title: A. Burakhan Koyuncu, Han Gao, Atanas Boev, Georgii Gaikov, Elena Alshina, Eckehard Steinbach
title_en: A. Burakhan Koyuncu, Han Gao, Atanas Boev, Georgii Gaikov, Elena Alshina, Eckehard Steinbach
abstract: 熵建模是高性能图像压缩算法的关键组成部分。近年来,自回归上下文建模的进展帮助基于学习的方法超越了其经典对应方法。然而,由于潜在空间-通道依赖性未被充分挖掘,以及上下文自适应性的次优实现,这些模型的性能仍有进一步提升的空间。受变压器自适应特性的启发,我们提出了一种基于变压器的上下文模型,命名为Contextformer,该模型将事实标准的注意力机制推广为空间-通道注意力。我们将现代压缩框架中的上下文模型替换为Contextformer,并在广泛使用的Kodak、CLIC2020和Tecnick图像数据集上进行测试。实验结果表明,所提出的模型相比标准通用视频编码(VVC)测试模型(VTM)16.2可实现高达11%的码率节省,并在PSNR和MS-SSIM指标上优于各种基于学习的模型。
abstract_en: Entropy modeling is a key component for high-performance image compression algorithms. Recent developments in autoregressive context modeling helped learning-based methods to surpass their classical counterparts. However, the performance of those models can be further improved due to the underexploited spatio-channel dependencies in latent space, and the suboptimal implementation of context adaptivity. Inspired by the adaptive characteristics of the transformers, we propose a transformer-based context model, named Contextformer, which generalizes the de facto standard attention mechanism to spatio-channel attention. We replace the context model of a modern compression framework with the Contextformer and test it on the widely used Kodak, CLIC2020, and Tecnick image datasets. Our experimental results show that the proposed model provides up to 11% rate savings compared to the standard Versatile Video Coding (VVC) Test Model (VTM) 16.2, and outperforms various learning-based models in terms of PSNR and MS-SSIM.

title: AJ Piergiovanni, Kairo Morton, Weicheng Kuo, Michael S. Ryoo, Anelia Angelova
title_en: AJ Piergiovanni, Kairo Morton, Weicheng Kuo, Michael S. Ryoo, Anelia Angelova
abstract: 视频问答是一项具有挑战性的任务,需要同时理解语言输入、单个视频帧中的视觉信息以及视频中事件的时间信息。在本文中,我们提出了一种新颖的多流视频编码器,用于视频问答,该编码器使用多个视频输入和一种新的视频-文本迭代共标记方法,以回答与视频相关的各种问题。我们在多个数据集(如MSRVTT-QA、MSVD-QA、IVQA)上对模型进行了实验评估,显著超越了先前的最先进方法。同时,我们的模型将所需的GFLOPs从150-360降低到仅67,产生了一个高效的视频问答模型。
abstract_en: Video question answering is a challenging task that requires understanding jointly the language input, the visual information in individual video frames, as well as the temporal information about the events occurring in the video. In this paper, we propose a novel multi-stream video encoder for video question answering that uses multiple video inputs and a new video-text iterative co-tokenization approach to answer a variety of questions related to videos. We experimentally evaluate the model on several datasets, such as MSRVTT-QA, MSVD-QA, IVQA, outperforming the previous state-of-the-art by large margins. Simultaneously, our model reduces the required GFLOPs from 150-360 to only 67, producing a highly efficient video question answering model.

title: Aaron Walsman, Muru Zhang, Klemen Kotar, Karthik Desingh, Ali Farhadi, Dieter Fox
title_en: Aaron Walsman, Muru Zhang, Klemen Kotar, Karthik Desingh, Ali Farhadi, Dieter Fox
abstract: 对具有复杂空间关系的几何结构的视觉理解是人类智能的基本组成部分。在儿童时期,我们不仅通过观察学习如何推理结构,还通过与周围世界互动——拆解物体并重新组装它们——来理解结构。能够推理结构和组合性使我们不仅能够构建事物,还能理解和逆向工程复杂系统。为推进基于部件的几何理解的交互式推理研究,我们提出了一种新的具有挑战性的组装问题,称为Break and Make,该问题使用乐高积木进行。在此问题中,智能体被给予一个乐高模型,并通过交互式检查和拆解来理解其结构。在检查阶段后,智能体必须通过从头开始使用低级动作原语重建模型来证明其理解。为促进对此问题的研究,我们构建了LTRON,一个完全交互式的三维模拟器,允许学习智能体组装、拆解和操作乐高模型。我们将其与一个由网络上上传的粉丝制作的乐高创作新数据集结合,以提供包含超过一千种独特积木形状的复杂场景。我们使用序列到序列模型迈出了解决此问题的第一步,这些模型为如何在这一具有挑战性的问题上取得进展提供了指导。我们的模拟器和数据可在github.com/aaronwalsman/ltron获取。额外的训练代码和PyTorch示例可在github.com/aaronwalsman/ltron-torch-eccv22获取。
abstract_en: Visual understanding of geometric structures with complex spatial relationships is a fundamental component of human intelligence. As children, we learn how to reason about structure not only from observation, but also by interacting with the world around us - by taking things apart and putting them back together again. The ability to reason about structure and compositionality allows us to not only build things, but also understand and reverse-engineer complex systems. In order to advance research in interactive reasoning for part-based geometric understanding, we propose a challenging new assembly problem using LEGO bricks that we call Break and Make. In this problem an agent is given a LEGO model and attempts to understand its structure by interactively inspecting and disassembling it. After this inspection period, the agent must then prove its understanding by rebuilding the model from scratch using low-level action primitives. In order to facilitate research on this problem we have built \LTRON, a fully interactive 3D simulator that allows learning agents to assemble, disassemble and manipulate LEGO models. We pair this simulator with a new dataset of fan-made LEGO creations that have been uploaded to the internet in order to provide complex scenes containing over a thousand unique brick shapes. We take a first step towards solving this problem using sequence-to-sequence models that provide guidance for how to make progress on this challenging problem. Our simulator and data are available at github.com/aaronwalsman/ltron. Additional training code and PyTorch examples are available at github.com/aaronwalsman/ltron-torch-eccv22.

title: Abduallah Mohamed, Deyao Zhu, Warren Vu, Mohamed Elhoseiny, Christian Claudel
title_en: Abduallah Mohamed, Deyao Zhu, Warren Vu, Mohamed Elhoseiny, Christian Claudel
abstract: Best-of-N (BoN) 平均位移误差 (ADE)/ 最终位移误差 (FDE) 是目前评估轨迹预测模型最常用的指标。然而,BoN 无法量化生成样本的整体情况,导致对模型预测质量与性能的评估存在片面性。我们提出了一种新的指标——平均马氏距离 (AMD),以解决这一问题。AMD 是一种量化生成样本整体与真实轨迹接近程度的指标。我们还引入了平均最大特征值 (AMV) 指标,用于量化预测结果的整体分布范围。通过实验证明,ADE/FDE 对分布偏移不敏感,可能给出偏差的准确率感知,而 AMD/AMV 指标则能更准确地反映模型性能。我们引入隐式最大似然估计 (IMLE) 作为传统生成模型的替代方法,用于训练我们的模型 Social-Implicit。IMLE 训练机制与 AMD/AMV 的目标一致,即预测与真实轨迹接近且分布紧致的轨迹。Social-Implicit 是一种内存高效的深度模型,仅包含 5.8K 参数,可在约 580Hz 的实时频率下运行,并取得了具有竞争力的实验结果。
abstract_en: Best-of-N (BoN) Average Displacement Error (ADE)/ Final Displacement Error (FDE) is the most used metric for evaluating trajectory prediction models. Yet, the BoN does not quantify the whole generated samples, resulting in an incomplete view of the model’s prediction quality and performance. We propose a new metric, Average Mahalanobis Distance (AMD) to tackle this issue. AMD is a metric that quantifies how close the whole generated samples are to the ground truth. We also introduce the Average Maximum Eigenvalue (AMV) metric that quantifies the overall spread of the predictions. Our metrics are validated empirically by showing that the ADE/FDE is not sensitive to distribution shifts, giving a biased sense of accuracy, unlike the AMD/AMV metrics. We introduce the usage of Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation (IMLE) as a replacement for traditional generative models to train our model, Social-Implicit. IMLE training mechanism aligns with AMD/AMV objective of predicting trajectories that are close to the ground truth with a tight spread. Social-Implicit is a memory efficient deep model with only 5.8K parameters that runs in real time of about 580Hz and achieves competitive results.

title: Abhijay Ghildyal, Feng Liu
title_en: Abhijay Ghildyal, Feng Liu
abstract: 现有的感知相似性度量指标假设图像与其参考图像之间对齐良好。因此,这些指标通常对微小的对齐误差敏感,而这种误差对人眼是不可察觉的。本文研究了微小错位(特别是输入图像与参考图像之间的微小位移)对现有度量指标的影响,并据此开发了一种对位移鲁棒的相似性度量指标。本文基于广泛使用的LPIPS(学习感知相似性度量指标),探讨了架构设计方面的考虑,以使其对不可察觉的错位具有鲁棒性。具体而言,我们研究了多种神经网络元素,如抗混叠滤波、池化、步幅、填充和跳连,讨论了它们在构建鲁棒度量指标中的作用。基于我们的研究,我们开发了一种新的基于深度神经网络的感知相似性度量指标。实验表明,我们的度量指标在容忍不可察觉的位移的同时,与人类相似性判断保持一致。代码可在 https://tinyurl.com/5n85r28r 获取。
abstract_en: Existing perceptual similarity metrics assume an image and its reference are well aligned. As a result, these metrics are often sensitive to a small alignment error that is imperceptible to the human eyes. This paper studies the effect of small misalignment, specifically a small shift between the input and reference image, on existing metrics, and accordingly develops a shift-tolerant similarity metric. This paper builds upon LPIPS, a widely used learned perceptual similarity metric, and explores architectural design considerations to make it robust against imperceptible misalignment. Specifically, we study a wide spectrum of neural network elements, such as anti-aliasing filtering, pooling, striding, padding, and skip connection, and discuss their roles in making a robust metric. Based on our studies, we develop a new deep neural network-based perceptual similarity metric. Our experiments show that our metric is tolerant to imperceptible shifts while being consistent with the human similarity judgment. Code is available at https://tinyurl.com/5n85r28r.

title: Abhinav Kumar, Garrick Brazil, Enrique Corona, Armin Parchami, Xiaoming Liu
title_en: Abhinav Kumar, Garrick Brazil, Enrique Corona, Armin Parchami, Xiaoming Liu
abstract: 现代神经网络使用卷积等基本构建块,这些构建块对任意2D平移保持等变性。然而,这些原始块在射影流形中并不对任意3D平移保持等变性。即便如此,所有单目3D检测器都使用原始块来获取3D坐标,而这一任务并非原始块的设计目标。本文首次提出了在射影流形中对任意3D平移保持等变性的卷积方法。由于深度估计是单目检测中最困难的任务,本文提出了一种基于现有尺度等变可操控块构建的深度等变网络(DEVIANT)。因此,DEVIANT在射影流形中对深度平移保持等变性,而原始网络则不具备这一特性。额外的深度等变性迫使DEVIANT学习一致的深度估计,因此DEVIANT在KITTI和Waymo数据集的图像-only类别中实现了最先进的单目3D检测结果,并在使用额外信息的方法中表现出竞争力。此外,DEVIANT在跨数据集评估中表现优于原始网络。
abstract_en: Modern neural networks use building blocks such as convolutions that are equivariant to arbitrary 2D translations. However, these vanilla blocks are not equivariant to arbitrary 3D translations in the projective manifold. Even then, all monocular 3D detectors use vanilla blocks to obtain the 3D coordinates, a task for which the vanilla blocks are not designed for. This paper takes the first step towards convolutions equivariant to arbitrary 3D translations in the projective manifold. Since the depth is the hardest to estimate for monocular detection, this paper proposes Depth EquiVarIAnt NeTwork (DEVIANT) built with existing scale equivariant steerable blocks. As a result, DEVIANT is equivariant to the depth translations in the projective manifold whereas vanilla networks are not. The additional depth equivariance forces the DEVIANT to learn consistent depth estimates, and therefore, DEVIANT achieves state-of-the-art monocular 3D detection results on KITTI and Waymo datasets in the image-only category and performs competitively to methods using extra information. Moreover, DEVIANT works better than vanilla networks in cross-dataset evaluation.

title: Abhishek Singh, Ethan Garza, Ayush Chopra, Praneeth Vepakomma, Vivek Sharma, Ramesh Raskar
title_en: Abhishek Singh, Ethan Garza, Ayush Chopra, Praneeth Vepakomma, Vivek Sharma, Ramesh Raskar
abstract: 我们提出了一种名为sanitizer的数据净化框架,用于实现安全且与任务无关的数据发布。尽管数据集的发布在计算机视觉的各类应用中持续产生重要影响,但其效果主要体现在隐私顾虑未阻碍数据共享的情况下。我们通过两阶段流程缓解这些顾虑:首先,引入全局解耦阶段,将原始数据分解为敏感和非敏感的潜在表示;其次,设计局部采样阶段,通过差分隐私合成敏感信息,并将其与非敏感潜在特征融合,生成具有隐私保护的有用表示。这种新形成的潜在信息是原始数据集的与任务无关的表示,其中敏感信息已被匿名化。虽然大多数算法以任务依赖的方式进行数据净化,但少数任务无关的净化技术通过屏蔽敏感信息实现数据净化。在本工作中,我们证明如果能够私有地合成敏感信息,可以实现更优的隐私-效用权衡。我们通过在现有基准任务上超越现有基线方法,并展示现有技术无法实现的新任务,验证了sanitizer的有效性。
abstract_en: We propose sanitizer, a framework for secure and task-agnostic data release. While releasing datasets continues to make a big impact in various applications of computer vision, its impact is mostly realized when data sharing is not inhibited by privacy concerns. We alleviate these concerns by sanitizing datasets in a two-stage process. First, we introduce a global decoupling stage for decomposing raw data into sensitive and non-sensitive latent representations. Secondly, we design a local sampling stage to synthetically generate sensitive information with differential privacy and merge it with non-sensitive latent features to create a useful representation while preserving the privacy. This newly formed latent information is a task-agnostic representation of the original dataset with anonymized sensitive information. While most algorithms sanitize data in a task-dependent manner, a few task-agnostic sanitization techniques sanitize data by censoring sensitive information. In this work, we show that a better privacy-utility trade-off is achieved if sensitive information can be synthesized privately. We validate the effectiveness of the sanitizer by outperforming state-of-the-art baselines on the existing benchmark tasks and demonstrating tasks that are not possible using existing techniques.

title: Adam W. Harley, 方兆远, Katerina Fragkiadaki
title_en: Adam W. Harley, Zhaoyuan Fang, Katerina Fragkiadaki
abstract: 视频中像素跟踪通常被研究为光流估计问题,其中每个像素通过一个位移向量描述其在下一帧中的位置。尽管更宽的时序上下文信息可自由获取,但以往尝试利用这一信息的方法仅在双帧方法基础上获得有限提升。本文重新审视了Sand和Teller的"粒子视频"方法,将像素跟踪视为长程运动估计问题,其中每个像素通过一条轨迹描述其在多个未来帧中的位置。我们使用当前光流和目标跟踪领域最先进的组件重建这一经典方法,包括密集成本图、迭代优化和学习的外观更新。我们通过从现有光流数据中挖掘长程无模点轨迹,并合成多帧遮挡进行数据增强来训练模型。我们在轨迹估计基准测试和关键点标签传播任务中验证了该方法,并在光流和特征跟踪方法中表现出优越性能。
abstract_en: Tracking pixels in videos is typically studied as an optical flow estimation problem, where every pixel is described with a displacement vector that locates it in the next frame. Even though wider temporal context is freely available, prior efforts to take this into account have yielded only small gains over 2-frame methods. In this paper, we revisit Sand and Teller’s ""particle video"" approach, and study pixel tracking as a long-range motion estimation problem, where every pixel is described with a trajectory that locates it in multiple future frames. We re-build this classic approach using components that drive the current state-of-the-art in flow and object tracking, such as dense cost maps, iterative optimization, and learned appearance updates. We train our models using long-range amodal point trajectories mined from existing optical flow data that we synthetically augment with multi-frame occlusions. We test our approach in trajectory estimation benchmarks and in keypoint label propagation tasks, and compare favorably against state-of-the-art optical flow and feature tracking methods.

title: Adil Kaan Akan, Fatma Güney
title_en: Adil Kaan Akan, Fatma Güney
abstract: 在自动驾驶领域,预测车辆周围所有代理体的位置和运动状态是规划的关键要求。近期,一种新的感知与预测联合建模方法应运而生,通过融合多摄像头获取的丰富感官信息,将其压缩为紧凑的俯视图表示以执行预测。然而,随着预测时间范围的延长,由于存在多种可能的预测结果,未来预测的质量会随时间下降。在本工作中,我们通过随机时间模型来应对未来预测中的固有不确定性。我们的模型通过每个时间步的随机残差更新,在潜在空间中学习时间动态。通过在每个时间步从学习到的分布中进行采样,我们获得了更具多样性和准确性的未来预测结果,尤其在场景中更远的空间区域和更长的时间范围内表现优于先前工作。尽管对每个时间步进行独立处理,但通过将动态学习与未来预测生成解耦,我们的模型仍保持高效性。
abstract_en: In self-driving, predicting future in terms of location and motion of all the agents around the vehicle is a crucial requirement for planning. Recently, a new joint formulation of perception and prediction has emerged by fusing rich sensory information perceived from multiple cameras into a compact bird’s-eye view representation to perform prediction. However, the quality of future predictions degrades over time while extending to longer time horizons due to multiple plausible predictions. In this work, we address this inherent uncertainty in future predictions with a stochastic temporal model. Our model learns temporal dynamics in a latent space through stochastic residual updates at each time step. By sampling from a learned distribution at each time step, we obtain more diverse future predictions that are also more accurate compared to previous work, especially stretching both spatially further regions in the scene and temporally over longer time horizons. Despite separate processing of each time step, our model is still efficient through decoupling of the learning of dynamics and the generation of future predictions.

title: Aditi Basu Bal, Ramy Mounir, Sathyanarayanan Aakur, Sudeep Sarkar, Anuj Srivastava
title_en: Aditi Basu Bal, Ramy Mounir, Sathyanarayanan Aakur, Sudeep Sarkar, Anuj Srivastava
abstract: 基于图的表示方法在视频数据的表示和分析中越来越受欢迎,尤其是在目标跟踪和场景理解应用中。因此,该方法中的一个关键工具是为与视频相关的图形时间序列生成统计推断。本文开发了一种卡尔曼平滑方法,用于从噪声、杂乱和不完整的数据中估计图形。主要挑战在于在存在由于虚假节点和缺失节点导致的噪声和杂乱数据时,找到并保持节点(显著检测到的对象)在时间帧之间的注册。首先,我们引入了一种图的商空间表示,该表示结合了节点的时间注册,并利用该度量结构在图形演化上施加动态模型。然后,我们推导出一种适应于商空间几何的卡尔曼平滑器,以估计密集且平滑的图形轨迹。我们使用模拟数据和从多视角扩展视频活动(MEVA)数据集中提取的实际视频图来演示该框架。该框架即使在存在噪声、杂乱和漏检的情况下也能成功估计图形。关键词:运动跟踪,图表示,视频图,商度量,卡尔曼平滑,非线性流形。
abstract_en: Graph-based representations are becoming increasingly popular for representing and analyzing video data, especially in object tracking and scene understanding applications. Accordingly, an essential tool in this approach is to generate statistical inferences for graphical time series associated with videos. This paper develops a Kalman-smoothing method for estimating graphs from noisy, cluttered, and incomplete data. The main challenge here is to find and preserve the registration of nodes (salient detected objects) across time frames when the data has noise and clutter due to false and missing nodes. First, we introduce a quotient-space representation of graphs that incorporates temporal registration of nodes, and we use that metric structure to impose a dynamical model on graph evolution. Then, we derive a Kalman smoother, adapted to the quotient space geometry, to estimate dense, smooth trajectories of graphs. We demonstrate this framework using simulated data and actual video graphs extracted from the Multiview Extended Video with Activities (MEVA) dataset. This framework successfully estimates graphs despite the noise, clutter, and missed detections. Keywords: motion tracking, graph representations, video graphs, quotient metrics, Kalman smoothing, nonlinear manifolds.

title: Adrian Bulat, Shiyang Cheng, Jing Yang, Andrew Garbett, Enrique Sanchez, Georgios Tzimiropoulos
title_en: Adrian Bulat, Shiyang Cheng, Jing Yang, Andrew Garbett, Enrique Sanchez, Georgios Tzimiropoulos
abstract: 如何学习一种通用的人脸表示?近期在人脸分析领域的深度学习研究主要聚焦于特定任务(如人脸识别、面部关键点定位等)的监督学习,却忽视了如何找到一种可快速适应多种人脸分析任务和数据集的人脸表示这一核心问题。为此,我们做出以下四点贡献:(a) 首次引入一个包含5项重要人脸分析任务的综合性评估基准,用于人脸表示学习;(b) 系统研究了两种大规模人脸表示学习方法:监督学习与无监督预训练。重要的是,我们重点关注小样本人脸学习的评估场景;(c) 探究了训练数据集的重要属性,包括其规模和质量(标注、未标注或甚至未整理的数据);(d) 为得出结论,我们进行了大量实验。我们的主要发现是:(1) 在完全野外、未整理数据上进行无监督预训练,可为所有考虑的人脸任务提供一致且在某些情况下显著的准确率提升;(2) 许多现有面部视频数据集似乎存在大量冗余。我们将发布代码、预训练模型和数据以促进未来研究。
abstract_en: What is the best way to learn a universal face representation? Recent work on Deep Learning in the area of face analysis has focused on supervised learning for specific tasks of interest (e.g. face recognition, facial landmark localization etc.) but has overlooked the overarching question of how to find a facial representation that can be readily adapted to several facial analysis tasks and datasets. To this end, we make the following 4 contributions: (a) we introduce, for the first time, a comprehensive evaluation benchmark for facial representation learning consisting of 5 important face analysis tasks. (b) We systematically investigate two ways of large-scale representation learning applied to faces: supervised and unsupervised pre-training. Importantly, we focus our evaluations on the case of few-shot facial learning. (c) We investigate important properties of the training datasets including their size and quality (labelled, unlabelled or even uncurated). (d) To draw our conclusions, we conducted a very large number of experiments. Our main two findings are: (1) Unsupervised pre-training on completely in-the-wild, uncurated data provides consistent and, in some cases, significant accuracy improvements for all facial tasks considered. (2) Many existing facial video datasets seem to have a large amount of redundancy. We will release code, pre-trained models and data to facilitate future research.

title: Adyasha Maharana, Darryl Hannan, Mohit Bansal
title_en: Adyasha Maharana, Darryl Hannan, Mohit Bansal
abstract: 文本到图像合成领域的最新进展催生了具有出色能力的大型预训练变压器,能够根据给定文本生成可视化图像。然而,这些模型在需要代理根据对应文本序列生成图像序列以形成叙事的故事可视化等专业任务中表现不佳。此外,我们发现故事可视化任务难以推广到新叙事中的未见过的情节和角色。因此,我们首先提出故事延续任务,该任务通过源图像条件生成视觉故事,从而更好地推广到包含新角色的叙事。随后,我们通过任务特定模块增强或“反向适配”预训练文本到图像合成模型,包括(a)序列图像生成和(b)从初始帧复制相关元素。我们探索了全模型微调以及基于提示的微调(参数高效适配)方法。我们在两个现有数据集PororoSV和FlintstonesSV上评估我们的方法StoryDALL-E,并引入了从视频字幕数据集中收集的新数据集DiDeMoSV。我们还开发了基于生成对抗网络(GAN)的模型StoryGANc用于故事延续,并与StoryDALL-E模型进行比较以展示我们方法的优势。我们证明,我们的反向适配方法在故事延续任务中优于基于GAN的模型。我们还表明,反向适配方法能够从源图像复制视觉元素并提升视觉帧的连贯性。最后,我们的分析表明,预训练变压器在理解包含多个角色的叙事并将其转化为适当图像方面存在困难。我们的工作鼓励未来对故事延续任务和大规模模型的研究。
abstract_en: Recent advances in text-to-image synthesis have led to large pretrained transformers with excellent capabilities to generate visualizations from a given text. However, these models are ill-suited for specialized tasks like story visualization, which requires an agent to produce a sequence of images given a corresponding sequence of captions, forming a narrative. Moreover, we find that the story visualization task fails to accommodate generalization to unseen plots and characters in new narratives. Hence, we first propose the task of story continuation, where the generated visual story is conditioned on a source image, allowing for better generalization to narratives with new characters. Then, we enhance or ‘retro-fit’ the pretrained text-to-image synthesis models with task-specific modules for (a) sequential image generation and (b) copying relevant elements from an initial frame. We explore full-model finetuning, as well as prompt-based tuning for parameter-efficient adaptation, of the pretrained model. We evaluate our approach StoryDALL-E on two existing datasets, PororoSV and FlintstonesSV, and introduce a new dataset DiDeMoSV collected from a video-captioning dataset. We also develop a model StoryGANc based on Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) for story continuation, and compare with the StoryDALL-E model to demonstrate the advantages of our approach. We show that our retro-fitting approach outperforms GAN-based models for story continuation. We also demonstrate that the ‘retro-fitting’ approach facilitates copying of visual elements from the source image and improved continuity in visual frames. Finally, our analysis suggests that pretrained transformers struggle with comprehending narratives containing multiple characters, and translating them into appropriate imagery. Our work encourages future research into story continuation and large-scale models for the task.

title: Adéla Šubrtová, David Futschik, Jan Čech, Michal Lukáč, Eli Shechtman, Daniel Sýkora
title_en: Adéla Šubrtová, David Futschik, Jan Čech, Michal Lukáč, Eli Shechtman, Daniel Sýkora
abstract: 我们提出了一种名为ChunkyGAN的新范式,用于利用生成对抗网络对图像进行建模和编辑。与之前寻求输入图像全局潜在表示的技术不同,我们的方法将输入图像细分为一组较小的组件(块),这些块可以手动或通过预训练的分割网络自动指定。对于每个块,由于约束条件较少,生成网络的潜在编码可以在局部更精确地估计。此外,在优化潜在编码的过程中,分割还可以进一步细化以提高匹配质量。这一过程使得原始图像能够实现空间解耦的高质量投影,这是以往方法难以实现的。为了展示我们方法的优势,我们在各种图像编辑场景中进行了定量和定性评估,这些场景受益于该方法更高的重建质量和局部特性。我们的方法足够灵活,甚至可以操控那些使用全局技术难以重建的领域外图像。
abstract_en: We present ChunkyGAN-a novel paradigm for modeling and editing images using generative adversarial networks. Unlike previous techniques seeking a global latent representation of the input image, our approach subdivides the input image into a set of smaller components (chunks) specified either manually or automatically using a pre-trained segmentation network. For each chunk, the latent code of a generative network is estimated locally with greater accuracy thanks to a smaller number of constraints. Moreover, during the optimization of latent codes, segmentation can further be refined to improve matching quality. This process enables high-quality projection of the original image with spatial disentanglement that previous methods would find challenging to achieve. To demonstrate the advantage of our approach, we evaluated it quantitatively and also qualitatively in various image editing scenarios that benefit from the higher reconstruction quality and local nature of the approach. Our method is flexible enough to manipulate even out-of-domain images that would be hard to reconstruct using global techniques.

title: Ahmed A. A. Osman, Timo Bolkart, Dimitrios Tzionas, Michael J. Black
title_en: Ahmed A. A. Osman, Timo Bolkart, Dimitrios Tzionas, Michael J. Black
abstract: 头部、手部和全身的统计3D形状模型在计算机视觉和图形学中被广泛应用。尽管应用广泛,我们证明现有头部和手部模型无法捕捉这些部位的完整运动范围。此外,现有研究大多忽视了脚部,而脚部对于建模人体运动至关重要,并在生物力学、动画和鞋类行业中有广泛应用。问题在于,先前的身体部位模型是使用隔离个体部位的3D扫描数据进行训练的。此类数据无法捕捉这些部位的完整运动范围,例如头部相对于颈部的运动。我们的观察表明,全身扫描提供了关于身体部位运动的重要信息。因此,我们提出了一种新的学习方案,利用全身和身体部位扫描的联邦数据集,联合训练全身模型和特定部位模型。具体而言,我们训练了一个名为SUPR(稀疏统一基于部位的表示)的表达性人体模型,其中每个关节严格影响模型顶点的稀疏集合。这种因子化表示使得SUPR可以拆分为一系列身体部位模型:一个表达性头部(SUPR-Head)、一个可动手(SUPR-Hand)和一个新颖的脚部(SUPR-Foot)。需要注意的是,脚部研究较少,现有3D人体模型的脚部高度欠驱动。利用新颖的脚部4D扫描数据,我们训练了一个扩展运动学树的模型,以捕捉脚趾的运动范围。此外,脚部会因地面接触而发生形变。为了建模这种形变,我们引入了一种新颖的非线性变形函数,该函数根据脚部姿态、形状和地面接触状态预测脚部形变。我们在前所未有的120万次身体、头部、手部和脚部扫描数据上训练SUPR。我们定量比较了SUPR及其单独的身体部位模型与现有表达性人体模型和身体部位模型,发现我们的模型套件在泛化能力和捕捉身体部位完整运动范围方面表现更优。SUPR已公开用于研究目的。
abstract_en: Statistical 3D shape models of the head, hands, and full body are widely used in computer vision and graphics. Despite their wide use, we show that existing models of the head and hands fail to capture the full range of motion for these parts. Moreover, existing work largely ignores the feet, which are crucial for modeling human movement and have applications in biomechanics, animation, and the footwear industry. The problem is that previous body part models are trained using 3D scans that are isolated to the individual parts. Such data does not capture the full range of motion for such parts, e.g. the motion of head relative to the neck. Our observation is that full-body scans provide important information about the motion of the body parts. Consequently, we propose a new learning scheme that jointly trains a full-body model and specific part models using a federated dataset of full-body and body-part scans. Specifically, we train an expressive human body model called SUPR (Sparse Unified Part-Based Representation), where each joint strictly influences a sparse set of model vertices. The factorized representation enables separating SUPR into an entire suite of body part models: an expressive head (SUPR-Head), an articulated hand (SUPR-Hand), and a novel foot (SUPR-Foot). Note that feet have received little attention and existing 3D body models have highly under-actuated feet. Using novel 4D scans of feet, we train a model with an extended kinematic tree that captures the range of motion of the toes. Additionally, feet deform due to ground contact. To model this, we include a novel non-linear deformation function that predicts foot deformation conditioned on the foot pose, shape, and ground contact. We train SUPR on an unprecedented number of scans: 1.2 million body, head, hand and foot scans. We quantitatively compare SUPR and the separate body parts to existing expressive human body models and body-part models and find that our suite of models generalizes better and captures the body parts’ full range of motion. SUPR is publicly available for research purposes.

title: 基于硬件感知的神经网络架构搜索框架
title_en: Ahmet Caner Yüzügüler, Nikolaos Dimitriadis, Pascal Frossard
abstract: 在目标平台实现高性能深度神经网络(DNN)推理的关键在于优化资源利用率。尽管已有针对推理延迟、内存占用和能耗的优化方法,但先前的硬件感知神经网络架构搜索(NAS)方法忽略了资源利用率,导致DNN无法充分利用目标推理平台。高效且准确地建模资源利用率具有挑战性,尤其是在广泛使用的基于数组的推理加速器(如Google TPU)中。在本文中,我们提出了一种新颖的硬件感知NAS框架,不仅优化任务准确性与推理延迟,还优化资源利用率。我们还提出并验证了推理加速器中资源利用率的新计算模型。通过使用所提出的NAS框架和资源利用率模型,我们在CIFAR-10和ImageNet-100数据集上的图像分类任务中,相比先前的硬件感知NAS方法实现了2.8-4倍的推理加速,同时保持了相似或更高的准确性。
abstract_en: Optimizing resource utilization in target platforms is key to achieving high performance during DNN inference. While optimizations have been proposed for inference latency, memory footprint, and energy consumption, prior hardware-aware neural architecture search (NAS) methods have omitted resource utilization, preventing DNNs to take full advantage of the target inference platforms. Modeling resource utilization efficiently and accurately is challenging, especially for widely-used array-based inference accelerators such as Google TPU. In this work, we propose a novel hardware-aware NAS framework that does not only optimize for task accuracy and inference latency, but also for resource utilization. We also propose and validate a new computational model for resource utilization in inference accelerators. By using the proposed NAS framework and the proposed resource utilization model, we achieve 2.8 - 4x speedup for DNN inference compared to prior hardware-aware NAS methods while attaining similar or improved accuracy in image classification on CIFAR-10 and Imagenet-100 datasets.

title: 毛爱华, 杜子慧, 文宇辉, 徐俊, 刘永进
title_en: Aihua Mao, Zihui Du, Yu-Hui Wen, Jun Xuan, Yong-Jin Liu
abstract: 点云去噪旨在从受噪声和异常值干扰的原始观测中恢复干净的点云,同时保留细粒度细节。我们提出了一种基于深度学习的新型去噪模型,该模型结合了归一化流和噪声解耦技术,以实现高精度的去噪效果。与现有工作通过提取点云特征进行逐点校正不同,我们从分布学习和特征解耦的角度出发构建去噪过程。通过将噪声点云视为干净点与噪声的联合分布,去噪结果可从潜在点表示中解耦噪声成分获得,而欧几里得空间与潜在空间之间的映射则通过归一化流建模。我们在合成3D模型和多种噪声设置下的真实世界数据集上评估了该方法。定性与定量结果表明,我们的方法在细节保留和分布均匀性方面均超越了先前最先进的深度学习方法。源代码可在https://github.com/unknownue/pdflow获取。
abstract_en: Point cloud denoising aims to restore clean point clouds from raw observations corrupted by noise and outliers while preserving the fine-grained details. We present a novel deep learning-based denoising model, that incorporates normalizing flows and noise disentanglement techniques to achieve high denoising accuracy. Unlike the existing works that extract features of point clouds for point-wise correction, we formulate the denoising process from the perspective of distribution learning and feature disentanglement. By considering noisy point clouds as a joint distribution of clean points and noise, the denoised results can be derived from disentangling the noise counterpart from latent point representation, whereas the mapping between Euclidean and latent spaces is modeled by normalizing flows. We evaluate our method on synthesized 3D models and real-world datasets with various noise settings. Qualitative and quantitative results show that our method surpasses previous state-of-the-art deep learning-based approaches in terms of detail preservation and distribution uniformity. The source code is available at https://github.com/unknownue/pdflow.

title: Aikaterini Adam, Torsten Sattler, Konstantinos Karantzalos, Tomas Pajdla
title_en: Aikaterini Adam, Torsten Sattler, Konstantinos Karantzalos, Tomas Pajdla
abstract: AR/VR应用和机器人需要知道场景何时发生变化。例如,当物体被移动、添加或移除时。我们提出了一种仅基于场景变化的3D物体发现方法。我们的方法不需要对什么是物体进行任何假设,而是通过利用其一致的移动来发现物体。变化最初被检测为深度图中的差异,并在发生刚性运动时被分割为物体。图割优化将变化标签传播到几何一致的区域。实验表明,我们的方法在3RScan数据集上相对于竞争基线达到了最先进的性能。我们的方法的源代码可在https://github.com/katadam/ObjectsCanMove找到。
abstract_en: AR/VR applications and robots need to know when the scene has changed. An example is when objects are moved, added, or removed from the scene. We propose a 3D object discovery method that is based only on scene changes. Our method does not need to encode any assumptions about what is an object, but rather discovers objects by exploiting their coherent move. Changes are initially detected as differences in the depth maps and segmented as objects if they undergo rigid motions. A graph cut optimization propagates the changing labels to geometrically consistent regions. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the 3RScan dataset against competitive baselines. The source code of our method can be found at https://github.com/katadam/ObjectsCanMove.

title: Ailin Deng, Shen Li, Miao Xiong, Zhirui Chen, Bryan Hooi
title_en: Ailin Deng, Shen Li, Miao Xiong, Zhirui Chen, Bryan Hooi
abstract: 可信机器学习对于深度学习模型的实际部署至关重要。尽管最先进的模型在准确率方面表现出令人惊叹的性能,但近期文献揭示其预测置信度评分往往不可靠:例如,在错误预测时常常过度自信,甚至对明显异常值也是如此。在本文中,我们引入了一种新的__TITLE_MATH_1__方法,使我们能够检查并缓解训练模型的过度自信问题,从而提高其可信度。我们提供了一个简单而有效的框架,可以灵活地以即插即用的方式应用于现有的可信度相关方法。在多个基准测试中针对三个可信度相关任务(误分类检测、校准和分布外检测)进行的大量实验验证了我们提出的探针框架的有效性。
abstract_en: Trustworthy machine learning is of primary importance to the practical deployment of deep learning models. While state-of-the-art models achieve astonishingly good performance in terms of accuracy, recent literature reveals that their predictive confidence scores unfortunately cannot be trusted: e.g., they are often overconfident when wrong predictions are made, or so even for obvious outliers. In this paper, we introduce a new approach of \emph{self-supervised probing}, which enables us to check and mitigate the overconfidence issue for a trained model, thereby improving its trustworthiness. We provide a simple yet effective framework, which can be flexibly applied to existing trustworthiness-related methods in a plug-and-play manner. Extensive experiments on three trustworthiness-related tasks (misclassification detection, calibration and out-of-distribution detection) across various benchmarks verify the effectiveness of our proposed probing framework.

title: Zeng Ailing, Yang Lei, Ju Xuan, Li Jiefeng, Wang Jianyi, Xu Qiang
title_en: Ailing Zeng, Lei Yang, Xuan Ju, Jiefeng Li, Jianyi Wang, Qiang Xu
abstract: 在分析人体运动视频时,现有姿态估计器的输出抖动在不同帧之间存在高度不平衡的估计误差。视频中的大多数帧相对容易估计,仅表现出轻微抖动。相反,对于罕见或被遮挡的动作,多个关节的估计位置在连续帧序列中与真实值存在显著偏差,导致明显的抖动。为解决这一问题,我们提出将专门的时序仅精炼网络附加到现有姿态估计器以抑制抖动,命名为SmoothNet。与现有基于学习的解决方案不同,后者通过时空模型联合优化所有关节的单帧精度和时序平滑性,SmoothNet通过学习每个关节的长程时间关系,无需考虑关节间噪声相关性,建模人体运动的自然平滑性特征。借助一个简单而有效的运动感知全连接网络,SmoothNet显著提升了现有姿态估计器的时序平滑性,并作为副作用增强了挑战性帧的估计精度。此外,作为时序仅模型,SmoothNet的独特优势在于其在各类估计器和数据集间的强迁移能力。在2D和3D姿态估计及身体恢复任务中,针对五个数据集和十一组流行主干网络的全面实验验证了所提方案的有效性。代码可在https://github.com/cure-lab/SmoothNet获取。
abstract_en: When analyzing human motion videos, the output jitters from existing pose estimators are highly-unbalanced with varied estimation errors across frames. Most frames in a video are relatively easy to estimate and only suffer from slight jitters. In contrast, for rarely seen or occluded actions, the estimated positions of multiple joints largely deviate from the ground truth values for a consecutive sequence of frames, rendering significant jitters on them. To tackle this problem, we propose to attach a dedicated temporal-only refinement network to existing pose estimators for jitter mitigation, named SmoothNet. Unlike existing learning-based solutions that employ spatio-temporal models to co-optimize per-frame precision and temporal smoothness at all the joints, SmoothNet models the natural smoothness characteristics in body movements by learning the long-range temporal relations of every joint without considering the noisy correlations among joints. With a simple yet effective motion-aware fully-connected network, SmoothNet improves the temporal smoothness of existing pose estimators significantly and enhances the estimation accuracy of those challenging frames as a side-effect. Moreover, as a temporal-only model, a unique advantage of SmoothNet is its strong transferability across various types of estimators and datasets. Comprehensive experiments on five datasets with eleven popular backbone networks across 2D and 3D pose estimation and body recovery tasks demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed solution. Code is available at https://github.com/cure-lab/SmoothNet.

title: Ailing Zeng, Xuan Ju, Lei Yang, Ruiyuan Gao, Xizhou Zhu, Bo Dai, Qiang Xu
title_en: Ailing Zeng, Xuan Ju, Lei Yang, Ruiyuan Gao, Xizhou Zhu, Bo Dai, Qiang Xu
abstract: 本文提出了一种基于视频的2D/3D人体姿态估计的简单基线框架DeciWatch,该框架在不降低性能的前提下,相比现有方法实现了10倍的效率提升。与当前逐帧估计视频帧的解决方案不同,DeciWatch引入了一种简单而有效的采样-去噪-恢复框架,仅关注稀疏采样的帧,利用人体运动的连续性和轻量级姿态表示。具体而言,DeciWatch均匀采样少于10%的视频帧进行详细估计,利用高效的Transformer架构对估计的2D/3D姿态进行去噪,然后通过另一个基于Transformer的网络准确恢复其余帧。在三个基于视频的人体姿态估计和身体网格恢复任务中,使用四个数据集的综合实验结果验证了DeciWatch的效率和有效性。代码可在https://github.com/cure-lab/DeciWatch获取。
abstract_en: This paper proposes a simple baseline framework for video-based 2D/3D human pose estimation that can achieve 10 times efficiency improvement over existing works without any performance degradation, named DeciWatch. Unlike current solutions that estimate each frame in a video, DeciWatch introduces a simple yet effective sample-denoise-recover framework that only watches sparsely sampled frames, taking advantage of the continuity of human motions and the lightweight pose representation. Specifically, DeciWatch uniformly samples less than 10% video frames for detailed estimation, denoises the estimated 2D/3D poses with an efficient Transformer architecture, and then accurately recovers the rest of the frames using another Transformer-based network. Comprehensive experimental results on three video-based human pose estimation and body mesh recovery tasks with four datasets validate the efficiency and effectiveness of DeciWatch. Code is available at https://github.com/cure-lab/DeciWatch.

title: Aisha Urooj, Hilde Kuehne, Chuang Gan, Niels Da Vitoria Lobo, Mubarak Shah
title_en: Aisha Urooj, Hilde Kuehne, Chuang Gan, Niels Da Vitoria Lobo, Mubarak Shah
abstract: 基于Transformer的视觉-语言表示学习在视觉问答(VQA)和定位任务中受到广泛关注并展现出卓越性能。然而,大多数在这些任务中表现优异的系统仍依赖预训练目标检测器进行训练,这限制了其对检测器可用目标类别的适用性。为缓解这一局限性,本文聚焦于Transformer框架下弱监督定位问题。我们的方法通过将每个视觉标记转换为胶囊表示,利用语言自注意力层的激活作为文本引导选择模块,在传递至下一层前对这些胶囊进行掩码处理。我们在具有挑战性的GQA数据集以及VQA-HAT数据集上评估了该方法。实验表明:从标准Transformer架构中移除被掩码对象的信息会导致性能显著下降,而整合胶囊机制显著提升了此类系统的定位能力,并在该领域其他方法中取得了新的最先进结果。
abstract_en: Transformers for visual-language representation learning have been getting a lot of interest and shown tremendous performance on visual question answering (VQA) and grounding. However, most systems that show good performance of those tasks still rely on pre-trained object detectors during training, which limits their applicability to the object classes available for those detectors. To mitigate this limitation, this paper focuses on the problem of weakly supervised grounding in the context of visual question answering in transformers. Our approach leverages capsules by transforming each visual token into a capsule representation in the visual encoder; it then uses activations from language self-attention layers as a text-guided selection module to mask those capsules before they are forwarded to the next layer. We evaluate our approach on the challenging GQA as well as VQA-HAT dataset for VQA grounding. Our experiments show that: while removing the information of masked objects from standard transformer architectures leads to a significant drop in performance, the integration of capsules significantly improves the grounding ability of such systems and provides new state-of-the-art results compared to other approaches in the field.

title: Akshat Dave, Yongyi Zhao, Ashok Veeraraghavan
title_en: Akshat Dave, Yongyi Zhao, Ashok Veeraraghavan
abstract: 从多张图像中重建物体的几何结构和外观,也称为逆渲染,是计算机图形学和视觉中的基础问题。逆渲染本质上是病态的,因为捕获的图像是由未知的光照、材质属性和场景几何结构复杂函数决定的。近年来,通过坐标基神经网络表示场景的进展促进了逆渲染,实现了令人印象深刻的几何重建和新视角合成。我们的关键洞察是偏振是神经逆渲染的有用线索,因为偏振强烈依赖于表面法线,并且对漫反射和镜面反射具有独特性。随着商用片上偏振传感器的出现,捕获偏振变得实用。我们提出PANDORA,一种基于隐式神经表示的偏振逆渲染方法。从物体的多视角偏振图像中,PANDORA联合提取物体的3D几何结构,将出射辐射分解为漫反射和镜面反射,并估计入射光照。我们证明PANDORA在辐射分解技术中优于现有最先进的方法。PANDORA输出无纹理伪影的干净表面重建,准确建模强镜面反射,并在实际无结构场景下估计光照。
abstract_en: Reconstructing an object’s geometry and appearance from multiple images, also known as inverse rendering, is a fundamental problem in computer graphics and vision. Inverse rendering is inherently ill-posed because the captured image is an intricate function of unknown lighting, material properties and scene geometry. Recent progress in representing scene through coordinate-based neural networks has facilitated inverse rendering resulting in impressive geometry reconstruction and novel-view synthesis. Our key insight is that polarization is a useful cue for neural inverse rendering as polarization strongly depends on surface normals and is distinct for diffuse and specular reflectance. With the advent of commodity on-chip polarization sensors, capturing polarization has become practical. We propose PANDORA, a polarimetric inverse rendering approach based on implicit neural representations. From multi-view polarization images of an object, PANDORA jointly extracts the object’s 3D geometry, separates the outgoing radiance into diffuse and specular and estimates the incident illumination. We show that PANDORA outperforms state-of-the-art radiance decomposition techniques. PANDORA outputs clean surface reconstructions free from texture artefacts, models strong specularities accurately and estimates illumination under practical unstructured scenarios.

title: Alejandro Pardo, Fabian Caba, Juan León Alcázar, Ali Thabet, Bernard Ghanem
title_en: Alejandro Pardo, Fabian Caba, Juan León Alcázar, Ali Thabet, Bernard Ghanem
abstract: 理解电影及其结构模式是解码视频编辑技艺的关键任务。尽管已有研究开发了用于一般分析的工具,例如在镜头级别检测角色或识别电影摄影特性,但对最基本的视频编辑——剪辑(Cut)的理解却投入较少。本文引入了剪辑类型识别任务,该任务需要建模多模态信息。为了推动这一新任务的研究,我们构建了一个大规模数据集,称为MovieCuts,其中包含173,967个视频片段,这些片段由电影行业专业人士定义的十种剪辑类型进行标注。我们对一系列音频-视觉方法进行了基准测试,包括处理该问题多模态特性的方法。我们的最佳模型达到了47.7%的mAP,这表明该任务具有挑战性,实现高度准确的剪辑类型识别仍是一个开放的研究问题。自动剪辑类型识别技术的进步可以为视频编辑行业带来新的体验,例如电影分析用于教育、视频重新剪辑、虚拟电影摄影、机器辅助预告片生成和机器辅助视频编辑等。我们的数据和代码已公开:https://github.com/PardoAlejo/MovieCuts。
abstract_en: Understanding movies and their structural patterns is a crucial task in decoding the craft of video editing. While previous works have developed tools for general analysis, such as detecting characters or recognizing cinematography properties at the shot level, less effort has been devoted to understanding the most basic video edit, the Cut. This paper introduces the Cut type recognition task, which requires modeling multi-modal information. To ignite research in this new task, we construct a large-scale dataset called MovieCuts, which contains 173,967 video clips labeled with ten cut types defined by professionals in the movie industry. We benchmark a set of audio-visual approaches, including some dealing with the problem’s multi-modal nature. Our best model achieves 47.7% mAP, which suggests that the task is challenging and that attaining highly accurate Cut type recognition is an open research problem. Advances in automatic Cut-type recognition can unleash new experiences in the video editing industry, such as movie analysis for education, video re-editing, virtual cinematography, machine-assisted trailer generation, and machine-assisted video editing, among others. Our data and code are publicly available: https://github.com/PardoAlejo/MovieCuts.

title: Aleksandr Kim, Guillem Brasó, Aljoša Ošep, Laura Leal-Taixé
title_en: Aleksandr Kim, Guillem Brasó, Aljoša Ošep, Laura Leal-Taixé
abstract: 大多数(三维)多目标跟踪方法依赖于基于外观的线索进行数据关联。相比之下,我们研究仅通过在三维空间中编码物体之间的几何关系作为数据驱动的数据关联线索,能够达到多大程度的性能。我们将三维检测结果编码为图中的节点,其中物体之间的空间和时间成对关系通过图边上的局部极坐标进行编码。这种表示方法使我们的几何关系对全局变换和轨迹平滑变化具有不变性,尤其是在非全驱运动情况下。这使得我们的图神经网络能够有效编码时间与空间交互,并充分利用上下文和运动线索,通过将数据关联问题建模为边分类来获得最终场景解释。我们在nuScenes数据集上建立了新的SOTA,并且更重要的是,展示了我们的方法PolarMOT在不同地点(波士顿、新加坡、卡尔斯鲁厄)和数据集(nuScenes和KITTI)之间具有显著的泛化能力。
abstract_en: Most (3D) multi-object tracking methods rely on appearance-based cues for data association. By contrast, we investigate how far we can get by only encoding geometric relationships between objects in 3D space as cues for data-driven data association. We encode 3D detections as nodes in a graph, where spatial and temporal pairwise relations among objects are encoded via localized polar coordinates on graph edges. This representation makes our geometric relations invariant to global transformations and smooth trajectory changes, especially under non-holonomic motion. This allows our graph neural network to learn to effectively encode temporal and spatial interactions and fully leverage contextual and motion cues to obtain final scene interpretation by posing data association as edge classification. We establish a new state-of-the-art on nuScenes dataset and, more importantly, show that our method, PolarMOT, generalizes remarkably well across different locations (Boston, Singapore, Karlsruhe) and datasets (nuScenes and KITTI).

title: Alessio Sampieri, Guido Maria D’Amely di Melendugno, Andrea Avogaro, Federico Cunico, Francesco Setti, Geri Skenderi, Marco Cristani, Fabio Galasso
title_en: Alessio Sampieri, Guido Maria D’Amely di Melendugno, Andrea Avogaro, Federico Cunico, Francesco Setti, Geri Skenderi, Marco Cristani, Fabio Galasso
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的可分离稀疏图卷积网络(SeS-GCN),以拓展协作机器人在工业环境中的应用边界。首次在图卷积网络(GCN)中,SeS-GCN通过师生框架对空间、时间及通道维度的交互进行瓶颈约束,并学习稀疏邻接矩阵。与现有技术相比,其参数量仅为1.72%,速度提升4倍,同时在Human3.6M数据集上未来1秒的预测精度仍保持相当水平,使协作机器人能够感知人类操作员。作为第二贡献,我们提出了工业协作(CHICO)新基准数据集,包含20名人类操作员和协作机器人的多视角视频、3D姿态及轨迹,涵盖7种现实工业动作。此外,数据集记录了226次真实碰撞事件。我们在CHICO上测试SeS-GCN,针对机器人感知任务:在人类姿态预测中,未来1秒平均误差达85.3 mm(MPJPE),运行时间仅2.3毫秒;在碰撞检测中,通过对比预测的人类运动与已知的协作机器人运动,获得F1-score为0.64。
abstract_en: Pushing back the frontiers of collaborative robots in industrial environments, we propose a new Separable-Sparse Graph Convolutional Network (SeS-GCN) for pose forecasting. For the first time, SeS-GCN bottlenecks the interaction of the spatial, temporal and channel-wise dimensions in GCNs, and it learns sparse adjacency matrices by a teacher-student framework. Compared to the state-of-the-art, it only uses 1.72% of the parameters and it is 4 times faster, while still performing comparably in forecasting accuracy on Human3.6M at 1 second in the future, which enables cobots to be aware of human operators. As a second contribution, we present a new benchmark of Cobots and Humans in Industrial COllaboration (CHICO). CHICO includes multi-view videos, 3D poses and trajectories of 20 human operators and cobots, engaging in 7 realistic industrial actions. Additionally, it reports 226 genuine collisions, taking place during the human-cobot interaction. We test SeS-GCN on CHICO for two important perception tasks in robotics: human pose forecasting, where it reaches an average error of 85.3 mm (MPJPE) at 1 sec in the future with a run time of 2.3 msec, and collision detection, by comparing the forecasted human motion with the known cobot motion, obtaining an F1-score of 0.64.

title: Alexander C. Li, Alexei A. Efros, Deepak Pathak
title_en: Alexander C. Li, Alexei A. Efros, Deepak Pathak
abstract: 对比方法最近在自监督表征学习(SSL)的性能上取得了显著提升。近期方法如BYOL或SimSiam声称将这些对比方法简化到其本质,去除包括负样本在内的非必要组件。这些“非对比”方法令人惊讶地在不使用负样本的情况下表现良好,尽管全局最小值位于平凡坍缩状态。我们对这些非对比方法进行实证分析,发现SimSiam对模型规模异常敏感。具体而言,当模型规模相对于数据集规模过小时,SimSiam表征会发生部分维度坍缩。我们提出一个度量指标来衡量这种坍缩的程度,并展示该指标可无需微调或标签预测下游任务性能。我们进一步分析架构设计选择及其对下游性能的影响。最后,我们证明转向持续学习设置可作为正则化器防止坍缩,而持续学习与多轮训练的混合方法可使ResNet-18在ImageNet上的线性探针准确率提升高达18个百分点。
abstract_en: Contrastive methods have led a recent surge in the performance of self-supervised representation learning (SSL). Recent methods like BYOL or SimSiam purportedly distill these contrastive methods down to their essence, removing bells and whistles, including the negative examples, that do not contribute to downstream performance. These “non-contrastive” methods surprisingly work well without using negatives even though the global minimum lies at trivial collapse. We empirically analyze these non-contrastive methods and find that SimSiam is extraordinarily sensitive to model size. In particular, SimSiam representations undergo partial dimensional collapse if the model is too small relative to the dataset size. We propose a metric to measure the degree of this collapse and show that it can be used to forecast the downstream task performance without any fine-tuning or labels. We further analyze architectural design choices and their effect on the downstream performance. Finally, we demonstrate that shifting to a continual learning setting acts as a regularizer and prevents collapse, and a hybrid between continual and multi-epoch training can improve linear probe accuracy by as many as 18 percentage points using ResNet-18 on ImageNet.

title: 半监督性能评估用于人脸识别(SPE-FR)
title_en: Alexandra Chouldechova, Siqi Deng, Yongxin Wang, Wei Xia, Pietro Perona
abstract: 我们引入了用于人脸识别的半监督性能评估(SPE-FR)。SPE-FR是一种统计方法,用于在身份标签不可用或不完整的情况下评估人脸识别系统的性能和算法偏差。该方法基于对人脸嵌入相似性得分的参数化贝叶斯建模。SPE-FR生成点估计、性能曲线和置信区间,以反映估计过程中的不确定性。我们专注于无监督设置,其中没有可用的身份标签,通过在广泛的人脸嵌入模型和两个公开可用的评估数据集上的实验验证了我们的方法。实验表明,SPE-FR可以准确评估无身份标签数据的性能,并自信地揭示系统性能中的人口统计偏差。
abstract_en: We introduce Semi-supervised Performance Evaluation for Face Recognition (SPE-FR). SPE-FR is a statistical method for evaluating the performance and algorithmic bias of face verification systems when identity labels are unavailable or incomplete. The method is based on parametric Bayesian modeling of the face embedding similarity scores. SPE-FR produces point estimates, performance curves, and confidence bands that reflect uncertainty in the estimation procedure. Focusing on the unsupervised setting wherein no identity labels are available, we validate our method through experiments on a wide range of face embedding models and two publicly available evaluation datasets. Experiments show that SPE-FR can accurately assess performance on data with no identity labels, and confidently reveal demographic biases in system performance.

title: Alexandros Kouris, Stylianos I. Venieris, Stefanos Laskaridis, Nicholas Lane
title_en: Alexandros Kouris, Stylianos I. Venieris, Stefanos Laskaridis, Nicholas Lane
abstract: 语义分割作为许多视觉系统的核心技术,广泛应用于自动驾驶汽车、机器人导航、增强现实和视频会议等领域。这些系统通常在有限资源环境下运行,并面临严格的延迟约束,因此优化高效执行变得尤为重要。同时,目标平台的异构计算能力和不同应用的多样化约束要求设计和训练多个针对特定场景的语义分割模型,导致维护成本过高。为此,我们提出了一种框架,将最先进的分割卷积神经网络(CNN)转换为多退出语义分割(MESS)网络:专门训练的模型,通过在其深度中引入参数化的提前退出机制,实现i)在简单样本推理过程中动态节省计算资源,ii)通过提供训练后可定制的速度-精度权衡,降低训练和维护成本。直接设计和训练此类网络可能损害性能。因此,我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段训练方案用于多退出网络。此外,MESS的参数化设计使得在部署时可通过穷举搜索在<1GPUh内联合优化附加分割头的数量、位置和架构以及退出策略。这使得MESS能够快速适应每个目标应用场景的设备能力和需求,提供“一次训练,处处部署”的解决方案。MESS变体在保持相同精度的情况下,相比原始主干网络可实现最高2.83倍的延迟降低,或在相同计算预算下实现5.33个百分点的精度提升。最后,MESS相比现有技术实现了数量级更快的架构定制速度。
abstract_en: Semantic segmentation arises as the backbone of many vision systems, spanning from self-driving cars and robot navigation to augmented reality and teleconferencing. Frequently operating under stringent latency constraints within a limited resource envelope, optimising for efficient execution becomes important. At the same time, the heterogeneous capabilities of the target platforms and diverse constraints of different applications require the design and training of multiple target-specific segmentation models, leading to excessive maintenance costs. To this end, we propose a framework for converting state-of-the-art segmentation CNNs to Multi-Exit Semantic Segmentation (MESS) networks: specially trained models that employ parametrised early exits along their depth to i) dynamically save computation during inference on easier samples and ii) save training and maintenance cost by offering a post-training customisable speed-accuracy trade-off. Designing and training such networks naively can hurt performance. Thus, we propose novel two-staged training scheme for multi-exit networks. Furthermore, the parametrisation of MESS enables co-optimising the number, placement and architecture of the attached segmentation heads along with the exit policy, upon deployment via exhaustive search in <1GPUh. This allows MESS to rapidly adapt to the device capabilities and application requirements for each target use-case, offering a train-once-deploy-everywhere solution. MESS variants achieve latency gains of up to 2.83x with the same accuracy, or 5.33 pp higher accuracy for the same computational budget, compared to the original backbone network. Lastly, MESS delivers orders of magnitude faster architectural customisation, compared to state-of-the-art techniques.

title: Alexandros Lattas, Yiming Lin, Jayanth Kannan, Ekin Ozturk, Luca Filipi, Giuseppe Claudio Guarnera, Gaurav Chawla, Abhijeet Ghosh
title_en: Alexandros Lattas, Yiming Lin, Jayanth Kannan, Ekin Ozturk, Luca Filipi, Giuseppe Claudio Guarnera, Gaurav Chawla, Abhijeet Ghosh
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于桌面的高质量面部捕捉系统,包括几何形状和面部外观。所提出的采集系统高度实用且可扩展,完全由商用组件构成。该设置包括一组用于受控照明以进行反射率捕捉的显示设备,并结合多视角面部几何捕捉。我们还提出了一种新颖的二进制照明模式,利用我们的设置高效采集反射率和光度法线,并实现漫反射-镜面反射分离。我们展示了两种不同捕捉设置的高质量结果——一种完全由便携式移动设备组成,用于静态面部捕捉;另一种由桌面LCD显示器组成,用于静态和动态面部捕捉。
abstract_en: We present a novel desktop-based system for high-quality facial capture including geometry and facial appearance. The proposed acquisition system is highly practical and scalable, consisting purely of commodity components. The setup consists of a set of displays for controlled illumination for reflectance capture, in conjunction with multiview acquisition of facial geometry. We additionally present a novel set of binary illumination patterns for efficient acquisition of reflectance and photometric normals using our setup, with diffuse-specular separation. We demonstrate high-quality results with two different variants of the capture setup - one entirely consisting of portable mobile devices targeting static facial capture, and the other consisting of desktop LCD displays targeting both static and dynamic facial capture.

title: Ali Dabouei, Fariborz Taherkhani, Sobhan Soleymani, Nasser M. Nasrabadi
title_en: Ali Dabouei, Fariborz Taherkhani, Sobhan Soleymani, Nasser M. Nasrabadi
abstract: 尽管对抗训练(AT)和自然训练(NT)在本质上存在根本区别,AT方法通常采用动量随机梯度下降(MSGD)进行外层优化。本文旨在通过研究外层优化在AT中被忽视的作用来分析这一选择。我们的探索性评估表明,AT相比NT会导致更高的梯度范数和方差。这一现象阻碍了AT中的外层优化,因为MSGD的收敛速度高度依赖于梯度的方差。为此,我们提出了一种名为ENGM的优化方法,通过正则化每个输入示例对平均小批量梯度的贡献。我们证明ENGM的收敛速度与梯度方差无关,因此适合用于AT。我们引入了一种技巧,利用梯度范数与网络参数和输入示例之间的相关性经验观察,以降低ENGM的计算成本。我们在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和TinyImageNet上的广泛评估和消融研究表明,ENGM及其变体在多种AT方法中持续提升了性能。此外,ENGM缓解了AT的主要缺陷,包括鲁棒过拟合和对超参数设置的高度敏感性。
abstract_en: Despite the fundamental distinction between adversarial and natural training (AT and NT), AT methods generally adopt momentum SGD (MSGD) for the outer optimization. This paper aims to analyze this choice by investigating the overlooked role of outer optimization in AT. Our exploratory evaluations reveal that AT induces higher gradient norm and variance compared to NT. This phenomenon hinders the outer optimization in AT since the convergence rate of MSGD is highly dependent on the variance of the gradients. To this end, we propose an optimization method called ENGM which regularizes the contribution of each input example to the average mini-batch gradients. We prove that the convergence rate of ENGM is independent of the variance of the gradients, and thus, it is suitable for AT. We introduce a trick to reduce the computational cost of ENGM using empirical observations on the correlation between the norm of gradients w.r.t. the network parameters and input examples. Our extensive evaluations and ablation studies on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet demonstrate that ENGM and its variants consistently improve the performance of a wide range of AT methods. Furthermore, ENGM alleviates major shortcomings of AT including robust overfitting and high sensitivity to hyperparameter settings.

title: Alireza Ganjdanesh, Shangqian Gao, Heng Huang
title_en: Alireza Ganjdanesh, Shangqian Gao, Heng Huang
abstract: 卷积神经网络(CNNs)的压缩对于在资源有限的边缘设备上部署这些模型至关重要。现有的CNN通道剪枝算法在复杂模型上取得了大量成功。它们从不同的角度处理剪枝问题,并使用不同的指标来指导剪枝过程。然而,这些指标主要关注模型的“输出”或“权重”,而忽视了其“解释性”信息。为填补这一空白,我们提出了一种新的视角,通过利用模型的解释性来引导剪枝过程,从而利用模型输入和输出的信息。然而,现有的解释方法无法实现我们的目标,因为它们要么在剪枝上效率低下,要么可能预测不一致的解释。我们通过引入一个选择器模型来解决这一挑战,该模型为剪枝模型预测实时平滑的显著性掩码。我们通过径向基函数(RBF)样式的函数参数化解释掩码的分布,以在选择器模型的归纳偏差中纳入自然图像的几何先验。因此,我们可以获得解释的紧凑表示,以减少我们剪枝方法的计算成本。我们利用选择器模型通过最大化剪枝模型和原始模型的解释表示的相似性来引导网络剪枝。在CIFAR-10和ImageNet基准数据集上的大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性。我们的实现可在\url{https://github.com/Alii-Ganjj/InterpretationsSteeredPruning}获取。
abstract_en: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) compression is crucial to deploying these models in edge devices with limited resources. Existing channel pruning algorithms for CNNs have achieved plenty of success on complex models. They approach the pruning problem from various perspectives and use different metrics to guide the pruning process. However, these metrics mainly focus on the model’s ‘outputs’ or ‘weights’ and neglect its ‘interpretations’ information. To fill in this gap, we propose to address the channel pruning problem from a novel perspective by leveraging the interpretations of a model to steer the pruning process, thereby utilizing information from both inputs and outputs of the model. However, existing interpretation methods cannot get deployed to achieve our goal as either they are inefficient for pruning or may predict non-coherent explanations. We tackle this challenge by introducing a selector model that predicts real-time smooth saliency masks for pruned models. We parameterize the distribution of explanatory masks by Radial Basis Function (RBF)-like functions to incorporate geometric prior of natural images in our selector model’s inductive bias. Thus, we can obtain compact representations of explanations to reduce the computational costs of our pruning method. We leverage our selector model to steer the network pruning by maximizing the similarity of explanatory representations for the pruned and original models. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet benchmark datasets demonstrate the efficacy of our proposed method. Our implementations are available at \url{https://github.com/Alii-Ganjj/InterpretationsSteeredPruning}

title: Alp Yurtsever, Tolga Birdal, Vladislav Golyanik
title_en: Alp Yurtsever, Tolga Birdal, Vladislav Golyanik
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于Frank-Wolfe算法的混合经典-量子框架Q-FW,用于在量子退火机(QA)上求解二次、线性约束二元优化问题。量子计算机的计算前提促使将各种现有视觉问题重新设计为量子友好的形式。实验性的QA实现可以解决一种特定的非凸问题,即二次无约束二元优化(QUBO)。然而,朴素的QUBO无法考虑参数的限制。为在参数空间中引入额外结构,研究人员通过正则化形式的(线性)约束构建了定制解决方案。然而,这需要一个超参数来平衡正则化的影响。迄今为止,尚未存在真正的二次二元优化(QBO)约束求解器。Q-FW首先将约束QBO重新表述为共正定规划(CP),然后利用Frank-Wolfe迭代求解CP,同时满足线性(不等式)约束。该过程将原始约束QBO展开为一组无约束QUBO,随后在QA上求解。我们使用D-Wave Advantage QA在两个重要的计算机视觉问题——图匹配和排列同步上进行合成和真实实验,结果表明我们的方法有效降低了对显式正则化系数的需求。
abstract_en: We present a hybrid classical-quantum framework based on the Frank-Wolfe algorithm, Q-FW, for solving quadratic, linearly-constrained, binary optimization problems on quantum annealers (QA). The computational premise of quantum computers has cultivated the re-design of various existing vision problems into quantum-friendly forms. Experimental QA realisations can solve a particular non-convex problem known as the quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO). Yet a naive-QUBO cannot take into account the restrictions on the parameters. To introduce additional structure in the parameter space, researchers have crafted ad-hoc solutions incorporating (linear) constraints in the form of regularizers. However, this comes at the expense of a hyper-parameter, balancing the impact of regularization. To date, a true constrained solver of quadratic binary optimization (QBO) problems has lacked. Q-FW first reformulates constrained-QBO as a copositive program (CP), then employs Frank-Wolfe iterations to solve CP while satisfying linear (in)equality constraints. This procedure unrolls the original constrained-QBO into a set of unconstrained QUBOs all of which are solved, in a sequel, on a QA. We use D-Wave Advantage QA to conduct synthetic and real experiments on two important computer vision problems, graph matching and permutation synchronization, which demonstrate that our approach is effective in alleviating the need for an explicit regularization coefficient.

title: Amanda Rios, Nilesh Ahuja, Ibrahima Ndiour, Utku Genc, Laurent Itti, Omesh Tickoo
title_en: Amanda Rios, Nilesh Ahuja, Ibrahima Ndiour, Utku Genc, Laurent Itti, Omesh Tickoo
abstract: 新颖性检测是实用机器学习在现实世界中的关键能力,其中模型在非平稳条件下运行,并反复接触新出现的未见过的数据。然而,大多数当前的新颖性检测方法都是专为静态、离线使用而开发的。在更现实的持续学习场景中,当数据分布发生变化时,这些方法的扩展性较差。为了解决这一关键差距,本文提出incDFM(增量深度特征建模),一种自监督的持续新颖性检测器。该方法在深度网络产生的中间特征空间上构建统计模型,并利用特征重建误差作为不确定性评分,以指导新样本的检测。最重要的是,incDFM通过任务内的多次迭代增量估计统计模型(而非单次估计)。每次仅选择最自信的新样本,这些样本将逐步引导后续的增量招募。对于某一任务,当ML模型遇到旧数据和新数据的混合时,检测器会标记新样本以将其纳入旧知识。然后,检测器会利用标记的新样本进行更新,为下一个任务做好准备。为了量化和基准测试性能,我们为持续学习调整了多个数据集:CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、SVHN、iNaturalist以及8个数据集。我们的实验表明,incDFM在持续新颖性检测中达到了最先进的性能。此外,当在分类的持续学习更广泛背景下进行检验时,我们的方法在最小化灾难性遗忘和误差传播方面表现出色。
abstract_en: Novelty detection is a key capability for practical machine learning in the real world, where models operate in non-stationary conditions and are repeatedly exposed to new, unseen data. Yet, most current novelty detection approaches have been developed exclusively for static, offline use. They scale poorly under more realistic, continual learning regimes in which data distribution shifts occur. To address this critical gap, this paper proposes incDFM (incremental Deep Feature Modeling), a self-supervised continual novelty detector. The method builds a statistical model over the space of intermediate features produced by a deep network, and utilizes feature reconstruction errors as uncertainty scores to guide the detection of novel samples. Most importantly, incDFM estimates the statistical model incrementally (via several iterations within a task), instead of a single-shot. Each time it selects only the most confident novel samples which will then guide subsequent recruitment incrementally. For a certain task where the ML model encounters a mixture of old and novel data, the detector flags novel samples to incorporate them to old knowledge. Then the detector is updated with the flagged novel samples, in preparation for a next task. To quantify and benchmark performance, we adapted multiple datasets for continual learning: CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, iNaturalist, and the 8-dataset. Our experiments show that incDFM achieves state of the art continual novelty detection performance. Furthermore, when examined in the greater context of continual learning for classification, our method is successful in minimizing catastrophic forgetting and error propagation.

title: 基于学习的点云隐式神经表示形状重建
title_en: Amine Ouasfi, Adnane Boukhayma
abstract: 我们探索了一种基于学习的点云形状重建新方法,该方法基于近年来流行的隐式神经形状表示。我们将问题建模为在特征空间中对隐式神经符号距离函数的少样本学习,并采用基于梯度的元学习方法进行求解。我们使用卷积编码器根据输入点云构建特征空间。隐式解码器学习根据该特征空间中表示的点预测符号距离值。将输入点云(即目标形状函数的零水平集样本)作为少样本学习中的支持(即上下文),我们训练解码器,使其能够通过少量(5次)调优步骤适应该上下文的底层形状。因此,我们首次同时结合了两种隐式神经网络条件机制,即特征编码和元学习。我们的数值和定性评估表明,在稀疏点云的隐式重建背景下,我们提出的方法(即特征空间中的元学习)优于现有方法,包括特征空间中的标准监督学习和欧几里得空间中的元学习,同时仍能提供快速推理。
abstract_en: We explore a new idea for learning based shape reconstruction from a point cloud, based on the recently popularized implicit neural shape representations. We cast the problem as a few-shot learning of implicit neural signed distance functions in feature space, that we approach using gradient based meta-learning. We use a convolutional encoder to build a feature space given the input point cloud. An implicit decoder learns to predict signed distance values given points represented in this feature space. Setting the input point cloud, i.e. samples from the target shape function’s zero level set, as the support (i.e. context) in few-shot learning terms, we train the decoder such that it can adapt its weights to the underlying shape of this context with a few (5) tuning steps. We thus combine two types of implicit neural network conditioning mechanisms simultaneously for the first time, namely feature encoding and meta-learning. Our numerical and qualitative evaluation shows that in the context of implicit reconstruction from a sparse point cloud, our proposed strategy, i.e. meta-learning in feature space, outperforms existing alternatives, namely standard supervised learning in feature space, and meta-learning in euclidean space, while still providing fast inference.

title: Amirhossein Habibian, Haitam Ben Yahia, Davide Abati, Efstratios Gavves, Fatih Porikli
title_en: Amirhossein Habibian, Haitam Ben Yahia, Davide Abati, Efstratios Gavves, Fatih Porikli
abstract: 本文旨在通过利用视频帧之间存在的时序冗余性,加速视频流处理任务,如目标检测和语义分割。与依赖显式运动对齐(如光流变形)的方法不同,我们提出了一种新颖的知识蒸馏方案,称为Delta蒸馏。在我们的方案中,学生模型学习教师模型中间特征随时间的变化。我们证明,这些时间变化可以通过视频帧内的时序冗余有效地进行蒸馏。在推理阶段,教师模型和学生模型协同提供预测:前者通过仅对关键帧提取初始表示,后者通过迭代估计并应用后续帧的增量变化。此外,我们考虑了多种设计选择以学习最优的学生模型架构,包括端到端可学习的架构搜索。通过在广泛架构(包括最高效的架构)上的大量实验,我们证明Delta蒸馏在语义分割和视频目标检测的精度与效率权衡方面设定了新的基准。最后,我们表明,作为副产品,Delta蒸馏提高了教师模型的时间一致性。
abstract_en: This paper aims to accelerate video stream processing, such as object detection and semantic segmentation, by leveraging the temporal redundancies that exist between video frames. Instead of relying on explicit motion alignment, such as optical flow warping, we propose a novel knowledge distillation schema coined as Delta Distillation. In our proposal, the student learns the variations in the teacher’s intermediate features over time. We demonstrate that these temporal variations can be effectively distilled due to the temporal redundancies within video frames. During inference, both teacher and student cooperate for providing predictions: the former by providing initial representations extracted only on the key-frame, and the latter by iteratively estimating and applying deltas for the successive frames. Moreover, we consider various design choices to learn optimal student architectures including an end-to-end learnable architecture search. By extensive experiments on a wide range of architectures, including the most efficient ones, we demonstrate that delta distillation sets a new state of the art in terms of accuracy vs. efficiency tradeoff for semantic segmentation and object detection in videos. Finally, we show that, as a by-product, delta distillation improves the temporal consistency of the teacher model.

title: Amita Kamath, Christopher Clark, Tanmay Gupta, Eric Kolve, Derek Hoiem, Aniruddha Kembhavi
title_en: Amita Kamath, Christopher Clark, Tanmay Gupta, Eric Kolve, Derek Hoiem, Aniruddha Kembhavi
abstract: 通用视觉(GPV)系统是设计用于无需架构调整即可解决广泛视觉任务的模型。目前,GPV主要从大规模全监督数据集中学习技能和概念。通过为每个技能获取数据来学习每个概念,将GPV扩展到数万个概念迅速变得不可行。本文提出了一种有效且低成本的替代方案:从监督数据集中学习技能,从网络图像搜索中学习概念,并利用GPV的一个关键特性——跨技能迁移视觉知识的能力。我们使用包含100万+张图像、覆盖1万+视觉概念的数据集,展示了基于网络监督的概念扩展方法在两个现有GPV(GPV-1和VL-T5)上的应用效果,测试了3个基准:5个基于COCO的数据集(80个基础概念)、基于OpenImages和VisualGenome仓库新整理的5个数据集(500个概念)以及网络衍生数据集(1万+概念)。我们还提出了一种新架构GPV-2,支持多种任务——从视觉任务如分类和定位,到视觉+语言任务如问答和图像描述,再到更专业的任务如人-物交互检测。GPV-2大幅受益于网络数据,在这些基准测试中均优于GPV-1和VL-T5。
abstract_en: General purpose vision (GPV) systems are models that are designed to solve a wide array of visual tasks without requiring architectural changes. Today, GPVs primarily learn both skills and concepts from large fully supervised datasets. Scaling GPVs to tens of thousands of concepts by acquiring data to learn each concept for every skill quickly becomes prohibitive. This work presents an effective and inexpensive alternative: learn skills from supervised datasets, learn concepts from web image search, and leverage a key characteristic of GPVs -- the ability to transfer visual knowledge across skills. We use a dataset of 1M+ images spanning 10k+ visual concepts to demonstrate webly-supervised concept expansion for two existing GPVs (GPV-1 and VL-T5) on 3 benchmarks - 5 COCO based datasets (80 primary concepts), a newly curated series of 5 datasets based on the OpenImages and VisualGenome repositories ( 500 concepts) and the Web-derived dataset (10k+ concepts). We also propose a new architecture, GPV-2 that supports a variety of tasks -- from vision tasks like classification and localization to vision+language tasks like QA and captioning to more niche ones like human-object interaction detection. GPV-2 benefits hugely from web data and outperforms GPV-1 and VL-T5 across these benchmarks.

title: An Gia Vien, Chul Lee
title_en: An Gia Vien, Chul Lee
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于曝光感知动态加权学习的新型单次曝光高动态范围(HDR)成像算法,该算法从空间变化曝光(SVE)原始图像中重建HDR图像。首先,我们通过开发一个网络来恢复欠曝光像素,该网络学习局部动态滤波器以利用跨色通道的局部邻近像素。其次,我们开发另一个网络,通过学习曝光感知特征融合,仅结合良好曝光区域中的有效特征。第三,我们通过自适应结合两个具有互补信息且特性不同的网络输出,合成原始辐照度图。最后,通过插值缺失的色彩信息获得全彩HDR图像。实验结果表明,所提出的算法在各种数据集上显著优于传统算法。源代码和预训练模型可在https://github.com/viengiaan/EDWL获取。
abstract_en: We propose a novel single-shot high dynamic range (HDR) imaging algorithm based on exposure-aware dynamic weighted learning, which reconstructs an HDR image from a spatially varying exposure (SVE) raw image. First, we recover poorly exposed pixels by developing a network that learns local dynamic filters to exploit local neighboring pixels across color channels. Second, we develop another network that combines only valid features in well-exposed regions by learning exposure-aware feature fusion. Third, we synthesize the raw radiance map by adaptively combining the outputs of the two networks that have different characteristics with complementary information. Finally, a full-color HDR image is obtained by interpolating missing color information. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm outperforms conventional algorithms significantly on various datasets. The source codes and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/viengiaan/EDWL.

title: An-Chieh Cheng, Xueting Li, Sifei Liu, Min Sun, Ming-Hsuan Yang
title_en: An-Chieh Cheng, Xueting Li, Sifei Liu, Min Sun, Ming-Hsuan Yang
abstract: 凭借对序列数据中长距离依赖关系的建模能力,Transformer模型在图像、音频和文本生成等生成任务中展现出卓越的性能。然而,由于模糊的序列化过程和不可行的计算负担,将其应用于生成结构不明确且数据量庞大的高分辨率点云等格式的研究仍较为有限。本文旨在进一步挖掘Transformer模型的潜力,将其应用于三维点云生成任务。核心思想是通过学习的规范空间,将某一类点云分解为语义对齐的形状组合序列。这些形状组合随后可被量化,并用于学习一个富含上下文的组合码本以实现点云生成。在点云重建和无条件生成的实验结果表明,我们的模型在性能上优于现有最先进的方法。此外,我们的模型可轻松扩展至多模态形状补全,作为条件形状生成的应用。
abstract_en: With the capacity of modeling long-range dependencies in sequential data, transformers have shown remarkable performances in a variety of generative tasks such as image, audio, and text generation. Yet, taming them in generating less structured and voluminous data formats such as high-resolution point clouds have seldom been explored due to ambiguous sequentialization processes and infeasible computation burden. In this paper, we aim to further exploit the power of transformers and employ them for the task of 3D point cloud generation. The key idea is to decompose point clouds of one category into semantically aligned sequences of shape compositions, via a learned canonical space. These shape compositions can then be quantized and used to learn a context-rich composition codebook for point cloud generation. Experimental results on point cloud reconstruction and unconditional generation show that our model performs favorably against state-of-the-art approaches. Furthermore, our model can be easily extended to multi-modal shape completion as an application for conditional shape generation.

title: Andrea Agostinelli, Michal Pándy, Jasper Uijlings, Thomas Mensink, Vittorio Ferrari
title_en: Andrea Agostinelli, Michal Pándy, Jasper Uijlings, Thomas Mensink, Vittorio Ferrari
abstract: 迁移性度量是一个日益成熟且日益受到关注的领域,旨在提供启发式方法来选择最适合的源模型,以在无需对所有模型进行微调的情况下迁移到给定的目标数据集。然而,现有研究依赖于定制的实验设置,这些设置在不同论文中存在差异,导致关于哪些迁移性度量效果最佳的结论不一致。在本文中,我们通过系统构建715,000种实验设置变体,开展了一项大规模研究。我们发现,即使是对实验设置进行微小调整,也会导致关于迁移性度量优越性的不同结论。随后,我们提出通过跨多个实验进行聚合评估,从而得出更稳定的结论。结果揭示了LogME在语义分割场景中选择优质源数据集的优越性,NLEEP在图像分类场景中选择优质源架构的能力,以及GBC在确定特定源模型对目标任务最有益处方面的优势。然而,没有单一的迁移性度量在所有场景中表现最佳。
abstract_en: Transferability metrics is a maturing field with increasing interest, which aims at providing heuristics for selecting the most suitable source models to transfer to a given target dataset, without fine-tuning them all. However, existing works rely on custom experimental setups which differ across papers, leading to inconsistent conclusions about which transferability metrics work best. In this paper we conduct a large-scale study by systematically constructing a broad range of 715k experimental setup variations. We discover that even small variations to an experimental setup lead to different conclusions about the superiority of a transferability metric over another. Then we propose better evaluations by aggregating across many experiments, enabling to reach more stable conclusions. As a result, we reveal the superiority of LogME at selecting good source datasets to transfer from in a semantic segmentation scenario, NLEEP at selecting good source architectures in an image classification scenario, and GBC at determining which target task benefits most from a given source model. Yet, no single transferability metric works best in all scenarios.

title: Andrea Burns, Deniz Arsan, Sanjna Agrawal, Ranjitha Kumar, Kate Saenko, Bryan A. Plummer
title_en: Andrea Burns, Deniz Arsan, Sanjna Agrawal, Ranjitha Kumar, Kate Saenko, Bryan A. Plummer
abstract: 视觉-语言导航(VLN)是一种代理在视觉环境中遵循语言指令的范式,其研究前提假设输入指令在环境中是完全可行的。然而在实际应用中,由于语言歧义或环境变化,请求可能无法实现。为研究未知指令可行性下的VLN,我们引入了一个新的数据集Mobile app Tasks with Iterative Feedback(MoTIF),其目标是在移动应用中完成自然语言指令。移动应用为研究VLN方法的实际下游应用提供了可扩展的领域。此外,移动应用指令通过点击、输入或滑动等操作生成具有状态变化的动作序列,为交互式导航提供指导。MoTIF是首个包含可行性标注的数据集,包含二元可行性标签和细粒度标签以解释任务不可满足的原因。我们进一步收集了针对歧义查询的后续问题,以支持任务不确定性解决的研究。借助我们的数据集,我们提出了新的可行性预测问题,即利用自然语言指令和多模态应用环境预测指令的可行性。MoTIF提供了更真实的移动应用数据集,因其包含比以往工作更多样化的环境、更高层次的目标和更长的动作序列。我们使用MoTIF评估交互式VLN方法,量化当前方法对新应用环境的泛化能力,并测量任务可行性对导航性能的影响。
abstract_en: Vision-language navigation (VLN), in which an agent follows language instruction in a visual environment, has been studied under the premise that the input command is fully feasible in the environment. Yet in practice, a request may not be possible due to language ambiguity or environment changes. To study VLN with unknown command feasibility, we introduce a new dataset Mobile app Tasks with Iterative Feedback (MoTIF), where the goal is to complete a natural language command in a mobile app. Mobile apps provide a scalable domain to study real downstream uses of VLN methods. Moreover, mobile app commands provide instruction for interactive navigation, as they result in action sequences with state changes via clicking, typing, or swiping. MoTIF is the first to include feasibility annotations, containing both binary feasibility labels and fine-grained labels for why tasks are unsatisfiable. We further collect follow-up questions for ambiguous queries to enable research on task uncertainty resolution. Equipped with our dataset, we propose the new problem of feasibility prediction, in which a natural language instruction and multimodal app environment are used to predict instruction feasibility. MoTIF provides a more realistic app dataset as it contains many diverse environments, high-level goals, and longer action sequences than prior work. We evaluate interactive VLN methods using MoTIF, quantify the generalization ability of current approaches to new app environments, and measure the effect of task feasibility on navigation performance.

title: Andreas Kurz, Thomas Neff, Zhaoyang Lv, Michael Zollhöfer, Markus Steinberger
title_en: Andreas Kurz, Thomas Neff, Zhaoyang Lv, Michael Zollhöfer, Markus Steinberger
abstract: 近年来,通过直接从稀疏观测数据中学习神经辐射场,新视角合成技术取得了革命性进展。然而,由于准确求解体积渲染方程需要每个光线进行大量采样,使用这一新范式进行图像渲染速度较慢。先前的工作主要集中在加速与每个采样点相关的网络计算,例如通过将辐射值缓存到显式空间数据结构中,但这种方法以牺牲模型紧凑性为代价。本文提出了一种新颖的双网络架构,通过学习如何最优地减少所需采样点数量来采取正交方向。为此,我们将网络划分为采样网络和着色网络,并联合训练这两个网络。我们的训练方案采用固定采样位置沿每条光线,并在训练过程中逐步引入稀疏性,以在低采样数量下仍能获得高质量结果。经过目标采样数量的微调后,得到的紧凑神经表示可在实时渲染。实验表明,我们的方法在质量和帧率方面均优于当前紧凑神经表示,并与高效混合表示表现相当。代码和补充材料可在https://thomasneff.github.io/adanerf获取。
abstract_en: Novel view synthesis has recently been revolutionized by learning neural radiance fields directly from sparse observations. However, rendering images with this new paradigm is slow due to the fact that an accurate quadrature of the volume rendering equation requires a large number of samples for each ray. Previous work has mainly focused on speeding up the network evaluations that are associated with each sample point, e.g., via caching of radiance values into explicit spatial data structures, but this comes at the expense of model compactness. In this paper, we propose a novel dual-network architecture that takes an orthogonal direction by learning how to best reduce the number of required sample points. To this end, we split our network into a sampling and shading network that are jointly trained. Our training scheme employs fixed sample positions along each ray, and incrementally introduces sparsity throughout training to achieve high quality even at low sample counts. After fine-tuning with the target number of samples, the resulting compact neural representation can be rendered in real-time. Our experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms concurrent compact neural representations in terms of quality and frame rate and performs on par with highly efficient hybrid representations. Code and supplementary material is available at https://thomasneff.github.io/adanerf.

title: Andreas Meuleman, Hakyeong Kim, James Tompkin, Min H. Kim
title_en: Andreas Meuleman, Hakyeong Kim, James Tompkin, Min H. Kim
abstract: 高精度逐像素深度对于计算摄影至关重要,因此智能手机现在配备了多模态相机系统,包括飞行时间(ToF)深度传感器和多个彩色摄像头。然而,由于ToF传感器的低分辨率和有限的主动照明功率,生成高分辨率的准确深度仍具有挑战性。融合RGB立体视觉和ToF信息是解决这些问题的有前景方向,但关键问题依然存在:为了提供高质量的2D RGB图像,智能手机主彩色传感器的镜头进行了光学稳定,导致浮动镜头的位姿未知,从而破坏了多模态图像传感器之间的几何关系。通过利用ToF深度估计和广角RGB摄像头,我们设计了一种基于密集2D/3D匹配的自动校准技术,可以从单张快照中估计稳定主RGB传感器的相机内参和畸变参数。这使我们能够通过相关体积融合立体视觉和ToF线索。在融合过程中,我们通过一个包含深度监督的真实世界训练数据集应用深度学习,该深度监督由神经重建方法估计。在评估方面,我们使用商用高功率深度摄像头获取测试数据集,并展示我们的方法比现有基线方法具有更高的准确性。
abstract_en: High-accuracy per-pixel depth is vital for computational photography, so smartphones now have multimodal camera systems with time-of-flight (ToF) depth sensors and multiple color cameras. However, producing accurate high-resolution depth is still challenging due to the low resolution and limited active illumination power of ToF sensors. Fusing RGB stereo and ToF information is a promising direction to overcome these issues, but a key problem remains: to provide high-quality 2D RGB images, the main smartphone color sensor’s lens is optically stabilized, resulting in an unknown pose for the floating lens that breaks the geometric relationships between the multimodal image sensors. Leveraging ToF depth estimates and a wide-angle RGB camera, we design an automatic calibration technique based on dense 2D/3D matching that can estimate camera pose intrinsic and distortion parameters of a stabilized main RGB sensor from a single snapshot. This lets us fuse stereo and ToF cues via a correlation volume. For fusion, we apply deep learning via a real-world training dataset with depth supervision estimated by a neural reconstruction method. For evaluation, we acquire a test dataset using a commercial high-power depth camera and show that our approach achieves higher accuracy than existing baselines.

title: Andrew Brown, Cheng-Yang Fu, Omkar Parkhi, Tamara L. Berg, Andrea Vedaldi
title_en: Andrew Brown, Cheng-Yang Fu, Omkar Parkhi, Tamara L. Berg, Andrea Vedaldi
abstract: 我们研究目标图像编辑问题,即通过驱动图像指定所需变化,将源图像中的某一区域与之进行融合。与以往方法不同,我们通过在代码空间中端到端学习编辑的条件概率分布来解决该问题。训练此类模型需要应对缺乏训练用编辑示例的挑战。为此,我们提出了一种自监督方法,通过在目标域中对现成图像进行增强处理来模拟编辑。其优势显著:作为最先进的自回归变换器实现,我们的方法简单易行,避开了基于类似GAN先验的方法所面临的困难,获得了显著更优的编辑效果,并且效率更高。此外,我们证明通过直观控制增强过程,可以在无需修改模型架构的情况下学习到不同的融合效果。我们在多个数据集上进行了广泛的定量和定性实验,包括人类研究,结果显著优于以往方法。
abstract_en: We consider the targeted image editing problem, namely blending a region in a source image with a driver image that specifies the desired change. Differently from prior works, we solve this problem by learning a conditional probability distribution of the edits, end-to-end in code space. Training such a model requires addressing the lack of example edits for training. To this end, we propose a self-supervised approach that simulates edits by augmenting off-the-shelf images in a target domain. The benefits are remarkable: implemented as a state-of-the-art auto-regressive transformer, our approach is simple, sidesteps difficulties with previous methods based on GAN-like priors, obtains significantly better edits, and is efficient. Furthermore, we show that different blending effects can be learned by an intuitive control of the augmentation process, with no other changes required to the model architecture. We demonstrate the superiority of this approach across several datasets in extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments, including human studies, significantly outperforming prior work.

title: Ankan Kumar Bhunia, Salman Khan, Hisham Cholakkal, Rao Muhammad Anwer, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Jorma Laaksonen, Michael Felsberg
title_en: Ankan Kumar Bhunia, Salman Khan, Hisham Cholakkal, Rao Muhammad Anwer, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Jorma Laaksonen, Michael Felsberg
abstract: Creative sketching or doodling is an expressive activity, where imaginative and previously unseen depictions of everyday visual objects are drawn. Creative sketch image generation is a challenging vision problem, where the task is to generate diverse, yet realistic creative sketches possessing the unseen composition of the visual-world objects. Here, we propose a novel coarse-to-fine two-stage framework, DoodleFormer, that decomposes the creative sketch generation problem into the creation of coarse sketch composition followed by the incorporation of fine-details in the sketch. We introduce graph-aware transformer encoders that effectively capture global dynamic as well as local static structural relations among different body parts. To ensure diversity of the generated creative sketches, we introduce a probabilistic coarse sketch decoder that explicitly models the variations of each sketch body part to be drawn. Experiments are performed on two creative sketch datasets: Creative Birds and Creative Creatures.
