Our qualitative, quantitative and human-based evaluations show that DoodleFormer outperforms the state-of-the-art on both datasets, yielding realistic and diverse creative sketches. On Creative Creatures, DoodleFormer achieves an absolute gain of 25 in Fr\`echet inception distance (FID) over state-of-the-art. We also demonstrate the effectiveness of DoodleFormer for related applications of text to creative sketch generation, sketch completion and house layout generation.
abstract_en: Creative sketching or doodling is an expressive activity, where imaginative and previously unseen depictions of everyday visual objects are drawn. Creative sketch image generation is a challenging vision problem, where the task is to generate diverse, yet realistic creative sketches possessing the unseen composition of the visual-world objects. Here, we propose a novel coarse-to-fine two-stage framework, DoodleFormer, that decomposes the creative sketch generation problem into the creation of coarse sketch composition followed by the incorporation of fine-details in the sketch. We introduce graph-aware transformer encoders that effectively capture global dynamic as well as local static structural relations among different body parts. To ensure diversity of the generated creative sketches, we introduce a probabilistic coarse sketch decoder that explicitly models the variations of each sketch body part to be drawn. Experiments are performed on two creative sketch datasets: Creative Birds and Creative Creatures. Our qualitative, quantitative and human-based evaluations show that DoodleFormer outperforms the state-of-the-art on both datasets, yielding realistic and diverse creative sketches. On Creative Creatures, DoodleFormer achieves an absolute gain of 25 in Fr\`echet inception distance (FID) over state-of-the-art. We also demonstrate the effectiveness of DoodleFormer for related applications of text to creative sketch generation, sketch completion and house layout generation.

title: Anpei Chen, Zexiang Xu, Andreas Geiger, Jingyi Yu, Hao Su
title_en: Anpei Chen, Zexiang Xu, Andreas Geiger, Jingyi Yu, Hao Su
abstract: 我们提出了一种名为TensoRF的新方法,用于建模和重建辐射场。与NeRF仅使用多层感知机(MLPs)不同,我们将场景的辐射场建模为一个4D张量,该张量表示具有每个体素多通道特征的3D体素网格。我们的核心思想是将4D场景张量分解为多个紧凑的低秩张量成分。我们证明,在我们的框架中应用传统的CANDECOMP/PARAFAC(CP)分解——将张量分解为具有紧凑向量的秩一成分——相比原始NeRF能够带来性能提升。为进一步提升性能,我们引入了一种新颖的向量-矩阵(VM)分解方法,该方法放松了张量两个模式的低秩约束,并将张量分解为紧凑的向量和矩阵因子。除了卓越的渲染质量外,与直接优化每个体素特征的先前和同期工作相比,我们的CP和VM分解模型在内存占用方面显著降低。实验表明,采用CP分解的TensoRF实现了快速重建(<30分钟),其渲染质量优于NeRF,甚至模型体积更小(<4MB)。此外,采用VM分解的TensoRF进一步提升了渲染质量,超越了先前的最先进方法,同时将重建时间缩短至<10分钟,并保持紧凑的模型体积(<75MB)。
abstract_en: We present TensoRF, a novel approach to model and reconstruct radiance fields. Unlike NeRF that purely uses MLPs, we model the radiance field of a scene as a 4D tensor, which represents a 3D voxel grid with per-voxel multi-channel features. Our central idea is to factorize the 4D scene tensor into multiple compact low-rank tensor components. We demonstrate that applying traditional CANDECOMP/PARAFAC (CP) decomposition -- that factorizes tensors into rank-one components with compact vectors -- in our framework leads to improvements over vanilla NeRF. To further boost performance, we introduce a novel vector-matrix (VM) decomposition that relaxes the low-rank constraints for two modes of a tensor and factorizes tensors into compact vector and matrix factors. Beyond superior rendering quality, our models with CP and VM decompositions lead to a significantly lower memory footprint in comparison to previous and concurrent works that directly optimize per-voxel features. Experimentally, we demonstrate that TensoRF with CP decomposition achieves fast reconstruction (<30 min) with better rendering quality and even a smaller model size (<4 MB) compared to NeRF. Moreover, TensoRF with VM decomposition further boosts rendering quality and outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods, while reducing the reconstruction time (<10 min) and retaining a compact model size (<75 MB).

title: Antonin Vobecky, David Hurych, Oriane Siméoni, Spyros Gidaris, Andrei Bursuc, Patrick Pérez, Josef Sivic
title_en: Antonin Vobecky, David Hurych, Oriane Siméoni, Spyros Gidaris, Andrei Bursuc, Patrick Pérez, Josef Sivic
abstract: 本文研究了在无任何人工标注的情况下,仅通过由配备摄像头和激光雷达传感器的汽车在城市中行驶时收集的原始非整理数据,学习像素级语义图像分割。我们的贡献有三个方面。首先,我们提出了一种新颖的方法,通过利用同步的激光雷达和图像数据,实现语义图像分割的跨模态无监督学习。该方法的关键在于使用一个对象建议模块,通过分析激光雷达点云以获取空间一致的对象建议。其次,我们证明这些三维对象建议可以与输入图像对齐,并可靠地聚类为具有语义意义的伪类别。最后,我们开发了一种跨模态蒸馏方法,利用部分标注有结果伪类别的图像数据,训练基于Transformer的图像语义分割模型。我们通过在四个不同的测试数据集(Cityscapes、Dark Zurich、夜间驾驶和ACDC)上进行测试,验证了该方法的泛化能力,且无需微调,相较于当前最优方法在该问题上取得了显著改进。
abstract_en: This work investigates learning pixel-wise semantic image segmentation in urban scenes without any manual annotation, just from the raw non-curated data collected by cars which, equipped with cameras and LiDAR sensors, drive around a city. Our contributions are threefold. First, we propose a novel method for cross-modal unsupervised learning of semantic image segmentation by leveraging synchronized LiDAR and image data. The key ingredient of our method is the use of an object proposal module that analyzes the LiDAR point cloud to obtain proposals for spatially consistent objects. Second, we show that these 3D object proposals can be aligned with the input images and reliably clustered into semantically meaningful pseudo-classes. Finally, we develop a cross-modal distillation approach that leverages image data partially annotated with the resulting pseudo-classes to train a transformer-based model for image semantic segmentation. We show the generalization capabilities of our method by testing on four different testing datasets (Cityscapes, Dark Zurich, Nighttime Driving and ACDC) without any finetuning, and demonstrate significant improvements compared to the current state of the art on this problem.

title: Ao Zhang, Yuan Yao, Qianyu Chen, Wei Ji, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun, Tat-Seng Chua
title_en: Ao Zhang, Yuan Yao, Qianyu Chen, Wei Ji, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun, Tat-Seng Chua
abstract: 场景图生成(SGG)旨在从图像中提取(主体,谓词,客体)三元组。近期工作在SGG领域取得了稳步进展,并为高层视觉与语言理解提供了有用的工具。然而,由于包括长尾分布和语义歧义在内的数据分布问题,当前SGG模型的预测倾向于坍缩到几个频繁但无信息的谓词(例如:on,at),这限制了这些模型在下游任务中的实际应用。为解决上述问题,我们提出了一种新颖的内部与外部数据迁移(IETrans)方法,该方法可插拔式应用并扩展至包含1,807个谓词类的大规模SGG。我们的IETrans通过自动创建增强数据集来缓解数据分布问题,该数据集为所有谓词提供了更充分且连贯的注释。通过应用我们提出的方法,Neural Motif模型在信息性SGG的宏性能上实现了翻倍。代码和数据已公开在https://github.com/waxnkw/IETrans-SGG.pytorch。
abstract_en: Scene graph generation (SGG) is designed to extract (subject, predicate, object) triplets in images. Recent works have made a steady progress on SGG, and provide useful tools for high-level vision and language understanding. However, due to the data distribution problems including long-tail distribution and semantic ambiguity, the predictions of current SGG models tend to collapse to several frequent but uninformative predicates (e.g., on, at), which limits practical application of these models in downstream tasks. To deal with the problems above, we propose a novel Internal and External Data Transfer (IETrans) method, which can be applied in a plug-and-play fashion and expanded to large SGG with 1,807 predicate classes. Our IETrans tries to relieve the data distribution problem by automatically creating an enhanced dataset that provides more sufficient and coherent annotations for all predicates. By applying our proposed method, a Neural Motif model doubles the macro performance for informative SGG. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/waxnkw/IETrans-SGG.pytorch.

title: Apostolos Modas, Rahul Rade, Guillermo Ortiz-Jiménez, Seyed-Mohsen Moosavi-Dezfooli, Pascal Frossard
title_en: Apostolos Modas, Rahul Rade, Guillermo Ortiz-Jiménez, Seyed-Mohsen Moosavi-Dezfooli, Pascal Frossard
abstract: 尽管深度网络在图像分类任务中表现出色,但它们在面对数据未预见的损坏时往往难以泛化。为了解决这一漏洞,先前的工作构建了复杂的增强策略,结合多种方法以丰富训练数据。然而,引入复杂的架构设计或启发式方法使得难以确定这些方法中哪些元素对提升鲁棒性至关重要。在本文中,我们采取了更基础的方法,通过原则性方法实现对常见损坏的鲁棒性。我们提出了PRIME,一种通用的数据增强方案,其依赖于简单但丰富的最大熵图像变换族。PRIME在抗损坏能力上优于现有方法,其简洁性和即插即用的特性使其能够与其他方法结合,进一步提升鲁棒性。我们分析PRIME以揭示混合策略在合成损坏图像中的重要性,并揭示常见损坏背景下鲁棒性与准确性的权衡。最后,我们证明该方法的计算效率使其能够轻松应用于在线和离线数据增强方案。
abstract_en: Despite their impressive performance on image classification tasks, deep networks have a hard time generalizing to unforeseen corruptions of their data. To fix this vulnerability, prior works have built complex data augmentation strategies, combining multiple methods to enrich the training data. However, introducing intricate design choices or heuristics makes it hard to understand which elements of these methods are indeed crucial for improving robustness. In this work, we take a step back and follow a principled approach to achieve robustness to common corruptions. We propose PRIME, a general data augmentation scheme that relies on simple yet rich families of max-entropy image transformations. PRIME outperforms the prior art in terms of corruption robustness, while its simplicity and plug-and-play nature enable combination with other methods to further boost their robustness. We analyze PRIME to shed light on the importance of the mixing strategy on synthesizing corrupted images, and to reveal the robustness-accuracy trade-offs arising in the context of common corruptions. Finally, we show that the computational efficiency of our method allows it to be easily used in both on-line and off-line data augmentation schemes.

title: Aram Davtyan, Paolo Favaro
title_en: Aram Davtyan, Paolo Favaro
abstract: 我们提出GLASS,一种用于全局和局部动作驱动序列合成的方法。GLASS是一种生成模型,以无监督方式在视频序列上进行训练,并且可以在测试时对输入图像进行动画处理。该方法学习将帧分割为前景-背景层,并通过全局和局部动作表示生成前景随时间的变化。全局动作明确与2D平移相关,而局部动作则与(几何和光度)局部变形相关。GLASS使用循环神经网络在帧之间进行转换,并通过重建损失进行训练。我们还引入了W-Sprites(行走精灵),一种具有预定义动作空间的新合成数据集。我们在W-Sprites和真实数据集上评估了我们的方法,并发现GLASS能够从单个输入图像生成逼真的视频序列,并成功学习比以往工作更先进的动作空间。更多细节、代码和示例视频可在https://araachie.github.io/glass/获取。
abstract_en: We present GLASS, a method for Global and Local Action-driven Sequence Synthesis. GLASS is a generative model that is trained on video sequences in an unsupervised manner and that can animate an input image at test time. The method learns to segment frames into foreground-background layers and to generate transitions of the foregrounds over time through a global and local action representation. Global actions are explicitly related to 2D shifts, while local actions are instead related to (both geometric and photometric) local deformations. GLASS uses a recurrent neural network to transition between frames and is trained through a reconstruction loss. We also introduce W-Sprites (Walking Sprites), a novel synthetic dataset with a predefined action space. We evaluate our method on both W-Sprites and real datasets, and find that GLASS is able to generate realistic video sequences from a single input image and to successfully learn a more advanced action space than in prior work. Further details, the code and example videos are available at https://araachie.github.io/glass/.

title: Ardhendu Shekhar Tripathi, Martin Danelljan, Samarth Shukla, Radu Timofte, Luc Van Gool
title_en: Ardhendu Shekhar Tripathi, Martin Danelljan, Samarth Shukla, Radu Timofte, Luc Van Gool
abstract: 我们提出了一种可训练的图像信号处理(ISP)框架,该框架能够根据智能手机拍摄的原始图像(RAW images)生成数码单反(DSLR)画质图像。为了解决训练图像对之间的颜色错位问题,我们采用了一种颜色条件ISP网络,并优化了每对输入RAW图像与参考DSLR图像之间的新型参数化颜色映射。在推理阶段,我们通过设计包含高效全局上下文Transformer模块的颜色预测网络来预测目标颜色图像。后者能够有效利用全局信息,学习一致的颜色和色调映射。我们进一步提出了一种鲁棒的掩码对齐损失函数,在训练过程中识别并丢弃运动估计不准确的区域。最后,我们引入了包含弱配对手机RAW图像和DSLR sRGB图像的ISP在野外(ISPW)数据集。我们对方法进行了广泛评估,在两个数据集上均达到了新的最先进水平。代码已开源至https://github.com/4rdhendu/TransformPhone2DSLR。
abstract_en: We propose a trainable Image Signal Processing (ISP) framework that produces DSLR quality images given RAW images captured by a smartphone. To address the color misalignments between training image pairs, we employ a color-conditional ISP network and optimize a novel parametric color mapping between each input RAW and reference DSLR image. During inference, we predict the target color image by designing a color prediction network with efficient Global Context Transformer modules. The latter effectively leverage global information to learn consistent color and tone mappings. We further propose a robust masked aligned loss to identify and discard regions with inaccurate motion estimation during training. Lastly, we introduce the ISP in the Wild (ISPW) dataset, consisting of weakly paired phone RAW and DSLR sRGB images. We extensively evaluate our method, setting a new state-of-the-art on two datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/4rdhendu/TransformPhone2DSLR.

title: Ardian Umam, Cheng-Kun Yang, Yung-Yu Chuang, Jen-Hui Chuang, Yen-Yu Lin
title_en: Ardian Umam, Cheng-Kun Yang, Yung-Yu Chuang, Jen-Hui Chuang, Yen-Yu Lin
abstract: 数据增强被开发用于增加训练数据的量和多样性,以增强模型的学习能力。与二维图像相比,点云具有三维几何特性,同时采集和标注成本较高,因此在增强方面面临巨大挑战和潜力。本文提出了一种三维增强方法,探索多个点云之间的结构差异,并生成更多样化的点云以丰富训练集。具体而言,我们提出了一种注意力模块,将点云分解为若干个不相交的点子集,称为划分,其中每个划分在另一个点云中都有对应的划分。通过交换匹配的划分,合成增强后的点云。由于同时探索了点云内部和点云之间的变化,这些点云表现出高度的多样性,因此对下游任务非常有用。所提出的增强方法可以作为模块集成到基于点的网络中。最终的框架是端到端可训练的。实验表明,该方法在ModelNet40和ModelNet10基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。本工作的代码已公开可用。
abstract_en: Data augmentation is developed for increasing the amount and diversity of training data to enhance model learning. Compared to 2D images, point clouds, with the 3D geometric nature as well as the high collection and annotation costs, pose great challenges and potentials for augmentation. This paper presents a 3D augmentation method that explores the structural variance across multiple point clouds, and generates more diverse point clouds to enrich the training set. Specifically, we propose an attention module that decomposes a point cloud into several disjoint point subsets, called divisions, in a way where each division has a corresponding division in another point cloud. The augmented point clouds are synthesized by swapping matched divisions. They exhibit high diversity since both intra- and inter-cloud variations are explored, hence useful for downstream tasks. The proposed method for augmentation can act as a module and be integrated into a point-based network. The resultant framework is end-to-end trainable. The experiments show that it achieves state-of-the-art performance on the ModelNet40 and ModelNet10 benchmarks. The code for this work is publicly available.

title: 基于切片Wasserstein距离的图像生成方法
title_en: Ariel Elnekave, Yair Weiss
abstract: 许多传统计算机视觉算法通过要求生成图像中的每个补丁与训练图像中的补丁相似(反之亦然)来生成逼真图像。近年来,这种经典方法已被使用补丁判别器的对抗训练所取代。对抗方法避免了寻找补丁最近邻的计算负担,但通常需要非常长的训练时间,且可能无法匹配补丁分布。在本文中,我们利用切片Wasserstein距离开发了一种算法,该算法能够显式且高效地最小化两幅图像中补丁分布之间的距离。我们的方法概念简单,无需训练,且可在几行代码中实现。在多个图像生成任务中,我们的结果通常优于单图像生成对抗网络(single-image-GANs),并且可在几秒钟内生成高质量图像。我们的实现可在https://github.com/ariel415el/GPDM公开获取。
abstract_en: Many traditional computer vision algorithms generate realistic images by requiring that each patch in the generated image be similar to a patch in a training image and vice versa. Recently, this classical approach has been replaced by adversarial training with a patch discriminator. The adversarial approach avoids the computational burden of finding nearest neighbors of patches but often requires very long training times and may fail to match the distribution of patches. In this paper we leverage the Sliced Wasserstein Distance to develop an algorithm that explicitly and efficiently minimizes the distance between patch distributions in two images. Our method is conceptually simple, requires no training and can be implemented in a few lines of codes. On a number of image generation tasks we show that our results are often superior to single-image-GANs, and can generate high quality images in a few seconds. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/ariel415el/GPDM.

title: Arjun Ashok, K J Joseph, Vineeth N Balasubramanian
title_en: Arjun Ashok, K J Joseph, Vineeth N Balasubramanian
abstract: In class-incremental learning, the model is expected to learn new classes continually while maintaining knowledge on previous classes. The challenge here lies in preserving the model’s ability to effectively represent prior classes in the feature space, while adapting it to represent incoming new classes. We propose two distillation-based objectives for class incremental learning that leverage the structure of the feature space to maintain accuracy on previous classes, as well as enable learning the new classes. In our first objective, termed cross-space clustering (CSC), we propose to use the feature space structure of the previous model to characterize directions of optimization that maximally preserve the class - directions that all instances of a specific class should collectively optimize towards, and those directions that they should collectively optimize away from. Apart from minimizing forgetting, such a class-level constraint indirectly encourages the model to reliably cluster all instances of a class in the current feature space, and further gives rise to a sense of “herd-immunity”, allowing all samples of a class to jointly combat the model from forgetting the class. Our second objective termed controlled transfer (CT) tackles incremental learning from an important and understudied perspective of inter-class transfer. CT explicitly approximates and conditions the current model on the semantic similarities between incrementally arriving classes and prior classes. This allows the model to learn the incoming classes in such a way that it maximizes positive forward transfer from similar prior classes, thus increasing plasticity, and minimizes negative backward transfer on dissimilar prior classes, whereby strengthening stability. We perform extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets, adding our method (CSCCT) on top of three prominent class-incremental learning methods. We observe consistent performance improvement on a variety of experimental settings.
abstract_en: In class-incremental learning, the model is expected to learn new classes continually while maintaining knowledge on previous classes. The challenge here lies in preserving the model’s ability to effectively represent prior classes in the feature space, while adapting it to represent incoming new classes. We propose two distillation-based objectives for class incremental learning that leverage the structure of the feature space to maintain accuracy on previous classes, as well as enable learning the new classes. In our first objective, termed cross-space clustering (CSC), we propose to use the feature space structure of the previous model to characterize directions of optimization that maximally preserve the class - directions that all instances of a specific class should collectively optimize towards, and those directions that they should collectively optimize away from. Apart from minimizing forgetting, such a class-level constraint indirectly encourages the model to reliably cluster all instances of a class in the current feature space, and further gives rise to a sense of “herd-immunity”, allowing all samples of a class to jointly combat the model from forgetting the class. Our second objective termed controlled transfer (CT) tackles incremental learning from an important and understudied perspective of inter-class transfer. CT explicitly approximates and conditions the current model on the semantic similarities between incrementally arriving classes and prior classes. This allows the model to learn the incoming classes in such a way that it maximizes positive forward transfer from similar prior classes, thus increasing plasticity, and minimizes negative backward transfer on dissimilar prior classes, whereby strengthening stability. We perform extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets, adding our method (CSCCT) on top of three prominent class-incremental learning methods. We observe consistent performance improvement on a variety of experimental settings.

title: Arsha Nagrani, Paul Hongsuck Seo, Bryan Seybold, Anja Hauth, Santiago Manen, Chen Sun, Cordelia Schmid
title_en: Arsha Nagrani, Paul Hongsuck Seo, Bryan Seybold, Anja Hauth, Santiago Manen, Chen Sun, Cordelia Schmid
abstract: 近年来,大规模图像-文本数据集的数量激增,因为带有替代文本描述的图像可以轻松在线获取。然而,以文本-视频和文本-音频配对形式获取大规模高质量的视频数据更具挑战性。为弥合这一差距,我们提出了一种新的视频挖掘流程,该流程通过将图像描述数据集中的描述转移到视频片段中,无需额外的人工努力。利用该流程,我们创建了一个新的大规模弱标注音频-视频描述数据集,包含数百万对视频片段和描述。我们证明,在该数据上训练基于多模态转换的模型,在视频检索和视频描述任务中取得了具有竞争力的性能,其效果与HowTo100M预训练模型相当,甚至在使用20倍更少的视频片段时表现更优。我们还表明,我们的挖掘视频片段适用于文本-音频预训练,并在音频检索任务中取得了最先进的结果。
abstract_en: There has been a recent explosion of large-scale image-text datasets, as images with alt-text captions can be easily obtained online. Obtaining large-scale, high quality data for video in the form of text-video and text-audio pairs however, is more challenging. To close this gap we propose a new video mining pipeline which involves transferring captions from image captioning datasets to video clips with no additional manual effort. Using this pipeline, we create a new large-scale, weakly labelled audio-video captioning dataset consisting of millions of paired clips and captions. We show that training a multimodal transformed based model on this data achieves competitive performance on video retrieval and video captioning, matching or even outperforming HowTo100M pretraining with 20x fewer clips. We also show that our mined clips are suitable for text-audio pretraining, and achieve state of the art results for the task of audio retrieval.

title: Artem Moskalev, Ivan Sosnovik, Volker Fischer, Arnold Smeulders
title_en: Artem Moskalev, Ivan Sosnovik, Volker Fischer, Arnold Smeulders
abstract: 对比学习的标准方法是通过最大化数据不同视图之间的相似性来实现。这些视图以成对形式排列,其中正样本表示同一对象的不同视图,负样本则对应不同对象的视图。监督信号来源于最大化正样本对的总相似性,而负样本对则用于防止模型退化。在本文中,我们注意到,仅考虑个体样本对的方法无法同时捕捉集合内部和集合间的相似性,当集合由数据视图形成时,这限制了可用于训练表示的监督信号的信息量。为此,我们提出超越对比个体样本对的方法,转而通过集合对比来聚焦对象集合。为此,我们采用组合二次分配理论,该理论旨在评估集合和图的相似性,并将集合对比目标作为对比学习方法的正则化项。我们进行了实验,并证明我们的方法在度量学习和自监督分类任务中提升了学习到的表示。
abstract_en: The standard approach to contrastive learning is to maximize the agreement between different views of the data. The views are ordered in pairs, such that they are either positive, encoding different views of the same object, or negative, corresponding to views of different objects. The supervisory signal comes from maximizing the total similarity over positive pairs, while the negative pairs are needed to avoid collapse. In this work, we note that the approach of considering individual pairs cannot account for both intra-set and inter-set similarities when the sets are formed from the views of the data. It thus limits the information content of the supervisory signal available to train representations. We propose to go beyond contrasting individual pairs of objects by focusing on contrasting objects as sets. For this, we use combinatorial quadratic assignment theory designed to evaluate set and graph similarities and derive set-contrastive objective as a regularizer for contrastive learning methods. We conduct experiments and demonstrate that our method improves learned representations for the tasks of metric learning and self-supervised classification.

title: DeepShadow:一种基于光度立体阴影图的单次拍摄深度图与表面法线恢复方法
title_en: Asaf Karnieli, Ohad Fried, Yacov Hel-Or
abstract: 本文提出了一种名为‘DeepShadow’的单次拍摄方法,用于从光度立体阴影图中恢复深度图和表面法线。以往研究将光度立体图像中的投影阴影视为干扰因素,而我们证明自阴影和投影阴影不仅不会干扰三维重建,反而可以作为强学习信号单独用于恢复深度图和表面法线。我们展示出在某些情况下,基于阴影的三维重建甚至可以超越基于明度的形状恢复方法。据我们所知,这是首个利用神经网络进行阴影三维形状重建的方法。该方法无需预训练或昂贵的标注数据,并在推理过程中进行优化。
abstract_en: This paper presents ‘DeepShadow’, a one-shot method for recovering the depth map and surface normals from photometric stereo shadow maps. Previous works that try to recover the surface normals from photometric stereo images treat cast shadows as a disturbance. We show that the self and cast shadows not only do not disturb 3D reconstruction, but can be used alone, as a strong learning signal, to recover the depth map and surface normals. We demonstrate that 3D reconstruction from shadows can even outperform shape-from-shading in certain cases. To the best of our knowledge, our method is the first to reconstruct 3D shape-from-shadows using neural networks. The method does not require any pre-training or expensive labeled data, and is optimized during inference time.

title: Ashima Garg, Depanshu Sani, Saket Anand
title_en: Ashima Garg, Depanshu Sani, Saket Anand
abstract: 标签层次结构通常作为生物分类学或语言数据集WordNet的一部分预先存在。已有研究利用这些层次结构来学习层次感知特征,以改进分类器,在保持或减少总体误差的同时使分类器产生语义上有意义的错误。本文提出了一种新颖的层次感知特征(HAF)学习方法,该方法在层次结构的每一层使用分类器,并约束这些分类器生成与标签层次结构一致的预测。分类器通过最小化Jensen-Shannon散度来训练,其中目标软标签来源于细粒度分类器。此外,我们采用了一种简单的几何损失函数,约束特征空间的几何结构以捕捉标签空间的语义结构。HAF是一种训练时方法,能够在保持top-1误差的同时改进错误,从而解决了交叉熵损失将所有错误视为同等严重的问题。我们在三个层次化数据集上评估HAF,并在iNaturalist-19和CIFAR-100数据集上取得了最先进的结果。
abstract_en: Label hierarchies are often available apriori as part of biological taxonomy or language datasets WordNet. Several works exploit these to learn hierarchy aware features in order to improve the classifier to make semantically meaningful mistakes while maintaining or reducing the overall error. In this paper, we propose a novel approach for learning Hierarchy Aware Features (HAF) that leverages classifiers at each level of the hierarchy that are constrained to generate predictions consistent with the label hierarchy. The classifiers are trained by minimizing a Jensen-Shannon Divergence with target soft labels obtained from the fine-grained classifiers. Additionally, we employ a simple geometric loss that constrains the feature space geometry to capture the semantic structure of the label space. HAF is a training time approach that improves the mistakes while maintaining top-1 error, thereby, addressing the problem of cross-entropy loss that treats all mistakes as equal. We evaluate HAF on three hierarchical datasets and achieve state-of-the-art results on the iNaturalist-19 and CIFAR-100 datasets.

title: Ashish Tiwari, Shanmuganathan Raman
title_en: Ashish Tiwari, Shanmuganathan Raman
abstract: Estimating 3D surface normals through photometric stereo has been of great interest in computer vision research. Despite the success of existing traditional and deep learning-based methods, it is still challenging due to: (i) the requirement of three or more differently illuminated images, (ii) the inability to model unknown general reflectance, and (iii) the requirement of accurate 3D ground truth surface normals and known lighting information for training. In this work, we attempt to address an under-explored problem of photometric stereo using just two differently illuminated images, referred to as the PS2 problem. It is an intermediate case between a single image-based reconstruction method like Shape from Shading (SfS) and the traditional Photometric Stereo (PS), which requires three or more images. We propose an inverse rendering-based deep learning framework, called DeepPS2, that jointly performs surface normal, albedo, lighting estimation, and image relighting in a completely self-supervised manner with no requirement of ground truth data. We demonstrate how image relighting in conjunction with image reconstruction enhances the lighting estimation in a self-supervised setting.
abstract_en: Estimating 3D surface normals through photometric stereo has been of great interest in computer vision research. Despite the success of existing traditional and deep learning-based methods, it is still challenging due to: (i) the requirement of three or more differently illuminated images, (ii) the inability to model unknown general reflectance, and (iii) the requirement of accurate 3D ground truth surface normals and known lighting information for training. In this work, we attempt to address an under-explored problem of photometric stereo using just two differently illuminated images, referred to as the PS2 problem. It is an intermediate case between a single image-based reconstruction method like Shape from Shading (SfS) and the traditional Photometric Stereo (PS), which requires three or more images. We propose an inverse rendering-based deep learning framework, called DeepPS2, that jointly performs surface normal, albedo, lighting estimation, and image relighting in a completely self-supervised manner with no requirement of ground truth data. We demonstrate how image relighting in conjunction with image reconstruction enhances the lighting estimation in a self-supervised setting.

title: LaTeRF: 一种基于神经场和自然语言描述的物体提取方法
title_en: Ashkan Mirzaei, Yash Kant, Jonathan Kelly, Igor Gilitschenski
abstract: 获取三维物体表示对于创建逼真模拟器和收集AR/VR应用资产至关重要。神经场在从二维图像学习场景的连续体素表示方面表现出色,但如何在弱监督条件下从这些模型中获取物体表示仍是一个开放性挑战。本文提出LaTeRF方法,该方法通过给定场景的二维图像、已知相机姿态、物体的自然语言描述以及输入图像中少量的点标签(物体点和非物体点),从场景中提取目标物体。为忠实提取物体,LaTeRF在每个三维点扩展NeRF公式,增加了一个“物体性”概率。此外,我们结合预训练CLIP模型的丰富潜在空间与可微物体渲染器,对物体被遮挡部分进行修复。我们在合成和真实数据集上展示了高保真度的物体提取效果,并通过广泛的消融实验验证了设计选择。
abstract_en: Obtaining 3D object representations is important for creating photo-realistic simulators and collecting assets for AR/VR applications. Neural fields have shown their effectiveness in learning a continuous volumetric representation of a scene from 2D images, but acquiring object representations from these models with weak supervision remains an open challenge. In this paper we introduce LaTeRF, a method for extracting an object of interest from a scene given 2D images of the entire scene and known camera poses, a natural language description of the object, and a small number of point-labels of object and non-object points in the input images. To faithfully extract the object from the scene, LaTeRF extends the NeRF formulation with an additional ‘objectness’ probability at each 3D point. Additionally, we leverage the rich latent space of a pre-trained CLIP model combined with our differentiable object renderer, to inpaint the occluded parts of the object. We demonstrate high-fidelity object extraction on both synthetic and real datasets and justify our design choices through an extensive ablation study.

title: Athanasios Papaioannou, Baris Gecer, Shiyang Cheng, Grigorios G. Chrysos, Jiankang Deng, Eftychia Fotiadou, Christos Kampouris, Dimitrios Kollias, Stylianos Moschoglou, Kritaphat Songsri-In, Stylianos Ploumpis, George Trigeorgis, Panagiotis Tzirakis, Evangelos Ververas, Yuxiang Zhou, Allan Ponniah, Anastasios Roussos, Stefanos Zafeiriou
title_en: Athanasios Papaioannou, Baris Gecer, Shiyang Cheng, Grigorios G. Chrysos, Jiankang Deng, Eftychia Fotiadou, Christos Kampouris, Dimitrios Kollias, Stylianos Moschoglou, Kritaphat Songsri-In, Stylianos Ploumpis, George Trigeorgis, Panagiotis Tzirakis, Evangelos Ververas, Yuxiang Zhou, Allan Ponniah, Anastasios Roussos, Stefanos Zafeiriou
abstract: 近年来,深度神经网络(DNNs)在计算机视觉、语音识别和自然语言处理等多个领域中被证明优于传统方法。深度神经网络成功应用的前提条件是拥有大量数据。尽管存在多种用于二维图像的面部数据集,但在处理三维人脸时却存在显著的数据集缺失。现有的面部数据集在表情种类或受试者数量方面均存在局限。这种缺乏大规模数据集的情况阻碍了深度神经网络所带来的巨大进步的发挥。在本文中,我们通过引入MimicMe这一新型大规模动态高分辨率三维人脸数据库,克服了这些限制。MimicMe包含4,700名受试者的记录,涵盖年龄、性别和种族的广泛多样性。这些记录以四维视频形式呈现,展示了多种面部行为,总计生成超过280,000个三维网格。我们还手动标注了这些网格中的大部分内容,标注了三维面部关键点,并将其归类到相应的表情类别中。此外,我们还构建了非常强大的混合形状(blendshapes)以参数化面部行为。MimicMe将在论文发表后公开获取,我们预计它将对从事人脸建模与分析研究的科研人员极具价值,包括三维/四维人脸及面部表情识别等众多问题。我们进行了多项实验,展示了该数据库在多种应用中的实用性。
abstract_en: Recently, Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have been shown to outperform traditional methods in many disciplines such as computer vision, speech recognition and natural language processing. A prerequisite for the successful application of DNNs is the big number of data. Even though various facial datasets exist for the case of 2D images, there is a remarkable absence of datasets when we have to deal with 3D faces. The available facial datasets are limited either in terms of expressions or in the number of subjects. This lack of large datasets hinders the exploitation of the great advances that DNNs can provide. In this paper, we overcome these limitations by introducing MimicMe, a novel large-scale database of dynamic high-resolution 3D faces. MimicMe contains recordings of 4,700 subjects with a great diversity on age, gender and ethnicity. The recordings are in the form of 4D videos of subjects displaying a multitude of facial behaviours, resulting to over 280,000 3D meshes in total. We have also manually annotated a big portion of these meshes with 3D facial landmarks and they have been categorized in the corresponding expressions. We have also built very powerful blendshapes for parametrising facial behaviour. MimicMe will be made publicly available upon publication and we envision that it will be extremely valuable to researchers working in many problems of face modelling and analysis, including 3D/4D face and facial expression recognition. We conduct several experiments and demonstrate the usefulness of the database for various applications.

title: Atreyee Saha, Salman S. Khan, Sagar Sehrawat, Sanjana S. Prabhu, Shanti Bhattacharya, Kaushik Mitra
title_en: Atreyee Saha, Salman S. Khan, Sagar Sehrawat, Sanjana S. Prabhu, Shanti Bhattacharya, Kaushik Mitra
abstract: 傅里叶全息显微镜(FPM)是一种成像技术,通过计算方法克服了传统显微镜在空间带宽积(SBP)上的限制。它利用低数值孔径(NA)物镜捕获的多张图像,并通过频域拼接实现高分辨率相位成像。现有的FPM重建方法大致可分为两类:基于物理正向成像模型的迭代优化方法,以及常用前馈深度学习框架的数据驱动方法。我们提出了一种混合模型驱动的残差网络,结合正向成像系统的知识与深度数据驱动网络。所提出的架构LWGNet将传统的Wirtinger流优化算法展开为一种新颖的神经网络设计,通过复数卷积块增强梯度图像。与传统的展开技术不同,LWGNet在阶段数更少的情况下,性能与现有传统方法和深度学习技术相当,尤其在低成本和低动态范围CMOS传感器上表现更优。这种在低比特深度和低成本传感器上的性能提升,有望显著降低FPM成像系统的成本。最后,我们在收集的实测数据上展示了持续改进的性能。
abstract_en: Fourier Ptychographic Microscopy (FPM) is an imaging procedure that overcomes the traditional limit on Space-Bandwidth Product (SBP) of conventional microscopes through computational means. It utilizes multiple images captured using a low numerical aperture (NA) objective and enables high-resolution phase imaging through frequency domain stitching. Existing FPM reconstruction methods can be broadly categorized into two approaches: iterative optimization based methods, which are based on the physics of the forward imaging model, and data-driven methods which commonly employ a feed-forward deep learning framework. We propose a hybrid model-driven residual network that combines the knowledge of the forward imaging system with a deep data-driven network. Our proposed architecture, LWGNet, unrolls traditional Wirtinger flow optimization algorithm into a novel neural network design that enhances the gradient images through complex convolutional blocks. Unlike other conventional unrolling techniques, LWGNet uses fewer stages while performing at par or even better than existing traditional and deep learning techniques, particularly, for low-cost and low dynamic range CMOS sensors. This improvement in performance for low-bit depth and low-cost sensors has the potential to bring down the cost of FPM imaging setup significantly. Finally, we show consistently improved performance on our collected real data.

title: Noguchi, Sun, Lin, Harada
title_en: Atsuhiro Noguchi, Xiao Sun, Stephen Lin, Tatsuya Harada
abstract: 我们提出了一种无监督方法,用于学习具有三维几何感知能力的可变形物体表示,该方法在训练过程中不使用图像-姿态对或前景掩码。尽管可以通过现有的三维神经表示方法通过显式姿态控制生成逼真图像,但这些方法需要真实三维姿态和前景掩码进行训练,而这些数据获取成本较高。我们通过使用生成对抗网络(GAN)训练来避免这一需求。生成器通过对抗训练从随机姿态和潜在向量中生成可变形物体的逼真图像。为避免GAN训练的高计算成本,我们提出了一种基于三平面的高效神经表示方法,并提出了基于GAN的无监督训练框架。实验结果验证了我们方法的高效性,并表明基于GAN的训练能够实现无需配对监督的可控三维表示学习。
abstract_en: We propose an unsupervised method for 3D geometry-aware representation learning of articulated objects, in which no image-pose pairs or foreground masks are used for training. Though photorealistic images of articulated objects can be rendered with explicit pose control through existing 3D neural representations, these methods require ground truth 3D pose and foreground masks for training, which are expensive to obtain. We obviate this need by learning the representations with GAN training. The generator is trained to produce realistic images of articulated objects from random poses and latent vectors by adversarial training. To avoid a high computational cost for GAN training, we propose an efficient neural representation for articulated objects based on tri-planes and then present a GAN-based framework for its unsupervised training. Experiments demonstrate the efficiency of our method and show that GAN-based training enables the learning of controllable 3D representations without paired supervision.

title: __TITLE_MATH_1__
title_en: Atsuro Okazawa
abstract: 传统的语义分割需要大量的标注图像数据集,并且只能在预定义的类别内进行预测。解决少样本分割问题(即仅需少量标注即可对新目标类别进行分割)具有重要意义。然而,在少样本分割中,由于样本数据的微小变化,目标类别在特征空间中的数据分布稀疏且覆盖范围有限。设置能够正确区分目标类别与其他类别的分类边界是一项不可能的任务。特别是,难以对接近边界且与目标类别相似的类别进行分类。本研究提出了一种跨类原型关系网络(IPRNet),通过降低其他类之间的相似性来提升分离性能。我们在Pascal-5i和COCO-20i数据集上进行了大量实验,结果表明IPRNet相比以往研究提供了最佳的分割性能。
abstract_en: Traditional semantic segmentation requires a large labeled image dataset and can only be predicted within predefined classes. Solving this problem of few-shot segmentation, which requires only a handful of annotations for the new target class, is important. However, with few-shot segmentation, the target class data distribution in the feature space is sparse and has low coverage because of the slight variations in the sample data. Setting the classification boundary that properly separates the target class from other classes is an impossible task. In particular, it is difficult to classify classes that are similar to the target class near the boundary. This study proposes the Interclass Prototype Relation Network (IPRNet), which improves the separation performance by reducing the similarity between other classes. We conducted extensive experiments with Pascal-5i and COCO-20i and showed that IPRNet provides the best segmentation performance compared with previous research.

title: Axel Levy, Frédéric Poitevin, Julien Martel, Youssef Nashed, Ariana Peck, Nina Miolane, Daniel Ratner, Mike Dunne, Gordon Wetzstein
title_en: Axel Levy, Frédéric Poitevin, Julien Martel, Youssef Nashed, Ariana Peck, Nina Miolane, Daniel Ratner, Mike Dunne, Gordon Wetzstein
abstract: 冷冻电子显微镜(cryo-EM)已成为结构生物学中具有基础重要性的工具,帮助我们理解生命的最基本构建模块。冷冻电子显微镜的算法挑战在于,从数百万张极其嘈杂的二维图像中联合估计生物分子的未知三维姿态和三维电子散射势。然而,现有重建算法由于计算和内存成本高昂,难以跟上冷冻电子显微镜数据集的快速增长。我们引入了cryoAI,这是一种针对均质构象的从头开始重建算法,通过直接基于梯度的优化方法,从单颗粒冷冻电子显微镜数据中优化粒子姿态和电子散射势。cryoAI结合了一个学习编码器,用于预测每个粒子图像的姿态,并与基于物理的解码器结合,将每个粒子图像聚合为散射势体积的隐式表示。该体积以傅里叶域存储以提高计算效率,并利用现代坐标网络架构以提高内存效率。结合对称化的损失函数,该框架在模拟和实验数据上均实现了与现有冷冻电子显微镜求解器相当的重建质量,对于大型数据集速度提升一个数量级,并且内存需求显著低于现有方法。
abstract_en: Cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has become a tool of fundamental importance in structural biology, helping us understand the basic building blocks of life. The algorithmic challenge of cryo-EM is to jointly estimate the unknown 3D poses and the 3D electron scattering potential of a biomolecule from millions of extremely noisy 2D images. Existing reconstruction algorithms, however, cannot easily keep pace with the rapidly growing size of cryo-EM datasets due to their high computational and memory cost. We introduce cryoAI, an ab initio reconstruction algorithm for homogeneous conformations that uses direct gradient-based optimization of particle poses and the electron scattering potential from single-particle cryo-EM data. CryoAI combines a learned encoder that predicts the poses of each particle image with a physics-based decoder to aggregate each particle image into an implicit representation of the scattering potential volume. This volume is stored in the Fourier domain for computational efficiency and leverages a modern coordinate network architecture for memory efficiency. Combined with a symmetrized loss function, this framework achieves results of a quality on par with state-of-the-art cryo-EM solvers for both simulated and experimental data, one order of magnitude faster for large datasets and with significantly lower memory requirements than existing methods.

title: Ayan Kumar Bhunia, Aneeshan Sain, Parth Hiren Shah, Animesh Gupta, Pinaki Nath Chowdhury, Tao Xiang, Yi-Zhe Song
title_en: Ayan Kumar Bhunia, Aneeshan Sain, Parth Hiren Shah, Animesh Gupta, Pinaki Nath Chowdhury, Tao Xiang, Yi-Zhe Song
abstract: 近年来,细粒度草图基于图像检索(FG-SBIR)的研究重点转向了在没有目标类别训练数据的情况下实现模型泛化。然而在实际应用中,训练好的FG-SBIR模型通常需要同时处理新类别和不同的人类草图绘制者(即不同的绘画风格)。尽管这使泛化问题复杂化,幸运的是通常可以获取少量示例,使模型能够适应新类别/风格。本文提出了一种新颖的视角——而非追求模型泛化能力,我们主张开发一种仅需极少量样本即可快速适应的模型(少样本方式)。为解决这一新问题,我们引入了一种基于模型无关元学习(MAML)的框架,并进行了多项关键改进:(1)作为具有基于边距对比损失的检索任务,我们在内循环中简化MAML训练以提高稳定性与可操作性。(2)我们的对比损失中的边距参数也与模型其余部分一同进行元学习。(3)在外循环中引入了三个额外的正则化损失项,以提升元学习得到的FG-SBIR模型在类别/风格适应中的有效性。在公开数据集上的大量实验表明,该方法在泛化和零样本方法基础上取得了显著提升,并优于多种强效的少样本基线方法。
abstract_en: The recent focus on Fine-Grained Sketch-Based Image Retrieval (FG-SBIR) has shifted towards generalising a model to new categories without any training data from them. In real-world applications, however, a trained FG-SBIR model is often applied to both new categories and different human sketchers, i.e., different drawing styles. Although this complicates the generalisation problem, fortunately, a handful of examples are typically available, enabling the model to adapt to the new category/style. In this paper, we offer a novel perspective -- instead of asking for a model that generalises, we advocate for one that quickly adapts, with just very few samples during testing (in a few-shot manner). To solve this new problem, we introduce a novel model-agnostic meta-learning (MAML) based framework with several key modifications: (1) As a retrieval task with a margin-based contrastive loss, we simplify the MAML training in the inner loop to make it more stable and tractable. (2) The margin in our contrastive loss is also meta-learned with the rest of the model. (3) Three additional regularisation losses are introduced in the outer loop, to make the meta-learned FG-SBIR model more effective for category/style adaptation. Extensive experiments on public datasets suggest a large gain over generalisation and zero-shot based approaches, and a few strong few-shot baselines.

title: Ayush Chopra, Abhinav Java, Abhishek Singh, Vivek Sharma, Ramesh Raskar
title_en: Ayush Chopra, Abhinav Java, Abhishek Singh, Vivek Sharma, Ramesh Raskar
abstract: 点云作为一种日益普遍的输入模态,其原始信号可通过深度学习的最新进展进行高效处理。然而,这种信号往往无意中捕获了敏感信息,可能泄露场景的语义和几何属性,而数据所有者并不希望共享这些信息。本工作的目标是在从点云中学习时保护敏感信息,通过在点云发布给下游任务之前进行信号审查。具体而言,我们专注于在保持感知任务效用的同时缓解属性泄露攻击。关键的启发式思路是利用感知任务在点云上的局部显著性,以实现良好的隐私-效用权衡。我们通过一种称为噪声采样审查(CBNS)的机制实现这一目标,该机制包含两个模块:i)不变采样:一种可微分的点云采样器,学习去除对效用不变的点;ii)噪声失真:学习对采样点进行失真处理,以解耦敏感信息与效用,并缓解隐私泄露。我们通过与最新基线的广泛比较以及关键设计选择的敏感性分析验证了CBNS的有效性。结果表明,CBNS实现了优越的隐私-效用权衡。
abstract_en: Point clouds are an increasingly ubiquitous input modality and the raw signal can be efficiently processed with recent progress in deep learning. This signal may, often inadvertently, capture sensitive information that can leak semantic and geometric properties of the scene which the data owner does not want to share. The goal of this work is to protect sensitive information when learning from point clouds; by censoring signal before the point cloud is released for downstream tasks. Specifically, we focus on preserving utility for perception tasks while mitigating attribute leakage attacks. The key motivating insight is to leverage the localized saliency of perception tasks on point clouds to provide good privacy-utility trade-offs. We realize this through a mechanism called censoring by noisy sampling (CBNS), which is composed of two modules: i) Invariant Sampling: a differentiable point-cloud sampler which learns to remove points invariant to utility and ii) Noise Distortion: which learns to distort sampled points to decouple the sensitive information from utility, and mitigate privacy leakage. We validate the effectiveness of CBNS through extensive comparisons with state-of-the-art baselines and sensitivity analyses of key design choices. Results show that CBNS achieves superior privacy-utility trade-offs.

title: Ayush Jain, Nikolaos Gkanatsios, Ishita Mediratta, Katerina Fragkiadaki
title_en: Ayush Jain, Nikolaos Gkanatsios, Ishita Mediratta, Katerina Fragkiadaki
abstract: 大多数旨在将指称性话语定位到二维和三维场景中的模型,学习从预训练检测器提供的对象建议池中选择所指对象。这种做法存在局限性,因为话语可能指代不同粒度的视觉实体,例如椅子、椅子的腿或椅子前腿的尖端,这些可能被检测器遗漏。我们提出一种语言定位模型,通过关注指称性话语和由预训练检测器计算的对象建议池,利用检测头解码所指对象,而无需从池中选择。这样,该模型借助强大的预训练对象检测器,而不受其遗漏的限制。我们称该模型为自下而上自上而下检测变换器(BUTD-DETR),因为它同时利用语言引导(自上而下)和对象性引导(自下而上)在图像和点云中定位指称性话语。此外,BUTD-DETR将目标检测视为指称性定位任务,并使用对象标签作为语言提示,从而在视觉场景中增强指称性定位任务的监督。所提出的模型在流行的3D语言定位基准测试中取得了新的最先进性能,显著优于之前的3D方法(在SR3D上提升12.6%,在NR3D上提升11.6%,在ScanRefer上提升6.3%)。当应用于二维图像时,其性能与之前的最先进方法相当。我们对模型设计选择进行了消融实验,并量化了它们对性能的贡献。我们的代码和检查点可在项目网站https://butd-detr.github.io找到。
abstract_en: Most models tasked to ground referential utterances in 2D and 3D scenes learn to select the referred object from a pool of object proposals provided by a pre-trained detector. This is limiting because an utterance may refer to visual entities at various levels of granularity, such as the chair, the leg of the chair, or the tip of the front leg of the chair, which may be missed by the detector. We propose a language grounding model that attends on the referential utterance and on the object proposal pool computed from a pre-trained detector to decode referenced objects with a detection head, without selecting them from the pool. In this way, it is helped by powerful pre-trained object detectors without being restricted by their misses. We call our model Bottom Up Top Down DEtection TRansformers (BUTD-DETR) because it uses both language guidance (top down) and objectness guidance (bottom-up) to ground referential utterances in images and point clouds. Moreover, BUTD-DETR casts object detection as referential grounding and uses object labels as language prompts to be grounded in the visual scene, augmenting supervision for the referential grounding task in this way. The proposed model sets a new state-of-the-art across popular 3D language grounding benchmarks with significant performance gains over previous 3D approaches (12.6% on SR3D, 11.6% on NR3D and 6.3% on ScanRefer). When applied in 2D images, it performs on par with the previous state of the art. We ablate the design choices of our model and quantify their contribution to performance. Our code and checkpoints can be found at the project website https://butd-detr.github.io

title: Babak Ehteshami Bejnordi, Amirhossein Habibian, Fatih Porikli, Amir Ghodrati
title_en: Babak Ehteshami Bejnordi, Amirhossein Habibian, Fatih Porikli, Amir Ghodrati
abstract: 高分辨率图像被广泛用于视频中的高性能目标检测。然而,处理高分辨率输入会带来高昂的计算成本,而简单地对输入进行下采样以降低计算成本会迅速导致检测性能下降。本文提出SALISA,一种新颖的非均匀基于显著性的输入采样技术,用于视频目标检测。该技术允许对不重要的背景区域进行大量下采样,同时保留高分辨率图像的细粒度细节。生成的图像空间尺寸更小,从而降低计算成本,同时实现与高分辨率输入相当的检测性能。为实现这一目标,我们提出了一种基于薄板样条空间变换网络(TPS-STN)的可微重采样模块。该模块通过一种新颖的损失函数进行正则化,以提供明确的监督信号,学习“放大”显著区域。我们在ImageNet-VID和UA-DETRAC视频目标检测数据集上报告了低计算量下的最先进结果。我们证明,在这两个数据集上,EfficientDet-D1(EfficientDet-D2)的mAP与EfficientDet-D2(EfficientDet-D3)相当,但计算成本显著降低。我们还表明,SALISA显著提升了小目标的检测性能。特别是,使用EfficientDet-D1检测器的SALISA在小目标检测上提升了77%,并且在某些情况下甚至超越了EfficientDet-D3基线。
abstract_en: High-resolution images are widely adopted for high-performance object detection in videos. However, processing high-resolution inputs comes with high computation costs, and naive down-sampling of the input to reduce the computation costs quickly degrades the detection performance. In this paper, we propose SALISA, a novel non-uniform SALiency-based Input SAmpling technique for video object detection that allows for heavy down-sampling of unimportant background regions while preserving the fine-grained details of a high-resolution image. The resulting image is spatially smaller, leading to reduced computational costs while enabling a performance comparable to a high-resolution input. To achieve this, we propose a differentiable resampling module based on a thin plate spline spatial transformer network (TPS-STN). This module is regularized by a novel loss to provide an explicit supervision signal to learn to “magnify” salient regions. We report state-of-the-art results in the low compute regime on the ImageNet-VID and UA-DETRAC video object detection datasets. We demonstrate that on both datasets, the mAP of an EfficientDet-D1 (EfficientDet-D2) gets on par with EfficientDet-D2 (EfficientDet-D3) at a much lower computational cost. We also show that SALISA significantly improves the detection of small objects. In particular, SALISA with an EfficientDet-D1 detector improves the detection of small objects by 77%, and remarkably also outperforms EfficientDet-D3 baseline.

title: Bangbang Yang, Chong Bao, Junyi Zeng, Hujun Bao, Yinda Zhang, Zhaopeng Cui, Guofeng Zhang
title_en: Bangbang Yang, Chong Bao, Junyi Zeng, Hujun Bao, Yinda Zhang, Zhaopeng Cui, Guofeng Zhang
abstract: 近期神经隐式渲染技术迅速发展,并在新视角合成和三维场景重建中展现出显著优势。然而,现有用于编辑目的的神经渲染方法功能有限,例如仅支持刚性变换,或无法对日常生活中的一般物体进行精细编辑。本文提出了一种基于网格的表示方法,通过在网格顶点上对神经隐式场进行解耦的几何和纹理编码,从而实现一系列编辑功能,包括网格引导的几何编辑、指定纹理编辑(支持纹理交换、填充和绘画操作)。为此,我们开发了多种技术:可学习的符号指示器以增强基于网格表示的空间可区分性,蒸馏与微调机制以确保稳定收敛,以及空间感知优化策略以实现精确的纹理编辑。在真实和合成数据上的大量实验及编辑示例验证了我们的方法在表示质量和编辑能力上的优越性。代码可在项目网页上获取:https://zju3dv.github.io/neumesh/
abstract_en: Very recently neural implicit rendering techniques have been rapidly evolved and shown great advantages in novel view synthesis and 3D scene reconstruction. However, existing neural rendering methods for editing purposes offer limited functionality, e.g., rigid transformation, or not applicable for fine-grained editing for general objects from daily lives. In this paper, we present a novel mesh-based representation by encoding the neural implicit field with disentangled geometry and texture codes on mesh vertices, which facilitates a set of editing functionalities, including mesh-guided geometry editing, designated texture editing with texture swapping, filling and painting operations. To this end, we develop several techniques including learnable sign indicators to magnify spatial distinguishability of mesh-based representation, distillation and fine-tuning mechanism to make a steady convergence, and the spatial-aware optimization strategy to realize precise texture editing. Extensive experiments and editing examples on both real and synthetic data demonstrate the superiority of our method on representation quality and editing ability. Code is available on the project webpage: https://zju3dv.github.io/neumesh/.

title: Banglei Guan, Ji Zhao
title_en: Banglei Guan, Ji Zhao
abstract: 我们提出了一种利用两个仿射对应关系(ACs)计算多摄像机系统六自由度相对姿态的新方法。现有解决方案要么受限于特定运动情况,计算复杂度过高,或需要过多点对应关系(PCs)。因此,这些求解器在使用RANSAC作为鲁棒估计器时,会阻碍高效或准确的相对姿态估计。本文表明,通过特殊参数化方法利用ACs与多摄像机系统之间的几何约束,相对姿态估计问题允许可行的最小解。我们基于两个ACs提出问题公式化,涵盖跨摄像机和同摄像机两种常见的ACs类型。在虚拟和真实多摄像机系统上的实验表明,所提出的求解器比现有算法更高效,同时获得更好的相对姿态精度。源代码可在https://github.com/jizhaox/relpose-mcs-depth获取。
abstract_en: We present a novel method to compute the 6DOF relative pose of multi-camera systems using two affine correspondences (ACs). Existing solutions to the multi-camera relative pose estimation are either restricted to special cases of motion, have too high computational complexity, or require too many point correspondences (PCs). Thus, these solvers impede an efficient or accurate relative pose estimation when applying RANSAC as a robust estimator. This paper shows that the relative pose estimation problem using ACs permits a feasible minimal solution, when exploiting the geometric constraints between ACs and multi-camera systems using a special parameterization. We present a problem formulation based on two ACs that encompass two common types of ACs across two views, i.e., inter-camera and intra-camera. Experiments on both virtual and real multi-camera systems prove that the proposed solvers are more efficient than the state-of-the-art algorithms, while resulting in a better relative pose accuracy. Source code is available at https://github.com/jizhaox/relpose-mcs-depth.

title: Bangrui Jiang, Zhihuai Xie, Zhen Xia, Songnan Li, Shan Liu
title_en: Bangrui Jiang, Zhihuai Xie, Zhen Xia, Songnan Li, Shan Liu
abstract: 视频去模糊旨在从模糊的视频序列中恢复清晰的帧。现有方法通常采用光流来补偿参考帧与每个相邻帧之间的错位。然而,由于大位移导致的光流估计不准确会在变形帧中引入伪影。在本工作中,我们提出了一种等效感受野可变形网络(ERDN),在特征层面进行对齐而无需估计光流。ERDN引入了一个双金字塔对齐模块,在该模块中通过级联的可变形卷积构建特征金字塔以对齐帧。具体而言,我们采用扩张空间金字塔块来预测可变形卷积的偏移量,使得每个特征金字塔层的理论感受野等效。为恢复清晰帧,我们提出了一种梯度引导融合模块,将结构先验纳入恢复过程。实验结果表明,所提方法在多个基准数据集上优于先前的最先进方法。代码已开源:https://github.com/TencentCloud/ERDN
abstract_en: Video deblurring aims to restore sharp frames from blurry video sequences. Existing methods usually adopt optical flow to compensate misalignment between reference frame and each neighboring frame. However, inaccurate flow estimation caused by large displacements will lead to artifacts in the warped frames. In this work, we propose an equivalent receptive field deformable network (ERDN) to perform alignment at the feature level without estimating optical flow. The ERDN introduces a dual pyramid alignment module, in which a feature pyramid is constructed to align frames using deformable convolution in a cascaded manner. Specifically, we adopt dilated spatial pyramid blocks to predict offsets for deformable convolutions, so that the theoretical receptive field is equivalent for each feature pyramid layer. To restore the sharp frame, we propose a gradient guided fusion module, which incorporates structure priors into the restoration process. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods on multiple benchmark datasets. The code is made available at: https://github.com/TencentCloud/ERDN.

title: Baoming Yan, Ke Gao, Bo Gao, Lin Wang, Jiang Yang, Xiaobo Li
title_en: Baoming Yan, Ke Gao, Bo Gao, Lin Wang, Jiang Yang, Xiaobo Li
abstract: 类别细分(CCS)在许多实际应用中具有重要意义,其中原本为粗粒度类别(例如鸟类)标注的训练集需要进一步支持其子类别的识别(例如天鹅、乌鸦),而仅有非常有限的细粒度标注样本。从因果表征学习的角度来看,这些子类别继承了粗粒度类别的相同决定性因素,其差异仅体现在值上。因此,为了以最小的细粒度标注成本支持具有挑战性的CCS任务,理想的增强方法应通过操控生成因素的粒度生成大量变体。为此,传统数据增强方法远未达到要求。它们通常在高度耦合的图像或特征空间中进行操作,因此只能模拟全局几何或光度变换。借助近期因素解耦生成器的进展,提出了一种无偏流形增强(UMA)方法用于CCS。通过一个可控制的预训练StyleGAN(用于粗粒度类别),在每个子类别的因素解耦流形上进行近似无偏增强,揭示了目标子类别与其决定性因素之间的无偏互信息。大量实验表明,在小数据学习场景(常用数据集的细粒度样本少于1%)下,与现有数据增强方法相比,UMA平均提升10.37%。在严重偏倚的挑战性任务中,准确率最高可提升16.79%。
abstract_en: Class Subdivision (CCS) is important for many practical applications, where the training set originally annotated for a coarse class (e.g. bird) needs to further support its sub-classes recognition (e.g. swan, crow) with only very few fine-grained labeled samples. From the perspective of causal representation learning, these sub-classes inherit the same determinative factors of the coarse class, and their difference lies only in values. Therefore, to support the challenging CCS task with minimum fine-grained labeling cost, an ideal data augmentation method should generate abundant variants by manipulating these sub-class samples at the granularity of generating factors. For this goal, traditional data augmentation methods are far from sufficient. They often perform in highly-coupled image or feature space, thus can only simulate global geometric or photometric transformations. Leveraging the recent progress of factor-disentangled generators, Unbiased Manifold Augmentation (UMA) is proposed for CCS. With a controllable StyleGAN pre-trained for a coarse class, an approximate unbiased augmentation is conducted on the factor-disentangled manifolds for each sub-class, revealing the unbiased mutual information between the target sub-class and its determinative factors. Extensive experiments have shown that in the case of small data learning (less than 1\% fine-grained samples of commonly used), our UMA can achieve 10.37\% average improvement compared with existing data augmentation methods. On challenging tasks with severe bias, the accuracy is improved by up to 16.79\%.

title: Ben Xue, Shenghui Ran, Quan Chen, Rongfei Jia, Binqiang Zhao, Xing Tang
title_en: Ben Xue, Shenghui Ran, Quan Chen, Rongfei Jia, Binqiang Zhao, Xing Tang
abstract: 图像色彩和谐化算法旨在自动匹配在不同条件下捕获的前景和背景图像的颜色分布。先前基于深度学习的模型忽视了两个对实际应用至关重要的问题,即高分辨率(HR)图像处理和模型可解释性。在本文中,我们提出了一种新颖的深度可解释色彩滤波器(DCCF)学习框架用于高分辨率图像和谐化。具体而言,DCCF首先将原始输入图像下采样到其低分辨率(LR)版本,然后以端到端方式学习四种人类可理解的神经滤波器(即色相、饱和度、明度和注意力渲染滤波器),最后将这些滤波器应用于原始输入图像以获得和谐化结果。得益于可解释的神经滤波器,我们能够为用户提供一个简单而高效的处理工具,以便在必要时以极少的努力与深度模型协作以获得所需结果。大量实验验证了DCCF学习框架的有效性,并在iHarmony4数据集上,其在图像全分辨率上优于最先进的后处理方法,分别在MSE和PSNR上实现了7.63%和1.69%的相对提升。我们的代码可在https://github.com/rockeyben/DCCF获取。
abstract_en: Image color harmonization algorithm aims to automatically match the color distribution of foreground and background images captured in different conditions. Previous deep learning based models neglect two issues that are critical for practical applications, namely high resolution (HR) image processing and model comprehensibility. In this paper, we propose a novel Deep Comprehensible Color Filter (DCCF) learning framework for high-resolution image harmonization. Specifically, DCCF first downsamples the original input image to its low-resolution (LR) counter-part, then learns four human comprehensible neural filters (i.e. hue, saturation, value and attentive rendering filters) in an end-to-end manner, finally applies these filters to the original input image to get the harmonized result. Benefiting from the comprehensible neural filters, we could provide a simple yet efficient handler for users to cooperate with deep model to get the desired results with very little effort when necessary. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of DCCF learning framework and it outperforms state-of-the-art post-processing method on iHarmony4 dataset on images’ full-resolutions by achieving 7.63% and 1.69% relative improvements on MSE and PSNR respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/rockeyben/DCCF.

title: Benedikt Boecking, Naoto Usuyama, Shruthi Bannur, Daniel C. Castro, Anton Schwaighofer, Stephanie Hyland, Maria Wetscherek, Tristan Naumann, Aditya Nori, Javier Alvarez-Valle, Hoifung Poon, Ozan Oktay
title_en: Benedikt Boecking, Naoto Usuyama, Shruthi Bannur, Daniel C. Castro, Anton Schwaighofer, Stephanie Hyland, Maria Wetscherek, Tristan Naumann, Aditya Nori, Javier Alvarez-Valle, Hoifung Poon, Ozan Oktay
abstract: 生物医学领域存在大量多模态数据,例如放射影像和报告。在大规模解读此类数据对于改善临床护理和加速临床研究至关重要。与通用领域相比,生物医学文本因其复杂的语义特性,在视觉-语言建模中面临额外挑战,而先前工作使用了未充分适配的模型,缺乏领域特定的语言理解能力。本文展示了一种基于原则的文本语义建模方法可显著提升自监督视觉-语言处理中的对比学习效果。我们发布了一种语言模型,通过改进的词汇量和利用放射报告中语义及话语特征的新型语言预训练目标,在放射学自然语言推理任务中实现了最先进的结果。进一步地,我们提出了一种以更好文本建模为核心的自监督联合视觉-语言方法。该方法在多个公开基准测试中建立了新的最先进结果,部分得益于我们新开发的领域特定语言模型。我们发布了一个包含放射科医生标注的局部对齐短语定位注释的新数据集,以促进生物医学视觉-语言处理中复杂语义建模的研究。广泛的评估,包括在该新数据集上的测试,表明我们的对比学习方法在分割任务中优于先前方法,尽管仅使用了全局对齐目标。
abstract_en: Multi-modal data abounds in biomedicine, such as radiology images and reports. Interpreting this data at scale is essential for improving clinical care and accelerating clinical research. Biomedical text with its complex semantics poses additional challenges in vision-language modelling compared to the general domain, and previous work has used insufficiently adapted models that lack domain-specific language understanding. In this paper, we show that principled textual semantic modelling can substantially improve contrastive learning in self-supervised vision-language processing. We release a language model that achieves state-of-the-art results in radiology natural-language inference through its improved vocabulary and novel language pretraining objective leveraging semantics and discourse characteristics in radiology reports. Further, we propose a self-supervised joint vision-language approach with a focus on better text modelling. It establishes new state of the art results on a wide range of publicly available benchmarks, in part by leveraging our new domain-specific language model. We release a new dataset with locally-aligned phrase grounding annotations by radiologists to facilitate the study of complex semantic modelling in biomedical vision-language processing. A broad evaluation, including on this new dataset, shows that our contrastive learning approach, aided by textual-semantic modelling, outperforms prior methods in segmentation tasks, despite only using a global-alignment objective.

title: Bengisu Ozbay, Octavia Camps, Mario Sznaier
title_en: Bengisu Ozbay, Octavia Camps, Mario Sznaier
abstract: We address the problem of segmenting moving rigid objects based on two-view image correspondences under a perspective camera model. While this is a well understood problem, existing methods scale poorly with the number of correspondences. In this paper we propose a fast segmentation algorithm that scales linearly with the number of correspondences and show that on benchmark datasets it offers the best trade-off between error and computational time: it is at least one order of magnitude faster than the best method (with comparable or better accuracy), with the ratio growing up to three orders of magnitude for larger number of correspondences. We approach the problem from an algebraic perspective by exploiting the fact that all points belonging to a given object lie in the same quadratic surface. The proposed method is based on a characterization of each surface in terms of the Christoffel polynomial associated with the probability that a given point belongs to the surface. This allows for efficiently segmenting points “one surface at a time” in O(number of points).
abstract_en: We address the problem of segmenting moving rigid objects based on two-view image correspondences under a perspective camera model. While this is a well understood problem, existing methods scale poorly with the number of correspondences. In this paper we propose a fast segmentation algorithm that scales linearly with the number of correspondences and show that on benchmark datasets it offers the best trade-off between error and computational time: it is at least one order of magnitude faster than the best method (with comparable or better accuracy), with the ratio growing up to three orders of magnitude for larger number of correspondences. We approach the problem from an algebraic perspective by exploiting the fact that all points belonging to a given object lie in the same quadratic surface. The proposed method is based on a characterization of each surface in terms of the Christoffel polynomial associated with the probability that a given point belongs to the surface. This allows for efficiently segmenting points “one surface at a time” in O(number of points).

title: Benita Wong, Joya Chen, You Wu, Stan Weixian Lei, Dongxing Mao, Difei Gao, Mike Zheng Shou
title_en: Benita Wong, Joya Chen, You Wu, Stan Weixian Lei, Dongxing Mao, Difei Gao, Mike Zheng Shou
abstract: 智能助手(如AR眼镜/机器人)的长期目标之一是帮助用户在以功能为中心的现实场景中完成任务,例如“如何让微波炉运行1分钟”。然而,目前仍缺乏明确的任务定义和合适的基准测试。本文定义了一个新任务,称为“以功能为中心的问题驱动任务完成”,其中AI助手应通过教学视频学习,为用户提供基于用户视角的分步指导。为支持该任务,我们构建了AssistQ数据集,包含100个新拍摄教学视频的531个问答样本。同时,我们开发了一种新型的“问题到动作”(Question-to-Actions, Q2A)模型,用于解决AQTC任务,并在AssistQ数据集上进行了验证。实验结果表明,我们的模型在多个与视觉问答(VQA)相关的基线模型上表现显著优于后者,但仍存在较大的改进空间。我们期望本任务和数据集能够推动第一视角AI助手的发展。项目页面地址为:https://showlab.github.io/assistq/
abstract_en: A long-standing goal of intelligent assistants such as AR glasses/robots has been to assist users in affordance-centric real-world scenarios, such as ""how can I run the microwave for 1 minute?”. However, there is still no clear task definition and suitable benchmarks. In this paper, we define a new task called Affordance-centric Question-driven Task Completion, where the AI assistant should learn from instructional videos to provide step-by-step help in the user’s view. To support the task, we constructed AssistQ, a new dataset comprising 531 question-answer samples from 100 newly filmed instructional videos. We also developed a novel Question-to-Actions (Q2A) model to address the AQTC task and validate it on the AssistQ dataset. The results show that our model significantly outperforms several VQA-related baselines while still having large room for improvement. We expect our task and dataset to advance Egocentric AI Assistant’s development. Our project page is available at: https://showlab.github.io/assistq/.

title: Benoît Guillard, Federico Stella, Pascal Fua
title_en: Benoît Guillard, Federico Stella, Pascal Fua
abstract: 无符号距离场(UDFs)可以用于表示非封闭表面。然而,当前将它们转换为显式网格的方法要么成本高昂,要么会降低精度。在这里,我们扩展了 marching cube 算法以处理 UDFs,既快速又准确。此外,我们的表面提取方法是可微的,这对于使用预训练的 UDF 网络拟合稀疏数据至关重要。
abstract_en: Unsigned Distance Fields (UDFs) can be used to represent non-watertight surfaces. However, current approaches to converting them into explicit meshes tend to either be expensive or to degrade the accuracy. Here, we extend the marching cube algorithm to handle UDFs, both fast and accurately. Moreover, our approach to surface extraction is differentiable, which is key to using pretrained UDF networks to fit sparse data.

title: Bernd Prach, Christoph H. Lampert
title_en: Bernd Prach, Christoph H. Lampert
abstract: 深度网络对输入的小变化具有鲁棒性是一项高度 desirable 的属性。实现这一属性的一种流行方法是设计具有小利普希茨常数的网络。在本文中,我们提出了一种构建此类利普希茨网络的新技术,该技术具有若干 desirable 的特性:它可以应用于任何线性网络层(全连接或卷积),它提供了对利普希茨常数的形式化保证,易于实现且运行效率高,并且可以与任何训练目标和优化方法结合使用。事实上,我们的技术是文献中首个同时实现所有这些特性的方法。我们的主要贡献是一种基于重缩放的权重矩阵参数化方法,该方法保证每个网络层的利普希茨常数不超过 1,并使学习到的权重矩阵接近正交。因此,我们称此类层为近正交利普希茨(AOL)层。在图像分类任务中,通过认证鲁棒准确性的实验和消融研究证实,AOL 层的性能与大多数现有方法相当。然而,它们更易于实现且应用范围更广,因为它们不需要作为网络架构的一部分进行计算成本高昂的矩阵正交化或求逆步骤。我们提供代码:https://github.com/berndprach/AOL
abstract_en: It is a highly desirable property for deep networks to be robust against small input changes. One popular way to achieve this property is by designing networks with a small Lipschitz constant. In this work, we propose a new technique for constructing such Lipschitz networks that has a number of desirable properties: it can be applied to any linear network layer (fully-connected or convolutional), it provides formal guarantees on the Lipschitz constant, it is easy to implement and efficient to run, and it can be combined with any training objective and optimization method. In fact, our technique is the first one in the literature that achieves all of these properties simultaneously. Our main contribution is a rescaling-based weight matrix parametrization that guarantees each network layer to have a Lipschitz constant of at most 1 and results in the learned weight matrices to be close to orthogonal. Hence we call such layers almost-orthogonal Lipschitz (AOL). Experiments and ablation studies in the context of image classification with certified robust accuracy confirm that AOL layers achieve results that are on par with most existing methods. Yet, they are simpler to implement and more broadly applicable, because they do not require computationally expensive matrix orthogonalization or inversion steps as part of the network architecture. We provide code at https://github.com/berndprach/AOL.

title: Biao Qian, Yang Wang, Hongzhi Yin, Richang Hong, Meng Wang
title_en: Biao Qian, Yang Wang, Hongzhi Yin, Richang Hong, Meng Wang
abstract: 在线知识蒸馏(OKD)通过相互利用教师模型与学生模型之间的差异来提升参与模型的性能。然而,关于二者之间差距的几个关键瓶颈问题——例如,为何以及何时较大的差距会损害学生模型的性能?如何量化教师与学生之间的差距?——尚未得到充分的正式研究。本文提出了一种可切换的在线知识蒸馏方法(SwitOKD),以回答这些问题。与现有方法侧重于测试阶段的准确率差距不同,SwitOKD的核心思想是通过两种模式之间的切换策略,在训练阶段自适应校准蒸馏差距:专家模式(暂停教师模型训练,保持学生模型学习)和学习模式(重启教师模型)。为获得适当的蒸馏差距,我们进一步设计了一个自适应切换阈值,提供了何时切换至学习模式或专家模式的正式准则,从而提升学生模型的性能。同时,教师模型也受益于我们的自适应切换阈值,基本保持与其它在线方法相当。我们进一步将SwitOKD扩展至具有两种基础拓扑结构的多网络。最后,大量实验与分析验证了SwitOKD在分类任务上优于现有方法的优势。我们的代码已开源至https://github.com/hfutqian/SwitOKD。
abstract_en: Online Knowledge Distillation (OKD) improves the involved models by reciprocally exploiting the difference between teacher and student. Several crucial bottlenecks over the gap between them -- e.g., Why and when does a large gap harm the performance, especially for student? How to quantify the gap between teacher and student? -- have received limited formal study. In this paper, we propose Switchable Online Knowledge Distillation (SwitOKD), to answer these questions.Instead of focusing on the accuracy gap at test phase by the existing arts, the core idea of SwitOKD is to adaptively calibrate the gap at training phase, namely distillation gap, via a switching strategy be-tween two modes -- expert mode (pause the teacher while keep the student learning) and learning mode (restart the teacher). To possess an appropriate distillation gap, we further devise an adaptive switching threshold, which provides a formal criterion as to when to switch to learning mode or expert mode, and thus improves the student’s performance. Meanwhile, the teacher benefits from our adaptive switching threshold and keeps basically on a par with other online arts. We further extend SwitOKD to multiple networks with two basis topologies. Finally, extensive experiments and analysis validate the merits of SwitOKD for classification over the state-of-the-arts. Our code is available at https://github.com/hfutqian/SwitOKD.

title: Bin Yan, Yi Jiang, Peize Sun, Dong Wang, Zehuan Yuan, Ping Luo, Huchuan Lu
title_en: Bin Yan, Yi Jiang, Peize Sun, Dong Wang, Zehuan Yuan, Ping Luo, Huchuan Lu
abstract: 我们提出了一种统一方法,称为Unicorn,能够通过同一个网络使用相同的模型参数同时解决四个跟踪问题(SOT、MOT、VOS、MOTS)。由于目标跟踪问题本身的碎片化定义,大多数现有跟踪器都是为解决单一任务或部分任务而开发,并过度专业化于特定任务的特征。相比之下,Unicorn提供了一种统一的解决方案,在所有跟踪任务中采用相同的输入、主干网络、嵌入和头部结构。首次实现了跟踪网络架构和学习范式的重大统一。Unicorn在8个跟踪数据集上表现与任务专用方法相当或更优,包括LaSOT、TrackingNet、MOT17、BDD100K、DAVIS16-17、MOTS20和BDD100K MOTS。我们相信Unicorn将为通用视觉模型的发展奠定坚实基础。代码已开源至https://github.com/MasterBin-IIAU/Unicorn。
abstract_en: We present a unified method, termed Unicorn, that can simultaneously solve four tracking problems (SOT, MOT, VOS, MOTS) with a single network using the same model parameters. Due to the fragmented definitions of the object tracking problem itself, most existing trackers are developed to address a single or part of tasks and overspecialize on the characteristics of specific tasks. By contrast, Unicorn provides a unified solution, adopting the same input, backbone, embedding, and head across all tracking tasks. For the first time, we accomplish the great unification of the tracking network architecture and learning paradigm. Unicorn performs on-par or better than its task-specific counterparts in 8 tracking datasets, including LaSOT, TrackingNet, MOT17, BDD100K, DAVIS16-17, MOTS20, and BDD100K MOTS. We believe that Unicorn will serve as a solid step towards the general vision model. Code is available at https://github.com/MasterBin-IIAU/Unicorn.

title: Bing Shuai, Alessandro Bergamo, Uta Büchler, Andrew Berneshawi, Alyssa Boden, Joseph Tighe
title_en: Bing Shuai, Alessandro Bergamo, Uta Büchler, Andrew Berneshawi, Alyssa Boden, Joseph Tighe
abstract: 本文提出了一种新的大规模多人跟踪数据集。我们的数据集规模比目前可用的高质量多目标跟踪数据集(如MOT17、HiEve和MOT20数据集)大一个数量级以上。由于该任务缺乏大规模的训练和测试数据,社区对跟踪系统在人员密度变化、执行动作、天气条件以及昼夜时间等广泛场景和条件下的性能理解受到限制。我们的数据集专门采集了这些条件的多样化场景,且标注信息包含丰富的元数据,使得跟踪器的性能可以沿这些不同维度进行评估。训练数据的缺乏也限制了对跟踪系统进行端到端训练的能力。因此,目前表现最佳的跟踪系统均依赖于在外部图像数据集上训练的强检测器。我们希望该数据集的发布能够推动利用大规模视频训练数据的新研究方向。
abstract_en: This paper presents a new large scale multi-person tracking dataset. Our dataset is over an order of magnitude larger than currently available high quality multi-object tracking datasets such as MOT17, HiEve, and MOT20 datasets. The lack of large scale training and test data for this task has limited the community’s ability to understand the performance of their tracking systems on a wide range of scenarios and conditions such as variations in person density, actions being performed, weather, and time of day. Our dataset was specifically sourced to provide a wide variety of these conditions and our annotations include rich meta-data such that the performance of a tracker can be evaluated along these different dimensions. The lack of training data has also limited the ability to perform end-to-end training of tracking systems. As such, the highest performing tracking systems all rely on strong detectors trained on external image datasets. We hope that the release of this dataset will enable new lines of research that take advantage of large scale video based training data.

title: Bingchen Zhao, Shaozuo Yu, Wufei Ma, Mingxin Yu, Shenxiao Mei, Angtian Wang, Ju He, Alan Yuille, Adam Kortylewski
title_en: Bingchen Zhao, Shaozuo Yu, Wufei Ma, Mingxin Yu, Shenxiao Mei, Angtian Wang, Ju He, Alan Yuille, Adam Kortylewski
abstract: 增强视觉算法在现实场景中的鲁棒性具有挑战性。其中一个原因是现有鲁棒性基准测试存在局限,要么依赖合成数据,要么忽略单个干扰因素的影响。我们引入了ROBIN数据集,该数据集包含10个物体类别在姿态、形状、纹理、上下文和天气条件方面的分布外示例,支持对图像分类、目标检测和3D姿态估计模型的基准测试。我们使用流行的基线方法进行的实验表明:1)某些干扰因素对性能的负面影响比其他因素更强,且取决于视觉任务类型。2)当前增强鲁棒性的方法仅具有边际效果,甚至可能降低鲁棒性。3)我们未观察到卷积架构与Transformer架构之间存在显著差异。我们相信该数据集为研究鲁棒性提供了丰富的测试平台,并将推动该领域的研究进展。
abstract_en: Enhancing the robustness of vision algorithms in real-world scenarios is challenging. One reason is that existing robustness benchmarks are limited, as they either rely on synthetic data or ignore the effects of individual nuisance factors. We introduce ROBIN, a benchmark dataset that includes out-of-distribution examples of 10 object categories in terms of pose, shape, texture, context and the weather conditions, and enables benchmarking models for image classification, object detection, and 3D pose estimation. Our experiments using popular baseline methods reveal that: 1) Some nuisance factors have a much stronger negative effect on the performance compared to others, also depending on the vision task. 2) Current approaches to enhance robustness have only marginal effects, and can even reduce robustness. 3) We do not observe significant differences between convolutional and transformer architectures. We believe our dataset provides a rich testbed to study robustness and will help push forward research in this area.

title: Bingliang Jiao, Lingqiao Liu, Liying Gao, Guosheng Lin, Lu Yang, Shizhou Zhang, Peng Wang, Yanning Zhang
title_en: Bingliang Jiao, Lingqiao Liu, Liying Gao, Guosheng Lin, Lu Yang, Shizhou Zhang, Peng Wang, Yanning Zhang
abstract: 现有的行人重识别方法在面对未见过的领域时常常出现显著的性能退化,这推动了对领域泛化行人重识别(DG-PReID)的研究兴趣。作为缓解领域差异的有效技术,实例归一化(IN)已被广泛应用于许多现有工作中。然而,IN也存在消除可能对特定领域或实例有用的判别性模式的局限性。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新的归一化方案,称为动态变换实例归一化(DTIN),以缓解IN的缺陷。我们的思路是利用动态卷积,使未归一化的特征能够控制归一化特征向新表示的转换。通过这种方式,我们可以确保网络具有足够的灵活性,在消除无关领域特定特征和适应特定领域或实例之间取得适当的平衡。我们进一步采用多任务学习策略训练模型,确保其能够自适应地生成任意领域的判别性特征表示。实验结果表明,我们的方法具有强大的领域生成能力,并在三个主流DG-PReID设置中取得了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Existing person re-identification methods often suffer significant performance degradation on unseen domains, which fuels interest in domain generalizable person re-identification (DG-PReID). As an effective technology to alleviate domain variance, the Instance Normalization (IN) has been widely employed in many existing works. However, IN also suffers from the limitation of eliminating discriminative patterns that might be useful for a particular domain or instance. In this work, we propose a new normalization scheme called Dynamically Transformed Instance Normalization (DTIN) to alleviate the drawback of IN. Our idea is to employ dynamic convolution to allow the unnormalized feature to control the transformation of the normalized features into new representations. In this way, we can ensure the network has sufficient flexibility to strike the right balance between eliminating irrelevant domain-specific features and adapting to individual domains or instances. We further utilize a multi-task learning strategy to train the model, ensuring it can adaptively produce discriminative feature representations for an arbitrary domain. Our results show a great domain generation capability and achieve state-of-the-art performance on three mainstream DG-PReID settings.

title: 从大规模噪声面部学习鲁棒特征表示成为高性能人脸识别的关键挑战之一
title_en: Bingqi Ma, Guanglu Song, Boxiao Liu, Yu Liu
abstract: 从大规模噪声面部学习鲁棒特征表示成为高性能人脸识别的关键挑战之一。近期研究尝试通过缓解类内冲突和类间冲突来应对这一挑战。然而,每个冲突中的无约束噪声类型仍使这些算法难以取得良好性能。为更深入理解这一问题,我们将每类面部的噪声类型以更细粒度的方式重新表述为N-身份|K-聚类|C-冲突。通过调整N、K和C的值,可生成不同类型的噪声面部。基于这一统一表述,我们发现噪声鲁棒表示学习的主要障碍在于算法在不同N、K和C下的灵活性。针对这一潜在问题,我们提出一种新方法,称为进化子中心学习(Evolving Sub-centers Learning, ESL),以寻找最优超平面来准确描述大规模噪声面部的潜在空间。具体而言,我们为每类初始化M个子中心,ESL通过生成、合并和删除操作,促使子中心自动对齐至N-身份|K-聚类|C-冲突面部。噪声面部中同一身份的图像可有效收敛至同一子中心,而不同身份的样本则会被推离。我们在具有不同N、K和C的合成噪声数据集上进行了详尽的消融研究,验证了其有效性。无需任何额外优化,ESL在大规模噪声面部上可显著超越现有最先进方法。
abstract_en: Learning robust feature representation from large-scale noisy faces stands out as one of the key challenges in high-performance face recognition. Recent attempts have been made to cope with this challenge by alleviating the intra-class conflict and inter-class conflict. However, the unconstrained noise type in each conflict still makes it difficult for these algorithms to perform well. To better understand this, we reformulate the noise type of faces in each class with a more fine-grained manner as N-identities|K-clusters|C-conflicts. Different types of noisy faces can be generated by adjusting the values of N, K, and C. Based on this unified formulation, we found that the main barrier behind the noise-robust representation learning is the flexibility of the algorithm under different N, K, and C. For this potential problem, we constructively propose a new method, named Evolving Sub-centers Learning (ESL), to find optimal hyperplanes to accurately describe the latent space of massive noisy faces. More specifically, we initialize M sub-centers for each class and ESL encourages it to be automatically aligned to N-identities|K-clusters|C-conflicts faces via producing, merging, and dropping operations. Images belonging to the same identity in noisy faces can effectively converge to the same sub-center and samples with different identities will be pushed away. We inspect its effectiveness with an elaborate ablation study on synthetic noisy datasets different N, K, and C. Without any bells and whistles, ESL can achieve significant performance gains over state-of-the-art methods in large-scale noisy faces.

title: Bo Hu, Tat-Jen Cham
title_en: Bo Hu, Tat-Jen Cham
abstract: 一些群体活动,如团队运动和编舞舞蹈,涉及参与者之间的紧密耦合互动。本文研究了在这些条件下推断和预测参与者行为的任务,具体包括运动轨迹和动作。我们将问题聚焦于估计一组目标参与者对其他观察参与者行为的反应。我们的核心思想是通过一种对逐帧推理和预测过程中误差累积具有鲁棒性的方法,建模参与者之间的时空关系。我们提出了一种新颖的Entry-Flipped Transformer(EF-Transformer),通过在空间和时间领域上使用注意力机制来建模参与者关系。与典型的Transformer不同,我们通过翻转查询、键和值条目的顺序来解决误差累积问题,以提高当前帧中观测特征的重要性和保真度。比较实验表明,我们的EF-Transformer在新采集的网球双打数据集、Ceilidh舞蹈数据集以及两个行人数据集中均取得了最佳性能。此外,还证明我们的EF-Transformer在限制累积误差和从错误估计中恢复方面表现更优。
abstract_en: Some group activities, such as team sports and choreographed dances, involve closely coupled interaction between participants. Here we investigate the tasks of inferring and predicting participant behavior, in terms of motion paths and actions, under such conditions. We narrow the problem to that of estimating how a set target participants react to the behavior of other observed participants. Our key idea is to model the spatio-temporal relations among participants in a manner that is robust to error accumulation during frame-wise inference and prediction. We propose a novel Entry-Flipped Transformer (EF-Transformer), which models the relations of participants by attention mechanisms on both spatial and temporal domains. Unlike typical transformers, we tackle the problem of error accumulation by flipping the order of query, key, and value entries, to increase the importance and fidelity of observed features in the current frame. Comparative experiments show that our EF-Transformer achieves the best performance on a newly-collected tennis doubles dataset, a Ceilidh dance dataset, and two pedestrian datasets. Furthermore, it is also demonstrated that our EF-Transformer is better at limiting accumulated errors and recovering from wrong estimations.

title: Bo Ke, Yunquan Zhu, Mengtian Li, Xiujun Shu, Ruizhi Qiao, Bo Ren
title_en: Bo Ke, Yunquan Zhu, Mengtian Li, Xiujun Shu, Ruizhi Qiao, Bo Ren
abstract: 在大规模多标签分类任务中,由于完全标注数据集的标注成本不断增加,从带有噪声网络标签的在线数据中学习正受到越来越多的关注。部分(正向)标注数据作为具有噪声标签数据的特例,具有经济上的可获取性。尽管它们包含大量假阴性标签样本,但它们被用作评估最新方法在真实场景中学习能力的基准。现有(部分)多标签方法通常在欧几里得空间中进行研究,其中标签嵌入与图像特征之间的关系不对称,从而难以学习。为了解决这一问题,我们提出将任务重新表述为超球面空间,其中可以将角度边距纳入超球面多标签损失函数。该边距使我们能够有效平衡假阴性标签和真阳性标签的影响。我们进一步设计了一种机制来调整角度边距并自适应缩放。我们在四个数据集(VOC12、COCO、CUB-200 和 NUS-WIDE)的三种多标签场景(单正标签、部分正标签和全标签)下研究了我们方法的有效性。在单正标签和部分正标签场景中,我们的方法达到了最先进的性能。通过比较不同比例部分正标签数据集的性能,验证了我们方法的鲁棒性。即使在完全标注场景中,我们的方法也比二元交叉熵(BCE)损失取得了超过1\%的改进。分析表明,学习到的标签嵌入可能对应实际标签相关性,因为在超球面空间中标签嵌入与图像特征是对称且可互换的。这进一步表明了我们方法的几何可解释性。代码可在 https://github.com/TencentYoutuResearch/MultiLabel-HML 获取。
abstract_en: Learning from online data with noisy web labels is gaining more attention due to the increasing cost of fully annotated datasets in large-scale multi-label classification tasks. Partial (positive) annotated data, as a particular case of data with noisy labels, are economically accessible.
