abstract: 尽管神经辐射场(NeRF)发展迅速,但密集覆盖的必要性在很大程度上限制了其更广泛的应用。虽然一些近期的工作尝试解决这一问题,但它们要么仅在稀疏视角下操作(即使如此,其中仍有一些),要么仅适用于简单对象/场景。在本工作中,我们考虑了一个更具挑战性的任务:通过“仅看一次”(即仅使用单个视角)来训练神经辐射场,以处理现实istically复杂的视觉场景。为实现这一目标,我们提出了一种单视角NeRF(SinNeRF)框架,该框架包含精心设计的语义和几何正则化。具体而言,SinNeRF构建了一个半监督学习过程,其中我们引入并传播几何伪标签和语义伪标签以指导渐进式训练过程。在复杂场景基准数据集上进行了大量实验,包括NeRF合成数据集、Local Light Field Fusion数据集和DTU数据集。我们证明,即使不预先在多视角数据集上训练,SinNeRF也能生成逼真的新视角合成结果。在单图像设置下,SinNeRF在所有情况下均显著优于当前最先进的NeRF基线。项目页面:https://vita-group.github.io/SinNeRF/
abstract_en: Despite the rapid development of Neural Radiance Field (NeRF), the necessity of dense covers largely prohibits its wider applications. While several recent works have attempted to address this issue, they either operate with sparse views (yet still, a few of them) or on simple objects/scenes. In this work, we consider a more ambitious task: training neural radiance field, over realistically complex visual scenes, by “looking only once”, i.e., using only a single view. To attain this goal, we present a Single View NeRF (SinNeRF) framework consisting of thoughtfully designed semantic and geometry regularizations. Specifically, SinNeRF constructs a semi-supervised learning process, where we introduce and propagate geometry pseudo labels and semantic pseudo labels to guide the progressive training process. Extensive experiments are conducted on complex scene benchmarks, including NeRF synthetic dataset, Local Light Field Fusion dataset, and DTU dataset. We show that even without pre-training on multi-view datasets, SinNeRF can yield photo-realistic novel-view synthesis results. Under the single image setting, SinNeRF significantly outperforms the current state-of-the-art NeRF baselines in all cases. Project page: https://vita-group.github.io/SinNeRF/

title: Dekun Wu, He Zhao, Xingce Bao, Richard P. Wildes
title_en: Dekun Wu, He Zhao, Xingce Bao, Richard P. Wildes
abstract: 本文研究了体育视频中自动化机器描述建模,该领域近年来取得了显著进展。然而,最先进的方法在捕捉人类专家分析体育场景的方式方面仍存在明显不足。主要原因包括:(1) 所使用的数据集由非官方提供者收集,这自然导致基于此类数据集训练的模型与实际应用场景之间存在差距;(2) 之前提出的方法需要大量标注工作(即像素级别的球员和球分割)以定位有用的视觉特征并获得可接受的结果;(3) 公共数据集非常有限。本文提出了一种面向体育视频分析(NSVA)的新型大规模NBA数据集,重点在于描述生成,以解决上述挑战。我们还设计了一种统一的方法,将原始视频处理为具有最小标注努力的有意义特征堆栈,证明了使用Transformer架构对这些特征进行跨建模可获得优异性能。此外,我们通过解决两个额外任务(即细粒度体育动作识别和显著球员识别)展示了NSVA的广泛应用。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/jackwu502/NSVA获取。
abstract_en: This paper investigates the modeling of automated machine description on sports video, which has seen much progress recently. Nevertheless, state-of-the-art approaches fall quite short of capturing how human experts analyze sports scenes. There are several major reasons: (1) The used dataset is collected from non-official providers, which naturally creates a gap between models trained on those datasets and real-world applications; (2) previously proposed methods require extensive annotation efforts (i.e., player and ball segmentation at pixel level) on localizing useful visual features to yield acceptable results; (3) very few public datasets are available. In this paper, we propose a novel large-scale NBA dataset for Sports Video Analysis (NSVA) with a focus on captioning, to address the above challenges. We also design a unified approach to process raw videos into a stack of meaningful features with minimum labelling efforts, showing that cross modeling on such features using a transformer architecture leads to strong performance. In addition, we demonstrate the broad application of NSVA by addressing two additional tasks, namely fine-grained sports action recognition and salient player identification. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/jackwu502/NSVA.

title: Deqing Sun, Charles Herrmann, Fitsum Reda, Michael Rubinstein, David J. Fleet, William T. Freeman
title_en: Deqing Sun, Charles Herrmann, Fitsum Reda, Michael Rubinstein, David J. Fleet, William T. Freeman
abstract: 像RAFT这样的近期光流模型中,训练细节和数据集的重要性如何?它们是否具有泛化能力?为探讨这些问题,我们并未开发新模型,而是采用一组现代训练技术重新审视三个主流模型(PWC-Net、IRR-PWC和RAFT),观察到显著性能提升,证明了这些训练细节的重要性和通用性。我们重新训练的PWC-Net和IRR-PWC模型在Sintel和KITTI 2015基准测试中相比原始发表结果表现出令人惊讶的大幅改进,最高可达30%。它们在KITTI 2015数据集上超越了更近期的Flow1D方法,同时推理速度提升3倍。我们重新训练的RAFT在KITTI 2015数据集上实现了4.31%的Fl-all得分,比所有已发表的光流方法更准确。我们的结果表明,在分析光流方法性能提升时,应将模型、训练技术与数据集的贡献分开评估。我们的源代码将公开发布。
abstract_en: How important are training details and datasets to recent optical flow models like RAFT? And do they generalize? To explore these questions, rather than develop a new model, we revisit three prominent models, PWC-Net, IRR-PWC and RAFT, with a common set of modern training techniques, and observe significantly better performance, demonstrating the importance and generality of these training details. Our newly trained PWC-Net and IRR-PWC models show surprisingly large improvements, up to 30% versus original published results on Sintel and KITTI 2015 benchmarks. They outperform the more recent Flow1D on KITTI 2015 while being 3× faster during inference. Our newly trained RAFT achieves an Fl-all score of 4.31% on KITTI 2015, more accurate than all published optical flow methods. Our results demonstrate the benefits of separating the contributions of models, training techniques and datasets when analyzing performance gains of optical flow methods. Our source code will be publicly available.

title: Deying Kong, Linguang Zhang, Liangjian Chen, Haoyu Ma, Xiangyi Yan, Shanlin Sun, Xingwei Liu, Kun Han, Xiaohui Xie
title_en: Deying Kong, Linguang Zhang, Liangjian Chen, Haoyu Ma, Xiangyi Yan, Shanlin Sun, Xingwei Liu, Kun Han, Xiaohui Xie
abstract: 从单目RGB图像重建三维手部网格因其在增强现实/虚拟现实领域的巨大应用潜力而受到越来越多的关注。大多数最先进的方法尝试以匿名方式解决这一任务。具体而言,即使在实际应用中用户身份信息在连续录制会话中保持不变,现有方法仍忽略了身份信息。本文提出了一种身份感知的手部网格估计模型,该模型可以结合由被试固有形状参数表示的身份信息。我们通过将提出的身份感知模型与一个匿名处理被试的基线模型进行对比,验证了身份信息的重要性。此外,为处理测试被试未见过的使用场景,我们提出了一种新颖的个性化流程,仅使用少量未标记的RGB图像校准被试的固有形状参数。在两个大规模公开数据集上的实验验证了我们提出方法的最先进性能。
abstract_en: Reconstructing 3D hand meshes from monocular RGB images has attracted increasing amount of attention due to its enormous potential applications in the field of AR/VR. Most state-of-the-art methods attempt to tackle this task in an anonymous manner. Specifically, the identity of the subject is ignored even though it is practically available in real applications where the user is unchanged in a continuous recording session. In this paper, we propose an identity-aware hand mesh estimation model, which can incorporate the identity information represented by the intrinsic shape parameters of the subject. We demonstrate the importance of the identity information by comparing the proposed identity-aware model to a baseline which treats subject anonymously. Furthermore, to handle the use case where the test subject is unseen, we propose a novel personalization pipeline to calibrate the intrinsic shape parameters using only a few unlabeled RGB images of the subject. Experiments on two large scale public datasets validate the state-of-the-art performance of our proposed method.

title: Di Chang, Aljaž Božič, Tong Zhang, Qingsong Yan, Yingcong Chen, Sabine Süsstrunk, Matthias Nießner
title_en: Di Chang, Aljaž Božič, Tong Zhang, Qingsong Yan, Yingcong Chen, Sabine Süsstrunk, Matthias Nießner
abstract: 在无监督多视角立体视觉(MVS)中,寻找不同视角间的准确对应关系是其致命弱点。现有方法均基于对应像素具有相似光度特征的假设。然而,真实场景中的多视角图像会观测到非朗伯表面并遭遇遮挡问题。本文提出了一种基于神经渲染的新型方法(RC-MVSNet),以解决视角间对应关系的模糊性问题。具体而言,我们引入深度渲染一致性损失,约束接近物体表面的几何特征以缓解遮挡问题;同时,我们提出参考视角合成损失,即使对于非朗伯表面也能生成一致的监督信号。在DTU和Tanks&Temples基准数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的RC-MVSNet方法在无监督MVS框架中取得了最先进的性能,并在许多监督方法中表现出竞争力。代码已开源至https://github.com/Boese0601/RC-MVSNet。
abstract_en: Finding accurate correspondences among different views is the Achilles’ heel of unsupervised Multi-View Stereo (MVS). Existing methods are built upon the assumption that corresponding pixels share similar photometric features. However, multi-view images in real scenarios observe non-Lambertian surfaces and experience occlusions. In this work, we propose a novel approach with neural rendering (RC-MVSNet) to solve such ambiguity issues of correspondences among views. Specifically, we impose a depth rendering consistency loss to constrain the geometry features close to the object surface to alleviate occlusions. Concurrently, we introduce a reference view synthesis loss to generate consistent supervision, even for non-Lambertian surfaces. Extensive experiments on DTU and Tanks&Temples benchmarks demonstrate that our RC-MVSNet approach achieves state-of-the-art performance over unsupervised MVS frameworks and competitive performance to many supervised methods. The code is released at https://github.com/Boese0601/RC-MVSNet.

title: Di Chen, Yu Liu, Lianghua Huang, Bin Wang, Pan Pan
title_en: Di Chen, Yu Liu, Lianghua Huang, Bin Wang, Pan Pan
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRF)通过仅使用带姿态的RGB图像学习隐式体积表示,展现出在特定场景中渲染新视角的显著能力。尽管其表现力和简洁性令人印象深刻,但NeRF在少量训练图像的情况下通常会收敛到具有错误几何结构的次优解。为此,我们提出GeoAug:一种针对NeRF的数据增强方法,该方法基于多视角几何约束丰富训练数据。GeoAug为训练提供随机人工(新视角,RGB图像)对,其中RGB图像来源于邻近的训练视角。通过深度图和相对视角将新视角的渲染扭曲到邻近训练视角,以匹配RGB图像的监督信息。我们的方法通过在训练中引入更多数据降低过拟合风险,同时为深度图提供额外的隐式监督。实验结果表明,我们的方法显著提升了在少量训练视角条件下神经辐射场的性能。
abstract_en: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) show remarkable ability to render novel views of a certain scene by learning an implicit volumetric representation with only posed RGB images. Despite its impressiveness and simplicity, NeRF usually converges to sub-optimal solutions with incorrect geometries given few training images. We hereby present GeoAug: a data augmentation method for NeRF, which enriches training data based on multi-view geometric constraint. GeoAug provides random artificial (novel pose, RGB image) pairs for training, where the RGB image is from a nearby training view. The rendering of a novel pose is warped to the nearby training view with depth map and relative pose to match the RGB image supervision. Our method reduces the risk of over-fitting by introducing more data during training, while also provides additional implicit supervision for depth maps. In experiments, our method significantly boosts the performance of neural radiance fields conditioned on few training views.

title: Dingfeng Shi, Yujie Zhong, Qiong Cao, Jing Zhang, Lin Ma, Jia Li, Dacheng Tao
title_en: Dingfeng Shi, Yujie Zhong, Qiong Cao, Jing Zhang, Lin Ma, Jia Li, Dacheng Tao
abstract: 本工作旨在通过类似DETR的基于动作查询的编码器-解码器框架推进时序动作检测(TAD)。然而,若直接应用于TAD,该框架存在若干问题:解码器中对查询间关系的探索不足、由于训练样本数量有限导致的分类训练不充分,以及推理过程中分类得分的不可靠性。为此,我们首先在解码器中提出一种关系注意力机制,通过查询间的关系引导注意力分配。此外,我们提出两种损失函数以促进和稳定动作分类的训练。最后,我们在推理过程中提出预测每个动作查询的定位质量,以区分高质量查询。所提出的ReAct方法在THUMOS14数据集上取得了最先进的性能,且计算成本显著低于先前方法。此外,我们进行了大量消融实验以验证各组件的有效性。
abstract_en: This work aims at advancing temporal action detection (TAD) using an encoder-decoder framework with action queries, similar to DETR, which has shown great success in object detection. However, the framework suffers from several problems if directly applied to TAD: the insufficient exploration of inter-query relation in the decoder, the inadequate classification training due to a limited number of training samples, and the unreliable classification scores at inference. To this end, we first propose a relational attention mechanism in the decoder, which guides the attention among queries based on their relations. Moreover, we propose two losses to facilitate and stabilize the training of action classification. Lastly, we propose to predict the localization quality of each action query at inference in order to distinguish high-quality queries. The proposed method, named ReAct, achieves the state-of-the-art performance on THUMOS14, with much lower computational costs than previous methods. Besides, extensive ablation studies are conducted to verify the effectiveness of each proposed component.

title: Dingkang Liang, Wei Xu, Xiang Bai
title_en: Dingkang Liang, Wei Xu, Xiang Bai
abstract: 人群定位,即预测头部位置,是一项比单纯计数更具实用性和高级的任务。现有方法采用伪边界框或预设计的定位图,依赖复杂的后处理来获取头部位置。本文提出了一种优雅的端到端人群定位Transformer模型CLTR,在基于回归的范式中解决该任务。所提方法将人群定位视为直接集合预测问题,将提取的特征和可训练嵌入作为Transformer解码器的输入。为减少歧义点并生成更合理的匹配结果,我们引入了基于KMO的匈牙利匹配器,采用附近上下文作为外部匹配成本。在五个不同数据设置下的数据集上进行的大量实验验证了方法的有效性。特别是,所提方法在NWPU-Crowd、UCF-QNRF和ShanghaiTech Part A数据集上实现了最佳的定位性能。
abstract_en: Crowd localization, predicting head positions, is a more practical and high-level task than simply counting. Existing methods employ pseudo-bounding boxes or pre-designed localization maps, relying on complex post-processing to obtain the head positions. In this paper, we propose an elegant, end-to-end Crowd Localization TRansformer named CLTR that solves the task in the regression-based paradigm. The proposed method views the crowd localization as a direct set prediction problem, taking extracted features and trainable embeddings as input of the transformer-decoder. To reduce the ambiguous points and generate more reasonable matching results, we introduce a KMO-based Hungarian matcher, which adopts the nearby context as the external matching cost. Extensive experiments conducted on five datasets in various data settings show the effectiveness of our method. In particular, the proposed method achieves the best localization performance on the NWPU-Crowd, UCF-QNRF, and ShanghaiTech Part A datasets.

title: Dingkang Yang, Shuai Huang, Shunli Wang, Yang Liu, Peng Zhai, Liuzhen Su, Mingcheng Li, Lihua Zhang
title_en: Dingkang Yang, Shuai Huang, Shunli Wang, Yang Liu, Peng Zhai, Liuzhen Su, Mingcheng Li, Lihua Zhang
abstract: 在计算机视觉领域,理解情感的上下文是一个日益热门的研究方向。现有方法缺乏可靠的上下文语义来缓解情感表达中的不确定性,并且未能互补地建模多种上下文表示。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了一种结合四种互补上下文的上下文感知情感识别框架。第一种上下文是基于面部表情、面部关键点、手势和步态的多模态情感识别。其次,我们采用通道和空间注意力模块以获取场景上下文的情感语义。受社会学理论启发,我们在第三种上下文通过构建关系图探索智能体间的情感传递。同时,我们提出了一种新颖的智能体-物体上下文,通过聚合场景中周围智能体与物体交互中的情感线索来缓解预测的模糊性。最后,我们引入了一种自适应相关性融合模块以学习多种上下文间的共享表示。大量实验表明,我们的方法在EMOTIC和GroupWalk数据集上均优于现有最先进方法。我们还发布了标注了多样化情感标签的数据集Human Emotion in Context (HECO)。在实践中,我们在HECO上与现有方法进行对比,我们的方法取得了更高的分类平均精度50.65%和更低的回归均误差率0.7。项目地址为https://heco2022.github.io/。
abstract_en: Understanding emotion in context is a rising hotspot in the computer vision community. Existing methods lack reliable context semantics to mitigate uncertainty in expressing emotions and fail to model multiple context representations complementarily. To alleviate these issues, we present a context-aware emotion recognition framework that combines four complementary contexts. The first context is multimodal emotion recognition based on facial expression, facial landmarks, gesture and gait. Secondly, we adopt the channel and spatial attention modules to obtain the emotion semantics of the scene context. Inspired by sociology theory, we explore the emotion transmission between agents by constructing relationship graphs in the third context. Meanwhile, we propose a novel agent-object context, which aggregates emotion cues from the interactions between surrounding agents and objects in the scene to mitigate the ambiguity of prediction. Finally, we introduce an adaptive relevance fusion module for learning the shared representations among multiple contexts. Extensive experiments show that our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on both EMOTIC and GroupWalk datasets. We also release a dataset annotated with diverse emotion labels, Human Emotion in Context (HECO). In practice, we compare with the existing methods on the HECO, and our approach obtains a higher classification average precision of 50.65% and a lower regression mean error rate of 0.7. The project is available at https://heco2022.github.io/.

title: Divya Kothandaraman, Tianrui Guan, Xijun Wang, Shuowen Hu, Ming Lin, Dinesh Manocha
title_en: Divya Kothandaraman, Tianrui Guan, Xijun Wang, Shuowen Hu, Ming Lin, Dinesh Manocha
abstract: 我们提出了一种用于无人机视频活动识别的方法,称为傅里叶活动识别(Fourier Activity Recognition, FAR)。我们的方法采用了一种新颖的傅里叶对象解耦技术,能够本质地区分出通常较小的人类主体与背景。该解耦技术在频域中表征空间像素随时间变化的程度,并利用傅里叶变换的卷积-乘法特性,将这种表示映射到网络获取的对应对象-背景纠缠特征。为封装上下文信息和长程时空依赖性,我们提出了一种新颖的傅里叶注意力算法,通过在频域中建模加权外积来模拟自注意力机制的优势。我们的傅里叶注意力机制计算量远低于自注意力机制。我们在多个无人机数据集(包括UAV Human RGB、UAV Human Night、Drone Action和NEC Drone)上评估了该方法,结果表明在Top-1准确率上相比现有方法提升了8.02%至38.69%。
abstract_en: We present a method, Fourier Activity Recognition (FAR), for UAV video activity recognition. Our formulation uses a novel Fourier object disentanglement method to innately separate out the human agent (which is typically small) from the background. Our disentanglement technique operates in the frequency domain to characterize the extent of temporal change of spatial pixels, and exploits convolution-multiplication properties of Fourier transform to map this representation to the corresponding object-background entangled features obtained from the network. To encapsulate contextual information and long-range space-time dependencies, we present a novel Fourier Attention algorithm, which emulates the benefits of self-attention by modeling the weighted outer product in the frequency domain. Our Fourier attention formulation uses much fewer computations than self-attention. We have evaluated our approach on multiple UAV datasets including UAV Human RGB, UAV Human Night, Drone Action, and NEC Drone. We demonstrate a relative improvement of 8.02% -38.69% in top-1 accuracy over prior work.

title: Dong Wang, Zhao Zhang, Ziwei Zhao, Yuhang Liu, Yihong Chen, Liwei Wang
title_en: Dong Wang, Zhao Zhang, Ziwei Zhao, Yuhang Liu, Yihong Chen, Liwei Wang
abstract: 本文探讨了点集表示在管状结构提取任务中的应用。与传统的掩码表示相比,点集表示具有灵活性和表示能力,不会受到固定网格的限制。受此启发,我们提出了PointScatter,作为管状结构提取任务的分割模型替代方案。PointScatter将图像分割为散点区域,并并行预测每个散点区域的点。我们进一步提出了基于贪心的区域间二分图匹配算法,以实现网络的端到端和高效训练。我们在四个公开的管状数据集上对PointScatter进行了基准测试,大量实验在管状结构分割和中心线提取任务中验证了该方法的有效性。代码可在https://github.com/zhangzhao2022/pointscatter获取。
abstract_en: This paper explores the point set representation for tubular structure extraction tasks. Compared with the traditional mask representation, the point set representation enjoys its flexibility and representation ability, which would not be restricted by the fixed grid as the mask. Inspired by this, we propose PointScatter, an alternative to the segmentation models for the tubular structure extraction task. PointScatter splits the image into scatter regions and parallelly predicts points for each scatter region. We further propose the greedy-based region-wise bipartite matching algorithm to train the network end-to-end and efficiently. We benchmark the PointScatter on four public tubular datasets, and the extensive experiments on tubular structure segmentation and centerline extraction task demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Code is available at https://github.com/zhangzhao2022/pointscatter.

title: 周东浩, 陈鹏飞, 王琼, 陈广勇, 洪鹏安
title_en: Donghao Zhou, Pengfei Chen, Qiong Wang, Guangyong Chen, Pheng-Ann Heng
abstract: 由于收集全面的多标签注释具有困难性,多标签数据集通常包含部分标签。我们考虑弱监督学习问题的一个极端情况,称为单正多标签学习(SPML),其中每个多标签训练图像仅有一个正标签。传统上,在SPML中所有未标注标签均被假设为负标签,这会引入虚假负标签并导致模型训练被假设的负标签主导。在本工作中,我们选择从另一种视角对待所有未标注标签,即承认它们是未知的。因此,我们提出熵最大化(EM)损失以获得特殊的梯度机制,从而提供适当的监督信号。此外,我们提出非对称伪标记(APL),采用非对称容忍策略和自适应学习过程,与EM损失协同工作,从而提供更精确的监督。实验表明,我们的方法显著提升了性能,并在所有四个基准测试中取得了最先进结果。代码可在https://github.com/Correr-Zhou/SPML-AckTheUnknown获取。
abstract_en: Due to the difficulty of collecting exhaustive multi-label annotations, multi-label datasets often contain partial labels. We consider an extreme of this weakly supervised learning problem, called single positive multi-label learning (SPML), where each multi-label training image has only one positive label. Traditionally, all unannotated labels are assumed as negative labels in SPML, which introduces false negative labels and causes model training to be dominated by assumed negative labels. In this work, we choose to treat all unannotated labels from an alternative perspective, i.e. acknowledging they are unknown. Hence, we propose entropy-maximization (EM) loss to attain a special gradient regime for providing proper supervision signals. Moreover, we propose asymmetric pseudo-labeling (APL), which adopts asymmetric-tolerance strategies and a self-paced procedure, to cooperate with EM loss and then provide more precise supervision. Experiments show that our method significantly improves performance and achieves state-of-the-art results on all four benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/Correr-Zhou/SPML-AckTheUnknown.

title: 金东铉, 王凯红, 凯特·赛恩科, 玛格丽特·贝特克, 斯坦·斯克拉夫
title_en: Donghyun Kim, Kaihong Wang, Kate Saenko, Margrit Betke, Stan Sclaroff
abstract: 尽管姿态估计是重要的计算机视觉任务,但需要昂贵的标注且容易受到领域偏移的影响。在本文中,我们研究了领域自适应2D姿态估计问题,该问题将从合成源域中学习到的知识转移到无监督的目标域。尽管近期提出了多种领域自适应姿态估计模型,但它们不够通用,仅专注于人体姿态或动物姿态估计,因此其有效性在特定场景中有所局限。在本工作中,我们提出了一种统一框架,能够很好地泛化到各种领域自适应姿态估计问题。我们提出通过输入级和输出级线索(像素和姿态标签)对表示进行对齐,这有助于从源域向未标注的目标域迁移知识。实验结果表明,我们的方法在各种领域偏移下实现了最先进的性能。我们的方法在人体姿态估计上优于现有基线最高达4.5个百分点(pp),在手部姿态估计上最高达7.4 pp,在动物姿态估计上对狗最高达4.8 pp,对羊最高达3.3 pp。这些结果表明,我们的方法能够缓解多种任务和甚至未见过的领域和对象(例如,训练在马的数据集上,测试在狗的数据集上)的领域偏移。我们的代码将在以下链接公开:https://github.com/VisionLearningGroup/UDA_PoseEstimation
abstract_en: While pose estimation is an important computer vision task, it requires expensive annotation and suffers from domain shift. In this paper, we investigate the problem of domain adaptive 2D pose estimation that transfers knowledge learned on a synthetic source domain to a target domain without supervision. While several domain adaptive pose estimation models have been proposed recently, they are not generic but only focus on either human pose or animal pose estimation, and thus their effectiveness is somewhat limited to specific scenarios. In this work, we propose a unified framework that generalizes well on various domain adaptive pose estimation problems. We propose to align representations using both input-level and output-level cues (pixels and pose labels, respectively), which facilitates the knowledge transfer from the source domain to the unlabeled target domain. Our experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance under various domain shifts. Our method outperforms existing baselines on human pose estimation by up to 4.5 percent points (pp), hand pose estimation by up to 7.4 pp, and animal pose estimation by up to 4.8 pp for dogs and 3.3 pp for sheep. These results suggest that our method is able to mitigate domain shift on diverse tasks and even unseen domains and objects (e.g., trained on horse and tested on dog). Our code will be publicly available at: https://github.com/VisionLearningGroup/UDA_PoseEstimation.

title: Donghyun Kim, Kaihong Wang, Stan Sclaroff, Kate Saenko
title_en: Donghyun Kim, Kaihong Wang, Stan Sclaroff, Kate Saenko
abstract: 深度模型必须学习鲁棒且可迁移的表示,以在新领域上表现良好。尽管已提出领域迁移方法(例如,领域自适应、领域泛化)来学习跨领域的可迁移表示,但这些方法通常应用于在ImageNet上预训练的ResNet主干网络。因此,现有研究对预训练对领域迁移任务的影响关注较少。本文对领域自适应和泛化的预训练进行了广泛研究和深入分析,包括网络架构、规模、预训练损失函数和数据集。我们观察到,仅使用最先进的主干网络就超越了现有的领域自适应基准模型,并在Office-Home和DomainNet数据集上分别提升了10.7%和5.5%。我们希望这项工作能为未来领域迁移研究提供更深入的见解。
abstract_en: Deep models must learn robust and transferable representations in order to perform well on new domains. While domain transfer methods (\eg, domain adaptation, domain generalization) have been proposed to learn transferable representations across domains, they are typically applied to ResNet backbones pre-trained on ImageNet. Thus, existing works pay little attention to the effects of pre-training on domain transfer tasks. In this paper, we provide a broad study and in-depth analysis of pre-training for domain adaptation and generalization, namely: network architectures, size, pre-training loss, and datasets. We observe that simply using a state-of-the-art backbone outperforms existing state-of-the-art domain adaptation baselines and set new baselines on Office-Home and DomainNet improving by 10.7% and 5.5%. We hope that this work can provide more insights for future domain transfer research.

title: Dongli Tan, Jiang-Jiang Liu, Xingyu Chen, Chao Chen, Ruixin Zhang, Yunhang Shen, Shouhong Ding, Rongrong Ji
title_en: Dongli Tan, Jiang-Jiang Liu, Xingyu Chen, Chao Chen, Ruixin Zhang, Yunhang Shen, Shouhong Ding, Rongrong Ji
abstract: 摘要。在统一的功能模型中对稀疏和密集图像匹配进行建模近期吸引了越来越多的研究兴趣。然而,现有研究主要关注提高匹配精度而忽视了其效率,这对于实际应用至关重要。本文提出了一种名为高效对应Transformer(ECO-TR)的高效结构,通过由粗到细的方式寻找对应关系,显著提升了功能模型的效率。为实现这一目标,多个Transformer模块按阶段连接,逐步在共享的多尺度特征提取网络上精炼预测坐标。给定一对图像和任意查询坐标,所有对应关系均可在单次前向传递中预测。我们进一步提出了一种自适应查询聚类策略和基于不确定性的异常检测模块,与所提出的框架协同工作以实现更快更优的预测。在各种稀疏和密集匹配任务上的实验验证了我们的方法在效率和有效性方面均优于现有最先进的方法。项目页面:https://dltan7.github.io/ecotr/
abstract_en: Abstract. Modeling sparse and dense image matching within a unified functional model has recently attracted increasing research interest. However, existing efforts mainly focus on improving matching accuracy while ignoring its efficiency, which is crucial for real-world applications. In this paper, we propose an efficient structure named Efficient Correspondence Transformer (ECO-TR) by finding correspondences in a coarse-to-fine manner, which significantly improves the efficiency of functional model. To achieve this, multiple transformer blocks are stage-wisely connected to gradually refine the predicted coordinates upon a shared multi-scale feature extraction network. Given a pair of images and for arbitrary query coordinates, all the correspondences are predicted within a single feed-forward pass. We further propose an adaptive query-clustering strategy and an uncertainty-based outlier detection module to cooperate with the proposed framework for faster and better predictions. Experiments on various sparse and dense matching tasks demonstrate the superiority of our method in both efficiency and effectiveness against existing state-of-the-arts. Project page: https://dltan7.github.io/ecotr/.

title: Dongliang Cao, Florian Bernard
title_en: Dongliang Cao, Florian Bernard
abstract: 三维形状匹配是计算机视觉和计算机图形学中的长期问题。尽管深度神经网络在形状匹配中展现出最先进的结果,但现有的基于学习的方法在多形状匹配的上下文中存在局限性:(i) 它们要么仅专注于形状对的匹配,从而导致循环不一致的多匹配,或 (ii) 需要显式的模板形状来处理多个形状的匹配。在本文中,我们提出了一种新颖的深度多形状匹配方法,该方法确保循环一致的多匹配,而无需依赖显式的模板形状。为此,我们利用了一种形状到宇宙的多匹配表示,并结合了强大的功能图正则化,从而使我们的多形状匹配神经网络能够以完全无监督的方式进行训练。虽然功能图正则化仅在训练期间考虑,但预测对应关系时并不计算功能图,从而实现了快速推理。我们证明了我们的方法在多个具有挑战性的基准数据集上取得了最先进的结果,并且最值得注意的是,我们的无监督方法甚至优于最近的监督方法。
abstract_en: 3D shape matching is a long-standing problem in computer vision and computer graphics. While deep neural networks were shown to lead to state-of-the-art results in shape matching, existing learning-based approaches are limited in the context of multi-shape matching: (i) either they focus on matching pairs of shapes only and thus suffer from cycle-inconsistent multi-matchings, or (ii) they require an explicit template shape to address the matching of a collection of shapes. In this paper, we present a novel approach for deep multi-shape matching that ensures cycle-consistent multi-matchings while not depending on an explicit template shape. To this end, we utilise a shape-to-universe multi-matching representation that we combine with powerful functional map regularisation, so that our multi-shape matching neural network can be trained in a fully unsupervised manner. While the functional map regularisation is only considered during training time, functional maps are not computed for predicting correspondences, thereby allowing for fast inference. We demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art results on several challenging benchmark datasets, and, most remarkably, that our unsupervised method even outperforms recent supervised methods.

title: 安东生,雷娜,顾先峰
title_en: Dongsheng An, Na Lei, Xianfeng Gu
abstract: 最优传输(OT)在两个测度之间的应用在许多领域中起着关键作用,涵盖经济、生物学以及机器学习和人工智能。传统的离散OT问题可以通过线性规划(LP)求解。不幸的是,由于规模庞大和内在的非线性,实现具有足够精度和效率的离散OT计划具有挑战性。一般来说,OT计划具有高度稀疏性。本文提出了一种辅助测度方法,利用半离散OT映射来估计具有平方欧几里得成本的离散OT计划的稀疏性。尽管获得精确的半离散OT映射较为困难,但可以通过凸优化计算近似的半离散OT映射来获取稀疏性信息。稀疏性信息可以进一步整合到下游的LP优化中,从而显著降低计算复杂度并提高精度。我们还给出了估计传输计划与OT计划在Wasserstein距离上的理论误差界。在合成数据和颜色传输任务上的实验验证了所提方法的准确性和效率。
abstract_en: Optimal transport (OT) between two measures plays an essential role in many fields, ranging from economy, biology to machine learning and artificial intelligence. Conventional discrete OT problem can be solved using linear programming (LP). Unfortunately, due to the large scale and the intrinsic non-linearity, achieving discrete OT plan with adequate accuracy and efficiency is challenging. Generally speaking, the OT plan is highly sparse. This work proposes an auxiliary measure method to use the semi-discrete OT maps to estimate the sparsity of the discrete OT plan with squared Euclidean cost. Although obtaining the accurate semi-discrete OT maps is difficult, we can find the sparsity information through computing the approximate semi-discrete OT maps by convex optimization. The sparsity information can be further incorporated into the downstream LP optimization to greatly reduce the computational complexity and improve the accuracy. We also give a theoretic error bound between the estimated transport plan and the OT plan in terms of Wasserstein distance. Experiments on both synthetic data and color transfer tasks demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method.

title: Dongting Hu, Liuhua Peng, Tingjin Chu, Xiaoxing Zhang, Yinian Mao, Howard Bondell, Mingming Gong
title_en: Dongting Hu, Liuhua Peng, Tingjin Chu, Xiaoxing Zhang, Yinian Mao, Howard Bondell, Mingming Gong
abstract: 单目深度估计(MDE)是一项从单张图像预测密集深度图的任务。尽管深度学习带来了近期进展,现有方法仍因MDE的病态特性容易产生错误。因此深度估计系统必须具备自我认知能力以避免灾难性后果。本文为监督式MDE模型提供了一种不确定性量化方法。从频率学派视角出发,我们通过预测方差捕捉不确定性,该方差包含两个组成部分:误差方差和估计方差。前者表示深度值的噪声,后者衡量由于有限数据训练导致的深度回归模型中的随机性。为估计误差方差,我们在离散化深度上执行约束序数回归(ConOR),以估计给定图像的深度条件分布,然后计算相应的条件均值和方差作为预测深度和误差方差估计量。我们的工作还利用自助法(bootstrapping)从重采样数据中推断估计方差。我们在模拟数据和真实数据上进行了实验以验证所提方法的有效性。结果表明,我们的方法在保持高深度预测精度的同时,能够产生准确的不确定性估计。
abstract_en: Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) is a task to predict a dense depth map from a single image. Despite the recent progress brought by deep learning, existing methods are still prone to errors due to the ill-posed nature of MDE. Hence depth estimation systems must be self-aware of possible mistakes to avoid disastrous consequences. This paper provides an uncertainty quantification method for supervised MDE models. From a frequentist view, we capture the uncertainty by predictive variance that consists of two terms: error variance and estimation variance. The former represents the noise of a depth value, and the latter measures the randomness in the depth regression model due to training on finite data. To estimate error variance, we perform constrained ordinal regression (ConOR) on discretized depth to estimate the conditional distribution of depth given image, and then compute the corresponding conditional mean and variance as the predicted depth and error variance estimator, respectively. Our work also leverages bootstrapping methods to infer estimation variance from re-sampled data. We perform experiments on both simulated and real data to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results show that our approach produces accurate uncertainty estimates while maintaining high depth prediction accuracy.

title: Dongwan Kim, Yi-Hsuan Tsai, Yumin Suh, Masoud Faraki, Sparsh Garg, Manmohan Chandraker, Bohyung Han
title_en: Dongwan Kim, Yi-Hsuan Tsai, Yumin Suh, Masoud Faraki, Sparsh Garg, Manmohan Chandraker, Bohyung Han
abstract: 尽管在多个数据集的聚合上训练分割模型是理想的,但主要挑战在于每个数据集的标签空间可能存在冲突。为了解决这一挑战,我们提出UniSeg,这是一种有效且与模型无关的方法,可在具有异构标签空间的多个数据集上自动训练分割模型,而无需任何手动重标签工作。具体而言,我们引入了两个新思想,以处理冲突和共现标签,从而在未见领域中实现更好的泛化性能。首先,我们识别出由标签空间不匹配引起的梯度冲突,并提出一种类别无关的二元交叉熵损失函数来缓解此类标签冲突。其次,我们提出了一种考虑跨数据集类别关系的损失函数,以实现更优的多数据集训练方案。在道路场景数据集上的大量定量和定性分析表明,UniSeg在多数据集基线方法上取得了改进,尤其是在未见数据集上,例如在KITTI数据集上实现了超过8%的IoU增益。此外,UniSeg在WildDash2公共基准测试中达到了39.4%的IoU,使其成为零样本设置下最强的提交之一。我们的项目页面可在https://www.nec-labs.com/ mas/UniSeg访问。
abstract_en: While it is desirable to train segmentation models on an aggregation of multiple datasets, a major challenge is that the label space of each dataset may be in conflict with one another. To tackle this challenge, we propose UniSeg, an effective and model-agnostic approach to automatically train segmentation models across multiple datasets with heterogeneous label spaces, without requiring any manual relabeling efforts. Specifically, we introduce two new ideas that account for conflicting and co-occurring labels to achieve better generalization performance in unseen domains. First, we identify a gradient conflict in training incurred by mismatched label spaces and propose a class-independent binary cross-entropy loss to alleviate such label conflicts. Second, we propose a loss function that considers class-relationships across datasets for a better multi-dataset training scheme.xtensive quantitative and qualitative analyses on road-scene datasets show that UniSeg improves over multi-dataset baselines, especially on unseen datasets, e.g., achieving more than 8%p gain in IoU on KITTI. Furthermore, UniSeg achieves 39.4% IoU on the WildDash2 public benchmark, making it one of the strongest submissions in the zero-shot setting. Our project page is available at https://www.nec-labs.com/ mas/UniSeg.

title: Dooseop Choi, KyoungWook Min
title_en: Dooseop Choi, KyoungWook Min
abstract: 变分自编码器(VAE)因其理论优雅、易于训练以及具有良好的流形表示特性,被广泛用于建模数据分布。然而,当应用于图像重建和生成任务时,VAE表现出生成样本容易模糊的局限性。我们观察到,类似的问题在基于VAE的轨迹预测模型中经常出现,即生成的轨迹位于相邻车道之间。为缓解这一问题,我们引入了分层潜在结构到基于VAE的预测模型中。基于轨迹分布可近似为简单分布(或模式)混合的假设,低级潜在变量用于建模混合分布的每个模式,高级潜在变量用于表示模式的权重。为准确建模每个模式,我们通过两种新颖计算的车道级上下文向量对低级潜在变量进行条件建模,一个对应车辆-车道交互,另一个对应车辆-车辆交互。这些上下文向量也通过所提出的模式选择网络用于建模权重。为评估我们的预测模型,我们使用了两个大规模真实世界数据集。实验结果表明,我们的模型不仅能够生成清晰的多模态轨迹分布,而且在预测准确性方面优于现有最先进的(SOTA)模型。
abstract_en: Variational autoencoder (VAE) has widely been utilized for modeling data distributions because it is theoretically elegant, easy to train, and has nice manifold representations. However, when applied to image reconstruction and synthesis tasks, VAE shows the limitation that the generated sample tends to be blurry. We observe that a similar problem, in which the generated trajectory is located between adjacent lanes, often arises in VAE-based trajectory forecasting models. To mitigate this problem, we introduce a hierarchical latent structure into the VAE-based forecasting model. Based on the assumption that the trajectory distribution can be approximated as a mixture of simple distributions (or modes), the low-level latent variable is employed to model each mode of the mixture and the high-level latent variable is employed to represent the weights for the modes. To model each mode accurately, we condition the low-level latent variable using two lane-level context vectors computed in novel ways, one corresponds to vehicle-lane interaction and the other to vehicle-vehicle interaction. The context vectors are also used to model the weights via the proposed mode selection network. To evaluate our forecasting model, we use two large-scale real-world datasets. Experimental results show that our model is not only capable of generating clear multi-modal trajectory distributions but also outperforms the state-of-the-art (SOTA) models in terms of prediction accuracy.

title: Dorian F. Henning, Tristan Laidlow, Stefan Leutenegger
title_en: Dorian F. Henning, Tristan Laidlow, Stefan Leutenegger
abstract: 从视频中估计人体运动是一个活跃的研究领域,因其在许多潜在应用中的重要性。大多数最先进的方法针对单张图像预测人体形状和姿态估计,而未利用视频中可用的时间信息。许多真实场景中的人体运动序列是由移动相机捕获的,这增加了相机运动与人体运动混淆的复杂性。因此,我们提出了BodySLAM,一种单目SLAM系统,可联合估计人体的位置、形状和姿态,以及相机轨迹。我们还引入了一种新颖的人体运动模型,以约束连续的身体姿态并观察场景的尺度。通过一系列在移动单目相机捕获的人体运动视频序列上的实验,我们证明BodySLAM相比单独估计这些参数,能够提升所有人体参数和相机姿态的估计效果。
abstract_en: Estimating human motion from video is an active research area due to its many potential applications. Most state-of-the-art methods predict human shape and posture estimates for individual images and do not leverage the temporal information available in video. Many ""in the wild"" sequences of human motion are captured by a moving camera, which adds the complication of conflated camera and human motion to the estimation. We therefore present BodySLAM, a monocular SLAM system that jointly estimates the position, shape, and posture of human bodies, as well as the camera trajectory. We also introduce a novel human motion model to constrain sequential body postures and observe the scale of the scene. Through a series of experiments on video sequences of human motion captured by a moving monocular camera, we demonstrate that BodySLAM improves estimates of all human body parameters and camera poses compared to estimating these separately.

title: Dustin Schwenk, Apoorv Khandelwal, Christopher Clark, Kenneth Marino, Roozbeh Mottaghi
title_en: Dustin Schwenk, Apoorv Khandelwal, Christopher Clark, Kenneth Marino, Roozbeh Mottaghi
abstract: 视觉问答(VQA)任务旨在为能够对视觉和自然语言输入进行联合推理的AI模型提供有意义的测试平台。尽管VQA数据集层出不穷,但这一目标仍受到一系列共同限制的阻碍。这些限制包括:依赖相对简单的重复性问题,其概念和语言结构重复;需要的外部世界知识有限;以及得出正确答案所需的推理有限。我们引入了A-OKVQA数据集,这是一个由约25000个多样化问题组成的众包数据集,这些问题需要广泛的基础常识和世界知识才能回答。与现有的基于知识的VQA数据集不同,这些问题不能仅通过查询知识库来回答,而是主要需要对图像中所描绘场景进行某种形式的常识推理。我们通过对其内容的详细分析以及在多种最先进的视觉-语言模型上的基线性能测量,展示了该新数据集的潜力。
abstract_en: The Visual Question Answering (VQA) task aspires to provide a meaningful testbed for the development of AI models that can jointly reason over visual and natural language inputs. Despite a proliferation of VQA datasets, this goal is hindered by a set of common limitations. These include a reliance on relatively simplistic questions that are repetitive in both concepts and linguistic structure, little world knowledge needed outside of the paired image, and limited reasoning required to arrive at the correct answer. We introduce A-OKVQA, a crowdsourced dataset composed of a diverse set of about 25K questions requiring a broad base of commonsense and world knowledge to answer. In contrast to the existing knowledge-based VQA datasets, the questions cannot be answered by simply querying a knowledge base, and instead primarily require some form of commonsense reasoning about the scene depicted in the image. We demonstrate the potential of this new dataset through a detailed analysis of its contents and baseline performance measurements over a variety of state-of-the-art vision-language models.

title: Dylan Turpin, Liquan Wang, Eric Heiden, Yun-Chun Chen, Miles Macklin, Stavros Tsogkas, Sven Dickinson, Animesh Garg
title_en: Dylan Turpin, Liquan Wang, Eric Heiden, Yun-Chun Chen, Miles Macklin, Stavros Tsogkas, Sven Dickinson, Animesh Garg
abstract: 手-物体交互研究需要为高维多指模型生成可行的抓取姿态,通常依赖解析抓取合成方法,但该方法往往产生脆弱且不自然的结果。本文提出Grasp’D,一种基于可微接触模拟的抓取合成方法,可同时处理已知模型和视觉输入。我们采用基于梯度的方法作为替代方案,以克服基于采样的抓取合成方法在缺乏简化假设(如预设接触位置和特征抓取)时的局限性。此类假设限制了抓取发现,特别是排除了高接触力抓取。相比之下,我们的基于模拟的方法能够实现稳定、高效、物理现实且高接触力的抓取合成,即使对于具有高自由度的夹爪形态。我们识别并解决了使抓取模拟适用于基于梯度优化的挑战,例如非光滑物体表面几何、接触稀疏性和崎岖的优化景观。Grasp’D在人类和机器人手模型上优于解析抓取合成方法,生成的抓取接触密度超过4倍,从而显著提高抓取稳定性。视频和代码可访问:graspd-eccv22.github.io。
abstract_en: The study of hand-object interaction requires generating viable grasp poses for high-dimensional multi-finger models, often relying on analytic grasp synthesis which tends to produce brittle and unnatural results. This paper presents Grasp’D, an approach to grasp synthesis by differentiable contact simulation that can work with both known models and visual inputs. We use gradient-based methods as an alternative to sampling-based grasp synthesis, which fails without simplifying assumptions, such as pre-specified contact locations and eigengrasps. Such assumptions limit grasp discovery and, in particular, exclude high-contact power grasps. In contrast, our simulation-based approach allows for stable, efficient, physically realistic, high-contact grasp synthesis, even for gripper morphologies with high-degrees of freedom. We identify and address challenges in making grasp simulation amenable to gradient-based optimization, such as non-smooth object surface geometry, contact sparsity, and a rugged optimization landscape. Grasp’D compares favorably to analytic grasp synthesis on human and robotic hand models, and resultant grasps achieve over 4× denser contact, leading to significantly higher grasp stability. Video and code available at: graspd-eccv22.github.io.

title: Dávid Rozenberszki, Or Litany, Angela Dai
title_en: Dávid Rozenberszki, Or Litany, Angela Dai
abstract: 近年来,深度神经网络在三维语义分割领域取得了显著进展,在现有数据集上展现出快速的性能提升。然而,当前三维语义分割基准数据集仅包含少量类别——例如ScanNet和SemanticKITTI分别少于30个类别,无法充分反映真实环境的多样性(例如,语义图像理解涵盖数百至数千个类别)。因此,我们提出研究更大词汇量的三维语义分割,并在ScanNet数据上构建了一个包含200个类别的扩展基准(比以往研究多一个数量级)。如此大量的类别数量也导致了显著的自然类别不平衡,这对现有三维语义分割方法提出了挑战。为在此背景下学习更鲁棒的三维特征,我们提出一种语言驱动的预训练方法,鼓励在训练样本有限的情况下,学习到的三维特征接近其预训练的文本嵌入。大量实验表明,我们的方法在提出的基准测试中持续超越最先进的三维预训练方法(+9%相对mIoU),包括在仅使用5%标注数据的有限数据场景中实现+25%相对mIoU的提升。
abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D semantic segmentation with deep neural networks have shown remarkable success, with rapid performance increase on available datasets. However, current 3D semantic segmentation benchmarks contain only a small number of categories -- less than 30 for ScanNet and SemanticKITTI, for instance, which are not enough to reflect the diversity of real environments (e.g., semantic image understanding covers hundreds to thousands of classes). Thus, we propose to study a larger vocabulary for 3D semantic segmentation with a new extended benchmark on ScanNet data with 200 class categories, an order of magnitude more than previously studied. This large number of class categories also induces a large natural class imbalance, both of which are challenging for existing 3D semantic segmentation methods. To learn more robust 3D features in this context, we propose a language-driven pre-training method to encourage learned 3D features that might have limited training examples to lie close to their pre-trained text embeddings. Extensive experiments show that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art 3D pre-training for 3D semantic segmentation on our proposed benchmark (+9% relative mIoU), including limited-data scenarios with +25% relative mIoU using only 5% annotations.

title: Eduardo Arnold, Jamie Wynn, Sara Vicente, Guillermo Garcia-Hernando, Aron Monszpart, Victor Prisacariu, Daniyar Turmukhambetov, Eric Brachmann
title_en: Eduardo Arnold, Jamie Wynn, Sara Vicente, Guillermo Garcia-Hernando, Aron Monszpart, Victor Prisacariu, Daniyar Turmukhambetov, Eric Brachmann
abstract: 我们能否仅通过单张参考图像对场景进行重定位?标准的视觉重定位需要数百张图像和尺度校准来构建场景特定的3D地图。相反,我们提出了一种无需地图的重定位方法,即仅使用场景的一张照片即可实现即时、度量尺度的重定位。现有数据集由于专注于大场景或可变性有限,不适用于评估无地图重定位。因此,我们构建了一个包含655个小型兴趣点的新数据集,如雕塑、壁画和喷泉,这些地点全球分布。每个地点均配有参考图像作为重定位锚点,并配有数十张具有已知度量尺度相机姿态的查询图像。该数据集具有变化的环境条件、显著的视角变化、地点间高度可变性,以及与参考图像视觉重叠度低至无的查询图像。我们识别出两种现有方法家族以提供基准结果:相对位姿回归,以及特征匹配结合单图像深度预测。尽管这些方法在数据集部分有利场景中表现出合理性能,但无地图重定位仍证明是一项挑战,需要新的创新性解决方案。
abstract_en: Can we relocalize in a scene represented by a single reference image? Standard visual relocalization requires hundreds of images and scale calibration to build a scene-specific 3D map. In contrast, we propose Map-free Relocalization, i.e., using only one photo of a scene to enable instant, metric scaled relocalization. Existing datasets are not suitable to benchmark map-free relocalization, due to their focus on large scenes or their limited variability. Thus, we have constructed a new dataset of 655 small places of interest, such as sculptures, murals and fountains, collected worldwide. Each place comes with a reference image to serve as a relocalization anchor, and dozens of query images with known, metric camera poses. The dataset features changing conditions, stark viewpoint changes, high variability across places, and queries with low to no visual overlap with the reference image.We identify two viable families of existing methods to provide baseline results: relative pose regression, and feature matching combined with single-image depth prediction. While these methods show reasonable performance on some favorable scenes in our dataset, map-free relocalization proves to be a challenge that requires new, innovative solutions.

title: Efthymios Tzinis, Scott Wisdom, Tal Remez, John R. Hershey
title_en: Efthymios Tzinis, Scott Wisdom, Tal Remez, John R. Hershey
abstract: 我们介绍了AudioScopeV2,这是一种最先进的通用音频-视觉屏幕声音分离系统,能够通过分析真实世界视频来学习分离声音并与屏幕上的物体关联。我们识别了之前音频-视觉屏幕声音分离工作的几个局限性,包括时空注意力的粗分辨率、音频分离模型收敛性差、训练和评估数据多样性不足,以及未能平衡屏幕声音保留与非屏幕声音抑制的权衡。我们为所有这些问题提供了解决方案。我们提出的跨模态和自注意力网络架构在时间维度上以更精细的分辨率捕捉音频-视觉依赖关系,同时我们还提出了高效的可分离变体,能够在不显著牺牲性能的情况下扩展到更长的视频。我们还发现,仅在音频上预训练分离模型可显著提升结果。在训练和评估中,我们从真实世界视频的大规模数据库(YFCC100M)中收集了新的屏幕声音人工标注数据。这一新数据集更具多样性且更具挑战性。最后,我们提出了一种校准程序,允许精确调节屏幕重建与非屏幕抑制的平衡,这大大简化了不同操作点模型之间的性能比较。总体而言,我们的实验结果在比之前方法更广泛的条件下显著提升了屏幕分离性能,且计算复杂度增加极少。
abstract_en: We introduce AudioScopeV2, a state-of-the-art universal audio-visual on-screen sound separation system which is capable of learning to separate sounds and associate them with on-screen objects by looking at in-the-wild videos. We identify several limitations of previous work on audio-visual on-screen sound separation, including the coarse resolution of spatio-temporal attention, poor convergence of the audio separation model, limited variety in training and evaluation data, and failure to account for the trade off between preservation of on-screen sounds and suppression of off-screen sounds. We provide solutions to all of these issues. Our proposed cross-modal and self-attention network architectures capture audio-visual dependencies at a finer resolution over time, and we also propose efficient separable variants that are capable of scaling to longer videos without sacrificing much performance. We also find that pre-training the separation model only on audio greatly improves results. For training and evaluation, we collected new human annotations of onscreen sounds from a large database of in-the-wild videos (YFCC100M). This new dataset is more diverse and challenging. Finally, we propose a calibration procedure that allows exact tuning of on-screen reconstruction versus off-screen suppression, which greatly simplifies comparing performance between models with different operating points. Overall, our experimental results show marked improvements in on-screen separation performance under much more general conditions than previous methods with minimal additional computational complexity.

title: Eitan Kosman, Dotan Di Castro
title_en: Eitan Kosman, Dotan Di Castro
abstract: 我们提出了一种简洁的视频表示方法,将感知有意义的特征编码到图结构中。通过这种表示方式,我们旨在利用视频中大量冗余信息以节省计算资源。首先,我们通过将超像素作为图节点,并在相邻超像素之间建立空间和时间连接,构建基于超像素的图表示。随后,我们利用图卷积网络处理这种表示并预测所需输出。结果表明,我们能够以更少的参数训练模型,从而缩短训练周期并减少计算资源需求。在公开数据集Kinetics-400和Charades上的全面实验研究表明,所提出的方法具有高度的成本效益,在训练和推理过程中仅需有限的商用硬件。该方法将计算需求降低10倍,同时取得与最先进方法相当的成果。我们认为,所提出的方案是一个有前景的方向,有望更高效地解决视频理解问题,并使资源受限的研究者能够在该领域取得更大进展。
abstract_en: We propose a concise representation of videos that encode perceptually meaningful features into graphs. With this representation, we aim to leverage the large amount of redundancies in videos and save computations. First, we construct superpixel-based graph representations of videos by considering superpixels as graph nodes and create spatial and temporal connections between adjacent superpixels. Then, we leverage Graph Convolutional Networks to process this representation and predict the desired output. As a result, we are able to train models with much fewer parameters, which translates into short training periods and a reduction in computation resource requirements. A comprehensive experimental study on the publicly available datasets Kinetics-400 and Charades shows that the proposed method is highly cost-effective and uses limited commodity hardware during training and inference. It reduces the computational requirements 10-fold while achieving results that are comparable to state-of-the-art methods. We believe that the proposed approach is a promising direction that could open the door to solving video understanding more efficiently and enable more resource limited users to thrive in this research field.

title: Elad Amrani, Leonid Karlinsky, Alex Bronstein
title_en: Elad Amrani, Leonid Karlinsky, Alex Bronstein
abstract: 我们提出了一种名为Self-Classifier的新型自监督端到端分类学习方法。Self-Classifier通过优化同一样本的两个增强视图的同类预测,在单阶段端到端方式中同时学习标签和表示。为保证非退化解(即所有标签均被分配到同一类的解),我们提出了一种具有均匀先验的数学驱动型交叉熵损失函数变体。在理论分析中,我们证明了退化解不在我们方法的最优解集合中。Self-Classifier易于实现且具有可扩展性。与其他流行的无监督分类和对比表示学习方法不同,它不需要任何预训练、期望最大化、伪标签、外部聚类、第二个网络、停止梯度操作或负样本对。尽管其简单性,我们的方法在ImageNet无监督分类任务中达到了新的最先进水平;甚至在无监督表示学习中也取得了与最先进方法相当的成果。代码可在https://github.com/elad-amrani/self-classifier获取。
abstract_en: We present Self-Classifier -- a novel self-supervised end-to-end classification learning approach. Self-Classifier learns labels and representations simultaneously in a single-stage end-to-end manner by optimizing for same-class prediction of two augmented views of the same sample. To guarantee non-degenerate solutions (i.e., solutions where all labels are assigned to the same class) we propose a mathematically motivated variant of the cross-entropy loss that has a uniform prior asserted on the predicted labels. In our theoretical analysis, we prove that degenerate solutions are not in the set of optimal solutions of our approach. Self-Classifier is simple to implement and scalable. Unlike other popular unsupervised classification and contrastive representation learning approaches, it does not require any form of pre-training, expectation-maximization, pseudo-labeling, external clustering, a second network, stop-gradient operation, or negative pairs. Despite its simplicity, our approach sets a new state of the art for unsupervised classification of ImageNet; and even achieves comparable to state-of-the-art results for unsupervised representation learning. Code is available at https://github.com/elad-amrani/self-classifier.

title: Eldar Insafutdinov, Dylan Campbell, João F. Henriques, Andrea Vedaldi
title_en: Eldar Insafutdinov, Dylan Campbell, João F. Henriques, Andrea Vedaldi
abstract: 我们提出了一种用于部分对称物体高精度三维重建的方法。我们基于近期在神经重建和渲染领域的进展,如神经辐射场(NeRF)。此类方法的主要缺点是无法重建训练图像中未明确可见的物体部分,这在野外图像和视频中尤为常见。当缺乏直接证据时,可以利用结构先验知识(如对称性)来补全缺失信息。然而,在神经渲染中利用此类先验知识极具挑战性:虽然几何形状和非反射材质可能对称,但场景环境中的阴影和反射通常不对称。为解决这一问题,我们对三维几何形状和材质属性施加了软对称约束,并将外观分解为光照、基础色和反射性。我们在最近引入的CO3D数据集上评估了该方法,重点关注汽车类别,因其对高反射材质的重建具有挑战性。我们展示了该方法能够以高保真度重建未观测区域,并生成高质量的新型视角图像。
abstract_en: We present a method for the accurate 3D reconstruction of partly-symmetric objects. We build on the strengths of recent advances in neural reconstruction and rendering such as Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF). A major shortcomings of such approaches is that they fail to reconstruct any part of the object which is not clearly visible in the training image, which is often the case for in-the-wild images and videos. When evidence is lacking, structural priors such as symmetry can be used to complete the missing information. However, exploiting such priors in neural rendering is highly non-trivial: while geometry and non-reflective materials may be symmetric, shadows and reflections from the ambient scene are not symmetric in general. To address this, we apply a soft symmetry constraint to the 3D geometry and material properties, having factored appearance into lighting, albedo colour and reflectivity. We evaluate our method on the recently introduced CO3D dataset, focusing on the car category due to the challenge of reconstructing highly-reflective materials. We show that it can reconstruct unobserved regions with high fidelity and render high-quality novel view images.

title: Elias Ramzi, Nicolas Audebert, Nicolas Thome, Clément Rambour, Xavier Bitot
title_en: Elias Ramzi, Nicolas Audebert, Nicolas Thome, Clément Rambour, Xavier Bitot
abstract: 图像检索通常使用平均精度(AP)或召回率@k进行评估。然而,这些指标仅适用于二元标签,且未考虑错误的严重程度。本文提出了一种针对相关图像检索的新型分层AP训练方法(HAPPIER)。HAPPIER基于一种新的H-AP度量,该度量利用概念层次结构来优化AP,通过整合错误的重要性,更准确地评估排序结果。为使用H-AP训练深度模型,我们仔细研究了问题的结构,设计了一个平滑下界替代函数,并结合聚类损失以确保排序的一致性。在6个数据集上的大量实验表明,HAPPIER在分层检索任务中显著优于现有方法,而在细粒度排序性能评估中与最新方法表现相当。最后,我们证明HAPPIER能更好地组织嵌入空间,并有效避免非分层方法的大多数严重失败案例。我们的代码已公开在https://github.com/elias-ramzi/HAPPIER。
abstract_en: Image Retrieval is commonly evaluated with Average Precision (AP) or Recall@k. Yet, those metrics, are limited to binary labels and do not take into account errors’ severity. This paper introduces a new hierarchical AP training method for pertinent image retrieval (HAPPIER). HAPPIER is based on a new H-AP metric, which leverages a concept hierarchy to refine AP by integrating errors’ importance and better evaluate rankings. To train deep models with H-AP, we carefully study the problem’s structure and design a smooth lower bound surrogate combined with a clustering loss that ensures consistent ordering. Extensive experiments on 6 datasets show that HAPPIER significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods for hierarchical retrieval, while being on par with the latest approaches when evaluating fine-grained ranking performances. Finally, we show that HAPPIER leads to better organization of the embedding space, and prevents most severe failure cases of non-hierarchical methods. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/elias-ramzi/HAPPIER.

title: Elijah Cole, Kimberly Wilber, Grant Van Horn, Xuan Yang, Marco Fornoni, Pietro Perona, Serge Belongie, Andrew Howard, Oisin Mac Aodha
title_en: Elijah Cole, Kimberly Wilber, Grant Van Horn, Xuan Yang, Marco Fornoni, Pietro Perona, Serge Belongie, Andrew Howard, Oisin Mac Aodha
abstract: 弱监督对象定位(WSOL)旨在仅使用图像级类别标签学习编码对象位置的表示。然而,许多对象可以被标记为不同粒度的标签。它是动物、鸟类,还是大角鸮?应该使用哪些图像级标签?本文研究了标签粒度在WSOL中的作用。为促进这一研究,我们引入了iNatLoc500,一个用于WSOL的新大规模细粒度基准数据集。令人惊讶的是,我们发现选择合适的训练标签粒度所带来的性能提升,远大于选择最佳WSOL算法。我们还表明,改变标签粒度可以显著提高数据效率。
abstract_en: Weakly supervised object localization (WSOL) aims to learn representations that encode object location using only image-level category labels. However, many objects can be labeled at different levels of granularity. Is it an animal, a bird, or a great horned owl? Which image-level labels should we use? In this paper we study the role of label granularity in WSOL. To facilitate this investigation we introduce iNatLoc500, a new large-scale fine-grained benchmark dataset for WSOL. Surprisingly, we find that choosing the right training label granularity provides a much larger performance boost than choosing the best WSOL algorithm. We also show that changing the label granularity can significantly improve data efficiency.

title: Emery Pierson, Mohamed Daoudi, Sylvain Arguillere
title_en: Emery Pierson, Mohamed Daoudi, Sylvain Arguillere
abstract: In this paper we address the task of the comparison and the classification of 3D shape sequences of human. The non-linear dynamics of the human motion and the changing of the surface parametrization over the time make this task very challenging. To tackle this issue, we propose to embed the 3D shape sequences in an infinite dimensional space, the space of varifolds, endowed with an inner product that comes from a given positive definite kernel. More specifically, our approach involves two steps: 1) the surfaces are represented as varifolds, this representation induces metrics equivariant to rigid motions and invariant to parametrization; 2) the sequences of 3D shapes are represented by Gram matrices derived from their infinite dimensional Hankel matrices, and we use Frobenius distance between two Symmetric Positive definite (SPD) matrices to compare two sequences. Extensive experiments show that our method is competitive with state-of-the-art in 3D sequence motion retrieval.
abstract_en: In this paper we address the task of the comparison and the classification of 3D shape sequences of human. The non-linear dynamics of the human motion and the changing of the surface parametrization over the time make this task very challenging. To tackle this issue, we propose to embed the 3D shape sequences in an infinite dimensional space, the space of varifolds, endowed with an inner product that comes from a given positive definite kernel. More specifically, our approach involves two steps: 1) the surfaces are represented as varifolds, this representation induces metrics equivariant to rigid motions and invariant to parametrization; 2) the sequences of 3D shapes are represented by Gram matrices derived from their infinite dimensional Hankel matrices, and we use Frobenius distance between two Symmetric Positive definite (SPD) matrices to compare two sequences. Extensive experiments show that our method is competitive with state-of-the-art in 3D sequence motion retrieval.

title: Emeç Erçelik, Ekim Yurtsever, Mingyu Liu, Zhijie Yang, Hanzhen Zhang, Pınar Topçam, Maximilian Listl, Yılmaz Kaan Çaylı, Alois Knoll
title_en: Emeç Erçelik, Ekim Yurtsever, Mingyu Liu, Zhijie Yang, Hanzhen Zhang, Pınar Topçam, Maximilian Listl, Yılmaz Kaan Çaylı, Alois Knoll
abstract: 目前最先进的基于激光雷达的3D目标检测方法依赖于监督学习和大规模标注数据集。然而,标注激光雷达数据耗费资源,仅依赖监督学习会限制训练模型的应用范围。自监督训练策略可以通过学习通用点云主干模型来缓解这些问题,以用于下游3D视觉任务。在此背景下,我们展示了自监督多帧流表示与单帧3D检测假设之间的关系。我们的主要贡献在于利用学习到的流和运动表示,将自监督主干与监督3D检测头相结合。首先,通过循环一致性训练自监督场景流估计模型。然后,将该模型的点云编码器作为单帧3D目标检测头模型的主干。该第二3D目标检测模型学习利用运动表示来区分具有不同运动模式的动态目标。在KITTI和nuScenes基准测试中,实验表明所提出的自监督预训练显著提升了3D检测性能。https://github.com/emecercelik/ssl-3d-detection.git
abstract_en: State-of-the-art lidar-based 3D object detection methods rely on supervised learning and large labeled datasets. However, annotating lidar data is resource-consuming, and depending only on supervised learning limits the applicability of trained models. Self-supervised training strategies can alleviate these issues by learning a general point cloud backbone model for downstream 3D vision tasks. Against this backdrop, we show the relationship between self-supervised multi-frame flow representations and single-frame 3D detection hypotheses. Our main contribution leverages learned flow and motion representations and combines a self-supervised backbone with a supervised 3D detection head. First, a self-supervised scene flow estimation model is trained with cycle consistency. Then, the point cloud encoder of this model is used as the backbone of a single-frame 3D object detection head model. This second 3D object detection model learns to utilize motion representations to distinguish dynamic objects exhibiting different movement patterns. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes benchmarks show that the proposed self-supervised pre-training increases 3D detection performance significantly. https://github.com/emecercelik/ssl-3d-detection.git

title: Emre Aksan, Shugao Ma, Akin Caliskan, Stanislav Pidhorskyi, Alexander Richard, Shih-En Wei, Jason Saragih, Otmar Hilliges
title_en: Emre Aksan, Shugao Ma, Akin Caliskan, Stanislav Pidhorskyi, Alexander Richard, Shih-En Wei, Jason Saragih, Otmar Hilliges
abstract: 基于多视角数据的神经面部化身可以生成逼真的3D重建。然而,在推理过程中,它们必须由有限的输入驱动,例如头戴式摄像机记录的部分视角或前置摄像头以及稀疏的面部地标。为了解决这种不对称性,我们引入了一个基于运行时输入的先验模型,并通过潜在空间中的归一化流将该先验空间与3D面部模型联系起来。我们提出的模型LiP-Flow包含两个编码器,它们从丰富的训练时间观察和贫乏的推理时间观察中学习表示。归一化流桥接了这两个表示空间,并将潜在样本从一个域转换到另一个域,使我们能够定义一个潜在似然目标。我们端到端地训练了我们的模型,以最大化两个表示空间的相似性和重建质量,使3D面部模型能够感知到有限的驱动信号。我们进行了广泛的评估,其中潜在代码被优化以从部分或稀疏的观察中重建3D化身。我们证明,我们的方法产生了一个表达力强且有效的先验,更好地捕捉面部动态和微妙表情。
abstract_en: Neural face avatars that are trained from multi-view data captured in camera domes can produce photo-realistic 3D reconstructions. However, at inference time, they must be driven by limited inputs such as partial views recorded by headset-mounted cameras or a front-facing camera, and sparse facial landmarks. To mitigate this asymmetry, we introduce a prior model that is conditioned on the runtime inputs and tie this prior space to the 3D face model via a normalizing flow in the latent space. Our proposed model, LiP-Flow, consists of two encoders that learn representations from the rich training-time and impoverished inference-time observations. A normalizing flow bridges the two representation spaces and transforms latent samples from one domain to another, allowing us to define a latent likelihood objective. We trained our model end-to-end to maximize the similarity of both representation spaces and the reconstruction quality, making the 3D face model aware of the limited driving signals. We conduct extensive evaluations where the latent codes are optimized to reconstruct 3D avatars from partial or sparse observations. We show that our approach leads to an expressive and effective prior, capturing facial dynamics and subtle expressions better.

title: Enric Corona, Gerard Pons-Moll, Guillem Alenyà, Francesc Moreno-Noguer
title_en: Enric Corona, Gerard Pons-Moll, Guillem Alenyà, Francesc Moreno-Noguer
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于优化的范式,用于在图像上拟合3D人体形状。与现有方法直接从输入图像回归低维统计人体模型(如SMPL)的参数不同,我们训练一个深度网络,仅根据图像特征和一个未拟合的网格,预测顶点向3D人体网格的方向。在推理阶段,我们采用该网络(称为LVD),在梯度下降优化流程中直至收敛,通常在初始化所有顶点为单个点的情况下,仅需数秒即可完成。详尽的评估表明,我们的方法能够捕捉具有非常不同体型的穿衣人体的潜在身体结构,相比现有方法取得了显著提升。此外,所提出的公式可以推广到其他输入数据源,我们在拟合全身和手部的3D扫描数据上进行了实验验证。
abstract_en: We propose a novel optimization-based paradigm for 3D human shape fitting on images. In contrast to existing approaches that directly regress the parameters of a low-dimensional statistical body model (e.g. SMPL) from input images, we propose training a deep network that, given solely image features and an unfit mesh, predicts the directions of the vertices towards the 3D body mesh. At inference, we employ this network, dubbed LVD, within a gradient-descent optimization pipeline until its convergence, which typically occurs in a fraction of a second even when initializing all vertices into a single point. An exhaustive evaluation demonstrates that our approach is able to capture the underlying body of clothed people with very different body shapes, achieving a significant improvement compared to state-of-the-art. Additionally, the proposed formulation can generalize to other sources of input data, which we experimentally show on fitting 3D scans of full bodies and hands.

title: 埃里克·叶茨, 弗兰克·刘, 大卫·沃姆布, 海·李
title_en: Eric Yeats, Frank Liu, David Womble, Hai Li
abstract: 我们提出了一种自监督方法,用于解耦高维数据中的变化因素,该方法不依赖于对潜在变化特征的先验知识(例如,不假设要提取的个体变量的数量或分布)。在我们称之为NashAE的方法中,高维特征解耦通过在标准自编码器(AE)的低维潜在空间中促进每个编码元素与从所有其他编码元素中恢复的该元素信息之间的差异来实现。通过将此作为AE与一组回归网络之间的极小极大博弈来框架化,这些回归网络每个都提供一个元素的条件估计,基于对所有其他元素的观察,从而高效地促进解耦。我们使用现有的解耦度量对我们的方法与领先的解耦方法进行定量比较。此外,我们展示了NashAE在学习的潜在表示中具有更高的可靠性和捕捉显著数据特征的能力。
abstract_en: We present a self-supervised method to disentangle factors of variation in high-dimensional data that does not rely on prior knowledge of the underlying variation profile (e.g., no assumptions on the number or distribution of the individual variables to be extracted). In this method which we call NashAE, high-dimensional feature disentanglement is accomplished in the low-dimensional latent space of a standard autoencoder (AE) by promoting the discrepancy between each encoding element and information of the element recovered from all other encoding elements. Disentanglement is promoted efficiently by framing this as a minmax game between the AE and an ensemble of regression networks which each provide an estimate of an element conditioned on an observation of all other elements. We quantitatively compare our approach with leading disentanglement methods using existing disentanglement metrics. Furthermore, we show that NashAE has increased reliability and increased capacity to capture salient data characteristics in the learned latent representation.

title: Erik Sandström, Martin R. Oswald, Suryansh Kumar, Silvan Weder, Fisher Yu, Cristian Sminchisescu, Luc Van Gool
title_en: Erik Sandström, Martin R. Oswald, Suryansh Kumar, Silvan Weder, Fisher Yu, Cristian Sminchisescu, Luc Van Gool
abstract: 许多手持式或混合现实设备在进行三维重建时仅使用单个传感器,尽管它们通常包含多个传感器。多传感器深度融合能够显著提升三维重建方法的鲁棒性和准确性,但现有技术尚不足以处理具有不同值范围以及噪声和异常值统计特性的传感器。为此,我们引入了SenFuNet,一种深度融合方法,该方法学习传感器特定的噪声和异常值统计特性,并以在线方式融合来自不同传感器的深度帧数据流。我们的方法无需时间同步和校准即可融合多传感器深度流,并且在少量训练数据下具有良好的泛化能力。我们在现实世界的CoRBS和Scene3D数据集以及Replica数据集上进行了多种传感器组合的实验。实验结果表明,我们的融合策略优于传统和近期的在线深度融合方法。此外,多传感器组合在异常值处理和表面重建精度方面比单传感器使用更加稳健和精确。源代码和数据可在https://github.com/tfy14esa/SenFuNet获取。
abstract_en: Many hand-held or mixed reality devices are used with a single sensor for 3D reconstruction, although they often comprise multiple sensors. Multi-sensor depth fusion is able to substantially improve the robustness and accuracy of 3D reconstruction methods, but existing techniques are not robust enough to handle sensors which operate with diverse value ranges as well as noise and outlier statistics. To this end, we introduce SenFuNet, a depth fusion approach that learns sensor-specific noise and outlier statistics and combines the data streams of depth frames from different sensors in an online fashion. Our method fuses multi-sensor depth streams regardless of time synchronization and calibration and generalizes well with little training data. We conduct experiments with various sensor combinations on the real-world CoRBS and Scene3D datasets, as well as the Replica dataset. Experiments demonstrate that our fusion strategy outperforms traditional and recent online depth fusion approaches. In addition, the combination of multiple sensors yields more robust outlier handling and more precise surface reconstruction than the use of a single sensor. The source code and data are available at https://github.com/tfy14esa/SenFuNet.

title: Erroll Wood, Tadas Baltrušaitis, Charlie Hewitt, Matthew Johnson, Jingjing Shen, Nikola Milosavljević, Daniel Wilde, Stephan Garbin, Toby Sharp, Ivan Stojiljković, Tom Cashman, Julien Valentin
title_en: Erroll Wood, Tadas Baltrušaitis, Charlie Hewitt, Matthew Johnson, Jingjing Shen, Nikola Milosavljević, Daniel Wilde, Stephan Garbin, Toby Sharp, Ivan Stojiljković, Tom Cashman, Julien Valentin
abstract: 地标在面部分析中通常起着关键作用,但许多身份或表情特征无法仅通过稀疏地标来表示。因此,为了更准确地重建人脸,地标通常会结合深度图像等附加信号或可微渲染等技术。我们能否仅通过增加地标数量来简化流程?为回答这一问题,我们提出了首个能够准确预测常规地标数量10倍的地标方法,覆盖整个头部,包括眼睛和牙齿。该方法通过合成训练数据实现,确保了完美的地标标注。通过对这些密集地标拟合可变形模型,我们在单目野外3D人脸重建中取得了最先进的结果。我们展示了密集地标作为跨帧整合面部形状信息的理想信号,通过在单目和多视角场景中实现准确且富有表现力的面部性能捕捉得以验证。该方法还具有高度效率:在单个CPU线程上,我们可以在超过150帧每秒的速度下预测密集地标并拟合3D人脸模型。请访问我们的网站:https://microsoft.github.io/DenseLandmarks/
abstract_en: Landmarks often play a key role in face analysis, but many aspects of identity or expression cannot be represented by sparse landmarks alone. Thus, in order to reconstruct faces more accurately, landmarks are often combined with additional signals like depth images or techniques like differentiable rendering. Can we keep things simple by just using more landmarks? In answer, we present the first method that accurately predicts 10x as many landmarks as usual, covering the whole head, including the eyes and teeth. This is accomplished using synthetic training data, which guarantees perfect landmark annotations. By fitting a morphable model to these dense landmarks, we achieve state-of-the-art results for monocular 3D face reconstruction in the wild. We show that dense landmarks are an ideal signal for integrating face shape information across frames by demonstrating accurate and expressive facial performance capture in both monocular and multi-view scenarios. This approach is also highly efficient: we can predict dense landmarks and fit our 3D face model at over 150FPS on a single CPU thread. Please see our website: https://microsoft.github.io/DenseLandmarks/.

title: Eun Sun Lee, Junho Kim, SangWon Park, Young Min Kim
title_en: Eun Sun Lee, Junho Kim, SangWon Park, Young Min Kim
abstract: 我们提出了一种领域自适应方法MoDA,该方法能够在没有真实监督的情况下,将预训练的具身智能体适配到新的嘈杂环境中。基于地图的记忆为视觉导航提供了重要的上下文信息,并表现出主要由平面墙壁和矩形障碍物组成的独特空间结构。我们的自适应方法鼓励在估计地图上固有的规律性,以指导智能体克服新环境中普遍存在的领域差异。具体而言,我们提出了一种高效的课程学习策略,通过风格迁移网络生成的伪干净地图进行自监督,以在线方式处理视觉和动态的退化问题。由于基于地图的表示为智能体策略提供了空间知识,我们的方法可以将预训练的策略网络部署到新的环境中。我们在各种实际场景中评估了MoDA,并展示了所提出的方法能够快速提升智能体在定位、地图构建、探索和点目标导航等下游任务中的性能。
abstract_en: We propose a domain adaptation method, MoDA, which adapts a pretrained embodied agent to a new, noisy environment without ground-truth supervision. Map-based memory provides important contextual information for visual navigation, and exhibits unique spatial structure mainly composed of flat walls and rectangular obstacles. Our adaptation approach encourages the inherent regularities on the estimated maps to guide the agent to overcome the prevalent domain discrepancy in a novel environment. Specifically, we propose an efficient learning curriculum to handle the visual and dynamics corruptions in an online manner, self-supervised with pseudo clean maps generated by style transfer networks. Because the map-based representation provides spatial knowledge for the agent’s policy, our formulation can deploy the pretrained policy networks from simulators in a new setting. We evaluate MoDA in various practical scenarios and show that our proposed method quickly enhances the agent’s performance in downstream tasks including localization, mapping, exploration, and point-goal navigation.

title: Eyal Naor, Itai Antebi, Shai Bagon, Michal Irani
title_en: Eyal Naor, Itai Antebi, Shai Bagon, Michal Irani
abstract: 由滚动快门(RS)摄像机获取的视频会导致空间失真帧。这些失真在快速摄像机/场景运动下变得显著。撤销RS效应有时被当作一个空间问题来处理,其中需要校正/移动物体以生成其正确的全局快门(GS)帧。然而,RS效应的根本原因是时间性的,而非空间性的。在本文中,我们提出了一种时空解决方案来解决RS问题。我们观察到,尽管RS视频和其对应的GS视频在xy帧之间存在显著差异,但它们的xt切片在已知的子帧时间偏移下却完全相同。此外,尽管每个视频内部存在强烈的时序混叠,它们共享相同的二维xt补丁分布。这使得我们可以利用RS输入视频施加的视频特定约束来约束GS输出视频。我们的算法由三个主要组件组成:(i) 使用现成的方法对连续RS帧进行密集时间上采样(该方法是在常规视频序列上训练的),从中提取GS“提案”。(ii) 使用专用的MergeNet学习正确合并此类GS“提案”。(iii) 一种视频特定的零样本优化,通过在GS输出视频和RS输入视频之间施加xt补丁的相似性来约束。我们的方法在基准数据集上取得了最先进的结果,无论是数值上还是视觉上,尽管它是在一个小的合成RS/GS数据集上训练的。此外,它能够很好地泛化到训练集分布之外的新复杂RS视频(例如,复杂的非刚性运动)——这些视频是使用大量数据训练的竞争方法难以处理的。我们将这些泛化能力归因于外部和内部约束的结合。
abstract_en: Videos obtained by rolling-shutter (RS) cameras result in spatially-distorted frames. These distortions become significant under fast camera/scene motions. Undoing effects of RS is sometimes addressed as a spatial problem, where objects need to be rectified/displaced in order to generate their correct global shutter (GS) frame. However, the cause of the RS effect is inherently temporal, not spatial. In this paper we propose a space-time solution to the RS problem. We observe that despite the severe differences between their xy-frames, a RS video and its corresponding GS video tend to share the exact same xt-slices - up to a known sub-frame temporal shift. Moreover, they share the same distribution of small 2D xt-patches, despite the strong temporal aliasing within each video. This allows to constrain the GS output video using video-specific constraints imposed by the RS input video. Our algorithm is composed of 3 main components: (i) Dense temporal upsampling between consecutive RS frames using an off-the-shelf method, (which was trained on regular video sequences), from which we extract GS “proposals”. (ii) Learning to correctly merge an ensemble of such GS “proposals” using a dedicated MergeNet. (iii) A video-specific zero-shot optimization which imposes the similarity of xt-patches between the GS output video and the RS input video. Our method obtains state-of-the-art results on benchmark datasets, both numerically and visually, despite being trained on a small synthetic RS/GS dataset. Moreover, it generalizes well to new complex RS videos with motion types outside the distribution of the training set (e.g., complex non-rigid motions) - videos which competing methods trained on much more data cannot handle well. We attribute these generalization capabilities to the combination of external and internal constraints.

title: Fabian Duffhauss, Ngo Anh Vien, Hanna Ziesche, Gerhard Neumann
title_en: Fabian Duffhauss, Ngo Anh Vien, Hanna Ziesche, Gerhard Neumann
abstract: 传感器融合可以显著提高许多计算机视觉任务的性能。然而,传统的融合方法要么不是数据驱动的,无法利用先验知识或在给定数据集中发现规律,要么仅限于单一应用。我们通过提出一种名为FusionVAE的新颖深度层次变分自编码器来克服这一缺点,该自编码器可以作为许多融合任务的基础。我们的方法能够生成多种图像样本,这些样本基于多个带有噪声、遮挡或仅部分可见的输入图像进行条件生成。我们推导并优化了FusionVAE的条件对数似然的变分下界。为了全面评估我们模型的融合能力,我们基于流行的计算机视觉数据集创建了三个新的图像融合数据集。在实验中,我们展示了FusionVAE学习到的聚合信息表示对于融合任务是相关的。结果表明,我们的方法显著优于传统方法。此外,我们还介绍了不同设计选择的优缺点。
abstract_en: Sensor fusion can significantly improve the performance of many computer vision tasks. However, traditional fusion approaches are either not data-driven and cannot exploit prior knowledge nor find regularities in a given dataset or they are restricted to a single application. We overcome this shortcoming by presenting a novel deep hierarchical variational autoencoder called FusionVAE that can serve as a basis for many fusion tasks. Our approach is able to generate diverse image samples that are conditioned on multiple noisy, occluded, or only partially visible input images. We derive and optimize a variational lower bound for the conditional log-likelihood of FusionVAE. In order to assess the fusion capabilities of our model thoroughly, we created three novel datasets for image fusion based on popular computer vision datasets. In our experiments, we show that FusionVAE learns a representation of aggregated information that is relevant to fusion tasks. The results demonstrate that our approach outperforms traditional methods significantly. Furthermore, we present the advantages and disadvantages of different design choices.

title: 法比安·门特泽尔,埃里克·阿古斯托森,约翰内斯·巴莱,大卫·明纳,尼克·约翰斯顿,乔治·托德里奇
title_en: Fabian Mentzer, Eirikur Agustsson, Johannes Ballé, David Minnen, Nick Johnston, George Toderici
abstract: 我们提出了基于生成对抗网络(GANs)的第一种神经视频压缩方法。我们的方法在用户研究中显著优于以往的神经和非神经视频压缩方法,为神经方法设定了新的视觉质量最先进水平。我们证明了GAN损失对于获得这种高质量视觉效果至关重要。两个因素使GAN损失有效:我们i)通过将生成器条件化于从变形的先前重建中提取的潜在变量来合成细节,然后ii)通过高质量的光流传播这些细节。我们发现,用户研究是比较方法所必需的,即我们的所有定量指标都无法预测所有研究。我们详细介绍了网络设计选择,并通过用户研究对其进行消融分析。
abstract_en: We present the first neural video compression method based on generative adversarial networks (GANs). Our approach significantly outperforms previous neural and non-neural video compression methods in a user study, setting a new state-of-the-art in visual quality for neural methods. We show that the GAN loss is crucial to obtain this high visual quality. Two components make the GAN loss effective: we i) synthesize detail by conditioning the generator on a latent extracted from the warped previous reconstruction to then ii) propagate this detail with high-quality flow. We find that user studies are required to compare methods, i.e., none of our quantitative metrics were able to predict all studies. We present the network design choices in detail, and ablate them with user studies.

title: Fabio Pizzati, Jean-François Lalonde, Raoul de Charette
title_en: Fabio Pizzati, Jean-François Lalonde, Raoul de Charette
abstract: 大多数图像到图像的翻译方法需要大量训练图像,这限制了其适用性。我们提出了一种名为ManiFest的框架,用于少样本图像翻译,该框架仅通过少量图像学习目标域的上下文感知表示。为了强制特征一致性,我们的框架在源域和额外的锚定域(假设由大量图像组成)之间学习一种风格流形。通过基于补丁的对抗损失和特征统计对齐损失,学习到的流形被插值并变形以接近少样本目标域。所有这些组件在单个端到端循环中同时进行训练。除了通用的少样本翻译任务外,我们的方法还可以通过单个示例图像进行条件控制,以再现其特定风格。广泛的实验表明,ManiFest在多个任务上都表现出色,在所有指标上均优于现有最先进的方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/cv-rits/ManiFest获取。
abstract_en: Most image-to-image translation methods require a large number of training images, which restricts their applicability. We instead propose ManiFest: a framework for few-shot image translation that learns a context-aware representation of a target domain from a few images only. To enforce feature consistency, our framework learns a style manifold between source and additional anchor domains (assumed to be composed of large numbers of images). The learned manifold is interpolated and deformed towards the few-shot target domain via patch-based adversarial and feature statistics alignment losses. All of these components are trained simultaneously during a single end-to-end loop. In addition to the general few-shot translation task, our approach can alternatively be conditioned on a single exemplar image to reproduce its specific style. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy of ManiFest on multiple tasks, outperforming the state-of-the-art on all metrics. Our code is avaliable at https://github.com/cv-rits/ManiFest.

title: Fan Hu, Aozhu Chen, Ziyue Wang, Fangming Zhou, Jianfeng Dong, Xirong Li
title_en: Fan Hu, Aozhu Chen, Ziyue Wang, Fangming Zhou, Jianfeng Dong, Xirong Li
abstract: 本文重新审视了特征融合这一传统话题,在文本到视频检索的新背景下。与以往仅在视频或文本一端进行特征融合的研究不同,我们旨在在一个统一框架内实现两端的特征融合。我们假设,通过优化特征的凸组合,比使用计算量大的多头自注意力机制建模它们的相关性更为优越。我们提出了轻量级注意力特征融合(LAFF)。LAFF在早期和晚期阶段,以及视频和文本两端进行特征融合,使其成为一种强大的方法,用于利用多样化的(现成的)特征。LAFF的可解释性可用于特征选择。在五个公共基准集(MSR-VTT、MSVD、TGIF、VATEX和TRECVID AVS 2016-2020)上的大量实验验证了LAFF作为文本到视频检索的新基线的有效性。
abstract_en: In this paper we revisit feature fusion, an old-fashioned topic, in the new context of text-to-video retrieval. Different from previous research that considers feature fusion only at one end, let it be video or text, we aim for feature fusion for both ends within a unified framework. We hypothesize that optimizing the convex combination of the features is preferred to modeling their correlations by computationally heavy multi-head self attention. We propose Lightweight Attentional Feature Fusion (LAFF). LAFF performs feature fusion at both early and late stages and at both video and text ends, making it a powerful method for exploiting diverse (off-the-shelf) features. The interpretability of LAFF can be used for feature selection. Extensive experiments on five public benchmark sets (MSR-VTT, MSVD, TGIF, VATEX and TRECVID AVS 2016-2020) justify LAFF as a new baseline for text-to-video retrieval.

title: 方高 曾,董斌,张媛,王天才,张翔宇,魏毅辰
title_en: Fangao Zeng, Bin Dong, Yuang Zhang, Tiancai Wang, Xiangyu Zhang, Yichen Wei
abstract: 对物体进行时序建模是多目标跟踪(MOT)中的关键挑战。现有方法通过基于运动和外观的相似性启发式关联检测来进行跟踪。关联的后处理性质阻碍了对视频序列中时序变化的端到端利用。在本文中,我们提出MOTR,它扩展了DETR \cite{carion2020detr},并引入“跟踪查询”以在整个视频中建模被跟踪实例。跟踪查询逐帧传递和更新,以进行时间迭代预测。我们提出跟踪片段感知的标签分配方法来训练跟踪查询和新生物体查询。我们进一步提出时序聚合网络和集体平均损失以增强时序关系建模。在DanceTrack上的实验结果表明,MOTR在HOTA指标上显著优于最先进的方法ByteTrack 6.5\%。在MOT17上,MOTR在关联性能上优于我们的同期工作TrackFormer和TransTrack。MOTR可以作为未来时序建模和基于Transformer的跟踪器研究的更强基线。代码可在\url{https://github.com/anonymous4669/MOTR}获取。
abstract_en: Temporal modeling of objects is a key challenge in multiple-object tracking (MOT). Existing methods track by associating detections through motion-based and appearance-based similarity heuristics. The post-processing nature of association prevents end-to-end exploitation of temporal variations in video sequence. In this paper, we propose MOTR, which extends DETR \cite{carion2020detr} and introduces “track query” to model the tracked instances in the entire video. Track query is transferred and updated frame-by-frame to perform iterative prediction over time. We propose tracklet-aware label assignment to train track queries and newborn object queries. We further propose temporal aggregation network and collective average loss to enhance temporal relation modeling. Experimental results on DanceTrack show that MOTR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art method, ByteTrack by 6.5\% on HOTA metric. On MOT17, MOTR outperforms our concurrent works, TrackFormer and TransTrack, on association performance. MOTR can serve as a stronger baseline for future research on temporal modeling and Transformer-based trackers. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/anonymous4669/MOTR}.

title: Fangneng Zhan, Yingchen Yu, Rongliang Wu, Jiahui Zhang, Kaiwen Cui, Aoran Xiao, Shijian Lu, Chunyan Miao
title_en: Fangneng Zhan, Yingchen Yu, Rongliang Wu, Jiahui Zhang, Kaiwen Cui, Aoran Xiao, Shijian Lu, Chunyan Miao
abstract: 生成对抗网络(GANs)在图像翻译和编辑方面取得了巨大成功。然而,高保真图像生成与风格控制仍是在计算机视觉领域面临的重要挑战。本文提出了一种通用的图像翻译与编辑框架,通过显式构建对应关系,实现图像生成中的准确语义和风格引导。为处理构建密集对应关系导致的二次复杂度问题,我们引入了一种双级特征对齐策略,采用top-$k$操作对块级特征进行排序,随后通过块特征间的密集注意力机制显著降低内存消耗。由于top-$k$操作涉及索引交换,阻碍了梯度传播,我们通过正则化地球移动问题对非可微的top-$k$操作进行近似,从而有效实现梯度反向传播。此外,我们设计了一种新颖的语义位置编码机制,为每个语义区域构建坐标以保留纹理结构。进一步地,我们设计了一种新颖的置信度特征注入模块,通过根据构建对应关系的可靠性自适应融合特征,缓解匹配问题。大量实验表明,与现有方法相比,我们的方法在定性和定量指标上均取得了优越性能。
abstract_en: Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have achieved great success in image translation and manipulation. However, high-fidelity image generation with faithful style control remains a grand challenge in computer vision. This paper presents a versatile image translation and manipulation framework that achieves accurate semantic and style guidance in image generation by explicitly building a correspondence. To handle the quadratic complexity incurred by building the dense correspondences, we introduce a bi-level feature alignment strategy that adopts a top-$k$ operation to rank block-wise features followed by dense attention between block features which reduces memory cost substantially. As the top-$k$ operation involves index swapping which precludes the gradient propagation, we approximate the non-differentiable top-$k$ operation with a regularized earth mover’s problem so that its gradient can be effectively back-propagated. In addition, we design a novel semantic position encoding mechanism that builds up coordinate for each individual semantic region to preserve texture structures while building correspondences.
