To demonstrate the potential of annotated poses, we show applications of the PoseScript dataset to retrieval of relevant poses from large-scale datasets and to synthetic pose generation, both based on a textual pose description. Code and dataset are available at https://europe.naverlabs.com/research/computer-vision/posescript/.

title: Golnaz Ghiasi, 谷秀悦, 崔 Yin, 林 Tsung-Yi
title_en: Golnaz Ghiasi, Xiuye Gu, Yin Cui, Tsung-Yi Lin
abstract: 我们设计了一个开放词汇图像分割模型,以将图像组织为由任意文本指示的有意义区域。尽管近期工作(CLIP 和 ALIGN)通过图像级描述标签实现了令人印象深刻的开放词汇分类准确率,但它们无法以像素级别分割视觉概念。我们认为这些模型缺少一个重要的视觉分组步骤,即在学习视觉语义对齐之前,将像素组织为组。我们提出 OpenSeg 来解决上述问题,同时仍然利用可扩展的图像级描述监督。首先,它学习生成可能组织的分割掩码。然后,它通过将描述中的每个单词与一个或多个预测掩码对齐来学习视觉语义对齐。我们发现掩码表示是支持从描述学习图像分割的关键,这使得数据集和词汇量的扩展成为可能。得益于其可扩展性,OpenSeg 在 PASCAL 数据集上显著优于最近的开放词汇方法 LSeg,mIoU 提高了 +19.9。
abstract_en: We design an open-vocabulary image segmentation model to organize an image into meaningful regions indicated by arbitrary texts. Recent works (CLIP and ALIGN), despite attaining impressive open-vocabulary classification accuracy with image-level caption labels, are unable to segment visual concepts with pixels. We argue that these models miss an important step of visual grouping, which organizes pixels into groups before learning visual-semantic alignments. We propose OpenSeg to address the above issue while still making use of scalable image-level supervision of captions. First, it learns to propose segmentation masks for possible organizations. Then it learns visual-semantic alignments by aligning each word in a caption to one or a few predicted masks. We find the mask representations are the key to support learning image segmentation from captions, making it possible to scale up the dataset and vocabulary sizes. OpenSeg significantly outperforms the recent open-vocabulary method of LSeg by +19.9 mIoU on PASCAL dataset, thanks to its scalability.

title: Gopal Sharma, Kangxue Yin, Subhransu Maji, Evangelos Kalogerakis, Or Litany, Sanja Fidler
title_en: Gopal Sharma, Kangxue Yin, Subhransu Maji, Evangelos Kalogerakis, Or Litany, Sanja Fidler
abstract: 我们提出在2D领域利用自监督技术来处理细粒度3D形状分割任务。这一方法受到观察结果的启发:基于视图的表面表示在建模高分辨率表面细节和纹理方面,比基于点云或体素占用的3D表示更有效。具体而言,给定一个3D形状,我们从多个视角对其进行渲染,并在对比学习框架内建立密集对应学习任务。结果表明,学习到的2D表示具有视角不变性和几何一致性,当在有限数量的标注形状上训练时,相较于仅基于2D或3D自监督的方法,具有更好的泛化能力。在纹理化(RenderPeople)和非纹理化(PartNet)3D数据集上的实验表明,我们的方法在细粒度部件分割任务中优于现有最先进的方法。当仅使用稀疏视角集进行训练或形状具有纹理时,相较于基线方法的改进更为显著,这表明该方法同时受益于2D处理和3D几何推理。
abstract_en: We propose to utilize self-supervised techniques in the 2D domain for fine-grained 3D shape segmentation tasks. This is inspired by the observation that view-based surface representations are more effective at modeling high-resolution surface details and texture than their 3D counterparts based on point clouds or voxel occupancy. Specifically, given a 3D shape, we render it from multiple views, and set up a dense correspondence learning task within the contrastive learning framework. As a result, the learned 2D representations are view-invariant and geometrically consistent, leading to better generalization when trained on a limited number of labeled shapes than alternatives based on self-supervision in 2D or 3D alone. Experiments on textured (RenderPeople) and untextured (PartNet) 3D datasets show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art alternatives in fine-grained part segmentation. The improvements over baselines are greater when only a sparse set of views is available for training or when shapes are textured, indicating that \mvd benefits from both 2D processing and 3D geometric reasoning.

title: Grant Van Horn, Rui Qian, Kimberly Wilber, Hartwig Adam, Oisin Mac Aodha, Serge Belongie
title_en: Grant Van Horn, Rui Qian, Kimberly Wilber, Hartwig Adam, Oisin Mac Aodha, Serge Belongie
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的基准数据集Sapsucker Woods 60(SSW60),以推动音频视觉细粒度分类研究的发展。尽管我们的社区在图像细粒度分类方面取得了显著进展,但音频和视频细粒度分类的研究仍相对较少。为了促进这一领域的发展,我们精心构建了SSW60数据集,使研究人员能够在图像、音频和视频三种模态中对同一组类别进行分类实验。该数据集涵盖60种鸟类物种,包含现有数据集中的图像,以及全新、专家整理的音频和视频数据集。我们通过使用最先进的Transformer方法,全面评估了音频视觉分类性能和模态融合实验。我们的研究结果表明,音频视觉融合方法在视频分类任务中的表现优于仅使用图像或音频的方法。我们还展示了由SSW60独特的三模态构建所带来的有趣的模态迁移实验。我们希望SSW60数据集及其配套基线能够推动这一引人入胜领域的研究。
abstract_en: We present a new benchmark dataset, Sapsucker Woods 60 (SSW60), for advancing research on audiovisual fine-grained categorization. While our community has made great strides in fine-grained visual categorization on images, the counterparts in audio and video fine-grained categorization are relatively unexplored. To encourage advancements in this space, we have carefully constructed the SSW60 dataset to enable researchers to experiment with classifying the same set of categories in three different modalities: images, audio, and video. The dataset covers 60 species of birds and is comprised of images from existing datasets, and brand new, expert curated audio and video datasets. We thoroughly benchmark audiovisual classification performance and modality fusion experiments through the use of state-of-the-art transformer methods. Our findings show that performance of audiovisual fusion methods is better than using exclusively image or audio based methods for the task of video classification. We also present interesting modality transfer experiments, enabled by the unique construction of SSW60 to encompass three different modalities. We hope the SSW60 dataset and accompanying baselines spur research in this fascinating area.

title: Grigorios G. Chrysos, Markos Georgopoulos, Jiankang Deng, Jean Kossaifi, Yannis Panagakis, Anima Anandkumar
title_en: Grigorios G. Chrysos, Markos Georgopoulos, Jiankang Deng, Jean Kossaifi, Yannis Panagakis, Anima Anandkumar
abstract: 深度神经网络已成为分类任务(例如物体和音频识别)成功的关键驱动力。通过多种最近提出的架构,已经取得了令人印象深刻的结果和泛化能力,其中大多数架构似乎彼此无关。在本工作中,我们提出了一种统一的框架来研究深度分类器。具体而言,我们将最先进的架构(例如残差网络和非局部网络)表示为输入的不同次数多项式形式。我们的框架为每种模型的归纳偏差提供了见解,并能够基于其多项式特性进行自然扩展。所提出的模型在标准图像和音频分类基准上进行了评估。在模型性能提升以及模型压缩方面,所提出模型的表达能力得到了突出体现。最后,该分类法允许的扩展在数据有限和长尾数据分布的情况下展示了优势。我们期望该分类法能够建立现有领域特定架构之间的联系。
abstract_en: Deep neural networks have been the driving force behind the success in classification tasks, e.g., object and audio recognition. Impressive results and generalization have been achieved by a variety of recently proposed architectures, the majority of which are seemingly disconnected. In this work, we cast the study of deep classifiers under a unifying framework. In particular, we express state-of-the-art architectures (e.g., residual and non-local networks) in the form of different degree polynomials of the input. Our framework provides insights on the inductive biases of each model and enables natural extensions building upon their polynomial nature. The efficacy of the proposed models is evaluated on standard image and audio classification benchmarks. The expressivity of the proposed models is highlighted both in terms of increased model performance as well as model compression. Lastly, the extensions allowed by this taxonomy showcase benefits in the presence of limited data and long-tailed data distributions. We expect this taxonomy to provide links between existing domain-specific architectures.

title: Guanbo Pan, Guo Lu, Zhihao Hu, Dong Xu
title_en: Guanbo Pan, Guo Lu, Zhihao Hu, Dong Xu
abstract: 近年来,神经图像压缩(NIC)算法展现出强大的编码性能。然而,大多数算法未能很好地适应图像内容。尽管已有研究通过更新编码器端组件提出了若干内容自适应方法,但潜在变量和解码器的自适应性尚未被充分挖掘。本文提出了一种新的NIC框架,通过提升潜在变量和解码器的自适应性来增强内容适应性。具体而言,为去除潜在变量中的冗余信息,我们提出的内容自适应通道丢弃(CACD)方法能够自动在空间维度选择潜在变量的最优质量等级并丢弃冗余通道。此外,我们提出的内容自适应特征变换(CAFT)方法通过提取图像内容的特征信息,提升解码器端的内容适应性,该特征信息随后用于解码器端特征的变换。实验结果表明,结合编码器端更新算法的所提方法在性能上达到当前最佳水平。
abstract_en: In recent years, neural image compression (NIC) algorithms have shown powerful coding performance. However, most of them are not adaptive to the image content. Although several content adaptive methods have been proposed by updating the encoder-side components, the adaptability of both latents and the decoder is not well exploited. In this work, we propose a new NIC framework that improves the content adaptability on both latents and the decoder. Specifically, to remove redundancy in the latents, our content adaptive channel dropping (CACD) method automatically selects the optimal quality levels for the latents spatially and drops the redundant channels. Additionally, we propose the content adaptive feature transformation (CAFT) method to improve decoder-side content adaptability by extracting the characteristic information of the image content, which is then used to transform the features in the decoder side. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed methods with the encoder-side updating algorithm achieve the state-of-the-art performance.

title: Guangcheng Chen, Li He, Yisheng Guan, Hong Zhang
title_en: Guangcheng Chen, Li He, Yisheng Guan, Hong Zhang
abstract: 当前偏振三维重建方法,包括在已建立的偏振形状重建文献中的方法,都是在正交投影假设下开发的。然而,在大视野情况下,这一假设不成立,可能导致基于该假设的方法产生显著的重建误差。为了解决这个问题,我们提出了适用于透视相机的视角相位角(PPA)模型。与正交模型相比,所提出的PPA模型准确描述了在透视投影下偏振相位角与表面法线之间的关系。此外,PPA模型使得仅通过单视角相位角图即可估计表面法线,并且不会受到所谓的π-模糊问题的影响。在真实数据上的实验表明,PPA模型比正交模型在使用透视相机进行表面法线估计时更加准确。
abstract_en: Current polarimetric 3D reconstruction methods, including those in the well-established shape from polarization literature, are all developed under the orthographic projection assumption. In the case of a large field of view, however, this assumption does not hold and may result in significant reconstruction errors in methods that make this assumption. To address this problem, we present the perspective phase angle (PPA) model that is applicable to perspective cameras. Compared with the orthographic model, the proposed PPA model accurately describes the relationship between polarization phase angle and surface normal under perspective projection. In addition, the PPA model makes it possible to estimate surface normals from only one single-view phase angle map and does not suffer from the so-called Ï€-ambiguity problem. Experiments on real data show that the PPA model is more accurate for surface normal estimation with a perspective camera than the orthographic model.

title: Guangcong Wang, Yinuo Yang, Chen Change Loy, Ziwei Liu
title_en: Guangcong Wang, Yinuo Yang, Chen Change Loy, Ziwei Liu
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的光照估计与编辑框架,从低动态范围(LDR)相机捕获的单张有限视场角(LFOV)图像生成高动态范围(HDR)室内全景光照。现有光照估计方法要么直接回归光照表示参数,要么将该问题分解为LFOV到全景和LDR到HDR光照生成子任务。然而,由于部分观测、高动态范围光照以及场景的固有歧义性,光照估计仍是一项具有挑战性的任务。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种耦合双StyleGAN全景合成网络(StyleLight),将LDR和HDR全景合成整合到统一框架中。LDR和HDR全景合成共享相似的生成器,但具有独立的判别器。在推理过程中,给定一个LDR LFOV图像,我们提出了一种焦点掩码GAN反演方法,通过LDR全景合成分支找到其潜在代码,然后通过HDR全景合成分支合成HDR全景。StyleLight将LFOV到全景和LDR到HDR光照生成整合到统一框架中,从而显著提升了光照估计性能。大量实验表明,我们的框架在室内光照估计任务中优于现有最先进的方法。值得注意的是,StyleLight还支持对室内HDR全景的直观光照编辑,适用于实际应用场景。代码可在https://style-light.github.io/获取。
abstract_en: We present a new lighting estimation and editing framework to generate high-dynamic-range (HDR) indoor panorama lighting from a single limited field-of-view (LFOV) image captured by low-dynamic-range (LDR) cameras. Existing lighting estimation methods either directly regress lighting representation parameters or decompose this problem into LFOV-to-panorama and LDR-to-HDR lighting generation sub-tasks. However, due to the partial observation, the high-dynamic-range lighting, and the intrinsic ambiguity of a scene, lighting estimation remains a challenging task. To tackle this problem, we propose a coupled dual-StyleGAN panorama synthesis network (StyleLight) that integrates LDR and HDR panorama synthesis into a unified framework. The LDR and HDR panorama synthesis share a similar generator but have separate discriminators. During inference, given an LDR LFOV image, we propose a focal-masked GAN inversion method to find its latent code by the LDR panorama synthesis branch and then synthesize the HDR panorama by the HDR panorama synthesis branch. StyleLight takes LFOV-to-panorama and LDR-to-HDR lighting generation into a unified framework and thus greatly improves lighting estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves superior performance over state-of-the-art methods on indoor lighting estimation. Notably, StyleLight also enables intuitive lighting editing on indoor HDR panoramas, which is suitable for real-world applications. Code is available at https://style-light.github.io/.

title: 广聪郑, 生明李, 惠王, 太平姚, 扬陈, 友红丁, 熙李
title_en: Guangcong Zheng, Shengming Li, Hui Wang, Taiping Yao, Yang Chen, Shouhong Ding, Xi Li
abstract: 去噪扩散概率模型(DDPM)通过引入一个独立的噪声感知分类器,在去噪过程中每个时间步提供条件梯度引导,从而实现从先验噪声到真实数据的灵活条件图像生成。然而,由于分类器能够轻易区分仅具有高层结构的不完全生成图像,这种梯度作为类别信息引导会过早消失,导致条件生成过程退化为无条件过程。为解决此问题,我们从两个视角提出两种简单但有效的改进方法。在采样过程中,我们引入预测分布的熵作为引导消失程度的度量,并提出一种熵感知缩放方法以自适应恢复条件语义引导。在训练阶段,我们提出熵感知优化目标以缓解对噪声数据的过度自信预测。在ImageNet1000 256x256数据集上,通过我们的采样方案和训练分类器,预训练的条件DDPM和无条件DDPM模型分别实现了10.89%(4.59到4.09)和43.5%(12到6.78)的FID提升。代码已开源至https://github.com/ZGCTroy/ED-DPM。
abstract_en: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) is able to make flexible conditional image generation from prior noise to real data, by introducing an independent noise-aware classifier to provide conditional gradient guidance at each time step of denoising process. However, due to the ability of the classifier to easily discriminate an incompletely generated image only with high-level structure, the gradient, which is a kind of class information guidance, tends to vanish early, leading to the collapse from conditional generation process into the unconditional process. To address this problem, we propose two simple but effective approaches from two perspectives. For sampling procedure, we introduce the entropy of predicted distribution as the measure of guidance vanishing level and propose an entropy-aware scaling method to adaptively recover the conditional semantic guidance. For the training stage, we propose the entropy-aware optimization objectives to alleviate the overconfident prediction for noisy data. On ImageNet1000 256x256, with our proposed sampling scheme and trained classifier, the pretrained conditional and unconditional DDPM model can achieve 10.89% (4.59 to 4.09) and 43.5% (12 to 6.78) FID improvement, respectively. Code is available at https://github.com/ZGCTroy/ED-DPM.

title: Guangming Wang, Yunzhe Hu, Zhe Liu, Yiyang Zhou, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Wei Zhan, Hesheng Wang
title_en: Guangming Wang, Yunzhe Hu, Zhe Liu, Yiyang Zhou, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Wei Zhan, Hesheng Wang
abstract: 从点云中估计三维场景流是计算机视觉中的低层次三维运动感知任务。流嵌入是场景流估计中常用的技术,它编码了连续两帧之间点的运动。因此,流嵌入需要准确捕捉运动的整体方向。然而,先前的工作仅在局部范围内搜索以确定软对应关系,忽略了那些实际匹配的远距离点。此外,估计的对应关系通常来自相邻点云的前向方向,可能与从后向方向获得的估计对应关系不一致。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新颖的全对全流嵌入层,在初始场景流估计过程中引入反向可靠性验证。此外,我们研究并比较了三维场景流网络关键组件中的几种设计选择,包括点相似度计算、预测器输入元素以及预测器与优化层级设计。在仔细选择最有效设计后,我们提出了一个在FlyingThings3D和KITTI Scene Flow数据集上达到最先进性能的模型。我们的模型在FlyingThings3D数据集上以EPE3D指标超越所有现有方法至少38.2%,在KITTI Scene Flow数据集上超越至少24.7%。我们的代码已发布在https://github.com/IRMVLab/3DFlow。
abstract_en: 3D scene flow estimation from point clouds is a low-level 3D motion perception task in computer vision. Flow embedding is a commonly used technique in scene flow estimation, and it encodes the point motion between two consecutive frames. Thus, it is critical for the flow embeddings to capture the correct overall direction of the motion. However, previous works only search locally to determine a soft correspondence, ignoring the distant points that turn out to be the actual matching ones. In addition, the estimated correspondence is usually from the forward direction of the adjacent point clouds, and may not be consistent with the estimated correspondence acquired from the backward direction. To tackle these problems, we propose a novel all-to-all flow embedding layer with backward reliability validation during the initial scene flow estimation. Besides, we investigate and compare several design choices in key components of the 3D scene flow network, including the point similarity calculation, input elements of predictor, and predictor & refinement level design. After carefully choosing the most effective designs, we are able to present a model that achieves the state-of-the-art performance on FlyingThings3D and KITTI Scene Flow datasets. Our proposed model surpasses all existing methods by at least 38.2% on FlyingThings3D dataset and 24.7% on KITTI Scene Flow dataset for EPE3D metric. We release our codes at https://github.com/IRMVLab/3DFlow.

title: Guangsheng Shi, Ruifeng Li, Chao Ma
title_en: Guangsheng Shi, Ruifeng Li, Chao Ma
abstract: 实时且高性能的三维目标检测对自动驾驶至关重要。近期表现最佳的三维目标检测器主要依赖于基于点的或三维体素的卷积操作,这两种方法在车载部署中计算效率均较低。相比之下,基于柱体的方法仅使用二维卷积,计算资源消耗较少,但其检测精度远低于基于体素的方法。本文通过分析柱体与体素方法之间的主要性能差距,提出了一种实时且高性能的柱体方法检测器PillarNet。所提出的PillarNet包含一个强大的编码器网络用于有效学习柱体特征,一个颈部网络用于空间-语义特征融合以及常用的检测头。仅使用二维卷积,PillarNet可灵活适配可选的柱体尺寸,并兼容经典二维CNN主干网络,如VGGNet和ResNet。此外,PillarNet受益于我们设计的解耦方向IoU回归损失以及IoU感知预测分支。在大规模nuScenes数据集和Waymo开放数据集上的大量实验结果表明,所提出的PillarNet在有效性与效率方面均优于现有最先进的三维检测器。
abstract_en: Real-time and high-performance 3D object detection is of critical importance for autonomous driving. Recent top-performing 3D object detectors mainly rely on point-based or 3D voxel-based convolutions, which are both computationally inefficient for onboard deployment. In contrast, pillar-based methods use solely 2D convolutions, which consume less computation resources, but they lag far behind their voxel-based counterparts in detection accuracy. In this paper, by examining the primary performance gap between pillar- and voxel-based detectors, we develop a real-time and high-performance pillar-based detector, dubbed PillarNet. The proposed PillarNet consists of a powerful encoder network for effective pillar feature learning, a neck network for spatial-semantic feature fusion and the commonly used detect head. Using only 2D convolutions, PillarNet is flexible to an optional pillar size and compatible with classical 2D CNN backbones, such as VGGNet and ResNet. Additionally, PillarNet benefits from our designed orientation-decoupled IoU regression loss along with the IoU-aware prediction branch. Extensive experimental results on large-scale nuScenes Dataset and Waymo Open Dataset demonstrate that the proposed PillarNet performs well over the state-of-the-art 3D detectors in terms of effectiveness and efficiency.

title: Guangzhi Wang, Yangyang Guo, Yongkang Wong, Mohan Kankanhalli
title_en: Guangzhi Wang, Yangyang Guo, Yongkang Wong, Mohan Kankanhalli
abstract: 在图像中检测人-物交互(HOI)是实现高层次视觉理解的重要步骤。现有工作通常侧重于改进人类和物体检测,或交互识别。然而,由于数据集的限制,这些方法往往在检测到的物体上对频繁交互进行良好拟合,却忽略了罕见交互,这种现象在本文中被称为物体偏差问题。在本工作中,我们首次从两个方面揭示了该问题:交互分布不平衡和模型学习偏差。为克服物体偏差问题,我们提出了一种新颖的插件式对象级去偏记忆(ODM)方法,用于在检测到的物体下重新平衡交互分布。通过精心设计的读写策略,所提出的ODM方法使罕见交互实例在训练中被更频繁采样,从而缓解由交互分布不平衡引起的物体偏差。我们将该方法应用于三个先进的基线模型,并在HICO-DET和HOI-COCO数据集上进行实验。为定量研究物体偏差问题,我们倡导一种新的模型评估协议。如实验结果所示,我们的方法在基线模型上带来了稳定且显著的改进,尤其是在每个物体下的罕见交互上。此外,在常规标准评估设置下,我们的方法在两个基准测试中取得了新的最先进结果。
abstract_en: Detecting Human-Object Interaction (HOI) in images is an important step towards high-level visual comprehension. Existing work often shed light on improving either human and object detection, or interaction recognition. However, due to the limitation of datasets, these methods tend to fit well on frequent interactions conditioned on the detected objects, yet largely ignoring the rare ones, which is referred to as the object bias problem in this paper. In this work, we for the first time, uncover the problem from two aspects: unbalanced interaction distribution and biased model learning. To overcome the object bias problem, we propose a novel plug-and-play Object-wise Debiasing Memory (ODM) method for re-balancing the distribution of interactions under detected objects. Equipped with carefully designed read and write strategies, the proposed ODM allows rare interaction instances to be more frequently sampled for training, thereby alleviating the object bias induced by the unbalanced interaction distribution. We apply this method to three advanced baselines and conduct experiments on the HICO-DET and HOI-COCO datasets. To quantitatively study the object bias problem, we advocate a new protocol for evaluating model performance. As demonstrated in the experimental results, our method brings consistent and significant improvements over baselines, especially on rare interactions under each object. In addition, when evaluating under the conventional standard setting, our method achieves new state-of-the-art on the two benchmarks.

title: Guanlin Li, Guowen Xu, Han Qiu, Ruan He, Jiwei Li, Tianwei Zhang
title_en: Guanlin Li, Guowen Xu, Han Qiu, Ruan He, Jiwei Li, Tianwei Zhang
abstract: 基于深度神经网络的3D点云分类模型已被证明对对抗样本存在脆弱性,近期研究人员提出了大量新型攻击技术。鉴于其在安全性和安全性关键任务中的广泛应用,保持3D模型在对抗环境下的鲁棒性至关重要。不幸的是,现有防御方法尚不通用,难以有效缓解所有类型的攻击。本文设计了两种创新方法以提升3D点云分类模型的对抗鲁棒性。(1) 我们引入CCN,一种新型点云架构,可平滑和扰乱对抗扰动。(2) 我们提出AMS,一种新颖的数据增强策略,以自适应平衡模型可用性与鲁棒性。大量评估表明,两种技术的结合比现有防御方案为3D分类模型提供了更显著的鲁棒性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/GuanlinLee/CCNAMS获取。
abstract_en: 3D point cloud classification models based on deep neural networks were proven to be vulnerable to adversarial examples, with a quantity of novel attack techniques proposed by researchers recently. It is of paramount importance to preserve the robustness of 3D models under adversarial environments, considering their broad application in safety- and security-critical tasks. Unfortunately, existing defenses are not general enough to satisfactorily mitigate all types of attacks. In this paper, we design two innovative methodologies to improve the adversarial robustness of 3D point cloud classification models. (1) We introduce CCN, a novel point cloud architecture which can smooth and disrupt the adversarial perturbations. (2) We propose AMS, a novel data augmentation strategy to adaptively balance the model usability and robustness. Extensive evaluations indicate the integration of the two techniques provides much more robustness than existing defense solutions for 3D classification models. Our code can be found in https://github.com/GuanlinLee/CCNAMS.

title: Guannan Guo, Qi Lin, Tao Chen, Zhenghui Feng, Zheng Wang, Jianping Li
title_en: Guannan Guo, Qi Lin, Tao Chen, Zhenghui Feng, Zheng Wang, Jianping Li
abstract: 采用红光-近红外光照明的水下成像技术可以避免在白光照明下因光趋性聚集引起的海洋浮游生物丰度观测偏差,但会导致采集的灰度图像中关键色彩信息的丢失,这对后续的人机识别并不理想。本文提出了一种基于深度网络的新型视觉系统IsPlanktonCLR,用于自动着色现场海洋浮游生物图像。IsPlanktonCLR通过自定义调色板生成自引导信息,该调色板由现场浮游生物图像颜色聚类获得。借助这种自引导信息,一个并行着色模块可将输入灰度图像恢复为真实的彩色图像。此外,提出了一种新的图像着色评估指标,能够客观反映比较图像间的色彩差异性。通过与现有先进方法的实验对比,结果表明我们的方法在科学浮游生物图像数据的色彩恢复方面显著优于以往方法。
abstract_en: Underwater imaging with red-NIR light illumination can avoid phototropic aggregation-induced observational deviation of marine plankton abundance under white light illumination, but this will lead to the loss of critical color information in the collected grayscale images, which is non-preferable to subsequent human and machine recognition. We present a novel deep networks-based vision system IsPlanktonCLR for automatic colorization of in situ marine plankton images. IsPlanktonCLR uses a reference module to generate self-guidance from a customized palette, which is obtained by clustering in situ plankton image colors. With this self-guidance, a parallel colorization module restores input grayscale images into their true color counterparts. Additionally, a new metric for image colorization evaluation is proposed, which can objectively reflect the color dissimilarity between comparative images. Experiments and comparisons with state-of-the-art approaches are presented to show that our method achieves a substantial improvement over previous methods on color restoration of scientific plankton image data.

title: Guanxiong Sun, Yang Hua, Guosheng Hu, Neil Robertson
title_en: Guanxiong Sun, Yang Hua, Guosheng Hu, Neil Robertson
abstract: 近年来,单阶段检测器在图像数据上已展现出与传统两阶段检测器相当的精度和更快的速度。然而,在视频目标检测(VOD)领域,大多数现有方法仍基于两阶段检测器。此外,直接将现有VOD方法适配到单阶段检测器会引入难以承受的计算成本。本文首先分析了使用单阶段检测器进行VOD的计算瓶颈。基于分析,我们提出了一种简单而高效的框架,通过利用视频帧间的时间一致性来解决计算瓶颈,实现高效的单阶段VOD。具体而言,我们的方法包含一个位置先验网络以过滤背景区域,以及一个尺寸先验网络以跳过特定帧低层特征图上的冗余计算。我们在多种现代单阶段检测器上测试了该方法,并在ImageNet VID数据集上进行了大量实验。优秀的实验结果验证了我们方法在有效性、效率和兼容性方面的优越性。代码已开源至https://github.com/guanxiongsun/EOVOD。
abstract_en: Recently, one-stage detectors have achieved competitive accuracy and faster speed compared with traditional two-stage detectors on image data. However, in the field of video object detection (VOD), most existing VOD methods are still based on two-stage detectors. Moreover, directly adapting existing VOD methods to one-stage detectors introduces unaffordable computational costs. In this paper, we first analyse the computational bottlenecks of using one-stage detectors for VOD. Based on the analysis, we present a simple yet efficient framework to address the computational bottlenecks and achieve efficient one-stage VOD by exploiting the temporal consistency in video frames. Specifically, our method consists of a location prior network to filter out background regions and a size prior network to skip unnecessary computations on low-level feature maps for specific frames. We test our method on various modern one-stage detectors and conduct extensive experiments on the ImageNet VID dataset. Excellent experimental results demonstrate the superior effectiveness, efficiency, and compatibility of our method. The code is available at https://github.com/guanxiongsun/EOVOD.

title: Guanxiong Sun, Yang Hua, Guosheng Hu, Neil Robertson
title_en: Guanxiong Sun, Yang Hua, Guosheng Hu, Neil Robertson
abstract: 深度视频模型,例如三维卷积神经网络或视频变换器,在稀疏视频任务(即每段视频预测一个结果)中取得了显著性能。然而,当将现有深度视频模型适配到密集视频任务(即每帧预测一个结果)时面临挑战。具体而言,这些模型部署成本高昂,在处理冗余帧时效果欠佳,且难以捕捉长程时间相关性。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种时间膨胀视频变换器(TDViT),其由精心设计的时间膨胀变换器块(TDTB)组成。TDTB可高效提取时空表示,并有效缓解时间冗余的负面影响。此外,通过分层TDTB结构,我们的方法实现了指数级扩展的时间感受野,从而能够建模长程动态。在两个密集视频基准测试集(即用于视频目标检测的ImageNet VID和用于视频实例分割的YouTube VIS)上进行了大量实验。卓越的实验结果验证了我们方法在效率、有效性及兼容性方面的优势。代码已开源至https://github.com/guanxiongsun/TDViT。
abstract_en: Deep video models, for example, 3D CNNs or video transformers, have achieved promising performance on sparse video tasks, i.e., predicting one result per video. However, challenges arise when adapting existing deep video models to dense video tasks, i.e., predicting one result per frame. Specifically, these models are expensive for deployment, less effective when handling redundant frames and difficult to capture long-range temporal correlations. To overcome these issues, we propose a Temporal Dilated Video Transformer (TDViT) that consists of carefully-designed temporal dilated transformer blocks (TDTB). TDTB can efficiently extract spatiotemporal representations and effectively alleviate the negative effect of temporal redundancy. Furthermore, by using hierarchical TDTBs, our approach obtains an exponentially expanded temporal receptive field and therefore can model long-range dynamics. Extensive experiments are conducted on two different dense video benchmarks, i.e., ImageNet VID for video object detection and YouTube VIS for video instance segmentation. Excellent experimental results demonstrate the superior efficiency, effectiveness, and compatibility of our method. The code is available at https://github.com/guanxiongsun/TDViT.

title: Guha Balakrishnan, Raghudeep Gadde, Aleix Martinez, Pietro Perona
title_en: Guha Balakrishnan, Raghudeep Gadde, Aleix Martinez, Pietro Perona
abstract: 我们提出了一种方法,用于在深度生成模型的潜在空间中寻找路径,这些路径可以在保持其他特征不变的情况下,最大程度地变化一组图像特征。关键的是,与以往的遍历方法不同,我们的方法可以操控图像的任意多维特征,例如面部身份和指定区域内的像素。我们的方法具有理论依据且概念简单:通过最大化某一特征集的微分变化,同时使另一特征集的变化可忽略不计,来选择最优的遍历方向。我们证明了该问题几乎等价于瑞利商最大化问题,并基于求解广义特征值方程提供了一个闭式解。我们通过重复计算相应的最优方向(称为瑞利特征方向REDs),在潜在空间中生成适当弯曲的路径。我们在StyleGAN2和BigGAN上对方法进行了实证评估,应用于以下图像领域:人脸、客厅和ImageNet。我们展示了该方法能够控制多种多维特征:人脸身份、几何和语义属性、空间频率带、指定区域内的像素以及物体的外观和位置。我们的工作表明,潜在空间的局部几何和语义分析蕴含着丰富的研究机会。
abstract_en: We present a method for finding paths in a deep generative model’s latent space that can maximally vary one set of image features while holding others constant. Crucially, unlike past traversal approaches, ours can manipulate arbitrary multidimensional features of an image such as facial identity and pixels within a specified region. Our method is principled and conceptually simple: optimal traversal directions are chosen by maximizing differential changes to one feature set such that changes to another set are negligible. We show that this problem is nearly equivalent to one of Rayleigh quotient maximization, and provide a closed-form solution to it based on solving a generalized eigenvalue equation. We use repeated computations of the corresponding optimal directions, which we call Rayleigh EigenDirections (REDs), to generate appropriately curved paths in latent space. We empirically evaluate our method using StyleGAN2 and BigGAN on the following image domains: faces, living rooms and ImageNet. We show that our method is capable of controlling various multidimensional features: face identity, geometric and semantic attributes, spatial frequency bands, pixels within a region, and the appearance and position of an object. Our work suggests that a wealth of opportunities lies in the local analysis of the geometry and semantics of latent spaces.

title: 古尔莫·戈麦斯-特雷纳多、斯蒂芬·拉图利耶、帕布罗·梅塞霍、奥斯卡·科尔顿
title_en: Guillermo Gomez-Trenado, Stéphane Lathuilière, Pablo Mesejo, Óscar Cordón
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的面部年龄编辑架构,能够在保持原始图像中相关细节的同时产生结构修改。我们分离输入图像的风格和内容,并提出了一种新的解码器网络,该网络采用基于风格的策略,结合输入图像的风格和内容表示,同时根据目标年龄对输出进行条件化。此外,我们超越了现有的老化方法,允许用户在推理时调整输入图像中结构保留的程度。为此,我们引入了一种称为自定义结构保留(CUSP)模块的掩码机制,该机制能够区分输入图像中应保留的相关区域与无关细节的区域。该机制无需任何额外监督。最后,我们证明了我们的方法在三个数据集上优于现有方法,并展示了我们调整结构保留策略的有效性。
abstract_en: In this work, we propose a novel architecture for face age editing that can produce structural modifications while maintaining relevant details present in the original image. We disentangle the style and content of the input image and propose a new decoder network that adopts a style-based strategy to combine the style and content representations of the input image while conditioning the output on the target age. Furthermore, we go beyond existing aging methods by allowing the users to adjust the degree of structure preservation in the input image at inference time. To this aim, we introduce a masking mechanism, termed Custom Structure Preservation (CUSP) module, that distinguishes relevant regions in the input image that should be preserved from those where details are irrelevant for the task. This mechanism does not require any additional supervision. Finally, we show that our method outperforms prior art on three datasets and demonstrate the effectiveness of our strategy to adjust structure preservation.

title: Guodong Ding, Angela Yao
title_en: Guodong Ding, Angela Yao
abstract: 我们提出了一种半监督学习方法用于时序动作分割任务。该任务的目标是在长且未剪辑的程序性视频中检测和分割动作,其中只有少量视频被密集标注,而大量视频未标注。为此,我们为未标注数据提出了两种新的损失函数:动作亲和力损失和动作连续性损失。动作亲和力损失通过施加从标注集诱导的动作先验来指导未标注样本的学习。动作连续性损失强制执行动作的时间连续性,同时也提供帧级分类监督。此外,我们提出了一种自适应边界平滑(ABS)方法,以构建更粗略的动作边界,从而实现更稳健和可靠的训练。所提出的损失函数和ABS方法在三个基准数据集上进行了评估。结果表明,它们在仅使用少量标注数据(5%和10%)的情况下显著提高了动作分割性能,并且在使用50%标注数据时取得了与全监督相当的结果。此外,当将ABS方法集成到全监督学习中时,成功提升了性能。
abstract_en: We present a semi-supervised learning approach to the temporal action segmentation task. The goal of the task is to temporally detect and segment actions in long, untrimmed procedural videos, where only a small set of videos are densely labelled, and a large collection of videos are unlabelled. To this end, we propose two novel loss functions for the unlabelled data: an action affinity loss and an action continuity loss. The action affinity loss guides the unlabelled samples learning by imposing the action priors induced from the labelled set. Action continuity loss enforces the temporal continuity of actions, which also provides frame-wise classification supervision. In addition, we propose an Adaptive Boundary Smoothing (ABS) approach to build coarser action boundaries for more robust and reliable learning. The proposed loss functions and ABS were evaluated on three benchmarks. Results show that they significantly improved action segmentation performance with a low amount (5% and 10%) of labelled data and achieved comparable results to full supervision with 50% labelled data. Furthermore, ABS succeeded in boosting performance when integrated into fully-supervised learning.

title: Guodong Wang, Yunhong Wang, Jie Qin, Dongming Zhang, Xiuguo Bao, Di Huang
title_en: Guodong Wang, Yunhong Wang, Jie Qin, Dongming Zhang, Xiuguo Bao, Di Huang
abstract: 视频异常检测(VAD)是计算机视觉中的重要研究课题。受自监督学习近期进展的启发,本文通过解决一个直观但具有挑战性的预训练任务——时空拼图,来解决VAD问题,该任务被建模为多标签细粒度分类问题。我们的方法相比现有工作具有以下优势:1)时空拼图在空间和时间维度上被解耦,分别负责捕捉高度有判别性的外观特征和运动特征;2)使用全排列生成涵盖多种难度级别的丰富拼图,使网络能够区分正常与异常事件之间的细微时空差异;3)以端到端方式处理预训练任务,无需依赖任何预训练模型。我们的方法在三个公开基准测试中均优于现有最先进的方法。特别是在上海科技大学校园数据集上,结果显著优于基于重建和预测的方法。
abstract_en: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) is an important topic in computer vision. Motivated by the recent advances in self-supervised learning, this paper addresses VAD by solving an intuitive yet challenging pretext task, i.e., spatio-temporal jigsaw puzzles, which is cast as a multi-label fine-grained classification problem. Our method exhibits several advantages over existing works: 1) the spatio-temporal jigsaw puzzles are decoupled in terms of spatial and temporal dimensions, responsible for capturing highly discriminative appearance and motion features, respectively; 2) full permutations are used to provide abundant jigsaw puzzles covering various difficulty levels, allowing the network to distinguish subtle spatio-temporal differences between normal and abnormal events; and 3) the pretext task is tackled in an end-to-end manner without relying on any pre-trained models. Our method outperforms state-of-the-art counterparts on three public benchmarks. Especially on ShanghaiTech Campus, the result is superior to reconstruction and prediction-based methods by a large margin.

title: Guodong Xu, Yuenan Hou, Ziwei Liu, Chen Change Loy
title_en: Guodong Xu, Yuenan Hou, Ziwei Liu, Chen Change Loy
abstract: StyleGAN家族是用于无条件生成的最流行的生成对抗网络(GANs)之一。尽管其性能令人印象深刻,但其对存储和计算资源的高需求阻碍了其在资源受限设备上的部署。本文对从流行的StyleGAN类架构进行知识蒸馏进行了全面研究。我们的关键洞察是,StyleGAN蒸馏的主要挑战在于输出差异问题,即在相同输入潜在编码下,教师模型和学生模型会产生不同的输出。标准的知识蒸馏损失函数在此异构蒸馏场景下通常失效。我们对这种差异问题的原因和影响进行了深入分析,并发现风格模块在决定生成图像的语义信息中起着至关重要的作用。基于这一发现,我们提出了一种新颖的学生模型初始化策略,可在最大程度上确保输出一致性。为进一步增强教师模型和学生模型之间的语义一致性,我们提出了一种基于潜在方向的蒸馏损失函数,以保留潜在空间中的语义关系。大量实验验证了我们的方法在蒸馏StyleGAN2和StyleGAN3中的有效性,显著优于现有的GAN蒸馏方法。代码和模型将被发布。
abstract_en: StyleGAN family is one of the most popular Generative adversarial networks (GANs) for unconditional generation. Despite its impressive performance, its high demand on storage and computation impedes their deployment on resource-constrained devices. This paper provides a comprehensive study of distilling from the popular StyleGAN-like architecture. Our key insight is that the main challenge of StyleGAN distillation lies in the output discrepancy issue, where the teacher and student model yield different outputs given the same input latent code. Standard knowledge distillation losses typically fail under this heterogeneous distillation scenario. We conduct thorough analysis about the reasons and effects of this discrepancy issue, and identify that the style module plays a vital role in determining semantic information of generated images. Based on this finding, we propose a novel initialization strategy for the student model, which can ensure the output consistency to the maximum extent. To further enhance the semantic consistency between the teacher and student model, we present a latent-direction-based distillation loss that preserves the semantic relations in latent space. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in distilling StyleGAN2 and StyleGAN3, outperforming existing GAN distillation methods by a large margin. Code and models will be released.

title: Guohao Ying, Xin He, Bin Gao, Bo Han, Xiaowen Chu
title_en: Guohao Ying, Xin He, Bin Gao, Bo Han, Xiaowen Chu
abstract: 生成对抗网络(GANs)在图像生成任务中已被证明是成功的。然而,GAN训练本质上是不稳定的。尽管许多工作尝试通过手动修改GAN架构来稳定训练,但这需要大量专业知识。神经网络架构搜索(NAS)已成为自动搜索GANs的有吸引力的解决方案。早期的NAS-GANs仅搜索生成器以降低搜索复杂度,但导致次优的GAN。一些近期工作尝试同时搜索生成器(G)和判别器(D),但它们受到GAN训练不稳定性的困扰。为缓解这一问题,我们提出了一种基于高效两阶段进化算法的NAS框架来搜索GANs,即EAGAN。我们将G和D的搜索解耦为两个阶段:阶段1在固定D的情况下搜索G,并采用多对一训练策略;阶段2在阶段1找到的最优G基础上搜索D,并采用一对一训练和权重重置策略以增强GAN训练的稳定性。两个阶段均采用非支配排序方法,在多目标(如模型规模、Inception Score(IS)和Fréchet Inception Distance(FID))下生成Pareto前沿架构。EAGAN应用于无条件图像生成任务,并可在CIFAR-10数据集上以1.2个GPU天数高效完成搜索。我们搜索的GANs在CIFAR-10数据集上取得具有竞争力的结果(IS=8.81±0.10,FID=9.91),并在STL-10数据集上超越了先前的NAS-GANs(IS=10.44±0.087,FID=22.18)。源代码:https://github.com/marsggbo/EAGAN.
abstract_en: Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have proven successful in image generation tasks. However, GAN training is inherently unstable. Although many works try to stabilize it by manually modifying GAN architecture, it requires much expertise. Neural architecture search (NAS) has become an attractive solution to search GANs automatically. The early NAS-GANs search only generators to reduce search complexity but lead to a sub-optimal GAN. Some recent works try to search both generator (G) and discriminator (D), but they suffer from the instability of GAN training. To alleviate the instability, we propose an efficient two-stage evolutionary algorithm-based NAS framework to search GANs, namely EAGAN. We decouple the search of G and D into two stages, where stage-1 searches G with a fixed D and adopts the many-to-one training strategy, and stage-2 searches D with the optimal G found in stage-1 and adopts the one-to-one training and weight-resetting strategies to enhance the stability of GAN training. Both stages use the non-dominated sorting method to produce Pareto-front architectures under multiple objectives (e.g., model size, Inception Score (IS), and Fréchet Inception Distance (FID)). EAGAN is applied to the unconditional image generation task and can efficiently finish the search on the CIFAR-10 dataset in 1.2 GPU days. Our searched GANs achieve competitive results (IS=8.81Â±0.10, FID=9.91) on the CIFAR-10 dataset and surpass prior NAS-GANs on the STL-10 dataset (IS=10.44Â±0.087, FID=22.18). Source code: https://github.com/marsggbo/EAGAN.

title: Sun Guolei, Liu Yun, Tang Hao, Chhatkuli Ajad, Zhang Le, Van Gool Luc
title_en: Guolei Sun, Yun Liu, Hao Tang, Ajad Chhatkuli, Le Zhang, Luc Van Gool
abstract: 视频语义分割(VSS)的核心在于如何利用时序信息进行预测。以往的研究主要致力于开发新的技术来计算跨帧亲和力,如光流和注意力机制。相反,本文从不同角度出发,通过挖掘跨帧亲和力之间的关系,实现更优的时序信息聚合。我们从两个方面探索亲和力之间的关系:单尺度内在相关性和多尺度关系。受传统特征处理方法启发,我们提出单尺度亲和力精炼(SAR)和多尺度亲和力聚合(MAA)。为使MAA得以执行,我们提出选择性标记屏蔽(STM)策略,用于在计算亲和力时为不同尺度选择一组一致的参考标记,这同时也提升了方法的效率。最后,通过SAR和MAA增强的跨帧亲和力被用于自适应地聚合时序信息。实验结果表明,所提出的方法在现有最先进的VSS方法中表现优异。
abstract_en: The essence of video semantic segmentation (VSS) is how to leverage temporal information for prediction. Previous efforts are mainly devoted to developing new techniques to calculate the cross-frame affinities such as optical flow and attention. Instead, this paper contributes from a different angle by mining relations among cross-frame affinities, upon which better temporal information aggregation could be achieved. We explore relations among affinities in two aspects: single-scale intrinsic correlations and multi-scale relations. Inspired by traditional feature processing, we propose Single-scale Affinity Refinement (SAR) and Multi-scale Affinity Aggregation (MAA). To make it feasible to execute MAA, we propose a Selective Token Masking (STM) strategy to select a subset of consistent reference tokens for different scales when calculating affinities, which also improves the efficiency of our method. At last, the cross-frame affinities strengthened by SAR and MAA are adopted for adaptively aggregating temporal information. Our experiments demonstrate that the proposed method performs favorably against state-of-the-art VSS methods.

title: 贾国利,杨菊凤
title_en: Guoli Jia, Jufeng Yang
abstract: 视觉情感识别(VER)在多种应用中发挥着重要作用,近年来吸引了越来越多研究人员的关注。由于情感具有模糊性,该领域很难标注一个可靠的大规模数据集。一种替代方案是半监督学习(SSL),它通过从无标签数据中逐步选择高置信度样本来帮助优化模型。然而,直接应用现有的SSL算法在VER任务中具有挑战性。一方面,与目标识别相比,在VER任务中,对无标签数据生成的伪标签的准确性下降幅度较大。另一方面,预测中的最大概率难以达到固定阈值,导致难以利用无标签样本。这两者都会导致学习模型的性能不佳。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了S2-VER,这是首个针对VER任务的SSL算法,包含两个组件。第一个组件是可靠情感标签学习,旨在提高伪标签的准确性。具体而言,它通过计算维护的情感原型与样本嵌入之间的相似性来生成平滑标签。第二个组件是模糊感知自适应阈值策略,专门用于利用更多无标签样本。具体来说,我们的策略使用信息熵来衡量平滑标签的模糊性,然后自适应调整阈值,以选择高置信度的无标签样本。在六个公开数据集上的大量实验表明,我们提出的S2-VER在性能上优于现有最先进的方法。代码可在https://github.com/exped1230/S2-VER获取。
abstract_en: Visual emotion recognition (VER), which plays an important role in various applications, has attracted increasing attention of researchers. Due to the ambiguous characteristic of emotion, it is hard to annotate a reliable large-scale dataset in this field. An alternative solution is semi-supervised learning (SSL), which progressively selects high-confidence samples from unlabeled data to help optimize the model. However, it is challenging to directly employ existing SSL algorithms in VER task. On the one hand, compared with object recognition, in VER task, the accuracy of the produced pseudo labels for unlabeled data drops a large margin. On the other hand, the maximum probability in the prediction is difficult to reach the fixed threshold, which leads to few unlabeled samples can be leveraged. Both of them would induce the suboptimal performance of the learned model. To address these issues, we propose S2-VER, the first SSL algorithm for VER, which consists of two com- ponents. The first component, reliable emotion label learning, aims to improve the accuracy of pseudo-labels. In detail, it generates smoothing labels by computing the similarity between the maintained emotion prototypes and the embedding of the sample. The second one is ambiguity-aware adaptive threshold strategy, which is dedicated to leveraging more unlabeled samples. Specifically, our strategy uses information entropy to measure the ambiguity of the smoothing labels, then adaptively adjusts the threshold, which is adopted to select high-confidence unlabeled samples. Extensive experiments conducted on six public datasets show that our proposed S2-VER performs favorably against the state-of-the-art approaches. The code is available at https://github.com/exped1230/S2-VER.

title: 李国秋,蔡冠雄,曾星宇,赵瑞
title_en: Guoqiu Li, Guanxiong Cai, Xingyu Zeng, Rui Zhao
abstract: 近期视频异常检测(VAD)的研究进展表明,特征区分是有效区分异常事件与正常事件的关键。我们观察到许多异常事件发生在有限的局部区域,而严重的背景噪声增加了特征学习的难度。本文提出了一种尺度感知的弱监督学习方法,仅使用粗粒度的视频级标签作为监督,从背景中捕捉局部且显著的异常模式。我们通过将帧分割为非重叠的补丁,并利用我们的补丁空间关系(PSR)模块捕捉不同区域之间的不一致性来实现这一目标,该模块包含自注意力机制和空洞卷积。为了解决异常的尺度变化并增强方法的鲁棒性,进一步引入了多尺度补丁聚合方法,通过融合不同尺度补丁的特征实现从局部到全局的空间感知。考虑到时间线索的重要性,我们借助现有的视频时间关系网络,将关系建模从空间域扩展到时空域,有效编码视频中的时空动态。实验结果表明,我们的方法在UCF-Crime和ShanghaiTech基准数据集上取得了新的最先进性能。代码可在https://github.com/nutuniv/SSRL获取。
abstract_en: Recent progress in video anomaly detection (VAD) has shown that feature discrimination is the key to effectively distinguishing anomalies from normal events. We observe that many anomalous events occur in limited local regions, and the severe background noise increases the difficulty of feature learning. In this paper, we propose a scale-aware weakly supervised learning approach to capture local and salient anomalous patterns from the background, using only coarse video-level labels as supervision. We achieve this by segmenting frames into non-overlapping patches and then capturing inconsistencies among different regions through our patch spatial relation (PSR) module, which consists of self-attention mechanisms and dilated convolutions. To address the scale variation of anomalies and enhance the robustness of our method, a multi-scale patch aggregation method is further introduced to enable local-to-global spatial perception by merging features of patches with different scales. Considering the importance of temporal cues, we extend the relation modeling from the spatial domain to the spatio-temporal domain with the help of the existing video temporal relation network to effectively encode the spatio-temporal dynamics in the video. Experimental results show that our proposed method achieves new state-of-the-art performance on UCF-Crime and ShanghaiTech benchmarks. Code are available at https://github.com/nutuniv/SSRL.

title: Gur-Eyal Sela, Ionel Gog, Justin Wong, Kumar Krishna Agrawal, Xiangxi Mo, Sukrit Kalra, Peter Schafhalter, Eric Leong, Xin Wang, Bharathan Balaji, Joseph Gonzalez, Ion Stoica
title_en: Gur-Eyal Sela, Ionel Gog, Justin Wong, Kumar Krishna Agrawal, Xiangxi Mo, Sukrit Kalra, Peter Schafhalter, Eric Leong, Xin Wang, Bharathan Balaji, Joseph Gonzalez, Ion Stoica
abstract: 高效视觉方法在延迟预算下最大化准确性。这些方法通过离线方式逐张图像评估准确性。然而,实时视觉应用(如自动驾驶)在流式处理场景中运行,推理开始与结束之间地面真实数据会发生变化,导致准确性显著下降。因此,近期研究提出在流式场景中平均最大化准确性。本文提出在每个环境上下文中最大化流式准确性。我们认为场景难度影响初始(离线)准确性差异,而场景中障碍物位移会影响后续准确性下降。我们的方法Octopus利用这些场景属性,在测试时选择最大化流式准确性的配置。该方法在传统静态方法基础上将跟踪性能(S-MOTA)提升7.4%。此外,使用本方法的性能提升是在离线准确性进展基础上实现的,而非替代。
abstract_en: Efficient vision works maximize accuracy under a latency budget. These works evaluate accuracy offline, one image at a time. However, real-time vision applications like autonomous driving operate in streaming settings, where ground truth changes between inference start and finish. This results in a significant accuracy drop. Therefore, a recent work proposed to maximize accuracy in streaming settings on average. In this paper, we propose to maximize streaming accuracy for every environment context. We posit that scenario difficulty influences the initial (offline) accuracy difference, while obstacle displacement in the scene affects the subsequent accuracy degradation. Our method, Octopus, uses these scenario properties to select configurations that maximize streaming accuracy at test time. Our method improves tracking performance (S-MOTA) by 7.4% over the conventional static approach. Further, performance improvement using our method comes in addition to, and not instead of, advances in offline accuracy.

title: Gusi Te, Xiu Li, Xiao Li, Jinglu Wang, Wei Hu, Yan Lu
title_en: Gusi Te, Xiu Li, Xiao Li, Jinglu Wang, Wei Hu, Yan Lu
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的范式,从单目视频输入构建可动画化的三维人体表示,使其能够在任何未见过的姿态和视角下进行渲染。我们的方法基于一个动态神经辐射场(NeRF),该NeRF通过基于网格的参数化三维人体模型作为几何代理进行绑定。以往的方法通常依赖于多视角视频或精确的三维几何信息作为额外输入;此外,大多数方法在泛化到未见过的姿态时会出现质量下降的问题。我们发现泛化的关键在于一个良好的输入嵌入,用于查询动态NeRF:一个良好的输入嵌入应定义一个在完整体空间中的单射映射,该映射由姿态变化下的表面网格变形引导。基于这一观察,我们提出将输入查询与一组测地线最近邻顶点所定义的局部表面区域的关系进行嵌入。通过包含位置和相对距离信息,我们的嵌入定义了一个距离保持的变形映射,并能良好地泛化到未见过的姿态。为了减少对额外输入的依赖,我们首先使用现成工具初始化每帧的三维网格,然后提出一个联合优化NeRF并优化初始网格的流程。大量实验表明,我们的方法能够在未见过的姿态和视角下合成合理的三维人体渲染结果。
abstract_en: We present a novel paradigm of building an animatable 3D human representation from a monocular video input, such that it can be rendered in any unseen poses and views. Our method is based on a dynamic Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) rigged by a mesh-based parametric 3D human model serving as a geometry proxy. Previous methods usually rely on multi-view videos or accurate 3D geometry information as additional inputs; besides, most methods suffer from degraded quality when generalized to unseen poses. We identify that the key to generalization is a good input embedding for querying dynamic NeRF: A good input embedding should define an injective mapping in the full volumetric space, guided by surface mesh deformation under pose variation. Based on this observation, we propose to embed the input query with its relationship to local surface regions spanned by a set of geodesic nearest neighbors on mesh vertices. By including both position and relative distance information, our embedding defines a distance-preserved deformation mapping and generalizes well to unseen poses. To reduce the dependency on additional inputs, we first initialize per-frame 3D meshes using off-the-shelf tools and then propose a pipeline to jointly optimize NeRF and refine the initial mesh. Extensive experiments show our method can synthesize plausible human rendering results under unseen poses and views.

title: Guy Erez, Ron Shapira Weber, Oren Freifeld
title_en: Guy Erez, Ron Shapira Weber, Oren Freifeld
abstract: 在视频分析中,背景模型具有许多应用,如背景/前景分离、变化检测、异常检测、跟踪等。然而,虽然在静态摄像机拍摄的视频中学习此类模型是一个相对成熟的任务,但在移动摄像机背景模型(MCBM)的情况下,由于摄像机运动带来的算法和可扩展性挑战,其成功程度远为有限。因此,现有的MCBM在适用范围和支持的摄像机运动类型上存在局限。这些障碍也阻碍了在该无监督任务中采用基于深度学习(DL)的端到端解决方案。此外,现有的MCBM通常在通常较大的全景图像域或在线模式下建模背景。不幸的是,前者会导致多个问题,包括可扩展性差,而后者则阻止了识别和利用摄像机重新访问先前场景部分的情况。本文提出了一种名为DeepMCBM的新方法,消除了上述所有问题并实现了最先进的结果。具体而言,首先我们识别出视频帧联合对齐(特别是在深度学习设置中)所面临的困难。接下来,我们提出了一种新的联合对齐策略,使我们能够使用空间变换网络,无需正则化或任何形式的专用(且不可微分)初始化。结合基于未变形鲁棒中心矩(从联合对齐中获得)的自编码器,这产生了一种端到端、无需正则化的MCBM,支持广泛的摄像机运动并具有良好的可扩展性。我们在多种视频上展示了DeepMCBM的实用性,包括其他方法无法处理的视频。我们的代码可在https://github.com/BGU-CS-VIL/DeepMCBM获取。
abstract_en: In video analysis, background models have many applications such as background/foreground separation, change detection, anomaly detection, tracking, and more. However, while learning such a model in a video captured by a static camera is a fairly-solved task, in the case of a Moving-camera Background Model (MCBM), the success has been far more modest due to algorithmic and scalability challenges that arise due to the camera motion. Thus, existing MCBMs are limited in their scope and their supported camera-motion types. These hurdles also impeded the employment, in this unsupervised task, of end-to-end solutions based on deep learning (DL). Moreover, existing MCBMs usually model the background either on the domain of a typically-large panoramic image or in an online fashion. Unfortunately, the former creates several problems, including poor scalability, while the latter prevents the recognition and leveraging of cases where the camera revisits previously-seen parts of the scene. This paper proposes a new method, called DeepMCBM, that eliminates all the aforementioned issues and achieves state-of-the-art results. Concretely, first we identify the difficulties associated with joint alignment of video frames in general and in a DL setting in particular. Next, we propose a new strategy for joint alignment that lets us use a spatial transformer net with neither a regularization nor any form of specialized (and non-differentiable) initialization. Coupled with an autoencoder conditioned on unwarped robust central moments (obtained from the joint alignment), this yields an end-to-end regularization-free MCBM that supports a broad range of camera motions and scales gracefully. We demonstrate DeepMCBM’s utility on a variety of videos, including ones beyond the scope of other methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/BGU-CS-VIL/DeepMCBM.

title: Guy Tevet, Brian Gordon, Amir Hertz, Amit H. Bermano, Daniel Cohen-Or
title_en: Guy Tevet, Brian Gordon, Amir Hertz, Amit H. Bermano, Daniel Cohen-Or
abstract: 我们介绍了MotionCLIP,一个具有解耦、行为良好的潜在嵌入的3D人体运动自编码器,支持高度语义的文本描述。MotionCLIP通过将其潜在空间与对比语言-图像预训练(CLIP)模型对齐,获得了其独特的功能。将人体运动流形对齐到CLIP空间,隐式地将CLIP的极其丰富的语义知识注入到流形中。特别是,它通过将语义相似的运动放置在彼此附近来帮助连续性,并通过继承CLIP空间结构来实现解耦。MotionCLIP包括一个基于Transformer的运动自编码器,训练以在与文本标签在CLIP空间中的位置对齐的同时重建运动。我们进一步利用CLIP的独特视觉理解,并通过以自监督的方式将运动对齐到渲染帧来注入更强的信号。我们表明,尽管CLIP从未见过运动领域,MotionCLIP提供了前所未有的文本到运动能力,允许跨域动作、解耦编辑和抽象语言规范。例如,文本提示“沙发”被解码为坐下动作,由于语言相似性,而提示“蜘蛛侠”导致类似于荡绳的解决方案,这在训练期间远未见过。此外,我们展示了如何利用引入的潜在空间进行运动插值、编辑和识别。
abstract_en: We introduce MotionCLIP, a 3D human motion auto-encoder featuring a latent embedding that is disentangled, well behaved, and supports highly semantic textual descriptions. MotionCLIP gains its unique power by aligning its latent space with that of the Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) model. Aligning the human motion manifold to CLIP space implicitly infuses the extremely rich semantic knowledge of CLIP into the manifold. In particular, it helps continuity by placing semantically similar motions close to one another, and disentanglement, which is inherited from the CLIP-space structure. MotionCLIP comprises a transformer-based motion auto-encoder, trained to reconstruct motion while being aligned to its text label’s position in CLIP-space. We further leverage CLIP’s unique visual understanding and inject an even stronger signal through aligning motion to rendered frames in a self-supervised manner. We show that although CLIP has never seen the motion domain, MotionCLIP offers unprecedented text-to-motion abilities, allowing out-of-domain actions, disentangled editing, and abstract language specification. For example, the text prompt “couch” is decoded into a sitting down motion, due to lingual similarity, and the prompt “Spiderman” results in a web-swinging-like solution that is far from seen during training. In addition, we show how the introduced latent space can be leveraged for motion interpolation, editing and recognition.

title: Gwangtak Bae, Byungjun Kim, Seongyong Ahn, Jihong Min, Inwook Shim
title_en: Gwangtak Bae, Byungjun Kim, Seongyong Ahn, Jihong Min, Inwook Shim
abstract: 激光雷达被广泛用于捕捉精确的三维户外场景结构。然而,在下雪天气中,激光雷达会产生大量不需要的噪声点,这会阻碍对有意义的三维场景结构的分析。使用带有雪标签的语义分割可以作为去除这些噪声点的直接解决方案,但需要繁琐的逐点标注。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的自监督学习框架,用于去除激光雷达点云中的雪点。我们的方法利用了噪声点的结构特征:与邻近点的空间相关性较低。我们的方法包含两个深度神经网络:点重建网络(PR-Net)从邻近点重建每个点;重建难度网络(RD-Net)预测PR-Net重建的逐点难度,我们称之为重建难度。通过简单的后处理,我们的方法无需任何标签即可有效检测雪点。我们的方法在无需标签的方法中达到了最先进水平,并且与全监督方法相当。此外,我们证明了我们的方法可以作为预训练任务,提高去雪监督训练的标签效率。
abstract_en: LiDAR is widely used to capture accurate 3D outdoor scene structures. However, LiDAR produces many undesirable noise points in snowy weather, which hamper analyzing meaningful 3D scene structures. Semantic segmentation with snow labels would be a straightforward solution for removing them, but it requires laborious point-wise annotation. To address this problem, we propose a novel self-supervised learning framework for snow points removal in LiDAR point clouds. Our method exploits the structural characteristic of the noise points: low spatial correlation with their neighbors. Our method consists of two deep neural networks: Point Reconstruction Network (PR-Net) reconstructs each point from its neighbors; Reconstruction Difficulty Network (RD-Net) predicts point-wise difficulty of the reconstruction by PR-Net, which we call reconstruction difficulty. With simple post-processing, our method effectively detects snow points without any label. Our method achieves the state-of-the-art performance among label-free approaches and is comparable to the fully-supervised method. Moreover, we demonstrate that our method can be exploited as a pretext task to improve label-efficiency of supervised training of de-snowing.

title: Gyeongsik Moon, Hyeongjin Nam, Takaaki Shiratori, Kyoung Mu Lee
title_en: Gyeongsik Moon, Hyeongjin Nam, Takaaki Shiratori, Kyoung Mu Lee
abstract: 尽管在三维着装人体重建领域已取得显著进展,但现有方法大多无法从包含多样人体姿态和外观的真实场景图像中生成鲁棒的结果。这主要是由于训练数据集与真实场景数据集之间存在较大的领域差距。训练数据集通常为合成数据集,包含从地面真值三维扫描中渲染的图像。然而,此类数据集相比真实场景数据集,包含更简单的人体姿态和更不自然的图像外观,这使得将其泛化到真实场景图像极具挑战性。为解决这一问题,本文提出ClothWild,一个面向真实场景图像的三维着装人体重建框架。首先,为增强领域差距的鲁棒性,我们提出一种弱监督流程,可通过真实场景数据集的二维监督目标进行训练。其次,我们设计基于DensePose的损失函数以降低弱监督的歧义性。在多个公开真实场景数据集上的广泛实证测试表明,所提出的ClothWild方法在准确性和鲁棒性方面均显著优于现有最先进的方法。代码已开源:https://github.com/hygenie1228/ClothWild_RELEASE
abstract_en: Although much progress has been made in 3D clothed human reconstruction, most of the existing methods fail to produce robust results from in-the-wild images, which contain diverse human poses and appearances. This is mainly due to the large domain gap between training datasets and in-the-wild datasets. The training datasets are usually synthetic ones, which contain rendered images from GT 3D scans. However, such datasets contain simple human poses and less natural image appearances compared to those of real in-the-wild datasets, which makes generalization of it to in-the-wild images extremely challenging. To resolve this issue, in this work, we propose ClothWild, a 3D clothed human reconstruction framework that firstly addresses the robustness on in-thewild images. First, for the robustness to the domain gap, we propose a weakly supervised pipeline that is trainable with 2D supervision targets of in-the-wild datasets. Second, we design a DensePose-based loss function to reduce ambiguities of the weak supervision. Extensive empirical tests on several public in-the-wild datasets demonstrate that our proposed ClothWild produces much more accurate and robust results than the state-of-the-art methods. The codes are available in here: https://github.com/hygenie1228/ClothWild_RELEASE.

title: Hadi M. Dolatabadi, Sarah Erfani, Christopher Leckie
title_en: Hadi M. Dolatabadi, Sarah Erfani, Christopher Leckie
abstract: 神经网络容易受到对抗攻击的影响:在输入中添加精心设计的、难以察觉的扰动可以改变其输出。对抗训练是训练鲁棒模型以抵御此类攻击最有效的方法之一。然而,与普通神经网络训练相比,对抗训练要慢得多,因为它需要在每次迭代中为整个训练数据集构建对抗样本,这限制了其有效性。最近提出的快速对抗训练(Fast Adversarial Training, FAT)能够高效地获得鲁棒模型。然而,其成功的原因尚未完全理解,更重要的是,它只能训练针对$\ell_\infty$-受限攻击的鲁棒模型,因为它在训练过程中使用FGSM。在本文中,通过利用核心集选择理论,我们展示了如何通过选择训练数据的小子集,提供一种通用且更原则性的方法来降低鲁棒训练的时间复杂度。与现有方法不同,我们的方法可以适应多种训练目标,包括TRADES、$\ell_p$-PGD和感知对抗训练(Perceptual Adversarial Training, PAT)。实验结果表明,我们的方法将对抗训练速度提升了2-3倍,同时清洁准确率和鲁棒准确率略有下降。
abstract_en: Neural networks are vulnerable to adversarial attacks: adding well-crafted, imperceptible perturbations to their input can modify their output. Adversarial training is one of the most effective approaches in training robust models against such attacks. However, it is much slower than vanilla training of neural networks since it needs to construct adversarial examples for the entire training data at every iteration, hampering its effectiveness. Recently, Fast Adversarial Training (FAT) was proposed that can obtain robust models efficiently. However, the reasons behind its success are not fully understood, and more importantly, it can only train robust models for $\ell_\infty$-bounded attacks as it uses FGSM during training. In this paper, by leveraging the theory of coreset selection, we show how selecting a small subset of training data provides a general, more principled approach toward reducing the time complexity of robust training. Unlike existing methods, our approach can be adapted to a wide variety of training objectives, including TRADES, $\ell_p$-PGD, and Perceptual Adversarial Training (PAT). Our experimental results indicate that our approach speeds up adversarial training by 2-3 times while experiencing a slight reduction in the clean and robust accuracy.

title: Haifeng Xia, Pu Wang, Zhengming Ding
title_en: Haifeng Xia, Pu Wang, Zhengming Ding
abstract: 无监督域适应(UDA)假设两个域均来自同一传感器(例如RGB或深度图像),通过借用标注良好的源域知识来解决目标域上未标注的特定任务。为提升模型性能,新型设备(如自动驾驶汽车)部署了多种传感器以获取更丰富的信息。然而,使用多视角数据训练的模型难以与仅配备单传感器的传统设备兼容。这种场景被称为不完整多视角域适应(IMVDA),其假设源域包含多视角数据,而目标域仅包含单视角实例。为应对这一实际需求,本文提出了一种新颖的通道增强与知识迁移(CEKT)框架,包含两个模块。具体而言,源域通道增强模块区分视角共性与视角特异性通道,并通过探索通道相似性来放大重要通道的表征。此外,自适应知识迁移模块尝试通过隐式缺失视角恢复和自适应跨域对齐,增强目标域向多视角语义的表征。大量实验结果验证了我们方法在解决IMVDA挑战中的有效性。
abstract_en: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) borrows well-labeled source knowledge to solve the specific task on unlabeled target domain with the assumption that both domains are from a single sensor, e.g., RGB or depth images. To boost model performance, multiple sensors are deployed on new-produced devices like autonomous vehicles to benefit from enriched information. However, the model trained with multi-view data difficultly becomes compatible with conventional devices only with a single sensor. This scenario is defined as incomplete multi-view domain adaptation (IMVDA), which considers that the source domain consists of multi-view data while the target domain only includes single-view instances. To overcome this practical demand, this paper proposes a novel Channel Enhancement and Knowledge Transfer (CEKT) framework with two modules. Concretely, the source channel enhancement module distinguishes view-common from view-specific channels and explores channel similarity to magnify the representation of important channels. Moreover, the adaptive knowledge transfer module attempts to enhance target representation towards multi-view semantic through implicit missing view recovery and adaptive cross-domain alignment. Extensive experimental results illustrate the effectiveness of our method in solving the IMVDA challenge.

title: Haimei Zhao, Jing Zhang, Sen Zhang, Dacheng Tao
title_en: Haimei Zhao, Jing Zhang, Sen Zhang, Dacheng Tao
abstract: Depth estimation, visual odometry (VO), and bird’s-eye-view (BEV) scene layout estimation present three critical tasks for driving scene perception, which is fundamental for motion planning and navigation in autonomous driving. Though they are complementary to each other, prior works usually focus on each individual task and rarely deal with all three tasks together. A naive way is to accomplish them independently in a sequential or parallel manner, but there are three drawbacks, i.e., 1) the depth and VO results suffer from the inherent scale ambiguity issue; 2) the BEV layout is usually estimated separately for roads and vehicles, while the explicit overlay-underlay relations between them are ignored; and 3) the BEV layout is directly predicted from the front-view image without using any depth-related information, although the depth map contains useful geometry clues for inferring scene layouts. In this paper, we address these issues by proposing a novel joint perception framework named JPerceiver, which can simultaneously estimate scale-aware depth and VO as well as BEV layout from a monocular video sequence. It exploits the cross-view geometric transformation (CGT) to propagate the absolute scale from the road layout to depth and VO based on a carefully-designed scale loss. Meanwhile, a cross-view and cross-modal transfer (CCT) module is devised to leverage the depth clues for reasoning road and vehicle layout through an attention mechanism. JPerceiver can be trained in an end-to-end multi-task learning way, where the CGT scale loss and CCT module promote inter-task knowledge transfer to benefit feature learning of each task. Experiments on Argoverse, Nuscenes and KITTI show the superiority of JPerceiver over existing methods on all the above three tasks in terms of accuracy, model size, and inference speed. The code and models are available at \href{https://github.com/sunnyHelen/JPerceiver}{https://github.com/sunnyHelen/JPerceiver}.

title: Haina Qin, Longfei Han, Juan Wang, Congxuan Zhang, Yanwei Li, Bing Li, Weiming Hu
title_en: Haina Qin, Longfei Han, Juan Wang, Congxuan Zhang, Yanwei Li, Bing Li, Weiming Hu
abstract: 在成像传感器与图像应用之间,硬件图像信号处理(ISP)流水线通过传感器信号重建RGB图像并将其输入下游任务。ISP中的处理模块依赖一组可调超参数,这些参数与输出之间存在复杂的相互作用。传统上由图像专家手动设置超参数,但这种方法耗时且偏向人类感知。近年来,基于不同优化算法的下游任务反馈被用于优化ISP。不幸的是,这些方法在推理阶段需保持参数固定,无法针对每张图像的特征进行特定参数调整。为此,我们提出了一种注意力感知学习方法,将参数预测网络集成到ISP调优中,并利用多注意力机制在输入RAW图像与参数空间之间生成注意力映射。所提方法端到端整合下游任务,在考虑下游任务反馈的同时,为每张图像预测特定参数。我们在目标检测、图像分割和人眼观看任务中验证了该方法。在这些应用中,我们的方法优于现有优化方法和专家调优。
abstract_en: Between the imaging sensor and the image applications, the hardware image signal processing (ISP) pipelines reconstruct an RGB image from the sensor signal and feed it into downstream tasks. The processing blocks in ISPs depend on a set of tunable hyperparameters that have a complex interaction with the output. Manual setting by image experts is the traditional way of hyperparameter tuning, which is time-consuming and biased towards human perception. Recently, ISP has been optimized by the feedback of the downstream tasks based on different optimization algorithms. Unfortunately, these methods should keep parameters fixed during the inference stage for arbitrary input without considering that each image should have specific parameters based on its feature. To this end, we propose an attention-aware learning method that integrates the parameter prediction network into ISP tuning and utilizes the multi-attention mechanism to generate the attentive mapping between the input RAW image and the parameter space. The proposed method integrates downstream tasks end-to-end, predicting specific parameters for each image while considering feedback from downstream tasks. We validate the proposed method on object detection, image segmentation, and human viewing tasks. In these applications, our method outperforms the existing optimization methods and expert tuning.

title: Haipeng Xiong, Angela Yao
title_en: Haipeng Xiong, Angela Yao
abstract: 局部计数,即局部区域内物体的数量,本质上是一个连续值。然而,近期最先进的方法表明,将计数任务建模为分类问题比回归方法表现更优。通过在精心设计的合成数据上进行一系列实验,我们证明这一反直觉结果是由不精确的局部计数真实值引起的。诸如偏倚点标注和错误匹配的高斯核函数等生成真实值的因子,会引入与真实局部计数的偏差。标准连续回归对这些误差高度敏感,解释了分类与回归方法之间性能差距的原因。为降低敏感性,我们将回归建模从连续尺度放宽为离散排序,并提出了一种新颖的离散约束(DC)回归方法。在三个公开数据集上,DC回归在人群计数任务中比分类和标准回归方法更准确。类似的优势也适用于年龄估计任务,验证了DC回归的整体有效性。代码可在 https://github.com/xhp-hust-2018-2011/dcreg 获取。
abstract_en: Local counts, or the number of objects in a local area, is a continuous value by nature. Yet recent state-of-the-art methods show that formulating counting as a classification task performs better than regression. Through a series of experiments on carefully controlled synthetic data, we show that this counter-intuitive result is caused by imprecise ground truth local counts. Factors such as biased dot annotations and incorrectly matched Gaussian kernels used to generate ground truth counts introduce deviations from the true local counts. Standard continuous regression is highly sensitive to these errors, explaining the performance gap between classification and regression. To mitigate the sensitivity, we loosen the regression formulation from a continuous scale to a discrete ordering and propose a novel discrete-constrained (DC) regression. Applied to crowd counting, DC-regression is more accurate than both classification and standard regression on three public benchmarks. A similar advantage also holds for the age estimation task, verifying the overall effectiveness of DC-regression. Code is available at https://github.com/xhp-hust-2018-2011/dcreg.

title: Haitian Zeng, Xin Yu, Jiaxu Miao, Yi Yang
title_en: Haitian Zeng, Xin Yu, Jiaxu Miao, Yi Yang
abstract: 我们提出了一种名为MHR-Net的新方法,用于从运动中恢复非刚性形状(NRSfM)。MHR-Net旨在为二维视图找到一组合理的重建结果,并从该组中选择最可能的重建结果。为了解决非刚性形状无监督生成的挑战,我们在MHR-Net中开发了一种新的确定性基与随机变形方案。非刚性形状首先表示为粗略形状基与灵活形状变形的和,然后通过变形部分的不确定性建模生成多个假设。MHR-Net在基和最佳假设的基础上优化重投影损失。此外,我们设计了一种新的普罗克鲁斯特斯残差损失,该损失减少了相似形状之间的刚性旋转,进一步提升了性能。实验表明,MHR-Net在Human3.6M、SURREAL和300-VW数据集上实现了最先进的重建精度。
abstract_en: We propose MHR-Net, a novel method for recovering Non-Rigid Shapes from Motion (NRSfM). MHR-Net aims to find a set of reasonable reconstructions for a 2D view, and it also selects the most likely reconstruction from the set. To deal with the challenging unsupervised generation of non-rigid shapes, we develop a new Deterministic Basis and Stochastic Deformation scheme in MHR-Net. The non-rigid shape is first expressed as the sum of a coarse shape basis and a flexible shape deformation, then multiple hypotheses are generated with uncertainty modeling of the deformation part. MHR-Net is optimized with reprojection loss on the basis and the best hypothesis. Furthermore, we design a new Procrustean Residual Loss, which reduces the rigid rotations between similar shapes and further improves the performance. Experiments show that MHR-Net achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction accuracy on Human3.6M, SURREAL and 300-VW datasets.

title: Haitian Zheng, Zhe Lin, Jingwan Lu, Scott Cohen, Eli Shechtman, Connelly Barnes, Jianming Zhang, Ning Xu, Sohrab Amirghodsi, Jiebo Luo
title_en: Haitian Zheng, Zhe Lin, Jingwan Lu, Scott Cohen, Eli Shechtman, Connelly Barnes, Jianming Zhang, Ning Xu, Sohrab Amirghodsi, Jiebo Luo
abstract: 近年来,图像修复方法取得了显著进展,但在处理复杂图像中的大孔洞时,往往难以生成合理的图像结构。这在一定程度上是由于缺乏能够同时捕捉图像长程依赖关系和高层语义的有效网络结构。我们提出了一种级联调制生成对抗网络(CM-GAN),这是一种新的网络设计,包括一个使用傅里叶卷积块的编码器,可以从带有孔洞的输入图像中提取多尺度特征表示,以及一个双流解码器,每个尺度级别都包含一个新颖的级联全局-空间调制块。在每个解码器块中,首先应用全局调制以进行粗粒度和语义感知的结构合成,随后通过空间调制进一步以空间自适应的方式调整特征图。此外,我们设计了一种对象感知的训练方案,以防止网络在孔洞中生成新对象,满足现实场景中对象移除任务的需求。进行了大量实验,结果表明我们的方法在定量和定性评估中均显著优于现有方法。请参考项目页面:https://github.com/htzheng/CM-GAN-Inpainting.
abstract_en: Recent image inpainting methods have made great progress but often struggle to generate plausible image structures when dealing with large holes in complex images. This is partially due to the lack of effective network structures that can capture both the long-range dependency and high-level semantics of an image. We propose cascaded modulation GAN (CM-GAN), a new network design consisting of an encoder with Fourier convolution blocks that extract multi-scale feature representations from the input image with holes and a dual-stream decoder with a novel cascaded global-spatial modulation block at each scale level. In each decoder block, global modulation is first applied to perform coarse and semantic-aware structure synthesis, followed by spatial modulation to further adjust the feature map in a spatially adaptive fashion. In addition, we design an object-aware training scheme to prevent the network from hallucinating new objects inside holes, fulfilling the needs of object removal tasks in real-world scenarios. Extensive experiments are conducted to show that our method significantly outperforms existing methods in both quantitative and qualitative evaluation. Please refer to the project page: https://github.com/htzheng/CM-GAN-Inpainting.

title: Haiwen Feng, Timo Bolkart, Joachim Tesch, Michael J. Black, Victoria Abrevaya
title_en: Haiwen Feng, Timo Bolkart, Joachim Tesch, Michael J. Black, Victoria Abrevaya
abstract: 虚拟面部化身将在沉浸式通信、游戏和元宇宙中发挥越来越重要的作用,因此确保其包容性至关重要。这要求无论年龄、性别或种族如何,都能准确恢复反照率。尽管在估计三维面部几何方面取得了显著进展,但外观估计却较少受到关注。该任务本质上具有歧义性,因为观察到的颜色是反照率和光照的函数,而这两者都是未知的。我们发现,当前方法由于(1)强烈偏见的先验知识倾向于偏好较浅的色素和(2)算法解决方案忽视了光照/反照率的歧义性,而偏向于浅肤色。为了解决这一问题,我们提出一个新的评估数据集(FAIR)和一个算法(TRUST)以改进反照率估计,从而提高公平性。具体而言,我们创建了首个面部反照率评估基准,其中受试者在肤色上保持平衡,并使用个体类型角(ITA)度量来衡量准确性。随后,我们通过一个关键观察来解决光照/反照率的歧义性:与裁剪后的面部图像相比,场景的完整图像包含有关光照的重要信息,可用于消除歧义。TRUST通过结合面部区域和从场景图像中获得的全局光照信号来回归面部反照率。我们的实验结果表明,与最先进的方法相比,在反照率估计的准确性和公平性方面均取得了显著改进。评估基准和代码可用于研究目的,网址为 https://trust.is.tue.mpg.de。
abstract_en: Virtual facial avatars will play an increasingly important role in immersive communication, games and the metaverse, and it is therefore critical that they be inclusive. This requires accurate recovery of the albedo, regardless of age, sex, or ethnicity. While significant progress has been made on estimating 3D facial geometry, appearance estimation has received less attention. The task is fundamentally ambiguous because the observed color is a function of albedo and lighting, both of which are unknown. We find that current methods are biased towards light skin tones due to (1) strongly biased priors that prefer lighter pigmentation and (2) algorithmic solutions that disregard the light/albedo ambiguity. To address this, we propose a new evaluation dataset (FAIR) and an algorithm (TRUST) to improve albedo estimation and, hence, fairness. Specifically, we create the first facial albedo evaluation benchmark where subjects are balanced in terms of skin color, and measure accuracy using the Individual Typology Angle (ITA) metric. We then address the light/albedo ambiguity by building on a key observation: the image of the full scene -as opposed to a cropped image of the face- contains important information about lighting that can be used for disambiguation. TRUST regresses facial albedo by conditioning on both the face region and a global illumination signal obtained from the scene image. Our experimental results show significant improvement compared to state-of-the-art methods on albedo estimation, both in terms of accuracy and fairness. The evaluation benchmark and code are available for research purposes at https://trust.is.tue.mpg.de.

title: Haixin Wang, Lu Zhou, Yingying Chen, Ming Tang, Jinqiao Wang
title_en: Haixin Wang, Lu Zhou, Yingying Chen, Ming Tang, Jinqiao Wang
abstract: 基于嵌入的方法(如关联嵌入)在自下而上的人体姿态估计中广泛应用。该框架下的方法通过预测的身份嵌入将候选关键点分组。然而,在某些复杂场景(如拥挤场景或图像中实例数量较多时),不同实例的身份嵌入可能具有线性不可分性。为减少该现象对关键点分组的影响,我们尝试为每个关键点学习稀疏多维嵌入。我们观察到嵌入的不同维度高度线性相关。为解决这一问题,我们在训练阶段对嵌入施加额外约束。基于实例尺度通常存在显著变化的事实,我们利用实例尺度对嵌入进行正则化,有效降低了嵌入的线性相关性并使其变得稀疏。我们在CrowdPose Test和COCO Test-dev上评估了我们的模型。与原始关联嵌入相比,我们的方法在关键点分组上表现出显著优势,尤其是在实例数量较多的拥挤场景中。此外,我们的方法在CrowdPose Test上达到74.5 AP的最先进结果,在COCO Test-dev上达到72.8 AP,优于其他自下而上方法。我们的代码和预训练模型可在https://github.com/CR320/CoupledEmbedding获取。
abstract_en: The embedding-based method such as Associative Embedding is popular in bottom-up human pose estimation. Methods under this framework group candidate keypoints according to the predicted identity embeddings. However, the identity embeddings of different instances are likely to be linearly inseparable in some complex scenes, such as crowded scene or when the number of instances in the image is large. To reduce the impact of this phenomenon on keypoint grouping, we try to learn a sparse multidimensional embedding for each keypoint. We observe that the different dimensions of embeddings are highly linearly correlated. To address this issue, we impose an additional constraint on the embeddings during training phase. Based on the fact that the scales of instances usually have significant variations, we uilize the scales of instances to regularize the embeddings, which effectively reduces the linear correlation of embeddings and makes embeddings being sparse. We evaluate our model on CrowdPose Test and COCO Test-dev. Compared to vanilla Associative Embedding, our method has an impressive superiority in keypoint grouping, especially in crowded scenes with a large number of instances. Furthermore, our method achieves state-of-the-art results on CrowdPose Test (74.5 AP) and COCO Test-dev (72.8 AP), outperforming other bottom-up methods. Our code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/CR320/CoupledEmbedding.

title: Haiyang Liu, Zihao Zhu, Naoya Iwamoto, Yichen Peng, Zhengqing Li, You Zhou, Elif Bozkurt, Bo Zheng
title_en: Haiyang Liu, Zihao Zhu, Naoya Iwamoto, Yichen Peng, Zhengqing Li, You Zhou, Elif Bozkurt, Bo Zheng
abstract: Achieving realistic, vivid, and human-like synthesized conversational gestures conditioned on multi-modal data is still an unsolved problem due to the lack of available datasets, models and standard evaluation metrics. To address this, we build Body-Expression-Audio-Text dataset, BEAT, which has i) 76 hours, high-quality, multi-modal data captured from 30 speakers talking with eight different emotions and in four different languages, ii) 32 millions frame-level emotion and semantic relevance annotations. Our statistical analysis on BEAT demonstrates the correlation of conversational gestures with facial expressions, emotions, and semantics, in addition to the known correlation with audio, text, and speaker identity. Based on this observation, we propose a baseline model, Cascaded Motion Network (CaMN), which consists of above six modalities modeled in a cascaded architecture for gesture synthesis. To evaluate the semantic relevancy, we introduce a metric, Semantic Relevance Gesture Recall (SRGR). Qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate metrics’ validness, ground truth data quality, and baseline’s state-of-the-art performance. To the best of our knowledge, BEAT is the largest motion capture dataset for investigating human gestures, which may contribute to a number of different research fields, including controllable gesture synthesis, cross-modality analysis, and emotional gesture recognition. The data, code and model are available on https://pantomatrix.github.io/BEAT/

title: Haiyang Yang, Shixiang Tang, Meilin Chen, Yizhou Wang, Feng Zhu, Lei Bai, Rui Zhao, Wanli Ouyang
title_en: Haiyang Yang, Shixiang Tang, Meilin Chen, Yizhou Wang, Feng Zhu, Lei Bai, Rui Zhao, Wanli Ouyang
abstract: 在显著不同的视觉领域中泛化学习到的表示是人类视觉系统的基本且关键能力。尽管近期的自监督学习方法在训练集与评估集同域时表现出色,但当在不同领域进行测试时会出现不理想的性能下降。因此,提出了多领域自监督学习任务,旨在学习领域不变特征,这些特征不仅适用于训练集同域的评估,还能泛化到未见过的领域。本文提出了一种用于多领域自监督学习的领域不变掩码自编码器(DiMAE),设计了一种新的预设任务,即跨域重建任务,以学习领域不变特征。其核心思想是通过添加来自不同领域的风格噪声来增强输入图像,然后从增强图像的嵌入中重建图像,从而规范编码器学习领域不变特征。为实现该思想,DiMAE包含两个关键设计:1)内容保持的风格混合,以参数无关的方式向输入添加其他领域的风格信息并保持内容;2)多个领域特定解码器,用于将编码的领域不变特征重建为输入对应的领域风格。在PACS和DomainNet上的实验表明,DiMAE相比近期最先进的方法取得了显著提升。
abstract_en: Generalizing learned representations across significantly different visual domains is a fundamental yet crucial ability of the human visual system. While recent self-supervised learning methods have achieved good performances with evaluation set on the same domain as the training set, they will have an undesirable performance decrease when tested on a different domain. Therefore, the self-supervised learning from multiple domains task is proposed to learn domain-invariant features that are not only suitable for evaluation on the same domain as the training set, but also can be generalized to unseen domains. In this paper, we propose a Domain-invariant Masked AutoEncoder (DiMAE) for self-supervised learning from multi-domains, which designs a new pretext task, i.e., the cross-domain reconstruction task, to learn domain-invariant features. The core idea is to augment the input image with style noise from different domains and then reconstruct the image from the embedding of the augmented image, regularizing the encoder to learn domain-invariant features. To accomplish the idea, DiMAE contains two critical designs, 1) content-preserved style mix, which adds style information from other domains to input while persevering the content in a parameter-free manner, and 2) multiple domain-specific decoders, which recovers the corresponding domain style of input to the encoded domain-invariant features for reconstruction. Experiments on PACS and DomainNet illustrate that DiMAE achieves considerable gains compared with recent state-of-the-art methods.

title: Han Wang, Jun Tang, Xiaodong Liu, Shanyan Guan, Rong Xie, Li Song
title_en: Han Wang, Jun Tang, Xiaodong Liu, Shanyan Guan, Rong Xie, Li Song
abstract: 近年来,应用上下文帧以提升视频目标检测中目标检测性能的趋势日益明显。现有方法通常一次性聚合特征以增强特征。然而,这些方法通常缺乏来自相邻帧的空间信息,并且特征聚合不足。为了解决这些问题,我们采用渐进式方法,引入时序信息和空间信息以实现综合增强。时序信息通过时序特征聚合模型(TFAM)引入,通过在上下文帧和目标帧(即待检测帧)之间进行注意力机制实现。同时,我们采用空间转换感知模型(STAM)来传递每个上下文帧与目标帧之间的位置转换信息。基于基于Transformer的检测器DETR,我们的PTSEFormer也采用端到端方式,避免了繁重的后处理步骤,同时在ImageNet VID数据集上实现了88.1%的mAP。代码可在https://github.com/Hon-Wong/PTSEFormer获取。
abstract_en: Recent years have witnessed a trend of applying context frames to boost the performance of object detection as video object detection. Existing methods usually aggregate features at one stroke to enhance the feature. These methods, however, usually lack spatial information from neighboring frames and suffer from insufficient feature aggregation. To address the issues, we perform a progressive way to introduce both temporal information and spatial information for an integrated enhancement. The temporal information is introduced by the temporal feature aggregation model (TFAM), by conducting an attention mechanism between the context frames and the target frame (i.e., the frame to be detected). Meanwhile, we employ a Spatial Transition Awareness Model (STAM) to convey the location transition information between each context frame and target frame. Built upon a transformer-based detector DETR, our PTSEFormer also follows an end-to-end fashion to avoid heavy post-processing procedures while achieving 88.1% mAP on the ImageNet VID dataset. Codes are available at https://github.com/Hon-Wong/PTSEFormer.

title: 和
title_en: Han Zhang, Yunchao Gu, Xinliang Wang, Junjun Pan, Minghui Wang
abstract: 标签,分别对应翻译后的标题和摘要,最后以
abstract_en: Lane detection requires adequate global information due to the simplicity of lane line features and changeable road scenes. In this paper, we propose a novel lane detection Transformer based on multi-frame input to regress the parameters of lanes under a lane shape modeling. We design a Multi-frame Horizontal and Vertical Attention (MHVA) module to obtain more global features and use Visual Transformer (VT) module to get ""lane tokens"" with interaction information of lane instances. Extensive experiments on two public datasets show that our model can achieve state-of-art results on VIL-100 dataset and comparable performance on Tusimple dataset. In addition, our model runs at 46 fps on multi-frame data while using few parameters, indicating the feasibility and practicability in real-time self-driving applications of our proposed method.

title: Han-Byul Kim, Eunhyeok Park, Sungjoo Yoo
title_en: Han-Byul Kim, Eunhyeok Park, Sungjoo Yoo
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的低比特激活量化方法——分支级激活裁剪搜索量化(BASQ)。BASQ在连续搜索空间中优化裁剪值,同时在离散搜索空间中搜索L2衰减权重因子以更新裁剪值。我们还提出了一种适用于MobileNet和ResNet结构的新型低精度块结构,该结构通过分支级搜索能够正常工作。我们通过将权重和激活量化为4比特或更低来评估所提出的方法。与仅适用于冗余网络(如ResNet-18)或高度优化网络(如MobileNet-v2)的有效方法不同,我们的方法在2到4比特的低精度范围内对两种类型的网络均保持稳定的竞争力。具体而言,我们的2比特MobileNet-v2在ImageNet上实现了64.71%的Top-1准确率,比现有方法高出2.8%;我们的4比特MobileNet-v2达到71.98%的准确率,与全精度准确率71.88%相当,而我们的统一量化方法在2比特ResNet-18上实现了与现有非统一量化方法相当的精度。
