abstract_en: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) has achieved new progress recently with the emerging framework of self-training deep networks, where the criteria for selection of unlabeled samples with pseudo labels play a key role in the empirical success. In this work, we propose such a new criterion based on consistency among multiple, stochastic classifiers, termed Stochastic Consensus (STOCO). Specifically, we model parameters of the classifiers as a Gaussian distribution whose mean and standard deviation are jointly optimized during training. Due to the scarcity of labels in SSL, modeling classifiers as a distribution itself provides additional regularization that mitigates overfitting to the labeled samples. We technically generate pseudo labels using a simple but flexible framework of deep discriminative clustering, which benefits from the overall structure of data distribution. We also provide theoretical analysis of our criterion by connecting with the theory of learning from noisy data. Our proposed criterion can be readily applied to self-training based SSL frameworks. By choosing the representative FixMatch as the baseline, our method with multiple stochastic classifiers achieves the state of the art on popular SSL benchmarks, especially in label-scarce cases.

title: 张慧聪,谢浩哲,姚宏勋
title_en: Huicong Zhang, Haozhe Xie, Hongxun Yao
abstract: 视频去模糊方法的关键成功因素是通过相邻视频帧的锐利像素补偿中间帧的模糊像素。因此,主流方法基于估计的光流对齐相邻帧,并融合对齐帧以实现恢复。然而,这些方法有时会产生令人不满意的结果,因为它们很少考虑像素的模糊程度,这可能导致从视频帧中引入模糊像素。实际上,并非视频帧中的所有像素都是锐利且有利于去模糊的。为了解决这一问题,我们提出时空可变形注意力网络(STDANet)用于视频去模糊,该网络通过考虑视频帧的像素级模糊程度来提取锐利像素的信息。具体而言,STDANet是一个结合运动估计器和时空可变形注意力(STDA)模块的编码器-解码器网络,其中运动估计器预测粗光流,作为STDA模块中寻找对应锐利像素的基础偏移量。实验结果表明,所提出的STDANet在GoPro、DVD和BSD数据集上优于现有的最先进方法。
abstract_en: The key success factor of the video deblurring methods is to compensate for the blurry pixels of the mid-frame with the sharp pixels of the adjacent video frames. Therefore, mainstream methods align the adjacent frames based on the estimated optical flows and fuse the alignment frames for restoration. However, these methods sometimes generate unsatisfactory results because they rarely consider the blur levels of pixels, which may introduce blurry pixels from video frames. Actually, not all the pixels in the video frames are sharp and beneficial for deblurring. To address this problem, we propose the spatio-temporal deformable attention network (STDANet) for video delurring, which extracts the information of sharp pixels by considering the pixel-wise blur levels of the video frames. Specifically, STDANet is an encoder-decoder network combined with the motion estimator and spatio-temporal deformable attention (STDA) module, where motion estimator predicts coarse optical flows that are used as base offsets to find the corresponding sharp pixels in STDA module. Experimental results indicate that the proposed STDANet performs favorably against state-of-the-art methods on the GoPro, DVD, and BSD datasets.

title: 吴慧思,肖芳艳,梁崇欣
title_en: Huisi Wu, Fangyan Xiao, Chongxin Liang
abstract: 少样本语义分割是解决数据稀缺场景的有前景方案,尤其是在训练数据有限的医学影像挑战中。然而,大多数现有少样本分割方法倾向于过度依赖包含目标类别的图像,这可能阻碍其对医学影像数据的利用。本文提出了一种少样本分割模型,利用不含目标类别的医学影像中的解剖学辅助信息进行双对比学习。双对比学习模块从原型和上下文的角度对向量进行比较,以增强学习特征的可区分性和数据利用效率。此外,为更友好地区分前景特征与背景特征,设计了一个约束迭代预测模块以优化查询图像的分割。在两个医学影像数据集上的实验表明,所提方法的性能与现有最先进方法相当。
abstract_en: Few-shot semantic segmentation is a promising solution for scarce data scenarios, especially for medical imaging challenges with limited training data. However, most of the existing few-shot segmentation methods tend to over rely on the images containing target classes, which may hinder its utilization of medical imaging data. In this paper, we present a few-shot segmentation model that employs anatomical auxiliary information from medical images without target classes for dual contrastive learning. The dual contrastive learning module performs comparison among vectors from the perspectives of prototypes and contexts, to enhance the discriminability of learned features and the data utilization. Besides, to distinguish foreground features from background features more friendly, a constrained iterative prediction module is designed to optimize the segmentation of the query image. Experiments on two medical image datasets show that the proposed method achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods.

title: 杨惠宗,Anthony Yezzi
title_en: Huizong Yang, Anthony Yezzi
abstract: 本文对三维表面上遮挡边界的局部结构提出了新的见解。先前文献已通过径向曲率、平面曲率和高斯曲率探讨了三维遮挡边界与其二维图像投影之间的关系。遮挡边界也常被隐式地研究为等值面的交集,避免以局部曲面几何显式描述。相比之下,本文以局部曲面几何为依据,显式地研究和表征遮挡曲线的局部结构。我们展示了如何仅沿观察方向,通过曲面的二阶结构提取遮挡曲线的一阶结构(其切线),而无需考虑其他方向的曲率或扭率。我们推导出一个定理,证明遮挡边界的切向量沿视线方向及其正交切向量展现出一种令人惊叹的优雅分解,其中分解权重精确对应于曲面的测地扭率和法曲率,仅沿视线方向!尽管本文的重点是增强对连续体中遮挡曲线的理论理解,但我们仍通过一种直接的 marching 方法展示了其潜在的数值应用,以显式追踪遮挡曲线。此外,我们还进行了数学分析,说明该理论与计算机视觉的相关性,以及其如何可能被用于未来更精确的2D/3D配准和/或多视角立体重建算法。
abstract_en: This paper develops new insight into the local structure of occluding boundaries on 3D surfaces. Prior literature has addressed the relationship between 3D occluding boundaries and their 2D image projections by radial curvature, planar curvature, and Gaussian curvature. Occluding boundaries have also been studied implicitly as intersections of level surfaces, avoiding their explicit description in terms of local surface geometry. In contrast, this work studies and characterizes the local structure of occluding curves explicitly in terms of the local geometry of the surface. We show how the first order structure of the occluding curve (its tangent) can be extracted from the second order structure of the surface purely along the viewing direction, without the need to consider curvatures or torsions in other directions. We derive a theorem to show that the tangent vector of the occluding boundary exhibits a strikingly elegant decomposition along the viewing direction and its orthogonal tangent, where the decomposition weights precisely match the geodesic torsion and the normal curvature of the surface respectively only along the line-of-sight! Though the focus of this paper is an enhanced theoretical understanding of the occluding curve in the continuum, we nevertheless demonstrate its potential numerical utility in a straight-forward marching method to explicitly trace out the occluding curve. We also present mathematical analysis to show the relevance of this theory to computer vision and how it might be leveraged in more accurate future algorithms for 2D/3D registration and/or multiview stereo reconstruction.

title: Huseyin Coskun, Alireza Zareian, Joshua L. Moore, Federico Tombari, Chen Wang
title_en: Huseyin Coskun, Alireza Zareian, Joshua L. Moore, Federico Tombari, Chen Wang
abstract: 聚类是无监督学习中一种普遍使用的工具。大多数现有的自监督表征学习方法通常基于视觉主导特征对样本进行聚类。虽然这对于基于图像的自监督学习效果良好,但在视频处理中往往失效,因为视频需要理解运动而非关注背景。使用光流作为RGB的补充信息可以缓解这一问题。然而,我们观察到两种模态的简单组合并不能带来有意义的提升。在本文中,我们提出了一种结合两种模态的原理性方法。具体而言,我们提出了一种新颖的聚类策略,利用每种模态的初始聚类分配作为先验,引导另一种模态的最终聚类分配。这一思想将强制两种模态形成相似的聚类结构,所形成的聚类将具有语义抽象性,并且对来自每个模态的噪声输入具有鲁棒性。此外,我们提出了一种新颖的正则化策略,以解决基于聚类的自监督学习方法中常见的特征坍缩问题。我们的广泛评估表明,所学习的表征在下游任务(如视频检索和动作识别)中具有有效性。具体而言,在视频检索任务中,我们在UCF数据集上优于当前最优方法7%,在HMDB数据集上优于4%;在线性视频分类任务中,我们在UCF数据集上优于当前最优方法5%,在HMDB数据集上优于6%。
abstract_en: Clustering is a ubiquitous tool in unsupervised learning. Most of the existing self-supervised representation learning methods typically cluster samples based on visually dominant features. While this works well for image-based selfsupervision, it often fails for videos, which require understanding motion rather than focusing on background. Using optical flow as complementary information to RGB can alleviate this problem. However, we observe that a naÂ ̈Ä±ve combination of the two modalities does not provide meaningful gains. In this paper, we propose a principled way to combine two modalities. Specifically, we propose a novel clustering strategy where we use the initial cluster assignment of each modality as prior to guide the final cluster assignment of the other modality. This idea will enforce similar cluster structures for both modalities, and the formed clusters will be semantically abstract and robust to noisy inputs coming from each individual modality. Additionally, we propose a novel regularization strategy to address the feature collapse problem, which is common in cluster-based self-supervised learning methods. Our extensive evaluation shows the effectiveness of our learned representations on downstream tasks, e.g., video retrieval and action recognition. Specifically, we outperform the state of the art by 7% on UCF and 4% on HMDB for video retrieval as well as 5% on UCF and 6% on HMDB for linear video classification.

title: Huy Phan, Cong Shi, Yi Xie, Tianfang Zhang, Zhuohang Li, Tianming Zhao, Jian Liu, Yan Wang, Yingying Chen, Bo Yuan
title_en: Huy Phan, Cong Shi, Yi Xie, Tianfang Zhang, Zhuohang Li, Tianming Zhao, Jian Liu, Yan Wang, Yingying Chen, Bo Yuan
abstract: 近年来,后门攻击已成为对深度神经网络(DNN)模型安全性的新兴威胁。截至目前,大多数现有研究聚焦于针对未压缩模型的后门攻击;而广泛应用于实际场景的压缩DNN模型的脆弱性却尚未被充分挖掘。本文提出针对紧凑型DNN模型的鲁棒且难以察觉的后门攻击方法(RIBAC)。通过系统分析与探索关键设计参数,我们提出一种框架,能够高效学习合适的触发模式、模型参数和剪枝掩码。从而同时实现高触发隐蔽性、高攻击成功率和高模型效率。在多个数据集上的广泛评估,包括对最先进防御机制的对抗测试,验证了RIBAC的高鲁棒性、隐蔽性和模型效率。代码已开源至https://github.com/huyvnphan/ECCV2022-RIBAC
abstract_en: Recently backdoor attack has become an emerging threat to the security of deep neural network (DNN) models. To date, most of the existing studies focus on backdoor attack against the uncompressed model; while the vulnerability of compressed DNNs, which are widely used in the practical applications, is little exploited yet. In this paper, we propose to study and develop Robust and Imperceptible Backdoor Attack against Compact DNN models (RIBAC). By performing systematic analysis and exploration on the important design knobs, we propose a framework that can learn the proper trigger patterns, model parameters and pruning masks in an efficient way. Thereby achieving high trigger stealthiness, high attack success rate and high model efficiency simultaneously. Extensive evaluations across different datasets, including the test against the state-of-the-art defense mechanisms, demonstrate the high robustness, stealthiness and model efficiency of RIBAC. Code is available at https://github.com/huyvnphan/ECCV2022-RIBAC

title: Huy V. Vo, Oriane Siméoni, Spyros Gidaris, Andrei Bursuc, Patrick Pérez, Jean Ponce
title_en: Huy V. Vo, Oriane Siméoni, Spyros Gidaris, Andrei Bursuc, Patrick Pérez, Jean Ponce
abstract: 使用弱标注训练的目标检测器是全监督方法的经济替代方案。然而,它们之间仍存在显著的性能差距。我们提出通过“框中框”(BiB)主动学习策略,对基础预训练的弱监督检测器进行微调,以缩小这一差距。BiB是一种专门针对弱监督检测器已知的失败模式设计的新型主动学习方法,通过从训练集中自动选择少量全标注样本进行微调。在VOC07和COCO基准测试中,实验表明BiB优于其他主动学习技术,并且仅需每类少量全标注图像即可显著提升基础弱监督检测器的性能。在VOC07数据集上,BiB仅使用10%的全标注图像即可达到全监督Fast RCNN性能的97%。在COCO数据集上,使用平均每类10张全标注图像(即训练集的1%),BiB也将弱监督检测器与全监督Fast RCNN在AP指标上的性能差距减少了70%以上,展现出性能与数据效率之间的良好平衡。我们的代码已公开在https://github.com/huyvvo/BiB。
abstract_en: Object detectors trained with weak annotations are affordable alternatives to fully-supervised counterparts. However, there is still a significant performance gap between them. We propose to narrow this gap by fine-tuning a base pre-trained weakly-supervised detector with a few fully-annotated samples automatically selected from the training set using “box-in-box” (BiB), a novel active learning strategy designed specifically to address the well-documented failure modes of weakly-supervised detectors. Experiments on the VOC07 and COCO benchmarks show that BiB outperforms other active learning techniques and significantly improves the base weakly-supervised detector’s performance with only a few fully-annotated images per class. BiB reaches 97% of the performance of fully-supervised Fast RCNN with only 10% of fully-annotated images on VOC07. On COCO, using on average 10 fully-annotated images per class, or equivalently 1% of the training set, BiB also reduces the performance gap (in AP) between the weakly-supervised detector and the fully-supervised Fast RCNN by over 70%, showing a good trade-off between performance and data efficiency. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/huyvvo/BiB.

title: Hyejin Lee, Daehee Kim, Daeun Lee, Jinkyu Kim, Jaekoo Lee
title_en: Hyejin Lee, Daehee Kim, Daeun Lee, Jinkyu Kim, Jaekoo Lee
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的自动上色技术,该技术能够学习多个源域之间的领域不变性,并利用这种不变性对未见过的目标域中的灰度图像进行上色。这对于通常由于数据不足而难以上色的草图、线艺术或线图来说尤其有用。为了解决这一问题,我们首先应用现有的领域泛化(DG)技术,然而由于网络过度强调学习领域不变内容(或形状),这些技术生成的图像往往显得不够生动。因此,我们提出了一种新的领域泛化上色模型,该模型包含两个模块:(i) 一个领域不变内容偏置特征编码器和 (ii) 一个源域特定的色彩生成器。为了解决领域不变特征中源域特定色彩信息不足的问题,我们提出了一种跳跃连接,可以通过自适应实例归一化传输内容特征统计信息。我们在公开的PACS和Office-Home DG基准数据集上的实验验证了我们的模型确实能够生成感知上合理的上色图像。此外,我们进行了一项用户研究,要求人类评估者 (1) 回答生成的图像是否自然上色,并 (2) 在替代方案中选择最佳生成图像。我们的模型显著优于替代方案,证实了所提方法的有效性。代码可在 \url{https://github.com/Lhyejin/DG-Colorization} 获取。
abstract_en: We propose a novel automatic colorization technique that learns domain-invariance across multiple source domains and is able to leverage such invariance to colorize grayscale images in unseen target domains. This would be particularly useful for colorizing sketches, line arts, or line drawings, which are generally difficult to colorize due to a lack of data. To address this issue, we first apply existing domain generalization (DG) techniques, which, however, produce less compelling desaturated images due to the network’s over-emphasis on learning domain-invariant contents (or shapes). Thus, we propose a new domain generalizable colorization model, which consists of two modules: (i) a domain-invariant content-biased feature encoder and (ii) a source-domain-specific color generator. To mitigate the issue of insufficient source domain-specific color information in domain-invariant features, we propose a skip connection that can transfer content feature statistics via adaptive instance normalization. Our experiments with publicly available PACS and Office-Home DG benchmarks confirm that our model is indeed able to produce perceptually reasonable colorized images. Further, we conduct a user study where human evaluators are asked to (1) answer whether the generated image looks naturally colored and to (2) choose the best-generated images against alternatives. Our model significantly outperforms the alternatives, confirming the effectiveness of the proposed method. The code is available at \url{https://github.com/Lhyejin/DG-Colorization}.

title: Hyeonsu Lee, Chankyu Choi
title_en: Hyeonsu Lee, Chankyu Choi
abstract: 场景文本去除(STR),即从自然场景图像中去除文本,近年来因其作为文本编辑或隐藏私人信息(如身份证号、电话号码和车牌号)的重要组成部分而受到关注。尽管目前有多种不同的STR方法正在被积极研究,但由于之前提出的方法均未使用相同的标准化训练/评估数据集,因此难以评估其优越性。我们使用相同的标准化训练/测试数据集,对几种先前方法进行了标准化重实现并评估其性能。本文还引入了一种简单但极其有效的门控注意力(GA)和感兴趣区域生成(RoIG)方法。GA通过注意力机制聚焦于文本笔画以及周围区域的纹理和颜色,从而更精确地去除输入图像中的文本。RoIG则仅关注图像中的文本区域而非整个图像,以更高效地训练模型。在基准数据集上的实验结果表明,我们的方法在几乎所有指标上均显著优于现有最先进的方法,并且生成的高质量结果更加显著。此外,由于我们的模型并未显式生成文本笔画掩码,因此无需额外的细化步骤或子模型,使模型速度更快且参数更少。数据集和代码可在https://github.com/naver/garnet获取。
abstract_en: Scene text removal (STR), a task of erasing text from natural scene images, has recently attracted attention as an important component of editing text or concealing private information such as ID, telephone, and license plate numbers. While there are a variety of different methods for STR actively being researched, it is difficult to evaluate superiority because previously proposed methods do not use the same standardized training/evaluation dataset. We use the same standardized training/testing dataset to evaluate the performance of several previous methods after standardized re-implementation. We also introduce a simple yet extremely effective Gated Attention (GA) and Region-of-Interest Generation (RoIG) methodology in this paper. GA uses attention to focus on the text stroke as well as the textures and colors of the surrounding regions to remove text from the input image much more precisely. RoIG is applied to focus on only the region with text instead of the entire image to train the model more efficiently. Experimental results on the benchmark dataset show that our method significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in almost all metrics with remarkably higher-quality results. Furthermore, because our model does not generate a text stroke mask explicitly, there is no need for additional refinement steps or sub-models, making our model extremely fast with fewer parameters. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/naver/garnet.

title: 申炯旭,李江贤,金晟焕,金俊谟
title_en: Hyounguk Shon, Janghyeon Lee, Seung Hwan Kim, Junmo Kim
abstract: 预训练表示是现代深度学习成功的关键要素之一。然而,现有持续学习方法的研究大多集中在从头开始增量学习模型上。本文探索了一种替代增量学习的框架,即从预训练表示持续微调模型。我们的方法利用预训练神经网络的线性化技术,实现简单且有效的持续学习。我们证明,这使得我们能够设计一个线性模型,其中二次参数正则化方法作为最优的持续学习策略,同时享受神经网络的高性能。我们还表明,所提出的算法使参数正则化方法能够应用于类别增量问题。此外,我们提供了现有参数空间正则化算法(如EWC)在使用交叉熵损失训练的神经网络上表现不佳的理论原因。我们证明,所提出的方法可以在图像分类任务中防止遗忘,同时实现高性能的持续微调。为了证明我们的方法可以应用于一般的持续学习场景,我们在数据增量、任务增量和类别增量学习问题中评估了我们的方法。
abstract_en: Pre-trained representation is one of the key elements in the success of modern deep learning. However, existing works on continual learning methods have mostly focused on learning models incrementally from scratch. In this paper, we explore an alternative framework to incremental learning where we continually fine-tune the model from a pre-trained representation. Our method takes advantage of linearization technique of a pre-trained neural network for simple and effective continual learning. We show that this allows us to design a linear model where quadratic parameter regularization method is placed as the optimal continual learning policy, and at the same time enjoying the high performance of neural networks. We also show that the proposed algorithm enables parameter regularization methods to be applied to class-incremental problems. Additionally, we provide a theoretical reason why the existing parameter-space regularization algorithms such as EWC underperform on neural networks trained with cross-entropy loss. We show that the proposed method can prevent forgetting while achieving high continual fine-tuning performance on image classification tasks. To show that our method can be applied to general continual learning settings, we evaluate our method in data-incremental, task-incremental, and class-incremental learning problems.

title: Hyundong Jin, Eunwoo Kim
title_en: Hyundong Jin, Eunwoo Kim
abstract: 在优化依次到来的任务时,深度神经网络通常由于缺乏维持旧任务知识的能力而遭受灾难性遗忘,这可能导致先前学习任务的性能显著下降。为缓解这一问题,已开展持续学习相关研究作为应对措施。然而,由于网络规模的扩大或与先前任务有利关联的知识变化,该方法会增加计算成本。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新颖方法,通过模型搜索区分对旧任务有益和有害的信息,以有效学习当前任务。给定新任务,所提方法从旧任务中发现潜在关联知识,可为获取新任务知识提供额外支持。此外,通过引入与关联任务当前任务损失的敏感性度量,我们发现任务间的协作关系,同时缓解有害干扰。我们将在持续学习的类别和任务增量场景中应用所提方法,使用从小规模到大规模的广泛数据集进行实验。实验结果表明,所提方法在实验中优于多种持续学习方法,同时有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
abstract_en: When optimizing sequentially incoming tasks, deep neural networks generally suffer from catastrophic forgetting due to their lack of ability to maintain knowledge from old tasks. This may lead to a significant performance drop of the previously learned tasks. To alleviate this problem, studies on continual learning have been conducted as a countermeasure. Nevertheless, it suffers from an increase in computational cost due to the expansion of the network size or a change in knowledge that is favorably linked to previous tasks. In this work, we propose a novel approach to differentiate helpful and harmful information for old tasks using a model search to learn a current task effectively. Given a new task, the proposed method discovers an underlying association knowledge from old tasks, which can provide additional support in acquiring the new task knowledge. In addition, by introducing a sensitivity measure to the loss of the current task from the associated tasks, we find cooperative relations between tasks while alleviating harmful interference. We apply the proposed approach to both task- and class-incremental scenarios in continual learning, using a wide range of datasets from small to large scales. Experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms a large variety of continual learning approaches for the experiments while effectively alleviating catastrophic forgetting.

title: 李亨泰、徐成敏、权熙成
title_en: Hyungtae Lee, Sungmin Eum, Heesung Kwon
abstract: 我们提出了一种动量重识别(MoReID)框架,该框架可以在通用重识别任务的训练中利用大量负样本。该框架的设计灵感来源于动量对比(MoCo),其通过字典存储当前和过去批次以构建大量编码样本集合。我们发现使用过去正样本(可能与当前正样本形成的编码特征属性高度不一致)效果不佳,因此MoReID设计为仅使用字典中存储的大量负样本。然而,如果使用广泛采用的仅用一个样本代表一组正/负样本的三元组损失(Triplet loss)进行训练,很难有效利用MoReID框架获得的扩展负样本集合。为最大化利用扩展负样本集合的优势,我们新引入了硬距离弹性损失(HE loss),该损失能够使用多个硬样本代表大量样本。实验表明,仅通过HE损失即可充分利用MoReID框架提供的大量负样本,在三个重识别基准数据集VeRi-776、Market-1501和VeRi-Wild上实现了最先进的准确率。
abstract_en: We present a Momentum Re-identification (MoReID) framework that can leverage a very large number of negative samples in training for general re-identification task. The design of this framework is inspired by Momentum Contrast (MoCo), which uses a dictionary to store current and past batches to build a large set of encoded samples. As we find it less effective to use past positive samples which may be highly inconsistent to the encoded feature property formed with the current positive samples, MoReID is designed to use only a large number of negative samples stored in the dictionary. However, if we train the model using the widely used Triplet loss that uses only one sample to represent a set of positive/negative samples, it is hard to effectively leverage the enlarged set of negative samples acquired by the MoReID framework. To maximize the advantage of using the scaled-up negative sample set, we newly introduce Hard-distance Elastic loss (HE loss), which is capable of using more than one hard sample to represent a large number of samples. Our experiments demonstrate that a large number of negative samples provided by MoReID framework can be utilized at full capacity only with the HE loss, achieving the state-of-the-art accuracy on three re-ID benchmarks, VeRi-776, Market-1501, and VeRi-Wild.

title: Inhwan Bae, Jin-Hwi Park, Hae-Gon Jeon
title_en: Inhwan Bae, Jin-Hwi Park, Hae-Gon Jeon
abstract: 建模人群行走的动力学是计算机视觉领域长期关注的问题。许多先前涉及行人轨迹预测的工作定义了特定的个体动作集合,以隐式建模群体行为。本文提出了一种名为GP-Graph的新架构,该架构通过集体群体表示实现拥挤环境下的有效行人轨迹预测,并兼容所有现有方法。GP-Graph的关键思想是将个体级和群体级关系建模为图表示。为此,GP-Graph首先学习将每个行人分配到最可能的行为群体。利用该分配信息,GP-Graph随后构建组内和组间交互作为图,分别考虑群体内部的人际关系和群体间关系。具体而言,对于组内交互,我们屏蔽与相关群体无关的行人图边。我们还提出群体池化与解池化操作,将多个行人的群体表示为一个图节点。最后,GP-Graph从组间交互的集成特征中推断出社会可接受的未来轨迹的概率图。此外,我们引入群体级潜在向量采样,以确保在一组可能的未来轨迹上进行集体推理。进行了大量实验验证我们架构的有效性,结果在公开基准数据集上表现出一致的性能提升。代码已公开在https://github.com/inhwanbae/GPGraph。
abstract_en: Modeling the dynamics of people walking is a problem of long-standing interest in computer vision. Many previous works involving pedestrian trajectory prediction define a particular set of individual actions to implicitly model group actions. In this paper, we present a novel architecture named GP-Graph which has collective group representations for effective pedestrian trajectory prediction in crowded environments, and is compatible with all types of existing approaches. A key idea of GP-Graph is to model both individual-wise and group-wise relations as graph representations. To do this, GP-Graph first learns to assign each pedestrian into the most likely behavior group. Using this assignment information, GP-Graph then forms both intra- and inter-group interactions as graphs, accounting for human-human relations within a group and group-group relations, respectively. To be specific, for the intra-group interaction, we mask pedestrian graph edges out of an associated group. We also propose group pooling&unpooling operations to represent a group with multiple pedestrians as one graph node. Lastly, GP-Graph infers a probability map for socially-acceptable future trajectories from the integrated features of both group interactions. Moreover, we introduce a group-level latent vector sampling to ensure collective inferences over a set of possible future trajectories. Extensive experiments are conducted to validate the effectiveness of our architecture, which demonstrates consistent performance improvements with publicly available benchmarks. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/inhwanbae/GPGraph.

title: Ioannis Kakogeorgiou, Spyros Gidaris, Bill Psomas, Yannis Avrithis, Andrei Bursuc, Konstantinos Karantzalos, Nikos Komodakis
title_en: Ioannis Kakogeorgiou, Spyros Gidaris, Bill Psomas, Yannis Avrithis, Andrei Bursuc, Konstantinos Karantzalos, Nikos Komodakis
abstract: Transformer模型和掩码语言建模技术正迅速被应用于计算机视觉领域,发展为视觉Transformer和掩码图像建模(MIM)。在本工作中,我们论证了图像标记掩码与文本中的标记掩码存在差异,这是由于图像中标记的数量和相关性不同所致。具体而言,为了生成具有挑战性的MIM预训练任务,我们主张从随机掩码转向信息引导掩码。我们在基于蒸馏的MIM框架中开发并验证了这一理念,其中教师Transformer编码器生成注意力图,用于指导学生模型的掩码策略。因此,我们提出了一种新颖的掩码策略,称为注意力引导掩码(AttMask),并证明其在密集型基于蒸馏的MIM以及基于蒸馏的自监督学习分类标记任务中均优于随机掩码。我们验证了AttMask能够加速学习过程,并在多种下游任务中提升性能。代码实现详见https://github.com/gkakogeorgiou/attmask。
abstract_en: Transformers and masked language modeling are quickly being adopted and explored in computer vision as vision transformers and masked image modeling (MIM). In this work, we argue that image token masking differs from token masking in text, due to the amount and correlation of tokens in an image. In particular, to generate a challenging pretext task for MIM, we advocate a shift from random masking to informed masking. We develop and exhibit this idea in the context of distillation-based MIM, where a teacher transformer encoder generates an attention map, which we use to guide masking for the student. We thus introduce a novel masking strategy, called attention-guided masking (AttMask), and we demonstrate its effectiveness over random masking for dense distillation-based MIM as well as plain distillation-based self-supervised learning on classification tokens. We confirm that AttMask accelerates the learning process and improves the performance on a variety of downstream tasks. We provide the implementation code at https://github.com/gkakogeorgiou/attmask.

title: Isaac Kasahara, Simon Stent, Hyun Soo Park
title_en: Isaac Kasahara, Simon Stent, Hyun Soo Park
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的道路驾驶数据集,称为“Look Both Ways”,该数据集包含驾驶员面部和前方道路场景的同步视频,以及通过驾驶员佩戴的眼动追踪眼镜注册的真实注视数据。我们的数据集支持对非侵入性估计驾驶员注意力焦点方法的研究——这是道路安全领域的重要应用方向。一个关键挑战是,该任务需要精确的注视估计,但监督的基于外观的注视估计方法通常难以迁移到真实驾驶数据集,且在域内获取监督数据也较为困难。因此,我们提出了一种驾驶员注视的自监督方法,利用驾驶员注视方向与驾驶员观察到的场景显著性之间的几何一致性。我们构建了一个三维几何学习框架以强制执行这种一致性,使注视模型能够监督场景显著性模型,反之亦然。我们实现了该方法的原型,并使用我们的数据集进行测试,结果表明与监督方法相比,该方法在无需额外标签的情况下可以实现更优的注视估计和场景显著性估计。
abstract_en: We present a new on-road driving dataset, called “Look Both Ways”, which contains synchronized video of both driver faces and the forward road scene, along with ground truth gaze data registered from eye tracking glasses worn by the drivers. Our dataset supports the study of methods for non-intrusively estimating a driver’s focus of attention while driving - an important application area in road safety. A key challenge is that this task requires accurate gaze estimation, but supervised appearance-based gaze estimation methods often do not transfer well to real driving datasets, and in-domain ground truth to supervise them is difficult to gather. We therefore propose a method for self-supervision of driver gaze, by taking advantage of the geometric consistency between the driver’s gaze direction and the saliency of the scene as observed by the driver. We formulate a 3D geometric learning framework to enforce this consistency, allowing the gaze model to supervise the scene saliency model, and vice versa. We implement a prototype of our method and test it with our dataset, to show that compared to a supervised approach it can yield better gaze estimation and scene saliency estimation with no additional labels.

title: Ishit Mehta, Manmohan Chandraker, Ravi Ramamoorthi
title_en: Ishit Mehta, Manmohan Chandraker, Ravi Ramamoorthi
abstract: 基于坐标的神经网络在隐式曲面参数化方面已成为几何表示的有效方法。它们有效地作为参数化水平集,其中零水平集定义了感兴趣的曲面。我们提出了一种框架,允许将针对三角网格定义的变形操作应用于此类隐式曲面。其中一些操作可以视为能量最小化问题,这些问题在显式曲面上诱导出瞬时流场。我们的方法通过扩展经典水平集理论,利用流场对参数化隐式曲面进行变形。此外,我们通过形式化与水平集理论的联系,推导出现有可微曲面提取和渲染方法的统一视角。我们证明这些方法偏离了理论,并且我们的方法在隐式几何的曲面平滑、平均曲率流、逆渲染和用户定义编辑等应用中表现出改进。
abstract_en: Coordinate-based neural networks parameterizing implicit surfaces have emerged as efficient representations of geometry. They effectively act as parametric level sets with the zero-level set defining the surface of interest. We present a framework that allows applying deformation operations defined for triangle meshes onto such implicit surfaces. Several of these operations can be viewed as energy-minimization problems that induce an instantaneous flow field on the explicit surface. Our method uses the flow field to deform parametric implicit surfaces by extending the classical theory of level sets. We also derive a consolidated view for existing methods on differentiable surface extraction and rendering, by formalizing connections to the level-set theory. We show that these methods drift from the theory and that our approach exhibits improvements for applications like surface smoothing, mean-curvature flow, inverse rendering and user-defined editing on implicit geometry.

title: Itsuki Ueda, Yoshihiro Fukuhara, Hirokatsu Kataoka, Hiroaki Aizawa, Hidehiko Shishido, Itaru Kitahara
title_en: Itsuki Ueda, Yoshihiro Fukuhara, Hirokatsu Kataoka, Hiroaki Aizawa, Hidehiko Shishido, Itaru Kitahara
abstract: 神经场在三维视觉任务中的成功已毋庸置疑。在此趋势下,一些旨在实现视觉定位(例如SLAM)的方法被提出,利用神经场估计距离或密度场。然而,仅依靠基于密度场的方法(如神经辐射场NeRF)难以实现高定位性能,因为它们在大多数空区域无法提供密度梯度。另一方面,基于距离场的方法(如神经隐式表面NeuS)在物体表面形状方面存在局限性。本文提出了一种新型三维表示方法——神经距离-密度场(NeDDF),该方法通过相互约束距离场和密度场实现。我们将距离场公式扩展到无显式边界表面的形状(如毛发或烟雾),从而实现从距离场到密度场的显式转换。通过显式转换实现的一致距离和密度场,既具备对初始值的鲁棒性,又能实现高质量配准。此外,场之间的一致性还允许从稀疏点云中快速收敛。实验表明,NeDDF能够在新视角合成任务中提供与NeRF相当的结果,同时实现高定位性能。代码可在https://github.com/ueda0319/neddf获取。
abstract_en: The success of neural fields for 3D vision tasks is now indisputable. Following this trend, several methods aiming for visual localization (e.g., SLAM) have been proposed to estimate distance or density fields using neural fields. However, it is difficult to achieve high localization performance by only density fields-based methods such as Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) since they do not provide density gradient in most empty regions. On the other hand, distance field-based methods such as Neural Implicit Surface (NeuS) have limitations in objects’ surface shapes. This paper proposes Neural Distance-Density Field (NeDDF), a novel 3D representation that reciprocally constrains the distance and density fields. We extend distance field formulation to shapes with no explicit boundary surface, such as fur or smoke, which enable explicit conversion from distance field to density field. Consistent distance and density fields realized by explicit conversion enable both robustness to initial values and high-quality registration. Furthermore, the consistency between fields allows fast convergence from sparse point clouds. Experiments show that NeDDF can achieve high localization performance while providing comparable results to NeRF on novel view synthesis. The code is available at https://github.com/ueda0319/neddf.

title: Iuliia Pliushch, Martin Mundt, Nicolas Lupp, Visvanathan Ramesh
title_en: Iuliia Pliushch, Martin Mundt, Nicolas Lupp, Visvanathan Ramesh
abstract: 尽管多年来已引入了大量深度分类的架构变体,但近期的研究发现其训练过程存在相似性。人们假设神经网络不仅会收敛到相似的表示,还会表现出一种实证一致,即哪些数据实例首先被学习。我们遵循这些研究的脚步,定义了一个度量来量化随时间变化的分类一致关系,并提出这种一致现象可以映射到所研究数据集的核心统计量。我们在CIFAR10、Pascal、ImageNet和KTH-TIPS2数据集上实证支持了这一假设。我们的发现表明,一致性似乎独立于特定的架构、训练超参数或标签,尽管它根据图像统计量遵循某种顺序。
abstract_en: Although a plethora of architectural variants for deep classification has been introduced over time, recent works have found empirical evidence towards similarities in their training process. It has been hypothesized that neural networks converge not only to similar representations, but also exhibit a notion of empirical agreement on which data instances are learned first. Following in the latter works’ footsteps, we define a metric to quantify the relationship between such classification agreement over time, and posit that the agreement phenomenon can be mapped to core statistics of the investigated dataset. We empirically corroborate this hypothesis across the CIFAR10, Pascal, ImageNet and KTH-TIPS2 datasets. Our findings indicate that agreement seems to be independent of specific architectures, training hyper-parameters or labels, albeit follows an ordering according to image statistics.

title: Jack Hessel, Jena D. Hwang, Jae Sung Park, Rowan Zellers, Chandra Bhagavatula, Anna Rohrbach, Kate Saenko, Yejin Choi
title_en: Jack Hessel, Jena D. Hwang, Jae Sung Park, Rowan Zellers, Chandra Bhagavatula, Anna Rohrbach, Kate Saenko, Yejin Choi
abstract: 人类在超越图像字面内容进行溯因推理和假设方面具有显著的能力。通过识别场景中分散的具象视觉线索,我们几乎无法避免根据日常经验和世界知识对超出字面场景的内容进行可能的推断。例如,如果我们看到“20英里/小时”标志与道路并列,可能会假设街道位于住宅区(而非高速公路),即使未绘制房屋。机器能否执行类似的视觉推理?我们提出Sherlock,一个包含103,000张图像的注释语料库,用于测试机器超越字面图像内容的溯因推理能力。我们采用自由观看范式:参与者首先观察并识别图像中的显著线索(如物体、动作),然后根据线索提供对场景的合理推断。总计收集了363,000个(线索,推断)对,构成了首个针对溯因视觉推理的语料库。利用该语料库,我们测试了三个互补的溯因推理维度:i)从大型候选语料库中检索相关推断;ii)通过边界框定位推断证据;iii)将合理推断与新收集的19,000条李克特量表判断诊断语料库进行对比。尽管我们发现通过多任务目标微调CLIP-RN50x64的表现优于强基线模型,但模型性能与人类共识之间仍存在显著差距。数据、模型和排行榜可在http://visualabduction.com/获取。
abstract_en: Humans have remarkable capacity to reason abductively and hypothesize about what lies beyond the literal content of an image. By identifying concrete visual clues scattered throughout a scene, we almost can’t help but draw probable inferences beyond the literal scene based on our everyday experience and knowledge about the world. For example, if we see a “20 mph” sign alongside a road, we might assume the street sits in a residential area (rather than on a highway), even if no houses are pictured. Can machines perform similar visual reasoning? We present Sherlock, an annotated corpus of 103K images for testing machine capacity for abductive reasoning beyond literal image contents. We adopt a free-viewing paradigm: participants first observe and identify salient clues within images (e.g., objects, actions) and then provide a plausible inference about the scene, given the clue. In total, we collect 363K (clue, inference) pairs, which form a first-of-its-kind abductive visual reasoning dataset. Using our corpus, we test three complementary axes of abductive reasoning. We evaluate the capacity of models to: i) retrieve relevant inferences from a large candidate corpus; ii) localize evidence for inferences via bounding boxes, and iii) compare plausible inferences to match human judgments on a newly-collected diagnostic corpus of 19K Likert-scale judgments. While we find that fine-tuning CLIP-RN50x64 with a multitask objective outperforms strong baselines, significant headroom exists between model performance and human agreement. Data, models, and leaderboard available at http://visualabduction.com/.

title: Jacob Krantz, Stefan Lee
title_en: Jacob Krantz, Stefan Lee
abstract: 近期视觉-语言导航(VLN)领域的研究提出了两种具有不同真实感的环境范式——基于拓扑环境的标准VLN设置(其中导航被抽象化处理),以及需要代理在连续三维环境中使用低级动作进行导航的VLN-CE设置。尽管两者共享相同的高层任务甚至底层指令-路径数据,但VLN-CE的表现显著落后于标准VLN。在本工作中,我们通过将代理从抽象环境的VLN迁移至连续环境的VLN-CE来探索这一差距。我们发现这种模拟到模拟的迁移效果显著,使VLN-CE的先前最佳表现提升了+12%的成功率。虽然这证明了该方向的潜力,但迁移后的代理在抽象环境中的原始性能并未完全保留。我们通过一系列实验识别导致性能下降的关键差异,为后续改进提供了明确方向。
abstract_en: Recent work in Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) has presented two environmental paradigms with differing realism -- the standard VLN setting built on topological environments where navigation is abstracted away, and the VLN-CE setting where agents must navigate continuous 3D environments using low-level actions. Despite sharing the high-level task and even the underlying instruction-path data, performance on VLN-CE lags behind VLN significantly. In this work, we explore this gap by transferring an agent from the abstract environment of VLN to the continuous environment of VLN-CE. We find that this sim-2-sim transfer is highly effective, improving over the prior state of the art in VLN-CE by +12% success rate. While this demonstrates the potential for this direction, the transfer does not fully retain the original performance of the agent in the abstract setting. We present a sequence of experiments to identify what differences result in performance degradation, providing clear directions for further improvement.

title: Jae-Ho Choi, Ki-Bong Kang, Kyung-Tae Kim
title_en: Jae-Ho Choi, Ki-Bong Kang, Kyung-Tae Kim
abstract: 非接触式呼吸频率测量(nRRM)旨在无需接触皮肤即可监测呼吸状态,可用于远程医疗、应急检测等多种应用场景。现有nRRM方法主要通过分析视频中的细节来提取微弱呼吸信号,但存在实际局限性,即被测对象的头部或身体需保持准静态。本研究基于无线电波信号,探讨对非静态对象(如大幅身体运动或行走人员)的呼吸信号估计任务。其核心思想是接收到的无线电波信号中同时包含人体全局运动(GM)与呼吸的混合反射信号,同时保留纯GM成分。训练过程中,我们的模型采用新颖的多任务对抗学习(MTAL)框架,以自监督方式捕捉无线电波信号到呼吸信号的映射关系并排除GM成分。我们基于新采集并公开的真实场景数据集测试了所提模型。本研究首次实现了移动/遮挡场景下的nRRM任务,并在人员静止状态下仍超越了最先进的基线方法。
abstract_en: Non-contact respiration rate measurement (nRRM), which aims to monitor one’s breathing status without any contact with the skin, can be utilized in various remote applications (e.g., telehealth or emergency detection). The existing nRRM approaches mainly analyze fine details from videos to extract minute respiration signals; however, they have practical limitations in that the head or body of a subject must be quasi-stationary. In this study, we examine the task of estimating the respiration signal of a non-stationary subject (a person with large body movements or even walking around) based on radio signals. The key idea is that the received radio signals retain both the reflections from human global motion (GM) and respiration in a mixed form, while preserving the GM-only components at the same time. During training, our model leverages a novel multi-task adversarial learning (MTAL) framework to capture the mapping from radio signals to respiration while excluding the GM components in a self-supervised manner. We test the proposed model based on the newly collected and released datasets under real-world conditions. This study is the first realization of the nRRM task for moving/occluded scenarios, and also outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines even when the person sits still.

title: Jaemin Na, Dongyoon Han, Hyung Jin Chang, Wonjun Hwang
title_en: Jaemin Na, Dongyoon Han, Hyung Jin Chang, Wonjun Hwang
abstract: 近期的无监督域适应方法利用了源域和目标域之间的邻近空间。然而,标签平衡崩溃问题(即在邻近实例的预测中,源域标签对目标域标签具有主导性)从未被解决。本文提出了一种实例级最小最大策略,通过最小化邻近空间中高不确定性实例的熵来解决该问题。我们通过求解最小最大问题将邻近空间划分为两个子空间:对比空间和共识空间。在对比空间中,通过约束实例具有对比视图和标签来缓解跨域差异;共识空间则减少同域类别间的混淆。我们的方法在Office-31、Office-Home和VisDA-C等公共基准上进行了验证,取得了最先进的性能。我们进一步证明,我们的方法在PACS数据集上优于当前最先进的方法,表明我们的实例级方法在多源域适应中也表现良好。代码可在https://github.com/NaJaeMin92/CoVi获取。
abstract_en: Recent unsupervised domain adaptation methods have utilized vicinal space between the source and target domains. However, the equilibrium collapse of labels, a problem where the source labels are dominant over the target labels in the predictions of vicinal instances, has never been addressed. In this paper, we propose an instance-wise minimax strategy that minimizes the entropy of high uncertainty instances in the vicinal space to tackle the stated problem. We divide the vicinal space into two subspaces through the solution of the minimax problem: contrastive space and consensus space. In the contrastive space, inter-domain discrepancy is mitigated by constraining instances to have contrastive views and labels, and the consensus space reduces the confusion between intra-domain categories. The effectiveness of our method is demonstrated on public benchmarks, including Office-31, Office-Home, and VisDA-C, achieving state-of-the-art performances. We further show that our method outperforms the current state-of-the-art methods on PACS, which indicates that our instance-wise approach works well for multi-source domain adaptation as well. Code is available at https://github.com/NaJaeMin92/CoVi.

title: Jaeseok Byun, Taebaek Hwang, Jianlong Fu, Taesup Moon
title_en: Jaeseok Byun, Taebaek Hwang, Jianlong Fu, Taesup Moon
abstract: 目前大多数现有的视觉与语言预训练(VLP)方法主要关注如何提取和对齐视觉与文本特征。与主流VLP方法不同,我们强调在预训练过程中两个常规应用的步骤对预训练模型性能具有关键影响:图像-文本匹配(ITM)中的小批量难负样本采样以及为掩码语言建模(MLM)分配较大的掩码概率。在实证验证了上述两个步骤的意外有效性后,我们系统性地设计了GRIT-VLP方法,该方法通过自适应采样小批量数据,更有效地挖掘ITM的难负样本,同时保持预训练的计算成本。我们的方法包含三个组成部分:1)GRouped mIni-baTch sampling(GRIT)策略,用于在小批量中收集相似示例;2)ITC一致性损失以提升挖掘能力;3)扩大MLM的掩码概率。因此,我们展示了GRIT-VLP在多种下游任务上实现了新的最先进性能,且计算成本显著降低。此外,我们证明了我们的模型在相同训练数据上仅需先前最先进模型ALBEF三分之一的训练轮次即可达到相当性能。代码已开源至https://github.com/jaeseokbyun/GRIT-VLP。
abstract_en: Most of the currently existing vision and language pre-training (VLP) methods have mainly focused on how to extract and align vision and text features. In contrast to the mainstream VLP methods, we highlight that two routinely applied steps during pre-training have crucial impact on the performance of the pre-trained model: in-batch hard negative sampling for image-text matching (ITM) and assigning the large masking probability for the masked language modeling (MLM). After empirically showing the unexpected effectiveness of above two steps, we systematically devise our GRIT-VLP, which adaptively samples mini-batches for more effective mining of hard negative samples for ITM while maintaining the computational cost for pre-training. Our method consists of three components: 1) GRouped mIni-baTch sampling (GRIT) strategy that collects similar examples in a mini-batch, 2) ITC consistency loss for improving the mining ability, and 3) enlarged masking probability for MLM. Consequently, we show our GRIT-VLP achieves a new state-of-the-art performance on various downstream tasks with much less computational cost. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our model is essentially in par with ALBEF, the previous state-of-the-art, only with one-third of training epochs on the same training data. Code is available at https://github.com/jaeseokbyun/GRIT-VLP.

title: Jaesung Choe, Chunghyun Park, Francois Rameau, Jaesik Park, In So Kweon
title_en: Jaesung Choe, Chunghyun Park, Francois Rameau, Jaesik Park, In So Kweon
abstract: MLP-Mixer作为CNNs和Transformer领域的新挑战者崭露头角。尽管相较于Transformer结构更为简单,但通道混合多层感知机与标记混合多层感知机的概念在图像识别任务中实现了显著性能。与图像不同,点云本质上是稀疏、无序且不规则的,这限制了MLP-Mixer在点云理解中的直接应用。为克服这些局限性,我们提出PointMixer,一种通用的点集操作符,可促进无结构3D点云之间的信息共享。通过简单地将标记混合多层感知机替换为Softmax函数,PointMixer能够实现点集内/间的特征混合。通过这种方式,PointMixer可广泛应用于集内、集间及层次化集混合。我们证明,在参数效率和准确性视角下,多种通道级特征聚合在多个点集中优于自注意力层或密集的标记级交互。大量实验表明,PointMixer在语义分割、分类和重建任务中相较于基于Transformer的方法展现出竞争力或优越性。
abstract_en: MLP-Mixer has newly appeared as a new challenger against the realm of CNNs and Transformer. Despite its simplicity compared to Transformer, the concept of channel-mixing MLPs and token-mixing MLPs achieves noticeable performance in image recognition tasks. Unlike images, point clouds are inherently sparse, unordered and irregular, which limits the direct use of MLP-Mixer for point cloud understanding. To overcome these limitations, we propose PointMixer, a universal point set operator that facilitates information sharing among unstructured 3D point cloud. By simply replacing token-mixing MLPs with Softmax function, PointMixer can “mix"" features within/between point sets. By doing so, PointMixer can be broadly used for intra-set, inter-set, and hierarchical-set mixing. We demonstrate that various channel-wise feature aggregation in numerous point sets is better than self-attention layers or dense token-wise interaction in a view of parameter efficiency and accuracy. Extensive experiments show the competitive or superior performance of PointMixer in semantic segmentation, classification, and reconstruction against Transformer-based methods.

title: Jaesung Rim, Geonung Kim, Jungeon Kim, Junyong Lee, Seungyong Lee, Sunghyun Cho
title_en: Jaesung Rim, Geonung Kim, Jungeon Kim, Junyong Lee, Seungyong Lee, Sunghyun Cho
abstract: 基于学习的去模糊方法的训练需要大量的模糊与清晰图像对。不幸的是,现有的合成数据集不够逼真,基于这些数据集训练的去模糊模型在处理真实模糊图像时效果不佳。虽然近期提出了真实数据集,但它们提供的场景和相机设置多样性有限,且在多样设置下采集真实数据集仍然具有挑战性。为了解决这一问题,本文分析了导致真实与合成模糊图像差异的各种因素。为此,我们提出了RSBlur,一个包含真实模糊图像及其对应清晰图像序列的新数据集,以实现对真实与合成模糊差异的详细分析。借助该数据集,我们揭示了模糊生成过程中不同因素的影响。基于分析结果,我们还提出了一种新颖的模糊合成流程,以生成更逼真的模糊效果。我们证明,我们的合成流程能够提升对真实模糊图像的去模糊性能。
abstract_en: Training learning-based deblurring methods demands a tremendous amount of blurred and sharp image pairs. Unfortunately, existing synthetic datasets are not realistic enough, and deblurring models trained on them cannot handle real blurred images effectively. While real datasets have recently been proposed, they provide limited diversity of scenes and camera settings, and capturing real datasets for diverse settings is still challenging. To resolve this, this paper analyzes various factors that introduce differences between real and synthetic blurred images. To this end, we present RSBlur, a novel dataset with real blurred images and the corresponding sharp image sequences to enable a detailed analysis of the difference between real and synthetic blur. With the dataset, we reveal the effects of different factors in the blur generation process. Based on the analysis, we also present a novel blur synthesis pipeline to synthesize more realistic blur. We show that our synthesis pipeline can improve the deblurring performance on real blurred images.

title: Jaewon Kam, Jungeon Kim, Soongjin Kim, Jaesik Park, Seungyong Lee
title_en: Jaewon Kam, Jungeon Kim, Soongjin Kim, Jaesik Park, Seungyong Lee
abstract: 从单张RGB-D图像成功完成深度补全需要同时提取丰富的2D和3D特征,并适当地融合这些异构特征。我们提出了一种新颖的深度补全框架CostDCNet,基于已被成功应用于多视角立体(MVS)的代价体深度估计方法。该方法实现高质量深度图估计的关键在于构建准确的代价体。为生成适用于单视角深度补全的高质量代价体,我们提出了一种简单但有效的架构,能够充分利用3D信息,提供了三种生成RGB-D特征体的选项,并采用逐平面像素洗牌技术实现高效的体体积上采样。我们的CostDCNet框架由轻量级深度神经网络组成(1.8M参数),运行实时(30ms)。尽管如此,得益于我们简单而有效的设计,CostDCNet的深度补全结果与现有最先进方法相当或更优。
abstract_en: Successful depth completion from a single RGB-D image requires both extracting plentiful 2D and 3D features and merging these heterogeneous features appropriately. We propose a novel depth completion framework, CostDCNet, based on the cost volume-based depth estimation approach that has been successfully employed for multi-view stereo (MVS). The key to high-quality depth map estimation in the approach is constructing an accurate cost volume. To produce a quality cost volume tailored to single-view depth completion, we present a simple but effective architecture that can fully exploit the 3D information, three options to make an RGB-D feature volume, and per-plane pixel shuffle for efficient volume upsampling. Our CostDCNet framework consists of lightweight deep neural networks ( 1.8M parameters), running in real time ( 30ms). Nevertheless, thanks to our simple but effective design, CostDCNet demonstrates depth completion results comparable to or better than the state-of-the-art methods.

title: Jaewon Lee, Kwang Pyo Choi, Kyong Hwan Jin
title_en: Jaewon Lee, Kwang Pyo Choi, Kyong Hwan Jin
abstract: 图像变形旨在将定义在矩形网格上的图像重塑为任意形状。近年来,隐式神经函数在以连续方式表示图像方面表现出显著的性能。然而,独立的多层感知机难以学习高频傅里叶系数。在本文中,我们提出了一种用于图像变形的局部纹理估计器(LTEW),随后采用隐式神经表示将图像变形为连续形状。从深度超分辨率(SR)主干网络估计的局部纹理通过局部变化的坐标变换雅可比矩阵相乘,以预测变形图像的傅里叶响应。我们的基于LTEW的神经函数在非对称尺度超分辨率和单应性变换方面优于现有变形方法。此外,我们的算法能够很好地泛化任意坐标变换,例如具有大放大因子的单应性变换和等距投影(ERP)透视变换,这些变换未在训练中提供。
abstract_en: Image warping aims to reshape images defined on rectangular grids into arbitrary shapes. Recently, implicit neural functions have shown remarkable performances in representing images in a continuous manner. However, a standalone multi-layer perceptron suffers from learning high-frequency Fourier coefficients. In this paper, we propose a local texture estimator for image warping (LTEW) followed by an implicit neural representation to deform images into continuous shapes. Local textures estimated from a deep super-resolution (SR) backbone are multiplied by locally-varying Jacobian matrices of a coordinate transformation to predict Fourier responses of a warped image. Our LTEW-based neural function outperforms existing warping methods for asymmetric-scale SR and homography transform. Furthermore, our algorithm well generalizes arbitrary coordinate transformations, such as homography transform with a large magnification factor and equirectangular projection (ERP) perspective transform, which are not provided in training.

title: Jaewoo Park, Nam Ik Cho
title_en: Jaewoo Park, Nam Ik Cho
abstract: 从单张RGB图像预测物体的六自由度位姿是一项基础的计算机视觉任务。通常,将变换后的物体顶点之间的距离作为位姿估计方法的目标函数。然而,这些方法未考虑相机空间中的投影几何,导致性能下降。针对这一问题,我们提出了一种基于投影网格而非物体顶点的新位姿估计系统。我们的位姿估计方法——动态投影空间变换网络(DProST)——在相机空间的射线上定位感兴趣区域网格,并通过估计的位姿将该网格转换到物体空间。转换后的网格既作为采样网格,也作为估计位姿的新准则。此外,由于DProST无需物体顶点,我们的方法可通过将网格替换为重建的特征,在无网格设置中应用。实验结果表明,无网格DProST在LINEMOD和LINEMOD-OCCLUSION数据集上优于最先进的基于网格的方法,并在YCBV数据集上与带有网格数据的方法表现相当。源代码可在https://github.com/parkjaewoo0611/DProST获取。
abstract_en: Predicting the object’s 6D pose from a single RGB image is a fundamental computer vision task. Generally, the distance between transformed object vertices is employed as an objective function for pose estimation methods. However, projective geometry in the camera space is not considered in those methods and causes performance degradation. In this regard, we propose a new pose estimation system based on a projective grid instead of object vertices. Our pose estimation method, dynamic projective spatial transformer network (DProST), localizes the region of interest grid on the rays in camera space and transforms the grid to object space by estimated pose. The transformed grid is used as both a sampling grid and a new criterion of the estimated pose. Additionally, because DProST does not require object vertices, our method can be used in a mesh-less setting by replacing the mesh with a reconstructed feature. Experimental results show that mesh-less DProST outperforms the state-of-the-art mesh-based methods on the LINEMOD and LINEMOD-OCCLUSION dataset, and shows competitive performance on the YCBV dataset with mesh data. The source code is available at https://github.com/parkjaewoo0611/DProST.

title: 韩在妍,欧世荣,金善朱
title_en: Jaeyeon Kang, Seoung Wug Oh, Seon Joo Kim
abstract: 视频修复的关键在于尽可能利用参考帧的相关信息。现有基于流的传播方法将视频合成过程分为多个步骤:流补全 -> 像素传播 -> 合成。然而存在显著缺点,即各步骤中的误差会持续累积并放大至后续步骤。为此,我们提出用于流引导视频修复的误差补偿框架(ECFVI),该框架利用基于流的方法并弥补其不足。通过新设计的流补全模块和利用误差引导图的误差补偿网络解决该问题。我们的方法显著提升了完成视频的时间一致性与视觉质量。实验结果表明,与最先进方法相比,我们的方法速度提升6倍且性能更优。此外,我们还提出新的基准数据集用于评估,通过补充现有测试数据集的不足。
abstract_en: The key to video inpainting is to use correlation information from as many reference frames as possible. Existing flow-based propagation methods split the video synthesis process into multiple steps: flow completion -> pixel propagation -> synthesis. However, there is a significant drawback that the errors in each step continue to accumulate and amplify in the next step. To this end, we propose an Error Compensation Framework for Flow-guided Video Inpainting (ECFVI), which takes advantage of the flow-based method and offsets its weaknesses. We address the weakness with the newly designed flow completion module and the error compensation network that exploits the error guidance map. Our approach greatly improves the temporal consistency and the visual quality of the completed videos. Experimental results show the superior performance of our proposed method with the speed up of ×6, compared to the state-of-the-art methods. In addition, we present a new benchmark dataset for evaluation by supplementing the weaknesses of existing test datasets.

title: James Hong, Haotian Zhang, Michaël Gharbi, Matthew Fisher, Kayvon Fatahalian
title_en: James Hong, Haotian Zhang, Michaël Gharbi, Matthew Fisher, Kayvon Fatahalian
abstract: 我们引入了在视频中定位时间精确且细粒度事件的任务(检测事件发生的确切时间点)。精确定位要求模型在全局上对动作的完整时间尺度进行推理,并在局部上识别帧间细微的外观和运动差异,以识别这些动作中的事件。令人惊讶的是,我们发现之前视频理解任务(如动作检测和分割)中表现最好的解决方案并不能同时满足这两个要求。为此,我们提出了E2E-Spot,一个紧凑的端到端模型,在精确定位任务中表现优异,并且可以在单块GPU上快速训练。我们证明E2E-Spot在精确定位任务上显著优于近期从视频动作检测、分割和定位文献中迁移的基线方法。最后,我们为多个细粒度体育动作数据集贡献了新的标注和分割,使其适用于未来关于精确定位的研究。
abstract_en: We introduce the task of spotting temporally precise, fine-grained events in video (detecting the precise moment in time events occur). Precise spotting requires models to reason globally about the full-time scale of actions and locally to identify subtle frame-to-frame appearance and motion differences that identify events during these actions. Surprisingly, we find that top performing solutions to prior video understanding tasks such as action detection and segmentation do not simultaneously meet both requirements. In response, we propose E2E-Spot, a compact, end-to-end model that performs well on the precise spotting task and can be trained quickly on a single GPU. We demonstrate that E2E-Spot significantly outperforms recent baselines adapted from the video action detection, segmentation, and spotting literature to the precise spotting task. Finally, we contribute new annotations and splits to several fine-grained sports action datasets to make these datasets suitable for future work on precise spotting.

title: Jan U. Müller, Michael Weinmann, Reinhard Klein
title_en: Jan U. Müller, Michael Weinmann, Reinhard Klein
abstract: 我们提出了一种高效且GPU加速的采样框架,该框架能够基于表面点喷涂实现可微点云渲染的无偏梯度近似。我们的框架将点对渲染图像的贡献建模为概率分布。在此模型中,我们推导出渲染函数的无偏近似梯度。为了高效评估所提出的采样估计,我们引入了一种基于树的数据结构,利用多极方法在近线性时间内进行采样。我们的梯度估计器使我们能够避免先前方法所需的正则化,从而实现更忠实的形状恢复。此外,我们验证了这些改进可应用于现实世界应用,通过优化实时SLAM系统获得的相机姿态和点云。最后,在神经渲染设置中采用我们的框架可同时优化点云和网络参数,突显了该框架增强数据驱动方法的能力。
abstract_en: We propose an efficient and GPU-accelerated sampling framework which enables unbiased gradient approximation for differentiable point cloud rendering based on surface splatting. Our framework models the contribution of a point to the rendered image as a probability distribution. We derive an unbiased approximative gradient for the rendering function within this model. To efficiently evaluate the proposed sample estimate, we introduce a tree-based data-structure which employs multi-pole methods to draw samples in near linear time. Our gradient estimator allows us to avoid regularization required by previous methods, leading to a more faithful shape recovery from images. Furthermore, we validate that these improvements are applicable to real-world applications by refining the camera poses and point cloud obtained from a real-time SLAM system. Finally, employing our framework in a neural rendering setting optimizes both the point cloud and network parameters, highlighting the framework’s ability to enhance data driven approaches.

title: Jang Hyun Cho, Philipp Krähenbühl
title_en: Jang Hyun Cho, Philipp Krähenbühl
abstract: 大规模目标检测和实例分割面临严重的数据不平衡问题。随着目标类别粒度的细化,这些类别在数据集中出现的频率会显著降低。然而在测试阶段,我们期望检测器能够对所有类别都表现出色,而不仅仅是高频类别。本文提供了对长尾检测问题的理论理解。我们展示了常用的平均平均精度(mAP)评估指标在未知测试集上的表现,如何受到基于边距的二分类错误在长尾目标检测训练集上的约束。我们通过一种新颖的替代目标函数——有效类别边距损失(ECM)来优化基于边距的二分类错误。ECM损失简单且具有坚实的理论依据,在LVIS v1基准测试中,其性能在多种架构和检测器组合下均优于其他启发式方法。代码已开源至 https://github.com/janghyuncho/ECM-Loss。
abstract_en: Large-scale object detection and instance segmentation faces a severe data imbalance. The finer-grained object classes become, the less frequent they appear in our datasets. However at test-time, we expect a detector that performs well for all classes and not just the most frequent ones. In this paper, we provide a theoretical understanding of the long-trail detection problem. We show how the commonly used mean average precision evaluation metric on an unknown test-set is bound by a margin-based binary classification error on a long-tailed object-detection training set. We optimize margin-based binary classification error with a novel surrogate objective called Effective Class-Margin Loss (ECM). The ECM loss is simple, theoretically well-motivated, and outperforms other heuristic counterparts on LVIS v1 benchmark over a wide range of architecture and detectors. Code is available at https://github.com/janghyuncho/ECM-Loss.

title: Jaskirat Singh, Cameron Smith, Jose Echevarria, Liang Zheng
title_en: Jaskirat Singh, Cameron Smith, Jose Echevarria, Liang Zheng
abstract: 基于笔触的渲染方法近年来已成为生成风格化绘画的流行解决方案。然而,当前该领域的研究主要集中在提升最终画布质量的改进上,因此常常忽视生成绘画序列对实际人类用户的可理解性。在本工作中,我们提出需要学习更具人类可理解性的绘画序列,以促进自主绘画系统在更交互式环境中的应用(例如作为人类用户的绘画辅助工具或机器人绘画应用)。为此,我们提出了一种新颖的绘画方法,该方法在生成输出画布的同时,展现出更贴近人类用户的绘画风格。所提出的绘画流程Intelli-Paint包含三个核心组件:1)一种渐进分层策略,允许智能体首先绘制自然背景场景,再以渐进方式添加每个前景物体;2)我们引入了一种新颖的序列笔触引导策略,帮助绘画智能体以语义感知的方式在不同图像区域间切换注意力;3)最后,我们提出了一种笔触正则化策略,可在不降低生成画布质量感知的前提下,将所需笔触总数减少60-80%。通过定量和定性实验结果表明,所得到的智能体不仅在输出画布生成效率上得到提升,还展现出更自然的绘画风格,能够更好地辅助人类用户通过数字艺术表达创意。
abstract_en: Stroke based rendering methods have recently become a popular solution for the generation of stylized paintings. However, the current research in this direction is focused mainly on the improvement of final canvas quality, and thus often fails to consider the intelligibility of the generated painting sequences to actual human users. In this work, we motivate the need to learn more human-intelligible painting sequences in order to facilitate the use of autonomous painting systems in a more interactive context (e.g. as a painting assistant tool for human users or for robotic painting applications). To this end, we propose a novel painting approach which learns to generate output canvases while exhibiting a painting style which is more relatable to human users. The proposed painting pipeline Intelli-Paint consists of 1) a progressive layering strategy which allows the agent to first paint a natural background scene before adding in each of the foreground objects in a progressive fashion. 2) We also introduce a novel sequential brushstroke guidance strategy which helps the painting agent to shift its attention between different image regions in a semantic-aware manner. 3) Finally, we propose a brushstroke regularization strategy which allows for 60-80% reduction in the total number of required brushstrokes without any perceivable differences in the quality of generated canvases. Through both quantitative and qualitative results, we show that the resulting agents not only show enhanced efficiency in output canvas generation but also exhibit a more natural-looking painting style which would better assist human users express their ideas through digital artwork.

title: Jaskirat Singh, Liang Zheng, Cameron Smith, Jose Echevarria
title_en: Jaskirat Singh, Liang Zheng, Cameron Smith, Jose Echevarria
abstract: 基于用户涂鸦的可控图像合成是计算机视觉领域备受关注的研究方向。在本文中,我们首次研究了从不完整且原始的人类绘画中进行逼真图像合成的问题。具体而言,我们提出了一种新颖的方法paint2pix,该方法通过学习从不完整人类绘画的流形到其真实渲染的映射,来学习预测(并适应)“用户想要绘制什么”。当与近期的自主绘画代理方法结合使用时,我们证明paint2pix可以用于从零开始进行渐进式图像合成。在此过程中,paint2pix允许新手用户逐步合成所需图像输出,仅需少量粗略的用户涂鸦即可准确引导合成过程的轨迹。此外,我们发现我们的方法还形成了一种令人惊讶的便捷真实图像编辑方法,允许用户通过添加少量精心放置的笔触,执行多样化的自定义精细编辑。
abstract_en: Controllable image synthesis with user scribbles is a topic of keen interest in the computer vision community. In this paper, for the first time we study the problem of photorealistic image synthesis from incomplete and primitive human paintings. In particular, we propose a novel approach paint2pix, which learns to predict (and adapt) “what a user wants to draw” from rudimentary brushstroke inputs, by learning a mapping from the manifold of incomplete human paintings to their realistic renderings. When used in conjunction with recent works in autonomous painting agents, we show that paint2pix can be used for progressive image synthesis from scratch. During this process, paint2pix allows a novice user to progressively synthesize the desired image output, while requiring just few coarse user scribbles to accurately steer the trajectory of the synthesis process. Furthermore, we find that our approach also forms a surprisingly convenient approach for real image editing, and allows the user to perform a diverse range of custom fine-grained edits through the addition of only a few well-placed brushstrokes.

title: Jason Y. Zhang, Deva Ramanan, Shubham Tulsiani
title_en: Jason Y. Zhang, Deva Ramanan, Shubham Tulsiani
abstract: 我们提出了一种数据驱动的方法,用于从任意物体的多张图像中推断相机视角。该任务是经典几何管线(如SfM和SLAM)的核心组件,也是当代神经方法(如NeRF)进行物体重建和视图合成的关键预处理要求。与现有基于对应关系的方法在稀疏视角下表现不佳不同,我们提出了一种自上而下的预测方法来估计相机视角。我们的关键技术洞察是使用基于能量的公式来表示相对相机旋转的分布,从而能够显式表示由物体对称性或视角产生的多个相机模式。利用这些相对预测,我们从多张图像中联合估计出一致的相机旋转集合。我们证明,我们的方法在稀疏图像上对已知和未知类别均优于最先进的SfM和SLAM方法。此外,我们的概率方法显著优于直接回归相对姿态,表明建模多模态性对于连贯的联合重建至关重要。我们展示了该系统可以作为从多视角数据集进行野外重建的基石。项目页面(包含代码和视频)可访问 https://jasonyzhang.com/relpose。
abstract_en: We describe a data-driven method for inferring the camera viewpoints given multiple images of an arbitrary object. This task is a core component of classic geometric pipelines such as SfM and SLAM, and also serves as a vital pre-processing requirement for contemporary neural approaches (e.g. NeRF) to object reconstruction and view synthesis. In contrast to existing correspondence-driven methods that do not perform well given sparse views, we propose a top-down prediction based approach for estimating camera viewpoints. Our key technical insight is the use of an energy-based formulation for representing distributions over relative camera rotations, thus allowing us to explicitly represent multiple camera modes arising from object symmetries or views. Leveraging these relative predictions, we jointly estimate a consistent set of camera rotations from multiple images. We show that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art SfM and SLAM methods given sparse images on both seen and unseen categories. Further, our probabilistic approach significantly outperforms directly regressing relative poses, suggesting that modeling multimodality is important for coherent joint reconstruction. We demonstrate that our system can be a stepping stone toward in-the-wild reconstruction from multi-view datasets. The project page with code and videos can be found at https://jasonyzhang.com/relpose.

title: Jasper Uijlings, Thomas Mensink, Vittorio Ferrari
title_en: Jasper Uijlings, Thomas Mensink, Vittorio Ferrari
abstract: 计算机视觉的发展依赖于大量可用于训练或评估新方法的数据集。然而每个数据集都有其独特的设计原则,导致标签集合、外观域和标注指令各不相同。本文探索了跨数据集的视觉语义关系的自动发现。我们希望理解数据集A中具有标签a的实例与数据集B中具有标签b的实例之间是否存在关联:它们是同一性、父子关系或重叠关系?还是两者之间没有视觉联系?为发现跨数据集的标签关系,我们提出了基于语言、基于视觉以及两者结合的方法。为评估这些方法,我们建立了COCO、ADE20k和Berkeley Deep Drive三个数据集之间的基准关系。我们的方法能够有效发现跨数据集的标签关系及其类型。我们利用这些结果深入分析实例关联的原因,发现缺失的方面,并利用关系创建更细粒度的标注。我们得出结论:仅通过标签名称的语义无法建立标签关系,关系高度依赖于每个数据集的构建方式。
abstract_en: Computer Vision is driven by the many datasets which can be used for training or evaluating novel methods. Each of these dataset, however, has its own design principles resulting in a different set of labels,different appearance domains and different annotation instructions. In this paper we explore the automatic discovery of visual-semantic relations between labels across datasets. We want to understand how the instances with label a in dataset A relate to the instances with label b in dataset B,are they in an identity, parent/child, or overlap relation? Or is there no visual link between these two? To find relations between labels across datasets,we propose methods based on language, on vision, and on a combination of both. In order to evaluate these we establish ground-truth relations between three datasets: COCO, ADE20k, and Berkeley Deep Drive. Our methods can effectively discover label relations across datasets and the type of the relations. We use these results for a deeper inspection on why instances relate, find missing aspects, and use our relations to create finer-grained annotations. We conclude that label relations cannot be established by looking at the label-name semantics alone, the relations depend highly on how each of the individual datasets was constructed.

title: Jayateja Kalla, Soma Biswas
title_en: Jayateja Kalla, Soma Biswas
abstract: 少样本类增量学习(FSCIL)旨在通过极少的标记样本逐步学习新类,同时避免遗忘已学习类的知识。FSCIL面临两大主要挑战:(i) 由于数据量有限,容易在新类上发生过拟合;(ii) 在增量阶段缺乏旧类数据,导致灾难性遗忘。本文提出一种自监督随机分类器(S3C),以应对FSCIL中的这两个挑战。分类器权重(或类原型)的随机性不仅缓解了新类样本数量不足的负面影响,也解决了增量步骤中旧类样本缺失的问题。此外,自监督组件有助于从基础类中学习具有泛化能力的特征,从而减少灾难性遗忘。在三个基准数据集上使用多种评估指标进行的广泛评估表明了所提出框架的有效性。我们还对两个额外的FSCIL现实场景进行了实验,即新类可用标注数据数量不同,以及基础类数量远少于新类的情况,结果表明所提出的S3C在所有这些具有挑战性的场景中均显著优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) aims to learn progressively about new classes with very few labeled samples, without forgetting the knowledge of already learnt classes. FSCIL suffers from two major challenges: (i) over-fitting on the new classes due to limited amount of data, (ii) catastrophically forgetting about the old classes due to unavailability of data from these classes in the incremental stages. In this work, we propose a self-supervised stochastic classifier (S3C) to counter both these challenges in FSCIL. The stochasticity of the classifier weights (or class prototypes) not only mitigates the adverse effect of absence of large number of samples of the new classes, but also the absence of samples from previously learnt classes during the incremental steps. This is complemented by the self-supervision component, which helps to learn features from the base classes which generalize well to unseen classes that are encountered in future, thus reducing catastrophic forgetting. Extensive evaluation on three benchmark datasets using multiple evaluation metrics show the effectiveness of the proposed framework. We also experiment on two additional realistic scenarios of FSCIL, namely where the number of annotated data available for each of the new classes can be different, and also where the number of base classes is much lesser, and show that the proposed S3C performs significantly better than the state-of-the-art for all these challenging scenarios.

title: Yoo Jayeon, Chung Inseop, Kwak Nojun
title_en: Jayeon Yoo, Inseop Chung, Nojun Kwak
abstract: 大多数现有的领域自适应目标检测方法利用对抗性特征对齐来将模型适应到新领域。对抗性特征对齐领域的最新进展致力于减少由于特征分布随物体类别变化而产生的对齐负面影响,即负迁移。然而,通过分析无锚点单阶段检测器的特征,本文发现负迁移可能发生,因为特征分布不仅取决于物体类别,还取决于偏移量到边界框的回归值。为了解决这一问题以获得领域不变性,我们根据偏移量值对特征进行对齐,考虑特征分布的模态。通过一种非常简单且有效的条件化方法,我们提出了一种OADA(偏移感知领域自适应目标检测器),在各种实验设置中实现了最先进的性能。此外,通过奇异值分解分析,我们发现我们的模型同时增强了判别性和迁移性。
abstract_en: Most existing domain adaptive object detection methods exploit adversarial feature alignment to adapt the model to a new domain. Recent advances in adversarial feature alignment strives to reduce the negative effect of alignment, or negative transfer, that occurs because the distribution of features varies depending on the category of objects. However, by analyzing the features of the anchor-free one-stage detector, in this paper, we find that negative transfer may occur because the feature distribution varies depending on the regression value for the offset to the bounding box as well as the category. To obtain domain invariance by addressing this issue, we align the feature conditioned on the offset value, considering the modality of the feature distribution. With a very simple and effective conditioning method, we propose OADA (Offset-Aware Domain Adaptive object detector) that achieves state-of-the-art performances in various experimental settings. In addition, by analyzing through singular value decomposition, we find that our model enhances both discriminability and transferability.

title: Jenny Schmalfuss, Philipp Scholze, Andrés Bruhn
title_en: Jenny Schmalfuss, Philipp Scholze, Andrés Bruhn
abstract: 近年来,光流方法几乎唯一地以精度为标准进行评估,而其鲁棒性往往被忽视。尽管对抗攻击为进行此类分析提供了一个有用的工具,但当前针对光流方法的攻击主要关注现实世界中的攻击场景,而非最坏情况下的鲁棒性评估。因此,在本工作中,我们提出了一种新的对抗攻击方法——扰动约束流攻击(PCFA)——该方法在现实世界攻击中更强调破坏性而非适用性。PCFA是一种全局攻击,通过优化对抗扰动使预测的光流向指定的目标光流转移,同时保持扰动的L2范数低于所选的界限。我们的实验表明PCFA在白盒和黑盒设置中均具有适用性,并展示了其发现比以往攻击更强对抗样本的能力。基于这些强样本,我们首次提供了考虑预测质量和对抗鲁棒性的光流方法联合排名,揭示了当前最先进的方法特别容易受到攻击。代码可在https://github.com/cv-stuttgart/PCFA获取。
abstract_en: Recent optical flow methods are almost exclusively judged in terms of accuracy, while their robustness is often neglected. Although adversarial attacks offer a useful tool to perform such an analysis, current attacks on optical flow methods focus on real-world attacking scenarios rather than a worst case robustness assessment. Hence, in this work, we propose a novel adversarial attack - the Perturbation-Constrained Flow Attack (PCFA) - that emphasizes destructivity over applicability as a real-world attack. PCFA is a global attack that optimizes adversarial perturbations to shift the predicted flow towards a specified target flow, while keeping the L2 norm of the perturbation below a chosen bound. Our experiments demonstrate PCFA’s applicability in white- and black-box settings, and show it finds stronger adversarial samples than previous attacks. Based on these strong samples, we provide the first joint ranking of optical flow methods considering both prediction quality and adversarial robustness, which reveals state-of-the-art methods to be particularly vulnerable. Code is available at https://github.com/cv-stuttgart/PCFA.

title: Jeong-gi Kwak, Yuanming Li, Dongsik Yoon, Donghyeon Kim, David Han, Hanseok Ko
title_en: Jeong-gi Kwak, Yuanming Li, Dongsik Yoon, Donghyeon Kim, David Han, Hanseok Ko
abstract: 近年来,二维生成对抗网络(2D GANs)在生成逼真人像方面取得了显著成果。然而,它们在生成过程中缺乏三维理解能力,因此存在多视角不一致问题。为缓解这一问题,已提出多种三维感知生成对抗网络(3D-aware GANs)并取得显著效果,但三维生成对抗网络(3D GANs)在语义属性编辑方面仍存在困难。目前对三维生成对抗网络的可控性与可解释性研究尚不充分。本工作中,我们提出两种解决方案以克服二维生成对抗网络和三维感知生成对抗网络的不足。首先,我们引入一种新型三维感知生成对抗网络SURF-GAN,该网络能够在训练过程中发现语义属性并以无监督方式对其进行控制。随后,我们将SURF-GAN的先验知识注入StyleGAN中,以获得高保真度的三维可控生成器。与现有基于潜在空间的方法允许隐式姿态控制不同,所提出的三维可控StyleGAN能够对人像生成实现显式姿态控制。这种蒸馏方法使三维控制与多种基于StyleGAN的技术(如反演和风格化)直接兼容,并在计算资源方面具有优势。我们的代码已开源于https://github.com/jgkwak95/SURF-GAN。
abstract_en: Over the years, 2D GANs have achieved great successes in photorealistic portrait generation. However, they lack 3D understanding in the generation process, thus they suffer from multi-view inconsistency problem. To alleviate the issue, many 3D-aware GANs have been proposed and shown notable results, but 3D GANs struggle with editing semantic attributes. The controllability and interpretability of 3D GANs have not been much explored. In this work, we propose two solutions to overcome these weaknesses of 2D GANs and 3D-aware GANs. We first introduce a novel 3D-aware GAN, SURF-GAN, which is capable of discovering semantic attributes during training and controlling them in an unsupervised manner. After that, we inject the prior of SURF-GAN into StyleGAN to obtain a high-fidelity 3D-controllable generator. Unlike existing latent-based methods allowing implicit pose control, the proposed 3D-controllable StyleGAN enables explicit pose control over portrait generation. This distillation allows direct compatibility between 3D control and many StyleGAN-based techniques (e.g., inversion and stylization), and also brings an advantage in terms of computational resources. Our codes are available at https://github.com/jgkwak95/SURF-GAN.

title: Jeonghun Baek, Yusuke Matsui, Kiyoharu Aizawa
title_en: Jeonghun Baek, Yusuke Matsui, Kiyoharu Aizawa
abstract: 不规则文本的识别一直是文本识别领域具有挑战性的课题。为促进该领域的研究,我们提供了一个新颖的漫画拟声词数据集(COO),其中包含日本漫画中的拟声词文本。COO包含大量任意文本,例如极端弯曲、部分压缩或任意放置的文本。此外,一些文本被分割为多个部分。每个部分都是截断文本,单独来看没有意义。这些部分需要通过链接来表达其意图含义。因此,我们提出了一种新颖的任务,用于预测截断文本之间的链接。我们通过三个任务来检测拟声词区域并捕捉其意图含义:文本检测、文本识别和链接预测。通过广泛的实验,我们分析了COO的特点。我们的数据和代码可在https://github.com/ku21fan/COO-Comic-Onomatopoeia获取。
abstract_en: Recognizing irregular texts has been a challenging topic in text recognition. To encourage research on this topic, we provide a novel comic onomatopoeia dataset (COO), which consists of onomatopoeia texts in Japanese comics. COO has many arbitrary texts, such as extremely curved, partially shrunk texts, or arbitrarily placed texts. Furthermore, some texts are separated into several parts. Each part is a truncated text and is not meaningful by itself. These parts should be linked to represent the intended meaning. Thus, we propose a novel task that predicts the link between truncated texts. We conduct three tasks to detect the onomatopoeia region and capture its intended meaning: text detection, text recognition, and link prediction. Through extensive experiments, we analyze the characteristics of the COO. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/ku21fan/COO-Comic-Onomatopoeia.

title: Jeongmin Bae, Mingi Kwon, Youngjung Uh
title_en: Jeongmin Bae, Mingi Kwon, Youngjung Uh
abstract: 面向前景的图像合成旨在生成图像及其前景掩码。一种常见方法是将图像建模为前景图像和背景图像的掩码融合。这是一个具有挑战性的问题,因为容易陷入平凡解,即其中一幅图像完全压制另一幅图像,导致掩码变为全白或全黑,前景与背景无法有意义地分离。我们提出FurryGAN,包含三个关键组件:1)同时确保前景图像和合成图像的真实性;2)设计掩码为粗粒度与细粒度掩码的组合;3)通过判别器中的辅助掩码预测器引导生成器。我们的方法能够以全无监督方式生成具有显著细节的逼真图像,其α掩码可覆盖毛发、毛皮和胡须。项目页面:\href{https://jeongminb.github.io/FurryGAN/}{https://jeongminb.github.io/FurryGAN/}
abstract_en: Foreground-aware image synthesis aims to generate images as well as their foreground masks. A common approach is to formulate an image as a masked blending of a foreground image and a background image. It is a challenging problem because it is prone to reach the trivial solution where either image overwhelms the other, i.e., the masks become completely full or empty, and the foreground and background are not meaningfully separated. We present FurryGAN with three key components: 1) imposing both the foreground image and the composite image to be realistic, 2) designing a mask as a combination of coarse and fine masks, and 3) guiding the generator by an auxiliary mask predictor in the discriminator. Our method produces realistic images with remarkably detailed alpha masks which cover hair, fur, and whiskers in a fully unsupervised manner. Project page: \href{https://jeongminb.github.io/FurryGAN/}{https://jeongminb.github.io/FurryGAN/}

title: Jhih-Ciang Wu, He-Yen Hsieh, Ding-Jie Chen, Chiou-Shann Fuh, Tyng-Luh Liu
title_en: Jhih-Ciang Wu, He-Yen Hsieh, Ding-Jie Chen, Chiou-Shann Fuh, Tyng-Luh Liu
abstract: Video anomaly detection (VAD) aims at localizing unexpected actions or activities in a video sequence. Existing mainstream VAD techniques are based on either the one-class formulation, which assumes all training data are normal, or weakly-supervised, which requires only video-level normal/anomaly labels. To establish a unified approach to solving the two VAD settings, we introduce a self-supervised sparse representation (S3R) framework that models the concept of anomaly at feature level by exploring the synergy between dictionary-based representation and self-supervised learning. With the learned dictionary, S3R facilitates two coupled modules, en-Normal and de-Normal, to reconstruct snippet-level features and filter out normal-event features. The self-supervised techniques also enable generating samples of pseudo normal/anomaly to train the anomaly detector. We demonstrate with extensive experiments that S3R achieves new state-of-the-art performances on popular benchmark datasets for both one-class and weakly-supervised VAD tasks. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/louisYen/S3R.
abstract_en: Video anomaly detection (VAD) aims at localizing unexpected actions or activities in a video sequence. Existing mainstream VAD techniques are based on either the one-class formulation, which assumes all training data are normal, or weakly-supervised, which requires only video-level normal/anomaly labels. To establish a unified approach to solving the two VAD settings, we introduce a self-supervised sparse representation (S3R) framework that models the concept of anomaly at feature level by exploring the synergy between dictionary-based representation and self-supervised learning. With the learned dictionary, S3R facilitates two coupled modules, en-Normal and de-Normal, to reconstruct snippet-level features and filter out normal-event features. The self-supervised techniques also enable generating samples of pseudo normal/anomaly to train the anomaly detector. We demonstrate with extensive experiments that S3R achieves new state-of-the-art performances on popular benchmark datasets for both one-class and weakly-supervised VAD tasks. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/louisYen/S3R.

title: Ji Yang, Xinxin Zuo, Sen Wang, Zhenbo Yu, Xingyu Li, Bingbing Ni, Minglun Gong, Li Cheng
title_en: Ji Yang, Xinxin Zuo, Sen Wang, Zhenbo Yu, Xingyu Li, Bingbing Ni, Minglun Gong, Li Cheng
abstract: 给定一张单张椅子图像,我们能否通过重建其3D形状和骨架,并进行合理的关节运动和动画,使其具有类似人体建模的动态效果?这是一个全新的问题,不仅超越了基于图像的对象重建,还涉及通用物体在三维空间中的可动动画,这可能催生众多下游增强现实和虚拟现实应用。本文提出了一种自动化方法,从单张图像完成通用3D物体的重建、绑定和动画全过程。为此,我们设计了一个两阶段的处理流程,其中包含多头结构以利用深度隐式函数进行骨架预测。同时,我们还构建了两个高保真渲染且标注骨架的通用物体3D数据集。实验结果表明,我们的方法在3D重建和骨架预测相关子任务中均显著优于现有最先进的方法。我们的代码和数据集已公开在专门的项目网站上。
abstract_en: Given a single chair image, could we wake it up by reconstructing its 3D shape and skeleton, as well as animating its plausible articulations and motions, similar to that of human modeling? It is a new problem that not only goes beyond image-based object reconstruction but also involves articulated animation of generic objects in 3D, which could give rise to numerous downstream augmented and virtual reality applications. In this paper, we propose an automated approach to tackle the entire process of reconstruct such generic 3D objects, rigging and animation, all from single images. A two-stage pipeline has thus been proposed, which specifically contains a multi-head structure to utilize the deep implicit functions for skeleton prediction. Two in-house 3D datasets of generic objects with high-fidelity rendering and annotated skeletons have also been constructed. Empirically our approach demonstrated promising results; when evaluated on the related sub-tasks of 3D reconstruction and skeleton prediction, our results surpass those of the state-of-the-arts by a noticeable margin. Our code and datasets are made publicly available at the dedicated project website.

title: 黄嘉博,金海林,龚少刚,刘阳
title_en: Jiabo Huang, Hailin Jin, Shaogang Gong, Yang Liu
abstract: 当前视频活动定位方法隐式地假设用于模型训练的活动时间边界标签是确定且精确的。然而,在非剧本自然视频中,不同活动大多平滑过渡,因此在时间轴上精确确定活动开始和结束时间本质上存在歧义。目前模型训练中忽略此类时间标签的不确定性,导致学习到的视频-文本关联关系存在偏差,测试时泛化能力较差。本文通过引入弹性时刻边界(Elastic Moment Bounding, EMB)解决该问题,以适应灵活且自适应的活动时间边界,建模具有对预设标注中底层时间不确定性的容忍度的普遍可解释视频-文本关联。具体而言,我们通过挖掘和发现最大化视频片段与查询句子对齐的帧级时间端点,自适应构建弹性边界。为实现更精确的匹配(片段内容注意力)和更鲁棒的定位(片段弹性边界),我们通过新颖的引导注意力机制,在片段级内容约束下优化帧级端点的选择。在三个视频活动定位基准数据集上的大量实验结果表明,EMB在不建模不确定性的情况下显著优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Current methods for video activity localisation over time assume implicitly that activity temporal boundaries labelled for model training are determined and precise. However, in unscripted natural videos, different activities mostly transit smoothly, so that it is intrinsically ambiguous to determine in labelling precisely when an activity starts and ends over time. Such uncertainties in temporal labelling are currently ignored in model training, resulting in learning mis-matched video-text correlation with poor generalisation in test. In this work, we solve this problem by introducing Elastic Moment Bounding (EMB) to accommodate flexible and adaptive activity temporal boundaries towards modelling universally interpretable video-text correlation with tolerance to underlying temporal uncertainties in pre-fixed annotations. Specifically, we construct elastic boundaries adaptively by mining and discovering frame-wise temporal endpoints that can maximise the alignment between video segments and query sentences. To enable both more accurate matching (segment content attention) and more robust localisation (segment elastic boundaries), we optimise the selection of frame-wise endpoints subject to segment-wise contents by a novel Guided Attention mechanism. Extensive experiments on three video activity localisation benchmarks demonstrate compellingly the EMB’s advantages over existing methods without modelling uncertainty.

title: Jiachang Hao, Haifeng Sun, Pengfei Ren, Jingyu Wang, Qi Qi, Jianxin Liao
title_en: Jiachang Hao, Haifeng Sun, Pengfei Ren, Jingyu Wang, Qi Qi, Jianxin Liao
abstract: 时序定位旨在在一个未剪辑视频中定位与给定句子查询语义对应的目标视频时刻。然而,近期研究发现现有方法存在严重的时序偏差问题。这些方法并未基于视觉-文本语义对齐来推理目标时刻位置,而是在训练集中过度依赖查询的时序偏差。为此,本文提出了一种新颖的训练框架,通过使用打乱视频来解决时序偏差问题,同时不损失定位准确性。我们的框架引入了两个辅助任务:跨模态匹配和时序顺序判别,以促进定位模型的训练。跨模态匹配任务利用打乱视频与原始视频之间内容的一致性,迫使定位模型挖掘视觉内容以语义匹配查询。时序顺序判别任务则通过时序顺序的差异强化对长期时序上下文的理解。在Charades-STA和ActivityNet Captions数据集上的大量实验验证了我们的方法在减轻对时序偏差依赖性和增强模型对不同时序分布泛化能力方面的有效性。代码已开源至https://github.com/haojc/ShufflingVideosForTSG。
abstract_en: Temporal grounding aims to locate a target video moment that semantically corresponds to the given sentence query in an untrimmed video. However, recent works find that existing methods suffer a severe temporal bias problem. These methods do not reason the target moment locations based on the visual-textual semantic alignment but over-rely on the temporal biases of queries in training sets. To this end, this paper proposes a novel training framework for grounding models to use shuffled videos to address temporal bias problem without losing grounding accuracy. Our framework introduces two auxiliary tasks, cross-modal matching and temporal order discrimination, to promote the grounding model training.
