title: Jiayuan Zhou, Lijun Wang, Huchuan Lu, Kaining Huang, Xinchu Shi, Bocong Liu
title_en: Jiayuan Zhou, Lijun Wang, Huchuan Lu, Kaining Huang, Xinchu Shi, Bocong Liu
abstract: RGB-D显著目标检测(SOD)在理解场景的3D几何结构方面具有显著优势。然而,现有的RGB-D SOD方法大多未充分挖掘深度图所传达的几何信息。本文提出了一种新框架以解决这一问题。我们通过使用深度图渲染的多个不同视角来增强输入图像,并将传统的单视角RGB-D SOD转化为多视角设置。由于不同视角捕捉了3D场景的互补上下文信息,通过多视角聚合可以显著提升检测精度。我们进一步设计了一个多视角显著性检测网络(MVSalNet),该网络首先对每个视角分别进行显著性预测,并通过融合模型整合多视角输出以生成最终的显著性预测。此外,还设计了一个动态过滤模块以促进更有效且灵活的特征提取。在6个广泛使用的数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在对比现有先进方法时具有竞争力。
abstract_en: RGB-D salient object detection (SOD) enjoys significant advantages in understanding 3D geometry of the scene. However, the geometry information conveyed by depth maps are mostly under-explored in existing RGB-D SOD methods. In this paper, we propose a new framework to address this issue. We augment the input image with multiple different views rendered using the depth maps, and cast the conventional single-view RGB-D SOD into a multi-view setting. Since different views captures complementary context of the 3D scene, the accuracy can be significantly improved through multi-view aggregation. We further design a multi-view saliency detection network (MVSalNet), which firstly performs saliency prediction for each view separately and incorporates multi-view outputs through a fusion model to produce final saliency prediction. A dynamic filtering module is also designed to facilitate more effective and flexible feature extraction. Extensive experiments on 6 widely used datasets demonstrate that our approach compares favorably against state-of-the-art approaches.

title: Jiazhen Ji, Huan Wang, Yuge Huang, Jiaxiang Wu, Xingkun Xu, Shouhong Ding, ShengChuan Zhang, Liujuan Cao, Rongrong Ji
title_en: Jiazhen Ji, Huan Wang, Yuge Huang, Jiaxiang Wu, Xingkun Xu, Shouhong Ding, ShengChuan Zhang, Liujuan Cao, Rongrong Ji
abstract: 由于其高识别准确率,人脸识别技术已被广泛应用于多个领域,包括移动设备的面部解锁、社区门禁系统和城市监控。当前高准确率的实现依赖于非常深的网络结构,因此面部图像通常需要传输到具有强大计算能力的第三方服务器进行推理。然而,面部图像直观地暴露了用户的身份信息。在此过程中,不可信的服务提供商和恶意用户会显著增加个人隐私泄露的风险。现有的隐私保护人脸识别方法往往伴随诸多副作用,如推理时间显著增加或识别准确率明显下降。本文提出一种基于频域差分隐私的人脸识别隐私保护方法。由于采用差分隐私技术,该方法在理论上提供了隐私保障。同时,准确率的损失非常微小。该方法首先将原始图像转换到频域,并去除直接成分(称为DC分量)。然后,基于差分隐私框架内后端人脸识别网络的损失,可以学习隐私预算分配方法。最后,向频域特征添加相应的噪声。根据大量实验,该方法在多个经典人脸识别测试集上表现优异。
abstract_en: Face recognition technology has been used in many fields due to its high recognition accuracy, including the face unlocking of mobile devices, community access control systems, and city surveillance. As the current high accuracy is guaranteed by very deep network structures, facial images often need to be transmitted to third-party servers with high computational power for inference. However, facial images visually reveal the user’s identity information. In this process, both untrusted service providers and malicious users can significantly increase the risk of a personal privacy breach. Current privacy-preserving approaches to face recognition are often accompanied by many side effects, such as a significant increase in inference time or a noticeable decrease in recognition accuracy. This paper proposes a privacy-preserving face recognition method using differential privacy in the frequency domain. Due to the utilization of differential privacy, it offers a guarantee of privacy in theory. Meanwhile, the loss of accuracy is very slight. This method first converts the original image to the frequency domain and removes the direct component termed DC. Then a privacy budget allocation method can be learned based on the loss of the back-end face recognition network within the differential privacy framework. Finally, it adds the corresponding noise to the frequency domain features. Our method performs very well with several classical face recognition test sets according to the extensive experiments.

title: 刘佳珍,李希荣,魏启杰,徐杰,丁大勇
title_en: Jiazhen Liu, Xirong Li, Qijie Wei, Jie Xu, Dayong Ding
abstract: 针对视网膜图像匹配(RIM)问题,我们提出了SuperRetina,这是首个端到端方法,具有可联合训练的关键点检测器和描述符。SuperRetina采用了一种新颖的半监督训练方式。一小部分(近100张)图像被不完全标注,并用于监督网络检测血管树上的关键点。为了解决手动标注的不完整性,我们提出了渐进式关键点扩展,以在每个训练周期中丰富关键点标签。通过利用基于关键点的改进三元组损失作为其描述符损失,SuperRetina在完整输入图像尺寸下生成高度判别的描述符。在多个真实世界数据集上的大量实验验证了SuperRetina的可行性。即使手动标注被自动标注取代,从而使训练过程完全无需人工标注,SuperRetina在两个RIM任务(即图像配准和身份验证)中仍优于多个强基线。
abstract_en: For retinal image matching (RIM), we propose SuperRetina, the first end-to-end method with jointly trainable keypoint detector and descriptor. SuperRetina is trained in a novel semi-supervised manner. A small set of (nearly 100) images are incompletely labeled and used to supervise the network to detect keypoints on the vascular tree. To attack the incompleteness of manual labeling, we propose Progressive Keypoint Expansion to enrich the keypoint labels at each training epoch. By utilizing a keypoint-based improved triplet loss as its description loss, SuperRetina produces highly discriminative descriptors at full input image size. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets justify the viability of SuperRetina. Even with manual labeling replaced by auto labeling and thus making the training process fully manual-annotation free, SuperRetina compares favorably against a number of strong baselines for two RIM tasks, i.e. image registration and identity verification.

title: Jichang Li, Guanbin Li, Feng Liu, Yizhou Yu
title_en: Jichang Li, Guanbin Li, Feng Liu, Yizhou Yu
abstract: 带噪声标签的学习(LNL)旨在通过减轻模型对噪声标签的过拟合效应,设计策略以提升模型性能和泛化能力。LNL的关键成功在于从海量噪声数据中尽可能多地识别干净样本,同时修正错误分配的噪声标签。近期进展利用单个样本的预测标签分布进行噪声验证和噪声标签校正,容易引发确认偏差。为缓解这一问题,我们提出邻域集体估计方法,通过将候选样本与其特征空间最近邻进行对比,重新评估其预测可靠性。具体而言,我们的方法分为两个步骤:1)邻域集体噪声验证,将所有训练样本划分为干净或噪声子集;2)邻域集体标签校正,对噪声样本进行重新标记,随后使用辅助技术进一步优化模型。在四个常用基准数据集(即CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Clothing-1M和Webvision-1.0)上的大量实验表明,所提出的方法显著优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Learning with noisy labels (LNL) aims at designing strategies to improve model performance and generalization by mitigating the effects of model overfitting to noisy labels. The key success of LNL lies in identifying as many clean samples as possible from massive noisy data, while rectifying the wrongly assigned noisy labels. Recent advances employ the predicted label distributions of individual samples to perform noise verification and noisy label correction, easily giving rise to confirmation bias. To mitigate this issue, we propose Neighborhood Collective Estimation, in which the predictive reliability of a candidate sample is re-estimated by contrasting it against its feature-space nearest neighbors. Specifically, our method is divided into two steps: 1) Neighborhood Collective Noise Verification to separate all training samples into a clean or noisy subset, 2) Neighborhood Collective Label Correction to relabel noisy samples, and then auxiliary techniques are used to assist further model optimization. Extensive experiments on four commonly used benchmark datasets, i.e., CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, Clothing-1M and Webvision-1.0, demonstrate that our proposed method considerably outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

title: Jichao Zhang, Enver Sangineto, Hao Tang, Aliaksandr Siarohin, Zhun Zhong, Nicu Sebe, Wei Wang
title_en: Jichao Zhang, Enver Sangineto, Hao Tang, Aliaksandr Siarohin, Zhun Zhong, Nicu Sebe, Wei Wang
abstract: 生成神经辐射场(GNeRF)模型通过从二维图像中提取隐式三维表示,最近被证明能够生成表示刚性/半刚性物体(如人脸或汽车)的逼真图像。然而,它们通常难以生成表示非刚性物体(如人体)的高质量图像,而人体在许多计算机图形学应用中具有重要价值。本文提出了一种三维感知语义引导生成模型(3D-SGAN),用于人体图像合成,该模型结合了GNeRF与纹理生成器。前者学习人体的隐式三维表示并输出一组二维语义分割掩码,后者将这些语义掩码转换为真实图像,为人体外观添加逼真纹理。无需额外的三维信息,我们的模型能够以照片级可控生成的方式学习三维人体表示。在DeepFashion数据集上的实验表明,3D-SGAN显著优于最新的基线模型。
abstract_en: Generative Neural Radiance Field (GNeRF) models, which extract implicit 3D representations from 2D images, have recently been shown to produce realistic images representing rigid/semi-rigid objects, such as human faces or cars. However, they usually struggle to generate high-quality images representing non-rigid objects, such as the human body, which is of a great interest for many computer graphics applications. This paper proposes a 3D-aware Semantic-Guided Generative Model (3D-SGAN) for human image synthesis, which combines a GNeRF with a texture generator. The former learns an implicit 3D representation of the human body and outputs a set of 2D semantic segmentation masks. The latter transforms these semantic masks into a real image, adding a realistic texture to the human appearance. Without requiring additional 3D information, our model can learn 3D human representations with a photo-realistic controllable generation. Our experiments on the DeepFashion dataset show that 3D-SGAN significantly outperforms the most recent baselines.

title: Jie Huang, Yajing Liu, Feng Zhao, Keyu Yan, Jinghao Zhang, Yukun Huang, Man Zhou, Zhiwei Xiong
title_en: Jie Huang, Yajing Liu, Feng Zhao, Keyu Yan, Jinghao Zhang, Yukun Huang, Man Zhou, Zhiwei Xiong
abstract: 在不正确的曝光条件下拍摄的图像不可避免地会受到亮度和结构的混合退化。大多数现有的基于深度学习的曝光校正方法在空间域中分别恢复这些退化。本文提出了一种新的曝光校正视角,即空间频率交互。具体而言,我们首先通过傅里叶变换重新审视不同曝光图像的频率特性,其中幅值分量包含大部分亮度信息,相位分量与结构信息相关。为此,我们提出了一种基于深度傅里叶变换的曝光校正网络(FECNet),该网络由幅值子网络和相位子网络组成,以逐步重建亮度和结构分量的表示。为了促进这两种表示的学习,我们在两个子网络中引入了空间频率交互(SFI)模块,该模块以两种格式处理局部空间特征和全局频率信息,以鼓励互补学习。大量实验表明,我们的FECNet在参数更少的情况下实现了优于其他方法的优越结果,并可扩展到其他图像增强任务,验证了其在广泛应用中的潜力。
abstract_en: Images captured under incorrect exposures unavoidably suffer from mixed degradations of lightness and structures. Most existing deep learning-based exposure correction methods separately restore such degradations in the spatial domain. In this paper, we present a new perspective for exposure correction with spatial-frequency interaction. Specifically, we first revisit the frequency properties of different exposure images via Fourier transform where the amplitude component contains most lightness information and the phase component is relevant to structure information. To this end, we propose a deep Fourier-based Exposure Correction Network (FECNet) consisting of an amplitude and a phase sub-networks to progressively reconstruct the representation of lightness and structure components. To facilitate learning these two representations, we introduce a Spatial-Frequency Interaction (SFI) block in two formats tailored to these two sub-networks, which interactively process the local spatial features and the global frequency information to encourage the complementary learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our FECNet achieves superior results than other methods with fewer parameters and can be extended to other image enhancement tasks, validating its potential for wide-range applications.

title: Jie Liang, Hui Zeng, Lei Zhang
title_en: Jie Liang, Hui Zeng, Lei Zhang
abstract: 高效且有效的现实世界图像超分辨率(Real-ISR)是一项具有挑战性的任务,由于现实世界图像的未知复杂退化以及实际应用中有限的计算资源。近期关于Real-ISR的研究通过建模图像退化空间取得了显著进展;然而,这些方法大多依赖于重型主干网络,并且难以灵活处理不同退化程度的图像。本文提出了一种高效且有效的退化自适应超分辨率(DASR)网络,其参数通过估计每个输入图像的退化程度自适应指定。具体而言,采用一个小型回归网络预测输入图像的退化参数,同时多个具有相同拓扑结构的卷积专家网络联合优化,通过非线性专家混合机制指定网络参数。多个专家的联合优化与退化自适应流程显著扩展了模型容量,以处理不同级别的退化,而推理仍保持高效,因为仅使用一个自适应指定的网络对输入图像进行超分辨率处理。我们的大量实验表明,DASR不仅在处理不同退化程度的真实世界图像方面比现有方法更有效,而且便于部署。代码、模型和数据集可在https://github.com/csjliang/DASR获取。
abstract_en: Efficient and effective real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR) is a challenging task due to the unknown complex degradation of real-world images and the limited computation resources in practical applications. Recent research on Real-ISR has achieved significant progress by modeling the image degradation space; however, these methods largely rely on heavy backbone networks and they are inflexible to handle images of different degradation levels. In this paper, we propose an efficient and effective degradation-adaptive super-resolution (DASR) network, whose parameters are adaptively specified by estimating the degradation of each input image. Specifically, a tiny regression network is employed to predict the degradation parameters of the input image, while several convolutional experts with the same topology are jointly optimized to specify the network parameters via a non-linear mixture of experts. The joint optimization of multiple experts and the degradation-adaptive pipeline significantly extend the model capacity to handle degradations of various levels, while the inference remains efficient since only one adaptively specified network is used for super-resolving the input image. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that DASR is not only much more effective than existing methods on handling real-world images with different degradation levels but also efficient for easy deployment. Codes, models and datasets are available at https://github.com/csjliang/DASR.

title: Jie Liu, Xiaoqing Guo, Yixuan Yuan
title_en: Jie Liu, Xiaoqing Guo, Yixuan Yuan
abstract: 开放集领域适应(OSDA)旨在解决源域和目标域之间部分共享类别分布偏移的问题,同时识别源域中未出现的目标样本。该问题的核心在于在缺乏源域相关知识的情况下,对这些各种未见过的样本进行未知类别的分类。尽管现有方法表现出色,但忽视了未知类别的复杂语义信息和巨大的类别内变化,无法有效表示复杂的分布。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种面向未知的新型学习框架(Unknown-Oriented Learning, UOL)用于OSDA,该框架由三个阶段组成:真实未知挖掘、虚假未知抑制和已知对齐。具体而言,在真实未知挖掘阶段,提出了一种配备权重差异约束的多未知检测器(Multi-Unknown Detector, MUD),以挖掘未知类别中的多样化语义信息。在虚假未知抑制阶段,构建了源到目标梯度图(Source-to-Target grAdient Graph, S2TAG),通过提出的超级置信度标准选择可靠的目标样本。随后,目标到目标梯度图(Target-to-Target grAdient Graph, T2TAG)利用梯度流形中的几何结构,为目标数据获取置信的伪标签。在最后的已知对齐阶段,将目标域中的已知样本与源域对齐,以缓解领域差异。大量实验表明,与现有最先进方法相比,我们的方法在三个基准数据集上均表现出优越性。
abstract_en: Open set domain adaptation (OSDA) aims to tackle the distribution shift of partially shared categories between the source and target domains, meanwhile identifying target samples non-appeared in source domain. The key issue behind this problem is to classify these various unseen samples as unknown category with the absent of relevant knowledge from the source domain. Though impressing performance, existing works neglect the complex semantic information and huge intra-category variation of unknown category, incapable of representing the complicated distribution. To overcome this, we propose a novel Unknown-Oriented Learning (UOL) framework for OSDA, and it is composed of three stages: true unknown excavation, false unknown suppression and known alignment. Specifically, to excavate the diverse semantic information in unknown category, the multi-unknown detector (MUD) equipped with weight discrepancy constraint is proposed in true unknown excavation. During false unknown suppression, Source-to-Target grAdient Graph (S2TAG) is constructed to select reliable target samples with the proposed super confidence criteria. Then, Target-to-Target grAdient Graph (T2TAG) exploits the geometric structure in gradient manifold to obtain confident pseudo labels for target data. At the last stage, known alignment, the known samples in the target domain are aligned with the source domain to alleviate the domain gap. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our method compared with state-of-the-art methods on three benchmarks.

title: Jie Qin, Jie Wu, Ming Li, Xuefeng Xiao, Min Zheng, Xingang Wang
title_en: Jie Qin, Jie Wu, Ming Li, Xuefeng Xiao, Min Zheng, Xingang Wang
abstract: 尽管半监督语义分割领域已取得不同程度的进展,但其近期的成功主要依赖于复杂模型,轻量化方案仍尚未被探索。我们发现现有知识蒸馏技术更关注有标签数据中的像素级概念,未能充分利用无标签数据中的信息性线索。因此,我们首次尝试通过一种新颖的多粒度蒸馏(MGD)方案提供轻量化半监督语义分割模型,其中多粒度从三个方面捕捉:i)互补教师结构;ii)有标签-无标签数据协同蒸馏;iii)分层和多层级损失设置。具体而言,MGD被构建为有标签-无标签数据协同蒸馏方案,有助于充分利用半监督设置中多样化的数据特征。通过结构互补的教师网络,建立了图像级语义敏感损失、区域级内容感知损失和像素级一致性损失,以丰富分层蒸馏抽象。在PASCAL VOC2012和Cityscapes数据集上的实验结果表明,MGD在多种划分协议下能够显著超越现有竞争方法。例如,在Cityscapes数据集的1/16划分协议下,ResNet-18和MobileNet-v2主干网络的性能分别提升了11.5%和4.6%。尽管模型主干网络的浮点运算次数(FLOPs)被压缩了3.4-5.3倍(ResNet-18)和38.7-59.6倍(MobileNetv2),但模型仍能实现令人满意的分割结果。
abstract_en: Albeit with varying degrees of progress in the field of Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation, most of its recent successes are involved in unwieldy models and the lightweight solution is still not yet explored. We find that existing knowledge distillation techniques pay more attention to pixel-level concepts from labeled data, which fails to take more informative cues within unlabeled data into account. Consequently, we offer the first attempt to provide lightweight SSSS models via a novel multi-granularity distillation (MGD) scheme, where multi-granularity is captured from three aspects: i) complementary teacher structure; ii) labeled-unlabeled data cooperative distillation; iii) hierarchical and multi-levels loss setting. Specifically, MGD is formulated as a labeled-unlabeled data cooperative distillation scheme, which helps to take full advantage of diverse data characteristics that are essential in the semi-supervised setting. Image-level semantic-sensitive loss, region-level content-aware loss, and pixel-level consistency loss are set up to enrich hierarchical distillation abstraction via structurally complementary teachers. Experimental results on PASCAL VOC2012 and Cityscapes reveal that MGD can outperform the competitive approaches by a large margin under diverse partition protocols. For example, the performance of ResNet-18 and MobileNet-v2 backbone is boosted by 11.5% and 4.6% respectively under 1/16 partition protocol on Cityscapes. Although the FLOPs of the model backbone is compressed by 3.4-5.3× (ResNet-18) and 38.7-59.6× (MobileNetv2), the model manages to achieve satisfactory segmentation results.

title: Jie Ren, Wenteng Liang, Ran Yan, Luo Mai, Shiwen Liu, Xiao Liu
title_en: Jie Ren, Wenteng Liang, Ran Yan, Luo Mai, Shiwen Liu, Xiao Liu
abstract: 大规模光束法平差(BA)需要大量内存和计算资源,而现有BA库难以满足这一需求。本文提出MegBA,一个基于GPU的分布式BA库。MegBA能够通过自动划分大规模BA问题,提供大规模聚合内存,并将子问题的求解器分配至并行节点。并行求解器采用分布式预处理共轭梯度法和分布式Schur消元法,从而高效计算出与单节点计算精度相当的有效解。为加速BA计算,我们利用商用GPU上的高性能原语实现端到端BA计算。MegBA提供了易于使用的API,兼容现有主流BA库。实验表明,MegBA在多个大规模BA基准测试中显著优于现有最先进的BA库:Ceres(41.45×)、RootBA(64.576×)和DeepLM(6.769×)。
abstract_en: Large-scale Bundle Adjustment (BA) requires massive memory and computation resources which are difficult to be fulfilled by existing BA libraries. In this paper, we propose MegBA, a GPU-based distributed BA library. MegBA can provide massive aggregated memory by automatically partitioning large BA problems, and assigning the solvers of sub-problems to parallel nodes. The parallel solvers adopt distributed Precondition Conjugate Gradient and distributed Schur Elimination, so that an effective solution, which can match the precision of those computed by a single node, can be efficiently computed. To accelerate BA computation, we implement end-to-end BA computation using high-performance primitives available on commodity GPUs. MegBA exposes easy-to-use APIs that are compatible with existing popular BA libraries. Experiments show that MegBA can significantly outperform state-of-the-art BA libraries: Ceres (41.45×), RootBA (64.576×) and DeepLM (6.769×) in several large-scale BA benchmarks.

title: Jiefeng Li, Siyuan Bian, Chao Xu, Gang Liu, Gang Yu, Cewu Lu
title_en: Jiefeng Li, Siyuan Bian, Chao Xu, Gang Liu, Gang Yu, Cewu Lu
abstract: 3D human pose estimation from a monocular video has recently seen significant improvements. However, most state-of-the-art methods are kinematics-based, which are prone to physically implausible motions with pronounced artifacts. Current dynamics-based methods can predict physically plausible motion but are restricted to simple scenarios with static camera view. In this work, we present D&D (Learning Human Dynamics from Dynamic Camera), which leverages the laws of physics to reconstruct 3D human motion from the in-the-wild videos with a moving camera. D&D introduces inertial force control (IFC) to explain the 3D human motion in the non-inertial local frame by considering the inertial forces of the dynamic camera. To learn the ground contact with limited annotations, we develop probabilistic contact torque (PCT), which is computed by differentiable sampling from contact probabilities and used to generate motions. The contact state can be weakly supervised by encouraging the model to generate correct motions. Furthermore, we propose an attentive PD controller that adjusts target pose states using temporal information to obtain smooth and accurate pose control. Our approach is entirely neural-based and runs without offline optimization or simulation in physics engines. Experiments on large-scale 3D human motion benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of D&D, where we exhibit superior performance against both state-of-the-art kinematics-based and dynamics-based methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Jeff-sjtu/DnD

title: Jiehong Lin, Zewei Wei, Changxing Ding, Kui Jia
title_en: Jiehong Lin, Zewei Wei, Changxing Ding, Kui Jia
abstract: 在三维空间中精确标注物体实例及其语义具有挑战性,因此合成数据被广泛用于此类任务,例如类别级6D物体姿态和尺寸估计。然而,合成域中的简单标注带来了仿真到真实(Sim2Real)领域差距的负面影响。本文旨在解决Sim2Real任务设置下的这一问题,即类别级6D物体姿态和尺寸估计的无监督领域自适应问题。我们提出了一种基于新型深度先验变形网络(Deep Prior Deformation Network,简称DPDN)的方法。DPDN学习将类别形状先验的特征变形以匹配物体观测特征,从而能够在特征空间中建立深层对应关系,直接回归物体姿态和尺寸。为减少Sim2Real领域差距,我们通过一致性学习在DPDN上构建了新的自监督目标;具体而言,我们对每个物体观测并行应用两种刚性变换,并分别输入DPDN以生成双重预测集;在并行学习基础上,引入跨一致性项以保持双重预测间的交叉一致性,提升DPDN对姿态变化的敏感性,同时使用个体内一致性项强化每个学习过程的自适应能力。我们在合成数据集CAMERA25和真实数据集REAL275的训练集上训练DPDN;实验结果在REAL275测试集上优于现有方法,无论是在无监督还是监督设置下。消融实验也验证了设计的有效性。我们的代码已公开在https://github.com/JiehongLin/Self-DPDN。
abstract_en: It is difficult to precisely annotate object instances and their semantics in 3D space, and as such, synthetic data are extensively used for these tasks, e.g., category-level 6D object pose and size estimation. However, the easy annotations in synthetic domains bring the downside effect of synthetic-to-real (Sim2Real) domain gap. In this work, we aim to address this issue in the task setting of Sim2Real, unsupervised domain adaptation for category-level 6D object pose and size estimation. We propose a method that is built upon a novel Deep Prior Deformation Network, shortened as DPDN. DPDN learns to deform features of categorical shape priors to match those of object observations, and is thus able to establish deep correspondence in the feature space for direct regression of object poses and sizes. To reduce the Sim2Real domain gap, we formulate a novel self-supervised objective upon DPDN via consistency learning; more specifically, we apply two rigid transformations to each object observation in parallel, and feed them into DPDN respectively to yield dual sets of predictions; on top of the parallel learning, an inter-consistency term is employed to keep cross consistency between dual predictions for improving the sensitivity of DPDN to pose changes, while individual intra-consistency ones are used to enforce self-adaptation within each learning itself. We train DPDN on both training sets of the synthetic CAMERA25 and real-world REAL275 datasets; our results outperform the existing methods on REAL275 test set under both the unsupervised and supervised settings. Ablation studies also verify the efficacy of our designs. Our code is released publicly at https://github.com/JiehongLin/Self-DPDN.

title: Jiepeng Wang, Peng Wang, Xiaoxiao Long, Christian Theobalt, Taku Komura, Lingjie Liu, Wenping Wang
title_en: Jiepeng Wang, Peng Wang, Xiaoxiao Long, Christian Theobalt, Taku Komura, Lingjie Liu, Wenping Wang
abstract: 从2D图像重建3D室内场景是许多计算机视觉和图形学应用中的重要任务。该任务的主要挑战在于,典型室内场景中大面积无纹理区域会使现有方法难以生成令人满意的重建结果。我们提出了一种新的方法NeuRIS,用于高质量重建室内场景。NeuRIS的核心思想是将估计的室内场景法线向量作为先验信息,集成到神经渲染框架中,以重建大范围无纹理形状,并且重要的是,以自适应方式实现对具有精细细节的不规则形状的重建。具体而言,我们在优化过程中通过检查重建的多视角一致性,实时评估法线先验的可信度。仅将被判定为可信的法线先验用于3D重建,这通常发生在平滑形状可能伴有弱纹理的区域。然而,对于包含小型物体或薄结构的区域,由于法线先验通常不可靠,我们仅依赖输入图像的视觉特征,因为此类区域通常包含相对丰富的视觉特征(如阴影变化和边界轮廓)。大量实验表明,NeuRIS在重建质量方面显著优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Reconstructing 3D indoor scenes from 2D images is an important task in many computer vision and graphics applications. A main challenge in this task is that large texture-less areas in typical indoor scenes make existing methods struggle to produce satisfactory reconstruction results. We propose a new method, dubbed NeuRIS, for high-quality reconstruction of indoor scenes. The key idea of NeuRIS is to integrate estimated normal vectors of indoor scenes as a prior in a neural rendering framework for reconstructing large texture-less shapes and, importantly, does so in an adaptive manner to also enable the reconstruction of irregular shapes with fine details. Specifically, we evaluate the faithfulness of the normal priors on-the-fly by checking the multi-view consistency of reconstruction during the optimization process. Only the normal priors accepted as faithful will be utilized for 3D reconstruction, which typically happens in regions of smooth shapes possibly with weak texture. However, for those regions with small objects or thin structure, for which the normal priors are usually unreliable, we will only rely on visual features of the input images, since such regions typically contain relatively rich visual features (e.g., shade changes and boundary contours). Extensive experiments show that NeuRIS significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art methods in terms of reconstruction quality.

title: Jieru Mei, Alex Zihao Zhu, Xinchen Yan, Hang Yan, Siyuan Qiao, Yukun Zhu, Liang-Chieh Chen, Henrik Kretzschmar
title_en: Jieru Mei, Alex Zihao Zhu, Xinchen Yan, Hang Yan, Siyuan Qiao, Yukun Zhu, Liang-Chieh Chen, Henrik Kretzschmar
abstract: 全景图像分割是计算机视觉任务,旨在识别图像中的像素组,并为其分配语义类别和对象实例标识符。由于其在机器人技术和自动驾驶等关键领域的应用,图像分割研究日益受到关注。研究社区因此依赖公开的基准数据集来推动计算机视觉的最先进水平。然而,由于密集标注图像的成本高昂,目前适合全景分割的真实标签数据集存在短缺。高昂的标注成本也使得现有数据集向视频领域和多摄像头设置扩展变得困难。因此,我们提出了Waymo Open Dataset:全景视频全景分割数据集,这是一个大规模数据集,为自动驾驶提供了高质量的全景分割标签。我们利用公开的Waymo Open Dataset(WOD)生成该数据集,利用其多样化的摄像头图像。我们的标签在视频处理中具有时间一致性,并且在车辆上安装的多个摄像头之间保持一致性,以实现完整的全景场景理解。具体而言,我们为28个语义类别提供了标签,并包含由五辆自动驾驶车辆在三个不同地理区域拍摄的2,860个时间序列,总计10万张标注的摄像头图像。据我们所知,这使得我们的数据集规模比现有提供视频全景分割标签的数据集大一个数量级。我们进一步提出了全景视频全景分割的新基准,并基于DeepLab模型家族建立了多个强大的基线。我们已公开了该基准和代码,希望促进未来对整体场景理解的研究。我们的数据集可在以下链接获取:https://waymo.com/open/
abstract_en: Panoptic image segmentation is the computer vision task of finding groups of pixels in an image and assigning semantic classes and object instance identifiers to them. Research in image segmentation has become increasingly popular due to its critical applications in robotics and autonomous driving. The research community thereby relies on publicly available benchmark dataset to advance the state-of-the-art in computer vision. Due to the high costs of densely labeling the images, however, there is a shortage of publicly available ground truth labels that are suitable for panoptic segmentation. The high labeling costs also make it challenging to extend existing datasets to the video domain and to multi-camera setups. We therefore present the Waymo Open Dataset: Panoramic Video Panoptic Segmentation dataset, a large-scale dataset that offers high-quality panoptic segmentation labels for autonomous driving. We generate our dataset using the publicly available Waymo Open Dataset (WOD), leveraging the diverse set of camera images. Our labels are consistent over time for video processing and consistent across multiple cameras mounted on the vehicles for full panoramic scene understanding. Specifically, we offer labels for 28 semantic categories and 2,860 temporal sequences that were captured by five cameras mounted on autonomous vehicles driving in three different geographical locations, leading to a total of 100k labeled camera images. To the best of our knowledge, this makes our dataset an order of magnitude larger than existing datasets that offer video panoptic segmentation labels. We further propose a new benchmark for Panoramic Video Panoptic Segmentation and establish a number of strong baselines based on the DeepLab family of models. We have made the benchmark and the code publicly available, which we hope will facilitate future research on holistic scene understanding. Our dataset can be found at: https://waymo.com/open/

title: Jiezhang Cao, Jingyun Liang, Kai Zhang, Wenguan Wang, Qin Wang, Yulun Zhang, Hao Tang, Luc Van Gool
title_en: Jiezhang Cao, Jingyun Liang, Kai Zhang, Wenguan Wang, Qin Wang, Yulun Zhang, Hao Tang, Luc Van Gool
abstract: 本文研究了一个实际的时空视频超分辨率(STVSR)问题,旨在从低帧率低分辨率模糊视频生成高帧率高分辨率清晰视频。此类问题常出现在使用低帧率和低分辨率相机记录快速动态事件时,所捕获的视频通常会面临三个典型问题:i)由于物体/相机在曝光期间的运动导致运动模糊;ii)当事件时间频率超过时间采样奈奎斯特极限时,不可避免地出现运动混叠;iii)由于空间采样率较低,高频细节丢失。这些问题可以通过依次执行三个独立的子任务(视频去模糊、帧插值和超分辨率)来缓解,但这些方法无法捕捉视频序列中的空间和时间相关性。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种可解释的STVSR框架,结合模型驱动和学习驱动方法。具体而言,我们将STVSR建模为联合视频去模糊、帧插值和超分辨率问题,并通过交替求解两个子问题来解决。对于第一个子问题,我们推导出一个可解释的解析解,并将其作为傅里叶数据变换层。随后,我们提出一个循环视频增强层用于第二个子问题,以进一步恢复高频细节。大量实验表明,我们的方法在定量指标和视觉质量方面均优于现有方法。
abstract_en: In this paper, we study a practical space-time video super-resolution (STVSR) problem which aims at generating a high-framerate high-resolution sharp video from a low-framerate low-resolution blurry video. Such problem often occurs when recording a fast dynamic event with a low-framerate and low-resolution camera, and the captured video would suffer from three typical issues: i) motion blur occurs due to object/camera motions during exposure time; ii) motion aliasing is unavoidable when the event temporal frequency exceeds the Nyquist limit of temporal sampling; iii) high-frequency details are lost because of the low spatial sampling rate. These issues can be alleviated by a cascade of three separate sub-tasks, including video deblurring, frame interpolation, and super-resolution, which, however, would fail to capture the spatial and temporal correlations among video sequences. To address this, we propose an interpretable STVSR framework by leveraging both model-based and learning-based methods. Specifically, we formulate STVSR as a joint video deblurring, frame interpolation, and super-resolution problem, and solve it as two sub-problems in an alternate way. For the first sub-problem, we derive an interpretable analytical solution and use it as a Fourier data transform layer. Then, we propose a recurrent video enhancement layer for the second sub-problem to further recover high-frequency details. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our method in terms of quantitative metrics and visual quality.

title: Jiezhang Cao, Jingyun Liang, Kai Zhang, Yawei Li, Yulun Zhang, Wenguan Wang, Luc Van Gool
title_en: Jiezhang Cao, Jingyun Liang, Kai Zhang, Yawei Li, Yulun Zhang, Wenguan Wang, Luc Van Gool
abstract: 基于参考图像的图像超分辨率(RefSR)旨在利用辅助参考(Ref)图像来提升低分辨率(LR)图像的分辨率。近年来,RefSR因其提供了一种超越单图像超分辨率(SR)的替代方法而受到广泛关注。然而,解决RefSR问题存在两个关键挑战:(i)当LR图像和Ref图像差异显著时,难以匹配它们之间的对应关系;(ii)如何将Ref图像中的相关纹理转移到LR图像以补偿细节是一个非常具有挑战性的问题。为了解决这些RefSR问题,本文提出了一种具有多尺度的可变形注意力Transformer,即DATSR,每个尺度由一个纹理特征编码器(TFE)模块、一个基于参考的可变形注意力(RDA)模块和一个残差特征聚合(RFA)模块组成。具体而言,TFE首先提取对图像变换(例如亮度)不敏感的LR和Ref图像特征,RDA随后可以利用多种相关纹理来补偿LR特征中的更多信息,而RFA最后将LR特征和相关纹理聚合,以获得更符合视觉愉悦的结果。大量实验表明,我们的DATSR在基准数据集上实现了最先进的定量和定性性能。
abstract_en: Reference-based image super-resolution (RefSR) aims to exploit auxiliary reference (Ref) images to super-resolve low-resolution (LR) images. Recently, RefSR has been attracting great attention as it provides an alternative way to surpass single image SR. However, addressing the RefSR problem has two critical challenges: (i) It is difficult to match the correspondence between LR and Ref images when they are significantly different; (ii) How to transfer the relevant texture from Ref images to compensate the details for LR images is very challenging. To address these issues of RefSR, this paper proposes a deformable attention Transformer, namely DATSR, with multiple scales, each of which consists of a texture feature encoder (TFE) module, a reference-based deformable attention (RDA) module and a residual feature aggregation (RFA) module. Specifically, TFE first extracts image transformation (e.g., brightness) insensitive features for LR and Ref images, RDA then can exploit multiple relevant textures to compensate more information for LR features, and RFA lastly aggregates LR features and relevant textures to get a more visually pleasant result. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our DATSR achieves state-of-the-art performance on benchmark datasets quantitatively and qualitatively.

title: Jihao Liu, Boxiao Liu, Hang Zhou, Hongsheng Li, Yu Liu
title_en: Jihao Liu, Boxiao Liu, Hang Zhou, Hongsheng Li, Yu Liu
abstract: CutMix是一种广泛用于训练现代卷积和Transformer视觉网络的增强技术。它最初设计用于鼓励卷积神经网络(CNNs)更多关注图像的全局上下文而非局部信息,这显著提升了CNNs的性能。然而,我们发现该技术对天然具有全局感受野的Transformer架构提升有限。本文提出了一种新颖的数据增强技术TokenMix,以提升视觉Transformer的性能。TokenMix通过将混合区域划分为多个独立部分,在标记级别混合两幅图像。此外,我们指出CutMix中混合学习目标(一对真实标签的线性组合)可能不准确且有时与直觉相悖。为获得更合适的训练目标,我们提出根据预训练教师模型生成的基于内容的神经激活图,为两幅图像分配目标得分,而无需教师模型具有高性能。通过在多种视觉Transformer架构上进行大量实验,我们证明TokenMix有助于视觉Transformer聚焦前景区域进行类别推理,并增强其对遮挡的鲁棒性,取得一致的性能提升。值得注意的是,我们提升了DeiT-T/S/B模型的ImageNet top-1准确率+1%。此外,TokenMix支持更长的训练周期,使用DeiT-S在400个epoch训练下达到81.2%的ImageNet top-1准确率。
abstract_en: CutMix is a popular augmentation technique commonly used for training modern convolutional and transformer vision networks. It was originally designed to encourage Convolution Neural Networks (CNNs) to focus more on an image’s global context instead of local information, which greatly improves the performance of CNNs. However, we found it to have limited benefits for transformer-based architectures that naturally have a global receptive field. In this paper, we propose a novel data augmentation technique TokenMix to improve the performance of vision transformers. TokenMix mixes two images at token level via partitioning the mixing region into multiple separated parts. Besides, we show that the mixed learning target in CutMix, a linear combination of a pair of the ground truth labels, might be inaccurate and sometimes counter-intuitive. To obtain a more suitable target, we propose to assign the target score according to the content-based neural activation maps of the two images from a pre-trained teacher model, which does not need to have high performance. With plenty of experiments on various vision transformer architectures, we show that our proposed TokenMix helps vision transformers focus on the foreground area to infer the classes and enhances their robustness to occlusion, with consistent performance gains. Notably, we improve DeiT-T/S/B with +1% ImageNet top-1 accuracy. Besides, TokenMix enjoys longer training, which achieves 81.2% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet with DeiT-S trained for 400 epochs.

title: Jihao Liu, Xin Huang, Guanglu Song, Hongsheng Li, Yu Liu
title_en: Jihao Liu, Xin Huang, Guanglu Song, Hongsheng Li, Yu Liu
abstract: 近年来,Transformer和多层感知机(MLP)架构在各种视觉任务中取得了显著成果。然而,如何有效结合这些操作符以构建高性能的混合视觉架构仍然是一个挑战。在本文中,我们通过提出一种新颖的统一架构搜索方法,研究卷积、Transformer和MLP的可学习组合。我们的方法包含两个关键设计以实现高性能网络的搜索。首先,我们将差异极大的可搜索操作符统一建模,从而使操作符能够通过相同的配置参数集进行表征。这样,整体搜索空间规模显著减小,总搜索成本变得可承受。其次,我们提出上下文感知的下采样模块(DSMs),以缓解不同类型操作符之间的差距。我们的DSMs能够更好地适应不同类型操作符的特征,这对于识别高性能混合架构至关重要。最后,我们将可配置操作符和DSMs整合到统一的搜索空间中,并采用基于强化学习的搜索算法进行搜索,以充分探索操作符的最优组合。为此,我们搜索了一个基线网络并对其进行扩展,获得了一组名为UniNets的模型,其准确率和效率均优于之前的ConvNets和Transformer。特别是,我们的UniNet-B5在ImageNet上实现了84.9%的top-1准确率,分别比EfficientNet-B7和BoTNet-T7少44%和55%的FLOPs。通过在ImageNet-21K上预训练,我们的UniNet-B6达到了87.4%的准确率,比Swin-L少51%的FLOPs和41%的参数。
abstract_en: Recently, transformer and multi-layer perceptron (MLP) architectures have achieved impressive results on various vision tasks. However, how to effectively combine those operators to form high-performance hybrid visual architectures still remains a challenge. In this work, we study the learnable combination of convolution, transformer, and MLP by proposing a novel unified architecture search approach. Our approach contains two key designs to achieve the search for high-performance networks. First, we model the very different searchable operators in a unified form and thus enable the operators to be characterized with the same set of configuration parameters. In this way, the overall search space size is significantly reduced, and the total search cost becomes affordable. Second, we propose context-aware downsampling modules (DSMs) to mitigate the gap between the different types of operators. Our proposed DSMs are able to better adapt features from different types of operators, which is important for identifying high-performance hybrid architectures. Finally, we integrate configurable operators and DSMs into a unified search space and search with a Reinforcement Learning-based search algorithm to fully explore the optimal combination of the operators. To this end, we search a baseline network and scale it up to obtain a family of models, named UniNets, which achieve much better accuracy and efficiency than previous ConvNets and Transformers. In particular, our UniNet-B5 achieves 84.9% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet, outperforming EfficientNet-B7 and BoTNet-T7 with 44% and 55% fewer FLOPs respectively. By pretraining on the ImageNet-21K, our UniNet-B6 achieves 87.4%, outperforming Swin-L with 51% fewer FLOPs and 41% fewer parameters.

title: Jihyong Oh, Munchurl Kim
title_en: Jihyong Oh, Munchurl Kim
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的联合去模糊与多帧插值(DeMFI)框架,称为DeMFINet,该框架通过两阶段方式将低帧率模糊视频转换为高帧率清晰视频。该框架基于流引导的注意力相关特征增强(FAC-FB)模块和递归增强(RB),在多帧插值(MFI)方面进行优化。其基线版本通过FAC-FB模块进行特征流引导的变形,以获得清晰插值帧并同时去模糊两个中心输入帧。其扩展版本进一步基于像素流引导的变形与基于门控循环单元(GRU)的RB提升了联合性能。我们的FAC-FB模块能够有效收集模糊输入帧在特征域中分散的模糊像素信息,从而提升联合性能。通过递归增强损失训练的RB使DeMFI-Net在推理阶段即使训练完成后也能适当选择更少的RB迭代次数以实现更快的运行速度。因此,我们的DeMFI-Net在多个数据集上实现了显著优于近期联合方法的最先进(SOTA)性能。所有源代码,包括预训练的DeMFI-Net,均可在https://github.com/JihyongOh/DeMFI获取。
abstract_en: We propose a novel joint deblurring and multi-frame interpolation (DeMFI) framework in a two-stage manner, called DeMFINet, which converts blurry videos of lower-frame-rate to sharp videos at higher-frame-rate based on flow-guided attentive-correlation-based feature bolstering (FAC-FB) module and recursive boosting (RB), in terms of multi-frame interpolation (MFI). Its baseline version performs featureflow-based warping with FAC-FB module to obtain a sharp-interpolated frame as well to deblur two center-input frames. Its extended version further improves the joint performance based on pixel-flow-based warping with GRU-based RB. Our FAC-FB module effectively gathers the distributed blurry pixel information over blurry input frames in featuredomain to improve the joint performances. RB trained with recursive boosting loss enables DeMFI-Net to adequately select smaller RB iterations for a faster runtime during inference, even after the training is finished. As a result, our DeMFI-Net achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performances for diverse datasets with significant margins compared to recent joint methods. All source codes, including pretrained DeMFI-Net, are publicly available at https://github.com/JihyongOh/DeMFI.

title: Jim Davis, Logan Frank
title_en: Jim Davis, Logan Frank
abstract: 批量归一化(BN)由归一化组件和仿射变换组成,已成为训练深度神经网络的关键步骤。网络中每个BN的标准初始化将仿射变换的缩放和偏移量分别设置为1和0。然而,经过训练后,我们发现这些参数与初始化值相比变化不大。此外,我们注意到归一化过程仍可能产生过大的值,这对训练是不利的。我们重新审视BN的公式,并提出一种新的BN初始化方法和更新方法,以解决上述问题。实验设计旨在强调和展示适当的BN缩放初始化对性能的积极影响,并使用严格的统计显著性检验进行评估。该方法可以在现有实现中使用,且无需额外的计算成本。源代码可在https://github.com/osu-cvl/revisiting-bn-init获取。
abstract_en: Batch normalization (BN) is comprised of a normalization component followed by an affine transformation and has become essential for training deep neural networks. Standard initialization of each BN in a network sets the affine transformation scale and shift to 1 and 0, respectively. However, after training we have observed that these parameters do not alter much from their initialization. Furthermore, we have noticed that the normalization process can still yield overly large values, which is undesirable for training. We revisit the BN formulation and present a new initialization method and update approach for BN to address the aforementioned issues. Experiments are designed to emphasize and demonstrate the positive influence of proper BN scale initialization on performance, and use rigorous statistical significance tests for evaluation. The approach can be used with existing implementations at no additional computational cost. Source code is available at https://github.com/osu-cvl/revisiting-bn-init.

title: Jin Wan, Hui Yin, Zhenyao Wu, Xinyi Wu, Yanting Liu, Song Wang
title_en: Jin Wan, Hui Yin, Zhenyao Wu, Xinyi Wu, Yanting Liu, Song Wang
abstract: 阴影去除是图像修复中的重要课题,能够为许多计算机视觉任务带来益处。当前最先进的阴影去除方法通常通过深度学习,最小化去阴影区域与对应(伪)无阴影版本之间的像素级差异。在完成阴影去除后,阴影区域与非阴影区域可能出现不一致的外观,导致图像视觉上不协调。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种风格引导的阴影去除网络(SG-ShadowNet),以提升阴影去除后的图像风格一致性。在SG-ShadowNet中,我们首先通过一个简单的区域风格估计器学习非阴影区域的风格表示。随后,我们提出了一种新颖有效的归一化策略,利用区域级风格调整初步覆盖的阴影区域,使其更与图像其余部分协调一致。大量实验表明,我们的SG-ShadowNet在ISTD+、SRD和视频阴影去除基准数据集上均优于现有竞争模型,取得了新的最先进性能。代码已开源:https://github.com/jinwan1994/SG-ShadowNet
abstract_en: Shadow removal is an important topic in image restoration, and it can benefit many computer vision tasks. State-of-the-art shadow-removal methods typically employ deep learning by minimizing a pixel-level difference between the de-shadowed region and their corresponding (pseudo) shadow-free version. After shadow removal, the shadow and non-shadow regions may exhibit inconsistent appearance, leading to a visually disharmonious image. To address this problem, we propose a style-guided shadow removal network (SG-ShadowNet) for better image style consistency after shadow removal. In SG-ShadowNet, we first learn the style representation of the non-shadow region via a simple region style estimator. Then we propose a novel effective normalization strategy with the region-level style to adjust the coarsely re-covered shadow region to be more harmonized with the rest of the image. Extensive experiments show that our proposed SG-ShadowNet outperforms all the existing competitive models and achieves a new state-of-the-art performance on ISTD+, SRD, and Video Shadow Removal benchmark datasets. Code is available at: https://github.com/jinwan1994/SG-ShadowNet.

title: Jindong Gu, Hengshuang Zhao, Volker Tresp, Philip H. S. Torr
title_en: Jindong Gu, Hengshuang Zhao, Volker Tresp, Philip H. S. Torr
abstract: 基于深度神经网络的图像分类容易受到对抗性扰动的影响。通过向输入图像添加人工的小且难以察觉的扰动,图像分类可以被轻易欺骗。作为最有效的防御策略之一,对抗训练被提出以解决分类模型的脆弱性,其中在训练过程中会生成并注入对抗样本到训练数据中。近年来,分类模型的攻击与防御已被广泛研究。语义分割作为分类的扩展,也受到了广泛关注。近期研究表明,需要大量攻击迭代才能生成有效欺骗分割模型的对抗样本。这一观察结果使得分割模型的鲁棒性评估和对抗训练面临挑战。在本工作中,我们提出了一种高效且有效的分割攻击方法,称为SegPGD。此外,我们提供了收敛性分析,证明在相同攻击迭代次数下,所提出的SegPGD能够生成比PGD更有效的对抗样本。进一步地,我们提出将SegPGD作为分割对抗训练的基础攻击方法。由于SegPGD能够生成更有效的对抗样本,使用SegPGD进行对抗训练可以提升分割模型的鲁棒性。我们的方法已在流行的分割模型架构和标准分割数据集上进行了实验验证。
abstract_en: Deep neural network-based image classifications are vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. The image classifications can be easily fooled by adding artificial small and imperceptible perturbations to input images. As one of the most effective defense strategies, adversarial training was proposed to address the vulnerability of classification models, where the adversarial examples are created and injected into training data during training. The attack and defense of classification models have been intensively studied in past years. Semantic segmentation, as an extension of classifications, has also received great attention recently. Recent work shows a large number of attack iterations are required to create effective adversarial examples to fool segmentation models. The observation makes both robustness evaluation and adversarial training on segmentation models challenging. In this work, we propose an effective and efficient segmentation attack method, dubbed SegPGD. Besides, we provide a convergence analysis to show the proposed SegPGD can create more effective adversarial examples than PGD under the same number of attack iterations. Furthermore, we propose to apply our SegPGD as the underlying attack method for segmentation adversarial training. Since SegPGD can create more effective adversarial examples, the adversarial training with our SegPGD can boost the robustness of segmentation models. Our proposals are also verified with experiments on popular Segmentation model architectures and standard segmentation datasets.

title: Jindong Gu, Volker Tresp, Yao Qin
title_en: Jindong Gu, Volker Tresp, Yao Qin
abstract: 近年来,视觉Transformer(ViT)在图像分类任务中表现出色,这使其成为卷积神经网络(CNN)的有前景的替代方案。与CNN不同,ViT将输入图像表示为图像块的序列。基于图像块的输入表示引发了以下问题:当单个输入图像块受到自然损坏或对抗性扰动时,ViT相比CNN的表现如何?在本工作中,我们研究了ViT对块级扰动的鲁棒性。令人惊讶的是,我们发现ViT对自然损坏的图像块比CNN更具鲁棒性,但对对抗性图像块更为脆弱。进一步地,我们发现注意力机制显著影响视觉Transformer的鲁棒性。具体而言,注意力模块可以通过有效忽略自然损坏的图像块来提升ViT的鲁棒性。然而,当ViT受到对抗攻击时,注意力机制容易被误导而过度关注对抗性扰动的图像块,从而导致错误。基于我们的分析,我们提出了一种基于温度缩放的简单方法以提升ViT对对抗性图像块的鲁棒性。我们进行了大量定性和定量实验,以支持我们的发现、对ViT块级扰动鲁棒性的理解以及在多种基于Transformer的架构上的改进。
abstract_en: Recent advances in Vision Transformer (ViT) have demonstrated its impressive performance in image classification, which makes it a promising alternative to Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Unlike CNNs, ViT represents an input image as a sequence of image patches. The patch-based input image representation makes the following question interesting: How does ViT perform when individual input image patches are perturbed with natural corruptions or adversarial perturbations, compared to CNNs? In this work, we study the robustness of ViT to patch-wise perturbations. Surprisingly, we {find} that ViTs are more robust to naturally corrupted patches than CNNs, whereas they are more vulnerable to adversarial patches. Furthermore, we discover that the attention mechanism greatly affects the robustness of vision transformers. Specifically, the attention module can help improve the robustness of ViT by effectively ignoring natural corrupted patches. However, when ViTs are attacked by an adversary, the attention mechanism can be easily fooled to focus more on the adversarially perturbed patches and cause a mistake. Based on our analysis, we propose a simple temperature-scaling based method to {improve} the robustness of ViT against adversarial patches. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments are performed to support our findings, understanding, and improvement of ViT robustness to patch-wise perturbations across a set of transformer-based architectures.

title: Jing He, Yiyi Zhou, Qi Zhang, Jun Peng, Yunhang Shen, Xiaoshuai Sun, Chao Chen, Rongrong Ji
title_en: Jing He, Yiyi Zhou, Qi Zhang, Jun Peng, Yunhang Shen, Xiaoshuai Sun, Chao Chen, Rongrong Ji
abstract: 像素合成是图像生成领域具有前景的研究范式,能够有效利用像素级先验知识进行生成。然而,现有方法仍面临过大的内存占用和计算开销问题。本文提出一种面向高效图像生成的渐进式像素合成网络,命名为PixelFolder。具体而言,PixelFolder将图像生成建模为渐进式像素回归问题,通过多阶段结构合成图像,从而大幅降低由大规模张量变换导致的开销。此外,我们引入新颖的像素折叠操作,在保持像素级先验知识的同时进一步提升模型效率。借助这些创新设计,我们显著降低了像素合成的计算成本,例如相比最新像素合成方法CIPS,计算量减少89%,参数量减少53%。为验证我们的方法,我们在FFHQ和LSUN Church两个基准数据集上进行了大量实验。实验结果表明,在大幅降低计算成本的前提下,PixelFolder在两个基准数据集上取得了新的最先进(SOTA)性能,即在FFHQ和LSUN Church上的FID分别为3.77和2.45。同时,PixelFolder相比SOTA方法如StyleGAN2也更加高效,计算量减少约72%,参数量减少约31%。这些结果充分验证了所提PixelFolder方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Pixel synthesis is a promising research paradigm for image generation, which can well exploit pixel-wise prior knowledge for generation. However, existing methods still suffer from excessive memory footprint and computation overhead. In this paper, we propose a progressive pixel synthesis network towards efficient image generation, coined as PixelFolder. Specifically, PixelFolder formulates image generation as a progressive pixel regression problem and synthesizes images via a multi-stage structure, which can greatly reduce the overhead caused by large tensor transformations. In addition, we introduce novel pixel folding operations to further improve model efficiency while maintaining pixel-wise prior knowledge for end-to-end regression. With these innovative designs, we greatly reduce the expenditure of pixel synthesis, e.g., reducing 89% computation and 53% parameters compared with the latest pixel synthesis method CIPS. To validate our approach, we conduct extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets, namely FFHQ and LSUN Church. The experimental results show that with much less expenditure, PixelFolder obtains new state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on two benchmark datasets, i.e., 3.77 FID and 2.45 FID on FFHQ and LSUN Church, respectively.Meanwhile, PixelFolder is also more efficient than the SOTA methods like StyleGAN2, reducing about 72% computation and 31% parameters, respectively. These results greatly validate the effectiveness of the proposed PixelFolder.

title: Jingcheng Ni, Nan Zhou, Jie Qin, Qian Wu, Junqi Liu, Boxun Li, Di Huang
title_en: Jingcheng Ni, Nan Zhou, Jie Qin, Qian Wu, Junqi Liu, Boxun Li, Di Huang
abstract: 对比学习在视频表征学习中展现出巨大潜力。然而,现有方法未能充分挖掘短期运动动态,而这些动态对于各种下游视频理解任务至关重要。本文提出运动敏感对比学习(MSCL),通过将光流捕捉到的运动信息注入RGB帧以增强特征学习。为实现这一目标,除了片段级全局对比学习外,我们开发了基于帧级对比目标的局部运动对比学习(LMCL)跨两种模态。此外,我们引入了光流旋转增强(FRA)以生成额外的运动打乱负样本,并通过运动差异采样(MDS)准确筛选训练样本。在标准基准数据集上的大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性。以常用的3D ResNet-18作为主干网络,我们在UCF101数据集上实现了91.5%的Top-1准确率,在Something-Something v2数据集上实现了50.3%的Top-1准确率用于视频分类,并在UCF101数据集上实现了65.6%的Top-1召回率用于视频检索,显著优于现有最先进方法。
abstract_en: Contrastive learning has shown great potential in video representation learning. However, existing approaches fail to sufficiently exploit short-term motion dynamics, which are crucial to various down-stream video understanding tasks. In this paper, we propose Motion Sensitive Contrastive Learning (MSCL) that injects the motion information captured by optical flows into RGB frames to strengthen feature learning. To achieve this, in addition to clip-level global contrastive learning, we develop Local Motion Contrastive Learning (LMCL) with frame-level contrastive objectives across the two modalities. Moreover, we introduce Flow Rotation Augmentation (FRA) to generate extra motion-shuffled negative samples and Motion Differential Sampling (MDS) to accurately screen training samples. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. With the commonly-used 3D ResNet-18 as the backbone, we achieve the top-1 accuracies of 91.5\% on UCF101 and 50.3\% on Something-Something v2 for video classification, and a 65.6\% Top-1 Recall on UCF101 for video retrieval, notably improving the state-of-the-art.

title: Jinghuan Shang, Kumara Kahatapitiya, Xiang Li, Michael S. Ryoo
title_en: Jinghuan Shang, Kumara Kahatapitiya, Xiang Li, Michael S. Ryoo
abstract: 强化学习(RL)可以被视为一个序列建模任务:给定一系列过去的状态-动作-奖励经验,智能体预测一系列下一步动作。在本工作中,我们提出了一种用于视觉强化学习的State-Action-Reward Transformer(StARformer),该方法显式建模短期状态-动作-奖励表示(StAR表示),本质上引入了类似马尔可夫的归纳偏置以提升长期建模能力。我们的方法首先通过自注意力机制提取图像状态块、动作和奖励标记在短时间窗口内的StAR表示。随后,这些表示与纯图像状态表示(提取为卷积特征)结合,对整个序列进行自注意力计算。实验表明,StARformer在基于图像的Atari和DeepMind Control Suite基准测试中,均优于基于Transformer的最先进方法,且在离线强化学习和模仿学习设置中表现更优。此外,StARformer对更长输入序列的兼容性更强。我们的代码可在https://github.com/elicassion/StARformer获取。
abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) can be considered as a sequence modeling task: given a sequence of past state-action-reward experiences, an agent predicts a sequence of next actions. In this work, we propose State-Action-Reward Transformer (StARformer) for visual RL, which explicitly models short-term state-action-reward representations (StAR-representations), essentially introducing a Markovian-like inductive bias to improve long-term modeling. Our approach first extracts StAR-representations by self-attending image state patches, action, and reward tokens within a short temporal window. These are then combined with pure image state representations --- extracted as convolutional features, to perform self-attention over the whole sequence. Our experiments show that StARformer outperforms the state-of-the-art Transformer-based method on image-based Atari and DeepMind Control Suite benchmarks, in both offline-RL and imitation learning settings. StARformer is also more compliant with longer sequences of inputs. Our code is available at https://github.com/elicassion/StARformer.

title: Jingkang Yang, Yi Zhe Ang, Zujin Guo, Kaiyang Zhou, Wayne Zhang, Ziwei Liu
title_en: Jingkang Yang, Yi Zhe Ang, Zujin Guo, Kaiyang Zhou, Wayne Zhang, Ziwei Liu
abstract: 现有研究从检测视角出发,针对场景图生成(SGG)这一图像场景理解的关键技术,即通过边界框检测物体,随后预测其成对关系。我们认为,这种范式会导致若干问题,阻碍该领域的发展。例如,当前数据集中的边界框标签通常包含冗余信息(如头发)并遗漏了对理解上下文至关重要的背景信息。在本工作中,我们引入全景场景图生成(PSG任务),这是一个新问题,要求模型基于全景分割而非刚性边界框生成更全面的场景图表示。我们为社区创建了一个高质量的PSG数据集,包含来自COCO和Visual Genome的51k精心标注图像,以跟踪领域进展。在基准测试中,我们构建了三个两阶段模型,这些模型修改自当前SGG的最先进方法,并构建了一个名为PSGTR的一阶段模型,其基于高效的Transformer检测器(即DETR)。我们进一步提出了一种名为PSGFormer的方法,通过在PSGTR上进行两项新颖扩展,实现了显著改进:1)在两个Transformer解码器中以查询形式分别建模物体和关系;2)一种类似提示的交互机制。最后,我们分享了开放挑战和未来方向的见解。
abstract_en: Existing research addresses scene graph generation (SGG), a critical technology to scene understanding in images, from the detection perspective, i.e., objects are detected using bounding boxes followed by prediction of their pairwise relationships. We argue that such a paradigm would cause several problems that impede the progress of the field. For instance, bounding box-based labels in current datasets usually contain redundant information like hairs and miss some background information that is crucial to the understanding of context. In this work, we introduce panoptic scene graph generation (PSG task), a new problem that requires the model to generate more comprehensive scene graph representations based on panoptic segmentations rather than rigid bounding boxes. A high-quality PSG dataset, which contains 51k well-annotated images from COCO and Visual Genome, is created for the community to keep track of the progress. For benchmarking, we build three two-stage models, which are modified from current state-of-the-arts in SGG, and another one-stage model called PSGTR, which is based on the efficient Transformer-based detector, i.e., DETR. We further propose an approach called PSGFormer, which achieves significant improvements with two novel extensions over PSGTR: 1) separate modeling of objects and relations in the form of queries in two Transformer decoders, and 2) a prompting-like interaction mechanism. In the end, we share insights on open challenges and future directions.

title: Jingqun Tang, Wenming Qian, Luchuan Song, Xiena Dong, Lan Li, Xiang Bai
title_en: Jingqun Tang, Wenming Qian, Luchuan Song, Xiena Dong, Lan Li, Xiang Bai
abstract: 文本检测与识别是现代光学字符识别(OCR)系统的核心组件。大多数OCR方法试图在检测阶段获取准确的文本边界框,该边界框作为文本识别阶段的输入。我们观察到,当使用紧密的文本边界框作为输入时,文本识别器由于边界框与文本识别深度表示之间的不一致性,经常无法达到最佳性能。本文提出Box Adjuster,一种基于强化学习的方法,用于调整每个文本边界框的形状,使其更兼容文本识别模型。此外,在处理合成到真实等跨域问题时,该方法显著减少了源域与目标域之间的分布不匹配。实验表明,当使用调整后的边界框作为训练的地面真实数据时,端到端文本识别系统的性能可以得到提升。具体而言,在多个场景文本理解基准数据集上,该方法在端到端文本识别任务中平均F-Score高出当前最先进的文本定位器2.0%,在领域自适应任务中平均F-Score高出4.6%。
abstract_en: Text detection and recognition are the essential components of a modern OCR system. Most OCR approaches attempt to obtain accurate bounding boxes of text at the detection stage, which is used as the input of the text recognition stage. We observe that when using tight text bounding boxes as input, a text recognizer frequently fails to achieve optimal performance due to the inconsistency between bounding boxes and deep representations of text recognition. In this paper, we propose Box Adjuster, a reinforcement learning-based method for adjusting the shape of each text bounding box to make it more compatible with text recognition models. Additionally, when dealing with cross-domain problems such as synthetic-to-real, the proposed method significantly reduces mismatches in domain distribution between the source and target domains. Experiments demonstrate that the performance of end-to-end text recognition systems can be improved when using the adjusted bounding boxes as the ground truth for training. Specifically, on several benchmark datasets for scene text understanding, the proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art text spotters by an average of 2.0% F-Score on end-to-end text recognition tasks and 4.6% F-Score on domain adaptation tasks.

title: 梁景唐, 孙晓东, 潘志曼, 王珏
title_en: Jingtang Liang, Xiaodong Cun, Chi-Man Pun, Jue Wang
abstract: 图像和谐化旨在根据特定背景修改合成区域的颜色。先前的工作将该任务建模为使用UNet家族结构进行像素级图像转换。然而,模型规模和计算成本限制了其在边缘设备和高分辨率图像上的处理能力。本文提出了一种空间分离曲线渲染网络(S2CRNet),一种新颖框架,首次证明了简单的全局编辑可以有效解决该任务以及高分辨率图像和谐化的挑战。在S2CRNet中,我们设计了一个曲线渲染模块(CRM),利用空间特定知识生成前景区域的分段曲线映射参数,并可直接使用学习到的颜色曲线渲染原始高分辨率图像。此外,我们还通过级联细化和语义引导对所提出的框架进行了两项扩展。实验表明,所提方法相比先前方法减少了超过90%的参数,但仍能在3个基准数据集上达到最先进的性能。此外,我们的方法在更高分辨率图像上运行流畅,且GPU计算资源消耗显著降低。源代码可在:\url{http://github.com/stefanLeong/S2CRNet} 获取。
abstract_en: Image harmonization aims to modify the color of the composited region according to the specific background. Previous works model this task as a pixel-wise image translation using UNet family structures. However, the model size and computational cost limit the ability of their models on edge devices and higher-resolution images. In this paper, we propose a spatial-separated curve rendering network (S2CRNet), a novel framework to prove that the simple global editing can effectively address this task as well as the challenge of high-resolution image harmonization for the first time. In S2CRNet, we design a curve rendering module (CRM) using spatial-specific knowledge to generate the parameters of the piece-wise curve mapping in the foreground region and we can directly render the original high-resolution images using the learned color curve. Besides, we also make two extensions of the proposed framework via cascaded refinement and semantic guidance. Experiments show that the proposed method reduces more than 90% of parameters compared with previous methods but still achieves the state-of-the-art performance on 3 benchmark datasets. Moreover, our method can work smoothly on higher resolution images with much lower GPU computational resources. The source codes are available at: \url{http://github.com/stefanLeong/S2CRNet}.

title: Jingwang Ling, Zhibo Wang, Ming Lu, Quan Wang, Chen Qian, Feng Xu
title_en: Jingwang Ling, Zhibo Wang, Ming Lu, Quan Wang, Chen Qian, Feng Xu
abstract: 可变形模型是3D人脸统计建模的核心。以往关于可变形模型的研究主要关注大规模面部几何结构,却忽略了面部细节。本文通过学习结构感知可编辑可变形模型(SEMM)来增强可变形模型对面部细节的表示能力。SEMM引入基于皱纹线距离场的细节结构表示,并与细节位移联合建模,以建立更优的对应关系,实现皱纹结构的直观操控。此外,SEMM引入两个转换模块,将表情混合形状权重和年龄值转换为潜在空间的变化,从而实现有效的语义细节编辑并保持身份特征。大量实验表明,所提模型能够紧凑表示面部细节,在表情动画定性与定量表现上均优于先前方法,并实现了有效的面部细节年龄编辑和皱纹线编辑。代码和模型可在https://github.com/gerwang/facial-detail-manipulation获取。
abstract_en: Morphable models are essential for the statistical modeling of 3D faces. Previous works on morphable models mostly focus on large-scale facial geometry but ignore facial details. This paper augments morphable models in representing facial details by learning a Structure-aware Editable Morphable Model (SEMM). SEMM introduces a detail structure representation based on the distance field of wrinkle lines, jointly modeled with detail displacements to establish better correspondences and enable intuitive manipulation of wrinkle structure. Besides, SEMM introduces two transformation modules to translate expression blendshape weights and age values into changes in latent space, allowing effective semantic detail editing while maintaining identity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed model compactly represents facial details, outperforms previous methods in expression animation qualitatively and quantitatively, and achieves effective age editing and wrinkle line editing of facial details. Code and model are available at https://github.com/gerwang/facial-detail-manipulation.

title: Jingwei Ma, Lucy Chai, Minyoung Huh, Tongzhou Wang, Ser-Nam Lim, Phillip Isola, Antonio Torralba
title_en: Jingwei Ma, Lucy Chai, Minyoung Huh, Tongzhou Wang, Ser-Nam Lim, Phillip Isola, Antonio Torralba
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的图像取证方法:在场景中放置物理折射物体(我们称之为图腾),以保护该场景的任何照片。图腾会弯曲和重定向光线,从而在单张图像中提供多个(尽管失真)的场景视角。防御者可以利用这些失真图腾像素来检测图像是否被篡改。我们的方法通过估计图腾在场景中的位置,并利用其已知的几何和材料属性,来解码穿过图腾的光线。为了验证受图腾保护的图像,我们检测从图腾视角重建的场景与从相机视角观察的场景之间的不一致性。这种方法使对抗性篡改任务更加困难,因为攻击者必须在几何上一致地修改图腾和图像像素,而无需了解图腾的物理属性。与以往基于学习的方法不同,我们的方法不需要在特定篡改数据集上进行训练,而是利用场景和相机的物理属性来解决取证问题。
abstract_en: We introduce a new approach to image forensics: placing physical refractive objects, which we call totems, into a scene so as to protect any photograph taken of that scene. Totems bend and redirect light rays, thus providing multiple, albeit distorted, views of the scene within a single image. A defender can use these distorted totem pixels to detect if an image has been manipulated. Our approach unscrambles the light rays passing through the totems by estimating their positions in the scene and using their known geometric and material properties. To verify a totem-protected image, we detect inconsistencies between the scene reconstructed from totem viewpoints and the scene’s appearance from the camera viewpoint. Such an approach makes the adversarial manipulation task more difficult, as the adversary must modify both the totem and image pixels in a geometrically consistent manner without knowing the physical properties of the totem. Unlike prior learning-based approaches, our method does not require training on datasets of specific manipulations, and instead uses physical properties of the scene and camera to solve the forensics problem.

title: Jingwen Ye, Yifang Fu, Jie Song, Xingyi Yang, Songhua Liu, Xin Jin, Mingli Song, Xinchao Wang
title_en: Jingwen Ye, Yifang Fu, Jie Song, Xingyi Yang, Songhua Liu, Xin Jin, Mingli Song, Xinchao Wang
abstract: 终身学习旨在学习一系列任务而不遗忘之前获得的知识。然而,涉及的训练数据可能由于隐私或版权原因而无法长期合法使用。在实际场景中,例如,模型所有者可能希望随时启用或禁用特定任务或特定样本的知识。这种对知识迁移的灵活控制,不幸的是,在以往的增量或减量学习方法中,甚至在问题设置层面都未被充分关注。在本文中,我们探索了一种新颖的学习方案,称为\textbf{L}earning w\textbf{I}th \textbf{R}ecoverable \textbf{F}orgetting (LIRF),该方案明确处理任务或样本特定知识的移除与恢复。具体而言,LIRF引入了两种创新方案,即知识\emph{存储}和\emph{撤回},允许将用户指定的知识从预训练网络中隔离,并在必要时重新注入。在知识存储过程中,指定的知识从目标网络中提取并存储在存储模块中,而目标网络中的不敏感或通用知识则被保留并进一步增强。在知识撤回过程中,被移除的知识会被重新添加到目标网络中。存储和撤回过程仅需对移除数据进行少量轮次的微调,从而确保数据和时间效率。我们在多个数据集上进行了实验,结果表明所提出的LIRF策略取得了令人鼓舞的成果,并具有令人满意的泛化能力。
abstract_en: Life-long learning aims at learning a sequence of tasks without forgetting the previously acquired knowledge. However, the involved training data may not be life-long legitimate due to privacy or copyright reasons. In practical scenarios, for instance, the model owner may wish to enable or disable the knowledge of specific tasks or specific samples from time to time. Such flexible control over knowledge transfer, unfortunately, has been largely overlooked in previous incremental or decremental learning methods, even at a problem-setup level. In this paper, we explore a novel learning scheme, termed as \textbf{L}earning w\textbf{I}th \textbf{R}ecoverable \textbf{F}orgetting (LIRF), that explicitly handles the task- or sample-specific knowledge removal and recovery. Specifically, LIRF brings in two innovative schemes, namely knowledge \emph{deposit} and \emph{withdrawal}, which allow for isolating user-designated knowledge from a pre-trained network and injecting it back when necessary. During the knowledge deposit process, the specified knowledge is extracted from the target network and stored in a deposit module, while the insensitive or general knowledge of the target network is preserved and further augmented. During knowledge withdrawal, the taken-off knowledge is added back to the target network. The deposit and withdraw processes only demand for a few epochs of finetuning on the removal data, ensuring both data and time efficiency. We conduct experiments on several datasets, and demonstrate that the proposed LIRF strategy yields encouraging results with gratifying generalization capability.

title: Jingyu Gong, Fengqi Liu, Jiachen Xu, Min Wang, Xin Tan, Zhizhong Zhang, Ran Yi, Haichuan Song, Yuan Xie, Lizhuang Ma
title_en: Jingyu Gong, Fengqi Liu, Jiachen Xu, Min Wang, Xin Tan, Zhizhong Zhang, Ran Yi, Haichuan Song, Yuan Xie, Lizhuang Ma
abstract: 近年来,考虑形状补全中领域差距的研究受到更多关注,因为监督方法在真实扫描中的表现不尽如人意。现有研究仅注意到输入扫描的差距,却忽略了输出预测中的差距,这种差距在补全任务中具有特殊性。本文将部分扫描分解为三个因素(领域、形状和遮挡)以处理跨领域补全中的输出差距。在因素学习方面,我们以自监督方式设计视角预测和领域分类任务,并引入因素排列一致性正则化以确保因素独立性。因此,只需操控遮挡因素即可完成扫描,同时保留领域和形状信息。为进一步适应目标领域的实例,我们引入优化阶段以最大化补全形状与输入扫描之间的一致性。在真实扫描和合成数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法显著优于先前方法,为后续研究提供了积极方向。代码可在 https://github.com/azuki-miho/OptDE 获取。
abstract_en: Recently, studies considering domain gaps in shape completion attracted more attention, due to the undesirable performance of supervised methods on real scans. They only noticed the gap in input scans, but ignored the gap in output prediction, which is specific for completion. In this paper, we disentangle partial scans into three (domain, shape, and occlusion) factors to handle the output gap in cross-domain completion. For factor learning, we design view-point prediction and domain classification tasks in a self-supervised manner and bring a factor permutation consistency regularization to ensure factor independence. Thus, scans can be completed by simply manipulating occlusion factors while preserving domain and shape information. To further adapt to instances in the target domain, we introduce an optimization stage to maximize the consistency between completed shapes and input scans. Extensive experiments on real scans and synthetic datasets show that ours outperforms previous methods by a large margin and is encouraging for the following works. Code is available at https://github.com/azuki-miho/OptDE.

title: 马景元,雷翔宇,刘楠,赵贤,蒲世良
title_en: Jingyuan Ma, Xiangyu Lei, Nan Liu, Xian Zhao, Shiliang Pu
abstract: 语义引导的自监督单目深度估计因深度与语义之间存在强跨任务相关性而被广泛研究。然而,由于深度估计与语义分割本质上是两种任务类型:前者为回归,后者为分类,深度特征与语义特征的分布自然存在差异。此前利用语义信息进行深度估计的工作大多忽视了这种表示差异,导致深度特征的表示增强不足。本文提出一种基于注意力的模块,通过在实例内解决特征独特性以增强任务特定特征。此外,提出基于度量学习的方法,通过在特征空间中分离实例实现对深度特征的全面增强。大量实验与分析验证了所提方法的有效性。最终,该方法在KITTI数据集上达到最先进性能。
abstract_en: Semantics-guided self-supervised monocular depth estimation has been widely researched, owing to the strong cross-task correlation of depth and semantics. However, since depth estimation and semantic segmentation are fundamentally two types of tasks: one is regression while the other is classification, the distribution of depth feature and semantic feature are naturally different. Previous works that leverage semantic information in depth estimation mostly neglect such representational discrimination, which leads to insufficient representation enhancement of depth feature. In this work, we propose an attention-based module to enhance task-specific feature by addressing their feature uniqueness within instances. Additionally, we propose a metric learning based approach to accomplish comprehensive enhancement on depth feature by creating a separation between instances in feature space. Extensive experiments and analysis demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method. In the end, our method achieves the state-of-the-art performance on KITTI dataset.

title_en: Jinhwan Seo, Wonho Bae, Danica J. Sutherland, Junhyug Noh, Daijin Kim
abstract: 和
abstract_en: Weakly Supervised Object Detection (WSOD) is a task that detects objects in an image using a model trained only on image-level annotations. Current state-of-the-art models benefit from self-supervised instance-level supervision, but since weak supervision does not include count or location information, the most common “argmax” labeling method often ignores many instances of objects. To alleviate this issue, we propose a novel multiple instance labeling method called object discovery. We further introduce a new contrastive loss under weak supervision where no instance-level information is available for sampling, called weakly supervised contrastive loss (WSCL). WSCL aims to construct a credible similarity threshold for object discovery by leveraging consistent features for embedding vectors in the same class. As a result, we achieve new state-of-the-art results on MS-COCO 2014 and 2017 as well as PASCAL VOC 2012, and competitive results on PASCAL VOC 2007. The code is available at https://github.com/jinhseo/OD-WSCL.

title: Jinhyuk Park, Albert No
title_en: Jinhyuk Park, Albert No
abstract: 知识蒸馏将复杂教师模型的知识迁移到小型学生模型中。近期研究表明,学生友好的教师模型更适合进行蒸馏,因为它能提供更可迁移的知识。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新颖框架“先剪枝,再蒸馏”,即首先对模型进行剪枝以增强其可迁移性,随后将其知识蒸馏到学生模型中。我们提供了多个探索性实验案例,证明剪枝后的教师模型比原始未剪枝网络表现更优。进一步地,我们从理论上证明了剪枝教师在蒸馏过程中起到正则化器的作用,从而降低泛化误差。基于这一结果,我们提出了一种新型神经网络压缩方案,其中学生网络基于剪枝后的教师模型构建,随后应用“先剪枝,再蒸馏”策略。代码已开源至 https://github.com/ososos888/prune-then-distill。
abstract_en: Knowledge distillation transfers the knowledge from a cumbersome teacher to a small student. Recent results suggest that the student-friendly teacher is more appropriate to distill since it provides more transferrable knowledge. In this work, we propose the novel framework, “prune, then distill,” that prunes the model first to make it more transferrable and then distill it to the student. We provide several exploratory examples where the pruned teacher teaches better than the original unpruned networks. We further show theoretically that the pruned teacher plays the role of regularizer in distillation, which reduces the generalization error. Based on this result, we propose a novel neural network compression scheme where the student network is formed based on the pruned teacher and then apply the “prune, then distill” strategy. The code is available at https://github.com/ososos888/prune-then-distill.

title: Jinhyung Park, Chenfeng Xu, Yiyang Zhou, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Wei Zhan
title_en: Jinhyung Park, Chenfeng Xu, Yiyang Zhou, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Wei Zhan
abstract: 尽管大量3D检测工作利用了RGB图像与点云之间的互补关系,但半监督目标识别的更广泛框架的发展并未受到多模态融合的影响。当前方法在存在配对图像和点云帧的情况下,仍独立开发2D和3D半监督学习的独立流程。观察到每个传感器的特性差异导致其偏向于检测不同目标,我们提出DetMatch,一个用于2D和3D模态联合半监督学习的灵活框架。通过识别两个传感器均检测到的目标,我们的流程生成了更干净、更稳健的伪标签集,不仅展现出更强的性能,还能抑制单模态误差传播。进一步地,我们利用RGB图像更丰富的语义信息来修正错误的3D类别预测,并提升3D框的定位精度。在具有挑战性的KITTI和Waymo数据集上评估我们的方法,我们超越了现有的强半监督学习方法,并观察到更高质量的伪标签。代码将在此发布:https://github.com/Divadi/DetMatch
abstract_en: While numerous 3D detection works leverage the complementary relationship between RGB images and point clouds, developments in the broader framework of semi-supervised object recognition remain uninfluenced by multi-modal fusion. Current methods develop independent pipelines for 2D and 3D semi-supervised learning despite the availability of paired image and point cloud frames. Observing that the distinct characteristics of each sensor cause them to be biased towards detecting different objects, we propose DetMatch, a flexible framework for joint semi-supervised learning on 2D and 3D modalities. By identifying objects detected in both sensors, our pipeline generates a cleaner, more robust set of pseudo-labels that both demonstrates stronger performance and stymies single-modality error propagation. Further, we leverage the richer semantics of RGB images to rectify incorrect 3D class predictions and improve localization of 3D boxes. Evaluating our method on the challenging KITTI and Waymo datasets, we improve upon strong semi-supervised learning methods and observe higher quality pseudo-labels. Code will be released here: https://github.com/Divadi/DetMatch.

title: Jinjin Gu, Haoming Cai, Chenyu Dong, Ruofan Zhang, Yulun Zhang, Wenming Yang, Chun Yuan
title_en: Jinjin Gu, Haoming Cai, Chenyu Dong, Ruofan Zhang, Yulun Zhang, Wenming Yang, Chun Yuan
abstract: 渲染高分辨率(HR)图形会带来显著的计算成本。高效的图形超分辨率(SR)方法可能在有限的计算资源下实现高分辨率渲染,并在工业界和研究社区中引起了广泛关注。我们提出了一种用于计算机图形学实时SR的新方法,即通过预测偏移量实现超分辨率(SRPO)。我们的算法将图像分为两部分进行处理,即锐利边缘区域和较平坦区域。对于边缘区域,不同于以往SR方法以抗锯齿图像作为输入,我们提出的SRPO利用光栅化图像的特性,直接对光栅化图像进行SR处理。为补偿高分辨率与低分辨率(LR)光栅化图像之间的残差,我们训练了一个超高效网络来预测偏移量图,将合适的周围像素移动到新位置。对于平坦区域,我们发现简单的插值方法已能生成合理的输出。最后,我们使用引导融合操作将网络生成的锐利边缘与插值方法生成的平坦区域融合,得到最终的SR图像。所提出的网络仅包含8,434个参数,可通过网络量化进行加速。大量实验表明,所提出的SRPO方法在计算成本上低于现有最先进方法,同时实现了更优的视觉效果。
abstract_en: Rendering high-resolution (HR) graphics brings substantial computational costs. Efficient graphics super-resolution (SR) methods may achieve HR rendering with small computing resources and have attracted extensive research interests in industry and research communities. We present a new method for real-time SR for computer graphics, namely Super-Resolution by Predicting Offsets (SRPO). Our algorithm divides the image into two parts for processing, i.e., sharp edges and flatter areas. For edges, different from the previous SR methods that take the anti-aliased images as inputs, our proposed SRPO takes advantage of the characteristics of rasterized images to conduct SR on the rasterized images. To complement the residual between HR and low-resolution (LR) rasterized images, we train an ultra-efficient network to predict the offset maps to move the appropriate surrounding pixels to the new positions. For flat areas, we found simple interpolation methods can already generate reasonable output. We finally use a guided fusion operation to integrate the sharp edges generated by the network and flat areas by the interpolation method to get the final SR image. The proposed network only contains 8,434 parameters and can be accelerated by network quantization. Extensive experiments show that the proposed SRPO can achieve superior visual effects at a smaller computational cost than the existing state-of-the-art methods.

title: 吴金林, 何灵霄, 刘武, 杨阳, 雷震, 梅涛, 李斯坦
title_en: Jinlin Wu, Lingxiao He, Wu Liu, Yang Yang, Zhen Lei, Tao Mei, Stan Z. Li
abstract: 视频目标重识别(reID)旨在通过将视频轨迹片段与裁剪的视频帧进行匹配,在非重叠摄像机下重新识别同一目标。关键在于如何充分利用时空交互以提取更准确的表示。然而,现有方法存在以下困境:(1)3D解决方案建模了时空交互,但常受相邻帧对齐问题的困扰;(2)2D解决方案采用分而治之的策略应对对齐问题,但无法利用时空交互。为解决上述问题,我们提出了一种上下文对齐视觉Transformer(CAViT),用于基于二维解决方案的时空交互。它包含多形状补丁嵌入(MPE)模块和时间移位注意力(TSA)模块。MPE旨在保留由姿态、遮挡或误检引起的对齐问题导致的空间语义信息。TSA旨在实现上下文空间语义特征对齐,并联合建模时空线索。我们进一步提出残差位置嵌入(RPE)以指导TSA关注时间显著性线索。在五个视频行人重识别数据集上的实验结果证明了所提CAViT的优越性。此外,在VVeRI-901-trial上进行的实验也表明CAViT在视频车辆重识别中的有效性。我们的代码可在\href{https://github.com/KimWu1994/CAViT}{https://github.com/KimWu1994/CAViT}获取。
abstract_en: Video object re-identification (reID) aims at re-identifying the same object under non-overlapping cameras by matching the video tracklets with cropped video frames. The key point is how to make full use of spatio-temporal interactions to extract more accurate representation. However, there are dilemmas within existing approaches: (1) 3D solutions model the spatio-temporal interaction but are often troubled with the misalignment of adjacent frames, and (2) 2D solutions adopt a divide-and-conquer strategy against the misalignment but cannot take advantage of the spatio-temporal interactions. To address the above problems, we propose a Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer (\textbf{CAViT}) to the spatio-temporal interaction with a 2D solution. It contains a Multi-shape Patch Embedding (\textbf{MPE}) module and a Temporal Shift Attention (\textbf{TSA}) module. MPE is designed to retain spatial semantic information against the misalignment caused by pose, occlusion, or misdetection. TSA is designed to achieve contextual spatial semantic feature alignment and jointly model spatio-temporal clues. We further propose a Residual Position Embedding (\textbf{RPE}) to guide TSA in focusing on the temporal saliency clues. Experimental results on five video person reID datasets demonstrate the superiority of the proposed CAViT. Additionally, the experiment conducted on VVeRI-901-trial also shows the effectiveness of CAViT for the video vehicle reID. Our code is available on \href{https://github.com/KimWu1994/CAViT}{https://github.com/KimWu1994/CAViT}.

title: Jinwoo Kim, Saeyoon Oh, Sungjun Cho, Seunghoon Hong
title_en: Jinwoo Kim, Saeyoon Oh, Sungjun Cho, Seunghoon Hong
abstract: 许多计算机视觉和机器学习问题可以建模为在超图上的学习,超图表示高阶关系。近期的超图学习方法基于消息传递机制扩展图神经网络,这种机制简单但本质上在建模长程依赖关系和表达能力方面存在根本性限制。另一方面,基于张量的协变神经网络具有最大表达性,但由于计算量大且对固定阶超边有严格假设,其在超图上的应用受到限制。我们解决了这些问题,提出了协变超图神经网络(Equivariant Hypergraph Neural Network, EHNN),这是首个实现通用超图学习中最大表达性协变层的尝试。我们还基于超网络(EHNN-MLP)和自注意力机制(EHNN-Transformer)提出了该框架的两个实用实现,这些方法易于实现且理论上比大多数消息传递方法更具表达性。我们在多种超图学习任务中验证了其能力,包括合成k边识别、半监督分类和视觉关键点匹配,并在强消息传递基线方法上取得了性能提升。我们的实现可在https://github.com/jw9730/ehnn获取。
abstract_en: Many problems in computer vision and machine learning can be cast as learning on hypergraphs that represent higher-order relations. Recent approaches for hypergraph learning extend graph neural networks based on message passing, which is simple yet fundamentally limited in modeling long-range dependencies and expressive power. On the other hand, tensor-based equivariant neural networks enjoy maximal expressiveness, but their application has been limited in hypergraphs due to heavy computation and strict assumptions on fixed-order hyperedges. We resolve these problems and present Equivariant Hypergraph Neural Network (EHNN), the first attempt to realize maximally expressive equivariant layers for general hypergraph learning. We also present two practical realizations of our framework based on hypernetworks (EHNN-MLP) and self-attention (EHNN-Transformer), which are easy to implement and theoretically more expressive than most message passing approaches. We demonstrate their capability in a range of hypergraph learning problems, including synthetic k-edge identification, semi-supervised classification, and visual keypoint matching, and report improved performances over strong message passing baselines. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/jw9730/ehnn.

title: Jinxiang Lai, Siqian Yang, Wenlong Liu, Yi Zeng, Zhongyi Huang, Wenlong Wu, Jun Liu, Bin-Bin Gao, Chengjie Wang
title_en: Jinxiang Lai, Siqian Yang, Wenlong Liu, Yi Zeng, Zhongyi Huang, Wenlong Wu, Jun Liu, Bin-Bin Gao, Chengjie Wang
abstract: 少样本学习(FSL)通过在大量已见(基础)样本和少量未见(新颖)样本中嵌入具有判别性的目标感知特征,缓解数据不足的挑战。现有大多数特征嵌入模块针对特定学习任务(如分类、分割和目标检测)专门设计,限制了嵌入特征的通用性。为此,我们提出了一种轻量且通用的模块——基于Transformer的语义滤波器(tSF),可应用于不同FSL任务。所提出的tSF通过语义滤波器重新设计Transformer结构的输入,不仅能够将基础集的知识迁移至新颖集,还能对目标类别进行语义特征过滤。此外,tSF的参数数量仅为标准Transformer块的一半(少于100万)。实验表明,我们的tSF在不同经典少样本学习任务中均能提升性能(约2%的提升),尤其在少样本分类任务中超越了现有最先进的方法在多个基准数据集上的表现。
abstract_en: Few-Shot Learning (FSL) alleviates the data shortage challenge via embedding discriminative target-aware features among plenty seen (base) and few unseen (novel) labeled samples. Most feature embedding modules in recent FSL methods are specially designed for corresponding learning tasks (e.g., classification, segmentation, and object detection), which limits the utility of embedding features. To this end, we propose a light and universal module named transformer-based Semantic Filter (tSF), which can be applied for different FSL tasks. The proposed tSF redesigns the inputs of a transformer-based structure by a semantic filter, which not only embeds the knowledge from whole base set to novel set but also filters semantic features for target category. Furthermore, the parameters of tSF is equal to half of a standard transformer block (less than 1M). In the experiments, our tSF is able to boost the performances in different classic few-shot learning tasks (about 2% improvement), especially outperforms the state-of-the-arts on multiple benchmark datasets in few-shot classification task.

title: Jinxing Zhou, Jianyuan Wang, Jiayi Zhang, Weixuan Sun, Jing Zhang, Stan Birchfield, Dan Guo, Lingpeng Kong, Meng Wang, Yiran Zhong
title_en: Jinxing Zhou, Jianyuan Wang, Jiayi Zhang, Weixuan Sun, Jing Zhang, Stan Birchfield, Dan Guo, Lingpeng Kong, Meng Wang, Yiran Zhong
abstract: 我们提出探索一个新问题,称为音频-视觉分割(AVS),其目标是在图像帧中输出产生声音的对象(sounding objects)的像素级地图。为促进该研究,我们构建了首个音频-视觉分割基准(AVSBench),为可听视频中发声对象提供像素级注释。通过该基准研究了两种设置:1)单个声源的半监督音频-视觉分割;2)多个声源的全监督音频-视觉分割。为解决AVS问题,我们提出了一种新方法,利用时间像素级的音频-视觉交互模块将音频语义作为视觉分割过程的指导。我们还设计了正则化损失函数以鼓励训练期间的音频-视觉映射。在AVSBench上的定量和定性实验将我们的方法与相关任务的现有方法进行比较,证明了所提方法在建立音频与像素级视觉语义之间桥梁方面的潜力。代码可在https://github.com/OpenNLPLab/AVSBench获取。
abstract_en: We propose to explore a new problem called audio-visual segmentation (AVS), in which the goal is to output a pixel-level map of the object(s) that produce sound at the time of the image frame. To facilitate this research, we construct the first audio-visual segmentation benchmark (AVSBench), providing pixel-wise annotations for the sounding objects in audible videos. Two settings are studied with this benchmark: 1) semi-supervised audio-visual segmentation with a single sound source and 2) fully-supervised audio-visual segmentation with multiple sound sources. To deal with the AVS problem, we propose a new method that uses a temporal pixel-wise audio-visual interaction module to inject audio semantics as guidance for the visual segmentation process. We also design a regularization loss to encourage the audio-visual mapping during training. Quantitative and qualitative experiments on the AVSBench compare our approach to several existing methods from related tasks, demonstrating that the proposed method is promising for building a bridge between the audio and pixel-wise visual semantics. Code is available at https://github.com/OpenNLPLab/AVSBench.

title: Jinyoung Jun, Jae-Han Lee, Chul Lee, Chang-Su Kim
title_en: Jinyoung Jun, Jae-Han Lee, Chul Lee, Chang-Su Kim
