abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的单目深度估计算法,将度量深度图分解为归一化深度图和尺度特征。所提出的网络由一个共享编码器和三个解码器组成,分别称为G-Net、N-Net和M-Net,用于估计梯度图、归一化深度图和度量深度图。M-Net通过利用G-Net和N-Net提取的相对深度特征,学习更精确地估计度量深度。所提出的算法具有优势,可以使用没有度量深度标签的数据集来提升度量深度估计的性能。在多个数据集上的实验结果表明,该算法不仅在性能上与最先进的算法具有竞争力,即使在训练时仅有少量度量深度数据的情况下也能产生可接受的结果。
abstract_en: We propose a novel algorithm for monocular depth estimation that decomposes a metric depth map into a normalized depth map and scale features. The proposed network is composed of a shared encoder and three decoders, called G-Net, N-Net, and M-Net, which estimate gradient maps, a normalized depth map, and a metric depth map, respectively. M-Net learns to estimate metric depths more accurately using relative depth features extracted by G-Net and N-Net. The proposed algorithm has the advantage that it can use datasets without metric depth labels to improve the performance of metric depth estimation. Experimental results on various datasets demonstrate that the proposed algorithm not only provides competitive performance to state-of-the-art algorithms but also yields acceptable results even when only a small amount of metric depth data is available for its training.

title: Jinyu Yang, Zhongqun Zhang, Zhe Li, Hyung Jin Chang, Aleš Leonardis, Feng Zheng
title_en: Jinyu Yang, Zhongqun Zhang, Zhe Li, Hyung Jin Chang, Aleš Leonardis, Feng Zheng
abstract: 在三维场景中的跟踪由于其在机器人技术、自动驾驶和场景理解中的广泛应用而日益受到关注。目前,三维跟踪仅限于基于特定模型的点云方法,这阻碍了三维跟踪器在自然三维场景中的应用。RGBD传感器由于其可获取的同步彩色和深度信息,为三维物体跟踪提供了更合理且可接受的解决方案。因此,本文研究了一个新问题:是否可以在RGBD视频中跟踪通用(类别无关)的三维物体,并预测感兴趣物体的三维边界框?为了促进该领域的进一步研究,我们构建了一个新的标准基准数据集“Track-it-in-3D”,包含300个RGBD视频序列,具有密集的三维标注和相应的评估协议。此外,我们提出了一种有效的跟踪基线方法,通过有效融合外观和空间信息,估计RGBD视频中任意物体的三维边界框。数据集和代码将公开可用。
abstract_en: Tracking in 3D scenes is gaining momentum because of its numerous applications in robotics, autonomous driving, and scene understanding. Currently, 3D tracking is limited to specific model-based approaches involving point clouds, which impedes 3D trackers from applying in natural 3D scenes. RGBD sensors provide a more reasonable and acceptable solution for 3D object tracking due to their readily available synchronised color and depth information. Thus, in this paper, we investigate a novel problem: is it possible to track a generic (class-agnostic) 3D object in RGBD videos and predict 3D bounding boxes of the object of interest? To inspire further research on this topic, we newly construct a standard benchmark for generic 3D object tracking, ‘Track-it-in-3D’, which contains 300 RGBD video sequences with dense 3D annotations and corresponding evaluation protocols. Furthermore, we propose an effective tracking baseline to estimate 3D bounding boxes for arbitrary objects in RGBD videos, by fusing appearance and spatial information effectively. The dataset and codes will be publicly available.

title: Jinze Yu, Jiaming Liu, Xiaobao Wei, Haoyi Zhou, Yohei Nakata, Denis Gudovskiy, Tomoyuki Okuno, Jianxin Li, Kurt Keutzer, Shanghang Zhang
title_en: Jinze Yu, Jiaming Liu, Xiaobao Wei, Haoyi Zhou, Yohei Nakata, Denis Gudovskiy, Tomoyuki Okuno, Jianxin Li, Kurt Keutzer, Shanghang Zhang
abstract: 近年来,检测Transformer(DETR)作为一种端到端的目标检测框架,取得了显著的性能表现。然而,它需要大量标注数据,并且在目标领域缺乏标注数据时会受到领域偏移问题的影响。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种基于均值教师框架的端到端跨领域检测Transformer(MTTrans),该方法能够充分利用目标领域的无标注数据进行目标检测训练,并通过伪标签在领域间传递知识。我们进一步提出了全面的多级特征对齐方法,利用Deformable DETR中的跨尺度自注意力机制,提升均值教师框架生成的伪标签质量。通过基于领域查询的特征对齐(DQFA)、双级图原型对齐(BGPA)和基于token的图像特征对齐(TIFA),分别在局部、全局和实例层级对图像和目标特征进行对齐。另一方面,通过均值教师框架对无标注目标领域数据进行伪标注后,可用于目标检测训练,从而实现更优的特征提取与对齐。因此,均值教师框架与全面的多级特征对齐方法可基于Transformer架构进行迭代优化与相互促进。大量实验表明,我们的方法在三个领域自适应场景中均达到最先进性能,特别是在Sim10k到Cityscapes场景中,mAP指标从52.6显著提升至57.9。代码将公开发布。
abstract_en: Recently, DEtection TRansformer (DETR), an end-to-end object detection pipeline, has achieved promising performance. However, it requires large-scale labeled data and suffers from domain shift, especially when no labeled data is available in the target domain. To solve this problem, we propose an end-to-end cross-domain detection Transformer based on the mean teacher framework, MTTrans, which can fully exploit unlabeled target domain data in object detection training and transfer knowledge between domains via pseudo labels. We further propose the comprehensive multi-level feature alignment to improve the pseudo labels generated by the mean teacher framework taking advantage of the cross-scale self-attention mechanism in Deformable DETR. Image and object features are aligned at the local, global, and instance levels with domain query-based feature alignment (DQFA), bi-level graph-based prototype alignment (BGPA), and token-wise image feature alignment (TIFA). On the other hand, the unlabeled target domain data pseudo-labeled and available for the object detection training by the mean teacher framework can lead to better feature extraction and alignment. Thus, the mean teacher framework and the comprehensive multi-level feature alignment can be optimized iteratively and mutually based on the architecture of Transformers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance in three domain adaptation scenarios, especially the result of Sim10k to Cityscapes scenario is remarkably improved from 52.6 mAP to 57.9 mAP. Code will be released.

title: Jiseok Youn, Jaehun Song, Hyung-Sin Kim, Saewoong Bahk
title_en: Jiseok Youn, Jaehun Song, Hyung-Sin Kim, Saewoong Bahk
abstract: 由于深度神经网络的自适应位宽量化在不同资源预算的平台上易于部署,因此其受到了越来越多的关注。在本文中,我们提出了一种元学习方法来实现这一目标。具体而言,我们提出了MEBQAT,这是一种简单而有效的位宽自适应量化感知训练(QAT)方法,通过重新定义元学习任务以包含位宽,将元学习有效结合到QAT中。在部署到平台后,MEBQAT允许(元)训练模型被量化到任何候选位宽,并帮助进行推理而不会因量化导致显著精度下降。此外,在少样本学习场景下,MEBQAT还可以通过添加传统优化或基于度量的元学习,将模型适应到任何位宽以及任何未见过的目标类别。我们设计了MEBQAT的变体,以支持两种场景:(1)位宽自适应量化场景;(2)同时适应量化位宽和目标类别的新少样本学习场景。我们通过在多种QAT方案中实验验证了其有效性。通过与(位宽专用)QAT、现有位宽自适应QAT和普通元学习进行性能比较,我们发现将位宽纳入元学习任务能够实现更高的鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Deep neural network quantization with adaptive bitwidths has gained increasing attention due to the ease of model deployment on various platforms with different resource budgets. In this paper, we propose a meta-learning approach to achieve this goal. Specifically, we propose MEBQAT, a simple yet effective way of bitwidth-adaptive quantization aware training (QAT) where meta-learning is effectively combined with QAT by redefining meta-learning tasks to incorporate bitwidths. After being deployed on a platform, MEBQAT allows the (meta-)trained model to be quantized to any candidate bitwidth then helps to conduct inference without much accuracy drop from quantization. Moreover, with a few-shot learning scenario, MEBQAT can also adapt a model to any bitwidth as well as any unseen target classes by adding conventional optimization or metric-based meta-learning. We design variants of MEBQAT to support both (1) a bitwidth-adaptive quantization scenario and (2) a new few-shot learning scenario where both quantization bitwidths and target classes are jointly adapted. We experimentally demonstrate their validity in multiple QAT schemes. By comparing their performance to (bitwidth-dedicated) QAT, existing bitwidth adaptive QAT and vanilla meta-learning, we find that merging bitwidths into meta-learning tasks achieves a higher level of robustness.

title: Jiwon Kim, Youngjo Min, Daehwan Kim, Gyuseong Lee, Junyoung Seo, Kwangrok Ryoo, Seungryong Kim
title_en: Jiwon Kim, Youngjo Min, Daehwan Kim, Gyuseong Lee, Junyoung Seo, Kwangrok Ryoo, Seungryong Kim
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的半监督学习框架,该框架通过利用图像的两个强增强视图之间的预测一致性正则化,以伪标签的置信度为权重,称为ConMatch。尽管最新的半监督学习方法使用图像的弱增强和强增强视图来定义方向一致性损失,但如何为两个强增强视图之间的一致性正则化定义这样的方向仍是一个未被探索的问题。为了解决这个问题,我们通过弱增强视图作为锚点,在非参数和参数方法中提出了新的伪标签置信度度量。特别是,在参数方法中,我们首次在神经网络中学习伪标签的置信度,以端到端的方式与主干模型一起学习。此外,我们还提出了分阶段训练以提高训练的收敛性。当整合到现有的半监督学习器中时,ConMatch持续提升了性能。我们进行了实验以证明ConMatch相对于最新方法的有效性,并提供了广泛的消融研究。代码已公开在\url{https://github.com/JiwonCocoder/ConMatch}
abstract_en: We present a novel semi-supervised learning framework that intelligently leverages the consistency regularization between the model’s predictions from two strongly-augmented views of an image, weighted by a confidence of pseudo-label, dubbed ConMatch. While the latest semi-supervised learning methods use weakly- and strongly-augmented views of an image to define a directional consistency loss, how to define such direction for the consistency regularization between two strongly-augmented views remains unexplored. To account for this, we present novel confidence measures for pseudo-labels from strongly-augmented views by means of weakly-augmented view as an anchor in non-parametric and parametric approaches. Especially, in parametric approach, we present, for the first time, to learn the confidence of pseudo-label within the networks, which is learned with backbone model in an end-to-end manner. In addition, we also present a stage-wise training to boost the convergence of training. When incorporated in existing semi-supervised learners, ConMatch consistently boosts the performance. We conduct experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of our ConMatch over the latest methods and provide extensive ablation studies. Code has been made publicly available at \url{https://github.com/JiwonCocoder/ConMatch

title: Jiyang Xie, Xiu Su, Shan You, Zhanyu Ma, Fei Wang, Chen Qian
title_en: Jiyang Xie, Xiu Su, Shan You, Zhanyu Ma, Fei Wang, Chen Qian
abstract: 近年来,社区对模型扩展的关注度不断提高,并致力于开发具有广泛规模谱系的模型家族。当前方法要么简单地采用一次性NAS方式构建非结构化且不可扩展的模型家族,要么依赖于手动但固定的扩展策略来扩展不必要的最佳基础模型。本文将这两个组件结合起来,提出ScaleNet,联合搜索基础模型和扩展策略,使扩展后的大型模型具有更 promising 的性能。具体而言,我们设计了一个超主干网络来体现不同规模谱系(例如FLOPs)的模型。然后,通过基于马尔可夫链的进化算法,扩展策略可以与基础模型交互式学习,并推广以开发更大的模型。为了获得一个合理的超主干网络,我们设计了一种分层采样策略,以增强其训练充分性并减轻干扰。实验结果表明,我们的扩展网络在各种FLOPs上表现出显著的性能优势,但搜索成本至少减少了2.53倍。
abstract_en: Recently, community has paid increasing attention on model scaling and contributed to developing a model family with a wide spectrum of scales. Current methods either simply resort to a one-shot NAS manner to construct a non-structural and non-scalable model family or rely on a manual yet fixed scaling strategy to scale an unnecessarily best base model. In this paper, we bridge both two components and propose ScaleNet to jointly search base model and scaling strategy so that the scaled large model can have more promising performance. Concretely, we design a super-supernet to embody models with different spectrum of sizes (e.g., FLOPs). Then, the scaling strategy can be learned interactively with the base model via a Markov chain-based evolution algorithm and generalized to develop even larger models. To obtain a decent super-supernet, we design a hierarchical sampling strategy to enhance its training sufficiency and alleviate the disturbance. Experimental results show our scaled networks enjoy significant performance superiority on various FLOPs, but with at least 2.53x reduction on search cost.

title: Jiyuan Zhang, Lulu Tang, Zhaofei Yu, Jiwen Lu, Tiejun Huang
title_en: Jiyuan Zhang, Lulu Tang, Zhaofei Yu, Jiwen Lu, Tiejun Huang
abstract: 脉冲相机是一种仿生视觉传感器,其采样机制模仿了灵长类视网膜的中央凹结构,展现出在40,000 Hz采样率下捕捉高速动态场景的巨大潜力。与传统数码相机不同,脉冲相机持续捕获光子并输出异步二进制脉冲,这些脉冲编码了时间、位置和光强信息。由于采样机制的差异,适用于数码相机的现成图像处理算法无法直接应用于脉冲相机生成的脉冲流。因此,开发针对脉冲数据的新型算法对于常见计算机视觉任务具有特别意义。本文聚焦于深度估计任务,该任务因脉冲流的自然特性(如不规则性、连续性和时空相关性)而具有挑战性,且尚未针对脉冲相机进行探索。我们提出Spike Transformer(Spike-T),一种新型学习脉冲数据并从连续脉冲流中估计单目深度的范式。为适配脉冲数据到Transformer架构,我们设计了一种配备时空分块划分模块的输入脉冲嵌入机制,以保持空间和时间域的特征。此外,我们构建了两个基于脉冲的深度数据集:一个是合成数据集,另一个是通过真实脉冲相机采集的数据集。实验结果表明,所提出的Spike-T能够准确预测场景深度,并在多个基准测试中持续优于其直接竞争对手。更重要的是,Spike-T学习到的表示能够良好地迁移到未见过的真实数据,表明其在现实场景中的泛化能力。据我们所知,这是首次实现直接从脉冲流中进行深度估计。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/Leozhangjiyuan/MDE-SpikingCamera获取。
abstract_en: Spiking camera is a bio-inspired vision sensor that mimics the sampling mechanism of the primate fovea, which has shown great potential for capturing high-speed dynamic scenes with a sampling rate of 40,000 Hz. Unlike conventional digital cameras, the spiking camera continuously captures photons and outputs asynchronous binary spikes that encode time, location, and light intensity. Because of the different sampling mechanisms, the off-the-shelf image-based algorithms for digital cameras are unsuitable for spike streams generated by the spiking camera. Therefore, it is of particular interest to develop novel, spike-aware algorithms for common computer vision tasks. In this paper, we focus on the depth estimation task, which is challenging due to the natural properties of spike streams, such as irregularity, continuity, and spatial-temporal correlation, and has not been explored for the spiking camera. We present Spike Transformer (Spike-T), a novel paradigm for learning spike data and estimating monocular depth from continuous spike streams. To fit spike data to Transformer, we present an input spike embedding equipped with a spatio-temporal patch partition module to maintain features from both spatial and temporal domains. Furthermore, we build two spike-based depth datasets. One is synthetic, and the other is captured by a real spiking camera. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed Spike-T can favorably predict the scene’s depth and consistently outperform its direct competitors. More importantly, the representation learned by Spike-T transfers well to the unseen real data, indicating the generalization of Spike-T to real-world scenarios. To our best knowledge, this is the first time that directly depth estimation from spike streams becomes possible. Code and Datasets are available at https://github.com/Leozhangjiyuan/MDE-SpikingCamera.

title: Joakim Johnander, Johan Edstedt, Michael Felsberg, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Martin Danelljan
title_en: Joakim Johnander, Johan Edstedt, Michael Felsberg, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Martin Danelljan
abstract: Few-shot segmentation is a challenging dense prediction task, which entails segmenting a novel query image given only a small annotated support set. The key problem is thus to design a method that aggregates detailed information from the support set, while being robust to large variations in appearance and context. To this end, we propose a few-shot segmentation method based on dense Gaussian process (GP) regression. Given the support set, our dense GP learns the mapping from local deep image features to mask values, capable of capturing complex appearance distributions. Furthermore, it provides a principled means of capturing uncertainty, which serves as another powerful cue for the final segmentation, obtained by a CNN decoder. Instead of a one-dimensional mask output, we further exploit the end-to-end learning capabilities of our approach to learn a high-dimensional output space for the GP. Our approach sets a new state-of-the-art on the PASCAL-5i and COCO-20i benchmarks, achieving an absolute gain of +8.4 mIoU in the COCO-20i 5-shot setting. Furthermore, the segmentation quality of our approach scales gracefully when increasing the support set size, while achieving robust cross-dataset transfer.
abstract_en: Few-shot segmentation is a challenging dense prediction task, which entails segmenting a novel query image given only a small annotated support set. The key problem is thus to design a method that aggregates detailed information from the support set, while being robust to large variations in appearance and context. To this end, we propose a few-shot segmentation method based on dense Gaussian process (GP) regression. Given the support set, our dense GP learns the mapping from local deep image features to mask values, capable of capturing complex appearance distributions. Furthermore, it provides a principled means of capturing uncertainty, which serves as another powerful cue for the final segmentation, obtained by a CNN decoder. Instead of a one-dimensional mask output, we further exploit the end-to-end learning capabilities of our approach to learn a high-dimensional output space for the GP. Our approach sets a new state-of-the-art on the PASCAL-5i and COCO-20i benchmarks, achieving an absolute gain of +8.4 mIoU in the COCO-20i 5-shot setting. Furthermore, the segmentation quality of our approach scales gracefully when increasing the support set size, while achieving robust cross-dataset transfer.

title: Joanna Hong, Minsu Kim, Yong Man Ro
title_en: Joanna Hong, Minsu Kim, Yong Man Ro
abstract: 本工作的目标是从无声说话的面部视频中重建语音。近期研究表明,从无声说话的面部视频中合成语音取得了令人印象深刻的效果。然而,这些方法并未显式考虑不同说话人身份特征的变化,这给视频到语音合成带来了挑战,尤其在未见过的说话人场景中更为关键。我们的方法是将给定无声说话面部视频中的语音内容与面部风格进行分离。通过引导模型独立建模这两种表示,即使输入的是未见过的说话人视频,模型仍能生成高可理解性的语音。为此,我们引入了语音-面部选择机制,从输入视频的视觉特征中分离出语音内容和说话人身份。解耦的表示通过基于面部风格的合成器联合合成语音,该合成器在保持语音内容的同时应用面部风格。因此,所提出的框架具有优势,即使在未见过的说话人视频输入下,也能合成包含正确内容的语音。我们在GRID、TCD-TIMIT志愿者和LRW数据集上验证了所提框架的有效性。
abstract_en: The goal of this work is to reconstruct speech from a silent talking face video. Recent studies have shown impressive performance on synthesizing speech from silent talking face videos. However, they have not explicitly considered on varying identity characteristics of different speakers, which place a challenge in the video-to-speech synthesis, and this becomes more critical in unseen-speaker settings. Our approach is to separate the speech content and the visage-style from a given silent talking face video. By guiding the model to independently focus on modeling the two representations, we can obtain the speech of high intelligibility from the model even when the input video of an unseen subject is given. To this end, we introduce speech-visage selection that separates the speech content and the speaker identity from the visual features of the input video. The disentangled representations are jointly incorporated to synthesize speech through visage-style based synthesizer which generates speech by coating the visage-styles while maintaining the speech content. Thus, the proposed framework brings the advantage of synthesizing the speech containing the right content even with the silent talking face video of an unseen subject. We validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework on the GRID, TCD-TIMIT volunteer, and LRW datasets.

title: Joaquín Ossandón, Benjamín Earle, Alvaro Soto
title_en: Joaquín Ossandón, Benjamín Earle, Alvaro Soto
abstract: 视觉-语言导航(VLN)任务要求通过仅使用视觉信息理解文本指令来导航自然室内环境。尽管这对大多数人类来说是微不足道的任务,但对AI模型而言仍然是一个开放性问题。在本工作中,我们假设当前模型性能低下核心在于对可用视觉信息的利用不足。为支持这一假设,我们提供了实验证据表明,当模型仅接收有限甚至没有视觉数据时,最先进的模型性能并未显著下降,这表明其对文本指令存在严重过拟合。为鼓励更合适的视觉信息使用,我们提出了一种新的数据增强方法,促进在生成文本导航指令时包含更多显式的视觉信息。我们的主要直觉是当前VLN数据集中的文本指令旨在告知专家导航者(如人类),而非初学者视觉导航代理(如随机初始化的深度学习模型)。具体而言,为弥合当前VLN数据集的视觉语义鸿沟,我们利用Matterport3D数据集提供的元数据(包括场景中物体标签等信息)。使用新指令集训练最先进的模型,在未知环境中成功率提升了8%,验证了所提数据增强方法的优势。
abstract_en: The Visual-and-Language Navigation (VLN) task requires understanding a textual instruction to navigate a natural indoor environment using only visual information. While this is a trivial task for most humans, it is still an open problem for AI models. In this work, we hypothesize that poor use of the visual information available is at the core of the low performance of current models. To support this hypothesis, we provide experimental evidence showing that state-of-the-art models are not severely affected when they receive just limited or even no visual data, indicating a strong overfitting to the textual instructions. To encourage a more suitable use of the visual information, we propose a new data augmentation method that fosters the inclusion of more explicit visual information in the generation of textual navigational instructions. Our main intuition is that current VLN datasets include textual instructions that are intended to inform an expert navigator, such as a human, but not a beginner visual navigational agent, such as a randomly initialized DL model. Specifically, to bridge the visual semantic gap of current VLN datasets, we take advantage of metadata available for the Matterport3D dataset that, among others, includes information about object labels that are present in the scenes. Training a state-of-the-art model with the new set of instructions increase its performance by 8% in terms of success rate on unseen environments, demonstrating the advantages of the proposed data augmentation method.

title: Jogendra Nath Kundu, Suvaansh Bhambri, Akshay Kulkarni, Hiran Sarkar, Varun Jampani, R. Venkatesh Babu
title_en: Jogendra Nath Kundu, Suvaansh Bhambri, Akshay Kulkarni, Hiran Sarkar, Varun Jampani, R. Venkatesh Babu
abstract: 无监督域适应(DA)中的主要挑战是缓解源域与目标域之间的域偏移。先前的DA研究显示,可以通过学习域不变表示来利用预训练任务缓解这一域偏移。然而,在实践中,我们发现大多数现有的预训练任务在应对其他已建立的技术时效果不佳。因此,我们从理论上分析了如何以及何时可以利用辅助预训练任务来辅助给定DA问题的目标任务,并开发了辅助任务适用性准则。基于该准则,我们设计了一种新颖的贴纸干预过程,并将贴纸分类作为与目标任务无监督DA同时进行的监督辅助DA问题。我们的方法不仅提高了目标任务的适应性能,还促进了隐私导向的源域无访问DA,即无需同时访问源域和目标域。在标准的Office-31、Office-Home、DomainNet和VisDA基准上的实验表明,我们的方法在单源和多源源域无访问DA中均具有优越性。我们的方法还补充了现有的非源域无访问工作,实现了领先的性能。
abstract_en: The prime challenge in unsupervised domain adaptation (DA) is to mitigate the domain shift between the source and target domains. Prior DA works show that pretext tasks could be used to mitigate this domain shift by learning domain invariant representations. However, in practice, we find that most existing pretext tasks are ineffective against other established techniques. Thus, we theoretically analyze how and when a subsidiary pretext task could be leveraged to assist the goal task of a given DA problem and develop objective subsidiary task suitability criteria. Based on this criteria, we devise a novel process of sticker intervention and cast sticker classification as a supervised subsidiary DA problem concurrent to the goal task unsupervised DA. Our approach not only improves goal task adaptation performance, but also facilitates privacy-oriented source-free DA i.e. without concurrent source-target access. Experiments on the standard Office-31, Office-Home, DomainNet, and VisDA benchmarks demonstrate our superiority for both single-source and multi-source source-free DA. Our approach also complements existing non-source-free works, achieving leading performance.

title: Johannes Theodoridis, Jessica Hofmann, Johannes Maucher, Andreas Schilling
title_en: Johannes Theodoridis, Jessica Hofmann, Johannes Maucher, Andreas Schilling
abstract: 实例分割的深度学习模型是否能以系统化的方式泛化到新对象?在分类任务中,这种行为曾受到质疑。本研究旨在探讨框架、架构或预训练等设计决策是否有助于实例分割的语义理解。为回答这一问题,我们考虑鲁棒性的一个特殊案例,并在针对以对象为中心的分布外纹理的挑战性基准上比较预训练模型。本工作中我们并未引入新方法,而是后退一步,评估广泛存在的现有文献。这包括Cascade和Mask R-CNN、Swin Transformer、BMask、YOLACT(++)、DETR、BCNet、SOTR和SOLOv2。我们发现,YOLACT++、SOTR和SOLOv2在分布外纹理方面显著比其他框架更具鲁棒性。此外,我们证明了更深且动态的架构能提升鲁棒性,而训练计划、数据增强和预训练的影响则较为有限。总结而言,我们在61个MS COCO版本上评估了68个模型,共计完成4148次评估。
abstract_en: Do deep learning models for instance segmentation generalize to novel objects in a systematic way? For classification, such behavior has been questioned. In this study, we aim to understand if certain design decisions such as framework, architecture or pre-training contribute to the semantic understanding of instance segmentation. To answer this question, we consider a special case of robustness and compare pre-trained models on a challenging benchmark for object-centric out-of-distribution texture. We do not introduce another method in this work. Instead, we take a step back and evaluate a broad range of existing literature. This includes Cascade and Mask R-CNN, Swin Transformer, BMask, YOLACT(++), DETR, BCNet, SOTR and SOLOv2. We find that YOLACT++, SOTR and SOLOv2 are significantly more robust to out-of-distribution texture than other frameworks. In addition, we show that deeper and dynamic architectures improve robustness whereas training schedules, data augmentation and pre-training have only a minor impact. In summary we evaluate 68 models on 61 versions of MS COCO for a total of 4148 evaluations.

title: John Lambert, Yuguang Li, Ivaylo Boyadzhiev, Lambert Wixson, Manjunath Narayana, Will Hutchcroft, James Hays, Frank Dellaert, Sing Bing Kang
title_en: John Lambert, Yuguang Li, Ivaylo Boyadzhiev, Lambert Wixson, Manjunath Narayana, Will Hutchcroft, James Hays, Frank Dellaert, Sing Bing Kang
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的自动2D平面图重建系统,该系统由我们的新型成对学习对齐验证器SALVe所驱动。系统的输入是稀疏分布的360度全景图,其语义特征(窗户、门和开口)被推断并用于假设房间的相邻或重叠关系。SALVe初始化姿态图,随后使用GTSAM进行优化。一旦计算出房间姿态,便通过HorizonNet推断房间布局,并通过缝合最可信的布局边界来构建平面图。我们通过定性与定量分析以及消融研究验证了该系统,结果显示其在完整性上比最先进的SfM系统高出200%以上,而不会牺牲准确性。我们的结果表明了工作的意义:81%的全景图姿态在前两个连通分量(CCs)中被定位,89%在前三个CCs中。
abstract_en: We propose a new system for automatic 2D floorplan reconstruction that is enabled by SALVe, our novel pairwise learned alignment verifier. The inputs to our system are sparsely located 360 deg. panoramas, whose semantic features (windows, doors, and openings) are inferred and used to hypothesize pairwise room adjacency or overlap. SALVe initializes a pose graph, which is subsequently optimized using GTSAM. Once the room poses are computed, room layouts are inferred using HorizonNet, and the floorplan is constructed by stitching the most confident layout boundaries. We validate our system qualitatively and quantitatively as well as through ablation studies, showing that it outperforms state-of-the-art SfM systems in completeness by over 200%, without sacrificing accuracy. Our results point to the significance of our work: poses of 81% of panoramas are localized in the first 2 CCs connected components (CCs), and 89% in the first 3 CCs.

title: John Seon Keun Yi, Minseok Seo, Jongchan Park, Dong-Geol Choi
title_en: John Seon Keun Yi, Minseok Seo, Jongchan Park, Dong-Geol Choi
abstract: 对大量数据进行标注成本高昂。主动学习旨在通过仅标注未标记数据集中最具信息量的数据来解决这一问题。我们提出了一种新颖的主动学习方法,该方法利用自监督预训练任务和独特的数据采样器,选择既困难又具有代表性的数据。我们发现,简单的自监督预训练任务(如旋转预测)的损失与下游任务损失密切相关。在主动学习迭代之前,预训练任务学习器在未标记数据集上进行训练,并根据预训练任务损失对未标记数据进行排序和分批处理。在每次主动学习迭代中,使用主任务模型在批次中采样最不确定的数据进行标注。我们在各种图像分类和分割基准上评估了我们的方法,并在CIFAR10、Caltech-101、ImageNet和Cityscapes上取得了令人信服的性能。我们进一步表明,我们的方法在不平衡数据集上表现良好,并可作为冷启动问题的有效解决方案,其中主动学习性能受随机采样的初始标记数据集影响。
abstract_en: Labeling a large set of data is expensive. Active learning aims to tackle this problem by asking to annotate only the most informative data from the unlabeled set. We propose a novel active learning approach that utilizes self-supervised pretext tasks and a unique data sampler to select data that are both difficult and representative. We discover that the loss of a simple self-supervised pretext task, such as rotation prediction, is closely correlated to the downstream task loss. Before the active learning iterations, the pretext task learner is trained on the unlabeled set, and the unlabeled data are sorted and split into batches by their pretext task losses. In each active learning iteration, the main task model is used to sample the most uncertain data in a batch to be annotated. We evaluate our method on various image classification and segmentation benchmarks and achieve compelling performances on CIFAR10, Caltech-101, ImageNet, and Cityscapes. We further show that our method performs well on imbalanced datasets, and can be an effective solution to the cold-start problem where active learning performance is affected by the randomly sampled initial labeled set.

title: Jon Almazán, Byungsoo Ko, Geonmo Gu, Diane Larlus, Yannis Kalantidis
title_en: Jon Almazán, Byungsoo Ko, Geonmo Gu, Diane Larlus, Yannis Kalantidis
abstract: 强大的图像搜索模型可以在特定领域(即一组标签)中学习,前提是该领域有一些标记的图像。然而,一个实用的视觉搜索模型应该足够灵活,能够同时解决多个检索任务,即使这些任务涵盖非常不同的专业领域。此外,它还应能够从这些不同检索任务的无标记图像中受益。本文考虑的是这种更实际的场景。我们通过提出的Grappa方法来解决这个问题,该方法从一个强大的预训练模型开始,并利用不同任务领域中的无标记图像,同时适应以处理多个检索任务。我们通过扩展预训练模型,添加多个独立训练的适配器集,这些适配器集使用不同大小的伪标签集,有效地模拟了不同的伪粒度。我们通过学习融合层将所有适配器集统一为一个适合所有检索任务的模型,这些融合层通过在特征空间中传播伪粒度注意力来引导。在由六个异构检索任务组成的基准测试中,结果表明,无监督的Grappa模型提高了最先进的自监督学习模型的零样本性能,并在某些情况下达到了或超过了任务标签感知的Oracle,该Oracle根据任务选择最合适的伪粒度。
abstract_en: Strong image search models can be learned for a specific domain, ie. set of labels, provided that some labeled images of that domain are available. A practical visual search model, however, should be versatile enough to solve multiple retrieval tasks simultaneously, even if those cover very different specialized domains. Additionally, it should be able to benefit from even unlabeled images from these various retrieval tasks. This is the more practical scenario that we consider in this paper. We address it with the proposed Grappa, an approach that starts from a strong pretrained model, and adapts it to tackle multiple retrieval tasks concurrently, using only unlabeled images from the different task domains. We extend the pretrained model with multiple independently trained sets of adaptors that use pseudo-label sets of different sizes, effectively mimicking different pseudo-granularities. We reconcile all adaptor sets into a single unified model suited for all retrieval tasks by learning fusion layers that we guide by propagating pseudo-granularity attentions across neighbors in the feature space. Results on a benchmark composed of six heterogeneous retrieval tasks show that the unsupervised Grappa model improves the zero-shot performance of a state-of-the-art self-supervised learning model, and in some places reaches or improves over a task label-aware oracle that selects the most fitting pseudo-granularity per task.

title: 学习对敏感或不需要属性不变的图像表示对于许多任务(包括偏差消除和跨域检索)非常重要
title_en: Jonathan Kahana, Yedid Hoshen
abstract: 在此,我们的目标是学习对提供标签的域(敏感属性)不变的表示,同时对所有其他未标记的图像属性保持信息性。我们提出了一种新方法,提出了一种新的域级对比目标以确保不变表示。该目标关键地限制负图像对必须来自同一域,从而强制实现域不变性,而标准对比目标则不具备此特性。该域级目标本身不足以实现目标,因为它会因捷径解导致特征抑制。我们通过结合重建约束、图像增强和使用预训练权重初始化来克服这一问题。我们的分析表明,增强的选择至关重要,错误的增强选择可能会损害不变性和信息性目标。在广泛的评估中,我们的方法在表示不变性、表示信息性和训练速度方面均显著优于现有最先进的方法。此外,我们发现,在某些情况下,即使不使用重建约束,我们的方法也能取得出色结果,从而实现更快且资源效率更高的训练。
abstract_en: Learning representations of images that are invariant to sensitive or unwanted attributes is important for many tasks including bias removal and cross domain retrieval. Here, our objective is to learn representations that are invariant to the domain (sensitive attribute) for which labels are provided, while being informative over all other image attributes, which are unlabeled. We present a new approach, proposing a new domain-wise contrastive objective for ensuring invariant representations. This objective crucially restricts negative image pairs to be drawn from the same domain, which enforces domain invariance whereas the standard contrastive objective does not. This domain-wise objective is insufficient on its own as it suffers from shortcut solutions resulting in feature suppression. We overcome this issue by a combination of a reconstruction constraint, image augmentations and initialization with pre-trained weights. Our analysis shows that the choice of augmentations is important, and that a misguided choice of augmentations can harm the invariance and informativeness objectives. In an extensive evaluation, our method convincingly outperforms the state-of-the-art in terms of representation invariance, representation informativeness, and training speed. Furthermore, we find that in some cases our method can achieve excellent results even without the reconstruction constraint, leading to a much faster and resource efficient training.

title: Jonghyun Bae, Woohyeon Baek, Tae Jun Ham, Jae W. Lee
title_en: Jonghyun Bae, Woohyeon Baek, Tae Jun Ham, Jae W. Lee
abstract: 深度神经网络(DNN)的训练过程通常采用分阶段流水线处理,先在CPU上进行数据准备,随后在如GPU等加速器上进行梯度计算。在理想流水线中,端到端训练吞吐量最终受限于加速器的吞吐量,而非数据准备阶段。过去,通过使用轻量级有损图像格式(如JPEG)编码的数据集,DNN训练流水线实现了接近最优的吞吐量。然而,随着高分辨率、无损编码数据集在需要高精度的应用中变得越来越流行,由于CPU上图像解码吞吐量较低,数据准备阶段出现了性能问题。因此,我们提出L3,一种专为高分辨率、高吞吐量DNN训练设计的轻量级无损图像格式。L3的解码过程在加速器上有效并行化,从而在DNN训练期间最小化CPU在数据准备中的干预。在NVIDIA A100 GPU上,针对Cityscapes数据集,L3的数据准备吞吐量比最流行的无损图像格式PNG高出9.29倍,从而实现1.71倍的端到端训练吞吐量提升。与流行的有损图像格式JPEG和WebP相比,L3在ImageNet数据集上分别以同等指标性能实现了1.77倍和2.87倍的端到端训练吞吐量提升。
abstract_en: The training process of deep neural networks (DNNs) is usually pipelined with stages for data preparation on CPUs followed by gradient computation on accelerators like GPUs. In an ideal pipeline, the end-to-end training throughput is eventually limited by the throughput of the accelerator, not by that of data preparation. In the past, the DNN training pipeline achieved a near-optimal throughput by utilizing datasets encoded with a lightweight, lossy image format like JPEG. However, as high-resolution, losslessly-encoded datasets become more popular for applications requiring high accuracy, a performance problem arises in the data preparation stage due to low-throughput image decoding on the CPU. Thus, we propose L3, a custom lightweight, lossless image format for high-resolution, high-throughput DNN training. The decoding process of L3 is effectively parallelized on the accelerator, thus minimizing CPU intervention for data preparation during DNN training. L3 achieves a 9.29x higher data preparation throughput than PNG, the most popular lossless image format, for the Cityscapes dataset on NVIDIA A100 GPU, which leads to 1.71x higher end-to-end training throughput. Compared to JPEG and WebP, two popular lossy image formats, L3 provides up to 1.77x and 2.87x higher end-to-end training throughput for ImageNet, respectively, at equivalent metric performance.

title: 新视角合成是一个长期存在的问题
title_en: Jonáš Kulhánek, Erik Derner, Torsten Sattler, Robert Babuška
abstract: 在本文中,我们考虑该问题的一个变体,即仅提供少量稀疏覆盖场景或物体的上下文视图。目标是预测场景中的新视角,这需要学习先验知识。当前最先进的方法基于神经辐射场(NeRF),尽管取得了令人印象深刻的结果,但这些方法由于需要为每张图像通过神经网络评估数百万个3D点样本,导致训练时间较长。我们提出了一种仅基于2D的方法,该方法通过神经网络单次前向传播,将多个上下文视图和查询姿态映射到新图像。我们的模型采用由代码本和Transformer模型组成的两阶段架构。代码本用于将单个图像嵌入到更小的潜在空间中,而Transformer模型在此更紧凑的空间中解决视角合成任务。为了高效训练我们的模型,我们引入了一种新颖的分支注意力机制,使我们能够使用同一模型不仅进行神经渲染,还能进行相机姿态估计。在真实场景上的实验结果表明,我们的方法在不显式进行3D推理的情况下,与基于NeRF的方法相比具有竞争力,并且训练速度更快。
abstract_en: Novel view synthesis is a long-standing problem. In this work, we consider a variant of the problem where we are given only a few context views sparsely covering a scene or an object. The goal is to predict novel viewpoints in the scene, which requires learning priors. The current state of the art is based on Neural Radiance Field (NeRF), and while achieving impressive results, the methods suffer from long training times as they require evaluating millions of 3D point samples via a neural network for each image. We propose a 2D-only method that maps multiple context views and a query pose to a new image in a single pass of a neural network. Our model uses a two-stage architecture consisting of a codebook and a transformer model. The codebook is used to embed individual images into a smaller latent space, and the transformer solves the view synthesis task in this more compact space. To train our model efficiently, we introduce a novel branching attention mechanism that allows us to use the same model not only for neural rendering but also for camera pose estimation. Experimental results on real-world scenes show that our approach is competitive compared to NeRF-based methods while not reasoning explicitly in 3D, and it is faster to train.

title: Joshua Andle, Salimeh Yasaei Sekeh
title_en: Joshua Andle, Salimeh Yasaei Sekeh
abstract: 持续学习(CL)要求模型在保留先前知识的同时,持续利用增量可用信息学习新任务。尽管已有大量CL方法,但大多数仍存在遗忘问题、高昂的内存成本或缺乏充分的理论理解。虽然不同CL训练范式已被广泛实证研究,但对其底层理论的关注仍显不足。本文建立了一个概率框架,分析网络层间信息流动在序列任务中的作用及其对学习性能的影响。我们的目标是在学习新任务时优化层间信息保留。这使得特定任务知识能够贯穿各层传播,同时保持对先前任务的模型性能。我们的分析为增量任务学习过程中层内信息适应提供了新见解。我们提供了实证证据,并突出展示了多任务性能的提升。代码可在https://github.com/Sekeh-Lab/InformationFlow-CL获取。
abstract_en: Continual learning (CL) requires a model to continually learn new tasks with incremental available information while retaining previous knowledge. Despite the numerous previous approaches to CL, most of them still suffer forgetting, expensive memory cost, or lack sufficient theoretical understanding. While different CL training regimes have been extensively studied empirically, insufficient attention has been paid to the underlying theory. In this paper, we establish a probabilistic framework to analyze information flow through layers in networks for sequential tasks and its impact on learning performance. Our objective is to optimize the information preservation between layers while learning new tasks. This manages task-specific knowledge passing throughout the layers while maintaining model performance on previous tasks. Our analysis provides novel insights into information adaptation within the layers during incremental task learning. We provide empirical evidence and practically highlight the performance improvement across multiple tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/Sekeh-Lab/InformationFlow-CL.

title: Joshua Weir, Junhong Zhao, Andrew Chalmers, Taehyun Rhee
title_en: Joshua Weir, Junhong Zhao, Andrew Chalmers, Taehyun Rhee
abstract: 我们提出了一种深度神经网络,用于去除无约束人像图像中的不想要的阴影特征,恢复底层纹理。我们的训练方案结合了三种正则化策略:掩码损失,以强调高频阴影特征;软阴影损失,提高对光照细微变化的敏感性;以及阴影偏移估计,以监督阴影与纹理的分离。与现有最先进的方法相比,我们的方法在愉悦度质量与泛化能力方面均有提升。我们进一步展示了如何通过我们的愉悦度方法增强对光敏感的计算机视觉任务(如人脸重照明和语义分割)的性能,使其能够处理极端光照条件。
abstract_en: We present a deep neural network for removing undesirable shading features from an unconstrained portrait image, recovering the underlying texture. Our training scheme incorporates three regularization strategies: masked loss, to emphasize high-frequency shading features; soft-shadow loss, which improves sensitivity to subtle changes in lighting; and shading-offset estimation, to supervise separation of shading and texture. Our method demonstrates improved delighting quality and generalization when compared with the state-of-the-art. We further demonstrate how our delighting method can enhance the performance of light-sensitive computer vision tasks such as face relighting and semantic parsing, allowing them to handle extreme lighting conditions.

title: José Lezama, Huiwen Chang, Lu Jiang, Irfan Essa
title_en: José Lezama, Huiwen Chang, Lu Jiang, Irfan Essa
abstract: 非自回归生成式变压器最近在图像生成任务中表现出色,其采样速度比自回归模型快几个数量级。然而,从视觉标记的真实联合分布中进行最优并行采样仍然是一个开放性挑战。在本文中,我们引入了Token-Critic,这是一个辅助模型,用于指导非自回归生成式变压器的采样过程。给定一个掩码并重建的真实图像,Token-Critic模型被训练以区分哪些视觉标记属于原始图像,哪些是由生成式变压器采样的。在非自回归迭代采样过程中,Token-Critic用于选择接受哪些标记以及拒绝并重新采样的标记。结合Token-Critic,最先进的生成式变压器显著提升了其性能,并在生成图像质量和多样性之间的权衡上,优于最近的扩散模型和生成对抗网络,特别是在具有挑战性的类别条件下的ImageNet生成任务中。
abstract_en: Non-autoregressive generative transformers recently demonstrated impressive image generation performance, and orders of magnitude faster sampling than their autoregressive counterparts. However, optimal parallel sampling from the true joint distribution of visual tokens remains an open challenge. In this paper we introduce Token-Critic, an auxiliary model to guide the sampling of a non-autoregressive generative transformer. Given a masked-and-reconstructed real image, the Token-Critic model is trained to distinguish which visual tokens belong to the original image and which were sampled by the generative transformer. During non-autoregressive iterative sampling, Token-Critic is used to select which tokens to accept and which to reject and resample. Coupled with Token-Critic, a state-of-the-art generative transformer significantly improves its performance, and outperforms recent diffusion models and GANs in terms of the trade-off between generated image quality and diversity, in the challenging class-conditional ImageNet generation.

title: Jou Won Song, Ye-In Park, Kyeongbo Kong, Jaeho Kwak, Suk-Ju Kang
title_en: Jou Won Song, Ye-In Park, Kyeongbo Kong, Jaeho Kwak, Suk-Ju Kang
abstract: 高动态范围(HDR)成像中的主要问题是在合并多曝光低动态范围图像时去除鬼影伪影。在弱对齐区域,可以使用基于卷积神经网络(CNN)的方法来抑制鬼影伪影。然而,在高度对齐区域,由于局部区域中不存在必要的信息,必须从全局区域提取特征。因此,专门用于局部特征提取的CNN方法无法获得令人满意的结果。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种基于Transformer的选择性HDR图像重建网络,该网络使用鬼影区域掩码。所提出的方法将给定图像分为鬼影和非鬼影区域,然后选择性地应用CNN或Transformer。所提出的选择性Transformer模块将整个图像划分为若干区域,以有效提取每个区域的特征,从而在鬼影区域中从整个图像中提取HDR重建所需的全部信息。在多个基准数据集上进行的大量实验表明,所提出的方法在抑制鬼影伪影方面优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: The primary issue in high dynamic range (HDR) imaging is the removal of ghost artifacts afforded when merging multi-exposure low dynamic range images. In the weakly misaligned region, ghost artifacts can be suppressed using convolutional neural network (CNN)-based methods. However, in highly misaligned regions, it is necessary to extract features from the global region because the necessary information does not exist in the local region. Therefore, the CNN-based methods specialized for local features extraction cannot obtain satisfactory results. To address this issue, we propose a transformer-based selective HDR image reconstruction network that uses a ghost region mask. The proposed method separates a given image into ghost and non-ghost regions, and then, selectively applies either the CNN or the transformer. The proposed selective transformer module divides an entire image into several regions to effectively extract the features of each region for HDR image reconstruction, thereby extracting the whole information required for HDR reconstruction in the ghost regions from the entire image. Extensive experiments conducted on several benchmark datasets demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method over existing state-of-the-art methods in terms of the mitigation of ghost artifacts.

title: Jovita Lukasik, Steffen Jung, Margret Keuper
title_en: Jovita Lukasik, Steffen Jung, Margret Keuper
abstract: 近年来,高效、自动化的高性能神经架构搜索(NAS)受到了越来越多的关注。研究的主要目标是减少对神经架构成本高昂的评估需求,同时高效探索大规模搜索空间。为此,代理模型将架构嵌入潜在空间并预测其性能,而神经架构生成模型则能够在生成器所采样的潜在空间中进行基于优化的搜索。代理模型和生成模型均旨在促进在结构良好的潜在空间中的高效查询搜索。本文进一步通过结合高效代理模型和生成设计的优势,改进了查询效率与优质架构生成之间的权衡。为此,我们提出了一种生成模型,与代理预测器配对,能够迭代地从越来越有前景的潜在子空间中生成样本。该方法实现了非常高效且有效的架构搜索,同时保持查询数量较低。此外,我们的方法可以以一种直接的方式联合优化多个目标,如准确性和硬件延迟。我们不仅在优化最高分类准确性的架构方面展示了该方法的优势,还在硬件约束的背景下表现优异,并在多个单目标和多目标NAS基准测试中超越了现有最先进的方法。我们在ImageNet上也取得了最先进的性能。代码可在https://github.com/jovitalukasik/AG-Net获取。
abstract_en: The efficient, automated search for well-performing neural architectures (NAS) has drawn increasing attention in the recent past. Thereby, the predominant research objective is to reduce the necessity of costly evaluations of neural architectures while efficiently exploring large search spaces. To this aim, surrogate models embed architectures in a latent space and predict their performance, while generative models for neural architectures enable optimization-based search within the latent space the generator draws from. Both, surrogate and generative models, have the aim of facilitating query-efficient search in a well-structured latent space. In this paper, we further improve the trade-off between query-efficiency and promising architecture generation by leveraging advantages from both, efficient surrogate models and generative design. To this end, we propose a generative model, paired with a surrogate predictor, that iteratively learns to generate samples from increasingly promising latent subspaces. This approach leads to very effective and efficient architecture search, while keeping the query amount low. In addition, our approach allows in a straightforward manner to jointly optimize for multiple objectives such as accuracy and hardware latency. We show the benefit of this approach not only w.r.t. the optimization of architectures for highest classification accuracy but also in the context of hardware constraints and outperform state-of-the-art methods on several NAS benchmarks for single and multiple objectives. We also achieve state-of-the-art performance on ImageNet. The code is available at https://github.com/jovitalukasik/AG-Net.

title: Ju He, Shuo Yang, Shaokang Yang, Adam Kortylewski, Xiaoding Yuan, Jie-Neng Chen, Shuai Liu, Cheng Yang, Qihang Yu, Alan Yuille
title_en: Ju He, Shuo Yang, Shaokang Yang, Adam Kortylewski, Xiaoding Yuan, Jie-Neng Chen, Shuai Liu, Cheng Yang, Qihang Yu, Alan Yuille
abstract: 以物体的部件来表示物体是自然的。这有望提升目标识别和分割算法的性能,同时也能帮助后续任务如活动识别。然而,基于部件的模型研究受到缺乏带有逐像素部件标注数据集的限制。这在很大程度上是由于标注物体部件的困难和高成本,因此除人类(已有大量基于部件的模型研究)外鲜有进行。为解决这一问题,我们提出PartImageNet,一个包含$158$类、约24,000张图像的大型高质量数据集,提供部件分割标注。PartImageNet的独特之处在于它在非刚性、可变形物体等通用类别上提供部件级标注,且数据量比现有部件数据集(排除人类数据集)大一个数量级。该数据集可用于目标分割、语义部件分割、少样本学习和部件发现等众多视觉任务。我们进行了全面实验研究这些任务,并建立了相应的基线模型。
abstract_en: It is natural to represent objects in terms of their parts. This has the potential to improve the performance of algorithms for object recognition and segmentation but can also help for downstream tasks like activity recognition. Research on part-based models, however, is hindered by the lack of datasets with per-pixel part annotations. This is partly due to the difficulty and high cost of annotating object parts so it has rarely been done except for humans (where there exists a big literature on part-based models). To help address this problem, we propose PartImageNet, a large, high-quality dataset with part segmentation annotations. It consists of $158$ classes from ImageNet with approximately 24,000 images. PartImageNet is unique because it offers part-level annotations on a general set of classes including non-rigid, articulated objects, while having an order of magnitude larger size compared to existing part datasets (excluding datasets of humans). It can be utilized for many vision tasks including Object Segmentation, Semantic Part Segmentation, Few-shot Learning and Part Discovery. We conduct comprehensive experiments which study these tasks and set up a set of baselines.

title: Juan F. Montesinos, Venkatesh S. Kadandale, Gloria Haro
title_en: Juan F. Montesinos, Venkatesh S. Kadandale, Gloria Haro
abstract: 本文提出了一种视听方法用于语音分离,在语音和歌唱语音的两种场景中实现了低延迟下的最先进结果。该模型基于两阶段网络架构。首先,通过轻量级图卷积网络处理面部关键点以获取运动线索。随后,音频和运动特征被输入到视听Transformer中,以生成较为准确的孤立目标声源估计。在第二阶段,主导语音通过仅音频网络进行增强。我们展示了不同的消融研究及与最先进方法的对比实验。最后,我们探讨了在语音分离任务中训练的模型在歌唱语音分离任务中的迁移性。演示、代码和权重可在 https://ipcv.github.io/VoViT/ 获取。
abstract_en: This paper presents an audio-visual approach for voice separation which produces state-of-the-art results at a low latency in two scenarios: speech and singing voice. The model is based on a two-stage network. Motion cues are obtained with a lightweight graph convolutional network that processes face landmarks. Then, both audio and motion features are fed to an audio-visual transformer which produces a fairly good estimation of the isolated target source. In a second stage, the predominant voice is enhanced with an audio-only network. We present different ablation studies and comparison to state-of-the-art methods. Finally, we explore the transferability of models trained for speech separation in the task of singing voice separation. The demos, code, and weights are available in https://ipcv.github.io/VoViT/

title: Juan León Alcázar, Moritz Cordes, Chen Zhao, Bernard Ghanem
title_en: Juan León Alcázar, Moritz Cordes, Chen Zhao, Bernard Ghanem
abstract: 摘要。近期主动说话人检测(ASD)问题的进展基于一个两阶段过程:特征提取和时空上下文聚合。本文提出了一种端到端的ASD工作流程,其中特征学习和上下文预测被联合学习。我们的端到端可训练网络同时学习多模态嵌入并聚合时空上下文。这导致了更适合的特征表示和ASD任务中性能的提升。我们还引入了交错图神经网络(iGNN)模块,根据ASD问题中的主要上下文来源划分消息传递。实验表明,iGNN模块聚合的特征更适合ASD,从而实现了最先进的性能。最后,我们设计了一种弱监督策略,证明了ASD问题也可以通过利用视听数据但仅依赖音频标注来解决。我们通过建模音频信号与可能声源(说话人)之间的直接关系,并引入对比损失实现了这一点。
abstract_en: Abstract. Recent advances in the Active Speaker Detection (ASD) problem build upon a two stage process: feature extraction and spatio-temporal context aggregation. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end ASD workflow where feature learning and contextual predictions are jointly learned. Our end-to-end trainable network simultaneously learns multi-modal embeddings and aggregates spatio-temporal context. This results in more suitable feature representations and improved performance in the ASD task. We also introduce interleaved graph neural network (iGNN) blocks, which split the message passing according to the main sources of context in the ASD problem. Experiments show that the aggregated features from the iGNN blocks are more suitable for ASD, resulting in state-of-the art performance. Finally, we design a weakly-supervised strategy, which demonstrates that the ASD problem can also be approached by utilizing audiovisual data but relying exclusively on audio annotations. We achieve this by modelling the direct relationship between the audio signal and the possible sound sources (speakers), as well as introducing a contrastive loss.

title: Juewen Peng, Jianming Zhang, Xianrui Luo, Hao Lu, Ke Xian, Zhiguo Cao
title_en: Juewen Peng, Jianming Zhang, Xianrui Luo, Hao Lu, Ke Xian, Zhiguo Cao
abstract: 部分遮挡效应是一种现象,即相机附近的模糊物体呈现半透明状态,导致被遮挡背景的部分显现。然而,现有景深渲染方法难以模拟真实的部分遮挡效应,原因在于全焦图像中遮挡区域的信息缺失。受可学习的3D场景表示——多平面图像(MPI)的启发,我们尝试通过引入一种基于MPI的高分辨率景深渲染框架MPIB来解决部分遮挡问题。为此,我们首先分析了如何将MPI表示应用于景深渲染。基于此分析,我们提出了一种结合背景修复模块的MPI表示模块,以实现高分辨率场景表示。该表示可重复用于根据控制参数渲染各种景深效果。为了训练和测试模型,我们还设计了一种基于光线追踪的景深生成器进行数据生成。在合成图像和真实世界图像上的大量实验验证了该框架的有效性和灵活性。
abstract_en: Partial occlusion effects are a phenomenon that blurry objects near a camera are semi-transparent, resulting in partial appearance of occluded background. However, it is challenging for existing bokeh rendering methods to simulate realistic partial occlusion effects due to the missing information of the occluded area in an all-in-focus image. Inspired by the learnable 3D scene representation, Multiplane Image (MPI), we attempt to address the partial occlusion by introducing a novel MPI-based high-resolution bokeh rendering framework, termed MPIB. To this end, we first present an analysis on how to apply the MPI representation to bokeh rendering. Based on this analysis, we propose an MPI representation module combined with a background inpainting module to implement high-resolution scene representation. This representation can then be reused to render various bokeh effects according to the controlling parameters. To train and test our model, we also design a ray-tracing-based bokeh generator for data generation. Extensive experiments on synthesized and real-world images validate the effectiveness and flexibility of this framework.

title: Julia Grabinski, Steffen Jung, Janis Keuper, Margret Keuper
title_en: Julia Grabinski, Steffen Jung, Janis Keuper, Margret Keuper
abstract: 近年来,卷积神经网络(CNNs)已成为计算机视觉任务中占主导地位的神经网络架构。从图像和信号处理的角度来看,这一成功可能令人意外,因为大多数CNNs固有的空间金字塔设计显然违反了基本的信号处理定律,即在下采样操作中违反采样定理。然而,由于较差的采样似乎不影响模型的准确性,这一问题一直被忽视,直到模型鲁棒性开始受到更多关注。在对抗攻击和分布偏移的背景下,最近的研究[18]表明,CNNs的脆弱性与较差下采样操作引起的混叠伪影之间存在强相关性。本文基于这些发现,提出了一种无混叠的下采样操作,可以轻松地插入到任何CNN架构中:FrequencyLowCut pooling。我们的实验表明,结合简单的Fast Gradient Sign Method(FGSM)对抗训练,我们的无超参数操作显著提高了模型的鲁棒性,并避免了灾难性过拟合。我们的代码可在https://github.com/GeJulia/flc_pooling获取。
abstract_en: Over the last years, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have been the dominating neural architecture in a wide range of computer vision tasks. From an image and signal processing point of view, this success might be a bit surprising as the inherent spatial pyramid design of most CNNs is apparently violating basic signal processing laws, i.e. Sampling Theorem in their down-sampling operations. However, since poor sampling appeared not to affect model accuracy, this issue has been broadly neglected until model robustness started to receive more attention. Recent work [18] in the context of adversarial attacks and distribution shifts, showed after all, that there is a strong correlation between the vulnerability of CNNs and aliasing artifacts induced by poor down-sampling operations. This paper builds on these findings and introduces an aliasing free down-sampling operation which can easily be plugged into any CNN architecture: FrequencyLowCut pooling. Our experiments show, that in combination with simple and Fast Gradient Sign Method (FGSM) adversarial training, our hyper-parameter free operator substantially improves model robustness and avoids catastrophic overfitting. Our code is available at https://github.com/GeJulia/flc_pooling.

title: Julia Hornauer, Vasileios Belagiannis
title_en: Julia Hornauer, Vasileios Belagiannis
abstract: 在单目深度估计中,图像上下文中的干扰(如移动物体或反射材料)很容易导致错误预测。因此,对于安全关键应用(如自动驾驶),每个像素的不确定性估计是必要的。我们提出了一种事后不确定性估计方法,用于已经训练完成且固定的深度估计模型,该模型由深度神经网络表示。通过使用辅助损失函数提取的梯度来估计不确定性。为了避免在损失定义中依赖真实信息,我们提出了一种基于图像及其水平翻转对应图像的深度预测对应关系的辅助损失函数。我们的方法在KITTI和NYU Depth V2基准测试中实现了最先进的不确定性估计结果,而无需重新训练神经网络。模型和代码已公开在https://github.com/jhornauer/GrUMoDepth。
abstract_en: In monocular depth estimation, disturbances in the image context, like moving objects or reflecting materials, can easily lead to erroneous predictions. For that reason, uncertainty estimates for each pixel are necessary, in particular for safety-critical applications such as automated driving. We propose a post hoc uncertainty estimation approach for an already trained and thus fixed depth estimation model, represented by a deep neural network. The uncertainty is estimated with the gradients which are extracted with an auxiliary loss function. To avoid relying on ground-truth information for the loss definition, we present an auxiliary loss function based on the correspondence of the depth prediction for an image and its horizontally flipped counterpart. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art uncertainty estimation results on the KITTI and NYU Depth V2 benchmarks without the need to retrain the neural network. Models and code are publicly available at https://github.com/jhornauer/GrUMoDepth.

title: Julian Chibane, Francis Engelmann, Tuan Anh Tran, Gerard Pons-Moll
title_en: Julian Chibane, Francis Engelmann, Tuan Anh Tran, Gerard Pons-Moll
abstract: 当前三维分割方法严重依赖大规模点云数据集,而这些数据集的标注工作异常繁琐。针对减少对逐点密集标注需求的尝试较少。本文研究弱监督三维语义实例分割。其核心思想是利用更容易且更快标注的三维边界框标签。事实上,我们证明仅使用边界框标签即可训练密集分割模型。我们的方法核心是\name{},其基于经典霍夫投票的深度模型,直接对边界框参数进行投票,并采用专门针对边界框投票的聚类方法。这超越了常用的中心投票方法,后者无法充分利用边界框标注。在ScanNet测试集上,我们的弱监督模型在其他弱监督方法中取得领先性能(+18 mAP@50)。值得注意的是,它还达到了当前全监督模型mAP@50得分的97%。为进一步验证工作的实用性,我们在最近发布的仅标注有三维边界框的ARKitScenes数据集上训练Box2Mask,并首次展示了令人信服的三维实例分割掩码。
abstract_en: Current 3D segmentation methods heavily rely on large-scale point-cloud datasets, which are notoriously laborious to annotate. Few attempts have been made to circumvent the need for dense per-point annotations. In this work, we look at weakly-supervised 3D semantic instance segmentation. The key idea is to leverage 3D bounding box labels which are easier and faster to annotate. Indeed, we show that it is possible to train dense segmentation models using only bounding box labels. At the core of our method, \name{}, lies a deep model, inspired by classical Hough voting, that directly votes for bounding box parameters, and a clustering method specifically tailored to bounding box votes. This goes beyond commonly used center votes, which would not fully exploit the bounding box annotations. On ScanNet test, our weakly supervised model attains leading performance among other weakly supervised approaches (+18 mAP@50). Remarkably, it also achieves 97% of the mAP@50 score of current fully supervised models. To further illustrate the practicality of our work, we train Box2Mask on the recently released ARKitScenes dataset which is annotated with 3D bounding boxes only, and show, for the first time, compelling 3D instance segmentation masks.

title: Julien Pourcel, Ngoc-Son Vu, Robert M. French
title_en: Julien Pourcel, Ngoc-Son Vu, Robert M. French
abstract: 本文针对在线任务无关持续学习这一极具挑战性的问题展开研究,该问题要求从非平稳数据中学习一系列新任务,每个样本仅用于一次训练且无需已知任务边界。本文提出了一种高效的半分布式关联记忆算法,称为动态稀疏分布式记忆(DSDM),该算法可在任意时间点进行学习和评估。DSDM能够动态且持续地建模任何非平稳数据流的分布。DSDM依赖于局部分布式但部分重叠的表示聚类,有效消除灾难性遗忘,同时保持分布式网络的泛化能力。此外,采用基于局部密度的剪枝技术来控制网络的记忆占用。DSDM在不同图像分类基准上显著优于最先进的持续学习方法,即使在数据量较少的场景下也表现优异。代码已公开:https://github.com/Julien-pour/Dynamic-Sparse-Distributed-Memory
abstract_en: This paper addresses the very challenging problem of online task-free continual learning in which a sequence of new tasks is learned from non-stationary data using each sample only once for training and without knowledge of task boundaries. We propose in this paper an efficient semi-distributed associative memory algorithm called Dynamic Sparse Distributed Memory (DSDM) where learning and evaluating can be carried out at any point of time. DSDM evolves dynamically and continually modeling the distribution of any non-stationary data streams. DSDM relies on locally distributed, but only partially overlapping clusters of representations to effectively eliminate catastrophic forgetting, while at the same time, maintaining the generalization capacities of distributed networks. In addition, a local density-based pruning technique is used to control the network’s memory footprint. DSDM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art continual learning methods on different image classification baselines, even in a low data regime. Code is publicly available: https://github.com/Julien-pour/Dynamic-Sparse-Distributed-Memory

title: Jun Cen, Peng Yun, Shiwei Zhang, Junhao Cai, Di Luan, Mingqian Tang, Ming Liu, Michael Yu Wang
title_en: Jun Cen, Peng Yun, Shiwei Zhang, Junhao Cai, Di Luan, Mingqian Tang, Ming Liu, Michael Yu Wang
abstract: 经典LIDAR语义分割在现实应用场景(如自动驾驶)中不够鲁棒,因为其为闭集且静态。闭集网络只能输出训练类别标签,即使面对未见过的对象;静态网络无法根据新数据更新知识库。因此,我们提出面向LIDAR点云的开放世界语义分割任务,旨在1)通过开放集语义分割识别新旧类别,2)通过增量学习逐步将新对象整合至现有知识库,同时避免遗忘旧类别。我们提出REdundAncy cLassifier(REAL)框架,为开放集语义分割和增量学习提供通用架构。实验结果表明,REAL在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes数据集的开放集语义分割任务中达到SOTA性能,并在增量学习中显著缓解灾难性遗忘问题。
abstract_en: Classical LIDAR semantic segmentation is not robust for real-world applications, e.g., autonomous driving, since it is closed-set and static. The closed-set network is only able to output labels of trained classes, even for objects never seen before, while a static network cannot update its knowledge base according to what it has seen. Therefore, we propose the open-world semantic segmentation task for LIDAR point clouds, which aims to 1) identify both old and novel classes using open-set semantic segmentation, and 2) gradually incorporate novel objects into the existing knowledge base using incremental learning without forgetting old classes. We propose a REdundAncy cLassifier (REAL) framework to provide a general architecture for both open-set semantic segmentation and incremental learning. The experimental results show that REAL can achieves state-of-the-art performance in the open-set semantic segmentation task on the SemanticKITTI and nuScenes datasets, and alleviate the catastrophic forgetting with a large margin during incremental learning.

title: Jun Wang, Abhir Bhalerao, Yulan He
title_en: Jun Wang, Abhir Bhalerao, Yulan He
abstract: 医学影像报告生成(RRG)旨在以类人语言自动描述医学影像,有望支持放射科医生的工作,减轻手动报告的负担。先前方法通常采用编码器-解码器架构,专注于单模态特征学习,而较少研究探索跨模态特征交互。本文提出一种跨模态原型驱动的网络(XPRONET),以促进跨模态模式学习并利用其提升医学影像报告生成任务。该方法通过三个精心设计、完全可微且互补的模块实现:共享的跨模态原型矩阵用于记录跨模态原型;跨模态原型网络用于学习跨模态原型并将跨模态信息嵌入到视觉和文本特征中;以及改进的多标签对比损失,以实现并增强多标签原型学习。XPRONET在IU-Xray和MIMIC-CXR基准测试中取得了显著提升,其在IU-Xray上的表现远超近期最先进方法,在MIMIC-CXR上也达到可比性能。
abstract_en: Radiology report generation (RRG) aims to describe automatically a radiology image with human-like language and could potentially support the work of radiologists, reducing the burden of manual reporting. Previous approaches often adopt an encoder-decoder architecture and focus on single-modal feature learning, while few studies explore cross-modal feature interaction. Here we propose a Cross-modal PROtotype driven NETwork (XPRONET) to promote cross-modal pattern learning and exploit it to improve the task of radiology report generation. This is achieved by three well-designed, fully differentiable and complementary modules: a shared cross-modal prototype matrix to record the cross-modal prototypes; a cross-modal prototype network to learn the cross-modal prototypes and embed the cross-modal information into the visual and textual features; and an improved multi-label contrastive loss to enable and enhance multi-label prototype learning. XPRONET obtains substantial improvements on the IU-Xray and MIMIC-CXR benchmarks, where its performance exceeds recent state-of-the-art approaches by a large margin on IU-Xray and comparable performance on MIMIC-CXR.

title: Jun Wei, Sheng Wang, S. Kevin Zhou, Shengguang Cui, Zhen Li
title_en: Jun Wei, Sheng Wang, S. Kevin Zhou, Shuguang Cui, Zhen Li
abstract: 弱监督目标定位(WSOL)旨在仅通过图像级标签检测目标。类激活图(CAMs)是WSOL中常用的特征。然而,现有基于CAM的方法往往过度追求用于目标识别的判别性特征,从而忽略了不同类别间的特征相似性,导致CAMs在目标定位中不完整。此外,由于过度依赖整体分类,CAMs对背景噪声敏感。本文提出了一种简单但有效的WSOL模型(命名为ISIC),通过类间特征相似性与类内外观一致性。在实践中,我们的ISIC模型首先针对原始交叉熵损失提出类间特征相似性(ICFS)损失。这种ICFS损失充分利用了不同类别间的共享特征与判别性特征,显著降低了模型对背景噪声的过拟合风险,并生成更完整的目标掩码。此外,替代CAMs,采用非负矩阵分解掩码模块从多张类内图像中提取目标掩码。得益于类内外观一致性,获得的伪掩码更加完整且鲁棒。因此,大量实验验证表明,我们的ISIC模型在CUB-200和ImageNet-1K基准测试中均达到最先进水平,即分别达到97.3%和70.0%的GT-Known定位准确率。
abstract_en: Weakly supervised object localization (WSOL) aims at detecting objects through only image-level labels. Class activation maps (CAMs) are the commonly used features for WSOL. However, existing CAM-based methods tend to excessively pursue discriminative features for object recognition and hence ignore the feature similarities among different categories, thereby leading to CAMs incomplete for object localization. In addition, CAMs are sensitive to background noise due to over-dependence on the holistic classification. In this paper, we propose a simple but effective WSOL model (named ISIC) through Inter-class feature Similarity and Intra-class appearance Consistency. In practice, our ISIC model first proposes the inter-class feature similarity (ICFS) loss against the original cross entropy loss. Such an ICFS loss sufficiently leverages the shared features together with the discriminative features between different categories, which significantly reduces the model over-fitting risk to background noise and brings more complete object masks. Besides, instead of CAMs, a non-negative matrix factorization mask module is applied to extract object masks from multiple intra-class images. Thanks to intra-class appearance consistency, the achieved pseudo masks are more complete and robust. As a result, extensive experiments confirm that our ISIC model achieves state-of-the-art on both CUB-200 and ImageNet-1K benchmarks i.e., 97.3% and 70.0% GT-Known localization accuracy, respectively.

title: Jun-Kun Chen, Yu-Xiong Wang
title_en: Jun-Kun Chen, Yu-Xiong Wang
abstract: 在原始点云上直接学习有效的语义表示已成为3D理解的核心课题。尽管取得了快速进展,最先进的编码器仍受限于规范化的点云,并在遭遇几何变换失真时表现出不足的性能。为克服这一挑战,我们提出PointTree,一种基于松弛K-D树的通用点云编码器,具有对变换的鲁棒性。我们的方法关键在于利用主成分分析(PCA)设计K-D树的划分规则。我们将松弛K-D树的结构作为计算图,并将特征建模为边界描述符,通过点级最大值操作进行融合。除该新颖的架构设计外,我们进一步通过引入预对齐——一种简单而有效的基于PCA的归一化方案——提升鲁棒性。我们的PointTree编码器结合预对齐在各类变换版本的广泛基准数据集上,从物体分类到语义分割的应用中均显著超越现有最先进方法。代码和预训练模型可在https://github.com/immortalCO/PointTree获取。
abstract_en: Being able to learn an effective semantic representation directly on raw point clouds has become a central topic in 3D understanding. Despite rapid progress, state-of-the-art encoders are restrictive to canonicalized point clouds, and have weaker than necessary performance when encountering geometric transformation distortions. To overcome this challenge, we propose PointTree, a general-purpose point cloud encoder that is robust to transformations based on relaxed K-D trees. Key to our approach is the design of the division rule in K-D trees by using principal component analysis (PCA). We use the structure of the relaxed K-D tree as our computational graph, and model the features as border descriptors which are merged with pointwise-maximum operation. In addition to this novel architecture design, we further improve the robustness by introducing pre-alignment -- a simple yet effective PCA-based normalization scheme. Our PointTree encoder combined with pre-alignment consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods by large margins, for applications from object classification to semantic segmentation on various transformed versions of the widely-benchmarked datasets. Code and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/immortalCO/PointTree.

title: Junbang Liang, Ming Lin
title_en: Junbang Liang, Ming Lin
abstract: 织物材料在虚拟世界中重现虚拟形象真实外观以及许多VR应用(如虚拟试穿、远程会议、角色动画)中起着核心作用。我们提出了一种端到端网络模型,利用视频输入估计虚拟世界中人类或虚拟形象所穿服装的织物材料。为实现高精度,我们联合学习人体和服装几何形状作为材料预测的条件。由于织物具有高度动态和可变形的特性,通用的数据驱动服装建模仍面临挑战。为解决这一问题,我们提出两级自编码器以兼顾任意服装几何形状的全局和局部特征,这些特征会直接影响材料感知。利用该网络,我们还能实现不同服装拓扑结构间的平滑几何过渡。在估计过程中,我们采用闭环优化结构在任务间共享信息,并利用学习到的服装特征进行服装材料的时间序列估计。实验表明,所提出的网络结构将材料分类准确率提升了1.5倍,适用于未见过的输入,并且运行速度比现有最佳方法快至少三个数量级。我们在虚拟试穿中验证了恢复的织物材料,仅通过单视频即可重现完整的虚拟形象外观,包括身体形状与姿态、服装几何形状和材料。
abstract_en: Fabric materials are central to recreating realistic appearance of avatars in a virtual world and many VR applications, ranging from virtual try-on, teleconferencing, to character animation. We propose an end-to-end network model that uses video input to estimate the fabric materials of the garment worn by a human or an avatar in a virtual world. To achieve the high accuracy, we jointly learn human body and the garment geometry as conditions to material prediction. Due to the highly dynamic and deformable nature of cloth, general data-driven garment modeling remains a challenge. To address this problem, we propose a two-level auto-encoder to account for both global and local features of any garment geometry that would directly affect material perception. Using this network, we can also achieve smooth geometry transitioning between different garment topologies. During the estimation, we use a closed-loop optimization structure to share information between tasks and feed the learned garment features for temporal estimation of garment materials. Experiments show that our proposed network structures greatly improve the material classification accuracy by 1.5x, with applicability to unseen input. It also runs at least three orders of magnitude faster than the state-of-the-art. We demonstrate the recovered fabric materials on virtual try-on, where we recreate the entire avatar appearance, including body shape and pose, garment geometry and materials from only a single video.

title: 肖俊斌,周潘,周泽西,严水成
title_en: Junbin Xiao, Pan Zhou, Tat-Seng Chua, Shuicheng Yan
abstract: 本文提出了一种用于视频问答(VideoQA)的视频图变换器(VGT)模型。VGT的独特之处在于两点:1)它设计了一个动态图变换器模块,通过显式捕捉视觉对象、它们的关系和动态,以进行复杂的时空推理;2)它利用解耦的视频和文本变换器,通过比较视频和文本的相关性来执行问答,而不是使用纠缠的跨模态变换器进行答案分类。视觉-文本通信通过额外的跨模态交互模块实现。通过更合理的视频编码和问答解决方案,我们证明了VGT在无需预训练的场景下,能够比现有方法在挑战动态关系推理的VideoQA任务中取得显著更好的性能。其性能甚至超过了使用数百万外部数据预训练的模型。我们进一步表明,VGT也能从自监督的跨模态预训练中获益良多,但所需数据量却小几个数量级。这些结果清楚地证明了VGT的有效性和优越性,并揭示了其在更高效数据预训练方面的潜力。通过全面的分析和一些启发式观察,我们希望VGT能够推动视频问答研究,从粗粒度的识别/描述转向真实视频中细粒度的关系推理。
abstract_en: This paper proposes a Video Graph Transformer (VGT) model for Video Quetion Answering (VideoQA). VGT’s uniqueness are two-fold: 1) it designs a dynamic graph transformer module which encodes video by explicitly capturing the visual objects, their relations, and dynamics for complex spatio-temporal reasoning; and 2) it exploits disentangled video and text Transformers for relevance comparison between the video and text to perform QA, instead of entangled cross-modal Transformer for answer classification. Vision-text communication is done by additional cross-modal interaction modules. With more reasonable video encoding and QA solution, we show that VGT can achieve much better performances on VideoQA tasks that challenge dynamic relation reasoning than prior arts in the pretraining-free scenario. Its performances even surpass those models that are pretrained with millions of external data. We further show that VGT can also benefit a lot from self-supervised cross-modal pretraining, yet with orders of magnitude smaller data. These results clearly demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of VGT, and reveal its potential for more data-efficient pretraining. With comprehensive analyses and some heuristic observations, we hope that VGT can promote VQA research beyond coarse recognition/description towards fine-grained relation reasoning in realistic videos.

title: 李俊波, 张欢, 谢驰航
title_en: Junbo Li, Huan Zhang, Cihang Xie
abstract: 贴片攻击,通过在输入图像中引入一种可感知但局部的改变,近年来获得了显著的关注。在本文中,我们提出一个统一的框架,利用最近出现的视觉Transformer来分析认证贴片防御任务(包括认证检测和认证恢复)。除了现有的仅考虑单个贴片的贴片防御设置外,我们首次研究了针对双重贴片攻击的认证检测,其中攻击者可以对两个不同区域的像素进行对抗性操控。得益于最近在自监督视觉Transformer(即,掩码自编码器)方面的进展,我们的方法在认证检测和认证恢复的对抗性贴片方面均达到了最先进的性能。在认证检测方面,我们在ImageNet上无需额外训练单个对抗性贴片的情况下,将性能提升了高达$\app16\%$,并且首次能够处理更具挑战性的双重贴片设置。我们的方法在基于检测的认证鲁棒性与干净图像准确率之间大幅缩小了差距。在认证恢复方面,我们的方法在所有攻击尺寸上将认证准确率提升了$\app2\%$,实现了新的最先进性能。
abstract_en: Patch attack, which introduces a perceptible but localized change to the input image, has gained significant momentum in recent years. In this paper, we propose a unified framework to analyze certified patch defense tasks (including both certified detection and certified recovery) using the recently emerged vision transformer. In addition to the existing patch defense setting where only one patch is considered, we provide the very first study on developing certified detection against the \emph{dual patch attack}, in which the attacker is allowed to adversarially manipulate pixels in two different regions. Benefiting from the recent progress in self-supervised vision transformers (\ie, masked autoencoder), our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both certified detection and certified recovery of adversarial patches. For certified detection, we improve the performance by up to $\app16\%$ on ImageNet without additional training for a single adversarial patch, and for the first time, can also tackle the more challenging dual patch setting. Our method largely \emph{closes the gap} between detection-based certified robustness and clean image accuracy. For certified recovery, our approach improves certified accuracy by $\app2\%$ on ImageNet across all attack sizes, attaining the new state-of-the-art performance.

title: Junbo Yin, Dingfu Zhou, Liangjun Zhang, Jin Fang, Cheng-Zhong Xu, Jianbing Shen, Wenguan Wang
title_en: Junbo Yin, Dingfu Zhou, Liangjun Zhang, Jin Fang, Cheng-Zhong Xu, Jianbing Shen, Wenguan Wang
abstract: 现有无监督点云预训练方法受限于场景级或点/体素级实例判别。场景级方法倾向于丢失对道路目标识别至关重要的局部细节,而点/体素级方法固有地受到有限感受野的限制,无法感知大型物体或环境上下文。考虑到区域级表示更适用于3D目标检测,我们设计了一种新的无监督点云预训练框架,称为ProposalContrast,通过对比区域提案学习鲁棒的3D表示。具体而言,通过对每个点云中采样的大量区域提案,建模每个提案内的几何点关系以生成具有表现力的提案表示。为了更好地适应3D检测特性,ProposalContrast同时优化簇间和提案间分离,即增强提案表示在语义类别和物体实例间的判别性。ProposalContrast的泛化能力和迁移性已在多种3D检测器(如PV-RCNN、CenterPoint、PointPillars和PointRCNN)和数据集(如KITTI、Waymo和ONCE)上得到验证。
abstract_en: Existing approaches for unsupervised point cloud pre-training are constrained to either scene-level or point/voxel-level instance discrimination. Scene-level methods tend to lose local details that are crucial for recognizing the road objects, while point/voxel-level methods inherently suffer from limited receptive field that is incapable of perceiving large objects or context environments. Considering region-level representations are more suitable for 3D object detection, we devise a new unsupervised point cloud pre-training framework, called ProposalContrast, that learns robust 3D representations by contrasting region proposals. Specifically, with an exhaustive set of region proposals sampled from each point cloud, geometric point relations within each proposal are modeled for creating expressive proposal representations. To better accommodate 3D detection properties, ProposalContrast optimizes with both inter-cluster and inter-proposal separation, i.e., sharpening the discriminativeness of proposal representations across semantic classes and object instances. The generalizability and transferability of ProposalContrast are verified on various 3D detectors (i.e., PV-RCNN, CenterPoint, PointPillars and PointRCNN) and datasets (i.e., KITTI, Waymo and ONCE).

title: Junbo Yin, Jin Fang, Dingfu Zhou, Liangjun Zhang, Cheng-Zhong Xu, Jianbing Shen, Wenguan Wang
title_en: Junbo Yin, Jin Fang, Dingfu Zhou, Liangjun Zhang, Cheng-Zhong Xu, Jianbing Shen, Wenguan Wang
abstract: 在自动驾驶场景中,基于点云的三维目标检测器严重依赖大量准确标注样本,然而点云中的三维标注过程极其繁琐、昂贵且耗时。为减少对大规模监督的依赖,已提出基于半监督学习(SSL)的方法。伪标签方法常用于SSL框架,但教师模型的低质量预测严重限制了其性能。本文提出了一种新的伪标签框架,通过若干必要设计将教师模型提升为高效模型。首先,为提高伪标签的召回率,提出了一种时空集成(STE)模块以生成足够的种子框。其次,为提高召回框的精度,设计了一种基于聚类的框投票(CBV)模块,通过聚类种子框获取聚合投票,从而消除了选择伪标签时对复杂阈值的依赖。此外,为减少训练过程中错误伪标签样本的负面影响,提出了一种基于框的对比学习(BCL)的软监督信号。我们在ONCE和Waymo数据集上验证了模型的有效性。例如,在ONCE数据集上,我们的方法将基线模型的mAP提升了9.51。此外,在Waymo数据集上,仅使用半标注数据,我们的模型在标注完整数据的oracle模型上表现更优。
abstract_en: Dominated point cloud-based 3D object detectors in autonomous driving scenarios rely heavily on the huge amount of accurately labeled samples, however, 3D annotation in the point cloud is extremely tedious, expensive and time-consuming. To reduce the dependence on large supervision, semi-supervised learning (SSL) based approaches have been proposed. The Pseudo-Labeling methodology is commonly used for SSL frameworks, however, the low-quality predictions from the teacher model have seriously limited its performance. In this work, we propose a new Pseudo-Labeling framework for semi-supervised 3D object detection, by enhancing the teacher model to a proficient one with several necessary designs. First, to improve the recall of pseudo labels, a Spatialtemporal Ensemble (STE) module is proposed to generate sufficient seed boxes. Second, to improve the precision of recalled boxes, a Clusteringbased Box Voting (CBV) module is designed to get aggregated votes from the clustered seed boxes. This also eliminates the necessity of sophisticated thresholds to select pseudo labels. Furthermore, to reduce the negative influence of wrong pseudo-labeled samples during the training, a soft supervision signal is proposed by considering Box-wise Contrastive Learning (BCL). The effectiveness of our model is verified on both ONCE and Waymo datasets. For example, on ONCE, our approach significantly improves the baseline by 9.51 mAP. Moreover, with half annotations, our model outperforms the oracle model with full annotations on Waymo.

title: Junbum Cha, Kyungjae Lee, Sungrae Park, Sanghyuk Chun
title_en: Junbum Cha, Kyungjae Lee, Sungrae Park, Sanghyuk Chun
abstract: 领域泛化(Domain Generalization, DG)旨在仅利用有限的源域数据,学习一个能够适应未见过的目标域的通用模型。以往的DG方法由于训练域与测试域之间存在显著的领域偏移,未能仅从源域中学习到领域不变的表示。为此,我们重新定义了DG目标,通过引入理想模型(能够泛化到任意可能域的模型)与互信息的联合优化。通过用预训练模型近似理想模型,我们推导出一个可处理的变分下界,称为理想模型互信息正则化(Mutual Information Regularization with Oracle, MIRO)。大量实验表明,MIRO显著提升了分布外性能。此外,我们的扩展实验表明,预训练模型规模越大,MIRO的性能提升越显著。代码已开源至 https://github.com/kakaobrain/miro。
abstract_en: Domain generalization (DG) aims to learn a generalized model to an unseen target domain using only limited source domains. Previous attempts to DG fail to learn domain-invariant representations only from the source domains due to the significant domain shifts between training and test domains. Instead, we re-formulate the DG objective using mutual information with the oracle model, a model generalized to any possible domain. We derive a tractable variational lower bound via approximating the oracle model by a pre-trained model, called Mutual Information Regularization with Oracle (MIRO). Our extensive experiments show that MIRO significantly improves the out-of-distribution performance. Furthermore, our scaling experiments show that the larger the scale of the pre-trained model, the greater the performance improvement of MIRO. Code is available at https://github.com/kakaobrain/miro.

title: Junde Wu, Yu Zhang, Rao Fu, Yuanpei Liu, Jing Gao
title_en: Junde Wu, Yu Zhang, Rao Fu, Yuanpei Liu, Jing Gao
abstract: 开放式无收银杂货店是顾客无需排队结账的杂货店。开发此类系统并不简单,因为它面临着识别动态且大规模人群流动的挑战。特别是,一种能够高效地将每个快照分配给对应顾客的聚类方法对于系统至关重要。受开放式无收银杂货店的独特挑战启发,我们提出了一种高效且有效的人员聚类方法。具体而言,我们首先提出了一种拥挤子图(Crowded Sub-Graph, CSG),用于定位海量且连续数据流中的关系。CSG通过所提出的“选择-连接-加权”(Pick-Link-Weight, PLW)策略构建,该策略基于时空信息选择节点,通过轨迹信息连接节点,并通过所提出的von Mises-Fisher(vMF)相似度度量对连接进行加权。随后,为确保方法能够适应动态且未见过的人员流动,我们提出了一种结合简单最近邻(Nearest Neighbor, NN)策略的图卷积网络(Graph Convolutional Network, GCN),以准确聚类CSG实例。GCN被采用以将特征投影到低维可分离空间,而NN能够在该空间中快速生成动态人员流动的结果。实验结果表明,所提出的方法在该场景下优于其他替代算法。在实践中,整个系统已在多个现实世界的开放式无收银杂货店中实现并部署。
abstract_en: Open checkout-free grocery is the grocery store where the customers never have to wait in line to check out. Developing a system like this is not trivial since it faces challenges of recognizing the dynamic and massive flow of people. In particular, a clustering method that can efficiently assign each snapshot to the corresponding customer is essential for the system. Motivated by unique challenges in the open checkout-free grocery, we propose an efficient and effective person clustering method. Specifically, we first propose a Crowded Sub-Graph (CSG) to localize the relationship among massive and continuous data streams. CSG is constructed by the proposed Pick-Link-Weight (PLW) strategy, which picks the nodes based on time-space information, links the nodes via trajectory information, and weighs the links by the proposed von Mises-Fisher (vMF) similarity metric. Then, to ensure that the method adapts to the dynamic and unseen person flow, we propose Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) with a simple Nearest Neighbor (NN) strategy to accurately cluster the instances of CSG. GCN is adopted to project the features into low-dimensional separable space, and NN is able to quickly produce a result in this space upon dynamic person flow. The experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms other alternative algorithms in this scenario. In practice, the whole system has been implemented and deployed in several real-world open checkout-free groceries.

title: Junfeng Wu, Qihao Liu, Yi Jiang, Song Bai, Alan Yuille, Xiang Bai
title_en: Junfeng Wu, Qihao Liu, Yi Jiang, Song Bai, Alan Yuille, Xiang Bai
abstract: 近年来,视频实例分割(VIS)在离线模型的推动下取得了显著进展,而在线模型逐渐受到关注减少,可能由于其性能表现较差。然而,在线方法在处理长视频序列和实时视频时具有固有的优势,而离线模型因计算资源的限制而无法实现。因此,如果在线模型能够达到与离线模型相当甚至更优的性能,将具有高度价值。通过分析当前在线模型和离线模型,我们发现性能差距的主要原因是特征空间中不同实例相似外观导致的帧间易错关联。基于此,我们提出了一种基于对比学习的在线框架,能够学习更具判别性的实例嵌入以实现关联,并充分利用历史信息以提升稳定性。尽管方法简单,我们在三个基准数据集上均超越了所有在线和离线方法。具体而言,在YouTube-VIS 2019数据集上达到49.5 AP,相比先前最优的在线方法和离线方法分别提升了13.2 AP和2.1 AP。此外,在更具挑战性的OVIS数据集上达到30.2 AP,该数据集包含显著的密集场景和遮挡,超越了先前最优方法14.8 AP。所提方法在第四届大规模视频对象分割挑战赛(CVPR2022)视频实例分割赛道中获得第一名。我们希望本方法的简洁性与有效性,以及对当前方法的洞察,能够为VIS模型的探索提供参考。代码已开源至https://github.com/wjf5203/VNext。
abstract_en: In recent years, video instance segmentation (VIS) has been largely advanced by offline models, while online models gradually attracted less attention possibly due to their inferior performance. However, online methods have their inherent advantage in handling long video sequences and ongoing videos while offline models fail due to the limit of computational resources. Therefore, it would be highly desirable if online models can achieve comparable or even better performance than offline models. By dissecting current online models and offline models, we demonstrate that the main cause of the performance gap is the error-prone association between frames caused by the similar appearance among different instances in the feature space. Observing this, we propose an online framework based on contrastive learning that is able to learn more discriminative instance embeddings for association and fully exploit history information for stability. Despite its simplicity, our method outperforms all online and offline methods on three benchmarks. Specifically, we achieve 49.5 AP on YouTube-VIS 2019, a significant improvement of 13.2 AP and 2.1 AP over the prior online and offline art, respectively. Moreover, we achieve 30.2 AP on OVIS, a more challenging dataset with significant crowding and occlusions, surpassing the prior art by 14.8 AP. The proposed method won first place in the video instance segmentation track of the 4th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation Challenge (CVPR2022). We hope the simplicity and effectiveness of our method, as well as our insight on current methods, could shed light on the exploration of VIS models. The code is available at https://github.com/wjf5203/VNext.

title: Junfeng Wu, Yi Jiang, Song Bai, Wenqing Zhang, Xiang Bai
title_en: Junfeng Wu, Yi Jiang, Song Bai, Wenqing Zhang, Xiang Bai
abstract: 本文提出SeqFormer用于视频实例分割。SeqFormer遵循视觉Transformer的原则,建模视频帧间的实例关系。然而,我们观察到,一个独立的实例查询足以捕捉视频中实例的时间序列,但注意力机制应在每帧独立进行。为实现这一目标,SeqFormer在每帧中定位实例并聚合时序信息,以学习视频级实例的强大表示,用于动态预测每帧的掩码序列。实例跟踪无需跟踪分支或后处理即可自然实现。在YouTube-VIS数据集上,SeqFormer在ResNet-50主干网络下达到47.4 AP,在ResNet-101主干网络下达到49.0 AP,且不使用任何额外技巧。这一成果分别比之前的最先进方法高出4.6和4.4。此外,结合近期提出的Swin Transformer,SeqFormer实现了更高的AP值59.3。我们希望SeqFormer能成为视频实例分割领域未来研究的强基线,并通过更鲁棒、准确、简洁的模型推动该领域发展。代码可在https://github.com/wjf5203/SeqFormer获取。
abstract_en: In this work, we present SeqFormer for video instance segmentation. SeqFormer follows the principle of vision transformer that models instance relationships among video frames. Nevertheless, we observe that a stand-alone instance query suffices for capturing a time sequence of instances in a video, but attention mechanisms shall be done with each frame independently. To achieve this, SeqFormer locates an instance in each frame and aggregates temporal information to learn a powerful representation of a video-level instance, which is used to predict the mask sequences on each frame dynamically. Instance tracking is achieved naturally without tracking branches or post-processing.
