Then, by performing a novel meta training and testing process to optimize the model to obtain good testing performance on these query sets after training on the support set, our framework can effectively guide the model to learn to well generalize against biases. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy of our proposed framework.

title: Li-Wu Tsao, Yan-Kai Wang, Hao-Siang Lin, Hong-Han Shuai, Lai-Kuan Wong, Wen-Huang Cheng
title_en: Li-Wu Tsao, Yan-Kai Wang, Hao-Siang Lin, Hong-Han Shuai, Lai-Kuan Wong, Wen-Huang Cheng
abstract: 早期的轨迹预测方法主要通过循环网络捕捉行人之间的序列结构,但这种方法在捕捉长序列结构时存在局限性。为解决这一问题,一些近期工作提出了基于Transformer的架构,其通过注意力机制构建。然而,这些基于Transformer的网络是端到端训练的,未充分利用预训练的价值。在本工作中,我们提出Social-SSL,通过自监督预训练捕捉跨序列轨迹结构,这在提升Transformer网络在轨迹预测中的数据效率和泛化能力方面起着关键作用。具体而言,Social-SSL通过三个预训练任务建模交互与运动模式:交互类型预测、接近度预测以及掩码跨序列到序列预训练。综合实验表明,Social-SSL在ETH/UCY和SDD数据集上的平均位移误差和最终位移误差分别比现有最先进方法高出至少12%和20%。
abstract_en: Earlier trajectory prediction approaches focus on ways of capturing sequential structures among pedestrians by using recurrent networks, which is known to have some limitations in capturing long sequence structures. To address this limitation, some recent works proposed Transformer-based architectures, which are built with attention mechanisms. However, these Transformer-based networks are trained end-to-end without capitalizing on the value of pre-training. In this work, we propose Social-SSL that captures cross-sequence trajectory structures via self-supervised pre-training, which plays a crucial role in improving both data efficiency and generalizability of Transformer networks for trajectory prediction. Specifically, Social-SSL models the interaction and motion patterns with three pretext tasks: interaction type prediction, closeness prediction, and masked cross-sequence to sequence pre-training. Comprehensive experiments show that Social-SSL outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by at least 12% and 20% on ETH/UCY and SDD datasets in terms of Average Displacement Error and Final Displacement Error.

title: 单目3D目标检测
title_en: Liang Peng, Fei Liu, Zhengxu Yu, Senbo Yan, Dan Deng, Zheng Yang, Haifeng Liu, Deng Cai
abstract: 单目3D目标检测是自动驾驶和计算机视觉领域具有挑战性的任务。通常做法中,大多数先前工作使用人工标注的3D框标签,而标注过程成本高昂。本文发现,在单目3D检测中,精确且细致的标注标签可能是不必要的,这一发现具有趣味性和反直觉性。使用随机扰动的粗略标签,检测器可以达到与使用真实标签相近的准确率。我们深入探讨了这一机制,并实证发现:就标签准确性而言,标签中的3D位置部分相较于其他部分更受青睐。受上述结论启发并考虑精确的激光雷达3D测量,我们提出了一种简单有效的框架,称为激光雷达点云引导的单目3D目标检测(LPCG)。该框架能够在不引入额外标注成本的情况下,要么降低标注成本,要么显著提升检测准确率。具体而言,它从未标注的激光雷达点云中生成伪标签。得益于精确的3D空间激光雷达测量,这些伪标签可以替代人工标注标签用于单目3D检测器的训练,因其3D位置信息精确。LPCG可应用于任何单目3D检测器,充分利用自动驾驶系统中的大量未标注数据。因此,在KITTI基准测试中,我们在单目3D和BEV(鸟瞰图)检测中均取得显著领先。在Waymo基准测试中,使用10%标注数据的方法准确率与使用100%标注数据的基线检测器相当。代码已发布于https://github.com/SPengLiang/LPCG。
abstract_en: Monocular 3D object detection is a challenging task in the self-driving and computer vision community. As a common practice, most previous works use manually annotated 3D box labels, where the annotating process is expensive. In this paper, we find that the precisely and carefully annotated labels may be unnecessary in monocular 3D detection, which is an interesting and counterintuitive finding. Using rough labels that are randomly disturbed, the detector can achieve very close accuracy compared to the one using the ground-truth labels. We delve into this underlying mechanism and then empirically find that: concerning the label accuracy, the 3D location part in the label is preferred compared to other parts of labels. Motivated by the conclusions above and considering the precise LiDAR 3D measurement, we propose a simple and effective framework, dubbed LiDAR point cloud guided monocular 3D object detection (LPCG). This framework is capable of either reducing the annotation costs or considerably boosting the detection accuracy without introducing extra annotation costs. Specifically, It generates pseudo labels from unlabeled LiDAR point clouds. Thanks to accurate LiDAR 3D measurements in 3D space, such pseudo labels can replace manually annotated labels in the training of monocular 3D detectors, since their 3D location information is precise. LPCG can be applied into any monocular 3D detector to fully use massive unlabeled data in a self-driving system. As a result, in KITTI benchmark, we take the first place on both monocular 3D and BEV (bird’s-eye-view) detection with a significant margin. In Waymo benchmark, our method using 10% labeled data achieves comparable accuracy to the baseline detector using 100% labeled data. The codes are released at https://github.com/SPengLiang/LPCG.

title: Liang Peng, Xiaopei Wu, Zheng Yang, Haifeng Liu, Deng Cai
title_en: Liang Peng, Xiaopei Wu, Zheng Yang, Haifeng Liu, Deng Cai
abstract: 单目三维目标检测因其低成本和简便的设置方式受到社区广泛关注。它以RGB图像作为输入,并在三维空间中预测三维框。最具挑战性的子任务在于实例深度估计。以往的工作通常采用直接估计方法。然而,本文指出,RGB图像上的实例深度并不直观,它由视觉深度线索和实例属性线索耦合,使得难以直接在网络中学习。因此,我们提出将实例深度重新表述为实例视觉表面深度(视觉深度)和实例属性深度(属性深度)的组合。视觉深度与物体在图像中的外观和位置相关,而属性深度依赖于物体的固有属性,这些属性对图像上的物体仿射变换具有不变性。相应地,我们将三维位置的不确定性分解为视觉深度不确定性和属性深度不确定性。通过结合不同类型的深度及其相关不确定性,可以获得最终的实例深度。此外,由于物理特性限制,单目三维检测中的数据增强通常受到限制,阻碍了性能的提升。基于所提出的实例深度解耦策略,我们可以缓解这一问题。在KITTI数据集上的评估表明,我们的方法取得了新的最先进结果,广泛的消融研究验证了我们方法中每个组件的有效性。代码已发布在https://github.com/SPengLiang/DID-M3D。
abstract_en: Monocular 3D detection has drawn much attention from the community due to its low cost and setup simplicity. It takes an RGB image as input and predicts 3D boxes in the 3D space. The most challenging sub-task lies in the instance depth estimation. Previous works usually use a direct estimation method. However, in this paper we point out that the instance depth on the RGB image is non-intuitive. It is coupled by visual depth clues and instance attribute clues, making it hard to be directly learned in the network. Therefore, we propose to reformulate the instance depth to the combination of the instance visual surface depth (visual depth) and the instance attribute depth (attribute depth). The visual depth is related to objects’ appearances and positions on the image. By contrast, the attribute depth relies on objects’ inherent attributes, which are invariant to the object affine transformation on the image. Correspondingly, we decouple the 3D location uncertainty into visual depth uncertainty and attribute depth uncertainty. By combining different types of depths and associated uncertainties, we can obtain the final instance depth. Furthermore, data augmentation in monocular 3D detection is usually limited due to the physical nature, hindering the boost of performance. Based on the proposed instance depth disentanglement strategy, we can alleviate this problem. Evaluated on KITTI, our method achieves new state-of-the-art results, and extensive ablation studies validate the effectiveness of each component in our method. The codes are released at https://github.com/SPengLiang/DID-M3D.

title: Liang Zhao, Zhenyao Wu, Xinyi Wu, Greg Wilsbacher, Song Wang
title_en: Liang Zhao, Zhenyao Wu, Xinyi Wu, Greg Wilsbacher, Song Wang
abstract: 场景文本识别(STR)在计算机视觉中具有许多重要应用。复杂背景仍然是STR面临的一大挑战,因为它们干扰了文本特征的提取。许多现有方法使用注意力区域、边界框或多边形来减少这种干扰。然而,这些方法定位的文本区域仍然包含大量不需要的背景干扰。在本文中,我们提出了一种无背景敏感方法BINet,通过显式利用文本语义分割(SSN)来更准确地提取文本。SSN是在一组现有分割数据上训练的,其数据量仅为STR训练数据的0.03%。这避免了STR训练数据的大规模像素级标注。为了有效利用分割线索,我们设计了新的分割细化和嵌入块,用于细化文本掩码并增强视觉特征。此外,我们提出了一种高效的流程,利用合成初始化(SI)对仅在真实数据(STR训练数据的1.7%)上训练的STR模型进行训练,而不是从头开始在合成和真实数据上训练。实验表明,所提出的方法能够更有效地识别复杂背景中的文本,在多个公开数据集上实现了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Scene Text Recognition (STR) has many important applications in computer vision. Complex backgrounds continue to be a big challenge for STR because they interfere with text feature extraction. Many existing methods use attentional regions, bounding boxes or polygons to reduce such interference. However, the text regions located by these methods still contain much undesirable background interference. In this paper, we propose a Background-Insensitive approach BINet by explicitly leveraging the text Semantic Segmentation (SSN) to extract texts more accurately. SSN is trained on a set of existing segmentation data, whose volume is only 0.03% of STR training data. This prevents the large-scale pixel-level annotations of the STR training data. To effectively utilize the segmentation cues, we design new segmentation refinement and embedding blocks for refining text-masks and reinforcing visual features. Additionally, we propose an efficient pipeline that utilizes Synthetic Initialization (SI) for STR models trained only on real data (1.7% of STR training data), instead of on both synthetic and real data from scratch. Experiments show that the proposed method can recognize text from complex backgrounds more effectively, achieving state-of-the-art performance on several public datasets.

title: Liangchen Song, Xuan Gong, Benjamin Planche, Meng Zheng, David Doermann, Junsong Yuan, Terrence Chen, Ziyan Wu
title_en: Liangchen Song, Xuan Gong, Benjamin Planche, Meng Zheng, David Doermann, Junsong Yuan, Terrence Chen, Ziyan Wu
abstract: 在动态场景中了解三维运动对于许多视觉应用至关重要。近期的研究主要集中在估计特定元素(如人类)的活动。本文利用神经运动场,在多视角设置下估计所有点的运动。由于颜色相似点和随时间变化颜色点的歧义性,使用多视角数据建模动态场景的运动具有挑战性。我们提出通过可预测性正则化来约束估计的运动。如果已知前几帧的运动,则未来近期内的运动应该是可预测的。因此,我们首先通过潜在嵌入条件化估计的运动,然后采用预测网络对嵌入进行可预测性约束,提出可预测性正则化框架PREF(Predictability REgularized Fields)。该框架在无需场景先验知识的情况下,实现了与基于神经运动场的动态场景表示方法相当或更优的结果。
abstract_en: Knowing the 3D motions in a dynamic scene is essential to many vision applications. Recent progress is mainly focused on estimating the activity of some specific elements like humans. In this paper, we leverage a neural motion field for estimating the motion of all points in a multiview setting. Modeling the motion from a dynamic scene with multiview data is challenging due to the ambiguities in points of similar color and points with time-varying color. We propose to regularize the estimated motion to be predictable. If the motion from previous frames is known, then the motion in the near future should be predictable. Therefore, we introduce a predictability regularization by first conditioning the estimated motion on latent embeddings, then by adopting a predictor network to enforce predictability on the embeddings. The proposed framework PREF (Predictability REgularized Fields) achieves on par or better results than state-of-the-art neural motion field-based dynamic scene representation methods, while requiring no prior knowledge of the scene.

title: 陈良宇,褚晓杰,张翔宇,孙健
title_en: Liangyu Chen, Xiaojie Chu, Xiangyu Zhang, Jian Sun
abstract: 尽管近年来图像修复领域取得了显著进展,但当前最先进的(SOTA)方法的系统复杂性也在增加,这可能会阻碍方法的便捷分析和比较。在本文中,我们提出了一种简单基线,该基线超越了当前最先进的方法,并且计算效率高。为进一步简化基线,我们揭示了非线性激活函数(例如Sigmoid、ReLU、GELU、Softmax等)并非必需:它们可以被乘法操作替代或移除。因此,我们从基线推导出一种无需非线性激活函数的网络,即NAFNet。在多个具有挑战性的基准测试中取得了SOTA结果,例如在GoPro数据集上(用于图像去模糊)达到了33.69 dB的PSNR,仅使用其计算成本的8.4%就超过了之前的SOTA 0.38 dB;在SIDD数据集上(用于图像去噪)达到了40.30 dB的PSNR,仅使用其计算成本的一半以下就超过了之前的SOTA 0.28 dB。代码和预训练模型已发布在https://github.com/megvii-research/NAFNet。
abstract_en: Although there have been significant advances in the field of image restoration recently, the system complexity of the state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods is increasing as well, which may hinder the convenient analysis and comparison of methods. In this paper, we propose a simple baseline that exceeds the SOTA methods and is computationally efficient. To further simplify the baseline, we reveal that the nonlinear activation functions, e.g. Sigmoid, ReLU, GELU, Softmax, etc. are not necessary: they could be replaced by multiplication or removed. Thus, we derive a Nonlinear Activation Free Network, namely NAFNet, from the baseline. SOTA results are achieved on various challenging benchmarks, e.g. 33.69 dB PSNR on GoPro (for image deblurring), exceeding the previous SOTA 0.38 dB with only 8.4% of its computational costs; 40.30 dB PSNR on SIDD (for image denoising), exceeding the previous SOTA 0.28 dB with less than half of its computational costs. The code and the pre-trained models are released at https://github.com/megvii-research/NAFNet.

title: 旋转搜索问题
title_en: Liangzu Peng, Mahyar Fazlyab, René Vidal
abstract: 旋转搜索问题旨在找到一个3D旋转,以最佳对齐给定数量的点对。为了使旋转搜索对异常值具有鲁棒性,先前的工作考虑了截断最小二乘法(TLS),这是一种非凸优化问题,以及其半定松弛(SDR)作为可行的替代方案。在存在噪声、异常值或两者的情况下,这种SDR在理论上是否紧致的问题,至今仍鲜有研究。我们推导了表征该SDR紧致性的条件,表明其紧致性取决于噪声水平、TLS的截断参数以及异常值分布(随机或聚类)。特别是,我们给出了在无噪声且无异常值情况下的紧致性简短证明,与先前工作的冗长分析形成对比。
abstract_en: The rotation search problem aims to find a 3D rotation that best aligns a given number of point pairs. To induce robustness against outliers for rotation search, prior work considers truncated least-squares (TLS), which is a non-convex optimization problem, and its semidefinite relaxation (SDR) as a tractable alternative. Whether or not this SDR is theoretically tight in the presence of noise, outliers, or both has remained largely unexplored. We derive conditions that characterize the tightness of this SDR, showing that the tightness depends on the noise level, the truncation parameters of TLS, and the outlier distribution (random or clustered). In particular, we give a short proof for the tightness in the noiseless and outlier-free case, as opposed to the lengthy analysis of prior work.

title: Lianyu Hu, Liqing Gao, Zekang Liu, Wei Feng
title_en: Lianyu Hu, Liqing Gao, Zekang Liu, Wei Feng
abstract: 池化方法是现代神经网络的必要组成部分,用于扩大感受野并降低计算成本。然而,常用的手工设计池化方法(如最大池化和平均池化)可能无法很好地保留判别性特征。尽管许多研究人员在空间域中精心设计了各种池化变体以解决这些限制并取得显著进展,但时间维度的研究却很少。直接应用手工方法或这些专门的空间变体可能并非最优解。本文从信号处理中的提升方案(Lifting Scheme)推导出时间提升池化(TLP),以智能地对不同时间层次的特征进行下采样。提升方案将输入信号分解为具有不同频率的子带,可视为不同的时间运动模式。我们的TLP是一个三阶段过程,通过信号分解、成分加权和信息融合生成精炼的下采样特征图。我们选择一个具有长序列的典型时间任务——连续手语识别(CSLR)作为测试平台,以验证TLP的有效性。在两个大规模数据集上的实验表明,TLP在计算开销相似的情况下,显著优于手工方法和专门的空间变体(提升1.5%)。作为稳健的特征提取器,TLP在多种数据集和主干网络上展现出良好的泛化能力,并在两个大规模CSLR数据集上取得新SOTA结果。可视化进一步展示了TLP在修正手语边界方面的机制。
abstract_en: Pooling methods are necessities for modern neural networks for increasing receptive fields and lowering down computational costs. However, commonly used hand-crafted pooling approaches, e.g. max pooling and average pooling, may not well preserve discriminative features. While many researchers have elaborately designed various pooling variants in spatial domain to handle these limitations with much progress, the temporal aspect is rarely visited where directly applying hand-crafted methods or these specialized spatial variants may not be optimal. In this paper, we derive temporal lift pooling (TLP) from the Lifting Scheme in signal processing to intelligently downsample features of different temporal hierarchies. The Lifting Scheme factorizes input signals into various sub-bands with different frequency, which can be viewed as different temporal movement patterns. Our TLP is a three-stage procedure, which performs signal decomposition, component weighting and information fusion to generate a refined downsized feature map. We select a typical temporal task with long sequences, i.e. continuous sign language recognition (CSLR), as our testbed to verify the effectiveness of TLP. Experiments on two large-scale datasets show TLP outperforms hand-crafted methods and specialized spatial variants by a large margin (1.5%) with similar computational overhead. As a robust feature extractor, TLP exhibits great generalizability upon multiple backbones on various datasets and achieves new state-of-the-art results on two large-scale CSLR datasets. Visualizations further demonstrate the mechanism of TLP in correcting gloss borders.

title: Lihe Ding, Shaocong Dong, Tingfa Xu, Xinli Xu, Jie Wang, Jianan Li
title_en: Lihe Ding, Shaocong Dong, Tingfa Xu, Xinli Xu, Jie Wang, Jianan Li
abstract: 从真实世界点云中估计场景流是实用3D视觉的基础任务。先前方法通常依赖深度模型首先在全分辨率下提取每个点的昂贵特征,然后通过复杂的匹配机制或特征解码获取流,导致高计算成本和延迟。在本工作中,我们提出了一种快速层次化网络FH-Net,该网络通过利用可靠的局部几何先验,直接通过轻量级Trans-flow层获取关键点流,并可选地通过逆Trans-up层反向传播计算的稀疏流,以获得不同分辨率的层次化流。为了更关注具有挑战性的动态物体,我们还提供了一种基于动态物体对生成的新复制粘贴数据增强技术。此外,为缓解真实世界训练数据的长期短缺,我们通过收集公共自动驾驶数据集中的激光雷达扫描点云并利用新颖的伪标签技术对收集的数据进行标注,建立了两个新的大规模数据集。在公共数据集和所提出数据集上的广泛实验表明,我们的方法在至少7倍更快的速度(113 FPS)下超越了先前最先进的方法。代码和数据已发布在https://github.com/pigtigger/FH-Net。
abstract_en: Estimating scene flow from real-world point clouds is a fundamental task for practical 3D vision. Previous methods often rely on deep models to first extract expensive per-point features at full resolution, and then get the flow either from complex matching mechanism or feature decoding, suffering high computational cost and latency. In this work, we propose a fast hierarchical network, FH-Net, which directly gets the key points flow through a lightweight Trans-flow layer utilizing the reliable local geometry prior, and optionally back-propagates the computed sparse flows through an inverse Trans-up layer to obtain hierarchical flows at different resolutions. To focus more on challenging dynamic objects, we also provide a new copy-and-paste data augmentation technique based on dynamic object pairs generation. Moreover, to alleviate the chronic shortage of real-world training data, we establish two new large-scale datasets to this field by collecting lidar-scanned point clouds from public autonomous driving datasets and annotating the collected data through novel pseudo-labeling. Extensive experiments on both public and proposed datasets show that our method outperforms prior state-of-the-arts while running at least 7× faster at 113 FPS. Code and data are released at https://github.com/pigtigger/FH-Net.

title: Likang Wang, Yue Gong, Xinjun Ma, Qirui Wang, Kaixuan Zhou, Lei Chen
title_en: Likang Wang, Yue Gong, Xinjun Ma, Qirui Wang, Kaixuan Zhou, Lei Chen
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的由粗到细多视角立体(MVS)算法,称为基于重要性采样的MVSNet(IS-MVSNet),以解决当前基于学习的MVS方法中深度分辨率有限的关键问题。我们提出了一种重要性采样模块,用于采样候选深度,有效实现了更高的深度分辨率,并在引入额外成本的情况下产生更好的点云结果。此外,我们提出了一种无监督的误差分布估计方法,用于调整重要性采样模块的密度变化。值得注意的是,所提出的采样模块不需要任何额外的训练,并且与基线模型的预训练权重合理配合。我们的方法在最精细的深度分辨率上实现了高达20倍的提升,从而显著受益于大多数场景,并在细节上表现出色。因此,IS-MVSNet在TNT的中间基准测试中优于所有已发表的论文,F值达到62.82%。代码可在github.com/NoOneUST/IS-MVSNet获取。
abstract_en: This paper presents a novel coarse-to-fine multi-view stereo (MVS) algorithm called importance-sampling-based MVSNet (IS-MVSNet) to address a crucial problem of limited depth resolution adopted by current learning-based MVS methods. We proposed an importance-sampling module for sampling candidate depth, effectively achieving higher depth resolution and yielding better point-cloud results while introducing no additional cost. Furthermore, we proposed an unsupervised error distribution estimation method for adjusting the density variation of the importance-sampling module. Notably, the proposed sampling module does not require any additional training and works reasonably well with the pre-trained weights of the baseline model. Our proposed method leads to up to 20x promotion on the most refined depth resolution, thus significantly benefiting most scenarios and excellently superior on fine details. As a result, IS-MVSNet outperforms all the published papers on TNT’s intermediate benchmark with an F-score of 62.82%. Code is available at github.com/NoOneUST/IS-MVSNet.

title: Liliane Momeni, Hannah Bull, K R Prajwal, Samuel Albanie, Gül Varol, Andrew Zisserman
title_en: Liliane Momeni, Hannah Bull, K R Prajwal, Samuel Albanie, Gül Varol, Andrew Zisserman
abstract: 近年来,手语研究者开始关注手语翻译电视广播,其包含(i)连续手语视频和(ii)与音频内容对应的字幕,作为现成且大规模的训练数据来源。此类数据在可用性方面面临的关键挑战是缺乏手语注释。以往利用此类弱对齐数据的研究仅发现字幕关键词与单个手语动作之间存在稀疏对应关系。在本工作中,我们提出了一种简单且可扩展的框架,大幅提高自动注释的密度。我们的贡献包括:(1)通过利用同义词和字幕-手语对齐,显著改进了之前的注释方法;(2)展示了从手语识别模型中伪标签化作为手语定位的价值;(3)提出了一种基于领域内示例的新方法,用于增加已知和未知类别的注释;(4)在BOBSL BSL手语语料库上,我们将自信的自动注释数量从67万增加到500万。我们公开这些注释以支持手语研究社区。
abstract_en: Recently, sign language researchers have turned to sign language interpreted TV broadcasts, comprising (i) a video of continuous signing and (ii) subtitles corresponding to the audio content, as a readily available and large-scale source of training data. One key challenge in the usability of such data is the lack of sign annotations. Previous work exploiting such weakly-aligned data only found sparse correspondences between keywords in the subtitle and individual signs. In this work, we propose a simple, scalable framework to vastly increase the density of automatic annotations. Our contributions are the following: (1) we significantly improve previous annotation methods by making use of synonyms and subtitle-signing alignment; (2) we show the value of pseudo-labelling from a sign recognition model as a way of sign spotting; (3) we propose a novel approach for increasing our annotations of known and unknown classes based on in domain exemplars; (4) on the BOBSL BSL sign language corpus, we increase the number of confident automatic annotations from 670K to 5M. We make these annotations publicly available to support the sign language research community.

title: Lin Geng Foo, Tianjiao Li, Hossein Rahmani, Qiuhong Ke, Jun Liu
title_en: Lin Geng Foo, Tianjiao Li, Hossein Rahmani, Qiuhong Ke, Jun Liu
abstract: 早期动作预测旨在在动作完全执行之前成功预测其类别标签。这是一个具有挑战性的任务,因为不同动作的初期阶段可能非常相似,仅存在细微的差异以进行区分。在本文中,我们提出了一种新颖的专家检索与组合(ERA)模块,该模块检索并组合一组最擅长利用具有判别性的细微差异的专家,以区分输入样本与其他高度相似的样本。为了促使我们的模型有效利用细微差异进行早期动作预测,我们推动专家专门区分高度相似的样本,迫使这些专家学习利用这些样本之间的细微差异。此外,我们设计了一种有效的专家学习率优化方法,平衡专家的优化过程并实现更好的性能。我们在四个公开的动作数据集上评估了我们的ERA模块,并取得了最先进的性能。代码将被发布。
abstract_en: Early action prediction aims to successfully predict the class label of an action before it is completely performed. This is a challenging task because the beginning stages of different actions can be very similar, with only minor subtle differences for discrimination. In this paper, we propose a novel Expert Retrieval and Assembly (ERA) module that retrieves and assembles a set of experts most specialized at using discriminative subtle differences, to distinguish an input sample from other highly similar samples. To encourage our model to effectively use subtle differences for early action prediction, we push experts to discriminate exclusively between samples that are highly similar, forcing these experts to learn to use subtle differences that exist between those samples. Additionally, we design an effective Expert Learning Rate Optimization method that balances the experts’ optimization and leads to better performance. We evaluate our ERA module on four public action datasets and achieve state-of-the-art performance. Code will be released.

title: Lin Huang, Tomas Hodan, Lingni Ma, Linguang Zhang, Luan Tran, Christopher D. Twigg, Po-Chen Wu, Junsong Yuan, Cem Keskin, Robert Wang
title_en: Lin Huang, Tomas Hodan, Lingni Ma, Linguang Zhang, Luan Tran, Christopher D. Twigg, Po-Chen Wu, Junsong Yuan, Cem Keskin, Robert Wang
abstract: 我们提出了一种方法,通过单张RGB图像和可用的三维模型来估计刚体对象的六自由度姿态。与传统的基于对应关系的方法不同,后者在输入图像的像素上预测三维对象坐标,所提出的方法在相机视锥体中采样的三维查询点上预测三维对象坐标。受近期PIFu风格方法用于三维重建的启发,从像素转向三维点的转变使得能够推理整个对象,包括其(自)遮挡部分。对于与像素对齐的图像特征相关的三维查询点,我们训练一个全连接神经网络来预测:(i) 对应的三维对象坐标,以及 (ii) 到对象表面的有符号距离,其中第一项仅定义在表面附近查询点。我们将该网络实现的映射称为神经对应场。然后通过Kabsch-RANSAC算法从预测的三维-三维对应关系中稳健地估计对象姿态。所提出的方法在三个BOP数据集上取得了最先进的结果,并在具有遮挡的挑战性情况下表现出优越性。项目网站为:linhuang17.github.io/NCF。
abstract_en: We propose a method for estimating the 6DoF pose of a rigid object with an available 3D model from a single RGB image. Unlike classical correspondence-based methods which predict 3D object coordinates at pixels of the input image, the proposed method predicts 3D object coordinates at 3D query points sampled in the camera frustum. The move from pixels to 3D points, which is inspired by recent PIFu-style methods for 3D reconstruction, enables reasoning about the whole object, including its (self-)occluded parts. For a 3D query point associated with a pixel-aligned image feature, we train a fully-connected neural network to predict: (i) the corresponding 3D object coordinates, and (ii) the signed distance to the object surface, with the first defined only for query points in the surface vicinity. We call the mapping realized by this network as Neural Correspondence Field. The object pose is then robustly estimated from the predicted 3D-3D correspondences by the Kabsch-RANSAC algorithm. The proposed method achieves state-of-the-art results on three BOP datasets and is shown superior especially in challenging cases with occlusion. The project website is at: linhuang17.github.io/NCF.

title: Lin Liu, Lingxi Xie, Xiaopeng Zhang, Shanxin Yuan, Xiangyu Chen, Wengang Zhou, Houqiang Li, Qi Tian
title_en: Lin Liu, Lingxi Xie, Xiaopeng Zhang, Shanxin Yuan, Xiangyu Chen, Wengang Zhou, Houqiang Li, Qi Tian
abstract: 学习自然图像修复的通用先验是一个重要但具有挑战性的任务。早期方法主要依赖手工设计的先验,包括归一化稀疏性、â„“0梯度、暗通道先验等。最近,深度神经网络被用于学习各种图像先验,但无法保证泛化能力。本文提出了一种新颖的方法,将任务无关的先验嵌入到Transformer中。我们的方法名为任务无关先验嵌入(TAPE),包含两个阶段:任务无关预训练和任务特定微调。其中,第一阶段将自然图像的先验知识嵌入到Transformer中,第二阶段提取这些知识以辅助下游图像修复任务。在各种退化类型的实验中验证了TAPE的有效性。在PSNR指标上,图像修复性能提升了高达1.45 dB,甚至优于任务特定算法。更重要的是,TAPE展示了从退化图像中分离通用图像先验的能力,这种能力对未知下游任务具有良好的迁移性。
abstract_en: Learning a generalized prior for natural image restoration is an important yet challenging task. Early methods mostly involved handcrafted priors including normalized sparsity, â„“0 gradients, dark channel priors, etc.. Recently, deep neural networks have been used to learn various image priors but do not guarantee to generalize. In this paper, we propose a novel approach that embeds a task-agnostic prior into a transformer. Our approach, named Task-Agnostic Prior Embedding (TAPE), consists of two stages, namely, task-agnostic pre-training and task-specific fine-tuning, where the first stage embeds prior knowledge about natural images into the transformer and the second stage extracts the knowledge to assist downstream image restoration. Experiments on various types of degradation validate the effectiveness of TAPE. The image restoration performance in terms of PSNR is improved by as much as 1.45 dB and even outperforms task-specific algorithms. More importantly, TAPE shows the ability of disentangling generalized image priors from degraded images, which enjoys favorable transfer ability to unknown downstream tasks.

title: Lin Zhang, Xin Li, Dongliang He, Fu Li, Yili Wang, Zhaoxiang Zhang
title_en: Lin Zhang, Xin Li, Dongliang He, Fu Li, Yili Wang, Zhaoxiang Zhang
abstract: 基于参考图像的超分辨率(RefSR)是具有前景的超分辨率分支,已在克服单图像超分辨率局限性方面展现出巨大潜力。尽管先前最先进的RefSR方法主要关注提升参考特征迁移的有效性和鲁棒性,但通常被忽视的是:当参考图像被引用时,一个良好重建的超分辨率图像应能为与其相似的低分辨率图像提供更优的超分辨率重建效果。因此,在本工作中,我们提出了一种互惠学习框架,能够合理利用这一事实以增强RefSR网络的学习能力。此外,我们特意设计了一个渐进式特征对齐与选择模块,以进一步提升RefSR任务的性能。所提出的新型模块在多尺度特征空间中对齐参考输入图像,并以渐进方式执行参考感知的特征选择,从而更精确地将参考特征迁移至输入特征,提升网络能力。我们的互惠学习范式与模型无关,可应用于任意RefSR模型。我们实证表明,多个近期最先进的RefSR模型均可通过我们的互惠学习范式实现一致性能提升。此外,所提出的模型结合互惠学习策略在多个基准测试中均取得了新的最先进性能。
abstract_en: Reference-based image super-resolution (RefSR) is a promising SR branch and has shown great potential in overcoming the limitations of single image super-resolution. While previous state-of-the-art RefSR methods mainly focus on improving the efficacy and robustness of reference feature transfer, it is generally overlooked that a well reconstructed SR image should enable better SR reconstruction for its similar LR images when it is referred to as. Therefore, in this work, we propose a reciprocal learning framework that can appropriately leverage such a fact to reinforce the learning of a RefSR network. Besides, we deliberately design a progressive feature alignment and selection module for further improving the RefSR task. The newly proposed module aligns reference-input images at multi-scale feature spaces and performs reference-aware feature selection in a progressive manner, thus more precise reference features can be transferred into the input features and the network capability is enhanced. Our reciprocal learning paradigm is model-agnostic and it can be applied to arbitrary RefSR models. We empirically show that multiple recent state-of-the-art RefSR models can be consistently improved with our reciprocal learning paradigm. Furthermore, our proposed model together with the reciprocal learning strategy sets new state-of-the-art performances on multiple benchmarks.

title: Linfeng Li, Minyue Jiang, Yue Yu, Wei Zhang, Xiangru Lin, Yingying Li, Xiao Tan, Jingdong Wang, Errui Ding
title_en: Linfeng Li, Minyue Jiang, Yue Yu, Wei Zhang, Xiangru Lin, Yingying Li, Xiao Tan, Jingdong Wang, Errui Ding
abstract: 当前最先进的半监督目标检测方法(SSOD)通常采用带有伪标签和指数移动平均(EMA)特性的教师-学生框架。尽管性能表现良好,但仍有许多问题需要解决,例如:(1)通过EMA由学生更新的教师模型容易失去其独特性,从而与学生模型生成相似的预测结果,随着训练的进行可能导致潜在的噪声累积;(2)伪标签的利用仍有很大提升空间。我们提出了一种多样学习者半监督目标检测框架以解决这些问题。具体而言,为保持教师与学生模型之间的差异性,我们的框架包含两个配对的教师-学生模型,并采用多样化的监督策略。此外,我们认为通常被许多现有方法视为不可靠且过时的伪标签具有重要价值。因此,设计了一种包含多阈值分类损失(MTC)和伪标签感知擦除(PLAE)的特定训练策略,以充分挖掘所有伪标签的完整集合。大量实验结果表明,我们的多样教师-学生框架在仅使用1%、5%和10%标记数据进行训练时,在MS-COCO数据集上分别超越了之前最先进的方法2.10%、1.50%和0.83%,验证了所提框架的有效性。此外,我们的方法在使用更大规模数据时也表现优异,例如在完整COCO训练集和123K张未标记图像上达到44.86%的mAP,刷新了新的性能记录。
abstract_en: Current state-of-the-art semi-supervised object detection methods (SSOD) typically adopt the teacher-student framework featured with pseudo labeling and Exponential Moving Average (EMA). Although the performance is desirable, many remaining issues still need to be resolved, for example: (1) the teacher updated by the student using EMA tends to lose its distinctiveness and hence generates similar predictions comparing with student and cause potential noise accumulation as the training proceeds; (2) the exploitation of pseudo labels still has much room for improvement. We present a diverse learner semi-supervised object detection framework to tackle these issues. Concretely, to maintain distinctiveness between teachers and students, our framework consists of two paired teacher-student models with diverse supervision strategy. In addition, we argue that the pseudo labels which are typically regarded as unreliable and obsoleted by many existing methods are of great value. A particular training strategy consisting of Multi-threshold Classification Loss (MTC) and Pseudo Label-Aware Erasing (PLAE) is hence designed to well explore the full set of all pseudo labels. Extensive experimental results show that our diverse teacher-student framework outperforms the previous state-of-the-art method on the MS-COCO dataset by 2.10%, 1.50% and 0.83% when training with only 1%, 5% and 10% labeled data, demonstrating the effectiveness of our proposed framework. Moreover, our approach also performs well with larger amount of data, e.g. using full COCO training set and 123K unlabeled images from COCO, reaching a new state-of-the-art performance of 44.86% mAP.

title: Linfeng Zhang, Xin Chen, Junbo Zhang, Runpei Dong, Kaisheng Ma
title_en: Linfeng Zhang, Xin Chen, Junbo Zhang, Runpei Dong, Kaisheng Ma
abstract: 深度学习的成功通常伴随着神经网络深度的增加。然而,传统训练方法仅在神经网络的最后一层进行监督,并逐层传播监督信号,导致中间层优化困难。最近提出的深度监督方法通过在深度神经网络的中间层添加辅助分类器,利用监督任务损失优化这些辅助分类器,从而直接对浅层进行监督。然而,深度监督与一个广为人知的观察结果存在冲突,即浅层学习的是低级特征而非任务偏向的高级语义特征。为了解决这一问题,本文提出了一种名为对比深度监督的新颖训练框架,通过基于数据增强的对比学习对中间层进行监督。实验结果在九个流行数据集和十一组模型上验证了其在监督学习、半监督学习和知识蒸馏中的图像分类、细粒度图像分类和目标检测效果。代码已发布在Github上。
abstract_en: The success of deep learning is usually accompanied by the growth in neural network depth. However, the traditional training method only supervises the neural network at its last layer and propagates the supervision layer-by-layer, which leads to hardship in optimizing the intermediate layers. Recently, deep supervision has been proposed to add auxiliary classifiers to the intermediate layers of deep neural networks. By optimizing these auxiliary classifiers with the supervised task loss, the supervision can be applied to the shallow layers directly. However, deep supervision conflicts with the well-known observation that the shallow layers learn low-level features instead of task-biased high-level semantic features. To address this issue, this paper proposes a novel training framework named Contrastive Deep Supervision, which supervises the intermediate layers with augmentation-based contrastive learning. Experimental results on nine popular datasets with eleven models demonstrate its effects on general image classification, fine-grained image classification and object detection in supervised learning, semi-supervised learning and knowledge distillation. Codes have been released in Github.

title: Lingzhi Zhang, Connelly Barnes, Kevin Wampler, Sohrab Amirghodsi, Eli Shechtman, Zhe Lin, Jianbo Shi
title_en: Lingzhi Zhang, Connelly Barnes, Kevin Wampler, Sohrab Amirghodsi, Eli Shechtman, Zhe Lin, Jianbo Shi
abstract: 近年来,深度模型在低分辨率图像修复任务中已取得最先进(SOTA)性能,但在与现代相机(如4K及以上分辨率)相关的高分辨率场景以及大孔洞修复中缺乏保真度。我们贡献了一个4K及以上分辨率的图像修复基准数据集,该数据集代表了现代传感器的典型照片。我们提出了一种新颖的框架,结合了深度学习与传统方法。我们使用现有的深度图像修复模型LaMa [28] 合理填充孔洞,构建包含结构、分割、深度的三个引导图像,并应用多引导PatchMatch [1] 生成八个候选上采样修复图像。随后,我们将所有候选修复结果输入一个新颖的筛选模块,通过8x8反对称成对偏好矩阵的列求和选择最佳修复结果。我们的框架在用户偏好上显著优于8个强基线模型,定量指标相比最佳基线LaMa提升高达7.4倍。当与4种不同的SOTA图像修复主干网络结合时,我们的技术使每种网络的性能均显著提升,最终在用户偏好上全面优于强超分辨率基线。
abstract_en: Recently, deep models have established SOTA performance for low-resolution image inpainting, but they lack fidelity at resolutions associated with modern cameras such as 4K or more, and for large holes. We contribute an inpainting benchmark dataset of photos at 4K and above representative of modern sensors. We demonstrate a novel framework that combines deep learning and traditional methods. We use an existing deep inpainting model LaMa [28] to fill the hole plausibly, es- tablish three guide images consisting of structure, segmentation, depth, and apply a multiply-guided PatchMatch [1] to produce eight candidate upsampled inpainted images. Next, we feed all candidate inpaintings through a novel curation module that chooses a good inpainting by column summation on an 8x8 antisymmetric pairwise preference matrix. Our framework’s results are overwhelmingly preferred by users over 8 strong baselines, with improvements of quantitative metrics up to 7.4 times over the best baseline LaMa, and our technique when paired with 4 different SOTA inpainting backbones improves each such that ours is overwhelmingly preferred by users over a strong super-res baseline.

title: Lingzhi Zhang, Shenghao Zhou, Simon Stent, Jianbo Shi
title_en: Lingzhi Zhang, Shenghao Zhou, Simon Stent, Jianbo Shi
abstract: 第一人称视频为人类行为的高保真建模提供了细粒度信息。手部和交互物体是理解观看者行为与意图的关键要素。我们提供了一个包含11,235张第一人称图像的数据集,每张图像均标注了手部和交互物体的像素级分割标签,涵盖多种日常活动场景。本数据集首次对交互手-物体接触边界进行了详细标注。我们提出了一种上下文感知的组合式数据增强技术,以适配分布外的YouTube第一人称视频。实验表明,我们的鲁棒手-物体分割模型与数据集可作为基础工具,提升或实现多个下游视觉任务,包括:手部状态分类、视频活动识别、手-物体交互的3D网格重建,以及在第一人称视频中通过视频修复实现的手部透视。所有数据与代码将向公众开放。
abstract_en: Egocentric videos offer fine-grain information for high-fidelity modeling of human behaviors. Hands and interacting objects are one crucial aspect of understanding viewer’s behaviors and intentions. We provide a labeled dataset consisting of 11,235 egocentric images with per-pixel segmentation labels of hands and the interacting objects in diverse daily activities. Our dataset is the first to label detailed interacting hand-object contact boundaries. We introduce a context-aware compositional data augmentation technique to adapt to out-of-the-distribution YouTube egocentric video. We show that our robust hand-object segmentation model and dataset can serve as a foundation tool to boost or enable several downstream vision applications, such as: Hand state classification, video activity recognition, 3D mesh reconstruction of hand-object interaction, and Seeing through the hand with video inpainting in egocentric videos. All of our data and code will be released to the public.

title: Lingzhi Zhang, Yuqian Zhou, Connelly Barnes, Sohrab Amirghodsi, Zhe Lin, Eli Shechtman, Jianbo Shi
title_en: Lingzhi Zhang, Yuqian Zhou, Connelly Barnes, Sohrab Amirghodsi, Zhe Lin, Eli Shechtman, Jianbo Shi
abstract: 图像修复是物体移除和图像编辑等实际应用中的关键任务。基于深度生成对抗网络(GAN)的模型在修复孔洞内的结构和纹理方面显著提升了修复性能,但也可能生成意外的伪影,如断裂结构或颜色块。用户通过感知这些伪影来判断图像修复模型的效果,并在典型的修整工作流中对这些不完美的区域进行修整并再次进行图像修复。受此工作流启发,我们提出了一种新的学习任务,即自动分割图像修复的感知伪影,并将该模型应用于图像修复模型的评估和迭代优化。具体而言,我们首先通过手动标注当前先进图像修复模型结果中的感知伪影,构建了一个新的图像修复伪影数据集。随后,我们在该数据集上训练先进的分割网络,以可靠地定位修复图像中的伪影区域。其次,我们提出了一种新的可解释性评估指标——感知伪影比率(Perceptual Artifact Ratio, PAR),其定义为令人反感的修复区域占整个修复区域的比例。PAR与真实用户偏好表现出强相关性。最后,我们进一步将生成的掩码与多种近期图像修复方法结合,用于迭代图像修复。大量实验表明,不同方法在伪影区域减少和修复质量提升方面均表现出一致的改进。
abstract_en: Image inpainting is an essential task for multiple practical applications like object removal and image editing. Deep GAN-based models greatly improve the inpainting performance in structures and textures within the hole, but might also generate unexpected artifacts like broken structures or color blobs. Users perceive these artifacts to judge the effectiveness of inpainting models, and retouch these imperfect areas to inpaint again in a typical retouching workflow. Inspired by this workflow, we propose a new learning task of automatic segmentation of inpainting perceptual artifacts, and apply the model for inpainting model evaluation and iterative refinement. Specifically, we first construct a new inpainting artifacts dataset by manually annotating perceptual artifacts in the results of state-of-the-art inpainting models. Then we train advanced segmentation networks on this dataset to reliably localize inpainting artifacts within inpainted images. Second, we propose a new interpretable evaluation metric called Perceptual Artifact Ratio (PAR), which is the ratio of objectionable inpainted regions to the entire inpainted area. PAR demonstrates a strong correlation with real user preference. Finally, we further apply the generated masks for iterative image inpainting by combining our approach with multiple recent inpainting methods. Extensive experiments demonstrate the consistent decrease of artifact regions and inpainting quality improvement across the different methods.

title: Linhui Sun, Yifan Zhang, Ke Cheng, Jian Cheng, Hanqing Lu
title_en: Linhui Sun, Yifan Zhang, Ke Cheng, Jian Cheng, Hanqing Lu
abstract: 事件相机是一种仿生传感器,能够异步捕获每个像素的亮度变化,并触发事件流而非基于帧的图像。每个事件流通常被分割成多个滑动窗口进行后续处理。然而,大多数现有的基于事件的方法忽略了相邻时空窗口之间的运动连续性,这将导致动态信息的丢失和额外的计算成本。为了高效提取包含动态信息的事件流的强特征,本文提出了一种新颖的基于记忆的双分支网络,即MENet。它包含一个基础分支,采用全尺寸事件点处理结构以提取基础特征,以及一个增量分支,配备轻量级网络以捕捉相邻时空窗口之间的时序动态。为了增强特征,特别是在增量分支中,设计了一个点处理记忆库,以勾勒事件特征空间的代表性信息。与基础分支相比,增量分支将计算复杂度降低了5倍,并将速度提升了19倍。实验表明,MENet在手势识别和物体识别任务中实现了最先进的性能,同时相比以往方法显著降低了计算复杂度。
abstract_en: Event cameras are bio-inspired sensors that asynchronously capture per-pixel brightness change and trigger a stream of events instead of frame-based images. Each event stream is generally split into multiple sliding windows for subsequent processing. However, most existing event-based methods ignore the motion continuity between adjacent spatiotemporal windows, which will result in the loss of dynamic information and additional computational costs. To efficiently extract strong features for event streams containing dynamic information, this paper proposes a novel memory-based network with dual-branch, namely MENet. It contains a base branch with a full-sized event point-wise processing structure to extract the base features and an incremental branch equipped with a light-weighted network to capture the temporal dynamics between two adjacent spatiotemporal windows. For enhancing the features, especially in the incremental branch, a point-wise memory bank is designed, which sketches the representative information of event feature space. Compared with the base branch, the incremental branch reduces the computational complexity up to 5 times and improves the speed by 19 times. Experiments show that MENet significantly reduces the computational complexity compared with previous methods while achieving state-of-the-art performance on gesture recognition and object recognition.

title: Linjie Lyu, Ayush Tewari, Thomas Leimkühler, Marc Habermann, Christian Theobalt
title_en: Linjie Lyu, Ayush Tewari, Thomas Leimkühler, Marc Habermann, Christian Theobalt
abstract: 给定一组场景图像,从新视角和光照条件下重新渲染该场景是一个重要且具有挑战性的问题,属于计算机视觉与图形学领域。一方面,大多数计算机视觉研究通常对图像形成过程施加诸多假设,例如直接光照和预定义材质,以使场景参数估计变得可行。另一方面,成熟的计算机图形学工具能够在已知所有场景参数的情况下建模复杂的逼真光照传输。结合这两种方法,我们提出了一种通过学习神经预计算辐射传输函数来实现新视角下场景重照明的方法,该方法利用新颖的环境贴图隐式处理全局光照效果。我们的方法仅需在单一未知光照条件下的一组真实场景图像上进行监督训练。为在训练过程中明确任务,我们紧密集成可微分路径追踪器,并提出合成OLAT与真实图像损失的组合。实验结果表明,恢复的场景参数解耦效果显著优于当前最先进的方法,因此我们的重新渲染结果也更加逼真和准确。
abstract_en: Given a set of images of a scene, the re-rendering of this scene from novel views and lighting conditions is an important and challenging problem in Computer Vision and Graphics. On the one hand, most existing works in Computer Vision usually impose many assumptions regarding the image formation process, e.g. direct illumination and predefined materials, to make scene parameter estimation tractable. On the other hand, mature Computer Graphics tools allow modeling of complex photo-realistic light transport given all the scene parameters. Combining these approaches, we propose a method for scene relighting under novel views by learning a neural precomputed radiance transfer function, which implicitly handles global illumination effects using novel environment maps. Our method can be solely supervised on a set of real images of the scene under a single unknown lighting condition. To disambiguate the task during training, we tightly integrate a differentiable path tracer in the training process and propose a combination of a synthesized OLAT and a real image loss. Results show that the recovered disentanglement of scene parameters improves significantly over the current state of the art and, thus, also our re-rendering results are more realistic and accurate.

title: Linzhi Huang, Jiahao Liang, Weihong Deng
title_en: Linzhi Huang, Jiahao Liang, Weihong Deng
abstract: 由于数据集多样性不足,姿态估计器的泛化能力较差。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种基于DH正向运动学模型的姿态增强方案,称为DH-AUG。我们观察到,以往的工作均基于单帧姿态增强,若直接应用于视频姿态估计器,将存在若干被忽视的问题:(i) 骨骼旋转角度的歧义性(多解问题);(ii) 生成的骨架视频缺乏运动连续性。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种基于DH正向运动学模型的专用生成器,称为DH生成器。大量实验表明,DH-AUG能够显著提升视频姿态估计器的泛化能力。此外,当应用于单帧3D姿态估计器时,我们的方法在性能上优于先前最佳的姿态增强方法。源代码已发布于https://github.com/hlz0606/DH-AUG-DH-Forward-Kinematics-Model-Driven-Augmentation-for-3D-Human-Pose-Estimation。
abstract_en: Due to the lack of diversity of datasets, the generalization ability of the pose estimator is poor. To solve this problem, we propose a pose augmentation solution via DH forward kinematics model, which we call DH-AUG. We observe that the previous work is all based on single-frame pose augmentation, if it is directly applied to video pose estimator, there will be several previously ignored problems: (i) angle ambiguity in bone rotation (multiple solutions); (ii) the generated skeleton video lacks movement continuity. To solve these problems, we propose a special generator based on DH forward kinematics model, which is called DH-generator. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DH-AUG can greatly increase the generalization ability of the video pose estimator. In addition, when applied to a single-frame 3D pose estimator, our method outperforms the previous best pose augmentation method. The source code has been released at https://github.com/hlz0606/DH-AUG-DH-Forward-Kinematics-Model-Driven-Augmentation-for-3D-Human-Pose-Estimation.

title: Liqiang Lin, Yilin Liu, Yue Hu, Xingguang Yan, Ke Xie, Hui Huang
title_en: Liqiang Lin, Yilin Liu, Yue Hu, Xingguang Yan, Ke Xie, Hui Huang
abstract: 我们提出UrbanScene3D,这是一个大规模数据平台,用于城市场景感知与重建的研究。UrbanScene3D包含超过128,000张高分辨率图像,涵盖16种场景,包括大规模真实城市区域和总面积达136平方公里的合成城市。该数据集还包含高精度激光雷达扫描数据和数百组不同观测模式的图像,为设计和评估空域路径规划与三维重建算法提供了全面基准。此外,该数据集基于Unreal Engine和Airsim模拟器构建,并结合了对数据集中每栋建筑的唯一实例标签的手动标注,能够生成各种数据,例如二维深度图、二维/三维边界框以及三维点云/网格分割等。配备物理引擎和光照系统的模拟器不仅能够生成多样化数据,还允许用户在所提出的城市环境中模拟车辆或无人机进行未来研究。该数据集及空域路径规划与三维重建基准可访问:https://vcc.tech/UrbanScene3
abstract_en: We present UrbanScene3D, a large-scale data platform for research of urban scene perception and reconstruction. UrbanScene3D contains over 128k high-resolution images covering 16 scenes including large-scale real urban regions and synthetic cities with 136 km2 area in total. The dataset also contains high-precision LiDAR scans and hundreds of image sets with different observation patterns, which provide a comprehensive benchmark to design and evaluate aerial path planning and 3D reconstruction algorithms. In addition, the dataset, which is built on Unreal Engine and Airsim simulator together with the manually annotated unique instance label for each building in the dataset, enables the generation of all kinds of data, e.g., 2D depth maps, 2D/3D bounding boxes, and 3D point cloud/mesh segmentations, etc. The simulator with physical engine and lighting system not only produce variety of data but also enable users to simulate cars or drones in the proposed urban environment for future research. The dataset with aerial path planning and 3D reconstruction benchmark is available at: https://vcc.tech/UrbanScene3

title: Liuwan Zhu, Rui Ning, Jiang Li, Chunsheng Xin, Hongyi Wu
title_en: Liuwan Zhu, Rui Ning, Jiang Li, Chunsheng Xin, Hongyi Wu
abstract: 这是首个在现代文本到图像检索系统中引入最可检索图像(MRI)和最不可检索图像(LRI)概念的工作。MRI与大量无关文本相关联,因此可被这些文本检索到;而LRI与相关文本无关联,因此无法被这些文本检索到。两者在实际应用中均具有重要意义。由于其一对多的特性,构建MRI和LRI本质上具有挑战性。本研究通过开发新颖且有效的损失函数来构建扰动,从而破坏视觉空间与语言空间之间的特征相关性,实现MRI和LRI的生成。所提出的方案基于CLIP(当前最先进的图像和文本表示模型)进行实现,用于展示MRI和LRI及其在隐私保护图像共享和恶意广告等场景中的应用。实验在多个基准数据集(包括Paris、ImageNet、Flickr30k和MSCOCO)上基于现代视觉-语言模型进行了广泛验证。实验结果表明,所提出方案在构建MRI和LRI方面具有有效性与鲁棒性。
abstract_en: This is the first work to introduce the Most Retrievable Image(MRI) and Least Retrievable Image(LRI) concepts in modern text-to-image retrieval systems. An MRI is associated with and thus can be retrieved by many unrelated texts, while an LRI is disassociated from and thus not retrievable by related texts. Both of them have important practical applications and implications. Due to their one-to-many nature, it is fundamentally challenging to construct MRI and LRI. This research addresses this nontrivial problem by developing novel and effective loss functions to craft perturbations that essentially corrupt feature correlation between visual and language spaces, thus enabling MRI and LRI. The proposed schemes are implemented based on CLIP, a state-of-the-art image and text representation model, to demonstrate MRI and LRI and their application in privacy-preserved image sharing and malicious advertisement. They are evaluated by extensive experiments based on the modern visual-language models on multiple benchmarks, including Paris, ImageNet, Flickr30k, and MSCOCO. The experimental results show the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed schemes for constructing MRI and LRI.

title: Liyuan Wang, Xingxing Zhang, Qian Li, Jun Zhu, Yi Zhong
title_en: Liyuan Wang, Xingxing Zhang, Qian Li, Jun Zhu, Yi Zhong
abstract: 持续学习需要与一系列任务保持增量兼容性。然而,模型架构的设计仍是一个开放性问题:通常情况下,使用共享参数集学习所有任务会受到任务间严重干扰的影响;而为每个任务使用专用参数子空间则受限于可扩展性。在本工作中,我们从理论上分析了持续学习中学习可塑性与记忆稳定性的泛化误差,这些误差可被统一上界限制,包括(1)任务分布之间的差异、(2)损失景观的平坦度以及(3)参数空间的覆盖程度。受生物学习系统处理序列经验的多并行隔室的鲁棒性启发,我们提出了一种持续学习的通用策略——小持续学习者协作(CoSCL)。具体而言,我们设计了一种固定数量的更窄子网络架构,以并行学习所有增量任务,这可以通过改善上述三个上界成分自然降低两种误差。为强化这一优势,我们通过惩罚特征表示预测差异来鼓励子网络协作。在固定参数预算下,CoSCL可显著提升多种代表性持续学习方法的性能(例如,在CIFAR-100-SC上提升10.64%,CIFAR-100-RS上提升9.33%,CUB-200-2011上提升11.45%,Tiny-ImageNet上提升6.72%),并达到新的最先进水平。我们的代码可在https://github.com/lywang3081/CoSCL获取。
abstract_en: Continual learning requires incremental compatibility with a sequence of tasks. However, the design of model architecture remains an open question: In general, learning all tasks with a shared set of parameters suffers from severe interference between tasks; while learning each task with a dedicated parameter subspace is limited by scalability. In this work, we theoretically analyze the generalization errors for learning plasticity and memory stability in continual learning, which can be uniformly upper-bounded by (1) discrepancy between task distributions, (2) flatness of loss landscape and (3) cover of parameter space. Then, inspired by the robust biological learning system that processes sequential experiences with multiple parallel compartments, we propose Cooperation of Small Continual Learners (CoSCL) as a general strategy for continual learning. Specifically, we present an architecture with a fixed number of narrower sub-networks to learn all incremental tasks in parallel, which can naturally reduce the two errors through improving the three components of the upper bound. To strengthen this advantage, we encourage to cooperate these sub-networks by penalizing the difference of predictions made by their feature representations. With a fixed parameter budget, CoSCL can improve a variety of representative continual learning approaches by a large margin (e.g., up to 10.64% on CIFAR-100-SC, 9.33% on CIFAR-100-RS, 11.45% on CUB-200-2011 and 6.72% on Tiny-ImageNet) and achieve the new state-of-the-art performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/lywang3081/CoSCL.

title: Lizhao Liu, Shangxin Huang, Zhuangwei Zhuang, Ran Yang, Mingkui Tan, Yaowei Wang
title_en: Lizhao Liu, Shangxin Huang, Zhuangwei Zhuang, Ran Yang, Mingkui Tan, Yaowei Wang
abstract: 深度度量学习(DML)旨在学习一个嵌入函数,将语义相似的数据投影到邻近的嵌入空间中,并在图像检索和人脸识别等许多应用中发挥关键作用。然而,DML方法的性能通常高度依赖于采样方法,在训练过程中从嵌入空间中选择有效的数据。在实践中,嵌入空间中的嵌入通过某些深度模型获得,由于训练点的缺失,嵌入空间常存在空洞区域,导致所谓的“缺失嵌入”问题。该问题可能损害样本质量,从而导致DML性能退化。在本工作中,我们研究如何缓解“缺失嵌入”问题以提高采样质量并实现有效的DML。为此,我们提出了一种密集锚定采样(DAS)方案,将具有对应数据点的嵌入视为“锚点”,并利用锚点附近的嵌入空间密集生成无数据点的嵌入。具体而言,我们提出利用单个锚点周围的嵌入空间进行判别特征缩放(DFS),以及利用多个锚点进行记忆变换位移(MTS)。通过结合有数据点和无数据点的嵌入,我们能够提供更多嵌入以促进采样过程,从而提升DML性能。我们的方法可无缝集成到现有DML框架中,并在不增加额外复杂度的情况下提升其性能。在三个基准数据集上的大量实验验证了我们方法的优越性。
abstract_en: Deep Metric Learning (DML) serves to learn an embedding function to project semantically similar data into nearby embedding space and plays a vital role in many applications, such as image retrieval and face recognition. However, the performance of DML methods often highly depends on sampling methods to choose effective data from the embedding space in the training. In practice, the embeddings in the embedding space are obtained by some deep models, where the embedding space is often with barren area due to the absence of training points, resulting in so called “missing embedding” issue. This issue may impair the sample quality, which leads to degenerated DML performance. In this work, we investigate how to alleviate the “missing embedding” issue to improve the sampling quality and achieve effective DML. To this end, we propose a Densely-Anchored Sampling (DAS) scheme that considers the embedding with corresponding data point as “anchor” and exploits the anchor’s nearby embedding space to densely produce embeddings without data points. Specifically, we propose to exploit the embedding space around single anchor with Discriminative Feature Scaling (DFS) and multiple anchors with Memorized Transformation Shifting (MTS). In this way, by combing the embeddings with and without data points, we are able to provide more embeddings to facilitate the sampling process thus boosting the performance of DML. Our method is effortlessly integrated into existing DML frameworks and improves them without bells and whistles. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate the superiority of our method.

title: Long Chen, Yuhang Zheng, Jun Xiao
title_en: Long Chen, Yuhang Zheng, Jun Xiao
abstract: 数据增强(DA)--- 生成超出原始训练集的额外训练样本 --- 在当今无偏VQA模型中被广泛用于缓解语言偏差。当前主流的DA策略是基于合成的方法,通过编辑某些视觉区域/词语,或从头重新生成样本来合成新样本。然而,这些合成样本总是不自然且容易出错。为了避免这一问题,最近的一项DA工作通过随机配对原始图像和其他人工撰写的问答对来生成新的增强样本。不幸的是,为了确保增强样本具有合理的答案,他们手动设计了一组启发式规则用于几种问题类型,这极大地限制了其泛化能力。为此,我们提出了一种基于知识蒸馏的数据增强方法用于VQA,称为KDDAug。具体而言,我们首先放宽合理图像-问题对的要求,这可以轻松应用于任何问题类型。然后,我们设计了一种基于知识蒸馏(KD)的答案分配方法,为所有组合的图像-问题对生成伪答案,这些答案对域内和分布外设置都具有鲁棒性。由于KDDAug是一种模型无关的DA策略,它可以无缝集成到任何VQA架构中。在多个主干网络和基准测试上的大量消融研究证明了KDDAug的有效性和泛化能力。
abstract_en: Data Augmentation (DA) --- generating extra training samples beyond original training set --- has been widely-used in today’s unbiased VQA models to mitigate the language biases. Current mainstream DA strategies are synthetic-based methods, which synthesize new samples by either editing some visual regions/words, or re-generating them from scratch. However, these synthetic samples are always unnatural and error-prone. To avoid this issue, a recent DA work composes new augmented samples by randomly pairing pristine images and other human-written questions. Unfortunately, to guarantee augmented samples have reasonable ground-truth answers, they manually design a set of heuristic rules for several question types, which extremely limits its generalization abilities. To this end, we propose a new Knowledge Distillation based Data Augmentation for VQA, dubbed KDDAug. Specifically, we first relax the requirements of reasonable image-question pairs, which can be easily applied to any question types. Then, we design a knowledge distillation (KD) based answer assignment to generate pseudo answers for all composed image-question pairs, which are robust to both in-domain and out-of-distribution settings. Since KDDAug is a model-agnostic DA strategy, it can be seamlessly incorporated into any VQA architectures. Extensive ablation studies on multiple backbones and benchmarks have demonstrated the effectiveness and generalization abilities of KDDAug.

title: Long Zhuo, Guangcong Wang, Shikai Li, Wayne Wu, Ziwei Liu
title_en: Long Zhuo, Guangcong Wang, Shikai Li, Wayne Wu, Ziwei Liu
abstract: 视频到视频合成(Vid2Vid)在从语义图序列生成逼真视频方面取得了显著成果。然而,该流程存在高计算成本和长推理延迟的问题,主要依赖于两个关键因素:1)网络架构参数,2)序列数据流。近期,基于更高效的网络架构,图像生成模型的参数已显著压缩。但现有方法主要关注网络架构的轻量化,忽略了序列数据流的规模。此外,由于缺乏时间一致性,基于图像的压缩方法不足以处理动态时间序列的视频合成。本文提出了一种时空压缩框架Fast-Vid2Vid,专注于生成模型的数据特性。该方法首次在时间维度上减少计算资源并加速推理。具体而言,我们对输入数据流进行空间压缩并减少时间冗余。经过提出的空间知识蒸馏后,模型可使用低分辨率数据流合成关键帧。最后,Fast-Vid2Vid通过运动补偿插值中间帧,延迟可忽略不计。在标准基准测试中,Fast-Vid2Vid达到约20 FPS的实时性能,并在单个V100 GPU上节省约8倍的计算成本。
abstract_en: Video-to-Video synthesis (Vid2Vid) has achieved remarkable results on generating a photo-realistic video from a sequence of semantic maps. However, this pipeline suffers from high computational cost and long inference latency, which largely depends on two essential factors: 1) network architecture parameters, 2) sequential data stream. Recently, the parameters of image-based generative models have been significantly compressed via more efficient network architectures. Nevertheless, existing methods mainly focus on slimming network architectures and ignore the size of sequential data stream. Moreover, due to the lack of temporal coherence, image-based compression is not sufficient for the compression of video synthesis with a dynamic time series. In this paper, we present a spatial-temporal compression framework, Fast-Vid2Vid, which focuses on data aspects of generative models. It makes the first attempt at time dimension to reduce computational resources and accelerate inference. Specifically, we compress the input data stream spatially and reduce the temporal redundancy. After the proposed spatial-knowledge distillation, our model can synthesize key-frames using low-resolution data stream. Finally, Fast-Vid2Vid interpolates inter frames by motion compensation with negligible latency. On standard benchmarks, Fast-Vid2Vid achieves around real-time performance as 20 FPS and saves around 8× computational cost on a single V100 GPU.

title: Longhui Wei, Lingxi Xie, Wengang Zhou, Houqiang Li, Qi Tian
title_en: Longhui Wei, Lingxi Xie, Wengang Zhou, Houqiang Li, Qi Tian
abstract: 近年来,掩码图像建模(MIM)已成为视觉预训练的有前景方向。在视觉Transformer的背景下,MIM通过将token级特征与预定义空间(例如,BEIT使用在大规模图像语料库上训练的d-VAE作为分词器)对齐,学习有效的视觉表征。本文进一步引入其他模态的指导,并验证了这种额外知识在视觉预训练中带来的显著提升。所提出的方法称为多模态引导视觉预训练(MVP),其中我们用CLIP的视觉分支替代分词器,CLIP是一个在4亿个图像-文本对上预训练的视觉-语言模型。我们通过标准实验验证了MVP的有效性,即在ImageNet上预训练ViT模型,并在一系列下游视觉识别任务上进行微调。特别是,预训练ViT-Base/16 300个epoch后,MVP在ADE-20K数据集上达到52.4%的mIOU,超越了BEIT(基线和先前最先进方法)6.8%的显著优势。
abstract_en: Recently, masked image modeling (MIM) has become a promising direction for visual pre-training. In the context of vision transformers, MIM learns effective visual representation by aligning the token-level features with a pre-defined space (e,g,, BEIT used a d-VAE trained on a large image corpus as the tokenizer). In this paper, we go one step further by introducing guidance from other modalities and validating that such additional knowledge leads to impressive gains for visual pre-training. The proposed approach is named Multimodality-guided Visual Pre-training (MVP), in which we replace the tokenizer with the vision branch of CLIP, a vision-language model pre-trained on 400 million image-text pairs. We demonstrate the effectivenss of MVP by performing standard experiments, i.e., pre-training the ViT models on ImageNet and fine-tuning them on a series of downstream visual recognition tasks. In particular, pre-training ViT-Base/16 for 300 epochs, MVP reports a 52.4% mIOU on ADE-20K, surpassing BEIT (the baseline and previous state-of-the-art) with an impressive margin of 6.8%.

title: Lu Qi, Jason Kuen, Zhe Lin, Jiuxiang Gu, Fengyun Rao, Dian Li, Weidong Guo, Zhen Wen, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jiaya Jia
title_en: Lu Qi, Jason Kuen, Zhe Lin, Jiuxiang Gu, Fengyun Rao, Dian Li, Weidong Guo, Zhen Wen, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jiaya Jia
abstract: 为了提升实例级检测/分割的性能,现有自监督和半监督方法从无标签数据中提取的训练信号要么与任务无关,要么高度任务相关。我们认为,这两种极端方法在任务性能上存在不足。使用过少的与任务相关的训练信号会导致下游任务的真实标签拟合不足,而相反则会导致过拟合。为此,我们提出了一种新颖的无类别半监督学习(Class-Agnostic Semi-Supervised Learning, CA-SSL)框架,以在从无标签数据中提取训练信号时实现更优的任务相关性平衡。CA-SSL包含三个训练阶段,分别作用于真实标签(有标签数据)或伪标签(无标签数据)。这种解耦策略避免了传统SSL方法中复杂的平衡机制,该机制需要同时平衡两种数据类型的贡献。特别地,我们引入了一个预热训练阶段,通过忽略伪标签中的类别信息,同时保留定位训练信号,以实现更优的任务相关性平衡。因此,我们的预热模型在检测和分割任务中微调真实标签时,能够更好地避免欠拟合/过拟合问题。使用3.6M无标签数据,我们在FCOS目标检测任务中,相比ImageNet预训练基线模型取得了4.7%的显著性能提升。此外,我们的预热模型在其他检测和分割框架中也表现出良好的迁移能力。
abstract_en: To improve instance-level detection/segmentation performance, existing self-supervised and semi-supervised methods extract either very task-unrelated or very task-specific training signals from unlabeled data. We argue that these two approaches, at the two extreme ends of the task-specificity spectrum, are suboptimal for the task performance. Utilizing too little task-specific training signals causes underfitting to the ground-truth labels of downstream tasks, while the opposite causes overfitting to the ground-truth labels. To this end, we propose a novel Class-Agnostic Semi-Supervised Learning (CA-SSL) framework to achieve a more favorable task-specificity balance in extracting training signals from unlabeled data. CA-SSL has three training stages that act on either ground-truth labels (labeled data) or pseudo labels (unlabeled data). This decoupling strategy avoids the complicated scheme in traditional SSL methods that balances the contributions from both data types. Especially, we introduce a warmup training stage to achieve a more optimal balance in task specificity by ignoring class information in the pseudo labels, while preserving localization training signals. As a result, our warmup model can better avoid underfitting/overfitting when fine-tuned on the ground-truth labels in detection and segmentation tasks. Using 3.6M unlabeled data, we achieve a remarkable performance gain of 4.7% over ImageNet-pretrained baseline on FCOS object detection. Also, our warmup model demonstrates excellent transferability to other detection and segmentation frameworks.

title: Luca Cavalli, Marc Pollefeys, Daniel Barath
title_en: Luca Cavalli, Marc Pollefeys, Daniel Barath
abstract: 自RANSAC算法问世以来,大量研究致力于提升其准确性和运行效率。然而,目前仅有少数方法旨在早期识别无效的最小样本,避免昂贵的模型估计和质量计算。为此,我们提出NeFSAC,一种高效的神经网络过滤算法,用于剔除运动不一致和条件差的最小样本。我们仅基于图像对应点的像素坐标训练NeFSAC,以预测最小样本是否能生成准确的相对位姿。我们的神经网络模型学习了导致不稳定位姿的样本典型运动模式,并识别可能运动中的规律,以促进条件良好且可能正确的样本。该轻量级架构实现了位姿估计中最小样本的主要不变量,新颖的训练方案解决了极端类别不平衡问题。NeFSAC可无缝集成到任何基于RANSAC的流程中。我们将其整合到USAC中,实验表明即使在极端训练-测试域差异下,它仍能持续提供显著加速——例如,为自动驾驶场景训练的模型也可在PhotoTourism数据集上运行。我们在三个公开真实世界数据集的超过10万张图像对上测试NeFSAC,发现其速度提升一个数量级,同时通常比单独使用USAC获得更准确的结果。源代码可在https://github.com/cavalli1234/NeFSAC获取。
abstract_en: Since RANSAC, a great deal of research has been devoted to improving both its accuracy and run-time. Still, only a few methods aim at recognizing invalid minimal samples early, before the often expensive model estimation and quality calculation are done. To this end, we propose NeFSAC, an efficient algorithm for neural filtering of motion-inconsistent and poorly-conditioned minimal samples. We train NeFSAC to predict the probability of a minimal sample leading to an accurate relative pose, only based on the pixel coordinates of the image correspondences. Our neural filtering model learns typical motion patterns of samples which lead to unstable poses, and regularities in the possible motions to favour well-conditioned and likely-correct samples. The novel lightweight architecture implements the main invariants of minimal samples for pose estimation, and a novel training scheme addresses the problem of extreme class imbalance. NeFSAC can be plugged into any existing RANSAC-based pipeline. We integrate it into USAC and show that it consistently provides strong speed-ups even under extreme train-test domain gaps -- for example, the model trained for the autonomous driving scenario works on PhotoTourism too. We tested NeFSAC on more than 100k image pairs from three publicly available real-world datasets and found that it leads to one order of magnitude speed-up, while often finding more accurate results than USAC alone. The source code is available at https://github.com/cavalli1234/NeFSAC.

title: Luchuan Song, Zheng Fang, Xiaodan Li, Xiaoyi Dong, Zhenchao Jin, Yuefeng Chen, Siwei Lyu
title_en: Luchuan Song, Zheng Fang, Xiaodan Li, Xiaoyi Dong, Zhenchao Jin, Yuefeng Chen, Siwei Lyu
abstract: 有必要开发有效的面部伪造检测方法,以应对不断演进的合成逼真面部技术所带来的严重恶意面部篡改风险。大量文献已研究基于深度学习的方法,尤其是那些考虑频率线索的方法,在检测假面方面取得了显著进展。基于频率线索的方法导致帧间不一致性,即使在相同的深度伪造视频中,最终检测结果仍不稳定。因此,这些模式仍存在不足和不稳定性。此外,由于各种伪造方法的多样性,先前方法中的不一致性问题显著加剧。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新的跨域深度学习框架用于面部伪造检测。所提出的框架通过多帧相关表示以及RGB域和频率域的互补线索挖掘潜在一致性。我们还引入了一个实例判别模块,以确定视频中每一帧的判别结果中心,这是一种在推理过程中自适应调整的策略。
abstract_en: It is necessary to develop effective face forgery detection methods with constantly evolving technologies in synthesizing realistic faces which raises serious risks on malicious face tampering. A large and growing body of literature has investigated deep learning-based approaches, especially those taking frequency clues into consideration, have achieved remarkable progress on detecting fake faces. The method based on frequency clues result in the inconsistency across frames and make the final detection result unstable even in the same deepfake video. So, these patterns are still inadequate and unstable. In addition to this, the inconsistency problem in the previous methods is significantly exacerbated due to the diversities among various forgery methods. To address this problem, we propose a novel deep learning framework for face forgery detection in cross domain. The proposed framework explores on mining the potential consistency through the correlated representations across multiple frames as well as the complementary clues from both RGB and frequency domains. We also introduce an instance discrimination module to determine the discriminative results center for each frame across the video, which is a strategy that adaptive adjust with during inference.

title: Lucy Chai, Michaël Gharbi, Eli Shechtman, Phillip Isola, Richard Zhang
title_en: Lucy Chai, Michaël Gharbi, Eli Shechtman, Phillip Isola, Richard Zhang
abstract: 生成模型通常在固定分辨率下运行,而自然图像的尺寸却多种多样。由于高分辨率细节被下采样丢失,低分辨率图像则被完全舍弃,导致宝贵的监督信息流失。我们认为每个像素都至关重要,因此创建了包含可变尺寸图像的数据集,这些图像以原生分辨率采集。为充分利用不同尺寸的数据,我们引入了连续尺度训练方法,该方法通过随机采样不同尺度的图像块来训练具有可变输出分辨率的新生成器。首先,通过在生成器中引入目标尺度条件,我们能够在不增加模型层数的情况下生成比以往更高的分辨率图像。其次,通过连续坐标条件,我们可以采样仍保持一致全局布局的图像块,这还允许在更高分辨率下进行可扩展训练。受控的FFHQ实验表明,我们的方法比离散多尺度方法更能有效利用多分辨率训练数据,实现了更低的FID分数和更清晰的高频细节。我们还对其他自然图像领域(如教堂、山脉和鸟类)进行了训练,并展示了在任意尺度下合成具有连贯全局布局和逼真局部细节的图像,实验结果超越了2K分辨率。我们的项目页面地址为:https://chail.github.io/anyres-gan/
abstract_en: Generative models operate at fixed resolution, even though natural images come in a variety of sizes. As high-resolution details are downsampled away and low-resolution images are discarded altogether, precious supervision is lost. We argue that every pixel matters and create datasets with variable-size images, collected at their native resolutions. To take advantage of varied-size data, we introduce continuous-scale training, a process that samples patches at random scales to train a new generator with variable output resolutions. First, conditioning the generator on a target scale allows us to generate higher resolution images than previously possible, without adding layers to the model. Second, by conditioning on continuous coordinates, we can sample patches that still obey a consistent global layout, which also allows for scalable training at higher resolutions. Controlled FFHQ experiments show that our method can take advantage of multi-resolution training data better than discrete multi-scale approaches, achieving better FID scores and cleaner high-frequency details. We also train on other natural image domains including churches, mountains, and birds, and demonstrate arbitrary scale synthesis with both coherent global layouts and realistic local details, going beyond 2K resolution in our experiments. Our project page is available at: https://chail.github.io/anyres-gan/.

title: 李路军
title_en: Lujun Li
abstract: 基于中间特征表示的知识蒸馏始终能带来显著的性能提升。传统特征蒸馏框架需要额外的教师选择/训练预算和复杂的转换操作以对齐教师-学生模型之间的特征。为解决该问题,我们分析特征蒸馏中的教师角色并发现一个有趣现象:额外的教师架构并非总是必需。随后我们提出Tf-FD,一个简单而有效的无教师特征蒸馏框架,通过复用学生模型内部的通道级和层级有意义特征,在无需额外模型的情况下提供类似教师的知识。具体而言,我们的框架分为层内蒸馏和层间蒸馏。层内Tf-FD执行特征显著性排序,将显著特征的知识转移到同一层的冗余特征。对于层间Tf-FD,我们处理深层表示中嵌入的高层语义知识,以指导浅层的训练。得益于这些自特征之间的微小差距,Tf-FD只需优化额外的特征模仿损失,无需复杂转换。此外,我们从特征正则化视角提供了深入讨论。我们在分类和目标检测任务上的实验表明,我们的技术在不同模型上实现了最先进结果,并具有快速的训练速度。代码已开源:https://lilujunai.github.io/Teacher-free-Distillation/
abstract_en: Knowledge distillation conditioned on intermediate feature representations always leads to significant performance improvements. Conventional feature distillation framework demands extra selecting/training budgets of teachers and complex transformations to align the features between teacher-student models. To address the problem, we analyze teacher roles in feature distillation and have an intriguing observation: additional teacher architectures are not always necessary. Then we propose Tf-FD, a simple yet effective Teacher-free Feature Distillation framework, reusing channel-wise and layer-wise meaningful features within the student to provide teacher-like knowledge without an additional model. In particular, our framework is subdivided into intra-layer and inter-layer distillation. The intra-layer Tf-FD performs feature salience ranking and transfers the knowledge from salient feature to redundant feature within the same layer. For inter-layer Tf-FD, we deal with distilling high-level semantic knowledge embedded in the deeper layer representations to guide the training of shallow layers. Benefiting from the small gap between these self-features, Tf-FD simply needs to optimize extra feature mimicking losses without complex transformations. Furthermore, we provide insightful discussions to shed light on Tf-FD from feature regularization perspectives. Our experiments conducted on classification and object detection tasks demonstrate that our technique achieves state-of-the-art results on different models with fast training speeds. Code is available at https://lilujunai.github.io/Teacher-free-Distillation/.

title: Lukas Hedegaard, Alexandros Iosifidis
title_en: Lukas Hedegaard, Alexandros Iosifidis
abstract: 我们引入了持续性三维卷积神经网络(Co3D CNNs),这是一种新的时空三维卷积神经网络计算形式,其特点是以逐帧方式处理视频,而非通过片段进行处理。在需要逐帧预测的在线任务中,Co3D CNNs消除了常规三维卷积神经网络的计算冗余,即在重叠片段中重复对帧进行卷积运算。我们证明了持续性三维卷积神经网络可以复用已有的三维卷积神经网络权重,在保持相似内存需求和准确率的同时,按时间感受野比例减少每预测的浮点运算次数(FLOPs)。这一结论在Kinetics-400和Charades数据集上通过多个模型验证,取得了显著成果:CoX3D模型在Kinetics-400数据集上实现了最先进的复杂度/准确率权衡,相比常规X3D模型,FLOPs减少了12.1-15.3倍,准确率提升了2.3-3.8%,同时将峰值内存消耗降低了高达48%。此外,我们研究了Co3D CNNs在启动时的瞬态响应,并对公开可用的三维卷积神经网络进行了广泛的硬件处理特性基准测试。
abstract_en: We introduce Continual 3D Convolutional Neural Networks (Co3D CNNs), a new computational formulation of spatio-temporal 3D CNNs, in which videos are processed frame-by-frame rather than by clip. In online tasks demanding frame-wise predictions, Co3D CNNs dispense with the computational redundancies of regular 3D CNNs, namely the repeated convolutions over frames, which appear in overlapping clips. We show that Continual 3D CNNs can reuse preexisting 3D-CNN weights to reduce the per-prediction floating point operations (FLOPs) in proportion to the temporal receptive field while retaining similar memory requirements and accuracy. This is validated with multiple models on Kinetics-400 and Charades with remarkable results: CoX3D models attain state-of-the-art complexity/accuracy trade-offs on Kinetics-400 with 12.1-15.3x reductions of FLOPs and 2.3-3.8% improvements in accuracy compared to regular X3D models while reducing peak memory consumption by up to 48%. Moreover, we investigate the transient response of Co3D CNNs at start-up and perform extensive benchmarks of on-hardware processing characteristics for publicly available 3D CNNs.

title: Lukas Hoyer, Dengxin Dai, Luc Van Gool
title_en: Lukas Hoyer, Dengxin Dai, Luc Van Gool
abstract: 无监督域适应(UDA)旨在将在一个源域(例如合成数据)上训练的模型适应到目标域(例如真实世界数据),而无需在目标域上进行进一步标注。本工作专注于语义分割的UDA,因为真实世界像素级标注尤其昂贵。由于语义分割的UDA方法通常对GPU内存需求很高,大多数先前的方法仅在下采样图像上运行。我们质疑这种设计,因为低分辨率预测通常无法保留细粒度细节。训练使用高分辨率图像的随机裁剪的替代方案缓解了这一问题,但未能捕捉长距离、域鲁棒的上下文信息。因此,我们提出了HRDA,一种多分辨率训练方法,结合了小高分辨率裁剪以保留细粒度分割细节和大低分辨率裁剪以通过学习的尺度注意力捕捉长距离上下文依赖关系,同时保持可控的GPU内存占用。HRDA能够适应小物体并保留细粒度分割细节。它通过5.5 mIoU和4.9 mIoU显著提高了GTA-to-Cityscapes和Synthia-to-Cityscapes的最先进性能,分别达到前所未有的73.8和65.8 mIoU。实现可在https://github.com/lhoyer/HRDA获取。
abstract_en: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) aims to adapt a model trained on the source domain (e.g. synthetic data) to the target domain (e.g. real-world data) without requiring further annotations on the target domain. This work focuses on UDA for semantic segmentation as real-world pixel-wise annotations are particularly expensive to acquire. As UDA methods for semantic segmentation are usually GPU memory intensive, most previous methods operate only on downscaled images. We question this design as low-resolution predictions often fail to preserve fine details. The alternative of training with random crops of high-resolution images alleviates this problem but falls short in capturing long-range, domain-robust context information. Therefore, we propose HRDA, a multi-resolution training approach for UDA, that combines the strengths of small high-resolution crops to preserve fine segmentation details and large low-resolution crops to capture long-range context dependencies with a learned scale attention, while maintaining a manageable GPU memory footprint. HRDA enables adapting small objects and preserving fine segmentation details. It significantly improves the state-of-the-art performance by 5.5 mIoU for GTA-to-Cityscapes and 4.9 mIoU for Synthia-to-Cityscapes, resulting in unprecedented 73.8 and 65.8 mIoU, respectively. The implementation is available at https://github.com/lhoyer/HRDA.

title: Lukas Koestler, Daniel Grittner, Michael Moeller, Daniel Cremers, Zorah Lähner
title_en: Lukas Koestler, Daniel Grittner, Michael Moeller, Daniel Cremers, Zorah Lähner
abstract: 神经场由于在新视角合成、几何重建和生成建模中表现出色,近年来在计算机视觉领域受到广泛关注。其优势包括坚实的理论基础和易于在当前深度学习框架中实现。尽管神经场已被应用于流形上的信号(例如纹理重建),但其表示方法仅限于将形状外在嵌入欧几里得空间。这种外在嵌入忽略了已知的流形内在属性,并且在函数迁移方面缺乏灵活性。为克服这些局限性,本文提出了一种新型且通用的流形神经场表示方法。流形神经场结合了神经场的优势与拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米算子的谱特性。理论上证明,流形神经场继承了外在神经场框架的许多理想特性,同时具备额外的内在特性,如等距不变性。实验表明,流形神经场能够从图像中重建高保真纹理,且在底层流形离散化时表现出鲁棒性。我们通过解决多种应用展示了流形神经场的通用性:变形形状与不同形状之间的纹理迁移、具有视角依赖性的现实世界图像纹理重建,以及在网格和点云上与离散化无关的学习。
abstract_en: Neural fields have gained significant attention in the computer vision community due to their excellent performance in novel view synthesis, geometry reconstruction, and generative modeling. Some of their advantages are a sound theoretic foundation and an easy implementation in current deep learning frameworks. While neural fields have been applied to signals on manifolds, e.g., for texture reconstruction, their representation has been limited to extrinsically embedding the shape into Euclidean space. The extrinsic embedding ignores known intrinsic manifold properties and is inflexible wrt. transfer of the learned function. To overcome these limitations, this work introduces intrinsic neural fields, a novel and versatile representation for neural fields on manifolds. Intrinsic neural fields combine the advantages of neural fields with the spectral properties of the Laplace-Beltrami operator. We show theoretically that intrinsic neural fields inherit many desirable properties of the extrinsic neural field framework but exhibit additional intrinsic qualities, like isometry invariance. In experiments, we show intrinsic neural fields can reconstruct high-fidelity textures from images with state-of-the-art quality and are robust to the discretization of the underlying manifold. We demonstrate the versatility of intrinsic neural fields by tackling various applications: texture transfer between deformed shapes & different shapes, texture reconstruction from real-world images with view dependence, and discretization-agnostic learning on meshes and point clouds.

title: Lumin Xu, Sheng Jin, Wang Zeng, Wentao Liu, Chen Qian, Wanli Ouyang, Ping Luo, Xiaogang Wang
title_en: Lumin Xu, Sheng Jin, Wang Zeng, Wentao Liu, Chen Qian, Wanli Ouyang, Ping Luo, Xiaogang Wang
abstract: Existing works on 2D pose estimation mainly focus on a certain category, e.g. human, animal, and vehicle. However, there are lots of application scenarios that require detecting the poses/keypoints of the unseen class of objects. In this paper, we introduce the task of Category-Agnostic Pose Estimation (CAPE), which aims to create a pose estimation model capable of detecting the pose of any class of object given only a few samples with keypoint definition. To achieve this goal, we formulate the pose estimation problem as a keypoint matching problem and design a novel CAPE framework, termed POse Matching Network (POMNet). A transformer-based Keypoint Interaction Module (KIM) is proposed to capture both the interactions among different keypoints and the relationship between the support and query images. We also introduce Multi-category Pose (MP-100) dataset, which is a 2D pose dataset of 100 object categories containing over 20K instances and is well-designed for developing CAPE algorithms. Experiments show that our method outperforms other baseline approaches by a large margin. Codes and data are available at https://github.com/luminxu/Pose-for-Everything.
abstract_en: Existing works on 2D pose estimation mainly focus on a certain category, e.g. human, animal, and vehicle. However, there are lots of application scenarios that require detecting the poses/keypoints of the unseen class of objects. In this paper, we introduce the task of Category-Agnostic Pose Estimation (CAPE), which aims to create a pose estimation model capable of detecting the pose of any class of object given only a few samples with keypoint definition. To achieve this goal, we formulate the pose estimation problem as a keypoint matching problem and design a novel CAPE framework, termed POse Matching Network (POMNet). A transformer-based Keypoint Interaction Module (KIM) is proposed to capture both the interactions among different keypoints and the relationship between the support and query images. We also introduce Multi-category Pose (MP-100) dataset, which is a 2D pose dataset of 100 object categories containing over 20K instances and is well-designed for developing CAPE algorithms. Experiments show that our method outperforms other baseline approaches by a large margin. Codes and data are available at https://github.com/luminxu/Pose-for-Everything.

title: 黄洛杰 刘毅康 陈丽 Eric Z. Chen 陈晓 孙山会
title_en: Luojie Huang, Yikang Liu, Li Chen, Eric Z. Chen, Xiao Chen, Shanhui Sun
abstract: 在血管成形术(即开通阻塞的冠状动脉)的临床操作中,需要在X射线透视引导下将球囊和支架等器械放置并扩张于动脉中。由于X射线剂量的限制,所得图像通常存在噪声。为了检查这些器械的正确放置,通常会将多个运动补偿帧进行平均以增强图像。因此,器械跟踪是实现该目的的必要步骤。尽管血管成形术器械设计有放射不透明标记以方便跟踪,但现有方法由于标记尺寸小和血管成形术场景复杂,难以达到令人满意的效果。本文提出了一种端到端的深度学习框架用于单支架跟踪,该框架包含三个分层模块:用于地标检测的U-Net、用于支架提议和特征提取的ResNet,以及用于支架跟踪的图卷积神经网络,该网络在时间上聚合了空间信息和外观特征。实验表明,与最先进的基于点的跟踪模型相比,我们的方法在检测性能上显著提升。此外,其快速的推理速度满足临床需求。
abstract_en: In clinical procedures of angioplasty (i.e., open clogged coronary arteries), devices such as balloons and stents need to be placed and expanded in arteries under the guidance of X-ray fluoroscopy. Due to the limitation of X-ray dose, the resulting images are often noisy. To check the correct placement of these devices, typically multiple motion-compensated frames are averaged to enhance the view. Therefore, device tracking is a necessary procedure for this purpose. Even though angioplasty devices are designed to have radiopaque markers for the ease of tracking, current methods struggle to deliver satisfactory results due to the small marker size and complex scenes in angioplasty. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end deep learning framework for single stent tracking, which consists of three hierarchical modules: a U-Net for landmark detection, a ResNet for stent proposal and feature extraction, and a graph convolutional neural network for stent tracking that temporally aggregates both spatial information and appearance features. The experiments show that our method performs significantly better in detection compared with the state-of-the-art point-based tracking models. In addition, its fast inference speed satisfies clinical requirements.

title: Luting Wang, Xiaojie Li, Yue Liao, Zeren Jiang, Jianlong Wu, Fei Wang, Chen Qian, Si Liu
title_en: Luting Wang, Xiaojie Li, Yue Liao, Zeren Jiang, Jianlong Wu, Fei Wang, Chen Qian, Si Liu
abstract: 传统的目标检测知识蒸馏(KD)方法主要集中在同构教师-学生检测器上。然而,轻量化检测器的设计往往与高容量检测器存在显著差异。因此,我们研究了异构教师-学生对之间的知识蒸馏以实现广泛应用。我们观察到,异构知识蒸馏(hetero-KD)的核心难点在于异构检测器主干特征之间存在显著语义差距,这是由于不同的优化方式导致的。传统同构知识蒸馏(homo-KD)方法受此差距影响,难以直接获得满意的异构知识蒸馏性能。本文提出异构辅助蒸馏(HEAD)框架,利用异构检测头作为辅助模块引导学生检测器的优化以减小该差距。在HEAD中,辅助模块是一个与教师头架构同构的额外检测头,附加在学生主干上。因此,异构知识蒸馏被转化为同构知识蒸馏,实现了从教师到学生的高效知识迁移。此外,当缺乏良好训练的教师检测器时,我们将HEAD扩展为无教师HEAD(TF-HEAD)框架。我们的方法相比现有检测知识蒸馏方法取得了显著提升。例如,在MS-COCO数据集上,TF-HEAD帮助R18 RetinaNet达到33.9 mAP(+2.2),而HEAD进一步提升至36.2 mAP(+4.5)。
abstract_en: Conventional knowledge distillation (KD) methods for object detection mainly concentrate on homogeneous teacher-student detectors. However, the design of a lightweight detector for deployment is often significantly different from a high-capacity detector. Thus, we investigate KD among heterogeneous teacher-student pairs for a wide application. We observe that the core difficulty for heterogeneous KD (hetero-KD) is the significant semantic gap between the backbone features of heterogeneous detectors due to the different optimization manners. Conventional homogeneous KD (homo-KD) methods suffer from such a gap and are hard to directly obtain satisfactory performance for hetero-KD. In this paper, we propose the HEtero-Assists Distillation (HEAD) framework, leveraging heterogeneous detection heads as assistants to guide the optimization of the student detector to reduce this gap. In HEAD, the assistant is an additional detection head with the architecture homogeneous to the teacher head attached to the student backbone. Thus, a hetero-KD is transformed into a homo-KD, allowing efficient knowledge transfer from the teacher to the student. Moreover, we extend HEAD into a Teacher-Free HEAD (TF-HEAD) framework when a well-trained teacher detector is unavailable. Our method has achieved significant improvement compared to current detection KD methods. For example, on the MS-COCO dataset, TF-HEAD helps R18 RetinaNet achieve 33.9 mAP (+2.2), while HEAD further pushes the limit to 36.2 mAP (+4.5).

title: Luyu Yang, Mingfei Gao, Zeyuan Chen, Ran Xu, Abhinav Shrivastava, Chetan Ramaiah
title_en: Luyu Yang, Mingfei Gao, Zeyuan Chen, Ran Xu, Abhinav Shrivastava, Chetan Ramaiah
abstract: 在在线隐私的背景下,许多方法提出复杂的安全保护措施以保护敏感数据。本文我们指出:不存储任何敏感数据是最佳的安全形式。我们提出了一种名为“焚毁后阅读”的在线框架,即每个在线样本在被处理后将永久删除。我们的框架利用公开数据的标签对未标记的敏感私有数据进行预测。为了解决从公开数据到私有数据不可避免的分布偏移问题,我们提出了一种新颖的领域自适应算法,直接针对该在线设置的基本挑战——缺乏多样化的源-目标数据对。我们设计了一种跨领域自举方法,命名为CroDoBo,以提高跨领域的数据多样性。为了充分挖掘多样化组合中的有价值差异,我们采用多学习者协同监督的训练策略。CroDoBo在四个领域自适应基准测试中实现了最先进的在线性能。代码已提供。
abstract_en: In the context of online privacy, many methods propose complex security preserving measures to protect sensitive data. In this paper, we note that: not storing any sensitive data is the best form of security. We propose an online framework called ""Burn After Reading"", i.e. each online sample is permanently deleted after it is processed.
