Our framework utilizes the labels from the public data and predicts on the unlabeled sensitive private data. To tackle the inevitable distribution shift from the public data to the private data, we propose a novel domain adaptation algorithm that directly aims at the fundamental challenge of this online setting--the lack of diverse source-target data pairs. We design a Cross-Domain Bootstrapping approach, named CroDoBo, to increase the combined data diversity across domains. To fully exploit the valuable discrepancies among the diverse combinations, we employ the training strategy of multiple learners with co-supervision. CroDoBo achieves state-of-the-art online performance on four domain adaptation benchmarks. Code is provided.

title: Mahmoud Assran, Mathilde Caron, Ishan Misra, Piotr Bojanowski, Florian Bordes, Pascal Vincent, Armand Joulin, Michael Rabbat, Nicolas Ballas
title_en: Mahmoud Assran, Mathilde Caron, Ishan Misra, Piotr Bojanowski, Florian Bordes, Pascal Vincent, Armand Joulin, Michael Rabbat, Nicolas Ballas
abstract: 我们提出了一种自监督学习框架——掩码双胞胎网络(Masked Siamese Networks, MSN),用于学习图像表示。我们的方法将包含随机掩码块的图像视图的表示与原始未掩码图像的表示进行匹配。这种自监督预训练策略在应用于视觉Transformer时具有特别的可扩展性,因为只有未掩码的块被网络处理。因此,MSN在提升联合嵌入架构的可扩展性的同时,生成了具有高语义级别的表示,在少样本图像分类任务中表现优异。例如,在ImageNet-1K数据集上,仅使用5,000张标注图像,我们的大型MSN模型达到了72.1%的Top-1准确率;使用ImageNet-1K标签的1%,我们实现了75.1%的Top-1准确率,创下了该基准上自监督学习的新最先进水平。我们的代码已公开在https://github.com/facebookresearch/msn。
abstract_en: We propose Masked Siamese Networks (MSN), a self-supervised learning framework for learning image representations. Our approach matches the representation of an image view containing randomly masked patches to the representation of the original unmasked image. This self-supervised pre-training strategy is particularly scalable when applied to Vision Transformers since only the unmasked patches are processed by the network. As a result, MSNs improve the scalability of joint-embedding architectures, while producing representations of a high semantic level that perform competitively on low-shot image classification. For instance, on ImageNet-1K, with only 5,000 annotated images, our large MSN models achieves 72.1% top-1 accuracy, and with 1% of ImageNet-1K labels, we achieve 75.1% top-1 accuracy, setting a new state-of-the-art for self-supervised learning on this benchmark. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/msn.

title: Mahyar Najibi, Jingwei Ji, Yin Zhou, Charles R. Qi, Xinchen Yan, Scott Ettinger, Dragomir Anguelov
title_en: Mahyar Najibi, Jingwei Ji, Yin Zhou, Charles R. Qi, Xinchen Yan, Scott Ettinger, Dragomir Anguelov
abstract: 现代自动驾驶系统中的基于学习的感知与预测模块通常依赖昂贵的人工标注,并且仅设计用于感知少量预定义的对象类别。这种封闭集范式对于安全关键型的自动驾驶任务而言是不足的,因为自动驾驶汽车需要在高度动态的世界中处理任意数量的交通参与者及其运动行为。为了解决这一难题,本文开创性地提出了一种新颖且具有挑战性的方向,即在无监督条件下训练感知与预测模型以理解开放集运动物体。我们提出的框架利用自学习的光流触发自动化元标注流水线以实现自动监督。在Waymo Open Dataset上的3D检测实验表明,我们的方法显著优于经典无监督方法,并且甚至与带有监督场景流的对应方法具有竞争力。我们进一步证明,我们的方法在开放集3D检测和轨迹预测中生成了极具前景的结果,证实了其在弥补全监督系统安全差距方面的潜力。
abstract_en: Learning-based perception and prediction modules in modern autonomous driving systems typically rely on expensive human annotation and are designed to perceive only a handful of predefined object categories. This closed-set paradigm is insufficient for the safety-critical autonomous driving task, where the autonomous vehicle needs to process arbitrarily many types of traffic participants and their motion behaviors in a highly dynamic world. To address this difficulty, this paper pioneers a novel and challenging direction, i.e., training perception and prediction models to understand open-set moving objects, with no human supervision. Our proposed framework uses self-learned flow to trigger an automated meta labeling pipeline to achieve automatic supervision. 3D detection experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset show that our method significantly outperforms classical unsupervised approaches and is even competitive to the counterpart with supervised scene flow. We further show that our approach generates highly promising results in open-set 3D detection and trajectory prediction, confirming its potential in closing the safety gap of fully supervised systems.

title: Malte Pedersen, Joakim Bruslund Haurum, Patrick Dendorfer, Thomas B. Moeslund
title_en: Malte Pedersen, Joakim Bruslund Haurum, Patrick Dendorfer, Thomas B. Moeslund
abstract: 目前尚无全面的指标来描述多目标跟踪(MOT)序列的复杂性。这种缺乏指标会降低可解释性,使数据集比较变得复杂,并将跟踪器性能的讨论减少到仅关注排行榜的位置。作为解决方案,我们提出了新的MOT数据集复杂性指标(MOTCOM),该指标结合了三个子指标,灵感来源于MOT中的关键问题:遮挡、不规则运动和视觉相似性。MOTCOM的见解可以开启对跟踪器性能的细致讨论,并可能促进对针对较少知名数据集或旨在解决子问题的新型贡献的更广泛认可。我们在全面的MOT17、MOT20和MOTSynth数据集上评估了MOTCOM,并表明MOTCOM在描述MOT序列复杂性方面比传统的密度和轨迹数量要好得多。项目页面:https://vap.aau.dk/motcom.
abstract_en: There exists no comprehensive metric for describing the complexity of Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) sequences. This lack of metrics decreases explainability, complicates comparison of datasets, and reduces the conversation on tracker performance to a matter of leader board position. As a remedy, we present the novel MOT dataset complexity metric (MOTCOM), which is a combination of three sub-metrics inspired by key problems in MOT: occlusion, erratic motion, and visual similarity. The insights of MOTCOM can open nuanced discussions on tracker performance and may lead to a wider acknowledgement of novel contributions developed for either less known datasets or those aimed at solving sub-problems. We evaluate MOTCOM on the comprehensive MOT17, MOT20, and MOTSynth datasets and show that MOTCOM is far better at describing the complexity of MOT sequences compared to the conventional density and number of tracks. Project page at https://vap.aau.dk/motcom.

title: Mamshad Nayeem Rizve, Navid Kardan, Mubarak Shah
title_en: Mamshad Nayeem Rizve, Navid Kardan, Mubarak Shah
abstract: 深度学习正在推动许多计算机视觉应用的最先进水平。然而,它依赖于大型标注数据仓库,而捕捉现实世界数据的无约束特性仍是一个未解决的问题。半监督学习(SSL)通过使用大量未标注数据来补充标注训练数据,以降低标注成本。标准的SSL方法假设未标注数据与标注数据来自相同的分布。最近,引入了一种更现实的SSL问题,称为开放世界SSL,其中未标注数据可能包含来自未知类别的样本。在本文中,我们提出了一种新颖的基于伪标签的方法来解决开放世界设置中的SSL问题。我们的方法核心在于利用样本不确定性,并结合关于类别分布的先验知识,为属于已知和未知类别的未标注数据生成可靠的类分布感知伪标签。我们的广泛实验展示了该方法在多个基准数据集上的有效性,在七个多样化数据集(包括CIFAR-100(17%)、ImageNet-100(5%)和Tiny ImageNet(9%))上显著优于现有最先进的方法。我们还展示了该方法在解决新类别发现任务中的灵活性,证明了其在处理不平衡数据时的稳定性,并通过一种估计新类别数量的技术来补充我们的方法。
abstract_en: Deep learning is pushing the state-of-the-art in many computer vision applications. However, it relies on large annotated data repositories, and capturing the unconstrained nature of the real-world data is yet to be solved. Semi-supervised learning (SSL) complements the annotated training data with a large corpus of unlabeled data to reduce annotation cost. The standard SSL approach assumes unlabeled data are from the same distribution as annotated data. Recently, a more realistic SSL problem, called open-world SSL, is introduced, where the unannotated data might contain samples from unknown classes. In this paper, we propose a novel pseudo-label based approach to tackle SSL in open-world setting. At the core of our method, we utilize sample uncertainty and incorporate prior knowledge about class distribution to generate reliable class-distribution-aware pseudo-labels for unlabeled data belonging to both known and unknown classes. Our extensive experimentation showcases the effectiveness of our approach on several benchmark datasets, where it substantially outperforms the existing state-of-the-art on seven diverse datasets including CIFAR-100 ( 17%), ImageNet-100 ( 5%), and Tiny ImageNet ( 9%). We also highlight the flexibility of our approach in solving novel class discovery task, demonstrate its stability in dealing with imbalanced data, and complement our approach with a technique to estimate the number of novel classes.

title: Mamshad Nayeem Rizve, Navid Kardan, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Mubarak Shah
title_en: Mamshad Nayeem Rizve, Navid Kardan, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Mubarak Shah
abstract: 半监督学习(SSL)是解决监督学习标注瓶颈的主要方法之一。近年来,SSL方法能够有效利用大量未标注数据来提升性能,同时仅依赖少量标注数据。大多数SSL方法的一个常见假设是,标注数据和未标注数据来自同一数据分布。然而,在许多现实场景中这一假设并不成立,这限制了其适用性。本文旨在解决不依赖该假设的具有挑战性的开放世界SSL问题。在开放世界SSL问题中,目标是识别已知类别的样本,同时检测并聚类未标注数据中出现的新类别样本。本文提出OpenLDN方法,利用成对相似性损失来发现新类别。通过双层优化规则,该成对相似性损失利用标注集中的信息,隐式地对新类别样本进行聚类,同时识别已知类别的样本。在发现新类别后,OpenLDN将开放世界SSL问题转化为标准SSL问题,借助现有SSL方法实现进一步的性能提升。我们的大量实验表明,OpenLDN在多个流行分类基准测试中优于当前最先进的方法,同时提供了更优的准确率/训练时间权衡。
abstract_en: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) is one of the dominant approaches to address the annotation bottleneck of supervised learning. Recent SSL methods can effectively leverage a large repository of unlabeled data to improve performance while relying on a small set of labeled data. One common assumption in most SSL methods is that the labeled and unlabeled data are from the same data distribution. However, this is hardly the case in many real-world scenarios, which limits their applicability. In this work, instead, we attempt to solve the challenging open-world SSL problem that does not make such an assumption. In the open-world SSL problem, the objective is to recognize samples of known classes, and simultaneously detect and cluster samples belonging to novel classes present in unlabeled data. This work introduces OpenLDN that utilizes a pairwise similarity loss to discover novel classes. Using a bi-level optimization rule this pairwise similarity loss exploits the information available in the labeled set to implicitly cluster novel class samples, while simultaneously recognizing samples from known classes. After discovering novel classes, OpenLDN transforms the open-world SSL problem into a standard SSL problem to achieve additional performance gains using existing SSL methods. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that OpenLDN outperforms the current state-of-the-art methods on multiple popular classification benchmarks while providing a better accuracy/training time trade-off.

title: Man Zhou, Jie Huang, Keyu Yan, Hu Yu, Xueyang Fu, Aiping Liu, Xian Wei, Feng Zhao
title_en: Man Zhou, Jie Huang, Keyu Yan, Hu Yu, Xueyang Fu, Aiping Liu, Xian Wei, Feng Zhao
abstract: 全色锐化旨在通过融合全色(PAN)图像和低分辨率多光谱(MS)图像生成高分辨率多光谱(MS)图像。尽管取得了显著进展,现有大多数全色锐化方法仅在空间域进行操作,很少在频率域探索潜在的解决方案。本文首次尝试在空间-频率域同时解决全色锐化问题,并提出一种空间-频率信息集成网络,命名为SFIIN。为实现SFIIN,我们设计了一个专为全色锐化定制的核心构建模块,包含三个关键组件:空间域信息分支、频率域信息分支和双域交互。具体而言,第一部分采用标准卷积在空间域整合PAN和MS图像两种模态的局部信息,第二部分采用深度傅里叶变换实现图像级感受野以探索全局上下文信息。随后,第三部分负责促进信息流动并学习互补表示。我们进行了大量实验以分析所提网络的有效性,并展示了其优于现有先进方法的优越性能。
abstract_en: Pan-sharpening aims to generate the high-resolution multi-spectral (MS) images by fusing PAN images and low-resolution MS images. Despite the great advances, most existing pan-sharpening methods only work in the spatial domain and rarely explore the potential solution in frequency domain. In this paper, we first attempt to address pan-sharpening in both spatial-frequency domain and propose a Spatial-Frequency Information Integration Network, dubbed as SFIIN. To implement SFIIN, we devise a core building module tailored with pan-sharpening, consisting of three key components: spatial-domain information branch, frequency-domain information one and dual domain interaction. To be specific, the first employs the standard convolution to integrate the local information of two modalities of PAN and MS images in the spatial domain while the second adopts deep Fourier transformation to achieve the image-wide receptive field for exploring global contextual information. Followed by, the third is responsible for facilitating the information flow and learning the complementary representation. We conduct extensive experiments to analyze the effectiveness of the proposed network and demonstrate the favorable performance against state-of-the-art methods.

title: Manxi Lin, Aasa Feragen
title_en: Manxi Lin, Aasa Feragen
abstract: 标准空间卷积假设输入数据具有规则的邻域结构。现有方法通常通过固定规则的"视图"(例如固定邻域大小)将卷积推广到不规则点云领域,其中每个点的卷积核大小保持不变。然而,由于点云的结构不如图像规则,固定邻域数量导致了不幸的归纳偏差。我们提出了一种新型图卷积方法,称为差分图卷积(diffConv),其不依赖于规则视图。diffConv在空间变化且密度扩张的邻域结构上进行操作,这些邻域结构进一步通过一种学习到的掩码注意力机制进行自适应调整。实验表明,我们的模型对噪声具有很强的鲁棒性,在3D形状分类和场景理解任务中取得了最先进的性能,同时推理速度更快。
abstract_en: Standard spatial convolutions assume input data with a regular neighborhood structure. Existing methods typically generalize convolution to the irregular point cloud domain by fixing a regular ""view"" through e.g. a fixed neighborhood size, where the convolution kernel size remains the same for each point. However, since point clouds are not as structured as images, the fixed neighbor number gives an unfortunate inductive bias. We present a novel graph convolution named Difference Graph Convolution (diffConv), which does not rely on a regular view. diffConv operates on spatially-varying and density-dilated neighborhoods, which are further adapted by a learned masked attention mechanism. Experiments show that our model is very robust to the noise, obtaining state-of-the-art performance in 3D shape classification and scene understanding tasks, along with a faster inference speed.

title: Manyuan Zhang, Guanglu Song, Yu Liu, Hongsheng Li
title_en: Manyuan Zhang, Guanglu Song, Yu Liu, Hongsheng Li
abstract: 数据清洗、架构设计和损失函数设计是实现高性能人脸识别的重要因素。此前,研究社区尝试通过优化每个单一因素来提升性能,但未能在三个方面的联合搜索中提出统一的解决方案。本文首次发现这些方面彼此紧密耦合。优化每个方面的设计实际上会显著限制性能并偏向算法设计。具体而言,我们发现最优模型架构或损失函数与数据清洗紧密耦合。为消除单一因素研究的偏差并提供对人脸识别模型设计的整体理解,我们首先为每个方面精心设计搜索空间,随后引入综合搜索方法,联合搜索最优的数据清洗、架构和损失函数设计。在我们的框架中,通过创新的基于强化学习的方法,使提出的综合搜索尽可能灵活。在百万级人脸识别基准上的大量实验验证了我们为每个方面设计的新搜索空间的有效性以及综合搜索的效果。我们在单个研究方向上开发的专家算法上取得了显著优势。更重要的是,我们分析了所搜索到的最优设计与单一因素独立设计之间的差异。我们指出,强大的模型倾向于在更困难的训练数据集和损失函数上进行优化。我们的实证研究可为未来研究提供指导,以构建更鲁棒的人脸识别系统。
abstract_en: Data cleaning, architecture, and loss function design are important factors contributing to high-performance face recognition. Previously, the research community tries to improve the performance of each single aspect but failed to present a unified solution on the joint search of the optimal designs for all three aspects.In this paper, we for the first time identify that these aspects are tightly coupled to each other. Optimizing the design of each aspect actually greatly limits the performance and biases the algorithmic design.Specifically, we find that the optimal model architecture or loss function is closely coupled with the data cleaning. To eliminate the bias of single-aspect research and provide an overall understanding of the face recognition model design, we first carefully design the search space for each aspect, then a comprehensive search method is introduced to jointly search optimal data cleaning, architecture, and loss function design.In our framework, we make the proposed comprehensive search as flexible as possible, by using an innovative reinforcement learning based approach.Extensive experiments on million-level face recognition benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our newly-designed search space for each aspect and the comprehensive search. We outperform expert algorithms developed for each single research track by large margins. More importantly, we analyze the difference between our searched optimal design and the independent design of the single factors. We point out that strong models tend to optimize with more difficult training datasets and loss functions. Our empirical study can provide guidance in future research towards more robust face recognition systems.

title: Maosen Li, Siheng Chen, Zijing Zhang, Lingxi Xie, Qi Tian, Ya Zhang
title_en: Maosen Li, Siheng Chen, Zijing Zhang, Lingxi Xie, Qi Tian, Ya Zhang
abstract: 基于图卷积网络的方法通过建模身体关节关系,在基于三维骨架的人体运动预测中展现出巨大潜力。然而,这些方法存在两个关键问题:首先,深度图卷积仅在有限的图谱频带内过滤特征,导致全频带信息丢失;其次,使用单一图结构建模全身低估了各身体部位的多样化模式。为解决第一个问题,我们提出自适应图散射方法,通过多个可训练的带通图滤波器将姿态特征分解到不同图谱频带,提供更丰富的信息,促进更全面的特征提取。为解决第二个问题,对身体部位进行独立建模以学习多样化动态,实现更精细的空间维度特征提取。集成上述两种设计,我们提出一种新颖的骨架分部图散射网络(SPGSN)。模型核心是级联的多部分图散射块(MPGSBs),其构建适用于多样化身体部位的大频带图滤波自适应图散射,并基于推断的频谱重要性及身体部位交互进行分解特征融合。大量实验表明,SPGSN在Human3.6M、CMU Mocap和3DPW数据集上的三维均关节位置误差(MPJPE)分别优于现有方法13.8%、9.3%和2.7%。
abstract_en: Graph convolutional network based methods that model the body joints’ relations, have recently shown great promise in 3D skeleton-based human motion prediction. However, these methods have two critical issues: first, deep graph convolutions filter features within only limited graph spectrum band, losing sufficient information in the full band; second, using a single graph to model the whole body underestimates the diverse patterns in various body-parts. To address the first issue, we propose adaptive graph scattering, which leverages multiple trainable band-pass graph filters to decompose pose features into various graph spectrum bands to provide richer information, promoting more comprehensive feature extraction. To address the second issue, body parts are modeled separately to learn diverse dynamics, which enables finer feature extraction along the spatial dimensions. Integrating the above two designs, we propose a novel skeleton-parted graph scattering network (SPGSN). The cores of the model are cascaded multi-part graph scattering blocks (MPGSBs), which build adaptive graph scattering for large-band graph filtering on diverse body-parts, as well as fuse the decomposed features based on the inferred spectrum importance and body-part interactions. Extensive experiments have shown that SPGSN outperforms state-of-the-art methods by remarkable margins of 13.8%, 9.3% and 2.7% in terms of 3D mean per joint position error (MPJPE) on Human3.6M, CMU Mocap and 3DPW datasets, respectively.

title: Ye Maosheng, Wan Rui, Xu Shuangjie, Cao Tongyi, Chen Qifeng
title_en: Maosheng Ye, Rui Wan, Shuangjie Xu, Tongyi Cao, Qifeng Chen
abstract: 在点云学习中,稀疏性和几何性是两个核心属性。近年来,许多方法通过单个或多个表示来提升点云语义分割的性能。然而,这些方法未能在性能、效率和内存消耗之间保持平衡,表现出无法恰当融合稀疏性和几何性的不足。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种基于单个体素表示的几何感知稀疏网络(Geometry-aware Sparse Networks, GASN)。GASN主要包含两个模块:稀疏特征编码器和稀疏几何特征增强模块。稀疏特征编码器提取局部上下文信息,稀疏几何特征增强模块则增强稀疏点云的几何属性,从而提升效率和性能。此外,我们在训练阶段提出深度稀疏监督机制,以帮助模型收敛并缓解内存消耗问题。我们的GASN在SemanticKITTI和Nuscenes数据集上均取得了最先进的性能,同时运行速度显著提升且内存消耗更低。
abstract_en: In point cloud learning, sparsity and geometry are two core properties. Recently, many approaches have been proposed through single or multiple representations to improve the performance of point cloud semantic segmentation. However, these works fail to maintain the balance among performance, efficiency, and memory consumption, showing incapability to integrate sparsity and geometry appropriately. To address these issues, we propose the Geometry-aware Sparse Networks (GASN) by utilizing the sparsity and geometry of a point cloud in a single voxel representation. GASN mainly consists of two modules, namely Sparse Feature Encoder and Sparse Geometry Feature Enhancement. The Sparse Feature Encoder extracts the local context information, and the Sparse Geometry Feature Enhancement enhances the geometric properties of a sparse point cloud to improve both efficiency and performance. In addition, we propose deep sparse supervision in the training phase to help convergence and alleviate the memory consumption problem. Our GASN achieves state-of-the-art performance on both SemanticKITTI and Nuscenes datasets while running significantly faster and consuming less memory.

title: Maoxun Yuan, Yinyan Wang, Xingxing Wei
title_en: Maoxun Yuan, Yinyan Wang, Xingxing Wei
abstract: 将多光谱数据集成到目标检测中,尤其是可见光和红外图像,近年来受到了广泛关注。由于可见光(RGB)和红外(IR)图像能够提供互补信息以应对光照变化,配对图像被广泛应用于多个领域,如多光谱行人检测、RGB-IR人群计数和RGB-IR显著目标检测。与自然RGB-IR图像相比,我们发现航空RGB-IR图像中的检测面临跨模态弱对齐问题,具体表现为同一物体在位置、尺寸和角度上的偏差。本文主要针对航空RGB-IR图像中的跨模态弱对齐挑战。具体而言,我们首先解释并分析弱对齐问题的成因。随后,我们提出一种平移-缩放-旋转对齐(Translation-Scale-Rotation Alignment, TSRA)模块,通过校准两种模态的特征图来解决该问题。该模块通过对齐过程预测两种模态物体之间的偏差,并利用模态选择(Modality-Selection, MS)策略提升对齐性能。最后,基于TSRA模块构建了面向航空图像RGB-IR目标检测的双流特征对齐检测器(TSFADet)。在公开的DroneVehicle数据集上的综合实验验证了我们的方法能够减弱跨模态对齐的影响,实现鲁棒的目标检测结果。
abstract_en: Integrating multispectral data in object detection, especially visible and infrared images, has received great attention in recent years. Since visible (RGB) and infrared (IR) images can provide complementary information to handle light variations, the paired images are used in many fields, such as multispectral pedestrian detection, RGB-IR crowd counting and RGB-IR salient object detection. Compared with natural RGB-IR images, we find detection in aerial RGB-IR images suffers from cross-modal weakly misalignment problems, which are manifested in the position, size and angle deviations of the same object. In this paper, we mainly address the challenge of cross-modal weakly misalignment in aerial RGB-IR images. Specifically, we firstly explain and analyze the cause of the weakly misalignment problem. Then, we propose a Translation-Scale-Rotation Alignment (TSRA) module to address the problem by calibrating the feature maps from these two modalities. The module predicts the deviation between two modality objects through an alignment process and utilizes Modality-Selection (MS) strategy to improve the performance of alignment. Finally, a two-stream feature alignment detector (TSFADet) based on the TSRA module is constructed for RGB-IR object detection in aerial images. With comprehensive experiments on the public DroneVehicle datasets, we verify that our method reduces the effect of the cross-modal misalignment and achieve robust detection results.

title: Marah Halawa, Olaf Hellwich, Pia Bideau
title_en: Marah Halawa, Olaf Hellwich, Pia Bideau
abstract: 轨迹预测是成功实现人机交互的关键任务,例如在自动驾驶领域。在本工作中,我们针对第一视角下移动相机场景中预测行人未来轨迹的问题,提出了一种新颖的基于动作的对比学习损失函数,该损失函数利用行人动作信息来提升学习到的轨迹嵌入表示。该新损失函数的核心思想是:执行相同动作的行人轨迹在特征空间中应比执行显著不同动作的行人轨迹更接近。换句话说,我们认为行人动作的行为信息会影响其未来轨迹。此外,我们引入了一种新颖的轨迹采样策略,能够有效增加负样本和正样本的对比度。通过训练的条件变分自编码器(CVAE)生成额外的合成轨迹样本,该CVAE是多个轨迹预测模型的核心。实验结果表明,我们提出的对比框架能够有效利用行人行为的上下文信息(即动作),并学习到更优的轨迹表示。因此,将所提出的对比框架集成到轨迹预测模型中,可提升其性能,并在三个轨迹预测基准测试中超越现有最先进方法。
abstract_en: Trajectory prediction is an essential task for successful human robot interaction, such as in autonomous driving. In this work, we address the problem of predicting future pedestrian trajectories in a first person view setting with a moving camera. To that end, we propose a novel action-based contrastive learning loss, that utilizes pedestrian action information to improve the learned trajectory embeddings. The fundamental idea behind this new loss is that trajectories of pedestrians performing the same action should be closer to each other in the feature space than the trajectories of pedestrians with significantly different actions. In other words, we argue that behavioral information about pedestrian action influences their future trajectory. Furthermore, we introduce a novel sampling strategy for trajectories that is able to effectively increase negative and positive contrastive samples. Additional synthetic trajectory samples are generated using a trained Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE), which is at the core of several models developed for trajectory prediction. Results show that our proposed contrastive framework employs contextual information about pedestrian behavior, i.e. action, effectively, and it learns a better trajectory representation. Thus, integrating the proposed contrastive framework within a trajectory prediction model improves its results and outperforms state-of-the-art methods on three trajectory prediction benchmarks.

title: Marco Pesavento, Marco Volino, Adrian Hilton
title_en: Marco Pesavento, Marco Volino, Adrian Hilton
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的框架,从单张低分辨率输入图像中重建超分辨率人体形状。该方法克服了现有方法的局限性,这些方法从单张图像重建3D人体形状时需要高分辨率图像以及表面法线或参数化模型等辅助数据来重建高细节形状。所提出的框架使用高细节隐式函数表示重建的形状。类似于2D图像超分辨率的目标,该方法学习从低分辨率形状到其高分辨率对应物的映射,并应用于从低分辨率图像中重建3D形状细节。该方法采用一种新颖的损失函数进行端到端训练,该损失函数估计同一3D表面形状的低分辨率和高分辨率表示之间信息的损失。针对单张图像重建穿衣人物的评估表明,我们的方法能够在不依赖辅助数据的情况下,从低分辨率图像中实现高细节表面重建。大量实验表明,当应用于低分辨率图像时,所提出的方法能够估计比以往方法获得的细节水平显著更高的超分辨率人体几何结构。
abstract_en: We propose a novel framework to reconstruct super-resolution human shape from a single low-resolution input image. The approach overcomes limitations of existing approaches that reconstruct 3D human shape from a single image, which require high-resolution images together with auxiliary data such as surface normal or a parametric model to reconstruct high-detail shape. The proposed framework represents the reconstructed shape with a high-detail implicit function. Analogous to the objective of 2D image super-resolution, the approach learns the mapping from a low-resolution shape to its high-resolution counterpart and it is applied to reconstruct 3D shape detail from low-resolution images. The approach is trained end-to-end employing a novel loss function which estimates the information lost between a low and high-resolution representation of the same 3D surface shape. Evaluation for single image reconstruction of clothed people demonstrates that our method achieves high-detail surface reconstruction from low-resolution images without auxiliary data. Extensive experiments show that the proposed approach can estimate super-resolution human geometries with a significantly higher level of detail than that obtained with previous approaches when applied to low-resolution images.

title: Marko Mihajlovic, Aayush Bansal, Michael Zollhöfer, Siyu Tang, Shunsuke Saito
title_en: Marko Mihajlovic, Aayush Bansal, Michael Zollhöfer, Siyu Tang, Shunsuke Saito
abstract: 基于像素对齐特征的图像体素化身技术能够推广到未见过的姿态和身份。先前的工作利用全局空间编码和多视角几何一致性来减少空间歧义。然而,全局编码通常容易过拟合训练数据的分布,且从稀疏视角学习多视角一致的重建较为困难。在本工作中,我们研究了现有空间编码的常见问题,并提出了一种简单但高度有效的高保真体素化身建模方法,适用于稀疏视角。其中一个关键思想是通过稀疏3D关键点编码相对空间3D信息。该方法对新视角合成和视角稀疏性具有鲁棒性。我们的方法在头部重建任务中优于现有最先进的方法。在对未见过的主体进行身体重建时,我们也实现了与使用参数化人体模型和时间特征聚合的先前方法相当的性能。实验表明,先前工作的大部分错误源于空间编码选择不当,因此我们建议了一种新的高保真图像化身建模方向。
abstract_en: Image-based volumetric avatars using pixel-aligned features promise generalization to unseen poses and identities. Prior work leverages global spatial encodings and multi-view geometric consistency to reduce spatial ambiguity. However, global encodings often suffer from overfitting to the distribution of the training data, and it is difficult to learn multi-view consistent reconstruction from sparse views. In this work, we investigate common issues with existing spatial encodings and propose a simple yet highly effective approach to modeling high-fidelity volumetric avatars from sparse views. One of the key ideas is to encode relative spatial 3D information via sparse 3D keypoints. This approach is robust to novel view synthesis and the sparsity of viewpoints. Our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods for head reconstruction. On body reconstruction for unseen subjects, we also achieve performance comparable to prior art that uses a parametric human body model and temporal feature aggregation. Our experiments show that a majority of errors in prior work stem from an inappropriate choice of spatial encoding and thus we suggest a new direction for high-fidelity image-based avatar modeling.

title: Markus Hofinger, Erich Kobler, Alexander Effland, Thomas Pock
title_en: Markus Hofinger, Erich Kobler, Alexander Effland, Thomas Pock
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel method for color propagation that is used to recolor gray-scale videos (e.g. historic movies). Our energy-based model combines deep learning with a variational formulation. At its core, the method optimizes over a set of plausible color proposals that are extracted from motion and semantic feature matches, together with a learned regularizer that resolves color ambiguities by enforcing spatial color smoothness. Our approach allows interpreting intermediate results and to incorporate extensions like using multiple reference frames even after training. We achieve state-of-the-art results on a number of standard benchmark datasets with multiple metrics and also provide convincing results on real historical videos - even though such types of video are not present during training. Moreover, a user evaluation shows that our method propagates initial colors more faithfully and temporally consistent.
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a novel method for color propagation that is used to recolor gray-scale videos (e.g. historic movies). Our energy-based model combines deep learning with a variational formulation. At its core, the method optimizes over a set of plausible color proposals that are extracted from motion and semantic feature matches, together with a learned regularizer that resolves color ambiguities by enforcing spatial color smoothness. Our approach allows interpreting intermediate results and to incorporate extensions like using multiple reference frames even after training. We achieve state-of-the-art results on a number of standard benchmark datasets with multiple metrics and also provide convincing results on real historical videos - even though such types of video are not present during training. Moreover, a user evaluation shows that our method propagates initial colors more faithfully and temporally consistent.

title: Martha Paskin, Daniel Baum, Mason N. Dean, Christoph von Tycowicz
title_en: Martha Paskin, Daniel Baum, Mason N. Dean, Christoph von Tycowicz
abstract: 三维形状相较于二维图像能提供更丰富的信息。然而,与获取二维图像相比,获取三维形状有时非常困难甚至不可能,因此有必要从二维图像中推导出三维形状。尽管这通常是一个数学上不适定的问题,但可以通过利用先验信息对问题进行约束来解决。本文提出了一种基于Kendall形状空间的新方法,用于从单目二维图像重建三维形状。该工作受到研究濒危物种大白鲨摄食行为的启发,由于其庞大的体型和活动性,获取三维形状数据几乎不可能,这阻碍了对其摄食行为和生态学的理解。然而,这些动物在摄食姿态下的二维图像却很容易获得。我们比较了我们的方法与最先进的基于形状的方法,分别在人体棍棒模型和鲨鱼头骨骼上进行测试。使用少量训练形状,我们证明了基于Kendall形状空间的方法比之前的方法更具鲁棒性,并能生成合理的形状。这对于研究对象稀有的应用至关重要,因此只能获得少量训练形状。
abstract_en: 3D shapes provide substantially more information than 2D images. However, the acquisition of 3D shapes is sometimes very difficult or even impossible in comparison with acquiring 2D images, making it necessary to derive the 3D shape from 2D images. Although this is, in general, a mathematically ill-posed problem, it might be solved by constraining the problem formulation using prior information. Here, we present a new approach based on Kendall’s shape space to reconstruct 3D shapes from single monocular 2D images. The work is motivated by an application to study the feeding behavior of the basking shark, an endangered species whose massive size and mobility render 3D shape data nearly impossible to obtain, hampering understanding of their feeding behaviors and ecology. 2D images of these animals in feeding position, however, are readily available. We compare our approach with state-of-the-art shape-based approaches, both on human stick models and on shark head skeletons. Using a small set of training shapes, we show that the Kendall shape space approach is substantially more robust than previous methods and results in plausible shapes. This is essential for the motivating application in which specimens are rare and therefore only few training shapes are available.

title: Martin Gubri, Maxime Cordy, Mike Papadakis, Yves Le Traon, Koushik Sen
title_en: Martin Gubri, Maxime Cordy, Mike Papadakis, Yves Le Traon, Koushik Sen
abstract: 我们提出了一种从大几何邻域(LGV)进行迁移的方法,这是一种新的技术,用于提高黑盒对抗攻击的迁移性。LGV从一个预训练的代理模型开始,并通过常数且较高的学习率进行少量额外训练周期,收集多个权重集。LGV利用了两个几何特性,这些特性与迁移性相关。首先,属于更宽权重最优解的模型是更好的代理模型。其次,我们识别出一个子空间,该子空间能够在该更宽最优解中生成有效的代理模型集合。通过广泛的实验,我们证明仅使用LGV就比所有(组合)四种已建立的测试时转换方法高出1.8到59.9个百分点。我们的发现为解释对抗样本的迁移性提供了新的视角,强调了权重空间几何的重要性。
abstract_en: We propose transferability from Large Geometric Vicinity (LGV), a new technique to increase the transferability of black-box adversarial attacks. LGV starts from a pretrained surrogate model and collects multiple weight sets from a few additional training epochs with a constant and high learning rate. LGV exploits two geometric properties that we relate to transferability. First, models that belong to a wider weight optimum are better surrogates. Second, we identify a subspace able to generate an effective surrogate ensemble among this wider optimum. Through extensive experiments, we show that LGV alone outperforms all (combinations of) four established test-time transformations by 1.8 to 59.9 percentage points. Our findings shed new light on the importance of the geometry of the weight space to explain the transferability of adversarial examples.

title: Martin Trimmel, Mihai Zanfir, Richard Hartley, Cristian Sminchisescu
title_en: Martin Trimmel, Mihai Zanfir, Richard Hartley, Cristian Sminchisescu
abstract: 激活函数在深度学习中起着核心作用,因为它们构成了神经网络的基本构建模块。近年来,研究重点逐渐转向探索新型激活函数,这些函数在现代神经网络架构中表现优于传统的修正线性单元(ReLU)。最近,有理激活函数(RAFs)引起了广泛关注,因为它们在图像分类任务中表现出与最先进的激活函数相当的性能。尽管它们具有明显的潜力,但先前的公式要么不安全,要么不平滑,要么并非真正的有理函数,且仅在精心初始化的情况下才能工作。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新颖的增强型有理函数ERA,并研究了如何更好地满足这些激活函数对网络组件和训练策略的特定需求。除了更加稳定外,所提出的函数在两个不同的任务(图像分类和3D人体姿态与形状重建)中,于多种轻量级网络架构上均优于其他标准激活函数。
abstract_en: Activation functions play a central role in deep learning since they form an essential building stone of neural networks. In the last few years, the focus has been shifting towards investigating new types of activations that outperform the classical Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) in modern neural architectures. Most recently, rational activation functions (RAFs) have awakened interest because they were shown to perform on par with state-of-the-art activations on image classification. Despite their apparent potential, prior formulations are either not safe, not smooth or not ""true"" rational functions, and they only work with careful initialisation. Aiming to mitigate these issues, we propose a novel, enhanced rational function, ERA, and investigate how to better accommodate the specific needs of these activations, to both network components and training regime. In addition to being more stable, the proposed function outperforms other standard ones across a range of lightweight network architectures on two different tasks: image classification and 3d human pose and shape reconstruction.

title: Masato Tamura, Rahul Vishwakarma, Ravigopal Vennelakanti
title_en: Masato Tamura, Rahul Vishwakarma, Ravigopal Vennelakanti
abstract: 本文提出了一种用于社会群体活动识别的新框架。作为群体活动识别的扩展任务,社会群体活动识别需要识别多个子群体活动并确定群体成员。大多数现有方法通过优化区域特征并将其总结为活动特征来处理这两个任务。这种启发式特征设计使得特征的有效性容易受到不完整的人体定位的影响,并忽视了场景上下文的重要性。此外,区域特征在识别群体成员方面并不理想,因为这些特征可能被区域中人物的特征所主导,并且具有不同的语义。为了解决这些问题,我们提出利用Transformer中的注意力模块来生成有效的社会群体特征。我们的方法设计为注意力模块能够识别并聚合与社会群体活动相关的特征,为每个社会群体生成有效的特征。群体成员信息被嵌入到特征中,从而通过前馈网络进行访问。前馈网络的输出以如此简洁的方式表示群体,以至于可以通过群体与个体之间的简单匈牙利匹配来识别群体成员。实验结果表明,我们的方法在Volleyball和Collective Activity数据集上优于现有的最先进方法。
abstract_en: This paper presents a novel framework for social group activity recognition. As an expanded task of group activity recognition, social group activity recognition requires recognizing multiple sub-group activities and identifying group members. Most existing methods tackle both tasks by refining region features and then summarizing them into activity features. Such heuristic feature design renders the effectiveness of features susceptible to incomplete person localization and disregards the importance of scene contexts. Furthermore, region features are sub-optimal to identify group members because the features may be dominated by those of people in the regions and have different semantics. To overcome these drawbacks, we propose to leverage attention modules in transformers to generate effective social group features. Our method is designed in such a way that the attention modules identify and then aggregate features relevant to social group activities, generating an effective feature for each social group. Group member information is embedded into the features and thus accessed by feed-forward networks. The outputs of feed-forward networks represent groups so concisely that group members can be identified with simple Hungarian matching between groups and individuals. Experimental results show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods on the Volleyball and Collective Activity datasets.

title: Matan Levy, Rami Ben-Ari, Dani Lischinski
title_en: Matan Levy, Rami Ben-Ari, Dani Lischinski
abstract: 图表问答(CQA)是一项用于评估图表理解能力的任务,其本质与自然图像的理解存在根本差异。CQA需要分析图表中文本与视觉组件之间的关系,以回答一般性问题或推断数值。大多数现有CQA数据集和模型均基于简化假设,这些假设通常使得模型性能超越人类表现。在本工作中,我们针对这一现象提出了一种新的模型,联合学习分类与回归任务。我们的语言-视觉框架采用协同注意力变换器,以捕捉问题与文本元素之间复杂的现实世界交互关系。我们在现实主义的PlotQA数据集上进行了大量实验验证设计,显著超越了先前方法,同时在FigureQA上展现出具有竞争力的性能。我们的模型特别适用于需要回归的现实问题,且答案可能超出词汇表范围。
abstract_en: Chart question answering (CQA) is a task used for assessing chart comprehension, which is fundamentally different from understanding natural images. CQA requires analyzing the relationships between the textual and the visual components of a chart, in order to answer general questions or infer numerical values. Most existing CQA datasets and models are based on simplifying assumptions that often enable surpassing human performance. In this work, we address this outcome and propose a new model that jointly learns classification and regression. Our language-vision setup uses co-attention transformers to capture the complex real-world interactions between the question and the textual elements. We validate our design with extensive experiments on the realistic PlotQA dataset, outperforming previous approaches by a large margin, while showing competitive performance on FigureQA. Our model is particularly well suited for realistic questions with out-of-vocabulary answers that require regression.

title: Matej Grcić, Petra Bevandić, Siniša Šegvić
title_en: Matej Grcić, Petra Bevandić, Siniša Šegvić
abstract: 异常检测可以通过常规训练数据的生成建模或通过与负样本训练数据的区分来实现。这两种方法表现出不同的失效模式。因此,混合算法成为一个有吸引力的研究目标。不幸的是,密集异常检测需要平移等变性和非常大的输入分辨率。这些要求使所有先前的混合方法在我们目前的知识范围内都不可行。因此,我们设计了一种基于重新解释判别性logits为非归一化联合分布的对数 $\hat{p}(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y})$ 的新型混合算法。我们的模型基于共享的卷积表示,从中我们恢复出三个密集预测:i) 闭集类后验 $P(\mathbf{y}|\mathbf{x})$,ii) 数据集后验 $P(\mathbf{d}_{in}|\mathbf{x})$,iii) 非归一化数据似然 $\hat{p}(\mathbf{x})$。后两个预测同时在标准训练数据和通用负样本数据集上进行训练。我们将这两个预测融合为一个混合异常分数,从而实现在大尺寸自然图像上的密集开放集识别。我们精心设计了一个自定义损失函数用于数据似然,以避免通过不可计算的归一化常数 $Z(\theta)$ 的反向传播。实验在标准密集异常检测基准数据集上评估我们的贡献,并以开放-mIoU - 一种新的密集开放集性能度量指标进行评估。我们的提交在计算开销可忽略的情况下实现了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Anomaly detection can be conceived either through generative modelling of regular training data or by discriminating with respect to negative training data. These two approaches exhibit different failure modes. Consequently, hybrid algorithms present an attractive research goal. Unfortunately, dense anomaly detection requires translational equivariance and very large input resolutions. These requirements disqualify all previous hybrid approaches to the best of our knowledge. We therefore design a novel hybrid algorithm based on reinterpreting discriminative logits as a logarithm of the unnormalized joint distribution $\hat{p}(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y})$. Our model builds on a shared convolutional representation from which we recover three dense predictions: i) the closed-set class posterior $P(\mathbf{y}|\mathbf{x})$, ii) the dataset posterior $P(\mathbf{d}_{in}|\mathbf{x})$, iii) unnormalized data likelihood $\hat{p}(\mathbf{x})$. The latter two predictions are trained both on the standard training data and on a generic negative dataset. We blend these two predictions into a hybrid anomaly score which allows dense open-set recognition on large natural images. We carefully design a custom loss for the data likelihood in order to avoid backpropagation through the untractable normalizing constant $Z(\theta)$. Experiments evaluate our contributions on standard dense anomaly detection benchmarks as well as in terms of open-mIoU - a novel metric for dense open-set performance. Our submissions achieve state-of-the-art performance despite neglectable computational overhead over the standard semantic segmentation baseline.

title: Mathis Petrovich, Michael J. Black, Gül Varol
title_en: Mathis Petrovich, Michael J. Black, Gül Varol
abstract: 我们探讨了从文本描述生成多样化三维人体运动的问题。这一具有挑战性的任务需要对两种模态进行联合建模:从文本中理解和提取有用的人本信息,然后生成合理且真实的连续人体姿态序列。与大多数先前工作专注于从文本描述生成单一确定性运动不同,我们设计了一种变分方法,能够生成多种多样的人体运动。我们提出了TEMOS,一种基于文本条件的生成模型,结合了使用人体运动数据进行变分自编码器(VAE)训练,以及一个文本编码器,该编码器生成与VAE潜在空间兼容的分布参数。我们展示了TEMOS框架不仅可以生成如先前工作所示的基于骨架的动画,还可以生成更具表现力的SMPL身体运动。我们在KIT Motion-Language基准上评估了我们的方法,尽管方法相对简单,但展示了显著优于当前最佳方法的改进。代码和模型可在我们的网页上获取。
abstract_en: We address the problem of generating diverse 3D human motions from textual descriptions. This challenging task requires joint modeling of both modalities: understanding and extracting useful human-centric information from the text, and then generating plausible and realistic sequences of human poses. In contrast to most previous work which focuses on generating a single, deterministic, motion from a textual description, we design a variational approach that can produce multiple diverse human motions. We propose TEMOS, a text-conditioned generative model leveraging variational autoencoder (VAE) training with human motion data, in combination with a text encoder that produces distribution parameters compatible with the VAE latent space. We show the TEMOS framework can produce both skeleton-based animations as in prior work, as well more expressive SMPL body motions. We evaluate our approach on the KIT Motion-Language benchmark and, despite being relatively straightforward, demonstrate significant improvements over the state of the art. Code and models are available on our webpage.

title: Matteo Boschini, Lorenzo Bonicelli, Angelo Porrello, Giovanni Bellitto, Matteo Pennisi, Simone Palazzo, Concetto Spampinato, Simone Calderara
title_en: Matteo Boschini, Lorenzo Bonicelli, Angelo Porrello, Giovanni Bellitto, Matteo Pennisi, Simone Palazzo, Concetto Spampinato, Simone Calderara
abstract: 本工作研究持续学习(CL)与迁移学习(TL)之间的关联性。特别是,我们揭示了网络预训练的广泛应用,指出其本身也面临灾难性遗忘问题。不幸的是,这一问题导致后续任务中知识迁移的利用不足。基于此,我们提出了一种混合方法Transfer without Forgetting(TwF),该方法基于固定预训练的兄弟网络,通过逐层损失项持续传播源域中的知识。实验表明,TwF在多种设置中均优于其他CL方法,平均在各类数据集和不同缓冲区大小下实现4.81%的类别增量准确率提升。
abstract_en: This work investigates the entanglement between Continual Learning (CL) and Transfer Learning (TL). In particular, we shed light on the widespread application of network pretraining, highlighting that it is itself subject to catastrophic forgetting. Unfortunately, this issue leads to the under-exploitation of knowledge transfer during later tasks. On this ground, we propose Transfer without Forgetting (TwF), a hybrid approach building upon a fixed pretrained sibling network, which continuously propagates the knowledge inherent in the source domain through a layer-wise loss term. Our experiments indicate that TwF steadily outperforms other CL methods across a variety of settings, averaging a 4.81% gain in Class-Incremental accuracy over a variety of datasets and different buffer sizes.

title: Matteo Taiana, Matteo Toso, Stuart James, Alessio Del Bue
title_en: Matteo Taiana, Matteo Toso, Stuart James, Alessio Del Bue
abstract: 通常,估计一组图像对应的相机姿态依赖于图像间的特征匹配。相反,我们首次通过使用物体性区域来指导姿态估计问题,而非显式的语义物体检测。我们提出了一种轻量级图神经网络Pose Refiner Network(PoserNet),用于优化近似的成对相对相机姿态。PoserNet利用多视角间物体性区域(简洁表达为边界框)的关联性,对稀疏连接的视图图进行全局优化。我们在7-Scenes数据集上评估了不同规模的图,展示了该过程如何有益于基于优化的运动平均算法,使旋转误差中位数较基于边界框的初始估计值降低62度。代码和数据可在https://github.com/IIT-PAVIS/PoserNet获取。
abstract_en: The estimation of the camera poses associated with a set of images commonly relies on feature matches between the images. In contrast, we are the first to address this challenge by using objectness regions to guide the pose estimation problem rather than explicit semantic object detections. We propose Pose Refiner Network (PoserNet) a light-weight Graph Neural Network to refine the approximate pair-wise relative camera poses. PoserNet exploits associations between the objectness regions - concisely expressed as bounding boxes - across multiple views to globally refine sparsely connected view graphs. We evaluate on the 7-Scenes dataset across varied sizes of graphs and show how this process can be beneficial to optimization-based motion averaging algorithms improving the median error on the rotation by 62 degrees with respect to the initial estimates obtained based on bounding boxes. Code and data are available at https://github.com/IIT-PAVIS/PoserNet.

title: Matthew Dutson, Yin Li, Mohit Gupta
title_en: Matthew Dutson, Yin Li, Mohit Gupta
abstract: 视频数据通常具有重复性;例如,相邻帧的内容通常具有强相关性。这种冗余性在多个复杂层次上出现,从低级像素值到纹理和高级语义。我们提出事件神经网络(EvNets),利用这种冗余性在视频推理过程中实现显著的计算节省。EvNets的一个显著特征是每个神经元具有状态变量,为其提供长期记忆,即使在存在显著相机运动的情况下,也能实现低成本、高精度的推理。我们展示了将广泛神经网络转换为EvNets的可能性,而无需重新训练。我们在高阶和低阶视觉处理的最先进架构上验证了我们的方法,包括姿态识别、目标检测、光流和图像增强。与传统网络相比,我们观察到计算成本减少了约一个数量级,而模型精度的减少几乎可以忽略不计。
abstract_en: Video data is often repetitive; for example, the contents of adjacent frames are usually strongly correlated. Such redundancy occurs at multiple levels of complexity, from low-level pixel values to textures and high-level semantics. We propose Event Neural Networks (EvNets), which leverage this redundancy to achieve considerable computation savings during video inference. A defining characteristic of EvNets is that each neuron has state variables that provide it with long-term memory, which allows low-cost, high-accuracy inference even in the presence of significant camera motion. We show that it is possible to transform a wide range of neural networks into EvNets without re-training. We demonstrate our method on state-of-the-art architectures for both high- and low-level visual processing, including pose recognition, object detection, optical flow, and image enhancement. We observe roughly an order-of-magnitude reduction in computational costs compared to conventional networks, with minimal reductions in model accuracy.

title: Matthias Minderer, Alexey Gritsenko, Austin Stone, Maxim Neumann, Dirk Weissenborn, Alexey Dosovitskiy, Aravindh Mahendran, Anurag Arnab, Mostafa Dehghani, Zhuoran Shen, Xiao Wang, Xiaohua Zhai, Thomas Kipf, Neil Houlsby
title_en: Matthias Minderer, Alexey Gritsenko, Austin Stone, Maxim Neumann, Dirk Weissenborn, Alexey Dosovitskiy, Aravindh Mahendran, Anurag Arnab, Mostafa Dehghani, Zhuoran Shen, Xiao Wang, Xiaohua Zhai, Thomas Kipf, Neil Houlsby
abstract: 将简单架构与大规模预训练相结合,在图像分类任务中取得了显著提升。对于目标检测任务,预训练和扩展方法的建立尚不完善,尤其是在长尾和开放词汇设置下,训练数据相对稀缺。本文提出了一种将图像-文本模型迁移到开放词汇目标检测的强效方案。我们采用标准的Vision Transformer架构并进行最小修改,结合对比图像-文本预训练和端到端检测微调。我们对这种设置的扩展性质进行分析,结果表明增加图像级预训练和模型规模可持续提升下游检测任务的性能。我们提供了实现零样本文本条件和单样本图像条件目标检测的适应策略和正则化方法。代码和模型将在GitHub上公开。
abstract_en: Combining simple architectures with large-scale pre-training has led to massive improvements in image classification. For object detection, pre-training and scaling approaches are less well established, especially in the long-tailed and open-vocabulary setting, where training data is relatively scarce. In this paper, we propose a strong recipe for transferring image-text models to open-vocabulary object detection. We use a standard Vision Transformer architecture with minimal modifications, contrastive image-text pre-training, and end-to-end detection fine-tuning. Our analysis of the scaling properties of this setup shows that increasing image-level pre-training and model size yield consistent improvements on the downstream detection task. We provide the adaptation strategies and regularizations needed to attain very strong performance on zero-shot text-conditioned and one-shot image-conditioned object detection. Code and models will be made available on GitHub.

title: Matthieu Paul, Martin Danelljan, Christoph Mayer, Luc Van Gool
title_en: Matthieu Paul, Martin Danelljan, Christoph Mayer, Luc Van Gool
abstract: 估计目标范围在视觉目标跟踪中是一个根本性挑战。通常,跟踪器以框为中心,完全依赖边界框来定义场景中的目标。在实践中,物体往往具有复杂形状且不与图像轴对齐。在这种情况下,边界框无法准确描述目标,通常包含大量背景像素。我们提出了一种以分割为中心的跟踪流程,不仅生成高精度的分割掩码,还内部使用分割掩码而非边界框进行处理。因此,我们的跟踪器能够更好地学习目标表示,从而清晰区分场景中的目标与背景内容。为实现对挑战性跟踪场景的必要鲁棒性,我们提出独立的实例定位组件,用于在生成输出掩码时对分割解码器进行条件约束。我们从分割掩码推断边界框,在挑战性跟踪数据集上验证我们的跟踪器,并在LaSOT数据集上取得新的最先进水平,成功AUC得分为69.7%。由于大多数跟踪数据集不包含掩码注释,我们无法使用它们评估预测的分割掩码。相反,我们在两个流行的视频对象分割数据集上验证分割质量。代码和训练模型可在https://github.com/visionml/pytracking获取。
abstract_en: Estimating the target extent poses a fundamental challenge in visual object tracking. Typically, trackers are box-centric and fully rely on a bounding box to define the target in the scene. In practice, objects often have complex shapes and are not aligned with the image axis. In these cases, bounding boxes do not provide an accurate description of the target and often contain a majority of background pixels. We propose a segmentation-centric tracking pipeline that not only produces a highly accurate segmentation mask, but also internally works with segmentation masks instead of bounding boxes. Thus, our tracker is able to better learn a target representation that clearly differentiates the target in the scene from background content. In order to achieve the necessary robustness for the challenging tracking scenario, we propose a separate instance localization component that is used to condition the segmentation decoder when producing the output mask. We infer a bounding box from the segmentation mask, validate our tracker on challenging tracking datasets and achieve the new state of the art on LaSOT with a success AUC score of 69.7%. Since most tracking datasets do not contain mask annotations, we cannot use them to evaluate predicted segmentation masks. Instead, we validate our segmentation quality on two popular video object segmentation datasets. The code and trained models are available at https://github.com/visionml/pytracking.

title: Md Mohaiminul Islam, Gedas Bertasius
title_en: Md Mohaiminul Islam, Gedas Bertasius
abstract: 大多数现代视频识别模型设计用于处理短时长视频片段(例如5-10秒)。因此,将此类模型应用于长电影理解任务具有挑战性,这类任务通常需要复杂的长程时间推理。最近引入的视频变换器通过使用长程时间自注意力机制部分解决了这一问题。然而,由于自注意力的二次成本,此类模型往往成本高昂且难以实际应用。相反,我们提出ViS4mer,一种高效的长程视频模型,结合了自注意力机制和近期引入的结构化状态空间序列(S4)层的优势。我们的模型使用标准Transformer编码器进行短程时空特征提取,并采用多尺度时间S4解码器进行后续长程时间推理。通过在每个解码器层逐步降低时空特征分辨率和通道维度,ViS4mer能够学习视频中的复杂长程时空依赖关系。此外,ViS4mer比纯自注意力模型快2.63倍,GPU内存需求减少8倍。此外,ViS4mer在Long Video Understanding(LVU)基准的9个长视频分类任务中取得了6个任务的最先进结果。进一步研究表明,我们的方法成功泛化到其他领域,在Breakfast和COIN程序性活动数据集上取得了具有竞争力的结果。代码已公开。
abstract_en: Most modern video recognition models are designed to operate on short video clips (e.g., 5-10s in length). Thus, it is challenging to apply such models to long movie understanding tasks, which typically require sophisticated long-range temporal reasoning. The recently introduced video transformers partially address this issue by using long-range temporal self-attention. However, due to the quadratic cost of self-attention, such models are often costly and impractical to use. Instead, we propose ViS4mer, an efficient long-range video model that combines the strengths of self-attention and the recently introduced structured state-space sequence (S4) layer. Our model uses a standard Transformer encoder for short-range spatiotemporal feature extraction, and a multi-scale temporal S4 decoder for subsequent long-range temporal reasoning. By progressively reducing the spatiotemporal feature resolution and channel dimension at each decoder layer, ViS4mer learns complex long-range spatiotemporal dependencies in a video. Furthermore, ViS4mer is 2.63x faster and requires 8x less GPU memory than the corresponding pure self-attention-based model. Additionally, ViS4mer achieves state-of-the-art results in 6 out of 9 long-form movie video classification tasks on the Long Video Understanding (LVU) benchmark. Furthermore, we show that our approach successfully generalizes to other domains, achieving competitive results on the Breakfast and the COIN procedural activity datasets. The code is publicly available.

title: Medhini Narasimhan, Arsha Nagrani, Chen Sun, Michael Rubinstein, Trevor Darrell, Anna Rohrbach, Cordelia Schmid
title_en: Medhini Narasimhan, Arsha Nagrani, Chen Sun, Michael Rubinstein, Trevor Darrell, Anna Rohrbach, Cordelia Schmid
abstract: 在YouTube上寻找特定任务指导的用户可能需要花费大量时间浏览内容,以找到符合其需求的正确视频。创建视觉摘要(视频的简略版本)可为观众提供快速概览,并大幅减少搜索时间。本工作中,我们专注于教学视频的摘要,这是视频摘要领域较少被探索的领域。与普通视频相比,教学视频可以解析为具有语义意义的段落,这些段落对应于演示任务的重要步骤。现有的视频摘要数据集依赖于手动帧级注释,这使得它们具有主观性且数据量有限。为了解决这一问题,我们首先通过利用两个关键假设,自动为教学视频语料库生成伪摘要:(i) 相关步骤很可能出现在同一任务的多个视频中(任务相关性),以及 (ii) 它们更可能由演示者口头描述(跨模态显著性)。我们提出了一种教学视频摘要网络,结合了上下文感知的时序视频编码器和段评分变压器。利用伪摘要作为弱监督,我们的网络仅根据视频和转录语音即可构建教学视频的视觉摘要。为了评估我们的模型,我们通过抓取包含视频演示和步骤视觉描述的WikiHow文章,收集了一个高质量的测试集WikiHow Summaries,从而获得真实摘要。我们在这一新基准上超越了多个基线和最先进的视频摘要模型。
abstract_en: YouTube users looking for instructions for a specific task may spend a long time browsing content trying to find the right video that matches their needs. Creating a visual summary (abridged version of a video) provides viewers with a quick overview and massively reduces search time. In this work, we focus on summarizing instructional videos, an under-explored area of video summarization. In comparison to generic videos, instructional videos can be parsed into semantically meaningful segments that correspond to important steps of the demonstrated task. Existing video summarization datasets rely on manual frame-level annotations, making them subjective and limited in size. To overcome this, we first automatically generate pseudo summaries for a corpus of instructional videos by exploiting two key assumptions: (i) relevant steps are likely to appear in multiple videos of the same task (Task Relevance), and (ii) they are more likely to be described by the demonstrator verbally (Cross-Modal Saliency). We propose an instructional video summarization network that combines a context-aware temporal video encoder and a segment scoring transformer. Using pseudo summaries as weak supervision, our network constructs a visual summary for an instructional video given only video and transcribed speech. To evaluate our model, we collect a high-quality test set, WikiHow Summaries, by scraping WikiHow articles that contain video demonstrations and visual depictions of steps allowing us to obtain the ground-truth summaries. We outperform several baselines and a state-of-the-art video summarization model on this new benchmark.

title: Megha Nawhal, Akash Abdu Jyothi, Greg Mori
title_en: Megha Nawhal, Akash Abdu Jyothi, Greg Mori
abstract: 动作预判涉及在观察视频的初始部分后预测未来动作。通常,整个视频会被处理以获得视频级别的表示,用于描述视频中正在进行的活动,进而进行未来预测。我们引入了ANTICIPATR模型,该模型通过结合段级表示(利用不同活动的个体片段)和视频级表示,实现长期动作预判。我们提出了一种两阶段学习方法,用于训练一种新型的基于Transformer的模型,该模型利用这两种表示类型直接预测给定预判时长内的未来动作实例集合。在Breakfast、50Salads、Epic-Kitchens-55和EGTEA Gaze+数据集上的实验结果验证了我们方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Action anticipation involves predicting future actions having observed the initial portion of a video. Typically, the observed video is processed as a whole to obtain a video-level representation of the ongoing activity in the video, which is then used for future prediction. We introduce ANTICIPATR which performs long-term action anticipation leveraging segment-level representations learned using individual segments from different activities, in addition to a video-level representation. We propose a two-stage learning approach to train a novel transformer-based model that uses these two types of representations to directly predict a set of future action instances over any given anticipation duration. Results on Breakfast, 50Salads, Epic-Kitchens-55, and EGTEA Gaze+ datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

title: Mehmet Aygün, Oisin Mac Aodha
title_en: Mehmet Aygün, Oisin Mac Aodha
abstract: 我们通过无监督学习的视角探索语义对应估计。我们使用标准化的评估协议,在多个具有挑战性的数据集上对几种最近提出的无监督方法进行了全面评估,其中我们变化了诸如主干网络架构、预训练策略以及预训练和微调数据集等因素。为了更好地理解这些方法的失败模式,并为改进提供更清晰的路径,我们提供了一个新的诊断框架以及一个更适合语义匹配任务的新性能度量标准。最后,我们介绍了一种新的无监督对应方法,该方法利用预训练特征的优势,同时在训练过程中鼓励更好的匹配。这使得与当前最先进的方法相比,匹配性能显著提高。
abstract_en: We explore semantic correspondence estimation through the lens of unsupervised learning. We thoroughly evaluate several recently proposed unsupervised methods across multiple challenging datasets using a standardized evaluation protocol where we vary factors such as the backbone architecture, the pre-training strategy, and the pre-training and finetuning datasets. To better understand the failure modes of these methods, and in order to provide a clearer path for improvement, we provide a new diagnostic framework along with a new performance metric that is better suited to the semantic matching task. Finally, we introduce a new unsupervised correspondence approach which utilizes the strength of pre-trained features while encouraging better matches during training. This results in significantly better matching performance compared to current state-of-the-art methods.

title: Meng Cao, Tianyu Yang, Junwu Weng, Can Zhang, Jue Wang, Yuexian Zou
title_en: Meng Cao, Tianyu Yang, Junwu Weng, Can Zhang, Jue Wang, Yuexian Zou
abstract: 视频-文本预训练(VTP)旨在从大规模网络视频中学习可迁移的表示,以应对各种下游任务。截至目前,几乎所有现有的VTP方法都局限于基于检索的下游任务,例如视频检索,而其在基于定位任务(如时间定位)上的迁移潜力尚未被充分探索。在本文中,我们通过实验分析并证明当前VTP方法与定位任务的不兼容性,并提出了一种面向定位的视频-文本预训练框架,称为LocVTP。具体而言,我们通过片段-词对应关系发现方案,对粗粒度对比对齐进行细粒度补充。为进一步增强所学特征的时间推理能力,我们提出了一种上下文投影头和一种时序感知对比损失,以感知上下文关系。在六个数据集上的四个下游任务上的大量实验表明,我们的LocVTP在基于检索和基于定位的任务上均取得了最先进的性能。此外,我们进行了全面的消融研究和深入分析,以探索最优的模型设计和训练策略。
abstract_en: Video-Text Pre-training (VTP) aims to learn transferable representations for various downstream tasks from large-scale web videos. To date, almost all existing VTP methods are limited to retrieval-based downstream tasks, e.g., video retrieval, whereas their transfer potentials on localization-based tasks, e.g., temporal grounding, are underexplored. In this paper, we experimentally analyze and demonstrate the incompatibility of current VTP methods with localization tasks, and propose a novel Localization-oriented Video-Ttext Pre-training framework, dubbed as LocVTP. Specifically, we perform the fine-grained contrastive alignment as a complement to the coarse-grained one by a clip-word correspondence discovery scheme. To further enhance the temporal reasoning ability of the learned feature, we propose a context projection head and a temporal aware contrastive loss to perceive the contextual relationships. Extensive experiments on four downstream tasks across six datasets demonstrate that our LocVTP achieves state-of-the-art performance on both retrieval-based and localization-based tasks. Furthermore, we conduct comprehensive ablation studies and thorough analyses to explore the optimum model designs and training strategies.

title: Meng Li, Shangyin Gao, Yihui Feng, Yibo Shi, Jing Wang
title_en: Meng Li, Shangyin Gao, Yihui Feng, Yibo Shi, Jing Wang
abstract: 近年来,随着深度神经网络的发展,端到端优化的图像压缩技术取得了显著进展,在速率-失真性能方面超越了经典方法。然而,大多数基于学习的图像压缩方法都是未标注的,在优化模型时未考虑图像语义或内容。事实上,人眼对不同内容的敏感度存在差异,因此在优化模型时也需要考虑图像内容。本文提出了一种面向内容的图像压缩方法,针对不同类型图像内容采用不同的策略。大量实验表明,所提出的方法在性能上与最先进的端到端学习图像压缩方法或经典方法相比具有竞争力。
abstract_en: In recent years, with the development of deep neural networks, end-to-end optimized image compression has made significant progress and exceeded the classic methods in terms of rate-distortion performance. However, most learning-based image compression methods are unlabeled and do not consider image semantics or content when optimizing the model. In fact, human eyes have different sensitivities to different content, so the image content also needs to be considered when optimizing the model. In this paper, we propose a content-oriented image compression method, which handles different kinds of image contents with different strategies. Extensive experiments show that the proposed method achieves competitive results compared with state-of-the-art end-to-end learned image compression methods or classic methods.

title: Mengde Xu, Zheng Zhang, Fangyun Wei, Yutong Lin, Yue Cao, Han Hu, Xiang Bai
title_en: Mengde Xu, Zheng Zhang, Fangyun Wei, Yutong Lin, Yue Cao, Han Hu, Xiang Bai
abstract: 近年来,基于视觉语言预训练的开放词汇图像分类取得了惊人的成果,即模型可以在不看到该类别的额外标注图像的情况下对任意类别进行分类。然而,如何使开放词汇识别在更广泛的视觉问题上表现良好仍不明确。本文旨在通过构建在现成的预训练视觉-语言模型(即CLIP)上的开放词汇语义分割。然而,语义分割与CLIP模型在视觉粒度上存在差异,语义分割处理的是像素级,而CLIP处理的是图像级。为解决处理粒度的差异,我们拒绝使用流行的单阶段FCN框架,转而倡导一个两阶段的语义分割框架,其中第一阶段提取可泛化的掩码提案,第二阶段利用基于图像的CLIP模型对第一阶段生成的掩码图像块进行开放词汇分类。实验结果表明,仅在COCO Stuff数据集上训练并在其他数据集上评估(无需微调)时,该两阶段框架的性能优于FCN。此外,该简单框架在零样本语义分割任务中也大幅超越了先前的最先进方法:在Pascal VOC 2012数据集上提升29.5 hIoU,在COCO Stuff数据集上提升8.9 hIoU。凭借其简洁性和强大性能,我们希望该框架能作为未来研究的基准。代码已公开在https://github.com/MendelXu/zsseg.baseline。
abstract_en: Recently, open-vocabulary image classification by vision language pre-training has demonstrated incredible achievements, that the model can classify arbitrary categories without seeing additional annotated images of that category. However, it is still unclear how to make the open-vocabulary recognition work well on broader vision problems. This paper targets open-vocabulary semantic segmentation by building it on an off-the-shelf pre-trained vision-language model, i.e., CLIP. However, semantic segmentation and the CLIP model perform on different visual granularity, that semantic segmentation processes on pixels while CLIP performs on images. To remedy the discrepancy in processing granularity, we refuse the use of the prevalent one-stage FCN based framework, and advocate a two-stage semantic segmentation framework, with the first stage extracting generalizable mask proposals and the second stage leveraging an image based CLIP model to perform open-vocabulary classification on the masked image crops which are generated in the first stage. Our experimental results show that this two-stage framework can achieve superior performance than FCN when trained only on COCO Stuff dataset and evaluated on other datasets without fine-tuning. Moreover, this simple framework also surpasses previous state-of-the-arts of zero-shot semantic segmentation by a large margin: +29.5 hIoU on the Pascal VOC 2012 dataset, and +8.9 hIoU on the COCO Stuff dataset. With its simplicity and strong performance, we hope this framework to serve as a baseline to facilitate future research. The code are made publicly available at https://github.com/MendelXu/zsseg.baseline.

title: Menglin Jia, Luming Tang, Bor-Chun Chen, Claire Cardie, Serge Belongie, Bharath Hariharan, Ser-Nam Lim
title_en: Menglin Jia, Luming Tang, Bor-Chun Chen, Claire Cardie, Serge Belongie, Bharath Hariharan, Ser-Nam Lim
abstract: 当前在适配预训练模型的常规做法是更新所有主干参数,即全量微调。本文提出视觉提示微调(Visual Prompt Tuning, VPT)作为针对视觉领域大规模Transformer模型的高效且有效的全量微调替代方案。受近期高效微调大规模语言模型进展的启发,VPT仅在输入空间中引入少量(少于1%的模型参数)可训练参数,同时保持模型主干冻结。通过在多种下游识别任务上的广泛实验,我们证明VPT相比其他参数高效微调方法取得了显著性能提升。最重要的是,VPT在多种模型容量和训练规模下甚至超越了全量微调,同时降低了每任务的存储成本。代码已开源:https://github.com/kmnp/vpt
abstract_en: The current modus operandi in adapting pre-trained models involves updating all the backbone parameters, i.e. full fine-tuning. This paper introduces Visual Prompt Tuning (VPT) as an efficient and effective alternative to full fine-tuning for large-scale Transformer models in vision. Taking inspiration from recent advances in efficiently tuning large language models, VPT introduces only a small amount (less than 1% of model parameters) of trainable parameters in the input space while keeping the model backbone frozen. Via extensive experiments on a wide variety of downstream recognition tasks, we show that VPT achieves significant performance gains compared to other parameter-efficient tuning protocols. Most importantly, VPT even outperforms full fine-tuning in many cases across model capacities and training scales, while reducing per-task storage cost. Code is available at https://github.com/kmnp/vpt.

title: Mengping Yang, Zhe Wang, Ziqiu Chi, Wenyi Feng
title_en: Mengping Yang, Zhe Wang, Ziqiu Chi, Wenyi Feng
abstract: 现有的少样本图像生成方法通常采用基于融合的策略,或在图像层面或特征层面生成新图像。然而,先前的方法难以合成具有精细细节的高频信号,导致生成质量下降。为解决这一问题,我们提出WaveGAN,一种面向少样本图像生成的频率感知模型。具体而言,我们将编码的特征解耦为多个频率成分,并通过低频跳跃连接保留轮廓和结构信息。随后,我们通过采用高频跳跃连接缓解生成器在合成精细细节时的困难,从而为生成器提供有信息量的频率信息。此外,我们利用频率L1损失对生成图像和真实图像进行处理,进一步抑制频率信息的丢失。大量实验验证了我们的方法在三个数据集上的有效性与先进性。值得注意的是,我们在Flower、Animal Faces和VGGFace数据集上分别取得了新的最先进结果,FID分别为42.17、30.35和4.96,LPIPS分别为0.3868、0.5076和0.3822。GitHub: https://github.com/kobeshegu/ECCV2022_WaveGAN
abstract_en: Existing few-shot image generation approaches typically employ fusion-based strategies, either on the image or the feature level, to produce new images. However, previous approaches struggle to synthesize high-frequency signals with fine details, deteriorating the synthesis quality. To address this, we propose WaveGAN, a frequency-aware model for few-shot image generation. Concretely, we disentangle encoded features into multiple frequency components and perform low-frequency skip connections to preserve outline and structural information. Then we alleviate the generator’s struggles of synthesizing fine details by employing high-frequency skip connections, thus providing informative frequency information to the generator. Moreover, we utilize a frequency L1-loss on the generated and real images to further impede frequency information loss. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and advancement of our method on three datasets. Noticeably, we achieve new state-of-the-art with FID 42.17, LPIPS 0.3868, FID 30.35, LPIPS 0.5076, and FID 4.96, LPIPS 0.3822 respectively on Flower, Animal Faces, and VGGFace. GitHub: https://github.com/kobeshegu/ECCV2022_WaveGAN

title: Mengxue Qu, Yu Wu, Wu Liu, Qiqi Gong, Xiaodan Liang, Olga Russakovsky, Yao Zhao, Yunchao Wei
title_en: Mengxue Qu, Yu Wu, Wu Liu, Qiqi Gong, Xiaodan Liang, Olga Russakovsky, Yao Zhao, Yunchao Wei
abstract: 本文研究了如何利用现代视觉-语言Transformer实现更优的指称视觉定位,并提出了一种简单而强大的选择性再训练(Selective Retraining, SiRi)机制。特别地,SiRi为视觉定位研究提供了一个重要原则,即更好的初始化视觉-语言编码器有助于模型收敛到更优的局部极小值,从而提升性能。基于这一原则,我们在训练过程中持续更新编码器参数,同时定期重新初始化其余参数,以迫使模型在增强的编码器基础上实现更优的优化。通过这种简单的训练机制,我们的SiRi在三个主流基准测试中显著超越了先前方法。此外,我们发现即使在有限的训练数据下,SiRi的表现也出人意料地优异。更重要的是,SiRi的有效性进一步通过其他模型和视觉-语言任务得到了验证。代码详见补充材料。
abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate how to achieve better referring visual grounding with modern vision-language transformers, and propose a simple yet powerful Selective Retraining (SiRi) mechanism. Particularly, SiRi conveys a significant principle to the research of visual grounding, i.e, a better initialized vision-language encoder would help the model converge to a better local minimum, advancing the performance accordingly. With such a principle, we continually update the parameters of the encoder as the training goes on, while periodically re-initialize the rest parameters to compel the model to be better optimized based on an enhanced encoder. With such a simple training mechanism, our SiRi can significantly outperform previous approaches on three popular benchmarks. Additionally, we reveal that SiRi performs surprisingly superior even with limited training data. More importantly, the effectiveness of SiRi, are further verified by other model and other V-L tasks. Code is available in the supplementary materials.

title: Mengyu Dai, Haibin Hang, Xiaoyang Guo
title_en: Mengyu Dai, Haibin Hang, Xiaoyang Guo
abstract: 生成模型尤其是生成对抗网络在低数据设置下训练时容易发散。为缓解这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的隐式数据增强方法,该方法有助于实现稳定训练并合成高质量样本,而无需标签信息。具体而言,我们将判别器视为真实数据流形的度量嵌入,从而提供真实数据点之间的适当距离。随后,我们利用特征空间中的信息开发了一种完全无监督且数据驱动的增强方法。在少样本生成任务上的实验表明,所提出的方法在数百个训练样本的情况下显著提升了强基线模型的性能。
abstract_en: Training of generative models especially Generative Adversarial Networks can easily diverge in low-data setting. To mitigate this issue, we propose a novel implicit data augmentation approach which facilitates stable training and synthesize high-quality samples without need of label information. Specifically, we view the discriminator as a metric embedding of the real data manifold, which offers proper distances between real data points. We then utilize information in the feature space to develop a fully unsupervised and data-driven augmentation method. Experiments on few-shot generation tasks show the proposed method significantly improve results from strong baselines with hundreds of training samples.

title: 弱监督时序动作定位(WS-TAL)
title_en: Mengyuan Chen, Junyu Gao, Shicai Yang, Changsheng Xu
abstract: 弱监督时序动作定位(WS-TAL)旨在仅使用视频级标签对动作实例进行定位并识别其类别。尽管取得了显著进展,现有方法仍面临严重的动作-背景歧义问题,这主要来源于聚合操作引入的背景噪声以及分类与定位任务差距导致的动作内部变化。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种通用的证据深度学习(EDL)框架用于WS-TAL,称为用于不确定性建模的双证据学习(DELU),该框架扩展了传统EDL范式以适应弱监督多标签分类目标。具体而言,针对自适应排除不期望的背景片段,我们利用视频级不确定性度量背景噪声对视频级预测的干扰。随后,进一步诱导片段级不确定性以实现渐进式学习,通过“由易到难”的方式逐步聚焦于整个动作实例。大量实验表明,DELU在THUMOS14和ActivityNet1.2基准上达到了最先进的性能。我们的代码可在github.com/MengyuanChen21/ECCV2022-DELU获取。
abstract_en: Weakly-supervised temporal action localization (WS-TAL) aims to localize the action instances and recognize their categories with only video-level labels. Despite great progress, existing methods suffer from severe action-background ambiguity, which mainly comes from background noise introduced by aggregation operations and large intra-action variations caused by the task gap between classification and localization. To address this issue, we propose a generalized evidential deep learning (EDL) framework for WS-TAL, called Dual-Evidential Learning for Uncertainty modeling (DELU), which extends the traditional paradigm of EDL to adapt to the weakly-supervised multi-label classification goal. Specifically, targeting at adaptively excluding the undesirable background snippets, we utilize the video-level uncertainty to measure the interference of background noise to video-level prediction. Then, the snippet-level uncertainty is further induced for progressive learning, which gradually focuses on the entire action instances in an “easy-to-hard” manner. Extensive experiments show that DELU achieves state-of-the-art performance on THUMOS14 and ActivityNet1.2 benchmarks. Our code is available in github.com/MengyuanChen21/ECCV2022-DELU.

title: Miao Liu, Lingni Ma, Kiran Somasundaram, Yin Li, Kristen Grauman, James M. Rehg, Chao Li
title_en: Miao Liu, Lingni Ma, Kiran Somasundaram, Yin Li, Kristen Grauman, James M. Rehg, Chao Li
abstract: 给定一段第一人称视角视频及其录制环境的上下文信息,我们能否识别出人物正在进行的动作,并确定该动作在三维空间中的发生位置?我们针对这一挑战性问题提出了解决方案:从第一人称视角视频中,联合识别并定位移动用户在已知三维地图上的动作。为此,我们提出了一种新颖的深度概率模型。该模型输入层次化体积表示(Hierarchical Volumetric Representation, HVR)的三维环境信息和第一人称视角视频,将三维动作位置作为潜在变量进行推断,并基于视频内容及其潜在位置周围的上下文线索识别动作。为评估我们的模型,我们在Ego4D数据集的子集中进行了大量实验,该子集同时包含了人类自然动作和逼真三维环境重建。我们的方法在已知和未知环境中均展现出强大的动作识别和三维动作定位性能。我们相信,本研究指明了第一人称视觉与三维场景理解交叉领域的一个充满前景的研究方向。
abstract_en: Given a video captured from a first person perspective and the environment context of where the video is recorded, can we recognize what the person is doing and identify where the action occurs in the 3D space? We address this challenging problem of jointly recognizing and localizing actions of a mobile user on a known 3D map from egocentric videos. To this end, we propose a novel deep probabilistic model. Our model takes the inputs of a Hierarchical Volumetric Representation (HVR) of the 3D environment and an egocentric video, infers the 3D action location as a latent variable, and recognizes the action based on the video and contextual cues surrounding its potential locations. To evaluate our model, we conduct extensive experiments on the subset of Ego4D dataset, in which both human naturalistic actions and photo-realistic 3D environment reconstructions are captured. Our method demonstrates strong results on both action recognition and 3D action localization across seen and unseen environments. We believe our work points to an exciting research direction in the intersection of egocentric vision, and 3D scene understanding.

title: Michael Kirchhof, Karsten Roth, Zeynep Akata, Enkelejda Kasneci
title_en: Michael Kirchhof, Karsten Roth, Zeynep Akata, Enkelejda Kasneci
abstract: 基于代理的深度度量学习(DML)通过在训练过程中将图像和类别代表(代理)嵌入到彼此接近的度量空间中来学习深度度量空间,通常通过它们之间的角度进行衡量。然而,这种方法忽略了嵌入的范数,而范数可能包含额外的有益上下文信息,例如类别或图像内在的不确定性。此外,基于代理的DML在学习类别内部结构方面存在困难。为同时解决这两个问题,我们引入了非各向同性概率基于代理的DML。我们将图像建模为超球面上的方向von Mises-Fisher(vMF)分布,并为类别代理提出了一种非各向同性von Mises-Fisher(nivMF)模型。这使得代理能够更好地表示嵌入空间中复杂的类别特定方差。为了将这些概率模型转化为代理到图像的度量,我们进一步开发并研究了多种分布到点和分布到分布的度量方法。每个框架选择都通过一组消融研究进行论证,展示了我们概率方法在基于代理的DML中的有益特性。这包括不确定性感知、训练期间更稳定的梯度以及整体更好的泛化性能。后者在标准DML基准测试中的竞争性表现中尤为明显。我们发现所提出的方法具有显著优势,表明现有的基于代理的DML可以通过更概率化的处理获得显著改进。
abstract_en: Proxy-based Deep Metric Learning (DML) learns deep metric spaces by embedding images and class representatives (proxies) close to one another during training, as commonly measured by the angle between them. However, this disregards the embedding norm, which can carry additional beneficial context such as class- or image-intrinsic uncertainty. In addition, proxy-based DML struggles to learn class-internal structures. To address both issues at once, we introduce non-isotropic probabilistic proxy-based DML. We model images as directional von Mises-Fisher (vMF) distributions on the hypersphere and motivate a non-isotropic von Mises-Fisher (nivMF) model for class proxies. This allows proxies to better represent complex class-specific variances in the embedding space. To cast these probabilistic models into proxy-to-image metrics, we further develop and investigate multiple distribution-to-point and distribution-to-distribution metrics. Each framework choice is motivated through a set of ablational studies, which showcase beneficial properties of our probabilistic approach to proxy-based DML. This comprises uncertainty-awareness, better behaved gradients during training and overall improved generalization performance. The latter is especially reflected in the competitive performance on the standard DML benchmarks. We find our proposed approach to compare favourably, suggesting that existing proxy-based DML can significantly benefit from a more probabilistic treatment.

title: Michaël Ramamonjisoa, Sinisa Stekovic, Vincent Lepetit
title_en: Michaël Ramamonjisoa, Sinisa Stekovic, Vincent Lepetit
abstract: 我们提出了MonteBoxFinder,一种方法,给定一个噪声点云输入,检测密集的不完美盒子集合,并采用离散优化算法高效探索所有盒子排列空间,以找到最适合点云的排列。我们的方法在ScanNet数据集上,无论是效率还是精度,都显著优于我们的离散优化基线。这是通过利用问题的结构,即立方体排列的拟合质量对立方体排列不变。最后,我们的解决方案搜索算法是通用的,因为它可以扩展到其他具有挑战性的离散优化场景。
abstract_en: We present MonteBoxFinder, a method that, given an noisy input point cloud, detects a dense set of imperfect boxes, and employs a discrete optimization algorithm that efficiently explores the space of allbox arrangements in order to find the arrangement that best fits the pointcloud. Our method demonstrates significant superiority of our method over our discrete optimization baselines on the ScanNet dataset, both inefficiency and precision. This is achieved by leveraging the structure of the problem, which is that the fit quality of a cuboid arrangement is invariant to cuboid permutation. Finally, our solution search algorithm is general, as it can be extended to other challenging discrete optimization scenarii.

title: Michał J. Tyszkiewicz, Kevis-Kokitsi Maninis, Stefan Popov, Vittorio Ferrari
title_en: Michał J. Tyszkiewicz, Kevis-Kokitsi Maninis, Stefan Popov, Vittorio Ferrari
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于Transformer的神经网络架构,用于从RGB视频中进行多目标三维重建。该架构通过两种替代方式表示其知识:作为全局三维特征网格和一个视图特定的二维网格数组。我们通过专用的双向注意力机制逐步在两者之间交换信息。我们利用对图像形成过程的知识,显著稀疏化注意力权重矩阵,使我们的架构在当前硬件上在内存和计算方面都具有可行性。我们在三维特征网格上附加一个DETR风格的头部,以检测场景中的物体并预测其三维姿态和三维形状。与之前的方法相比,我们的架构是单阶段、端到端可训练的,能够从多个视频帧对场景进行整体推理,而无需脆弱的跟踪步骤。我们在具有挑战性的Scan2CAD数据集上评估了我们的方法,在三维物体姿态估计方面优于(1)最近的RGB视频三维物体姿态估计的最先进方法;以及(2)结合多视角立体视觉与RGB-D CAD对齐的强替代方法。我们计划发布我们的源代码。
abstract_en: We propose a transformer-based neural network architecture for multi-object 3D reconstruction from RGB videos. It relies on two alternative ways to represent its knowledge: as a global 3D grid of features and an array of view-specific 2D grids. We progressively exchange information between the two with a dedicated bidirectional attention mechanism. We exploit knowledge about the image formation process to significantly sparsify the attention weight matrix, making our architecture feasible on current hardware, both in terms of memory and computation. We attach a DETR-style head on top of the 3D feature grid in order to detect the objects in the scene and to predict their 3D pose and 3D shape. Compared to previous methods, our architecture is single stage, end-to-end trainable, and it can reason holistically about a scene from multiple video frames without needing a brittle tracking step. We evaluate our method on the challenging Scan2CAD dataset, where we outperform (1) recent state-of-the-art methods for 3D object pose estimation from RGB videos; and (2) a strong alternative method combining Multi-view Stereo with RGB-D CAD alignment. We plan to release our source code.

title: Min Jin Chong, David Forsyth
title_en: Min Jin Chong, David Forsyth
abstract: 一种风格映射器会将其输入图像应用某种固定风格(例如,将人脸转换为卡通)。本文描述了一种简单流程——JoJoGAN——用于从单个风格示例学习风格映射器。JoJoGAN利用GAN反演过程和StyleGAN的风格混合属性,从单个示例风格生成大量配对数据集。随后使用该配对数据集对StyleGAN进行微调。通过GAN反演后接微调的StyleGAN,即可实现图像的风格映射。JoJoGAN仅需一个参考示例,训练时间短至30秒即可。JoJoGAN能够成功处理极端风格参考(如动物面孔)。此外,用户可控制使用风格的哪些方面以及应用程度。定性和定量评估表明,JoJoGAN生成的高质量高分辨率图像在当前最先进的方法上表现显著优于。
abstract_en: A style mapper applies some fixed style to its input images (so, for example, taking faces to cartoons). This paper describes a simple procedure -- JoJoGAN -- to learn a style mapper from a single example of the style. JoJoGAN uses a GAN inversion procedure and StyleGAN’s style-mixing property to produce a substantial paired dataset from a single example style. The paired dataset is then used to fine-tune a StyleGAN. An image can then be style mapped by GAN-inversion followed by the fine-tuned StyleGAN. JoJoGAN needs just one reference and as little as 30 seconds of training time. JoJoGAN can use extreme style references (say, animal faces) successfully. Furthermore, one can control what aspects of the style are used and how much of the style is applied. Qualitative and quantitative evaluation show that JoJoGAN produces high quality high resolution images that vastly outperform the current state-of-the-art.

title: Min Zhang, Siteng Huang, Wenbin Li, Donglin Wang
title_en: Min Zhang, Siteng Huang, Wenbin Li, Donglin Wang
abstract: 本文主要研究如何通过预训练任务(如旋转或颜色排列等)为少样本图像分类学习额外的特征表示。由预训练任务生成的额外知识可以进一步提升少样本学习(FSL)性能,因为其与人工标注的监督(即FSL任务的类别标签)存在差异。为解决该问题,我们提出了一种插件式层次化树结构感知(HTS)方法,该方法不仅学习FSL与预训练任务之间的关系,更重要的是能够自适应选择和聚合预训练任务生成的特征表示,以最大化FSL任务的性能。我们引入了层次化树构建组件和门控选择聚合组件,用于构建树结构并挖掘更丰富的可迁移知识,从而快速适应少量标注图像的新型类别。大量实验表明,我们的HTS方法能够显著增强多种少样本方法,在四个基准数据集上实现了新的最先进性能。代码已开源:https://github.com/remiMZ/HTS-ECCV22
abstract_en: In this paper, we mainly focus on the problem of how to learn additional feature representations for few-shot image classification through pretext tasks (e.g., rotation or color permutation and so on). This additional knowledge generated by pretext tasks can further improve the performance of few-shot learning (FSL) as it differs from human-annotated supervision (i.e., class labels of FSL tasks). To solve this problem, we present a plug-in Hierarchical Tree Structure-aware (HTS) method, which not only learns the relationship of FSL and pretext tasks, but more importantly, can adaptively select and aggregate feature representations generated by pretext tasks to maximize the performance of FSL tasks. A hierarchical tree constructing component and a gated selection aggregating component is introduced to construct the tree structure and find richer transferable knowledge that can rapidly adapt to novel classes with a few labeled images. Extensive experiments show that our HTS can significantly enhance multiple few-shot methods to achieve new state-of-the-art performance on four benchmark datasets. The code is available at: https://github.com/remiMZ/HTS-ECCV22.

title: Ming Li, Xueqian Jin, Xuejiao Hu, Jingzhao Dai, Sidan Du, Yang Li
title_en: Ming Li, Xueqian Jin, Xuejiao Hu, Jingzhao Dai, Sidan Du, Yang Li
abstract: 本文提出了一种基于多视角360度相机的两阶段全方位深度估计框架。该框架首先通过全方位立体匹配从不同相机对中估计深度图,随后融合深度图以增强对镜头污渍、水滴以及强光引起的反光的鲁棒性。我们采用球面特征学习来解决全景图的失真问题。此外,我们提出一个包含12,000张道路场景全景图和3,000张真实深度图的合成360度数据集,用于训练和评估360度深度估计算法。该数据集考虑了污损镜头和反光等现实场景因素,更贴近实际环境。实验结果表明,所提出的框架在合成环境和真实环境中均能生成可靠结果,并在不同数据集上实现了最先进性能。代码和数据可在https://github.com/nju-ee/MODE-2022获取。
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a two-stage omnidirectional depth estimation framework with multi-view 360-degree cameras. The framework first estimates the depth maps from different camera pairs via omnidirectional stereo matching and then fuses the depth maps to achieve robustness against mud spots, water drops on camera lenses, and glare caused by intense light. We adopt spherical feature learning to address the distortion of panoramas. In addition, a synthetic 360-degree dataset consisting of 12K road scene panoramas and 3K ground truth depth maps is presented to train and evaluate 360-degree depth estimation algorithms. Our dataset takes soiled camera lenses and glare into consideration, which is more consistent with the real-world environment. Experimental results show that the proposed framework generates reliable results in both synthetic and real-world environments, and it achieves state-of-the-art performance on different datasets. The code and data are available at https://github.com/nju-ee/MODE-2022

title: Ming-Yang Ho, Min-Sheng Wu, Che-Ming Wu
title_en: Ming-Yang Ho, Min-Sheng Wu, Che-Ming Wu
