By extensive experiments on three datasets for zero-shot fine-grained recognition, we show that our attacks outperform conventional universal classification attacks and transfer well between different recognition architectures.

title: Neehar Kondapaneni, Pietro Perona, Oisin Mac Aodha
title_en: Neehar Kondapaneni, Pietro Perona, Oisin Mac Aodha
abstract: 每年,成千上万的人学习新的视觉分类任务——放射科医生学习识别肿瘤,观鸟者学习区分相似物种,众包工作者学习如何标注有价值的数据以用于自动驾驶等应用。随着人类学习,其大脑会更新提取和关注的视觉特征,这最终影响其最终的分类决策。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新颖的任务,追踪人类学习者在进行具有挑战性的视觉分类任务时的分类行为演变。我们提出了一种模型,该模型联合提取学习者使用的视觉特征,并预测其使用的分类函数。我们从真实人类学习者处收集了三个具有挑战性的新数据集,以评估不同视觉知识追踪方法的性能。我们的结果表明,我们的循环模型能够预测人类学习者在三个具有挑战性的医学图像和物种识别任务中的分类行为。
abstract_en: Each year, thousands of people learn new visual categorization tasks - radiologists learn to recognize tumors, birdwatchers learn to distinguish similar species, and crowd workers learn how to annotate valuable data for applications like autonomous driving. As humans learn, their brain updates the visual features it extracts and attend to, which ultimately informs their final classification decisions. In this work, we propose a novel task of tracing the evolving classification behavior of human learners as they engage in challenging visual classification tasks. We propose models that jointly extract the visual features used by learners as well as predicting the classification functions they utilize. We collect three challenging new datasets from real human learners in order to evaluate the performance of different visual knowledge tracing methods. Our results show that our recurrent models are able to predict the classification behavior of human learners on three challenging medical image and species identification tasks.

title: Nicolas Dufour, David Picard, Vicky Kalogeiton
title_en: Nicolas Dufour, David Picard, Vicky Kalogeiton
abstract: 大量近期工作致力于语义条件图像生成。大多数方法聚焦于更狭窄的姿势迁移任务,而忽略了更具挑战性的主体迁移任务,后者不仅需要迁移姿势,还需同时迁移外观和背景。本文提出SCAM(语义交叉注意力调制)系统,该系统在图像的每个语义区域(包括前景和背景)中编码丰富多样的信息,从而实现精确生成并强调细节。这得益于语义注意力Transformer编码器,该编码器为每个语义区域提取多个潜在向量,以及相应的生成器,该生成器通过使用语义交叉注意力调制来利用这些多潜在向量。该系统仅使用重建设置进行训练,而主体迁移在测试时执行。我们的分析表明,所提出的架构能够有效编码每个语义区域的外观多样性。在iDesigner、CelebAMask-HD和ADE20K数据集上的大量实验表明,SCAM优于竞争方法;此外,它在主体迁移任务上设立了新的技术标杆。
abstract_en: A large body of recent work targets semantically conditioned image generation. Most such methods focus on the narrower task of pose transfer and ignore the more challenging task of subject transfer that consists in not only transferring the pose but also the appearance and background. In this work, we introduce SCAM (Semantic Cross Attention Modulation), a system that encodes rich and diverse information in each semantic region of the image (including foreground and background), thus achieving precise generation with emphasis on fine details. This is enabled by the Semantic Attention Transformer Encoder that extracts multiple latent vectors for each semantic region, and the corresponding generator that exploits these multiple latents by using semantic cross attention modulation. It is trained only using a reconstruction setup, while subject transfer is performed at test time. Our analysis shows that our proposed architecture is successful at encoding the diversity of appearance in each semantic region. Extensive experiments on the iDesigner, CelebAMask-HD and ADE20K datasets show that SCAM outperforms competing approaches; moreover, it sets the new state of the art on subject transfer.

title: Nikhil Reddy, Abhinav Singhal, Abhishek Kumar, Mahsa Baktashmotlagh, Chetan Arora
title_en: Nikhil Reddy, Abhinav Singhal, Abhishek Kumar, Mahsa Baktashmotlagh, Chetan Arora
abstract: 用于自主导航的计算机视觉系统必须在现实世界中预期的恶劣天气和光照条件下具有良好泛化能力。然而,当前最先进的(\sota)方法在白天图像上训练后,对在这些条件下捕获的图像进行语义分割仍是一项具有挑战性的任务,这是由于相关的分布偏移。另一方面,为实现该目的开发的领域自适应技术依赖于源数据、(无标签)目标数据及其辅助信息(例如 \gps)的可用性。即使如此,它们通常仅适应单一(特定)目标领域。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的、完全在测试时进行的自适应技术,名为 \textit{Master of ALL} (\mall),用于同时泛化到多个目标领域。\mall 在推理阶段直接学习从多个目标领域的未见过的恶劣天气图像中进行泛化。更具体地说,给定一个预训练模型及其参数,\mall 在推理阶段强制执行边缘一致性先验,并根据(a)单个测试样本(\malls)或(b)整个测试领域连续更新模型(\malld)。不仅不需要目标数据,\mall 也不需要访问源数据,因此可以与任何预训练模型结合使用。使用一个简单的在白天图像上预训练的模型,\mall 在领域泛化和测试时自适应设置中均优于专门设计的恶劣天气语义分割方法。我们在雾、雪、夜间、多云、阴天和雨天等条件下的实验验证了我们方法的目标领域无关的有效性。我们进一步表明,即使模型已经针对特定恶劣天气条件进行了预训练,\mall 仍能提升其在恶劣天气条件下的性能。
abstract_en: Computer vision systems for autonomous navigation must generalize well in adverse weather and illumination conditions expected in the real world. However, semantic segmentation of images captured in such conditions remains a challenging task for current state-of-the-art (\sota) methods trained on broad daylight images, due to the associated distribution shift. On the other hand, domain adaptation techniques developed for the purpose rely on the availability of the source data, (un)labeled target data and/or its auxiliary information (e.g., \gps). Even then, they typically adapt to a single(specific) target domain(s). To remedy this, we propose a novel, fully test time, adaptation technique, named \textit{Master of ALL} (\mall), for simultaneous generalization to multiple target domains. \mall learns to generalize on unseen adverse weather images from multiple target domains directly at the inference time. More specifically, given a pre-trained model and its parameters, \mall enforces edge consistency prior at the inference stage and updates the model based on (a) a single test sample at a time (\malls), or (b) continuously for the whole test domain (\malld). Not only the target data, \mall also does not need access to the source data and thus, can be used with any pre-trained model. Using a simple model pre-trained on daylight images, \mall outperforms specially designed adverse weather semantic segmentation methods, both in domain generalization and test-time adaptation settings. Our experiments on foggy, snow, night, cloudy, overcast, and rainy conditions demonstrate the target domain-agnostic effectiveness of our approach. We further show that \mall can improve the performance of a model on an adverse weather condition, even when the model is already pre-trained for the specific condition.

title: Nikita Dvornik, Isma Hadji, Hai Pham, Dhaivat Bhatt, Brais Martinez, Afsaneh Fazly, Allan D. Jepson
title_en: Nikita Dvornik, Isma Hadji, Hai Pham, Dhaivat Bhatt, Brais Martinez, Afsaneh Fazly, Allan D. Jepson
abstract: 本文研究了教学视频中弱监督多步骤定位问题。现有方法通常依赖于给定的步骤列表,但在实际中,成功执行程序往往可以通过略微不同的步骤顺序实现。因此,为实现视频中的有效定位,近期工作需要在训练和测试阶段由人工标注者提供视频中步骤的实际顺序。相反,本文仅依赖于通用的程序文本,且不与特定视频绑定。我们通过将指令列表转换为过程流图来表示完成程序的各种方式,该流图捕捉了步骤的偏序关系。使用流图可降低训练和测试阶段的标注需求。为此,我们引入了新的问题——流图到视频定位。在此设置中,我们寻求与过程流图和给定视频一致的最优步骤顺序。为解决该问题,我们提出了一种新算法——Graph2Vid,该算法可推断视频中步骤的实际顺序并同时进行定位。为验证所提方法的优势,我们扩展了CrossTask数据集以包含过程流图信息。实验表明,Graph2Vid在无需步骤顺序标注的情况下,既比基线方法更高效,又实现了强大的步骤定位结果。
abstract_en: In this work, we consider the problem of weakly-supervised multi-step localization in instructional videos. An established approach to this problem is to rely on a given list of steps. However, in reality, there is often more than one way to execute a procedure successfully, by following the set of steps in slightly varying orders. Thus, for successful localization in a given video, recent works require the actual order of procedure steps in the video, to be provided by human annotators at both training and test times. Instead, here, we only rely on generic procedural text that is not tied to a specific video. We represent the various ways to complete the procedure by transforming the list of instructions into a procedure flow graph which captures the partial order of steps. Using the flow graphs reduces both training and test time annotation requirements. To this end, we introduce the new problem of flow graph to video grounding. In this setup, we seek the optimal step ordering consistent with the procedure flow graph and a given video. To solve this problem, we propose a new algorithm - Graph2Vid - that infers the actual ordering of steps in the video and simultaneously localizes them. To show the advantage of our proposed formulation, we extend the CrossTask dataset with procedure flow graph information. Our experiments show that Graph2Vid is both more efficient than the baselines and yields strong step localization results, without the need for step order annotation.

title: Niklas Hanselmann, Katrin Renz, Kashyap Chitta, Apratim Bhattacharyya, Andreas Geiger
title_en: Niklas Hanselmann, Katrin Renz, Kashyap Chitta, Apratim Bhattacharyya, Andreas Geiger
abstract: 模拟器为自动驾驶系统的安全、低成本开发提供了可能性。然而,当前的驾驶模拟器对背景交通的模型行为较为简单。通常通过手动调整场景来诱导安全关键性情况。另一种方法是对背景交通轨迹进行对抗性扰动。本文研究了使用CARLA模拟器进行安全关键性驾驶场景生成的这一方法。我们使用运动学自行车模型作为模拟器真实动力学的代理,并观察到通过该代理模型的梯度足以优化背景交通轨迹。基于这一发现,我们提出了KING方法,其生成安全关键性驾驶场景的成功率比黑盒优化高20%。通过使用特权规则基础专家算法解决KING生成的场景,我们获得了用于模仿学习策略的训练数据。在对该新数据进行微调后,我们展示了策略在避免碰撞方面表现更优。重要的是,我们生成的数据在KING生成的测试场景以及传统手工制作的场景中均减少了碰撞,证明了改进的鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Simulators offer the possibility of safe, low-cost development of self-driving systems. However, current driving simulators exhibit naïve behavior models for background traffic. Hand-tuned scenarios are typically added during simulation to induce safety-critical situations. An alternative approach is to adversarially perturb the background traffic trajectories. In this paper, we study this approach to safety-critical driving scenario generation using the CARLA simulator. We use a kinematic bicycle model as a proxy to the simulator’s true dynamics and observe that gradients through this proxy model are sufficient for optimizing the background traffic trajectories. Based on this finding, we propose KING, which generates safety-critical driving scenarios with a 20% higher success rate than black-box optimization. By solving the scenarios generated by KING using a privileged rule-based expert algorithm, we obtain training data for an imitation learning policy. After fine-tuning on this new data, we show that the policy becomes better at avoiding collisions. Importantly, our generated data leads to reduced collisions on both held-out scenarios generated via KING as well as traditional hand-crafted scenarios, demonstrating improved robustness.

title: Nikolas Lamb, Sean Banerjee, Natasha Kholgade Banerjee
title_en: Nikolas Lamb, Sean Banerjee, Natasha Kholgade Banerjee
abstract: 我们提出DeepMend,一种利用学习到的占据函数重建破碎形状修复的新方法。现有形状修复方法预测低分辨率体素化修复或平滑修复,或需要对称性或访问预先存在的完整参考模型。我们将破碎形状的占据情况表示为底层完整形状和断裂表面占据情况的结合,其中断裂表面通过神经网络建模为潜在编码的函数。给定破碎形状的占据样本,我们通过添加新颖的惩罚项增强推理损失来估计潜在编码,以避免空洞或体积过大的修复。我们使用估计的编码重建修复形状。我们在合成和真实世界扫描物体上的模拟断裂以及扫描的真实破碎杯子上展示了结果。与现有方法和两种基线方法相比,我们的工作在破碎形状非断裂区域的准确性及避免修复伪影方面取得了最先进的结果。
abstract_en: We present DeepMend, a novel approach to reconstruct restorations to fractured shapes using learned occupancy functions. Existing shape repair approaches predict low-resolution voxelized restorations or smooth restorations, or require symmetries or access to a pre-existing complete oracle. We represent the occupancy of a fractured shape as the conjunction of the occupancy of an underlying complete shape and a break surface, which we model as functions of latent codes using neural networks. Given occupancy samples from a fractured shape, we estimate latent codes using an inference loss augmented with novel penalties to avoid empty or voluminous restorations. We use the estimated codes to reconstruct a restoration shape. We show results with simulated fractures on synthetic and real-world scanned objects, and with scanned real fractured mugs. Compared to existing approaches and to two baseline methods, our work shows state-of-the-art results in accuracy and avoiding restoration artifacts over non-fracture regions of the fractured shape.

title: Nilesh Kulkarni, Justin Johnson, David F. Fouhey
title_en: Nilesh Kulkarni, Justin Johnson, David F. Fouhey
abstract: We present an approach for full 3D scene reconstruction from a single new image that can be trained on realistic non-watertight scans. Our approach uses a predicted distance function, since these have shown promise in handling complex topologies and large spaces. We identify and analyze two key challenges for predicting these implicit functions from an image that have prevented their success on 3D scenes from a single image. First, we show that predicting a conventional scene distance from an image requires reasoning over a large receptive field. Second, we analytically show that the optimal output of a network that predicts these distance functions is often not a distance function. We propose an alternate approach, the Direct Ray Distance Function (DRDF), that avoids both challenges. We show that a deep network trained to predict DRDFs outperforms all other methods quantitatively and qualitatively on 3D reconstruction on Matterport3D, 3DFront, and ScanNet
abstract_en: We present an approach for full 3D scene reconstruction from a single new image that can be trained on realistic non-watertight scans. Our approach uses a predicted distance function, since these have shown promise in handling complex topologies and large spaces. We identify and analyze two key challenges for predicting these implicit functions from an image that have prevented their success on 3D scenes from a single image. First, we show that predicting a conventional scene distance from an image requires reasoning over a large receptive field. Second, we analytically show that the optimal output of a network that predicts these distance functions is often not a distance function. We propose an alternate approach, the Direct Ray Distance Function (DRDF), that avoids both challenges. We show that a deep network trained to predict DRDFs outperforms all other methods quantitatively and qualitatively on 3D reconstruction on Matterport3D, 3DFront, and ScanNet

title: 基于莫比乌斯变换的图卷积网络在3D人体姿态估计中的应用
title_en: Niloofar Azizi, Horst Possegger, Emanuele Rodolà, Horst Bischof
abstract: 3D人体姿态估计是理解人类行为的基础。最近,图卷积网络(GCNs)在该领域取得了有希望的结果,实现了最先进的性能并提供了较为轻量的架构。然而,GCNs的主要局限性在于无法显式编码所有关节间的变换。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的谱图卷积网络,利用莫比乌斯变换(MöbiusGCN)。特别是,这使我们能够直接且显式地编码关节间的变换,从而获得显著更紧凑的表示。与迄今为止最轻量的架构相比,我们的新方法所需参数减少了90-98%,即我们最轻量的MöbiusGCN仅使用0.042M可训练参数。除了参数的大幅减少外,显式编码关节变换还使我们能够实现最先进的结果。我们在两个具有挑战性的姿态估计基准Human3.6M和MPI-INF-3DHP上评估了我们的方法,展示了MöbiusGCN的最先进结果和泛化能力。
abstract_en: 3D human pose estimation is fundamental to understanding human behavior. Recently, promising results have been achieved by graph convolutional networks(GCNs), which achieve state-of-the-art performance and provide rather light-weight architectures. However, a major limitation of GCNs is their inability to encode all the transformations between joints explicitly. To address this issue, we propose a novel spectral GCN using the MÃ¶bius transformation (MÃ¶biusGCN). In particular, this allows us to directly and explicitly encode the transformation between joints, resulting in a significantly more compact representation. Compared to even the lightest architectures so far, our novel approach requires 90-98% fewer parameters, i.e. our lightest MÃ¶biusGCN uses only 0.042M trainable parameters. Besides the drastic parameter reduction, explicitly encoding the transformation of joints also enables us to achieve state-of-the-art results. We evaluate our approach on the two challenging pose estimation benchmarks, Human3.6M and MPI-INF-3DHP, demonstrating both state-of-the-art results and the generalization capabilities of MÃ¶biusGCN.

title: Ning Ma, Hongyi Zhang, Xuhui Li, Sheng Zhou, Zhen Zhang, Jun Wen, Haifeng Li, Jingjun Gu, Jiajun Bu
title_en: Ning Ma, Hongyi Zhang, Xuhui Li, Sheng Zhou, Zhen Zhang, Jun Wen, Haifeng Li, Jingjun Gu, Jiajun Bu
abstract: 少样本动作识别旨在识别少量标注的新动作类别,因其实际意义而受到越来越多的关注。人体骨架通过显式建模骨架关节间的时空关系,为该问题提供了可解释且数据高效的表示。然而,现有的基于骨架的空间-时间模型往往导致关节位置可区分性下降,从而引发模糊的空间匹配和较差的可解释性。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新颖的空间匹配策略,包括空间解耦和空间激活。空间解耦的动机在于我们发现为叶节点(例如“手”关节)提供更多的空间信息有助于增加骨架匹配的表示多样性。为实现空间解耦,我们通过秩最大化约束鼓励骨架在满秩空间中进行表示。最后,引入基于注意力的空间激活机制,通过根据匹配对自适应调整解耦关节,将解耦效果融入其中。在三个骨架基准数据集上的大量实验表明,所提出的空间匹配策略可以有效嵌入到现有时间对齐框架中,实现显著的性能提升以及内在的可解释性。
abstract_en: Few-shot action recognition aims to recognize few-labeled novel action classes and attracts growing attentions due to practical significance. Human skeletons provide explainable and data-efficient representation for this problem by explicitly modeling spatial-temporal relations among skeleton joints. However, existing skeleton-based spatial-temporal models tend to deteriorate the positional distinguishability of joints, which leads to fuzzy spatial matching and poor explainability. To address these issues, we propose a novel spatial matching strategy consisting of spatial disentanglement and spatial activation. The motivation behind spatial disentanglement is that we find more spatial information for leaf nodes (e.g., the “hand” joint ) is beneficial to increase representation diversity for skeleton matching. To achieve spatial disentanglement, we encourage the skeletons to be represented in a full rank space with rank maximization constraint. Finally, an attention based spatial activation mechanism is introduced to incorporate the disentanglement, by adaptively adjusting the disentangled joints according to matching pairs. Extensive experiments on three skeleton benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed spatial matching strategy can be effectively inserted into existing temporal alignment frameworks, achieving considerable performance improvements as well as inherent explainability.

title: Nir Shaul, Yoav Y. Schechner
title_en: Nir Shaul, Yoav Y. Schechner
abstract: 发达地区拥有大量的人工光源。与星星类似,它们似乎会闪烁,即发生散射现象。这种现象是由随机湍流引起的。我们利用这一现象来重建湍流强度(TS)的空间分布。传感过程是被动的,使用城市尺度的多视角相机系统。相机感知场景中光源的散射信号。该散射信号具有一个线积分的线性模型,积分范围为湍流强度场。因此,通过线性断层扫描分析可恢复湍流强度。散射提供了比基于入射角(投影畸变)统计的断层扫描更具信息量的测量和湍流强度恢复。我们介绍了该方法的背景和理论。随后,我们描述了一个大规模实验,使用分布式成像设备来验证这一理念。据我们所知,这是首次提出利用被动光学散射测量重建湍流强度水平场的工作。
abstract_en: Developed areas have plenty of artificial light sources. As the stars, they appear to twinkle, i.e., scintillate. This effect is caused by random turbulence. We leverage this phenomenon in order to reconstruct the spatial distribution the turbulence strength (TS). Sensing is passive, using a multi-view camera setup in a city scale. The cameras sense the scintillation of light sources in the scene. The scintillation signal has a linear model of a line integral over the field of TS. Thus, the TS is recovered by linear tomography analysis. Scintillation offers measurements and TS recovery, which are more informative than tomography based on angle-of-arrival (projection distortion) statistics. We present the background and theory of the method. Then, we describe a large field experiment to demonstrate this idea, using distributed imagers. As far as we know, this work is the first to propose reconstruction of a TS horizontal field, using passive optical scintillation measurements.

title: Niv Cohen, Rinon Gal, Eli A. Meirom, Gal Chechik, Yuval Atzmon
title_en: Niv Cohen, Rinon Gal, Eli A. Meirom, Gal Chechik, Yuval Atzmon
abstract: 基于大规模网络数据预训练的大型视觉与语言模型提供了对众多视觉与语言问题极具价值的表示。然而,尚不清楚如何将这些模型扩展以推理用户特定的视觉概念,这些概念以非结构化语言形式存在。这一问题出现在多个领域,从个性化图像检索到与智能设备的个性化交互。我们引入了一种新的学习设置,称为个性化视觉与语言(PerVL),并提供了两个新的基准数据集,用于在自然场景中检索和分割用户特定(“个性化”)概念。在PerVL中,应学习个性化概念(1)独立于下游任务(2)允许预训练模型使用自由语言进行推理,以及(3)无需提供个性化负例。我们提出了一种解决PerVL的架构,该架构通过向预训练模型的输入词汇表中添加个性化概念的新词嵌入来运行。模型随后可以简单地将它们作为句子的一部分使用。我们证明,我们的方法可以从少量示例中学习个性化视觉概念,并在使用丰富文本查询的图像检索和语义分割中有效应用它们。例如,该模型相比最强基线,将MRR提高了51.1%(28.4% vs 18.8%)。
abstract_en: Large Vision & Language models pretrained on web-scale data provide representations that are invaluable for numerous V&L problems. However, it is unclear how they can be extended to reason about user-specific visual concepts in unstructured language. This problem arises in multiple domains, from personalized image retrieval to personalized interaction with smart devices. We introduce a new learning setup called Personalized Vision & Language (PerVL) with two new benchmark datasets for retrieving and segmenting user-specific (""""personalized"""") concepts “in the wild"""". In PerVL, one should learn personalized concepts (1) independently of the downstream task (2) allowing a pretrained model to reason about them with free language, and (3) without providing personalized negative examples. We propose an architecture for solving PerVL that operates by expanding the input vocabulary of a pretrained model with new word embeddings for the personalized concepts. The model can then simply employ them as part of a sentence. We demonstrate that our approach learns personalized visual concepts from a few examples and effectively applies them in image retrieval and semantic segmentation using rich textual queries. For example the model improves MRR by 51.1% (28.4% vs 18.8%) compared to the strongest baseline.

title: Niv Haim, Ben Feinstein, Niv Granot, Assaf Shocher, Shai Bagon, Tali Dekel, Michal Irani
title_en: Niv Haim, Ben Feinstein, Niv Granot, Assaf Shocher, Shai Bagon, Tali Dekel, Michal Irani
abstract: 生成对抗网络(GANs)能够执行基于单个视频的生成和操作任务,但这些单视频GANs在单个视频上的训练时间要求不合理,使其几乎不切实际。本文我们质疑从单个视频生成任务中使用GAN的必要性,并引入了一种适用于多种生成和操作任务的非参数基线方法。我们复兴了经典的空间-时间块最近邻方法,并将其适应为可扩展的无条件生成模型,无需任何学习过程。这种简单的基线方法在视觉质量和真实感方面意外地优于单视频GANs(通过定量和定性评估验证),并且运行速度显著提升(训练时间从数天缩短至数秒)。除了多样化的视频生成,我们还利用相同框架展示了其他应用,包括视频类比和时空重定向。我们提出的方法可轻松扩展至全高清视频。这些观察结果表明,如果正确适配,经典方法在这些任务中显著优于复杂的深度学习架构。这为单视频生成和操作任务设定了新的基线,并且更重要的是,首次使从单个视频进行多样化生成成为实际可能。
abstract_en: GANs are able to perform generation and manipulation tasks, trained on a single video. However, these single video GANs require unreasonable amount of time to train on a single video, rendering them almost impractical. In this paper we question the necessity of a GAN for generation from a single video, and introduce a non-parametric baseline for a variety of generation and manipulation tasks. We revive classical space-time patches-nearest-neighbors approaches and adapt them to a scalable unconditional generative model, without any learning. This simple baseline surprisingly outperforms single-video GANs in visual quality and realism (confirmed by quantitative and qualitative evaluations), and is disproportionately faster (runtime reduced from several days to seconds). Other than diverse video generation, we demonstrate other applications using the same framework, including video analogies and spatio-temporal retargeting. Our proposed approach is easily scaled to Full-HD videos. These observations show that the classical approaches, if adapted correctly, significantly outperform heavy deep learning machinery for these tasks. This sets a new baseline for single-video generation and manipulation tasks, and no less important -- makes diverse generation from a single video practically possible for the first time.

title: Nobuhiko Wakai, Satoshi Sato, Yasunori Ishii, Takayoshi Yamashita
title_en: Nobuhiko Wakai, Satoshi Sato, Yasunori Ishii, Takayoshi Yamashita
abstract: 尽管近年来基于学习的校准方法可以从单张图像预测外参和内参相机参数,但这些方法在鱼眼图像中的准确性会下降。这种下降是由于实际投影与预期投影之间的不匹配。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种通用相机模型,该模型有望解决各种类型的畸变。我们的通用相机模型通过相机投影的闭式数值计算被用于基于学习的方法。同时,为了恢复旋转和鱼眼畸变,我们提出了一种使用相机模型的基于学习的校准方法。此外,我们还提出了一种损失函数,以减轻四个外参和内参相机参数的误差幅度偏差。大量实验表明,我们的方法在两个大规模数据集和使用现成鱼眼相机拍摄的图像上均优于传统方法。此外,我们是首批研究人员之一,使用各种类型的投影分析了基于学习的方法在现成相机上的性能。
abstract_en: Although recent learning-based calibration methods can predict extrinsic and intrinsic camera parameters from a single image, the accuracy of these methods is degraded in fisheye images. This degradation is caused by mismatching between the actual projection and expected projection. To address this problem, we propose a generic camera model that has the potential to address various types of distortion. Our generic camera model is utilized for learning-based methods through a closed-form numerical calculation of the camera projection. Simultaneously to recover rotation and fisheye distortion, we propose a learning-based calibration method that uses the camera model. Furthermore, we propose a loss function that alleviates the bias of the magnitude of errors for four extrinsic and intrinsic camera parameters. Extensive experiments demonstrated that our proposed method outperformed conventional methods on two large-scale datasets and images captured by off-the-shelf fisheye cameras. Moreover, we are the first researchers to analyze the performance of learning-based methods using various types of projection for off-the-shelf cameras.

title: Norman Mu, Alexander Kirillov, David Wagner, Saining Xie
title_en: Norman Mu, Alexander Kirillov, David Wagner, Saining Xie
abstract: 近期研究表明,自监督预训练在具有挑战性的视觉识别任务中优于监督学习。CLIP作为一种通过语言监督进行学习的新方法,在多种基准测试中表现出色。在本工作中,我们探讨自监督学习是否能辅助语言监督在视觉表示学习中的应用,特别是在视觉Transformer中。我们引入了SLIP,这是一种结合自监督学习和CLIP预训练的多任务学习框架。预训练后,我们全面评估表示质量,并在三种不同设置下与CLIP和自监督学习进行性能比较:零样本迁移、线性分类和端到端微调。在ImageNet和多个附加数据集上,我们发现SLIP的准确率大幅提升。我们通过在不同模型规模、训练计划和预训练数据集上的实验进一步验证了这些结果。我们的发现表明,SLIP兼具两者的优势:相比自监督学习(+8.1%线性准确率)和语言监督(+5.2%零样本准确率)均表现出更优性能。我们的代码可在:github.com/facebookresearch/SLIP 获取。
abstract_en: Recent work has shown that self-supervised pre-training leads to improvements over supervised learning on challenging visual recognition tasks. CLIP, an exciting new approach to learning with language supervision, demonstrates promising performance on a wide variety of benchmarks. In this work, we explore whether self-supervised learning can aid in the use of language supervision for visual representation learning with Vision Transformers. We introduce SLIP, a multi-task learning framework for combining self-supervised learning and CLIP pre-training. After pre-training, we thoroughly evaluate representation quality and compare performance to both CLIP and self-supervised learning under three distinct settings: zero-shot transfer, linear classification, and end-to-end finetuning. Across ImageNet and a battery of additional datasets, we find that SLIP improves accuracy by a large margin. We validate our results further with experiments on different model sizes, training schedules, and pre-training datasets. Our findings show that SLIP enjoys the best of both worlds: better performance than self-supervision (+8.1% linear accuracy) and language supervision (+5.2% zero-shot accuracy). Our code is available at: github.com/facebookresearch/SLIP.

title: Oindrila Saha, Zezhou Cheng, Subhransu Maji
title_en: Oindrila Saha, Zezhou Cheng, Subhransu Maji
abstract: 在深度网络部分分割训练中,获取详细注释的成本是一个显著瓶颈。我们提出一个框架,利用前景-背景掩码和关键点位置等粗粒度标签来改进部分分割模型。关键挑战在于这些标注来自不同任务且标注风格各异,无法直接映射到部分标签。为此,我们提出联合学习标注风格与部分分割模型之间的依赖关系,从而利用多样化标签的监督信息。为评估我们的方法,我们在Caltech-UCSD鸟类和OID飞机数据集上构建了基准测试。我们的方法在基于多任务学习、半监督学习以及依赖手动设计损失函数的稀疏监督方法的基线模型上均取得更好性能。
abstract_en: A significant bottleneck in training deep networks for part segmentation is the cost of obtaining detailed annotations. We propose a framework to exploit coarse labels such as figure-ground masks and keypoint locations that are readily available for some categories to improve part segmentation models. A key challenge is that these annotations were collected for different tasks and with different labeling styles and cannot be readily mapped to the part labels. To this end, we propose to jointly learn the dependencies between labeling styles and the part segmentation model, allowing us to utilize supervision from diverse labels. To evaluate our approach we develop a benchmark on the Caltech-UCSD birds and OID Aircraft dataset. Our approach outperforms baselines based on multi-task learning, semi-supervised learning, and competitive methods relying on loss functions manually designed to exploit sparse-supervision.

title: Olivier J. Hénaff, Skanda Koppula, Evan Shelhamer, Daniel Zoran, Andrew Jaegle, Andrew Zisserman, João Carreira, Relja Arandjelović
title_en: Olivier J. Hénaff, Skanda Koppula, Evan Shelhamer, Daniel Zoran, Andrew Jaegle, Andrew Zisserman, João Carreira, Relja Arandjelović
abstract: 自监督学习(SSL)的前景在于利用大量未标记数据解决复杂任务。尽管在简单的图像级学习方面取得了显著进展,但最近的方法表明,包含图像结构知识具有优势。然而,通过引入手工制作的图像分割来定义感兴趣区域,或采用专门的增强策略,这些方法牺牲了使SSL如此强大的简单性和通用性。相反,我们提出了一种自监督学习范式,该范式能够自行发现这种图像结构。我们的方法Odin将目标发现与表示网络结合,无需监督即可发现有意义的图像分割。由此产生的学习范式更简单、更鲁棒且更具通用性,在COCO数据集上的目标检测和实例分割,以及在PASCAL和Cityscapes数据集上的语义分割中实现了最先进的迁移学习结果,同时在DAVIS数据集上的视频分割任务中显著超越了监督预训练。
abstract_en: The promise of self-supervised learning (SSL) is to leverage large amounts of unlabeled data to solve complex tasks. While there has been excellent progress with simple, image-level learning, recent methods have shown the advantage of including knowledge of image structure. However, by introducing hand-crafted image segmentations to define regions of interest, or specialized augmentation strategies, these methods sacrifice the simplicity and generality that makes SSL so powerful. Instead, we propose a self-supervised learning paradigm that discovers this image structure by itself. Our method, Odin, couples object discovery and representation networks to discover meaningful image segmentations without any supervision. The resulting learning paradigm is simpler, less brittle, and more general, and achieves state-of-the-art transfer learning results for object detection and instance segmentation on COCO, and semantic segmentation on PASCAL and Cityscapes, while strongly surpassing supervised pre-training for video segmentation on DAVIS.

title: Omer Bar-Tal, Dolev Ofri-Amar, Rafail Fridman, Yoni Kasten, Tali Dekel
title_en: Omer Bar-Tal, Dolev Ofri-Amar, Rafail Fridman, Yoni Kasten, Tali Dekel
abstract: 我们提出了一种用于自然图像和视频的零样本、文本驱动编辑方法。给定一张图像或视频以及一个文本提示,我们的目标是以语义方式编辑现有物体的外观(例如纹理)或在场景中添加视觉效果(例如烟雾、火焰)。我们基于一个从单个输入中提取的内部数据集训练生成器,同时利用外部预训练的CLIP模型施加我们的损失函数。与直接生成编辑输出不同,我们的核心思想是生成一个编辑层(颜色+透明度),并将其叠加在输入上。这使我们能够通过直接应用于编辑层的新型文本驱动损失函数控制生成过程,并保持对输入的高保真度。我们的方法既不依赖预训练生成器,也不需要用户提供的掩码。我们在多种物体和场景的高分辨率图像和视频上展示了局部化的语义编辑。
abstract_en: We present a method for zero-shot, text-driven editing of natural images and videos. Given an image or a video and a text prompt, our goal is to edit the appearance of existing objects (e.g., texture) or augment the scene with visual effects (e.g., smoke, fire) in a semantic manner. We train a generator on an \emph{internal dataset}, extracted from a single input, while leveraging an \emph{external} pretrained CLIP model to impose our losses. Rather than directly generating the edited output, our key idea is to generate an \emph{edit layer} (color+opacity) that is composited over the input. This allows us to control the generation and maintain high fidelity to the input via novel text-driven losses applied directly to the edit layer. Our method neither relies on a pretrained generator nor requires user-provided masks. We demonstrate localized, semantic edits on high-resolution images and videos across a variety of objects and scenes.

title: Omkar Thawakar, Sanath Narayan, Jiale Cao, Hisham Cholakkal, Rao Muhammad Anwer, Muhammad Haris Khan, Salman Khan, Michael Felsberg, Fahad Shahbaz Khan
title_en: Omkar Thawakar, Sanath Narayan, Jiale Cao, Hisham Cholakkal, Rao Muhammad Anwer, Muhammad Haris Khan, Salman Khan, Michael Felsberg, Fahad Shahbaz Khan
abstract: 当前最先进的基于Transformer的视频实例分割(VIS)方法通常在注意力计算中仅使用单尺度时空特征或逐帧多尺度特征。我们认为这种注意力计算忽略了处理视频中目标外观形变所必需的多尺度时空特征关系。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种基于Transformer的VIS框架,命名为MS-STS VIS,其编码器包含一个新颖的多尺度时空分割(MS-STS)注意力模块。所提出的MS-STS模块能够有效捕捉视频中多帧间不同尺度的时空特征关系。我们进一步在解码器中引入了注意力块,以增强视频不同帧中检测实例的时间一致性。此外,在训练过程中引入了一个辅助判别器,以确保在多尺度时空特征空间中更好的前景-背景分离。我们在两个基准数据集(Youtube-VIS 2019和2021)上进行了大量实验。我们的MS-STS VIS在两个基准数据集上均取得了最先进的性能。当使用ResNet50主干网络时,我们的MS-STS在Youtube-VIS 2019验证集上实现了50.1%的mask AP,分别比文献中最佳结果高出2.7%和4.8%(在AP75高重叠阈值下),同时在模型大小和速度上与之相当。当使用Swin Transformer主干网络时,MS-STS VIS在Youtube-VIS 2019验证集上实现了61.0%的mask AP。我们的代码和模型将公开发布。
abstract_en: State-of-the-art transformer-based video instance segmentation (VIS) approaches typically utilize either single-scale spatio-temporal features or per-frame multi-scale features during the attention computations. We argue that such an attention computation ignores the multi-scale spatio-temporal feature relationships that are crucial to tackle target appearance deformations in videos. To address this issue, we propose a transformer-based VIS framework, named MS-STS VIS, that comprises a novel multi-scale spatio-temporal split (MS-STS) attention module in the encoder. The proposed MS-STS module effectively captures spatio-temporal feature relationships at multiple scales across frames in a video. We further introduce an attention block in the decoder to enhance the temporal consistency of the detected instances in different frames of a video. Moreover, an auxiliary discriminator is introduced during training to ensure better foreground-background separability within the multi-scale spatio-temporal feature space. We conduct extensive experiments on two benchmarks: Youtube-VIS (2019 and 2021). Our MS-STS VIS achieves state-of-the-art performance on both benchmarks. When using the ResNet50 backbone, our MS-STS achieves a mask AP of 50.1%, outperforming the best reported results in literature by 2.7% and by 4.8% at higher overlap threshold of AP75, while being comparable in model size and speed on Youtube-VIS 2019 val. set. When using the Swin Transformer backbone, MS-STS VIS achieves mask AP of 61.0% on Youtube-VIS 2019 val. set. Our code and models will be made public.

title: Omri Avrahami, Dani Lischinski, Ohad Fried
title_en: Omri Avrahami, Dani Lischinski, Ohad Fried
abstract: 当前的生成模型能够合成高保真图像,但每个模型都专门针对特定的目标领域。这提出了模型融合的需求:将两个或多个预训练生成模型合并为一个统一的模型。在本工作中,我们解决了模型融合问题,考虑了两个在现实世界中常见的约束条件:(1) 无法访问原始训练数据,(2) 不增加神经网络的规模。据我们所知,目前尚未有研究在这些约束条件下进行模型融合。我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段解决方案。在第一阶段,我们通过一种称为模型根化的技术,将所有模型的权重转换到相同的参数空间。在第二阶段,我们通过平均权重并针对每个特定领域进行微调,将根化后的模型进行合并,仅使用原始训练模型生成的数据。我们证明了我们的方法优于基线方法和现有的迁移学习技术,并探讨了多种应用场景。
abstract_en: Today’s generative models are capable of synthesizing high-fidelity images, but each model specializes on a specific target domain. This raises the need for model merging: combining two or more pretrained generative models into a single unified one. In this work we tackle the problem of model merging, given two constraints that often come up in the real world: (1) no access to the original training data, and (2) without increasing the size of the neural network. To the best of our knowledge, model merging under these constraints has not been studied thus far. We propose a novel, two-stage solution. In the first stage, we transform the weights of all the models to the same parameter space by a technique we term model rooting. In the second stage, we merge the rooted models by averaging their weights and fine-tuning them for each specific domain, using only data generated by the original trained models. We demonstrate that our approach is superior to baseline methods and to existing transfer learning techniques, and investigate several applications.

title: Oran Gafni, Adam Polyak, Oron Ashual, Shelly Sheynin, Devi Parikh, Yaniv Taigman
title_en: Oran Gafni, Adam Polyak, Oron Ashual, Shelly Sheynin, Devi Parikh, Yaniv Taigman
abstract: 近年来,文本到图像生成方法提供了一种简单而令人兴奋的文本与图像领域之间的转换能力。尽管这些方法在逐步提升生成图像的保真度和文本相关性方面取得了进展,但仍有几个关键问题尚未解决,限制了其适用性和质量。我们提出了一种新颖的文本到图像方法,通过以下三个方面解决这些问题:(i) 引入与文本互补的简单控制机制,以场景形式实现控制;(ii) 引入元素显著提升分词过程,通过在关键图像区域(人脸和显著物体)应用领域知识;(iii) 为Transformer应用案例调整无分类器引导。我们的模型在FID和人工评估结果上达到最先进水平,实现了512×512像素分辨率下高保真图像的生成,显著提升了视觉质量。通过场景可控性,我们引入了多项新功能:(i) 场景编辑,(ii) 基于锚定场景的文本编辑,(iii) 克服分布外文本提示,(iv) 故事插图生成,如\href{https://youtu.be/N4BagnXzPXY}{我们编写的故事}所示。
abstract_en: Recent text-to-image generation methods provide a simple yet exciting conversion capability between text and image domains. While these methods have incrementally improved the generated image fidelity and text relevancy, several pivotal gaps remain unanswered, limiting applicability and quality. We propose a novel text-to-image method that addresses these gaps by (i) enabling a simple control mechanism complementary to text in the form of a scene, (ii) introducing elements that substantially improve the tokenization process by employing domain-specific knowledge over key image regions (faces and salient objects), and (iii) adapting classifier-free guidance for the transformer use case. Our model achieves state-of-the-art FID and human evaluation results, unlocking the ability to generate high fidelity images in a resolution of 512×512 pixels, significantly improving visual quality. Through scene controllability, we introduce several new capabilities: (i) Scene editing, (ii) text editing with anchor scenes, (iii) overcoming out-of-distribution text prompts, and (iv) story illustration generation, as demonstrated in \href{https://youtu.be/N4BagnXzPXY}{the story we wrote}.

title: Oren Katzir, Dani Lischinski, Daniel Cohen-Or
title_en: Oren Katzir, Dani Lischinski, Daniel Cohen-Or
abstract: 我们介绍了一种无监督技术,通过分离形状和姿态,将点云编码为规范形状表示。我们的编码器具有稳定性和一致性,意味着形状编码完全与姿态无关,而提取的旋转和平移能够将同一类别的不同输入形状语义对齐到共同的规范姿态。具体而言,我们设计了一种基于向量神经网络(Vector Neuron Networks)的自编码器,这是一种旋转等变神经网络,其层我们扩展以提供旋转等变性之外的平移等变性。由此产生的编码器通过构造产生姿态不变的形状编码,使我们的方法能够专注于学习一类物体的一致规范姿态。定量和定性实验验证了我们方法的优越稳定性和一致性。
abstract_en: We introduce an unsupervised technique for encoding point clouds into a canonical shape representation, by disentangling shape and pose. Our encoder is stable and consistent, meaning that the shape encoding is purely pose-invariant, while the extracted rotation and translation are able to semantically align different input shapes of the same class to a common canonical pose. Specifically, we design an auto-encoder based on Vector Neuron Networks, a rotation-equivariant neural network, whose layers we extend to provide translation-equivariance in addition to rotation-equivariance only. The resulting encoder produces pose-invariant shape encoding by construction, enabling our approach to focus on learning a consistent canonical pose for a class of objects. Quantitative and qualitative experiments validate the superior stability and consistency of our approach.

title: Oren Nuriel, Sharon Fogel, Ron Litman
title_en: Oren Nuriel, Sharon Fogel, Ron Litman
abstract: 利用卷积层的特性,神经网络在模式识别任务中表现出极高的有效性。然而在某些情况下,其决策基于非预期信息,导致在标准基准测试中表现优异,但对具有挑战性的测试条件泛化能力不足,并出现反直觉的失败。近期研究将这种现象称为“捷径学习”,并已在多个领域探讨其存在。在文本识别领域,我们揭示了另一种此类捷径,即识别器过度依赖局部图像统计信息。受此启发,我们提出了一种调节对局部统计信息依赖的方法,以提升文本识别性能。我们的方法称为TextAdaIN,通过在特征图中创建局部扰动,防止网络过度拟合局部统计信息。其方法是将每个特征图视为元素序列,并在小批量中故意错配元素间的细粒度特征统计信息。尽管TextAdaIN方法简单,但大量实验表明其效果优于其他更复杂的方法。TextAdaIN在标准手写文本识别基准测试中取得了最先进结果。它可推广至多种架构和场景文本识别领域。此外,我们证明集成TextAdaIN可提升对更具挑战性测试条件的鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Leveraging the characteristics of convolutional layers, neural networks are extremely effective for pattern recognition tasks. However in some cases, their decisions are based on unintended information leading to high performance on standard benchmarks but also to a lack of generalization to challenging testing conditions and unintuitive failures. Recent work has termed this “shortcut learning” and addressed its presence in multiple domains. In text recognition, we reveal another such shortcut, whereby recognizers overly depend on local image statistics. Motivated by this, we suggest an approach to regulate the reliance on local statistics that improves text recognition performance. Our method, termed TextAdaIN, creates local distortions in the feature map which prevent the network from overfitting to local statistics. It does so by viewing each feature map as a sequence of elements and deliberately mismatching fine-grained feature statistics between elements in a mini-batch. DespiteTextAdaIN’s simplicity, extensive experiments show its effectiveness compared to other, more complicated methods. TextAdaIN achieves state-of-the-art results on standard handwritten text recognition benchmarks. It generalizes to multiple architectures and to the domain of scene text recognition. Furthermore, we demonstrate that integrating TextAdaIN improves robustness towards more challenging testing conditions.

title: Osman Tursun, Simon Denman, Sridha Sridharan, Clinton Fookes
title_en: Osman Tursun, Simon Denman, Sridha Sridharan, Clinton Fookes
abstract: 高质量的显著性图在多个机器学习应用领域中至关重要,包括可解释AI和弱监督目标检测与分割。已有许多技术通过神经网络生成更优的显著性图。然而,这些方法往往局限于特定的显著性可视化方法或显著性问题。本文提出了一种新颖的显著性增强方法,称为\textbf{SESS}(\textbf{S}aliency \textbf{E}nhancing with \textbf{S}caling and \textbf{S}liding)。该方法是对现有显著性图生成方法的通用扩展,适用于任何模型和方法。通过SESS,现有显著性方法能够更好地应对尺度变化、目标对象的多实例出现、干扰项的存在,并生成更少噪声、更具判别性的显著性图。SESS通过融合来自不同尺度和区域的多个补丁提取的显著性图,并采用一种新颖的融合方案(结合通道权重和空间加权平均)来提升显著性。为提高效率,我们引入了预过滤步骤,可排除无用的显著性图以提升效率,同时仍能增强整体结果。我们在目标识别和检测基准数据集上评估SESS,取得了显著提升。代码已公开发布,供研究人员验证性能并进一步开发。代码地址为https://github.com/neouyghur/SESS。
abstract_en: High-quality saliency maps are essential in several machine learning application areas including explainable AI and weakly supervised object detection and segmentation. Many techniques have been developed to generate better saliency using neural networks. However, they are often limited to specific saliency visualisation methods or saliency issues. We propose a novel saliency enhancing approach called \textbf{SESS} (\textbf{S}aliency \textbf{E}nhancing with \textbf{S}caling and \textbf{S}liding). It is a method and model agnostic extension to existing saliency map generation methods. With SESS, existing saliency approaches become robust to scale variance, multiple occurrences of target objects, presence of distractors and generate less noisy and more discriminative saliency maps. SESS improves saliency by fusing saliency maps extracted from multiple patches at different scales from different areas, and combines these individual maps using a novel fusion scheme that incorporates channel-wise weights and spatial weighted average. To improve efficiency, we introduce a pre-filtering step that can exclude uninformative saliency maps to improve efficiency while still enhancing overall results. We evaluate SESS on object recognition and detection benchmarks where it achieves significant improvement. The code is released publicly to enable researchers to verify performance and further development. Code is available at https://github.com/neouyghur/SESS.

title: Otniel-Bogdan Mercea, Thomas Hummel, A. Sophia Koepke, Zeynep Akata
title_en: Otniel-Bogdan Mercea, Thomas Hummel, A. Sophia Koepke, Zeynep Akata
abstract: 视频分类中的音频-视觉广义零样本学习需要理解音频与视觉信息之间的关系,以便在测试时识别来自新类别的样本。视频数据中音频与视觉数据的自然语义和时序对齐关系可以被利用,以学习能够推广到未见过类别的强大表示。我们提出了一种多模态和时序交叉注意力框架,用于音频-视觉广义零样本学习。该框架的输入是通过预训练网络获得的时序对齐的音频和视觉特征。鼓励框架关注跨模态的时序对应关系,而非模态内部的自注意力,显著提升了性能。我们证明,所提出的框架在UCF-GZSL、VGGSound-GZSL和ActivityNet-GZSL基准测试中,实现了(广义)零样本学习的最先进性能。
abstract_en: Audio-visual generalised zero-shot learning for video classification requires understanding the relations between the audio and visual information in order to be able to recognise samples from novel, previously unseen classes at test time. The natural semantic and temporal alignment between audio and visual data in video data can be exploited to learn powerful representations that generalise to unseen classes at test time. We propose a multi-modal and Temporal Cross-attention Framework for audio-visual generalised zero-shot learning. Its inputs are temporally aligned audio and visual features that are obtained from pre-trained networks. Encouraging the framework to focus on cross-modal correspondence across time instead of self-attention within the modalities boosts the performance significantly. We show that our proposed framework that ingests temporal features yields state-of-the-art performance on the UCF-GZSL, VGGSound-GZSL, and ActivityNet-GZSL benchmarks for (generalised) zero-shot learning.

title: Pablo Cervantes, Yusuke Sekikawa, Ikuro Sato, Koichi Shinoda
title_en: Pablo Cervantes, Yusuke Sekikawa, Ikuro Sato, Koichi Shinoda
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于变分隐式神经表示(INR)的动作条件人体运动生成方法。变分形式使得INR能够生成动作条件分布,从而可以轻松采样表示以生成新颖的人体运动序列。我们的方法通过构造实现可变长度序列生成,因为部分INR通过时间嵌入优化以适应任意长度的完整序列。相比之下,先前研究在建模可变长度序列时遇到了困难。我们在HumanAct12、NTU-RGBD和UESTC数据集上验证了我们的方法,结果表明在生成运动的真实性和多样性方面均优于所有相关方法。令人惊讶的是,即使使用MLP解码器,我们的方法也持续优于最先进的基于Transformer的自动编码器。特别是,我们证明了由我们的方法生成的可变长度运动在真实性和多样性方面均优于最先进的方法生成的固定长度运动。代码见https://github.com/PACerv/ImplicitMotion
abstract_en: We propose an action-conditional human motion generation method using variational implicit neural representations (INR). The variational formalism enables action-conditional distributions of INRs, from which one can easily sample representations to generate novel human motion sequences. Our method offers variable-length sequence generation by construction because a part of INR is optimized for a whole sequence of arbitrary length with temporal embeddings. In contrast, previous works reported difficulties with modeling variable-length sequences. We confirm that our method with a Transformer decoder outperforms all relevant methods on HumanAct12, NTU-RGBD, and UESTC datasets in terms of realism and diversity of generated motions. Surprisingly, even our method with an MLP decoder consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art Transformer-based auto-encoder. In particular, we show that variable-length motions generated by our method are better than fixed-length motions generated by the state-of-the-art method in terms of realism and diversity. Code at https://github.com/PACerv/ImplicitMotion

title: Pan Ji, Qingan Yan, Yuxin Ma, Yi Xu
title_en: Pan Ji, Qingan Yan, Yuxin Ma, Yi Xu
abstract: 我们提出了一种鲁棒且精确的深度细化系统GeoRefine,用于从单目序列中生成几何一致的稠密映射。GeoRefine包含三个模块:一个结合学习先验的混合SLAM模块、一个利用自监督的在线深度细化模块,以及通过TSDF融合实现的全局映射模块。该系统设计上支持在线运行,通过以下方法实现卓越的鲁棒性和精度:(i) 一种结合学习型光流和/或深度的鲁棒化混合SLAM;(ii) 利用SLAM输出并强制长期几何一致性的自监督损失函数;(iii) 细致的系统设计以避免在线深度细化中的退化情况。我们在多个公开数据集上对GeoRefine进行了广泛评估,深度误差绝对相对值低至5%。
abstract_en: We present a robust and accurate depth refinement system, named GeoRefine, for geometrically-consistent dense mapping from monocular sequences. GeoRefine consists of three modules: a hybrid SLAM module using learning-based priors, an online depth refinement module leveraging self-supervision, and a global mapping module via TSDF fusion. The proposed system is online by design and achieves great robustness and accuracy via: (i) a robustified hybrid SLAM that incorporates learning-based optical flow and/or depth; (ii) self-supervised losses that leverage SLAM outputs and enforce long-term geometric consistency; (iii) careful system design that avoids degenerate cases in online depth refinement. We extensively evaluate GeoRefine on multiple public datasets and reach as low as 5% absolute relative depth errors.

title: Pandeng Li, Hongtao Xie, Jiannan Ge, Lei Zhang, Shaobo Min, Yongdong Zhang
title_en: Pandeng Li, Hongtao Xie, Jiannan Ge, Lei Zhang, Shaobo Min, Yongdong Zhang
abstract: 无监督视频哈希通常通过学习重建输入视频来优化二进制码。这种重建约束过度关注帧级时间上下文变化,而忽略了对检索更有用的视频级全局语义。因此,我们通过将视频信息分解为重建依赖信息和语义依赖信息,解耦语义提取与重建约束。具体而言,我们首先设计了一个简单的双流结构,包括时间层和哈希层。随后,在自监督获得的语义相似性知识帮助下,哈希层学习捕捉用于语义检索的信息,而时间层学习捕捉用于重建的信息。通过这种方式,模型自然地将解耦语义保留在二进制码中。经过全面实验验证,我们的方法在三个视频基准数据集上持续优于最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Unsupervised video hashing usually optimizes binary codes by learning to reconstruct input videos. Such reconstruction constraint spends much effort on frame-level temporal context changes without focusing on video-level global semantics that are more useful for retrieval. Hence, we address this problem by decomposing video information into reconstruction-dependent and semantic-dependent information, which disentangles the semantic extraction from reconstruction constraint. Specifically, we first design a simple dual-stream structure, including a temporal layer and a hash layer. Then, with the help of semantic similarity knowledge obtained from self-supervision, the hash layer learns to capture information for semantic retrieval, while the temporal layer learns to capture the information for reconstruction. In this way, the model naturally preserves the disentangled semantics into binary codes. Validated by comprehensive experiments, our method consistently outperforms the state-of-the-arts on three video benchmarks.

title: Paritosh Parmar, Amol Gharat, Helge Rhodin
title_en: Paritosh Parmar, Amol Gharat, Helge Rhodin
abstract: 在锻炼过程中保持正确姿势对于预防受伤和最大化肌肉质量增长至关重要。检测锻炼动作中的错误需要估计人体姿态。然而,现成的姿态估计器在健身房场景录制的视频中表现不佳,原因包括相机角度、健身器材遮挡、光照条件和服装等因素。更糟糕的是,需要检测的锻炼错误非常细微。为此,我们提出从无标签样本中学习面向锻炼的图像和视频表示,使得仅需专家标注的小数据集即可实现监督式的错误检测。具体而言,我们的领域知识引导的自监督方法(姿态对比学习和运动解耦)利用运动动作的谐波运动,并借助相机角度、服装和光照的大幅变化来学习强大的表示。为促进我们的自监督预训练和监督微调,我们整理了一个新的锻炼数据集Fitness-AQA(https://github.com/ParitoshParmar/Fitness-AQA),包含深蹲(BackSquat)、杠铃划船(BarbellRow)和肩推(OverheadPress)三种动作。该数据集由专家教练标注了多种关键且常见的锻炼错误。实验结果表明,我们的自监督表示优于现成的2D和3D姿态估计器以及多个其他基线方法。我们还展示了这些方法可应用于其他领域/任务,如姿态估计和跳水质量评估。
abstract_en: Maintaining proper form while exercising is important for preventing injuries and maximizing muscle mass gains. Detecting errors in workout form naturally requires estimating human’s body pose. However, off-the-shelf pose estimators struggle to perform well on the videos recorded in gym scenarios due to factors such as camera angles, occlusion from gym equipment, illumination, and clothing. To aggravate the problem, the errors to be detected in the workouts are very subtle. To that end, we propose to learn exercise-oriented image and video representations from unlabeled samples such that a small dataset annotated by experts suffices for supervised error detection. In particular, our domain knowledge-informed self-supervised approaches (pose contrastive learning and motion disentangling) exploit the harmonic motion of the exercise actions, and capitalize on the large variances in camera angles, clothes, and illumination to learn powerful representations. To facilitate our self-supervised pretraining, and supervised finetuning, we curated a new exercise dataset, Fitness-AQA (https://github.com/ParitoshParmar/Fitness-AQA), comprising of three exercises: BackSquat, BarbellRow, and OverheadPress. It has been annotated by expert trainers for multiple crucial and typically occurring exercise errors. Experimental results show that our self-supervised representations outperform off-the-shelf 2D- and 3D-pose estimators and several other baselines. We also show that our approaches can be applied to other domains/tasks such as pose estimation and dive quality assessment.

title: Patrick Grady, Chengcheng Tang, Samarth Brahmbhatt, Christopher D. Twigg, Chengde Wan, James Hays, Charles C. Kemp
title_en: Patrick Grady, Chengcheng Tang, Samarth Brahmbhatt, Christopher D. Twigg, Chengde Wan, James Hays, Charles C. Kemp
abstract: 人们通常通过用手施加压力与周围环境进行互动。虽然可以通过在手和环境之间放置压力传感器来测量手部压力,但这样做会改变接触力学,干扰人类的触觉感知,需要昂贵的传感器,并且难以扩展到大型环境。我们探索了使用常规RGB摄像头推断手部压力的可能性,从而实现从未安装传感器的手和表面进行机器感知。核心洞察是,手部施加压力会导致有信息量的外观变化。手部具有共同的生物力学特性,导致类似的可观察现象,如软组织变形、血液分布、手部姿态和投射阴影。我们收集了36名具有不同肤色的参与者对安装了传感器的平面表面施加压力的视频。然后训练了一个深度模型(PressureVisionNet)从单个RGB图像推断压力图像。我们的模型能够推断出训练数据之外的参与者的压力,并且优于基线模型。我们还展示了模型的输出依赖于手部的外观和接触区域附近的投射阴影。总体而言,我们的结果表明,之前未观察到的人类手部外观可以用于准确推断施加的压力。数据、代码和模型可在网络上获取。
abstract_en: People often interact with their surroundings by applying pressure with their hands. While hand pressure can be measured by placing pressure sensors between the hand and the environment, doing so can alter contact mechanics, interfere with human tactile perception, require costly sensors, and scale poorly to large environments. We explore the possibility of using a conventional RGB camera to infer hand pressure, enabling machine perception of hand pressure from uninstrumented hands and surfaces. The central insight is that the application of pressure by a hand results in informative appearance changes. Hands share biomechanical properties that result in similar observable phenomena, such as soft-tissue deformation, blood distribution, hand pose, and cast shadows. We collected videos of 36 participants with diverse skin tone applying pressure to an instrumented planar surface. We then trained a deep model (PressureVisionNet) to infer a pressure image from a single RGB image. Our model infers pressure for participants outside of the training data and outperforms baselines. We also show that the output of our model depends on the appearance of the hand and cast shadows near contact regions. Overall, our results suggest the appearance of a previously unobserved human hand can be used to accurately infer applied pressure. Data, code, and models are available online.

title: Patsorn Sangkloy, Wittawat Jitkrittum, Diyi Yang, James Hays
title_en: Patsorn Sangkloy, Wittawat Jitkrittum, Diyi Yang, James Hays
abstract: 我们研究了在真实场景中通过素描和文本查询联合检索图像的问题。我们提出了TASK-former(文本与素描Transformer),这是一种端到端可训练的图像检索模型,输入为文本描述和素描。我们认为,这两种输入模态在互补性方面具有独特优势,单靠其中任何一种都无法轻易实现。TASK-former采用类似CLIP的后期融合双编码器方法,允许高效可扩展的检索,因为检索集可以独立于查询进行索引。我们通过实验证明,结合输入素描(即使素描质量较差)与文本显著提升了检索召回率,相较于传统的基于文本的图像检索方法。为评估我们的方法,我们收集了COCO数据集测试集图像的5,000幅手绘素描。收集的素描可通过https://janesjanes.github.io/tsbir/获取。
abstract_en: We address the problem of retrieving in-the-wild images with both a sketch and a text query. We present TASK-former (Text And SKetch transformer), an end-to-end trainable model for image retrieval using a text description and a sketch as input. We argue that both input modalities complement each other in a manner that cannot be achieved easily by either one alone. TASK-former follows the late-fusion dual-encoder approach, similar to CLIP, which allows efficient and scalable retrieval since the retrieval set can be indexed independently of the queries. We empirically demonstrate that using an input sketch (even a poorly drawn one) in addition to text considerably increases retrieval recall compared to traditional text-based image retrieval. To evaluate our approach, we collect 5,000 hand-drawn sketches for images in the test set of the COCO dataset. The collected sketches are available a https://janesjanes.github.io/tsbir/.

title: Paul Albert, Eric Arazo, Noel E. O’Connor, Kevin McGuinness
title_en: Paul Albert, Eric Arazo, Noel E. O’Connor, Kevin McGuinness
abstract: 使用搜索引擎进行网络图像检索是创建图像数据集时替代手动筛选的诱人选择,但其主要缺点仍然是检索到的错误(噪声)样本比例。先前研究表明,这些噪声样本是分布内(ID)样本与分布外(OOD)图像的混合:前者被错误分类但具有与数据集中其他类别相似的视觉语义,后者与数据集中的任何类别均无语义关联。实际上,后者是检索到的噪声图像的主要类型。为应对这种噪声双重性,我们提出了一种两阶段算法。首先通过无监督对比学习在特征空间中表示图像,发现对比学习的对齐与均匀性原则能够在单位超球体上将OOD样本线性分离于ID样本。随后使用固定邻域大小进行谱嵌入,并在类别层面应用异常敏感聚类,以检测干净样本与OOD聚类,以及ID噪声异常。最后训练一个抗噪神经网络,将ID噪声纠正至正确类别,并通过引导对比目标利用OOD样本进行聚类,以提升低级特征。我们的算法在合成噪声图像数据集和真实网络爬取数据上均超越了现有最优结果。本工作在github.com/PaulAlbert31/SNCF完整可复现。
abstract_en: Using search engines for web image retrieval is a tempting alternative to manual curation when creating an image dataset, but their main drawback remains the proportion of incorrect (noisy) samples retrieved. These noisy samples have been evidenced by previous works to be a mixture of in-distribution (ID) samples, assigned to the incorrect category but presenting similar visual semantics to other classes in the dataset, and out-of-distribution (OOD) images, which share no semantic correlation with any category from the dataset. The latter are, in practice, the dominant type of noisy images retrieved. To tackle this noise duality, we propose a two stage algorithm starting with a detection step where we use unsupervised contrastive feature learning to represent images in a feature space. We find that the alignment and uniformity principles of contrastive learning allow OOD samples to be linearly separated from ID samples on the unit hypersphere. We then spectrally embed the unsupervised representations using a fixed neighborhood size and apply an outlier sensitive clustering at the class level to detect the clean and OOD clusters as well as ID noisy outliers. We finally train a noise robust neural network that corrects ID noise to the correct category and utilizes OOD samples in a guided contrastive objective, clustering them to improve low-level features. Our algorithm improves the state-of-the-art results on synthetic noise image datasets as well as real-world web-crawled data. Our work is fully reproducible github.com/PaulAlbert31/SNCF.

title: Paul Jacob, Éloi Zablocki, Hédi Ben-Younes, Mickaël Chen, Patrick Pérez, Matthieu Cord
title_en: Paul Jacob, Éloi Zablocki, Hédi Ben-Younes, Mickaël Chen, Patrick Pérez, Matthieu Cord
abstract: 随着深度学习模型在安全关键应用中的广泛应用,可解释性和可信度成为主要关注点。对于简单的图像,如低分辨率人脸肖像,近期提出通过合成视觉反事实解释来揭示训练分类模型的决策机制。本文针对高质量图像和复杂场景的反事实解释生成问题展开研究。借助近期语义到图像模型,我们提出了一种新的生成式反事实解释框架,能够产生合理且稀疏的修改,同时保持整体场景结构。此外,我们引入了“区域定向反事实解释”概念及对应框架,用户可通过指定查询图像中需解释的语义区域集合来引导反事实生成。在包含高质量肖像(CelebAMask-HQ)和驾驶场景(BDD100k)等具有挑战性的数据集上进行了大量实验。
abstract_en: As deep learning models are increasingly used in safety-critical applications, explainability and trustworthiness become major concerns. For simple images, such as low-resolution face portraits, synthesizing visual counterfactual explanations has recently been proposed as a way to uncover the decision mechanisms of a trained classification model. In this work, we address the problem of producing counterfactual explanations for high-quality images and complex scenes. Leveraging recent semantic-to-image models, we propose a new generative counterfactual explanation framework that produces plausible and sparse modifications which preserve the overall scene structure. Furthermore, we introduce the concept of ""region-targeted counterfactual explanations"", and a corresponding framework, where users can guide the generation of counterfactuals by specifying a set of semantic regions of the query image the explanation must be about. Extensive experiments are conducted on challenging datasets including high-quality portraits (CelebAMask-HQ) and driving scenes (BDD100k).

title: Paul Upchurch, Ransen Niu
title_en: Paul Upchurch, Ransen Niu
abstract: 理解世界的关键算法是材料分割,它为每个像素分配一个标签(如金属、玻璃等)。我们发现,基于现有数据训练的模型在某些情况下表现不佳,并提出通过一个包含44,560张室内和室外图像的320万密集分割的大规模数据集来解决这一问题,该数据集的分割数量是现有数据的23倍。我们的数据涵盖了更多样化的场景、物体、视角和材料,并且包含更公平的皮肤类型分布。我们展示了一个基于我们数据训练的模型在多个数据集和视角上优于最先进的模型。我们提出了一项大规模场景解析基准测试和基线,其在46种材料上的像素级准确率为0.729,类别平均准确率为0.585,平均IoU为0.420。
abstract_en: A key algorithm for understanding the world is material segmentation, which assigns a label (metal, glass, etc.) to each pixel. We find that a model trained on existing data underperforms in some settings and propose to address this with a large-scale dataset of 3.2 million dense segments on 44,560 indoor and outdoor images, which is 23x more segments than existing data. Our data covers a more diverse set of scenes, objects, viewpoints and materials, and contains a more fair distribution of skin types. We show that a model trained on our data outperforms a state-of-the-art model across datasets and viewpoints. We propose a large-scale scene parsing benchmark and baseline of 0.729 per-pixel accuracy, 0.585 mean class accuracy and 0.420 mean IoU across 46 materials.

title: Paul-Edouard Sarlin, Mihai Dusmanu, Johannes L. Schönberger, Pablo Speciale, Lukas Gruber, Viktor Larsson, Ondrej Miksik, Marc Pollefeys
title_en: Paul-Edouard Sarlin, Mihai Dusmanu, Johannes L. Schönberger, Pablo Speciale, Lukas Gruber, Viktor Larsson, Ondrej Miksik, Marc Pollefeys
abstract: 定位与建图是增强现实(AR)的基础技术,它使数字内容能够在现实世界中进行共享和持久化。尽管取得了显著进展,研究人员仍然主要受到不具代表性的现实世界AR场景的不现实基准的驱动。特别是,基准通常基于小规模数据集,场景多样性低,由固定摄像头捕获,并缺乏惯性、射频或深度数据等其他传感器输入。此外,地面真实数据(GT)的准确性大多不足以满足AR需求。为了解决这一差距,我们引入了一个新的基准,该基准包含全面的捕获和GT流程,使我们能够在各种场景和异构设备上大规模共注册现实的AR轨迹。为了建立准确的GT,我们的流程以全自动的方式稳健地将捕获的轨迹与激光扫描对齐。基于此流程,我们发布了一个包含多样且大规模场景的基准数据集,这些场景是使用头戴式和手持AR设备记录的。我们扩展了多种最先进的方法,以利用AR特定的设置,并在我们的基准上进行评估。根据结果,我们提出了当前研究差距的新见解,为社区的未来工作提供了方向。
abstract_en: Localization and mapping is the foundational technology for augmented reality (AR) that enables sharing and persistence of digital content in the real world. While significant progress has been made, researchers are still mostly driven by unrealistic benchmarks not representative of real-world AR scenarios. In particular, benchmarks are often based on small-scale datasets with low scene diversity, captured from stationary cameras, and lacking other sensor inputs like inertial, radio, or depth data. Furthermore, ground-truth (GT) accuracy is mostly insufficient to satisfy AR requirements. To close this gap, we introduce a new benchmark with a comprehensive capture and GT pipeline, which allow us to co-register realistic AR trajectories in diverse scenes and from heterogeneous devices at scale. To establish accurate GT, our pipeline robustly aligns the captured trajectories against laser scans in a fully automatic manner. Based on this pipeline, we publish a benchmark dataset of diverse and large-scale scenes recorded with head-mounted and hand-held AR devices. We extend several state-of-the-art methods to take advantage of the AR specific setup and evaluate them on our benchmark. Based on the results, we present novel insights on current research gaps to provide avenues for future work in the community.

title: Pavlo Molchanov, Jimmy Hall, Hongxu Yin, Jan Kautz, Nicolo Fusi, Arash Vahdat
title_en: Pavlo Molchanov, Jimmy Hall, Hongxu Yin, Jan Kautz, Nicolo Fusi, Arash Vahdat
abstract: 我们引入了一种基于神经架构搜索技术的延迟感知网络加速方法(LANA),用于加速神经网络。LANA包含两个阶段:第一阶段通过逐层特征图蒸馏技术,为目标网络的每一层训练多种替代操作;第二阶段采用一种新颖的约束整数线性优化(ILP)方法,解决高效操作的组合选择问题。ILP方法具有独特优势:(i) 可在数秒至数分钟内完成NAS;(ii) 容易满足预算约束;(iii) 按层粒度进行操作;(iv) 支持庞大的搜索空间O(10^100),在效果和效率上超越了以往的搜索方法。在大量实验中,我们证明LANA能够在目标延迟预算约束下生成高效且准确的模型,且显著优于其他技术。我们分析了三种流行网络架构:EfficientNetV1、EfficientNetV2和ResNeST,并在压缩较大模型时实现了所有模型的准确率提升(最高达3.0%)。在GPU和CPU上,LANA实现了显著的速度提升(最高达5倍),且仅导致小幅或无准确率下降。
abstract_en: We introduce latency-aware network acceleration (LANA)-an approach that builds on neural architecture search technique to accelerate neural networks. LANA consists of two phases: in the first phase, it trains many alternative operations for every layer of a target network using layer-wise feature map distillation. In the second phase, it solves the combinatorial selection of efficient operations using a novel constrained integer linear optimization (ILP) approach. ILP brings unique properties as it (i) performs NAS within a few seconds to minutes, (ii) easily satisfies budget constraints, (iii) works on the layer-granularity, (iv) supports a huge search space O(10^100), surpassing prior search approaches in efficacy and efficiency. In extensive experiments, we show that LANA yields efficient and accurate models constrained by a target latency budget, while being significantly faster than other techniques. We analyze three popular network architectures: EfficientNetV1, EfficientNetV2 and ResNeST, and achieve accuracy improvement (up to 3.0%) for all models when compressing larger models. LANA achieves significant speed-ups (up to 5x) with minor to no accuracy drop on GPU and CPU.

title: Pedro Hermosilla, Michael Schelling, Tobias Ritschel, Timo Ropinski
title_en: Pedro Hermosilla, Michael Schelling, Tobias Ritschel, Timo Ropinski
abstract: 适当的权重初始化对于成功训练神经网络至关重要。近年来,批量归一化通过基于批量统计信息对每一层进行简单归一化,降低了权重初始化的重要性。不幸的是,当应用于小批量尺寸时,批量归一化存在诸多缺点,因为需要应对在点云学习过程中遇到的内存限制。尽管有坚实的权重初始化策略可以使得批量归一化变得不必要,从而避免这些缺点,但目前尚未有针对点卷积网络的此类方法。为填补这一空白,我们提出了一种框架,以统一多种连续卷积。这使我们的主要贡献——方差感知的权重初始化成为可能。我们证明,这种初始化方法可以在避免批量归一化的同时,实现相似甚至在某些情况下更优的性能。
abstract_en: Appropriate weight initialization has been of key importance to successfully train neural networks. Recently, batch normalization has diminished the role of weight initialization by simply normalizing each layer based on batch statistics. Unfortunately, batch normalization has several drawbacks when applied to small batch sizes, as they are required to cope with memory limitations when learning on point clouds. While well-founded weight initialization strategies can render batch normalization unnecessary and thus avoid these drawbacks, no such approaches have been proposed for point convolutional networks. To fill this gap, we propose a framework to unify the multitude of continuous convolutions. This enables our main contribution, variance-aware weight initialization. We show that this initialization can avoid batch normalization while achieving similar and, in some cases, better performance.

title: Pei Sun, Mingxing Tan, Weiyue Wang, Chenxi Liu, Fei Xia, Zhaoqi Leng, Dragomir Anguelov
title_en: Pei Sun, Mingxing Tan, Weiyue Wang, Chenxi Liu, Fei Xia, Zhaoqi Leng, Dragomir Anguelov
abstract: 点云中的三维目标检测是现代机器人和自动驾驶系统的核心组件。三维目标检测的关键挑战来自于三维场景中点占据的固有稀疏性。在本文中,我们提出了一种可扩展且精确的三维目标检测模型Sparse Window Transformer (SWFormer),该模型能够充分利用点云的稀疏性。基于Swin Transformer的思想,SWFormer在稀疏体素上操作,并通过分桶方案高效处理可变长度的稀疏窗口。除了每个空间窗口内的自注意力机制,我们的SWFormer还通过多尺度特征融合和窗口平移操作捕捉跨窗口相关性。为进一步解决从稀疏特征中精确检测三维目标的独特挑战,我们提出了一种新的体素扩散技术。在Waymo Open Dataset上的实验结果表明,我们的SWFormer在官方测试集上实现了车辆和行人的73.36 L2 mAPH,超越了所有先前的单阶段和双阶段模型。
abstract_en: 3D object detection in point clouds is a core component for modern robotics and autonomous driving systems. A key challenge in 3D object detection comes from the inherent sparse nature of point occupancy within the 3D scene. In this paper, we propose Sparse Window Transformer (SWFormer ), a scalable and accurate model for 3D object detection, which can take full advantage of the sparsity of point clouds. Built upon the idea of Swin Transformers, SWFormer operates on the sparse voxels and processes variable-length sparse windows efficiently using a bucketing scheme. In addition to self-attention within each spatial window, our SWFormer also captures cross-window correlation with multi-scale feature fusion and window shifting operations. To further address the unique challenge of detecting 3D objects accurately from sparse features, we propose a new voxel diffusion technique. Experimental results on the Waymo Open Dataset show our SWFormer achieves state-of-the-art 73.36 L2 mAPH on vehicle and pedestrian for 3D object detection on the official test set, outperforming all previous single-stage and two-stage models.

title: Pei Xu, Jean-Bernard Hayet, Ioannis Karamouzas
title_en: Pei Xu, Jean-Bernard Hayet, Ioannis Karamouzas
abstract: Predicting pedestrian movement is critical for human behavior analysis and also for safe and efficient human-agent interactions. However, despite significant advancements, it is still challenging for existing approaches to capture the uncertainty and multimodality of human navigation decision making. In this paper, we propose SocialVAE, a novel approach for human trajectory prediction. The core of SocialVAE is a timewise variational autoencoder architecture that exploits stochastic recurrent neural networks to perform prediction, combined with a social attention mechanism and a backward posterior approximation to allow for better extraction of pedestrian navigation strategies. We show that SocialVAE improves current state-of-the-art performance on several pedestrian trajectory prediction benchmarks, including the ETH/UCY benchmark, Stanford Drone Dataset, and SportVU NBA movement dataset.
abstract_en: Predicting pedestrian movement is critical for human behavior analysis and also for safe and efficient human-agent interactions. However, despite significant advancements, it is still challenging for existing approaches to capture the uncertainty and multimodality of human navigation decision making. In this paper, we propose SocialVAE, a novel approach for human trajectory prediction. The core of SocialVAE is a timewise variational autoencoder architecture that exploits stochastic recurrent neural networks to perform prediction, combined with a social attention mechanism and a backward posterior approximation to allow for better extraction of pedestrian navigation strategies. We show that SocialVAE improves current state-of-the-art performance on several pedestrian trajectory prediction benchmarks, including the ETH/UCY benchmark, Stanford Drone Dataset, and SportVU NBA movement dataset.

title: Peihao Zhu, Rameen Abdal, John Femiani, Peter Wonka
title_en: Peihao Zhu, Rameen Abdal, John Femiani, Peter Wonka
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的自动发型迁移算法,特别针对姿态不匹配的复杂输入。我们的算法输入为两幅图像,一幅用于发型,另一幅用于身份(人脸)。我们不需要额外的输入,如分割掩码。我们的算法包含多个步骤,贡献了三个新颖组件。第一贡献是将光头化纳入发型编辑流程,以简化头发覆盖区域的背景和人脸区域的修复。第二贡献是一种新颖的嵌入算法,能够处理姿态变化和语义图像融合。第三贡献是发型网络架构,该架构通过联合执行多项任务(如身份图像的光头化、两幅图像间的变换估计、变形和发型复制)实现发型与身份图像的语义融合。实验结果表明,我们的方法在定量和定性结果上均优于当前最先进的方法。代码和数据将被发布。
abstract_en: We propose a novel algorithm for automatic hairstyle transfer, specifically targeting complicated inputs that do not match in pose. The input to our algorithm are two images, one for the hairstyle and one for the identity (face). We do not require any additional inputs such as segmentation masks. Our algorithm consists of multiple steps and we contribute three novel components. The first contribution is the idea to include baldification into hairstyle editing pipelines to simplify inpainting of background and face regions covered by hair. The second contribution is a novel embedding algorithm that can handle both pose changes and semantic image blending. The third contribution is the hairnet architecture that semantically blends the hairstyle and identity images, performing multiple tasks jointly, such as baldification of the identity image, transformation estimation between the two images, warping, and hairstyle copying. Our results show a clear improvement over current state of the art methods in both quantitative and qualitative results. Code and data will be released.

title: Peixian Chen, Mengdan Zhang, Yunhang Shen, Kekai Sheng, Yuting Gao, Xing Sun, Ke Li, Chunhua Shen
title_en: Peixian Chen, Mengdan Zhang, Yunhang Shen, Kekai Sheng, Yuting Gao, Xing Sun, Ke Li, Chunhua Shen
abstract: 视觉Transformer(ViTs)正在改变目标检测任务的格局。ViTs在检测中的自然应用是用基于Transformer的主干网络替代基于CNN的主干网络,这种做法简单却在推理阶段带来巨大的计算负担。更精细的应用是DETR家族,该方法消除了目标检测中许多手工设计组件的需求,但引入了需要长时间收敛的解码器。因此,基于Transformer的目标检测难以在大规模应用中普及。为克服这些问题,我们提出了一种新颖的无解码器全Transformer架构(DFFT)目标检测器,首次在训练和推理阶段均实现了高效性。我们通过围绕两个切入点简化目标检测为仅编码器的单级锚框密集预测问题:1)消除训练效率低下的解码器,利用两个强编码器保持单级特征图预测的准确性;2)在计算资源有限的情况下探索低级语义特征用于检测任务。特别地,我们设计了一种新颖的轻量级检测导向Transformer主干网络,基于精心设计的消融研究,高效捕捉具有丰富语义的低级特征。在MS COCO基准上的大量实验表明,DFFT{SMALL}在计算成本降低28%且训练轮次减少超过10倍的情况下,比DETR提升2.5% AP。与领先的基于锚框检测器RetinaNet相比,DFFT{SMALL}在计算成本降低70%的同时获得超过5.5%的AP增益。
abstract_en: Vision transformers (ViTs) are changing the landscape of object detection tasks. A natural usage of ViTs in detection is to replace the CNN-based backbone with a transformer-based backbone, which is simple yet brings an enormous computation burden during inference. More subtle usage is the DETR family, which eliminates the need for many hand-designed components in object detection but introduces a decoder demanding an extra-long time to converge. As a result, transformer-based object detection could not prevail in large-scale applications. To overcome these issues, we propose a novel decoder-free fully transformer-based (DFFT) object detector, achieving high efficiency in both training and inference stages for the first time. We simplify objection detection to an encoder-only single-level anchor-based dense prediction problem by centering around two entry points: 1) Eliminate the training-inefficient decoder and leverage two strong encoders to preserve the accuracy of single-level feature map prediction; 2) Explore low-level semantic features for the detection task with limited computational resources. In particular, we design a novel lightweight detection-oriented transformer backbone that efficiently captures low-level features with rich semantics based on a well-conceived ablation study. Extensive experiments on the MS COCO benchmark demonstrate that DFFT{SMALL} outperforms DETR by 2.5% AP with 28% computation cost reduction and more than 10X fewer training epochs. Compared with the cutting-edge anchor-based detector RetinaNet, DFFT{SMALL} obtains over 5.5% AP gain while cutting down 70% computation cost.

title: Peng Wang, Cheng Da, Cong Yao
title_en: Peng Wang, Cheng Da, Cong Yao
abstract: 场景文本识别(STR)一直是计算机视觉领域的活跃研究课题。为解决这一具有挑战性的问题,众多创新方法相继被提出,将语言学知识融入STR模型已成为近期的重要趋势。在本工作中,我们首先借鉴视觉Transformer(ViT)的最新进展,构建了一个概念简单却强大的视觉STR模型,该模型基于ViT,优于以往场景文本识别的最先进模型,包括纯视觉模型和语言增强方法。为进一步整合语言知识,我们提出了一种多粒度预测策略,以隐式方式将语言模态的信息注入模型,即在输出空间中引入NLP中广泛使用的子词表示(BPE和WordPiece),除了传统的字符级表示外,且未采用独立的语言模型(LM)。所得到的算法(称为MGP-STR)能够将STR的性能上限提升至更高水平。具体而言,它在标准基准测试中实现了平均识别准确率为93.35%。
abstract_en: Scene text recognition (STR) has been an active research topic in computer vision for years. To tackle this challenging problem, numerous innovative methods have been successively proposed and incorporating linguistic knowledge into STR models has recently become a prominent trend. In this work, we first draw inspiration from the recent progress in Vision Transformer (ViT) to construct a conceptually simple yet powerful vision STR model, which is built upon ViT and outperforms previous state-of-the-art models for scene text recognition, including both pure vision models and language-augmented methods. To integrate linguistic knowledge, we further propose a Multi-Granularity Prediction strategy to inject information from the language modality into the model in an implicit way, i.e., subword representations (BPE and WordPiece) widely-used in NLP are introduced into the output space, in addition to the conventional character level representation, while no independent language model (LM) is adopted. The resultant algorithm (termed MGP-STR) is able to push the performance envelop of STR to an even higher level. Specifically, it achieves an average recognition accuracy of 93.35% on standard benchmarks.

title: Pengfei Chen, Xuehui Yu, Xumeng Han, Najmul Hassan, Kai Wang, Jiachen Li, Jian Zhao, Humphrey Shi, Zhenjun Han, Qixiang Ye
title_en: Pengfei Chen, Xuehui Yu, Xumeng Han, Najmul Hassan, Kai Wang, Jiachen Li, Jian Zhao, Humphrey Shi, Zhenjun Han, Qixiang Ye
abstract: 单点监督的目标检测近年来受到了越来越多的关注。然而,单点监督目标检测(PSOD)与边界框监督检测之间的性能差距仍然很大。在本文中,我们将这种较大的性能差距归因于生成高质量提议袋的失败,而高质量的提议袋对于多实例学习(MIL)至关重要。为了解决这个问题,我们引入了一种轻量级的替代现成提议(OTSP)方法,从而创建了点到框网络(P2BNet),该网络可以通过类似锚点的方式生成提议,从而构建跨对象平衡的提议袋。通过充分研究准确的位置信息,P2BNet进一步构建了实例级袋,避免了多个对象的混合。最后,采用级联式的粗到细策略来提高提议与真实值(GT)之间的IoU。得益于这些策略,P2BNet能够为目标检测生成高质量的实例级袋。P2BNet在MS COCO数据集上相对于之前的最佳PSOD方法,将平均精度(AP)提高了超过50%。它还展示了弥合点监督和边界框监督检测器之间性能差距的巨大潜力。代码将在github.com/ucas-vg/P2BNet上发布。
abstract_en: Object detection using single point supervision has received increasing attention over the years. However, the performance gap between point supervised object detection (PSOD) and bounding box supervised detection remains large. In this paper, we attribute such a large performance gap to the failure of generating high-quality proposal bags which are crucial for multiple instance learning (MIL). To address this problem, we introduce a lightweight alternative to the off-the-shelf proposal (OTSP) method and thereby create the Point-to-Box Network (P2BNet), which can construct a inter-objects balanced proposal bag by generating proposals in an anchor-like way. By fully investigating the accurate position information, P2BNet further constructs an instance-level bag, avoiding the mixture of multiple objects. Finally, a coarse-to-fine policy in a cascade fashion is utilized to improve the IoU between proposals and ground-truth (GT). Benefiting from these strategies, P2BNet is able to produce high-quality instance-level bags for object detection. P2BNet improves the mean average precision (AP) by more than 50% relative to the previous best PSOD method on the MS COCO dataset. It also demonstrates the great potential to bridge the performance gap between point supervised and bounding-box supervised detectors. The code will be released at github.com/ucas-vg/P2BNet.

title: Pengfei Guo, Dong Yang, Ali Hatamizadeh, An Xu, Ziyue Xu, Wenqi Li, Can Zhao, Daguang Xu, Stephanie Harmon, Evrim Turkbey, Baris Turkbey, Bradford Wood, Francesca Patella, Elvira Stellato, Gianpaolo Carrafiello, Vishal M. Patel, Holger R. Roth
title_en: Pengfei Guo, Dong Yang, Ali Hatamizadeh, An Xu, Ziyue Xu, Wenqi Li, Can Zhao, Daguang Xu, Stephanie Harmon, Evrim Turkbey, Baris Turkbey, Bradford Wood, Francesca Patella, Elvira Stellato, Gianpaolo Carrafiello, Vishal M. Patel, Holger R. Roth
abstract: 联邦学习(FL)是一种分布式机器学习技术,能够在不显式共享数据的情况下实现协作模型训练。FL算法固有的隐私保护特性使其在医疗领域尤其具有吸引力。然而,在客户端数据分布异构的情况下,标准的FL方法不稳定,需要大量的超参数调优才能达到最佳性能。传统的超参数优化算法在现实世界的FL应用中不切实际,因为它们涉及大量的训练试验,而受限的计算预算往往难以承担。在本工作中,我们提出了一种高效的基于强化学习(RL)的联邦超参数优化算法,称为Auto-FedRL,其中在线RL代理可以根据当前的训练进度动态调整每个客户端的超参数。进行了大量实验以研究不同的搜索策略和RL代理。所提出的方法在CIFAR-10数据集的异构数据分割以及两个真实世界医学图像分割数据集上进行了验证,用于肺部CT中的新冠病变分割和腹部CT中的胰腺分割。
abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) is a distributed machine learning technique that enables collaborative model training while avoiding explicit data sharing. The inherent privacy-preserving property of FL algorithms makes them especially attractive to the medical field. However, in case of heterogeneous client data distributions, standard FL methods are unstable and require intensive hyperparameter tuning to achieve optimal performance. Conventional hyperparameter optimization algorithms are impractical in real-world FL applications as they involve numerous training trials, which are often not affordable with limited compute budgets. In this work, we propose an efficient reinforcement learning (RL)-based federated hyperparameter optimization algorithm, termed Auto-FedRL, in which an online RL agent can dynamically adjust hyperparameters of each client based on the current training progress. Extensive experiments are conducted to investigate different search strategies and RL agents. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated on a heterogeneous data split of the CIFAR-10 dataset as well as two real-world medical image segmentation datasets for COVID-19 lesion segmentation in chest CT and pancreas segmentation in abdominal CT..

title: Pengwan Yang, Yuki M. Asano, Pascal Mettes, Cees G. M. Snoek
title_en: Pengwan Yang, Yuki M. Asano, Pascal Mettes, Cees G. M. Snoek
abstract: 本文的目标是在运行时绕过少样本视频理解中对带标签示例的需求。尽管已证明其有效性,在许多实际视频场景中,即使标注少量示例也显得不现实。这在时空视频理解中尤为明显,因为随着对细节的重视程度提高,注释的复杂性也在不断增加。我们不采用人类 oracle 提供少量密集标注支持视频的少样本学习方式,而是提出一种自动学习方法,根据查询找到合适的支持视频。我们称此为自学习,并提出一种简单的自监督学习方法,以生成适合无监督检索相关样本的嵌入空间。为展示这一新颖的设置,我们首次在自学习(及少样本)环境下解决视频实例分割问题,目标是在空间和时间域中对实例进行像素级分割。我们提供了基于新型 Transformer 模型的强基线性能,并表明自学习甚至可以超越少样本学习,并且可以与少样本学习正向结合以进一步提升性能。在新基准测试上的实验表明,我们的方法实现了强劲的性能,在某些场景下与 oracle 支持相当,能够扩展到大规模未标注视频集合,并可在半监督设置中进行结合。
abstract_en: The goal of this paper is to bypass the need for labelled examples in few-shot video understanding at run time. While proven effective, in many practical video settings even labelling a few examples appears unrealistic. This is especially true as the level of details in spatio-temporal video understanding and with it, the complexity of annotations continues to increase. Rather than performing few-shot learning with a human oracle to provide a few densely labelled support videos, we propose to automatically learn to find appropriate support videos given a query. We call this self-shot learning and we outline a simple self-supervised learning method to generate an embedding space well-suited for unsupervised retrieval of relevant samples. To showcase this novel setting, we tackle, for the first time, video instance segmentation in a self-shot (and few-shot) setting, where the goal is to segment instances at the pixel-level across the spatial and temporal domains. We provide strong baseline performances that utilize a novel transformer-based model and show that self-shot learning can even surpass few-shot and can be positively combined for further performance gains. Experiments on new benchmarks show that our approach achieves strong performance, is competitive to oracle support in some settings, scales to large unlabelled video collections, and can be combined in a semi-supervised setting.

title: Pengwei Liang, Junjun Jiang, Xianming Liu, Jiayi Ma
title_en: Pengwei Liang, Junjun Jiang, Xianming Liu, Jiayi Ma
abstract: 图像融合作为生成高质量图像的替代方案,被广泛用于从多张图像中合成图像,同时也能用于从单张退化图像中进行图像恢复。图像融合的本质是整合源图像中的互补信息或最佳部分。当前的融合方法通常需要大量配对样本或复杂的损失函数和融合规则来训练监督或无监督模型。本文提出了一种基于自监督表征学习的强大学习模型用于融合任务,称为分解用于融合(DeFusion)。无需任何配对数据或复杂损失函数,DeFusion能够将源图像分解到特征嵌入空间中,从而分离出公共特征和独特特征。因此,即使无需微调,通过分解阶段联合训练的重建(投影)头,也可以在嵌入空间内实现图像融合。得益于自监督学习的发展,我们可以通过简单但直接的预文本任务训练模型,使其学习图像分解能力。预训练模型能够学习到具有很好泛化能力的有效特征:DeFusion是一个统一的通用框架,其使用与图像融合无关的数据集进行训练,可直接应用于各种图像融合任务。大量实验表明,所提出的DeFusion在不同图像融合任务中,其性能与现有最先进的方法(无论是监督还是无监督)相比具有竞争力,甚至更优。
abstract_en: Image fusion is famous as an alternative solution to generate one high-quality image from multiple images in addition to image restoration from a single degraded image. The essence of image fusion is to integrate complementary information or best parts from source images. The current fusion methods usually need a large number of paired samples or sophisticated loss functions and fusion rules to train the supervised or unsupervised model. In this paper, we propose a powerful image decomposition model for fusion task via the self-supervised representation learning, dubbed Decomposition for Fusion (DeFusion).
