In this paper, we propose an end-to-end transformer-based model to overcome these challenges. Benefited from the long-range context extraction of transformer and our holistic architecture, our method could colorize images with more diverse colors. Besides, we introduce color tokens into our approach and treat the colorization task as a classification problem, which increases the saturation of results. We also propose a series of modules to make image features interact with color tokens, and restrict the range of possible color candidates, which makes our results visually pleasing and reasonable. In addition, our method does not require any additional external priors, which ensures its well generalization capability. Extensive experiments and user studies demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance than previous works.

title: Shuchen Weng, Yi Wei, Ming-Ching Chang, Boxin Shi
title_en: Shuchen Weng, Yi Wei, Ming-Ching Chang, Boxin Shi
abstract: 实例轮廓调整在图像编辑中具有重要价值,它允许用户通过草图操作对照片中实例的轮廓进行膨胀或腐蚀。为了生成有意义的纹理同时保持清晰的用户期望轮廓,需要满足若干关键要求。由于现有开箱即用的图像编辑方法忽视了这些要求,因此不适用。为此,我们提出了一种专门的两阶段方法。第一阶段从输入图像中提取结构线索,并补全调整区域缺失的结构线索。第二阶段为结构驱动的卷积神经网络(CNN),其根据补全的结构线索生成图像纹理。在结构驱动的CNN中,我们重新设计了卷积操作的上下文采样策略和注意力机制,使其能够基于结构线索估计并排序上下文的相关性,无论上下文在图像平面中的分布如何,均优先采样排名最高的上下文。因此,结构驱动的CNN保证了具有清晰且符合用户期望轮廓的图像纹理的有意义性。此外,我们的方法无需任何语义标签作为输入,从而确保了其良好的泛化能力。我们针对相关任务调整了多个基线方法进行评估,实验结果验证了其有效性。
abstract_en: Instance contour adjustment is desirable in image editing, which allows the contour of an instance in a photo to be either dilated or eroded via user sketching. This imposes several requirements for a favorable method in order to generate meaningful textures while preserving clear user-desired contours. Due to the ignorance of these requirements, the off-the-shelf image editing methods herein are unsuited. Therefore, we propose a specialized two-stage method. The first stage extracts the structural cues from the input image, and completes the missing structural cues for the adjusted area. The second stage is a structure-driven CNN which generates image textures following the guidance of the completed structural cues. In the structure-driven CNN, we redesign the context sampling strategy of the convolution operation and attention mechanism such that they can estimate and rank the relevance of the contexts based on the structural cues, and sample the top-ranked contexts regardless of their distribution on the image plane. Thus, the meaningfulness of image textures with clear and user-desired contours are guaranteed by the structure-driven CNN. In addition, our method does not require any semantic label as input, which thus ensures its well generalization capability. We evaluate our method against several baselines adapted from the related tasks, and the experimental results demonstrate its effectiveness.

title: 陈舒宏,Matthias Zwicker
title_en: Shuhong Chen, Matthias Zwicker
abstract: 传统二维动画制作劳动密集型,通常需要动画师手动绘制每秒十二帧运动画面。尽管自动帧插值技术可缓解这一负担,但与逼真视频相比,二维动画在插值过程中面临更多特殊挑战。本工作中,我们针对先前动画插值系统未探索的挑战,重点提升感知质量。首先,我们提出SoftsplatLite(SSL),一种参数更少且感知性能更优的前向变形插值架构。其次,我们设计距离变换模块(DTM),利用线条邻近线索修正困难的纯色区域失真。第三,我们定义受限相对线性差异度量(RRLD),以自动化此前需手动收集的训练数据过程。最后,我们通过用户研究评估二维动画生成效果,确立LPIPS感知度量和切比雪夫线距离(CD)比传统PSNR和SSIM更适合作为质量评估指标。
abstract_en: Traditional 2D animation is labor-intensive, often requiring animators to manually draw twelve illustrations per second of movement. While automatic frame interpolation may ease this burden, 2D animation poses additional difficulties compared to photorealistic video. In this work, we address challenges unexplored in previous animation interpolation systems, with a focus on improving perceptual quality. Firstly, we propose SoftsplatLite (SSL), a forward-warping interpolation architecture with fewer trainable parameters and better perceptual performance. Secondly, we design a Distance Transform Module (DTM) that leverages line proximity cues to correct aberrations in difficult solid-color regions. Thirdly, we define a Restricted Relative Linear Discrepancy metric (RRLD) to automate the previously manual training data collection process. Lastly, we explore evaluation of 2D animation generation through a user study, and establish that the LPIPS perceptual metric and chamfer line distance (CD) are more appropriate measures of quality than PSNR and SSIM used in prior art.

title: Shunta Maeda
title_en: Shunta Maeda
abstract: 自Dong等人首次取得成功以来,基于深度学习的方法在单图像超分辨率领域已成为主流。该方法用深度神经网络替代了传统稀疏编码方法中所有手工设计的图像处理步骤。与显式构建高/低分辨率字典的稀疏编码方法不同,基于深度学习的方法通过多个卷积的非线性组合隐式获取字典。基于深度学习方法的一个缺点是,其性能在域外图像(与训练数据集生成方式不同的图像)上会下降。我们提出了一种具有深度字典的端到端超分辨率网络(SRDD),其中在不牺牲深度学习优势的前提下显式学习高分辨率字典。大量实验表明,显式学习高分辨率字典使网络在域外测试图像上更具鲁棒性,同时保持域内测试图像的性能。
abstract_en: Since the first success of Dong et al., the deep-learning-based approach has become dominant in the field of single-image super-resolution. This replaces all the handcrafted image processing steps of traditional sparse-coding-based methods with a deep neural network. In contrast to sparse-coding-based methods, which explicitly create high/low-resolution dictionaries, the dictionaries in deep-learning-based methods are implicitly acquired as a nonlinear combination of multiple convolutions. One disadvantage of deep-learning-based methods is that their performance is degraded for images created differently from the training dataset (out-of-domain images). We propose an end-to-end super-resolution network with a deep dictionary (SRDD), where a high-resolution dictionary is explicitly learned without sacrificing the advantages of deep learning. Extensive experiments show that explicit learning of high-resolution dictionary makes the network more robust for out-of-domain test images while maintaining the performance of the in-domain test images.

title: Shuo Lei, Xuchao Zhang, Jianfeng He, Fanglan Chen, Bowen Du, Chang-Tien Lu
title_en: Shuo Lei, Xuchao Zhang, Jianfeng He, Fanglan Chen, Bowen Du, Chang-Tien Lu
abstract: 少样本语义分割旨在仅使用少量标注示例学习分割新对象类别。大多数现有方法考虑了一种设置,其中基础类别是从与新类别相同的域中采样的。然而,在许多应用中,收集足够的训练数据进行元学习是不可行或不可能的。在本文中,我们将少样本语义分割扩展到一个新的任务,称为跨域少样本语义分割(CD-FSS),其目标是将具有充足训练标签的域的元知识泛化到资源匮乏的域。此外,为CD-FSS任务建立了一个新的基准,并通过任务难度测量进行表征。我们在所提出的基准上评估了代表性的少样本分割方法和基于迁移学习的方法,并发现当前的少样本分割方法无法解决CD-FSS问题。为了解决具有挑战性的CD-FSS问题,我们提出了一种基于金字塔锚转换的少样本分割网络(PATNet),其中域特定特征被转换为域无关特征,以便下游分割模块能够快速适应未见过的域。我们的模型在CD-FSS中分别以1-shot和5-shot方式超越了最先进的少样本分割方法,平均准确率分别提高了8.49%和10.61%。
abstract_en: Few-shot semantic segmentation aims at learning to segment a novel object class with only a few annotated examples. Most existing methods consider a setting where base classes are sampled from the same domain as the novel classes. However, in many applications, collecting sufficient training data for meta-learning is infeasible or impossible. In this paper, we extend few-shot semantic segmentation to a new task, called Cross-Domain Few-Shot Semantic Segmentation (CD-FSS), which aims to generalize the meta-knowledge from domains with sufficient training labels to low-resource domains. Moreover, a new benchmark for the CD-FSS task is established and characterized by a task difficulty measurement. We evaluate both representative few-shot segmentation methods and transfer learning based methods on the proposed benchmark and find that current few-shot segmentation methods fail to address CD-FSS. To tackle the challenging CD-FSS problem, we propose a novel Pyramid-Anchor-Transformation based few-shot segmentation network (PATNet), in which domain-specific features are transformed into domain-agnostic ones for downstream segmentation modules to fast adapt to unseen domains. Our model outperforms the state-of-the-art few-shot segmentation method in CD-FSS by 8.49% and 10.61% average accuracies in 1-shot and 5-shot, respectively.

title: Shuo Li, Fang Liu, Zehua Hao, Kaibo Zhao, Licheng Jiao
title_en: Shuo Li, Fang Liu, Zehua Hao, Kaibo Zhao, Licheng Jiao
abstract: 大多数少样本图像分类方法基于任务进行训练。通常,任务是基于具有大量标记图像的基类构建的,这需要大量精力。无监督少样本图像分类方法不需要标记图像,因为它们要求任务基于未标记图像构建。为了高效地利用未标记图像构建任务,我们提出了一种新颖的单阶段聚类方法:学习特征到聚类空间(LF2CS)。该方法首先通过固定聚类中心建立可分离的聚类空间,然后使用可学习模型将特征映射到聚类空间。基于LF2CS,我们提出了一种图像采样和c-way k-shot任务构建方法。通过该方法,我们提出了一种新颖的无监督少样本图像分类方法,联合学习可学习模型、聚类和少样本图像分类。实验和可视化结果表明,我们的LF2CS在新类别上具有强大的泛化能力。从图像采样角度,我们根据任务构建方式实现了四个基线。基于Conv-4和ResNet-12主干网络,在Omniglot、miniImageNet、tieredImageNet和CIFARFS数据集上进行实验。实验结果表明,我们的方法优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Most few-shot image classification methods are trained based on tasks. Usually, tasks are built on base classes with a large number of labeled images, which consumes large effort. Unsupervised few-shot image classification methods do not need labeled images, because they require tasks to be built on unlabeled images. In order to efficiently build tasks with unlabeled images, we propose a novel single-stage clustering method: Learning Features into Clustering Space (LF2CS), which first set a separable clustering space by fixing the clustering centers and then use a learnable model to learn features into the clustering space. Based on our LF2CS, we put forward an image sampling and c-way k-shot task building method. With this, we propose a novel unsupervised few-shot image classification method, which jointly learns the learnable model, clustering and few-shot image classification. Experiments and visualization show that our LF2CS has a strong ability to generalize to the novel categories. From the perspective of image sampling, we implement four baselines according to how to build tasks. We conduct experiments on the Omniglot, miniImageNet, tieredImageNet and CIFARFS datasets based on the Conv-4 and ResNet-12 backbones. Experimental results show that ours outperform the state-of-the-art methods.

title: 杨硕,徐畅
title_en: Shuo Yang, Chang Xu
abstract: 对抗鲁棒性对于深度学习模型抵御对抗攻击至关重要。尽管对抗训练被认为是提升模型对抗鲁棒性的最有效方法之一,但通常会导致自然准确率下降。本文认为,对于可攻击样本,传统对抗训练通过固定大小的扰动球生成的对抗样本会远离原始类别向目标类别偏移,从而导致模型在自然目标类别上的性能大幅下降,进而降低自然准确率。为此,我们提出数据自适应对抗训练(DAAT),通过自然训练的校准网络帮助每个自然样本自适应调整扰动球的大小。此外,动态训练策略使DAAT模型在保持显著自然准确率的同时具备出色的鲁棒性。基于一个玩具示例,我们从理论上证明了对抗训练导致自然准确率下降的现象,并展示了数据自适应扰动大小如何帮助模型抵御这一现象。最后,基于基准数据集的实验证明,与强基线模型相比,DAAT模型在自然准确率上实现了显著提升。
abstract_en: Adversarial robustness is critical for deep learning models to defend against adversarial attacks. Although adversarial training is considered to be one of the most effective ways to improve the model’s adversarial robustness, it usually yields models with lower natural accuracy. In this paper, we argue that, for the attackable examples, traditional adversarial training which utilizes a fixed size perturbation ball can create adversarial examples that deviate far away from the original class towards the target class. Thus, the model’s performance on the natural target class will drop drastically, which leads to the decline of natural accuracy. To this end, we propose the Data-Adaptive Adversarial Training (DAAT) which adaptively adjusts the perturbation ball to a proper size for each of the natural examples with the help of a natural trained calibration network. Besides, a dynamic training strategy empowers the DAAT models with impressive robustness while retaining remarkable natural accuracy. Based on a toy example, we theoretically prove the recession of the natural accuracy caused by adversarial training and show how the data-adaptive perturbation size helps the model resist it. Finally, empirical experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the significant improvement of DAAT models on natural accuracy compared with strong baselines.

title: Shuxian Liang, Xu Shen, Jianqiang Huang, Xian-Sheng Hua
title_en: Shuxian Liang, Xu Shen, Jianqiang Huang, Xian-Sheng Hua
abstract: 本文探讨了视频识别中的细节,旨在提高准确性。观察到最近的工作中大多数失败案例集中在非常相似的动作(如高踢与侧踢)之间的误分类,这些需要捕捉细粒度的判别细节。为了解决这个问题,我们提出了用于视频动作识别的概要到细节网络。首先,引入了一个概要网络来预测前k个可能的动作,并生成概要(细节的位置、尺度和上下文特征)。其次,根据概要,应用一个细节网络来提取输入中的判别细节并推断最终的动作预测。所提出的概要到细节网络使我们能够以端到端的方式从头开始训练模型,并研究各种概要/细节识别架构。在基准数据集(包括Kinetics-400、Mini-Kinetics和Something-Something V1 & V2)上的大量实验表明,我们的方法比竞争基线更有效且更高效。代码可在:https://github.com/liang4sx/S2DNet 获取。
abstract_en: In this paper, we explore the details in video recognition with the aim to improve the accuracy. It is observed that most failure cases in recent works fall on the mis-classifications among very similar actions (such as high kick vs. side kick) that need a capturing of fine-grained discriminative details. To solve this problem, we propose synopsis-to-detail networks for video action recognition. Firstly, a synopsis network is introduced to predict the top-k likely actions and generate the synopsis (location & scale of details and contextual features). Secondly, according to the synopsis, a detail network is applied to extract the discriminative details in the input and infer the final action prediction. The proposed synopsis-to-detail networks enable us to train models directly from scratch in an end-to-end manner and to investigate various architectures for synopsis/detail recognition. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets, including Kinetics-400, Mini-Kinetics and Something-Something V1 & V2, show that our method is more effective and efficient than the competitive baselines. Code is available at: https://github.com/liang4sx/S2DNet.

title: Siddhant Bansal, Chetan Arora, C.V. Jawahar
title_en: Siddhant Bansal, Chetan Arora, C.V. Jawahar
abstract: 过程学习涉及识别关键步骤并确定其逻辑顺序以完成任务。现有方法通常使用第三人称视频进行学习,导致被操作对象在视觉上较小且常被演员遮挡,从而产生显著误差。相比之下,我们观察到通过第一人称(以自我为中心)可穿戴摄像头获取的视频能够提供无遮挡且清晰的动作视图。然而,从第一人称视频进行过程学习具有挑战性,因为(a)由于佩戴者的头部运动,摄像头视角会发生剧烈变化;(b)由于视频的无约束性,存在无关帧。因此,当前最先进的方法假设动作在时间上大致同步且持续时间相同,这一假设不成立。相反,我们提出利用关键步骤在视频间的时序对应关系。为此,我们提出了一种新颖的自监督对应与剪切(CnC)框架用于过程学习。CnC通过多个视频中关键步骤的时序对应关系识别并利用这些关系以学习过程。实验表明,CnC在基准数据集ProceL和CrossTask上分别优于现有方法5.2%和6.3%。此外,针对使用第一人称视频的过程学习,我们提出了包含130名受试者执行16项任务的62小时视频数据集EgoProceL。项目页面(https://sid2697.github.io/egoprocel/)提供了源代码和数据集。
abstract_en: Procedure learning involves identifying the key-steps and determining their logical order to perform a task. Existing approaches commonly use third-person videos for learning the procedure, making the manipulated object small in appearance and often occluded by the actor, leading to significant errors. In contrast, we observe that videos obtained from first-person (egocentric) wearable cameras provide an unobstructed and clear view of the action. However, procedure learning from egocentric videos is challenging because (a) the camera view undergoes extreme changes due to the wearer’s head motion, and (b) the presence of unrelated frames due to the unconstrained nature of the videos. Due to this, current state-of-the-art methods’ assumptions that the actions occur at approximately the same time and are of the same duration, do not hold. Instead, we propose to use the signal provided by the temporal correspondences between key-steps across videos. To this end, we present a novel self-supervised Correspond and Cut (CnC) framework for procedure learning. CnC identifies and utilizes the temporal correspondences between the key-steps across multiple videos to learn the procedure. Our experiments show that CnC outperforms the state-of-the-art on the benchmark ProceL and CrossTask datasets by 5.2% and 6.3%, respectively. Furthermore, for procedure learning using egocentric videos, we propose the EgoProceL dataset consisting of 62 hours of videos captured by 130 subjects performing 16 tasks. The source code and the dataset are available on the project page https://sid2697.github.io/egoprocel/.

title: Sijie Zhu, Zhe Lin, Scott Cohen, Jason Kuen, Zhifei Zhang, Chen Chen
title_en: Sijie Zhu, Zhe Lin, Scott Cohen, Jason Kuen, Zhifei Zhang, Chen Chen
abstract: 面向合成的物体搜索旨在根据背景图像和查询边界框,找到最兼容的物体进行合成。先前的工作主要关注学习前景物体与背景之间的兼容性,但未能从大规模数据中学习其他重要因素,即几何和光照。为更进一步,本文提出GALA(几何与光照感知),一种通用的前景物体搜索方法,通过判别建模几何和光照兼容性,实现开放世界图像合成。值得注意的是,该方法在CAIS数据集上取得了最先进的结果,并在大规模开放世界数据集(如Pixabay和Open Images)上表现出良好的泛化能力。此外,我们的方法能够有效处理非框场景,即用户仅提供背景图像而无任何输入边界框。实验在真实世界图像上进行,展示了所提方法在合成感知搜索、前景物体自动定位/缩放预测中的应用。
abstract_en: Compositing-aware object search aims to find the most compatible objects for compositing given a background image and a query bounding box. Previous works focus on learning compatibility between the foreground object and background, but fail to learn other important factors from large-scale data, i.e. geometry and lighting. To move a step further, this paper proposes GALA (Geometry-and-Lighting-Aware), a generic foreground object search method with discriminative modeling on geometry and lighting compatibility for open-world image compositing. Remarkably, it achieves state-of-the-art results on the CAIS dataset and generalizes well on large-scale open-world datasets, i.e. Pixabay and Open Images. In addition, our method can effectively handle non-box scenarios, where users only provide background images without any input bounding box. Experiments are conducted on real-world images to showcase applications of the proposed method for compositing-aware search and automatic location/scale prediction for the foreground object.

title: Simon Doll, Richard Schulz, Lukas Schneider, Viviane Benzin, Markus Enzweiler, Hendrik P.A. Lensch
title_en: Simon Doll, Richard Schulz, Lukas Schneider, Viviane Benzin, Markus Enzweiler, Hendrik P.A. Lensch
abstract: 基于DETR的核心思想,本文提出了一种以对象为中心的三维目标检测框架,该框架通过有限数量的三维对象查询进行操作,而非密集的边界框提案后接非极大值抑制。在图像特征提取后,采用仅解码器的Transformer架构在基于集合的损失函数上进行训练。SpatialDETR通过注意力机制在单个图像内及不同视角之间推断分类和边界框估计。为在注意力块中融合多视角信息,我们引入了一种新颖的几何位置编码,该编码结合视角射线几何,显式考虑外在和内在相机设置。这样,空间感知的跨视角注意力能够利用任意接收场整合跨传感器数据,从而整合全局上下文。在nuScenes基准上的大量实验展示了全局注意力的潜力,并取得了最先进的性能。代码可在https://github.com/cgtuebingen/SpatialDETR获取。
abstract_en: Based on the key idea of DETR this paper introduces an object-centric 3D object detection framework that operates on a limited number of 3D object queries instead of dense bounding box proposals followed by non-maximum suppression. After image feature extraction a decoder-only transformer architecture is trained on a set-based loss. SpatialDETR infers the classification and bounding box estimates based on attention both spatially within each image and across the different views. To fuse the multi-view information in the attention block we introduce a novel geometric positional encoding that incorporates the view ray geometry to explicitly consider the extrinsic and intrinsic camera setup. This way, the spatially-aware cross-view attention exploits arbitrary receptive fields to integrate cross-sensor data and therefore global context. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes benchmark demonstrate the potential of global attention and result in state-of-the-art performance. Code available at https://github.com/cgtuebingen/SpatialDETR.

title: Simon Reiß, Constantin Seibold, Alexander Freytag, Erik Rodner, Rainer Stiefelhagen
title_en: Simon Reiß, Constantin Seibold, Alexander Freytag, Erik Rodner, Rainer Stiefelhagen
abstract: 语义体分割面临需要体素级标注真实数据的挑战,而获取此类数据需要巨大的努力。本文研究了如何从稀疏标注的体数据中训练模型,即仅对体数据中个别切片进行标注的情况。通过将该场景建模为半弱监督问题(仅部分区域有标注),我们获得了令人惊讶的结果:若在训练过程中适当约束有效模型的假设空间,昂贵的密集体标注可以被低成本的、部分标注的体数据替代,且对准确性影响有限。通过我们的对比约束正则化(Con2R)方法,我们证明了3D卷积模型可以仅使用不到4%的二维真实标签进行训练,仍能达到全监督基线模型(使用密集体标注)88%的准确性。为深入理解Con2R的成功原因,我们研究了半监督算法在新型体半弱监督场景中的迁移效果。通过这种方式,我们探索了视网膜液体和脑肿瘤分割任务,并详细分析了在极端稀疏标签场景下准确率的演变过程。
abstract_en: Semantic volume segmentation suffers from the requirement of having voxel-wise annotated ground-truth data, which requires immense effort to obtain. In this work, we investigate how models can be trained from sparsely annotated volumes, i.e. volumes with only individual slices annotated. By formulating the scenario as a semi-weakly supervised problem where only some regions in the volume are annotated, we obtain surprising results: expensive dense volumetric annotations can be replaced by cheap, partially labeled volumes with limited impact on accuracy if the hypothesis space of valid models gets properly constrained during training. With our Contrastive Constrained Regularization (Con2R), we demonstrate that 3D convolutional models can be trained with less than 4% of only two dimensional ground-truth labels and still reach up to 88% accuracy of fully supervised baseline models with dense volumetric annotations. To get insights into Con2Rs success, we study how strong semi-supervised algorithms transfer to our new volumetric semi-weakly supervised setting. In this manner, we explore retinal fluid and brain tumor segmentation and give a detailed look into accuracy progression for scenarios with extremely scarce labels.

title: Simon Schreiberhuber, Jean-Baptiste Weibel, Timothy Patten, Markus Vincze
title_en: Simon Schreiberhuber, Jean-Baptiste Weibel, Timothy Patten, Markus Vincze
abstract: 基于结构光的深度传感器通过从捕获的像素强度中提取模式位置,独立于场景外观提供精确的深度信息。特别是,空间邻域编码是一种流行的结构光方法,适用于即插即用硬件。然而,它会因场景几何结构在像素附近的投影模式发生形变和碎片化而受到影响。这迫使算法在深度预测精度与对模式碎片化或外观变化的鲁棒性之间寻找微妙平衡。虽然立体匹配在牺牲精度的情况下提供了更高的鲁棒性,但我们证明,学习回归像素在投影模式中的位置不仅在与分类结合时更精确,还可以通过引入权重自适应层实现同等的鲁棒性。我们提出以粗到细的方式将回归问题分解为更小的分类子问题,该层通过高效实现每个像素的多层感知机分支,应用于卷积神经网络提取的特征。由于我们的方法需要全监督,我们在足够接近真实世界领域的渲染数据集上训练算法。在独立采集的真实世界数据集上,我们证明我们的网络优于现有最先进的方法,并且显著优于其他基于回归的方法。
abstract_en: Structured light-based depth sensors provide accurate depth information independently of the scene appearance by extracting pattern positions from the captured pixel intensities. Spatial neighborhood encoding, in particular, is a popular structured light approach for off-the-shelf hardware. However, it suffers from the distortion and fragmentation of the projected pattern by the scene’s geometry in the vicinity of a pixel. This forces algorithms to find a delicate balance between depth prediction accuracy and robustness to pattern fragmentation or appearance change. While stereo matching provides more robustness at the expense of accuracy, we show that learning to regress a pixel’s position within the projected pattern is not only more accurate when combined with classification but can be made equally robust. We propose to split the regression problem into smaller classification sub-problems in a coarse-to-fine manner with the use of a weight-adaptive layer that efficiently implements branching per-pixel Multilayer Perceptrons applied to features extracted by a Convolutional Neural Network. As our approach requires full supervision, we train our algorithm on a rendered dataset sufficiently close to the real-world domain. On a separately captured real-world dataset, we show that our network outperforms state-of-the-art and is significantly more robust than other regression-based approaches.

title: Simon Vandenhende, Dhruv Mahajan, Filip Radenovic, Deepti Ghadiyaram
title_en: Simon Vandenhende, Dhruv Mahajan, Filip Radenovic, Deepti Ghadiyaram
abstract: A visual counterfactual explanation replaces image regions in a query image with regions from a distractor image such that the system’s decision on the transformed image changes to the distractor class. In this work, we present a novel framework for computing visual counterfactual explanations based on two key ideas. First, we enforce that the replaced and replacer regions contain the same semantic part, resulting in more semantically consistent explanations. Second, we use multiple distractor images in a computationally efficient way and obtain more discriminative explanations with fewer region replacements. Our approach is 27 % more semantically consistent and an order of magnitude faster than a competing method on three fine-grained image recognition datasets. We highlight the utility of our counterfactuals over existing works through machine teaching experiments where we teach humans to classify different bird species. We also complement our explanations with the vocabulary of parts and attributes that contributed the most to the system’s decision. In this task as well, we obtain state-of-the-art results when using our counterfactual explanations relative to existing works, reinforcing the importance of semantically consistent explanations. Source code is available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/visual-counterfactuals.
abstract_en: A visual counterfactual explanation replaces image regions in a query image with regions from a distractor image such that the system’s decision on the transformed image changes to the distractor class. In this work, we present a novel framework for computing visual counterfactual explanations based on two key ideas. First, we enforce that the replaced and replacer regions contain the same semantic part, resulting in more semantically consistent explanations. Second, we use multiple distractor images in a computationally efficient way and obtain more discriminative explanations with fewer region replacements. Our approach is 27 % more semantically consistent and an order of magnitude faster than a competing method on three fine-grained image recognition datasets. We highlight the utility of our counterfactuals over existing works through machine teaching experiments where we teach humans to classify different bird species. We also complement our explanations with the vocabulary of parts and attributes that contributed the most to the system’s decision. In this task as well, we obtain state-of-the-art results when using our counterfactual explanations relative to existing works, reinforcing the importance of semantically consistent explanations. Source code is available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/visual-counterfactuals.

title: Simone Rossetti, Damiano Zappia, Marta Sanzari, Marco Schaerf, Fiora Pirri
title_en: Simone Rossetti, Damiano Zappia, Marta Sanzari, Marco Schaerf, Fiora Pirri
abstract: 弱监督语义分割(WSSS)研究在仅以图像-类别标签作为监督的情况下,探索了多种方向以改进典型的CNN加类别激活图(CAM)加优化的流程。尽管与全监督方法的差距已有所缩小,但在此框架内进一步缩小差距似乎不太可能。另一方面,基于视觉Transformer(ViT)的WSSS方法尚未探索有效的CAM替代方案。ViT特征在自监督学习中已被证明能够保留场景布局和物体边界。为验证这一发现,我们证明了全局最大池化(GMP)能够进一步强化Transformer在自监督方法中的优势,通过利用补丁特征与类别概率协商像素标签概率。本文提出了一种新的WSSS方法,称为ViT-PCM(ViT补丁-类别映射),不基于CAM。所提出的端到端网络通过单一优化过程进行学习,实现分割掩码的精细形状和准确定位。我们的模型在基线伪掩码(BPM)上超越了现有最先进方法,在PascalVOC 2012验证集上达到69.3%的mIoU。我们证明,尽管参数数量最少,我们的方法仍优于所有其他方法。简而言之,定量和定性结果表明,ViT-PCM是基于CNN-CAM架构的优秀替代方案。
abstract_en: Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation (WSSS) research has explored many directions to improve the typical pipeline CNN plus class activation maps (CAM) plus refinements, given the image-class label as the only supervision. Though the gap with the fully supervised methods is reduced, further abating the spread seems unlikely within this framework. On the other hand, WSSS methods based on Vision Transformers (ViT) have not yet explored valid alternatives to CAM. ViT features have been shown to retain a scene layout, and object boundaries in self-supervised learning. To confirm these findings, we prove that the advantages of transformers in self-supervised methods are further strengthened by Global Max Pooling (GMP), which can leverage patch features to negotiate pixel-label probability with class probability. This work proposes a new WSSS method dubbed ViT-PCM (ViT Patch-Class Mapping), not based on CAM. The end-to-end presented network learns with a single optimization process, refined shape and proper localization for segmentation masks. Our model outperforms the state-of-the-art on baseline pseudo-masks (BPM), where we achieve 69.3\% mIoU on PascalVOC 2012 validation set. We show that our approach has the least set of parameters, though obtaining higher accuracy than all other approaches. In a sentence, quantitative and qualitative results of our method reveal that ViT-PCM is an excellent alternative to CNN-CAM based architectures.

title: Sipeng Zheng, Shizhe Chen, Qin Jin
title_en: Sipeng Zheng, Shizhe Chen, Qin Jin
abstract: 少样本动作识别旨在基于目标动作类别的有限标注数据识别测试视频中的动作。主流方法将视频投影到度量空间中并通过最近邻进行分类。它们主要通过全局或时间对齐单独衡量视频相似性,而最优匹配应为多层级。然而,随着对更细粒度视觉线索的关注,由粗到细的匹配学习复杂度迅速上升,缺乏详细的局部监督是另一挑战。本文提出一种分层匹配模型,通过缩放匹配模块支持全局、时间及空间层级的全面相似性度量。我们进一步在训练中提出混合监督的分层对比学习(HCL),不仅利用监督对比学习区分不同层级的视频,还通过循环一致性作为弱监督对判别性时间片段或空间块进行对齐。我们的模型在四个基准数据集上取得了最先进性能,特别是在最具挑战性的1-shot动作识别设置中。代码将在补充材料中提供。
abstract_en: Few-shot action recognition aims to recognize actions in test videos based on limited annotated data of target action classes. The dominant approaches project videos into a metric space and classify videos via nearest neighboring. They mainly measure video similarities using global or temporal alignment alone, while an optimum matching should be multi-level. However, the complexity of learning coarse-to-fine matching quickly rises as we focus on finer-grained visual cues, and the lack of detailed local supervision is another challenge. In this work, we propose a hierarchical matching model to support comprehensive similarity measure at global, temporal and spatial levels via a zoom-in matching module.We further propose a mixed-supervised hierarchical contrastive learning (HCL) in training, which not only employs supervised contrastive learning to differentiate videos at different levels, but also utilizes cycle consistency as weak supervision to align discriminative temporal clips or spatial patches. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on four benchmarks especially under the most challenging 1-shot action recognition setting. Code will be provided in supplementary material.

title: Sirui Xu, Yu-Xiong Wang, Liang-Yan Gui
title_en: Sirui Xu, Yu-Xiong Wang, Liang-Yan Gui
abstract: 基于历史姿态序列的多样化人体运动预测近年来受到越来越多的关注。尽管取得了快速进展,现有方法主要通过基于似然的采样来捕捉人体运动的多模态特性,但模式坍缩现象普遍存在。本文提出了一种简单而有效的方案,通过将随机采样的代码与确定性可学习组件——锚点(anchors)分离,以提升样本精度与多样性。进一步地,锚点被分解为空间锚点和时间锚点,为时空差异提供了具有吸引力的可解释性控制。原则上,我们的时空锚点采样方法(STARS)可应用于不同的运动预测模型。本文提出了一种交互增强的时空图卷积网络(IE-STGCN),该网络编码了人体运动的先验知识(如空间局部性),并将锚点整合其中。大量实验表明,我们的方法在随机预测和确定性预测中均优于现有最先进方法,表明其作为统一框架在建模人体运动方面的有效性。我们的代码和预训练模型可在https://github.com/Sirui-Xu/STARS获取。
abstract_en: Predicting diverse human motions given a sequence of historical poses has received increasing attention. Despite rapid progress, existing work captures the multi-modal nature of human motions primarily through likelihood-based sampling, where the mode collapse has been widely observed. In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective approach that disentangles randomly sampled codes with a deterministic learnable component named anchors to promote sample precision and diversity. Anchors are further factorized into spatial anchors and temporal anchors, which provide attractively interpretable control over spatial-temporal disparity. In principle, our spatial-temporal anchor-based sampling (STARS) can be applied to different motion predictors. Here we propose an interaction-enhanced spatial-temporal graph convolutional network (IE-STGCN) that encodes prior knowledge of human motions (e.g., spatial locality), and incorporate the anchors into it. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms state of the art in both stochastic and deterministic prediction, suggesting it as a unified framework for modeling human motions. Our code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/Sirui-Xu/STARS.

title: Siwei Zhang, Qianli Ma, Yan Zhang, Zhiyin Qian, Taein Kwon, Marc Pollefeys, Federica Bogo, Siyu Tang
title_en: Siwei Zhang, Qianli Ma, Yan Zhang, Zhiyin Qian, Taein Kwon, Marc Pollefeys, Federica Bogo, Siyu Tang
abstract: 从第一视角理解社会互动对许多应用至关重要,例如辅助机器人和增强现实/虚拟现实。理解互动伙伴的身体姿态和运动是推理互动的关键。然而,该领域的研究严重受限于缺乏数据集。现有数据集在规模、捕获/标注模式、真实标签质量或互动多样性方面存在局限。我们通过提出EgoBody数据集填补这一空白,该数据集是首个针对复杂三维场景中第一视角下的人体姿态、形状和运动估计的大型数据集。我们使用微软HoloLens2头显记录丰富的第一视角数据流(包括RGB、深度、眼动追踪、头部和手部追踪)。为获得精确的三维真实标签,我们通过多台Kinect设备组成的装置校准头显,并将表达性SMPL-X身体网格拟合到多视角RGB-D帧中,重建与场景相对的三维人体形状和姿态随时间的变化。我们收集了68个序列,涵盖多样化的互动场景,并提出了首个基于第一视角的社交伙伴三维全身姿态和形状估计基准。我们广泛评估了最先进的方法,指出了其在第一视角场景中的局限性,并通过我们的高质量标注解决了这些局限性。数据和代码将用于研究目的。
abstract_en: Understanding social interactions from egocentric views is crucial for many applications, ranging from assistive robotics to AR/VR. Key to reasoning about interactions is to understand the body pose and motion of the interaction partner from the egocentric view. However, research in this area is severely hindered by the lack of datasets. Existing datasets are limited in terms of either size, capture/annotation modalities, ground-truth quality, or interaction diversity. We fill this gap by proposing EgoBody, a novel large-scale dataset for human pose, shape and motion estimation from egocentric views, during interactions in complex 3D scenes. We employ Microsoft HoloLens2 headsets to record rich egocentric data streams (including RGB, depth, eye gaze, head and hand tracking). To obtain accurate 3D ground truth, we calibrate the headset with a multi-Kinect rig and fit expressive SMPL-X body meshes to multi-view RGB-D frames, reconstructing 3D human shapes and poses relative to the scene, over time. We collect 68 sequences, spanning diverse interaction scenarios, and propose the first benchmark for 3D full-body pose and shape estimation of the social partner from egocentric views. We extensively evaluate state-of-the-art methods, highlight their limitations in the egocentric scenario, and address such limitations leveraging our high-quality annotations. Data and code will be available for research purposes.

title: Sixian Zhang, Weijie Li, Xinhang Song, Yubing Bai, Shuqiang Jiang
title_en: Sixian Zhang, Weijie Li, Xinhang Song, Yubing Bai, Shuqiang Jiang
abstract: 物体导航是让智能体导航至目标物体的任务。现有研究尝试在新环境中扩展导航能力,并在训练环境中观察到的目标物体类别上实现合理性能。然而,这种设置在现实世界场景中存在一定局限性,因为导航至未见过的物体类别通常是不可避免的。本文聚焦于仅基于有限训练知识,在新环境中导航至未见过物体的问题。与常见的ObjectNav任务相同,我们的智能体仍以自我为中心的观察和目标物体类别作为输入,无需任何额外输入。我们的解决方案是让智能体通过合成目标物体的特征来“想象”未见过的物体。我们提出了一种生成式元对抗网络(GMAN),主要由特征生成器和环境元判别器组成,旨在分两步生成未见过物体和新环境的特征。前者基于物体类别的语义嵌入生成未见过物体的初始特征,后者使生成器进一步学习新环境的背景特征,逐步将生成的特征调整以逼近目标物体的真实特征。调整后的特征作为更具体的表示,引导智能体进行导航。此外,为通过少量观察快速更新生成器,整个对抗框架以基于梯度的元学习方式进行学习。在AI2THOR和RoboTHOR模拟器上的实验结果验证了所提方法在导航至未见过物体类别上的有效性。
abstract_en: Object navigation is a task to let the agent navigate to a target object. Prevailing works attempt to expand navigation ability in new environments and achieve reasonable performance on the seen object categories that have been observed in training environments. However, this setting is somewhat limited in real world scenario, where navigating to unseen object categories is generally unavoidable. In this paper, we focus on the problem of navigating to unseen objects in new environments only based on limited training knowledge. Same as the common ObjectNav tasks, our agent still gets the egocentric observation and target object category as the input and does not require any extra inputs. Our solution is to let the agent “imagine"" the unseen object by synthesizing features of the target object. We propose a generative meta-adversarial network (GMAN), which is mainly composed of a feature generator and an environmental meta discriminator, aiming to generate features for unseen objects and new environments in two steps. The former generates the initial features of the unseen objects based on the semantic embedding of the object category. The latter enables the generator to further learn the background characteristics of the new environment, progressively adapting the generated features to approximate the real features of the target object. The adapted features serve as a more specific representation of the target to guide the agent. Moreover, to fast update the generator with a few observations, the entire adversarial framework is learned in the gradient-based meta-learning manner. The experimental results on AI2THOR and RoboTHOR simulators demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in navigating to unseen object categories.

title: Siyou Lin, Hongwen Zhang, Zerong Zheng, Ruizhi Shao, Yebin Liu
title_en: Siyou Lin, Hongwen Zhang, Zerong Zheng, Ruizhi Shao, Yebin Liu
abstract: 我们提出FITE,一种用于服装中人体化身建模的First-Implicit-Then-Explicit框架。我们的框架首先学习表示粗略服装拓扑的隐式曲面模板,然后利用这些模板指导点集的生成,进一步捕捉姿态依赖的服装变形(如褶皱)。我们的流程结合了隐式和显式表示的优点,即能够处理拓扑变化并高效捕捉细节。我们还提出了扩散皮肤绑定以促进模板训练,特别是针对宽松服装,并提出了基于投影的姿势编码方法,从网格模板中提取姿势信息,无需预定义的UV映射或连接性。我们的代码已公开在https://github.com/jsnln/fite。
abstract_en: We present FITE, a First-Implicit-Then-Explicit framework for modeling human avatars in clothing. Our framework first learns implicit surface templates representing the coarse clothing topology, and then employs the templates to guide the generation of point sets which further capture pose-dependent clothing deformations such as wrinkles. Our pipeline incorporates the merits of both implicit and explicit representations, namely, the ability to handle varying topology and the ability to efficiently capture fine details. We also propose diffused skinning to facilitate template training especially for loose clothing, and projection-based pose-encoding to extract pose information from mesh templates without predefined UV map or connectivity. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/jsnln/fite.

title: Siyuan Li, Martin Danelljan, Henghui Ding, Thomas E. Huang, Fisher Yu
title_en: Siyuan Li, Martin Danelljan, Henghui Ding, Thomas E. Huang, Fisher Yu
abstract: 当前多类别多目标跟踪(MOT)指标通过类别标签对跟踪结果进行分组,以实现每个类别的评估。同样,MOT方法通常仅将相同类别的目标进行关联。这两种在MOT中普遍采用的策略隐含地假设分类性能接近完美。然而,在近期大规模MOT数据集中,这一假设并不成立,这些数据集包含大量类别,其中包含许多罕见或语义相似的类别。因此,由此产生的分类不准确会导致跟踪效果不佳,且对跟踪器的基准测试不足。我们通过将分类与跟踪解耦来解决这些问题。我们引入了一种新的指标——Track Every Thing Accuracy(TETA),将跟踪测量分解为三个子因素:定位、关联和分类,即使在分类不准确的情况下也能对跟踪性能进行全面评估。TETA还解决了大规模跟踪数据集中存在的标注不完整问题。我们进一步提出了一种Track Every Thing跟踪器(TETer),其通过类示例匹配(CEM)进行关联。实验表明,TETA能够更全面地评估跟踪器,而TETer在具有挑战性的大规模数据集BDD100K和TAO上相比现有方法取得了显著提升。
abstract_en: Current multi-category Multiple Object Tracking (MOT) metrics use class labels to group tracking results for per-class evaluation. Similarly, MOT methods typically only associate objects with the same class predictions. These two prevalent strategies in MOT implicitly assume that the classification performance is near-perfect. However, this is far from the case in recent large-scale MOT datasets, which contain large numbers of classes with many rare or semantically similar categories. Therefore, the resulting inaccurate classification leads to sub-optimal tracking and inadequate benchmarking of trackers. We address these issues by disentangling classification from tracking. We introduce a new metric, Track Every Thing Accuracy (TETA), breaking tracking measurement into three sub-factors: localization, association, and classification, allowing comprehensive benchmarking of tracking performance even under inaccurate classification. TETA also deals with the challenging incomplete annotation problem in large-scale tracking datasets. We further introduce a Track Every Thing tracker (TETer), that performs association using Class Exemplar Matching (CEM). Our experiments show that TETA evaluates trackers more comprehensively, and TETer achieves significant improvements on the challenging large-scale datasets BDD100K and TAO compared to the state-of-the-art.

title: Siyuan Liang, Longkang Li, Yanbo Fan, Xiaojun Jia, Jingzhi Li, Baoyuan Wu, Xiaochun Cao
title_en: Siyuan Liang, Longkang Li, Yanbo Fan, Xiaojun Jia, Jingzhi Li, Baoyuan Wu, Xiaochun Cao
abstract: 近期研究表明,基于深度模型的检测器在黑盒场景(攻击者无法访问模型信息)中也容易受到对抗样本的影响。现有大多数攻击方法旨在最小化真正率,但往往表现出较差的攻击性能,因为攻击后的边界框周围可能检测到另一个次优的边界框作为新的真正率。为解决这一挑战,我们提出同时最小化真正率并最大化假正率,这可以鼓励更多假正样本阻断新真正率边界框的生成。该问题被建模为多目标优化(MOP)问题,通用算法可以搜索帕累托最优解。然而,我们的任务包含超过两百万个决策变量,导致搜索效率低下。因此,我们扩展了标准遗传算法,引入随机子集选择和分而治之策略,称为GARSDC,显著提升了效率。此外,为缓解通用算法对种群质量的敏感性,我们生成了梯度先验初始种群,利用具有相似主干的检测器之间的可迁移性。与现有先进攻击方法相比,GARSDC在大量实验中将mAP平均降低了12.0,并将查询次数减少了约1000倍。我们的代码可在https://github.com/LiangSiyuan21/GARSDC获取。
abstract_en: Recent studies have shown that detectors based on deep models are vulnerable to adversarial examples, even in the black-box scenario where the attacker cannot access the model information. Most existing attack methods aim to minimize the true positive rate, which often shows poor attack performance, as another sub-optimal bounding box may be detected around the attacked bounding box to be the new true positive one. To settle this challenge, we propose to minimize the true positive rate and maximize the false positive rate, which can encourage more false positive objects to block the generation of new true positive bounding boxes. It is modeled as a multi-objective optimization (MOP) problem, of which the generic algorithm can search the Pareto-optimal. However, our task has more than two million decision variables, leading to low searching efficiency. Thus, we extend the standard \textbf{G}enetic \textbf{A}lgorithm with \textbf{R}andom \textbf{S}ubset selection and \textbf{D}ivide-and-\textbf{C}onquer, called GARSDC, which significantly improves the efficiency. Moreover, to alleviate the sensitivity to population quality in generic algorithms, we generate a gradient-prior initial population, utilizing the transferability between different detectors with similar backbones. Compared with the state-of-art attack methods, GARSDC decreases by an average 12.0 in the mAP and queries by about 1000 times in extensive experiments. Our codes can be found at https://github.com/LiangSiyuan21/GARSDC.

title: Siyuan Zhou, Liu Liu, Li Niu, Liqing Zhang
title_en: Siyuan Zhou, Liu Liu, Li Niu, Liqing Zhang
abstract: 物体放置旨在将前景物体以合适的位置和尺寸放置在背景图像上。在本工作中,我们将物体放置问题视为图补全问题,并提出了一种新颖的图补全模块(GCM)。背景场景通过具有不同空间位置和不同感受野的多个节点的图进行表示。前景物体被编码为一个特殊节点,应插入到该图中的合理位置。我们还基于GCM的结构设计了双路径框架,以充分利用标注的合成图像。在OPA数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在生成合理物体放置的同时,显著优于现有方法,且不损失多样性。
abstract_en: Object placement aims to place a foreground object over a background image with a suitable location and size. In this work, we treat object placement as a graph completion problem and propose a novel graph completion module (GCM). The background scene is represented by a graph with multiple nodes at different spatial locations with various receptive fields. The foreground object is encoded as a special node that should be inserted at a reasonable place in this graph. We also design a dual-path framework upon the structure of GCM to fully exploit annotated composite images. With extensive experiments on OPA dataset, our method proves to significantly outperform existing methods in generating plausible object placement without loss of diversity.

title: Sk Miraj Ahmed, Suhas Lohit, Kuan-Chuan Peng, Michael J. Jones, Amit K. Roy-Chowdhury
title_en: Sk Miraj Ahmed, Suhas Lohit, Kuan-Chuan Peng, Michael J. Jones, Amit K. Roy-Chowdhury
abstract: 低成本的深度和红外传感器作为RGB传感器的替代方案已成为现实,在自主导航和遥感等领域相比RGB传感器具有某些优势。因此,构建针对深度和红外数据的计算机视觉和深度学习系统至关重要。然而,这些模态的大规模带标签数据集仍然缺乏。在这种情况下,将源模态(RGB)上训练的具有良好标签的大数据集的神经网络知识迁移至目标模态(深度、红外等)的神经网络具有重要价值。由于内存和隐私等原因,可能无法访问源数据,知识迁移需要仅依赖源模型进行。我们提出了一种有效的解决方案SOCKET:无源跨模态知识迁移,用于解决在无法访问任务相关源数据的情况下,将知识从一种源模态迁移至不同目标模态的挑战性任务。该框架通过使用配对的无关任务数据缩小模态差异,并通过将目标特征的均值和方差与源模型中存在的批量归一化统计量进行匹配来实现。我们通过大量实验表明,我们的方法在不考虑模态差异的分类任务中显著优于现有的无源方法。
abstract_en: Cost-effective depth and infrared sensors as alternatives to usual RGB sensors are now a reality, and have some advantages over RGB in domains like autonomous navigation and remote sensing. As such, building computer vision and deep learning systems for depth and infrared data are crucial. However, large labeled datasets for these modalities are still lacking. In such cases, transferring knowledge from a neural network trained on a well-labeled large dataset in the source modality (RGB) to a neural network that works on a target modality (depth, infrared, etc.) is of great value. For reasons like memory and privacy, it may not be possible to access the source data, and knowledge transfer needs to work with only the source models. We describe an effective solution, SOCKET: SOurce-free Cross-modal KnowledgE Transfer for this challenging task of transferring knowledge from one source modality to a different target modality without access to task-relevant source data. The framework reduces the modality gap using paired task-irrelevant data, as well as by matching the mean and variance of the target features with the batch-norm statistics that are present in the source models. We show through extensive experiments that our method significantly outperforms existing source-free methods for classification tasks which do not account for the modality gap.

title: Sohrab Madani, Jayden Guan, Waleed Ahmed, Saurabh Gupta, Haitham Hassanieh
title_en: Sohrab Madani, Jayden Guan, Waleed Ahmed, Saurabh Gupta, Haitham Hassanieh
abstract: 毫米波(mmWave)雷达由于其在恶劣天气下的优良特性,正逐渐成为自动驾驶汽车中更受欢迎的感知模式。然而,目前它们在语义场景理解方面缺乏足够的空间分辨率。在本文中,我们提出了Radatron,一个能够使用毫米波雷达作为独立传感器进行精确物体检测的系统。为了实现Radatron,我们引入了一个前所未有的高分辨率汽车雷达数据集,该数据集是使用级联MIMO(多输入多输出)雷达收集的。我们的雷达实现了5厘米的距离分辨率和1.2度的角度分辨率,比其他公开数据集精细10倍。我们还开发了一种新颖的混合雷达处理和深度学习方法,以实现高车辆检测精度。我们训练并广泛评估了Radatron,结果显示其在二维边界框检测中达到92.6%的AP50和56.3%的AP75精度,分别比现有技术提高了8%和15.9%。代码和数据集可在https://jguan.page/Radatron/上获取。
abstract_en: Millimeter wave (mmWave) radars are becoming a more popular sensing modality in self-driving cars due to their favorable characteristics in adverse weather. Yet, they currently lack sufficient spatial resolution for semantic scene understanding. In this paper, we present Radatron, a system capable of accurate object detection using mmWave radar as a stand-alone sensor. To enable Radatron, we introduce a first-of-its-kind, high-resolution automotive radar dataset collected with a cascaded MIMO (Multiple Input Multiple Output) radar. Our radar achieves 5 cm range resolution and 1.2-degree angular resolution, 10× finer than other publicly available datasets. We also develop a novel hybrid radar processing and deep learning approach to achieve high vehicle detection accuracy. We train and extensively evaluate Radatron to show it achieves 92.6% AP50 and 56.3% AP75 accuracy in 2D bounding box detection, an 8% and 15.9% improvement over prior art respectively. Code and dataset are available on https://jguan.page/Radatron/.

title: Song Wen, Hao Wang, Dimitris N. Metaxas
title_en: Song Wen, Hao Wang, Dimitris N. Metaxas
abstract: 多智能体轨迹预测由于其在自动驾驶等广泛应用场景中的重要性,近年来受到广泛关注。大多数现有方法通过RNNs或Transformer模型在时间维度建模智能体动态,并采用社交汇聚或GNNs建模与其他智能体的交互;这些方法通常难以显式学习底层的连续时间动态和智能体交互。为解决这些问题,我们提出Social ODE,显式建模智能体的时间动态和交互关系。我们的方法利用神经微分方程建模连续时间动态,并在潜在空间中融合距离、交互强度和攻击性估计以建模智能体交互。大量实验表明,我们的Social ODE方法在性能上优于现有先进方法,更重要的是,能够成功避开突发障碍物并有效控制智能体运动,而先前方法在这些场景中往往表现不佳。
abstract_en: Multi-agent trajectory forecasting has recently attracted a lot of attention due to its widespread applications including autonomous driving. Most previous methods use RNNs or Transformers to model agent dynamics in the temporal dimension and social pooling or GNNs to model interactions with other agents; these approaches usually fail to learn the underlying continuous temporal dynamics and agent interactions explicitly. To address these problems, we propose Social ODE which explicitly models temporal agent dynamics and agent interactions. Our approach leverages Neural ODEs to model continuous temporal dynamics, and incorporates distance, interaction intensity, and aggressiveness estimation into agent interaction modeling in latent space. We show in extensive experiments that our Social ODE approach compares favorably with state-of-the-art, and more importantly, can successfully avoid sudden obstacles and effectively control the motion of the agent, while previous methods often fail in such cases.

title: Song Wu, Kaichao You, Weihua He, Chen Yang, Yang Tian, Yaoyuan Wang, Ziyang Zhang, Jianxing Liao
title_en: Song Wu, Kaichao You, Weihua He, Chen Yang, Yang Tian, Yaoyuan Wang, Ziyang Zhang, Jianxing Liao
abstract: 视频帧插值由于现实场景的不断变化而是一项具有挑战性的任务。先前方法通常计算双向光流,然后在线性运动假设下预测中间光流,导致各向同性中间光流生成。后续研究通过估计高阶运动信息和额外帧实现了各向异性调整。基于运动假设,这些方法难以建模真实场景中的复杂运动。本文提出了一种端到端训练方法A^2OF,用于视频帧插值,具有事件驱动的各向异性光流调整。具体而言,我们利用事件生成中间光流的光流分布掩码,能够建模两帧之间的复杂运动。所提方法在视频帧插值中优于先前方法,将基于事件的监督视频插值提升到更高阶段。
abstract_en: Video frame interpolation is a challenging task due to the ever-changing real-world scene. Previous methods often calculate the bi-directional optical flows and then predict the intermediate optical flows under the linear motion assumptions, leading to isotropic intermediate flow generation. Follow-up research obtained anisotropic adjustment through estimated higher-order motion information with extra frames. Based on the motion assumptions, their methods are hard to model the complicated motion in real scenes. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end training method A^2OF for video frame interpolation with event-driven Anisotropic Adjustment of Optical Flows. Specifically, we use events to generate optical flow distribution masks for the intermediate optical flow, which can model the complicated motion between two frames. Our proposed method outperforms the previous methods in video frame interpolation, taking supervised event-based video interpolation to a higher stage.

title: Songhua Liu, Jingwen Ye, Sucheng Ren, Xinchao Wang
title_en: Songhua Liu, Jingwen Ye, Sucheng Ren, Xinchao Wang
abstract: 示例引导的图像生成领域面临的关键挑战在于建立输入图像与引导图像之间的细粒度对应关系。尽管现有方法取得了令人鼓舞的成果,但其依赖于两种主要策略:一种是通过估计密集注意力来计算每一点的匹配,但由于二次内存成本限制,仅能处理粗粒度尺度;另一种是固定对应关系数量以实现线性复杂度,但缺乏灵活性。本文提出了一种基于动态稀疏注意力的Transformer模型,称为动态稀疏Transformer(DynaST),以实现高效且精细的匹配。我们的方法核心是一种新颖的动态注意力单元,专门用于覆盖单个位置应关注的最优token数量的变化。具体而言,DynaST利用Transformer结构的多层特性,以级联方式执行动态注意力方案,从而优化匹配结果并合成视觉愉悦的输出。此外,我们引入了统一的训练目标,使DynaST成为适用于监督和无监督场景的通用参考图像翻译框架。在三个应用(姿态引导的人像生成、基于边缘的面部合成、无失真图像风格迁移)上的大量实验表明,DynaST在局部细节上表现出色,超越了现有技术,同时显著降低了计算成本。我们的代码可在\href{https://github.com/Huage001/DynaST}{此处}获取。
abstract_en: One key challenge of exemplar-guided image generation lies in establishing fine-grained correspondences between input and guided images. Prior approaches, despite the promising results, have relied on either estimating dense attention to compute per-point matching, which is limited to only coarse scales due to the quadratic memory cost, or fixing the number of correspondences to achieve linear complexity, which lacks flexibility. In this paper, we propose a dynamic sparse attention based Transformer model, termed Dynamic Sparse Transformer (DynaST), to achieve fine-level matching with favorable efficiency. The heart of our approach is a novel dynamic-attention unit, dedicated to covering the variation on the optimal number of tokens one position should focus on. Specifically, DynaST leverages the multi-layer nature of Transformer structure, and performs the dynamic attention scheme in a cascaded manner to refine matching results and synthesize visually-pleasing outputs. In addition, we introduce a unified training objective for DynaST, making it a versatile reference-based image translation framework for both supervised and unsupervised scenarios. Extensive experiments on three applications, pose-guided person image generation, edge-based face synthesis, and undistorted image style transfer, demonstrate that DynaST achieves superior performance in local details, outperforming the state of the art while reducing the computational cost significantly. Our code is available \href{https://github.com/Huage001/DynaST}{here}.

title: 范松林,高伟,李戈
title_en: Songlin Fan, Wei Gao, Ge Li
abstract: 本文研究了尚未探索的任务-点云显著目标检测(SOD)。与图像显著目标检测不同,我们发现点云的注意力转移可能导致显著性冲突,即某一物体悖论性地同时属于显著和非显著类别。为规避这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的视角依赖显著目标视角,合理反映点云场景中最引人注目的物体。基于此定义,我们引入了PCSOD,这是首个针对点云SOD提出的数据集,包含2,872个室内外3D视角。我们的数据集样本采用层次化标注,例如超类/子类、边界框和分割图,这赋予了数据集卓越的泛化能力和广泛的应用性,验证了多种假设。为进一步证明解决方案的可行性,我们还贡献了一个基线模型,并对五个代表性模型进行基准测试以实现全面比较。所提出的模型能够有效分析不规则且无序的点以检测显著目标。得益于任务定制化设计,我们的方法在其他基线模型上展现出显著优势,产生更令人满意的检测结果。大量实验和讨论揭示了该研究领域的广阔前景,为后续研究铺平了道路。
abstract_en: This paper researches the unexplored task-point cloud salient object detection (SOD). Differing from SOD for images, we find the attention shift of point clouds may provoke saliency conflict, i.e., an object paradoxically belongs to salient and non-salient categories. To eschew this issue, we present a novel view-dependent perspective of salient objects, reasonably reflecting the most eye-catching objects in point cloud scenarios. Following this formulation, we introduce PCSOD, the first dataset proposed for point cloud SOD consisting of 2,872 in-/out-door 3D views. The samples in our dataset are labeled with hierarchical annotations, e.g., super-/sub-class, bounding box, and segmentation map, which endows the brilliant generalizability and broad applicability of our dataset verifying various conjectures. To evidence the feasibility of our solution, we further contribute a baseline model and benchmark five representative models for a comprehensive comparison. The proposed model can effectively analyze irregular and unordered points for detecting salient objects. Thanks to incorporating the task-tailored designs, our method shows visible superiority over other baselines, producing more satisfactory results. Extensive experiments and discussions reveal the promising potential of this research field, paving the way for further study.

title: 林松南,马业,郭振华,文比汉
title_en: Songnan Lin, Ye Ma, Zhenhua Guo, Bihan Wen
abstract: 近年来,针对动态视觉传感器(DVS)的事件驱动应用,深度学习的最新进展主要依赖于在模拟数据上的训练。然而,大多数模拟器忽略了真实DVS的各种基于物理特性的特征,例如事件时间戳的保真度和全面的噪声效应。我们提出了一种事件模拟器,称为DVS-Voltmeter,以实现DVS应用中的高性能深度网络。DVS-Voltmeter将物理的基本原理——(1)DVS电路中的电压变化,(2)由光子接收引起的随机性,以及(3)由温度和寄生光电流引起的噪声效应——整合到随机过程中。通过新颖的传感器设计和物理原理的洞察,DVS-Voltmeter在高帧率视频的基础上生成更真实的事件。定性和定量实验表明,模拟的事件与真实数据相似。在两个任务上的评估,即语义分割和强度图像重建,表明使用DVS-Voltmeter训练的神经网络在真实事件上表现出优于现有最先进的模拟器的泛化能力。
abstract_en: Recent advances in deep learning for event-driven applications with dynamic vision sensors (DVS) primarily rely on training over simulated data. However, most simulators ignore various physics-based characteristics of real DVS, such as the fidelity of event timestamps and comprehensive noise effects. We propose an event simulator, dubbed DVS-Voltmeter, to enable high-performance deep networks for DVS applications. DVS-Voltmeter incorporates the fundamental principle of physics - (1) voltage variations in a DVS circuit, (2) randomness caused by photon reception, and (3) noise effects caused by temperature and parasitic photocurrent - into a stochastic process. With the novel insight into the sensor design and physics, DVS-Voltmeter generates more realistic events, given high frame-rate videos. Qualitative and quantitative experiments show that the simulated events resemble real data. The evaluation on two tasks, i.e., semantic segmentation and intensity-image reconstruction, indicates that neural networks trained with DVS-Voltmeter generalize favorably on real events against state-of- the-art simulators.

title: Songwei Ge, Thomas Hayes, Harry Yang, Xi Yin, Guan Pang, David Jacobs, Jia-Bin Huang, Devi Parikh
title_en: Songwei Ge, Thomas Hayes, Harry Yang, Xi Yin, Guan Pang, David Jacobs, Jia-Bin Huang, Devi Parikh
abstract: 视频被创建用于表达情感、交流信息和分享体验。视频合成一直吸引着研究人员的关注。尽管视觉合成技术的快速发展推动了这一领域取得显著进展,但大多数现有研究仍主要集中在提升帧质量及帧间过渡效果上,而在生成长视频方面进展有限。本文提出了一种基于3D-VQGAN和Transformer的方法,能够生成数千帧的视频。我们的评估表明,使用UCF-101、Sky Time-lapse和Taichi-HD等标准基准数据集中的16帧视频片段训练的模型,可以生成多样、连贯且高质量的长视频。我们还展示了通过结合文本和音频的时间信息,对方法进行条件扩展以生成有意义的长视频。视频和代码可访问 https://songweige.github.io/projects/tats。
abstract_en: Videos are created to express emotion, exchange information, and share experiences. Video synthesis has intrigued researchers for a long time. Despite the rapid progress driven by advances in visual synthesis, most existing studies focus on improving the frames’ quality and the transitions between them, while little progress has been made in generating longer videos. In this paper, we present a method that builds on 3D-VQGAN and transformers to generate videos with thousands of frames. Our evaluation shows that our model trained on 16-frame video clips from standard benchmarks such as UCF-101, Sky Time-lapse, and Taichi-HD datasets can generate diverse, coherent, and high-quality long videos. We also showcase conditional extensions of our approach for generating meaningful long videos by incorporating temporal information with text and audio. Videos and code can be found at https://songweige.github.io/projects/tats.

title: Soshi Shimada, Vladislav Golyanik, Zhi Li, Patrick Pérez, Weipeng Xu, Christian Theobalt
title_en: Soshi Shimada, Vladislav Golyanik, Zhi Li, Patrick Pérez, Weipeng Xu, Christian Theobalt
abstract: 无标记单目3D人体运动捕捉(MoCap)与场景交互是一个与扩展现实、机器人和虚拟化身生成相关的具有挑战性的研究课题。由于单目设置的固有深度模糊性,现有方法捕捉的3D运动常包含严重伪影,如错误的体-场景穿透、抖动和身体漂浮。为解决这些问题,我们提出HULC,一种新的3D人体MoCap方法,能够感知场景几何。HULC估计3D姿态和密集的体-环境表面接触以改进3D定位,同时确定主体的绝对尺度。此外,我们引入基于新型姿态流形采样的3D姿态轨迹优化,以解决错误的体-环境穿透问题。尽管该方法所需的输入结构比现有场景感知单目MoCap算法更少,但其生成的姿势更符合物理现实:HULC在各种实验和不同指标上显著且一致地优于现有方法。项目页面:https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/HULC/
abstract_en: Marker-less monocular 3D human motion capture (MoCap) with scene interactions is a challenging research topic relevant for extended reality, robotics and virtual avatar generation. Due to the inherent depth ambiguity of monocular settings, 3D motions captured with existing methods often contain severe artefacts such as incorrect body-scene inter-penetrations, jitter and body floating. To tackle these issues, we propose HULC, a new approach for 3D human MoCap which is aware of the scene geometry. HULC estimates 3D poses and dense body-environment surface contacts for improved 3D localisations, as well as the absolute scale of the subject. Furthermore, we introduce a 3D pose trajectory optimisation based on a novel pose manifold sampling that resolves erroneous body-environment inter-penetrations. Although the proposed method requires less structured inputs compared to existing scene-aware monocular MoCap algorithms, it produces more physically plausible poses: HULC significantly and consistently outperforms the existing approaches in various experiments and on different metrics. Project page: https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/HULC/

title: Spencer Whitehead, Suzanne Petryk, Vedaad Shakib, Joseph Gonzalez, Trevor Darrell, Anna Rohrbach, Marcus Rohrbach
title_en: Spencer Whitehead, Suzanne Petryk, Vedaad Shakib, Joseph Gonzalez, Trevor Darrell, Anna Rohrbach, Marcus Rohrbach
abstract: 机器学习取得了显著进展,在多模态任务如视觉问答(VQA)中,模型的准确率与人类的差距已大幅缩小。然而,尽管人类在不确定时可以说“我不知道”(即选择弃权不回答问题),但这一能力在多模态研究中却长期被忽视,尽管这一问题对于VQA在实际场景中的应用至关重要。在本工作中,我们提出了一种可靠的VQA问题建模方法,优先选择弃权而非提供错误答案。我们首先为多个VQA模型赋予弃权能力,并分析其覆盖率(回答问题的比例)、风险(该比例下的错误率)。为此,我们探索了多种弃权方法。我们发现,尽管表现最佳的模型在VQA v2数据集上准确率超过71%,但直接使用模型的softmax分数引入弃权选项会限制其仅能回答不到8%的问题以实现低错误风险(即1%)。这促使我们采用多模态选择函数直接估计预测答案的正确性,我们证明该方法可显著提升覆盖率,例如在1%风险下,覆盖率可从6.8%提升至16.3%(提升2.4倍)。虽然分析覆盖率与风险至关重要,但这两者存在权衡关系,使得比较VQA模型具有挑战性。为此,我们还提出了一种针对VQA的有效可靠性度量指标,其对错误答案的惩罚权重高于弃权。这种新的问题建模、度量指标及分析方法为构建具有自我意识的可靠VQA模型奠定了基础,使模型仅在不确定答案时才选择弃权。
abstract_en: Machine learning has advanced dramatically, narrowing the accuracy gap to humans in multimodal tasks like visual question answering (VQA). However, while humans can say ""I don’t know"" when they are uncertain (i.e., abstain from answering a question), such ability has been largely neglected in multimodal research, despite the importance of this problem to the usage of VQA in real settings. In this work, we promote a problem formulation for reliable VQA, where we prefer abstention over providing an incorrect answer. We first enable abstention capabilities for several VQA models, and analyze both their coverage, the portion of questions answered, and risk, the error on that portion. For that, we explore several abstention approaches. We find that although the best performing models achieve over 71% accuracy on the VQA v2 dataset, introducing the option to abstain by directly using a model’s softmax scores limits them to answering less than 8% of the questions to achieve a low risk of error (i.e., 1%). This motivates us to utilize a multimodal selection function to directly estimate the correctness of the predicted answers, which we show can increase the coverage by, for example, 2.4x from 6.8% to 16.3% at 1% risk. While it is important to analyze both coverage and risk, these metrics have a trade-off which makes comparing VQA models challenging. To address this, we also propose an Effective Reliability metric for VQA that places a larger cost on incorrect answers compared to abstentions. This new problem formulation, metric, and analysis for VQA provide the groundwork for building effective and reliable VQA models that have the self-awareness to abstain if and only if they don’t know the answer.

title: Sravanti Addepalli, Kaushal Bhogale, Priyam Dey, R. Venkatesh Babu
title_en: Sravanti Addepalli, Kaushal Bhogale, Priyam Dey, R. Venkatesh Babu
abstract: 自监督学习在最近从手工设计的预训练任务向基于实例相似度的方法转变后,已成为视觉表征学习的有前景方法。大多数最先进的方法强制要求给定图像的各种增强版本之间保持相似性,而一些方法还额外使用对比方法以显式确保多样化的表征。尽管这些方法确实展现了有希望的方向,但与监督方法相比,它们需要显著更多的训练迭代次数。在本文中,我们探讨了这些方法收敛缓慢的原因,并进一步提出通过收敛速度显著更快且对表征学习也具有用处的良定义辅助任务来增强这些方法。所提出的方法利用旋转预测任务来提升现有最先进的方法的效率。我们在多个数据集上使用所提出的方法展示了显著的性能提升,特别是在较低的训练轮次下。
abstract_en: Self-supervision has emerged as a propitious method for visual representation learning after the recent paradigm shift from handcrafted pretext tasks to instance-similarity based approaches. Most state-of-the-art methods enforce similarity between various augmentations of a given image, while some methods additionally use contrastive approaches to explicitly ensure diverse representations. While these approaches have indeed shown promising direction, they require a significantly larger number of training iterations when compared to the supervised counterparts. In this work, we explore reasons for the slow convergence of these methods, and further propose to strengthen them using well-posed auxiliary tasks that converge significantly faster, and are also useful for representation learning. The proposed method utilizes the task of rotation prediction to improve the efficiency of existing state-of-the-art methods. We demonstrate significant gains in performance using the proposed method on multiple datasets, specifically for lower training epochs.

title: Sravanti Addepalli, Samyak Jain, Gaurang Sriramanan, R. Venkatesh Babu
title_en: Sravanti Addepalli, Samyak Jain, Gaurang Sriramanan, R. Venkatesh Babu
abstract: 深度神经网络对对抗攻击的脆弱性推动了构建鲁棒模型的研究。尽管大多数对抗训练算法旨在防御受限于低幅度Lp范数约束的攻击,但现实中的对手并不受此类约束的限制。在本工作中,我们旨在在更大的范围内实现对抗鲁棒性,以抵御可能可察觉但不会改变人类(或Oracle)预测的扰动。存在翻转Oracle预测的图像和不翻转的图像,使得这一对抗鲁棒性设置变得具有挑战性。我们讨论了超越感知限制的对抗防御算法的理想目标,并进一步指出了简单地将现有训练算法扩展到更高扰动范围的不足之处。为了克服这些不足,我们提出了一种新的防御方法,Oracle对齐对抗训练(OA-AT),在对抗训练过程中使网络的预测与Oracle的预测对齐。所提出的方法在较大的epsilon范围内(如CIFAR-10上的L-inf范围16/255)实现了最先进的性能,同时在标准范围内(8/255)优于现有防御方法(AWP、TRADES、PGD-AT)。
abstract_en: The vulnerability of Deep Neural Networks to Adversarial Attacks has fuelled research towards building robust models. While most Adversarial Training algorithms aim at defending attacks constrained within low magnitude Lp norm bounds, real-world adversaries are not limited by such constraints. In this work, we aim to achieve adversarial robustness within larger bounds, against perturbations that may be perceptible, but do not change human (or Oracle) prediction. The presence of images that flip Oracle predictions and those that do not makes this a challenging setting for adversarial robustness. We discuss the ideal goals of an adversarial defense algorithm beyond perceptual limits, and further highlight the shortcomings of naively extending existing training algorithms to higher perturbation bounds. In order to overcome these shortcomings, we propose a novel defense, Oracle-Aligned Adversarial Training (OA-AT), to align the predictions of the network with that of an Oracle during adversarial training. The proposed approach achieves state-of-the-art performance at large epsilon bounds (such as an L-inf bound of 16/255 on CIFAR-10) while outperforming existing defenses (AWP, TRADES, PGD-AT) at standard bounds (8/255) as well.

title: Stefan Haller, Lorenz Feineis, Lisa Hutschenreiter, Florian Bernard, Carsten Rother, Dagmar Kainmüller, Paul Swoboda, Bogdan Savchynskyy
title_en: Stefan Haller, Lorenz Feineis, Lisa Hutschenreiter, Florian Bernard, Carsten Rother, Dagmar Kainmüller, Paul Swoboda, Bogdan Savchynskyy
abstract: 图匹配优化问题是计算机视觉中许多任务的关键组成部分,例如将两个可变形物体建立对应关系。自然地,过去几十年中提出了大量适用的算法。由于尚未建立统一的标准基准测试,其性能声明往往难以验证,因为不同问题实例和评估标准导致结果不可比。为解决这些不足,我们对图匹配算法进行了比较研究。我们创建了一个统一的基准测试,收集并分类大量现有且公开可用的计算机视觉图匹配问题,并以通用格式进行整理。同时,我们收集并分类了最流行的图匹配算法开源实现。其性能评估遵循优化算法比较的最佳实践。该研究设计为可重复且可扩展,以作为未来有价值的资源。我们的研究提供了三个显著见解:(i) 流行的问题实例可在远少于1秒的时间内精确求解,因此不足以用于未来的实证评估;(ii) 最流行的基线方法在性能上远逊于当前最先进的方法;(iii) 尽管该问题是NP难的,但来自视觉应用的实例即使在顶点数超过500的图中,也常常可在几秒内求解。
abstract_en: The graph matching optimization problem is an essential component for many tasks in computer vision, such as bringing two deformable objects in correspondence. Naturally, a wide range of applicable algorithms have been proposed in the last decades. Since a common standard benchmark has not been developed, their performance claims are often hard to verify as evaluation on differing problem instances and criteria make the results incomparable. To address these shortcomings, we present a comparative study of graph matching algorithms. We create a uniform benchmark where we collect and categorize a large set of existing and publicly available computer vision graph matching problems in a common format. At the same time we collect and categorize the most popular open-source implementations of graph matching algorithms. Their performance is evaluated in a way that is in line with the best practices for comparing optimization algorithms. The study is designed to be reproducible and extensible to serve as a valuable resource in the future. Our study provides three notable insights: (i) popular problem instances are exactly solvable in substantially less than 1 second, and, therefore, are insufficient for future empirical evaluations; (ii) the most popular baseline methods are highly inferior to the best available methods; (iii) despite the NP-hardness of the problem, instances coming from vision applications are often solvable in a few seconds even for graphs with more than 500 vertices.

title: Stefan Kolek, Duc Anh Nguyen, Ron Levie, Joan Bruna, Gitta Kutyniok
title_en: Stefan Kolek, Duc Anh Nguyen, Ron Levie, Joan Bruna, Gitta Kutyniok
abstract: 我们提出CartoonX(卡通解释),一种针对图像分类器的模型无关的解释方法,基于率失真解释(RDE)框架。自然图像大致是分段光滑信号——也称为卡通图像——并且在小波域中趋于稀疏。CartoonX是首个利用这一特性的方法,要求其解释在小波域中稀疏,从而提取图像的相关分段光滑部分,而非相关像素稀疏区域。我们证明CartoonX能够揭示新颖且有价值的解释信息,特别是在误分类情况下。此外,我们表明CartoonX在使用更少系数的情况下达到更低的失真,优于现有方法。
abstract_en: We present CartoonX (Cartoon Explanation), a novel model-agnostic explanation method tailored towards image classifiers and based on the rate-distortion explanation (RDE) framework. Natural images are roughly piece-wise smooth signals---also called cartoon-like images---and tend to be sparse in the wavelet domain. CartoonX is the first explanation method to exploit this by requiring its explanations to be sparse in the wavelet domain, thus extracting the relevant piece-wise smooth part of an image instead of relevant pixel-sparse regions. We demonstrate that CartoonX can reveal novel valuable explanatory information, particularly for misclassifications. Moreover, we show that CartoonX achieves a lower distortion with fewer coefficients than state-of-the-art methods.

title: Stephan Alaniz, Massimiliano Mancini, Anjan Dutta, Diego Marcos, Zeynep Akata
title_en: Stephan Alaniz, Massimiliano Mancini, Anjan Dutta, Diego Marcos, Zeynep Akata
abstract: 人类在需要快速传递物体信息的游戏场景中展现出高水平的抽象能力。他们将信息内容分解为多个部分,并通过可解释的协议进行传递。为使机器具备此类能力,我们提出了基于基本图元的草图抽象任务,目标是在预算限制下使用固定集合的绘图基本图元表示草图。为解决该任务,我们设计了自监督的Primitive-Matching Network(PMN),学习对草图进行可解释的抽象。具体而言,PMN将草图中的每一笔映射到给定集合中最相似的基本图元,并预测一个仿射变换以将选定图元对齐到目标笔画。我们通过距离变换损失函数端到端地学习笔画到图元的映射,该损失函数在原始草图被预测图元精确重建时达到最小值。我们的PMN抽象方法在给定通信预算下,实现在草图识别和基于草图的图像检索任务中最高的性能,同时保持高度可解释性。这为草图分析开辟了新可能,例如通过提取定义物体类别的最相关图元来比较草图。代码可在https://github.com/ExplainableML/sketch-primitives获取。
abstract_en: Humans show high-level of abstraction capabilities in games that require quickly communicating object information. They decompose the message content into multiple parts and communicate them in an interpretable protocol. Toward equipping machines with such capabilities, we propose the Primitive-based Sketch Abstraction task where the goal is to represent sketches using a fixed set of drawing primitives under the influence of a budget. To solve this task, our Primitive-Matching Network (PMN), learns interpretable abstractions of a sketch in a self supervised manner. Specifically, PMN maps each stroke of a sketch to its most similar primitive in a given set, predicting an affine transformation that aligns the selected primitive to the target stroke. We learn this stroke-to-primitive mapping end-to-end with a distance-transform loss that is minimal when the original sketch is precisely reconstructed with the predicted primitives. Our PMN abstraction empirically achieves the highest performance on sketch recognition and sketch-based image retrieval given a communication budget, while at the same time being highly interpretable. This opens up new possibilities for sketch analysis, such as comparing sketches by extracting the most relevant primitives that define an object category. Code is available at https://github.com/ExplainableML/sketch-primitives.

title: Subhankar Roy, Martin Trapp, Andrea Pilzer, Juho Kannala, Nicu Sebe, Elisa Ricci, Arno Solin
title_en: Subhankar Roy, Martin Trapp, Andrea Pilzer, Juho Kannala, Nicu Sebe, Elisa Ricci, Arno Solin
abstract: 无源域适应(SFDA)旨在通过仅使用预训练的源模型,将分类器适应到未标记的目标数据集上。然而,源数据的缺失和领域偏移使得对目标数据的预测不可靠。我们提出量化源模型预测的不确定性,并利用其指导目标域适应。为此,我们通过在网络参数上引入先验构建概率源模型,从而在模型预测上形成分布。通过拉普拉斯近似估计不确定性,并将其用于识别不位于源流形的目标数据点,在最大化目标数据互信息时降低这些数据点的权重。与近期工作不同,我们的概率处理方式计算开销小,解耦源训练与目标适应,且无需专门的源训练或修改模型架构。我们在闭集和开集设置中展示了基于不确定性的SFDA相较于传统SFDA的优势,并提供了实证证据表明,即使不进行调参,我们的方法对强领域偏移更具鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) aims to adapt a classifier to an unlabelled target data set by only using a pre-trained source model. However, the absence of the source data and the domain shift makes the predictions on the target data unreliable. We propose quantifying the uncertainty in the source model predictions and utilizing it to guide the target adaptation. For this, we construct a probabilistic source model by incorporating priors on the network parameters inducing a distribution over the model predictions. Uncertainties are estimated by employing a Laplace approximation and incorporated to identify target data points that do not lie in the source manifold and to down-weight them when maximizing the mutual information on the target data. Unlike recent works, our probabilistic treatment is computationally lightweight, decouples source training and target adaptation, and requires no specialized source training or changes of the model architecture. We show the advantages of uncertainty-guided SFDA over traditional SFDA in the closed-set and open-set settings and provide empirical evidence that our approach is more robust to strong domain shifts even without tuning.

title: Subhankar Roy, Mingxuan Liu, Zhun Zhong, Nicu Sebe, Elisa Ricci
title_en: Subhankar Roy, Mingxuan Liu, Zhun Zhong, Nicu Sebe, Elisa Ricci
abstract: 我们研究了新的任务——类增量新类发现(class-iNCD),该任务指的是通过利用在包含不相交但相关类别的标记数据集上训练的预训练模型,在无标签数据集中发现新类别。除了发现新类别外,我们还旨在保持模型对之前见过的基础类别的识别能力。受基于回放的增量学习方法启发,本文提出了一种用于class-iNCD的新方法,通过联合利用基础类特征原型和特征级知识蒸馏,防止对基础类过去信息的遗忘。我们还提出了一种自训练聚类策略,该策略同时对新类别进行聚类,并为基础类和新类别训练联合分类器。这使得我们的方法能够在类增量设置中运行。我们在三个常见基准上的实验表明,我们的方法显著优于现有最先进的方法。代码可在\url{https://github.com/OatmealLiu/class-iNCD}获取。
abstract_en: We study the new task of class-incremental Novel Class Discovery (class-iNCD), which refers to the problem of discovering novel categories in an unlabelled data set by leveraging a pre-trained model that has been trained on a labelled data set containing disjoint yet related categories. Apart from discovering novel classes, we also aim at preserving the ability of the model to recognize previously seen base categories. Inspired by rehearsal-based incremental learning methods, in this paper we propose a novel approach for class-iNCD which prevents forgetting of past information about the base classes by jointly exploiting base class feature prototypes and feature-level knowledge distillation. We also propose a self-training clustering strategy that simultaneously clusters novel categories and trains a joint classifier for both the base and novel classes. This makes our method able to operate in a class-incremental setting. Our experiments, conducted on three common benchmarks, demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/OatmealLiu/class-iNCD}.

title: 基于BDQ的隐私保护人体动作识别方法
title_en: Sudhakar Kumawat, Hajime Nagahara
abstract: 随着智能计算机视觉系统在个人空间中的广泛应用,人们对这些系统可能带来的隐私和安全风险意识不断增强。一方面,我们希望这些系统能够通过理解周围环境来协助日常生活,另一方面,我们又希望它们在不捕获任何敏感信息的情况下完成这一任务。为此,本文提出了一种简单而稳健的隐私保护编码器BDQ,用于隐私保护的人体动作识别任务,该编码器由三个模块组成:模糊、差分和量化。首先,输入场景通过模糊模块进行边缘平滑。随后,差分模块通过在连续帧之间进行逐像素强度减法,以突出运动特征并抑制明显的高层隐私属性。最后,对运动差分帧应用量化模块以去除低层隐私属性。通过对抗训练以端到端方式优化BDQ参数,使其能够学习保留动作识别属性同时抑制隐私属性。我们在三个基准数据集上的实验表明,所提出的编码器设计在与先前工作相比时能够实现最先进的权衡。此外,我们还展示了所达到的权衡效果与基于DVS传感器的事件相机相当。代码可在:https://github.com/suakaw/BDQ_PrivacyAR 获取。
abstract_en: The widespread use of smart computer vision systems in our personal spaces has led to an increased consciousness about the privacy and security risks that these systems pose. On the one hand, we want these systems to assist in our daily lives by understanding their surroundings, but on the other hand, we want them to do so without capturing any sensitive information. Towards this direction, this paper proposes a simple, yet robust privacy-preserving encoder called BDQ for the task of privacy-preserving human action recognition that is composed of three modules: Blur, Difference, and Quantization. First, the input scene is passed to the Blur module to smoothen the edges. This is followed by the Difference module to apply a pixel-wise intensity subtraction between consecutive frames to highlight motion features and suppress obvious high-level privacy attributes. Finally, the Quantization module is applied to the motion difference frames to remove the low-level privacy attributes. The BDQ parameters are optimized in an end-to-end fashion via adversarial training such that it learns to allow action recognition attributes while inhibiting privacy attributes. Our experiments on three benchmark datasets show that the proposed encoder design can achieve state-of-the-art trade-off when compared with previous works. Furthermore, we show that the trade-off achieved is at par with the DVS sensor-based event cameras. Code available at: https://github.com/suakaw/BDQ_PrivacyAR.

title: Sudipta Paul, Niluthpol Chowdhury Mithun, Amit K. Roy-Chowdhury
title_en: Sudipta Paul, Niluthpol Chowdhury Mithun, Amit K. Roy-Chowdhury
abstract: 近期关于基于文本的时刻定位的研究在多个基准数据集上展现了高精度。然而,这些方法依赖于假设在测试时定位系统只会遇到训练集中存在的事件(即已见事件)。因此,这些模型针对固定集合的已见事件进行优化,难以推广到实际需求中对更广泛事件(包括未见事件)进行定位的任务。此外,获取涵盖所有可能场景的视频和文本进行训练并不实际。针对这一问题,本文引入并解决基于文本的新型/未见事件时间定位问题。我们的目标是根据文本查询对视频时刻进行时间定位,其中视频时刻和文本查询在训练过程中均未被观察或提供。为解决该问题,我们将基于文本的时刻定位推理任务形式化为关系预测问题,假设语义相关时刻之间存在概念关系,例如,与未见文本查询相关的时间时刻与与语义最相关已见查询相关的时间时刻可能包含共享概念。基于未见文本查询的候选时刻正确性的可能性将取决于其与语义最相关已见查询对应时刻的相关性。在两个基于文本的时刻定位数据集上的实验证明,我们的方法在性能上相比现有定位方法可提升高达15%。
abstract_en: Recent works on text-based localization of moments have shown high accuracy on several benchmark datasets. However, these approaches are trained and evaluated relying on the assumption that the localization system, during testing, will only encounter events that are available in the training set (i.e., seen events). As a result, these models are optimized for a fixed set of seen events and they are unlikely to generalize to the practical requirement of localizing a wider range of events, some of which may be unseen. Moreover, acquiring videos and text comprising all possible scenarios for training is not practical. In this regard, this paper introduces and tackles the problem of text-based temporal localization of novel/unseen events. Our goal is to temporally localize video moments based on text queries, where both the video moments and text queries are not observed/available during training. Towards solving this problem, we formulate the inference task of text-based localization of moments as a relational prediction problem, hypothesizing a conceptual relation between semantically relevant moments, e.g., a temporally relevant moment corresponding to an unseen text query and a moment corresponding to a seen text query may contain shared concepts. The likelihood of a candidate moment to be the correct one based on an unseen text query will depend on its relevance to the moment corresponding to the semantically most relevant seen query. Empirical results on two text-based moment localization datasets show that our proposed approach can reach up to 15% absolute improvement in performance compared to existing localization approaches.

title: Suhwan Cho, Heansung Lee, Minhyeok Lee, Chaewon Park, Sungjun Jang, Minjung Kim, Sangyoun Lee
title_en: Suhwan Cho, Heansung Lee, Minhyeok Lee, Chaewon Park, Sungjun Jang, Minjung Kim, Sangyoun Lee
abstract: 半监督视频对象分割(VOS)旨在密集跟踪视频中指定的目标对象。该任务的主要挑战之一是存在与目标对象相似的背景干扰项。我们提出三种新颖策略来抑制这些干扰项:1)时空多样化模板构建方案,以获得目标对象的泛化特性;2)可学习的距离评分函数,通过利用连续两帧之间的时序一致性来排除空间上远离的目标干扰项;3)交换-附加增强方法,通过提供包含纠缠对象的训练样本,迫使每个对象具有独特的特征。在所有公开基准数据集上,我们的模型即使具备实时性能,也实现了与当前最先进方法相当的性能。定性结果也证明了我们的方法优于现有方法。我们相信我们的方法将广泛用于未来的VOS研究。
abstract_en: Semi-supervised video object segmentation (VOS) aims to densely track certain designated objects in videos. One of the main challenges in this task is the existence of background distractors that appear similar to the target objects. We propose three novel strategies to suppress such distractors: 1) a spatio-temporally diversified template construction scheme to obtain generalized properties of the target objects; 2) a learnable distance-scoring function to exclude spatially-distant distractors by exploiting the temporal consistency between two consecutive frames; 3) swap-and-attach augmentation to force each object to have unique features by providing training samples containing entangled objects. On all public benchmark datasets, our model achieves a comparable performance to contemporary state-of-the-art approaches, even with real-time performance. Qualitative results also demonstrate the superiority of our approach over existing methods. We believe our approach will be widely used for future VOS research.

title: Sukai Wang, Ming Liu
title_en: Sukai Wang, Ming Liu
abstract: 对于自动驾驶系统而言,大规模点云的存储成本和传输速度成为重要瓶颈,因其数据量庞大。本文提出了一种基于范围图像的三阶段框架,利用熵模型压缩扫描激光雷达的点云数据。在我们的三阶段框架中,通过将回归问题转化为有限分类问题,对较粗糙的范围图像进行优化,以提升生成精确点云的性能。在特征提取部分,我们提出了一种新颖的注意力卷积层,用于融合基于体素的3D特征到2D范围图像中。与基于八叉树的压缩方法相比,结合熵模型的范围图像压缩在自动驾驶场景中表现更优。在不同线数的激光雷达和不同场景下的实验表明,所提出的压缩方案在重建质量和下游任务中显著优于现有先进方法。
abstract_en: For autonomous driving systems, the storage cost and transmission speed of the large-scale point clouds become an important bottleneck because of their large volume. In this paper, we propose a range image-based three-stage framework to compress the scanning LiDAR’s point clouds using the entropy model. In our three-stage framework, we refine the coarser range image by converting the regression problem into the limited classification problem to improve the performance of generating accurate point clouds. And in the feature extraction part, we propose a novel attention Conv layer to fuse the voxel-based 3D features in the 2D range image. Compared with the Octree-based compression methods, the range image compression with the entropy model performs better in the autonomous driving scene. Experiments on LiDARs with different lines and in different scenarios show that our proposed compression scheme outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches in reconstruction quality and downstream tasks by a wide margin.

title: <中文标题>
title_en: Sung-Hoon Yoon, Hyeokjun Kweon, Jegyeong Cho, Shinjeong Kim, Kuk-Jin Yoon
abstract: <中文摘要>
abstract_en: Weakly supervised semantic segmentation (WSSS) has employed Class Activation Maps (CAMs) to localize the objects. However, the CAMs typically do not fit along the object boundaries and highlight only the most-discriminative regions. To resolve the problems, we propose a Gated Pyramid Pooling (GPP) layer which is a substitute for a Global Average Pooling (GAP) layer, and an Adversarial Erasing Framework via Triplet (AEFT). In the GPP layer, a feature pyramid is obtained by pooling the CAMs at multiple spatial resolutions, and then be aggregated into an attention for class prediction by gated convolution. With the process, CAMs are trained not only to capture the global context but also to preserve fine-details from the image. Meanwhile, the AEFT targets an over-expansion, a chronic problem of Adversarial Erasing (AE).
