Although AE methods expand CAMs by erasing the discriminative regions, they usually suffer from the over-expansion due to an absence of guidelines on when to stop erasing. We experimentally verify that the over-expansion is due to rigid classification, and metric learning can be a flexible remedy for it. AEFT is devised to learn the concept of erasing with the triplet loss between the input image, erased image, and negatively sampled image. With the GPP and AEFT, we achieve new state-of-the-art both on the PASCAL VOC 2012 val/test and MS-COCO 2014 val set by 70.9%/71.7% and 44.8% in mIoU, respectively.

title: Sungha Choi, Seunghan Yang, Seokeon Choi, Sungrack Yun
title_en: Sungha Choi, Seunghan Yang, Seokeon Choi, Sungrack Yun
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的测试时适应策略,该策略仅利用目标域的未标记在线数据,调整在源域上预训练的模型,以缓解由于源域和目标域之间的分布偏移导致的性能下降。使用未标记的在线数据调整整个模型参数可能会因无监督目标的错误信号而产生不利影响。为了解决这个问题,我们提出了一种与分布偏移无关的权重正则化方法,该方法在测试时适应过程中鼓励对分布偏移敏感的模型参数进行大幅更新,而对不敏感的参数进行小幅更新。这种正则化方法通过利用高学习率的优势,使模型能够快速适应目标域而不导致性能下降。此外,我们提出了一种基于最近源原型的辅助任务,以对齐源域和目标域的特征,这有助于减少分布偏移并进一步提高性能。我们证明,我们的方法在各种标准基准测试中表现出最先进的性能,甚至优于其监督学习对应方法。
abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel test-time adaptation strategy that adjusts the model pre-trained on the source domain using only unlabeled online data from the target domain to alleviate the performance degradation due to the distribution shift between the source and target domains. Adapting the entire model parameters using the unlabeled online data may be detrimental due to the erroneous signals from an unsupervised objective. To mitigate this problem, we propose a shift-agnostic weight regularization that encourages largely updating the model parameters sensitive to distribution shift while slightly updating those insensitive to the shift, during test-time adaptation. This regularization enables the model to quickly adapt to the target domain without performance degradation by utilizing the benefit of a high learning rate. In addition, we present an auxiliary task based on nearest source prototypes to align the source and target features, which helps reduce the distribution shift and leads to further performance improvement. We show that our method exhibits state-of-the-art performance on various standard benchmarks and even outperforms its supervised counterpart.

title: Sungho Shin, Joosoon Lee, Junseok Lee, Yeonguk Yu, Kyoobin Lee
title_en: Sungho Shin, Joosoon Lee, Junseok Lee, Yeonguk Yu, Kyoobin Lee
abstract: 深度学习在人脸识别基准测试中取得了出色的表现,但在低分辨率(LR)图像上性能显著下降。我们提出了一种注意力相似性知识蒸馏方法,将高分辨率(HR)网络获得的注意力图作为教师网络传输到低分辨率(LR)网络作为学生网络,以提升LR识别性能。受人类能够基于从高分辨率图像中获得的先验知识近似估计LR图像中物体区域的启发,我们设计了使用余弦相似度的知识蒸馏损失函数,使学生网络的注意力与教师网络的注意力相似。在各种LR人脸识别基准测试中的实验验证了所提出的方法在LR设置下通常能提高识别性能,通过简单地传输精心构建的注意力图,超越了最先进的结果。代码和预训练模型可在https://github.com/gist-ailab/teaching-where-to-look公开获取。
abstract_en: Deep learning has achieved outstanding performance for face recognition benchmarks, but performance reduces significantly for low resolution (LR) images. We propose an attention similarity knowledge distillation approach, which transfers attention maps obtained from a high resolution (HR) network as a teacher into an LR network as a student to boost LR recognition performance. Inspired by humans being able to approximate an object’s region from an LR image based on prior knowledge obtained from HR images, we designed the knowledge distillation loss using the cosine similarity to make the student network’s attention resemble the teacher network’s attention. Experiments on various LR face related benchmarks confirmed the proposed method generally improved recognition performances on LR settings, outperforming state-of-the-art results by simply transferring well-constructed attention maps. The code and pretrained models are publicly available in the https://github.com/gist-ailab/teaching-where-to-look.

title: Volumetric Aggregation with Transformers (VAT) 在少样本分割中的应用
title_en: Sunghwan Hong, Seokju Cho, Jisu Nam, Stephen Lin, Seungryong Kim
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的成本聚合网络,称为体积聚合与Transformer(VAT),用于少样本分割。通过在全局感受野上使用自注意力机制,Transformer的应用可以促进相关图的聚合。然而,为了进行Transformer处理,相关图的分词可能会带来负面影响,因为分词边界处的不连续性会减少靠近分词边缘的局部上下文信息,并降低归纳偏置。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种4D卷积Swin Transformer,其中在高维Swin Transformer之前依次使用一系列小核卷积,为所有像素提供局部上下文并引入卷积归纳偏置。此外,我们通过在金字塔结构中应用Transformer来提升聚合性能,其中粗粒度层级的聚合指导细粒度层级的聚合。随后,借助查询的外观嵌入,在解码器中过滤Transformer输出的误差。通过该模型,我们在少样本分割的所有标准基准测试中均取得了新的最先进性能。实验表明,VAT在语义对应任务中也达到了最先进性能,其中成本聚合同样发挥着核心作用。
abstract_en: We present a novel cost aggregation network, called Volumetric Aggregation with Transformers (VAT), for few-shot segmentation. The use of transformers can benefit correlation map aggregation through self-attention over a global receptive field. However, the tokenization of a correlation map for transformer processing can be detrimental, because the discontinuity at token boundaries reduces the local context available near the token edges and decreases inductive bias. To address this problem, we propose a 4D Convolutional Swin Transformer, where a high-dimensional Swin Transformer is preceded by a series of small-kernel convolutions that impart local context to all pixels and introduce convolutional inductive bias. We additionally boost aggregation performance by applying transformers within a pyramidal structure, where aggregation at a coarser level guides aggregation at a finer level. Error in the transformer output is then filtered in the subsequent decoder with the help of the query’s appearance embedding. With this model, a new state-of-the-art is set for all the standard benchmarks in few-shot segmentation. It is shown that VAT attains state-of-the-art performance for semantic correspondence as well, where cost aggregation also plays a central role.

title: FedX:一种无监督联邦学习框架
title_en: Sungwon Han, Sungwon Park, Fangzhao Wu, Sundong Kim, Chuhan Wu, Xing Xie, Meeyoung Cha
abstract: 本文提出了FedX,一种无监督联邦学习框架。我们的模型从分散且异构的本地数据中学习无偏表示。它采用双向知识蒸馏与对比学习作为核心组件,使联邦系统能够在不要求客户端共享任何数据特征的情况下运行。此外,其可扩展的架构可以作为现有无监督算法在联邦设置中的附加模块。实验表明,我们的模型在五种无监督算法上显著提升了性能(1.58--5.52pp)。
abstract_en: This paper presents FedX, an unsupervised federated learning framework. Our model learns unbiased representation from decentralized and heterogeneous local data. It employs a two-sided knowledge distillation with contrastive learning as a core component, allowing the federated system to function without requiring clients to share any data features. Furthermore, its adaptable architecture can be used as an add-on module for existing unsupervised algorithms in federated settings. Experiments show that our model improves performance significantly (1.58--5.52pp) on five unsupervised algorithms.

title: Sunjae Yoon, Ji Woo Hong, Eunseop Yoon, Dahyun Kim, Junyeong Kim, Hee Suk Yoon, Chang D. Yoo
title_en: Sunjae Yoon, Ji Woo Hong, Eunseop Yoon, Dahyun Kim, Junyeong Kim, Hee Suk Yoon, Chang D. Yoo
abstract: Video moment retrieval (VMR) aims to localize target moments in untrimmed videos pertinent to a given textual query. Existing retrieval systems tend to rely on retrieval bias as a shortcut and thus, fail to sufficiently learn multi-modal interactions between query and video. This retrieval bias stems from learning frequent co-occurrence patterns between query and moments, which spuriously correlate objects (e.g., a pencil) referred in the query with moments (e.g., scene of writing with a pencil) where the objects frequently appear in the video, such that they converge into biased moment predictions. Although recent debiasing methods have focused on removing this retrieval bias, we argue that these biased predictions sometimes should be preserved because there are many queries where biased predictions are rather helpful. To conjugate this retrieval bias, we propose a Selective Query-guided Debiasing network (SQuiDNet), which incorporates the following two main properties: (1) Biased Moment Retrieval that intentionally uncovers the biased moments inherent in objects of the query and (2) Selective Query-guided Debiasing that performs selective debiasing guided by the meaning of the query. Our experimental results on three moment retrieval benchmarks (i.e., TVR, ActivityNet, DiDeMo) show the effectiveness of SQuiDNet and qualitative analysis shows improved interpretability.
abstract_en: Video moment retrieval (VMR) aims to localize target moments in untrimmed videos pertinent to a given textual query. Existing retrieval systems tend to rely on retrieval bias as a shortcut and thus, fail to sufficiently learn multi-modal interactions between query and video. This retrieval bias stems from learning frequent co-occurrence patterns between query and moments, which spuriously correlate objects (e.g., a pencil) referred in the query with moments (e.g., scene of writing with a pencil) where the objects frequently appear in the video, such that they converge into biased moment predictions. Although recent debiasing methods have focused on removing this retrieval bias, we argue that these biased predictions sometimes should be preserved because there are many queries where biased predictions are rather helpful. To conjugate this retrieval bias, we propose a Selective Query-guided Debiasing network (SQuiDNet), which incorporates the following two main properties: (1) Biased Moment Retrieval that intentionally uncovers the biased moments inherent in objects of the query and (2) Selective Query-guided Debiasing that performs selective debiasing guided by the meaning of the query. Our experimental results on three moment retrieval benchmarks (i.e., TVR, ActivityNet, DiDeMo) show the effectiveness of SQuiDNet and qualitative analysis shows improved interpretability.

title: 金苏妮、妮可·迈斯特、维克拉姆·V·拉马萨瓦米、露丝·冯、奥尔加·鲁萨科夫斯基
title_en: Sunnie S. Y. Kim, Nicole Meister, Vikram V. Ramaswamy, Ruth Fong, Olga Russakovsky
abstract: 随着人工智能技术越来越多地应用于高影响、高风险领域,出现了一些新的方法,旨在使AI模型更具人类可解释性。尽管可解释性研究最近有所增长,但缺乏对所提技术的系统性评估。在本工作中,我们介绍了HIVE(视觉解释的人类可解释性),一个新颖的人类评估框架,用于评估解释在AI辅助决策场景中对人类用户的实用性,并支持可证伪的假设检验、跨方法比较和以人类为中心的视觉可解释性方法评估。据我们所知,这是同类工作的首次尝试。使用HIVE,我们进行了经过IRB批准的人类研究,参与人数接近1000人,并评估了四种代表计算机视觉可解释性工作的多样性方法:GradCAM、BagNet、ProtoPNet和ProtoTree。我们的结果表明,解释能够增强人类对AI预测的信任,即使对于错误预测也是如此,但这些解释不足以让用户区分正确和错误的预测。我们开源HIVE,以促进未来研究,并鼓励更多以人类为中心的可解释性研究方法。
abstract_en: As AI technology is increasingly applied to high-impact, high-risk domains, there have been a number of new methods aimed at making AI models more human interpretable. Despite the recent growth of interpretability work, there is a lack of systematic evaluation of proposed techniques. In this work, we introduce HIVE (Human Interpretability of Visual Explanations), a novel human evaluation framework that assesses the utility of explanations to human users in AI-assisted decision making scenarios, and enables falsifiable hypothesis testing, cross-method comparison, and human-centered evaluation of visual interpretability methods. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work of its kind. Using HIVE, we conduct IRB-approved human studies with nearly 1000 participants and evaluate four methods that represent the diversity of computer vision interpretability works: GradCAM, BagNet, ProtoPNet, and ProtoTree. Our results suggest that explanations engender human trust, even for incorrect predictions, yet are not distinct enough for users to distinguish between correct and incorrect predictions. We open-source HIVE to enable future studies and encourage more human-centered approaches to interpretability research.

title: Suprosanna Shit, Rajat Koner, Bastian Wittmann, Johannes Paetzold, Ivan Ezhov, Hongwei Li, Jiazhen Pan, Sahand Sharifzadeh, Georgios Kaissis, Volker Tresp, Bjoern Menze
title_en: Suprosanna Shit, Rajat Koner, Bastian Wittmann, Johannes Paetzold, Ivan Ezhov, Hongwei Li, Jiazhen Pan, Sahand Sharifzadeh, Georgios Kaissis, Volker Tresp, Bjoern Menze
abstract: 图像的全面表示需要理解对象及其相互关系,尤其是在图像到图生成任务中,例如道路网络提取、血管网络提取或场景图生成。传统方法采用两阶段方法,先进行目标检测,再单独进行关系预测,这阻碍了对象与关系的同步交互。本文提出了一种统一的一阶段基于Transformer的框架Relationformer,联合预测对象及其关系。我们利用直接基于集合的对象预测,并通过对象间的交互学习联合的对象-关系表示。除了现有的[obj]-token,我们提出了一种新颖的可学习token,即[rln]-token。与[obj]-token结合,[rln]-token通过一系列相互关联实现图像的局部和全局语义推理。结合成对的[obj]-token,[rln]-token有助于高效的关系预测。我们在多个多样且跨领域的数据集上实现了最先进的性能,证明了我们方法的有效性和通用性。
abstract_en: A comprehensive representation of an image requires understanding objects and their mutual relationship, especially in image-to-graph generation, e.g., road network extraction, blood-vessel network extraction, or scene graph generation. Traditionally, image-to-graph generation is addressed with a two-stage approach consisting of object detection followed by a separate relation prediction, which prevents simultaneous object-relation interaction. This work proposes a unified one-stage transformer-based framework, namely Relationformer, that jointly predicts objects and their relations. We leverage direct set-based object prediction and incorporate the interaction among the objects to learn an object-relation representation jointly. In addition to existing [obj]-tokens, we propose a novel learnable token, namely [rln]-token. Together with [obj]-tokens, [rln]-token exploits local and global semantic reasoning in an image through a series of mutual associations. In combination with the pair-wise [obj]-token, the [rln]-token contributes to a computationally efficient relation prediction. We achieve state-of-the-art performance on multiple, diverse and multi-domain datasets that demonstrate our approach’s effectiveness and generalizability.

title: Suraj Kothawade, Saikat Ghosh, Sumit Shekhar, Yu Xiang, Rishabh Iyer
title_en: Suraj Kothawade, Saikat Ghosh, Sumit Shekhar, Yu Xiang, Rishabh Iyer
abstract: 基于深度神经网络的目标检测器在自动驾驶、生物医学成像等多个领域取得了显著成功。已知其成功依赖于大量来自目标领域的数据。虽然深度模型在整体准确率方面通常表现良好,但在处理罕见但关键的数据切片时往往表现不佳。例如,"夜间摩托车"或"夜间自行车"等数据切片在自动驾驶应用中往往罕见但非常关键,此类切片上的误检可能导致灾难性失败和事故。主动学习(AL)是一种已知的范式,用于通过人类在环的方式增量且自适应地构建训练数据集。然而,当前基于主动学习的获取函数难以应对包含罕见切片的真实世界数据集,因为它们基于图像的不确定性评分或全局描述符。我们提出TALISMAN,一种针对罕见切片的目标主动学习框架,使用次模互信息(Submodular Mutual Information)进行目标检测。我们的方法利用感兴趣区域(RoI)特征实例化的次模互信息函数,高效地定位并获取罕见切片的数据点。我们在标准PASCAL VOC07+12和BDD100K(真实世界自动驾驶数据集)上评估了该框架。我们观察到,TALISMAN在罕见切片的平均精度和mAP指标上均优于其他方法。
abstract_en: Deep neural networks based object detectors have shown great success in a variety of domains like autonomous vehicles, biomedical imaging, etc. It is known that their success depends on a large amount of data from the domain of interest. While deep models often perform well in terms of overall accuracy, they often struggle in performance on rare yet critical data slices. For example, data slices like ""motorcycle at night"" or ""bicycle at night"" are often rare but very critical slices for self-driving applications and false negatives on such rare slices could result in ill-fated failures and accidents. Active learning (AL) is a well-known paradigm to incrementally and adaptively build training datasets with a human in the loop. However, current AL based acquisition functions are not well-equipped to tackle real-world datasets with rare slices, since they are based on uncertainty scores or global descriptors of the image. We propose TALISMAN, a novel framework for Targeted Active Learning or object detectIon with rare slices using Submodular MutuAl iNformation. Our method uses the submodular mutual information functions instantiated using features of the region of interest (RoI) to efficiently target and acquire data points with rare slices. We evaluate our framework on the standard PASCAL VOC07+12 and BDD100K, a real-world self-driving dataset. We observe that TALISMAN outperforms other methods by in terms of average precision on rare slices, and in terms of mAP.

title: Surgan Jandial, Yash Khasbage, Arghya Pal, Vineeth N Balasubramanian, Balaji Krishnamurthy
title_en: Surgan Jandial, Yash Khasbage, Arghya Pal, Vineeth N Balasubramanian, Balaji Krishnamurthy
abstract: 近期,利用知识蒸馏(KD)无意中窃取私有/敏感信息的行为引起了广泛关注,并因其关键性质引导了后续的防御研究。近期工作《Nasty Teacher》提出开发无法被攻击模型蒸馏或模仿的教师模型。然而,Nasty Teacher所提供的保密性承诺尚未得到充分研究,为进一步强化对这类漏洞的防御,我们尝试绕过其防御机制,在其存在的情况下成功窃取(或提取)信息。具体而言,我们从两个不同方向分析Nasty Teacher,并据此精心开发出简单而高效的HTC和SCM方法,使模型从Nasty Teacher中学习的效率提升高达68.63%。此外,我们还基于对窃取行为的洞察提出了一种改进的防御方法。我们在多样化的模型/设置上进行的详细实验和消融研究验证了我们方法的有效性。
abstract_en: The inadvertent stealing of private/sensitive information using Knowledge Distillation (KD) has been getting significant attention recently and has guided subsequent defense efforts considering its critical nature. Recent work \textit{Nasty Teacher} proposed to develop teachers which can not be distilled or imitated by models attacking it. However, the promise of confidentiality offered by a nasty teacher is not well studied, and as a further step to strengthen against such loopholes, we attempt to bypass its defense and steal (or extract) information in its presence successfully. Specifically, we analyze Nasty Teacher from two different directions and subsequently leverage them carefully to develop simple yet efficient methodologies, named as HTC and SCM, which increase the learning from Nasty Teacher by upto 68.63% on standard datasets. Additionally, we also explore an improvised defense method based on our insights of stealing. Our detailed set of experiments and ablations on diverse models/settings demonstrate the efficacy of our approach.

title: Suryansh Kumar, Luc Van Gool
title_en: Suryansh Kumar, Luc Van Gool
abstract: 本文倡导在经典非刚性结构从运动(NRSfM)中使用有机先验。所谓有机先验,指的是嵌入于NRSfM矩阵分解理论中的宝贵中间先验信息。研究表明,此类先验信息存在于分解后的矩阵中,令人惊讶的是,现有方法通常忽视了这些先验信息。本文的主要贡献在于提出了一种简单、系统且实用的方法,能够有效利用这些有机先验信息解决NRSfM问题。所提出的方法仅基于低秩形状的常见假设,为正交投影下的NRSfM提供了可靠的解决方案。我们的工作揭示了有机先验信息的可访问性与相机运动及形状变形类型无关。此外,本文从形状和运动两个方面对NRSfM分解提供了深入见解,并首次展示了单次旋转平均对NRSfM的益处。进一步地,我们概述了如何利用基于有机先验的方法有效恢复运动和非刚性3D形状,并展示了显著优于无先验NRSfM的实验结果。最后,我们通过在多个基准数据集上的大量实验和评估,验证了所提方法的优势。
abstract_en: This paper advocates the use of organic priors in classical non-rigid structure from motion (NRSfM). By organic priors, we mean invaluable intermediate prior information intrinsic to the NRSfM matrix factorization theory. It is shown that such priors reside in the factorized matrices, and quite surprisingly, existing methods generally disregard them. The paper’s main contribution is to put forward a simple, methodical, and practical method that can effectively exploit such organic priors to solve NRSfM. The proposed method does not make assumptions other than the popular one on the low-rank shape and offers a reliable solution to NRSfM under orthographic projection. Our work reveals that the accessibility of organic priors is independent of the camera motion and shape deformation type. Besides that, the paper provides insights into the NRSfM factorization---both in terms of shape and motion---and is the first approach to show the benefit of single rotation averaging for NRSfM. Furthermore, we outline how to effectively recover motion and non-rigid 3D shape using the proposed organic prior based approach and demonstrate results that outperform prior-free NRSfM performance by a significant margin. Finally, we present the benefits of our method via extensive experiments and evaluations on several benchmark datasets.

title: Ta-Ying Cheng, Qingyong Hu, Qian Xie, Niki Trigoni, Andrew Markham
title_en: Ta-Ying Cheng, Qingyong Hu, Qian Xie, Niki Trigoni, Andrew Markham
abstract: 采样是点云任务中的关键操作,通过丢弃冗余点来提高计算效率和可处理性。通用采样算法(如最远点采样)可以在不同任务、模型和数据集中无需修改即可运行,但其本质对下游任务/模型是无感知的。因此,它们没有隐含的知识来判断哪些点应保留、哪些应丢弃。近期研究表明,任务特定的点云采样(如SampleNet)可以通过学习哪些点更具信息量,从而超越传统采样方法。然而,这些可学习的采样器面临两个固有问题:i)过度拟合模型而非任务,ii)需要额外训练采样网络,这与原始目标(通过下采样提高效率)相悖。本文提出了一种几乎通用的采样器,旨在学习保留特定任务中最有用的点,同时以低成本适应不同任务、模型或数据集。首先,我们证明在相同任务(如形状重建)中对多个模型进行训练,相比vanilla SampleNet在准确性上显著提升,因为采样网络未过度拟合特定任务网络。其次,我们展示了如何在多个任务上训练一个几乎通用的元采样器。该元采样器在应用于不同数据集、网络甚至不同任务时,可快速微调,从而摊销初始训练成本。
abstract_en: Sampling is a key operation in point-cloud task and acts to increase computational efficiency and tractability by discarding redundant points. Universal sampling algorithms (e.g., Farthest Point Sampling) work without modification across different tasks, models, and datasets, but by their very nature are agnostic about the downstream task/model. As such, they have no implicit knowledge about which points would be best to keep and which to reject. Recent work has shown how task-specific point cloud sampling (e.g., SampleNet) can be used to outperform traditional sampling approaches by learning which points are more informative. However, these learnable samplers face two inherent issues: i) overfitting to a model rather than a task, and ii) requiring training of the sampling network from scratch, in addition to the task network, somewhat countering the original objective of down-sampling to increase efficiency. In this work, we propose an almost-universal sampler, in our quest for a sampler that can learn to preserve the most useful points for a particular task, yet be inexpensive to adapt to different tasks, models or datasets. We first demonstrate how training over multiple models for the same task (e.g., shape reconstruction) significantly outperforms the vanilla SampleNet in terms of accuracy by not overfitting the sample network to a particular task network. Second, we show how we can train an almost-universal meta-sampler across multiple tasks. This meta-sampler can then be rapidly fine-tuned when applied to different datasets, networks, or even different tasks, thus amortizing the initial cost of training.

title: Taeho Kim, Yongin Kwon, Jemin Lee, Taeho Kim, Sangtae Ha
title_en: Taeho Kim, Yongin Kwon, Jemin Lee, Taeho Kim, Sangtae Ha
abstract: 移动设备运行深度学习模型用于图像分类、语音识别等各种用途。由于移动设备的资源限制,研究人员主要关注通过模型剪枝构建轻量级深度神经网络(DNN)模型,或通过编译器优化生成高效代码。我们发现,模型压缩与编译器自动调优之间的直接集成往往无法为目标设备生成最高效的模型。我们提出CPrune,一种基于编译器信息的模型剪枝方法,以支持满足特定目标准确率的应用程序。CPrune通过基于编译器调优过程中构建的程序结构信息进行有指导的剪枝,生成轻量级DNN模型。实验结果表明,与最先进的TVM自动调优相比,CPrune将DNN执行速度提升了最高2.73倍,同时满足准确率要求。
abstract_en: Mobile devices run deep learning models for various purposes, such as image classification and speech recognition. Due to the resource constraints of mobile devices, researchers have focused on either making a lightweight deep neural network (DNN) model using model pruning or generating an efficient code using compiler optimization. We found that the straightforward integration between model compression and compiler auto-tuning often does not produce the most efficient model for a target device. We propose CPrune, a compiler-informed model pruning for efficient target-aware DNN execution to support an application with a required target accuracy. CPrune makes a lightweight DNN model through informed pruning based on the structural information of programs built during the compiler tuning process. Our experimental results show that CPrune increases the DNN execution speed up to 2.73x compared to the state-of-the-art TVM auto-tune while satisfying the accuracy requirement.

title: 金泰伍、 Chung Chaeyeon、 Kim Yoonseo、 Park Sunghyun、 Kim Kangyeol、 Choo Jaegul
title_en: Taewoo Kim, Chaeyeon Chung, Yoonseo Kim, Sunghyun Park, Kangyeol Kim, Jaegul Choo
abstract: 由于发型的复杂性和精细度,发型编辑具有独特性和挑战性。尽管近期的方法显著提升了发型细节,但这些模型在源图像姿态与目标发型图像姿态差异较大时,往往会产生不理想的输出,限制了其实际应用。HairFIT是一种姿态不变的发型迁移模型,缓解了这一限制,但仍存在保留精细发型纹理质量不满意的不足。为解决这些限制,我们提出了一种高性能的姿态不变发型迁移模型,配备了潜在优化和新提出的局部风格匹配损失。在StyleGAN2的潜在空间中,我们首先基于局部风格匹配探索保留详细纹理的目标发型姿态对齐潜在代码。然后,我们的模型在考虑对齐的目标发型的情况下,对源图像的遮挡区域进行修复,并将两幅图像融合以生成最终输出。实验结果表明,我们的模型在较大姿态差异下转移发型和保留局部发型纹理方面具有优势。代码可在https://github.com/Taeu/Style-Your-Hair获取。
abstract_en: Editing hairstyle is unique and challenging due to the complexity and delicacy of hairstyle. Although recent approaches significantly improved the hair details, these models often produce undesirable outputs when a pose of a source image is considerably different from that of a target hair image, limiting their real-world applications. HairFIT, a pose-invariant hairstyle transfer model, alleviates this limitation yet still shows unsatisfactory quality in preserving delicate hair textures. To solve these limitations, we propose a high-performing pose-invariant hairstyle transfer model equipped with latent optimization and a newly presented local-style-matching loss. In the StyleGAN2 latent space, we first explore a pose-aligned latent code of a target hair with the detailed textures preserved based on local style matching. Then, our model inpaints the occlusions of the source considering the aligned target hair and blends both images to produce a final output. The experimental results demonstrate that our model has strengths in transferring a hairstyle under larger pose differences and preserving local hairstyle textures. The codes are available at https://github.com/Taeu/Style-Your-Hair.

title: Taewoo Kim, Jeongmin Lee, Lin Wang, Kuk-Jin Yoon
title_en: Taewoo Kim, Jeongmin Lee, Lin Wang, Kuk-Jin Yoon
abstract: 运动去模糊是一个高度病态的问题,这是由于在模糊退化过程中丢失了运动信息。由于事件相机能够以高时间分辨率捕捉明显的运动,已有多种尝试探索事件在引导去模糊中的潜力。这些方法通常假设曝光时间与视频帧率的倒数相同。然而,在实际情况中并非如此,曝光时间可能是未知的,并且会根据视频拍摄环境(例如光照条件)动态变化。在本文中,我们假设基于帧的相机具有动态变化且未知的曝光时间,来解决事件引导的运动去模糊问题。为此,我们首先通过考虑视频帧采集过程中曝光和读出时间,推导出一种新的事件引导运动去模糊公式。然后,我们提出了一种新颖的端到端学习框架用于事件引导的运动去模糊。特别是,我们设计了一种新颖的基于曝光时间的事件选择(ETES)模块,通过估计模糊帧特征与事件之间的跨模态相关性,选择性地使用事件特征。此外,我们提出了一种特征融合模块,以有效融合来自事件和模糊帧的选定特征。我们在多个数据集上进行了大量实验,并证明我们的方法实现了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Motion deblurring is a highly ill-posed problem due to the loss of motion information in the blur degradation process. Since event cameras can capture apparent motion with a high temporal resolution, several attempts have explored the potential of events for guiding deblurring. These methods generally assume that the exposure time is the same as the reciprocal of the video frame rate. However, this is not true in real situations, and the exposure time might be unknown and dynamically varies depending on the video shooting environment(e.g., illumination condition). In this paper, we address the event-guided motion deblurring assuming dynamically variable unknown exposure time of the frame-based camera. To this end, we first derive a new formulation for event-guided motion deblurring by considering the exposure and readout time in the video frame acquisition process. We then propose a novel end-to-end learning framework for event-guided motion deblurring. In particular, we design a novel Exposure Time-based Event Selection(ETES) module to selectively use event features by estimating the cross-modal correlation between the features from blurred frames and the events. Moreover, we propose a feature fusion module to fuse the selected features from events and blur frames effectively. We conduct extensive experiments on various datasets and demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance.

title: Tai Wang, Jiangmiao Pang, Dahua Lin
title_en: Tai Wang, Jiangmiao Pang, Dahua Lin
abstract: 从单目输入感知三维物体对机器人系统至关重要,相较于多传感器设置,其具有经济性。然而,单张图像无法提供任何预测绝对深度值的线索,因此这一任务尤为困难。受双目方法用于三维物体检测的启发,我们利用相机本体运动提供的强几何结构,实现精确的物体深度估计与检测。我们首先对一般双视角情况进行了理论分析,注意到两个挑战:1)多估计值累积误差使直接预测变得不可行;2)静态相机和匹配歧义导致的固有困境。为此,我们建立几何感知代价体作为深度估计的替代方案,并进一步通过单目理解补偿第二个问题。我们的框架名为Depth from Motion(DfM),利用建立的几何结构将2D图像特征提升至3D空间,并在此基础上检测三维物体。我们还提出了一种无需姿态的DfM方法,使其在相机姿态不可用时仍可使用。我们的框架在KITTI基准测试中显著优于现有最先进方法。详细的定量和定性分析也验证了我们的理论结论。代码已发布于https://github.com/Tai-Wang/Depth-from-Motion。
abstract_en: Perceiving 3D objects from monocular inputs is crucial for robotic systems, given its economy compared to multi-sensor settings. It is notably difficult as a single image can not provide any clues for predicting absolute depth values. Motivated by binocular methods for 3D object detection, we take advantage of the strong geometry structure provided by camera ego-motion for accurate object depth estimation and detection. We first make a theoretical analysis on this general two-view case and notice two challenges: 1) Cumulative errors from multiple estimations that make the direct prediction intractable; 2) Inherent dilemmas caused by static cameras and matching ambiguity. Accordingly, we establish the stereo correspondence with a geometry-aware cost volume as the alternative for depth estimation and further compensate it with monocular understanding to address the second problem. Our framework, named Depth from Motion (DfM), then uses the established geometry to lift 2D image features to the 3D space and detects 3D objects thereon. We also present a pose-free DfM to make it usable when the camera pose is unavailable. Our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin on the KITTI benchmark. Detailed quantitative and qualitative analyses also validate our theoretical conclusions. The code is released at https://github.com/Tai-Wang/Depth-from-Motion.

title: Takehiko Ohkawa, Yu-Jhe Li, Qichen Fu, Ryosuke Furuta, Kris M. Kitani, Yoichi Sato
title_en: Takehiko Ohkawa, Yu-Jhe Li, Qichen Fu, Ryosuke Furuta, Kris M. Kitani, Yoichi Sato
abstract: 我们的目标是在仅有在非常不同条件下(例如室内)拍摄的标记图像的情况下,提高在新成像条件(例如户外)下手关键点回归和像素级手部分割的性能。在现实世界中,训练用于这两个任务的模型需要在各种成像条件下工作。然而,现有标记手数据集覆盖的成像条件变化有限。因此,有必要将基于标记图像(源)训练的模型适应到未标记图像(目标)中,这些图像具有未见过的成像条件。虽然为这两个任务已经开发了自训练领域自适应方法(即以自监督方式从未标记目标图像中学习),但当目标图像的预测存在噪声时,其训练可能会导致性能下降。为了避免这种情况,在自训练过程中对噪声预测赋予低重要性(置信度)权重至关重要。在本文中,我们提出利用两个预测之间的差异来估计目标图像在两个任务中的置信度。这两个预测分别来自两个独立网络,其差异有助于识别噪声预测。为了将我们提出的置信度估计整合到自训练中,我们提出了一种教师-学生框架,其中两个网络(教师)为自训练提供监督,而教师网络通过知识蒸馏从学生网络中学习。我们的实验表明,该方法在不同光照、抓取物体、背景和相机视角的自适应设置中优于现有最先进的方法。与最新的对抗性自适应方法相比,我们的方法在HO3D数据集上的多任务得分提高了4%。我们还在Ego4D数据集上验证了该方法,Ego4D是包含户外快速变化成像条件的自拍视频数据集。
abstract_en: We aim to improve the performance of regressing hand keypoints and segmenting pixel-level hand masks under new imaging conditions (e.g., outdoors) when we only have labeled images taken under very different conditions (e.g., indoors). In the real world, it is important that the model trained for both tasks works under various imaging conditions. However, their variation covered by existing labeled hand datasets is limited. Thus, it is necessary to adapt the model trained on the labeled images (source) to unlabeled images (target) with unseen imaging conditions. While self-training domain adaptation methods (i.e., learning from the unlabeled target images in a self-supervised manner) have been developed for both tasks, their training may degrade performance when the predictions on the target images are noisy. To avoid this, it is crucial to assign a low importance (confidence) weight to the noisy predictions during self-training. In this paper, we propose to utilize the divergence of two predictions to estimate the confidence of the target image for both tasks. These predictions are given from two separate networks, and their divergence helps identify the noisy predictions. To integrate our proposed confidence estimation into self-training, we propose a teacher-student framework where the two networks (teachers) provide supervision to a network (student) for self-training, and the teachers are learned from the student by knowledge distillation. Our experiments show its superiority over state-of-the-art methods in adaptation settings with different lighting, grasping objects, backgrounds, and camera viewpoints. Our method improves by 4% the multi-task score on HO3D compared to the latest adversarial adaptation method. We also validate our method on Ego4D, egocentric videos with rapid changes in imaging conditions outdoors.

title: Takumi Kobayashi
title_en: Takumi Kobayashi
abstract: 在各种视觉分类任务中,深度卷积神经网络(CNNs)为我们带来了显著的性能提升。为进一步提高性能,通过考虑边距来改善类间特征分布等方法对CNNs的特征表示学习进行正则化是有效的。本文提出了一种基于特征向量随机旋转的正则化方法。随机旋转源自圆锥表示,用于描述样本的角边距。虽然该方法通过旋转矩阵对向量进行随机旋转以引入几何正则化,但我们以统计形式理论公式化了正则化,排除了昂贵的几何旋转,同时在训练CNN时有效地对分类施加基于旋转的正则化。在分类任务的实验中,该方法从多个方面进行了全面评估,其性能优于其他正则化方法。代码可在https://github.com/tk1980/StatRot获取。
abstract_en: In various visual classification tasks, we enjoy significant performance improvement by deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs). To further boost performance, it is effective to regularize feature representation learning of CNNs such as by considering margin to improve feature distribution across classes. In this paper, we propose a regularization method based on random rotation of feature vectors. Random rotation is derived from cone representation to describe angular margin of a sample. While it induces geometric regularization to randomly rotate vectors by means of rotation matrices, we theoretically formulate the regularization in a statistical form which excludes costly geometric rotation as well as effectively imposes rotation-based regularization on classification in training CNNs. In the experiments on classification tasks, the method is thoroughly evaluated from various aspects, while producing favorable performance compared to the other regularization methods. Codes are available at https://github.com/tk1980/StatRot.

title: Tal Ben-Haim, Tammy Riklin Raviv
title_en: Tal Ben-Haim, Tammy Riklin Raviv
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的图神经网络(GNN)方法,用于高通量显微镜视频中的细胞追踪。通过将整个时间序列建模为一个直接图,其中细胞实例由节点表示,它们的关联由边表示,我们通过寻找图中的最大路径来提取所有细胞轨迹。这通过几个关键贡献集成到端到端的深度学习框架中实现。我们利用深度度量学习算法提取能够区分不同生物细胞实例并组装相同细胞实例的细胞特征向量。我们引入了一种新的GNN块类型,使节点和边特征向量能够相互更新,从而促进底层的消息传递过程。消息传递的概念,其范围由GNN块的数量决定,是至关重要的,因为它使信息能够在连续帧中节点和边与其邻居之间流动。最后,我们解决了一个边分类问题,并利用识别出的活跃边构建细胞的轨迹和系谱树。我们通过将该方法应用于不同细胞类型、成像设置和实验条件下的2D和3D数据集,展示了所提出细胞追踪方法的优势。我们证明了我们的框架在大多数评估数据集上优于当前最先进的方法。代码可在我们的仓库中获取:https://github.com/talbenha/cell-tracker-gnn。
abstract_en: We present a novel graph neural network (GNN) approach for cell tracking in high-throughput microscopy videos. By modeling the entire time-lapse sequence as a direct graph where cell instances are represented by its nodes and their associations by its edges, we extract the entire set of cell trajectories by looking for the maximal paths in the graph. This is accomplished by several key contributions incorporated into an end-to-end deep learning framework. We exploit a deep metric learning algorithm to extract cell feature vectors that distinguish between instances of different biological cells and assemble same cell instances. We introduce a new GNN block type which enables a mutual update of node and edge feature vectors, thus facilitating the underlying message passing process. The message passing concept, whose extent is determined by the number of GNN blocks, is of fundamental importance as it enables the ‘flow’ of information between nodes and edges much behind their neighbors in consecutive frames. Finally, we solve an edge classification problem and use the identified active edges to construct the cells’ tracks and lineage trees. We demonstrate the strengths of the proposed cell tracking approach by applying it to 2D and 3D datasets of different cell types, imaging setups, and experimental conditions. We show that our framework outperforms current state-of-the-art methods on most of the evaluated datasets. The code is available at our repository: https://github.com/talbenha/cell-tracker-gnn.

title: Tan M. Dinh, Rang Nguyen, Binh-Son Hua
title_en: Tan M. Dinh, Rang Nguyen, Binh-Son Hua
abstract: 本文对文本到图像合成领域的最新方法进行了研究,并提出了一种评估这些方法的框架。我们考虑了包含单个或多个对象的图像合成场景。研究指出现有评估流程存在以下问题:(i) 在图像质量评估中,常用的指标(如Inception分数IS)在单对象场景中常被误校准,或在多对象场景中被误用;(ii) 在文本相关性与对象准确性评估中,现有R-精度(RP)和语义对象准确率(SOA)指标分别存在过拟合现象;(iii) 在多对象场景中,许多关键评估因素(如对象保真度、位置对齐、计数对齐等)被严重忽视;(iv) 当前指标对方法的排序与真实图像的评估结果高度不一致。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一套结合现有指标和新指标的综合评估体系。对于现有指标,我们通过温度缩放改进了IS指标,提出IS*以校准IS所用分类器的置信度;同时提出缓解RP和SOA过拟合问题的解决方案。对于新指标,我们开发了计数对齐、位置对齐、对象中心IS和对象中心FID指标以评估多对象场景。实验表明,使用我们的指标集合进行基准测试可使现有方法的排序高度一致,并与人类评估结果高度吻合。作为副产品,我们创建了AttnGAN++,通过谱归一化稳定AttnGAN的训练过程,构建了一个简单但强大的基准模型。我们还发布了名为TISE的工具箱,以倡导文本到图像模型的公平且一致的评估。
abstract_en: In this paper, we conduct a study on the state-of-the-art methods for text-to-image synthesis and propose a framework to evaluate these methods. We consider syntheses where an image contains a single or multiple objects. Our study outlines several issues in the current evaluation pipeline: (i) for image quality assessment, a commonly used metric, e.g., Inception Score (IS), is often either miscalibrated for the single-object case or misused for the multi-object case; (ii) for text relevance and object accuracy assessment, there is an overfitting phenomenon in the existing R-precision (RP) and Semantic Object Accuracy (SOA) metrics, respectively; (iii) for multi-object case, many vital factors for evaluation, e.g., object fidelity, positional alignment, counting alignment, are largely dismissed; (iv) the ranking of the methods based on current metrics is highly inconsistent with real images. To overcome these issues, we propose a combined set of existing and new metrics to systematically evaluate the methods. For existing metrics, we offer an improved version of IS named IS* by using temperature scaling to calibrate the confidence of the classifier used by IS; we also propose a solution to mitigate the overfitting issues of RP and SOA. For new metrics, we develop counting alignment, positional alignment, object-centric IS, and object-centric FID metrics for evaluating the multi-object case. We show that benchmarking with our bag of metrics results in a highly consistent ranking among existing methods that is well-aligned with human evaluation. As a by-product, we create AttnGAN++, a simple but strong baseline for the benchmark by stabilizing the training of AttnGAN using spectral normalization. We also release our toolbox, so-called TISE, for advocating fair and consistent evaluation of text-to-image models.

title: , <中文标题>,
title_en: Tan Wang, Qianru Sun, Sugiri Pranata, Karlekar Jayashree, Hanwang Zhang
abstract: , <中文摘要>,
abstract_en: We are interested in learning robust models from insufficient data, without the need for any externally pre-trained checkpoints. First, compared to sufficient data, we show why insufficient data renders the model more easily biased to the limited training environments that are usually different from testing. For example, if all the training swan samples are “white”, the model may wrongly use the “white” environment to represent the intrinsic class swan. Then, we justify that equivariance inductive bias can retain the class feature while invariance inductive bias can remove the environmental feature, leaving the class feature that generalizes to any environmental changes in testing. To impose them on learning, for equivariance, we demonstrate that any off-the-shelf contrastive-based self-supervised feature learning method can be deployed; for invariance, we propose a class-wise invariant risk minimization (IRM) that efficiently tackles the challenge of missing environmental annotation in conventional IRM. State-of-the-art experimental results on real-world benchmarks (VIPriors, ImageNet100 and NICO) validate the great potential of equivariance and invariance in data-efficient learning. The code is available at https://github.com/Wangt-CN/EqInv.

title: Tanqiu Qiao, Qianhui Men, Frederick W. B. Li, Yoshiki Kubotani, Shigeo Morishima, Hubert P. H. Shum
title_en: Tanqiu Qiao, Qianhui Men, Frederick W. B. Li, Yoshiki Kubotani, Shigeo Morishima, Hubert P. H. Shum
abstract: 视频中的人-物体交互(HOI)识别对于分析人类活动非常重要。现有大多数专注于视觉特征的工作通常在现实世界场景中会受到遮挡问题的影响。当涉及多个人员和物体的HOI时,这一问题将变得更加复杂。考虑到几何特征如人体姿态和物体位置对理解HOI提供了有意义的信息,我们认为在HOI识别中结合视觉和几何特征的优势是有益的,并提出了一种新颖的两级几何特征引导的图卷积网络(2G-GCN)。几何级图模型了人类和物体几何特征之间的相互依赖性,而融合级图进一步将它们与人类和物体的视觉特征进行融合。为了在具有挑战性的场景中展示我们方法的新颖性和有效性,我们提出了一种新的多人员HOI数据集(MPHOI-72)。在MPHOI-72(多人员HOI)、CAD-120(单人HOI)和Bimanual Actions(双手HOI)数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在与现有最先进的方法相比具有优越的性能。
abstract_en: Human-Object Interaction (HOI) recognition in videos is important for analyzing human activity. Most existing work focusing on visual features usually suffer from occlusion in the real-world scenarios. Such a problem will be further complicated when multiple people and objects are involved in HOIs. Consider that geometric features such as human pose and object position provide meaningful information to understand HOIs, we argue to combine the benefits of both visual and geometric features in HOI recognition, and propose a novel Two-level Geometric feature-informed Graph Convolutional Network (2G-GCN). The geometric-level graph models the interdependency between geometric features of humans and objects, while the fusion-level graph further fuses them with visual features of humans and objects. To demonstrate the novelty and effectiveness of our method in challenging scenarios, we propose a new multi-person HOI dataset (MPHOI-72). Extensive experiments on MPHOI-72 (multi-person HOI), CAD-120 (single-human HOI) and Bimanual Actions (two-hand HOI) datasets demonstrate our superior performance compared to state-of-the-arts.

title: Tao He, Lianli Gao, Jingkuan Song, Yuan-Fang Li
title_en: Tao He, Lianli Gao, Jingkuan Song, Yuan-Fang Li
abstract: 场景图生成(SGG)是一项基础任务,旨在检测图像中物体之间的视觉关系。现有的SGG方法要求所有物体类别在训练集中预先提供。这种封闭设置限制了SGG的实际应用。本文引入了开放词汇场景图生成,这是一种新颖、现实且具有挑战性的设置,在该设置中,模型在少量基础物体类别上进行训练,但需要推断未见过的目标物体类别的关系。为此,我们提出了一种两步方法:首先在大量粗粒度区域-描述数据上进行预训练,然后利用两种基于提示的技术对预训练模型进行微调,而无需更新其参数。此外,我们的方法能够支持对完全未见过的物体类别的推理,这是现有方法无法处理的。在三个基准数据集Visual Genome、GQA和Open-Image上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在开放词汇SGG(Ov-SGG)设置以及传统封闭SGG设置中均显著优于近期强大的SGG方法。
abstract_en: Scene graph generation (SGG) is a fundamental task aimed at detecting visual relations between objects in an image. The prevailing SGG methods require all object classes to be given in the training set. Such a closed setting limits the practical application of SGG. In this paper, we introduce open-vocabulary scene graph generation, a novel, realistic and challenging setting, in which a model is trained on a small set of base object classes but is required to infer relations for unseen target object classes. To this end, we propose a two-step method which firstly pre-trains on large amounts of coarse-grained region-caption data and then leverage two prompt-based techniques to finetune the pre-trained model without updating its parameters. Moreover, our method is able to support inference over completely unseen object classes, which existing methods are incapable of handling. On extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets, Visual Genome, GQA and Open-Image, our method significantly outperforms recent, strong SGG methods on the setting of Ov-SGG, as well as on the conventional closed SGG.

title: 孙涛、卢成、凌海斌
title_en: Tao Sun, Cheng Lu, Haibin Ling
abstract: 目标域中标签的缺失使得无监督域适应(UDA)在许多实际应用中成为一种有吸引力的技术,尽管它也带来了巨大的挑战,因为模型适应在没有标记目标数据的情况下变得更加困难。在本文中,我们通过寻求来自目标域先验知识的补偿来解决这一问题,这种先验知识在实践中通常是(部分)可用的,例如来自人类专业知识。这导致了一种新颖且实用的设置,除了训练数据外,还可用一些关于目标类分布的先验知识。我们将这种设置称为知识引导的无监督域适应(KUDA)。特别是,我们考虑了两种关于目标域类分布的先验知识类型:单值边界,它描述了单个类概率的上下界,以及二元关系,它描述了两个类概率之间的关系。我们提出了一种通用的校正模块,利用这种先验知识来改进模型生成的伪标签。该模块被公式化为一个零一规划问题,该问题来源于先验知识和一个平滑正则化器。它可以轻松地插入基于自训练的UDA方法中,并且我们将其与两种最先进的方法SHOT和DINE结合。在四个基准上的实验证明,校正模块明显提高了伪标签的质量,这反过来又有利于自训练阶段。在先验知识的指导下,两种方法的性能都显著提升。我们希望我们的工作能激发进一步在UDA中整合先验知识的研究。代码可在https://github.com/tsun/KUDA获取。
abstract_en: The waive of labels in the target domain makes Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) an attractive technique in many real-world applications, though it also brings great challenges as model adaptation becomes harder without labeled target data. In this paper, we address this issue by seeking compensation from target domain prior knowledge, which is often (partially) available in practice, e.g., from human expertise. This leads to a novel yet practical setting where in addition to the training data, some prior knowledge about the target class distribution are available. We term the setting as Knowledge-guided Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (KUDA). In particular, we consider two specific types of prior knowledge about the class distribution in the target domain: Unary Bound that describes the lower and upper bounds of individual class probabilities, and Binary Relationship that describes the relations between two class probabilities. We propose a general rectification module that uses such prior knowledge to refine model generated pseudo labels. The module is formulated as a Zero-One Programming problem derived from the prior knowledge and a smooth regularizer. It can be easily plugged into self-training based UDA methods, and we combine it with two state-of-the-art methods, SHOT and DINE. Empirical results on four benchmarks confirm that the rectification module clearly improves the quality of pseudo labels, which in turn benefits the self-training stage. With the guidance from prior knowledge, the performances of both methods are substantially boosted. We expect our work to inspire further investigations in integrating prior knowledge in UDA. Code is available at https://github.com/tsun/KUDA.

title: Tao Zhang, Wu Huang
title_en: Tao Zhang, Wu Huang
abstract: Few-shot learning 在稀缺样本上执行分类和回归任务。作为最具代表性的 few-shot 学习模型之一,原型网络将每个类别表示为样本平均值,或称为原型,并通过欧几里得距离衡量样本与原型的相似性。本文提出了一种谱滤波(收缩)框架,用于在再生核希尔伯特空间(RKHS)中衡量查询样本与原型(即相对原型)之间的差异。在该框架中,进一步提出利用 Tikhonov 正则化作为滤波函数的 few-shot 分类方法。我们在 miniImageNet 数据集、tiered-ImageNet 数据集和 CIFAR-FS 数据集上基于不同核函数验证了该方法。实验结果表明,所提出的模型能够达到最先进水平。此外,实验结果还表明,所提出的收缩方法能够提升模型性能。源代码可在 https://github.com/zhangtao2022/DSFN 获取。
abstract_en: Few-shot learning performs classification tasks and regression tasks on scarce samples. As one of the most representative few-shot learning models, Prototypical Network represents each class as sample average, or a prototype, and measures the similarity of samples and prototypes by Euclidean distance. In this paper, we propose a framework of spectral filtering (shrinkage) for measuring the difference between query samples and prototypes, or namely the relative prototypes, in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). In this framework, we further propose a method utilizing Tikhonov regularization as the filter function for few-shot classification. We conduct several experiments to verify our method utilizing different kernels based on the miniImageNet dataset, tiered-ImageNet dataset and CIFAR-FS dataset. The experimental results show that the proposed model can perform the state-of-the-art. In addition, the experimental results show that the proposed shrinkage method can boost the performance. Source code is available at https://github.com/zhangtao2022/DSFN.

title: Taotao Jing, Haifeng Xia, Renran Tian, Haoran Ding, Xiao Luo, Joshua Domeyer, Rini Sherony, Zhengming Ding
title_en: Taotao Jing, Haifeng Xia, Renran Tian, Haoran Ding, Xiao Luo, Joshua Domeyer, Rini Sherony, Zhengming Ding
abstract: 自动驾驶领域对可解释的动作决策模型产生了浓厚兴趣,这类模型旨在模拟人类认知。现有的可解释自动驾驶模型主要探索静态的人类解释,忽略了未被显式标注或标注者之间不一致的隐含视觉语义。本文提出了一种新颖的可解释动作决策模型(InAction),通过显式人类标注和隐含视觉语义提供更丰富的解释。首先,提出的视觉语义模块从视觉输入中捕捉基于区域的动作诱导成分,学习隐含视觉语义以在动作决策中提供人类可理解的解释。其次,通过结合全局视觉特征和动作诱导视觉语义开发了显式推理模块,旨在联合对齐人类标注解释与动作决策。在两个自动驾驶基准测试中的实验结果验证了InAction模型在对比现有可解释自动驾驶模型时,能够有效解释隐含和显式信息。
abstract_en: Autonomous driving has attracted interest for interpretable action decision models that mimic human cognition. Existing interpretable autonomous driving models explore static human explanations, which ignore the implicit visual semantics that are not explicitly annotated or even consistent across annotators. In this paper, we propose a novel Interpretable Action decision making (InAction) model to provide an enriched explanation from both explicit human annotation and implicit visual semantics. First, a proposed visual-semantic module captures the region-based action-inducing components from the visual inputs, which learns the implicit visual semantics to provide a human-understandable explanation in action decision making. Second, an explicit reasoning module is developed by incorporating global visual features and action-inducing visual semantics, which aims to jointly align the human-annotated explanation and action decision making. Experimental results on two autonomous driving benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our InAction model for explaining both implicitly and explicitly by comparing it to existing interpretable autonomous driving models.

title: Taras Khakhulin, Vanessa Sklyarova, Victor Lempitsky, Egor Zakharov
title_en: Taras Khakhulin, Vanessa Sklyarova, Victor Lempitsky, Egor Zakharov
abstract: 我们提出了一种用于创建基于网格的单次拍摄(ROME)人头虚拟形象的系统。从单张照片出发,我们的系统估计出头部网格(包括面部和非面部头部部分的个性化细节),以及神经纹理编码局部光度和几何细节。生成的虚拟形象可以进行绑定,并通过深度渲染网络进行渲染,该网络与网格和纹理估计器一起在野外视频数据集上进行训练。在实验中,我们观察到,我们的系统在头部几何恢复和渲染质量方面表现优异,尤其是在姿态和表情变化较大的情况下。
abstract_en: We present a system for the creation of realistic one-shot mesh-based (ROME) human head avatars. From a single photograph, our system estimates the head mesh (with person-specific details in both the facial and non-facial head parts) as well as the neural texture encoding local photometric and geometric details. The resulting avatars are rigged and can be rendered using a deep rendering network, which is trained alongside the mesh and texture estimators on a dataset of in-the-wild videos. In the experiments, we observe that our system performs competitively both in terms of head geometry recovery and the quality of renders, especially for strong pose and expression changes.

title: Tarasha Khurana, Peiyun Hu, Achal Dave, Jason Ziglar, David Held, Deva Ramanan
title_en: Tarasha Khurana, Peiyun Hu, Achal Dave, Jason Ziglar, David Held, Deva Ramanan
abstract: 安全自动驾驶的运动规划需要学习环境如何随时间演化。场景中可行驶区域的以自身为中心的感知不仅随环境中行为主体的运动变化,也随自身车辆的运动变化。为大规模规划提出的自监督表示(如以自身为中心的自由空间)混淆了这两种运动,使得表示难以用于下游运动规划。本文使用几何占用作为视图依赖表示(如自由空间)的自然替代方案。占用地图能够自然地将环境运动与自身车辆运动解耦。然而,由于遮挡,无法直接观察场景的完整3D占用,使其难以作为学习信号。我们的关键洞察是使用可微射线投射将未来占用预测“渲染”为未来激光雷达扫描预测,这些预测可与真实扫描进行比较以实现自监督学习。使用可微射线投射使占用成为预测网络中的内部表示。在缺乏真实占用数据的情况下,我们定量评估了射线投射激光雷达扫描的预测,并展示了最高15个F1点的改进。对于下游运动规划器,该表示通过直接指导不可行驶区域,相较于以自由空间为中心的运动规划器,可将与物体的碰撞减少高达17%。
abstract_en: Motion planning for safe autonomous driving requires learning how the environment around an ego-vehicle evolves with time. Ego-centric perception of driveable regions in a scene not only changes with the motion of actors in the environment, but also with the movement of the ego-vehicle itself. Self-supervised representations proposed for large-scale planning, such as ego-centric freespace, confound these two motions, making the representation difficult to use for downstream motion planners. In this paper, we use geometric occupancy as a natural alternative to view-dependent representations such as freespace. Occupancy maps naturally disentagle the motion of the environment from the motion of the ego-vehicle. However, one cannot directly observe the full 3D occupancy of a scene (due to occlusion), making it difficult to use as a signal for learning. Our key insight is to use differentiable raycasting to ""render"" future occupancy predictions into future LiDAR sweep predictions, which can be compared with ground-truth sweeps for self-supervised learning. The use of differentiable raycasting allows occupancy to emerge as an internal representation within the forecasting network. In the absence of groundtruth occupancy, we quantitatively evaluate the forecasting of raycasted LiDAR sweeps and show improvements of upto 15 F1 points. For downstream motion planners, where emergent occupancy can be directly used to guide non-driveable regions, this representation relatively reduces the number of collisions with objects by up to 17% as compared to freespace-centric motion planners.

title: Tarun Kalluri, Astuti Sharma, Manmohan Chandraker
title_en: Tarun Kalluri, Astuti Sharma, Manmohan Chandraker
abstract: 实际的现实世界数据集包含大量类别,为无监督域适应带来了新挑战,如类间可区分性不足,现有仅依赖域不变性的方法难以充分应对。本文提出MemSAC方法,通过源域和目标域样本级相似性实现具有区分性的迁移,同时支持大规模类别的架构设计。为此,我们首先引入一种基于记忆增强的方法,高效提取带标签源域与无标签目标域实例之间的成对相似性关系,适用于任意数量的类别。随后,我们提出并理论证明了一种新型对比损失变体,通过在类内跨域样本间促进局部一致性,同时强制类间分离,从而保持从源域到目标域的区分性迁移。我们在多个针对大规模适应设计的挑战性迁移任务上验证了MemSAC的优势,如包含345类的DomainNet数据集和包含200类的Caltech-UCSD鸟类细粒度适应数据集,显著超越了先前的最先进方法。我们还提供了对MemSAC有效性的深入分析和见解。
abstract_en: Practical real world datasets with plentiful categories introduce new challenges for unsupervised domain adaptation like small inter-class discriminability, that existing approaches relying on domain invariance alone cannot handle sufficiently well. In this work we propose MemSAC, which exploits sample level similarity across source and target domains to achieve discriminative transfer, along with architectures that scale to a large number of categories. For this purpose, we first introduce a memory augmented approach to efficiently extract pairwise similarity relations between labeled source and unlabeled target domain instances, suited to handle an arbitrary number of classes. Next, we propose and theoretically justify a novel variant of the contrastive loss to promote local consistency among within-class cross domain samples while enforcing separation between classes, thus preserving discriminative transfer from source to target. We validate the advantages of MemSAC with significant improvements over previous state-of-the-art on multiple challenging transfer tasks designed for large-scale adaptation, such as DomainNet with 345 classes and fine-grained adaptation on Caltech-UCSD birds dataset with 200 classes. We also provide in-depth analysis and insights into the effectiveness of MemSAC.

title: Tejan Karmali, Rishubh Parihar, Susmit Agrawal, Harsh Rangwani, Varun Jampani, Maneesh Singh, R. Venkatesh Babu
title_en: Tejan Karmali, Rishubh Parihar, Susmit Agrawal, Harsh Rangwani, Varun Jampani, Maneesh Singh, R. Venkatesh Babu
abstract: 生成对抗网络(GANs)的进步使得生成高质量的高分辨率逼真图像成为可能。StyleGANs通过在W/W+空间中对潜在风格向量进行数学运算,实现对这类图像的引人注目的属性修改,这些运算有效调节了生成器的丰富层次化表示。此类操作在原始StyleGAN论文中已从单纯的属性交换扩展到包括插值操作。尽管StyleGANs在多个方面取得了显著改进,但生成的图像仍被认为不够自然。生成图像的质量基于两个假设:(a) 生成器学习到的层次化表示的丰富性,以及(b) 风格空间的线性和平滑性。在本工作中,我们提出了一种层次化语义正则化器(HSR),将生成器学习到的层次化表示与在大量数据上预训练网络学习到的强大特征对齐。HSR不仅能够提升生成器的表示能力,还能改善潜在风格空间的线性和平滑性,从而生成更自然的风格编辑图像。为验证改进的线性性,我们提出了一种新指标——属性线性得分(ALS)。通过在不同标准数据集上平均提升16.19%的感知路径长度(PPL)指标,显著减少了不自然图像的生成,同时提升了属性编辑任务中属性变化的线性性。
abstract_en: Progress in GANs has enabled the generation of high-resolution photorealistic images of astonishing quality. StyleGANs allow for compelling attribute modification on such images via mathematical operations on the latent style vectors in the W/W+ space that effectively modulate the rich hierarchical representations of the generator. Such operations have recently been generalized beyond mere attribute swapping in the original StyleGAN paper to include interpolations. In spite of many significant improvements in StyleGANs, they are still seen to generate unnatural images. The quality of the generated images is predicated on two assumptions; (a) The richness of the hierarchical representations learnt by the generator, and, (b) The linearity and smoothness of the style spaces. In this work, we propose a Hierarchical Semantic Regularizer (HSR) which aligns the hierarchical representations learnt by the generator to corresponding powerful features learnt by pretrained networks on large amounts of data. HSR is shown to not only improve generator representations but also the linearity and smoothness of the latent style spaces, leading to the generation of more natural-looking style-edited images. To demonstrate improved linearity, we propose a novel metric - Attribute Linearity Score (ALS). A significant reduction in the generation of unnatural images is corroborated by improvement in the Perceptual Path Length (PPL) metric by 16.19% averaged across different standard datasets while simultaneously improving the linearity of attribute-change in the attribute editing tasks.

title: Teng Xi, Yifan Sun, Deli Yu, Bi Li, Nan Peng, Gang Zhang, Xinyu Zhang, Zhigang Wang, Jinwen Chen, Jian Wang, Lufei Liu, Haocheng Feng, Junyu Han, Jingtuo Liu, Errui Ding, Jingdong Wang
title_en: Teng Xi, Yifan Sun, Deli Yu, Bi Li, Nan Peng, Gang Zhang, Xinyu Zhang, Zhigang Wang, Jinwen Chen, Jian Wang, Lufei Liu, Haocheng Feng, Junyu Han, Jingtuo Liu, Errui Ding, Jingdong Wang
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的统一特征优化(Unified Feature Optimization, UFO)范式,用于在现实世界和大规模场景下训练和部署深度模型,该范式需要集成多种AI功能。UFO旨在通过在所有任务上进行大规模预训练,使每个单个任务受益。与现有基础模型相比,UFO具有两个不同的侧重点,即相对较小的模型规模和无需适应成本:1)UFO以多任务学习方式将广泛的任务压缩到一个中等规模的统一模型中,并在转移到下游任务时进一步修剪模型规模。2)UFO不强调向新任务的迁移。相反,它旨在使修剪后的模型专门用于一个或多个已见过的任务。为此,它直接选择统一模型中的部分模块,因此完全无需适应成本。凭借这两个特性,UFO为灵活部署提供了极大便利,同时保持了大规模预训练的优势。UFO的关键优势在于,修剪过程不仅减少了模型规模和推理消耗,甚至在某些任务上还提高了准确性。具体而言,UFO考虑多任务训练,并对统一模型产生双重影响:一些密切相关任务具有相互促进作用,而一些任务则相互冲突。UFO通过一种新颖的网络架构搜索(Network Architecture Search, NAS)方法,成功减少了冲突并保留了相互促进作用。在广泛深度表征学习任务(如人脸识别、行人重识别、车辆重识别和产品检索)上的实验表明,从UFO修剪得到的模型在准确率上高于其单任务训练的对应模型,同时模型规模更小,验证了UFO的概念。此外,UFO还支持发布了一个170亿参数的计算机视觉(CV)基础模型,这是业界最大的CV模型。
abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel Unified Feature Optimization (UFO) paradigm for training and deploying deep models under real-world and large-scale scenarios, which requires a collection of multiple AI functions. UFO aims to benefit each single task with a large-scale pretraining on all tasks. Compared with existing foundation models, UFO has two different points of emphasis, i.e., relatively smaller model size and NO adaptation cost: 1) UFO squeezes a wide range of tasks into a moderate-sized unified model in a multi-task learning manner and further trims the model size when transferred to down-stream tasks. 2) UFO does not emphasize transfer to novel tasks. Instead, it aims to make the trimmed model dedicated for one or more already-seen task. To this end, it directly selects partial modules in the unified model, and thus requires completely NO adaptation cost. With these two characteristics, UFO provides great convenience for flexible deployment, while maintaining the benefits of large-scale pretraining. A key merit of UFO is that the trimming process not only reduces the model size and inference consumption, but also even improves the accuracy on certain tasks. Specifically, UFO considers the multi-task training and brings two-fold impact on the unified model: some closely related tasks have mutual benefits, while some tasks have conflicts against each other. UFO manages to reduce the conflicts and to preserve the mutual benefits through a novel Network Architecture Search (NAS) method. Experiments on a wide range of deep representation learning tasks (i.e., face recognition, person re-identification, vehicle re-identification and product retrieval) show that the model trimmed from UFO achieves higher accuracy than its single-task-trained counterpart and yet has smaller model size, validating the concept of UFO. Besides, UFO also supported the release of 17 billion parameters computer vision (CV) foundation model which is the largest CV model in the industry.

title: Thanh Nguyen, Chau Pham, Khoi Nguyen, Minh Hoai
title_en: Thanh Nguyen, Chau Pham, Khoi Nguyen, Minh Hoai
abstract: 我们研究了一个新的任务——少样本目标计数与检测。给定目标物体类别的少量示例边界框,我们旨在计数并检测所有目标类别的物体。该任务与少样本计数任务具有相同的监督机制,但额外输出物体边界框以及总物体数量。为解决这一具有挑战性的问题,我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段训练策略和一种新颖的不确定性感知少样本目标检测器Counting-DETR。前者旨在生成伪真实边界框以训练后者,后者利用前者提供的伪真实边界框,但采取必要步骤以应对伪真实边界框的不完美性。为验证我们的方法在新任务上的性能,我们引入了两个新数据集,命名为FSCD-147和FSCD-LVIS。这两个数据集均包含复杂场景的图像,每张图像包含多个物体类别,且物体在形状、尺寸和外观上存在巨大变化。我们的方法在计数和检测指标上均显著优于来自少样本目标计数和少样本目标检测的强基线模型。
abstract_en: We tackle a new task of few-shot object counting and detection. Given a few exemplar bounding boxes of a target object class, we seek to count and detect all the objects of the target class. This task shares the same supervision as the few-shot counting but additionally outputs the object bounding boxes along with the total object count. To address this challenging problem, we introduce a novel two-stage training strategy and a novel uncertainty-aware few-shot object detector Counting-DETR. The former is aimed at generating pseudo ground truth bounding boxes to train the latter. The latter leverages the pseudo ground-truth provided by the former, but taking the necessary steps to account for the imperfection of pseudo ground truth. To validate the performance of our method on the new task, we introduce a two new datasets named FSCD-147 and FSCD-LVIS. Both datasets contain images with complex scene, multiple object classes per image, and huge variation in object shapes, sizes, and appearance. Our propose approach outperforms very strong baselines adapted from few-shot object counting and few-shot object detection with a large margin in both counting and detection metrics.

title: Theodoros Panagiotakopoulos, Pier Luigi Dovesi, Linus Härenstam-Nielsen, Matteo Poggi
title_en: Theodoros Panagiotakopoulos, Pier Luigi Dovesi, Linus Härenstam-Nielsen, Matteo Poggi
abstract: 无监督域适应(UDA)旨在减少训练数据与测试数据之间的域差距,通常以离线方式进行。然而,在部署过程中,域变化可能持续且不可预测地发生(例如突然的天气变化)。在这种情况下,深度神经网络的准确率会急剧下降,而离线适应可能不足以应对这种情况。本文针对语义分割问题提出在线域适应(OnDA)方法。我们设计了一种能够有效应对连续域变化(无论是渐进式还是突发式)的框架,并在雨天和雾天场景中进行了评估。实验结果表明,我们的框架能够在部署过程中有效适应新域,同时避免对先前域的灾难性遗忘。
abstract_en: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) aims at reducing the domain gap between training and testing data and is, in most cases, carried out in offline manner. However, domain changes may occur continuously and unpredictably during deployment (e.g. sudden weather changes). In such conditions, deep neural networks witness dramatic drops in accuracy and offline adaptation may not be enough to contrast it. In this paper, we tackle Online Domain Adaptation (OnDA) for semantic segmentation. We design a pipeline that is robust to continuous domain shifts, either gradual or sudden, and we evaluate it in the case of rainy and foggy scenarios. Our experiments show that our framework can effectively adapt to new domains during deployment, while not being affected by catastrophic forgetting of the previous domains.

title: Theodoros Pissas, Claudio S. Ravasio, Lyndon Da Cruz, Christos Bergeles
title_en: Theodoros Pissas, Claudio S. Ravasio, Lyndon Da Cruz, Christos Bergeles
abstract: 本工作探讨了监督对比学习在语义分割中的应用。我们通过对比学习增强语义分割网络提取的多尺度特征的判别能力。我们的方法论核心在于利用模型编码器多个阶段特征空间中的样本,无需数据增强或在线记忆库即可获得多样化的样本集。为实现这一扩展,我们引入了一种高效且有效的采样过程,使得能够在编码器的多尺度特征上应用对比损失。此外,通过将编码器的多尺度表示映射到公共特征空间,我们引入了一种新颖的监督局部-全局约束,通过跨尺度对比学习将高分辨率局部特征与低分辨率全局特征进行关联。综合来看,我们的多尺度与跨尺度对比损失显著提升了多种模型(DeepLabv3、HRNet、OCRNet、UPerNet)在卷积神经网络和Transformer主干网络上的性能,这些模型在4个来自自然领域(Cityscapes、PascalContext、ADE20K)和外科领域(CaDIS)的多样化数据集上进行了评估。我们的代码可在https://github.com/RViMLab/MS_CS_ContrSeg获取。
abstract_en: This work considers supervised contrastive learning for semantic segmentation. We apply contrastive learning to enhance the discriminative power of the multi-scale features extracted by semantic segmentation networks. Our key methodological insight is to leverage samples from the feature spaces emanating from multiple stages of a model’s encoder itself requiring neither data augmentation nor online memory banks to obtain a diverse set of samples. To allow for such an extension we introduce an efficient and effective sampling process, that enables applying contrastive losses over the encoder’s features at multiple scales. Furthermore, by first mapping the encoder’s multi-scale representations to a common feature space, we instantiate a novel form of supervised local-global constraint by introducing cross-scale contrastive learning linking high-resolution local features to low-resolution global features. Combined, our multi-scale and cross-scale contrastive losses boost performance of various models (DeepLabv3, HRNet, OCRNet, UPerNet) with both CNN and Transformer backbones, when evaluated on 4 diverse datasets from natural (Cityscapes, PascalContext, ADE20K) but also surgical (CaDIS) domains. Our code is available at https://github.com/RViMLab/MS_CS_ContrSeg.

title: Thomas Eboli, Jean-Michel Morel, Gabriele Facciolo
title_en: Thomas Eboli, Jean-Michel Morel, Gabriele Facciolo
abstract: 任何相机的光学系统都会降低照片的清晰度,这是关键的视觉质量标准。这种退化由点扩散函数(PSF)表征,其依赖于光的波长,并在成像场中变化。本文提出了一种两阶段方案,用于在单张原始或JPEG图像中校正光学畸变,即无需任何关于相机或镜头的先验信息。首先,我们为重叠块估计局部高斯模糊核,并使用非盲去模糊技术对其进行锐化。基于数十种镜头的PSF测量,这些模糊核被建模为由七个参数定义的RGB高斯分布。其次,我们使用卷积神经网络去除第一阶段未考虑的剩余横向色差,该网络经过训练以最小化红/绿和蓝/绿残差图像。在合成和真实图像上的实验表明,这两个阶段的结合产生了一种快速的盲光学畸变补偿技术,其性能可与商业非盲算法相媲美。
abstract_en: The optics of any camera degrades the sharpness of photographs, which is a key visual quality criterion. This degradation is characterized by the point-spread function (PSF), which depends on the wavelengths of light and is variable across the imaging field. In this paper, we propose a two-step scheme to correct optical aberrations in a single raw or JPEG image, i.e., without any prior information on the camera or lens. First, we estimate local Gaussian blur kernels for overlapping patches and sharpen them with a non-blind deblurring technique. Based on the measurements of the PSFs of dozens of lenses, these blur kernels are modeled as RGB Gaussians defined by seven parameters. Second, we remove the remaining lateral chromatic aberrations (not contemplated in the first step) with a convolutional neural network, trained to minimize the red/green and blue/green residual images. Experiments on both synthetic and real images show that the combination of these two stages yields a fast state-of-the-art blind optical aberration compensation technique that competes with commercial non-blind algorithms.

title: Thomas Hayes, Songyang Zhang, Xi Yin, Guan Pang, Sasha Sheng, Harry Yang, Songwei Ge, Qiyuan Hu, Devi Parikh
title_en: Thomas Hayes, Songyang Zhang, Xi Yin, Guan Pang, Sasha Sheng, Harry Yang, Songwei Ge, Qiyuan Hu, Devi Parikh
abstract: 多模态视频-音频-文本理解与生成可从狭窄但丰富的数据集中受益。狭窄性使研究社区能够解决小规模挑战并取得进展,丰富性则确保我们沿着核心挑战取得进展。为此,我们提出一个大规模视频-音频-文本数据集MUGEN,该数据集通过开源平台游戏CoinRun收集。我们对游戏进行了重大修改,通过引入音频和启用新交互使其更加丰富。我们训练了具有不同目标的强化学习代理,以导航游戏并与13个对象和角色进行交互。这使我们能够自动提取大量多样化的视频及其关联音频。我们采样了375,000个视频片段(每个3.2秒),并从人类标注者处收集文本描述。每个视频还包含从游戏引擎自动提取的额外注释,例如每帧的准确语义地图和模板化文本描述。总体而言,MUGEN可帮助推进多模态理解与生成领域的多项研究任务。我们在涉及视频-音频-文本检索与生成的任务上对代表性方法进行了基准测试。我们的数据集和代码已发布于:https://mugen-org.github.io/。
abstract_en: Multimodal video-audio-text understanding and generation can benefit from datasets that are narrow but rich. The narrowness allows bite-sized challenges that the research community can make progress on. The richness ensures we are making progress along the core challenges. To this end, we present a large-scale video-audio-text dataset MUGEN, collected using the open-sourced platform game CoinRun. We made substantial modifications to make the game richer by introducing audio and enabling new interactions. We trained RL agents with different objectives to navigate the game and interact with 13 objects and characters. This allows us to automatically extract a large collection of diverse videos and associated audio. We sample 375K video clips (3.2s each) and collect text descriptions from human annotators. Each video has additional annotations that are extracted automatically from the game engine, such as accurate semantic maps for each frame and templated textual descriptions. Altogether, MUGEN can help progress research in many tasks in multimodal understanding and generation. We benchmark representative approaches on tasks involving video-audio-text retrieval and generation. Our dataset and code are released at: https://mugen-org.github.io/.

title: 基于动作条件的人类运动序列生成
title_en: Thomas Lucas, Fabien Baradel, Philippe Weinzaepfel, Grégory Rogez
abstract: 我们研究了基于动作条件的人类运动序列生成问题。现有工作主要分为两类:一类是基于观察到的过去运动进行预测的模型,另一类是仅基于动作标签和持续时间进行生成的模型。与之不同,我们提出了一种能够基于任意长度的观察数据(包括零长度)生成运动的方法。为解决这一通用问题,我们提出了PoseGPT,这是一种基于自回归Transformer架构的方法,其内部将人类运动压缩为量化后的潜在序列。首先,一个自编码器将人类运动映射到离散空间中的潜在索引序列,并可逆地进行反向映射。受生成式预训练Transformer(GPT)的启发,我们在该空间中提出训练类似GPT的模型进行下一步索引预测;这使得PoseGPT能够输出可能未来的分布,无论是否基于过去运动进行条件约束。潜在空间的离散性和压缩性使类似GPT的模型能够专注于长程信号,因为它消除了输入信号中的低级冗余。预测离散索引也缓解了预测平均姿态的常见陷阱,这是回归连续值时的典型失败案例,因为离散目标的平均值本身并不是目标。实验结果表明,我们的方法在HumanAct12(标准但规模较小的数据集)、BABEL(近期大规模运动捕捉数据集)和GRAB(人类-物体交互数据集)上均取得了最先进的结果。
abstract_en: We address the problem of action-conditioned generation of human motion sequences. Existing work falls into two categories: forecast models conditioned on observed past motions, or generative models conditioned action labels and duration only. In contrast, we generate motion conditioned on observations of arbitrary length, including none. To solve this generalized problem, we propose PoseGPT, an auto-regressive transformer-based approach which internally compresses human motion into quantized latent sequences. An auto-encoder first maps human motion to latent index sequences in a discrete space, and vice-versa. Inspired by the Generative Pretrained Transformer (GPT), we propose to train a GPT-like model for next-index prediction in that space; this allows PoseGPT to output distributions on possible futures, with or without conditioning on past motion. The discrete and compressed nature of the latent space allows the GPT- like model to focus on long-range signal, as it removes low-level redundancy in the input signal. Predicting discrete indices also alleviates the common pitfall of predicting averaged poses, a typical failure case when regressing continuous values, as the average of discrete targets is not a target itself. Our experimental results show that our proposed approach achieves state-of-the-art results on Hu- manAct12 - a standard but small scale dataset, on BABEL - a recent large scale MoCap dataset and on GRAB - a human-object interactions dataset.

title: Tian Ye, Yunchen Zhang, Mingchao Jiang, Liang Chen, Yun Liu, Sixiang Chen, Erkang Chen
title_en: Tian Ye, Yunchen Zhang, Mingchao Jiang, Liang Chen, Yun Liu, Sixiang Chen, Erkang Chen
abstract: 在现实世界中,雾霾条件下拍摄的图像退化过程可能非常复杂,其中雾霾的空间分布因图像而异。近期方法采用深度神经网络直接从雾霾图像中恢复干净场景。然而,由于网络架构的通用设计以及对准确雾霾退化模型估计的失败,近期去雾方法在现实世界雾霾图像上的泛化能力并不理想。为了解决现实世界雾霾退化建模问题,我们提出了一种新颖的可分离混合注意力(SHA)模块,通过捕捉正交方向上的位置敏感特征来感知雾霾密度以实现该目标。此外,提出了一种密度编码矩阵以显式建模雾霾的不均匀分布。该密度编码矩阵以半监督方式生成位置编码——这种雾霾密度感知与建模策略在特征层上有效捕捉了不均匀分布的退化现象。通过合适地结合SHA模块和密度编码矩阵,我们设计了一种新颖的去雾网络架构,实现了良好的复杂度-性能权衡。在合成数据集和现实世界数据集上的综合评估表明,所提方法在定量和定性方面均显著超越了所有现有最先进的方法。代码已发布在 https://github.com/Owen718/ECCV22-Perceiving-and-Modeling-Density-for-Image-Dehazing。
abstract_en: In the real world, the degradation of images taken under haze can be quite complex, where the spatial distribution of haze varies from image to image. Recent methods adopt deep neural networks to recover clean scenes from hazy images directly. However, due to the generic design of network architectures and the failure in estimating an accurate haze degradation model, the generalization ability of recent dehazing methods on real-world hazy images is not ideal. To address the problem of modeling real-world haze degradation, we propose a novel Separable Hybrid Attention (SHA) module to perceive haze density by capturing positional-sensitive features in the orthogonal directions to achieve this goal. Moreover, a density encoding matrix is proposed to model the uneven distribution of the haze explicitly. The density encoding matrix generates positional encoding in a semi-supervised way -- such a haze density perceiving and modeling strategy captures the unevenly distributed degeneration at the feature-level effectively. Through a suitable combination of SHA and density encoding matrix, we design a novel dehazing network architecture, which achieves a good complexity-performance trade-off. Comprehensive evaluation on both synthetic datasets and real-world datasets demonstrates that the proposed method surpasses all the state-of-the-art approaches with a large margin both quantitatively and qualitatively. The code is released in https://github.com/Owen718/ECCV22-Perceiving-and-Modeling-Density-for-Image-Dehazing.

title: Tian Yu Liu, Parth Agrawal, Allison Chen, Byung-Woo Hong, Alex Wong
title_en: Tian Yu Liu, Parth Agrawal, Allison Chen, Byung-Woo Hong, Alex Wong
abstract: We propose a method to infer a dense depth map from a single image, its calibration, and the associated sparse point cloud. In order to leverage existing models (teachers) that produce putative depth maps, we propose an adaptive knowledge distillation approach that yields a positive congruent training process, wherein a student model avoids learning the error modes of the teachers. In the absence of ground truth for model selection and training, our method, termed Monitored Distillation, allows a student to exploit a blind ensemble of teachers by selectively learning from predictions that best minimize the reconstruction error for a given image. Monitored Distillation yields a distilled depth map and a confidence map, or “monitor"""", for how well a prediction from a particular teacher fits the observed image. The monitor adaptively weights the distilled depth where if all of the teachers exhibit high residuals, the standard unsupervised image reconstruction loss takes over as the supervisory signal. On indoor scenes (VOID), we outperform blind ensembling baselines by 17.53% and unsupervised methods by 24.25%; we boast a 79% model size reduction while maintaining comparable performance to the best supervised method. For outdoors (KITTI), we tie for 5th overall on the benchmark despite not using ground truth. Code available at: https://github.com/alexklwong/mondi-python.
abstract_en: We propose a method to infer a dense depth map from a single image, its calibration, and the associated sparse point cloud. In order to leverage existing models (teachers) that produce putative depth maps, we propose an adaptive knowledge distillation approach that yields a positive congruent training process, wherein a student model avoids learning the error modes of the teachers. In the absence of ground truth for model selection and training, our method, termed Monitored Distillation, allows a student to exploit a blind ensemble of teachers by selectively learning from predictions that best minimize the reconstruction error for a given image. Monitored Distillation yields a distilled depth map and a confidence map, or “monitor"""", for how well a prediction from a particular teacher fits the observed image. The monitor adaptively weights the distilled depth where if all of the teachers exhibit high residuals, the standard unsupervised image reconstruction loss takes over as the supervisory signal. On indoor scenes (VOID), we outperform blind ensembling baselines by 17.53% and unsupervised methods by 24.25%; we boast a 79% model size reduction while maintaining comparable performance to the best supervised method. For outdoors (KITTI), we tie for 5th overall on the benchmark despite not using ground truth. Code available at: https://github.com/alexklwong/mondi-python.

title: Tian Zhang, Kongming Liang, Ruoyi Du, Xian Sun, Zhanyu Ma, Jun Guo
title_en: Tian Zhang, Kongming Liang, Ruoyi Du, Xian Sun, Zhanyu Ma, Jun Guo
abstract: 组合零样本学习(CZSL)旨在利用训练集中已见属性-物体组合所学到的知识,识别新颖的组合。先前方法主要将图像和组合投影到共同的嵌入空间中以衡量其兼容性得分。然而,属性和物体共享上述学习到的视觉表示,导致模型利用虚假相关性并偏向于已见配对。相反,我们将CZSL重新视为分布外泛化问题。若将物体视为域,则可学习物体不变特征,以可靠地识别附着于任何物体的属性。类似地,当以属性为域识别带属性的物体时,也可学习属性不变特征。具体而言,我们提出一种不变特征学习框架,在表示和梯度层面对齐不同域,以捕捉与任务相关的固有特征。在两个CZSL基准上的实验表明,所提方法显著优于先前最先进方法。
abstract_en: Compositional Zero-Shot Learning (CZSL) aims to recognize novel compositions using knowledge learned from seen attribute-object compositions in the training set. Previous works mainly project an image and a composition into a common embedding space to measure their compatibility score. However, both attributes and objects share the visual representations learned above, leading the model to exploit spurious correlations and bias towards seen pairs. Instead, we reconsider CZSL as an out-of-distribution generalization problem. If an object is treated as a domain, we can learn object-invariant features to recognize the attributes attached to any object reliably. Similarly, attribute-invariant features can also be learned when recognizing the objects with attributes as domains. Specifically, we propose an invariant feature learning framework to align different domains at the representation and gradient levels to capture the intrinsic characteristics associated with the tasks. Experiments on two CZSL benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms the previous state-of-the-art.

title: Tianhan Xu, Tatsuya Harada
title_en: Tianhan Xu, Tatsuya Harada
abstract: 近年来,辐射场技术的进步使得静态或动态三维场景的逼真渲染成为可能,但仍不支持用于场景操作或动画的显式变形。本文提出了一种方法,使辐射场能够实现一种新型变形:自由形式辐射场变形。我们使用一个包围前景物体的三角网格(称为笼子)作为接口,通过操控笼子顶点,我们的方法实现了辐射场的自由形式变形。该方法的核心是基于笼子的变形技术,这在网格变形中常用。我们提出了一种新颖的公式,将其扩展到辐射场,该公式将采样点在变形空间中的位置和视角方向映射到规范空间,从而实现变形场景的渲染。合成数据集和真实世界数据集的变形结果验证了我们方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Recent advances in radiance fields enable photorealistic rendering of static or dynamic 3D scenes, but still do not support explicit deformation that is used for scene manipulation or animation. In this paper, we propose a method that enables a new type of deformation of the radiance field: free-form radiance field deformation. We use a triangular mesh that encloses the foreground object called cage as an interface, and by manipulating the cage vertices, our approach enables the free-form deformation of the radiance field. The core of our approach is cage-based deformation which is commonly used in mesh deformation. We propose a novel formulation to extend it to the radiance field, which maps the position and the view direction of the sampling points from the deformed space to the canonical space, thus enabling the rendering of the deformed scene. The deformation results of the synthetic datasets and the real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

title: Tianjiao Li, Lin Geng Foo, Qiuhong Ke, Hossein Rahmani, Anran Wang, Jinghua Wang, Jun Liu
title_en: Tianjiao Li, Lin Geng Foo, Qiuhong Ke, Hossein Rahmani, Anran Wang, Jinghua Wang, Jun Liu
abstract: 细粒度动作识别的目标是成功区分具有细微差异的动作类别。为解决这一问题,我们从人类视觉系统中获得灵感,该系统包含专门处理特定任务的大脑区域。我们设计了一种新颖的动态时空专业化(DSTS)模块,该模块由仅对高度相似样本子集激活的专门神经元组成。在训练过程中,损失函数迫使专门神经元学习具有判别性的细粒度差异,以区分这些相似样本,从而提升细粒度识别性能。此外,一种时空专业化方法进一步优化了专门神经元的架构,以捕捉更多空间或时间细粒度信息,从而更好地应对视频中的广泛时空变化。最后,我们设计了一种上游-下游学习算法,以优化模型的动态决策,使DSTS模块具有更好的泛化能力。我们在两个广泛使用的细粒度动作识别数据集上取得了最先进的性能。我们将发布我们的代码。
abstract_en: The goal of fine-grained action recognition is to successfully discriminate between action categories with subtle differences. To tackle this, we derive inspiration from the human visual system which contains specialized regions in the brain that are dedicated towards handling specific tasks. We design a novel Dynamic Spatio-Temporal Specialization (DSTS) module, which consists of specialized neurons that are only activated for a subset of samples that are highly similar. During training, the loss forces the specialized neurons to learn discriminative fine-grained differences to distinguish between these similar samples, improving fine-grained recognition. Moreover, a spatio-temporal specialization method further optimizes the architectures of the specialized neurons to capture either more spatial or temporal fine-grained information, to better tackle the large range of spatio-temporal variations in the videos. Lastly, we design an Upstream-Downstream Learning algorithm to optimize our model’s dynamic decisions, allowing our DSTS module to generalize better. We obtain state-of-the-art performance on two widely-used fine-grained action recognition datasets. We will release our code.

title: Tianli Zhao, Xi Sheryl Zhang, Wentao Zhu, Jiaxing Wang, Sen Yang, Ji Liu, Jian Cheng
title_en: Tianli Zhao, Xi Sheryl Zhang, Wentao Zhu, Jiaxing Wang, Sen Yang, Ji Liu, Jian Cheng
abstract: 在移动设备上的实际深度神经网络设计中,必须考虑计算资源约束和不同应用场景下的推理延迟。在深度网络加速方法中,剪枝是一种广泛采用的实践,用于在计算资源消耗和准确性之间取得平衡,通过通道级或随机移除不重要的连接,对模型准确性影响最小。粗粒度通道剪枝可立即显著降低延迟,而细粒度权重剪枝则更灵活地保留准确性。本文提出了一种联合通道剪枝和权重剪枝的统一框架,命名为JCW,实现了通道剪枝和权重剪枝之间的最佳剪枝比例。为了进一步优化延迟和准确性的权衡,我们在JCW框架中开发了一种定制的多目标进化算法,使单次搜索即可获得满足各种部署需求的最优候选架构。大量实验表明,JCW在ImageNet分类数据集上相比先前最先进的剪枝方法实现了更好的延迟与准确性的权衡。
abstract_en: For practical deep neural network design on mobile devices, it is essential to consider the constraints incurred by the computational resources and the inference latency in various applications. Among deep network acceleration approaches, pruning is a widely adopted practice to balance the computational resource consumption and the accuracy, where unimportant connections can be removed either channel-wisely or randomly with a minimal impact on model accuracy. The coarse-grained channel pruning instantly results in a significant latency reduction, while the fine-grained weight pruning is more flexible to retain accuracy. In this paper, we present a unified framework for the Joint Channel pruning and Weight pruning, named JCW, which achieves an optimal pruning proportion between channel and weight pruning. To fully optimize the trade-off between latency and accuracy, we further develop a tailored multi-objective evolutionary algorithm in the JCW framework, which enables one single round search to obtain the optimal candidate architectures for various deployment requirements.
