Extensive experiments demonstrate that the JCW achieves a better trade-off between the latency and accuracy against previous state-of-the-art pruning methods on the ImageNet classification dataset.

title: Tianxin Huang, Jiangning Zhang, Jun Chen, Yuang Liu, Yong Liu
title_en: Tianxin Huang, Jiangning Zhang, Jun Chen, Yuang Liu, Yong Liu
abstract: 下采样算法被采用以简化点云并降低后续任务的计算成本。现有的基于学习的采样方法通常需要训练一个大型采样网络以支持不同分辨率下的采样,即使只需要低分辨率点,也必须生成高分辨率点的代价。在本文中,我们提出了一种无分辨率依赖的点云采样网络,可直接对原始点云进行不同分辨率的采样,通过优化非学习型初始采样点以达到更优位置。此外,我们引入数据蒸馏技术,通过考虑原始点云与采样点任务网络输出之间的差异来辅助训练过程。在点云重建和识别任务上的实验表明,我们的方法在时间与内存成本上均低于现有基于学习的采样策略,同时实现了SOTA性能。代码已开源至https://github.com/Tianxinhuang/PCDNet。
abstract_en: Down-sampling algorithms are adopted to simplify the point clouds and save the computation cost on subsequent tasks. Existing learning-based sampling methods often need to train a big sampling network to support sampling under different resolutions, which must generate sampled points with the costly maximum resolution even if only low-resolution points need to be sampled. In this work, we propose a novel resolution-free point clouds sampling network to directly sample the original point cloud to different resolutions, which is conducted by optimizing non-learning-based initial sampled points to better positions. Besides, we introduce data distillation to assist the training process by considering the differences between task network outputs from original point clouds and sampled points. Experiments on point cloud reconstruction and recognition tasks demonstrate that our method can achieve SOTA performances with lower time and memory cost than existing learning-based sampling strategies. Codes are available at https://github.com/Tianxinhuang/PCDNet.

title: Tianxin Huang, Xuemeng Yang, Jiangning Zhang, Jinhao Cui, Hao Zou, Jun Chen, Xiangrui Zhao, Yong Liu
title_en: Tianxin Huang, Xuemeng Yang, Jiangning Zhang, Jinhao Cui, Hao Zou, Jun Chen, Xiangrui Zhao, Yong Liu
abstract: 对于如二维图像和一维连续信号等有序数据的重建网络,可以通过逐元素平方误差进行优化,而排列任意的点云无法直接约束,因为其点排列不固定。尽管现有方法设计了算法来匹配两个点云并基于匹配结果评估形状误差,但它们受限于预定义的匹配过程。在本工作中,我们提出了一种名为PCLossNet的新框架,该框架无需任何匹配即可学习训练点云重建网络。通过与重建网络一起进行对抗训练,PCLossNet能够更好地探索点云之间的差异,生成更精确的重建结果。在多个数据集上的实验验证了我们方法的优越性,其中PCLossNet能够帮助网络实现显著更低的重建误差并提取更具代表性的特征,训练效率约为常用EMD损失的四倍。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Tianxinhuang/PCLossNet获取。
abstract_en: Reconstruction networks for well-ordered data such as 2D images and 1D continuous signals are easy to optimize through element-wised squared errors, while permutation-arbitrary point clouds cannot be constrained directly because their points permutations are not fixed. Though existing works design algorithms to match two point clouds and evaluate shape errors based on matched results, they are limited by pre-defined matching processes. In this work, we propose a novel framework named PCLossNet which learns to train a point cloud reconstruction network without any matching. By training through an adversarial process together with the reconstruction network, PCLossNet can better explore the differences between point clouds and create more precise reconstruction results. Experiments on multiple datasets prove the superiority of our method, where PCLossNet can help networks achieve much lower reconstruction errors and extract more representative features, with about 4 times faster training efficiency than the commonly-used EMD loss. Our codes can be found in https://github.com/Tianxinhuang/PCLossNet.

title: Tianxue Ma, Mingwei Bi, Jian Zhang, Wang Yuan, Zhizhong Zhang, Yuan Xie, Shouhong Ding, Lizhuang Ma
title_en: Tianxue Ma, Mingwei Bi, Jian Zhang, Wang Yuan, Zhizhong Zhang, Yuan Xie, Shouhong Ding, Lizhuang Ma
abstract: 少样本目标检测基于包含大量标注样本的基础集,用于检测样本稀缺的新类别。大多数现有方法主要依赖元学习或迁移学习,忽视了基础集中可能包含未标注的新类别对象这一事实,这容易导致性能下降和较差的泛化能力,因为这些新对象被当作背景处理。基于上述现象,我们提出了一种相互强化结构网络(MRSN),以合理利用基础集中未标注的新类别实例。具体而言,MRSN包含一个挖掘模型,用于发现未标注的新类别实例,以及一个吸收模型,用于学习可变知识。随后,我们在吸收模型中设计了一个提案对比一致性(PCC)模块,以充分利用类别特征并避免从挖掘标签中产生的偏差。此外,我们提出了一种简单有效的数据合成方法单向-CutMix(UD-CutMix),以提高模型挖掘新类别实例的鲁棒性,促使模型关注物体的判别部分并消除背景信息的干扰。大量实验表明,我们的方法在PASCAL VOC和MS-COCO数据集上取得了最先进的结果。我们的代码将在https://github.com/MMatx/MRSN发布。
abstract_en: Few-shot object detection is based on the base set with abundant labeled samples to detect novel categories with scarce samples. The majority of former solutions are mainly based on meta-learning or transfer-learning, neglecting the fact that images from the base set might contain unlabeled novel-class objects, which easily leads to performance degradation and poor plasticity since those novel objects are served as the background. Based on the above phenomena, we propose a Mutually Reinforcing Structure Network (MRSN) to make rational use of unlabeled novel class instances in the base set. In particular, MRSN consists of a mining model which unearths unlabeled novel-class instances and an absorbed model which learns variable knowledge. Then, we design a Proposal Contrastive Consistency (PCC) module in the absorbed model to fully exploit class characteristics and avoid bias from unearthed labels. Furthermore,we propose a simple and effective data synthesis method undirectional-CutMix (UD-CutMix) to improve the robustness of model mining novel class instances, urge the model to pay attention to discriminative parts of objects and eliminate the interference of background information. Extensive experiments illustrate that our proposed approach achieves state-of-the-art results on PASCAL VOC and MS-COCO datasets. Our code will be released at https://github.com/MMatx/MRSN.

title: Tianyi Liu, Sen He, Vinodh Kumaran Jayakumar, Wei Wang
title_en: Tianyi Liu, Sen He, Vinodh Kumaran Jayakumar, Wei Wang
abstract: 在云3D领域,如云游戏和云虚拟现实(VR)中,图像帧在云端进行渲染和压缩(编码),然后发送到客户端供用户观看。为了实现低延迟和高图像质量,快速、高压缩率和高质量的图像压缩技术更受青睐。本文探讨了学习图像压缩的计算时间减少技术,使其更适合云3D应用。更具体地说,我们采用了轻量(低复杂度)和应用特定的AI模型,以在不降低图像质量的前提下减少计算时间。我们的方法基于两个关键洞察:(1)由3D应用生成的帧具有高度同质性,应用特定的压缩模型相比通用模型能提升率失真性能;(2)许多3D应用生成的计算机合成帧复杂度低于自然照片,这使得降低模型复杂度以加速压缩计算成为可能。我们在六个游戏图像数据集上评估了我们的模型。结果表明,我们的方法在率失真性能上与最先进的学习图像压缩算法相当,同时实现了约5到9倍的速度提升,将压缩时间缩短至不足1秒(0.74秒),使学习图像压缩更接近于在云3D中的可行性。代码可在https://github.com/cloud-graphics-rendering/AppSpecificLIC获取。
abstract_en: In Cloud 3D, such as Cloud Gaming and Cloud Virtual Reality (VR), image frames are rendered and compressed (encoded) in the cloud, and sent to the clients for users to view. For low latency and high image quality, fast, high compression rate, and high-quality image compression techniques are preferable. This paper explores computation time reduction techniques for learned image compression to make it more suitable for cloud 3D. More specifically, we employed slim (low-complexity) and application-specific AI models to reduce the computation time without degrading image quality. Our approach is based on two key insights: (1) as the frames generated by a 3D application are highly homogeneous, application-specific compression models can improve the rate-distortion performance over a general model; (2) many computer-generated frames from 3D applications are less complex than natural photos, which makes it feasible to reduce the model complexity to accelerate compression computation. We evaluated our models on six gaming image datasets. The results show that our approach has similar rate-distortion performance as a state-of-the-art learned image compression algorithm, while obtaining about 5x to 9x speedup and reducing the compression time to be less than 1 second (0.74s), bringing learned image compression closer to being viable for cloud 3D. Code is available at https://github.com/cloud-graphics-rendering/AppSpecificLIC.

title: 王天宇、刘妙妙、Ng Kee Siong
title_en: Tianyu Wang, Miaomiao Liu, Kee Siong Ng
abstract: 我们研究了点云上的以对象为中心的学习问题,这对于高层次的关系推理和可扩展的机器智能至关重要。特别是,我们引入了一个框架SPAIR3D,将3D点云分解为空间混合模型,其中每个组件对应一个对象。为了在点云上建模空间混合模型,我们推导出Chamfer混合损失,该损失自然地融入到我们的变分训练流程中。此外,我们采用了一种对象指定方案,描述每个对象相对于其局部体素网格单元的位置。这种方案使SPAIR3D能够建模任意数量对象的场景。我们在无监督场景分解任务上评估了我们的方法。实验结果表明,SPAIR3D具有强大的可扩展性,并且能够以无监督的方式检测和分割点云中的未知数量的对象。
abstract_en: We tackle the problem of object-centric learning on point clouds, which is crucial for high-level relational reasoning and scalable machine intelligence. In particular, we introduce a framework, SPAIR3D, to factorize a 3D point cloud into a spatial mixture model where each component corresponds to one object. To model the spatial mixture model on point clouds, we derive the Chamfer Mixture Loss, which fits naturally into our variational training pipeline. Moreover, we adopt an object-specification scheme that describes each object’s location relative to its local voxel grid cell. Such a scheme allows SPAIR3D to model scenes with an arbitrary number of objects. We evaluate our method on the task of unsupervised scene decomposition. Experimental results demonstrate that SPAIR3D has strong scalability and is capable of detecting and segmenting an unknown number of objects from a point cloud in an unsupervised manner.

title: Tianyue Cao, Yongxin Wang, Yifan Xing, Tianjun Xiao, Tong He, Zheng Zhang, Hao Zhou, Joseph Tighe
title_en: Tianyue Cao, Yongxin Wang, Yifan Xing, Tianjun Xiao, Tong He, Zheng Zhang, Hao Zhou, Joseph Tighe
abstract: 我们提出了一种实用的开放世界表示学习设置,目标是在训练过程中无需先验知识或与新类别相关的图像,即可学习未见过类别的表示。然而,现有的开放世界表示学习方法通常假设许多约束条件,这些条件在实践中常被违反,因此无法推广到所提出的设置。我们提出了一种新颖的渐进方法,该方法在每次迭代中选择在特征空间中与当前已知类别距离较远且具有高同质性的无标签样本。然后,通过在这些选定样本上进行聚类生成高质量的伪标签,逐步提升特征泛化能力。实验表明,所提出的方法在自然物种图像检索和人脸验证基准测试中,持续优于最先进的开放世界半监督学习方法和新类发现方法。
abstract_en: We propose a practical open-world representation learning setting where the objective is to learn the representations for unseen categories without prior knowledge or access to images associated with these novel categories during training. Existing open-world representation learning methods, however, assume many constraints, which are often violated in practice and thus fail to generalize to the proposed setting. We propose a novel progressive approach which, at each iteration, selects unlabeled samples that attain a high homogeneity while belonging to classes that are distant to the current set of known classes in the feature space. Then we use the high-quality pseudo-labels generated via clustering over these selected samples to improve the feature generalization iteratively. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art open-world semi-supervised learning methods and novel class discovery methods over nature species image retrieval and face verification benchmarks.

title: Tim Brooks, Alexei A. Efros
title_en: Tim Brooks, Alexei A. Efros
abstract: 人类姿态能告诉我们关于场景的哪些信息?我们提出一个任务来回答这个问题:给定人类姿态作为输入,生成与之兼容的场景。人类姿态捕捉到的细微线索——动作语义、环境可用性、物体交互——提供了令人惊讶的见解,揭示哪些场景是兼容的。我们提出一个大规模的生成对抗网络,用于基于姿态的场景生成。我们显著扩大了训练数据的规模和复杂性,整理了一个包含超过1900万帧的大型元数据集,记录了人类在日常环境中的活动。我们通过将模型容量翻倍(相对于StyleGAN2)来处理如此复杂的数据,并设计了一种姿态条件机制,引导模型学习姿态与场景之间的细微关系。我们利用训练好的模型进行各种应用:生成与姿态兼容的场景(有或没有人类)、可视化不兼容的场景和姿态、将一个人从一个生成的图像放置到另一个场景中,以及姿态动画。我们的模型生成多样化的样本,并在准确的人体放置(正确关键点百分比)和质量(Fréchet inception距离)方面优于基于姿态的StyleGAN2和Pix2Pix/Pix2PixHD基线。
abstract_en: What does human pose tell us about a scene? We propose a task to answer this question: given human pose as input, hallucinate a compatible scene. Subtle cues captured by human pose --- action semantics, environment affordances, object interactions --- provide surprising insight into which scenes are compatible. We present a large-scale generative adversarial network for pose-conditioned scene generation. We significantly scale the size and complexity of training data, curating a massive meta-dataset containing over 19 million frames of humans in everyday environments. We double the capacity of our model with respect to StyleGAN2 to handle such complex data, and design a pose conditioning mechanism that drives our model to learn the nuanced relationship between pose and scene. We leverage our trained model for various applications: hallucinating pose-compatible scene(s) with or without humans, visualizing incompatible scenes and poses, placing a person from one generated image into another scene, and animating pose. Our model produces diverse samples and outperforms pose-conditioned StyleGAN2 and Pix2Pix/Pix2PixHD baselines in terms of accurate human placement (percent of correct keypoints) and quality (Fréchet inception distance).

title: Ting Yao, Yingwei Pan, Yehao Li, Chong-Wah Ngo, Tao Mei
title_en: Ting Yao, Yingwei Pan, Yehao Li, Chong-Wah Ngo, Tao Mei
abstract: 多尺度视觉Transformer(ViT)已成为计算机视觉任务的强大主干网络,但Transformer中的自注意力计算与输入块数呈二次方关系。因此,现有方案常通过下采样操作(例如平均池化)对键值进行处理,以大幅降低计算成本。本文认为,这种过度激进的下采样设计不可逆,尤其会导致物体高频成分(例如纹理细节)的信息丢失。受小波理论启发,我们构建了一种新的小波视觉Transformer(Wave-ViT),通过统一的小波变换与自注意力学习实现可逆下采样。该方案支持对键值进行无损下采样,从而更有效地平衡效率与精度的权衡。此外,通过逆小波变换扩大感受野,聚合局部上下文以增强自注意力输出。我们在多个视觉任务(如图像识别、目标检测和实例分割)上进行了大量实验,验证了Wave-ViT的优越性。其性能在浮点运算次数相近的情况下超越了现有ViT主干网络。源代码可在\url{https://github.com/YehLi/ImageNetModel}获取。
abstract_en: Multi-scale Vision Transformer (ViT) has emerged as a powerful backbone for computer vision tasks, while the self-attention computation in Transformer scales quadratically w.r.t. the input patch number. Thus, existing solutions commonly employ down-sampling operations (e.g., average pooling) over keys/values to dramatically reduce the computational cost. In this work, we argue that such over-aggressive down-sampling design is not invertible and inevitably causes information dropping especially for high-frequency components in objects (e.g., texture details). Motivated by the wavelet theory, we construct a new Wavelet Vision Transformer (Wave-ViT) that formulates the invertible down-sampling with wavelet transforms and self-attention learning in a unified way. This proposal enables self-attention learning with lossless down-sampling over keys/values, facilitating the pursuing of a better efficiency-vs-accuracy trade-off. Furthermore, inverse wavelet transforms are leveraged to strengthen self-attention outputs by aggregating local contexts with enlarged receptive field. We validate the superiority of Wave-ViT through extensive experiments over multiple vision tasks (e.g., image recognition, object detection and instance segmentation). Its performances surpass state-of-the-art ViT backbones with comparable FLOPs. Source code is available at \url{https://github.com/YehLi/ImageNetModel}.

title: Tingle Li, Yichen Liu, Andrew Owens, Hang Zhao
title_en: Tingle Li, Yichen Liu, Andrew Owens, Hang Zhao
abstract: 从雨滴的滴答声到雪地的咯吱声,我们听到的声音常常传达出场景中出现的视觉纹理。在本文中,我们提出了一种从未标记的视听数据中学习视觉风格的方法。我们的模型学习通过调整场景的纹理来匹配声音,我们将这一问题称为音频驱动的图像风格化。给定一个配对的视听数据集,我们学习修改输入图像,使得在调整后,这些图像更可能与给定的输入声音共同出现。在定量和定性评估中,我们的基于声音的模型优于基于标签的方法。我们还表明,音频可以作为操控图像的直观表示,因为调整声音的音量或混合两种声音会导致视觉风格的可预测变化。
abstract_en: From the patter of rain to the crunch of snow, the sounds we hear often convey the visual textures that appear within a scene. In this paper, we present a method for learning visual styles from unlabeled audio-visual data. Our model learns to manipulate the texture of a scene to match a sound, a problem we term audio-driven image stylization. Given a dataset of paired audio-visual data, we learn to modify input images such that, after manipulation, they are more likely to co-occur with a given input sound. In quantitative and qualitative evaluations, our sound-based model outperforms label-based approaches. We also show that audio can be an intuitive representation for manipulating images, as adjusting a sound’s volume or mixing two sounds together results in predictable changes to visual style.

title: 面向大规模真实场景面部表情数据集的噪声标签问题研究
title_en: Tohar Lukov, Na Zhao, Gim Hee Lee, Ser-Nam Lim
abstract: 近期研究强调了由于模糊面部表情、低质量面部图像以及标注者主观性等因素导致的大规模真实场景面部表情数据集中噪声标签问题。为解决噪声标签问题,我们提出软标签平滑(Soft Label Smoothing, SLS),通过根据相应置信度为多个高置信度类别分配概率,同时为低置信度类别分配固定低概率,从而平滑logits中的多个高置信度类别。具体而言,我们基于均值教师(Mean-Teacher, MT)架构提出了一种称为平滑操作框架(Smooth Operator Framework for Teaching, SOFT)的方法,其中SLS应用于教师模型的logits。我们发现,平滑后的教师logit通过一致性损失为学生模型提供了有益的监督——在30%噪声率下,SLS相比MT方法使错误率降低了15%。总体而言,SOFT在缓解对称性和非对称性噪声方面均显著优于现有方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/toharl/soft获取。
abstract_en: Recent studies have highlighted the problem of noisy labels in large scale in-the-wild facial expressions datasets due to the uncertainties caused by ambiguous facial expressions, low-quality facial images, and the subjectiveness of annotators. To solve the problem of noisy labels, we propose Soft Label Smoothing (SLS), which smooths out multiple high-confidence classes in the logits by assigning them a probability based on the corresponding confidence, and at the same time assigning a fixed low probability to the low-confidence classes. Specifically, we introduce what we call the Smooth Operator Framework for Teaching (SOFT), based on a mean-teacher (MT) architecture where SLS is applied over the teacher’s logits. We find that the smoothed teacher’s logit provides a beneficial supervision to the student via a consistency loss -- at 30\% noise rate, SLS leads to 15\% reduction in the error rate compared with MT. Overall, SOFT beats the state of the art at mitigating noisy labels by a significant margin for both symmetric and asymmetric noise. Our code is available at https://github.com/toharl/soft.

title: Tom Monnier, Matthew Fisher, Alexei A. Efros, Mathieu Aubry
title_en: Tom Monnier, Matthew Fisher, Alexei A. Efros, Mathieu Aubry
abstract: 单视角重建方法通常依赖于视角标注、轮廓、背景缺失、同一实例的多视角、模板形状或对称性。我们通过显式利用不同物体实例图像之间的一致性,避免了所有此类监督和假设。因此,我们的方法可以从大量未标注的同一物体类别的图像中学习。我们的主要贡献是两种利用跨实例一致性的方法:(i) 渐进式条件化,一种通过课程学习方式逐步将模型从类别细化到实例的训练策略;(ii) 邻近重建,一种强制相似形状或纹理实例之间一致性的损失函数。此外,我们的方法成功还依赖于:一种将图像分解为显式形状、纹理、姿态和背景的结构化自编码架构;微分渲染的改进公式;以及在3D和姿态学习之间交替的新型优化方案。我们在多样化的合成ShapeNet数据集(经典需要多视角监督的方法基准)和标准真实图像基准(Pascal3D+ Car、CUB)上比较了我们的方法UNICORN,其中大多数方法需要已知的模板和轮廓标注。我们还展示了其在更具挑战性的现实数据集(CompCars、LSUN)上的适用性,其中没有轮廓信息且图像未围绕物体裁剪。
abstract_en: Approaches for single-view reconstruction typically rely on viewpoint annotations, silhouettes, the absence of background, multiple views of the same instance, a template shape, or symmetry. We avoid all such supervision and assumptions by explicitly leveraging the consistency between images of different object instances. As a result, our method can learn from large collections of unlabelled images depicting the same object category. Our main contributions are two ways for leveraging cross-instance consistency: (i) progressive conditioning, a training strategy to gradually specialize the model from category to instances in a curriculum learning fashion; and (ii) neighbor reconstruction, a loss enforcing consistency between instances having similar shape or texture. Also critical to the success of our method are: our structured autoencoding architecture decomposing an image into explicit shape, texture, pose, and background; an adapted formulation of differential rendering; and a new optimization scheme alternating between 3D and pose learning. We compare our approach, UNICORN, both on the diverse synthetic ShapeNet dataset - the classical benchmark for methods requiring multiple views as supervision - and on standard real-image benchmarks (Pascal3D+ Car, CUB) for which most methods require known templates and silhouette annotations. We also showcase applicability to more challenging real-world collections (CompCars, LSUN), where silhouettes are not available and images are not cropped around the object.

title: Tong He, Wei Yin, Chunhua Shen, Anton van den Hengel
title_en: Tong He, Wei Yin, Chunhua Shen, Anton van den Hengel
abstract: 当前三维实例分割的最先进方法通常包含聚类步骤,尽管其往往依赖启发式方法、贪心算法且对数据统计变化缺乏鲁棒性。相比之下,我们提出了一种全卷积的三维点云实例分割方法,采用逐点预测的方式进行工作。通过这种方式,该方法避免了基于聚类的方法所面临的挑战:引入模型不同任务之间的依赖关系。我们发现其成功的关键在于为每个采样点分配合适的标签。不同于常用的静态或基于距离的分配策略,我们提出使用最优传输方法,根据动态匹配成本最优地将目标掩码分配给采样点。我们的方法在ScanNet和S3DIS基准数据集上取得了有希望的结果。所提出的方法消除了任务间的依赖关系,因此相较于其他竞争方法,代表了一个更简单且更灵活的三维实例分割框架,同时实现了更高的分割精度。
abstract_en: The current state-of-the-art methods in 3D instance segmentation typically involve a clustering step, despite the tendency towards heuristics, greedy algorithms, and a lack of robustness to the changes in data statistics. In contrast, we propose a fully convolutional 3D point cloud instance segmentation method that works in a per-point prediction fashion. In doing so it avoids the challenges that clustering-based methods face: introducing dependencies among different tasks of the model. We find the key to its success is assigning a suitable target to each sampled point. Instead of the commonly used static or distance-based assignment strategies, we propose to use an Optimal Transport approach to optimally assign target masks to the sampled points according to the dynamic matching costs. Our approach achieves promising results on both ScanNet and S3DIS benchmarks. The proposed approach removes intertask dependencies and thus represents a simpler and more flexible 3D instance segmentation framework than other competing methods, while achieving improved segmentation accuracy.

title: Tong Wang, Yuan Yao, Feng Xu, Shengwei An, Hanghang Tong, Ting Wang
title_en: Tong Wang, Yuan Yao, Feng Xu, Shengwei An, Hanghang Tong, Ting Wang
abstract: 后门攻击已被证明是对深度学习系统(如生物识别认证和自动驾驶)的严重威胁。一种有效的后门攻击可以在特定预定义条件下(即触发器)迫使模型表现出异常行为,而在其他情况下则正常运行。现有攻击的触发器主要注入到像素空间中,这些触发器在训练和推理阶段往往具有视觉可识别性,并且容易被现有防御方法检测到。本文提出了一种简单但有效且隐蔽的黑盒后门攻击FTrojan,通过在频率域中植入后门实现。其核心思想是:在频率域中触发的扰动对应于整个图像中分散的微小像素级扰动,这破坏了现有防御方法的底层假设,使污染图像在视觉上难以与干净图像区分。大量实验评估表明,FTrojan具有高度有效性,且污染图像保持较高的感知质量。此外,我们证明FTrojan能够有效规避或显著降低现有防御方法的性能。
abstract_en: Backdoor attacks have been shown to be a serious threat against deep learning systems such as biometric authentication and autonomous driving. An effective backdoor attack could enforce the model misbehave under certain predefined conditions, i.e., triggers, but behave normally otherwise. The triggers of existing attacks are mainly injected in the pixel space, which tend to be visually identifiable at both training and inference stages and detectable by existing defenses. In this paper, we propose a simple but effective and invisible black-box backdoor attack FTrojan through trojaning the frequency domain. The key intuition is that triggering perturbations in the frequency domain correspond to small pixel-wise perturbations dispersed across the entire image, breaking the underlying assumptions of existing defenses and making the poisoning images visually indistinguishable from clean ones. Extensive experimental evaluations show that FTrojan is highly effective and the poisoning images retain high perceptual quality. Moreover, we show that FTrojan can robustly elude or significantly degenerate the performance of existing defenses.

title: Tong Wu, Guangyu Gao, Junshi Huang, Xiaolin Wei, Xiaoming Wei, Chi Harold Liu
title_en: Tong Wu, Guangyu Gao, Junshi Huang, Xiaolin Wei, Xiaoming Wei, Chi Harold Liu
abstract: 对于依赖图像级标注的弱监督语义分割(WSSS),通常依靠分类网络生成初始分割伪标签。然而,分类网络的优化目标通常忽视了不同像素之间的区分性,例如不显著的前景和背景区域。本文提出了一种自适应空间二元交叉熵(Spatial-BCE)损失函数用于WSSS,旨在增强像素间的区分性。在Spatial-BCE损失中,我们对每个像素独立计算损失,并启发式地为前景和背景像素分别分配优化方向。同时提出了一种辅助的自监督任务以确保Spatial-BCE损失按预期工作。此外,为增强网络对不同数据分布的泛化能力,设计了一种交替训练策略以自适应生成划分前景和背景的阈值。得益于Spatial-BCE损失生成的高质量初始伪标签,我们的方法也减少了对后处理的依赖,从而简化了WSSS的流程。我们的方法在PASCAL VOC 2012和COCO2014数据集上进行了验证,并取得了新的最先进水平。
abstract_en: For Weakly-Supervised Semantic Segmentation (WSSS) with image-level annotation, mostly relies on the classification network to generate initial segmentation pseudo-labels. However, the optimization target of classification networks usually neglects the discrimination between different pixels, like insignificant foreground and background regions. In this paper, we propose an adaptive Spatial Binary Cross-Entropy (Spatial-BCE) Loss for WSSS, which aims to enhance the discrimination between pixels. In Spatial-BCE Loss, we calculate the loss independently for each pixel and heuristically assign the optimization directions for foreground and background pixels separately. An auxiliary self-supervised task is also proposed to guarantee the Spatial-BCE Loss working as envisaged. Meanwhile, to enhance the network’s generalization for different data distributions, we design an alternate training strategy to adaptively generate thresholds to divide the foreground and background. Benefiting from high-quality initial pseudo-labels by Spatial-BCE Loss, our method also reduce the reliance on post-processing, thereby simplifying the pipeline of WSSS. Our method is validated on the PASCAL VOC 2012 and COCO2014 datasets and achieves the new state-of-the-art.

title: Townim Chowdhury, Ali Cheraghian, Sameera Ramasinghe, Sahar Ahmadi, Morteza Saberi, Shafin Rahman
title_en: Townim Chowdhury, Ali Cheraghian, Sameera Ramasinghe, Sahar Ahmadi, Morteza Saberi, Shafin Rahman
abstract: 少样本类增量学习(FSCIL)旨在通过少量示例,对已训练在基础类别上的模型进行增量微调,以适应新类别集合,同时避免遗忘先前的训练。近期FSCIL的研究主要针对2D图像数据。然而,随着摄像技术的进步,3D点云数据变得比以往任何时候都更加丰富,这促使我们考虑在3D数据上进行FSCIL。本文在3D领域解决FSCIL问题。除了已知的灾难性遗忘和少样本数据过拟合问题外,3D FSCIL还可能带来新的挑战。例如,在现实场景中,基础类别可能包含大量合成实例,而增量步骤中仅能获得少量真实扫描的新型类别样本(来自RGBD传感器)。由于合成数据与真实数据之间的差异,FSCIL在后续增量步骤中面临额外挑战,导致性能下降。我们通过使用Microshapes(正交基向量)来描述任何3D对象,利用预定义规则减少合成与真实数据的差异,从而实现少样本增量训练。我们提出新的3D FSCIL测试协议,使用流行的合成数据集ModelNet和ShapeNet,以及3D真实扫描数据集ScanObjectNN和Common Objects in 3D(CO3D)。通过与现有方法的比较,我们验证了在3D领域中所提方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) aims to incrementally fine-tune a model trained on base classes for a novel set of classes using a few examples without forgetting the previous training. Recent efforts of FSCIL addresses this problem primarily on 2D image data. However, due to the advancement of camera technology, 3D point cloud data has become more available than ever, which warrants considering FSCIL on 3D data. In this paper, we address FSCIL in the 3D domain. In addition to well-known problems of catastrophic forgetting of past knowledge and overfitting of few-shot data, 3D FSCIL can bring newer challenges. For example, base classes may contain many synthetic instances in a realistic scenario. In contrast, only a few real-scanned samples (from RGBD sensors) of novel classes are available in incremental steps. Due to the data variation from synthetic to real, FSCIL endures additional challenges, degrading performance in later incremental steps. We attempt to solve this problem by using Microshapes (orthogonal basis vectors) describing any 3D objects using a pre-defined set of rules. It supports incremental training with few-shot examples minimizing synthetic to real data variation. We propose new test protocols for 3D FSCIL using popular synthetic datasets, ModelNet and ShapeNet and 3D real-scanned datasets, ScanObjectNN and Common Objects in 3D (CO3D). By comparing state-of-the-art methods, we establish the effectiveness of our approach on the 3D domain.

title: Tsu-Jui Fu, Xin Eric Wang, William Yang Wang
title_en: Tsu-Jui Fu, Xin Eric Wang, William Yang Wang
abstract: 尽管风格迁移在某些方面表现出色,但其需要预先准备风格图像,可能导致缺乏创意性和可访问性。另一方面,遵循人类指令是进行艺术风格迁移最自然的方式,能够显著提升视觉效果应用中的可控性。我们引入了一个新任务——语言驱动的艺术风格迁移(LDAST),通过文本引导对内容图像的风格进行操控。我们提出对比语言视觉艺术家(CLVA),该模型学习从风格指令中提取视觉语义,并通过基于补丁的风格判别器实现LDAST。判别器通过考虑语言与风格图像或迁移结果补丁之间的相关性,联合嵌入风格指令。CLVA进一步通过对比内容图像与风格指令的对比对来提升相互关联性。相同内容图像的结果可以保持一致的内容结构。此外,它们应从包含相似视觉语义的风格指令中呈现类似的风格模式。实验结果表明,我们的CLVA在LDAST任务中表现出色,取得了卓越的迁移效果。
abstract_en: Despite having promising results, style transfer, which requires preparing style images in advance, may result in lack of creativity and accessibility. Following human instruction, on the other hand, is the most natural way to perform artistic style transfer that can significantly improve controllability for visual effect applications. We introduce a new task---language-driven artistic style transfer (LDAST)---to manipulate the style of a content image, guided by a text. We propose contrastive language visual artist (CLVA) that learns to extract visual semantics from style instructions and accomplish LDAST by the patch-wise style discriminator. The discriminator considers the correlation between language and patches of style images or transferred results to jointly embed style instructions. CLVA further compares contrastive pairs of content image and style instruction to improve the mutual relativeness. The results from the same content image can preserve consistent content structures. Besides, they should present analogous style patterns from style instructions that contain similar visual semantics. The experiments show that our CLVA is effective and achieves superb transferred results on LDAST.

title: Tsung-Han Wu, Yi-Syuan Liou, Shao-Ji Yuan, Hsin-Ying Lee, Tung-I Chen, Kuan-Chih Huang, Winston H. Hsu
title_en: Tsung-Han Wu, Yi-Syuan Liou, Shao-Ji Yuan, Hsin-Ying Lee, Tung-I Chen, Kuan-Chih Huang, Winston H. Hsu
abstract: 在领域自适应领域,模型性能与目标域标注数量之间存在权衡。主动学习通过使用少量具有信息量的标注数据最大化模型性能,在这种场景下非常有用。在本文中,我们提出了D2ADA,一个用于语义分割的通用主动领域自适应框架。为了以最少的查询标签适应目标域,我们提出获取在目标域中具有高概率密度但在源域中具有低概率密度的样本标签,这些标签与现有的源域标注数据互补。为了进一步提高标注效率,我们设计了一种动态调度策略,随时间调整领域探索与模型不确定性之间的标注预算。大量实验表明,我们的方法在两个基准测试GTA5 -> Cityscapes和SYNTHIA -> Cityscapes上优于现有的主动学习和领域自适应基线。在少于5%的目标域标注情况下,我们的方法达到与全监督相当的结果。
abstract_en: In the field of domain adaptation, a trade-off exists between the model performance and the number of target domain annotations. Active learning, maximizing model performance with few informative labeled data, comes in handy for such a scenario. In this work, we present D2ADA, a general active domain adaptation framework for semantic segmentation. To adapt the model to the target domain with minimum queried labels, we propose acquiring labels of the samples with high probability density in the target domain yet with low probability density in the source domain, complementary to the existing source domain labeled data. To further facilitate labeling efficiency, we design a dynamic scheduling policy to adjust the labeling budgets between domain exploration and model uncertainty over time. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms existing active learning and domain adaptation baselines on two benchmarks, GTA5 -> Cityscapes and SYNTHIA -> Cityscapes. With less than 5% target domain annotations, our method reaches comparable results with that of full supervision.

title: Tu Bui, Ning Yu, John Collomosse
title_en: Tu Bui, Ning Yu, John Collomosse
abstract: 生成对抗网络(GANs)的快速发展为图像溯源带来了新的挑战;检测图像是否为合成图像,并在确认为合成图像时确定其使用的GAN架构。独特的是,我们提出了一种能够实现1)语义内容不变的图像匹配;2)对常见于网络重新分享过程中遇到的良性变换(如质量、分辨率、形状等变化)具有鲁棒性的解决方案。为正式化我们的研究,我们收集了一个具有挑战性的基准数据集Attribution88,用于鲁棒且实用的图像溯源。随后,我们提出了RepMix,一种基于表示混合和新颖损失函数的GAN指纹技术。我们验证了其追踪GAN生成图像来源的能力,该能力对图像的语义内容具有不变性,并且对扰动具有鲁棒性。我们展示了我们的方法在语义泛化能力和鲁棒性方面均显著优于现有GAN指纹技术。
abstract_en: Rapid advances in Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) raise new challenges for image attribution; detecting whether an image is synthetic and, if so, determining which GAN architecture created it. Uniquely, we present a solution to this task capable of 1) matching images invariant to their semantic content; 2) robust to benign transformations (changes in quality, resolution, shape, etc.) commonly encountered as images are re-shared online. In order to formalize our research, a challenging benchmark, Attribution88, is collected for robust and practical image attribution. We then propose RepMix, our GAN fingerprinting technique based on representation mixing and a novel loss. We validate its capability of tracing the provenance of GAN-generated images invariant to the semantic content of the image and also robust to perturbations. We show our approach improves significantly from existing GAN fingerprinting works on both semantic generalization and robustness.

title: Tuan Ngo, Khoi Nguyen
title_en: Tuan Ngo, Khoi Nguyen
abstract: 本文介绍了一个新的三维点云问题:少样本实例分割。给定少量标注的点云示例以表示目标类别,我们的目标是在查询点云中分割出该目标类的所有实例。该问题在点级实例分割标注成本极高的实际应用中具有广泛的应用价值。为解决这一问题,我们提出了Geodesic-Former——首个用于三维点云实例分割的测地引导Transformer。其核心思想是利用测地距离来解决激光雷达三维点云的密度不平衡问题。激光雷达三维点云在物体表面附近密集,而在其他区域稀疏或为空,使得欧几里得距离难以区分不同物体。相比之下,测地距离更合适,因为它编码了场景的几何信息,可用于作为Transformer解码器中注意力机制的引导信号,生成表示实例不同特征的核。这些核随后用于动态卷积以获得最终的实例掩码。为在新任务上评估Geodesic-Former,我们提出了ScannetV2和S3DIS这两个常见三维点云实例分割数据集的新划分方式。Geodesic-Former在显著优势下持续超越了从最新三维点云实例分割方法中适配的强基线模型。代码可在https://github.com/VinAIResearch/GeoFormer获取。
abstract_en: This paper introduces a new problem in 3D point cloud: few-shot instance segmentation. Given a few annotated point clouds exemplified a target class, our goal is to segment all instances of this target class in a query point cloud. This problem has a wide range of practical applications where point-wise instance segmentation annotation is prohibitively expensive to collect. To address this problem, we present Geodesic-Former -- the first geodesic-guided transformer for 3D point cloud instance segmentation. The key idea is to leverage the geodesic distance to tackle the density imbalance of LiDAR 3D point clouds. The LiDAR 3D point clouds are dense near the object surface and sparse or empty elsewhere making the Euclidean distance less effective to distinguish different objects. The geodesic distance, on the other hand, is more suitable since it encodes the scene’s geometry which can be used as a guiding signal for the attention mechanism in a transformer decoder to generate kernels representing distinct features of instances. These kernels are then used in a dynamic convolution to obtain the final instance masks. To evaluate Geodesic-Former on the new task, we propose new splits of the two common 3D point cloud instance segmentation datasets: ScannetV2 and S3DIS. Geodesic-Former consistently outperforms strong baselines adapted from state-of-the-art 3D point cloud instance segmentation approaches with a significant margin. Code is available at https://github.com/VinAIResearch/GeoFormer.

title: Tuan-Anh Vu, Thanh Nguyen, Binh-Son Hua, Quang-Hieu Pham, Sai-Kit Yeung
title_en: Tuan-Anh Vu, Thanh Nguyen, Binh-Son Hua, Quang-Hieu Pham, Sai-Kit Yeung
abstract: 从三维点云中进行物体重建在计算机视觉和计算机图形学研究领域取得了显著进展。然而,从随时间变化的点云(即四维点云)进行重建通常被忽视。本文提出了一种新的网络架构,名为RFNet-4D,该架构可联合从四维点云中重建物体及其运动流。关键洞察在于,通过从点云序列中学习空间和时间特征同时执行两项任务,可以利用各自任务的优势,从而提升整体性能。为验证这一能力,我们设计了一个时间向量场学习模块,采用无监督学习方法进行流估计,并结合监督学习的空间结构学习用于物体重建。在基准数据集上的大量实验和分析验证了我们方法的有效性和效率。实验结果表明,我们的方法在流估计和物体重建方面均达到最先进水平,且在训练和推理过程中均显著优于现有方法。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/hkust-vgd/RFNet-4D获取。
abstract_en: Object reconstruction from 3D point clouds has achieved impressive progress in the computer vision and computer graphics research field. However, reconstruction from time-varying point clouds (a.k.a. 4D point clouds) is generally overlooked. In this paper, we propose a new network architecture, namely RFNet-4D, that jointly reconstruct objects and their motion flows from 4D point clouds. The key insight is that simultaneously performing both tasks via learning spatial and temporal features from a sequence of point clouds can leverage individual tasks, leading to improved overall performance. To prove this ability, we design a temporal vector field learning module using unsupervised learning approach for flow estimation, leveraged by supervised learning of spatial structures for object reconstruction. Extensive experiments and analyses on benchmark dataset validated the effectiveness and efficiency of our method. As shown in experimental results, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on both flow estimation and object reconstruction while performing much faster than existing methods in both training and inference. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/hkust-vgd/RFNet-4D.

title: Tze Ho Elden Tse, Zhongqun Zhang, Kwang In Kim, Aleš Leonardis, Feng Zheng, Hyung Jin Chang
title_en: Tze Ho Elden Tse, Zhongqun Zhang, Kwang In Kim, Aleš Leonardis, Feng Zheng, Hyung Jin Chang
abstract: 能够推理手与物体之间的物理接触对于理解手-物体操作至关重要。然而,尽管在手部和物体数据集中进行了精确的三维标注,三维手部和物体重建仍存在差距。近期研究利用接触图来优化不准确的手-物体姿态估计,并基于物体模型生成抓取动作。然而,这些方法需要显式的三维监督信息,而此类信息较为稀缺,因此仅适用于受限场景,例如热成像相机观测被操作物体残留的热量。本文提出了一种新颖的半监督框架,允许我们从单目视频中学习接触信息。具体而言,我们利用大规模数据集中的视觉和几何一致性约束生成半监督学习的伪标签,并提出一种高效的图神经网络来推断接触信息。我们的半监督学习框架在现有基于有限标注数据训练的监督学习方法上取得了显著改进。值得注意的是,与常用的基于PointNet的方法相比,我们的模型在参数数量和内存访问成本不到一半的情况下仍能实现更优的性能。我们展示了使用接触图规则手-物体交互以生成更精确重建的优势。进一步证明了使用伪标签训练可以将接触图估计扩展到域外物体,并在多个数据集上实现更好的泛化能力。
abstract_en: Being able to reason about the physical contacts between hands and objects is crucial in understanding hand-object manipulation. However, despite the efforts in accurate 3D annotations in hand and object datasets, there still exist gaps in 3D hand and object reconstructions. Recent works leverage contact maps to refine inaccurate hand-object pose estimations and generate grasps given object models. However, they require explicit 3D supervision which is seldom available and therefore, are limited to constrained settings, e.g., where thermal cameras observe residual heat left on manipulated objects. In this paper, we propose a novel semi-supervised framework that allows us to learn contact from monocular videos. Specifically, we leverage visual and geometric consistency constraints in large-scale datasets for generating pseudo-labels in semi-supervised learning and propose an efficient graph-based network to infer contact. Our semi-supervised learning framework achieves a favourable improvement over the existing supervised learning methods trained on data with ‘limited’ annotations. Notably, our proposed model is able to achieve superior results with less than half the network parameters and memory access cost when compared with the commonly-used PointNet-based approach. We show benefits from using a contact map that rules hand-object interactions to produce more accurate reconstructions. We further demonstrate that training with pseudo-labels can extend contact map estimations to out-of-domain objects and generalise better across multiple datasets.

title: Uddeshya Upadhyay, Shyamgopal Karthik, Yanbei Chen, Massimiliano Mancini, Zeynep Akata
title_en: Uddeshya Upadhyay, Shyamgopal Karthik, Yanbei Chen, Massimiliano Mancini, Zeynep Akata
abstract: 高质量的校准不确定性估计对于众多现实世界应用至关重要,尤其是在基于深度学习的部署型机器学习系统中。虽然贝叶斯深度学习技术能够实现不确定性估计,但使用大规模数据集对其进行训练是一个昂贵的过程,且不总是能获得与非贝叶斯方法竞争的模型。此外,许多已训练并部署的高性能深度学习模型本质上是非贝叶斯的,且不提供不确定性估计。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了BayesCap方法,该方法为冻结模型学习贝叶斯恒等映射,从而实现不确定性估计。BayesCap是一种内存高效的算法,可以在原始数据集的小部分上进行训练,通过为预测提供校准的不确定性估计,增强预训练的非贝叶斯计算机视觉模型,而无需(i)损害模型性能,以及(ii)昂贵地从头开始重新训练模型。所提出的方法对各种架构和任务均无依赖性。我们在包括图像超分辨率、去模糊、图像修复以及关键应用如医学图像翻译等广泛任务和多样化架构上验证了该方法的有效性。此外,我们将推导出的不确定性估计应用于关键场景(如自动驾驶中的深度估计)中检测分布外样本。
abstract_en: High-quality calibrated uncertainty estimates are crucial for numerous real-world applications, especially for deep learning-based deployed ML systems. While Bayesian deep learning techniques allow uncertainty estimation, training them with large-scale datasets is an expensive process that does not always yield models competitive with non-Bayesian counterparts. Moreover, many of the high-performing deep learning models that are already trained and deployed are non-Bayesian in nature, and do not provide uncertainty estimates. To address these issues, we propose BayesCap that learns a Bayesian identity mapping for the frozen model, allowing uncertainty estimation. BayesCap is a memory-efficient method that can be trained on a small fraction of the original dataset, enhancing pretrained non-Bayesian computer vision models by providing calibrated uncertainty estimates for the predictions without (i) hampering the performance of the model and (ii) the need for expensive retraining the model from scratch. The proposed method is agnostic to various architectures and tasks. We show the efficacy of our method on a wide variety of tasks with a diverse set of architectures, including image super-resolution, deblurring, inpainting, and crucial application such as medical image translation. Moreover, we apply the derived uncertainty estimates to detect out-of-distribution samples in critical scenarios like depth estimation in autonomous driving.

title: Vaikkunth Mugunthan, Eric Lin, Vignesh Gokul, Christian Lau, Lalana Kagal, Steve Pieper
title_en: Vaikkunth Mugunthan, Eric Lin, Vignesh Gokul, Christian Lau, Lalana Kagal, Steve Pieper
abstract: 联邦学习(FL)使客户端能够在保持本地训练数据去中心化的情况下协作训练模型。然而,高昂的通信成本、客户端间的数据异构性以及缺乏个性化技术阻碍了联邦学习的发展。本文提出FedLTN,一种受著名彩票假设启发的新方法,用于在非独立同分布(non-IID)数据设置下学习稀疏且个性化的彩票票网络(LTNs),以实现通信高效且个性化的联邦学习。通过保留本地客户端的批量归一化统计信息、无需回滚的后剪枝以及使用服务器动量聚合LTNs,我们的方法显著优于现有最先进的解决方案。在CIFAR-10和TinyImageNet数据集上的实验验证了我们的方法在学习个性化模型的同时显著降低通信成本的有效性。
abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) enables clients to collaboratively train a model, while keeping their local training data decentralized. However, high communication costs, data heterogeneity across clients, and lack of personalization techniques hinder the development of FL. In this paper, we propose FedLTN, a novel approach motivated by the well-known Lottery Ticket Hypothesis to learn sparse and personalized lottery ticket networks (LTNs) for communication-efficient and personalized FL under non-identically and independently distributed (non-IID) data settings. Preserving batch-norm statistics of local clients, postpruning without rewinding, and aggregation of LTNs using server momentum ensures that our approach significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art solutions. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and TinyImageNet datasets show the efficacy of our approach in learning personalized models while significantly reducing communication costs.

title: Van-Quang Nguyen, Masanori Suganuma, Takayuki Okatani
title_en: Van-Quang Nguyen, Masanori Suganuma, Takayuki Okatani
abstract: 当前最先进的图像描述生成方法采用基于区域的特征,因为它们能提供对象级信息,这是描述图像内容所必需的;这些特征通常由如Faster R-CNN等目标检测器提取。然而,这些方法存在一些问题,例如缺乏上下文信息、检测不准确的风险以及高计算成本。前两个问题可以通过额外使用基于网格的特征来解决。然而,如何提取和融合这两种类型的特征仍是一个未被探索的领域。本文提出了一种仅使用Transformer的神经架构,称为GRIT(基于网格和区域的图像描述Transformer),该架构能有效利用这两种视觉特征生成更优的描述。GRIT将先前方法中使用的基于CNN的检测器替换为基于DETR的检测器,从而提高了计算效率。此外,其仅由Transformer组成的整体设计使得模型能够进行端到端训练。这种创新设计与双视觉特征的集成显著提升了性能。在多个图像描述生成基准测试中的实验结果表明,GRIT在推理准确性和速度方面均优于先前方法。
abstract_en: Current state-of-the-art methods for image captioning employ region-based features, as they provide object-level information that is essential to describe the content of images; they are usually extracted by an object detector such as Faster R-CNN. However, they have several issues, such as lack of contextual information, the risk of inaccurate detection, and the high computational cost. The first two could be resolved by additionally using grid-based features. However, how to extract and fuse these two types of features is uncharted. This paper proposes a Transformer-only neural architecture, dubbed GRIT (Grid- and Region-based Image captioning Transformer), that effectively utilizes the two visual features to generate better captions. GRIT replaces the CNN-based detector employed in previous methods with a DETR-based one, making it computationally faster. Moreover, its monolithic design consisting only of Transformers enables end-to-end training of the model. This innovative design and the integration of the dual visual features bring about significant performance improvement. The experimental results on several image captioning benchmarks show that GRIT outperforms previous methods in inference accuracy and speed.

title: Varshanth Rao, Md Ibrahim Khalil, Haoda Li, Peng Dai, Juwei Lu
title_en: Varshanth Rao, Md Ibrahim Khalil, Haoda Li, Peng Dai, Juwei Lu
abstract: 音频-视觉事件定位(AVEL)问题涉及解决三个核心子任务:利用跨模态引导创建高效的音频-视觉表示,形成短期时序特征聚合,并通过其积累实现长期依赖关系的解决。这些子任务通常由专门模块执行,但模块间的有限交互限制了特征学习的串行方式。以往研究通常将视频视为时序多模态流。我们改进并扩展了这一观点,提出了一种新颖的架构——双视角网络(DPNet),其特点包括:(1)通过图神经网络(GNN)在视频的直观图视角上同时实现跨模态引导和短期时序聚合;(2)部署时间卷积网络(TCN)以实现长期依赖关系的解决;(3)通过交替在GNN和TCN之间进行的无环特征精炼过程鼓励交互式特征学习。此外,我们引入了关系图卷积变换器(RelationalGraph Convolutional Transformer),这是一种集成到DPNet中的新型GNN,用于表达并关注每个段节点与其不同关系邻域的关系表示。最后,我们通过一种名为“复制与链接”的新视频增强技术多样化DPNet的输入,该技术输出语义相同的视频融合,其图表示可与源视频的图表示相链接。实验表明,我们的DPNet框架在公共AVE数据集上显著优于先前的最先进方法,而广泛的消融研究验证了所提出方法的有效性。
abstract_en: The Audio-Visual Event Localization (AVEL) problem involves tackling three core sub-tasks: the creation of efficient audio-visual representations using cross-modal guidance, the formation of short-term temporal feature aggregations, and its accumulation to achieve long-term dependency resolution. These sub-tasks are often performed by tailored modules, where the limited inter-module interaction restricts feature learning to a serialized manner. Past works have traditionally viewed videos as temporally sequenced multi-modal streams. We improve and extend on this view by proposing a novel architecture, the Dual Perspective Network (DPNet), that - (1) additionally operates on an intuitive graph perspective of a video to simultaneously facilitate cross-modal guidance and short-term temporal aggregation using a Graph NeuralNetwork (GNN), (2) deploys a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN)to achieve long-term dependency resolution, and (3) encourages interactive feature learning using an acyclic feature refinement process that alternates between the GNN and TCN. Further, we introduce the RelationalGraph Convolutional Transformer, a novel GNN integrated into the DP-Net, to express and attend each segment node’s relational representation with its different relational neighborhoods. Lastly, we diversify the input to the DPNet through a new video augmentation technique called Replicate and Link, which outputs semantically identical video blends whose graph representations can be linked to that of the source videos. Experiments reveal that our DPNet framework outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods by large margins for the AVEL task on the public AVE dataset, while extensive ablation studies corroborate the efficacy of each proposed method.

title: Vasileios Choutas, Federica Bogo, Jingjing Shen, Julien Valentin
title_en: Vasileios Choutas, Federica Bogo, Jingjing Shen, Julien Valentin
abstract: 在增强现实(AR)和虚拟现实(VR)场景中,以准确、鲁棒且快速的方式将人体、手部或面部的参数化模型拟合到稀疏输入信号上,有望显著提升沉浸感。解决这些问题的系统通常首先将参数化模型的参数直接从输入数据回归。这种方法快速且鲁棒,是迭代最小化算法的良好起点。后者通过最小化能量函数来寻找最小值,通常由数据项和编码问题结构知识的先验项组成。尽管这种方法无疑非常成功,但先验项通常是手动定义的启发式方法,找到不同项之间的适当平衡以获得高质量结果是一项非平凡的任务。此外,将这些系统转换和优化以在高性能方式运行需要定制实现,这需要工程师和领域专家投入大量时间。在本文中,我们借鉴最近在学习优化方面的进展,提出了一种受经典Levenberg-Marquardt算法启发的更新规则。我们在三个问题上展示了所提出的神经优化器的有效性:从头戴式设备进行3D人体估计、从稀疏2D关键点进行3D人体估计以及从密集2D地标进行面部表面估计。我们的方法可以轻松应用于新的模型拟合问题,并在准确性和速度方面提供了与精心调校的“传统”模型拟合流程具有竞争力的替代方案。
abstract_en: Fitting parametric models of human bodies, hands or faces to sparse input signals in an accurate, robust, and fast manner has the promise of significantly improving immersion in AR and VR scenarios. A common first step in systems that tackle these problems is to regress the parameters of the parametric model directly from the input data. This approach is fast, robust, and is a good starting point for an iterative minimization algorithm. The latter searches for the minimum of an energy function, typically composed of a data term and priors that encode our knowledge about the problem’s structure. While this is undoubtedly a very successful recipe, priors are often hand defined heuristics and finding the right balance between the different terms to achieve high quality results is a non-trivial task. Furthermore, converting and optimizing these systems to run in a performant way requires custom implementations that demand significant time investments from both engineers and domain experts. In this work, we build upon recent advances in learned optimization and propose an update rule inspired by the classic Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm. We show the effectiveness of the proposed neural optimizer on three problems, 3D body estimation from a head-mounted device, 3D body estimation from sparse 2D keypoints and face surface estimation from dense 2D landmarks. Our method can easily be applied to new model fitting problems and offers a competitive alternative to well-tuned ‘traditional’ model fitting pipelines, both in terms of accuracy and speed.

title: Vasyl Borsuk, Roman Vei, Orest Kupyn, Tetiana Martyniuk, Igor Krashenyi, Jiři Matas
title_en: Vasyl Borsuk, Roman Vei, Orest Kupyn, Tetiana Martyniuk, Igor Krashenyi, Jiři Matas
abstract: 我们提出FEAR,这是一个快速、高效、准确且鲁棒的双胞胎视觉跟踪器家族。我们提出了一种新颖且高效的方法,利用双模板表示进行目标模型适应,该方法仅通过单个可学习参数即可融合时序信息。我们进一步通过像素级融合模块改进跟踪器架构。通过将上述模块与复杂的主干网络结合,FEAR-M和FEAR-L跟踪器在多个学术基准测试中均超越了大多数双胞胎跟踪器的准确性和效率。采用轻量级主干网络的优化版本FEAR-XS,在保持近SOTA结果的同时,比当前双胞胎跟踪器快了超过10倍。FEAR-XS跟踪器比LightTrack小2.4倍、快4.3倍,且具有更高的准确性。此外,我们通过引入FEAR基准测试扩展了模型效率的定义,该基准测试评估能耗和执行速度。我们证明了能耗是移动设备上跟踪器的限制因素。源代码、预训练模型和评估协议可在https://github.com/PinataFarms/FEARTracker获取。
abstract_en: We present FEAR, a family of fast, efficient, accurate, and robust Siamese visual trackers. We present a novel and efficient way to benefit from dual-template representation for object model adaption, which incorporates temporal information with only a single learnable parameter. We further improve the tracker architecture with a pixel-wise fusion block. By plugging-in sophisticated backbones with the abovementioned modules, FEAR-M and FEAR-L trackers surpass most Siamese trackers on several academic benchmarks in both accuracy and efficiency. Employed with the lightweight backbone, the optimized version FEAR-XS offers more than 10 times faster tracking than current Siamese trackers while maintaining near state-of-the-art results. FEAR-XS tracker is 2.4x smaller and 4.3x faster than LightTrack with superior accuracy. In addition, we expand the definition of the model efficiency by introducing FEAR benchmark that assesses energy consumption and execution speed. We show that energy consumption is a limiting factor for trackers on mobile devices. Source code, pretrained models, and evaluation protocol are available at https://github.com/PinataFarms/FEARTracker.

title: Victor Escorcia, Ricardo Guerrero, Xiatian Zhu, Brais Martinez
title_en: Victor Escorcia, Ricardo Guerrero, Xiatian Zhu, Brais Martinez
abstract: 从视频数据中学习以自我为中心的动作识别模型具有挑战性,因为背景中存在干扰物,例如无关物体。因此,将物体信息进一步整合到动作模型中是有益的。现有方法通常利用通用物体检测器来识别和表示场景中的物体。然而,仍存在几个重要问题。目标领域(数据集)仍需要高质量的物体类别注释以学习良好的物体表示。此外,先前方法深度耦合了现有动作模型与物体表示,因此需要联合重新训练,导致集成成本高且不够灵活。为克服这两个限制,我们引入了Self-supervised learning Over Sets(SOS),一种通过离线手-物体接触检测器检测到的视频物体区域来预训练通用Objects In Contact(OIC)表示模型的方法。与传统自监督学习中单独增强物体区域不同,我们将动作过程视为具有独特时空连续性的自然数据变换,并利用每段视频中物体集合之间的固有关系。在两个数据集EPIC-KITCHENS-100和EGTEA上的大量实验表明,我们的OIC显著提升了多个最先进的视频分类模型的性能。
abstract_en: Learning an egocentric action recognition model from video data is challenging due to distractors in the background, e.g., irrelevant objects. Further integrating object information into an action model is hence beneficial. Existing methods often leverage a generic object detector to identify and represent the objects in the scene. However, several important issues remain. Object class annotations of good quality for the target domain (dataset) are still required for learning good object representation. Moreover, previous methods deeply couple existing action models with object representations, and thus need to retrain them jointly, leading to costly and inflexible integration. To overcome both limitations, we introduce Self-supervised learning Over Sets (SOS), an approach to pre-train a generic Objects In Contact (OIC) representation model from video object regions detected by an off-the-shelf hand-object contact detector. Instead of augmenting object regions individually as in conventional self-supervised learning, we view the action process as a means of natural data transformations with unique spatiotemporal continuity and exploit the inherent relationships among per-video object sets. Extensive experiments on two datasets, EPIC-KITCHENS-100 and EGTEA, show that our OIC significantly boosts the performance of multiple state-of-the-art video classification models.

title: Viktor Rudnev, Mohamed Elgharib, William Smith, Lingjie Liu, Vladislav Golyanik, Christian Theobalt
title_en: Viktor Rudnev, Mohamed Elgharib, William Smith, Lingjie Liu, Vladislav Golyanik, Christian Theobalt
abstract: 从照片中对户外场景进行逼真编辑需要深入理解图像形成过程,并准确估计场景几何、反射率和光照。随后可以在保持场景反照率和几何不变的前提下,对光照进行精细操控。我们提出NeRF-OSR,即首个基于神经辐射场的户外场景重光照方法。与现有方法不同,我们的技术仅需一组在非受控环境下拍摄的户外照片,即可同时编辑场景光照和相机视角。此外,它还支持通过球谐函数模型直接控制场景光照。为评估,我们收集了一个新的基准数据集,包含多个户外地点在不同时间从多个视角拍摄的图像。对于每个时间点,均采集360度环境贴图及颜色校准棋盘格,以实现对真实数据的准确数值评估。与当前最优方法对比实验表明,NeRF-OSR在高质量和逼真自阴影再现方面实现了可控的光照和视角编辑。
abstract_en: Photorealistic editing of outdoor scenes from photographs requires a profound understanding of the image formation process and an accurate estimation of the scene geometry, reflectance and illumination. A delicate manipulation of the lighting can then be performed while keeping the scene albedo and geometry unaltered. We present NeRF-OSR, i.e., the first approach for outdoor scene relighting based on neural radiance fields. In contrast to the prior art, our technique allows simultaneous editing of both scene illumination and camera viewpoint using only a collection of outdoor photos shot in uncontrolled settings. Moreover, it enables direct control over the scene illumination, as defined through a spherical harmonics model. For evaluation, we collect a new benchmark dataset of several outdoor sites photographed from multiple viewpoints and at different times. For each time, a 360 degree environment map is captured together with a colour-calibration chequerboard to allow accurate numerical evaluations on real data against ground truth. Comparisons against SoTA show that NeRF-OSR enables controllable lighting and viewpoint editing at higher quality and with realistic self-shadowing reproduction.

title: Vincent Le Guen, Clément Rambour, Nicolas Thome
title_en: Vincent Le Guen, Clément Rambour, Nicolas Thome
abstract: 当前光流估计的最先进方法依赖于深度学习,而要达到现实数据上的最优性能,需要复杂的序列训练方案。在本文中,我们引入了COMBO深度网络,该网络显式地利用了传统方法中使用的亮度恒定性(BC)模型。由于BC是一种近似的物理模型,在多种情况下会被违反,我们提出训练一个结合物理约束网络和数据驱动网络的混合模型。我们引入了一种独特且有意义的流分解方法,将物理先验与数据驱动的补充部分分离,并包含对BC模型的不确定性量化。我们推导了一种训练方案,用于在监督和半监督背景下学习分解的不同组成部分。实验表明,COMBO在多个基准测试中超越了最先进的监督网络(如RAFT),达到了最先进性能。我们展示了COMBO如何利用BC模型并适应其局限性。最后,我们证明了我们的半监督方法可以显著简化训练过程。
abstract_en: State-of-the-art methods for optical flow estimation rely on deep learning, which require complex sequential training schemes to reach optimal performances on real-world data. In this work, we introduce the COMBO deep network that explicitly exploits the brightness constancy (BC) model used in traditional methods. Since State-of-the-art methods for optical flow estimation rely on deep learning, which require complex sequential training schemes to reach optimal performances on real-world data. In this work, we introduce the COMBO deep network that explicitly exploits the brightness constancy (BC) model used in traditional methods. Since BC is an approximate physical model violated in several situations, we propose to train a physically-constrained network complemented with a data-driven network. We introduce a unique and meaningful flow decomposition between the physical prior and the data-driven complement, including an uncertainty quantification of the BC model. We derive a training scheme for learning the different components of the decomposition, in a supervised but also in a semi-supervised context. Experiments show that COMBO can improve performances over state-of-the-art supervised networks, eg RAFT, reaching state-of-the-art performances on several benchmarks. We highlight how COMBO can leverage the BC model and adapt to its limitations. Finally, we show that our semi-supervised method can significantly simplify the training procedure.

title: Vishwanath Saragadam, Jasper Tan, Guha Balakrishnan, Richard G. Baraniuk, Ashok Veeraraghavan
title_en: Vishwanath Saragadam, Jasper Tan, Guha Balakrishnan, Richard G. Baraniuk, Ashok Veeraraghavan
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的神经信号模型,旨在高效地表示大规模高分辨率信号。我们多尺度隐式神经表示(MINER)的关键创新在于通过拉普拉斯金字塔实现的内部表示,该方法提供了信号的稀疏多尺度分解,能够捕捉跨尺度的正交信号部分。我们利用拉普拉斯金字塔的优势,通过在每个尺度上用小型MLP表示金字塔的小块不相交区域。这使得网络容量能够从粗尺度自适应地增加到细尺度,并仅表示具有强信号能量的信号部分。每个MLP的参数从粗尺度到细尺度进行优化,从而在粗尺度上实现更快的近似,最终实现极快的训练过程。我们将MINER应用于一系列大规模信号表示任务,包括十亿像素图像和非常大的点云,并证明其所需的参数数量少于竞争技术(如ACORN)的25%,内存占用仅为33%,计算时间仅为10%,即可达到相同的表示精度。
abstract_en: We introduce a new neural signal model designed for efficient high-resolution representation of large-scale signals. The key innovation in our multiscale implicit neural representation (MINER) is an internal representation via a Laplacian pyramid, which provides a sparse multiscale decomposition of the signal that captures orthogonal parts of the signal across scales. We leverage the advantages of the Laplacian pyramid by representing small disjoint patches of the pyramid at each scale with a small MLP. This enables the capacity of the network to adaptively increase from coarse to fine scales, and only represent parts of the signal with strong signal energy. The parameters of each MLP are optimized from coarse-to-fine scale which results in faster approximations at coarser scales, thereby ultimately an extremely fast training process. We apply MINER to a range of large-scale signal representation tasks, including gigapixel images and very large point clouds, and demonstrate that it requires fewer than 25% of the parameters, 33% of the memory footprint, and 10% of the computation time of competing techniques such as ACORN to reach the same representation accuracy.

title: Vitjan Zavrtanik, Matej Kristan, Danijel Skočaj
title_en: Vitjan Zavrtanik, Matej Kristan, Danijel Skočaj
abstract: 当前判别式无监督表面异常检测的最先进方法依赖于外部数据集来合成异常增强的训练图像。此类方法在近分布异常上容易失败,因为这些异常与无异常区域相似,难以真实合成。我们提出了一种基于量化特征空间表示的双解码器架构DSR,避免了图像级异常合成的需求。无需对异常的视觉属性做出任何假设,DSR通过从学习到的量化特征空间中采样来生成异常,这使得能够受控地生成近分布异常。DSR在KSDD2和MVTec异常检测数据集上取得了最先进的结果。在具有挑战性的现实世界KSDD2数据集上的实验表明,DSR显著优于其他无监督表面异常检测方法,在异常检测中将先前最佳方法的AP提高了10%,在异常定位中提高了35%的AP。
abstract_en: The state-of-the-art in discriminative unsupervised surface anomaly detection relies on external datasets for synthesizing anomaly-augmented training images. Such approaches are prone to failure on near-in-distribution anomalies since these are difficult to be synthesized realistically due to their similarity to anomaly-free regions. We propose an architecture based on quantized feature space representation with dual decoders, DSR, that avoids the image-level anomaly synthesis requirement. Without making any assumptions about the visual properties of anomalies, DSR generates the anomalies at the feature level by sampling the learned quantized feature space, which allows a controlled generation of near-in-distribution anomalies. DSR achieves state-of-the-art results on the KSDD2 and MVTec anomaly detection datasets. The experiments on the challenging real-world KSDD2 dataset show that DSR significantly outperforms other unsupervised surface anomaly detection methods, improving the previous top-performing methods by 10% AP in anomaly detection and 35% AP in anomaly localization.

title: Vitor Guizilini, Igor Vasiljevic, Jiading Fang, Rareș Ambruș, Greg Shakhnarovich, Matthew R. Walter, Adrien Gaidon
title_en: Vitor Guizilini, Igor Vasiljevic, Jiading Fang, Rareș Ambruș, Greg Shakhnarovich, Matthew R. Walter, Adrien Gaidon
abstract: 现代三维计算机视觉通过学习提升几何推理能力,将图像数据映射到代价体积或极线约束等经典结构以改进匹配效果。这些架构根据具体问题进行专门设计,因此需要大量任务特定调优,常导致领域泛化性能不佳。近期,通用型Transformer架构通过将几何先验作为输入而非强制约束,在光流和深度估计等任务中取得了显著成果。本文在此基础上提出学习一种隐式的多视角一致场景表示,引入一系列三维数据增强技术作为几何归纳先验以增加视角多样性。我们还证明引入视角合成作为辅助任务可进一步提升深度估计性能。我们的深度场网络(DeFiNe)在立体视觉和视频深度估计任务中无需显式几何约束即达到最先进水平,并在零样本领域泛化方面取得显著提升。
abstract_en: Modern 3D computer vision leverages learning to boost geometric reasoning, mapping image data to classical structures such as cost volumes or epipolar constraints to improve matching. These architectures are specialized according to the particular problem, and thus require significant task-specific tuning, often leading to poor domain generalization performance. Recently, generalist Transformer architectures have achieved impressive results in tasks such as optical flow and depth estimation by encoding geometric priors as inputs rather than as enforced constraints. In this paper, we extend this idea and propose to learn an implicit, multi-view consistent scene representation, introducing a series of 3D data augmentation techniques as a geometric inductive prior to increase view diversity. We also show that introducing view synthesis as an auxiliary task further improves depth estimation. Our Depth Field Networks (DeFiNe) achieve state-of-the-art results in stereo and video depth estimation without explicit geometric constraints, and improve on zero-shot domain generalization by a wide margin.

title: Vladimir Chikin, Kirill Solodskikh, Irina Zhelavskaya
title_en: Vladimir Chikin, Kirill Solodskikh, Irina Zhelavskaya
abstract: 尽管深度神经网络(DNNs)量化能显著降低计算和存储成本,但会降低模型容量,从而通常导致精度下降。解决这一问题的一种可能方法是为不同层使用不同的量化位宽。混合精度方法的主要挑战是定义每层的位宽,同时满足内存和延迟要求。受此挑战启发,我们提出了一种新颖技术,用于显式控制混合精度量化DNNs的复杂度,该技术在包含固定大小神经网络的表面上进行平滑优化。此外,我们引入了一类平滑量化正则化器,可与我们的复杂度控制方法联合使用,适用于后训练混合精度量化和量化感知训练。我们的方法可应用于任何神经网络架构。实验表明,所提出的技术达到了最先进的结果。
abstract_en: While Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) quantization leads to a significant reduction in computational and storage costs, it reduces model capacity and therefore, usually leads to an accuracy drop. One of the possible ways to overcome this issue is to use different quantization bit-widths for different layers. The main challenge of the mixed-precision approach is to define the bit-widths for each layer, while staying under memory and latency requirements. Motivated by this challenge, we introduce a novel technique for explicit complexity control of DNNs quantized to mixed-precision, which uses smooth optimization on the surface containing neural networks of constant size. Furthermore, we introduce a family of smooth quantization regularizers, which can be used jointly with our complexity control method for both post-training mixed-precision quantization and quantization-aware training. Our approach can be applied to any neural network architecture. Experiments show that the proposed techniques reach state-of-the-art results.

title: Vlas Zyrianov, Xiyue Zhu, Shenlong Wang
title_en: Vlas Zyrianov, Xiyue Zhu, Shenlong Wang
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖、有效且可控的生成模型LiDARGen,该模型能够生成逼真的LiDAR点云感知读数。我们的方法利用了强大的得分匹配能量基模型,并将点云生成过程建模为等矩形视角下的随机去噪过程。该模型使我们能够采样出多样且高质量的点云样本,并保证其物理可行性和可控性。我们在具有挑战性的KITTI-360和NuScenes数据集上验证了该方法的有效性。定量和定性结果表明,我们的方法生成的样本比其他生成模型更加逼真。此外,LiDARGen可以在不重新训练的情况下,根据输入条件采样点云。我们证明了所提出的生成模型可以直接用于稠密化LiDAR点云。
abstract_en: We present LiDARGen, a novel, effective, and controllable generative model that produces realistic LiDAR point cloud sensory readings. Our method leverages the powerful score-matching energy-based model and formulates the point cloud generation process as a stochastic denoising process in the equirectangular view. This model allows us to sample diverse and high-quality point cloud samples with guaranteed physical feasibility and controllability. We validate the effectiveness of our method on the challenging KITTI-360 and NuScenes datasets. The quantitative and qualitative results show that our approach produces more realistic samples than other generative models. Furthermore, LiDARGen can sample point clouds conditioned on inputs without retraining. We demonstrate that our proposed generative model could be directly used to densify LiDAR point clouds.

title: Vojtech Panek, Zuzana Kukelova, Torsten Sattler
title_en: Vojtech Panek, Zuzana Kukelova, Torsten Sattler
abstract: 视觉定位,即相机位姿估计问题,是自主机器人和增强现实系统等应用的核心组成部分。文献中占主导地位的方法,已被证明可以扩展到大型场景并处理复杂的光照和季节变化,基于从图像中提取的局部特征。场景表示是一个稀疏的Structure-from-Motion点云,与特定的局部特征相关联。切换到另一种特征类型需要在构建点云时在数据库图像之间进行昂贵的特征匹配步骤。因此,本文探讨了一种更灵活的替代方法,基于密集的3D网格,无需在数据库图像之间进行特征匹配即可构建场景表示。我们证明这种方法可以达到最先进的结果。我们进一步表明,即使在没有神经渲染阶段的情况下,从这些网格的渲染中提取特征,甚至在渲染原始场景几何形状而不使用颜色或纹理的情况下,也能获得令人惊讶的竞争力结果。我们的结果表明,基于密集3D模型的表示方法是现有表示方法的有前途的替代方案,并指出了未来研究的有趣且具有挑战性的方向。
abstract_en: Visual localization, i.e., the problem of camera pose estimation, is a central component of applications such as autonomous robots and augmented reality systems. A dominant approach in the literature, shown to scale to large scenes and to handle complex illumination and seasonal changes, is based on local features extracted from images. The scene representation is a sparse Structure-from-Motion point cloud that is tied to a specific local feature. Switching to another feature type requires an expensive feature matching step between the database images used to construct the point cloud. In this work, we thus explore a more flexible alternative based on dense 3D meshes that does not require features matching between database images to build the scene representation. We show that this approach can achieve state-of-the-art results. We further show that surprisingly competitive results can be obtained when extracting features on renderings of these meshes, without any neural rendering stage, and even when rendering raw scene geometry without color or texture. Our results show that dense 3D model-based representations are a promising alternative to existing representations and point to interesting and challenging directions for future research.

title: Vongani H. Maluleke, Neerja Thakkar, Tim Brooks, Ethan Weber, Trevor Darrell, Alexei A. Efros, Angjoo Kanazawa, Devin Guillory
title_en: Vongani H. Maluleke, Neerja Thakkar, Tim Brooks, Ethan Weber, Trevor Darrell, Alexei A. Efros, Angjoo Kanazawa, Devin Guillory
abstract: 本研究探讨了生成图像模型的性能和评估如何受到训练数据集种族构成的影响。通过分析和控制不同训练数据集中的种族分布,我们观察到不同训练分布对生成图像质量及生成图像种族分布的影响。我们的结果表明,生成图像的种族构成成功保留了训练数据的种族构成。然而,我们观察到截断技术(用于推理阶段生成高质量图像)会加剧数据中的种族不平衡。最后,当我们研究图像质量和种族之间的关系时,发现某一种族的最高感知视觉质量图像来源于该种族在数据集中有良好代表性的分布,并且标注者始终更倾向于生成白人面孔而非黑人面孔。
abstract_en: In this work, we study how the performance and evaluation of generative image models are impacted by the racial composition of the datasets upon which these models are trained. By examining and controlling the racial distributions in various training datasets, we are able to observe the impacts of different training distributions on generated image quality and the racial distributions of the generated images. Our results show that the racial compositions of generated images successfully preserve that of the training data. However, we observe that truncation, a technique used to generate higher quality images during inference, exacerbates racial imbalances in the data. Lastly, when examining the relationship between image quality and race, we find that the highest perceived visual quality images of a given race come from a distribution where that race is well-represented, and that annotators consistently prefer generated white faces over Black faces.

title: Walter Goodwin, Sagar Vaze, Ioannis Havoutis, Ingmar Posner
title_en: Walter Goodwin, Sagar Vaze, Ioannis Havoutis, Ingmar Posner
abstract: Object pose estimation is an important component of most vision pipelines for embodied agents, as well as in 3D vision more generally. In this paper we tackle the problem of estimating the pose of novel object categories in a zero-shot manner. This extends much of the existing literature by removing the need for pose-labelled datasets or category-specific CAD models for training or inference. Specifically, we make the following contributions. First, we formalise the zero-shot, category-level pose estimation problem and frame it in a way that is most applicable to real-world embodied agents. Secondly, we propose a novel method based on semantic correspondences from a self-supervised vision transformer to solve the pose estimation problem. We further re-purpose the recent CO3D dataset to present a controlled and realistic test setting. Finally, we demonstrate that all baselines for our proposed task perform poorly, and show that our method provides a six-fold improvement in average rotation accuracy at 30 degrees. Our code is available at https://github.com/applied-ai-lab/zero-shot-pose.
abstract_en: Object pose estimation is an important component of most vision pipelines for embodied agents, as well as in 3D vision more generally. In this paper we tackle the problem of estimating the pose of novel object categories in a zero-shot manner. This extends much of the existing literature by removing the need for pose-labelled datasets or category-specific CAD models for training or inference. Specifically, we make the following contributions. First, we formalise the zero-shot, category-level pose estimation problem and frame it in a way that is most applicable to real-world embodied agents. Secondly, we propose a novel method based on semantic correspondences from a self-supervised vision transformer to solve the pose estimation problem. We further re-purpose the recent CO3D dataset to present a controlled and realistic test setting. Finally, we demonstrate that all baselines for our proposed task perform poorly, and show that our method provides a six-fold improvement in average rotation accuracy at 30 degrees. Our code is available at https://github.com/applied-ai-lab/zero-shot-pose.

title: Wang Zhao, Shaohui Liu, Hengkai Guo, Wenping Wang, Yong-Jin Liu
title_en: Wang Zhao, Shaohui Liu, Hengkai Guo, Wenping Wang, Yong-Jin Liu
abstract: 从单目视频中估计移动摄像机的姿态是一个具有挑战性的问题,尤其是在动态环境中存在运动物体的情况下,现有摄像机姿态估计方法的性能容易受到几何不一致像素的影响。为了解决这一挑战,我们提出了一种基于密集对应关系的鲁棒密集间接结构从运动方法,该方法通过成对光流初始化的密集对应关系进行优化。我们的核心思想是将长范围视频对应关系优化为密集点轨迹,并利用其学习鲁棒的运动分割估计。我们提出了一种新的神经网络架构,用于处理不规则点轨迹数据。然后,通过全局捆绑调整对被分类为静态的长范围点轨迹部分进行摄像机姿态估计和优化。在MPI Sintel数据集上的实验表明,我们的系统生成的摄像机轨迹显著优于现有最先进的方法。此外,我们的方法能够在完全静态场景中保持合理的摄像机姿态精度,这始终优于基于端到端深度学习的强先进密集对应关系方法,证明了基于光流和点轨迹的密集间接方法的潜力。由于点轨迹表示具有通用性,我们进一步在具有复杂动态物体运动的野外单目视频上展示了结果和比较。代码可在https://github.com/bytedance/particle-sfm获取。
abstract_en: Estimating the pose of a moving camera from monocular video is a challenging problem, especially due to the presence of moving objects in dynamic environments, where the performance of existing camera pose estimation methods are susceptible to pixels that are not geometrically consistent. To tackle this challenge, we present a robust dense indirect structure-from-motion method for videos that is based on dense correspondence initialized from pairwise optical flow. Our key idea is to optimize long range video correspondence as dense point trajectories and use it to learn robust estimation of motion segmentation. A novel neural network architecture is proposed for processing irregular point trajectory data. Camera poses are then estimated and optimized with global bundle adjustment over the portion of long-range point trajectories that are classified as static. Experiments on MPI Sintel dataset show that our system produces significantly more accurate camera trajectories compared to existing state-of-the-art methods. In addition, our method is able to retain reasonable accuracy of camera poses on fully static scenes, which consistently outperforms strong state-of-the-art dense correspondence based methods with end-to-end deep learning, demonstrating the potential of dense indirect methods based on optical flow and point trajectories. As the point trajectory representation is general, we further present results and comparisons on in-the-wild monocular videos with complex motion of dynamic objects. Code is available at https://github.com/bytedance/particle-sfm.

title: Wangmeng Xiang, Chao Li, Biao Wang, Xihan Wei, Xian-Sheng Hua, Lei Zhang
title_en: Wangmeng Xiang, Chao Li, Biao Wang, Xihan Wei, Xian-Sheng Hua, Lei Zhang
abstract: 基于Transformer的方法在基于二维图像的视觉任务中取得了显著进展。然而,对于基于3D视频的任务(如动作识别),直接将时空变换器应用于视频数据会因补丁数量大幅增加和自注意力计算的二次复杂度而带来沉重的计算和内存负担。如何高效且有效地建模视频数据的3D自注意力机制已成为Transformer领域的一大挑战。本文提出了一种时间补丁位移(Temporal Patch Shift, TPS)方法,用于在视频动作识别中高效建模3D自注意力机制。TPS在时间维度上以特定马赛克模式位移部分补丁,从而将普通的空间自注意力操作转换为具有微小额外开销的时空自注意力操作。因此,我们可以在与二维自注意力几乎相同的计算和内存成本下计算3D自注意力。TPS是一个即插即用模块,可插入现有二维Transformer模型中以增强时空特征学习。所提方法在Something-something V1 & V2、Diving-48和Kinetics400数据集上取得了与SOTA相当的性能,同时在计算和内存成本上显著更高效。TPS的源代码可在https://github.com/MartinXM/TPS获取。
abstract_en: Transformer-based methods have recently achieved great advancement on 2D image-based vision tasks. For 3D video-based tasks such as action recognition, however, directly applying spatiotemporal transformers on video data will bring heavy computation and memory burdens due to the largely increased number of patches and the quadratic complexity of self-attention computation. How to efficiently and effectively model the 3D self-attention of video data has been a great challenge for transformers. In this paper, we propose a Temporal Patch Shift (TPS) method for efficient 3D self-attention modeling in transformers for video-based action recognition. TPS shifts part of patches with a specific mosaic pattern in the temporal dimension, thus converting a vanilla spatial self-attention operation to a spatiotemporal one with little additional cost. As a result, we can compute 3D self-attention using nearly the same computation and memory cost as 2D self-attention. TPS is a plug-and-play module and can be inserted into existing 2D transformer models to enhance spatiotemporal feature learning. The proposed method achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-arts on Something-something V1 \& V2, Diving-48, and Kinetics400 while being much more efficient on computation and memory cost. The source code of TPS can be found at https://github.com/MartinXM/TPS.

title: Wanhua Li, Zhexuan Cao, Jianjiang Feng, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu
title_en: Wanhua Li, Zhexuan Cao, Jianjiang Feng, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu
abstract: 物体通常与多个属性相关联,而这些属性往往表现出高度相关性。建模属性间的复杂关系对多属性学习提出了巨大挑战。本文提出了一种简单且通用的框架,名为Label2Label,用于挖掘复杂的属性相关性。Label2Label是首个从语言建模视角进行多属性预测的尝试。具体而言,它将每个属性标签视为描述样本的"词"。由于每个样本被标注有多个属性标签,这些"词"会自然形成一个无序但有意义的"句子",从而描述对应样本的语义信息。受自然语言处理中预训练语言模型显著成功的启发,Label2Label引入了一个图像条件掩码语言模型,该模型会随机掩码标签"句子"中的部分"词"标记,并旨在基于掩码后的"句子"和图像特征传递的上下文信息恢复这些被掩码的"词"。我们的直觉是,如果神经网络能够基于上下文和剩余属性提示推断缺失属性,那么实例级的属性关系将被良好把握。Label2Label在概念上简单且在实践中表现出色。无需引入任务特定的先验知识和高度专门化的网络设计,我们的方法在三个不同的多属性学习任务上均优于高度定制化的领域特定方法,达到了最先进水平。代码可在https://github.com/Li-Wanhua/Label2Label获取。
abstract_en: Objects are usually associated with multiple attributes, and these attributes often exhibit high correlations. Modeling complex relationships between attributes poses a great challenge for multi-attribute learning. This paper proposes a simple yet generic framework named Label2Label to exploit the complex attribute correlations. Label2Label is the first attempt for multi-attribute prediction from the perspective of language modeling. Specifically, it treats each attribute label as a ""word"" describing the sample. As each sample is annotated with multiple attribute labels, these ""words"" will naturally form an unordered but meaningful ""sentence"", which depicts the semantic information of the corresponding sample. Inspired by the remarkable success of pre-training language models in NLP, Label2Label introduces an image-conditioned masked language model, which randomly masks some of the ""word"" tokens from the label ""sentence"" and aims to recover them based on the masked ""sentence"" and the context conveyed by image features. Our intuition is that the instance-wise attribute relations are well grasped if the neural net can infer the missing attributes based on the context and the remaining attribute hints. Label2Label is conceptually simple and empirically powerful. Without incorporating task-specific prior knowledge and highly specialized network designs, our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on three different multi-attribute learning tasks, compared to highly customized domain-specific methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Li-Wanhua/Label2Label.

title: 陈万利,朱星杰,陈国金,余贝
title_en: Wanli Chen, Xinge Zhu, Guojin Chen, Bei Yu
abstract: 先前分析点云的最先进研究主要依赖于体素化量化,因为它能更好地保持空间局部性和几何信息。然而,这些3D体素化方法及其后续的3D卷积网络往往带来较大的计算开销和GPU占用。一种直接的替代方案是将3D体素化展平为2D结构或利用支柱表示法进行维度降低,但所有这些方法都会不可避免地改变空间局部性和3D几何信息。为此,我们提出HilbertNet,在保持基于体素方法的局部性优势的同时显著降低计算成本。其中关键组件是一种基于希尔伯特曲线的新展平机制,这是一种著名的局部性和几何信息保持函数。即,如果使用希尔伯特曲线编码展平3D体素,所得结构将与原始体素具有相似的空间拓扑结构。通过希尔伯特展平,我们不仅能够使用二维卷积(比三维卷积更轻量)处理体素,还能引入适合二维空间的技术(如Transformer)以提升性能。我们的HilbertNet在ShapeNet和ModelNet40数据集上实现了更小成本和GPU占用下的最先进性能。
abstract_en: Previous state-of-the-art research on analyzing point cloud mainly rely on the voxelization quantization because it keeps the better spatial locality and geometry. However, these 3D voxelization methods and subsequent 3D convolution networks often bring the large computational overhead and GPU occupation. A straightforward alternative is to flatten 3D voxelization into 2D structure or utilize the pillar representation to perform the dimension reduction, while all of them would inevitably alter the spatial locality and 3D geometric information. In this way, we propose the HilbertNet to maintain the locality advantage of voxel-based methods while significantly reducing the computational cost. Here the key component is a new flattening mechanism based on Hilbert curve, which is a famous locality and geometry preserving function. Namely, if flattening 3D voxels using Hilbert curve encoding, the resulting structure will have similar spatial topology compared with original voxels. Through the Hilbert flattening, we can not only use 2D convolution (more lightweight than 3D convolution) to process voxels, but also incorporate technologies suitable in 2D space, such as transformer, to boost the performance. Our proposed HilbertNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on ShapeNet and ModelNet40 datasets with smaller cost and GPU occupation.

title: Wanyi Zhuang, Qi Chu, Zhentao Tan, Qiankun Liu, Haojie Yuan, Changtao Miao, Zixiang Luo, Nenghai Yu
title_en: Wanyi Zhuang, Qi Chu, Zhentao Tan, Qiankun Liu, Haojie Yuan, Changtao Miao, Zixiang Luo, Nenghai Yu
abstract: 帧内不一致性已被证明对人脸伪造检测的泛化能力具有有效性。然而,学习关注这些不一致性需要额外的像素级伪造位置标注。获取此类标注并非易事。一些现有方法通过生成带有位置标注的大规模合成数据,但此过程耗时费力。其他方法通过减去配对的真实与伪造图像生成伪造位置标签,但此类配对数据难以收集,生成的标签通常不连续。为克服这些局限性,我们提出了一种基于视觉Transformer的无监督不一致性感知方法,称为UIA-ViT。得益于自注意力机制,补丁嵌入之间的注意力图自然地表示一致性关系,使视觉Transformer适用于一致性表征学习。具体而言,我们提出两个关键组件:无监督补丁一致性学习(UPCL)和渐进一致性加权组装(PCWA)。UPCL旨在通过从多元高斯估计中导出的渐进优化伪标注学习与一致性相关的表征。PCWA通过UPCL优化的先前补丁嵌入增强最终分类嵌入,进一步提升检测性能。大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Intra-frame inconsistency has been proved to be effective for the generalization of face forgery detection. However, learning to focus on these inconsistency requires extra pixel-level forged location annotations. Acquiring such annotations is non-trivial. Some existing methods generate large-scale synthesized data with location annotations, which is time-consuming. Others generate forgery location labels by subtracting paired real and fake images, yet such paired data is difficult to collected and the generated label is usually discontinuous. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel Unsupervised Inconsistency-Aware method based on Vision Transformer, called UIA-ViT. Thanks to the self-attention mechanism, the attention map among patch embeddings naturally represents the consistency relation, making the vision Transformer suitable for the consistency representation learning. Specifically, we propose two key components: Unsupervised Patch Consistency Learning (UPCL) and Progressive Consistency Weighted Assemble (PCWA). UPCL is designed for learning the consistency-related representation with progressive optimized pseudo annotations that are derived from multivariate Gaussian estimation. PCWA enhances the final classification embedding with previous patch embeddings optimized by UPCL to further improve the detection performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

title: Wei He, Quanming Yao, Naoto Yokoya, Tatsumi Uezato, Hongyan Zhang, Liangpei Zhang
title_en: Wei He, Quanming Yao, Naoto Yokoya, Tatsumi Uezato, Hongyan Zhang, Liangpei Zhang
abstract: 卷积神经网络已被广泛应用于高光谱图像(HSI)修复。然而,充分利用高光谱图像的空谱信息仍是一个挑战。在本工作中,我们将3D卷积分解为轻量级的2D空间和光谱卷积,并构建了一个面向光谱信息的搜索空间用于HSI修复。随后,我们利用神经架构搜索策略,自动学习包含合适卷积和连接的最有效架构,以充分挖掘空谱信息。我们还确定具有全局和局部跳连的超网络可以进一步提升HSI修复性能。在CAVE数据集上搜索得到的架构已被应用于多种数据集去噪和成像重建任务,并取得了显著效果。基于丰富的实验,我们得出结论:搜索得到的架构的可迁移性依赖于光谱信息,而与噪声水平无关。
abstract_en: Convolutional neural networks have been widely developed for hyperspectral image (HSI) restoration. However, making full use of the spatial-spectral information of HSIs still remains a challenge. In this work, we disentangle the 3D convolution into lightweight 2D spatial and spectral convolutions, and build a spectrum-aware search space for HSI restoration. Subsequently, we utilize neural architecture search strategy to automatically learn the most efficient architecture with proper convolutions and connections in order to fully exploit the spatial-spectral information. We also determine that the super-net with global and local skip connections can further boost HSI restoration performance.
