abstract: 自动图像上色是一项具有挑战性的任务,吸引了大量研究兴趣。先前基于深度神经网络的方法取得了令人印象深刻的结果。然而,这些上色图像仍然不尽如人意,距离实际应用还有很大差距。其原因是现有方法忽略了语义一致性和色彩丰富性这两个关键要素。在本工作中,我们提出了一种通过颜色记忆辅助的混合注意力Transformer实现的自动图像上色方法,即ColorFormer。我们的网络包含基于Transformer的编码器和颜色记忆解码器。编码器的核心模块是我们的提出的全局-局部混合注意力操作,该操作提升了捕捉全局感受野依赖关系的能力。凭借对不同场景下灰度图像上下文语义信息的强大建模能力,我们的网络可以生成语义一致的上色结果。在解码器部分,我们设计了一个颜色记忆模块,用于存储针对图像自适应查询的各种语义-颜色映射。查询到的颜色先验被用作参考,帮助解码器生成更加生动和多样的结果。实验结果表明,与最先进的方法相比,我们的方法能够生成更加真实且语义匹配的颜色图像。此外,由于提出的端到端架构,推理速度在V100 GPU上达到40FPS,满足实时需求。
abstract_en: Automatic image colorization is a challenging task that attracts a lot of research interest. Previous methods employing deep neural networks have produced impressive results. However, these colorization images are still unsatisfactory and far from practical applications. The reason is that semantic consistency and color richness are two key elements ignored by existing methods. In this work, we propose an automatic image colorization method via color memory assisted hybrid-attention transformer, namely ColorFormer. Our network consists of a transformer-based encoder and a color memory decoder. The core module of the encoder is our proposed global-local hybrid attention operation, which improves the ability to capture global receptive field dependencies. With the strong power to model contextual semantic information of grayscale image in different scenes, our network can produce semantic-consistent colorization results. In decoder part, we design a color memory module which stores various semantic-color mapping for image-adaptive queries. The queried color priors are used as reference to help the decoder produce more vivid and diverse results. Experimental results show that our method can generate more realistic and semantically matched color images compared with state-of-the-art methods. Moreover, owing to the proposed end-to-end architecture, the inference speed reaches 40FPS on a V100 GPU, which meets the real-time requirement.

title: Xin Dong, Sai Qian Zhang, Ang Li, H.T. Kung
title_en: Xin Dong, Sai Qian Zhang, Ang Li, H.T. Kung
abstract: 联邦学习旨在从多个分布式设备(即客户端)中训练全局模型,而无需交换其私有本地数据。一个关键挑战是处理多个客户端之间非独立同分布(non-i.i.d.)数据,这可能导致其本地特征差异。我们引入超球面联邦学习(SphereFed)框架,通过将数据点的学习表示约束在客户端共享的单位超球面上,以解决非独立同分布问题。具体而言,所有客户端通过最小化固定分类器的损失来学习其本地表示,该分类器的权重跨度单位超球面。在联邦训练提升全局模型后,该分类器进一步通过最小化均方误差的闭式解进行校准。我们证明校准解可高效且分布式地计算,无需直接访问本地数据。大量实验表明,我们的SphereFed方法能够显著提升多种现有联邦学习算法的准确性(在挑战性数据集上最高提升6%),同时增强跨数据集和模型架构的计算与通信效率。
abstract_en: Federated Learning aims at training a global model from multiple decentralized devices (i.e. clients) without exchanging their private local data. A key challenge is the handling of non-i.i.d. (independent identically distributed) data across multiple clients that may induce disparities of their local features. We introduce the Hyperspherical Federated Learning (SphereFed) framework to address the non-i.i.d. issue by constraining learned representations of data points to be on a unit hypersphere shared by clients. Specifically, all clients learn their local representations by minimizing the loss with respect to a fixed classifier whose weights span the unit hypersphere. After federated training in improving the global model, this classifier is further calibrated with a closed-form solution by minimizing a mean squared loss. We show that the calibration solution can be computed efficiently and distributedly without direct access of local data. Extensive experiments indicate that our SphereFed approach is able to improve the accuracy of multiple existing federated learning algorithms by a considerable margin (up to 6% on challenging datasets) with enhanced computation and communication efficiency across datasets and model architectures.

title: Xin Lai, Zhuotao Tian, Xiaogang Xu, Yingcong Chen, Shu Liu, Hengshuang Zhao, Liwei Wang, Jiaya Jia
title_en: Xin Lai, Zhuotao Tian, Xiaogang Xu, Yingcong Chen, Shu Liu, Hengshuang Zhao, Liwei Wang, Jiaya Jia
abstract: 无监督域适应在语义分割中减轻了对昂贵像素级标注的依赖。它利用带标签的源域数据集以及未标记的目标域图像来学习分割网络。本文观察到现有域不变学习框架的两个主要问题:(1) 网络被特征分布对齐所干扰,无法专注于分割任务;(2) 源域数据拟合良好可能会损害目标域性能。为解决这些问题,我们提出解耦网络(DecoupleNet)以缓解源域过拟合,并使最终模型更专注于分割任务。同时,我们提出自判别(Self-Discrimination, SD)并引入辅助分类器,利用伪标签学习更具判别性的目标域特征。最后,我们提出在线增强自训练(Online Enhanced Self-Training, OEST)以在线方式提升伪标签的质量。实验表明我们的方法优于现有最先进的方法。广泛的消融研究验证了每个组件的有效性。代码可在https://github.com/dvlab-research/DecoupleNet获取。
abstract_en: Unsupervised domain adaptation in semantic segmentation alleviates the reliance on expensive pixel-wise annotation. It uses a labeled source domain dataset as well as unlabeled target domain images to learn a segmentation network. In this paper, we observe two main issues of existing domain-invariant learning framework. (1) Being distracted by the feature distribution alignment, the network cannot focus on the segmentation task. (2) Fitting source domain data well would compromise the target domain performance. To address these issues, we propose DecoupleNet to alleviate source domain overfitting and let the final model focus more on the segmentation task. Also, we put forward Self-Discrimination (SD) and introduce an auxiliary classifier to learn more discriminative target domain features with pseudo labels. Finally, we propose Online Enhanced Self-Training (OEST) to contextually enhance the quality of pseudo labels in an online manner. Experiments show our method outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. Extensive ablation studies verify the effectiveness of each component. Code is available at https://github.com/dvlab-research/DecoupleNet.

title: Xin Li, Botian Shi, Yuenan Hou, Xingjiao Wu, Tianlong Ma, Yikang Li, Liang He
title_en: Xin Li, Botian Shi, Yuenan Hou, Xingjiao Wu, Tianlong Ma, Yikang Li, Liang He
abstract: 多模态三维目标检测在自动驾驶领域一直是活跃的研究课题。然而,探索稀疏三维点云与密集二维像素之间的跨模态特征融合仍具有挑战性。现有方法要么将图像特征与投影到二维图像平面的点云特征进行融合,要么将稀疏点云与密集图像像素进行结合。这些融合方法往往导致严重的信息损失,从而导致性能不理想。为了解决这些问题,我们构建了点云与图像之间的同构结构,通过将相机特征转换到激光雷达三维空间,以避免投影信息损失。本文提出了一种同构多模态特征融合与交互方法(HMFI)用于三维目标检测。具体而言,我们首先设计了一个图像体素提升模块(IVLM),将二维图像特征提升到三维空间并生成同构图像体素特征。接着,我们通过引入基于自注意力的查询融合机制(QFM),将体素化点云特征与不同区域的图像特征进行融合。随后,我们提出了一种体素特征交互模块(VFIM),以强制同构点云和图像体素表示中相同物体的语义信息一致性,这可以为跨模态特征融合提供物体级对齐指导,并增强复杂背景下的判别能力。我们在KITTI和Waymo Open Dataset上进行了大量实验,所提出的HMFI方法在性能上优于现有的多模态方法。特别是在KITTI基准上的骑行者三维检测任务中,HMFI方法大幅超越了所有已发表的算法。
abstract_en: Multi-modal 3D object detection has been an active research topic in autonomous driving. Nevertheless, it is non-trivial to explore the cross-modal feature fusion between sparse 3D points and dense 2D pixels. Recent approaches either fuse the image features with the point cloud features that are projected onto the 2D image plane or combine the sparse point cloud with dense image pixels. These fusion approaches often suffer from severe information loss, thus causing sub-optimal performance. To address these problems, we construct the homogeneous structure between the point cloud and images to avoid projective information loss by transforming the camera features into the LiDAR 3D space. In this paper, we propose a homogeneous multi-modal feature fusion and interaction method (HMFI) for 3D object detection. Specifically, we first design an image voxel lifter module (IVLM) to lift 2D image features into the 3D space and generate homogeneous image voxel features. Then, we fuse the voxelized point cloud features with the image features from different regions by introducing the self-attention based query fusion mechanism (QFM). Next, we propose a voxel feature interaction module (VFIM) to enforce the consistency of semantic information from identical objects in the homogeneous point cloud and image voxel representations, which can provide object-level alignment guidance for cross-modal feature fusion and strengthen the discriminative ability in complex backgrounds. We conduct extensive experiments on the KITTI and Waymo Open Dataset, and the proposed HMFI achieves better performance compared with the state-of-the-art multi-modal methods. Particularly, for the 3D detection of cyclist on the KITTI benchmark, HMFI surpasses all the published algorithms by a large margin.

title: , <中文标题>,
title_en: Xin Liu, Xiaofei Shao, Bo Wang, Yali Li, Shengjin Wang
abstract: , <中文摘要>,
abstract_en: Image guided depth completion aims to recover per-pixel dense depth maps from sparse depth measurements with the help of aligned color images, which has a wide range of applications from robotics to autonomous driving. However, the 3D nature of sparse-to-dense depth completion has not been fully explored by previous methods. In this work, we propose a Graph Convolution based Spatial Propagation Network (GraphCSPN) as a general approach for depth completion. First, unlike previous methods, we leverage convolution neural networks as well as graph neural networks in a complementary way for geometric representation learning. In addition, the proposed networks explicitly incorporate learnable geometric constraints to regularize the propagation process performed in three-dimensional space rather than in two-dimensional plane. Furthermore, we construct the graph utilizing sequences of feature patches, and update it dynamically with an edge attention module during propagation, so as to better capture both the local neighboring features and global relationships over long distance. Extensive experiments on both indoor NYU-Depth-v2 and outdoor KITTI datasets demonstrate that our method achieves the state-of-the-art performance, especially when compared in the case of using only a few propagation steps. Code and models are available at the project page.

title: Xin Wu, Hao Zhao, Shunkai Li, Yingdian Cao, Hongbin Zha
title_en: Xin Wu, Hao Zhao, Shunkai Li, Yingdian Cao, Hongbin Zha
abstract: 视觉重定位旨在恢复已知环境中的相机位姿,这对于机器人或增强现实等应用至关重要。前馈绝对相机位姿回归方法通过网络直接输出位姿,但存在精度低的问题。同时,基于场景坐标的算法虽然精度较高,但需要迭代RANSAC后处理,这给高效端到端训练和推理带来了挑战。为了兼顾两者优势,我们提出了一种前馈方法SC-wLS,通过加权最小二乘位姿回归利用所有场景坐标估计。该可微分公式在2D-3D对应关系上施加权重网络,仅需位姿监督。定性结果展示了学习到的权重的可解释性。在7Scenes和Cambridge数据集上的评估表明,与先前前馈方法相比性能显著提升。此外,我们的SC-wLS方法实现了新能力:在权重网络上实现自监督测试时适应。代码和模型已公开。
abstract_en: Visual re-localization aims to recover camera poses in a known environment, which is vital for applications like robotics or augmented reality. Feed-forward absolute camera pose regression methods directly output poses by a network, but suffer from low accuracy. Meanwhile, scene coordinate based methods are accurate, but need iterative RANSAC post-processing, which brings challenges to efficient end-to-end training and inference. In order to have the best of both worlds, we propose a feed-forward method termed SC-wLS that exploits all scene coordinate estimates for weighted least squares pose regression. This differentiable formulation exploits a weight network imposed on 2D-3D correspondences, and requires pose supervision only. Qualitative results demonstrate the interpretability of learned weights. Evaluations on 7Scenes and Cambridge datasets show significantly promoted performance when compared with former feed-forward counterparts. Moreover, our SC-wLS method enables a new capability: self-supervised test-time adaptation on the weight network. Codes and models are publicly available.

title: Xin Yu, Peng Dai, Wenbo Li, Lan Ma, Jiajun Shen, Jia Li, Xiaojuan Qi
title_en: Xin Yu, Peng Dai, Wenbo Li, Lan Ma, Jiajun Shen, Jia Li, Xiaojuan Qi
abstract: 随着移动设备的快速发展,现代广泛使用的智能手机通常允许用户拍摄4K分辨率(即超高清)图像。然而,在低级视觉领域具有挑战性的图像去摩尔纹任务中,现有研究大多在低分辨率或合成图像上进行。因此,这些方法在4K分辨率图像上的有效性仍不明确。本文探索超高清图像的摩尔纹去除方法。为此,我们提出了首个超高清去摩尔纹数据集(UHDM),其中包含5000对真实场景的4K分辨率图像,并对当前最先进的方法进行了基准研究。进一步地,我们提出了一种高效的基线模型ESDNet,用于处理4K摩尔纹图像,其中我们构建了语义对齐的尺度感知模块以应对摩尔纹图案的尺度变化。大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性,该方法在保持更轻量级的同时显著优于现有最先进的方法。代码和数据集可在https://xinyu-andy.github.io/uhdm-page获取。
abstract_en: With the rapid development of mobile devices, modern widely-used mobile phones typically allow users to capture 4K resolution (i.e., ultra-high-definition) images. However, for image demoiréing, a challenging task in low-level vision, existing works are generally carried out on low-resolution or synthetic images. Hence, the effectiveness of these methods on 4K resolution images is still unknown. In this paper, we explore moiré pattern removal for ultra-high-definition images. To this end, we propose the first ultra-high-definition demoiréing dataset (UHDM), which contains 5,000 real-world 4K resolution image pairs, and conduct a benchmark study on current state-of-the-art methods. Further, we present an efficient baseline model ESDNet for tackling 4K moiré images, wherein we build a semantic-aligned scale-aware module to address the scale variation of moiré patterns. Extensive experiments manifest the effectiveness of our approach, which outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin while being much more lightweight. Code and dataset are available at https://xinyu-andy.github.io/uhdm-page.

title: 张欣东,曾慧,郭世,张磊
title_en: Xindong Zhang, Hui Zeng, Shi Guo, Lei Zhang
abstract: 近年来,基于Transformer的方法在各种视觉任务中表现出色,包括图像超分辨率(SR),通过利用自注意力(SA)进行特征提取。然而,现有基于Transformer模型中SA的计算成本非常高,而一些操作可能对SR任务是冗余的。这限制了SA计算的范围,从而限制了SR性能。在本文中,我们提出了一种高效的长距离注意力网络(ELAN)用于图像SR。具体而言,我们首先采用移位卷积(shift-conv)有效提取图像局部结构信息,同时保持与1x1卷积相同的复杂度水平,然后提出了一种分组多尺度自注意力(GMSA)模块,该模块通过不同窗口大小在非重叠特征组上计算SA,以利用图像的长距离依赖关系。通过简单地将两个移位卷积与GMSA模块级联,构建了一个高效的长距离注意力块(ELAB),并通过共享注意力机制进一步加速。无需复杂设计,我们的ELAN通过依次级联ELAB实现了相对简单的结构。大量实验表明,ELAN在复杂度显著降低的情况下,甚至比基于Transformer的SR模型取得了更好的结果。ELAN的源代码可在https://github.com/xindongzhang/ELAN找到。
abstract_en: Recently, transformer-based methods have demonstrated impressive results in various vision tasks, including image super-resolution (SR), by exploiting the self attention (SA) for feature extraction. However, the computation of SA in most existing transformer based models is very expensive, while some employed operations may be redundant for the SR task. This limits the range of SA computation and consequently limits the SR performance. In this work, we propose an efficient long-range attention network (ELAN) for image SR. Specifically, we first employ shift convolution (shift-conv) to effectively extract the image local structural information while maintaining the same level of complexity as 1x1 convolution, then propose a group-wise multi-scale self-attention (GMSA) module, which calculates SA on non-overlapped groups of features using different window sizes to exploit the long-range image dependency. A highly efficient long-range attention block (ELAB) is then built by simply cascading two shift-conv with a GMSA module, which is further accelerated by using a shared attention mechanism. Without bells and whistles, our ELAN follows a fairly simple design by sequentially cascading the ELABs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ELAN obtains even better results against the transformer-based SR models but with significantly less complexity. The source codes of ELAN can be found at https://github.com/xindongzhang/ELAN.

title: Xingjian Zhen, Zihang Meng, Rudrasis Chakraborty, Vikas Singh
title_en: Xingjian Zhen, Zihang Meng, Rudrasis Chakraborty, Vikas Singh
abstract: 比较神经网络模型的功能行为,无论是单个网络随时间的变化,还是训练期间或训练后两个(或多个)网络之间的比较,是理解它们在学习什么(以及没有学习什么)的关键步骤,并且对于识别正则化策略或效率改进策略至关重要。尽管近年来取得了进展,例如比较视觉变换器与卷积神经网络,但对功能的系统比较,尤其是在不同网络之间,仍然具有挑战性,通常逐层进行。诸如典型相关分析(CCA)等方法原则上适用,但迄今为止使用较少。在本文中,我们重新审视了一种(较少为人知的)统计方法,称为距离相关性(及其部分变体),旨在评估不同维度特征空间之间的相关性。我们描述了在大规模模型中部署该方法所需的步骤——这为一系列应用打开了大门,从根据另一个深度模型进行条件化,学习解耦表示,以及优化直接更具对抗性攻击鲁棒性的多样化模型。我们的实验表明,这是一种多功能的正则化器(或约束),具有许多优势,可以避免此类分析中常见的某些困难。
abstract_en: Comparing the functional behavior of neural network models, whether it is a single network over time or two (or more networks) during or post-training, is an essential step in understanding what they are learning (and what they are not), and for identifying strategies for regularization or efficiency improvements. Despite recent progress, e.g., comparing vision transformers to CNNs, systematic comparison of function, especially across different networks, remains difficult and is often carried out layer by layer. Approaches such as canonical correlation analysis (CCA) are applicable in principle, but have been sparingly used so far. In this paper, we revisit a (less widely known) from statistics, called distance correlation (and its partial variant), designed to evaluate correlation between feature spaces of different dimensions. We describe the steps necessary to carry out its deployment for large scale models -- this opens the door to a surprising array of applications ranging from conditioning one deep model w.r.t. another, learning disentangled representations as well as optimizing diverse models that would directly be more robust to adversarial attacks. Our experiments suggest a versatile regularizer (or constraint) with many advantages, which avoids some of the common difficulties one faces in such analyses.

title: Xingping Dong, Jianbing Shen, Ling Shao
title_en: Xingping Dong, Jianbing Shen, Ling Shao
abstract: 无监督元学习的开创性工作是一种基于聚类的伪标签方法,该方法模型无关且能够利用监督算法从无标签数据中进行学习。然而,这种方法常常面临标签不一致性和多样性有限的问题,导致性能不佳。在本工作中,我们证明了这一问题的核心原因在于嵌入空间缺乏聚类友好性。通过全面的实验验证,我们通过最小化类间与类内相似度比值来突破这一限制,从而提供聚类友好的嵌入特征。令人惊讶的是,我们仅在嵌入空间中使用简单的聚类算法(k-means)获取伪标签,便实现了显著的性能提升。此外,我们采用渐进式评估机制以获取更多样化的样本,进一步缓解多样性有限的问题。此外,我们的方法是模型无关的,可以轻松集成到现有监督方法中。为验证其泛化能力,我们将该方法集成到两个代表性算法:MAML和EP中。在三个主要的少样本基准测试中,结果清楚地表明,所提出的方法相比现有最先进的模型取得了显著提升。值得注意的是,我们的方法在两项任务中均优于相应的监督方法。
abstract_en: The pioneering unsupervised meta-learning work is a clustering-based pseudo-labeling method, which is model-agnostic and can utilize supervised algorithms for learning from unlabeled data. However, it often suffers from label inconsistency and limited diversity, which leads to poor performance. In this work, we prove that the core reason for this comes from the lack of a clustering-friendly property in the embedding space. Through comprehensive experimental validations, we break this restriction by minimizing the inter-class to intra-class similarity ratio to provide clustering-friendly embedding features. Surprisingly, we only utilize a simple clustering algorithm (k-means) on our embedding space to obtain pseudo-labels and achieve significant improvement. Moreover, we adopt a progressive evaluation mechanism to seek more diverse samples in order to further alleviate the limited diversity problem. Besides, our approach is model-agnostic and can easily be integrated into existing supervised methods. To demonstrate its generalization ability, we integrate it into two representative algorithms: MAML and EP. The results on three major few-shot benchmarks clearly show that the proposed method achieves significant improvement compared to the state-of-the-art models. Notably, our approach outperforms the corresponding supervised method in two tasks.

title: Xingrun Xing, Yangguang Li, Wei Li, Wenrui Ding, Yalong Jiang, Yufeng Wang, Jing Shao, Chunlei Liu, Xianglong Liu
title_en: Xingrun Xing, Yangguang Li, Wei Li, Wenrui Ding, Yalong Jiang, Yufeng Wang, Jing Shao, Chunlei Liu, Xianglong Liu
abstract: 现有的二值神经网络(BNNs)主要依赖局部卷积与二值化函数进行操作。然而,这种简单的位运算缺乏对上下文依赖关系的建模能力,而这种能力对于视觉模型中学习判别性深度表示至关重要。在本工作中,我们通过提出新的二值神经模块设计来解决这一问题,使BNNs能够学习有效的上下文依赖关系。首先,我们提出了一种二值多层感知机(MLP)块,作为二值卷积块的替代方案,直接建模上下文依赖关系。二值MLP同时建模了短距离和长距离特征依赖关系,其中前者提供局部归纳偏差,后者突破二值卷积的有限感受野。通过长-短距离二值MLP块实现了稀疏的上下文交互。其次,为提高具有上下文依赖关系的二值模型的鲁棒性,我们计算上下文动态嵌入以确定通用二值卷积块中的二值化阈值。借助我们的二值MLP块和改进的二值卷积,我们构建了具有显式上下文依赖建模的BNNs,称为BCDNet。在标准ImageNet-1K分类基准测试中,BCDNet取得了72.3%的Top-1准确率,并显著优于领先的二值方法。特别是,所提出的BCDNet在操作量相近的情况下,Top-1准确率比最先进的ReActNet-A高出2.9%。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Sense-GVT/BCDNet获取。
abstract_en: Existing Binary Neural Networks (BNNs) mainly operate on local convolutions with binarization function. However, such simple bit operations lack the ability of modeling contextual dependencies, which is critical for learning discriminative deep representations in vision models. In this work, we tackle this issue by presenting new designs of binary neural modules, which enables BNNs to learn effective contextual dependencies. First, we propose a binary multi-layer perceptron (MLP) block as an alternative to binary convolution blocks to directly model contextual dependencies. Both short-range and long-range feature dependencies are modeled by binary MLPs, where the former provides local inductive bias and the latter breaks limited receptive field in binary convolutions. A sparse contextual interaction is achieved with the long-short range binary MLP block. Second, to improve the robustness of binary models with contextual dependencies, we compute the contextual dynamic embeddings to determine the binarization thresholds in general binary convolutional blocks. Armed with our binary MLP blocks and improved binary convolution, we build the BNNs with explicit Contextual Dependency modeling, termed as BCDNet. On the standard ImageNet-1K classification benchmark, the BCDNet achieves 72.3% Top-1 accuracy and outperforms leading binary methods by a large margin. In particular, the proposed BCDNet exceeds the state-of-the-art ReActNet-A by 2.9% Top-1 accuracy with similar operations. Our codes is available at https://github.com/Sense-GVT/BCDNet.

title: 知识分解(KF):一种新颖的知识迁移任务探索
title_en: Xingyi Yang, Jingwen Ye, Xinchao Wang
abstract: 本文探索了一种新颖且雄心勃勃的知识迁移任务,称为知识分解(KF)。KF的核心思想在于知识的模块化与可组装性:给定一个预训练网络模型作为输入,KF旨在将其分解为若干因子网络,每个因子网络仅处理特定任务并维护从源网络中分解出的任务特定知识。这些因子网络在任务层面实现解耦,可直接组装(无需微调)生成更强大的多任务网络。换句话说,因子网络作为乐高积木般的构建模块,使我们能够以即插即用的方式构建定制化网络。具体而言,每个因子网络包含两个模块:一个任务无关的公共知识模块,被所有因子网络共享;以及一个专门针对该因子网络的任务特定模块。我们引入信息论目标InfoMax-Bottleneck(IMB),通过优化学习表示与输入之间的互信息来实现KF。在多个基准测试中,实验表明,所得到的因子网络不仅在专用任务上表现出色,且在解耦性方面也取得令人满意的结果,同时具备更好的可解释性和模块化特性。此外,学习到的公共知识表示在迁移学习任务中展现出显著效果。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Adamdad/KnowledgeFactor获取。
abstract_en: In this paper, we explore a novel and ambitious knowledge-transfer task, termed Knowledge Factorization (KF). The core idea of KF lies in the modularization and assemblability of knowledge: given a pretrained network model as input, KF aims to decompose it into several factor networks, each of which handles only a dedicated task and maintains task-specific knowledge factorized from the source network. Such factor networks are task-wise disentangled and can be directly assembled, without any fine-tuning, to produce the more competent combined-task networks. In other words, the factor networks serve as Lego-brick-like building blocks, allowing us to construct customized networks in a plug-and-play manner. Specifically, each factor network comprises two modules, a common-knowledge module that is task-agnostic and shared by all factor networks, alongside with a task-specific module dedicated to the factor network itself. We introduce an information-theoretic objective, InfoMax-Bottleneck (IMB), to carry out KF by optimizing the mutual information between the learned representations and input. Experiments across various benchmarks demonstrate that, the derived factor networks yield gratifying performances on not only the dedicated tasks but also disentanglement, while enjoying much better interpretability and modularity. Moreover, the learned common-knowledge representations give rise to impressive results on transfer learning. Our code is available at https://github.com/Adamdad/KnowledgeFactor.

title: Xingyi Zhou, Rohit Girdhar, Armand Joulin, Philipp Krähenbühl, Ishan Misra
title_en: Xingyi Zhou, Rohit Girdhar, Armand Joulin, Philipp Krähenbühl, Ishan Misra
abstract: 当前的目标检测器由于检测数据集规模较小,其词汇量受到限制。相比之下,图像分类器可以处理更大的词汇量,因为其数据集更大且更容易收集。我们提出Detic,该方法通过在图像分类数据上训练检测器的分类器,从而将检测器的词汇量扩展到数万个概念。与以往方法不同,Detic无需复杂的分配方案,即可根据模型预测将图像标签分配给边界框,使其更容易实现,并且兼容多种检测架构和主干网络。我们的实验结果表明,即使对于没有边界框标注的类别,Detic也能生成出色的检测器。在开放词汇量和长尾检测基准测试中,Detic均优于以往方法。在开放词汇量LVIS基准测试中,Detic对所有类别获得2.4 mAP的提升,对新类别获得8.3 mAP的提升。在标准LVIS基准测试中,当评估所有类别或仅罕见类别时,Detic分别获得41.7 mAP,从而缩小了样本数量较少的目标类别之间的性能差距。首次,我们训练了一个包含ImageNet数据集中二万一千个类别的检测器,并展示了其无需微调即可泛化到新数据集的能力。代码已包含在补充材料中。
abstract_en: Current object detectors are limited in vocabulary size due to the small scale of detection datasets. Image classifiers, on the other hand, reason about much larger vocabularies, as their datasets are larger and easier to collect. We propose Detic, which simply trains the classifiers of a detector on image classification data and thus expands the vocabulary of detectors to tens of thousands of concepts. Unlike prior work, Detic does not need complex assignment schemes to assign image labels to boxes based on model predictions, making it much easier to implement and compatible with a range of detection architectures and backbones. Our results show that Detic yields excellent detectors even for classes without box annotations. It outperforms prior work on both open-vocabulary and long-tail detection benchmarks. Detic provides a gain of 2.4 mAP for all classes and 8.3 mAP for novel classes on the open-vocabulary LVIS benchmark. On the standard LVIS benchmark, Detic obtains 41.7 mAP when evaluated on all classes, or only rare classes, hence closing the gap in performance for object categories with few samples. For the first time, we train a detector with all the twenty-one-thousand classes of the ImageNet dataset and show that it generalizes to new datasets without finetuning. Code is provided in the supplementary.

title: Xingyu Jiang, Hongkun Dou, Chengwei Fu, Bingquan Dai, Tianrun Xu, Yue Deng
title_en: Xingyu Jiang, Hongkun Dou, Chengwei Fu, Bingquan Dai, Tianrun Xu, Yue Deng
abstract: 自然图像在不同区域可能遭受非均匀雾霾分布的影响。然而,这一重要事实几乎未被现有监督去雾方法所考虑,这些方法在损失设计中对所有训练块的权重均等处理。这些监督方法可能在某些被浓重雾霾污染的区域无法实现令人满意的恢复。因此,为了更合理的去雾损失设计,应考虑不同训练块的差异性重要性。这一思路与人类学习过程一致,即困难的概念总是需要更多的练习。为此,我们提出了一种双层去雾(BILD)框架,通过设计一个用于加权监督去雾的内部循环和一个用于训练块重新加权的外部循环。通过简单的推导,我们展示了BILD的梯度与策略梯度自然关联,因此可以通过强化学习中的奖励机制来解释BILD的目标。BILD本身并不是一种新的去雾方法,更准确地说,它是一个灵活的框架,可以无缝地与通用监督去雾方法结合,以提升其性能。
abstract_en: Natural images can suffer from non-uniform haze distributions in different regions. However, this important fact is hardly considered in existing supervised dehazing methods, in which all training patches are accounted for equally in the loss design. These supervised methods may fail in making promising recoveries on some regions contaminated by heavy hazes. Therefore, for a more reasonable dehazing losses design, the varying importance of different training patches should be taken into account. Such rationale is exactly in line with the process of human learning that difficult concepts always require more practice in learning. To this end, we propose a bi-level dehazing (BILD) framework by designing an internal loop for weighted supervised dehazing and an external loop for training patch reweighting. With simple derivations, we show the gradients of BILD exhibit natural connections with policy gradient and can thus explain the BILD objective by the rewarding mechanism in reinforcement learning. The BILD is not a new dehazing method per se, it is better recognized as a flexible framework that can seamlessly work with general supervised dehazing approaches for their performance boosting.

title: Xingyu Liu, Gu Wang, Yi Li, Xiangyang Ji
title_en: Xingyu Liu, Gu Wang, Yi Li, Xiangyang Ji
abstract: 尽管类别级9自由度物体位姿估计近期有所发展,但以往基于对应关系或直接回归的方法由于物体形状和颜色等类内差异巨大,其精度均受到限制。与之不同,本文提出了一种类别级物体位姿和尺寸优化器CATRE,能够通过迭代优化点云数据,生成精确的位姿估计结果。给定初始位姿估计,CATRE通过将部分观测点云与抽象形状先验对齐,预测初始位姿与真实位姿之间的相对变换。具体而言,我们提出了一种新颖的解耦架构,该架构能够区分旋转与平移/尺寸估计的固有差异。大量实验表明,我们的方法在REAL275、CAMERA25和LM基准测试中显著优于现有最先进方法,达到约85.32Hz的处理速度,并在类别级跟踪任务中取得了具有竞争力的结果。我们进一步证明CATRE能够对未见过的类别进行位姿优化。代码和训练模型已公开。
abstract_en: While category-level 9DoF object pose estimation has emerged recently, previous correspondence-based or direct regression methods are both limited in accuracy due to the huge intra-category variances in object shape and color, etc. Orthogonal to them, this work presents a category-level object pose and size refiner CATRE, which is able to iteratively enhance pose estimate from point clouds to produce accurate results. Given an initial pose estimate, CATRE predicts a relative transformation between the initial pose and ground truth by means of aligning the partially observed point cloud and an abstract shape prior. In specific, we propose a novel disentangled architecture being aware of the inherent distinctions between rotation and translation/size estimation. Extensive experiments show that our approach remarkably outperforms state-of-the-art methods on REAL275, CAMERA25, and LM benchmarks up to a speed of approximately 85.32Hz, and achieves competitive results on category-level tracking. We further demonstrate that CATRE can perform pose refinement on unseen category. Code and trained models are available.

title: 李欣浩,李静静,杜哲凯,朱磊,李文
title_en: Xinhao Li, Jingjing Li, Zhekai Du, Lei Zhu, Wen Li
abstract: 开放集领域适应(OSDA)旨在识别目标域中在源域中出现的类别,同时将未在源域中出现的目标专属类别归入未知类别,这忽略了后者的多样性,因此无法对其做出解释。最近提出的语义恢复开放集领域适应(SR-OSDA)引入了语义属性,并通过部分对齐和视觉-语义投影来应对这一挑战,标志着可解释OSDA的第一步。沿着这一思路,本文提出了一种表示学习框架,称为角度边距分离(AMS),揭示了判别性和鲁棒性表示在开放集领域适应和跨域语义恢复中的强大作用。我们的核心思想是利用带有正则化的加法角度边距,同时进行鲁棒特征微调和判别性联合特征对齐,这有助于学习更准确且偏差更小的视觉-语义投影。进一步地,我们提出了一种后训练重投影方法,在不损害未见类别性能的前提下提升已见类别的解释能力。大量实验验证了AMS在现有SR-OSDA基线上的显著提升,在多个迁移任务中,未见类别的语义恢复准确率平均提高了7.6%。我们的代码可在https://github.com/LeoXinhaoLee/AMS获取。
abstract_en: Open-set Domain Adaptation (OSDA) aims to recognize classes in the target domain that are seen in the source domain while rejecting other unseen target-exclusive classes into an unknown class, which ignores the diversity of the latter and is therefore incapable of their interpretation. The recently-proposed Semantic Recovery OSDA (SR-OSDA) brings in semantic attributes and attacks the challenge via partial alignment and visual-semantic projection, marking the first step towards interpretable OSDA. Following that line, in this work, we propose a representation learning framework termed Angular Margin Separation (AMS) that unveils the power of discriminative and robust representation for both open-set domain adaptation and cross-domain semantic recovery. Our core idea is to exploit an additive angular margin with regularization for both robust feature fine-tuning and discriminative joint feature alignment, which turns out advantageous to learning an accurate and less biased visual-semantic projection. Further, we propose a post-training re-projection that boosts the performance of seen classes interpretation without deterioration on unseen classes. Verified by extensive experiments, AMS achieves a notable improvement over the existing SR-OSDA baseline, with an average 7.6% increment in semantic recovery accuracy of unseen classes in multiple transfer tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/LeoXinhaoLee/AMS.

title: Xinlei He, Hongbin Liu, Neil Zhenqiang Gong, Yang Zhang
title_en: Xinlei He, Hongbin Liu, Neil Zhenqiang Gong, Yang Zhang
abstract: 半监督学习(SSL)通过利用标记数据和未标记数据来训练机器学习(ML)模型。最先进的SSL方法可以通过使用更少的标记数据实现与监督学习相当的性能。然而,大多数现有工作集中在提升SSL的性能上。在本文中,我们采取了不同的角度,研究SSL的训练数据隐私问题。具体而言,我们提出了首个针对SSL训练模型的基于数据增强的成员推理攻击。给定一个数据样本和对模型的黑盒访问权限,成员推理攻击的目标是判断该数据样本是否属于模型的训练数据集。我们的评估表明,所提出的攻击方法在性能上优于现有成员推理攻击,并在针对SSL训练模型的攻击中表现最佳。此外,我们发现SSL中成员信息泄露的原因与监督学习中普遍认为的过拟合(训练准确率与测试准确率的差距)不同。我们观察到,SSL模型在测试数据上具有良好的泛化能力(几乎无过拟合),但通过给出更自信的预测(无论其正确性如何)来记忆训练数据。我们还探索了早停作为防止针对SSL的成员推理攻击的对策。结果表明,早停可以缓解成员推理攻击,但以模型实用性下降为代价。
abstract_en: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) leverages both labeled and unlabeled data to train machine learning (ML) models. State-of-the-art SSL methods can achieve comparable performance to supervised learning by leveraging much fewer labeled data. However, most existing works focus on improving the performance of SSL. In this work, we take a different angle by studying the training data privacy of SSL. Specifically, we propose the first data augmentation-based membership inference attacks against ML models trained by SSL. Given a data sample and the black-box access to a model, the goal of membership inference attack is to determine whether the data sample belongs to the training dataset of the model. Our evaluation shows that the proposed attack can consistently outperform existing membership inference attacks and achieves the best performance against the model trained by SSL. Moreover, we uncover that the reason for membership leakage in SSL is different from the commonly believed one in supervised learning, i.e., overfitting (the gap between training and testing accuracy). We observe that the SSL model is well generalized to the testing data (with almost 0 overfitting) but memorizes the training data by giving a more confident prediction regardless of its correctness. We also explore early stopping as a countermeasure to prevent membership inference attacks against SSL. The results show that early stopping can mitigate the membership inference attack, but with the cost of model’s utility degradation.

title: Xinpeng Ding, Jingwen Yang, Xiaowei Hu, Xiaomeng Li
title_en: Xinpeng Ding, Jingwen Yang, Xiaowei Hu, Xiaomeng Li
abstract: 视频阴影检测旨在生成视频帧之间一致的阴影预测。然而,当前方法在视频帧间存在不一致的阴影预测,尤其是在视频中光照和背景纹理发生变化时。我们观察到,这种不一致的预测是由阴影特征不一致性引起的,即相同阴影区域在相邻帧中的特征表现出不同的属性。本文提出了一种新颖的阴影一致性对应方法(SC-Cor),以增强视频阴影检测中特定阴影区域在帧间的像素级相似性。我们提出的SC-Cor具有三个主要优势。首先,无需密集的像素到像素对应标签,SC-Cor可以在弱监督方式下学习帧间的像素级对应关系。其次,SC-Cor考虑了阴影内部的可分离性,对视频中变化的纹理和光照具有鲁棒性。最后,SC-Cor是一个即插即用模块,可以轻松集成到现有阴影检测器中,且无需额外计算成本。我们进一步设计了一个新的评估指标,用于评估视频阴影检测结果的时间稳定性。实验结果表明,SC-Cor在IoU指标上比现有最先进方法提升了6.51%,在新引入的时间稳定性指标上提升了3.35%。
abstract_en: Video shadow detection aims to generate consistent shadow predictions among video frames. However, the current approaches suffer from inconsistent shadow predictions across frames, especially when the illumination and background textures change in a video. We make an observation that the inconsistent predictions are caused by the shadow feature inconsistency, i.e., the features of the same shadow regions show dissimilar proprieties among the nearby frames. In this paper, we present a novel Shadow-Consistent Correspondence method (SC-Cor) to enhance pixel-wise similarity of the specific shadow regions across frames for video shadow detection. Our proposed SC-Cor has three main advantages. Firstly, without requiring the dense pixel-to-pixel correspondence labels, SC-Cor can learn the pixel-wise correspondence across frames in a weakly-supervised manner. Secondly, SC-Cor considers intra-shadow separability, which is robust to the variant textures and illuminations in videos. Finally, SC-Cor is a plug-and-play module that can be easily integrated into existing shadow detectors with no extra computational cost. We further design a new evaluation metric to evaluate the temporal stability of the video shadow detection results. Experimental results show that SC-Cor outperforms the prior state-of-the-art method, by 6.51% on IoU and 3.35% on the newly introduced temporal stability metric.

title: Xinshuo Weng, Junyu Nan, Kuan-Hui Lee, Rowan McAllister, Adrien Gaidon, Nicholas Rhinehart, Kris M. Kitani
title_en: Xinshuo Weng, Junyu Nan, Kuan-Hui Lee, Rowan McAllister, Adrien Gaidon, Nicholas Rhinehart, Kris M. Kitani
abstract: 预测周围代理的未来状态对于自动驾驶等自主系统至关重要。先前的工作提出了一种对象无关的顺序点云预测(SPF)任务,无需在轨迹预测前进行精确的检测和跟踪,从而实现了有效的预测-检测流程,适用于下游的检测和轨迹预测。先前工作的局限性在于,其仅预测确定性的未来点云序列,而动态场景本身存在固有的不确定性。在本文中,我们通过提出一个生成模型来解决随机SPF问题,该模型包含两个主要组件:(1) 一个条件变分递归神经网络,用于建模时间依赖的潜在空间;(2) 一个金字塔LSTM,通过时间对齐的跳跃连接提高预测保真度。通过在真实世界自动驾驶数据集上的实验,我们的随机SPF模型生成了更高保真度的预测,与确定性模型相比,Chamfer距离降低了高达56.6%。此外,我们的模型能够估计预测点的不确定性,这对下游任务具有帮助。
abstract_en: Predicting futures of surrounding agents is critical for autonomous systems such as self-driving cars. Instead of requiring accurate detection and tracking prior to trajectory prediction, an object agnostic Sequential Pointcloud Forecasting (SPF) task was proposed in prior work, which enables a forecast-then-detect pipeline effective for downstream detection and trajectory prediction. One limitation of prior work is that it forecasts only a deterministic sequence of future point clouds, despite the inherent uncertainty of dynamic scenes. In this work, we tackle the stochastic SPF problem by proposing a generative model with two main components: (1) a conditional variational recurrent neural network that models a temporally-dependent latent space; (2) a pyramid-LSTM that increases the fidelity of predictions with temporally-aligned skip connections. Through experiments on real-world autonomous driving datasets, our stochastic SPF model produces higher-fidelity predictions, reducing Chamfer distances by up to 56.6% compared to its deterministic counterpart. In addition, our model can estimate the uncertainty of predicted points, which can be helpful to downstream tasks.

title: Xinwei Liu, Jian Liu, Yang Bai, Jindong Gu, Tao Chen, Xiaojun Jia, Xiaochun Cao
title_en: Xinwei Liu, Jian Liu, Yang Bai, Jindong Gu, Tao Chen, Xiaojun Jia, Xiaochun Cao
abstract: 作为一种常见的安全工具,可见水印技术已被广泛应用于保护数字图像的版权。然而,近期研究表明,深度神经网络(DNNs)可以去除可见水印而不损害其宿主图像。此类水印去除技术对图像的所有权构成了重大威胁。受深度神经网络对对抗性扰动的脆弱性启发,我们提出了一种基于对抗机器学习的新型防御机制。从攻击者的视角出发,盲水印去除网络可被视为我们的目标模型;随后,我们实际上在宿主图像上优化一种不可察觉的对抗性扰动,主动攻击水印去除网络,称为水印疫苗(Watermark Vaccine)。具体而言,提出了两种类型的疫苗。破坏性水印疫苗(DWV)在通过水印去除网络后会破坏宿主图像及其水印。相比之下,不可擦除水印疫苗(IWV)则通过尝试保持水印不被去除且仍可察觉的方式工作。大量实验验证了我们的DWV/IWV在防止水印去除方面的有效性,尤其是在各种水印去除网络上。代码已发布在https://github.com/thinwayliu/Watermark-Vaccine。
abstract_en: As a common security tool, visible watermarking has been widely applied to protect copyrights of digital images. However, recent works have shown that visible watermarks can be removed by DNNs without damaging their host images. Such watermark-removal techniques pose a great threat to the ownership of images. Inspired by the vulnerability of DNNs on adversarial perturbations, we propose a novel defence mechanism by adversarial machine learning for good. From the perspective of the adversary, blind watermark-removal networks can be posed as our target models; then we actually optimize an imperceptible adversarial perturbation on the host images to proactively attack against watermark-removal networks, dubbed Watermark Vaccine. Specifically, two types of vaccines are proposed. Disrupting Watermark Vaccine (DWV) induces to ruin the host image along with watermark after passing through watermark-removal networks. In contrast, Inerasable Watermark Vaccine (IWV) works in another fashion of trying to keep the watermark not removed and still noticeable. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our DWV/IWV in preventing watermark removal, especially on various watermark removal networks. The Code is released in https://github.com/thinwayliu/Watermark-Vaccine.

title: Xinyi Li, Haibin Ling
title_en: Xinyi Li, Haibin Ling
abstract: 相机重定位或绝对姿态回归是视觉里程计、运动结构恢复(SfM)和SLAM等众多计算机视觉任务的核心。本文提出了一种基于图变换器主干网络的神经网络方法,即GTCaR(用于相机重定位的图变换器),以解决多视角相机重定位问题。与以往主要依赖光度一致性引导姿态回归的工作不同,GTCaR通过将图像特征、相机姿态信息及帧间相对运动融合为编码图属性,并针对图一致性与姿态精度进行联合训练,从而显著提升了计算效率。通过利用带有边特征的图变换器层并启用邻接张量,GTCaR动态捕捉全局注意力,从而使姿态图具备演化结构,实现更优的鲁棒性与精度。此外,可选的时间变换器层主动增强序列输入的时空帧间关系。在多个公开基准数据集上的评估表明,GTCaR优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Camera re-localization or absolute pose regression is the centerpiece in numerous computer vision tasks such as visual odometry, structure from motion (SfM) and SLAM. In this paper we propose a neural network approach with a graph Transformer backbone, namely GTCaR (Graph Transformer for Camera Re-localization), to address the multi-view camera re-localization problem. In contrast with prior work where the pose regression is mainly guided by photometric consistency, GTCaR effectively fuses the image features, camera pose information and inter-frame relative camera motions into encoded graph attributes and is trained towards the graph consistency and pose accuracy combined instead, yielding significantly higher computational efficiency. By leveraging graph Transformer layers with edge features and enabling the adjacency tensor, GTCaR dynamically captures the global attention and thus endows the pose graph with evolving structures to achieve improved robustness and accuracy. In addition, optional temporal Transformer layers actively enhance the spatiotemporal inter-frame relation for sequential inputs. Evaluation of the proposed network on various public benchmarks demonstrates that GTCaR outperforms state-of-the-art approaches.

title: Xinyi Wu, Zhenyao Wu, Jin Wan, Lili Ju, Song Wang
title_en: Xinyi Wu, Zhenyao Wu, Jin Wan, Lili Ju, Song Wang
abstract: 视频语义分割是计算机视觉中的基础且重要任务,通常需要大规模标注数据来训练深度神经网络模型。为避免繁琐的手动标注,近期引入了领域自适应视频分割方法,通过将自标记模拟视频源域的知识迁移至未标记真实世界视频目标域。然而,这引发了一个有趣的问题——虽然视频到视频的适应是自然的想法,但源数据是否必须为视频?本文认为,由于目标域视频分割的时间连续性可以在不依赖源域视频的情况下进行估计和强制,因此无需传输时间知识。这促使我们提出了一种新的图像到视频领域自适应语义分割框架(I2VDA),其中源域是一组不含时间信息的图像。在此设定下,我们仅基于空间知识通过对抗训练桥接领域差距,并开发了一种新颖的时间增强策略,从而充分利用并学习目标域中的时间一致性。此外,我们引入了一种新的训练方案,通过利用代理网络实时生成伪标签,这非常有效地提高了对抗训练的稳定性。在两个合成到真实场景的实验结果表明,所提出的I2VDA方法在视频语义分割任务上甚至优于现有的最先进的视频到视频领域自适应方法。
abstract_en: Video semantic segmentation is a fundamental and important task in computer vision, and it usually requires large-scale labeled data for training deep neural network models. To avoid laborious manual labeling, domain adaptive video segmentation approaches were recently introduced by transferring the knowledge from the source domain of self-labeled simulated videos to the target domain of unlabeled real-world videos. However, it leads to an interesting question -- while video-to-video adaptation is a natural idea, does the source data require to be videos? In this paper, we argue that it is not necessary to transfer temporal knowledge since the temporal continuity of video segmentation in the target domain can be estimated and enforced without reference to videos in the source domain. This motivates a new framework of Image-to-Video Domain Adaptive Semantic Segmentation (I2VDA), where the source domain is a set of images without temporal information. Under this setting, we bridge the domain gap via adversarial training based on only the spatial knowledge, and develop a novel temporal augmentation strategy, through which the temporal consistency in the target domain is well-exploited and learned. In addition, we introduce a new training scheme by leveraging a proxy network to produce pseudo-labels on-the-fly, which is very effective to improve the stability of adversarial training. Experimental results on two synthetic-to-real scenarios show that the proposed I2VDA method can achieve even better performance on video semantic segmentation than existing state-of-the-art video-to-video domain adaption approaches.

title: 邹新毅、闫燕、薛景浩、陈思、王翰子
title_en: Xinyi Zou, Yan Yan, Jing-Hao Xue, Si Chen, Hanzi Wang
abstract: 大多数现有的复合面部表情识别(FER)方法依赖于大规模标记的复合表情数据进行训练。然而,收集此类数据是劳动密集型且耗时的。在本文中,我们针对跨域少样本学习(FSL)设置下的复合FER任务,仅需目标域中少量的复合表情样本。具体而言,我们提出了一种新颖的级联分解网络(CDNet),该网络基于顺序分解机制,级联多个具有共享参数的“学习分解”模块,以获得可迁移的特征空间。为了解决任务中由于基础类别有限导致的过拟合问题,设计了一种部分正则化策略,有效结合了基于小样本训练和基于小批量训练的优势。通过在多个基本表情数据集上训练相似任务,CDNet学习了“学习分解”的能力,可以轻松适应识别未见过的复合表情。在实验室和野外环境下的复合表情数据集上的大量实验表明,我们提出的CDNet优于几种最先进的FSL方法。代码可在:https://github.com/zouxinyi0625/CDNet.
abstract_en: Most existing compound facial expression recognition (FER) methods rely on large-scale labeled compound expression data for training. However, collecting such data is labor-intensive and time-consuming. In this paper, we address the compound FER task in the cross-domain few-shot learning (FSL) setting, which requires only a few samples of compound expressions in the target domain. Specifically, we propose a novel cascaded decomposition network (CDNet), which cascades several learn-to-decompose modules with shared parameters based on a sequential decomposition mechanism, to obtain a transferable feature space. To alleviate the overfitting problem caused by limited base classes in our task, a partial regularization strategy is designed to effectively exploit the best of both episodic training and batch training. By training across similar tasks on multiple basic expression datasets, CDNet learns the ability of learn-to-decompose that can be easily adapted to identify unseen compound expressions. Extensive experiments on both in-the-lab and in-the-wild compound expression datasets demonstrate the superiority of our proposed CDNet against several state-of-the-art FSL methods. Code is available at: https://github.com/zouxinyi0625/CDNet.

title: Xinyu Shi, Dong Wei, Yu Zhang, Donghuan Lu, Munan Ning, Jiashun Chen, Kai Ma, Yefeng Zheng
title_en: Xinyu Shi, Dong Wei, Yu Zhang, Donghuan Lu, Munan Ning, Jiashun Chen, Kai Ma, Yefeng Zheng
abstract: 少样本语义分割(FSS)研究引起了广泛关注,其目标是在仅有少量目标类标注支持图像的情况下,对查询图像中的目标对象进行分割。该具有挑战性的任务的关键在于通过利用查询与支持图像之间的细粒度相关性,充分利用支持图像中的信息。然而,大多数现有方法要么将支持信息压缩为少数类别级原型,要么在像素级别仅使用部分支持信息(例如仅前景),导致不可忽视的信息损失。在本文中,我们提出了一种密集像素级跨查询与支持注意力加权掩码聚合(DCAMA),通过配对查询与支持特征之间的多级像素级相关性,充分利用前景和背景支持信息。基于Transformer架构中的缩放点积注意力机制,DCAMA将每个查询像素视为一个token,计算其与所有支持像素的相似性,并将所有支持像素标签的加权聚合作为其分割标签预测,权重由相似性决定。基于DCAMA的独特设计,我们进一步提出了一种高效且有效的单次推理方法,用于n-shot分割,其中所有支持图像的像素被一次性收集用于掩码聚合。实验表明,我们的DCAMA在标准FSS基准PASCAL-5i、COCO-20i和FSS-1000上显著提升了性能,例如在1-shot mIoU上分别比之前最佳记录提高了3.1%、9.7%和3.6%。消融研究也验证了DCAMA的设计。
abstract_en: Research into Few-shot Semantic Segmentation (FSS) has attracted great attention, with the goal to segment target objects in a query image given only a few annotated support images of the target class. A key to this challenging task is to fully utilize the information in the support images by exploiting fine-grained correlations between the query and support images. However, most existing approaches either compressed the support information into a few class-wise prototypes, or used partial support information (e.g., only foreground) at the pixel level, causing non-negligible information loss. In this paper, we propose Dense pixel-wise Cross-query-and-support Attention weighted Mask Aggregation (DCAMA), where both foreground and background support information are fully exploited via multi-level pixel-wise correlations between paired query and support features. Implemented with the scaled dot-product attention in the Transformer architecture, DCAMA treats every query pixel as a token, computes its similarities with all support pixels, and predicts its segmentation label as an additive aggregation of all the support pixels’ labels--weighted by the similarities. Based on the unique formulation of DCAMA, we further propose efficient and effective one-pass inference for n-shot segmentation, where pixels of all support images are collected for the mask aggregation at once. Experiments show that our DCAMA significantly advances the state of the art on standard FSS benchmarks of PASCAL-5i, COCO-20i, and FSS-1000, e.g., with 3.1%, 9.7%, and 3.6% absolute improvements in 1-shot mIoU over previous best records. Ablative studies also verify the design DCAMA.

title: 周欣悦, 严明宇, 陈欣媛, 孙丽, 高昌欣, 李青莉
title_en: Xinyue Zhou, Mingyu Yin, Xinyuan Chen, Li Sun, Changxin Gao, Qingli Li
abstract: 可控人像合成任务通过显式控制身体姿态和外观,能够实现广泛的应用。本文提出了一种基于交叉注意力的风格分布模块,用于计算源语义风格与目标姿态之间的关系以实现姿态迁移。该模块有意选择每个语义所代表的风格,并根据目标姿态进行分布。交叉注意力中的注意力矩阵表达了目标姿态与所有语义的源风格之间的动态相似性。因此,它可以用于路由源图像中的颜色和纹理,并进一步通过目标分割图进行约束以实现更清晰的目标。同时,为了准确编码源外观,还添加了不同语义风格之间的自注意力机制。我们的模型在姿态迁移和虚拟试穿任务上进行了定量和定性验证。代码可在 https://github.com/xyzhouo/CASD 获取。
abstract_en: Controllable person image synthesis task enables a wide range of applications through explicit control over body pose and appearance. In this paper, we propose a cross attention based style distribution module that computes between the source semantic styles and target pose for pose transfer. The module intentionally selects the style represented by each semantic and distributes them according to the target pose. The attention matrix in cross attention expresses the dynamic similarities between the target pose and the source styles for all semantics. Therefore, it can be utilized to route the color and texture from the source image, and is further constrained by the target parsing map to achieve a clearer objective. At the same time, to encode the source appearance accurately, the self attention among different semantic styles is also added. The effectiveness of our model is validated quantitatively and qualitatively on pose transfer and virtual try-on tasks. Codes are available at https://github.com/xyzhouo/CASD.

title: Xiu Su, Shan You, Jiyang Xie, Mingkai Zheng, Fei Wang, Chen Qian, Changshui Zhang, Xiaogang Wang, Chang Xu
title_en: Xiu Su, Shan You, Jiyang Xie, Mingkai Zheng, Fei Wang, Chen Qian, Changshui Zhang, Xiaogang Wang, Chang Xu
abstract: 视觉Transformer(ViTs)继承了NLP的成功经验,但其结构尚未被充分研究和优化以适应视觉任务。最简单的解决方案是直接通过广泛使用的卷积神经网络(CNN)神经网络架构搜索(NAS)寻找最优结构。然而,我们实证发现这种直接迁移会导致超级former训练中出现灾难性失败并令人沮丧的不稳定性。本文我们认为,由于ViTs主要在token嵌入上操作且具有较少归纳偏差,不同架构间的通道不平衡会加剧权重共享假设,从而导致训练不稳定。因此,我们开发了一种新的循环权重共享机制,用于ViTs的token嵌入,使每个通道能够更均匀地贡献给所有候选架构。此外,我们还提出恒等变换偏移以缓解超级former中的多对一问题,并利用弱增强和正则化技术实证实现更稳定的训练。基于这些改进,我们的方法ViTAS在基于DeiT和Twins的ViTs中均表现出显著优势。例如,在仅$1.4$G FLOPs预算下,我们的搜索架构在ImageNet-$1$k上比基线DeiT准确率高出$3.3\%$。在$3.0$G FLOPs下,我们的结果在ImageNet-$1$k上达到$82.0\%$准确率,并在COCO$2017$上实现$45.9\%$ mAP,比其他ViT高出$2.4\%$。
abstract_en: Vision transformers (ViTs) inherited the success of NLP but their structures have not been sufficiently investigated and optimized for visual tasks. One of the simplest solutions is to directly search the optimal one via the widely used neural architecture search (NAS) in CNNs. However, we empirically find this straightforward adaptation would encounter catastrophic failures and be frustratingly unstable for the training of superformer. In this paper, we argue that since ViTs mainly operate on token embeddings with little inductive bias, imbalance of channels for different architectures would worsen the weight-sharing assumption and cause the training instability as a result. Therefore, we develop a new cyclic weight-sharing mechanism for token embeddings of the ViTs, which enables each channel could more evenly contribute to all candidate architectures. Besides, we also propose identity shifting to alleviate the many-to-one issue in superformer and leverage weak augmentation and regularization techniques for more steady training empirically. Based on these, our proposed method, ViTAS, has achieved significant superiority in both DeiT- and Twins-based ViTs. For example, with only $1.4$G FLOPs budget, our searched architecture has $3.3\%$ ImageNet-$1$k accuracy than the baseline DeiT. With $3.0$G FLOPs, our results achieve $82.0\%$ accuracy on ImageNet-$1$k, and $45.9\%$ mAP on COCO$2017$ which is $2.4\%$ superior than other ViTs.

title: Xiufeng Xie, Ning Zhou, Wentao Zhu, Ji Liu
title_en: Xiufeng Xie, Ning Zhou, Wentao Zhu, Ji Liu
abstract: 物联网设备的轻量化特性使得在增强现实等应用中本地运行深度神经网络(DNNs)面临挑战。近期物联网通信技术如LTE-M的进展显著提升了链路带宽,使物联网设备能够将视觉数据流式传输至运行DNNs进行推理的边缘服务器。然而,未压缩的视觉数据仍可能轻易导致物联网链路过载,且无线频谱被众多物联网设备共享,导致链路带宽不稳定。主流编解码器虽可减少数据流量,但会严重降低推理精度。近期针对可微分JPEG的研究通过训练编解码器以应对推理精度的损害。但这些方法依赖于损失函数中的启发式配置来平衡速率-精度权衡,无法保证满足物联网带宽约束。本文提出AutoJPEG,一种带宽感知的自适应压缩方案,通过学习JPEG编码参数以在带宽约束下优化DNN推理精度。我们通过分析JPEG编解码器工作流程,将压缩图像大小建模为编码参数的闭式函数。此外,我们构建了一个带约束的优化框架,在确保图像大小严格符合带宽约束的前提下最小化原始DNN损失。我们的评估在多种DNN模型和数据集上验证了AutoJPEG的有效性。实验结果表明,AutoJPEG在主流编解码器(如JPEG和WebP)及优化图像编解码器以适应DNN推理的最先进方案中表现更优。
abstract_en: The lightweight nature of IoT devices makes it challenging to run deep neural networks (DNNs) locally for applications like augmented reality. Recent advances in IoT communication like LTE-M have significantly boosted the link bandwidth, enabling IoT devices to stream visual data to edge servers running DNNs for inference. However, uncompressed visual data can still easily overload the IoT link, and the wireless spectrum is shared by numerous IoT devices, causing unstable link bandwidth. Mainstream codecs can reduce the traffic but at the cost of severe inference accuracy drops. Recent works on differentiable JPEG train the codec to tackle the damage to inference accuracy. But they rely on heuristic configurations in the loss function to balance the rate-accuracy tradeoff, providing no guarantee to meet the IoT bandwidth constraint. This paper presents AutoJPEG, a bandwidth-aware adaptive compression solution that learns the JPEG encoding parameters to optimize the DNN inference accuracy under bandwidth constraints. We model the compressed image size as a closed-form function of encoding parameters by analyzing the JPEG codec workflow. Furthermore, we formulate a constrained optimization framework to minimize the original DNN loss while ensuring the image size strictly meets the bandwidth constraint. Our evaluation validates AutoJPEG on various DNN models and datasets. In our experiments, AutoJPEG outperforms the mainstream codecs (like JPEG and WebP) and the state-of-the-art solutions that optimize the image codec for DNN inference.

title: Xu Cao, Hiroaki Santo, Boxin Shi, Fumio Okura, Yasuyuki Matsushita
title_en: Xu Cao, Hiroaki Santo, Boxin Shi, Fumio Okura, Yasuyuki Matsushita
abstract: 本文研究了从表面法线图恢复表面时的不连续性保持问题。为建模不连续性,我们引入假设:待恢复的表面是半光滑的,即表面在水平和垂直方向上处处单侧可导(因此单侧连续)。在半光滑表面假设下,我们提出了一种双边加权泛函用于不连续性保持的法线积分。关键思想是根据单侧深度不连续性的定义,基于每个点两侧的单侧可导性进行相对加权。结果表明,我们的方法有效保持了不连续性,并在恢复的表面中减轻了现有方法中的欠分割或过分割伪影。此外,我们以新方式统一了正交投影与透视投影情况下的法线积分问题,并在两种情况下均展示了有效的不连续性保持结果。
abstract_en: This paper studies the discontinuity preservation problem in recovering a surface from its surface normal map. To model discontinuities, we introduce the assumption that the surface to be recovered is semi-smooth, i.e., the surface is one-sided differentiable (hence one-sided continuous) everywhere in the horizontal and vertical directions. Under the semi-smooth surface assumption, we propose a bilaterally weighted functional for discontinuity preserving normal integration. The key idea is to relatively weight the one-sided differentiability at each point’s two sides based on the definition of one-sided depth discontinuity. As a result, our method effectively preserves discontinuities and alleviates the under- or over-segmentation artifacts in the recovered surfaces compared to existing methods. Further, we unify the normal integration problem in the orthographic and perspective cases in a new way and show effective discontinuity preservation results in both cases.

title: Xu Yan, Jiantao Gao, Chaoda Zheng, Chao Zheng, Ruimao Zhang, Shuguang Cui, Zhen Li
title_en: Xu Yan, Jiantao Gao, Chaoda Zheng, Chao Zheng, Ruimao Zhang, Shuguang Cui, Zhen Li
abstract: 随着相机和激光雷达传感器在自动驾驶中捕获互补信息,人们已投入大量努力通过多模态数据融合开发语义分割算法。然而,基于融合的方法需要配对数据,即激光雷达点云和相机图像,且在训练和推理中都需要严格的点到像素映射,这严重阻碍了它们在实际场景中的应用。因此,在本工作中,我们提出了2D先验辅助语义分割(2DPASS),这是一种通用的训练方案,通过充分利用具有丰富外观的2D图像,来提升点云的表示学习。在实践中,通过利用辅助模态融合和多尺度融合到单知识蒸馏(MSFSKD),2DPASS从多模态数据中获取更丰富的语义和结构信息,然后将这些信息在线蒸馏到纯3D网络中。因此,配备2DPASS,我们的基线仅使用点云输入就实现了显著提升。具体而言,它在两个大规模基准(即SemanticKITTI和NuScenes)上达到了最先进的水平,包括SemanticKITTI单次和多次扫描竞赛的top-1结果。
abstract_en: As camera and LiDAR sensors capture complementary information used in autonomous driving, great efforts have been made to develop semantic segmentation algorithms through multi-modality data fusion. However, fusion-based approaches require paired data, i.e., LiDAR point clouds and camera images with strict point-to-pixel mappings, as the inputs in both training and inference, which seriously hinders their application in practical scenarios. Thus, in this work, we propose the 2D Priors Assisted Semantic Segmentation (2DPASS), a general training scheme, to boost the representation learning on point clouds, by fully taking advantage of 2D images with rich appearance. In practice, by leveraging an auxiliary modal fusion and multi-scale fusion-to-single knowledge distillation (MSFSKD), 2DPASS acquires richer semantic and structural information from the multi-modal data, which are then online distilled to the pure 3D network. As a result, equipped with 2DPASS, our baseline shows significant improvement with only point cloud inputs. Specifically, it achieves the state-of-the-arts on two large-scale benchmarks (i.e. SemanticKITTI and NuScenes), including top-1 results in both single and multiple scan(s) competitions of SemanticKITTI.

title: Xu Yao, Alasdair Newson, Yann Gousseau, Pierre Hellier
title_en: Xu Yao, Alasdair Newson, Yann Gousseau, Pierre Hellier
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的编码器架构用于生成对抗网络(GAN)的反演。该任务旨在从预训练生成对抗网络(GAN)的潜在空间中重建真实图像。与以往仅从真实图像预测潜在编码的基于编码器的方法不同,所提出的编码器同时将给定图像映射到潜在编码和特征张量。特征张量对于精确反演至关重要,有助于获得更好的感知质量和更低的重建误差。我们在多个基于风格的生成器上进行了广泛的实验,这些生成器在不同的数据域上进行了预训练。我们的方法是首个在反演中包含特征张量的前馈编码器,优于当前最先进的基于编码器的GAN反演方法。此外,视频反演实验表明,我们的方法在视频反演中更加准确且稳定。这为视频中的实时编辑提供了可能性。
abstract_en: We present a new encoder architecture for GAN inversion. The task is to reconstruct a real image from the latent space of a pre-trained Generative Adversarial Network (GAN). Unlike previous encoder-based methods which predict only a latent code from a real image, the proposed encoder maps the given image to both a latent code and a feature tensor, simultaneously. The feature tensor is key for accurate inversion, which helps to obtain better perceptual quality and lower reconstruction error. We conduct extensive experiments for several style-based generators pre-trained on different data domains. Our method is the first feed-forward encoder to include the feature tensor in the inversion, outperforming the state-of-the-art encoder-based methods for GAN inversion. Additionally, experiments on video inversion show that our method yields a more accurate and stable inversion for videos. This offers the possibility to perform real-time editing in videos.

title: Xuan Gong, Meng Zheng, Benjamin Planche, Srikrishna Karanam, Terrence Chen, David Doermann, Ziyan Wu
title_en: Xuan Gong, Meng Zheng, Benjamin Planche, Srikrishna Karanam, Terrence Chen, David Doermann, Ziyan Wu
abstract: 全监督的人体网格恢复方法由于三维标注基准数据集的可用性和多样性有限,存在数据需求量大且泛化能力差的问题。近年来,自监督人体网格恢复方法在基于合成数据的训练范式下取得了进展,其中模型通过合成配对的2D表示(如2D关键点和分割掩码)与3D网格进行训练。然而,针对合成密集对应图(即IUV)的研究较少,因为合成训练数据与真实测试数据之间的领域差距难以解决。为缓解IUV上的领域差距,我们提出利用鲁棒但稀疏的2D关键点信息进行跨表示对齐。具体而言,初始网格估计与两种2D表示之间的对齐误差被传递至回归器,并在后续网格回归中动态修正。这种自适应的跨表示对齐方法通过学习偏差并捕捉互补信息,既保留了稀疏表示的鲁棒性,又利用了密集表示的丰富性。我们在多个标准基准数据集上进行了大量实验,取得了具有竞争力的结果,有助于减少生成最先进人体网格模型所需的标注工作量。
abstract_en: Fully supervised human mesh recovery methods are data-hungry and have poor generalizability due to the limited availability and diversity of 3D-annotated benchmark datasets. Recent progress in self-supervised human mesh recovery has been made using synthetic-data-driven training paradigms where the model is trained from synthetic paired 2D representation (e.g., 2D keypoints and segmentation masks) and 3D mesh. However, on synthetic dense correspondence maps (i.e., IUV) few have been explored since the domain gap between synthetic training data and real testing data is hard to address for 2D dense representation. To alleviate this domain gap on IUV, we propose cross-representation alignment utilizing the complementary information from the robust but sparse representation (2D keypoints). Specifically, the alignment errors between initial mesh estimation and both 2D representations are forwarded into regressor and dynamically corrected in the following mesh regression. This adaptive cross-representation alignment explicitly learns from the deviations and captures complementary information: robustness from sparse representation and richness from dense representation. We conduct extensive experiments on multiple standard benchmark datasets and demonstrate competitive results, helping take a step towards reducing the annotation effort needed to produce state-of-the-art models in human mesh estimation.

title: Xuan Son Nguyen
title_en: Xuan Son Nguyen
abstract: 使用对称半正定矩阵(SPSD)进行表示学习在许多机器学习问题中已被证明是有效的。最近,一些SPSD神经网络已被提出并展现出有前景的性能。尽管这些工作都共享将深度神经网络(DNNs)中的一些基本操作推广到SPSD流形设置的共同思路,但它们提出的一般化方法通常是随意设计的。在本文中,我们尝试提出一个原理性的框架来构建此类一般化方法。我们的方法受到双曲神经网络(HNNs)成功的影响,这些网络在多种应用中表现出色。在这里,我们考虑将双曲向量空间理论与SPSD流形的黎曼几何联系起来。我们首先提出一种方法来定义基本操作,即在(满秩)对称正定(SPD)矩阵的双曲向量空间中的二元运算和标量乘法。随后,我们将这些操作扩展到低秩SPSD流形设置中。最后,我们提出了一种构建SPSD神经网络的方法。在三个用于人体活动识别的基准测试上的实验评估展示了我们提出框架的有效性。
abstract_en: Representation learning with Symmetric Positive Semi-definite (SPSD) matrices has proven effective in many machine learning problems. Recently, some SPSD neural networks have been proposed and shown promising performance. While these works share a common idea of generalizing some basic operations in deep neural networks (DNNs) to the SPSD manifold setting, their proposed generalizations are usually designed in an ad hoc manner. In this work, we make an attempt to propose a principled framework for building such generalizations. Our method is motivated by the success of hyperbolic neural networks (HNNs) that have demonstrated impressive performance in a variety of applications. At the heart of HNNs is the theory of gyrovector spaces that provides a powerful tool for studying hyperbolic geometry. Here we consider connecting the theory of gyrovector spaces and the Riemannian geometry of SPSD manifolds. We first propose a method to define basic operations, i.e., binary operation and scalar multiplication in gyrovector spaces of (full-rank) Symmetric Positive Definite (SPD) matrices. We then extend these operations to the low-rank SPSD manifold setting. Finally, we present an approach for building SPSD neural networks. Experimentl evaluations on three benchmarks for human activity recognition demonstrate the efficacy of our proposed framework.

title: 易玄宇、唐凯华、华先胜、林朱慧、张翰王
title_en: Xuanyu Yi, Kaihua Tang, Xian-Sheng Hua, Joo-Hwee Lim, Hanwang Zhang
abstract: 传统去噪方法依赖于噪声样本独立同分布的假设,因此即使受到噪声干扰,所得到的分类器仍能轻松将噪声识别为异常值。然而,在不可避免存在长尾分布的大规模数据中,这一假设并不现实。这种不平衡性使得分类器对尾部类别的区分能力下降,其先前“容易”的噪声现在转变为“困难”的噪声——它们几乎与尾部样本一样被视为异常值。我们引入这一新挑战为噪声长尾分类(NLT)。不出所料,我们发现大多数去噪方法无法识别这些困难噪声,导致在三个提出的NLT基准测试(ImageNet-NLT、Animal10-NLT和Food101-NLT)上性能显著下降。为此,我们设计了一个名为“由难到易”(H2E)的迭代噪声学习框架。我们的引导思想是首先学习一个分类器,使其对类别和上下文分布的变化具有不变性,将“困难”噪声转化为“容易”噪声,其去除进一步提高不变性。实验结果表明,我们的H2E在长尾设置下优于最先进的去噪方法及其变体,同时在平衡设置下保持稳定性能。代码见附录。
abstract_en: Conventional de-noising methods rely on the assumption that the noisy samples are independent and identically distributed, so the resultant classifier, though disturbed by noise, can still easily identify the noises as outliers. However, the assumption is unrealistic in large-scale data that is inevitably long-tailed. Such imbalance makes a classifier less discriminative for the tail classes, whose previously “easy” noises are now turned into “hard” ones--they are almost as outliers as the tail samples. We introduce this new challenge as Noisy Long-Tailed Classification (NLT). Not surprisingly, we find that most de-noising methods fail to identify the hard noises, resulting in significant performance drop on the three proposed NLT benchmarks: ImageNet-NLT, Animal10-NLT, and Food101-NLT. To this end, we design an iterative noisy learning framework called Hard-to-Easy (H2E). Our bootstrapping philosophy is to first learn a classifier as noise identifier invariant to the class and context distributional change, reducing “hard” noises to “easy” ones, whose removal further improves the invariance. Experimental results show that our H2E outperforms state-of-the-art de-noising methods and their ablations on long-tailed settings while maintaining a stable performance on balanced ones. Codes are in Appendix.

title: 人-物交互(HOI)检测
title_en: Xubin Zhong, Changxing Ding, Zijian Li, Shaoli Huang
abstract: 人-物交互(HOI)检测是高层图像理解的核心任务。近年来,基于检测Transformer(DETR)的HOI检测器因其卓越的性能和高效的结构而受到广泛关注。然而,这些方法通常采用固定HOI查询应对所有测试图像,这使得其在特定图像中物体位置变化时容易失效。为此,本文提出通过挖掘硬正样本查询来增强DETR的鲁棒性,这些查询通过部分视觉线索强制生成正确预测。首先,我们根据每个训练图像中标注的人-物对的地面真实(GT)位置显式构建硬正样本查询。具体而言,我们移动每个标注人-物对的GT边界框,使得移动后的框仅覆盖GT框的某一部分。我们将每个标注人-物对移动后的框坐标编码为HOI查询。其次,我们通过遮挡解码器层交叉注意力图中的高分区域隐式构建另一组硬正样本查询。遮挡后的注意力图仅覆盖HOI预测的部分重要线索。最后,提出一种交替策略,高效结合两种类型的硬查询。在每次迭代中,同时采用DETR的可学习查询和一种选定类型的硬正样本查询进行损失计算。实验结果表明,所提出的方法可广泛应用于现有的基于DETR的HOI检测器。此外,我们在三个基准数据集HICO-DET、V-COCO和HOI-A上持续取得最先进性能。
abstract_en: Human-Object Interaction (HOI) detection is a core task for high-level image understanding. Recently, Detection Transformer (DETR)-based HOI detectors have become popular due to their superior performance and efficient structure. However, these approaches typically adopt fixed HOI queries for all testing images, which is vulnerable to the location change of objects in one specific image. Accordingly, in this paper, we propose to enhance DETR’s robustness by mining hard-positive queries, which are forced to make correct predictions using partial visual cues. First, we explicitly compose hard-positive queries according to the ground-truth (GT) position of labeled human-object pairs for each training image. Specifically, we shift the GT bounding boxes of each labeled human-object pair so that the shifted boxes cover only a certain portion of the GT ones. We encode the coordinates of the shifted boxes for each labeled human-object pair into an HOI query. Second, we implicitly construct another set of hard-positive queries by masking the top scores in cross-attention maps of the decoder layers. The masked attention maps then only cover partial important cues for HOI predictions. Finally, an alternate strategy is proposed that efficiently combines both types of hard queries. In each iteration, both DETR’s learnable queries and one selected type of hard-positive queries are adopted for loss computation. Experimental results show that our proposed approach can be widely applied to existing DETR-based HOI detectors. Moreover, we consistently achieve state-of-the-art performance on three benchmarks: HICO-DET, V-COCO, and HOI-A.

title: 王旭东,连龙,Stella X. Yu
title_en: Xudong Wang, Long Lian, Stella X. Yu
abstract: 给定一个未标记的数据集和一个标注预算,我们研究如何选择性地标注固定数量的实例,使得在这样的部分标注数据集上进行半监督学习(SSL)效果最佳。我们不仅关注通常SSL中从给定的标注数据传播标签到未标注数据的过程,还专注于选择正确的数据进行标注。这个实例选择任务具有挑战性,因为没有标注数据时,我们不知道学习的目标是什么。直观上,无论下游任务是什么,需要标注的实例必须具有代表性且多样化:前者有助于标签传播到未标注数据,而后者确保整个数据集的覆盖。我们通过在预训练特征空间中选择聚类原型,或在用于实例区分的特征优化过程中选择聚类原型,两者都不需要标签。我们的无监督选择性标注方法在给定标注数据的最新主动学习方法上,通过标签效率提高了8-25倍。例如,在CIFAR-10(ImageNet-1K)上,使用0.08%(0.2%)标注数据时,它将FixMatch的准确率提高了10%(14%),这表明在标注数据上花费少量计算就能带来显著的收益,尤其是在标注预算较低的情况下。我们的工作为实用的SSL设定了新标准。
abstract_en: Given an unlabeled dataset and an annotation budget, we study how to selectively label a fixed number of instances so that semi-supervised learning (SSL) on such a partially labeled dataset is most effective. We focus on selecting the right data to label, in addition to usual SSL’s propagating labels from given labeled data to the rest unlabeled data. This instance selection task is challenging, as without any labeled data we don’t know what the objective of learning should be. Intuitively, no matter what the downstream task is, instances to be labeled must be representative and diverse: The former would facilitate label propagation to unlabeled data, whereas the latter would ensure coverage of the entire dataset. We capture this idea by selecting cluster prototypes, either in a pretrained feature space, or along with the feature to be optimized for instance discrimination, both without labels. Our unsupervised selective labeling consistently improves SSL methods over state-of-the-art active learning given labeled data, by 8-25x in label efficiency. For example, it boosts FixMatch by 10%(14%) in accuracy on CIFAR-10(ImageNet-1K) with 0.08%(0.2%) labeled data, demonstrating that small computation spent on what data to label brings significant gain especially under a low annotation budget. Our work sets a new standard for practical SSL.

title: 艺术文本识别是一项极具挑战性的任务,具有广泛的应用范围。
title_en: Xudong Xie, Ling Fu, Zhifei Zhang, Zhaowen Wang, Xiang Bai
abstract: 艺术文本识别是一项极具挑战性的任务,具有广泛的应用范围。然而,当前的场景文本识别方法主要关注不规则文本,而未专门研究艺术文本。艺术文本识别的挑战包括特殊设计字体和效果带来的各种外观变化、字符之间的复杂连接和重叠,以及背景图案的严重干扰。为缓解这些问题,我们提出在三个层次上识别艺术文本。首先,应用角点来引导字符内部局部特征的提取,考虑到角结构对外观和形状的鲁棒性。这样,角点的离散性切断了字符之间的连接,角点的稀疏性提高了对背景干扰的鲁棒性。其次,我们设计了一个字符对比损失来建模字符级特征,提高字符分类的特征表示。第三,我们利用Transformer在图像级学习全局特征,并通过角点查询交叉注意力机制建模角点的全局关系。此外,我们提供了一个艺术文本数据集来基准性能。实验结果验证了我们提出的方法在艺术文本识别中的显著优越性,并在几个模糊和透视数据集上实现了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Artistic text recognition is an extremely challenging task with a wide range of applications. However, current scene text recognition methods mainly focus on irregular text while have not explored artistic text specifically. The challenges of artistic text recognition include the various appearance with special-designed fonts and effects, the complex connections and overlaps between characters, and the severe interference from background patterns. To alleviate these problems, we propose to recognize the artistic text at three levels. Firstly, corner points are applied to guide the extraction of local features inside characters, considering the robustness of corner structures to appearance and shape. In this way, the discreteness of the corner points cuts off the connection between characters, and the sparsity of them improves the robustness for background interference. Secondly, we design a character contrastive loss to model the character-level feature, improving the feature representation for character classification. Thirdly, we utilize Transformer to learn the global feature on image-level and model the global relationship of the corner points, with the assistance of a corner-query cross-attention mechanism. Besides, we provide an artistic text dataset to benchmark the performance. Experimental results verify the significant superiority of our proposed method on artistic text recognition and also achieve state-of-the-art performance on several blurred and perspective datasets.

title: 秦学斌, 戴航, 胡晓斌, 范登平, 邵玲, Luc Van Gool
title_en: Xuebin Qin, Hang Dai, Xiaobin Hu, Deng-Ping Fan, Ling Shao, Luc Van Gool
abstract: 我们对一种称为二元图像分割(DIS)的新任务进行了系统研究,该任务旨在从自然图像中分割出高精度对象。为此,我们收集了首个大规模DIS数据集,称为DIS5K,包含5,470张高分辨率(如2K、4K或更大)图像,涵盖各种背景下的伪装、显著或精细对象。DIS使用极细粒度标签进行标注。此外,我们引入了一个简单的中间监督基线(IS-Net),通过特征级和掩码级指导进行DIS模型训练。IS-Net在提出的DIS5K数据集上超越了各种前沿基线,使其成为一种通用的自学习监督网络,可促进未来DIS研究。进一步地,我们设计了一种称为人工校正努力(HCE)的新指标,该指标近似估算校正误检和漏检所需的鼠标点击操作次数。HCE用于衡量模型与实际应用之间的差距,从而可以补充现有指标。最后,我们进行了最大规模的基准测试,评估了16种代表性分割模型,提供了关于对象复杂性的更深入讨论,并展示了若干潜在应用(如背景移除、艺术设计、3D重建)。希望这些努力能为学术界和工业界开辟有前景的研究方向。项目页面:https://xuebinqin.github.io/dis/index.html
abstract_en: We present a systematic study on a new task called dichotomous image segmentation (DIS), which aims to segment highly accurate objects from natural images. To this end, we collected the first large-scale DIS dataset, called DIS5K, which contains 5,470 high-resolution (e.g., 2K, 4K or larger) images covering camouflaged, salient, or meticulous objects in various backgrounds. DIS is annotated with extremely fine-grained labels. Besides, we introduce a simple intermediate supervision baseline (IS-Net) using both feature-level and mask-level guidance for DIS model training. IS-Net outperforms various cutting-edge baselines on the proposed DIS5K, making it a general self-learned supervision network that can facilitate future research in DIS. Further, we design a new metric called human correction efforts (HCE) which approximates the number of mouse clicking operations required to correct the false positives and false negatives. HCE is utilized to measure the gap between models and real-world applications and thus can complement existing metrics. Finally, we conduct the largest-scale benchmark, evaluating 16 representative segmentation models, providing a more insightful discussion regarding object complexities, and showing several potential applications (e.g., background removal, art design, 3D reconstruction). Hoping these efforts can open up promising directions for both academic and industries. Project page: https://xuebinqin.github.io/dis/index.html.

title: Xuejun Yan, Hongyu Yan, Jingjing Wang, Hang Du, Zhihong Wu, Di Xie, Shiliang Pu, Li Lu
title_en: Xuejun Yan, Hongyu Yan, Jingjing Wang, Hang Du, Zhihong Wu, Di Xie, Shiliang Pu, Li Lu
abstract: 点云学习的快速发展推动了点云补全进入一个新时代。然而,大多数现有补全方法的信息流均为前馈式,高层信息很少被重新利用以提升低层特征学习。为此,我们提出了一种新颖的反馈网络(FBNet)用于点云补全,其中当前特征通过重定向后续的细粒度特征进行高效优化。首先,部分输入被馈送到分层图网络(HGNet)以生成粗略形状。然后,我们级联多个反馈感知补全(FBAC)模块,并在时间维度上展开。相邻时间步之间的反馈连接利用细粒度特征来改进当前形状生成。构建反馈连接的主要挑战是当前特征与后续特征之间的维度不匹配。为了解决这一问题,精心设计的点交叉变换器通过交叉注意力策略从反馈特征中提取高效信息,然后利用增强的反馈特征优化当前特征。在多个数据集上的定量和定性实验表明,所提出的FBNet在点云补全任务中优于现有最先进的方法。源代码和模型可在https://github.com/hikvision-research/3DVision/tree/main/PointCompletion/FBNet获取。
abstract_en: The rapid development of point cloud learning has driven point cloud completion into a new era. However, the information flows of most existing completion methods are solely feedforward, and high-level information is rarely reused to improve low-level feature learning. To this end, we propose a novel Feedback Network (FBNet) for point cloud completion, in which present features are efficiently refined by rerouting subsequent fine-grained ones. Firstly, partial inputs are fed to a Hierarchical Graph-based Network (HGNet) to generate coarse shapes. Then, we cascade several Feedback-Aware Completion (FBAC) Blocks and unfold them across time recurrently. Feedback connections between two adjacent time steps exploit fine-grained features to improve present shape generations. The main challenge of building feedback connections is the dimension mismatching between present and subsequent features. To address this, the elaborately designed point Cross Transformer exploits efficient information from feedback features via cross attention strategy and then refines present features with the enhanced feedback features. Quantitative and qualitative experiments on several datasets demonstrate the superiority of proposed FBNet compared to state-of-the-art methods on point completion task. The source code and model are available at https://github.com/hikvision-research/3DVision/tree/main/PointCompletion/FBNet.

title: Xueqing Deng, Dawei Sun, Shawn Newsam, Peng Wang
title_en: Xueqing Deng, Dawei Sun, Shawn Newsam, Peng Wang
abstract: 最近的知识蒸馏(KD)研究表明,不同的人工设计方案对学习结果有显著影响。然而,在KD中,自动搜索最优的蒸馏方案尚未得到充分探索。在本文中,我们提出了DistPro,一个新颖的框架,通过可微元学习搜索最优的KD过程。具体来说,给定一个学生网络和教师网络的对,DistPro首先从教师网络的传输层到学生网络的接收层建立丰富的KD路径,并同时提出各种变换,用于沿路径比较特征图以进行蒸馏。然后,每种路径和变换选择的组合都与一个随机加权过程相关联,该过程在蒸馏的每一步指示其重要性。在搜索阶段,我们的双层元优化策略可以有效地学习该过程。在蒸馏阶段,DistPro采用学习到的过程进行知识蒸馏,这显著提高了学生网络的准确性,尤其是在需要更快训练的情况下。最后,我们发现学习到的过程可以在相似任务和网络之间进行泛化。在我们的实验中,DistPro在流行数据集(如CIFAR100和ImageNet)上,在不同数量的学习周期下实现了最先进的(SoTA)准确性,这证明了我们框架的有效性。
abstract_en: Recent Knowledge distillation (KD) studies show that different manually designed schemes impact the learned results significantly. Yet, in KD, automatically searching an optimal distillation scheme has not yet been well explored. In this paper, we propose DistPro, a novel framework which searches for an optimal KD process via differentiable meta-learning. Specifically, given a pair of student and teacher networks, DistPro first sets up a rich set of KD pathways from the transmitting layers of the teacher to the receiving layers of the student, and in the meanwhile, various transforms are also proposed for comparing feature maps along a pathway for the distillation. Then, each combination of a pathway and a transform choice is associated with a stochastic weighting process which indicates its importance at every step during the distillation. In the searching stage, the process can be effectively learned through our proposed bi-level meta-optimization strategy. In the distillation stage, DistPro adopts the learned processes for knowledge distillation, which significantly improves the student accuracy especially when faster training is required. Lastly, we find the learned processes can be generalized between similar tasks and networks. In our experiments, DistPro produces state-of-the-art (SoTA) accuracy under varying number of learning epochs on popular datasets, i.e. CIFAR100 and ImageNet, which demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.

title: Xuesong Chen, Shaoshuai Shi, Benjin Zhu, Ka Chun Cheung, Hang Xu, Hongsheng Li
title_en: Xuesong Chen, Shaoshuai Shi, Benjin Zhu, Ka Chun Cheung, Hang Xu, Hongsheng Li
abstract: 准确且可靠的三维检测对于自动驾驶车辆和服务机器人等许多应用至关重要。本文提出了一种灵活且高性能的三维检测框架,名为MPPNet,用于点云序列的三维时序目标检测。我们提出了一种新颖的三级框架,通过代理点实现多帧特征编码与交互,以实现更优的检测效果。三级框架分别执行单帧特征编码、短片段特征融合和全序列特征聚合。为在合理计算资源下处理长序列点云,我们提出了组内特征混合和组间特征注意力机制,形成第二和第三级特征编码层次,通过递归应用以聚合多帧轨迹特征。代理点不仅作为每帧的一致性目标表示,还充当帧间特征交互的载体。在大型Waymo Open数据集上的实验表明,当应用于短(如4帧)和长(如16帧)点云序列时,我们的方法在多个指标上显著优于现有最先进的方法。代码将在https://github.com/open-mmlab/OpenPCDet公开。
abstract_en: Accurate and reliable 3D detection is vital for many applications including autonomous driving vehicles and service robots. In this paper, we present a flexible and high-performance 3D detection frame-work, named MPPNet, for 3D temporal object detection with point cloud sequences. We propose a novel three-hierarchy framework with proxy points for multi-frame feature encoding and interactions to achieve better detection. The three hierarchies conduct per-frame feature encoding, short-clip feature fusion, and whole-sequence feature aggregation, respectively. To enable processing long-sequence point clouds with reasonable computational resources, intra-group feature mixing and inter-group feature attention are proposed to form the second and third feature encoding hierarchies, which are recurrently applied for aggregating multi-frame trajectory features. The proxy points not only act as consistent object representations for each frame, but also serves as the courier to facilitate feature interaction between frames. The experiments on large Waymo Open dataset show that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods with large margins when applied to both short (e.g., 4-frame) and long (e.g., 16-frame) point cloud sequences. Code will be publicly available at https://github.com/open-mmlab/OpenPCDet.

title: Xueting Li, Xiaolong Wang, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Alexei A. Efros, Sifei Liu
title_en: Xueting Li, Xiaolong Wang, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Alexei A. Efros, Sifei Liu
abstract: 现有的纹理合成方法主要关注于基于小尺寸纹理样本生成大尺寸纹理图像。但此类样本通常被假设为高度整理过的:矩形、干净且静态的。本文旨在直接从日常物体和场景的自然图像中提取纹理,构建纹理模型,并将其应用于纹理合成、纹理编辑等任务。关键思想是联合学习图像分组与纹理建模。图像分组模块发现干净的纹理段,每个纹理段由纹理建模模块表示为一个纹理编码和一个参数化正弦波。通过强制模型从纹理编码和正弦波中重建输入图像,我们的模型可以通过自监督方式在一组杂乱的自然图像上进行学习,无需任何标注或干净纹理图像。我们证明所学习的纹理特征能够捕捉真实图像中的许多自然和人工纹理,并可应用于纹理合成、纹理编辑和纹理交换等任务。
abstract_en: Existing texture synthesis methods focus on generating large texture images given a small texture sample. But such samples are typically assumed to be highly curated: rectangular, clean, and stationary. This paper aims to scrape textures directly from natural images of everyday objects and scenes, build texture models, and employ them for texture synthesis, texture editing, etc. The key idea is to jointly learn image grouping and texture modeling. The image grouping module discovers clean texture segments, each of which is represented as a texture code and a parametric sine wave by the texture modeling module. By enforcing the model to reconstruct the input image from the texture codes and sine waves, our model can be learned via self-supervision on a set of cluttered natural images, without requiring any form of annotation or clean texture images. We show that the learned texture features capture many natural and man-made textures in real images, and can be applied to tasks like texture synthesis, texture editing and texture swapping.

title: Xuhui Tian, Xinran Lin, Fan Zhong, Xueying Qin
title_en: Xuhui Tian, Xinran Lin, Fan Zhong, Xueying Qin
abstract: 基于优化的三维目标跟踪方法以精度高和速度较快著称,但容易受到帧间大位移的影响,由于局部极小值的存在,通常需要大量计算才能克服。本文提出了一种快速有效的非局部三维跟踪方法。基于局部极小值主要由面外旋转引起的观察结果,我们提出了一种结合非局部和局部优化的混合方法,针对不同参数进行优化,从而在6D位姿空间中实现高效的非局部搜索。此外,还提出了一种预计算的鲁棒轮廓基跟踪方法用于局部优化。通过使用长搜索线和多个候选对应关系,该方法能够更好地适应不同的帧位移,无需进行由粗到细的搜索。预计算完成后,姿态更新可以非常快速地进行,从而实现实时非局部优化。我们的方法在小位移和大位移情况下均优于所有先前方法。对于大位移情况,精度显著提高(81.7% vs. 19.4%)。同时,仅使用CPU即可实现实时速度(>50fps)。源代码可在https://github.com/cvbubbles/nonlocal-3dtracking获取。
abstract_en: Optimization-based 3D object tracking is known to be precise and fast, but sensitive to large inter-frame displacements due to the local minimum, which usually requires large amount of computation to be overcome. In this paper we propose a fast and effective non-local 3D tracking method. Based on the observation that local minimum are mostly due to the out-of-plane rotation, we propose a hybrid approach combining non-local and local optimizations for different parameters, resulting in efficient non-local search in the 6D pose space. In addition, a precomputed robust contour-based tracking method is proposed for the local optimization. By using long search lines with multiple candidate correspondences, it can better adaptive to different frame displacements without the need of coarse-to-fine search. After the pre-computation, pose updates can be conducted very fast, enabling the non-local optimization in real time. Our method outperforms all previous methods for both small and large displacements. For large displacements, the accuracy is greatly improved (81.7% v.s.19.4%).
