title: Ye Huang, Di Kang, Liang Chen, Xuefei Zhe, Wenjing Jia, Linchao Bao, Xiangjian He
title_en: Ye Huang, Di Kang, Liang Chen, Xuefei Zhe, Wenjing Jia, Linchao Bao, Xiangjian He
abstract: Recent segmentation methods, such as OCR and CPNet, utilizing “class level” information in addition to pixel features, have achieved notable success for boosting the accuracy of existing network modules. However, the extracted class-level information was simply concatenated to pixel features, without explicitly being exploited for better pixel representation learning. Moreover, these approaches learn soft class centers based on coarse mask prediction, which is prone to error accumulation. In this paper, aiming to use class level information more effectively, we propose a universal Class-Aware Regularization (CAR) approach to optimize the intra-class variance and inter-class distance during feature learning, motivated by the fact that humans can recognize an object by itself no matter which other objects it appears with. Three novel loss functions are proposed. The first loss function encourages more compact class representations within each class, the second directly maximizes the distance between different class centers, and the third further pushes the distance between inter-class centers and pixels. Furthermore, the class center in our approach is directly generated from ground truth instead of from the error-prone coarse prediction. Our method can be easily applied to most existing segmentation models during training, including OCR and CPNet, and can largely improve their accuracy at no additional inference overhead. Extensive experiments and ablation studies conducted on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed CAR can boost the accuracy of all baseline models by up to 2.23% mIOU with superior generalization ability. The complete code is available at https://github.com/edwardyehuang/CAR.
abstract_en: Recent segmentation methods, such as OCR and CPNet, utilizing “class level” information in addition to pixel features, have achieved notable success for boosting the accuracy of existing network modules. However, the extracted class-level information was simply concatenated to pixel features, without explicitly being exploited for better pixel representation learning. In this paper, aiming to use class level information more effectively, we propose a universal Class-Aware Regularization (CAR) approach to optimize the intra-class variance and inter-class distance during feature learning, motivated by the fact that humans can recognize an object by itself no matter which other objects it appears with. title: Ye Yu, Jialin Yuan, Gaurav Mittal, Li Fuxin, Mei Chen
title_en: Ye Yu, Jialin Yuan, Gaurav Mittal, Li Fuxin, Mei Chen
abstract: 视频对象分割(VOS)是视频理解的基础。基于Transformer的方法在半监督VOS任务中表现出显著的性能提升。然而,现有方法在分割彼此接近且视觉相似的对象时面临挑战。本文提出了一种新颖的运动-外观邻近空间双边注意力Transformer(BATMAN),用于半监督VOS。该方法通过新颖的光流校准模块捕捉视频中的对象运动,该模块将分割掩码与光流估计融合,以提升对象内部光流平滑度并减少对象边界噪声。随后,校准后的光流被用于我们的双边注意力机制,该机制在考虑运动和外观的邻近双边空间中计算查询帧与参考帧之间的对应关系。大量实验验证了BATMAN架构的有效性,在四个流行的VOS基准测试中均优于所有现有最先进的方法:YouTube-VOS 2019(85.0%)、YouTube-VOS 2018(85.3%)、DAVIS 2017Val/Test-dev(86.2%/82.2%)和DAVIS 2016(92.5%)。
abstract_en: Video Object Segmentation (VOS) is fundamental to video understanding. Transformer-based methods show significant performance improvement on semi-supervised VOS. However, existing work faces challenges segmenting visually similar objects in close proximity of each other. In this paper, we propose a novel Bilateral Attention Transformer in Motion-Appearance Neighboring space (BATMAN) for semi-supervised VOS. It captures object motion in the video via a novel optical flow calibration module that fuses the segmentation mask with optical flow estimation to improve within-object optical flow smoothness and reduce noise at object boundaries. This calibrated optical flow is then employed in our novel bilateral attention, which computes the correspondence between the query and reference frames in the neighboring bilateral space considering both motion and appearance. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of BATMAN architecture by outperforming all existing state-of-the-art on all four popular VOS benchmarks: Youtube-VOS 2019 (85.0%), Youtube-VOS 2018 (85.3%), DAVIS 2017Val/Test-dev (86.2%/82.2%), and DAVIS 2016 (92.5%).

title: Ye Zhu, Kyle Olszewski, Yu Wu, Panos Achlioptas, Menglei Chai, Yan Yan, Sergey Tulyakov
title_en: Ye Zhu, Kyle Olszewski, Yu Wu, Panos Achlioptas, Menglei Chai, Yan Yan, Sergey Tulyakov
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的对抗性多模态框架Dance2Music-GAN(D2M-GAN),该框架能够根据舞蹈视频生成复杂的音乐样本。我们的框架以舞蹈视频帧和人体运动作为输入,学习生成与输入相匹配的音乐样本。与大多数现有条件音乐生成工作不同,这些工作通常使用符号音频表示(如MIDI)生成特定类型的单乐器声音,并依赖预定义的音乐合成器,本文中我们采用向量量化(VQ)音频表示生成复杂风格的舞蹈音乐(如流行、Breaking等),并利用其符号表示和连续表示的通用性和高抽象能力。通过在多个数据集上进行大量实验,并遵循全面的评估协议,我们评估了我们的方法与现有方法的生成质量。所获得的定量结果,衡量了音乐一致性、节奏对应性和音乐多样性,证明了我们方法的有效性。最后但同样重要的是,我们整理了一个野外TikTok视频的挑战性舞蹈音乐数据集,用于进一步验证我们的方法在现实应用中的效果——并希望该数据集能成为相关未来研究的起点。
abstract_en: We present Dance2Music-GAN (D2M-GAN), a novel adversarial multi-modal framework that generates complex musical samples conditioned on dance videos. Our proposed framework takes dance video frames and human body motions as input, and learns to generate music samples that plausibly accompany the corresponding input. Unlike most existing conditional music generation works that generate specific types of mono-instrumental sounds using symbolic audio representations (e.g., MIDI), and that usually rely on pre-defined musical synthesizers, in this work we generate dance music in complex styles (e.g., pop, breaking, etc.) by employing a Vector Quantized (VQ) audio representation, and leverage both its generality and high abstraction capacity of its symbolic and continuous counterparts. By performing an extensive set of experiments on multiple datasets, and following a comprehensive evaluation protocol, we assess the generative qualities of our proposal against alternatives. The attained quantitative results, which measure the music consistency, beats correspondence, and music diversity, demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method. Last but not least, we curate a challenging dance-music dataset of in-the-wild TikTok videos, which we use to further demonstrate the efficacy of our approach in real-world applications -- and which we hope to serve as a starting point for relevant future research.

title: Yen-Cheng Liu, Chih-Yao Ma, Xiaoliang Dai, Junjiao Tian, Peter Vajda, Zijian He, Zsolt Kira
title_en: Yen-Cheng Liu, Chih-Yao Ma, Xiaoliang Dai, Junjiao Tian, Peter Vajda, Zijian He, Zsolt Kira
abstract: 近年来,半监督目标检测(SSOD)的发展表明,利用未标记数据可以提升目标检测器的性能。然而,现有方法均假设未标记数据不包含分布外(OOD)类别,这在大规模未标记数据集中并不现实。本文考虑了一个更具实际意义但更具挑战性的问题——开放集半监督目标检测(OSSOD)。我们首先发现现有SSOD方法在开放集条件下性能提升有限,这是由于语义扩展现象,即分布外对象被错误预测为分布内伪标签,干扰半监督训练。为解决此问题,我们引入在线和离线分布外检测模块,并将其集成到SSOD方法中。通过广泛研究发现,基于自监督视觉Transformer的离线分布外检测器相比在线检测器更具鲁棒性,因其能有效抵抗伪标签的干扰。实验表明,所提框架有效缓解了语义扩展问题,并在多个OSSOD基准数据集(包括大规模COCO-OpenImages)上实现了稳定提升。我们还验证了框架在不同OSSOD条件下的有效性,包括分布内类别数量变化、监督程度差异以及未标记集组合差异。
abstract_en: Recent developments for Semi-Supervised Object Detection (SSOD) have shown the promise of leveraging unlabeled data to improve an object detector. However, thus far these methods have assumed that the unlabeled data does not contain out-of-distribution (OOD) classes, which is unrealistic with larger-scale unlabeled datasets. In this paper, we consider a more practical yet challenging problem, Open-Set Semi-Supervised Object Detection (OSSOD). We first find the existing SSOD method obtains a lower performance gain in open-set conditions, and this is caused by the semantic expansion, where the distracting OOD objects are mispredicted as in-distribution pseudo-labels for the semi-supervised training. To address this problem, we consider online and offline OOD detection modules, which are integrated with SSOD methods. With the extensive studies, we found that leveraging an offline OOD detector based on a self-supervised vision transformer performs favorably against online OOD detectors due to its robustness to the interference of pseudo-labeling. In the experiment, our proposed framework effectively addresses the semantic expansion issue and shows consistent improvements on many OSSOD benchmarks, including large-scale COCO-OpenImages. We also verify the effectiveness of our framework under different OSSOD conditions, including varying numbers of in-distribution classes, different degrees of supervision, and different combinations of unlabeled sets.

title: Yew Lee Tan, Adams Wai-Kin Kong, Jung-Jae Kim
title_en: Yew Lee Tan, Adams Wai-Kin Kong, Jung-Jae Kim
abstract: 场景文本识别(STR)涉及在自然场景裁剪图像中阅读文本的任务。传统STR模型采用卷积神经网络(CNN)后接循环神经网络的编码器-解码器框架。近年来,Transformer架构因其在捕捉长期依赖性方面的强大能力被广泛应用于STR领域,这种长期依赖性在场景文本图像中尤为显著。许多研究人员将Transformer作为混合CNN-Transformer编码器的一部分,通常后接Transformer解码器。然而,此类方法仅在编码过程中中期利用长期依赖性。尽管视觉Transformer(ViT)能够在早期阶段捕捉这种依赖性,但其在STR中的应用仍被严重忽视。本文提出了一种仅使用Transformer的模型作为简单基线,其性能优于混合CNN-Transformer模型。此外,识别出两个关键改进方向。首先,第一个解码字符的预测准确率最低。其次,不同原始宽高比的图像对图像块分辨率的反应存在差异,而ViT仅采用固定单一图像块分辨率。为探索这些领域,提出了一种集成专家的纯Transformer模型(PTIE)。PTIE是一种能够处理多种图像块分辨率并在原始和逆字符顺序下解码的Transformer模型。该模型在7个常用基准数据集上进行了测试,并与超过20种最先进的方法进行了比较。实验结果表明,所提出的方法在大多数基准数据集上均优于现有方法,取得了最先进的结果。
abstract_en: Scene text recognition (STR) involves the task of reading text in cropped images of natural scenes. Conventional models in STR employ convolutional neural network (CNN) followed by recurrent neural network in an encoder-decoder framework. In recent times, the transformer architecture is being widely adopted in STR as it shows strong capability in capturing long-term dependency which appears to be prominent in scene text images. Many researchers utilized transformer as part of a hybrid CNN-transformer encoder, often followed by a transformer decoder. However, such methods only make use of the long-term dependency mid-way through the encoding process. Although the vision transformer (ViT) is able to capture such dependency at an early stage, its utilization remains largely unexploited in STR. This work proposes the use of a transformer-only model as a simple baseline which outperforms hybrid CNN-transformer models. Furthermore, two key areas for improvement were identified. Firstly, the first decoded character has the lowest prediction accuracy. Secondly, images of different original aspect ratios react differently to the patch resolutions while ViT only employ one fixed patch resolution. To explore these areas, Pure Transformer with Integrated Experts (PTIE) is proposed. PTIE is a transformer model that can process multiple patch resolutions and decode in both the original and reverse character orders. It is examined on 7 commonly used benchmarks and compared with over 20 state-of-the-art methods. The experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms them and obtains state-of-the-art results in most benchmarks.

title: Yeying Jin, Wenhan Yang, Robby T. Tan
title_en: Yeying Jin, Wenhan Yang, Robby T. Tan
abstract: 夜间图像不仅存在低光照问题,还面临光照分布不均的挑战。现有大多数夜间可见性增强方法主要聚焦于增强低光照区域,这不可避免地导致亮区域出现过度增强和饱和现象,例如受光效应影响的区域(如眩光、强光等)。为解决这一问题,我们需要在抑制亮区域光效应的同时,增强暗区域的亮度。基于此思路,我们提出一种无监督方法,结合层分解网络与光效应抑制网络。给定单张夜间图像作为输入,我们的分解网络通过无监督层特定先验损失引导,学习将图像分解为遮挡层、反射层和光效应层。光效应抑制网络进一步抑制光效应,并同时增强暗区域的光照。该网络利用估计的光效应层作为指导,聚焦于光效应区域。为恢复背景细节并减少幻觉/伪影,我们提出结构一致性与高频一致性损失。在真实图像上的定量与定性评估表明,我们的方法在抑制夜间光效应和增强暗区域亮度方面均优于现有最先进方法。我们的数据与代码已开源:https://github.com/jinyeying/night-enhancement
abstract_en: Night images suffer not only from low light, but also from uneven distributions of light. Most existing night visibility enhancement methods focus mainly on enhancing low-light regions. This inevitably leads to over enhancement and saturation in bright regions, such as those regions affected by light effects (glare, floodlight, etc). To address this problem, we need to suppress the light effects in bright regions while, at the same time, boosting the intensity of dark regions. With this idea in mind, we introduce an unsupervised method that integrates a layer decomposition network and a light-effects suppression network. Given a single night image as input, our decomposition network learns to decompose shading, reflectance and light-effects layers, guided by unsupervised layer-specific prior losses. Our light-effects suppression network further suppresses the light effects and, at the same time, enhances the illumination in dark regions. This light-effects suppression network exploits the estimated light-effects layer as the guidance to focus on the light-effects regions. To recover the background details and reduce hallucination/artefacts, we propose structure and high-frequency consistency losses. Our quantitative and qualitative evaluations on real images show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods in suppressing night light effects and boosting the intensity of dark regions. Our data and code is available at: https://github.com/jinyeying/night-enhancement>

title: Yi Sun, Jian Li, Xin Xu
title_en: Yi Sun, Jian Li, Xin Xu
abstract: 大多数最先进的深度神经网络使用静态推理图,这使得此类网络无法根据输入数据的复杂性动态调整网络的深度或宽度。与这些静态模型不同,深度自适应神经网络(例如多出口网络)通过根据输入进行自适应推理来提高计算效率。为了实现自适应推理,多出口网络在不同深度处附加多个输出出口。不幸的是,这些出口在训练阶段通常会相互干扰。这种干扰会降低模型性能,并对收敛速度产生负面影响。为了解决这一问题,我们研究了这些多出口网络的梯度冲突,并提出了一种基于元学习的新型训练范式,即Meta-GF(元梯度融合),以和谐地训练这些出口。与现有方法不同,Meta-GF考虑了共享参数对每个出口的重要性,并通过元学习得到的权重融合每个出口的梯度。在CIFAR和ImageNet上的实验结果验证了所提方法的有效性。此外,所提出的Meta-GF无需对网络结构进行修改,可直接与先前的训练技术结合。代码可在https://github.com/SYVAE/MetaGF获取。
abstract_en: Most state-of-the-art deep neural networks use static inference graphs, which makes it impossible for such networks to dynamically adjust the depth or width of the network according to the complexity of the input data. Different from these static models, depth-adaptive neural networks, e.g. the multi-exit networks, aim at improving the computation efficiency by conducting adaptive inference conditioned on the input. To achieve adaptive inference, multiple output exits are attached at different depths of the multi-exit networks. Unfortunately, these exits usually interfere with each other in the training stage. The interference would reduce performance of the models and cause negative influences on the convergence speed. To address this problem, we investigate the gradient conflict of these multi-exit networks, and propose a novel meta-learning based training paradigm namely Meta-GF(meta gradient fusion) to harmoniously train these exits. Different from existing approaches, Meta-GF takes account of the importances of the shared parameters to each exit, and fuses the gradients of each exit by the meta-learned weights. Experimental results on CIFAR and ImageNet verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. Furthermore, the proposed Meta-GF requires no modification on the network structures and can be directly combined with previous training techniques. The code is available at https://github.com/SYVAE/MetaGF.

title: Yi Wang, Menghan Xia, Lu Qi, Jing Shao, Yu Qiao
title_en: Yi Wang, Menghan Xia, Lu Qi, Jing Shao, Yu Qiao
abstract: 多模态歧义和颜色渗漏仍是上色任务中的挑战性问题。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种基于生成对抗网络的新型上色方法PalGAN,集成了调色板估计和色度注意力机制。为规避多模态问题,我们提出了一种新的上色公式:首先从输入灰度图像中估计概率调色板,再通过生成模型基于该调色板进行颜色分配。进一步地,我们采用色度注意力机制处理颜色渗漏问题,通过同时考虑语义和强度相关性研究颜色亲和性。在大量实验中,PalGAN在定量评估和视觉比较中均优于现有方法,能够生成具有显著多样性、对比度和边缘保持效果的图像。借助调色板设计,我们的方法即使在无关上下文中也能实现图像间的颜色迁移。
abstract_en: Multimodal ambiguity and color bleeding remain challenging in colorization. To tackle these problems, we propose a new GAN-based colorization approach PalGAN, integrated with palette estimation and chromatic attention. To circumvent the multimodality issue, we present a new colorization formulation that estimates a probabilistic palette from the input gray image first, then conducts color assignment conditioned on the palette through a generative model. Further, we handle color bleeding with chromatic attention. It studies color affinities by considering both semantic and intensity correlation. In extensive experiments, PalGAN outperforms state-of-the-arts in quantitative evaluation and visual comparison, delivering notable diverse, contrastive, and edge-preserving appearances. With the palette design, our method enables color transfer between images even with irrelevant contexts.

title: Yi Wei, Zibu Wei, Yongming Rao, Jiaxin Li, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu
title_en: Yi Wei, Zibu Wei, Yongming Rao, Jiaxin Li, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu
abstract: 本文提出激光雷达蒸馏(LiDAR Distillation)方法,以弥合由不同激光雷达光束数量导致的3D目标检测领域差距。在许多实际应用场景中,量产机器人和车辆使用的激光雷达点云通常比大规模公开数据集中的激光雷达光束数量更少。此外,随着激光雷达升级为不同光束数量的产品型号,利用先前高分辨率传感器采集的标注数据变得更具挑战性。尽管近期在域自适应3D检测方面取得了进展,但大多数方法仍难以消除由光束数量差异引起的领域差距。我们发现,在训练过程中对源域和目标域的点云密度进行对齐至关重要。受此启发,我们提出了一种渐进式框架以缓解由光束数量差异引起的领域偏移。在每次迭代中,我们首先通过下采样高光束点云生成低光束伪激光雷达点云。然后采用教师-学生框架,从光束数量更多的数据中蒸馏丰富的信息。在Waymo、nuScenes和KITTI数据集上,使用三种不同的激光雷达基检测器进行的大量实验验证了我们激光雷达蒸馏方法的有效性。值得注意的是,我们的方法在推理过程中不增加任何额外的计算成本。代码已开源至https://github.com/weiyithu/LiDAR-Distillation。
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose the LiDAR Distillation to bridge the domain gap induced by different LiDAR beams for 3D object detection. In many real-world applications, the LiDAR points used by mass-produced robots and vehicles usually have fewer beams than that in large-scale public datasets. Moreover, as the LiDARs are upgraded to other product models with different beam amount, it becomes challenging to utilize the labeled data captured by previous versions’ high-resolution sensors. Despite the recent progress on domain adaptive 3D detection, most methods struggle to eliminate the beam-induced domain gap. We find that it is essential to align the point cloud density of the source domain with that of the target domain during the training process. Inspired by this discovery, we propose a progressive framework to mitigate the beam-induced domain shift. In each iteration, we first generate low-beam pseudo LiDAR by downsampling the high-beam point clouds. Then the teacher-student framework is employed to distill rich information from the data with more beams. Extensive experiments on Waymo, nuScenes and KITTI datasets with three different LiDAR-based detectors demonstrate the effectiveness of our LiDAR Distillation. Notably, our approach does not increase any additional computation cost for inference. Code is available at https://github.com/weiyithu/LiDAR-Distillation.

title: Yi-Ting Chen, Jinghao Shi, Zelin Ye, Christoph Mertz, Deva Ramanan, Shu Kong
title_en: Yi-Ting Chen, Jinghao Shi, Zelin Ye, Christoph Mertz, Deva Ramanan, Shu Kong
abstract: 多模态输入的物体检测可以提升许多安全关键系统(如自动驾驶汽车(AVs))的性能。受AVs在昼夜均需运行的启发,我们研究了使用RGB和热成像相机的多模态物体检测,因为后者在光照条件差时能提供更强的物体特征。我们探索了不同模态间信息融合的策略。我们的主要贡献是一种概率集成技术ProbEn,这是一种简单且无需学习的融合方法,可将多模态检测结果进行整合。我们从贝叶斯规则和模态间条件独立性的基本原理推导出ProbEn。通过概率边缘化,ProbEn优雅地处理了当检测器未在同一物体上触发时缺失模态的情况。重要的是,即使条件独立性假设不成立,ProbEn也能显著提升多模态检测性能,例如融合其他融合方法(包括现成方法和内部训练方法)的输出。我们在包含对齐(KAIST)和非对齐(FLIR)多模态图像的两个基准数据集上验证了ProbEn,结果显示ProbEn在相对性能上优于先前工作超过{\bf 13\%}!
abstract_en: Object detection with multimodal inputs can improve many safety-critical systems such as autonomous vehicles (AVs). Motivated by AVs that operate in both day and night, we study multimodal object detection with RGB and thermal cameras, since the latter provides much stronger object signatures under poor illumination. We explore strategies for fusing information from different modalities. Our key contribution is a probabilistic ensembling technique, ProbEn, a simple non-learned method that fuses together detections from multi-modalities. We derive ProbEn from Bayes’ rule and first principles that assume conditional independence across modalities. Through probabilistic marginalization, ProbEn elegantly handles missing modalities when detectors do not fire on the same object. Importantly, ProbEn also notably improves multimodal detection even when the conditional independence assumption does not hold, e.g., fusing outputs from other fusion methods (both off-the-shelf and trained in-house). We validate ProbEn on two benchmarks containing both aligned (KAIST) and unaligned (FLIR) multimodal images, showing that ProbEn outperforms prior work by more than {\bf 13\%} in relative performance!

title: Yian Wang, Ruihai Wu, Kaichun Mo, Jiaqi Ke, Qingnan Fan, Leonidas J. Guibas, Hao Dong
title_en: Yian Wang, Ruihai Wu, Kaichun Mo, Jiaqi Ke, Qingnan Fan, Leonidas J. Guibas, Hao Dong
abstract: 感知和与三维可变形物体(如橱柜、门和水龙头)进行交互,为未来在人类环境中执行日常任务的家庭助手机器人带来了特定挑战。除了解析可变形部件和关节参数,研究人员最近倡导在输入形状几何上学习操作可能性,这种做法更具任务意识且几何细节更精细。然而,现有方法仅将被动观察作为输入,忽略了诸多隐藏但重要的运动学约束(如关节位置和限制)和动力学因素(如关节摩擦和恢复系数),导致在存在此类不确定性的测试案例中出现显著精度损失。本文提出了一种名为AdaAfford的新颖框架,该框架通过极少的测试时交互快速调整可及性先验以获得更精确的实例特定后验。我们使用PartNet-Mobility数据集进行了大规模实验,证明我们的系统优于基线方法。论文被接受后,我们将发布代码和数据。
abstract_en: Perceiving and interacting with 3D articulated objects, such as cabinets, doors, and faucets, pose particular challenges for future home-assistant robots performing daily tasks in human environments. Besides parsing the articulated parts and joint parameters, researchers recently advocate learning manipulation affordance over the input shape geometry which is more task-aware and geometrically fine-grained. However, taking only passive observations as inputs, these methods ignore many hidden but important kinematic constraints (e.g., joint location and limits) and dynamic factors (e.g., joint friction and restitution), therefore losing significant accuracy for test cases with such uncertainties. In this paper, we propose a novel framework, named AdaAfford, that learns to perform very few test-time interactions for quickly adapting the affordance priors to more accurate instance-specific posteriors. We conduct large-scale experiments using the PartNet-Mobility dataset and prove that our system performs better than baselines. We will release our code and data upon paper acceptance.

title: Yibo Shi, Yunying Ge, Jing Wang, Jue Mao
title_en: Yibo Shi, Yunying Ge, Jing Wang, Jue Mao
abstract: 近年来,学习视频压缩技术受到了广泛关注,并呈现出快速发展的趋势,取得了有希望的成果。然而,先前的研究仍存在一些关键问题,在广泛使用的PSNR度量指标上与传统压缩标准存在性能差距。本文提出几种技术以有效提升性能。首先,为解决累积误差问题,我们在GoP中引入条件I帧作为首帧,从而稳定重建质量并节省比特率。其次,为在不增加解码器复杂度的前提下高效提升帧间预测准确性,我们在编码器端提出一种像素到特征的运动预测方法,帮助我们获取高质量的运动信息。第三,我们提出一种基于概率的熵跳过方法,不仅带来性能提升,还大幅降低熵编码的运行时间。借助这些强大技术,本文提出AlphaVC,一种高性能且高效的基于学习的视频压缩方案。据我们所知,AlphaVC是首个在所有常见测试数据集上均超越最新压缩标准VVC的端到端AI编解码器(PSNR指标BD率节省-28.2%,MSSSIM指标BD率节省-52.2%),且具有非常快速的编码(0.001x VVC)和解码(1.69x VVC)速度。
abstract_en: Recently, learned video compression has drawn lots of attention and show a rapid development trend with promising results. However, the previous works still suffer from some criticial issues and have a performance gap with traditional compression standards in terms of widely used PSNR metric. In this paper, we propose several techniques to effectively improve the performance. First, to address the problem of accumulative error, we introduce a conditional-I-frame as the first frame in the GoP, which stabilizes the reconstructed quality and saves the bit-rate. Second, to efficiently improve the accuracy of inter prediction without increasing the complexity of decoder, we propose a pixel-to-feature motion prediction method at encoder side that helps us to obtain high-quality motion information. Third, we propose a probability-based entropy skipping method, which not only brings performance gain, but also greatly reduces the runtime of entropy coding. With these powerful techniques, this paper proposes AlphaVC, a high-performance and efficient learned video compression scheme. To the best of our knowledge, AlphaVC is the first E2E AI codec that exceeds the latest compression standard VVC on all common test datasets for both PSNR (-28.2% BD-rate saving) and MSSSIM (-52.2% BD-rate saving), and has very fast encoding (0.001x VVC) and decoding (1.69x VVC) speeds.

title: Yichen Sheng, Yifan Liu, Jianming Zhang, Wei Yin, A. Cengiz Oztireli, He Zhang, Zhe Lin, Eli Shechtman, Bedrich Benes
title_en: Yichen Sheng, Yifan Liu, Jianming Zhang, Wei Yin, A. Cengiz Oztireli, He Zhang, Zhe Lin, Eli Shechtman, Bedrich Benes
abstract: 阴影对于逼真图像合成至关重要。基于物理的阴影渲染方法需要三维几何结构,而这些结构并不总是可用。基于深度学习的阴影合成方法通过学习从光源信息到物体阴影的映射,无需显式建模阴影几何结构。然而,这些方法缺乏控制能力且容易产生视觉伪影。我们引入了“像素高度”这一新颖的几何表示方法,该方法编码了物体、地面和相机姿态之间的相关性。像素高度可以从三维几何结构计算得出,也可以手动标注在二维图像上,并且可以通过监督方法从单视角RGB图像预测得出。它能够基于投影几何学在二维图像中计算硬阴影,从而提供对阴影方向和形状的精确控制。此外,我们提出了一种数据驱动的软阴影生成器,根据软度输入参数对硬阴影进行软化处理。定性与定量评估表明,所提出的像素高度显著提升了阴影生成的质量,同时实现了可控性。
abstract_en: Shadows are essential for realistic image compositing. Physics based shadow rendering methods require 3D geometries, which are not always available. Deep learning-based shadow synthesis methods learn a mapping from the light information to an object’s shadow without explicitly modeling the shadow geometry. Still, they lack control and are prone to visual artifacts. We introduce “Pixel Height”, a novel geometry representation that encodes the correlations between objects, ground, and camera pose. The Pixel Height can be calculated from 3D geometries, manually annotated on 2D images, and it can also be predicted from a single-view RGB image by a supervised approach. It can be used to calculate hard shadows in a 2D image based on the projective geometry, providing precise control of the shadows’ direction and shape. Furthermore, we propose a data-driven soft shadow generator to apply softness to a hard shadow based on a softness input parameter. Qualitative and quantitative evaluations demonstrate that the proposed Pixel Height significantly improves the quality of the shadow generation while allowing for controllability.

title: Yidi Shao, Chen Change Loy, Bo Dai
title_en: Yidi Shao, Chen Change Loy, Bo Dai
abstract: 基于粒子的系统提供了一种灵活且统一的方式来模拟具有复杂动态的物理系统。大多数现有的基于粒子系统的数据驱动模拟器采用图神经网络(GNNs)作为其网络主干,因为粒子及其相互作用可以自然地通过图节点和图边表示。然而,尽管基于粒子的系统通常包含数百甚至数千个粒子,但将粒子相互作用显式建模为图边不可避免地导致显著的计算开销,这是由于粒子相互作用数量的增加。因此,本文提出了一种新型的基于Transformer的方法,称为具有隐式边的Transformer(TIE),以无需边的方式捕捉粒子相互作用的丰富语义。TIE的核心思想是将涉及成对粒子相互作用的计算分散到每个粒子的更新中。这是通过调整自注意力模块以模拟GNN中图边更新公式实现的。为了提高TIE的泛化能力,我们进一步引入可学习的材料特定抽象粒子来分离全局材料语义与局部粒子语义。我们在不同复杂度和材料的多样化领域评估了我们的模型。与现有的基于GNN的方法相比,TIE在无需额外优化的情况下实现了所有这些领域中更优的性能和泛化能力。代码和模型可在https://github.com/ftbabi/TIE_ECCV2022.git获取。
abstract_en: Particle-based systems provide a flexible and unified way to simulate physics systems with complex dynamics. Most existing data-driven simulators for particle-based systems adopt graph neural networks (GNNs) as their network backbones, as particles and their interactions can be naturally represented by graph nodes and graph edges. However, while particle-based systems usually contain hundreds even thousands of particles, the explicit modeling of particle interactions as graph edges inevitably leads to a significant computational overhead, due to the increased number of particle interactions. Consequently, in this paper we propose a novel Transformer-based method, dubbed as Transformer with Implicit Edges (TIE), to capture the rich semantics of particle interactions in an edge-free manner. The core idea of TIE is to decentralize the computation involving pair-wise particle interactions into per-particle updates. This is achieved by adjusting the self-attention module to resemble the update formula of graph edges in GNN. To improve the generalization ability of TIE, we further amend TIE with learnable material-specific abstract particles to disentangle global material-wise semantics from local particle-wise semantics. We evaluate our model on diverse domains of varying complexity and materials. Compared with existing GNN-based methods, without bells and whistles, TIE achieves superior performance and generalization across all these domains. Codes and models are available at https://github.com/ftbabi/TIE_ECCV2022.git.

title: Yifan Jiang, Bartlomiej Wronski, Ben Mildenhall, Jonathan T. Barron, Zhangyang Wang, Tianfan Xue
title_en: Yifan Jiang, Bartlomiej Wronski, Ben Mildenhall, Jonathan T. Barron, Zhangyang Wang, Tianfan Xue
abstract: 大多数图像去噪网络在整个输入图像上应用单一的静态卷积核集合。这对于自然图像来说是次优的,因为自然图像通常由异质的视觉模式组成。动态卷积试图通过使用逐像素卷积核来解决这一问题,但这种方法大大增加了计算成本。在本文中,我们提出了可塑卷积(MalleConv),它能够以最小的计算开销实现空间变化处理。MalleConv使用一组较小的空间变化卷积核,这是静态卷积核和逐像素卷积核之间的折中方案。这些空间变化卷积核由一个在下采样输入上运行的高效预测网络生成,因此比由全分辨率图像生成的逐像素卷积核计算效率更高,同时相比静态卷积核扩大了网络的感受野。这些卷积核随后通过一个高效的实时切片操作符进行联合上采样,并以最小的内存开销应用于全分辨率特征图。为了验证MalleConv的有效性,我们利用它构建了一个高效的去噪网络,称为MalleNet。MalleNet在不采用非常深网络架构的情况下实现了高质量的去噪效果,例如,其运行速度比最佳去噪算法(SwinIR)快8.9$\times$,同时保持相似的质量。我们还表明,将单个MalleConv层添加到标准卷积基网络中,可以显著降低计算成本,或在相似成本下提升图像质量。
abstract_en: Most image denoising networks apply a single set of static convolutional kernels across the entire input image. This is sub-optimal for natural images, as they often consist of heterogeneous visual patterns. Dynamic convolution tries to address this issue by using per-pixel convolution kernels, but this greatly increases computational cost. In this work, we present \textbf{Malle}able \textbf{Conv}olution (\textbf{MalleConv}), which performs spatial-varying processing with minimal computational overhead. MalleConv uses a smaller set of spatially-varying convolution kernels, a compromise between static and per-pixel convolution kernels. These spatially-varying kernels are produced by an efficient predictor network running on a downsampled input, making them much more efficient to compute than per-pixel kernels produced by a full-resolution image, and also enlarging the network’s receptive field compared with static kernels. These kernels are then jointly upsampled and applied to a full-resolution feature map through an efficient on-the-fly slicing operator with minimum memory overhead. To demonstrate the effectiveness of MalleConv, we use it to build an efficient denoising network we call \textbf{MalleNet}. MalleNet achieves high quality results without a very deep architecture, e.g., running 8.9$\times$ faster than the best performing denoising algorithms (SwinIR) while maintaining similar quality. We also show that a single MalleConv layer added to a standard convolution-based backbone can contribute significantly to reducing the computational cost or can boost image quality at a similar cost.

title: Yifei Huang, Lijin Yang, Yoichi Sato
title_en: Yifei Huang, Lijin Yang, Yoichi Sato
abstract: 少样本动作识别旨在仅使用少量标注训练样本识别新颖的动作类别。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新方法,首先将每个视频总结为包含一组全局原型和一组聚焦原型的复合原型,然后基于原型比较视频相似性。每个全局原型被鼓励从整个视频中提取特定方面,例如动作的起始或动作的演变。由于全局原型没有明确的标注,我们使用一组聚焦原型来关注视频中的特定时间戳。通过匹配支持视频和查询视频之间的复合原型来比较相似性。全局原型直接匹配,以便从同一视角比较动作,例如两个动作是否以相似方式开始。对于聚焦原型,由于视频中动作存在多种时间偏移,我们应用二部匹配以允许在不同时间戳上比较同一动作。大量实验表明,我们的方法在多个基准测试中显著优于现有方法,取得了最先进的结果。详细消融研究分析了每组原型在捕捉视频不同方面中的重要性。
abstract_en: Few-shot action recognition aims to recognize novel action classes using only a small number of labeled training samples. In this work, we propose a novel approach that first summarizes each video into compound prototypes consisting of a group of global prototypes and a group of focused prototypes, and then compares video similarity based on the prototypes. Each global prototype is encouraged to summarize a specific aspect from the entire video, for example, the start of the action or the evolution of the action. Since no clear annotation is provided for the global prototypes, we use a group of focused prototypes and to focus on certain timestamps in the video. We compare similarity by matching the compound prototypes between the support and query videos. The global prototypes are directly matched so that the actions can be compared from the same perspective, for example, whether two actions start similarly. For the focused prototypes, since actions have various temporal shifts in the videos, we apply bipartite matching to allow comparison of the same action on different timestamps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks by a large margin. A detailed ablation study analyzes the importance of each group of prototypes in capturing different aspects of the video.

title: Yifeng Zhang, Ming Jiang, Qi Zhao
title_en: Yifeng Zhang, Ming Jiang, Qi Zhao
abstract: 视觉对话(VD)是一项视觉-语言任务,要求AI系统围绕视觉内容进行自然的问答对话。利用对话历史作为上下文,VD模型在公开基准测试中取得了令人满意的性能。然而,现有VD数据集并未提供足够多的依赖上下文的问题,这些问题需要从对话历史中获取知识才能回答。因此,先进的VQA模型在不考虑对话上下文的情况下仍能保持良好性能。在本工作中,我们专注于开发新的数据集和模型,以突出上下文推理在VD中的作用。我们定义了一种上下文模式的层次结构,用于表示和组织对话上下文,从而实现对上下文依赖关系的量化分析,并设计新的VD数据集和模型。随后,我们开发了两个新的数据集,即CLEVR-VD和GQA-VD,分别提供合成图像和现实图像上的上下文丰富的对话。此外,我们提出了一种新型的神经模块网络方法,其特征在于VD中的上下文推理。通过在不同数据集上的实验结果和模型对比,我们验证了所提出数据集和方法的有效性。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/SuperJohnZhang/ContextVD获取。
abstract_en: Visual Dialog (VD) is a vision-language task that requires AI systems to maintain a natural question-answering dialog about visual contents. Using the dialog history as contexts, VD models have achieved promising performance on public benchmarks. However, prior VD datasets do not provide sufficient contextually dependent questions that require knowledge from the dialog history to answer. As a result, advanced VQA models can still perform well without considering the dialog context. In this work, we focus on developing new datasets and models to highlight the role of contextual reasoning in VD. We define a hierarchy of contextual patterns to represent and organize the dialog context, enabling quantitative analyses of contextual dependencies and designs of new VD datasets and models. We then develop two new datasets, namely CLEVR-VD and GQA-VD, offering context-rich dialogs over synthetic and realistic images, respectively. Furthermore, we propose a novel neural module network method featuring contextual reasoning in VD. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed datasets and method with experimental results and model comparisons across different datasets. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/SuperJohnZhang/ContextVD.

title: Yifu Zhang, Chunyu Wang, Xinggang Wang, Wenjun Zeng, Wenyu Liu
title_en: Yifu Zhang, Chunyu Wang, Xinggang Wang, Wenjun Zeng, Wenyu Liu
abstract: 视频中的多目标跟踪需要解决相邻帧之间目标一对一匹配的基本问题。大多数方法通过首先丢弃特征距离超过阈值的不可能配对,然后使用匈牙利算法连接目标以最小化总体距离来解决该问题。然而,我们发现从重识别特征计算出的距离分布在不同视频中可能有显著差异。因此,不存在一个单一的最优阈值,可以让我们安全地丢弃不可能配对。为了解决这个问题,我们提出了一种高效的方法,实时计算每对目标的边缘概率。边缘概率可以视为一种归一化距离,其稳定性显著高于原始特征距离。因此,我们可以为所有视频使用单一阈值。该方法具有通用性,可以应用于现有跟踪器,以在IDF1度量上获得约1个点的提升。在MOT17和MOT20基准测试中取得了具有竞争力的结果。此外,计算出的概率更具可解释性,有助于后续的后处理操作。
abstract_en: Multi-object tracking in videos requires to solve a fundamental problem of one-to-one assignment between objects in adjacent frames. Most methods address the problem by first discarding impossible pairs whose feature distances are larger than a threshold, followed by linking objects using Hungarian algorithm to minimize the overall distance. However, we find that the distribution of the distances computed from Re-ID features may vary significantly for different videos. So there isn’t a single optimal threshold which allows us to safely discard impossible pairs. To address the problem, we present an efficient approach to compute a marginal probability for each pair of objects in real time. The marginal probability can be regarded as a normalized distance which is significantly more stable than the original feature distance. As a result, we can use a single threshold for all videos. The approach is general and can be applied to the existing trackers to obtain about one point improvement in terms of IDF1 metric. It achieves competitive results on MOT17 and MOT20 benchmarks. In addition, the computed probability is more interpretable which facilitates subsequent post-processing operations.

title: Yifu Zhang, Peize Sun, Yi Jiang, Dongdong Yu, Fucheng Weng, Zehuan Yuan, Ping Luo, Wenyu Liu, Xinggang Wang
title_en: Yifu Zhang, Peize Sun, Yi Jiang, Dongdong Yu, Fucheng Weng, Zehuan Yuan, Ping Luo, Wenyu Liu, Xinggang Wang
abstract: 多目标跟踪(MOT)旨在估计视频中物体的边界框和身份信息。大多数方法通过关联得分高于阈值的检测框来获取身份信息。对于得分较低的检测框(例如被遮挡的物体),通常直接丢弃,这会导致非忽视的真阳性物体丢失和轨迹碎片化。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种简单、有效且通用的关联方法,通过关联几乎所有的检测框(而非仅高分检测框)进行跟踪。对于低分检测框,我们利用其与轨迹片段的相似性来恢复真阳性物体并过滤背景检测。当应用于9种不同的SOTA跟踪器时,我们的方法在IDF1分数上实现了1到10分的稳定提升。为了推动MOT的SOTA性能,我们设计了一个简单且强大的跟踪器,命名为ByteTrack。首次在MOT17测试集上以单块V100 GPU实现30 FPS运行速度,取得了80.3 MOTA、77.3 IDF1和63.1 HOTA。ByteTrack在MOT20、HiEve和BDD100K跟踪基准测试中也达到了SOTA性能。源代码、预训练模型(含部署版本)及应用于其他跟踪器的教程已发布于https://github.com/ifzhang/ByteTrack。
abstract_en: Multi-object tracking (MOT) aims at estimating bounding boxes and identities of objects in videos. Most methods obtain identities by associating detection boxes whose scores are higher than a threshold. The objects with low detection scores, e.g. occluded objects, are simply thrown away, which brings non-negligible true object missing and fragmented trajectories. To solve this problem, we present a simple, effective and generic association method, tracking by associating almost every detection box instead of only the high score ones. For the low score detection boxes, we utilize their similarities with tracklets to recover true objects and filter out the background detections. When applied to 9 different state-of-the-art trackers, our method achieves consistent improvement on IDF1 score ranging from 1 to 10 points. To put forwards the state-of-the-art performance of MOT, we design a simple and strong tracker, named ByteTrack. For the first time, we achieve 80.3 MOTA, 77.3 IDF1 and 63.1 HOTA on the test set of MOT17 with 30 FPS running speed on a single V100 GPU. ByteTrack also achieves state-of-the-art performance on MOT20, HiEve and BDD100K tracking benchmarks. The source code, pre-trained models with deploy versions and tutorials of applying to other trackers are released at https://github.com/ifzhang/ByteTrack.

title: Yiheng Li, Connelly Barnes, Kun Huang, Fang-Lue Zhang
title_en: Yiheng Li, Connelly Barnes, Kun Huang, Fang-Lue Zhang
abstract: 光流计算是视频处理流程早期阶段的关键环节。本文聚焦于该领域中较少被探索的问题——利用深度神经网络进行360°光流估计,以支持日益流行的虚拟现实(VR)应用。为了解决在应用卷积神经网络时全景表示的失真问题,我们提出了一种新颖的多投影融合框架,该框架融合了使用不同投影方法训练模型预测的光流结果。它学习在不同投影下结合光流结果中的互补信息。我们还构建了首个大规模全景光流数据集,以支持神经网络的训练和全景光流估计方法的评估。在我们数据集上的实验结果表明,我们的方法优于现有方法及其他为处理360°内容开发的替代深度网络。
abstract_en: Optical flow computation is essential in the early stages of the video processing pipeline. This paper focuses on a less explored problem in this area, the 360Â° optical flow estimation using deep neural networks to support the increasingly popular VR applications. To address the distortions of panoramic representations when applying convolutional neural networks, we propose a novel multi-projection fusion framework that fuses the optical flow predicted by the models trained using different projection methods. It learns to combine the complementary information in the optical flow results under different projections. We also build the first large-scale panoramic optical flow dataset to support the training of neural networks and the evaluation of panoramic optical flow estimation methods. The experiment results on our dataset demonstrate that our method outperforms the existing methods and other alternative deep networks that were developed for processing 360Â° content.

title: Yijin Li, Xinyang Liu, Wenqi Dong, Han Zhou, Hujun Bao, Guofeng Zhang, Yinda Zhang, Zhaopeng Cui
title_en: Yijin Li, Xinyang Liu, Wenqi Dong, Han Zhou, Hujun Bao, Guofeng Zhang, Yinda Zhang, Zhaopeng Cui
abstract: 轻量级飞行时间(ToF)深度传感器体积小、成本低、能耗低,已被大规模部署在移动设备上,用于自动对焦、障碍物检测等场景。然而,由于其特定的测量方式(区域内的深度分布而非单个像素的深度值)和极低的分辨率,难以满足需要高保真深度的应用场景,如三维重建。本文提出DELTAR,一种新型方法,通过与彩色图像协作,使轻量级ToF传感器具备测量高分辨率和精确深度的能力。作为DELTAR的核心,我们提出一个针对深度分布定制的特征提取器和基于注意力机制的神经架构,以高效融合彩色图像与ToF域的信息。为在真实场景中评估我们的系统,我们设计了数据采集设备,并提出一种新的RGB相机与ToF传感器校准方法。实验表明,我们的方法在深度完成和深度超分辨率领域现有框架中生成更精确的深度,并与消费级RGB-D传感器性能相当。代码和数据可在项目网页获取:https://zju3dv.github.io/deltar。
abstract_en: Light-weight time-of-flight (ToF) depth sensors are small, cheap, low-energy and have been massively deployed on mobile devices for the purposes like autofocus, obstacle detection, etc. However, due to their specific measurements (depth distribution in a region instead of the depth value at a certain pixel) and extremely low resolution, they are insufficient for applications requiring high-fidelity depth such as 3D reconstruction. In this paper, we propose DELTAR, a novel method to empower light-weight ToF sensors with the capability of measuring high resolution and accurate depth by cooperating with a color image. As the core of DELTAR, a feature extractor customized for depth distribution and an attention-based neural architecture is proposed to fuse the information from the color and ToF domain efficiently. To evaluate our system in real-world scenarios, we design a data collection device and propose a new approach to calibrate the RGB camera and ToF sensor. Experiments show that our method produces more accurate depth than existing frameworks designed for depth completion and depth super-resolution and achieves on par performance with a commodity-level RGB-D sensor. Code and data are available on the project webpage: https://zju3dv.github.io/deltar.

title: Yijun Qian, Lijun Yu, Wenhe Liu, Alexander G. Hauptmann
title_en: Yijun Qian, Lijun Yu, Wenhe Liu, Alexander G. Hauptmann
abstract: 为了避免在应用监督动作识别模型时耗时的标注和重新训练循环,零样本动作识别(ZSAR)已成为一个蓬勃发展的研究方向。ZSAR要求模型通过连接视觉特征和语义表示来识别训练集中从未出现过的动作。然而,由于动作的复杂性,从源动作域向目标动作域迁移知识仍然具有挑战性。先前的ZSAR方法主要通过集成或应用新的动作级特征来缓解源动作与目标动作之间的表示差异。然而,动作级特征较为粗粒度,导致学习到的一对一映射对相似目标动作较为脆弱。同时,特征的集成或应用通常需要额外的计算或标注。这些方法未注意到,两个名称不同的动作可能仍共享相同的原子动作组件。这使得人类能够通过从已知动作中学习到的一系列原子动作快速理解未见过的动作。受此启发,我们提出了一种名为Jigsaw网络(JigsawNet)的方法,该方法通过无监督地将复杂动作分解为原子动作的组合,并连接视觉特征与语义表示之间的组间关系来实现动作识别。为了增强学习到的组间桥梁的鲁棒性,我们提出了组激励(Group Excitation, GE)模块以建模样本内知识,并引入一致性损失(Consistency Loss)以迫使模型从样本间知识中学习。我们的JigsawNet在三个基准数据集上取得了最先进的性能,并在显著的差距上超越了先前的工作。
abstract_en: To avoid the time-consuming annotating and retraining cycle in applying supervised action recognition models, Zero-Shot Action Recognition (ZSAR) has become a thriving direction. ZSAR requires models to recognize actions that never appear in the training set through bridging visual features and semantic representations. However, due to the complexity of actions, it remains challenging to transfer knowledge learned from source to target action domains. Previous ZSAR methods mainly focus on mitigating representation variance between source and target actions through integrating or applying new action-level features. However, the action-level features are coarse-grained and make the learned one-to-one bridge fragile to similar target actions. Meanwhile, integration or application of features usually requires extra computation or annotation. These methods didn’t notice that two actions with different names may still share the same atomic action components. It enables humans to quickly understand an unseen action given a bunch of atomic actions learned from seen actions. Inspired by this, we propose Jigsaw Network (JigsawNet) which recognizes complex actions through unsupervisedly decomposing them into combinations of atomic actions and bridging group-to-group relationships between visual features and semantic representations. To enhance the robustness of the learned group-to-group bridge, we propose Group Excitation (GE) module to model intra-sample knowledge and Consistency Loss to enforce the model learn from inter-sample knowledge. Our JigsawNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on three benchmarks and surpasses previous works with noticeable margins.

title: Yijun Yang, Ruiyuan Gao, Qiang Xu
title_en: Yijun Yang, Ruiyuan Gao, Qiang Xu
abstract: 本文提出了一种名为MOODCat的新型分布外(OOD)检测框架,用于图像分类器。MOODCat对输入图像的随机部分进行掩码处理,并利用生成模型根据分类结果将掩码图像合成新的图像。随后,通过计算原始图像与合成图像之间的语义差异进行分布外检测。与现有解决方案相比,MOODCat通过提出的掩码和条件合成策略自然学习分布内数据的语义信息,这对于识别分布外数据至关重要。实验结果表明,MOODCat在分布外检测任务中显著优于现有最先进的解决方案。我们的代码可在https://github.com/cure-lab/MOODCat获取。
abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel out-of-distribution (OOD) detection framework named MOODCat for image classifiers. MOODCat masks a random portion of the input image and uses a generative model to synthesize the masked image to a new image conditioned on the classification result. It then calculates the semantic difference between the original image and the synthesized one for OOD detection. Compared to existing solutions, MOODCat naturally learns the semantic information of the in-distribution data with the proposed mask and conditional synthesis strategy, which is critical to identify OODs. Experimental results demonstrate that MOODCat outperforms state-of-the-art OOD detection solutions by a large margin. Our code is available at https://github.com/cure-lab/MOODCat.

title: Yikang Ding, Qingtian Zhu, Xiangyue Liu, Wentao Yuan, Haotian Zhang, Chi Zhang
title_en: Yikang Ding, Qingtian Zhu, Xiangyue Liu, Wentao Yuan, Haotian Zhang, Chi Zhang
abstract: 监督多视角立体(MVS)方法在重建质量方面取得了显著进展,但面临大规模真实深度数据收集的挑战。本文提出了一种基于知识蒸馏的新型自监督训练框架,称为KD-MVS,主要包含自监督教师模型训练和基于蒸馏的学生模型训练。具体而言,教师模型通过光度与特征度一致性以自监督方式训练。随后,通过概率知识传递将教师模型的知识蒸馏至学生模型。在验证知识的监督下,学生模型能够显著超越其教师模型。在多个数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法甚至可以超越监督方法。在Tanks and Temples基准测试中,我们的方法在所有提交方法中排名第一。
abstract_en: Supervised multi-view stereo (MVS) methods have achieved remarkable progress in terms of reconstruction quality, but suffer from the challenge of collecting large-scale ground-truth depth. In this paper, we propose a novel self-supervised training pipeline for MVS based on knowledge distillation, termed KD-MVS, which mainly consists of self-supervised teacher training and distillation-based student training. Specifically, the teacher model is trained in a self-supervised fashion using both photometric and featuremetric consistency. Then we distill the knowledge of the teacher model to the student model through probabilistic knowledge transferring. With the supervision of validated knowledge, the student model is able to outperform its teacher by a large margin. Extensive experiments performed on multiple datasets show our method can even outperform supervised methods. It ranks 1st among all submitted methods on Tanks and Temples benchmark.

title: Yili Wang, Xin Li, Kun Xu, Dongliang He, Qi Zhang, Fu Li, Errui Ding
title_en: Yili Wang, Xin Li, Kun Xu, Dongliang He, Qi Zhang, Fu Li, Errui Ding
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的图像润饰方法,通过将润饰过程建模为一系列新引入的可训练神经色彩算子序列。该神经色彩算子模仿传统色彩算子的行为,在学习像素级色彩变换的同时,其强度由标量控制。为反映色彩算子的同态性质,我们采用等变映射并采用编码器-解码器结构,将非线性色彩变换映射到高维空间中更简单的变换(即平移)。每个神经色彩算子的标量强度通过基于CNN的强度预测器,通过分析全局图像统计信息进行预测。总体而言,我们的方法具有轻量级特点并提供灵活的控制。在公开数据集上的实验和用户研究显示,与现有最先进方法相比,我们的方法在定量指标和视觉质量方面均取得最佳结果。代码和数据将公开发布。
abstract_en: We propose a novel image retouching method by modeling the retouching process as performing a sequence of newly introduced trainable neural color operators. The neural color operator mimics the behavior of traditional color operators and learns pixelwise color transformation while its strength is controlled by a scalar. To reflect the homomorphism property of color operators, we employ equivariant mapping and adopt an encoder-decoder structure which maps the non-linear color transformation to a much simpler transformation (i.e., translation) in a high dimensional space. The scalar strength of each neural color operator is predicted using CNN based strength predictors by analyzing global image statistics. Overall, our method is rather lightweight and offers flexible controls. Experiments and user studies on public datasets show that our method consistently achieves the best results compared with SOTA methods in both quantitative measures and visual qualities. The code and data will be made publicly available.

title: Yilin Wen, Xiangyu Li, Hao Pan, Lei Yang, Zheng Wang, Taku Komura, Wenping Wang
title_en: Yilin Wen, Xiangyu Li, Hao Pan, Lei Yang, Zheng Wang, Taku Komura, Wenping Wang
abstract: 针对从RGB图像中对刚性物体进行可扩展的6自由度姿态估计,旨在处理多个物体并推广到新物体。基于一个著名的自编码框架,以应对物体对称性和缺乏标注训练数据的问题,我们通过将自编码器的潜在表示解耦为形状和姿态子空间,实现了可扩展性。潜在形状空间通过对比度度量学习建模不同物体的相似性,潜在姿态码与规范旋转进行比较以实现旋转检索。由于不同物体对称性会导致潜在姿态空间不一致,我们重新将形状表示与规范旋转纠缠,以生成形状依赖的姿态码本用于旋转检索。我们在两个基准测试中展示了最先进的性能,分别包含无类别的纹理less CAD物体和有类别的日常物体,并进一步通过扩展到更具挑战性的跨类别的日常物体设置,展示了改进的可扩展性。
abstract_en: Scalable 6D pose estimation for rigid objects from RGB images aims at handling multiple objects and generalizing to novel objects. Building on a well-known auto-encoding framework to cope with object symmetry and the lack of labeled training data, we achieve scalability by disentangling the latent representation of auto-encoder into shape and pose sub-spaces. The latent shape space models the similarity of different objects through contrastive metric learning, and the latent pose code is compared with canonical rotations for rotation retrieval. Because different object symmetries induce inconsistent latent pose spaces, we re-entangle the shape representation with canonical rotations to generate shape-dependent pose codebooks for rotation retrieval. We show state-of-the-art performance on two benchmarks containing textureless CAD objects without category and daily objects with categories respectively, and further demonstrate improved scalability by extending to a more challenging setting of daily objects across categories.

title: 钱一鸣,詹姆斯·H·埃利尔
title_en: Yiming Qian, James H. Elder
abstract: 来自建筑环境规律性的线性透视线索可用于在线重新校准相机的内参和外参参数,但这些估计值可能因场景中的不规则性、线段估计的不确定性以及背景杂乱而不可靠。本文通过四项举措解决这一挑战。首先,我们使用PanoContext全景图像数据集,整理出一个涵盖广泛场景、焦距和相机姿态的新型现实数据集。其次,我们利用该新型数据集和YorkUrbanDB系统评估文献中常见的线性透视偏差度量方法,表明偏差度量方法和似然模型的选择对可靠性有巨大影响。第三,我们基于这些发现创建了一个名为fR的新型在线相机校准系统,并证明其显著优于现有技术,大幅降低了估计相机旋转和焦距的误差。第四项贡献是一种新颖且高效的不确定性估计方法,通过战略性选择用于重新校准的帧,可显著提升对关键性能应用的在线可靠性。
abstract_en: Linear perspective cues deriving from regularities of the built environment can be used to recalibrate both intrinsic and extrinsic camera parameters online, but these estimates can be unreliable due to irregularities in the scene, uncertainties in line segment estimation and background clutter. Here we address this challenge through four initiatives. First, we use the PanoContext panoramic image dataset to curate a novel and realistic dataset of planar projections over a broad range of scenes, focal lengths and camera poses. Second, we use this novel dataset and the YorkUrbanDB to systematically evaluate the linear perspective deviation measures frequently found in the literature and show that the choice of deviation measure and likelihood model has a huge impact on reliability. Third, we use these findings to create a novel system for online camera calibration we call fR, and show that it outperforms the prior state of the art, substantially reducing error in estimated camera rotation and focal length. Our fourth contribution is a novel and efficient approach to estimating uncertainty that can dramatically improve online reliability for performance-critical applications by strategically selecting which frames to use for recalibration.

title: Yinan He, Gengshi Huang, Siyu Chen, Jianing Teng, Kun Wang, Zhenfei Yin, Lu Sheng, Ziwei Liu, Yu Qiao, Jing Shao
title_en: Yinan He, Gengshi Huang, Siyu Chen, Jianing Teng, Kun Wang, Zhenfei Yin, Lu Sheng, Ziwei Liu, Yu Qiao, Jing Shao
abstract: 在计算机视觉领域,基于大规模监督学习的预训练模型在过去几年已被证明是有效的。然而,现有研究大多专注于从单一数据源(例如用于分类的ImageNet或用于检测的COCO)的单个任务中学习。这种受限形式由于缺乏来自各种任务和数据源的大量语义信息,限制了其泛化能力和实用性。本文表明,联合学习异构任务和多种数据源有助于实现通用视觉表征,从而实现各种下游任务的更好迁移效果。因此,学习如何弥合不同任务和数据源之间的差距是关键,但这一问题仍是一个开放性问题。在本工作中,我们提出了一种名为X-Learner的表征学习框架,该框架通过扩展和压缩阶段学习由多种来源监督的多视觉任务的通用特征:1)扩展阶段:X-Learner通过协调层学习任务特定特征,以缓解任务干扰并丰富表征。2)压缩阶段:X-Learner将模型压缩到合理尺寸,并学习通用且可迁移的表征以适应各种任务迁移。大量实验表明,X-Learner在无需额外标注、模态和计算成本的情况下,在不同任务上均取得了优于现有表征学习方法的优异性能。值得注意的是,在12个下游数据集上,单个X-Learner模型在分类、目标检测和语义分割任务中分别表现出3.0%、3.3%和1.8%的显著提升。
abstract_en: In computer vision, pre-training models based on large-scale supervised learning have been proven effective over the past few years. However, existing works mostly focus on learning from the individual tasks with the single data source e.g., ImageNet for classification or COCO for detection). This restricted form limits their generalizability and usability due to the lack of vast semantic information from various tasks and data sources. Here, we demonstrate that jointly learning from heterogeneous tasks and multiple data sources contributes to universal visual representation, leading to better transferring results of various downstream tasks. Thus, learning how to bridge the gaps among different tasks and data sources is the key, but it still remains an open question. In this work, we propose a representation learning framework called X-Learner, which learns the universal feature of multiple vision tasks supervised by various sources, with expansion and squeeze stage:1) Expansion Stage: X-Learner learns the task-specific feature to alleviate task interference and enrich the representation by reconciliation layer. 2) Squeeze Stage: X-Learner condenses the model to a reasonable size and learns the universal and generalizable representation for various tasks transferring. Extensive experiments demonstrate that X-Learner achieves strong performance on different tasks without extra annotations, modalities and computational costs compared to existing representation learning methods. Notably, a single X-Learner model shows remarkable gains of 3.0%, 3.3% and 1.8% over current pre-trained models on 12 downstream datasets for classification, object detection and semantic segmentation.

title: Yinbo Chen, Xiaolong Wang
title_en: Yinbo Chen, Xiaolong Wang
abstract: 隐式神经表示(INRs)近年来已崭露头角,并在离散表示方面展现出优势。然而,通常需要从头开始通过梯度下降优化来拟合给定观测数据的INR,这种方法效率低下且在稀疏观测下泛化能力差。为解决此问题,大多数先前工作训练了一个超网络,生成单个向量来调节INR权重,但该单向量成为信息瓶颈,限制了输出INR的重建精度。近期研究表明,通过基于梯度的元学习可无需单向量瓶颈精确推断INR的全部权重。受基于梯度的元学习通用形式的启发,我们提出一种使用Transformer作为超网络的框架,其中专门化为集合到集合映射的Transformer可直接构建完整的INR权重。我们在不同任务和领域中验证了该方法构建INR的有效性,包括2D图像回归和3D物体的视角合成。我们的工作建立了Transformer超网络与基于梯度的元学习算法之间的联系,并进一步分析了生成的INR特性。
abstract_en: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have emerged and shown their benefits over discrete representations in recent years. However, fitting an INR to the given observations usually requires optimization with gradient descent from scratch, which is inefficient and does not generalize well with sparse observations. To address this problem, most of the prior works train a hypernetwork that generates a single vector to modulate the INR weights, where the single vector becomes an information bottleneck that limits the reconstruction precision of the output INR. Recent work shows that the whole set of weights in INR can be precisely inferred without the single-vector bottleneck by gradient-based meta-learning. Motivated by a generalized formulation of gradient-based meta-learning, we propose a formulation that uses Transformers as hypernetworks for INRs, where it can directly build the whole set of INR weights with Transformers specialized as set-to-set mapping. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method for building INRs in different tasks and domains, including 2D image regression and view synthesis for 3D objects. Our work draws connections between the Transformer hypernetworks and gradient-based meta-learning algorithms and we provide further analysis for understanding the generated INRs.

title: Ying Chen, Liang Qiao, Zhanzhan Cheng, Shiliang Pu, Yi Niu, Xi Li
title_en: Ying Chen, Liang Qiao, Zhanzhan Cheng, Shiliang Pu, Yi Niu, Xi Li
abstract: 端到端文本定位近年来因其在全局优化和实际应用中的高可维护性而受到广泛关注。然而,输入尺度始终是一个艰难的权衡,因为识别小文本实例通常需要放大整个图像,这会带来高昂的计算成本。本文为了解决这一问题,提出了一种新颖的高效动态低分辨率蒸馏(DLD)文本定位框架,旨在以不同小但可识别的分辨率推断图像,并在准确性和效率之间取得更好的平衡。具体而言,我们采用分辨率选择器动态决定不同图像的输入分辨率,该选择器受推理准确性和计算成本的约束。此外,在文本识别分支上实施了另一种序列知识蒸馏策略,使低分辨率输入获得与高分辨率图像相当的性能。所提出的方法可以端到端优化,并适用于任何当前文本定位框架以提升其实用性。在多个文本定位基准上的大量实验表明,所提出的方法显著提升了低分辨率模型的可用性。代码已公开。
abstract_en: End-to-end text spotting has attached great attention recently due to its benefits on global optimization and high maintainability for real applications. However, the input scale has always been a tough trade-off since recognizing a small text instance usually requires enlarging the whole image, which brings high computational costs. In this paper, to address this problem, we propose a novel cost-efficient Dynamic Low-resolution Distillation (DLD) text spotting framework, which aims to infer images in different small but recognizable resolutions and achieve a better balance between accuracy and efficiency. Concretely, we adopt a resolution selector to dynamically decide the input resolutions for different images, which is constraint by both inference accuracy and computational cost. Another sequential knowledge distillation strategy is conducted on the text recognition branch, making the low-res input obtains comparable performance to a high-res image. The proposed method can be optimized end-to-end and adopted in any current text spotting framework to improve their practicabilities. Extensive experiments on several text spotting benchmarks show that the proposed method vastly improves the usability of low-res models. The code is available.

title: Yingdong Hu, Renhao Wang, Kaifeng Zhang, Yang Gao
title_en: Yingdong Hu, Renhao Wang, Kaifeng Zhang, Yang Gao
abstract: 在图像之间建立视觉对应关系是一项具有挑战性且至关重要的任务。近年来,大量自监督方法被提出以更好地学习视觉对应关系的表示。然而,我们发现这些方法往往未能有效利用语义信息,过度依赖低层次特征的匹配。相反,人类视觉能够通过区分不同物体作为跟踪的先验知识。受此范式启发,我们提出学习语义感知的细粒度对应关系。首先,我们证明通过丰富的图像级自监督方法可以隐式获得语义对应关系。我们进一步设计了一个像素级自监督学习目标,专门针对细粒度对应关系。对于下游任务,我们将这两种互补的对应关系表示进行融合,证明它们能够协同增强性能。我们的方法在多种视觉对应任务(包括视频对象分割、人体姿态跟踪和人体部位跟踪)中,超越了先前最先进的基于卷积网络的自监督方法。
abstract_en: Establishing visual correspondence across images is a challenging and essential task. Recently, an influx of self-supervised methods have been proposed to better learn representations for visual correspondence. However, we find that these methods often fail to leverage semantic information and over-rely on the matching of low-level features. In contrast, human vision is capable of distinguishing between distinct objects as a pretext to tracking. Inspired by this paradigm, we propose to learn semantic-aware fine-grained correspondence. Firstly, we demonstrate that semantic correspondence is implicitly available through a rich set of image-level self-supervised methods. We further design a pixel-level self-supervised learning objective which specifically targets fine-grained correspondence. For downstream tasks, we fuse these two kinds of complementary correspondence representations together, demonstrating that they boost performance synergistically. Our method surpasses previous state-of-the-art self-supervised methods using convolutional networks on a variety of visual correspondence tasks, including video object segmentation, human pose tracking, and human part tracking.

title: Yingfei Liu, Tiancai Wang, Xiangyu Zhang, Jian Sun
title_en: Yingfei Liu, Tiancai Wang, Xiangyu Zhang, Jian Sun
abstract: 本文提出了一种用于多视角三维目标检测的位置嵌入变换(PETR)。PETR将三维坐标的位置信息编码到图像特征中,生成三维位置感知特征。目标查询能够感知三维位置感知特征并执行端到端目标检测。截至投稿时,PETR在标准nuScenes数据集上取得了最先进的性能(50.4% NDS和44.1% mAP),并在基准测试中排名第一。它可以作为未来研究的简单而强大的基线。
abstract_en: In this paper, we develop position embedding transformation (PETR) for multi-view 3D object detection. PETR encodes the position information of 3D coordinates into image features, producing the 3D position-aware features. Object query can perceive the 3D position-aware features and perform end-to-end object detection. Till submission, PETR achieves state-of-the-art performance (50.4% NDS and 44.1% mAP) on standard nuScenes dataset and ranks 1st place on the benchmark. It can serve as a simple yet strong baseline for future research.

title: Yingjie Chen, Huasong Zhong, Chong Chen, Chen Shen, Jianqiang Huang, Tao Wang, Yun Liang, Qianru Sun
title_en: Yingjie Chen, Huasong Zhong, Chong Chen, Chen Shen, Jianqiang Huang, Tao Wang, Yun Liang, Qianru Sun
abstract: 人脸聚类是利用大规模无标签人脸图像扩展人脸识别系统的一种有前景的方法。然而,识别小规模或稀疏的人脸图像簇(我们称之为硬簇)仍然具有挑战性,这主要是由于簇的异质性,即簇在大小和稀疏性上的高度变化。因此,传统方法使用统一阈值(用于识别簇)往往会导致属于硬簇的样本被错误分类。我们通过利用样本的邻域信息,并以概率方式推断样本的簇成员关系来解决这一问题。我们引入了两个新颖的模块,基于邻域扩散的密度(NDDe)和基于转移概率的距离(TPDi),在此基础上,我们可以简单地应用带有统一阈值的标准密度峰值聚类算法。我们在多个基准数据集上的实验表明,每个模块都对最终性能有所贡献,并且将这两个模块整合到其他先进的面部聚类方法中,可以将这些方法的性能提升到新的最先进水平。
abstract_en: Face clustering is a promising way to scale up face recognition systems using large-scale unlabeled face images. It remains challenging to identify small or sparse face image clusters that we call hard clusters, which is caused by the heterogeneity, i.e., high variations in size and sparsity, of the clusters. Consequently, the conventional way of using a uniform threshold (to identify clusters) often leads to a terrible misclassification for the samples that should belong to hard clusters. We tackle this problem by leveraging the neighborhood information of samples and inferring the cluster memberships (of samples) in a probabilistic way. We introduce two novel modules, Neighborhood-Diffusion-based Density (NDDe) and Transition-Probability-based Distance (TPDi), based on which we can simply apply the standard Density Peak Clustering algorithm with a uniform threshold. Our experiments on multiple benchmarks show that each module contributes to the final performance of our method, and by incorporating them into other advanced face clustering methods, these two modules can boost the performance of these methods to a new state-of-the-art.

title: 李莹燕,陈云涛,何佳伟,张兆翔
title_en: Yingyan Li, Yuntao Chen, Jiawei He, Zhaoxiang Zhang
abstract: 从单目图像中估计物体的精确三维位置是一个具有挑战性的问题,因为缺乏深度信息。先前的研究表明,利用物体关键点的投影约束来估计多个深度候选值可以提升检测性能。然而,现有方法只能将垂直边缘作为投影约束用于深度估计。因此,这些方法仅使用少量的投影约束,生成的深度候选值不足,导致深度估计不准确。在本文中,我们提出了一种方法,利用来自任意方向边缘的密集投影约束。通过这种方式,我们采用更多的投影约束,并生成大量的深度候选值。此外,我们提出了一种图匹配加权模块来融合深度候选值。所提出的方法DCD(密集约束检测器)在KITTI和WOD基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。代码已发布在https://github.com/BraveGroup/DCD。
abstract_en: Estimating accurate 3D locations of objects from monocular images is a challenging problem because of lacking depth. Previous work shows that utilizing the object’s keypoint projection constraints to estimate multiple depth candidates boosts the detection performance. However, the existing methods can only utilize vertical edges as projection constraints for depth estimation. So these methods only use a small number of projection constraints and produce insufficient depth candidates, leading to inaccurate depth estimation. In this paper, we propose a method that utilizes dense projection constraints from edges of any direction. In this way, we employ much more projection constraints and produce considerable depth candidates. Besides, we present a graph matching weighting module to merge the depth candidates. The proposed method DCD (Densely Constrained Detector) achieves state-of-the-art performance on the KITTI and WOD benchmarks. Code is released at https://github.com/BraveGroup/DCD.

title: Yining Zhao, Chao Wen, Zhou Xue, Yue Gao
title_en: Yining Zhao, Chao Wen, Zhou Xue, Yue Gao
abstract: 在从单张全景图像估计3D房间布局时,重要的几何结构可以通过全局线框进行紧凑描述。基于这一观察,我们提出了一种替代方法,通过在可学习的霍夫变换模块中建模长程几何模式来估计3D空间中的墙壁。我们将立方图瓦片中的图像特征转换到曼哈顿世界的霍夫空间,并直接将特征映射到几何输出。卷积层不仅学习局部梯度样线特征,还利用全局信息,通过简单的网络结构成功预测被遮挡的墙壁。与大多数先前工作不同,预测是在每个立方图瓦片上单独进行的,然后进行组装以获得布局估计。实验结果表明,我们在预测精度和性能方面与最新的最先进方法取得了可比的结果。代码可在https://github.com/Starrah/DMH-Net获取。
abstract_en: Significant geometric structures can be compactly described by global wireframes in the estimation of 3D room layout from a single panoramic image. Based on this observation, we present an alternative approach to estimate the walls in 3D space by modeling long-range geometric patterns in a learnable Hough Transform block. We transform the image feature from a cubemap tile to the Hough space of a Manhattan world and directly map the feature to the geometric output. The convolutional layers not only learn the local gradient-like line features, but also utilize the global information to successfully predict occluded walls with a simple network structure. Unlike most previous work, the predictions are performed individually on each cubemap tile, and then assembled to get the layout estimation. Experimental results show that we achieve comparable results with recent state-of-the-art in prediction accuracy and performance. Code is available at https://github.com/Starrah/DMH-Net.

title: Yinlin Hu, Pascal Fua, Mathieu Salzmann
title_en: Yinlin Hu, Pascal Fua, Mathieu Salzmann
abstract: 最近的6D物体位姿估计方法,包括无监督方法,都需要大量的真实训练图像。不幸的是,在某些应用中,例如太空或深水环境,即使获取未标注的真实图像也几乎不可能。本文提出了一种方法,该方法可以仅使用合成图像进行训练,或可选地使用少量额外的真实图像。给定由第一个网络获得的粗略位姿估计,它使用第二个网络预测由粗略位姿渲染的图像与真实图像之间的密集2D对应场,并推断所需的位姿校正。这种方法比现有最先进的方法对合成图像与真实图像之间的领域偏移更为不敏感。当不使用任何真实图像时,其性能与需要标注真实图像进行训练的方法相当;而当仅使用20张真实图像时,其性能显著优于这些方法。
abstract_en: Most recent 6D object pose estimation methods, including unsupervised ones, require many real training images. Unfortunately, for some applications, such as those in space or deep under water, acquiring real images, even unannotated, is virtually impossible. In this paper, we propose a method that can be trained solely on synthetic images, or optionally using a few additional real ones. Given a rough pose estimate obtained from a first network, it uses a second network to predict a dense 2D correspondence field between the image rendered using the rough pose and the real image and infers the required pose correction. This approach is much less sensitive to the domain shift between synthetic and real images than state-of-the-art methods. It performs on par with methods that require annotated real images for training when not using any, and outperforms them considerably when using as few as twenty real images.

title: Yinyu Nie, Angela Dai, Xiaoguang Han, Matthias Nießner
title_en: Yinyu Nie, Angela Dai, Xiaoguang Han, Matthias Nießner
abstract: 借助可穿戴惯性测量单元(IMU)传感器,可以在无需视觉输入的情况下,通过可穿戴设备估计人体姿态。在本工作中,我们提出问题:能否仅通过人体轨迹信息对现实环境中的物体结构进行推理?关键在于,我们观察到人体运动和交互往往能提供场景中物体的强信息——例如,一个人坐下的动作通常暗示存在椅子或沙发等物体。为此,我们提出P2R-Net,基于环境中观测到的人体轨迹输入,学习场景中物体的概率三维模型,该模型以物体类别和带方向的三维边界框为特征。P2R-Net建模了物体类别的概率分布以及深度高斯混合模型用于物体边界框,从而能够从观测到的人体轨迹中采样出多种多样的、合理的物体配置模式。在实验中,我们展示了P2R-Net能够有效学习人体运动对应的多模态物体分布,并生成多种合理的环境物体结构,即使在没有任何视觉信息的情况下。实验结果表明,P2R-Net在PROX数据集和VirtualHome平台上的表现均优于基线方法。
abstract_en: With wearable IMU sensors, one can estimate human poses from wearable devices without requiring visual input. In this work, we pose the question: Can we reason about object structure in real-world environments solely from human trajectory information? Crucially, we observe that human motion and interactions tend to give strong information about the objects in a scene -- for instance a person sitting indicates the likely presence of a chair or sofa. To this end, we propose P2R-Net to learn a probabilistic 3D model of the objects in a scene characterized by their class categories and oriented 3D bounding boxes, based on an input observed human trajectory in the environment. P2R-Net models the probability distribution of object class as well as a deep Gaussian mixture model for object boxes, enabling sampling of multiple, diverse, likely modes of object configurations from an observed human trajectory. In our experiments we show that P2R-Net can effectively learn multi-modal distributions of likely objects for human motions, and produce a variety of plausible object structures of the environment, even without any visual information. The results demonstrate that P2R-Net consistently outperforms the baselines on the PROX dataset and the VirtualHome platform.

title: Yipeng Gao, Lingxiao Yang, Yunmu Huang, Song Xie, Shiyong Li, Wei-Shi Zheng
title_en: Yipeng Gao, Lingxiao Yang, Yunmu Huang, Song Xie, Shiyong Li, Wei-Shi Zheng
abstract: 在领域偏移下,跨域少样本目标检测旨在利用少量标注的目标域数据适应目标域中的目标检测器。存在两个显著挑战:(1) 目标域数据高度不足;(2) 由于未加限制地放大目标样本,可能导致过适应和误导。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种包含两个部分的自适应方法。首先,我们提出了一种自适应优化策略,选择与目标样本相似的增强数据,而非盲目增加数据量。具体而言,我们从一开始就过滤掉显著偏离目标特征分布的增强候选数据。其次,为进一步缓解数据限制,我们提出多级领域感知数据增强方法,以增加增强数据的多样性和合理性,该方法利用跨图像前景-背景混合。实验表明,所提出的方法在多个基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Under the domain shift, cross-domain few-shot object detection aims to adapt object detectors in the target domain with a few annotated target data. There exists two significant challenges: (1) Highly insufficient target domain data; (2) Potential over-adaptation and misleading caused by inappropriately amplified target samples without any restriction. To address these challenges, we propose an adaptive method consisting of two parts. First, we propose an adaptive optimization strategy to select augmented data similar to target samples rather than blindly increasing the amount. Specifically, we filter the augmented candidates which significantly deviate from the target feature distribution in the very beginning. Second, to further relieve the data limitation, we propose the multi-level domain-aware data augmentation to increase the diversity and rationality of augmented data, which exploits the cross-image foreground-background mixture. Experiments show that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks.

title: 钟毅奇、倪振阳、陈思恒、Ulrich Neumann
title_en: Yiqi Zhong, Zhenyang Ni, Siheng Chen, Ulrich Neumann
abstract: 此前经过某一位置的历史轨迹可能有助于推断当前位于该位置的智能体的未来轨迹。尽管在高精度地图的指导下轨迹预测技术取得了显著进步,但仅有少数研究探索了此类局部历史信息。在本文中,我们将此类信息重新引入为轨迹预测系统的一种新型输入数据:局部行为数据,我们将其概念化为特定位置的历史轨迹集合。局部行为数据有助于系统强调预测的局部性,并更好地理解静态地图对象对移动智能体的影响。我们提出了一种新颖的局部行为感知(LBA)预测框架,通过融合观测轨迹、高精度地图和局部行为数据的信息来提高预测准确性。此外,当此类历史数据不足或不可用时,我们采用一种局部行为无关(LBF)预测框架,该框架采用基于知识蒸馏的架构来推断缺失数据的影响。大量实验表明,将这两种框架应用于现有方法可显著提升其性能。特别是,LBA框架在nuScenes数据集上将SOTA方法的性能提升了至少14%(K=1指标)。
abstract_en: The historical trajectories previously passing through a location may help infer the future trajectory of an agent currently at this location. Despite great improvements in trajectory forecasting with the guidance of high-definition maps, only a few works have explored such local historical information. In this work, we re-introduce this information as a new type of input data for trajectory forecasting systems: the local behavior data, which we conceptualize as a collection of location-specific historical trajectories. Local behavior data helps the systems emphasize the prediction locality and better understand the impact of static map objects on moving agents. We propose a novel local-behavior-aware (LBA) prediction framework that improves forecasting accuracy by fusing information from observed trajectories, HD maps, and local behavior data. Also, where such historical data is insufficient or unavailable, we employ a local-behavior-free (LBF) prediction framework, which adopts a knowledge-distillation-based architecture to infer the impact of missing data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that upgrading existing methods with these two frameworks significantly improves their performances. Especially, the LBA framework boosts the SOTA methods’ performance on the nuScenes dataset by at least 14% for the K=1 metrics.

title: Yiran Xu, Badour AlBahar, Jia-Bin Huang
title_en: Yiran Xu, Badour AlBahar, Jia-Bin Huang
abstract: 生成对抗网络(GANs)在图像生成质量和真实图像的语义编辑能力方面表现出色,例如改变物体类别、修改属性或转移风格。然而,将基于GAN的编辑独立应用于每一帧视频时,不可避免地会导致时间闪烁伪影。我们提出了一种简单而有效的视频编辑方法,以实现时间一致的视频编辑。我们的核心思想是通过优化潜在代码和预训练生成器,最小化时间光度不一致性。我们在不同领域和GAN反演技术上评估了编辑质量,并展示了优于基线的有利结果。
abstract_en: Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have demonstrated impressive image generation quality and semantic editing capability of real images, e.g., changing object classes, modifying attributes, or transferring styles. However, applying these GAN-based editing to a video independently for each frame inevitably results in temporal flickering artifacts. We present a simple yet effective method to facilitate temporally coherent video editing. Our core idea is to minimize the temporal photometric inconsistency by optimizing both the latent code and the pre-trained generator. We evaluate the quality of our editing on different domains and GAN inversion techniques and show favorable results against the baselines.

title: Yixu Wang, Jie Li, Hong Liu, Yan Wang, Yongjian Wu, Feiyue Huang, Rongrong Ji
title_en: Yixu Wang, Jie Li, Hong Liu, Yan Wang, Yongjian Wu, Feiyue Huang, Rongrong Ji
abstract: 先前研究表明,黑盒模型的功能可以通过完整的概率输出被完全窃取。然而,在更实际的硬标签设置下,我们观察到现有方法会遭受灾难性性能退化。我们认为这是由于概率预测中缺乏丰富的信息以及硬标签导致的过拟合。为此,我们提出了一种新型的硬标签模型窃取方法,称为黑盒解剖器(black-box dissector),该方法包含两个基于擦除的模块。一个是CAM驱动的擦除策略,旨在从受害模型中增强硬标签中隐藏的信息容量;另一个是基于随机擦除的自知识蒸馏模块,利用替代模型的软标签来缓解过拟合问题。在四个广泛使用的数据集上的大量实验结果一致表明,我们的方法在性能上优于现有最先进的方法,最多可提升8.27%。我们还在现实世界的API和防御方法上验证了该方法的有效性和实际潜力。此外,我们的方法还促进了其他下游任务,即迁移对抗攻击。
abstract_en: Previous studies have verified that the functionality of black-box models can be stolen with full probability outputs. However, under the more practical hard-label setting, we observe that existing methods suffer from catastrophic performance degradation. We argue this is due to the lack of rich information in the probability prediction and the overfitting caused by hard labels. To this end, we propose a novel hard-label model stealing method termed black-box dissector, which consists of two erasing-based modules. One is a CAM-driven erasing strategy that is designed to increase the information capacity hidden in hard labels from the victim model. The other is a random-erasing-based self-knowledge distillation module that utilizes soft labels from the substitute model to mitigate overfitting. Extensive experiments on four widely-used datasets consistently demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with an improvement of at most 8.27%. We also validate the effectiveness and practical potential of our method on real-world APIs and defense methods. Furthermore, our method promotes other downstream tasks, i.e., transfer adversarial attacks.

title: Yiyou Sun, Yixuan Li
title_en: Yiyou Sun, Yixuan Li
abstract: 检测分布外(OOD)输入是安全部署机器学习模型于现实世界中的核心挑战。先前方法通常依赖于从过度参数化权重空间中导出的分布外得分,而很大程度上忽视了稀疏化的作用。本文揭示了重要见解:依赖不重要的权重和单元可以直接导致分布外检测的脆弱性。为缓解这一问题,我们提出了一种基于稀疏化的分布外检测框架,称为DICE。我们的核心思想是根据贡献度量对权重进行排序,并选择性地使用最显著的权重来推导分布外检测的输出。我们提供了实证和理论上的见解,阐明并解释了DICE如何提升分布外检测机制。通过去除噪声信号,DICE可证明减少分布外数据的输出方差,从而产生更尖锐的输出分布,并增强与分布内数据的可分性。我们在多个基准测试中验证了基于稀疏化的分布外检测有效性,并建立了具有竞争力的性能。
abstract_en: Detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs is a central challenge for safely deploying machine learning models in the real world. Previous methods commonly rely on an OOD score derived from the overparameterized weight space, while largely overlooking the role of sparsification. In this paper, we reveal important insights that reliance on unimportant weights and units can directly attribute to the brittleness of OOD detection. To mitigate the issue, we propose a sparsification-based OOD detection framework termed DICE. Our key idea is to rank weights based on a measure of contribution, and selectively use the most salient weights to derive the output for OOD detection. We provide both empirical and theoretical insights, characterizing and explaining the mechanism by which DICE improves OOD detection. By pruning away noisy signals, DICE provably reduces the output variance for OOD data, resulting in a sharper output distribution and stronger separability from ID data. We demonstrate the effectiveness of sparsification-based OOD detection on several benchmarks and establish competitive performance.

title: Yiyu Zhuang, Hao Zhu, Xusen Sun, Xun Cao
title_en: Yiyu Zhuang, Hao Zhu, Xusen Sun, Xun Cao
abstract: 我们提出了一种参数模型,利用神经辐射场将自由视角图像映射到编码的面部形状、表情和外观向量空间,称为可变形面部NeRF(Morphable Facial NeRF,MoFaNeRF)。具体而言,MoFaNeRF将编码的面部形状、表情和外观,以及空间坐标和视角方向作为输入传递给多层感知机(MLP),输出空间点的辐射值以实现逼真图像合成。与传统的三维可变形模型(3DMM)相比,MoFaNeRF在直接合成逼真面部细节(包括眼睛、嘴巴和胡须)方面表现出优越性。此外,通过插值输入的形状、表情和外观编码,可以轻松实现连续面部变形。通过引入身份特定调制和纹理编码器,我们的模型能够合成精确的光度细节,并展现出强大的表示能力。我们的模型在基于图像的拟合、随机生成、面部绑定、面部编辑和新视角合成等多个应用中均表现出色。实验表明,我们的方法在表示能力上优于以往的参数模型,并在多个应用中取得了具有竞争力的性能。据我们所知,我们的工作是首个基于神经辐射场的面部参数模型,可用于拟合、生成和操控。代码和数据可在https://github.com/zhuhao-nju/mofanerf获取。
abstract_en: We propose a parametric model that maps free-view images into a vector space of coded facial shape, expression and appearance with a neural radiance field, namely Morphable Facial NeRF. Specifically, MoFaNeRF takes the coded facial shape, expression and appearance along with space coordinate and view direction as input to an MLP, and outputs the radiance of the space point for photo-realistic image synthesis. Compared with conventional 3D morphable models (3DMM), MoFaNeRF shows superiority in directly synthesizing photo-realistic facial details even for eyes, mouths, and beards. Also, continuous face morphing can be easily achieved by interpolating the input shape, expression and appearance codes. By introducing identity-specific modulation and texture encoder, our model synthesizes accurate photometric details and shows strong representation ability. Our model shows strong ability on multiple applications including image-based fitting, random generation, face rigging, face editing, and novel view synthesis. Experiments show that our method achieves higher representation ability than previous parametric models, and achieves competitive performance in several applications. To the best of our knowledge, our work is the first facial parametric model built upon a neural radiance field that can be used in fitting, generation and manipulation. The code and data is available at https://github.com/zhuhao-nju/mofanerf.

title: Yiyuan Zhang, Sanyuan Zhao, Yuhao Kang, Jianbing Shen
title_en: Yiyuan Zhang, Sanyuan Zhao, Yuhao Kang, Jianbing Shen
abstract: 可见光-红外再识别(VI-ReID)在图像检索中具有挑战性。模态差异会导致显著的类内变化。现有方法大多通过模态不变性桥接不同模态,或生成中间模态以提升性能。不同地,本文提出了一种新型框架,名为级联聚合的模态协同互补学习网络(MSCLNet)。其核心思想是通过协同两种模态构建多样化的身份判别语义表示并减少噪声。随后,在两种模态优势的基础上对协同表示进行互补优化。此外,我们提出级联聚合策略,对特征分布进行细粒度优化,逐步聚合子类、类内和类间特征嵌入。在SYSU-MM01和RegDB数据集上的大量实验表明,MSCLNet显著优于现有方法。在大规模SYSU-MM01数据集上,我们的模型在Rank-1准确率和mAP值上分别达到76.99%和71.64%。我们的代码将开源于https://github.com/bitreidgroup/VI-ReID-MSCLNet
abstract_en: Visible-Infrared Re-Identification (VI-ReID) is challenging in image retrievals. The modality discrepancy will easily make huge intra-class variations. Most existing methods either bridge different modalities through modality-invariance or generate the intermediate modality for better performance. Differently, this paper proposes a novel framework, named Modality Synergy Complement Learning Network (MSCLNet) with Cascaded Aggregation. Its basic idea is to synergize two modalities to construct diverse representations of identity-discriminative semantics and less noise. Then, we complement synergistic representations under the advantages of the two modalities. Furthermore, we propose the Cascaded Aggregation strategy for fine-grained optimization of the feature distribution, which progressively aggregates feature embeddings from the subclass, intra-class, and inter-class. Extensive experiments on SYSU-MM01 and RegDB datasets show that MSCLNet outperforms the state-of-the-art by a large margin. On the large-scale SYSU-MM01 dataset, our model can achieve 76.99% and 71.64% in terms of Rank-1 accuracy and mAP value. Our code will be available at https://github.com/bitreidgroup/VI-ReID-MSCLNet

title: Yizeng Han, Yifan Pu, Zihang Lai, Chaofei Wang, Shiji Song, Junfeng Cao, Wenhui Huang, Chao Deng, Gao Huang
title_en: Yizeng Han, Yifan Pu, Zihang Lai, Chaofei Wang, Shiji Song, Junfeng Cao, Wenhui Huang, Chao Deng, Gao Huang
abstract: 早期退出是一种提升深度网络推理效率的有效范式。通过构建具有不同资源需求的分类器(出口),此类网络允许简单样本在早期出口输出,无需执行更深层的网络层。尽管现有研究主要聚焦于多出口网络的架构设计,但此类模型的训练策略仍鲜有探索。当前最先进的模型在训练时对所有样本一视同仁。然而,测试阶段的早期退出行为被忽视,导致训练与测试之间存在差距。本文提出通过样本加权来弥合这一差距。直观而言,通常在推理阶段早期退出的简单样本,应为训练早期分类器贡献更多。而难以处理的样本(主要从深层网络退出),则应由后期分类器重点训练。我们的工作提出采用权重预测网络,在每个出口对不同训练样本的损失进行加权。该权重预测网络与主干模型在元学习框架下,通过新颖的优化目标联合优化。通过将推理阶段的自适应行为引入训练阶段,我们证明所提出的加权机制能够持续改善分类准确率与推理效率之间的平衡。代码已开源于 https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/L2W-DEN。
abstract_en: Early exiting is an effective paradigm for improving the inference efficiency of deep networks. By constructing classifiers with varying resource demands (the exits), such networks allow easy samples to be output at early exits, removing the need for executing deeper layers. While existing works mainly focus on the architectural design of multi-exit networks, the training strategies for such models are largely left unexplored. The current state-of-the-art models treat all samples the same during training. However, the early-exiting behavior during testing has been ignored, leading to a gap between training and testing. In this paper, we propose to bridge this gap by sample weighting. Intuitively, easy samples, which generally exit early in the network during inference, should contribute more to training early classifiers. The training of hard samples (mostly exit from deeper layers), however, should be emphasized by the late classifiers. Our work proposes to adopt a weight prediction network to weight the loss of different training samples at each exit. This weight prediction network and the backbone model are jointly optimized under a \emph{meta-learning} framework with a novel optimization objective.
