By bringing the adaptive behavior during inference into the training phase, we show that the proposed weighting mechanism consistently improves the trade-off between classification accuracy and inference efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/L2W-DEN.

title: Yizheng Wu, Min Shi, Shuaiyuan Du, Hao Lu, Zhiguo Cao, Weicai Zhong
title_en: Yizheng Wu, Min Shi, Shuaiyuan Du, Hao Lu, Zhiguo Cao, Weicai Zhong
abstract: 我们引入了一种三维实例表示方法,称为实例核(instance kernels),其中每个实例通过一个一维向量表示,该向量编码了三维实例的语义、位置和形状信息。我们证明,通过在完整场景上扫描核,实例核能够实现简单的掩码推理,避免了标准三维实例分割流程中对提议(proposals)或启发式聚类算法的严重依赖。实例核的思想受到近期动态卷积在二维/三维实例分割中的成功应用的启发。然而,我们发现由于点云数据的无序和非结构化特性,表示三维实例具有挑战性,例如,较差的实例定位会显著降低实例表示质量。为了解决这一问题,我们构建了一种新颖的三维实例编码范式。首先,定位潜在的实例质心作为候选;然后设计一种候选合并方案,同时聚合重复候选并收集合并质心周围的上下文信息以形成实例核。一旦获得实例核,即可通过动态卷积重建实例掩码,其权重由实例核条件化。整个流程通过动态核网络(DKNet)实现。实验结果表明,DKNet在ScanNetV2和S3DIS数据集上均优于现有方法,且具有更优的实例定位性能。代码已开源:https://github.com/W1zheng/DKNet
abstract_en: We introduce a 3D instance representation, termed instance kernels, where instances are represented by one-dimensional vectors that encode the semantic, positional, and shape information of 3D instances. We show that instance kernels enable easy mask inference by simply scanning kernels over the entire scenes, avoiding the heavy reliance on proposals or heuristic clustering algorithms in standard 3D instance segmentation pipelines. The idea of instance kernel is inspired by recent success of dynamic convolutions in 2D/3D instance segmentation. However, we find it non-trivial to represent 3D instances due to the disordered and unstructured nature of point cloud data, e.g., poor instance localization can significantly degrade instance representation. To remedy this, we construct a novel 3D instance encoding paradigm. First, potential instance centroids are localized as candidates. Then, a candidate merging scheme is devised to simultaneously aggregate duplicated candidates and collect context around the merged centroids to form the instance kernels. Once instance kernels are available, instance masks can be reconstructed via dynamic convolutions whose weights are conditioned on instance kernels. The whole pipeline is instantiated with a dynamic kernel network (DKNet). Results show that DKNet outperforms the state of the arts on both ScanNetV2 and S3DIS datasets with better instance localization. Code is available: https://github.com/W1zheng/DKNet.

title: Yoli Shavit, Yosi Keller
title_en: Yoli Shavit, Yosi Keller
abstract: 绝对姿态回归器(APR)网络被训练以根据捕获的图像估计相机姿态。它们从图像中计算潜在表示,从而回归相机的位置和方向。与提供最先进精度的基于结构的定位方案相比,APRs在定位精度、运行时间和内存之间提供了不同的权衡。在本文中,我们引入了相机姿态自动编码器(PAEs),这是一种多层感知机,通过教师-学生方法进行训练,使用APRs作为教师来编码相机姿态。我们展示了由此产生的潜在姿态表示能够紧密复现APR的性能,并证明了它们在相关任务中的有效性。具体而言,我们提出了一种轻量级的测试时优化方法,其中最近的训练姿态被编码并用于精调相机位置估计。该过程在CambridgeLandmarks和7Scenes基准测试中实现了APRs的新状态-of-the-art位置精度。我们还展示了可以从学习的姿态编码中重建训练图像,为以低内存成本整合训练集的视觉信息铺平了道路。我们的代码和预训练模型可在https://github.com/yolish/camera-pose-auto-encoders获取。
abstract_en: Absolute pose regressor (APR) networks are trained to estimate the pose of the camera given a captured image. They compute latent image representations from which the camera position and orientation are regressed. APRs provide a different tradeoff between localization accuracy, runtime, and memory, compared to structure-based localization schemes that provide state-of-the-art accuracy. In this work, we introduce Camera Pose Auto-Encoders (PAEs), multilayer perceptrons that are trained via a Teacher-Student approach to encode camera poses using APRs as their teachers. We show that the resulting latent pose representations can closely reproduce APR performance and demonstrate their effectiveness for related tasks. Specifically, we propose a light-weight test-time optimization in which the closest train poses are encoded and used to refine camera position estimation. This procedure achieves a new state-of-the-art position accuracy for APRs, on both the CambridgeLandmarks and 7Scenes benchmarks. We also show that train images can be reconstructed from the learned pose encoding, paving the way for integrating visual information from the train set at a low memory cost. Our code and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/yolish/camera-pose-auto-encoders.

title: Yong Guo, David Stutz, Bernt Schiele
title_en: Yong Guo, David Stutz, Bernt Schiele
abstract: Despite their success, deep networks have been shown to be highly susceptible to perturbations, often causing significant drops in accuracy. In this paper, we investigate model robustness on perturbed inputs by studying the performance of internal sub-networks (subnets). Interestingly, we observe that most subnets show particularly poor robustness against perturbations. More importantly, these weak subnets are correlated with the overall lack of robustness. Tackling this phenomenon, we propose a new training procedure that identifies and enhances weak subnets (EWS) to improve robustness. Specifically, we develop a search algorithm to find particularly weak subnets and explicitly strengthen them via knowledge distillation from the full network. We show that EWS greatly improves both robustness against corrupted images as well as accuracy on clean data. Being complementary to popular data augmentation methods, EWS consistently improves robustness when combined with these approaches. To highlight the flexibility of our approach, we combine EWS also with popular adversarial training methods resulting in improved adversarial robustness.
abstract_en: Despite their success, deep networks have been shown to be highly susceptible to perturbations, often causing significant drops in accuracy. In this paper, we investigate model robustness on perturbed inputs by studying the performance of internal sub-networks (subnets). Interestingly, we observe that most subnets show particularly poor robustness against perturbations. More importantly, these weak subnets are correlated with the overall lack of robustness. Tackling this phenomenon, we propose a new training procedure that identifies and enhances weak subnets (EWS) to improve robustness. Specifically, we develop a search algorithm to find particularly weak subnets and explicitly strengthen them via knowledge distillation from the full network. We show that EWS greatly improves both robustness against corrupted images as well as accuracy on clean data. Being complementary to popular data augmentation methods, EWS consistently improves robustness when combined with these approaches. To highlight the flexibility of our approach, we combine EWS also with popular adversarial training methods resulting in improved adversarial robustness.

title: Yong Liu, Ran Yu, Fei Yin, Xinyuan Zhao, Wei Zhao, Weihao Xia, Yujiu Yang
title_en: Yong Liu, Ran Yu, Fei Yin, Xinyuan Zhao, Wei Zhao, Weihao Xia, Yujiu Yang
abstract: 近年来,几种基于时空记忆的方法已验证了将中间帧及其掩码作为记忆存储有助于视频中目标对象的分割。然而,这些方法主要关注当前帧与记忆帧之间的更好匹配,而没有显式关注记忆的质量。因此,分割掩码质量较差的帧容易被记忆,导致分割掩码误差累积问题,进而影响分割性能。此外,记忆帧数量随帧数线性增长也限制了模型处理长视频的能力。为此,我们提出了一种质量感知动态记忆网络(QDMN),用于评估每帧的分割质量,使记忆库能够选择性存储准确分割的帧以防止误差累积问题。随后,我们将分割质量与时间一致性结合,动态更新记忆库以提高模型的实用性。无需任何复杂设计,我们的QDMN在DAVIS和YouTube-VOS基准测试中均取得了新的最先进性能。此外,大量实验表明,所提出的质量评估模块(QAM)可作为通用插件应用于基于记忆的方法,并显著提升性能。我们的源代码可在https://github.com/workforai/QDMN获取。
abstract_en: Recently, several spatial-temporal memory-based methods have verified that storing intermediate frames and their masks as memory are helpful to segment target objects in videos. However, they mainly focus on better matching between the current frame and the memory frames without explicitly paying attention to the quality of the memory. Therefore, frames with poor segmentation masks are prone to be memorized, which leads to an segmentation mask error accumulation problem and further affect the segmentation performance. In addition, the linear increase of memory frames with the growth of frame number also limits the ability of the models to handle long videos. To this end, we propose a Quality-aware Dynamic Memory Network (QDMN) to evaluate the segmentation quality of each frame, allowing the memory bank to selectively store accurately segmented frames to prevent the error accumulation problem. Then, we combine the segmentation quality with temporal consistency to dynamically update the memory bank to improve the practicability of the models. Without any bells and whistles, our QDMN achieves new state-of-the-art performance on both DAVIS and YouTube-VOS benchmarks. Moreover, extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed Quality Assessment Module (QAM) can be applied to memory-based methods as generic plugins and significantly improves performance. Our source code is available at https://github.com/workforai/QDMN.

title: Yong Liu, Ran Yu, Jiahao Wang, Xinyuan Zhao, Yitong Wang, Yansong Tang, Yujiu Yang
title_en: Yong Liu, Ran Yu, Jiahao Wang, Xinyuan Zhao, Yitong Wang, Yansong Tang, Yujiu Yang
abstract: 本文通过增强帧内交互研究半监督视频对象分割。近期基于记忆网络的方法主要关注利用帧间时序参考,而对帧内空间依赖性关注较少。具体而言,这些分割模型容易受到某一帧中无关非目标对象的干扰。为此,我们提出全局谱滤波记忆网络(GSFM),通过在频域中学习长期空间依赖性来提升帧内交互。GSFM的关键组件是用于空间信息混合的二维(逆)离散傅里叶变换。此外,我们实证发现编码器(主干网络)应增强低频特征,而解码器(分割头)应增强高频特征。我们将其归因于编码器提取语义信息的作用以及解码器突出细粒度细节的作用。因此,提出低(高)频模块以适应这一情形。在流行的DAVIS和YouTube-VOS基准数据集上的大量实验表明,GSFM显著优于基线方法并达到最先进性能。此外,大量分析表明所提出的模块具有合理性及良好的泛化能力。我们的源代码可在https://github.com/workforai/GSFM获取。
abstract_en: This paper studies semi-supervised video object segmentation through boosting intra-frame interaction. Recent memory network-based methods focus on exploiting inter-frame temporal reference while paying little attention to intra-frame spatial dependency. Specifically, these segmentation model tends to be susceptible to interference from unrelated nontarget objects in a certain frame. To this end, we propose Global Spectral Filter Memory network (GSFM), which improves intra-frame interaction through learning long-term spatial dependencies in the spectral domain. The key components of GSFM is 2D (inverse) discrete Fourier transform for spatial information mixing. Besides, we empirically find low frequency feature should be enhanced in encoder (backbone) while high frequency for decoder (segmentation head). We attribute this to semantic information extracting role for encoder and fine-grained details highlighting role for decoder. Thus, Low (High)-Frequency Module is proposed to fit this circumstance. Extensive experiments on the popular DAVIS and YouTube-VOS benchmarks demonstrate that GSFM noticeably outperforms the baseline method and achieves state-of-the-art performance. Besides, extensive analysis shows that the proposed modules are reasonable and of great generalization ability. Our source code is available at https://github.com/workforai/GSFM.

title: Yongcheng Jing, Yining Mao, Yiding Yang, Yibing Zhan, Mingli Song, Xinchao Wang, Dacheng Tao
title_en: Yongcheng Jing, Yining Mao, Yiding Yang, Yibing Zhan, Mingli Song, Xinchao Wang, Dacheng Tao
abstract: 当前最先进的参数化和非参数化风格迁移方法容易因全局统计对齐导致局部风格模式失真,或因块不匹配产生令人不悦的伪影。本文研究了一种新颖的半参数化神经风格迁移框架,该框架缓解了参数化和非参数化风格化方法的不足。我们的方法核心思想是利用图神经网络(GNNs)建立精确且细粒度的内容-风格对应关系。为此,我们开发了一个详细的GNN模型,以内容和风格局部块作为图顶点。风格迁移过程随后被建模为在可学习方式下,风格节点与内容节点之间的注意力机制异构信息传递,从而在局部块层面实现自适应的多对一风格-内容关联。此外,引入了详细的可变形图卷积操作以实现跨尺度的风格-内容匹配。实验结果表明,所提出的半参数化图像风格化方法在具有挑战性的风格模式上取得了令人鼓舞的结果,既保持了全局外观,又保留了精美的细节。此外,通过在推理阶段控制边的数量,该方法还触发了诸如单模型多样化块基风格化等新功能。
abstract_en: State-of-the-art parametric and non-parametric style transfer approaches are prone to either distorted local style patterns due to global statistics alignment, or unpleasing artifacts resulting from patch mismatching. In this paper, we study a novel semi-parametric neural style transfer framework that alleviates the deficiency of both parametric and non-parametric stylization. The core idea of our approach is to establish accurate and fine-grained content-style correspondences using graph neural networks (GNNs). To this end, we develop an elaborated GNN model with content and style local patches as the graph vertices. The style transfer procedure is then modeled as the attention-based heterogeneous message passing between the style and content nodes in a learnable manner, leading to adaptive many-to-one style-content correlations at the local patch level. In addition, an elaborated deformable graph convolutional operation is introduced for cross-scale style-content matching. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed semi-parametric image stylization approach yields encouraging results on the challenging style patterns, preserving both global appearance and exquisite details. Furthermore, by controlling the number of edges at the inference stage, the proposed method also triggers novel functionalities like diversified patch-based stylization with a single model.

title: Yonghyun Jeong, Doyeon Kim, Youngmin Ro, Pyounggeon Kim, Jongwon Choi
title_en: Yonghyun Jeong, Doyeon Kim, Youngmin Ro, Pyounggeon Kim, Jongwon Choi
abstract: 尽管生成模型的最新进展为社会带来了诸多益处,但生成的图像可能被滥用于欺诈、诽谤和虚假新闻等恶意目的。为防止此类情况,学界开展了大量研究以区分生成图像与真实图像,但仍然面临在训练设置之外检测未见过的生成图像的挑战。为解决这一问题,我们分析了生成图像的特征性“指纹”,并提出了一种新框架,用于复现由各种生成模型产生的多样化指纹。通过仅使用真实图像训练模型,我们的框架可避免对特定生成模型的数据依赖,提升泛化能力。基于指纹在频域被强调的数学推导,我们设计了生成图像检测器以有效训练指纹。即使仅使用真实图像进行训练,我们的框架在性能上仍优于现有最先进的检测器。我们还提供了新的基准数据集,通过使用最新抗伪影生成模型的图像来展示模型的鲁棒性,以减少频谱差异。
abstract_en: While recent advances in generative models benefit the society, the generated images can be abused for malicious purposes, like fraud, defamation, and false news. To prevent such cases, vigorous research is conducted on distinguishing the generated images from the real ones, but challenges still remain with detecting the unseen generated images outside of the training settings. To overcome this problem, we analyze the distinctive characteristic of the generated images called ‘fingerprints,’ and propose a new framework to reproduce diverse types of fingerprints generated by various generative models. By training the model with the real images only, our framework can avoid data dependency on particular generative models and enhance generalization. With the mathematical derivation that the fingerprint is emphasized at the frequency domain, we design a generated image detector for effective training of the fingerprints. Our framework outperforms the prior state-of-the-art detectors, even though only real images are used for training. We also provide new benchmark datasets to demonstrate the model’s robustness using the images of the latest anti-artifact generative models for reducing the spectral discrepancies.

title: Yongming Rao, Wenliang Zhao, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu
title_en: Yongming Rao, Wenliang Zhao, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu
abstract: 视觉Transformer在多种视觉识别任务中展现出最先进的结果。将卷积替换为点积自注意力机制以混合空间信息的机制,普遍被认为是视觉Transformer成功的关键要素。本文深入探讨了视觉Transformer与近期全MLP模型之间的关键差异。我们的实证结果表明,视觉Transformer的优越性主要来源于数据依赖的token混合策略和多头机制,而非查询-键交互。受此观察启发,我们提出了一种计算和参数效率更高的操作,称为自适应权重混合,用于在无需token-token交互的情况下生成注意力权重。基于此操作,我们开发了一种新架构AMixer,能够在不使用自注意力的情况下捕捉长期和短期空间依赖关系。大量实验表明,我们的自适应权重混合方法比之前的方法更高效且有效,且我们的AMixer在ImageNet和下游任务上相比视觉Transformer和MLP模型在准确率与复杂度之间取得了更好的平衡。
abstract_en: Vision Transformers have shown state-of-the-art results for various visual recognition tasks. The dot-product self-attention mechanism that replaces convolution to mix spatial information is commonly recognized as the indispensable ingredient behind the success of vision Transformers. In this paper, we thoroughly investigate the key differences between vision Transformers and recent all-MLP models. Our empirical results show the superiority of vision Transformers mainly comes from the data-dependent token mixing strategy and the multi-head scheme instead of query-key interactions. Inspired by this observation, we propose a computationally and parametrically efficient operation named adaptive weight mixing to generate attention weights without token-token interactions. Based on this operation, we develop a new architecture named as AMixer to capture both long-term and short-term spatial dependencies without self-attention. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our adaptive weight mixing is more efficient and effective than previous weight generation methods and our AMixer can achieve a better trade-off between accuracy and complexity than vision Transformers and MLP models on both ImageNet and downstream tasks.

title: Yongsheng Yu, Dawei Du, Libo Zhang, Tiejian Luo
title_en: Yongsheng Yu, Dawei Du, Libo Zhang, Tiejian Luo
abstract: 图像修复是一个基于不完整图像与掩码来恢复缺失或损坏图像内容的不适定问题。先前的工作通常通过多阶段方式预测辅助结构(例如边缘、分割和轮廓)以帮助生成视觉上逼真的补全块。然而,不精确的辅助先验可能导致修复结果偏倚。此外,一些方法通过多个阶段的复杂神经网络实现时耗时较长。为了解决这一问题,我们开发了一种端到端的多模态引导Transformer网络,包含一个修复分支和两个辅助分支用于语义分割和边缘纹理。在每个Transformer块中,所提出的多尺度空间感知注意力模块可通过辅助去归一化高效学习多模态结构特征。与依赖于偏倚先验直接引导的先前方法不同,我们的方法基于多模态间的判别性交互信息,在图像中丰富语义一致的上下文。在多个具有挑战性的图像修复数据集上的综合实验表明,我们的方法在处理各种规则/不规则掩码时实现了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Image inpainting is an ill-posed problem to recover missing or damaged image content based on incomplete images with masks. Previous works usually predict the auxiliary structures (\eg, edges, segmentation and contours) to help fill visually realistic patches in a multi-stage fashion. However, imprecise auxiliary priors may yield biased inpainted results. Besides, it is time-consuming for some methods to be implemented by multiple stages of complex neural networks. To solve this issue, we develop an end-to-end multi-modality guided transformer network, including one inpainting branch and two auxiliary branches for semantic segmentation and edge textures. Within each transformer block, the proposed multi-scale spatial-aware attention module can learn the multi-modal structural features efficiently via auxiliary denormalization. Different from previous methods relying on direct guidance from biased priors, our method enriches semantically consistent context in an image based on discriminative interplay information from multiple modalities. Comprehensive experiments on several challenging image inpainting datasets show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance to deal with various regular/irregular masks efficiently.

title: 于永生, 张立波, 范恒, 罗铁建
title_en: Yongsheng Yu, Libo Zhang, Heng Fan, Tiejian Luo
abstract: 图像修复旨在通过其未遮挡内容,以语义一致的方式恢复损坏图像。先前方法通常重用训练良好的GAN作为有效先验,通过GAN反演生成缺失区域的逼真补丁。然而,这些算法对硬约束的忽视可能导致GAN反演与图像修复之间的差距。为解决此问题,本文提出了一种新的GAN反演模型用于图像修复,称为{\it InvertFill},主要由一个包含预调制模块的编码器和一个具有F&W+潜在空间的GAN生成器组成。在编码器中,预调制网络利用多尺度结构将更具判别性的语义编码到风格向量中。为弥合GAN反演与图像修复之间的差距,提出F&W+潜在空间以消除明显的色彩差异和语义不一致。为重建忠实且逼真的图像,设计了一个简单而有效的软更新均值潜在模块,以捕捉更多域内模式,合成高保真纹理以处理大范围损坏。在Places2、CelebA-HQ、MetFaces和Scenery四个具有挑战性的数据集上的综合实验表明,我们的InvertFill在定性和定量上均优于先进方法,并能良好支持跨域图像的补全。所有代码、模型和结果将在接受后公开。
abstract_en: Image inpainting seeks a semantically consistent way to recover the corrupted image in the light of its unmasked content. Previous approaches usually reuse the well-trained GAN as effective prior to generate realistic patches for missing holes with GAN inversion. Nevertheless, the ignorance of hard constraint in these algorithms may yield the gap between GAN inversion and image inpainting. Addressing this problem, in this paper we devise a novel GAN inversion model for image inpainting, dubbed {\it InvertFill}, mainly consisting of an encoder with a pre-modulation module and a GAN generator with F&W+ latent space. Within the encoder, the pre-modulation network leverages multi-scale structures to encode more discriminative semantic into style vectors. In order to bridge the gap between GAN inversion and image inpainting, F&W+ latent space is proposed to eliminate glaring color discrepancy and semantic inconsistency. To reconstruct faithful and photorealistic images, a simple yet effective Soft-update Mean Latent module is designed to capture more diverse in-domain patterns that synthesize high-fidelity textures for large corruptions. Comprehensive experiments on four challenging dataset, including Places2, CelebA-HQ, MetFaces, and Scenery, demonstrate that our InvertFill outperforms the advanced approaches qualitatively and quantitatively and supports the completion of out-of-domain images well. All codes, models and results will be made available upon the acceptance.

title: 陈永伟, 王子豪, 邹长坤, 陈科, 贾奎
title_en: Yongwei Chen, Zihao Wang, Longkun Zou, Ke Chen, Kui Jia
abstract: 基于基准数据集的物体点云语义分析主要依赖于合成数据集的发布,包括从物体CAD模型中采样的合成实例。然而,从合成数据中学习可能无法泛化到实际场景,其中点云通常不完整、分布不均匀且存在噪声。这种模拟到现实(Sim2Real)领域差距的挑战可以通过领域自适应学习算法缓解;然而,我们认为通过更物理真实的渲染生成合成点云是一种强大的替代方案,因为可以系统地捕捉非均匀噪声模式。为此,我们提出了一种集成方案,包括通过将散斑图案投影到CAD模型上生成立体图像来实现物体点云的物理真实合成,以及一种新颖的准平衡自训练方法,通过稀疏性驱动的伪标签样本选择,针对长尾类实现更平衡的数据分布。实验结果验证了我们方法的有效性及其两个模块在点云分类上的无监督领域自适应性能,达到了最先进的表现。源代码和SpeckleNet合成数据集可在https://github.com/Gorilla-Lab-SCUT/QS3获取。
abstract_en: Semantic analyses of object point clouds are largely driven by releasing of benchmarking datasets, including synthetic ones whose instances are sampled from object CAD models. However, learning from synthetic data may not generalize to practical scenarios, where point clouds are typically incomplete, non-uniformly distributed, and noisy. Such a challenge of Simulation-to-Reality (Sim2Real) domain gap could be mitigated via learning algorithms of domain adaptation; however, we argue that generation of synthetic point clouds via more physically realistic rendering is a powerful alternative, as systematic non-uniform noise patterns can be captured. To this end, we propose an integrated scheme consisting of physically realistic synthesis of object point clouds via rendering stereo images via projection of speckle patterns onto CAD models and a novel quasi-balanced self-training designed for more balanced data distribution by sparsity-driven selection of pseudo labeled samples for long tailed classes. Experiment results can verify the effectiveness of our method as well as both of its modules for unsupervised domain adaptation on point cloud classification, achieving the state-of-the-art performance. Source codes and the SpeckleNet synthetic dataset are available at https://github.com/Gorilla-Lab-SCUT/QS3.

title: Youming Deng, Yansheng Li, Yongjun Zhang, Xiang Xiang, Jian Wang, Jingdong Chen, Jiayi Ma
title_en: Youming Deng, Yansheng Li, Yongjun Zhang, Xiang Xiang, Jian Wang, Jingdong Chen, Jiayi Ma
abstract: 针对场景图生成(SGG),由于众包标注的存在,粗粒度与细粒度谓词在数据集中混合,且长尾问题也较为显著。鉴于这一复杂情况,许多现有SGG方法将谓词视为同等重要,并在单阶段监督下通过混合粒度谓词进行模型学习,导致预测结果相对粗糙。为缓解次优混合粒度标注及长尾效应问题,本文提出了一种新颖的分层记忆学习(HML)框架,从简单到复杂地学习模型,类似于人类的分层记忆学习过程。在完成粗粒度与细粒度谓词的自主划分后,模型首先在粗粒度谓词上进行训练,随后学习细粒度谓词。为实现这一分层学习模式,本文首次采用新的概念重构(CR)与模型重构(MR)约束公式化HML框架。值得注意的是,HML框架可视为一种通用优化策略,用于提升各类SGG模型性能,并在SGG基准测试中取得显著改进。
abstract_en: Regarding Scene Graph Generation (SGG), coarse and fine predicates mix in the dataset due to the crowd-sourced labeling, and the long-tail problem is also pronounced. Given this tricky situation, many existing SGG methods treat the predicates equally and learn the model under the supervision of mixed-granularity predicates in one stage, leading to relatively coarse predictions. In order to alleviate the impact of the suboptimum mixed-granularity annotation and long-tail effect problems, this paper proposes a novel Hierarchical Memory Learning (HML) framework to learn the model from simple to complex, which is similar to the human beings’ hierarchical memory learning process. After the autonomous partition of coarse and fine predicates, the model is first trained on the coarse predicates and then learns the fine predicates. In order to realize this hierarchical learning pattern, this paper, for the first time, formulates the HML framework using the new Concept Reconstruction (CR) and Model Reconstruction (MR) constraints. It is worth noticing that the HML framework can be taken as one general optimization strategy to improve various SGG models, and significant improvement can be achieved on the SGG benchmark.

title: Young Hwi Kim, Hyolim Kang, Seon Joo Kim
title_en: Young Hwi Kim, Hyolim Kang, Seon Joo Kim
abstract: 大多数在线视频理解任务旨在立即处理每个流媒体帧并逐帧输出预测结果。为了扩展现有在线视频任务的实例级预测,最近提出了在线时序动作定位(Online Temporal Action Localization, On-TAL)。然而,由于缺乏实例级上下文,简单的On-TAL方法在对每帧预测进行分组时存在局限性。为此,我们提出在线锚框变换器(Online Anchor Transformer, OAT),将基于锚框的动作定位模型扩展到在线设置中。我们还引入了一种适用于在线场景的后处理方法,用于抑制重复的动作提案。在THUMOS’14、MUSES和BBDB数据集上对On-TAL的评估显示,mAP指标有显著提升,且通过略微调整后处理方法,我们的模型在性能上与最先进的离线时序动作定位(TAL)方法相当。除了mAP评估外,我们还提出了一种针对On-TAL的新型在线导向指标——早期检测指标,并测量了每种On-TAL方法的响应性。
abstract_en: Most online video understanding tasks aim to immediately process each streaming frame and output predictions frame-by-frame. For extension to instance-level predictions of existing online video tasks, Online Temporal Action Localization (On-TAL) has been recently proposed. However, simple On-TAL approaches of grouping per-frame predictions have limitations due to the lack of instance-level context. To this end, we propose Online Anchor Transformer (OAT) to extend the anchor-based action localization model to the online setting. We also introduce an online-applicable post-processing method that suppresses repetitive action proposals. Evaluations of On-TAL on THUMOS’14, MUSES, and BBDB show significant improvements in terms of mAP, and our model shows comparable performance to the state-of-the-art offline TAL methods with a minor change of the post-processing method. In addition to mAP evaluation, we additionally present a new online-oriented metric of early detection for On-TAL, and measure the responsiveness of each On-TAL approach.

title: Young Kyun Jang, Geonmo Gu, Byungsoo Ko, Isaac Kang, Nam Ik Cho
title_en: Young Kyun Jang, Geonmo Gu, Byungsoo Ko, Isaac Kang, Nam Ik Cho
abstract: 在基于哈希的图像检索系统中,退化或变换后的输入通常会生成与原始输入不同的代码,从而降低检索准确性。为缓解这一问题,可以在训练过程中应用数据增强。然而,即使图像的增强样本在真实特征空间中相似,量化过程仍可能使它们在汉明空间中分散得很远。这会导致表示差异,进而阻碍训练并降低性能。在本文中,我们提出了一种新颖的自蒸馏哈希方案,以最小化这种差异并利用增强数据的潜力。通过将弱变换样本的哈希知识转移到强变换样本,我们使哈希码对各种变换不敏感。我们还引入了基于哈希代理的相似性学习和基于二元交叉熵的量化损失,以提供高质量的哈希码。最终,我们构建了一个深度哈希框架,不仅改进了现有的深度哈希方法,还实现了最先进的检索结果。进行了大量实验,验证了我们工作的有效性。
abstract_en: In hash-based image retrieval systems, degraded or transformed inputs usually generate different codes from the original, deteriorating the retrieval accuracy. To mitigate this issue, data augmentation can be applied during training. However, even if augmented samples of an image are similar in real feature space, the quantization can scatter them far away in Hamming space. This results in representation discrepancies that can impede training and degrade performance. In this work, we propose a novel self-distilled hashing scheme to minimize the discrepancy while exploiting the potential of augmented data. By transferring the hash knowledge of the weakly-transformed samples to the strong ones, we make the hash code insensitive to various transformations. We also introduce hash proxy-based similarity learning and binary cross entropy-based quantization loss to provide fine quality hash codes. Ultimately, we construct a deep hashing framework that not only improves the existing deep hashing approaches, but also achieves the state-of-the-art retrieval results. Extensive experiments are conducted and confirm the effectiveness of our work.

title: Youngeun Kim, Yuhang Li, Hyoungseob Park, Yeshwanth Venkatesha, Priyadarshini Panda
title_en: Youngeun Kim, Yuhang Li, Hyoungseob Park, Yeshwanth Venkatesha, Priyadarshini Panda
abstract: 脉冲神经网络(SNNs)由于其固有的高稀疏激活特性,作为传统人工神经网络(ANNs)的潜在节能替代方案而受到广泛关注。然而,大多数先前的SNN方法使用类似ANN的架构(例如VGG-Net或ResNet),这可能在SNN中对二进制信息的时间序列处理提供次优性能。为了解决这个问题,本文介绍了一种新颖的神经架构搜索(NAS)方法,用于寻找更好的SNN架构。受最近NAS方法的启发,这些方法通过初始化时的激活模式找到最优架构,我们选择能够在不同数据样本中表示多样化脉冲激活模式的架构,而无需训练。此外,为了进一步利用脉冲之间的时序信息,我们搜索层之间的前馈连接以及后向连接(即时间反馈连接)。有趣的是,通过我们的搜索算法找到的SNASNet在具有后向连接的情况下实现了更高的性能,这表明设计适合利用时序信息的SNN架构的重要性。我们在三个图像识别基准上进行了广泛的实验,结果表明SNASNet在显著减少时间步数(5个时间步)的情况下实现了最先进的性能。代码可在Github上获取。
abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have gained huge attention as a potential energy-efficient alternative to conventional Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) due to their inherent high-sparsity activation. However, most prior SNN methods use ANN-like architectures (e.g., VGG-Net or ResNet), which could provide sub-optimal performance for temporal sequence processing of binary information in SNNs. To address this, in this paper, we introduce a novel Neural Architecture Search (NAS) approach for finding better SNN architectures. Inspired by recent NAS approaches that find the optimal architecture from activation patterns at initialization, we select the architecture that can represent diverse spike activation patterns across different data samples without training. Moreover, to further leverage the temporal information among the spikes, we search for feed forward connections as well as backward connections (i.e., temporal feedback connections) between layers. Interestingly, SNASNet found by our search algorithm achieves higher performance with backward connections, demonstrating the importance of designing SNN architecture for suitably using temporal information. We conduct extensive experiments on three image recognition benchmarks where we show that SNASNet achieves state-of-the-art performance with significantly lower timesteps (5 timesteps). Code is available at Github.

title: Youngeun Kim, Yuhang Li, Hyoungseob Park, Yeshwanth Venkatesha, Ruokai Yin, Priyadarshini Panda
title_en: Youngeun Kim, Yuhang Li, Hyoungseob Park, Yeshwanth Venkatesha, Ruokai Yin, Priyadarshini Panda
abstract: 脉冲神经网络(SNNs)近年来作为一种新型低功耗深度神经网络崭露头角,适合在低功耗移动/边缘设备上实现。由于此类设备内存存储有限,近年来对SNNs的神经剪枝技术进行了广泛研究。大多数现有SNN剪枝工作聚焦于浅层SNNs(2-6层),然而,最新SNN研究提出了更深的SNNs(>16层),这难以与现有SNN剪枝方法兼容。为将剪枝技术扩展至深层SNNs,我们研究了彩票假设(LTH),该假设指出密集网络包含较小的子网络(即胜出票),其性能可与密集网络相当。我们的LTH研究揭示了胜出票在不同数据集和架构的深层SNNs中始终存在,可实现高达97%的稀疏性而不会造成巨大性能损失。然而,LTH的迭代搜索过程在结合SNNs的多时间步时会带来巨大的训练计算成本。为缓解这种沉重的搜索成本,我们提出了早期时间(ET)票,通过较少时间步即可找到重要权重连接。所提出的ET票可无缝结合常见剪枝技术(如迭代幅度剪枝IMP和早鸟票EB)以寻找胜出票。实验结果表明,与IMP或EB方法相比,ET票可将搜索时间减少高达38%。代码可在Github上获取。
abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have recently emerged as a new generation of low-power deep neural networks, which is suitable to be implemented on low-power mobile/edge devices. As such devices have limited memory storage, neural pruning on SNNs has been widely explored in recent years. Most existing SNN pruning works focus on shallow SNNs (2 6 layers), however, deeper SNNs (>16 layers) are proposed by state-of-the-art SNN works, which is difficult to be compatible with the current SNN pruning work. To scale up a pruning technique towards deep SNNs, we investigate Lottery Ticket Hypothesis (LTH) which states that dense networks contain smaller subnetworks (i.e., winning tickets) that achieve comparable performance to the dense networks. Our studies on LTH reveal that the winning tickets consistently exist in deep SNNs across various datasets and architectures, providing up to 97% sparsity without huge performance degradation. However, the iterative searching process of LTH brings a huge training computational cost when combined with the multiple timesteps of SNNs. To alleviate such heavy searching cost, we propose Early-Time (ET) ticket where we find the important weight connectivity from a smaller number of timesteps. The proposed ET ticket can be seamlessly combined with a common pruning techniques for finding winning tickets, such as Iterative Magnitude Pruning (IMP) and Early-Bird (EB) tickets. Our experiment results show that the proposed ET ticket reduces search time by up to 38% compared to IMP or EB methods. Code is available at Github.

title: Younho Jang, Wheemyung Shin, Jinbeom Kim, Simon Woo, Sung-Ho Bae
title_en: Younho Jang, Wheemyung Shin, Jinbeom Kim, Simon Woo, Sung-Ho Bae
abstract: 知识蒸馏(KD)是一种著名的模型压缩策略,旨在以更少的参数提升模型性能。然而,近期针对目标检测的知识蒸馏方法面临两个局限性。首先,它们仅蒸馏邻近的前景区域,忽略了潜在有用的背景信息。其次,它们仅考虑全局上下文,导致学生模型难以从教师模型中学习局部细节。为克服这些挑战性问题,我们提出了一种新颖的知识蒸馏方法GLAMD,从教师模型中同时蒸馏全局和局部知识。我们将特征图划分为多个块,并对整个特征区域及每个块应用注意力机制,以同时提取全局上下文和局部细节。我们的方法在COCO2017数据集上取得了40.8 AP的优异表现,比基于ResNet50的 Faster R-CNN学生模型高3.4 AP,比之前的基于全局注意力机制的蒸馏方法高0.7 AP。
abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a well-known model compression strategy to improve models’ performance with fewer parameters. However, recent KD approaches for object detection have faced two limitations. First, they distill nearby foreground regions, ignoring potentially useful background information. Second, they only consider global contexts, thereby the student model can hardly learn local details from the teacher model. To overcome such challenging issues, we propose a novel knowledge distillation method, GLAMD, distilling both global and local knowledge from the teacher. We divide the feature maps into several patches and apply an attention mechanism for both the entire feature area and each patch to extract the global context as well as local details simultaneously. Our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods with 40.8 AP on COCO2017 dataset, which is 3.4 AP higher than the student model (ResNet50 based Faster R-CNN) and 0.7 AP higher than the previous global attention-based distillation method.

title: Youwei Li, Haibin Huang, Lanpeng Jia, Haoqiang Fan, Shuaicheng Liu
title_en: Youwei Li, Haibin Huang, Lanpeng Jia, Haoqiang Fan, Shuaicheng Liu
abstract: 本文提出D2C-SR,一种面向现实场景图像超分辨率任务的新型框架。作为一类病态问题,超分辨率相关任务的关键挑战在于给定低分辨率输入可能对应多种预测结果。大多数经典深度学习方法忽略了这一基本事实,缺乏对潜在高频分布的显式建模,导致结果模糊。近期基于生成对抗网络(GAN)或学习超分辨率空间的方法虽能生成模拟纹理,但无法保证纹理的准确性,定量性能较低。重新思考这两方面,我们以离散形式学习潜在高频细节的分布,并提出两阶段流水线:发散阶段到收敛阶段。在发散阶段,我们设计基于树结构的深度网络作为发散主干网络。提出发散损失函数,鼓励树结构网络生成的结果发散至可能的高频表示,这是我们对潜在高频分布的离散建模方式。在收敛阶段,我们分配空间权重融合这些发散预测,获得包含更准确细节的最终输出。我们的方法提供了便捷的端到端推理方式。我们在多个现实场景基准数据集上进行评估,包括新提出的具有x8放大倍率的D2CRealSR数据集。实验表明,D2C-SR在准确性和视觉效果上均优于现有最先进方法,参数数量显著减少。我们的D2C结构还可作为通用结构应用于其他方法以获得性能提升。代码和数据集已开源:https://github.com/megvii-research/D2C-SR
abstract_en: In this paper, we present D2C-SR, a novel framework for the task of real-world image super-resolution. As an ill-posed problem, the key challenge in super-resolution related tasks is there can be multiple predictions for a given low-resolution input. Most classical deep learning based approaches ignored the fundamental fact and lack explicit modeling of the underlying high-frequency distribution which leads to blurred results. Recently, some methods of GAN-based or learning super-resolution space can generate simulated textures but do not promise the accuracy of the textures which have low quantitative performance. Rethinking both, we learn the distribution of underlying high-frequency details in a discrete form and propose a two-stage pipeline: divergence stage to convergence stage. At divergence stage, we propose a tree-based structure deep network as our divergence backbone. Divergence loss is proposed to encourage the generated results from the tree-based network to diverge into possible high-frequency representations, which is our way of discretely modeling the underlying high-frequency distribution. At convergence stage, we assign spatial weights to fuse these divergent predictions to obtain the final output with more accurate details. Our approach provides a convenient end-to-end manner to inference. We conduct evaluations on several real-world benchmarks, including a new proposed D2CRealSR dataset with x8 scaling factor. Our experiments demonstrate that D2C-SR achieves better accuracy and visual improvements against state-of-the-art methods, with a significantly less parameters number and our D2C structure can also be applied as a generalized structure to some other methods to obtain improvement. Our codes and dataset are available at https://github.com/megvii-research/D2C-SR

title: Yu Hong, Hang Dai, Yong Ding
title_en: Yu Hong, Hang Dai, Yong Ding
abstract: 利用基于LiDAR的探测器或真实LiDAR点数据指导单目3D检测带来了显著提升,例如伪LiDAR方法。然而,现有方法通常采用非端到端训练策略,并未充分挖掘LiDAR信息的潜力,其中LiDAR数据的丰富潜力尚未被充分挖掘。本文提出跨模态知识蒸馏(CMKD)网络用于单目3D检测,以高效直接的方式在特征和响应层面将LiDAR模态的知识迁移至图像模态。此外,我们进一步将CMKD扩展为半监督训练框架,通过从大规模无标签数据中蒸馏知识显著提升了性能。截至投稿,CMKD在KITTI测试集和Waymo验证集上的单目3D检测器中排名第一,相比之前最先进的方法取得了显著性能提升。我们的代码将在https://github.com/Cc-Hy/CMKD发布。
abstract_en: Leveraging LiDAR-based detectors or real LiDAR point data to guide monocular 3D detection has brought significant improvement, e.g., Pseudo-LiDAR methods. However, the existing methods usually apply non-end-to-end training strategies and insufficiently leverage the LiDAR information, where the rich potential of the LiDAR data has not been well exploited. In this paper, we propose the Cross-Modality Knowledge Distillation (CMKD) network for monocular 3D detection to efficiently and directly transfer the knowledge from LiDAR modality to image modality on both features and responses. Moreover, we further extend CMKD as a semi-supervised training framework by distilling knowledge from large-scale unlabeled data and significantly boost the performance. Until submission, CMKD ranks 1st among the monocular 3D detectors with publications on both KITTI test set and Waymo val set with significant performance gains compared to previous state-of-the-art methods. Our code will be released at https://github.com/Cc-Hy/CMKD.

title: Yu Liu, Hui Zhang
title_en: Yu Liu, Hui Zhang
abstract: 本文研究了在一般运动下基于基础矩阵的相机自标定问题。基础矩阵可以分解为对称部分(Steiner圆锥)和反对称部分(固定点),我们发现这对完全标定相机参数具有重要意义。我们首先通过基础矩阵对称、反对称部分的图像以及绝对二次曲线的图像获取固定直线。然后阐述并证明了该固定直线的性质,由此推导出Steiner圆锥与绝对二次曲线图像之间一般特征向量的新约束条件。因此,我们提出了一种完全标定相机参数的方法。首先,通过至少三幅图像获得的图像绝对二次曲线的新约束条件,可以求解出相机的三个内参参数,即两个焦距和倾斜角。在此基础上,我们可初始化并迭代恢复Steiner圆锥的最优投影中心对,从而获得对应的消失线和圆点图像。最后,利用至少三幅图像获得的圆点图像,完全标定所有五个相机参数。在合成数据和真实数据上的实验结果表明,我们的方法在精度方面达到了最先进的性能水平。
abstract_en: This paper addresses the problem of camera auto-calibration from the fundamental matrix under general motion. The fundamental matrix can be decomposed into a symmetric part (a Steiner conic) and a skew-symmetric part (a fixed point), which we find useful for fully calibrating camera parameters. We first obtain a fixed line from the image of the symmetric, skew-symmetric parts of the fundamental matrix and the image of the absolute conic. Then the properties of this fixed line are presented and proved, from which new constraints on general eigenvectors between the Steiner conic and the image of the absolute conic are derived. We thus propose a method to fully calibrate the camera. First, the three camera intrinsic parameters, i.e., the two focal lengths and the skew, can be solved from our new constraints on the imaged absolute conic obtained from at least three images. On this basis, we can initialize and then iteratively restore the optimal pair of projection centers of the Steiner conic, thereby obtaining the corresponding vanishing lines and images of circular points. Finally, all five camera parameters are fully calibrated using images of circular points obtained from at least three images. Experimental results on synthetic and real data demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of accuracy.

title: Yu Qiu, Jing Xu
title_en: Yu Qiu, Jing Xu
abstract: 目前针对CT切片的病灶分割研究多集中于单一类型的病灶。然而,通用且多类别的病灶分割更为重要,因为不同部位的诊断通常相互关联且同时进行。现有的通用病灶分割方法由于缺乏像素级标注数据,属于弱监督方法。为将该领域引入全监督时代,我们建立了一个大规模的通用病灶分割数据集SegLesion。同时,我们为该任务提出了一种基线方法。考虑到由于CT场景有限,CT切片易于编码,我们提出了一种知识嵌入模块(KEM),以适应字典学习的概念用于该任务。具体而言,KEM首先学习CT切片的知识编码,然后将学习到的知识编码嵌入到CT切片的深度特征中以提高区分性。通过引入KEM,设计了用于通用病灶分割的知识嵌入网络(KEN)。为广泛比较KEN与之前分割方法,我们为SegLesion构建了一个大型基准测试。KEN实现了最先进的性能,因此可作为未来研究的强有力基线。数据和代码将公开发布。
abstract_en: Most efforts on lesion segmentation from CT slices focus on one specific lesion type. However, universal and multi-category lesion segmentation is more important because the diagnoses of different body parts are usually correlated and carried out simultaneously. The existing universal lesion segmentation methods are weakly-supervised due to the lack of pixel-level annotation data. To bring this field into the fully-supervised era, we establish a large-scale universal lesion segmentation dataset, SegLesion. We also propose a baseline method for this task. Considering that it is easy to encode CT slices owing to the limited CT scenarios, we propose a Knowledge Embedding Module (KEM) to adapt the concept of dictionary learning for this task. Specifically, KEM first learns the knowledge encoding of CT slices and then embeds the learned knowledge encoding into the deep features of a CT slice to increase the distinguishability. With KEM incorporated, a Knowledge Embedding Network (KEN) is designed for universal lesion segmentation. To extensively compare KEN to previous segmentation methods, we build a large benchmark for SegLesion. KEN achieves state-of-the-art performance and can thus serve as a strong baseline for future research. Data and code will be released.

title: Yu Tian, Yuyuan Liu, Guansong Pang, Fengbei Liu, Yuanhong Chen, Gustavo Carneiro
title_en: Yu Tian, Yuyuan Liu, Guansong Pang, Fengbei Liu, Yuanhong Chen, Gustavo Carneiro
abstract: 当前最先进的(SOTA)复杂城市驾驶场景异常分割方法探索通过异常暴露学习的像素级分类不确定性,或外部重建模型。然而,先前直接将高不确定性关联到异常的方法有时会导致错误的异常预测,而外部重建模型往往对实时自动驾驶嵌入式系统来说效率不足。在本文中,我们提出了一种新的异常分割方法,名为像素级能量偏置弃权学习(PEBAL),该方法结合了学习自适应像素级异常类的模型和学习内点像素分布的能量模型(EBM)。更具体地说,PEBAL基于EBM和AL的非平凡联合训练,其中EBM被训练以对异常像素(来自异常暴露)输出高能量,而AL被训练使得这些高能量像素在被归入异常类时接受自适应的低惩罚。我们对PEBAL进行了广泛的评估,结果表明其在四个基准测试中均取得了最佳性能。
abstract_en: State-of-the-art (SOTA) anomaly segmentation approaches on complex urban driving scenes explore pixel-wise classification uncertainty learned from outlier exposure, or external reconstruction models. However, previous uncertainty approaches that directly associate high uncertainty to anomaly may sometimes lead to incorrect anomaly predictions, and external reconstruction models tend to be too inefficient for real-time self-driving embedded systems. In this paper, we propose a new anomaly segmentation method, named pixel-wise energy-biased abstention learning (PEBAL), that explores pixel-wise abstention learning (AL) with a model that learns an adaptive pixel-level anomaly class, and an energy-based model (EBM) that learns inlier pixel distribution. More specifically, PEBAL is based on a non-trivial joint training of EBM and AL, where EBM is trained to output high-energy for anomaly pixels (from outlier exposure) and AL is trained such that these high-energy pixels receive adaptive low penalty for being included to the anomaly class. We extensively evaluate PEBAL against the SOTA and show that it achieves the best performance across four benchmarks.

title: Yu Zhang, Junle Yu, Xiaolin Huang, Wenhui Zhou, Ji Hou
title_en: Yu Zhang, Junle Yu, Xiaolin Huang, Wenhui Zhou, Ji Hou
abstract: 本文介绍了PCR-CG:一种新颖的3D点云配准模块,显式地将颜色信号嵌入到几何表示中。与仅使用几何表示的先前方法不同,我们的模块专门设计用于有效关联颜色与几何信息以完成点云配准任务。我们的主要贡献是一种2D-3D跨模态学习算法,该算法将从颜色信号中学习到的特征嵌入到几何表示中。通过我们设计的2D-3D投影模块,图像中对应点周围正方形区域的像素特征能够有效关联到点云表示。这样,重叠区域不仅可以通过点云推断,还可以通过纹理外观进行推断。颜色的添加并非易事。我们对比了多种用于向3D添加颜色的基线方法,例如通过隐式方式逐像素添加特征或RGB值。我们以Predator作为基线方法,并将其模块集成到该方法中。实验结果表明,在3DLoMatch基准测试中取得了显著提升。借助我们的模块,我们在基线方法的基础上实现了6.5%的配准召回率提升。为验证2D特征对3D任务的有效性,我们对不同的2D预训练网络进行了消融实验,并展示了预训练权重与任务性能之间的正相关关系。我们的研究揭示了在配准任务中将显式的深度颜色特征与点云关联所带来的显著优势。
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce PCR-CG: a novel 3D point cloud registration module explicitly embedding the color signals into geometry representation. Different from the previous methods that used only geometry representation, our module is specifically designed to effectively correlate color and geometry for the point cloud registration task. Our key contribution is a 2D-3D cross-modality learning algorithm that embeds the features learned from color signals to the geometry representation. With our designed 2D-3D projection module, the pixel features in a square region centered at correspondences perceived from images are effectively correlated with point cloud representations. In this way, the overlap regions can be inferred not only from point cloud but also from the texture appearances. Adding color is non-trivial. We compare against a variety of baselines designed for adding color to 3D, such as exhaustively adding per-pixel features or RGB values in an implicit manner. We leverage Predator as our baseline method and incorporate our module into it. Our experimental results indicate a significant improvement on the 3DLoMatch benchmark. With the help of our module, we achieve a significant improvement of 6.5% registration recall over our baseline method. To validate the effectiveness of 2D features on 3D, we ablate different 2D pre-trained networks and show a positive correlation between the pre-trained weights and task performance. Our study reveals a significant advantage of correlating explicit deep color features to the point cloud in the registration task.

title: Yu-Jie Chen, Shin-I Cheng, Wei-Chen Chiu, Hung-Yu Tseng, Hsin-Ying Lee
title_en: Yu-Jie Chen, Shin-I Cheng, Wei-Chen Chiu, Hung-Yu Tseng, Hsin-Ying Lee
abstract: 当前的图像到图像翻译方法通过条件生成模型来构建任务,导致模型仅学习到颜色变化或局部区域变化,这些变化受到条件上下文提供的丰富结构信息的约束。在本工作中,我们提出将向量量化技术引入图像到图像翻译框架。向量量化的内容表示不仅能够促进翻译过程,还能实现不同领域间的无条件分布共享。同时,结合解耦的风格表示,所提出的方法进一步增强了图像扩展能力,使其在领域内和跨领域中均具备灵活性。定性与定量实验表明,我们的框架在图像到图像翻译和图像扩展任务中取得了与最先进方法相当的性能。与针对单一任务的方法相比,所提出的方法作为统一框架,能够整合图像到图像翻译、无条件生成和图像扩展等多种应用。例如,它为图像生成和扩展提供了风格多样性,并为图像到图像翻译赋予了进一步的扩展能力。
abstract_en: Current image-to-image translation methods formulate the task with conditional generation models, leading to learning only the recolorization or regional changes as being constrained by the rich structural information provided by the conditional contexts. In this work, we propose introducing the vector quantization technique into the image-to-image translation framework. The vector quantized content representation can facilitate not only the translation, but also the unconditional distribution shared among different domains. Meanwhile, along with the disentangled style representation, the proposed method further enables the capability of image extension with flexibility in both intra- and inter-domains. Qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves comparable performance to the state-of-the-art image-to-image translation and image extension methods. Compared to methods for individual tasks, the proposed method, as a unified framework, unleashes applications combining image-to-image translation, unconditional generation, and image extension altogether. For example, it provides style variability for image generation and extension, and equips image-to-image translation with further extension capabilities.

title: Yu-Ting Yen, Chia-Ni Lu, Wei-Chen Chiu, Yi-Hsuan Tsai
title_en: Yu-Ting Yen, Chia-Ni Lu, Wei-Chen Chiu, Yi-Hsuan Tsai
abstract: For monocular depth estimation, acquiring ground truths for real data is not easy, and thus domain adaptation methods are commonly adopted using the supervised synthetic data. However, this may still incur a large domain gap due to the lack of supervision from the real data. In this paper, we develop a domain adaptation framework via generating reliable pseudo ground truths of depth from real data to provide direct supervisions. Specifically, we propose two mechanisms for pseudo-labeling: 1) 2D-based pseudo labels via measuring the consistency of depth predictions when images are with the same content but different styles; 2) 3D-aware pseudo labels via a point cloud completion network that learns to complete the depth values in the 3D space, thus providing more structural information in a scene to refine and generate more reliable pseudo labels. In experiments, we show that our pseudo-labeling methods improve depth estimation in various settings, including the usage of stereo pairs during training. Furthermore, the proposed method performs favorably against several state-of-the-art unsupervised domain adaptation approaches in real-world datasets.
abstract_en: For monocular depth estimation, acquiring ground truths for real data is not easy, and thus domain adaptation methods are commonly adopted using the supervised synthetic data. However, this may still incur a large domain gap due to the lack of supervision from the real data. In this paper, we develop a domain adaptation framework via generating reliable pseudo ground truths of depth from real data to provide direct supervisions. Specifically, we propose two mechanisms for pseudo-labeling: 1) 2D-based pseudo labels via measuring the consistency of depth predictions when images are with the same content but different styles; 2) 3D-aware pseudo labels via a point cloud completion network that learns to complete the depth values in the 3D space, thus providing more structural information in a scene to refine and generate more reliable pseudo labels. In experiments, we show that our pseudo-labeling methods improve depth estimation in various settings, including the usage of stereo pairs during training. Furthermore, the proposed method performs favorably against several state-of-the-art unsupervised domain adaptation approaches in real-world datasets.

title: 基于未来光流预测的多行人轨迹预测框架S2F2
title_en: Yu-Wen Chen, Hsuan-Kung Yang, Chu-Chi Chiu, Chun-Yi Lee
abstract: 本文提出了一种单阶段框架S2F2,通过预测未来光流,从原始视频图像中预测多个人的轨迹。S2F2与之前的两阶段方法不同,它能够同时进行多人的检测、重识别和轨迹预测。S2F2的架构包含两个主要部分:(1) 上下文特征提取器,负责提取用于检测和重识别的共享潜在特征嵌入;(2) 预测模块,负责提取用于轨迹预测的共享潜在特征嵌入。两个部分的输出经过处理后生成行人最终预测轨迹。与以往方法不同,S2F2的计算负担在行人数量增加时保持稳定。为了公平比较S2F2与其他方法,我们设计了一个StaticMOT数据集,排除了涉及第一视角运动的视频序列。实验结果表明,S2F2在保持与当前MOT模型相当的跟踪性能的同时,能够超越两种传统轨迹预测算法和一种近期的两阶段学习模型。
abstract_en: In this work, we present a single-stage framework, named S2F2, for forecasting multiple human trajectories from raw video images by predicting future optical flows. S2F2 differs from the previous two-stage approaches in that it performs detection, Re-ID, and forecasting of multiple pedestrians at the same time. The architecture of S2F2 consists of two primary parts: (1) a context feature extractor responsible for extracting a shared latent feature embedding for performing detection and Re-ID, and (2) a forecasting module responsible for extracting a shared latent feature embedding for forecasting. The outputs of the two parts are then processed to generate the final predicted trajectories of pedestrians. Unlike previous approaches, the computational burden of S2F2 remains consistent even if the number of pedestrians grows. In order to fairly compare S2F2 against the other approaches, we designed a StaticMOT dataset that excludes video sequences involving egocentric motions. The experimental results demonstrate that S2F2 is able to outperform two conventional trajectory forecasting algorithms and a recent learning-based two-stage model, while maintaining tracking performance on par with the contemporary MOT models.

title: Yu-Yun Tseng, Alexander Bell, Danna Gurari
title_en: Yu-Yun Tseng, Alexander Bell, Danna Gurari
abstract: 我们引入了一个源自摄影师的小样本定位数据集,这些摄影师真实地试图学习他们所拍摄图像中的视觉内容。该数据集包含超过4,000张图像中100个类别的8,000多个分割结果,这些图像由有视觉障碍的人拍摄。与现有的小样本目标检测和实例分割数据集相比,我们的数据集是首个定位物体孔洞(例如,在12.4%的分割结果中发现)的数据集,展示了物体在图像中占据更广泛的尺寸范围,且文本在我们的物体中出现频率超过五倍(例如,在24.7%的分割结果中发现)。对两种现代小样本定位算法的分析表明,它们在我们的新数据集上泛化能力较差。这些算法通常难以定位具有孔洞的物体、非常小或非常大的物体,以及缺乏文本的物体。为了鼓励更大社区解决这些未解挑战,我们公开分享我们的标注小样本数据集,网址为http://anonymous。
abstract_en: We introduce a few-shot localization dataset originating from photographers who authentically were trying to learn about the visual content in the images they took. It includes over 8,000 segmentations of 100 categories in over 4,000 images that were taken by people with visual impairments. Compared to existing few-shot object detection and instance segmentation datasets, our dataset is the first to locate holes in objects (e.g., found in 12.4% of our segmentations), it shows objects that occupy a much larger range of sizes relative to the images, and text is over five times more common in our objects (e.g., found in 24.7% of our segmentations). Analysis of two modern few-shot localization algorithms demonstrates that they generalize poorly to our new dataset. The algorithms commonly struggle to locate objects with holes, very small and very large objects, and objects lacking text. To encourage a larger community to work on these unsolved challenges, we publicly share our annotated few-shot dataset at http://anonymous.

title: YuXuan Liu, Nikhil Mishra, Maximilian Sieb, Yide Shentu, Pieter Abbeel, Xi Chen
title_en: YuXuan Liu, Nikhil Mishra, Maximilian Sieb, Yide Shentu, Pieter Abbeel, Xi Chen
abstract: 3D bounding boxes are a widespread intermediate representation in many computer vision applications. However, predicting them is a challenging task, largely due to partial observability, which motivates the need for a strong sense of uncertainty. While many recent methods have explored better architectures for consuming sparse and unstructured point cloud data, we hypothesize that there is room for improvement in the modeling of the output distribution and explore how this can be achieved using an autoregressive prediction head. Additionally, we release a simulated dataset, COB-3D, which highlights new types of ambiguity that arise in real-world robotics applications, where 3D bounding box prediction has largely been underexplored. We propose methods for leveraging our autoregressive model to make high confidence predictions and meaningful uncertainty measures, achieving strong results on SUN-RGBD, Scannet, KITTI, and our new dataset. Code and dataset are available at https://bbox.yuxuanliu.com.
abstract_en: 3D bounding boxes are a widespread intermediate representation in many computer vision applications. However, predicting them is a challenging task, largely due to partial observability, which motivates the need for a strong sense of uncertainty. While many recent methods have explored better architectures for consuming sparse and unstructured point cloud data, we hypothesize that there is room for improvement in the modeling of the output distribution and explore how this can be achieved using an autoregressive prediction head. Additionally, we release a simulated dataset, COB-3D, which highlights new types of ambiguity that arise in real-world robotics applications, where 3D bounding box prediction has largely been underexplored. We propose methods for leveraging our autoregressive model to make high confidence predictions and meaningful uncertainty measures, achieving strong results on SUN-RGBD, Scannet, KITTI, and our new dataset. Code and dataset are available at https://bbox.yuxuanliu.com.

title: Yuan Liu, Yilin Wen, Sida Peng, Cheng Lin, Xiaoxiao Long, Taku Komura, Wenping Wang
title_en: Yuan Liu, Yilin Wen, Sida Peng, Cheng Lin, Xiaoxiao Long, Taku Komura, Wenping Wang
abstract: 本文提出了一种通用的无模型六自由度(6-DoF)物体姿态估计器Gen6D。现有可泛化姿态估计器要么需要高质量的物体模型,要么在测试时需要额外的深度图或物体掩码,这显著限制了其应用范围。相比之下,我们的姿态估计器仅需一些未见过物体的带姿态图像,即可在任意环境中准确预测物体姿态。Gen6D由一个物体检测器、一个视角选择器和一个姿态优化器组成,所有模块均无需3D物体模型,且能够泛化到未见过的物体。实验表明,Gen6D在两个无模型数据集(MOPED数据集和新提出的GenMOP数据集)上均取得了最先进的结果。此外,在LINEMOD数据集上,Gen6D与实例特定姿态估计器相比也取得了具有竞争力的结果。
abstract_en: In this paper, we present a generalizable model-free 6-DoF object pose estimator called Gen6D. Existing generalizable pose estimators either need the high-quality object models or require additional depth maps or object masks in test time, which significantly limits their application scope. In contrast, our pose estimator only requires some posed images of the unseen object and is able to accurately predict poses of the object in arbitrary environments. Gen6D consists of an object detector, a viewpoint selector and a pose refiner, all of which do not require the 3D object model and can generalize to unseen objects. Experiments show that Gen6D achieves state-of-the-art results on two model-free datasets: the MOPED dataset and a new GenMOP dataset. In addition, on the LINEMOD dataset, Gen6D achieves competitive results compared with instance-specific pose estimators.

title: Yuan Wang, Rui Sun, Zhe Zhang, Tianzhu Zhang
title_en: Yuan Wang, Rui Sun, Zhe Zhang, Tianzhu Zhang
abstract: 少样本分割(FSS)旨在仅使用少量标注的支撑图像对给定查询图像中的目标进行分割。有限的支撑信息使其成为一项极具挑战性的任务。大多数先前表现最好的方法采用原型学习或亲和力学习。然而,它们要么未能进一步利用支撑像素以促进分割并丢失空间信息,要么对噪声像素不鲁棒且计算成本高昂。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新颖的端到端自适应代理Transformer(AAFormer),通过Transformer编码器-解码器架构整合原型学习和亲和力学习,利用其互补性,包括表示编码器、代理学习解码器和代理匹配解码器。所提出的AAFormer具有以下优势。首先,为在无任何显式监督的情况下学习代理标记,并使代理标记能够以自适应方式将不同目标分割为多样化部分,我们根据上下文感知、空间感知和多样性三个特征定制了代理学习解码器。其次,所提出的代理匹配解码器负责将直接的像素级匹配矩阵分解为两个更易于计算的矩阵以抑制噪声像素。在两个标准基准上的大量实验结果表明,我们的AAFormer在最先进的FSS方法中表现优异。
abstract_en: Few-shot segmentation (FSS) aims to segment objects in a given query image with only a few labelled support images. The limited support information makes it an extremely challenging task. Most previous best-performing methods adopt prototypical learning or affinity learning. Nevertheless, they either neglect to further utilize support pixels for facilitating segmentation and lose spatial information, or are not robust to noisy pixels and computationally expensive. In this work, we propose a novel end-to-end adaptive agent transformer (AAFormer) to integrate prototypical and affinity learning to exploit the complementarity between them via a transformer encoder-decoder architecture, including a representation encoder, an agent learning decoder and an agent matching decoder. The proposed AAFormer enjoys several merits. First, to learn agent tokens well without any explicit supervision, and to make agent tokens capable of dividing different objects into diverse parts in an adaptive manner, we customize the agent learning decoder according to the three characteristics of context awareness, spatial awareness and diversity. Second, the proposed agent matching decoder is responsible for decomposing the direct pixel-level matching matrix into two more computationally-friendly matrices to suppress the noisy pixels. Extensive experimental results on two standard benchmarks demonstrate that our AAFormer performs favorably against state-of-the-art FSS methods.

title: Yuanbo Xiangli, Linning Xu, Xingang Pan, Nanxuan Zhao, Anyi Rao, Christian Theobalt, Bo Dai, Dahua Lin
title_en: Yuanbo Xiangli, Linning Xu, Xingang Pan, Nanxuan Zhao, Anyi Rao, Christian Theobalt, Bo Dai, Dahua Lin
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRF)在建模三维物体和受控场景方面取得了出色的表现,通常是在单一尺度下进行。在本工作中,我们关注多尺度情况,其中在截然不同的尺度上观察到图像的大幅变化。这种场景在现实世界中广泛存在,例如城市场景,其视角范围从捕捉城市概览的卫星级图像,到展示建筑复杂细节的地面级图像;也可以在景观和精细的Minecraft 3D模型中常见。这些场景中广泛的视角点产生了具有非常不同细节层次的多尺度渲染,这对神经辐射场带来了巨大挑战,并使其倾向于产生妥协的结果。为了解决这些问题,我们引入了BungeeNeRF,这是一种渐进式神经辐射场,能够在截然不同的尺度上实现细节层次渲染。从拟合远距离视角的浅层基础块开始,随着训练的进行,新的块被附加以适应日益接近视角中出现的细节。该策略逐步激活NeRF的位置编码输入中的高频通道,随着训练的推进展开更复杂的细节。我们在多个数据源(如城市模型、合成数据和无人机拍摄数据)上展示了BungeeNeRF在建模具有大幅变化视角的多样化多尺度场景中的优越性,并支持不同细节层次的高质量渲染。
abstract_en: Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) has achieved outstanding performance in modeling 3D objects and controlled scenes, usually under a single scale. In this work, we focus on multi-scale cases where large changes in imagery are observed at drastically different scales. This scenario vastly exists in the real world, such as city scenes, with views ranging from satellite level that captures the overview of a city, to ground level imagery showing complex details of an architecture; and can also be commonly identified in landscape and delicate minecraft 3D models. The wide span of viewing points within these scenes yields multiscale renderings with very different levels of detail, which poses great challenges to neural radiance field and biases it towards compromised results. To address these issues, we introduce BungeeNeRF, a progressive neural radiance field that achieves level-of-detail rendering across drastically varied scales. Starting from fitting distant views with a shallow base block, as training progresses, new blocks are appended to accommodate the emerging details in the increasingly closer views. The strategy progressively activates high-frequency channels in NeRF’s positional encoding inputs to unfold more complex details as the training proceeds. We demonstrate the superiority of BungeeNeRF in modeling diverse multi-scale scenes with drastically varying views on multiple data sources (e.g., city models, synthetic, and drone captured data), and its support for high-quality rendering in different levels of detail.

title: Yuanhan Zhang, Zhenfei Yin, Jing Shao, Ziwei Liu
title_en: Yuanhan Zhang, Zhenfei Yin, Jing Shao, Ziwei Liu
abstract: 尽管在特定视觉领域(如人脸、狗和地点)已取得令人印象深刻的性能,但能够泛化到多种自然视觉领域的全领域视觉表示仍具有高度需求。然而,现有用于评估视觉表示的基准(如ImageNet、VTAB-natural和CLIP基准套件)要么在领域范围上存在局限,要么是通过任意整合当前数据集构建的。在本文中,我们提出了全领域基准测试(OmniBenchmark),该基准测试能够系统地衡量在广泛视觉领域中的泛化能力。OmniBenchmark首先整合了Wikidata的概念,以扩展WordNet每个子树的概念存储量。然后,它利用WordNet中的专家知识,定义了包含21个语义领域的自然领域综合光谱,其规模是ImageNet的两倍。最后,我们手动标注了所有7,372个有效概念,形成了包含1,074,346张图像的21领域数据集。借助OmniBenchmark,我们提出了一种层次化实例对比学习框架,用于学习更优的全领域视觉表示,即关系对比学习(ReCo),从而提升了跨全领域表示学习的性能。由于层次化语义关系自然地出现在视觉数据集的标签系统中,ReCo在预训练过程中吸引同一语义领域内的表示,使得当ReCo进一步微调到特定领域时,模型收敛速度比传统对比学习更快。大量实验表明,ReCo在ImageNet和OmniBenchmark上均优于最先进的对比学习方法。此外,我们在基准上系统地研究了近期在架构(从CNN到Transformer)和学习范式(从监督学习到自监督学习)方面的进展。揭示了多项实用观察结果,以促进未来研究。
abstract_en: Though impressive performance has been achieved in specific visual realms (\eg faces, dogs, and places), an omni-vision representation that can generalize to many natural visual domains is highly desirable. Nonetheless, the existing benchmark for evaluating visual representations, such as ImageNet, VTAB-natural, and CLIP benchmark suite, is either limited in the spectrum of realms or built by arbitrarily integrating the current datasets. In this paper, we propose Omni-Realm Benchmark (OmniBenchmark) that enables systematically measuring the generalization ability across a wide range of visual realms. OmniBenchmark firstly integrates the concepts from Wikidata to enlarge the storage of concepts of each sub-tree of WordNet. Then, it leverages expert knowledge from WordNet to define a comprehensive spectrum of 21 semantic realms in the natural domain, which is twice of ImageNet’s. Finally, we manually annotate all 7,372 valid concepts, forming a 21-realm dataset with 1,074,346 images. With OmniBenchmark, we propose a hierarchical instance contrastive learning framework for learning better omni-vision representation, \ie Relational Contrastive learning (ReCo), boosting the performance of representation learning across omni-realms. As the hierarchical semantic relation naturally emerges in the label system of visual datasets, ReCo attracts the representations within the same semantic realm during pre-training, facilitating the model converges faster than conventional contrastive learning when ReCo is further fine-tuned to the specific realm. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of ReCo over state-of-the-art contrastive learning methods on both ImageNet and OmniBenchmark. Beyond that, We conduct a systematic investigation of recent advances in both architectures (from CNNs to transformers) and learning paradigms (from supervised learning to self-supervised learning) on our benchmark. Multiple practical observations are revealed to facilitate future research.

title: Yuanhao Cai, Jing Lin, Xiaowan Hu, Haoqian Wang, Xin Yuan, Yulun Zhang, Radu Timofte, Luc Van Gool
title_en: Yuanhao Cai, Jing Lin, Xiaowan Hu, Haoqian Wang, Xin Yuan, Yulun Zhang, Radu Timofte, Luc Van Gool
abstract: 已开发出许多基于学习的算法来解决编码孔径快照光谱成像(CASSI)的逆问题。然而,基于卷积神经网络(CNN)的方法在捕捉长距离依赖关系方面存在局限性。先前基于Transformer的方法密集采样标记,其中一些标记无用,并在内容无关的标记之间计算多头自注意力(MSA)。在本文中,我们提出了一种新颖的基于Transformer的方法——由粗到细稀疏Transformer(CST),首次将高光谱图像(HSI)的稀疏性嵌入深度学习以实现HSI重建。具体而言,CST使用我们提出的光谱感知筛选机制(SASM)进行粗粒度块选择。然后,所选块被输入我们定制的光谱聚合哈希多头自注意力(SAH-MSA)以实现精细像素聚类和自相似性捕捉。全面实验表明,我们的CST在计算成本更低的情况下显著优于最先进方法。https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/MST
abstract_en: Many learning-based algorithms have been developed to solve the inverse problem of coded aperture snapshot spectral imaging (CASSI). However, CNN-based methods show limitations in capturing long-range dependencies. Previous Transformer-based methods densely sample tokens, some of which are uninformative, and calculate multi-head self-attention (MSA) between some tokens that are unrelated in content. In this paper, we propose a novel Transformer-based method, coarse-to-fine sparse Transformer (CST), firstly embedding HSI sparsity into deep learning for HSI reconstruction. In particular, CST uses our proposed spectra-aware screening mechanism (SASM) for coarse patch selecting. Then the selected patches are fed into our customized spectra-aggregation hashing multi-head self-attention (SAH-MSA) for fine pixel clustering and self-similarity capturing. Comprehensive experiments show that our CST significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods while requiring cheaper computational costs. https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/MST

title: 熊元浩,谢俊乔
title_en: Yuanhao Xiong, Cho-Jui Hsieh
abstract: 近年来,深度学习在解决分类和决策等各类问题上取得了显著进展。快速的发展催生了一种新型框架——学习-学习(L2L),其中通过神经网络建模的自动优化算法(优化器)旨在学习更新目标目标函数(优化对象)的规则。尽管该方法在特定问题上具有优势,但由于其不稳定性,仍无法替代经典方法。与手工设计的算法不同,神经优化器可能面临稳定性问题——在不同但相似的状态下,相同的神经优化器可能产生截然不同的更新。受理想优化器应具备稳定性这一性质的启发,我们提出了一种正则化项,可强制学习到的优化器保持平滑性和稳定性。在神经网络训练任务上的全面实验表明,所提出的正则化项即使在迁移到不同架构和数据集的任务时,也能持续提升学习到的神经优化器性能。此外,我们展示了所提出的平滑性诱导正则化器在少样本学习任务中可提升神经优化器的性能。代码可在https://github.com/xyh97/SmoothedOptimizer获取。
abstract_en: Recent decades have witnessed great advances of deep learning in tackling various problems such as classification and decision making. The rapid development gave rise to a novel framework, Learning-to-Learn (L2L), in which an automatic optimization algorithm (optimizer) modeled by neural networks is expected to learn rules for updating the target objective function (optimizee). Despite its advantages for specific problems, L2L still cannot replace classic methods due to its instability. Unlike hand-engineered algorithms, neural optimizers may suffer from the instability issue---under distinct but similar states, the same neural optimizer can produce quite different updates. Motivated by the stability property that should be satisfied by an ideal optimizer, we propose a regularization term that can enforce the smoothness and stability of the learned optimizers. Comprehensive experiments on the neural network training tasks demonstrate that the proposed regularization consistently improve the learned neural optimizers even when transferring to tasks with different architectures and datasets. Furthermore, we show that our smoothness-inducing regularizer can improve the performance of neural optimizers on few-shot learning tasks. Code can be found at https://github.com/xyh97/SmoothedOptimizer.

title_en: Yuansheng Zhu, Wentao Bao, Qi Yu
abstract_en: Open Set Video Anomaly Detection (OpenVAD) aims to identify abnormal events from video data where both known anomalies and novel ones exist in testing. Unsupervised models learned solely from normal videos are applicable to any testing anomalies but suffer from a high false positive rate. In contrast, weakly supervised methods are effective in detecting known anomalies but could fail in an open world. We develop a novel weakly supervised method for the OpenVAD problem by integrating evidential deep learning (EDL) and normalizing flows (NFs) into a multiple instance learning (MIL) framework. Specifically, we propose to use graph neural networks and triplet loss to learn discriminative features for training the EDL classifier, where the EDL is capable of identifying the unknown anomalies by quantifying the uncertainty. Moreover, we develop an uncertainty-aware selection strategy to obtain clean anomaly instances and a NFs module to generate the pseudo anomalies. Our method is superior to existing approaches by inheriting the advantages of both the unsupervised NFs and the weakly-supervised MIL framework. Experimental results on multiple real-world video datasets show the effectiveness of our method.

title: Yuanzheng Ci, Chen Lin, Lei Bai, Wanli Ouyang
title_en: Yuanzheng Ci, Chen Lin, Lei Bai, Wanli Ouyang
abstract: 近年来,基于对比的自监督学习方法取得了显著成功。然而,自监督学习需要极长的训练轮次(例如MoCo v3需要800轮)才能获得理想结果,这对普通学术界不可接受,也阻碍了该领域的进一步发展。本文重新审视了基于动量的对比学习框架,发现两个增强视图仅生成一个正样本对的效率低下。我们提出Fast-MoCo——一种新颖框架,通过组合补丁从两个增强视图中构建多个正样本对,从而提供丰富的监督信号,在几乎不增加额外计算成本的情况下显著加速训练。Fast-MoCo仅训练100轮即可达到73.5%的线性评估准确率,与MoCo v3(ResNet-50主干网络)训练800轮的结果相当。额外训练200轮后,结果进一步提升至75.1%,与当前最先进方法相当。在多个下游任务上的实验也验证了Fast-MoCo的有效性。
abstract_en: Contrastive-based self-supervised learning methods achieved great success in recent years. However, self-supervision requires extremely long training epochs (e.g., 800 epochs for MoCo v3) to achieve promising results, which is unacceptable for the general academic community and hinders the development of this topic. This work revisits the momentum-based contrastive learning frameworks and identifies the inefficiency in which two augmented views generate only one positive pair. We propose Fast-MoCo - a novel framework that utilizes combinatorial patches to construct multiple positive pairs from two augmented views, which provides abundant supervision signals that bring significant acceleration with neglectable extra computational cost. Fast-MoCo trained with 100 epochs achieves 73.5% linear evaluation accuracy, similar to MoCo v3 (ResNet-50 backbone) trained with 800 epochs. Extra training (200 epochs) further improves the result to 75.1%, which is on par with state-of-the-art methods. Experiments on several downstream tasks also confirm the effectiveness of Fast-MoCo.

title: Yuchao Gu, Xintao Wang, Liangbin Xie, Chao Dong, Gen Li, Ying Shan, Ming-Ming Cheng
title_en: Yuchao Gu, Xintao Wang, Liangbin Xie, Chao Dong, Gen Li, Ying Shan, Ming-Ming Cheng
abstract: 尽管生成式面部先验和几何先验近期在盲人脸修复任务中展现了高质量的修复效果,但生成与输入一致的精细面部细节仍是一个具有挑战性的问题。受经典字典方法和近期向量量化(VQ)技术的启发,我们提出了一种基于VQ的人脸修复方法——VQFR。VQFR利用高质量人脸提取的高质量低级特征库,从而有助于恢复逼真的面部细节。然而,简单应用VQ码本无法实现具有忠实细节和身份保持的良好效果。因此,我们进一步引入了两种特殊网络设计。1)我们首先研究VQ码本中的压缩块大小,发现采用适当压缩块大小设计的VQ码本对于平衡质量和保真度至关重要。2)为了进一步融合输入中的低级特征,同时不“污染”由VQ码本生成的逼真细节,我们提出了一种由纹理解码器和主解码器组成的并行解码器。这两个解码器随后通过可变形卷积的纹理变形模块进行交互。配备VQ码本作为面部细节字典和并行解码器设计,所提出的VQFR在保持与先前方法一致保真度的同时,大幅提升了面部细节的修复质量。
abstract_en: Although generative facial prior and geometric prior have recently demonstrated high-quality results for blind face restoration, producing fine-grained facial details faithful to inputs remains a challenging problem. Motivated by the classical dictionary-based methods and the recent vector quantization (VQ) technique, we propose a VQ-based face restoration method - VQFR. VQFR takes advantage of high-quality low-level feature banks extracted from high-quality faces and can thus help recover realistic facial details. However, the simple application of the VQ codebook cannot achieve good results with faithful details and identity preservation. Therefore, we further introduce two special network designs. 1). We first investigate the compression patch size in the VQ codebook and find that the VQ codebook designed with a proper compression patch size is crucial to balance the quality and fidelity. 2). To further fuse low-level features from inputs while not “contaminating” the realistic details generated from the VQ codebook, we proposed a parallel decoder consisting of a texture decoder and a main decoder. Those two decoders then interact with a texture warping module with deformable convolution. Equipped with the VQ codebook as a facial detail dictionary and the parallel decoder design, the proposed VQFR can largely enhance the restored quality of facial details while keeping the fidelity to previous methods.

title: Yuchen Li, Ujjwal Upadhyay, Habib Slim, Tezuesh Varshney, Ahmed Abdelreheem, Arpit Prajapati, Suhail Pothigara, Peter Wonka, Mohamed Elhoseiny
title_en: Yuchen Li, Ujjwal Upadhyay, Habib Slim, Tezuesh Varshney, Ahmed Abdelreheem, Arpit Prajapati, Suhail Pothigara, Peter Wonka, Mohamed Elhoseiny
abstract: 我们提出了3D CoMPaT,这是一个包含超过719万张渲染材料组合的大型标注数据集,涵盖7262个独特3D模型的7262个独特3D模型,平均每个模型有990个组合。3D CoMPaT覆盖43个形状类别、235个独特部件名称和167个独特材料类别,这些材料可应用于3D对象的部件。每个应用了部件-材料组合的对象均从四个等距视角以及四个随机视角进行渲染,总计生成5800万张渲染图像(719万张组合 × 8视角)。该数据集主要关注在部件级别对3D形状进行风格化处理,并使用兼容材料。我们引入了一个新任务,称为Grounded CoMPaT识别(GCR),用于集体识别和定位3D对象部件上的材料组合。我们提出了该任务的两种变体,并采用最先进的2D/3D深度学习方法作为基线,为未来研究提供参考。我们希望这项工作能简化未来关于组合3D视觉的研究。数据集和代码可在https://www.3dcompat-dataset.org/ 公开获取。
abstract_en: We present 3D CoMPaT, a richly annotated large-scale dataset of more than 7.19 million rendered compositions of Materials on Parts of 7262 unique 3D Models; 990 compositions per model on average. 3D CoMPaT covers 43 shape categories, 235 unique part names, and 167 unique material classes that can be applied to parts of 3D objects. Each object with the applied part-material compositions is rendered from four equally spaced views as well as four randomized views, leading to a total of 58 million renderings (7.19 million compositions ×8 views). This dataset primarily focuses on stylizing 3D shapes at part-level with compatible materials. We introduce a new task, called Grounded CoMPaT Recognition (GCR), to collectively recognize and ground compositions of materials on parts of 3D objects. We present two variations of this task and adapt state-of-art 2D/3D deep learning methods to solve the problem as baselines for future research. We hope our work will help ease future research on compositional 3D Vision. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://www.3dcompat-dataset.org/

title: Yuchen Liu, Yabo Chen, Wenrui Dai, Mengran Gou, Chun-Ting Huang, Hongkai Xiong
title_en: Yuchen Liu, Yabo Chen, Wenrui Dai, Mengran Gou, Chun-Ting Huang, Hongkai Xiong
abstract: Despite promising success in intra-dataset tests, existing face anti-spoofing (FAS) methods suffer from poor generalization ability under domain shift. This problem can be solved by aligning source and target data. However, due to privacy and security concerns of human faces, source data are usually inaccessible during adaptation for practical deployment, where only a pre-trained source model and unlabeled target data are available. In this paper, we propose a novel Source-free Domain Adaptation framework for Face Anti-Spoofing, namely SDA-FAS, that addresses the problems of source knowledge adaptation and target data exploration under the source-free setting. For source knowledge adaptation, we present novel strategies to realize self-training and domain alignment. We develop a contrastive domain alignment module to align conditional distribution across different domains by aggregating the features of fake and real faces separately. We demonstrate in theory that the pre-trained source model is equivalent to the source data as source prototypes for supervised contrastive learning in domain alignment. The source-oriented regularization is also introduced into self-training to alleviate the self-biasing problem. For target data exploration, self-supervised learning is employed with specified patch shuffle data augmentation to explore intrinsic spoofing features for unseen attack types. To our best knowledge, SDA-FAS is the first attempt that jointly optimizes the source-adapted knowledge and target self-supervised exploration for FAS. Extensive experiments on thirteen cross-dataset testing scenarios show that the proposed framework outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by a large margin.
abstract_en: Despite promising success in intra-dataset tests, existing face anti-spoofing (FAS) methods suffer from poor generalization ability under domain shift. This problem can be solved by aligning source and target data. However, due to privacy and security concerns of human faces, source data are usually inaccessible during adaptation for practical deployment, where only a pre-trained source model and unlabeled target data are available. In this paper, we propose a novel Source-free Domain Adaptation framework for Face Anti-Spoofing, namely SDA-FAS, that addresses the problems of source knowledge adaptation and target data exploration under the source-free setting. For source knowledge adaptation, we present novel strategies to realize self-training and domain alignment. We develop a contrastive domain alignment module to align conditional distribution across different domains by aggregating the features of fake and real faces separately. We demonstrate in theory that the pre-trained source model is equivalent to the source data as source prototypes for supervised contrastive learning in domain alignment. The source-oriented regularization is also introduced into self-training to alleviate the self-biasing problem. For target data exploration, self-supervised learning is employed with specified patch shuffle data augmentation to explore intrinsic spoofing features for unseen attack types. To our best knowledge, SDA-FAS is the first attempt that jointly optimizes the source-adapted knowledge and target self-supervised exploration for FAS. Extensive experiments on thirteen cross-dataset testing scenarios show that the proposed framework outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by a large margin.

title: Yuchen Liu, Zhixin Shu, Yijun Li, Zhe Lin, Richard Zhang, S.Y. Kung
title_en: Yuchen Liu, Zhixin Shu, Yijun Li, Zhe Lin, Richard Zhang, S.Y. Kung
abstract: 得益于生成对抗网络(GANs)的突破,三维可控的人像合成技术取得了显著进展。然而,仍难以对现有人脸图像进行精确的三维控制。虽然将GAN反演与一种三维感知、噪声到图像的GAN进行拼接是一种直接的解决方案,但这种方法效率低下,可能导致编辑质量明显下降。为填补这一空白,我们提出了3D-FM GAN,这是一种专为三维可控人脸编辑设计的新颖条件GAN框架,在端到端学习阶段后无需任何调参。通过将输入人脸图像和基于物理的三维编辑渲染编码到StyleGAN的潜在空间中,我们的图像生成器能够提供高质量、身份保持的三维可控人脸编辑。为有效学习这一新型框架,我们开发了两种关键的训练策略和一种新颖的乘法共调制架构,显著超越了朴素方案。通过广泛的评估,我们证明了我们的方法在各种任务中优于现有技术,具有更好的编辑性、更强的身份保持能力和更高的照片真实感。此外,我们还展示了该设计在大姿态编辑和领域外图像上的更好泛化能力。
abstract_en: 3D-controllable portrait synthesis has significantly advanced, thanks to breakthroughs in generative adversarial networks (GANs). However, it is still challenging to manipulate existing face images with precise 3D control. While concatenating GAN inversion and a 3D-aware, noise-to-image GAN is a straight-forward solution, it is inefficient and may lead to noticeable drop in editing quality. To fill this gap, we propose 3D-FM GAN, a novel conditional GAN framework designed specifically for 3D-controllable Face Manipulation, and does not require any tuning after the end-to-end learning phase. By carefully encoding both the input face image and a physically-based rendering of 3D edits into a StyleGAN’s latent spaces, our image generator provides high-quality, identity-preserved, 3D-controllable face manipulation. To effectively learn such novel framework, we develop two essential training strategies and a novel multiplicative co-modulation architecture that improves significantly upon naive schemes. With extensive evaluations, we show that our method outperforms the prior arts on various tasks, with better editability, stronger identity preservation, and higher photo-realism. In addition, we demonstrate a better generalizability of our design on large pose editing and out-of-domain images.

title: Yuchen Luo, Junwei Zhu, Keke He, Wenqing Chu, Ying Tai, Chengjie Wang, Junchi Yan
title_en: Yuchen Luo, Junwei Zhu, Keke He, Wenqing Chu, Ying Tai, Chengjie Wang, Junchi Yan
abstract: 身份交换和去标识化是身份解耦人脸图像生成的两个关键应用。尽管这两个任务具有相似的问题定义,但长期以来被分别研究,而高分辨率(megapixels)下的身份解耦人脸生成仍处于探索阶段。在本文中,我们提出了StyleFace,一个统一的框架,用于1024^2分辨率的高保真身份交换和去标识化。为了编码真实身份并支持虚拟身份生成,我们将身份表示为潜在变量,并进一步利用对比学习进行潜在空间正则化。此外,我们采用StyleGAN2来提升在高分辨率下的生成质量,并设计了一个自适应属性提取器,以简单而有效的方式自适应地保留与身份无关的属性。大量实验表明,StyleFace在高分辨率身份交换和去标识化任务中分别达到了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Identity swapping and de-identification are two essential applications of identity-disentangled face image generation. Although sharing a similar problem definition, the two tasks have been long studied separately, and identity-disentangled face generation on megapixels is still under exploration. In this work, we propose StyleFace, a unified framework for 1024^2 resolution high-fidelity identity swapping and de-identification. To encode real identity while supporting virtual identity generation, we represent identity as a latent variable and further utilize contrastive learning for latent space regularization. Besides, we utilize StyleGAN2 to improve the generation quality on megapixels and devise an Adaptive Attribute Extractor, which adaptively preserves the identity-irrelevant attributes in a simple yet effective way. Extensive experiments demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of StyleFace in high-resolution identity swapping and de-identification, respectively.

title: Yuchi Liu, Zhongdao Wang, Tom Gedeon, Liang Zheng
title_en: Yuchi Liu, Zhongdao Wang, Tom Gedeon, Liang Zheng
abstract: 本文不包含技术新颖性,但介绍了我们在数据生成协议、数据库和见解方面的关键发现。我们旨在解决由于数据收集成本过高导致的微表情(MiE)识别领域缺乏大规模数据集的问题,这使得大规模训练变得不切实际。为此,我们开发了一种协议,可自动合成大规模的MiE训练数据,从而训练出适用于真实测试数据的改进识别模型。具体而言,我们发现了三种可构成可训练MiE的动作单元(AUs)。这些AUs来源于真实MiE、宏表情视频的早期帧以及人类专家知识定义的AUs与表情类别的关系。利用这些AUs,我们的协议通过大量不同身份的面部图像和现成的面部生成器进行MiE合成,生成MiE-X数据集。MiE识别模型在MiE-X上进行训练或预训练,并在真实测试集上评估,取得了非常有竞争力的准确率。实验结果不仅验证了发现的AUs和MiE-X数据集的有效性,还揭示了MiE的一些有趣特性:它们在不同面孔上具有可推广性,接近宏表情的早期阶段,且可以手动定义。
