abstract_en: This paper does not contain technical novelty but introduces our key discoveries in a data generation protocol, a database and insights. We aim to address the lack of large-scale datasets in micro-expression (MiE) recognition due to the prohibitive cost of data collection, which renders large-scale training less feasible. To this end, we develop a protocol to automatically synthesize large scale MiE training data that allow us to train improved recognition models for real-world test data. Specifically, we discover three types of Action Units (AUs) that can constitute trainable MiEs. These AUs come from real-world MiEs, early frames of macro-expression videos, and the relationship between AUs and expression categories defined by human expert knowledge. With these AUs, our protocol then employs large numbers of face images of various identities and an off-the-shelf face generator for MiE synthesis, yielding the MiE-X dataset. MiE recognition models are trained or pre-trained on MiE-X and evaluated on real-world test sets, where very competitive accuracy is obtained. Experimental results not only validate the effectiveness of the discovered AUs and MiE-X dataset but also reveal some interesting properties of MiEs: they generalize across faces, are close to early-stage macro-expressions, and can be manually defined.

title: Yuda Song, Hui Qian, Xin Du
title_en: Yuda Song, Hui Qian, Xin Du
abstract: 目前主流的图像到图像翻译方法基于全卷积网络,该网络提取并转换图像的特征,然后重建图像。然而,当处理高分辨率图像时,这些方法的计算成本不可接受。为此,我们提出了多曲线翻译器(MCT),该方法不仅预测对应输入像素的翻译像素,还预测其邻近像素的翻译结果。如果将高分辨率图像下采样到低分辨率版本,丢失的像素是剩余像素的邻近像素。因此,MCT使得只需输入下采样图像即可对全分辨率图像进行映射,从而显著降低计算成本。此外,MCT是一种插件式方法,利用现有的基线模型,只需替换其输出层。实验表明,MCT的变体可以实时处理4K图像,并在各种逼真图像到图像翻译任务中达到与基线模型相当甚至更好的性能。
abstract_en: The dominant image-to-image translation methods are based on fully convolutional networks, which extract and translate an image’s features and then reconstruct the image. However, they have unacceptable computational costs when working with high-resolution images. To this end, we present the Multi-Curve Translator (MCT), which not only predicts the translated pixels for the corresponding input pixels but also for their neighboring pixels. And if a high-resolution image is downsampled to its low-resolution version, the lost pixels are the remaining pixels’ neighboring pixels. So MCT makes it possible to feed the network only the downsampled image to perform the mapping for the full-resolution image, which can dramatically lower the computational cost. Besides, MCT is a plug-in approach that utilizes existing base models and requires only replacing their output layers. Experiments demonstrate that the MCT variants can process 4K images in real-time and achieve comparable or even better performance than the base models on various photorealistic image-to-image translation tasks.

title: 袁断,齐磊,王磊,周路平,石英焕
title_en: Yue Duan, Lei Qi, Lei Wang, Luping Zhou, Yinghuan Shi
abstract: 本文提出互分布对齐(RDA)方法以解决半监督学习(SSL)问题,这是一种无需超参数的框架,独立于置信度阈值,适用于匹配(传统)和不匹配的类别分布场景。分布不匹配是常被忽视但更普遍的SSL场景,其中标记数据与未标记数据不落入相同的类别分布。这可能导致模型无法可靠利用标记数据,显著降低SSL方法的性能,而传统分布对齐方法无法解决此问题。在RDA中,我们对两个分类器预测的伪标签和互补标签的未标记数据分布进行互分布对齐。这两个携带互补信息的分布可以在无需类别分布先验的情况下相互正则化。此外,我们理论证明RDA最大化输入-输出互信息。我们的方法在多种分布不匹配场景及传统匹配SSL设置下均取得了有前景的性能。代码可在:https://github.com/NJUyued/RDA4RobustSSL 获取。
abstract_en: In this work, we propose Reciprocal Distribution Alignment (RDA) to address semi-supervised learning (SSL), which is a hyperparameter-free framework that is independent of confidence threshold and works with both the matched (conventionally) and the mismatched class distributions. Distribution mismatch is an often overlooked but more general SSL scenario where the labeled and the unlabeled data do not fall into the identical class distribution. This may lead to the model not exploiting the labeled data reliably and drastically degrade the performance of SSL methods, which could not be rescued by the traditional distribution alignment. In RDA, we enforce a reciprocal alignment on the distributions of the predictions from two classifiers predicting pseudo-labels and complementary labels on the unlabeled data. These two distributions, carrying complementary information, could be utilized to regularize each other without any prior of class distribution. Moreover, we theoretically show that RDA maximizes the input-output mutual information. Our approach achieves promising performance in SSL under a variety of scenarios of mismatched distributions, as well as the conventional matched SSL setting. The code is available at: https://github.com/NJUyued/RDA4RobustSSL.

title: 岳松,Nicu Sebe,王伟
title_en: Yue Song, Nicu Sebe, Wei Wang
abstract: 在神经网络中插入SVD元层容易导致协方差病态条件,这可能损害模型的训练稳定性与泛化能力。本文系统研究了如何通过强制预SVD层正交性来改善协方差条件。首先调查了现有对权重的正交处理技术。然而,这些技术虽能改善条件数,但会损害模型性能。为避免这种副作用,我们提出最近正交梯度(NOG)和最优学习率(OLR)。我们的方法在两个应用中得到验证:去相关批量归一化(BN)和全局协方差池化(GCP)。在视觉识别任务上的大量实验表明,我们的方法能同时提升协方差条件数和泛化能力。此外,与正交权重的结合进一步提升了性能。
abstract_en: Inserting an SVD meta-layer into neural networks is prone to make the covariance ill-conditioned, which could harm the model in the training stability and generalization abilities. In this paper, we systematically study how to improve the covariance conditioning by enforcing orthogonality to the Pre-SVD layer. Existing orthogonal treatments on the weights are first investigated. However, these techniques can improve the conditioning but would hurt the performance. To avoid such a side effect, we propose the Nearest Orthogonal Gradient (NOG) and Optimal Learning Rate (OLR). The effectiveness of our methods is validated in two applications: decorrelated Batch Normalization (BN) and Global Covariance Pooling (GCP). Extensive experiments on visual recognition demonstrate that our methods can simultaneously improve the covariance conditioning and generalization. Moreover, the combinations with orthogonal weight can further boost the performances.

title: Yue Song, Nicu Sebe, Wei Wang
title_en: Yue Song, Nicu Sebe, Wei Wang
abstract: EigenDecomposition (ED) is at the heart of many computer vision algorithms and applications. One crucial bottleneck limiting its usage is the expensive computation cost, particularly for a mini-batch of matrices in the deep neural networks. In this paper, we propose a QR-based ED method dedicated to the application scenarios of computer vision. Our proposed method performs the ED entirely by batched matrix/vector multiplication, which processes all the matrices simultaneously and thus fully utilizes the power of GPUs. Our technique is based on the explicit QR iterations by Givens rotation with double Wilkinson shifts. With several acceleration techniques, the time complexity of QR iterations is reduced from $O{(}n^5{)}$ to $O{(}n^3{)}$. The numerical test shows that for small and medium batched matrices (\emph{e.g.,} $dim{<}32$) our method can be much faster than the Pytorch SVD function. Experimental results on visual recognition and image generation demonstrate that our methods also achieve competitive performances.
abstract_en: EigenDecomposition (ED) is at the heart of many computer vision algorithms and applications. One crucial bottleneck limiting its usage is the expensive computation cost, particularly for a mini-batch of matrices in the deep neural networks. In this paper, we propose a QR-based ED method dedicated to the application scenarios of computer vision. Our proposed method performs the ED entirely by batched matrix/vector multiplication, which processes all the matrices simultaneously and thus fully utilizes the power of GPUs. Our technique is based on the explicit QR iterations by Givens rotation with double Wilkinson shifts. With several acceleration techniques, the time complexity of QR iterations is reduced from $O{(}n^5{)}$ to $O{(}n^3{)}$. The numerical test shows that for small and medium batched matrices (\emph{e.g.,} $dim{<}32$) our method can be much faster than the Pytorch SVD function. Experimental results on visual recognition and image generation demonstrate that our methods also achieve competitive performances.

title: 徐岳,李永路,李杰峰,卢策吾
title_en: Yue Xu, Yong-Lu Li, Jiefeng Li, Cewu Lu
abstract: 长尾图像识别对深度学习系统提出了巨大挑战,因为多数类(头类)与少数类(尾类)之间的不平衡严重扭曲了数据驱动的深度神经网络。先前的方法从数据分布、特征空间和模型设计等角度解决数据不平衡问题。在本工作中,我们建议在分类器学习之前,从之前被忽略的平衡标签空间视角出发,直面头尾偏差的瓶颈。为缓解头尾偏差,我们提出了一种简洁的范式,通过逐步调整标签空间并划分头类与尾类,动态地从不平衡中构建平衡,以促进分类。借助灵活的数据过滤和标签空间映射,我们可以轻松地将我们的方法嵌入到大多数分类模型中,尤其是解耦训练方法。此外,我们发现头尾类的可分性在不同特征和不同归纳偏差下存在差异。因此,我们提出的模型还提供了一种特征评估方法,并为长尾特征学习铺平了道路。大量实验表明,我们的方法在广泛使用的基准上提升了各类先进方法的性能。代码可在https://github.com/silicx/DLSA获取。
abstract_en: Long-tailed image recognition presents massive challenges to deep learning systems since the imbalance between majority (head) classes and minority (tail) classes severely skews the data-driven deep neural networks. Previous methods tackle with data imbalance from the viewpoints of data distribution, feature space, and model design, etc.In this work, instead of directly learning a recognition model, we suggest confronting the bottleneck of head-to-tail bias before classifier learning, from the previously omitted perspective of balancing label space. To alleviate the head-to-tail bias, we propose a concise paradigm by progressively adjusting label space and dividing the head classes and tail classes, dynamically constructing balance from imbalance to facilitate the classification. With flexible data filtering and label space mapping, we can easily embed our approach to most classification models, especially the decoupled training methods. Besides, we find the separability of head-tail classes varies among different features with different inductive biases. Hence, our proposed model also provides a feature evaluation method and paves the way for long-tailed feature learning. Extensive experiments show that our method can boost the performance of state-of-the-arts of different types on widely-used benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/silicx/DLSA.

title: Yue Zhao, Junzhou Chen, Zirui Zhang, Ronghui Zhang
title_en: Yue Zhao, Junzhou Chen, Zirui Zhang, Ronghui Zhang
abstract: 在注意力机制研究中,现有方法由于注意力层中特征压缩较重,难以高效利用神经网络的信息。本文提出了一种简单且通用的方法,名为Bridge Attention(桥接注意力),以解决这一问题。作为一种新思路,BA-Net直接整合前一层的特征,并有效促进信息交互。模型实现仅采用简单的策略,类似于SENet。此外,在广泛研究不同先前特征的有效性后,我们发现了一个简单而令人兴奋的见解:在每个块内通过BN桥接所有卷积输出,可以获得更好的注意力,从而增强神经网络的性能。BA-Net具有有效性、稳定性且易于使用。对计算机视觉任务的全面评估表明,所提出的方法在准确性和计算效率方面均优于现有的通道注意力方法。
abstract_en: In attention mechanism research, most existing methods are hard to utilize well the information of the neural network with high computing efficiency due to heavy feature compression in the attention layer. This paper proposes a simple and general approach named Bridge Attention to address this issue. As a new idea, BA-Net straightforwardly integrates features from previous layers and effectively promotes information interchange. Only simple strategies are employed for the model implementation, similar to the SENet. Moreover, after extensively investigating the effectiveness of different previous features, we discovered a simple and exciting insight that bridging all the convolution outputs inside each block with BN can obtain better attention to enhance the performance of neural networks. BA-Net is effective, stable, and easy to use. A comprehensive evaluation of computer vision tasks demonstrates that the proposed approach achieves better performance than the existing channel attention methods regarding accuracy and computing efficiency.

title: Yue Zhao, Philipp Krähenbühl
title_en: Yue Zhao, Philipp Krähenbühl
abstract: 视频流识别需要在视频的每一帧中对物体及其动作进行推理。一个优秀的视频流识别模型能够同时捕捉视频的长期动态变化和短期变化。不幸的是,在大多数现有方法中,计算复杂度会随着所考虑动态长度的增加而线性或二次增长。这一问题在基于Transformer的架构中尤为突出。为了解决这一问题,我们通过核方法的视角重新表述视频Transformer中的交叉注意力机制,并应用两种类型的时间平滑核:矩形核或拉普拉斯核。由此得到的流式注意力机制在帧与帧之间复用大量计算,仅需每帧常数时间更新。基于这一思想,我们构建了TeSTra,一种时间平滑Transformer,能够以恒定的缓存和计算开销处理任意长度的输入。具体而言,在流式场景下,其运行速度是等效滑动窗口Transformer的6倍(以2048帧为基准)。此外,得益于更长的时间跨度,TeSTra在THUMOS’14和EPIC-Kitchen-100两个标准在线动作检测与动作预测数据集上取得了最先进的结果。TeSTra的实时版本在THUMOS’14数据集上超越了除一种方法外的所有先前方法。
abstract_en: Streaming video recognition reasons about objects and their actions in every frame of a video. A good streaming recognition model captures both long-term dynamics and short-term changes of video. Unfortunately, in most existing methods, the computational complexity grows linearly or quadratically with the length of the considered dynamics. This issue is particularly pronounced in transformer-based architectures. To address this issue, we reformulate the cross-attention in a video transformer through the lens of kernel and apply two kinds of temporal smoothing kernel: A box kernel or a Laplace kernel. The resulting streaming attention reuses much of the computation from frame to frame, and only requires a constant time update each frame. Based on this idea, we build TeSTra, a Temporal Smoothing Transformer, that takes in arbitrarily long inputs with constant caching and computing overhead. Specifically, it runs 6x faster than equivalent sliding-window based transformers with 2,048 frames in a streaming setting. Furthermore, thanks to the increased temporal span, TeSTra achieves state-of-the-art results on THUMOS’14 and EPIC-Kitchen-100, two standard online action detection and action anticipation datasets. A real-time version of TeSTra outperforms all but one prior approaches on the THUMOS’14 dataset.

title: Yuecong Min, Peiqi Jiao, Yanan Li, Xiaotao Wang, Lei Lei, Xiujuan Chai, Xilin Chen
title_en: Yuecong Min, Peiqi Jiao, Yanan Li, Xiaotao Wang, Lei Lei, Xiujuan Chai, Xilin Chen
abstract: 连接主义时序分类(CTC)是序列识别中常用的损失函数,它通过迭代对齐序列及其对应的标签为未分段的序列数据提供监督。CTC中的空白类在对齐过程中起着关键作用,通常被认为导致CTC的尖峰行为。在本研究中,我们提出了一种名为RadialCTC的目标函数,该函数在超球面上约束序列特征,同时保留CTC的迭代对齐机制。每个非空白类学习到的特征分布在空白类中心的径向弧线上,这提供了清晰的几何解释,并使对齐过程更加高效。此外,RadialCTC可以通过简单修改空白类的logit来控制尖峰行为。识别和定位的实验结果验证了RadialCTC在两个序列识别应用中的有效性。
abstract_en: Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) is a popular objective function in sequence recognition, which provides supervision for unsegmented sequence data through aligning sequence and its corresponding labeling iteratively. The blank class of CTC plays a crucial role in the alignment process and is often considered responsible for the peaky behavior of CTC. In this study, we propose an objective function named RadialCTC that constrains sequence features on a hypersphere while retaining the iterative alignment mechanism of CTC. The learned features of each non-blank class are distributed on a radial arc from the center of the blank class, which provides a clear geometric interpretation and makes the alignment process more efficient. Besides, RadialCTC can control the peaky behavior by simply modifying the logit of the blank class. Experimental results of recognition and localization demonstrate the effectiveness of RadialCTC on two sequence recognition applications.

title: Yuecong Xu, Jianfei Yang, Haozhi Cao, Keyu Wu, Min Wu, Zhenghua Chen
title_en: Yuecong Xu, Jianfei Yang, Haozhi Cao, Keyu Wu, Min Wu, Zhenghua Chen
abstract: 基于视频的无监督域适应(VUDA)方法通过提升视频模型的鲁棒性,使其能够应用于不同环境下的动作识别任务。然而,这些方法在适应过程中需要持续访问源数据。但在许多实际应用场景中,源视频域中的主体和场景应与目标视频域中的无关。随着对数据隐私的日益重视,需要访问源数据的方法会引发严重的隐私问题。因此,为应对这一问题,提出了一种更实际的域适应场景,即无源视频域适应(SFVDA)。尽管已有少量针对图像数据的无源域适应(SFDA)方法,但由于视频的多模态特性以及额外的时间特征存在,这些方法在SFVDA中表现显著退化。本文提出了一种新颖的注意力时间一致性网络(ATCoN),通过学习时间一致性来解决SFVDA问题,该一致性由两个新的一致性目标保证:特征一致性和源预测一致性,这些目标在局部时间特征上进行计算。ATCoN进一步通过基于预测置信度关注局部时间特征,构建有效的整体时间特征。实验结果表明,ATCoN在多个跨域动作识别基准测试中均达到最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Video-based Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (VUDA) methods improve the robustness of video models, enabling them to be applied to action recognition tasks across different environments. However, these methods require constant access to source data during the adaptation process. Yet in many real-world applications, subjects and scenes in the source video domain should be irrelevant to those in the target video domain. With the increasing emphasis on data privacy, such methods that require source data access would raise serious privacy issues. Therefore, to cope with such concern, a more practical domain adaptation scenario is formulated as the Source-Free Video-based Domain Adaptation (SFVDA). Though there are a few methods for Source-Free Domain Adaptation (SFDA) on image data, these methods yield degenerating performance in SFVDA due to the multi-modality nature of videos, with the existence of additional temporal features. In this paper, we propose a novel Attentive Temporal Consistent Network (ATCoN) to address SFVDA by learning temporal consistency, guaranteed by two novel consistency objectives, namely feature consistency and source prediction consistency, performed across local temporal features. ATCoN further constructs effective overall temporal features by attending to local temporal features based on prediction confidence. Empirical results demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of ATCoN across various cross-domain action recognition benchmarks.

title: Yuedong Chen, Qianyi Wu, Chuanxia Zheng, Tat-Jen Cham, Jianfei Cai
title_en: Yuedong Chen, Qianyi Wu, Chuanxia Zheng, Tat-Jen Cham, Jianfei Cai
abstract: 图像翻译和操作随着深度生成模型的快速发展而受到越来越多的关注。尽管现有方法已经取得了令人印象深刻的结果,但它们主要在2D空间中进行操作。鉴于基于NeRF的3D感知生成模型的最新进展,我们引入了一个新任务,即语义到NeRF的翻译,旨在根据单个视图语义掩码作为输入,重建由NeRF建模的3D场景模型。为启动这一新颖任务,我们提出了Sem2NeRF框架。具体而言,Sem2NeRF通过将语义掩码编码到控制预训练解码器3D场景表示的潜在代码中,解决了高度具有挑战性的任务。为了进一步提高映射的准确性,我们在编码器和解码器的设计中集成了新的区域感知学习策略。我们验证了所提出的Sem2NeRF的有效性,并证明其在两个基准数据集上优于多个强基线。代码和视频可在https://donydchen.github.io/sem2nerf/获取。
abstract_en: Image translation and manipulation have gain increasing attention along with the rapid development of deep generative models. Although existing approaches have brought impressive results, they mainly operated in 2D space. In light of recent advances in NeRF-based 3D-aware generative models, we introduce a new task, Semantic-to-NeRF translation, that aims to reconstruct a 3D scene modelled by NeRF, conditioned on one single-view semantic mask as input. To kick-off this novel task, we propose the Sem2NeRF framework. In particular, Sem2NeRF addresses the highly challenging task by encoding the semantic mask into the latent code that controls the 3D scene representation of a pre-trained decoder. To further improve the accuracy of the mapping, we integrate a new region-aware learning strategy into the design of both the encoder and the decoder. We verify the efficacy of the proposed Sem2NeRF and demonstrate that it outperforms several strong baselines on two benchmark datasets. Code and video are available at https://donydchen.github.io/sem2nerf/

title: Yuehan Zhang, Bo Ji, Jia Hao, Angela Yao
title_en: Yuehan Zhang, Bo Ji, Jia Hao, Angela Yao
abstract: 在图像超分辨率领域,像素级准确性和感知保真度都是理想的。然而,大多数深度学习方法由于感知-失真权衡,只能在一方面实现高性能,而成功平衡该权衡的工作依赖于融合分别训练模型的结果并进行定制的后处理。在本文中,我们提出了一种具有低频约束(LFc-SR)的新型超分辨率模型,通过单个模型平衡目标和感知质量,生成具有高PSNR和感知评分的超分辨率图像。我们进一步引入了一种基于ADMM的交替优化方法,用于约束模型的非平凡学习。实验表明,我们的方法在不使用繁琐的后处理程序的情况下达到了最先进的性能。代码可在https://github.com/Yuehan717/PDASR获取。
abstract_en: In image super-resolution, both pixel-wise accuracy and perceptual fidelity are desirable. However, most deep learning methods only achieve high performance in one aspect due to the perception-distortion trade-off, and works that successfully balance the trade-off rely on fusing results from separately trained models with ad-hoc post-processing. In this paper, we propose a novel super-resolution model with a low-frequency constraint (LFc-SR), which balances the objective and perceptual quality through a single model and yields super-resolved images with high PSNR and perceptual scores. We further introduce an ADMM-based alternating optimization method for the non-trivial learning of the constrained model. Experiments showed that our method, without cumbersome post-processing procedures, achieved the state-of-the-art performance. The code is available at https://github.com/Yuehan717/PDASR.

title: 图对比学习中的自监督表示学习方法研究
title_en: Yuehui Han, Le Hui, Haobo Jiang, Jianjun Qian, Jin Xie
abstract: 对比学习在图表示学习领域展现出巨大潜力。通过手动构建正/负样本,大多数图对比学习方法依赖基于向量内积的相似度度量来区分样本以实现图表示。然而,人工构建的样本(如对图节点或边的扰动)可能无法有效捕捉图的内在局部结构。同时,基于向量内积的相似度度量无法充分挖掘图的局部结构以准确表征图差异。为此,本文提出了一种基于自适应子图生成的对比学习框架,用于高效且鲁棒的自监督图表示学习,采用最优传输距离作为子图间的相似度度量。该方法旨在通过捕捉图的内在结构生成对比样本,并同时基于子图的特征和结构区分样本。具体而言,对于每个中心节点,通过自适应学习与其邻域节点的关系权重,首先开发网络生成插值子图。随后,分别从相同节点和不同节点构建正负子图对。最后,采用两种类型的最优传输距离(即Wasserstein距离和Gromov-Wasserstein距离)构建结构化对比损失。在基准数据集上的大量节点分类实验验证了所提图对比学习方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Contrastive learning has shown great promise in the field of graph representation learning. By manually constructing positive/negative samples, most graph contrastive learning methods rely on the vector inner product based similarity metric to distinguish the samples for graph representation. However, the handcrafted sample construction (e.g., the perturbation on the nodes or edges of the graph) may not effectively capture the intrinsic local structures of the graph. Also, the vector inner product based similarity metric cannot fully exploit the local structures of the graph to characterize the graph difference well. To this end, in this paper, we propose a novel adaptive subgraph generation based contrastive learning framework for efficient and robust self-supervised graph representation learning, and the optimal transport distance is utilized as the similarity metric between the subgraphs. It aims to generate contrastive samples by capturing the intrinsic structures of the graph and distinguish the samples based on the features and structures of subgraphs simultaneously. Specifically, for each center node, by adaptively learning relation weights to the nodes of the corresponding neighborhood, we first develop a network to generate the interpolated subgraph. We then construct the positive and negative pairs of subgraphs from the same and different nodes, respectively. Finally, we employ two types of optimal transport distances (i.e., Wasserstein distance and Gromov-Wasserstein distance) to construct the structured contrastive loss. Extensive node classification experiments on benchmark datasets verify the effectiveness of our graph contrastive learning method.

title: Yuetian Weng, Zizheng Pan, Mingfei Han, Xiaojun Chang, Bohan Zhuang
title_en: Yuetian Weng, Zizheng Pan, Mingfei Han, Xiaojun Chang, Bohan Zhuang
abstract: 动作检测任务旨在对长时序未剪辑视频中的每个动作实例,同时推断其动作类别及起始和结束时刻的定位信息。尽管视觉Transformer在视频理解领域推动了近期进展,但设计高效的动作检测架构仍颇具挑战性,因视频片段长序列上的自注意力机制计算成本极高。为此,我们提出了一种高效的分层时空金字塔Transformer(STPT)用于动作检测,基于Transformer早期自注意力层仍聚焦于局部模式这一事实。具体而言,我们在早期阶段采用局部窗口注意力机制编码丰富的局部时空表示,而在后期阶段应用全局注意力模块捕捉长期时空依赖关系。通过这种方式,我们的STPT在大幅减少冗余的同时,能够同时编码局部特征与依赖关系,实现了精度与效率之间的良好平衡。例如,仅使用RGB输入,所提出的STPT在THUMOS14数据集上达到53.6%的mAP,超越了I3D+AFSD RGB模型超过10%,且在GFLOPs仅为31%的情况下,与使用额外光流特征的最先进AFSD方法表现相当,这为动作检测提供了一个高效且有效的端到端Transformer框架。
abstract_en: The task of action detection aims at deducing both the action category and localization of the start and end moment for each action instance in a long, untrimmed video. While vision Transformers have driven the recent advances in video understanding, it is non-trivial to design an efficient architecture for action detection due to the prohibitively expensive self-attentions over a long sequence of video clips. To this end, we present an efficient hierarchical Spatio-Temporal Pyramid Transformer (STPT) for action detection, building upon the fact that the early self-attention layers in Transformers still focus on local patterns. Specifically, we propose to use local window attention to encode rich local spatio-temporal representations in the early stages while applying global attention modules to capture long-term space-time dependencies in the later stages. In this way, our STPT can encode both locality and dependency with largely reduced redundancy, delivering a promising trade-off between accuracy and efficiency. For example, with only RGB input, the proposed STPT achieves 53.6% mAP on THUMOS14, surpassing I3D+AFSD RGB model by over 10% and performing favorably against state-of-the-art AFSD that uses additional flow features with 31% fewer GFLOPs, which serves as an effective and efficient end-to-end Transformer-based framework for action detection.

title: Yufei Guo, Liwen Zhang, Yuanpei Chen, Xinyi Tong, Xiaode Liu, YingLei Wang, Xuhui Huang, Zhe Ma
title_en: Yufei Guo, Liwen Zhang, Yuanpei Chen, Xinyi Tong, Xiaode Liu, YingLei Wang, Xuhui Huang, Zhe Ma
abstract: 受大脑启发的脉冲神经网络(SNNs)因其事件驱动和能效高的特性近年来受到越来越多的关注。神经形态硬件上存储与计算架构的集成使SNNs与深度神经网络(DNNs)存在显著差异。本文认为,在某些硬件中,SNNs可能无法从权重共享机制中获益,而权重共享机制在DNNs中能有效减少参数并提升推理效率。我们假设,采用非共享卷积核的SNN可能表现更优。基于此假设,提出了一种名为Real Spike的训练-推理解耦方法,该方法在推理阶段既支持非共享卷积核又使用二值脉冲,在训练阶段则同时保持共享卷积核和实值脉冲。这种解耦机制通过重参数化技术实现。此外,基于训练-推理解耦思想,提出了一系列在不同层级构建Real Spike的方法,这些方法在推理阶段仍保持共享卷积,并兼容神经形态与非神经形态硬件平台。理论证明表明,基于Real Spike的SNN网络优于其原始版本。实验结果表明,所有不同版本的Real Spike均能持续提升SNN性能。此外,所提方法在非脉冲静态数据集和神经形态数据集上均优于现有最先进模型。
abstract_en: Brain-inspired spiking neural networks (SNNs) have recently drawn more and more attention due to their event-driven and energy efficient characteristics. The integration of storage and computation paradigm on neuromorphic hardwares makes SNNs much different from Deep Neural Networks (DNNs). In this paper, we argue that SNNs may not benefit from the weight-sharing mechanism, which can effectively reduce parameters and improve inference efficiency in DNNs, in some hardwares, and assume that an SNN with unshared convolution kernels could perform better. Motivated by this assumption, a training-inference decoupling method for SNNs named as Real Spike is proposed, which not only enjoys both unshared convolution kernels and binary spikes in inference time but also aintains both shared convolution kernels and Real-valued Spikes during training. This decoupling mechanism of SNN is realized by a re-parameterization technique. Furthermore, based on the training-inference-decoupled idea, a series of other ways for constructing Real Spike on different levels are presented, which also enjoy shared convolutions in the inference and are friendly to both neuromorphic and non-neuromorphic hardware platforms. A theoretical proof is given to clarify that the Real Spike-based SNN network is superior to its vanilla counterpart. Experimental results show that all different Real Spike versions can consistently improve the SNN performance. Moreover, the proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art models on both non-spiking static and neuromorphic datasets.

title: Yufei Guo, Yuanpei Chen, Liwen Zhang, YingLei Wang, Xiaode Liu, Xinyi Tong, Yuanyuan Ou, Xuhui Huang, Zhe Ma
title_en: Yufei Guo, Yuanpei Chen, Liwen Zhang, YingLei Wang, Xiaode Liu, Xinyi Tong, Yuanyuan Ou, Xuhui Huang, Zhe Ma
abstract: 脉冲神经网络(SNN)近年来受到了越来越多的关注。它采用二进制脉冲信号来传递信息。得益于SNN的信息传递范式,激活值与权重的乘法运算可以被加法运算替代,从而更加节能。然而,其“硬重置”机制在膜电位超过发放阈值时会忽略膜电位之间的差异,导致信息损失。同时,在发放时刻将膜电位量化为0/1脉冲信号不可避免地引入量化误差,从而也会造成信息损失。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了一种“软重置”机制,用于基于监督训练的SNN,该机制会根据膜电位的大小将其驱动至动态重置电位,并通过膜电位整流器(MPR)将膜电位重新分布到接近脉冲的范围内以减少量化误差。实验结果表明,采用所提出的“软重置”机制和MPR的SNN在静态和动态数据集上均优于其原始版本。
abstract_en: The Spiking Neural Network (SNN) has attracted more and more attention recently. It adopts binary spike signals to transmit information. Benefitting from the information passing paradigm of SNNs, the multiplications of activations and weights can be replaced by additions, which are more energy-efficient. However, its “Hard Reset"" mechanism for the firing activity would ignore the difference among membrane potentials when the membrane potential is above the firing threshold, causing information loss. Meanwhile, quantifying the membrane potential to 0/1 spikes at the firing instants will inevitably introduce the quantization error thus bringing about information loss too. To address these problems, we propose a “Soft Reset"" mechanism for the supervised training-based SNNs, which will drive the membrane potential to a dynamic reset potential according to its magnitude, and Membrane Potential Rectifier (MPR) to reduce the quantization error via redistributing the membrane potential to a range close to the spikes. Experimental results show that the SNNs with the proposed “Soft Reset"" mechanism and MPR outperform their vanilla counterparts on both static and dynamic datasets.

title: Yufei Xu, Qiming Zhang, Jing Zhang, Dacheng Tao
title_en: Yufei Xu, Qiming Zhang, Jing Zhang, Dacheng Tao
abstract: 自监督学习方法(SSL)通过最大化两个增强视图之间的互信息取得了显著成功,其中裁剪是一种流行的增强技术。裁剪区域被广泛用于构建正样本对,而裁剪后剩余的区域在现有方法中很少被探索,尽管它们共同构成同一图像实例,并且都对类别描述有贡献。本文首次从整体视角出发,证明了裁剪过程中两个区域的重要性,并通过设计一个简单而有效的预训练任务——区域对比学习(RegionCL),展示了同时利用这两个区域的有效性。技术上,为了构建这两种区域,我们从每个输入图像中随机裁剪一个区域(称为paste view),并将其与不同图像的裁剪区域交换,组合成包含剩余区域(称为canvas view)的新图像。然后,而不是将新图像整体作为正负样本,我们基于以下简单准则,从区域视角高效构建对比样本对:即每个视图(1)与来自同一原始图像的增强视图为正样本,(2)与来自其他图像的增强视图为负样本。通过对流行SSL方法进行少量修改,RegionCL利用了这些丰富的样本对,帮助模型区分canvas视图和paste视图的区域特征,从而学习到更好的视觉表征。在ImageNet、MS COCO和Cityscapes上的实验表明,RegionCL显著提升了MoCov2、DenseCL和SimSiam的性能,并在分类、检测和分割任务中达到了最先进的效果。
abstract_en: Self-supervised methods (SSL) have achieved significant success via maximizing the mutual information between two augmented views, where cropping is a popular augmentation technique. Cropped regions are widely used to construct positive pairs, while the remained regions after cropping have rarely been explored in existing methods, although they together constitute the same image instance and both contribute to the description of the category. In this paper, we make the first attempt to demonstrate the importance of both regions in cropping from a complete perspective and the effectiveness of using both regions via designing a simple yet effective pretext task called Region Contrastive Learning (RegionCL). Technically, to construct the two kinds of regions, we randomly crop a region (called the paste view) from each input image with the same size and swap them between different images to compose new images together with the remained regions (called the canvas view). Then, instead of taking the new images as a whole for positive or negative samples, contrastive pairs are efficiently constructed from the regional perceptive based on the following simple criteria, i.e., each view is (1) positive with views augmented from the same original image and (2) negative with views augmented from other images. With minor modifications to popular SSL methods, RegionCL exploits those abundant pairs and helps the model distinguish the regions features from both canvas and paste views, therefore learning better visual representations. Experiments on ImageNet, MS COCO, and Cityscapes demonstrate that RegionCL improves MoCov2, DenseCL, and SimSiam by large margins and achieves state-of-the-art performance on classification, detection, and segmentation tasks.

title: Yuhang Li, Youngeun Kim, Hyoungseob Park, Tamar Geller, Priyadarshini Panda
title_en: Yuhang Li, Youngeun Kim, Hyoungseob Park, Tamar Geller, Priyadarshini Panda
abstract: 基于事件数据集开发脉冲神经网络(SNNs)的神经形态智能近年来引起了广泛关注。然而,事件数据集的有限规模使SNNs容易过拟合且收敛不稳定。这一问题尚未被先前学术研究充分探讨。为最小化这一泛化差距,我们提出了一种专门针对事件数据集的神经形态数据增强(Neuromorphic Data Augmentation, NDA)方法,旨在显著稳定SNN训练并减少训练与测试性能间的泛化差距。所提方法简单且兼容现有SNN训练流程。通过该增强方法,我们首次展示了SNNs的无监督对比学习的可行性。我们在主流的神经形态视觉基准数据集上进行了全面实验,结果表明NDA显著优于先前的最先进方法。例如,基于NDA的SNN在CIFAR10-DVS和N-Caltech 101数据集上分别实现了10.1%和13.7%的准确率提升。代码已开源至GitHub(URL)。
abstract_en: Developing neuromorphic intelligence on event-based datasets with Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) has recently attracted much research attention. However, the limited size of event-based datasets makes SNNs prone to overfitting and unstable convergence. This issue remains unexplored by previous academic works. In an effort to minimize this generalization gap, we propose Neuromorphic Data Augmentation (NDA), a family of geometric augmentations specifically designed for event-based datasets with the goal of significantly stabilizing the SNN training and reducing the generalization gap between training and test performance. The proposed method is simple and compatible with existing SNN training pipelines. Using the proposed augmentation, for the first time, we demonstrate the feasibility of unsupervised contrastive learning for SNNs. We conduct comprehensive experiments on prevailing neuromorphic vision benchmarks and show that NDA yields substantial improvements over previous state-of-the-art results. For example, the NDA-based SNN achieves accuracy gain on CIFAR10-DVS and N-Caltech 101 by 10.1% and 13.7%, respectively. Code is available on GitHub (URL).

title: Yuhang Zang, Wei Li, Kaiyang Zhou, Chen Huang, Chen Change Loy
title_en: Yuhang Zang, Wei Li, Kaiyang Zhou, Chen Huang, Chen Change Loy
abstract: 开放词汇目标检测,即通过自然语言指导检测新颖目标的问题,近年来受到了研究社区的广泛关注。理想情况下,我们希望扩展一个开放词汇检测器,使其能够根据用户输入的自然语言或示例图像生成边界框预测。这为人机交互提供了极大的灵活性和用户体验。为此,我们提出了一种基于DETR的新型开放词汇检测器——OV-DETR,该检测器在训练完成后,可以根据目标的类别名称或示例图像检测任何对象。将DETR转化为开放词汇检测器的最大挑战在于,无法通过未标记图像计算新颖类别的分类成本矩阵。为克服这一挑战,我们将学习目标公式化为输入查询(类别名称或示例图像)与对应对象之间的二元匹配问题,从而在测试时学习有用的对应关系以泛化到未见过的查询。在训练过程中,我们选择将Transformer解码器的条件建模为从预训练视觉-语言模型(如CLIP)获得的输入嵌入,以实现文本和图像查询的匹配。在LVIS和COCO数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的OV-DETR——首个端到端的基于Transformer的开放词汇检测器——在当前最佳方法上实现了非平凡的性能提升。
abstract_en: Open-vocabulary object detection, which is concerned with the problem of detecting novel objects guided by natural language, has gained increasing attention from the community. Ideally, we would like to extend an open-vocabulary detector such that it can produce bounding box predictions based on user inputs in form of either natural language or exemplar image. This offers great flexibility and user experience for human-computer interaction. To this end, we propose a novel open-vocabulary detector based on DETR---hence the name OV-DETR---which, once trained, can detect any object given its class name or an exemplar image. The biggest challenge of turning DETR into an open-vocabulary detector is that it is impossible to calculate the classification cost matrix of novel classes without access to their labeled images. To overcome this challenge, we formulate the learning objective as a binary matching one between input queries (class name or exemplar image) and the corresponding objects, which learns useful correspondence to generalize to unseen queries during testing. For training, we choose to condition the Transformer decoder on the input embeddings obtained from a pre-trained vision-language model like CLIP, in order to enable matching for both text and image queries. With extensive experiments on LVIS and COCO datasets, we demonstrate that our OV-DETR---the first end-to-end Transformer-based open-vocabulary detector---achieves non-trivial improvements over current state of the arts.

title: 张宇航,王程瑞,凌旭,邓伟红
title_en: Yuhang Zhang, Chengrui Wang, Xu Ling, Weihong Deng
abstract: 带噪声标签的面部表情识别(FER)由于类间相似性和标注歧义性,比传统带噪声标签分类任务更具挑战性。近期研究主要通过过滤掉大损失样本解决这一问题。本文从新的特征学习视角探索处理噪声标签的方法。我们发现,FER模型通过关注与噪声标签相关的部分特征而非整体特征来记忆噪声样本,而非从导致潜在真实标签的全部特征中学习。受此启发,我们提出了一种新颖的擦除注意力一致性(EAC)方法,在训练过程中自动抑制噪声样本。具体而言,我们首先利用面部图像的翻转语义一致性设计不平衡框架,随后随机擦除输入图像并使用翻转注意力一致性防止模型过度关注部分特征。EAC在现有最先进的带噪声标签FER方法上显著优于其他方法,并且在具有大量类别的任务(如CIFAR100和Tiny-ImageNet)中具有良好的泛化能力。代码已开源:https://github.com/zyh-uaiaaaa/Erasing-Attention-Consistency
abstract_en: Noisy label Facial Expression Recognition (FER) is more challenging than traditional noisy label classification tasks due to the inter-class similarity and the annotation ambiguity. Recent works mainly tackle this problem by filtering out large-loss samples. In this paper, we explore dealing with noisy labels from a new feature-learning perspective. We find that FER models remember noisy samples by focusing on a part of the features that can be considered related to the noisy labels instead of learning from the whole features that lead to the latent truth. Inspired by that, we propose a novel Erasing Attention Consistency (EAC) method to suppress the noisy samples during the training process automatically. Specifically, we first utilize the flip semantic consistency of facial images to design an imbalanced framework. We then randomly erase input images and use flip attention consistency to prevent the model from focusing on a part of the features. EAC significantly outperforms state-of-the-art noisy label FER methods and generalizes well to other tasks with a large number of classes like CIFAR100 and Tiny-ImageNet. The code is available at https://github.com/zyh-uaiaaaa/Erasing-Attention-Consistency.

title: Yuheng Li, Yijun Li, Jingwan Lu, Eli Shechtman, Yong Jae Lee, Krishna Kumar Singh
title_en: Yuheng Li, Yijun Li, Jingwan Lu, Eli Shechtman, Yong Jae Lee, Krishna Kumar Singh
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的方法,用于具有对多种因素显式控制的多样化前景生成。现有的基于图像修复的前景生成方法通常难以生成多样化结果,并且很少允许用户显式控制特定的变化因素(例如,对人脸修复结果进行面部身份或表情的变化)。我们利用对比学习与潜在编码,为相同的遮挡输入生成多样化前景结果。具体而言,我们定义了两组潜在编码,其中一组控制预定义的因素(“已知”),另一组控制剩余因素(“未知”)。从这两组中采样的潜在编码共同双模调制卷积核,以指导生成器合成多样化结果。实验表明,我们的方法在结果多样性与生成可控性方面优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: We introduce a new method for diverse foreground generation with explicit control over various factors. Existing image inpainting based foreground generation methods often struggle to generate diverse results and rarely allow users to explicitly control specific factors of variation (e.g., varying the facial identity or expression for face inpainting results). We leverage contrastive learning with latent codes to generate diverse foreground results for the same masked input. Specifically, we define two sets of latent codes, where one controls a pre-defined factor (“known”), and the other controls the remaining factors (“unknown”). The sampled latent codes from the two sets jointly bi-modulate the convolution kernels to guide the generator to synthesize diverse results. Experiments demonstrate the superiority of our method over state-of-the-arts in result diversity and generation controllability.

title: 全雨辉,秦欣然,庞同尧,纪慧
title_en: Yuhui Quan, Xinran Qin, Tongyao Pang, Hui Ji
abstract: 深度学习已成为压缩成像领域的一个有前景的工具,其任务是从压缩测量中重建潜在图像。针对由监督深度学习方法对潜在图像真实值的依赖所导致的局限性,本文提出了一种无监督方法,该方法仅使用一组压缩测量来训练深度图像重建模型。训练过程在测量域和图像域中进行自监督,采用基于符号翻转的噪声生成器的双头噪声注入损失。此外,所提出的方案还可用于高效地将训练好的模型适应于测试样本以进一步提升性能,其开销远低于现有内部学习方法。广泛的实验表明,所提出的方法在现有无监督方法上表现出显著的性能提升,并在与监督方法的竞争中表现良好。
abstract_en: Deep learning has been one promising tool for compressive imaging whose task is to reconstruct latent images from their compressive measurements. Aiming at addressing the limitations of supervised deep learning-based methods caused by their prerequisite on the ground truths of latent images, this paper proposes an unsupervised approach that trains a deep image reconstruction model using only a set of compressive measurements. The training is self-supervised in the domain of measurements and the domain of images, using a double-head noise-injected loss with a sign-flipping-based noise generator. In addition, the proposed scheme can also be used for efficiently adapting a trained model to a test sample for further improvement, with much less overhead than existing internal learning methods. Extensive experiments show that the proposed approach provides noticeable performance gain over existing unsupervised methods and competes well against the supervised ones.

title: Yuhui Quan, Zhuojie Chen, Huan Zheng, Hui Ji
title_en: Yuhui Quan, Zhuojie Chen, Huan Zheng, Hui Ji
abstract: 非盲图像去卷积(NBID)旨在从模糊图像中恢复潜在的清晰图像,已知对应的模糊核。大多数现有的NBID深度神经网络均需在大量真实图像(GT)上进行训练,这限制了其在显微成像和医学成像等实际应用中的适用性。本文提出了一种无监督深度学习方法用于NBID,无需访问真实图像。通过自监督重建损失解决真实图像缺失带来的挑战,该损失能很好地逼近其监督学习对应版本。针对模糊核可能存在的误差,采用基于中间样本的自监督预测损失以及基于核扰动的集成推理方案进行处理。实验表明,所提方法在准确核或错误核条件下均能提供与现有监督学习方法非常具有竞争力的性能。
abstract_en: Non-blind image deconvolution (NBID) is about restoring a latent sharp image from a blurred one, given an associated blur kernel. Most existing deep neural networks for NBID are trained over many ground truth (GT) images, which limits their applicability in practical applications such as microscopic imaging and medical imaging. This paper proposes an unsupervised deep learning approach for NBID which avoids accessing GT images. The challenge raised from the absence of GT images is tackled by a self-supervised reconstruction loss that approximates its supervised counterpart well. The possible errors of blur kernels are addressed by a self-supervised prediction loss based on intermediate samples as well as an ensemble inference scheme based on kernel perturbation. The experiments show that the proposed approach provides very competitive performance to existing supervised learning-based methods, no matter under accurate kernels or erroneous kernels.

title: Yujin Chen, Matthias Nießner, Angela Dai
title_en: Yujin Chen, Matthias Nießner, Angela Dai
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的方法,通过无监督预训练将4D动态物体先验注入到学习到的3D表示中。我们观察到,物体在环境中的动态运动提供了关于其物体性的关键线索,因此提出通过赋予学习到的3D表示这种动态理解,从而有效提升下游3D语义场景理解任务的性能。我们提出了一种新的数据增强方案,利用合成3D形状在静态3D环境中的运动,并在3D-4D约束下采用对比学习,将4D不变性编码到学习到的3D表示中。实验表明,我们的无监督表示学习在下游3D语义分割、物体检测和实例分割任务中均取得性能提升,尤其在数据稀缺场景中表现显著改善。我们的结果表明,与从头训练相比,在ScanNet/SUN RGB-D数据集上,我们的4D预训练方法在物体检测mAP@0.5指标上分别提升了5.5%/6.5%,且在测试时无额外运行时开销。
abstract_en: We present a new approach to instill 4D dynamic object priors into learned 3D representations by unsupervised pre-training. We observe that dynamic movement of an object through an environment provides important cues about its objectness, and thus propose to imbue learned 3D representations with such dynamic understanding, that can then be effectively transferred to improved performance in downstream 3D semantic scene understanding tasks. We propose a new data augmentation scheme leveraging synthetic 3D shapes moving in static 3D environments, and employ contrastive learning under 3D-4D constraints that encode 4D invariances into the learned 3D representations. Experiments demonstrate that our unsupervised representation learning results in improvement in downstream 3D semantic segmentation, object detection, and instance segmentation tasks, and moreover, notably improves performance in data-scarce scenarios. Our results show that our 4D pre-training method improves downstream tasks such as object detection mAP@0.5 by 5.5%/6.5% over training from scratch on ScanNet/SUN RGB-D while involving no additional run-time overhead at test time.

title: 欧宇金,叶钟旭
title_en: Yujin Oh, Jong Chul Ye
abstract: 由于分割标签稀缺,已进行了大量研究,通过领域自适应、半监督或自监督学习技术训练分割网络,以利用大量未标记数据集。然而,这些方法各不相同,因此尚不清楚如何将这些方法结合以提升性能。受近期多领域图像翻译方法的启发,本文提出了一种新颖的分割框架,使用自适应实例归一化(AdaIN),通过简单更改任务特定的AdaIN代码,训练单个生成器同时执行领域自适应和半监督分割任务。具体而言,我们的框架设计用于处理胸部X光片(CXR)分割中的困难情况,其中标签仅对正常数据可用,但训练模型需应用于正常和异常数据。所提出的网络在领域转移下表现出良好的泛化能力,并在异常CXR分割中达到最先进的性能。
abstract_en: As segmentation labels are scarce, extensive researches have been conducted to train segmentation networks with domain adaptation, semi-supervised or self-supervised learning techniques to utilize abun- dant unlabeled dataset. However, these approaches appear different from each other, so it is not clear how these approaches can be combined for better performance. Inspired by recent multi-domain image translation approaches, here we propose a novel segmentation framework using adap- tive instance normalization (AdaIN), so that a single generator is trained to perform both domain adaptation and semi-supervised segmentation tasks via knowledge distillation by simply changing task-specific AdaIN codes. Specifically, our framework is designed to deal with difficult situ- ations in chest X-ray radiograph (CXR) segmentation, where labels are only available for normal data, but trained model should be applied to both normal and abnormal data. The proposed network demonstrates great generalizability under domain shift and achieves the state-of-the- art performance for abnormal CXR segmentation.

title: Yuki Kawana, Yusuke Mukuta, Tatsuya Harada
title_en: Yuki Kawana, Yusuke Mukuta, Tatsuya Harada
abstract: 现实世界中广泛存在人工关节结构物体。然而,先前的无监督部分分解方法不适用于此类物体,因为它们假设部件位置在空间上固定,导致部件解析不一致。本文提出PPD(无监督姿态感知部分分解),以解决一种新颖的设置,该设置明确针对具有机械关节的人工关节结构物体,在部件解析中考虑部件姿态。作为一种分析-合成方法,我们证明针对部件形状和姿态的类别通用先验学习有助于无监督学习(1)抽象部件形状的部件解析,以及(2)在单帧形状监督下将部件姿态作为关节参数进行学习。我们在合成和真实数据集上评估了我们的方法,并表明其在基于与监督基线相当的部件姿态估计性能的基础上,能够实现关节结构物体的一致部件解析,优于先前的工作。
abstract_en: Man-made articulated objects exist widely in the real world. However, previous methods for unsupervised part decomposition are unsuitable for such objects because they assume a spatially fixed part location, resulting in inconsistent part parsing. In this paper, we propose PPD (unsupervised Pose-aware Part Decomposition) to address a novel setting that explicitly targets man-made articulated objects with mechanical joints, considering the part poses in part parsing. As an analysis-by-synthesis approach, We show that category-common prior learning for both part shapes and poses facilitates the unsupervised learning of (1) part parsing with abstracted part shapes, and (2) part poses as joint parameters under single-frame shape supervision. We evaluate our method on synthetic and real datasets, and we show that it outperforms previous works in consistent part parsing of the articulated objects based on comparable part pose estimation performance to the supervised baseline.

title: 苏宇坤、林国生、孙瑞周、吴清耀
title_en: Yukun Su, Guosheng Lin, Ruizhou Sun, Qingyao Wu
abstract: 物体姿态转换是一项具有挑战性的任务。然而,现有大多数姿态转换网络仅专注于合成人体。这些方法要么依赖关键点信息,要么依赖配对目标姿态图像的手动标注进行训练。然而,收集此类配对数据需要大量人力,且关键点信息无法推广到一般物体。本文针对从非配对数据中实现新颖通用物体姿态转换的问题。给定一个提供外观信息的物体源图像以及在缺乏配对示例的情况下作为参考的期望姿态图像,我们生成该物体在该姿态下的描述,保留物体和背景的外观。具体而言,为了保留源信息,我们在相关匹配模块之后提出一个对抗网络,包含$\textbf{S}$空间-$\textbf{S}$结构(SS)模块和$\textbf{T}$纹理-$\textbf{S}$风格-$\textbf{C}$颜色(TSC)模块,以使输出在语义上与目标姿态图像对应,同时在上下文中与源图像相关。此外,我们可以扩展我们的网络以完成多物体和跨类别姿态转换。大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性,与近期方法相比,所生成的图像在图像质量上更加真实。此外,我们展示了该方法在多个应用中的实用性。
abstract_en: Object pose transformation is a challenging task. Yet, most existing pose transformation networks only focus on synthesizing humans. These methods either rely on the keypoints information or rely on the manual annotations of the paired target pose images for training. However, collecting such paired data is laboring and the cue of keypoints is inapplicable to general objects. In this paper, we address a problem of novel general object pose transformation from unpaired data. Given a source image of an object that provides appearance information and the desired pose image as a reference in the absence of paired examples, we produce a depiction of that object in that pose, retaining the appearance of both the object and background. Specifically, to preserve the source information, we propose an adversarial network with $\textbf{S}$patial-$\textbf{S}$tructural (SS) block and $\textbf{T}$exture-$\textbf{S}$tyle-$\textbf{C}$olor (TSC) block after the correlation matching module that facilitates the output to be semantically corresponding to the target pose image while contextually related to the source image. In addition, we can extend our network to complete multi-object and cross-category pose transformation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method which can create more realistic images when compared to those of recent approaches in terms of image quality. Moreover, we show the practicality of our method for several applications.

title: Yuliang Zou, Zizhao Zhang, Chun-Liang Li, Han Zhang, Tomas Pfister, Jia-Bin Huang
title_en: Yuliang Zou, Zizhao Zhang, Chun-Liang Li, Han Zhang, Tomas Pfister, Jia-Bin Huang
abstract: 我们提出了一种用于跨域图像分割的测试时适应方法。我们的方法很简单:在测试时,针对新的未见过的实例,我们通过执行实例特定的批量归一化(统计)校准来适应预训练模型。我们的方法包含两个核心组件。首先,我们将手动设计的批量归一化校准规则替换为可学习模块。其次,我们利用强大的数据增强来模拟随机域迁移,以学习校准规则。与现有的领域适应方法相比,我们的方法在训练时不需要访问目标域数据,也不需要进行计算成本高昂的测试时模型训练/优化。将我们的方法与通过标准配方训练的模型结合,取得了显著的改进,与几种最先进的领域泛化和单次无监督领域适应方法相比具有明显优势。将我们的方法与领域泛化方法结合,进一步提高了性能,达到了新的最先进的水平。
abstract_en: We propose a test-time adaptation method for cross-domain image segmentation. Our method is simple: Given a new unseen instance at the test time, we adapt a pre-trained model by conducting instance-specific BatchNorm (statistics) calibration. Our approach has two core components. First, we replace the manually designed BatchNorm calibration rule with a learnable module. Second, we leverage strong data augmentation to simulate random domain shifts for learning the calibration rule. In contrast to existing domain adaptation methods, our method does not require accessing the target domain data at training time or conducting computationally expensive test-time model training/optimization. Equipping our method with models trained by standard recipes achieves significant improvement, comparing favorably with several state-of-the-art domain generalization and one-shot unsupervised domain adaptation approaches. Combining our method with the domain generalization methods further improves the performance, reaching a new state of the art.

title: Yulin Wang, Yang Yue, Xinhong Xu, Ali Hassani, Victor Kulikov, Nikita Orlov, Shiji Song, Humphrey Shi, Gao Huang
title_en: Yulin Wang, Yang Yue, Xinhong Xu, Ali Hassani, Victor Kulikov, Nikita Orlov, Shiji Song, Humphrey Shi, Gao Huang
abstract: 近期研究表明,减少时间和空间冗余是实现高效视频识别的有效方法,例如将大部分计算资源分配给任务相关的帧子集或每帧中最有价值的图像区域。然而,在大多数现有工作中,通常仅对其中一种冗余进行建模,而忽略另一种。本文在最近提出的AdaFocusV2算法基础上,探索了时空动态计算的统一建模方法,提出了改进的AdaFocusV3框架。我们的方法通过仅在少量但信息量丰富的三维视频立方体上激活高计算量网络,从而降低计算成本。这些立方体从由帧高度、宽度和视频时长构成的空间中裁剪得到,其位置通过轻量级策略网络在样本级自适应确定。在测试阶段,每个视频对应的立方体数量动态配置,即按顺序处理视频立方体直至生成足够可靠的预测。值得注意的是,通过深度特征插值近似非可微的裁剪操作,AdaFocusV3可以有效训练。在六个基准数据集(即ActivityNet、FCVID、Mini-Kinetics、Something-Something V1&V2和Diving48)上的大量实验证明,我们的模型显著优于竞争基线方法。
abstract_en: Recent research has revealed that reducing the temporal and spatial redundancy are both effective approaches towards efficient video recognition, e.g., allocating the majority of computation to a task-relevant subset of frames or the most valuable image regions of each frame. However, in most existing works, either type of redundancy is typically modeled with another absent. This paper explores the unified formulation of spatial-temporal dynamic computation on top of the recently proposed AdaFocusV2 algorithm, contributing to an improved AdaFocusV3 framework. Our method reduces the computational cost by activating the expensive high-capacity network only on some small but informative 3D video cubes. These cubes are cropped from the space formed by frame height, width, and video duration, while their locations are adaptively determined with a light-weighted policy network on a per-sample basis. At test time, the number of the cubes corresponding to each video is dynamically configured, i.e., video cubes are processed sequentially until a sufficiently reliable prediction is produced. Notably, AdaFocusV3 can be effectively trained by approximating the non-differentiable cropping operation with the interpolation of deep features. Extensive empirical results on six benchmark datasets (i.e., ActivityNet, FCVID, Mini-Kinetics, Something-Something V1&V2 and Diving48) demonstrate that our model is considerably more efficient than competitive baselines.

title: Yulong Cao, Chaowei Xiao, Anima Anandkumar, Danfei Xu, Marco Pavone
title_en: Yulong Cao, Chaowei Xiao, Anima Anandkumar, Danfei Xu, Marco Pavone
abstract: 轨迹预测对于自动驾驶车辆(AVs)规划正确且安全的驾驶行为至关重要。尽管许多先前研究旨在提高预测准确性,但很少有研究探讨其方法的对抗鲁棒性。为弥合这一差距,我们提出研究数据驱动轨迹预测系统的对抗鲁棒性。我们设计了一种基于优化的对抗攻击框架,利用精心设计的可微动态模型生成逼真的对抗轨迹。实证研究表明,我们对当前最先进的预测模型的对抗鲁棒性进行了基准测试,结果显示我们的攻击使通用指标和规划感知指标的预测误差分别增加了超过50%和37%。我们还展示了该攻击在仿真环境中可能导致AV驶出道路或与其他车辆碰撞。最后,我们演示了如何通过对抗训练方案来缓解对抗攻击。
abstract_en: Trajectory prediction is essential for autonomous vehicles (AVs) to plan correct and safe driving behaviors. While many prior works aim to achieve higher prediction accuracy, few studies the adversarial robustness of their methods. To bridge this gap, we propose to study the adversarial robustness of data-driven trajectory prediction systems. We devise an optimization-based adversarial attack framework that leverages a carefully-designed differentiable dynamic model to generate realistic adversarial trajectories. Empirically, we benchmark the adversarial robustness of state-of-the-art prediction models and show that our attack increases the prediction error for both general metrics and planning-aware metrics by more than 50% and 37%. We also show that our attack can lead an AV to drive off-road or collide into other vehicles in simulation. Finally, we demonstrate how to mitigate the adversarial attacks using an adversarial training scheme.

title: Yun Xing, Dayan Guan, Jiaxing Huang, Shijian Lu
title_en: Yun Xing, Dayan Guan, Jiaxing Huang, Shijian Lu
abstract: 在大量标注训练数据的监督下,视频语义分割取得了显著进展。然而,领域自适应视频分割(即通过从标注源域适应到未标注目标域来缓解数据标注约束)却长期被忽视。我们设计了时序伪监督(TPS),这是一种简单有效的学习方法,通过一致性训练的思想从未标注目标视频中学习有效表示。与传统仅在空间域构建一致性的方法不同,我们通过强制模型在增强视频帧之间保持一致性,探索在时空域进行一致性训练,从而能够从更多样化的目标数据中学习。具体而言,我们设计了跨帧伪标签机制,在学习增强当前视频帧的同时,从先前视频帧中提供伪监督。跨帧伪标签鼓励网络生成高置信度预测,从而有效促进与跨帧增强的一致性训练。在多个公开数据集上的大量实验表明,TPS在实现上更简单,训练更稳定,并且在视频分割精度上优于现有最先进的方法。代码已开源:https://github.com/xing0047/TPS
abstract_en: Video semantic segmentation has achieved great progress under the supervision of large amounts of labelled training data. However, domain adaptive video segmentation, which can mitigate data labelling constraints by adapting from a labelled source domain toward an unlabelled target domain, is largely neglected. We design temporal pseudo supervision (TPS), a simple and effective method that explores the idea of consistency training for learning effective representations from unlabelled target videos. Unlike traditional consistency training that builds consistency in spatial space, we explore consistency training in spatiotemporal space by enforcing model consistency across augmented video frames which helps learn from more diverse target data. Specifically, we design cross-frame pseudo labelling to provide pseudo supervision from previous video frames while learning from the augmented current video frames. The cross-frame pseudo labelling encourages the network to produce high-certainty predictions, which facilitates consistency training with cross-frame augmentation effectively. Extensive experiments over multiple public datasets show that TPS is simpler to implement, much more stable to train, and achieves superior video segmentation accuracy as compared with the state-of-the-art. Code is available at https://github.com/xing0047/TPS.

title: Yun-Hao Cao, Hao Yu, Jianxin Wu
title_en: Yun-Hao Cao, Hao Yu, Jianxin Wu
abstract: 视觉Transformer(ViTs)正逐渐成为卷积神经网络(CNNs)在视觉识别中的替代方案。它们在与CNNs的竞争中表现出色,但由于缺乏典型的卷积归纳偏置,它们比常见的CNNs需要更多的数据。它们通常在JFT-300M或至少ImageNet上进行预训练,而很少有研究探讨在有限数据下训练ViTs。在本文中,我们研究如何在有限数据(例如2040张图像)下训练ViTs。我们提供了理论分析,表明我们的方法(基于参数化实例判别)优于其他方法,因为它能够同时捕捉特征对齐和实例相似性。我们在各种ViT主干网络下,从头开始在7个小型数据集上训练时取得了最先进的结果。我们还研究了小型数据集的迁移能力,并发现从小型数据集中学习到的表示甚至可以提升大规模ImageNet训练。
abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) is emerging as an alternative to convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for visual recognition. They achieve competitive results with CNNs but the lack of the typical convolutional inductive bias makes them more data-hungry than common CNNs. They are often pretrained on JFT-300M or at least ImageNet and few works study training ViTs with limited data. In this paper, we investigate how to train ViTs with limited data (e.g., 2040 images). We give theoretical analyses that our method (based on parametric instance discrimination) is superior to other methods in that it can capture both feature alignment and instance similarities. We achieve state-of-the-art results when training from scratch on 7 small datasets under various ViT backbones. We also investigate the transferring ability of small datasets and find that representations learned from small datasets can even improve large-scale ImageNet training.

title: Yun-Hao Cao, Peiqin Sun, Yechang Huang, Jianxin Wu, Shuchang Zhou
title_en: Yun-Hao Cao, Peiqin Sun, Yechang Huang, Jianxin Wu, Shuchang Zhou
abstract: 随着自监督学习(SSL)的成功,通过自监督预训练模型进行微调已成为提升下游任务性能的主流范式。然而,我们发现当前SSL模型在进行低比特量化时会出现严重的精度下降,阻碍了其在资源受限应用中的部署。本文提出了一种称为协同自监督与量化学习(SSQL)的方法,用于预训练量化友好的自监督模型,以促进下游部署。SSQL以自监督的方式对比量化模型与全精度模型的特征,其中量化模型的比特宽度在每一步随机选择。SSQL不仅在量化到低比特宽度时显著提升了精度,而且在大多数情况下也提高了全精度模型的精度。通过仅训练一次,SSQL即可同时受益于不同比特宽度下的各种下游任务。此外,无需额外存储开销即可实现比特宽度的灵活性,训练和推理过程中仅需存储一次权重。我们对SSQL的优化过程进行了理论分析,并在各种基准上进行了详尽实验,进一步验证了我们方法的有效性。
abstract_en: With the success of self-supervised learning (SSL), it has become a mainstream paradigm to fine-tune from self-supervised pretrained models to boost the performance on downstream tasks. However, we find that current SSL models suffer severe accuracy drops when performing low-bit quantization, prohibiting their deployment in resource-constrained applications. In this paper, we propose a method called synergistic self-supervised and quantization learning (SSQL) to pretrain quantization-friendly self-supervised models facilitating downstream deployment. SSQL contrasts the features of the quantized and full precision models in a self-supervised fashion, where the bit-width for the quantized model is randomly selected in each step. SSQL not only significantly improves the accuracy when quantized to lower bit-widths, but also boosts the accuracy of full precision models in most cases. By only training once, SSQL can then benefit various downstream tasks at different bit-widths simultaneously. Moreover, the bit-width flexibility is achieved without additional storage overhead, requiring only one copy of weights during training and inference. We theoretically analyze the optimization process of SSQL, and conduct exhaustive experiments on various benchmarks to further demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

title: 霍永翰、张志鹏、陈鹏宇、阿莱桑德罗·格努蒂、彭文孝
title_en: Yung-Han Ho, Chih-Peng Chang, Peng-Yu Chen, Alessandro Gnutti, Wen-Hsiao Peng
abstract: 本文提出了一种基于条件增强归一化流(CANF)的端到端学习视频压缩系统,称为CANF-VC。大多数学习视频压缩系统采用与传统编解码器相同的混合编码架构。最近关于条件编码的研究表明,混合编码存在次优性,为深度生成模型在构建新编码框架中发挥关键作用提供了机会。CANF-VC代表了一种新的尝试,利用条件ANF学习视频生成模型以实现条件帧间编码。我们选择ANF是因为它是一种特殊的生成模型,包含变分自编码器作为特例,并能够实现更好的表达能力。CANF-VC还将条件编码思想扩展到运动编码,形成纯条件编码框架。在常用数据集上的大量实验结果验证了CANF-VC优于现有最先进方法。CANF-VC的源代码可在https://github.com/NYCU-MAPL/CANF-VC获取。
abstract_en: This paper presents an end-to-end learning-based video compression system, termed CANF-VC, based on conditional augmented normalizing flows (CANF). Most learned video compression systems adopt the same hybrid-based coding architecture as the traditional codecs. Recent research on conditional coding has shown the sub-optimality of the hybrid-based coding and opens up opportunities for deep generative models to take a key role in creating new coding frameworks. CANF-VC represents a new attempt that leverages the conditional ANF to learn a video generative model for conditional inter-frame coding. We choose ANF because it is a special type of generative model, which includes variational autoencoder as a special case and is able to achieve better expressiveness. CANF-VC also extends the idea of conditional coding to motion coding, forming a purely conditional coding framework. Extensive experimental results on commonly used datasets confirm the superiority of CANF-VC to the state-of-the-art methods. The source code of CANF-VC is available at https://github.com/NYCU-MAPL/CANF-VC.

title: Yunhao Ba, Howard Zhang, Ethan Yang, Akira Suzuki, Arnold Pfahnl, Chethan Chinder Chandrappa, Celso M. de Melo, Suya You, Stefano Soatto, Alex Wong, Achuta Kadambi
title_en: Yunhao Ba, Howard Zhang, Ethan Yang, Akira Suzuki, Arnold Pfahnl, Chethan Chinder Chandrappa, Celso M. de Melo, Suya You, Stefano Soatto, Alex Wong, Achuta Kadambi
abstract: 我们提出了一种大规模的真实世界雨天与干净图像配对数据集,并提出了一种去除由雨痕和雨水积聚引起的图像退化的方法。由于目前尚无真实世界去雨数据集,现有最先进的方法依赖于合成数据,因此受限于sim2real领域差距;此外,由于缺乏真实配对数据集,严格的评估仍是一个挑战。我们通过细致控制非雨变化,收集了一个真实配对的去雨数据集,填补了这一空白。我们的数据集支持多样真实世界雨现象(如雨痕和雨水积聚)的配对训练和定量评估。为学习对雨现象鲁棒的表示,我们提出了一种深度神经网络,通过最小化雨天与干净图像之间的雨鲁棒损失来重建底层场景。大量实验表明,我们的模型在各种条件下均优于现有的去雨方法。项目网站:https://visual.ee.ucla.edu/gt_rain.htm/.
abstract_en: We propose a large-scale dataset of real-world rainy and clean image pairs and a method to remove degradations, induced by rain streaks and rain accumulation, from the image. As there exists no real-world dataset for deraining, current state-of-the-art methods rely on synthetic data and thus are limited by the sim2real domain gap; moreover, rigorous evaluation remains a challenge due to the absence of a real paired dataset. We fill this gap by collecting a real paired deraining dataset through meticulous control of non-rain variations. Our dataset enables paired training and quantitative evaluation for diverse real-world rain phenomena (e.g. rain streaks and rain accumulation). To learn a representation robust to rain phenomena, we propose a deep neural network that reconstructs the underlying scene by minimizing a rain-robust loss between rainy and clean images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our model outperforms the state-of-the-art deraining methods on real rainy images under various conditions. Project website: https://visual.ee.ucla.edu/gt_rain.htm/.

title: Yunhao Ge, Harkirat Behl, Jiashu Xu, Suriya Gunasekar, Neel Joshi, Yale Song, Xin Wang, Laurent Itti, Vibhav Vineet
title_en: Yunhao Ge, Harkirat Behl, Jiashu Xu, Suriya Gunasekar, Neel Joshi, Yale Song, Xin Wang, Laurent Itti, Vibhav Vineet
abstract: 传统方法训练计算机视觉模型需要收集并标注大量不同场景配置和属性的图像数据。这一过程极其耗时,且难以确保所捕获的数据分布与应用场景的目标域良好匹配。近年来,合成数据作为一种解决上述两个问题的方法逐渐兴起。然而,现有方法要么需要人工专家手动调整每个场景属性,要么使用自动方法但缺乏控制,这需要渲染大量随机数据变化,速度慢且常无法针对目标域进行优化。我们提出了首个完全可微的合成数据生成流程,利用神经辐射场(NeRFs)与目标应用的损失函数形成闭环,按需生成数据,无需人工劳动,以最大化目标任务的准确性。我们通过合成和现实世界物体检测实验验证了方法的有效性。此外,我们在新的"YCB-in-the-Wild"数据集上进行评估,该数据集为现实环境中物体检测提供了多样姿态的测试场景。
abstract_en: Traditional approaches for training a computer vision models requires collecting and labelling vast amounts of imagery under a diverse set of scene configurations and properties. This process is incredibly time-consuming, and it is challenging to ensure that the captured data distribution maps well to the target domain of an application scenario. In recent years, synthetic data has emerged as a way to address both of these issues. However, current approaches either require human experts to manually tune each scene property or use automatic methods that provide little to no control; this requires rendering large amounts random data variations, which is slow and is often suboptimal for the target domain. We present the first fully differentiable synthetic data generation pipeline that uses Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) in a closed-loop with a target application’s loss function to generate data, on demand, with no human labor, to maximise accuracy for a target task. We illustrate the effectiveness of our method with synthetic and real-world object detection experiments. In addition, we evaluate on a new ""YCB-in-the-Wild"" dataset that provides a test scenario for object detection with varied pose in real-world environments.

title: Yunhao Ge, Yao Xiao, Zhi Xu, Xingrui Wang, Laurent Itti
title_en: Yunhao Ge, Yao Xiao, Zhi Xu, Xingrui Wang, Laurent Itti
abstract: 我们研究了人类视觉系统(HVS)的三个重要特征——形状、纹理和颜色——对物体分类的贡献。我们构建了一个类人视觉引擎(HVE),该引擎明确且分别地从图像中计算形状、纹理和颜色特征。随后将得到的特征向量进行拼接以支持最终分类。我们证明HVE能够总结并排序三个特征对物体识别的贡献。我们通过人类实验确认,HVE和人类主要使用某些特定特征来支持特定类别的分类(例如,纹理是区分斑马与其他四足动物的主要特征,无论是对人类还是HVE)。借助HVE,给定任何环境(数据集),我们能够总结整个任务(全局)最重要的特征(例如,在CUB数据集中,颜色是总体分类最重要的特征),以及每个类别(局部)最重要的特征(例如,在iLab-20M数据集中,形状是识别船只最重要的特征)。为了进一步展示HVE的实用性,我们利用它模拟人类在无属性标注情况下的开放世界零样本学习能力。最后,我们证明HVE还可以通过结合不同特征来模拟人类的想象力能力。
abstract_en: We investigate the contributions of three important features of the human visual system (HVS)---shape, texture, and color ---to object classification. We build a humanoid vision engine (HVE) that explicitly and separately computes shape, texture, and color features from images. The resulting feature vectors are then concatenated to support the final classification. We show that HVE can summarize and rank-order the contributions of the three features to object recognition. We use human experiments to confirm that both HVE and humans predominantly use some specific features to support the classification of specific classes (e.g., texture is the dominant feature to distinguish a zebra from other quadrupeds, both for humans and HVE). With the help of HVE, given any environment (dataset), we can summarize the most important features for the whole task (global; e.g., color is the most important feature overall for classification with the CUB dataset), and for each class (local; e.g., shape is the most important feature to recognize boats in the iLab-20M dataset). To demonstrate more usefulness of HVE, we use it to simulate the open-world zero-shot learning ability of humans with no attribute labeling. Finally, we show that HVE can also simulate human imagination ability with the combination of different features.

title: Yunhui Han, Kunming Luo, Ao Luo, Jiangyu Liu, Haoqiang Fan, Guiming Luo, Shuaicheng Liu
title_en: Yunhui Han, Kunming Luo, Ao Luo, Jiangyu Liu, Haoqiang Fan, Guiming Luo, Shuaicheng Liu
abstract: 从视频中获取真实标签具有挑战性,因为像素级流标签的手动标注成本高昂且繁琐。此外,现有方法尝试将训练好的模型适应到合成数据集上以应用于真实视频,这不可避免地存在领域差异问题,阻碍了实际应用中的性能表现。为了解决这些问题,我们提出RealFlow,一个基于期望最大化(Expectation-Maximization)的框架,可以直接从任何未标记的真实视频中生成大规模光流数据集。具体而言,我们首先估计视频帧对之间的光流,然后基于预测的流合成新的图像。因此,新的图像对及其对应的流可以被视为新的训练集。此外,我们设计了现实图像对渲染(Realistic Image Pair Rendering, RIPR)模块,采用softmax splatting和双向孔填充技术来缓解图像合成中的伪影问题。在E步中,RIPR渲染新图像以生成大量训练数据;在M步中,我们利用生成的训练数据训练光流网络,该网络可用于下一轮E步的光流估计。在迭代学习过程中,流网络的能力逐渐提升,光流的准确性以及合成数据集的质量也随之提高。实验结果表明,RealFlow在数据集生成方法上表现出显著优势。此外,基于生成的数据集,我们的方法在两个标准基准测试中相比监督和无监督光流方法均取得了最先进的性能。我们的代码和数据集可在https://github.com/megvii-research/RealFlow获取。
abstract_en: Obtaining the ground truth labels from a video is challenging since the manual annotation of pixel-wise flow labels is prohibitively expensive and laborious. Besides, existing approaches try to adapt the trained model on synthetic datasets to authentic videos, which inevitably suffers from domain discrepancy and hinders the performance for real-world applications. To solve these problems, we propose RealFlow, an Expectation-Maximization based framework that can create large-scale optical flow datasets directly from any unlabeled realistic videos. Specifically, we first estimate optical flow between a pair of video frames, and then synthesize a new image from this pair based on the predicted flow. Thus the new image pairs and their corresponding flows can be regarded as a new training set. Besides, we design a Realistic Image Pair Rendering (RIPR) module that adopts softmax splatting and bi-directional hole filling techniques to alleviate the artifacts of the image synthesis. In the E-step, RIPR renders new images to create a large quantity of training data. In the M-step, we utilize the generated training data to train an optical flow network, which can be used to estimate optical flows in the next E-step. During the iterative learning steps, the capability of the flow network is gradually improved, so is the accuracy of the flow, as well as the quality of the synthesized dataset. Experimental results show that RealFlow outperforms previous dataset generation methods by a considerably large margin. Moreover, based on the generated dataset, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on two standard benchmarks compared with both supervised and unsupervised optical flow methods. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/megvii-research/RealFlow

title: Yuning Lu, Liangjian Wen, Jianzhuang Liu, Yajing Liu, Xinmei Tian
title_en: Yuning Lu, Liangjian Wen, Jianzhuang Liu, Yajing Liu, Xinmei Tian
abstract: 现有少样本学习(FSL)方法依赖于大规模带标签数据集的训练,这限制了它们利用大量无标签数据的能力。从信息论视角出发,我们提出了一种有效的无监督少样本学习方法,通过自监督学习来获取表征。遵循信息最大化(InfoMax)原则,我们的方法通过捕捉数据的内在结构来学习全面的表征。具体而言,我们使用低偏差的互信息(MI)估计器最大化实例与其表征之间的互信息(MI),以进行自监督预训练。与专注于可见类别可区分特征的监督预训练不同,我们的自监督模型对可见类别的偏倚更小,从而在未见类别上表现出更好的泛化能力。我们解释了监督预训练和自监督预训练实际上是在最大化不同的MI目标。进一步进行了大量实验,以分析其在不同训练设置下的少样本学习性能。令人惊讶的是,结果表明在适当条件下,自监督预训练可以优于监督预训练。与最先进的少样本学习方法相比,我们的方法在广泛使用的少样本学习基准测试中实现了与无基类标签相当的性能。
abstract_en: Existing few-shot learning (FSL) methods rely on training with a large labeled dataset, which prevents them from leveraging abundant unlabeled data. From an information-theoretic perspective, we propose an effective unsupervised FSL method, learning representations with self-supervision. Following the InfoMax principle, our method learns comprehensive representations by capturing the intrinsic structure of the data. Specifically, we maximize the mutual information (MI) of instances and their representations with a low-bias MI estimator to perform self-supervised pre-training. Rather than supervised pre-training focusing on the discriminable features of the seen classes, our self-supervised model has less bias toward the seen classes, resulting in better generalization for unseen classes. We explain that supervised pre-training and self-supervised pre-training are actually maximizing different MI objectives. Extensive experiments are further conducted to analyze their FSL performance with various training settings. Surprisingly, the results show that self-supervised pre-training can outperform supervised pre-training under the appropriate conditions. Compared with state-of-the-art FSL methods, our approach achieves comparable performance on widely used FSL benchmarks without any labels of the base classes.

title: Yunlu Chen, Basura Fernando, Hakan Bilen, Matthias Nießner, Efstratios Gavves
title_en: Yunlu Chen, Basura Fernando, Hakan Bilen, Matthias Nießner, Efstratios Gavves
abstract: 近年来,神经隐式表示在建模具有任意拓扑结构的3D形状方面取得了显著进展。在本工作中,我们针对此类表示的两个关键局限性进行改进:一是无法捕捉局部3D几何细节,二是难以从未见过的3D变换形状中学习并进行泛化。为此,我们引入了一种新型的图隐式函数家族,其包含协变层,通过局部k近邻图嵌入和多分辨率稀疏点集观测,实现了对精细局部细节的建模以及对多种几何变换的鲁棒性。我们的方法在ShapeNet重建任务中,将现有旋转协变隐式函数的IoU从0.69提升至0.89。我们还证明,该协变隐式函数可扩展到其他类型的相似变换,并能泛化到未见过的平移和缩放。
abstract_en: In recent years, neural implicit representations have made remarkable progress in modeling of 3D shapes with arbitrary topology. In this work, we address two key limitations of such representations, in failing to capture local 3D geometric fine details, and to learn from and generalize to shapes with unseen 3D transformations. To this end, we introduce a novel family of graph implicit functions with equivariant layers that facilitates modeling fine local details and guaranteed robustness to various groups of geometric transformations, through local k-NN graph embeddings with sparse point set observations at multiple resolutions. Our method improves over the existing rotation-equivariant implicit function from 0.69 to 0.89 (IoU) on the ShapeNet reconstruction task. We also show that our equivariant implicit function can be extended to other types of similarity transformations and generalizes to unseen translations and scaling.

title: 白云鹏、董超、柴增浩、王安东、徐正卓、袁春
title_en: Yunpeng Bai, Chao Dong, Zenghao Chai, Andong Wang, Zhengzhuo Xu, Chun Yuan
abstract: 基于示例的上色方法依赖参考图像为灰度图像提供合理的颜色。基于示例的上色方法的关键和难点在于建立这两幅图像之间的准确对应关系。先前的方法尝试构建这种对应关系,但面临两个障碍。首先,使用亮度通道计算对应关系不够准确。其次,他们构建的密集对应关系引入了错误的匹配结果并增加了计算负担。为了解决这两个问题,我们提出语义稀疏上色网络(SSCN),以粗到细的方式将全局图像风格和与语义相关的细节颜色转移到灰度图像中。我们的网络能够完美平衡全局和局部颜色,同时缓解模糊匹配问题。实验表明,我们的方法在定量和定性评估中均优于现有方法,并实现了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Exemplar-based colorization approaches rely on reference image to provide plausible colors for target gray-scale image. The key and difficulty of exemplar-based colorization is to establish an accurate correspondence between these two images. Previous approaches have attempted to construct such a correspondence but are faced with two obstacles. First, using luminance channels for the calculation of correspondence is inaccurate. Second, the dense correspondence they built introduces wrong matching results and increases the computation burden. To address these two problems, we propose Semantic-Sparse Colorization Network (SSCN) to transfer both the global image style and detailed semantic-related colors to the gray-scale image in a coarse-to-fine manner. Our network can perfectly balance the global and local colors while alleviating the ambiguous matching problem. Experiments show that our method outperforms existing methods in both quantitative and qualitative evaluation and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

title: Yunshan Zhong, Mingbao Lin, Mengzhao Chen, Ke Li, Yunhang Shen, Fei Chao, Yongjian Wu, Rongrong Ji
title_en: Yunshan Zhong, Mingbao Lin, Mengzhao Chen, Ke Li, Yunhang Shen, Fei Chao, Yongjian Wu, Rongrong Ji
abstract: 尽管后训练量化因无需访问原始完整训练数据而受到关注,但其性能不佳主要源于图像数据稀缺。为缓解这一限制,本文利用零样本量化引入的合成数据与校准数据集,提出一种细粒度数据分布对齐(FDDA)方法以提升后训练量化的性能。该方法基于我们在深度网络训练层中观察到的批量归一化统计(BNS)的两个重要特性,即类间分离和类内不一致。为保留这一细粒度分布信息:1)我们计算校准数据集的每类BNS作为该类的BNS中心,并提出BNS中心化损失,强制不同类别的合成数据分布接近其自身中心;2)我们在中心中添加高斯噪声以模拟类内不一致,并提出BNS失真损失,强制同一类别的合成数据分布接近失真中心。通过利用这两种细粒度损失,我们的方法在ImageNet上展现出最先进的性能,尤其是在第一层和最后一层均量化为低比特时。
abstract_en: While post-training quantization receives popularity mostly due to its evasion in accessing the original complete training dataset, its poor performance also stems from scarce images. To alleviate this limitation, in this paper, we leverage the synthetic data introduced by zero-shot quantization with calibration dataset and propose a fine-grained data distribution alignment (FDDA) method to boost the performance of post-training quantization. The method is based on two important properties of batch normalization statistics (BNS) we observed in deep layers of the trained network, i.e., inter-class separation and intra-class incohesion. To preserve this fine-grained distribution information: 1) We calculate the per-class BNS of the calibration dataset as the BNS centers of each class and propose a BNS-centralized loss to force the synthetic data distributions of different classes to be close to their own centers. 2) We add Gaussian noise into the centers to imitate the incohesion and propose a BNS-distorted loss to force the synthetic data distribution of the same class to be close to the distorted centers. By utilizing these two fine-grained losses, our method manifests the state-of-the-art performance on ImageNet, especially when both the first and last layers are quantized to the low-bit.

title: Yunshan Zhong, Mingbao Lin, Xunchao Li, Ke Li, Yunhang Shen, Fei Chao, Yongjian Wu, Rongrong Ji
title_en: Yunshan Zhong, Mingbao Lin, Xunchao Li, Ke Li, Yunhang Shen, Fei Chao, Yongjian Wu, Rongrong Ji
abstract: 轻量级超分辨率(SR)模型因其在移动设备上的适用性而受到广泛关注。许多研究采用网络量化技术来压缩SR模型。然而,这些方法在使用低成本逐层量化器将SR模型量化到超低精度(如2位和3位)时,会遭受严重的性能退化。本文识别出性能下降源于逐层对称量化器与SR模型中高度非对称激活分布之间的矛盾。这种差异会导致量化等级的浪费或重建图像的细节损失。因此,我们提出了一种新型的激活量化器,称为动态双可训练边界(DDTB),以适应激活的非对称性。具体而言,DDTB的创新点包括:1)采用可训练上下界逐层量化器以应对高度非对称激活;2)动态门控控制器在运行时自适应调整上下界,以克服不同样本间激活范围的剧烈变化。为减少额外开销,动态门控控制器被量化为2位,并根据引入的动态强度仅应用于SR网络的部分区域。大量实验表明,我们的DDTB在超低精度下表现出显著的性能提升。例如,当将EDSR量化为2位并放大输出图像至x4时,在Urban100基准测试中PSNR提升了0.70dB。
abstract_en: Light-weight super-resolution (SR) models have received considerable attention for their serviceability in mobile devices. Many efforts employ network quantization to compress SR models. However, these methods suffer from severe performance degradation when quantizing the SR models to ultra-low precision (e.g., 2-bit and 3-bit) with the low-cost layer-wise quantizer. In this paper, we identify that the performance drop comes from the contradiction between the layer-wise symmetric quantizer and the highly asymmetric activation distribution in SR models. This discrepancy leads to either a waste on the quantization levels or detail loss in reconstructed images. Therefore, we propose a novel activation quantizer, referred to as Dynamic Dual Trainable Bounds (DDTB), to accommodate the asymmetry of the activations. Specifically, DDTB innovates in: 1) A layer-wise quantizer with trainable upper and lower bounds to tackle the highly asymmetric activations. 2) A dynamic gate controller to adaptively adjust the upper and lower bounds at runtime to overcome the drastically varying activation ranges over different samples. To reduce the extra overhead, the dynamic gate controller is quantized to 2-bit and applied to only part of the SR networks according to the introduced dynamic intensity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our DDTB exhibits significant performance improvements in ultra-low precision. For example, our DDTB achieves a 0.70dB PSNR increase on Urban100 benchmark when quantizing EDSR to 2-bit and scaling up output images to x4.

title: Yunsheng Li, Yinpeng Chen, Xiyang Dai, Dongdong Chen, Mengchen Liu, Pei Yu, Ying Jin, Lu Yuan, Zicheng Liu, Nuno Vasconcelos
title_en: Yunsheng Li, Yinpeng Chen, Xiyang Dai, Dongdong Chen, Mengchen Liu, Pei Yu, Ying Jin, Lu Yuan, Zicheng Liu, Nuno Vasconcelos
abstract: 目标检测器的复杂度-精度权衡是资源受限视觉任务中的关键问题。先前的研究强调了使用高效主干网络实现的检测器。本文研究了检测头中提议处理对这一权衡的影响。假设提升检测效率需要向不平等处理提议的范式转变,即对优质提议分配更多计算资源,而非劣质提议。这能更高效地利用可用计算预算,在相同FLOPS下实现更高精度。我们将此建模为一个学习问题,目标是在检测头中为提议分配运算符,使总计算成本受限且精度最大化。关键发现是,这种匹配可学习为一个函数,将每个提议嵌入映射到运算符的one-hot编码。尽管该函数诱导了复杂的动态网络路由机制,但可通过简单MLP实现,并与现成的目标检测器端到端学习。实验表明,这种动态提议处理(DPP)在给定计算复杂度下,显著优于最先进的端到端目标检测器(DETR、Sparse R-CNN)。
abstract_en: The complexity-precision trade-off of an object detector is a critical problem for resource constrained vision tasks. Previous works have emphasized detectors implemented with efficient backbones. The impact on this trade-off of proposal processing by the detection head is investigated in this work. It is hypothesized that improved detection efficiency requires a paradigm shift, towards the unequal processing of proposals, assigning more computation to good proposals than poor ones. This results in better utilization of available computational budget, enabling higher accuracy for the same FLOPS. We formulate this as a learning problem where the goal is to assign operators to proposals, in the detection head, so that the total computational cost is constrained and the precision is maximized. The key finding is that such matching can be learned as a function that maps each proposal embedding into a one-hot code over operators. While this function induces a complex dynamic network routing mechanism, it can be implemented by a simple MLP and learned end-to-end with off-the-shelf object detectors. This it dynamic proposal processing (DPP) is shown to outperform state-of-the-art end-to-end object detectors (DETR, Sparse R-CNN) by a clear margin for a given computational complexity.

title: Yunsheng Pang, Qiuhong Ke, Hossein Rahmani, James Bailey, Jun Liu
title_en: Yunsheng Pang, Qiuhong Ke, Hossein Rahmani, James Bailey, Jun Liu
abstract: 人体交互识别在许多应用中具有重要意义。在识别交互过程中,一个关键线索是交互的身体部位。在本文中,我们提出了一种新颖的交互图变换器(Interaction Graph Transformer,IGFormer)网络,通过将交互身体部位建模为图来进行基于骨架的交互识别。更具体地说,所提出的IGFormer根据交互身体部位之间的语义和距离相关性构建交互图,并通过基于学习到的图聚合交互身体部位的信息来增强每个人的表现。此外,我们提出了一种语义分区模块,将每个人体骨架序列转换为身体部位-时间序列,以更好地捕捉骨架序列的空间和时间信息,从而学习图结构。在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的模型在显著程度上优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Human interaction recognition is very important in many applications. One crucial cue in recognizing an interaction is the interactive body parts. In this work, we propose a novel Interaction Graph Transformer (IGFormer) network for skeleton-based interaction recognition via modeling the interactive body parts as graphs. More specifically, the proposed IGFormer constructs interaction graphs according to the semantic and distance correlations between the interactive body parts, and enhances the representation of each person by aggregating the information of the interactive body parts based on the learned graphs. Furthermore, we propose a Semantic Partition Module to transform each human skeleton sequence into a Body-Part-Time sequence to better capture the spatial and temporal information of the skeleton sequence for learning the graphs. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that our model outperforms the state-of-the-art with a significant margin.

title: 周云文、阿比什克·卡、埃里克·特纳、阿达尔什·库沃尔、郭晓晨、瑞安·C·杜托伊特、康斯坦丁·佐索斯
title_en: Yunwen Zhou, Abhishek Kar, Eric Turner, Adarsh Kowdle, Chao X. Guo, Ryan C. DuToit, Konstantine Tsotsos
abstract: 视觉惯性里程计(VIO)是当前大多数增强现实/虚拟现实(AR/VR)和自主机器人系统(在学术界和工业界)的位姿估计核心。然而,这些系统对关键参数(如传感器偏差、重力方向和度量尺度)的初始化高度敏感。在实际场景中,当高视差或可变加速度假设很少满足时(例如,悬停的空中机器人、智能手机AR用户未用手机做手势),经典视觉惯性初始化公式通常会变得病态或无法有意义地收敛。在本文中,我们专门针对这些对野外使用至关重要的低激发场景进行视觉惯性初始化。我们提出通过引入一种新的基于学习的测量作为更高层次的输入,来规避经典视觉惯性结构从运动(SfM)初始化的限制。我们利用学习到的单目深度图像(mono-depth)来约束特征的相对深度,并通过联合优化其尺度和偏移量,将单目深度升级为度量尺度。我们的实验表明,与经典视觉惯性初始化公式相比,问题条件得到了显著改善,并在公共基准测试中相对于最先进的方法展示了显著的精度和鲁棒性提升,特别是在低激发场景下。我们进一步将这一改进扩展到现有里程计系统的实现中,以说明我们的改进初始化方法对结果跟踪轨迹的影响。
abstract_en: Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) is the pose estimation backbone for most AR/VR and autonomous robotic systems today, in both academia and industry. However, these systems are highly sensitive to the initialization of key parameters such as sensor biases, gravity direction, and metric scale.
