abstract: 创建和编辑3D对象的形状和颜色需要大量的人力和专业知识。与直接在3D界面中操作相比,二维交互(如草图和涂鸦)通常对用户来说更加自然和直观。在本文中,我们提出了一种通用的多模态生成模型,通过共享的潜在空间将二维模态与隐式3D表示耦合。通过该模型,只需将编辑从特定的二维控制模态通过潜在空间传播,即可实现多功能的3D生成和操作。例如,通过绘制草图编辑3D形状,通过在二维渲染上绘制彩色涂鸦重新着色3D表面,或根据一个或几个参考图像生成特定类别的3D形状。与以往的工作不同,我们的模型不需要为每个编辑任务重新训练或微调,并且在概念上简单,易于实现,对输入域变化具有鲁棒性,并且能够灵活地在部分二维输入上进行多样化重建。我们在两种代表性的二维模态(灰度线草图和渲染彩色图像)上评估了我们的框架,并展示了我们的方法如何利用这些二维模态实现各种形状操作和生成任务。
abstract_en: Creating and editing the shape and color of 3D objects require tremendous human effort and expertise. Compared to direct manipulation in 3D interfaces, 2D interactions such as sketches and scribbles are usually much more natural and intuitive for the users. In this paper, we propose a generic multi-modal generative model that couples the 2D modalities and implicit 3D representations through shared latent spaces. With the proposed model, versatile 3D generation and manipulation are enabled by simply propagating the editing from a specific 2D controlling modality through the latent spaces. For example, editing the 3D shape by drawing a sketch, re-colorizing the 3D surface via painting color scribbles on the 2D rendering, or generating 3D shapes of a certain category given one or a few reference images. Unlike prior works, our model does not require re-training or fine-tuning per editing task and is also conceptually simple, easy to implement, robust to input domain shifts, and flexible to diverse reconstruction on partial 2D inputs. We evaluate our framework on two representative 2D modalities of grayscale line sketches and rendered color images, and demonstrate that our method enables various shape manipulation and generation tasks with these 2D modalities.

title: 黄展博, 刘金源, 范欣, 刘日升, 钟伟, 罗中轩
title_en: Zhanbo Huang, Jinyuan Liu, Xin Fan, Risheng Liu, Wei Zhong, Zhongxuan Luo
abstract: 近年来,深度网络在红外与可见光图像融合(IVIF)领域取得了显著进展。然而,大多数现有方法无法有效处理源图像的轻微错位问题,并且存在较高的计算和空间复杂度。本文通过开发一种用于鲁棒且高效融合的循环校正网络(ReCoNet),解决了社区中鲜有涉及的这两个关键问题。具体而言,我们设计了变形模块以显式补偿几何失真,并引入注意力机制以缓解鬼影类伪影。同时,网络包含并行空洞卷积层,并以循环方式运行,显著降低了空间和计算复杂度。ReCoNet能够有效缓解轻微错位带来的结构失真和纹理伪影。在两个公开数据集上的大量实验验证了ReCoNet相较于现有IVIF方法在准确性和有效性上的优越性。实验结果表明,在存在错位的数据集上,ReCoNet的CC值相对提升16%,效率提升86%。源代码可在https://github.com/dlut-dimt/reconet获取。
abstract_en: Recent advances in deep networks have gained great attention in infrared and visible image fusion (IVIF). Nevertheless, most existing methods are incapable of dealing with slight misalignment on source images and suffer from high computational and spatial expenses. This paper tackles these two critical issues rarely touched in the community by developing a recurrent correction network for robust and efficient fusion, namely ReCoNet. Concretely, we design a deformation module to explicitly compensate geometrical distortions and an attention mechanism to mitigate ghosting-like artifacts, respectively. Meanwhile, the network consists of a parallel dilated convolutional layer and runs in a recurrent fashion, significantly reducing both spatial and computational complexities. ReCoNet can effectively and efficiently alleviates both structural distortions and textural artifacts brought by slight misalignment. Extensive experiments on two public datasets demonstrate the superior accuracy and efficacy of our ReCoNet against the state-of-the-art IVIF methods. Consequently, we obtain a 16% relative improvement of CC on datasets with misalignment and boost the efficiency by 86%. The source code is available at https://github.com/dlut-dimt/reconet.

title: Zhanghan Ke, Chunyi Sun, Lei Zhu, Ke Xu, Rynson W.H. Lau
title_en: Zhanghan Ke, Chunyi Sun, Lei Zhu, Ke Xu, Rynson W.H. Lau
abstract: 近期关于图像和谐化的研究将该问题视为像素级图像翻译任务,通过大规模自编码器进行求解。然而在处理高分辨率图像时,这些方法在性能和推理速度方面均不理想。本文观察到,通过调整基础图像滤波器的输入参数(如亮度和对比度),人类即可从合成图像生成逼真图像。因此,我们将图像和谐化问题建模为图像级回归任务,以学习人类用于该任务的滤波器参数。我们提出了一种名为Harmonizer的框架用于图像和谐化。与基于黑盒自编码器的先前方法不同,Harmonizer包含一个用于预测滤波器参数的神经网络,以及多个基于预测参数的白盒滤波器(white-box filters)用于图像和谐化。我们还引入了级联回归器和动态损失策略,以更稳定精确地学习滤波器参数。由于我们的网络仅输出图像级参数且所用滤波器效率较高,Harmonizer在参数量和推理速度上均显著优于现有方法。综合实验表明,Harmonizer在高分辨率输入上显著超越现有方法。最后,我们将Harmonizer应用于视频和谐化,实现了帧间一致的输出效果,并在1080P分辨率下达到56fps的处理速度。
abstract_en: Recent works on image harmonization solve the problem as a pixel-wise image translation task via large autoencoders. They have unsatisfactory performances and slow inference speeds when dealing with high-resolution images. In this work, we observe that adjusting the input arguments of basic image filters, e.g., brightness and contrast, is sufficient for humans to produce realistic images from the composite ones. Hence, we frame image harmonization as an image-level regression problem to learn the arguments of the filters that humans use for the task. We present a Harmonizer framework for image harmonization. Unlike prior methods that are based on black-box autoencoders, Harmonizer contains a neural network for filter argument prediction and several white-box filters (based on the predicted arguments) for image harmonization. We also introduce a cascade regressor and a dynamic loss strategy for Harmonizer to learn filter arguments more stably and precisely. Since our network only outputs image-level arguments and the filters we used are efficient, Harmonizer is much lighter and faster than existing methods. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that Harmonizer surpasses existing methods notably, especially with high-resolution inputs. Finally, we apply Harmonizer to video harmonization, which achieves consistent results across frames and 56 fps at 1080P resolution.

title: Zhanghao Sun, Jian Wang, Yicheng Wu, Shree Nayar
title_en: Zhanghao Sun, Jian Wang, Yicheng Wu, Shree Nayar
abstract: 闪光照明广泛应用于低光环境下的成像。然而,照明强度随传播距离平方衰减,这给远距离闪光成像带来了显著挑战。我们提出了一种新的闪光技术,称为“图案化闪光”,用于远距离闪光成像。图案化闪光将光学功率集中于点阵中。与传统均匀闪光中信号被噪声全面淹没的情况相比,图案化闪光在视野中稀疏分布的点上提供更强的信号,确保这些点的信号能够从传感器噪声中脱颖而出。这使得后处理能够识别重要物体和细节。此外,图案化闪光将纹理投射到场景中,可被视为用于深度感知的结构光系统。基于该新型系统,我们开发了一种结合图像重建和深度估计的卷积神经网络算法。我们构建了硬件原型,并在各种场景中测试了所提出的闪光技术。实验结果表明,我们的图案化闪光在低光环境下的远距离性能显著优于现有技术。我们的代码和数据已公开。
abstract_en: Flash illumination is widely used in imaging under low-light environments. However, illumination intensity falls off with propagation distance quadratically, which poses significant challenges for flash imaging at a long distance. We propose a new flash technique, named “patterned flash”, for flash imaging at a long distance. Patterned flash concentrates optical power into a dot array. Compared with the conventional uniform flash where the signal is overwhelmed by the noise everywhere, patterned flash provides stronger signals at sparsely distributed points across the field of view to ensure the signals at those points stand out from the sensor noise. This enables post-processing to resolve important objects and details. Additionally, the patterned flash projects texture onto the scene, which can be treated as a structured light system for depth perception. Given the novel system, we develop a joint image reconstruction and depth estimation algorithm with a convolutional neural network. We build a hardware prototype and test the proposed flash technique on various scenes. The experimental results demonstrate that our patterned flash has significantly better performance at long distances in low-light environments. Our code and data are publicly available.

title: 杨展元,王静华,朱英英
title_en: Zhanyuan Yang, Jinghua Wang, Yingying Zhu
abstract: 一种包含顺序预训练和元训练阶段的两阶段训练范式在当前少样本学习(FSL)研究中被广泛应用。许多方法采用自监督学习和对比学习以取得新的最先进结果。然而,对比学习在FSL训练范式的两个阶段中的潜力仍未被充分挖掘。本文提出了一种基于对比学习的新框架,无缝地将对比学习整合到两个阶段中以提升少样本分类性能。在预训练阶段,我们提出了一种自监督对比损失,形式为特征向量与特征图、特征图与特征图之间的对比,利用全局和局部信息学习良好的初始表示。在元训练阶段,我们提出了一种跨视图小样本训练机制,对同一小样本的两个不同视图执行最近质心分类,并基于此采用距离缩放对比损失。这两种策略迫使模型克服视图间的偏差,促进表示的可迁移性。在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法取得了具有竞争力的结果。
abstract_en: A two-stage training paradigm consisting of sequential pre-training and meta-training stages has been widely used in current few-shot learning (FSL) research. Many of these methods use self-supervised learning and contrastive learning to achieve new state-of-the-art results. However, the potential of contrastive learning in both stages of FSL training paradigm is still not fully exploited. In this paper, we propose a novel contrastive learning-based framework that seamlessly integrates contrastive learning into both stages to improve the performance of few-shot classification. In the pre-training stage, we propose a self-supervised contrastive loss in the forms of feature vector vs. feature map and feature map vs. feature map, which uses global and local information to learn good initial representations. In the meta-training stage, we propose a cross-view episodic training mechanism to perform the nearest centroid classification on two different views of the same episode and adopt a distance-scaled contrastive loss based on them. These two strategies force the model to overcome the bias between views and promote the transferability of representations. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method achieves competitive results.

title: Zhaodong Sun, Xiaobai Li
title_en: Zhaodong Sun, Xiaobai Li
abstract: 基于视频的远程生理测量利用面部视频测量血容量变化信号,也称为远程光电容积描记法(rPPG)。监督方法在rPPG测量中取得了最先进的性能。然而,监督rPPG方法需要面部视频和真实生理信号进行模型训练。本文提出了一种无需真实信号的无监督rPPG测量方法。我们使用3DCNN模型从每个视频的不同时空位置生成多个rPPG信号,并通过对比损失进行训练,其中同一视频的rPPG信号被拉近,不同视频的rPPG信号被推开。我们在五个公开数据集上进行测试,包括RGB视频和NIR视频。结果表明,我们的方法优于之前的无监督基线方法,在所有五个数据集上均达到接近当前最佳监督rPPG方法的精度。此外,我们还证明了我们的方法运行速度更快,对噪声的鲁棒性更强。我们的代码可在https://github.com/zhaodongsun/contrast-phys获取。
abstract_en: Video-based remote physiological measurement utilizes face videos to measure the blood volume change signal, which is also called remote photoplethysmography (rPPG). Supervised methods for rPPG measurements achieve state-of-the-art performance. However, supervised rPPG methods require face videos and ground truth physiological signals for model training. In this paper, we propose an unsupervised rPPG measurement method that does not require ground truth signals for training. We use a 3DCNN model to generate multiple rPPG signals from each video in different spatiotemporal locations and train the model with a contrastive loss where rPPG signals from the same video are pulled together while those from different videos are pushed away. We test on five public datasets, including RGB videos and NIR videos. The results show that our method outperforms the previous unsupervised baseline and achieves accuracies very close to the current best supervised rPPG methods on all five datasets. Furthermore, we also demonstrate that our approach can run at a much faster speed and is more robust to noises than the previous unsupervised baseline. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhaodongsun/contrast-phys.

title: Zhaofan Qiu, Yehao Li, Yu Wang, Yingwei Pan, Ting Yao, Tao Mei
title_en: Zhaofan Qiu, Yehao Li, Yu Wang, Yingwei Pan, Ting Yao, Tao Mei
abstract: 本文提出了一种专为3D点云应用设计的新型深度架构,命名为SPE-Net。嵌入的"选择性位置编码(SPE)"过程依赖于一种注意力机制,该机制能够有效关注输入的底层旋转条件。这种编码的旋转条件随后决定了网络参数中应重点关注的部分,并被证明在训练过程中能有效降低优化的自由度。该机制因此能通过降低训练难度更好地利用旋转增强,使SPE-Net在训练和测试阶段均对旋转数据具有鲁棒性。本文的新发现也促使我们重新思考提取的旋转信息与实际测试准确率之间的关系。引人注目的是,我们揭示了通过SPE-Net局部编码旋转信息,即使没有实际全局旋转,旋转不变特征对测试样本仍具有关键作用。我们在四个基准数据集上实证展示了SPE-Net及其相关假设的优势,结果显示在旋转和非旋转测试数据上均显著优于现有最先进方法。源代码可在https://github.com/ZhaofanQiu/SPE-Net获取。
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a novel deep architecture tailored for 3D point cloud applications, named as SPE-Net. The embedded ""Selective Position Encoding (SPE)"" procedure relies on an attention mechanism that can effectively attend to the underlying rotation condition of the input. Such encoded rotation condition then determines which part of the network parameters to be focused on, and is shown to efficiently help reduce the degree of freedom of the optimization during training. This mechanism henceforth can better leverage the rotation augmentations through reduced training difficulties, making SPE-Net robust against rotated data both during training and testing. The new findings in our paper also urge us to rethink the relationship between the extracted rotation information and the actual test accuracy. Intriguingly, we reveal evidences that by locally encoding the rotation information through SPE-Net, the rotation-invariant features are still of critical importance in benefiting the test samples without any actual global rotation. We empirically demonstrate the merits of the SPE-Net and the associated hypothesis on four benchmarks, showing evident improvements on both rotated and unrotated test data over SOTA methods. Source code is available at https://github.com/ZhaofanQiu/SPE-Net.

title: Zhaoning Sun, Nico Messikommer, Daniel Gehrig, Davide Scaramuzza
title_en: Zhaoning Sun, Nico Messikommer, Daniel Gehrig, Davide Scaramuzza
abstract: 在高动态范围(HDR)和高速条件下准确获取语义信息仍然是基于图像的算法面临的开放性挑战,由于严重的图像退化现象。事件相机有望解决这些挑战,因为它们具有更高的动态范围,并且对运动模糊具有鲁棒性。然而,基于事件的语义分割仍处于初级阶段,这主要是由于缺乏高质量的标注数据集。在本文中,我们引入ESS(基于事件的语义分割),通过无监督域适应(UDA)直接将现有标注图像数据集中的语义分割任务转移到未标注的事件数据上。与现有UDA方法相比,我们的方法对循环、运动不变的事件嵌入与图像嵌入进行对齐。因此,我们的方法不需要视频数据,也不需要图像与事件之间的逐像素对齐,而且关键的是,无需从静态图像中生成运动。此外,我们引入了DSEC-Semantic,这是首个具有细粒度标注的大规模基于事件的数据集。我们证明,仅使用图像标签,ESS优于现有UDA方法;当结合事件标签时,它甚至在DDD17和DSEC-Semantic上超越了最先进的监督方法。最后,ESS具有通用性,这释放了大量现有的标注图像数据集,并为事件相机之前无法进入的新领域开辟了新的研究方向。
abstract_en: Retrieving accurate semantic information in challenging high dynamic range (HDR) and high-speed conditions remains an open challenge for image-based algorithms due to severe image degradations. Event cameras promise to address these challenges since they feature a much higher dynamic range and are resilient to motion blur. Nonetheless, semantic segmentation with event cameras is still in its infancy which is chiefly due to the lack of high-quality, labeled datasets. In this work, we introduce ESS (Event-based Semantic Segmentation), which tackles this problem by directly transferring the semantic segmentation task from existing labeled image datasets to unlabeled events via unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA). Compared to existing UDA methods, our approach aligns recurrent, motion-invariant event embeddings with image embeddings. For this reason, our method neither requires video data nor per-pixel alignment between images and events and, crucially, does not need to hallucinate motion from still images. Additionally, we introduce DSEC-Semantic, the first large-scale event-based dataset with fine-grained labels. We show that using image labels alone, ESS outperforms existing UDA approaches, and when combined with event labels, it even outperforms state-of-the-art supervised approaches on both DDD17 and DSEC-Semantic. Finally, ESS is general-purpose, which unlocks the vast amount of existing labeled image datasets and paves the way for new and exciting research directions in new fields previously inaccessible for event cameras.

title: Zhaopeng Dou, Zhongdao Wang, Weihua Chen, Yali Li, Shengjin Wang
title_en: Zhaopeng Dou, Zhongdao Wang, Weihua Chen, Yali Li, Shengjin Wang
abstract: 当前的人像图像检索方法在准确率指标上取得了显著提升。然而,它们很少描述预测的可靠性。本文提出了一种不确定性感知学习(UAL)方法来解决这一问题。UAL旨在通过同时考虑数据不确定性和模型不确定性,提供可靠性感知的预测。数据不确定性捕捉样本中固有的“噪声”,而模型不确定性描述模型对样本预测的置信度。具体而言,在UAL中,(1) 我们提出了一种无需采样的数据不确定性学习方法,在训练过程中自适应地为不同样本分配权重,降低低质量模糊样本的权重;(2) 我们利用贝叶斯框架通过假设网络参数服从伯努利分布来建模模型不确定性;(3) 数据不确定性与模型不确定性在统一网络中联合学习,二者作为可靠性评估的两个基本标准:如果探针是高质量的(低数据不确定性)且模型对探针的预测有信心(低模型不确定性),则最终排名将被视为可靠。在风险控制设置和多查询设置下的实验表明,所提出的可靠性评估是有效的。我们的方法在三种具有挑战性的基准数据集上也表现出优越的性能,且在常规单查询设置下表现优异。代码已开源:https://github.com/dcp15/UAL
abstract_en: Current person image retrieval methods have achieved great improvements in accuracy metrics. However, they rarely describe the reliability of the prediction. In this paper, we propose an Uncertainty-Aware Learning (UAL) method to remedy this issue. UAL aims at providing reliability-aware predictions by considering data uncertainty and model uncertainty simultaneously. Data uncertainty captures the “noise” inherent in the sample, while model uncertainty depicts the model’s confidence in the sample’s prediction. Specifically, in UAL, (1) we propose a sampling-free data uncertainty learning method to adaptively assign weights to different samples during training, down-weighting the low-quality ambiguous samples. (2) we leverage the Bayesian framework to model the model uncertainty by assuming the parameters of the network follow a Bernoulli distribution. (3) the data uncertainty and the model uncertainty are jointly learned in a unified network, and they serve as two fundamental criteria for the reliability assessment: if a probe is high-quality (low data uncertainty) and the model is confident in the prediction of the probe (low model uncertainty), the final ranking will be assessed as reliable. Experiments under the risk-controlled settings and the multi-query settings show the proposed reliability assessment is effective. Our method also shows superior performance on three challenging benchmarks under the vanilla single query settings. The code is available at: https://github.com/dcp15/UAL

title: Zhaoqi Leng, Shuyang Cheng, Benjamin Caine, Weiyue Wang, Xiao Zhang, Jonathon Shlens, Mingxing Tan, Dragomir Anguelov
title_en: Zhaoqi Leng, Shuyang Cheng, Benjamin Caine, Weiyue Wang, Xiao Zhang, Jonathon Shlens, Mingxing Tan, Dragomir Anguelov
abstract: 数据增强是一种重要的技术,用于提高点云中三维检测的数据效率并节省标注成本。然而,现有的增强策略迄今为止仅设计用于利用带标签数据,这限制了数据多样性。在本文中,我们认识到伪标签和数据增强是互补的,因此提出利用未标记数据进行数据增强以丰富训练数据。具体而言,我们设计了三种基于伪标签的数据增强策略(PseudoAugments),以融合带标签和伪标签的场景,包括帧(PseudoFrame)、物体(PseudoBBox)和背景(PseudoBackground)。PseudoAugments通过减轻伪标签错误并生成多样化的融合训练场景,优于伪标签方法。我们证明PseudoAugments在基于点和基于体素的架构、不同模型容量以及KITTI和Waymo Open Dataset上均具有泛化能力。为缓解超参数调优和迭代伪标签的成本,我们开发了一种基于种群的数据增强框架,名为AutoPseudoAugment。与之前离线进行伪标签的文献不同,我们的框架通过一次完成PseudoAugments和超参数调优,以降低计算成本。在大规模Waymo Open Dataset上的实验结果表明,我们的方法优于最先进的自动数据增强方法(PPBA)和自训练方法(伪标签)。特别是,AutoPseudoAugment在车辆和行人任务上比现有方法分别高效3倍和2倍。值得注意的是,AutoPseudoAugment在车辆检测任务中仅使用10%的带标签运行片段即可接近完整数据集训练结果。
abstract_en: Data augmentation is an important technique to improve data efficiency and to save labeling cost for 3D detection in point clouds. Yet, existing augmentation policies have so far been designed to only utilize labeled data, which limits the data diversity. In this paper, we recognize that pseudo labeling and data augmentation are complementary, thus propose to leverage unlabeled data for data augmentation to enrich the training data. In particular, we design three novel pseudo-label based data augmentation policies (PseudoAugments) to fuse both labeled and pseudo-labeled scenes, including frames (PseudoFrame), objects (PseudoBBox), and background (PseudoBackground). PseudoAugments outperforms pseudo labeling by mitigating pseudo labeling errors and generating diverse fused training scenes. We demonstrate PseudoAugments generalize across point-based and voxel-based architectures, different model capacity and both KITTI and Waymo Open Dataset. To alleviate the cost of hyperparameter tuning and iterative pseudo labeling, we develop a population-based data augmentation framework for 3D detection, named AutoPseudoAugment. Unlike previous works that perform pseudo-labeling offline, our framework performs PseudoAugments and hyperparameter tuning in one shot to reduce computational cost. Experimental results on the large-scale Waymo Open Dataset show our method outperforms state-of-the-art auto data augmentation method (PPBA) and self-training method (pseudo labeling). In particular, AutoPseudoAugment is about 3X and 2X data efficient on vehicle and pedestrian tasks compared to prior arts. Notably, AutoPseudoAugment nearly matches the full dataset training results, with just 10% of the labeled run segments on the vehicle detection task.

title: Zhaowei Cai, Gukyeong Kwon, Avinash Ravichandran, Erhan Bas, Zhuowen Tu, Rahul Bhotika, Stefano Soatto
title_en: Zhaowei Cai, Gukyeong Kwon, Avinash Ravichandran, Erhan Bas, Zhuowen Tu, Rahul Bhotika, Stefano Soatto
abstract: 本文研究了具有挑战性的实例级视觉-语言任务,其中自由形式语言需要与对象对齐而非整个图像。为解决这些任务,我们提出X-DETR架构,其包含三个主要组件:目标检测器、语言编码器和视觉-语言对齐模块。视觉和语言流在最终阶段之前保持独立,并通过高效的点积操作进行对齐。整个网络采用端到端训练方式,使得检测器针对视觉-语言任务进行优化而非使用现成组件。为克服配对对象-语言注释的有限规模,我们利用其他弱监督类型扩展知识覆盖范围。X-DETR简单而有效的架构在多种实例级视觉-语言任务中表现出良好的准确性和快速速度,例如在不使用任何LVIS注释训练的情况下,于1.2K类别LVIS检测任务中达到16.4 AP,速度达20帧/秒。代码已开源至https://github.com/amazon-research/cross-modal-detr。
abstract_en: In this paper, we study the challenging instance-wise vision-language tasks, where the free-form language is required to align with the objects instead of the whole image. To address these tasks, we propose X-DETR, whose architecture has three major components: an object detector, a language encoder, and vision-language alignment. The vision and language streams are independent until the end and they are aligned using an efficient dot-product operation. The whole network is trained end-to-end, such that the detector is optimized for the vision-language tasks instead of an off-the-shelf component. To overcome the limited size of paired object-language annotations, we leverage other weak types of supervision to expand the knowledge coverage. This simple yet effective architecture of X-DETR shows good accuracy and fast speeds for multiple instance-wise vision-language tasks, e.g., 16.4 AP on LVIS detection of 1.2K categories at 20 frames per second without using any LVIS annotation during training. The code is available at https://github.com/amazon-research/cross-modal-detr.

title: 人体重光照是一项高度理想但具有挑战性的任务
title_en: Zhaoxi Chen, Ziwei Liu
abstract: 人体重光照是一项高度理想但具有挑战性的任务。现有方法要么需要使用光照舞台捕获的昂贵逐光捕获(OLAT)数据,要么无法自由改变渲染人体的视角。在本文中,我们提出了一种原理性框架Relighting4D,该框架能够在未知光照条件下仅通过人体视频实现自由视角重光照。我们的核心洞察是,人体在时空变化的几何形状和反射率可以分解为法线图、遮挡图、漫反射图和镜面图的神经场集合。这些神经场进一步整合到基于物理的反射感知渲染中,其中神经场中的每个顶点吸收并反射环境光。整个框架可以通过物理信息引导的先验设计进行自监督学习,以实现对动态人体演员的自由视角重光照。代码可在https://github.com/FrozenBurning/Relighting4D获取。
abstract_en: Human relighting is a highly desirable yet challenging task. Existing works either require expensive one-light-at-a-time (OLAT) captured data using light stage or cannot freely change the viewpoints of the rendered body. In this work, we propose a principled framework, Relighting4D, that enables free-viewpoints relighting from only human videos under unknown illuminations. Our key insight is that the space-time varying geometry and reflectance of the human body can be decomposed as a set of neural fields of normal, occlusion, diffuse, and specular maps. These neural fields are further integrated into reflectance-aware physically based rendering, where each vertex in the neural field absorbs and reflects the light from the environment. The whole framework can be learned from videos in a self-supervised manner, with physically informed priors designed for regularization. Extensive experiments on both real and synthetic datasets demonstrate that our framework is capable of relighting dynamic human actors with free-viewpoints. Codes are available at https://github.com/FrozenBurning/Relighting4D.

title: Zhaoxin Fan, Zhenbo Song, Jian Xu, Zhicheng Wang, Kejian Wu, Hongyan Liu, Jun He
title_en: Zhaoxin Fan, Zhenbo Song, Jian Xu, Zhicheng Wang, Kejian Wu, Hongyan Liu, Jun He
abstract: 近年来,基于RGBD的类别级6自由度物体姿态估计在性能上取得了显著提升,然而深度信息的依赖限制了其更广泛的应用。为缓解这一问题,本文提出了一种名为Object Level Depth reconstruction Network(OLD-Net)的新方法,仅以RGB图像作为输入进行类别级6自由度物体姿态估计。我们提出通过将类别级形状先验变形为物体级深度,并结合规范化的NOCS表示,直接从单目RGB图像中预测物体级深度。引入了两个新型模块:归一化全局位置提示(Normalized Global Position Hints, NGPH)和形状感知的解耦深度重建模块(Shape-aware Decoupled Depth Reconstruction, SDDR),以学习高保真度的物体级深度和精细的形状表示。最后,通过将预测的规范表示与反投影的物体级深度对齐,求解6自由度物体姿态。在具有挑战性的CAMERA25和REAL275数据集上的大量实验表明,尽管模型结构简单,我们的方法在性能上达到了最先进水平。
abstract_en: Recently, RGBD-based category-level 6D object pose estimation has achieved promising improvement in performance, however, the requirement of depth information prohibits broader applications. In order to relieve this problem, this paper proposes a novel approach named Object Level Depth reconstruction Network (OLD-Net) taking only RGB images as input for category-level 6D object pose estimation. We propose to directly predict object-level depth from a monocular RGB image by deforming the category-level shape prior into object-level depth and the canonical NOCS representation. Two novel modules named Normalized Global Position Hints (NGPH) and Shape-aware Decoupled Depth Reconstruction (SDDR) module are introduced to learn high fidelity object-level depth and delicate shape representations. At last, the 6D object pose is solved by aligning the predicted canonical representation with the back-projected object-level depth. Extensive experiments on the challenging CAMERA25 and REAL275 datasets indicate that our model, though simple, achieves state-of-the-art performance.

title: Zhaoyang Huang, Xiaoyu Shi, Chao Zhang, Qiang Wang, Ka Chun Cheung, Hongwei Qin, Jifeng Dai, Hongsheng Li
title_en: Zhaoyang Huang, Xiaoyu Shi, Chao Zhang, Qiang Wang, Ka Chun Cheung, Hongwei Qin, Jifeng Dai, Hongsheng Li
abstract: 我们引入了一种基于Transformer的神经网络架构,称为FlowFormer,用于学习光流。FlowFormer将由图像对构建的4D代价体进行分词,通过新颖的潜在空间中的交替组Transformer(AGT)层将代价分词编码为代价记忆,并通过具有动态位置代价查询的循环Transformer解码器解码代价记忆。在Sintel基准测试中,FlowFormer在干净通道和最终通道上分别实现了1.144和2.183的平均端点误差(AEPE),比最佳发表结果(1.388和2.47)分别减少了17.6%和11.6%。此外,FlowFormer还表现出强大的泛化性能。无需在Sintel上进行训练,FlowFormer在Sintel训练集的干净通道上实现了0.95 AEPE,优于最佳发表结果(1.29)26.9%。
abstract_en: We introduce optical Flow transFormer, dubbed as FlowFormer, a transformer-based neural network architecture for learning optical flow. FlowFormer tokenizes the 4D cost volume built from an image pair, encodes the cost tokens into a cost memory with alternate-group transformer (AGT) layers in a novel latent space, and decodes the cost memory via a recurrent transformer decoder with dynamic positional cost queries. On the Sintel benchmark, FlowFormer achieves 1.144 and 2.183 average end-ponit-error (AEPE) on the clean and final pass, a 17.6% and 11.6% error reduction from the best published result (1.388 and 2.47). Besides, FlowFormer also achieves strong generalization performance. Without being trained on Sintel, FlowFormer achieves 0.95 AEPE on the Sintel training set clean pass, outperforming the best published result (1.29) by 26.9%.

title: Zhaoyu Chen, Bo Li, Shuang Wu, Jianghe Xu, Shouhong Ding, Wenqiang Zhang
title_en: Zhaoyu Chen, Bo Li, Shuang Wu, Jianghe Xu, Shouhong Ding, Wenqiang Zhang
abstract: 尽管深度神经网络(DNNs)在计算机视觉领域表现出色,但它们容易受到精心设计的对抗样本的攻击,这些样本可能导致DNNs产生错误输出。贴片攻击是其中最具威胁性的一种形式,可能危及现实世界系统的安全性。以往的研究通常假设贴片具有固定形状,如圆形或矩形,并未将贴片形状视为贴片攻击的关键因素。为探讨这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的可变形贴片表示(DPR),能够利用三角形的几何结构,支持轮廓建模与掩码之间的可微映射。此外,我们引入了一种联合优化算法,称为可变形对抗贴片(DAPatch),该算法允许同时高效优化形状和纹理以提升攻击性能。我们证明,即使面积较小,特定形状也能提升攻击性能。因此,DAPatch通过在GTSRB和ILSVRC2012数据集上对不同网络架构进行形状变形,实现了最先进的攻击性能,生成的贴片在现实世界中具有潜在威胁性。
abstract_en: Though deep neural networks (DNNs) have demonstrated excellent performance in computer vision, they are susceptible and vulnerable to carefully crafted adversarial examples which can mislead DNNs to incorrect outputs. Patch attack is one of the most threatening forms, which has the potential to threaten the security of real-world systems. Previous work always assumes patches to have fixed shapes, such as circles or rectangles, and it does not consider the shape of patches as a factor in patch attacks. To explore this issue, we propose a novel Deformable Patch Representation (DPR) that can harness the geometric structure of triangles to support the differentiable mapping between contour modeling and masks. Moreover, we introduce a joint optimization algorithm, named Deformable Adversarial Patch (DAPatch), which allows simultaneous and efficient optimization of shape and texture to enhance attack performance. We show that even with a small area, a particular shape can improve attack performance. Therefore, DAPatch achieves state-of-the-art attack performance by deforming shapes on GTSRB and ILSVRC2012 across various network architectures, and the generated patches can be threatening in the real world.

title: Zhaoyuan Yin, Pichao Wang, Fan Wang, Xianzhe Xu, Hanling Zhang, Hao Li, Rong Jin
title_en: Zhaoyuan Yin, Pichao Wang, Fan Wang, Xianzhe Xu, Hanling Zhang, Hao Li, Rong Jin
abstract: 无监督语义分割旨在无需人工标注的情况下,从低层次视觉特征中获取高层次语义表示。现有大多数方法采用自下而上的方法,通过视觉线索或预定义规则对像素进行分组。因此,这些自下而上的方法在面对包含多个物体且部分物体具有相似视觉外观的复杂场景时,难以生成细粒度语义分割。相比之下,我们提出首个用于极端复杂场景的自上而下无监督语义分割框架,实现细粒度分割。具体而言,我们首先通过自监督学习方式从大规模视觉数据中获取丰富的高层次结构化语义概念信息,并利用此类信息作为先验,发现目标数据集中的潜在语义类别。其次,通过计算特定发现语义表示的类别激活图(CAM),将发现的高层次语义类别映射到低层次像素特征。最后,获得的CAMs作为伪标签用于训练分割模块,生成最终的语义分割结果。在多个语义分割基准数据集上的实验结果表明,我们的自上而下无监督分割方法在不同语义粒度级别设置下,对以物体为中心和场景为中心的数据集均表现出鲁棒性,并优于所有当前最先进的自下而上方法。
abstract_en: Unsupervised semantic segmentation aims to obtain high-level semantic representation on low-level visual features without manual annotations. Most existing methods are bottom-up approaches that try to group pixels into regions based on their visual cues or certain predefined rules. As a result, it is difficult for these bottom-up approaches to generate fine-grained semantic segmentation when coming to complicated scenes with multiple objects and some objects sharing similar visual appearance. In contrast, we propose the first top-down unsupervised semantic segmentation framework for fine-grained segmentation in extremely complicated scenarios. Specifically, we first obtain rich high-level structured semantic concept information from large-scale vision data in a self-supervised learning manner, and use such information as a prior to discover potential semantic categories presented in target datasets. Secondly, the discovered high-level semantic categories are mapped to low-level pixel features by calculating the class activate map (CAM) with respect to certain discovered semantic representation. Lastly, the obtained CAMs serve as pseudo labels to train the segmentation module and produce final semantic segmentation. Experimental results on multiple semantic segmentation benchmarks show that our top-down unsupervised segmentation is robust to both object-centric and scene-centric datasets under different settings of semantic granularity level, and outperforms all the current state-of-the-art bottom-up methods.

title: Zhe Li, Zerong Zheng, Hongwen Zhang, Chaonan Ji, Yebin Liu
title_en: Zhe Li, Zerong Zheng, Hongwen Zhang, Chaonan Ji, Yebin Liu
abstract: 为了解决单目人体体积捕捉中由部分观测导致的病态问题,我们提出了AvatarCap,一个新颖的框架,将可动画化角色模型引入捕捉流程,以实现可见和不可见区域的高保真重建。我们的方法首先从少量(20个)3D扫描数据中创建一个可动画化角色模型作为先验。然后,给定该主体的单目RGB视频,我们的方法结合图像观测和角色先验信息,从而无论可见性如何,都能重建具有动态细节的高保真3D纹理模型。为了从少量样本中学习有效的角色模型用于体积捕捉,我们提出了GeoTexAvatar,该方法通过几何和纹理监督以分解的隐式方式约束姿态依赖的动力学。进一步提出了一种基于角色条件的体积捕捉方法,包含规范法线融合和重建网络,以整合图像观测和角色动力学,实现可见和不可见区域的高保真重建。总体而言,我们的方法实现了单目人体体积捕捉的详细且姿态依赖的动力学,实验表明我们的方法优于现有技术。
abstract_en: To address the ill-posed problem caused by partial observations in monocular human volumetric capture, we present AvatarCap, a novel framework that introduces animatable avatars into the capture pipeline for high-fidelity reconstruction in both visible and invisible regions. Our method firstly creates an animatable avatar for the subject from a small number ( 20) of 3D scans as a prior. Then given a monocular RGB video of this subject, our method integrates information from both the image observation and the avatar prior, and accordingly reconstructs high-fidelity 3D textured models with dynamic details regardless of the visibility. To learn an effective avatar for volumetric capture from only few samples, we propose GeoTexAvatar, which leverages both geometry and texture supervisions to constrain the pose-dependent dynamics in a decomposed implicit manner. An avatar-conditioned volumetric capture method that involves a canonical normal fusion and a reconstruction network is further proposed to integrate both image observations and avatar dynamics for high-fidelity reconstruction in both observed and invisible regions. Overall, our method enables monocular human volumetric capture with detailed and pose-dependent dynamics, and the experiments show that our method outperforms state of the art.

title: Zhe Wang, Jie Lin, Xue Geng, Mohamed M. Sabry Aly, Vijay Chandrasekhar
title_en: Zhe Wang, Jie Lin, Xue Geng, Mohamed M. Sabry Aly, Vijay Chandrasekhar
abstract: 为不同通道分配不同的位宽并独立量化,可以提高量化精度和准确性。大多数先前的工作使用相等的位宽对所有层或通道进行量化,这是次优的。另一方面,探索通道位宽的超参数空间非常具有挑战性,因为随着通道数量的增加,搜索空间呈指数级增长,这在深度神经网络中可能达到数千个通道。在本文中,我们解决了高效探索通道位宽超参数空间的问题。我们将深度神经网络的量化问题建模为率失真优化问题,并提出了一种超快速算法来搜索通道的位分配。我们的方法仅具有线性时间复杂度,并且可以在CPU上几分钟内找到最优的位分配。此外,我们提供了一种有效的方法来提升目标硬件平台上的性能。我们限制每层的位率(大小),以尽可能多地将权重和激活值存储在芯片上,并将硬件感知的约束条件纳入我们的目标函数中。硬件感知的约束条件不会对优化过程造成额外开销,并对硬件性能有非常积极的影响。实验结果表明,我们的方法在ImageNet上的四个深度神经网络ResNet-18、ResNet-34、ResNet-50和MobileNet-v2上达到了最先进的结果。硬件仿真结果表明,我们的方法能够在两种深度学习加速器TPU和Eyeriss上分别带来高达3.5倍和3.0倍的速度提升。
abstract_en: Allocating different bit widths to different channels and quantizing them independently bring higher quantization precision and accuracy. Most of prior works use equal bit width to quantize all layers or channels, which is sub-optimal. On the other hand, it is very challenging to explore the hyperparameter space of channel bit widths, as the search space increases exponentially with the number of channels, which could be tens of thousand in a deep neural network. In this paper, we address the problem of efficiently exploring the hyperparameter space of channel bit widths. We formulate the quantization of deep neural networks as a rate-distortion optimization problem, and present an ultra-fast algorithm to search the bit allocation of channels. Our approach has only linear time complexity and can find the optimal bit allocation within a few minutes on CPU. In addition, we provide an effective way to improve the performance on target hardware platforms. We restrict the bit rate (size) of each layer to allow as many weights and activations as possible to be stored on-chip, and incorporate hardware-aware constraints into our objective function. The hardware-aware constraints do not cause additional overhead to optimization, and have very positive impact on hardware performance. Experimental results show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on four deep neural networks, ResNet-18, ResNet-34, ResNet-50, and MobileNet-v2, on ImageNet. Hardware simulation results demonstrate that our approach is able to bring up to 3.5x and 3.0x speedups on two deep-learning accelerators, TPU and Eyeriss, respectively.

title: Zhehan Kan, Shuoshuo Chen, Zeng Li, Zhihai He
title_en: Zhehan Kan, Shuoshuo Chen, Zeng Li, Zhihai He
abstract: 我们观察到,由于人体各部位的生物约束,人体姿态的关键点之间存在显著的组间结构相关性和空间耦合性。这种组间结构相关性可以用于提升人体姿态估计的准确性与鲁棒性。本文中,我们开发了一种自约束预测-验证网络,在训练过程中表征并学习关键点间的结构相关性。在推理阶段,验证网络提供的反馈信息使我们能够进一步优化姿态预测,显著提升人体姿态估计性能。具体而言,我们根据人体结构将关键点划分为若干组。在每组内,关键点进一步划分为高置信度基础关键点和低置信度终端关键点。我们开发了自约束预测-验证网络,在这些关键点子集之间进行前向与反向预测。姿态估计以及通用预测任务中的一个根本性挑战在于,缺乏验证获得的姿态估计或预测结果是否准确的机制,因为缺乏真实标签。一旦成功学习,验证网络可作为前向姿态预测的准确性验证模块。在推理阶段,它可通过以高置信度关键点的自约束损失为优化目标,指导低置信度关键点姿态估计结果的局部优化。我们在基准MS COCO和CrowdPose数据集上的大量实验结果表明,所提方法能显著提升姿态估计结果。
abstract_en: We observe that human poses exhibit strong group-wise structural correlation and spatial coupling between keypoints due to the biological constraints of different body parts. This group-wise structural correlation can be explored to improve the accuracy and robustness of human pose estimation. In this work, we develop a self-constrained prediction-verification network to characterize and learn the structural correlation between keypoints during training. During the inference stage, the feedback information from the verification network allows us to perform further optimization of pose prediction, which significantly improves the performance of human pose estimation. Specifically, we partition the keypoints into groups according to the biological structure of human body. Within each group, the keypoints are further partitioned into two subsets, high-confidence base keypoints and low-confidence terminal keypoints. We develop a self-constrained prediction-verification network to perform forward and backward predictions between these keypoint subsets. One fundamental challenge in pose estimation, as well as in generic prediction tasks, is that there is no mechanism for us to verify if the obtained pose estimation or prediction results are accurate or not, since the ground truth is not available. Once successfully learned, the verification network serves as an accuracy verification module for the forward pose prediction. During the inference stage, it can be used to guide the local optimization of the pose estimation results of low-confidence keypoints with the self-constrained loss on high-confidence keypoints as the objective function. Our extensive experimental results on benchmark MS COCO and CrowdPose datasets demonstrate that the proposed method can significantly improve the pose estimation results.

title: Zhelun Shen, Yuchao Dai, Xibin Song, Zhibo Rao, Dingfu Zhou, Liangjun Zhang
title_en: Zhelun Shen, Yuchao Dai, Xibin Song, Zhibo Rao, Dingfu Zhou, Liangjun Zhang
abstract: 现有的基于深度学习的立体匹配方法要么专注于在目标数据集上实现最优性能但对其他数据集泛化能力差,要么通过抑制域敏感特征来处理跨域泛化问题,这导致性能显著下降。为了解决这些问题,我们提出PCW-Net,一种基于金字塔组合与变形代价体的网络,以在多种基准测试中实现良好的跨域泛化能力和立体匹配精度。具体而言,我们的PCW-Net设计有两个目的。首先,在金字塔的高层构建组合体,并开发代价体融合模块以整合它们进行初始视差估计。通过融合多尺度组合体,可以覆盖多尺度感受野,从而提取域不变特征。其次,在金字塔的最后一层构建变形体以进行视差细化。所提出的变形体可以将初始视差搜索范围中的残差搜索范围缩小到精细粒度范围,这能显著缓解网络在无约束残差搜索空间中寻找正确残差的难度。在合成数据集上训练并在未见过的真实数据集上泛化时,我们的方法展现出强大的跨域泛化能力,并在现有最先进方法的基础上有显著优势。经过在真实数据集上的微调,我们的方法在KITTI 2012中排名第一,在KITTI 2015中排名第二,在Argoverse中排名第一(截至2022年3月6日所有已发表方法)。
abstract_en: Existing deep learning based stereo matching methods either focus on achieving optimal performances on the target dataset while with poor generalization for other datasets or focus on handling the cross-domain generalization by suppressing the domain sensitive features which results in a significant sacrifice on the performance. To tackle these problems, we propose PCW-Net, a Pyramid Combination and Warping cost volume-based network to achieve good performance on both cross-domain generalization and stereo matching accuracy on various benchmarks. In particular, our PCW-Net is designed for two purposes. First, we construct combination volumes on the upper levels of the pyramid and develop a cost volume fusion module to integrate them for initial disparity estimation. Multi-scale receptive fields can be covered by fusing multi-scale combination volumes, thus, domain-invariant features can be extracted. Second, we construct the warping volume at the last level of the pyramid for disparity refinement. The proposed warping volume can narrow down the residue searching range from the initial disparity searching range to a fine-grained one, which can dramatically alleviate the difficulty of the network to find the correct residue in an unconstrained residue searching space. When training on synthetic datasets and generalizing to unseen real datasets, our method shows strong cross-domain generalization and outperforms existing state-of-the-arts with a large margin. After fine-tuning on the real datasets, our method ranks first on KITTI 2012, second on KITTI 2015, and first on the Argoverse among all published methods as of 6, March 2022.

title: Zhen Cheng, Tao Wang, Yong Li, Fenglong Song, Chang Chen, Zhiwei Xiong
title_en: Zhen Cheng, Tao Wang, Yong Li, Fenglong Song, Chang Chen, Zhiwei Xiong
abstract: 现有基于深度学习的HDRTV重建方法假设一种色调映射算子(TMOs)作为退化过程,以合成SDRTV-HDRTV对用于监督训练。本文认为,尽管传统TMOs利用了高效的动态范围压缩先验知识,但在建模真实退化过程中存在信息过度保留、色彩偏差和可能产生伪影等缺陷,导致训练的重建网络难以良好泛化到真实场景。为解决此问题,我们提出一种基于学习的数据合成方法,通过将多个色调映射先验知识整合到网络结构和损失函数中,学习真实SDRTV的特性。具体而言,我们设计了一个条件双流网络,以先验色调映射结果作为引导,通过全局和局部变换合成SDRTV。为训练数据合成网络,我们构建了一种新颖的自监督内容损失,约束不同亮度分布区域合成SDRTV的不同方面,并引入对抗损失以增强细节的真实性。为验证方法的有效性,我们使用该方法合成SDRTV-HDRTV对并用于训练多个HDRTV重建网络。随后,我们收集了包含标记和未标记真实SDRTV的两个推理数据集。实验结果表明,使用我们合成数据训练的网络在两个真实数据集上的泛化性能显著优于现有方案。
abstract_en: Existing deep learning based HDRTV reconstruction methods assume one kind of tone mapping operators (TMOs) as the degradation procedure to synthesize SDRTV-HDRTV pairs for supervised training. In this paper, we argue that, although traditional TMOs exploit efficient dynamic range compression priors, they have several drawbacks on modeling the realistic degradation: information over-preservation, color bias and possible artifacts, making the trained reconstruction networks hard to generalize well to real-world cases. To solve this problem, we propose a learning-based data synthesis approach to learn the properties of real-world SDRTVs by integrating several tone mapping priors into both network structures and loss functions. In specific, we design a conditioned two-stream network with prior tone mapping results as a guidance to synthesize SDRTVs by both global and local transformations. To train the data synthesis network, we form a novel self-supervised content loss to constraint different aspects of the synthesized SDRTVs at regions with different brightness distributions and an adversarial loss to emphasize the details to be more realistic. To validate the effectiveness of our approach, we synthesize SDRTV-HDRTV pairs with our method and use them to train several HDRTV reconstruction networks. Then we collect two inference datasets containing both labeled and unlabeled real-world SDRTVs, respectively. Experimental results demonstrate that, the networks trained with our synthesized data generalize significantly better to these two real-world datasets than existing solutions.

title: Zhen Liu, Yinglong Wang, Bing Zeng, Shuaicheng Liu
title_en: Zhen Liu, Yinglong Wang, Bing Zeng, Shuaicheng Liu
abstract: 高动态范围(HDR)去鬼影算法旨在生成无鬼影且具有真实细节的HDR图像。受限于感受野的局部性,现有的基于卷积神经网络(CNN)的方法在存在大运动和严重饱和的情况下通常容易产生鬼影伪影和强度失真。本文提出了一种新型的上下文感知视觉Transformer(CA-ViT),用于生成无鬼影的高动态范围图像。CA-ViT设计为双分支架构,能够联合捕捉全局和局部依赖关系。具体而言,全局分支采用基于窗口的Transformer编码器来建模长距离物体运动和强度变化,以解决鬼影问题。对于局部分支,我们设计了局部上下文提取器(LCE)以捕捉短距离图像特征,并利用通道注意力机制在提取的特征中选择具有信息量的局部细节,以补充全局分支。通过将CA-ViT作为基本组件,我们进一步构建了HDR-Transformer,这是一种分层网络,用于重建高质量的无鬼影HDR图像。在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在计算预算显著减少的情况下,定性和定量上均优于现有最先进的方法。代码可在https://github.com/megvii-research/HDR-Transformer获取
abstract_en: High dynamic range (HDR) deghosting algorithms aim to generate ghost-free HDR images with realistic details. Restricted by the locality of the receptive field, existing CNN-based methods are typically prone to producing ghosting artifacts and intensity distortions in the presence of large motion and severe saturation. In this paper, we propose a novel Context-aware Vision Transformer (CA-ViT) for ghost-free high dynamic range imaging. The CA-ViT is designed as a dual-branch architecture, which can jointly capture both global and local dependencies. Specifically, the global branch employs a window-based Transformer encoder to model long-range object movements and intensity variations to solve ghosting. For the local branch, we design a local context extractor (LCE) to capture short-range image features and use the channel attention mechanism to select informative local details across the extracted features to complement the global branch. By incorporating the CA-ViT as basic components, we further build the HDR-Transformer, a hierarchical network to reconstruct high-quality ghost-free HDR images. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets show that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods qualitatively and quantitatively with considerably reduced computational budgets. Codes are available at https://github.com/megvii-research/HDR-Transformer

title: Zhen Wang, Liu Liu, Yajing Kong, Jiaxian Guo, Dacheng Tao
title_en: Zhen Wang, Liu Liu, Yajing Kong, Jiaxian Guo, Dacheng Tao
abstract: 在线持续学习(online CL)研究在没有任务边界的在线数据流中学习序列任务的问题,旨在适应新数据的同时缓解过去任务的灾难性遗忘。本文提出了一种框架对比视觉变换器(CVT),基于变换器架构设计了一种聚焦对比学习策略,以实现在线CL更好的稳定性-可塑性权衡。具体来说,我们为在线CL设计了一种新的外部注意力机制,隐式捕捉先前任务的信息。此外,CVT包含每个类别的可学习焦点,可以积累先前类别的知识以减轻遗忘。基于可学习焦点,我们设计了一种聚焦对比损失,以在新类和过去类之间重新平衡对比学习,并巩固之前学习的表示。此外,CVT包含一个双分类器结构,用于解耦当前类的学习并平衡所有观察到的类。广泛的实验结果表明,我们的方法在在线CL基准上以更少的参数实现了最先进的性能,并有效缓解了灾难性遗忘。
abstract_en: Online continual learning (online CL) studies the problem of learning sequential tasks from an online data stream without task boundaries, aiming to adapt to new data while alleviating catastrophic forgetting on the past tasks. This paper proposes a framework Contrastive Vision Transformer (CVT), which designs a focal contrastive learning strategy based on a transformer architecture, to achieve a better stability-plasticity trade-off for online CL. Specifically, we design a new external attention mechanism for online CL that implicitly captures previous tasks’ information. Besides, CVT contains learnable focuses for each class, which could accumulate the knowledge of previous classes to alleviate forgetting. Based on the learnable focuses, we design a focal contrastive loss to rebalance contrastive learning between new and past classes and consolidate previously learned representations. Moreover, CVT contains a dual-classifier structure for decoupling learning current classes and balancing all observed classes. The extensive experimental results show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance with even fewer parameters on online CL benchmarks and effectively alleviates the catastrophic forgetting.

title: Zhen Wang, Long Chen, Wenbo Ma, Guangxing Han, Yulei Niu, Jian Shao, Jun Xiao
title_en: Zhen Wang, Long Chen, Wenbo Ma, Guangxing Han, Yulei Niu, Jian Shao, Jun Xiao
abstract: 给定一张图像和一个参考描述,图像描述编辑任务旨在纠正对齐错误并生成优化后的描述。然而,所有现有的描述编辑方法都是隐式模型,即它们直接生成优化后的描述,而没有与参考描述建立显式关联。在本文中,我们引入了一个新任务:显式描述编辑(ECE)。ECE模型显式生成一系列编辑操作,该编辑操作序列可以将参考描述转换为优化后的描述。与隐式编辑相比,ECE具有多项优势:1)可解释性:能够追踪整个编辑路径。2)编辑效率:只需修改少量词汇。3)类人化:模仿人类进行描述编辑的方式,并尝试保持原句结构。为了解决这一新任务,我们提出了首个ECE模型:TIger。TIger是一个基于非自回归Transformer的模型,包含三个模块:Tagger_del、Tagger_add和Inserter。具体而言,Tagger_del决定每个词汇是否需要保留,Tagger_add决定新增词汇的位置,Inserter预测新增词汇的具体内容。为进一步促进ECE研究,我们通过重组两个现有数据集,提出了两个新的ECE基准数据集,分别命名为COCO-EE和Flickr30K-EE。在两个基准数据集上的大量消融实验验证了TIger的有效性。
abstract_en: Given an image and a reference caption, the image caption editing task aims to correct the misalignment errors and generate a refined caption. However, all existing caption editing works are implicit models, ie, they directly produce the refined captions without explicit connections to the reference captions. In this paper, we introduce a new task: Explicit Caption Editing (ECE). ECE models explicitly generate a sequence of edit operations, and this edit operation sequence can translate the reference caption into a refined one. Compared to the implicit editing, ECE has multiple advantages: 1) Explainable: it can trace the whole editing path. 2) Editing Efficient: it only needs to modify a few words. 3) Human-like: it resembles the way that humans perform caption editing, and tries to keep original sentence structures. To solve this new task, we propose the first ECE model: TIger. TIger is a non-autoregressive transformer-based model, consisting of three modules: Tagger_del, Tagger_add, and Inserter. Specifically, Tagger_del decides whether each word should be preserved or not, Tagger_add decides where to add new words, and Inserter predicts the specific word for adding. To further facilitate ECE research, we propose two new ECE benchmarks by re-organizing two existing datasets, dubbed COCO-EE and Flickr30K-EE, respectively. Extensive ablations on both two benchmarks have demonstrated the effectiveness of TIger.

title: Zhen Xing, Hengduo Li, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang
title_en: Zhen Xing, Hengduo Li, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang
abstract: 现有单视角三维重建方法的性能严重依赖于大规模三维标注数据。然而,此类标注数据的收集既繁琐又昂贵。半监督学习作为一种替代方法,可以缓解对人工标注的依赖,但在三维重建领域尚未被探索。受近期半监督图像分类任务中自集成方法取得的成功启发,我们首先提出SSP3D,一种用于三维重建的半监督框架。具体而言,我们引入了注意力引导的原型形状先验模块,以指导真实物体的重建。我们进一步引入了判别器引导模块,以激励更好的形状生成,以及一个正则化器以容忍噪声训练样本。在ShapeNet基准测试中,所提出的方法在各种标注比例(即1%、5%、10%和20%)下均显著优于先前的监督方法。此外,当在标注比例为10%时,我们的方法在真实世界Pix3D数据集上的表现也良好。我们还展示了该方法能够通过少量新监督数据迁移到新类别。在流行的ShapeNet数据集上的实验表明,我们的方法在少样本设置下,比零样本基线高出超过12%,比当前最先进方法高出超过7%。
abstract_en: The performance of existing single-view 3D reconstruction methods heavily relies on large-scale of 3D annotations. However, such annotations are tedious and expensive to collect. Semi-supervised learning serves as an alternative way to mitigate the need for manual labels, but remains unexplored in 3D reconstruction. Inspired by the recent success of self-ensembling method in semi-supervised image classification task, we first propose SSP3D, a semi-supervised framework for 3D reconstruction. In particular, we introduce an attention-guided prototype shape prior module for guiding realistic object reconstruction. we further introduce a discriminator-guided module to incentivize better shape generation, as well as a regularizer to tolerate noisy training samples. On the ShapeNet benchmark, the proposed approach outperforms previous supervised methods by clear margins margin under various labeling ratios, ( i.e., 1%, 5%, 10% and 20%). Moreover, our approach also performs well when transferring to real-world Pix3D datasets under labeling ratios of 10%. We also demonstrate our method could transfer to novel categories with few novel supervised data. Experiments on the popular ShapeNet dataset show that our method outperforms the zero-shot baseline by over 12% and the current state-of-the-art by over 7% in the few-shot setting.

title: 真星,陈艺江,凌志新,周向东,向宇
title_en: Zhen Xing, Yijiang Chen, Zhixin Ling, Xiangdong Zhou, Yu Xiang
abstract: 基于少样本学习的新型类别三维重建在现实应用中具有吸引力,并吸引了越来越多的研究兴趣。先前的方法主要关注如何为不同类别设计形状先验模型。其在未见过的类别上的表现并不十分突出。本文提出了一种记忆先验对比网络(MPCN),该网络可以在基于少样本学习的三维重建框架中存储形状先验知识。通过形状记忆,提出了一种多头注意力模块,用于捕捉候选形状先验的不同部分,并将这些部分融合以指导新型类别的三维重建。此外,我们引入了一种三维感知的对比学习方法,该方法不仅能补充记忆网络的检索准确性,还能更好地组织图像特征以供下游任务使用。与先前的少样本三维重建方法相比,MPCN可以在无需类别标注的情况下处理类间可变性。在基准合成数据集和Pascal3D+真实世界数据集上的实验结果表明,我们的模型显著优于当前最先进的方法。
abstract_en: 3D reconstruction of novel categories based on few-shot learning is appealing in real-world applications and attracts increasing research interests. Previous approaches mainly focus on how to design shape prior models for different categories. Their performance on unseen categories is not very competitive. In this paper, we present a Memory Prior Contrastive Network (MPCN) that can store shape prior knowledge in a few-shot learning based 3D reconstruction framework. With the shape memory, a multi-head attention module is proposed to capture different parts of a candidate shape prior and fuse these parts together to guide 3D reconstruction of novel categories. Besides, we introduce a 3D-aware contrastive learning method, which can not only complement the retrieval accuracy of memory network, but also better organize image features for downstream tasks. Compared with previous few-shot 3D reconstruction methods, MPCN can handle the inter-class variability without category annotations. Experimental results on a benchmark synthetic dataset and the Pascal3D+ real-world dataset show that our model outperforms the current state-of-the-art methods significantly.

title: Zhenchao Jin, Dongdong Yu, Luchuan Song, Zehuan Yuan, Lequan Yu
title_en: Zhenchao Jin, Dongdong Yu, Luchuan Song, Zehuan Yuan, Lequan Yu
abstract: 特征金字塔网络(FPN)是目标检测器的关键组件之一。然而,研究人员长期存在一个谜题:引入FPN后,大尺度目标的检测性能通常会被抑制。为此,本文首先重新审视FPN在检测框架中的应用,从优化的角度揭示FPN成功的原因。随后,我们指出大尺度目标性能下降是由于集成FPN后出现的不合理的反向传播路径所致。这使得主干网络的每一层仅具备特定尺度范围内的目标检测能力。基于上述分析,我们提出了两种可行策略,以使FPN-based检测框架中主干网络的每一层都能检测所有目标。具体而言,一种是引入辅助目标函数,使主干网络的每一层在训练过程中直接接收多尺度目标的反向传播信号;另一种是更合理地构建特征金字塔,以避免不合理的反向传播路径。在COCO基准上的大量实验验证了我们分析的合理性以及方法的有效性。无需复杂设计,我们证明了所提方法在多种检测框架(包括单阶段、两阶段、基于锚点、无锚点和基于Transformer的检测器)中均实现了超过2%的显著提升。
abstract_en: Feature pyramid network (FPN) is one of the key components for object detectors. However, there is a long-standing puzzle for researchers that the detection performance of large-scale objects are usually suppressed after introducing FPN. To this end, this paper first revisits FPN in the detection framework and reveals the nature of the success of FPN from the perspective of optimization. Then, we point out that the degraded performance of large-scale objects is due to the arising of improper back-propagation paths after integrating FPN. It makes each level of the backbone network only has the ability to look at the objects within a certain scale range. Based on these analysis, two feasible strategies are proposed to enable each level of the backbone to look at all objects in the FPN-based detection frameworks. Specifically, one is to introduce auxiliary objective functions to make each backbone level directly receive the back-propagation signals of various-scale objects during training. The other is to construct the feature pyramid in a more reasonable way to avoid the irrational back-propagation paths. Extensive experiments on the COCO benchmark validate the soundness of our analysis and the effectiveness of our methods. Without bells and whistles, we demonstrate that our method achieves solid improvements (more than 2%) on various detection frameworks: one-stage, two-stage, anchor-based, anchor-free and transformer-based detectors.

title: Zhendong Yang, Zhe Li, Mingqi Shao, Dachuan Shi, Zehuan Yuan, Chun Yuan
title_en: Zhendong Yang, Zhe Li, Mingqi Shao, Dachuan Shi, Zehuan Yuan, Chun Yuan
abstract: 知识蒸馏已被成功应用于各种任务。当前的蒸馏算法通常通过模仿教师的输出来提升学生模型的性能。本文表明,教师还可以通过指导学生模型的特征恢复来提升其表征能力。从这一角度出发,我们提出了一种名为掩码生成蒸馏(Masked Generative Distillation, MGD)的方法,其设计简单:我们随机掩码学生模型的特征图中部分像素,并通过一个简单模块强制其生成教师模型的完整特征。MGD是一种真正通用的基于特征的蒸馏方法,可应用于包括图像分类、目标检测、语义分割和实例分割在内的多种任务。我们在多个模型和大量数据集上进行了实验,结果表明所有学生模型均取得了显著性能提升。值得注意的是,我们将ResNet-18的ImageNet top-1准确率从69.90%提升至71.69%,将基于ResNet-50主干的RetinaNet的Boundingbox mAP从37.4提升至41.0,将基于ResNet-50的SOLO的Mask mAP从33.1提升至36.2,将基于ResNet-18的DeepLabV3的mIoU从73.20提升至76.02。我们的代码已开源在https://github.com/yzd-v/MGD。
abstract_en: Knowledge distillation has been applied to various tasks successfully. The current distillation algorithm usually improves students’ performance by imitating the output of the teacher. This paper shows that teachers can also improve students’ representation power by guiding students’ feature recovery. From this point of view, we propose Masked Generative Distillation (MGD), which is simple: we mask random pixels of the student’s feature and force it to generate the teacher’s full feature through a simple block. MGD is a truly general feature-based distillation method, which can be utilized on various tasks, including image classification, object detection, semantic segmentation and instance segmentation. We experiment on different models with extensive datasets and the results show that all the students achieve excellent improvements. Notably, we boost ResNet-18 from 69.90% to 71.69% ImageNet top-1 accuracy, RetinaNet with ResNet-50 backbone from 37.4 to 41.0 Boundingbox mAP, SOLO based on ResNet-50 from 33.1 to 36.2 Mask mAP and DeepLabV3 based on ResNet-18 from 73.20 to 76.02 mIoU. Our codes are available at https://github.com/yzd-v/MGD.

title: Zheng Chang, Shuchen Weng, Yu Li, Si Li, Boxin Shi
title_en: Zheng Chang, Shuchen Weng, Yu Li, Si Li, Boxin Shi
abstract: 基于语言的上色需要生成的图像与用户提供的语言描述保持一致。最近的一项工作提出通过将语言解耦为颜色和物体条件来解决该问题。尽管取得了相当大的进展,其性能仍受到三个关键问题的限制。(i) 使用独立特征提取器导致视觉和语言模态之间存在较大差距,使得难以充分理解语言。(ii) 语言特征未通过图像特征进行优化,导致语言可能无法精确地对图像进行上色。(iii) 局部区域无法感知整张图像,产生全局不一致的颜色。在本文中,我们引入Transformer到基于语言的上色中,以解决上述问题同时保持语言解耦特性。我们的方法统一了图像和语言模态,并进一步以由粗到细的方式使颜色条件随图像特征演变。此外,得益于全局感受野,我们的方法对强局部变化具有鲁棒性。大量实验表明,我们的方法能够生成逼真的上色效果,并在与描述语句的一致性方面优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Language-based colorization requires the colorized image to be consistent with the the user-provided language caption. A most recent work proposes to decouple the language into color and object conditions in solving the problem. Though decent progress has been made, its performance is limited by three key issues. (i) The large gap between vision and language modalities using independent feature extractors makes it difficult to fully understand the language. (ii) The inaccurate language features are never refined by the image features such that the language may fail to colorize the image precisely. (iii) The local region does not perceive the whole image, producing global inconsistent colors. In this work, we introduce transformer into language-based colorization to tackle the aforementioned issues while keeping the language decoupling property. Our method unifies the modalities of image and language, and further performs color conditions evolving with image features in a coarse-to-fine manner. In addition, thanks to the global receptive field, our method is robust to the strong local variation. Extensive experiments demonstrate our method is able to produce realistic colorization and outperforms prior arts in terms of consistency with the caption.

title: Zheng Dang, Lizhou Wang, Yu Guo, Mathieu Salzmann
title_en: Zheng Dang, Lizhou Wang, Yu Guo, Mathieu Salzmann
abstract: 本文研究了从点云数据中估计物体6自由度位姿的任务。尽管近期基于学习的方法在合成数据集上取得了显著成功,但我们发现这些方法在真实数据场景下会失效。因此,我们分析了这些失败的原因,将其归因于源点云与目标点云特征分布的差异,以及广泛使用的基于SVD的损失函数对两点云之间旋转范围的敏感性。我们通过引入一种新的归一化策略Match Normalization解决第一个挑战,并通过基于点对应负对数似然的损失函数解决第二个挑战。我们的两个贡献具有通用性,可应用于许多现有的基于学习的3D物体配准框架,我们通过在DCP和IDAM两个框架中实现它们加以说明。在真实场景TUD-L、LINEMOD和Occluded-LINEMOD数据集上的实验验证了我们策略的有效性。这些策略首次使基于学习的3D物体配准方法在真实数据上取得了有意义的结果。因此,我们预计这些方法将成为点云配准技术未来发展的关键。
abstract_en: In this work, we tackle the task of estimating the 6D pose of an object from point cloud data. While recent learning-based approaches to addressing this task have shown great success on synthetic datasets, we have observed them to fail in the presence of real-world data. We thus analyze the causes of these failures, which we trace back to the difference between the feature distributions of the source and target point clouds, and the sensitivity of the widely-used SVD-based loss function to the range of rotation between the two point clouds. We address the first challenge by introducing a new normalization strategy, Match Normalization, and the second via the use of a loss function based on the negative log likelihood of point correspondences. Our two contributions are general and can be applied to many existing learning-based 3D object registration frameworks, which we illustrate by implementing them in two of them, DCP and IDAM. Our experiments on the real-scene TUD-L, LINEMOD and Occluded-LINEMOD datasets evidence the benefits of our strategies. They allow for the first time learning-based 3D object registration methods to achieve meaningful results on real-world data. We therefore expect them to be key to the future development of point cloud registration methods.

title: Zheng Yuan, Jie Zhang, Shiguang Shan
title_en: Zheng Yuan, Jie Zhang, Shiguang Shan
abstract: 对抗攻击为研究深度学习模型的鲁棒性提供了一种有效途径。基于迁移的黑盒攻击方法中,一类方法通过多种图像变换操作提升对抗样本的迁移性,该方法虽有效但未考虑输入图像的特定特征。本文提出了一种新型架构,称为自适应图像变换学习器(AITL),将不同图像变换操作整合到统一框架中,进一步提升对抗样本的迁移性。与现有方法中固定的组合变换不同,我们精心设计的变换学习器能够自适应选择最适合输入图像的变换组合。在ImageNet上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在多种设置下显著提升了对正常训练模型和防御模型的攻击成功率。
abstract_en: Adversarial attacks provide a good way to study the robustness of deep learning models. One category of methods in transfer-based black-box attack utilizes several image transformation operations to improve the transferability of adversarial examples, which is effective, but fails to take the specific characteristic of the input image into consideration. In this work, we propose a novel architecture, called Adaptive Image Transformation Learner (AITL), which incorporates different image transformation operations into a unified framework to further improve the transferability of adversarial examples. Unlike the fixed combinational transformations used in existing works, our elaborately designed transformation learner adaptively selects the most effective combination of image transformations specific to the input image. Extensive experiments on ImageNet demonstrate that our method significantly improves the attack success rates on both normally trained models and defense models under various settings.

title: Zhengkai Jiang, Yuxi Li, Ceyuan Yang, Peng Gao, Yabiao Wang, Ying Tai, Chengjie Wang
title_en: Zhengkai Jiang, Yuxi Li, Ceyuan Yang, Peng Gao, Yabiao Wang, Ying Tai, Chengjie Wang
abstract: 无监督域适应(UDA)旨在将训练在带标签源域上的模型适应到无标签目标域。本文提出原型对比适应(ProCA),一种用于无监督域自适应语义分割的简单高效的对比学习方法。先前的域适应方法仅考虑不同域内类表示分布的对齐,而类间结构关系的探索不足,导致目标域上的对齐表示可能不再像源域上那样容易区分。相反,ProCA将类间信息纳入类别级原型,并采用以类为中心的分布对齐进行适应。通过将相同类原型视为正样本,其他类原型视为负样本,实现以类为中心的分布对齐,ProCA在经典域适应任务上取得了最先进性能,即GTA5 $\to$ Cityscapes \text{和} SYNTHIA $\to$ Cityscapes。代码将公开。
abstract_en: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) aims to adapt the model trained on the labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain. In this paper, we present Prototypical Contrast Adaptation (ProCA), a simple and efficient contrastive learning method for unsupervised domain adaptive semantic segmentation. Previous domain adaptation methods merely consider the alignment of the intra-class representational distributions across various domains, while the inter-class structural relationship is insufficiently explored, resulting in the aligned representations on the target domain might not be as easily discriminated as done on the source domain anymore. Instead, ProCA incorporates inter-class information into class-wise prototypes, and adopts the class-centered distribution alignment for adaptation. By considering the same class prototypes as positives and other class prototypes as negatives to achieve class-centered distribution alignment, ProCA achieves state-of-the-art performance on classical domain adaptation tasks, {\em i.e., GTA5 $\to$ Cityscapes \text{and} SYNTHIA $\to$ Cityscapes}. Code will be made available.

title: Zhenglun Kong, Peiyan Dong, Xiaolong Ma, Xin Meng, Wei Niu, Mengshu Sun, Xuan Shen, Geng Yuan, Bin Ren, Hao Tang, Minghai Qin, Yanzhi Wang
title_en: Zhenglun Kong, Peiyan Dong, Xiaolong Ma, Xin Meng, Wei Niu, Mengshu Sun, Xuan Shen, Geng Yuan, Bin Ren, Hao Tang, Minghai Qin, Yanzhi Wang
abstract: 近年来,视觉Transformer(ViT)在计算机视觉领域不断刷新新纪录,但其高计算和内存成本使其在工业生产中的推广面临困难。考虑到计算复杂度、ViT的内部数据模式以及边缘设备部署需求,我们提出了一种延迟感知的软标记剪枝框架SPViT,该框架可应用于扁平化和分层结构的普通Transformer,如DeiTs和Swin-Transformers(Swin)。具体而言,我们设计了一个基于动态注意力的多头标记选择器,这是一个轻量级模块,用于自适应实例级标记选择。我们进一步引入了一种软剪枝技术,将选择器模块选出的低信息量标记整合为一个包装标记,而非完全丢弃。SPViT通过我们提出的延迟感知训练策略,与特定边缘设备的精度和延迟需求之间建立平衡。实验结果表明,SPViT在图像分类任务中保持与ViT相当的性能,显著降低了计算成本。此外,SPViT可确保识别模型满足移动设备和FPGA的延迟规范,甚至在移动设备上实现DeiT-T的实时执行。例如,在移动设备上,SPViT将DeiT-T的延迟降低至26毫秒(比现有方法高26%至41%),同时在ImageNet上Top-1准确率比现有方法高0.25%至4%。我们的代码已发布于https://github.com/PeiyanFlying/SPViT
abstract_en: Recently, Vision Transformer (ViT) has continuously established new milestones in the computer vision field, while the high computation and memory cost makes its propagation in industrial production difficult. Considering the computation complexity, the internal data pattern of ViTs, and the edge device deployment, we propose a latency-aware soft token pruning framework, SPViT, which can be set up on vanilla Transformers of both flatten and hierarchical structures, such as DeiTs and Swin-Transformers (Swin). More concretely, we design a dynamic attention-based multi-head token selector, which is a lightweight module for adaptive instance-wise token selection. We further introduce a soft pruning technique, which integrates the less informative tokens chosen by the selector module into a package token rather than discarding them completely. SPViT is bound to the trade-off between accuracy and latency requirements of specific edge devices through our proposed latency-aware training strategy. Experiment results show that SPViT significantly reduces the computation cost of ViTs with comparable performance on image classification. Moreover, SPViT can guarantee the identified model meets the latency specifications of mobile devices and FPGA, and even achieve the real-time execution of DeiT-T on mobile devices. For example, SPViT reduces the latency of DeiT-T to 26 ms (26% 41% superior to existing works) on the mobile device with 0.25% 4% higher top-1 accuracy on ImageNet. Our code is released at https://github.com/PeiyanFlying/SPViT

title: Zhengming Zhou, Qiulei Dong
title_en: Zhengming Zhou, Qiulei Dong
abstract: 自监督单目深度估计近年来在计算机视觉领域受到了广泛关注。大多数现有文献通过直接拼接或逐元素相加的方式对多尺度特征进行聚合以进行深度预测,然而,此类特征聚合操作通常忽略了多尺度特征之间的上下文一致性。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种自蒸馏特征聚合(SDFA)模块,用于同时聚合一对低尺度和高尺度特征并保持其上下文一致性。SDFA采用三个分支分别学习三个特征偏移图:一个用于优化输入的低尺度特征,另外两个则在设计的自蒸馏模式下优化输入的高尺度特征。随后,我们提出了一种基于SDFA的网络用于自监督单目深度估计,并设计了一种自蒸馏训练策略以使用SDFA模块训练该网络。在KITTI数据集上的实验结果表明,所提出的方法在大多数情况下优于现有的比较方法。代码可在https://github.com/ZM-Zhou/SDFA-Net_pytorch获取。
abstract_en: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation has received much attention recently in computer vision. Most of the existing works in literature aggregate multi-scale features for depth prediction via either straightforward concatenation or element-wise addition, however, such feature aggregation operations generally neglect the contextual consistency between multi-scale features. Addressing this problem, we propose the Self-Distilled Feature Aggregation (SDFA) module for simultaneously aggregating a pair of low-scale and high-scale features and maintaining their contextual consistency. The SDFA employs three branches to learn three feature offset maps respectively: one offset map for refining the input low-scale feature and the other two for refining the input high-scale feature under a designed self-distillation manner. Then, we propose an SDFA-based network for self-supervised monocular depth estimation, and design a self-distilled training strategy to train the proposed network with the SDFA module. Experimental results on the KITTI dataset demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the comparative state-of-the-art methods in most cases. The code is available at https://github.com/ZM-Zhou/SDFA-Net_pytorch.

title: Zhengqi Gao, Fan-Keng Sun, Mingran Yang, Sucheng Ren, Zikai Xiong, Marc Engeler, Antonio Burazer, Linda Wildling, Luca Daniel, Duane S. Boning
title_en: Zhengqi Gao, Fan-Keng Sun, Mingran Yang, Sucheng Ren, Zikai Xiong, Marc Engeler, Antonio Burazer, Linda Wildling, Luca Daniel, Duane S. Boning
abstract: 数据是现代深度学习的核心。监督学习令人印象深刻的表现建立在大量准确标注数据的基础上。然而,在某些实际应用中,精确标注可能不可行;相反,每个数据样本会由多个标注者提供多个噪声标签(而非一个准确标签)。在这样的噪声训练数据集上学习分类器是一项具有挑战性的任务。先前的方法通常假设所有数据样本共享与标注者错误相关的相同参数集,而我们证明标签误差学习应同时依赖于标注者和数据样本。受此观察的启发,我们提出了一种新颖的学习算法。所提出的方法在MNIST、CIFAR-100和ImageNet-100数据集上相比几种最先进的基线方法表现出优越性。我们的代码可在以下链接获取:https://github.com/zhengqigao/Learning-from-Multiple-Annotator-Noisy-Labels
abstract_en: Data lies at the core of modern deep learning. The impressive performance of supervised learning is built upon a base of massive accurately labeled data. However, in some real-world applications, accurate labeling might not be viable; instead, multiple noisy labels (instead of one accurate label) are provided by several annotators for each data sample. Learning a classifier on such a noisy training dataset is a challenging task. Previous approaches usually assume that all data samples share the same set of parameters related to annotator errors, while we demonstrate that label error learning should be both annotator and data sample dependent. Motivated by this observation, we propose a novel learning algorithm. The proposed method displays superiority compared with several state-of-the-art baseline methods on MNIST, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet-100. Our code is available at: https://github.com/zhengqigao/Learning-from-Multiple-Annotator-Noisy-Labels.

title: Zhengqi Li, Qianqian Wang, Noah Snavely, Angjoo Kanazawa
title_en: Zhengqi Li, Qianqian Wang, Noah Snavely, Angjoo Kanazawa
abstract: 我们提出了一种方法,从单视角出发,学习生成无边界自然场景的飞行轨迹视频。该能力无需相机姿态或每个场景的多视角图像即可从一组单张照片中学习获得。为实现这一目标,我们提出了一种新颖的自监督视角生成训练范式,通过采样和渲染虚拟摄像机轨迹(包括循环摄像机路径),使模型能够从一组单视角图像中学习稳定的视角生成。在测试阶段,尽管从未见过视频,我们的方法可以仅凭单张图像生成包含数百个新视角的长摄像机轨迹,其内容具有逼真且多样的特性。我们与需要带姿态多视角视频的最新监督视角生成方法进行了比较,展示了优越的性能和合成质量。我们的项目网页(包含视频结果)位于 infinite-nature-zero.github.io。
abstract_en: We present a method for learning to generate unbounded flythrough videos of natural scenes starting from a single view. This capability is learned from a collection of single photographs, without requiring camera poses or even multiple views of each scene. To achieve this, we propose a novel self-supervised view generation training paradigm where we sample and render virtual camera trajectories, including cyclic camera paths, allowing our model to learn stable view generation from a collection of single views. At test time, despite never having seen a video, our approach can take a single image and generate long camera trajectories comprised of hundreds of new views with realistic and diverse content. We compare our approach with recent state-of-the-art supervised view generation methods that require posed multi-view videos and demonstrate superior performance and synthesis quality. Our project webpage, including video results, is at infinite-nature-zero.github.io.

title: Zhengqin Li, Jia Shi, Sai Bi, Rui Zhu, Kalyan Sunkavalli, Miloš Hašan, Zexiang Xu, Ravi Ramamoorthi, Manmohan Chandraker
title_en: Zhengqin Li, Jia Shi, Sai Bi, Rui Zhu, Kalyan Sunkavalli, Miloš Hašan, Zexiang Xu, Ravi Ramamoorthi, Manmohan Chandraker
abstract: 我们提出了一种方法,通过单张图像及其预测的深度和光源分割掩码,对复杂室内照明进行编辑。这是一个极具挑战性的问题,需要建模复杂的光传输,并仅通过场景的部分低动态范围(LDR)观测,将高动态范围(HDR)照明与材质和几何结构分离。我们通过两个新颖的组件来解决这一问题:1)一种整体场景重建方法,用于估计场景反射率和参数化三维照明;2)一种神经渲染框架,从我们的预测重新渲染场景。我们使用基于物理的室内光表示方法,允许直观的编辑,并推断可见和不可见的光源。我们的神经渲染框架结合了基于物理的直接照明和阴影渲染与深度网络,以近似全局光照。它可以捕捉具有挑战性的照明效果,如柔和阴影、方向性照明、镜面材质和相互反射。以往的单图像逆渲染方法通常将场景照明和几何结构纠缠在一起,仅支持如物体插入等应用。相反,通过结合参数化三维照明估计与神经场景渲染,我们展示了首个自动实现完整场景重照明的方法,包括光源插入、移除和替换,仅需单张图像。所有源代码和数据将公开发布。
abstract_en: We present a method to edit complex indoor lighting from a single image with its predicted depth and light source segmentation masks. This is an extremely challenging problem that requires modeling complex light transport, and disentangling HDR lighting from material and geometry with only a partial LDR observation of the scene. We tackle this problem using two novel components: 1) a holistic scene reconstruction method that estimates scene reflectance and parametric 3D lighting, and 2) a neural rendering framework that re-renders the scene from our predictions. We use physically-based indoor light representations that allow for intuitive editing, and infer both visible and invisible light sources. Our neural rendering framework combines physically-based direct illumination and shadow rendering with deep networks to approximate global illumination. It can capture challenging lighting effects, such as soft shadows, directional lighting, specular materials, and interreflections. Previous single image inverse rendering methods usually entangle scene lighting and geometry and only support applications like object insertion. Instead, by combining parametric 3D lighting estimation with neural scene rendering, we demonstrate the first automatic method to achieve full scene relighting, including light source insertion, removal, and replacement, from a single image. All source code and data will be publicly released.

title: Zhengyuan Yang, Zhe Gan, Jianfeng Wang, Xiaowei Hu, Faisal Ahmed, Zicheng Liu, Yumao Lu, Lijuan Wang
title_en: Zhengyuan Yang, Zhe Gan, Jianfeng Wang, Xiaowei Hu, Faisal Ahmed, Zicheng Liu, Yumao Lu, Lijuan Wang
abstract: 我们提出UniTAB,一种统一文本与框输出的基于定位的视觉-语言(VL)建模方法。基于定位的VL任务(如基于定位的描述生成)要求模型生成文本描述,并将预测的词语与物体区域对齐。为实现这一目标,模型必须同时生成所需的文本和框输出,并且同时指示词语与框之间的对齐关系。与现有通过多个独立模块处理不同输出的解决方案不同,UniTAB使用共享的token序列表示文本和框输出,并引入一种特殊标记,自然地在序列中指示词-框对齐关系。因此,UniTAB能够通过自由地将生成的词语锚定到物体区域,提供更全面且可解释的图像描述。在基于定位的描述生成任务中,UniTAB提供了一个更简单的单输出头解决方案,并在定位和描述生成评估中显著优于现有最先进方法。在具有不同期望输出格式(即文本、框或其组合)的一般VL任务中,UniTAB通过单一网络实现的性能优于或与任务特定的最先进方法相当。实验覆盖了7个VL基准,包括基于定位的描述生成、视觉定位、图像描述生成和视觉问答。此外,UniTAB的统一多任务网络和任务无关的输出序列设计使模型参数高效,并可推广到新任务。
abstract_en: We propose UniTAB that Unifies Text And Box outputs for grounded vision-language (VL) modeling. Grounded VL tasks such as grounded captioning require the model to generate a text description and align predicted words with object regions. To achieve this, models must generate desired text and box outputs together, and meanwhile indicate the alignments between words and boxes. In contrast to existing solutions that use multiple separate modules for different outputs, UniTAB represents both text and box outputs with a shared token sequence, and introduces a special token to naturally indicate word-box alignments in the sequence. UniTAB thus could provide a more comprehensive and interpretable image description, by freely grounding generated words to object regions. On grounded captioning, UniTAB presents a simpler solution with a single output head, and significantly outperforms state of the art in both grounding and captioning evaluations. On general VL tasks that have different desired output formats (i.e., text, box, or their combination), UniTAB with a single network achieves better or comparable performance than task-specific state of the art. Experiments cover 7 VL benchmarks, including grounded captioning, visual grounding, image captioning, and visual question answering. Furthermore, UniTAB’s unified multi-task network and the task-agnostic output sequence design make the model parameter efficient and generalizable to new tasks.

title: Zhengzhong Tu, Hossein Talebi, Han Zhang, Feng Yang, Peyman Milanfar, Alan Bovik, Yinxiao Li
title_en: Zhengzhong Tu, Hossein Talebi, Han Zhang, Feng Yang, Peyman Milanfar, Alan Bovik, Yinxiao Li
abstract: Transformer模型近年来在计算机视觉领域受到了广泛关注。然而,自注意力机制在图像尺寸扩展方面的可扩展性不足限制了其在主流视觉主干网络中的广泛应用。本文提出了一种高效且可扩展的注意力模型,称为多轴注意力,其包含两个方面:分块局部注意力和扩张全局注意力。这些设计选择使得模型能够在任意输入分辨率上以线性复杂度实现全局-局部空间交互。我们还通过有效融合所提出的注意力模型与卷积操作,提出了一种简单的层次化视觉主干网络,称为MaxViT,通过在多个阶段重复基本构建模块实现。值得注意的是,MaxViT能够在整个网络中持续进行全局感知,即使在早期的高分辨率阶段也是如此。我们在广泛的视觉任务上验证了模型的有效性。在图像分类任务中,MaxViT在多种设置下均取得了最先进性能:无需额外数据,MaxViT在ImageNet-1K上达到86.5%的top-1准确率;在ImageNet-21K预训练下,我们的模型达到88.7%的top-1准确率。对于下游任务,MaxViT作为主干网络在目标检测和视觉美学评估中均表现出色。我们还展示了所提出的模型在ImageNet上具有强大的生成建模能力,证明了MaxViT模块作为通用视觉组件的卓越潜力。源代码和训练模型将在https://github.com/google-research/maxvit上提供。
abstract_en: Transformers have recently gained significant attention in the computer vision community. However, the lack of scalability of self-attention mechanisms with respect to image size has limited their wide adoption in state-of-the-art vision backbones. In this paper we introduce an efficient and scalable attention model we call multi-axis attention, which consists of two aspects: blocked local and dilated global attention. These design choices allow global-local spatial interactions on arbitrary input resolutions with only linear complexity. We also present a new architectural element by effectively blending our proposed attention model with convolutions, and accordingly propose a simple hierarchical vision backbone, dubbed MaxViT, by simply repeating the basic building block over multiple stages. Notably, MaxViT is able to ”see” globally throughout the entire network, even in earlier, high-resolution stages. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our model on a broad spectrum of vision tasks. On image classification, MaxViT achieves state-of-the-art performance under various settings: without extra data, MaxViT attains 86.5% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy; with ImageNet-21K pre-training, our model achieves 88.7% top-1 accuracy. For downstream tasks, MaxViT as a backbone delivers favorable performance on object detection as well as visual aesthetic assessment. We also show that our proposed model expresses strong generative modeling capability on ImageNet, demonstrating the superior potential of MaxViT blocks as a universal vision module. The source code and trained models will be available at https://github.com/google-research/maxvit.

title: 傅振奇, 王武, 黄悦, 丁兴浩, 马凯况
title_en: Zhenqi Fu, Wu Wang, Yue Huang, Xinghao Ding, Kai-Kuang Ma
abstract: 水下图像增强(UIE)面临的主要挑战是真实高质图像不可用。大多数现有方法首先生成近似参考图,然后使用确定性训练增强网络。此类方法无法处理参考图的模糊性。本文将UIE分解为分布估计和共识过程。我们提出了一种新颖的概率网络,以学习退化水下图像的增强分布。具体而言,我们结合条件变分自编码器与自适应实例归一化,构建增强分布。随后,我们采用共识过程,基于分布中的样本集预测确定性结果。通过学习增强分布,我们的方法在一定程度上能够应对参考图标注引入的偏差。此外,共识过程有助于捕捉稳健且稳定的结果。我们在两个广泛使用的现实水下图像增强数据集上评估了所提出的方法。实验结果表明,我们的方法能够采样可能的增强预测。同时,共识估计与最先进的UIE方法相比具有竞争力的性能。
abstract_en: A main challenge faced in the deep learning-based Underwater Image Enhancement (UIE) is that the ground truth high-quality image is unavailable. Most of the existing methods first generate approximate reference maps and then train an enhancement network with certainty. This kind of method fails to handle the ambiguity of the reference map. In this paper, we resolve UIE into distribution estimation and consensus process. We present a novel probabilistic network to learn the enhancement distribution of degraded underwater images. Specifically, we combine conditional variational autoencoder with adaptive instance normalization to construct the enhancement distribution. After that, we adopt a consensus process to predict a deterministic result based on a set of samples from the distribution. By learning the enhancement distribution, our method can cope with the bias introduced in the reference map labeling to some extent. Additionally, the consensus process is useful to capture a robust and stable result. We examined the proposed method on two widely used real-world underwater image enhancement datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach enables sampling possible enhancement predictions. Meanwhile, the consensus estimate yields competitive performance compared with state-of-the-art UIE methods.

title: Zhenqiang Ying, Deepti Ghadiyaram, Alan Bovik
title_en: Zhenqiang Ying, Deepti Ghadiyaram, Alan Bovik
abstract: 需要高效且准确的视频质量工具来监控并通过Zoom、Webex、Meet等平台流式传输的远程存在流量的感知优化。然而,现有模型在多模态、实时流媒体远程存在内容的预测能力上存在局限。本文通过以下几种方式解决远程存在视频质量评估(TVQA)的显著挑战。首先,我们通过收集来自不同国家的约2000个远程存在视频,缓解了主观标注数据的匮乏问题,并在这些视频上众包获取了约80000个主观质量标签。利用这一新资源,我们创建了一个首创的在线视频质量预测框架,采用多模态学习框架,通过独立路径分别计算视觉和音频质量预测。我们的集成模型能够提供精确的质量预测,涵盖块、帧、片段和视听级别。我们的模型在现有质量数据库和我们新构建的TVQA数据库上均实现了最先进的性能,且计算成本显著降低,使其成为移动设备和嵌入式系统的理想解决方案。
abstract_en: Efficient and accurate video quality tools are needed to monitor and perceptually optimize telepresence traffic streamed via Zoom, Webex, Meet, etc. However, existing models are limited in their prediction capabilities on multi-modal, live streaming telepresence content. Here we address the significant challenges of Telepresence Video Quality Assessment (TVQA) in several ways. First, we mitigated the dearth of subjectively labeled data by collecting ~2k telepresence videos from different countries, on which we crowdsourced ~80k subjective quality labels. Using this new resource, we created a first-of-a-kind online video quality prediction framework for live streaming, using a multi-modal learning framework with separate pathways to compute visual and audio quality predictions. Our all-in-one model is able to provide accurate quality predictions at the patch, frame, clip, and audiovisual levels. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on both existing quality databases and our new TVQA database, at a considerably lower computational expense, making it an attractive solution for mobile and embedded systems.

title: Zhenxuan Fang, Weisheng Dong, Xin Li, Jinjian Wu, Leida Li, Guangming Shi
title_en: Zhenxuan Fang, Weisheng Dong, Xin Li, Jinjian Wu, Leida Li, Guangming Shi
abstract: 传统观点认为,在盲超分辨率(SR)中,首先从低分辨率图像中估计未知的退化,然后利用退化信息进行图像重建。这种顺序方法存在两个根本性缺陷:即鲁棒性不足(当估计的退化不准确时性能下降)和透明度不足(网络架构是启发式的,未结合领域知识)。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了一种联合最大后验(MAP)方法,同时估计未知核和高分辨率图像。我们的方法首先在估计模糊核时引入潜在空间中的不确定性学习,旨在提高对估计误差的鲁棒性。然后,我们通过展开联合MAP估计器,结合学习到的拉普拉斯尺度混合(LSM)先验和估计的核,提出了一种新的SR网络。我们还开发了一种新颖的方法,通过深度卷积神经网络(DCNN)估计LSM模型的尺度先验系数和局部均值。所有MAP估计算法的参数和DCNN参数通过端到端训练联合优化。在合成和真实世界图像上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在盲图像SR任务中实现了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Conventional wisdom in blind super-resolution (SR) first estimates the unknown degradation from the low-resolution image and then exploits the degradation information for image reconstruction. Such sequential approaches suffer from two fundamental weaknesses - i.e., the lack of robustness (the performance drops when the estimated degradation is inaccurate) and the lack of transparency (network architectures are heuristic without incorporating domain knowledge). To address these issues, we propose a joint Maximum a Posterior (MAP) approach for estimating the unknown kernel and high-resolution image simultaneously. Our method first introduces uncertainty learning in the latent space when estimating the blur kernel, aiming at improving the robustness to the estimation error. Then we propose a novel SR network by unfolding the joint MAP estimator with a learned Laplacian Scale Mixture (LSM) prior and the estimated kernel.
