title: Abhinav N Harish*, Larry Heck, Josiah P Hanna, Zsolt Kira, Andrew Szot
title_en: Abhinav N Harish*, Larry Heck, Josiah P Hanna, Zsolt Kira, Andrew Szot
abstract: 我们提出了一种名为AuxDistill的新方法,通过辅助任务蒸馏(AuxDistill)使强化学习(RL)能够解决长时间跨度的机器人控制问题。AuxDistill通过同时执行与辅助任务相关的多任务强化学习,实现这一目标,这些辅助任务更容易学习且与主任务相关。加权蒸馏损失将这些辅助任务的行为转移到主任务上以解决问题。我们证明了AuxDistill能够在无需演示、学习课程或预训练技能的情况下,从环境奖励中学习出像素到动作的策略,解决具有挑战性的多阶段具身物体重新排列任务。在Habitat Object Rearrangement基准测试中,AuxDistill的成功率比之前的最先进基线高2.3倍,并且优于使用预训练技能和专家演示的方法。
abstract_en: We present Reinforcement Learning via Auxiliary Task Distillation (AuxDistill), a new method that enables reinforcement learning (RL) to perform long-horizon robot control problems by distilling behaviors from auxiliary RL tasks. AuxDistill achieves this by concurrently carrying out multi-task RL with auxiliary tasks, which are easier to learn and relevant to the main task. A weighted distillation loss transfers behaviors from these auxiliary tasks to solve the main task. We demonstrate that AuxDistill can learn a pixels-to-actions policy for a challenging multi-stage embodied object rearrangement task from the environment reward without demonstrations, a learning curriculum, or pre-trained skills. AuxDistill achieves 2.3× higher success than the previous state-of-the-art baseline in the Habitat Object Rearrangement benchmark and outperforms methods that use pre-trained skills and expert demonstrations.

title: Abhishek Singh*, Vivek Sharma, Rohan Sukumaran, John J Mose, Jeffrey K Chiu, Justin Yu, Ramesh Raskar
title_en: Abhishek Singh*, Vivek Sharma, Rohan Sukumaran, John J Mose, Jeffrey K Chiu, Justin Yu, Ramesh Raskar
abstract: 本文研究了如何对深度神经网络(DNN)表示中输入的重建进行基准测试。这一逆向问题在隐私研究领域具有重要意义,其中特征混淆技术被提出作为隐私保护的机器学习(ML)推理方法。在本基准测试中,我们表征了不同的混淆技术,并设计了不同的攻击模型。我们基于对手的不同背景知识提出了多种重建技术。我们开发了一个模块化平台,在统一框架下整合了不同的混淆技术、重建算法和评估指标。通过该平台,我们对各种混淆和重建技术进行基准测试,以评估其隐私-效用权衡。最后,我们发布了一个混淆表示的数据集,以促进该领域的研究。我们已开源代码、数据集、超参数和训练模型,可访问地址为 https: //github.com/aidecentralized/InferenceBenchmark。
abstract_en: In this work, we tackle the question of how to benchmark reconstruction of inputs from deep neural networks (DNN) representations. This inverse problem is of great importance in the privacy community where obfuscation of features has been proposed as a technique for privacy-preserving machine learning (ML) inference. In this benchmark, we characterize different obfuscation techniques and design different attack models. We propose multiple reconstruction techniques based upon distinct background knowledge of the adversary. We develop a modular platform that integrates different obfuscation techniques, reconstruction algorithms, and evaluation metrics under a common framework. Using our platform, we benchmark various obfuscation and reconstruction techniques for evaluating their privacy-utility trade-off. Finally, we release a dataset of obfuscated representations to foster research in this area. We have open-sourced code, dataset, hyper-parameters, and trained models that can be found at https: //github.com/aidecentralized/InferenceBenchmark.

title_en: Abrar Majeedi, Viswanatha Reddy Gajjala, Satya Sai Srinath Namburi GNVV, Yin Li*
abstract: 和
abstract_en: The ability to quantify how well an action is carried out, also known as action quality assessment (AQA), has attracted recent interest in the vision community. Unfortunately, prior methods often ignore the score rubric used by human experts and fall short of quantifying the uncertainty of the model prediction. To bridge the gap, we present — a deep probabilistic model that integrates score rubric and accounts for prediction uncertainty for AQA. Central to our method lies in stochastic embeddings of action steps, defined on a graph structure that encodes the score rubric. The embeddings spread probabilistic density in the latent space and allow our method to represent model uncertainty. The graph encodes the scoring criteria, based on which the quality scores can be decoded. We demonstrate that our method establishes new state of the art on public benchmarks, including FineDiving, MTL-AQA, and JIGSAWS, with superior performance in score prediction and uncertainty calibration. Our code is available at https://abrarmajeedi.github.io/rica2_aqa/.

title: Ada-Astrid Balauca*, Danda Pani Paudel, Kristina Toutanova, Luc Van Gool
title_en: Ada-Astrid Balauca*, Danda Pani Paudel, Kristina Toutanova, Luc Van Gool
abstract: CLIP是一种强大且广泛使用的工具,用于在自然语言描述的上下文中理解图像以执行细致的任务。然而,由于其通用性,它无法提供针对特定应用场景的细粒度且结构化的理解。在本工作中,我们旨在将CLIP调整为用于博物馆展品的细粒度且结构化的视觉理解,形式为表格数据。为实现这种理解,我们(a)收集、整理并建立了一个包含20万多个图像-表格对的数据集,并(b)开发了一种方法,能够根据输入图像预测表格输出。我们的数据集是公开领域中首个此类数据集。同时,所提出的方法通过利用CLIP的强大表示能力,实现了细粒度和表格数据的理解,具有创新性。所提出的方法(MUZE)通过一个基于Transformer的解析网络(parseNet)学习将CLIP的图像嵌入映射到表格结构。更具体而言,parseNet能够预测缺失的属性值,同时整合输入图像中已知属性-值对的上下文信息。我们证明了这种方法在准确性上实现了显著提升。通过全面的实验,我们在新建立的基准测试中展示了所提方法在博物馆展品细粒度和结构化理解方面的有效性,取得了令人鼓舞的结果。我们的数据集和源代码可在以下链接获取:https://github.com/insait-institute/MUZE
abstract_en: CLIP is a powerful and widely used tool for understanding images in the context of natural language descriptions to perform nuanced tasks. However, it does not offer application-specific fine-grained and structured understanding, due to its generic nature. In this work, we aim to adapt CLIP for fine-grained and structured – in the form of tabular data – visual understanding of museum exhibits. To facilitate such understanding we (a) collect, curate, and benchmark a dataset of 200K+ image-table pairs, and (b) develop a method that allows predicting tabular outputs for input images. Our dataset is the first of its kind in the public domain. At the same time, the proposed method is novel in leveraging CLIP’s powerful representations for fine-grained and tabular understanding. The proposed method (MUZE) learns to map CLIP’s image embeddings to the tabular structure by means of a proposed transformer-based parsing network (parseNet). More specifically, parseNet enables prediction of missing attribute values while integrating context from known attribute-value pairs for an input image. We show that this leads to significant improvement in accuracy. Through exhaustive experiments, we show the effectiveness of the proposed method on fine-grained and structured understanding of museum exhibits, by achieving encouraging results in a newly established benchmark. Our dataset and source-code can be found at: https://github.com/insait-institute/MUZE

title: Adam Pardyl*, Michał Wronka, Maciej Wołczyk, Kamil Adamczewski, Tomasz Trzcinski, Bartosz Zieliński*
title_en: Adam Pardyl*, Michał Wronka, Maciej Wołczyk, Kamil Adamczewski, Tomasz Trzcinski, Bartosz Zieliński*
abstract: 主动视觉探索(AVE)是一项涉及动态选择观察(片段)的任务,对于促进环境中的理解与导航至关重要。尽管现代AVE方法在性能上表现出色,但它们受限于固定比例的刚性网格片段。相比之下,配备光学变焦功能的现有移动平台可以捕捉任意位置和比例的片段。为弥合软件与硬件能力之间的差距,我们引入了__TITLE_MATH_1__。该方法采用Soft Actor-Critic算法,这是一种专为探索任务设计的强化学习算法,用于选择任意位置和比例的片段。这种策略使我们的模型能够在进行详细分析前快速建立对环境的整体认知。实验结果表明,__ABS_MATH_1__在各类视觉任务中超越了先前方法,同时在现实场景的AVE应用中具有更广泛适用性。
abstract_en: Active Visual Exploration (AVE) is a task that involves dynamically selecting observations (glimpses), which is critical to facilitate comprehension and navigation within an environment. While modern AVE methods have demonstrated impressive performance, they are constrained to fixed-scale glimpses from rigid grids. In contrast, existing mobile platforms equipped with optical zoom capabilities can capture glimpses of arbitrary positions and scales. To address this gap between software and hardware capabilities, we introduce . It uses Soft Actor-Critic, a reinforcement learning algorithm tailored for exploration tasks, to select glimpses of arbitrary position and scale. This approach enables our model to rapidly establish a general awareness of the environment before zooming in for detailed analysis. Experimental results demonstrate that surpasses previous methods across various visual tasks while maintaining greater applicability in realistic AVE scenarios.

title: Aditay Tripathi*, Pradeep Shenoy, Anirban Chakraborty
title_en: Aditay Tripathi*, Pradeep Shenoy, Anirban Chakraborty
abstract: 自监督学习(SSL)对于从大量未标记图像中学习高质量表示至关重要。早期降低SSL计算需求的研究主要集中在识别足够用于训练的数据子集上。除了使用静态的代表性子集,这些方法还需要少量标记数据对实例进行评分。在本工作中,我们设计了一种新的算法家族,该算法利用SSL方法的训练动态,并在训练过程中持续调整所选子集。我们的方法包含两个关键组件:a) 一种由粗到细的训练数据精炼调度,其中初始训练轮次在更大的数据子集上进行,随后所选子集在训练过程中逐渐缩小;b) 使用一个无监督代理模型,根据训练实例对模型当前状态的信息量动态选择训练实例。我们还利用代理模型通过引入额外的正则化损失对主模型和代理模型的表示进行对齐,以加速初始学习过程。我们在CIFAR100、CIFAR10、Tiny ImageNet和STL10数据集上验证了我们的方法,并在计算量与准确率的权衡方面相比先前方法取得了显著提升。值得注意的是,在Tiny ImageNet数据集上,我们实现了31.6%的计算负载减少(包括目标模型训练和数据子集选择),同时保持相似的分类准确率。
abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is critical for learning high-quality representations from unlabeled images at scale. Earlier efforts at reducing the compute requirements of SSL have focused on identifying subsets of training data that are sufficient for training. In addition to using a static representative subset, these methods also require small amounts of labeled data for scoring instances. In this work, we design a new family of algorithms that exploits the training dynamics of SSL methods and adjusts the selected subset throughout the training process. Our proposal has two key components: a) a coarse-to-fine refinement schedule for training data, where initial training rounds are performed on larger subsets of data, and the selected subset shrinks throughout the training process, and b) the use of an unsupervised proxy model that dynamically selects training instances based on their informativeness for the model’s current state. We also use the proxy model to speed up initial learning by aligning the representations of the primary and proxy models using an additional regularization loss. We validate our method on CIFAR100, CIFAR10, Tiny ImageNet, and STL10 datasets and document significant gains in terms of compute-accuracy tradeoff compared to previous approaches. Notably, we show a 31.6% reduction in computational load (includes training the target model and data subset selection) on Tiny ImageNet with similar classification accuracy.

title: Aditya Annavajjala*, Alind Khare*, Animesh Agrawal, Igor Fedorov, Hugo M Latapie, Myungjin Lee, Alexey Tumanov
title_en: Aditya Annavajjala*, Alind Khare*, Animesh Agrawal, Igor Fedorov, Hugo M Latapie, Myungjin Lee, Alexey Tumanov
abstract: 卷积神经网络(CNN)越来越多地部署在不同的硬件、动态环境和低功耗嵌入式设备上。这促使设计和训练CNN架构,以在满足这些可变部署约束的条件下最大化准确性。随着部署场景数量的增加,需要找到可扩展的解决方案来设计和训练专用的CNN。一次性训练(Once-for-all training)作为一种可扩展的方法出现,它通过保持恒定的训练成本同时联合训练多个模型(子网络),并在之后找到专用的CNN。可扩展性是通过训练完整模型并同时将其缩减为共享模型权重(权重共享缩减)的较小子网络来实现的。然而,现有的一次性训练方法会导致巨大的训练成本,达到1200 GPU小时。我们认为这是因为它们要么过早地开始缩减完整模型,要么过晚。因此,我们提出了一种延迟ε缩减(Delayed ε-Shrinking)方法,当完整模型部分训练(约50%)时开始缩减过程,从而提高训练成本并更好地进行就地知识蒸馏到较小的模型。所提出的方法还包括新颖的启发式方法,动态调整子网络的学习率(ε),从而改善从较大到较小子网络的权重共享知识蒸馏。结果表明,该方法在包括CIFAR10/100、ImageNet-100和ImageNet-1k在内的不同数据集上,准确性和成本方面均优于现有的最先进的一次性训练技术。它在ImageNet-1k的top1准确率上提高了1.83%,或在保持相同准确率的情况下,FLOPs减少了1.3倍,训练成本(GPU*小时)降低了2.5倍。代码已发布在https://github.com/gatech-sysml/deps。
abstract_en: CNNs are increasingly deployed across different hardware, dynamic environments, and low-power embedded devices. This has led to the design and training of CNN architectures with the goal of maximizing accuracy subject to such variable deployment constraints. As the number of deployment scenarios grows, there is a need to find scalable solutions to design and train specialized CNNs. Once-for-all training has emerged as a scalable approach that jointly co-trains many models (subnets) at once with a constant training cost and finds specialized CNNs later. The scalability is achieved by training the full model and simultaneously reducing it to smaller subnets that share model weights (weight-shared shrinking). However, existing once-for-all training approaches incur huge training costs reaching 1200 GPU hours. We argue this is because they either start the process of shrinking the full model too early or too late. Hence, we propose Delayed ε-Shrinking () that starts the process of shrinking the full model when it is partially trained (∼ 50%), which leads to training cost improvement and better in-place knowledge distillation to smaller models. The proposed approach also consists of novel heuristics that dynamically adjust subnet learning rates incrementally (ε), leading to improved weight-shared knowledge distillation from larger to smaller subnets as well. As a result, outperforms state-of-the-art once-for-all training techniques across different datasets including CIFAR10/100, ImageNet-100, and ImageNet-1k on accuracy and cost. It achieves 1.83% higher ImageNet-1k top1 accuracy or the same accuracy with 1.3x reduction in FLOPs and 2.5x drop in training cost (GPU*hrs). Code is released at https://github.com/gatech-sysml/deps.

title: Aditya Chinchure*, Pushkar Shukla*, Gaurav Bhatt, Kiri Salij, Kartik Hosanagar, Leonid Sigal, Matthew Turk
title_en: Aditya Chinchure*, Pushkar Shukla*, Gaurav Bhatt, Kiri Salij, Kartik Hosanagar, Leonid Sigal, Matthew Turk
abstract: 文本到图像(TTI)生成模型在生成复杂且高质量图像的能力方面近年来取得了显著进展。同时,这些模型已被证明存在有害的偏见,包括夸张的社会偏见(如性别、种族)以及限制模型生成更多样化图像的偶然相关性。在本文中,我们提出了一种通用方法,利用反事实推理来研究和量化任何TTI模型和任何提示下的广泛偏见。与那些在预定义的偏见轴上评估生成图像的其他工作不同,我们的方法能够自动识别与给定提示可能相关的潜在偏见,并测量这些偏见。此外,我们通过图像生成中的语义概念提供后置解释,以补充定量评分。我们展示了我们的方法能够通过语义概念解释复杂的多维偏见,以及任何给定提示下不同偏见之间的交叉性。我们进行了广泛的用户研究,以证明我们的方法和分析结果与人类判断一致。1 1 数据和代码可在https://tibet-ai.github.io获取。贡献。* 表示同等贡献
abstract_en: Text-to-Image (TTI) generative models have shown great progress in the past few years in terms of their ability to generate complex and high-quality imagery. At the same time, these models have been shown to suffer from harmful biases, including exaggerated societal biases (e.g., gender, ethnicity), as well as incidental correlations that limit such a model’s ability to generate more diverse imagery. In this paper, we propose a general approach to study and quantify a broad spectrum of biases, for any TTI model and for any prompt, using counterfactual reasoning. Unlike other works that evaluate generated images on a predefined set of bias axes, our approach automatically identifies potential biases that might be relevant to the given prompt, and measures those biases. In addition, we complement quantitative scores with post-hoc explanations in terms of semantic concepts in the images generated. We show that our method is uniquely capable of explaining complex multi-dimensional biases through semantic concepts, as well as the intersectionality between different biases for any given prompt. We perform extensive user studies to illustrate that the results of our method and analysis are consistent with human judgements.1 1 Data and code is available at https://tibet-ai.github.io. contribution. ∗ indicates equal

title: Aditya Jain*, Fagner Cunha, Michael J Bunsen, Juan Sebastián Cañas, Léonard Pasi, Nathan Pinoy, Flemming Helsing, JoAnne Russo, Marc S Botham, Michael Sabourin, Jonathan Fréchette, Alexandre Anctil, Yacksecari Lopez, Eduardo Navarro, Filonila Pérez, Ana C Zamora, Jose Alejandro Ramirez-Silva, Jonathan Gagnon, Tom A August, Kim Bjerge, Alba Gomez Segura, Marc Belisle, Yves Basset, Kent P McFarland, David B Roy, Toke T Høye, Maxim Larrivee, David Rolnick
title_en: Aditya Jain*, Fagner Cunha, Michael J Bunsen, Juan Sebastián Cañas, Léonard Pasi, Nathan Pinoy, Flemming Helsing, JoAnne Russo, Marc S Botham, Michael Sabourin, Jonathan Fréchette, Alexandre Anctil, Yacksecari Lopez, Eduardo Navarro, Filonila Pérez, Ana C Zamora, Jose Alejandro Ramirez-Silva, Jonathan Gagnon, Tom A August, Kim Bjerge, Alba Gomez Segura, Marc Belisle, Yves Basset, Kent P McFarland, David B Roy, Toke T Høye, Maxim Larrivee, David Rolnick
abstract: 昆虫占全球生物多样性的半数,然而许多昆虫正面临消失的危机,这对生态系统和农业产生严重后果。尽管存在这一危机,关于昆虫多样性和数量的数据仍极其匮乏,原因在于人类专家稀缺以及缺乏可扩展的监测工具。生态学家开始采用摄像机陷阱记录和研究昆虫,并提出计算机视觉算法作为可扩展数据处理的解决方案。然而,野外昆虫监测面临独特的挑战,这些挑战尚未在计算机视觉领域得到解决,包括长尾数据、高度相似的类别以及显著的分布偏移。我们首次提供了针对细粒度昆虫识别的大规模机器学习基准测试,旨在匹配生态学家在现实任务中面临的挑战。我们的贡献包括一个由公民科学平台和博物馆图像组成的精选数据集,以及一个来自多洲自动摄像机陷阱的专家标注数据集,用于在实地条件下测试分布外泛化能力。我们训练并评估了多种基线算法,并引入了一组数据增强技术,以提升跨地理区域和硬件设置的泛化能力。该数据集已公开发布1。1 https://github.com/RolnickLab/ami-dataset
abstract_en: Insects represent half of all global biodiversity, yet many of the world’s insects are disappearing, with severe implications for ecosystems and agriculture. Despite this crisis, data on insect diversity and abundance remain woefully inadequate, due to the scarcity of human experts and the lack of scalable tools for monitoring. Ecologists have started to adopt camera traps to record and study insects, and have proposed computer vision algorithms as an answer for scalable data processing. However, insect monitoring in the wild poses unique challenges that have not yet been addressed within computer vision, including the combination of long-tailed data, extremely similar classes, and significant distribution shifts. We provide the first large-scale machine learning benchmarks for fine-grained insect recognition, designed to match real-world tasks faced by ecologists. Our contributions include a curated dataset of images from citizen science platforms and museums, and an expert-annotated dataset drawn from automated camera traps across multiple continents, designed to test out-of-distribution generalization under field conditions. We train and evaluate a variety of baseline algorithms and introduce a combination of data augmentation techniques that enhance generalization across geographies and hardware setups. The dataset is made publicly available1 . 1 https://github.com/RolnickLab/ami-dataset

title: Aditya Prakash*, Arjun Gupta, Saurabh Gupta
title_en: Aditya Prakash*, Arjun Gupta, Saurabh Gupta
abstract: 物体在相机视野范围内移动时会经历不同程度的透视失真。用于从单张图像预测3D的模型通常仅在感兴趣物体周围进行裁剪,并忽略物体在相机视野中的位置信息。我们注意到,忽略这一位置信息会进一步加剧从2D图像进行3D推理时的固有歧义性,甚至可能阻止模型对训练数据进行拟合。为缓解这种歧义,我们提出了一种内参感知的位置编码(Intrinsics-Aware Positional Encoding),该方法结合了图像裁剪位置和相机内参的信息。在三个流行的单图像3D重建基准测试中(纽约大学深度预测、KITTI与nuScenes上的3D目标检测、以及ARCTIC数据集上的可变形物体3D形状预测)的实验表明了该方法的优势。
abstract_en: Objects undergo varying amounts of perspective distortion as they move across a camera’s field of view. Models for predicting 3D from a single image often work with crops around the object of interest and ignore the location of the object in the camera’s field of view. We note that ignoring this location information further exaggerates the inherent ambiguity in making 3D inferences from 2D images and can prevent models from even fitting to the training data. To mitigate this ambiguity, we propose Intrinsics-Aware Positional Encoding (), which incorporates information about the location of crops in the image and camera intrinsics. Experiments on three popular 3D-from-a-single-image benchmarks: depth prediction on NYU, 3D object detection on KITTI & nuScenes, and predicting 3D shapes of articulated objects on ARCTIC, show the benefits of .

title: Aditya Prakash*, Matthew Chang, Matthew Jin, Ruisen Tu, Saurabh Gupta
title_en: Aditya Prakash*, Matthew Chang, Matthew Jin, Ruisen Tu, Saurabh Gupta
abstract: 现有工作通过单张图像重建手持物体时,通常在图像与三维形状配对的数据集上训练模型。然而,此类数据在真实世界中难以大规模获取。因此,这些方法在野外场景中面对新型物体时泛化能力较差。尽管三维监督是主要瓶颈,但存在大量a) 展示手-物体交互的野外原始视频数据和b) 合成三维形状集合。本文提出模块化方法,利用这些来源的三维监督来扩展手持物体重建模型的学习。具体而言,我们从视频中提取多视角二维掩码监督,并从形状集合中获取三维形状先验。通过这些间接的三维线索,训练占据网络以从单张RGB图像预测物体的三维形状。在具有挑战性的野外MOW数据集上的实验表明,与在现有数据集上使用三维监督训练的模型相比,我们的方法在物体泛化设置中实现了11.6%的相对提升。
abstract_en: Prior works for reconstructing hand-held objects from a single image train models on images paired with 3D shapes. Such data is challenging to gather in the real world at scale. Consequently, these approaches do not generalize well when presented with novel objects in in-the-wild settings. While 3D supervision is a major bottleneck, there is an abundance of a) in-the-wild raw video data showing hand-object interactions and b) synthetic 3D shape collections. In this paper, we propose modules to leverage 3D supervision from these sources to scale up the learning of models for reconstructing hand-held objects. Specifically, we extract multiview 2D mask supervision from videos and 3D shape priors from shape collections. We use these indirect 3D cues to train occupancy networks that predict the 3D shape of objects from a single RGB image. Our experiments in the challenging object generalization setting on in-the-wild MOW dataset show 11.6% relative improvement over models trained with 3D supervision on existing datasets.

title: Aditya Prakash*, Ruisen Tu, Matthew Chang, Saurabh Gupta
title_en: Aditya Prakash*, Ruisen Tu, Matthew Chang, Saurabh Gupta
abstract: 在日常第一视角图像中进行3D手位姿估计具有挑战性,原因包括:视觉信号差(交互对象遮挡、低分辨率与运动模糊)、大视角失真(手部靠近相机)以及非受控场景下缺乏3D注释。尽管现有方法常使用手部裁剪作为输入以聚焦细粒度视觉信息来应对视觉信号差,但由视角失真和野外数据缺乏3D注释带来的挑战尚未被系统研究。我们聚焦这一研究空白,探讨不同实践方法的影响,包括以裁剪作为输入、融合相机信息、辅助监督以及扩展数据集。我们提供了适用于卷积网络和Transformer模型的若干见解,从而提升性能。基于研究发现,我们提出了__TITLE_MATH_1__,一个用于日常第一视角图像的3D手位姿估计系统。在4个多样化数据集(H2O, __ABS_MATH_1__, __ABS_MATH_2__, __ABS_MATH_3__)上的零样本评估表明,我们的方法在2D和3D指标上均有效,其中在3D指标上超越以往方法7.4%–66%。在系统级对比中,__TITLE_MATH_1__在第一视角分割上取得最佳3D手位姿,所有指标均优于FrankMocap,且在6个指标中有3个优于HaMeR,同时模型体积仅为HaMeR的1/10,训练数据量仅为HaMeR的1/5。
abstract_en: 3D hand pose estimation in everyday egocentric images is challenging for several reasons: poor visual signal (occlusion from the object of interaction, low resolution & motion blur), large perspective distortion (hands are close to the camera), and lack of 3D annotations outside of controlled settings. While existing methods often use hand crops as input to focus on fine-grained visual information to deal with poor visual signal, the challenges arising from perspective distortion and lack of 3D annotations in the wild have not been systematically studied. We focus on this gap and explore the impact of different practices, crops as input, incorporating camera information, auxiliary supervision, scaling up datasets. We provide several insights that are applicable to both convolutional and transformer models, leading to better performance. Based on our findings, we also present , a system for 3D hand pose estimation in everyday egocentric images. Zero-shot evaluation on 4 diverse datasets (H2O, , , ) demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach across 2D and 3D metrics, where we beat past methods by 7.4% – 66%. In system level comparisons, achieves the best 3D hand pose on egocentric split, outperforms FrankMocap across all metrics and HaMeR on 3 out of 6 metrics while being 10× smaller and trained on 5× less data.

title: Aditya Singh*, Haohan Wang
title_en: Aditya Singh*, Haohan Wang
abstract: 根据最近的研究,自监督学习(SSL)难以直接扩展到更小的架构上。为缓解这一缺陷,同时在无标签的情况下训练更小的网络,一种方向是采用无监督知识蒸馏(UKD)。现有UKD方法手工构建教师与学生之间具有保留价值的样本间/样本内关系。然而,这可能会忽略/忽视教师映射中存在其他关键关系。本文不同于通过启发式方法构建保留关系,而是直接激励学生建模教师的嵌入流形。若映射后的流形相似,所有样本间/样本内关系将间接得到保留。我们首先证明,由于现有方法仅依赖L2归一化的嵌入特征,因此无法保留教师的潜在流形。随后,我们提出一个简单的目标函数以捕捉归一化导致的信息损失。我们提出的损失项称为空间相似性,激励学生特征空间的每个维度与对应教师维度相似。我们在多个基准数据集上进行了大量实验,验证了所提方法的优异性能。
abstract_en: As per recent studies, Self-supervised learning (SSL) does not readily extend to smaller architectures. One direction to mitigate this shortcoming while simultaneously training a smaller network without labels is to adopt unsupervised knowledge distillation (UKD). Existing UKD approaches handcraft preservation worthy inter/intra sample relationships between the teacher and its student. However, this may overlook/ignore other key relationships present in the mapping of a teacher. In this paper, instead of heuristically constructing preservation worthy relationships between samples, we directly motivate the student to model the teacher’s embedding manifold. If the mapped manifold is similar, all inter/intra sample relationships are indirectly conserved. We first demonstrate that prior methods cannot preserve teacher’s latent manifold due to their sole reliance on L2 normalised embedding features. Subsequently, we propose a simple objective to capture the lost information due to normalisation. Our proposed loss component, termed space similarity, motivates each dimension of a student’s feature space to be similar to the corresponding dimension of its teacher. We perform extensive experiments demonstrating strong performance of our proposed approach on various benchmarks.

title_en: Adnen Abdessaied*, Lei Shi, Andreas Bulling

title: Adrian Rodriguez-Munoz*, Tongzhou Wang, Antonio Torralba
title_en: Adrian Rodriguez-Munoz*, Tongzhou Wang, Antonio Torralba
abstract: 对抗鲁棒模型在每个数据样本周围具有局部平滑性,使得小扰动无法显著改变模型输出。在现代系统中,这种平滑性通常通过对抗训练获得,该方法显式地要求模型在扰动示例上表现良好。在本工作中,我们展示了通过仅在自然示例上正则化模型输入梯度的惊人有效性。惩罚输入梯度范数通常被认为是一种远不如其他方法的策略。我们的分析表明,梯度范数正则化的效果关键依赖于激活函数的平滑性,并且实际上在采用平滑激活函数(而非分段线性函数,如ReLU)的现代视觉Transformer中极为有效,这与先前的信念相悖。在ImageNet-1k数据集上,梯度范数训练达到的性能超过当前最先进的PGD-3对抗训练(52% vs. 56%)的90%,同时仅使用后者计算成本的60%(无需复杂的对抗优化)。我们的分析还突出了模型鲁棒性与自然输入梯度属性(如样本和通道统计的不对称性)之间的关系。令人惊讶的是,我们发现通过简单地正则化梯度使其集中在图像边缘(而无需显式条件梯度范数),可以显著提升模型鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Adversarially robust models are locally smooth around each data sample so that small perturbations cannot drastically change model outputs. In modern systems, such smoothness is usually obtained via Adversarial Training, which explicitly enforces models to perform well on perturbed examples. In this work, we show the surprising effectiveness of instead regularizing the gradient model inputs on natural examples only. Penalizing input Gradient Norm is commonly believed to be a much inferior approach. Our analyses identify that the performance of Gradient Norm regularization critically depends on the smoothness of activation functions, and are in fact extremely effective on modern vision transformers that adopt smooth activations over piecewise linear ones (, ReLU), contrary to prior belief. On ImageNet-1k, Gradient Norm training achieves > 90% the performance of state-of-the-art PGD-3 Adversarial Training (52% vs. 56%), while using only 60% computation cost of the state-of-the-art without complex adversarial optimization. Our analyses also highlight the relationship between model robustness and properties of natural input gradients, such as asymmetric sample and channel statistics. Surprisingly, we find model robustness can be significantly improved by simply regularizing its gradients to concentrate on image edges without explicit conditioning on the gradient norm.

title: Adriano D'Alessandro*, Ali Mahdavi-Amiri, Ghassan Hamarneh
title_en: Adriano D'Alessandro*, Ali Mahdavi-Amiri, Ghassan Hamarneh
abstract: 对象计数方法通常依赖于手动标注的数据集。创建此类数据集的成本限制了这些网络对特定类别(如人类或企鹅)对象的计数能力,而对多样类别对象的计数仍然是一个挑战。稳健的文本到图像潜在扩散模型(LDMs)的可用性引发了这些模型是否可以用于生成计数数据集的问题。然而,LDMs仅基于文本提示难以创建具有精确对象数量的图像,但它们可以通过在图像中添加和删除对象来提供可靠的排序信号。利用这些数据,我们首先引入了一种无监督排序方法,以学习与对象相关的特征,随后使用由LDMs生成的计数数据进行优化和锚定,以实现计数目的。此外,我们提出了一种密度分类器引导的方法,用于将图像划分为可以可靠计数的对象区域。因此,我们可以为任何类型的对象生成计数数据,并以无监督的方式进行计数。我们的方法优于无监督和少量样本的替代方案,并且不限于具有计数数据的特定对象类别。代码可在:github.com/adrian-dalessandro/AFreeCA.
abstract_en: Object counting methods typically rely on manually annotated datasets. The cost of creating such datasets has restricted the versatility of these networks to count objects from specific classes (such as humans or penguins), and counting objects from diverse categories remains a challenge. The availability of robust text-to-image latent diffusion models (LDMs) raises the question of whether these models can be utilized to generate counting datasets. However, LDMs struggle to create images with an exact number of objects based solely on text prompts but they can be used to offer a dependable sorting signal by adding and removing objects within an image. Leveraging this data, we initially introduce an unsupervised sorting methodology to learn object-related features that are subsequently refined and anchored for counting purposes using counting data generated by LDMs. Further, we present a density classifier-guided method for dividing an image into patches containing objects that can be reliably counted. Consequently, we can generate counting data for any type of object and count them in an unsupervised manner. Our approach outperforms unsupervised and few-shot alternatives and is not restricted to specific object classes for which counting data is available. Code available at: github.com/adrian-dalessandro/AFreeCA.

title: Aggelina Chatziagapi*, Grigorios Chrysos, Dimitris Samaras
title_en: Aggelina Chatziagapi*, Grigorios Chrysos, Dimitris Samaras
abstract: 我们引入了(Multi-Identity Gaussian Splatting),一种新颖的方法,仅使用单目视频,学习一个单一的神经表示来表征多个身份。近期针对人类化身的三维高斯点云(3DGS)方法需要为每个身份单独优化。然而,学习多身份表示在鲁棒地对任意姿态的人体进行动画化方面具有优势。我们提出构建一个高阶张量,整合所有训练身份的可学习3DGS参数。通过假设低秩结构并分解张量,我们在统一网络中建模多个主体的复杂刚性与非刚性变形,显著减少总参数数量。我们的方法利用所有训练身份的信息,能够在具有挑战性的未见姿态下实现鲁棒动画,优于现有方法。它还可以扩展以学习未见身份。项目页面:https://aggelinacha.github.io/MIGS/
abstract_en: We introduce (Multi-Identity Gaussian Splatting), a novel method that learns a single neural representation for multiple identities, using only monocular videos. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) approaches for human avatars require per-identity optimization. However, learning a multi-identity representation presents advantages in robustly animating humans under arbitrary poses. We propose to construct a high-order tensor that combines all the learnable 3DGS parameters for all the training identities. By assuming a low-rank structure and factorizing the tensor, we model the complex rigid and non-rigid deformations of multiple subjects in a unified network, significantly reducing the total number of parameters. Our proposed approach leverages information from all the training identities and enables robust animation under challenging unseen poses, outperforming existing approaches. It can also be extended to learn unseen identities. Project page: https://aggelinacha.github.io/MIGS/.

title: Agneet Chatterjee*, Gabriela Ben Melech Stan, Estelle Guez Aflalo, Sayak Paul, Dhruba Ghosh, Tejas Gokhale, Ludwig Schmidt, Hanna Hajishirzi, Vasudev Lal, Chitta R Baral, Yezhou Yang
title_en: Agneet Chatterjee*, Gabriela Ben Melech Stan, Estelle Guez Aflalo, Sayak Paul, Dhruba Ghosh, Tejas Gokhale, Ludwig Schmidt, Hanna Hajishirzi, Vasudev Lal, Chitta R Baral, Yezhou Yang
abstract: 当前文本到图像(T2I)模型的一个关键缺陷是其无法一致生成符合文本提示中指定空间关系的图像。本文对这一局限性进行了全面研究,同时开发了数据集和方法以支持改进T2I模型空间推理的算法解决方案。我们发现,空间关系在当前视觉-语言数据集的图像描述中代表性不足。为缓解这一数据瓶颈,我们创建了SPRIGHT,这是首个专注于空间关系的大型数据集,通过重新标注4个广泛使用的视觉数据集中的600万张图像,并通过三重评估与分析流程,证明SPRIGHT提高了现有数据集中空间关系的比例。我们通过展示仅使用约0.25%的SPRIGHT数据即可在生成空间准确图像方面实现22%的提升,同时改善FID和CMMD分数,证明了SPRIGHT数据的有效性。我们还发现,训练包含更多物体的图像可显著提升空间一致性,包括在T2I-CompBench上实现最先进的结果,空间得分为0.2133,通过在约500张图像上微调即可实现。通过一系列受控实验和消融实验,我们记录了其他发现,这些发现可能支持未来研究,以理解影响文本到图像模型空间一致性的因素。项目页面:https://spright-t2i.github.io/
abstract_en: One of the key shortcomings in current text-to-image (T2I) models is their inability to consistently generate images which faithfully follow the spatial relationships specified in the text prompt. In this paper, we offer a comprehensive investigation of this limitation, while also developing datasets and methods that support algorithmic solutions to improve spatial reasoning in T2I models. We find that spatial relationships are under-represented in the image descriptions found in current vision-language datasets. To alleviate this data bottleneck, we create SPRIGHT, the first spatially focused, large-scale dataset, by re-captioning 6 million images from 4 widely used vision datasets and through a 3-fold evaluation and analysis pipeline, show that SPRIGHT improves the proportion of spatial relationships in existing datasets. We show the efficacy of SPRIGHT data by showing that using only ∼0.25% of SPRIGHT results in a 22% improvement in generating spatially accurate images while also improving FID and CMMD scores. We also find that training on images containing a larger number of objects leads to substantial improvements in spatial consistency, including state-of-the-art results on T2I-CompBench with a spatial score of 0.2133, by fine-tuning on ¡500 images. Through a set of controlled experiments and ablations, we document additional findings that could support future work that seeks to understand factors that affect spatial consistency in text-to-image models. Project page : https://spright-t2i.github.io/

title: Agneet Chatterjee*, Yiran Luo, Tejas Gokhale, Yezhou Yang, Chitta R Baral
title_en: Agneet Chatterjee*, Yiran Luo, Tejas Gokhale, Yezhou Yang, Chitta R Baral
abstract: 文本到图像(T2I)和多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)已被应用于多种计算机视觉和多模态学习任务的解决方案中。然而,研究发现此类视觉-语言模型缺乏正确推理空间关系的能力。为解决这一缺陷,我们开发了REVISION框架,该框架提升了视觉-语言模型的空间保真度。REVISION是一个基于三维渲染的流程,可根据文本提示生成空间准确的合成图像。REVISION是一个可扩展框架,目前支持100多个三维资产、11种空间关系,且所有内容均包含多样化的摄像视角和背景。通过以无训练方式利用REVISION生成的图像作为额外指导,可显著提升T2I模型在所有空间关系上的空间一致性,在VISOR和T2I-CompBench基准测试中取得具有竞争力的性能。我们还设计了RevQA基准测试,用于评估MLLMs的空间推理能力,并发现当前最先进的模型在对抗性设置下对复杂空间推理的鲁棒性不足。我们的结果和发现表明,基于渲染的框架是开发空间感知生成模型的有效方法。代码和数据可访问:https://github.com/agneet42/revision
abstract_en: Text-to-Image (T2I) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have been adopted in solutions for several computer vision and multimodal learning tasks. However, it has been found that such vision-language models lack the ability to correctly reason over spatial relationships. To tackle this shortcoming, we develop the REVISION framework which improves spatial fidelity in vision-language models. REVISION is a 3D rendering based pipeline that generates spatially accurate synthetic images, given a textual prompt. REVISION is an extendable framework, which currently supports 100+ 3D assets, 11 spatial relationships, all with diverse camera perspectives and backgrounds. Leveraging images from REVISION as additional guidance in a training-free manner consistently improves the spatial consistency of T2I models across all spatial relationships, achieving competitive performance on the VISOR and T2I-CompBench benchmarks. We also design RevQA, a question-answering benchmark to evaluate the spatial reasoning abilities of MLLMs, and find that state-of-the-art models are not robust to complex spatial reasoning under adversarial settings. Our results and findings indicate that utilizing rendering-based frameworks is an effective approach for developing spatially-aware generative models. Code and data available at : https://github.com/agneet42/revision

title: Agrim Gupta*, Lijun Yu, Kihyuk Sohn, Xiuye Gu, Meera Hahn, Li Fei-Fei, Irfan Essa, Lu Jiang, Jose Lezama
title_en: Agrim Gupta*, Lijun Yu, Kihyuk Sohn, Xiuye Gu, Meera Hahn, Li Fei-Fei, Irfan Essa, Lu Jiang, Jose Lezama
abstract: 我们提出了一种扩散变换器,用于从文本提示生成逼真视频。我们的方法有两个关键设计决策。首先,我们使用因果编码器在统一的潜在空间中联合压缩图像和视频,从而实现跨模态的训练和生成。其次,为了提高内存和训练效率,我们采用了一种专门针对联合空间和时空生成建模的窗口注意力架构。这些设计决策的结合使我们能够在不使用无分类器引导的情况下,在已有的视频(UCF-101和Kinetics-600)和图像(ImageNet)生成基准测试中达到最先进的性能。最后,我们还训练了一个由三个模型组成的级联结构,用于文本到视频生成任务,包括一个基础潜在视频扩散模型和两个视频超分辨率扩散模型,以生成分辨率为512 × 896、每秒8帧的视频。
abstract_en: We present , a diffusion transformer for photorealistic video generation from text prompts. Our approach has two key design decisions. First, we use a causal encoder to jointly compress images and videos within a unified latent space, enabling training and generation across modalities. Second, for memory and training efficiency, we use a window attention architecture tailored for joint spatial and spatiotemporal generative modeling. Taken together these design decisions enable us to achieve state-of-the-art performance on established video (UCF-101 and Kinetics-600) and image (ImageNet) generation benchmarks without using classifier free guidance. Finally, we also train a cascade of three models for the task of text-to-video generation consisting of a base latent video diffusion model, and two video super-resolution diffusion models to generate videos of 512 × 896 resolution at 8 frames per second.

title: Ahmad Khaliq, Ming Xu, Stephen Hausler, Michael J Milford, Sourav Garg*
title_en: Ahmad Khaliq, Ming Xu, Stephen Hausler, Michael J Milford, Sourav Garg*
abstract: 视觉位置识别(VPR)是许多具身智能体视觉定位管道中的关键组件。VPR通常被表述为一个图像检索任务,旨在联合学习局部特征和聚合方法。当前最先进的VPR方法依赖于VLAD聚合,该方法可以通过特征对聚类中心的软分配来学习特征的加权贡献。然而,这一过程存在两个关键限制。首先,特征到聚类的加权未考虑聚类内过度表示的重复结构(例如阴影或窗格),这种现象也被称为“突发性”问题,传统上通过在聚合前对重复特征进行折扣来解决。其次,对于具有高维局部特征的最先进图像编码器,特征到聚类的比较计算密集。本文通过引入VLAD-BuFF解决了这些限制,提出了两项创新贡献:i)基于自相似性的特征折扣机制,以在端到端VPR训练中学习突发感知特征;ii)通过PCA初始化的可学习预投影减少局部特征维度以实现快速特征聚合。我们在9个公开数据集上对方法进行了基准测试,其中VLAD-BuFF设定了新的最先进水平。我们的方法即使在局部特征维度减少12倍的情况下仍能保持高召回率,从而在不牺牲召回率的前提下实现快速特征聚合。通过额外的定性研究,我们展示了所提出的加权方法如何有效降低非独特特征的权重。源代码:https://github.com/Ahmedest61/VLAD-BuFF/.
abstract_en: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) is a crucial component of many visual localization pipelines for embodied agents. VPR is often formulated as an image retrieval task aimed at jointly learning local features and an aggregation method. The current state-of-the-art VPR methods rely on VLAD aggregation, which can be trained to learn a weighted contribution of features through their soft assignment to cluster centers. However, this process has two key limitations. Firstly, the feature-to-cluster weighting does not account for over-represented repetitive structures within a cluster, e.g., shadows or window panes; this phenomenon is also referred to as the ‘burstiness’ problem, classically solved by discounting repetitive features before aggregation. Secondly, feature to cluster comparisons are compute-intensive for state-of-the-art image encoders with high-dimensional local features. This paper addresses these limitations by introducing VLAD-BuFF with two novel contributions: i) a self-similarity based feature discounting mechanism to learn Burst-aware features within end-to-end VPR training, and ii) Fast Feature aggregation by reducing local feature dimensions specifically through PCA-initialized learnable pre-projection. We benchmark our method on 9 public datasets, where VLAD-BuFF sets a new state of the art. Our method is able to maintain its high recall even for 12× reduced local feature dimensions, thus enabling fast feature aggregation without compromising on recall. Through additional qualitative studies, we show how our proposed weighting method effectively downweights the non-distinctive features. Source code: https://github.com/Ahmedest61/VLAD-BuFF/.

title: Ahmad Rezaei*, Mohammad Akbari*, Saeed Ranjbar Alvar, Arezou Fatemi, Yong Zhang*
title_en: Ahmad Rezaei*, Mohammad Akbari*, Saeed Ranjbar Alvar, Arezou Fatemi, Yong Zhang*
abstract: 随着生成模型能够生成与真实图像难以区分的高质量图像,人们对AI生成图像的恶意使用产生了越来越多的担忧。不可感知的图像水印技术是应对这一问题的可行方案之一。先前的水印方法将图像映射到潜在空间以添加水印。此外,潜在扩散模型(LDM)在预训练自动编码器的潜在空间中生成图像。我们认为,这一潜在空间可以用于将水印技术整合到生成过程中。为此,我们提出了LaWa,一种专为LDM设计的生成过程中图像水印方法。通过使用由粗到细的水印嵌入模块,LaWa修改了预训练自动编码器的潜在空间,在保持图像感知质量的同时,实现了对广泛图像变换的高度鲁棒性。我们证明LaWa也可作为通用图像水印方法。通过大量实验,我们展示了LaWa在感知质量、对抗攻击的鲁棒性以及计算复杂度方面均优于先前工作,同时具有极低的误报率。代码可在以下链接获取。
abstract_en: With generative models producing high quality images that are indistinguishable from real ones, there is growing concern regarding the malicious usage of AI-generated images. Imperceptible image watermarking is one viable solution towards such concerns. Prior watermarking methods map the image to a latent space for adding the watermark. Moreover, Latent Diffusion Models (LDM) generate the image in the latent space of a pre-trained autoencoder. We argue that this latent space can be used to integrate watermarking into the generation process. To this end, we present LaWa, an in-generation image watermarking method designed for LDMs. By using coarse-to-fine watermark embedding modules, LaWa modifies the latent space of pre-trained autoencoders and achieves high robustness against a wide range of image transformations while preserving perceptual quality of the image. We show that LaWa can also be used as a general image watermarking method. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that LaWa outperforms previous works in perceptual quality, robustness against attacks, and computational complexity, while having very low false positive rate. Code is available here.

title: Ahmad Sajedi*, Samir Khaki, Lucy Z. Liu, Ehsan Amjadian, Yuri A. Lawryshyn, Konstantinos N. Plataniotis
title_en: Ahmad Sajedi*, Samir Khaki, Lucy Z. Liu, Ehsan Amjadian, Yuri A. Lawryshyn, Konstantinos N. Plataniotis
abstract: 数据集蒸馏旨在将大规模真实数据集的知识蒸馏到小型但具有信息量的合成数据中,使得在该数据上训练的模型性能与在完整数据集上训练的模型相当。尽管近期取得了一定进展,现有数据集蒸馏方法在计算效率、对复杂高分辨率数据集的可扩展性以及对深度架构的泛化能力方面仍存在挑战。这些方法通常需要在蒸馏比例变化时重新训练模型,因为知识是嵌入到原始像素中的。本文提出了一种名为数据到模型蒸馏(D2M)的新型框架,通过将真实图像和生成图像中提取的丰富表示进行对齐,将真实数据集的知识蒸馏到预训练生成模型的可学习参数中。学习到的生成模型随后可以为不同蒸馏比例和深度架构生成具有信息量的训练图像。在15个不同分辨率数据集上的大量实验表明,D2M在性能、重新蒸馏效率和跨架构泛化能力方面均表现出色。我们的方法有效扩展至高分辨率128×128 ImageNet-1K数据集。此外,我们验证了D2M在神经架构搜索等下游应用中的实际优势。
abstract_en: Dataset distillation aims to distill the knowledge of a large-scale real dataset into small yet informative synthetic data such that a model trained on it performs as well as a model trained on the full dataset. Despite recent progress, existing dataset distillation methods often struggle with computational efficiency, scalability to complex high-resolution datasets, and generalizability to deep architectures. These approaches typically require retraining when the distillation ratio changes, as knowledge is embedded in raw pixels. In this paper, we propose a novel framework called Data-to-Model Distillation (D2M) to distill the real dataset’s knowledge into the learnable parameters of a pre-trained generative model by aligning rich representations extracted from real and generated images. The learned generative model can then produce informative training images for different distillation ratios and deep architectures. Extensive experiments on 15 datasets of varying resolutions show D2M’s superior performance, re-distillation efficiency, and cross-architecture generalizability. Our method effectively scales up to high-resolution 128×128 ImageNet-1K. Furthermore, we verify D2M’s practical benefits for downstream applications in neural architecture search.

title: Akin Caliskan*, Berkay Kicanaoglu, Hyeongwoo Kim
title_en: Akin Caliskan*, Berkay Kicanaoglu, Hyeongwoo Kim
abstract: 我们提出PAV(个性化头部虚拟形象),用于在任意视角和面部表情下合成人脸。PAV引入了一种方法,通过学习动态可变形神经辐射场(NeRF),特别是从同一角色在不同外观和形状变化下的单目说话面部视频集合中进行学习。与现有仅基于单个外观建模输入视频的头部NeRF方法不同,我们的方法允许学习多外观NeRF,通过可学习的潜在神经特征附加到基础几何结构上,为每个输入视频引入外观嵌入。此外,所提出的外观条件密度公式有助于在辐射场预测中实现角色形状的变化,例如胡须和软组织。据我们所知,我们的方法是首个在统一网络中建模同一主体多外观的外观和形状变化的动态可变形NeRF框架。我们在多种主体上的定量和定性研究中实验证明,PAV在视觉渲染质量上优于基线方法。
abstract_en: We propose PAV, Personalized Head Avatar for the synthesis of human faces under arbitrary viewpoints and facial expressions. PAV introduces a method that learns a dynamic deformable neural radiance field (NeRF), in particular from a collection of monocular talking face videos of the same character under various appearance and shape changes. Unlike existing head NeRF methods that are limited to modeling such input videos on a per-appearance basis, our method allows for learning multi-appearance NeRFs, introducing appearance embedding for each input video via learnable latent neural features attached to the underlying geometry. Furthermore, the proposed appearance-conditioned density formulation facilitates the shape variation of the character, such as facial hair and soft tissues, in the radiance field prediction. To the best of our knowledge, our approach is the first dynamic deformable NeRF framework to model appearance and shape variations in a single unified network for multi-appearances of the same subject. We demonstrate experimentally that PAV outperforms the baseline method in terms of visual rendering quality in our quantitative and qualitative studies on various subjects.

title: Akshat Ramachandran*, Souvik Kundu*, Tushar Krishna*
title_en: Akshat Ramachandran*, Souvik Kundu*, Tushar Krishna*
abstract: 我们提出CLAMP-ViT,一种用于视觉Transformer(ViTs)的无数据后训练量化方法。我们识别了现有技术的局限性,特别是其无法利用有意义的块间关系,导致生成简单且语义模糊的数据,影响量化精度。CLAMP-ViT采用两阶段方法,在数据生成和模型量化之间循环适应。具体而言,我们引入块级对比学习方案以生成更丰富、语义明确的数据。此外,我们利用对比学习在逐层进化搜索中实现固定精度和混合精度量化,以识别最优量化参数,同时缓解非平滑损失景观的影响。在各类视觉任务的广泛评估中,CLAMP-ViT表现出优越性能,在相似或更优压缩比下,分类任务Top-1准确率提升最高达3%,目标检测mAP提升0.6,分割任务mIoU提升1.5。代码可在https: //github.com/georgia-tech-synergy-lab/CLAMP-ViT.git获取
abstract_en: We present CLAMP-ViT, a data-free post-training quantization method for vision transformers (ViTs). We identify the limitations of recent techniques, notably their inability to leverage meaningful inter-patch relationships, leading to the generation of simplistic and semantically vague data, impacting quantization accuracy. CLAMP-ViT employs a two-stage approach, cyclically adapting between data generation and model quantization. Specifically, we incorporate a patch-level contrastive learning scheme to generate richer, semantically meaningful data. Furthermore, we leverage contrastive learning in layer-wise evolutionary search for fixed- and mixed-precision quantization to identify optimal quantization parameters while mitigating the effects of a non-smooth loss landscape. Extensive evaluations across various vision tasks demonstrate the superiority of CLAMP-ViT, with performance improvements of up to 3% in top-1 accuracy for classification, 0.6 mAP for object detection, and 1.5 mIoU for segmentation at similar or better compression ratio over existing alternatives. Code is available at https: //github.com/georgia-tech-synergy-lab/CLAMP-ViT.git

title: Akshay Krishnan*, Abhijit Kundu*, Kevis-Kokitsi Maninis, James Hays, Matthew Brown
title_en: Akshay Krishnan*, Abhijit Kundu*, Kevis-Kokitsi Maninis, James Hays, Matthew Brown
abstract: 我们提出OmniNOCS,这是一个大规模的单目数据集,包含3D归一化物体坐标空间(NOCS)图、物体掩码和3D边界框标注,适用于室内外场景。OmniNOCS的物体类别数量是现有NOCS数据集(NOCS-Real275、Wild6D)的20倍,实例数量是200倍。我们利用OmniNOCS训练了一个新颖的基于Transformer的单目NOCS预测模型(NOCSformer),该模型能够从2D物体检测中预测出准确的NOCS、实例掩码和姿态,适用于多种类别。这是首个能够通过2D框提示泛化到广泛类别的NOCS模型。我们在3D定向边界框预测任务上评估了该模型,其结果与最先进的3D检测方法(如__ABS_MATH_1__)相当。与其他3D检测方法不同,我们的模型还提供了详细且精确的3D物体形状和分割信息。我们基于OmniNOCS提出了一个新颖的NOCS预测基准测试,希望为该领域的未来研究提供有用的基线。我们的数据集和代码将在项目网站上发布:https://omninocs.github.io。
abstract_en: We propose OmniNOCS, a large-scale monocular dataset with 3D Normalized Object Coordinate Space (NOCS) maps, object masks, and 3D bounding box annotations for indoor and outdoor scenes. OmniNOCS has 20 times more object classes and 200 times more instances than existing NOCS datasets (NOCS-Real275, Wild6D). We use OmniNOCS to train a novel, transformer-based monocular NOCS prediction model (NOCSformer) that can predict accurate NOCS, instance masks and poses from 2D object detections across diverse classes. It is the first NOCS model that can generalize to a broad range of classes when prompted with 2D boxes. We evaluate our model on the task of 3D oriented bounding box prediction, where it achieves comparable results to state-of-the-art 3D detection methods such as . Unlike other 3D detection methods, our model also provides detailed and accurate 3D object shape and segmentation. We propose a novel benchmark for the task of NOCS prediction based on OmniNOCS, which we hope will serve as a useful baseline for future work in this area. Our dataset and code will be at the project website: https://omninocs.github.io.

title_en: Akshay Kulkarni*, Tsui-Wei Weng
abstract_en: We propose a novel and low-cost test-time adversarial defense by devising interpretability-guided neuron importance ranking methods to identify neurons important to the output classes. Our method is a training-free approach that can significantly improve the robustness-accuracy tradeoff while incurring minimal computational overhead. While being among the most efficient test-time defenses (4× faster), our method is also robust to a wide range of black-box, white-box, and adaptive attacks that break previous test-time defenses. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method for CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and ImageNet-1k on the standard RobustBench benchmark (with average gains of 2.6%, 4.9%, and 2.8% respectively). We also show improvements (average 1.5%) over the state-of-the-art test-time defenses even under strong adaptive attacks.

title: Akshay Paruchuri*, Samuel Ehrenstein, Shuxian Wang, Inbar Fried, Stephen Pizer, Marc Niethammer, Roni Sengupta
title_en: Akshay Paruchuri*, Samuel Ehrenstein, Shuxian Wang, Inbar Fried, Stephen Pizer, Marc Niethammer, Roni Sengupta
abstract: 在内窥镜视频中进行单目深度估计可以辅助和机器人手术获得更好的器官覆盖度以及检测各种健康问题。尽管主流自然图像深度估计取得了显著进展,但由于缺乏强几何特征和具有挑战性的光照效果,现有技术在内窥镜图像上表现不佳。本文中,我们利用光度线索,即内窥镜发出的光和表面反射的光,来改进单目深度估计。我们首先创建了两种新颖的损失函数,包括监督和自监督变体,这些损失函数利用逐像素阴影表示。随后,我们提出了一种新的深度细化网络(PPSNet),该网络利用相同的逐像素阴影表示。最后,我们引入了教师-学生迁移学习方法,从带有监督的合成数据和带有自监督的临床数据中生成更优的深度图。我们在C3VD数据集上取得了最先进的结果,同时从临床数据中估计出高质量的深度图。我们的代码、预训练模型和补充材料可在项目页面找到:https://ppsnet.github.io/
abstract_en: Monocular depth estimation in endoscopy videos can enable assistive and robotic surgery to obtain better coverage of the organ and detection of various health issues. Despite promising progress on mainstream, natural image depth estimation, techniques perform poorly on endoscopy images due to a lack of strong geometric features and challenging illumination effects. In this paper, we utilize the photometric cues, i.e., the light emitted from an endoscope and reflected by the surface, to improve monocular depth estimation. We first create two novel loss functions with supervised and self-supervised variants that utilize a per-pixel shading representation. We then propose a novel depth refinement network (PPSNet) that leverages the same per-pixel shading representation. Finally, we introduce teacher-student transfer learning to produce better depth maps from both synthetic data with supervision and clinical data with self-supervision. We achieve state-of-the-art results on the C3VD dataset while estimating high-quality depth maps from clinical data. Our code, pre-trained models, and supplementary materials can be found on our project page: https://ppsnet.github.io/.

title: Alakh Desai*, Nuno Vasconcelos
title_en: Alakh Desai*, Nuno Vasconcelos
abstract: 在使用扩散模型(DMs)进行图像生成时,可以通过负提示n来补充文本提示p,帮助定义合成图像中不希望出现的属性。虽然这有助于提升提示遵循性与图像质量,但寻找良好的负提示具有挑战性。我们认为这源于人类与扩散模型之间的语义鸿沟,使得对扩散模型有效的负提示在人类看来显得不直观。为弥合这一鸿沟,我们提出了一种新的扩散负提示()策略。该策略基于一种新方法,通过在扩散模型分布下采样最不符合p的图像,称为扩散负采样()。给定p,采样得到一张图像,随后由用户或图像描述模型将其转换为自然语言,生成负提示n∗。最终使用(p, n∗)对扩散模型进行提示。该方法易于实现且无需训练。实验与人类评估表明,该方法在定量和定性方面均表现优异,并可轻松与多种扩散模型变体结合。
abstract_en: For image generation with diffusion models (DMs), a negative prompt n can be used to complement the text prompt p, helping define properties not desired in the synthesized image. While this improves prompt adherence and image quality, finding good negative prompts is challenging. We argue that this is due to a semantic gap between humans and DMs, which makes good negative prompts for DMs appear unintuitive to humans. To bridge this gap, we propose a new diffusion-negative prompting () strategy. is based on a new procedure to sample images that are least compliant with p under the distribution of the DM, denoted as diffusion-negative sampling (). Given p, one such image is sampled, which is then translated into natural language by the user or a captioning model, to produce the negative prompt n∗ . The pair (p, n∗ ) is finally used to prompt the DM. is straightforward to implement and requires no training. Experiments and human evaluations show that performs well both quantitatively and qualitatively and can be easily combined with several DM variants.

title: Alberto Hojel*, Yutong Bai, Trevor Darrell, Amir Globerson, Amir Bar*
title_en: Alberto Hojel*, Yutong Bai, Trevor Darrell, Amir Globerson, Amir Bar*
abstract: 视觉提示是一种通过上下文示例教授模型执行视觉任务的技术,无需额外训练。在本研究中,我们分析了近期的视觉提示模型MAE-VQGAN的激活情况,发现任务向量,即编码任务特定信息的激活。基于这一洞察,我们证明可以通过识别任务向量并利用它们引导网络执行不同任务,而无需提供任何上下文输入输出示例。为找到任务向量,我们计算模型中每个任务的注意力头平均激活,并使用REINFORCE算法将新查询图像补丁应用于其中一部分。结果表明,这些任务向量能够引导模型比原始模型更有效地执行任务。1 1 代码和模型见www.github.com/alhojel/visual_task_vectors
abstract_en: Visual Prompting is a technique for teaching models to perform a visual task via in-context examples, without any additional training. In this work, we analyze the activations of MAE-VQGAN, a recent Visual Prompting model [?], and find Task Vectors, activations that encode task-specific information. Equipped with this insight, we demonstrate that it is possible to identify the Task Vectors and use them to guide the network towards performing different tasks without having to provide any in-context input-output examples. To find Task Vectors, we compute the mean activations of the attention heads in the model per task and use the REINFORCE [?] algorithm to patch into a subset of them with a new query image. The resulting Task Vectors guide the model towards performing the task better than the original model.1 1 For code and models see www.github.com/alhojel/visual_task_vectors

title: Aleksandar Shtedritski*, Christian Rupprecht, Andrea Vedaldi
title_en: Aleksandar Shtedritski*, Christian Rupprecht, Andrea Vedaldi
abstract: 规范表面映射通过将物体的每个像素分配到3D模板中的对应点,扩展了关键点检测。由DensePose推广用于人体分析后,作者尝试将其应用于更多类别,但由于手动监督的高成本,成果有限。本文提出了一种无需手动监督的方法,该方法在大多数类别上均优于监督方法。我们的核心思想是利用DINO和Stable Diffusion等开放性基础计算机视觉模型,这些模型对自然类别具有出色的先验知识。该方法将图像到模板的对应估计问题转化为利用基础模型特征进行图像到图像的对应预测。通过将物体图像与非写实模板渲染进行匹配,模拟了手动标注的收集过程。这些对应关系随后用于监督任意感兴趣物体的高质量规范映射。我们还表明,图像生成器可以进一步提升模板视图的逼真度,为模型提供额外的监督来源。
abstract_en: Canonical surface mapping generalizes keypoint detection by assigning each pixel of an object to a corresponding point in a 3D template. Popularised by DensePose for the analysis of humans, authors have since attempted to apply the concept to more categories, but with limited success due to the high cost of manual supervision. In this work, we introduce , a method to learn canonical maps without manual supervision which achieves better results than supervised methods for most categories. Our idea is to leverage foundation computer vision models such as DINO and Stable Diffusion that are open-ended and thus possess excellent priors over natural categories. reduces the problem of estimating image-to-template correspondences to predicting image-to-image correspondences using features from the foundation models. The reduction works by matching images of the object to non-photorealistic renders of the template, which emulates the process of collecting manual annotations for this task. These correspondences are then used to supervise high-quality canonical maps for any object of interest. We also show that image generators can further improve the realism of the template views, which provide an additional source of supervision for the model.

title: Alessio Sampieri*, Alessio Palma, Indro Spinelli, Fabio Galasso
title_en: Alessio Sampieri*, Alessio Palma, Indro Spinelli, Fabio Galasso
abstract: 合成人类运动的目标持续时间是一个关键属性,需要对运动动力学和风格进行建模控制。加快动作表现不仅仅是快进。然而,最先进的技术在人类行为合成方面对目标序列长度的控制有限。我们引入了从文本描述符生成长度感知的3D人类运动序列的问题,并提出了一种新的模型来合成可变目标长度的运动,我们称之为“长度感知潜在扩散模型”(LADiff)。LADiff包含两个新模块:1)一个长度感知变分自编码器,用于学习具有长度依赖潜在编码的运动表示;2)一个符合长度的潜在扩散模型,用于生成细节丰富的运动,其细节随着所需目标序列长度的增加而增加。LADiff在两个已建立的基准HumanML3D和KIT-ML上,大多数现有运动合成指标上显著优于最先进的技术。代码可在https://github.com/AlessioSam/LADiff获取。
abstract_en: The target duration of a synthesized human motion is a critical attribute that requires modeling control over the motion dynamics and style. Speeding up an action performance is not merely fast-forwarding it. However, state-of-the-art techniques for human behavior synthesis have limited control over the target sequence length. We introduce the problem of generating length-aware 3D human motion sequences from textual descriptors, and we propose a novel model to synthesize motions of variable target lengths, which we dub “Length-Aware Latent Diffusion” (LADiff ). LADiff consists of two new modules: 1) a length-aware variational auto-encoder to learn motion representations with length-dependent latent codes; 2) a length-conforming latent diffusion model to generate motions with a richness of details that increases with the required target sequence length. LADiff significantly improves over the state-of-the-art across most of the existing motion synthesis metrics on the two established benchmarks of HumanML3D and KIT-ML. The code is available at https://github.com/AlessioSam/LADiff.

title: Alex Gomez-Villa*, Dipam Goswami, Kai Wang, Andy Bagdanov, Bartlomiej Twardowski, Joost van de Weijer
title_en: Alex Gomez-Villa*, Dipam Goswami, Kai Wang, Andy Bagdanov, Bartlomiej Twardowski, Joost van de Weijer
abstract: 使用从头训练的主干网络并从一个小的初始任务开始的无示例类别增量学习,对持续表示学习提出了重大挑战。基于原型的方法在持续更新时面临关键问题,即由于语义漂移,旧类原型会漂移到新特征空间中的不同位置。通过分析基于原型的持续学习,我们证明遗忘并非由于特征提取器判别能力的下降,且可能通过漂移补偿进行纠正。为解决这一问题,我们提出可学习的漂移补偿(LDC),可有效缓解任何移动主干网络的漂移,无论其是监督还是无监督的。LDC可快速且直接地集成到现有持续学习方法中。此外,我们展示了如何将LDC与自监督CL方法结合,首次实现了无示例的半监督持续学习方法。我们在多个数据集的监督和半监督设置中均取得了最先进的性能。代码可在https: //github.com/alviur/ldc获取。
abstract_en: Exemplar-free class-incremental learning using a backbone trained from scratch and starting from a small first task presents a significant challenge for continual representation learning. Prototype-based approaches, when continually updated, face the critical issue of semantic drift due to which the old class prototypes drift to different positions in the new feature space. Through an analysis of prototype-based continual learning, we show that forgetting is not due to diminished discriminative power of the feature extractor, and can potentially be corrected by drift compensation. To address this, we propose Learnable Drift Compensation (LDC), which can effectively mitigate drift in any moving backbone, whether supervised or unsupervised. LDC is fast and straightforward to integrate on top of existing continual learning approaches. Furthermore, we showcase how LDC can be applied in combination with self-supervised CL methods, resulting in the first exemplar-free semi-supervised continual learning approach. We achieve state-of-the-art performance in both supervised and semi-supervised settings across multiple datasets. Code is available at https: //github.com/alviur/ldc.

title: Alex Rich*, Noah Stier, Pradeep Sen, Tobias Hollerer
title_en: Alex Rich*, Noah Stier, Pradeep Sen, Tobias Hollerer
abstract: 尽管无监督多视角立体视觉(MVS)取得了显著进展,其核心损失函数设计自引入以来基本保持不变。然而,我们识别出该核心损失函数设计的基本局限性,并提出了三项重大改进以提升深度先验、遮挡和视角依赖效应的建模能力。首先,我们通过钳制深度平滑性约束消除预测深度图中显著的阶梯状和边缘伪影。其次,我们提出了一种学习视角合成方法,生成用于光度损失的图像,避免使用手动编码启发式方法处理视角依赖效应。最后,我们采样超出MVS输入使用的额外视角进行监督,挑战网络预测与未见视角匹配的深度。这些贡献共同形成了一种改进的监督策略,我们称之为loss。我们的loss的关键优势在于可轻松集成到现有无监督MVS训练流程中,在竞争性重建基准测试中实现显著提升,并以极低的训练成本在物体边界处实现大幅改善的定性性能。
abstract_en: Despite significant progress in unsupervised multi-view stereo (MVS), the core loss formulation has remained largely unchanged since its introduction. However, we identify fundamental limitations to this core loss and propose three major changes to improve the modeling of depth priors, occlusion, and view-dependent effects. First, we eliminate prominent stair-stepping and edge artifacts in predicted depth maps using a clamped depth-smoothness constraint. Second, we propose a learned view-synthesis approach to generate an image for photometric loss, avoiding the use of hand-coded heuristics for handling view-dependent effects. Finally, we sample additional views for supervision beyond those used as MVS input, challenging the network to predict depth that matches unseen views. Together, these contributions form an improved supervision strategy we call loss. The key advantage of our loss is that it can be easily dropped into existing unsupervised MVS training pipelines, resulting in significant improvements on competitive reconstruction benchmarks and drastically better qualitative performance around object boundaries for minimal training cost.

title: Alexander Timans*, Christoph-Nikolas Straehle, Kaspar Sakmann, Eric Nalisnick
title_en: Alexander Timans*, Christoph-Nikolas Straehle, Kaspar Sakmann, Eric Nalisnick
abstract: 量化模型的预测不确定性对于自动驾驶等安全关键型应用至关重要。我们考虑在多目标检测中量化此类不确定性。特别是,我们利用符合性预测来获得具有保证覆盖范围的物体边界框不确定性区间。在此过程中面临的一个挑战是,边界框预测依赖于物体的类别标签。因此,我们开发了一种新颖的两步符合性方法,将预测类别标签的不确定性传播到边界框的不确定性区间中。这扩展了我们符合性覆盖保证的有效性,使其包含被错误分类的物体,从而提供更具操作性的安全保证。此外,我们研究了新颖的集成和分位数回归公式,以确保边界框区间能适应物体尺寸,实现更均衡的覆盖。在现实世界数据集上验证我们的两步方法,发现所需的覆盖水平可通过实际紧密的预测不确定性区间实现。
abstract_en: Quantifying a model’s predictive uncertainty is essential for safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. We consider quantifying such uncertainty for multi-object detection. In particular, we leverage conformal prediction to obtain uncertainty intervals with guaranteed coverage for object bounding boxes. One challenge in doing so is that bounding box predictions are conditioned on the object’s class label. Thus, we develop a novel two-step conformal approach that propagates uncertainty in predicted class labels into the uncertainty intervals of bounding boxes. This broadens the validity of our conformal coverage guarantees to include incorrectly classified objects, thus offering more actionable safety assurances. Moreover, we investigate novel ensemble and quantile regression formulations to ensure the bounding box intervals are adaptive to object size, leading to a more balanced coverage. Validating our two-step approach on real-world datasets for 2D bounding box localization, we find that desired coverage levels are satisfied with practically tight predictive uncertainty intervals.

title: Alexander Veicht*, Paul-Edouard Sarlin*, Philipp Lindenberger, Marc Pollefeys
title_en: Alexander Veicht*, Paul-Edouard Sarlin*, Philipp Lindenberger, Marc Pollefeys
abstract: 从单张图像中,视觉线索可以帮助推断焦距和重力方向等内参和外参相机参数。这种单图像标定可以受益于各种下游应用,如图像编辑和3D映射。目前针对该问题的方法基于两种方式:一种是基于直线和消失点的经典几何方法,另一种是端到端训练的深度神经网络。学习方法在鲁棒性上更强,但在泛化到新环境时表现较差,且其精度不如经典方法。我们假设这些方法缺乏3D几何提供的约束。在本文中,我们引入了一个深度神经网络,通过优化过程利用3D几何的普遍规则。该网络端到端训练以估计相机参数,并学会从数据中发现有用的视觉线索。在各种基准上的实验表明,该方法比现有的经典和学习方法更加鲁棒和准确。其内部优化估计不确定性,有助于标记失败案例,并受益于下游应用如视觉定位。代码和训练模型在https://github.com/cvg/GeoCalib公开可用。
abstract_en: From a single image, visual cues can help deduce intrinsic and extrinsic camera parameters like the focal length and the gravity direction. This single-image calibration can benefit various downstream applications like image editing and 3D mapping. Current approaches to this problem are based on either classical geometry with lines and vanishing points or on deep neural networks trained end-to-end. The learned approaches are more robust but struggle to generalize to new environments and are less accurate than their classical counterparts. We hypothesize that they lack the constraints that 3D geometry provides. In this work, we introduce , a deep neural network that leverages universal rules of 3D geometry through an optimization process. is trained end-to-end to estimate camera parameters and learns to find useful visual cues from the data. Experiments on various benchmarks show that is more robust and more accurate than existing classical and learned approaches. Its internal optimization estimates uncertainties, which help flag failure cases and benefit downstream applications like visual localization. The code and trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/cvg/GeoCalib.

title: Alexandre Eymaël, Renaud Vandeghen*, Anthony Cioppa, Silvio Giancola, Bernard Ghanem, Marc Van Droogenbroeck
title_en: Alexandre Eymaël, Renaud Vandeghen*, Anthony Cioppa, Silvio Giancola, Bernard Ghanem, Marc Van Droogenbroeck
abstract: 图像编码器的自监督预训练在文献中普遍存在,尤其是在掩码自编码器(MAE)引入之后。当前的研究尝试从视频中的运动中学习以物体为中心的表示。特别是,SiamMAE最近引入了一种孪生网络,通过从视频的两个帧中训练具有共享权重的编码器,并采用高非对称掩码比例(95%)。在本文中,我们提出了一种替代方法CropMAE,用于SiamMAE引入的孪生预训练。我们的方法通过仅考虑来自同一图像但裁剪方式不同的裁剪图像对,与传统从视频中提取帧对的方法不同。因此,CropMAE消除了对视频数据集的需求,同时保持了具有竞争力的性能,并大幅减少了预训练和学习时间。此外,我们证明了CropMAE可以在没有显式运动的情况下学习相似的以物体为中心的表示,表明当前的自监督学习方法并非通过显式的物体运动学习此类表示,而是得益于两个视图之间隐含的图像变换。最后,CropMAE实现了迄今为止最高的掩码比例(98.5%),使得仅使用两个可见块即可重建图像。我们的代码可在https://github.com/alexandre-eymael/CropMAE获取。
abstract_en: Self-supervised pre-training of image encoders is omnipresent in the literature, particularly following the introduction of Masked autoencoders (MAE). Current efforts attempt to learn object-centric representations from motion in videos. In particular, SiamMAE recently introduced a Siamese network, training a shared-weight encoder from two frames of a video with a high asymmetric masking ratio (95%). In this work, we propose CropMAE, an alternative approach to the Siamese pre-training introduced by SiamMAE. Our method specifically differs by exclusively considering pairs of cropped images sourced from the same image but cropped differently, deviating from the conventional pairs of frames extracted from a video. CropMAE therefore alleviates the need for video datasets, while maintaining competitive performances and drastically reducing pre-training and learning time. Furthermore, we demonstrate that CropMAE learns similar object-centric representations without explicit motion, showing that current self-supervised learning methods do not learn such representations from explicit object motion, but rather thanks to the implicit image transformations that occur between the two views. Finally, CropMAE achieves the highest masking ratio to date (98.5%), enabling the reconstruction of images using only two visible patches. Our code is available at https://github.com/alexandre-eymael/ CropMAE.

title: Ali Cheraghian*, Zeeshan Hayder, Sameeea Ramasinghe, Shafin Rahman, Javad Jafaryahya, Lars Petersson, Mehrtash Harandi
title_en: Ali Cheraghian*, Zeeshan Hayder, Sameeea Ramasinghe, Shafin Rahman, Javad Jafaryahya, Lars Petersson, Mehrtash Harandi
abstract: 近年来,鲁棒的预训练基础模型已被成功应用于许多下游任务。在此,我们希望利用此类强大模型解决3D点云对象上的少样本类别增量学习(FSCIL)任务。我们的方法是将广为人知的基于CLIP的基础模型(在2D图像和文本对上训练)重新编程以实现此目的。CLIP模型通过输入2D图像进行工作,因此为了在我们的上下文中利用它,我们将3D物体点云投影到2D图像空间以创建适当的深度图。为此,先前的工作考虑了一组固定且不可训练的相机姿态。相反,我们提出训练网络以找到最佳描述物体并适合从CLIP视觉编码器提取2D图像特征的投影。直接使用生成的深度图不适合CLIP模型,因此我们应用模型重编程范式对深度图进行处理,以增强前景和背景以适应它。这消除了对基础模型进行修改或微调的需要。在我们研究的设置中,我们对新类别的数据访问有限,导致过拟合问题。在此,我们通过使用多个GPT生成的文本描述的提示工程方法来解决此问题。我们的方法C3PR在ModelNet、ShapeNet、ScanObjectNN和CO3D数据集上成功超越了现有的FSCIL方法。代码可在https://github.com/alichr/C3PR获取。
abstract_en: In recent years, robust pre-trained foundation models have been successfully used in many downstream tasks. Here, we would like to use such powerful models to address the problem of few-shot class incremental learning (FSCIL) tasks on 3D point cloud objects. Our approach is to reprogram the well-known CLIP-based foundation model (trained on 2D images and text pairs) for this purpose. The CLIP model works by ingesting 2D images, so to leverage it in our context, we project the 3D object point cloud onto 2D image space to create proper depth maps. For this, prior works consider a fixed and non-trainable set of camera poses. In contrast, we propose to train the network to find a projection that best describes the object and is appropriate for extracting 2D image features from the CLIP vision encoder. Directly using the generated depth map is not suitable for the CLIP model, so we apply the model reprogramming paradigm to the depth map to augment the foreground and background to adapt it. This removes the need for modification or fine-tuning of the foundation model. In the setting we have investigated, we have limited access to data from novel classes, resulting in a problem with overfitting. Here, we address this problem via the use of a prompt engineering approach using multiple GPT-generated text descriptions. Our method, C3PR, successfully outperforms existing FSCIL methods on ModelNet, ShapeNet, ScanObjectNN, and CO3D datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/alichr/C3PR.

title: Ali Hatamizadeh*, Jiaming Song, Guilin Liu, Jan Kautz, Arash Vahdat
title_en: Ali Hatamizadeh*, Jiaming Song, Guilin Liu, Jan Kautz, Arash Vahdat
abstract: 具有强大表达能力和高质量样本的扩散模型在生成领域已取得最先进(SOTA)性能。开创性的视觉Transformer(ViT)也展示了强大的建模能力和可扩展性,尤其是在识别任务中。本文研究了ViT在基于扩散的生成学习中的有效性,并提出了一种新的模型,称为扩散视觉Transformer(DiffiT)。具体而言,我们提出了一种对去噪过程进行细粒度控制的方法,并引入了时间依赖多头自注意力(TMSA)机制。DiffiT在生成高保真度图像方面表现出惊人的有效性,且参数效率显著提升。我们还提出了潜在空间和图像空间的DiffiT模型,并在不同分辨率下的多种类别条件和无条件合成任务中展示了最先进性能。在ImageNet-256数据集上,潜在空间DiffiT模型实现了新的最先进FID分数1.73,其参数量比其他基于Transformer的扩散模型(如MDT和DiT)分别减少了19.85%和16.88%。
abstract_en: Diffusion models with their powerful expressivity and high sample quality have achieved State-Of-The-Art (SOTA) performance in the generative domain. The pioneering Vision Transformer (ViT) has also demonstrated strong modeling capabilities and scalability, especially for recognition tasks. In this paper, we study the effectiveness of ViTs in diffusion-based generative learning and propose a new model denoted as Diffusion Vision Transformers (DiffiT). Specifically, we propose a methodology for finegrained control of the denoising process and introduce the Time-dependant Multihead Self Attention (TMSA) mechanism. DiffiT is surprisingly effective in generating high-fidelity images with significantly better parameter efficiency. We also propose latent and image space DiffiT models and show SOTA performance on a variety of class-conditional and unconditional synthesis tasks at different resolutions. The Latent DiffiT model achieves a new SOTA FID score of 1.73 on ImageNet-256 dataset while having 19.85%, 16.88% less parameters than other Transformer-based diffusion models such as MDT and DiT, respectively.

title: Ali Mosleh*, Luxi Zhao, Atin Vikram Singh, Jaeduk Han, Abhijith Punnappurath, Marcus A Brubaker, Jihwan Choe, Michael S Brown
title_en: Ali Mosleh*, Luxi Zhao, Atin Vikram Singh, Jaeduk Han, Abhijith Punnappurath, Marcus A Brubaker, Jihwan Choe, Michael S Brown
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的非参数传感器噪声模型,该模型直接从捕获的图像中为每个强度级别构建概率质量函数。我们证明,与现有模型相比,我们的噪声模型能更准确地拟合真实传感器噪声。我们详细介绍了推导非参数噪声模型的捕获过程,并引入了一种插值方法,以减少需要捕获的ISO级别数量。此外,我们提出了一种方法,当无噪声图像不可用时,可在现有噪声图像上合成噪声。我们的噪声模型校准简单,在下游任务中相比竞争模型提供了显著改进。
abstract_en: We introduce a novel non-parametric sensor noise model that directly constructs probability mass functions per intensity level from captured images. We show that our noise model provides a more accurate fit to real sensor noise than existing models. We detail the capture procedure for deriving our non-parametric noise model and introduce an interpolation method that reduces the number of ISOs levels that need to be captured. In addition, we propose a method to synthesize noise on existing noisy images when noise-free images are not available. Our noise model is straightforward to calibrate and provides notable improvements over competing noise models on downstream tasks.

title: Ali Zare*, Yulei Niu, Hammad Ayyubi, Shih-Fu Chang
title_en: Ali Zare*, Yulei Niu, Hammad Ayyubi, Shih-Fu Chang
abstract: 教学视频中的过程规划任务需要根据初始状态和目标状态的视觉观察生成操作步骤序列。尽管该任务取得了快速进展,但仍存在几个关键挑战:(1) 自适应过程:现有方法假设操作步骤数量已知且固定,导致模型在序列长度变化的现实场景中泛化能力不足。(2) 时间关系:理解步骤间的时间关系知识对于生成合理且可执行的计划至关重要。(3) 标注成本:对教学视频进行步骤级标注(如时间戳)或序列级标注(如操作类别)既耗时又劳动密集,限制了其在大规模数据集上的泛化能力。本文提出了一种新的实用设定,称为教学视频中的自适应过程规划,其中过程长度不固定或预先确定。为解决这些挑战,我们引入了检索增强规划器(Retrieval-Augmented Planner, RAP)模型。具体而言,针对自适应过程,RAP采用自回归模型架构动态确定操作步骤的结束;针对时间关系,RAP通过外部记忆模块显式检索训练视频中最相关的状态-动作对并修订生成的过程;为应对高标注成本,RAP采用弱监督学习方式,通过为操作步骤生成伪标签扩展训练数据集至其他任务相关但未标注的视频。在CrossTask和COIN基准测试中,RAP在传统固定长度模型之上展现出优越性,确立了其作为自适应过程规划强基线解决方案的地位。
abstract_en: Procedure Planning in instructional videos entails generating a sequence of action steps based on visual observations of the initial and target states. Despite the rapid progress in this task, there remain several critical challenges to be solved: (1) Adaptive procedures: Prior works hold an unrealistic assumption that the number of action steps is known and fixed, leading to non-generalizable models in real-world scenarios where the sequence length varies. (2) Temporal relation: Understanding the step temporal relation knowledge is essential in producing reasonable and executable plans. (3) Annotation cost: Annotating instructional videos with step-level labels (, timestamp) or sequence-level labels (, action category) is demanding and labor-intensive, limiting its generalizability to large-scale datasets. In this work, we propose a new and practical setting, called adaptive procedure planning in instructional videos, where the procedure length is not fixed or pre-determined. To address these challenges, we introduce Retrieval-Augmented Planner (RAP) model. Specifically, for adaptive procedures, RAP adaptively determines the conclusion of actions using an auto-regressive model architecture. For temporal relation, RAP establishes an external memory module to explicitly retrieve the most relevant state-action pairs from the training videos and revises the generated procedures. To tackle high annotation cost, RAP utilizes a weakly-supervised learning manner to expand the training dataset to other task-relevant, unannotated videos by generating pseudo labels for action steps. Experiments on CrossTask and COIN benchmarks show the superiority of RAP over traditional fixed-length models, establishing it as a strong baseline solution for adaptive procedure planning.

title: Alind Khare*, Animesh Agrawal, Aditya Annavajjala, Payman Behnam, Myungjin Lee, Hugo M Latapie, Alexey Tumanov
title_en: Alind Khare*, Animesh Agrawal, Aditya Annavajjala, Payman Behnam, Myungjin Lee, Hugo M Latapie, Alexey Tumanov
abstract: 联邦学习(FL)的神经架构搜索(NAS)是一个新兴领域。它在数据无法集中(由于隐私、通信成本或监管限制)时,自动化深度神经网络(DNNs)的设计与训练。近期的联邦NAS方法不仅减少了人工努力,还帮助实现比传统联邦学习方法(如FedAvg)更高的准确性。尽管取得了成功,现有的联邦NAS方法在满足设备端推理中常见的多样化部署目标(包括硬件、延迟预算或可变电池水平)方面仍存在不足。大多数联邦NAS方法仅搜索有限范围的神经架构模式,并在DNN中重复使用,从而限制了可实现的性能。此外,这些方法为满足部署目标而产生高昂的训练成本。它们对每个案例重复进行DNN架构的训练和搜索。本文通过解耦联邦NAS中的训练与搜索来解决这些问题。在联邦学习环境中,联合训练包含在单一超网络中的大量多样化DNN架构。训练后,客户端通过提取训练好的超网络的不同部分,本地执行NAS以找到专用的DNN,无需额外训练。该方法以O(1)(而非O(N))成本在任意N个部署目标下找到专用DNN架构。作为的一部分,我们引入——一种新颖的联邦学习训练算法,它在不同客户端数据分布下对DNN架构(≈5×108)进行多目标联邦优化。相比现有联邦NAS方法,实现了最高37.7%的准确性提升或最多8.13倍的MACs减少。代码已发布于https://github.com/gatech-sysml/superfednas。
abstract_en: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) for Federated Learning (FL) is an emerging field. It automates the design and training of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) when data cannot be centralized due to privacy, communication costs, or regulatory restrictions. Recent federated NAS methods not only reduce manual effort but also help achieve higher accuracy than traditional FL methods like FedAvg. Despite the success, existing federated NAS methods still fall short in satisfying diverse deployment targets common in on-device inference including hardware, latency budgets, or variable battery levels. Most federated NAS methods search for only a limited range of neuro-architectural patterns, repeat them in a DNN, thereby restricting achievable performance. Moreover, these methods incur prohibitive training costs to satisfy deployment targets. They perform the training and search of DNN architectures repeatedly for each case. addresses these challenges by decoupling the training and search in federated NAS. co-trains a large number of diverse DNN architectures contained inside one supernet in the FL setting. Post-training, clients perform NAS locally to find specialized DNNs by extracting different parts of the trained supernet with no additional training. takes O(1) (instead of O(N )) cost to find specialized DNN architectures in FL for any N deployment targets. As part of , we introduce —a novel FL training algorithm that performs multi-objective federated optimization of DNN architectures (≈ 5 ∗ 108 ) under different client data distributions. achieves upto 37.7% higher accuracy or upto 8.13x reduction in MACs than existing federated NAS methods. Code is released at https://github.com/gatech-sysml/superfednas.

title: Alireza Ganjdanesh*, Yan Kang, Yuchen Liu, Richard Zhang, Zhe Lin, Heng Huang
title_en: Alireza Ganjdanesh*, Yan Kang, Yuchen Liu, Richard Zhang, Zhe Lin, Heng Huang
abstract: 扩散概率模型可以生成高质量的样本。然而,其采样过程需要大量的去噪步骤,导致速度慢且计算成本高。我们提出通过将预训练扩散模型剪枝为高效专家的混合模型来降低采样成本。首先,我们研究了去噪时间步之间的相似性,观察到自然聚类现象,甚至在不同数据集之间也存在。这表明,无需为所有时间步使用单一模型,而是可以为各自的时间区间使用独立模型作为“专家”。因此,我们分别在每个时间区间上对预训练模型进行弹性深度和宽度的微调,以获得对应去噪区间的专家模型。为优化专家间的资源使用,我们引入了专家路由代理,该代理学习选择合适的网络配置。通过这种方式,我们的方法可以以端到端方式在专家间分配计算预算,无需手动启发式方法。最后,通过选定的配置,我们对剪枝后的专家进行微调,获得高效专家的混合模型。我们在LSUN-Church、LSUN-Beds、FFHQ和ImageNet等多个数据集上验证了我们的方法DiffPruning在潜在扩散模型架构中的有效性。
abstract_en: Diffusion probabilistic models can generate high-quality samples. Yet, their sampling process requires numerous denoising steps, making it slow and computationally intensive. We propose to reduce the sampling cost by pruning a pretrained diffusion model into a mixture of efficient experts. First, we study the similarities between pairs of denoising timesteps, observing a natural clustering, even across different datasets. This suggests that rather than having a single model for all time steps, separate models can serve as “experts” for their respective time intervals. As such, we separately fine-tune the pretrained model on each interval, with elastic dimensions in depth and width, to obtain experts specialized in their corresponding denoising interval. To optimize the resource usage between experts, we introduce our Expert Routing Agent, which learns to select a set of proper network configurations. By doing so, our method can allocate the computing budget between the experts in an end-to-end manner without requiring manual heuristics. Finally, with a selected configuration, we fine-tune our pruned experts to obtain our mixture of efficient experts. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, DiffPruning, across several datasets, LSUN-Church, LSUN-Beds, FFHQ, and ImageNet, on the Latent Diffusion Model architecture.

title: Aljosa Osep*, Tim Meinhardt, Francesco Ferroni, Neehar Peri, Deva Ramanan, Laura Leal-Taixé
title_en: Aljosa Osep*, Tim Meinhardt, Francesco Ferroni, Neehar Peri, Deva Ramanan, Laura Leal-Taixé
abstract: 我们提出了一种名为(LiDAR中的Segment Anything)的方法,包含一个可由文本提示驱动的零样本模型,用于分割和分类LiDAR中的任何物体,以及一个伪标签引擎,可在无需人工监督的情况下促进模型训练。尽管现有范式(LPS)依赖于对先验定义的少数物体类别进行人工监督,我们利用2D视觉基础模型生成3D监督“免费”。我们的伪标签包括实例掩码和对应的CLIP令牌,通过校准的多模态数据将其提升至LiDAR。通过在这些标签上训练模型,我们将2D基础模型蒸馏至LiDAR模型中。即使没有人工标签,我们的模型在类无关分割任务中达到91%的性能,在零样本LPS任务中达到54%的性能,优于完全监督的最先进状态。此外,我们超越了那些不进行蒸馏仅将图像特征提升至3D的多个基线模型。更重要的是,我们证明该模型支持任意类别提示,可轻松扩展至新数据集,并且随着自标签数据量的增加,具有显著的改进潜力。我们发布了所有模型和代码。
abstract_en: We propose the (Segment Anything in Lidar) method consisting of a text-promptable zero-shot model for segmenting and classifying any object in Lidar, and a pseudo-labeling engine that facilitates model training without manual supervision. While the established paradigm for (LPS) relies on manual supervision for a handful of object classes defined a priori, we utilize 2D vision foundation models to generate 3D supervision “for free”. Our pseudo-labels consist of instance masks and corresponding CLIP tokens, which we lift to Lidar using calibrated multi-modal data. By training our model on these labels, we distill the 2D foundation models into our Lidar model. Even without manual labels, our model achieves 91% in terms of class-agnostic segmentation and 54% in terms of zero-shot LPS of the fully supervised state-of-the-art. Furthermore, we outperform several baselines that do not distill but only lift image features to 3D. More importantly, we demonstrate that supports arbitrary class prompts, can be easily extended to new datasets, and shows significant potential to improve with increasing amounts of self-labeled data. We release all models and the code.

title: Alper Canberk*, Maksym Bondarenko, Ege Ozguroglu, Ruoshi Liu, Carl Vondrick
title_en: Alper Canberk*, Maksym Bondarenko, Ege Ozguroglu, Ruoshi Liu, Carl Vondrick
abstract: 像绘画这样的创造性过程通常涉及逐个创建图像的不同组成部分。我们能否构建一个计算模型来执行此任务?先前的工作往往因对图像进行全局修改、在不合理的空间位置插入物体以及生成不准确的光照细节而失败。我们观察到,尽管最先进的模型在物体插入任务上表现不佳,但它们能够很好地移除自然图像中的物体并擦除背景。通过反转物体移除的方向,我们获得了高质量的数据,用于学习插入与周围环境在空间、物理和光学上一致的物体。借助这一可扩展的自动数据生成流程,我们可以创建用于学习物体插入的数据集,并以此训练我们提出的文本条件扩散模型。定性和定量实验表明,我们的模型在物体插入任务中取得了最先进的结果,特别是在野外图像中。我们在各种领域中展示了对多样插入提示和图像的令人信服的结果。此外,我们通过将插入模型与由CLIP引导的束搜索结合,实现了迭代插入的自动化。
abstract_en: Creative processes such as painting often involve creating different components of an image one by one. Can we build a computational model to perform this task? Prior works often fail by making global changes to the image, inserting objects in unrealistic spatial locations, and generating inaccurate lighting details. We observe that while state-of-the-art models perform poorly on object insertion, they can remove objects and erase the background in natural images very well. Inverting the direction of object removal, we obtain high-quality data for learning to insert objects that are spatially, physically, and optically consistent with the surroundings. With this scalable automatic data generation pipeline, we can create a dataset for learning object insertion, which is used to train our proposed text-conditioned diffusion model. Qualitative and quantitative experiments have shown that our model achieves state-of-the-art results in object insertion, particularly for in-the-wild images. We show compelling results on diverse insertion prompts and images across various domains.
