In addition, we automate iterative insertion by combining our insertion model with beam search guided by CLIP.

title: Amandeep Kumar*, Muhammad Awais, Sanath Narayan, Hisham Cholakkal, Salman Khan, Rao Muhammad Anwer
title_en: Amandeep Kumar*, Muhammad Awais, Sanath Narayan, Hisham Cholakkal, Salman Khan, Rao Muhammad Anwer
abstract: 现有二维方法借助StyleGAN的表达能力和解耦的潜在空间,通过文本提示对人脸图像进行不同属性的编辑。相比之下,生成不同目标姿态人脸的三维感知方法需要属性特定分类器,为每个属性学习独立的模型权重,难以扩展到新属性。本文提出了一种高效、即插即用的三维感知人脸编辑框架,基于属性特定提示学习,实现跨多种目标姿态生成可控属性的人脸图像。为此,我们引入了一种基于文本驱动的可学习风格标记潜在属性编辑器(LAE)。LAE利用预训练的视觉-语言模型,在任意预训练的三维感知GAN的潜在空间中寻找文本引导的属性特定编辑方向。它通过可学习的风格标记和风格映射器,学习并转换该编辑方向至三维潜在空间。为训练支持多属性的LAE,我们采用方向对比损失和风格标记损失。此外,为确保不同姿态和属性下的视角一致性和身份保持,我们引入了多种三维感知的身份和姿态保持损失。实验表明,所提框架能够生成高质量的三维感知且视角一致的图像,同时保持属性特定特征。我们在包括发色和发型、表情等不同面部属性上验证了方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Drawing upon StyleGAN’s expressivity and disentangled latent space, existing 2D approaches employ textual prompting to edit facial images with different attributes. In contrast, 3D-aware approaches that generate faces at different target poses require attribute-specific classifiers, learning separate model weights for each attribute, and are not scalable for novel attributes. In this work, we propose an efficient, plug-and-play, 3D-aware face editing framework, based on attribute-specific prompt learning, enabling the generation of facial images with controllable attributes across various target poses. To this end, we introduce a text-driven learnable style token-based latent attribute editor (LAE). The LAE harnesses a pre-trained vision-language model to find text-guided attribute-specific editing direction in the latent space of any pre-trained 3D-aware GAN. It utilizes learnable style tokens and style mappers to learn and transform this editing direction to 3D latent space. To train LAE with multiple attributes, we use directional contrastive loss and style token loss. Furthermore, to ensure view consistency and identity preservation across different poses and attributes, we employ several 3D-aware identity and pose preservation losses. Our experiments show that our proposed framework generates high-quality images with 3D awareness and view consistency while maintaining attribute-specific features. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on different facial attributes, including hair color and style, expression, and others.

title: Amber Yijia Zheng*, Chiao-An Yang*, Raymond A. Yeh
title_en: Amber Yijia Zheng*, Chiao-An Yang*, Raymond A. Yeh
abstract: 开源预训练主干网络的发展使得为新任务微调模型相对容易。然而,这种降低的入门门槛可能带来潜在风险,例如恶意行为者开发用于有害应用的模型。由此产生一个问题:是否可以开发一种预训练模型,使其难以针对某些下游任务进行微调?为研究这一问题,我们聚焦于少样本分类(FSC)。具体而言,我们探讨了如何在保持其他类别性能的同时,使FSC对一组受限类别更具挑战性。我们提出了一种在预训练主干网络上进行元学习的方法,使其成为“较差的初始化”。我们提出的“学习阻碍”(LTO)算法成功阻碍了三种数据集上的四种FSC方法,包括用于图像分类的ImageNet和CIFAR100,以及用于属性分类的CelebA。
abstract_en: Advancements in open-source pre-trained backbones make it relatively easy to fine-tune a model for new tasks. However, this lowered entry barrier poses potential risks, e.g., bad actors developing models for harmful applications. A question arises: Is possible to develop a pre-trained model that is difficult to fine-tune for certain downstream tasks? To begin studying this, we focus on few-shot classification (FSC). Specifically, we investigate methods to make FSC more challenging for a set of restricted classes while maintaining the performance of other classes. We propose to meta-learn over the pre-trained backbone in a manner that renders it a “poor initialization”. Our proposed Learning to Obstruct (LTO) algorithm successfully obstructs four FSC methods across three datasets, including ImageNet and CIFAR100 for image classification, as well as CelebA for attribute classification.

title: Amber Yijia Zheng*, Raymond A. Yeh
title_en: Amber Yijia Zheng*, Raymond A. Yeh
abstract: 开源文本到图像模型和微调方法的进展导致了恶意适配风险的增加,即通过微调生成有害/未经授权的内容。近期研究如Glaze或MIST开发了数据中毒技术,以保护数据免受适配方法的侵害。本文考虑了一种替代性的保护范式。我们提出通过学习难以被适配方法利用的模型参数来“免疫”模型;简称为IMMA。具体而言,IMMA应在模型权重发布前应用以缓解这些风险。实证结果表明,IMMA在三种适配方法(LoRA、Textual-Inversion和DreamBooth)下对恶意适配具有有效性,包括模仿艺术风格和学习不当/未经授权内容。代码可在https://github.com/amberyzheng/IMMA获取。
abstract_en: Advancements in open-sourced text-to-image models and fine-tuning methods have led to the increasing risk of malicious adaptation, , fine-tuning to generate harmful/unauthorized content. Recent works, , Glaze or MIST, have developed data-poisoning techniques which protect the data against adaptation methods. In this work, we consider an alternative paradigm for protection. We propose to “immunize” the model by learning model parameters that are difficult for the adaptation methods when fine-tuning malicious content; in short IMMA. Specifically, IMMA should be applied before the release of the model weights to mitigate these risks. Empirical results show IMMA’s effectiveness against malicious adaptations, including mimicking the artistic style and learning of inappropriate/unauthorized content, over three adaptation methods: LoRA, Textual-Inversion, and DreamBooth. The code is available at https://github. com/amberyzheng/IMMA.

title: Amin Parchami-Araghi*, Moritz Böhle, Sukrut Rao, Bernt Schiele
title_en: Amin Parchami-Araghi*, Moritz Böhle, Sukrut Rao, Bernt Schiele
abstract: 知识蒸馏(KD)已被证明能有效将大型教师模型压缩为小型学生模型。尽管已知学生模型可以达到与教师模型相似的准确率,但研究表明它们往往并未学习到相同的函数。然而,通常高度期望学生模型与教师模型的函数具有相似的特性,例如基于相同的__TITLE_MATH_1__进行预测,因为这能确保学生从教师那里学习到“正确的特征”。在本文中,我们探讨是否可以通过不仅优化经典的KD损失,还优化教师模型和学生模型生成的解释的相似性来实现这一目标。尽管这一想法简单直观,但我们发现所提出的“增强解释的知识蒸馏”(__ABS_MATH_1__)(1)在准确率和学生-教师一致性方面相比基于logit的知识蒸馏提供了显著提升,(2)确保学生从教师那里学习到正确的理由并给出相似的解释,(3)对模型架构、训练数据量甚至与“近似”预计算的解释均具有鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Knowledge Distillation (KD) has proven effective for compressing large teacher models into smaller student models. While it is well known that student models can achieve similar accuracies as the teachers, it has also been shown that they nonetheless often do not learn the same function. It is, however, often highly desirable that the student’s and teacher’s functions share similar properties such as basing the prediction on the same , as this ensures that students learn the ‘right features’ from the teachers. In this work, we explore whether this can be achieved by not only optimizing the classic KD loss but also the similarity of the explanations generated by the teacher and the student. Despite the idea being simple and intuitive, we find that our proposed ‘explanation-enhanced’ KD () (1) consistently provides large gains over logit-based KD in terms of accuracy and student-teacher agreement, (2) ensures that the student learns from the teacher to be right for the right reasons and to give similar explanations, and (3) is robust with respect to the model architectures, the amount of training data, and even works with ‘approximate’, pre-computed explanations.

title: Amir Bar*, Arya Bakhtiar, Danny L Tran, Antonio Loquercio, Jathushan Rajasegaran, yann lecun, Amir Globerson, Trevor Darrell
title_en: Amir Bar*, Arya Bakhtiar, Danny L Tran, Antonio Loquercio, Jathushan Rajasegaran, yann lecun, Amir Globerson, Trevor Darrell
abstract: 动物通过感知世界来规划行动,并与其他智能体互动以完成复杂任务,展现出AI系统目前仍无法匹敌的能力。为推进我们对动物与AI系统能力的理解,并缩小二者之间的差距,我们引入了一个包含多样自运动与多智能体交互示例的宠物自运动图像数据集。当前视频数据集通常将自运动和交互示例分开,很少同时包含两者。此外,EgoPet提供了与现有以人为中心或车辆为中心数据集截然不同的视角。我们定义了两个领域内基准任务以捕捉动物行为,并定义第三个基准任务评估EgoPet作为机器人四足运动预训练资源的效用,结果表明基于EgoPet训练的模型在性能上优于基于先前数据集的模型。1 1 项目页面:www.amirbar.net/egopet
abstract_en: Animals perceive the world to plan their actions and interact with other agents to accomplish complex tasks, demonstrating capabilities that are still unmatched by AI systems. To advance our understanding and reduce the gap between the capabilities of animals and AI systems, we introduce a dataset of pet egomotion imagery with diverse examples of simultaneous egomotion and multi-agent interaction. Current video datasets separately contain egomotion and interaction examples, but rarely both at the same time. In addition, EgoPet offers a radically distinct perspective from existing egocentric datasets of humans or vehicles. We define two in-domain benchmark tasks that capture animal behavior, and a third benchmark to assess the utility of EgoPet as a pretraining resource to robotic quadruped locomotion, showing that models trained from EgoPet outperform those trained from prior datasets. 1 1 Project page: www.amirbar.net/egopet

title: Amir Mehrpanah*, Erik Englesson, Hossein Azizpour
title_en: Amir Mehrpanah*, Erik Englesson, Hossein Azizpour
abstract: 理解深度网络的行为对于提高对其结果的信心至关重要。尽管已有大量工作用于解释其预测结果,但研究人员仍面临可靠性问题,这可归因于形式化方法的不足。在本研究中,我们采用新颖的概率和谱视角对解释方法进行形式化分析。我们的研究揭示了由于使用梯度而产生的普遍谱偏差,并通过实验发现了一些常见的设计选择,特别是使用平方梯度和输入扰动。我们进一步分析了解释方法中扰动超参数的选择(如SmoothGrad)如何导致不一致的解释,并基于我们提出的形式化方法提出两种改进方案:(i) 一种确定标准扰动尺度的机制,以及 (ii) 我们称为SpectralLens的聚合方法。最后,我们通过定量评估验证了我们的理论结果。
abstract_en: Understanding the behavior of deep networks is crucial to increase our confidence in their results. Despite an extensive body of work for explaining their predictions, researchers have faced reliability issues, which can be attributed to insufficient formalism. In our research, we adopt novel probabilistic and spectral perspectives to formally analyze explanation methods. Our study reveals a pervasive spectral bias stemming from the use of gradient, and sheds light on some common design choices that have been discovered experimentally, in particular, the use of squared gradient and input perturbation. We further characterize how the choice of perturbation hyperparameters in explanation methods, such as SmoothGrad, can lead to inconsistent explanations and introduce two remedies based on our proposed formalism: (i) a mechanism to determine a standard perturbation scale, and (ii) an aggregation method which we call SpectralLens. Finally, we substantiate our theoretical results through quantitative evaluations.

title: Amita Kamath*, Cheng-Yu Hsieh, Kai-Wei Chang, Ranjay Krishna
title_en: Amita Kamath*, Cheng-Yu Hsieh, Kai-Wei Chang, Ranjay Krishna
abstract: 多个基准测试表明,我们当前最先进的视觉-语言模型(如CLIP)在组合性方面存在不足。给定一张图像,这些基准测试会探测模型能否从一组具有组合性的干扰项中识别出对应的描述文本。对此,近期大量研究通过使用干扰项作为困难负样本对CLIP进行微调,取得了性能提升。然而,我们的研究发现,这些提升实际上被高估了——因为现有基准测试并未检验微调后的模型是否对困难正样本保持不变。通过构建包含112,382个困难负样本和困难正样本的评估数据集,我们发现包含困难正样本会使CLIP的性能下降12.9%,而人类在该任务上的表现轻松达到99%。使用困难负样本微调的CLIP性能下降幅度更大,高达38.7%。基于这一发现,我们构建了一个包含1,775,259张图像和文本的训练数据集,其中同时包含困难负样本和困难正样本。通过同时训练这两种样本,我们在现有基准测试上取得了性能提升,同时在困难正样本上的表现也得到改善,表明组合性能力的提升更加稳健。我们的研究建议,未来的研究需要严格测试并改进CLIP对相关“正向”概念之间语义关系的理解。
abstract_en: Several benchmarks have concluded that our best vision-language models (, CLIP) are lacking in compositionality. Given an image, these benchmarks probe a model’s ability to identify its associated caption amongst a set of compositional distractors. In response, a surge of recent proposals show improvements by finetuning CLIP with distractors as hard negatives. Our investigations reveal that these improvements have, in fact, been overstated — because existing benchmarks do not probe whether finetuned models remain invariant to hard positives. By curating an evaluation dataset with 112, 382 hard negatives and hard positives, we uncover that including hard positives decreases CLIP’s performance by 12.9%, while humans perform effortlessly at 99%. CLIP finetuned with hard negatives results in an even larger decrease, up to 38.7%. With this finding, we then produce a 1,775,259 image-text training set with both hard negative and hard positive captions. By training with both, we see improvements on existing benchmarks while simultaneously improving performance on hard positives, indicating a more robust improvement in compositionality. Our work suggests the need for future research to rigorously test and improve CLIP’s understanding of semantic relationships between related “positive” concepts.

title: Amrin Kareem*, Jean Lahoud, Hisham Cholakkal*
title_en: Amrin Kareem*, Jean Lahoud, Hisham Cholakkal*
abstract: 近年来,三维感知系统在视觉识别任务(如分割)中的能力得到了显著提升。然而,这些系统仍然严重依赖显式的人类指令来识别目标对象或类别,缺乏主动推理和理解隐式用户意图的能力。我们引入了一种新颖的分割任务,称为三维物体的推理部分分割,旨在根据关于三维物体特定部分的复杂且隐式的文本查询输出分割掩码。为了促进评估和基准测试,我们提出了一套大型三维数据集,包含超过60,000条指令及其对应的、专门针对基于推理的三维部分分割而整理的真实部分分割注释。我们提出了一种模型,该模型能够基于隐式文本查询对三维物体的部分进行分割,并生成与三维物体分割请求相对应的自然语言解释。实验表明,我们的方法在使用显式查询的模型上具有竞争力,同时具备识别部分概念、对它们进行推理以及利用世界知识进行补充的能力。我们的源代码、数据集和训练模型可通过此网址访问。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in 3D perception systems have significantly improved their ability to perform visual recognition tasks such as segmentation. However, these systems still heavily rely on explicit human instruction to identify target objects or categories, lacking the capability to actively reason and comprehend implicit user intentions. We introduce a novel segmentation task known as reasoning part segmentation for 3D objects, aiming to output a segmentation mask based on complex and implicit textual queries about specific parts of a 3D object. To facilitate evaluation and benchmarking, we present a large 3D dataset comprising over 60k instructions paired with corresponding ground-truth part segmentation annotations specifically curated for reasoning-based 3D part segmentation. We propose a model that is capable of segmenting parts of 3D objects based on implicit textual queries and generating natural language explanations corresponding to 3D object segmentation requests. Experiments show that our method achieves competitive performance to models that use explicit queries, with the additional abilities to identify part concepts, reason about them, and complement them with world knowledge. Our source code, dataset, and trained models are accessible at this url.

title: Amy Zhao, Chengcheng Tang, Lezi Wang, Yijing Li, Mihika Dave, Lingling Tao*, Christopher D. Twigg, Robert Y. Wang
title_en: Amy Zhao, Chengcheng Tang, Lezi Wang, Yijing Li, Mihika Dave, Lingling Tao*, Christopher D. Twigg, Robert Y. Wang
abstract: 在佩戴虚拟现实(VR)、增强现实(AR)或混合现实(MR)头显设备时,准确追踪用户的全身姿态是实现真实自我表达、自然社交存在感和直观用户界面的先决条件。现有的VR/AR设备全身追踪方法要么存在欠约束问题(例如,仅通过头显和控制器姿态推断全身姿态),要么需要不切实际的硬件配置(如将摄像头放置在远离用户面部的位置以提高身体可见性)。本文提出了一种首个无需控制器的以第一人称视角的全身姿态追踪方案,该方案基于实际VR设备运行,并使用与同步定位与地图构建(SLAM)追踪相同的摄像头。我们提出了一种新颖的以第一人称视角的追踪架构,利用多视角潜在特征建模身体运动的时序历史。此外,我们发布了首个大规模真实图像数据集用于以第一人称视角的全身姿态追踪,包含真实的VR头显配置和多样化的受试者与动作。在该数据集上的基准测试表明,我们的方法在追踪结果的精度和流畅性方面均优于其他最先进的方法。我们对模型选择进行了消融实验,并演示了该方法在VR头显上实现实时运行。包含超过30小时录制内容和300万帧的该数据集将向公众公开。
abstract_en: Accurate tracking of a user’s body pose while wearing a virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR) or mixed reality (MR) headset is a prerequisite for authentic self-expression, natural social presence, and intuitive user interfaces. Existing body tracking approaches on VR/AR devices are either under-constrained, e.g., attempting to infer full body pose from only headset and controller pose, or require impractical hardware setups that place cameras far from a user’s face to improve body visibility. In this paper, we present the first controller-less egocentric body tracking solution that runs on an actual VR device using the same cameras that are used for SLAM tracking. We propose a novel egocentric tracking architecture that models the temporal history of body motion using multi-view latent features. Furthermore, we release the first large-scale real-image dataset for egocentric body tracking, , with a realistic VR headset configuration and diverse subjects and motions. Benchmarks on the dataset shows that our approach outperforms other state-of-the-art methods in both accuracy and smoothness of the resulting motion. We perform ablation studies on our model choices and demonstrate the method running in realtime on a VR headset. Our dataset with more than 30 hours of recordings and 3 million frames will be made publicly available.

title: An Zhang*, Han Wang, Xiang Wang, Tat-Seng Chua
title_en: An Zhang*, Han Wang, Xiang Wang, Tat-Seng Chua
abstract: 领域泛化(DG)旨在通过利用充分的监督信号来增强分布外(OOD)泛化能力,其核心是学习对领域迁移具有不变性的特征。然而,此类标记数据的稀缺性促使无监督领域泛化(UDG)的兴起——这一任务更为重要且具有挑战性,因为模型在无监督方式下跨多个领域进行训练,最终在未见过的领域上进行测试。UDG正日益受到关注,但仍远未被充分研究。为弥合研究差距,我们提出了一种针对UDG的新型学习框架,称为解耦掩码自编码器(DisMAE),旨在发现能够忠实揭示内在特征和表面变化的解耦表示,而无需访问类别标签。其核心是领域不变语义特征的蒸馏,这些特征无法被领域分类器区分,同时过滤掉领域特定变化(例如颜色方案和纹理模式)等不稳定且冗余的特征。值得注意的是,DisMAE通过语义和轻量级变化编码器的非对称双分支架构进行联合训练,提供动态数据操作和表示层级增强能力。在四个基准数据集(DomainNet、PACS、VLCS、Colored MNIST)上进行的大量实验表明,DisMAE在DG和UDG任务中均能实现与最先进DG和UDG基线相当的OOD性能,为利用大规模无标签数据提升泛化能力提供了潜在研究方向。我们的代码可在https: //github.com/rookiehb/DisMAE获取。
abstract_en: Domain Generalization (DG), designed to enhance out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, is all about learning invariance against domain shifts utilizing sufficient supervision signals. Yet, the scarcity of such labeled data has led to the rise of unsupervised domain generalization (UDG) — a more important yet challenging task in that models are trained across diverse domains in an unsupervised manner and eventually tested on unseen domains. UDG is fast gaining attention but is still far from well-studied. To close the research gap, we propose a novel learning framework designed for UDG, termed the Disentangled Masked AutoEncoder (DisMAE), aiming to discover the disentangled representations that faithfully reveal the intrinsic features and superficial variations without access to the class label. At its core is the distillation of domain-invariant semantic features, which can not be distinguished by domain classifier, while filtering out the domain-specific variations (for example, color schemes and texture patterns) that are unstable and redundant. Notably, DisMAE co-trains the asymmetric dual-branch architecture with semantic and lightweight variation encoders, offering dynamic data manipulation and representation level augmentation capabilities. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets (DomainNet, PACS, VLCS, Colored MNIST) with both DG and UDG tasks demonstrate that DisMAE can achieve competitive OOD performance compared with the state-of-the-art DG and UDG baselines, which shed light on potential research line in improving the generalization ability with large-scale unlabeled data. Our codes are available at https: //github.com/rookiehb/DisMAE.

title: Ana-Maria Marcu*, Long Chen, Jan Hünermann, Alice Karnsund, Benoit Hanotte, Prajwal Chidananda, Saurabh Nair, Vijay Badrinarayanan, Alex Kendall, Jamie Shotton, Elahe Arani, Oleg Sinavski
title_en: Ana-Maria Marcu*, Long Chen, Jan Hünermann, Alice Karnsund, Benoit Hanotte, Prajwal Chidananda, Saurabh Nair, Vijay Badrinarayanan, Alex Kendall, Jamie Shotton, Elahe Arani, Oleg Sinavski
abstract: 我们引入了LingoQA,这是一个用于自动驾驶领域视觉问答的新型数据集和基准测试。该数据集包含28,000个独特的短视频场景和419,000个标注。在我们的基准测试上评估最先进的视觉-语言模型显示,其性能低于人类水平,GPT-4V对59.6%的问题作出真实回答,而人类则达到96.6%。为了评估,我们提出了一种名为Lingo-Judge的真实性分类器,其与人类评估的斯皮尔曼相关系数达到0.95,超越了现有的技术如METEOR、BLEU、CIDEr和GPT-4。我们建立了基础视觉-语言模型并进行了广泛的消融实验以理解其性能。我们发布了数据集和基准测试1作为自动驾驶领域视觉-语言模型的评估平台。1 https://github.com/wayveai/LingoQA
abstract_en: We introduce LingoQA, a novel dataset and benchmark for visual question answering in autonomous driving. The dataset contains 28K unique short video scenarios, and 419K annotations. Evaluating state-of-the-art vision-language models on our benchmark shows that their performance is below human capabilities, with GPT-4V responding truthfully to 59.6% of the questions compared to 96.6% for humans. For evaluation, we propose a truthfulness classifier, called Lingo-Judge, that achieves a 0.95 Spearman correlation coefficient to human evaluations, surpassing existing techniques like METEOR, BLEU, CIDEr, and GPT-4. We establish a baseline vision-language model and run extensive ablation studies to understand its performance. We release our dataset and benchmark1 as an evaluation platform for vision-language models in autonomous driving. 1 https://github.com/wayveai/LingoQA

title: Anagh Malik*, Noah Juravsky, Ryan Po, Gordon Wetzstein, Kiriakos N. Kutulakos, David B. Lindell
title_en: Anagh Malik*, Noah Juravsky, Ryan Po, Gordon Wetzstein, Kiriakos N. Kutulakos, David B. Lindell
abstract: 我们提出了一种成像与神经渲染技术,旨在从新颖的、移动的摄像机视角合成光在场景中传播的视频。我们的方法依赖于一种新的超高速成像系统,以捕捉具有皮秒级时间分辨率的多视角视频数据集。结合该数据集,我们引入了一种基于瞬态场的高效神经体积渲染框架。该场被定义为从三维点和二维方向到高维离散时间信号的映射,该信号表示在超高速时间尺度上的时变辐射度。使用瞬态场进行渲染可以自然地考虑光速有限导致的效果,包括由于光传播延迟引起的视角依赖的外观变化。我们渲染了一系列复杂效果,包括散射、镜面反射、折射和衍射。此外,我们展示了通过时间扭曲过程去除视角依赖的传播延迟、相对论效应的渲染以及直接和全局光传输成分的视频合成。
abstract_en: We present an imaging and neural rendering technique that seeks to synthesize videos of light propagating through a scene from novel, moving camera viewpoints. Our approach relies on a new ultrafast imaging setup to capture a first-of-its kind, multi-viewpoint video dataset with picosecond-level temporal resolution. Combined with this dataset, we introduce an efficient neural volume rendering framework based on the transient field. This field is defined as a mapping from a 3D point and 2D direction to a high-dimensional, discrete-time signal that represents time-varying radiance at ultrafast timescales. Rendering with transient fields naturally accounts for effects due to the finite speed of light, including viewpoint-dependent appearance changes caused by light propagation delays to the camera. We render a range of complex effects, including scattering, specular reflection, refraction, and diffraction. Additionally, we demonstrate removing viewpoint-dependent propagation delays using a time warping procedure, rendering of relativistic effects, and video synthesis of direct and global components of light transport.

title: Ananthu Aniraj*, Cassio F. Dantas, Dino Ienco, Diego Marcos
title_en: Ananthu Aniraj*, Cassio F. Dantas, Dino Ienco, Diego Marcos
abstract: 显式检测物体部件并对其进行推理的计算机视觉方法是迈向固有可解释模型的重要一步。现有基于细粒度分类任务驱动的部件发现方法对发现部件的几何属性做出非常严格的假设;它们应为小而紧凑的部件。尽管这种先验在某些情况下是有用的,但本文表明,预训练的基于Transformer的视觉模型(如自监督的DINOv2 ViT)能够放松这些约束条件。特别是,我们发现允许任意尺寸多个连通组件的总变分(TV)先验显著优于先前方法。我们在三个细粒度分类基准数据集(CUB、PartImageNet和Oxford Flowers)上测试了我们的方法,并与之前发表的方法以及基于Transformer主干的PDiscoNet最新方法重新实现进行比较。我们在部件发现指标和下游分类任务上均取得了显著提升,表明自监督ViT模型中的强归纳偏置要求重新思考可用于无监督部件发现的几何先验。训练代码和预训练模型可在https://github.com/ananthu-aniraj/pdiscoformer获取。
abstract_en: Computer vision methods that explicitly detect object parts and reason on them are a step towards inherently interpretable models. Existing approaches that perform part discovery driven by a fine-grained classification task make very restrictive assumptions on the geometric properties of the discovered parts; they should be small and compact. Although this prior is useful in some cases, in this paper we show that pre-trained transformer-based vision models, such as self-supervised DINOv2 ViT, enable the relaxation of these constraints. In particular, we find that a total variation (TV) prior, which allows for multiple connected components of any size, substantially outperforms previous work. We test our approach on three fine-grained classification benchmarks: CUB, PartImageNet and Oxford Flowers, and compare our results to previously published methods as well as a re-implementation of the state-of-the-art method PDiscoNet with a transformer-based backbone. We consistently obtain substantial improvements across the board, both on part discovery metrics and the downstream classification task, showing that the strong inductive biases in self-supervised ViT models require to rethink the geometric priors that can be used for unsupervised part discovery. Training code and pre-trained models are available at https:// github.com/ananthu-aniraj/pdiscoformer.

title: Anas Mahmoud*, Ali Harakeh, Steven Waslander
title_en: Anas Mahmoud*, Ali Harakeh, Steven Waslander
abstract: 在大量且多样化的多模态数据集上进行预训练的2D基础模型,凭借其强大的表示能力,能够以极少或无下游监督的方式高效处理2D任务。2D到3D的蒸馏框架的出现将这些能力扩展到了3D模型上。然而,针对自动驾驶数据集进行3D表示蒸馏时,自相似性、类别不平衡和点云稀疏性等挑战会阻碍对比蒸馏的有效性,尤其是在零样本学习场景中。尽管基于相似性的蒸馏方法能够提升零样本性能,但其生成的表示能力往往缺乏判别性,从而降低少样本性能。我们研究了当前最先进的蒸馏框架所生成的2D与3D表示之间的结构差异,并揭示了二者存在显著不匹配。此外,我们证明观察到的结构差异与蒸馏表示在零样本和少样本3D语义分割任务中的有效性呈负相关。为弥合这一差距,我们提出了一种关系蒸馏框架,通过施加同模态和跨模态约束,使蒸馏得到的3D表示能够紧密捕捉2D表示的结构特征。这种对齐显著提升了对比蒸馏在零样本分割任务中3D表示的性能。此外,我们的关系损失在分布内和分布外的少样本分割任务中持续提升3D表示的质量,优于依赖相似性损失的方法。
abstract_en: Pre-trained on extensive and diverse multi-modal datasets, 2D foundation models excel at addressing 2D tasks with little or no downstream supervision, owing to their robust representations. The emergence of 2D-to-3D distillation frameworks has extended these capabilities to 3D models. However, distilling 3D representations for autonomous driving datasets presents challenges like self-similarity, class imbalance, and point cloud sparsity, hindering the effectiveness of contrastive distillation, especially in zero-shot learning contexts. Whereas other methodologies, such as similarity-based distillation, enhance zero-shot performance, they tend to yield less discriminative representations, diminishing few-shot performance. We investigate the gap in structure between the 2D and the 3D representations that result from state-of-the-art distillation frameworks and reveal a significant mismatch between the two. Additionally, we demonstrate that the observed structural gap is negatively correlated with the efficacy of the distilled representations on zero-shot and few-shot 3D semantic segmentation. To bridge this gap, we propose a relational distillation framework enforcing intra-modal and cross-modal constraints, resulting in distilled 3D representations that closely capture the structure of the 2D representation. This alignment significantly enhances 3D representation performance over those learned through contrastive distillation in zero-shot segmentation tasks. Furthermore, our relational loss consistently improves the quality of 3D representations in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution few-shot segmentation tasks, outperforming approaches that rely on the similarity loss.

title: Anay Majee*, Ryan X Sharp, Rishabh Iyer*
title_en: Anay Majee*, Ryan X Sharp, Rishabh Iyer*
abstract: 目标类别混淆和遗忘一直是Few-Shot Object Detection(FSOD)研究中的核心挑战。为克服基于度量学习的FSOD技术中的这些缺陷,我们提出了一种新颖的次模互信息学习(Submodular Mutual Information Learning)框架,该框架采用组合互信息函数作为损失函数的学习目标,以强制学习基础类别与新类别之间的良好分离特征簇。此外,联合目标通过最小化类中包含的总次模信息,从而生成判别性特征簇。该联合目标的综合效果在FSOD中显著提升了类别混淆和遗忘问题。进一步研究表明,该方法可推广至多种现有FSOD方法,提升其性能,且与主干网络架构无关。在流行的FSOD基准数据集PASCAL-VOC和MS-COCO上的实验表明,我们的方法可推广至当前最优(State-of-the-Art, SoTA)方法,在VOC(split 3)10-shot设置和COCO 30-shot设置中分别将新类别性能提升至5.7%(3.3 mAP点)和5.4%(2.6 mAP点)。实验还表明,我们的方法在保持基础类别性能方面表现更优,并且在不依赖底层架构的情况下收敛速度可达现有方法的2倍。1 项目页面: https://anaymajee.me/assets/project_pages/smile.html.
abstract_en: Confusion and forgetting of object classes have been challenges of prime interest in Few-Shot Object Detection (FSOD). To overcome these pitfalls in metric learning based FSOD techniques, we introduce a novel Submodular Mutual Information Learning ( 1 ) framework for loss functions which adopts combinatorial mutual information functions as learning objectives to enforce learning of well-separated feature clusters between the base and novel classes. Additionally, the joint objective in minimizes the total submodular information contained in a class leading to discriminative feature clusters. The combined effect of this joint objective demonstrates significant improvements in class confusion and forgetting in FSOD. Further we show that generalizes to several existing approaches in FSOD, improving their performance, agnostic of the backbone architecture. Experiments on popular FSOD benchmarks, PASCAL-VOC and MS-COCO show that our approach generalizes to State-of-the-Art (SoTA) approaches improving their novel class performance by up to 5.7% (3.3 mAP points) and 5.4% (2.6 mAP points) on the 10-shot setting of VOC (split 3) and 30-shot setting of COCO datasets respectively. Our experiments also demonstrate better retention of base class performance and up to 2× faster convergence over existing approaches agnostic of the underlying architecture. 1 Project page: https://anaymajee.me/assets/project_pages/smile.html.

title: Anders Christensen*, Nooshin Mojab*, Khushman Patel, Karan Ahuja, Zeynep Akata, Ole Winther, Mar Gonzalez Franco, Andrea Colaco
title_en: Anders Christensen*, Nooshin Mojab*, Khushman Patel, Karan Ahuja, Zeynep Akata, Ole Winther, Mar Gonzalez Franco, Andrea Colaco
abstract: 球形或全向图像提供了一种沉浸式的视觉格式,适用于广泛的计算机视觉应用。然而,球形图像的几何特性对为普通2D图像设计的模型和指标构成了重大挑战。在此,我们展示直接应用Fréchet初始距离(FID)不足以量化球形图像的几何保真度。我们引入了两个考虑几何约束的定量指标,即__TITLE_MATH_1__和断续度得分(DS)。__TITLE_MATH_1__是扩展的FID,通过利用立方图投影来额外捕捉球形格式的视野需求。DS是基于核的接缝对齐得分,用于评估球形图像2D表示边界处的连续性。在实验中,__TITLE_MATH_1__和DS量化了FID无法检测的几何保真度问题。
abstract_en: Spherical or omni-directional images offer an immersive visual format appealing to a wide range of computer vision applications. However, geometric properties of spherical images pose a major challenge for models and metrics designed for ordinary 2D images. Here, we show that direct application of Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) is insufficient for quantifying geometric fidelity in spherical images. We introduce two quantitative metrics accounting for geometric constraints, namely () and Discontinuity Score (DS). is an extension of FID tailored to additionally capture field-of-view requirements of the spherical format by leveraging cubemap projections. DS is a kernel-based seam alignment score of continuity across borders of 2D representations of spherical images. In experiments, and DS quantify geometry fidelity issues that are undetected by FID.

title: Andong Tan, Fengtao Zhou, Hao Chen*
title_en: Andong Tan, Fengtao Zhou, Hao Chen*
abstract: 概念瓶颈模型(CBM)是一种设计上可解释的框架,其决策过程首先预测一组可解释的概念,然后基于给定的概念预测类别标签。现有的CBM通常使用固定的概念集进行训练(概念由数据集标注或通过语言模型查询获得)。然而,这种封闭世界假设在实践中并不现实,因为用户可能在模型部署后希望了解任意所需概念在决策中的作用。受近期视觉-语言预训练模型(如CLIP)在零样本分类中巨大成功启发,我们提出“OpenCBM”,通过以下方法为CBM赋予开放词汇概念:(1)通过基于原型的特征对齐,将可训练图像特征提取器的特征空间与CLIP的图像编码器对齐;(2)在下游数据集上同时训练图像分类器;(3)通过任何用户指定的文本概念(由CLIP的文本编码器编码)重构训练好的分类头。为进一步揭示用户可能缺失的概念,我们提出在重构过程中迭代寻找与残差参数最接近的概念嵌入,直至残差足够小。据我们所知,我们的“OpenCBM”是首个支持开放词汇概念的CBM,为用户提供独特优势,例如在模型训练后仍可移除、添加或替换任意所需概念以解释模型预测。此外,我们的模型在基准数据集CUB-200-2011上的分类准确率比先前最先进的CBM高出9%。
abstract_en: The concept bottleneck model (CBM) is an interpretable-by-design framework that makes decisions by first predicting a set of interpretable concepts, and then predicting the class label based on the given concepts. Existing CBMs are trained with a fixed set of concepts (concepts are either annotated by the dataset or queried from language models). However, this closed-world assumption is unrealistic in practice, as users may wonder about the role of any desired concept in decision-making after the model is deployed. Inspired by the large success of recent vision-language pre-trained models such as CLIP in zero-shot classification, we propose “OpenCBM” to equip the CBM with open vocabulary concepts via: (1) Aligning the feature space of a trainable image feature extractor with that of a CLIP’s image encoder via a prototype based feature alignment; (2) Simultaneously training an image classifier on the downstream dataset; (3) Reconstructing the trained classification head via any set of user-desired textual concepts encoded by CLIP’s text encoder. To reveal potentially missing concepts from users, we further propose to iteratively find the closest concept embedding to the residual parameters during the reconstruction until the residual is small enough. To the best of our knowledge, our “OpenCBM” is the first CBM with concepts of open vocabularies, providing users the unique benefit such as removing, adding, or replacing any desired concept to explain the model’s prediction even after a model is trained. Moreover, our model significantly outperforms the previous state-of-the-art CBM by 9% in the classification accuracy on the benchmark dataset CUB-200-2011.

title: Andrea Caraffa*, Davide Boscaini, Amir Hamza, Fabio Poiesi
title_en: Andrea Caraffa*, Davide Boscaini, Amir Hamza, Fabio Poiesi
abstract: 在训练过程中未见过的对象的6自由度位姿估计具有高度需求但极具挑战性。零样本对象6自由度位姿估计方法通过利用大规模、逼真的合成数据集提供的额外任务特定监督来解决这一挑战。然而,其性能严重依赖于渲染数据的质量和多样性,并且需要大量的训练。在本文中,我们展示了如何在不使用任务特定数据训练的情况下完成相同任务。我们提出了一种新颖的解决方案,该方案利用了预训练的几何和视觉基础模型的能力。通过结合来自无关3D点云数据集学习的3D几何描述符和来自网络规模2D图像集合学习的2D视觉特征,生成独特的3D点级描述符。然后通过基于RANSAC的3D配准估计未见过对象的6自由度位姿。我们还引入了一种基于视觉特征的新算法,以解决几何对称对象引起的歧义。我们在BOP基准的七个核心数据集上进行了全面评估,这些数据集包含超过一百个3D对象和在各种场景中拍摄的20,000张图像。我们的方法在所有最先进的方法中表现一致,包括在合成6自由度位姿估计数据上广泛训练的竞争对手。代码可在 andreacaraffa.github.io/freeze 公开获取。
abstract_en: Estimating the 6D pose of objects unseen during training is highly desirable yet challenging. Zero-shot object 6D pose estimation methods address this challenge by leveraging additional task-specific supervision provided by large-scale, photo-realistic synthetic datasets. However, their performance heavily depends on the quality and diversity of rendered data and they require extensive training. In this work, we show how to tackle the same task but without training on task-specific data. We propose , a novel solution that harnesses the capabilities of pre-trained geometric and vision foundation models. generates distinctive 3D point-level descriptors by combining 3D geometric descriptors learned from unrelated 3D point cloud datasets and 2D visual features learned from web-scale 2D image collections. We then estimate the 6D pose of unseen objects via RANSAC-based 3D registration. We also introduce a novel algorithm based on visual features to resolve ambiguities caused by geometrically symmetric objects. We comprehensively evaluate across the seven core datasets of the BOP Benchmark, which include over a hundred 3D objects and 20,000 images captured in various scenarios. consistently outperforms all state-of-the-art approaches, including competitors extensively trained on synthetic 6D pose estimation data. Code is publicly available at andreacaraffa.github.io/freeze.

title: 安德里亚·康蒂*, 马特奥·波吉, 瓦莱里奥·卡姆巴雷里, 斯特凡诺·马托奇亚
title_en: Andrea Conti*, Matteo Poggi, Valerio Cambareri, Stefano Mattoccia
abstract: 高帧率和精确的深度估计在机器人和汽车感知的多个关键任务中起着重要作用。目前,这可以通过用于室内和室外应用的ToF和LiDAR设备实现。然而,它们的应用受到低帧率、能耗和空间稀疏性的限制。深度按需(DoD)通过利用高帧率RGB传感器与潜在较低帧率和稀疏主动深度传感器相结合,实现了精确的时间和空间深度密集化。我们的提案通过显著减少对深度传感器的流媒体需求,通过其三个核心阶段:i)多模态编码,ii)迭代多模态集成,iii)深度解码,共同实现了更低的能耗和更密集的形状重建。我们展示了扩展的证据,评估了DoD在室内和室外视频数据集上的有效性,涵盖了环境扫描和汽车感知的使用案例。
abstract_en: High frame rate and accurate depth estimation plays an important role in several tasks crucial to robotics and automotive perception. To date, this can be achieved through ToF and LiDAR devices for indoor and outdoor applications, respectively. However, their applicability is limited by low frame rate, energy consumption, and spatial sparsity. Depth on Demand (DoD) allows for accurate temporal and spatial depth densification achieved by exploiting a high frame rate RGB sensor coupled with a potentially lower frame rate and sparse active depth sensor. Our proposal jointly enables lower energy consumption and denser shape reconstruction, by significantly reducing the streaming requirements on the depth sensor thanks to its three core stages: i) multi-modal encoding, ii) iterative multi-modal integration, and iii) depth decoding. We present extended evidence assessing the effectiveness of DoD on indoor and outdoor video datasets, covering both environment scanning and automotive perception use cases.

title: 基于学习的校准方法在从单张图像估计宽视场相机参数方面展现出有前景的结果。然而,这些端到端方法通常受限于单一固定相机模型,导致以下问题:(i) 缺乏灵活性,当更换相机模型时需要更改网络架构并重新训练;(ii) 准确性降低,单一模型限制了训练数据中相机类型的多样性;(iii) 相机模型选择受限,因为基于学习的方法需要可微分的损失函数,因此需要具有闭式解的去畸变方程。为此,我们提出了一种针对径向对称相机的新型两步校准框架。我们的方法核心是一个专用的卷积神经网络(CNN),给定输入图像,输出隐式相机表示(VaCR),将每个图像点映射到投影到该点的3D光束方向。VaCR随后用于鲁棒的非线性优化过程,以确定任何输入的径向对称模型的相机参数。通过将相机模型参数估计与仅基于模型径向对称性假设的VaCR分离,我们克服了端到端方法的主要局限性。实验结果证明了所提框架相比现有方法的优势。代码见github.com/andreadalcin/RadiallySymmetricCalib。
title_en: Andrea Porfiri Dal Cin*, Francesco Azzoni, Giacomo Boracchi, Luca Magri*
abstract: __ABS_MATH_1__
abstract_en: Recent learning-based calibration methods yield promising results in estimating parameters for wide field-of-view cameras from single images. Yet, these end-to-end approaches are typically tethered to one fixed camera model, leading to issues: (i) lack of flexibility, necessitating network architectural changes and retraining when changing camera models; (ii) reduced accuracy, as a single model limits the diversity of cameras represented in the training data; (iii) restrictions in camera model selection, as learning-based methods need differentiable loss functions and, thus, undistortion equations with closed-form solutions. In response, we present a novel two-step calibration framework for radially symmetric cameras. Key to our approach is a specialized CNN that, given an input image, outputs an implicit camera representation (VaCR), mapping each image point to the direction of the 3D light ray projecting onto it. The VaCR is used in a subsequent robust non-linear optimization process to determine the camera parameters for any radially symmetric model provided as input. By disentangling the estimation of camera model parameters from the VaCR, which is based only on the assumption of radial symmetry in the model, we overcome the main limitations of end-to-end approaches. Experimental results demonstrate the advantages of the proposed framework compared to state-of-the-art methods. Code is at github.com/andreadalcin/RadiallySymmetricCalib.

title: Andrei Atanov*, Rishubh Singh, Jiawei Fu, Isabella Yu, Andrew Spielberg, Amir Zamir
title_en: Andrei Atanov*, Rishubh Singh, Jiawei Fu, Isabella Yu, Andrew Spielberg, Amir Zamir
abstract: 在解决计算机视觉任务时,事实上的标准方法是使用通用的高分辨率相机,并根据人类直觉选择其在智能体上的安装位置。另一方面,自然界中广泛存在的极其简单且设计精良的视觉传感器使许多生物能够展现出多样且复杂的行为。受这些例子的启发,我们提出以下问题:1. 简单视觉传感器在解决视觉任务中的有效性如何?2. 它们的设计在有效性方面起什么作用?我们探索了分辨率低至单像素的简单传感器,代表单个感光细胞。首先,我们证明仅需少量感光细胞即可合理地解决不同的视觉任务,例如视觉导航和连续控制,即其性能显著优于盲体,并与高分辨率相机相当。其次,我们表明这些简单视觉传感器的设计在提供有用信息和成功解决这些任务方面起着关键作用。为了找到表现良好的设计,我们提出了一种计算设计优化算法,并在不同任务和领域中评估其有效性,显示出有希望的结果。最后,我们进行了一项人类调查,评估人类手动设计的直观设计的有效性,结果显示计算找到的设计在大多数情况下是最佳设计之一。
abstract_en: A de facto standard approach in solving computer vision tasks is to use a common high-resolution camera and choose its placement on an agent based on human intuition. On the other hand, extremely simple and well-designed visual sensors found throughout nature allow many organisms to exhibit diverse, complex behaviors. In this work, motivated by these examples, we raise the following questions: 1. How effective simple visual sensors are in solving vision tasks? 2. What role does their design play in their effectiveness? We explore simple sensors with resolutions as low as one-by-one pixel, representing a single photoreceptor. First, we demonstrate that just a few photoreceptors can be enough to solve different vision tasks, such as visual navigation and continuous control, reasonably well, i.e., with the performance significantly better than that of a blind agent and comparable to a high-resolution camera. Second, we show that the design of these simple visual sensors plays a crucial role in their ability to provide useful information and successfully solve these tasks. To find a well-performing design, we present a computational design optimization algorithm and evaluate its effectiveness across different tasks and domains, showing promising results. Finally, we conduct a human survey to evaluate the effectiveness of intuitive designs engineered manually by humans, showing that the computationally found design is among the best designs in most cases.

title: COMPOSE: 一种用于人像的新型阴影编辑管道
title_en: Andrew Z Hou*, Zhixin Shu, Xuaner Zhang, He Zhang, Yannick Hold-Geoffroy, Jae Shin Yoon, Xiaoming Liu
abstract: 现有的人像重照明方法在精确控制面部阴影方面存在困难,尤其是在处理方向性光源产生的硬阴影或在保持现有光照条件和谐的情况下调整阴影时。在许多情况下,完全改变输入光照对于人像修图应用是不理想的:人们可能希望保留所拍摄环境的一些真实性。现有的阴影编辑方法通常仅限于面部区域,并且通常提供有限的光照控制选项,如阴影柔化或旋转。在本文中,我们引入了COMPOSE:一种新颖的人像阴影编辑管道,可对阴影属性(如形状、强度和位置)进行精确控制,同时保留人像的原始环境光照。这种程度的解耦和可控性得益于对环境图表示的创新分解,将其分为环境光和可编辑的高斯主导光源。COMPOSE是一个四阶段管道,包括光照估计与编辑、光照扩散、阴影合成以及最终的阴影编辑。我们将面部阴影定义为由主导光源产生的结果,并使用我们创新的高斯环境图表示进行编码。利用OLAT数据集,我们训练了模型以:(1) 从图像预测该光源表示,(2) 使用该表示生成逼真的阴影。我们还通过管道展示了全面且直观的阴影编辑。通过广泛的定量和定性评估,我们证明了系统在阴影编辑方面的强大能力。
abstract_en: Existing portrait relighting methods struggle with precise control over facial shadows, particularly when faced with challenges such as handling hard shadows from directional light sources or adjusting shadows while remaining in harmony with existing lighting conditions. In many situations, completely altering input lighting is undesirable for portrait retouching applications: one may want to preserve some authenticity in the captured environment. Existing shadow editing methods typically restrict their application to just the facial region and often offer limited lighting control options, such as shadow softening or rotation. In this paper, we introduce COMPOSE: a novel shadow editing pipeline for human portraits, offering precise control over shadow attributes such as shape, intensity, and position, all while preserving the original environmental illumination of the portrait. This level of disentanglement and controllability is obtained thanks to a novel decomposition of the environment map representation into ambient light and an editable gaussian dominant light source. COMPOSE is a four-stage pipeline that consists of light estimation and editing, light diffusion, shadow synthesis, and finally shadow editing. We define facial shadows as the result of a dominant light source, encoded using our novel gaussian environment map representation. Utilizing an OLAT dataset, we have trained models to: (1) predict this light source representation from images, and (2) generate realistic shadows using this representation. We also demonstrate comprehensive and intuitive shadow editing with our pipeline. Through extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations, we have demonstrated the robust capability of our system in shadow editing.

title: Andrey Voynov*, Amir Hertz, Moab Arar, Shlomi Fruchter, Daniel Cohen-Or
title_en: Andrey Voynov*, Amir Hertz, Moab Arar, Shlomi Fruchter, Daniel Cohen-Or
abstract: 当前最先进的扩散模型可以根据文本、分割和深度等条件生成高度逼真的图像。然而,一个常被忽视的重要方面是图像捕捉时所使用的特定相机几何形状。不同光学系统对最终场景外观的影响经常被忽视。本研究引入了一个框架,将文本到图像的扩散模型与图像渲染中使用的特定镜头几何形状紧密集成。我们的方法基于基于像素坐标的条件方法,能够控制渲染几何。值得注意的是,我们展示了曲率属性的操控,实现了多样的视觉效果,如鱼眼、全景视图和球面纹理,使用单个扩散模型。
abstract_en: State-of-the-art diffusion models can generate highly realistic images based on various conditioning like text, segmentation, and depth. However, an essential aspect often overlooked is the specific camera geometry used during image capture. The influence of different optical systems on the final scene appearance is frequently overlooked. This study introduces a framework that intimately integrates a text-to-image diffusion model with the particular lens geometry used in image rendering. Our method is based on a per-pixel coordinate conditioning method, enabling the control over the rendering geometry. Notably, we demonstrate the manipulation of curvature properties, achieving diverse visual effects, such as fish-eye, panoramic views, and spherical texturing using a single diffusion model.

title: Andy V Huynh*, Lauren Gillespie, Jael Lopez-Saucedo, Claire Tang, Rohan Sikand, Moisés Expósito-Alonso
title_en: Andy V Huynh*, Lauren Gillespie, Jael Lopez-Saucedo, Claire Tang, Rohan Sikand, Moisés Expósito-Alonso
abstract: 多模态图像-文本对比学习表明,可以跨模态学习联合表示。本文展示如何通过对比学习利用图像数据的多种视图,即使在某一视图缺失的情况下,也能提升物种识别的下游细粒度分类性能。我们提出ContRastive Image-remote Sensing Pre-training (CRISP)—一种用于自然世界地面和空中图像表示学习的新预训练任务,并引入Nature Multi-View (NMV)数据集,该数据集包含超过300万对地面和空中图像,涵盖加利福尼亚州生态多样性丰富的地区中超过6,000种植物分类群。NMV数据集及配套材料可在hf.co/datasets/ andyvhuynh/NatureMultiView获取。
abstract_en: Multimodal image-text contrastive learning has shown that joint representations can be learned across modalities. Here, we show how leveraging multiple views of image data with contrastive learning can improve downstream fine-grained classification performance for species recognition, even when one view is absent. We propose ContRastive Image-remote Sensing Pre-training (CRISP)—a new pre-training task for ground-level and aerial image representation learning of the natural world—and introduce Nature Multi-View (NMV), a dataset of natural world imagery including > 3 million ground-level and aerial image pairs for over 6,000 plant taxa across the ecologically diverse state of California. The NMV dataset and accompanying material are available at hf.co/datasets/ andyvhuynh/NatureMultiView.

title: __TITLE_MATH_1__
title_en: Aneeshan Sain*, Pinaki Nath Chowdhury, Subhadeep Koley, Ayan Kumar Bhunia, Yi-Zhe Song
abstract: 本文深入探讨了细粒度草图基于图像检索(FG-SBIR)的复杂动态,重点分析了草图创作过程中视角选择这一关键但被忽视的方面。与能够通过大规模数据集无缝处理多视角的图像系统不同,受限于固定视角数据采集,草图系统面临显著挑战。我们的初步研究采用预训练的FG-SBIR模型,揭示了当查询草图与目标实例视角不同时系统的表现困境。有趣的是,问卷调查结果显示用户更倾向于自主性,多数用户支持视角特定的检索方式。为解决这一矛盾,我们倡导构建视角感知系统,无缝支持视角无关与视角特定任务。克服数据集局限性,我们的第一贡献通过多视角的3D物体2D投影,引入跨模态视角感知。第二贡献提出通过解耦实现可定制的跨模态特征,实现模式切换的便捷性。在标准数据集上的大量实验验证了方法的有效性。
abstract_en: In this paper, we delve into the intricate dynamics of Fine-Grained Sketch-Based Image Retrieval (FG-SBIR) by addressing a critical yet overlooked aspect – the choice of viewpoint during sketch creation. Unlike photo systems that seamlessly handle diverse views through extensive datasets, sketch systems, with limited data collected from fixed perspectives, face challenges. Our pilot study, employing a pre-trained FG-SBIR model, highlights the system’s struggle when query-sketches differ in viewpoint from target instances. Interestingly, a questionnaire however shows users desire autonomy, with a significant percentage favouring view-specific retrieval. To reconcile this, we advocate for a view-aware system, seamlessly accommodating both view-agnostic and view-specific tasks. Overcoming dataset limitations, our first contribution leverages multi-view 2D projections of 3D objects, instilling cross-modal view awareness. The second contribution introduces a customisable cross-modal feature through disentanglement, allowing effortless mode switching. Extensive experiments on standard datasets validate the effectiveness of our method.

title: Anestis Kastellos*, Athanasios Psaltis, Charalampos Z Patrikakis, Petros Daras
title_en: Anestis Kastellos*, Athanasios Psaltis, Charalampos Z Patrikakis, Petros Daras
abstract: 在联邦学习(FL)领域,管理模型架构变异性的问题超越了单纯的工程技术障碍,成为该领域发展的关键要素,尤其是在文献中不断涌现的模型架构数量持续增加的背景下。这种对架构变异性关注的产生源于联邦学习的独特性质,即多样化的设备或参与者,各自拥有不同的数据和计算约束,共同训练共享模型。所提出的FL系统架构能够在不同客户端部署多样化的卷积神经网络(CNN)架构,同时超越现有最先进的FL方法。FedHARM 1 通过让每个本地客户端在共享数据集上收敛,利用不同架构的优势并限制其弱点,从而在测试集上实现更优性能。1 代码:https://github.com/Kastellos/FedHARM
abstract_en: In the domain of Federated Learning (FL), the issue of managing variability in model architectures surpasses a mere technical barrier, representing a crucial aspect of the field’s evolution, especially considering the ever-increasing number of model architectures emerging in the literature. This focus on architecture variability emerges from the unique nature of FL, where diverse devices or participants, each with their own data and computational constraints, collaboratively train a shared model. The proposed FL system architecture facilitates the deployment of diverse convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures across distinct clients, while outperforming the state-of-the-art FL methodologies. F edHARM 1 capitalizes on the strengths of different architectures while limiting their weaknesses by converging each local client on a shared dataset to achieve superior performance on the test set. 1 Code: https://github.com/Kastellos/FedHARM

title: Angelos Kratimenos*, Jiahui Lei, Kostas Daniilidis
title_en: Angelos Kratimenos*, Jiahui Lei, Kostas Daniilidis
abstract: 准确且高效地建模动态场景和运动被视为一项极具挑战性的任务,这归因于时间动态性和运动复杂性。为应对这些挑战,我们提出了一种紧凑且高效的表示方法,将动态场景分解为若干神经轨迹。我们认为,动态场景中每个点的运动可以分解为一组显式或学习得到的轨迹。我们精心设计的神经框架仅在时间维度查询极小的已学习基底集合,从而实现与3D高斯泼溅相似的渲染速度,超过120帧每秒,同时仅需静态场景两倍的存储空间。我们的神经表示方法有效约束了动态场景固有的欠约束运动场,从而实现高效且快速的优化。这是通过将每个点绑定到运动系数,强制共享基底轨迹实现的。通过谨慎地对运动系数应用稀疏性损失,我们能够解耦构成场景的运动,独立控制它们,并生成前所未见的新运动组合。我们仅需5分钟训练即可达到最先进的渲染质量,在不到半小时内即可合成具有超现实质量的动态场景新视角。我们的表示方法具有可解释性、高效性,并且表达能力足够强大,可在单目和多视角场景中实现实时复杂动态场景运动的视图合成。
abstract_en: Accurately and efficiently modeling dynamic scenes and motions is considered so challenging a task due to temporal dynamics and motion complexity. To address these challenges, we propose , a compact and efficient representation that decomposes a dynamic scene into a few neural trajectories. We argue that the per-point motions of a dynamic scene can be decomposed into a small set of explicit or learned trajectories. Our carefully designed neural framework consisting of a tiny set of learned basis queried only in time allows for rendering speed similar to 3D Gaussian Splatting, surpassing 120 FPS, while at the same time, requiring only double the storage compared to static scenes. Our neural representation adequately constrains the inherently underconstrained motion field of a dynamic scene leading to effective and fast optimization. This is done by biding each point to motion coefficients that enforce the per-point sharing of basis trajectories. By carefully applying a sparsity loss to the motion coefficients, we are able to disentangle the motions that comprise the scene, independently control them, and generate novel motion combinations that have never been seen before. We can reach state-of-the-art render quality within just 5 minutes of training and in less than half an hour, we can synthesize novel views of dynamic scenes with superior photorealistic quality. Our representation is interpretable, efficient, and expressive enough to offer real-time view synthesis of complex dynamic scene motions, in monocular and multi-view scenarios.

title: Anh Thai*, Weiyao Wang, Hao Tang, Stefan Stojanov, James M Rehg, Matt Feiszli
title_en: Anh Thai*, Weiyao Wang, Hao Tang, Stefan Stojanov, James M Rehg, Matt Feiszli
abstract: 3D物体部分分割在计算机视觉应用中至关重要。尽管在2D物体部分分割领域已取得显著进展,但3D版本的研究却较少,部分原因在于标注的3D数据集稀缺,且收集成本高昂。在本工作中,我们提出利用少量标注的3D形状或丰富的2D标注数据集进行3D物体部分分割。我们提出了一种新颖的方法,称为3-By-2,在不同基准测试中实现了最先进(SOTA)性能,适用于不同粒度级别。通过使用预训练基础模型的特征并利用语义和几何对应关系,我们能够克服有限3D标注的挑战。我们的方法利用可用的2D标签,实现了有效的3D物体部分分割。该方法3-By-2可适应各种部分分类体系和粒度级别,展示了跨不同物体类别的部分标签迁移能力。项目网站:https://ngailapdi.github.io/projects/3by2/
abstract_en: 3D object part segmentation is essential in computer vision applications. While substantial progress has been made in 2D object part segmentation, the 3D counterpart has received less attention, in part due to the scarcity of annotated 3D datasets, which are expensive to collect. In this work, we propose to leverage a few annotated 3D shapes or richly annotated 2D datasets to perform 3D object part segmentation. We present our novel approach, termed 3-By-2 that achieves SOTA performance on different benchmarks with various granularity levels. By using features from pretrained foundation models and exploiting semantic and geometric correspondences, we are able to overcome the challenges of limited 3D annotations. Our approach leverages available 2D labels, enabling effective 3D object part segmentation. Our method 3-By-2 can accommodate various part taxonomies and granularities, demonstrating part label transfer ability across different object categories. Project website: https://ngailapdi.github.io/projects/3by2/.

title: Anil Batra*, Davide Moltisanti, Laura Sevilla-Lara, Marcus Rohrbach, Frank Keller
title_en: Anil Batra*, Davide Moltisanti, Laura Sevilla-Lara, Marcus Rohrbach, Frank Keller
abstract: 程序化视频(如食谱演示)在传达分步指令方面具有重要作用。然而,理解此类视频具有挑战性,因为它涉及步骤的精确定位和文本指令的生成。手动标注步骤和编写指令成本高昂,这限制了当前数据集的规模并阻碍了有效的学习。利用大型但嘈杂的视频-转录数据集进行预训练可以提升性能,但需要大量计算资源。此外,转录内容包含无关信息,且风格与人类编写的指令不同。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新技术__TITLE_MATH_1__,用于自动为食谱领域生成高质量训练数据:(i) Sieve:过滤无关转录内容;(ii) Swap:通过将转录内容替换为文本型食谱数据集中的人类编写指令,获取高质量文本。最终生成的数据集规模比当前网络级数据集小三个数量级,但仍能高效训练大规模模型。除__TITLE_MATH_1__外,我们还提出Procedure Transformer(ProcX),该模型用于程序化视频的端到端步骤定位和指令生成。当在我们整理的数据集上预训练时,该模型在YouCook2和Tasty数据集上实现了最先进的性能,且仅使用了少量训练数据。我们已发布代码和数据集。1 1 https://github.com/anilbatra2185/sns_procx
abstract_en: Procedural videos, exemplified by recipe demonstrations, are instrumental in conveying step-by-step instructions. However, understanding such videos is challenging as it involves the precise localization of steps and the generation of textual instructions. Manually annotating steps and writing instructions is costly, which limits the size of current datasets and hinders effective learning. Leveraging large but noisy video-transcript datasets for pre-training can boost performance but demands significant computational resources. Furthermore, transcripts contain irrelevant content and differ in style from human-written instructions. To mitigate these issues, we propose a novel technique, , to automatically generate high-quality training data for the recipe domain: (i) Sieve: filters irrelevant transcripts and (ii) Swap: acquires high-quality text by replacing transcripts with human-written instruction from a text-only recipe dataset. The resulting dataset is three orders of magnitude smaller than current web-scale datasets but enables efficient training of large-scale models. Alongside , we propose Procedure Transformer (ProcX), a model for end-to-end step localization and instruction generation for procedural videos. When pre-trained on our curated dataset, this model achieves state-of-the-art performance on YouCook2 and Tasty while using a fraction of the training data. We have released code and dataset.1 1 https://github.com/anilbatra2185/sns_procx

title: Animesh Karnewar*, Roman Shapovalov, Tom Monnier, Andrea Vedaldi, Niloy J. Mitra*, David Novotny*
title_en: Animesh Karnewar*, Roman Shapovalov, Tom Monnier, Andrea Vedaldi, Niloy J. Mitra*, David Novotny*
abstract: 将物体的2D视图信息编码到3D表示中对于通用的3D特征提取至关重要。此类特征可进一步用于3D重建、3D生成等应用。我们提出(Gradient Origin Embeddings)方法,无需预先训练的图像特征提取器即可将输入的2D图像编码到任意3D表示中;不同于典型的先前方法,这些方法要么使用大型预训练模型提取的2D特征对输入图像进行编码,要么为处理不同的3D表示设计定制特征;更糟糕的是,针对特定3D神经表示(如MLPs和hash-grids)的编码器可能尚未可用。我们在OmniObject3D基准上广泛评估了我们的方法在不同实验设置下的表现。首先,我们通过一个名为Plenoptic-Encoding的示例实验,评估该机制在多种3D表示上的表现与先前编码机制的对比情况。其次,通过结合__ABS_MATH_1__和DFM(Diffusion with Forward Models)实现的Fusion方法,在OmniObject3D生成任务中取得了新的SOTA FID值22.12,进一步验证了GOEmbed机制的有效性。最后,我们评估了该机制对稀疏视角3D重建流程的增强效果。
abstract_en: Encoding information from 2D views of an object into a 3D representation is crucial for generalized 3D feature extraction. Such features can then enable 3D reconstruction, 3D generation, and other applications. We propose (Gradient Origin Embeddings) that encodes input 2D images into any 3D representation, without requiring a pre-trained image feature extractor; unlike typical prior approaches in which input images are either encoded using 2D features extracted from large pre-trained models, or customized features are designed to handle different 3D representations; or worse, encoders may not yet be available for specialized 3D neural representations such as MLPs and hash-grids. We extensively evaluate our proposed under different experimental settings on the OmniObject3D benchmark. First, we evaluate how well the mechanism compares against prior encoding mechanisms on multiple 3D representations using an illustrative experiment called Plenoptic-Encoding. Second, the efficacy of the GOEmbed mechanism is further demonstrated by achieving a new SOTA FID of 22.12 on the OmniObject3D generation task using a combination of and DFM (Diffusion with Forward Models), which we call Fusion. Finally, we evaluate how the mechanism bolsters sparse-view 3D reconstruction pipelines.

title: Animesh Sinha*, Bo Sun, Anmol Kalia, Arantxa Casanova, Elliot Blanchard, David Yan, Winnie Zhang, Tony Nelli, Jiahui Chen, Hardik Shah, Licheng Yu, Mitesh Kumar Singh, Ankit Ramchandani, Maziar Sanjabi, Sonal Gupta, Amy L Bearman, Dhruv Mahajan
title_en: Animesh Sinha*, Bo Sun, Anmol Kalia, Arantxa Casanova, Elliot Blanchard, David Yan, Winnie Zhang, Tony Nelli, Jiahui Chen, Hardik Shah, Licheng Yu, Mitesh Kumar Singh, Ankit Ramchandani, Maziar Sanjabi, Sonal Gupta, Amy L Bearman, Dhruv Mahajan
abstract: 我们提出了一种名为Style Tailoring的方法,用于在特定领域对潜在扩散模型(LDMs)进行微调,以实现高质量的视觉效果、提示对齐和场景多样性。我们选择贴纸图像生成作为目标领域,因为这些图像与通常由大规模LDMs生成的逼真图像有显著差异。我们以Emu等优秀的文本到图像模型为起点,发现依赖于逼真模型的提示工程生成贴纸会导致提示对齐和场景多样性不足。为克服这些缺陷,我们首先使用弱监督收集数百万张贴纸样图像对Emu进行微调以激发多样性。随后,我们从模型生成中精选人类在环(HITL)对齐和风格数据集,并分别进行微调以提升提示对齐和风格对齐。在这些数据集上的顺序微调在风格对齐和提示对齐之间存在权衡。为解决这一权衡,我们提出了一种名为Style Tailoring的新型微调方法,该方法联合拟合内容和风格分布,实现最佳平衡。评估结果表明,与使用基础Emu模型进行贴纸生成的提示工程相比,我们的方法在视觉质量上提升了14%,提示对齐度提升了16.2%,场景多样性提升了15.3%。
abstract_en: We introduce Style Tailoring, a recipe to finetune Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) in a distinct domain with high visual quality, prompt alignment and scene diversity. We choose sticker image generation as the target domain, as the images significantly differ from photorealistic samples typically generated by large-scale LDMs. We start with a competent text-to-image model, like Emu, and show that relying on prompt engineering with a photorealistic model to generate stickers leads to poor prompt alignment and scene diversity. To overcome these drawbacks, we first finetune Emu on millions of sticker-like images collected using weak supervision to elicit diversity. Next, we curate Human-in-the-loop (HITL) Alignment and Style datasets from model generations, and finetune to improve prompt alignment and style alignment respectively. Sequential finetuning on these datasets poses a tradeoff between better style alignment and prompt alignment gains. To address this tradeoff, we propose a novel fine-tuning method called Style Tailoring, which jointly fits the content and style distribution and achieves best tradeoff. Evaluation results show our method improves visual quality by 14%, prompt alignment by 16.2% and scene diversity by 15.3%, compared to prompt engineering the base Emu model for stickers generation.

title: Anindita Ghosh*, Rishabh Dabral, Vladislav Golyanik, Christian Theobalt, Philipp Slusallek
title_en: Anindita Ghosh*, Rishabh Dabral, Vladislav Golyanik, Christian Theobalt, Philipp Slusallek
abstract: 当前针对三维人体运动合成的方法能够生成高质量的数字人类动画,使其执行各种动作和手势。然而,在这一范式中,处理多人交互的复杂动力学仍存在显著的技术缺口。在本文中,我们提出__TITLE_MATH_1__,这是一种基于去噪扩散的模型,能够合成两人交互场景中人体的全身反应性运动。给定一个人的运动,我们采用结合时空交叉注意力机制,合成第二个人的反应性身体和手部运动,从而完成两人之间的互动。我们在具有挑战性的两人场景中进行了验证,如双人舞蹈、忍术、踢拳和杂技,其中一个人的运动对另一个人产生复杂且多样的影响。我们还贡献了一个包含全身和手指运动的两人交互数据集。我们通过多种定量指标、定性可视化和用户研究进行评估,并表明其在交互式运动编辑应用中的可用性。更多细节请访问项目页面:https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/remos
abstract_en: Current approaches for 3D human motion synthesis generate high-quality animations of digital humans performing a wide variety of actions and gestures. However, a notable technological gap exists in addressing the complex dynamics of multi-human interactions within this paradigm. In this work, we present , a denoising diffusion-based model that synthesizes full-body reactive motion of a person in a two-person interaction scenario. Given the motion of one person, we employ a combined spatio-temporal cross-attention mechanism to synthesize the reactive body and hand motion of the second person, thereby completing the interactions between the two. We demonstrate across challenging two-person scenarios such as pair-dancing, Ninjutsu, kickboxing, and acrobatics, where one person’s movements have complex and diverse influences on the other. We also contribute the dataset for two-person interactions containing full-body and finger motions. We evaluate through multiple quantitative metrics, qualitative visualizations, and a user study, and also indicate usability in interactive motion editing applications. More details are available on the project page: https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/remos

title: Aniruddha Mahapatra*, Richa Mishra*, Ziyi Chen, Boyang Ding, Renda Li, Shoulei Wang, Jun-Yan Zhu, Peng Chang, Mei Han, Jing Xiao
title_en: Aniruddha Mahapatra*, Richa Mishra*, Ziyi Chen, Boyang Ding, Renda Li, Shoulei Wang, Jun-Yan Zhu, Peng Chang, Mei Han, Jing Xiao
abstract: 共语音手势视频生成是许多数字人应用的关键技术。在生成高质量的说话头视频方面已经取得了显著进展。然而,现有的手势视频生成方法主要受限于广泛采用的基于2D骨架的手势表示,仍然难以生成逼真的手部动作。我们引入了一种音频驱动的共语音视频生成流程,利用基于3D人体网格的表示方法来合成人类语音视频。通过采用基于3D人体网格的手势表示,我们提出了一种基于网格的视频生成器,包括网格纹理图优化步骤,随后是条件生成对抗网络(GAN),输出具有逼真手部动作的逼真手势视频。我们在TalkSHOW数据集上的实验表明,我们的方法在2D骨架基准方法上更有效。
abstract_en: Co-speech gesture video generation is an enabling technique for many digital human applications. Substantial progress has been made in creating high-quality talking head videos. However, existing hand gesture video generation methods are primarily limited by the widely adopted 2D skeleton-based gesture representation and still struggle to generate realistic hands. We introduce an audio-driven co-speech video generation pipeline to synthesize human speech videos leveraging 3D human mesh-based representations. By adopting a 3D human mesh-based gesture representation, we present a mesh-grounded video generator that includes a mesh texture map optimization step followed by a conditional GAN network and outputs photorealistic gesture videos with realistic hands. Our experiments on the TalkSHOW dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of our method over 2D skeleton-based baselines.

title: Anita Rau*, Josiah Aklilu, Floyd C Holsinger, Serena Yeung-Levy
title_en: Anita Rau*, Josiah Aklilu, Floyd C Holsinger, Serena Yeung-Levy
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRFs)通过最小化预测视角的渲染损失进行训练。然而,光度损失通常无法提供足够的信息来区分产生相同图像的不同可能几何结构。因此,先前的工作在NeRF训练中引入了深度监督,利用预训练深度网络的密集预测作为伪真实值。尽管这些深度先验假设在去除噪声后是完美的,但在实践中,其准确性更难以捕捉。本文提出了一种新颖的方法来处理NeRF监督中的深度先验不确定性。我们不使用定制训练的深度或不确定性先验,而是使用现成的预训练扩散模型在去噪过程中预测深度并捕捉不确定性。由于我们意识到深度先验容易出错,我们提出使用地球移动距离(Earth Mover’s Distance)监督射线终止距离分布,而不是通过L2损失强制渲染深度精确复制深度先验。我们的深度引导NeRF在标准深度指标上显著优于所有基线,同时保持光度度量上的性能。
abstract_en: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) are trained to minimize the rendering loss of predicted viewpoints. However, the photometric loss often does not provide enough information to disambiguate between different possible geometries yielding the same image. Previous work has thus incorporated depth supervision during NeRF training, leveraging dense predictions from pre-trained depth networks as pseudo-ground truth. While these depth priors are assumed to be perfect once filtered for noise, in practice, their accuracy is more challenging to capture. This work proposes a novel approach to uncertainty in depth priors for NeRF supervision. Instead of using custom-trained depth or uncertainty priors, we use off-the-shelf pretrained diffusion models to predict depth and capture uncertainty during the denoising process. Because we know that depth priors are prone to errors, we propose to supervise the ray termination distance distribution with Earth Mover’s Distance instead of enforcing the rendered depth to replicate the depth prior exactly through L2 -loss. Our depth-guided NeRF outperforms all baselines on standard depth metrics by a large margin while maintaining performance on photometric measures.

title: Ankit Vani*, Bac Nguyen, Samuel Lavoie, Ranjay Krishna, Aaron Courville
title_en: Ankit Vani*, Bac Nguyen, Samuel Lavoie, Ranjay Krishna, Aaron Courville
abstract: 选择性注意帮助我们在持续不断的感官输入中聚焦于任务相关的方面。这种感知约束使我们能够在干扰下实现稳健泛化,并对可感知概念的新组合进行有效处理。Transformer架构采用了类似的注意力机制,但以Transformer为骨干的表征学习模型(如CLIP和DINO)往往无法展现稳健性和组合性。我们指出一个缺失的架构先验:与人类感知不同,Transformer编码不会对单个概念进行独立关注。为此,我们提出了一种读出机制,将编码划分为可独立关注的槽位,每个槽位由单个注意力头生成。将该机制应用于CLIP,赋予了归纳偏置:视觉和文本模态是共享组合性世界的不同视角,且对应概念相同。通过该机制,我们在CLIP上展示了下游识别、稳健性、检索和组合性基准测试的改进(在ImageNet上提升高达+14%,在SugarCrepe上提升+4%),并在DINO的最近邻和线性探针ImageNet任务上分别提升+3%。我们还展示了干预并选择单个概念以进一步提升下游任务性能的能力(SugarCrepe从+4%提升至+9%),并利用这一能力研究表示结构的稳健性。最后,我们通过消融实验和学习概念的可视化提供了深入见解。
abstract_en: Selective attention helps us focus on task-relevant aspects in the constant flood of our sensory input. This constraint in our perception allows us to robustly generalize under distractions and to new compositions of perceivable concepts. Transformers employ a similar notion of attention in their architecture, but representation learning models with transformer backbones like CLIP and DINO often fail to demonstrate robustness and compositionality. We highlight a missing architectural prior: unlike human perception, transformer encodings do not separately attend over individual concepts. In response, we propose , a read-out mechanism that partitions encodings into separately-attended slots, each produced by a single attention head. Using with CLIP imparts an inductive bias that the vision and text modalities are different views of a shared compositional world with the same corresponding concepts. Using , we demonstrate improvements on downstream recognition, robustness, retrieval, and compositionality benchmarks with CLIP (up to +14% for ImageNet, +4% for SugarCrepe), and on nearest neighbors and linear probe for ImageNet with DINO (+3% each). We also showcase a powerful ability to intervene and select individual concepts to further improve downstream task performance (up from +4% to +9% for SugarCrepe) and use this ability to study the robustness of ’s representation structure. Finally, we provide insights through ablation experiments and visualization of learned concepts.

title: Anpei Chen*, Haofei Xu, Stefano Esposito, Siyu Tang, Andreas Geiger
title_en: Anpei Chen*, Haofei Xu, Stefano Esposito, Siyu Tang, Andreas Geiger
abstract: 辐射场方法已实现了逼真新视角合成和几何重建。但它们主要应用于单场景优化或小基线设置中。尽管一些近期研究通过利用Transformer进行大基线前馈重建,但它们均采用标准的全局注意力机制,因此忽略了三维重建的局部特性。我们提出了一种方法,将Transformer层中的局部和全局推理统一起来,从而提高了质量和收敛速度。我们的模型将场景表示为高斯体积,并结合图像编码器和组注意力层,以实现高效的前馈重建。实验结果表明,我们的模型在四块GPU上训练两天后,在重建360度辐射场方面表现出高保真度,并且对零样本测试和域外测试具有鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Radiance field methods have achieved photorealistic novel view synthesis and geometry reconstruction. But they are mostly applied in per-scene optimization or small-baseline settings. While several recent works investigate feed-forward reconstruction with large baselines by utilizing transformers, they all operate with a standard global attention mechanism and hence ignore the local nature of 3D reconstruction. We propose a method that unifies local and global reasoning in transformer layers, resulting in improved quality and faster convergence. Our model represents scenes as Gaussian Volumes and combines this with an image encoder and Group Attention Layers for efficient feed-forward reconstruction. Experimental results demonstrate that our model, trained for two days on four GPUs, demonstrates high fidelity in reconstructing 360◦ radiance fields, and robustness to zero-shot and out-of-domain testing.

title: Anqi Zhang, Guangyu Gao*
title_en: Anqi Zhang, Guangyu Gao*
abstract: 类增量语义分割(CISS)在语义分割的增量学习中,旨在分割新类别同时减少对旧类别的灾难性遗忘。此外,背景迁移(background shifting)——即每一步背景类别持续变化——是CISS的一个特殊挑战。当前方法中共享背景分类器难以应对这些变化,导致背景预测稳定性下降和分割精度降低。针对这一特殊挑战,我们设计了一种新颖的背景适应机制,该机制在每一步显式建模背景残差而非背景本身,并聚合这些残差以表示演化的背景。因此,背景适应机制确保了先前背景分类器的稳定性,同时使模型能够专注于附加通道中易于学习的残差,从而增强背景区分能力,提升新类别的预测效果。为精确优化背景适应机制,我们提出伪背景二元交叉熵损失(Pseudo Background Binary Cross-Entropy loss)和背景适应损失(Background Adaptation losses),以放大适应效果。设计了分组知识蒸馏(Group Knowledge Distillation)和背景特征蒸馏(Background Feature Distillation)策略以防止旧类别的遗忘。我们的方法在Pascal VOC 2012和ADE20K数据集上评估,超越了现有无示例状态-of-the-art方法,在VOC 10-1中达到3.0%的mIoU,在ADE 100-5中达到2.0%的mIoU,显著提升了新类别的准确性并缓解了灾难性遗忘。代码可在https://andyzaq.github.io/barmsite/获取。
abstract_en: Class Incremental Semantic Segmentation (CISS), within Incremental Learning for semantic segmentation, targets segmenting new categories while reducing the catastrophic forgetting on the old categories. Besides, background shifting, where the background category changes constantly in each step, is a special challenge for CISS. Current methods with a shared background classifier struggle to keep up with these changes, leading to decreased stability in background predictions and reduced accuracy of segmentation. For this special challenge, we designed a novel background adaptation mechanism, which explicitly models the background residual rather than the background itself in each step, and aggregates these residuals to represent the evolving background. Therefore, the background adaptation mechanism ensures the stability of previous background classifiers, while enabling the model to concentrate on the easy-learned residuals from the additional channel, which enhances background discernment for better prediction of novel categories. To precisely optimize the background adaptation mechanism, we propose Pseudo Background Binary Cross-Entropy loss and Background Adaptation losses, which amplify the adaptation effect. Group Knowledge Distillation and Background Feature Distillation strategies are designed to prevent forgetting old categories. Our approach, evaluated across various incremental scenarios on Pascal VOC 2012 and ADE20K datasets, outperforms prior exemplar-free state-of-the-art methods with mIoU of 3.0% in VOC 10-1 and 2.0% in ADE 100-5, notably enhancing the accuracy of new classes while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Code is available in https://andyzaq.github.io/barmsite/.

title: Anselm Haselhoff*, Kevin Trelenberg, Fabian Küppers, Jonas Schneider
title_en: Anselm Haselhoff*, Kevin Trelenberg, Fabian Küppers, Jonas Schneider
abstract: 视觉反事实解释(CF)方法通过修改图像概念、形状等,以改变预测结果为预定义的输出,同时保持与原始查询图像的高度相似性。与自解释模型(SEMs)和热图技术不同,它们赋予用户检验假设性“如果...会怎样”场景的能力。以往的CF方法要么需要后验训练,限制了透明度与CF质量之间的平衡,要么要求在推理过程中进行优化。为弥合透明SEMs与CF方法之间的差距,我们引入了GdVAE,这是一种基于条件变分自编码器(CVAE)的自解释模型,集成了高斯判别分析(GDA)分类器和CF解释功能。通过生成分类器利用任务特定原型实现全透明度,并在潜在空间中采用闭式解来生成CF。通过使用解释器函数正则化潜在空间,提升了CF的一致性。与现有方法的广泛比较验证了我们的方法在生成高质量CF解释的同时保持透明度的有效性。代码和模型已公开。
abstract_en: Visual counterfactual explanation (CF) methods modify image concepts, , shape, to change a prediction to a predefined outcome while closely resembling the original query image. Unlike self-explainable models (SEMs) and heatmap techniques, they grant users the ability to examine hypothetical ”what-if” scenarios. Previous CF methods either entail post-hoc training, limiting the balance between transparency and CF quality, or demand optimization during inference. To bridge the gap between transparent SEMs and CF methods, we introduce the GdVAE, a self-explainable model based on a conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE), featuring a Gaussian discriminant analysis (GDA) classifier and integrated CF explanations. Full transparency is achieved through a generative classifier that leverages class-specific prototypes for the downstream task and a closed-form solution for CFs in the latent space. The consistency of CFs is improved by regularizing the latent space with the explainer function. Extensive comparisons with existing approaches affirm the effectiveness of our method in producing high-quality CF explanations while preserving transparency. Code and models are public.

title: Antoine Guédon*, Vincent Lepetit
title_en: Antoine Guédon*, Vincent Lepetit
abstract: 我们提出了一种名为Gaussian Frosting的新颖基于网格的表示方法,用于实时高质量渲染和编辑复杂的3D效果。我们的方法基于最近的三维高斯点喷涂框架,该框架通过优化一组三维高斯分布来从图像中逼近辐射场。我们首先在优化过程中从高斯分布中提取基础网格,然后构建并细化围绕网格的自适应高斯层,其厚度可变,以更好地捕捉表面附近的精细细节和体积效果,如头发或草。我们称这一层为Gaussian Frosting,因为它类似于蛋糕上的霜层。材料越模糊,霜层越厚。我们还引入了高斯分布的参数化方法,以确保它们保持在霜层内部,并在变形、缩放、编辑或动画网格时自动调整其参数。我们的表示方法允许通过高斯点喷涂实现高效的渲染,同时通过修改基础网格实现编辑和动画。此外,网格可用于高斯分布的遮挡剔除,加速优化和推理过程中的渲染。我们在各种合成和真实场景中展示了该方法的有效性,并表明其优于现有的基于表面的方法。我们还将发布代码和基于网络的查看器作为额外贡献。
abstract_en: We propose Gaussian Frosting, a novel mesh-based representation for high-quality rendering and editing of complex 3D effects in real-time. Our approach builds on the recent 3D Gaussian Splatting framework, which optimizes a set of 3D Gaussians to approximate a radiance field from images. We propose first extracting a base mesh from Gaussians during optimization, then building and refining an adaptive layer of Gaussians with a variable thickness around the mesh to better capture the fine details and volumetric effects near the surface, such as hair or grass. We call this layer Gaussian Frosting, as it resembles a coating of frosting on a cake. The fuzzier the material, the thicker the frosting. We also introduce a parameterization of the Gaussians to enforce them to stay inside the frosting layer and automatically adjust their parameters when deforming, rescaling, editing or animating the mesh. Our representation allows for efficient rendering using Gaussian splatting, as well as editing and animation by modifying the base mesh. Additionally, the mesh can be used for occlusion culling on Gaussians, accelerating rendering during both optimization and inference. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on various synthetic and real scenes, and show that it outperforms existing surface-based approaches. We will release our code and a web-based viewer as additional contributions.

title: Antonio Martinez-Sanchez*, Ulrike Homberg, J. M. Almira, Harold Phelippeau
title_en: Antonio Martinez-Sanchez*, Ulrike Homberg, J. M. Almira, Harold Phelippeau
abstract: 目标检测是计算机视觉中的主要任务。模板匹配是检测任意模板对象的参考方法。然而,模板匹配的计算复杂度取决于旋转精度,这成为大尺寸3D图像(断层扫描图像)的限制因素。在此,我们实现了一种名为张量模板匹配的新算法,该算法基于一个数学框架,通过张量场表示模板的所有旋转。与标准模板匹配不同,所提出的算法的计算复杂度与旋转精度无关。通过使用来自断层扫描的合成数据和真实数据,我们证明张量模板匹配比模板匹配快得多,并且有潜力提高其准确性。
abstract_en: Object detection is a main task in computer vision. Template matching is the reference method for detecting objects with arbitrary templates. However, template matching computational complexity depends on the rotation accuracy, being a limiting factor for large 3D images (tomograms). Here, we implement a new algorithm called tensorial template matching, based on a mathematical framework that represents all rotations of a template with a tensor field. Contrary to standard template matching, the computational complexity of the presented algorithm is independent of the rotation accuracy. Using both, synthetic and real data from tomography, we demonstrate that tensorial template matching is much faster than template matching and has the potential to improve its accuracy.

title: Antonio Tejero-de-Pablos*, Riku Togashi, Mayu Otani, Shin'ichi Satoh
title_en: Antonio Tejero-de-Pablos*, Riku Togashi, Mayu Otani, Shin'ichi Satoh
abstract: 无源域适应(SFDA)的目标是重新训练一个在源域(绘图)数据上训练的模型,仅使用目标域(照片)样本对目标域数据进行分类。除了域偏移之外,在现实场景中,源域和目标域中每个类别的样本数量也会不同(类别分布偏移,或CDS)。仅通过目标数据处理无标签的CDS具有挑战性,因此先前的方法假设源数据中没有类别不平衡。我们研究了SFDA流程,并首次提出了一种能够处理源数据和目标数据中类别不平衡的SFDA方法。虽然伪标签是SFDA中用于估计目标数据分布的核心技术,但它依赖于最近邻,这使其对类别分布偏移(CDS)敏感。我们能够通过利用额外的通用特征(这些特征不受源模型类别分布偏移偏差的影响)来计算稳健的最近邻。这为哪些最近邻更适合适应提供了“第二意见”。我们使用各种类型的特征、数据集和任务评估了我们的方法,在CDS下的SFDA中优于先前的方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/CyberAgentAILab/Robust_Nearest_Neighbors_SFDA-CDS获取。
abstract_en: The goal of source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) is retraining a model fit on data from a source domain (drawings) to classify data from a target domain (photos) employing only the target samples. In addition to the domain shift, in a realistic scenario, the number of samples per class on source and target would also differ (class distribution shift, or CDS). Dealing label-less with CDS via target data only is challenging, and thus previous methods assume no class imbalance in the source data. We study the SFDA pipeline and, for the first time, propose a SFDA method that can deal with class imbalance in both source and target data. While pseudolabeling is the core technique in SFDA to estimate the distribution of the target data, it relies on nearest neighbors, which makes it sensitive to class distribution shifts (CDS). We are able to calculate robust nearest neighbors by leveraging additional generic features free of the source model’s CDS bias. This provides a “second-opinion” regarding which nearest neighbors are more suitable for adaptation. We evaluate our method using various types of features, datasets and tasks, outperforming previous methods in SFDA under CDS. Our code is available at https://github.com/ CyberAgentAILab/Robust_Nearest_Neighbors_SFDA-CDS.

title: Anurag Das*, Xinting Hu, Li Jiang, Bernt Schiele
title_en: Anurag Das*, Xinting Hu, Li Jiang, Bernt Schiele
abstract: 近期研究表明,大型视觉-语言模型(如CLIP)可以提升语义分割性能。这些方法通常旨在实现像素级的视觉-语言对齐,但往往依赖于CLIP提供的低分辨率图像特征,导致边界处的类别歧义。此外,CLIP文本嵌入中的全局场景表示与局部和细节级别的像素特征之间缺乏直接关联,使得有意义的对齐更加困难。为解决这些局限性,我们提出MTA-CLIP,一种采用掩码级视觉-语言对齐的新框架。具体而言,我们首先提出Mask-Text Decoder,利用CLIP语言模型中的丰富文本数据增强掩码表示。随后,通过Mask-to-Text对比学习将掩码表示与文本嵌入进行对齐。此外,我们引入Mask-Text Prompt Learning,利用多个上下文特定的提示对文本嵌入进行优化,以捕捉掩码中多样化的类别表示。总体而言,MTA-CLIP在标准基准数据集ADE20k和Cityscapes上分别超越先前方法2.8%和1.3%,达到当前最优水平。
abstract_en: Recent approaches have shown that large-scale vision-language models such as CLIP can improve semantic segmentation performance. These methods typically aim for pixel-level vision-language alignment, but often rely on low-resolution image features from CLIP, resulting in class ambiguities along boundaries. Moreover, the global scene representations in CLIP text embeddings do not directly correlate with the local and detailed pixel-level features, making meaningful alignment more difficult. To address these limitations, we introduce MTA-CLIP, a novel framework employing mask-level vision-language alignment. Specifically, we first propose Mask-Text Decoder that enhances the mask representations using rich textual data with the CLIP language model. Subsequently, it aligns mask representations with text embeddings using Mask-to-Text Contrastive Learning. Furthermore, we introduce Mask-Text Prompt Learning, utilizing multiple context-specific prompts for text embeddings to capture diverse class representations across masks. Overall, MTA-CLIP achieves state-of-the-art, surpassing prior works by an average of 2.8% and 1.3% on standard benchmark datasets, ADE20k and Cityscapes, respectively.

title: Anxhelo Diko*, Danilo Avola, Bardh Prenkaj, Federico Fontana, Luigi Cinque
title_en: Anxhelo Diko*, Danilo Avola, Bardh Prenkaj, Federico Fontana, Luigi Cinque
abstract: 动作预判是指从部分观察到的事件序列中预测未来活动的任务。然而,该任务面临固有的未来不确定性以及对相互关联动作进行推理的困难。与以往专注于提取更优视觉和时序信息的工作不同,我们学习基于典型动作模式和上下文共现的语义互联动作表示,提出新颖的语义引导表示学习(S-GEAR)框架。S-GEAR学习视觉动作原型,并利用语言模型构建其关系结构,从而诱导语义性。为验证S-GEAR的有效性,我们在四个动作预判基准数据集上进行测试,取得优于以往工作的结果:在Epic-Kitchen 55、EGTEA Gaze+和50 Salads数据集上,Top-1准确率分别提升+3.5、+2.7和+3.5绝对点,在Epic-Kitchens 100数据集的Top-5召回率上提升+1.4。我们进一步观察到,S-GEAR能够有效将动作间的几何关联从语言迁移到视觉原型。最后,S-GEAR通过展示动作语义互联的复杂影响,为预判任务开辟了新的研究前沿。代码:bluehttps://github.com/ADiko1997/S-GEAR
abstract_en: Action anticipation is the task of forecasting future activity from a partially observed sequence of events. However, this task is exposed to intrinsic future uncertainty and the difficulty of reasoning upon interconnected actions. Unlike previous works that focus on extrapolating better visual and temporal information, we learn action representations that are aware of their semantic interconnectivity based on prototypical action patterns and contextual co-occurrences, proposing the novel Semantically Guided Representation Learning (S-GEAR) framework. S-GEAR learns visual action prototypes and leverages language models to structure their relationship, inducing semanticity. To gather insights on S-GEAR’s effectiveness, we test it on four action anticipation benchmarks, obtaining improved results compared to previous works: +3.5, +2.7, and +3.5 absolute points on Top-1 Accuracy on Epic-Kitchen 55, EGTEA Gaze+ and 50 Salads, respectively, and +1.4 on Top-5 Recall on Epic-Kitchens 100. We further observe that S-GEAR effectively transfers the geometric associations between actions from language to visual prototypes. Finally, S-GEAR opens new research frontiers in anticipation tasks by demonstrating the intricate impact of action semantic interconnectivity. Code: bluehttps://github.com/ADiko1997/S-GEAR.

title: Aoming Liu*, Zhong Li*, Zhang Chen*, Nannan Li, Yi Xu, Bryan Plummer
title_en: Aoming Liu*, Zhong Li*, Zhang Chen*, Nannan Li, Yi Xu, Bryan Plummer
abstract: 沉浸式场景生成,特别是全景图创建,显著受益于大规模预训练文本到图像(T2I)模型在多视角图像生成中的适应性应用。由于获取多视角图像的成本较高,无需调优的生成方法更受青睐。然而,现有方法要么仅限于简单对应关系,要么需要大量微调以捕捉复杂对应关系。我们提出PanoFree,一种无需调优的多视角图像生成新方法,支持广泛的对应关系。PanoFree通过迭代变形与修复顺序生成多视角图像,无需微调即可解决误差累积导致的不一致性和伪影问题。它通过增强跨视角感知来改善误差累积,并借助跨视角引导、风险区域估计与擦除、对称双向引导生成实现闭环,以及基于引导的语义和密度控制来保持场景结构。在Planar、360°和Full Spherical Panoramas数据集上的实验表明,PanoFree在无需额外微调的情况下显著降低误差,提升全局一致性并增强图像质量。与现有方法相比,PanoFree在时间和GPU内存使用效率上分别提高5倍和3倍,并在用户研究中展现出更优的结果多样性(提升2倍)。PanoFree为昂贵的微调或额外预训练模型的使用提供了可行替代方案。
abstract_en: Immersive scene generation, notably panorama creation, benefits significantly from the adaptation of large pre-trained text-to-image (T2I) models for multi-view image generation. Due to the high cost of acquiring multi-view images, tuning-free generation is preferred. However, existing methods are either limited to simple correspondences or require extensive fine-tuning to capture complex ones. We present PanoFree, a novel method for tuning-free multi-view image generation that supports an extensive array of correspondences. PanoFree sequentially generates multi-view images using iterative warping and inpainting, addressing the key issues of inconsistency and artifacts from error accumulation without the need for fine-tuning.
