It improves error accumulation by enhancing cross-view awareness and refines the warping and inpainting processes via cross-view guidance, risky area estimation and erasing, and symmetric bidirectional guided generation for loop closure, alongside guidance-based semantic and density control for scene structure preservation. In experiments on Planar, 360°, and Full Spherical Panoramas, PanoFree demonstrates significant error reduction, improves global consistency, and boosts image quality without extra fine-tuning. Compared to existing methods, PanoFree is up to 5x more efficient in time and 3x more efficient in GPU memory usage, and maintains superior diversity of results (2x better in our user study). PanoFree offers a viable alternative to costly fine-tuning or the use of additional pre-trained models.

title: Aoran Xiao, Weihao Xuan, Heli Qi, Yun Xing, Ruijie Ren, Xiaoqin Zhang, Ling Shao, Shijian Lu*
title_en: Aoran Xiao, Weihao Xuan, Heli Qi, Yun Xing, Ruijie Ren, Xiaoqin Zhang, Ling Shao, Shijian Lu*
abstract: 分割任何模型(SAM)在通用图像分割任务中展现了显著的零样本能力以及灵活的几何提示机制。然而,它在稀疏表示或超出其训练分布的领域(如航拍、医学和非RGB图像)中往往表现不佳。近期研究主要集中在使用全监督方法将SAM适配到这些领域,这需要大量标注训练数据,且在数据收集方面存在实际挑战。本文提出CAT-SAM,一种条件微调网络,以数据高效的方式探索SAM在多种具有挑战性的下游领域的少样本适应。其核心设计是一种提示桥接结构,使重型图像编码器和轻量级掩码解码器能够基于解码器条件进行联合微调。该桥接机制将掩码解码器的领域特定特征映射到图像编码器,仅通过少量样本即可实现两者协同适应,最终在多种下游任务中实现优越的分割效果。我们开发了两种CAT-SAM变体,分别采用两种图像编码器的微调策略:一种在输入空间中注入可学习的提示标记,另一种插入轻量级适配器网络。在11个下游任务上的大量实验表明,即使在极具挑战性的单样本适应设置下,CAT-SAM也能实现一致的优越分割性能。
abstract_en: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) has demonstrated remarkable zero-shot capability and flexible geometric prompting in general image segmentation. However, it often struggles in domains that are either sparsely represented or lie outside its training distribution, such as aerial, medical, and non-RGB images. Recent efforts have predominantly focused on adapting SAM to these domains using fully supervised methods, which necessitate large amounts of annotated training data and pose practical challenges in data collection. This paper presents CAT-SAM, a ConditionAl Tuning network that explores few-shot adaptation of SAM toward various challenging downstream domains in a data-efficient manner. The core design is a prompt bridge structure that enables decoder-conditioned joint tuning of the heavyweight image encoder and the lightweight mask decoder. The bridging maps the domain-specific features of the mask decoder to the image encoder, fostering synergic adaptation of both components with mutual benefits with few-shot target samples only, ultimately leading to superior segmentation in various downstream tasks. We develop two CAT-SAM variants that adopt two tuning strategies for the image encoder: one injecting learnable prompt tokens in the input space and the other inserting lightweight adapter networks. Extensive experiments over 11 downstream tasks show that CAT-SAM achieves superior segmentation consistently even under the very challenging one-shot adaptation setup. 0* Co-first authors with equal contributions. † Corresponding author. page: https://xiaoaoran.github.io/projects/CAT-SAM 0 Project

title: Archana Swaminathan*, Anubhav Gupta, Kamal Gupta, Shishira R Maiya, Vatsal Agarwal, Abhinav Shrivastava
title_en: Archana Swaminathan*, Anubhav Gupta, Kamal Gupta, Shishira R Maiya, Vatsal Agarwal, Abhinav Shrivastava
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRFs)已彻底革新了静态场景和物体的3D重建,提供了前所未有的高质量效果。然而,将NeRFs扩展到建模动态物体或物体运动关节仍是一个具有挑战性的问题。先前的研究通过关注物体的部件级重建和运动估计来解决这一问题,但它们往往依赖于关于移动部件数量或物体类别的启发式方法,这可能限制了其实际应用。在本文中,我们提出了一种新颖的方法,用于表示动态3D物体。我们的方法涉及在不同的时间步或“状态”中观察物体,并将超网络条件化于当前状态,利用该状态参数化我们的NeRF。这种方法使我们能够学习每个状态的视角不变的潜在表示。我们进一步证明,通过在这些状态之间进行插值,可以在3D空间中生成之前未见过的新运动关节配置。我们的实验结果突显了我们的方法在以与视角和关节配置无关的方式对物体进行运动关节方面的有效性。值得注意的是,我们的方法在依赖运动信息进行运动关节注册的先前方法上表现更优。
abstract_en: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) have revolutionized the reconstruction of static scenes and objects in 3D, offering unprecedented quality. However, extending NeRFs to model dynamic objects or object articulations remains a challenging problem. Previous works have tackled this issue by focusing on part-level reconstruction and motion estimation for objects, but they often rely on heuristics regarding the number of moving parts or object categories, which can limit their practical use. In this work, we introduce , a novel approach for representing dynamic 3D objects. Our method involves observing the object at distinct time steps or “states” and conditioning a hypernetwork on the current state, using this to parameterize our NeRF. This approach allows us to learn a view-invariant latent representation for each state. We further demonstrate that by interpolating between these states, we can generate novel articulation configurations in 3D space that were previously unseen. Our experimental results highlight the effectiveness of our method in articulating objects in a manner that is independent of the viewing angle and joint configuration. Notably, our approach outperforms previous methods that rely on motion information for articulation registration.

title: Arman Behnam*, Binghui Wang
title_en: Arman Behnam*, Binghui Wang
abstract: 图神经网络(GNN)解释器识别确保给定图预测的重要子图。迄今为止,几乎所有GNN解释器均基于关联性,容易产生虚假相关性。我们提出__TITLE_MATH_1__,一种通过因果推断的GNN因果解释器。我们的解释器基于观察到图通常包含一个因果基础子图的发现。__TITLE_MATH_1__包含三个主要步骤:1)为图构建因果结构及相应的结构因果模型(SCM),从而实现节点间的因果效应计算。2)直接计算现实图中的因果效应在计算上具有挑战性。因此,我们借鉴最近的神经因果模型(NCM),一种可训练的特殊SCM,并为GNN设计定制化NCM。通过训练这些GNN NCM,因果效应可轻松计算。3)通过优化的GNN-NCM揭示因果解释GNN预测的子图。在多个合成和现实图上的评估结果验证了__TITLE_MATH_1__在精确真实解释识别方面显著优于现有GNN解释器1。1 代码可在https://github.com/ArmanBehnam/CXGNN获取
abstract_en: Graph neural network (GNN) explainers identify the important subgraph that ensures the prediction for a given graph. Until now, almost all GNN explainers are based on association, which is prone to spurious correlations. We propose , a GNN causal explainer via causal inference. Our explainer is based on the observation that a graph often consists of a causal underlying subgraph. includes three main steps: 1) It builds causal structure and the corresponding structural causal model (SCM) for a graph, which enables the cause-effect calculation among nodes. 2) Directly calculating the cause-effect in real-world graphs is computationally challenging. It is then enlightened by the recent neural causal model (NCM), a special type of SCM that is trainable, and design customized NCMs for GNNs. By training these GNN NCMs, the cause-effect can be easily calculated. 3) It uncovers the subgraph that causally explains the GNN predictions via the optimized GNN-NCMs. Evaluation results on multiple synthetic and real-world graphs validate that significantly outperforms existing GNN explainers in exact groundtruth explanation identification1 . 1 Code is available at https://github.com/ArmanBehnam/CXGNN

title: Armand Comas, Di Qiu*, Menglei Chai, Marcel C. Bühler, Amit Raj, Ruiqi Gao, Qiangeng Xu, Mark J Matthews, Paulo Gotardo, Sergio Orts-Escolano, Thabo Beeler
title_en: Armand Comas, Di Qiu*, Menglei Chai, Marcel C. Bühler, Amit Raj, Ruiqi Gao, Qiangeng Xu, Mark J Matthews, Paulo Gotardo, Sergio Orts-Escolano, Thabo Beeler
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的框架,用于3D人类虚拟形象的生成与个性化,利用文本提示来提升用户参与度和定制化能力。我们的方法核心在于关键创新,旨在克服逼真虚拟形象合成中的挑战。首先,我们采用条件神经辐射场(NeRF)模型,基于大规模未标注的多视角数据集进行训练,以创建一个通用的初始解决方案空间,从而加速并多样化虚拟形象生成。其次,我们开发了一种几何先验,利用文本到图像扩散模型的能力,确保卓越的视角不变性,并支持虚拟形象几何的直接优化。这些基础思想由我们基于变分得分蒸馏(VSD)构建的优化流程所补充,该流程缓解了纹理丢失和过度饱和的问题。如我们的广泛实验所支持,这些策略共同实现了前所未有的视觉质量的定制虚拟形象,并更好地符合输入文本提示。您可以在我们的网站上找到更多结果和视频:syntec-research.github.io/MagicMirror
abstract_en: We introduce a novel framework for 3D human avatar generation and personalization, leveraging text prompts to enhance user engagement and customization. Central to our approach are key innovations aimed at overcoming the challenges in photo-realistic avatar synthesis. Firstly, we utilize a conditional Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) model, trained on a large-scale unannotated multi-view dataset, to create a versatile initial solution space that accelerates and diversifies avatar generation. Secondly, we develop a geometric prior, leveraging the capabilities of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models, to ensure superior view invariance and enable direct optimization of avatar geometry. These foundational ideas are complemented by our optimization pipeline built on Variational Score Distillation (VSD), which mitigates texture loss and over-saturation issues. As supported by our extensive experiments, these strategies collectively enable the creation of custom avatars with unparalleled visual quality and better adherence to input text prompts. You can find more results and videos in our website: syntec-research.github.io/MagicMirror

title: Armen Avetisyan*, Christopher Xie, Henry Howard-Jenkins, Tsun-Yi Yang, Samir Aroudj, Suvam Patra, Fuyang Zhang, Luke Holland, Duncan Frost, Campbell Orme, Jakob Engel, Edward Miller, Richard Newcombe, Vasileios Balntas
title_en: Armen Avetisyan*, Christopher Xie, Henry Howard-Jenkins, Tsun-Yi Yang, Samir Aroudj, Suvam Patra, Fuyang Zhang, Luke Holland, Duncan Frost, Campbell Orme, Jakob Engel, Edward Miller, Richard Newcombe, Vasileios Balntas
abstract: 我们提出了一种方法,该方法通过自回归、基于标记的方法,直接以结构化语言指令序列的形式生成完整的场景模型。我们的场景表示方法受到近期Transformer模型和大型语言模型(LLMs)成功经验的启发,与传统方法不同,后者通常将场景描述为网格、体素网格、点云或辐射场。我们的方法通过场景语言编码器-解码器架构,直接从编码的视觉数据中推断出结构化语言指令集。为了训练该方法,我们生成并发布了一个大规模的合成数据集,包含10万个高质量的室内场景,包含以自我为中心的场景漫游的逼真图像和真实标注渲染结果。我们的方法在建筑布局估计任务中取得了最先进的结果,并在三维物体检测任务中表现出竞争力。最后,我们探索了该方法的一个优势,即通过简单的结构化语言指令添加即可快速适应新指令,我们以粗粒度三维物体部分重建等任务为例进行了说明。† 该工作是在作者担任Meta实习生期间完成的。
abstract_en: We introduce , a method that directly produces full scene models as a sequence of structured language commands using an autoregressive, token-based approach. Our proposed scene representation is inspired by recent successes in transformers & LLMs, and departs from more traditional methods which commonly describe scenes as meshes, voxel grids, point clouds or radiance fields. Our method infers the set of structured language commands directly from encoded visual data using a scene language encoder-decoder architecture. To train , we generate and release a large-scale synthetic dataset called consisting of 100k high-quality indoor scenes, with photorealistic and ground-truth annotated renders of egocentric scene walkthroughs. Our method gives state-of-the art results in architectural layout estimation, and competitive results in 3D object detection. Lastly, we explore an advantage for , which is the ability to readily adapt to new commands via simple additions to the structured language, which we illustrate for tasks such as coarse 3D object part reconstruction. † Work done while the author was an intern at Meta.

title: Arpit Garg*, Cuong Cao Nguyen, RAFAEL FELIX, Thanh-Toan Do, Gustavo Carneiro
title_en: Arpit Garg*, Cuong Cao Nguyen, RAFAEL FELIX, Thanh-Toan Do, Gustavo Carneiro
abstract: 深度学习在处理噪声标签时面临严峻挑战,因为模型倾向于过度拟合受标签噪声影响的样本。这一挑战进一步被实例依赖噪声(IDN)所加剧,这是一种源于样本信息模糊的现实标签噪声形式。为应对IDN,标签噪声学习(LNL)引入了样本选择阶段以区分干净样本和噪声标签样本。该阶段采用任意准则和预定义课程,初始时选择大多数样本为噪声,并在训练过程中逐渐降低该选择率。此类课程是次优的,因为它未考虑训练集中实际的标签噪声率。本文通过一种新的噪声率估计方法解决此问题,该方法可轻松集成到大多数最先进的(SOTA)LNL方法中,从而生成更有效的课程。合成数据集和现实世界基准测试结果表明,将我们的方法与SOTA LNL方法结合可显著提升准确性。1 1 代码可在https://github.com/arpit2412/NoiseRateLearning获取。本研究受工程与物理科学研究委员会(EPSRC)通过EP/Y018036/1资助,以及澳大利亚研究委员会(ARC)通过FT190100525资助。
abstract_en: Deep learning faces a formidable challenge when handling noisy labels, as models tend to overfit samples affected by label noise. This challenge is further compounded by the presence of instance-dependent noise (IDN), a realistic form of label noise arising from ambiguous sample information. To address IDN, Label Noise Learning (LNL) incorporates a sample selection stage to differentiate clean and noisy-label samples. This stage uses an arbitrary criterion and a pre-defined curriculum that initially selects most samples as noisy and gradually decreases this selection rate during training. Such curriculum is sub-optimal since it does not consider the actual label noise rate in the training set. This paper addresses this issue with a new noise-rate estimation method that is easily integrated with most state-of-the-art (SOTA) LNL methods to produce a more effective curriculum. Synthetic and real-world benchmarks’ results demonstrate that integrating our approach with SOTA LNL methods improves accuracy in most cases.1 1 Code is available at https://github.com/arpit2412/NoiseRateLearning. Supported by the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC) through grant EP/Y018036/1 and the Australian Research Council (ARC) through grant FT190100525.

title: 阿特米斯·帕纳戈普鲁*, 李雪, 宁宇, 李俊楠, 李东旭, 沙菲克·乔蒂, 徐然, 西尔维奥·萨瓦雷塞, 熊才明, 胡安·卡洛斯·尼布雷斯
title_en: Artemis Panagopoulou*, Le Xue, Ning Yu, LI JUNNAN, DONGXU LI, Shafiq Joty, Ran Xu, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Juan Carlos Niebles
abstract: 近期研究通过学习图像到语言的投影以及利用大语言模型(LLMs)出色的推理能力,在视觉推理任务中取得了显著进展。本文介绍了一种高效且有效的框架,将多种模态(图像、3D、音频和视频)集成到一个冻结的LLM中,并展示了跨模态推理的新兴能力(2+模态输入)。我们的方法探索了两种不同的投影机制:Q-Formers和线性投影(LPs)。通过在16个基准数据集上对所有四种模态进行广泛实验,我们探讨了这两种方法,并评估了它们在集成和独立跨模态推理中的适应性。Q-Former投影在单一模态场景中表现出优越的性能,并在涉及两个或更多模态的联合与判别推理中展现出更高的适应性。然而,在任务-模态数据有限的场景中,其泛化能力弱于线性投影。为实现该框架,我们设计了一个可扩展的流程,可自动从不同模态的可用描述数据中生成高质量的指令微调数据集,并贡献了24K音频问答数据和250K 3D问答数据。为促进跨模态推理的进一步研究,我们引入了DisCRn(判别跨模态推理(DisCRn))基准,包含9K音频-视频问答样本和28K图像-3D问答样本,要求模型在不同输入模态之间进行判别性推理。代码和数据可在https://github.com/salesforce/LAVIS/tree/main/projects/xinstructbl获取。
abstract_en: Recent research has achieved significant advancements in visual reasoning tasks through learning image-to-language projections and leveraging the impressive reasoning abilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This paper introduces an efficient and effective framework that integrates multiple modalities (images, 3D, audio and video) to a frozen LLM and demonstrates an emergent ability for cross-modal reasoning (2+ modality inputs). Our approach explores two distinct projection mechanisms: Q-Formers and Linear Projections (LPs). Through extensive experimentation across all four modalities on 16 benchmarks, we explore both methods and assess their adaptability in integrated and separate cross-modal reasoning. The Q-Former projection demonstrates superior performance in single modality scenarios and adaptability in joint versus discriminative reasoning involving two or more modalities. However, it exhibits lower generalization capabilities than linear projection in contexts where task-modality data are limited. To enable this framework, we devise a scalable pipeline that automatically generates high-quality, instruction-tuning datasets from readily available captioning data across different modalities, and contribute 24K QA data for audio and 250K QA data for 3D. To facilitate further research in cross-modal reasoning, we introduce the DisCRn (Discriminative Cross-modal Reasoning (DisCRn)) benchmark comprising 9K audio-video QA samples and 28K image-3D QA samples that require the model to reason discriminatively across disparate input modalities. Code and data is available at https://github.com/salesforce/LAVIS/tree/main/projects/xinstructbl

title: Arthur Aubret*, Céline Teulière, Jochen Triesch
title_en: Arthur Aubret*, Céline Teulière, Jochen Triesch
abstract: 自监督学习(SSL)已彻底革新了视觉表征学习,但尚未达到人类视觉的鲁棒性。造成这一现象的原因可能是SSL在学习过程中并未利用人类可用的所有数据。当学习物体时,人类通常有意识地转动或绕行物体,研究表明这些交互行为能显著增强学习效果。本文探讨此类与物体相关的动作是否能提升SSL。为此,我们从四个视频数据集中提取了用于从一个物体的以自我为中心视角切换到另一个视角所执行的动作。随后,我们引入了一种新的损失函数,通过将执行的动作与同一片段中提取的两幅图像的表征对齐,学习视觉和动作嵌入。这使得执行的动作能够结构化潜在的视觉表征。实验结果表明,我们的方法在下游类别识别任务中始终优于先前方法。在分析中,我们发现观察到的提升与同一类别中不同物体的视角对齐度改善相关。总体而言,我们的工作表明,与物体的具身交互可以提升物体类别的SSL。
abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has revolutionized visual representation learning, but has not achieved the robustness of human vision. A reason for this could be that SSL does not leverage all the data available to humans during learning. When learning about an object, humans often purposefully turn or move around objects and research suggests that these interactions can substantially enhance their learning. Here we explore whether such object-related actions can boost SSL. For this, we extract the actions performed to change from one ego-centric view of an object to another in four video datasets. We then introduce a new loss function to learn visual and action embeddings by aligning the performed action with the representations of two images extracted from the same clip. This permits the performed actions to structure the latent visual representation. Our experiments show that our method consistently outperforms previous methods on downstream category recognition. In our analysis, we find that the observed improvement is associated with a better viewpoint-wise alignment of different objects from the same category. Overall, our work demonstrates that embodied interactions with objects can improve SSL of object categories.

title: Artur Jesslen*, Guofeng Zhang, Angtian Wang, Wufei Ma, Alan Yuille, Adam Kortylewski
title_en: Artur Jesslen*, Guofeng Zhang, Angtian Wang, Wufei Ma, Alan Yuille, Adam Kortylewski
abstract: 面向物体分类的判别模型通常学习基于图像的表示,这些表示无法捕捉物体的组合性和三维特性。在本文中,我们展示了将三维组合物体表示显式集成到图像分类的深度网络中,可以显著提升分布外场景下的泛化能力。具体而言,我们引入了一种新型架构,称为__TITLE_MATH_1__,该架构包含一个特征提取器和针对每个目标物体类别的神经物体体积。每个神经物体体积由发射特征向量的三维高斯组成。这种组合物体表示允许通过独立匹配每个类别的三维高斯特征与从输入图像提取的特征,实现高度鲁棒且快速的物体分类估计。此外,可以通过对应神经物体体积的逆渲染估计物体姿态。为了实现物体分类,每个三维高斯的神经特征被训练以与以下内容区分开:(i) 其他类别中三维高斯的特征,(ii) 同一物体其他三维高斯的特征,以及(iii) 背景特征。我们的实验表明,由于物体表示的三维组合结构,__ABS_MATH_1__相比标准架构具有引人注目的优势,具体包括:(1) 在广泛的真实世界和合成分布外偏移场景中表现出卓越的鲁棒性;(2) 相比标准模型,增强的人类可解释性,同时保持实时推理和分布内数据上的竞争力准确性。代码和模型可在 /GenIntel/NOVUM 获取。
abstract_en: Discriminative models for object classification typically learn image-based representations that do not capture the compositional and 3D nature of objects. In this work, we show that explicitly integrating 3D compositional object representations into deep networks for image classification leads to a largely enhanced generalization in out-of-distribution scenarios. In particular, we introduce a novel architecture, referred to as , that consists of a feature extractor and a neural object volume for every target object class. Each neural object volume is a composition of 3D Gaussians that emit feature vectors. This compositional object representation allows for a highly robust and fast estimation of the object class by independently matching the features of the 3D Gaussians of each category to features extracted from an input image. Additionally, the object pose can be estimated via inverse rendering of the corresponding neural object volume. To enable the classification of objects, the neural features at each 3D Gaussian are trained discriminatively to be distinct from (i) the features of 3D Gaussians in other categories, (ii) features of other 3D Gaussians of the same object, and (iii) the background features. Our experiments show that offers intriguing advantages over standard architectures due to the 3D compositional structure of the object representation, namely: (1) An exceptional robustness across a spectrum of real-world and synthetic out-of-distribution shifts and (2) an enhanced human interpretability compared to standard models, all while maintaining real-time inference and a competitive accuracy on in-distribution data. Code and model can be found at /GenIntel/NOVUM.

title: Ashesh Ashesh*, Florian Jug*
title_en: Ashesh Ashesh*, Florian Jug*
abstract: 本文提出了一种方法,用于解决新的分析任务——联合语义图像分割与无监督去噪的挑战。这种双重方法在荧光显微镜领域具有重要应用价值,其中语义图像分割具有重要应用,但噪声通常会阻碍图像内容的下游分析。图像分割涉及将图像分解为其可区分的语义结构。我们展示出现有最先进的该任务方法在存在图像噪声时表现不佳,无意中也将噪声分布到预测输出中。本文提出的方法通过整合无监督去噪子任务来处理图像噪声。这种整合即使在存在显著且现实水平的成像噪声的情况下,也能实现改进的语义图像解混。在中,一个关键创新是使用专门制定的噪声模型,并对高维层次化潜在空间进行KL散度损失的适当调整。我们在现实世界的显微镜图像上展示了该方法在多个任务中的性能。此外,我们进行了定性和定量评估,并将结果与现有基准进行比较,证明了使用的效果:通过两个合适的噪声模型,使用单个变分分割编码器-解码器(VSE)网络联合执行语义分割和去噪。
abstract_en: In this work, we present , a method to tackle a new analysis task, the challenge of joint semantic image splitting and unsupervised denoising. This dual approach has important applications in fluorescence microscopy, where semantic image splitting has important applications but noise does generally hinder the downstream analysis of image content. Image splitting involves dissecting an image into its distinguishable semantic structures. We show that the current state-of-the-art method for this task struggles in the presence of image noise, inadvertently also distributing the noise across the predicted outputs. The method we present here can deal with image noise by integrating an unsupervised denoising subtask. This integration results in improved semantic image unmixing, even in the presence of notable and realistic levels of imaging noise. A key innovation in is the use of specifically formulated noise models and the suitable adjustment of KL-divergence loss for the high-dimensional hierarchical latent space we are training. We showcase the performance of across multiple tasks on real-world microscopy images. Additionally, we perform qualitative and quantitative evaluations and compare the results to existing benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of using : a single Variational Splitting Encoder-Decoder (VSE) Network using two suitable noise models to jointly perform semantic splitting and denoising.

title: Ashish Tiwari*, Satoshi Ikehata, Shanmuganathan Raman
title_en: Ashish Tiwari*, Satoshi Ikehata, Shanmuganathan Raman
abstract: Photometric stereo typically demands intricate data acquisition setups involving multiple light sources to recover surface normals accurately. In this paper, we propose MERLiN, an attention-based hourglass network that integrates single image-based inverse rendering and relighting within a single unified framework. We evaluate the performance of photometric stereo methods using these relit images and demonstrate how they can circumvent the underlying challenge of complex data acquisition. Our physically-based model is trained on a large synthetic dataset containing complex shapes with spatially varying BRDF and is designed to handle indirect illumination effects to improve material reconstruction and relighting. Through extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluation, we demonstrate that the proposed framework generalizes well to real-world images, achieving high-quality shape, material estimation, and relighting. We assess these synthetically relit images over photometric stereo benchmark methods for their physical correctness and resulting normal estimation accuracy, paving the way towards single-shot photometric stereo through physically-based relighting. This work allows us to address the single image-based inverse rendering problem holistically, applying well to both synthetic and real data and taking a step towards mitigating the challenge of data acquisition in photometric stereo.
abstract_en: Photometric stereo typically demands intricate data acquisition setups involving multiple light sources to recover surface normals accurately. In this paper, we propose MERLiN, an attention-based hourglass network that integrates single image-based inverse rendering and relighting within a single unified framework. We evaluate the performance of photometric stereo methods using these relit images and demonstrate how they can circumvent the underlying challenge of complex data acquisition. Our physically-based model is trained on a large synthetic dataset containing complex shapes with spatially varying BRDF and is designed to handle indirect illumination effects to improve material reconstruction and relighting. Through extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluation, we demonstrate that the proposed framework generalizes well to real-world images, achieving high-quality shape, material estimation, and relighting. We assess these synthetically relit images over photometric stereo benchmark methods for their physical correctness and resulting normal estimation accuracy, paving the way towards single-shot photometric stereo through physically-based relighting. This work allows us to address the single image-based inverse rendering problem holistically, applying well to both synthetic and real data and taking a step towards mitigating the challenge of data acquisition in photometric stereo.

title: Ashkan Mirzaei*, Tristan T Aumentado-Armstrong, Marcus A Brubaker, Jonathan Kelly, Alex Levinshtein, Konstantinos G Derpanis, Igor Gilitschenski
title_en: Ashkan Mirzaei*, Tristan T Aumentado-Armstrong, Marcus A Brubaker, Jonathan Kelly, Alex Levinshtein, Konstantinos G Derpanis, Igor Gilitschenski
abstract: 去噪扩散模型在生成和编辑图像方面的成功引发了人们对其用于编辑通过神经辐射场(NeRFs)表示的3D场景的兴趣。然而,当前的3D编辑方法缺乏同时精确定位编辑位置并限制修改到所需体积区域的能力。因此,这些方法常常过度编辑,改变场景中无关的部分。我们引入了一个新任务——3D编辑定位,以自动识别编辑任务的相关区域并相应地限制编辑。为实现这一目标,我们首先解决2D编辑定位问题,然后将其扩展到多视角以应对3D定位挑战。对于2D定位,我们利用InstructPix2Pix(IP2P)并识别IP2P预测在有无指令时的差异。我们将这种差异称为相关性图。相关性图传达了改变每个像素以实现编辑的重要性,并指导后续修改,确保与编辑无关的像素保持不变。通过多视角图像的相关性图,我们可以定义相关性场,确定应进行修改的3D区域。这使我们能够通过在训练视图上进行迭代更新,提高文本引导的3D NeRF场景编辑的质量,这些更新由相关性场的渲染引导。我们的方法在NeRF和图像编辑任务中均实现了最先进的性能。我们将公开代码。
abstract_en: The success of denoising diffusion models in generating and editing images has sparked interest in using diffusion models for editing 3D scenes represented via neural radiance fields (NeRFs). However, current 3D editing methods lack a way to both pinpoint the edit location and limit changes to the desired volumetric region. Consequently, these methods often over-edit, altering irrelevant parts of the scene. We introduce a new task, 3D edit localization, to automatically identify the relevant region for an editing task and restrict the edit accordingly. To achieve this goal, we initially tackle 2D edit localization, and then lift it to multiple views to address the 3D localization challenge. For 2D localization, we leverage InstructPix2Pix (IP2P) and identify the discrepancy between IP2P predictions with and without the instruction. We refer to this discrepancy as the relevance map. The relevance map conveys the importance of changing each pixel to achieve an edit, and guides downstream modifications, ensuring that pixels irrelevant to the edit remain unchanged. With the relevance maps of multiview posed images, we can define the relevance field, defining the 3D region within which modifications should be made. This enables us to improve the quality of text-guided 3D NeRF scene editing, by performing iterative updates on the training views, guided by renders from the relevance field. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on both NeRF and image editing tasks. We will make the code available.

title: Astitva Srivastava*, Pranav Manu, Amit Raj, Varun Jampani, Avinash Sharma
title_en: Astitva Srivastava*, Pranav Manu, Amit Raj, Varun Jampani, Avinash Sharma
abstract: 本文针对高质量纹理的文本驱动3D服装生成这一新挑战性问题展开研究。我们提出WordRobe,一种新颖的框架,可从用户友好的文本提示中生成无姿态且带纹理的3D服装网格。我们首先通过一种新颖的粗到细训练策略和潜在表示解耦损失学习3D服装的潜在表示,促进更优的潜在插值。随后,我们以弱监督方式将服装潜在空间对齐至CLIP嵌入空间,实现文本驱动的3D服装生成与编辑。在外观建模方面,我们利用ControlNet的零样本生成能力,在单次前向推理步骤中合成视角一致的纹理图,从而大幅缩短生成时间。定量评估与定性用户研究结果表明,WordRobe在学习3D服装潜在空间、服装插值及文本驱动纹理合成方面均优于现有SOTA方法。通过WordRobe生成的无姿态3D服装网格可直接输入标准布料模拟与动画管线,无需任何后处理。
abstract_en: In this paper, we tackle a new and challenging problem of text-driven generation of 3D garments with high-quality textures. We propose, WordRobe, a novel framework for the generation of unposed & textured 3D garment meshes from user-friendly text prompts. We achieve this by first learning a latent representation of 3D garments using a novel coarse-to-fine training strategy and a loss for latent disentanglement, promoting better latent interpolation. Subsequently, we align the garment latent space to the CLIP embedding space in a weakly supervised manner, enabling text-driven 3D garment generation and editing. For appearance modeling, we leverage the zero-shot generation capability of ControlNet to synthesize view-consistent texture maps in a single feed-forward inference step, thereby drastically decreasing the generation time as compared to existing methods. We demonstrate superior performance over current SOTAs for learning 3D garment latent space, garment interpolation, and text-driven texture synthesis, supported by quantitative evaluation and qualitative user study. The unposed 3D garment meshes generated using WordRobe can be directly fed to standard cloth simulation & animation pipelines without any post-processing.

title: Atsushi Hashimoto*, Koki Maeda, Tosho Hirasawa, Jun Harashima, Leszek Rybicki, Yusuke Fukasawa, Yoshitaka Ushiku
title_en: Atsushi Hashimoto*, Koki Maeda, Tosho Hirasawa, Jun Harashima, Leszek Rybicki, Yusuke Fukasawa, Yoshitaka Ushiku
abstract: 程序化视频理解正在引起视觉与语言研究社区的关注。基于深度学习的视频分析需要大量数据。因此,现有研究通常使用网络视频作为训练资源,这使得从原始视频观测中查询教学内容变得困难。为了解决这一问题,我们提出一个新的数据集COM Kitchens。该数据集包含由智能手机拍摄的未剪辑俯视视角视频,参与者根据给定食谱进行食品准备。固定视角视频数据集由于高昂的摄像机设置成本,往往缺乏环境多样性。我们使用现代广角智能手机镜头,从水槽到炉灶的烹饪台面进行俯视视角拍摄,无需现场协助即可记录活动。通过这种设置,我们通过向参与者分发智能手机收集了一个多样化的数据集。利用该数据集,我们提出了新的视频到文本检索任务在线食谱检索(OnRR),以及新的未剪辑俯视视角视频密集视频字幕生成(DVC-OV)领域。我们的实验验证了当前基于网络视频的最先进方法在处理这些任务时的能力和局限性。数据集和代码可在https://doi.org/10.32130/rdata.6.1和https://github.com/omron-sinicx/com_kitchens分别获取。
abstract_en: Procedural video understanding is gaining attention in the vision and language community. Deep learning-based video analysis requires extensive data. Consequently, existing works often use web videos as training resources, making it challenging to query instructional contents from raw video observations. To address this issue, we propose a new dataset, COM Kitchens. The dataset consists of unedited overhead-view videos captured by smartphones, in which participants performed food preparation based on given recipes. Fixed-viewpoint video datasets often lack environmental diversity due to high camera setup costs. We used modern wide-angle smartphone lenses to cover cooking counters from sink to cooktop in an overhead view, capturing activity without in-person assistance. With this setup, we collected a diverse dataset by distributing smartphones to participants. With this dataset, we propose the novel video-to-text retrieval task Online Recipe Retrieval (OnRR) and new video captioning domain Dense Video Captioning on unedited Overhead-View videos (DVC-OV). Our experiments verified the capabilities and limitations of current web-video-based SOTA methods in handling these tasks. The dataset and code are available at https://doi.org/10.32130/rdata.6.1 and https://github. com/omron-sinicx/com_kitchens, respectively.

title: 中村雅也*, 山中隆男*
title_en: Atsuya Nakata*, Takao Yamanaka*
abstract: 全向图像在各种应用中被越来越多地使用,包括虚拟现实和社交网络服务(SNS)。然而,与普通视野(NFoV)图像相比,全向图像的可用性相对有限,因为需要专用相机来拍摄全向图像。因此,基于生成对抗网络(GAN)的几种方法被提出用于合成全向图像,但这些方法在模型训练中遇到了困难,由于训练过程中的不稳定性以及/或显著的时间消耗。为了解决这些问题,本文提出了一种新的全向图像合成方法2S-ODIS(两阶段全向图像合成),该方法生成高质量的全向图像,但大幅减少了训练时间。这是通过利用在大型NFoV图像数据库(如ImageNet)上预训练的VQGAN(向量量化生成对抗网络)模型实现的,而无需微调。由于该预训练模型在等距直角投影(ERP)中无法表示全向图像的失真,因此不能直接应用于ERP中的全向图像合成。因此,采用了两阶段结构,首先在ERP中创建全局粗略图像,然后通过整合多个局部NFoV图像在更高分辨率下对图像进行细化,以补偿ERP中的失真,这两部分均基于预训练的VQGAN模型。结果表明,所提出的方法2S-ODIS将训练时间从OmniDreamer的14天减少到更高图像质量下的4天。
abstract_en: Omni-directional images have been increasingly used in various applications, including virtual reality and SNS (Social Networking Services). However, their availability is comparatively limited in contrast to normal field of view (NFoV) images, since specialized cameras are required to take omni-directional images. Consequently, several methods have been proposed based on generative adversarial networks (GAN) to synthesize omni-directional images, but these approaches have shown difficulties in training of the models, due to instability and/or significant time consumption in the training. To address these problems, this paper proposes a novel omni-directional image synthesis method, 2S-ODIS (Two-Stage Omni-Directional Image Synthesis), which generated high-quality omni-directional images but drastically reduced the training time. This was realized by utilizing the VQGAN (Vector Quantized GAN) model pre-trained on a large-scale NFoV image database such as ImageNet without fine-tuning. Since this pre-trained model does not represent distortions of omni-directional images in the equi-rectangular projection (ERP), it cannot be applied directly to the omni-directional image synthesis in ERP. Therefore, two-stage structure was adopted to first create a global coarse image in ERP and then refine the image by integrating multiple local NFoV images in the higher resolution to compensate the distortions in ERP, both of which are based on the pre-trained VQGAN model. As a result, the proposed method, 2S-ODIS, achieved the reduction of the training time from 14 days in OmniDreamer to four days in higher image quality.

title: Aurélien Cecille*, Stefan Duffner, Franck Davoine, Thibault Neveu, Rémi Agier
title_en: Aurélien Cecille*, Stefan Duffner, Franck Davoine, Thibault Neveu, Rémi Agier
abstract: 单目深度估计近年来取得了显著进展,但预测度量深度的模型在多样化相机姿态和数据集上的泛化能力仍存在挑战。尽管近期的监督方法通过利用地面先验信息在推理过程中缓解了这一问题,但其在自监督设置中的适应性受限于尺度恢复的额外挑战。为解决这一差距,本文提出了一种专门针对自监督范式的地面区域约束机制。该机制不仅能够准确恢复尺度,还确保了深度预测与地面先验信息之间的一致性。实验结果表明,我们的方法在KITTI基准测试中超越了现有尺度恢复技术,并显著提升了模型的泛化能力。这种改进体现在其在多样化相机旋转下的更鲁棒表现,以及在零样本条件下对之前未见过的驾驶数据集(如DDAD)的适应性。
abstract_en: Monocular depth estimation has greatly improved in the recent years but models predicting metric depth still struggle to generalize across diverse camera poses and datasets. While recent supervised methods mitigate this issue by leveraging ground prior information at inference, their adaptability to self-supervised settings is limited due to the additional challenge of scale recovery. Addressing this gap, we propose in this paper a novel constraint on ground areas designed specifically for the self-supervised paradigm. This mechanism not only allows to accurately recover the scale but also ensures coherence between the depth prediction and the ground prior. Experimental results show that our method surpasses existing scale recovery techniques on the KITTI benchmark and significantly enhances model generalization capabilities. This improvement can be observed by its more robust performance across diverse camera rotations and its adaptability in zero-shot conditions with previously unseen driving datasets such as DDAD.

title: Aveen Dayal*, Rishabh Lalla, Linga Reddy Cenkeramaddi, C. Krishna Mohan, Abhinav Kumar, Vineeth N Balasubramanian
title_en: Aveen Dayal*, Rishabh Lalla, Linga Reddy Cenkeramaddi, C. Krishna Mohan, Abhinav Kumar, Vineeth N Balasubramanian
abstract: 无监督领域自适应(UDA)是机器学习中的关键挑战,旨在将知识从有标签的源领域转移到无标签的目标领域。在本工作中,我们旨在通过引入一种利用伪候选集对目标数据进行标注的方法,提升现有UDA方法在目标集上的准确率。这些伪候选集在缺乏直接监督的情况下充当真实标签的代理。为了提高目标领域的准确性,我们提出了一种基于伪候选集的无监督领域自适应优化方法(UDPCS),该方法能够有效学习在伪候选集中对类别进行区分。我们的方法具有两个独特的损失函数:一个作用于伪候选集以优化其预测,另一个作用于伪候选集之外的标签。我们采用基于阈值的策略进一步引导学习过程,以实现准确的标签消歧。我们通过在三个知名基准数据集(Office-Home、VisDA和DomainNet)上的大量实验验证了我们新颖且简单的方法。实验结果表明,我们的方法在这些数据集上实现了目标准确率的持续提升。
abstract_en: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) is a critical challenge in machine learning, aiming to transfer knowledge from a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain. In this work, we aim to improve target set accuracy in any existing UDA method by introducing an approach that utilizes pseudo-candidate sets for labeling the target data. These pseudo-candidate sets serve as a proxy for the true labels in the absence of direct supervision. To enhance the accuracy of the target domain, we propose Unsupervised Domain Adaptation refinement using Pseudo-Candidate Sets (UDPCS), a method which effectively learns to disambiguate among classes in the pseudo-candidate set. Our approach is characterized by two distinct loss functions: one that acts on the pseudo-candidate set to refine its predictions and another that operates on the labels outside the pseudo-candidate set. We use a threshold-based strategy to further guide the learning process toward accurate label disambiguation. We validate our novel yet simple approach through extensive experiments on three well-known benchmark datasets: Office-Home, VisDA, and DomainNet. Our experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of our method in achieving consistent gains on target accuracies across these datasets.

title: Avery Ma*, Amir-massoud Farahmand, Yangchen Pan, Philip Torr, Jindong Gu
title_en: Avery Ma*, Amir-massoud Farahmand, Yangchen Pan, Philip Torr, Jindong Gu
abstract: 神经网络容易受到可跨不同模型迁移的对抗扰动的影响。本文提出了一种新颖的模型对齐技术,旨在提升源模型生成可迁移对抗扰动的能力。在对齐过程中,通过最小化对齐损失来微调源模型的参数。该损失衡量源模型与另一个独立训练的见证模型之间预测结果的差异。为了理解模型对齐的效果,我们对损失景观的变化进行了几何分析。在ImageNet数据集上使用多种模型架构进行的大量实验表明,由对齐源模型生成的扰动比原始源模型生成的扰动具有显著更高的迁移性。我们的源代码可在https://github.com/averyma/model-alignment获取。
abstract_en: Neural networks are susceptible to adversarial perturbations that are transferable across different models. In this paper, we introduce a novel model alignment technique aimed at improving a given source model’s ability in generating transferable adversarial perturbations. During the alignment process, the parameters of the source model are fine-tuned to minimize an alignment loss. This loss measures the divergence in the predictions between the source model and another, independently trained model, referred to as the witness model. To understand the effect of model alignment, we conduct a geometric analysis of the resulting changes in the loss landscape. Extensive experiments on the ImageNet dataset, using a variety of model architectures, demonstrate that perturbations generated from aligned source models exhibit significantly higher transferability than those from the original source model. Our source code is available at https://github.com/averyma/model-alignment.

title: Avinash Paliwal*, Wei Ye, Jinhui Xiong, Dmytro Kotovenko, Rakesh Ranjan, Vikas Chandra, Nima Khademi Kalantari
title_en: Avinash Paliwal*, Wei Ye, Jinhui Xiong, Dmytro Kotovenko, Rakesh Ranjan, Vikas Chandra, Nima Khademi Kalantari
abstract: 近年来,图像三维重建领域迅速发展,首先得益于神经辐射场(NeRF)的引入,随后是三维高斯点云(3DGS)技术的出现。后者在训练速度、推理速度以及重建质量方面相比NeRF具有显著优势。尽管3DGS在密集输入图像上表现良好,但其无结构的点云表示在面对极端稀疏输入图像(如仅3张图像)的挑战性场景时,容易过拟合,导致从新视角观察时呈现为杂乱无章的针状结构。为解决这一问题,我们提出正则化优化和基于深度的初始化方法。我们的核心思想是引入一种可受控的结构化高斯表示,通过在二维图像空间中进行约束,防止高斯点在优化过程中独立移动。具体而言,我们通过隐式卷积解码器引入单视角和多视角约束,并通过总变分损失分别实现。在引入高斯点一致性后,我们进一步通过流式损失函数约束优化过程。为支持我们的正则化优化,我们提出了一种基于单目深度估计的初始化方法,每个输入视角均进行高斯点初始化。我们在多种场景中展示了与现有最先进的稀疏视角NeRF方法相比的显著改进。
abstract_en: The field of 3D reconstruction from images has rapidly evolved in the past few years, first with the introduction of Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) and more recently with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). The latter provides a significant edge over NeRF in terms of the training and inference speed, as well as the reconstruction quality. Although 3DGS works well for dense input images, the unstructured point-cloud like representation quickly overfits to the more challenging setup of extremely sparse input images (e.g., 3 images), creating a representation that appears as a jumble of needles from novel views. To address this issue, we propose regularized optimization and depth-based initialization. Our key idea is to introduce a structured Gaussian representation that can be controlled in 2D image space. We then constraint the Gaussians, in particular their position, and prevent them from moving independently during optimization. Specifically, we introduce single and multiview constraints through an implicit convolutional decoder and a total variation loss, respectively. With the coherency introduced to the Gaussians, we further constrain the optimization through a flow-based loss function. To support our regularized optimization, we propose an approach to initialize the Gaussians using monocular depth estimates at each input view. We demonstrate significant improvements compared to the state-of-the-art sparse-view NeRF-based approaches on a variety of scenes.

title: Axel Sauer*, Dominik Lorenz, Andreas Blattmann, Robin Rombach
title_en: Axel Sauer*, Dominik Lorenz, Andreas Blattmann, Robin Rombach
abstract: 我们引入了对抗扩散蒸馏(ADD),这是一种新颖的训练方法,能够在仅1–4步内高效采样大规模基础图像扩散模型,同时保持高质量图像。我们利用分数蒸馏技术,结合对抗损失,以大规模现成图像扩散模型作为教师信号,在仅一步或两步采样步骤的低步数范式中确保高图像保真度。我们的分析表明,我们的模型在单步采样中明显优于现有少数步骤方法(如GANs、潜在一致性模型),并在仅四步采样时达到与最先进扩散模型(SDXL)相当的性能。ADD是首个解锁单步实时图像合成的基础模型方法。
abstract_en: We introduce Adversarial Diffusion Distillation (ADD), a novel training approach that efficiently samples large-scale foundational image diffusion models in just 1–4 steps while maintaining high image quality. We use score distillation to leverage large-scale off-the-shelf image diffusion models as a teacher signal in combination with an adversarial loss to ensure high image fidelity even in the low-step regime of one or two sampling steps. Our analyses show that our model clearly outperforms existing few-step methods (GANs, Latent Consistency Models) in a single step and reaches the performance of state-of-the-art diffusion models (SDXL) in only four steps. ADD is the first method to unlock single-step, real-time image synthesis with foundation models.

title: 跟踪任意点(TAP)问题的简单自监督方法
title_en: Ayush Shrivastava*, Andrew Owens
abstract: 我们提出了一种简单且自监督的方法来解决跟踪任意点(TAP)问题。我们训练一个全局匹配Transformer,通过对比随机游走在视频中找到循环一致的轨迹,利用Transformer的基于注意力的全局匹配来定义时空图上的随机游走转移矩阵。该方法能够对点之间进行“所有对”比较,使模型获得高空间精度并获取强对比学习信号,同时避免了近期方法(如粗到细匹配)的许多复杂性。为此,我们提出了一系列设计决策,使全局匹配架构能够通过循环一致性进行自监督训练。例如,我们发现基于Transformer的方法对捷径解敏感,并提出了一种数据增强方案来解决这一问题。我们的方法在TapVid基准测试中表现出色,优于之前的自监督跟踪方法(如DIFT),并在与几种监督方法的对比中具有竞争力。
abstract_en: We present a simple, self-supervised approach to the Tracking Any Point (TAP) problem. We train a global matching transformer to find cycle consistent tracks through video via contrastive random walks, using the transformer’s attention-based global matching to define the transition matrices for a random walk on a space-time graph. The ability to perform “all pairs” comparisons between points allows the model to obtain high spatial precision and to obtain a strong contrastive learning signal, while avoiding many of the complexities of recent approaches (such as coarse-to-fine matching). To do this, we propose a number of design decisions that allow global matching architectures to be trained through self-supervision using cycle consistency. For example, we identify that transformer-based methods are sensitive to shortcut solutions, and propose a data augmentation scheme to address them. Our method achieves strong performance on the TapVid benchmarks, outperforming previous self-supervised tracking methods, such as DIFT, and is competitive with several supervised methods.

title: Bac Nguyen*, Stefan Uhlich, Fabien Cardinaux, Lukas Mauch, Marzieh Edraki, Aaron Courville
title_en: Bac Nguyen*, Stefan Uhlich, Fabien Cardinaux, Lukas Mauch, Marzieh Edraki, Aaron Courville
abstract: 处理训练数据中的分布偏移,即分布外(OOD)泛化,是机器学习领域的重要挑战。尽管像CLIP这样的预训练视觉-语言模型在零样本任务中表现出色,但进一步微调模型以适应下游任务会导致对分布外数据的性能退化。本文提出了一种稀疏微调方法(Sparse Adaptation for Fine-Tuning),该方法通过仅更新梯度幅度较大的重要参数子集,防止微调过程遗忘预训练模型中的通用知识,其余参数保持冻结。该方法易于实现且概念简单。大量实验表明,仅使用0.1%的模型参数即可显著提升CLIP的性能。在多个基准测试中,该方法均优于基线方法。在ImageNet及其变体的少样本学习基准测试中,该方法在分布外设置下相比传统微调方法平均提升5.15%。
abstract_en: Handling distribution shifts from training data, known as out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, poses a significant challenge in the field of machine learning. While a pre-trained vision-language model like CLIP has demonstrated remarkable zero-shot performance, further adaptation of the model to downstream tasks leads to undesirable degradation for OOD data. In this work, we introduce Sparse Adaptation for Fine-Tuning (), a method that prevents fine-tuning from forgetting the general knowledge in the pre-trained model. only updates a small subset of important parameters whose gradient magnitude is large, while keeping the other parameters frozen. is straightforward to implement and conceptually simple. Extensive experiments show that with only 0.1% of the model parameters, can significantly improve the performance of CLIP. It consistently outperforms baseline methods across several benchmarks. On the few-shot learning benchmark of ImageNet and its variants, gives a gain of 5.15% on average over the conventional fine-tuning method in OOD settings.

title: Badr-Eddine Marani*, Mohamed Hanini, Nihitha Malayarukil, Stergios Christodoulidis, Maria Vakalopoulou, Enzo Ferrante
title_en: Badr-Eddine Marani*, Mohamed Hanini, Nihitha Malayarukil, Stergios Christodoulidis, Maria Vakalopoulou, Enzo Ferrante
abstract: 机器学习模型在关键决策过程中的广泛应用凸显了偏差发现与缓解策略的必要性。识别偏差系统背后的原因并不直接,因为许多情况下这些偏差与隐藏的虚假相关性相关,而这些相关性并不容易被察觉。传统方法依赖于通过分析模型在预定义数据子集上的性能来进行偏差审计,这些子集通常由性别或种族等常见属性定义(针对人类数据),或由其他定义语义连贯图像组的特定属性定义。然而,事先并不总是知道定义视觉识别系统故障模式的具体属性。近期方法提出利用大型视觉语言模型来发现这些组别,该模型能够提取跨模态嵌入并生成文本描述,以表征模型表现不佳的子集。在本文中,我们主张结合视觉解释(例如通过GradCAM或其他方法生成的热图)可以提升此类偏差发现与缓解框架的性能。为此,我们引入了视觉基础的偏差发现与缓解(ViG-Bias)技术,这是一种简单而有效的技术,可集成到多种现有框架中,以提升偏差发现和缓解性能。我们的全面评估表明,在包括CelebA、Waterbirds和NICO++在内的多个具有挑战性的数据集上,结合视觉解释可以增强DOMINO、FACTS和Bias-to-Text等现有技术的性能。
abstract_en: The proliferation of machine learning models in critical decision-making processes has underscored the need for bias discovery and mitigation strategies. Identifying the reasons behind a biased system is not straightforward, since in many occasions they are associated with hidden spurious correlations which are not easy to spot. Standard approaches rely on bias audits performed by analyzing model performance in predefined subgroups of data samples, usually characterized by common attributes like gender or ethnicity when it comes to people, or other specific attributes defining semantically coherent groups of images. However, it is not always possible to know a priori the specific attributes defining the failure modes of visual recognition systems. Recent approaches propose to discover these groups by leveraging large vision language models, which enable the extraction of cross-modal embeddings and the generation of textual descriptions to characterize the subgroups where a certain model is underperforming. In this work, we argue that incorporating visual explanations (e.g. heatmaps generated via GradCAM or other approaches) can boost the performance of such bias discovery and mitigation frameworks. To this end, we introduce Visually Grounded Bias Discovery and Mitigation (ViG-Bias), a simple yet effective technique which can be integrated to a variety of existing frameworks to improve both discovery and mitigation performance. Our comprehensive evaluation shows that incorporating visual explanations enhances existing techniques like DOMINO, FACTS and Bias-to-Text, across several challenging datasets, including CelebA, Waterbirds, and NICO++.

title: Bahar Aydemir*, Deblina Bhattacharjee, Tong Zhang, Mathieu Salzmann, Sabine Süsstrunk
title_en: Bahar Aydemir*, Deblina Bhattacharjee, Tong Zhang, Mathieu Salzmann, Sabine Süsstrunk
abstract: 显著性预测模型受到标注数据多样性和数量有限的制约。标准的数据增强技术(如旋转和裁剪)会改变场景构成,从而影响显著性。我们提出了一种新颖的数据增强方法,用于深度显著性预测,该方法在编辑自然图像时保持现实场景的复杂性和变异性。由于显著性依赖于高层和低层特征,我们的方法通过结合光度和语义属性(如颜色、对比度、亮度和类别)来同时学习这些特征。为此,我们引入了一种显著性引导的交叉注意力机制,该机制能够对光度属性进行针对性编辑,从而增强特定图像区域的显著性。实验结果表明,我们的数据增强方法能够持续提升各种显著性模型的性能。此外,利用增强特征进行显著性预测,在公开的显著性基准测试中取得了优越的性能。我们的预测结果与编辑图像中的人类视觉注意力模式高度一致,这一结论通过用户研究得到验证。我们的代码已在GitHub1上公开。
abstract_en: Saliency prediction models are constrained by the limited diversity and quantity of labeled data. Standard data augmentation techniques such as rotating and cropping alter scene composition, affecting saliency. We propose a novel data augmentation method for deep saliency prediction that edits natural images while preserving the complexity and variability of real-world scenes. Since saliency depends on high-level and low-level features, our approach involves learning both by incorporating photometric and semantic attributes such as color, contrast, brightness, and class. To that end, we introduce a saliency-guided cross-attention mechanism that enables targeted edits on the photometric properties, thereby enhancing saliency within specific image regions. Experimental results show that our data augmentation method consistently improves the performance of various saliency models. Moreover, leveraging the augmentation features for saliency prediction yields superior performance on publicly available saliency benchmarks. Our predictions align closely with human visual attention patterns in the edited images, as validated by a user study. Our code is publicly available on GitHub1 .

title: Baicheng Li*, Zike Yan*, Dong Wu, Hanqing Jiang, Hongbin Zha*
title_en: Baicheng Li*, Zike Yan*, Dong Wu, Hanqing Jiang, Hongbin Zha*
abstract: 基于隐式神经表示的同步定位与建图(SLAM)由于其强大的表达表示能力和创新性的持续学习范式受到了广泛关注。然而,将此类系统部署在动态环境中尚未得到充分研究。即使对于传统算法而言,此类挑战也难以处理,因为包含动态物体的不同视角观测会破坏几何和光度一致性,而一致性是联合优化相机姿态和地图参数的基础。本文最佳利用持续学习的特性,提出了一种面向动态环境的新型SLAM框架。尽管已有研究通过经验回放策略来避免灾难性遗忘,但我们认为遗忘是一种有益特性。通过自适应控制回放缓冲区,可以轻松缓解运动物体引起的模糊性。我们通过引入持续学习的分类器来限制动态物体的回放,神经地图与分类器的迭代优化显著提升了SLAM系统在动态环境中的鲁棒性。在具有挑战性的数据集上的实验验证了所提框架的有效性。
abstract_en: Simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) with implicit neural representations has received extensive attention due to the expressive representation power and the innovative paradigm of continual learning. However, deploying such a system within a dynamic environment has not been well-studied. Such challenges are intractable even for conventional algorithms since observations from different views with dynamic objects involved break the geometric and photometric consistency, whereas the consistency lays the foundation for joint optimizing the camera pose and the map parameters. In this paper, we best exploit the characteristics of continual learning and propose a novel SLAM framework for dynamic environments. While past efforts have been made to avoid catastrophic forgetting by exploiting an experience replay strategy, we view forgetting as a desirable characteristic. By adaptively controlling the replayed buffer, the ambiguity caused by moving objects can be easily alleviated through forgetting. We restrain the replay of the dynamic objects by introducing a continually-learned classifier for dynamic object identification. The iterative optimization of the neural map and the classifier notably improves the robustness of the SLAM system under a dynamic environment. Experiments on challenging datasets verify the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

title: Baifeng Shi*, Ziyang Wu, Maolin Mao, Xin Wang, Trevor Darrell
title_en: Baifeng Shi*, Ziyang Wu, Maolin Mao, Xin Wang, Trevor Darrell
abstract: 扩大视觉模型的规模已成为获取更强大视觉表征的默认标准。在本文中,我们探讨了视觉模型规模扩大的临界点,即进一步增大模型规模已不再必要。首先,我们展示了按尺度扩展(Scaling on Scales)的威力,其中预训练并冻结的小型视觉模型(如ViT-B或ViT-L),在多个图像尺度上运行,可以在分类、分割、深度估计、多模态大语言模型(MLLM)基准测试和机器人操作任务中超越更大的模型(如ViT-H或ViT-G)。值得注意的是,在V∗基准测试中,该方法在MLLM的详细理解任务上达到了最先进性能,超越了GPT-4V等模型。我们分析了按尺度扩展相较于按模型规模扩展更优的条件。尽管更大模型在处理困难样本时具有更好的泛化能力,但我们证明了大型视觉模型的特征可以被多尺度小型模型很好地近似。这表明当前大多数甚至全部大型预训练模型所学习的表征,也可以通过多尺度小型模型获得。我们的结果表明,多尺度小型模型具有与大型模型相当的学习能力,使用该方法预训练的小型模型可以匹配甚至超越大型模型的优势。我们发布了一个Python包,可通过一行代码应用于任何视觉模型:https://github.com/bfshi/scaling_on_scales。
abstract_en: Scaling up the size of vision models has been the de facto standard to obtain more powerful visual representations. In this work, we discuss the point beyond which larger vision models are not necessary. First, we demonstrate the power of Scaling on Scales (), whereby a pre-trained and frozen smaller vision model (, ViT-B or ViT-L), run over multiple image scales, can outperform larger models (, ViT-H or ViT-G) on classification, segmentation, depth estimation, Multimodal LLM (MLLM) benchmarks, and robotic manipulation. Notably, achieves state-of-the-art performance in detailed understanding of MLLM on the V∗ benchmark, surpassing models such as GPT-4V. We examine the conditions under which is a preferred scaling approach compared to scaling on model size. While larger models have the advantage of better generalization on hard examples, we show that features of larger vision models can be well approximated by those of multi-scale smaller models. This suggests most, if not all, of the representations learned by current large pre-trained models can also be obtained from multi-scale smaller models. Our results show that a multi-scale smaller model has comparable learning capacity to a larger model, and pre-training smaller models with can match or even exceed the advantage of larger models. We release a Python package that can apply on any vision model with one line of code: https://github.com/bfshi/scaling_on_scales.

title: Baijiong Lin*, Weisen Jiang, Pengguang Chen, Yu Zhang, Shu Liu, Yingcong Chen
title_en: Baijiong Lin*, Weisen Jiang, Pengguang Chen, Yu Zhang, Shu Liu, Yingcong Chen
abstract: 多任务密集场景理解通过学习用于多个密集预测任务的模型,在广泛应用场景中具有重要价值。建模长距离依赖关系并增强跨任务交互是多任务密集预测的关键。本文提出MTMamba,一种基于Mamba的新型多任务场景理解架构。该架构包含两种核心模块:自任务Mamba(STM)模块和跨任务Mamba(CTM)模块。STM模块通过利用Mamba处理长距离依赖关系,而CTM模块显式建模任务交互以促进跨任务信息交换。在NYUDv2和PASCAL-Context数据集上的实验表明,MTMamba在基于Transformer和CNN的方法上表现出优越性能。值得注意的是,在PASCAL-Context数据集上,MTMamba在语义分割、人体解析和物体边界检测任务中分别超越先前最佳方法2.08、5.01和4.90个百分点。代码已开源至https://github.com/EnVision-Research/MTMamba。
abstract_en: Multi-task dense scene understanding, which learns a model for multiple dense prediction tasks, has a wide range of application scenarios. Modeling long-range dependency and enhancing cross-task interactions are crucial to multi-task dense prediction. In this paper, we propose MTMamba, a novel Mamba-based architecture for multi-task scene understanding. It contains two types of core blocks: self-task Mamba (STM) block and cross-task Mamba (CTM) block. STM handles long-range dependency by leveraging Mamba, while CTM explicitly models task interactions to facilitate information exchange across tasks. Experiments on NYUDv2 and PASCAL-Context datasets demonstrate the superior performance of MTMamba over Transformer-based and CNN-based methods. Notably, on the PASCAL-Context dataset, MTMamba achieves improvements of +2.08, +5.01, and +4.90 over the previous best methods in the tasks of semantic segmentation, human parsing, and object boundary detection, respectively. The code is available at https://github.com/EnVision-Research/MTMamba.

title: Baixin Xu, Jiangbei Hu, Fei Hou, Kwan-Yee Lin, Wayne Wu, Chen Qian, Ying He*
title_en: Baixin Xu, Jiangbei Hu, Fei Hou, Kwan-Yee Lin, Wayne Wu, Chen Qian, Ying He*
abstract: 神经渲染技术的进步增加了对能够直观编辑作为神经隐式曲面表示的3D对象的技术的需求。本文介绍了一种新颖的神经算法,用于将神经隐式曲面参数化为简单的参数化域(如球体和多面体)。我们的方法允许用户指定参数化域中的立方体数量,学习一种与目标3D对象几何形状高度相似的配置。它通过从对象的零水平集计算正向映射和反向映射的逆变形,实现对象与域之间的双向变形。我们通过循环损失确保近似双射映射,并优化变形平滑性。使用拉普拉斯正则化器和优化后的学习参数化域,保证了参数化质量(通过角度和面积失真评估)。我们的框架可与现有神经渲染流水线集成,利用单个对象或多组几何相似对象的多视角图像自动重建3D几何并计算纹理图,无需任何先验信息。我们在人体头部和人造物体的图像上验证了该方法的有效性。源代码可在https://xubaixinxbx.github.io/neuparam获取。
abstract_en: The advancements in neural rendering have increased the need for techniques that enable intuitive editing of 3D objects represented as neural implicit surfaces. This paper introduces a novel neural algorithm for parameterizing neural implicit surfaces to simple parametric domains like spheres and polycubes. Our method allows users to specify the number of cubes in the parametric domain, learning a configuration that closely resembles the target 3D object’s geometry. It computes bi-directional deformation between the object and the domain using a forward mapping from the object’s zero level set and an inverse deformation for backward mapping. We ensure nearly bijective mapping with a cycle loss and optimize deformation smoothness. The parameterization quality, assessed by angle and area distortions, is guaranteed using a Laplacian regularizer and an optimized learned parametric domain. Our framework integrates with existing neural rendering pipelines, using multi-view images of a single object or multiple objects of similar geometries to reconstruct 3D geometry and compute texture maps automatically, eliminating the need for any prior information. We demonstrate the method’s effectiveness on images of human heads and man-made objects. The source code is available at https://xubaixinxbx.github.io/neuparam.

title: Balamurali Murugesan*, Julio Silva-Rodríguez, Ismail Ben Ayed, Jose Dolz
title_en: Balamurali Murugesan*, Julio Silva-Rodríguez, Ismail Ben Ayed, Jose Dolz
abstract: 本文针对基于CLIP的模型适配中的关键问题——校准错误,特别是在分布外(OOD)样本的挑战性场景中,这一问题在现有CLIP适配文献中被忽视。我们实证表明,流行的CLIP适配方法(如适配器、提示学习和测试时适配)在存在分布漂移时会显著降低零样本基线的校准能力。我们识别出logit范围的增加是CLIP适配方法校准错误的根本原因,这与之前校准全监督模型的工作形成对比。受这些观察启发,我们提出了一种简单且模型无关的解决方案,通过将每个样本的logit范围缩放到其零样本预测logit,以缓解校准错误。我们探索了三种不同的实现方式,这些方法可以在适配过程中集成,或直接在推理时使用。在流行的OOD分类基准上的综合实验表明,所提出的方法在缓解校准错误的同时保持了判别性能,其改进效果在三种日益流行的适配方法家族中保持一致。代码已公开在:https://github.com/ Bala93/CLIPCalib
abstract_en: This paper addresses the critical issue of miscalibration in CLIP-based model adaptation, particularly in the challenging scenario of out-of-distribution (OOD) samples, which has been overlooked in the existing literature on CLIP adaptation. We empirically demonstrate that popular CLIP adaptation approaches, such as Adapters, Prompt Learning, and Test-Time Adaptation, substantially degrade the calibration capabilities of the zero-shot baseline in the presence of distributional drift. We identify the increase in logit ranges as the underlying cause of miscalibration of CLIP adaptation methods, contrasting with previous work on calibrating fully-supervised models. Motivated by these observations, we present a simple and model-agnostic solution to mitigate miscalibration, by scaling the logit range of each sample to its zero-shot prediction logits. We explore three different alternatives to achieve this, which can be either integrated during adaptation or directly used at inference time. Comprehensive experiments on popular OOD classification benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approaches in mitigating miscalibration while maintaining discriminative performance, whose improvements are consistent across the three families of these increasingly popular approaches. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/ Bala93/CLIPCalib .

title: Banglei Guan, Ji Zhao*, Laurent Kneip
title_en: Banglei Guan, Ji Zhao*, Laurent Kneip
abstract: 基于点对应(PC)的相对位姿估计是一种广泛应用的技术。对于广义相机的两个视角,需要最小配置的六个点对应。本文提出几种基于六个点对应的最小求解器,用于计算多相机系统的六自由度相对位姿,包括针对广义相机的最小求解器和针对双相机系统实际配置的两个最小求解器。方程构建基于旋转和平移的解耦。旋转通过Cayley或四元数参数化表示,而平移可以通过隐变量技术消除。当一组点对应关系连接两个视角中的相同相机时,会发现并证明射线束约束。这是减少解的数量并生成数值稳定求解器的关键。此外,所有多相机系统的六点问题配置都被枚举。大量实验表明,与最先进的六点方法相比,我们的求解器在准确性和效率方面具有优势。代码可在https://github.com/jizhaox/relpose-6pt获取。
abstract_en: Relative pose estimation using point correspondences (PC) is a widely used technique. A minimal configuration of six PCs is required for two views of generalized cameras. In this paper, we present several minimal solvers that use six PCs to compute the 6DOF relative pose of multi-camera systems, including a minimal solver for the generalized camera and two minimal solvers for the practical configuration of two-camera rigs. The equation construction is based on the decoupling of rotation and translation. Rotation is represented by Cayley or quaternion parametrization, and translation can be eliminated by using the hidden variable technique. Ray bundle constraints are found and proven when a subset of PCs relate the same cameras across two views. This is the key to reducing the number of solutions and generating numerically stable solvers. Moreover, all configurations of six-point problems for multi-camera systems are enumerated. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior accuracy and efficiency of our solvers compared to state-of-the-art six-point methods. The code is available at https://github.com/jizhaox/relpose-6pt.

title: Bangyan Liao, Zhenjun Zhao, Lu Chen, Haoang Li, Daniel Cremers, Peidong Liu*
title_en: Bangyan Liao, Zhenjun Zhao, Lu Chen, Haoang Li, Daniel Cremers, Peidong Liu*
abstract: 平面调整(PA)对于许多3D应用至关重要,涉及姿态估计和平面恢复的同步进行。尽管近期取得了进展,但其在多视角点云配准领域仍是一个具有挑战性的问题。当前最先进的方法仅在良好的初始化条件下才能实现全局最优收敛。此外,其高时间复杂度使其难以应用于大规模问题。为解决这些挑战,我们首先提出了一种新颖的优化策略,称为双凸松弛(Bi-Convex Relaxation),该策略将原始问题分解为两个更简单的子问题,利用凸松弛技术对每个子问题进行重新表述,并交替求解直至原始问题收敛。在此基础上,我们提出了两种算法变体,即基于点到平面误差的GlobalPointer和基于平面到平面误差的GlobalPointer++,用于解决平面调整问题。在合成数据集和真实数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法可以在线性时间复杂度下实现大规模平面调整,具有更大的收敛区域,并且对不良初始化具有鲁棒性,同时达到与先前方法相似的精度。代码可在github.com/wu-cvgl/GlobalPointer获取。
abstract_en: Plane adjustment (PA) is crucial for many 3D applications, involving simultaneous pose estimation and plane recovery. Despite recent advancements, it remains a challenging problem in the realm of multi-view point cloud registration. Current state-of-the-art methods can achieve globally optimal convergence only with good initialization. Furthermore, their high time complexity renders them impractical for large-scale problems. To address these challenges, we first exploit a novel optimization strategy termed Bi-Convex Relaxation, which decouples the original problem into two simpler sub-problems, reformulates each sub-problem using a convex relaxation technique, and alternately solves each one until the original problem converges. Building on this strategy, we propose two algorithmic variants for solving the plane adjustment problem, namely GlobalPointer and GlobalPointer++, based on point-to-plane and plane-to-plane errors, respectively. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real datasets demonstrate that our method can perform large-scale plane adjustment with linear time complexity, larger convergence region, and robustness to poor initialization, while achieving similar accuracy as prior methods. The code is available at github.com/wu-cvgl/GlobalPointer.

title: Baoxiong Jia*, Yixin Chen, Huangyue Yu, Yan Wang, Xuesong Niu, Tengyu Liu, Qing Li, Siyuan Huang
title_en: Baoxiong Jia*, Yixin Chen, Huangyue Yu, Yan Wang, Xuesong Niu, Tengyu Liu, Qing Li, Siyuan Huang
abstract: 三维视觉-语言(3D-VL)接地旨在将语言与三维物理环境对齐,是开发具身智能体的核心基础。与2D领域近期的进展相比,将语言接地在三维场景中面临两个重大挑战:(i) 配对的3D-VL数据稀缺,难以支持对三维场景的接地学习,尤其是在多样化的物体配置、丰富的属性和复杂的关系中;(ii) 缺乏统一的学习框架来从接地的三维数据中提炼知识。在本工作中,我们旨在通过系统性地扩展室内场景中的3D-VL学习来解决这些主要挑战。我们引入了首个百万级的3D-VL数据集,涵盖室内场景,包含从人类标注和我们可扩展的场景图生成方法中收集的视觉-语言对。我们证明这种扩展使得能够建立统一的预训练框架Grounded Pre-training for Scenes(),用于3D-VL学习。通过大量实验,我们展示了在现有3D视觉接地和问答基准测试中取得的性能表现。我们还表明,数据扩展效应不仅限于,对诸如3D语义分割等任务的模型也具有普遍益处。通过在具有挑战性的3D-VL任务中的零样本迁移实验,揭示了和的巨大潜力。
abstract_en: 3D vision-language (3dvl) grounding, which aims to align language with 3D physical environments, stands as a cornerstone in developing embodied agents. In comparison to recent advancements in the 2D domain, grounding language in 3D scenes faces two significant challenges: (i) the scarcity of paired 3dvl data to support grounded learning of 3D scenes, especially considering complexities within diverse object configurations, rich attributes, and intricate relationships; and (ii) the absence of a unified learning framework to distill knowledge from grounded 3D data. In this work, we aim to address these major challenges in 3D-VL by examining the potential of systematically upscaling 3D-VL learning in indoor scenes. We introduce the first million-scale 3D-VL dataset, , encompassing indoor scenes and comprising vision-language pairs collected from both human annotations and our scalable scene-graph-based generation approach. We demonstrate that this scaling allows for a unified pre-training framework, Grounded Pre-training for Scenes (), for 3D-VL learning. Through extensive experiments, we showcase the effectiveness of by achieving performance on existing 3D visual grounding and question-answering benchmarks. We also show that the data scaling effect is not limited to , but is generally beneficial for models on tasks like 3D semantic segmentation. The vast potential of and is unveiled through zero-shot transfer experiments in challenging 3dvl tasks.

title: Bartłomiej Sobieski*, Przemyslaw Biecek*
title_en: Bartłomiej Sobieski*, Przemyslaw Biecek*
abstract: 尽管在生成可视化反事实解释的方法开发方面取得了越来越多的进展,先前的研究将其视为一种完全局部的技术。在本文中,我们首次尝试将此类技术全局化。具体而言,我们发现扩散自编码器的潜在空间以全局方向的形式编码了给定分类器的推理过程。我们提出了一种基于代理的新方法,仅使用单张图像,在完全黑盒方式下发现两种类型的这些方向。具体来说,g方向能够翻转给定分类器在整张图像数据集上的决策,而h方向进一步增加了解释的多样性。我们一般称其为全局反事实方向(Global Counterfactual Directions, GCDs)。此外,我们展示了GCDs可以自然地与潜在积分梯度结合,从而产生一种新的黑盒归因方法,同时增强对反事实解释的理解。我们在现有基准上验证了我们的方法,并展示了其在现实世界用例中的泛化能力。
abstract_en: Despite increasing progress in development of methods for generating visual counterfactual explanations, previous works consider them as an entirely local technique. In this work, we take the first step at globalizing them. Specifically, we discover that the latent space of Diffusion Autoencoders encodes the inference process of a given classifier in the form of global directions. We propose a novel proxy-based approach that discovers two types of these directions with the use of only single image in an entirely black-box manner. Precisely, g-directions allow for flipping the decision of a given classifier on an entire dataset of images, while h-directions further increase the diversity of explanations. We refer to them in general as Global Counterfactual Directions (GCDs). Moreover, we show that GCDs can be naturally combined with Latent Integrated Gradients resulting in a new black-box attribution method, while simultaneously enhancing the understanding of counterfactual explanations. We validate our approach on existing benchmarks and show that it generalizes to real-world use-cases.

title: Basak Melis Ocal*, Maxim Tatarchenko, Sezer Karaoglu, Theo Gevers
title_en: Basak Melis Ocal*, Maxim Tatarchenko, Sezer Karaoglu, Theo Gevers
abstract: 设计高质量的室内三维场景在许多实际应用中至关重要,例如房间规划或游戏开发。传统上,这一过程耗时且需要艺术技能及对专业软件的熟悉,使得普通用户难以参与。然而,生成式人工智能的最新进展为三维设计的民主化奠定了坚实基础。本文提出了一种基于文本的三维房间设计开创性方法。给定描述房间内物体摆放的自然语言提示,我们的方法可生成对应的高质量三维场景。通过附加文本提示,用户可改变整个场景或场景内单个物体的外观。该方法基于上下文学习、CAD模型检索及基于3D高斯点云的风格化处理构建,提供易于使用的端到端流程,即使对新手也友好。项目页面可访问:https://sceneteller.github.io/
abstract_en: Designing high-quality indoor 3D scenes is important in many practical applications, such as room planning or game development. Conventionally, this has been a time-consuming process which requires both artistic skill and familiarity with professional software, making it hardly accessible for layman users. However, recent advances in generative AI have established solid foundation for democratizing 3D design. In this paper, we propose a pioneering approach for text-based 3D room design. Given a prompt in natural language describing the object placement in the room, our method produces a high-quality 3D scene corresponding to it. With an additional text prompt the users can change the appearance of the entire scene or of individual objects in it. Built using in-context learning, CAD model retrieval and 3D-Gaussian-Splatting-based stylization, our turnkey pipeline produces state-of-the-art 3D scenes, while being easy to use even for novices. Our project page is available at https://sceneteller.github.io/.

title: Basile Van Hoorick*, Rundi Wu, Ege Ozguroglu, Kyle Sargent, Ruoshi Liu, Pavel Tokmakov, Achal Dave, Changxi Zheng, Carl Vondrick
title_en: Basile Van Hoorick*, Rundi Wu, Ege Ozguroglu, Kyle Sargent, Ruoshi Liu, Pavel Tokmakov, Achal Dave, Changxi Zheng, Carl Vondrick
abstract: 从单一视角准确重建复杂动态场景仍然是计算机视觉中的挑战性任务。当前的动态新视角合成方法通常需要来自多个不同摄像机视角的视频,这需要精心设计的录制设置,并显著限制了其在现实世界以及具身AI应用中的实用性。在本文中,我们提出GCD,一种可控的单目动态视角合成管道,该方法利用大规模扩散先验知识,给定任意场景的视频,能够根据一组相对摄像机姿态参数生成同步视频,从任意选定的视角进行条件生成。我们的模型不需要深度作为输入,也不显式建模3D场景几何结构,而是通过端到端的视频到视频翻译来高效实现目标。尽管仅在合成多视角视频数据上进行训练,零样本真实世界泛化实验在多个领域(包括机器人、物体恒常性和驾驶环境)中均显示出有希望的结果。我们认为,我们的框架有可能在丰富的动态场景理解、机器人感知以及虚拟现实中的交互式3D视频观看体验方面解锁强大的应用。
abstract_en: Accurate reconstruction of complex dynamic scenes from just a single viewpoint continues to be a challenging task in computer vision. Current dynamic novel view synthesis methods typically require videos from many different camera viewpoints, necessitating careful recording setups, and significantly restricting their utility in the wild as well as in terms of embodied AI applications. In this paper, we propose GCD, a controllable monocular dynamic view synthesis pipeline that leverages large-scale diffusion priors to, given a video of any scene, generate a synchronous video from any other chosen perspective, conditioned on a set of relative camera pose parameters. Our model does not require depth as input, and does not explicitly model 3D scene geometry, instead performing end-to-end video-to-video translation in order to achieve its goal efficiently. Despite being trained on synthetic multi-view video data only, zero-shot real-world generalization experiments show promising results in multiple domains, including robotics, object permanence, and driving environments. We believe our framework can potentially unlock powerful applications in rich dynamic scene understanding, perception for robotics, and interactive 3D video viewing experiences for virtual reality.

title: Basudha Pal*, Arunkumar Kannan*, Ram Prabhakar Kathirvel, Alice O'Toole, Rama Chellappa
title_en: Basudha Pal*, Arunkumar Kannan*, Ram Prabhakar Kathirvel, Alice O'Toole, Rama Chellappa
abstract: 在采用扩散模型进行人脸生成领域取得了显著进展。然而,扩散模型在生成过程中倾向于放大偏差,导致年龄、性别和种族等敏感面部属性的分布不均。本文提出了一种新颖的方法,通过去偏处理扩散模型生成图像中的属性来解决这一问题。我们的方法利用高斯混合模型(GMM)在扩散模型的潜在空间中定位均值,从而解耦面部属性。该方法借助扩散模型可适应的潜在结构,能够在不重新训练的情况下实时定位负责生成特定属性的子空间。我们在多个人脸数据集上验证了该技术的有效性,实现了更公平的数据生成同时保持样本质量。此外,我们通过在原始数据集中加入公平生成的数据来增强数据集,实证展示了其在下游分类任务中减少偏差的有效性,而不会影响性能。
abstract_en: Significant advancements have been achieved in the domain of face generation with the adoption of diffusion models. However, diffusion models tend to amplify biases during the generative process, resulting in an uneven distribution of sensitive facial attributes such as age, gender, and race. In this paper, we introduce a novel approach to address this issue by debiasing the attributes in the images generated by diffusion models. Our approach involves disentangling facial attributes by localizing the means within the latent space of the diffusion model using Gaussian mixture models (GMM). This method, leveraging the adaptable latent structure of diffusion models, allows us to localize the subspace responsible for generating specific attributes on-the-fly without the need for retraining. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our technique across various face datasets, resulting in fairer data generation while preserving sample quality. Furthermore, we empirically illustrate its effectiveness in reducing bias in downstream classification tasks without compromising performance by augmenting the original dataset with fairly generated data.

title: Beichen Zhang*, Pan Zhang, Xiaoyi Dong*, Yuhang Zang, Jiaqi Wang*
title_en: Beichen Zhang*, Pan Zhang, Xiaoyi Dong*, Yuhang Zang, Jiaqi Wang*
abstract: 对比语言-图像预训练(CLIP)通过对齐图像和文本模态,已成为零样本分类、文本-图像检索和文本-图像生成的基石。尽管其被广泛采用,但CLIP的一个显著局限在于文本输入长度不足。文本标记长度被限制在77个以内,实证研究表明其实际有效长度甚至不足20个。这阻碍了CLIP处理详细描述的能力,限制了其在需要大量前提条件的图像检索和文本到图像生成中的应用。为此,我们提出Long-CLIP作为CLIP的即插即用替代方案,支持长文本输入,保留甚至超越其零样本泛化能力,并对齐CLIP的潜在空间,使其无需任何进一步适配即可在下游框架中直接替换CLIP。然而,实现这一目标远非易事,因为简单的微调会导致CLIP性能显著下降。此外,用支持更长上下文的语言模型替代文本编码器需要使用大量数据进行预训练,带来显著成本。因此,Long-CLIP引入了一种高效的CLIP微调方案,包含两项新策略以保持原始能力,包括(1)保留知识的文本位置嵌入拉伸和(2)CLIP特征的主要成分匹配。通过仅利用一百万对额外的长文本-图像数据对,Long-CLIP在长描述文本-图像检索任务中相比CLIP提升了约20%,在传统文本-图像检索任务(如COCO和Flickr30k)中提升了约6%。此外,Long-CLIP通过即插即用方式替换CLIP,增强了从详细文本描述生成图像的能力。代码和模型已发布于https://github.com/beichenzbc/Long-CLIP。
abstract_en: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) has been the cornerstone for zero-shot classification, text-image retrieval, and text-image generation by aligning image and text modalities. Despite its widespread adoption, a significant limitation of CLIP lies in the inadequate length of text input. The length of the text token is restricted to 77, and an empirical study shows the actual effective length is even less than 20. This prevents CLIP from handling detailed descriptions, limiting its applications for image retrieval and text-to-image generation with extensive prerequisites. To this end, we propose Long-CLIP as a plug-and-play alternative to CLIP that supports long-text input, retains or even surpasses its zero-shot generalizability, and aligns the CLIP latent space, making it readily replace CLIP without any further adaptation in downstream frameworks. Nevertheless, achieving this goal is far from straightforward, as simplistic fine-tuning can result in a significant degradation of CLIP’s performance. Moreover, substituting the text encoder with a language model supporting longer contexts necessitates pretraining with vast amounts of data, incurring significant expenses. Accordingly, Long-CLIP introduces an efficient fine-tuning solution on CLIP with two novel strategies designed to maintain the original capabilities, including (1) a knowledge-preserved stretching of positional embedding and (2) a primary component matching of CLIP features. With leveraging just one million extra long text-image pairs, Long-CLIP has shown the superiority to CLIP for about 20% in long caption text-image retrieval and 6% in traditional text-image retrieval tasks, , COCO and Flickr30k. Furthermore, Long-CLIP offers enhanced capabilities for generating images from detailed text descriptions by replacing CLIP in a plug-and-play manner. Codes and models are released at https://github.com/beichenzbc/ Long-CLIP.

title: Bencheng Liao, Shaoyu Chen, Bo Jiang, Tianheng Cheng, Qian Zhang, Wenyu Liu, Chang Huang, Xinggang Wang*
title_en: Bencheng Liao, Shaoyu Chen, Bo Jiang, Tianheng Cheng, Qian Zhang, Wenyu Liu, Chang Huang, Xinggang Wang*
abstract: 在线车道图构建是自动驾驶领域具有前景但极具挑战性的任务。先前方法通常以像素或分段为单位建模车道图,并通过逐像素或分段连接来恢复车道图,这破坏了车道的连续性,导致性能次优。人类驾驶员更关注并沿连续完整的路径驾驶,而非考虑车道分段。自动驾驶车辆也需要通过车道图获取针对特定路径的引导信息以进行轨迹规划。我们认为,表示交通流的路径是车道图的基本元素。受此启发,我们提出以路径式方法建模车道图,该方法能有效保持车道的连续性并编码交通信息用于规划。我们提出一种基于路径的在线车道图构建方法,称为LaneGAP,通过Path2Graph算法端到端学习路径并恢复车道图。我们在可控且公平的条件下,对nuScenes和Argoverse2等具有挑战性的数据集进行定性和定量实验,证明LaneGAP在准确性和效率上优于传统的基于像素和分段的方法。与近期最先进的分段式方法TopoNet在OpenLane-V2数据集上的对比实验表明,LaneGAP仍以1.6 mIoU的优势胜出,进一步验证了路径式建模的有效性。补充材料中的大量可视化结果表明,LaneGAP能够应对多样化的交通场景。代码已开源至https://github.com/hustvl/LaneGAP。
abstract_en: Online lane graph construction is a promising but challenging task in autonomous driving. Previous methods usually model the lane graph at the pixel or piece level, and recover the lane graph by pixel-wise or piece-wise connection, which breaks down the continuity of the lane and results in suboptimal performance. Human drivers focus on and drive along the continuous and complete paths instead of considering lane pieces. Autonomous vehicles also require path-specific guidance from lane graph for trajectory planning. We argue that the path, which indicates the traffic flow, is the primitive of the lane graph. Motivated by this, we propose to model the lane graph in a novel path-wise manner, which well preserves the continuity of the lane and encodes traffic information for planning. We present a path-based online lane graph construction method, termed LaneGAP, which end-to-end learns the path and recovers the lane graph via a Path2Graph algorithm. We qualitatively and quantitatively demonstrate the superior accuracy and efficiency of LaneGAP over conventional pixel-based and piece-based methods on the challenging nuScenes and Argoverse2 datasets under controllable and fair conditions. Compared to the recent state-of-the-art piece-wise method TopoNet on the OpenLane-V2 dataset, LaneGAP still outperforms by 1.6 mIoU, further validating the effectiveness of path-wise modeling. Abundant visualizations in the supplementary material show LaneGAP can cope with diverse traffic conditions. Code is released at https://github.com/hustvl/ LaneGAP.

title: Benjamin Attal*, Dor Verbin, Ben Mildenhall, Peter Hedman, Jonathan T Barron, Matthew O'Toole, Pratul Srinivasan
title_en: Benjamin Attal*, Dor Verbin, Ben Mildenhall, Peter Hedman, Jonathan T Barron, Matthew O'Toole, Pratul Srinivasan
abstract: 当前最先进的三维重建技术主要基于体积场景表示,该方法需要沿光线采样多个点以计算到达该点的颜色。将这些表示应用于更一般的逆渲染任务——从观测图像中重建几何结构、材质和光照——具有挑战性,因为递归地对这些体积表示进行路径追踪的计算成本较高。近期的研究通过使用辐射缓存(radiance caches)来缓解这一问题:这些数据结构存储了从任意方向到达任意点的稳态、无限次反射的辐射值。然而,这些解决方案依赖于引入偏差的近似方法,更重要的是,这些偏差会传播到用于优化的梯度中。我们提出了一种方法,能够在避免这些近似的同时保持计算效率。具体而言,我们利用两种技术来降低渲染方程无偏估计的方差:(1)一种遮挡感知的重要性采样器,用于入射光照;(2)一种快速缓存架构,可作为高质量但计算成本更高的体积缓存的控制变量。我们证明,通过消除这些偏差,我们的方法提高了基于辐射缓存的逆渲染的通用性,并在存在挑战性的光传输效应(如镜面相互反射)时提升了渲染质量。
abstract_en: State-of-the-art techniques for 3D reconstruction are largely based on volumetric scene representations, which require sampling multiple points to compute the color arriving along a ray. Using these representations for more general inverse rendering — reconstructing geometry, materials, and lighting from observed images — is challenging because recursively path-tracing such volumetric representations is expensive. Recent works alleviate this issue through the use of radiance caches: data structures that store the steady-state, infinite-bounce radiance arriving at any point from any direction. However, these solutions rely on approximations that introduce bias into the renderings and, more importantly, into the gradients used for optimization. We present a method that avoids these approximations while remaining computationally efficient. In particular, we leverage two techniques to reduce variance for unbiased estimators of the rendering equation: (1) an occlusion-aware importance sampler for incoming illumination and (2) a fast cache architecture that can be used as a control variate for the radiance from a high-quality, but more expensive, volumetric cache. We show that by removing these biases our approach improves the generality of radiance cache based inverse rendering, as well as increasing quality in the presence of challenging light transport effects such as specular interreflections.

title: Benjamin Gallusser, Martin Weigert*
title_en: Benjamin Gallusser, Martin Weigert*
abstract: 细胞追踪是活细胞显微镜中普遍存在的图像分析任务。与自然图像的多目标追踪(MOT)不同,细胞追踪通常涉及数百个外观相似的对象,这些对象在每一帧中都可能发生分裂,使其成为一个特别具有挑战性的问题。当前最先进的方法遵循基于检测的追踪范式,首先在每一帧中检测所有细胞,然后在第二步中将它们链接起来,形成生物一致的细胞轨迹。链接通常通过离散优化方法解决,这需要为每个数据集手动调整超参数,因此在实践中使用起来繁琐。本文提出了一种通用的细胞追踪方法,该方法使用简单的Transformer架构,直接从标注数据中学习时间窗口内细胞之间的成对关联。重要的是,与现有的基于Transformer的MOT流程不同,我们的学习架构还考虑了分裂对象(如细胞),即使使用简单的贪心链接也能实现精确追踪,从而朝着消除复杂链接步骤的需求迈出重要一步。所提出的架构通过避免处理密集图像的计算负担,利用时间窗口内检测的完整时空上下文。我们证明,我们的追踪方法在各种生物数据集(如细菌、细胞培养和荧光粒子)上,与高度调优的最先进细胞追踪算法表现相当或更优。我们提供代码:https: //github.com/weigertlab/trackastra.
abstract_en: Cell tracking is a ubiquitous image analysis task in live-cell microscopy. Unlike multiple object tracking (MOT) for natural images, cell tracking typically involves hundreds of similar-looking objects that can divide in each frame, making it a particularly challenging problem. Current state-of-the-art approaches follow the tracking-by-detection paradigm, first all cells are detected per frame and successively linked in a second step to form biologically consistent cell tracks. Linking is commonly solved via discrete optimization methods, which require manual tuning of hyperparameters for each dataset and are therefore cumbersome to use in practice. Here we propose , a general purpose cell tracking approach that uses a simple transformer architecture to directly learn pairwise associations of cells within a temporal window from annotated data. Importantly, unlike existing transformer-based MOT pipelines, our learning architecture also accounts for dividing objects such as cells and allows for accurate tracking even with simple greedy linking, thus making strides towards removing the requirement for a complex linking step. The proposed architecture operates on the full spatio-temporal context of detections within a time window by avoiding the computational burden of processing dense images. We show that our tracking approach performs on par with or better than highly tuned state-of-the-art cell tracking algorithms for various biological datasets, such as bacteria, cell cultures and fluorescent particles. We provide code at https: //github.com/weigertlab/trackastra.

title: Benjamin J Biggs*, Arjun Seshadri, Yang Zou, Achin Jain, Aditya Golatkar, Yusheng Xie, Alessandro Achille, Ashwin Swaminathan, Stefano Soatto
title_en: Benjamin J Biggs*, Arjun Seshadri, Yang Zou, Achin Jain, Aditya Golatkar, Yusheng Xie, Alessandro Achille, Ashwin Swaminathan, Stefano Soatto
abstract: 我们提出了一种名为Diffusion Soup的分隔方法,用于文本到图像生成。该方法通过平均在分片数据上训练的扩散模型的权重。从结构上讲,我们的方法能够在不增加额外内存或推理成本的情况下实现无需训练的持续学习和遗忘,因为可以通过重新平均来添加或移除对应于数据分片的模型。我们证明Diffusion Soup的采样点在权重空间中近似于构成数据集分布的几何平均,这提供了反记忆保证,并支持零样本风格混合。实验证明,Diffusion Soup在分片数据上优于联合所有数据分片训练的标杆模型,图像奖励(Image Reward)提升了30%(.34 → .44),在美学数据上IR指标提升了59%(.37 → .59)。在两种情况下,souping在TIFA评分上也表现更优(分别为85.5 → 86.5和85.6 → 86.8)。我们展示了稳健的遗忘能力——移除任何单个领域分片仅会使IR指标下降1%(.45 → .44)——并通过真实数据验证了反记忆保证的理论见解。最后,我们展示了Diffusion Soup将不同分片微调模型的风格进行融合的能力,实现了零样本生成混合风格。
