The versatility and generalizability of DIFFender are evident across a variety of settings, classifiers, and attack methodologies, marking an advancement in adversarial patch defense strategies. Our code is available at https:// github.com/kkkcx/DIFFender.

title: Camillo Quattrocchi*, Antonino Furnari, Daniele Di Mauro, Mario Valerio Giuffrida, Giovanni Maria Farinella
title_en: Camillo Quattrocchi*, Antonino Furnari, Daniele Di Mauro, Mario Valerio Giuffrida, Giovanni Maria Farinella
abstract: 我们研究了将时间动作分割系统从外在(固定)摄像头场景转移到第一人称场景的问题,其中可穿戴摄像头捕获视频数据。传统的监督方法需要收集和标注新的第一人称视频数据集以适应模型,这成本高昂且耗时。相反,我们提出了一种新颖的方法,通过利用现有的标注外在视频数据和一组新的未标注、同步的外在-第一人称视频对进行适应,这些视频对无需收集时间动作分割标注。我们采用基于知识蒸馏的方法实现该方法,并在特征层和时间动作分割模型层进行探究。在Assembly101和EgoExo4D数据集上的实验验证了所提方法的有效性,相较于经典无监督领域适应和时间对齐方法。无需额外优化,我们的最佳模型在未接触任何第一人称标注的情况下,性能与基于标注第一人称数据训练的监督方法相当,在Assembly101数据集上编辑得分(28.59 vs 12.60)相比仅使用外在数据训练的基线模型提升了+15.99。在类似场景下,我们的方法在具有挑战性的EgoExo4D基准测试中也提升了+3.32的编辑得分。代码已开源:https://github.com/fpv-iplab/ synchronization-is-all-you-need.
abstract_en: We consider the problem of transferring a temporal action segmentation system initially designed for exocentric (fixed) cameras to an egocentric scenario, where wearable cameras capture video data. The conventional supervised approach requires the collection and labeling of a new set of egocentric videos to adapt the model, which is costly and time-consuming. Instead, we propose a novel methodology which performs the adaptation leveraging existing labeled exocentric videos and a new set of unlabeled, synchronized exocentric-egocentric video pairs, for which temporal action segmentation annotations do not need to be collected. We implement the proposed methodology with an approach based on knowledge distillation, which we investigate both at the feature and Temporal Action Segmentation model level. Experiments on Assembly101 and EgoExo4D demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method against classic unsupervised domain adaptation and temporal alignment approaches. Without bells and whistles, our best model performs on par with supervised approaches trained on labeled egocentric data, without ever seeing a single egocentric label, achieving a +15.99 improvement in the edit score (28.59 vs 12.60) on the Assembly101 dataset compared to a baseline model trained solely on exocentric data. In similar settings, our method also improves edit score by +3.32 on the challenging EgoExo4D benchmark. Code is available here: https://github.com/fpv-iplab/ synchronization-is-all-you-need.

title: Camilo L Fosco*, Benjamin Lahner, Bowen Pan, Alex Andonian, Emilie L Josephs, Alex Lascelles, Aude Oliva
title_en: Camilo L Fosco*, Benjamin Lahner, Bowen Pan, Alex Andonian, Emilie L Josephs, Alex Lascelles, Aude Oliva
abstract: 近年来,脑到刺激重建领域取得了显著进展,但现有技术仍具有数据集和受试者特定性,通常仅在单一数据集上进行测试。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新颖的技术,旨在从功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)信号中重建视频,该技术设计用于跨数据集和跨受试者表现。我们的流程通过多数据集和多受试者训练,能够准确生成来自不同受试者和不同数据集的2秒和3秒视频片段。这有助于回归预训练文本到视频和视频到视频模型的关键潜在向量和条件向量,以重建与受试者观察到的原始刺激相匹配的准确视频。我们方法的核心是引入了一个三阶段方法:首先将fMRI信号对齐到语义嵌入,然后回归重要向量,最后利用这些估计值生成视频。我们的方法在定性和定量分析(包括众包式人类评估)中验证了最先进的重建能力。我们展示了在两个数据集以及多受试者设置中的性能提升。我们的消融研究揭示了不同对齐策略和数据缩放决策对重建性能的影响,并通过分析性能随更多受试者数据利用而演变的趋势,暗示了零样本重建的未来发展方向。
abstract_en: The field of brain-to-stimuli reconstruction has seen significant progress in the last few years, but techniques continue to be subject-specific and are usually tested on a single dataset. In this work, we present a novel technique to reconstruct videos from functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) signals designed for performance across datasets and across human participants. Our pipeline accurately generates 2 and 3-second video clips from brain activity coming from distinct participants and different datasets by leveraging multi-dataset and multi-subject training. This helps us regress key latent and conditioning vectors for pretrained text-to-video and video-to-video models to reconstruct accurate videos that match the original stimuli observed by the participant. Key to our pipeline is the introduction of a 3-stage approach that first aligns fMRI signals to semantic embeddings, then regresses important vectors, and finally generates videos with those estimations. Our method demonstrates state-of-the-art reconstruction capabilities verified by qualitative and quantitative analyses, including crowd-sourced human evaluation. We showcase performance improvements across two datasets, as well as in multi-subject setups. Our ablation studies shed light on how different alignment strategies and data scaling decisions impact reconstruction performance, and we hint at a future for zero-shot reconstruction by analyzing how performance evolves as more subject data is leveraged.

title: Canyu Zhang*, Xiaoguang Li*, Qing Guo*, Song Wang*
title_en: Canyu Zhang*, Xiaoguang Li*, Qing Guo*, Song Wang*
abstract: 图像的隐式表示可以将连续域中的任意坐标映射到其对应的色彩值,展现出强大的图像重建能力。然而,现有的隐式表示方法仅关注构建连续的外观映射,忽略了像素间语义信息的连续性。因此,当输入图像中的语义信息受损(如大面积缺失)时,实现理想的重建结果变得具有挑战性。为解决这一问题,我们提出学习语义感知的隐式表示(SAIR),即使每个像素的隐式表示依赖于其外观信息和语义信息(即该像素所属的对象)。为此,我们提出一个包含两个模块的框架:(1)针对受损图像的语义隐式表示(SIR)。给定连续域中的任意坐标,我们可以获得与其对应的文本对齐嵌入,指示该像素所属的对象。(2)基于SIR的外观隐式表示(AIR)。给定连续域中的任意坐标,我们可以在输入图像中是否存在该像素的情况下重建其色彩值。我们在图像修复任务中验证了这一新颖的语义感知隐式表示方法,广泛实验表明,我们的方法在显著程度上超越了现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Implicit representation of an image can map arbitrary coordinates in the continuous domain to their corresponding color values, presenting a powerful capability for image reconstruction. Nevertheless, existing implicit representation approaches only focus on building continuous appearance mapping, ignoring the continuities of the semantic information across pixels. Consequently, achieving the desired reconstruction results becomes challenging when the semantic information within input image is corrupted, such as when a large region is missing. To address the issue, we suggest learning semantic-aware implicit representation ( SAIR), that is, we make the implicit representation of each pixel rely on both its appearance and semantic information (, which object does the pixel belong to). To this end, we propose a framework with two modules: (1) a semantic implicit representation (SIR) for a corrupted image. Given an arbitrary coordinate in the continuous domain, we can obtain its respective text-aligned embedding indicating the object the pixel belongs. (2) an appearance implicit representation (AIR) based on the SIR. Given an arbitrary coordinate in the continuous domain, we can reconstruct its color whether or not the pixel is missed in the input. We validate the novel semantic-aware implicit representation method on the image inpainting task, and the extensive experiments demonstrate that our method surpasses state-of-the-art approaches by a significant margin.

title: Carlos Hinojosa*, Shuming Liu, Bernard Ghanem
title_en: Carlos Hinojosa*, Shuming Liu, Bernard Ghanem
abstract: 掩码自编码器(MAE)作为一种强大的自监督框架,已在多种下游任务中展现出卓越的性能。为增加预训练任务的难度并学习更丰富的视觉表征,现有研究主要通过替换标准随机掩码策略,采用更复杂的策略如对抗引导和教师引导掩码。然而,这些策略依赖输入数据,通常会增加模型复杂度并需要额外计算生成掩码模式。这引发了一个问题:我们能否在不依赖输入数据或增加计算成本的情况下,提升MAE的性能?本文提出了一种简单而有效的数据无关方法,称为__TITLE_MATH_1__,通过过滤随机噪声生成不同的二值掩码模式。受图像处理中彩色噪声的启发,我们探索了四种滤波器以生成具有不同空间和语义先验的掩码模式。__TITLE_MATH_1__无需额外可学习参数或网络计算开销,却显著增强了学习到的表征。我们提供了全面的实证评估,证明了与随机掩码相比,我们的策略在下游任务中具有优越性。值得注意的是,与基线MAE实现相比,在语义分割任务中,我们的方法在mIoU指标上提升了2.72。
abstract_en: Masked AutoEncoders (MAE) have emerged as a robust self-supervised framework, offering remarkable performance across a wide range of downstream tasks. To increase the difficulty of the pretext task and learn richer visual representations, existing works have focused on replacing standard random masking with more sophisticated strategies, such as adversarial-guided and teacher-guided masking. However, these strategies depend on the input data thus commonly increasing the model complexity and requiring additional calculations to generate the mask patterns. This raises the question: Can we enhance MAE performance beyond random masking without relying on input data or incurring additional computational costs? In this work, we introduce a simple yet effective data-independent method, termed , which generates different binary mask patterns by filtering random noise. Drawing inspiration from color noise in image processing, we explore four types of filters to yield mask patterns with different spatial and semantic priors. requires no additional learnable parameters or computational overhead in the network, yet it significantly enhances the learned representations. We provide a comprehensive empirical evaluation, demonstrating our strategy’s superiority in downstream tasks compared to random masking. Notably, we report an improvement of 2.72 in mIoU in semantic segmentation tasks relative to baseline MAE implementations.

title: Casper van Engelenburg*, Fatemeh Mostafavi, Emanuel Kuhn, Yuntae Jeon, Michael Franzen, Matthias Standfest, Jan van Gemert, Seyran Khademi
title_en: Casper van Engelenburg*, Fatemeh Mostafavi, Emanuel Kuhn, Yuntae Jeon, Michael Franzen, Matthias Standfest, Jan van Gemert, Seyran Khademi
abstract: 多样且真实的平面图数据对于开发有用的建筑平面设计计算机辅助方法至关重要。当前的大规模平面图数据集主要包含简单的平面图布局,通常仅代表单户住宅。为弥补现有数据集与现实世界的差距,我们开发了修改后的瑞士住宅数据集(Modified Swiss Dwellings, MSD)——首个包含大量多户住宅平面图布局的大规模数据集。MSD包含超过5300个中型至大型建筑综合体的平面图,涵盖超过18900个不同的住宅单元。我们验证了现有平面图生成方法在简单场景中虽有效,但尚无法无缝应对MSD带来的挑战。本基准测试呼吁在平面图机器理解领域开展新的研究。代码和数据已公开。
abstract_en: Diverse and realistic floor plan data are essential for the development of useful computer-aided methods in architectural design. Today’s large-scale floor plan datasets predominantly feature simple floor plan layouts, typically representing single-apartment dwellings only. To compensate for the mismatch between current datasets and the real world, we develop Modified Swiss Dwellings (MSD) – the first large-scale floor plan dataset that contains a significant share of layouts of multi-apartment dwellings. MSD features over 5.3K floor plans of medium- to large-scale building complexes, covering over 18.9K distinct apartments. We validate that existing approaches for floor plan generation, while effective in simpler scenarios, cannot yet seamlessly address the challenges posed by MSD. Our benchmark calls for new research in floor plan machine understanding. Code and data are open.

title: Chaitanya Patel*, Shaojie Bai, Te-Li Wang, Jason Saragih, Shih-En Wei
title_en: Chaitanya Patel*, Shaojie Bai, Te-Li Wang, Jason Saragih, Shih-En Wei
abstract: 虚拟现实(VR)展现出通过比其他媒体更沉浸的社交互动的潜力。关键在于能够准确地对个性化逼真化身进行动画制作,因此需要高效且准确地获取头戴式设备摄像头(HMC)图像的标签,同时佩戴VR头显。这具有挑战性,因为存在斜视摄像头视角和图像模态差异。在本工作中,我们首先表明,化身与HMC图像之间的领域差异是主要困难来源之一,其中基于Transformer的架构在领域一致数据上能实现高精度,但当重新引入领域差异时性能会下降。基于这一发现,我们提出一个分两部分的系统:一个迭代优化模块接收域内输入,以及一个通用的化身引导的图像到图像领域迁移模块,该模块基于当前估计进行条件约束。这两个模块相互强化:当展示接近真实值的示例时,领域迁移变得更加容易,而更好的领域差异消除反过来又提高了配准效果。我们的系统消除了对昂贵离线优化的需求,并产生比直接回归方法更高质量的在线配准。我们通过在消费级头显上的大量实验验证了方法的准确性和效率,结果显著优于这些基线方法。为促进该方向的进一步研究,我们公开了大规模数据集和代码。
abstract_en: Virtual Reality (VR) bares promise of social interactions that can feel more immersive than other media. Key to this is the ability to accurately animate a personalized photorealistic avatar, and hence the acquisition of the labels for headset-mounted camera (HMC) images need to be efficient and accurate, while wearing a VR headset. This is challenging due to oblique camera views and differences in image modality. In this work, we first show that the domain gap between the avatar and HMC images is one of the primary sources of difficulty, where a transformer-based architecture achieves high accuracy on domain-consistent data, but degrades when the domain-gap is re-introduced. Building on this finding, we propose a system split into two parts: an iterative refinement module that takes in-domain inputs, and a generic avatar-guided image-to-image domain transfer module conditioned on current estimates. These two modules reinforce each other: domain transfer becomes easier when close-to-groundtruth examples are shown, and better domain-gap removal in turn improves the registration. Our system obviates the need for costly offline optimization, and produces online registration of higher quality than direct regression method. We validate the accuracy and efficiency of our approach through extensive experiments on a commodity headset, demonstrating significant improvements over these baselines. To stimulate further research in this direction, we make our large-scale dataset and code publicly available.

title: Chang Liu*, MingXu zhu, Cong Ma
title_en: Chang Liu*, MingXu zhu, Cong Ma
abstract: 车路协同(V2X)技术由于路边基础设施感知数据集的可用性已成为研究热点。然而,这些数据集主要关注城市交叉路口,缺乏高速公路场景的数据。此外,由于多传感器同步数据有限,数据集中的感知任务主要为单目三维(MONO 3D)。为弥补这一不足,我们提出了Highway-V2X(H-V2X),这是首个由真实世界传感器采集的高速公路鸟瞰视角(BEV)感知数据集。该数据集覆盖超过100公里的高速公路,包含多样化的道路和天气条件。H-V2X包含超过190万个细粒度分类的BEV空间样本,由多台同步摄像头采集,并提供矢量地图。我们进行了联合2D-3D标定以确保正确的投影,并通过人工劳动确保数据质量。此外,我们提出了三个与高速公路场景高度相关的任务:BEV检测、BEV跟踪和轨迹预测。我们为每个任务进行了基准测试,并提出了结合矢量地图信息的创新方法。我们希望H-V2X和基准方法能够推动高速公路BEV感知研究方向。数据集可在https://pan.quark.cn/s/86d19da10d18获取
abstract_en: Vehicle-to-everything (V2X) technology has become an area of interest in research due to the availability of roadside infrastructure perception datasets. However, these datasets primarily focus on urban intersections and lack data on highway scenarios. Additionally, the perception tasks in the datasets are mainly MONO 3D due to limited synchronized data across multiple sensors. To bridge this gap, we propose Highway-V2X (H-V2X), the first large-scale highway Bird’s-Eye-View (BEV) perception dataset captured by sensors in the real world. The dataset covers over 100 kilometers of highway, with a diverse range of road and weather conditions. H-V2X consists of over 1.9 million fine-grained categorized samples in BEV space, captured by multiple synchronized cameras, with vector map provided. We performed joint 2D-3D calibrations to ensure correct projection and human labor was involved to ensure data quality. Furthermore, we propose three highly relevant tasks to the highway scenario: BEV detection, BEV tracking, and trajectory prediction. We conducted benchmarks for each task, and innovative methods incorporating vector map information were proposed. We hope that H-V2X and benchmark methods will facilitate highway BEV perception research direction. The dataset is available at https://pan.quark.cn/s/86d19da10d18

title: Chang Liu, Giulia Rizzoli, Pietro Zanuttigh, Fu Li, Yi Niu*
title_en: Chang Liu, Giulia Rizzoli, Pietro Zanuttigh, Fu Li, Yi Niu*
abstract: 当前弱监督增量学习(WILSS)方法在语义分割中仅考虑用图像级标签替代像素级标注,而训练图像仍来自精心设计的数据集。本文我们认为,广泛可用的网络图像也可用于新类别的学习。为此,我们首先引入一种基于傅里叶变换的领域判别器策略,选择在潜在空间中与先前示例相似的网络图像。随后,提出一种有效的基于文本描述的复习策略以保留已学习的类别。据我们所知,这是首个在WILSS中仅依赖网络图像实现新概念学习和已有类别保留的工作。实验结果表明,所提方法在增量步骤中无需使用人工选择和标注的数据即可达到最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Current weakly-supervised incremental learning for semantic segmentation (WILSS) approaches only consider replacing pixel-level annotations with image-level labels, while the training images are still from well-designed datasets. In this work, we argue that widely available web images can also be considered for the learning of new classes. To achieve this, firstly we introduce a strategy to select web images which are similar to previously seen examples in the latent space using a Fourier-based domain discriminator. Then, an effective caption-driven reharsal strategy is proposed to preserve previously learnt classes. To our knowledge, this is the first work to rely solely on web images for both the learning of new concepts and the preservation of the already learned ones in WILSS. Experimental results show that the proposed approach can reach state-of-the-art performances without using manually selected and annotated data in the incremental steps.

title: Changan Chen*, Puyuan Peng, Ami Baid, Zihui Xue, Wei-Ning Hsu, David Harwath, Kristen Grauman
title_en: Changan Chen*, Puyuan Peng, Ami Baid, Zihui Xue, Wei-Ning Hsu, David Harwath, Kristen Grauman
abstract: 为人类动作生成逼真的音频对于许多应用非常重要,例如电影音效制作或虚拟现实游戏。现有方法在训练过程中隐式地假设视频与音频之间存在完全对应关系,但许多声音发生在画面之外,与视觉内容的对应关系较弱甚至没有,导致测试时出现不受控的环境音或幻觉。我们提出了一种新颖的环境感知音频生成模型AV-LDM。我们设计了一种新的音频条件机制,以在野外训练视频中学习分离前景动作声音与环境背景声音。给定一个全新的无声视频,我们的模型通过检索增强生成技术,创建与视觉内容在语义和时间上都匹配的音频。我们在两个野外第一视角视频数据集Ego4D和EPIC-KITCHENS上训练和评估我们的模型,并引入了Ego4D-Sounds——包含120万条动作-音频对应片段的精选数据集。我们的模型优于一系列现有方法,能够可控生成环境音,并且在计算机图形游戏片段上展现出泛化潜力。总体而言,我们的方法是首个在训练时从包含自然背景音的非策划片段中,忠实聚焦于观察到的视觉内容进行视频到音频生成的方案。
abstract_en: Generating realistic audio for human actions is important for many applications, such as creating sound effects for films or virtual reality games. Existing approaches implicitly assume total correspondence between the video and audio during training, yet many sounds happen off-screen and have weak to no correspondence with the visuals—resulting in uncontrolled ambient sounds or hallucinations at test time. We propose a novel ambient-aware audio generation model, AV-LDM. We devise a novel audio-conditioning mechanism to learn to disentangle foreground action sounds from the ambient background sounds in in-the-wild training videos. Given a novel silent video, our model uses retrieval-augmented generation to create audio that matches the visual content both semantically and temporally. We train and evaluate our model on two in-the-wild egocentric video datasets, Ego4D and EPIC-KITCHENS, and we introduce Ego4D-Sounds—1.2M curated clips with action-audio correspondence. Our model outperforms an array of existing methods, allows controllable generation of the ambient sound, and even shows promise for generalizing to computer graphics game clips. Overall, our approach is the first to focus video-to-audio generation faithfully on the observed visual content despite training from uncurated clips with natural background sounds.

title: Changhoon Kim*, Kyle Min*, Yezhou Yang
title_en: Changhoon Kim*, Kyle Min*, Yezhou Yang
abstract: In the evolving landscape of text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models, the remarkable capability to generate high-quality images from textual descriptions faces challenges with the potential misuse of reproducing sensitive content. To address this critical issue, we introduce Robust Adversarial Concept Erase (RACE), a novel approach designed to mitigate these risks by enhancing the robustness of concept erasure method for T2I models. RACE utilizes a sophisticated adversarial training framework to identify and mitigate adversarial text embeddings, significantly reducing the Attack Success Rate (ASR). Impressively, RACE achieves a 30% reduction in ASR for the “nudity” concept against the leading white-box attack method. Our extensive evaluations demonstrate RACE’s effectiveness in defending against both white-box and black-box attacks, marking a significant advancement in protecting T2I diffusion models from generating inappropriate or misleading imagery. This work underlines the essential need for proactive defense measures in adapting to the rapidly advancing field of adversarial challenges. Our code is publicly available: https://github.com/chkimmmmm/R.A.C.E.
abstract_en: In the evolving landscape of text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models, the remarkable capability to generate high-quality images from textual descriptions faces challenges with the potential misuse of reproducing sensitive content. To address this critical issue, we introduce Robust Adversarial Concept Erase (RACE), a novel approach designed to mitigate these risks by enhancing the robustness of concept erasure method for T2I models. RACE utilizes a sophisticated adversarial training framework to identify and mitigate adversarial text embeddings, significantly reducing the Attack Success Rate (ASR). Impressively, RACE achieves a 30% reduction in ASR for the “nudity” concept against the leading white-box attack method. Our extensive evaluations demonstrate RACE’s effectiveness in defending against both white-box and black-box attacks, marking a significant advancement in protecting T2I diffusion models from generating inappropriate or misleading imagery. This work underlines the essential need for proactive defense measures in adapting to the rapidly advancing field of adversarial challenges. Our code is publicly available: https://github.com/chkimmmmm/R.A.C.E.

title: Changming Xu*, Gagandeep Singh
title_en: Changming Xu*, Gagandeep Singh
abstract: Existing work in trustworthy machine learning primarily focuses on single-input adversarial perturbations. In many real-world attack scenarios, input-agnostic adversarial attacks, e.g. universal adversarial perturbations (UAPs), are much more feasible. Current certified training methods train models robust to single-input perturbations but achieve suboptimal clean and UAP accuracy, thereby limiting their applicability in practical applications. We propose a novel method, , for certified training of networks robust against UAP attackers. We show in an extensive evaluation across different datasets, architectures, and perturbation magnitudes that our method outperforms traditional certified training methods on standard accuracy (up to 10.3%) and achieves SOTA performance on the more practical certified UAP accuracy metric.
abstract_en: Existing work in trustworthy machine learning primarily focuses on single-input adversarial perturbations. In many real-world attack scenarios, input-agnostic adversarial attacks, e.g. universal adversarial perturbations (UAPs), are much more feasible. Current certified training methods train models robust to single-input perturbations but achieve suboptimal clean and UAP accuracy, thereby limiting their applicability in practical applications. We propose a novel method, , for certified training of networks robust against UAP attackers. We show in an extensive evaluation across different datasets, architectures, and perturbation magnitudes that our method outperforms traditional certified training methods on standard accuracy (up to 10.3%) and achieves SOTA performance on the more practical certified UAP accuracy metric.

title: Changrui Chen, Kurt Debattista, Jungong Han*
title_en: Changrui Chen, Kurt Debattista, Jungong Han*
abstract: 伪标签算法在各类任务中表现出高度有效性,尤其是在半监督学习领域,但其脆弱性在基准数据集上并不总是显而易见,导致实际应用中的性能欠佳。本文中,我们识别出伪标签方法中某些通道激活现象,称为伪装通道激活(以下简称伪装激活),当训练数据分布不一致时,这些激活会加剧确认偏误问题。即使是最先进的半监督学习模型,在不同分布的数据上也会在某些通道上表现出显著不同的激活水平,这阻碍了伪标签的全部潜力。我们通过分析每个通道激活的组成部分,采取了全新的视角来解决这一问题。具体而言,我们将每个通道的激活建模为两个独立成分的混合。混合比例使我们能够识别伪装激活,从而可以采用我们简单而有效的正则化方法,减弱伪标签与伪装激活之间的相关性。这种缓解降低了伪标签推理的错误风险,从而实现更稳健的优化。该正则化方法在推理阶段不会引入额外的计算成本,并可无缝集成到各种下游任务的伪标签算法中作为插件。我们的实验表明,所提出的方法在包括图像分类、语义分割和目标检测在内的多种视觉任务中,在6个基准数据集上均取得了最先进的结果。
abstract_en: The pseudo-labelling algorithm is highly effective across various tasks, particularly in semi-supervised learning, yet its vulnerabilities are not always apparent on benchmark datasets, leading to suboptimal real-world performance. In this paper, we identified some channel activations in pseudo-labelling methods, termed disguising channel activations (abbreviated as disguising activations in the following sections), which exacerbate the confirmation bias issue when the training data distribution is inconsistent. Even state-of-the-art semi-supervised learning models exhibit significantly different levels of activation on some channels for data in different distributions, impeding the full potential of pseudo labelling. We take a novel perspective to address this issue by analysing the components of each channel’s activation. Specifically, we model the activation of each channel as the mixture of two independent components. The mixture proportion enables us to identify the disguising activations, making it possible to employ our straightforward yet effective regularisation to attenuate the correlation between pseudo labels and disguising activations. This mitigation reduces the error risk of pseudo-label inference, leading to more robust optimization. The regularisation introduces no additional computing costs during the inference phase and can be seamlessly integrated as a plug-in into pseudo-labelling algorithms in various downstream tasks. Our experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art results across 6 benchmark datasets in diverse vision tasks, including image classification, semantic segmentation, and object detection.

title: Changsheng Lu*, Zheyuan Liu, Piotr Koniusz*
title_en: Changsheng Lu*, Zheyuan Liu, Piotr Koniusz*
abstract: 利用基础模型(如CLIP)构建多功能关键点检测器受到越来越多的关注。现有大多数模型接受文本提示(如“猫的鼻子”)或视觉提示(如带有关键点标注的支持图像),以检测查询图像中的对应关键点,从而展现出零样本或少样本检测能力。然而,多模态提示的研究仍处于初步阶段,提示在语义和语言上的多样性尚未充分开发。例如,如何处理新型关键点检测的未见文本提示以及多样化的文本提示如“你能检测猫的鼻子和耳朵吗?”在本工作中,我们从模态、语义(已见/未见)和语言三个方面开放提示的多样性,以实现更通用的零样本和少样本关键点检测(Z-FSKD)。我们提出了一种新颖的OpenKD模型,该模型利用多模态原型集支持视觉和文本提示。进一步地,为了推断未见文本的关键点位置,我们在训练中加入了视觉和文本领域中插值的辅助关键点和文本,这提高了模型的空间推理能力,并显著提升了零样本新型关键点检测性能。我们还发现大型语言模型(LLM)是一种优秀的解析器,在从文本中解析关键点时准确率超过96%。借助LLM,OpenKD能够处理多样化的文本提示。实验结果表明,我们的方法在Z-FSKD任务中达到了最先进的性能,并为处理未见文本和多样化文本开辟了新途径。源代码和数据可在https://github.com/AlanLuSun/OpenKD获取。最近,基于(视觉)提示的关键点检测吸引了社区的研究兴趣,因为它相比传统封闭集关键点检测提供了更通用的检测范式。现有提示包括文本提示、视觉提示或两者的结合。然而,文本提示在语义上的多样性非常有限,仅使用刻板模板,这严重阻碍了实际应用。在本工作中,我们进一步开放提示多样性,从简单的文本提示到困难的未见文本提示,通过迁移大规模预训练模型(如视觉-语言模型CLIP和大型语言模型Vicuna/Llama 2)的知识,推动更通用的关键点检测。具体而言,我们提出了一种新颖的OpenKD模型,该模型包含词汇/文本解析模块、双模态提示机制、用于信号对齐和知识迁移的双对比损失等。为了测试模型有效性,我们为现有关键点检测数据集构建了多样化的文本提示集。我们的模型不仅支持视觉或文本模态提示,还具备推断未见文本提示关键点位置的能力,实现了首个零样本新型关键点检测。实验结果突显了所提出方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Exploiting foundation models (, CLIP) to build a versatile keypoint detector has gained increasing attention. Most existing models accept either the text prompt (, “the nose of a cat”), or the visual prompt (, support image with keypoint annotations), to detect the corresponding keypoints in query image, thereby, exhibiting either zero-shot or few-shot detection ability. However, the research on multimodal prompting is still underexplored, and the prompt diversity in semantics and language is far from opened. For example, how to handle unseen text prompts for novel keypoint detection and the diverse text prompts like “Can you detect the nose and ears of a cat?” In this work, we open the prompt diversity in three aspects: modality, semantics (seen unseen), and language, to enable a more general zero- and few-shot keypoint detection (Z-FSKD). We propose a novel OpenKD model which leverages a multimodal prototype set to support both visual and textual prompting. Further, to infer the keypoint location of unseen texts, we add the auxiliary keypoints and texts interpolated in visual and textual domains into training, which improves the spatial reasoning of our model and significantly enhances zero-shot novel keypoint detection. We also find large language model (LLM) is a good parser, which achieves over 96% accuracy when parsing keypoints from texts. With LLM, OpenKD can handle diverse text prompts. Experimental results show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on Z-FSKD and initiates new ways of dealing with unseen text and diverse texts. The source code and data are available at https://github.com/AlanLuSun/OpenKD. Recently the (visual) prompt based keypoint detection has attracted the research interest in community as it provides more general detection paradigm compared to traditional close-set keypoint detection. Existing prompts include the textual prompt, visual prompt, or the both. However, the diversity of text prompt is quite limited in semantics and only using stereotype templates, which severely hinders the real-world application. In this work, we are further opening the prompt diversity, ranging from the easy text prompt to hard and unseen text prompt, pushing towards a more general keypoint detection by transferring the knowledge of large-scale pre-trained models such as vision-language model CLIP and large-language model Vicuna/Llama 2. Specifically, we propose a novel OpenKD model which consists of lexical/text parsing module, dual-modal prompting mechanism, dual-contrastive loss for signal alignment and knowledge transfer, and others. To test the model efficacy, we construct diverse text prompt sets for existing keypoint detection datasets. Our model not only supports both visual or textual modality prompting, but also has the capability to infer keypoint locations of unseen text prompts, realizing the first zero-shot novel keypoint detection. The experiments highlight the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

title: Changshuo Wang*, Meiqing Wu, Siew-Kei Lam, Xin Ning, Shangshu Yu, Ruiping Wang, Weijun Li, Thambipillai Srikanthan
title_en: Changshuo Wang*, Meiqing Wu, Siew-Kei Lam, Xin Ning, Shangshu Yu, Ruiping Wang, Weijun Li, Thambipillai Srikanthan
abstract: 尽管在点云理解的预训练方法上取得了显著进展,但直接从不规则点云中捕捉复杂的形状信息而不依赖外部数据仍是一个严峻挑战。为解决这一问题,我们提出GPSFormer,一种基于全局感知与局部结构拟合的Transformer模型,能够以高精度从点云中学习详细形状信息。GPSFormer的核心是全局感知模块(GPM)和局部结构拟合卷积(LSFConv)。具体而言,GPM利用自适应可变形图卷积(ADGConv)在特征空间中识别相似特征间的短程依赖关系,并通过多头注意力机制(MHA)学习特征空间内所有位置的长程依赖关系,最终实现上下文表示的灵活学习。受泰勒级数启发,我们设计LSFConv,从显式编码的局部几何结构中学习低阶基础信息和高阶细化信息。通过将GPM和LSFConv作为基础组件集成,我们构建了GPSFormer,一种能够有效捕捉点云全局与局部结构的前沿Transformer模型。大量实验验证了GPSFormer在三个点云任务(形状分类、部件分割和少样本学习)中的有效性。GPSFormer的代码可在https://github.com/changshuowang/GPSFormer获取。
abstract_en: Despite the significant advancements in pre-training methods for point cloud understanding, directly capturing intricate shape information from irregular point clouds without reliance on external data remains a formidable challenge. To address this problem, we propose GPSFormer, an innovative Global Perception and Local Structure Fitting-based Transformer, which learns detailed shape information from point clouds with remarkable precision. The core of GPSFormer is the Global Perception Module (GPM) and the Local Structure Fitting Convolution (LSFConv). Specifically, GPM utilizes Adaptive Deformable Graph Convolution (ADGConv) to identify short-range dependencies among similar features in the feature space and employs Multi-Head Attention (MHA) to learn long-range dependencies across all positions within the feature space, ultimately enabling flexible learning of contextual representations. Inspired by Taylor series, we design LSFConv, which learns both low-order fundamental and high-order refinement information from explicitly encoded local geometric structures. Integrating the GPM and LSFConv as fundamental components, we construct GPSFormer, a cutting-edge Transformer that effectively captures global and local structures of point clouds. Extensive experiments validate GPSFormer’s effectiveness in three point cloud tasks: shape classification, part segmentation, and few-shot learning. The code of GPSFormer is available at https://github.com/changshuowang/ GPSFormer.

title: Lee昌硕*、Kim炯硕、Lee승민、Jung在焕、Cho云哲、Kim泰钟、Jo泰勇、Lee明俊、Jang茂硕*
title_en: Chanseok Lee*, Jeongsol Kim, Seungmin Lee, Jaehwang Jung, Yunje Cho, Taejoong Kim, Taeyong Jo, Myungjun Lee, Mooseok Jang*
abstract: 盲去模糊是一种不适定逆问题,涉及从单张模糊图像中恢复清晰图像和模糊核。当引入未知强度的强噪声时,该问题的挑战性显著增加。现有盲去模糊方法由于过拟合和解空间扰动,对噪声高度敏感。本文提出了一种基于抗噪核估计函数和深度图像先验(DIP)的盲去模糊方法。具体而言,所提出的核估计函数能够在给定清晰图像和最优条件的情况下,有效估计强噪声模糊图像的模糊核。因此,采用DIP生成清晰图像以利用其自然图像先验。此外,设计了多核估计方案以应对未知噪声水平的广泛范围。包括模拟图像和现实世界示例的大量实验研究表明,所提方法在去模糊性能上具有优越性。官方代码已上传至https://github.com/csleemooo/BD_noise_robust_kernel_estimation。
abstract_en: Blind deblurring is an ill-posed inverse problem involving the retrieval of a clear image and blur kernel from a single blurry image. The challenge arises considerably when strong noise, where its level remains unknown, is introduced. Existing blind deblurring methods are highly susceptible to noise due to overfitting and disturbances in the solution space. Here, we propose a blind deblurring method based on a noise-robust kernel estimation function and deep image prior (DIP). Specifically, the proposed kernel estimation function effectively estimates the blur kernel even for strongly noisy blurry images given a clear image and optimal condition. Therefore, DIP is adopted for the generation of a clear image to leverage its natural image prior. Additionally, the multiple kernel estimation scheme is designed to address a wide range of unknown noise levels. Extensive experimental studies, including simulated images and real-world examples, demonstrate the superior deblurring performance of the proposed method. The official code is uploaded in https://github.com/csleemooo/BD_noise_robust_kernel_estimation.

title: Chao Chen, Yu-Shen Liu*, Zhizhong Han
title_en: Chao Chen, Yu-Shen Liu*, Zhizhong Han
abstract: 从单张2D图像中重建未见过类别的3D点云具有挑战性。当前方法通常采用以观察者为中心的坐标系,将已见过类别中学习到的全局先验泛化到未见过类别的3D形状重建中。然而,重建精度和可解释性仍有待提升。为解决这一问题,我们提出学习局部模式模块化方法,用于未见过类别的3D形状重建,实现了良好的泛化能力和高重建精度。我们的核心思想是学习一种类无关且易于泛化的局部先验,在以物体为中心的坐标系中进行表示。具体而言,局部先验通过在已见过类别中学习和定制局部模式模块化过程获得。在此过程中,我们首先在局部区域学习一组模式,这些模式是基于以物体为中心的坐标系,用于表示不同类别形状上的任意区域。随后,我们利用学习到的局部模式对初始重建形状上的每个区域进行模块化处理。在此基础上,我们通过细化重建细节,利用输入图像定制局部模式模块化。我们的方法能够在不依赖大量模式或任何额外信息(如分割监督或相机姿态)的情况下,以物体为中心的坐标系重建高保真度的点云。实验结果表明,在广泛使用的基准测试中,我们的方法在未见过类别的形状重建精度上达到最先进水平。代码已开源至https://github.com/ chenchao15/Unseen。
abstract_en: It is challenging to reconstruct 3D point clouds in unseen classes from single 2D images. Instead of object-centered coordinate system, current methods generalized global priors learned in seen classes to reconstruct 3D shapes from unseen classes in viewer-centered coordinate system. However, the reconstruction accuracy and interpretability are still eager to get improved. To resolve this issue, we introduce to learn local pattern modularization for reconstructing 3D shapes in unseen classes, which achieves both good generalization ability and high reconstruction accuracy. Our insight is to learn a local prior which is class-agnostic and easy to generalize in object-centered coordinate system. Specifically, the local prior is learned via a process of learning and customizing local pattern modularization in seen classes. During this process, we first learn a set of patterns in local regions, which is the basis in the object-centered coordinate system to represent an arbitrary region on shapes across different classes. Then, we modularize each region on an initially reconstructed shape using the learned local patterns. Based on that, we customize the local pattern modularization using the input image by refining the reconstruction with more details. Our method enables to reconstruct high fidelity point clouds from unseen classes in object-centered coordinate system without requiring a large number of patterns or any additional information, such as segmentation supervision or camera poses. Our experimental results under widely used benchmarks show that our method achieves the state-of-the-art reconstruction accuracy for shapes from unseen classes. The code is available at https://github.com/ chenchao15/Unseen.

title: Chao Dai, Yang Wang*, Chaolin Huang, Zhou Jia Kai, Qilin Xu, Minpeng Xu
title_en: Chao Dai, yang wang*, Chaolin Huang, zhou jiakai, Qilin Xu, Minpeng Xu
abstract: 准确检测头影测量标志点对正畸诊断和治疗计划至关重要。现有方法依赖于多个模型的级联结构以实现更高精度,这大大增加了训练和部署过程的复杂性。本文提出了一种新颖的回归范式,能够在高分辨率X光图像中同时检测所有头影测量标志点。我们的方法仅利用Transformer模型的编码器模块设计双编码器架构,从而实现从粗到精的头影测量标志点位置精确检测。具体而言,整个模型架构包含三个主要组件:特征提取模块、参考编码器模块和微调编码器模块。这些组件分别负责X光图像的特征提取与融合、头影测量标志点的粗定位以及标志点定位的微调。值得注意的是,我们的框架是完全端到端可微分的,并能天然地学习利用头影测量标志点之间的相互依赖关系。实验表明,我们的方法在均方根误差(MRE)和2mm成功检测率(SDR)指标上显著超越当前最先进的方法,同时减少了计算资源消耗。代码已开源至https://github.com/huang229/D-CeLR
abstract_en: Accurate detection of cephalometric landmarks is crucial for orthodontic diagnosis and treatment planning. Current methods rely on a cascading form of multiple models to achieve higher accuracy, which greatly complicates both training and deployment processes. In this paper, we introduce a novel regression paradigm capable of simultaneously detecting all cephalometric landmarks in high-resolution X-ray images. Our approach only utilizes the encoder module from the transformer to design a dual-encoder architecture, enabling precise detection of cephalometric landmark positions from coarse to fine. Specifically, the entire model architecture comprises three main components: a feature extractor module, a reference encoder module, and a finetune encoder module. These components are respectively responsible for feature extraction and fusion for X-ray images, coarse localization of cephalometric landmark, and fine-tuning of cephalometric landmark positioning. Notably, our framework is fully end-to-end differentiable and innately learns to exploit the interdependencies among cephalometric landmarks. Experiments demonstrate that our method significantly surpasses the current state-of-the-art methods in Mean Radical Error (MRE) and the 2mm Success Detection Rate (SDR) metrics, while also reducing computational resource consumption. The code is available at https://github.com/huang229/D-CeLR

title: Chao Gong*, Kai Chen, Zhipeng Wei, Jingjing Chen*, Yu-Gang Jiang
title_en: Chao Gong*, Kai Chen, Zhipeng Wei, Jingjing Chen*, Yu-Gang Jiang
abstract: 文本到图像模型面临安全问题,包括与版权和不适宜工作内容(NSFW)相关的担忧。尽管已有多种方法被提出用于从扩散模型中擦除不当概念,但这些方法通常存在擦除不彻底、消耗大量计算资源以及无意中损害生成能力的问题。在本工作中,我们引入了可靠且高效的概念擦除(RECE)方法,该方法无需额外微调即可在3秒内修改模型。具体而言,RECE高效利用闭式解推导新的目标嵌入,这些嵌入能够在未学习的模型中重新生成被擦除的概念。为减少由推导嵌入可能表示的不当内容,RECE进一步在交叉注意力层中将它们与无害概念对齐。新表示嵌入的推导和擦除过程迭代进行,以实现对不当概念的彻底擦除。此外,为保持模型的生成能力,RECE在推导过程中引入额外的正则化项,从而在擦除过程中最小化对无关概念的影响。上述所有过程均采用闭式解,确保仅需3秒即可实现极其高效的擦除。与先前方法相比,我们的方法在对原始生成能力造成轻微损害的情况下实现了更高效且彻底的擦除,并展现出对红队工具更强的鲁棒性。代码可在https://github.com/CharlesGong12/RECE获取。redWARNING: 本文包含可能具有冒犯性的模型输出。
abstract_en: Text-to-image models encounter safety issues, including concerns related to copyright and Not-Safe-For-Work (NSFW) content. Despite several methods have been proposed for erasing inappropriate concepts from diffusion models, they often exhibit incomplete erasure, consume a lot of computing resources, and inadvertently damage generation ability. In this work, we introduce Reliable and Efficient Concept Erasure (RECE), a novel approach that modifies the model in 3 seconds without necessitating additional fine-tuning. Specifically, RECE efficiently leverages a closed-form solution to derive new target embeddings, which are capable of regenerating erased concepts within the unlearned model. To mitigate inappropriate content potentially represented by derived embeddings, RECE further aligns them with harmless concepts in cross-attention layers. The derivation and erasure of new representation embeddings are conducted iteratively to achieve a thorough erasure of inappropriate concepts. Besides, to preserve the model’s generation ability, RECE introduces an additional regularization term during the derivation process, resulting in minimizing the impact on unrelated concepts during the erasure process. All the processes above are in closed-form, guaranteeing extremely efficient erasure in only 3 seconds. Benchmarking against previous approaches, our method achieves more efficient and thorough erasure with minor damage to original generation ability and demonstrates enhanced robustness against red-teaming tools. Code is available at https://github. com/CharlesGong12/RECE. redWARNING: This paper contains model outputs that may be offensive.

title: 黄超*, 德扬·马克维奇*, 许晨良*, 阿历山大·理查德*
title_en: Chao Huang*, Dejan Markovic*, Chenliang Xu*, Alexander Richard*
abstract: 尽管近年来逼真三维人体模型的渲染与动画技术已趋于成熟并达到令人印象深刻的品质,但与全身模型相关空间音频的建模仍被长期忽视。本文提出一种框架,能够实现高质量的空间音频生成,可渲染由人体产生的完整三维声场,包括语音、脚步声、手部与身体的交互声等。基于三维身体姿态和头戴麦克风采集的音频等基础视听表示,我们证明可以在三维空间中的任意位置高效且精确地渲染完整的声学场景。为实现近场和实时声场渲染,我们借鉴图形神经渲染中的体积原语思想,并将其转换至声学领域。我们的声学原语使声场表示规模缩小一个数量级,并克服了先前方法在近场渲染中的不足。项目页面:https: //wikichao.github.io/Acoustic-Primitives/
abstract_en: While rendering and animation of photorealistic 3D human body models have matured and reached an impressive quality over the past years, modeling the spatial audio associated with such full body models has been largely ignored so far. In this work, we present a framework that allows for high-quality spatial audio generation, capable of rendering the full 3D soundfield generated by a human body, including speech, footsteps, hand-body interactions, and others. Given a basic audio-visual representation of the body in form of 3D body pose and audio from a head-mounted microphone, we demonstrate that we can render the full acoustic scene at any point in 3D space efficiently and accurately. To enable near-field and realtime rendering of sound, we borrow the idea of volumetric primitives from graphical neural rendering and transfer them into the acoustic domain. Our acoustic primitives result in an order of magnitude smaller soundfield representations and overcome deficiencies in near-field rendering compared to previous approaches. Our project page: https: //wikichao.github.io/Acoustic-Primitives/.

title: Chao Wang*, Zhedong Zheng, Ruijie Quan, Yi Yang
title_en: Chao Wang*, Zhedong Zheng, Ruijie Quan, Yi Yang
abstract: 本文深入探讨面向现实场景的盲图像分解(BID)方法,旨在从多样且未知的天气组合及强度中统一恢复图像。我们的研究发现,现有BID方法和数据集在受控实验室环境与复杂现实环境之间存在一个固有差距。具体而言,现有方法通常忽略了一个物理特性:恶劣天气随场景深度变化而非均匀深度,这限制了其在现实照片中的效率。为解决这一局限性,我们设计了一个端到端的深度感知盲网络(DeBNet),以显式学习深度感知的透射率图,并进一步预测深度引导的噪声残差,联合生成恢复输出。此外,我们采用神经网络架构搜索,在指定搜索空间内自适应寻找最优架构,考虑多种退化之间显著的形状和结构差异。为验证有效性,我们进一步引入两个新的BID数据集,即BID-CityScapes和BID-GTAV,分别在现实场景和合成户外图像上模拟深度感知退化。在现有及提出的基准数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: In this paper, we delve into Blind Image Decomposition (BID) tailored for real-world scenarios, aiming to uniformly recover images from diverse, unknown weather combinations and intensities. Our investigation uncovers one inherent gap between the controlled lab settings and the complex real-world environments. In particular, existing BID methods and datasets usually overlook the physical property that adverse weather varies with scene depth rather than a uniform depth, thus constraining their efficiency on real-world photos. To address this limitation, we design an end-to-end Depth-aware Blind Network, namely DeBNet, to explicitly learn the depth-aware transmissivity maps, and further predict the depth-guided noise residual to jointly produce the restored output. Moreover, we employ neural architecture search to adaptively find optimal architectures within our specified search space, considering significant shape and structure differences between multiple degradations. To verify the effectiveness, we further introduce two new BID datasets, namely BID-CityScapes and BID-GTAV, which simulate depth-aware degradations on real-world and synthetic outdoor images, respectively. Extensive experiments on both existing and proposed benchmarks show the superiority of our method over state-of-the-art approaches.

title: <中文标题>
title_en: Chao Xu, Ang Li, Linghao Chen, Yulin Liu, Ruoxi Shi, Hao Su*, Minghua Liu*
abstract: <中文摘要>
abstract_en: Open-world 3D generation has recently attracted considerable attention. While many single-image-to-3D methods have yielded visually appealing outcomes, they often lack sufficient controllability and tend to produce hallucinated regions that may not align with users’ expectations. In this paper, we explore an important scenario in which the input consists of one or a few unposed 2D images of a single object, with little or no overlap. We propose a novel method, , to reconstruct a 3D textured mesh and estimate the relative camera poses for these sparse-view images. distills knowledge from 2D diffusion models and finetunes them to implicitly deduce the 3D spatial relationships between the sparse views. The diffusion model is trained to jointly predict surrogate representations for camera poses and multi-view images of the object under known poses, integrating all information from the input sparse views. These predictions are then leveraged to accomplish 3D reconstruction and pose estimation, and the reconstructed 3D model can be used to further refine the camera poses of input views. Through extensive experiments on three datasets, we demonstrate that our method not only significantly outperforms baseline methods in terms of 3D reconstruction quality and pose prediction accuracy but also exhibits strong efficiency. It requires only about 20 seconds to produce a textured mesh and camera poses for the input views.

title: Chaofeng Chen*, Annan Wang, Haoning Wu, Liang Liao, Wenxiu Sun, Qiong Yan, Weisi Lin*
title_en: Chaofeng Chen*, Annan Wang, Haoning Wu, Liang Liao, Wenxiu Sun, Qiong Yan, Weisi Lin*
abstract: 文本到图像的扩散模型通常通过优化对数似然目标进行训练,这在满足下游任务的特定需求(如图像美学和图像-文本对齐)时存在挑战。近期研究通过强化学习或直接反向传播利用人类奖励来优化扩散U-Net,以解决这一问题。然而,许多方法忽略了文本编码器的重要性,该编码器通常在训练过程中保持预训练且固定状态。本文证明,通过强化学习微调文本编码器可以增强结果的文本-图像对齐度,从而提升视觉质量。我们的主要动机源于观察到当前文本编码器存在次优性,通常需要仔细调整提示。虽然微调U-Net可以部分提升性能,但仍然受制于次优的文本编码器。因此,我们提出使用低秩适应的强化学习,基于任务特定奖励对文本编码器进行微调,称为TexForce。我们首先证明微调文本编码器可以提升扩散模型的性能。然后,我们说明TexForce可以简单地与现有的U-Net微调模型结合,无需额外训练即可获得显著更好的结果。最后,我们展示了该方法在多样化应用中的适应性,包括高质量人脸和手部图像的生成。
abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models are typically trained to optimize the log-likelihood objective, which presents challenges in meeting specific requirements for downstream tasks, such as image aesthetics and image-text alignment. Recent research addresses this issue by refining the diffusion U-Net using human rewards through reinforcement learning or direct backpropagation. However, many of them overlook the importance of the text encoder, which is typically pretrained and fixed during training. In this paper, we demonstrate that by finetuning the text encoder through reinforcement learning, we can enhance the text-image alignment of the results, thereby improving the visual quality. Our primary motivation comes from the observation that the current text encoder is suboptimal, often requiring careful prompt adjustment. While fine-tuning the U-Net can partially improve performance, it remains suffering from the suboptimal text encoder. Therefore, we propose to use reinforcement learning with low-rank adaptation to finetune the text encoder based on task-specific rewards, referred as TexForce. We first show that finetuning the text encoder can improve the performance of diffusion models. Then, we illustrate that TexForce can be simply combined with existing U-Net finetuned models to get much better results without additional training. Finally, we showcase the adaptability of our method in diverse applications, including the generation of high-quality face and hand images.

title: 机朝杰*, 李宇峰, 廖毅毅
title_en: Chaojie Ji*, Yufeng Li, Yiyi Liao
abstract: 本工作致力于在各种场景下实现反射表面的实时新视角合成这一具有挑战性的任务。现有的实时渲染方法,尤其是基于网格的方法,在建模具有丰富视角依赖外观的表面时通常表现不佳。我们的核心思想是利用网格进行渲染加速,同时结合一种新的方法来参数化视角依赖信息。我们将颜色分解为漫反射和镜面反射,并基于神经环境图在反射方向上建模镜面颜色。实验表明,与最先进的离线方法相比,我们的方法在高反射表面上实现了相当的重建质量,同时还能高效地在智能手机等边缘设备上实现实时渲染。我们的项目页面位于 https://xdimlab.github.io/REFRAME/。
abstract_en: This work tackles the challenging task of achieving real-time novel view synthesis for reflective surfaces across various scenes. Existing real-time rendering methods, especially those based on meshes, often have subpar performance in modeling surfaces with rich view-dependent appearances. Our key idea lies in leveraging meshes for rendering acceleration while incorporating a novel approach to parameterize view-dependent information. We decompose the color into diffuse and specular, and model the specular color in the reflected direction based on a neural environment map. Our experiments demonstrate that our method achieves comparable reconstruction quality for highly reflective surfaces compared to state-of-the-art offline methods, while also efficiently enabling real-time rendering on edge devices such as smartphones. Our project page is at https://xdimlab.github.io/REFRAME/.

title: Chaoyue Xing*, Wei Mao, Miaomiao Liu
title_en: Chaoyue Xing*, Wei Mao, Miaomiao Liu
abstract: 本文针对场景感知的三维人体运动预测问题展开研究。该任务中的关键挑战在于通过建模人与场景的交互关系,预测与场景一致的未来人体运动。尽管近期研究已表明,对人与场景交互的显式约束可以避免鬼影运动的出现,但这些方法仅对部分人体运动施加约束,例如人体的全局运动或与场景接触的少数关节,其余部分则未受约束。为解决这一局限性,我们提出使用人体与场景之间的互距来表示人与场景的交互。这种互距约束同时限制了局部和全局的人体运动,从而实现全身运动约束的预测。具体而言,互距约束包含两个组成部分:人体网格上每个顶点到场景表面的有符号距离,以及基础场景点到人体网格的距离。我们进一步引入一种从有符号距离函数(SDF)体积中学习得到的全局场景表示,以确保全局场景表示与互距显式约束之间的一致性。我们开发了一个包含两个连续步骤的流程:首先预测未来的互距,随后预测未来的人体运动。我们在训练过程中显式确保预测姿态与互距之间的一致性。在合成数据集和真实数据集上的广泛测试表明,我们的方法在性能上持续超越当前最先进的技术。
abstract_en: In this paper, we address the issue of scene-aware 3D human motion forecasting. A key challenge in this task is to predict future human motions that are coherent with the scene by modeling human-scene interactions. While recent works have demonstrated that explicit constraints on human-scene interactions can prevent the occurrence of ghost motion, they only provide constraints on partial human motion e.g., the global motion of the human or a few joints contacting the scene, leaving the rest of unconstrained. To address this limitation, we propose to represent the human-scene interaction using the mutual distance between the human body and the scene. Such mutual distances constrain both the local and global human motion, resulting in a whole-body motion constrained prediction. In particular, mutual distance constraints consist of two components, the signed distance of each vertex on the human mesh to the scene surface and the distance of basis scene points to the human mesh. We further introduce a global scene representation learned from a signed distance function (SDF) volume to ensure coherence between the global scene representation and the explicit constraint from the mutual distance. We develop a pipeline with two sequential steps: predicting the future mutual distances first, followed by forecasting future human motion. We explicitly ensure consistency between predicted poses and mutual distances during training. Extensive testing on both synthetic and real datasets demonstrates that our method consistently surpasses the performance of current state-of-the-art techniques.

title: Charig Yang* 等
title_en: Charig Yang*, Weidi Xie, Andrew Zisserman
abstract: 我们的目标是发现并定位图像序列中的单调时间变化。为实现这一目标,我们利用了一个简单的代理任务,即对打乱的图像序列进行排序,其中“时间”作为监督信号,因为只有与时间单调变化的特征才能产生正确的排序。我们还引入了一种基于Transformer的模型,用于对任意长度的图像序列进行排序,并内置归因图。训练完成后,该模型能够成功发现并定位单调变化,同时忽略循环和随机变化。我们在多个领域展示了该模型的应用,涵盖不同场景和物体类型,能够发现未见过序列中的物体级和环境变化。我们还证明了基于注意力的归因图可作为有效提示,用于分割变化区域,并且学习到的表示可用于下游应用。最后,我们展示了该模型在图像排序标准基准测试中达到了最先进的水平。
abstract_en: Our objective is to discover and localize monotonic temporal changes in a sequence of images. To achieve this, we exploit a simple proxy task of ordering a shuffled image sequence, with ‘time’ serving as a supervisory signal, since only changes that are monotonic with time can give rise to the correct ordering. We also introduce a transformer-based model for ordering of image sequences of arbitrary length with built-in attribution maps. After training, the model successfully discovers and localizes monotonic changes while ignoring cyclic and stochastic ones. We demonstrate applications of the model in multiple domains covering different scene and object types, discovering both object-level and environmental changes in unseen sequences. We also demonstrate that the attention-based attribution maps function as effective prompts for segmenting the changing regions, and that the learned representations can be used for downstream applications. Finally, we show that the model achieves the state-of-the-art on standard benchmarks for image ordering.

title: 洪彻恩,李炯穆*
title_en: Cheeun Hong, Kyoung Mu Lee*
abstract: 尽管量化已成为降低各种高层视觉任务计算复杂度的有前景的方法,但它不可避免地导致图像超分辨率(SR)网络中的精度损失。这是由于SR网络中不同通道和输入图像的特征分布显著不同,这使得选择固定量化范围变得复杂。现有工作通过在测试时动态调整量化范围以适应变化的分布来解决分布不匹配问题。然而,这种动态适应在推理过程中会带来额外的计算成本。相反,我们提出了一种新的量化感知训练方案,该方案在不需要动态适应的情况下有效克服了SR网络中的分布不匹配问题。直观上,可以通过正则化特征与固定量化范围之间的距离来缓解这种不匹配。然而,我们观察到,这种正则化在训练过程中可能与重建损失的梯度冲突,从而负面影响SR精度。因此,我们选择仅在正则化梯度与重建损失梯度对齐时进行不匹配的正则化。此外,我们引入了一种逐层权重裁剪校正方案,以确定更适合逐层权重的量化范围。实验结果表明,我们的框架有效减少了分布不匹配,并在计算开销最小的情况下实现了最先进的性能。代码可在https://github.com/Cheeun/ODM获取。
abstract_en: Although quantization has emerged as a promising approach to reducing computational complexity across various high-level vision tasks, it inevitably leads to accuracy loss in image super-resolution (SR) networks. This is due to the significantly divergent feature distributions across different channels and input images of the SR networks, which complicates the selection of a fixed quantization range. Existing works address this distribution mismatch problem by dynamically adapting quantization ranges to the varying distributions during test time. However, such a dynamic adaptation incurs additional computational costs during inference. In contrast, we propose a new quantization-aware training scheme that effectively Overcomes the Distribution Mismatch problem in SR networks without the need for dynamic adaptation. Intuitively, this mismatch can be mitigated by regularizing the distance between the feature and a fixed quantization range. However, we observe that such regularization can conflict with the reconstruction loss during training, negatively impacting SR accuracy. Therefore, we opt to regularize the mismatch only when the gradients of the regularization are aligned with those of the reconstruction loss. Additionally, we introduce a layer-wise weight clipping correction scheme to determine a more suitable quantization range for layer-wise weights. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework effectively reduces the distribution mismatch and achieves state-of-the-art performance with minimal computational overhead. Codes are available at https://github.com/Cheeun/ODM.

title: Chen Guo*, Tianjian Jiang, Manuel Kaufmann, Chengwei Zheng, Julien Valentin, Jie Song*, Otmar Hilliges
title_en: Chen Guo*, Tianjian Jiang, Manuel Kaufmann, Chengwei Zheng, Julien Valentin, Jie Song*, Otmar Hilliges
abstract: 尽管近年来单目视频中的人体三维重建取得了显著进展,但最先进的方法中很少能处理在运动过程中表现出大范围非刚性表面变形的宽松衣物。这限制了这些方法的应用场景,仅适用于穿着标准裤子或T恤的人体。我们的方法__TITLE_MATH_1__克服了这一局限,能够从单目野外视频中重建穿着宽松衣物的人体高质量三维模型。为解决该问题,我们首先建立了一种分层神经人体表示,将穿着衣物的人体分解为神经内体和外层衣物。在分层神经表示的基础上,我们进一步引入了一个非层次化虚拟骨骼变形模块,用于衣物层,可自由移动,从而准确恢复非刚性变形的宽松衣物。全局优化通过多层可微体积渲染联合优化人体和衣物的形状、外观及变形。为评估__TITLE_MATH_1__,我们在多视角捕捉工作室中记录了动态变形衣物的受试者。该评估在现有数据集和我们新构建的数据集上均表明__TITLE_MATH_1__在室内数据集和野外视频中均显著优于现有方法。
abstract_en: While previous years have seen great progress in the 3D reconstruction of humans from monocular videos, few of the state-of-the-art methods are able to handle loose garments that exhibit large non-rigid surface deformations during articulation. This limits the application of such methods to humans that are dressed in standard pants or T-shirts. Our method, , overcomes this limitation and reconstructs high-quality 3D models of humans dressed in loose garments from monocular in-the-wild videos. To tackle this problem, we first establish a layered neural human representation that decomposes clothed humans into a neural inner body and outer clothing. On top of the layered neural representation, we further introduce a non-hierarchical virtual bone deformation module for the clothing layer that can freely move, which allows the accurate recovery of non-rigidly deforming loose clothing. A global optimization jointly optimizes the shape, appearance, and deformations of the human body and clothing via multi-layer differentiable volume rendering. To evaluate , we record subjects with dynamically deforming garments in a multi-view capture studio. This evaluation, both on existing and our novel dataset, demonstrates ’s clear superiority over prior art on both indoor datasets and in-the-wild videos.

title: Chen Ju*, Haicheng Wang, Haozhe Cheng, Xu Chen, Zhonghua Zhai, Weilin Huang, Jinsong Lan, Shuai Xiao*, Bo Zheng
title_en: Chen Ju*, Haicheng Wang, Haozhe Cheng, Xu Chen, Zhonghua Zhai, Weilin Huang, Jinsong Lan, Shuai Xiao*, Bo Zheng
abstract: 视觉-语言大模型(VLMs)近期因其卓越的性能成为AI的核心支柱。然而,其高昂的计算成本(如吞吐量和延迟)限制了其在现实场景中的应用潜力。为加速VLMs,现有方法多聚焦于模型层面:剪枝、蒸馏、量化,却完全忽视了数据层面的冗余问题。为弥补这一缺陷,本文首次揭示了数据冗余的严重性,并设计了一个基于信息度的插件式Turbo模块,用于从视觉或文本数据中剪枝低效token。为实现效率与性能的平衡,信息度综合考虑了两个关键因素:互冗余度与语义价值。具体而言,前者评估序列token间的数据重复性;后者通过token对整体语义的贡献度进行评估。因此,信息度高的token具有更低的冗余度和更强的语义性。对于VLMs的计算,Turbo作为用户友好的插件,通过信息度对数据进行排序,仅利用顶层数据即可节省成本。其优势体现在多个方面,例如:兼容各类理解与生成型VLMs、无需重新训练即可简单使用、工程实现成本低廉。在多个VLMs基准测试中,我们通过全面实验验证了Turbo在性能几乎无损失的前提下显著加速的效果。
abstract_en: Vision-Language Large Models (VLMs) recently become primary backbone of AI, due to the impressive performance. However, their expensive computation costs, i.e., throughput and delay, impede potentials in the real-world scenarios. To achieve acceleration for VLMs, most existing methods focus on the model perspective: pruning, distillation, quantization, but completely overlook the data-perspective redundancy. To fill the overlook, this paper pioneers the severity of data redundancy, and designs one plug-and-play Turbo module guided by information degree to prune inefficient tokens from visual or textual data. In pursuit of efficiency-performance trade-offs, information degree takes two crucial factors into consideration: mutual redundancy and semantic value. Concretely, the former evaluates data duplication between sequential tokens; while the latter evaluates each token by its contribution to the overall semantics. As a result, tokens with high information degree carry less redundancy and stronger semantics. For VLMs’ calculation, Turbo works as a user-friendly plug-in that sorts data referring to information degree, utilizing only top-level ones to save costs. Its advantages are multifaceted, e.g., being generally compatible to various VLMs across understanding and generation, simple use without re-training and trivial engineering efforts. On multiple VLMs benchmarks, we fully experiment to demonstrate the good acceleration of Turbo, under negligible performance drop.

title: Chen Rao, Guangyuan Li, Zehua Lan, Jiakai Sun, Junsheng Luan, Wei Xing*, Lei Zhao*, Huaizhong Lin*, Jianfeng Dong, Dalong Zhang
title_en: Chen Rao, Guangyuan Li, Zehua Lan, Jiakai Sun, Junsheng Luan, Wei Xing*, Lei Zhao*, Huaizhong Lin*, Jianfeng Dong, Dalong Zhang
abstract: 当前的视频去模糊方法在恢复高频信息方面存在局限,因为回归损失对高频细节较为保守。由于扩散模型(DMs)在生成高频细节方面具有强大的能力,我们考虑将DMs引入视频去模糊任务。然而,我们发现直接将DMs应用于视频去模糊任务存在以下问题:(1)DMs需要许多迭代步骤从高斯噪声生成视频,这会消耗大量计算资源。(2)DMs容易被视频中的模糊伪影误导,导致去模糊视频出现不合理内容和失真。为了解决上述问题,我们提出了一种新颖的视频去模糊框架VD-Diff,将扩散模型集成到小波感知动态Transformer(WADT)中。具体而言,我们在高度紧凑的潜在空间中执行扩散模型,以生成包含符合真实分布高频信息的先验特征。我们设计WADT以保留并恢复视频中的低频信息,同时利用扩散模型生成的高频信息。大量实验表明,我们提出的VD-Diff在GoPro、DVD、BSD和Real-World Video数据集上优于当前最先进的方法(SOTA)。代码将发布在https://github.com/Chen-Rao/VD-Diff。
abstract_en: Current video deblurring methods have limitations in recovering high-frequency information since the regression losses are conservative with high-frequency details. Since Diffusion Models (DMs) have strong capabilities in generating high-frequency details, we consider introducing DMs into the video deblurring task. However, we found that directly applying DMs to the video deblurring task has the following problems: (1) DMs require many iteration steps to generate videos from Gaussian noise, which consumes many computational resources. (2) DMs are easily misled by the blurry artifacts in the video, resulting in irrational content and distortion of the deblurred video. To address the above issues, we propose a novel video deblurring framework VD-Diff that integrates the diffusion model into the Wavelet-Aware Dynamic Transformer (WADT). Specifically, we perform the diffusion model in a highly compact latent space to generate prior features containing high-frequency information that conforms to the ground truth distribution. We design the WADT to preserve and recover the low-frequency information in the video while utilizing the high-frequency information generated by the diffusion model. Extensive experiments show that our proposed VD-Diff outperforms SOTA methods on GoPro, DVD, BSD, and Real-World Video datasets. The codes will be available at https://github.com/Chen-Rao/VD-Diff.

title: Chen Xu, Tianhui Song, Weixin Feng, Xubin Li, Tiezheng Ge, Bo Zheng, Limin Wang*
title_en: Chen Xu, Tianhui Song, Weixin Feng, Xubin Li, Tiezheng Ge, Bo Zheng, Limin Wang*
abstract: 扩散模型在图像、音频和视频生成任务中显著推动了技术发展。然而,其在实际场景中的应用受到推理速度缓慢的限制。受一致性模型的启发,我们提出了一种子路径线性逼近模型(SPLAM),该模型能够在保持高质量图像生成的同时加速扩散模型。SPLAM将PF-ODE轨迹视为由采样点划分的PF-ODE子路径序列,并利用子路径线性(SL)常微分方程(ODE)在每个PF-ODE子路径上形成渐进且连续的误差估计。对这些SL-ODE的优化使SPLAM能够构建累积逼近误差更小的去噪映射。还开发了一种高效的蒸馏方法,以促进预训练扩散模型(如潜在扩散模型)的集成。大量实验结果表明,SPLAM实现了显著的训练效率,仅需6个A100 GPU天即可生成一个能够进行2至4步生成的高质量生成模型。在LAION、MS COCO 2014和MS COCO 2017数据集上的综合评估也表明,SPLAM在少量步数生成任务中超越了现有加速方法,在FID指标和生成图像质量方面均达到最先进水平。
abstract_en: Diffusion models have significantly advanced the state of the art in image, audio, and video generation tasks. However, their applications in practical scenarios are hindered by slow inference speed. Drawing inspiration from the consistency models, we propose the Sub-Path Linear Approximation Model (SPLAM), which can accelerate diffusion models while maintaining high-quality image generation. SPLAM treats the PF-ODE trajectory as a series of PF-ODE sub-paths divided by sampled points, and harnesses sub-path linear (SL) ODEs to form a progressive and continuous error estimation along each individual PF-ODE sub-path. The optimization on such SL-ODEs allows SPLAM to construct denoising mapping with smaller cumulative approximated error. An efficient distillation method is also developed to facilitate the incorporation of pre-trained diffusion models, such as latent diffusion models. The extensive experimental results demonstrate SPLAM achieves remarkable training efficiency, requiring only 6 A100 GPU days to produce a high-quality generative model capable of 2 to 4-step generation. Comprehensive evaluations on LAION, MS COCO 2014, and MS COCO 2017 datasets also illustrate that SPLAM surpasses the existing acceleration methods in few-step generation tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance both on FID and the quality of the generated images.

title: Chen-Chen Zong, Ye-Wen Wang, Kun-Peng Ning, Hai-Bo Ye, Sheng-Jun Huang*
title_en: Chen-Chen Zong, Ye-Wen Wang, Kun-Peng Ning, Hai-Bo Ye, Sheng-Jun Huang*
abstract: 在开放集场景中,主动学习(AL)提出了一个新颖的挑战,即在包含已知类和未知类数据的未标记数据池中识别最有价值的示例。传统方法优先选择低置信度的具有信息量的示例,存在误选低置信度未知类示例的风险。近期方法倾向于选择最可能属于已知类的示例,存在选择简单已掌握示例的风险。本文尝试查询既可能来自已知类又高度信息量的示例,并提出双向不确定性主动学习(BUAL)框架。具体而言,我们首先通过将未知类示例推向高置信度预测区域(即提出的随机标签负向学习方法)实现这一目标。随后,我们通过联合估计正负学习带来的不确定性,提出双向不确定性采样策略以进行一致且稳定的采样。BUAL成功将现有基于不确定性的AL方法扩展到复杂的开放集场景。在多个开放程度各异的数据集上的大量实验表明,BUAL取得了最先进的性能。代码可在该链接获取。
abstract_en: Active learning (AL) in open set scenarios presents a novel challenge of identifying the most valuable examples in an unlabeled data pool that comprises data from both known and unknown classes. Traditional methods prioritize selecting informative examples with low confidence, with the risk of mistakenly selecting unknown-class examples with similarly low confidence. Recent methods favor the most probable known-class examples, with the risk of picking simple already mastered examples. In this paper, we attempt to query examples that are both likely from known classes and highly informative, and propose a Bidirectional Uncertainty-based Active Learning (BUAL) framework. Specifically, we achieve this by first pushing the unknown class examples toward regions with high-confidence predictions, i.e., the proposed Random Label Negative Learning method. Then, we propose a Bidirectional Uncertainty sampling strategy by jointly estimating uncertainty posed by both positive and negative learning to perform consistent and stable sampling. BUAL successfully extends existing uncertainty-based AL methods to complex open-set scenarios. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets with varying openness demonstrate that BUAL achieves state-of-the-art performance. The code is available at this link.

title: Chen-Wei Xie*, Siyang Sun, Liming Zhao, Pandeng Li, Shuailei Ma, Yun Zheng
title_en: Chen-Wei Xie*, Siyang Sun, Liming Zhao, Pandeng Li, Shuailei Ma, Yun Zheng
abstract: 近年来,利用图像-文本数据集学习视觉表示引起了广泛关注。现有方法主要依赖跨模态监督,并在必要时引入同模态监督。它们忽视了模态融合监督的潜在优势。由于模态融合表示通过文本信息增强了图像表示,我们推测其更具判别性,可能成为视觉表示学习的强大教师。本文通过实验验证了这一假设,并提出了一种基于模态融合监督学习视觉表示的新方法。具体而言,我们引入了一个融合编码器,将图像和文本编码为融合表示。该表示可通过两种蒸馏方式监督视觉表示学习:(i) 分类蒸馏:利用融合表示将图像-文本对聚类为K个簇,并为每个对分配软簇分配,作为伪分类标签以监督图像编码器;(ii) 检索蒸馏:计算融合表示与同一批次中所有文本表示的相似度。通过将相似度分布作为对应图像与所有文本之间的伪检索相似度,可防止一对一对比学习将相关但未配对的对分离。该方法兼容现有的语言监督视觉表示学习方法。实验结果表明,该方法能够带来显著提升,并在多个数据集上达到最先进水平。代码、数据集和预训练模型可在https://github.com/Eniac-Xie/FuseTeacher获取。
abstract_en: Learning visual representation with image-text datasets attracts a lot of attention in recent years. Existing approaches primarily rely on cross-modality supervision, and incorporate intra-modality supervision if necessary. They overlook the potential benefits of modality-fused supervision. Since modality-fused representation augments the image representation with textual information, we conjecture it is more discriminative and potential to be a strong teacher for visual representation learning. In this paper, we validate this hypothesis by experiments and propose a novel method that learns visual representation by modality-fused supervision. Specifically, we introduce a fusion encoder that encodes image and text into a fusion representation. This representation can be utilized to supervise the visual representation learning in two distillation ways: (i) Classification Distillation: we cluster image-text pairs into K clusters using the fusion representation and assign each pair a soft cluster assignment, which is served as a pseudo classification label for supervising the image encoder. (ii) Retrieval Distillation: we calculate the similarities between the fusion representation and all text representations in the same batch. By using the similarity distribution as pseudo retrieval similarity between the corresponding image and all texts, we can prevent one-to-one contrastive learning from separating relevant but unpaired pairs. The is compatible with existing language supervised visual representation learning methods. Experimental results demonstrate that it is able to bring significant improvements and achieves state-of-the-art methods on various datasets. Code, datasets and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/Eniac-Xie/FuseTeacher.

title: Chen-Yi Lu*, Shubham Agarwal, Md Mehrab Tanjim, Kanak Mahadik, Anup Rao, Subrata Mitra, Shiv K Saini, Saurabh Bagchi, Somali Chaterji
title_en: Chen-Yi Lu*, Shubham Agarwal, Md Mehrab Tanjim, Kanak Mahadik, Anup Rao, Subrata Mitra, Shiv K Saini, Saurabh Bagchi, Somali Chaterji
abstract: 文本到图像扩散模型在生成逼真图像方面表现出色,但存在处理时间慢的问题。为解决这一问题,已引入无需训练的基于检索的加速方法,该方法利用预先生成的“轨迹”来提升性能。然而,这些方法往往缺乏多样性与保真度,因其高度依赖于与存储提示的相似性。为解决这一问题,我们提出(Retrieving Concepts),一种创新的基于检索的扩散加速方法,该方法从提示中提取视觉“概念”,构建知识库以生成可适应的轨迹。因此, surpasses现有基于检索的方法,生成高保真图像,并将所需的神经函数评估(NFEs)减少高达40%。在MS-COCO、Pick-a-pick和DiffusionDB数据集上的广泛测试表明,该方法在多个指标(如Pick Score、CLIP Score和Aesthetics Score)上均优于现有方法。用户研究进一步表明,由该方法生成的76%的图像被评为最高保真度,优于两种竞争方法:纯文本检索和基于噪声相似性的检索。项目网址:https://stevencylu.github.io/ReCon.
abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models excel in generating photo-realistic images but are hampered by slow processing times. Training-free retrieval-based acceleration methods, which leverage pre-generated “trajectories,” have been introduced to address this. Yet, these methods often lack diversity and fidelity as they depend heavily on similarities to stored prompts. To address this, we present (Retrieving Concepts), an innovative retrieval-based diffusion acceleration method that extracts visual “concepts” from prompts, forming a knowledge base that facilitates the creation of adaptable trajectories. Consequently, surpasses existing retrieval-based methods, producing high-fidelity images and reducing required Neural Function Evaluations (NFEs) by up to 40%. Extensive testing on MS-COCO, Pick-a-pick, and DiffusionDB datasets confirms that consistently outperforms established methods across multiple metrics such as Pick Score, CLIP Score, and Aesthetics Score. A user study further indicates that 76% of images generated by are rated as the highest fidelity, outperforming two competing methods, a purely text-based retrieval and a noise similarity-based retrieval. Project URL: https://stevencylu.github.io/ReCon.

title: ChenHan Jiang*, Yihan Zeng, Tianyang Hu, Songcen Xu, Wei Zhang, Hang Xu, Dit-Yan Yeung
title_en: ChenHan Jiang*, Yihan Zeng, Tianyang Hu, Songcen Xu, Wei Zhang, Hang Xu, Dit-Yan Yeung
abstract: 基于良好训练的2D扩散模型的分数蒸馏采样(SDS)在文本到3D生成中展现出巨大潜力。然而,该范式将视图无关的2D图像分布蒸馏到3D表示每个视图的渲染分布中,忽视了视图间的连贯性,导致生成结果出现3D不一致性。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新的范式——联合分数蒸馏(JSD),以确保连贯的3D生成。具体而言,我们建模联合图像分布,引入能量函数以捕捉扩散模型中去噪图像间的连贯性。随后,我们推导出针对3D表示多个渲染视图的联合分数蒸馏,而非SDS中的单个视图。此外,我们实例化了三种通用的视图感知模型作为能量函数,证明其与JSD的兼容性。实验表明,JSD显著缓解了SDS中的3D不一致性问题,同时保持文本一致性。此外,我们引入了几何消退方案和分类器自由引导(CFG)切换策略以增强生成细节。我们的框架JointDreamer在文本到3D生成中建立了新基准,取得了88.5%的CLIP R-精度和27.7%的CLIP分数的优异结果。这些指标表明了卓越的文本一致性,以及显著的几何一致性和纹理保真度。
abstract_en: Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) by well-trained 2D diffusion models has shown great promise in text-to-3D generation. However, this paradigm distills view-agnostic 2D image distributions into the rendering distribution of 3D representation for each view independently, overlooking the coherence across views and yielding 3D inconsistency in generations. In this work, we propose Joint Score Distillation (JSD), a new paradigm that ensures coherent 3D generations. Specifically, we model the joint image distribution, which introduces an energy function to capture the coherence among denoised images from the diffusion model. We then derive the joint score distillation on multiple rendered views of the 3D representation, as opposed to a single view in SDS. In addition, we instantiate three universal view-aware models as energy functions, demonstrating compatibility with JSD. Empirically, JSD significantly mitigates the 3D inconsistency problem in SDS, while maintaining text congruence. Moreover, we introduce the Geometry Fading scheme and Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) Switching strategy to enhance generative details. Our framework, JointDreamer, establishes a new benchmark in text-to-3D generation, achieving outstanding results with an 88.5% CLIP R-Precision and 27.7% CLIP Score. These metrics demonstrate exceptional text congruence, as well as remarkable geometric consistency and texture fidelity.

title: 成功,姚晨*,邱阳罗,乐叶,李涛,张宇智,孙宇飞*,张乐
title_en: Cheng Gong, Yao Chen*, Qiuyang Luo, Ye Lu, Tao Li, Yuzhi Zhang, Yufei Sun*, Le Zhang
abstract: 多出口网络通过共享主干网络和权重在多个出口间进行高效模型推理,是一种有前景的架构。然而,共享权重的梯度冲突导致了次优的准确率。本文引入了深度特征手术(Deep Feature Surgery, DFS),该方法包含特征分割和特征引用两种策略,以解决多出口网络训练过程中的梯度冲突问题。特征分割沿深度轴将共享特征在所有出口间进行分割,以缓解梯度冲突,同时促进每个出口的联合优化。随后,特征引用通过增强不同深度下各出口的多尺度特征,提升模型准确率。此外,DFS通过降低反向传播的复杂度减少了训练操作。在Cifar100和ImageNet数据集上的实验结果表明,DFS在多种模型和任务中相比基线方法,训练时间最多可减少50.00%,准确率最高提升6.94%。在MSDNet上的预算批量分类评估显示,DFS在Cifar100上实现与基线方法相同分类准确率时,每张图像平均FLOPs消耗仅为基线方法的2倍。代码已开源至https: //github.com/GongCheng1919/dfs。
abstract_en: Multi-exit network is a promising architecture for efficient model inference by sharing backbone networks and weights among multiple exits. However, the gradient conflict of the shared weights results in sub-optimal accuracy. This paper introduces Deep Feature Surgery (), which consists of feature partitioning and feature referencing approaches to resolve gradient conflict issues during the training of multi-exit networks. The feature partitioning separates shared features along the depth axis among all exits to alleviate gradient conflict while simultaneously promoting joint optimization for each exit. Subsequently, feature referencing enhances multi-scale features for distinct exits across varying depths to improve the model accuracy. Furthermore, reduces the training operations with the reduced complexity of backpropagation. Experimental results on Cifar100 and ImageNet datasets exhibit that provides up to a 50.00% reduction in training time and attains up to a 6.94% enhancement in accuracy when contrasted with baseline methods across diverse models and tasks. Budgeted batch classification evaluation on MSDNet demonstrates that DFS uses about 2× fewer average FLOPs per image to achieve the same classification accuracy as baseline methods on Cifar100. The code is available at https: //github.com/GongCheng1919/dfs.

title: Cheng Han, Qifan Wang, Sohail A Dianat, Majid Rabbani, Raghuveer Rao, Yi Fang, Qiang Guan, Lifu Huang, Dongfang Liu*
title_en: Cheng Han, Qifan Wang, Sohail A Dianat, Majid Rabbani, Raghuveer Rao, Yi Fang, Qiang Guan, Lifu Huang, Dongfang Liu*
abstract: 基于Transformer的架构因其卓越的性能,已成为各种视觉任务的事实上的标准模型。随着这些基于Transformer的模型规模的不断扩大,模型蒸馏在现实部署中变得尤为重要,尤其是在计算资源受限的设备上。然而,现有的知识蒸馏方法在教师与学生之间存在较大容量差距(例如10倍压缩率)时,效果会显著下降。在本文中,我们提出了一种名为自动多步蒸馏(AMD)的新方法,用于大规模视觉模型压缩。具体而言,我们的蒸馏过程分为多个步骤。首先,教师模型经过蒸馏形成一个中间教师辅助模型,随后该中间模型进一步蒸馏到学生模型中。我们引入了一个高效且有效的优化框架,以自动识别能够实现学生模型最大性能的最优教师辅助模型。我们在多个图像分类数据集(包括CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet)上进行了大量实验。结果一致表明,AMD优于多个现有基线方法,为未来大规模视觉模型的知识蒸馏方法提供了新的方向。
abstract_en: Transformer-based architectures have become the de-facto standard models for diverse vision tasks owing to their superior performance. As the size of these transformer-based models continues to scale up, model distillation becomes extremely important in real-world deployments, particularly on devices limited by computational resources. However, prevailing knowledge distillation methods exhibit diminished efficacy when confronted with a large capacity gap between the teacher and the student, e.g, 10× compression rate. In this paper, we present a novel approach named Automatic Multi-step Distillation (AMD) for large-scale vision model compression. In particular, our distillation process unfolds across multiple steps. Initially, the teacher undergoes distillation to form an intermediate teacher-assistant model, which is subsequently distilled further to the student. An efficient and effective optimization framework is introduced to automatically identify the optimal teacher-assistant that leads to the maximal student performance. We conduct extensive experiments on multiple image classification datasets, including CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet. The findings consistently reveal that AMD outperforms several established baselines, paving a path for future knowledge distillation methods on large-scale vision models.

title: Cheng Peng*, Yutao Tang, Yifan Zhou, Nengyu Wang, Xijun Liu, Deming Li, Rama Chellappa
title_en: Cheng Peng*, Yutao Tang, Yifan Zhou, Nengyu Wang, Xijun Liu, Deming Li, Rama Chellappa
abstract: 近期基于3D高斯点云的场景重建与新视角合成方法在精心策划的基准测试中取得了令人印象深刻的结果;然而,现实生活中拍摄的图像往往存在模糊问题。在本工作中,我们分析了基于高斯点云的方法对多种图像模糊(如运动模糊、失焦模糊、下采样模糊等)的鲁棒性。在这些退化条件下,基于高斯点云的方法容易过拟合,生成效果劣于基于神经辐射场的方法。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种与模糊无关的高斯点云方法(Blur Agnostic Gaussian Splatting, BAGS)。BAGS引入了额外的2D建模能力,使得即使在图像级模糊的情况下,也能重建出3D一致且高质量的场景。具体而言,我们通过从模糊提案网络(Blur Proposal Network, BPN)中估计每个像素的卷积核来建模模糊。BPN设计用于考虑场景的空间、颜色和深度变化,以最大化建模能力。此外,BPN还提出一个质量评估掩码,指示模糊发生区域。最后,我们引入了一种由粗到精的核优化方案;该优化方案快速且避免了由于稀疏点云初始化(通常在对模糊图像应用运动结构恢复时出现)导致的次优解。我们证明BAGS在各种具有挑战性的模糊条件和成像几何下实现了逼真的图像渲染,同时显著优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Recent efforts in using 3D Gaussians for scene reconstruction and novel view synthesis can achieve impressive results on curated benchmarks; however, images captured in real life are often blurry. In this work, we analyze the robustness of Gaussian-Splatting-based methods against various image blur, such as motion blur, defocus blur, downscaling blur, . Under these degradations, Gaussian-Splatting-based methods tend to overfit and produce worse results than Neural-Radiance-Field-based methods. To address this issue, we propose Blur Agnostic Gaussian Splatting (BAGS). BAGS introduces additional 2D modeling capacities such that a 3D-consistent and high quality scene can be reconstructed despite image-wise blur. Specifically, we model blur by estimating per-pixel convolution kernels from a Blur Proposal Network (BPN). BPN is designed to consider spatial, color, and depth variations of the scene to maximize modeling capacity. Additionally, BPN also proposes a quality-assessing mask, which indicates regions where blur occur. Finally, we introduce a coarse-to-fine kernel optimization scheme; this optimization scheme is fast and avoids sub-optimal solutions due to a sparse point cloud initialization, which often occurs when we apply Structure-from-Motion on blurry images. We demonstrate that BAGS achieves photorealistic renderings under various challenging blur conditions and imaging geometry, while significantly improving upon existing approaches.

title: Cheng Shi, Yuchen Zhu, Sibei Yang*
title_en: Cheng Shi, Yuchen Zhu, Sibei Yang*
abstract: 近年来,大规模基础模型的进展引发了对训练高度熟练的大规模视觉模型的广泛关注。一个普遍的共识围绕着汇集大量高质量标注数据的必要性。然而,鉴于计算机视觉中密集任务(如目标检测和分割)的标注固有挑战,一种实际的策略是结合并利用所有可用数据进行训练。在本工作中,我们提出了Plain-Det,它提供了灵活性以适应新数据集,性能在多样化数据集上具有鲁棒性,训练效率高,并且与各种检测架构兼容。我们利用Def-DETR,在Plain-Det的帮助下,在COCO上实现了51.9的mAP,与当前最先进的检测器相当。我们在13个下游数据集上进行了广泛实验,Plain-Det展示了强大的泛化能力。代码已发布在https://github.com/ChengShiest/Plain-Det.
abstract_en: Recent advancements in large-scale foundational models have sparked widespread interest in training highly proficient large vision models. A common consensus revolves around the necessity of aggregating extensive, high-quality annotated data. However, given the inherent challenges in annotating dense tasks in computer vision, such as object detection and segmentation, a practical strategy is to combine and leverage all available data for training purposes. In this work, we propose Plain-Det, which offers flexibility to accommodate new datasets, robustness in performance across diverse datasets, training efficiency, and compatibility with various detection architectures. We utilize Def-DETR, with the assistance of Plain-Det, to achieve a mAP of 51.9 on COCO, matching the current state-of-the-art detectors. We conduct extensive experiments on 13 downstream datasets and Plain-Det demonstrates strong generalization capability. Code is release at https://github.com/ChengShiest/Plain-Det.

title: Cheng Shi, Yulin Zhang, Bin Yang, Jiajin Tang, Yuexin Ma, Sibei Yang*
title_en: Cheng Shi, Yulin Zhang, Bin Yang, Jiajin Tang, Yuexin Ma, Sibei Yang*
abstract: 无监督三维实例分割旨在无需任何标注的情况下,从三维点云中分割物体。现有方法面临聚类过于松散或过于紧密的挑战,导致欠分割或过分割。为解决这一问题,我们提出Part2Object,一种具有物体引导的分层聚类方法。Part2Object从点到物体部件再到物体进行多层聚类,使物体可在任意层级显现。此外,它从时间连续的2D RGB帧中提取并利用3D物体性先验,以指导聚类过程。同时,我们提出Hi-Mask3D以支持分层的三维物体部件和实例分割。通过在Part2Object提取的物体和物体部件上训练Hi-Mask3D,我们在多种设置中实现了与最先进模型相比一致且更优的性能,包括无监督实例分割、数据高效微调和跨数据集泛化。代码已发布于https://github.com/ChengShiest/Part2Object。
abstract_en: Unsupervised 3D instance segmentation aims to segment objects from a 3D point cloud without any annotations. Existing methods face the challenge of either too loose or too tight clustering, leading to under-segmentation or over-segmentation. To address this issue, we propose Part2Object, hierarchical clustering with object guidance. Part2Object employs multi-layer clustering from points to object parts and objects, allowing objects to manifest at any layer. Additionally, it extracts and utilizes 3D objectness priors from temporally consecutive 2D RGB frames to guide the clustering process. Moreover, we propose Hi-Mask3D to support hierarchical 3D object part and instance segmentation. By training Hi-Mask3D on the objects and object parts extracted from Part2Object, we achieve consistent and superior performance compared to state-of-the-art models in various settings, including unsupervised instance segmentation, data-efficient fine-tuning, and cross-dataset generalization. Code is release at https://github. com/ChengShiest/Part2Object.

title: Cheng Tan*, Jingxuan Wei*, Zhangyang Gao, Linzhuang Sun, Siyuan Li, Ruifeng Guo, BiHui Yu, Stan Z. Li*
title_en: Cheng Tan*, Jingxuan Wei*, Zhangyang Gao, Linzhuang Sun, Siyuan Li, Ruifeng Guo, BiHui Yu, Stan Z. Li*
abstract: 多模态推理是一项具有挑战性的任务,要求模型在多个模态间进行推理以回答问题。现有方法通过将语言和视觉模态纳入两阶段推理框架,将推理过程与答案推断分离,取得了一定进展。然而,这些方法往往因生成的推理过程质量不足而效果有限。在本工作中,我们深入探讨了推理过程在模型推理中的重要性。我们观察到,当推理过程完全准确时,模型的准确率显著提升,这凸显了高质量推理过程生成的必要性。受此启发,我们提出MC-CoT,一种自洽性训练策略,通过生成多个推理过程和答案,随后通过投票机制选择最准确的结果。该方法不仅提升了生成推理过程的质量,还使答案更加准确且鲁棒。通过大量实验,我们证明了我们的方法在各类基准测试中显著提升了模型性能。值得注意的是,我们展示了即使较小的基础模型,当配备我们的方法后,也能达到与大模型相当的性能,这体现了我们的方法在利用推理过程提升多模态推理能力方面的潜力。代码已开源在github.com/chengtan9907/mc-cot。
abstract_en: Multimodal reasoning is a challenging task that requires models to reason across multiple modalities to answer questions. Existing approaches have made progress by incorporating language and visual modalities into a two-stage reasoning framework, separating rationale generation from answer inference. However, these approaches often fall short due to the inadequate quality of the generated rationales. In this work, we delve into the importance of rationales in model reasoning.
