abstract: 现代虚拟形象生成器允许任何人合成逼真实时对话的虚拟形象,开启了基于虚拟形象的人类交流新纪元,例如沉浸式AR/VR互动或带宽受限的视频会议。其安全采用需要一种机制验证生成的虚拟形象是否可信:是否未经同意使用个人外貌?我们将此任务称为虚拟形象指纹识别。为解决该问题,我们首先引入了一个大规模的真实与合成视频数据集,记录人们在视频通话中的互动,其中合成视频通过一个人的面部外观和另一个人的表情生成。我们通过学习与面部外观无关的运动特征来验证合成视频中驱动表情的身份。本方案是该领域首个解决方案,平均AUC达到0.85。对其实际应用至关重要的泛化能力也得到验证,可推广至训练中未见过的新生成器(平均AUC为0.83)。相关数据集及其他资源可访问:https: //research.nvidia.com/labs/nxp/avatar-fingerprinting/.
abstract_en: Modern avatar generators allow anyone to synthesize photorealistic real-time talking avatars, ushering in a new era of avatar-based human communication, such as with immersive AR/VR interactions or videoconferencing with limited bandwidths. Their safe adoption, however, requires a mechanism to verify if the rendered avatar is trustworthy: does it use the appearance of an individual without their consent? We term this task avatar fingerprinting. To tackle it, we first introduce a large-scale dataset of real and synthetic videos of people interacting on a video call, where the synthetic videos are generated using the facial appearance of one person and the expressions of another. We verify the identity driving the expressions in a synthetic video, by learning motion signatures that are independent of the facial appearance shown. Our solution, the first in this space, achieves an average AUC of 0.85. Critical to its practical use, it also generalizes to new generators never seen in training (average AUC of 0.83). The proposed dataset and other resources can be found at: https: //research.nvidia.com/labs/nxp/avatar-fingerprinting/.

title: Elad Hirsch*, Gefen Dawidowicz, Ayellet Tal
title_en: Elad Hirsch*, Gefen Dawidowicz, Ayellet Tal
abstract: 从X光图像生成医疗报告是一项具有挑战性的任务,尤其是在非配对设置下,缺乏配对的图像-报告数据进行训练。为解决这一挑战,我们提出了一种新颖的模型,利用两个独立数据集中可用的信息:一个包含报告,另一个包含图像。我们的模型核心思想是通过结合自编码报告生成与多模态(报告-图像)对齐,提供解决方案。然而,当缺乏配对对应关系时,如何实现这种对齐仍是一个挑战。我们的解决方案采用辅助任务,特别是对比学习和分类,以将相关图像和报告置于相近位置。这种方法不同于以往依赖预处理步骤(如利用知识图谱中存储的外部信息)的方法。我们的模型MedRAT超越了先前的最先进方法,证明了无需配对数据或外部工具即可生成全面医疗报告的可行性。我们的代码已公开 1 。1 https://github.com/eladhi/MedRAT
abstract_en: Medical report generation from X-ray images is a challenging task, particularly in an unpaired setting where paired image-report data is unavailable for training. To address this challenge, we propose a novel model that leverages the available information in two distinct datasets, one comprising reports and the other consisting of images. The core idea of our model revolves around the notion that combining auto-encoding report generation with multi-modal (report-image) alignment can offer a solution. However, the challenge persists regarding how to achieve this alignment when pair correspondence is absent. Our proposed solution involves the use of auxiliary tasks, particularly contrastive learning and classification, to position related images and reports in close proximity to each other. This approach differs from previous methods that rely on pre-processing steps, such as using external information stored in a knowledge graph. Our model, named MedRAT, surpasses previous state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating the feasibility of generating comprehensive medical reports without the need for paired data or external tools. Our code is publicly available 1 . 1 https://github.com/eladhi/MedRAT

title: Elona Dupont*, Kseniya Cherenkova, Dimitrios Mallis, Gleb A Gusev, Anis Kacem, Djamila Aouada
title_en: Elona Dupont*, Kseniya Cherenkova, Dimitrios Mallis, Gleb A Gusev, Anis Kacem, Djamila Aouada
abstract: 三维反向工程是一种研究方向,通过给定物理对象的三维扫描数据推断出CAD模型,具有许多具有前景的实际应用。本文提出__TITLE_MATH_1__,这是一种端到端的基于Transformer的架构,可从点云预测CAD序列。__TITLE_MATH_1__通过采用分层学习策略来利用CAD序列的结构。还引入了一个循环细化器以回归草图基本元素参数。在DeepCAD [?] 和Fusion360 [?] 数据集上的严格实验表明,__TITLE_MATH_1__取得了最先进的结果。结果分析采用了一种针对CAD序列的提出的度量标准——CAD序列平均精度(Mean Average Precision of CAD Sequence),该度量标准解决了现有度量标准的局限性。
abstract_en: 3D reverse engineering, in which a CAD model is inferred given a 3D scan of a physical object, is a research direction that offers many promising practical applications. This paper proposes , an end-to-end transformer-based architecture that predicts the CAD sequence from a point cloud. leverages the structure of CAD sequences by using a hierarchical learning strategy. A loop refiner is also introduced to regress sketch primitive parameters. Rigorous experimentation on the DeepCAD [?] and Fusion360 [?] datasets show that achieves state-of-the-art results. The result analysis is supported with a proposed metric for CAD sequence, the mean Average Precision of CAD Sequence, that addresses the limitations of existing metrics.

title: Emanuel Sanchez Aimar*, Nathaniel D Helgesen, Yonghao Xu, Marco Kuhlmann, Michael Felsberg
title_en: Emanuel Sanchez Aimar*, Nathaniel D Helgesen, Yonghao Xu, Marco Kuhlmann, Michael Felsberg
abstract: 长尾半监督学习(LTSSL)代表了半监督应用的实用场景,其挑战在于有偏的标签分布会误导分类器。这一问题通常因有标签和无标签类别分布之间的差异而加剧,导致伪标签偏差、稀有类别被忽视以及概率校准不良。为解决这些问题,我们引入了灵活分布对齐(FlexDA),这是一种新颖的自适应对数调整损失框架,旨在动态估计并使预测与无标签数据的实际分布对齐,最终实现平衡的分类器。FlexDA进一步通过基于蒸馏的一致性损失得到增强,促进各类别间公平的数据使用,并有效利用低置信度样本。该方法封装于ADELLO(Align and Distill Everything All at Once)中,证明了其对标签偏移的鲁棒性,在LTSSL场景中显著提升了模型校准效果,并在多个基准测试(包括CIFAR100-LT、STL10-LT和ImageNet127)中超越了先前最先进的方法,解决了半监督学习中的类别不平衡挑战。我们的代码可在https://github.com/emasa/ADELLO-LTSSL获取。
abstract_en: Long-tailed semi-supervised learning (LTSSL) represents a practical scenario for semi-supervised applications, challenged by skewed labeled distributions that bias classifiers. This problem is often aggravated by discrepancies between labeled and unlabeled class distributions, leading to biased pseudo-labels, neglect of rare classes, and poorly calibrated probabilities. To address these issues, we introduce Flexible Distribution Alignment (FlexDA), a novel adaptive logit-adjusted loss framework designed to dynamically estimate and align predictions with the actual distribution of unlabeled data and achieve a balanced classifier by the end of training. FlexDA is further enhanced by a distillation-based consistency loss, promoting fair data usage across classes and effectively leveraging underconfident samples. This method, encapsulated in ADELLO (Align and Distill Everything All at Once), proves robust against label shift, significantly improves model calibration in LTSSL contexts, and surpasses previous state-of-of-art approaches across multiple benchmarks, including CIFAR100-LT, STL10-LT, and ImageNet127, addressing class imbalance challenges in semi-supervised learning. Our code is available at https://github.com/emasa/ADELLO-LTSSL.

title: Emanuele Santellani*, Martin Zach, Christian Sormann, Mattia Rossi, Andreas Kuhn, Friedrich Fraundorfer
title_en: Emanuele Santellani*, Martin Zach, Christian Sormann, Mattia Rossi, Andreas Kuhn, Friedrich Fraundorfer
abstract: 关键点提取是许多计算机视觉应用的基础,从定位到三维重建。关键点通常带有分数,用于根据其质量对关键点进行排序。虽然学习得到的关键点通常比手工设计的关键点具有更好的特性,但它们的分数不易解释,使得在不同方法之间几乎无法比较单个关键点的质量。我们提出了一种框架,可以优化任何方法提取的关键点,同时通过可解释的分数对其进行表征。我们的方法利用了一种修改后的鲁棒高斯混合模型拟合,旨在拒绝非鲁棒关键点并优化剩余关键点。我们的分数包含两个组成部分:一个与从不同视角拍摄的图像中提取相同关键点的概率相关,另一个与关键点的定位精度相关。这两个可解释的组成部分使得可以比较不同方法提取的单个关键点。通过大量实验,我们证明,当应用于流行的关键点检测器时,我们的框架在关键点的可重复性以及单应性、双视角/多视角姿态恢复任务中的性能方面均表现出一致的提升。
abstract_en: The extraction of keypoints in images is at the basis of many computer vision applications, from localization to 3D reconstruction. Keypoints come with a score permitting to rank them according to their quality. While learned keypoints often exhibit better properties than handcrafted ones, their scores are not easily interpretable, making it virtually impossible to compare the quality of individual keypoints across methods. We propose a framework that can refine, and at the same time characterize with an interpretable score, the keypoints extracted by any method. Our approach leverages a modified robust Gaussian Mixture Model fit designed to both reject non-robust keypoints and refine the remaining ones. Our score comprises two components: one relates to the probability of extracting the same keypoint in an image captured from another viewpoint, the other relates to the localization accuracy of the keypoint. These two interpretable components permit a comparison of individual keypoints extracted across different methods. Through extensive experiments we demonstrate that, when applied to popular keypoint detectors, our framework consistently improves the repeatability of keypoints as well as their performance in homography and two/multiple-view pose recovery tasks.

title: En Yu, Liang Zhao, YANA WEI, Jinrong Yang, Dongming Wu, Lingyu Kong, Haoran Wei, Tiancai Wang, Zheng Ge, Xiangyu Zhang, Wenbing Tao*
title_en: En Yu, Liang Zhao, YANA WEI, Jinrong Yang, Dongming Wu, Lingyu Kong, Haoran Wei, Tiancai Wang, Zheng Ge, Xiangyu Zhang, Wenbing Tao*
abstract: 人类能够基于当前观察预判未来,这种能力我们称为预判能力。然而,这一能力在现有多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)中尚未得到充分探索,限制了其理解主体意图的能力。为解决这一问题,我们将未来建模集成到MLLMs中。通过利用轨迹这一高度结构化的表示形式作为学习目标,我们旨在使模型能够理解时空动态。受大语言模型(LLMs)学习范式启发,我们首先提出预判预训练(Foresight Pre-Training, FPT),该方法联合学习以轨迹为中心的多种任务,使MLLMs能够从给定的初始观察中预测完整轨迹。随后,我们提出预判指令微调(Foresight Instruction-Tuning, FIT),要求MLLMs基于预测的轨迹推理潜在的未来事件。借助FPT和FIT,我们构建了一个统一的MLLM,命名为Merlin,支持复杂未来推理。实验表明,Merlin在未来的推理任务和视觉理解任务中均展现出卓越的预判能力。项目页面:https: //ahnsun.github.io/merlin
abstract_en: Humans can foresee the future based on present observations, a skill we term as foresight minds. However, this capability remains under-explored within existing MLLMs, hindering their capacity to understand intentions behind subjects. To address this, we integrate the future modeling into MLLMs. By utilizing the trajectory, a highly structured representation, as a learning objective, we aim to equip the model to understand spatiotemporal dynamics. Inspired by the learning paradigm of LLMs, we first propose Foresight Pre-Training (FPT) that jointly learns various tasks centered on trajectories, enabling MLLMs to predict entire trajectories from a given initial observation. Then, we propose Foresight Instruction-Tuning (FIT) that requires MLLMs to reason about potential future events based on predicted trajectories. Aided by FPT and FIT, we build an unified MLLM named Merlin that supports complex future reasoning. Experiments show Merlin’s foresight minds with impressive performance on both future reasoning and visual comprehension tasks. Project page: https: //ahnsun.github.io/merlin.

title: En-hui Yang, Linfeng Ye*
title_en: En-hui Yang, Linfeng Ye*
abstract: 为保护深度神经网络(DNN)的知识产权,提出两个与知识蒸馏(KD)相关的概念:可蒸馏DNN和KD抗性DNN。若一个DNN作为黑盒输入输出教师模型时,可通过KD方法蒸馏出学生模型,且蒸馏后学生模型在准确率上优于仅通过标签平滑(LS student)训练的学生模型,则该DNN被称为可蒸馏DNN。若一个DNN作为黑盒输入输出教师模型时,无法被特定KD方法蒸馏出准确率优于LS student的学生模型,则该DNN被称为对该KD方法具有KD抗性。进一步提出了一种新的KD方法,称为马尔可夫KD(MKD)。当应用于通过自我削弱KD训练的恶劣教师模型时,MKD使其完全可蒸馏,尽管这些恶劣教师模型在本文工作之前被证明对现有文献中的先进KD方法具有KD抗性。当应用于普通教师模型时,MKD生成的学生模型在准确率上显著优于通过相同普通教师模型进行KD训练的学生模型。更有趣的是,MKD能够将某一领域训练的教师模型知识迁移到另一领域训练的学生模型中。
abstract_en: To protect intellectual property of a deep neural network (DNN), two knowledge distillation (KD) related concepts are proposed: distillable DNN and KD-resistant DNN. A DNN is said to be distillable if used as a black-box input-output teacher, it can be distilled by a KD method to train a student model so that the distilled student outperforms the student trained alone with label smoothing (LS student) in terms of accuracy. A DNN is said to be KD-resistant with respect to a specific KD method if used as a black-box input-output teacher, it cannot be distilled by that specific KD method to yield a distilled student outperforming LS student in terms of accuracy. A new KD method called Markov KD (MKD) is further presented. When applied to nasty teachers trained by self-undermining KD, MKD makes those nasty teachers fully distillable, although those nasty teachers are shown to be KD-resistant with respect to state-of-the-art KD methods existing in the literature before our work. When applied to normal teachers, MKD yields distilled students outperforming those trained by KD from the same normal teachers by a large margin. More interestingly, MKD is capable of transferring knowledge from teachers trained in one domain to students trained in another domain.

title: Eric Brachmann*, Jamie Wynn, Shuai Chen, Tommaso Cavallari, Aron Monszpart, Daniyar Turmukhambetov, Victor Adrian Prisacariu
title_en: Eric Brachmann*, Jamie Wynn, Shuai Chen, Tommaso Cavallari, Aron Monszpart, Daniyar Turmukhambetov, Victor Adrian Prisacariu
abstract: 我们研究从一组描绘场景的图像中估计相机参数的任务。流行的基于特征的运动恢复结构(SfM)工具通过增量重建解决此任务:它们重复对稀疏3D点进行三角化,并将更多相机视角注册到稀疏点云中。我们将增量SfM重新诠释为视觉重定位器的迭代应用与优化,即一种将新视角注册到当前重建状态的方法。这种视角使我们能够研究非基于局部特征匹配的替代视觉重定位器。我们证明,场景坐标回归作为一种基于学习的重定位方法,能够从无约束图像中构建隐式神经场景表示。不同于其他基于学习的重建方法,我们无需姿态先验或顺序输入,并能高效优化数千张图像。在许多情况下,我们的方法ACE0估计的相机姿态精度接近基于特征的SfM,如新视角合成实验所示。项目页面:https://nianticlabs.github.io/acezero/
abstract_en: We address the task of estimating camera parameters from a set of images depicting a scene. Popular feature-based structure-from-motion (SfM) tools solve this task by incremental reconstruction: they repeat triangulation of sparse 3D points and registration of more camera views to the sparse point cloud. We re-interpret incremental structure-from-motion as an iterated application and refinement of a visual relocalizer, that is, of a method that registers new views to the current state of the reconstruction. This perspective allows us to investigate alternative visual relocalizers that are not rooted in local feature matching. We show that scene coordinate regression, a learning-based relocalization approach, allows us to build implicit, neural scene representations from unposed images. Different from other learning-based reconstruction methods, we do not require pose priors nor sequential inputs, and we optimize efficiently over thousands of images. In many cases, our method, ACE0, estimates camera poses with an accuracy close to feature-based SfM, as demonstrated by novel view synthesis. Project page: https://nianticlabs.github.io/acezero/

title: Eric Dexheimer*, Andrew Davison
title_en: Eric Dexheimer*, Andrew Davison
abstract: 我们提出COMO,一个实时单目映射与里程计系统,通过一组紧凑的三维锚点编码密集几何信息。通过每帧深度协方差函数解码锚点投影到密集几何,确保深度图在可见锚点处无缝衔接。该表示方法支持相机姿态与密集几何的联合优化、内在三维一致性以及高效的二阶推理。为保持紧凑且表达力强的地图,我们引入前端模块,利用协方差函数跨帧跟踪和初始化潜在视觉相似的三维点。总体而言,我们提出一个实时系统,能够准确估计相机姿态和一致的几何结构。
abstract_en: We present COMO, a real-time monocular mapping and odometry system that encodes dense geometry via a compact set of 3D anchor points. Decoding anchor point projections into dense geometry via per-keyframe depth covariance functions guarantees that depth maps are joined together at visible anchor points. The representation enables joint optimization of camera poses and dense geometry, intrinsic 3D consistency, and efficient second-order inference. To maintain a compact yet expressive map, we introduce a frontend that leverages the covariance function for tracking and initializing potentially visually indistinct 3D points across frames. Altogether, we introduce a real-time system capable of estimating accurate poses and consistent geometry.

title: Erik Wallin*, Lennart Svensson, Fredrik Kahl, Lars Hammarstrand
title_en: Erik Wallin*, Lennart Svensson, Fredrik Kahl, Lars Hammarstrand
abstract: 在开放集半监督学习(OSSL)中,我们考虑可能包含未知类别的无标签数据集。现有OSSL方法通常使用softmax置信度对数据进行分布内(ID)或分布外(OOD)分类。此外,许多OSSL工作依赖于针对ID/OOD分类的临时阈值,而未考虑问题的统计特性。我们提出了一种基于特征空间中数据与ID子空间之间角度的新ID/OOD分类得分。此外,我们提出了一种估计给定ID或OOD数据的得分条件分布的方法,从而实现对数据是否为ID或OOD的概率预测。这些组件被整合到一个OSSL框架中,称为ProSub,在多个基准问题上实验证明其达到SOTA性能。我们的代码可在https://github.com/walline/prosub获取。
abstract_en: In open-set semi-supervised learning (OSSL), we consider unlabeled datasets that may contain unknown classes. Existing OSSL methods often use the softmax confidence for classifying data as in-distribution (ID) or out-of-distribution (OOD). Additionally, many works for OSSL rely on ad-hoc thresholds for ID/OOD classification, without considering the statistics of the problem. We propose a new score for ID/OOD classification based on angles in feature space between data and an ID subspace. Moreover, we propose an approach to estimate the conditional distributions of scores given ID or OOD data, enabling probabilistic predictions of data being ID or OOD. These components are put together in a framework for OSSL, termed ProSub, that is experimentally shown to reach SOTA performance on several benchmark problems. Our code is available at https://github.com/walline/prosub.

title: Erum Mushtaq*, Duygu Nur Yaldiz, Yavuz Faruk Bakman, Jie Ding, Chenyang Tao, Dimitrios Dimitriadis, Salman Avestimehr
title_en: Erum Mushtaq*, Duygu Nur Yaldiz, Yavuz Faruk Bakman, Jie Ding, Chenyang Tao, Dimitrios Dimitriadis, Salman Avestimehr
abstract: 持续自监督学习(CSSL)在未标记数据上按顺序学习一系列任务。持续学习的两个主要挑战是灾难性遗忘和任务混淆。虽然已有研究针对灾难性遗忘问题探讨了CSSL问题,但针对任务混淆方面的研究仍较为有限。本文通过大量实验表明,自监督学习(SSL)会使CSSL更容易受到任务混淆问题的影响,尤其是在类别增量学习的多样性较低的场景中,因为不同任务中的不同类别并未同时进行训练。受此挑战启发,我们提出了一种新颖的跨模型特征混合(CroMo-Mixup)框架,通过两个关键组件解决该问题:1)跨任务数据混合,通过混合不同任务的样本以增强负样本多样性;2)跨模型特征混合,学习混合样本及其原始图像的嵌入与当前模型和旧模型之间的相似性,从而促进跨任务类别对比学习和旧知识检索。我们在三个数据集(CIFAR10、CIFAR100和tinyImageNet)的不同类别增量学习设置下,评估了CroMo-Mixup在提升任务ID预测和所有任务平均线性准确率方面的有效性。我们还验证了CroMo-Mixup与四种最先进的SSL目标的兼容性。代码已开源至https://github.com/ErumMushtaq/CroMo-Mixup。
abstract_en: Continual self-supervised learning (CSSL) learns a series of tasks sequentially on the unlabeled data. Two main challenges of continual learning are catastrophic forgetting and task confusion. While CSSL problem has been studied to address the catastrophic forgetting challenge, little work has been done to address the task confusion aspect. In this work, we show through extensive experiments that self-supervised learning (SSL) can make CSSL more susceptible to the task confusion problem, particularly in less diverse settings of class incremental learning because different classes belonging to different tasks are not trained concurrently. Motivated by this challenge, we present a novel cross-model feature Mixup (CroMo-Mixup) framework that addresses this issue through two key components: 1) Cross-Task data Mixup, which mixes samples across tasks to enhance negative sample diversity; and 2) Cross-Model feature Mixup, which learns similarities between embeddings obtained from current and old models of the mixed sample and the original images, facilitating cross-task class contrast learning and old knowledge retrieval. We evaluate the effectiveness of CroMo-Mixup to improve both Task-ID prediction and average linear accuracy across all tasks on three datasets, CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and tinyImageNet under different class-incremental learning settings. We validate the compatibility of CroMo-Mixup on four state-of-the-art SSL objectives. Code is available at https://github.com/ErumMushtaq/CroMo-Mixup.

title: Eugene Valassakis, Guillermo Garcia-Hernando*
title_en: Eugene Valassakis, Guillermo Garcia-Hernando*
abstract: 从单张RGB图像预测相机空间手网格对于在三维虚拟和增强世界中实现逼真的手部交互至关重要。以往的工作通常将该任务分为两个阶段:给定手部裁剪图像,首先在相对坐标系中预测网格,然后在独立的阶段将这些预测提升到相机空间,这通常导致有价值的情境和尺度信息的丢失。为防止这些信息的丢失,我们提出将这两个阶段统一到一个端到端的解决方案中,以解决2D-3D对应问题。该解决方案通过一个新的可微分全局定位模块,使相机空间输出能够反向传播到网络的其余部分。我们还引入了一个图像校正步骤,使训练数据集和输入图像如同由同一相机获取一样进行协调,有助于缓解该问题固有的尺度-深度歧义。我们在三个公开基准上通过与多个基线和最先进的方法进行对比评估,验证了我们框架的有效性。
abstract_en: Predicting camera-space hand meshes from single RGB images is crucial for enabling realistic hand interactions in 3D virtual and augmented worlds. Previous work typically divided the task into two stages: given a cropped image of the hand, predict meshes in relative coordinates, followed by lifting these predictions into camera space in a separate and independent stage, often resulting in the loss of valuable contextual and scale information. To prevent the loss of these cues, we propose unifying these two stages into an end-to-end solution that addresses the 2D-3D correspondence problem. This solution enables back-propagation from camera space outputs to the rest of the network through a new differentiable global positioning module. We also introduce an image rectification step that harmonizes both the training dataset and the input image as if they were acquired with the same camera, helping to alleviate the inherent scale-depth ambiguity of the problem. We validate the effectiveness of our framework in evaluations against several baselines and state-of-the-art approaches across three public benchmarks.

title: EungGu Kang*, Byeonghun Lee, Sunghoon Im, Kyong Hwan Jin
title_en: EungGu Kang*, Byeonghun Lee, Sunghoon Im, Kyong Hwan Jin
abstract: 多帧超分辨率(MFSR)相比单图像超分辨率(SISR)能够实现更高的性能,因为MFSR能够利用多个帧中丰富的信息。近期的MFSR方法采用可变形卷积网络(DCN)对帧进行对齐。然而,现有MFSR方法由于DCN的局限性(如小的感受野和预定义的卷积核数量),存在参考帧与源帧之间的对齐偏差问题。由此,现有MFSR方法难以有效表征高频信息。为此,我们提出基于傅里叶空间与光流的深度突发多尺度超分辨率方法(BurstM)。所提方法通过估计光流偏移实现精确对齐,并预测每帧的连续傅里叶系数以表征高频纹理。此外,我们通过支持多种超分辨率(SR)尺度因子,增强了网络的灵活性。实验表明,我们的方法在性能和灵活性方面均优于现有MFSR方法。源代码可在https://github.com/Egkang-Luis/burstm获取。
abstract_en: Multi frame super-resolution (MFSR) achieves higher performance than single image super-resolution (SISR), because MFSR leverages abundant information from multiple frames. Recent MFSR approaches adapt the deformable convolution network (DCN) to align the frames. However, the existing MFSR suffers from misalignments between the reference and source frames due to the limitations of DCN, such as small receptive fields and the predefined number of kernels. From these problems, existing MFSR approaches struggle to represent high-frequency information. To this end, we propose Deep Burst Multi-scale SR using Fourier Space with Optical Flow (BurstM). The proposed method estimates the optical flow offset for accurate alignment and predicts the continuous Fourier coefficient of each frame for representing high-frequency textures. In addition, we have enhanced the network’s flexibility by supporting various super-resolution (SR) scale factors with the unimodel. We demonstrate that our method has the highest performance and flexibility than the existing MFSR methods. Our source code is available at https://github.com/Egkang-Luis/burstm

title: Eungbean Lee, Somi Jeong, Kwanghoon Sohn*
title_en: Eungbean Lee, Somi Jeong, Kwanghoon Sohn*
abstract: 示例引导的图像转换,能够生成符合结构控制与风格示例的逼真图像,因其增强用户对风格操作的控制能力而受到关注。先前的方法主要依赖于在跨域输入之间建立密集对应关系。尽管如此,这些方法在建立密集对应关系时会产生二次内存和计算成本,导致适应性有限且性能下降。本文提出了一种新型方法,称为基于布朗桥扩散模型的示例引导图像转换(EBDM)。我们的方法将任务建模为随机布朗桥过程,即以结构控制作为固定初始点的扩散过程,并在仅给定示例图像的条件下转换为相应的逼真图像。为高效引导扩散过程向示例风格,我们定义了三个关键组件:全局编码器、示例网络和示例注意力模块,以整合示例图像的全局和细节纹理信息。利用桥接扩散,网络可以在仅依赖示例风格的条件下实现结构控制的图像转换,从而实现更稳健的训练和推理过程。我们通过全面的基准评估和视觉结果展示了该方法相较于竞争方法的优越性。
abstract_en: Exemplar-guided image translation, synthesizing photo-realistic images that conform to both structural control and style exemplars, is attracting attention due to its ability to enhance user control over style manipulation. Previous methodologies have predominantly depended on establishing dense correspondences across cross-domain inputs. Despite these efforts, they incur quadratic memory and computational costs for establishing dense correspondence, resulting in limited versatility and performance degradation. In this paper, we propose a novel approach termed Exemplar-guided Image Translation with Brownian-Bridge Diffusion Models (EBDM). Our method formulates the task as a stochastic Brownian bridge process, a diffusion process with a fixed initial point as structure control and translates into the corresponding photo-realistic image while being conditioned solely on the given exemplar image. To efficiently guide the diffusion process toward the style of exemplar, we delineate three pivotal components: the Global Encoder, the Exemplar Network, and the Exemplar Attention Module to incorporate global and detailed texture information from exemplar images. Leveraging Bridge diffusion, the network can translate images from structure control while exclusively conditioned on the exemplar style, leading to more robust training and inference processes. We illustrate the superiority of our method over competing approaches through comprehensive benchmark evaluations and visual results.

title: Evangelos Ververas*, Polydefkis Gkagkos, Jiankang Deng, Michail C Doukas, Jia Guo, Stefanos Zafeiriou
title_en: Evangelos Ververas*, Polydefkis Gkagkos, Jiankang Deng, Michail C Doukas, Jia Guo, Stefanos Zafeiriou
abstract: 开发能够良好泛化到未见过的领域和真实环境中的眼动估计模型仍然是一个挑战,目前尚无已知的最佳解决方案。这主要是由于获取覆盖现实世界中人脸、头部姿态和环境分布的真实数据极为困难。大多数近期方法尝试通过领域自适应来弥合特定源域和目标域之间的差距。在本文中,我们提出训练通用眼动估计模型,这些模型无需适应即可直接应用于新环境。为此,我们利用了头部、身体和手部姿态估计通过将其视为密集3D坐标预测而受益的观察结果,并类似地将眼动估计表达为密集3D眼网格的回归。为了弥合图像域之间的差距,我们创建了一个包含多样人脸的大型数据集,并基于人脸的3D几何结构提取了眼动伪标注,设计了多视角监督框架以在训练过程中平衡其影响。我们在眼动泛化任务中测试了我们的方法,当没有真实数据时,相比现有最佳方法提升了最高23%,当存在真实数据时提升了最高10%。
abstract_en: Developing gaze estimation models that generalize well to unseen domains and in-the-wild conditions remains a challenge with no known best solution. This is mostly due to the difficulty of acquiring ground truth data that cover the distribution of faces, head poses, and environments that exist in the real world. Most recent methods attempt to close the gap between specific source and target domains using domain adaptation. In this work, we propose to train general gaze estimation models which can be directly employed in novel environments without adaptation. To do so, we leverage the observation that head, body, and hand pose estimation benefit from revising them as dense 3D coordinate prediction, and similarly express gaze estimation as regression of dense 3D eye meshes. To close the gap between image domains, we create a large-scale dataset of diverse faces with gaze pseudo-annotations, which we extract based on the 3D geometry of the face, and design a multi-view supervision framework to balance their effect during training. We test our method in the task of gaze generalization, in which we demonstrate improvement of up to 23% compared to state-of-the-art when no ground truth data are available, and up to 10% when they are.

title: 埃万杰洛斯·韦弗拉斯, 罗兰多斯·亚历山大·波塔米亚斯*, 季飞宋, 建康邓, 斯特凡诺斯·扎菲里欧
title_en: Evangelos Ververas, Rolandos Alexandros Potamias*, Jifei Song, Jiankang Deng, Stefanos Zafeiriou
abstract: 随着神经辐射场(NeRFs)的出现,三维高斯点云(3D-GS)为实时神经渲染开辟了新途径,克服了体素方法的计算负担。已有多种3D-GS的扩展方法被提出以实现可压缩性和高保真性能。然而,这些方法采用几何无关的优化方案,忽视了场景的固有三维结构,从而限制了表示的表达能力和质量,导致各种浮点误差和伪影。在本文中,我们提出了一种结构感知高斯点云方法(SAGS),该方法隐式编码场景几何结构,在基准数据集上实现了最先进的渲染性能和存储需求的降低。SAGS基于局部-全局图表示,能够学习复杂场景并强制有意义的点位移以保持场景几何结构。此外,我们引入了一种轻量级的SAGS版本,采用简单而有效的中点插值方案,展示了无需任何压缩策略即可实现场景紧凑表示,尺寸缩减高达24倍。在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明,SAGS在渲染质量和模型尺寸方面均优于最先进的3D-GS方法。此外,我们证明了结构感知方法能够有效缓解前序方法的浮点伪影和不规则失真,同时获得精确的深度图。
abstract_en: Following the advent of NeRFs, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS) has paved the way to real-time neural rendering overcoming the computational burden of volumetric methods. Several extensions of 3D-GS have been proposed to achieve compressible and high-fidelity performance. However, by employing a geometry-agnostic optimization scheme, these methods neglect the inherent 3D structure of the scene, thereby restricting the expressivity and the quality of the representation, resulting in various floating points and artifacts. In this work, we propose a structure-aware Gaussian Splatting method (SAGS) that implicitly encodes the geometry of the scene, which reflects to state-of-the-art rendering performance and reduced storage requirements on benchmark datasets. SAGS is founded on a local-global graph representation that facilitates the learning of complex scenes and enforces meaningful point displacements that preserve the scene’s geometry. Additionally, we introduce a lightweight version of SAGS, using a simple yet effective mid-point interpolation scheme, which showcases a compact representation of the scene with up to 24× size reduction without the reliance on any compression strategies. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate the superiority of SAGS compared to state-of-the-art 3D-GS methods under both rendering quality and model size. Besides, we demonstrate that our structure-aware method can effectively mitigate floating artifacts and irregular distortions of previous methods while obtaining precise depth maps.

title: Evin Pınar Örnek*, Yann Labbé, Bugra Tekin, Lingni Ma, Cem Keskin, Christian Forster, Tomas Hodan
title_en: Evin Pınar Örnek*, Yann Labbé, Bugra Tekin, Lingni Ma, Cem Keskin, Christian Forster, Tomas Hodan
abstract: 我们提出FoundPose,一种基于模型的方法,用于从单张RGB图像中对未见过的对象进行6自由度姿态估计。该方法无需任何对象或任务特定的训练,即可快速加载新对象的3D模型。与现有方法通常在大规模任务特定数据集上进行预训练以推广到新对象并弥合图像到模型域差距不同,我们证明最近的视觉基础模型在自监督训练下已展现出此类泛化能力。具体而言,我们的方法通过在图像与预渲染对象模板之间匹配DINOv2模型的补丁描述符,建立图像到模型的2D-3D对应关系。我们发现,通过中间DINOv2层的补丁描述符进行k近邻匹配可以建立可靠的对应关系。此类描述符携带比最后一层描述符更强的位置信息,在语义信息因对象对称性或缺乏纹理而模糊时尤为重要。为避免与所有对象模板建立对应关系,我们开发了一种高效的模板检索方法,将补丁描述符整合到词袋表示法中,可迅速提出少量相似外观的模板。此外,我们应用特征度量对齐以补偿粗略补丁采样导致的2D-3D对应关系差异。该方法在标准BOP基准测试中显著优于现有RGB方法,且无需优化即可实现七种多样化数据集的姿态估计,并可无缝结合现有渲染对比优化方法,实现仅RGB的最先进结果。项目页面:evinpinar.github.io/foundpose.
abstract_en: We propose FoundPose, a model-based method for 6D pose estimation of unseen objects from a single RGB image. The method can quickly onboard new objects using their 3D models without requiring any object- or task-specific training. In contrast, existing methods typically pre-train on large-scale, task-specific datasets in order to generalize to new objects and to bridge the image-to-model domain gap. We demonstrate that such generalization capabilities can be observed in a recent vision foundation model trained in a self-supervised manner. Specifically, our method estimates the object pose from image-to-model 2D-3D correspondences, which are established by matching patch descriptors from the recent DINOv2 model between the image and pre-rendered object templates. We find that reliable correspondences can be established by kNN matching of patch descriptors from an intermediate DINOv2 layer. Such descriptors carry stronger positional information than descriptors from the last layer, and we show their importance when semantic information is ambiguous due to object symmetries or a lack of texture. To avoid establishing correspondences against all object templates, we develop an efficient template retrieval approach that integrates the patch descriptors into the bag-of-words representation and can promptly propose a handful of similarly looking templates. Additionally, we apply featuremetric alignment to compensate for discrepancies in the 2D-3D correspondences caused by coarse patch sampling. The resulting method noticeably outperforms existing RGB methods for refinement-free pose estimation on the standard BOP benchmark with seven diverse datasets and can be seamlessly combined with an existing render-and-compare refinement method to achieve RGB-only state-of-the-art results. Project page: evinpinar.github.io/foundpose.

title: Fabien Baradel*, Thomas LUCAS, Matthieu Armando, Salma Galaaoui, Romain Brégier, Philippe Weinzaepfel, Gregory Rogez
title_en: Fabien Baradel*, Thomas LUCAS, Matthieu Armando, Salma Galaaoui, Romain Brégier, Philippe Weinzaepfel, Gregory Rogez
abstract: 我们提出了一种强大的模型,用于从单张RGB图像中恢复多人三维人体网格。预测结果涵盖全身,包括手部和面部表情,采用SMPL-X参数化模型及相机坐标系中的三维位置。我们的模型通过预测人员位置的粗略二维热图来检测人物,利用标准Vision Transformer(ViT)主干网络生成的特征。随后,通过一种新的交叉注意力模块——人体预测头(HPH),预测其全身姿态、形状和三维位置,每个检测到的人物均有一个查询注意力机制关注全部特征集。由于直接预测单次拍摄中的细粒度手部和面部姿态(无需依赖显式的身体部位裁剪区域)在现有数据中难以学习,我们引入了__ABS_MATH_1__数据集,包含靠近相机且手部姿态多样的人类。我们证明将该数据集纳入训练数据可进一步提升预测效果,尤其是手部姿态。该模型还可选地考虑相机内参,通过为每个图像标记编码相机射线方向实现。这种简单设计在全身和仅身体基准测试中均取得优异性能:在448×448图像上使用ViT-S主干网络已获得快速且具有竞争力的模型,而更大的模型和更高分辨率则可达到最先进水平。
abstract_en: We present , a strong model for multi-person 3D human mesh recovery from a single RGB image. Predictions encompass the whole body, , including hands and facial expressions, using the SMPL-X parametric model and 3D location in the camera coordinate system. Our model detects people by predicting coarse 2D heatmaps of person locations, using features produced by a standard Vision Transformer (ViT) backbone. It then predicts their whole-body pose, shape and 3D location using a new cross-attention module called the Human Prediction Head (HPH), with one query attending to the entire set of features for each detected person. As direct prediction of fine-grained hands and facial poses in a single shot, , without relying on explicit crops around body parts, is hard to learn from existing data, we introduce , the dataset, containing humans close to the camera with diverse hand poses. We show that incorporating it into the training data further enhances predictions, particularly for hands. also optionally accounts for camera intrinsics, if available, by encoding camera ray directions for each image token. This simple design achieves strong performance on whole-body and body-only benchmarks simultaneously: a ViT-S backbone on 448×448 images already yields a fast and competitive model, while larger models and higher resolutions obtain state-of-the-art results.

title: 和
title_en: Fabio Quattrini*, Vittorio Pippi, Silvia Cascianelli*, Rita Cucchiara
abstract: 作为标签,然后是中文内容,最后是
abstract_en: Diffusion models have become the State-of-the-Art for text-to-image generation, and increasing research effort has been dedicated to adapting the inference process of pretrained diffusion models to achieve zero-shot capabilities. An example is the generation of panorama images, which has been tackled in recent works by combining independent diffusion paths over overlapping latent features, which is referred to as joint diffusion, obtaining perceptually aligned panoramas. However, these methods often yield semantically incoherent outputs and trade-off diversity for uniformity. To overcome this limitation, we propose the Merge-Attend-Diffuse operator, which can be plugged into different types of pretrained diffusion models used in a joint diffusion setting to improve the perceptual and semantical coherence of the generated panorama images. Specifically, we merge the diffusion paths, reprogramming self- and cross-attention to operate on the aggregated latent space. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experimental analysis, together with a user study, demonstrate that our method maintains compatibility with the input prompt and visual quality of the generated images while increasing their semantic coherence. We release the code at https: //github.com/aimagelab/MAD.

title: Fabio Tosi, Pierluigi Zama Ramirez, Matteo Poggi*
title_en: Fabio Tosi, Pierluigi Zama Ramirez, Matteo Poggi*
abstract: 我们提出了一种新方法,旨在解决单图像深度估计任务中由具有挑战性的分布外数据带来的复杂性。我们从便于深度预测的图像开始,通过系统生成包含全面挑战和对应深度信息的用户自定义场景。这通过利用先进的文本到图像扩散模型实现,该模型具有深度感知控制,能够从文本提示中合成高质量图像内容,同时保持生成图像与源图像之间的3D结构一致性。随后,通过自蒸馏协议对任何单目深度网络进行微调,该协议考虑了我们策略生成的图像及其在简单、无挑战场景上的自身深度预测。在针对我们目的定制的基准测试中,实验验证了我们方法的有效性和通用性。
abstract_en: We present a novel approach designed to address the complexities posed by challenging, out-of-distribution data in the single-image depth estimation task. Starting with images that facilitate depth prediction due to the absence of unfavorable factors, we systematically generate new, user-defined scenes with a comprehensive set of challenges and associated depth information. This is achieved by leveraging cutting-edge text-to-image diffusion models with depth-aware control, known for synthesizing high-quality image content from textual prompts while preserving the coherence of 3D structure between generated and source imagery. Subsequent fine-tuning of any monocular depth network is carried out through a self-distillation protocol that takes into account images generated using our strategy and its own depth predictions on simple, unchallenging scenes. Experiments on benchmarks tailored for our purposes demonstrate the effectiveness and versatility of our proposal.

title: 和
title_en: Fadi Boutros*, Vitomir Struc, Naser Damer
abstract: 标签,并且在最后加上
abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) aims at improving the performance of a compact student model by distilling the knowledge from a high-performing teacher model. In this paper, we present an adaptive KD approach, namely AdaDistill, for deep face recognition. The proposed AdaDistill embeds the KD concept into the softmax loss by training the student using a margin penalty softmax loss with distilled class centers from the teacher. Being aware of the relatively low capacity of the compact student model, we propose to distill less complex knowledge at an early stage of training and more complex one at a later stage of training. This relative adjustment of the distilled knowledge is controlled by the progression of the learning capability of the student over the training iterations without the need to tune any hyper-parameters. Extensive experiments and ablation studies show that AdaDistill can enhance the discriminative learning capability of the student and demonstrate superiority over various state-of-the-art competitors on several challenging benchmarks, such as IJB-B, IJB-C, and ICCV2021-MFR 1 . 1 https://github.com/fdbtrs/AdaDistill

title: Fadlullah A Raji*, John Murray-Bruce*
title_en: Fadlullah A Raji*, John Murray-Bruce*
abstract: 传统成像需要视线才能准确呈现场景的视觉表示。然而在某些情况下,获取合适的视线可能不切实际、危险甚至不可能。非视线(NLOS)成像通过从间接测量中重建场景来解决这一挑战。最近,利用普通照片捕捉隐藏场景投射在可见墙上的细微阴影的被动式NLOS方法引起了关注。这些方法目前仅限于1D或低分辨率2D彩色成像,或定位形状已知的隐藏物体。本文我们扩展了这一类方法,展示了如何从普通NLOS照片中实现隐藏场景的3D重建。为此,我们提出了一种光传输模型的新表述方式,将隐藏场景分解为遮光和非遮光组件,从而得到可分离的非线性最小二乘(SNLLS)反问题。我们开发了两种解决方案:一种基于梯度的优化方法,另一种受物理启发的神经网络方法,我们称之为Soft Shadow扩散(SSD)。尽管面临此处的困难逆问题,我们的方法在真实实验场景中对多种3D场景均有效。此外,SSD在模拟中训练,但在模拟和现实世界NLOS场景中对未见过的类别具有良好的泛化能力。SSD还表现出对噪声和环境光照的惊人鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Conventional imaging requires a line of sight to create accurate visual representations of a scene. In certain circumstances, however, obtaining a suitable line of sight may be impractical, dangerous, or even impossible. Non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging addresses this challenge by reconstructing the scene from indirect measurements. Recently, passive NLOS methods that use an ordinary photograph of the subtle shadow cast onto a visible wall by the hidden scene have gained interest. These methods are currently limited to 1D or low-resolution 2D color imaging or to localizing a hidden object whose shape is approximately known. Here, we generalize this class of methods and demonstrate a 3D reconstruction of a hidden scene from an ordinary NLOS photograph. To achieve this, we propose a novel reformulation of the light transport model that conveniently decomposes the hidden scene into light-occluding and non-light-occluding components to yield a separable non-linear least squares (SNLLS) inverse problem. We develop two solutions: A gradient-based optimization method and a physics-inspired neural network approach, which we call Soft Shadow diffusion (SSD). Despite the challenging ill-conditioned inverse problem encountered here, our approaches are effective on numerous 3D scenes in real experimental scenarios. Moreover, SSD is trained in simulation but generalizes well to unseen classes in simulation and real-world NLOS scenes. SSD also shows surprising robustness to noise and ambient illumination.

title: Faegheh Sardari*, Armin Mustafa, Philip JB Jackson, Adrian Hilton
title_en: Faegheh Sardari*, Armin Mustafa, Philip JB Jackson, Adrian Hilton
abstract: 弱监督音频-视觉视频解析(AVVP)方法旨在仅使用视频级标签检测仅音频事件、仅视觉事件和音频-视觉事件。现有方法通过利用单模态和跨模态上下文来解决这一问题。然而,我们认为虽然跨模态学习对检测音频-视觉事件有益,但在弱监督场景下,它会通过引入无关模态信息而对未对齐的音频或视觉事件产生负面影响。本文提出了一种新颖的学习框架,该框架优化了嵌入空间中跨模态上下文的整合,使网络能够显式地结合跨模态信息以检测音频-视觉事件,同时过滤掉未对齐事件的跨模态信息。此外,由于视频通常涉及复杂的类别关系,建模这些关系可提升性能。然而,这会引入额外的计算成本。我们的框架设计为在训练过程中利用跨类别关系,而无需在推理阶段增加额外计算。此外,我们提出了新的度量标准以更准确地评估方法在执行AVVP时的能力。我们的大量实验表明,该方法在LLP和UnAV-100数据集上分别将F值提升了1.9%和2.4%,显著优于现有最先进结果。代码已开源:https://github.com/faeghehsardari/coleaf
abstract_en: Weakly supervised audio-visual video parsing (AVVP) methods aim to detect audible-only, visible-only, and audible-visible events using only video-level labels. Existing approaches tackle this by leveraging unimodal and cross-modal contexts. However, we argue that while cross-modal learning is beneficial for detecting audible-visible events, in the weakly supervised scenario, it negatively impacts unaligned audible or visible events by introducing irrelevant modality information. In this paper, we propose , a novel learning framework that optimizes the integration of cross-modal context in the embedding space such that the network explicitly learns to combine cross-modal information for audible-visible events while filtering them out for unaligned events. Additionally, as videos often involve complex class relationships, modelling them improves performance. However, this introduces extra computational costs into the network. Our framework is designed to leverage cross-class relationships during training without incurring additional computations at inference. Furthermore, we propose new metrics to better evaluate a method’s capabilities in performing AVVP. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that significantly improves the state-of-the-art results by an average of 1.9% and 2.4% F-score on the LLP and UnAV-100 datasets, respectively. Code is available at: https://github.com/faeghehsardari/coleaf.

title: Fan Duan, Jiahao Yu, Li Chen*
title_en: Fan Duan, Jiahao Yu, Li Chen*
abstract: 点云在自动驾驶、制造业等众多实际应用中被广泛使用。然而,这些点云由于视角受限、扫描仪分辨率不足和遮挡等问题,常常存在不完整性。因此,缺失部分的预测是一项关键任务。在本文中,我们提出了一种新颖的点云补全方法。我们利用球面模板来引导粗略完整模板的生成,并通过对应池化(Corres-Pooling)查询生成器生成动态查询标记。具体来说,我们首先通过将高斯球面模板嵌入到部分输入中,并将模板转换为最佳匹配输入,生成粗略完整模板。随后,我们使用Corres-Pooling查询生成器来细化粗略模板,并生成动态查询标记,这些标记可用于预测完整的点代理。最后,我们根据精细模板和预测的点代理,通过遵循粗到精范式的FoldingNet生成完整的点云。实验结果表明,我们的T-CorresNet在多个基准测试中优于现有最先进的方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/df-boy/T-CorresNet获取。
abstract_en: Point clouds are commonly used in various practical applications such as autonomous driving and the manufacturing industry. However, these point clouds often suffer from incompleteness due to limited perspectives, scanner resolution and occlusion. Therefore the prediction of missing parts performs a crucial task. In this paper, we propose a novel method for point cloud completion. We utilize a spherical template to guide the generation of the coarse complete template and generate the dynamic query tokens through a correspondence pooling (Corres-Pooling) query generator. Specifically, we first generate the coarse complete template by embedding a Gaussian spherical template into the partial input and transforming the template to best match the input. Then we use the Corres-Pooling query generator to refine the coarse template and generate dynamic query tokens which could be used to predict the complete point proxies. Finally, we generate the complete point cloud with a FoldingNet following the coarse-to-fine paradigm, according to the fine template and the predicted point proxies. Experimental results demonstrate that our T-CorresNet outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on several benchmarks. Our codes are available at https://github.com/df-boy/T-CorresNet.

title: Fan Li*, Zixiao Zhang, Yi Huang, Jianzhuang Liu, Renjing Pei, Bin Shao, Songcen Xu
title_en: Fan Li*, Zixiao Zhang, Yi Huang, Jianzhuang Liu, Renjing Pei, Bin Shao, Songcen Xu
abstract: 传统图像修复任务旨在通过参考周围背景和前景来修复受损区域。然而,日益增长需求的对象擦除任务旨在擦除对象并生成和谐的背景。先前基于GAN的图像修复方法在复杂纹理生成方面存在困难。新兴的基于扩散模型的算法(如Stable Diffusion Inpainting)展现出生成新内容的能力,但它们往往在擦除对象的位置产生不协调的结果,并需要高质量的文本提示输入。为了解决这些挑战,我们引入了MagicEraser,一个专门针对对象擦除任务的基于扩散模型的框架。它包含两个阶段:内容初始化和可控生成。在后一阶段,我们开发了两个即插即用模块,称为提示调优和语义感知注意力重聚焦。此外,我们提出了一种数据构建策略,生成专门适用于该任务的训练数据。MagicEraser在实现内容生成的精细且有效控制的同时,有效缓解了不需要的伪影。实验结果突显了我们的方法在对象擦除任务中的重要进展。
abstract_en: The traditional image inpainting task aims to restore corrupted regions by referencing surrounding background and foreground. However, the object erasure task, which is in increasing demand, aims to erase objects and generate harmonious background. Previous GAN-based inpainting methods struggle with intricate texture generation. Emerging diffusion model-based algorithms, such as Stable Diffusion Inpainting, exhibit the capability to generate novel content, but they often produce incongruent results at the locations of the erased objects and require high-quality text prompt inputs. To address these challenges, we introduce MagicEraser, a diffusion model-based framework tailored for the object erasure task. It consists of two phases: content initialization and controllable generation. In the latter phase, we develop two plug-and-play modules called prompt tuning and semantics-aware attention refocus. Additionally, we propose a data construction strategy that generates training data specially suitable for this task. MagicEraser achieves fine and effective control of content generation while mitigating undesired artifacts. Experimental results highlight a valuable advancement of our approach in the object erasure task.

title: Fan Qi*, Pan Ruijie, Zhang Huaiwen, Xu Changsheng*
title_en: Fan Qi*, Ruijie Pan, Huaiwen Zhang, Changsheng Xu*
abstract: 智能监控系统稳健检测异常事件的需求在视觉数据敏感性和隐私问题的背景下提出了独特挑战。我们提出了一种新颖的联邦学习框架用于视频异常检测,在数据异构性和隐私保护的约束下运行。我们利用联邦视觉一致性聚类在服务器端对客户端进行分组。进一步创新体现在自适应语义增强蒸馏策略上,该策略将公共视频知识注入我们的框架。在此过程中,利用大语言模型进行公共视频的语义生成与校准。这些视频-文本对随后用于微调多模态网络,该网络作为教师模型更新全局模型。这种方法不仅优化了视频表示,还增强了对异常事件的敏感性。我们的广泛评估展示了FedVAD在提升无监督和弱监督异常检测方面的卓越能力,其性能可与集中式训练范式相媲美,同时保持隐私性。代码将在https://github.com/Eurekaer/FedVAD公开提供。
abstract_en: The imperative for smart surveillance systems to robustly detect anomalies poses a unique challenge given the sensitivity of visual data and privacy concerns. We propose a novel Federated Learning framework for Video Anomaly Detection that operates under the constraints of data heterogeneity and privacy preservation. We utilize Federated Visual Consistency Clustering to group clients on the server side. Further innovation is realized with an Adaptive Semantic-Enhanced Distillation strategy that infuses public video knowledge into our framework. During this process, Large Language Models are utilized for semantic generation and calibration of public videos. These video-text pairs are then used to fine-tune a multimodal network, which serves as a teacher in updating the global model. This approach not only refines video representations but also increases sensitivity to anomalous events. Our extensive evaluations showcase FedVAD’s proficiency in boosting unsupervised and weakly supervised anomaly detection, rivaling centralized training paradigms while preserving privacy. The code will be made available publicly at https://github.com/Eurekaer/FedVAD.

title: Fan Qi*, Yu Duan, Changsheng Xu, Huaiwen Zhang*
title_en: Fan Qi*, Yu Duan, Changsheng Xu, Huaiwen Zhang*
abstract: 将文本输入无缝转换为自然且富有表现力的手语具有深远的社会意义。手语不仅仅是手部动作。它还包括对细腻交流至关重要的面部表情和口部动作。在文本到手语的翻译中实现语义精确性和情感共鸣至关重要。我们的工作率先实现了文本到手语视频的端到端直接翻译,涵盖了全身和面部表情的逼真表现。我们通过为手语视频定制多模态条件,超越了传统的扩散模型。此外,我们的改进型运动感知手语生成框架增强了手语中文本与视觉线索之间的对齐,进一步提高了生成手语视频的质量。大量实验表明,我们的方法在语义一致性、自然性和表现力方面显著优于现有最先进的方法,并在RWTH-2014、RWTH-2014-T、WLASL、CSL-Daily和AUTSL数据集上呈现了基准定量结果。我们的代码可在https://github.com/mingtiannihao/SignGen获取。
abstract_en: The seamless transformation of textual input into natural and expressive sign language holds profound societal significance. Sign language is not solely about hand gestures. It encompasses vital facial expressions and mouth movements essential for nuanced communication. Achieving both semantic precision and emotional resonance in text-to-sign language translation is of paramount importance. Our work pioneers direct end-to-end translation of text into sign language videos, encompassing a realistic representation of the entire body and facial expressions. We go beyond traditional diffusion models by tailoring the multi-modal conditions for sign language videos. Additionally, our modified motion-aware sign generation framework enhances alignment between text and visual cues in sign language, further improving the quality of the generated sign language videos. Extensive experiments show that our approach significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches in terms of semantic consistency, naturalness, and expressiveness, presenting benchmark quantitative results on the RWTH-2014, RWTH-2014-T, WLASL, CSL-Daily, and AUTSL. Our code is available at https://github.com/mingtiannihao/SignGen.

title: Fangcen Liu, Chenqiang Gao*, Yaming Zhang, Junjie Guo, Jinghao Wang, Deyu Meng
title_en: Fangcen Liu, Chenqiang Gao*, Yaming Zhang, Junjie Guo, Jinghao Wang, Deyu Meng
abstract: 近年来,基础模型席卷了计算机视觉领域,推动了不同模态下各类任务的进步。然而,有效设计红外基础模型仍是一个开放性问题。本文提出InfMAE,一种专门针对红外模态的基础模型。首先,我们提出了Inf30数据集,旨在缓解红外视觉社区中自监督学习大规模数据稀缺的问题。此外,考虑到红外图像的固有特性,我们设计了一种信息感知的掩码策略。该策略在自监督学习过程中更注重红外图像中信息丰富的区域,有助于学习强大的表示。此外,为增强下游任务的泛化能力,我们采用多尺度编码器进行潜在表示学习。最后,我们开发了红外解码器以重建图像。大量实验表明,我们提出的InfMAE方法在三个关键下游任务——红外图像语义分割、目标检测和小目标检测中,均优于其他监督和自监督学习方法。
abstract_en: In recent years, foundation models have swept the computer vision field, facilitating the advancement of various tasks within different modalities. However, effectively designing an infrared foundation model remains an open question. In this paper, we introduce InfMAE, a foundation model tailored specifically for the infrared modality. Initially, we present Inf30, an infrared dataset developed to mitigate the scarcity of large-scale data for self-supervised learning within the infrared vision community. Moreover, considering the intrinsic characteristics of infrared images, we design an information-aware masking strategy. It allows for a greater emphasis on the regions with richer information in infrared images during the self-supervised learning process, which is conducive to learning strong representations. Additionally, to enhance generalization capabilities in downstream tasks, we employ a multi-scale encoder for latent representation learning. Finally, we develop an infrared decoder to reconstruct images. Extensive experiments show that our proposed method InfMAE outperforms other supervised and self-supervised learning methods in three key downstream tasks: infrared image semantic segmentation, object detection, and small target detection.

title: Fangfu Liu, Hanyang Wang, Weiliang Chen, Haowen Sun, Yueqi Duan*
title_en: Fangfu Liu, Hanyang Wang, Weiliang Chen, Haowen Sun, Yueqi Duan*
abstract: 近年来,3D生成模型展现出强大的生成能力,通过单张图像或自然语言引导3D内容生成过程,为用户提供了新的创作灵活性。然而,现有3D生成方法在跨多类提示创建以主体为导向的3D内容方面仍面临挑战。本文提出了一种新颖的3D定制方法,命名为Make-Your-3D,可在5分钟内仅通过主体单张图像及其文本描述,生成高保真且一致的个性化3D内容。我们的核心洞察是将多视角扩散模型与身份特定的2D生成模型的分布进行协调,使其与目标3D主体的分布对齐。具体而言,我们设计了一个共进化框架以降低分布方差,其中每个模型分别通过身份感知优化和主体先验优化从对方进行学习。大量实验表明,我们的方法能够生成高质量、一致且以主体为导向的3D内容,其文本驱动的修改在主体图像中未见过。项目页面:https://liuff19.github.io/Make-Your-3D/
abstract_en: Recent years have witnessed the strong power of 3D generation models, which offer a new level of creative flexibility by allowing users to guide the 3D content generation process through a single image or natural language. However, it remains challenging for existing 3D generation methods to create subject-driven 3D content across diverse prompts. In this paper, we introduce a novel 3D customization method, dubbed Make-Your-3D that can personalize high-fidelity and consistent 3D content from only a single image of a subject with text description within 5 minutes. Our key insight is to harmonize the distributions of a multi-view diffusion model and an identity-specific 2D generative model, aligning them with the distribution of the desired 3D subject. Specifically, we design a co-evolution framework to reduce the variance of distributions, where each model undergoes a process of learning from the other through identity-aware optimization and subject-prior optimization, respectively. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method can produce high-quality, consistent, and subject-specific 3D content with text-driven modifications that are unseen in subject image. Project page: https://liuff19.github.io/Make-Your-3D/.

title: 丁方强*, 罗振, 赵培军, 卢晓轩
title_en: Fangqiang Ding*, Zhen Luo, Peijun Zhao, Chris Xiaoxuan Lu
abstract: 人体运动感知在智能系统的决策制定、用户交互和个性化服务中起着至关重要的作用。已开展的大量研究主要基于摄像头,但其侵入性限制了其在智能家居应用中的使用。为了解决这一问题,毫米波雷达因其隐私友好的特性而受到欢迎。在本工作中,我们提出了milliFlow,一种新颖的深度学习方法,用于估计场景流作为毫米波点云的补充运动信息,作为特征的中间层次,并直接受益于下游的人体运动感知任务。实验结果表明,与竞争方法相比,我们的方法表现出优越的性能。此外,通过结合场景流信息,我们在人体活动识别、人体解析和人体部位跟踪方面取得了显著改进。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/Toytiny/milliFlow上获取。
abstract_en: Human motion sensing plays a crucial role in smart systems for decision-making, user interaction, and personalized services. Extensive research that has been conducted is predominantly based on cameras, whose intrusive nature limits their use in smart home applications. To address this, mmWave radars have gained popularity due to their privacy-friendly features. In this work, we propose milliFlow, a novel deep learning approach to estimate scene flow as complementary motion information for mmWave point cloud, serving as an intermediate level of features and directly benefiting downstream human motion sensing tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the superior performance of our method when compared with the competing approaches. Furthermore, by incorporating scene flow information, we achieve remarkable improvements in human activity recognition and human parsing and support human body part tracking. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Toytiny/milliFlow.

title: 周芳琴*, Mert Kilickaya, Joaquin Vanschoren, Ran Piao
title_en: Fangqin Zhou*, Mert Kilickaya, Joaquin Vanschoren, Ran Piao
abstract: 高光谱成像(HSI)在遥感领域的精确视觉任务中发挥着越来越关键的作用,能够捕捉广泛的视觉数据。Transformer架构显著提升了HSI任务的性能,而Transformer架构搜索(TAS)的进步提高了模型发现效率。为利用这些进展进行HSI分类,我们做出以下贡献:i)我们提出HyTAS,这是首个针对高光谱成像的Transformer架构搜索基准;ii)我们全面评估了12种不同方法,在5个不同数据集上识别最优Transformer;iii)我们对高光谱Transformer搜索性能进行了广泛因素分析,极大推动了该方向未来的研究。所有基准材料均可在HyTAS获取。
abstract_en: Hyperspectral Imaging (HSI) plays an increasingly critical role in precise vision tasks within remote sensing, capturing a wide spectrum of visual data. Transformer architectures have significantly enhanced HSI task performance, while advancements in Transformer Architecture Search (TAS) have improved model discovery. To harness these advancements for HSI classification, we make the following contributions: i) We propose HyTAS, the first benchmark on transformer architecture search for Hyperspectral imaging, ii) We comprehensively evaluate 12 different methods to identify the optimal transformer over 5 different datasets, iii) We perform an extensive factor analysis on the Hyperspectral transformer search performance, greatly motivating future research in this direction. All benchmark materials are available at HyTAS.

title: Fangwei Zhong*, Kui Wu, Hai Ci, Chu-ran Wang, Hao Chen
title_en: Fangwei Zhong*, Kui Wu, Hai Ci, Chu-ran Wang, Hao Chen
abstract: 具身视觉跟踪是在动态三维环境中利用智能体的自视野视觉追踪目标物体。这是具身智能体的一项关键且具有挑战性的技能。然而,现有方法存在训练效率低下和泛化能力差的问题。本文提出了一种新颖框架,结合视觉基础模型(VFM)和离线强化学习(offline RL),以增强具身视觉跟踪能力。我们使用预训练的VFM(如“Tracking Anything”)通过文本提示提取语义分割掩码。随后,我们采用离线RL(如Conservative Q-Learning)训练循环策略网络,从收集的演示数据中学习,无需在线交互。为进一步提升策略网络的鲁棒性和泛化能力,我们引入了掩码重定位机制和多级数据收集策略。通过这种方式,我们可以在消费级GPU(如Nvidia RTX 3090)上一小时内训练出鲁棒的策略。我们在多个高保真环境中评估了我们的智能体,包括具有挑战性的场景(如分心和遮挡)。结果表明,我们的智能体在样本效率、对分心因素的鲁棒性以及对未见过场景和目标的泛化能力方面均优于现有最先进方法。我们还展示了所学智能体从虚拟环境向真实机器人迁移的能力。1 1 项目网站: https://sites.google.com/view/offline-evt
abstract_en: Embodied visual tracking is to follow a target object in dynamic 3D environments using an agent’s egocentric vision. This is a vital and challenging skill for embodied agents. However, existing methods suffer from inefficient training and poor generalization. In this paper, we propose a novel framework that combines visual foundation models (VFM) and offline reinforcement learning (offline RL) to empower embodied visual tracking. We use a pre-trained VFM, such as “Tracking Anything”, to extract semantic segmentation masks with text prompts. We then train a recurrent policy network with offline RL, e.g., Conservative Q-Learning, to learn from the collected demonstrations without online interactions. To further improve the robustness and generalization of the policy network, we also introduce a mask re-targeting mechanism and a multi-level data collection strategy. In this way, we can train a robust policy within an hour on a consumer-level GPU, e.g., Nvidia RTX 3090. We evaluate our agent on several high-fidelity environments with challenging situations, such as distraction and occlusion. The results show that our agent outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of sample efficiency, robustness to distractors, and generalization to unseen scenarios and targets. We also demonstrate the transferability of the learned agent from virtual environments to a real-world robot. 1 1 Project Website: https://sites.google.com/view/offline-evt

title: Fangzhou Song, Bin Zhu, Yanbin Hao*, Shuo Wang
title_en: Fangzhou Song, Bin Zhu, Yanbin Hao*, Shuo Wang
abstract: 在通用嵌入空间中学习食谱和食品图像表示对于跨模态食谱检索至关重要但非 trivial。本文提出了一种新的视角,通过利用基础模型进行数据增强来解决该问题。借助基础模型(如 Llama2 和 SAM)显著的能力,我们提出通过提取与对应对象相关的对齐信息来增强食谱和食品图像。具体而言,Llama2 用于从食谱生成文本描述,旨在捕捉食品图像的视觉线索;SAM 用于生成与食谱中关键成分对应的图像分割。为充分利用增强数据,我们引入了数据增强检索框架(DAR),以增强跨模态检索的食谱和图像表示学习。我们首先在预训练 CLIP 模型中注入适配器层,以降低计算成本而非完全微调所有参数。此外,提出多级圆形损失来对齐原始数据和增强数据对,该损失对正负样本对分配不同的惩罚。在 Recipe1M 数据集上,我们的 DAR 方法在现有方法中表现显著优于其他方法。广泛的消融研究验证了 DAR 每个组件的有效性。代码可在 magentahttps://github.com/Noah888/DAR 获取。
abstract_en: Learning recipe and food image representation in common embedding space is non-trivial but crucial for cross-modal recipe retrieval. In this paper, we propose a new perspective for this problem by utilizing foundation models for data augmentation. Leveraging on the remarkable capabilities of foundation models (i.e., Llama2 and SAM), we propose to augment recipe and food image by extracting alignable information related to the counterpart. Specifically, Llama2 is employed to generate a textual description from the recipe, aiming to capture the visual cues of a food image, and SAM is used to produce image segments that correspond to key ingredients in the recipe. To make full use of the augmented data, we introduce Data Augmented Retrieval framework (DAR) to enhance recipe and image representation learning for cross-modal retrieval. We first inject adapter layers to pre-trained CLIP model to reduce computation cost rather than fully fine-tuning all the parameters. In addition, multi-level circle loss is proposed to align the original and augmented data pairs, which assigns different penalties for positive and negative pairs. On the Recipe1M dataset, our DAR outperforms all existing methods by a large margin. Extensive ablation studies validate the effectiveness of each component of DAR. Code is available at magentahttps://github.com/Noah888/DAR.

title: Fanyue Wei, Wei Zeng, Zhenyang Li, Dawei Yin, Lixin Duan, Wen Li*
title_en: Fanyue Wei, Wei Zeng, Zhenyang Li, Dawei Yin, Lixin Duan, Wen Li*
abstract: 个性化文本到图像模型允许用户根据对象(由一组参考图像指定)生成多种风格的图像(由句子指定)。尽管基于扩散的生成模型已经取得了显著成果,但在扩散过程中,对象的视觉结构和细节常常意外地发生变化。一个主要原因在于,这些基于扩散的方法在训练过程中通常采用简单的重建目标,难以在生成图像和参考图像之间强制实现适当的结构一致性。为此,本文设计了一种新颖的强化学习框架,利用确定性策略梯度方法进行个性化文本到图像生成,从而可以轻松地将各种目标(包括微分或非微分目标)纳入其中,以监督扩散模型,提高生成图像的质量。在个性化文本到图像生成基准数据集上的实验结果表明,我们的方法在保持文本对齐的同时,在视觉保真度上显著优于现有最先进的方法。我们的代码可在以下链接获取:https://github.com/wfanyue/DPG-T2I-Personalization.
abstract_en: Personalized text-to-image models allow users to generate varied styles of images (specified with a sentence) for an object (specified with a set of reference images). While remarkable results have been achieved using diffusion-based generation models, the visual structure and details of the object are often unexpectedly changed during the diffusion process. One major reason is that these diffusion-based approaches typically adopt a simple reconstruction objective during training, which can hardly enforce appropriate structural consistency between the generated and the reference images. To this end, in this paper, we design a novel reinforcement learning framework by utilizing the deterministic policy gradient method for personalized text-to-image generation, with which various objectives, differential or even non-differential, can be easily incorporated to supervise the diffusion models to improve the quality of the generated images. Experimental results on personalized text-to-image generation benchmark datasets demonstrate that our proposed approach outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods by a large margin on visual fidelity while maintaining text-alignment. Our code is available at: https://github.com/wfanyue/DPG-T2I-Personalization.

title: Farzad Farhadzadeh*, Qiqi Hou, Hoang Le, Amir Said, Randall R Rauwendaal, Alex Bourd, Fatih Porikli
title_en: Farzad Farhadzadeh*, Qiqi Hou, Hoang Le, Amir Said, Randall R Rauwendaal, Alex Bourd, Fatih Porikli
abstract: 渲染技术的进步推动了纹理资产的显著增长,包括分辨率、复杂度和新型纹理组件,但数据量的增长并未得到压缩技术的相应发展。与此同时,神经图像压缩(NIC)取得了显著进展并展现出 promising results,但现有方法无法直接应用于神经纹理压缩。首先,纹理压缩需要在并行渲染(如 GPU 上的块纹理解压缩)中实现按需和实时解码,支持随机访问。此外,NIC 不支持多分辨率重建(mip-levels),也无法高效联合压缩不同纹理通道集合。本文提出了一种新颖的纹理集压缩方法,结合传统 GPU 纹理表示与 NIC 技术,旨在实现随机访问并支持多通道纹理集。为实现该目标,我们提出了一种非对称自编码器框架:编码器采用卷积网络在瓶颈-潜在空间中捕捉细节信息,解码器则利用全连接网络,其输入为采样的潜在特征加上位置信息,针对给定的纹理坐标和 mip 级别。该潜在数据通过调整扫描步长即可简化访问多分辨率数据。实验结果表明,该方法相比传统纹理压缩效果显著提升,并在最新神经网络方法基础上取得显著改进。
abstract_en: Advances in rendering have led to tremendous growth in texture assets, including resolution, complexity, and novel textures components, but this growth in data volume has not been matched by advances in its compression. Meanwhile Neural Image Compression (NIC) has advanced significantly and shown promising results, but the proposed methods cannot be directly adapted to neural texture compression. First, texture compression requires on-demand and real-time decoding with random access during parallel rendering (e.g. block texture decompression on GPUs). Additionally, NIC does not support multi-resolution reconstruction (mip-levels), nor does it have the ability to efficiently jointly compress different sets of texture channels. In this work, we introduce a novel approach to texture set compression that integrates traditional GPU texture representation and NIC techniques, designed to enable random access and support many-channel texture sets. To achieve this goal, we propose an asymmetric auto-encoder framework that employs a convolutional encoder to capture detailed information in a bottleneck-latent space, and at decoder side we utilize a fully connected network, whose inputs are sampled latent features plus positional information, for a given texture coordinate and mip level. This latent data is defined to enable simplified access to multi-resolution data by simply changing the scanning strides. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach provides much better results than conventional texture compression, and significant improvement over the latest method using neural networks.

title: Fazilet Gokbudak*, Alejandro Sztrajman, Chenliang Zhou, Fangcheng Zhong, Rafal Mantiuk, A. Cengiz Oztireli
title_en: Fazilet Gokbudak*, Alejandro Sztrajman, Chenliang Zhou, Fangcheng Zhong, Rafal Mantiuk, A. Cengiz Oztireli
abstract: 本文提出了一种从稀疏采样数据中估计测量BRDF的技术。我们的方法能够提供准确的BRDF重建,并可推广至新材质。这为从多种数据源进行BRDF重建打开了可能性。该方法的成功依赖于超网络生成稳健的BRDF表示能力,以及集合编码器允许将不同尺寸的输入馈入架构的能力。集合编码器和超网络还支持对密集采样的BRDF进行压缩。我们在包含100种各向同性材质的知名MERL数据集上,从定性和定量两个方面评估了该技术。我们的方法能够:1)即使在极端稀疏采样情况下,准确估计未见过材质的BRDF;2)将测量的BRDF压缩为非常小的嵌入,例如7维。
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce a technique to estimate measured BRDFs from a sparse set of samples. Our approach offers accurate BRDF reconstructions that are generalizable to new materials. This opens the door to BRDF reconstructions from a variety of data sources. The success of our approach relies on the ability of hypernetworks to generate a robust representation of BRDFs and a set encoder that allows us to feed inputs of different sizes to the architecture. The set encoder and the hypernetwork also enable the compression of densely sampled BRDFs. We evaluate our technique both qualitatively and quantitatively on the well-known MERL dataset of 100 isotropic materials. Our approach accurately 1) estimates the BRDFs of unseen materials even for an extremely sparse sampling, 2) compresses the measured BRDFs into very small embeddings, e.g., 7D.

title: Federica Arrigoni*, Andrea Fusiello, Tomas Pajdla
title_en: Federica Arrigoni*, Andrea Fusiello, Tomas Pajdla
abstract: 观测图是一种表示未校准相机及其几何关系的有效方法:节点对应相机,边表示基础矩阵。通过分析该图,可以确定该问题是否可解,即是否存在唯一(除单个射影变换外)的相机集合,与给定的基础矩阵兼容。本文在观测图可解性研究中取得了多项进展:我们提出了一种比以往文献更直接的问题表述方法,基于一个显式连接相机对的基础矩阵公式;我们引入了新的“”概念,证明其在理解真实结构从运动图中的实用性;我们提出了一种测试和提取不可解情况组件的算法,其效率优于以往方法;我们提出了一个关于与可解性关联的开放问题。
abstract_en: The viewing graph is a useful way to represent uncalibrated cameras and their geometric relationships: nodes correspond to cameras and edges represent fundamental matrices. By analyzing this graph, it is possible to establish if the problem is “solvable” in the sense that there exists a unique (up to a single projective transformation) set of cameras that are compliant with the given fundamental matrices. In this paper, we take several steps forward in the study of viewing graph solvability: we propose a new formulation of the problem that is more direct than previous literature, based on a formula that explicitly links pairs of cameras via their fundamental matrix; we introduce the new concept of “”, demonstrating its usefulness in understanding real structure from motion graphs; we propose an algorithm for testing and extracting components of unsolvable cases, that is more efficient than previous work; we set up an open question on the connection between and solvability.

title: Federico Nocentini*, Thomas Besnier, Claudio Ferrari, Sylvain Arguillere, Stefano Berretti, Mohamed Daoudi
title_en: Federico Nocentini*, Thomas Besnier, Claudio Ferrari, Sylvain Arguillere, Stefano Berretti, Mohamed Daoudi
abstract: 语音驱动的3D虚拟人物生成已成为研究人员关注的重要领域,面临诸多挑战。现有方法受限于固定拓扑结构的面部动画,其中通过逐点对应建立点集,且点的数量和顺序在模型可动画的所有身份中保持一致。在本工作中,我们提出了ScanTalk,一种能够对任意拓扑结构(包括扫描数据)的3D面部进行动画的新框架。我们的方法依赖于DiffusionNet架构来克服固定拓扑结构的限制,为更灵活和逼真的3D动画提供了有前景的途径。通过利用DiffusionNet的强大能力,ScanTalk不仅能够适应多样化的面部结构,还能在处理扫描数据时保持高保真度,从而提升生成的3D虚拟人物的真实性和通用性。通过与现有先进方法的全面比较,我们验证了所提方法的有效性,展示了其生成与现有技术相当的逼真虚拟人物的能力。尽管我们的主要目标是开发一种无拓扑约束的通用方法,但所有现有先进方法均受此类限制。代码和预训练模型可在https://github.com/miccunifi/ScanTalk获取。
abstract_en: Speech-driven 3D talking heads generation has emerged as a significant area of interest among researchers, presenting numerous challenges. Existing methods are constrained by animating faces with fixed topologies, wherein point-wise correspondence is established, and the number and order of points remains consistent across all identities the model can animate. In this work, we present ScanTalk, a novel framework capable of animating 3D faces in arbitrary topologies including scanned data. Our approach relies on the DiffusionNet architecture to overcome the fixed topology constraint, offering promising avenues for more flexible and realistic 3D animations. By leveraging the power of DiffusionNet, ScanTalk not only adapts to diverse facial structures but also maintains fidelity when dealing with scanned data, thereby enhancing the authenticity and versatility of generated 3D talking heads. Through comprehensive comparisons with state-of-the-art methods, we validate the efficacy of our approach, demonstrating its capacity to generate realistic talking heads comparable to existing techniques. While our primary objective is to develop a generic method free from topological constraints, all state-of-the-art methodologies are bound by such limitations. Code for reproducing our results, and the pre-trained model are available at https://github.com/miccunifi/ScanTalk.

title: Federico Stella*, Nicolas Talabot, Hieu Le, Pascal Fua
title_en: Federico Stella*, Nicolas Talabot, Hieu Le, Pascal Fua
abstract: 从有符号距离场(SDF)中提取表面可以通过传统算法(如Marching Cubes)实现。然而,由于这些算法依赖于表面两侧的符号翻转,因此无法直接应用于无符号距离场(UDF)。在本文中,我们提出了一种深度学习方法,将UDF局部转换为SDF,从而可以使用现有算法有效进行三角剖分。我们证明该方法在表面检测中比现有方法具有更高的准确性。此外,该方法能够很好地推广到未见过的形状和数据集,同时具备并行化能力。我们还通过将其与最先进的双网格方法DualMeshUDF结合使用,展示了该方法的灵活性。DualMeshUDF可以直接在UDF上运行,改进其结果并消除对参数调优的需求。
abstract_en: Extracting surfaces from Signed Distance Fields (SDFs) can be accomplished using traditional algorithms, such as Marching Cubes. However, since they rely on sign flips across the surface, these algorithms cannot be used directly on Unsigned Distance Fields (UDFs). In this work, we introduce a deep-learning approach to taking a UDF and turning it locally into an SDF, so that it can be effectively triangulated using existing algorithms. We show that it achieves better accuracy in surface detection than existing methods. Furthermore it generalizes well to unseen shapes and datasets, while being parallelizable. We also demonstrate the flexibily of the method by using it in conjunction with DualMeshUDF, a state of the art dual meshing method that can operate on UDFs, improving its results and removing the need to tune its parameters.

title: 王飞*
title_en: Fei Wang*
abstract: 从草图进行三维重建提供了一种提升三维建模效率的有效方法。然而,由于草图固有的抽象表示特性和多样性带来的困难,此类任务仍处于初步探索阶段。本文提出了一种新颖的深度神经网络模型Sketch2Vox,用于从单目草图进行三维重建。该模型以草图作为输入,首先将其转换为两种不同的表示形式,即二值图像和二维点云。其次,我们使用两个新开发的处理模块提取语义特征,包括针对二值图像分层抽象特征学习设计的SktConv模块,以及针对二维点云局部和全局上下文特征提取设计的SktMPFM模块。在将特征输入三维解码-精修模块进行细粒度重建之前,通过所提出的跨模态融合注意力模块根据其内部相关性将图像基特征图和点基特征图进行融合。最后,我们使用优化模块对生成的三维模型进行细节精修。为评估方法的效率,我们收集了一个包含超过12,000对草图-体素的大规模数据集,并将提出的Sketch2Vox与几种最先进的方法进行比较。实验结果表明,所提方法在重建质量方面优于其他方法。该数据集可在https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aXug8PcLnWaDZiWZrcmhvVNFC4n_eAih/view?usp=sharing公开获取。
abstract_en: 3D reconstruction from a sketch offers an efficient means of boosting the productivity of 3D modeling. However, such a task remains largely under-explored due to the difficulties caused by the inherent abstractive representation and diversity of sketches. In this paper, we introduce a novel deep neural network model, Sketch2Vox, for 3D reconstruction from a single monocular sketch. Taking a sketch as input, the proposed model first converts it into two different representations, i.e., a binary image and a 2D point cloud. Second, we extract semantic features from them using two newly-developed processing modules, including the SktConv module designed for hierarchical abstract features learning from the binary image and the SktMPFM designed for local and global context feature extraction from the 2D point cloud. Prior to feeding features into the 3D-decoder-refiner module for fine-grained reconstruction, the resultant image-based and point-based feature maps are fused together according to their internal correlation using the proposed cross-modal fusion attention module. Finally, we use an optimization module to refine the details of the generated 3D model. To evaluate the efficiency of our method, we collect a large dataset consisting of more than 12,000 Sketch-Voxel pairs and compare the proposed Sketch2Vox against several state-of-the-art methods. The experimental results demonstrate the proposed method is superior to peer ones with regard to reconstruction quality. The dataset is publicly available on https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aXug8PcLnWaDZiWZrcmhvVNFC4n_ eAih/view?usp=sharing.

title: Feichi Lu*, Zijian Dong*, Jie Song, Otmar Hilliges
title_en: Feichi Lu*, Zijian Dong*, Jie Song, Otmar Hilliges
abstract: 尽管在人体运动捕捉领域取得了进展,现有多视角方法在估计多人紧密互动时的3D姿态和形状仍面临挑战。这一困难源于对准确2D关节估计的依赖,而遮挡和身体接触导致的2D检测结果难以获得。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖方法,利用每个个体的个性化隐式神经化身作为先验,显著提升了该具有挑战性的姿态估计任务的鲁棒性和精度。具体而言,通过分层体积渲染从稀疏多视角视频中高效重建化身。重建的化身先验允许基于颜色和轮廓渲染损失直接优化3D姿态,绕过了与噪声2D检测相关的问题。为处理相互穿透现象,我们在化身重叠形状区域提出碰撞损失以添加穿透约束。此外,3D姿态和化身以交替方式进行优化。实验结果表明,我们的方法在多个公开数据集上达到了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Despite progress in human motion capture, existing multi-view methods often face challenges in estimating the 3D pose and shape of multiple closely interacting people. This difficulty arises from reliance on accurate 2D joint estimations, which are hard to obtain due to occlusions and body contact when people are in close interaction. To address this, we propose a novel method leveraging the personalized implicit neural avatar of each individual as a prior, which significantly improves the robustness and precision of this challenging pose estimation task. Concretely, the avatars are efficiently reconstructed via layered volume rendering from sparse multi-view videos. The reconstructed avatar prior allows for the direct optimization of 3D poses based on color and silhouette rendering loss, bypassing the issues associated with noisy 2D detections. To handle interpenetration, we propose a collision loss on the overlapping shape regions of avatars to add penetration constraints. Moreover, both 3D poses and avatars are optimized in an alternating manner. Our experimental results demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on several public datasets.

title: Feixiang Zhou, Bryan Williams, Hossein Rahmani*
title_en: Feixiang Zhou, Bryan Williams, Hossein Rahmani*
abstract: 缓解噪声伪标签问题仍然是半监督时序动作定位(SS-TAL)中的关键挑战。现有方法通常基于严格条件过滤伪标签,但往往分别评估分类和定位质量,导致伪标签排序和选择效果不佳。特别是,所选正样本中可能存在不准确的伪标签,同时可靠标签可能被错误分配到负样本中。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新颖的自适应伪标签学习(APL)框架,以提升伪标签选择效果。具体而言,为提高排序质量,提出自适应标签质量评估(ALQA)方法,联合学习分类置信度和定位可靠性,并基于联合得分动态选择伪标签。此外,我们提出实例级一致性判别器(ICD),通过实例间的内在一致性同时消除模糊正样本并挖掘潜在正样本,从而实现更精确的选择。我们进一步引入通用的无监督动作感知对比预训练(ACP),增强动作内部及动作与背景之间的判别能力,这对SS-TAL具有显著帮助。在THUMOS14和ActivityNet v1.3上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在多种半监督设置下均达到最先进性能。
abstract_en: Alleviating noisy pseudo labels remains a key challenge in Semi-Supervised Temporal Action Localization (SS-TAL). Existing methods often filter pseudo labels based on strict conditions, but they typically assess classification and localization quality separately, leading to suboptimal pseudo-label ranking and selection. In particular, there might be inaccurate pseudo labels within selected positives, alongside reliable counterparts erroneously assigned to negatives. To tackle these problems, we propose a novel Adaptive Pseudo-label Learning (APL) framework to facilitate better pseudo-label selection. Specifically, to improve the ranking quality, Adaptive Label Quality Assessment (ALQA) is proposed to jointly learn classification confidence and localization reliability, followed by dynamically selecting pseudo labels based on the joint score. Additionally, we propose an Instance-level Consistency Discriminator (ICD) for eliminating ambiguous positives and mining potential positives simultaneously based on inter-instance intrinsic consistency, thereby leading to a more precise selection. We further introduce a general unsupervised Action-aware Contrastive Pre-training (ACP) to enhance the discrimination both within actions and between actions and backgrounds, which benefits SS-TAL. Extensive experiments on THUMOS14 and ActivityNet v1.3 demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance under various semi-supervised settings.

title: Feiyu CHEN*, Wei Lin, Ziquan Liu, Antoni Chan
title_en: Feiyu CHEN*, Wei Lin, Ziquan Liu, Antoni Chan
abstract: 不可察觉的水印在保障图像内容真实性及创作者权益方面至关重要。近年来,一些领先的水印技术,特别是零比特水印技术,在图像水印中展现了出色的不可察觉性和鲁棒性。然而,这些方法存在安全缺陷,例如伪造风险以及用另一个水印轻易擦除现有水印的可能性,同时缺乏关于检测性能的统计保证。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新框架,用于训练秘密密钥网络(SKN),该网络作为不可复制的保护机制,用于保障嵌入的水印。SKN被训练使得自然图像的输出服从标准多变量正态分布。为了嵌入水印,我们对图像应用对抗攻击(修改后的PGD攻击),使得SKN生成一个长度更长的秘密密钥签名(SKS)。随后,我们推导出两种假设检验,通过SKN响应幅度和SKS角度检测图像中水印的存在,从而提供误报率的统计保证。我们的广泛实证研究表明,我们的框架在鲁棒性方面与现有方法相当,并在安全性和不可察觉性方面表现卓越。
abstract_en: Imperceptible watermarks are essential in safeguarding the content authenticity and the rights of creators in imagery. Recently, several leading approaches, notably zero-bit watermarking, have demonstrated impressive imperceptibility and robustness in image watermarking. However, these methods have security weaknesses, e.g., the risk of counterfeiting and the ease of erasing an existing watermark with another watermark, while also lacking a statistical guarantee regarding the detection performance. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework to train a secret key network (SKN), which serves as a non-duplicable safeguard for securing the embedded watermark. The SKN is trained so that natural images’ output obeys a standard multi-variate normal distribution. To embed a watermark, we apply an adversarial attack (a modified PGD attack) on the image such that the SKN produces a secret key signature (SKS) with a longer length. We then derive two hypothesis tests to detect the presence of the watermark in an image via the SKN response magnitude and the SKS angle, which offer a statistical guarantee of the false positive rate. Our extensive empirical study demonstrates that our framework maintains robustness comparable to existing methods and excels in security and imperceptibility.

title: Feng Cheng*, Mi Luo*, Huiyu Wang, Alex Dimakis, Lorenzo Torresani, Gedas Bertasius, Kristen Grauman
title_en: Feng Cheng*, Mi Luo*, Huiyu Wang, Alex Dimakis, Lorenzo Torresani, Gedas Bertasius, Kristen Grauman
abstract: 我们提出了一种3D感知的扩散模型,用于解决从第三人称(exocentric)视角到第一人称(egocentric)视角的转换任务——即从对应的第三人称图像生成第一人称视角图像。基于扩散模型生成逼真图像的能力,我们提出了一种基于Transformer的扩散模型,通过两种机制融合几何先验知识:(i) 第一人称点云光栅化和 (ii) 3D感知的旋转交叉注意力机制。第一人称点云光栅化将输入的第三人称图像转换为第一人称布局,随后被扩散图像Transformer使用。作为扩散Transformer去噪模块的一部分,3D感知的旋转交叉注意力机制进一步融合了源第三人称视角的3D信息和语义特征。我们的方法在具有挑战性和多样性的Ego-Exo4D多视角数据集上取得了最先进的结果,并在训练过程中未遇到的新环境中表现出强大的泛化能力。我们的代码、处理后的数据和预训练模型已公开在https://klauscc.github.io/4diff上。
abstract_en: We present , a 3D-aware diffusion model addressing the exo-to-ego viewpoint translation task — generating first-person (egocentric) view images from the corresponding third-person (exocentric) images. Building on the diffusion model’s ability to generate photorealistic images, we propose a transformer-based diffusion model that incorporates geometry priors through two mechanisms: (i) egocentric point cloud rasterization and (ii) 3D-aware rotary cross-attention. Egocentric point cloud rasterization converts the input exocentric image into an egocentric layout, which is subsequently used by a diffusion image transformer. As a component of the diffusion transformer’s denoiser block, the 3D-aware rotary cross-attention further incorporates 3D information and semantic features from the source exocentric view. Our achieves state-of-the-art results on the challenging and diverse Ego-Exo4D multiview dataset and exhibits robust generalization to novel environments not encountered during training. Our code, processed data, and pretrained models are publicly available at https://klauscc.github.io/ 4diff.

title: Feng Li*, Hao Zhang, Peize Sun, Xueyan Zou, Shilong Liu, Chunyuan Li, Jianwei Yang, Lei Zhang*, Jianfeng Gao*
title_en: Feng Li*, Hao Zhang, Peize Sun, Xueyan Zou, Shilong Liu, Chunyuan Li, Jianwei Yang, Lei Zhang*, Jianfeng Gao*
abstract: 在本工作中,我们引入__TITLE_MATH_1__,这是一个增强的图像分割基础框架,能够以所需的粒度对任何对象进行分割和识别。与基础分割模型SAM[?]相比,我们的模型具有两个独特优势:(i) 粒度可控性,即模型可以生成任意所需粒度的分割掩码,从对象到部件再到两者;(ii) 语义感知性,即模型同时预测不同粒度掩码的语义标签。为实现多粒度能力,我们提出了一种多选项学习方案,其中每个点击点生成多个粒度级别的掩码集合,对应一组真实掩码。为实现语义感知,我们整合了不同粒度级别的多个数据集,并通过解耦的对象和部件任务训练模型,以促进不同任务间的知识共享与迁移。据我们所知,这是首次在SA-1B、实例级和部件级分割数据集上联合训练模型。实验结果和可视化展示表明,我们的模型成功实现了预期目标。此外,我们证明了使用SA-1B定义的分割任务与其他分割任务(如全景和部件分割)进行多任务训练,可使所有分割任务的性能均有所提升。特别是,通过添加SAM数据,我们在COCO全景分割任务中取得了60.2 PQ的新最先进水平。
abstract_en: In this work, we introduce , an augmented image segmentation foundation for segmenting and recognizing anything at desired granularities. Compared to the foundational segmentation model SAM [?], our model has two unique advantages: (i) granularity-controllability in that the model can produce segmentation masks at any desired granularities, from objects to parts to both; (ii) semantic-awareness in that the model simultaneously predicts semantic labels for masks at different granularities. To enable multi-granularity capabilities, we propose a multi-choice learning scheme, where each click point generates a set of masks at multiple levels of granularity, corresponding to a set of ground-truth masks. To achieve semantic awareness, we consolidate multiple datasets of different levels of granularity and train our model using decoupled object- and part-based tasks to facilitate knowledge sharing and transfer among different tasks. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first attempt to jointly train a model on SA-1B, instance-level, and part-level segmentation datasets. Experimental results and visualizations demonstrate that our model successfully achieves the desired goals. Furthermore, we show that multi-task training using the segmentation task defined on SA-1B and other segmentation tasks (e.g., panoptic and part segmentation) leads to performance gains on all segmentation tasks. In particular, we achieve a new state-of-the-art in COCO panoptic segmentation 60.2 PQ by adding SAM data.

title: Feng Liu*, Tengteng Huang, Qianjing Zhang, Haotian Yao, Chi Zhang, Fang Wan, Qixiang Ye, Yanzhao Zhou*
