abstract: 我们提出GroundUp,这是首个用于城市区域三维体量构思的基于草图的构思工具。我们聚焦于早期阶段的城市设计,其中草图是常用工具,设计从平衡规划建筑体量(体量)和开放空间开始。本着以人类为中心的AI理念,我们旨在帮助建筑师通过在2D草图和3D模型之间轻松切换,快速修订设计想法,实现更流畅的迭代和想法共享。受建筑师反馈和现有工作流程的启发,我们的系统首先输入用户绘制的俯视图中多栋建筑的草图。随后,用户绘制所设想场地的透视草图。我们的方法设计用于利用两种草图中信息的互补性,使用户能够快速预览和调整推断出的3D形状。驱动所提出城市体量系统的模型包含两个主要组件。首先,我们提出了一种新颖的草图到深度预测网络,用于透视草图,利用俯视图草图形状。其次,我们将互补但稀疏的2D信号融合,以条件化一个常规训练的潜在扩散模型。其次,我们使用从透视草图中提取的深度线索作为扩散模型的条件,最终在俯视图中完成几何形状。扩散模型在高度场域中运行,因此我们的最终3D几何形状表示为高度场,使用户能够从地面开始构建城市。我们将发布代码、数据集和界面。代码、数据集和界面可在visual.cs.ucl.ac.uk/pubs/groundup获取。
abstract_en: We propose GroundUp, the first sketch-based ideation tool for 3D city massing of urban areas. We focus on early-stage urban design, where sketching is a common tool and the design starts from balancing planned building volumes (masses) and open spaces. With Human-Centered AI in mind, we aim to help architects quickly revise their ideas by easily switching between 2D sketches and 3D models, allowing for smoother iteration and sharing of ideas. Inspired by feedback from architects and existing workflows, our system takes as a first input a user sketch of multiple buildings in a top-down view. The user then draws a perspective sketch of the envisioned site. Our method is designed to exploit the complementarity of information in the two sketches and allows users to quickly preview and adjust the inferred 3D shapes. Our model, driving the proposed urban massing system, has two main components. First, we propose a novel sketch-to-depth prediction network for perspective sketches that exploits top-down sketch shapes. Second, we amalgamate the complimentary but sparse 2D signals to condition a customarily trained latent diffusion model. Second, we use depth cues derived from the perspective sketch as a condition to our diffusion model, which ultimately completes the geometry in a top-down view. The diffusion model works in the domain of a heightfield, Thus, our final 3D geometry is represented as a heightfield, allowing users to construct the city “from the ground up”. We will release the code, datasets, and interface. The code, datasets, and interface are available at visual.cs.ucl.ac.uk/pubs/groundup.

title: Go Ohtani*, Ryu Tadokoro, Ryosuke Yamada, Yuki M Asano, Iro Laina, Christian Rupprecht, Nakamasa Inoue, Rio Yokota, Hirokatsu Kataoka, Yoshimitsu Aoki
title_en: Go Ohtani*, Ryu Tadokoro, Ryosuke Yamada, Yuki M Asano, Iro Laina, Christian Rupprecht, Nakamasa Inoue, Rio Yokota, Hirokatsu Kataoka, Yoshimitsu Aoki
abstract: 本文研究了用于图像超分辨率(SR)的训练数据这一研究不足的影响。通常情况下,新颖的SR方法会在DIV2K和DF2K等常见训练数据集上进行开发和基准测试。然而,我们从多样性和质量的角度重新审视和思考训练数据,从而回答“SR训练对SR模型的重要性如何”这一问题。为此,我们提出了一种自动化的图像评估流程。通过该流程,我们将现有的高分辨率图像数据集与更大规模的图像数据集(如ImageNet和PASS)进行分层比较,以评估其性能。我们发现,具有(i)低压缩伪影、(ii)高图像内多样性(通过不同物体数量判断)以及(iii)大量来自ImageNet或PASS的图像的数据集均能积极提升SR性能。我们希望所提出的简单而有效的数据集整理流程能够为未来SR数据集的构建提供指导,并产生整体更好的模型。代码已发布在:https://github.com/gohtanii/DiverSeg-dataset
abstract_en: In this work, we investigate the understudied effect of the training data used for image super-resolution (SR). Most commonly, novel SR methods are developed and benchmarked on common training datasets such as DIV2K and DF2K. However, we investigate and rethink the training data from the perspectives of diversity and quality, thereby addressing the question of “How important is SR training for SR models?”. To this end, we propose an automated image evaluation pipeline. With this, we stratify existing high-resolution image datasets and larger-scale image datasets such as ImageNet and PASS to compare their performances. We find that datasets with (i) low compression artifacts, (ii) high within-image diversity as judged by the number of different objects, and (iii) a large number of images from ImageNet or PASS all positively affect SR performance. We hope that the proposed simple-yet-effective dataset curation pipeline will inform the construction of SR datasets in the future and yield overall better models. Code is available at: https://github.com/gohtanii/DiverSeg-dataset

title: Gongfan Fang*, Xinyin Ma, Michael Bi Mi, Xinchao Wang*
title_en: Gongfan Fang*, Xinyin Ma, Michael Bi Mi, Xinchao Wang*
abstract: 结构化剪枝通过移除冗余子结构来降低深度神经网络的计算开销。然而,评估不同子结构的相对重要性仍是一个重大挑战,尤其是在具有新颖机制和架构的先进视觉模型中,如自注意力、深度可分离卷积或残差连接。这些异构子结构通常表现出差异化的参数规模、权重分布和计算拓扑,给重要性比较带来显著困难。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种名为同构剪枝的简单方法,该方法在多种网络架构(如视觉Transformer和CNN)中均表现出色,并在不同模型规模上实现了竞争力的性能。同构剪枝源于一个观察:当在预定义的重要性准则下评估时,异构子结构在重要性分布上表现出显著差异,而同构结构则呈现相似的重要性模式。这启发我们对不同类型的子结构进行独立排序和比较,以实现更可靠的剪枝。我们在ImageNet-1K上的实验证明,同构剪枝超越了专门为Transformer或CNN设计的多种剪枝基线。例如,通过剪枝现成的DeiT-Base模型,我们将DeiT-Tiny的准确率从74.52%提升至77.50%。对于ConvNext-Tiny,我们将其性能从82.06%提升至82.18%,同时减少了参数数量和内存占用。代码已开源至https://github.com/VainF/Isomorphic-Pruning。
abstract_en: Structured pruning reduces the computational overhead of deep neural networks by removing redundant sub-structures. However, assessing the relative importance of different sub-structures remains a significant challenge, particularly in advanced vision models featuring novel mechanisms and architectures like self-attention, depth-wise convolutions, or residual connections. These heterogeneous substructures usually exhibit diverged parameter scales, weight distributions, and computational topology, introducing considerable difficulty to importance comparison. To overcome this, we present Isomorphic Pruning, a simple approach that demonstrates effectiveness across a range of network architectures such as Vision Transformers and CNNs, and delivers competitive performance across different model sizes. Isomorphic Pruning originates from an observation that, when evaluated under a pre-defined importance criterion, heterogeneous sub-structures demonstrate significant divergence in their importance distribution, as opposed to isomorphic structures that present similar importance patterns. This inspires us to perform isolated ranking and comparison on different types of sub-structures for more reliable pruning. Our empirical results on ImageNet-1K demonstrate that Isomorphic Pruning surpasses several pruning baselines dedicatedly designed for Transformers or CNNs. For instance, we improve the accuracy of DeiT-Tiny from 74.52% to 77.50% by pruning an off-the-shelf DeiT-Base model. And for ConvNext-Tiny, we enhanced performance from 82.06% to 82.18%, while reducing the number of parameters and memory usage. Code is available at https://github.com/ VainF/Isomorphic-Pruning.

title: Gonçalo José Dias Pais, Valter André Piedade, Moitreya Chatterjee, Marcus Greiff, Pedro Miraldo*
title_en: Gonçalo José Dias Pais, Valter André Piedade, Moitreya Chatterjee, Marcus Greiff, Pedro Miraldo*
abstract: 多种神经辐射场(NeRFs)的变体显著提高了合成图像的准确性以及3D场景/物体的表面重建效果。在所有这些方法中,一个关键特征是无法使用所有可能的输入数据训练神经网络,特别是每个像素和投影射线上的潜在3D点,这受限于可扩展性问题。虽然原始NeRFs对图像像素和投影射线上的3D点进行均匀采样,但一些变体仅关注引导投影射线上的3D点采样。在本文中,我们利用前景场景的隐式表面表示,并在3D图像投影空间中建模概率密度函数,以实现对感兴趣区域的更精准射线采样,从而提升渲染效果。此外,我们提出了一种新的表面重建损失函数以提高性能。该新损失函数充分探索了所提出的3D图像投影空间模型,并结合了近表面和空空间成分。通过将我们的新型采样策略和新型损失函数整合到当前最先进的神经隐式表面渲染器中,我们实现了更精确和详细的3D重建以及改进的图像渲染,特别是在任何给定场景中的感兴趣区域。项目页面:https://merl.com/research/highlights/ps-neus.
abstract_en: Several variants of Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) have significantly improved the accuracy of synthesized images and surface reconstruction of 3D scenes/objects. In all of these methods, a key characteristic is that none can train the neural network with every possible input data, specifically, every pixel and potential 3D point along the projection rays due to scalability issues. While vanilla NeRFs uniformly sample both the image pixels and 3D points along the projection rays, some variants focus only on guiding the sampling of the 3D points along the projection rays. In this paper, we leverage the implicit surface representation of the foreground scene and model a probability density function in a 3D image projection space to achieve a more targeted sampling of the rays toward regions of interest, resulting in improved rendering. Additionally, a new surface reconstruction loss is proposed for improved performance. This new loss fully explores the proposed 3D image projection space model and incorporates near-to-surface and empty space components. By integrating our novel sampling strategy and novel loss into current state-of-the-art neural implicit surface renderers, we achieve more accurate and detailed 3D reconstructions and improved image rendering, especially for the regions of interest in any given scene. Project page: https://merl.com/research/highlights/ps-neus.

title: Gopal Sharma*, Daniel Rebain, Kwang Moo Yi, Andrea Tagliasacchi
title_en: Gopal Sharma*, Daniel Rebain, Kwang Moo Yi, Andrea Tagliasacchi
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的神经辐射场(NeRF)表示方法,用于非不透明场景,通过利用纹理多边形实现快速推理。尽管NeRF能够提供高质量的新型视图渲染,但其关键限制在于依赖体渲染,这可能计算成本高昂且未充分利用现代图形硬件的进展。许多现有方法在建模体积效果时表现不足,因为它们仅依赖表面渲染。因此,我们提出使用多边形建模场景,从而获得用于建模体积效果所需的积分点,以及从纹理中获取其不透明度和颜色。为了获得此类多边形网格,我们训练一个专用场,其零交叉点对应于体渲染时的积分点,并在此场上执行Marching Cubes算法。随后进行光线追踪,并利用光线追踪着色器获取最终颜色图像。我们的方法允许轻松集成到现有图形框架中,能够在1920 × 1080图像上实现超过100帧/秒的渲染速度,同时仍能表示非不透明物体。
abstract_en: We propose a novel Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) representation for non-opaque scenes that enables fast inference by utilizing textured polygons. Despite the high-quality novel view rendering that NeRF provides, a critical limitation is that it relies on volume rendering that can be computationally expensive and does not utilize the advancements in modern graphics hardware. Many existing methods fall short when it comes to modelling volumetric effects as they rely purely on surface rendering. We thus propose to model the scene with polygons, which can then be used to obtain the quadrature points required to model volumetric effects, and also their opacity and colour from the texture. To obtain such polygonal mesh, we train a specialized field whose zero-crossings would correspond to the quadrature points when volume rendering, and perform marching cubes on this field. We then perform ray-tracing and utilize the ray-tracing shader to obtain the final colour image. Our method allows an easy integration with existing graphics frameworks allowing rendering speed of over 100 frames-per-second for a 1920 × 1080 image, while still being able to represent non-opaque objects.

title: Gowthami Somepalli*, Anubhav Gupta, Kamal Gupta, Shramay Palta, Micah Goldblum, Jonas A. Geiping, Abhinav Shrivastava, Tom Goldstein
title_en: Gowthami Somepalli*, Anubhav Gupta, Kamal Gupta, Shramay Palta, Micah Goldblum, Jonas A. Geiping, Abhinav Shrivastava, Tom Goldstein
abstract: 生成模型现在被图形设计师和艺术家广泛使用。先前的研究表明,这些模型在生成过程中会记住并经常复制其训练数据中的内容。因此,随着这些模型的普及,每次生成图像用于专业用途前,都需要进行数据库搜索以确定图像的属性是否可归因于特定的训练数据。现有工具主要关注检索语义内容相似的图像。同时,许多艺术家关注文本到图像模型中的风格复制问题。我们提出了一种理解并从图像中提取风格描述符的框架。我们的框架包含一个新数据集,该数据集通过风格是图像的主观属性这一洞察力进行整理,该属性捕捉了包括但不限于颜色、纹理、形状等复杂而有意义的交互因素。我们还提出了一种提取风格描述符的方法,可用于将生成图像的风格归因于文本到图像模型训练数据集中的图像。我们在各种风格检索任务中展示了有前景的结果。我们还对Stable Diffusion模型中的风格归因和匹配进行了定性和定量分析。
abstract_en: Generative models are now widely used by graphic designers and artists. Prior works have shown that these models remember and often replicate content from their training data during generation. Hence as their proliferation increases, it has become important to perform a database search to determine whether the properties of the image are attributable to specific training data, every time before a generated image is used for professional purposes. Existing tools for this purpose focus on retrieving images of similar semantic content. Meanwhile, many artists are concerned with style replication in text-to-image models. We present a framework for understanding and extracting style descriptors from images. Our framework comprises a new dataset curated using the insight that style is a subjective property of an image that captures complex yet meaningful interactions of factors including but not limited to colors, textures, shapes, We also propose a method to extract style descriptors that can be used to attribute style of a generated image to the images used in the training dataset of a text-to-image model. We showcase promising results in various style retrieval tasks. We also quantitatively and qualitatively analyze style attribution and matching in the Stable Diffusion model.

title: Grzegorz Rypeść*, Daniel Marczak, Sebastian Cygert, Tomasz Trzcinski, Bartlomiej Twardowski
title_en: Grzegorz Rypeść*, Daniel Marczak, Sebastian Cygert, Tomasz Trzcinski, Bartlomiej Twardowski
abstract: 广义持续类别发现(GCCD)旨在从按顺序到达且部分标记的数据集中学习,同时揭示新类别。传统方法依赖特征蒸馏以防止遗忘旧知识。然而,这种策略限制了模型适应和有效区分新类别的能力。为了解决这一问题,我们引入了一种新颖的技术,将可学习投影器与特征蒸馏相结合,从而在不牺牲旧知识的情况下增强模型的适应性。通过辅助类别适应网络缓解了先前学习类别的分布偏移。我们证明,尽管每个组件单独提供适度的益处,但它们的组合——称为CAMP(类别适应与投影蒸馏相结合)——显著改善了学习新信息与保留旧知识之间的平衡。CAMP在多个GCCD和类别增量学习场景中表现出优越的性能。代码可在Github上获取。
abstract_en: Generalized Continual Category Discovery (GCCD) tackles learning from sequentially arriving, partially labeled datasets while uncovering new categories. Traditional methods depend on feature distillation to prevent forgetting the old knowledge. However, this strategy restricts the model’s ability to adapt and effectively distinguish new categories. To address this, we introduce a novel technique integrating a learnable projector with feature distillation, thus enhancing model adaptability without sacrificing past knowledge. The resulting distribution shift of the previously learned categories is mitigated with the auxiliary category adaptation network. We demonstrate that while each component offers modest benefits individually, their combination – dubbed CAMP (Category Adaptation Meets Projected distillation) – significantly improves the balance between learning new information and retaining old. CAMP exhibits superior performance across several GCCD and Class Incremental Learning scenarios. The code is available on Github.

title: Guan Gui, Bin-Bin Gao*, Jun Liu, Chengjie Wang, Yunsheng Wu
title_en: Guan Gui, Bin-Bin Gao*, Jun Liu, Chengjie Wang, Yunsheng Wu
abstract: 由于工业检测中异常样本稀缺,异常检测是一项具有实际意义且具有挑战性的任务。一些现有方法通过合成噪声或外部数据来解决这一问题。然而,合成异常与真实世界异常之间始终存在较大的语义差距,导致异常检测性能较弱。为解决该问题,我们提出了一种少样本异常驱动生成(AnoGen)方法,该方法通过仅使用少量真实异常引导扩散模型生成逼真且多样的异常,从而有助于训练异常检测模型。具体而言,我们的工作分为三个阶段。第一阶段,我们基于少量给定的真实异常学习异常分布,并将所学知识注入嵌入向量中。第二阶段,我们利用嵌入向量和给定的边界框,引导扩散模型在特定对象(或纹理)上生成逼真且多样的异常。第三阶段,我们提出了一种弱监督异常检测方法,利用生成的异常训练更强大的模型。我们的方法以DRAEM和DesTSeg为基础模型,并在常用的工业异常检测数据集MVTec上进行实验。实验结果表明,我们生成的异常有效提升了异常分类和分割任务的模型性能,其中DRAEM和DesTSeg在分割任务中分别实现了5.8%和1.5%的AU-PR度量提升。代码和生成的异常数据可在https://github.com/gaobb/AnoGen获取。
abstract_en: Anomaly detection is a practical and challenging task due to the scarcity of anomaly samples in industrial inspection. Some existing anomaly detection methods address this issue by synthesizing anomalies with noise or external data. However, there is always a large semantic gap between synthetic and real-world anomalies, resulting in weak performance in anomaly detection. To solve the problem, we propose a few-shot Anomaly-driven Generation (AnoGen) method, which guides the diffusion model to generate realistic and diverse anomalies with only a few real anomalies, thereby benefiting training anomaly detection models. Specifically, our work is divided into three stages. In the first stage, we learn the anomaly distribution based on a few given real anomalies and inject the learned knowledge into an embedding. In the second stage, we use the embedding and given bounding boxes to guide the diffusion model to generate realistic and diverse anomalies on specific objects (or textures). In the final stage, we propose a weakly-supervised anomaly detection method to train a more powerful model with generated anomalies. Our method builds upon DRAEM and DesTSeg as the foundation model and conducts experiments on the commonly used industrial anomaly detection dataset, MVTec. The experiments demonstrate that our generated anomalies effectively improve the model performance of both anomaly classification and segmentation tasks simultaneously, , DRAEM and DseTSeg achieved a 5.8% and 1.5% improvement in AU-PR metric on segmentation task, respectively. The code and generated anomalous data are available at https://github.com/gaobb/AnoGen.

title: 陈广城*, 何毅成, 何立, 张虹
title_en: Guangcheng Chen*, Yicheng He, Li He, Hong Zhang
abstract: 神经隐式曲面重建近期取得了显著进展。尽管采用复杂的光照建模,现有方法在处理无纹理和镜面表面时仍存在困难。与RGB图像不同,偏振图像能够直接对表面法线的方位角提供约束。本文提出PISR,一种利用几何精确的偏振损失函数独立优化形状的新方法。此外,PISR在图像空间中平滑表面法线以消除严重形状失真,并借助基于哈希网格的神经符号距离函数加速重建。实验结果表明,PISR实现了更高的精度和鲁棒性,在1 mm尺度下L1 Chamfer距离为0.5 mm,F值达到99.5%,且收敛速度比现有偏振曲面重建方法快4~30倍。源代码可在https://github.com/GCChen97/PISR获取
abstract_en: Neural implicit surface reconstruction has achieved remarkable progress recently. Despite resorting to complex radiance modeling, state-of-the-art methods still struggle with textureless and specular surfaces. Different from RGB images, polarization images can provide direct constraints on the azimuth angles of the surface normals. In this paper, we present PISR, a novel method that utilizes a geometrically accurate polarimetric loss to refine shape independently of appearance. In addition, PISR smooths surface normals in image space to eliminate severe shape distortions and leverages the hash-grid-based neural signed distance function to accelerate the reconstruction. Experimental results demonstrate that PISR achieves higher accuracy and robustness, with an L1 Chamfer distance of 0.5 mm and an F-score of 99.5% at 1 mm, while converging 4 ∼ 30× faster than previous polarimetric surface reconstruction methods. The source code is available at https://github.com/GCChen97/PISR

title: 方广琪,王兵*
title_en: Guangchi Fang, Bing Wang*
abstract: 本研究探讨了在高斯分布数量受限的情况下高效表示场景的挑战。我们的分析从传统图形学和2D计算机视觉转向点云视角,指出高斯表示的空间分布效率低下是模型性能的关键限制。为解决这一问题,我们引入了包括模糊分割和深度重初始化在内的密集化策略,以及通过保持交集和采样进行的简化方法。这些技术重新组织了高斯分布的空间位置,从而在渲染质量、资源消耗和存储压缩方面在多个数据集和基准测试中实现了显著提升。我们的Mini-Splatting无缝集成于原始光栅化流程,为未来基于高斯光栅化的研究提供了坚实的基准。代码已提供。
abstract_en: In this study, we explore the challenge of efficiently representing scenes with a constrained number of Gaussians. Our analysis shifts from traditional graphics and 2D computer vision to the perspective of point clouds, highlighting the inefficient spatial distribution of Gaussian representation as a key limitation in model performance. To address this, we introduce strategies for densification including blur split and depth reinitialization, and simplification through intersection preserving and sampling. These techniques reorganize the spatial positions of the Gaussians, resulting in significant improvements across various datasets and benchmarks in terms of rendering quality, resource consumption, and storage compression. Our Mini-Splatting integrates seamlessly with the original rasterization pipeline, providing a strong baseline for future research in Gaussian-Splatting-based works. Code is available.

title: Guanghao Zheng, Yuchen Liu, Wenrui Dai*, Chenglin Li, Junni Zou, Hongkai Xiong
title_en: Guanghao Zheng, Yuchen Liu, Wenrui Dai*, Chenglin Li, Junni Zou, Hongkai Xiong
abstract: 视觉变换器(ViTs)在多模态人脸防伪(FAS)的缺失模态场景中效果显著下降。现有方法依赖模态不变特征来缓解这一问题,但忽略了模态特定特征。为解决此问题,我们提出了一种面向人脸防伪的缺失模态适配器框架(MMA-FAS),该框架通过模态解耦适配器和LBP引导的对比损失,显式结合模态不变与模态特定特征。模态解耦适配器从频率分解视角将特征解耦为模态不变与特定特征。LBP引导的对比损失结合批次级与样本级模态掩码策略,迫使模型根据攻击类型和模态组合对样本进行聚类,进一步增强模态特定特征。此外,我们提出了一种自适应模态组合采样策略,动态调整掩码策略中的样本概率,以平衡不同模态组合的训练过程。大量实验表明,所提出的方法在所有缺失模态场景下均实现了最先进的同数据集和跨数据集性能。
abstract_en: The effectiveness of Vision Transformers (ViTs) diminishes considerably in multi-modal face anti-spoofing (FAS) under missing modality scenarios. Existing approaches rely on modality-invariant features to alleviate this issue but ignore modality-specific features. To solve this issue, we propose a Missing Modality Adapter framework for Face Anti-Spoofing (MMA-FAS), which leverages modality-disentangle adapters and LBP-guided contrastive loss for explicit combination of modality-invariant and modality-specific features. Modality-disentangle adapters disentangle features into modality-invariant and -specific features from the view of frequency decomposition. LBP-guided contrastive loss, together with batch-level and sample-level modality masking strategies, forces the model to cluster samples according to attack types and modal combinations, which further enhances modality-specific and -specific features. Moreover, we propose an adaptively modal combination sampling strategy, which dynamically adjusts the sample probability in masking strategies to balance the training process of different modal combinations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art intra-dataset and cross-dataset performance in all the missing modality scenarios.

title: Guangrui Li, Rahul Duggal*, Aaditya Singh, Kaustav Kundu, Bing Shuai, Jonathan Wu
title_en: Guangrui Li, Rahul Duggal*, Aaditya Singh, Kaustav Kundu, Bing Shuai, Jonathan Wu
abstract: 鲁棒微调旨在将视觉-语言模型适配到下游任务,同时保留其对未见数据的零样本能力。近期研究引入了微调策略,以提升下游任务的分布内(ID)性能,同时最小化对未见数据的分布外(OOD)性能的下降。这种平衡通过将微调后的表示与预训练表示对齐,或限制微调权重与预训练模型之间的显著偏差来实现。在后一种方法中,正则化项被统一应用于所有参数。我们的工作提出根据每个神经元对微调数据集的重要性选择性地应用正则化项。为此,我们开发了一个重要性得分指标,量化每个神经元对下游任务的重要性,并据此开发了两种微调策略:重要性引导的有选择性微调和重要性引导的正则化。我们的方法可以与基于表示空间的方法同时使用,在参数空间基础上优于其他方法。我们在各种数据集的标准鲁棒微调基准上,实现了优于现有最佳方法的改进,适用于全样本和低样本设置。
abstract_en: Robust fine-tuning aims to adapt a vision-language model to downstream tasks while preserving its zero-shot capabilities on unseen data. Recent studies have introduced fine-tuning strategies to improve in-distribution (ID) performance on the downstream tasks while minimizing deterioration in out-of-distribution (OOD) performance on unseen data. This balance is achieved either by aligning the fine-tuned representations with the pre-trained ones or by constraining significant deviations in fine-tuned weights compared to the pre-trained model. In the latter approach, the regularization term is uniformly applied to all parameters. Our work proposes selectively applying the regularization term based on the importance of each neuron to the fine-tuning dataset. To this end, we have developed an importance-score metric to quantify each neurons’ importance to the downstream task, which we then leverage to develop two fine-tuning strategies: importance-guided selective fine-tuning and importance-guided regularization. Our approach can be used concurrently with representation space-based methods, outperforming other approaches based on parameter space. We achieve improvements over the state-of-the-art on standard robust fine-tuning benchmarks across various datasets, in both full-shot and low-shot settings.

title: 郑广涛*, 叶文倩, 张爱东
title_en: Guangtao Zheng*, Wenqian Ye, Aidong Zhang
abstract: 少样本图像分类器旨在以最小监督和有限数据识别和分类新数据,但常表现出对类别间虚假相关性及虚假属性的依赖,这种现象称为虚假偏差。虚假相关性通常存在于某些样本中,少样本分类器可能因这些相关性而受到虚假偏差的影响。目前缺乏自动基准系统来评估少样本分类器对虚假偏差的鲁棒性。本文提出了一种系统且严谨的基准框架FewSTAB,以公平地展示和量化少样本分类器对虚假偏差的多种鲁棒程度。FewSTAB创建了具有偏差属性的少样本评估任务,使得使用这些属性进行预测会导致性能下降。为构建这些任务,我们基于预训练的视觉-语言模型提出基于属性的样本选择策略,无需手动数据集构建。这使得FewSTAB能够利用任何现有测试数据自动基准虚假偏差。FewSTAB在评估维度上提供了新视角,并提供了构建鲁棒分类器的新设计指南。此外,它能够基准不同程度的虚假偏差,并支持不同鲁棒程度的设计。通过在三个数据集上的十种少样本学习方法实验验证了其有效性。我们希望该框架能启发新型鲁棒少样本分类器的设计。我们的代码可在https://github.com/gtzheng/FewSTAB获取。
abstract_en: Few-shot image classifiers are designed to recognize and classify new data with minimal supervision and limited data but often show reliance on spurious correlations between classes and spurious attributes, known as spurious bias. Spurious correlations commonly hold in certain samples and few-shot classifiers can suffer from spurious bias induced from them. There is an absence of an automatic benchmarking system to assess the robustness of few-shot classifiers against spurious bias. In this paper, we propose a systematic and rigorous benchmark framework, termed FewSTAB, to fairly demonstrate and quantify varied degrees of robustness of few-shot classifiers to spurious bias. FewSTAB creates few-shot evaluation tasks with biased attributes so that using them for predictions can demonstrate poor performance. To construct these tasks, we propose attribute-based sample selection strategies based on a pre-trained vision-language model, eliminating the need for manual dataset curation. This allows FewSTAB to automatically benchmark spurious bias using any existing test data. FewSTAB offers evaluation results in a new dimension along with a new design guideline for building robust classifiers. Moreover, it can benchmark spurious bias in varied degrees and enable designs for varied degrees of robustness. Its effectiveness is demonstrated through experiments on ten few-shot learning methods across three datasets. We hope our framework can inspire new designs of robust few-shot classifiers. Our code is available at https://github.com/ gtzheng/FewSTAB.

title: 翟广耀*, 埃文·皮纳尔·奥尔内克, 戴振宇, 廖若彤, 闫迪, 纳西尔·纳瓦布, 费德里科·托马巴里, 本杰明·布萨姆
title_en: Guangyao Zhai*, Evin Pınar Örnek, Dave Zhenyu Chen, Ruotong Liao, Yan Di, Nassir Navab, Federico Tombari, Benjamin Busam
abstract: 我们提出EchoScene,这是一种交互式且可控的生成模型,可在场景图上生成三维室内场景。EchoScene利用一种双分支扩散模型,该模型能够动态适应场景图。现有方法由于节点数量变化、多种边组合以及操作器引发的节点-边操作而难以处理场景图。EchoScene通过将每个节点与去噪过程相关联,并实现协作信息交换,从而增强对全局约束的可控且一致的生成。这通过形状和布局分支中的信息回声方案实现。在每次去噪步骤中,所有过程都会将其去噪数据与信息交换单元共享,该单元使用图卷积结合这些更新。该方案确保去噪过程受到对场景图整体理解的影响,从而促进全局一致场景的生成。生成的场景可以通过编辑输入场景图并在扩散模型中采样噪声在推理过程中进行操作。大量实验验证了我们的方法,该方法在保持场景可控性的同时,在生成保真度方面超越了先前方法。此外,生成的场景质量较高,因此可以直接与现成的纹理生成兼容。我们的代码和模型已开源。
abstract_en: We present EchoScene, an interactive and controllable generative model that generates 3D indoor scenes on scene graphs. EchoScene leverages a dual-branch diffusion model that dynamically adapts to scene graphs. Existing methods struggle to handle scene graphs due to varying numbers of nodes, multiple edge combinations, and manipulator-induced node-edge operations. EchoScene overcomes this by associating each node with a denoising process and enables collaborative information exchange, enhancing controllable and consistent generation aware of global constraints. This is achieved through an information echo scheme in both shape and layout branches. At every denoising step, all processes share their denoising data with an information exchange unit that combines these updates using graph convolution. The scheme ensures that the denoising processes are influenced by a holistic understanding of the scene graph, facilitating the generation of globally coherent scenes. The resulting scenes can be manipulated during inference by editing the input scene graph and sampling the noise in the diffusion model. Extensive experiments validate our approach, which maintains scene controllability and surpasses previous methods in generation fidelity. Moreover, the generated scenes are of high quality and thus directly compatible with off-the-shelf texture generation. Our code and models are open-sourced.

title: Guangyu Sun*, Matias Mendieta, Aritra Dutta, Xin Li, Chen Chen
title_en: Guangyu Sun*, Matias Mendieta, Aritra Dutta, Xin Li, Chen Chen
abstract: 多模态Transformer在不同领域取得了显著进展,但高质量数据的隐私问题阻碍了其进一步优化。联邦学习(FL)作为一种隐私保护范式,为在不直接访问各客户端原始数据的情况下训练模型提供了新思路。尽管其潜力巨大,但关于未配对单模态客户端与Transformer架构在联邦学习中的研究方向仍存在空白。为填补这一空白,本文在视觉-语言领域探索了一种迁移多模态联邦学习(MFL)场景,其中客户端的数据分布在不同数据集中。我们系统评估了当使用Transformer架构时现有方法的性能,并通过解决客户端间的同模态与跨模态差距,提出了一种新颖框架——联邦模态互补与协作(FedCola)。通过在多种联邦学习设置下的广泛实验,FedCola在性能上优于先前方法,为未来多模态Transformer的联邦训练提供了新视角。代码可在https://github.com/imguangyu/FedCola获取。
abstract_en: Multi-modal transformers mark significant progress in different domains, but privacy concerns on high-quality data hinder their further improvement. Federated learning (FL) has emerged as a promising privacy-preserving paradigm for training models without direct access to the raw data held by different clients. Despite its potential, a considerable research direction regarding the unpaired uni-modal clients and the transformer architecture in FL remains unexplored. To fill this gap, this paper explores a transfer multi-modal federated learning (MFL) scenario within the vision-language domain, where clients possess data of various modalities distributed across different datasets. We systematically evaluate the performance of existing methods when a transformer architecture is utilized and introduce a novel framework called Federated modality complementary and collaboration (FedCola) by addressing the in-modality and cross-modality gaps among clients. Through extensive experiments across various FL settings, FedCola demonstrates superior performance over previous approaches, offering new perspectives on future federated training of multi-modal transformers. Code is available at magentahttps://github.com/imguangyu/FedCola.

title: Guanren Qiao, Guiliang Liu*, Guorui Quan, Rongxiao Qu
title_en: Guanren Qiao, Guiliang Liu*, Guorui Quan, Rongxiao Qu
abstract: 智能车辆轨迹建模是交通仿真系统的核心组成部分。然而,这类轨迹预测器通常被训练以模仿人类驾驶员的运动行为。模仿模型往往难以捕捉数据分布长尾端的安全关键事件,尤其是在涉及多辆驾驶员的复杂环境中。本文通过博弈论视角解决这一挑战,利用一般和马尔可夫博弈建模车辆间的竞争性交互,并通过相关均衡表征安全关键事件。为实现该目标,我们预训练一个生成式世界模型以预测自动驾驶场景的环境动态。基于该世界模型,我们通过将乐观贝尔曼更新与磁镜下降结合到多智能体强化学习(MARL)算法的目标函数中,探查动作预测器以识别粗相关均衡(CCE)。我们进行了大量实验,证明我们的算法在竞争性自动驾驶环境中优于其他基线方法,能够高效缩小CCE差距并生成有意义的轨迹。代码已开源:https://github.com/qiaoguanren/MARL-CCE
abstract_en: Modeling the trajectories of intelligent vehicles is an essential component of a traffic-simulating system. However, such trajectory predictors are typically trained to imitate the movements of human drivers. The imitation models often fall short of capturing safety-critical events residing in the long-tail end of the data distribution, especially under complex environments involving multiple drivers. In this paper, we propose a game-theoretic perspective to resolve this challenge by modeling the competitive interactions of vehicles in a general-sum Markov game and characterizing these safety-critical events with the correlated equilibrium. To achieve this goal, we pretrain a generative world model to predict the environmental dynamics of self-driving scenarios. Based on this world model, we probe the action predictor for identifying the Coarse Correlated Equilibrium (CCE) by incorporating both optimistic Bellman update and magnetic mirror descent into the objective function of the Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) algorithm. We conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate our algorithm outperforms other baselines in terms of efficiently closing the CCE-gap and generating meaningful trajectories under competitive autonomous driving environments. The code is available at: https://github.com/qiaoguanren/ MARL-CCE.

title: Guansong Lu*, Yuanfan Guo, Jianhua Han, Minzhe Niu, Yihan Zeng, Songcen Xu, Wei Zhang, Hang Xu, Zhao Zhong, Zeyi Huang
title_en: Guansong Lu*, Yuanfan Guo, Jianhua Han, Minzhe Niu, Yihan Zeng, Songcen Xu, Wei Zhang, Hang Xu, Zhao Zhong, Zeyi Huang
abstract: 当前大规模扩散模型在条件图像合成领域实现了重大突破,能够解析文本、人体姿态和边缘等多样化提示信息。然而,其对大量计算资源和数据采集的依赖仍是制约因素。另一方面,现有扩散模型因图像分辨率和潜在空间嵌入结构不兼容,难以在统一框架下联合使用,这限制了其多控制信号的整合应用。为解决这些限制,我们提出“PanGu-Draw”,一种面向资源高效文本到图像合成的新型潜在扩散模型,能够灵活适配多种控制信号。我们首先提出一种资源高效的“时间解耦训练策略”,将单体文本到图像模型拆分为结构生成器和纹理生成器。每个生成器采用最大化数据利用和计算效率的训练方案,使数据准备工作量减少48%,训练资源消耗降低51%。其次,我们引入“Coop-Diffusion”算法,使不同潜在空间和预定义分辨率的预训练扩散模型能够在统一去噪过程中协同工作。这使得无需额外数据或重新训练即可实现任意分辨率的多控制图像合成。PanGu-Draw的实证验证表明其在文本到图像和多控制图像生成方面表现出色,为未来模型训练效率和生成多样性提供了有前景的发展方向。最大规模的5B参数T2I PanGu-Draw模型已在Ascend平台发布。项目页面:https://pangu-draw.github.io
abstract_en: Current large-scale diffusion models represent a giant leap forward in conditional image synthesis, capable of interpreting diverse cues like text, human poses, and edges. However, their reliance on substantial computational resources and extensive data collection remains a bottleneck. On the other hand, the integration of existing diffusion models, each specialized for different controls and operating in unique latent spaces, poses a challenge due to incompatible image resolutions and latent space embedding structures, hindering their joint use. Addressing these constraints, we present “PanGu-Draw”, a novel latent diffusion model designed for resource-efficient text-to-image synthesis that adeptly accommodates multiple control signals. We first propose a resource-efficient Time-Decoupling Training Strategy, which splits the monolithic text-to-image model into structure and texture generators. Each generator is trained using a regimen that maximizes data utilization and computational efficiency, cutting data preparation by 48% and reducing training resources by 51%. Secondly, we introduce “Coop-Diffusion”, an algorithm that enables the cooperative use of various pre-trained diffusion models with different latent spaces and predefined resolutions within a unified denoising process. This allows for multi-control image synthesis at arbitrary resolutions without the necessity for additional data or retraining. Empirical validations of Pangu-Draw show its exceptional prowess in text-to-image and multi-control image generation, suggesting a promising direction for future model training efficiencies and generation versatility. The largest 5B T2I PanGu-Draw model is released on the Ascend platform. Project page: https://pangu-draw.github.io

title: Guanting Dong*, Yueyi Zhang*, Xiaoyan Sun, Zhiwei Xiong
title_en: Guanting Dong*, Yueyi Zhang*, Xiaoyan Sun, Zhiwei Xiong
abstract: 近年来,飞行时间(ToF)深度去噪技术在去除多路径干扰(MPI)和散粒噪声方面取得了显著进展。然而,现有方法仅利用单帧ToF数据,忽略了帧间的相关性。本文提出首个基于学习的多帧ToF去噪框架。与现有方法不同,我们的框架通过邻近帧间的相关性引导ToF噪声去除过程,并引入置信度图。具体而言,我们设计了双相关估计模块,该模块同时利用帧内相关性和帧间相关性。帧内相关性明确建立了场景中几何物体空间位置的相关性,有助于深度残差初始化。帧间相关性则识别不同帧间ToF噪声分布的变化,从而定位强ToF噪声区域。为进一步利用双相关性,我们引入了置信度引导的残差回归模块,预测置信度图以指导残差回归过程,优先处理强ToF噪声区域。实验评估表明,我们的框架在有效降低强ToF噪声方面显著优于现有方法。源代码可在https://github.com/gtdong-ustc/multi-frame-tof-denoising获取。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in Time-of-Flight (ToF) depth denoising have achieved impressive results in removing Multi-Path Interference (MPI) and shot noise. However, existing methods only utilize a single frame of ToF data, neglecting the correlation between frames. In this paper, we propose the first learning-based framework for multi-frame ToF denoising. Different from existing methods, our framework leverages the correlation between neighboring frames to guide ToF noise removal with a confidence map. Specifically, we introduce a Dual-Correlation Estimation Module, which exploits both intra- and inter-correlation. The intra-correlation explicitly establishes the relevance between the spatial positions of geometric objects within the scene, aiding in depth residual initialization. The inter-correlation discerns variations in ToF noise distribution across different frames, thereby locating the regions with strong ToF noise. To further leverage dual-correlation, we introduce a Confidence-guided Residual Regression Module to predict a confidence map, which guides the residual regression to prioritize the regions with strong ToF noise. The experimental evaluations have consistently shown that our framework outperforms existing ToF denoising methods, highlighting its superior performance in effectively reducing strong ToF noise. The source code is available at https://github.com/gtdong-ustc/multi-frame-tof-denoising.

title: Guanxing Lu, Shiyi Zhang, Ziwei Wang*, Changliu Liu, Jiwen Lu, Yansong Tang
title_en: Guanxing Lu, Shiyi Zhang, Ziwei Wang*, Changliu Liu, Jiwen Lu, Yansong Tang
abstract: 在非结构化环境中执行基于语言的机器人操作任务对于通用智能机器人具有高度需求。传统机器人操作方法通常学习观察的语义表示以进行动作预测,这忽略了场景级别的时空动态以完成人类目标。在本文中,我们提出了一种名为ManiGaussian的动态高斯泼溅方法,用于多任务机器人操作,该方法通过未来场景重建挖掘场景动态。具体而言,我们首先构建了动态高斯泼溅框架,该框架推断高斯嵌入空间中的语义传播,其中语义表示用于预测最优机器人动作。然后,我们构建了一个高斯世界模型,对动态高斯泼溅框架中的分布进行参数化,通过未来场景重建在交互环境中提供信息性监督。我们在10个RLBench任务及其166种变体上评估了ManiGaussian,结果表明我们的框架在平均成功率达到13.1%的情况下优于最先进的方法。1 项目页面: https://guanxinglu.github.io/ManiGaussian/
abstract_en: Performing language-conditioned robotic manipulation tasks in unstructured environments is highly demanded for general intelligent robots. Conventional robotic manipulation methods usually learn a semantic representation of the observation for action prediction, which ignores the scene-level spatiotemporal dynamics for human goal completion. In this paper, we propose a dynamic Gaussian Splatting method named ManiGaussian for multi-task robotic manipulation, which mines scene dynamics via future scene reconstruction. Specifically, we first formulate the dynamic Gaussian Splatting framework that infers the semantics propagation in the Gaussian embedding space, where the semantic representation is leveraged to predict the optimal robot action. Then, we build a Gaussian world model to parameterize the distribution in our dynamic Gaussian Splatting framework, which provides informative supervision in the interactive environment via future scene reconstruction. We evaluate our ManiGaussian on 10 RLBench tasks with 166 variations, and the results demonstrate our framework can outperform the state-of-the-art methods by 13.1% in average success rate1 . 1 Project page: https://guanxinglu.github.io/ManiGaussian/

title: Guian Fang*, Wenbiao Yan, Yuanfan Guo, Jianhua Han, Zutao Jiang, Hang Xu, Shengcai Liao, Xiaodan Liang
title_en: Guian Fang*, Wenbiao Yan, Yuanfan Guo, Jianhua Han, Zutao Jiang, Hang Xu, Shengcai Liao, Xiaodan Liang
abstract: 文本到图像的扩散模型在条件图像生成领域取得了显著进展。然而,这些模型通常难以准确生成包含人类的图像,导致肢体变形等异常现象。这一问题主要源于扩散模型对肢体质量的识别与评估不足。为解决这一问题,我们引入了AbHuman,这是首个专注于解剖学异常的大型合成人类基准数据集。该基准包含56,000张合成人类图像,每张图像均标注有详细的边界框级标签,识别出18个不同类别中147,000个异常。基于此,可通过传统技术如负向提示和引导建立人类异常识别体系,从而提升图像生成质量。为进一步提升效果,我们提出HumanRefiner,一种新颖的即插即用方法,用于文本到图像生成中人类异常的粗粒度到细粒度优化。具体而言,HumanRefiner利用自诊断流程检测并修正粗粒度异常人体姿态和细粒度异常级别的问题,实现可逆姿态扩散生成。在AbHuman基准上的实验结果表明,HumanRefiner显著减少了生成偏差,在肢体质量方面相比最先进的开源生成器SDXL提升2.9倍,相比DALL-E 3在人类评估中提升1.4倍。我们的AbHuman数据集可在https://github.com/Enderfga/HumanRefiner获取。
abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models have significantly advanced in conditional image generation. However, these models usually struggle with accurately rendering images featuring humans, resulting in distorted limbs and other anomalies. This issue primarily stems from the insufficient recognition and evaluation of limb qualities in diffusion models. To address this issue, we introduce AbHuman, the first large-scale synthesized human benchmark focusing on anatomical anomalies. This benchmark consists of 56K synthesized human images, each annotated with detailed, bounding-box level labels identifying 147K human anomalies in 18 different categories. Based on this, the recognition of human anomalies can be established, which in turn enhances image generation through traditional techniques such as negative prompting and guidance. To further boost the improvement, we propose HumanRefiner, a novel plug-and-play approach for the coarse-to-fine refinement of human anomalies in text-to-image generation. Specifically, HumanRefiner utilizes a self-diagnostic procedure to detect and correct issues related to both coarse-grained abnormal human poses and fine-grained anomaly levels, facilitating pose-reversible diffusion generation. Experimental results on the AbHuman benchmark demonstrate that HumanRefiner significantly reduces generative discrepancies, achieving a 2.9x improvement in limb quality compared to the state-of-the-art open-source generator SDXL and a 1.4x improvement over DALL-E 3 in human evaluations. Our AbHuman dataset is available at https://github.com/Enderfga/HumanRefiner.

title: Guillaume Astruc*, Nicolas Gonthier, Clement Mallet, Loic Landrieu
title_en: Guillaume Astruc*, Nicolas Gonthier, Clement Mallet, Loic Landrieu
abstract: 地球观测(EO)中传感器的多样性和互补性要求开发定制化的自监督多模态学习方法。然而,当前的多模态EO数据集和模型通常专注于单一数据类型,要么是单日期图像,要么是时间序列,这限制了其应用效果。为解决这一问题,我们提出了OmniSat,一种新颖的架构,能够通过利用模态间的对齐性,在无标签的情况下将多样化的EO模态融合为具有表达力的特征。为验证我们的方法优势,我们通过增加新模态扩展现有数据集,创建了两个新的多模态数据集。在林业、土地覆盖分类和作物制图三个下游任务中,OmniSat无需监督即可学习到丰富的表征,在半监督和全监督设置中均达到最先进的性能。此外,我们的多模态预训练方案即使在仅有一个模态可用时也能提升性能。代码和数据集可在__ABS_MATH_1__获取。
abstract_en: The diversity and complementarity of sensors available for Earth Observations (EO) calls for developing bespoke self-supervised multimodal learning approaches. However, current multimodal EO datasets and models typically focus on a single data type, either mono-date images or time series, which limits their impact. To address this issue, we introduce OmniSat, a novel architecture able to merge diverse EO modalities into expressive features without labels by exploiting their alignment. To demonstrate the advantages of our approach, we create two new multimodal datasets by augmenting existing ones with new modalities. As demonstrated for three downstream tasks—forestry, land cover classification, and crop mapping—OmniSat can learn rich representations without supervision, leading to state-of-the-art performances in semi- and fully supervised settings. Furthermore, our multimodal pretraining scheme improves performance even when only one modality is available for inference. The code and dataset are available at .

title: Guillaume Jaume*, Anurag J Vaidya*, Andrew Zhang, Andrew Song, Richard J Chen, Sharifa Sahai, Dandan Mo, Emilio Madrigal, Long P Le, Faisal Mahmood*
title_en: Guillaume Jaume*, Anurag J Vaidya*, Andrew Zhang, Andrew Song, Richard J Chen, Sharifa Sahai, Dandan Mo, Emilio Madrigal, Long P Le, Faisal Mahmood*
abstract: 开发能够学习H&E十亿像素全切片图像(WSIs)通用且可迁移表示的自监督学习(SSL)模型,在计算病理学中变得越来越有价值。这些模型有望推动关键任务的发展,如少样本分类、切片检索和患者分层。现有方法通过将滑片的两种不同增强(或视图)对齐,将SSL原理从小图像(例如224×224块)扩展到整个滑片。然而,由此得到的表示仍受限于视图的临床和生物学多样性。相反,我们假设使用多种标记染色的滑片(如免疫组化)作为不同视图,可以形成丰富的任务无关训练信号。为此,我们引入了MADELEIN,一种用于滑片表示学习的多模态预训练策略。MADELEIN在大规模乳腺癌样本(N=4,211 个WSIs,跨五种染色)和肾移植样本(N=12,070 个WSIs,跨四种染色)上,通过双全局-局部跨染色对齐目标进行训练。我们在多种下游评估中展示了MADELEIN学习的滑片表示质量,涵盖形态学和分子分类到预后预测,共包含7,299 个WSIs,来自多个医学中心。代码见 https://github.com/mahmoodlab/MADELEIN
abstract_en: Developing self-supervised learning (SSL) models that can learn universal and transferable representations of H&E gigapixel whole-slide images (WSIs) is becoming increasingly valuable in computational pathology. These models hold the potential to advance critical tasks such as few-shot classification, slide retrieval, and patient stratification. Existing approaches for slide representation learning extend the principles of SSL from small images (e.g., 224×224 patches) to entire slides, usually by aligning two different augmentations (or views) of the slide. Yet the resulting representation remains constrained by the limited clinical and biological diversity of the views. Instead, we postulate that slides stained with multiple markers, such as immunohistochemistry, can be used as different views to form a rich task-agnostic training signal. To this end, we introduce , a multimodal pretraining strategy for slide representation learning. is trained with a dual global-local cross-stain alignment objective on large cohorts of breast cancer samples (N=4,211 WSIs across five stains) and kidney transplant samples (N=12,070 WSIs across four stains). We demonstrate the quality of slide representations learned by on various downstream evaluations, ranging from morphological and molecular classification to prognostic prediction, comprising 21 tasks using 7,299 WSIs from multiple medical centers. Code at https://github.com/mahmoodlab/MADELEIN

title: GuoQiang Zhao, JunJie Huang, Xiaoyun Yan*, Zhaojing Wang, Junwei Tang, Yangjun Ou, Xinrong Hu, Tao Peng
title_en: GuoQiang Zhao, JunJie Huang, Xiaoyun Yan*, Zhaojing Wang, Junwei Tang, Yangjun Ou, Xinrong Hu, Tao Peng
abstract: RGB-热(RGB-T)语义分割是多模态图像分割的重要研究分支。当前RGB-T语义分割方法普遍存在两个未解决且典型的缺陷。首先,它们缺乏开放词汇识别能力,这显著限制了其应用场景。其次,在融合RGB图像和热图像时,通常需要设计复杂的融合网络结构,这通常导致网络训练效率低下。我们提出OpenRSS,一种开放词汇RGB-T语义分割方法,以解决这两个缺陷。据我们所知,OpenRSS是首个具备开放词汇分割能力的RGB-T语义分割方法。OpenRSS通过向SAM添加所提出的热信息提示模块和动态低秩适应策略,对基本分割模型SAM进行修改,以实现RGB-T语义分割。这些设计有效融合了RGB和热信息,但可训练参数数量远少于其他方法。OpenRSS通过联合利用视觉-语言模型CLIP和修改后的SAM实现开放词汇能力。通过大量实验,OpenRSS在RGB-T图像上展示了有效的开放词汇语义分割能力。它在多个RGB-T语义分割基准测试中优于其他最先进的RGB开放词汇语义分割方法:在MFNet数据集上mIoU提升+12.1%,在MCubeS数据集上mIoU提升+18.4%,在Freiburg Thermal数据集上mIoU提升+21.4%。代码将发布在https://github.com/SXDR/OpenRSS。
abstract_en: RGB-Thermal (RGB-T) semantic segmentation is an important research branch of multi-modal image segmentation. The current RGB-T semantic segmentation methods generally have two unsolved and typical shortcomings. First, they do not have the open-vocabulary recognition ability, which significantly limits their application scenarios. Second, when fusing RGB and thermal images, they often need to design complex fusion network structures, which usually results in low network training efficiency. We present OpenRSS, the Open-vocabulary RGB-T Semantic Segmentation method, to solve these two disadvantages. To our knowledge, OpenRSS is the first RGB-T semantic segmentation method with open-vocabulary segmentation capability. OpenRSS modifies the basic segmentation model SAM for RGB-T semantic segmentation by adding the proposed thermal information prompt module and dynamic low-rank adaptation strategy to SAM. These designs effectively fuse the RGB and thermal information, but with much fewer trainable parameters than other methods. OpenRSS achieves the open-vocabulary capability by jointly utilizing the vision-language model CLIP and the modified SAM. Through extensive experiments, OpenRSS demonstrates its effective open-vocabulary semantic segmentation ability on RGB-T images. It outperforms other state-of-the-art RGB open-vocabulary semantic segmentation methods on multiple RGB-T semantic segmentation benchmarks: +12.1% mIoU on the MFNet dataset, +18.4% mIoU on the MCubeS dataset, and +21.4% mIoU on the Freiburg Thermal dataset. Code will be released at https://github.com/SXDR/OpenRSS.

title: Guohao Sun*, Can Qin, JIAMINAN WANG, Zeyuan Chen, Ran Xu, Zhiqiang Tao
title_en: Guohao Sun*, Can Qin, JIAMINAN WANG, Zeyuan Chen, Ran Xu, Zhiqiang Tao
abstract: 近年来,视觉语言模型在视觉指令调优的推动下展现出在广泛任务中的显著泛化能力。然而,预训练视觉编码器与大语言模型(LLMs)之间的鸿沟成为整个网络的瓶颈。为提升跨模态对齐,现有方法通常通过增加覆盖更广泛视觉任务的视觉指令数据进行微调,但此类数据获取成本高昂且未充分挖掘图像中蕴含的丰富上下文信息。本文首次尝试利用视觉指令数据中被忽视的上下文信息,训练模型实现自监督的“学习”如何生成高质量问题。通过这种方式,我们提出了一种名为SQ-LLaVA的创新框架:面向大型视觉语言助手的自问自答机制。SQ-LLaVA在分析视觉线索和语言先验知识的基础上,展现出生成灵活且有意义的图像相关问题的能力,标志着视觉理解能力的显著提升。此外,基于高质量指令数据对SQ-LLaVA进行微调,其性能相较传统视觉指令调优方法有所提升。这一改进凸显了自问自答技术在实现跨多种场景下更深层次、更细腻的视觉内容理解方面的有效性。我们的代码已开源,详见https://github.com/heliossun/SQ-LLaVA。
abstract_en: Recent advances in vision-language models have shown notable generalization in broad tasks through visual instruction tuning. However, bridging the gap between the pre-trained vision encoder and the large language models (LLMs) becomes the whole network’s bottleneck. To improve cross-modality alignment, existing works usually consider more visual instruction data covering a broader range of vision tasks to fine-tune the model for question-answering, which, however, is costly to obtain and has not thoroughly explored the rich contextual information contained in images. This paper first attempts to harness the overlooked context within visual instruction data, training the model to self-supervised “learning” how to ask high-quality questions. In this way, we introduce a novel framework named SQ-LLaVA: Self-Questioning for Large Vision-Language Assistant. SQ-LLaVA exhibits proficiency in generating flexible and meaningful image-related questions while analyzing the visual clue and prior language knowledge, signifying an advanced level of generalized visual understanding. Moreover, fine-tuning SQ-LLaVA on higher-quality instruction data shows a performance improvement compared with traditional visual-instruction tuning methods. This improvement highlights the efficacy of self-questioning techniques in achieving a deeper and more nuanced comprehension of visual content across various contexts. Our code is available at https://github.com/heliossun/SQ-LLaVA.

title: 张国强*, J.P. Lewis, W. Bastiaan Kleijn
title_en: Guoqiang Zhang*, j.p. lewis, W. Bastiaan Kleijn
abstract: 近年来,已提出多种方法解决DDIM反向推导中的不一致性问题,以实现图像编辑,例如EDICT[?]和Null-text反向推导[?]。然而,上述方法引入了较大的计算开销。本文提出了一种名为双向积分近似(BDIA)的新技术,可在计算开销可以忽略不计的情况下实现精确扩散逆过程。我们考虑通过平均正向和反向DDIM步骤得到的一类二阶积分算法。所提出的方法将下一步的扩散状态估计为当前步骤估计的高斯噪声与前一步和当前扩散状态的线性组合。这使得在已知当前和下一步状态的情况下,能够精确计算前一步状态,从而实现精确的扩散逆过程。我们对BDIA-DDIM进行了收敛性分析,包括DDIM作为特例的分析。实验表明,BDIA-DDIM在(往返式)提示驱动的图像编辑中表现出色。我们的实验进一步表明,BDIA-DDIM在文本到图像生成和传统图像采样中,生成的图像采样质量显著优于DDIM和EDICT。1 1 BDIA还可用于改进其他ODE求解器的性能,除了DDIM。特别是,发现将BDIA应用于EDM采样过程,在四个预训练模型上均表现出更一致的性能(见附录??中的Alg. ??和Table ??)。
abstract_en: Recently, various methods have been proposed to address the inconsistency issue of DDIM inversion to enable image editing, such as EDICT [?] and Null-text inversion [?]. However, the above methods introduce considerable computational overhead. In this paper, we propose a new technique, named bidirectional integration approximation (BDIA), to perform exact diffusion inversion with negligible computational overhead. We consider a family of second order integration algorithms obtained by averaging forward and backward DDIM steps. The resulting approach estimates the next diffusion state as a linear combination of the estimated Gaussian noise at the current step and the previous and current diffusion states. This allows for exact backward computation of previous state given the current and next ones, leading to exact diffusion inversion. We perform a convergence analysis for BDIA-DDIM that includes the analysis for DDIM as a special case. It is demonstrated with experiments that BDIA-DDIM is effective for (round-trip) prompt-driven image editing. Our experiments further show that BDIA-DDIM produces markedly better image sampling quality than DDIM and EDICT for text-to-image generation and conventional image sampling.1 1 BDIA can also be applied to improve the performance of other ODE solvers in addition to DDIM. In particular, it is found that applying BDIA to the EDM sampling procedure produces consistently better performance over four pre-trained models (see Alg. ?? and Table ?? in Appendix ??).

title: Guoqing Wang, Zhongdao Wang, Pin Tang, Jilai Zheng, Xiangxuan Ren, Bailan Feng, Chao Ma*
title_en: Guoqing Wang, Zhongdao Wang, Pin Tang, Jilai Zheng, Xiangxuan Ren, Bailan Feng, Chao Ma*
abstract: 现有的三维语义占据预测方法通常将任务视为单次三维体素分割问题,专注于输入与占据图之间的单步映射,这限制了其对局部区域逐步细化和补全的能力。本文提出OccGen,一种简单而强大的生成式感知模型,用于三维语义占据预测。OccGen采用“噪声到占据”的生成范式,通过预测并消除来自随机高斯分布的噪声,逐步推断和细化占据图。OccGen包含两个主要组件:一个能够处理多模态输入的条件编码器,以及一个使用多模态特征作为条件的渐进式细化解码器,应用扩散去噪技术。该生成流程的关键洞察在于,扩散去噪过程天然能够建模密集三维占据图的由粗到细细化,从而生成更详细的预测结果。在多个占据基准数据集上的大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性,相较于现有最先进方法,OccGen在nuScenes-Occupancy数据集的多模态、仅激光雷达和仅摄像头设置下,分别相对提升了mIoU 9.5%、6.3%和13.3%。此外,作为生成式感知模型,OccGen展现出判别模型无法实现的特性,例如在多步预测中提供不确定性估计。
abstract_en: Existing 3D semantic occupancy prediction methods typically treat the task as a one-shot 3D voxel-wise segmentation problem, focusing on a single-step mapping between the inputs and occupancy maps, which limits their ability to refine and complete local regions gradually. In this paper, we introduce OccGen, a simple yet powerful generative perception model for 3D semantic occupancy prediction. OccGen adopts a “noise-to-occupancy” generative paradigm, progressively inferring and refining the occupancy map by predicting and eliminating noise originating from a random Gaussian distribution. OccGen consists of two main components: a conditional encoder that is capable of processing multi-modal inputs, and a progressive refinement decoder that applies diffusion denoising using the multi-modal features as conditions. A key insight of this generative pipeline is that the diffusion denoising process is naturally able to model the coarse-to-fine refinement of the dense 3D occupancy map, therefore producing more detailed predictions. Extensive experiments on several occupancy benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method compared to the state-of-the-art methods. For instance, OccGen relatively enhances the mIoU by 9.5%, 6.3%, and 13.3% on nuScenes-Occupancy dataset under the muli-modal, LiDAR-only, and camera-only settings, respectively. Moreover, as a generative perception model, OccGen exhibits desirable properties that discriminative models cannot achieve, such as providing uncertainty estimates alongside its multiple-step predictions.

title: Guowei Xu, Jiale Tao, Wen Li*, Lixin Duan
title_en: Guowei Xu, Jiale Tao, Wen Li*, Lixin Duan
abstract: 在随机人类运动预测(SHMP)领域,研究者常采用生成模型如生成对抗网络(GANs)、变分自编码器(VAEs)和扩散模型。然而,大多数先前方法由于缺乏对潜在分布的指导,难以准确预测既真实又与过去运动连贯的运动。本文提出语义潜在方向(SLD)作为解决方案,旨在通过约束潜在空间以学习有意义的运动语义,提升SHMP的准确性。SLD定义一系列正交潜在方向,并将未来运动的假设表示为这些方向的线性组合。通过构建此类信息瓶颈,SLD在捕捉有意义的运动语义方面表现出色,从而提升运动预测精度。此外,SLD通过在推理阶段调整潜在方向的系数,实现可控的预测能力。进一步扩展SLD,我们引入一组运动查询以增强预测多样性。通过将这些运动查询与SLD空间对齐,SLD被进一步提升至更准确且连贯的运动预测。通过在广泛基准上进行大量实验,我们展示了该方法在准确预测运动的同时保持真实性和多样性的平衡优势。代码和预训练模型可在https://github.com/GuoweiXu368/SLD-HMP获取。
abstract_en: In the realm of stochastic human motion prediction (SHMP), researchers have often turned to generative models like GANS, VAEs and diffusion models. However, most previous approaches have struggled to accurately predict motions that are both realistic and coherent with past motion due to a lack of guidance on the latent distribution. In this paper, we introduce Semantic Latent Directions (SLD) as a solution to this challenge, aiming to constrain the latent space to learn meaningful motion semantics and enhance the accuracy of SHMP. SLD defines a series of orthogonal latent directions and represents the hypothesis of future motion as a linear combination of these directions. By creating such an information bottleneck, SLD excels in capturing meaningful motion semantics, thereby improving the precision of motion predictions. Moreover, SLD offers controllable prediction capabilities by adjusting the coefficients of the latent directions during the inference phase. Expanding on SLD, we introduce a set of motion queries to enhance the diversity of predictions. By aligning these motion queries with the SLD space, SLD is further promoted to more accurate and coherent motion predictions. Through extensive experiments conducted on widely used benchmarks, we showcase the superiority of our method in accurately predicting motions while maintaining a balance of realism and diversity. Our code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/GuoweiXu368/SLD-HMP.

title: 三维目标检测
title_en: Guowen Zhang*, Junsong Fan, Liyi Chen, Zhaoxiang Zhang, Zhen Lei, Lei Zhang
abstract: 三维目标检测是场景理解的关键组成部分。然而,大规模三维数据集的标注需要大量的人力投入。为了解决这一问题,许多方法采用弱监督三维目标检测,通过利用二维框和场景/类别特定的先验知识来估计三维框。然而,这些方法通常依赖复杂的手动先验知识,难以推广到新类别和场景。在本文中,我们提出了一种通用方法,可以轻松适应新场景和/或类别。开发了一个统一框架,从RGB图像和相关的二维框中学习三维目标检测器。具体而言,我们提出了三个通用组件:先验注入模块,从大型语言模型中获取通用物体几何先验;二维空间投影约束,最小化投影三维框边界与图像平面上对应二维框之间的差异;三维空间几何约束,构建点到框对齐损失以进一步优化估计的三维框姿态。在KITTI和SUN-RGBD数据集上的实验表明,仅使用二维标注,我们的方法就能生成高质量的三维边界框。源代码可在https://github.com/gwenzhang/GGA获取。
abstract_en: 3D object detection is an indispensable component for scene understanding. However, the annotation of large-scale 3D datasets requires significant human effort. To tackle this problem, many methods adopt weakly supervised 3D object detection that estimates 3D boxes by leveraging 2D boxes and scene/class-specific priors. However, these approaches generally depend on sophisticated manual priors, which is hard to generalize to novel categories and scenes. In this paper, we are motivated to propose a general approach, which can be easily adapted to new scenes and/or classes. A unified framework is developed for learning 3D object detectors from RGB images and associated 2D boxes. In specific, we propose three general components: prior injection module to obtain general object geometric priors from LLM model, 2D space projection constraint to minimize the discrepancy between the boundaries of projected 3D boxes and their corresponding 2D boxes on the image plane, and 3D space geometry constraint to build a Point-to-Box alignment loss to further refine the pose of estimated 3D boxes. Experiments on KITTI and SUN-RGBD datasets demonstrate that our method yields surprisingly high-quality 3D bounding boxes with only 2D annotation. The source code is available at https://github.com/gwenzhang/GGA.

title: Guoxing Sun*, Rishabh Dabral, Pascal Fua, Christian Theobalt, Marc Habermann
title_en: Guoxing Sun*, Rishabh Dabral, Pascal Fua, Christian Theobalt, Marc Habermann
abstract: 从稀疏RGB观测中实现忠实的人体性能捕捉和自由视角渲染是计算机视觉与图形学领域长期存在的难题。主要挑战在于观测数据的不足以及场景固有的歧义性,例如遮挡和深度不确定性。因此,尽管辐射场在密集设置中表现出色,能够捕捉高频外观和几何细节,但在稀疏相机视角上直接监督时效果不佳,因为场会过度拟合稀疏视角输入。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种方法,能够在极稀疏甚至单视角下实现高效且高质量的几何恢复和新视角合成。我们的核心思想是仅从潜在稀疏多视角视频中元学习辐射场权重,这些权重可作为先验知识,在稀疏图像上微调时提供良好的网络权重初始化,从而有效解决稀疏视角捕捉中的歧义性。由于人体结构的关节性和运动引起的表面形变,学习此类先验知识具有挑战性。因此,我们提出在姿态规范化的空间中元学习场权重,这减少了空间特征范围,使特征学习更加有效。因此,可以快速微调我们的场参数,以推广到未见过的姿态、新的光照条件以及新的稀疏(甚至单目)相机视角。为了在不同场景下评估我们的方法,我们收集了一个新数据集,该数据集包含在密集相机穹顶和野外稀疏相机设备中拍摄的受试者,并在公共数据集和我们的数据集上展示了优于近期最先进方法的优异结果。
abstract_en: Faithful human performance capture and free-view rendering from sparse RGB observations is a long-standing problem in Vision and Graphics. The main challenges are the lack of observations and the inherent ambiguities of the setting, e.g. occlusions and depth ambiguity. As a result, radiance fields, which have shown great promise in capturing high-frequency appearance and geometry details in dense setups, perform poorly when naı̈vely supervising them on sparse camera views, as the field simply overfits to the sparse-view inputs. To address this, we propose , a method for efficient and high-quality geometry recovery and novel view synthesis given very sparse or even a single view of the human. Our key idea is to meta-learn the radiance field weights solely from potentially sparse multi-view videos, which can serve as a prior when fine-tuning them on sparse imagery depicting the human. This prior provides a good network weight initialization, thereby effectively addressing ambiguities in sparse-view capture. Due to the articulated structure of the human body and motion-induced surface deformations, learning such a prior is non-trivial. Therefore, we propose to meta-learn the field weights in a pose-canonicalized space, which reduces the spatial feature range and makes feature learning more effective. Consequently, one can fine-tune our field parameters to quickly generalize to unseen poses, novel illumination conditions as well as novel and sparse (even monocular) camera views. For evaluating our method under different scenarios, we collect a new dataset, , which contains subjects captured in, both, a dense camera dome and in-the-wild sparse camera rigs, and demonstrate superior results compared to recent state-of-the-art methods on, both, public and dataset.

title: Guoxing Zhang, Yiming Liu, xiaoyu yang, Chao Huang*, HUANG Hailong
title_en: Guoxing Zhang, Yiming Liu, xiaoyu yang, Chao Huang*, HUANG Hailong
abstract: 在自主仿真与监控领域,真实场景对于推动目标检测算法的发展至关重要。现有空载数据集存在样本类别不平衡问题,尤其在大型车辆如卡车等场景中表现突出,且光照条件不真实。这阻碍了驾驶行为分析与模仿的进步。为解决这些局限性,我们引入了一个新颖的多模态车辆监控数据集,整合了空载热红外与sRGB图像。其贡献包括:(1) 一个新的热红外车辆检测基准,确保在夜间光照条件下实现稳健的目标检测。(2) 与高精度地图(HD-MAP)配对的热红外监控视频,以提升多车辆跟踪性能。(3) 针对半挂车的专用标注,精确记录其运动轨迹与物理坐标。TrafficNight显著提升了对交通动态中大型车辆的理解,为增强自动驾驶系统和复杂环境下的交通监控提供了基准。1 1 详见TrafficNight项目网页获取代码和更多信息。
abstract_en: In autonomous simulation and surveillance, realistic scenarios are crucial for advancing object detection algorithms. Existing aerial datasets suffer from sample class imbalance, especially in larger vehicles like trucks, and unrealistic lighting conditions. This hampers progress in driving behavior analysis and imitation. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel multimodal vehicle surveillance dataset, integrating aerial thermal infrared and sRGB imagery. It contributes: (1) A novel thermal infrared vehicle detection benchmark, ensuring robust object detection in nighttime lighting conditions. (2) Thermal infrared surveillance videos paired with corresponding HD-MAPs for improved multi-vehicle tracking. (3) Specialized annotations for semi-trailers, precisely documenting their movement trajectories and physical coordinates. TrafficNight significantly advances understanding of larger vehicles in traffic dynamics, serving as a benchmark for enhancing Autopilot systems and traffic surveillance in challenging environments. 1 1 See TrafficNight project webpage for the code and more.

title: Gustavo Perez*, Daniel Sheldon, Grant Van Horn, Subhransu Maji
title_en: Gustavo Perez*, Daniel Sheldon, Grant Van Horn, Subhransu Maji
abstract: 基于计算机视觉的重新识别(Re-ID)系统正越来越多地用于估计大型图像集合中的种群数量。然而,当任务具有挑战性或部署在新分布的数据上时,估计的种群数量可能显著不准确。我们提出了一种人类参与的方法,通过基于现成Re-ID系统的成对相似性来驱动种群数量的估计。我们的方法基于嵌套重要性采样,根据成对相似性选择图像对供人类验证,并产生渐近无偏的种群数量估计及其置信区间。我们在多个动物Re-ID数据集上进行了实验,证明我们的方法优于强大的基线和主动聚类方法。在许多情况下,我们能够通过验证总图像对中的一小部分(通常少于0.002%),将仅使用CV估计的误差率从约80%降低至低于20%。随着准确率的提高,验证成本降低,为在部署Re-ID系统时在可接受的容忍度内进行种群数量估计提供了实用方法。1 1 代码可在:https://github.com/cvl-umass/counting-clusters 获取
abstract_en: Computer vision-based re-identification (Re-ID) systems are increasingly being deployed for estimating population size in large image collections. However, the estimated size can be significantly inaccurate when the task is challenging or when deployed on data from new distributions. We propose a human-in-the-loop approach for estimating population size driven by a pairwise similarity derived from an off-the-shelf Re-ID system. Our approach, based on nested importance sampling, selects pairs of images for human vetting driven by the pairwise similarity, and produces asymptotically unbiased population size estimates with associated confidence intervals. We perform experiments on various animal Re-ID datasets and demonstrate that our method outperforms strong baselines and active clustering approaches. In many cases, we are able to reduce the error rates of the estimated size from around 80% using CV alone to less than 20% by vetting a fraction (often less than 0.002%) of the total pairs. The cost of vetting reduces with the increase in accuracy and provides a practical approach for population size estimation within a desired tolerance when deploying Re-ID systems.1 1 Code available at: https://github.com/cvl-umass/counting-clusters

title: Guénolé Fiche*, Simon Leglaive, Xavier Alameda-Pineda, Antonio Agudo, Francesc Moreno
title_en: Guénolé Fiche*, Simon Leglaive, Xavier Alameda-Pineda, Antonio Agudo, Francesc Moreno
abstract: 以往关于从RGB图像中进行人体姿态和形状估计(HPSE)的研究可以大致分为两大类:参数化方法和非参数化方法。参数化技术利用低维统计人体模型以实现更逼真的结果,而近期的非参数化方法则通过直接回归人体网格的3D坐标来实现更高的精度。本文提出了一种新的范式来解决HPSE问题,该范式涉及对人体网格的低维离散潜在表示,并将HPSE框架视为分类任务。与预测身体模型参数或3D顶点坐标不同,我们专注于预测所提出的离散潜在表示,该表示可以解码为注册的人体网格。这种创新范式提供了两个关键优势。首先,预测低维离散表示使我们的预测局限于拟人化姿态和形状的空间,即使在训练数据有限的情况下也是如此。其次,通过将问题框架视为分类任务,我们可以利用神经网络固有的判别能力。所提出的模型VQ-HPS预测网格的离散潜在表示。实验结果表明,VQ-HPS在少量数据训练时产生的结果与参数化方法相当,同时超越了当前最先进的非参数化方法。VQ-HPS在大规模数据集上的训练也显示出有前景的结果,突显了分类方法在HPSE中的巨大潜力。项目页面请访问 https://g-fiche.github.io/research-pages/vqhps/。
abstract_en: Previous works on Human Pose and Shape Estimation (HPSE) from RGB images can be broadly categorized into two main groups: parametric and non-parametric approaches. Parametric techniques leverage a low-dimensional statistical body model for realistic results, whereas recent non-parametric methods achieve higher precision by directly regressing the 3D coordinates of the human body mesh. This work introduces a novel paradigm to address the HPSE problem, involving a low-dimensional discrete latent representation of the human mesh and framing HPSE as a classification task. Instead of predicting body model parameters or 3D vertex coordinates, we focus on predicting the proposed discrete latent representation, which can be decoded into a registered human mesh. This innovative paradigm offers two key advantages. Firstly, predicting a low-dimensional discrete representation confines our predictions to the space of anthropomorphic poses and shapes even when little training data is available. Secondly, by framing the problem as a classification task, we can harness the discriminative power inherent in neural networks. The proposed model, VQ-HPS, predicts the discrete latent representation of the mesh. The experimental results demonstrate that VQ-HPS outperforms the current state-of-the-art non-parametric approaches while yielding results as realistic as those produced by parametric methods when trained with few data. VQ-HPS also shows promising results when training on large-scale datasets, highlighting the significant potential of the classification approach for HPSE. See the project page at https://g-fiche.github.io/research-pages/vqhps/.

title: Gwanghyun Kim, Hayeon Kim, Hoigi Seo, Dong Un Kang, Se Young Chun*
title_en: Gwanghyun Kim, Hayeon Kim, Hoigi Seo, Dong Un Kang, Se Young Chun*
abstract: 现有文本到图像扩散模型在生成高分辨率、以人类为中心的场景时仍面临细节和控制方面的挑战。这一挑战源于训练图像尺寸的限制、文本编码器容量(受限的token数量)以及生成涉及多个人物的复杂场景的固有难度。尽管当前方法仅尝试解决训练尺寸限制问题,但往往导致生成的人类中心场景出现严重伪影。我们提出BeyondScene,一种新颖的框架,克服了先前的限制,利用现有预训练扩散模型生成高分辨率(超过8K)的以人类为中心的场景,具有出色的文本-图像对应关系和自然性。BeyondScene采用分阶段和分层的方法,首先生成一个关注实例创建中关键元素的详细基础图像,处理扩散模型token限制之外的详细描述,然后无缝地将基础图像转换为更高分辨率的输出,超越训练图像尺寸,并通过我们提出的实例感知分层放大过程,结合文本和实例的细节信息。该过程包含我们提出的高频注入前向扩散和自适应联合扩散。BeyondScene在与详细文本描述的对应关系和自然性方面超越了现有方法,为在预训练扩散模型能力之外实现更高分辨率的人类中心场景创建铺平了道路,无需昂贵的重新训练。项目页面:https://janeyeon.github.io/beyond-scene.
abstract_en: Generating higher-resolution human-centric scenes with details and controls remains a challenge for existing text-to-image diffusion models. This challenge stems from limited training image size, text encoder capacity (limited tokens), and the inherent difficulty of generating complex scenes involving multiple humans. While current methods attempted to address training size limit only, they often yielded human-centric scenes with severe artifacts. We propose BeyondScene, a novel framework that overcomes prior limitations, generating exquisite higher-resolution (over 8K) human-centric scenes with exceptional text-image correspondence and naturalness using existing pretrained diffusion models. BeyondScene employs a staged and hierarchical approach to initially generate a detailed base image focusing on crucial elements in instance creation for multiple humans and detailed descriptions beyond token limit of diffusion model, and then to seamlessly convert the base image to a higher-resolution output, exceeding training image size and incorporating details aware of text and instances via our novel instance-aware hierarchical enlargement process that consists of our proposed high-frequency injected forward diffusion and adaptive joint diffusion. BeyondScene surpasses existing methods in terms of correspondence with detailed text descriptions and naturalness, paving the way for advanced applications in higher-resolution human-centric scene creation beyond the capacity of pretrained diffusion models without costly retraining. Project page: https://janeyeon.github.io/beyond-scene.

title: Gwangtak Bae, Changwoon Choi, Hyeongjun Heo, Sang Min Kim, Young Min Kim*
title_en: Gwangtak Bae, Changwoon Choi, Hyeongjun Heo, Sang Min Kim, Young Min Kim*
abstract: 我们提出了一种逆图像形成模块,可增强现有视觉SLAM系统在随意拍摄场景中的鲁棒性。随意拍摄的视频常受运动模糊和外观变化的影响,这会降低最终一致的3D视觉表示的质量。我们提出将物理成像整合到SLAM系统中,该系统采用线性HDR辐射图来收集测量数据。具体而言,单个帧通过沿相机轨迹聚合多个姿态的图像,以解释手持视频中普遍存在的运动模糊。此外,我们通过为图像形成步骤分配显式变量(如白平衡、曝光时间和相机响应函数)来适应每帧的外观变化。通过联合优化这些附加变量,SLAM系统生成高质量图像并获得更精确的轨迹。大量实验表明,我们的方法可以集成到使用各种场景表示(如神经辐射场或高斯点云)的最新视觉SLAM系统中。Project website
abstract_en: We present an inverse image-formation module that can enhance the robustness of existing visual SLAM pipelines for casually captured scenarios. Casual video captures often suffer from motion blur and varying appearances, which degrade the final quality of coherent 3D visual representation. We propose integrating the physical imaging into the SLAM system, which employs linear HDR radiance maps to collect measurements. Specifically, individual frames aggregate images of multiple poses along the camera trajectory to explain prevalent motion blur in hand-held videos. Additionally, we accommodate per-frame appearance variation by dedicating explicit variables for image formation steps, namely white balance, exposure time, and camera response function. Through joint optimization of additional variables, the SLAM pipeline produces high-quality images with more accurate trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach can be incorporated into recent visual SLAM pipelines using various scene representations, such as neural radiance fields or Gaussian splatting. Project website

title: Gwanhyeong Koo, Sunjae Yoon, Ji Woo Hong, Chang D. Yoo*
title_en: Gwanhyeong Koo, Sunjae Yoon, Ji Woo Hong, Chang D. Yoo*
abstract: 当前图像编辑方法主要采用DDIM反演,通过双分支扩散方法保留原始图像的属性和布局。然而,这些方法在处理涉及改变图像布局或结构的非刚性编辑时面临挑战。我们的全面分析表明,DDIM潜变量的高频成分对于保留原始图像的关键特征和布局至关重要,这些成分显著导致了上述局限性。为解决这一问题,我们提出了FlexiEdit,通过精炼DDIM潜变量并减少目标编辑区域的高频成分,从而提升对输入文本提示的保真度。FlexiEdit包含两个关键组件:(1) 潜变量优化,通过调整DDIM潜变量以更好地适应布局调整;(2) 通过重新反演实现的编辑保真度增强,旨在确保编辑更准确地反映输入文本提示。我们的方法在图像编辑领域取得了显著进展,特别是在执行复杂非刚性编辑方面,通过对比实验展示了其增强的能力。
abstract_en: Current image editing methods primarily utilize DDIM Inversion, employing a two-branch diffusion approach to preserve the attributes and layout of the original image. However, these methods encounter challenges with non-rigid edits, which involve altering the image’s layout or structure. Our comprehensive analysis reveals that the high-frequency components of DDIM latent, crucial for retaining the original image’s key features and layout, significantly contribute to these limitations. Addressing this, we introduce FlexiEdit, which enhances fidelity to input text prompts by refining DDIM latent, by reducing high-frequency components in targeted editing areas. FlexiEdit comprises two key components: (1) Latent Refinement, which modifies DDIM latent to better accommodate layout adjustments, and (2) Edit Fidelity Enhancement via Re-inversion, aimed at ensuring the edits more accurately reflect the input text prompts. Our approach represents notable progress in image editing, particularly in performing complex non-rigid edits, showcasing its enhanced capability through comparative experiments.

title: Gyeong Ryeol Song, Noo-ri Kim, Jin-Seop Lee, Jee-Hyong Lee*
title_en: Gyeong Ryeol Song, Noo-ri Kim, Jin-Seop Lee, Jee-Hyong Lee*
abstract: 单正多标签学习(SPML)是一种用于标注数据稀缺场景的方法,其中每张图像仅被分配一个正标签,其余标签保持未标注。大多数SPML方法假设未标注标签为负样本(“假设负样本”,AN)。然而,基于此假设,一些正标签不可避免地被误判为负样本(假阴性),导致模型性能下降。因此,在AN假设下识别假阴性标签至关重要。先前方法通过假设负样本的模型输出来识别假阴性标签。然而,由于模型在噪声负样本上进行训练,其输出不可靠。因此,有必要有效利用SPML中最可靠的信息来识别假阴性标签。本文提出了一种基于信息差距的假阴性损失拒绝(IGNORE)方法用于SPML。我们生成一个掩码图像,仅保留单个正标签的判别区域。当掩码图像中没有目标对象的信息时,模型对该对象的logit值应较低。基于这一直觉,我们通过比较掩码图像与原始图像之间显著的logit值差距来识别假阴性标签。此外,通过在模型训练中拒绝假阴性标签,可以防止模型偏向假阴性标签,从而构建更可靠的模型。我们在四个数据集(Pascal VOC 2012、MS COCO、NUSWIDE 和 CUB)上评估了我们的方法。与SPML领域先前最先进的方法相比,我们的方法在大多数数据集上均表现更优。
abstract_en: Single Positive Multi-Label Learning (SPML) is a method for a scarcely annotated setting, in which each image is assigned only one positive label while the other labels remain unannotated. Most approaches for SPML assume unannotated labels as negatives (“Assumed Negative”, AN). However, with this assumption, some positive labels are inevitably regarded as negative (false negative), resulting in model performance degradation. Therefore, identifying false negatives is the most important with AN assumption. Previous approaches identified false negative labels using the model outputs of assumed negative labels. However, models were trained with noisy negative labels, their outputs were not reliable. Therefore, it is necessary to consider effectively utilizing the most reliable information in SPML for identifying false negative labels. In this paper, we propose the Information Gap-based False Negative LOss REjection (IGNORE) method for SPML. We generate the masked image that all parts are removed except for the discriminative area of the single positive label. It is reasonable that when there is no information of an object in the masked image, the model’s logit for that object is low. Based on this intuition, we identify the false negative labels if they have a significant model’s logit gap between the masked image and the original image. Also, by rejecting false negatives in the model training, we can prevent the model from being biased to false negative labels, and build more reliable models. We evaluate our method on four datasets: Pascal VOC 2012, MS COCO, NUSWIDE, and CUB. Compared to previous state-of-the-art methods in SPML, our method outperforms them on most of the datasets.

title: Gyeongrok Oh*, Jaehwan Jeong, Sieun Kim, Wonmin Byeon, Jinkyu Kim, Sungwoong Kim, Sangpil Kim*
title_en: Gyeongrok Oh*, Jaehwan Jeong, Sieun Kim, Wonmin Byeon, Jinkyu Kim, Sungwoong Kim, Sangpil Kim*
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于扩散的视频生成方法,该方法能够根据用户提供的多个独立句子生成展示多个事件的视频。我们的方法无需大规模视频数据集,因为它使用了预训练的基于扩散的文本到视频生成模型,而无需微调过程。具体而言,我们提出了一种最后一帧感知的扩散过程,通过初始化潜在空间并同时调整潜在空间中的噪声,以增强生成视频中的运动动态,从而保持连续视频之间的视觉连贯性,其中每个视频包含不同的事件。此外,我们发现通过参考所有先前帧迭代更新潜在向量,可以保持视频片段中各帧的全局外观。为了处理视频生成的动态文本输入,我们利用了一种新颖的提示生成器,将用户的粗略文本信息转换为文本到视频扩散模型的多个最优提示。大量实验和用户研究表明,我们的方法在内容和语义的时间连贯性方面优于其他视频生成模型。视频示例可在我们的项目页面上查看:https://kuai-lab.github.io/eccv2024mevg。
abstract_en: We introduce a novel diffusion-based video generation method, generating a video showing multiple events given multiple individual sentences from the user. Our method does not require a large-scale video dataset since our method uses a pre-trained diffusion-based text-to-video generative model without a fine-tuning process. Specifically, we propose a last frame-aware diffusion process to preserve visual coherence between consecutive videos where each video consists of different events by initializing the latent and simultaneously adjusting noise in the latent to enhance the motion dynamic in a generated video. Furthermore, we find that the iterative update of latent vectors by referring to all the preceding frames maintains the global appearance across the frames in a video clip. To handle dynamic text input for video generation, we utilize a novel prompt generator that transfers course text messages from the user into the multiple optimal prompts for the text-to-video diffusion model. Extensive experiments and user studies show that our proposed method is superior to other video-generative models in terms of temporal coherency of content and semantics. Video examples are available on our project page: https://kuai-lab.github.io/eccv2024mevg.

title: Gyeongsik Moon*, Takaaki Shiratori, Shunsuke Saito
title_en: Gyeongsik Moon*, Takaaki Shiratori, Shunsuke Saito
abstract: 面部表情和手势是表达情感并与世界互动的必要手段。然而,大多数从随意拍摄视频中建模的三维人体虚拟形象仅支持身体运动,缺乏面部表情和手势。在本工作中,我们提出了ExAvatar,一种从短时单目视频中学习得到的具有表情的全身三维人体虚拟形象。我们将ExAvatar设计为全身参数化网格模型(SMPL-X)与三维高斯点云(3DGS)的结合。主要挑战包括1)视频中面部表情和姿态的多样性有限,以及2)缺乏三维观测数据(如三维扫描和RGB-D图像)。视频中有限的多样性使得生成新颖面部表情和姿态的动画变得非平凡。此外,缺乏三维观测数据可能导致未在视频中观察到的人体部分出现显著歧义,从而在新颖运动下产生明显伪影。为解决这些问题,我们引入了网格与三维高斯的混合表示。我们的混合表示将每个三维高斯视为具有预定义连接信息(即三角面)的网格表面顶点,遵循SMPL-X的网格拓扑结构。这使得ExAvatar能够通过SMPL-X的面部表情空间驱动,实现新颖面部表情的动画。此外,通过基于连接性的正则化方法,我们显著减少了新颖面部表情和姿态中的伪影。
abstract_en: Facial expression and hand motions are necessary to express our emotions and interact with the world. Nevertheless, most of the 3D human avatars modeled from a casually captured video only support body motions without facial expressions and hand motions. In this work, we present ExAvatar, an expressive whole-body 3D human avatar learned from a short monocular video. We design ExAvatar as a combination of the whole-body parametric mesh model (SMPL-X) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). The main challenges are 1) a limited diversity of facial expressions and poses in the video and 2) the absence of 3D observations, such as 3D scans and RGBD images. The limited diversity in the video makes animations with novel facial expressions and poses non-trivial. In addition, the absence of 3D observations could cause significant ambiguity in human parts that are not observed in the video, which can result in noticeable artifacts under novel motions. To address them, we introduce our hybrid representation of the mesh and 3D Gaussians. Our hybrid representation treats each 3D Gaussian as a vertex on the surface with pre-defined connectivity information (i.e., triangle faces) between them following the mesh topology of SMPL-X. It makes our ExAvatar animatable with novel facial expressions by driven by the facial expression space of SMPL-X. In addition, by using connectivity-based regularizers, we significantly reduce artifacts in novel facial expressions and poses.

title: Gyojin Han*, Jiwan Hur, Jaehyun Choi, Junmo Kim*
title_en: Gyojin Han*, Jiwan Hur, Jaehyun Choi, Junmo Kim*
abstract: 近年来,三维形状表示方法的发展为生成详细的三维形状开辟了新的可能性。尽管取得了这些进展,但针对具有随时间变形的三维物体形式的四维动态形状生成的研究仍较为有限。为弥合这一差距,本文重点研究四维动态形状的生成,强调生成质量和效率。HyperDiffusion是先前关于四维生成的工作,提出了一种直接生成四维占据场权重参数的方法,但由于运动表示与形状表示未分离,导致时间一致性低且渲染速度慢。因此,我们提出了一种新的神经变形表示方法,并将其与条件神经符号距离场结合,设计了一种四维表示架构,其中运动潜在空间与形状潜在空间分离。所提出的变形表示方法通过预测多个部分的皮肤权重和刚性变换来工作,相较于现有四维表示的变形模块,在理解形状结构方面具有优势。此外,我们设计了一种扩散模型的训练过程,利用我们四维表示提取的形状和运动特征作为数据点。无条件生成、有条件生成和运动重定向实验的结果表明,我们的方法不仅在四维动态形状生成方面优于先前工作,还具有多种潜在应用。
abstract_en: Recent developments in 3D shape representation opened new possibilities for generating detailed 3D shapes. Despite these advances, there are few studies dealing with the generation of 4D dynamic shapes that have the form of 3D objects deforming over time. To bridge this gap, we focus on generating 4D dynamic shapes with an emphasis on both generation quality and efficiency in this paper. HyperDiffusion, a previous work on 4D generation, proposed a method of directly generating the weight parameters of 4D occupancy fields but suffered from low temporal consistency and slow rendering speed due to motion representation that is not separated from the shape representation of 4D occupancy fields. Therefore, we propose a new neural deformation representation and combine it with conditional neural signed distance fields to design a 4D representation architecture in which the motion latent space is disentangled from the shape latent space. The proposed deformation representation, which works by predicting skinning weights and rigid transformations for multiple parts, also has advantages over the deformation modules of existing 4D representations in understanding the structure of shapes. In addition, we design a training process of a diffusion model that utilizes the shape and motion features that are extracted by our 4D representation as data points. The results of unconditional generation, conditional generation, and motion retargeting experiments demonstrate that our method not only shows better performance than previous works in 4D dynamic shape generation but also has various potential applications.

title: Haejoon Lee*, Aswin Sankaranarayanan
title_en: Haejoon Lee*, Aswin Sankaranarayanan
abstract: 本研究通过光谱次表面散射(4)测量推进材料分类技术。虽然光谱和次表面散射测量已被分别用于材料分类,但我们认为次表面散射的强光谱依赖性使其能够产生高度判别的特征。然而,获取4测量需要耗时的高光谱扫描。我们通过展示精心选择的4点扩散函数的2D投影足以进行材料估计来避免这一问题。我们还设计并实现了一种新型成像装置,包括点照明和光谱分散相机,以获取所需的2D投影。最后,通过全面的实验,我们证明了4成像在材料分类任务中优于光谱和次表面散射测量。
abstract_en: This study advances material classification using Spectral Sub-Surface Scattering (4) measurements. While spectrum and subsurface scattering measurements have individually been used in material classification, we argue that the strong spectral dependence of subsurface scattering lends itself to highly discriminative features. However, obtaining 4 measurements requires a time-consuming hyperspectral scan. We avoid this by showing that a carefully chosen 2D projection of the 4 point spread function is sufficient for material estimation. We also design and implement a novel imaging setup, consisting of a point illumination and a spectrally-dispersing camera, to make the desired 2D projections. Finally, through comprehensive experiments, we demonstrate the superiority of 4 imaging over spectral and sub-surface scattering measurements for the task of material classification.

title: Hai Ci*, Pei Yang, Yiren Song, Mike Zheng Shou*
title_en: Hai Ci*, Pei Yang, Yiren Song, Mike Zheng Shou*
abstract: 我们重新审视Tree-Ring Watermarking,这是一种近期提出的扩散模型水印技术,表现出对多种攻击的卓越鲁棒性。我们对其进行了深入研究,发现水印过程无意中引入的分布偏移(除水印模式匹配外)是其卓越鲁棒性的关键因素。进一步研究揭示了其原始设计中的固有缺陷,特别是在多密钥识别能力方面,分布偏移无法提供帮助。基于这些发现与分析,我们提出了RingID以增强多密钥识别。RingID包含一种新颖的多通道异构水印方法,旨在无缝融合来自不同水印的独特优势。结合一系列建议的改进措施,RingID在多密钥识别方面展现出显著提升。Github页面:https://github.com/showlab/RingID
abstract_en: We revisit Tree-Ring Watermarking, a recent diffusion model watermarking method that demonstrates great robustness to various attacks. We conduct an in-depth study on it and reveal that the distribution shift unintentionally introduced by the watermarking process, apart from watermark pattern matching, contributes to its exceptional robustness. Our investigation further exposes inherent flaws in its original design, particularly in its ability to identify multiple distinct keys, where distribution shift offers no assistance.
