Based on these findings and analysis, we present RingID for enhanced multi-key identification. It consists of a novel multi-channel heterogeneous watermarking approach designed to seamlessly amalgamate distinctive advantages from diverse watermarks. Coupled with a series of suggested enhancements, RingID exhibits substantial advancements in multi-key identification. Github page: https://github.com/showlab/RingID

title: Hai Jiang, Ao Luo, Xiaohong Liu, Songchen Han, Shuaicheng Liu*
title_en: Hai Jiang, Ao Luo, Xiaohong Liu, Songchen Han, Shuaicheng Liu*
abstract: 本文提出了一种基于扩散的无监督框架,将具有物理可解释性的Retinex理论与扩散模型相结合,用于低光照图像增强,命名为LightenDiffusion。具体而言,我们提出了一种内容迁移分解网络,该网络在潜在空间而非图像空间内执行Retinex分解,从而能够将未配对的低光照和正常光照图像的编码特征分解为内容丰富的反射图和内容无关的光照图。随后,将低光照图像的反射图和正常光照图像的光照图作为输入,结合低光照特征的引导进行无监督恢复,进一步提出了一种自约束一致性损失,以消除正常光照内容对恢复结果的干扰,从而提升整体视觉质量。在公开的真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明,所提出的LightenDiffusion在无监督方法中优于现有最先进的方法,并且在泛化能力上与监督方法相当。我们的代码可在https://github.com/JianghaiSCU/LightenDiffusion获取。
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a diffusion-based unsupervised framework that incorporates physically explainable Retinex theory with diffusion models for low-light image enhancement, named LightenDiffusion. Specifically, we present a content-transfer decomposition network that performs Retinex decomposition within the latent space instead of image space as in previous approaches, enabling the encoded features of unpaired low-light and normal-light images to be decomposed into content-rich reflectance maps and content-free illumination maps. Subsequently, the reflectance map of the low-light image and the illumination map of the normal-light image are taken as input to the diffusion model for unsupervised restoration with the guidance of the low-light feature, where a self-constrained consistency loss is further proposed to eliminate the interference of normal-light content on the restored results to improve overall visual quality. Extensive experiments on publicly available real-world benchmarks show that the proposed LightenDiffusion outperforms state-of-the-art unsupervised competitors and is comparable to supervised methods while being more generalizable to various scenes. Our code is available at https://github.com/JianghaiSCU/LightenDiffusion.

title: Haibo Jin, Ruoxi Chen, Jinyin Chen, Haibin Zheng, Yang Zhang, Haohan Wang*
title_en: Haibo Jin, Ruoxi Chen, Jinyin Chen, Haibin Zheng, Yang Zhang, Haohan Wang*
abstract: 深度神经网络(DNNs)在现实应用中的成功得益于丰富的预训练模型。然而,带有后门的预训练模型可能对下游DNNs的部署构成显著的木马威胁。已提出众多后门检测方法,但存在两个方面的局限性:(1) 对触发器大小高度敏感,尤其是在隐蔽攻击(即混合攻击和防御自适应攻击)中;(2) 严重依赖良性示例进行逆向工程。为解决这些挑战,我们通过实证观察发现,各种木马攻击触发的木马行为可归因于由对模型预测变化贡献更大的前k个关键神经元组成的木马路径。受此启发,我们提出CatchBackdoor,一种针对木马攻击的检测方法。基于木马行为与木马路径触发错误之间的紧密关联,CatchBackdoor从良性路径出发,通过差分模糊化逐步逼近木马路径。随后,我们从木马路径中逆向触发,以引发由多样木马攻击导致的错误。在MINST、CIFAR-10和a-ImageNet数据集及7个模型(LeNet、ResNet和VGG)上的大量实验表明,CatchBackdoor在检测性能(1)有效性方面优于现有方法,尤其在隐蔽攻击中表现更优(平均提升约2倍);(2)可扩展性方面,其对触发器大小具有鲁棒性,并且无需良性示例即可进行检测。
abstract_en: The success of deep neural networks (DNNs) in real-world applications has benefited from abundant pre-trained models. However, the backdoored pre-trained models can pose a significant trojan threat to the deployment of downstream DNNs. Numerous backdoor detection methods have been proposed but are limited to two aspects: (1) high sensitivity on trigger size, especially on stealthy attacks (i.e., blending attacks and defense adaptive attacks); (2) rely heavily on benign examples for reverse engineering. To address these challenges, we empirically observed that trojaned behaviors triggered by various trojan attacks can be attributed to the trojan path, composed of top-k critical neurons with more significant contributions to model prediction changes. Motivated by it, we propose CatchBackdoor, a detection method against trojan attacks. Based on the close connection between trojaned behaviors and trojan path to trigger errors, CatchBackdoor starts from the benign path and gradually approximates the trojan path through differential fuzzing. We then reverse triggers from the trojan path, to trigger errors caused by diverse trojaned attacks. Extensive experiments on MINST, CIFAR-10, and a-ImageNet datasets and 7 models (LeNet, ResNet, and VGG) demonstrate the superiority of CatchBackdoor over the state-of-the-art methods, in terms of (1) effective - it shows better detection performance, especially on stealthy attacks (∼ × 2 on average); (2) extensible it is robust to trigger size and can conduct detection without benign examples.

title: 王海波*,郭伟峰*
title_en: Haibo Wang*, Weifeng Ge*
abstract: 随着多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)的突破,回答需要高级推理能力和世界知识的复杂视觉问题已成为开发AI模型的重要测试平台。然而,为MLLMs赋予强大的跨模态推理能力仍面临挑战,因为人类的认知机制尚未被系统理解。本文认为,如果我们能收集丰富的视觉线索,就能更准确地识别图像、更好地理解问题、更轻松地回忆相关知识,最终推理出答案。我们通过挖掘图像中的问答对并将其作为提示输入多模态大语言模型来发现这些丰富的视觉线索。我们称该方法为问答提示(Q&A Prompts)。具体而言,我们首先使用训练集中的图像-答案对和对应问题作为输入和输出,训练一个视觉问题生成(VQG)模型。然后,我们使用图像标记模型识别各种实例,并将包装好的图像-标签对输入VQG模型,以提取的图像标签作为答案生成相关问题。最后,我们通过视觉感知提示模块将生成的问答对编码为提示,并输入预训练的MLLMs以推理出最终答案。实验结果表明,与最先进的方法相比,我们的Q&A Prompts在需要跨多领域世界知识推理的挑战性视觉问答数据集(如OK-VQA和A-OKVQA)上取得了显著提升。代码将在链接中提供。
abstract_en: With the breakthrough of multi-modal large language models (MLLMs), answering complex visual questions that demand advanced reasoning abilities and world knowledge has become a much more important testbed for developing AI models than ever. However, equipping MLLMs with robust cross-modality reasoning ability remains challenging since the cognition scheme of humans has not been understood systematically. In this paper, we believe that if we can collect rich visual clues, we will recognize the image more accurately, understand the question better, recall relevant knowledge more easily, and finally reason out the answer. We discover these rich visual clues by mining question-answer pairs in images and sending them into multi-modal large language models as prompts. We call the proposed method Q&A Prompts. Specifically, we first use the image-answer pairs and the corresponding questions in the training set as inputs and outputs to train a visual question generation (VQG) model. Then, we use an image tagging model to identify various instances and send packaged image-tag pairs into the VQG model to generate relevant questions with the extracted image tags as answers. Finally, we encode these generated question-answer pairs as prompts with a visual-aware prompting module and send them into pre-trained MLLMs to reason out the final answers. Experimental results show that, compared with state-of-the-art methods, our Q&A Prompts achieves substantial improvements on the challenging visual question answering datasets requiring reasoning over diverse world knowledge, such as OK-VQA and A-OKVQA. Codes will be avaliable at link.

title: Haibo Yang, Yang Chen, Yingwei Pan*, Ting Yao, Zhineng Chen, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang, Tao Mei
title_en: Haibo Yang, Yang Chen, Yingwei Pan*, Ting Yao, Zhineng Chen, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang, Tao Mei
abstract: Learning radiance fields (NeRF) with powerful 2D diffusion models has garnered popularity for text-to-3D generation. Nevertheless, the implicit 3D representations of NeRF lack explicit modeling of meshes and textures over surfaces, and such surface-undefined way may suffer from the issues, e.g., noisy surfaces with ambiguous texture details or cross-view inconsistency. To alleviate this, we present DreamMesh, a novel text-to-3D architecture that pivots on well-defined surfaces (triangle meshes) to generate high-fidelity explicit 3D model. Technically, DreamMesh capitalizes on a distinctive coarse-to-fine scheme. In the coarse stage, the mesh is first deformed by text-guided Jacobians and then DreamMesh textures the mesh with an interlaced use of 2D diffusion models in a tuning free manner from multiple viewpoints. In the fine stage, DreamMesh jointly manipulates the mesh and refines the texture map, leading to high-quality triangle meshes with high-fidelity textured materials. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DreamMesh significantly outperforms state-of-the-art text-to-3D methods in faithfully generating 3D content with richer textual details and enhanced geometry. Our project page is available at https://dreammesh.github.io.
abstract_en: Learning radiance fields (NeRF) with powerful 2D diffusion models has garnered popularity for text-to-3D generation. Nevertheless, the implicit 3D representations of NeRF lack explicit modeling of meshes and textures over surfaces, and such surface-undefined way may suffer from the issues, e.g., noisy surfaces with ambiguous texture details or cross-view inconsistency. To alleviate this, we present DreamMesh, a novel text-to-3D architecture that pivots on well-defined surfaces (triangle meshes) to generate high-fidelity explicit 3D model. Technically, DreamMesh capitalizes on a distinctive coarse-to-fine scheme. In the coarse stage, the mesh is first deformed by text-guided Jacobians and then DreamMesh textures the mesh with an interlaced use of 2D diffusion models in a tuning free manner from multiple viewpoints. In the fine stage, DreamMesh jointly manipulates the mesh and refines the texture map, leading to high-quality triangle meshes with high-fidelity textured materials. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DreamMesh significantly outperforms state-of-the-art text-to-3D methods in faithfully generating 3D content with richer textual details and enhanced geometry. Our project page is available at https://dreammesh.github.io.

title: Haidong Zhu, Tianyu Ding*, Tianyi Chen, Ilya Zharkov, Ram Nevatia, Luming Liang
title_en: Haidong Zhu, Tianyu Ding*, Tianyi Chen, Ilya Zharkov, Ram Nevatia, Luming Liang
abstract: 泛化能力和少样本学习是神经辐射场(NeRF)中的关键挑战,通常由于像素级渲染缺乏整体理解。我们提出CaesarNeRF,一种端到端方法,通过结合场景级校准的语义表示与像素级表示,推动少样本、可泛化的神经渲染,实现无需牺牲高质量细节的整体理解。CaesarNeRF显式建模参考视图的姿态差异,结合场景级语义表示,提供校准的整体理解。该校准过程通过精确位置对齐不同视角,并通过序列优化进一步增强,以捕捉变化的细节。在LLFF、Shiny、mip-NeRF 360和MVImgNet等公开数据集上的大量实验表明,CaesarNeRF在不同参考视图数量下均达到最先进性能,† 甚至在单参考图像情况下也表现出色。∗ 等贡献。通讯作者。本工作是在Haidong Zhu于微软实习期间完成的。
abstract_en: Generalizability and few-shot learning are key challenges in Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), often due to the lack of a holistic understanding in pixel-level rendering. We introduce CaesarNeRF, an end-to-end approach that leverages scene-level CAlibratEd SemAntic Representation along with pixel-level representations to advance few-shot, generalizable neural rendering, facilitating a holistic understanding without compromising high-quality details. CaesarNeRF explicitly models pose differences of reference views to combine scene-level semantic representations, providing a calibrated holistic understanding. This calibration process aligns various viewpoints with precise location and is further enhanced by sequential refinement to capture varying details. Extensive experiments on public datasets, including LLFF, Shiny, mip-NeRF 360, and MVImgNet, show that CaesarNeRF delivers state-of-the-art performance across varying numbers of reference views, † proving effective even with a single reference image. ∗ Equal contribution. Corresponding author. This work was done when Haidong Zhu was an intern at Microsoft.

title: Haijin Zeng*, Hiep Luong, Wilfried Philips
title_en: Haijin Zeng*, Hiep Luong, Wilfried Philips
abstract: 光谱成像能够揭示我们周围世界中的隐藏细节。然而,要充分挖掘这一潜力,必须开发有效的光谱解马赛克技术。尽管基于学习的光谱解马赛克方法取得了成功,但三个挑战阻碍了其实际应用。首先,现有的卷积神经网络和基于注意力的模型难以捕捉光谱相似性及长程依赖关系。其次,当光学特性(如多光谱滤光阵列(MSFA)排列和波长分布)变化时,其性能不稳定。最后,它们缺乏将成像系统物理特性(如MSFA模式)结构化整合的方法。针对上述挑战,本文提出了一种波长嵌入引导的滤光阵列注意力Transformer(WeFAT),用于有效的光谱解马赛克。具体而言,受去噪扩散模型中时间步嵌入的启发,我们提出了一种波长嵌入引导的多头自注意力(We-MSA)机制,使模型具备波长记忆,从而适应多样化的相机。该方法将每个光谱特征视为一个token,直接将波长信息整合到注意力计算中。此外,我们开发了MSFA注意力机制(MaM),引导We-MSA聚焦于产生高质量光谱数据的空间区域。实验结果证实,WeFAT在仅使用ARAD数据集训练的情况下,表现出对具有不同光谱分布和MSFA模式的多样化相机的强性能一致性。它在模拟和真实数据集上均优于当前最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Spectral imaging offers the capability to unveil hidden details within the world around us. However, to fully harness this potential, it is imperative to develop effective spectral demosaicing techniques. Despite the success of learning based spectral demosaicing methods, three challenges hinder their practical use. Firstly, existing convolutional neural networks and attention-based models, struggle to capture spectral similarities and long-range dependencies. Secondly, their performance is unstable when optical characteristics, like multispectral filter array (MSFA) arrangement and wavelength distribution, change. Lastly, they lack a structured approach to incorporating imaging system physics, such as MSFA pattern. Addressing these challenges, our paper introduces the Wavelength Embedding guided Filter Array Attention Transformer (WeFAT) for effective spectral demosaicing. Specifically, inspired by the timestep embedding in denoising diffusion models, we propose a Wavelength Embedding guided Multi-head Self-Attention (We-MSA) mechanism to imbue our model with wavelength memory, facilitating adaptation to diverse cameras. This approach treats each spectral feature as a token, directly integrating wavelength information into attention calculation. Additionally, we developed a MSFA-attention Mechanism (MaM) steering We-MSA to focus on spatial regions yielding high-quality spectral data. Experimental results affirm that WeFAT exhibits strong performance consistency across diverse cameras characterized by varying spectral distributions and MSFA patterns, trained solely on ARAD dataset. It also outperforms current state-of-the-art methods in both simulated and real datasets.

title: Haijin Zeng, Yuxi Liu, Yongyong Chen*, Youfa Liu, Chong Peng, Jingyong Su
title_en: Haijin Zeng, Yuxi Liu, Yongyong Chen*, Youfa Liu, Chong Peng, Jingyong Su
abstract: 高光谱图像(HSI)重建对于从编码孔径快拍光谱成像(CASSI)系统压缩测量中恢复空谱信息至关重要。尽管端到端和深度展开方法在效果上表现良好,但其对大量训练数据的依赖性带来了挑战,尤其是标记的HSI数据稀缺。现有方法通常在有限的数据集(如KAIST和CAVE)上进行训练,导致模型存在偏差且泛化能力差。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种通用的高光谱快拍压缩成像自监督适配器(SAH-SCI)。与全量微调或线性探针不同,SAH-SCI通过训练轻量级适配器来增强模型泛化能力,同时保留原始模型的参数。我们提出了一种结合光谱与空间适配的新方法,以增强图像模型对空谱推理的处理能力。此外,我们引入了定制化的适配器自监督损失函数,以捕捉CASSI成像的一致性、群不变性和图像不确定性。该方法有效缩小了病态HSI重建的解空间。实验结果表明,SAH在参数更少的情况下优于先前方法,提供了简洁性和对任何端到端或展开方法的适应性。我们的方法为未来高光谱成像任务中利用更鲁棒的图像基础模型铺平了道路。
abstract_en: Hyperspectral image (HSI) reconstruction is vital for recovering spatial-spectral information from compressed measurements in coded aperture snapshot spectral imaging (CASSI) systems. Despite the effectiveness of end-to-end and deep unfolding methods, their reliance on substantial training data poses challenges, notably the scarcity of labeled HSIs. Existing approaches often train on limited datasets, such as KAIST and CAVE, leading to biased models with poor generalization capabilities. Addressing these challenges, we propose a universal Self-Supervised Adapter for Hyperspectral Snapshot Compressive Imaging (SAH-SCI). Unlike full fine-tuning or linear probing, SAH-SCI enhances model generalization by training a lightweight adapter while preserving the original model’s parameters. We propose a novel approach that combines spectral and spatial adaptation to enhance an image model’s capacity for spatial-spectral reasoning. Additionally, we introduce a customized adapter self-supervised loss function that captures the consistency, group invariance and image uncertainty of CASSI imaging. This approach effectively reduces the solution space for ill-posed HSI reconstruction. Experimental results demonstrate SAH’s superiority over previous methods with fewer parameters, offering simplicity and adaptability to any end-to-end or unfolding methods. Our approach paves the way for leveraging more robust image foundation models in future hyperspectral imaging tasks.

title: Haijun Xiong, Bin Feng*, Xinggang Wang, Wenyu Liu
title_en: Haijun Xiong, Bin Feng*, Xinggang Wang, Wenyu Liu
abstract: 步态识别是一种生物特征技术,通过个体的行走模式来区分不同人。然而,先前方法在准确提取身份特征时面临挑战,因为它们常常与非身份线索纠缠。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种受因果性启发的判别特征学习模块,旨在有效消除三域(空间、时间与频谱)中的混杂因素影响。具体而言,我们利用交叉像素级注意力生成器(CPAG)在空间和时间域中生成事实性与反事实性特征的注意力分布。随后,我们引入傅里叶投影头(FPH)将空间特征投影到频谱空间,从而在保留关键信息的同时降低计算成本。此外,我们采用对比学习优化方法,对同一主体的序列施加语义一致性约束。我们的方法在具有挑战性的数据集上展现出显著性能提升,证明了其有效性。此外,该方法可无缝集成到现有步态识别方法中。
abstract_en: Gait recognition is a biometric technology that distinguishes individuals by their walking patterns. However, previous methods face challenges when accurately extracting identity features because they often become entangled with non-identity clues. To address this challenge, we propose , a causality-inspired discriminative feature learning module designed to effectively eliminate the influence of confounders in triple domains, , spatial, temporal, and spectral. Specifically, we utilize the Cross Pixel-wise Attention Generator (CPAG) to generate attention distributions for factual and counterfactual features in spatial and temporal domains. Then, we introduce the Fourier Projection Head (FPH) to project spatial features into the spectral space, which preserves essential information while reducing computational costs. Additionally, we employ an optimization method with contrastive learning to enforce semantic consistency constraints across sequences from the same subject. Our approach has demonstrated significant performance improvements on challenging datasets, proving its effectiveness. Moreover, it can be seamlessly integrated into existing gait recognition methods.

title: Haiqian Han, Jiacheng Lyu, Jianing Li*, Henglu Wei, Cheng Li, Yajing Wei, SHU CHEN, Xiangyang Ji*
title_en: Haiqian Han, Jiacheng Lyu, Jianing Li*, Henglu Wei, Cheng Li, Yajing Wei, SHU CHEN, Xiangyang Ji*
abstract: 现有事件相机模拟器主要关注视频事件的生成过程,往往忽视现实相机系统中完整的光学路径。为解决这一局限性,我们提出了一种基于物理的事件相机模拟器(PECS),该模拟器能够通过直接与3D场景接口生成高保真现实事件流。我们的PECS包含一个镜头模拟模块,用于精确复制光到传感器芯片的传输过程,以及一个多光谱渲染模块用于精确生成光生电流。我们提出了两个时空事件度量指标,用于评估模拟事件与实际相机事件的相似性。实验结果表明,我们的PECS在基于事件的信号保真度方面显著优于四个最先进的模拟器。我们将PECS集成到UE平台中,生成大量多任务合成数据集,并评估其在下游视觉任务(如视频重建)中的有效性。我们的开源代码可在https: //github.com/lanpokn/PECS_trail_version获取。
abstract_en: Existing event camera simulators primarily focus on the process of generating video events and often overlook the entire optical path in real-world camera systems. To address this limitation, we propose a novel Physical-based Event Camera Simulator (PECS), which is able to generate a high-fidelity realistic event stream by directly interfacing with the 3D scene. Our PECS features a lens simulation block for accurate light-to-sensor chip replication and a multispectral rendering module for precise photocurrent generation. We present two spatiotemporal event metrics to assess the similarity between simulated and actual camera events. Experimental results demonstrate that our PECS outperforms four state-of-the-art simulators by a large margin in terms of event-based signal fidelity. We integrate our PECS into the UE platform to generate extensive multi-task synthetic datasets and evaluate its effectiveness in downstream vision tasks (e.g., video reconstruction). Our open-source code is available at https: //github.com/lanpokn/PECS_trail_version.

title: Hairong Jin, Yuefan Shen, Jianwen Lou, Kun Zhou, Youyi Zheng*
title_en: Hairong Jin, Yuefan Shen, Jianwen Lou, Kun Zhou, Youyi Zheng*
abstract: 三维关键点检测在三维形状分析中起着关键作用。大多数流行方法依赖于生成共享热图。这种方法需要后续的后处理技术,如聚类或非极大值抑制(NMS),以在高置信度区域定位关键点,导致性能效率低下。为了解决这一问题,我们引入了KeypointDETR,这是一种端到端的三维关键点检测框架。KeypointDETR主要通过二分匹配损失进行训练,迫使网络预测一组热图和潜在关键点的概率。每个热图突出显示一个关键点的位置,相关概率不仅表示该特定关键点的存在,还表明其语义一致性。结合二分匹配损失,我们采用基于Transformer的网络架构,在编码器和解码器中分别引入点级和查询级的自注意力机制。点级编码器利用自注意力机制在动态图上处理每个点的局部特征空间,生成热图特征。作为框架的关键部分,查询级解码器促进查询间的信息交换。它通过交叉注意力机制捕捉关键点热图、位置和语义属性之间的潜在联系,从而实现热图和概率的预测。在KeypointNet数据集上的大量实验表明,KeypointDETR优于竞争基线,在关键点显著性和对应关系估计任务中表现出色。(代码将在github.com/bibi547/KeypointDETR发布)
abstract_en: 3D keypoint detection plays a pivotal role in 3D shape analysis. The majority of prevalent methods depend on producing a shared heatmap. This approach necessitates subsequent post-processing techniques such as clustering or non-maximum suppression (NMS) to pinpoint keypoints within high-confidence regions, resulting in performance inefficiencies. To address this issue, we introduce KeypointDETR, an end-to-end 3D keypoint detection framework. KeypointDETR is predominantly trained with a bipartite matching loss, which compels the network to forecast sets of heatmaps and probabilities for potential keypoints. Each heatmap highlights one keypoint’s location, and the associated probability indicates not only the presence of that specific keypoint but also its semantic consistency. Together with the bipartite matching loss, we utilize a transformer-based network architecture, which incorporates both point-wise and query-wise self-attention within the encoder and decoder, respectively. The point-wise encoder leverages the self-attention mechanism on a dynamic graph derived from the local feature space of each point, resulting in the generation of heatmap features. As a key part of our framework, the query-wise decoder facilitates inter-query information exchange. It captures the underlying connections among keypoints’ heatmaps, positions, and semantic attributes via the cross-attention mechanism, enabling the prediction of heatmaps and probabilities. Extensive experiments conducted on the KeypointNet dataset reveal that KeypointDETR outperforms competitive baselines, demonstrating superior performance in keypoint saliency and correspondence estimation tasks. (The code will be released at github.com/bibi547/KeypointDETR)

title: Haisheng Fu*, Jie Liang, Zhenman Fang, Jingning Han, Feng Liang, Guohe Zhang
title_en: Haisheng Fu*, Jie Liang, Zhenman Fang, Jingning Han, Feng Liang, Guohe Zhang
abstract: 近年来,学习图像压缩(LIC)取得了显著进展,甚至在传统基于DCT或离散小波变换(DWT)的方法上表现更优。然而,LIC主要通过自编码器网络和熵编码减少空间冗余,但并未显式去除DCT或DWT中频域的相关性。为兼顾两者优势,我们提出了一种简单但高效的框架,将DWT引入基于CNN的LIC的卷积层和熵编码中。首先,在核心和超先验自编码器网络中,我们提出了一种小波域卷积(WeConv)模块,该模块在DWT后执行卷积,再通过逆DWT将数据转换回空间域。该模块在CNN网络的选定层中使用,以显式减少频域相关性,并使信号在小波域中更稀疏。我们还提出了一种小波域通道自回归熵模型(WeChARM),其中编码器网络的输出潜在表示首先通过DWT转换,再进行量化和熵编码,如传统范式所示。此外,熵编码被分为两个步骤:首先编码所有低频小波系数,再利用其作为先验编码高频系数。通道熵编码进一步应用于每一步。通过结合WeConv和WeChARM,所提出的WeConvene方案在率失真(R-D)性能上优于其他先进LIC方法及最新H.266/VVC标准。在Kodak数据集和基线网络中,相比H.266/VVC实现−0.4% BD率节省,引入最简单的Haar变换后,节省提升至−4.7%。考虑到Haar变换的简单性,这一成果令人印象深刻。启用基于Haar的小波域熵编码进一步提升至−8.2%。当将Haar变换替换为5/3或9/7小波时,整体节省分别达到−9.4%和−9.8%。独立的WeConv层还可用于图像/视频压缩以外的其他计算机视觉任务。源代码可在https: //github.com/fengyurenpingsheng/WeConvene获取。
abstract_en: Recently learned image compression (LIC) has achieved great progress and even outperformed the traditional approach using DCT or discrete wavelet transform (DWT). However, LIC mainly reduces spatial redundancy in the autoencoder networks and entropy coding, but has not fully removed the frequency-domain correlation explicitly as in DCT or DWT. To leverage the best of both worlds, we propose a surprisingly simple but efficient framework, which introduces the DWT to both the convolution layers and entropy coding of CNN-based LIC. First, in both the core and hyperprior autoencoder networks, we propose a Wavelet-domain Convolution (WeConv) module, which performs convolution after DWT, and then converts the data back to spatial domain via inverse DWT. This module is used at selected layers in a CNN network to reduce the frequency-domain correlation explicitly and make the signal sparser in DWT domain. We also propose a Wavelet-domain Channel-wise Auto-Regressive entropy Model (WeChARM), where the output latent representations from the encoder network are first transformed by the DWT, before applying quantization and entropy coding, as in the traditional paradigm. Moreover, the entropy coding is split into two steps. We first code all low-frequency DWT coefficients, and then use them as prior to code high-frequency coefficients. The channel-wise entropy coding is further used in each step. By combining WeConv and WeChARM, the proposed WeConvene scheme achieves superior R-D performance compared to other state-of-the-art LIC methods as well as the latest H.266/VVC. For the Kodak dataset and the baseline network with −0.4% BD-Rate saving over H.266/VVC, introducing WeConv with the simplest Haar transform improves the saving to −4.7%. This is quite impressive given the simplicity of the Haar transform. Enabling Haar-based WeChARM entropy coding further boosts the saving to −8.2%. When the Haar transform is replaced by the 5/3 or 9/7 wavelet, the overall saving becomes −9.4% and −9.8% respectively. The standalone WeConv layer can also be used in many other computer vision tasks beyond image/video compression. The source code is available at https: //github.com/fengyurenpingsheng/WeConvene.

title: Haisong Liu, Yang Chen, Haiguang Wang, Zetong Yang, Tianyu Li, Jia Zeng, Li Chen, Hongyang Li, Limin Wang*
title_en: Haisong Liu, Yang Chen, Haiguang Wang, Zetong Yang, Tianyu Li, Jia Zeng, Li Chen, Hongyang Li, Limin Wang*
abstract: 占用预测在自动驾驶中起着关键作用。先前的方法通常构建密集的3D体素,忽视了场景的固有稀疏性并导致高昂的计算成本。为弥合这一差距,我们引入了一种新颖的全稀疏占用网络,称为SparseOcc。SparseOcc首先从视觉输入中重建稀疏的3D表示,随后通过稀疏查询从3D稀疏表示中预测语义/实例占用。设计了一种掩码引导的稀疏采样方法,使稀疏查询能够以全稀疏方式与2D特征交互,从而避免使用昂贵的密集特征或全局注意力。此外,我们设计了一种基于射线的评估指标,即RayIoU,以解决传统体素级mIoU标准中沿深度方向的不一致性惩罚问题。SparseOcc通过实现34.0的RayIoU验证了其有效性,同时保持7帧历史输入下的实时推理速度17.3 FPS。通过引入更多前帧至15帧,SparseOcc在不增加额外复杂度的情况下持续提升性能至35.1 RayIoU。代码可在https://github.com/MCG-NJU/SparseOcc获取。
abstract_en: Occupancy prediction plays a pivotal role in autonomous driving. Previous methods typically construct dense 3D volumes, neglecting the inherent sparsity of the scene and suffering high computational costs. To bridge the gap, we introduce a novel fully sparse occupancy network, termed SparseOcc. SparseOcc initially reconstructs a sparse 3D representation from visual inputs and subsequently predicts semantic/instance occupancy from the 3D sparse representation by sparse queries. A mask-guided sparse sampling is designed to enable sparse queries to interact with 2D features in a fully sparse manner, thereby circumventing costly dense features or global attention. Additionally, we design a thoughtful ray-based evaluation metric, namely RayIoU, to solve the inconsistency penalty along depths raised in traditional voxel-level mIoU criteria. SparseOcc demonstrates its effectiveness by achieving a RayIoU of 34.0, while maintaining a real-time inference speed of 17.3 FPS, with 7 history frames inputs. By incorporating more preceding frames to 15, SparseOcc continuously improves its performance to 35.1 RayIoU without bells and whistles. Code is available at https:// github.com/MCG-NJU/SparseOcc.

title: Haiwen Diao*, Bo Wan, Xu Jia, Yunzhi Zhuge, Ying Zhang, Huchuan Lu*, Long Chen
title_en: Haiwen Diao*, Bo Wan, Xu Jia, Yunzhi Zhuge, Ying Zhang, Huchuan Lu*, Long Chen
abstract: 参数高效迁移学习(PETL)已成为适应大型预训练模型到下游任务的热门研究领域,通过大幅减少可训练参数,在微调过程中应对内存挑战。为解决这一问题,内存高效序列(METL)避免通过大型主干网络反向传播梯度。然而,它们通过仅依赖冻结的中间输出并限制对预训练模型先验知识的全面探索而妥协。此外,跨层特征之间的依赖关系和冗余性常被忽视,从而掩盖了更具判别性的表示,导致与传统PETL方法固有的性能差距。因此,我们提出了一种创新的METL策略SHERL,用于资源受限场景,将整个适应过程解耦为两个连续且互补的步骤。在早期阶段,通过反冗余操作整合中间输出,增强其后续交互的兼容性;在后期阶段,利用少量后期预训练层可缓解内存开销的峰值需求,并将这些相对灵活的特征调节为更适应且强大的新领域表示。在视觉-语言和纯语言任务上的大量消融实验表明,SHERL结合了参数和内存高效技术的优势,在微调过程中以更低的内存消耗实现与传统方法相当或更优的性能。我们的代码已公开在:https://github.com/Paranioar/SHERL。
abstract_en: Parameter-efficient transfer learning (PETL) has emerged as a flourishing research field for adapting large pre-trained models to downstream tasks, greatly reducing trainable parameters while grappling with memory challenges during fine-tuning. To address it, memory-efficient series (METL) avoid backpropagating gradients through the large backbone. However, they compromise by exclusively relying on frozen intermediate outputs and limiting the exhaustive exploration of prior knowledge from pre-trained models. Moreover, the dependency and redundancy between cross-layer features are frequently overlooked, thereby submerging more discriminative representations and causing an inherent performance gap (vs. conventional PETL methods). Hence, we propose an innovative METL strategy called SHERL for resource-limited scenarios to decouple the entire adaptation into two successive and complementary processes. In the early route, intermediate outputs are consolidated via an anti-redundancy operation, enhancing their compatibility for subsequent interactions; thereby in the late route, utilizing minimal late pre-trained layers could alleviate the peak demand on memory overhead and regulate these fairly flexible features into more adaptive and powerful representations for new domains. Extensive ablations on vision-and-language and language-only tasks show that SHERL combines the strengths of both parameter and memory-efficient techniques, performing on-par or better across diverse architectures with lower memory during fine-tuning. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/Paranioar/SHERL.

title: Haiwen Feng*, Zheng Ding, Zhihao Xia, Simon Niklaus, Victoria Fernandez Abrevaya, Michael J. Black, Xuaner Zhang
title_en: Haiwen Feng*, Zheng Ding, Zhihao Xia, Simon Niklaus, Victoria Fernandez Abrevaya, Michael J. Black, Xuaner Zhang
abstract: 我们引入了有界生成作为一项通用任务,以控制视频生成,仅基于给定的起始帧和结束帧,合成任意的摄像机和主体运动。我们的目标是充分利用图像到视频模型的固有泛化能力,而无需对原始模型进行额外的训练或微调。这是通过我们提出的新的采样策略实现的,该策略我们称之为,它融合了基于起始帧和结束帧的时序前向和反向去噪路径。融合后的路径生成的视频能够平滑地连接两个帧,生成忠实的主体运动、静态场景的新视角以及当两个边界帧相同时无缝的视频循环。我们整理了一个多样化的图像对评估数据集,并与现有方法进行了比较。我们发现,在所有子任务中,我们的方法都优于相关工作,展示了其在有界帧引导下生成复杂运动和3D一致视图的能力。项目页面请参见https://time-reversal.github.io.
abstract_en: We introduce bounded generation as a generalized task to control video generation to synthesize arbitrary camera and subject motion based only on a given start and end frame. Our objective is to fully leverage the inherent generalization capability of an image-to-video model without additional training or fine-tuning of the original model. This is achieved through the proposed new sampling strategy, which we call , that fuses the temporally forward and backward denoising paths conditioned on the start and end frame, respectively. The fused path results in a video that smoothly connects the two frames, generating inbetweening of faithful subject motion, novel views of static scenes, and seamless video looping when the two bounding frames are identical. We curate a diverse evaluation dataset of image pairs and compare against the closest existing methods. We find that outperforms related work on all subtasks, exhibiting the ability to generate complex motions and 3D-consistent views guided by bounded frames. See project page at https://time-reversal. github.io.

title: Haiyang Guo*, Fei Zhu, Wenzhuo Liu, Xu-Yao Zhang*, Cheng-Lin Liu
title_en: Haiyang Guo*, Fei Zhu, Wenzhuo Liu, Xu-Yao Zhang*, Cheng-Lin Liu
abstract: 现有的联邦学习方法已有效应对了涉及数据隐私和非独立同分布(non-IID)数据的分布式学习场景。然而,在现实场景中,每个客户端动态学习新类别,要求全局模型能够对所有已见过的类别进行分类。为在低通信成本下有效缓解灾难性遗忘和数据异质性问题,我们提出了一种简单有效的名为PILoRA的方法。一方面,我们采用原型学习以获取更好的特征表示,并利用原型与类别特征之间的启发式信息设计原型重加权模块,以解决数据异质性导致的分类器偏差问题,而无需重新训练分类器。另一方面,我们将增量学习视为学习不同任务向量并将其编码在不同LoRA参数中的过程。据此,我们提出增量LoRA以缓解灾难性遗忘。在标准数据集上的实验结果表明,我们的方法显著优于现有最先进的方法。更重要的是,我们的方法在不同设置和数据异质性程度下展现出强大的鲁棒性和优越性。代码可在https://github.com/ Ghy0501/PILoRA获取。
abstract_en: Existing federated learning methods have effectively dealt with decentralized learning in scenarios involving data privacy and non-IID data. However, in real-world situations, each client dynamically learns new classes, requiring the global model to classify all seen classes. To effectively mitigate catastrophic forgetting and data heterogeneity under low communication costs, we propose a simple and effective method named PILoRA. On the one hand, we adopt prototype learning to learn better feature representations and leverage the heuristic information between prototypes and class features to design a prototype re-weight module to solve the classifier bias caused by data heterogeneity without retraining the classifier. On the other hand, we view incremental learning as the process of learning distinct task vectors and encoding them within different LoRA parameters. Accordingly, we propose Incremental LoRA to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. Experimental results on standard datasets indicate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches significantly. More importantly, our method exhibits strong robustness and superiority in different settings and degrees of data heterogeneity. The code is available at https://github.com/ Ghy0501/PILoRA.

title: Haiyang Wang*, Hao Tang, Li Jiang, Shaoshuai Shi, Muhammad Ferjad Naeem, Hongsheng Li, Bernt Schiele, Liwei Wang
title_en: Haiyang Wang*, Hao Tang, Li Jiang, Shaoshuai Shi, Muhammad Ferjad Naeem, Hongsheng Li, Bernt Schiele, Liwei Wang
abstract: 本文提出了一种简单而有效的框架,称为__TITLE_MATH_1__,仅使用纯ViT即可同时适用于各种视觉任务。受多层Transformer架构(如GPT)在大语言模型(LLMs)中广泛应用的启发,我们试图将其应用范围扩展为强大的视觉基础模型(VFM)。然而,与语言建模不同,视觉任务通常需要特定模块,如检测任务的边界框头和分割任务的像素解码器,这极大阻碍了强大多层Transformer在视觉领域的应用。为解决这一问题,我们设计了一个通用语言接口,使成功的自回归解码能够灵活统一各类视觉任务,从图像级理解(如图像描述),到稀疏感知(如目标检测),再到密集预测(如语义分割)。基于上述设计,整个模型仅由ViT构成,无需任何特定添加,实现了显著的架构简化。__ABS_MATH_1__是一个多任务视觉模型,在五个代表性基准上联合训练,无需任务特定微调。有趣的是,我们的__ABS_MATH_1__在通用性能上建立了新基准,并促进任务间的相互增强,相较于孤立训练取得了显著提升。这反映了与LLMs相似的影响。进一步通过27个数据集丰富训练,__ABS_MATH_1__在各类任务上实现了强大的零样本结果。由于其简单设计,该范式有望缩小视觉与语言之间的架构差距。代码和模型可在redhttps: //github.com/Haiyang-W/GiT获取。
abstract_en: This paper proposes a simple, yet effective framework, called , simultaneously applicable for various vision tasks only with a vanilla ViT. Motivated by the universality of the Multi-layer Transformer architecture (e.g., GPT) widely used in large language models (LLMs), we seek to broaden its scope to serve as a powerful vision foundation model (VFM). However, unlike language modeling, visual tasks typically require specific modules, such as bounding box heads for detection and pixel decoders for segmentation, greatly hindering the application of powerful multi-layer transformers in the vision domain. To solve this, we design a universal language interface that empowers the successful auto-regressive decoding to adeptly unify various visual tasks, from image-level understanding (e.g. captioning), over sparse perception (e.g. detection), to dense prediction (e.g. segmentation). Based on the above designs, the entire model is composed solely of a ViT, without any specific additions, offering a remarkable architectural simplification. is a multi-task visual model, jointly trained across five representative benchmarks without task-specific fine-tuning. Interestingly, our builds a new benchmark in generalist performance, and fosters mutual enhancement across tasks, leading to significant improvements compared to isolated training. This reflects a similar impact observed in LLMs. Further enriching training with 27 datasets, achieves strong zero-shot results over various tasks. Due to its simple design, this paradigm holds promise for narrowing the architectural gap between vision and language. Code and models are available at redhttps: //github.com/Haiyang-W/GiT.

title: Haiyang Yu, Teng Fu, Bin Li*, Xiangyang Xue
title_en: Haiyang Yu, Teng Fu, Bin Li*, Xiangyang Xue
abstract: 场景文本分割旨在从场景图像中裁剪出文本,通常用于帮助生成模型编辑或删除文本。现有的文本分割方法往往涉及多种与文本相关的监督信息以提高性能。然而,大多数方法忽略了文本边缘的重要性,而文本边缘对于下游应用具有重要意义。本文提出了一种边缘感知的Transformer模型,称为EAFormer,以更精确地分割文本,尤其是在文本边缘区域。具体而言,我们首先设计了一个文本边缘提取器以检测边缘并过滤掉非文本区域的边缘。然后,我们提出了一种边缘引导的编码器,使模型更加关注文本边缘。最后,采用基于MLP的解码器来预测文本掩码。我们在常用基准数据集上进行了大量实验以验证EAFormer的有效性。实验结果表明,所提出的方法在文本边缘分割方面优于先前方法。考虑到几个基准数据集(如COCO TS和MLT S)的标注不够准确,无法公平评估我们的方法,我们对这些数据集进行了重新标注。通过实验,我们观察到当使用更准确的标注进行训练时,我们的方法能实现更高的性能提升。代码和数据集可在bluehttps://hyangyu.github.io/EAFormer/获取。
abstract_en: Scene text segmentation aims at cropping texts from scene images, which is usually used to help generative models edit or remove texts. The existing text segmentation methods tend to involve various text-related supervisions for better performance. However, most of them ignore the importance of text edges, which are significant for downstream applications. In this paper, we propose Edge-Aware Transformers, termed EAFormer, to segment texts more accurately, especially at the edge of texts. Specifically, we first design a text edge extractor to detect edges and filter out edges of non-text areas. Then, we propose an edge-guided encoder to make the model focus more on text edges. Finally, an MLP-based decoder is employed to predict text masks. We have conducted extensive experiments on commonly-used benchmarks to verify the effectiveness of EAFormer. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can perform better than previous methods, especially on the segmentation of text edges. Considering that the annotations of several benchmarks (e.g., COCO TS and MLT S) are not accurate enough to fairly evaluate our methods, we have relabeled these datasets. Through experiments, we observe that our method can achieve a higher performance improvement when more accurate annotations are used for training. The code and datasets are available at bluehttps://hyangyu.github.io/EAFormer/.

title: Haiyang Zheng, Nan Pu, Wenjing Li*, Nicu Sebe, Zhun Zhong*
title_en: Haiyang Zheng, Nan Pu, Wenjing Li*, Nicu Sebe, Zhun Zhong*
abstract: 本文研究了通用类别发现(Generalized Category Discovery, GCD)问题,旨在利用已知类别的标注数据知识,对来自已知和未知类别的无标签数据进行聚类。当前的GCD方法仅依赖于视觉线索,然而忽视了人类认知过程中发现新视觉类别时的多模态感知特性。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种两阶段的TextGCD框架,通过利用强大的视觉-语言模型实现多模态GCD。TextGCD主要包括基于检索的文本生成(Retrieval-based Text Generation, RTG)阶段和跨模态协同教学(Cross-modality Co-teaching, CCT)阶段。首先,RTG利用来自多样化数据集的类别标签和大型语言模型的属性构建视觉词汇表,以检索方式为图像生成描述性文本。其次,CCT通过文本与视觉模态之间的差异促进相互学习,从而增强视觉GCD。此外,我们设计了一种自适应类别对齐策略,确保模态间的类别感知对齐,并设计了一种软投票机制以整合多模态线索。在八个数据集上的实验表明,我们的方法显著优于现有最先进的方法。值得注意的是,我们的方法在ImageNet-1k和CUB数据集上的All accuracy分别比最佳竞争对手高出7.7%和10.8%。代码可在https://github.com/HaiyangZheng/TextGCD获取。
abstract_en: In this paper, we study the problem of Generalized Category Discovery (GCD), which aims to cluster unlabeled data from both known and unknown categories using the knowledge of labeled data from known categories. Current GCD methods rely on only visual cues, which however neglect the multi-modality perceptive nature of human cognitive processes in discovering novel visual categories. To address this, we propose a two-phase TextGCD framework to accomplish multi-modality GCD by exploiting powerful Visual-Language Models. TextGCD mainly includes a retrieval-based text generation (RTG) phase and a cross-modality co-teaching (CCT) phase. First, RTG constructs a visual lexicon using category tags from diverse datasets and attributes from Large Language Models, generating descriptive texts for images in a retrieval manner. Second, CCT leverages disparities between textual and visual modalities to foster mutual learning, thereby enhancing visual GCD. In addition, we design an adaptive class aligning strategy to ensure the alignment of category perceptions between modalities as well as a soft-voting mechanism to integrate multi-modality cues. Experiments on eight datasets show the large superiority of our approach over state-of-the-art methods. Notably, our approach outperforms the best competitor, by 7.7% and 10.8% in All accuracy on ImageNet-1k and CUB, respectively. Code is available at https://github.com/HaiyangZheng/TextGCD.

title: Haizhong Zheng*, Jiachen Sun, Shutong Wu, Bhavya Kailkhura, Zhuoqing Morley Mao, Chaowei Xiao*, Atul Prakash*
title_en: Haizhong Zheng*, Jiachen Sun, Shutong Wu, Bhavya Kailkhura, Zhuoqing Morley Mao, Chaowei Xiao*, Atul Prakash*
abstract: 给定一个真实世界的数据集,数据凝练(DC)旨在合成一个小型合成数据集,该数据集能够捕捉自然数据集的知识,同时可用于训练模型并保持相当的准确性。近期研究提出通过数据参数化增强DC,将数据凝练为非常紧凑的参数化数据容器而非图像。数据参数化的直觉是通过编码图像的共享特征来避免额外的存储成本。在本文中,我们认识到由于分类系统的固有层次结构,图像在层次方式上共享共同特征,而当前的数据参数化方法忽略了这一点。为了更好地使DC与这种层次特性对齐,并鼓励数据容器内部更高效的特征共享,我们提出了一种新颖的数据参数化架构——层次化记忆网络(HMN)。HMN以三层结构存储凝练数据,分别表示数据集级、类别级和实例级特征。层次化架构的另一个有益特性是,HMN在实现特征共享的同时,自然确保图像之间的良好独立性。这使得HMN能够进行实例级剪枝以减少冗余信息,从而进一步降低冗余并提升性能。我们在五个公开数据集上评估了HMN,结果表明我们的方法优于所有基线方法。
abstract_en: Given a real-world dataset, data condensation (DC) aims to synthesize a small synthetic dataset that captures the knowledge of a natural dataset while being usable for training models with comparable accuracy. Recent works propose to enhance DC with data parameterization, which condenses data into very compact parameterized data containers instead of images. The intuition behind data parameterization is to encode shared features of images to avoid additional storage costs. In this paper, we recognize that images share common features in a hierarchical way due to the inherent hierarchical structure of the classification system, which is overlooked by current data parameterization methods. To better align DC with this hierarchical nature and encourage more efficient information sharing inside data containers, we propose a novel data parameterization architecture, Hierarchical Memory Network (HMN). HMN stores condensed data in a three-tier structure, representing the dataset-level, class-level, and instance-level features. Another helpful property of the hierarchical architecture is that HMN naturally ensures good independence among images despite achieving information sharing. This enables instance-level pruning for HMN to reduce redundant information, thereby further minimizing redundancy and enhancing performance. We evaluate HMN on five public datasets and show that our proposed method outperforms all baselines.

title: Hajin Shim, Changhun Kim, Eunho Yang*
title_en: Hajin Shim, Changhun Kim, Eunho Yang*
abstract: 从现实世界传感器捕获的3D点云数据通常包含由于遮挡、分辨率限制和尺度变化等障碍导致的噪声点。这些挑战阻碍了在干净点云上预训练的点云识别模型的部署,导致显著的性能退化。尽管测试时适应(TTA)策略在2D领域对此问题表现出有希望的结果,但其在3D点云中的应用仍处于探索阶段。在TTA方法中,一种输入适应方法通过预训练的扩散模型直接将测试实例转换为源域,已在2D领域提出。尽管其在实际场景中表现出鲁棒的TTA性能,但直接将其应用于3D域可能因忽略点云的固有特性以及计算成本过高而效果不佳。受这些限制的启发,我们提出CloudFixer,一种针对3D点云的测试时输入适应方法,采用预训练的扩散模型。具体而言,CloudFixer通过精心设计的目标函数优化几何变换参数,这些目标函数利用了点云的几何特性。我们还通过避免通过扩散模型的反向传播和耗时的生成过程,显著提高了计算效率。此外,我们提出了一种在线模型适应策略,通过将原始模型预测与适应后的输入预测对齐。大量实验展示了CloudFixer在多种TTA基线方法上的优越性,尤其在处理常见退化和自然分布偏移方面表现出色。我们的代码可在https://github.com/shimazing/CloudFixer获取。
abstract_en: 3D point clouds captured from real-world sensors frequently encompass noisy points due to various obstacles, such as occlusion, limited resolution, and variations in scale. These challenges hinder the deployment of pre-trained point cloud recognition models trained on clean point clouds, leading to significant performance degradation. While test-time adaptation (TTA) strategies have shown promising results on this issue in the 2D domain, their application to 3D point clouds remains under-explored. Among TTA methods, an input adaptation approach, which directly converts test instances to the source domain using a pre-trained diffusion model, has been proposed in the 2D domain. Despite its robust TTA performance in practical situations, naively adopting this into the 3D domain may be suboptimal due to the neglect of inherent properties of point clouds, and its prohibitive computational cost. Motivated by these limitations, we propose CloudFixer, a test-time input adaptation method tailored for 3D point clouds, employing a pre-trained diffusion model. Specifically, CloudFixer optimizes geometric transformation parameters with carefully designed objectives that leverage the geometric properties of point clouds. We also substantially improve computational efficiency by avoiding backpropagation through the diffusion model and a prohibitive generation process. Furthermore, we propose an online model adaptation strategy by aligning the original model prediction with that of the adapted input. Extensive experiments showcase the superiority of CloudFixer over various TTA baselines, excelling in handling common corruptions and natural distribution shifts across diverse real-world scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/shimazing/CloudFixer.

title: Hallee E. Wong*, Marianne Rakic, John Guttag, Adrian V. Dalca
title_en: Hallee E. Wong*, Marianne Rakic, John Guttag, Adrian V. Dalca
abstract: 生物医学图像分割是科学研究和临床护理中的关键部分。在拥有足够标注数据的情况下,深度学习模型可以被训练以准确自动化特定的生物医学图像分割任务。然而,手动分割图像以创建训练数据是非常劳动密集型的,并且需要领域专业知识。我们提出了ScribblePrompt,这是一个基于神经网络的灵活交互式分割工具,用于生物医学成像,使人类标注者能够使用涂鸦、点击和边界框来分割之前未见过的结构。通过严格的定量实验,我们证明在相似的交互量下,ScribblePrompt在训练期间未见过的数据集上产生的分割结果比以前的方法更准确。在与领域专家进行的用户研究中,ScribblePrompt将标注时间减少了28%,同时与最佳方法相比,Dice系数提高了15%。ScribblePrompt的成功依赖于一系列精心设计的决策。这些包括结合高度多样化的图像和任务的训练策略、用于模拟用户交互和标签的新算法,以及支持快速推理的网络。我们在一个交互式演示中展示了ScribblePrompt,提供了代码,并在https://scribbleprompt.csail.mit.edu发布了涂鸦注释数据集。
abstract_en: Biomedical image segmentation is a crucial part of both scientific research and clinical care. With enough labelled data, deep learning models can be trained to accurately automate specific biomedical image segmentation tasks. However, manually segmenting images to create training data is highly labor intensive and requires domain expertise. We present ScribblePrompt, a flexible neural network based interactive segmentation tool for biomedical imaging that enables human annotators to segment previously unseen structures using scribbles, clicks, and bounding boxes. Through rigorous quantitative experiments, we demonstrate that given comparable amounts of interaction, ScribblePrompt produces more accurate segmentations than previous methods on datasets unseen during training. In a user study with domain experts, ScribblePrompt reduced annotation time by 28% while improving Dice by 15% compared to the next best method. ScribblePrompt’s success rests on a set of careful design decisions. These include a training strategy that incorporates both a highly diverse set of images and tasks, novel algorithms for simulated user interactions and labels, and a network that enables fast inference. We showcase ScribblePrompt in an interactive demo, provide code, and release a dataset of scribble annotations at https://scribbleprompt.csail.mit.edu

title: Hamza Rami*, Jhony H. Giraldo, Nicolas Winckler, Stéphane Lathuilière
title_en: Hamza Rami*, Jhony H. Giraldo, Nicolas Winckler, Stéphane Lathuilière
abstract: 再识别系统(Re-ID)对公共安全至关重要,但面临适应与训练分布不同的环境的挑战。此外,随着对个人自由的担忧增加,公共场所实施了严格的隐私协议,这为在新环境中部署准确的再识别系统增加了复杂性。例如,在欧盟,"数据最小化"和"目的限制"原则限制了图像的保留和处理,仅限于严格必要的范围。这些法规对依赖服务器集中数据的传统再识别训练方案提出了挑战。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新的隐私保护分布式无监督域适应设置用于行人再识别(__TITLE_MATH_1__),以解决域迁移问题,而无需将任何图像传输到相机设备之外。为应对这一设置,我们引入了__ABS_MATH_1__,一种新颖的解决方案,直接在边缘设备内适应行人再识别模型。我们提出的解决方案利用源域的原型,在边缘设备内对齐特征统计信息。这些源原型在边缘设备间分布,以最小化针对该设置定制的分布式最大均值差异(MMD)损失。我们的实验结果提供了有力证据,证明__ABS_MATH_1__在准确性和通信效率方面均优于所有评估方法,同时保持数据隐私。
abstract_en: Re-Identification systems (Re-ID) are crucial for public safety but face the challenge of having to adapt to environments that differ from their training distribution. Furthermore, rigorous privacy protocols in public places are being enforced as apprehensions regarding individual freedom rise, adding layers of complexity to the deployment of accurate Re-ID systems in new environments. For example, in the European Union, the principles of “Data Minimization” and “Purpose Limitation” restrict the retention and processing of images to what is strictly necessary. These regulations pose a challenge to the conventional Re-ID training schemes that rely on centralizing data on servers. In this work, we present a novel setting for privacy-preserving Distributed Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for person Re-ID () to address the problem of domain shift without requiring any image transfer outside the camera devices. To address this setting, we introduce , a novel solution that adapts person Re-ID models directly within the edge devices. Our proposed solution employs prototypes derived from the source domain to align feature statistics within edge devices. Those source prototypes are distributed across the edge devices to minimize a distributed Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) loss tailored for the setting. Our experiments provide compelling evidence that outperforms all evaluated methods in terms of both accuracy and communication efficiency, all while maintaining data privacy.

title: Han Li*, Shaohui Li*, Shuangrui Ding, Wenrui Dai*, Maida Cao, Chenglin Li, Junni Zou, Hongkai Xiong
title_en: Han Li*, Shaohui Li*, Shuangrui Ding, Wenrui Dai*, Maida Cao, Chenglin Li, Junni Zou, Hongkai Xiong
abstract: 面向机器和人眼视觉的图像压缩(ICMH)近年来受到了越来越多的关注。现有ICMH方法由于任务特定网络设计的复杂性,导致训练和存储开销较高,从而受到限制。为了解决这一问题,本文提出了一种新颖的轻量级适配器调优框架Adapt-ICMH,该框架在减少开销的同时,更好地平衡了任务性能和比特率。我们提出了一种空间-频率调制适配器(SFMA),它通过空间调制适配器同时消除非语义冗余,并通过频率调制适配器增强任务相关的频率成分并抑制任务无关的频率成分。所提出的适配器具有即插即用的特性,能够与几乎所有现有的学习图像压缩模型兼容,而不会影响预训练模型的性能。实验表明,Adapt-ICMH在减少微调参数和计算复杂度的情况下,能够持续优于现有的ICMH框架,适用于各种机器视觉任务。代码将在https://github.com/qingshi9974/ECCV2024-AdpatICMH发布。
abstract_en: Image compression for machine and human vision (ICMH) has gained increasing attention in recent years. Existing ICMH methods are limited by high training and storage overheads due to heavy design of task-specific networks. To address this issue, in this paper, we develop a novel lightweight adapter-based tuning framework for ICMH, named Adapt-ICMH, that better balances task performance and bitrates with reduced overheads. We propose a spatial-frequency modulation adapter (SFMA) that simultaneously eliminates non-semantic redundancy with a spatial modulation adapter, and enhances task-relevant frequency components and suppresses task-irrelevant frequency components with a frequency modulation adapter. The proposed adapter is plug-and-play and compatible with almost all existing learned image compression models without compromising the performance of pre-trained models. Experiments demonstrate that Adapt-ICMH consistently outperforms existing ICMH frameworks on various machine vision tasks with fewer fine-tuned parameters and reduced computational complexity. Code will be released at https://github.com/qingshi9974/ECCV2024-AdpatICMH.

title: Han Wang*, Yanjie Wang, Ye Yongjie, Yuxiang Nie, Can Huang
title_en: Han Wang*, Yanjie Wang, Ye Yongjie, Yuxiang Nie, Can Huang
abstract: 多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)已展现出对静态图像中物体的感知能力,但在视频相关任务(如目标跟踪)中的应用仍处于初步探索阶段。这种研究不足主要源于两个关键挑战。首先,需要在大规模视频数据集上进行广泛预训练,以使MLLMs具备跨多帧感知物体并理解帧间关系的能力。其次,处理大量帧数据时,大型语言模型(LLMs)的上下文窗口可能带来显著的计算负担。为应对第一个挑战,我们引入了支持三项任务的大型视频数据集,包括单目标跟踪(SOT)、引用单目标跟踪(RSOT)和视频引用表达生成(Video-REG)。该数据集包含127万标注视频帧,包含对应的目标框和描述信息。借助该数据集,我们对MLLMs进行训练,并提出令牌压缩模型T-Selector以解决第二个挑战。我们的方法Elysium:通过MLLM探索视频中的目标级感知,是一种端到端可训练的MLLM,旨在无需任何额外插件或专家模型的情况下完成视频中的目标级任务。所有代码和数据集已开源至https://github.com/Hon-Wong/Elysium。
abstract_en: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated their ability to perceive objects in still images, but their application in video-related tasks, such as object tracking, remains understudied. This lack of exploration is primarily due to two key challenges. Firstly, extensive pretraining on large-scale video datasets is required to equip MLLMs with the capability to perceive objects across multiple frames and understand inter-frame relationships. Secondly, processing a large number of frames within the context window of Large Language Models (LLMs) can impose a significant computational burden. To address the first challenge, we introduce , a large-scale video dataset supported for three tasks: Single Object Tracking (SOT), Referring Single Object Tracking (RSOT), and Video Referring Expression Generation (Video-REG). contains 1.27 million annotated video frames with corresponding object boxes and descriptions. Leveraging this dataset, we conduct training of MLLMs and propose a token-compression model T-Selector to tackle the second challenge. Our proposed approach, Elysium: Exploring Object-level Perception in Videos via MLLM, is an end-to-end trainable MLLM that attempts to conduct object-level tasks in videos without requiring any additional plug-in or expert models. All codes and datasets are released at https://github.com/Hon-Wong/Elysium.

title: Han Xiao, 郑文昭, 左思成, 高鹏, 周杰, 卢继文*
title_en: Han Xiao, Wenzhao Zheng, Sicheng Zuo, Peng Gao, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu*
abstract: 视觉Transformer在多个任务中展现出有前景的结果,并成为核心组件。现有大多数工作集中在上下文特征提取,并通过额外的位置嵌入引入空间信息。然而,它们仅考虑每个图像标记内的局部位置信息,无法有效建模底层场景的全局空间关系。为解决这一挑战,我们提出了一种高效的视觉Transformer架构SpatialFormer,具有显式的空间理解能力,用于通用的图像表征学习。具体而言,我们为图像标记添加自适应空间标记,分别表示上下文和空间信息。我们通过位置编码初始化空间标记以引入通用空间先验,并通过可学习嵌入增强其以建模自适应空间信息。为了更好的泛化能力,我们采用仅解码器的整体架构,并提出双向交叉注意力模块以实现上下文标记与空间标记之间的高效交互。SpatialFormer学习具有显式场景理解的可迁移图像表征,其中输出的空间标记可进一步作为任务特定解码器的增强初始查询,以更好地适应下游任务。在图像分类、语义分割和2D/3D目标检测任务上的大量实验验证了所提SpatialFormer架构的效率和可迁移性。代码可在https://github.com/Euphoria16/SpatialFormer获取。
abstract_en: Vision transformers have demonstrated promising results and become core components in many tasks. Most existing works focus on context feature extraction and incorporate spatial information through additional positional embedding. However, they only consider the local positional information within each image token and cannot effectively model the global spatial relations of the underlying scene. To address this challenge, we propose an efficient vision transformer architecture, SpatialFormer, with explicit spatial understanding for generalizable image representation learning. Specifically, we accompany the image tokens with adaptive spatial tokens to represent the context and spatial information respectively. We initialize the spatial tokens with positional encoding to introduce general spatial priors and augment them with learnable embeddings to model adaptive spatial information. For better generalization, we employ a decoder-only overall architecture and propose a bilateral cross-attention block for efficient interactions between context and spatial tokens. SpatialFormer learns transferable image representations with explicit scene understanding, where the output spatial tokens can further serve as enhanced initial queries for task-specific decoders for better adaptations to downstream tasks. Extensive experiments on image classification, semantic segmentation, and 2D/3D object detection tasks demonstrate the efficiency and transferability of the proposed SpatialFormer architecture. Code is available at https://github.com/Euphoria16/SpatialFormer.

title: Han Zhou, Wei Dong, Xiaohong Liu*, Shuaicheng Liu, Xiongkuo Min, Guangtao Zhai, Jun Chen*
title_en: Han Zhou, Wei Dong, Xiaohong Liu*, Shuaicheng Liu, Xiongkuo Min, Guangtao Zhai, Jun Chen*
abstract: 现有大多数低光照图像增强(LLIE)方法要么直接将低光照(LL)映射到正常光照(NL)图像,要么使用语义或光照图作为引导。然而,LLIE的不适定性质以及从受损输入中进行语义检索的困难限制了这些方法,尤其是在极端低光照条件下。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种基于生成潜在特征码本检索(GLARE)的新LLIE网络,其中码本先验是通过向量量化(VQ)策略从未退化的NL图像中导出的。更重要的是,我们开发了一种生成可逆潜在归一化流(I-LNF)模块,以对齐LL特征分布到NL潜在表示,确保码本中的正确码检索。此外,设计了一种新颖的自适应特征变换(AFT)模块,该模块包含可调节函数供用户使用,并结合自适应混合块(AMB)和双解码器架构,以进一步提高保真度,同时保留码本先验提供的现实细节。大量实验验证了GLARE在各种基准数据集和真实世界数据上的优越性能。其在低光照目标检测任务中的预处理工具有效性进一步验证了GLARE在高层视觉应用中的价值。代码已发布于https://github.com/LowLevelAI/GLARE。
abstract_en: Most existing Low-light Image Enhancement (LLIE) methods either directly map Low-Light (LL) to Normal-Light (NL) images or use semantic or illumination maps as guides. However, the ill-posed nature of LLIE and the difficulty of semantic retrieval from impaired inputs limit these methods, especially in extremely low-light conditions. To address this issue, we present a new LLIE network via Generative LAtent feature based codebook REtrieval (GLARE), in which the codebook prior is derived from undegraded NL images using a Vector Quantization (VQ) strategy. More importantly, we develop a generative Invertible Latent Normalizing Flow (I-LNF) module to align the LL feature distribution to NL latent representations, guaranteeing the correct code retrieval in the codebook. In addition, a novel Adaptive Feature Transformation (AFT) module, featuring an adjustable function for users and comprising an Adaptive Mix-up Block (AMB) along with a dual-decoder architecture, is devised to further enhance fidelity while preserving the realistic details provided by codebook prior. Extensive experiments confirm the superior performance of GLARE on various benchmark datasets and real-world data. Its effectiveness as a preprocessing tool in low-light object detection tasks further validates GLARE for high-level vision applications. Code is released at https://github.com/ LowLevelAI/GLARE.

title: Hang Guo*, Jinmin Li, Tao Dai*, Zhihao Ouyang, Xudong Ren, Shu-Tao Xia
title_en: Hang Guo*, Jinmin Li, Tao Dai*, Zhihao Ouyang, Xudong Ren, Shu-Tao Xia
abstract: 近年来,图像修复领域取得了显著进展,这主要归功于现代深度神经网络(如卷积神经网络和Transformer)的发展。然而,现有修复主干网络常常面临全局感受野与高效计算之间的矛盾,限制了其在实际中的应用。最近,选择性结构状态空间模型(尤其是改进版Mamba)在长程依赖建模方面展现出巨大潜力,其线性复杂度为解决上述矛盾提供了新途径。然而,标准Mamba在低级视觉任务中仍面临局部像素遗忘和通道冗余等挑战。本文提出了一种简单而有效的基线模型MambaIR,在保留原始Mamba结构的基础上引入局部增强和通道注意力机制。通过这种方式,MambaIR充分利用局部像素相似性并减少通道冗余。大量实验验证了我们方法的优越性,例如在图像超分辨率任务中,MambaIR在保持相似计算成本的同时,以全局感受野优势超越SwinIR高达0.45dB。代码已开源至https://github.com/csguoh/MambaIR。
abstract_en: Recent years have seen significant advancements in image restoration, largely attributed to the development of modern deep neural networks, such as CNNs and Transformers. However, existing restoration backbones often face the dilemma between global receptive fields and efficient computation, hindering their application in practice. Recently, the Selective Structured State Space Model, especially the improved version Mamba, has shown great potential for long-range dependency modeling with linear complexity, which offers a way to resolve the above dilemma. However, the standard Mamba still faces certain challenges in low-level vision such as local pixel forgetting and channel redundancy. In this work, we introduce a simple but effective baseline, named MambaIR, which introduces both local enhancement and channel attention to improve the vanilla Mamba. In this way, our MambaIR takes advantage of the local pixel similarity and reduces the channel redundancy. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our method, for example, MambaIR outperforms SwinIR by up to 0.45dB on image SR, using similar computational cost but with a global receptive field. Code is available at https://github.com/csguoh/MambaIR.

title: Hang Hua*, Jing Shi, Kushal Kafle, Simon Jenni, Daoan Zhang, John Collomosse, Scott Cohen, Jiebo Luo
title_en: Hang Hua*, Jing Shi, Kushal Kafle, Simon Jenni, Daoan Zhang, John Collomosse, Scott Cohen, Jiebo Luo
abstract: 大规模预训练技术的最新进展推动了具有显著多模态内容理解和生成能力的先进视觉-语言模型(VLMs)的发展。尽管VLMs在复杂推理方面表现出色,但当前模型往往难以有效且精确地捕捉图像和文本两侧的组合信息。为解决这一问题,我们提出了__TITLE_MATH_1__,一个基于方面细粒度文本与图像匹配的新基准测试,专注于文本与图像不匹配检测与修正。该基准测试引入了一种新任务,以提升和评估VLMs在基于方面的细粒度文本与图像匹配中的组合性。在此任务中,模型需要识别描述中的不匹配方面短语,确定该方面的类别,并为可能包含0至3个不匹配项的图像-文本对提出修正方案。为评估模型在该新任务上的表现,我们提出了一种新的评估指标ITM-IoU,实验表明其与人工评估具有高度相关性。此外,我们还对主流VLMs进行了全面的实验分析,包括全监督学习和上下文学习场景。我们发现,基于__ABS_MATH_1__训练的模型在检测细粒度文本与图像不匹配方面表现出更强的能力。此外,尽管具有强大多模态上下文学习能力的模型(如GPT-4V、Gemini Pro Vision)在细粒度组合性图像与文本匹配分析方面并不如预期熟练。借助__TITLE_MATH_1__,我们能够构建一个用于文本到图像生成幻觉检测与修正的系统。相关资源可访问https://hanghuacs.github.io/finematch/。
abstract_en: Recent progress in large-scale pre-training has led to the development of advanced vision-language models (VLMs) with remarkable proficiency in comprehending and generating multimodal content. Despite the impressive ability to perform complex reasoning for VLMs, current models often struggle to effectively and precisely capture the compositional information on both the image and text sides. To address this, we propose , a new aspect-based fine-grained text and image matching benchmark, focusing on text and image mismatch detection and correction. This benchmark introduces a novel task for boosting and evaluating the VLMs’ compositionality for aspect-based fine-grained text and image matching. In this task, models are required to identify mismatched aspect phrases within a caption, determine the aspect’s class, and propose corrections for an image-text pair that may contain between 0 and 3 mismatches. To evaluate the models’ performance on this new task, we propose a new evaluation metric named ITM-IoU for which our experiments show a high correlation to human evaluation. In addition, we also provide a comprehensive experimental analysis of existing mainstream VLMs, including fully supervised learning and in-context learning settings. We have found that models trained on demonstrate enhanced proficiency in detecting fine-grained text and image mismatches. Moreover, models (e.g., GPT-4V, Gemini Pro Vision) with strong abilities to perform multimodal in-context learning are not as skilled at fine-grained compositional image and text matching analysis. With , we are able to build a system for text-to-image generation hallucination detection and correction. Resources are available at https://hanghuacs.github.io/finematch/.

title: Hang Yao, Ming Liu*, Zhicun Yin, Zifei Yan, Xiaopeng Hong, Wangmeng Zuo
title_en: Hang Yao, Ming Liu*, Zhicun Yin, Zifei Yan, Xiaopeng Hong, Wangmeng Zuo
abstract: 扩散模型在无监督异常检测任务中表现出优越的性能。由于仅使用正常数据进行训练,扩散模型倾向于在测试图像中添加一定噪声后重构其正常对应物。然而,这些方法将所有潜在异常视为同等重要,这可能导致两个主要问题。从全局视角来看,不同异常图像的重构难度存在差异。例如,补全缺失元素比处理划痕更困难,因此需要更多的去噪步骤。因此,我们提出为每个样本预测特定的去噪步骤,通过评估图像内容与扩散模型提取的先验之间的差异,而非对所有样本使用相同的设置。从局部视角来看,同一图像中异常区域的重构与正常区域存在差异。理论上,扩散模型在每一步预测噪声,通常遵循标准高斯分布。然而,由于异常与其潜在正常对应物的差异,异常区域预测的噪声必然偏离标准高斯分布。为此,我们提出在训练中引入合成异常样本,鼓励扩散模型突破标准高斯分布的限制,并在推理过程中采用空间自适应特征融合方案。通过上述改进,我们提出一种全局与局部自适应扩散模型(简称GLAD),用于无监督异常检测,该方法引入了引人注目的灵活性,在实现无异常重构的同时尽可能保留正常信息。我们在三个常用异常检测数据集(MVTec-AD、MPDD和VisA)以及我们整合的印刷电路板数据集(PCB-Bank)上进行了大量实验,验证了所提方法的有效性。源代码和预训练模型已公开在https://github.com/hyao1/GLAD。
abstract_en: Diffusion models have shown superior performance on unsupervised anomaly detection tasks. Since trained with normal data only, diffusion models tend to reconstruct normal counterparts of test images with certain noises added. However, these methods treat all potential anomalies equally, which may cause two main problems. From the global perspective, the difficulty of reconstructing images with different anomalies is uneven. For example, adding back a missing element is harder than dealing with a scratch, thus requiring a larger number of denoising steps. Therefore, instead of utilizing the same setting for all samples, we propose to predict a particular denoising step for each sample by evaluating the difference between image contents and the priors extracted from diffusion models. From the local perspective, reconstructing abnormal regions differs from normal areas even in the same image. Theoretically, the diffusion model predicts a noise for each step, typically following a standard Gaussian distribution. However, due to the difference between the anomaly and its potential normal counterpart, the predicted noise in abnormal regions will inevitably deviate from the standard Gaussian distribution. To this end, we propose introducing synthetic abnormal samples in training to encourage the diffusion models to break through the limitation of standard Gaussian distribution, and a spatial-adaptive feature fusion scheme is utilized during inference. With the above modifications, we propose a global and local adaptive diffusion model (abbreviated to GLAD) for unsupervised anomaly detection, which introduces appealing flexibility and achieves anomaly-free reconstruction while retaining as much normal information as possible. Extensive experiments are conducted on three commonly used anomaly detection datasets (MVTec-AD, MPDD, and VisA) and a printed circuit board dataset (PCB-Bank) we integrated, showing the effectiveness of the proposed method. The source code and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/hyao1/GLAD.

title: 王涵静*, Bashirul Azam Biswas, 机强
title_en: Hanjing Wang*, Bashirul Azam Biswas, Qiang Ji
abstract: 不确定性归因(UA)旨在识别深度学习模型预测不确定性中的关键贡献因素。为提升现有UA方法的可信度,我们将UA形式化为一个优化问题,以在输入上学习二进制掩码。所学掩码可识别显著影响输出不确定性的区域,并通过在掩码输入上学习信息性扰动实现不确定性降低。我们的方法通过整合三项关键改进,增强了UA的可解释性并保持高效率:SAM引导的掩码参数化以实现高效且可解释的掩码学习;可学习扰动自适应定位并优化特定输入的异常区域,无需手动调整扰动参数;以及Gumbel-sigmoid重参数化的新颖应用,以在连续优化下高效学习伯努利分布的二进制掩码。我们在异常区域检测和可信度测试实验中验证了方法的优越性,优于现有最先进的UA方法。
abstract_en: Uncertainty attribution (UA) aims to identify key contributors to predictive uncertainty in deep learning models. To improve the faithfulness of existing UA methods, we formulate UA as an optimization problem to learn a binary mask on the input. The learned mask identifies regions that significantly contribute to output uncertainty and allows uncertainty reduction through learning informative perturbations on the masked input. Our method enhances UA interpretability and maintains high efficiency by integrating three key improvements: Segment Anything Model (SAM)-guided mask parameterization for efficient and interpretable mask learning; learnable perturbations that adaptively target and refine problematic regions specific to each input without manually tuning the perturbation parameters; and a novel application of Gumbel-sigmoid reparameterization for efficiently learning Bernoulli-distributed binary masks under continuous optimization. Our experiments on problematic region detection and faithfulness tests demonstrate our method’s superiority over state-of-the-art UA methods.

title: Hanjung Kim, Jaehyun Kang, Miran Heo, Sukjun Hwang, Seoung Wug Oh, Seon Joo Kim*
title_en: Hanjung Kim, Jaehyun Kang, Miran Heo, Sukjun Hwang, Seoung Wug Oh, Seon Joo Kim*
abstract: In recent years, online Video Instance Segmentation (VIS) methods have shown remarkable advancement with their powerful query-based detectors. Utilizing the output queries of the detector at the frame-level, these methods achieve high accuracy on challenging benchmarks. However, our observations demonstrate that these methods heavily rely on location information, which often causes incorrect associations between objects. This paper presents that a key axis of object matching in trackers is appearance information, which becomes greatly instructive under conditions where positional cues are insufficient for distinguishing their identities. Therefore, we suggest a simple yet powerful extension to object decoders that explicitly extract embeddings from backbone features and drive queries to capture the appearances of objects, which greatly enhances instance association accuracy. Furthermore, recognizing the limitations of existing benchmarks in fully evaluating appearance awareness, we have constructed a synthetic dataset to rigorously validate our method. By effectively resolving the over-reliance on location information, we achieve state-of-the-art results on YouTube-VIS 2019/2021 and Occluded VIS (OVIS). Code is available at https://github.com/KimHanjung/VISAGE.
abstract_en: In recent years, online Video Instance Segmentation (VIS) methods have shown remarkable advancement with their powerful query-based detectors. Utilizing the output queries of the detector at the frame-level, these methods achieve high accuracy on challenging benchmarks. However, our observations demonstrate that these methods heavily rely on location information, which often causes incorrect associations between objects. This paper presents that a key axis of object matching in trackers is appearance information, which becomes greatly instructive under conditions where positional cues are insufficient for distinguishing their identities. Therefore, we suggest a simple yet powerful extension to object decoders that explicitly extract embeddings from backbone features and drive queries to capture the appearances of objects, which greatly enhances instance association accuracy. Furthermore, recognizing the limitations of existing benchmarks in fully evaluating appearance awareness, we have constructed a synthetic dataset to rigorously validate our method. By effectively resolving the over-reliance on location information, we achieve state-of-the-art results on YouTube-VIS 2019/2021 and Occluded VIS (OVIS). Code is available at https://github.com/KimHanjung/VISAGE.

title: Hanrong Ye*, Jason Kuen, Qing Liu, Zhe Lin, Brian Price, Dan Xu*
title_en: Hanrong Ye*, Jason Kuen, Qing Liu, Zhe Lin, Brian Price, Dan Xu*
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的数据生成方法,该方法突破了当前最先进的图像分割模型的性能边界。先前分割数据合成方法的主要瓶颈在于“分割标签器模块”的设计,该模块用于根据图像生成分割掩码[?]。这些分割标签器模块本身即为分割模型,其性能限制了在合成掩码上训练的下游分割模型的表现。这些方法面临“鸡与蛋困境”,因此无法超越现有分割模型。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的方法,逆转传统的数据生成流程:我们首先(i)从文本提示中生成高度多样且符合真实世界分布的分割掩码,然后(ii)基于这些分割掩码合成逼真的图像。通过这种方式,我们无需任何分割标签器模块。该方法整合了两种数据生成策略,即MaskSyn和ImgSyn,显著提升了合成掩码和图像的数据多样性。值得注意的是,我们合成数据的高质量使该方法在仅使用合成数据训练时,在ADE20K数据集上比先前的数据合成方法[?]的mIoU提升了+25.2。在竞争激烈的ADE20K和COCO基准测试中,我们的数据生成方法显著提升了当前最先进的分割模型在语义分割、全景分割和实例分割任务中的性能。此外,实验表明,使用我们的合成数据训练分割模型,使其对未见过的数据域(包括真实世界图像和AI生成图像)具有更强的鲁棒性。
abstract_en: We present , a new data generation approach that pushes the performance boundaries of state-of-the-art image segmentation models. One major bottleneck of previous data synthesis methods for segmentation is the design of “segmentation labeler module”, which is used to synthesize segmentation masks for images [?]. The segmentation labeler modules, which are segmentation models by themselves, bound the performance of downstream segmentation models trained on the synthetic masks. These methods encounter a “chicken or egg dilemma” and thus fail to outperform existing segmentation models. To address this issue, we propose a novel method that reverses the traditional data generation process: we first (i) generate highly diverse segmentation masks that match real-world distribution from text prompts, and then (ii) synthesize realistic images conditioned on the segmentation masks. In this way, we avoid the need for any segmentation labeler module. integrates two data generation strategies, namely MaskSyn and ImgSyn, to largely improve data diversity in synthetic masks and images. Notably, the high quality of our synthetic data enables our method to outperform the previous data synthesis method [?] by +25.2 mIoU on ADE20K when trained with pure synthetic data. On the highly competitive ADE20K and COCO benchmarks, our data generation method markedly improves the performance of state-of-the-art segmentation models in semantic segmentation, panoptic segmentation, and instance segmentation. Moreover, experiments show that training with our synthetic data makes the segmentation models more robust towards unseen data domains, including real-world and AI-generated images.

title: 李涵亭, 牛红静, 赵峰*
title_en: Hanting Li, Hongjing Niu, Feng Zhao*
abstract: 近年来,深度生成模型发展迅速,能够基于输入文本生成高质量图像。以符合人类偏好的方式评估合成图像的质量,对于生成模型的评估和优选图像的选择至关重要。先前的工作通过在带有偏好标注的图像对上训练评分模型,将模型与人类偏好对齐。这些精心标注的图像对能够很好地描述人类选择图像的偏好。然而,当前这些偏好模型的训练范式是通过交叉熵损失,在每对图像中直接最大化偏好图像得分并最小化非偏好图像得分。这种简单且朴素的训练范式主要存在两个问题:1)对于质量相近的图像对,盲目最小化非偏好图像得分是不合理的,容易导致过拟合。2)未考虑人类对小视觉扰动的鲁棒性,导致最终模型无法做出稳定选择。因此,我们提出Stable Preference,重新定义人类偏好模型的训练范式,并引入抗干扰损失以提升对视觉扰动的鲁棒性。我们的方法在两个流行的文本到图像人类偏好数据集上取得了最先进性能。大量消融实验和可视化结果验证了我们方法的合理性和有效性。
abstract_en: In recent years, deep generative models have developed rapidly and can generate high-quality images based on input texts. Assessing the quality of synthetic images in a way consistent with human preferences is critical for both generative model evaluation and preferred image selection. Previous works aligned models with human preferences by training scoring models on image pairs with preference annotations. These carefully annotated image pairs well describe human preferences for choosing images. However, current training paradigm of these preference models is to directly maximize the preferred image score while minimizing the non-preferred image score in each image pair through cross-entropy loss. This simple and naive training paradigm mainly has two problems: 1) For image pairs of similar quality, it is unreasonable to blindly minimize the score of non-preferred images and can easily lead to overfitting. 2) The human robustness to small visual perturbations is not taken into account, resulting in the final model being unable to make stable choices. Therefore, we propose Stable Preference to redefine the training paradigm of human preference model and a anti-interference loss to improve the robustness to visual disturbances. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on two popular text-to-image human preference datasets. Extensive ablation studies and visualizations demonstrate the rationality and effectiveness of our method.

title: Hanwei Liu*, Rudong An, Zhimeng Zhang, Bowen Ma, Wei Zhang, Yan Song, Yujing Hu, Chen Wei, Yu Ding*
title_en: Hanwei Liu*, Rudong An, Zhimeng Zhang, Bowen Ma, Wei Zhang, Yan Song, Yujing Hu, Chen Wei, Yu Ding*
abstract: 由于身份、头部姿态和背景等任务无关噪声的存在,面部表情分析仍是一项具有挑战性的任务。为了解决这一问题,本文提出了一种名为Norface的新框架,该框架统一适用于动作单元(AU)分析和面部情感识别(FER)任务。Norface由归一化网络和分类网络组成。首先,精心设计的归一化网络通过保持面部表情一致性,将原始图像归一化为具有相同姿态和背景的通用身份,从而直接去除上述任务无关噪声。随后,这些归一化后的图像被输入分类网络。由于身份一致性及其他因素(如头部姿态、背景等),归一化图像使分类网络能够更有效地提取有用的表情信息。此外,分类网络结合了专家混合模型,以优化潜在表示,包括处理面部表示的输入和多(AU或情感)标签的输出。大量实验验证了基于身份归一化理念的精心设计框架。所提出的方法在多个面部表情分析任务(包括AU检测、AU强度估计和FER任务及其跨数据集任务)中均优于现有SOTA方法。归一化数据集和代码请访问项目页面。
abstract_en: Facial Expression Analysis remains a challenging task due to unexpected task-irrelevant noise, such as identity, head pose, and background. To address this issue, this paper proposes a novel framework, called Norface, that is unified for both Action Unit (AU) analysis and Facial Emotion Recognition (FER) tasks. Norface consists of a normalization network and a classification network. First, the carefully designed normalization network struggles to directly remove the above task-irrelevant noise, by maintaining facial expression consistency but normalizing all original images to a common identity with consistent pose, and background. Then, these additional normalized images are fed into the classification network. Due to consistent identity and other factors (e.g. head pose, background, etc.), the normalized images enable the classification network to extract useful expression information more effectively. Additionally, the classification network incorporates a Mixture of Experts to refine the latent representation, including handling the input of facial representations and the output of multiple (AU or emotion) labels. Extensive experiments validate the carefully designed framework with the insight of identity normalization. The proposed method outperforms existing SOTA methods in multiple facial expression analysis tasks, including AU detection, AU intensity estimation, and FER tasks, as well as their cross-dataset tasks. For the normalized datasets and code please visit project page.

title: Hanyang Kong*, Dongze Lian, Michael Bi Mi, Xinchao Wang*
title_en: Hanyang Kong*, Dongze Lian, Michael Bi Mi, Xinchao Wang*
abstract: 我们介绍了DreamDrone,一种新颖的零样本且无需训练的流程,可从文本提示生成无边界飞行场景。与专注于逐帧扭曲图像的其他方法不同,我们主张显式扭曲预训练文本到图像扩散模型的中间潜在代码,以实现高质量图像生成和泛化能力。为进一步提升生成图像的真实性,我们还提出了一种特征对应引导的扩散过程和一种高通滤波策略,分别促进几何一致性与高频细节一致性。大量实验表明,DreamDrone显著超越现有方法,在无需训练或微调数据集、也不需预先重建3D点云的情况下,实现了高度逼真的场景生成,具有卓越的视觉质量。
abstract_en: We introduce DreamDrone, a novel zero-shot and training-free pipeline for generating unbounded flythrough scenes from textual prompts. Different from other methods that focus on warping images frame by frame, we advocate explicitly warping the intermediate latent code of the pre-trained text-to-image diffusion model for high-quality image generation and generalization ability. To further enhance the fidelity of the generated images, we also propose a feature-correspondence-guidance diffusion process and a high-pass filtering strategy to promote geometric consistency and high-frequency detail consistency, respectively. Extensive experiments reveal that DreamDrone significantly surpasses existing methods, delivering highly authentic scene generation with exceptional visual quality, without training or fine-tuning on datasets or reconstructing 3D point clouds in advance.

title: Hao Chen*, Saining Xie, Ser-Nam Lim, Abhinav Shrivastava
title_en: Hao Chen*, Saining Xie, Ser-Nam Lim, Abhinav Shrivastava
abstract: 尽管视频数据在可用性和内容丰富性方面具有优势,但其高维性给视频研究带来了挑战。近期的研究进展探索了利用神经网络对视频进行隐式表示的方法,在视频压缩和增强等应用中表现出色。然而,长时间的编码时间仍然是视频隐式神经表示(INRs)的一个持续挑战。在本文中,我们专注于在隐式表示中提高视频编码和解码的速度。我们引入了两个关键组件:NeRV-Enc,一种基于Transformer的超网络,用于快速编码;以及NeRV-Dec,一种并行解码器,用于高效视频加载。NeRV-Enc通过消除基于梯度的优化,实现了高达104倍的速度提升。同时,NeRV-Dec简化了视频解码,以比传统编解码器快11倍的加载速度表现优异,并且在使用预解码视频进行RAM加载时,速度提高了2.5倍,同时体积仅为传统方法的65分之一。
abstract_en: Despite the abundant availability and content richness for video data, its high-dimensionality poses challenges for video research. Recent advancements have explored the implicit representation for videos using neural networks, demonstrating strong performance in applications such as video compression and enhancement. However, the prolonged encoding time remains a persistent challenge for video Implicit Neural Representations (INRs). In this paper, we focus on improving the speed of video encoding and decoding within implicit representations. We introduce two key components: NeRV-Enc, a transformer-based hyper-network for fast encoding; and NeRV-Dec, a parallel decoder for efficient video loading. NeRV-Enc achieves an impressive speed-up of 104 × by eliminating gradient-based optimization. Meanwhile, NeRV-Dec simplifies video decoding, outperforming conventional codecs with a loading speed 11× faster, and surpassing RAM loading with pre-decoded videos (2.5× faster while being 65× smaller in size).

title: Hao Cheng, Erjia Xiao, Jindong Gu, Le Yang, Jinhao Duan, Jize Zhang, Jiahang Cao, Kaidi Xu, Renjing Xu*
title_en: Hao Cheng, Erjia Xiao, Jindong Gu, Le Yang, Jinhao Duan, Jize Zhang, Jiahang Cao, Kaidi Xu, Renjing Xu*
abstract: 大视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)依赖于视觉编码器和大语言模型(LLMs),在视觉与语言的联合空间中展现出在多种多模态任务中的卓越能力。然而,破坏视觉-语言模型(VLMs)如对比语言-图像预训练(CLIP)的排版攻击,也被认为是对LVLMs的安全威胁。首先,我们验证了当前知名商业和开源LVLMs上的排版攻击,并揭示了这一威胁的广泛存在。其次,为了更好地评估这一漏洞,我们提出了迄今为止最全面且规模最大的排版数据集。该排版数据集不仅考虑了在各种多模态任务下排版攻击的评估,还评估了受多种因素生成文本影响的排版攻击效果。基于评估结果,我们研究了排版攻击影响VLMs和LVLMs的原因,得出三个具有深刻见解的发现。在进一步验证我们发现合理性的过程中,我们将排版攻击导致的性能下降从42.07%降低至13.90%。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/ChaduCheng/TypoDecep获取
abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) rely on vision encoders and Large Language Models (LLMs) to exhibit remarkable capabilities on various multi-modal tasks in the joint space of vision and language. However, typographic attacks, which disrupt Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP), have also been expected to be a security threat to LVLMs. Firstly, we verify typographic attacks on current well-known commercial and open-source LVLMs and uncover the widespread existence of this threat. Secondly, to better assess this vulnerability, we propose the most comprehensive and largest-scale Typographic Dataset to date. The Typographic Dataset not only considers the evaluation of typographic attacks under various multi-modal tasks but also evaluates the effects of typographic attacks, influenced by texts generated with diverse factors. Based on the evaluation results, we investigate the causes why typographic attacks impacting VLMs and LVLMs, leading to three highly insightful discoveries. During the process of further validating the rationality of our discoveries, we can reduce the performance degradation caused by typographic attacks from 42.07% to 13.90%. Code and Dataset are available in https://github.com/ChaduCheng/TypoDecep

title: Hao Cheng, SIYUAN YANG, Chong Wang, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Alex Kot, Bihan Wen*
title_en: Hao Cheng, SIYUAN YANG, Chong Wang, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Alex Kot, Bihan Wen*
abstract: 视频类别增量学习(VCIL)旨在学习具有判别性和泛化性的视频帧特征表示,以缓解灾难性遗忘问题。传统VCIL方法通常保留先前任务中一部分帧或特征作为示例,用于后续增量学习阶段。然而,这些策略忽视了基础类与新类之间的关联,有时甚至导致隐私泄露。为解决这一挑战,我们提出了一种时空子空间投影(STSP)方案用于VCIL。具体而言,我们提出了一种基于时间的判别子空间分类器(TSC),通过正交子空间基表示每个类别,并采用子空间投影损失进行分类。与依赖全连接层的典型分类方法不同,我们的TSC能够识别视频内容中的时空动态,从而增强每个视频样本的表示能力。此外,我们将类间和类内正交约束引入TSC,确保每个类别占据独特的正交子空间,由其基定义。为进一步防止灾难性遗忘,我们还采用基于空间的梯度投影(SGP)策略,调整网络梯度以对齐先前任务的空间特征集的零空间。在HMDB51、UCF101和Something-Something V2三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的STSP方法优于现有最先进的对比方法,证明了其在VCIL中的有效性。
abstract_en: Video class-incremental learning (VCIL) aims to learn discriminative and generalized feature representations for video frames to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. Conventional VCIL methods often retain a subset of frames or features from prior tasks as exemplars for subsequent incremental learning stages. However, these strategies overlook the connection between base and novel classes, sometimes even leading to privacy leakage. To address this challenge, we introduce a Spatial-Temporal Subspace Projection (STSP) scheme for VCIL. Specifically, we propose a discriminative Temporal-based Subspace Classifier (TSC) that represents each class with an orthogonal subspace basis and adopts subspace projection loss for classification. Unlike typical classification methods relying on fully connected layers, our TSC discerns the spatial-temporal dynamics in video content, thereby enhancing the representation of each video sample. Additionally, we implement inter- and intra-class orthogonal constraints into TSC, ensuring each class occupies a unique orthogonal subspace, defined by its basis.
