title: Heitor Rapela Medeiros*, Masih Aminbeidokhti, Fidel A Guerrero Pena, David Latortue, Eric Granger, Marco Pedersoli
title_en: Heitor Rapela Medeiros*, Masih Aminbeidokhti, Fidel A Guerrero Pena, David Latortue, Eric Granger, Marco Pedersoli
abstract: 在深度学习中,一种常见做法是使用大规模数据集训练大型神经网络,以在各种领域和任务中实现高准确率。尽管这种方法在许多应用领域表现良好,但在处理与预训练模型所用数据存在显著分布偏移的新模态数据时,往往会出现严重失败。本文重点研究将大型RGB图像目标检测模型适应到具有显著模态偏移的红外(IR)图像新数据上的方法。我们提出模态翻译器(ModTr)作为对传统方法(即对新模态进行大规模模型微调)的替代方案。ModTr通过一个小型转换网络对IR输入图像进行适应,该网络直接最小化检测损失进行训练。原始RGB模型随后可以在翻译后的输入上运行,无需对模型参数进行任何进一步更改或微调。在两个知名数据集上进行的从IR到RGB图像翻译实验表明,我们的简单方法提供的检测器性能与标准微调相当或更优,且不会遗忘原始模型的知识。这为基于服务的更灵活高效的检测流程打开了大门,其中单一未修改的服务器(如RGB检测器)可以持续运行,同时被不同模态(如IR)的查询请求所调用,对应的翻译模型则负责模态转换。我们的代码可在以下链接获取:https://github.com/heitorrapela/ModTr
abstract_en: A common practice in deep learning involves training large neural networks on massive datasets to achieve high accuracy across various domains and tasks. While this approach works well in many application areas, it often fails drastically when processing data from a new modality with a significant distribution shift from the data used to pre-train the model. This paper focuses on adapting a large object detection model trained on RGB images to new data extracted from IR images with a substantial modality shift. We propose Modality Translator (ModTr) as an alternative to the common approach of fine-tuning a large model to the new modality. ModTr adapts the IR input image with a small transformation network trained to directly minimize the detection loss. The original RGB model can then work on the translated inputs without any further changes or fine-tuning to its parameters. Experimental results on translating from IR to RGB images on two well-known datasets show that our simple approach provides detectors that perform comparably or better than standard fine-tuning, without forgetting the knowledge of the original model. This opens the door to a more flexible and efficient service-based detection pipeline, where a unique and unaltered server, such as an RGB detector, runs constantly while being queried by different modalities, such as IR with the corresponding translations model. Our code is available at: https://github.com/heitorrapela/ModTr.

title: Helisa Dhamo*, Yinyu Nie, Arthur Moreau, Jifei Song, Richard Shaw, Yiren Zhou, Eduardo Pérez-Pellitero*
title_en: Helisa Dhamo*, Yinyu Nie, Arthur Moreau, Jifei Song, Richard Shaw, Yiren Zhou, Eduardo Pérez-Pellitero*
abstract: 近年来,3D头部动画在质量和运行时性能方面取得了显著提升,特别是得益于可微渲染和神经辐射场技术的进步。实时渲染是现实应用中高度理想的追求目标。我们提出HeadGaS模型,该模型利用3D高斯点云(3DGS)进行3D头部重建与动画生成。本文引入一种混合模型,将显式的3DGS表示扩展为可学习的潜在特征基底,这些特征可与参数化头部模型的低维参数线性融合,从而获得与表情相关的颜色和不透明度值。我们证明HeadGaS在实时推理帧率上实现了最先进水平的结果,帧率超越基线高达2 dB,同时渲染速度提升超过10倍。
abstract_en: 3D head animation has seen major quality and runtime improvements over the last few years, particularly empowered by the advances in differentiable rendering and neural radiance fields. Real-time rendering is a highly desirable goal for real-world applications. We propose HeadGaS, a model that uses 3D Gaussian Splats (3DGS) for 3D head reconstruction and animation. In this paper we introduce a hybrid model that extends the explicit 3DGS representation with a base of learnable latent features, which can be linearly blended with low-dimensional parameters from parametric head models to obtain expression-dependent color and opacity values. We demonstrate that HeadGaS delivers state-of-the-art results in real-time inference frame rates, surpassing baselines by up to 2 dB, while accelerating rendering speed by over ×10.

title: Hemanth Saratchandran*, Thomas X Wang, Simon Lucey
title_en: Hemanth Saratchandran*, Thomas X Wang, Simon Lucey
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的神经网络权重矩阵归一化技术,我们称之为权重条件化。该方法旨在缩小权重矩阵最小和最大奇异值之间的差距,从而获得更良态的矩阵。这一技术的灵感部分来源于数值线性代数领域,其中良态矩阵被证明能够为迭代求解器提供更强的收敛性保证。我们提供了理论基础,证明我们的归一化技术能够平滑损失景观,从而提升随机梯度下降算法的收敛性。实证结果表明,我们的归一化方法不仅在多种神经网络架构(包括卷积神经网络(CNN)、视觉Transformer(ViT)、神经辐射场(NeRF)和3D形状建模)中表现优异,而且在性能上超越了现有文献中的权重归一化技术。
abstract_en: In this article, we introduce a novel normalization technique for neural network weight matrices, which we term weight conditioning. This approach aims to narrow the gap between the smallest and largest singular values of the weight matrices, resulting in better-conditioned matrices. The inspiration for this technique partially derives from numerical linear algebra, where well-conditioned matrices are known to facilitate stronger convergence results for iterative solvers. We provide a theoretical foundation demonstrating that our normalization technique smoothens the loss landscape, thereby enhancing convergence of stochastic gradient descent algorithms. Empirically, we validate our normalization across various neural network architectures, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Vision Transformers (ViT), Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), and 3D shape modeling. Our findings indicate that our normalization method is not only competitive but also outperforms existing weight normalization techniques from the literature.

title: 王涵*, 朱涵心, 何天宇, 冯润森, 邓家军, 边江, 陈志博
title_en: Henan Wang*, Hanxin Zhu, Tianyu He, Runsen Feng, Jiajun Deng, Jiang Bian, Zhibo Chen
abstract: 3D高斯点云(3DGS)已成为在三维表示和图像渲染领域具有显著潜力的新兴技术。然而,3DGS的存储开销较大,显著阻碍了其实际应用。在本工作中,我们将紧凑的3D高斯学习建模为端到端的率失真优化(RDO)问题,并提出RDO-Gaussian方法,以实现灵活且连续的速率控制。RDO-Gaussian解决了当前方案中的两个主要问题:1)不同于以往在固定失真下最小化速率的方法,我们引入了动态剪枝和熵约束向量量化(ECVQ),同时优化速率和失真。2)以往的工作将每个高斯的颜色视为同等重要,而我们则通过可学习的参数数量对不同区域和材质的颜色进行建模。我们在真实和合成场景中验证了我们的方法,结果显示RDO-Gaussian将3D高斯的大小减少了超过40倍,并在率失真性能上超越了现有方法。
abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become an emerging technique with remarkable potential in 3D representation and image rendering. However, the substantial storage overhead of 3DGS significantly impedes its practical applications. In this work, we formulate the compact 3D Gaussian learning as an end-to-end Rate-Distortion Optimization (RDO) problem and propose RDO-Gaussian that can achieve flexible and continuous rate control. RDO-Gaussian addresses two main issues that exist in current schemes: 1) Different from prior endeavors that minimize the rate under the fixed distortion, we introduce dynamic pruning and entropy-constrained vector quantization (ECVQ) that optimize the rate and distortion at the same time. 2) Previous works treat the colors of each Gaussian equally, while we model the colors of different regions and materials with learnable numbers of parameters. We verify our method on both real and synthetic scenes, showcasing that RDO-Gaussian greatly reduces the size of 3D Gaussian over 40×, and surpasses existing methods in rate-distortion performance.

title: 周恒宇, 张慧*, 王斌*
title_en: Hengyu Zhou, Hui Zhang*, Bin Wang*
abstract: 矢量图形的广泛应用对矢量化方法提出了显著需求。尽管近期基于学习的技术已展现出生成拓扑结构清晰的矢量图像的能力,但对这些基本图形进行渐变填充仍是一个挑战。本文提出了一种分割引导的矢量化框架,将位图图像转换为具有径向渐变填充的简洁矢量图形。在嵌入式渐变感知分割子程序的指导下,我们的方法逐步将渐变填充的贝塞尔路径追加到输出中,其中基本图形参数通过我们新设计的初始化技术启动,并通过最小化我们设计的新型损失函数进行优化。我们基于可微渲染器与传统分割算法构建该方法,将其发展为一种无需模型的位图到矢量转换工具。该方法在各种输入上进行了测试,证明其不依赖特定数据集,能够生成相比以往工作具有更优视觉质量和分层拓扑结构的矢量图形。
abstract_en: The widespread use of vector graphics creates a significant demand for vectorization methods. While recent learning-based techniques have shown their capability to create vector images of clear topology, filling these primitives with gradients remains a challenge. In this paper, we propose a segmentation-guided vectorization framework to convert raster images into concise vector graphics with radial gradient fills. With the guidance of an embedded gradient-aware segmentation subroutine, our approach progressively appends gradient-filled Bézier paths to the output, where primitive parameters are initiated with our newly designed initialization technique and are optimized to minimize our novel loss function. We build our method on a differentiable renderer with traditional segmentation algorithms to develop it as a model-free tool for raster-to-vector conversion. It is tested on various inputs to demonstrate its feasibility, independent of datasets, to synthesize vector graphics with improved visual quality and layer-wise topology compared to prior work.

title: 赵亨元*, 周潘*, 郑志明*
title_en: Henry Hengyuan Zhao*, Pan Zhou*, Mike Zheng Shou*
abstract: 多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)展现出卓越的问题解决能力,但很少有研究致力于评估生成视觉指令调优数据的能力。本文旨在探索增强MLLMs独立生成数据的潜力,无需依赖GPT-4。我们引入了一个全面的数据生成流程,包括四个关键步骤:(i) 指令数据收集,(ii) 指令模板设计,(iii) 增强MLLMs,以及(iv) 数据生成与过滤。此外,我们提出了两种数据生成模式:任务无关和任务特定,以实现可控输出。我们证明,使用LLaVA1.5训练的合成VQA样数据集在12个多模态基准测试中提升了10个的性能。此外,当使用类似REC的合成数据集训练时,基础模型MLLM Shikra在7个REC数据集上表现出提升。通过实验和合成数据分析,我们的发现包括:(1) 当前的MLLMs可以在不依赖GPT-4V的情况下作为稳健的数据生成器;(2) 使用任务特定数据集训练的MLLMs在生成复杂指令调优数据方面可以超越GPT-4V;(3) 合成数据集在各种多模态基准测试中提升性能,并有助于缓解模型幻觉。代码可在https://github.com/zhaohengyuan1/Genixer找到。
abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate exceptional problem-solving capabilities, but few research studies aim to gauge the ability to generate visual instruction tuning data. This paper proposes to explore the potential of empowering MLLMs to generate data independently without relying on GPT-4. We introduce , a comprehensive data generation pipeline consisting of four key steps: (i) instruction data collection, (ii) instruction template design, (iii) empowering MLLMs, and (iv) data generation and filtering. Additionally, we outline two modes of data generation: task-agnostic and task-specific, enabling controllable output. We demonstrate that a synthetic VQA-like dataset trained with LLaVA1.5 enhances performance on 10 out of 12 multimodal benchmarks. Additionally, the grounding MLLM Shikra, when trained with a REC-like synthetic dataset, shows improvements on 7 out of 8 REC datasets. Through experiments and synthetic data analysis, our findings are: (1) current MLLMs can serve as robust data generators without assistance from GPT-4V; (2) MLLMs trained with task-specific datasets can surpass GPT-4V in generating complex instruction tuning data; (3) synthetic datasets enhance performance across various multimodal benchmarks and help mitigate model hallucinations. The code can be found at https://github.com/zhaohengyuan1/Genixer.

title: Heyuan Li*, Ce Chen, Tianhao Shi, Yuda Qiu, Sizhe An, Guanying CHEN, Xiaoguang Han*
title_en: Heyuan Li*, Ce Chen, Tianhao Shi, Yuda Qiu, Sizhe An, Guanying CHEN, Xiaoguang Han*
abstract: 尽管近期在三维感知生成对抗网络(GANs)方面取得的进展有助于近正面视角人脸合成的发展,但全面合成可从所有角度观看的完整三维头部仍面临挑战。虽然PanoHead[?]证明了使用包含正面和背面视角图像的大规模数据集进行完整头部合成的可能性,但其常导致背面视角出现伪影。基于我们深入的分析,发现原因主要分为两方面。首先,从网络架构角度,我们发现所采用的三平面/三网格表示空间中每个平面倾向于混淆两侧的特征,导致“镜像”伪影(例如,眼镜出现在背面)。其次,从数据监督角度,我们发现现有三维感知GANs中的判别器训练主要关注渲染图像本身的质量,而对其与渲染视角的合理性关注不足。这使得生成非正面视角的“人脸”成为可能,因为其容易欺骗判别器。为此,我们提出SphereHead,一种基于球面坐标系的新型三平面表示方法,该方法符合人体头部的几何特征,并能有效缓解许多生成伪影。我们进一步引入视角-图像一致性损失用于判别器,以强调相机参数与图像之间的对应关系。这些努力的结合实现了视觉效果更优且伪影显著减少的成果。我们的代码和数据集已公开在https://lhyfst.github.io/spherehead/。
abstract_en: While recent advances in 3D-aware Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have aided the development of near-frontal view human face synthesis, the challenge of comprehensively synthesizing a full 3D head viewable from all angles still persists. Although PanoHead [?] proves the possibilities of using a large-scale dataset with images of both frontal and back views for full-head synthesis, it often causes artifacts for back views. Based on our in-depth analysis, we found the reasons are mainly twofold. First, from network architecture perspective, we found each plane in the utilized tri-plane/tri-grid representation space tends to confuse the features from both sides, causing “mirroring” artifacts (e.g., the glasses appear in the back). Second, from data supervision aspect, we found that existing discriminator training in 3D-aware GANs mainly focuses on the quality of the rendered image itself, and does not care much about its plausibility with the perspective from which it was rendered. This makes it possible to generate “face” in non-frontal views, due to its easiness to fool the discriminator. In response, we propose SphereHead, a novel tri-plane representation in the spherical coordinate system that fits the human head’s geometric characteristics and efficiently mitigates many of the generated artifacts. We further introduce a view-image consistency loss for the discriminator to emphasize the correspondence of the camera parameters and the images. The combination of these efforts results in visually superior outcomes with significantly fewer artifacts. Our code and dataset is publicly available at https://lhyfst.github.io/spherehead/.

title: Dahmani Hiba*, Bennehar Moussab, Piasco Nathan, Roldao Jimenez Luis G, Tsishkou Dzmitry
title_en: Hiba Dahmani*, Moussab Bennehar, Nathan Piasco, Luis G Roldao Jimenez, Dzmitry Tsishkou
abstract: 隐式神经表示方法在从无结构的野外照片集合中学习3D场景方面取得了显著进展,但仍然受限于体渲染的高计算成本。最近,三维高斯点云(3D Gaussian Splatting)作为一种更快速的替代方案出现,其渲染质量卓越且训练效率更高,尤其适用于小规模和以物体为中心的场景。然而,该技术在处理无结构的野外数据时表现不佳。为解决这一问题,我们将三维高斯点云扩展至处理无结构图像集合。我们通过建模外观来捕捉渲染图像中的光度变化。此外,我们引入了一种新机制,以无监督方式训练瞬态高斯,处理场景遮挡物的存在。在多样化的照片集合场景和户外地标多通道采集实验中,我们的方法在效率提升的同时超越了先前工作,取得了最先进的结果。
abstract_en: Implicit neural representation methods have shown impressive advancements in learning 3D scenes from unstructured in-the-wild photo collections but are still limited by the large computational cost of volumetric rendering. Recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting emerged as a much faster alternative with superior rendering quality and training efficiency, especially for small-scale and object-centric scenarios. Nevertheless, this technique suffers from poor performance on unstructured in-the-wild data. To tackle this, we extend over 3D Gaussian Splatting to handle unstructured image collections. We achieve this by modeling appearance to seize photometric variations in the rendered images. Additionally, we introduce a new mechanism to train transient Gaussians to handle the presence of scene occluders in an unsupervised manner. Experiments on diverse photo collection scenes and multi-pass acquisition of outdoor landmarks show the effectiveness of our method over prior works achieving state-of-the-art results with improved efficiency.

title: Hitesh Kandala*, Jianfeng Gao, Jianwei Yang
title_en: Hitesh Kandala*, Jianfeng Gao, Jianwei Yang
abstract: 我们提出Pix2Gif,这是一种基于运动引导的扩散模型,用于图像到GIF(视频)生成。我们通过将任务表述为由文本和运动幅度提示引导的图像翻译问题来解决这一问题,如图??所示。为确保模型遵循运动引导,我们提出了一种新的运动引导变形模块,该模块根据两种类型的提示对源图像的特征进行空间变换。此外,我们引入了感知损失,以确保变换后的特征图保持在目标图像的同一空间内,从而保证内容的一致性和连贯性。在模型训练前,我们通过从TGIF视频-标题数据集中提取连贯的图像帧,精心整理了数据,该数据集提供了关于主体时间变化的丰富信息。预训练后,我们以零样本方式将模型应用于多个视频数据集。广泛的定性和定量实验验证了模型的有效性——它不仅能够捕捉文本中的语义提示,还能捕捉运动引导中的空间信息。我们使用一个配备16×V100 GPU的节点训练所有模型。
abstract_en: We present Pix2Gif, a motion-guided diffusion model for image-to-GIF (video) generation. We tackle this problem differently by formulating the task as an image translation problem steered by text and motion magnitude prompts, as shown in Fig. ??. To ensure that the model adheres to motion guidance, we propose a new motion-guided warping module to spatially transform the features of the source image conditioned on the two types of prompts. Furthermore, we introduce a perceptual loss to ensure the transformed feature map remains within the same space as the target image, ensuring content consistency and coherence. In preparation for the model training, we meticulously curated data by extracting coherent image frames from the TGIF video-caption dataset, which provides rich information about the temporal changes of subjects. After pretraining, we apply our model in a zero-shot manner to a number of video datasets. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our model – it not only captures the semantic prompt from text but also the spatial ones from motion guidance. We train all our models using a single node of 16×V100 GPUs.

title: Hmrishav Bandyopadhyay*, Pinaki Nath Chowdhury, Aneeshan Sain, Subhadeep Koley, Tao Xiang, Ayan Kumar Bhunia, Yi-Zhe Song
title_en: Hmrishav Bandyopadhyay*, Pinaki Nath Chowdhury, Aneeshan Sain, Subhadeep Koley, Tao Xiang, Ayan Kumar Bhunia, Yi-Zhe Song
abstract: 本文首次将大规模基础模型与人类草图理解相结合。我们展示了这一结合带来的影响——在通用草图表示学习(例如分类)方面实现范式转变。这种泛化能力体现在两个方面:(i) 跨未知类别的泛化(即开放集),以及 (ii) 跨抽象层次的泛化(即优质与劣质草图),这两个问题在草图研究领域仍是未解决的紧迫挑战。我们的设计直观且以转移CLIP已有的卓越泛化能力为核心,旨在促进草图的通用学习。我们首先通过学习特定于草图的提示,利用新颖的辅助头(将位图转换为矢量草图)对原始CLIP模型进行“条件化”处理,这使CLIP具备“草图感知”能力。随后,我们使CLIP对草图固有的不同抽象层次更加敏感。这通过学习一个抽象特定提示偏倚的码本实现,其加权组合可支持跨抽象层次的草图表示——低抽象边缘图、TU-Berlin中的中等抽象草图以及QuickDraw中的高度抽象涂鸦。我们的框架在零样本和少样本设置下,以及跨不同抽象边界的新颖场景中,均超越了流行的草图表示学习算法。
abstract_en: This paper, for the first time, marries large foundation models with human sketch understanding. We demonstrate what this brings – a paradigm shift in terms of generalised sketch representation learning (e.g., classification). This generalisation happens on two fronts: (i) generalisation across unknown categories (i.e., open-set), and (ii) generalisation traversing abstraction levels (i.e., good and bad sketches), both being timely challenges that remain unsolved in the sketch literature. Our design is intuitive and centred around transferring the already stellar generalisation ability of CLIP to benefit generalised learning for sketches. We first “condition” the vanilla CLIP model by learning sketch-specific prompts using a novel auxiliary head of raster to vector sketch conversion. This importantly makes CLIP “sketch-aware”. We then make CLIP acute to the inherently different sketch abstraction levels. This is achieved by learning a codebook of abstraction-specific prompt biases, a weighted combination of which facilitates the representation of sketches across abstraction levels – low abstract edge-maps, medium abstract sketches in TU-Berlin, and highly abstract doodles in QuickDraw. Our framework surpasses popular sketch representation learning algorithms in both zero-shot and few-shot setups and in novel settings across different abstraction boundaries.

title: Hoang Pham*, The-Anh Ta, Anh T Tran, Khoa D Doan
title_en: Hoang Pham*, The-Anh Ta, Anh T Tran, Khoa D Doan
abstract: 近年来,后门攻击已成为对机器学习模型安全性的新兴威胁。从攻击者的角度来看,植入的后门应能够抵抗防御算法,但一些最近提出的微调防御方法可以有效移除这些后门。这主要是由于深度神经网络的灾难性遗忘(CF)特性。本文通过利用持续学习(CL)技术来对抗后门的CF特性。我们首先研究了后门模型与微调模型在损失景观中的连接性。我们的分析证实,微调防御方法,尤其是更先进的方法,可以轻松地将被污染的模型推出后门区域,使其完全遗忘后门的存在。基于这一发现,我们从持续学习的角度重新定义后门训练,并提出了一种名为顺序后门学习(SBL)的新框架,该框架能够生成具有抗微调能力的后门。该框架将后门污染过程分为两个任务:第一个任务学习一个带有后门的模型,而第二个任务则基于持续学习原理,将模型移动到具有抗微调能力的后门区域。我们还通过在框架中使用锐度感知最小化器来寻找更平坦的后门区域,进一步增强了植入后门的持久性。最后,我们通过在多个后门领域基准数据集上的大量实证实验验证了我们方法的有效性。源代码可在https: //github.com/mail-research/SBL-resilient-backdoors获取
abstract_en: Recently, backdoor attacks have become an emerging threat to the security of machine learning models. From the adversary’s perspective, the implanted backdoors should be resistant to defensive algorithms, but some recently proposed fine-tuning defenses can remove these backdoors with notable efficacy. This is mainly due to the catastrophic forgetting (CF) property of deep neural networks. This paper counters CF of backdoors by leveraging continual learning (CL) techniques. We begin by investigating the connectivity between a backdoored and fine-tuned model in the loss landscape. Our analysis confirms that fine-tuning defenses, especially the more advanced ones, can easily push a poisoned model out of the backdoor regions, making it forget all about the backdoors. Based on this finding, we re-formulate backdoor training through the lens of CL and propose a novel framework, named Sequential Backdoor Learning (SBL), that can generate resilient backdoors. This framework separates the backdoor poisoning process into two tasks: the first task learns a backdoored model, while the second task, based on the CL principles, moves it to a backdoored region resistant to fine-tuning. We additionally propose to seek flatter backdoor regions via a sharpness-aware minimizer in the framework, further strengthening the durability of the implanted backdoor. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our method through extensive empirical experiments on several benchmark datasets in the backdoor domain. The source code is available at https: //github.com/mail-research/SBL-resilient-backdoors

title: Homanga Bharadhwaj*等
title_en: Homanga Bharadhwaj*, Roozbeh Mottaghi, Abhinav Gupta, Shubham Tulsiani
abstract: 我们旨在学习一种可泛化的目标条件策略,使机器人能够执行多样化的操作——在新颖的场景中与未见过的对象进行交互,而无需测试时的适应。虽然典型方法依赖大量示范数据实现此类泛化,我们提出了一种方法,利用网络视频预测合理的交互计划,并学习任务无关的转换以获取现实世界中的机器人动作。我们的框架基于目标预测图像中点在未来时间步应如何移动的轨迹,并可通过网络上的多样化视频进行训练,包括人类和机器人操作日常物品的视频。我们利用这些2D轨迹预测推断待操作物体的刚体变换序列,并获得可在开环方式下执行的机器人末端执行器姿态。随后,我们通过闭环策略预测残差动作,以优化该开环计划,该策略仅需少量领域内机器人特定的示范数据。我们证明,这种结合可扩展学习轨迹预测与仅需少量领域内机器人数据的残差策略的方法,能够实现多样化的可泛化机器人操作,并展示了在未见过的任务、对象和场景中的广泛现实世界机器人操作结果。https://homangab.github.io/track2act/ 1 1∗ equal contribution. Correspondence to Homanga B. hbharadh@cs.cmu.edu
abstract_en: We seek to learn a generalizable goal-conditioned policy that enables diverse robot manipulation — interacting with unseen objects in novel scenes without test-time adaptation. While typical approaches rely on a large amount of demonstration data for such generalization, we propose an approach that leverages web videos to predict plausible interaction plans and learns a task-agnostic transformation to obtain robot actions in the real world. Our framework, predicts tracks of how points in an image should move in future time-steps based on a goal, and can be trained with diverse videos on the web including those of humans and robots manipulating everyday objects. We use these 2D track predictions to infer a sequence of rigid transforms of the object to be manipulated, and obtain robot end-effector poses that can be executed in an open-loop manner. We then refine this open-loop plan by predicting residual actions through a closed loop policy trained with a few embodiment-specific demonstrations. We show that this approach of combining scalably learned track prediction with a residual policy requiring minimal in-domain robot-specific data enables diverse generalizable robot manipulation, and present a wide array of real-world robot manipulation results across unseen tasks, objects, and scenes. https://homangab.github.io/track2act/ 1 1∗ equal contribution. Correspondence to Homanga B. hbharadh@cs.cmu.edu

title: Hong Mo*, Xiong Zhang*, Jianchao Tan, Cheng Yang, Qiong Gu, Bo Hang, Wenqi Ren
title_en: Hong Mo*, Xiong Zhang*, Jianchao Tan, Cheng Yang, Qiong Gu, Bo Hang, Wenqi Ren
abstract: 多视角计数(MVC)方法在存在严重遮挡和视角畸变的场景中展现出优于单视角方法的优越性。然而,传统MVC方法中手工设计的启发式特征和相同的相机布局需求限制了其在现实场景中的适用性和可扩展性。本文提出了一种简洁的三维MVC框架CountFormer,通过将多视角图像级特征提升至场景级体积表示,并基于体积特征估计三维密度图。通过引入相机编码策略,CountFormer成功将相机参数嵌入体积查询和图像级特征中,使其能够处理差异显著的多种相机布局。此外,我们引入了基于注意力机制的特征提升模块,将图像级特征转换为每个相机视角的三维体积表示。随后,多视角体积聚合模块通过注意力机制聚合多种多视角体积,构建全面的场景级体积表示,使CountFormer能够处理任意动态相机布局下的图像。所提方法在多个广泛使用的数据集上优于现有最先进的方法,证明了其相比传统MVC框架在现实部署中的更大适用性。
abstract_en: Multi-view counting (MVC) methods have shown their superiority over single-view counterparts, particularly in situations characterized by heavy occlusion and severe perspective distortions. However, hand-crafted heuristic features and identical camera layout requirements in conventional MVC methods limit their applicability and scalability in real-world scenarios. In this work, we propose a concise 3D MVC framework called CountFormer to elevate multi-view image-level features to a scene-level volume representation and estimate the 3D density map based on the volume features. By incorporating a camera encoding strategy, CountFormer successfully embeds camera parameters into the volume query and image-level features, enabling it to handle various camera layouts with significant differences. Furthermore, we introduce a feature lifting module capitalized on the attention mechanism to transform image-level features into a 3D volume representation for each camera view. Subsequently, the multi-view volume aggregation module attentively aggregates various multi-view volumes to create a comprehensive scene-level volume representation, allowing CountFormer to handle images captured by arbitrary dynamic camera layouts. The proposed method performs favorably against the state-of-the-art approaches across various widely used datasets, demonstrating its greater suitability for real-world deployment compared to conventional MVC frameworks.

title: Hong Zhang, Yixuan Lyu, Qian Yu, Hanyang Liu, Huimin Ma, Yuan Ding, Yifan Yang*
title_en: Hong Zhang, Yixuan Lyu, Qian Yu, Hanyang Liu, Huimin Ma, Yuan Ding, Yifan Yang*
abstract: 在伪装目标分割(COS)领域,尽管分割性能持续提升,但有效伪装的底层机制仍理解不足,如同黑箱。为解决这一问题,我们首次开展全面研究,探讨伪装属性对伪装模式有效性的影响,提供了一个用于评估伪装设计的量化框架。为支持该分析,我们构建了首个包含伪装目标描述及其属性贡献的语料库,命名为COD-Text And X-attributions(COD-TAX)。此外,受人类信息处理分层过程启发:从高层场景文本描述,到中层局部区域摘要,再到低层像素数据的详细分析。我们开发了一个结合文本与视觉信息的鲁棒框架,用于COS任务,命名为属性引导的注视网络建模(Attribution CUe Modeling with Eye-fixation Network,ACUMEN)。ACUMEN在三个广泛使用的数据集上超越了九种领先方法,表现出色。我们最后总结了研究中识别出属性的关键见解。代码:https://github.com/lyu-yx/ACUMEN.
abstract_en: In the domain of Camouflaged Object Segmentation (COS), despite continuous improvements in segmentation performance, the underlying mechanisms of effective camouflage remain poorly understood, akin to a black box. To address this gap, we present the first comprehensive study to examine the impact of camouflage attributes on the effectiveness of camouflage patterns, offering a quantitative framework for the evaluation of camouflage designs. To support this analysis, we have compiled the first dataset comprising descriptions of camouflaged objects and their attribute contributions, termed COD-Text And X-attributions (COD-TAX). Moreover, drawing inspiration from the hierarchical process by which humans process information: from high-level textual descriptions of overarching scenarios, through mid-level summaries of local areas, to low-level pixel data for detailed analysis. We have developed a robust framework that combines textual and visual information for the task of COS, named Attribution CUe Modeling with Eye-fixation Network (ACUMEN). ACUMEN demonstrates superior performance, outperforming nine leading methods across three widely-used datasets. We conclude by highlighting key insights derived from the attributes identified in our study. Code: https://github.com/lyu-yx/ACUMEN.

title: Hongbeen Park, Minjeong Park, Giljoo Nam, Jinkyu Kim*
title_en: Hongbeen Park, Minjeong Park, Giljoo Nam, Jinkyu Kim*
abstract: 同时定位与建图(SLAM)在自动驾驶、移动机器人和混合现实等领域具有关键作用。基于密集视觉SLAM的RGB-D相机系统具有优势,但在实现大规模场景下的实时性能、鲁棒性和可扩展性方面面临挑战。近期利用神经隐式场景表示的方法展现出潜力,但存在高计算成本和内存需求的问题。ESLAM引入了基于平面的张量分解方法,但仍难以解决内存增长问题。为应对这些挑战,我们提出了一种更高效的视觉SLAM模型,称为LRSLAM,该模型采用低秩张量分解方法。我们的方法通过六轴和CP分解,实现了比现有最先进方法更优的收敛速度、内存效率和重建/定位质量。在多样化的室内RGB-D数据集上的评估表明,LRSLAM在参数效率、处理时间和准确性方面均表现出色,同时保持了重建和定位质量。我们的代码将在发表后公开。
abstract_en: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) has been crucial across various domains, including autonomous driving, mobile robotics, and mixed reality. Dense visual SLAM, leveraging RGB-D camera systems, offers advantages but faces challenges in achieving real-time performance, robustness, and scalability for large-scale scenes. Recent approaches utilizing neural implicit scene representations show promise but suffer from high computational costs and memory requirements. ESLAM introduced a plane-based tensor decomposition but still struggled with memory growth. Addressing these challenges, we propose a more efficient visual SLAM model, called LRSLAM, utilizing low-rank tensor decomposition methods. Our approach, leveraging the Six-axis and CP decompositions, achieves better convergence rates, memory efficiency, and reconstruction/localization quality than existing state-of-the-art approaches. Evaluation across diverse indoor RGB-D datasets demonstrates LRSLAM’s superior performance in terms of parameter efficiency, processing time, and accuracy, retaining reconstruction and localization quality. Our code will be publicly available upon publication.

title: Hongbin Lin, Yifan Zhang, Shuaicheng Niu, Shuguang Cui, Zhen Li*
title_en: Hongbin Lin, Yifan Zhang, Shuaicheng Niu, Shuguang Cui, Zhen Li*
abstract: 单目三维目标检测(Mono 3Det)旨在从单张RGB图像中识别三维目标。然而,现有方法通常假设训练数据和测试数据遵循相同分布,这在现实测试场景中可能不成立。为解决分布外(OOD)问题,我们探索了一种新的适应范式,称为完全测试时适应(Fully Test-time Adaptation),旨在通过处理测试时潜在的数据分布偏移,将训练良好的模型适应到未标记的测试数据。然而,由于OOD测试数据导致检测分数显著下降,将该范式应用于Mono 3Det面临重大挑战。这种下降与现有检测方法预定义的分数阈值冲突,导致严重的目标遗漏(如罕见正样本检测和大量误检)。因此,有限的正样本检测和大量噪声预测使得测试时适应在Mono 3Det中失效。为解决此问题,我们提出了一种新颖的单目测试时适应(MonoTTA)方法,基于两种新策略。1)可靠性驱动适应:我们实证发现高分目标仍具可靠性,优化高分目标可提升所有检测的置信度。因此,我们设计了一种自适应策略,识别可靠目标用于模型适应,发现潜在目标并缓解遗漏。2)噪声防护适应:由于高分目标可能稀缺,我们开发了一个负向正则化项,通过负向学习利用大量低分目标,防止对噪声和琐碎解的过拟合。实验结果表明,该方法在OOD测试场景中为Mono 3Det模型带来显著性能提升,在KITTI数据集上平均提升约190%,在nuScenes数据集上平均提升约198%。源代码现已发布于redHongbin98/MonoTTA。
abstract_en: Monocular 3D object detection (Mono 3Det) aims to identify 3D objects from a single RGB image. However, existing methods often assume training and test data follow the same distribution, which may not hold in real-world test scenarios. To address the out-of-distribution (OOD) problems, we explore a new adaptation paradigm for Mono 3Det, termed Fully Test-time Adaptation which aims to adapt a well-trained model to unlabeled test data by handling potential data distribution shifts at test time. However, applying this paradigm in Mono 3Det poses significant challenges due to OOD test data causing a remarkable decline in object detection scores. This decline conflicts with the pre-defined score thresholds of existing detection methods, leading to severe object omissions (, rare positive detections and many false negatives). Consequently, the limited positive detection and plenty of noisy predictions cause test-time adaptation to fail in Mono 3Det. To handle this problem, we propose a novel Monocular Test-Time Adaptation (MonoTTA) method, based on two new strategies. 1) Reliability-driven adaptation: we empirically find that high-score objects are still reliable and the optimization of high-score objects can enhance confidence across all detections. Thus, we devise a self-adaptive strategy to identify reliable objects for model adaptation, which discovers potential objects and alleviates omissions. 2) Noise-guard adaptation: since high-score objects may be scarce, we develop a negative regularization term to exploit the numerous low-score objects via negative learning, preventing overfitting to noise and trivial solutions. Experimental results show that brings significant performance gains for Mono 3Det models in OOD test scenarios, approximately 190% gains by average on KITTI and 198% gains on nuScenes. The source code is now available at redHongbin98/MonoTTA.

title: Hongcheng Zhang, Liu Liang, Pengxin Zeng*, Xiao Song, Zhe Wang
title_en: Hongcheng Zhang, Liu Liang, Pengxin Zeng*, Xiao Song, Zhe Wang
abstract: 由于基于查询的范式能够在不显式构建密集鸟瞰图特征的情况下实现低延迟,稀疏三维检测器受到了广泛关注。然而,这些检测器的性能通常劣于其密集对应物。本文发现,弥合性能差距的关键在于增强两种模态中丰富表示的感知能力。本文提出了一种高性能的全稀疏检测器,用于端到端多模态三维目标检测。该检测器称为SparseLIF,包含三个关键设计:(1) 视角感知查询生成(PAQG),通过视角先验生成高质量的三维查询;(2) 区域感兴趣感知采样(RIAS),通过从每个模态中采样区域感兴趣特征进一步优化先验查询;(3) 不确定性感知融合(UAF),精确量化每个传感器模态的不确定性,并自适应地进行最终多模态融合,从而实现对传感器噪声的强鲁棒性。截至论文提交时,SparseLIF在nuScenes数据集上取得了最先进的性能,在验证集和测试基准上均排名第一,显著优于所有现有的三维目标检测器。
abstract_en: Sparse 3D detectors have received significant attention since the query-based paradigm embraces low latency without explicit dense BEV feature construction. However, these detectors achieve worse performance than their dense counterparts. In this paper, we find the key to bridging the performance gap is to enhance the awareness of rich representations in two modalities. Here, we present a high-performance fully sparse detector for end-to-end multi-modality 3D object detection. The detector, termed SparseLIF, contains three key designs, which are (1) Perspective-Aware Query Generation (PAQG) to generate high-quality 3D queries with perspective priors, (2) RoI-Aware Sampling (RIAS) to further refine prior queries by sampling RoI features from each modality, (3) Uncertainty-Aware Fusion (UAF) to precisely quantify the uncertainty of each sensor modality and adaptively conduct final multi-modality fusion, thus achieving great robustness against sensor noises. By the time of paper submission, SparseLIF achieves state-of-the-art performance on the nuScenes dataset, ranking 1st on both validation set and test benchmark, outperforming all state-of-the-art 3D object detectors by a notable margin.

title: Honghao Xu, Juzhan Xu, Zeyu Huang, Pengfei Xu, Hui Huang, Ruizhen Hu*
title_en: Honghao Xu, Juzhan Xu, Zeyu Huang, Pengfei Xu, Hui Huang, Ruizhen Hu*
abstract: 本文提出了一种名为FRI-Net的新方法,用于从三维点云重建二维平面图。现有方法通常依赖于角点回归或框回归,未充分考虑房间的全局形状。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新颖的方法,利用房间级隐式表示与结构正则化来表征平面图中的房间形状。通过将平面图中房间布局的几何先验纳入我们的训练策略,生成的房间多边形在几何上更加规整。我们在两个具有挑战性的数据集Structured3D和SceneCAD上进行了实验。与现有最先进的方法相比,我们的方法表现出更优的性能,验证了所提出表示方法在平面图重建中的有效性。
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce a novel method called FRI-Net for 2D floorplan reconstruction from 3D point cloud. Existing methods typically rely on corner regression or box regression, which lack consideration for the global shapes of rooms. To address these issues, we propose a novel approach using a room-wise implicit representation with structural regularization to characterize the shapes of rooms in floorplans. By incorporating geometric priors of room layouts in floorplans into our training strategy, the generated room polygons are more geometrically regular. We have conducted experiments on two challenging datasets, Structured3D and SceneCAD. Our method demonstrates improved performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, validating the effectiveness of our proposed representation for floorplan reconstruction.

title: 郭红吉,王涵静,计强*
title_en: Hongji Guo, Hanjing Wang, Qiang Ji*
abstract: 在线动作检测旨在识别流媒体视频中正在进行的动作,而无需查看未来。及时且可靠的响应对于实际应用至关重要。本文提出贝叶斯证据深度学习(BEDL),一种高效且可泛化的在线动作检测与不确定性量化框架。具体而言,我们通过教师-学生架构将贝叶斯神经网络与证据深度学习相结合。教师模型以贝叶斯方式构建,并通过证据深度学习将其互信息和分布传递给学生模型。这样,学生模型可以在高效量化不确定性的同时进行准确的在线推理。与现有证据深度学习方法相比,BEDL通过利用贝叶斯教师模型更准确地估计不确定性。此外,我们设计了一个注意力模块用于主动在线动作检测(OAD),该模块基于贝叶斯互信息主动选择重要特征,而非使用所有特征。我们在THUMPS’14、TVSeries和HDD等基准数据集上评估BEDL,结果表明其在保持高效推理的同时具有竞争力的性能。广泛的消融研究验证了各组件的有效性。为验证不确定性量化,我们进行了不同类型的不确定性在线异常检测实验。
abstract_en: Online action detection aims at identifying the ongoing action in a streaming video without seeing the future. Timely and reliable response is critical for real-world applications. In this paper, we introduce Bayesian Evidential Deep Learning (BEDL), an efficient and generalizable framework for online action detection and uncertainty quantification. Specifically, we combine Bayesian neural networks and evidential deep learning by a teacher-student architecture. The teacher model is built in a Bayesian manner and transfers its mutual information and distribution to the student model through evidential deep learning. In this way, the student model can make accurate online inference while efficiently quantifying the uncertainty. Compared to existing evidential deep learning methods, BEDL estimates uncertainty more accurately by leveraging the Bayesian teacher model. In addition, we designed an attention module for active OAD, which actively selects important features based on the Bayesian mutual information instead of using all the features. We evaluated BEDL on benchmark datasets including THUMPS’14, TVSeries, and HDD. BEDL achieves competitive performance while keeping efficient inference. Extensive ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of each component. To verify the uncertainty quantification, we perform experiments of online anomaly detection with different types of uncertainties.

title: Hongjing Niu*, Hanting Li, Bin Li, Feng Zhao*
title_en: Hongjing Niu*, Hanting Li, Bin Li, Feng Zhao*
abstract: 在大规模数据集上进行预训练已成为训练深度神经网络的基本方法。预训练能够提供比随机初始化更优的参数集合,从而降低深度神经网络在目标任务上的训练成本。此外,预训练还提供了大量特征表示,可能有助于提升模型的泛化能力。然而,这一潜在优势尚未得到充分重视,并被粗糙的微调过程所掩盖。基于一些探索性实验,本文重新审视了微调过程,提出了理解微调的新视角。此外,本文提出了一些即插即用的微调策略作为简单微调的替代方案。这些微调策略通过闲置部分神经元来更好地保留预训练特征,从而实现更优的泛化性能。
abstract_en: Pre-training on large-scale datasets has become a fundamental method for training deep neural networks. Pre-training provides a better set of parameters than random initialization, which reduces the training cost of deep neural networks on the target task. In addition, pre-training also provides a large number of feature representations, which may help improve generalization capabilities. However, this potential advantage has not received enough attention and has been buried by rough fine-tuning. Based on some exploratory experiments, this paper rethinks the fine-tuning process and gives a new perspective on understanding fine-tuning. Moreover, this paper proposes some plug-and-play fine-tuning strategies as alternatives for simple fine-tuning. These fine-tuning strategies all preserve pre-trained features better by creating idling of some neurons, leading to better generalization.

title: 吴宏涛,Angelica I Aviles-Rivero,杨毅君,任晶晶,陈思翔,陈浩宇,朱磊*
title_en: Hongtao Wu, Angelica I Aviles-Rivero, Yijun Yang, Jingjing Ren, Sixiang Chen, Haoyu Chen, Lei Zhu*
abstract: 积雪退化在户外场景中通过不可取的退化现象对计算机视觉任务的发展提出了严峻挑战。尽管当前基于深度学习的去雪方法在合成基准数据集上取得了成功,但由于缺乏配对的真实世界训练数据,它们在恢复分布外的真实世界雪景视频时仍存在困难。为了解决这一瓶颈,我们提出了一种半监督范式的视频去雪新范式,以纳入未标记的真实数据实现通用的去雪效果。具体而言,我们构建了一个包含85个雪景视频的真实世界数据集,并提出了一个配备新型分布驱动对比正则化的半监督视频去雪网络(SemiVDN)。精心设计的对比正则化缓解了合成数据与真实数据之间的分布差异,从而保持了所需的雪不变背景细节。此外,基于大气散射模型,我们引入了一个先验引导的时间解耦专家模块,以帧相关的方式分解雪景视频的物理成分。我们在基准数据集和收集的真实雪景数据上评估了SemiVDN。实验结果表明,我们的方法在图像和视频级去雪方法中具有优越性。我们的代码和数据集可在https://github.com/TonyHongtaoWu/SemiVDN获取。
abstract_en: Snow degradations present formidable challenges to the advancement of computer vision tasks by the undesirable corruption in outdoor scenarios. While current deep learning-based desnowing approaches achieve success on synthetic benchmark datasets, they struggle to restore out-of-distribution real-world snowy videos due to the deficiency of paired real-world training data. To address this bottleneck, we devise a new paradigm for video desnowing in a semi-supervised spirit to involve unlabeled real data for the generalizable snow removal. Specifically, we construct a real-world dataset with 85 snowy videos, and then present a Semi-supervised Video Desnowing Network (SemiVDN) equipped by a novel Distribution-driven Contrastive Regularization. The elaborated contrastive regularization mitigates the distribution gap between the synthetic and real data, and consequently maintains the desired snow-invariant background details. Furthermore, based on the atmospheric scattering model, we introduce a Prior-guided Temporal Decoupling Experts module to decompose the physical components that make up a snowy video in a frame-correlated manner. We evaluate our SemiVDN on benchmark datasets and the collected real snowy data. The experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our approach against state-of-the-art imageand video-level desnowing methods. Our code and the dataset are available at https://github.com/TonyHongtaoWu/SemiVDN.

title: Yi Hongwei*, Thies Justus, Black Michael J., Peng Xue Bin, Rempe Davis*
title_en: Hongwei Yi*, Justus Thies, Michael J. Black, Xue Bin Peng, Davis Rempe*
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于去噪扩散模型的文本控制场景感知运动生成方法。先前的文本到运动方法由于缺乏包含运动、文本描述和交互场景的数据集,主要关注孤立角色而未考虑场景。我们的方法首先在大规模动作捕捉数据集上预训练一个场景无关的文本到运动扩散模型,强调目标达成约束。随后,我们通过使用包含地面平面和物体形状等详细场景信息的数据进行微调,增强了该模型的场景感知组件。为促进训练,我们在场景中嵌入了标注的导航和交互动作。所提出的方法能够生成不同场景中具有各种物体形状、方向、初始身体位置和姿态的逼真且多样的人-物交互,如导航和坐姿。大量实验表明,我们的方法在人类-场景交互的合理性以及生成运动的真实性和多样性方面均优于先前技术。代码和数据可在  获取。
abstract_en: We present , a text-controlled scene-aware motion generation method based on denoising diffusion models. Previous text-to-motion methods focus on characters in isolation without considering scenes due to the limited availability of datasets that include motion, text descriptions, and interactive scenes. Our approach begins with pre-training a scene-agnostic text-to-motion diffusion model, emphasizing goal-reaching constraints on large-scale motion-capture datasets. We then enhance this model with a scene-aware component, fine-tuned using data augmented with detailed scene information, including ground plane and object shapes. To facilitate training, we embed annotated navigation and interaction motions within scenes. The proposed method produces realistic and diverse human-object interactions, such as navigation and sitting, in different scenes with various object shapes, orientations, initial body positions, and poses. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach surpasses prior techniques in terms of the plausibility of human-scene interactions and the realism and variety of the generated motions. Code and data are available at .

title: Hongxiao Yu, Yuqi Wang, Yuntao Chen, Zhaoxiang Zhang*
title_en: Hongxiao Yu, Yuqi Wang, Yuntao Chen, Zhaoxiang Zhang*
abstract: 基于摄像头的三维占用预测近年来在户外驾驶场景中受到越来越多的关注。然而,室内场景的研究仍相对较少。室内场景的核心差异在于场景规模的复杂性和物体尺寸的差异性。本文提出了一种名为__TITLE_MATH_1__的新方法,用于利用单目图像预测室内场景占用。__TITLE_MATH_1__利用预训练的深度模型优势以实现精确的深度预测。此外,我们在__TITLE_MATH_1__中引入了双特征视线投影(D-FLoSP)模块,以增强三维体素特征的学习。为促进该领域的进一步研究,我们提出了Occ-ScanNet,一个大规模的室内场景占用基准数据集。该数据集规模是NYUv2数据集的40倍,有助于未来室内场景分析的可扩展研究。在NYUv2和Occ-ScanNet上的实验结果表明,我们的方法达到了最先进的性能。数据集和代码已公开在https://github.com/hongxiaoy/ ISO.git。
abstract_en: Camera-based 3D occupancy prediction has recently garnered increasing attention in outdoor driving scenes. However, research in indoor scenes remains relatively unexplored. The core differences in indoor scenes lie in the complexity of scene scale and the variance in object size. In this paper, we propose a novel method, named , for predicting indoor scene occupancy using monocular images. harnesses the advantages of a pretrained depth model to achieve accurate depth predictions. Furthermore, we introduce the Dual Feature Line of Sight Projection (D-FLoSP) module within , which enhances the learning of 3D voxel features. To foster further research in this domain, we introduce Occ-ScanNet, a large-scale occupancy benchmark for indoor scenes. With a dataset size 40 times larger than the NYUv2 dataset, it facilitates future scalable research in indoor scene analysis. Experimental results on both NYUv2 and Occ-ScanNet demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance. The dataset and code are made publicly at https://github.com/hongxiaoy/ ISO.git.

title: 基于Transformer的任意点跟踪
title_en: Hongyang Li*, Hao Zhang, Shilong Liu, Zhaoyang Zeng, Tianhe Ren, Feng Li, Lei Zhang*
abstract: 本文提出了一种简单而有效的基于Transformer的任意点跟踪方法(TAP)。基于点跟踪与目标检测和跟踪具有高度相似性的观察,我们借鉴类似DETR的算法设计来解决TAP任务。在中,每个视频帧中的每个跟踪点被表示为一个点查询,该查询包含位置部分和内容部分。如同DETR,每个查询(其位置和内容特征)会逐层自然更新。其可见性通过更新后的内容特征进行预测。属于同一跟踪点的查询可通过沿时间维度的自注意力机制交换信息。由于所有操作均在类似DETR的算法中精心设计,该模型概念上非常简单。我们还采用了一些有用的设计,如光流模型中的代价体积,并开发了简单设计以在缓解特征漂移问题的同时提供长期时间信息。在多个数据集上展示了强大的性能,推理速度也显著提升。
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective approach for Tracking Any Point with TRansformers (). Based on the observation that point tracking bears a great resemblance to object detection and tracking, we borrow designs from DETR-like algorithms to address the task of TAP. In , in each video frame, each tracking point is represented as a point query, which consists of a positional part and a content part. As in DETR, each query (its position and content feature) is naturally updated layer by layer. Its visibility is predicted by its updated content feature. Queries belonging to the same tracking point can exchange information through self-attention along the temporal dimension. As all such operations are well-designed in DETR-like algorithms, the model is conceptually very simple. We also adopt some useful designs such as cost volume from optical flow models and develop simple designs to provide long temporal information while mitigating the feature drifting issue. demonstrates strong performance with state-of-the-art performance on various datasets with faster inference speed.

title: Hongyu Wen*, Erich Liang, Jia Deng
title_en: Hongyu Wen*, Erich Liang, Jia Deng
abstract: 实现对非朗伯物体的三维理解是一项具有重要应用价值的任务,但现有大多数算法在处理此类物体时仍存在困难。该领域进展的主要障碍之一是缺乏全面的非朗伯物体基准数据集——大多数基准数据集场景和物体多样性不足,且没有为被透明表面遮挡的物体提供多层三维标注。本文引入__TITLE_MATH_1__,这是一个包含非朗伯物体光流多层真实世界基准数据集,具有更丰富的场景和物体多样性,包含在185个室内和室外场景及360个独特物体中采集的150,000组高质量光流与立体图像对。以__ABS_MATH_1__作为评估数据,我们提出了一项新的任务——多层光流。为支持该任务的训练数据,我们引入了一个大规模密集标注的合成数据集,包含30个场景中60,000张图像,专门针对非朗伯物体进行优化。在合成数据集上训练模型可实现多层光流预测,而将现有光流方法在该数据集上微调可显著提升其在非朗伯物体上的性能,同时不损害对漫反射物体的性能表现。
abstract_en: Achieving 3D understanding of non-Lambertian objects is an important task with many useful applications, but most existing algorithms struggle to deal with such objects. One major obstacle towards progress in this field is the lack of holistic non-Lambertian benchmarks—most benchmarks have low scene and object diversity, and none provide multi-layer 3D annotations for objects occluded by transparent surfaces. In this paper, we introduce , a real world benchmark containing multi-layer ground truth annotation for optical flow of non-Lambertian objects. Compared to previous benchmarks, our benchmark exhibits greater scene and object diversity, with 150k high quality optical flow and stereo pairs taken over 185 indoor and outdoor scenes and 360 unique objects. Using as evaluation data, we propose a new task called multi-layer optical flow. To provide training data for this task, we introduce a large-scale densely-annotated synthetic dataset containing 60k images within 30 scenes tailored for non-Lambertian objects. Training on our synthetic dataset enables model to predict multi-layer optical flow, while fine-tuning existing optical flow methods on the dataset notably boosts their performance on non-Lambertian objects without compromising the performance on diffuse objects.

title: Hongyuan Wang, Lizhi Wang*, Jiang Xu, Chang Chen, Xue Hu, Fenglong Song, Youliang Yan
title_en: Hongyuan Wang, Lizhi Wang*, Jiang Xu, Chang Chen, Xue Hu, Fenglong Song, Youliang Yan
abstract: 旨在从易于获取的RGB图像中恢复高光谱图像(HSI)的光谱超分辨率技术,在计算摄影领域引起了越来越多的关注。光谱超分辨率的关键在于利用HSI内部的相关性。然而,现有Transformer模型存在两类瓶颈限制了性能提升和实际应用。首先,现有Transformer通常分别强调空间相关性或光谱相关性,破坏了HSI的3D特征,阻碍了统一空间-光谱相关性的挖掘。其次,现有自注意力机制通过学习token对之间的相关性建立全秩相关矩阵,导致其无法描述HSI中多个token广泛存在的线性依赖关系。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种用于光谱超分辨率的全面相关Transformer(ECT)。首先,我们提出了一种光谱断续3D(SD3D)分割策略,通过整合空间连续分割策略和光谱断续分割策略,建模统一的局部-非局部空间-光谱相关性。其次,我们提出了一种动态低秩映射(DLRM)模型,通过动态计算的低秩依赖图捕捉多个token之间的线性依赖关系。通过整合统一的空间-光谱注意力和线性依赖关系,我们的ECT能够建模HSI内的全面相关性。在模拟和真实数据上的实验结果表明,我们的方法达到了SOTA。
abstract_en: Spectral super-resolution that aims to recover hyperspectral image (HSI) from easily obtainable RGB image has drawn increasing interest in the field of computational photography. The crucial aspect of spectral super-resolution lies in exploiting the correlation within HSIs. However, two types of bottlenecks in existing Transformers limit performance improvement and practical applications. First, existing Transformers often separately emphasize either spatial-wise or spectral-wise correlation, disrupting the 3D features of HSI and hindering the exploitation of unified spatial-spectral correlation. Second, existing self-attention mechanism always establishes full-rank correlation matrix by learning the correlation between pairs of tokens, leading to its inability to describe linear dependence widely existing in HSI among multiple tokens. To address these issues, we propose an Exhaustive Correlation Transformer (ECT) for spectral super-resolution. First, we propose a Spectral-wise Discontinuous 3D (SD3D) splitting strategy, which models unified local-nonlocal spatial-spectral correlation by integrating spatial-wise continuous splitting strategy and spectral-wise discontinuous splitting strategy. Second, we propose a Dynamic Low-Rank Mapping (DLRM) model, which captures linear dependence among multiple tokens through a dynamically calculated low-rank dependence map. By integrating unified spatial-spectral attention and linear dependence, our ECT can model exhaustive correlation within HSI. The experimental results on both simulated and real data indicate that our method achieves SOTA.

title: Hoonhee Cho, Jae-Young Kang, Kuk-Jin Yoon*
title_en: Hoonhee Cho, Jae-Young Kang, Kuk-Jin Yoon*
abstract: 事件相机是一种受生物视网膜启发的动态视觉传感器,具有高动态范围、高时间分辨率和低功耗的特点。这些特性使它们能够在极端条件下感知三维环境。事件数据在时间维度上是连续的,这使得每个像素的运动可以被详细描述。为了充分利用事件相机在时间上的密集性和连续性,我们提出了一种新颖的时序事件立体匹配框架,该框架持续利用先前时间步的信息。这是通过同时训练事件立体匹配网络和立体光流实现的,立体光流是一种新概念,能够捕捉双目相机所有像素的运动。由于在训练过程中获取光流的地面真实值具有挑战性,我们提出了一种仅使用视差图训练立体光流的方法。通过利用光流进行时间信息聚合,事件基立体匹配的性能得到了增强。我们在MVSEC和DSEC数据集上取得了最先进的性能。该方法计算效率高,通过级联方式堆叠先前信息。代码可在https: //github.com/mickeykang16/TemporalEventStereo获取。
abstract_en: Event cameras are dynamic vision sensors inspired by the biological retina, characterized by their high dynamic range, high temporal resolution, and low power consumption. These features make them capable of perceiving 3D environments even in extreme conditions. Event data is continuous across the time dimension, which allows a detailed description of each pixel’s movements. To fully utilize the temporally dense and continuous nature of event cameras, we propose a novel temporal event stereo, a framework that continuously uses information from previous time steps. This is accomplished through the simultaneous training of an event stereo matching network alongside stereoscopic flow, a new concept that captures all pixel movements from stereo cameras. Since obtaining ground truth for optical flow during training is challenging, we propose a method that uses only disparity maps to train the stereoscopic flow. The performance of event-based stereo matching is enhanced by temporally aggregating information using the flows. We have achieved state-of-the-art performance on the MVSEC and the DSEC datasets. The method is computationally efficient, as it stacks previous information in a cascading manner. The code is available at https: //github.com/mickeykang16/TemporalEventStereo.

title: Hoonhee Cho, Sung-Hoon Yoon, Hyeokjun Kweon, Kuk-Jin Yoon*
title_en: Hoonhee Cho, Sung-Hoon Yoon, Hyeokjun Kweon, Kuk-Jin Yoon*
abstract: 事件相机在捕捉高对比度场景和动态物体方面表现出色,相较于传统基于帧的相机具有显著优势。尽管已有大量研究探索利用事件相机进行语义分割,但为这类具有挑战性的场景生成像素级密集语义图仍需大量人工标注。为此,我们提出EV-WSSS:一种新颖的弱监督事件基语义分割方法,仅需稀疏点标注即可实现。为充分挖掘事件数据的时间特性,所提框架在1)原始前向事件数据与2)包含过去和未来互补信息的更长反向事件数据之间进行非对称双学生学习。此外,为缓解稀疏监督带来的挑战,我们提出基于类别原型的特征级对比学习,该原型在空间区域和样本层面进行精心聚合。同时,我们进一步挖掘双学生学习模型的潜力,通过交换两个学习路径间的原型,从而融合其互补优势。在包括本论文新提供的DSEC Night-Point数据集(含稀疏点标注)在内的多个数据集上进行大量实验,所提方法在无需依赖像素级密集真实标签的情况下取得了显著的分割效果。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/Chohoonhee/EV-WSSS获取。
abstract_en: Event cameras excel in capturing high-contrast scenes and dynamic objects, offering a significant advantage over traditional frame-based cameras. Despite active research into leveraging event cameras for semantic segmentation, generating pixel-wise dense semantic maps for such challenging scenarios remains labor-intensive. As a remedy, we present EV-WSSS: a novel weakly supervised approach for event-based semantic segmentation that utilizes sparse point annotations. To fully leverage the temporal characteristics of event data, the proposed framework performs asymmetric dual-student learning between 1) the original forward event data and 2) the longer reversed event data, which contain complementary information from the past and the future, respectively. Besides, to mitigate the challenges posed by sparse supervision, we propose feature-level contrastive learning based on class-wise prototypes, carefully aggregated at both spatial region and sample levels. Additionally, we further excavate the potential of our dual-student learning model by exchanging prototypes between the two learning paths, thereby harnessing their complementary strengths. With extensive experiments on various datasets, including DSEC Night-Point with sparse point annotations newly provided by this paper, the proposed method achieves substantial segmentation results even without relying on pixel-level dense ground truths. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Chohoonhee/EV-WSSS.

title: Hossein Jafarinia*, Alireza Alipanah, Saeed Razavi, Nahal Mirzaie, Mohammad Hossein Rohban*
title_en: Hossein Jafarinia*, Alireza Alipanah, Saeed Razavi, Nahal Mirzaie, Mohammad Hossein Rohban*
abstract: 在数字病理学中,使用多实例学习(MIL)进行全切片图像(WSI)分类面临显著的计算挑战。现有方法主要依赖于广泛的自监督学习(SSL)以实现满意的性能,需要较长的训练周期和大量的计算资源。同时,由于从自然图像到WSI的领域转移,缺乏预训练会影响性能。我们引入Snuffy架构,这是一种基于稀疏变换器的新型MIL池化方法,通过有限的预训练减轻性能损失,并支持持续的少样本预训练作为有竞争力的替代方案。我们的稀疏模式针对病理学进行了优化,并在稀疏变换器的层数数量上具有最紧的概率尖锐界限,理论上证明了其作为通用逼近器的有效性。我们在CAMELYON16和TCGA肺癌数据集上展示了Snuffy的有效性,实现了优越的WSI和图像块级准确率。代码可在https: //github.com/jafarinia/snuffy获取。[width=0.9]figures/Plot Black.png 图1:性能(AUC)与CAMELYON16的对比。效率(尺寸和时间)权衡
abstract_en: Whole Slide Image (WSI) classification with multiple instance learning (MIL) in digital pathology faces significant computational challenges. Current methods mostly rely on extensive self-supervised learning (SSL) for satisfactory performance, requiring long training periods and considerable computational resources. At the same time, no pre-training affects performance due to domain shifts from natural images to WSIs. We introduce Snuffy architecture, a novel MIL-pooling method based on sparse transformers that mitigates performance loss with limited pre-training and enables continual few-shot pre-training as a competitive option. Our sparsity pattern is tailored for pathology and is theoretically proven to be a universal approximator with the tightest probabilistic sharp bound on the number of layers for sparse transformers, to date. We demonstrate Snuffy’s effectiveness on CAMELYON16 and TCGA Lung cancer datasets, achieving superior WSI and patch-level accuracies. The code is available on https: //github.com/jafarinia/snuffy. [width=0.9]figures/Plot Black.png Figure 1: Performance (AUC) vs. CAMELYON16. efficiency (size and time) trade off on

title: Hoyong Kwon, Jaeseok Jeong, Sung-Hoon Yoon, Kuk-Jin Yoon*
title_en: Hoyong Kwon, Jaeseok Jeong, Sung-Hoon Yoon, Kuk-Jin Yoon*
abstract: 基于图像级别的弱监督语义分割(WSSS)通常通过类激活图(CAMs)获取目标定位信息。尽管在WSSS中视觉Transformer(ViTs)因其对全局上下文的理解能力而被越来越多地探索,但ViT生成的CAMs在边界区域仍存在定位不精确和假阳性激活的问题。本文提出了一种基于频率域信息的新颖WSSS框架,旨在解决上述问题。在我们的框架中,引入了基于幅度混合的相位集中(MPC)模块,该模块引导分类器优先关注包含高层语义细节的相位信息。通过扰动和混合幅度,MPC指导分类器强化并集中于相位中的形状信息,从而在CAMs边界区域实现更精细的区分。此外,受频率域中分类“捷径”可能引发CAMs假阳性现象的实证观察启发,我们引入了频率捷径抑制(FSS)模块。该模块旨在抑制此类捷径的形成,从而缓解假阳性问题。我们的方法在PASCAL VOC 2012和MS COCO 2014数据集上取得了新的最先进性能,代码已开源至https://github.com/kwonhoyong3/PCSS-WSSS。
abstract_en: Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation (WSSS) with image-level supervision typically acquires object localization information from Class Activation Maps (CAMs). While Vision Transformers (ViTs) in WSSS have been increasingly explored for their superior performance in understanding global context, CAMs from ViT still show imprecise localization in boundary areas and false positive activation. This paper proposes a novel WSSS framework that targets these issues based on the information from the frequency domain. In our framework, we introduce the Magnitude-mixing-based Phase Concentration (MPC) module, which guides the classifier to prioritize phase information containing high-level semantic details. By perturbing and mixing the magnitude, MPC guides the classifier to accentuate and concentrate on the shape information in the phase, thereby leading to finer distinctions in CAMs boundary regions. Additionally, inspired by empirical observations that the classification ”shortcut” in the frequency domain can induce false positives in CAMs, we introduce a Frequency Shortcut Suppression (FSS) module. This module aims to discourage the formation of such shortcuts, thereby mitigating false positives. The effectiveness of our approach is demonstrated by achieving new state-of-the-art performance on both PASCAL VOC 2012 and MS COCO 2014 datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/kwonhoyong3/PCSS-WSSS.

title: Hritam Basak*, Zhaozheng Yin
title_en: Hritam Basak*, Zhaozheng Yin
abstract: 半监督域适应(SSDA)涵盖将源域中获取的表示适应到新目标域的过程,利用有限的带标签样本与大量目标域的无标签数据。简单地将域适应(DA)和半监督学习(SSL)进行聚合无法达到最佳性能,主要由于两个关键挑战:(1)训练数据分布偏向源域表示学习,(2)冗余的域特异性特征持续存在,阻碍了有效的域无关(即任务特定)特征提取。为追求更高的泛化能力和鲁棒性,我们提出了一种新的分阶段学习策略的SSDA框架:“学习、遗忘、再学习”。首先,我们训练两个编码器-分类器对,一个用于源域,另一个用于目标域,旨在学习域特异性特征。这涉及对域内图像最小化分类损失,对域外图像最大化不确定性损失。随后,我们将图像转换到新的空间中,战略性地去除(遗忘)域特异性表示,同时保持其与原始表示的结构相似性。这种主动去除域特异性属性的过程通过高斯引导的潜在对齐(GLA)策略进一步补充,该策略利用先验分布对域无关的源域和目标域表示进行对齐。所提出的SSDA框架可进一步扩展到无监督域适应(UDA)。在两个域自适应图像分类任务上的评估表明,我们的方法在SSDA和UDA场景中均优于现有最先进的(SoTA)方法。代码可在GitHub上获取。
abstract_en: Semi-supervised Domain Adaptation (SSDA) encompasses the process of adapting representations acquired from the source domain to a new target domain, utilizing a limited number of labeled samples in conjunction with an abundance of unlabeled data from the target domain. Simple aggregation of domain adaptation (DA) and semi-supervised learning (SSL) falls short of optimal performance due to two primary challenges: (1) skewed training data distribution favoring the source representation learning, and (2) the persistence of superfluous domain-specific features, hindering effective domain-agnostic (i.e., task-specific) feature extraction. In pursuit of greater generalizability and robustness, we present an SSDA framework with a new episodic learning strategy: “learn, forget, then learn more”. First, we train two encoder-classifier pairs, one for the source and the other for the target domain, aiming to learn domain-specific features. This involves minimizing classification loss for in-domain images and maximizing uncertainty loss for out-of-domain images. Subsequently, we transform the images into a new space, strategically unlearning (forgetting) the domain-specific representations while preserving their structural similarity to the originals. This proactive removal of domain-specific attributes is complemented by learning more domain-agnostic features using a Gaussian-guided latent alignment (GLA) strategy that uses a prior distribution to align domain-agnostic source and target representations. The proposed SSDA framework can be further extended to unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA). Evaluation across two domain adaptive image classification tasks reveals our method’s superiority over state-of-the-art (SoTA) methods in both SSDA and UDA scenarios. Code is available at: GitHub.

title: Hu Cao, Zehua Zhang, Yan Xia, Xinyi Li, Jiahao Xia, Guang Chen*, Alois C. Knoll
title_en: Hu Cao, Zehua Zhang, Yan Xia, Xinyi Li, Jiahao Xia, Guang Chen*, Alois C. Knoll
abstract: 在基于帧的视觉中,由于传统相机的感知能力有限,物体检测在复杂条件下会面临显著的性能退化。事件相机输出稀疏且异步的事件,为解决这些问题提供了潜在方案。然而,有效融合两种异构模态仍是一个开放性问题。本文提出了一种新颖的层次化特征细化网络用于事件-帧融合。核心思想是设计粗到细融合模块,称为跨模态自适应特征细化(CAFR)模块。在初始阶段,双向跨模态交互(BCI)部分促进来自两个不同源的信息传递。随后,通过在双重自适应特征细化(TAFR)部分对齐两个模态的通道级均值和方差,进一步细化特征。我们在两个基准数据集上进行了大量实验:低分辨率PKU-DDD17-Car数据集和高分辨率DSEC数据集。实验结果表明,我们的方法在DSEC数据集上超越了现有最优方法8.0%。此外,当向帧图像引入15种不同退化类型时,我们的方法展现出显著更好的鲁棒性(69.5% vs 38.7%)。代码可在链接(https://github.com/HuCaoFighting/FRN)中找到。
abstract_en: In frame-based vision, object detection faces substantial performance degradation under challenging conditions due to the limited sensing capability of conventional cameras. Event cameras output sparse and asynchronous events, providing a potential solution to solve these problems. However, effectively fusing two heterogeneous modalities remains an open issue. In this work, we propose a novel hierarchical feature refinement network for event-frame fusion. The core concept is the design of the coarse-to-fine fusion module, denoted as the cross-modality adaptive feature refinement (CAFR) module. In the initial phase, the bidirectional cross-modality interaction (BCI) part facilitates information bridging from two distinct sources. Subsequently, the features are further refined by aligning the channel-level mean and variance in the two-fold adaptive feature refinement (TAFR) part. We conducted extensive experiments on two benchmarks: the low-resolution PKU-DDD17-Car dataset and the high-resolution DSEC dataset. Experimental results show that our method surpasses the state-of-the-art by an impressive margin of 8.0% on the DSEC dataset. Besides, our method exhibits significantly better robustness (69.5% versus 38.7%) when introducing 15 different corruption types to the frame images. The code can be found at the link (https://github.com/HuCaoFighting/FRN).

title: Hu Jinjing, Wenrui Liu, Hong Chang*, Bingpeng MA, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen
title_en: Hu Jinjing, Wenrui Liu, Hong Chang*, Bingpeng MA, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen
abstract: 检测分布外(OOD)输入对于现实应用至关重要。然而,由于在训练阶段无法获取OOD数据,使用带有分布内(ID)和OOD标签的监督二分类方法不可行。因此,先前的工作通常通过代理ID分类任务来学习用于OOD检测的特征表示。在本研究中,我们通过信息论的视角深入探讨了这两个任务之间的关系。我们的分析表明,优化分类目标不可避免地会导致OOD检测相关信息的过度自信和压缩。为了解决这两个问题,我们提出OOD熵正则化(OER),以正则化分类导向的表示学习中捕获的信息,从而检测OOD样本。理论分析和实验结果均表明,OER在OOD检测中表现出一致的提升。
abstract_en: Detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs are pivotal for real-world applications. However, due to the inaccessibility of OODs during training phase, applying supervised binary classification with in-distribution (ID) and OOD labels is not feasible. Therefore, previous works typically employ the proxy ID classification task to learn feature representation for OOD detection task. In this study, we delve into the relationship between the two tasks through the lens of Information Theory. Our analysis reveals that optimizing the classification objective could inevitably cause the over-confidence and undesired compression of OOD detection-relevant information. To address these two problems, we propose OOD Entropy Regularization (OER) to regularize the information captured in classification-oriented representation learning for detecting OOD samples. Both theoretical analyses and experimental results underscore the consistent improvement of OER on OOD detection.

title: Hu Yu, Li Shen, Jie Huang, Hongsheng Li, Feng Zhao*
title_en: Hu Yu, Li Shen, Jie Huang, Hongsheng Li, Feng Zhao*
abstract: 去噪扩散模型已成为图像生成的主流方法,但其在训练过程中仍存在收敛速度慢的问题,并在采样过程中面临颜色偏移的挑战。本文识别出这些障碍主要源于扩散模型默认训练范式的固有偏差和次优性。具体而言,我们提供了理论见解,指出扩散模型中ε预测的普遍恒定损失权重策略会导致训练阶段的偏差估计,从而阻碍对原始图像的准确估计。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种源自解锁偏差部分的简单而有效的加权策略。此外,我们进行了全面系统的探索,揭示了偏差问题的存在形式、影响及其根本原因。这些分析有助于深化对扩散模型的理解。实验结果表明,仅通过调整损失权重策略,我们的方法显著提升了样本质量,并在训练和采样过程中展现出更高的效率。代码已公开在https: //github.com/yuhuUSTC/Debias
abstract_en: Denoising diffusion models have emerged as a dominant approach for image generation, however they still suffer from slow convergence in training and color shift issues in sampling. In this paper, we identify that these obstacles can be largely attributed to bias and suboptimality inherent in the default training paradigm of diffusion models. Specifically, we offer theoretical insights that the prevailing constant loss weight strategy in ε-prediction of diffusion models leads to biased estimation during the training phase, hindering accurate estimations of original images. To address the issue, we propose a simple but effective weighting strategy derived from the unlocked biased part. Furthermore, we conduct a comprehensive and systematic exploration, unraveling the inherent bias problem in terms of its existence, impact and underlying reasons. These analyses contribute to advancing the understanding of diffusion models. Empirical results demonstrate that our method remarkably elevates sample quality and displays improved efficiency in both training and sampling processes, by only adjusting loss weighting strategy. The code is released publicly at https: //github.com/yuhuUSTC/Debias

title: 张虎,徐建华,唐涛,孙海阳,于欣*,黄子 Helen*,于凯城
title_en: Hu Zhang, xu jianhua, Tao Tang, Haiyang Sun, Xin Yu*, Zi Helen Huang*, Kaicheng Yu
abstract: 传统基于LiDAR的目标检测研究主要聚焦于闭集场景,难以满足复杂现实应用需求。直接迁移现有2D开放词汇模型至LiDAR数据时,若仅使用部分已知LiDAR类别进行开放词汇能力扩展,易出现过拟合问题:模型会检测已知对象,甚至在面对新类别时也会误检。本文提出OpenSight,一种更先进的基于LiDAR的开放词汇检测2D-3D建模框架。OpenSight利用2D-3D几何先验进行通用对象的初步识别与定位,随后对检测对象进行更具体的语义解释。该过程首先从LiDAR的配套相机图像中生成通用对象的2D框,这些2D框与LiDAR点云共同提升至LiDAR空间以估计对应的3D框。为提升通用对象感知能力,框架融合了时间感知与空间感知约束。时间感知通过关联连续时间戳的预测3D框,校正漏检或误检框;空间感知则随机放置部分"精确"估计的3D框于不同距离,增强通用对象的可见性。为解析检测对象的具体语义,我们开发了跨模态对齐与融合模块,首先对齐3D特征与2D图像嵌入,再融合对齐后的3D-2D特征进行语义解码。实验表明,我们的方法在广泛使用的3D检测基准上建立了开放词汇性能的最先进水平,并能有效识别新类别目标。
abstract_en: Traditional LiDAR-based object detection research primarily focuses on closed-set scenarios, which falls short in complex real-world applications. Directly transferring existing 2D open-vocabulary models with some known LiDAR classes for open-vocabulary ability, however, tends to suffer from over-fitting problems: The obtained model will detect the known objects, even presented with a novel category. In this paper, we propose OpenSight, a more advanced 2D-3D modeling framework for LiDAR-based open-vocabulary detection. OpenSight utilizes 2D-3D geometric priors for the initial discernment and localization of generic objects, followed by a more specific semantic interpretation of the detected objects. The process begins by generating 2D boxes for generic objects from the accompanying camera images of LiDAR. These 2D boxes, together with LiDAR points, are then lifted back into the LiDAR space to estimate corresponding 3D boxes. For better generic object perception, our framework integrates both temporal and spatial-aware constraints. Temporal awareness correlates the predicted 3D boxes across consecutive timestamps, recalibrating the missed or inaccurate boxes. The spatial awareness randomly places some “precisely” estimated 3D boxes at varying distances, increasing the visibility of generic objects. To interpret the specific semantics of detected objects, we develop a cross-modal alignment and fusion module to first align 3D features with 2D image embeddings and then fuse the aligned 3D-2D features for semantic decoding. Our experiments indicate that our method establishes state-of-the-art open-vocabulary performance on widely used 3D detection benchmarks and effectively identifies objects for new categories of interest.

title: Huabin Liu, Xiao Ma, Cheng Zhong, Yang Zhang, Weiyao Lin*
title_en: Huabin Liu, Xiao Ma, Cheng Zhong, Yang Zhang, Weiyao Lin*
abstract: 视频推理通常在视频问答(VQA)范式中进行,该范式要求模型从时间与因果视角理解并推理视频内容。传统监督式VQA方法通过精心标注的问答数据集获得这一能力,而先进的视觉-语言模型则凭借大规模的视觉-文本预训练数据展现出卓越性能。然而,由于跨模态学习中潜在的语言偏差和虚假的视觉-文本关联,其答案在实际应用中的可靠性仍存在担忧。本文聚焦于基于视觉证据的VQA任务,要求模型在提供答案的同时给出明确的视觉证据,即特定视频片段。由于训练过程中缺乏时间标注,我们提出了一种新颖的双向推理框架,在弱监督设置下执行基于视觉证据的VQA。具体而言,我们的框架包含两条并行但双通道的推理路径。它们基于视频内容分别从时间顺序或因果关系对称的两个双向视角进行时间定位与答案生成。通过构建这两条分支间的循环一致性关系,模型被引导为时间定位与答案生成提供自监督。在Next-GQA和Env-QA数据集上的实验表明,我们的框架在基于视觉证据的VQA任务中表现出色,能够提供合理的时序位置以验证答案。
abstract_en: Video reasoning typically operates within the Video Question-Answering (VQA) paradigm, which demands that the models understand and reason about video content from temporal and causal perspectives. Traditional supervised VQA methods gain this capability through meticulously annotated QA datasets, while advanced visual-language models exhibit remarkable performance due to large-scale visual-text pretraining data. Nevertheless, due to potential language bias and spurious visual-text correlations in cross-modal learning, concerns about the reliability of their answers persist in real-world applications. In this paper, we focus on the grounded VQA task, which necessitates models to provide answers along with explicit visual evidence, i.e., certain video segments. As temporal annotation is not available during training, we propose a novel bi-directional reasoning framework to perform grounded VQA in a weakly-supervised setting. Specifically, our framework consists of two parallel but dual reasoning paths. They conduct temporal grounding and answering based on the video content, approaching it from two dual directions that are symmetrical in terms of temporal order or causal relationships. By constructing a cycle-consistency relationship between these two branches, the model is prompted to provide self-guidance supervision for both temporal grounding and answering. Experiments conducted on the Next-GQA and Env-QA datasets demonstrate that our framework achieves superior performance in grounded VQA and can provide reasonable temporal locations that validate the answers.

title: Huadong Li, Minhao Jing, Jin Wang, Shichao Dong, Jiajun Liang, Haoqiang Fan, Renhe Ji*
title_en: Huadong Li, Minhao Jing, Jin Wang, Shichao Dong, Jiajun Liang, Haoqiang Fan, Renhe Ji*
abstract: 在深度补全领域,人们普遍认为稀疏监督的效果不如密集监督,但其背后的原因却很少被讨论。为此,我们重新审视了雷达-相机深度补全任务,并提出了一种新的方法,利用稀疏激光雷达监督,在准确性和速度上均优于之前基于密集激光雷达监督的方法。具体而言,当使用稀疏激光雷达监督进行训练时,深度补全模型通常会输出包含显著条纹状伪影的深度图。我们发现,这种现象是由于从稀疏激光雷达监督中隐式学习到的位置分布模式引起的,本文将其称为激光雷达分布泄漏(LDL)。基于这一理解,我们提出了一种新颖的干扰补偿雷达-相机深度补全框架来解决这一问题。干扰部分旨在故意干扰从稀疏监督中学习到的激光雷达分布,而补偿部分则旨在利用三维空间和二维语义信息来补偿之前干扰导致的信息损失。大量实验结果表明,通过减少LDL的影响,我们的稀疏监督框架在平均绝对误差(MAE)上比最先进的密集监督方法提高了11.6%,并在每秒帧数(FPS)上实现了1.6倍的速度提升。代码可在https://github.com/megvii-research/Sparse-Beats-Dense获取。
abstract_en: It is widely believed that sparse supervision is worse than dense supervision in the field of depth completion, but the underlying reasons for this are rarely discussed. To this end, we revisit the task of radar-camera depth completion and present a new method with sparse LiDAR supervision to outperform previous dense LiDAR supervision methods in both accuracy and speed. Specifically, when trained by sparse LiDAR supervision, depth completion models usually output depth maps containing significant stripe-like artifacts. We find that such a phenomenon is caused by the implicitly learned positional distribution pattern from sparse LiDAR supervision, termed as LiDAR Distribution Leakage (LDL) in this paper. Based on such understanding, we present a novel Disruption-Compensation radar-camera depth completion framework to address this issue. The Disruption part aims to deliberately disrupt the learning of LiDAR distribution from sparse supervision, while the Compensation part aims to leverage 3D spatial and 2D semantic information to compensate for the information loss of previous disruptions. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that by reducing the impact of LDL, our framework with sparse supervision outperforms the state-of-the-art dense supervision methods with 11.6% improvement in Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and 1.6× speedup in Frame Per Second (FPS). The code is available at https://github.com/megvii-research/Sparse-Beats-Dense.

title: 陈华峰, 邵迪*, 郭广乾, 高山*
title_en: Huafeng Chen, Dian SHAO*, Guangqian Guo, shan gao*
abstract: 伪装目标检测(COD)要求模型能够迅速且准确地区分无缝隐藏在环境中的目标。由于细微差异和模糊边界,COD不仅对模型而言是一项极具挑战性的任务,对人工标注者同样如此,需要大量努力提供像素级标注。为减轻沉重的标注负担,我们提出仅通过单点监督来完成该任务。具体而言,通过快速点击每个目标,我们首先将原始基于点的标注自适应地扩展为合理的提示区域。随后,为避免在判别性部分周围出现局部定位,我们提出一种注意力调节器,通过部分遮蔽标注区域,将模型注意力分散到整个目标上。此外,为解决仅基于点标注下伪装目标特征表示的不稳定性,我们基于不同增强的图像对(如改变颜色或进行平移)执行无监督对比学习。在三个主流COD基准数据集上,实验结果表明,我们的模型在多种指标上显著优于几种弱监督方法。
abstract_en: Camouflaged Object Detection (COD) demands models to expeditiously and accurately distinguish objects which conceal themselves seamlessly in the environment. Owing to the subtle differences and ambiguous boundaries, COD is not only a remarkably challenging task for models but also for human annotators, requiring huge efforts to provide pixel-wise annotations. To alleviate the heavy annotation burden, we propose to fulfill this task with the help of only one point supervision. Specifically, by swiftly clicking on each object, we first adaptively expand the original point-based annotation to a reasonable hint area. Then, to avoid partial localization around discriminative parts, we propose an attention regulator to scatter model attention to the whole object through partially masking labeled regions. Moreover, to solve the unstable feature representation of camouflaged objects under only point-based annotation, we perform unsupervised contrastive learning based on differently augmented image pairs (e.g. changing color or doing translation). On three mainstream COD benchmarks, experimental results show that our model outperforms several weakly-supervised methods by a large margin across various metrics.

title: Huafeng Chen, Pengxu Wei, Guangqian Guo, Shan Gao*
title_en: Huafeng Chen, Pengxu Wei, Guangqian Guo, Shan Gao*
abstract: 现有伪装目标检测(COD)方法严重依赖掩码标注,而获取这些标注耗时且劳动密集。现有的弱监督COD方法在性能上明显不如全监督方法,并且难以同时支持现有的所有类型伪装目标标签,包括涂鸦、边界框和点。即使对于分割任何模型(SAM),处理弱监督COD仍存在问题,通常会遇到涂鸦标签的提示兼容性、极端响应、语义错误响应和不稳定特征表示等挑战,在伪装场景中产生令人不满意的结果。为缓解这些问题,本文提出了一种统一的COD框架,称为SAM-COD,能够支持任意弱监督标签。我们的SAM-COD采用提示适配器,基于SAM处理涂鸦作为提示。同时,我们引入响应过滤器和语义匹配器模块,以提高SAM在COD提示下获得的掩码质量。为减轻不准确掩码预测的负面影响,采用了一种新的提示自适应知识蒸馏策略,以确保可靠的特征表示。为验证方法的有效性,我们在三个主流COD基准数据集上进行了大量实证实验。结果表明,我们的方法在弱监督甚至全监督方法中均具有优越性。
abstract_en: Most Camouflaged Object Detection (COD) methods heavily rely on mask annotations, which are time-consuming and labor-intensive to acquire. Existing weakly-supervised COD approaches exhibit significantly inferior performance compared to fully-supervised methods and struggle to simultaneously support all the existing types of camouflaged object labels, including scribbles, bounding boxes, and points. Even for Segment Anything Model (SAM), it is still problematic to handle the weakly-supervised COD and it typically encounters challenges of prompt compatibility of the scribble labels, extreme response, semantically erroneous response, and unstable feature representations, producing unsatisfactory results in camouflaged scenes. To mitigate these issues, we propose a unified COD framework in this paper, termed SAM-COD, which is capable of supporting arbitrary weakly-supervised labels. Our SAM-COD employs a prompt adapter to handle scribbles as prompts based on SAM. Meanwhile, we introduce response filter and semantic matcher modules to improve the quality of the masks obtained by SAM under COD prompts. To alleviate the negative impacts of inaccurate mask predictions, a new strategy of prompt-adaptive knowledge distillation is utilized to ensure a reliable feature representation. To validate the effectiveness of our approach, we have conducted extensive empirical experiments on three mainstream COD benchmarks. The results demonstrate the superiority of our method against state-of-the-art weakly-supervised and even fully-supervised methods.

title: Huafeng Qin, Xin Jin*, Hongyu Zhu, Hongchao Liao, Mounim A. El Yacoubi, Xinbo Gao
title_en: Huafeng Qin, Xin Jin*, Hongyu Zhu, Hongchao Liao, Mounim A. El Yacoubi, Xinbo Gao
abstract: Mixup数据增强方法已被应用于深度学习的各类任务中,以提升深度神经网络的泛化能力。现有方法如CutMix、SaliencyMix等通过随机用另一张图像的补丁替换一张图像中的补丁来生成混合图像。类似地,对应的标签通过固定比例λ进行线性组合。在混合过程中,两幅图像中的目标可能会重叠,导致混合样本中的部分语义信息被破坏。此时,混合图像与混合标签信息不匹配。此外,此类标签可能误导深度学习模型的训练,导致性能下降。为解决该问题,我们提出了一种名为SUMix的新方法,在训练过程中学习混合样本的混合比例及不确定性。首先,我们设计了一个可学习的相似度函数以计算精确的混合比例。其次,引入一种正则化项来建模混合样本的不确定性。我们在五个图像基准数据集上进行了实验,大量实验结果表明,我们的方法能够提升基于切割的Mixup方法的分类器性能。源代码可在https://github.com/JinXins/SUMix获取。
abstract_en: Mixup data augmentation approaches have been applied for various tasks of deep learning to improve the generalization ability of deep neural networks. Some existing approaches CutMix, SaliencyMix, etc. randomly replace a patch in one image with patches from another to generate the mixed image. Similarly, the corresponding labels are linearly combined by a fixed ratio λ by l. The objects in two images may be overlapped during the mixing process, so some semantic information is corrupted in the mixed samples. In this case, the mixed image does not match the mixed label information. Besides, such a label may mislead the deep learning model training, which results in poor performance. To solve this problem, we proposed a novel approach named SUMix to learn the mixing ratio as well as the uncertainty for the mixed samples during the training process. First, we design a learnable similarity function to compute an accurate mix ratio. Second, an approach is investigated as a regularized term to model the uncertainty of the mixed samples. We conduct experiments on five image benchmarks, and extensive experimental results imply that our method is capable of improving the performance of classifiers with different cutting-based mixup approaches. The source code is available at https://github.com/JinXins/SUMix.

title: 高焕昂、高明驹、李佳驹、李文毅、支荣、唐浩、赵浩*
title_en: Huan-ang Gao, Mingju Gao, Jiaju Li, Wenyi Li, Rong Zhi, Hao Tang, Hao Zhao*
abstract: 语义图像合成(SIS)在传感器模拟领域展现出良好的前景。然而,基于生成对抗网络(GANs)的当前最佳实践尚未达到预期的质量水平。随着潜扩散模型在图像生成领域取得显著进展,我们被促使评估ControlNet,这是一种因其密集控制能力而著称的方法。我们的研究发现了其结果中的两个主要问题:大型语义区域中存在奇怪的子结构,以及内容与语义掩码的不匹配。通过实证研究,我们确定了这些问题的根源在于训练数据分布与推理阶段应用的标准正态先验之间的不匹配。为了解决这一挑战,我们为SIS开发了特定的噪声先验,包括空间先验、类别先验以及创新性的空间-类别联合先验。这种方法我们命名为SCP-Diff,在Cityscapes、ADE20K和COCO-Stuff数据集上实现了SIS的新SOTA结果,其在Cityscapes上的FID低至10.53。代码和模型可通过项目页面访问。
abstract_en: Semantic image synthesis (SIS) shows good promises for sensor simulation. However, current best practices in this field, based on GANs, have not yet reached the desired level of quality. As latent diffusion models make significant strides in image generation, we are prompted to evaluate ControlNet, a notable method for its dense control capabilities. Our investigation uncovered two primary issues with its results: the presence of weird sub-structures within large semantic areas and the misalignment of content with the semantic mask. Through empirical study, we pinpointed the cause of these problems as a mismatch between the noised training data distribution and the standard normal prior applied at the inference stage. To address this challenge, we developed specific noise priors for SIS, encompassing spatial, categorical, and an innovative spatial-categorical joint prior for inference. This approach, which we have named SCP-Diff, has set new state-of-the-art results in SIS on Cityscapes, ADE20K and COCO-Stuff, yielding a FID as low as 10.53 on Cityscapes. The code and models can be accessed via the project page.

title: Huangbiao Xu, Xiao Ke*, Yuezhou Li, Rui Xu, Huanqi Wu, Xiaofeng Lin, Wenzhong Guo
title_en: Huangbiao Xu, Xiao Ke*, Yuezhou Li, Rui Xu, Huanqi Wu, Xiaofeng Lin, Wenzhong Guo
abstract: 动作质量评估(AQA)是一项具有挑战性的视觉任务,需要辨别和量化同一类别动作中的细微差异。尽管近期研究在创建细粒度标注以实现更精确分析方面取得了进展,但现有方法主要关注粗粒度动作分割,导致难以识别具有判别性的动作帧。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种面向动作质量评估的视觉-语言动作知识学习方法,并设计了一个多粒度对齐框架以理解不同层次的动作知识。在我们的框架中,通过CLIP将专业知识(如专业术语)嵌入到视频级、阶段级和帧级表示中。我们进一步提出了一种新的语义感知协同注意力模块,以防止混淆交互并保留跨模态和跨语义空间中的文本知识。具体而言,我们利用CLIP强大的跨模态知识,将文本语义嵌入到图像特征中,从而引导动作时空表示。我们的方法可以与现有AQA方法无缝集成,无论是否使用帧级标注。大量实验和消融研究表明,我们的方法在四个公开的短时和长时AQA基准数据集(FineDiving、MTL-AQA、JIGSAWS和Fis-V)上均达到最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Action quality assessment (AQA) is a challenging vision task that requires discerning and quantifying subtle differences in actions from the same class. While recent research has made strides in creating fine-grained annotations for more precise analysis, existing methods primarily focus on coarse action segmentation, leading to limited identification of discriminative action frames. To address this issue, we propose a Vision-Language Action Knowledge Learning approach for action quality assessment, along with a multi-grained alignment framework to understand different levels of action knowledge. In our framework, prior knowledge, such as specialized terminology, is embedded into video-level, stage-level, and frame-level representations via CLIP. We further propose a new semantic-aware collaborative attention module to prevent confusing interactions and preserve textual knowledge in cross-modal and cross-semantic spaces. Specifically, we leverage the powerful cross-modal knowledge of CLIP to embed textual semantics into image features, which then guide action spatial-temporal representations. Our approach can be plug-and-played with existing AQA methods, frame-wise annotations or not. Extensive experiments and ablation studies show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art on four public short and long-term AQA benchmarks: FineDiving, MTL-AQA, JIGSAWS, and Fis-V.

title: Huankang Guan, Rynson W.H. Lau*
title_en: Huankang Guan, Rynson W.H. Lau*
abstract: 显著物体排序(SOR)旨在研究人类观察者如何在场景中在不同物体间转移注意力。先前的工作尝试挖掘显式视觉显著性线索,如空间频率和语义上下文,以应对这一挑战。然而,这些视觉显著性线索可能在处理现实场景时存在不足,现实场景通常涉及多种人类活动和交互。我们观察到,人类观察者的注意力可以被场景中人物的姿态和手势所反射性引导,这些姿态和手势表明了他们的活动。例如,观察者倾向于转移注意力跟随他人的头部朝向或跑步/行走方向以预判接下来会发生什么。受此观察启发,我们提出利用人体姿态来理解人类参与者与其环境之间的高层交互,以实现稳健的显著物体排序。具体而言,我们提出PoseSOR,一个基于人体姿态的SOR模型,包含两个新颖模块:1)姿态感知交互(PAI)模块,将人体姿态知识整合到显著物体查询中以学习高层交互;2)姿态驱动排序(PDR)模块,将姿态知识作为方向线索以帮助预测人类注意力转移的位置。据我们所知,我们的方法是首个探索人体姿态用于显著物体排序的方案。大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性,特别是在复杂场景中,我们的模型在SOR基准测试中达到了新的最先进水平。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/guanhuankang/ECCV24PoseSOR获取。
abstract_en: Salient Object Ranking (SOR) aims to study how human observers shift their attention among various objects within a scene. Previous works attempt to excavate explicit visual saliency cues, , spatial frequency and semantic context, to tackle this challenge.
