However, these visual saliency cues may fall short in handling real-world scenarios, which often involve various human activities and interactions. We observe that human observers’ attention can be reflexively guided by the poses and gestures of the people in the scene, which indicate their activities. For example, observers tend to shift their attention to follow others’ head orientation or running/walking direction to anticipate what will happen. Inspired by this observation, we propose to exploit human poses in understanding high-level interactions between human participants and their surroundings for robust salient object ranking. Specifically, we propose PoseSOR, a human pose-aware SOR model for the SOR task, with two novel modules: 1) a Pose-Aware Interaction (PAI) module to integrate human pose knowledge into salient object queries for learning high-level interactions, and 2) a Pose-Driven Ranking (PDR) module to apply pose knowledge as directional cues to help predict where human attention will shift to. To our knowledge, our approach is the first to explore human pose for salient object ranking. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, particularly in complex scenes, and our model sets the new state-of-the-art on the SOR benchmarks. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/guanhuankang/ECCV24PoseSOR.

title: Hui Lu*, Albert Ali Salah, Ronald Poppe
title_en: Hui Lu*, Albert Ali Salah, Ronald Poppe
abstract: 扩散模型在图像生成中实现了卓越的质量,但以高昂的成本为代价。迭代去噪需要大量时间步长才能生成高保真度图像。去噪过程受到初始重建误差累积的严重限制,这种初始重建误差源于对目标数据的不准确重建,导致输出质量下降且收敛速度变慢。为解决这些问题,我们提出补偿采样方法,引导生成过程向目标域发展。我们引入了一个补偿项,该补偿项以U-Net实现,其训练开销可以忽略不计。我们的方法具有灵活性,并在基准数据集CIFAR-10、CelebA、CelebA-HQ、FFHQ-256和FSG上展示了其在无条件生成、人脸补全和人脸遮挡去除中的应用。我们的方法在图像质量方面始终达到最先进水平,同时将去噪过程的收敛速度在训练中提升了多达一个数量级。
abstract_en: Diffusion models achieve remarkable quality in image generation, but at a cost. Iterative denoising requires many time steps to produce high fidelity images. The denoising process is crucially limited by an accumulation of the reconstruction error due to an initial inaccurate reconstruction of the target data. This leads to lower quality outputs, and slower convergence. To address these issues, we propose compensation sampling to guide the generation towards the target domain. We introduce a compensation term, implemented as a U-Net, which adds negligible training overhead. Our approach is flexible and we demonstrate its application in unconditional generation, face inpainting, and face de-occlusion on benchmark datasets CIFAR-10, CelebA, CelebA-HQ, FFHQ-256, and FSG. Our approach consistently yields state-of-the-art results in terms of image quality, while accelerating the denoising process to converge during training by up to an order of magnitude.

title: Hui Zhang*, Sammy Christen, Zicong Fan, Otmar Hilliges, Jie Song
title_en: Hui Zhang*, Sammy Christen, Zicong Fan, Otmar Hilliges, Jie Song
abstract: 人类的手具有高度灵巧性,能够与多种物体进行交互,例如抓取物体的特定部分或从期望的方向接近物体。更重要的是,人类无需特定物体的技能即可抓取任何形状的物体。近期的研究工作通常基于单一目标(如期望的接近方向或抓取区域)合成抓取动作。此外,这些方法通常依赖昂贵的手-物体交互数据进行训练和推理,这限制了其大规模合成未见过物体抓取动作的能力。本文提出一种策略学习框架,统一生成跨多种运动目标、多样物体形状和灵巧手形态的手-物体抓取动作。目标包括可抓取区域、方向、手腕旋转和手部位置。无需任何手-物体交互数据,我们训练的策略在58个物体上能够稳健地为超过50万个未见过的物体合成多样化的抓取动作,成功率高达82.2%。同时,该策略遵循目标约束,使每个物体能够生成多样化的抓取方式。此外,我们展示了该框架可部署到不同灵巧手,并与重建或生成的物体协同工作。我们通过定量和定性评估验证了方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Human hands possess the dexterity to interact with diverse objects such as grasping specific parts of the objects and/or approaching them from desired directions. More importantly, humans can grasp objects of any shape without object-specific skills. Recent works synthesize grasping motions following single objectives such as a desired approach heading direction or a grasping area. Moreover, they usually rely on expensive hand-object data during training and inference, which limits their capability to synthesize grasping motions for unseen objects at scale. In this paper, we unify the generation of hand-object grasping motions across multiple motion objectives, diverse object shapes and dexterous hand morphologies in a policy learning framework . The objectives are composed of the graspable area, heading direction, wrist rotation, and hand position. Without requiring any hand-object interaction data, our policy trained with 58 objects can robustly synthesize diverse grasping motions for more than 500k unseen objects with a success rate of 82.2%. At the same time, the policy adheres to objectives, which enables the generation of diverse grasps per object. Moreover, we show that our framework can be deployed to different dexterous hands and work with reconstructed or generated objects. We quantitatively and qualitatively evaluate our method to show the efficacy of our approach.

title: Huilin Zhu, Jingling Yuan, Zhengwei Yang, Yu Guo, Xian Zhong*, Zheng Wang, Shengfeng He*
title_en: Huilin Zhu, Jingling Yuan, Zhengwei Yang, Yu Guo, Xian Zhong*, Zheng Wang, Shengfeng He*
abstract: 零样本物体计数(ZOC)旨在通过仅使用测试时物体类别的名称来对图像中的物体进行计数,而无需手动标注。然而,当前ZOC方法面临的关键挑战在于其无法有效识别高质量的示例。这一缺陷限制了其在多样化类别中的可扩展性,并阻碍了识别类别与图像内容之间强视觉关联的建立。为此,我们提出基于视觉关联的零样本物体计数(VA-Count)框架。VA-Count包含一个示例增强模块(EEM)和一个噪声抑制模块(NSM),二者协同优化类别示例识别过程,同时最小化错误物体识别的后果。EEM利用先进的视觉-语言预训练模型发现潜在示例,确保框架对各类别的适应性。同时,NSM通过对比学习区分最优与次优示例对,降低错误示例的负面影响。VA-Count在零样本场景中展示了其有效性和可扩展性,在两个物体计数数据集上表现出优越性能。
abstract_en: Zero-shot object counting (ZOC) aims to enumerate objects in images using only the names of object classes during testing, without the need for manual annotations. However, a critical challenge in current ZOC methods lies in their inability to identify high-quality exemplars effectively. This deficiency hampers scalability across diverse classes and undermines the development of strong visual associations between the identified classes and image content. To this end, we propose the Visual Association-based Zero-shot Object Counting (VA-Count) framework. VA-Count consists of an Exemplar Enhancement Module (EEM) and a Noise Suppression Module (NSM) that synergistically refine the process of class exemplar identification while minimizing the consequences of incorrect object identification. The EEM utilizes advanced vision-language pretaining models to discover potential exemplars, ensuring the framework’s adaptability to various classes. Meanwhile, the NSM employs contrastive learning to differentiate between optimal and suboptimal exemplar pairs, reducing the negative effects of erroneous exemplars. VA-Count demonstrates its effectiveness and scalability in zero-shot contexts with superior performance on two object counting datasets.

title: Huiqun Wang, Yiping Bao, Panwang Pan, Zeming Li, Xiao Liu, Ruijie Yang, Di Huang*
title_en: Huiqun Wang, Yiping Bao, Panwang Pan, Zeming Li, Xiao Liu, Ruijie Yang, Di Huang*
abstract: 近年来,针对三维点云的多模态预训练在通过对齐三维形状及其对应的二维图像和语言描述的异构特征方面取得了令人鼓舞的成果。然而,当前的简单解决方案往往忽视了样本之间的复杂结构关系,这可能限制了多模态学习的全部潜力。为了解决这一问题,我们引入了多模态关系蒸馏(MRD),这是一种三模态预训练框架,旨在有效将权威的大型视觉-语言模型(VLM)蒸馏到三维主干网络中。MRD旨在捕捉每种模态内部的关系以及不同模态之间的关系,并生成更具判别性的三维形状表示。值得注意的是,MRD在下游的零样本分类任务和跨模态检索任务中实现了显著改进,取得了新的最先进性能。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in multi-modal pre-training for 3D point clouds have demonstrated promising results by aligning heterogeneous features across 3D shapes and their corresponding 2D images and language descriptions. However, current straightforward solutions often overlook intricate structural relations among samples, potentially limiting the full capabilities of multi-modal learning. To address this issue, we introduce Multi-modal Relation Distillation (MRD), a tri-modal pre-training framework, which is designed to effectively distill reputable large Vision-Language Models (VLM) into 3D backbones. MRD aims to capture both intra-relations within each modality as well as cross-relations between different modalities and produce more discriminative 3D shape representations. Notably, MRD achieves significant improvements in downstream zero-shot classification tasks and cross-modality retrieval tasks, delivering new state-of-the-art performance.

title: 基于对抗训练的文档篡改定位方法
title_en: Huiru Shao, Zhuang Qian, Kaizhu Huang, Wei Wang, Xiaowei Huang, Qiufeng Wang*
abstract: 近年来文档伪造技术的进步产生了恶意且几乎无法视觉追踪的篡改,给文档篡改定位(DTL)带来了巨大挑战。尽管近期取得了显著进展,但对DTL中对抗鲁棒性的探索却极为有限。本文首次揭示了大多数现有DTL模型对对抗攻击的脆弱性,强调了DTL领域需要更多关注。为实现鲁棒的DTL,我们证明对抗训练可以提升模型的鲁棒性并有效防御对抗攻击。作为重要进展,我们进一步引入了一种潜在流形对抗训练方法,通过在对抗样本的潜在流形上引入扰动,而非仅依赖标签引导信息,从而增强DTL的对抗鲁棒性。在DTL基准数据集上的大量实验表明对抗训练的必要性,我们提出的基于流形的方法在白盒和黑盒攻击中显著提升了对抗鲁棒性。代码将发布在https://github.com/SHR-77/DTL-ARob.git。
abstract_en: Recent advances in document forgery techniques produce malicious yet nearly visually untraceable alterations, imposing a big challenge for document tampering localization (DTL). Despite significant recent progress, there has been surprisingly limited exploration of adversarial robustness in DTL. This paper presents the first effort to uncover the vulnerability of most existing DTL models to adversarial attacks, highlighting the need for greater attention within the DTL community. In pursuit of robust DTL, we demonstrate that adversarial training can promote the model’s robustness and effectively protect against adversarial attacks. As a notable advancement, we further introduce a latent manifold adversarial training approach that enhances adversarial robustness in DTL by incorporating perturbations on the latent manifold of adversarial examples, rather than exclusively relying on label-guided information. Extensive experiments on DTL benchmark datasets show the necessity of adversarial training and our proposed manifold-based method significantly improves the adversarial robustness on both white-box and black-box attacks. Codes will be available at https://github.com/SHR-77/DTL-ARob.git.

title: Huiyu Duan*, Xiongkuo Min, Sijing Wu, Wei Shen, Guangtao Zhai
title_en: Huiyu Duan*, Xiongkuo Min, Sijing Wu, Wei Shen, Guangtao Zhai
abstract: 图像处理,包括图像修复、图像增强等,涉及从退化输入生成高质量的干净图像。基于深度学习的方法在单任务条件下对各种图像处理任务表现出优越的性能。然而,它们需要为不同的退化类型和程度训练独立的模型,这限制了这些模型的泛化能力,并限制了其在现实世界中的应用。在本文中,我们提出了一种文本引导的统一图像处理器,用于低级视觉任务,称为UniProcessor,该处理器能够有效处理各种退化类型和程度,并支持多模态控制。具体而言,我们的UniProcessor通过交叉注意力将退化特定信息与主题提示编码,并通过操作提示处理退化。这些上下文控制特征通过交叉注意力注入到UniProcessor主干中,以控制处理过程。为了实现自动主题提示生成,我们进一步通过指令调优技术构建了一个通用的视觉-语言模型,用于低级退化感知。我们的UniProcessor涵盖30种退化类型,大量实验表明,我们的UniProcessor无需额外训练或调优即可很好地处理这些退化,并且优于其他竞争方法。此外,借助退化感知的上下文控制,我们的UniProcessor首次展示了处理具有多种退化的图像中单个失真能力。代码可在:https: //github.com/IntMeGroup/UniProcessor 获取。
abstract_en: Image processing, including image restoration, image enhancement, etc., involves generating a high-quality clean image from a degraded input. Deep learning-based methods have shown superior performance for various image processing tasks in terms of single-task conditions. However, they require to train separate models for different degradations and levels, which limits the generalization abilities of these models and restricts their applications in real-world. In this paper, we propose a text-induced Unified image Processor for low-level vision tasks, termed UniProcessor, which can effectively process various degradation types and levels, and support multimodal control. Specifically, our UniProcessor encodes degradation-specific information with the subject prompt and process degradations with the manipulation prompt. These context control features are injected into the UniProcessor backbone via cross-attention to control the processing procedure. For automatic subject-prompt generation, we further build a vision-language model for general-purpose low-level degradation perception via instruction tuning techniques. Our UniProcessor covers 30 degradation types, and extensive experiments demonstrate that our UniProcessor can well process these degradations without additional training or tuning and outperforms other competing methods. Moreover, with the help of degradation-aware context control, our UniProcessor first shows the ability to individually handle a single distortion in an image with multiple degradations. Code is available at: https: //github.com/IntMeGroup/UniProcessor.

title: Hulin Li*
title_en: Hulin Li*
abstract: 多头检测器通常采用特征融合金字塔颈部结构进行多尺度检测,并在工业界广泛应用。然而,这种方案在不同层级特征金字塔的表示被强制点对点融合时面临特征错位问题。为解决这一问题,我们设计了独立层次金字塔(IHP)架构,以评估特征未融合金字塔颈部结构对多头检测器的有效性。随后,我们引入了带有权重下采样因子的软最近邻插值(SNI),以减轻不同层级特征融合的影响同时保留关键纹理。此外,我们提出了一种在扩展空间窗口(ESD)中进行特征自适应选择的方法,以保留空间特征并增强轻量级卷积技术(GSConvE)。这些进展最终形成了我们的二次特征对齐方案(SA)用于实时检测,在Pascal VOC和MS COCO数据集上取得了最先进的结果。代码将发布于https://github.com/AlanLi1997/rethinking-fpn。
abstract_en: Multi-head detectors typically employ a features-fused-pyramid-neck for multi-scale detection and are widely adopted in the industry. However, this approach faces feature misalignment when representations from different hierarchical levels of the feature pyramid are forcibly fused point-to-point. To address this issue, we designed an independent hierarchy pyramid (IHP) architecture to evaluate the effectiveness of the features-unfused-pyramid-neck for multi-head detectors. Subsequently, we introduced soft nearest neighbor interpolation (SNI) with a weight-downscaling factor to mitigate the impact of feature fusion at different hierarchies while preserving key textures. Furthermore, we present a feature adaptive selection method for downsampling in extended spatial windows (ESD) to retain spatial features and enhance lightweight convolutional techniques (GSConvE). These advancements culminate in our secondary features alignment solution (SA) for real-time detection, achieving state-of-the-art results on Pascal VOC and MS COCO. Code will be released at https://github.com/AlanLi1997/rethinking-fpn.

title: Hunmin Yang, Jongoh Jeong, Kuk-Jin Yoon*
title_en: Hunmin Yang, Jongoh Jeong, Kuk-Jin Yoon*
abstract: 近年来,视觉-语言基础模型(如CLIP)在学习可迁移至多样化下游任务和领域的表示能力方面表现出色。随着这类强大模型的出现,有效利用其能力解决具有挑战性的视觉任务变得至关重要。另一方面,仅有少数研究关注于设计能够迁移至未知领域和模型架构的对抗样本。在本文中,我们提出了一种名为PDCL-Attack的新颖迁移攻击方法,该方法利用CLIP模型增强基于生成模型攻击框架生成的对抗扰动的可迁移性。具体而言,我们通过利用文本的语义表示能力,特别是输入图像真实类别标签的语义信息,构建了有效的提示驱动特征引导机制。据我们所知,我们首次将提示学习引入以增强可迁移生成攻击。在多种跨领域和跨模型设置下进行的大量实验实证验证了我们的方法,结果表明其优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Recent vision-language foundation models, such as CLIP, have demonstrated superior capabilities in learning representations that can be transferable across diverse range of downstream tasks and domains. With the emergence of such powerful models, it has become crucial to effectively leverage their capabilities in tackling challenging vision tasks. On the other hand, only a few works have focused on devising adversarial examples that transfer well to both unknown domains and model architectures. In this paper, we propose a novel transfer attack method called PDCL-Attack, which leverages the CLIP model to enhance the transferability of adversarial perturbations generated by a generative model-based attack framework. Specifically, we formulate an effective prompt-driven feature guidance by harnessing the semantic representation power of text, particularly from the ground-truth class labels of input images. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to introduce prompt learning to enhance the transferable generative attacks. Extensive experiments conducted across various cross-domain and cross-model settings empirically validate our approach, demonstrating its superiority over state-of-the-art methods.

title: Hussain Sajwani, Dimitrios Makris, Yahya Prof. Zweiri, Fariborz Baghaei Naeini, Sanket Mr Kachole*
title_en: Hussain Sajwani, Dimitrios Makris, Yahya Prof. Zweiri, Fariborz Baghaei Naeini, Sanket Mr Kachole*
abstract: 脉冲神经网络(SNNs)提供了一种生物启发的计算机视觉方法,能够以更低的能耗实现对视觉数据更高效的处理。然而,在SNNs中维持稳态具有挑战性,因为需要持续调整神经响应以保持平衡和最优处理效率,以应对多样且常常不可预测的输入信号。为应对这些挑战,我们提出了异步生物可实现神经元(ABN),这是一种动态脉冲发放机制,能够以简单而强大的方式自动适应输入信号的变化。其参数包括膜梯度(MG)、阈值回顾梯度(TRG)和脉冲效率(SE),使其在易于实现、显著效果和已证实的能耗降低方面表现出色,这是我们在实验中展示的关键创新。在多个数据集上的全面评估表明,ABN在图像分类和分割、神经平衡维持和能效方面表现出增强的性能。
abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer a biologically inspired approach to computer vision that can lead to more efficient processing of visual data with reduced energy consumption. However, maintaining homeostasis within SNNs is challenging, as it requires continuous adjustment of neural responses to preserve equilibrium and optimal processing efficiency amidst diverse and often unpredictable input signals. In response to these challenges, we propose the Asynchronous Bioplausible Neuron (ABN), a dynamic spike firing mechanism that offers a simple yet potent auto-adjustment to variations in input signals. Its parameters, Membrane Gradient (MG), Threshold Retrospective Gradient (TRG), and Spike Efficiency (SE), make it stand out for its easy implementation, significant effectiveness, and proven reduction in power consumption, a key innovation demonstrated in our experiments. Comprehensive evaluation across various datasets demonstrates ABN’s enhanced performance in image classification and segmentation, maintenance of neural equilibrium, and energy efficiency.

title: Huy Phan*, Jinqi Xiao, Yang Sui, Tianfang Zhang, Zijie Tang, Cong Shi, Yan Wang, Yingying Chen, Bo Yuan
title_en: Huy Phan*, Jinqi Xiao, Yang Sui, Tianfang Zhang, Zijie Tang, Cong Shi, Yan Wang, Yingying Chen, Bo Yuan
abstract: 深度神经网络(DNNs)已广泛部署在现实世界的关键任务应用中,需要有效的方法来保护深度学习模型免受恶意攻击。受后门攻击高隐蔽性和潜在危害的启发,已提出一系列针对DNNs的后门防御方法。然而,大多数现有方法需要访问干净的训练数据,限制了其实际应用。此外,最先进的(SOTA)解决方案无法在无需数据的方式下同时提升模型的鲁棒性和紧凑性,这对于资源受限的应用至关重要。为解决这些挑战,本文提出了一种高效的无数据后门防御机制Clean & Compact(C&C),能够对原始感染的DNNs实现净化和紧凑化。基于对触发模式的秩级敏感性,C&C共同探索并实现高模型清洁度和效率,无需训练数据,使该方案在许多现实世界、资源受限场景中极具吸引力。在不同设置下的广泛评估一致表明,我们的方法优于现有的SOTA后门防御方法。
abstract_en: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have been widely deployed in real-world, mission-critical applications, necessitating effective approaches to protect deep learning models against malicious attacks. Motivated by the high stealthiness and potential harm of backdoor attacks, a series of backdoor defense methods for DNNs have been proposed. However, most existing approaches require access to clean training data, hindering their practical use. Additionally, state-of-the-art (SOTA) solutions cannot simultaneously enhance model robustness and compactness in a data-free manner, which is crucial in resource-constrained applications. To address these challenges, in this paper, we propose Clean & Compact (C&C), an efficient data-free backdoor defense mechanism that can bring both purification and compactness to the original infected DNNs. Built upon the intriguing rank-level sensitivity to trigger patterns, C&C co-explores and achieves high model cleanliness and efficiency without the need for training data, making this solution very attractive in many real-world, resource-limited scenarios. Extensive evaluations across different settings consistently demonstrate that our proposed approach outperforms SOTA backdoor defense methods.

title: Hyejin Park, Dongbo Min*
title_en: Hyejin Park, Dongbo Min*
abstract: 在对抗蒸馏(Adversarial Distillation, AD)领域,从具有对抗鲁棒性的教师模型向鲁棒性较弱的学生模型进行战略性和精确的知识迁移至关重要。我们的动态引导对抗蒸馏(Dynamic Guidance Adversarial Distillation, DGAD)框架直接应对差异样本重要性问题,重点关注纠正教师模型的误分类。DGAD采用误分类感知分区(Misclassification-Aware Partitioning, MAP)动态调整蒸馏重点,通过引导至最可靠的教师预测来优化学习过程。此外,我们的纠错标签交换(Error-corrective Label Swapping, ELS)可纠正教师模型在干净输入和对抗性扰动输入上的误分类,提升知识迁移的质量。进一步地,预测一致性正则化(Predictive Consistency Regularization, PCR)确保学生模型在干净输入和对抗性输入上均能保持一致性能,显著增强其整体鲁棒性。通过整合这些方法,DGAD显著提升了干净数据的准确率,并强化了模型对复杂对抗威胁的防御能力。我们在CIFAR10、CIFAR100和Tiny ImageNet数据集上进行的实验验证(采用多种模型架构)证明了DGAD的有效性,确立其作为增强对抗环境下学生模型鲁棒性与准确性的有前景方法。代码已开源至https://github.com/kunsaram01/DGAD。
abstract_en: In the realm of Adversarial Distillation (AD), strategic and precise knowledge transfer from an adversarially robust teacher model to a less robust student model is paramount. Our Dynamic Guidance Adversarial Distillation (DGAD) framework directly tackles the challenge of differential sample importance, with a keen focus on rectifying the teacher model’s misclassifications. DGAD employs Misclassification-Aware Partitioning (MAP) to dynamically tailor the distillation focus, optimizing the learning process by steering towards the most reliable teacher predictions. Additionally, our Error-corrective Label Swapping (ELS) corrects misclassifications of the teacher on both clean and adversarially perturbed inputs, refining the quality of knowledge transfer. Further, Predictive Consistency Regularization (PCR) guarantees consistent performance of the student model across both clean and adversarial inputs, significantly enhancing its overall robustness. By integrating these methodologies, DGAD significantly improves upon the accuracy of clean data and fortifies the model’s defenses against sophisticated adversarial threats. Our experimental validation on CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and Tiny ImageNet datasets, employing various model architectures, demonstrates the efficacy of DGAD, establishing it as a promising approach for enhancing both the robustness and accuracy of student models in adversarial settings. The code is available at https://github.com/kunsaram01/DGAD.

title_en: Hyeongseok Jeon, Sanmin Kim, Abi Rahman Syamil, Junsoo Kim, Dongsuk Kum*
abstract_en: Predicting the maneuvers of surrounding vehicles is imperative for the safe navigation of autonomous vehicles. However, naturalistic driving datasets tend to be highly imbalanced, with a bias towards the ”going straight” maneuver. Consequently, learning and accurately predicting turning maneuvers pose significant challenges. In this study, we propose a novel two-stage maneuver learning method that can overcome such strong biases by leveraging two heterogeneous datasets in a complementary manner. In the first training phase, we utilize an intersection-centric dataset characterized by balanced distribution of maneuver classes to learn the representations of each maneuver. Subsequently, in the second training phase, we incorporate an ego-centric driving dataset to account for various geometrical road shapes, by transferring the knowledge of geometric diversity to the maneuver prediction model. To facilitate this, we constructed an in-house intersection-centric trajectory dataset with a well-balanced maneuver distribution. By harnessing the power of heterogeneous datasets, our framework significantly improves maneuver prediction performance, particularly for minority maneuver classes such as turning maneuvers. The dataset is available at https: //github.com/KAIST-VDCLab/VDC-Trajectory-Dataset.

title: Jeong Hyeonho, Chang Jinho, Park Geon Yeong, Ye Jong Chul
title_en: Hyeonho Jeong, Jinho Chang, Geon Yeong Park, Jong Chul Ye*
abstract: 基于文本驱动的扩散视频编辑面临图像编辑文献中未出现的独特挑战:建立现实世界运动。与现有视频编辑方法不同,我们专注于分数蒸馏采样以绕过标准逆扩散过程,并从已展现自然运动的视频开始优化。我们的分析表明,虽然视频分数蒸馏可以有效引入目标文本指示的新内容,但也可能导致显著的结构和运动偏差。为应对这一问题,我们提出在分数蒸馏过程中匹配原始视频与编辑视频的时空自相似性。得益于分数蒸馏的使用,我们的方法是模型无关的,可应用于级联和非级联视频扩散框架。通过与领先方法的广泛比较,我们的方法在改变外观的同时,能够准确保留原始结构和运动。
abstract_en: Text-driven diffusion-based video editing presents a unique challenge not encountered in image editing literature: establishing real-world motion. Unlike existing video editing approaches, here we focus on score distillation sampling to circumvent the standard reverse diffusion process and initiate optimization from videos that already exhibit natural motion. Our analysis reveals that while video score distillation can effectively introduce new content indicated by target text, it can also cause significant structure and motion deviation. To counteract this, we propose to match the space-time self-similarities of the original video and the edited video during the score distillation. Thanks to the use of score distillation, our approach is model-agnostic, which can be applied for both cascaded and non-cascaded video diffusion frameworks. Through extensive comparisons with leading methods, our approach demonstrates its superiority in altering appearances while accurately preserving the original structure and motion.

title: Hyeonseong Kim, Sung-Hoon Yoon, Minseok Kim, Kuk-Jin Yoon*
title_en: Hyeonseong Kim, Sung-Hoon Yoon, Minseok Kim, Kuk-Jin Yoon*
abstract: 激光雷达语义分割对于自动驾驶中理解周围环境非常重要。现有方法假设封闭集场景,训练和测试标签空间相同。然而,在现实世界中,测试过程中可能出现训练时未遇到的未知类别,使得现有方法难以应用。本文提出了一种新颖的实时类别发现方法用于激光雷达语义分割,旨在测试时即时分类和分割未知和已知类别,仅通过训练时学习已知类别实现。为了在归纳设置中嵌入即时分割能力,我们采用基于哈希编码的模型,具有可扩展的预测空间作为基线。在此基础上,提出双原型学习以增强已知类别的识别,减少对类内方差的敏感性。此外,我们提出了一种基于表示混合的新颖混合类别学习框架,以提高未知类别的发现能力。所提出的混合框架有效建模了分布外表示,并在训练期间学习语义分组,同时区分分布内表示。在SemanticKITTI和SemanticPOSS数据集上的大量实验表明,所提出的方法优于基线方法。代码可在https://github.com/hskim617/OCDSS获取。
abstract_en: LiDAR semantic segmentation is important for understanding the surrounding environment in autonomous driving. Existing methods assume closed-set situations with the same training and testing label space. However, in the real world, unknown classes not encountered during training may appear during testing, making it difficult to apply existing methodologies. In this paper, we propose a novel on-the-fly category discovery method for LiDAR semantic segmentation, aiming to classify and segment both unknown and known classes instantaneously during test time, achieved solely by learning with known classes in training. To embed instant segmentation capability in an inductive setting, we adopt a hash coding-based model with an expandable prediction space as a baseline. Based on this, dual prototypical learning is proposed to enhance the recognition of the known classes by reducing the sensitivity to intra-class variance. Additionally, we propose a novel mixing-based category learning framework based on representation mixing to improve the discovery capability of unknown classes. The proposed mixing-based framework effectively models out-of-distribution representations and learns to semantically group them during training while distinguishing them from in-distribution representations. Extensive experiments on SemanticKITTI and SemanticPOSS datasets demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method compared to the baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/ hskim617/OCDSS.

title: Hyeonwoo Kim, Sookwan Han, Patrick Kwon, Hanbyul Joo*
title_en: Hyeonwoo Kim, Sookwan Han, Patrick Kwon, Hanbyul Joo*
abstract: 理解人类在与特定环境交互时所蕴含的内在知识(例如,可供性)对于提升AI以更好地辅助人类至关重要。尽管现有方法主要关注交互中的物体接触,但这种可供性表示无法充分涵盖人-物交互(HOIs)的其他重要方面,即相对位置和方向的模式。本文提出了一种新的可供性表示方法,称为全面可供性(ComA)。给定一个三维物体网格,ComA建模了交互人体网格中顶点的相对方向和接近度分布,捕捉合理的接触模式、相对方向和空间关系。为构建该分布,我们提出了一种新颖的流程,可基于任意三维目标物体网格合成多样且逼真的三维HOI样本。该流程利用预训练的二维修复扩散模型,从物体渲染图像生成HOI图像,并将其提升至三维空间。为避免生成虚假的可供性,我们提出了一种新的修复框架——自适应掩码修复。由于ComA基于合成样本构建,因此可以无限制地扩展到任何物体。通过大量实验,我们证明ComA在建模基于接触的可供性方面优于依赖人类标注的竞争对手。重要的是,我们还通过优化框架展示了ComA在三维重建人-物交互的潜力,突显其在结合接触与非接触属性方面的优势。
abstract_en: Understanding the inherent human knowledge in interacting with a given environment (e.g., affordance) is essential for improving AI to better assist humans. While existing approaches primarily focus on human-object contacts during interactions, such affordance representation cannot fully address other important aspects of human-object interactions (HOIs), i.e. patterns of relative positions and orientations. In this paper, we introduce a novel affordance representation, named Comprehensive Affordance (ComA). Given a 3D object mesh, ComA models the distribution of relative orientation and proximity of vertices in interacting human meshes, capturing plausible patterns of contact, relative orientations, and spatial relationships. To construct the distribution, we present a novel pipeline that synthesizes diverse and realistic 3D HOI samples given any 3D target object mesh. The pipeline leverages a pre-trained 2D inpainting diffusion model to generate HOI images from object renderings and lifts them into 3D. To avoid the generation of false affordances, we propose a new inpainting framework, Adaptive Mask Inpainting. Since ComA is built on synthetic samples, it can extend to any object in an unbounded manner. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that ComA outperforms competitors that rely on human annotations in modeling contact-based affordance. Importantly, we also showcase the potential of ComA to reconstruct human-object interactions in 3D through an optimization framework, highlighting its advantage in incorporating both contact and non-contact properties.

title: Hyesong Choi, Hunsang Lee, Seyoung Joung, Hyejin Park, Jiyeong Kim, Dongbo Min*
title_en: Hyesong Choi, Hunsang Lee, Seyoung Joung, Hyejin Park, Jiyeong Kim, Dongbo Min*
abstract: 受掩码语言建模(MLM)成功驱动,计算机视觉领域的自监督学习因掩码图像建模(MIM)在推动近期突破中的核心作用而焕发出新的活力。尽管MIM在各种下游任务中取得了显著成果,但其整体效率偶尔受到预训练阶段漫长时长的阻碍。本文提出一种视角,即通过优化掩码标记来解决这一普遍问题。首先,我们深入探讨了掩码标记应具备的固有属性。在这些属性中,我们主要致力于阐述和强调掩码标记固有的“数据独特性”属性。通过全面分析预训练模型中掩码标记与可见标记之间的异质性,我们提出了一种新型方法,称为掩码标记优化(MTO),专门设计用于通过权重重校准和增强掩码标记的关键属性来提升模型效率。所提出的方法是一种可适配的解决方案,能够无缝集成到任何利用掩码标记的MIM方法中。因此,MTO在预训练效率方面取得了显著提升,使实现近期方法收敛性能所需的预训练轮次减少了约50%。代码可在https://github.com/doihye/MTO获取。
abstract_en: Driven by the success of Masked Language Modeling (MLM), the realm of self-supervised learning for computer vision has been invigorated by the central role of Masked Image Modeling (MIM) in driving recent breakthroughs. Notwithstanding the achievements of MIM across various downstream tasks, its overall efficiency is occasionally hampered by the lengthy duration of the pre-training phase. This paper presents a perspective that the optimization of masked tokens as a means of addressing the prevailing issue. Initially, we delve into an exploration of the inherent properties that a masked token ought to possess. Within the properties, we principally dedicated to articulating and emphasizing the ‘data distinctiveness’ attribute inherent in masked tokens. Through a comprehensive analysis of the heterogeneity between masked tokens and visible tokens within pre-trained models, we propose a novel approach termed masked token optimization (MTO), specifically designed to improve model efficiency through weight recalibration and the enhancement of the key property of masked tokens. The proposed method serves as an adaptable solution that seamlessly integrates into any MIM approach that leverages masked tokens. As a result, MTO achieves a considerable improvement in pre-training efficiency, resulting in an approximately 50% reduction in pre-training epochs required to attain converged performance of the recent approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/doihye/MTO.

title: Hyesong Choi, Hyejin Park, Kwang Moo Yi, Sungmin Cha, Dongbo Min*
title_en: Hyesong Choi, Hyejin Park, Kwang Moo Yi, Sungmin Cha, Dongbo Min*
abstract: 本文介绍了基于显著性的自适应掩码(Saliency-Based Adaptive Masking, SBAM),这是一种新颖且成本效益高的方法,通过优先考虑标记显著性显著提升掩码图像建模(Masked Image Modeling, MIM)方法的预训练性能。我们的方法对掩码比例变化具有鲁棒性,有效缓解了现有方法中常见的性能不稳定问题。这降低了基于掩码的预训练对掩码比例的敏感性,从而允许我们提出一种自适应策略,为每个数据样本定制特定的掩码比例,这是现有方法无法实现的。为此,我们提出了一种自适应掩码比例(Adaptive Masking Ratio, AMR)策略,根据标记显著性动态调整每张图像独特内容的掩码比例。我们在ImageNet-1K数据集上展示了该方法在基于掩码的预训练中显著优于现有技术。代码和模型参数可在https://github.com/doihye/SBAM获取。
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce Saliency-Based Adaptive Masking (SBAM), a novel and cost-effective approach that significantly enhances the pre-training performance of Masked Image Modeling (MIM) approaches by prioritizing token salience. Our method provides robustness against variations in masking ratios, effectively mitigating the performance instability issues common in existing methods. This relaxes the sensitivity of MIM-based pre-training to masking ratios, which in turn allows us to propose an adaptive strategy for ‘tailored’ masking ratios for each data sample, which no existing method can provide. Toward this goal, we propose an Adaptive Masking Ratio (AMR) strategy that dynamically adjusts the proportion of masking for the unique content of each image based on token salience. We show that our method significantly improves over the state-of-the-art in mask-based pre-training on the ImageNet-1K dataset. Code and model parameters are available at https://github.com/doihye/ SBAM.

title: Hyogon Ryu, Seohyun Lim, Hyunjung Shim*
title_en: Hyogon Ryu, Seohyun Lim, Hyunjung Shim*
abstract: 十亿参数扩散模型(如Stable Diffusion XL、Imagen和DALL-E 3)的出现显著推动了生成式AI领域的发展。然而,其大规模架构由于高资源需求和缓慢的推理速度,在微调和部署过程中面临挑战。本文探索了尚未被充分研究但前景广阔的量化扩散模型微调领域。我们的分析表明,基线方法忽略了微调扩散模型时模型权重的差异模式以及不同时间步长中的角色差异。为解决这些局限性,我们提出了一种专门针对量化扩散模型的新型内存高效微调方法,命名为TuneQDM。我们的方法将量化尺度作为可分离函数,以考虑通道间的权重模式,随后以时间步长为单位优化这些尺度,以有效反映每个时间步长的作用。TuneQDM在保持与全精度模型相当性能的同时,显著提升了内存效率。实验结果表明,我们的方法在单/多主体生成任务中均优于基线方法,展现出与全精度模型相当的主体保真度和提示保真度。
abstract_en: The emergence of billion-parameter diffusion models such as Stable Diffusion XL, Imagen, and DALL-E 3 has significantly propelled the domain of generative AI. However, their large-scale architecture presents challenges in fine-tuning and deployment due to high resource demands and slow inference speed. This paper explores the relatively unexplored yet promising realm of fine-tuning quantized diffusion models. Our analysis revealed that the baseline neglects the distinct patterns in model weights and the different roles throughout time steps when finetuning the diffusion model. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel memory-efficient fine-tuning method specifically designed for quantized diffusion models, dubbed TuneQDM. Our approach introduces quantization scales as separable functions to consider inter-channel weight patterns. Then, it optimizes these scales in a timestep-specific manner for effective reflection of the role of each time step. TuneQDM achieves performance on par with its full-precision counterpart while simultaneously offering significant memory efficiency. Experimental results demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms the baseline in both single-/multi-subject generations, exhibiting high subject fidelity and prompt fidelity comparable to the full precision model.

title: Hyolim Kang, Jeongseok Hyun, Joungbin An, Youngjae Yu, Seon Joo Kim*
title_en: Hyolim Kang, Jeongseok Hyun, Joungbin An, Youngjae Yu, Seon Joo Kim*
abstract: 在线时序动作定位(On-TAL)是一项关键任务,旨在在动作结束时即时识别未剪辑流视频中的动作实例——这是从基于帧的在线动作检测(OAD)的重大飞跃。然而,检测重叠动作的挑战往往被忽视,尽管这在流视频中是常见场景。当前能够处理并发动作的方法严重依赖于类别信息,限制了其灵活性。本文引入了ActionSwitch,这是首个无类别依赖的On-TAL框架,能够检测重叠动作。通过消除对类别信息的依赖,ActionSwitch为各种情况提供了更广泛的应用,包括同一类别的重叠动作或类别信息不可用的场景。该方法通过提出的“保守性损失”进行补充,该损失函数直接将保守决策原则嵌入到On-TAL中。我们的ActionSwitch在复杂数据集上实现了最先进的性能,包括针对具有挑战性的第一视角视图的Epic-Kitchens 100数据集和包含细粒度动作的FineAction数据集。
abstract_en: Online Temporal Action Localization (On-TAL) is a critical task that aims to instantaneously identify action instances in untrimmed streaming videos as soon as an action concludes—a major leap from frame-based Online Action Detection (OAD). Yet, the challenge of detecting overlapping actions is often overlooked even though it is a common scenario in streaming videos. Current methods that can address concurrent actions depend heavily on class information, limiting their flexibility. This paper introduces ActionSwitch, the first class-agnostic On-TAL framework capable of detecting overlapping actions. By obviating the reliance on class information, ActionSwitch provides wider applicability to various situations, including overlapping actions of the same class or scenarios where class information is unavailable. This approach is complemented by the proposed “conservativeness loss”, which directly embeds a conservative decision-making principle into the loss function for On-TAL. Our ActionSwitch achieves state-of-the-art performance in complex datasets, including Epic-Kitchens 100 targeting the challenging egocentric view and FineAction consisting of fine-grained actions.

title: Hyun Seok Seong, WonJun Moon, SuBeen Lee, Jae-Pil Heo*
title_en: Hyun Seok Seong, WonJun Moon, SuBeen Lee, Jae-Pil Heo*
abstract: 劳动密集型标注对于语义分割的推动催生了无监督语义分割方法的出现。近期研究利用基于图像级自监督预训练模型特征的块级对比学习。然而,仅依赖图像级预训练模型的相似性监督往往因块级语义表示不足而产生不可靠的指导。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种渐进式代理锚点传播(PPAP)策略。该方法通过将代理锚点迁移至语义相似样本密集区域,逐步识别出更可信的正样本。具体而言,我们首先建立紧密边界以在每个锚点周围收集少量可靠的正样本。随后,考虑正样本分布,我们将代理锚点迁移至正样本浓度更高的区域,并根据代理锚点的传播程度调整正样本边界。此外,为应对正负样本可能共存的模糊区域,我们引入了实例级模糊区域。这些区域内的样本被排除在负样本集之外,进一步提升了负样本集的可靠性。我们在多个数据集上的最先进性能验证了所提方法在无监督语义分割中的有效性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/hynnsk/PPAP获取。
abstract_en: The labor-intensive labeling for semantic segmentation has spurred the emergence of Unsupervised Semantic Segmentation. Recent studies utilize patch-wise contrastive learning based on features from image-level self-supervised pretrained models. However, relying solely on similarity-based supervision from image-level pretrained models often leads to unreliable guidance due to insufficient patch-level semantic representations. To address this, we propose a Progressive Proxy Anchor Propagation (PPAP) strategy. This method gradually identifies more trustworthy positives for each anchor by relocating its proxy to regions densely populated with semantically similar samples. Specifically, we initially establish a tight boundary to gather a few reliable positive samples around each anchor. Then, considering the distribution of positive samples, we relocate the proxy anchor towards areas with a higher concentration of positives and adjust the positiveness boundary based on the propagation degree of the proxy anchor. Moreover, to account for ambiguous regions where positive and negative samples may coexist near the positiveness boundary, we introduce an instance-wise ambiguous zone. Samples within these zones are excluded from the negative set, further enhancing the reliability of the negative set. Our state-of-the-art performances on various datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed method for Unsupervised Semantic Segmentation. Our code is available at https://github.com/hynnsk/PPAP.

title: Hyunbo Shim, In Cho, Daekyu Kwon, Seon Joo Kim*
title_en: Hyunbo Shim, In Cho, Daekyu Kwon, Seon Joo Kim*
abstract: 本文提出了一种基于优化的非视线成像(NLOS)新方法,旨在在一般设置下以显著减少重建时间的方式重建隐藏场景。在NLOS成像中,目标物体的可见表面明显稀疏。为减少空区域带来的不必要的计算,我们设计了一种方法,通过从隐藏空间中连续采样的点集进行部分传播来渲染瞬态。我们的方法能够利用表面法线准确且高效地建模视图依赖的反射率,从而获得表面几何形状以及反照率。在该流程中,我们提出了一种新的域缩减策略,以消除空区域中的冗余计算。在优化过程中,我们的域缩减过程定期以粗到细的方式从采样域中修剪空区域,从而显著提高了效率。我们在各种稀疏扫描模式的NLOS场景中展示了该方法的有效性。在合成数据和真实世界数据上的实验支持了该方法在一般NLOS场景中的有效性,以及与先前基于优化的解决方案相比的改进效率。我们的代码可在https://github.com/hyunbo9/domain-reduction-strategy获取。
abstract_en: This paper presents a novel optimization-based method for non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging that aims to reconstruct hidden scenes under general setups with significantly reduced reconstruction time. In NLOS imaging, the visible surfaces of the target objects are notably sparse. To mitigate unnecessary computations arising from empty regions, we design our method to render the transients through partial propagations from a continuously sampled set of points from the hidden space. Our method is capable of accurately and efficiently modeling the view-dependent reflectance using surface normals, which enables us to obtain surface geometry as well as albedo. In this pipeline, we propose a novel domain reduction strategy to eliminate superfluous computations in empty regions. During the optimization process, our domain reduction procedure periodically prunes the empty regions from our sampling domain in a coarse-to-fine manner, leading to substantial improvement in efficiency. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in various NLOS scenarios with sparse scanning patterns. Experiments conducted on both synthetic and real-world data support the efficacy in general NLOS scenarios, and the improved efficiency of our method compared to the previous optimization-based solutions. Our code is available at https://github.com/hyunbo9/domain-reduction-strategy.

title: HyungJune Lee*, JinYi Yoon
title_en: HyungJune Lee*, JinYi Yoon
abstract: 随着边缘智能的爆发,利用联邦间接知识对于提升个体学习者的任务变得至关重要。然而,传统的知识重用方法常常导致灾难性遗忘问题。在本文中,我们重新审视了在边缘智能背景下持续学习的概念,并解决知识迁移问题以增强联邦持续学习。由于每个学习者处理私有异构数据,我们提出Pick-a-back,这是一种通过选择性重用具有相似行为模式的外部知识的设备间知识联邦框架。通过借用间接经验,边缘设备可以从有用的知识中启动学习,从而实现更快且更通用的知识获取。通过在轻量级架构上使用包含各种数据集的持续任务,我们验证了Pick-a-back通过选择性知识联邦提供了高达8.0%的推理性能提升。我们的代码可在https://github.com/jinyi-yoon/Pick-a-back.git获取。
abstract_en: With the explosion of edge intelligence, leveraging federated indirect knowledge has become crucial for boosting the tasks of individual learners. However, the conventional approach to knowledge reuse often leads to catastrophic forgetting issues. In this paper, we revisit the concept of continual learning in the context of edge intelligence and address the knowledge transfer problem to enhance federated continual learning. Since each learner processes private heterogeneous data, we propose Pick-a-back, a device-to-device knowledge federation framework by selectively reusing the external knowledge with similar behavioral patterns. By borrowing indirect experiences, an edge device can initiate learning from useful knowledge and thus achieve faster yet more generalized knowledge acquisition. Using continual tasks consisting of various datasets on lightweight architectures, we have validated that Pick-a-back provides a significant inference improvement of up to 8.0% via selective knowledge federation. Our codes are available at https://github.com/jinyi-yoon/Pick-a-back.git.

title: Hyungjin Chung, Jong Chul Ye*
title_en: Hyungjin Chung, Jong Chul Ye*
abstract: 近年来,利用生成扩散先验的逆问题求解器因其卓越的质量而受到广泛关注。然而,当训练分布与测试分布存在差异时,需要对先验进行适应。在本工作中,我们提出了深度扩散图像先验(DDIP),通过引入与深度图像先验的正式联系,扩展了最近的SCD [?] 适应方法。在此框架下,我们提出了一种高效的适应方法,称为D3IP,专门针对3D测量数据,它在保持优异性能的同时,将DDIP的计算速度提升了多个数量级。D3IP实现了3D逆求解器的无缝集成,从而实现了连贯的3D重建。此外,我们展示了元学习技术也可以应用于进一步提升性能。我们证明,我们的方法能够仅通过与训练集差异极大的幻影图像训练的生成先验,解决多样化的3D重建任务,这为即使在无法使用金标准数据训练时,也开辟了应用扩散逆求解器的新机遇。代码:https://github.com/HJ-harry/DDIP3D
abstract_en: Recent inverse problem solvers that leverage generative diffusion priors have garnered significant attention due to their exceptional quality. However, adaptation of the prior is necessary when there exists a discrepancy between the training and testing distributions. In this work, we propose deep diffusion image prior (DDIP), which generalizes the recent adaptation method of SCD [?] by introducing a formal connection to the deep image prior. Under this framework, we propose an efficient adaptation method dubbed D3IP, specified for 3D measurements, which accelerates DDIP by orders of magnitude while achieving superior performance. D3IP enables seamless integration of 3D inverse solvers and thus leads to coherent 3D reconstruction. Moreover, we show that meta-learning techniques can also be applied to yield even better performance. We show that our method is capable of solving diverse 3D reconstructive tasks from the generative prior trained only with phantom images that are vastly different from the training set, opening up new opportunities of applying diffusion inverse solvers even when training with gold standard data is impossible. Code: https://github.com/HJ-harry/ DDIP3D

title: Hyunjin Kim, Minhyuk Sung*
title_en: Hyunjin Kim, Minhyuk Sung*
abstract: 我们提出了一种方法,旨在实现2D到3D分割提升的任务适应。近期研究强调了利用2D分割模型通过少样本适应实现高质量3D分割的优势。然而,先前方法主要关注将2D分割模型适应到渲染图像和合成文本描述领域迁移,而非专门优化3D分割。我们的任务适应方法通过针对3D分割的目标函数微调2D边界框预测模型。我们引入用于自适应合并的2D边界框权重,并通过小型额外神经网络学习这些权重。此外,我们结合SAM(基于边界框的前景分割模型)以提升2D分割边界,从而改善3D分割边界。在PartNet-Mobility数据集上的实验表明,我们的任务适应方法显著提升了性能,相比SotA少样本3D分割模型,语义和实例分割的mIoU提升了7.0%,mAP50提升了5.2%。代码已开源至https://github.com/KAIST-Visual-AI-Group/PartSTAD。
abstract_en: We introduce , a method designed for the task adaptation of 2D-to-3D segmentation lifting. Recent studies have highlighted the advantages of utilizing 2D segmentation models to achieve high-quality 3D segmentation through few-shot adaptation. However, previous approaches have focused on adapting 2D segmentation models for domain shift to rendered images and synthetic text descriptions, rather than optimizing the model specifically for 3D segmentation. Our proposed task adaptation method finetunes a 2D bounding box prediction model with an objective function for 3D segmentation. We introduce weights for 2D bounding boxes for adaptive merging and learn the weights using a small additional neural network. Additionally, we incorporate SAM, a foreground segmentation model on a bounding box, to improve the boundaries of 2D segments and consequently those of 3D segmentation. Our experiments on the PartNet-Mobility dataset show significant improvements with our task adaptation approach, achieving a 7.0%p increase in mIoU and a 5.2%p improvement in mAP50 for semantic and instance segmentation compared to the SotA few-shot 3D segmentation model. The code is available at https://github.com/KAIST-Visual-AI-Group/PartSTAD.

title: 基于原型的联邦学习方法
title_en: Hyunsin Park*, Sungrack Yun
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于原型的联邦学习方法,旨在为分类或验证任务中的嵌入网络设计。我们的研究重点是每个客户端仅拥有单一类别数据的场景。主要挑战是开发一种能够在满足隐私约束条件下区分不同类别的嵌入网络。将真实类别原型共享给服务器或其他客户端可能会泄露敏感信息。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种代理类原型,而非真实类别原型将在客户端之间共享。我们的方法通过与最近邻进行线性组合生成代理类原型。这种技术在隐藏真实类别原型的同时,使客户端能够学习具有判别性的嵌入网络。我们与添加随机高斯噪声和使用余弦相似度约束的随机选择等替代技术进行了比较。此外,我们评估了该方法对梯度反转攻击的鲁棒性,并引入了原型泄露的衡量指标。该指标量化了共享所提出的代理类原型时私有信息的泄露程度。此外,我们对方法的收敛性质进行了理论分析。我们的从头开始的联邦学习方法通过在CIFAR-100、VoxCeleb1和VGGFace2三个基准数据集上的实证结果验证了其有效性。
abstract_en: We propose a prototype-based federated learning method designed for embedding networks in classification or verification tasks. Our focus is on scenarios where each client has data from a single class. The main challenge is to develop an embedding network that can distinguish between different classes while adhering to privacy constraints. Sharing true class prototypes with the server or other clients could potentially compromise sensitive information. To tackle this issue, we propose a proxy class prototype that will be shared among clients instead of the true class prototype. Our approach generates proxy class prototypes by linearly combining them with their nearest neighbors. This technique conceals the true class prototype while enabling clients to learn discriminative embedding networks. We compare our method to alternative techniques, such as adding random Gaussian noise and using random selection with cosine similarity constraints. Furthermore, we evaluate the robustness of our approach against gradient inversion attacks and introduce a measure for prototype leakage. This measure quantifies the extent of private information revealed when sharing the proposed proxy class prototype. Moreover, we provide a theoretical analysis of the convergence properties of our approach. Our proposed method for federated learning from scratch demonstrates its effectiveness through empirical results on three benchmark datasets: CIFAR-100, VoxCeleb1, and VGGFace2.

title: Hyunwoo Yu, Yubin Cho, Beoungwoo Kang, Seunghun Moon, Kyeongbo Kong, Suk-Ju Kang*
title_en: Hyunwoo Yu, Yubin Cho, Beoungwoo Kang, Seunghun Moon, Kyeongbo Kong, Suk-Ju Kang*
abstract: 我们提出了一种编码器-解码器注意力变换器(ED-AFormer),其包含无嵌入变换器(EFT)编码器和基于我们无嵌入注意力(EFA)结构的全注意力解码器。所提出的EFA是一种新颖的全局上下文建模机制,专注于实现全局非线性功能,而非查询、键和值的具体角色。对于解码器,我们探索了考虑全局性的优化结构,以提升语义分割性能。此外,我们提出了一种新颖的推理空间缩减(ISR)方法以提高计算效率。与以往的空间缩减注意力方法不同,我们的ISR方法在推理阶段进一步降低键-值分辨率,从而缓解高效语义分割中的计算性能权衡差距。与现有的基于变换器的语义分割模型相比,我们的EDAFormer在ADE20K、Cityscapes和COCO-Stuff三个公开基准数据集上展示了高效的计算性能和最先进的结果。此外,我们的ISR方法在Cityscapes数据集上将计算成本降低了最多61%,同时仅造成微小的mIoU性能下降。代码可在https://github.com/hyunwoo137/EDAFormer获取。
abstract_en: We present an Encoder-Decoder Attention Transformer, ED-AFormer, which consists of the Embedding-Free Transformer (EFT) encoder and the all-attention decoder leveraging our Embedding-Free Attention (EFA) structure. The proposed EFA is a novel global context modeling mechanism that focuses on functioning the global non-linearity, not the specific roles of the query, key and value. For the decoder, we explore the optimized structure for considering the globality, which can improve the semantic segmentation performance. In addition, we propose a novel Inference Spatial Reduction (ISR) method for the computational efficiency. Different from the previous spatial reduction attention methods, our ISR method further reduces the key-value resolution at the inference phase, which can mitigate the computation-performance trade-off gap for the efficient semantic segmentation. Our EDAFormer shows the state-of-the-art performance with the efficient computation compared to the existing transformer-based semantic segmentation models in three public benchmarks, including ADE20K, Cityscapes and COCO-Stuff. Furthermore, our ISR method reduces the computational cost by up to 61% with minimal mIoU performance degradation on Cityscapes dataset. The code is available at https://github.com/hyunwoo137/EDAFormer.

title: I-Hsiang Chen, Wei-Ting Chen, Yu-Wei Liu, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Sy-Yen Kuo*
title_en: I-HSIANG CHEN, Wei-Ting Chen, Yu-Wei Liu, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Sy-Yen Kuo*
abstract: 人群计数与定位因在计算机视觉中的广泛应用而变得愈发重要。尽管基于点的策略在人群计数方法中被广泛采用,但它们面临显著挑战,即缺乏有效的学习策略来指导匹配过程。这一缺陷导致提案点与目标点的匹配不稳定,进而影响整体性能。为解决此问题,我们提出了一种有效方法以稳定基于点方法中的提案-目标匹配。我们提出辅助点引导(APG),为提案选择与优化提供清晰且有效的指导,解决匹配不确定性这一核心问题。此外,我们开发了隐式特征插值(IFI),以在多样化的密集人群场景中实现自适应特征提取,进一步提升模型的鲁棒性与准确性。大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性,展示了在人群计数与定位性能上的显著提升,特别是在具有挑战性的场景下。
abstract_en: Crowd counting and localization have become increasingly important in computer vision due to their wide-ranging applications. While point-based strategies have been widely used in crowd counting methods, they face a significant challenge, i.e., the lack of an effective learning strategy to guide the matching process. This deficiency leads to instability in matching point proposals to target points, adversely affecting overall performance. To address this issue, we introduce an effective approach to stabilize the proposal-target matching in point-based methods. We propose Auxiliary Point Guidance (APG) to provide clear and effective guidance for proposal selection and optimization, addressing the core issue of matching uncertainty. Additionally, we develop Implicit Feature Interpolation (IFI) to enable adaptive feature extraction in diverse crowd scenarios, further enhancing the model’s robustness and accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, showing significant improvements in crowd counting and localization performance, particularly under challenging conditions.

title: Ian Huang*, Guandao Yang, Leonidas Guibas
title_en: Ian Huang*, Guandao Yang, Leonidas Guibas
abstract: 图形设计在电影制作和游戏设计等众多应用中具有重要意义。为创建高质量的场景,设计师通常需要在Blender等软件中花费数小时时间,期间可能需要重复执行连接材质节点等操作数百次。此外,略微不同的设计目标可能需要完全不同的操作序列,使得自动化变得困难。本文提出了一种系统,利用视觉语言模型(VLMs)如GPT-4V,智能搜索设计动作空间以找到满足用户意图的解决方案。具体而言,我们设计了基于视觉的编辑生成器和状态评估器协同工作,以找到实现目标的正确操作序列。受人类设计过程中视觉想象力作用的启发,我们通过图像生成模型的“想象”参考图像补充VLMs的视觉推理能力,为抽象语言描述提供视觉基础。本文提供了实证证据表明,我们的系统能够根据文本和/或参考图像生成简单的Blender编辑序列,用于编辑程序化材质和几何体,以及在复杂场景中调整产品渲染的光照配置。1 1 项目网站和代码请访问:BlenderAlchemyWeb/ https://ianhuang0630.github.io/
abstract_en: Graphics design is important for various applications, including movie production and game design. To create a high-quality scene, designers usually need to spend hours in software like Blender, in which they might need to interleave and repeat operations, such as connecting material nodes, hundreds of times. Moreover, slightly different design goals may require completely different sequences, making automation difficult. In this paper, we propose a system that leverages Vision-Language Models (VLMs), like GPT-4V, to intelligently search the design action space to arrive at an answer that can satisfy a user’s intent. Specifically, we design a vision-based edit generator and state evaluator to work together to find the correct sequence of actions to achieve the goal. Inspired by the role of visual imagination in the human design process, we supplement the visual reasoning capabilities of VLMs with “imagined” reference images from image-generation models, providing visual grounding of abstract language descriptions. In this paper, we provide empirical evidence suggesting our system can produce simple but tedious Blender editing sequences for tasks such as editing procedural materials and geometry from text and/or reference images, as well as adjusting lighting configurations for product renderings in complex scenes. 1 1 For project website and code, please go to: BlenderAlchemyWeb/ https://ianhuang0630.github.io/

title: Ibrahim Ethem Hamamci*, Sezgin Er, Anjany Sekuboyina, Enis Simsar, Alperen Tezcan, Ayse Gulnihan Simsek, Sevval Nil Esirgun, Furkan Almas, Irem Dogan, Muhammed Furkan Dasdelen, Chinmay Prabhakar, Hadrien Reynaud, Sarthak Pati, Christian Bluethgen, Mehmet Kemal Ozdemir, Bjoern Menze
title_en: Ibrahim Ethem Hamamci*, Sezgin Er, Anjany Sekuboyina, Enis Simsar, Alperen Tezcan, Ayse Gulnihan Simsek, Sevval Nil Esirgun, Furkan Almas, Irem Dogan, Muhammed Furkan Dasdelen, Chinmay Prabhakar, Hadrien Reynaud, Sarthak Pati, Christian Bluethgen, Mehmet Kemal Ozdemir, Bjoern Menze
abstract: 基于文本条件的医学图像生成对于放射学至关重要,可用于扩充小数据集、保护数据隐私以及实现患者特异性建模。然而,其在CT和MRI等关键护理领域至关重要的三维医学成像中的应用仍属空白。本文中,我们引入了GenerateCT,这是首个基于自由形式医学文本提示生成三维医学影像的方法。GenerateCT结合了文本编码器和三个关键组件:一种新颖的因果视觉变换器用于编码三维CT体积,一个文本-图像变换器用于对齐CT和文本标记,以及一个基于文本条件的超分辨率扩散模型。由于在三维医学成像领域缺乏直接可比的方法,我们对GenerateCT进行了基准测试,证明其在所有关键指标上均优于现有方法。重要的是,我们通过评估其在多异常分类任务中的实用性,探索了GenerateCT的临床应用。首先,我们通过在真实数据集上训练多异常分类器建立了基准。为进一步评估模型对外部数据集的泛化能力及其在零样本场景下对未见提示的性能,我们采用外部数据集训练分类器,设定了额外的基准。我们进行了两项实验,通过使用GenerateCT合成与每个数据集相等数量的体积,将训练数据集规模翻倍。第一项实验表明,当联合使用真实和生成体积训练分类器时,AP分数提高了11%。第二项实验显示,当基于未见提示训练分类器时,性能提升了7%。此外,GenerateCT能够将合成训练数据集扩展到任意规模。例如,我们生成了100,000个三维CT体积,数量是真实数据集的五倍,并仅使用这些合成体积训练分类器。令人印象深刻的是,该分类器的性能比使用所有可用真实数据训练的分类器高出8%。最后,领域专家评估了生成的体积,确认其与文本提示高度一致。访问我们的代码、模型权重、训练数据和生成数据:https://github.com/ibrahimethemhamamci/GenerateCT
abstract_en: Text-conditional medical image generation is vital for radiology, augmenting small datasets, preserving data privacy, and enabling patient-specific modeling. However, its applications in 3D medical imaging, such as CT and MRI, which are crucial for critical care, remain unexplored. In this paper, we introduce GenerateCT, the first approach to generating 3D medical imaging conditioned on free-form medical text prompts. GenerateCT incorporates a text encoder and three key components: a novel causal vision transformer for encoding 3D CT volumes, a text-image transformer for aligning CT and text tokens, and a text-conditional super-resolution diffusion model. Without directly comparable methods in 3D medical imaging, we benchmarked GenerateCT against cutting-edge methods, demonstrating its superiority across all key metrics. Importantly, we explored GenerateCT’s clinical applications by evaluating its utility in a multi-abnormality classification task. First, we established a baseline by training a multi-abnormality classifier on our real dataset. To further assess the model’s generalization to external datasets and its performance with unseen prompts in a zero-shot scenario, we employed an external dataset to train the classifier, setting an additional benchmark. We conducted two experiments in which we doubled the training datasets by synthesizing an equal number of volumes for each set using GenerateCT. The first experiment demonstrated an 11% improvement in the AP score when training the classifier jointly on real and generated volumes. The second experiment showed a 7% improvement when training on both real and generated volumes based on unseen prompts. Moreover, GenerateCT enables the scaling of synthetic training datasets to arbitrary sizes. As an example, we generated 100,000 3D CT volumes, fivefold the number in our real dataset, and trained the classifier exclusively on these synthetic volumes. Impressively, this classifier surpassed the performance of the one trained on all available real data by a margin of 8%. Lastly, domain experts evaluated the generated volumes, confirming a high degree of alignment with the text prompts. Access our code, model weights, training data, and generated data at https://github.com/ibrahimethemhamamci/GenerateCT.

title: Idit Diamant*, Amir Rosenfeld, Idan Achituve, Jacob Goldberger, Arnon Netzer
title_en: Idit Diamant*, Amir Rosenfeld, Idan Achituve, Jacob Goldberger, Arnon Netzer
abstract: 无源域适应旨在在不访问源数据的情况下,将源训练的模型适应到未标记的目标域。近年来,该技术吸引了越来越多的关注,现有方法主要集中在自训练策略上,通常包含伪标签技术。本文提出了一种新颖的噪声学习方法,专门针对域适应场景中的噪声分布,学习消除伪标签的混淆。具体而言,我们学习伪标签的噪声转移矩阵,以捕捉每个类别的标签污染情况,并学习潜在的真实标签分布。估计噪声转移矩阵能够更准确地估计真实类别后验概率,从而提升预测准确性。我们展示了该方法与几种无源域适应方法(SHOT、SHOT++和AaD)结合时的有效性,并在三个域适应数据集(VisDA、DomainNet和OfficeHome)上取得了最先进的结果。
abstract_en: Source-free domain adaptation aims to adapt a source-trained model to an unlabeled target domain without access to the source data. It has attracted growing attention in recent years, where existing approaches focus on self-training that usually includes pseudo-labeling techniques. In this paper, we introduce a novel noise-learning approach tailored to address noise distribution in domain adaptation settings and learn to de-confuse the pseudo-labels. More specifically, we learn a noise transition matrix of the pseudo-labels to capture the label corruption of each class and learn the underlying true label distribution. Estimating the noise transition matrix enables a better true class-posterior estimation, resulting in better prediction accuracy. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach when combined with several source-free domain adaptation methods: SHOT, SHOT++, and AaD. We obtain state-of-the-art results on three domain adaptation datasets: VisDA, DomainNet, and OfficeHome.

title: 无源域自适应目标检测(SFOD)
title_en: Ilhoon Yoon, Hyeongjun Kwon, Jin Kim, Junyoung Park, Hyunsung Jang, Kwanghoon Sohn*
abstract: 无源域自适应目标检测(SFOD)是一种将训练好的检测器部署到新无标签域的有前景策略,无需访问源数据,从而解决数据隐私和效率方面的重大关切。大多数SFOD方法依赖于Mean-Teacher(MT)自训练范式,该范式高度依赖高置信度伪标签(HPL)。然而,这些HPL往往忽视了在域迁移中出现显著外观变化的小实例。此外,由于训练样本稀缺,HPL忽略了低置信度实例,导致对源域熟悉实例的适应偏向。为解决这一局限性,我们在基于Mean-Teacher的SFOD框架中引入了低置信度伪标签蒸馏(LPLD)损失。该新方法旨在利用区域建议网络(RPN)的建议,这些建议可能包含在陌生域中难以检测的对象。首先,我们使用标准伪标签技术提取HPL,并从RPN生成的建议中挖掘一组低置信度伪标签(LPL),排除与HPL重叠不显著的实例。这些LPL进一步通过利用类别关系信息和减少LPLD损失计算中的固有噪声进行优化。此外,我们使用特征距离自适应加权LPLD损失,以关注包含更大前景区域的LPL。我们的方法在四个跨域目标检测基准上超越了先前的SFOD方法。大量实验表明,LPLD损失通过减少误检并促进源模型的域不变知识的使用,实现了有效的适应。代码可在https://github.com/junia3/LPLD获取。无源域自适应目标检测
abstract_en: Source-Free domain adaptive Object Detection (SFOD) is a promising strategy for deploying trained detectors to new, unlabeled domains without accessing source data, addressing significant concerns around data privacy and efficiency. Most SFOD methods leverage a Mean-Teacher (MT) self-training paradigm relying heavily on High-confidence Pseudo Labels (HPL). However, these HPL often overlook small instances that undergo significant appearance changes with domain shifts. Additionally, HPL ignore instances with low confidence due to the scarcity of training samples, resulting in biased adaptation toward familiar instances from the source domain. To address this limitation, we introduce the Low-confidence Pseudo Label Distillation (LPLD) loss within the Mean-Teacher based SFOD framework. This novel approach is designed to leverage the proposals from Region Proposal Network (RPN), which potentially encompasses hard-to-detect objects in unfamiliar domains. Initially, we extract HPL using a standard pseudo-labeling technique and mine a set of Low-confidence Pseudo Labels (LPL) from proposals generated by RPN, leaving those that do not overlap significantly with HPL. These LPL are further refined by leveraging class-relation information and reducing the effect of inherent noise for the LPLD loss calculation. Furthermore, we use feature distance to adaptively weight the LPLD loss to focus on LPL containing a larger foreground area. Our method outperforms previous SFOD methods on four cross-domain object detection benchmarks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our LPLD loss leads to effective adaptation by reducing false negatives and facilitating the use of domain-invariant knowledge from the source model. Code is available at https://github.com/junia3/ LPLD. Source-Free domain adaptive Object Detection

title: 伊利亚·特罗菲莫夫*, 达里亚·沃罗诺娃, 埃德瓦尔·图尔钦斯基, 叶夫根尼·伯纳耶夫, 谢尔盖·巴拉尼科夫
title_en: Ilya Trofimov*, Daria Voronkova, Eduard Tulchinskii, Evgeny Burnaev, Serguei Barannikov
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的拓扑工具用于计算机视觉——标量函数拓扑发散度(SFTD),该工具用于衡量两个具有公共定义域的函数的下水平集之间的多尺度拓扑差异。函数可以定义在无向图或任意维数的欧几里得空间上。大多数现有的拓扑比较方法基于持久性条形码之间的Wasserstein距离,且未考虑拓扑特征的定位。SFTD的最小化确保了标量函数的对应拓扑特征位于相同位置。所提出的工具提供了有用的可视化,展示了函数拓扑差异的区域。我们展示了该方法在三维计算机视觉中的应用。特别是,实验表明,SFTD作为额外损失可提高从二维荧光显微镜图像重建细胞状三维形状的精度,并有助于识别三维分割中的拓扑错误。此外,我们证明了SFTD在二维分割问题中优于Betti匹配损失。代码已公开:https://github.com/IlyaTrofimov/SFTD
abstract_en: We propose a new topological tool for computer vision - Scalar Function Topology Divergence (SFTD), which measures the dissimilarity of multi-scale topology between sublevel sets of two functions having a common domain. Functions can be defined on an undirected graph or Euclidean space of any dimensionality. Most of the existing methods for comparing topology are based on Wasserstein distance between persistence barcodes and they don’t take into account the localization of topological features. The minimization of SFTD ensures that the corresponding topological features of scalar functions are located in the same places. The proposed tool provides useful visualizations depicting areas where functions have topological dissimilarities. We provide applications of the proposed method to 3D computer vision. In particular, experiments demonstrate that SFTD as an additional loss improves the reconstruction of cellular 3D shapes from 2D fluorescence microscopy images, and helps to identify topological errors in 3D segmentation. Additionally, we show that SFTD outperforms Betti matching loss in 2D segmentation problems. The code is publicly available: https://github.com/IlyaTrofimov/SFTD.

title: Imad Eddine MAROUF*, Subhankar Roy, Enzo Tartaglione, Stéphane Lathuilière
title_en: Imad Eddine MAROUF*, Subhankar Roy, Enzo Tartaglione, Stéphane Lathuilière
abstract: 本文研究了持续学习(CL)问题,其目标是在一系列任务上学习模型,假设在学习当前任务数据时,先前任务的数据变得不可用。持续学习本质上是在新任务学习(可塑性)与保持先前学习概念的性能(稳定性)之间进行权衡。为解决稳定性-可塑性权衡问题,我们提出对先前和当前任务的模型参数进行加权集成。这种加权集成模型,我们称之为持续模型平均(或CoMA),通过利用可塑性在当前任务上获得高精度,同时不会偏离先前的权重配置,从而确保稳定性。我们还提出了一种改进的CoMA变体,称为持续费舍尔加权模型平均(或CoFiMA),该方法通过利用模型权重的费舍尔信息,选择性地对权重集成中的每个参数进行加权。这两种变体在概念上简单,易于实现,并在多个标准CL基准测试中有效达到最先进的性能。代码可在:https://github.com/IemProg/CoFiMA 获取。
abstract_en: In this work, we study the problem of continual learning (CL) where the goal is to learn a model on a sequence of tasks, under the assumption that the data from the previous tasks becomes unavailable while learning on the current task data. CL is essentially a balancing act between learning on the new task (plasticity) and maintaining the performance on the previously learned concepts (stability). To address the stability-plasticity trade-off, we propose to perform weight-ensembling of the model parameters of the previous and current tasks. This weighted-ensembled model, which we call Continual Model Averaging (or CoMA), attains high accuracy on the current task by leveraging plasticity, while not deviating too far from the previous weight configuration, ensuring stability. We also propose an improved variant of CoMA, named Continual Fisher-weighted Model Averaging (or CoFiMA), that selectively weighs each parameter in the weights ensemble by leveraging the Fisher information of the weights of the model. Both variants are conceptually simple, easy to implement, and effective in attaining state-of-the-art performance on several standard CL benchmarks. Code is available at: https://github.com/IemProg/CoFiMA.

title: 在Cho, Hyunbo Shim, Seon Joo Kim*
title_en: In Cho, Hyunbo Shim, Seon Joo Kim*
abstract: 本文旨在通过减少采样次数和扫描区域数量,实现更实用的非视距成像。为此,我们引入了一种基于相量的增强网络,该网络能够从噪声干扰的局部观测中预测干净且完整的测量数据。我们采用去噪自编码器方案,在测量空间中获取丰富且抗噪的表示。通过该流程,我们的增强网络被训练以准确重建其被污染和局部的测量数据。然而,我们观察到去噪应用通常会导致退化和过度平滑的结果,这是由于测量数据中存在不必要的伪频信号。为了解决这一问题,我们引入了一种基于相量的流程,旨在将网络的频谱限制在感兴趣的频率范围内,该范围内检测到大部分信息信号。以孔径处的相量波前(带限信号)作为网络的输入和输出,引导我们的网络从感兴趣的频率范围学习并丢弃不必要的信息。在更实际的采集场景中的实验结果表明,我们可以通过16倍或64倍更少的采样次数和4倍更小的孔径实现绕过角落的成像。我们的代码可在https://github.com/join16/LEAP获取。
abstract_en: This paper aims to facilitate more practical NLOS imaging by reducing the number of samplings and scan areas. To this end, we introduce a phasor-based enhancement network that is capable of predicting clean and full measurements from noisy partial observations. We leverage a denoising autoencoder scheme to acquire rich and noise-robust representations in the measurement space. Through this pipeline, our enhancement network is trained to accurately reconstruct complete measurements from their corrupted and partial counterparts. However, we observe that the application of denoising often yields degraded and over-smoothed results, caused by unnecessary and spurious frequency signals present in measurements. To address this issue, we introduce a phasor-based pipeline designed to limit the spectrum of our network to the frequency range of interests, where the majority of informative signals are detected. The phasor wavefronts at the aperture, which are band-limited signals, are employed as inputs and outputs of the network, guiding our network to learn from the frequency range of interests and discard unnecessary information. The experimental results in more practical acquisition scenarios demonstrate that we can look around the corners with 16× or 64× fewer samplings and 4× smaller apertures. Our code is available at https://github.com/join16/LEAP.

title: Ioannis Maniadis Metaxas*, Georgios Tzimiropoulos, Ioannis Patras
title_en: Ioannis Maniadis Metaxas*, Georgios Tzimiropoulos, Ioannis Patras
abstract: 自监督学习最近在跨模态和模态间的预训练范式中崭露头角,取得了显著成果。在图像领域,组(或聚类)判别方法是最成功的手段之一。然而,此类框架需要防范聚类分配的严重不平衡,以避免退化为平凡解。现有方法通常通过重新加权聚类分配以促进平衡,或采用离线操作(如定期重新聚类)来防止退化。然而,前者通常需要大批次尺寸,导致资源需求增加,而后者在处理大规模数据集时存在可扩展性问题。在本文中,我们提出了一种框架,通过新颖的聚类平衡方法解决该问题。该方法估计批次间聚类的相对大小,并根据其相对大小在线调整聚类分配,从而克服了先前方法对大批次尺寸的依赖,实现完全在线处理,因此可扩展至任何数据集。我们进行了大量实验来评估我们的方法,并证明:a) 相比先前工作,实现了最先进的结果且资源需求显著降低;b) 完全在线,因此可扩展至大规模数据集;c) 即使在非常小的批次尺寸下也稳定且有效。代码和模型将在此处提供。
abstract_en: Self-supervised learning has recently emerged as the preeminent pretraining paradigm across and between modalities, with remarkable results. In the image domain specifically, group (or cluster) discrimination has been one of the most successful methods. However, such frameworks need to guard against heavily imbalanced cluster assignments to prevent collapse to trivial solutions. Existing works typically solve this by reweighing cluster assignments to promote balance, or with offline operations (e.g. regular re-clustering) that prevent collapse. However, the former typically requires large batch sizes, which leads to increased resource requirements, and the latter introduces scalability issues with regard to large datasets. In this work, we propose , a framework that tackles this problem with a novel cluster balancing method. estimates the relative size of the clusters across batches and balances them by adjusting cluster assignments, proportionately to their relative size and in an online manner. Thereby, it overcomes previous methods’ dependence on large batch sizes and is fully online, and therefore scalable to any dataset. We conduct extensive experiments to evaluate our approach and demonstrate that : a) achieves state-of-the-art results with significantly reduced resource requirements compared to previous works, b) is fully online, and therefore scalable to large datasets, and c) is stable and effective even with very small batch sizes. Code and models will be made available here.

title: Ioannis Siglidis*, Aleksander Holynski, Alexei A. Efros, Mathieu Aubry, Shiry Ginosar
title_en: Ioannis Siglidis*, Aleksander Holynski, Alexei A. Efros, Mathieu Aubry, Shiry Ginosar
abstract: 本文展示了如何利用用于图像合成的生成模型作为视觉数据挖掘的工具。我们的见解是,由于当代生成模型能够学习其训练数据的准确表示,我们可以利用它们通过挖掘视觉模式来总结数据。具体而言,我们证明了在将条件扩散模型微调以从特定数据集中合成图像后,可以使用这些模型在该数据集上定义典型性度量。该度量评估不同数据标签(如地理位置、时间戳、语义标签,甚至疾病的存在)的视觉元素的典型性。这种通过合成进行数据分析的方法在数据挖掘中有两个关键优势。首先,它比传统的基于对应关系的方法扩展性更好,因为它不需要显式比较所有视觉元素对。其次,虽然大多数以往的视觉数据挖掘工作专注于单一数据集,但我们的方法在内容和规模上适用于多样化的数据集,包括历史汽车数据集、历史人脸数据集、大型全球街景数据集以及更大规模的场景数据集。此外,我们的方法允许在类别标签之间转换视觉元素并分析一致的变化。项目页面:https://diff-mining.github.io/
abstract_en: This paper demonstrates how to use generative models trained for image synthesis as tools for visual data mining. Our insight is that since contemporary generative models learn an accurate representation of their training data, we can use them to summarize the data by mining for visual patterns. Concretely, we show that after finetuning conditional diffusion models to synthesize images from a specific dataset, we can use these models to define a typicality measure on that dataset. This measure assesses how typical visual elements are for different data labels, such as geographic location, time stamps, semantic labels, or even the presence of a disease. This analysis-by-synthesis approach to data mining has two key advantages. First, it scales much better than traditional correspondence-based approaches since it does not require explicitly comparing all pairs of visual elements. Second, while most previous works on visual data mining focus on a single dataset, our approach works on diverse datasets in terms of content and scale, including a historical car dataset, a historical face dataset, a large worldwide street-view dataset, and an even larger scene dataset. Furthermore, our approach allows for translating visual elements across class labels and analyzing consistent changes. Project page: https://diff-mining. github.io/.

title: Isaac Labe, Noam Issachar, Itai Lang, Sagie Benaim*
title_en: Isaac Labe, Noam Issachar, Itai Lang, Sagie Benaim*
abstract: 我们研究了在单目视频输入下学习动态3D语义辐射场的任务。我们的学习到的语义辐射场能够捕捉动态3D场景中每个点的语义信息以及颜色和几何属性,从而实现新视角的生成及其对应的语义信息。这使得能够对多样化的3D语义实体进行分割和跟踪,通过简单直观的界面(包括用户点击或文本提示)进行指定。为此,我们提出了,一种统一的3D表示方法,用于动态3D场景的外观和语义信息,基于最近提出的动态3D高斯表示。我们的表示方法在时间上同时优化颜色和语义信息。方法的关键在于外观和语义属性的联合优化,二者共同影响场景的几何属性。我们在其支持密集语义3D物体跟踪的能力上评估了我们的方法,并展示了适用于多种场景的高质量、快速渲染结果。我们的项目网页可在https://isaaclabe.github.io/DGD-Website/访问。
abstract_en: We tackle the task of learning dynamic 3D semantic radiance fields given a single monocular video as input. Our learned semantic radiance field captures per-point semantics as well as color and geometric properties for a dynamic 3D scene, enabling the generation of novel views and their corresponding semantics. This enables the segmentation and tracking of a diverse set of 3D semantic entities, specified using a simple and intuitive interface that includes a user click or a text prompt. To this end, we present , a unified 3D representation for both the appearance and semantics of a dynamic 3D scene, building upon the recently proposed dynamic 3D Gaussians representation. Our representation is optimized over time with both color and semantic information. Key to our method is the joint optimization of the appearance and semantic attributes, which jointly affect the geometric properties of the scene. We evaluate our approach in its ability to enable dense semantic 3D object tracking and demonstrate high-quality results that are fast to render, for a diverse set of scenes. Our project webpage is available on https://isaaclabe.github.io/DGD-Website/

title: Ishan Khatri*, Kyle Vedder*, Neehar Peri, Deva Ramanan, James Hays
title_en: Ishan Khatri*, Kyle Vedder*, Neehar Peri, Deva Ramanan, James Hays
abstract: 当前最先进的场景流方法普遍无法准确描述小物体的运动,而现有的评估协议通过在多个点上进行平均来掩盖这一缺陷。为解决这一局限性,我们提出了一种新的类别感知且速度归一化的评估协议——Bucket Normalized EPE,该协议能更准确地对比不同速度物体类型的误差差异。此外,我们提出TrackFlow,这是一种令人沮丧地简单的监督场景流基线方法,它将高质量的3D物体检测器(使用标准类别重平衡技术训练)与简单的卡尔曼滤波跟踪器相结合。值得注意的是,TrackFlow在现有指标上达到了最先进的性能,并在我们提出的指标上显著优于以往方法。我们的结果表明,场景流评估必须具备类别和速度感知能力,监督场景流方法必须解决点级类别不平衡问题。我们的评估工具包和代码已开源在GitHub上。
abstract_en: State-of-the-art scene flow methods broadly fail to describe the motion of small objects, and existing evaluation protocols hide this failure by averaging over many points. To address this limitation, we propose Bucket Normalized EPE, a new class-aware and speed-normalized evaluation protocol that better contextualizes error comparisons between object types that move at vastly different speeds. In addition, we propose TrackFlow, a frustratingly simple supervised scene flow baseline that combines a high-quality 3D object detector (trained using standard class re-balancing techniques) with a simple Kalman filter-based tracker. Notably, TrackFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance on existing metrics and shows large improvements over prior work on our proposed metric. Our results highlight that scene flow evaluation must be class and speed aware, and supervised scene flow methods must address point-level class imbalances. Our evaluation toolkit and code is available on GitHub.

title: Ishan Rajendrakumar Dave*, Fabian Caba, Mubarak Shah, Simon Jenni*
title_en: Ishan Rajendrakumar Dave*, Fabian Caba, Mubarak Shah, Simon Jenni*
abstract: 时序视频对齐旨在同步两个视频中的关键事件,如物体交互或动作阶段转换。此类方法可以受益于各种视频编辑、处理和理解任务。然而,现有方法在假设给定适合对齐的视频对的限制下运行,显著限制了其更广泛的应用。为了解决这个问题,我们将时序对齐重新表述为一个搜索问题,并引入了可对齐视频检索(AVR)任务。给定一个查询视频,我们的方法可以从大量剪辑中识别出可对齐的视频,并在时间上与查询视频同步。为了实现这一点,我们做出了三个关键贡献:1)我们引入了DRAQ,一个视频可对齐性指标,用于从候选集中识别并重新排序最佳可对齐视频;2)我们提出了一种有效的、可推广的帧级视频特征设计,以提高几种现成特征表示的对齐性能;3)我们提出了一种新颖的基准和评估协议,使用循环一致性度量进行AVR评估。我们在三个数据集上的实验,包括大规模Kinetics700,证明了我们的方法在从多样化数据集中识别可对齐视频对方面的有效性。
abstract_en: Temporal video alignment aims to synchronize the key events like object interactions or action phase transitions in two videos. Such methods could benefit various video editing, processing, and understanding tasks. However, existing approaches operate under the restrictive assumption that a suitable video pair for alignment is given, significantly limiting their broader applicability. To address this, we re-pose temporal alignment as a search problem and introduce the task of Alignable Video Retrieval (AVR). Given a query video, our approach can identify well-alignable videos from a large collection of clips and temporally synchronize them to the query. To achieve this, we make three key contributions: 1) we introduce DRAQ, a video alignability indicator to identify and re-rank the best alignable video from a set of candidates; 2) we propose an effective and generalizable frame-level video feature design to improve the alignment performance of several off-the-shelf feature representations, and 3) we propose a novel benchmark and evaluation protocol for AVR using cycle-consistency metrics. Our experiments on 3 datasets, including large-scale Kinetics700, demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in identifying alignable video pairs from diverse datasets.

title: Ishan Rajendrakumar Dave*, Mamshad Nayeem Rizve*, Mubarak Shah
title_en: Ishan Rajendrakumar Dave*, Mamshad Nayeem Rizve*, Mubarak Shah
abstract: 现实中的动作识别应用往往需要对细微动作进行细粒度理解,例如在体育分析、AR/VR用户交互和手术视频等领域。尽管细粒度动作的标注成本更高,但现有的半监督动作识别方法主要集中在粗粒度动作识别上。由于细粒度动作缺乏场景偏置,其分类需要理解动作阶段,因此现有的粗粒度半监督方法无法有效处理。在本工作中,我们首次系统地研究了半监督细粒度动作识别(FGAR)。我们观察到,对齐距离如动态时间规整(DTW)能够提供一种适合比较细粒度动作的阶段感知度量,这一概念在FGAR中尚未被探索。然而,常规DTW距离是成对的,并假设成对严格对齐,因此不直接适用于细粒度动作分类。为在有限标签设置中利用此类对齐距离,我们提出了一种基于对齐性验证的度量学习技术,以有效区分细粒度动作对。我们的可学习对齐性得分提供了更优的阶段感知度量,用于优化主视频编码器的伪标签。我们的协作伪标签框架“FinePseudo”在四个细粒度动作识别数据集(Diving48、FineGym99、FineGym288和FineDiving)上显著优于现有方法,并在现有粗粒度数据集(Kinetics400和Something-SomethingV2)上也表现出提升。我们还展示了协作伪标签在开放世界半监督设置中处理新未标注类别的鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Real-life applications of action recognition often require a fine-grained understanding of subtle movements, e.g., in sports analytics, user interactions in AR/VR, and surgical videos. Although fine-grained actions are more costly to annotate, existing semi-supervised action recognition has mainly focused on coarse-grained action recognition. Since fine-grained actions are more challenging due to the absence of scene bias, classifying these actions requires an understanding of action-phases. Hence, existing coarse-grained semi-supervised methods do not work effectively. In this work, we for the first time thoroughly investigate semi-supervised fine-grained action recognition (FGAR). We observe that alignment distances like dynamic time warping (DTW) provide a suitable action-phase-aware measure for comparing fine-grained actions, a concept previously unexploited in FGAR. However, since regular DTW distance is pairwise and assumes strict alignment between pairs, it is not directly suitable for classifying fine-grained actions. To utilize such alignment distances in a limited-label setting, we propose an Alignability-Verification-based Metric learning technique to effectively discriminate between fine-grained action pairs. Our learnable alignability score provides a better phase-aware measure, which we use to refine the pseudo-labels of the primary video encoder. Our collaborative pseudo-labeling-based framework ‘FinePseudo’ significantly outperforms prior methods on four fine-grained action recognition datasets: Diving48, FineGym99, FineGym288, and FineDiving, and shows improvement on existing coarse-grained datasets: Kinetics400 and Something-SomethingV2. We also demonstrate the robustness of our collaborative pseudo-labeling in handling novel unlabeled classes in open-world semi-supervised setups.

title: 伊万·马丁诺维奇*, 约西普·萨里奇, 辛尼斯拉·塞格维奇
title_en: Ivan Martinović*, Josip Šarić, Siniša Šegvić
abstract: 领域自适应全景分割有望解决自然场景理解中长尾异常情况的问题。先前的最先进方法通过跨任务一致性、系统级优化和教师预测的启发式改进来应对这一问题。相反,我们提出利用掩码变换器自身估计预测不确定性的显著能力。我们的方法通过利用全景教师预测的细粒度置信度来避免噪声放大。具体而言,我们使用掩码范围置信度调节损失,并抑制教师预测不确定或学生预测置信度高的像素的反向传播。在标准基准上的实验评估揭示了所提出选择技术的显著贡献。我们在Synthia→Cityscapes上报告了47.4 PQ,相比最先进方法提升了6.2个百分点。源代码可在github.com/helen1c/MC-PanDA获取。
abstract_en: Domain adaptive panoptic segmentation promises to resolve the long tail of corner cases in natural scene understanding. Previous state of the art addresses this problem with cross-task consistency, careful system-level optimization and heuristic improvement of teacher predictions. In contrast, we propose to build upon remarkable capability of mask transformers to estimate their own prediction uncertainty. Our method avoids noise amplification by leveraging fine-grained confidence of panoptic teacher predictions. In particular, we modulate the loss with mask-wide confidence and discourage back-propagation in pixels with uncertain teacher or confident student. Experimental evaluation on standard benchmarks reveals a substantial contribution of the proposed selection techniques. We report 47.4 PQ on Synthia→Cityscapes, which corresponds to an improvement of 6.2 percentage points over the state of the art. The source code is available at github.com/helen1c/MC-PanDA.

title: Ivona Najdenkoska*, Animesh Sinha, Abhimanyu Dubey, Dhruv Mahajan, Vignesh Ramanathan, Filip Radenovic
title_en: Ivona Najdenkoska*, Animesh Sinha, Abhimanyu Dubey, Dhruv Mahajan, Vignesh Ramanathan, Filip Radenovic
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于扩散的框架Context Diffusion,使图像生成模型能够从上下文中的视觉示例中学习。近期相关工作针对图像生成的上下文学习进行了探索,其中在查询图像和上下文示例及文本提示的共同作用下进行生成。然而,当缺少提示时,生成图像的质量和上下文保真度会下降,表明这些模型无法真正从视觉上下文中学习。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖框架,将视觉上下文的编码与期望图像布局的保持进行分离。这使得模型能够从视觉上下文和提示中学习,也可以单独从其中任一要素学习。此外,我们使模型能够处理少样本设置,从而有效应对多样化的上下文学习场景。我们的实验和人工评估表明,Context Diffusion在领域内和领域外任务中均表现出色,相比同类模型在图像质量和上下文保真度方面实现了整体提升。
abstract_en: We propose Context Diffusion, a diffusion-based framework that enables image generation models to learn from visual examples presented in context. Recent work tackles such in-context learning for image generation, where a query image is provided alongside context examples and text prompts. However, the quality and context fidelity of the generated images deteriorate when the prompt is not present, demonstrating that these models cannot truly learn from the visual context. To address this, we propose a novel framework that separates the encoding of the visual context and the preservation of the desired image layout. This results in the ability to learn from the visual context and prompts, but also from either of them. Furthermore, we enable our model to handle few-shot settings, to effectively address diverse in-context learning scenarios. Our experiments and human evaluation demonstrate that Context Diffusion excels in both in-domain and out-of-domain tasks, resulting in an overall enhancement in image quality and context fidelity compared to counterpart models.

title: Jack Lu*, Ryan Teehan*, Mengye Ren*
title_en: Jack Lu*, Ryan Teehan*, Mengye Ren*
abstract: 本文提出了一种简单且易于实现的方法,以提升基于扩散的图像生成模型的样本多样性与创造力,并防止训练数据复制。该方法通过一组参考图像,在生成过程中主动推动生成图像嵌入远离参考嵌入。我们提出了FSCG-8(Few-Shot Creative Generation 8),这是一个包含八个不同类别的少样本创意生成数据集,涵盖不同的概念、风格和场景,其中实现了最高的样本多样性与保真度。此外,我们通过大规模评估表明,该方法在使用训练文本提示时能有效防止训练数据复制。代码和数据集可在https: //github.com/Agentic-Learning-AI-Lab/procreate-diffusion-public获取。
