abstract_en: In this paper, we propose , a simple and easy-to-implement method to improve sample diversity and creativity of diffusion-based image generative models and to prevent training data reproduction. operates on a set of reference images and actively propels the generated image embedding away from the reference embeddings during the generation process. We propose FSCG-8 (Few-Shot Creative Generation 8), a few-shot creative generation dataset on eight different categories—encompassing different concepts, styles, and settings—in which achieves the highest sample diversity and fidelity. Furthermore, we show that is effective at preventing replicating training data in a large-scale evaluation using training text prompts. Code and are available at https: //github.com/Agentic-Learning-AI-Lab/procreate-diffusion-public.

title: Jacopo Bonato*, Marco Cotogni, Luigi Sabetta*
title_en: Jacopo Bonato*, Marco Cotogni, Luigi Sabetta*
abstract: 本文提出了一种面向类和架构无关的近似遗忘方法——选择性蒸馏遗忘(SCAR)。SCAR能够在不使用保留集(保留集是当前最先进的近似遗忘算法的关键组件)的情况下,高效消除特定信息,同时保持模型的测试准确率。我们的方法通过修改的马哈拉诺比斯距离引导被遗忘实例的特征向量向最近的错误类别分布对齐。此外,我们提出了一种蒸馏技巧机制,利用分布外图像将原始模型的知识蒸馏到遗忘模型中,从而在不使用任何保留集的情况下保留原始模型的测试性能。重要的是,我们提出了一种自遗忘版本的SCAR,能够在不访问遗忘集的情况下实现遗忘。我们在三个公开数据集上实验验证了所提方法的有效性,并与最先进的方法进行比较。我们的方法在不使用保留集的性能上优于其他方法,并且与依赖保留集的最佳方法表现相当。
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce Selective-distillation for Class and Architecture-agnostic unleaRning (SCAR), a novel approximate unlearning method. SCAR efficiently eliminates specific information while preserving the model’s test accuracy without using a retain set, which is a key component in state-of-the-art approximate unlearning algorithms. Our approach utilizes a modified Mahalanobis distance to guide the unlearning of the feature vectors of the instances to be forgotten, aligning them to the nearest wrong class distribution. Moreover, we propose a distillation-trick mechanism that distills the knowledge of the original model into the unlearning model with out-of-distribution images for retaining the original model’s test performance without using any retain set. Importantly, we propose a self-forget version of SCAR that unlearns without having access to the forget set. We experimentally verified the effectiveness of our method, on three public datasets, comparing it with state-of-the-art methods. Our method obtains performance higher than methods that operate without the retain set and comparable w.r.t the best methods that rely on the retain set.

title: Jae Joong Lee, Bosheng Li, Sara M Beery, Jonathan Huang, Songlin Fei, Raymond A. Yeh, Bedrich Benes*
title_en: Jae Joong Lee, Bosheng Li, Sara M Beery, Jonathan Huang, Songlin Fei, Raymond A. Yeh, Bedrich Benes*
abstract: 我们介绍了__TITLE_MATH_1__,这是首个包含600,000个环保意识型、3D模拟就绪树模型的集合,这些模型通过扩散先验生成。每个重建的3D树模型对应于Google的Auto Arborist数据集中的图像,该数据集包含北美地区街道视图图像及其对应的树属标签。我们的方法通过利用文本提示指定树属,提炼了两个树适应型扩散模型的得分,从而促进形状重建。此过程涉及重建一个填充有点标记的3D树包络,随后利用基于指定属的条件空间殖民算法估计树木的分枝结构。
abstract_en: We introduce , featuring the first collection of 600,000 environmentally aware, 3D simulation-ready tree models generated through Diffusion priors. Each reconstructed 3D tree model corresponds to an image from Google’s Auto Arborist Dataset, comprising street view images and associated genus labels of trees across North America. Our method distills the scores of two tree-adapted diffusion models by utilizing text prompts to specify a tree genus, thus facilitating shape reconstruction. This process involves reconstructing a 3D tree envelope filled with point markers, which are subsequently utilized to estimate the tree’s branching structure using the space colonization algorithm conditioned on a specified genus.

title: Jae Myung Kim*, Jessica Bader, Stephan Alaniz, Cordelia Schmid, Zeynep Akata
title_en: Jae Myung Kim*, Jessica Bader, Stephan Alaniz, Cordelia Schmid, Zeynep Akata
abstract: 尽管文本到图像扩散模型在图像合成方面已显示出最先进的结果,但它们在下游应用中尚未证明其有效性。先前的工作提出了在有限真实数据访问的情况下生成数据以训练图像分类器。然而,这些方法在生成分布内图像或描绘细粒度特征方面存在困难,从而阻碍了在合成数据集上训练的分类模型的泛化能力。我们提出了DataDream,一个框架,通过少量示例引导,更真实地表示真实数据分布,用于合成分类数据集。DataDream在少量真实图像上微调图像生成模型的LoRA权重,然后使用调整后的模型生成训练数据。接着,我们使用合成数据微调CLIP的LoRA权重,以在多种数据集上提高下游图像分类性能,超越先前方法。我们通过广泛的实验验证了DataDream的有效性,在10个数据集中有7个数据集上使用少量示例数据实现了最先进的分类准确率,而在其他3个数据集上具有竞争力。此外,我们提供了各种因素对模型性能影响的见解,例如真实示例和生成图像的数量以及微调计算量。代码可在https://github.com/ExplainableML/DataD获取。
abstract_en: While text-to-image diffusion models have been shown to achieve state-of-the-art results in image synthesis, they have yet to prove their effectiveness in downstream applications. Previous work has proposed to generate data for image classifier training given limited real data access. However, these methods struggle to generate in-distribution images or depict fine-grained features, thereby hindering the generalization of classification models trained on synthetic datasets. We propose DataDream, a framework for synthesizing classification datasets that more faithfully represents the real data distribution when guided by few-shot examples of the target classes. DataDream fine-tunes LoRA weights for the image generation model on the few real images before generating the training data using the adapted model. We then fine-tune LoRA weights for CLIP using the synthetic data to improve downstream image classification over previous approaches on a large variety of datasets. We demonstrate the efficacy of DataDream through extensive experiments, surpassing state-of-the-art classification accuracy with few-shot data across 7 out of 10 datasets, while being competitive on the other 3. Additionally, we provide insights into the impact of various factors, such as the number of real-shot and generated images as well as the fine-tuning compute on model performance. The code is available at https://github.com/ExplainableML/DataD

title: Jae Soon Baik*, In Young Yoon, Kun Hoon Kim, Jun Won Choi*
title_en: Jae Soon Baik*, In Young Yoon, Kun Hoon Kim, Jun Won Choi*
abstract: 深度神经网络在各类领域中通过大规模、标注良好的数据集取得了显著进展。然而,现实世界的数据往往呈现出长尾分布和标签噪声,这会显著降低模型的泛化性能。针对这些问题,近期研究主要集中在基于目标类别内高置信度样本估计每个类别中心的方法上。这些方法的性能受限于仅使用类别内训练样本进行中心估计,导致中心质量易受长尾分布和噪声标签的影响。在本研究中,我们提出了一种名为分布感知样本选择与对比学习(DaSC)的鲁棒训练框架。具体而言,DaSC引入了分布感知类别中心估计(DaCC)以生成增强的类别中心。DaCC通过对所有样本的特征进行加权平均,权重基于模型预测确定。此外,我们提出了一种置信度感知的对比学习策略,以获得平衡且鲁棒的表示。训练样本被分为高置信度样本和低置信度样本。我们的方法通过高置信度样本应用半监督平衡对比损失(SBCL),利用可靠的标签信息缓解类别偏差。对于低置信度样本,我们的方法计算增强型混合样本实例判别损失(MIDL),以自监督方式提升其表示能力。在CIFAR和现实世界噪声标签数据集上的实验结果表明,所提出的DaSC方法相比以往方法具有优越性能。我们的代码可在https://github.com/JaesoonBaik1213/DaSC获取。
abstract_en: Deep neural networks have demonstrated remarkable advancements in various fields using large, well-annotated datasets. However, real-world data often exhibit long-tailed distributions and label noise, significantly degrading generalization performance. Recent studies addressing these issues have focused on noisy sample selection methods that estimate the centroid of each class based on high-confidence samples within each target class. The performance of these methods is limited because they use only the training samples within each class for class centroid estimation, making the quality of centroids susceptible to long-tailed distributions and noisy labels. In this study, we present a robust training framework called Distribution-aware Sample Selection and Contrastive Learning (DaSC). Specifically, DaSC introduces a Distribution-aware Class Centroid Estimation (DaCC) to generate enhanced class centroids. DaCC performs weighted averaging of the features from all samples, with weights determined based on model predictions. Additionally, we propose a confidence-aware contrastive learning strategy to obtain balanced and robust representations. The training samples are categorized into high-confidence and low-confidence samples. Our method then applies Semi-supervised Balanced Contrastive Loss (SBCL) using high-confidence samples, leveraging reliable label information to mitigate class bias. For the low-confidence samples, our method computes Mixup-enhanced Instance Discrimination Loss (MIDL) to improve their representations in a self-supervised manner. Our experimental results on CIFAR and real-world noisy-label datasets demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed DaSC compared to previous approaches. Our code is available at https://github.com/JaesoonBaik1213/DaSC.

title: Jaehui Hwang, Dongyoon Han, Byeongho Heo, Song Park, Sanghyuk Chun*, Jong-Seok Lee
title_en: Jaehui Hwang, Dongyoon Han, Byeongho Heo, Song Park, Sanghyuk Chun*, Jong-Seok Lee
abstract: 近年来,许多深度神经网络架构被开发用于图像分类。它们的相似性或差异性以及影响其(不)相似性的因素仍充满疑问。为解决这一问题,我们旨在设计一种量化且可扩展的神经网络架构相似性度量方法。我们提出基于对抗攻击可迁移性的相似性度量(Similarity by Attack Transferability, SAT),该方法源于对抗攻击可迁移性包含与输入梯度和决策边界相关的信息,这些信息常用于理解模型行为。我们利用SAT对69种最先进的ImageNet分类器进行大规模分析以回答这一问题。此外,我们还提供了关于多模型机器学习应用的有趣见解,例如模型集成和知识蒸馏。实验结果表明,使用具有不同组件的多样化神经网络架构可为这些场景带来优势。
abstract_en: In recent years, many deep neural architectures have been developed for image classification. Whether they are similar or dissimilar and what factors contribute to their (dis)similarities remains curious. To address this question, we aim to design a quantitative and scalable similarity measure between neural architectures. We propose Similarity by Attack Transferability (SAT) from the observation that adversarial attack transferability contains information related to input gradients and decision boundaries widely used to understand model behaviors. We conduct a large-scale analysis on 69 state-of-the-art ImageNet classifiers using our SAT to answer the question. In addition, we provide interesting insights into ML applications using multiple models, such as model ensemble and knowledge distillation. Our results show that using diverse neural architectures with distinct components can benefit such scenarios.

title: Jaehyeok Kim, Dongyoon Wee, Dan Xu*
title_en: Jaehyeok Kim, Dongyoon Wee, Dan Xu*
abstract: 本文介绍了面向运动的组合神经辐射场(MoCo-NeRF),这是一种框架,旨在通过新颖的非刚性运动建模方法对单目人体视频进行自由视角渲染。在动态着装人体的背景下,复杂的布料动态会产生与骨骼关节运动本质不同的非刚性运动,这对渲染质量至关重要。传统方法将非刚性运动建模为空间(3D)偏差和骨骼变换的组合。然而,由于其高学习复杂度且缺乏直接监督,难以在合理时间内达到最优质量。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的方法,将非刚性运动建模为辐射残差场,以利用渲染中的更直接颜色监督,并利用刚性辐射场作为先验知识以降低学习过程的复杂度。我们的方法使用单一多分辨率哈希编码(MHE)同时学习刚性骨骼运动的规范T型姿态表示和非刚性运动的辐射残差场。此外,为进一步提升训练效率和实用性,我们扩展MoCo-NeRF以支持在同一框架内对多个主体进行联合训练,这得益于我们对非刚性运动建模的有效设计。这种可扩展性通过集成全局MHE、可学习的身份码以及多个局部MHE实现。我们在ZJU-MoCap和MonoCap数据集上展示了大量实验结果,清楚地证明了在单主体和多主体设置中均达到最先进的性能。代码和模型将在项目页面公开:https://stevejaehyeok.github.io/publications/moco-nerf。
abstract_en: This paper introduces Motion-oriented Compositional Neu-ral Radiance Fields (MoCo-NeRF), a framework designed to perform free-viewpoint rendering of monocular human videos via novel non-rigid motion modeling approach. In the context of dynamic clothed humans, complex cloth dynamics generate non-rigid motions that are intrinsically distinct from skeletal articulations and critically important for the rendering quality. The conventional approach models non-rigid motions as spatial (3D) deviations in addition to skeletal transformations. However, it is either time-consuming or challenging to achieve optimal quality due to its high learning complexity without a direct supervision. To target this problem, we propose a novel approach of modeling non-rigid motions as radiance residual fields to benefit from more direct color supervision in the rendering and utilize the rigid radiance fields as a prior to reduce the complexity of the learning process. Our approach utilizes a single multiresolution hash encoding (MHE) to concurrently learn the canonical T-pose representation from rigid skeletal motions and the radiance residual field for non-rigid motions. Additionally, to further improve both training efficiency and usability, we extend MoCo-NeRF to support simultaneous training of multiple subjects within a single framework, thanks to our effective design for modeling non-rigid motions. This scalability is achieved through the integration of a global MHE and learnable identity codes in addition to multiple local MHEs. We present extensive results on ZJU-MoCap and MonoCap, clearly demonstrating state-of-the-art performance in both single- and multi-subject settings. The code and model will be made publicly available at the project page: https://stevejaehyeok.github.io/publications/moco-nerf.

title: Jaehyeong Jeon*, Kibum Kim, Kanghoon Yoon, Chanyoung Park
title_en: Jaehyeong Jeon*, Kibum Kim, Kanghoon Yoon, Chanyoung Park
abstract: 场景图生成(SGG)任务涉及检测图像中的物体并预测表示物体之间关系的谓词。然而,在SGG基准数据集中,尽管单个谓词可能表现出多样的语义(即语义多样性),现有SGG模型却被训练为为每个物体对预测唯一的谓词。这导致SGG模型忽略了谓词可能存在的语义多样性,从而产生偏差预测。本文提出了一种新颖的模型无关的语义多样性感知的基于原型的学习(DPL)框架,该框架能够基于对谓词语义多样性的理解实现无偏预测。具体而言,DPL学习每个谓词在语义空间中覆盖的区域,以区分单个谓词可能代表的各种不同语义。大量实验表明,我们提出的模型无关的DPL框架在现有SGG模型上显著提升了性能,并且有效理解了谓词的语义多样性。代码可在https://github.com/JeonJaeHyeong/DPL.git获取。
abstract_en: The scene graph generation (SGG) task involves detecting objects within an image and predicting predicates that represent the relationships between the objects. However, in SGG benchmark datasets, each subject-object pair is annotated with a single predicate even though a single predicate may exhibit diverse semantics (i.e., semantic diversity), existing SGG models are trained to predict the one and only predicate for each pair. This in turn results in the SGG models to overlook the semantic diversity that may exist in a predicate, thus leading to biased predictions. In this paper, we propose a novel model-agnostic Semantic Diversity-aware Prototype-based Learning () framework that enables unbiased predictions based on the understanding of the semantic diversity of predicates. Specifically, DPL learns the regions in the semantic space covered by each predicate to distinguish among the various different semantics that a single predicate can represent. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed model-agnostic DPL framework brings significant performance improvement on existing SGG models, and also effectively understands the semantic diversity of predicates. The code is available at https://github.com/JeonJaeHyeong/ DPL.git.

title: Jaein Kim, HEE BIN YOO, Dong-Sig Han, Yeon-Ji Song, Byoung-Tak Zhang*
title_en: Jaein Kim, HEE BIN YOO, Dong-Sig Han, Yeon-Ji Song, Byoung-Tak Zhang*
abstract: 点云中固有的几何信息丰富性强调了利用群等变性的必要性,因为保持点云拓扑结构到特征空间能够为解决三维空间中的问题提供直观的归纳偏置。由于通过模型架构体现对称性相较于依赖数据增强具有优势,因此在点云领域已成为关键研究课题。然而,现有方法在群的非连续性或复杂架构导致计算效率低下方面存在局限。本文提出CSEConv:一种新型点卷积层,其在连续SO(3)作用下保持等变性。其结构基于群论框架,实现了球面上的卷积模块。将滤波器明确为定义于双余子空间上的显式、连续且严格等变函数,是使我们的方法相比先前方法更具可扩展性的独特之处。从对合成和真实世界点云数据集的分类实验中,我们的方法在连续旋转群等变的点基模型中取得了最佳准确率(据我们所知)。
abstract_en: The inherent richness of geometric information in point cloud underscores the necessity of leveraging group equivariance, as preserving the topological structure of the point cloud up to the feature space provides an intuitive inductive bias for solving problems in 3D space. Since manifesting the symmetry by means of model architecture has an advantage over the dependence on the augmentation, it has been a crucial research topic in the point cloud field. However, existing methods have limitations in the non-continuity of groups or the complex architecture causing computational inefficiency. In this paper, we propose CSEConv: a novel point convolution layer equivariant under continuous SO(3) actions. Its structure is founded on the framework of group theory, realizing the convolution module defined on a sphere. Implementing its filters to be explicit, continuous, and rigorously equivariant functions defined upon the double coset space is the distinctive factor which makes our method more scalable than previous approaches. From the classification experiments on synthetic and real-world point cloud datasets, our method achieves the best accuracy, to the best of our knowledge, amidst point-based models equivariant against continuous rotation group.

title: Jaejung Seol, SeoJun Kim, Jaejun Yoo*
title_en: Jaejung Seol, SeoJun Kim, Jaejun Yoo*
abstract: 视觉布局在广告、海报和网页UI设计等图形设计领域起着至关重要的作用。通过生成模型实现内容感知布局生成的最新趋势展现出潜力,但往往忽视了布局设计的语义复杂性,将其简单视为数值优化问题。为弥合这一差距,我们引入了PosterLlama,这是一种通过将布局元素重新格式化为HTML代码并利用语言模型中的丰富设计知识来生成视觉和文本一致布局的网络。此外,我们通过独特的基于深度的海报增强策略增强了模型的鲁棒性。这确保了即使在数据有限的情况下,生成的布局仍保持语义丰富且视觉吸引力。我们在多个基准测试上的广泛评估表明,PosterLlama在生成真实且内容感知的布局方面优于现有方法。它支持前所未有的广泛条件,包括但不限于内容感知布局生成、元素条件布局生成和布局补全等,作为高度通用的用户操作工具。项目网页:PosterLlama
abstract_en: Visual layout plays a critical role in graphic design fields such as advertising, posters, and web UI design. The recent trend toward content-aware layout generation through generative models has shown promise, yet it often overlooks the semantic intricacies of layout design by treating it as a simple numerical optimization. To bridge this gap, we introduce , a network designed for generating visually and textually coherent layouts by reformatting layout elements into HTML code and leveraging the rich design knowledge within language models. Furthermore, we enhance the robustness of our model with a unique depth-based poster augmentation strategy. This ensures our generated layouts remain semantically rich but also visually appealing, even with limited data. Our extensive evaluations across several benchmarks demonstrate that outperforms existing methods in producing authentic and content-aware layouts. It supports an unparalleled range of conditions, including but not limited to content-aware layout generation, element conditional layout generation, and layout completion, among others, serving as a highly versatile user manipulation tool. Project webpage: PosterLlama

title: Jaeseong Lee*, Junha Hyung*, Sohyun Jeong, Jaegul Choo*
title_en: Jaeseong Lee*, Junha Hyung*, Sohyun Jeong, Jaegul Choo*
abstract: 人脸交换技术因其多样化的应用而受到广泛关注。大多数先前的人脸交换方法都依赖于跷跷板训练方案,也称为目标导向方法。然而,这种方法常导致模型训练不稳定,并因目标身份泄露问题产生融合身份的不期望样本。源导向方法通过自重构目标实现了更稳定的训练,但往往无法准确反映目标图像的肤色和光照效果。本文提出了一种新颖的自监督方法——形状无关的掩码自编码器(SAMAE)训练方案,该方案结合了目标导向方法和源导向方法的优势。我们的训练方案通过规避传统的跷跷板训练机制,并引入明确的地面真实数据,解决了传统训练方法的局限性。我们的模型通过学习解耦的身份与非身份特征,有效缓解了身份泄露问题,并准确反映目标的漫反射率和光照效果。此外,我们通过穿孔混淆和随机网格缩放等新技术,紧密解决了形状错位和体积差异问题。SAMAE建立了新的技术前沿,超越了其他基线方法,在保持身份属性和非身份属性方面均未妥协。
abstract_en: Face swapping has gained significant attention for its varied applications. Most previous face swapping approaches have relied on the seesaw game training scheme, also known as the target-oriented approach. However, this often leads to instability in model training and results in undesired samples with blended identities due to the target identity leakage problem. Source-oriented methods achieve more stable training with self-reconstruction objective but often fail to accurately reflect target image’s skin color and illumination. This paper introduces the Shape Agnostic Masked AutoEncoder (SAMAE) training scheme, a novel self-supervised approach that combines the strengths of both target-oriented and source-oriented approaches. Our training scheme addresses the limitations of traditional training methods by circumventing the conventional seesaw game and introducing clear ground truth through its self-reconstruction training regime. Our model effectively mitigates identity leakage and reflects target albedo and illumination through learned disentangled identity and non-identity features. Additionally, we closely tackle the shape misalignment and volume discrepancy problems with new techniques, including perforation confusion and random mesh scaling. SAMAE establishes a new state-of-the-art, surpassing other baseline methods, preserving both identity and non-identity attributes without sacrificing on either aspect.

title: Jaeyeul Kim, Jungwan Woo, Jeonghoon Kim, Sunghoon Im*
title_en: Jaeyeul Kim, Jungwan Woo, Jeonghoon Kim, Sunghoon Im*
abstract: 在基于LiDAR的感知领域,已取得显著进展,但领域泛化仍是一个重大挑战。当模型应用于具有不同LiDAR传感器的不熟悉数据集或新环境中时,性能往往会因点云密度分布的变化而下降。为解决这一挑战,我们提出了一种密度判别特征嵌入(DDFE)模块,该模块基于观察到单个源LiDAR点云包含密度谱的观察结果。DDFE模块精心设计用于在单一源域中提取密度特定特征,从而促进不同LiDAR传感器之间具有相似密度特性的物体识别。此外,我们引入了一种简单而有效的密度增强技术,旨在扩展源数据中的密度谱范围,从而增强DDFE的能力。我们的DDFE模块是一种通用且轻量级的领域泛化模块,可无缝集成到各种3D主干网络中,并在多种当前最先进的领域泛化方法上表现出优越性能。代码可在https://github.com/dgist-cvlab/MultiDensityDG获取。
abstract_en: In the realm of LiDAR-based perception, significant strides have been made, yet domain generalization remains a substantial challenge. The performance often deteriorates when models are applied to unfamiliar datasets with different LiDAR sensors or deployed in new environments, primarily due to variations in point cloud density distributions. To tackle this challenge, we propose a Density Discriminative Feature Embedding (DDFE) module, capitalizing on the observation that a single source LiDAR point cloud encompasses a spectrum of densities. The DDFE module is meticulously designed to extract density-specific features within a single source domain, facilitating the recognition of objects sharing similar density characteristics across different LiDAR sensors. In addition, we introduce a simple yet effective density augmentation technique aimed at expanding the spectrum of density in source data, thereby enhancing the capabilities of the DDFE. Our DDFE stands out as a versatile and lightweight domain generalization module. It can be seamlessly integrated into various 3D backbone networks, where it has demonstrated superior performance over current state-of-the-art domain generalization methods. Code is available at https://github.com/ dgist-cvlab/MultiDensityDG.

title: James A D Gardner*, Evgenii Kashin, Bernhard Egger, William Smith
title_en: James A D Gardner*, Evgenii Kashin, Bernhard Egger, William Smith
abstract: 从无约束图像集合中逆渲染户外场景是一项具有挑战性的任务,特别是由于几何因素导致的光照/反照率歧义以及光照环境的遮挡(阴影)。然而,图像中存在许多线索,有助于分离几何、反照率和阴影。尽管当前最先进的方法通常会遮蔽天空,我们利用了天空像素提供对应方向上远距离光照的直接观测,并通过神经光照先验,利用统计线索推导剩余的光照环境。我们提出的光照先验的结合得益于一种新颖的“由外到内”方法,基于神经方向距离函数计算可微天空可见性。该方法高度高效,可以与神经场景表示并行训练,使外观损失的梯度从阴影流向影响光照和几何的估计。我们的方法估计高质量的反照率、几何、光照和天空可见性,在NeRF-OSR重照明基准测试中达到最先进水平。我们的代码和模型可在https://github.com/JADGardner/neusky获取。
abstract_en: Inverse rendering of outdoor scenes from unconstrained image collections is a challenging task, particularly illumination/albedo ambiguities and occlusion of the illumination environment (shadowing) caused by geometry. However, there are many cues in an image that can aid in the disentanglement of geometry, albedo and shadows. Whilst sky is frequently masked out in state-of-the-art methods, we exploit the fact that any sky pixel provides a direct observation of distant lighting in the corresponding direction and, via a neural illumination prior, a statistical cue to derive the remaining illumination environment. The incorporation of our illumination prior is enabled by a novel ‘outside-in’ method for computing differentiable sky visibility based on a neural directional distance function. This is highly efficient and can be trained in parallel with the neural scene representation, allowing gradients from appearance loss to flow from shadows to influence the estimation of illumination and geometry. Our method estimates high-quality albedo, geometry, illumination and sky visibility, achieving state-of-the-art results on the NeRF-OSR relighting benchmark. Our code and models can be found at https://github.com/JADGardner/neusky.

title: James Burgess*, Kuan-Chieh Wang, Serena Yeung-Levy
title_en: James Burgess*, Kuan-Chieh Wang, Serena Yeung-Levy
abstract: 文本到图像扩散模型能够生成令人印象深刻且逼真的图像,但它们是否仅通过2D监督学习就能表征3D世界?我们证明了这一点,某些3D场景表示确实被编码在如Stable Diffusion等模型的文本嵌入空间中。我们的方法,视点神经文本倒置(ViewNeTI),旨在发现3D视点标记;这些标记控制生成图像的3D视点——即场景中的渲染姿态。具体而言,我们训练一个小型神经映射器,将连续的相机视点参数预测为视点标记(一个词嵌入)。该标记通过交叉注意力机制引导扩散生成,以产生具有所需相机视点的图像。使用ViewNeTI作为评估工具,我们报告两个发现:首先,文本潜在空间对特定3D场景具有连续的视点控制流形;其次,我们发现所有场景均存在通用的视点控制流形。我们得出结论,由于视点标记控制3D“渲染”视点,因此冻结的2D扩散模型中很可能嵌入了场景表示。最后,我们利用3D场景表示进行3D视觉任务,即视点控制的文本到图像生成,以及从单张图像进行新视点合成,其中我们的方法在LPIPS指标上达到最先进水平。代码可在https://github.com/jmhb0/view_neti获取
abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models generate impressive and realistic images, but do they learn to represent the 3D world from only 2D supervision? We demonstrate that yes, certain 3D scene representations are encoded in the text embedding space of models like Stable Diffusion. Our approach, Viewpoint Neural Textual Inversion (ViewNeTI), is to discover 3D view tokens; these tokens control the 3D viewpoint — the rendering pose in a scene — of generated images. Specifically, we train a small neural mapper to take continuous camera viewpoint parameters and predict a view token (a word embedding). This token conditions diffusion generation via cross-attention to produce images with the desired camera viewpoint. Using ViewNeTI as an evaluation tool, we report two findings: first, the text latent space has a continuous view-control manifold for particular 3D scenes; second, we find evidence for a generalized view-control manifold for all scenes. We conclude that since the view token controls the 3D ‘rendering’ viewpoint, there is likely a scene representation embedded in frozen 2D diffusion models. Finally, we exploit the 3D scene representations for 3D vision tasks, namely, view-controlled text-to-image generation, and novel view synthesis from a single image, where our approach sets state-of-the-art for LPIPS. Code available at https://github.com/jmhb0/view_neti

title: Jan D Lehr*, Jan H Philipps, Alik Sargsyan, Martin Pape, Jörg Krüger
title_en: Jan D Lehr*, Jan H Philipps, Alik Sargsyan, Martin Pape, Jörg Krüger
abstract: 近年来,视觉工业异常检测(IAD)领域涌现出许多新的半监督学习方法。同时,用于基准测试的方法新数据集却寥寥无几。最流行的MVTec-AD数据集因其类别多样性及工业对象的可获取性而广受关注。但许多方法已在MVTec-AD数据集上实现了超过99%的AUROC分数。该数据集提供的缺陷类别似乎易于检测。此外,目前尚无方法能对IAD数据集中需检测的缺陷进行统计描述。本文提出了一种新的视觉工业异常检测数据集及一种用于异常检测数据集难度评估的AD3评分方法。新数据集名为VIADUCT,包含49个类别和来自11个不同行业的10,986张高分辨率图像。通过多家制造企业的支持,该数据集呈现了大量实际检测问题。其包含大量不同缺陷,并提供详细的像素级标注。通过与其他先进数据集的对比,突显了VIADUCT数据集的附加价值。因此,我们对每个数据集提供类别数、图像数、缺陷类别及缺陷数量的概述。除这些显性对比外,还通过AD3评分描述数据集的缺陷特征。该新颖评分用于分析缺陷尺寸及其与对应对象的相似性。使用七种选定的工业异常检测方法在新数据集上进行基准测试,结果显示仍有改进空间。研究表明,VIADUCT数据集是基于图像的工业异常检测领域最大的数据集。除其难以识别的微小缺陷外,该数据集还提供了最大的缺陷变异性和最多的缺陷类别。通过AD3评分描述数据集时发现,VIADUCT数据集的缺陷最为隐蔽。利用AD3评分,可为IAD数据集中的每个缺陷生成先验知识。AD3评分与IAD方法基准测试结果相关联,表明其可用于估计缺陷检测难度。未来,可通过AD3评分预先评估新对象是否能被IAD方法识别,从而避免进行耗能的基准测试。AD3评分的简单计算可生成有价值的先验知识,节省资源。
abstract_en: The field of visual Industrial Anomaly Detection (IAD) has brought forth many new semi-supervised learning methods in recent years. At the same time, there have been few new datasets for benchmarking the methods. The most popular dataset is MVTec-AD dataset, because of its diversity of categories and availability of industrial objects. But many methods already achieve AUROC scores of more than 99 % on the MVTec-AD dataset. The defects of the categories that the dataset provides appear to be easily detectable. Furthermore, there is no existing approach to statistically describe the defects that need to be found in IAD datasets. This paper presents a new dataset for visual industrial anomaly detection and a novel approach for Anomaly Detection Dataset Difficulty assessment with the AD3 score. The new dataset named VIADUCT contains 49 categories and 10,986 high resolution images from eleven different sectors. Through the support of several manufacturing companies, numerous real inspection problems are presented through the dataset. It contains a large number of different defects with detailed pixel-wise annotations. The VIADUCT dataset is compared with other state of the art datasets to underline its added value. Therefore, we provide an overview for each dataset regarding the number of categories, images, defect categories and defects. In addition to these obvious comparisons the defects of the datasets are described with the AD3 score. This novel score is used to analyze the size of the defects and the similarity between the defect and its corresponding object. Using seven selected methods from industrial anomaly detection, a benchmark is performed on the new dataset, showing that there is still potential for improvement. It is shown that the VIADUCT dataset is the largest dataset in the field of image-based industrial anomaly detection. In addition to its very small defects which are hard to recognize, the dataset also offers the greatest variance of possible defects and the most defect classes. Describing the datasets with AD3 score it can be found that VIADUCT dataset have the most inconspicuous defects. With the AD3 score we are able to create a-priori knowledge for every single defect in IAD datasets. The AD3 score correlates with the results of the IAD method benchmark, showing that it can be used to estimate defect detection difficulty. In the future, new objects can be assessed to see whether defects can be recognized using IAD methods before an energy-intensive benchmark is performed. The simple calculation of the AD3 score generates valuable a-priori knowledge and can save resources.

title: Jan Skvrna*, Lukáš Neumann
title_en: Jan Skvrna*, Lukáš Neumann
abstract: 在激光雷达点云中实现精确的目标检测是实现稳健且安全的自动驾驶和机器人应用的关键前提。目前训练三维目标检测器需要手动标注大量训练数据,这一过程非常耗时且成本高昂。因此,可轻易获取的标注训练数据量有限,而且这些标注数据集很可能不包含边缘案例或罕见实例,因为这些实例在如此小的数据集中出现的概率较低。本文提出了一种无需任何手动标注即可训练三维目标检测器的方法,该方法利用现有的开箱即用的视觉组件,并通过利用周围世界的连续性。因此,该方法仅需在现实世界中收集传感器记录即可训练三维检测器,这极其经济且允许使用比传统全监督方法多几个数量级的数据进行训练。该方法在KITTI和Waymo Open数据集上进行了评估,其性能超越了所有先前的弱监督方法,并且在与使用人类三维标签的方法相比时,显著缩小了性能差距。我们的方法源代码已公开在https://www.github.com/jskvrna/TCC-Det。
abstract_en: Accurate object detection in LiDAR point clouds is a key prerequisite of robust and safe autonomous driving and robotics applications. Training the 3D object detectors currently involves the need to manually annotate vasts amounts of training data, which is very time-consuming and costly. As a result, the amount of annotated training data readily available is limited, and moreover these annotated datasets likely do not contain edge-case or otherwise rare instances, simply because the probability of them occurring in such a small dataset is low. In this paper, we propose a method to train 3D object detector without any need for manual annotations, by exploiting existing off-the-shelf vision components and by using the consistency of the world around us. The method can therefore be used to train a 3D detector by only collecting sensor recordings in the real world, which is extremely cheap and allows training using orders of magnitude more data than traditional fully-supervised methods. The method is evaluated on KITTI and Waymo Open datasets, where it outperforms all previous weakly-supervised methods and where it narrows the gap when compared to methods using human 3D labels. The source code of our method is publicly available at https://www.github. com/jskvrna/TCC-Det.

title: Jason J. Yu*, Tristan Aumentado-Armstrong, Fereshteh Forghani, Konstantinos G. Derpanis, Marcus A. Brubaker
title_en: Jason J. Yu*, Tristan Aumentado-Armstrong, Fereshteh Forghani, Konstantinos G. Derpanis, Marcus A. Brubaker
abstract: 本文研究生成式新视角合成(GNVS)问题,即在给定有限已知视角的情况下生成新颖且合理的场景视角。本文提出一种基于集合的生成模型,能够根据任意数量的视角同时生成多个自洽的新视角。我们的方法不仅限于逐个生成单张图像,还可根据可变数量的视角进行条件生成。因此,在生成大量视角时,我们的方法不受低阶自回归生成方法的限制,更能保持大规模图像集合中生成图像的质量。我们在标准NVS数据集上评估了该模型,结果表明其优于当前最先进的基于图像的GNVS基线方法。此外,我们展示了该模型能够生成无自然顺序排列的视角集合,如循环路径和双目轨迹,并在这些任务上显著优于其他方法。我们的项目页面地址为:https://yorkucvil.github.io/PolyOculus-NVS/
abstract_en: This paper considers the problem of generative novel view synthesis (GNVS), generating novel, plausible views of a scene given a limited number of known views. Here, we propose a set-based generative model that can simultaneously generate multiple, self-consistent new views, conditioned on any number of views. Our approach is not limited to generating a single image at a time and can condition on a variable number of views. As a result, when generating a large number of views, our method is not restricted to a low-order autoregressive generation approach and is better able to maintain generated image quality over large sets of images. We evaluate our model on standard NVS datasets and show that it outperforms the state-of-the-art image-based GNVS baselines. Further, we show that the model is capable of generating sets of views that have no natural sequential ordering, like loops and binocular trajectories, and significantly outperforms other methods on such tasks. Our project page is available at: https://yorkucvil.github.io/PolyOculus-NVS/.

title: Javier Grau Chopite*, Patrick Hähn, Matthias B Hullin*
title_en: Javier Grau Chopite*, Patrick Hähn, Matthias B Hullin*
abstract: 非视线(NLoS)重建,即对超出相机视野范围场景的成像任务,通常通过源-传感器系统扫描可见区域并分析与隐藏静态场景交互后的光的二次反射来实现。估计角落处的人类活动将是新兴NLoS应用中的重要任务,近期文献中已有相关尝试。然而,由于NLoS感知需要较长的曝光时间和全面扫描,连续运动的重建仍易产生伪影且不可靠。本文分析动态场景与扫描硬件之间的相互作用,以识别滤波和数据驱动方法的潜在失效案例。研究结果表明,现有重建方法由于扫描设置引入的空间-时间偏移,易产生系统性误差。为缓解这一问题,我们提出一种动态场景的图像形成模型,显式整合运动偏移。基于此模型,我们构建了一个人体姿态估计基准方法,在极慢扫描速率下仍能实现高精度。
abstract_en: Non-line-of-sight (NLoS) reconstruction, i.e., the task of imaging scenes beyond the camera’s field of view, is often implemented using source-and-sensor systems that scan the visible region and analyze secondary reflections of light that has interacted with the hidden static scene. Estimating human activity around the corner will be a task of major interest for emerging NLoS applications, and some attempts have been reported in the recent literature. However, due to the long exposure times and comprehensive scans needed for NLoS sensing, the reconstruction of continuous movement remains prone to artifacts and is unreliable. In this paper, we analyze the interplay between dynamic scenes and scanning hardware to identify possible failure cases for filtering and data-driven approaches. Our studies indicate that existing reconstruction methods are prone to systematic error due to the space-time skew introduced by scanning setups. To alleviate this issue, we propose an image formation model for dynamic scenes that explicitly integrates motion skew. Using this model, we construct a baseline method for human pose estimation that achieves high accuracy, even at very slow scan rates.

title: Jeeyung Kim*, Ze Wang, Qiang Qiu
title_en: Jeeyung Kim*, Ze Wang, Qiang Qiu
abstract: 提升模型可解释性可以通过揭示模型如何得出预测来解决虚假相关性问题。概念瓶颈模型(CBMs)可以通过人类可理解的概念,以一种原理性的方式揭示和引导模型行为,尽管这需要大量的人力成本进行数据标注。在本文中,我们利用多种基础模型的协同作用,构建几乎无需人工努力的CBMs。我们发现基于预训练模型构建的CBMs存在 undesirable biases(不良偏差),并提出了一种新框架,该框架能够利用预训练模型,同时免疫于这些偏差,从而减少对虚假相关性的依赖。具体而言,我们的方法提供了一个无缝流程,采用基础模型对数据集中的潜在虚假相关性进行评估,对图像进行概念标注,并优化标注以提高鲁棒性。我们在多个数据集上评估了该方法,结果表明其在减少模型对虚假相关性的依赖的同时,能够保持其可解释性。
abstract_en: Enhancing model interpretability can address spurious correlations by revealing how models draw their predictions. Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) can provide a principled way of disclosing and guiding model behaviors through human-understandable concepts, albeit at a high cost of human efforts in data annotation. In this paper, we leverage a synergy of multiple foundation models to construct CBMs with nearly no human effort. We discover undesirable biases in CBMs built on pre-trained models and propose a novel framework designed to exploit pre-trained models while being immune to these biases, thereby reducing vulnerability to spurious correlations. Specifically, our method offers a seamless pipeline that adopts foundation models for assessing potential spurious correlations in datasets, annotating concepts for images, and refining the annotations for improved robustness. We evaluate the proposed method on multiple datasets, and the results demonstrate its effectiveness in reducing model reliance on spurious correlations while preserving its interpretability.

title: Jefferson Hernandez*, Ruben Villegas, Vicente Ordonez
title_en: Jefferson Hernandez*, Ruben Villegas, Vicente Ordonez
abstract: 我们提出了一种结合掩码自编码器(MAE)和对比学习的模型。该模型通过在MAE重建损失下学习的局部特征进行池化,获得全局表示,并在图像和视频帧之间使用对比目标进行训练。我们证明了在该模型下学习的视觉表示在视频和图像分类任务中具有良好的泛化能力。特别是,该模型在ImageNet-1k数据集上,相比最近提出的OmniMAE,在相同数据训练时达到86%的Top-1准确率(+1.3%绝对提升),在额外数据训练时达到87.1%的Top-1准确率(+2.4%绝对提升)。同时,该模型在视频基准测试中超越了大多数其他方法,在具有挑战性的Something something-v2视频基准测试中获得75.9%的Top-1准确率。当在来自多样化数据集的视频和图像上进行训练时,我们的方法在视频和图像分类基准测试之间保持平衡的迁移学习性能,仅略逊于最佳监督方法。
abstract_en: We propose , a model that combines both Masked AutoEncoders (MAE) and contrastive learning. is trained using a global representation obtained by pooling the local features learned under an MAE reconstruction loss and using this representation under a contrastive objective across images and video frames. We show that visual representations learned under generalize well to video and image classification tasks. Particularly, obtains state-of-the-art transfer learning performance from video to images on Imagenet-1k compared to the recently proposed OmniMAE by achieving a top-1 accuracy of 86% (+1.3% absolute improvement) when trained on the same data and 87.1% (+2.4% absolute improvement) when training on extra data. At the same time, outperforms most other methods on video benchmarks by obtaining 75.9% top-1 accuracy on the challenging Something something-v2 video benchmark. When training on videos and images from diverse datasets, our method maintains a balanced transfer-learning performance between video and image classification benchmarks, coming only as a close second to the best-supervised method.

title: Jeffrey Wen*, Rizwan Ahmad, Phillip Schniter
title_en: Jeffrey Wen*, Rizwan Ahmad, Phillip Schniter
abstract: 在成像逆问题中,人们试图从缺失/损坏的测量数据中恢复图像。由于此类问题具有病态性,量化测量与恢复过程引入的不确定性具有重要意义。受恢复图像用于下游任务(如软输出分类)的应用启发,我们提出一种以任务为中心的不确定性量化方法。具体而言,我们使用一致性预测构建一个区间,该区间以用户指定的概率保证包含真实图像的task输出,并通过该区间的宽度量化测量与恢复过程引入的不确定性。对于基于后验采样的图像恢复,我们构建局部自适应预测区间。此外,我们提出在多个轮次中收集测量数据,一旦任务不确定性低于可接受水平即停止。我们在加速磁共振成像(MRI)中验证了该方法:https://github.com/jwen307/TaskUQ。
abstract_en: In imaging inverse problems, one seeks to recover an image from missing/corrupted measurements. Because such problems are ill-posed, there is great motivation to quantify the uncertainty induced by the measurement-and-recovery process. Motivated by applications where the recovered image is used for a downstream task, such as soft-output classification, we propose a task-centered approach to uncertainty quantification. In particular, we use conformal prediction to construct an interval that is guaranteed to contain the task output from the true image up to a user-specified probability, and we use the width of that interval to quantify the uncertainty contributed by measurement-and-recovery. For posterior-sampling-based image recovery, we construct locally adaptive prediction intervals. Furthermore, we propose to collect measurements over multiple rounds, stopping as soon as the task uncertainty falls below an acceptable level. We demonstrate our methodology on accelerated magnetic resonance imaging (MRI): https://github.com/jwen307/TaskUQ.

title: Jens Hellekes*, Manuel Mühlhaus, Reza Bahmanyar, Seyed Majid Azimi, Franz Kurz
title_en: Jens Hellekes*, Manuel Mühlhaus, Reza Bahmanyar, Seyed Majid Azimi, Franz Kurz
abstract: 通过同时考虑时间和空间的变化,可以增强交通分析的信息价值。应用于无人机视频的车辆跟踪算法相比街面监控摄像头能提供更全面的概览。然而,现有的空域多目标跟踪(MOT)数据集仅针对静态场景,移动摄像头场景下覆盖更大区域的性能仍未知。为填补这一空白,我们提出了VETRA数据集,用于空域图像中的车辆跟踪,引入了摄像头运动、帧率以及物体类型、尺寸和数量等方面的异质性。在处理这些挑战时,最先进的在线MOT算法相比其他基准数据集性能有所下降。通过集成摄像头运动补偿和自适应搜索半径,我们的基线算法能够有效应对VETRA固有的移动视野等挑战,尽管仍有进一步改进的潜力。将数据集开源给社区,为车辆跟踪算法在多样化实际应用中的测试与开发提供了缺失的关键基础模块。VETRA可在此下载:https://www.dlr.de/en/eoc/vetra
abstract_en: The informative power of traffic analysis can be enhanced by considering changes in both time and space. Vehicle tracking algorithms applied to drone videos provide a better overview than street-level surveillance cameras. However, existing aerial MOT datasets only address stationary settings, leaving the performance in moving-camera scenarios covering a considerably larger area unknown. To fill this gap, we present VETRA, a dataset for vehicle tracking in aerial imagery introducing heterogeneity in terms of camera movement, frame rate, as well as type, size and number of objects. When dealing with these challenges, state-of-the-art online MOT algorithms experience a decrease in performance compared to other benchmark datasets. The integration of camera motion compensation and an adaptive search radius enables our baseline algorithm to effectively handle the moving field of view and other challenges inherent to VETRA, although potential for further improvement remains. Making the dataset available to the community adds a missing building block for both testing and developing vehicle tracking algorithms for versatile real-world applications. VETRA can be downloaded here: https://www.dlr.de/en/eoc/vetra.

title: Jeongho Kim*, Min-Jung Kim*, Junsoo Lee, Jaegul Choo*
title_en: Jeongho Kim*, Min-Jung Kim*, Junsoo Lee, Jaegul Choo*
abstract: 基于姿态的人体图像动画扩散模型在真实人体视频合成方面展现出显著能力。尽管先前方法取得了有希望的结果,但在实现时间一致的动画和确保与现成姿态检测器的鲁棒性方面仍存在挑战。本文提出了一种基于姿态的人体图像动画方法,该方法对错误姿态具有鲁棒性,并且在时间上保持一致。与先前方法不同,我们利用预训练的ControlNet而无需微调,以利用其从大量姿态-图像-描述对中预获取的广泛知识。为了保持ControlNet冻结,我们将其适配到UNet层,使网络能够在姿态特征和外观特征之间对齐潜在空间。此外,通过引入额外的时间层到ControlNet中,我们增强了对姿态检测器异常值的鲁棒性。通过对时间轴上的注意力图进行分析,我们设计了一种新的温度图,利用姿态信息实现更静态的背景。大量实验表明,所提出的方法在涵盖各种姿态(如chibi)的视频合成任务中取得了有希望的结果。项目页面:https://eccv2024tcan.github.io/
abstract_en: Pose-driven human-image animation diffusion models have shown remarkable capabilities in realistic human video synthesis. Despite the promising results achieved by previous approaches, challenges persist in achieving temporally consistent animation and ensuring robustness with off-the-shelf pose detectors. In this paper, we present , a pose-driven human image animation method that is robust to erroneous poses and consistent over time. In contrast to previous methods, we utilize the pre-trained ControlNet without fine-tuning to leverage its extensive pre-acquired knowledge from numerous pose-image-caption pairs. To keep the ControlNet frozen, we adapt LoRA to the UNet layers, enabling the network to align the latent space between the pose and appearance features. Additionally, by introducing an additional temporal layer to the ControlNet, we enhance robustness against outliers of the pose detector. Through the analysis of attention maps over the temporal axis, we also designed a novel temperature map leveraging pose information, allowing for a more static background. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method can achieve promising results in video synthesis tasks encompassing various poses, like chibi. Project Page: https://eccv2024tcan.github.io/

title: Jeonghyeok Do, Munchurl Kim*
title_en: Jeonghyeok Do, Munchurl Kim*
abstract: 基于骨架的动作识别通过利用骨架数据中关节坐标及其连接关系对人类动作进行分类,在多种场景中被广泛应用。尽管图卷积网络(GCNs)已被提出用于表示为图的骨架数据,但其感受野受限于关节连接性。为解决这一局限性,近期研究引入了基于Transformer的方法。然而,捕捉所有帧中所有关节之间的相关性需要大量内存资源。为此,我们提出了一种名为骨骼-时间Transformer(SkateFormer)的新方法,该方法根据不同的骨骼-时间关系类型(Skate-Type)对关节和帧进行划分,并在每个划分中执行骨骼-时间自注意力(Skate-MSA)。我们将动作识别中的关键骨骼-时间关系分为四种类型。这些类型结合了(i)基于物理邻近和远距离关节的两种骨骼关系类型,以及(ii)基于邻近和远距离帧的两种时间关系类型。通过这种划分特定的注意力策略,我们的SkateFormer能够以高效计算的方式,以动作自适应的方式选择性地关注对动作识别至关重要的关键关节和帧。在多个基准数据集上的大量实验验证了我们的SkateFormer优于近期最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Skeleton-based action recognition, which classifies human actions based on the coordinates of joints and their connectivity within skeleton data, is widely utilized in various scenarios. While Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) have been proposed for skeleton data represented as graphs, they suffer from limited receptive fields constrained by joint connectivity. To address this limitation, recent advancements have introduced transformer-based methods. However, capturing correlations between all joints in all frames requires substantial memory resources. To alleviate this, we propose a novel approach called Skeletal-Temporal Transformer (SkateFormer) that partitions joints and frames based on different types of skeletal-temporal relation (Skate-Type) and performs skeletal-temporal self-attention (Skate-MSA) within each partition. We categorize the key skeletal-temporal relations for action recognition into a total of four distinct types. These types combine (i) two skeletal relation types based on physically neighboring and distant joints, and (ii) two temporal relation types based on neighboring and distant frames. Through this partition-specific attention strategy, our SkateFormer can selectively focus on key joints and frames crucial for action recognition in an action-adaptive manner with efficient computation. Extensive experiments on various benchmark datasets validate that our SkateFormer outperforms recent state-of-the-art methods.

title: Jeongkee Lim, Yusung Kim*
title_en: Jeongkee Lim, Yusung Kim*
abstract: 无监督域适应(UDA)中的语义分割挑战不仅源于源图像与目标图像之间的域迁移,还源于跨域的类别分类法差异。传统UDA研究假设源域与目标域之间分类法一致,从而限制了其识别和适应目标域分类法的能力。本文提出了一种新颖方法——基于视觉语言模型(VLMs)的跨域不一致分类法语义分割(CSI),即使在源域与目标域类别不匹配的情况下也能有效执行域自适应语义分割。CSI利用视觉语言模型(VLMs)的语义泛化潜力,与先前UDA方法形成协同效应。该方法结合传统UDA方法获得的分割推理,以及VLMs中嵌入的丰富语义知识,对目标域中新类别进行重新标记。这种方法无需目标域的地面真实标签即可有效适应扩展分类法。我们的方法在不一致分类法设置(粗粒度到细粒度分类法和开放分类法)的各种基准测试中均表现出色,并在与先前最先进的UDA方法集成时展现出一致的协同效应。实现代码已开源于https://github.com/jkee58/CSI。
abstract_en: The challenge of semantic segmentation in Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) emerges not only from domain shifts between source and target images but also from discrepancies in class taxonomies across domains. Traditional UDA research assumes consistent taxonomy between the source and target domains, thereby limiting their ability to recognize and adapt to the taxonomy of the target domain. This paper introduces a novel approach, Cross-Domain Semantic Segmentation on Inconsistent Taxonomy using Vision Language Models (CSI), which effectively performs domain-adaptive semantic segmentation even in situations of source-target class mismatches. CSI leverages the semantic generalization potential of Visual Language Models (VLMs) to create synergy with previous UDA methods. It leverages segment reasoning obtained through traditional UDA methods, combined with the rich semantic knowledge embedded in VLMs, to relabel new classes in the target domain. This approach allows for effective adaptation to extended taxonomies without requiring any ground truth label for the target domain. Our method has shown to be effective across various benchmarks in situations of inconsistent taxonomy settings (coarse-to-fine taxonomy and open taxonomy) and demonstrates consistent synergy effects when integrated with previous state-of-the-art UDA methods. The implementation is available at https://github.com/jkee58/CSI.

title: Jeongmin Bae, Seoha Kim, Youngsik Yun, Hahyun Lee, Gun Bang, Youngjung Uh*
title_en: Jeongmin Bae, Seoha Kim, Youngsik Yun, Hahyun Lee, Gun Bang, Youngjung Uh*
abstract: 随着三维高斯点云(3DGS)提供快速且高质量的新视角合成,将其变形以表示动态场景是自然的延伸。然而,先前的工作未能准确重建复杂的动态场景。我们将失败归因于变形场的设计,该变形场被构建为基于坐标的函数。这种方法存在问题,因为3DGS是多个以高斯为中心的场的混合,而不仅仅是单一的基于坐标的框架。为了解决这个问题,我们将变形定义为每个高斯嵌入和时间嵌入的函数。此外,我们将变形分解为粗变形和细变形,分别建模缓慢和快速运动。另外,我们引入了针对每个高斯嵌入的局部平滑正则化,以提高动态区域的细节。项目页面:https://jeongminb.github.io/e-d3dgs/
abstract_en: As 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides fast and high-quality novel view synthesis, it is a natural extension to deform a canonical 3DGS to multiple frames for representing a dynamic scene. However, previous works fail to accurately reconstruct complex dynamic scenes. We attribute the failure to the design of the deformation field, which is built as a coordinate-based function. This approach is problematic because 3DGS is a mixture of multiple fields centered at the Gaussians, not just a single coordinate-based framework. To resolve this problem, we define the deformation as a function of per-Gaussian embeddings and temporal embeddings. Moreover, we decompose deformations as coarse and fine deformations to model slow and fast movements, respectively. Also, we introduce a local smoothness regularization for per-Gaussian embedding to improve the details in dynamic regions. Project page: https://jeongminb.github.io/e-d3dgs/

title: Jeongsol Kim, Geon Yeong Park, Jong Chul Ye*
title_en: Jeongsol Kim, Geon Yeong Park, Jong Chul Ye*
abstract: 反向采样和分数蒸馏近年来已成为利用潜在扩散模型(LDMs)进行图像操作的主要方法。虽然反向扩散采样通常需要调整LDM架构或特征工程,但分数蒸馏提供了一种简单而强大的模型无关方法,但容易出现模式坍缩。为了解决这些局限性并利用两种方法的优势,本文提出了一种名为DreamSampler的新框架,通过正则化潜在优化的视角无缝整合这两种不同方法。与分数蒸馏类似,DreamSampler是一种适用于任何LDM架构的模型无关方法,但允许在图像编辑和重建中添加额外指导,实现蒸馏和反向采样。通过涉及图像编辑、SVG重建等实验,我们展示了DreamSampler相比现有方法的竞争力,同时提供了新应用。
abstract_en: Reverse sampling and score-distillation have emerged as main workhorses in recent years for image manipulation using latent diffusion models (LDMs). While reverse diffusion sampling often requires adjustments of LDM architecture or feature engineering, score distillation offers a simple yet powerful model-agnostic approach, but it is often prone to mode-collapsing. To address these limitations and leverage the strengths of both approaches, here we introduce a novel framework called DreamSampler, which seamlessly integrates these two distinct approaches through the lens of regularized latent optimization. Similar to score-distillation, DreamSampler is a model-agnostic approach applicable to any LDM architecture, but it allows both distillation and reverse sampling with additional guidance for image editing and reconstruction. Through experiments involving image editing, SVG reconstruction and etc, we demonstrate the competitive performance of DreamSampler compared to existing approaches, while providing new applications.

title: Jeremy Klotz*, Shree Nayar
title_en: Jeremy Klotz*, Shree Nayar
abstract: 极简视觉系统使用解决视觉任务所需的最小像素数量。虽然传统相机采用大面积的正方形像素网格,但极简相机使用可任意形状的自由形状像素以增加其信息量。我们证明,极简相机的硬件可以建模为神经网络的第一层,后续层用于推理。针对任何给定任务训练网络,可获得相机自由形状像素的形状,每个像素均通过光电探测器和光学掩模实现。我们已设计了三种极简相机:用于监控室内空间(8个像素)、测量房间照明(8个像素)和估计交通流量(8个像素)。这些系统的性能与具有数量级更多像素的传统相机相当。极简视觉具有两大优势。首先,它自然倾向于保护场景中个人的隐私,因为捕获的信息不足以提取视觉细节。其次,由于极简相机的测量数量非常少,我们证明其可以完全自供电,即无需外部电源或电池即可运行。
abstract_en: A minimalist vision system uses the smallest number of pixels needed to solve a vision task. While traditional cameras use a large grid of square pixels, a minimalist camera uses freeform pixels that can take on arbitrary shapes to increase their information content. We show that the hardware of a minimalist camera can be modeled as the first layer of a neural network, where the subsequent layers are used for inference. Training the network for any given task yields the shapes of the camera’s freeform pixels, each of which is implemented using a photodetector and an optical mask. We have designed minimalist cameras for monitoring indoor spaces (with 8 pixels), measuring room lighting (with 8 pixels), and estimating traffic flow (with 8 pixels). The performance demonstrated by these systems is on par with a traditional camera with orders of magnitude more pixels. Minimalist vision has two major advantages. First, it naturally tends to preserve the privacy of individuals in the scene since the captured information is inadequate for extracting visual details. Second, since the number of measurements made by a minimalist camera is very small, we show that it can be fully self-powered, i.e., function without an external power supply or a battery.

title: Jeremy Styborski*, Mingzhi Lyu*, Yi Huang*, Adams Kong*
title_en: Jeremy Styborski*, Mingzhi Lyu*, Yi Huang*, Adams Kong*
abstract: 可用性毒化攻击通过在图像中引入与类别相关的快捷特征,利用监督学习(SL)算法,使得在被污染数据上训练的模型对真实世界数据集无用。自监督学习(SSL)通过利用增强技术学习实例区分,被视为对抗污染数据的强大防御手段。然而,通过在CIFAR-10和ImageNet-100数据集上扩展对多种毒化攻击的研究,我们发现SSL的性能往往较差,远低于在干净数据上训练的性能。利用监督学习对毒化攻击的脆弱性,我们引入对抗训练(AT)于监督学习,以混淆毒化特征并指导SSL的鲁棒特征学习。我们提出的防御方法VESPR(基于监督毒化脆弱性实现鲁棒SSL),在七种流行可用性毒化攻击中超越了六种先前防御方法的性能。VESPR在所有先前防御方法中表现最佳,使被毒化模型的ImageNet-100测试准确率最低值和平均值分别提升了16%和9%。通过分析和消融实验,我们阐明了VESPR如何学习鲁棒的类别特征。代码:https://github.com/JStyborski/VESPR
abstract_en: Availability poisons exploit supervised learning (SL) algorithms by introducing class-related shortcut features in images such that models trained on poisoned data are useless for real-world datasets. Self-supervised learning (SSL), which utilizes augmentations to learn instance discrimination, is regarded as a strong defense against poisoned data. However, by extending the study of SSL across multiple poisons on the CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-100 datasets, we demonstrate that it often performs poorly, far below that of training on clean data. Leveraging the vulnerability of SL to poison attacks, we introduce adversarial training (AT) on SL to obfuscate poison features and guide robust feature learning for SSL. Our proposed defense, designated VESPR (Vulnerability Exploitation of Supervised Poisoning for Robust SSL), surpasses the performance of six previous defenses across seven popular availability poisons. VESPR displays superior performance over all previous defenses, boosting the minimum and average ImageNet-100 test accuracies of poisoned models by 16% and 9%, respectively. Through analysis and ablation studies, we elucidate the mechanisms by which VESPR learns robust class features. Code: https://github.com/JStyborski/ VESPR

title: Ji Ha Jang, Hoigi Seo, Se Young Chun*
title_en: Ji Ha Jang, Hoigi Seo, Se Young Chun*
abstract: 可供性指的是物体固有的潜在交互可能性。可供性感知可以使智能体高效地导航并交互新环境。弱监督可供性定位无需耗费高昂的像素级标注,仅通过外在视角图像即可教授智能体可供性概念。尽管近期弱监督可供性定位取得了 promising results(有前景的结果),但仍存在挑战,包括需要配对的外在视角与第一视角图像数据集,以及对单个物体进行多样化可供性定位的复杂性。为解决这些问题,我们提出 INTRA(INTeraction Relationship-aware weakly supervised Affordance grounding,交互关系感知的弱监督可供性定位)。与以往方法不同,INTRA 将该问题重新定义为表征学习,仅通过外在视角图像进行对比学习以识别交互的独特特征,从而无需配对数据集。此外,我们利用视觉-语言模型嵌入,设计文本条件的可供性图生成方法,通过对比学习反映交互关系,并通过文本同义词增强提升鲁棒性。我们的方法在 AGD20K、IIT-AFF、CAD 和 UMD 等多样化数据集上均优于现有方法。此外,实验结果表明,我们的方法在合成图像/插图中具有显著的领域可扩展性,能够对新颖交互和物体进行可供性定位。项目页面: https://jeeit17.github.io/INTRA
abstract_en: Affordance denotes the potential interactions inherent in objects. The perception of affordance can enable intelligent agents to navigate and interact with new environments efficiently. Weakly supervised affordance grounding teaches agents the concept of affordance without costly pixel-level annotations, but with exocentric images. Although recent advances in weakly supervised affordance grounding yielded promising results, there remain challenges including the requirement for paired exocentric and egocentric image dataset, and the complexity in grounding diverse affordances for a single object. To address them, we propose INTeraction Relationship-aware weakly supervised Affordance grounding (INTRA). Unlike prior arts, INTRA recasts this problem as representation learning to identify unique features of interactions through contrastive learning with exocentric images only, eliminating the need for paired datasets. Moreover, we leverage vision-language model embeddings for performing affordance grounding flexibly with any text, designing text-conditioned affordance map generation to reflect interaction relationship for contrastive learning and enhancing robustness with our text synonym augmentation. Our method outperformed prior arts on diverse datasets such as AGD20K, IIT-AFF, CAD and UMD. Additionally, experimental results demonstrate that our method has remarkable domain scalability for synthesized images / illustrations and is capable of performing affordance grounding for novel interactions and objects. Project page: https://jeeit17. github.io/INTRA

title: Jia Wan*, Qiangqiang Wu, Wei Lin, Antoni Chan
title_en: Jia Wan*, Qiangqiang Wu, Wei Lin, Antoni Chan
abstract: 现有的人群计数模型需要大量训练数据,而标注过程耗时。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种简单而有效的基于Segment-Everything-Everywhere Model(SEEM)的人群计数方法,该模型是Segmentation Anything Model(SAM)的改进版本,用于生成伪标签以训练人群计数模型。然而,我们的初步研究发现,SEEM在密集人群场景中的表现受限,主要由于高密度区域中大量人员被遗漏。为克服这一局限性,我们提出了一种自适应分辨率的SEEM模型,以处理人群场景中的尺度变化、遮挡和人员重叠问题。同时,我们引入了一种基于高斯混合模型的鲁棒定位方法,用于预测预测人员掩码中的头部位置。基于掩码和点伪标签,我们提出了一种鲁棒损失函数,该函数根据SEEM的预测结果排除不确定区域,从而提升计数网络的训练过程。最后,我们提出了一种迭代方法生成伪标签。该方法旨在通过识别高密度区域中常被首次伪标签迭代遗漏的微小人员,提高分割掩码的质量。总体而言,我们提出的方法在无监督人群计数中取得了最佳性能,同时在某些经典监督全监督方法中表现相当。这使其成为一种高效且多用途的人群计数工具,尤其适用于无标注数据的情况。
abstract_en: The existing crowd counting models require extensive training data, which is time-consuming to annotate. To tackle this issue, we propose a simple yet effective crowd counting method by utilizing the Segment-Everything-Everywhere Model (SEEM), an adaptation of the Segmentation Anything Model (SAM), to generate pseudo-labels for training crowd counting models. However, our initial investigation reveals that SEEM’s performance in dense crowd scenes is limited, primarily due to the omission of many persons in high-density areas. To overcome this limitation, we propose an adaptive resolution SEEM to handle the scale variations, occlusions, and overlapping of people within crowd scenes. Alongside this, we introduce a robust localization method, based on Gaussian Mixture Models, for predicting the head positions in the predicted people masks. Given the mask and point pseudo-labels, we propose a robust loss function, which is designed to exclude uncertain regions based on SEEM’s predictions, thereby enhancing the training process of the counting network. Finally, we propose an iterative method for generating pseudo-labels. This method aims at improving the quality of the segmentation masks by identifying more tiny persons in high-density regions, which are often missed in the first pseudo-labeling iteration. Overall, our proposed method achieves the best unsupervised performance in crowd counting, while also being comparable to some classic supervised fully methods. This makes it a highly effective and versatile tool for crowd counting, especially in situations where labeled data is not available.

title: Jia-Hao Xiao, Ming-Kun Xie, Heng-Bo Fan, Gang Niu, Masashi Sugiyama, Sheng-Jun Huang*
title_en: Jia-Hao Xiao, Ming-Kun Xie, Heng-Bo Fan, Gang Niu, Masashi Sugiyama, Sheng-Jun Huang*
abstract: 半监督多标签学习(SSMLL)是一种利用未标记数据降低精确多标签标注收集成本的强大框架。与半监督学习不同,由于实例中包含多重语义,SSMLL无法直接选择最可能的标签作为伪标签。为解决此问题,主流方法开发了有效的阈值策略以生成准确的伪标签。不幸的是,该方法忽视了模型预测质量及其对伪标签性能的潜在影响。本文提出了一种双视角方法以生成高质量伪标签。为提升模型预测质量,我们通过双解耦增强相关性和判别性特征的学习,同时优化伪标签的生成与利用。为获得合适的类别级阈值,我们提出度量自适应阈值策略,通过估计阈值以最大化给定度量下标记数据的伪标签性能。在多个基准数据集上的实验表明,所提方法可达到最先进性能,并显著优于对比方法。实现代码可在JiahaoXxX/SSMLL-D2L MAT获取。
abstract_en: Semi-supervised multi-label learning (SSMLL) is a powerful framework for leveraging unlabeled data to reduce the expensive cost of collecting precise multi-label annotations. Unlike semi-supervised learning, one cannot select the most probable label as the pseudo-label in SSMLL due to multiple semantics contained in an instance. To solve this problem, the mainstream method developed an effective thresholding strategy to generate accurate pseudo-labels. Unfortunately, the method neglected the quality of model predictions and its potential impact on pseudo-labeling performance. In this paper, we propose a dual-perspective method to generate high-quality pseudo-labels. To improve the quality of model predictions, we perform dual-decoupling to boost the learning of correlative and discriminative features, while refining the generation and utilization of pseudo-labels. To obtain proper class-wise thresholds, we propose the metric-adaptive thresholding strategy to estimate the thresholds, which maximize the pseudo-label performance for a given metric on labeled data. Experiments on multiple benchmark datasets show the proposed method can achieve the state-of-the-art performance and outperform the comparative methods with a significant margin. The implementation is available at JiahaoXxX/SSMLL-D2L MAT.

title: Jia-Yi Li, Xi-Le Zhao*, Jian-Li Wang, Chao Wang, Min Wang
title_en: Jia-Yi Li, Xi-Le Zhao*, Jian-Li Wang, Chao Wang, Min Wang
abstract: 近年来,隐式神经表示(INRs)因其在多维数据恢复中的潜力而受到越来越多的关注。然而,INRs仅通过多层感知机(MLP)将坐标映射到对应值,忽略了数据的固有语义信息。为利用数据中的语义先验知识,我们提出了一种新颖的广义超像素引导的INR(S-INR)。具体而言,我们建议使用广义超像素而非像素作为INR处理多维数据(如图像和气象数据)的基本单元。首先将广义超像素的坐标输入到专用的注意力机制多层感知机,随后中间结果与共享字典矩阵进行交互。S-INR中精心设计的模块使我们能够巧妙地利用广义超像素内部及跨超像素的语义信息。在多种应用上的大量实验验证了我们的S-INR相较于现有先进INR方法的有效性和优越性。
abstract_en: Recently, implicit neural representations (INRs) have attracted increasing attention for multi-dimensional data recovery. However, INRs simply map coordinates via a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) to corresponding values, ignoring the inherent semantic information of the data. To leverage semantic priors from the data, we propose a novel Superpixel-informed INR (S-INR). Specifically, we suggest utilizing generalized superpixel instead of pixel as an alternative basic unit of INR for multi-dimensional data (e.g., images and weather data). The coordinates of generalized superpixels are first fed into exclusive attention-based MLPs, and then the intermediate results interact with a shared dictionary matrix. The elaborately designed modules in S-INR allow us to ingenuously exploit the semantic information within and across generalized superpixels. Extensive experiments on various applications validate the effectiveness and efficacy of our S-INR compared to state-of-the-art INR methods.

title: JiaHua Xiao, Yang Liu, Xing Wei*
title_en: JiaHua Xiao, Yang Liu, Xing Wei*
abstract: 在高光谱图像(HSI)中进行适当的光谱建模对于HSI去噪至关重要且极具挑战性。与现有方法在建模长程光谱依赖性时难以兼顾有效性与灵活性,或直接探索空间光谱信息而缺乏区域区分的策略相比,我们引入了RAS2S——一种简单而有效的序列到序列(Seq2Seq)学习框架,以提升HSI去噪效果。RAS2S将HSI去噪视为一个Seq2Seq翻译问题,通过自回归方式将噪声光谱序列转换为干净的光谱序列。此外,缺乏区域区分的空间光谱信息探索与HSI固有的空间光谱多样性相矛盾,导致无关区域产生负面干扰。因此,我们提出了一种新颖的空间光谱区域感知模块,以明确感知具有不同空间光谱表示的语义区域,最大化Seq2Seq学习的光谱建模潜力。通过这种改进的Seq2Seq学习范式,RAS2S不仅在捕捉长程光谱依赖性方面展现出巨大潜力,还能保持处理多样化HSI的灵活性。大量实验表明,RAS2S在模型规模仅为0.08M的情况下,定量和定性上均优于现有最先进方法。源代码可在https: //github.com/MIV-XJTU/RAS2S获取。
abstract_en: Proper spectral modeling within hyperspectral image (HSI) is critical yet highly challenging for HSI denoising. In contrast to existing methods that struggle between effectiveness and flexibility in modeling long-range spectral dependencies and directly explore spatial-spectral information without region discrimination, we introduce RAS2S—a simple yet effective sequence-to-sequence (Seq2Seq) learning framework for better HSI denoising. RAS2S treats HSI denoising as a Seq2Seq translation problem, which converts the noisy spectral sequence to its clean ones in an autoregressive fashion. In addition, spatial-spectral information exploration without region discrimination contradicts the intrinsic spatial-spectral diversity of HSIs, leading to negative interference from spatial-spectral unrelated regions. Thus we propose a novel spatial-spectral region-aware module to distinctively perceive the semantic regions with different spatial-spectral representations, maximizing the spectral modeling potential of Seq2Seq learning. With such an improved Seq2Seq learning paradigm, RAS2S not only shows huge potential in capturing long-range spectral dependencies, but also maintains the flexibility to handle diverse HSIs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RAS2S outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods quantitatively and qualitatively with a minimal model size, merely 0.08M. Source code is available at https: //github.com/MIV-XJTU/RAS2S.

title: Jiabao Wang, Qiang Meng, Guochao Liu, Liujiang Yan, Ke Wang, Ming-Ming Cheng, Qibin Hou*
title_en: Jiabao Wang, Qiang Meng, Guochao Liu, Liujiang Yan, Ke Wang, Ming-Ming Cheng, Qibin Hou*
abstract: 在自动驾驶领域,三维目标检测的时间稳定性对驾驶安全具有重要影响。然而,现有的指标如mAP和MOTA无法评估检测稳定性,因此该领域研究较少。为弥合这一差距,本文提出__TITLE_MATH_1__,一种能够从置信度、框定位、尺寸和方向四个维度全面评估三维检测器稳定性的新指标。通过在Waymo Open Dataset上对最先进的目标检测器进行基准测试,__ABS_MATH_1__揭示了其他指标尚未发现的物体稳定性特性。为进一步帮助模型提升稳定性,我们引入了一种通用且有效的训练策略,称为预测一致性学习(PCL)。PCL本质上鼓励在不同时间戳和增强条件下对同一物体的预测一致性,从而提升检测稳定性。此外,我们通过广泛使用的CenterPoint验证了PCL的有效性,在车辆类别上取得了86.00的显著提升,超越基线5.48。我们希望本文工作能作为可靠基准,并引起学术界对三维目标检测中这一关键问题的关注。
abstract_en: In autonomous driving, the temporal stability of 3D object detection greatly impacts the driving safety. However, the detection stability cannot be accessed by existing metrics such as mAP and MOTA, and consequently is less explored by the community. To bridge this gap, this work proposes (), a new metric that can comprehensively evaluate the stability of 3D detectors in terms of confidence, box localization, extent, and heading. By benchmarking state-of-the-art object detectors on the Waymo Open Dataset, reveals interesting properties of object stability that have not been previously discovered by other metrics. To help models improve their stability, we further introduce a general and effective training strategy, called Prediction Consistency Learning (PCL). PCL essentially encourages the prediction consistency of the same objects under different timestamps and augmentations, leading to enhanced detection stability. Furthermore, we examine the effectiveness of PCL with the widely-used CenterPoint, and achieve a remarkable of 86.00 for vehicle class, surpassing the baseline by 5.48. We hope our work could serve as a reliable baseline and draw the community’s attention to this crucial issue in 3D object detection.

title: 卢佳晨、黄泽、杨泽宇、张佳慧、张立*
title_en: Jiachen Lu, Ze Huang, Zeyu Yang, Zhang Jiahui, Li Zhang*
abstract: 生成多摄像头街景视频对于扩充自动驾驶数据集至关重要,以应对对大量多样化数据的迫切需求。由于传统渲染方法在多样性方面存在局限性,并且在处理光照条件时面临挑战,扩散模型方法正逐渐取代传统方法。然而,扩散模型方法面临的重要挑战是确保生成的传感器数据既保持世界内部一致性,又保持传感器间一致性。为解决这些挑战,我们结合了额外的显式世界体积,并提出()。该系统专门设计,利用4D世界体积作为视频生成的基础元素。我们的模型分为两个阶段:(i) 基于车辆控制序列预想未来的4D时间世界体积;(ii) 通过该预想的4D时间世界体积和传感器互联性生成多摄像头视频。4D世界体积的引入不仅使模型能够根据车辆控制输入生成高质量的街景视频,还能够支持场景编辑任务。
abstract_en: Generating multi-camera street-view videos is critical for augmenting autonomous driving datasets, addressing the urgent demand for extensive and varied data. Due to the limitations in diversity and challenges in handling lighting conditions, traditional rendering-based methods are increasingly being supplanted by diffusion-based methods. However, a significant challenge in diffusion-based methods is ensuring that the generated sensor data preserve both intra-world consistency and inter-sensor coherence. To address these challenges, we combine an additional explicit world volume and propose (). This system is specifically designed to leverage 4D world volume as a foundational element for video generation. Our model operates in two distinct phases: (i) envisioning the future 4D temporal world volume based on vehicle control sequences, and (ii) generating multi-camera videos, informed by this envisioned 4D temporal world volume and sensor interconnectivity. The incorporation of the 4D world volume empowers not only to generate high-quality street-view videos in response to vehicle control inputs but also to facilitate scene editing tasks.

title: Jiacheng Chen*, Yuefan Wu, Jiaqi Tan, Hang Ma, Yasutaka Furukawa*
title_en: Jiacheng Chen*, Yuefan Wu, Jiaqi Tan, Hang Ma, Yasutaka Furukawa*
abstract: 本文提出了一种向量HD映射算法,将映射任务建模为跟踪任务,并利用记忆潜变量的历史记录以确保时间上的一致重建。我们的方法将传感器流累积到两个潜在表示的记忆缓冲区中:1)鸟瞰图(BEV)空间中的栅格潜变量,2)道路元素(如人行横道、车道分隔线和道路边界)上的向量潜变量。该方法借鉴了跟踪文献中的查询传播范式,显式地将前一帧跟踪的道路元素与当前帧关联,同时融合通过距离步长选择的子集记忆潜变量以进一步增强时间一致性。向量潜变量被解码以重建道路元素的几何结构。本文进一步通过以下两个方面做出基准贡献:1)改进现有数据集的处理代码以生成具有时间对齐的一致真实值;2)在现有mAP指标中加入一致性检查。该方法在nuScenes和Agroverse2数据集上分别在传统指标和新一致性感知指标上超过现有方法8%和19%。代码和模型可在我们的项目页面获取:https://map-tracker.github.io。
abstract_en: This paper presents a vector HD-mapping algorithm that formulates the mapping as a tracking task and uses a history of memory latents to ensure consistent reconstructions over time. Our method, , accumulates a sensor stream into memory buffers of two latent representations: 1) Raster latents in the bird’s-eye-view (BEV) space and 2) Vector latents over the road elements (i.e., pedestrian-crossings, lane-dividers, and road-boundaries). The approach borrows the query propagation paradigm from the tracking literature that explicitly associates tracked road elements from the previous frame to the current, while fusing a subset of memory latents selected with distance strides to further enhance temporal consistency. A vector latent is decoded to reconstruct the geometry of a road element. The paper further makes benchmark contributions by 1) Improving processing code for existing datasets to produce consistent ground truth with temporal alignments and 2) Augmenting existing mAP metrics with consistency checks. significantly outperforms existing methods on both nuScenes and Agroverse2 datasets by over 8% and 19% on the conventional and the new consistency-aware metrics, respectively. The code and models are available on our project page: https://map-tracker.github.io.

title: Jiacheng Cheng*, Xiang Dai, Jia Wan, Nick Antipa, Nuno Vasconcelos
title_en: Jiacheng Cheng*, Xiang Dai, Jia Wan, Nick Antipa, Nuno Vasconcelos
abstract: 本文研究了隐私保护相机(PPC)的设计问题。先前的设计依赖于静态点扩散函数(PSF),其优化目标是防止私密视觉信息(如可识别的面部特征)被检测到。然而,PSF 可通过测量相机对点光源的响应轻易恢复,使得这些相机容易受到 PSF 反演攻击。本文提出了一种新的动态隐私保护相机设计,以防止此类攻击。该相机依赖于动态光学元件(如空间光调制器)实现时变 PSF,其在每张图像中都会变化。PSF 通过学习到的流形嵌入随机生成,该嵌入通过对抗训练同时满足用户指定的隐私目标(如人脸识别准确率)和任务效用。在多个隐私保护视觉任务上的实证评估表明,该设计对 PSF 反演攻击显著更鲁棒。此外,通过概念验证相机模型验证了该方法的硬件可行性。
abstract_en: The problem of designing a privacy-preserving camera (PPC) is considered. Previous designs rely on a static point spread function (PSF), optimized to prevent detection of private visual information, such as recognizable facial features. However, the PSF can be easily recovered by measuring the camera response to a point light source, making these cameras vulnerable to PSF inversion attacks. A new dynamic privacy-preserving () camera design is proposed to prevent such attacks. cameras rely on dynamic optical elements, such spatial light modulators, to implement a time-varying PSF, which changes from picture to picture. PSFs are drawn randomly with a learned manifold embedding, trained adversarially to simultaneously meet user-specified targets for privacy, such as face recognition accuracy, and task utility. Empirical evaluations on multiple privacy-preserving vision tasks demonstrate that the design is significantly more robust to PSF inversion attacks than previous PPCs. Furthermore, the hardware feasibility of the approach is validated by a proof-of-concept camera model.

title: Jiacheng Deng*, Jiahao Lu, Tianzhu Zhang
title_en: Jiacheng Deng*, Jiahao Lu, Tianzhu Zhang
abstract: 3D目标检测对于理解三维场景至关重要。当前技术通常需要大量标注的训练数据,但获取点云的点级标注耗时且繁琐。近期半监督方法的发展通过采用教师-学生框架为未标注点云生成伪标签来缓解这一问题。然而,这些伪标签常常存在多样性不足和质量欠佳的问题。为克服这些挑战,我们提出了一种基于智能体的半监督3D目标检测扩散模型(Diff3DETR)。具体而言,设计了一种基于智能体的目标查询生成器,以在采样位置与内容嵌入之间取得平衡,从而有效适应动态场景。此外,一个框感知的去噪模块利用DDIM去噪过程和Transformer解码器中的长程注意力机制,逐步优化边界框。在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D数据集上的大量实验表明,Diff3DETR优于现有的半监督3D目标检测方法。
abstract_en: 3D object detection is essential for understanding 3D scenes. Contemporary techniques often require extensive annotated training data, yet obtaining point-wise annotations for point clouds is time-consuming and laborious. Recent developments in semi-supervised methods seek to mitigate this problem by employing a teacher-student framework to generate pseudo-labels for unlabeled point clouds. However, these pseudo-labels frequently suffer from insufficient diversity and inferior quality. To overcome these hurdles, we introduce an Agent-based Diffusion Model for Semi-supervised 3D Object Detection (Diff3DETR). Specifically, an agent-based object query generator is designed to produce object queries that effectively adapt to dynamic scenes while striking a balance between sampling locations and content embedding. Additionally, a box-aware denoising module utilizes the DDIM denoising process and the long-range attention in the transformer decoder to refine bounding boxes incrementally. Extensive experiments on ScanNet and SUN RGB-D datasets demonstrate that Diff3DETR outperforms state-of-the-art semi-supervised 3D object detection methods.

title: Jiacong Xu*, Mingqian Liao, Ram Prabhakar Kathirvel, Vishal Patel
title_en: Jiacong Xu*, Mingqian Liao, Ram Prabhakar Kathirvel, Vishal Patel
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRF)通过从多视角图像中学习场景的隐式体积表示,实现逼真新视角合成,这些图像忠实地传达了色度信息。然而,传感器噪声会污染低值像素信号,且有损相机图像信号处理器在极端黑暗情况下会进一步去除近零强度值,从而损害合成性能。现有方法从原始图像重建低光场景,但在黑暗区域难以恢复纹理和边界细节。此外,它们不适合依赖显式表示的高速模型。为解决这些问题,我们提出Thermal-NeRF,该方法以热红外和可见光原始图像作为输入,考虑到热红外相机对光照变化具有鲁棒性,且原始图像保留了黑暗环境中的任何可能线索,从而同时实现可见光与热红外视角合成。此外,首个多视角热红外与可见光数据集(MVTV)被建立以支持多模态NeRF研究。Thermal-NeRF在细节保留与噪声平滑之间取得了最佳平衡,且合成性能优于先前工作。最后,我们证明两种模态在三维重建中相互有益。代码和数据集可通过https://github.com/XuJiacong/Thermal-NeRF访问
abstract_en: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) accomplishes photo-realistic novel view synthesis by learning the implicit volumetric representation of a scene from multi-view images, which faithfully convey the colorimetric information. However, sensor noises will contaminate low-value pixel signals, and the lossy camera image signal processor will further remove near-zero intensities in extremely dark situations, deteriorating the synthesis performance. Existing approaches reconstruct low-light scenes from raw images but struggle to recover texture and boundary details in dark regions. Additionally, they are unsuitable for high-speed models relying on explicit representations. To address these issues, we present Thermal-NeRF, which takes thermal and visible raw images as inputs, considering the thermal camera is robust to the illumination variation and raw images preserve any possible clues in the dark, to accomplish visible and thermal view synthesis simultaneously. Also, the first multi-view thermal and visible dataset (MVTV) is established to support the research on multimodal NeRF. Thermal-NeRF achieves the best trade-off between detail preservation and noise smoothing and provides better synthesis performance than previous work. Finally, we demonstrate that both modalities are beneficial to each other in 3D reconstruction. Code and dataset can be accessed via https://github.com/XuJiacong/Thermal-NeRF

title: Jiafeng Mao*, Xueting Wang, Kiyoharu Aizawa
title_en: Jiafeng Mao*, Xueting Wang, Kiyoharu Aizawa
abstract: 文本到图像扩散模型允许用户对生成图像的内容进行控制。然而,文本到图像生成偶尔会导致生成失败,用户需要在相同文本提示下生成数十张图像才能获得满意结果。我们提出了去噪领域的彩票假设:随机初始化的高斯噪声图像包含特殊像素块(中奖票块),这些块天然倾向于独立地去噪为特定内容。标准文本到图像合成中的生成失败是由于初始噪声图像中中奖票块的最优与实际空间分布之间的差距。为此,我们实现了语义驱动的初始图像构建方法,针对提示中提到的每个概念,从已知的中奖票块生成初始噪声。我们进行了一系列实验验证中奖票块的特性,并展示了其在图像和提示中的泛化能力。结果表明,将中奖票块聚合到初始噪声图像中能有效引导模型在对应位置生成指定对象。
abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models allow users control over the content of generated images. Still, text-to-image generation occasionally leads to generation failure requiring users to generate dozens of images under the same text prompt before they obtain a satisfying result. We formulate the lottery ticket hypothesis in denoising: randomly initialized Gaussian noise images contain special pixel blocks (winning tickets) that naturally tend to be denoised into specific content independently. The generation failure in standard text-to-image synthesis is caused by the gap between optimal and actual spatial distribution of winning tickets in initial noisy images. To this end, we implement semantic-driven initial image construction creating initial noise from known winning tickets for each concept mentioned in the prompt. We conduct a series of experiments that verify the properties of winning tickets and demonstrate their generalizability across images and prompts. Our results show that aggregating winning tickets into the initial noise image effectively induce the model to generate the specified object at the corresponding location.

title: Jiafu Chen*, Tianyi Chu, Jiakai Sun, Wei Xing, Lei Zhao
title_en: Jiafu Chen*, Tianyi Chu, Jiakai Sun, Wei Xing, Lei Zhao
abstract: 三维图像修复是计算机视觉与图形学中的一个具有挑战性的任务,旨在移除物体并用与背景视觉连贯且完整的表示填充缺失区域。已有几种方法被提出以解决这一问题,并在图像修复领域取得了显著成果。然而,这些方法尚未完全解决依赖每个视角的掩码所带来的局限性。为每个视角获取掩码可能耗时且会降低质量,尤其是在视角数量较多或场景复杂的情况下。为解决这一局限性,我们提出了一种创新方法,无需每个视角的掩码,而是使用选定视角的单个掩码。我们专注于提升正面视角场景的图像修复质量。通过将单个2D掩码反投影到NeRFs空间中,我们定义了需要修复的三维区域。我们引入了一个两步优化过程。首先,我们利用2D图像修复器为选定视角生成颜色和深度先验,为待修复区域提供粗略监督。其次,我们结合2D扩散模型以提升修复区域的质量,减少失真并提高整体视觉保真度。通过大量实验,我们验证了所提单掩码图像修复框架的有效性。结果表明,我们的方法成功修复了复杂几何结构,并生成了视觉合理且逼真的结果。
abstract_en: 3D inpainting is a challenging task in computer vision and graphics that aims to remove objects and fill in missing regions with a visually coherent and complete representation of the background. A few methods have been proposed to address this problem, yielding notable results in inpainting. However, these methods haven’t perfectly solved the limitation of relying on masks for each view. Obtaining masks for each view can be time-consuming and reduces quality, especially in scenarios with a large number of views or complex scenes. To address this limitation, we propose an innovative approach that eliminates the need for per-view masks and uses a single mask from a selected view. We focus on improving the quality of forward-facing scene inpainting. By unprojecting the single 2D mask into the NeRFs space, we define the regions that require inpainting in three dimensions. We introduce a two-step optimization process. Firstly, we utilize 2D inpainters to generate color and depth priors for the selected view. This provides a rough supervision for the area to be inpainted. Secondly, we incorporate a 2D diffusion model to enhance the quality of the inpainted regions, reducing distortions and elevating the overall visual fidelity. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our single-mask inpainting framework. The results show that our approach successfully inpaints complex geometry and produces visually plausible and realistic outcomes.

title: Jiahao Chang*, Yinglin Xu, Yihao Li, Yuantao Chen, Wensen Feng, Xiaoguang Han
title_en: Jiahao Chang*, Yinglin Xu, Yihao Li, Yuantao Chen, Wensen Feng, Xiaoguang Han
abstract: 点云配准是大规模三维场景扫描与重建中的基础问题。借助深度学习,配准方法已取得显著进展,达到近成熟的阶段。随着神经辐射场(NeRF)的引入,其凭借强大的视图合成能力成为最受欢迎的三维场景表示方法。针对NeRF表示,其在大规模场景重建中也需进行配准。然而,这一领域研究极为匮乏。这主要是由于隐式表示下建模两个场景间的几何关系存在固有挑战。现有方法通常将隐式表示转换为显式表示以进行进一步配准。最近,高斯点云(GS)被引入,采用显式的三维高斯分布。该方法在保持高质量渲染的同时显著提升了渲染速度。鉴于两个场景具有显式的GS表示,在本工作中,我们探索它们之间的三维配准任务。为此,我们提出GaussReg,一种新颖的由粗到精框架,兼具快速与高精度。粗配准阶段遵循现有点云配准方法,对GS生成的点云进行粗略对齐估计。我们进一步提出了一种图像引导的精细配准方法,通过GS渲染图像以提供更详细的几何信息用于精确对齐。为支持全面评估,我们精心构建了一个场景级数据集ScanNet-GSReg(包含从ScanNet数据集中获取的1379个场景)以及一个野外数据集GSReg。实验结果表明,我们的方法在多个数据集上均达到最先进性能。与HLoc(使用SuperPoint作为特征提取器和SuperGlue作为匹配器)相比,GaussReg的速度快44倍且精度相当。
abstract_en: Point cloud registration is a fundamental problem for large-scale 3D scene scanning and reconstruction. With the help of deep learning, registration methods have evolved significantly, reaching a nearly-mature stage. As the introduction of Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), it has become the most popular 3D scene representation as its powerful view synthesis capabilities. Regarding NeRF representation, its registration is also required for large-scale scene reconstruction. However, this topic extremly lacks exploration. This is due to the inherent challenge to model the geometric relationship among two scenes with implicit representations. The existing methods usually convert the implicit representation to explicit representation for further registration. Most recently, Gaussian Splatting (GS) is introduced, employing explicit 3D Gaussian. This method significantly enhances rendering speed while maintaining high rendering quality. Given two scenes with explicit GS representations, in this work, we explore the 3D registration task between them. To this end, we propose GaussReg, a novel coarse-to-fine framework, both fast and accurate. The coarse stage follows existing point cloud registration methods and estimates a rough alignment for point clouds from GS. We further newly present an image-guided fine registration approach, which renders images from GS to provide more detailed geometric information for precise alignment. To support comprehensive evaluation, we carefully build a scene-level dataset called ScanNet-GSReg with 1379 scenes obtained from the ScanNet dataset and collect an in-the-wild dataset called GSReg. Experimental results demonstrate our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple datasets. Our GaussReg is 44× faster than HLoc (SuperPoint as the feature extractor and SuperGlue as the matcher) with comparable accuracy.

title: 李佳和, 张佳伟, 白晓*, 郑金*, 宁欣, 周俊, 顾林
title_en: Jiahe Li, Jiawei Zhang, Xiao Bai*, Jin Zheng*, Xin Ning, Jun Zhou, Lin Gu
abstract: 辐射场在合成逼真的3D说话头像方面表现出色。然而,由于难以拟合陡峭的外观变化,现有方法通过直接修改点外观来表示面部运动的主流范式可能导致动态区域的失真。为解决这一挑战,我们引入了TalkingGaussian,这是一种基于变形的辐射场框架,用于高保真度的说话头像合成。利用基于点的高斯点云技术,我们的方法通过在持久高斯基元上应用平滑且连续的变形来表示面部运动,而无需学习像之前方法那样困难的外观变化。由于这种简化,可以在保持高度完整的面部特征的同时合成精确的面部运动。在这样的变形范式下,我们进一步识别出一种面部-口部运动不一致的问题,这会影响详细说话运动的学习。为了解决这一冲突,我们将模型分解为两个分支,分别处理面部和口部内部区域,从而简化学习任务,帮助重建更准确的口部运动和结构。大量实验表明,我们的方法能够生成高质量的唇同步说话头像视频,与之前的方法相比,在面部保真度和效率方面表现更好。代码可在:https://github.com/Fictionarry/TalkingGaussian 获取。
abstract_en: Radiance fields have demonstrated impressive performance in synthesizing lifelike 3D talking heads. However, due to the difficulty in fitting steep appearance changes, the prevailing paradigm that presents facial motions by directly modifying point appearance may lead to distortions in dynamic regions. To tackle this challenge, we introduce TalkingGaussian, a deformation-based radiance fields framework for high-fidelity talking head synthesis.
