To address this issue, we propose a domain adaptation scheme based on a blurring model to achieve test-time fine-tuning for deblurring models in unseen domains. Since blurred and sharp pairs are unavailable for fine-tuning during inference, our scheme can generate domain-adaptive training pairs to calibrate a deblurring model for the target domain. First, a Relative Sharpness Detection Module is proposed to identify relatively sharp regions from the blurry input images and regard them as pseudo-sharp images. Next, we utilize a blurring model to produce blurred images based on the pseudo-sharp images extracted during testing. To synthesize blurred images in compliance with the target data distribution, we propose a Domain-adaptive Blur Condition Generation Module to create domain-specific blur conditions for the blurring model. Finally, the generated pseudo-sharp and blurred pairs are used to fine-tune a deblurring model for better performance. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our approach can significantly improve state-of-the-art video deblurring methods, providing performance gains of up to 7.54dB on various real-world video deblurring datasets. The source code is available at https://github.com/Jin-Ting-He/DADeblur.

title: 金娜·金*, 李基虎*, 康朱万*
title_en: Jina Kim*, Jihoo Lee*, Jewon Kang*
abstract: 视频神经表示(NeRV)通过神经网络对视频信号进行参数化,引入了一种新颖的方法论。然而,现有的NeRV方法由于频谱偏差问题,在捕捉精细空间细节和运动模式时存在困难,其中神经网络学习高频(HF)成分的速度慢于低频(LF)成分。本文提出了一种频谱保持NeRV(SNeRV),作为增强隐式视频表示的新方法,通过高效处理各种频率成分来提升性能。SNeRV利用二维离散小波变换(DWT)将视频分解为LF和HF特征,保留空间结构并直接解决频谱偏差问题。为平衡紧凑性,我们仅对LF成分进行编码,而包含精细纹理的HF成分由解码器生成。多分辨率融合单元(MFU)和高频修复器(HFR)等专用模块被集成到主干网络中,以促进表示。此外,我们将SNeRV扩展到有效捕捉相邻视频帧之间的时间相关性,通过将扩展视为对时间域的额外频率分解。这种方法允许我们使用时间扩展上采样块(TUBs)将时空LF特征嵌入网络。实验结果表明,SNeRV在捕捉细节方面优于现有NeRV模型,并实现了增强的重建效果,使其在隐式视频表示领域具有广阔前景。代码可在https: //github.com/qwertja/SNeRV获取。
abstract_en: Neural representation for video (NeRV), which employs a neural network to parameterize video signals, introduces a novel methodology in video representations. However, existing NeRV-based methods have difficulty in capturing fine spatial details and motion patterns due to spectral bias, in which a neural network learns high-frequency (HF) components at a slower rate than low-frequency (LF) components. In this paper, we propose spectra-preserving NeRV (SNeRV) as a novel approach to enhance implicit video representations by efficiently handling various frequency components. SNeRV uses 2D discrete wavelet transform (DWT) to decompose video into LF and HF features, preserving spatial structures and directly addressing the spectral bias issue. To balance the compactness, we encode only the LF components, while HF components that include fine textures are generated by a decoder. Specialized modules, including a multi-resolution fusion unit (MFU) and a high-frequency restorer (HFR), are integrated into a backbone to facilitate the representation. Furthermore, we extend SNeRV to effectively capture temporal correlations between adjacent video frames, by casting the extension as additional frequency decomposition to a temporal domain. This approach allows us to embed spatio-temporal LF features into the network, using temporally extended up-sampling blocks (TUBs). Experimental results demonstrate that SNeRV outperforms existing NeRV models in capturing fine details and achieves enhanced reconstruction, making it a promising approach in the field of implicit video representations. The codes are available at https: //github.com/qwertja/SNeRV.

title: Jinbo Xing*, Menghan Xia, Yong Zhang, Haoxin Chen, Wangbo Yu, Hanyuan Liu, Gongye Liu, Xintao Wang, Ying Shan, Tien-Tsin Wong
title_en: Jinbo Xing*, Menghan Xia, Yong Zhang, Haoxin Chen, Wangbo Yu, Hanyuan Liu, Gongye Liu, Xintao Wang, Ying Shan, Tien-Tsin Wong
abstract: 对静态图像进行动画化可以提供引人入胜的视觉体验。传统图像动画技术主要聚焦于通过随机动态(如云层和流体)或领域特定运动(如人体发丝或身体动作)来动画化自然场景,因此限制了其在更广泛视觉内容中的适用性。为克服这一局限性,我们探索了开放域图像的动态内容合成,将其转换为动画视频。关键思想是通过将图像作为引导信息融入生成过程,利用文本到视频扩散模型的运动先验知识。给定一幅图像,我们首先使用查询Transformer将其投影到与文本对齐的丰富图像上下文表征空间,这有助于视频模型以兼容的方式消化图像内容。然而,部分视觉细节在生成的视频中仍难以被保留。为补充更精确的图像信息,我们进一步通过将图像与初始噪声拼接后输入扩散模型。实验结果表明,所提出的方法能够生成视觉上令人信服且更符合逻辑与自然的运动,同时更符合输入图像。对比评估验证了我们的方法相较于现有竞争方案具有显著优势。
abstract_en: Animating a still image offers an engaging visual experience. Traditional image animation techniques mainly focus on animating natural scenes with stochastic dynamics (e.g. clouds and fluid) or domain-specific motions (e.g. human hair or body motions), and thus limits their applicability to more general visual content. To overcome this limitation, we explore the synthesis of dynamic content for open-domain images, converting them into animated videos. The key idea is to utilize the motion prior of text-to-video diffusion models by incorporating the image into the generative process as guidance. Given an image, we first project it into a text-aligned rich image context representation space using a query Transformer, which facilitates the video model to digest the image content in a compatible fashion. However, some visual details still struggle to be preserved in the resultant videos. To supplement with more precise image information, we further feed the full image to the diffusion model by concatenating it with the initial noises. Experimental results show that our proposed method can produce visually convincing and more logical & natural motions, as well as higher conformity to the input image. Comparative evaluation demonstrates the notable superiority of our approach over existing competitors.

title: Jincen Jiang, Qianyu Zhou, Yuhang Li, Xuequan Lu*, Meili Wang*, Lizhuang Ma, Jian Chang, Jian Jun Zhang
title_en: Jincen Jiang, Qianyu Zhou, Yuhang Li, Xuequan Lu*, Meili Wang*, Lizhuang Ma, Jian Chang, Jian Jun Zhang
abstract: 近期点云理解研究在未见数据上表现出性能下降,这是由于不同领域间的分布偏移所致。尽管近期研究采用领域泛化(Domain Generalization, DG)技术通过学习领域不变特征来缓解这一问题,但大多数方法仅针对单一任务设计,忽视了测试数据的潜在价值。尽管上下文学习(In-Context Learning, ICL)展现出多任务学习能力,但其通常依赖高质量的上下文丰富数据,仅考虑单一数据集,并且在点云理解领域鲜有研究。本文提出了一种新颖且实用的多领域多任务设置,通过统一模型处理多个领域和多个任务,实现领域泛化的点云理解。为此,我们提出领域泛化点云上下文学习(Domain Generalized Point-In-Context Learning, DG-PIC),在测试时提升跨任务和跨领域的泛化能力。具体而言,我们开发了双级源原型估计方法,同时考虑全局形状上下文和局部几何结构以表征源领域,并设计了双级测试时特征迁移机制,利用宏观领域语义信息和微观补丁位置关系,使目标数据在测试时更接近源数据。我们的DG-PIC无需在测试时进行模型更新,即可处理未见领域和多个任务(如点云重建、去噪和配准),并在统一模型中实现。我们还引入了针对该新设置的基准测试。综合实验表明,DG-PIC显著优于现有最先进的技术。
abstract_en: Recent point cloud understanding research suffers from performance drops on unseen data, due to the distribution shifts across different domains. While recent studies use Domain Generalization (DG) techniques to mitigate this by learning domain-invariant features, most are designed for a single task and neglect the potential of testing data. Despite In-Context Learning (ICL) showcasing multi-task learning capability, it usually relies on high-quality context-rich data and considers a single dataset, and has rarely been studied in point cloud understanding. In this paper, we introduce a novel, practical, multi-domain multi-task setting, handling multiple domains and multiple tasks within one unified model for domain generalized point cloud understanding. To this end, we propose Domain Generalized Point-In-Context Learning (DG-PIC) that boosts the generalizability across various tasks and domains at testing time. In particular, we develop dual-level source prototype estimation that considers both global-level shape contextual and local-level geometrical structures for representing source domains and a dual-level test-time feature shifting mechanism that leverages both macro-level domain semantic information and micro-level patch positional relationships to pull the target data closer to the source ones during the testing. Our DG-PIC does not require any model updates during the testing and can handle unseen domains and multiple tasks, i.e., point cloud reconstruction, denoising, and registration, within one unified model. We also introduce a benchmark for this new setting. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that DG-PIC outperforms state-of-the-art techniques significantly.

title: Jinfeng Liu*, Lingtong Kong, Bo Li, Zerong Wang, Hong Gu, Jinwei Chen
title_en: Jinfeng Liu*, Lingtong Kong, Bo Li, Zerong Wang, Hong Gu, Jinwei Chen
abstract: 自监督单目深度估计因其无需依赖深度标注即可进行训练而受到广泛关注。在单目视频训练场景中,现有方法仅在现有相机视角之间进行视图合成,导致指导信息不足。为解决这一问题,我们尝试通过基于光流的视频帧插值(VFI)合成更多虚拟相机视角,称为时间增强。对于多帧推理,为避免像ManyDepth等基于显式几何的方法遇到的动态物体问题,我们回归特征融合范式,设计了一个VFI辅助的多帧融合模块,利用基于光流的VFI模型获取的运动和遮挡信息对多帧特征进行对齐与聚合。最终,我们构建了一个统一的自监督学习框架,命名为Mono-ViFI,用于单帧与多帧深度的双向连接。在该框架中,通过图像仿射变换进行空间数据增强以提升数据多样性,并引入三元组深度一致性损失进行正则化。单帧与多帧模型可共享权重,使我们的框架更加紧凑且内存高效。大量实验表明,我们的方法在当前先进架构上实现了显著提升。源代码可在https://github.com/LiuJF1226/Mono-ViFI获取。
abstract_en: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation has gathered notable interest since it can liberate training from dependency on depth annotations. In monocular video training case, recent methods only conduct view synthesis between existing camera views, leading to insufficient guidance. To tackle this, we try to synthesize more virtual camera views by flow-based video frame interpolation (VFI), termed as temporal augmentation. For multi-frame inference, to sidestep the problem of dynamic objects encountered by explicit geometry-based methods like ManyDepth, we return to the feature fusion paradigm and design a VFI-assisted multi-frame fusion module to align and aggregate multi-frame features, using motion and occlusion information obtained by the flow-based VFI model. Finally, we construct a unified self-supervised learning framework, named Mono-ViFI, to bilaterally connect single- and multi-frame depth. In this framework, spatial data augmentation through image affine transformation is incorporated for data diversity, along with a triplet depth consistency loss for regularization. The single- and multi-frame models can share weights, making our framework compact and memory-efficient. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method can bring significant improvements to current advanced architectures. Source code is available at https://github.com/LiuJF1226/Mono-ViFI.

title: Jing Gu*, Nanxuan Zhao, Wei Xiong, Qing Liu, Zhifei Zhang, He Zhang, Jianming Zhang, HyunJoon Jung, Yilin Wang*, Xin Eric Wang*
title_en: Jing Gu*, Nanxuan Zhao, Wei Xiong, Qing Liu, Zhifei Zhang, He Zhang, Jianming Zhang, HyunJoon Jung, Yilin Wang*, Xin Eric Wang*
abstract: 有效编辑个人内容在使个体表达创造力、在其视觉故事中编织引人入胜的叙事以及提升视觉内容的整体质量与影响力方面发挥着关键作用。因此,在本工作中,我们引入__TITLE_MATH_1__,一种新颖框架,可在保持上下文不变的前提下,将图像中的任意对象替换为参考提供的个性化概念。与现有个性化主体替换方法相比,__TITLE_MATH_1__具有三个独特优势:(1) 对任意对象和部件而非主体进行精确控制,(2) 更忠实保留上下文像素,(3) 更好地将个性化概念适配到图像中。首先,我们提出目标变量替换,通过区域控制潜在特征图并交换掩码变量,实现对上下文的忠实保留和初始语义概念替换。随后,我们引入外观适应机制,使语义概念在图像生成过程中无缝适配到目标位置、形状、风格和内容。在人类和自动评估的大量实验结果表明,我们的方法在个性化替换任务中显著优于基线方法。此外,__TITLE_MATH_1__在单对象、多对象、部分对象及跨域替换任务中展现出精确且忠实的替换能力。__TITLE_MATH_1__在基于文本的替换任务及其他超越替换的场景(如物体插入)中也表现出卓越性能。
abstract_en: Effective editing of personal content holds a pivotal role in enabling individuals to express their creativity, weaving captivating narratives within their visual stories, and elevate the overall quality and impact of their visual content. Therefore, in this work, we introduce , a novel framework that can swap any objects in an image with personalized concepts given by the reference, while keeping the context unchanged. Compared with existing methods for personalized subject swapping, has three unique advantages: (1) precise control of arbitrary objects and parts rather than the main subject, (2) more faithful preservation of context pixels, (3) better adaptation of the personalized concept to the image. First, we propose targeted variable swapping to apply region control over latent feature maps and swap masked variables for faithful context preservation and initial semantic concept swapping. Then, we introduce appearance adaptation, to seamlessly adapt the semantic concept into the original image in terms of target location, shape, style, and content during the image generation process. Extensive results on both human and automatic evaluation demonstrate significant improvements of our approach over baseline methods on personalized swapping. Furthermore, shows its precise and faithful swapping abilities across single object, multiple objects, partial object, and cross-domain swapping tasks. also achieves great performance on text-based swapping and tasks beyond swapping such as object insertion.

title: Jing Li, Di Kang, Zhenyu He*
title_en: Jing Li, Di Kang, Zhenyu He*
abstract: 基于深度学习的多视角面部捕捉方法在准确性和速度上均表现出色,其速度比传统网格配准流程快几个数量级。然而,现有系统(如TEMPEH)严格受限于仅能对训练数据所使用的相同相机阵列进行推理。本研究旨在提升模型的泛化能力,使训练好的模型能够方便地在不同相机阵列上进行推理(即捕捉新数据)。为此,我们提出了一种更具泛化性的初始化模块,用于提取与相机阵列无关的3D特征,包括基于视觉凸包的头部定位模块和基于视觉凸包的可见性感知3D特征聚合模块。此外,我们提出了一种“基于分歧的更新”学习策略,通过在训练过程中丢弃潜在不准确的监督信号,更好地处理数据噪声(如不准确的配准、扫描噪声)。所提出的可泛化且鲁棒的拓扑一致多视角面部捕捉系统(__TITLE_MATH_1__)可方便地用于不同相机阵列的数据捕捉,大幅减少数据采集与处理的工作量。在FaMoS和FaceScape数据集上的实验验证了所提方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Deep learning-based multi-view facial capture methods have shown impressive accuracy while being several orders of magnitude faster than a traditional mesh registration pipeline. However, the existing systems (e.g. TEMPEH) are strictly restricted to inference on the data captured by the same camera array used to capture their training data. In this study, we aim to improve the generalization ability so that a trained model can be readily used for inference (i.e. capture new data) on a different camera array. To this end, we propose a more generalizable initialization module to extract the camera array-agnostic 3D feature, including a visual hull-based head localization and a visibility-aware 3D feature aggregation module enabled by the visual hull. In addition, we propose an “update-by-disagreement” learning strategy to better handle data noise (e.g. inaccurate registration, scan noise) by discarding potentially inaccurate supervision signals during training. The resultant generalizable and robust topologically consistent multi-view facial capture system () can be readily used to capture data on a different camera array, reducing great effort on data collection and processing. Experiments on the FaMoS and FaceScape datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

title: Jing Li, Junsong Fan*, Zhaoxiang Zhang*
title_en: Jing Li, Junsong Fan*, Zhaoxiang Zhang*
abstract: 为弥合点标签与逐像素标签之间的差距,现有基于点监督的全景分割方法通常通过基于规则的像素到实例距离,将未标记像素分配到对应实例以估计密集伪标签。这些距离无法通过点标签端到端优化,通常为次优结果,导致伪标签不准确。本文提出基于可学习距离分配未标记像素到对应实例。具体而言,我们将每个实例表示为锚查询,通过距离分支利用锚查询与像素特征之间的交叉注意力预测像素到实例距离,该预测距离由点标签端到端监督。为确保每个查询能准确表征对应实例,我们通过查询聚合和查询增强过程迭代优化锚查询,随后利用这些查询预测改进后的距离结果和伪标签。我们通过实验验证了所提方法的有效性,并取得了最先进结果。
abstract_en: To bridge the gap between point labels and per-pixel labels, existing point-supervised panoptic segmentation methods usually estimate dense pseudo labels by assigning unlabeled pixels to corresponding instances according to rule-based pixel-to-instance distances. These distances cannot be optimized by point labels end to end and are usually suboptimal, which result in inaccurate pseudo labels. Here we propose to assign unlabeled pixels to corresponding instances based on a learnable distance. Specifically, we represent each instance as an anchor query, then predict the pixel-to-instance distance based on the cross-attention between anchor queries and pixel features through a distance branch, the predicted distance is supervised by point labels end to end. In order that each query can accurately represent the corresponding instance, we iteratively improve anchor queries through query aggregating and query enhancing processes, then improved distance results and pseudo labels are predicted with these queries. We have experimentally demonstrated the effectiveness of our approach and achieved state-of-the-art results.

title: Jing Wu*, Jia-Wang Bian, Xinghui Li, Guangrun Wang, Ian Reid, Philip Torr, Victor Adrian Prisacariu*
title_en: Jing Wu*, Jia-Wang Bian, Xinghui Li, Guangrun Wang, Ian Reid, Philip Torr, Victor Adrian Prisacariu*
abstract: 我们提出了一种文本驱动的方法,用于编辑由三维高斯泼溅(3DGS)重建的三维场景。我们的方法首先利用3DGS渲染一组图像,并基于输入提示使用预训练的2D扩散模型(ControlNet)对这些图像进行编辑,随后利用该编辑结果优化3D模型。我们的关键贡献是多视角一致编辑,它能够同时编辑所有图像,而非如以往方法那样逐个图像迭代编辑并更新3D模型。这使得编辑速度更快且视觉质量更高。这是通过以下两个术语实现的:(a) 深度条件编辑,通过利用自然一致的深度图,在多视角图像间强制几何一致性;(b) 基于注意力的潜在代码对齐,通过图像潜在表示之间的自视角和跨视角注意力,将编辑图像的外观统一到多个参考视角。实验表明,我们的方法在编辑速度和视觉效果上均优于先前的最先进方法。项目网站:https://gaussctrl.active.vision/
abstract_en: We propose , a text-driven method to edit a 3D scene reconstructed by the 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). Our method first renders a collection of images by using the 3DGS and edits them by using a pre-trained 2D diffusion model (ControlNet) based on the input prompt, which is then used to optimise the 3D model. Our key contribution is multi-view consistent editing, which enables editing all images together instead of iteratively editing one image while updating the 3D model as in previous works. It leads to faster editing as well as higher visual quality. This is achieved by the two terms: (a) depth-conditioned editing that enforces geometric consistency across multi-view images by leveraging naturally consistent depth maps. (b) attention-based latent code alignment that unifies the appearance of edited images by conditioning their editing to several reference views through self and cross-view attention between images’ latent representations. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves faster editing and better visual results than previous state-of-the-art methods. Project website: https://gaussctrl.active.vision/

title: Jing Wu*, Mehrtash Harandi
title_en: Jing Wu*, Mehrtash Harandi
abstract: 机器反学习已成为消除训练模型中数据影响的关键任务。它遵循最新的数据监管标准,提升机器学习应用的隐私和安全性。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新的机器反学习方法。首先,通过连接敏感度识别给定模型中与遗忘数据最相关的参数。通过重新初始化这些参数中最具影响力的前k%参数,获得一个用于消除遗忘数据影响的修剪模型。随后,采用基于梯度投影的方法对修剪模型进行微调,寻求在保留剩余数据信息的同时剔除与遗忘数据相关信息的参数。我们的实验结果在图像分类和图像生成任务中表明,该方法与现有方法相比展现出竞争力。源代码可在https://github.com/JingWu321/Scissorhands.0.0.1获取。Warning: 本文包含可能令人反感的露骨性影像。
abstract_en: Machine unlearning has become a pivotal task to erase the influence of data from a trained model. It adheres to recent data regulation standards and enhances the privacy and security of machine learning applications. In this work, we present a new machine unlearning approach . Initially, identifies the most pertinent parameters in the given model relative to the forgetting data via connection sensitivity. By reinitializing the most influential top-k percent of these parameters, a trimmed model for erasing the influence of the forgetting data is obtained. Subsequently, fine-tunes the trimmed model with a gradient projection-based approach, seeking parameters that preserve information on the remaining data while discarding information related to the forgetting data. Our experimental results, conducted across image classification and image generation tasks, demonstrate that , showcases competitive performance when compared to existing methods. Source code is available at https://github.com/JingWu321/ Scissorhands. 0.0.1 Warning: This paper contains explicit sexual imagery that may be offensive.

title: 张婧,郑亮*,王萌,郭丹*
title_en: Jing Zhang, Liang Zheng*, Meng Wang, Dan Guo*
abstract: 本文开发了小型视觉语言模型以理解视觉艺术,该模型在给定艺术作品时,旨在识别其情感类别并用自然语言解释这一预测。尽管小型模型计算效率高,但其容量相比大型模型受到很大限制。为突破这一权衡,本文通过情感建模和输入输出特征对齐构建了小型情感视觉语言模型(SEVLM)。一方面,基于心理学专家标注的效价-唤醒-控制(VAD)知识,我们引入并融合通过VAD词典和VAD头提取的情感特征,以对齐预测情感解释的VAD向量与真实值。这使得视觉语言模型相比仅使用传统文本嵌入,能够更好地理解和生成情感文本。另一方面,我们设计了对比头以拉近图像、其情感类别和解释的嵌入,从而对齐模型输出与输入。在两个公开的情感解释数据集上,我们证明所提出的技术持续提升了基线SEVLM的视觉艺术理解性能。重要的是,所提出的模型可在单块RTX 2080 Ti上训练和评估,同时表现出非常强的性能:它不仅优于当前最先进的小型模型,经过微调后还与LLaVA 7B和GPT4(V)具有竞争力。代码可在https://github.com/BetterZH/SEVLM-获取。
abstract_en: This paper develops small vision language models to understand visual art, which, given an art work, aims to identify its emotion category and explain this prediction with natural language. While small models are computationally efficient, their capacity is much limited compared with large models. To break this trade-off, this paper builds a small emotional vision language model (SEVLM) by emotion modeling and input-output feature alignment. On the one hand, based on valence-arousal-dominance (VAD) knowledge annotated by psychology experts, we introduce and fuse emotional features derived through VAD dictionary and a VAD head to align VAD vectors of predicted emotion explanation and the ground truth. This allows the vision language model to better understand and generate emotional texts, compared with using traditional text embeddings alone. On the other hand, we design a contrastive head to pull close embeddings of the image, its emotion class, and explanation, which aligns model outputs and inputs. On two public affective explanation datasets, we show that the proposed techniques consistently improve the visual art understanding performance of baseline SEVLMs. Importantly, the proposed model can be trained and evaluated on a single RTX 2080 Ti while exhibiting very strong performance: it not only outperforms the state-of-the-art small models but is also competitive compared with LLaVA 7B after fine-tuning and GPT4(V). The code is available at https://github.com/BetterZH/SEVLM-

title: 杨景文、孙佳慕、杨永亮、杨杰、山英、曹燕培、高林*
title_en: Jing-Wen Yang, Jia-Mu Sun, Yong-Liang Yang, Jie Yang, Ying Shan, Yan-Pei Cao, Lin Gao*
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRF)在包含可变形物体的动态场景中取得了显著进展。然而,大多数先前的工作需要多视角输入或长时间训练(数小时),使得它们难以应用于现实场景。近期致力于解决模糊伪影的工作可能在不同分辨率渲染时,难以在保持高频细节的同时预测稳定且准确的形变。为此,我们引入了一种新颖的框架DMiT(可变形多级渐进三平面),该框架采用mipmap技术,从新视角渲染不同分辨率的动态场景。借助分层的多级渐进三平面,我们引入了一个MLP,有效预测观察空间与规范空间之间的映射,不仅实现了高保真动态场景渲染,还支持高性能的训练和推理。此外,设计了一种联合几何和形变优化的训练方案,用于规范正则化,以重建高质量的几何结构。在合成和真实动态场景上的大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性和效率。
abstract_en: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) have achieved remarkable progress on dynamic scenes with deformable objects. Nonetheless, most previous works required multi-view inputs or long training time (several hours), making it hard to apply them for real-world scenarios. Recent works dedicated to addressing blurry artifacts may fail to predict stable and accurate deformation while keeping high-frequency details when rendering at various resolutions. To this end, we introduce a novel framework DMiT (Deformable Mipmapped Tri-Plane) that adopts the mipmaps to render dynamic scenes at various resolutions from novel views. With the help of hierarchical mipmapped tri-planes, we incorporate an MLP to effectively predict a mapping between the observation space and the canonical space, enabling not only high-fidelity dynamic scene rendering but also high-performance training and inference. Moreover, a training scheme for joint geometry and deformation refinement is designed for canonical regularization to reconstruct high-quality geometries. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real dynamic scenes demonstrate the efficacy and efficiency of our method.

title: Jingfan Guo, Jae Shin Yoon, Shunsuke Saito, Takaaki Shiratori, Hyun Soo Park*
title_en: Jingfan Guo, Jae Shin Yoon, Shunsuke Saito, Takaaki Shiratori, Hyun Soo Park*
abstract: 本文提出了一种可泛化的模型,通过从真实数据中学习,合成高保真度的3D服装褶皱变形。鉴于现实世界服装复杂的变形行为,该任务面临显著挑战,主要由于缺乏准确的地面真实数据。获取高保真度的3D变形需要特殊设备如多摄像头系统,这难以大规模扩展。为解决这一挑战,我们将服装分解为基底表面和细小褶皱,并引入一种新方法,能够从粗略服装变形中生成高频率的3D位移褶皱。我们的方法基于Green-Lagrange应变场——一种局部旋转不变的测量指标,与身体和服装拓扑无关,从而增强其泛化能力。利用有限的真实数据(例如3K)的服装网格,我们训练了一个扩散模型,该模型可根据其应变场从粗略服装网格生成高保真度褶皱。在实践中,我们使用体条件化的变分自编码器(VAE)获取粗略服装网格,确保变形与身体姿态的兼容性。在实验中,我们证明了我们的生成褶皱模型在合成新颖身体姿态和服装的高保真度褶皱变形方面优于现有方法,同时保持与训练数据相当的质量。
abstract_en: This paper proposes a generalizable model to synthesize high-fidelity clothing wrinkle deformation in 3D by learning from real data. Given the complex deformation behaviors of real-world clothing, this task presents significant challenges, primarily due to the lack of accurate ground-truth data. Obtaining high-fidelity 3D deformations requires special equipment like a multi-camera system, which is not easily scalable. To address this challenge, we decompose the clothing into a base surface and fine wrinkles; and introduce a new method that can generate wrinkles as high-frequency 3D displacement from coarse clothing deformation. Our method is conditioned by Green-Lagrange strain field—a local rotation-invariant measurement that is independent of body and clothing topology, enhancing its generalizability. Using limited real data (e.g., 3K) of garment meshes, we train a diffusion model that can generate high-fidelity wrinkles from a coarse clothing mesh, conditioned on its strain field. Practically, we obtain the coarse clothing mesh using a body-conditioned VAE, ensuring compatibility of the deformation with the body pose. In our experiments, we demonstrate that our generative wrinkle model outperforms existing methods by synthesizing high-fidelity wrinkle deformation from novel body poses and clothing while preserving the quality comparable to the one from training data.

title: Jinghang Li, Bangyan Liao, Xiuyuan Lu, Peidong Liu, Shaojie Shen, Yi Zhou*
title_en: Jinghang Li, Bangyan Liao, Xiuyuan Lu, Peidong Liu, Shaojie Shen, Yi Zhou*
abstract: 预测与前车潜在碰撞是任何自动驾驶/辅助驾驶系统的基本功能。现有基于视觉的解决方案的一个瓶颈是其更新率受限于标准相机的帧率。本文提出了一种新颖的方法,利用神经形态事件相机估计碰撞时间,该相机是一种生物启发式视觉传感器,能够以与场景动态完全相同的速度进行感知。所提出算法的核心是一个两步方法,通过粗到细的方式对事件数据进行高效且精确的几何模型拟合。第一步是基于新颖几何测量的鲁棒线性求解器,克服了基于事件的法线流的部分可观测性。第二步通过时空配准过程进一步优化所得模型,该过程被表述为非线性优化问题。在合成数据和真实数据上的实验验证了所提方法的有效性,在效率和准确性方面均优于其他替代方法。本文使用的数据集可在https://nail-hnu.github.io/EventAidedTTC/获取。
abstract_en: Predicting a potential collision with leading vehicles is an essential functionality of any autonomous/assisted driving system. One bottleneck of existing vision-based solutions is that their updating rate is limited to the frame rate of standard cameras used. In this paper, we present a novel method that estimates the time to collision using a neuromorphic event-based camera, a biologically inspired visual sensor that can sense at exactly the same rate as scene dynamics. The core of the proposed algorithm consists of a two-step approach for efficient and accurate geometric model fitting on event data in a coarse-to-fine manner. The first step is a robust linear solver based on a novel geometric measurement that overcomes the partial observability of event-based normal flow. The second step further refines the resulting model via a spatio-temporal registration process formulated as a nonlinear optimization problem. Experiments on both synthetic and real data demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, outperforming other alternative methods in terms of efficiency and accuracy. Dataset used in this paper can be found at https://nail-hnu.github.io/EventAidedTTC/.

title: Jinghao Zhou*, Tomas Jakab, Philip Torr, Christian Rupprecht
title_en: Jinghao Zhou*, Tomas Jakab, Philip Torr, Christian Rupprecht
abstract: 近年来,三维生成模型取得了显著进展,能够从文本或图像输入中生成几乎任意的三维资产。然而,这些方法在生成物体时未考虑其最终所处的场景。本文提出了一种框架,允许对现有三维资产进行风格化处理,使其适应给定的二维场景,并生成逼真的构图,仿佛该资产已融入环境。这不仅为物体风格化提供了新的控制层级,例如相同资产可根据环境变化进行风格化(如从夏季到冬季,或奇幻与未来主义场景),还使物体与场景的构图更加可控。我们通过结合可微分光线追踪与预训练文本到图像扩散模型的图像先验,对物体的纹理和环境光照进行建模与优化。我们证明该方法适用于各种室内和室外场景及任意物体。详见我们的项目页面。
abstract_en: Recently, 3D generative models have made impressive progress, enabling the generation of almost arbitrary 3D assets from text or image inputs. However, these approaches generate objects in isolation without any consideration for the scene where they will eventually be placed. In this paper, we propose a framework that allows for the stylization of an existing 3D asset to fit into a given 2D scene, and additionally produce a photorealistic composition as if the asset was placed within the environment. This not only opens up a new level of control for object stylization, for example, the same assets can be stylized to reflect changes in the environment, such as summer to winter or fantasy versus futuristic settings—but also makes the object-scene composition more controllable. We achieve this by combining modeling and optimizing the object’s texture and environmental lighting through differentiable ray tracing with image priors from pre-trained text-to-image diffusion models. We demonstrate that our method applies to a wide variety of indoor and outdoor scenes and arbitrary objects. See also our project page.

title: Jinghe Yang*, Mingming Gong, Ye Pu
title_en: Jinghe Yang*, Mingming Gong, Ye Pu
abstract: 与空中场景相比,水下深度估计面临自身特有的挑战。例如,由于水下环境中传感器的限制,获取具有真实姿态的高质量训练数据存在困难。此外,水下成像的物理特性与空中场景存在显著差异,因此为空中深度估计开发的方法在水下应用时性能不佳,这是由于领域差异所致。为解决这些挑战,本文提出了一种基于迁移学习的新型方法——物理引导的水下深度估计(PUDE)。其核心思想是利用少量无真实测量值的水下图像集,通过物理水下成像模型引导,将预训练的空中深度估计模型知识迁移至水下场景。我们基于物理模型提出新颖的边界损失函数,以修正深度估计结果,使其符合实际水下物理特性。最后,在多个数据集上的评估表明,PUDE模型在定量和定性比较中均优于现有空中和水下方法。
abstract_en: Compared to the in-air case, underwater depth estimation has its own challenges. For instance, acquiring high-quality training datasets with groundtruth poses difficulties due to sensor limitations in aquatic environments. Additionally, the physics characteristics of underwater imaging diverge significantly from the in-air case, the methods developed for in-air depth estimation underperform when applied underwater, due to the domain gap. To address these challenges, our paper introduces a novel transfer-learning-based method - Physics-informed Underwater Depth Estimation (PUDE). The key idea is to transfer the knowledge of a pre-trained in-air depth estimation model to underwater settings utilizing a small underwater image set without groundtruth measurement, guided by a physical underwater imaging formation model. We propose novel bound losses based on the physical model to rectify the depth estimations to align with actual underwater physical properties. Finally, in the evaluations across multiple datasets, we compare PUDE model with other existing in-air and underwater methods. The results reveal that the PUDE model excels in both quantitative and qualitative comparisons.

title: Jinghua Hou, Tong Wang, Xiaoqing Ye, Zhe Liu, Shi Gong, Xiao Tan, Errui Ding, Jingdong Wang, Xiang Bai*
title_en: Jinghua Hou, Tong Wang, Xiaoqing Ye, Zhe Liu, Shi Gong, Xiao Tan, Errui Ding, Jingdong Wang, Xiang Bai*
abstract: 准确的深度信息对于提升多视角3D物体检测性能至关重要。尽管一些现有的多视角3D检测器利用像素级深度监督取得了成功,但它们忽视了两个重要现象:1)从激光雷达点获得的深度监督通常分布在物体表面,由于缺乏3D物体中心的深度信息,这对现有的基于DETR的3D检测器不友好;2)对于远处的物体,对整个物体进行细粒度深度估计更具挑战性。因此,我们认为物体级深度(或物体的3D中心)对于准确检测至关重要。本文提出了一种新的多视角3D物体检测器__TITLE_MATH_1__,其核心思想是通过我们提出的物体级位置嵌入,有效将物体级深度信息注入网络。具体而言,我们首先采用物体级深度编码器,以像素级深度图作为先验,准确估计物体级深度。然后,我们利用提出的物体级位置嵌入将物体级深度信息编码到Transformer解码器中,从而生成3D物体感知特征进行最终检测。大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性。此外,__ABS_MATH_1__在nuScenes测试基准上取得了新的最先进性能,NDS达到64.4%,mAP达到56.7%。代码可在https://github.com/AlmoonYsl/OPEN获取。
abstract_en: Accurate depth information is crucial for enhancing the performance of multi-view 3D object detection. Despite the success of some existing multi-view 3D detectors utilizing pixel-wise depth supervision, they overlook two significant phenomena: 1) the depth supervision obtained from LiDAR points is usually distributed on the surface of the object, which is not so friendly to existing DETR-based 3D detectors due to the lack of the depth of 3D object center; 2) for distant objects, fine-grained depth estimation of the whole object is more challenging. Therefore, we argue that the object-wise depth (or 3D center of the object) is essential for accurate detection. In this paper, we propose a new multi-view 3D object detector named , whose main idea is to effectively inject object-wise depth information into the network through our proposed object-wise position embedding. Specifically, we first employ an object-wise depth encoder, which takes the pixel-wise depth map as a prior, to accurately estimate the object-wise depth. Then, we utilize the proposed object-wise position embedding to encode the object-wise depth information into the transformer decoder, thereby producing 3D object-aware features for final detection. Extensive experiments verify the effectiveness of our proposed method. Furthermore, achieves a new state-of-the-art performance with 64.4% NDS and 56.7% mAP on the nuScenes test benchmark. The code is available at https://github. com/AlmoonYsl/OPEN.

title: 吴婧婧, 方正尧, 李鹏远, 张成权, 陈方林, 卢光明, 皮文杰*
title_en: Jingjing Wu, Zhengyao Fang, Pengyuan Lyu, Chengquan Zhang, Fanglin Chen, Guangming Lu, Wenjie Pei*
abstract: 仅基于转录的监督文本定位旨在通过仅依赖转录内容而非文本边界进行监督,从而消除昂贵的边界标注。该任务的核心在于在场景文本图像中定位每个转录内容,而无需位置标注。在本工作中,我们将这一具有挑战性的问题建模为弱监督跨模态对比学习问题,并设计了一个简单而有效的模型,该模型能够以弱监督方式检测场景图像中的每个转录内容。与典型的跨模态对比学习方法不同,这些方法侧重于建模整张图像与文本描述之间的整体语义相关性,我们的方法则进行原子对比学习,建模文本转录与其在场景图像中相关区域的字符级外观一致性,以弱监督方式检测转录内容的锚点。通过检测到的锚点作为伪位置标签,进一步指导文本定位的学习。在四个具有挑战性的基准数据集上的大量实验验证了我们模型的优越性能。代码将被发布。
abstract_en: Transcription-only Supervised Text Spotting aims to learn text spotters relying only on transcriptions but no text boundaries for supervision, thus eliminating expensive boundary annotation. The crux of this task lies in locating each transcription in scene text images without location annotations. In this work, we formulate this challenging problem as a Weakly Supervised Cross-modality Contrastive Learning problem, and design a simple yet effective model dubbed that is able to detect each transcription in a scene image in a weakly supervised manner. Unlike typical methods for cross-modality contrastive learning that focus on modeling the holistic semantic correlation between an entire image and a text description, our conducts atomistic contrastive learning to model the character-wise appearance consistency between a text transcription and its correlated region in a scene image to detect an anchor point for the transcription in a weakly supervised manner. The detected anchor points by are further used as pseudo location labels to guide the learning of text spotting. Extensive experiments on four challenging benchmarks demonstrate the superior performance of our model over other methods. Code will be released.

title: Jingjing Zheng, Wanglong Lu, Wenzhe Wang, Yankai Cao*, Xiaoqin Zhang, Xianta Jiang
title_en: Jingjing Zheng, Wanglong Lu, Wenzhe Wang, Yankai Cao*, Xiaoqin Zhang, Xianta Jiang
abstract: 近年来,基于张量奇异值分解(t-SVD)的张量恢复方法在处理视觉数据(如彩色图像和视频)方面展现出巨大潜力。然而,这些方法在面对具有非光滑变化的张量数据时,往往会出现严重的性能退化。这种现象在现实场景中普遍存在,但传统基于t-SVD的方法却忽略了这一点。在本工作中,我们引入了一种新型的张量恢复模型,该模型采用可学习的张量核范数来解决这一挑战。我们开发了一种名为交替近端乘子法(APMM)的新优化算法,用于迭代求解所提出的张量补全模型。理论分析证明了所提出的APMM能够收敛到优化问题的Karush–Kuhn–Tucker(KKT)点。此外,我们基于APMM提出了一种多目标张量恢复框架,以高效探索张量数据在各维度间的相关性,为将基于t-SVD的方法扩展到高阶张量情况提供了新的视角。数值实验验证了所提方法在张量补全中的有效性。
abstract_en: Recently, numerous tensor singular value decomposition (t-SVD)-based tensor recovery methods have shown promise in processing visual data, such as color images and videos. However, these methods often suffer from severe performance degradation when confronted with tensor data exhibiting non-smooth changes. It has been commonly observed in real-world scenarios but ignored by the traditional t-SVD-based methods. In this work, we introduce a novel tensor recovery model with a learnable tensor nuclear norm to address such challenge. We develop a new optimization algorithm named the Alternating Proximal Multiplier Method (APMM) to iteratively solve the proposed tensor completion model. Theoretical analysis demonstrates the convergence of the proposed APMM to the Karush–Kuhn–Tucker (KKT) point of the optimization problem. In addition, we propose a multi-objective tensor recovery framework based on APMM to efficiently explore the correlations of tensor data across its various dimensions, providing a new perspective on extending the t-SVD-based method to higher-order tensor cases. Numerical experiments demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed method in tensor completion.

title: Jingkang Yang, Yuhao Dong, Shuai Liu, Bo Li, Ziyue Wang, ChenCheng Jiang, Haoran Tan, Jiamu Kang, Yuanhan Zhang, Kaiyang Zhou, Ziwei Liu*
title_en: Jingkang Yang, Yuhao Dong, Shuai Liu, Bo Li, Ziyue Wang, ChenCheng Jiang, Haoran Tan, Jiamu Kang, Yuanhan Zhang, Kaiyang Zhou, Ziwei Liu*
abstract: 大规模视觉-语言模型(VLMs)在多模态感知与推理方面取得了显著进展。当集成到具身智能体中时,现有具身VLM工作要么输出详细的操控级动作序列,要么仅提供抽象级别的计划,导致高层规划与现实世界操控之间存在鸿沟。为弥合这一鸿沟,我们引入Octopus,一个具身视觉-语言程序员,通过可执行代码生成作为中介连接规划与操控。Octopus设计用于1)熟练理解智能体的视觉与文本任务目标,2)制定复杂动作序列,3)生成可执行代码。为促进Octopus模型开发,我们引入OctoVerse:一套针对基于视觉的代码生成器的基准测试环境套件,涵盖从模拟器中的日常琐事到复杂视频游戏(如《侠盗猎车手》(GTA)和《我的世界》(Minecraft))中高级交互的广泛任务。为训练Octopus,我们利用GPT-4控制探索性智能体生成训练数据,即动作蓝图和对应的可执行代码。我们还收集反馈以实现增强的训练方案,称为环境反馈强化学习(RLEF)。通过一系列实验,我们展示了Octopus的功能并呈现了令人信服的结果,表明所提出的RLEF优化了智能体的决策过程。通过开源我们的模拟环境、数据集和模型架构,我们希望激发进一步创新并促进具身AI社区的协作应用。项目页面可访问https://choiszt.github.io/Octopus/。
abstract_en: Large vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved substantial progress in multimodal perception and reasoning. When integrated into an embodied agent, existing embodied VLM works either output detailed action sequences at the manipulation level or only provide plans at an abstract level, leaving a gap between high-level planning and real-world manipulation. To bridge this gap, we introduce Octopus, an embodied vision-language programmer that uses executable code generation as a medium to connect planning and manipulation. Octopus is designed to 1) proficiently comprehend an agent’s visual and textual task objectives, 2) formulate intricate action sequences, and 3) generate executable code. To facilitate Octopus model development, we introduce OctoVerse: a suite of environments tailored for benchmarking vision-based code generators on a wide spectrum of tasks, ranging from mundane daily chores in simulators to sophisticated interactions in complex video games such as Grand Theft Auto (GTA) and Minecraft. To train Octopus, we leverage GPT-4 to control an explorative agent that generates training data, i.e., action blueprints and corresponding executable code. We also collect feedback that enables an enhanced training scheme called Reinforcement Learning with Environmental Feedback (RLEF). Through a series of experiments, we demonstrate Octopus’s functionality and present compelling results, showing that the proposed RLEF refines the agent’s decision-making. By open-sourcing our simulation environments, dataset, and model architecture, we aspire to ignite further innovation and foster collaborative applications within the broader embodied AI community. The project page is available at https://choiszt.github.io/Octopus/.

title: Jinglin Liang, Jin Zhong, Hanlin Gu, Zhongqi Lu, Xingxing Tang, Gang Dai, Shuangping Huang*, Lixin Fan, Qiang Yang
title_en: Jinglin Liang, Jin Zhong, Hanlin Gu, Zhongqi Lu, Xingxing Tang, Gang Dai, Shuangping Huang*, Lixin Fan, Qiang Yang
abstract: 联邦类持续学习(FCCL)融合了分布式客户端学习的挑战与无缝适应新类别的需求,同时避免遗忘旧类别。FCCL的关键挑战是灾难性遗忘,这一问题在持续学习(CL)中已有一定程度的研究。然而,由于隐私保护需求,一些传统方法(如经验回放)无法直接应用于FCCL。现有FCCL方法通过联邦训练生成对抗网络(GANs)或无数据知识蒸馏生成历史数据以缓解遗忘问题。然而,这些方法常面临生成器训练不稳定或生成数据质量低的问题,限制了其对模型的指导效果。为解决这一挑战,我们提出了一种基于扩散模型的数据回放新方法。不同于训练扩散模型,我们采用预训练的条件扩散模型,通过反向推导每个类别,在模型输入空间中搜索对应输入条件,显著降低计算资源和时间消耗,同时确保有效生成。此外,我们通过对比学习增强分类器在生成数据和真实数据上的领域泛化能力,间接提升生成数据对真实数据的表征能力。综合实验表明,我们的方法显著优于现有基线。代码可在https://github.com/jinglin-liang/DDDR获取。
abstract_en: Federated Class Continual Learning (FCCL) merges the challenges of distributed client learning with the need for seamless adaptation to new classes without forgetting old ones. The key challenge in FCCL is catastrophic forgetting, an issue that has been explored to some extent in Continual Learning (CL). However, due to privacy preservation requirements, some conventional methods, such as experience replay, are not directly applicable to FCCL. Existing FCCL methods mitigate forgetting by generating historical data through federated training of GANs or data-free knowledge distillation. However, these approaches often suffer from unstable training of generators or low-quality generated data, limiting their guidance for the model. To address this challenge, we propose a novel method of data replay based on diffusion models. Instead of training a diffusion model, we employ a pre-trained conditional diffusion model to reverse-engineer each class, searching the corresponding input conditions for each class within the model’s input space, significantly reducing computational resources and time consumption while ensuring effective generation. Furthermore, we enhance the classifier’s domain generalization ability on generated and real data through contrastive learning, indirectly improving the representational capability of generated data for real data. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines. Code is available at https:// github.com/jinglin-liang/DDDR.

title: Jinglin Zhan, Tiejun Liu, Rengang Li, Zhaoxiang Zhang, Yuntao Chen*
title_en: Jinglin Zhan, Tiejun Liu, Rengang Li, Zhaoxiang Zhang, Yuntao Chen*
abstract: 大规模三维边界框标注对于激光雷达目标检测至关重要,但成本高昂。半监督目标检测(SSOD)为利用未标注数据提供了有前景的解决方案,但主流的伪标签方法在训练时需要对噪声教师标签进行细致的超参数调优。在本工作中,我们提出了一种()范式用于激光雷达半监督目标检测。我们的方法核心是,一种基于Transformer的网络,能够预测可能的放置位置以及对象-位置适配度分数,以语义连贯的方式将标注对象插入未标注扫描中。基于,首次成功实现了激光雷达半监督目标检测中的对象复制粘贴。为了在由生成的部分标注扫描上训练目标检测器,我们在部分监督过程中采用空间感知分类损失,以处理将所有未标注对象视为背景导致的假阴性问题。我们进行了大量实验以验证方法的有效性和通用性。与用于激光雷达检测的其他最先进的标签高效方法相比,我们的方法在标注数据量最少的情况下实现了最佳检测器性能。在Waymo数据集上,仅使用1%的标注数据,我们的半监督检测器性能与全监督基线相当。同样,在nuScenes数据集上,我们的半监督CenterPoint在NDS评分上达到全监督模型检测性能的99%,仅使用5%的标注数据。代码已发布于https://github.com/JinglinZhan/CSOT
abstract_en: Large-scale 3D bounding box annotation is crucial for LiDAR object detection but comes at a high cost. Semi-supervised object detection (SSOD) offers promising solutions to leverage unannotated data, but the predominant pseudo-labeling approach requires careful hyperparameter tuning for training on noisy teacher labels. In this work, we propose a () paradigm for LiDAR SSOD. Central to our approach is , a transformer-based network that predicts possible placement locations and the object-place fitness scores for inserting annotated objects into unlabeled scans in a semantic coherence manner. Based on , successfully enables object copy-paste in LiDAR SSOD for the first time. To train object detectors on partially annotated scans generated by , we adopt a spatial-aware classification loss throughout our partial supervision to handle false negative issues caused by treating all unlabeled objects as background. We conduct extensive experiments to verify the efficacy and generality of our method. Compared to other state-of-the-art label-efficient methods used in LiDAR detection, our approach requires the least amount of annotation while achieves the best detector. Using only 1% of the labeled data on the Waymo dataset, our semi-supervised detector achieves performance on par with the fully supervised baseline. Similarly, on the nuScenes dataset, our semi-supervised CenterPoint reaches 99% of the fully supervised model’s detection performance in terms of NDS score, while using just 5% of the labeled data. Code is released at https://github.com/JinglinZhan/CSOT

title: Jingmeng Li, Lukang Fu, Surun Yang, Hui Wei*
title_en: Jingmeng Li, Lukang Fu, Surun Yang, Hui Wei*
abstract: 新兴图像(EIs)是一种由不规则形状和大小的离散斑点组成的风格化图像,仅使用黑白颜色。EIs在认知心理学的知觉组织研究中具有重要应用价值,并可作为验证码机制。然而,从自然图像生成高质量EIs面临以下挑战:1)颜色量化——如何在将自然图像的颜色空间减少到1位时最小化感知损失;2)感知难度调整——如何调整目标检测与识别的感知难度。本文提出了一种通用框架HiEI,用于从自然图像生成高质量EIs,包含三个模块:以用户为中心的颜色量化模块(TTNet)、感知难度控制(PDC)模块和模板向量化(TV)模块。TTNet和PDC模块专门设计用于解决上述挑战。实验结果表明,与现有EI生成方法相比,HiEI能够生成内容和风格质量更优的EIs,同时在控制感知难度方面提供更大的灵活性。特别地,我们实验验证了由HiEI生成的EIs能够有效抵御基于深度网络的视觉模型攻击,证实了其作为验证码机制的可行性。
abstract_en: Emerging images (EIs) are a type of stylized image that consists of discrete speckles with irregular shapes and sizes, colored only in black and white. EIs have significant applications that can contribute to the study of perceptual organization in cognitive psychology and serve as a CAPTCHA mechanism. However, generating high-quality EIs from natural images faces the following challenges: 1) color quantization–how to minimize perceptual loss when reducing the color space of a natural image to 1-bit; 2) perceived difficulty adjustment–how to adjust the perceived difficulty for object detection and recognition. This paper proposes a universal framework HiEI to generate high-quality EIs from natural images, which contains three modules: the human-centered color quantification module (TTNet), the perceived difficulty control (PDC) module, and the template vectorization (TV) module. TTNet and PDC modules are specifically designed to address the aforementioned challenges. Experimental results show that compared to the existing EI generation methods, HiEI can generate EIs with superior content and style quality while offering more flexibility in controlling perceived difficulty. In particular, we experimently demonstrate that EIs generated by HiEI can effectively defend against attacks from deep network-based visual models, confirming their viability as a CAPTCHA mechanism.

title: Jingyang Huo, Yikai Wang, Yanwei Fu*, Xuelin Qian, Chong Li, Yun Wang, Jianfeng Feng
title_en: Jingyang Huo, Yikai Wang, Yanwei Fu*, Xuelin Qian, Chong Li, Yun Wang, Jianfeng Feng
abstract: 近期的fMRI到图像方法主要聚焦于将fMRI信号与预训练扩散模型的特定条件进行关联。这些方法虽然能够生成高质量图像,但仅捕捉了fMRI信号中复杂信息的有限方面,对图像生成的细节控制能力较弱。相比之下,本文提出直接利用fMRI信号调节扩散模型的生成过程。我们的方法NeuroPictor将fMRI到图像的流程分为三个步骤:i) fMRI校准编码,通过多个体预训练构建共享潜在空间以最小化个体差异并支持后续多受试者训练;ii) fMRI到图像多受试者预训练,通过感知学习引导扩散模型在不同个体间学习高低层次条件;iii) fMRI到图像单受试者优化,与步骤ii类似但聚焦于特定个体的适应。NeuroPictor从fMRI信号中提取高层语义特征以表征视觉刺激,并通过低层操控网络进行增量微调,为扩散模型提供精确的结构指令。通过约67,000组来自不同个体的fMRI-图像配对数据训练,我们的模型在fMRI到图像解码能力上表现出色,尤其在单受试者设置中,如基准数据集所示。我们的代码和模型可在https://jingyanghuo.github.io/neuropictor/获取。
abstract_en: Recent fMRI-to-image approaches mainly focused on associating fMRI signals with specific conditions of pre-trained diffusion models. These approaches, while producing high-quality images, capture only a limited aspect of the complex information in fMRI signals and offer little detailed control over image creation. In contrast, this paper proposes to directly modulate the generation process of diffusion models using fMRI signals. Our approach, NeuroPictor, divides the fMRI-to-image process into three steps: i) fMRI calibrated-encoding, to tackle multi-individual pre-training for a shared latent space to minimize individual difference and enable the subsequent multi-subject training; ii) fMRI-to-image multi-subject pre-training, perceptually learning to guide diffusion model with high- and low-level conditions across different individuals; iii) fMRI-to-image single-subject refining, similar with step ii but focus on adapting to particular individual. NeuroPictor extracts high-level semantic features from fMRI signals that characterizing the visual stimulus and incrementally fine-tunes the diffusion model with a low-level manipulation network to provide precise structural instructions. By training with about 67,000 fMRI-image pairs from various individuals, our model enjoys superior fMRI-to-image decoding capacity, particularly in the within-subject setting, as evidenced in benchmark datasets. Our code and model are available at https://jingyanghuo.github.io/neuropictor/.

title: 陈景业*, 黄雨盼, 吕腾超, 崔磊, 陈启峰, 魏富如
title_en: Jingye Chen*, Yupan Huang, Tengchao Lv, Lei Cui, Qifeng Chen, Furu Wei
abstract: 扩散模型近年来已被证明是一种强大的生成模型,但在生成视觉文本方面仍面临挑战。尽管现有工作致力于提升文本渲染的准确性,但这些方法仍存在若干缺陷,如(1)灵活性和自动化程度有限,(2)布局预测能力受限,(3)多样性不足。本文提出TextDiffuser-2,旨在综合考虑上述三个方面,释放语言模型在文本渲染中的潜力。首先,我们对大型语言模型进行微调以实现布局规划。该大型语言模型能够自动生成关键词并为文本渲染确定最优位置。其次,我们利用扩散模型中的语言模型对关键词的位置和内容进行行级编码。与以往采用字符级指导的方法不同,我们的方法生成了更具多样性的文本图像。我们进行了大量实验,并结合人类参与者和GPT-4V的用户研究,验证了TextDiffuser-2在实现更合理文本布局和增强多样性方面的能力。此外,所提出的方法兼容现有文本渲染技术,如TextDiffuser和GlyphControl,能够提升自动化程度和多样性,同时增强渲染精度。例如,通过使用所提出的布局规划器,TextDiffuser能够生成更具审美效果的换行和对齐文本,同时无需显式指定关键词。此外,GlyphControl可借助布局规划器实现多样化的布局,无需用户指定字形图像,当使用所提出的布局编码训练技术时,渲染F值可提升6.51%。代码和模型可在https: //aka.ms/textdiffuser-2获取。
abstract_en: The diffusion model has been proven a powerful generative model in recent years, yet it remains a challenge in generating visual text. Although existing work has endeavored to enhance the accuracy of text rendering, these methods still suffer from several drawbacks, such as (1) limited flexibility and automation, (2) constrained capability of layout prediction, and (3) restricted diversity. In this paper, we present TextDiffuser-2, aiming to unleash the power of language models for text rendering while taking these three aspects into account. Firstly, we fine-tune a large language model for layout planning. The large language model is capable of automatically generating keywords and placing the text in optimal positions for text rendering. Secondly, we utilize the language model within the diffusion model to encode the position and content of keywords at the line level. Unlike previous methods that employed tight character-level guidance, our approach generates more diverse text images. We conduct extensive experiments and incorporate user studies involving human participants and GPT-4V, validating TextDiffuser-2’s capacity to achieve a more rational text layout and generation with enhanced diversity. Furthermore, the proposed methods are compatible with existing text rendering techniques, such as TextDiffuser and GlyphControl, serving to enhance automation and diversity, as well as augment the rendering accuracy. For instance, by using the proposed layout planner, TextDiffuser is capable of rendering text with more aesthetically pleasing line breaks and alignment, meanwhile obviating the need for explicit keyword specification. Furthermore, GlyphControl can leverage the layout planner to achieve diverse layouts without the necessity for user-specified glyph images, and the rendering F-measure can be boosted by 6.51% when using the proposed layout encoding training technique. The code and model are available at https: //aka.ms/textdiffuser-2.

title: Jingyi Lu, Xinghui Li, Kai Han*
title_en: Jingyi Lu, Xinghui Li, Kai Han*
abstract: 基于点拖动的图像编辑方法(如DragDiffusion)引起了广泛关注。然而,由于基于点的编辑指令稀疏性,点拖动方法存在计算开销大和误读用户意图的问题。本文提出了一种基于区域的复制粘贴拖动方法,以克服这些局限性。该方法允许用户通过手柄区域和目标区域的形式表达编辑指令,实现更精确的控制并缓解歧义。此外,基于区域的操作可在单次迭代中完成编辑,速度远超基于点拖动的方法。我们还引入了注意力交换技术以提升编辑过程的稳定性。为验证该方法,我们扩展了现有基于点拖动的数据集,增加了基于区域的拖动指令。实验结果表明,该方法在速度、准确性和与用户意图的匹配度方面均优于现有基于点拖动的方法。值得注意的是,该方法在512×512分辨率图像上完成编辑仅需不到2秒,比DragDiffusion快100倍以上,同时实现了更优的性能。项目页面:https://visual-ai.github.io/regiondrag
abstract_en: Point-drag-based image editing methods, like DragDiffusion, have attracted significant attention. However, point-drag-based approaches suffer from computational overhead and misinterpretation of user intentions, due to the sparsity of point-based editing instructions. In this paper, we propose a region-based copy-and-paste dragging method, , to overcome these limitations. allows users to express their editing instructions in the form of handle and target regions, enabling more precise control and alleviating ambiguity. In addition, region-based operations complete editing in one iteration and are much faster than point-drag-based methods. We also incorporate the attention-swapping technique for enhanced stability during editing. To validate our approach, we extend existing point-drag-based datasets with region-based dragging instructions. Experimental results demonstrate that outperforms existing point-drag-based approaches in terms of speed, accuracy, and alignment with user intentions. Remarkably, completes the edit on an image with a resolution of 512×512 in less than 2 seconds, which is more than 100× faster than DragDiffusion, while achieving better performance. Project page: https://visual-ai.github.io/regiondrag.

title: Jingyi Tang*, Gu Wang, Zeyu Chen, Shengquan Li, Xiu Li*, Xiangyang Ji
title_en: Jingyi Tang*, Gu Wang, Zeyu Chen, Shengquan Li, Xiu Li*, Xiangyang Ji
abstract: 尽管针对室内场景中物体姿态估计的方法已取得显著成果,但水下物体的姿态估计仍面临挑战,这主要源于复杂水下环境带来的困难,如光照衰减、模糊现象以及获取真实标注的高昂成本。为此,我们提出FAFA,一种频率感知的流辅助自监督框架,用于无人潜航器(UUVs)的6D姿态估计。本质上,我们首先在合成数据上训练一个频率感知的流基姿态估计器,其中提出了一种基于FFT的增强方法,以帮助网络从频率视角捕捉领域不变特征和目标领域风格。进一步地,我们通过强制流辅助的多级一致性进行自监督训练,以适应真实水下环境。我们的框架仅依赖三维模型和RGB图像,消除了对真实姿态标注或其他模态数据(如深度)的需求。我们在常见的水下物体姿态基准数据集上评估了FAFA的有效性,并展示了其相较于现有方法的显著性能提升。代码已开源至github.com/tjy0703/FAFA。
abstract_en: Although methods for estimating the pose of objects in indoor scenes have achieved great success, the pose estimation of underwater objects remains challenging due to difficulties brought by the complex underwater environment, such as degraded illumination, blurring, and the substantial cost of obtaining real annotations. In response, we introduce FAFA, a Frequency-Aware Flow-Aided self-supervised framework for 6D pose estimation of unmanned underwater vehicles (UUVs). Essentially, we first train a frequency-aware flow-based pose estimator on synthetic data, where an FFT-based augmentation approach is proposed to facilitate the network in capturing domain-invariant features and target domain styles from a frequency perspective. Further, we perform self-supervised training by enforcing flow-aided multi-level consistencies to adapt it to the real-world underwater environment. Our framework relies solely on the 3D model and RGB images, alleviating the need for any real pose annotations or other-modality data like depths. We evaluate the effectiveness of FAFA on common underwater object pose benchmarks and showcase significant performance improvements compared to state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at github.com/tjy0703/FAFA.

title: Jingyi Xu*, Hieu Le, Dimitris Samaras
title_en: Jingyi Xu*, Hieu Le, Dimitris Samaras
abstract: 生成模型的发展增加了对样本质量评估的需求。为此,先前方法依赖于预训练的特征提取器,将生成样本和真实样本嵌入到一个共同空间中进行比较。然而,不同的特征提取器可能导致评估结果不一致。此外,这些方法在缺乏鲁棒、通用特征提取器的领域(如医学图像或3D资产)中不可行。在本文中,我们提出直接考察训练后的生成模型的潜在空间以推断生成样本的质量。这是可行的,因为生成样本的质量直接与其相似的训练数据量相关,我们可以通过考察潜在空间的密度来推断这一信息。因此,我们使用潜在密度得分函数来量化样本质量。我们证明,所提出的得分与各种生成模型(包括VAEs、GANs和潜在扩散模型)的样本质量高度相关。与先前的质量评估方法相比,我们的方法具有以下优势:1)降低计算成本的预生成质量估计,2)适用于各种领域和模态的泛化能力,3)适用于基于潜在空间的图像编辑和生成方法。大量实验表明,我们提出的方法可以受益于下游任务,如少样本图像分类和潜在空间人脸图像编辑。代码可在https://github.com/cvlab-stonybrook/LS-sample-quality获取。
abstract_en: Advances in generative models increase the need for sample quality assessment. To do so, previous methods rely on a pre-trained feature extractor to embed the generated samples and real samples into a common space for comparison. However, different feature extractors might lead to inconsistent assessment outcomes. Moreover, these methods are not applicable for domains where a robust, universal feature extractor does not yet exist, such as medical images or 3D assets. In this paper, we propose to directly examine the latent space of the trained generative model to infer generated sample quality. This is feasible because the quality a generated sample directly relates to the amount of training data resembling it, and we can infer this information by examining the density of the latent space. Accordingly, we use a latent density score function to quantify sample quality. We show that the proposed score correlates highly with the sample quality for various generative models including VAEs, GANs and Latent Diffusion Models. Compared with previous quality assessment methods, our method has the following advantages: 1) pre-generation quality estimation with reduced computational cost, 2) generalizability to various domains and modalities, and 3) applicability to latent-based image editing and generation methods. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed methods can benefit downstream tasks such as few-shot image classification and latent face image editing. Code is available at https://github.com/cvlab-stonybrook/LS-sample-quality.

title: Jingyu Lin, Jiaqi Gu, Bojian Wu, Lubin Fan*, Renjie Chen*, Ligang Liu, Jieping Ye
title_en: Jingyu Lin, Jiaqi Gu, Bojian Wu, Lubin Fan*, Renjie Chen*, Ligang Liu, Jieping Ye
abstract: 我们引入了一种新颖的神经体积姿态特征,称为PoseMap,旨在通过封装图像与相关相机姿态之间的信息来增强相机定位。我们的框架结合了绝对姿态回归(APR)架构和增强的NeRF模块。这种集成不仅有助于生成新视角以丰富训练数据集,还能够学习有效的姿态特征。此外,我们扩展了该架构以实现自监督在线对齐,使我们的方法能够在统一框架内用于无标签图像的训练和微调。实验表明,我们的方法在室内和室外基准场景中平均性能提升14.28%和20.51%,在准确率方面优于现有APR方法,达到最先进水平。
abstract_en: We introduce a novel neural volumetric pose feature, termed PoseMap, designed to enhance camera localization by encapsulating the information between images and the associated camera poses. Our framework leverages an Absolute Pose Regression (APR) architecture, together with an augmented NeRF module. This integration not only facilitates the generation of novel views to enrich the training dataset but also enables the learning of effective pose features. Additionally, we extend our architecture for self-supervised online alignment, allowing our method to be used and fine-tuned for unlabelled images within a unified framework. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves 14.28% and 20.51% performance gain on average in indoor and outdoor benchmark scenes, outperforming existing APR methods with state-of-the-art accuracy.

title: Jingyun Liang*, Yuchen Fan, Kai Zhang*, Radu Timofte, Luc Van Gool, Rakesh Ranjan
title_en: Jingyun Liang*, Yuchen Fan, Kai Zhang*, Radu Timofte, Luc Van Gool, Rakesh Ranjan
abstract: 尽管近年来扩散模型在视频生成领域取得了显著进展,但大多数方法仅是对图像生成框架的简单扩展,未能显式考虑视频与图像的关键差异——运动。本文提出了一种新颖的运动感知视频生成框架(MoVideo),从视频深度和光流两个方面考虑运动信息。前者通过逐帧物体距离和空间布局调节运动,后者则通过跨帧对应关系描述运动,有助于保持细节并提升时间一致性。具体而言,给定一个由文本提示生成或存在的关键帧,我们首先设计一个包含时空模块的扩散模型,生成视频深度及对应的光流。随后,在深度、基于光流的变形潜在视频及计算出的遮挡掩码指导下,通过另一个时空扩散模型在潜在空间中生成视频。最后,我们再次利用光流对不同帧进行对齐和优化,以提升从潜在空间到像素空间的视频解码质量。实验表明,MoVideo在文本到视频和图像到视频生成任务中均达到当前最优水平,展现出良好的提示一致性、帧间一致性和视觉质量。
abstract_en: While recent years have witnessed great progress on using diffusion models for video generation, most of them are simple extensions of image generation frameworks, which fail to explicitly consider one of the key differences between videos and images, , motion. In this paper, we propose a novel motion-aware video generation (MoVideo) framework that takes motion into consideration from two aspects: video depth and optical flow. The former regulates motion by per-frame object distances and spatial layouts, while the later describes motion by cross-frame correspondences that help in preserving fine details and improving temporal consistency. More specifically, given a key frame that exists or generated from text prompts, we first design a diffusion model with spatio-temporal modules to generate the video depth and the corresponding optical flows. Then, the video is generated in the latent space by another spatio-temporal diffusion model under the guidance of depth, optical flow-based warped latent video and the calculated occlusion mask. Lastly, we use optical flows again to align and refine different frames for better video decoding from the latent space to the pixel space. In experiments, MoVideo achieves state-of-the-art results in both text-to-video and image-to-video generation, showing promising prompt consistency, frame consistency and visual quality.

title: Jinhao Deng, Wei Ye, Hai Wu, Qiming Xia, Xun Huang, Xin Li, Jin Fang, Wei Li*, Chenglu Wen*, Cheng Wang
title_en: Jinhao Deng, Wei Ye, Hai Wu, Qiming Xia, Xun Huang, Xin Li, Jin Fang, Wei Li*, Chenglu Wen*, Cheng Wang
abstract: 点云数据,代表场景的精确三维布局,迅速推动了三维物体检测的研究。然而,由于三维传感器的快速迭代,导致点云分布显著不同。这反过来导致了三维跨传感器物体检测性能不佳。本文引入了一个名为CMD的跨机制数据集,以支持解决这一挑战的研究。CMD是第一个领域适应数据集,全面涵盖了多种机械传感器和各种场景的三维物体检测。在传感器方面,CMD包括32束激光雷达、128束激光雷达、固态激光雷达、4D毫米波雷达和摄像头,所有设备均良好同步和校准。在场景方面,CMD由50个从不同场景中采集的序列组成,涵盖从校园到高速公路等多种场景。此外,我们验证了各种领域适应方法在减轻基于传感器的领域差异方面的有效性。我们还提出了一种DIG方法,从密度、强度和几何学的角度减少领域差异,有效弥合不同传感器之间的领域差距。在CMD数据集上的实验结果表明,我们提出的DIG方法优于最先进的技术,证明了我们基线方法的有效性。数据集和相应的代码可在https://github.com/im-djh/CMD获取。
abstract_en: Point cloud data, representing the precise 3D layout of the scene, quickly drives the research of 3D object detection. However, the challenge arises due to the rapid iteration of 3D sensors, which leads to significantly different distributions in point clouds. This, in turn, results in subpar performance of 3D cross-sensor object detection. This paper introduces a Cross Mechanism Dataset, named CMD, to support research tackling this challenge. CMD is the first domain adaptation dataset, comprehensively encompassing diverse mechanical sensors and various scenes for 3D object detection. In terms of sensors, CMD includes 32-beam LiDAR, 128-beam LiDAR, solid-state LiDAR, 4D millimeter-wave radar, and cameras, all of which are well-synchronized and calibrated. Regarding the scenes, CMD consists of 50 sequences collocated from different scenarios, ranging from campuses to highways. Furthermore, we validated the effectiveness of various domain adaptation methods in mitigating sensor-based domain differences. We also proposed a DIG method to reduce domain disparities from the perspectives of Density, Intensity, and Geometry, which effectively bridges the domain gap between different sensors. The experimental results on the CMD dataset show that our proposed DIG method outperforms the state-of-the-art techniques, demonstrating the effectiveness of our baseline method. The dataset and the corresponding code are available at https://github.com/im-djh/CMD.

title: Jinhee Kim, Taesung Kim, Jaegul Choo*
title_en: Jinhee Kim, Taesung Kim, Jaegul Choo*
abstract: 近年来,交互式关键点估计方法的进展在提高准确性的同时减少了用户干预。然而,在椎体关键点估计中,当不准确的关键点密集分布或重叠时,这些方法需要用户输入进行误差校正,这可能成本较高。我们提出了一种新颖的方法KeyBot,专门设计用于识别和校正现有模型中的显著且典型的错误,类似于用户的修订。通过表征典型错误类型并使用模拟误差进行训练,KeyBot能够有效校正这些错误,并显著减少用户的工作量。在三个公开数据集上的全面定量和定性评估证实,KeyBot显著优于现有方法,在交互式椎体关键点估计中实现了最先进的性能。源代码和演示视频可在我们的项目页面上获取。
abstract_en: Recent advances in interactive keypoint estimation methods have enhanced accuracy while minimizing user intervention. However, these methods require user input for error correction, which can be costly in vertebrae keypoint estimation where inaccurate keypoints are densely clustered or overlap. We introduce a novel approach, KeyBot, specifically designed to identify and correct significant and typical errors in existing models, akin to user revision. By characterizing typical error types and using simulated errors for training, KeyBot effectively corrects these errors and significantly reduces user workload. Comprehensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations on three public datasets confirm that KeyBot significantly outperforms existing methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance in interactive vertebrae keypoint estimation. The source code and demo video are available on our project page.

title: Jinho Jeong, Jinwoo Kim, Younghyun Jo, Seon Joo Kim*
title_en: Jinho Jeong, Jinwoo Kim, Younghyun Jo, Seon Joo Kim*
abstract: 近年来,对有效超分辨率(SR)技术的需求显著增加,尤其是在处理2K至8K分辨率的大规模图像时。对于基于深度神经网络的单图像超分辨率(SISR),由于计算约束,通常需要将图像分解为重叠的块。在这样的分块分解方案中,可以根据每个块的恢复难度不同地分配计算资源,从而在保持SR性能的同时进一步提高效率。然而,这种方法存在一个局限性:计算资源在块内是均匀分配的,当块中包含恢复难度不同的像素时,会导致效率降低。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种名为像素级分类器的单图像超分辨率方法(PCSR),该方法旨在在像素级别上自适应地分配计算资源。PCSR模型包括一个主干网络、一个像素级分类器以及一组具有不同容量的像素级上采样器。像素级分类器根据每个像素的恢复难度将其分配到合适的上采样器,从而优化计算资源的使用。我们的方法在推理过程中无需重新训练即可实现性能与计算成本的平衡。实验结果表明,PCSR在不同主干网络模型和基准测试中,相较于现有的分块分配方法,在PSNR-FLOP权衡方面具有优势。代码将发布在https://github.com/3587jjh/PCSR。
abstract_en: In recent times, the need for effective super-resolution (SR) techniques has surged, especially for large-scale images ranging 2K to 8K resolutions. For DNN-based SISR, decomposing images into overlapping patches is typically necessary due to computational constraints. In such patch-decomposing scheme, one can allocate computational resources differently based on each patch’s difficulty to further improve efficiency while maintaining SR performance. However, this approach has a limitation: computational resources is uniformly allocated within a patch, leading to lower efficiency when the patch contain pixels with varying levels of restoration difficulty. To address the issue, we propose the Pixel-level Classifier for Single Image Super-Resolution (PCSR), a novel method designed to distribute computational resources adaptively at the pixel level. A PCSR model comprises a backbone, a pixel-level classifier, and a set of pixel-level upsamplers with varying capacities. The pixel-level classifier assigns each pixel to an appropriate upsampler based on its restoration difficulty, thereby optimizing computational resource usage. Our method allows for performance and computational cost balance during inference without re-training. Our experiments demonstrate PCSR’s advantage over existing patch-distributing methods in PSNR-FLOP trade-offs across different backbone models and benchmarks. The code will be available at https://github.com/3587jjh/PCSR.

title: Jinho Park*, Se Young Chun, Mingoo Seok
title_en: Jinho Park*, Se Young Chun, Mingoo Seok
abstract: 数据驱动的视觉惯性里程计(VIO)因其性能表现而备受关注,因为VIO是自主机器人中的关键组成部分。然而,由于需要在设备内存中容纳大量网络参数,其在资源受限设备上的部署并不容易。此外,这些网络在部署后可能因测试时环境分布偏移而面临失效风险。鉴于此,我们提出UL-VIO——一种超轻量级(<1M)的VIO网络,能够基于视觉惯性一致性进行测试时适应(TTA)。具体而言,我们在保留低层编码器部分(包括所有BatchNorm参数)的同时对网络进行模型压缩,以实现资源高效的测试时适应。该方法在KITTI数据集上仅比现有最佳方法小36倍,且误差仅增加1%。对于测试时适应,我们提出使用惯性参考网络输出作为伪标签,并更新BatchNorm参数以实现轻量且有效的适应。据我们所知,这是首个在VIO上进行噪声鲁棒TTA的工作。实验结果在KITTI、EuRoC和Marulan数据集上验证了我们的资源高效适应方法在多样化TTA场景及动态域偏移下的有效性。
abstract_en: Data-driven visual-inertial odometry (VIO) has received highlights for its performance since VIOs are a crucial compartment in autonomous robots. However, their deployment on resource-constrained devices is non-trivial since large network parameters should be accommodated in the device memory. Furthermore, these networks may risk failure post-deployment due to environmental distribution shifts at test time. In light of this, we propose UL-VIO – an ultra-lightweight (< 1M) VIO network capable of test-time adaptation (TTA) based on visual-inertial consistency. Specifically, we perform model compression to the network while preserving the low-level encoder part, including all BatchNorm parameters for resource-efficient test-time adaptation. It achieves 36× smaller network size than state-of-the-art with a minute increase in error – 1% on the KITTI dataset. For test-time adaptation, we propose to use the inertia-referred network outputs as pseudo labels and update the BatchNorm parameter for lightweight yet effective adaptation. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to perform noise-robust TTA on VIO. Experimental results on the KITTI, EuRoC, and Marulan datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our resource-efficient adaptation method under diverse TTA scenarios with dynamic domain shifts.

title: Jinhyeok Jang*, ByungOk Han, Jaehong Kim, Chan-Hyun Youn
title_en: Jinhyeok Jang*, ByungOk Han, Jaehong Kim, Chan-Hyun Youn
abstract: 公共数据集在推动以数据为中心的AI发展中起着关键作用,但它们仍容易受到非法使用的威胁。本文提出了一种名为“隐蔽偏见”的新型数据集水印方法,能够可靠地识别和验证未经授权的数据使用。我们的方法基于一个观察:训练模型往往无意中学习到偏见性知识,并且即使没有与目标任务直接相关的信息,也能仅基于偏见数据进行功能运作。利用这一特性,我们故意通过不可察觉的水印嵌入类别级隐藏偏见,这些水印与目标数据集无关但共享相同的标签。因此,使用该水印数据训练的模型会隐秘地学习对这些水印进行分类。模型对水印的分类性能成为不可反驳的未经授权使用证据,这无法通过偶然实现。我们的方法具有多项优势:1)隐蔽且模型无关的水印;2)对目标任务影响最小;3)不可反驳的滥用证据;4)在实际场景中的适用性提升。我们通过大量实验验证了这些优势,并将该方法扩展到细粒度分类和图像分割任务。我们的实现可在here1获取。1 https://github.com/jjh6297/UndercoverBias
abstract_en: Public datasets play a crucial role in advancing data-centric AI, yet they remain vulnerable to illicit uses. This paper presents ‘undercover bias,’ a novel dataset watermarking method that can reliably identify and verify unauthorized data usage. Our approach is inspired by an observation that trained models often inadvertently learn biased knowledge and can function on bias-only data, even without any information directly related to a target task. Leveraging this, we deliberately embed class-wise hidden bias via unnoticeable watermarks, which are unrelated to the target dataset but share the same labels. Consequently, a model trained on this watermarked data covertly learns to classify these watermarks. The model’s performance in classifying the watermarks serves as irrefutable evidence of unauthorized usage, which cannot be achieved by chance. Our approach presents multiple benefits: 1) stealthy and model-agnostic watermarks; 2) minimal impact on the target task; 3) irrefutable evidence of misuse; and 4) improved applicability in practical scenarios. We validate these benefits through extensive experiments and extend our method to fine-grained classification and image segmentation tasks. Our implementation is available at here1 . 1 https://github.com/jjh6297/UndercoverBias

title: Jinjie Mai*, Wenxuan Zhu, Sara Rojas, Jesus Zarzar, Abdullah Hamdi, Guocheng Qian, Bing Li, Silvio Giancola, Bernard Ghanem
title_en: Jinjie Mai*, Wenxuan Zhu, Sara Rojas, Jesus Zarzar, Abdullah Hamdi, Guocheng Qian, Bing Li, Silvio Giancola, Bernard Ghanem
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRFs)通常需要大量具有准确姿态的图像以实现精确的新型视角合成,这与现实场景中视角稀疏且姿态存在噪声的情况不符。先前针对稀疏视角和噪声姿态学习NeRFs的解决方案仅考虑成对视角的局部几何一致性。受运动结构恢复(SfM)中捆绑调整方法的启发,我们提出TrackNeRF,以实现更全局一致的几何重建和更精确的姿态优化。TrackNeRF引入了特征轨迹,这些轨迹是跨所有可见视角的连接像素轨迹,对应于相同的3D点。通过在特征轨迹间强制重投影一致性,TrackNeRF显式鼓励整体三维一致性。通过大量实验,TrackNeRF在噪声和稀疏视角重建中设立了新的基准。特别是在DTU数据集下,TrackNeRF在多种稀疏和噪声视角设置中,相较于最先进的BARF和SPARF方法,在PSNR指标上分别提升了约8和1。代码可在purplehttps://tracknerf.github.io/获取。
abstract_en: Neural radiance fields (NeRFs) generally require many images with accurate poses for accurate novel view synthesis, which does not reflect realistic setups where views can be sparse and poses can be noisy. Previous solutions for learning NeRFs with sparse views and noisy poses only consider local geometry consistency with pairs of views. Closely following bundle adjustment in Structure-from-Motion (SfM), we introduce TrackNeRF for more globally consistent geometry reconstruction and more accurate pose optimization. TrackNeRF introduces feature tracks, connected pixel trajectories across all visible views that correspond to the same 3D points. By enforcing reprojection consistency among feature tracks, TrackNeRF encourages holistic 3D consistency explicitly. Through extensive experiments, TrackNeRF sets a new benchmark in noisy and sparse view reconstruction. In particular, TrackNeRF shows significant improvements over the state-of-the-art BARF and SPARF by ∼ 8 and ∼ 1 in terms of PSNR on DTU under various sparse and noisy view setups. The code is available at purplehttps://tracknerf.github.io/.

title: Jinke Li*, Xiao He*, Chonghua Zhou, Xiaoqiang Cheng, Yang Wen, Dan Zhang*
title_en: Jinke Li*, Xiao He*, Chonghua Zhou, Xiaoqiang Cheng, Yang Wen, Dan Zhang*
abstract: 三维占据(3D occupancy)是一种先进的驾驶场景感知技术,通过将物理空间量化为网格地图,无需区分前景与背景即可表征整个场景。广泛采用的先投影可变形注意力机制在将图像特征转换为三维表示方面效率较高,但由于传感器部署约束,其在多视角特征聚合方面面临挑战。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种学习优先的视角注意力机制,以实现有效的多视角特征聚合。此外,我们展示了该视角注意力机制在多种多视角三维任务中的可扩展性,包括地图构建和三维目标检测。通过结合所提出的视角注意力机制以及额外的多帧流式时间注意力机制,我们引入了ViewFormer,这是一种以视觉为中心的基于Transformer的框架,用于时空特征聚合。为进一步探索占据级别的流表示,我们提出了FlowOcc3D基准,该基准基于现有的高质量数据集构建。对该基准的定性与定量分析揭示了表征细粒度动态场景的潜力。大量实验表明,我们的方法显著优于现有最先进的方法。代码已开源至https://github.com/ViewFormerOcc/ViewFormer-Occ。
abstract_en: 3D occupancy, an advanced perception technology for driving scenarios, represents the entire scene without distinguishing between foreground and background by quantifying the physical space into a grid map. The widely adopted projection-first deformable attention, efficient in transforming image features into 3D representations, encounters challenges in aggregating multi-view features due to sensor deployment constraints. To address this issue, we propose our learning-first view attention mechanism for effective multi-view feature aggregation. Moreover, we showcase the scalability of our view attention across diverse multi-view 3D tasks, including map construction and 3D object detection. Leveraging the proposed view attention as well as an additional multi-frame streaming temporal attention, we introduce ViewFormer, a vision-centric transformer-based framework for spatiotemporal feature aggregation. To further explore occupancy-level flow representation, we present FlowOcc3D, a benchmark built on top of existing high-quality datasets. Qualitative and quantitative analyses on this benchmark reveal the potential to represent fine-grained dynamic scenes. Extensive experiments show that our approach significantly outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods. The codes are available at https://github.com/ViewFormerOcc/ViewFormer-Occ.

title: 面向机器的图像编码(ICM)研究进展
title_en: Jinming Liu*, Ruoyu Feng, Yunpeng Qi, Qiuyu Chen, Zhibo Chen, Wenjun Zeng, Xin Jin
abstract: 近年来,得益于基于学习的图像压缩与分析技术的快速发展,面向机器的图像编码(ICM)领域引发了广泛关注并取得了显著进展。先前研究通常需要训练独立的编解码器以支持不同码率层级、机器任务和网络架构,导致缺乏灵活性和实用性。为解决这些挑战,我们提出了一种率-失真-认知可控的通用图像压缩方法,该方法允许用户通过单一神经网络模型调整码率(Rate)、图像重建质量(Distortion)和机器任务精度(Cognition),实现超控性。具体而言,我们首先在主压缩分支中引入面向认知的损失函数,训练支持多样化机器任务的编解码器。该分支通过调节潜在编码通道的量化程度实现可变码率。为进一步提升重建图像质量,我们采用辅助分支通过可扩展码流补充残余信息。最终,两个分支通过“βx + (1 − β)y”插值策略实现认知-失真均衡。大量实验表明,我们的方法在ICM性能方面表现优异,并实现了灵活的率-失真-认知控制。
abstract_en: Recently, the field of Image Coding for Machines (ICM) has garnered heightened interest and significant advances thanks to the rapid progress of learning-based techniques for image compression and analysis. Previous studies often require training separate codecs to support various bitrate levels, machine tasks, and networks, thus lacking both flexibility and practicality. To address these challenges, we propose a rate-distortion-cognition controllable versatile image compression, which method allows the users to adjust the bitrate (i.e., Rate), image reconstruction quality (i.e., Distortion), and machine task accuracy (i.e., Cognition) with a single neural model, achieving ultra-controllability. Specifically, we first introduce a cognition-oriented loss in the primary compression branch to train a codec for diverse machine tasks. This branch attains variable bitrate by regulating quantization degree through the latent code channels. To further enhance the quality of the reconstructed images, we employ an auxiliary branch to supplement residual information with a scalable bitstream. Ultimately, two branches use a ‘βx + (1 − β)y’ interpolation strategy to achieve a balanced cognition-distortion trade-off. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method yields satisfactory ICM performance and flexible Rate-Distortion-Cognition controlling.

title: Jinpeng Chen, Runmin Cong*, Yuxuan Luo, Horace Ho Shing Ip, Sam Kwong*
title_en: Jinpeng Chen, Runmin Cong*, Yuxuan Luo, Horace Ho Shing Ip, Sam Kwong*
abstract: 本研究探讨了持续全景分割这一新兴领域,突出了三个关键平衡点。首先,我们引入了过往类别回溯蒸馏技术,以平衡现有知识的稳定性与对新信息的适应性。该技术基于最终标签分配结果,回溯与过往类别相关的特征,对先前模型中这些特定特征进行知识蒸馏,同时允许其他特征灵活适应新信息。此外,我们提出了一种类别比例记忆策略,使回放样本集中的类别分布与历史训练数据保持一致。该策略在回放过程中维持类别表示的平衡性,提升有限容量回放样本集在回忆先前类别的实用性。此外,考虑到回放样本仅标注其原始步骤中的类别,我们设计了平衡反误导损失,以对抗不完整标注的影响,而不会导致分类偏差。基于这些创新,我们提出了一种名为平衡持续全景分割(BalConpas)的新方法。在具有挑战性的ADE20K数据集上的评估表明,其性能优于现有最先进的方法。官方代码可在https://github.com/jinpeng0528/BalConpas获取。
abstract_en: This study explores the emerging area of continual panoptic segmentation, highlighting three key balances. First, we introduce past-class backtrace distillation to balance the stability of existing knowledge with the adaptability to new information. This technique retraces the features associated with past classes based on the final label assignment results, performing knowledge distillation targeting these specific features from the previous model while allowing other features to flexibly adapt to new information. Additionally, we introduce a class-proportional memory strategy, which aligns the class distribution in the replay sample set with that of the historical training data. This strategy maintains a balanced class representation during replay, enhancing the utility of the limited-capacity replay sample set in recalling prior classes. Moreover, recognizing that replay samples are annotated only for the classes of their original step, we devise balanced anti-misguidance losses, which combat the impact of incomplete annotations without incurring classification bias. Building upon these innovations, we present a new method named Balanced Continual Panoptic Segmentation (BalConpas). Our evaluation on the challenging ADE20K dataset demonstrates its superior performance compared to existing state-of-the-art methods. The official code is available at https://github.com/jinpeng0528/ BalConpas

title: Jinpeng Dong, Yutong Lin, Chen Li, Sanping Zhou, Nanning Zheng*
title_en: Jinpeng Dong, Yutong Lin, Chen Li, Sanping Zhou, Nanning Zheng*
abstract: 当前端到端检测器通常利用Transformer进行目标检测并表现出有前景的性能。其中,可变形DETR是一种代表性范式,能够有效利用多尺度特征。然而,局部感受野有限和查询-编码器交互受限削弱了多尺度学习。本文分析了局部特征增强和多级编码器利用以改进多尺度学习,并构建了一种新型检测Transformer检测器,称为增强DETR(AugDETR),以实现这些目标。具体而言,AugDETR包含两个组件:混合注意力编码器和编码器混合交叉注意力。混合注意力编码器扩大了可变形编码器的感受野,并引入全局上下文特征以增强特征表示。编码器混合交叉注意力基于查询特征自适应地利用多级编码器,以获得更具判别性的目标特征和更快的收敛速度。通过将AugDETR与基于DETR的检测器(如DINO、AlignDETR、DDQ)结合,我们的模型在COCO数据集上分别在ResNet-50-4scale和12个epoch设置下实现了1.2、1.1和1.0 AP的性能提升。
abstract_en: Current end-to-end detectors typically exploit transformers to detect objects and show promising performance. Among them, Deformable DETR is a representative paradigm that effectively exploits multi-scale features. However, small local receptive fields and limited query-encoder interactions weaken multi-scale learning. In this paper, we analyze local feature enhancement and multi-level encoder exploitation for improved multi-scale learning and construct a novel detection transformer detector named Augmented DETR (AugDETR) to realize them. Specifically, AugDETR consists of two components: Hybrid Attention Encoder and Encoder-Mixing Cross-Attention. Hybrid Attention Encoder enlarges the receptive field of the deformable encoder and introduces global context features to enhance feature representation. Encoder-Mixing Cross-Attention adaptively leverages multi-level encoders based on query features for more discriminative object features and faster convergence. By combining AugDETR with DETR-based detectors such as DINO, AlignDETR, DDQ, our models achieve performance improvements of 1.2, 1.1, and 1.0 AP in the COCO under the ResNet-50-4scale and 12 epochs setting, respectively.

title: Jinpeng Liu, Wenxun Dai, Chunyu Wang, Yiji Cheng, Yansong Tang*, Xin Tong
title_en: Jinpeng Liu, Wenxun Dai, Chunyu Wang, Yiji Cheng, Yansong Tang*, Xin Tong
abstract: 传统文本到运动生成方法通常基于有限的文本-运动配对数据进行训练,导致其难以泛化到开放词汇场景。一些工作利用CLIP模型对运动空间和文本空间进行对齐,旨在实现从自然语言运动描述生成运动。然而,这些方法仍受限于生成有限且不真实的原地运动。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种名为PRO-Motion1的分而治之框架,包含运动规划器、姿态去噪器和运动去噪器三个模块。运动规划器指导大语言模型(LLMs)生成描述目标运动关键姿态的脚本序列。与自然语言不同,这些脚本可通过非常简单的文本模板描述所有可能的姿态,显著降低了姿态去噪器的复杂度,该模块将脚本转换为姿态,为开放词汇文本到运动生成铺平了道路。最后,运动去噪器作为另一个扩散模型实现,不仅增加了运动帧数,还估计了所有姿态的全身平移和旋转,从而生成更动态的运动。实验结果表明,我们的方法在与其他方法相比具有优越性,并展示了其从复杂开放词汇提示(如“自由舞蹈”)生成多样化且逼真运动的能力。1 PRO-Motion: Plan, postuRe and gO for text-to-Motion generation
abstract_en: Conventional text-to-motion generation methods are usually trained on limited text-motion pairs, making them hard to generalize to open-vocabulary scenarios. Some works use the CLIP model to align the motion space and the text space, aiming to enable motion generation from natural language motion descriptions. However, they are still constrained to generate limited and unrealistic in-place motions. To address these issues, we present a divide-and-conquer framework named PRO-Motion1 , which consists of three modules as motion planner, posture-denoiser and go-denoiser. The motion planner instructs Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate a sequence of scripts describing the key postures in the target motion. Differing from natural languages, the scripts can describe all possible postures following very simple text templates. This significantly reduces the complexity of posture-denoiser, which transforms a script to a posture, paving the way for open-vocabulary text-to-motion generation. Finally, the go-denoiser, implemented as another diffusion model, not only increases the motion frames but also estimates the whole-body translations and rotations for all postures, resulting in more dynamic motions. Experimental results have shown the superiority of our method with other counterparts, and demonstrated its capability of generating diverse and realistic motions from complex open-vocabulary prompts such as “Feel free to dance”. 1 PRO-Motion: Plan, postuRe and gO for text-to-Motion generation

title: Jinrui Zhang, Teng Wang, Haigang Zhang, Ping Lu, Feng Zheng*
title_en: Jinrui Zhang, Teng Wang, Haigang Zhang, Ping Lu, Feng Zheng*
abstract: 大视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)在多种视觉-语言任务中展现出 promising performance(有前景的性能)。然而,它们仍易受幻觉影响,生成与视觉内容或指令不一致的输出。尽管已提出多种缓解策略,但这些方法往往忽视了幻觉的关键成因:训练过程中缺乏细粒度推理监督。在没有中间推理步骤的情况下,模型可能在指令与响应之间建立表面化的捷径,无法内化内在的推理逻辑。为解决这一挑战,我们提出反思性指令调优,将推理学习整合到视觉指令调优中。与仅从响应中学习的先前方法不同,我们的方法要求模型预测解释响应正确或错误的推理依据。这促使模型更深入地参与每个响应背后的细粒度推理过程,从而提升模型的推理能力。为支持这一方法,我们提出 REVERIE,这是首个包含 ReflEctiVE RatIonalE 注释的大规模指令调优数据集。REVERIE 包含 115k 机器生成的推理指令,每条指令均配有对应的正确响应与混淆响应对,并附有全面的推理依据,解释每个响应正确性或错误性的理由。在多个 LVLM 基准测试中,实验结果表明使用 REVERIE 数据集进行反思性指令调优可显著提升模型性能,验证了从推理依据中反思的有效性。项目页面为 https://zjr2000.github.io/projects/reverie
abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have shown promising performance on a variety of vision-language tasks.
