Additionally, we introduce a novel mechanism that integrates human perception feedback to guide network optimization, suppressing over/under-exposure conditions. Meanwhile, to address the issue from the temporal perspective, the designed Inter subnet fully exploits temporal cues in progressive optimization, which helps achieve improved temporal consistency in enhancement results. Consequently, the proposed method achieves superior performance to state-of-the-art methods in video illumination, noise suppression, and temporal consistency across outdoor and indoor scenes. Our code is available at https://github.com/lingyzhu0101/ UDU.git

title: Lingzhe Zhao, Peng Wang, Peidong Liu*
title_en: Lingzhe Zhao, Peng Wang, Peidong Liu*
abstract: 尽管神经渲染在3D场景重建和新视角合成方面展现出显著的能力,但其高度依赖高质量清晰图像和精确的相机姿态。已有大量方法提出利用运动模糊图像训练神经辐射场(NeRF),这类图像在低光或长曝光等现实场景中常见。然而,NeRF的隐式表示难以从严重运动模糊图像中准确恢复复杂细节,且无法实现实时渲染。相比之下,近期在三维高斯点云渲染领域的进展通过显式优化点云为三维高斯分布,实现了高质量的3D场景重建和实时渲染。本文提出了一种新型方法,命名为BAD-Gaussians(捆绑调整去模糊高斯点云渲染),该方法利用显式高斯表示,通过处理具有不精确相机姿态的严重运动模糊图像,实现高质量场景重建。我们的方法建模了运动模糊图像的物理成像过程,并在曝光时间内联合学习高斯参数同时恢复相机运动轨迹。实验表明,BAD-Gaussians不仅在合成和真实数据集上相比先前最先进的去模糊神经渲染方法实现了更优的渲染质量,还具备实时渲染能力。
abstract_en: While neural rendering has demonstrated impressive capabilities in 3D scene reconstruction and novel view synthesis, it heavily relies on high-quality sharp images and accurate camera poses. Numerous approaches have been proposed to train Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) with motion-blurred images, commonly encountered in real-world scenarios such as low-light or long-exposure conditions. However, the implicit representation of NeRF struggles to accurately recover intricate details from severely motion-blurred images and cannot achieve real-time rendering. In contrast, recent advancements in 3D Gaussian Splatting achieve high-quality 3D scene reconstruction and real-time rendering by explicitly optimizing point clouds into 3D Gaussians. In this paper, we introduce a novel approach, named BAD-Gaussians (Bundle Adjusted Deblur Gaussian Splatting), which leverages explicit Gaussian representation and handles severe motion-blurred images with inaccurate camera poses to achieve high-quality scene reconstruction. Our method models the physical image formation process of motion-blurred images and jointly learns the parameters of Gaussians while recovering camera motion trajectories during exposure time. In our experiments, we demonstrate that BAD-Gaussians not only achieves superior rendering quality compared to previous state-of-the-art deblur neural rendering methods on both synthetic and real datasets but also enables real-time rendering capabilities.

title: Lingzhuang Meng, Mingwen Shao*, Yuanjian Qiao, Wenjie Liu
title_en: Lingzhuang Meng, Mingwen Shao*, Yuanjian Qiao, Wenjie Liu
abstract: 在基于替代训练的黑盒攻击中,替代模型与目标模型的相似性对于攻击成功至关重要。然而,现有方案仅训练替代模型模仿目标模型的输出,而未充分模拟决策空间,导致替代模型生成的对抗样本被目标模型分类为非目标类别。为缓解这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的类间拓扑对齐(ICTA)方案,通过在决策空间中对齐两个模型的类间位置关系,更全面地模拟目标模型。具体而言,我们首先设计位置探索样本(PES),以更彻底地探索目标模型决策空间中类间的相对位置关系。随后,利用PES约束替代模型在不同方向上的类间相对位置,从而对齐两个模型的类间拓扑结构。这样,替代模型在决策空间中与目标模型更加一致,生成的对抗样本更可能误导目标模型将其分类为目标类别。实验结果表明,与现有替代训练方法相比,我们的ICTA在多种场景下显著提升了攻击成功率,尤其在目标攻击中表现出高效性。
abstract_en: In black-box attacks based on substitute training, the similarity of the substitute model to the target model is critical for successful attacks. However, existing schemes merely train the substitute model to mimic the outputs of the target model without fully simulating the decision space, resulting in the adversarial samples generated by the substitute model being classified into the non-target class by the target model. To alleviate this issue, we propose a novel Inter-Class Topology Alignment (ICTA) scheme to more comprehensively simulate the target model by aligning the inter-class positional relationships of two models in the decision space. Specifically, we first design the Position Exploration Sample (PES) to more thoroughly explore the relative positional relationships between classes in the decision space of the target model. Subsequently, we align the inter-class topology between the two models by utilizing the PES to constrain the inter-class relative position of the substitute model in different directions. In this way, the substitute model is more consistent with the target model in the decision space, so that the generated adversarial samples will be more successful in misleading the target model to classify them into the target class. The experimental results demonstrate that our ICTA significantly improves attack success rate in various scenarios compared to existing substitute training methods, particularly performing efficiently in target attacks.

title: Linhao Qu*, Dingkang Yang, Dan Huang, Qinhao Guo, rongkui luo, Shaoting Zhang, Xiaosong Wang*
title_en: Linhao Qu*, Dingkang Yang, Dan Huang, Qinhao Guo, rongkui luo, Shaoting Zhang, Xiaosong Wang*
abstract: 当前用于病理图像分析的多实例学习算法通常需要大量全切片图像(Whole Slide Images)进行有效训练,但在学习数据有限的场景中表现欠佳。在临床环境中,由于患者隐私保护和罕见或新兴疾病的存在,获取病理切片的访问权限受到限制。少样本弱监督全切片图像分类(Few-shot Weakly Supervised WSI Classification)的出现,能够应对有限切片数据和稀疏切片级标签的诊断挑战。基于预训练模型(如CLIP)的提示学习(Prompt Learning)似乎为该场景提供了一种有前景的方案;然而,当前相关研究仍较为有限,现有算法多局限于像素级提示或仅依赖语言提示。本文提出了一种融合病理知识的多实例提示学习框架,通过在像素级和切片级整合视觉与文本的先验知识。训练过程结合静态与可学习提示,有效引导预训练模型的激活,进一步促进关键病理模式的诊断。引入轻量级消息传递(自注意力)和摘要(注意力池化)层,以建模同一患者数据中像素与切片之间的关系。此外,对齐感知的对比损失确保了像素级和切片级视觉与文本可学习提示在特征层面的对齐。我们的方法在三个具有挑战性的临床任务中表现出色,显著优于其他少样本方法。
abstract_en: Current multi-instance learning algorithms for pathology image analysis often require a substantial number of Whole Slide Images for effective training but exhibit suboptimal performance in scenarios with limited learning data. In clinical settings, restricted access to pathology slides is inevitable due to patient privacy concerns and the prevalence of rare or emerging diseases. The emergence of the Few-shot Weakly Supervised WSI Classification accommodates the significant challenge of the limited slide data and sparse slide-level labels for diagnosis. Prompt learning based on the pre-trained models (, CLIP) appears to be a promising scheme for this setting; however, current research in this area is limited, and existing algorithms often focus solely on patch-level prompts or confine themselves to language prompts. This paper proposes a multi-instance prompt learning framework enhanced with pathology knowledge, , integrating visual and textual prior knowledge into prompts at both patch and slide levels. The training process employs a combination of static and learnable prompts, effectively guiding the activation of pre-trained models and further facilitating the diagnosis of key pathology patterns. Lightweight Messenger (self-attention) and Summary (attention-pooling) layers are introduced to model relationships between patches and slides within the same patient data. Additionally, alignment-wise contrastive losses ensure the feature-level alignment between visual and textual learnable prompts for both patches and slides. Our method demonstrates superior performance in three challenging clinical tasks, significantly outperforming comparative few-shot methods.

title: Linjiang Huang*, Rongyao Fang, Aiping Zhang, Guanglu Song, Si Liu, Yu Liu, Hongsheng Li*
title_en: Linjiang Huang*, Rongyao Fang, Aiping Zhang, Guanglu Song, Si Liu, Yu Liu, Hongsheng Li*
abstract: 本研究探讨了从预训练扩散模型生成高分辨率图像的方法,解决了当模型应用于超出其训练分辨率的场景时出现的重复模式和结构失真等持续性挑战。为解决这一问题,我们从频域分析的角度提出了一种无需训练的创新方法FouriScale。我们通过引入膨胀技术与低通操作替代预训练扩散模型中的原始卷积层,旨在分别实现结构一致性与尺度一致性。进一步结合填充后再裁剪策略,我们的方法可灵活处理不同宽高比的文本到图像生成。通过FouriScale的引导,我们的方法成功在生成图像的结构完整性与保真度之间取得平衡,实现了任意尺寸、高分辨率、高质量的图像生成。凭借其简洁性与兼容性,我们的方法为未来超高分辨率图像合成的探索提供了有价值的参考。源代码可在https://github.com/LeonHLJ/FouriScale获取。
abstract_en: In this study, we delve into the generation of high-resolution images from pre-trained diffusion models, addressing persistent challenges, such as repetitive patterns and structural distortions, that emerge when models are applied beyond their trained resolutions. To address this issue, we introduce an innovative, training-free approach FouriScale from the perspective of frequency domain analysis. We replace the original convolutional layers in pre-trained diffusion models by incorporating a dilation technique along with a low-pass operation, intending to achieve structural consistency and scale consistency across resolutions, respectively. Further enhanced by a padding-then-crop strategy, our method can flexibly handle text-to-image generation of various aspect ratios. By using the FouriScale as guidance, our method successfully balances the structural integrity and fidelity of generated images, achieving arbitrary-size, high-resolution, and high-quality generation. With its simplicity and compatibility, our method can provide valuable insights for future explorations into the synthesis of ultra-high-resolution images. The source code is available at https://github.com/LeonHLJ/FouriScale.

title: Linlan Huang, Xusheng Cao, Haori Lu, Xialei Liu*
title_en: Linlan Huang, Xusheng Cao, Haori Lu, Xialei Liu*
abstract: 类增量学习是一个具有挑战性的问题,其目标是训练一个能够随时间逐步分类更多类别的模型。随着视觉-语言预训练模型(如CLIP)的发展,它们展现出良好的泛化能力,使得在完全冻结参数的情况下,能够出色地完成类增量学习。然而,通过简单微调模型进一步适配下游任务时,会导致严重的遗忘现象。现有大多数基于预训练模型的工作假设,当模型获取新知识时,旧类别的遗忘是均匀的。本文提出了一种名为自适应表示调整与参数融合(RAPF)的方法。在新数据训练过程中,我们通过文本特征衡量新类别对旧类别的影响并调整表示。训练完成后,我们采用分解的参数融合策略,进一步缓解适配器模块微调过程中的遗忘现象。在多个传统基准测试中,我们的方法取得了最先进的结果。代码已开源,地址为https://github.com/linlany/RAPF。
abstract_en: Class-incremental learning is a challenging problem, where the goal is to train a model that can classify data from an increasing number of classes over time. With the advancement of vision-language pre-trained models such as CLIP, they demonstrate good generalization ability that allows them to excel in class-incremental learning with completely frozen parameters. However, further adaptation to downstream tasks by simply fine-tuning the model leads to severe forgetting. Most existing works with pre-trained models assume that the forgetting of old classes is uniform when the model acquires new knowledge. In this paper, we propose a method named Adaptive Representation Adjustment and Parameter Fusion (RAPF). During training for new data, we measure the influence of new classes on old ones and adjust the representations, using textual features. After training, we employ a decomposed parameter fusion to further mitigate forgetting during adapter module fine-tuning. Experiments on several conventional benchmarks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art results. Our code is available at https://github.com/linlany/RAPF.

title: Linlong Fan, Ye Huang*, Yanqi Ge, Wen Li, Lixin Duan
title_en: Linlong Fan, Ye Huang*, Yanqi Ge, Wen Li, Lixin Duan
abstract: 现有基于视图的方法在从预定义视角识别三维物体方面表现出色,但对任意视角下的识别探索有限。这是一个具有挑战性且现实的场景,因为每个物体具有不同的视角位置和数量,且其姿态未对齐。然而,大多数基于视图的方法通过聚合多视角特征来获取全局特征表示,难以应对任意视角下的三维物体识别。由于任意视角输入的未对齐性,特征稳健聚合具有挑战性,导致性能下降。本文提出了一种新颖的部件感知网络(PANet),采用基于部件的表示方法来解决这些问题。这种基于部件的表示旨在定位和理解三维物体的不同部件,如飞机机翼和尾部。其具有视角不变性和旋转鲁棒性等特性,在应对任意视角下的三维物体识别问题时具有优势。我们的实验结果在基准数据集上清楚地表明,所提出的方法在任意视角下的三维物体识别任务中优于现有的基于视图聚合基线方法,甚至超越了大多数固定视角方法。
abstract_en: Existing view-based methods excel at recognizing 3D objects from predefined viewpoints, but their exploration of recognition under arbitrary views is limited. This is a challenging and realistic setting because each object has different viewpoint positions and quantities, and their poses are not aligned. However, most view-based methods, which aggregate multiple view features to obtain a global feature representation, hard to address 3D object recognition under arbitrary views. Due to the unaligned inputs from arbitrary views, it is challenging to robustly aggregate features, leading to performance degradation. In this paper, we introduce a novel Part-aware Network (PANet), which is a part-based representation, to address these issues. This part-based representation aims to localize and understand different parts of 3D objects, such as airplane wings and tails. It has properties such as viewpoint invariance and rotation robustness, which give it an advantage in addressing the 3D object recognition problem under arbitrary views. Our results on benchmark datasets clearly demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms existing view-based aggregation baselines for the task of 3D object recognition under arbitrary views, even surpassing most fixed viewpoint methods.

title: Linrui Tian*, Qi Wang*, Bang Zhang*, Liefeng Bo*
title_en: Linrui Tian*, Qi Wang*, Bang Zhang*, Liefeng Bo*
abstract: 本工作中,我们通过关注音频提示与面部动作之间动态且细腻的关系,来应对提升说话头视频生成真实感和表现力的挑战。我们识别出传统技术的局限性,这些技术往往无法捕捉人类表情的完整范围以及个体面部风格的独特性。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了EMO,一个新颖的框架,采用直接音频到视频的合成方法,无需中间3D模型或面部关键点。我们的方法确保视频中帧的无缝过渡和身份的一致性保持,从而产生高度表达且逼真的动画。实验结果表明,EMO不仅能够生成令人信服的说话视频,还能生成各种风格的唱歌视频,在表现力和真实感方面显著优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: In this work, we tackle the challenge of enhancing the realism and expressiveness in talking head video generation by focusing on the dynamic and nuanced relationship between audio cues and facial movements. We identify the limitations of traditional techniques that often fail to capture the full spectrum of human expressions and the uniqueness of individual facial styles. To address these issues, we propose EMO, a novel framework that utilizes a direct audio-to-video synthesis approach, bypassing the need for intermediate 3D models or facial landmarks. Our method ensures seamless frame transitions and consistent identity preservation throughout the video, resulting in highly expressive and lifelike animations. Experimental results demonstrate that EMO is able to produce not only convincing speaking videos but also singing videos in various styles, significantly outperforming existing state-of-the-art methodologies in terms of expressiveness and realism.

title: Lintao Peng, Siyu Xie, Liheng Bian*
title_en: Lintao Peng, Siyu Xie, Liheng Bian*
abstract: 近年来,基于学习的高光谱图像(HSI)重建方法展现出 promising performance。然而,现有基于学习的方法仍面临两个问题。1)它们很少同时考虑高光谱图像的空间稀疏性和跨波段相似性先验。2)它们对所有图像区域一视同仁,忽略了纹理丰富和边缘区域比平滑区域更难以重建。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种不确定性驱动的高光谱图像重建方法,称为 Specformer。具体而言,我们首先引入了一个频域自注意力(FWSA)模块,并将其与空间域局部窗口自注意力(LWSA)模块并行结合,形成空间-频率(SF)模块。LWSA 可引导网络关注密集光谱信息区域,FWSA 可捕捉跨波段相似性。并行设计有助于网络建模跨窗口连接,扩展感受野同时保持线性复杂度。我们将 SF 模块作为多尺度 U 型网络的主要构建块,形成我们的 Specformer。此外,我们引入了不确定性驱动的损失函数,可强化网络对纹理丰富和边缘区域的关注。在模拟和真实高光谱图像数据集上的实验表明,我们的 Specformer 在计算和内存成本更低的情况下优于现有最先进方法。代码可在 https://github.com/bianlab/Specformer 获取。
abstract_en: Recently, learning-based Hyperspectral image (HSI) reconstruction methods have demonstrated promising performance. However, existing learning-based methods still face two issues. 1) They rarely consider both the spatial sparsity and inter-spectral similarity priors of HSI. 2) They treat all image regions equally, ignoring that texture-rich and edge regions are more difficult to reconstruct than smooth regions. To address these issues, we propose an uncertainty-driven HSI reconstruction method termed Specformer. Specifically, we first introduce a frequency-wise self-attention (FWSA) module, and combine it with a spatial-wise local-window self-attention (LWSA) module in parallel to form a Spatial-Frequency (SF) block. LWSA can guide the network to focus on the regions with dense spectral information, and FWSA can capture the inter-spectral similarity. Parallel design helps the network to model cross-window connections, and expand its receptive fields while maintaining linear complexity. We use SF-block as the main building block in a multi-scale U-shape network to form our Specformer. In addition, we introduce an uncertainty-driven loss function, which can reinforce the network’s attention to the challenging regions with rich textures and edges. Experiments on simulated and real HSI datasets show that our Specformer outperforms state-of-the-art methods with lower computational and memory costs. The code is available at https://github.com/bianlab/Specformer.

title: Linus Härenstam-Nielsen*, 卢桑, Abhishek Saroha, Nikita Araslanov*, Daniel Cremers*
title_en: Linus Härenstam-Nielsen*, Lu Sang, Abhishek Saroha, Nikita Araslanov*, Daniel Cremers*
abstract: 神经隐式曲面可用于从不完美的点云中恢复精确的3D几何结构。在本文中,我们展示最先进的技术通过最小化单侧Chamfer距离的近似值来实现。这种形状度量是非对称的,因为它仅确保点云接近曲面,但不保证曲面接近点云。因此,现有方法可能产生包含虚假表面的不准确重建。尽管文献中广泛使用了一种对抗虚假表面的方法,但我们通过理论和实验表明,这种方法等同于对曲面面积进行正则化,导致过度平滑。作为一种更具吸引力的替代方案,我们提出DiffCD,一种对应于对称Chamfer距离的新损失函数。与之前的工作不同,DiffCD还确保曲面接近点云,从而在无需额外正则化的情况下消除虚假表面。我们实验表明,DiffCD能够可靠地恢复高度的形状细节,在不同表面复杂度和噪声水平下显著优于现有方法。项目代码可在https://github.com/linusnie/diffcd获取。
abstract_en: Neural implicit surfaces can be used to recover accurate 3D geometry from imperfect point clouds. In this work, we show that state-of-the-art techniques work by minimizing an approximation of a one-sided Chamfer distance. This shape metric is not symmetric, as it only ensures that the point cloud is near the surface but not vice versa. As a consequence, existing methods can produce inaccurate reconstructions with spurious surfaces. Although one approach against spurious surfaces has been widely used in the literature, we theoretically and experimentally show that it is equivalent to regularizing the surface area, resulting in over-smoothing. As a more appealing alternative, we propose DiffCD, a novel loss function corresponding to the symmetric Chamfer distance. In contrast to previous work, DiffCD also assures that the surface is near the point cloud, which eliminates spurious surfaces without the need for additional regularization. We experimentally show that DiffCD reliably recovers a high degree of shape detail, substantially outperforming existing work across varying surface complexity and noise levels. Project code is available at https://github.com/linusnie/ diffcd.

title: Linxi Huan, Mingyue Dong, Linwei Yue, Shuhan Shen, Xianwei Zheng*
title_en: Linxi Huan, Mingyue Dong, Linwei Yue, Shuhan Shen, Xianwei Zheng*
abstract: 本文提出了一种侧视上下文修复策略(SidePaint),以简化未知3D模式的推理,用于语义场景补全。基于观察到模式补全的学习负担随着空间复杂度和特征稀疏性的增加而增加,SidePaint策略被设计为将复杂的3D模式学习分解为更简单的2D上下文修复,使用密集的特征体积。具体而言,我们的方法通过距离感知投影将图像特征密集地提升到3D体积空间,并在从特征体积中切片的2D侧视特征图中推理缺失的模式。通过在2D空间中降低模式复杂性来减轻学习负担,我们的SidePaint策略比直接学习3D模式实现了更有效的语义补全。大量实验验证了我们的SidePaint策略在多个具有挑战性的语义场景补全基准上的有效性。
abstract_en: This paper proposes a side-view context inpainting strategy (SidePaint) to ease the reasoning of unknown 3D patterns for semantic scene completion. Based on the observation that the learning burden on pattern completion increases with spatial complexity and feature sparsity, the SidePaint strategy is designed to decompose the complex 3D pattern learning into easier 2D context inpainting with dense feature volumes. Specifically, our approach densely lifts image features into 3D volume space with distance-aware projection, and reasons missing patterns in 2D side-view feature maps sliced from feature volumes. With the learning burden relieved by decreasing pattern complexity in 2D space, our SidePaint strategy enables more effective semantic completion than directly learning 3D patterns. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our SidePaint strategy on several challenging semantic scene completion benchmarks.

title: Linyan Yang*, Lukas Hoyer*, Mark Weber, Tobias Fischer, Dengxin Dai, Laura Leal-Taixé, Daniel Cremers, Marc Pollefeys, Luc Van Gool
title_en: Linyan Yang*, Lukas Hoyer*, Mark Weber, Tobias Fischer, Dengxin Dai, Laura Leal-Taixé, Daniel Cremers, Marc Pollefeys, Luc Van Gool
abstract: 无监督域适应(UDA)是连接带标签源域(例如合成数据)与无标签目标域之间的任务。我们观察到,当前的UDA方法在细结构上表现较差,并倾向于对具有歧义外观的对象进行过度分割。为了解决这些不足,我们提出利用几何信息,即深度预测,因为深度不连续性通常与分割边界一致。我们表明,简单地将深度信息纳入当前的UDA方法中并不能充分利用这种互补信息的潜力。为此,我们提出了MICDrop,通过掩码图像编码器特征的同时反向掩码深度编码器特征,学习联合特征表示。通过这种简单而有效的互补掩码策略,我们强制在学习联合特征表示时同时使用两种模态。为了辅助这一过程,我们提出了一种特征融合模块,以提高全局和局部信息共享,同时对深度预测中的错误具有鲁棒性。我们证明,我们的方法可以嵌入到各种近期的UDA方法中,并在标准UDA基准测试中持续提升结果,取得新的最先进性能。项目页面:https://github.com/ly-muc/MICDrop
abstract_en: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) is the task of bridging the domain gap between a labeled source domain, e.g., synthetic data, and an unlabeled target domain. We observe that current UDA methods show inferior results on fine structures and tend to oversegment objects with ambiguous appearance. To address these shortcomings, we propose to leverage geometric information, i.e., depth predictions, as depth discontinuities often coincide with segmentation boundaries. We show that naively incorporating depth into current UDA methods does not fully exploit the potential of this complementary information. To this end, we present MICDrop, which learns a joint feature representation by masking image encoder features while inversely masking depth encoder features. With this simple yet effective complementary masking strategy, we enforce the use of both modalities when learning the joint feature representation. To aid this process, we propose a feature fusion module to improve both global as well as local information sharing while being robust to errors in the depth predictions. We show that our method can be plugged into various recent UDA methods and consistently improve results across standard UDA benchmarks, obtaining new state-of-the-art performances. Project Page: https://github.com/ly-muc/ MICDrop

title: Liqi Yan*, Qifan Wang, Junhan Zhao, Qiang Guan, Zheng Tang, Jianhui Zhang, Dongfang Liu*
title_en: Liqi Yan*, Qifan Wang, Junhan Zhao, Qiang Guan, Zheng Tang, Jianhui Zhang, Dongfang Liu*
abstract: 第一人称视角(FPV)在革新无人机(UAV)轨迹方面展现出巨大潜力,为在复杂建筑结构中导航提供了令人兴奋的途径。然而,传统神经辐射场(NeRF)方法面临诸如每次迭代仅采样单个点、需要大量视角进行监督等挑战。无人机视频进一步加剧了这些问题,由于视角有限且空间尺度变化显著,导致在不同尺度下细节渲染不足。为此,我们提出FPV-NeRF,通过三个关键方面解决这些挑战:(1)时间一致性。利用时空连续性确保帧间无缝连贯;(2)全局结构。在点采样过程中融入多种全局特征以保持空间完整性;(3)局部精细度。采用综合框架和多分辨率监督实现多尺度场景特征表示,应对无人机视频的空间尺度复杂性。此外,由于公开可用的FPV视频资源稀缺,我们引入了一种创新的视角合成方法,利用NeRF从无人机视频生成FPV视角,增强无人机的空间感知能力。我们的新型数据集涵盖无人机领域从户外到室内的多样化轨迹,与传统NeRF场景存在显著差异。通过在室内外建筑结构上的广泛实验,FPV-NeRF在我们构建的无人机数据集中展现出对飞行空间更深入的理解,优于现有最先进的方法。进一步信息请访问我们的项目页面:https://fpv-nerf. github.io/
abstract_en: First-Person-View (FPV) holds immense potential for revolutionizing the trajectory of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), offering an exhilarating avenue for navigating complex building structures. Yet, traditional Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) methods face challenges such as sampling single points per iteration and requiring an extensive array of views for supervision. UAV videos exacerbate these issues with limited viewpoints and significant spatial scale variations, resulting in inadequate detail rendering across diverse scales. In response, we introduce FPV-NeRF, addressing these challenges through three key facets: (1) Temporal consistency. Leveraging spatio-temporal continuity ensures seamless coherence between frames; (2) Global structure. Incorporating various global features during point sampling preserves space integrity; (3) Local granularity. Employing a comprehensive framework and multi-resolution supervision for multi-scale scene feature representation tackles the intricacies of UAV video spatial scales. Additionally, due to the scarcity of publicly available FPV videos, we introduce an innovative view synthesis method using NeRF to generate FPV perspectives from UAV footage, enhancing spatial perception for drones. Our novel dataset spans diverse trajectories, from outdoor to indoor environments, in the UAV domain, differing significantly from traditional NeRF scenarios. Through extensive experiments encompassing both interior and exterior building structures, FPV-NeRF demonstrates a superior understanding of the UAV flying space, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in our curated UAV dataset. Explore our project page for further insights: https://fpv-nerf. github.io/.

title: Liqiang He*, Sinisa Todorovic
title_en: Liqiang He*, Sinisa Todorovic
abstract: 本工作针对跨域语义分割问题。尽管近期的卷积神经网络和无需提议的Transformer取得了显著进展,我们提出了一种新的Transformer模型,其编码器更轻量,解码器采用更复杂的结构,通过查询标记预测分割掩码,称为__TITLE_MATH_1__。通过两种机制减少源域与目标域之间的域差距。首先,我们将解码器中的跨注意力分解为域无关和域特定部分,强制查询标记与图像标记的域无关属性交互,这些属性在源域和目标域中共享,而非导致域差距的域特定属性。其次,我们使用梯度反转块控制梯度反向传播,从而在__TITLE_MATH_1__的解码器中引入对抗学习。在两个基准域迁移任务——GTA到Cityscapes和SYNTHIA到Cityscapes上的实验结果表明,__TITLE_MATH_1__在显著更低复杂度下优于当前最先进的无需提议方法。实现代码可在https://github.com/helq2612/ADFormer获取。
abstract_en: This work addresses cross-domain semantic segmentation. While recent CNNs and proposal-free transformers led to significant advances, we introduce a new transformer with a lighter encoder and more complex decoder with query tokens for predicting segmentation masks, called . The domain gap between the source and target domains is reduced with two mechanisms. First, we decompose cross-attention in the decoder into domain-independent and domain-specific parts to enforce the query tokens interact with the domain-independent aspects of the image tokens, shared by the source and target domains, rather than domain-specific counterparts which induce the domain gap. Second, we use the gradient reverse block to control back-propagation of the gradient, and hence introduce adversarial learning in the decoder of . Our results on two benchmark domain shifts – GTA to Cityscapes and SYNTHIA to Cityscapes – show that outperforms SOTA proposal-free methods with significantly lower complexity. The implementation is available at https://github.com/helq2612/ADFormer.

title: Liren He, Zhengkai Jiang, Jinlong Peng, Wenbing Zhu, Liang Liu, Qiangang Du, Xiaobin Hu, Mingmin Chi*, Yabiao Wang*, Chengjie Wang*
title_en: Liren He, Zhengkai Jiang, Jinlong Peng, Wenbing Zhu, Liang Liu, Qiangang Du, Xiaobin Hu, Mingmin Chi*, Yabiao Wang*, Chengjie Wang*
abstract: 在多类异常检测领域,基于重构的单类异常检测方法面临“学习捷径”的著名挑战,即模型未能正确学习正常样本的模式,而是选择恒等映射或人工噪声消除等捷径。因此,模型无法重构真实异常作为正常实例,导致异常检测失败。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的统一特征重构异常检测框架,称为RLR(从可学习参考表示中重构特征)。与以往方法不同,RLR利用可学习参考表示迫使模型显式学习正常特征模式,从而避免陷入“学习捷径”问题。此外,RLR在可学习参考中引入局部性约束,以更有效地捕捉正常模式,并采用掩码可学习键注意力机制提升鲁棒性。在15类MVTec-AD数据集和12类VisA数据集上的评估表明,在统一设置下,RLR的性能优于现有最先进的方法。代码可在RLR获取。
abstract_en: In the field of multi-class anomaly detection, reconstruction-based methods derived from single-class anomaly detection face the well-known challenge of “learning shortcuts”, wherein the model fails to learn the patterns of normal samples as it should, opting instead for shortcuts such as identity mapping or artificial noise elimination. Consequently, the model becomes unable to reconstruct genuine anomalies as normal instances, resulting in a failure of anomaly detection. To counter this issue, we present a novel unified feature reconstruction-based anomaly detection framework termed RLR (Reconstruct features from a Learnable Reference representation). Unlike previous methods, RLR utilizes learnable reference representations to compel the model to learn normal feature patterns explicitly, thereby prevents the model from succumbing to the “learning shortcuts” issue. Additionally, RLR incorporates locality constraints into the learnable reference to facilitate more effective normal pattern capture and utilizes a masked learnable key attention mechanism to enhance robustness. Evaluation of RLR on the 15-category MVTec-AD dataset and the 12-category VisA dataset shows superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods under the unified setting. Code is available at RLR.

title: Liting Lin, Heng Fan, Zhipeng Zhang, Yaowei Wang*, Yong Xu, Haibin Ling*
title_en: Liting Lin, Heng Fan, Zhipeng Zhang, Yaowei Wang*, Yong Xu, Haibin Ling*
abstract: 受大语言模型中参数高效微调(PEFT)的启发,我们提出LoRAT方法,揭示了在实验室级资源下使用更大视觉Transformer(ViT)进行跟踪的潜力。我们的工作核心在于将LoRA技术(一种无需增加推理延迟即可微调模型小部分参数的技术)应用于视觉跟踪领域。然而,独特的挑战和潜在的领域差异使得这种迁移并不像第一直觉那样简单。首先,基于Transformer的跟踪器为模板图像和搜索图像构建了非共享的位置嵌入。这给LoRA的迁移带来了挑战,通常需要在应用于预训练主干网络时保持设计的一致性,以适应下游任务。其次,卷积头固有的归纳偏置削弱了参数高效微调在跟踪模型中的有效性。为克服这些限制,我们首先将基于Transformer的跟踪器中的位置嵌入解耦为共享空间嵌入和独立类型嵌入。共享嵌入描述多分辨率图像(即模板图像和搜索图像)的绝对坐标,继承自预训练主干网络;而独立嵌入表示每个token的来源,并从头开始学习。此外,我们设计了一个基于多层感知机(MLP)的无锚头,以适配PETR,从而在减少计算开销的同时实现更好的性能。通过我们的设计,1)可在仅25.8GB显存(批量大小为16)的GPU上训练使用ViT-g主干网络的跟踪器;2)将L-224变体的训练时间从35.0降至10.8 GPU小时;3)使用L-224变体将LaSOT SUC分数从0.703提升至0.742;4)将L-224变体的推理速度从52 FPS提升至119 FPS。代码和模型可在https://github.com/LitingLin/LoRAT获取。
abstract_en: Motivated by the Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) in large language models, we propose LoRAT, a method that unveils the power of larger Vision Transformers (ViT) for tracking within laboratory-level resources. The essence of our work lies in adapting LoRA, a technique that fine-tunes a small subset of model parameters without adding inference latency, to the domain of visual tracking. However, unique challenges and potential domain gaps make this transfer not as easy as the first intuition. Firstly, a transformer-based tracker constructs unshared position embedding for template and search image. This poses a challenge for the transfer of LoRA, usually requiring consistency in the design when applied to the pre-trained backbone, to downstream tasks. Secondly, the inductive bias inherent in convolutional heads diminishes the effectiveness of parameter-efficient fine-tuning in tracking models. To overcome these limitations, we first decouple the position embeddings in transformer-based trackers into shared spatial ones and independent type ones. The shared embeddings, which describe the absolute coordinates of multi-resolution images (namely, the template and search images), are inherited from the pre-trained backbones. In contrast, the independent embeddings indicate the sources of each token and are learned from scratch. Furthermore, we design an anchor-free head solely based on a multilayer perceptron (MLP) to adapt PETR, enabling better performance with less computational overhead. With our design, 1) it becomes practical to train trackers with the ViT-g backbone on GPUs with only memory of 25.8GB (batch size of 16); 2) we reduce the training time of the L-224 variant from 35.0 to 10.8 GPU hours; 3) we improve the LaSOT SUC score from 0.703 to 0.742 with the L-224 variant; 4) we fast the inference speed of the L-224 variant from 52 to 119 FPS. Code and models are available at https://github.com/LitingLin/LoRAT.

title: Liu He*, Daniel Aliaga
title_en: Liu He*, Daniel Aliaga
abstract: 大规模城市布局生成在多个学科中引起了广泛关注。先前的方法采用程序生成需要手动编码规则或深度学习需要大量数据。然而,先前的方法未考虑城市布局生成的上下文敏感性。我们的方法通过利用整个城市的规范图表示来解决这一问题,这有助于可扩展性并捕捉城市布局中固有的多层语义。我们引入了一种新颖的基于图的掩码自编码器(GMAE)用于城市尺度的城市布局生成。该方法将带属性的建筑、城市街区、社区和城市编码为统一的图结构,从而实现图自编码器的自监督掩码训练。此外,我们采用计划迭代采样进行2.5D布局生成,优先生成重要的城市街区和建筑。我们的方法在330个美国城市的异构城市风格中实现了良好的真实感、语义一致性和正确性。代码和数据集已发布在https://github.com/Arking1995/COHO。
abstract_en: The generation of large-scale urban layouts has garnered substantial interest across various disciplines. Prior methods have utilized procedural generation requiring manual rule coding or deep learning needing abundant data. However, prior approaches have not considered the context-sensitive nature of urban layout generation. Our approach addresses this gap by leveraging a canonical graph representation for the entire city, which facilitates scalability and captures the multi-layer semantics inherent in urban layouts. We introduce a novel graph-based masked autoencoder (GMAE) for city-scale urban layout generation. The method encodes attributed buildings, city blocks, communities and cities into a unified graph structure, enabling self-supervised masked training for graph autoencoder. Additionally, we employ scheduled iterative sampling for 2.5D layout generation, prioritizing the generation of important city blocks and buildings. Our approach achieves good realism, semantic consistency, and correctness across the heterogeneous urban styles in 330 US cities. Codes and datasets are released at https://github.com/Arking1995/COHO.

title: Liwen Hu*, Ziluo Ding, Mianzhi Liu, Lei Ma*, Tiejun Huang
title_en: Liwen Hu*, Ziluo Ding, Mianzhi Liu, Lei Ma*, Tiejun Huang
abstract: 高时间分辨率尖峰相机能够产生连续二进制尖峰流以记录每个像素的光强度。通过使用重建方法,可以从尖峰流中恢复高速场景中的场景细节。然而,现有方法在低光环境下表现不佳,因为尖峰流中信息不足。为此,我们提出了一种基于双向循环的重建框架,以更好地处理此类极端条件。具体而言,设计了一种光照鲁棒表示(LR-Rep)以聚合尖峰流中的时间信息。此外,融合模块用于提取时间特征。同时,我们合成了一组高速低光场景的重建数据集,其中光源设计与现实情况保持一致。实验表明我们的方法具有优越性。重要的是,我们的方法也很好地推广到真实尖峰流。我们的项目是:https://github.com/Acnext/Learning-to-Robustly-Reconstruct-Dynamic-
abstract_en: Spike camera with high temporal resolution can fire continuous binary spike streams to record per-pixel light intensity. By using reconstruction methods, the scene details in high-speed scenes can be restored from spike streams. However, existing methods struggle to perform well in low-light environments due to insufficient information in spike streams. To this end, we propose a bidirectional recurrent-based reconstruction framework to better handle such extreme conditions. In more detail, a light-robust representation (LR-Rep) is designed to aggregate temporal information in spike streams. Moreover, a fusion module is used to extract temporal features. Besides, we synthesize a reconstruction dataset for high-speed low-light scenes where light sources are carefully designed to be consistent with reality. The experiment shows the superiority of our method. Importantly, our method also generalizes well to real spike streams. Our project is: https://github.com/Acnext/Learning-to-Robustly-Reconstruct-Dynamic-

title: Lixin Xue*, Chen Guo, Chengwei Zheng, Fangjinhua Wang, Tianjian Jiang, Hsuan-I Ho, Manuel Kaufmann, Jie Song, Otmar Hilliges
title_en: Lixin Xue*, Chen Guo, Chengwei Zheng, Fangjinhua Wang, Tianjian Jiang, Hsuan-I Ho, Manuel Kaufmann, Jie Song, Otmar Hilliges
abstract: 计算机辅助感知系统的一个总体目标是实现以人类为中心的三维世界的整体理解,包括对人类、场景及其全局空间关系的忠实重建。尽管单目三维重建在仅针对人类或场景的视频 footage 上已取得进展,但对人类与场景的联合重建及其全局空间信息仍是一个未解决的挑战。为了解决这一问题,我们引入了一种新颖且统一的框架,能够从单目RGB视频中同时实现静态场景与动态人类在时间和空间上一致的三维重建。具体而言,我们利用共享的三维空间中的两个神经场,对时间一致的规范人体模型和静态场景表示进行参数化。此外,我们开发了一个全局优化框架,考虑了潜在的人体-场景穿透和遮挡所施加的物理约束。与单独重建相比,我们的框架能够实现人类和场景的详细且整体的几何重建。此外,我们引入了一个合成数据集用于定量评估。在真实世界和合成视频上的大量实验和消融研究证明了我们的框架在单目人-场景重建中的有效性。代码和数据可在我们的项目页面上公开获取。
abstract_en: An overarching goal for computer-aided perception systems is the holistic understanding of the human-centric 3D world, including faithful reconstructions of humans, scenes, and their global spatial relationships. While recent progress in monocular 3D reconstruction has been made for footage of either humans or scenes alone, the joint reconstruction of both humans and scenes, along with their global spatial information, remains an unsolved challenge. To address this, we introduce a novel and unified framework that simultaneously achieves temporally and spatially coherent 3D reconstruction of static scenes with dynamic humans from monocular RGB videos. Specifically, we parameterize temporally consistent canonical human models and static scene representations using two neural fields in a shared 3D space. Additionally, we develop a global optimization framework that considers physical constraints imposed by potential human-scene interpenetration and occlusion. Compared to separate reconstructions, our framework enables detailed and holistic geometry reconstructions of both humans and scenes. Furthermore, we introduce a synthetic dataset for quantitative evaluations. Extensive experiments and ablation studies on both real-world and synthetic videos demonstrate the efficacy of our framework in monocular human-scene reconstruction. Code and data are publicly available on our project page.

title: Lixiong Qin*, Mei Wang, Xuannan Liu, Yuhang Zhang, Wei Deng, Xiaoshuai Song, Weiran Xu*, Weihong Deng
title_en: Lixiong Qin*, Mei Wang, Xuannan Liu, Yuhang Zhang, Wei Deng, Xiaoshuai Song, Weiran Xu*, Weihong Deng
abstract: 随着对各类人脸分析任务的综合研究不断深入,研究者们日益关注开发一种统一的方法来实现人脸感知。现有方法主要讨论统一表示与训练,缺乏任务扩展性和应用效率。为解决这一问题,我们聚焦于统一的模型结构,探索了一种通用人脸模型。作为一种直观的设计,Naive Faceptor使具有相同输出形状和粒度的任务能够共享标准化输出头的结构设计,从而提升了任务扩展性。此外,Faceptor采用精心设计的单编码器双解码器架构,允许任务特定查询表示新出现的语义。该设计在统一模型结构的同时,提高了存储开销方面的应用效率。此外,我们引入Layer-Attention机制到Faceptor中,使模型能够自适应地从最优层中选择特征以执行所需任务。通过在13个面部感知数据集上的联合训练,Faceptor在面部关键点定位、面部解析、年龄估计、表情识别、二分类属性分类和人脸识别等任务中均取得了卓越性能,在大多数任务中达到或超越了专用方法的性能。我们的训练框架还可应用于辅助监督学习,在数据稀疏任务如年龄估计和表情识别中显著提升了性能。代码和模型将在https://github.com/lxq1000/Faceptor公开。
abstract_en: With the comprehensive research conducted on various face analysis tasks, there is a growing interest among researchers to develop a unified approach to face perception. Existing methods mainly discuss unified representation and training, which lack task extensibility and application efficiency. To tackle this issue, we focus on the unified model structure, exploring a face generalist model. As an intuitive design, Naive Faceptor enables tasks with the same output shape and granularity to share the structural design of the standardized output head, achieving improved task extensibility. Furthermore, Faceptor is proposed to adopt a well-designed single-encoder dual-decoder architecture, allowing task-specific queries to represent new-coming semantics. This design enhances the unification of model structure while improving application efficiency in terms of storage overhead. Additionally, we introduce Layer-Attention into Faceptor, enabling the model to adaptively select features from optimal layers to perform the desired tasks. Through joint training on 13 face perception datasets, Faceptor achieves exceptional performance in facial landmark localization, face parsing, age estimation, expression recognition, binary attribute classification, and face recognition, achieving or surpassing specialized methods in most tasks. Our training framework can also be applied to auxiliary supervised learning, significantly improving performance in data-sparse tasks such as age estimation and expression recognition. The code and models will be made publicly available at https://github.com/lxq1000/Faceptor.

title: Lixuan Zhang, Meina Kan, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen*
title_en: Lixuan Zhang, Meina Kan, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen*
abstract: 近年来,基于模型的强化学习技术通过构建关于环境动态的世界模型来学习决策方法。世界模型的学习需要与真实环境进行大量交互。因此,诸如APV等创新方法提出通过大规模视频进行无监督预训练世界模型,从而减少对真实环境的交互次数以微调世界模型。然而,这些方法仅将世界模型预训练为无动作条件的视频预测模型,而最终的世界模型是动作条件的。这一差距限制了无监督预训练在增强世界模型能力方面的有效性。为进一步释放无监督预训练的潜力,我们提出了一种方法,即从无动作视频中预训练世界模型,但结合可学习动作表示(PreLAR)。具体而言,将两个相邻时间步的观测编码为隐式动作表示,从而将世界模型预训练为动作条件模型。为使隐式动作表示更接近真实动作,设计了动作-状态一致性损失以实现其自监督优化。在微调阶段,将真实动作编码为动作表示,以训练整体世界模型完成下游任务。所提出的方法在Meta-world模拟环境中评估了各种视觉控制任务。结果表明,所提出的PreLAR显著提升了世界模型学习的样本效率,证明了在世界模型预训练中引入动作的必要性。代码可访问 https://github.com/zhanglixuan0720/PreLAR
abstract_en: The recent technique of Model-Based Reinforcement Learning learns to make decisions by building a world model about the dynamics of the environment. The world model learning requires extensive interactions with the real environment. Therefore, several innovative approaches such as APV proposed to unsupervised pre-train the world model from large-scale videos, allowing fewer interactions to fine-tune the world model. However, these methods only pre-train the world model as a video predictive model without action conditions, while the final world model is action-conditional. This gap limits the effectiveness of unsupervised pre-training in enhancing the world model’s capabilities. To further release the potential of unsupervised pre-training, we introduce an approach that Pre-trains the world model from action-free videos but with Learnable Action Representation (PreLAR). Specifically, the observations of two adjacent time steps are encoded as an implicit action representation, with which the world model is pre-trained as action conditional. To make the implicit action representation closer to the real action, an action-state consistency loss is designed to self-supervise its optimization. During fine-tuning, the real actions are encoded as the action representation to train the overall world model for downstream tasks. The proposed method is evaluated on various visual control tasks from the Meta-world simulation environment. The results show that the proposed PreLAR significantly improves the sample efficiency in world model learning, demonstrating the necessity of incorporating action in the world model pre-training. Codes can be found at https://github.com/zhanglixuan0720/PreLAR

title: Long Li, Nian Liu*, Dingwen Zhang, Zhongyu Li, Salman Khan, Rao Anwer, Hisham Cholakkal, Junwei Han*, Fahad Shahbaz Khan
title_en: Long Li, Nian Liu*, Dingwen Zhang, Zhongyu Li, Salman Khan, Rao Anwer, Hisham Cholakkal, Junwei Han*, Fahad Shahbaz Khan
abstract: 跨图像关联建模对于共显著物体检测至关重要。尽管现有方法在性能上表现良好,但它们在充分的跨图像关联建模方面仍存在局限性。因为大多数方法在启发式计算的原始跨图像关联指导下,专注于图像特征优化。它们直接依赖于原始关联,这些关联在复杂场景中不可靠,且其图像特征优化方法对跨图像关联建模不够明确。为缓解这些局限性,本文提出了一种深度关联学习策略,通过深度网络对原始关联进行显式转换,生成深度关联特征。具体而言,我们首先创建超关联以收集密集的像素对原始关联,然后在这些超关联上部署深度聚合网络。为此,我们设计了一个渐进式关联生成模块,并额外增强了超关联计算。更重要的是,我们提出了一种基于对应关系的关联压缩模块,引入了一个预训练任务——语义对应关系估计,以压缩超关联,减少计算负担并消除噪声。我们还设计了一个对象感知的循环一致性损失以实现高质量的对应关系估计。在三个基准数据集上的实验结果证明了所提方法在不同训练设置下的显著有效性。代码可在以下链接获取:https://github.com/dragonlee258079/CONDA。
abstract_en: Inter-image association modeling is crucial for co-salient object detection. Despite satisfactory performance, previous methods still have limitations on sufficient inter-image association modeling. Because most of them focus on image feature optimization under the guidance of heuristically calculated raw inter-image associations. They directly rely on raw associations which are not reliable in complex scenarios, and their image feature optimization approach is not explicit for inter-image association modeling. To alleviate these limitations, this paper proposes a deep association learning strategy that deploys deep networks on raw associations to explicitly transform them into deep association features. Specifically, we first create hyperassociations to collect dense pixel-pair-wise raw associations and then deploys deep aggregation networks on them. We design a progressive association generation module for this purpose with additional enhancement of the hyperassociation calculation. More importantly, we propose a correspondence-induced association condensation module that introduces a pretext task, semantic correspondence estimation, to condense the hyperassociations for computational burden reduction and noise elimination. We also design an object-aware cycle consistency loss for high-quality correspondence estimations. Experimental results in three benchmark datasets demonstrate the remarkable effectiveness of our proposed method with various training settings. The code is available at: https://github.com/dragonlee258079/CONDA.

title: Longrong Yang, Hanbin Zhao, Yunlong Yu*, Xiaodong Zeng, Xi Li*
title_en: Longrong Yang, Hanbin Zhao, Yunlong Yu*, Xiaodong Zeng, Xi Li*
abstract: 基于提示的持续学习是利用预训练知识进行下游持续学习的一个新兴方向。当进入新会话时,现有的基于提示的持续学习方法通常通过引入提示来调整预训练模型的特征以适应新数据。然而,这些提示缺乏显式建模会话间类别关系的优化目标,因此无法构建清晰的会话间类别边界。此外,一些旧样本在推理过程中使用新提示,导致提示歧义重叠空间——一种旧类别空间与新类别空间重叠的特殊情形。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了一种创新方法RCS-Prompt,通过双向优化提示来重新排列类别空间。RCS-Prompt优化提示以在类别空间中表示不同会话的判别区域。此外,它通过修改一小部分新样本的标签为旧类别,并使用定制的对称损失函数对其进行训练,从而缓解提示歧义重叠空间。所提出的方法有效减少了旧类别空间与新类别空间的重叠,从而建立了清晰的会话间类别边界。我们在公开数据集上广泛评估了RCS-Prompt,证明了其在基于提示的持续学习中的有效性。代码可在https://github.com/longrongyang/RCS-Prompt获取。
abstract_en: Prompt-based Continual Learning is an emerging direction in leveraging pre-trained knowledge for downstream continual learning. While arriving at a new session, existing prompt-based continual learning methods usually adapt features from pre-trained models to new data by introducing prompts. However, these prompts lack an optimization objective explicitly modeling inter-session class relationships, thus failing to construct clear inter-session class margins. Moreover, some old samples use new prompts during inference, resulting in the prompt-ambiguity overlap space - a special situation where old and new class spaces overlap. To address these issues, we propose an innovative approach called RCS-Prompt to Rearrange Class Space by bidirectionally optimizing prompts. RCS-Prompt optimizes prompts to signify discriminative regions across different sessions in the class space. Additionally, it mitigates the prompt-ambiguity overlap space by altering the labels of a small subset of new samples to old classes and training them with a customized symmetric loss. The proposed method effectively reduces the overlap between old and new class spaces, thereby establishing clear inter-session class margins. We extensively evaluate RCS-Prompt on public datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness in prompt-based continual learning. Code is available at https://github.com/longrongyang/RCS-Prompt.

title: Longxiang Tang*, Zhuotao Tian, Kai Li, Chunming He, Hantao Zhou, Hengshuang Zhao, Xiu Li, Jiaya Jia
title_en: Longxiang Tang*, Zhuotao Tian, Kai Li, Chunming He, Hantao Zhou, Hengshuang Zhao, Xiu Li, Jiaya Jia
abstract: 本研究针对领域-类别增量学习问题,这是一个现实但具有挑战性的持续学习场景,其中领域分布和目标类别在任务间发生变化。为处理这些多样任务,引入了预训练的视觉-语言模型(VLMs),因其具有强大的泛化能力。然而,这会引发新问题:当适应新任务时,预训练VLMs中编码的知识可能受到干扰,损害其固有的零样本能力。现有方法通过在额外数据集上对VLMs进行知识蒸馏调整来解决此问题,但需要高昂的计算开销。为高效解决此问题,我们提出分布感知的无干扰知识集成(DIKI)框架,从避免信息干扰的角度保留预训练VLMs的知识。具体而言,我们设计了一种完全残差机制,将新学习的知识注入冻结的主干网络,同时对预训练知识产生最小的负面影响。此外,该残差特性使我们的分布感知集成校准方案能够显式控制来自未见分布测试数据的信息植入过程。实验表明,我们的DIKI仅使用0.86%的训练参数且训练时间显著减少,就超越了当前最先进的方法。代码可在:https://github.com/lloongx/DIKI 获取。
abstract_en: This study addresses the Domain-Class Incremental Learning problem, a realistic but challenging continual learning scenario where both the domain distribution and target classes vary across tasks. To handle these diverse tasks, pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are introduced for their strong generalizability. However, this incurs a new problem: the knowledge encoded in the pre-trained VLMs may be disturbed when adapting to new tasks, compromising their inherent zero-shot ability. Existing methods tackle it by tuning VLMs with knowledge distillation on extra datasets, which demands heavy computation overhead. To address this problem efficiently, we propose the Distribution-aware Interference-free Knowledge Integration (DIKI) framework, retaining pre-trained knowledge of VLMs from a perspective of avoiding information interference. Specifically, we design a fully residual mechanism to infuse newly learned knowledge into a frozen backbone, while introducing minimal adverse impacts on pre-trained knowledge. Besides, this residual property enables our distribution-aware integration calibration scheme, explicitly controlling the information implantation process for test data from unseen distributions. Experiments demonstrate that our DIKI surpasses the current state-of-the-art approach using only 0.86% of the trained parameters and requiring substantially less training time. Code is available at: https://github.com/lloongx/DIKI.

title: Lorenzo Baraldi*, Federico Cocchi, Marcella Cornia, Lorenzo Baraldi, Alessandro Nicolosi, Rita Cucchiara
title_en: Lorenzo Baraldi*, Federico Cocchi, Marcella Cornia, Lorenzo Baraldi, Alessandro Nicolosi, Rita Cucchiara
abstract: 区分真实内容与由先进AI方法生成的内容正变得愈发困难。尽管先前研究主要关注虚假人脸的检测,但生成的自然图像的识别仅在最近才开始受到关注。这促使近期探索利用基础视觉-语言模型(如CLIP)的解决方案。然而,CLIP嵌入空间优化于全局图像-文本对齐,其设计并非针对深度伪造检测,忽略了定制训练和局部图像特征的潜在优势。在本研究中,我们提出了一种专门用于深度伪造检测的新型嵌入空间CoDE(Contrastive Deepfake Embeddings)。CoDE通过对比学习进行训练,并额外强制全局-局部相似性。为支持模型训练,我们构建了一个全面的数据集,重点关注由扩散模型生成的图像,包含使用四种不同生成器生成的920万张图像。实验结果表明,CoDE在新收集的数据集上实现了最先进的准确率,同时展现出对未见过的图像生成器的出色泛化能力。我们的源代码、训练模型和收集数据集已公开在:https://github.com/aimagelab/CoDE。∗ 等贡献。
abstract_en: Discerning between authentic content and that generated by advanced AI methods has become increasingly challenging. While previous research primarily addresses the detection of fake faces, the identification of generated natural images has only recently surfaced. This prompted the recent exploration of solutions that employ foundation vision-and-language models, like CLIP. However, the CLIP embedding space is optimized for global image-to-text alignment and is not inherently designed for deepfake detection, neglecting the potential benefits of tailored training and local image features. In this study, we propose CoDE (Contrastive Deepfake Embeddings), a novel embedding space specifically designed for deepfake detection. CoDE is trained via contrastive learning by additionally enforcing global-local similarities. To sustain the training of our model, we generate a comprehensive dataset that focuses on images generated by diffusion models and encompasses a collection of 9.2 million images produced by using four different generators. Experimental results demonstrate that CoDE achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on the newly collected dataset, while also showing excellent generalization capabilities to unseen image generators. Our source code, trained models, and collected dataset are publicly available at: https://github.com/aimagelab/CoDE. ∗ Equal contribution.

title: Lorenzo Mur-Labadia*, Ruben Martinez-Cantin, Jose J Guerrero, Giovanni Maria Farinella, Antonino Furnari
title_en: Lorenzo Mur-Labadia*, Ruben Martinez-Cantin, Jose J Guerrero, Giovanni Maria Farinella, Antonino Furnari
abstract: 短期物体交互预判(STA)包括从第一视角视频中检测下一个活跃物体的位置、交互的名词和动词类别以及接触时间。这种能力对于可穿戴助手或人机交互理解用户目标至关重要,但目前仍需改进以实现精确可靠的STA预测。本文通过两项贡献提升STA预测性能:1)我们提出STAformer,一种新型基于注意力的架构,集成了帧引导的时间池化、双图像-视频注意力和多尺度特征融合,以支持从图像输入视频对中进行STA预测;2)我们引入两个新模块,通过建模可操作性将STA预测与人类行为关联。首先,我们整合了一个环境可操作性模型,作为可在此物理场景中发生的交互的持久记忆。其次,我们通过观察手部和物体轨迹预测交互热点,提高STA预测在热点区域的置信度。实验结果表明,在Ego4D数据集上STA的整体Top-5 mAP相对提升高达+45%,在新型精选的EPIC-Kitchens STA标签集上提升高达+42%。我们将发布Ego4D和EPIC-Kitchens的代码、标注和预提取的可操作性信息,以鼓励该领域的未来研究。
abstract_en: Short-Term object-interaction Anticipation (STA) consists of detecting the location of the next-active objects, the noun and verb categories of the interaction, and the time to contact from the observation of egocentric video. This ability is fundamental for wearable assistants or human-robot interaction to understand the user’s goals, but there is still room for improvement to perform STA in a precise and reliable way. In this work, we improve the performance of STA predictions with two contributions: 1) We propose STAformer, a novel attention-based architecture integrating frame-guided temporal pooling, dual image-video attention, and multiscale feature fusion to support STA predictions from an image-input video pair; 2) We introduce two novel modules to ground STA predictions on human behavior by modeling affordances. First, we integrate an environment affordance model which acts as a persistent memory of interactions that can take place in a given physical scene. Second, we predict interaction hotspots from the observation of hands and object trajectories, increasing confidence in STA predictions localized around the hotspot. Our results show significant relative Overall Top-5 mAP improvements of up to +45% on Ego4D and +42% on a novel set of curated EPIC-Kitchens STA labels. We will release the code, annotations, and pre-extracted affordances on Ego4D and EPIC-Kitchens to encourage future research in this area.

title: Lorenzo Vaquero*, Yihong Xu, Xavier Alameda-Pineda, Victor M. Brea, Manuel Mucientes
title_en: Lorenzo Vaquero*, Yihong Xu, Xavier Alameda-Pineda, Victor M. Brea, Manuel Mucientes
abstract: 多目标跟踪(MOT)旨在精确估计多个目标随时间的位置和身份。主流方法跟踪-检测(TbD)首先检测目标,然后关联检测结果,形成一种简单而有效的方法。然而,现代检测器可能在某些帧中偶尔漏检某些目标,导致跟踪器过早停止跟踪。为了解决这个问题,我们提出__TITLE_MATH_1__,意思是“搜索”,一个与任何在线TbD系统兼容的通用框架,增强其持续跟踪检测器漏检目标的能力,主要由于遮挡。值得注意的是,这是在不修改过去跟踪结果或访问未来帧的情况下完成的,即完全在线方式。__ABS_MATH_1__基于邻近轨迹、运动和学习到的标记生成建议。利用决策Transformer,整合多模态视觉和时空信息,将其视为多选择问答任务来解决目标建议关联。__TITLE_MATH_2__是独立于底层跟踪器进行训练的,仅在合成数据上进行训练,无需微调。通过__ABS_MATH_2__,我们在五个不同的跟踪器上展示了持续的性能提升,并在三个不同的基准上建立了新的最先进基线。代码可在:https://github.com/lorenzovaquero/BUSCA。
abstract_en: Multi-object tracking (MOT) endeavors to precisely estimate the positions and identities of multiple objects over time. The prevailing approach, tracking-by-detection (TbD), first detects objects and then links detections, resulting in a simple yet effective method. However, contemporary detectors may occasionally miss some objects in certain frames, causing trackers to cease tracking prematurely. To tackle this issue, we propose , meaning ‘to search’, a versatile framework compatible with any online TbD system, enhancing its ability to persistently track those objects missed by the detector, primarily due to occlusions. Remarkably, this is accomplished without modifying past tracking results or accessing future frames, i.e., in a fully online manner. generates proposals based on neighboring tracks, motion, and learned tokens. Utilizing a decision Transformer that integrates multimodal visual and spatiotemporal information, it addresses the object-proposal association as a multi-choice question-answering task. is trained independently of the underlying tracker, solely on synthetic data, without requiring fine-tuning. Through , we showcase consistent performance enhancements across five different trackers and establish a new state-of-the-art baseline across three different benchmarks. Code available at: https://github.com/lorenzovaquero/BUSCA.

title: Luc P.J. Sträter*, Mohammadreza Salehi, Efstratios Gavves, Cees G.M. Snoek, Yuki M. Asano
title_en: Luc P.J. Sträter*, Mohammadreza Salehi, Efstratios Gavves, Cees G.M. Snoek, Yuki M. Asano
abstract: 在异常检测领域,现有方法往往在高层语义或低层工业基准测试中表现优异,但很少能在跨领域任务中取得良好效果。语义异常是指与训练集在语义上不同的新颖事物,例如自动驾驶汽车中未见过的物体。相比之下,工业异常是保持语义含义的细微缺陷,例如飞机部件中的裂纹。本文提出了一种名为GeneralAD的异常检测框架,旨在以最小的每任务调整即可在语义、近分布和工业场景中运行。在我们的方法中,我们利用视觉Transformer的固有设计,其在图像块上进行训练,从而确保最后的隐藏状态保留基于补丁的结构。我们提出了一种新颖的自监督异常生成模块,通过添加噪声和打乱等简单操作对补丁特征进行处理,构建伪异常样本。这些特征被输入到基于注意力的判别器中,该判别器被训练以对图像中的每个补丁进行评分。通过这种方式,我们的方法不仅能够准确识别图像级别的异常,还能生成可解释的异常图。我们在十个数据集上广泛评估了我们的方法,在六个数据集中取得了最先进的结果,在其余数据集中表现与现有方法相当。代码可在https://github.com/LucStrater/GeneralAD获取。
abstract_en: In the domain of anomaly detection, methods often excel in either high-level semantic or low-level industrial benchmarks, rarely achieving cross-domain proficiency. Semantic anomalies are novelties that differ in meaning from the training set, like unseen objects in self-driving cars. In contrast, industrial anomalies are subtle defects that preserve semantic meaning, such as cracks in airplane components. In this paper, we present GeneralAD, an anomaly detection framework designed to operate in semantic, near-distribution, and industrial settings with minimal per-task adjustments. In our approach, we capitalize on the inherent design of Vision Transformers, which are trained on image patches, thereby ensuring that the last hidden states retain a patch-based structure. We propose a novel self-supervised anomaly generation module that employs straightforward operations like noise addition and shuffling to patch features to construct pseudo-abnormal samples. These features are fed to an attention-based discriminator, which is trained to score every patch in the image. With this, our method can both accurately identify anomalies at the image level and also generate interpretable anomaly maps. We extensively evaluated our approach on ten datasets, achieving state-of-the-art results in six and on-par performance in the remaining for both localization and detection tasks. Code available at https://github.com/ LucStrater/GeneralAD.

title: Luca Bartolomei*, Matteo Poggi, Andrea Conti, Stefano Mattoccia*
title_en: Luca Bartolomei*, Matteo Poggi, Andrea Conti, Stefano Mattoccia*
abstract: 事件立体匹配是一种新兴技术,用于从神经形态相机估计深度;然而,事件在无运动或存在大范围无纹理区域时不太可能触发,使得对应问题极具挑战性。为此,我们提出将立体事件相机与固定频率的主动传感器(例如激光雷达)集成,收集稀疏的深度测量值,从而克服上述限制。此类深度提示通过在堆栈或原始输入流中插入虚构事件(即幻觉)来实现,补偿亮度变化缺失的信息。我们的技术具有通用性,可适配任何结构化表示以堆叠事件,并在事件立体应用中优于现有最先进的融合方法。
abstract_en: Event stereo matching is an emerging technique to estimate depth from neuromorphic cameras; however, events are unlikely to trigger in the absence of motion or the presence of large, untextured regions, making the correspondence problem extremely challenging. Purposely, we propose integrating a stereo event camera with a fixed-frequency active sensor – e.g., a LiDAR – collecting sparse depth measurements, overcoming the aforementioned limitations. Such depth hints are used by hallucinating – i.e., inserting fictitious events – the stacks or raw input streams, compensating for the lack of information in the absence of brightness changes. Our techniques are general, can be adapted to any structured representation to stack events and outperform state-of-the-art fusion methods applied to event-based stereo.

title: Luca Di Giammarino*, Boyang Sun, Giorgio Grisetti, Marc Pollefeys, Hermann Blum, Daniel Barath
title_en: Luca Di Giammarino*, Boyang Sun, Giorgio Grisetti, Marc Pollefeys, Hermann Blum, Daniel Barath
abstract: 在多样化环境中实现精确定位是计算机视觉和机器人学中的根本性挑战。该任务涉及确定传感器(通常为相机)在给定空间中的精确位置和方向。传统定位方法通常依赖被动感知,这在特征有限或动态环境中可能表现不佳。为此,本文探讨了主动定位领域,强调视点选择的重要性以提升定位精度。我们的贡献包括采用数据驱动方法与适用于实时操作的简单架构、自监督数据训练方法,以及能够持续将地图集成到针对实际机器人应用的规划框架中。实验结果表明,我们的方法在针对类似问题和合成数据与真实数据上的泛化能力方面均优于现有方法。我们还发布了开源实现以造福社区,网址为www.github.com/rvp-group/learning-where-to-look。
abstract_en: Accurate localization in diverse environments is a fundamental challenge in computer vision and robotics. The task involves determining a sensor’s precise position and orientation, typically a camera, within a given space. Traditional localization methods often rely on passive sensing, which may struggle in scenarios with limited features or dynamic environments. In response, this paper explores the domain of active localization, emphasizing the importance of viewpoint selection to enhance localization accuracy. Our contributions involve using a data-driven approach with a simple architecture designed for real-time operation, a self-supervised data training method, and the capability to consistently integrate our map into a planning framework tailored for real-world robotics applications. Our results demonstrate that our method performs better than the existing one, targeting similar problems and generalizing on synthetic and real data. We also release an open-source implementation to benefit the community at www.github.com/rvp-group/learning-where-to-look.

title: Lucas Goncalves, Prashant Mathur*, Chandrashekhar Lavania, Metehan Cekic, Marcello Federico, Kyu Han
title_en: Lucas Goncalves, Prashant Mathur*, Chandrashekhar Lavania, Metehan Cekic, Marcello Federico, Kyu Han
abstract: 近年来,音频-视觉生成建模领域的进展得益于深度学习技术的进步以及数据丰富的基准测试集的出现。然而,这一领域的增长不仅归因于模型和基准测试集本身,普遍认可的评估指标也在推动该领域的发展中发挥着重要作用。尽管已有许多用于单独评估音频和视觉内容的指标,但缺乏能够对视频“在野外”中音频-视觉同步性提供定量且可解释的度量标准。为解决这一问题,我们首先创建了一个大规模的人工标注数据集(100多个小时),涵盖音频-视觉内容中九种类型的同步错误及其人类感知方式。随后,我们开发了一种名为PEAVS(感知音频-视觉同步性评估)的新颖自动评估指标,该指标采用五级量表来评估音频-视觉同步性质量。通过新生成的数据集验证PEAVS,其与人类标注的皮尔逊相关系数在集级别达到0.79,在片段级别达到0.54。在实验中,我们观察到PEAVS相比基于Fréchet的音频-视觉同步性扩展指标有50%的相对提升,证实了PEAVS在客观建模视频“在野外”中音频-视觉同步性主观感知方面的有效性。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in audio-visual generative modeling have been propelled by progress in deep learning and the availability of data-rich benchmarks. However, the growth is not attributed solely to models and benchmarks. Universally accepted evaluation metrics also play an important role in advancing the field. While there are many metrics available to evaluate audio and visual content separately, there is a lack of metrics that offer a quantitative and interpretable measure of audio-visual synchronization for videos ‘in the wild’. To address this gap, we first created a large scale human annotated dataset (100+ hrs) representing nine types of synchronization errors in audio-visual content and how human perceive them. We then developed a PEAVS (Perceptual Evaluation of Audio-Visual Synchrony) score, a novel automatic metric with a 5-point scale that evaluates the quality of audio-visual synchronization. We validate PEAVS using a newly generated dataset, achieving a Pearson correlation of 0.79 at the set level and 0.54 at the clip level when compared to human labels. In our experiments, we observe a relative gain 50% over a natural extension of Fréchet based metrics for Audio-Visual synchrony, confirming PEAVS’ efficacy in objectively modeling subjective perceptions of audio-visual synchronization for videos ‘in the wild’.

title: Lucas J Koerner*, Shantanu Gupta, Atul N Ingle, Mohit Gupta
title_en: Lucas J Koerner*, Shantanu Gupta, Atul N Ingle, Mohit Gupta
abstract: 单光子相机(SPC)正逐渐成为各种具有挑战性的成像应用中的首选传感器。一类基于单光子雪崩二极管(SPAD)的SPC通过雪崩过程检测单个光子;随后可通过处理原始光子数据,在极低光照、高动态范围和快速运动条件下提取场景信息。然而,SPAD的单光子灵敏度以更高的能耗为代价——每个光子检测消耗的能量比CMOS相机更多。这种雪崩功率显著限制了传感器分辨率,并可能阻碍基于SPAD的SPC的广泛应用。我们提出了一种名为光子抑制的计算成像方法,以解决这一挑战。光子抑制根据下游推理任务目标和资源约束,战略性地在空间和时间上分配检测。我们开发了轻量级、基于传感器的计算抑制策略,利用历史光子数据实时禁用SPAD像素,以选择最具信息量的未来光子。作为案例研究,我们设计了针对图像重建和边缘检测的定制策略,并通过仿真和真实SPC捕获数据验证,实现了超过90%的光子检测减少,同时保持任务性能指标。我们的工作提出了“应检测哪些光子?”这一问题,并为未来节能的单光子成像铺平了道路。实验代码可在https: //wisionlab.com/project/inhibition获取。
abstract_en: Single-photon cameras (SPCs) are emerging as sensors of choice for various challenging imaging applications. One class of SPCs based on the single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) detects individual photons using an avalanche process; the raw photon data can then be processed to extract scene information under extremely low light, high dynamic range, and rapid motion. Yet, single-photon sensitivity in SPADs comes at a cost — each photon detection consumes more energy than that of a CMOS camera. This avalanche power significantly limits sensor resolution and could restrict widespread adoption of SPAD-based SPCs. We propose a computational-imaging approach called photon inhibition to address this challenge. Photon inhibition strategically allocates detections in space and time based on downstream inference task goals and resource constraints. We develop lightweight, on-sensor computational inhibition policies that use past photon data to disable SPAD pixels in real-time, to select the most informative future photons. As case studies, we design policies tailored for image reconstruction and edge detection, and demonstrate, both via simulations and real SPC captured data, considerable reduction in photon detections (over 90% of photons) while maintaining task performance metrics. Our work raises the question of “which photons should be detected?”, and paves the way for future energy-efficient single-photon imaging. Source code for our experiments is available at https: //wisionlab.com/project/inhibition.

title: Lucas Relic*, Roberto Azevedo, Markus Gross, Christopher Schroers*
title_en: Lucas Relic*, Roberto Azevedo, Markus Gross, Christopher Schroers*
abstract: 将扩散模型引入图像压缩领域,有望在极低比特率下生成逼真且细节丰富的重建图像。先前的方法主要关注将扩散模型作为具有抗量化误差能力的表达解码器,用于条件信号。然而,通过这种方式实现竞争性结果需要耗费大量资源的扩散模型训练和由于迭代生成过程导致的长时间推理。在本工作中,我们将量化误差的消除建模为去噪任务,利用扩散模型恢复传输图像潜变量中丢失的信息。我们的方法仅需执行不到完整扩散生成过程的10%,且无需对扩散模型进行架构修改,从而能够直接使用基础模型作为强先验,无需对主干网络进行额外微调。我们提出的编解码器在定量真实度指标上优于先前方法,并验证了我们的重建图像在主观质量上更受终端用户青睐,即使其他方法使用两倍比特率。
abstract_en: Incorporating diffusion models in the image compression domain has the potential to produce realistic and detailed reconstructions, especially at extremely low bitrates. Previous methods focus on using diffusion models as expressive decoders robust to quantization errors in the conditioning signals. However, achieving competitive results in this manner requires costly training of the diffusion model and long inference times due to the iterative generative process. In this work we formulate the removal of quantization error as a denoising task, using diffusion to recover lost information in the transmitted image latent. Our approach allows us to perform less than 10% of the full diffusion generative process and requires no architectural changes to the diffusion model, enabling the use of foundation models as a strong prior without additional fine tuning of the backbone. Our proposed codec outperforms previous methods in quantitative realism metrics, and we verify that our reconstructions are qualitatively preferred by end users, even when other methods use twice the bitrate.

title: Lucas Stoffl, Andy Bonnetto, Stéphane D'Ascoli, Alexander Mathis*
title_en: Lucas Stoffl, Andy Bonnetto, Stéphane D'Ascoli, Alexander Mathis*
abstract: 自然行为具有层次结构。然而,目前针对这一方面的基准测试却十分匮乏。鉴于大规模层次化行为基准测试的稀缺性,我们创建了一个新颖的合成篮球比赛基准测试(Shot7M2)。除了合成数据,我们将BABEL扩展为一个层次化动作分割基准测试(hBABEL)。随后,我们开发了一个掩码自编码器框架(hBehaveMAE),以无监督方式揭示运动捕捉数据的层次化特性。我们发现,hBehaveMAE在Shot7M2和hBABEL上学习到了可解释的潜在表示,其中低层编码器表现出更强的细粒度运动表示能力,而高层编码器则捕捉复杂动作和活动。此外,我们在MABe22基准测试上评估了hBehaveMAE,该基准测试包含短期和长期行为状态的表征学习。hBehaveMAE在无需领域特定特征提取的情况下实现了最先进的性能。这些组件协同作用,有助于揭示自然行为的层次化组织结构。模型和基准测试可在https://github.com/amathislab/BehaveMAE获取。
abstract_en: Natural behavior is hierarchical. Yet, there is a paucity of benchmarks addressing this aspect. Recognizing the scarcity of large-scale hierarchical behavioral benchmarks, we create a novel synthetic basketball playing benchmark (Shot7M2). Beyond synthetic data, we extend BABEL into a hierarchical action segmentation benchmark (hBABEL). Then, we develop a masked autoencoder framework (hBehaveMAE) to elucidate the hierarchical nature of motion capture data in an unsupervised fashion. We find that hBehaveMAE learns interpretable latents on Shot7M2 and hBABEL, where lower encoder levels show a superior ability to represent fine-grained movements, while higher encoder levels capture complex actions and activities. Additionally, we evaluate hBehaveMAE on MABe22, a representation learning benchmark with short and long-term behavioral states. hBehaveMAE achieves state-of-the-art performance without domain-specific feature extraction. Together, these components synergistically contribute towards unveiling the hierarchical organization of natural behavior. Models and benchmarks are available at https://github.com/amathislab/BehaveMAE.

title: Luchuan Song*, Pinxin Liu, Lele Chen, Guojun Yin, Chenliang Xu
title_en: Luchuan Song*, Pinxin Liu, Lele Chen, Guojun Yin, Chenliang Xu
abstract: 近年来,神经体积渲染在面部avatar重建领域取得了显著进展。尽管已有显著进步,但从单目视频中重建复杂且动态的头部运动仍面临捕捉和恢复细粒度细节的挑战。本文提出了一种名为Tri2-plane的新方法,用于单目逼真体积头部avatar重建。与现有依赖单一三平面变形场进行动态面部建模的方法不同,所提出的Tri2-plane利用特征金字塔原理和三个自顶向下的侧向连接三平面来提升细节。它在多个尺度上采样和渲染面部细节,从整个面部过渡到特定局部区域,再进一步细化到更精细的子区域。此外,我们在训练中引入了基于相机的几何感知滑动窗口方法作为增强策略,这不仅提升了在规范空间外的鲁棒性,还特别增强了跨身份生成能力。实验结果表明,Tri2-plane不仅超越了现有方法,还在定量和定性评估中均表现出色。项目网站为:https://songluchuan.github.io/Tri2Plane.github. io/.
abstract_en: Recent years have witnessed considerable achievements in facial avatar reconstruction with neural volume rendering. Despite notable advancements, the reconstruction of complex and dynamic head movements from monocular videos still suffers from capturing and restoring fine-grained details. In this work, we propose a novel approach, named Tri2 -plane, for monocular photo-realistic volumetric head avatar reconstructions. Distinct from the existing works that rely on a single tri-plane deformation field for dynamic facial modeling, the proposed Tri2 -plane leverages the principle of feature pyramids and three top-to-down lateral connections tri-planes for details improvement. It samples and renders facial details at multiple scales, transitioning from the entire face to specific local regions and then to even more refined sub-regions. Moreover, we incorporate a camera-based geometry-aware sliding window method as an augmentation in training, which improves the robustness beyond the canonical space, with a particular improvement in cross-identity generation capabilities. Experimental outcomes indicate that the Tri2 -plane not only surpasses existing methodologies but also achieves superior performance across quantitative and qualitative assessments. The project website is: https://songluchuan.github.io/Tri2Plane.github. io/.

title: 早期烟雾分割(ESS)在准确定位烟雾源方面起着关键作用,有助于快速实施火灾救援和气体泄漏检测。与常规物体不同,常规物体通常为刚性、不透明且边界清晰,而早期烟雾由于存在大面积高透明区域,导致烟雾特征与背景特征高度相似。关键解决方案是获取判别性嵌入空间。一些基于距离的方法通过使用特定损失函数(如基于成对的三元组损失和基于代理的NCA损失)约束特征提取器以实现该目标。本文提出了一种名为判别散度分析(DSA)的新方法。与仅测量欧几里得距离不同,DSA从样本散度角度评估嵌入空间的紧致性和分离性。DSA分别在像素-代理散度(IOS)和代理-代理散度(OOS)上进行,并设计统一的损失函数以优化特征提取器。DSA可轻松集成到常规分割方法中,仅在训练阶段应用,推理阶段不会产生额外计算成本。大量实验表明,DSA能够持续提升各类模型在早期烟雾分割中的性能。
title_en: Lujian Yao*, Haitao Zhao*, Jingchao Peng, Zhongze Wang, Kaijie Zhao
abstract_en: Early smoke segmentation (ESS) plays a crucial role in accurately locating the source of smoke, facilitating prompt fire rescue operations and gas leak detection. Unlike regular objects, which are typically rigid, opaque, and have clear boundaries, ESS presents challenges due to the large areas of high transparency in early smoke. This leads to a significant similarity between smoke features and the surrounding background features. The key solution is to obtain a discriminative embedding space. Some distance-based methods have pursued this goal by using specific loss functions (e.g., pair-based Triplet loss and proxy-based NCA loss) to constrain the feature extractor. In this paper, we propose a novel approach called discriminative scatter analysis (DSA). Instead of solely measuring Euclidean distance, DSA assesses the compactness and separation of the embedding space from a sample scatter perspective. DSA is performed on both pixel-proxy scatter (IOS) and proxy-proxy scatter (OOS), and a unified loss function is designed to optimize the feature extractor. DSA can be easily integrated with regular segmentation methods. It is applied only during training and without incurring any additional computational cost during inference. Extensive experiments have demonstrated that DSA can consistently improve the performance of various models in ESS.

title: Lujun Li, Haosen Sun, Shiwen Li, Peijie Dong, Wenhan Luo, Wei Xue, Qifeng Liu*, Yike Guo*
title_en: Lujun Li, Haosen Sun, Shiwen Li, Peijie Dong, Wenhan Luo, Wei Xue, Qifeng Liu*, Yike Guo*
abstract: 本文介绍了Auto-GAS,这是首个基于自发现代理的无需训练的生成架构搜索(GAS)框架。生成对抗网络(GANs)等生成模型如今广泛应用于许多实时应用中。先前的GAS方法使用可微或进化搜索来寻找最优的GAN生成器以实现快速推理和内存效率。然而,这些基于训练的GAS技术的高计算开销限制了其应用。为提高搜索效率,我们探索无需训练的GAS,但发现现有的针对分类任务设计的零成本代理在生成基准测试中表现不佳。为解决这一挑战,我们开发了一个专为GAS任务定制的代理搜索框架以增强预测能力。具体而言,我们构建了一个信息感知代理,其输入为特征统计信息,并利用先进的变换、编码、降维和增强操作来表示候选代理。随后,我们采用进化算法在种群中基于相关性评估对优质候选进行交叉和变异操作。最后,我们使用优化后的代理在无需训练的情况下执行生成器搜索。因此,Auto-GAS实现了GAS的自动化代理发现,同时显著加速了训练前的搜索过程。在图像生成和图像到图像翻译任务上的大量实验表明,Auto-GAS在准确率与速度的权衡上优于现有方法。值得注意的是,Auto-GAS在搜索速度比GAN压缩快110倍的情况下取得了具有竞争力的性能。代码地址:https://github.com/lliai/Auto-GAS
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce Auto-GAS, the first training-free Generative Architecture Search (GAS) framework enabled by an auto-discovered proxy. Generative models like Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) are now widely used in many real-time applications. Previous GAS methods use differentiable or evolutionary search to find optimal GAN generators for fast inference and memory efficiency. However, the high computational overhead of these training-based GAS techniques limits their adoption. To improve search efficiency, we explore training-free GAS but find existing zero-cost proxies designed for classification tasks underperform on generation benchmarks. To address this challenge, we develop a custom proxy search framework tailored for GAS tasks to enhance predictive power. Specifically, we construct an information-aware proxy that takes feature statistics as inputs and utilizes advanced transform, encoding, reduction, and augment operations to represent candidate proxies. Then, we employ an evolutionary algorithm to perform crossover and mutation on superior candidates within the population based on correlation evaluation. Finally, we perform generator search without training using the optimized proxy. Thus, Auto-GAS enables automated proxy discovery for GAS while significantly accelerating the search before training stage. Extensive experiments on image generation and image-to-image translation tasks demonstrate that Auto-GAS strikes superior accuracy-speed tradeoffs over state-of-the-art methods. Remarkably, Auto-GAS achieves competitive scores with 110× faster search than GAN Compression. Code at: https://github.com/lliai/Auto-GAS.

title: Lujun Li, Zimian Wei*, Peijie Dong, Wenhan Luo, Wei Xue, Qifeng Liu*, Yike Guo*
title_en: Lujun Li, Zimian Wei*, Peijie Dong, Wenhan Luo, Wei Xue, Qifeng Liu*, Yike Guo*
abstract: 本文提出AttnZero,这是首个用于自动发现高效注意力模块的框架,专门针对视觉Transformer(ViTs)。尽管传统ViTs中的自注意力计算复杂度为二次,但线性注意力提供了具有线性复杂度近似的更高效替代方案。然而,现有手工设计的线性注意力存在性能退化问题。为解决这些问题,AttnZero构建了搜索空间,并采用进化算法发现潜在的线性注意力公式。具体而言,搜索空间包含六种计算图及高级激活、归一化和二进制操作符。为增强通用性,我们通过将候选注意力应用于多种高级ViTs所得结果作为多目标进化搜索的依据。为加速搜索过程,我们利用程序检查与拒绝协议快速过滤不具前景的候选方案。此外,我们开发了Attn-Bench-101,该工具提供了搜索空间中2000种注意力的预计算性能,使我们能够总结注意力设计的见解。实验结果表明,发现的AttnZero模块在不同任务中具有良好的泛化能力,并在多种ViTs中持续提升性能。例如,使用AttnZero训练的DeiT—PVT—Swin—CSwin的tiny模型在ImageNet上分别达到74.9%—78.1%—82.1%—82.9%的top-1准确率。代码地址:https://github.com/lliai/AttnZero.
abstract_en: In this paper, we present AttnZero, the first framework for automatically discovering efficient attention modules tailored for Vision Transformers (ViTs). While traditional self-attention in ViTs suffers from quadratic computation complexity, linear attention offers a more efficient alternative with linear complexity approximation. However, existing hand-crafted linear attention suffers from performance degradation. To address these issues, our AttnZero constructs search spaces and employs evolutionary algorithms to discover potential linear attention formulations. Specifically, our search space consists of six kinds of computation graphs and advanced activation, normalize, and binary operators. To enhance generality, we derive results of candidate attention applied to multiple advanced ViTs as the multi-objective for the evolutionary search. To expedite the search process, we utilize program checking and rejection protocols to filter out unpromising candidates swiftly. Additionally, we develop Attn-Bench-101, which provides precomputed performance of 2,000 attentions in the search spaces, enabling us to summarize attention design insights. Experimental results demonstrate that the discovered AttnZero module generalizes well to different tasks and consistently achieves improved performance across various ViTs. For instance, the tiny model of DeiT—PVT—Swin—CSwin trained with AttnZero on ImageNet reaches 74.9%—78.1%—82.1%—82.9% top-1 accuracy. Codes at: https://github.com/lliai/AttnZero.

title: Lukas Bösiger*, Mihai Dusmanu, Marc Pollefeys, Zuria Bauer
title_en: Lukas Bösiger*, Mihai Dusmanu, Marc Pollefeys, Zuria Bauer
abstract: 从三维重建生成逼真图像对于许多计算机视觉和机器人学流程至关重要,尤其是在混合现实应用以及在模拟环境中训练自主代理方面。然而,新视角的质量严重依赖于源重建,而由于几何和外观的噪声或缺失,源重建通常不完美。受基于参考的超分辨率网络近期成功启发,我们提出MaRINeR,一种利用邻近映射图像信息优化目标视角渲染的方法。我们首先基于深度特征在目标视角的场景几何原始渲染图像与邻近参考图像之间建立匹配,随后进行层次细节传输。我们在显式和隐式场景表示的定量指标和定性示例中展示了改进的渲染效果。我们进一步将该方法应用于伪真实值验证、合成数据增强以及降低三维重建渲染的细节恢复等下游任务。
abstract_en: Rendering realistic images from 3D reconstruction is an essential task of many Computer Vision and Robotics pipelines, notably for mixed-reality applications as well as training autonomous agents in simulated environments. However, the quality of novel views heavily depends of the source reconstruction which is often imperfect due to noisy or missing geometry and appearance. Inspired by the recent success of reference-based super-resolution networks, we propose MaRINeR, a refinement method that leverages information of a nearby mapping image to improve the rendering of a target viewpoint. We first establish matches between the raw rendered image of the scene geometry from the target viewpoint and the nearby reference based on deep features, followed by hierarchical detail transfer. We show improved renderings in quantitative metrics and qualitative examples from both explicit and implicit scene representations. We further employ our method on the downstream tasks of pseudo-ground-truth validation, synthetic data enhancement and detail recovery for renderings of reduced 3D reconstructions.

title: Lukas Hoyer*, David Joseph Tan, Muhammad Ferjad Naeem, Luc Van Gool, Federico Tombari
title_en: Lukas Hoyer*, David Joseph Tan, Muhammad Ferjad Naeem, Luc Van Gool, Federico Tombari
abstract: 在半监督语义分割中,模型通过有限数量的标注图像和大量未标注图像进行训练,以减少高昂的标注成本。尽管先前方法能够学习到良好的分割边界,但由于监督信息有限,容易混淆视觉相似的类别。另一方面,视觉-语言模型(VLMs)能够从图像-描述数据集中学习多样化的语义知识,但因图像级训练会产生噪声分割。在SemiVL中,我们首次提出将VLM预训练获得的丰富先验知识集成到半监督语义分割中,以学习更优的语义决策边界。为适应从全局推理到局部推理的转变,我们引入了一种空间微调策略以实现标签高效的训练。进一步地,我们设计了语言引导的解码器,联合推理视觉与语言信息。最后,我们提出通过类定义的语言引导方式,处理类别标签中的固有歧义。我们在4个语义分割数据集上评估SemiVL,结果显著优于先前半监督方法。例如,在仅使用232张标注图像时,SemiVL在COCO数据集上将mIoU提升13.5;在仅使用92张标注图像时,将mIoU提升6.1。项目页面:github.com/google-research/semivl
abstract_en: In semi-supervised semantic segmentation, a model is trained with a limited number of labeled images along with a large corpus of unlabeled images to reduce the high annotation effort. While previous methods are able to learn good segmentation boundaries, they are prone to confuse classes with similar visual appearance due to the limited supervision. On the other hand, vision-language models (VLMs) are able to learn diverse semantic knowledge from image-caption datasets but produce noisy segmentation due to the image-level training. In SemiVL, we newly propose to integrate rich priors from VLM pre-training into semi-supervised semantic segmentation to learn better semantic decision boundaries. To adapt the VLM from global to local reasoning, we introduce a spatial fine-tuning strategy for label-efficient learning. Further, we design a language-guided decoder to jointly reason over vision and language. Finally, we propose to handle inherent ambiguities in class labels by instructing the model with language guidance in the form of class definitions. We evaluate SemiVL on 4 semantic segmentation datasets, where it significantly outperforms previous semi-supervised methods. For instance, SemiVL improves the state of the art by +13.5 mIoU on COCO with 232 annotated images and by +6.1 mIoU on Pascal VOC with 92 annotated images. Project page: github.com/google-research/semivl

title: Luozhou Wang*, Guibao Shen, Wenhang Ge, Guangyong Chen, Yijun Li, Yingcong Chen*
title_en: Luozhou Wang*, Guibao Shen, Wenhang Ge, Guangyong Chen, Yijun Li, Yingcong Chen*
abstract: 文本到图像扩散模型通过支持文本之外的各种附加条件(例如深度图、边界框)实现了更可控的生成。然而,这些模型的训练基于文本与附加条件完美对齐的前提。如果这种对齐不满足,最终输出可能被单一条件主导,或产生歧义,无法满足用户期望。为解决此问题,我们提出了一种无需训练的方法——文本锚定分数组合(Text-Anchored Score Composition, TASC),以进一步提升现有模型在部分对齐条件下的可控性。TASC首先根据配对关系分离条件,对每对条件单独计算结果,确保每对条件不再存在冲突。随后,我们提出一种注意力重新对齐操作,通过交叉注意力机制重新对齐这些独立计算的结果,避免在组合回原结果时产生新冲突。定性和定量结果均表明,我们的方法在处理未对齐条件方面有效,其性能优于近期方法,并且更重要的是为可控图像生成过程增加了灵活性。
abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models have advanced towards more controllable generation via supporting various additional conditions (e.g., depth map, bounding box) beyond text. However, these models are learned based on the premise of perfect alignment between the text and extra conditions. If this alignment is not satisfied, the final output could be either dominated by one condition, or ambiguity may arise, failing to meet user expectations. To address this issue, we present a training-free approach called Text-Anchored Score Composition (TASC) to further improve the controllability of existing models when provided with partially aligned conditions. The TASC firstly separates conditions based on pair relationships, computing the result individually for each pair. This ensures that each pair no longer has conflicting conditions. Then we propose an attention realignment operation to realign these independently calculated results via a cross-attention mechanism to avoid new conflicts when combining them back. Both qualitative and quantitative results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in handling unaligned conditions, which performs favorably against recent methods and more importantly adds flexibility to the controllable image generation process.

title: MN Zhao, Lihe Zhang*, Yuqiu Kong, Baocai Yin
title_en: MN Zhao, Lihe Zhang*, Yuqiu Kong, Baocai Yin
abstract: 快速对抗训练(Fast Adversarial Training, FAT)因其在提升对抗鲁棒性方面的有效性而受到研究社区的广泛关注。尤其值得注意的是,该领域面临灾难性过拟合(Catastrophic Overfitting, CO)的挑战。尽管现有FAT方法在缓解CO方面取得了一定进展,但对抗鲁棒性的提升往往伴随着干净样本分类准确率的显著下降。为解决这一问题,我们首先利用干净样本与对抗样本之间的特征激活差异,分析CO的根本成因。有趣的是,我们的研究发现,CO可归因于少数特定路径引发的特征覆盖。通过在这些路径中精心设计的正则化项有意操控特征激活差异,可以有效缓解甚至诱导CO,进一步验证了这一观察结果。值得注意的是,采用这些正则化项训练的模型在性能上优于以往的FAT工作。在此基础上,我们利用CO实现“攻击混淆”,旨在提升模型性能。因此,当在评估阶段向输入添加随机噪声时,受CO影响的模型可在干净数据和对抗数据上均达到最优分类准确率。我们还验证了其对迁移对抗样本的鲁棒性,以及诱导CO对提升鲁棒性的必要性。因此,CO可能并非必须解决的问题。
abstract_en: Fast Adversarial Training (FAT) has gained increasing attention within the research community owing to its efficacy in improving adversarial robustness. Particularly noteworthy is the challenge posed by catastrophic overfitting (CO) in this field. Although existing FAT approaches have made strides in mitigating CO, the ascent of adversarial robustness occurs with a non-negligible decline in classification accuracy on clean samples. To tackle this issue, we initially employ the feature activation differences between clean and adversarial examples to analyze the underlying causes of CO.
