abstract: 神经场因其能够理解三维视觉世界(如推断语义、几何和动态)而在计算机视觉和机器人领域表现出色。鉴于神经场从二维图像中密集表示三维场景的能力,我们提出问题:能否通过掩码自编码器进行自监督预训练,以生成有效的三维表示?得益于将Transformer扩展到新数据模态的惊人成功,我们采用标准的3D视觉Transformer来适应NeRFs的独特公式。我们利用NeRF的体素网格作为Transformer的密集输入,与点云等其他三维表示(信息密度不均且表示不规则)形成对比。由于将掩码自编码器应用于隐式表示(如NeRF)存在困难,我们选择通过相机轨迹进行采样,提取跨域标准化的显式表示。我们的目标通过从NeRF的辐射度和密度网格中遮蔽随机块,并使用标准的3D Swin Transformer重建遮蔽块来实现。通过这种方式,模型可以学习完整场景的语义和空间结构。我们在提出的精选姿态RGB数据集上大规模预训练该表示,总计超过180万张图像。预训练完成后,编码器可用于有效的三维迁移学习。我们的NeRF-MAE自监督预训练方法在各种具有挑战性的三维任务中表现出显著的可扩展性和性能提升。利用未标记的姿态2D数据进行预训练,NeRF-MAE在Front3D和ScanNet数据集上显著优于自监督三维预训练和NeRF场景理解基线,三维目标检测的AP50和AP25绝对性能提升分别超过20%和8%。项目页面:magentanerf-mae.github.io
abstract_en: Neural fields excel in computer vision and robotics due to their ability to understand the 3D visual world such as inferring semantics, geometry, and dynamics. Given the capabilities of neural fields in densely representing a 3D scene from 2D images, we ask the question: Can we scale their self-supervised pretraining, specifically using masked autoencoders, to generate effective 3D representations from posed RGB images. Owing to the astounding success of extending transformers to novel data modalities, we employ standard 3D Vision Transformers to suit the unique formulation of NeRFs. We leverage NeRF’s volumetric grid as a dense input to the transformer, contrasting it with other 3D representations such as pointclouds where the information density can be uneven, and the representation is irregular. Due to the difficulty of applying masked autoencoders to an implicit representation, such as NeRF, we opt for extracting an explicit representation that canonicalizes scenes across domains by employing the camera trajectory for sampling. Our goal is made possible by masking random patches from NeRF’s radiance and density grid and employing a standard 3D Swin Transformer to reconstruct the masked patches. In doing so, the model can learn the semantic and spatial structure of complete scenes. We pretrain this representation at scale on our proposed curated posed-RGB data, totaling over 1.8 million images. Once pretrained, the encoder is used for effective 3D transfer learning. Our novel self-supervised pretraining for NeRFs, NeRF-MAE, scales remarkably well and improves performance on various challenging 3D tasks. Utilizing unlabeled posed 2D data for pretraining, NeRF-MAE significantly outperforms self-supervised 3D pretraining and NeRF scene understanding baselines on Front3D and ScanNet datasets with an absolute performance improvement of over 20% AP50 and 8% AP25 for 3D object detection. Project Page: magentanerf-mae.github.io

title: Mujtaba Hussain Mirza*, Maria Rosaria Briglia*, Senad Beadini*, Iacopo Masi*
title_en: Mujtaba Hussain Mirza*, Maria Rosaria Briglia*, Senad Beadini*, Iacopo Masi*
abstract: 通过将鲁棒判别分类器重新诠释为能量模型(Energy-based Model, EBM),我们为对抗训练(Adversarial Training, AT)的动力学提供了新的视角。我们的分析揭示了在对抗训练过程中能量景观的特性:无目标攻击生成的对抗样本在模型视角下比原始数据更符合分布(能量更低),而目标攻击则表现出相反现象。基于深入分析,我们提出了新的理论与实践结果,表明诠释对抗训练的能量动力学能够提升理解:(1) 对抗训练动态由三个阶段主导,第三阶段出现鲁棒过拟合,自然能量与对抗能量之间存在显著差异;(2) 通过将TRADES损失函数重新表述为能量形式,我们证明TRADES通过对齐自然能量与对抗能量隐式缓解过拟合;(3) 我们实证表明所有近期最先进的鲁棒分类器均在平滑能量景观,并在能量模型框架下统一了对抗训练理解与损失函数加权研究。基于严谨证据,我们提出加权能量对抗训练(Weighted Energy Adversarial Training, WEAT),这是一种新型样本加权方案,在CIFAR-10、SVHN等基准测试中达到与最先进方法相当的鲁棒准确率,并在CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet中表现更优。进一步证明鲁棒分类器在生成能力的强度与质量上存在差异,我们提供了一种简单方法通过鲁棒分类器提升该能力,在无需生成建模训练的情况下实现显著的Inception Score(IS)和FID。代码已开源至github.com/OmnAI-Lab/Robust-Classifiers-under-the-lens-of-EBM。
abstract_en: By reinterpreting a robust discriminative classifier as Energy-based Model (EBM), we offer a new take on the dynamics of adversarial training (AT). Our analysis of the energy landscape during AT reveals that untargeted attacks generate adversarial images much more in-distribution (lower energy) than the original data from the point of view of the model. Conversely, we observe the opposite for targeted attacks. On the ground of our thorough analysis, we present new theoretical and practical results that show how interpreting AT energy dynamics unlocks a better understanding: (1) AT dynamic is governed by three phases and robust overfitting occurs in the third phase with a drastic divergence between natural and adversarial energies (2) by rewriting TRADES loss in terms of energies, we show that TRADES implicitly alleviates overfitting by means of aligning the natural energy with the adversarial one (3) we empirically show that all recent state-of-the-art robust classifiers are smoothing the energy landscape and we reconcile a variety of studies about understanding AT and weighting the loss function under the umbrella of EBMs. Motivated by rigorous evidence, we propose Weighted Energy Adversarial Training (WEAT), a novel sample weighting scheme that yields robust accuracy matching the state-of-the-art on multiple benchmarks such as CIFAR-10 and SVHN and going beyond in CIFAR-100 and Tiny-ImageNet. We further show that robust classifiers vary in the intensity and quality of their generative capabilities, and offer a simple method to push this capability, reaching a remarkable Inception Score (IS) and FID using a robust classifier without training for generative modeling. The code to reproduce our results is available at github.com/OmnAI-Lab/Robust-Classifiers-under-the-lens-of-EBM.

title: Muyang Qiu, Jian Zhang, Lei Qi, Qian Yu, Yinghuan Shi*, Yang Gao
title_en: Muyang Qiu, Jian Zhang, Lei Qi, Qian Yu, Yinghuan Shi*, Yang Gao
abstract: 尽管在医学图像分割领域泛化方面取得了近期进展,但对所有源域进行体素级标注仍是一项巨大负担。最近提出的半监督领域泛化方法通过利用有限的标注数据和多个医疗机构收集的大量未标注数据,旨在应对这一挑战,其核心在于精准利用未标注数据的同时提升泛化能力。在本工作中,我们观察到医疗机构间的领域偏移会导致特征统计量差异显著,这种意外的归一化过程会严重降低伪标签质量。然而,这一现象可被用于促进未见领域泛化。因此,我们提出:1)多统计量-独立分支以缓解领域偏移对可靠伪标签的影响;2)统计量聚合分支用于学习领域不变特征。此外,为模拟具有统计量差异的未见领域,我们从两个方面入手:在图像层面采用直方图匹配的扰动策略,在特征层面采用随机批量归一化选择策略,生成多样化的统计量以扩展训练分布。在三个医学图像数据集上的评估结果验证了我们方法的有效性,优于近期SOTA方法。代码已开源至https: //github.com/qiumuyang/SIAB。
abstract_en: Despite the recent success of domain generalization in medical image segmentation, voxel-wise annotation for all source domains remains a huge burden. Semi-supervised domain generalization has been proposed very recently to combat this challenge by leveraging limited labeled data along with abundant unlabeled data collected from multiple medical institutions, depending on precisely harnessing unlabeled data while improving generalization simultaneously. In this work, we observe that domain shifts between medical institutions cause disparate feature statistics, which significantly deteriorates pseudo-label quality due to an unexpected normalization process. Nevertheless, this phenomenon could be exploited to facilitate unseen domain generalization. Therefore, we propose 1) multiple statistics-individual branches to mitigate the impact of domain shifts for reliable pseudo-labels and 2) one statistics-aggregated branch for domain-invariant feature learning. Furthermore, to simulate unseen domains with statistics difference, we approach this from two aspects, , a perturbation with histogram matching at image level and a random batch normalization selection strategy at feature level, producing diverse statistics to expand the training distribution. Evaluation results on three medical image datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method compared with recent SOTA methods. The code is available at https: //github.com/qiumuyang/SIAB.

title: Muyao Niu, Tong Chen, Yifan Zhan, Zhuoxiao Li, Xiang Ji, Yinqiang Zheng*
title_en: Muyao Niu, Tong Chen, Yifan Zhan, Zhuoxiao Li, Xiang Ji, Yinqiang Zheng*
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRFs)因其在新视角合成方面的出色能力而日益流行。然而,其有效性受到大多数相机系统中常见的滚动快门(RS)效应的阻碍。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了RS-NeRF方法,该方法旨在通过具有RS失真输入的新型视角合成正常图像。这涉及一个物理模型,该模型复制了在RS条件下的成像过程,并对每个图像行的NeRF参数和相机外参进行联合优化。我们进一步通过深入研究RS特性并开发算法来增强其功能,解决了基础RS-NeRF模型的固有缺陷。首先,我们施加平滑性正则化以更好地估计轨迹并提高合成质量,符合相机运动先验。我们还识别并解决了基础RS模型中的根本性缺陷,引入了多采样算法。这种新方法通过全面利用每个中间相机姿态下不同行的RGB数据,提高了模型性能。通过严格的实验,我们证明RS-NeRF在合成和现实场景中均优于先前方法,证明其有效纠正RS相关失真的能力。代码和数据可用:https://github.com/MyNiuuu/RS-NeRF
abstract_en: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) have become increasingly popular because of their impressive ability for novel view synthesis. However, their effectiveness is hindered by the Rolling Shutter (RS) effects commonly found in most camera systems. To solve this, we present RS-NeRF, a method designed to synthesize normal images from novel views using input with RS distortions. This involves a physical model that replicates the image formation process under RS conditions and jointly optimizes NeRF parameters and camera extrinsic for each image row. We further address the inherent shortcomings of the basic RS-NeRF model by delving into the RS characteristics and developing algorithms to enhance its functionality. First, we impose a smoothness regularization to better estimate trajectories and improve the synthesis quality, in line with the camera movement prior. We also identify and address a fundamental flaw in the vanilla RS model by introducing a multi-sampling algorithm. This new approach improves the model’s performance by comprehensively exploiting the RGB data across different rows for each intermediate camera pose. Through rigorous experimentation, we demonstrate that RS-NeRF surpasses previous methods in both synthetic and real-world scenarios, proving its ability to correct RS-related distortions effectively. Codes and data available: https://github. com/MyNiuuu/RS-NeRF

title: Muyao Niu, Xiaodong Cun*, Xintao Wang, Yong Zhang, Ying Shan, Yinqiang Zheng*
title_en: Muyao Niu, Xiaodong Cun*, Xintao Wang, Yong Zhang, Ying Shan, Yinqiang Zheng*
abstract: 我们提出MOFA-Video,一种先进的可控图像动画方法,能够通过多种附加可控信号(如人体关键点参考、手动轨迹和另一段提供的视频)或其组合,从给定图像生成视频。这与仅能在特定运动域工作或依赖扩散先验显示弱控制能力的先前方法不同。为实现目标,我们设计了多个领域感知的运动场适配器(MOFA-Adapters),用于控制视频生成流程中的生成运动。对于MOFA-Adapters,我们考虑视频的时间运动一致性,首先从给定的稀疏控制条件生成密集运动流,然后将给定图像的多尺度特征封装为引导特征,以实现稳定的视频扩散生成。由于手动轨迹和人体关键点均包含稀疏控制信息,我们分别简单地训练了两个运动适配器。训练后,不同领域的MOFA-Adapters可协同工作,实现更可控的视频生成。代码已开源:https: //github.com/MyNiuuu/MOFA-Video
abstract_en: We present MOFA-Video, an advanced controllable image animation method that generates video from the given image using various additional controllable signals (such as human landmarks reference, manual trajectories, and another even provided video) or their combinations. This is different from previous methods which only can work on a specific motion domain or show weak control abilities with diffusion prior. To achieve our goal, we design several domain-aware motion field adapters (, MOFA-Adapters) to control the generated motions in the video generation pipeline. For MOFA-Adapters, we consider the temporal motion consistency of the video and generate the dense motion flow from the given sparse control conditions first, and then, the multi-scale features of the given image are wrapped as a guided feature for stable video diffusion generation. We naively train two motion adapters for the manual trajectories and the human landmarks individually since they both contain sparse information about the control. After training, the MOFA-Adapters in different domains can also work together for more controllable video generation. Codes available: https: //github.com/MyNiuuu/MOFA-Video

title: 尹乃玉*, 王涵静, 于越, 高天, 阿米特·杜兰达尔, 纪强
title_en: Naiyu Yin*, Hanjing Wang, Yue Yu, Tian Gao, Amit Dhurandhar, Qiang Ji
abstract: 在计算机视觉和机器学习领域,识别高维数据的低维、语义潜在因果表示已成为一个活跃的研究领域。因果领域泛化方法旨在识别生成输入数据的潜在因果变量,并构建不变因果机制以提升分布外(OOD)预测性能。然而,关于选择用于预测的因果变量的最佳方法尚无共识。现有方法通常选择因果或反因果变量,排除其他不变且具有判别性的特征。本文提出使用马尔可夫毯特征,因其具有与目标变量最大互信息的最小集合特性。为此,我们构建了因果马尔可夫毯表示学习(CMBRL)框架,允许在潜在空间中发现马尔可夫毯。随后,我们利用识别出的马尔可夫毯特征构建不变预测机制,使其适用于跨领域的预测。与最先进的领域泛化方法相比,我们的方法在分布偏移下展现出更强的鲁棒性和适应性。
abstract_en: Identifying low-dimensional, semantic latent causal representations for high-dimensional data has become a dynamic field in computer vision and machine learning. Causal domain generalization methods aim to identify latent causal variables that generate input data and build invariant causal mechanisms for prediction tasks, thereby improving out-of-distribution (OOD) prediction performance. However, there is no consensus on the best approach for selecting causal variables for prediction. Existing methods typically choose causal or anti-causal variables, excluding other invariant, discriminative features. In this paper, we propose using Markov Blanket features due to their property of being the minimal set that possesses the maximum mutual information with the target. To achieve this, we establish a Causal Markov Blanket Representation Learning (CMBRL) framework, which allows for Markov Blanket discovery in the latent space. We then construct an invariant prediction mechanism using the identified Markov Blanket features, making it suitable for predictions across domains. Compared to state-of-the-art domain generalization methods, our approach exhibits robustness and adaptability under distribution shifts.

title: Nanye Ma*, Mark Goldstein, Michael Albergo, Nicholas M Boffi, Eric Vanden-Eijnden*, Saining Xie*
title_en: Nanye Ma*, Mark Goldstein, Michael Albergo, Nicholas M Boffi, Eric Vanden-Eijnden*, Saining Xie*
abstract: 我们提出了可扩展插值变换器(Scalable Interpolant Transformers, SiT),这是一种基于扩散变换器(Diffusion Transformers, DiT)架构的生成模型家族。插值框架能够以比标准扩散模型更灵活的方式连接两个分布,使得可以模块化地研究影响基于动态传输的生成模型的各种设计选择:离散或连续时间学习、目标函数、连接分布的插值器以及确定性或随机采样。通过精心引入上述要素,SiT在相同的模型结构、参数数量和GFLOPs下,超越了DiT在条件ImageNet 256×256和512×512基准测试中的表现。通过探索可独立于学习过程进行调优的各类扩散系数,SiT分别实现了FID-50K分数2.06和2.62。代码可在此获取:https://github.com/willisma/SiT
abstract_en: We present Scalable Interpolant Transformers (SiT), a family of generative models built on the backbone of Diffusion Transformers (DiT). The interpolant framework, which allows for connecting two distributions in a more flexible way than standard diffusion models, makes possible a modular study of various design choices impacting generative models built on dynamical transport: learning in discrete or continuous time, the objective function, the interpolant that connects the distributions, and deterministic or stochastic sampling. By carefully introducing the above ingredients, SiT surpasses DiT uniformly across model sizes on the conditional ImageNet 256 × 256 and 512 × 512 benchmark using the exact same model structure, number of parameters, and GFLOPs. By exploring various diffusion coefficients, which can be tuned separately from learning, SiT achieves an FID-50K score of 2.06 and 2.62, respectively. Code is available here: https://github.com/willisma/SiT

title: Naoya Sogi*, Takashi Shibata*, Makoto Terao*
title_en: Naoya Sogi*, Takashi Shibata*, Makoto Terao*
abstract: 预训练的视觉与语言(V&L)模型显著提升了跨模态图像-文本检索的性能。然而,一般情况下,由于图像中词语与小物体之间的粗略对齐,V&L模型在小物体的检索性能有限。相反,已知人类认知以物体为中心,即使物体较小,我们也会更加关注重要的物体。为了弥合人类认知与V&L模型能力之间的差距,我们提出了一种基于“对象感知查询扰动”的跨模态图像-文本检索框架。所提出的方法生成检测到物体的关键特征子空间,并利用该子空间扰动相应的查询,以提高图像中的物体感知能力。在所提出的方法中,可以在不进行额外微调的情况下,保持现有V&L模型丰富的表达能力和检索性能,实现对象感知的跨模态图像-文本检索。在四个公开数据集上的综合实验表明,我们的方法优于传统算法。
abstract_en: The pre-trained vision and language (V&L) models have substantially improved the performance of cross-modal image-text retrieval. In general, however, V&L models have limited retrieval performance for small objects because of the rough alignment between words and the small objects in the image. In contrast, it is known that human cognition is object-centric, and we pay more attention to important objects, even if they are small. To bridge this gap between the human cognition and the V&L model’s capability, we propose a cross-modal image-text retrieval framework based on “object-aware query perturbation.” The proposed method generates a key feature subspace of the detected objects and perturbs the corresponding queries using this subspace to improve the object awareness in the image. In our proposed method, object-aware cross-modal image-text retrieval is possible while keeping the rich expressive power and retrieval performance of existing V&L models without additional fine-tuning. Comprehensive experiments on four public datasets show that our method outperforms conventional algorithms.

title: Narek Tumanyan*, Assaf Singer, Shai Bagon, Tali Dekel
title_en: Narek Tumanyan*, Assaf Singer, Shai Bagon, Tali Dekel
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的视频长期密集跟踪框架。我们的方法核心是结合单视频测试时训练与预训练DINO-ViT模型学习到的强大局部语义特征。具体而言,我们的框架同时采用DINO的特征以适应测试视频的运动观测,同时训练一个直接利用优化特征的跟踪器。整个框架通过结合自监督损失和正则化方法进行端到端训练,使我们能够保留并受益于DINO的语义先验。大量评估表明,我们的方法在已知基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。DINO-tracker显著优于自监督方法,并在长期遮挡等具有挑战性的跟踪场景中超越了最先进的监督跟踪器,同时与之具有竞争力。
abstract_en: We present – a new framework for long-term dense tracking in video. The pillar of our approach is combining test-time training on a single video, with the powerful localized semantic features learned by a pre-trained DINO-ViT model. Specifically, our framework simultaneously adopts DINO’s features to fit to the motion observations of the test video, while training a tracker that directly leverages the refined features. The entire framework is trained end-to-end using a combination of self-supervised losses, and regularization that allows us to retain and benefit from DINO’s semantic prior. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that our method achieves state-of-the-art results on known benchmarks. DINO-tracker significantly outperforms self-supervised methods and is competitive with state-of-the-art supervised trackers, while outperforming them in challenging cases of tracking under long-term occlusions.

title: Nazmul Karim*, Abdullah Al Arafat, Umar Khalid, Zhishan Guo, Nazanin Rahnavard
title_en: Nazmul Karim*, Abdullah Al Arafat, Umar Khalid, Zhishan Guo, Nazanin Rahnavard
abstract: 近期研究表明,深度神经网络(DNNs)对各种后门攻击存在脆弱性,其中通过利用特定类型的触发器或毒化机制,可以破坏DNNs的行为。最先进的(SOTA)防御方法采用过于复杂的机制,要么需要计算成本高昂的对抗性搜索模块来反向工程触发器分布,要么需要过度敏感的超参数选择模块。此外,它们在具有挑战性的场景中表现不佳,例如有限验证数据和强攻击情况下。本文提出了一种名为神经掩码微调(NFT)的方法,旨在以最优方式重新组织神经元活动,从而消除后门的影响。利用简单的数据增强方法如MixUp,NFT放松了触发器合成过程,并消除了对抗性搜索模块的需求。我们的研究进一步揭示,直接在有限验证数据下进行权重微调会导致净化后的干净测试准确率下降,主要由于过拟合问题。为了解决这一问题,我们提出对神经掩码而非模型权重进行微调。此外,设计了一种掩码正则化器以进一步缓解净化过程中的模型漂移。NFT的独特特性使其在运行时间和样本使用效率方面表现出高度优势,即使每类仅有一个样本也可移除后门。我们通过广泛的实验验证了NFT的有效性,涵盖图像分类、目标检测、视频动作识别、3D点云和自然语言处理任务。我们在11个基准数据集(ImageNet、UCF101、Pascal VOC、ModelNet、OpenSubtitles2012等)上评估了我们的方法对14种不同攻击(LIRA、WaNet等)的防御效果。我们的代码已在此GitHub仓库中公开。
abstract_en: Recent studies have revealed the vulnerability of deep neural networks (DNNs) to various backdoor attacks, where the behavior of DNNs can be compromised by utilizing certain types of triggers or poisoning mechanisms. State-of-the-art (SOTA) defenses employ too-sophisticated mechanisms that require either a computationally expensive adversarial search module for reverse-engineering the trigger distribution or an over-sensitive hyper-parameter selection module. Moreover, they offer sub-par performance in challenging scenarios, , limited validation data and strong attacks. In this paper, we propose—Neural mask Fine-Tuning (NFT)—with an aim to optimally re-organize the neuron activities in a way that the effect of the backdoor is removed. Utilizing a simple data augmentation like MixUp, NFT relaxes the trigger synthesis process and eliminates the requirement of the adversarial search module. Our study further reveals that direct weight fine-tuning under limited validation data results in poor post-purification clean test accuracy, primarily due to overfitting issue. To overcome this, we propose to fine-tune neural masks instead of model weights. In addition, a mask regularizer has been devised to further mitigate the model drift during the purification process. The distinct characteristics of NFT render it highly efficient in both runtime and sample usage, as it can remove the backdoor even when a single sample is available from each class. We validate the effectiveness of NFT through extensive experiments covering the tasks of image classification, object detection, video action recognition, 3D point cloud, and natural language processing. We evaluate our method against 14 different attacks (LIRA, WaNet, ) on 11 benchmark data sets (ImageNet, UCF101, Pascal VOC, ModelNet, OpenSubtitles2012, ). Our code is available online in this GitHub Repository.

title: Nazmul Karim*, Hasan Iqbal, Umar Khalid, Chen Chen, Jing Hua
title_en: Nazmul Karim*, Hasan Iqbal, Umar Khalid, Chen Chen, Jing Hua
abstract: 文本到图像(T2I)扩散模型因其在2D内容生成与编辑中的多功能性和用户友好性近期受到广泛关注。然而,由于缺乏大规模数据集,针对3D场景编辑专门训练扩散模型具有挑战性。目前,编辑3D场景需要要么重新训练模型以适应各种3D编辑需求,要么为每种独特的编辑类型开发特定方法。此外,最先进的(SOTA)技术需要来自同一场景的多张同步编辑图像以实现有效的场景编辑。鉴于当前T2I模型的局限性,在多张图像上实现一致的编辑效果仍然具有挑战性,导致编辑过程中出现多视角不一致。这种不一致性会削弱3D场景编辑1的性能,当这些图像被使用时。在本研究中,我们提出了一种名为Free-Editor的新型无训练3D场景编辑技术,该技术使用户能够在测试阶段无需重新训练模型即可编辑3D场景。我们的方法通过实施单视角编辑方案,有效解决了最先进的(SOTA)方法中存在的多视角风格不一致问题。具体而言,我们证明仅通过修改单个视角即可实现特定3D场景的编辑。为此,我们提出了一种Edit Transformer,利用自视角注意力机制和跨视角注意力机制分别确保视角内一致性与视角间风格迁移。通过消除模型重新训练和多视角编辑的需求,我们的方法显著降低了编辑时间与内存资源消耗,运行速度约为SOTA方法的20倍。我们在多个基准数据集上进行了广泛实验,展示了所提出技术的多样化编辑能力。项目页面:https://free-editor.github.io/ 1 在此处,3D场景编辑指的是NeRF模型编辑。在本研究中,我们主要关注基于NeRF的3D场景表示。
abstract_en: Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion models have recently gained traction for their versatility and user-friendliness in 2D content generation and editing. However, training a diffusion model specifically for 3D scene editing is challenging due to the scarcity of large-scale datasets. Currently, editing 3D scenes necessitates either retraining the model to accommodate various 3D edits or developing specific methods tailored to each unique editing type. Moreover, state-of-the-art (SOTA) techniques require multiple synchronized edited images from the same scene to enable effective scene editing. Given the current limitations of T2I models, achieving consistent editing effects across multiple images remains difficult, leading to multi-view inconsistency in editing. This inconsistency undermines the performance of 3D scene editing 1 when these images are utilized. In this study, we introduce a novel, training-free 3D scene editing technique called Free-Editor, which enables users to edit 3D scenes without the need for model retraining during the testing phase. Our method effectively addresses the issue of multi-view style inconsistency found in state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods through the implementation of a single-view editing scheme. Specifically, we demonstrate that editing a particular 3D scene can be achieved by modifying only a single view. To facilitate this, we present an Edit Transformer that ensures intra-view consistency and inter-view style transfer using self-view and cross-view attention mechanisms, respectively. By eliminating the need for model retraining and multi-view editing, our approach significantly reduces editing time and memory resource requirements, achieving runtimes approximately 20 times faster than SOTA methods. We have performed extensive experiments on various benchmark datasets, showcasing the diverse editing capabilities of our proposed technique. Project Page: https://free-editor.github.io/ 1 Here, 3D scene editing indicates NeRF model editing. In this study, we mainly focus on NeRF-based 3D scene representation.

title: Neerja Thakkar*, Karttikeya Mangalam, Andrea Bajcsy, Jitendra Malik
title_en: Neerja Thakkar*, Karttikeya Mangalam, Andrea Bajcsy, Jitendra Malik
abstract: 人类轨迹预测通常被建模为零样本泛化问题:一个预测器在训练场景的人类运动数据集上进行学习,然后部署到未见过的测试场景中。尽管这种范式取得了巨大进展,但其根本假设是部署场景中人类行为的趋势随时间保持不变。因此,当前的预测模型无法适应瞬态人类行为,例如人群暂时聚集观看街头艺人、行人雨中匆忙穿行并避开水坑,或抗议活动突然爆发。我们形式化了上下文特定自适应轨迹预测问题,并提出了一种受提示调优启发的新适应方法,称为潜在走廊。通过在预训练的人类轨迹预测器输入中加入可学习的图像提示,预测器能够从极少量的新数据(例如观察2名行人30秒)中推断趋势,在部署场景中得到显著提升。在MOTSynth模拟数据中,模型参数增加不足0.1%的情况下,我们实现了高达23.9%的ADE提升,在MOT和Wildtrack真实行人数据中达到16.4%的ADE提升。定性分析表明,潜在走廊使预测器具备对场景几何结构和上下文特定人类行为的感知,而非自适应预测器难以捕捉这些特征。
abstract_en: Human trajectory prediction is typically posed as a zero-shot generalization problem: a predictor is learnt on a dataset of human motion in training scenes, and then deployed on unseen test scenes. While this paradigm has yielded tremendous progress, it fundamentally assumes that trends in human behavior within the deployment scene are constant over time. As such, current prediction models are unable to adapt to transient human behaviors, such as crowds temporarily gathering to see buskers, pedestrians hurrying through the rain and avoiding puddles, or a protest breaking out. We formalize the problem of context-specific adaptive trajectory prediction and propose a new adaptation approach inspired by prompt tuning called latent corridors. By augmenting the input of a pre-trained human trajectory predictor with learnable image prompts, the predictor improves in the deployment scene by inferring trends from extremely small amounts of new data (e.g., 2 humans observed for 30 seconds). With less than 0.1% additional model parameters, we see up to 23.9% ADE improvement in MOTSynth simulated data and 16.4% ADE in MOT and Wildtrack real pedestrian data. Qualitatively, we observe that latent corridors imbue predictors with an awareness of scene geometry and context-specific human behaviors that non-adaptive predictors struggle to capture.

title: Nhat Le, Khoa Do, Xuan Bui, Tuong Do, Erman Tjiputra, Quang D.Tran, Anh Nguyen*
title_en: Nhat Le, Khoa Do, Xuan Bui, Tuong Do, Erman Tjiputra, Quang D.Tran, Anh Nguyen*
abstract: 从音乐生成群体舞蹈动作是一项具有多种工业应用的具有挑战性的任务。尽管已有多种方法被提出以解决该问题,但大多数方法优先优化舞蹈动作的保真度,受限于数据集中预定义的舞者数量。这一限制阻碍了其在现实世界应用中的适应性。我们的研究解决了群体编舞的可扩展性问题,同时保持自然性和同步性。具体而言,我们提出了一种基于相位的变分生成模型,用于在学习生成流形的过程中生成群体舞蹈动作。我们的方法实现了高保真度的群体舞蹈动作,并能够在仅消耗最小且恒定内存的情况下生成无限数量的舞者。在两个公开数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在很大程度上超越了最近的最先进方法,并且可以扩展到训练数据之外的大量舞者。
abstract_en: Generating group dance motion from the music is a challenging task with several industrial applications. Although several methods have been proposed to tackle this problem, most of them prioritize optimizing the fidelity in dancing movement, constrained by predetermined dancer counts in datasets. This limitation impedes adaptability to real-world applications. Our study addresses the scalability problem in group choreography while preserving naturalness and synchronization. In particular, we propose a phase-based variational generative model for group dance generation on learning a generative manifold. Our method achieves high-fidelity group dance motion and enables the generation with an unlimited number of dancers while consuming only a minimal and constant amount of memory. The intensive experiments on two public datasets show that our proposed method outperforms recent state-of-the-art approaches by a large margin and is scalable to a great number of dancers beyond the training data.

title: NianHui Guo*, Hong Guo, Christoph Meinel, Haojin Yang
title_en: NianHui Guo*, Hong Guo, Christoph Meinel, Haojin Yang
abstract: 二进制神经网络(BNNs)为实现高效的深度学习模型提供了一条有前景的途径,但受限于将噪声浮点梯度与二进制参数对齐的固有挑战。为解决这一问题,我们引入了Diode,这是一种专为BNNs设计的突破性优化器,通过独特且无需隐含权重的方法利用梯度符号信息来弥合这一差距。通过专注于梯度符号的低阶矩估计进行参数更新,Diode能够统一微调二进制参数,显著提升模型收敛性,而无需依赖32位隐含权重或嵌入缓冲区。本文通过在多种视觉和自然语言处理(NLP)任务上的全面评估,展示了Diode的卓越性能。值得注意的是,Diode通过减少八倍的训练迭代次数,将BNext-18在ImageNet ILSVRC2012上的Top-1准确率提升了0.96%,超越了现有技术水平。在ReActNet案例中,Diode不仅匹配甚至略微超越了先前基准,无需采用复杂的多阶段优化策略,有效将训练时间减半。此外,Diode在GLUE基准的二进制BERT架构上证明了其强大的泛化能力,无需数据增强即优于现有BiT设计3.3%,并在增强条件下建立了新的SOTA准确率78.8%。Diode的实现可在:https://github.com/GreenBitAI/bitorch-engine 获取。
abstract_en: Binary Neural Networks (BNNs) offer a promising avenue toward achieving efficient deep-learning models but are hindered by the inherent challenge of aligning noisy floating-point gradients with binary parameters. To address this, we introduce Diode, a groundbreaking optimizer designed explicitly for BNNs that bridges this gap by utilizing the gradient’s sign information in a unique, latent-weight-free approach. By focusing on the gradient sign’s lower-order moment estimate for parameter updates, Diode uniformly fine-tunes binary parameters, significantly enhancing model convergence without the dependency on 32-bit latent weights or embedding buffers. This paper showcases Diode’s superior performance through comprehensive evaluations on a variety of vision and Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. Remarkably, Diode advances the state-of-the-art by increasing BNext-18 Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet ILSVRC2012 by 0.96% with eightfold fewer training iterations. In the case of ReActNet, Diode not only matches but slightly exceeds previous benchmarks without resorting to complex multi-stage optimization strategies, effectively halving the training duration. Additionally, Diode proves its robust generalization capability on the binary BERT architecture within the GLUE benchmark, outperforming the existing BiT design by 3.3% without data augmentation and establishing a new SOTA accuracy of 78.8% with augmentation. The implementation of Diode is available at: https://github.com/GreenBitAI/bitorch-engine.

title: Nick Stracke*, Stefan Andreas Baumann, Joshua Susskind, Miguel Angel Bautista, Bjorn Ommer
title_en: Nick Stracke*, Stefan Andreas Baumann, Joshua Susskind, Miguel Angel Bautista, Bjorn Ommer
abstract: 文本到图像生成模型已成为一种突出且强大的工具,能够生成高分辨率的逼真图像。然而,指导这些模型的生成过程以考虑反映风格和/或结构信息的详细条件形式仍然是一个开放性问题。在本文中,我们提出了__TITLE_MATH_1__,这是一种通过新颖的条件LoRA模块将风格和结构条件统一在同一公式下的方法,实现了零样本控制。__TITLE_MATH_1__是一种高效且强大的文本到图像扩散模型条件方法,能够在生成过程中实现细粒度控制条件,并优于最近的最先进方法。项目页面:compvis.github.io/LoRAdapter/
abstract_en: Text-to-image generative models have become a prominent and powerful tool that excels at generating high-resolution realistic images. However, guiding the generative process of these models to take into account detailed forms of conditioning reflecting style and/or structure information remains an open problem. In this paper, we present , an approach that unifies both style and structure conditioning under the same formulation using a novel conditional LoRA block that enables zero-shot control. is an efficient and powerful approach to condition text-to-image diffusion models, which enables fine-grained control conditioning during generation and outperforms recent state-of-the-art approaches. Project page: compvis.github.io/LoRAdapter/

title: Nico Messikommer*, Giovanni Cioffi, Mathias Gehrig, Davide Scaramuzza
title_en: Nico Messikommer*, Giovanni Cioffi, Mathias Gehrig, Davide Scaramuzza
abstract: 视觉里程计(VO)是移动机器人和增强/虚拟现实任务的关键技术。尽管近期取得进展,现有VO方法仍依赖启发式设计选择,需要人类专家数周的超参数调优,限制了其泛化能力和鲁棒性。我们通过将VO重新定义为序列决策任务,并应用强化学习(RL)动态适应VO过程来解决这些挑战。我们的方法引入了一个神经网络,作为VO流程中的智能体,根据实时条件做出关键帧选择和网格大小等决策。我们的方法通过基于姿态误差、运行时间等指标的奖励函数,减少对启发式选择的依赖,引导系统运行。RL框架将VO系统和图像序列视为环境,智能体通过关键点、地图统计信息和先验姿态接收观测数据。使用经典VO方法和公开基准的实验结果表明,该方法在准确性和鲁棒性上均有提升,验证了RL增强的VO方法在不同场景下的泛化能力。我们认为这种范式转变通过消除对启发式参数耗时调优的需求,推动了VO技术的发展。
abstract_en: Visual Odometry (VO) is essential to downstream mobile robotics and augmented/virtual reality tasks. Despite recent advances, existing VO methods still rely on heuristic design choices that require several weeks of hyperparameter tuning by human experts, hindering generalizability and robustness. We address these challenges by reframing VO as a sequential decision-making task and applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) to adapt the VO process dynamically. Our approach introduces a neural network, operating as an agent within the VO pipeline, to make decisions such as keyframe and grid-size selection based on real-time conditions. Our method minimizes reliance on heuristic choices using a reward function based on pose error, runtime, and other metrics to guide the system. Our RL framework treats the VO system and the image sequence as an environment, with the agent receiving observations from keypoints, map statistics, and prior poses. Experimental results using classical VO methods and public benchmarks demonstrate improvements in accuracy and robustness, validating the generalizability of our RL-enhanced VO approach to different scenarios. We believe this paradigm shift advances VO technology by eliminating the need for time-intensive parameter tuning of heuristics.

title: Niels Chr Overgaard*, Anders Holst
title_en: Niels Chr Overgaard*, Anders Holst
abstract: 本文研究了从CASSI测量中恢复高光谱图像的标准模型所关联的线性逆问题。该问题被表述为一个目标函数的最小化问题,该目标函数是总变分正则化项和最小二乘损失函数的和。标准的一阶迭代最小化算法(如ISTA、FISTA和TwIST)需要输入损失函数梯度的Lipschitz常数,或至少该值的良好上界,以选择合适的步长。对于本文考虑的损失项,该Lipschitz常数等于测量映射的最大奇异值的平方。在实际应用中,该数值通常直接计算为巨大方阵的最大特征值。这有时会成为优化算法中的瓶颈。本文通过展示如何从一个尺寸仅为直接方法三到四个数量级更小的方阵中计算Lipschitz常数,有效消除了这一瓶颈。
abstract_en: The linear inverse problem associated with the standard model for hyperspectral image recovery from CASSI measurements is considered. This is formulated as the minimization of an objective function which is the sum of a total variation regularizer and a least squares loss function. Standard first-order iterative minimization algorithms, such as ISTA, FISTA and TwIST, require as input the value of the Lipschitz constant for the gradient of the loss function, or at least a good upper bound on this value, in order to select appropriate step lengths. For the loss term considered here, this Lipschitz constant equals the square of the largest singular value of the measurement map. In applications, this number is usually computed directly as the largest eigenvalue of a huge square matrix. This can sometimes become a bottleneck in an otherwise optimized algorithm. In the present paper we effectively eliminate this bottleneck for CASSI reconstructions by showing how the Lipschitz constant can be calculated from a square matrix whose size is easily three orders of magnitudes smaller than in the direct approach.

title: Nikhil Gosala*, Kürsat Petek, B Ravi Kiran, Senthil Yogamani, Paulo L. J. Drews-Jr, Wolfram Burgard, Abhinav Valada
title_en: Nikhil Gosala*, Kürsat Petek, B Ravi Kiran, Senthil Yogamani, Paulo L. J. Drews-Jr, Wolfram Burgard, Abhinav Valada
abstract: 语义鸟瞰图(BEV)地图为自动驾驶中的各种决策任务提供了丰富的表示形式,并具有强大的遮挡推理能力。然而,大多数BEV映射方法采用全监督学习范式,依赖大量人工标注的BEV真实数据。在本文中,我们通过提出首个无监督表示学习方法来解决这一限制,以标签高效的方式从单目正面视图(FV)图像生成语义BEV地图。我们的方法通过两个独立的神经路径在无监督方式下预训练网络,使其能够独立推理场景几何结构和语义信息,随后仅使用少量BEV标签对网络进行微调以完成语义BEV映射任务。我们通过利用FV图像的空间和时间一致性来学习场景几何结构,并采用新颖的时间掩码自编码器框架来编码场景表示,从而实现无需标签的预训练。在KITTI-360和nuScenes数据集上的大量评估表明,我们的方法在仅使用1%的BEV标签且不依赖额外标注数据的情况下,性能与现有最先进的方法相当。
abstract_en: Semantic Bird’s Eye View (BEV) maps offer a rich representation with strong occlusion reasoning for various decision making tasks in autonomous driving. However, most BEV mapping approaches employ a fully supervised learning paradigm that relies on large amounts of human-annotated BEV ground truth data. In this work, we address this limitation by proposing the first unsupervised representation learning approach to generate semantic BEV maps from a monocular frontal view (FV) image in a label-efficient manner. Our approach pretrains the network to independently reason about scene geometry and scene semantics using two disjoint neural pathways in an unsupervised manner and then finetunes it for the task of semantic BEV mapping using only a small fraction of labels in the BEV. We achieve label-free pretraining by exploiting spatial and temporal consistency of FV images to learn scene geometry while relying on a novel temporal masked autoencoder formulation to encode the scene representation. Extensive evaluations on the KITTI-360 and nuScenes datasets demonstrate that our approach performs on par with the existing state-of-the-art approaches while using only 1% of BEV labels and no additional labeled data.

title: Niki Amini-Naieni*, Tomas Jakab, Andrea Vedaldi, Ronald Clark
title_en: Niki Amini-Naieni*, Tomas Jakab, Andrea Vedaldi, Ronald Clark
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRFs)显著提升了新视角合成效果,但其图像预测中的不确定性量化仍存在挑战。现有不确定性估计方法,包括最先进的密度感知NeRF集成(DANE)[?],均未进行校准,导致图像预测常出现过自信或欠自信的问题,这可能影响其实际应用。本文首次提出一种方法,实现NeRFs的校准不确定性。为此,我们克服了将现有校准技术适配到NeRFs中的关键挑战:需要从目标场景中保留真实图像,从而减少用于训练NeRF的图像数量。这一问题在稀疏视角设置中尤为突出,此时可能仅使用三张图像即可。为解决此问题,我们引入了元校准器的概念,该校准器通过单次前向传播即可对NeRFs进行不确定性校准,无需保留目标场景的任何图像。我们的元校准器是一个神经网络,输入为NeRF图像和未校准的不确定性图,输出针对场景的校准曲线以修正NeRF的未校准不确定性。我们证明该元校准器可泛化到未见过的场景,并实现校准良好且达到SOTA的NeRF不确定性,显著优于DANE和其他方法。这为依赖准确NeRF不确定性估计的应用(如最佳下视点规划)提供了改进机会,也有可能提升医学诊断中的图像重建可信度。
abstract_en: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) have markedly improved novel view synthesis, but accurate uncertainty quantification in their image predictions remains an open problem. The prevailing methods for estimating uncertainty, including the state-of-the-art Density-aware NeRF Ensembles (DANE) [?], quantify uncertainty without calibration. This frequently leads to over- or under-confidence in image predictions, which can undermine their real-world applications. In this paper, we propose a method which, for the first time, achieves calibrated uncertainties for NeRFs. To accomplish this, we overcome a significant challenge in adapting existing calibration techniques to NeRFs: a need to hold out ground truth images from the target scene, reducing the number of images left to train the NeRF. This issue is particularly problematic in sparse-view settings, where we can operate with as few as three images. To address this, we introduce the concept of a meta-calibrator that performs uncertainty calibration for NeRFs with a single forward pass without the need for holding out any images from the target scene. Our meta-calibrator is a neural network that takes as input the NeRF images and uncalibrated uncertainty maps and outputs a scene-specific calibration curve that corrects the NeRF’s uncalibrated uncertainties. We show that the meta-calibrator can generalize on unseen scenes and achieves well-calibrated and state-of-the-art uncertainty for NeRFs, significantly beating DANE and other approaches. This opens opportunities to improve applications that rely on accurate NeRF uncertainty estimates such as next-best view planning and potentially more trustworthy image reconstruction for medical diagnosis.

title: Nikita Karaev*, Ignacio Rocco, Ben Graham, Natalia Neverova, Andrea Vedaldi, Christian Rupprecht
title_en: Nikita Karaev*, Ignacio Rocco, Ben Graham, Natalia Neverova, Andrea Vedaldi, Christian Rupprecht
abstract: 我们引入了一个基于Transformer的模型,用于在长视频序列中跟踪大量二维点。与大多数现有方法独立跟踪点不同,该模型联合跟踪点,考虑它们之间的依赖关系。我们证明联合跟踪显著提高了跟踪的准确性和鲁棒性,并允许跟踪被遮挡的点和超出相机视野的点。我们还为这一类跟踪器引入了多项创新,包括使用令牌代理,这显著提高了内存效率,并允许在单个GPU上同时跟踪70,000个点。该算法是一个在线算法,在短窗口上因果地运行。然而,它通过展开窗口作为循环网络进行训练,即使点被遮挡或离开视野,也能长时间维护跟踪记录。在定量评估中,该模型在标准点跟踪基准测试中显著优于现有跟踪器。代码和模型权重可在https://co-tracker.github.io/获取。
abstract_en: We introduce , a transformer-based model that tracks a large number of 2D points in long video sequences. Differently from most existing approaches that track points independently, tracks them jointly, accounting for their dependencies. We show that joint tracking significantly improves tracking accuracy and robustness, and allows to track occluded points and points outside of the camera view. We also introduce several innovations for this class of trackers, including using token proxies that significantly improve memory efficiency and allow to track 70k points jointly and simultaneously at inference on a single GPU. is an online algorithm that operates causally on short windows. However, it is trained utilizing unrolled windows as a recurrent network, maintaining tracks for long periods of time even when points are occluded or leave the field of view. Quantitatively, substantially outperforms prior trackers on standard point-tracking benchmarks. Code and model weights are available at https://co-tracker.github.io/

title: Niklas Gard*, Anna Hilsmann, Peter Eisert
title_en: Niklas Gard*, Anna Hilsmann, Peter Eisert
abstract: 本文提出SPVLoc,一种全局室内定位方法,能够准确确定查询图像的六维(6D)相机姿态,且对场景特定先验知识需求极少,无需场景特定训练。我们的方法采用新颖的匹配过程,将给定的RGB图像视角相机视口定位在室内环境的全景语义布局表示集合中。这些全景图由一个无纹理的3D参考模型渲染生成,该模型仅包含房间形状的近似结构信息以及门和窗的标注。我们证明,一个简单的卷积网络结构可以成功实现图像到全景图以及最终图像到模型的匹配。通过视口分类得分,我们对参考全景图进行排序,并选择与查询图像的最佳匹配。随后,估计所选全景图与查询图像之间的6D相对姿态。实验表明,该方法不仅有效弥合了领域差距,还能很好地泛化到训练数据中未出现的场景。此外,其定位精度优于现有方法,并且能够估计更多相机姿态的自由度。我们的源代码已公开:https: //fraunhoferhhi.github.io/spvloc.
abstract_en: In this paper, we present SPVLoc, a global indoor localization method that accurately determines the six-dimensional (6D) camera pose of a query image and requires minimal scene-specific prior knowledge and no scene-specific training. Our approach employs a novel matching procedure to localize the perspective camera’s viewport, given as an RGB image, within a set of panoramic semantic layout representations of the indoor environment. The panoramas are rendered from an untextured 3D reference model, which only comprises approximate structural information about room shapes, along with door and window annotations. We demonstrate that a straightforward convolutional network structure can successfully achieve image-to-panorama and ultimately image-to-model matching. Through a viewport classification score, we rank reference panoramas and select the best match for the query image. Then, a 6D relative pose is estimated between the chosen panorama and query image. Our experiments demonstrate that this approach not only efficiently bridges the domain gap but also generalizes well to previously unseen scenes that are not part of the training data. Moreover, it achieves superior localization accuracy compared to the state of the art methods and also estimates more degrees of freedom of the camera pose. Our source code is publicly available at: https: //fraunhoferhhi.github.io/spvloc.

title: Nikolai Kalischek*, Torben Peters, Jan Dirk Wegner, Konrad Schindler
title_en: Nikolai Kalischek*, Torben Peters, Jan Dirk Wegner, Konrad Schindler
abstract: 概率去噪扩散模型(DDMs)已为2D图像生成设定了新标准。将DDMs扩展至3D内容创作是当前研究的活跃领域。本文提出TetraDiffusion,一种基于三维空间四面体划分的扩散模型,以实现高效、高分辨率的3D形状生成。我们的模型引入了直接作用于四面体划分的卷积和转置卷积运算符,并无缝集成颜色等附加属性。我们的设计在生成网格几何方面效率显著提升:与现有网格扩散技术相比,TetraDiffusion的速度最高可达200倍。同时,它减少了内存消耗,并能在远高于现有网格生成器的分辨率下运行。仅使用标准消费级硬件,它在空间细节方面设定了新标准,并在多种质量指标上超越了其他网格生成器。更多结果和代码请参见我们的项目页面 tetradiffusion.github.io。
abstract_en: Probabilistic denoising diffusion models (DDMs) have set a new standard for 2D image generation. Extending DDMs for 3D content creation is an active field of research. Here, we propose TetraDiffusion, a diffusion model that operates on a tetrahedral partitioning of 3D space to enable efficient, high-resolution 3D shape generation. Our model introduces operators for convolution and transpose convolution that act directly on the tetrahedral partition, and seamlessly includes additional attributes like color. Our design generates mesh geometry much more efficiently: Compared to existing mesh diffusion techniques, TetraDiffusion is up to 200× faster. At the same time, it reduces memory consumption and can operate at substantially higher resolution than existing mesh generators. Using only standard consumer hardware, it sets a new standard in terms of spatial detail and outperforms other mesh generators across a range of quality metrics. For additional results and code see our project page tetradiffusion.github. io.

title: Nikolai Körber*, Eduard Kromer, Andreas Siebert, Sascha Hauke, Daniel Mueller-Gritschneder, Björn Schuller
title_en: Nikolai Körber*, Eduard Kromer, Andreas Siebert, Sascha Hauke, Daniel Mueller-Gritschneder, Björn Schuller
abstract: [height=4.8cm]figures/teaserc lic2020.pdf 图1:失真-感知对比(左上角最佳)我们提出EGIC,一种增强型生成图像压缩方法,能够通过单一模型高效遍历失真-感知曲线。EGIC基于两个新颖的构建模块:i) OASIS-C,一种条件预训练语义分割引导的判别器,它根据潜在图像分布,为生成器提供空间和语义感知的梯度反馈;ii) 输出残差预测(ORP),一种针对多真实感图像压缩的改造方案,通过调整MSE优化和GAN优化解码器输出之间残差的影响,实现对合成过程的控制。总体而言,EGIC形成了一种强大的编解码器,在失真端的表现几乎与VTM-20.0相当,同时超越了当前最先进的扩散和基于生成对抗网络的方法(如HiFiC、MS-ILLM和DIRAC-100)。EGIC易于实现,非常轻量,且具有出色的插值特性,使其成为针对低比特率范围的实用应用的有前景候选方案。
abstract_en: [height=4.8cm]figures/teaserc lic2020.pdf Figure 1: Distortion-perception comparison (top left is best) We introduce EGIC, an enhanced generative image compression method that allows traversing the distortion-perception curve efficiently from a single model. EGIC is based on two novel building blocks: i) OASIS-C, a conditional pre-trained semantic segmentation-guided discriminator, which provides both spatially and semantically-aware gradient feedback to the generator, conditioned on the latent image distribution, and ii) Output Residual Prediction (ORP), a retrofit solution for multi-realism image compression that allows control over the synthesis process by adjusting the impact of the residual between an MSE-optimized and GAN-optimized decoder output on the GAN-based reconstruction. Together, EGIC forms a powerful codec, outperforming state-of-the-art diffusion and GAN-based methods (, HiFiC, MS-ILLM, and DIRAC-100), while performing almost on par with VTM-20.0 on the distortion end. EGIC is simple to implement, very lightweight, and provides excellent interpolation characteristics, which makes it a promising candidate for practical applications targeting the low bit range.

title: Nikos Kolotouros*, Thiemo Alldieck, Enric Corona, Eduard Gabriel Bazavan, Cristian Sminchisescu
title_en: Nikos Kolotouros*, Thiemo Alldieck, Enric Corona, Eduard Gabriel Bazavan, Cristian Sminchisescu
abstract: 我们提出了一种方法,能够从不同输入模态(如图像和文本提示)快速生成高质量的3D人体虚拟形象,并控制生成的姿态和形状。其核心在于使用针对特定任务专门设计的基于扩散的图像生成网络,随后通过3D提升网络进行处理。我们有意将生成过程与3D建模分离,从而能够利用在数十亿对文本-图像数据上训练的强大图像合成先验知识。我们通过额外的图像条件微调潜在扩散网络,以实现图像生成和背面预测,并支持生成多种不同的3D假设。我们的部分微调方法能够在不引发灾难性遗忘的情况下,为每个任务适配网络。在实验中,我们证明了该方法能够生成准确且高质量的3D虚拟形象,其外观多样且符合多模态的文本、图像和身体控制信号。我们的方法可在2秒内生成3D模型,速度比现有大多数方法快四个数量级,而现有方法大多仅解决我们任务的一部分且控制手段更少。该方法使大规模可控生成人体虚拟形象的应用成为可能。项目网站可访问 https://www.nikoskolot.com/avatarpopup/。
abstract_en: We present , a method for fast, high quality 3D human avatar generation from different input modalities, such as images and text prompts and with control over the generated pose and shape. The common theme is the use of diffusion-based image generation networks that are specialized for each particular task, followed by a 3D lifting network. We purposefully decouple the generation from the 3D modeling which allow us to leverage powerful image synthesis priors, trained on billions of text-image pairs. We fine-tune latent diffusion networks with additional image conditioning for image generation and back-view prediction, and to support qualitatively different multiple 3D hypotheses. Our partial fine-tuning approach allows to adapt the networks for each task without inducing catastrophic forgetting. In our experiments, we demonstrate that our method produces accurate, high-quality 3D avatars with diverse appearance that respect the multimodal text, image, and body control signals. Our approach can produce a 3D model in as few as 2 seconds, a four orders of magnitude speedup the vast majority of existing methods, most of which solve only a subset of our tasks, and with fewer controls. enables applications that require the controlled 3D generation of human avatars at scale. The project website can be found at https://www.nikoskolot.com/avatarpopup/.

title: Niloofar Azizi*, Mohsen Fayyaz, Horst Bischof
title_en: Niloofar Azizi*, Mohsen Fayyaz, Horst Bischof
abstract: 理解人类行为本质上依赖于精确的3D人体姿态估计。图卷积网络(GCNs)近期展现出显著进展,通过相对轻量的架构实现了最先进性能。在图结构数据的背景下,利用图拉普拉斯矩阵的特征向量进行位置编码是有效的。然而,该方法未明确说明如何处理输入图中边缺失的场景。为此,我们提出了一种新颖的位置编码技术PerturbPE,从特征基中提取一致且规则的成分。我们的方法通过施加多重扰动并取其平均值,从特征基中提取一致且规则的成分。PerturbPE利用瑞利-薛定谔微扰定理(RSPT)计算扰动特征向量。采用该标记技术增强了模型的鲁棒性和泛化能力。我们的实验结果支持理论发现,例如在遮挡导致单条边缺失的场景中,我们在Human3.6M数据集上观察到性能提升最高达12%。此外,我们的新方法在两条边缺失的场景中显著提升性能,为当前最佳方法设立了新基准。
abstract_en: Understanding human behavior fundamentally relies on accurate 3D human pose estimation. Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) have recently shown promising advancements, delivering state-of-the-art performance with rather lightweight architectures. In the context of graph-structured data, leveraging the eigenvectors of the graph Laplacian matrix for positional encoding is effective. Yet, the approach does not specify how to handle scenarios where edges in the input graph are missing. To this end, we propose a novel positional encoding technique, PerturbPE, that extracts consistent and regular components from the eigenbasis. Our method involves applying multiple perturbations and taking their average to extract the consistent and regular component from the eigenbasis. PerturbPE leverages the Rayleigh-Schrodinger Perturbation Theorem (RSPT) for calculating the perturbed eigenvectors. Employing this labeling technique enhances the robustness and generalizability of the model. Our results support our theoretical findings, e.g. our experimental analysis observed a performance enhancement of up to 12% on the Human3.6M dataset in instances where occlusion resulted in the absence of one edge. Furthermore, our novel approach significantly enhances performance in scenarios where two edges are missing, setting a new benchmark for state-of-the-art.

title: Nina Shvetsova*, Anna Kukleva, Xudong Hong, Christian Rupprecht, Bernt Schiele, Hilde Kuehne
title_en: Nina Shvetsova*, Anna Kukleva, Xudong Hong, Christian Rupprecht, Bernt Schiele, Hilde Kuehne
abstract: 教学视频是通过从视频音频信号中提取自动语音识别系统(ASR)生成的字幕,学习文本-视频或甚至多模态表示的常见来源。然而,与人工标注的字幕相比,语音和字幕自然地与视频的视觉内容存在差异,因此仅能提供噪声监督。结果,大规模无需标注的网络视频训练数据仍无法为文本-视频模型的训练提供最优效果。在本工作中,我们提出利用大型语言模型(LLMs)的能力,大规模获取与视频对齐的高质量视频描述。具体而言,我们通过提示LLM基于教学视频的ASR字幕生成合理的视频字幕。为此,我们引入了一种提示方法,能够处理更长的字幕文本,从而捕捉超出单句的上下文信息。我们进一步提示LLM根据字幕的时间戳为每个生成的字幕生成时间戳,并最终将生成的字幕与视频进行时间对齐。通过这种方式,我们无需人工监督即可大规模生成具有人类风格的视频字幕。我们将该方法应用于HowTo100M数据集的字幕,创建了一个新的大规模数据集HowToCaption。我们的评估表明,生成的字幕不仅在零样本文本-视频检索和视频字幕生成任务中显著优于多个基准数据集,还实现了文本叙述与音频的解耦,从而提升文本-视频-音频任务的性能。1 1 所有数据和代码可在https://github.com/ninatu/howtocaption获取。
abstract_en: Instructional videos are a common source for learning text-video or even multimodal representations by leveraging subtitles extracted with automatic speech recognition systems (ASR) from the audio signal in the videos. However, in contrast to human-annotated captions, both speech and subtitles naturally differ from the visual content of the videos and thus provide only noisy supervision. As a result, large-scale annotation-free web video training data remains sub-optimal for training text-video models. In this work, we propose to leverage the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to obtain high-quality video descriptions aligned with videos at scale. Specifically, we prompt an LLM to create plausible video captions based on ASR subtitles of instructional videos. To this end, we introduce a prompting method that is able to take into account a longer text of subtitles, allowing us to capture the contextual information beyond one single sentence. We further prompt the LLM to generate timestamps for each produced caption based on the timestamps of the subtitles and finally align the generated captions to the video temporally. In this way, we obtain human-style video captions at scale without human supervision. We apply our method to the subtitles of the HowTo100M dataset, creating a new large-scale dataset, HowToCaption. Our evaluation shows that the resulting captions not only significantly improve the performance over many different benchmark datasets for zero-shot text-video retrieval and video captioning, but also lead to a disentangling of textual narration from the audio, boosting the performance in text-video-audio tasks.1 1 All data and code is available at https://github.com/ninatu/howtocaption.

title: 温妮娜*、帕拉斯基瓦斯·佩吉奥斯、艾克·彼得森、阿萨·费拉根、西阿瓦什·阿贾蒙德·比格德尔
title_en: Nina Weng*, Paraskevas Pegios, Eike Petersen, Aasa Feragen, Siavash Arjomand Bigdeli
abstract: 捷径学习是指模型(例如心脏疾病分类器)利用目标标签与虚假捷径特征(例如起搏器)之间的相关性,基于捷径特征而非真实的判别特征来预测目标标签。这在医学影像中很常见,其中治疗和临床注释与疾病标签相关,使其成为预测疾病的便捷捷径。我们提出了一种新颖的检测和量化潜在捷径特征影响的方法,通过快速扩散基的反事实图像生成,可以合成地移除或添加捷径特征。通过一种新颖的自优化掩码方案,我们在无需额外推理步骤的情况下空间限制变化,鼓励移除空间受限的捷径特征,同时确保无捷径反事实保持其剩余图像特征的高程度。利用这些方法,我们评估了捷径特征对模型预测的影响。这得益于我们的第二项贡献:一种高效的扩散基反事实解释方法,在图像质量与现有技术相当的情况下显著提升了推理速度。我们在两个大型胸部X光数据集、皮肤病变数据集和CelebA上验证了这一方法。我们的代码可在https://fastdime.compute.dtu.dk公开获取。
abstract_en: Shortcut learning is when a model – e.g. a cardiac disease classifier – exploits correlations between the target label and a spurious shortcut feature, e.g. a pacemaker, to predict the target label based on the shortcut rather than real discriminative features. This is common in medical imaging, where treatment and clinical annotations correlate with disease labels, making them easy shortcuts to predict disease. We propose a novel detection and quantification of the impact of potential shortcut features via a fast diffusion-based counterfactual image generation that can synthetically remove or add shortcuts. Via a novel self-optimized masking scheme we spatially limit the changes made with no extra inference step, encouraging the removal of spatially constrained shortcut features while ensuring that the shortcut-free counterfactuals preserve their remaining image features to a high degree. Using these, we assess how shortcut features influence model predictions. This is enabled by our second contribution: An efficient diffusion-based counterfactual explanation method with significant inference speed-up at comparable image quality as state-of-the-art. We confirm this on two large chest X-ray datasets, a skin lesion dataset, and CelebA. Our code is publicly available at https://fastdime.compute.dtu.dk.

title: Ning Gao, Sanping Zhou*, Le Wang, Nanning Zheng
title_en: Ning Gao, Sanping Zhou*, Le Wang, Nanning Zheng
abstract: 半监督学习已成为医学图像分割领域广泛应用的技术。现有研究主要聚焦于构建一致性约束或生成伪标签以提供高质量的监督信号,其主要挑战在于如何保持模型能力的持续提升。本文提出了一种简单而有效的半监督学习框架,称为渐进均值教师(Progressive Mean Teachers, PMT),用于医学图像分割,其目标是在训练过程中通过学习鲁棒且多样的特征来生成高保真伪标签。具体而言,我们的PMT采用标准均值教师来惩罚当前状态的一致性,并利用两组MT架构进行协同训练。这两组MT架构分别经过长时间更新,以维持通过迭代差异产生的性能差距所建立的稳定模型多样性。此外,采用一种基于差异驱动的对齐正则化器,以加速滞后模型与领先模型表征能力的对齐。同时,采用一种简单而有效的伪标签过滤算法,便于模型评估和在模型高性能运行时选择高保真伪标签用于协同训练。在包含不同模态(即CT和MRI)的两个数据集上的实验结果表明,我们的方法在多个维度上优于现有的医学图像分割方法。代码已开源至https://github.com/Axi404/PMT。
abstract_en: Semi-supervised learning has emerged as a widely adopted technique in the field of medical image segmentation. The existing works either focuses on the construction of consistency constraints or the generation of pseudo labels to provide high-quality supervisory signals, whose main challenge mainly comes from how to keep the continuous improvement of model capabilities. In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective semi-supervised learning framework, termed Progressive Mean Teachers (PMT), for medical image segmentation, whose goal is to generate high-fidelity pseudo labels by learning robust and diverse features in the training process. Specifically, our PMT employs a standard mean teacher to penalize the consistency of the current state and utilizes two sets of MT architectures for co-training. The two sets of MT architectures are individually updated for prolonged periods to maintain stable model diversity established through performance gaps generated by iteration differences. Additionally, a difference-driven alignment regularizer is employed to expedite the alignment of lagging models with the representation capabilities of leading models. Furthermore, a simple yet effective pseudo-label filtering algorithm is employed for facile evaluation of models and selection of high-fidelity pseudo-labels outputted when models are operating at high performance for co-training purposes. Experimental results on two datasets with different modalities, i.e., CT and MRI, demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art medical image segmentation approaches across various dimensions. The code is available at https://github. com/Axi404/PMT.

title: Ning Gao, Xingyu Jiang, Xiuhui Zhang, Yue Deng*
title_en: Ning Gao, Xingyu Jiang, Xiuhui Zhang, Yue Deng*
abstract: 目前大多数单图像去雨(SID)方法基于具有全局建模能力的Transformer以实现高质量重建。然而,其架构仅从空间域构建长距离特征,导致为保持有效性需承担显著的计算负担。此外,这些方法在训练中要么忽略负样本信息,要么未能充分挖掘负样本中存在的雨痕模式。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种频率感知去雨Transformer框架(FADformer),该框架通过全面捕捉频率域特征实现高效的雨痕去除。具体而言,我们构建了FADBlock模块,包含融合傅里叶卷积混合器(FFCM)和先验门控前馈网络(PGFN)。与自注意力机制不同,FFCM在空间域和频率域均执行卷积操作,赋予其局部-全局捕捉能力和高效性。同时,PGFN通过门控方式引入残差通道先验,以增强局部细节并保留特征结构。此外,我们在训练中引入了频率域对比正则化(FCR)。FCR通过频率域对比学习并利用负样本中的雨痕模式提升性能。大量实验验证了FADformer的效率与有效性。源代码可在https://github.com/deng-ai-lab/FADformer获取。
abstract_en: Most current single image-deraining (SID) methods are based on the Transformer with global modeling for high-quality reconstruction. However, their architectures only build long-range features from the spatial domain, which suffers from a significant computational burden to keep effectiveness. Besides, these methods either overlook negative sample information in training or underutilize the rain streak patterns present in the negative ones. To tackle these problems, we propose a Frequency-Aware Deraining Transformer Framework (FADformer) that fully captures frequency domain features for efficient rain removal. Specifically, we construct the FADBlock, including the Fused Fourier Convolution Mixer (FFCM) and Prior-Gated Feed-forward Network (PGFN). Unlike self-attention mechanisms, the FFCM conducts convolution operations in both spatial and frequency domains, endowing it with local-global capturing capabilities and efficiency. Simultaneously, the PGFN introduces residue channel prior in a gating manner to enhance local details and retain feature structure. Furthermore, we introduce a Frequency-domain Contrastive Regularization (FCR) during training. The FCR facilitates contrastive learning in the frequency domain and leverages rain streak patterns in negative samples to improve performance. Extensive experiments show the efficiency and effectiveness of our FADformer. The source code is available at https://github.com/deng-ai-lab/FADformer.

title: Ning Yu*, Chia-chih Chen, Zeyuan Chen, Rui Meng, Gang Wu, Paul W Josel, Juan Carlos Niebles, Caiming Xiong, Ran Xu
title_en: Ning Yu*, Chia-chih Chen, Zeyuan Chen, Rui Meng, Gang Wu, Paul W Josel, Juan Carlos Niebles, Caiming Xiong, Ran Xu
abstract: 图形布局设计在视觉传达中起着至关重要的作用。然而,手工制作布局设计需要高技能、耗时且难以批量生产。生成模型的出现使设计自动化成为可能,但要生成符合设计师多模态需求的布局设计(即受背景图像约束并由前景内容驱动)仍具有挑战性。我们提出LayoutDETR,它继承了生成建模的高质量和真实感,同时将内容感知需求重新表述为检测问题:我们学习在背景图像中检测合理的位置、尺度和空间关系,以生成符合多模态前景元素的布局。我们的解决方案在公开基准数据集和我们新整理的广告横幅数据集上均实现了布局生成的最先进性能。我们将解决方案集成到一个图形系统中,便于用户研究,并展示了用户对我们的设计显著优于基线模型。代码、模型、数据集和演示可在GitHub上获取。
abstract_en: Graphic layout designs play an essential role in visual communication. Yet handcrafting layout designs is skill-demanding, time-consuming, and non-scalable to batch production. Generative models emerge to make design automation scalable but it remains non-trivial to produce designs that comply with designers’ multimodal desires, i.e., constrained by background images and driven by foreground content. We propose LayoutDETR that inherits the high quality and realism from generative modeling, while reformulating content-aware requirements as a detection problem: we learn to detect in a background image the reasonable locations, scales, and spatial relations for multimodal foreground elements in a layout. Our solution sets a new state-of-the-art performance for layout generation on public benchmarks and on our newly-curated ad banner dataset. We integrate our solution into a graphical system that facilitates user studies, and show that users prefer our designs over baselines by significant margins. Code, models, dataset, and demos are available at GitHub.

title: Ningli Xu, Rongjun Qin*
title_en: Ningli Xu, Rongjun Qin*
abstract: 从卫星图像中预测城市场景的真实地面视角是一项具有挑战性的任务,由于卫星图像与地面视角图像之间存在显著的视角差异。我们提出了一种新颖的流程来解决这一挑战,通过生成最大程度尊重多视角卫星图像中弱几何和纹理的地理特定视角。与现有方法不同,这些方法通过部分语义或从高空卫星图像中提取的几何信息来生成图像,我们的方法直接利用卫星图像的综合信息,在地理坐标位置预测地面视角图像,从而生成分辨率提升十倍或更多的地面级图像。我们利用了一种新颖的建筑细化方法,以减少卫星数据在地面级别的几何失真,这确保了使用扩散网络进行视角合成时的准确条件。此外,我们提出了一种新颖的地理特定先验,促使扩散模型的分布学习尊重更接近预测图像地理坐标的图像样本。我们证明了我们的流程是首个仅基于卫星图像生成接近真实且地理特定的地面视角的方法。代码和数据集可在https://gdaosu.github.io/geocontext/获取。
abstract_en: Predicting realistic ground views from satellite imagery in urban scenes is a challenging task due to the significant view gaps between satellite and ground-view images. We propose a novel pipeline to tackle this challenge, by generating geospecifc views that maximally respect the weak geometry and texture from multi-view satellite images. Different from existing approaches that hallucinate images from cues such as partial semantics or geometry from overhead satellite images, our method directly predicts ground-view images at geolocation by using a comprehensive set of information from the satellite image, resulting in ground-level images with a resolution boost at a factor of ten or more. We leverage a novel building refinement method to reduce geometric distortions in satellite data at ground level, which ensures the creation of accurate conditions for view synthesis using diffusion networks. Moreover, we proposed a novel geospecific prior, which prompts distribution learning of diffusion models to respect image samples that are closer to the geolocation of the predicted images. We demonstrate our pipeline is the first to generate close-to-real and geospecific ground views merely based on satellite images. Code and dataset are available at https://gdaosu.github.io/geocontext/.

title: Nir Barel*, Ron A Shapira Weber*, Nir Mualem, Shahaf E Finder, Oren Freifeld*
title_en: Nir Barel*, Ron A Shapira Weber*, Nir Mualem, Shahaf E Finder, Oren Freifeld*
abstract: 图像联合对齐(Joint Alignment, JA)的无监督任务面临高复杂度、几何失真以及收敛至劣质局部或全局最优解等挑战。尽管视觉Transformer(Vision Transformers, ViT)近期为JA任务提供了有价值的特征,但其仍无法完全解决这些问题。因此,研究人员通常依赖昂贵的模型和大量正则化项,导致训练时间较长且超参数调优困难。我们提出了一种新颖的方法——空间联合对齐模型(SpaceJAM),以高效简洁的方式解决JA任务。SpaceJAM采用紧凑的架构,仅包含约16,000个可训练参数,并且无需正则化或图谱维护即可运行。在SPair-71K和CUB数据集上的评估表明,SpaceJAM在匹配现有方法对齐能力的同时,显著降低了计算需求,并实现了至少10倍的速度提升。SpaceJAM为快速有效的图像对齐设定了新标准,使该过程更加便捷高效。我们的代码可在:https://bgu-cs-vil.github.io/SpaceJAM/ 获取。
abstract_en: The unsupervised task of Joint Alignment (JA) of images is beset by challenges such as high complexity, geometric distortions, and convergence to poor local or even global optima. Although Vision Transformers (ViT) have recently provided valuable features for JA, they fall short of fully addressing these issues. Consequently, researchers frequently depend on expensive models and numerous regularization terms, resulting in long training times and challenging hyperparameter tuning. We introduce the Spatial Joint Alignment Model (SpaceJAM), a novel approach that addresses the JA task with efficiency and simplicity. SpaceJAM leverages a compact architecture with only ∼16K trainable parameters and uniquely operates without the need for regularization or atlas maintenance. Evaluations on SPair-71K and CUB datasets demonstrate that SpaceJAM matches the alignment capabilities of existing methods while significantly reducing computational demands and achieving at least a 10x speedup. SpaceJAM sets a new standard for rapid and effective image alignment, making the process more accessible and efficient. Our code is available at: https://bgu-cs-vil.github.io/ SpaceJAM/.

title: Nishad Singhi*, Jae Myung Kim, Karsten Roth, Zeynep Akata
title_en: Nishad Singhi*, Jae Myung Kim, Karsten Roth, Zeynep Akata
abstract: 概念瓶颈模型(CBMs)通过基于人类可理解的概念来实现图像分类,从而允许可解释的模型决策以及人类干预,其中专家用户可以修改不匹配的概念选择,以可解释的方式影响模型决策。然而,现有方法通常需要对每张图像进行大量的人类干预才能达到强性能,这在获取人类反馈成本高昂的场景中提出了实际挑战。在本文中,我们发现这一问题源于干预过程中对概念的独立处理,其中某一概念的改变不会影响其他概念的使用。为了解决这一问题,我们引入了一个可训练的概念干预重对齐模块,该模块利用概念关系在干预后重新对齐概念分配。在标准基准测试中,我们发现概念重对齐显著提高了干预效果,并减少了达到目标分类性能或概念预测准确率所需的干预次数。此外,它可轻松集成到现有的基于概念的架构中,而无需更改模型本身。这种降低的人机协作成本对于增强资源受限环境中CBMs的可行性至关重要。我们的代码可在https://github.com/ExplainableML/获取
abstract_en: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) ground image classification on human-understandable concepts to allow for interpretable model decisions as well as human interventions, in which expert users can modify misaligned concept choices to interpretably influence the decision of the model. However, existing approaches often require numerous human interventions per image to achieve strong performances, posing practical challenges in scenarios where obtaining human feedback is expensive. In this paper, we find that this is driven by an independent treatment of concepts during intervention, wherein a change of one concept does not influence the use of other ones. To address this issue, we introduce a trainable concept intervention realignment module, which leverages concept relations to realign concept assignments post-intervention. Across standard benchmarks, we find that concept realignment significantly improves intervention efficacy and reduces the number of interventions needed to reach a target classification performance or concept prediction accuracy. Moreover, it easily integrates into existing concept-based architectures without requiring changes to the models themselves. This reduced cost of human-model collaboration is crucial to enhance the feasibility of CBMs in resource-constrained environments. Our code is available at https://github.com/ExplainableML/

title: Nithin Gopalakrishnan Nair*, Jeya Maria Jose Valanarasu, Vishal Patel
title_en: Nithin Gopalakrishnan Nair*, Jeya Maria Jose Valanarasu, Vishal Patel
abstract: 基于扩散的大型文本到图像(T2I)模型在文本到图像生成和空间条件图像生成任务中展现出令人印象深刻的生成能力。我们可以通过使用配对数据对模型进行端到端训练,以获得逼真生成质量。然而,要添加新任务时,通常需要使用所有模态的配对数据从头开始重新训练模型,以保持良好的生成性能。本文针对这一问题,提出了一种新颖的策略,以最小的计算成本扩展生成模型到新任务。在实验过程中,我们发现扩散模型的中间特征图的方差图能够捕捉条件强度。利用这一先验信息,我们提出MaxFusion,一种高效的策略,用于扩展文本到图像生成模型以适应新模态条件。具体而言,我们结合多个模型的对齐特征,产生组合效应。我们的融合策略可以集成到现成模型中,以增强其生成能力。
abstract_en: Large diffusion-based Text-to-Image (T2I) models have shown impressive generative powers for text-to-image generation and spatially conditioned image generation. We can train the model end-to-end with paired data for most applications to obtain photorealistic generation quality. However, to add a task, one often needs to retrain the model from scratch using paired data across all modalities to retain good generation performance. This paper tackles this issue and proposes a novel strategy to scale a generative model across new tasks with minimal computation. During our experiments, we discovered that the variance maps of intermediate feature maps of diffusion models capture the conditioning intensity. Utilizing this prior information, we propose MaxFusion, an efficient strategy to scale up text-to-image generation models to accommodate new modality conditions. Specifically, we combine aligned features of multiple models, bringing a compositional effect. Our fusion strategy can be integrated into off-the-shelf models to enhance their generative prowess.

title: Noam Elata*, Tomer Michaeli, Michael Elad
title_en: Noam Elata*, Tomer Michaeli, Michael Elad
abstract: 压缩感知(CS)通过选择一组足够用于高保真重建的少量测量值,实现了快速图像采集。自适应压缩感知旨在通过根据已获取数据中获得的信息动态选择未来的测量值,进一步增强这一过程。然而,许多现有框架通常针对特定任务进行定制,并需要复杂的训练过程。我们提出AdaSense,一种新颖的自适应压缩感知方法,该方法利用零样本后验采样与预训练扩散模型。通过按顺序从后验分布中进行采样,我们可以在采集过程中量化每个可能的未来线性测量值的不确定性。AdaSense消除了额外训练的需要,并具有最小调参需求下对多样化领域的无缝适应能力。我们的实验表明,AdaSense在从少量测量值中重建面部图像方面具有有效性。此外,我们还将AdaSense应用于磁共振成像(MRI)和计算机断层扫描(CT)领域医学图像的主动采集,突显了其在实际应用中的加速潜力。1 1 我们的代码可在https://github.com/noamelata/AdaSense获取。
abstract_en: Compressed Sensing (CS) facilitates rapid image acquisition by selecting a small subset of measurements sufficient for high-fidelity reconstruction. Adaptive CS seeks to further enhance this process by dynamically choosing future measurements based on information gleaned from data that is already acquired. However, many existing frameworks are often tailored to specific tasks and require intricate training procedures. We propose AdaSense, a novel Adaptive CS approach that leverages zero-shot posterior sampling with pre-trained diffusion models. By sequentially sampling from the posterior distribution, we can quantify the uncertainty of each possible future linear measurement throughout the acquisition process. AdaSense eliminates the need for additional training and boasts seamless adaptation to diverse domains with minimal tuning requirements. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of AdaSense in reconstructing facial images from a small number of measurements. Furthermore, we apply AdaSense for active acquisition of medical images in the domains of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and computed tomography (CT), highlighting its potential for tangible real-world acceleration.1 1 Our code is available at https://github.com/noamelata/AdaSense.

title: Noo-ri Kim, Jin-Seop Lee, Jee-Hyong Lee*
title_en: Noo-ri Kim, Jin-Seop Lee, Jee-Hyong Lee*
abstract: 半监督学习是一种利用带标签样本和无标签样本的机器学习方法,旨在提升模型性能的同时降低标注成本。当存在数十到数百个带标签样本时,半监督学习方法表现出良好的性能,但大多数方法在仅提供少量带标签样本时表现较差。本文聚焦于具有挑战性的标签稀缺环境,其中每个类别仅有少量带标签样本。我们提出的模型ExMatch通过自监督模型从无标签样本中获取可靠信息,并将其用于半监督学习。在训练过程中,ExMatch引导模型维持适当的分布并基于自监督模型和自身模型的信息抵抗从错误伪标签中学习。ExMatch在多个基准数据集上展现出稳定的训练进度和最先进的性能。在极端标签稀缺情况下,ExMatch在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和SVHN数据集上性能提升约5%至21%。ExMatch还在高分辨率和大规模数据集(如STL-10、Tiny-ImageNet和ImageNet)中表现出显著的性能提升。
abstract_en: Semi-supervised learning is a learning method that uses both labeled and unlabeled samples to improve the performance of the model while reducing labeling costs. When there were tens to hundreds of labeled samples, semi-supervised learning methods showed good performance, but most of them showed poor performance when only a small number of labeled samples were given. In this paper, we focus on challenging label-scarce environments, where there are only a few labeled samples per class. Our proposed model, ExMatch, is designed to obtain reliable information from unlabeled samples using self-supervised models and utilize it for semi-supervised learning. In the training process, ExMatch guides the model to maintain an appropriate distribution and resist learning from incorrect pseudo-labels based on the information from self-supervised models and its own model. ExMatch shows stable training progress and the state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmark datasets. In extremely label-scare situations, performance is improved by about 5% to 21% for CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and SVHN. ExMatch also demonstrates significant performance improvements in high-resolution and large-scale dataset such as STL-10, Tiny-ImageNet, and ImageNet.

title: Noranart Vesdapunt*, Kah Kuen Fu, Yue Wu, Xu Zhang, Pradeep Natarajan
title_en: Noranart Vesdapunt*, Kah Kuen Fu, Yue Wu, Xu Zhang, Pradeep Natarajan
abstract: 近年来,大规模图像-文本预训练模型(如CLIP)的进展通过利用预训练知识弥合源域和目标域之间的差距,显著提升了无监督域适应(UDA)性能。然而,灾难性遗忘仍为主要挑战,因为传统微调方法在目标域上调整CLIP模型权重时会快速覆盖其预训练知识。为解决该问题,我们提出将CLIP的特征转换为高维向量(超向量)空间,以利用超向量的鲁棒性特性。我们首先研究超向量空间中的特征维度大小,通过实证方法找到允许足够特征模式冗余的维度阈值,从而避免过度训练(从而缓解灾难性遗忘)。为进一步利用超向量的鲁棒性,我们提出差异减少方法以降低源域与目标域之间的域偏移,并提出特征增强方法以从源域特征合成带标签的目标域特征。我们在四个公开的UDA数据集上取得了最佳结果,并展示了该方法在其他应用(少样本学习、持续学习)中的泛化能力。所提方法还表现出跨视觉-语言和视觉主干的模型无关性。
abstract_en: Recent advancement in the large-scale image-text pre-training model (such as CLIP) has significantly improved unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) by leveraging the pre-trained knowledge to bridge the source and target domain gap. However, Catastrophic forgetting still remains to be the main challenge, since traditional fine-tuning method to adjust CLIP model weights on a target domain can quickly override CLIP’s pre-trained knowledge. To address the above issue, we propose to convert CLIP’s features into high-dimensional vector (hypervector) space to utilize the robustness property of hypervector. We first study the feature dimension size in the hypervector space to empirically find the dimension threshold that allows enough feature patterns to be redundant to avoid excessive training (thus mitigating catastrophic forgetting). To further utilize the robustness of hypervector, we propose Discrepancy Reduction to reduce the domain shift between source and target domains, and Feature Augmentation to synthesize labeled target domain features from source domain features. We achieved the best results on four public UDA datasets, and showed the generalization of our method to other applications (few-shot learning, continual learning). The proposed method also shows model-agnostic property across vision-language and vision backbones.

title: Ofir Abramovich*, Niv Nayman*, Sharon Fogel, Inbal Lavi, Ron Litman, Shahar Tsiper, Royee Tichauer, Srikar Appalaraju, Shai Mazor, R. Manmatha
title_en: Ofir Abramovich*, Niv Nayman*, Sharon Fogel, Inbal Lavi, Ron Litman, Shahar Tsiper, Royee Tichauer, Srikar Appalaraju, Shai Mazor, R. Manmatha
abstract: 近年来,视觉文档理解领域取得了显著进展,主流架构由视觉和语言模型的级联组成。文本部分可以通过外部OCR模型显式提取(基于OCR的方法),或通过赋予视觉模型阅读能力(无需OCR的方法)。通常,模型的查询仅输入语言组件,要求视觉特征涵盖整个文档。本文提出VisFocus,一种无需OCR的方法,通过将语言提示直接与视觉编码器耦合,更好地利用视觉编码器的能力。为此,我们用接收输入提示并能突出文档相关部分、忽略其他部分的层替代下采样层。我们结合架构改进与新颖的预训练任务,使用文档文本片段的语言掩码(替代提示输入视觉编码器),以增强模型的聚焦能力。因此,VisFocus学会将注意力分配给与提示相关的文本块。实验表明,这种提示引导的视觉编码方法显著提升了性能,在多个基准测试中达到最先进水平。*在亚马逊实习期间完成的工作† 通讯作者:nivnay@amazon.com
abstract_en: In recent years, notable advancements have been made in the domain of visual document understanding, with the prevailing architecture comprising a cascade of vision and language models. The text component can either be extracted explicitly with the use of external OCR models in OCR-based approaches, or alternatively, the vision model can be endowed with reading capabilities in OCR-free approaches. Typically, the queries to the model are input exclusively to the language component, necessitating the visual features to encompass the entire document. In this paper, we present VisFocus, an OCR-free method designed to better exploit the vision encoder’s capacity by coupling it directly with the language prompt. To do so, we replace the down-sampling layers with layers that receive the input prompt and allow highlighting relevant parts of the document, while disregarding others. We pair the architecture enhancements with a novel pre-training task, using language masking on a snippet of the document text fed to the visual encoder in place of the prompt, to empower the model with focusing capabilities. Consequently, VisFocus learns to allocate its attention to text patches pertinent to the provided prompt. Our experiments demonstrate that this prompt-guided visual encoding approach significantly improves performance, achieving state-of-the-art results on various benchmarks. *Work done during an internshipemployment at Amazon† Corresponding author: nivnay@amazon.com

title: Ofir Shifman*, Yair Weiss
title_en: Ofir Shifman*, Yair Weiss
abstract: 在图像分类中表现出色的深度神经网络此前已被证明容易受到微小变换(如输入图像的单像素平移)的欺骗。为了解决这一问题,近年来提出了两种方法。第一种方法建议使用大规模数据集并结合数据增强,希望高度多样化的训练集能够教会网络学习不变性。第二种方法建议基于采样理论的架构修改,以显式处理图像平移。在本文中,我们展示这些方法在处理模拟相机方向细微变化的“自然”图像平移时仍存在不足。我们的研究发现,对于当前最先进的模型(如在LAION-2B上训练的open-CLIP或DINO-v2),约40%的测试图像在单像素平移后会导致预测图像表示发生显著变化,而专门构建以抵抗循环平移的模型仍可能有11%的概率被单像素现实(非循环)平移欺骗。我们提出了通过裁剪选择实现鲁棒推理:一种可证明能实现任意所需一致性的简单方法,尽管会以适度的模型准确率为代价。重要的是,我们展示了采用该方法可将单像素平移欺骗当前最先进的模型的能力降低至低于5%,同时仅导致1%的分类准确率下降。此外,我们还表明该方法可轻松调整以处理循环移位。在这种情况下,我们实现了100%的整数移位鲁棒性,且无需进一步训练即可达到最先进的准确率。代码可在https://github.com/ofirshifman/RICS获取。
abstract_en: Deep neural networks that achieve remarkable performance in image classification have previously been shown to be easily fooled by tiny transformations such as a one pixel translation of the input image. In order to address this problem, two approaches have been proposed in recent years. The first approach suggests using huge datasets together with data augmentation in the hope that a highly varied training set will teach the network to learn to be invariant. The second approach suggests using architectural modifications based on sampling theory to deal explicitly with image translations. In this paper, we show that these approaches still fall short in robustly handling ’natural’ image translations that simulate a subtle change in camera orientation. Our findings reveal that a mere one-pixel translation can result in a significant change in the predicted image representation for approximately 40% of the test images in state-of-the-art models (e.g. open-CLIP trained on LAION-2B or DINO-v2) , while models that are explicitly constructed to be robust to cyclic translations can still be fooled with 1 pixel realistic (non-cyclic) translations 11% of the time. We present Robust Inference by Crop Selection: a simple method that can be proven to achieve any desired level of consistency, although with a modest tradeoff with the model’s accuracy. Importantly, we demonstrate how employing this method reduces the ability to fool state-of-the-art models with a 1 pixel translation to less than 5% while suffering from only a 1% drop in classification accuracy. Additionally, we show that our method can be easily adjusted to deal with circular shifts as well. In such a case we achieve 100% robustness to integer shifts with state-of-the-art accuracy, and with no need for any further training. Code is available at: https://github.com/ofirshifman/RICS.

title: Olga Zatsarynna*, Emad Bahrami*, Yazan Abu Farha, Gianpiero Francesca, Jürgen Gall*
title_en: Olga Zatsarynna*, Emad Bahrami*, Yazan Abu Farha, Gianpiero Francesca, Jürgen Gall*
abstract: 长期动作预测已成为自动驾驶和人机交互等许多应用中的重要任务。与短期预测不同,预测更长时间范围内的动作在不确定性随时间范围增加的情况下提出了更大的挑战。尽管在预测更长时间范围内的动作方面取得了显著进展,但大多数提出的方法都在确定性设置下处理该任务,并忽略了潜在的不确定性。在本文中,我们提出了一种新颖的门控时间扩散(GTD)网络,该网络建模了观测和未来预测的不确定性。作为生成器,我们引入了一种门控预测网络(GTAN),以互表征的方式建模视频中的已观测帧和未观测帧。一方面,使用互表征对过去和未来进行建模,使我们能够联合建模观测和未来的模糊性;另一方面,GTAN可以通过设计对已观测和未观测部分进行差异化处理,并引导它们之间的信息流动。我们的模型在Breakfast、Assembly101和50Salads数据集上实现了随机和确定性设置下的最先进结果。
abstract_en: Long-term action anticipation has become an important task for many applications such as autonomous driving and human-robot interaction. Unlike short-term anticipation, predicting more actions into the future imposes a real challenge with the increasing uncertainty in longer horizons. While there has been a significant progress in predicting more actions into the future, most of the proposed methods address the task in a deterministic setup and ignore the underlying uncertainty. In this paper, we propose a novel Gated Temporal Diffusion (GTD) network that models the uncertainty of both the observation and the future predictions. As generator, we introduce a Gated Anticipation Network (GTAN) to model both observed and unobserved frames of a video in a mutual representation. On the one hand, using a mutual representation for past and future allows us to jointly model ambiguities in the observation and future, while on the other hand GTAN can by design treat the observed and unobserved parts differently and steer the information flow between them. Our model achieves state-of-the-art results on the Breakfast, Assembly101 and 50Salads datasets in both stochastic and deterministic settings.

title: Omar Ghezzi*, Giuseppe Boccignone, Giuliano Grossi, Raffaella Lanzarotti, Alessandro D'Amelio
title_en: Omar Ghezzi*, Giuseppe Boccignone, Giuliano Grossi, Raffaella Lanzarotti, Alessandro D'Amelio
abstract: 本文介绍了CliffPhys,这是一个利用超复数神经架构进行基于摄像头的呼吸测量的模型家族。所提出的方法从标准RGB摄像头中提取呼吸运动,依赖于光流和单目深度估计分别获得二维向量场和标量场。我们展示了采用Clifford神经层建模恢复输入场中的几何关系如何有效估计呼吸信息。在三个公开数据集上的实验结果表明,CliffPhys在呼吸率预测方面相比基线和近期神经方法表现出优越性能,取得了最先进的成果。源代码可在:https: //github.com/phuselab/CliffPhys 获取。
abstract_en: This paper presents CliffPhys, a family of models that leverage hypercomplex neural architectures for camera-based respiratory measurement. The proposed approach extracts respiratory motion from standard RGB cameras, relying on optical flow and monocular depth estimation to obtain a 2D vector field and a scalar field, respectively. We show how the adoption of Clifford Neural Layers to model the geometric relationships within the recovered input fields allows respiratory information to be effectively estimated. Experimental results on three publicly available datasets demonstrate CliffPhys’ superior performance compared to both baselines and recent neural approaches, achieving state-of-the-art results in the prediction of respiratory rates. Source code available at: https: //github.com/phuselab/CliffPhys.

title: Omer Dahary*, Or Patashnik, Kfir Aberman, Danny Cohen-Or
title_en: Omer Dahary*, Or Patashnik, Kfir Aberman, Danny Cohen-Or
abstract: 文本到图像扩散模型具有生成多样且高质量图像的非凡能力。然而,它们常常难以忠实地捕捉包含多个主体的复杂输入提示的预期语义。最近,众多布局到图像的扩展方法被引入以提升用户控制能力,旨在定位由特定标记表示的主体。然而,这些方法在处理多个语义或视觉相似主体时,往往生成语义不准确的图像。在本工作中,我们研究并分析了这些限制的原因。我们的探索揭示了主要问题源于去噪过程中主体之间的无意语义泄漏。这种泄漏归因于扩散模型的注意力层,其倾向于混合不同主体的视觉特征。为了解决这些问题,我们引入了Bounded Attention,这是一种无需训练的方法,用于在采样过程中限制信息流。Bounded Attention可防止主体间的有害泄漏,并能够引导生成过程以促进每个主体的独特性,即使在复杂的多主体条件下也能实现。通过广泛的实验,我们证明了我们的方法能够生成更符合给定提示和布局的多个主体图像。
abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models have an unprecedented ability to generate diverse and high-quality images. However, they often struggle to faithfully capture the intended semantics of complex input prompts that include multiple subjects. Recently, numerous layout-to-image extensions have been introduced to improve user control, aiming to localize subjects represented by specific tokens. Yet, these methods often produce semantically inaccurate images, especially when dealing with multiple semantically or visually similar subjects.
