In this work, we study and analyze the causes of these limitations. Our exploration reveals that the primary issue stems from inadvertent semantic leakage between subjects in the denoising process. This leakage is attributed to the diffusion model’s attention layers, which tend to blend the visual features of different subjects. To address these issues, we introduce Bounded Attention, a training-free method for bounding the information flow in the sampling process. Bounded Attention prevents detrimental leakage among subjects and enables guiding the generation to promote each subject’s individuality, even with complex multi-subject conditioning. Through extensive experimentation, we demonstrate that our method empowers the generation of multiple subjects that better align with given prompts and layouts.

title: Opher Bar Nathan*, Deborah Levy, Tali Treibitz, Dan Rosenbaum
title_en: Opher Bar Nathan*, Deborah Levy, Tali Treibitz, Dan Rosenbaum
abstract: 水下图像恢复是一项具有挑战性的任务,因为水的影响会随着距离的增加而显著增强。这进一步受到缺乏无水清洁场景真实数据的限制。扩散先验已作为强大的图像恢复先验方法出现。然而,它们通常需要使用目标恢复输出的数据集进行训练,而这种情况在我们的案例中并不可用。我们还观察到,仅使用颜色数据是不够的,因此通过添加深度通道来增强先验。我们使用标准的RGBD数据集,在空气中的自然户外场景的联合空间上训练一个无条件扩散模型先验。结合基于水下图像形成模型的新型引导方法,我们生成清洁图像的后验样本,从而去除水的影响。尽管我们的先验在训练过程中并未接触任何水下图像,但我们的方法在极具挑战性的场景中仍优于最先进的图像恢复基线方法。我们的代码、模型和数据可在项目网站上获取。
abstract_en: Underwater image restoration is a challenging task because of water effects that increase dramatically with distance. This is worsened by lack of ground truth data of clean scenes without water. Diffusion priors have emerged as strong image restoration priors. However, they are often trained with a dataset of the desired restored output, which is not available in our case. We also observe that using only color data is insufficient, and therefore augment the prior with a depth channel. We train an unconditional diffusion model prior on the joint space of color and depth, using standard RGBD datasets of natural outdoor scenes in air. Using this prior together with a novel guidance method based on the underwater image formation model, we generate posterior samples of clean images, removing the water effects. Even though our prior did not see any underwater images during training, our method outperforms state-of-the-art baselines for image restoration on very challenging scenes. Our code, models and data are available on the project’s website.

title: Or Hirschorn*, Shai Avidan
title_en: Or Hirschorn*, Shai Avidan
abstract: 传统二维姿态估计模型受限于其类别特定设计,仅适用于预定义的对象类别。当处理新型物体时,由于缺乏相关训练数据,这种限制变得尤为具有挑战性。为解决这一局限性,引入了无类别姿态估计(CAPE)。CAPE旨在利用少量样本单模型对任意对象类别进行关键点定位,仅需少量带有标注关键点的支持图像。我们提出了与传统CAPE技术的重大突破,传统方法将关键点视为孤立实体,而我们将输入姿态数据视为图结构。通过基于图的网络利用关键点之间的固有几何关系,打破对称性,保持结构完整性,并更好地处理遮挡问题。我们在包含超过20,000张图像、涵盖超过100个类别的MP-100基准数据集上验证了我们的方法。在1-shot设置下,我们的方案性能提升0.98%,实现了CAPE的新SOTA。此外,我们对数据集进行了骨架标注增强。我们的代码和数据已公开。
abstract_en: Traditional 2D pose estimation models are limited by their category-specific design, making them suitable only for predefined object categories. This restriction becomes particularly challenging when dealing with novel objects due to the lack of relevant training data. To address this limitation, category-agnostic pose estimation (CAPE) was introduced. CAPE aims to enable keypoint localization for arbitrary object categories using a few-shot single model, requiring minimal support images with annotated keypoints. We present a significant departure from conventional CAPE techniques, which treat keypoints as isolated entities, by treating the input pose data as a graph. We leverage the inherent geometrical relations between keypoints through a graph-based network to break symmetry, preserve structure, and better handle occlusions. We validate our approach on the MP-100 benchmark, a comprehensive dataset comprising over 20,000 images spanning over 100 categories. Our solution boosts performance by 0.98% under a 1-shot setting, achieving a new state-of-the-art for CAPE. Additionally, we enhance the dataset with skeleton annotations. Our code and data are publicly available.

title: 作者列表:Orcun Cetintas*, Tim Meinhardt, Guillem Brasó, Laura Leal-Taixé
title_en: Orcun Cetintas*, Tim Meinhardt, Guillem Brasó, Laura Leal-Taixé
abstract: 提高视频轨迹标注的标注效率,有望使下一代数据需求量大的跟踪算法在大规模数据集上蓬勃发展。尽管这一任务的重要性,目前探索如何高效全面标注跟踪数据集的工作却非常有限。在本文中,我们引入了SPAM,这是一个视频标注引擎,能够以最小的人工干预提供高质量的标注。SPAM的构建基于两个关键洞察:i)大多数跟踪场景可以轻松解决。为了利用这一点,我们使用预训练模型生成高质量的伪标签,仅保留人工参与处理更困难的实例子集;ii)处理轨迹标注在时间上的时空依赖性可以通过图结构优雅且高效地建模。因此,我们采用统一的图表示方法来解决轨迹在时间上的检测和身份关联标注问题。基于这些洞察,SPAM以低于真实标注成本的分数生成高质量标注。我们证明,使用SPAM标签训练的跟踪器在性能上与使用人工标注训练的跟踪器相当,同时仅需3−20%的人工标注工作量。因此,SPAM为大规模跟踪数据集的高效标注铺平了道路。我们发布了所有模型和代码。
abstract_en: Increasing the annotation efficiency of trajectory annotations from videos has the potential to enable the next generation of data-hungry tracking algorithms to thrive on large-scale datasets. Despite the importance of this task, there are currently very few works exploring how to efficiently label tracking datasets comprehensively. In this work, we introduce SPAM, a video label engine that provides high-quality labels with minimal human intervention. SPAM is built around two key insights: i) most tracking scenarios can be easily resolved. To take advantage of this, we utilize a pre-trained model to generate high-quality pseudo-labels, reserving human involvement for a smaller subset of more difficult instances; ii) handling the spatiotemporal dependencies of track annotations across time can be elegantly and efficiently formulated through graphs. Therefore, we use a unified graph formulation to address the annotation of both detections and identity association for tracks across time. Based on these insights, SPAM produces high-quality annotations with a fraction of ground truth labeling cost. We demonstrate that trackers trained on SPAM labels achieve comparable performance to those trained on human annotations while requiring only 3−20% of the human labeling effort. Hence, SPAM paves the way towards highly efficient labeling of large-scale tracking datasets. We release all models and code.

title: Orest Kupyn*, Christian Rupprecht
title_en: Orest Kupyn*, Christian Rupprecht
abstract: 我们提出了一种通过结合预训练潜在扩散模型的广泛分布知识来扩展数据集的方法。数据增强通常将关于图像形成过程的归纳偏见引入训练(例如平移、缩放、颜色变化等)。在此,我们超越了简单的像素变换,引入了在对象实例层面重新绘制图像部分的实例级数据增强概念。该方法结合条件扩散模型与深度和边缘图控制条件,能够无缝地在场景中重新绘制单个对象,适用于任何分割或检测数据集。作为数据增强方法,它提升了最先进的显著物体检测、语义分割和目标检测模型的性能与泛化能力。通过重新绘制所有隐私敏感实例(如人物、车牌等),该方法也适用于数据匿名化。我们还发布了COCO、Pascal VOC和DUTS等流行数据集的完全合成与匿名化扩展。项目页面详见此处。
abstract_en: We present a method for expanding a dataset by incorporating knowledge from the wide distribution of pre-trained latent diffusion models. Data augmentations typically incorporate inductive biases about the image formation process into the training (e.g. translation, scaling, colour changes, etc.). Here, we go beyond simple pixel transformations and introduce the concept of instance-level data augmentation by repainting parts of the image at the level of object instances. The method combines a conditional diffusion model with depth and edge maps control conditioning to seamlessly repaint individual objects inside the scene, being applicable to any segmentation or detection dataset. Used as a data augmentation method, it improves the performance and generalization of the state-of-the-art salient object detection, semantic segmentation and object detection models. By redrawing all privacy-sensitive instances (people, license plates, etc.), the method is also applicable for data anonymization. We also release fully synthetic and anonymized expansions for popular datasets: COCO, Pascal VOC and DUTS. The project page is available here.

title: Oscar Skean*, Aayush Dhakal, Nathan Jacobs, Luis G Sanchez Giraldo
title_en: Oscar Skean*, Aayush Dhakal, Nathan Jacobs, Luis G Sanchez Giraldo
abstract: 自监督学习(SSL)是表征学习的流行范式。近期的多视角方法可分为样本对比、维度对比或非对称网络类,每类方法都有其避免信息坍缩的特定策略。尽管这些方法收敛到相似质量的解,但实证研究表明某些方法存在训练周期效率低下问题,需要更长时间才能达到目标性能。提升效率的两种主要方法是协方差特征值正则化和使用更多视角。然而,由于计算特征值的计算复杂度,这两种方法难以结合。我们提出目标函数FroSSL,该方法在完全避免特征值分解的同时融合了这两种方法。FroSSL通过最小化协方差Frobenius范数来避免坍缩,并通过最小化均方误差实现增强不变性。我们证明FroSSL比其他任何SSL方法都更快达到竞争性精度,并提供理论和实证支持,表明这种更快收敛性源于FroSSL对嵌入协方差矩阵特征值的影响。此外,我们还展示当使用FroSSL在STL-10、Tiny Imagenet和Imagenet-100等数据集上训练ResNet18时,在线性探针评估中能够学习到具有竞争力的表征。Github
abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is a popular paradigm for representation learning. Recent multiview methods can be classified as sample-contrastive, dimension-contrastive, or asymmetric network-based, with each family having its own approach to avoiding informational collapse. While these families converge to solutions of similar quality, it can be empirically shown that some methods are epoch-inefficient and require longer training to reach a target performance. Two main approaches to improving efficiency are covariance eigenvalue regularization and using more views. However, these two approaches are difficult to combine due to the computational complexity of computing eigenvalues. We present the objective function FroSSL which reconciles both approaches while avoiding eigendecomposition entirely. FroSSL works by minimizing covariance Frobenius norms to avoid collapse and minimizing mean-squared error to achieve augmentation invariance. We show that FroSSL reaches competitive accuracies more quickly than any other SSL method and provide theoretical and empirical support that this faster convergence is due to how FroSSL affects the eigenvalues of the embedding covariance matrices. We also show that FroSSL learns competitive representations on linear probe evaluation when used to train a ResNet18 on several datasets, including STL-10, Tiny Imagenet, and Imagenet-100. Github

title: Otto Seiskari*, Jerry Ylilammi, Valtteri Kaatrasalo, Pekka Rantalankila, Matias Turkulainen, Juho Kannala, Esa Rahtu, Arno Solin
title_en: Otto Seiskari*, Jerry Ylilammi, Valtteri Kaatrasalo, Pekka Rantalankila, Matias Turkulainen, Juho Kannala, Esa Rahtu, Arno Solin
abstract: 基于高斯点云(3DGS)的高质量场景重建和新视角合成通常需要稳定、高质量的静态照片,而使用手持相机拍摄往往难以实现。我们提出了一种方法,能够适应相机运动,并利用手持视频数据(包含运动模糊和滚动快门畸变)实现高质量场景重建。我们的方法基于对物理成像过程的详细建模,并利用视觉惯性里程计(VIO)估计的运动速度。在单张图像帧的曝光时间内,相机姿态被视为非静态,并在重建过程中进一步优化相机姿态。我们构建了一个可微渲染流水线,通过屏幕空间近似高效地将滚动快门和运动模糊效应整合到3DGS框架中。实验结果表明,与现有方法相比,我们的方法在抑制相机运动方面表现出更优性能,从而推动了3DGS在自然场景中的应用。
abstract_en: High-quality scene reconstruction and novel view synthesis based on Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) typically require steady, high-quality photographs, often impractical to capture with handheld cameras. We present a method that adapts to camera motion and allows high-quality scene reconstruction with handheld video data suffering from motion blur and rolling shutter distortion. Our approach is based on detailed modelling of the physical image formation process and utilizes velocities estimated using visual-inertial odometry (VIO). Camera poses are considered non-static during the exposure time of a single image frame and camera poses are further optimized in the reconstruction process. We formulate a differentiable rendering pipeline that leverages screen space approximation to efficiently incorporate rolling-shutter and motion blur effects into the 3DGS framework. Our results with both synthetic and real data demonstrate superior performance in mitigating camera motion over existing methods, thereby advancing 3DGS in naturalistic settings.

title: Ozan Unal*, Christos Sakaridis, Luc Van Gool
title_en: Ozan Unal*, Christos Sakaridis, Luc Van Gool
abstract: 三维分割是计算机视觉中的核心问题,与许多其他密集预测任务类似,它需要大量标注数据进行充分训练。然而,对三维点云进行密集标注以实现全监督训练仍然过于劳动密集且成本高昂。半监督训练提供了一个更实用的替代方案,其中仅提供少量标注数据,并辅以更大的未标注数据集。因此,该领域研究如何有效利用未标注数据,以减少因缺乏标注而产生的性能差距。在本工作中,受贝叶斯深度学习启发,我们首先提出了一种贝叶斯自训练框架,用于半监督三维语义分割。通过随机推断生成初始伪标签集,并基于估计的点级不确定性进行过滤。通过构建启发式的n部分匹配算法,我们将该方法扩展到半监督三维实例分割,最终使用相同的构建模块扩展到密集三维视觉定位。我们在SemanticKITTI和ScribbleKITTI数据集上展示了三维语义分割的最先进结果,在ScanNet和S3DIS数据集上展示了三维实例分割的最先进结果。我们在ScanRefer数据集上进一步实现了密集三维视觉定位相比纯监督基线的显著提升。我们的项目页面可在ouenal.github.io/bst/访问。
abstract_en: 3D segmentation is a core problem in computer vision and, similarly to many other dense prediction tasks, it requires large amounts of annotated data for adequate training. However, densely labeling 3D point clouds to employ fully-supervised training remains too labor intensive and expensive. Semi-supervised training provides a more practical alternative, where only a small set of labeled data is given, accompanied by a larger unlabeled set. This area thus studies the effective use of unlabeled data to reduce the performance gap that arises due to the lack of annotations. In this work, inspired by Bayesian deep learning, we first propose a Bayesian self-training framework for semi-supervised 3D semantic segmentation. Employing stochastic inference, we generate an initial set of pseudo-labels and then filter these based on estimated point-wise uncertainty. By constructing a heuristic n-partite matching algorithm, we extend the method to semi-supervised 3D instance segmentation, and finally, with the same building blocks, to dense 3D visual grounding. We demonstrate state-of-the-art results for our semi-supervised method on SemanticKITTI and ScribbleKITTI for 3D semantic segmentation and on ScanNet and S3DIS for 3D instance segmentation. We further achieve substantial improvements in dense 3D visual grounding over supervised-only baselines on ScanRefer. Our project page is available at ouenal.github.io/bst/.

title: Ozan Unal*, Christos Sakaridis, Suman Saha, Luc Van Gool
title_en: Ozan Unal*, Christos Sakaridis, Suman Saha, Luc Van Gool
abstract: 三维视觉接地任务是指在三维场景中定位由自然语言描述所指代的对象。该任务因其在自主室内机器人、AR/VR等广泛领域的应用而近年来受到越来越多的关注。一种常见的处理三维视觉接地的方法是基于检测的接地(grounding-by-detection),通过边界框实现定位。然而,对于需要物理交互的真实应用场景,边界框不足以描述物体的几何特性。因此,我们研究了密集三维视觉接地问题,即基于引用的三维实例分割。我们提出了一种密集三维接地网络ConcreteNet,包含四个新颖的独立模块,旨在提升对具有同类语义干扰物的挑战性重复实例的接地性能。首先,我们引入了自下而上的注意力融合模块以消除实例间关系线索的歧义;其次,构建对比训练方案以在潜在空间中实现分离;随后,通过学习的全局相机标记解决视角依赖的描述;最后,采用多视角集成以提升引用掩码的质量。ConcreteNet在具有挑战性的ScanRefer在线基准测试中排名第一,并在ICCV 3D场景语言“三维物体定位”挑战赛中获得冠军。我们的代码可在ouenal.github.io/concretenet/获取。
abstract_en: 3D visual grounding is the task of localizing the object in a 3D scene which is referred by a description in natural language. With a wide range of applications ranging from autonomous indoor robotics to AR/VR, the task has recently risen in popularity. A common formulation to tackle 3D visual grounding is grounding-by-detection, where localization is done via bounding boxes. However, for real-life applications that require physical interactions, a bounding box insufficiently describes the geometry of an object. We therefore tackle the problem of dense 3D visual grounding, i.e. referral-based 3D instance segmentation. We propose a dense 3D grounding network ConcreteNet, featuring four novel stand-alone modules that aim to improve grounding performance for challenging repetitive instances, i.e. instances with distractors of the same semantic class. First, we introduce a bottom-up attentive fusion module that aims to disambiguate inter-instance relational cues, next, we construct a contrastive training scheme to induce separation in the latent space, we then resolve view-dependent utterances via a learned global camera token, and finally we employ multi-view ensembling to improve referred mask quality. ConcreteNet ranks 1st on the challenging ScanRefer online benchmark and has won the ICCV 3rd Workshop on Language for 3D Scenes “3D Object Localization” challenge. Our code is available at ouenal.github.io/concretenet/.

title: Oğuzhan Fatih Kar*, Alessio Tonioni*, Petra Poklukar, Achin Kulshrestha, Amir Zamir, Federico Tombari
title_en: Oğuzhan Fatih Kar*, Alessio Tonioni*, Petra Poklukar, Achin Kulshrestha, Amir Zamir, Federico Tombari
abstract: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)通常由视觉编码器(例如CLIP)和语言模型(LM)组成,后者解释编码后的特征以解决下游任务。尽管取得了显著进展,但由于视觉编码器能力的限制,VLMs仍存在一些缺陷,例如对某些图像特征的“盲视”、视觉幻觉等。为了解决这些问题,我们研究了扩展VLMs的视觉编码能力。我们首先全面评估了具有不同归纳偏置的几种视觉编码器,以解决VLM任务。我们观察到,没有一种编码配置能在不同任务中始终取得最佳性能,且具有不同偏置的编码器在性能上可以出人意料地相似。受此启发,我们引入了一种方法,名为,该方法将多个冻结编码器的特征整合到一个更通用的表示中,可以直接作为冻结LM的输入。在广泛的图像描述和VQA基准测试中,该方法实现了最先进的性能,并显著减少了VLMs的上述问题,同时所需的可训练参数比现有方法更少,且具有更压缩的表示。我们的结果突显了将不同视觉偏置结合的潜力,以实现更广泛和语境化的视觉理解。
abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are typically composed of a vision encoder, e.g. CLIP, and a language model (LM) that interprets the encoded features to solve downstream tasks. Despite remarkable progress, VLMs are subject to several shortcomings due to the limited capabilities of vision encoders, e.g. “blindness” to certain image features, visual hallucination, etc. To address these issues, we study broadening the visual encoding capabilities of VLMs. We first comprehensively benchmark several vision encoders with different inductive biases for solving VLM tasks. We observe that there is no single encoding configuration that consistently achieves top performance across different tasks, and encoders with different biases can perform surprisingly similarly. Motivated by this, we introduce a method, named , that consolidates features from multiple frozen encoders into a more versatile representation that can be directly fed as the input to a frozen LM. achieves state-of-the-art performance on a broad range of captioning and VQA benchmarks and significantly reduces the aforementioned issues of VLMs, while requiring a smaller number of trainable parameters than existing methods and having a more compressed representation. Our results highlight the potential of incorporating different visual biases for a more broad and contextualized visual understanding of VLMs.

title: PENG LIAO*, 王希路*, 金耀初*, 杜文莉*
title_en: PENG LIAO*, Xilu Wang*, Yaochu Jin*, Wenli Du*
abstract: 在多种设备上部署模型需要在多个目标之间进行权衡,由于不同的资源限制。显然,基于超网络的多目标神经网络架构搜索(MO-NAS)存在小模型陷阱问题,现有方法可能无法维持大型模型。此外,多任务神经网络架构搜索(MT-NAS)在同时处理多个任务方面表现出色,但大多数现有研究集中在来自同一数据集的任务上,限制了其在现实场景中的实用性,因为多个任务可能来自不同的数据集。为解决上述挑战,我们提出了一种用于神经网络架构搜索(NAS)的多目标进化多任务框架(MO-EMT-NAS),以实现跨不同数据集任务的架构知识迁移,同时寻找多目标、模型准确性和计算效率的帕累托最优架构。为缓解小模型陷阱问题,我们引入了一个辅助目标,帮助维持多个具有相似准确性的较大模型。此外,通过并行化基于权重共享的超网络的训练和验证,进一步提升了计算效率。在包含两个、三个和四个任务组合的七个数据集上的实验结果表明,与最先进的单目标MT-NAS算法相比,MO-EMT-NAS在最小分类误差方面表现更优,同时能够提供模型性能与复杂度之间的灵活权衡。与相应的多目标单任务方法相比,MO-EMT-NAS的运行时间减少了59.7%至77.7%。
abstract_en: Deploying models across diverse devices demands tradeoffs among multiple objectives due to different resource constraints. Arguably, due to the small model trap problem in multi-objective neural architecture search (MO-NAS) based on a supernet, existing approaches may fail to maintain large models. Moreover, multi-tasking neural architecture search (MT-NAS) excels in handling multiple tasks simultaneously, but most existing efforts focus on tasks from the same dataset, limiting their practicality in real-world scenarios where multiple tasks may come from distinct datasets. To tackle the above challenges, we propose a Multi-Objective Evolutionary Multi-Tasking framework for NAS (MO-EMT-NAS) to achieve architectural knowledge transfer across tasks from different datasets while finding Pareto optimal architectures for multi-objectives, model accuracy and computational efficiency. To alleviate the small model trap issue, we introduce an auxiliary objective that helps maintain multiple larger models of similar accuracy. Moreover, the computational efficiency is further enhanced by parallelizing the training and validation of the weight-sharing-based supernet. Experimental results on seven datasets with two, three, and four task combinations show that MO-EMT-NAS achieves a better minimum classification error while being able to offer flexible trade-offs between model performance and complexity, compared to the state-of-the-art single-objective MT-NAS algorithms. The runtime of MO-EMT-NAS is reduced by 59.7% to 77.7%, compared to the corresponding multi-objective single-task approaches.

title: Panjian Huang, Yunjie Peng, Saihui Hou*, Chunshui Cao, Xu Liu, Zhiqiang He, Yongzhen Huang*
title_en: Panjian Huang, Yunjie Peng, Saihui Hou*, Chunshui Cao, Xu Liu, Zhiqiang He, Yongzhen Huang*
abstract: 现实场景中的广泛遮挡由于缺失和噪声信息以及位置和尺度上的身体错位,对步态识别提出了挑战。我们认为,步态序列中丰富的动态上下文信息本质上具有解决遮挡的特性:1)具有步态连续性的相邻帧允许整体身体区域推断遮挡的身体区域;2)步态周期允许整体动作与遮挡动作之间的信息整合。因此,我们引入了一种动作检测视角,将步态序列视为动作的组合。为在复杂遮挡场景下检测准确的动作,我们提出了一种基于动作检测的专家混合模型(GaitMoE),包含时间专家混合(MTE)和动作专家混合(MAE)。MTE通过时间专家自适应构建动作锚点,MAE通过动作专家自适应从动作锚点构建动作提案。特别地,将动作检测作为步态识别的代理任务,仅使用ID标签进行端到端联合训练。此外,由于缺乏统一的遮挡基准数据集,我们构建了一个开创性的遮挡步态数据库(OccGait),包含丰富的遮挡场景和遮挡类型标注。在OccGait、OccCASIA-B、Gait3D和GREW数据集上的大量实验验证了GaitMoE的优越性能。OccGait数据集可在https://github.com/BNU-IVC/OccGait获取。
abstract_en: Extensive occlusions in real-world scenarios pose challenges to gait recognition due to missing and noisy information, as well as body misalignment in position and scale. We argue that rich dynamic contextual information within a gait sequence inherently possesses occlusion-solving traits: 1) Adjacent frames with gait continuity allow holistic body regions to infer occluded body regions; 2) Gait cycles allow information integration between holistic actions and occluded actions. Therefore, we introduce an action detection perspective where a gait sequence is regarded as a composition of actions. To detect accurate actions under complex occlusion scenarios, we propose an Action Detection Based Mixture of Experts (GaitMoE), consisting of Mixture of Temporal Experts (MTE) and Mixture of Action Experts (MAE). MTE adaptively constructs action anchors by temporal experts and MAE adaptively constructs action proposals from action anchors by action experts. Especially, action detection as a proxy task with gait recognition is an end-to-end joint training only with ID labels. In addition, due to the lack of a unified occluded benchmark, we construct a pioneering Occluded Gait database (OccGait), containing rich occlusion scenarios and annotations of occlusion types. Extensive experiments on OccGait, OccCASIA-B, Gait3D and GREW demonstrate the superior performance of GaitMoE. OccGait is available at https://github.com/BNU-IVC/OccGait.

title: Parth Parag Kulkarni*, Gaurav Kumar Nayak, Mubarak Shah
title_en: Parth Parag Kulkarni*, Gaurav Kumar Nayak, Mubarak Shah
abstract: 视频地理定位是当前时代的关键问题。仅给定一个视频,确定其拍摄位置可以带来诸多优势。全球地理定位问题之前已有研究,但仅使用图像模态。其视频版本仍相对未被充分探索。同时,视频地理定位也逐渐受到关注,但现有方法均局限于特定区域。这促使我们探索全球范围的视频地理定位问题。因此,我们提出了一种新的全球视频地理定位问题,目标是根据视频依次预测正确的城市、州/省、国家和大洲。然而,目前尚无大规模的视频数据集具有广泛的全球覆盖,以训练解决该问题的模型。为此,我们引入了一个新的数据集“CityGuessr68k”,包含来自全球166个城市的68,269个视频。我们还提出了一种新的基线方法,设计了一个基于Transformer的架构,包含一个优雅的“自交叉注意力”模块以融合场景信息,以及一种“文本标签对齐”策略以在特征空间中从文本标签中蒸馏知识。为了进一步提升我们的位置预测,我们还利用了软场景标签。最后,我们在新数据集以及Mapillary(MSLS)[?]上展示了我们方法的性能。我们的代码和数据集可在以下链接获取。
abstract_en: Video geolocalization is a crucial problem in current times. Given just a video, ascertaining where it was captured from can have a plethora of advantages. The problem of worldwide geolocalization has been tackled before, but only using the image modality. Its video counterpart remains relatively unexplored. Meanwhile, video geolocalization has also garnered some attention in the recent past, but the existing methods are all restricted to specific regions. This motivates us to explore the problem of video geolocalization at a global scale. Hence, we propose a novel problem of worldwide video geolocalization with the objective of hierarchically predicting the correct city, state/province, country, and continent, given a video. However, no large scale video datasets that have extensive worldwide coverage exist, to train models for solving this problem. To this end, we introduce a new dataset, “CityGuessr68k ” comprising of 68,269 videos from 166 cities all over the world. We also propose a novel baseline approach to this problem, by designing a transformer-based architecture comprising of an elegant “Self-Cross Attention” module for incorporating scenes as well as a “TextLabel Alignment” strategy for distilling knowledge from textlabels in feature space. To further enhance our location prediction, we also utilize soft-scene labels. Finally we demonstrate the performance of our method on our new dataset as well as Mapillary(MSLS)[?]. Our code and datasets are available here.

title: Patrick M Jensen, Vedrana A Dahl, Rebecca Engberg, Carsten Gundlach, Hans Martin Kjer, Anders B Dahl*
title_en: Patrick M Jensen, Vedrana A Dahl, Rebecca Engberg, Carsten Gundlach, Hans Martin Kjer, Anders B Dahl*
abstract: 领域迁移显著影响深度学习算法的性能,尤其是在体积3D图像中的目标检测任务中。标注的训练数据对于基于深度学习的目标检测至关重要。然而,对密集排列物体进行标注既耗时又昂贵。为此,我们建议在单个扫描物体上训练模型,从而在训练数据与检测数据之间产生领域迁移。为解决这一挑战,我们引入了一个数据集,包含12种虫类类型的9154个微CT体积和388个紧密排列虫类混合体积。该数据集的特点是源域和目标域中具有相同外观的物体,这在其他用于领域迁移的基准数据集中较为罕见。训练过程中使用按类别标记的单个虫类体积,而测试阶段则采用带有中心点标注和虫类类型标签的混合物。与数据集一同提供的还有基准检测分析,旨在推动三维目标检测方法的发展。
abstract_en: Domain shift significantly influences the performance of deep learning algorithms, particularly for object detection within volumetric 3D images. Annotated training data is essential for deep learning-based object detection. However, annotating densely packed objects is time-consuming and costly. Instead, we suggest training models on individually scanned objects, causing a domain shift between training and detection data. To address this challenge, we introduce the dataset, comprising 9154 micro-CT volumes of 12 bug types and 388 volumes of tightly packed bug mixtures. This dataset is characterized by having objects with the same appearance in the source and target domains, which is uncommon for other benchmark datasets for domain shift. During training, individual bug volumes labeled by class are utilized, while testing employs mixtures with center point annotations and bug type labels. Together with the dataset, we provide a baseline detection analysis, with the aim of advancing the field of 3D object detection methods.

title: Patrick Palmer*, Martin Krüger, Stefan Schütte, Richard Altendorfer, Ganesh Adam, Torsten Bertram
title_en: Patrick Palmer*, Martin Krüger, Stefan Schütte, Richard Altendorfer, Ganesh Adam, Torsten Bertram
abstract: 准确的三维物体检测对于自动驾驶至关重要。虽然激光雷达传感器适合该任务,但其成本高昂且在恶劣天气条件下存在局限性。3+1D成像雷达传感器提供了一种成本效益高且鲁棒的替代方案,但由于其低分辨率和高测量噪声而面临挑战。现有的3+1D成像雷达数据集包含雷达和激光雷达数据,能够实现跨模态模型改进。尽管在推理过程中不应使用激光雷达,但其可辅助仅使用雷达的物体检测器的训练。我们探索了两种从激光雷达向雷达域及仅雷达物体检测器迁移知识的策略:1. 采用顺序激光雷达点云稀疏化的多阶段训练;2. 跨模态知识蒸馏。在多阶段过程中,考察了三种稀疏化方法。我们的结果表明,通过多阶段训练,平均精度均值(mAP)性能提升了最高4.2个百分点;通过知识蒸馏,以教师模型权重初始化学生模型,mAP性能提升了最高3.9个百分点。这些方法的主要优势在于其可适用于其他三维物体检测网络,无需修改其架构,如我们在两个不同物体检测器上的分析所示。我们的代码可在https://github.com/rst-tu-dortmund/lerojd获取。
abstract_en: Accurate 3D object detection is vital for automated driving. While lidar sensors are well suited for this task, they are expensive and have limitations in adverse weather conditions. 3+1D imaging radar sensors offer a cost-effective, robust alternative but face challenges due to their low resolution and high measurement noise. Existing 3+1D imaging radar datasets include radar and lidar data, enabling cross-modal model improvements. Although lidar should not be used during inference, it can aid the training of radar-only object detectors. We explore two strategies to transfer knowledge from the lidar to the radar domain and radar-only object detectors: 1. multi-stage training with sequential lidar point cloud thin-out, and 2. cross-modal knowledge distillation. In the multi-stage process, three thin-out methods are examined. Our results show significant performance gains of up to 4.2 percentage points in mean Average Precision with multi-stage training and up to 3.9 percentage points with knowledge distillation by initializing the student with the teacher’s weights. The main benefit of these approaches is their applicability to other 3D object detection networks without altering their architecture, as we show by analyzing it on two different object detectors. Our code is available at https://github.com/ rst-tu-dortmund/lerojd.

title: Pau de Jorge Aranda*, Riccardo Volpi, Puneet Dokania, Philip Torr, Gregory Rogez
title_en: Pau de Jorge Aranda*, Riccardo Volpi, Puneet Dokania, Philip Torr, Gregory Rogez
abstract: 当将语义分割模型部署到现实世界时,它不可避免地会遇到训练期间未见过的语义类别。为确保此类系统的安全部署,准确评估和提升其异常分割能力至关重要。然而,获取和标注语义分割数据成本高昂,且未预料到的条件具有长尾分布且潜在危险。事实上,现有异常分割数据集仅捕获有限数量的异常,缺乏真实感或存在显著领域偏移。本文提出了一种名为“将物体置于上下文中的(POC)”流程,通过扩散模型可以真实地将任何物体添加到任何图像中。POC可用于轻松扩展任何数据集,添加任意数量的物体。在实验中,我们基于POC生成的数据提出了不同的异常分割数据集,并展示了POC能够提升最近最先进的异常微调方法在多个标准化基准测试中的性能。POC在学习新类别方面也有效。例如,我们利用它通过引入Pascal类别子集来增强Cityscapes样本,并证明在这些数据上训练的模型性能与Pascal训练基线相当。这证实了在POC生成图像上训练的模型具有较低的合成到真实世界的差距。代码:https://github.com/naver/poc
abstract_en: When deploying a semantic segmentation model into the real world, it will inevitably encounter semantic classes that were not seen during training. To ensure a safe deployment of such systems, it is crucial to accurately evaluate and improve their anomaly segmentation capabilities. However, acquiring and labelling semantic segmentation data is expensive and unanticipated conditions are long-tail and potentially hazardous. Indeed, existing anomaly segmentation datasets capture a limited number of anomalies, lack realism or have strong domain shifts. In this paper, we propose the Placing Objects in Context (POC) pipeline to realistically add any object into any image via diffusion models. POC can be used to easily extend any dataset with an arbitrary number of objects. In our experiments, we present different anomaly segmentation datasets based on POC-generated data and show that POC can improve the performance of recent state-of-the-art anomaly fine-tuning methods across several standardized benchmarks. POC is also effective for learning new classes. For example, we utilize it to augment Cityscapes samples by incorporating a subset of Pascal classes and demonstrate that models trained on such data achieve comparable performance to the Pascal-trained baseline. This corroborates the low synth2real gap of models trained on POC-generated images. Code: https://github.com/ naver/poc

title: Paul Albert*, Kevin McGuinness, Eric Arazo, Tarun Krishna, Noel O Connor, Jack Valmadre
title_en: Paul Albert*, Kevin McGuinness, Eric Arazo, Tarun Krishna, Noel O Connor, Jack Valmadre
abstract: 在网页爬取数据上训练分类器需要具备对标注错误和无关示例鲁棒性的学习算法。本文基于近期实证观察,即对噪声网页爬取数据集应用无监督对比学习可获得一种特征表示,在该表示下分布内(ID)和分布外(OOD)样本具有线性可分性[?]。我们证明直接估计分离超平面确实能够准确检测分布外样本,但令人惊讶的是,这种检测并未带来分类准确率的提升。深入探究这一现象,我们发现近乎完美的检测遗漏了对监督学习有价值的清洁示例类型。这些示例通常代表视觉简单的图像,尽管使用标准损失或距离方法可较容易识别为清洁示例,但通过无监督学习与分布外分布分离效果较差。由于我们进一步观察到与SOTA指标相关性较低,这促使我们提出混合解决方案,交替使用线性分离噪声检测和最先进的(SOTA)小损失方法。当与SOTA算法PLS结合时,我们在存在网页噪声的现实图像分类任务中显著提升了SOTA结果 https://github.com/PaulAlbert31/ LSA
abstract_en: Training a classifier on web-crawled data demands learning algorithms that are robust to annotation errors and irrelevant examples. This paper builds upon the recent empirical observation that applying unsupervised contrastive learning to noisy, web-crawled datasets yields a feature representation under which the in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) samples are linearly separable [?]. We show that direct estimation of the separating hyperplane can indeed offer an accurate detection of OOD samples, and yet, surprisingly, this detection does not translate into gains in classification accuracy. Digging deeper into this phenomenon, we discover that the near-perfect detection misses a type of clean examples that are valuable for supervised learning. These examples often represent visually simple images, which are relatively easy to identify as clean examples using standard loss- or distance-based methods despite being poorly separated from the OOD distribution using unsupervised learning. Because we further observe a low correlation with SOTA metrics, this urges us to propose a hybrid solution that alternates between noise detection using linear separation and a state-of-the-art (SOTA) small-loss approach. When combined with the SOTA algorithm PLS, we substantially improve SOTA results for real-world image classification in the presence of web noise https://github.com/PaulAlbert31/ LSA

title: Paul Roetzer*, Ahmed Abbas*, Dongliang Cao, Florian Bernard, Paul Swoboda
title_en: Paul Roetzer*, Ahmed Abbas*, Dongliang Cao, Florian Bernard, Paul Swoboda
abstract: 本文工作提出将基于学习的方法与组合形式化方法的优势相结合,用于3D形状匹配。虽然基于学习的方法能够实现最先进的匹配性能,但它们无法保证几何一致性,导致获得的匹配结果在局部区域不光滑。相反,基于公理的优化方法可以通过显式约束有效匹配空间来考虑几何一致性。然而,现有的公理形式化方法无法扩展到实际相关的问题规模,并且需要用户输入来初始化非凸优化问题。我们致力于通过提出一种新型的组合求解器来弥合这一差距,该求解器结合了一组独特的有利特性:我们的方法(i)无需初始化,(ii)可大规模并行化,并采用准牛顿方法驱动,(iii)提供最优性间隙,(iv)在减少运行时间的同时提高匹配质量,并为许多实例提供全局最优结果。all_papers.txt decode_tex_noligatures.sh decode_tex_noligatures.sh~ decode_tex.sh decode_tex.sh~ ECCV_abstracts.csv ECCV_abstracts_good.csv ECCV.csv ECCV.csv~ ECCV_new.csv generate_list.sh generate_list.sh~ generate_overview.sh gen.sh gen.sh~ HOWTO HOWTO~ pdflist pdflist.copied RCS snippet.html 这些作者对本工作贡献相同。
abstract_en: In this work we propose to combine the advantages of learning-based and combinatorial formalisms for 3D shape matching. While learning-based methods lead to state-of-the-art matching performance, they do not ensure geometric consistency, so that obtained matchings are locally non-smooth. On the contrary, axiomatic, optimisation-based methods allow to take geometric consistency into account by explicitly constraining the space of valid matchings. However, existing axiomatic formalisms do not scale to practically relevant problem sizes, and require user input for the initialisation of non-convex optimisation problems. We work towards closing this gap by proposing a novel combinatorial solver that combines a unique set of favourable properties: our approach (i) is initialisation free, (ii) is massively parallelisable and powered by a quasi-Newton method, (iii) provides optimality gaps, and (iv) delivers improved matching quality with decreased runtime and globally optimal results for many instances. all_papers.txt decode_tex_noligatures.sh decode_tex_noligatures.sh~ decode_tex.sh decode_tex.sh~ ECCV_abstracts.csv ECCV_abstracts_good.csv ECCV.csv ECCV.csv~ ECCV_new.csv generate_list.sh generate_list.sh~ generate_overview.sh gen.sh gen.sh~ HOWTO HOWTO~ pdflist pdflist.copied RCS snippet.html These authors contributed equally to this work.

title: Pavel Suma*, Giorgos Kordopatis-Zilos, Ahmet Iscen, Giorgos Tolias
title_en: Pavel Suma*, Giorgos Kordopatis-Zilos, Ahmet Iscen, Giorgos Tolias
abstract: 本文研究了在内存效率约束下实例级图像检索重排序问题,最终目标是将每张图像的内存使用量限制在1KB以内。与当前普遍关注性能提升的研究方向不同,本文优先考虑性能与内存需求之间的关键权衡。所提出的模型采用基于Transformer的架构,通过捕捉图像内部及跨图像的局部描述符交互来估计图像间相似性。该模型的一个显著特性是能够进行非对称相似性估计。数据库图像使用比查询图像更少的描述符进行表示,在不增加内存消耗的情况下实现了性能提升。为确保在不同应用场景下的适应性,引入了一个通用模型,在测试阶段可根据局部描述符数量进行调整。在标准基准测试中的结果表明,我们的方法在性能上优于手工设计和学习模型。特别是与当前忽略内存占用的最先进方法相比,我们的方法不仅实现了更优的性能,而且内存占用显著降低。代码和预训练模型已公开在:https://github.com/pavelsuma/ames
abstract_en: This work investigates the problem of instance-level image retrieval re-ranking with the constraint of memory efficiency, ultimately aiming to limit memory usage to 1KB per image. Departing from the prevalent focus on performance enhancements, this work prioritizes the crucial trade-off between performance and memory requirements. The proposed model uses a transformer-based architecture designed to estimate image-to-image similarity by capturing interactions within and across images based on their local descriptors. A distinctive property of the model is the capability for asymmetric similarity estimation. Database images are represented with a smaller number of descriptors compared to query images, enabling performance improvements without increasing memory consumption. To ensure adaptability across different applications, a universal model is introduced that adjusts to a varying number of local descriptors during the testing phase. Results on standard benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our approach over both hand-crafted and learned models. In particular, compared with current state-of-the-art methods that overlook their memory footprint, our approach not only attains superior performance but does so with a significantly reduced memory footprint. The code and pretrained models are publicly available at: https://github.com/pavelsuma/ames

title: 周培,杨彦超*
title_en: Pei Zhou, Yanchao Yang*
abstract: 我们的目标是发现嵌入在未标注示范数据中的操作概念,这些概念被认定为关键物理状态。发现的概念可以促进操作策略的训练并提升泛化能力。当前依赖多模态基础模型推导关键状态的方法通常由于多模态机器人数据有限而缺乏准确性和语义一致性。相比之下,我们引入一个信息论准则来表征标志着一组物理状态的规律性。我们还开发了一个框架,利用该准则训练概念发现网络,从而绕过对人类语义的依赖并减轻昂贵的人工标注成本。所提出的准则基于观察到值得概念化的关键状态通常比非关键状态具有更多的物理约束。这一现象可形式化为最大化假设关键状态与其前序状态之间的互信息,即最大互信息(MaxMI)。通过采用MaxMI,训练后的关键状态定位网络能够准确识别具有充分物理意义的状态,并表现出与人类感知合理的语义兼容性。此外,所提出的框架生成的关键状态在各种机器人任务中,相较于基线方法,能够引导具有更高成功率和更好泛化能力的概念引导操作策略,验证了所提出准则的有效性。我们的源代码可在https://github.com/PeiZhou26/MaxMI获取。
abstract_en: We aim to discover manipulation concepts embedded in the unannotated demonstrations, which are recognized as key physical states. The discovered concepts can facilitate training manipulation policies and promote generalization. Current methods relying on multimodal foundation models for deriving key states usually lack accuracy and semantic consistency due to limited multimodal robot data. In contrast, we introduce an information-theoretic criterion to characterize the regularities that signify a set of physical states. We also develop a framework that trains a concept discovery network using this criterion, thus bypassing the dependence on human semantics and alleviating costly human labeling. The proposed criterion is based on the observation that key states, which deserve to be conceptualized, often admit more physical constraints than non-key states. This phenomenon can be formalized as maximizing the mutual information between the putative key state and its preceding state, i.e., Maximal Mutual Information (MaxMI). By employing MaxMI, the trained key state localization network can accurately identify states of sufficient physical significance, exhibiting reasonable semantic compatibility with human perception. Furthermore, the proposed framework produces key states that lead to concept-guided manipulation policies with higher success rates and better generalization in various robotic tasks compared to the baselines, verifying the effectiveness of the proposed criterion. Our source code can be found at https://github.com/PeiZhou26/MaxMI.

title: Peibei Cao, HAOYU CHEN, Jingzhe Ma, Yu-Chieh Yuan, Zhiyong Xie, Xin Xie, Haiqing Bai, Kede Ma*
title_en: Peibei Cao, HAOYU CHEN, Jingzhe Ma, Yu-Chieh Yuan, Zhiyong Xie, Xin Xie, Haiqing Bai, Kede Ma*
abstract: 高动态范围(HDR)捕获和显示由于技术进步和消费者对卓越图像质量需求的增长而受到广泛关注。因此,HDR图像压缩对于在不遭受大文件尺寸和低效数据处理问题的情况下充分实现HDR成像的优势至关重要。传统上,这是通过引入残差/增益图作为附加元数据来实现的,以弥合HDR图像与低动态范围(LDR)图像之间的差距,使前者能够与LDR图像编解码器兼容,但提供次优的率失真性能。在本工作中,我们启动了端到端优化的HDR图像压缩研究,以实现感知最优的存储和显示。具体而言,我们学习将HDR图像压缩为两个比特流:一个用于生成LDR图像以确保与传统LDR显示器的兼容性,另一个作为辅助信息以帮助从输出LDR图像重建HDR图像。为了衡量输出HDR和LDR图像的感知质量,我们使用了两种最近提出的图像失真度量,这些度量均经过与图像质量的人类感知数据验证,并参考了未压缩的HDR图像。通过端到端优化率失真性能,我们的方法在所有比特率下显著提升了HDR和LDR图像质量。代码可在https://github.com/cpb68/EPIC-HDR/获取。
abstract_en: High dynamic range (HDR) capture and display have seen significant growth in popularity driven by the advancements in technology and increasing consumer demand for superior image quality. As a result, HDR image compression is crucial to fully realize the benefits of HDR imaging without suffering from large file sizes and inefficient data handling. Conventionally, this is achieved by introducing a residual/gain map as additional metadata to bridge the gap between HDR and low dynamic range (LDR) images, making the former compatible with LDR image codecs but offering suboptimal rate-distortion performance. In this work, we initiate efforts towards end-to-end optimized HDR image compression for perceptually optimal storage and display. Specifically, we learn to compress an HDR image into two bitstreams: one for generating an LDR image to ensure compatibility with legacy LDR displays, and another as side information to aid HDR image reconstruction from the output LDR image. To measure the perceptual quality of output HDR and LDR images, we use two recently proposed image distortion metrics, both validated against human perceptual data of image quality and with reference to the uncompressed HDR image. Through end-to-end optimization for rate-distortion performance, our method dramatically improves HDR and LDR image quality at all bit rates. The code is available at https://github.com/cpb68/EPIC-HDR/.

title: Peidong Li*, Wancheng Shen, Qihao Huang, Dixiao Cui*
title_en: Peidong Li*, Wancheng Shen, Qihao Huang, Dixiao Cui*
abstract: 基于相机的鸟瞰图(BEV)感知通常在采用3D到2D或2D到3D视角转换(VT)策略之间面临权衡。3D到2D视角转换通常采用资源密集型Transformer来建立3D与2D特征间的稳健对应关系,而2D到3D视角转换则利用Lift-Splat-Shoot(LSS)流水线实现实时应用,可能遗漏远距离信息。为解决这些局限性,我们提出DualBEV,一个统一框架,通过融合三种概率测量的共享特征转换,同时支持两种策略。通过在单阶段考虑双视角对应关系,DualBEV有效弥合了这两种策略之间的差距,充分发挥各自优势。我们的方法在无需Transformer的情况下达到最先进性能,效率与LSS方法相当,在nuScenes测试集上取得55.2% mAP和63.4% NDS。代码已开源于https: //github.com/PeidongLi/DualBEV。
abstract_en: Camera-based Bird’s-Eye-View (BEV) perception often struggles between adopting 3D-to-2D or 2D-to-3D view transformation (VT). The 3D-to-2D VT typically employs resource-intensive Transformer to establish robust correspondences between 3D and 2D features, while the 2D-to-3D VT utilizes the Lift-Splat-Shoot (LSS) pipeline for real-time application, potentially missing distant information. To address these limitations, we propose DualBEV, a unified framework that utilizes a shared feature transformation incorporating three probabilistic measurements for both strategies. By considering dual-view correspondences in one stage, DualBEV effectively bridges the gap between these strategies, harnessing their individual strengths. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance without Transformer, delivering comparable efficiency to the LSS approach, with 55.2% mAP and 63.4% NDS on the nuScenes test set. Code is available at https: //github.com/PeidongLi/DualBEV.

title: Peifu Liu, Tingfa Xu*, Jie Wang, Huan Chen, Huiyan Bai, Jianan Li*
title_en: Peifu Liu, Tingfa Xu*, Jie Wang, Huan Chen, Huiyan Bai, Jianan Li*
abstract: 高光谱图像分类是一项任务,旨在将预定义类别分配给遥感场景高光谱图像中的每个像素,但常因忽视光谱相似像素之间的相关性而面临挑战。这种疏忽可能导致边缘定义不准确,并在连续区域中难以管理细微的光谱变化。为解决这些问题,我们引入了一种受超像素概念启发的新型双阶段光谱超标记分类器(DSTC)。DSTC采用基于光谱导数的像素聚类,将具有相似光谱特征的像素分组为光谱超标记。通过将这些标记的分类投影到图像空间,我们实现了保持区域分类一致性和精确边界的像素级结果。此外,考虑到标记内部的多样性,我们提出了一种基于类别比例的软标签。该标签根据类别流行度自适应地为不同类别分配权重,有效管理数据分布不平衡问题并提升分类性能。在WHU-OHS、IP、KSC和UP数据集上的综合实验验证了DSTC的鲁棒分类能力及其各组件的有效性。代码将在https://github.com/laprf/DSTC公开。
abstract_en: Hyperspectral image classification, a task that assigns pre-defined classes to each pixel in a hyperspectral image of remote sensing scenes, often faces challenges due to the neglect of correlations between spectrally similar pixels. This oversight can lead to inaccurate edge definitions and difficulties in managing minor spectral variations in contiguous areas. To address these issues, we introduce the novel Dual-stage Spectral Supertoken Classifier (DSTC), inspired by superpixel concepts. DSTC employs spectrum-derivative-based pixel clustering to group pixels with similar spectral characteristics into spectral supertokens. By projecting the classification of these tokens onto the image space, we achieve pixel-level results that maintain regional classification consistency and precise boundary. Moreover, recognizing the diversity within tokens, we propose a class-proportion-based soft label. This label adaptively assigns weights to different categories based on their prevalence, effectively managing data distribution imbalances and enhancing classification performance. Comprehensive experiments on WHU-OHS, IP, KSC, and UP datasets corroborate the robust classification capabilities of DSTC and the effectiveness of its individual components. Code will be publicly available at https://github.com/laprf/DSTC.

title: Peijun Bao*, Zihao Shao, Wenhan Yang, Boon Poh Ng, Alex Kot
title_en: Peijun Bao*, Zihao Shao, Wenhan Yang, Boon Poh Ng, Alex Kot
abstract: 时空视频定位旨在根据给定的语言查询在视频中定位时空管状区域。为消除标注成本,我们首次探索以零样本方式解决时空视频定位问题。我们的方法无需任何训练视频或标注数据,而是在测试时通过利用预训练的视觉-语言模型,并在视频和文本查询中进行优化来定位目标对象。为实现时空理解,我们引入了一种多模态调制机制,将时空上下文整合到视觉和文本表征中。在视觉方面,我们设计了一种基于上下文的视觉调制,通过上下文语义的传播与聚合增强视觉表征。同时,在文本方面,我们提出了一种基于原型的文本调制,利用视觉原型优化文本表征,有效缓解跨模态差异。此外,为克服交织的时空困境,我们提出了一种期望最大化(EM)框架,以交替方式优化时间相关性估计和空间区域识别过程。全面实验验证了我们的零样本方法在与更强监督的多个先进方法相比表现出更优性能。代码已开源至 https://github.com/baopj/E3M。
abstract_en: Spatio-temporal video grounding aims to localize the spatio-temporal tube in a video according to the given language query. To eliminate the annotation costs, we make a first exploration to tackle spatio-temporal video grounding in a zero-shot manner. Our method dispenses with the need for any training videos or annotations; instead, it localizes the target object by leveraging pre-trained vision-language models and optimizing within the video and text query during the test time. To enable spatio-temporal comprehension, we introduce a multimodal modulation that integrates the spatio-temporal context into both visual and textual representation. On the visual side, we devise a context-based visual modulation that enhances the visual representation by propagation and aggregation of the contextual semantics. Concurrently, on the textual front, we propose a prototype-based textual modulation to refine the textual representations using visual prototypes, effectively mitigating the cross-modal discrepancy. In addition, to overcome the interleaved spatio-temporal dilemma, we propose an expectation maximization (EM) framework to optimize the process of temporal relevance estimation and spatial region identification in an alternating way. Comprehensive experiments validate that our zero-shot approach achieves superior performance in comparison to several state-of-the-art methods with stronger supervision. The code is available at https://github.com/baopj/E3M.

title: 和
title_en: Peiqi Chen*, Lei Yu, Yi Wan*, Yongjun Zhang*, Jian Wang, Liheng Zhong, Jingdong Chen, Ming Yang
abstract: 作为标题和摘要的标记,并且在最后加上
abstract_en: Detector-free local feature matching methods have demonstrated significant performance improvements since leveraging the power of Transformer architecture. The global receptive field allows for simultaneous interaction among all elements, proving particularly beneficial in regions with low texture or repetitive patterns. However, Transformer-based methods are confronted by how to achieve a balance between computational cost and expressive efficacy when dealing with numerous features. In this work, we revisit existing detector-free methods and propose EcoMatcher, a universal matcher based on implicit clustering termed Context Clusters. By introducing coarse-grained features as clustering centers, similar features are allocated to the same center, forming distinct clustering patterns. Features within the same cluster are then dispatched with identical messages from their center but at varying scales depending on the similarity metrics. This process defines a novel feature extraction paradigm for both self-understanding and cross-interaction of image pairs, facilitating fusing multi-level features and reducing overall complexity. EcoMatcher proves to be a competitive detector-free method in terms of memory consumption and runtime speed, while also achieves strong performance on mainstream benchmarks.

title: Peiqi Jiao, Yuecong Min, Xilin Chen*
title_en: Peiqi Jiao, Yuecong Min, Xilin Chen*
abstract: 手语翻译(SLT)旨在将手语视频转换为文本句子。尽管手语词序(gloss sequences),作为手语视频的书面近似形式,为SLT中的视觉表征学习提供了信息性对齐监督,但相关手语注释的高成本限制了其可扩展性。近期研究在没有手语注释的情况下尚未取得令人满意的成果。在本研究中,我们将挑战归因于视觉与文本标记之间灵活的对应关系,并旨在通过从文本句子构建类似手语的约束来解决这一问题。具体而言,我们提出了一种视觉对齐预训练(VAP)方案,通过贪心方式对齐视觉与文本标记以利用视觉信息。VAP方案增强了视觉编码器在捕捉语义感知视觉信息方面的能力,并促进了与在大规模语料库上预训练的翻译模块更好地适配。在四个SLT基准测试中的实验结果证明了VAP的有效性,其能够生成合理的对齐,并显著缩小与基于手语方法的性能差距。
abstract_en: Sign Language Translation (SLT) aims to translate sign videos into text sentences. While gloss sequences, the written approximation of sign videos, provide informative alignment supervision for visual representation learning in SLT, the associated high cost of gloss annotations hampers the scalability. Recent works have yet to achieve satisfactory results without gloss annotations. In this study, we attribute the challenge to the flexible correspondence between visual and textual tokens, and aim to address it by constructing a gloss-like constraint from text sentences. Specifically, we propose a Visual Alignment Pre-training (VAP) scheme to exploit visual information by aligning visual and textual tokens in a greedy manner. The VAP scheme enhances visual encoder in capturing semantic-aware visual information and facilitates better adaptation with translation modules pre-trained on large-scale corpora. Experimental results across four SLT benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of VAP, which can generate reasonable alignments and significantly narrow the performance gap with gloss-based methods.

title: Peirong Liu*, Oula Puonti, Xiaoling Hu, Daniel C. Alexander, Juan E. Iglesias
title_en: Peirong Liu*, Oula Puonti, Xiaoling Hu, Daniel C. Alexander, Juan E. Iglesias
abstract: 近年来,基于学习的方法在校准医疗影像领域(如计算机断层扫描(CT))取得了显著进展。然而,这些方法在非校准模态(尤其是磁共振(MR)成像)中难以泛化,其性能对MR对比度、分辨率和方向差异高度敏感。这限制了其在多样化真实临床协议中的广泛应用。我们提出Brain-ID,这是一种用于脑影像的解剖结构表征学习模型。通过提出的“轻度到严重”个体内生成方法,Brain-ID能够稳健地处理个体特异性脑解剖结构,无论获取图像的外观如何。Brain-ID完全基于合成输入训练,通过单层即可适应各种下游任务。我们提出了新的度量指标,用于验证Brain-ID特征的个体内/个体间鲁棒性,并在四个下游应用中评估其性能,涵盖对比度无关任务(解剖结构重建、脑分割)和对比度相关任务(超分辨率、偏场估计)(展示案例)。在六个公开数据集上的大量实验表明,Brain-ID在不同MR对比度和CT上所有任务中均达到最先进性能,更重要的是,其在低分辨率和小数据集上仍能保持性能。代码可在https://github.com/peirong26/Brain-ID获取。
abstract_en: Recent learning-based approaches have made astonishing advances in calibrated medical imaging like computerized tomography (CT). Yet, they struggle to generalize in uncalibrated modalities – notably magnetic resonance (MR) imaging, where performance is highly sensitive to the differences in MR contrast, resolution, and orientation. This prevents broad applicability to diverse real-world clinical protocols. We introduce Brain-ID, an anatomical representation learning model for brain imaging. With the proposed “mild-to-severe” intra-subject generation, Brain-ID is robust to the subject-specific brain anatomy regardless of the appearance of acquired images. Trained entirely on synthetic inputs, Brain-ID readily adapts to various downstream tasks through one layer. We present new metrics to validate the intra/inter-subject robustness of Brain-ID features, and evaluate their performance on four downstream applications, covering contrast-independent (anatomy reconstruction, brain segmentation), and contrast-dependent (super-resolution, bias field estimation) tasks (showcase). Extensive experiments on six public datasets demonstrate that Brain-ID achieves state-of-the-art performance in all tasks on different MR contrasts and CT, and more importantly, preserves its performance on low-resolution and small datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/peirong26/Brain-ID.

title: Peishen Yan, Hao Wang, Tao Song*, Yang Hua, Ruhui Ma, Ningxin Hu, Mohammad Reza Haghighat, Haibing Guan
title_en: Peishen Yan, Hao Wang, Tao Song*, Yang Hua, Ruhui Ma, Ningxin Hu, Mohammad Reza Haghighat, Haibing Guan
abstract: 联邦学习(FL)正成为利用分布式数据并保护数据隐私的流行范式。然而,由于分布式特性,FL系统容易受到拜占庭攻击的威胁,恶意客户端通过上传恶意模型更新攻击全局模型。随着层级和参数级细粒度攻击的发展,攻击的隐蔽性和有效性显著提升。现有防御机制仅通过分析客户端上传的模型更新的模型级统计信息来缓解拜占庭攻击,由于对细粒度攻击缺乏认知或过度反应,无法有效防御此类攻击。为解决这一问题,我们提出SkyMask,一种新的无攻击依赖的鲁棒FL系统,首次利用细粒度可学习掩码在参数级识别恶意模型更新。具体而言,FL服务器冻结并乘以客户端上传的模型更新与参数级掩码,通过一个小规模干净数据集(即根数据集)训练掩码,以在高维空间中学习良性与恶意模型更新的细微差异。我们的广泛实验涉及在三个公开数据集上使用最先进的(SOTA)攻击对不同模型的测试结果表明,在相同攻击下,测试准确率比SOTA防御策略高14%,并成功防御高达80%恶意客户端的攻击。代码可在https://github.com/KoalaYan/SkyMask获取。
abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) is becoming a popular paradigm for leveraging distributed data and preserving data privacy. However, due to the distributed characteristic, FL systems are vulnerable to Byzantine attacks that compromised clients attack the global model by uploading malicious model updates. With the development of layer-level and parameter-level fine-grained attacks, the attacks’ stealthiness and effectiveness have been significantly improved. The existing defense mechanisms solely analyze the model-level statistics of individual model updates uploaded by clients to mitigate Byzantine attacks, which are ineffective against fine-grained attacks due to unawareness or overreaction. To address this problem, we propose SkyMask, a new attack-agnostic robust FL system that firstly leverages fine-grained learnable masks to identify malicious model updates at the parameter level. Specifically, the FL server freezes and multiplies the model updates uploaded by clients with the parameter-level masks, and trains the masks over a small clean dataset (i.e., root dataset) to learn the subtle difference between benign and malicious model updates in a high-dimension space. Our extensive experiments involve different models on three public datasets under state-of-the-art (SOTA) attacks, where the results show that achieves up to 14% higher testing accuracy compared with SOTA defense strategies under the same attacks and successfully defends against attacks with malicious clients of a high fraction up to 80%. Code is available at https://github.com/ KoalaYan/SkyMask.

title: 熊佩熙*, 迈克尔·A·科祖奇, 尼勒什·贾因
title_en: Peixi Xiong*, Michael A Kozuch, Nilesh Jain
abstract: 文本到图像生成在计算机视觉和自然语言处理中扮演着关键角色,通过将文本描述转化为视觉表示。然而,理解包含丰富关系内容的详细文本提示中的复杂关系仍然是重大挑战。为解决这一问题,我们引入了一项新任务:富含逻辑的文本到图像生成。与依赖简短且结构简单的自然语言输入的传统图像生成任务不同,我们的任务聚焦于富含关系信息的复杂文本输入。为应对这些复杂性,我们收集了文本-视觉逻辑数据集,旨在评估文本到图像生成模型在多样且复杂场景下的性能。此外,我们提出了一种基线模型作为该任务的基准。该模型包含三个关键组件:关系理解模块、多模态融合模块和负样本对判别器。这些组件增强了模型处理信息性标记扰动的能力,并在图像生成过程中优先考虑关系元素。https://github.com/IntelLabs/Textual-Visual-Logic-Challenge
abstract_en: Text-to-image generation plays a pivotal role in computer vision and natural language processing by translating textual descriptions into visual representations. However, understanding complex relations in detailed text prompts filled with rich relational content remains a significant challenge. To address this, we introduce a novel task: Logic-Rich Text-to-Image generation. Unlike conventional image generation tasks that rely on short and structurally simple natural language inputs, our task focuses on intricate text inputs abundant in relational information. To tackle these complexities, we collect the Textual-Visual Logic dataset, designed to evaluate the performance of text-to-image generation models across diverse and complex scenarios. Furthermore, we propose a baseline model as a benchmark for this task. Our model comprises three key components: a relation understanding module, a multimodality fusion module, and a negative pair discriminator. These components enhance the model’s ability to handle disturbances in informative tokens and prioritize relational elements during image generation. https:// github.com/IntelLabs/Textual-Visual-Logic-Challenge

title: Peiyu Yang*, Naveed Akhtar, Mubarak Shah, Ajmal Mian
title_en: Peiyu Yang*, Naveed Akhtar, Mubarak Shah, Ajmal Mian
abstract: 可信机器学习需要对模型对非鲁棒特征的依赖进行细致调控。我们提出了一种框架,通过将模型预测归因于输入来界定和调控此类特征。在我们的方法中,鲁棒特征归因表现出一定的稳定性,而非鲁棒特征归因则容易波动。这种行为使得能够识别模型对非鲁棒特征的依赖与输入样本边缘密度平滑度之间的相关性。因此,我们独特地对边缘密度相对于输入特征的梯度进行正则化以增强鲁棒性。此外,我们设计了一种高效的正则化实现方案,以解决底层优化过程潜在的数值不稳定性问题。同时,我们通过分析揭示,与我们的边缘密度平滑方法不同,常见的输入梯度正则化会平滑输入的条件或联合密度,这可能导致有限的鲁棒性。实验验证了所提方法的有效性,提供了其解决特征泄露问题和缓解虚假相关性的明确证据。大量实验结果进一步证明,我们的技术使模型能够对像素值、输入梯度和密度的扰动表现出鲁棒性。1 我们的代码可在https://github.com/ypeiyu/input_density_reg获取。
abstract_en: Trustworthy machine learning necessitates meticulous regulation of model reliance on non-robust features. We propose a framework to delineate and regulate such features by attributing model predictions to the input. Within our approach, robust feature attributions exhibit a certain consistency, while non-robust feature attributions are susceptible to fluctuations. This behavior allows identification of correlation between model reliance on non-robust features and smoothness of marginal density of the input samples. Hence, we uniquely regularize the gradients of the marginal density w.r.t. the input features for robustness. We also devise an efficient implementation of our regularization1 to address the potential numerical instability of the underlying optimization process. Moreover, we analytically reveal that, as opposed to our marginal density smoothing, the prevalent input gradient regularization smoothens conditional or joint density of the input, which can cause limited robustness. Our experiments validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, providing clear evidence of its capability to address the feature leakage problem and mitigate spurious correlations. Extensive results further establish that our technique enables the model to exhibit robustness against perturbations in pixel values, input gradients, and density. 1 Our code is available at https://github.com/ypeiyu/input_density_reg.

title: 彭金*, 李浩, 程泽森, 李柯涵, 于润毅, 刘畅*, 贾翔阳, 原立*, 陈杰
title_en: Peng Jin*, Hao Li, Zesen Cheng, Kehan Li, Runyi Yu, Chang Liu*, Xiangyang Ji, Li Yuan*, Jie Chen
abstract: 文本到运动生成不仅需要将局部动作与语言进行关联,还需无缝融合这些个体动作以合成多样且真实的全局运动。然而,现有运动生成方法主要关注全局运动的直接合成,而忽视了生成和控制局部动作的重要性。本文提出局部动作引导的运动扩散模型,通过将局部动作作为细粒度控制信号,促进全局运动生成。具体而言,我们提供了一种自动化的参考局部动作采样方法,并利用图注意力网络评估每个局部动作在整体运动合成中的引导权重。在合成全局运动的扩散过程中,我们计算局部动作梯度以提供条件引导。这种从局部到全局的范式降低了直接生成全局运动的复杂性,并通过采样多样化的动作作为条件来提升运动多样性。在两个人体运动数据集HumanML3D和KIT上的大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性。此外,我们的方法在无缝结合各种局部动作和连续引导权重调整方面具有灵活性,能够适应多样化的用户偏好,这可能对相关领域具有潜在意义。项目页面可访问https://jpthu17.github.io/GuidedMotion-project/。
abstract_en: Text-to-motion generation requires not only grounding local actions in language but also seamlessly blending these individual actions to synthesize diverse and realistic global motions. However, existing motion generation methods primarily focus on the direct synthesis of global motions while neglecting the importance of generating and controlling local actions. In this paper, we propose the local action-guided motion diffusion model, which facilitates global motion generation by utilizing local actions as fine-grained control signals. Specifically, we provide an automated method for reference local action sampling and leverage graph attention networks to assess the guiding weight of each local action in the overall motion synthesis. During the diffusion process for synthesizing global motion, we calculate the local-action gradient to provide conditional guidance. This local-to-global paradigm reduces the complexity associated with direct global motion generation and promotes motion diversity via sampling diverse actions as conditions. Extensive experiments on two human motion datasets, , HumanML3D and KIT, demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. Furthermore, our method provides flexibility in seamlessly combining various local actions and continuous guiding weight adjustment, accommodating diverse user preferences, which may hold potential significance for the community. The project page is available at https://jpthu17.github.io/GuidedMotion-project/.

title: 王鹏, 李兆海, 唐俊, 钟焕, 黄飞, 杨志博*, 姚聪*
title_en: Peng Wang, Zhaohai Li, Jun Tang, Humen Zhong, Fei Huang, Zhibo Yang*, Cong Yao*
abstract: 从图像中读取文本(无论是自然场景还是文档)一直是持续数十年的研究课题,由于其高技术挑战性和广泛的应用范围。此前,已开发出专门模型来处理文本阅读的子任务(例如场景文本识别、手写文本识别和数学表达式识别)。然而,这些专门模型通常无法有效泛化到不同的子任务。最近,通用模型(如GPT-4V)通过统一方式在大量数据上进行训练,在各种场景中读取文本方面展现出巨大潜力,但存在准确率有限和效率低下的缺点。在本工作中,我们提出Platypus,一种用于文本阅读的通用专门模型。具体而言,Platypus结合了两者的优势:通过单一统一架构识别各种形式的文本,同时实现卓越的准确率和高效率。为了更好地利用Platypus的优势,我们还构建了一个文本阅读数据集(称为Worms),其图像来源于先前数据集并部分重新标注。在标准基准上的实验验证了所提出的Platypus模型的有效性和优越性。模型和数据将在magentaAdvancedLiterateMachinery公开。
abstract_en: Reading text from images (either natural scenes or documents) has been a long-standing research topic for decades, due to the high technical challenge and wide application range. Previously, individual specialist models are developed to tackle the sub-tasks of text reading (e.g., scene text recognition, handwritten text recognition and mathematical expression recognition). However, such specialist models usually cannot effectively generalize across different sub-tasks. Recently, generalist models (such as GPT-4V), trained on tremendous data in a unified way, have shown enormous potential in reading text in various scenarios, but with the drawbacks of limited accuracy and low efficiency. In this work, we propose Platypus, a generalized specialist model for text reading. Specifically, Platypus combines the best of both worlds: being able recognize text of various forms with a single unified architecture, while achieving excellent accuracy and high efficiency. To better exploit the advantage of Platypus, we also construct a text reading dataset (called Worms), the images of which are curated from previous datasets and partially re-labeled. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed Platypus model. Model and data will be made publicly available at magentaAdvancedLiterateMachinery.

title: Peng Xiao, Yi Xie, Xuemiao Xu*, Weihong Chen, Huaidong Zhang*
title_en: Peng Xiao, Yi Xie, Xuemiao Xu*, Weihong Chen, Huaidong Zhang*
abstract: 人体姿态预测是人体意图理解中的主要问题,可以通过深度方法学习历史姿态来解决。然而,现有方法在多人场景中往往缺乏对个体在事件中角色的建模,导致在复杂场景中表现受限,尤其是在同时发生多种交互的情况下。本文提出了一种交互感知姿态预测Transformer(IAFormer)框架,以更好地学习交互特征。基于事件通常仅涉及场景中部分人群的关键洞察,我们设计了交互感知模块(IPM)来评估人与事件的交互水平。通过交互评估,利用注意力机制提取与交互相关的特征进行预测。此外,我们提出了交互先验学习模块(IPLM),用于学习和积累高频交互的先验知识,鼓励语义姿态预测而非简单的轨迹姿态预测。我们在CMU-Mocap、UMPM、CHI3D、Human3.6M和合成人群数据集上进行了实验。结果表明,我们的方法在不同人数场景下显著优于现有最先进的方法。代码可在purplehttps: //github.com/ArcticPole/IAFormer获取
abstract_en: Human Pose Forecasting is a major problem in human intention comprehension that can be addressed through learning the historical poses via deep methods. However, existing methods often lack the modeling of the person’s role in the event in multi-person scenes. This leads to limited performance in complicated scenes with variant interactions happening at the same time. In this paper, we introduce the Interaction-Aware Pose Forecasting Transformer (IAFormer) framework to better learn the interaction features. With the key insight that the event often involves only part of the people in the scene, we designed the Interaction Perceptron Module (IPM) to evaluate the human-to-event interaction level. With the interaction evaluation, the human-independent features are extracted with the attention mechanism for interaction-aware forecasting. In addition, an Interaction Prior Learning Module (IPLM) is presented to learn and accumulate prior knowledge of high-frequency interactions, encouraging semantic pose forecasting rather than simple trajectory pose forecasting. We conduct experiments using datasets such as CMU-Mocap, UMPM, CHI3D, Human3.6M, and synthesized crowd datasets. The results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches considering scenarios with varying numbers of people. Code is available at purplehttps: //github.com/ArcticPole/IAFormer

title: 彭正, 刘涛, 易子利, 马睿*
title_en: Peng Zheng, Tao Liu, Zili Yi, Rui Ma*
abstract: 随着神经辐射场和生成模型的发展,已有大量方法被提出,用于从2D图像学习3D人体生成。这些方法允许对生成的3D人体姿态进行控制,并支持从不同视角进行渲染。然而,现有方法均未探索人体图像合成中的语义解耦,即无法分离生成不同语义部分(如身体、上衣和下装)的过程。此外,现有方法受限于神经辐射场的高计算成本,只能合成512×2分辨率的图像。为解决这些局限性,我们引入了SemanticHuman-HD,这是首个实现语义解耦人体图像合成的方法。值得注意的是,SemanticHuman-HD也是首个实现1024×2分辨率3D感知图像合成的方法,得益于我们提出的3D感知超分辨率模块。通过利用深度图和语义掩码作为3D感知超分辨率的指导,我们显著减少了体渲染过程中的采样点数量,从而降低了计算成本。我们的对比实验验证了方法的优越性,通过消融实验也验证了各组件的有效性。此外,我们的方法为多种应用开辟了新可能,包括3D服装生成、语义感知图像合成、可控图像合成以及分布外图像合成。项目页面地址为:https://pengzheng0707.github.io/SemanticHuman-HD/
abstract_en: With the development of neural radiance fields and generative models, numerous methods have been proposed for learning 3D human generation from 2D images. These methods allow control over the pose of the generated 3D human and enable rendering from different viewpoints. However, none of these methods explore semantic disentanglement in human image synthesis, i.e., they can not disentangle the generation of different semantic parts, such as the body, tops, and bottoms. Furthermore, existing methods are limited to synthesize images at 5122 resolution due to the high computational cost of neural radiance fields. To address these limitations, we introduce SemanticHuman-HD, the first method to achieve semantic disentangled human image synthesis. Notably, SemanticHuman-HD is also the first method to achieve 3D-aware image synthesis at 10242 resolution, benefiting from our proposed 3D-aware super-resolution module. By leveraging the depth maps and semantic masks as guidance for the 3D-aware super-resolution, we significantly reduce the number of sampling points during volume rendering, thereby reducing the computational cost. Our comparative experiments demonstrate the superiority of our method. The effectiveness of each proposed component is also verified through ablation studies. Moreover, our method opens up exciting possibilities for various applications, including 3D garment generation, semantic-aware image synthesis, controllable image synthesis, and out-of-distribution image synthesis. Our project page is at https://pengzheng0707.github.io/SemanticHuman-HD/

title: Pengbo Guo, Chengxu Liu, Xingsong Hou*, Xueming Qian
title_en: Pengbo Guo, Chengxu Liu, Xingsong Hou*, Xueming Qian
abstract: 鱼眼图像校正旨在校正鱼眼相机拍摄图像中的畸变。尽管当前模型在与训练数据具有相似畸变程度的图像上表现出有希望的结果,但当畸变程度发生变化且不重新训练时,会产生次优结果。处理不同畸变程度的泛化能力不足限制了其实际应用。本文进一步迈出一步,使无需重新训练即可有效校正不同畸变程度的图像。我们提出了一种基于查询的可控畸变校正网络(QueryCDR)用于鱼眼图像。具体而言,我们首先提出了畸变感知可学习查询机制(DLQM),将不同畸变程度的潜在空间关系定义为一系列可学习查询。每个查询均可学习以获得位置依赖的校正控制条件,从而对校正过程进行控制。然后,我们提出两种可控调制模块,以更好地引导畸变特征的调制。这些核心组件相互协作,有效提升了模型在不同畸变程度下的泛化能力。在不同畸变程度的鱼眼图像数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法实现了高质量且可控的畸变校正。代码可在 https://github.com/PbGuo/QueryCDR 获取。
abstract_en: Fisheye image rectification aims to correct distortions in images taken with fisheye cameras. Although current models show promising results on images with a similar degree of distortion as the training data, they will produce sub-optimal results when the degree of distortion changes and without retraining. The lack of generalization ability for dealing with varying degrees of distortion limits their practical application. In this paper, we take one step further to enable effective distortion rectification for images with varying degrees of distortion without retraining. We propose a novel Query-based Controllable Distortion Rectification network for fisheye images (QueryCDR). In particular, we first present the Distortion-aware Learnable Query Mechanism (DLQM), which defines the latent spatial relationships for different distortion degrees as a series of learnable queries. Each query can be learned to obtain position-dependent rectification control conditions, providing control over the rectification process. Then, we propose two kinds of controllable modulating blocks to enable the control conditions to guide the modulation of the distortion features better. These core components cooperate with each other to effectively boost the generalization ability of the model at varying degrees of distortion. Extensive experiments on fisheye image datasets with different distortion degrees demonstrate our approach achieves high-quality and controllable distortion rectification. Code is available at https://github.com/PbGuo/QueryCDR.

title: Pengfei Wang*, Yuxi Wang, Shuai Li, Zhaoxiang Zhang, Zhen Lei, Lei Zhang
title_en: Pengfei Wang*, Yuxi Wang, Shuai Li, Zhaoxiang Zhang, Zhen Lei, Lei Zhang
abstract: 大规模3D文本配对数据的稀缺性对开放词汇3D场景理解提出了重大挑战,因此人们普遍采用互联网级2D数据,并通过知识蒸馏将开放词汇能力迁移至3D模型。然而,现有基于蒸馏的3D场景理解方法依赖于2D模型的表征能力,忽视了3D数据提供的几何先验和固有表征优势的探索。本文提出了一种有效方法,即几何引导的自蒸馏(Geometry Guided Self-Distillation, GGSD),从2D预训练模型中学习更优的3D表征。具体而言,我们首先设计了一个几何引导的蒸馏模块以从2D模型中迁移知识,然后利用3D几何先验缓解2D模型的固有噪声并增强表征学习过程。由于3D表征的优势,蒸馏后的3D学生模型性能显著超越2D教师模型。这促使我们进一步通过自蒸馏利用3D数据的表征优势。实验结果表明,我们的GGSD方法在室内和室外基准数据集上均显著优于现有开放词汇3D场景理解方法。代码已开源:https://github.com/Wang-pengfei/GGSD
abstract_en: The scarcity of large-scale 3D-text paired data poses a great challenge on open vocabulary 3D scene understanding, and hence it is popular to leverage internet-scale 2D data and transfer their open vocabulary capabilities to 3D models through knowledge distillation. However, the existing distillation-based 3D scene understanding approaches rely on the representation capacity of 2D models, disregarding the exploration of geometric priors and inherent representational advantages offered by 3D data. In this paper, we propose an effective approach, namely Geometry Guided Self-Distillation (GGSD), to learn superior 3D representations from 2D pre-trained models. Specifically, we first design a geometry guided distillation module to distill knowledge from 2D models, and then leverage the 3D geometric priors to alleviate the inherent noise in 2D models and enhance the representation learning process. Due to the advantages of 3D representation, the performance of the distilled 3D student model can significantly surpass that of the 2D teacher model. This motivates us to further leverage the representation advantages of 3D data through self-distillation. As a result, our proposed GGSD approach outperforms the existing open vocabulary 3D scene understanding methods by a large margin, as demonstrated by our experiments on both indoor and outdoor benchmark datasets. Codes are available at https://github.com/ Wang-pengfei/GGSD.

title: Pengfei Wang, Xiaofei Hui, Jing Wu, Zile Yang, Kian Eng Ong, Xinge Zhao, Beijia Lu, Dezhao Huang, Evan Ling, Weiling Chen, Keng Teck Ma, Minhoe Hur, Jun Liu*
title_en: Pengfei Wang, Xiaofei Hui, Jing Wu, Zile Yang, Kian Eng Ong, Xinge Zhao, Beijia Lu, Dezhao Huang, Evan Ling, Weiling Chen, Keng Teck Ma, Minhoe Hur, Jun Liu*
abstract: Knowing merely where the target is located is not sufficient for many real-life scenarios. In contrast, capturing rich details about the tracked target via its semantic trajectory, i.e. who/what this target is interacting with and when, where, and how they are interacting over time, is especially crucial and beneficial for various applications (e.g., customer analytics, public safety). We term such tracking as Semantic Tracking and define it as tracking the target based on the user’s input and then, most importantly, capturing the semantic trajectory of this target. Acquiring such information can have significant impacts on sales, public safety, etc. However, currently, there is no dataset for such comprehensive tracking of the target. To address this gap, we create SemTrack, a large and comprehensive dataset containing annotations of the target’s semantic trajectory. The dataset contains 6.7 million frames from 6961 videos, covering a wide range of 52 different interaction classes with 115 different object classes spanning 10 different supercategories in 12 types of different scenes, including both indoor and outdoor environments. We also propose SemTracker, a simple and effective method, and incorporate a meta-learning approach to better handle the challenges of this task. Our dataset and code can be found at https://sutdcv.github. io/SemTrack.

title: 杜鹏辉, 王宇, 孙毅凡, 王路亭, 廖悦, 张刚, 丁尔瑞, 王燕*, 王景东, 刘思*
title_en: Penghui Du, Yu Wang, Yifan Sun, Luting Wang, Yue Liao, gang zhang, Errui Ding, Yan Wang*, Jingdong Wang, Si Liu*
abstract: 现有方法通过利用视觉-语言模型(VLMs)如CLIP的鲁棒开放词汇识别能力来增强开放词汇目标检测。然而,出现了两个主要挑战:(1)概念表示的不足,其中CLIP的文本空间中的类别名称缺乏文本和视觉知识。(2)对基础类别的过拟合倾向,在从VLMs转移到检测器时,开放词汇知识偏向于基础类别。为了解决这些挑战,我们提出了语言模型指令(LaMI)策略,该策略利用视觉概念之间的关系,并在简单而有效的DETR-like检测器(称为LaMI-DETR)中应用这些关系。LaMI利用GPT构建视觉概念,并使用T5研究类别间的视觉相似性。这些跨类别的关系优化了概念表示并避免了对基础类别的过拟合。全面的实验验证了我们的方法在相同严格设置下优于现有方法,且无需依赖外部训练资源。LaMI-DETR在OV-LVIS上实现了罕见框AP为43.4,超过了之前的最佳成绩7.8个罕见框AP。
abstract_en: Existing methods enhance open-vocabulary object detection by leveraging the robust open-vocabulary recognition capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), such as CLIP. However, two main challenges emerge: (1) A deficiency in concept representation, where the category names in CLIP’s text space lack textual and visual knowledge. (2) An overfitting tendency towards base categories, with the open vocabulary knowledge biased towards base categories during the transfer from VLMs to detectors. To address these challenges, we propose the Language Model Instruction (LaMI) strategy, which leverages the relationships between visual concepts and applies them within a simple yet effective DETR-like detector, termed LaMI-DETR. LaMI utilizes GPT to construct visual concepts and employs T5 to investigate visual similarities across categories. These inter-category relationships refine concept representation and avoid overfitting to base categories. Comprehensive experiments validate our approach’s superior performance over existing methods in the same rigorous setting without reliance on external training resources. LaMI-DETR achieves a rare box AP of 43.4 on OV-LVIS, surpassing the previous best by 7.8 rare box AP.

title: Pengkun Jiao*, Na Zhao*, Jingjing Chen, Yu-Gang Jiang
title_en: Pengkun Jiao*, Na Zhao*, Jingjing Chen, Yu-Gang Jiang
abstract: 开放词汇三维目标检测(OV-3DDet)旨在对任意新三维场景中的已知和未知物体类别进行定位和识别。尽管语言和视觉基础模型在处理各种开放词汇任务时取得了成功,但OV-3DDet面临训练数据有限的显著挑战。虽然一些开创性工作已将视觉-语言模型(VLM)知识整合到OV-3DDet学习中,但这些基础模型的全部潜力尚未被充分挖掘。在本文中,我们通过利用语言和视觉基础模型,解锁文本和视觉智慧以解决开放词汇三维检测任务。我们利用视觉基础模型为三维场景中发现新类别提供图像级指导。具体而言,我们采用目标检测视觉基础模型,实现图像中零样本物体的发现,这作为识别新三维物体的初始种子和过滤指导。此外,为使三维空间与强大的视觉-语言空间对齐,我们引入分层对齐方法,通过预训练VLM在实例、类别和场景层级上将三维特征空间与视觉-语言特征空间对齐。通过大量实验,我们展示了准确率和泛化能力的显著提升,突显了基础模型在推动开放词汇三维目标检测在现实场景中发展的潜力。
abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D object detection (OV-3DDet) aims to localize and recognize both seen and previously unseen object categories within any new 3D scene. While language and vision foundation models have achieved success in handling various open-vocabulary tasks with abundant training data, OV-3DDet faces a significant challenge due to the limited availability of training data. Although some pioneering efforts have integrated vision-language models (VLM) knowledge into OV-3DDet learning, the full potential of these foundational models has yet to be fully exploited. In this paper, we unlock the textual and visual wisdom to tackle the open-vocabulary 3D detection task by leveraging the language and vision foundation models. We leverage a vision foundation model to provide image-wise guidance for discovering novel classes in 3D scenes. Specifically, we utilize a object detection vision foundation model to enable the zero-shot discovery of objects in images, which serves as the initial seeds and filtering guidance to identify novel 3D objects. Additionally, to align the 3D space with the powerful vision-language space, we introduce a hierarchical alignment approach, where the 3D feature space is aligned with the vision-language feature space using a pretrained VLM at the instance, category, and scene levels. Through extensive experimentation, we demonstrate significant improvements in accuracy and generalization, highlighting the potential of foundation models in advancing open-vocabulary 3D object detection in real-world scenarios.

title: Penglei Sun, Yaoxian Song, Xinglin Pan, Peijie Dong, Xiaofei Yang, Qiang Wang*, Zhixu Li, Tiefeng Li, Xiaowen Chu*
title_en: Penglei Sun, Yaoxian Song, Xinglin Pan, Peijie Dong, Xiaofei Yang, Qiang Wang*, Zhixu Li, Tiefeng Li, Xiaowen Chu*
abstract: 现有针对三维对象的物体级语言接地研究主要通过利用现成的预训练模型捕捉特征(如视角选择或几何先验)来提升性能。然而,这些方法未能考虑探索语言-视觉对齐的跨模态表示在跨领域场景中的应用。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种名为DA4LG的新型方法,用于三维对象的语言接地领域自适应。具体而言,所提出的DA4LG包含一个结合多任务学习的视觉适配器模块,通过全面的多模态特征表示实现视觉-语言对齐。实验结果表明,DA4LG在视觉和非视觉语言描述中均表现出竞争力,且不受观察完整性的影响。在语言接地基准SNARE中,DA4LG在单视角设置和多视角设置下的准确率分别达到83.8%和86.8%,均达到最先进水平。模拟实验显示,与现有方法相比,DA4LG展现出良好的实用性和泛化性能。我们的项目可在https://sites.google.com/view/da4lg获取。
abstract_en: The existing works on object-level language grounding with 3D objects mostly focus on improving performance by utilizing the off-the-shelf pre-trained models to capture features, such as viewpoint selection or geometric priors. However, they have failed to consider exploring the cross-modal representation of language-vision alignment in the cross-domain field. To answer this problem, we propose a novel method called Domain Adaptation for Language Grounding (DA4LG) with 3D objects. Specifically, the proposed DA4LG consists of a visual adapter module with multi-task learning to realize vision-language alignment by comprehensive multimodal feature representation. Experimental results demonstrate that DA4LG competitively performs across visual and non-visual language descriptions, independent of the completeness of observation. DA4LG achieves state-of-the-art performance in the single-view setting and multi-view setting with the accuracy of 83.8% and 86.8% respectively in the language grounding benchmark SNARE. The simulation experiments show the well-practical and generalized performance of DA4LG compared to the existing methods. Our project is available at https://sites.google.com/view/da4lg.

title: Pengwei Yin*, Jingjing Wang, Guanzhong Zeng, Di Xie, Jiang Zhu
title_en: Pengwei Yin*, Jingjing Wang, Guanzhong Zeng, Di Xie, Jiang Zhu
abstract: 注视估计模型的泛化能力常因与注视无关的各种因素而显著受限,尤其是在训练数据集有限的情况下。当前策略通过不同的领域泛化技术来应对这一挑战,但由于仅依赖值标签进行回归时存在过拟合风险,这些方法取得的成效有限。近年来预训练视觉-语言模型的进展促使我们利用丰富的语义信息。本文提出了一种新颖的方法,将注视估计任务重新框架为视觉-语言对齐问题。我们提出的框架名为语言引导的注视估计(LG-Gaze),通过视觉-语言模型丰富的先验知识,学习连续且几何敏感的注视估计特征。具体而言,LG-Gaze通过我们提出的多模态对比回归损失,将注视特征与连续语言特征对齐,为不同负样本定制自适应权重。此外,为更好地适应注视估计任务的标签,我们提出了一种几何感知插值方法以获得更精确的注视嵌入。通过大量实验,我们验证了该框架在四个不同跨域评估任务中的有效性。
abstract_en: The ability of gaze estimation models to generalize is often significantly hindered by various factors unrelated to gaze, especially when the training dataset is limited. Current strategies aim to address this challenge through different domain generalization techniques, yet they have had limited success due to the risk of overfitting when solely relying on value labels for regression. Recent progress in pre-trained vision-language models has motivated us to capitalize on the abundant semantic information available. We propose a novel approach in this paper, reframing the gaze estimation task as a vision-language alignment issue. Our proposed framework, named Language-Guided Gaze Estimation (LG-Gaze), learns continuous and geometry-sensitive features for gaze estimation benefit from the rich prior knowledges of vision-language models. Specifically, LG-Gaze aligns gaze features with continuous linguistic features through our proposed multimodal contrastive regression loss, which customizes adaptive weights for different negative samples. Furthermore, to better adapt to the labels for gaze estimation task, we propose a geometry-aware interpolation method to obtain more precise gaze embeddings. Through extensive experiments, we validate the efficacy of our framework in four different cross-domain evaluation tasks.

title: 丁鹏翔、赵涵、张文杰、宋文轩、张敏、黄世腾、杨宁溪、王东林*
title_en: Pengxiang Ding, Han Zhao, Wenjie Zhang, Wenxuan Song, Min Zhang, Siteng Huang, Ningxi Yang, Donglin Wang*
abstract: 机器人智能的重要体现是能够自然交互并自主决策的能力。传统四足机器人学习通常将语言交互和视觉自主感知分开处理,虽然简化了系统设计,但也限制了不同信息流之间的协同。这种分离在实现无缝自主推理、决策和动作执行方面带来了挑战。为解决这些局限性,本文引入了一种新型范式,名为四足机器人视觉-语言-动作任务(QUAR-VLA)。该方法紧密整合视觉信息和指令以生成可执行动作,有效融合感知、规划和决策。核心思想是提升机器人的整体智能水平。在此框架下,一个显著挑战在于将细粒度指令与视觉感知信息对齐。这强调了确保机器人准确解读并根据视觉观察执行详细指令的复杂性。因此,我们提出了四足机器人变压器(QUART),一种VLA模型,可将来自不同模态的视觉信息和指令作为输入,并生成适用于现实机器人可执行动作,同时发布了四足机器人数据集(QUARD),一个包含感知、导航及全身操作等高级能力的大型多任务数据集,用于训练QUART模型。我们的广泛评估表明,该方法实现了高性能的机器人策略,并使QUART具备多种泛化能力。
abstract_en: The important manifestation of robot intelligence is the ability to naturally interact and autonomously make decisions. Traditional quadruped robot learning typically handles language interaction and visual autonomous perception separately, which, while simplifying system design, also limits the synergy between different information streams. This separation poses challenges in achieving seamless autonomous reasoning, decision-making, and action execution. To address these limitations, a novel paradigm, named Vision-Language-Action tasks for QUAdruped Robots (QUAR-VLA), has been introduced in this paper. This approach tightly integrates visual information and instructions to generate executable actions, effectively merging perception, planning, and decision-making. The central idea is to elevate the overall intelligence of the robot. Within this framework, a notable challenge lies in aligning fine-grained instructions with visual perception information. This emphasizes the complexity involved in ensuring that the robot accurately interprets and acts upon detailed instructions in harmony with its visual observations.
