Consequently, we propose QUAdruped Robotic Transformer (QUART), a VLA model to integrate visual information and instructions from diverse modalities as input and generates executable actions for real-world robots and present QUAdruped Robot Dataset (QUARD), a large-scale multi-task dataset including perception, navigation and advanced capability like whole-body manipulation tasks for training QUART model. Our extensive evaluation shows that our approach leads to performant robotic policies and enables QUART to obtain a range of generalization capabilities.

title: Pengyu Li*, biao wang, Tianchu Guo, Xian-Sheng Hua
title_en: Pengyu Li*, biao wang, Tianchu Guo, Xian-Sheng Hua
abstract: 近年来,基于Transformer的大规模视觉模型,如Segment Anything Model (SAM)和Stable Diffusion (SD),在计算机视觉领域取得了显著成功。然而,Transformer的多头注意力机制(MHA)中的四次方复杂度导致了输入输出均为高分辨率的模型产生显著的计算开销。尽管已有若干研究尝试缓解这一挑战,但尚未有方法能在不需大量努力和GPU小时数重新训练或微调模型的前提下,有效降低大规模视觉模型的复杂度和延迟。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种简单而有效的即插即用Transformer模块——Grid-Attention(GridAttn)。GridAttn通过集成提出的Grid Clustering模块、Grid Distributing策略和Grid Recovering模块与常规MHA,提升大规模视觉模型的计算效率,同时在无需重新训练或微调参数的情况下保持其性能。我们在近期的高分辨率任务上进行了大量实验,包括零样本实例分割(SAM、Expedit-SAM)、文本到图像生成(Stable Diffusion V2.1)和语义分割(SegFormer B0-B5)。实验表明:无需任何训练或微调,GridAttn可将GFLOPs降低4.6%-16.1%,GPU推理延迟降低8.2%-21.4%,同时保持等效性能(性能偏差比小于1%)。此外,实验还表明GridAttn也可从头训练或以极小的微调成本进行微调,从而显著提升性能-效率的平衡。作为建议,我们鼓励社区在部署已训练良好的Transformer模型、微调预训练模型或从头训练新模型时,采用我们的GridAttn。源代码将在https://github.com/pengyuLPY/GridAttn发布。
abstract_en: Recently, transformer-based large vision models, , the Segment Anything Model (SAM) and Stable Diffusion (SD), have achieved remarkable success in the computer vision field. However, the quartic complexity within the transformer’s Multi-Head Attention (MHA) leads to substantial computational costs in these models whose inputs and outputs are high-resolution. Although several prior works attempted to alleviate this challenge, none have successfully reduced the complexity and latency of large vision models while preserving their remarkable capabilities without requiring enormous efforts and GPU hours to re-train or fine-tune the models. To address the challenge, we propose a simple yet effective plug-and-play transformer block called Grid-Attention(GridAttn). The GridAttn integrates the proposed Grid Clustering module, Grid Distributing strategies, and Grid Recovering module with common MHA to enhance the large vision models’ computational efficiency and preserve their performance without the need for re-training or fine-tuning their parameters. We conduct extensive experiments on recent high-resolution tasks, including zero-shot instance segmentation (SAM, Expedit-SAM), text-to-image generation (Stable Diffusion V2.1), and semantic segmentation (SegFormer B0-B5). The experiments demonstrate that: Without any training or fine-tuning, GridAttn reduces GFlops by the range of [4.6%, 16.1%] and GPU inference latency by [8.2%, 21.4%], all while achieving equivalent performance (the performance bias ratio is less than 1%). Furthermore, the experiments present that GridAttn can also be trained from scratch or fine-tuned with very slight fine-tuning costs, resulting in a significantly improved performance-efficiency tradeoff. As a recommendation, we encourage the community to incorporate our GridAttn whenever deploying a well-trained transformer directly, fine-tuning a pre-trained one, or training a new one from scratch. The source code will be released in https://github.com/pengyuLPY/GridAttn.

title: Pengyu Zhang*, Hao Yin, Zeren Wang, Wenyue Chen, Sheng Ming Li, Dong Wang, Huchuan Lu, Xu Jia
title_en: Pengyu Zhang*, Hao Yin, Zeren Wang, Wenyue Chen, Sheng Ming Li, Dong Wang, Huchuan Lu, Xu Jia
abstract: 手语是听力障碍人群最有效的沟通工具之一。现有大多数工作聚焦于提升RGB视频中手语任务的性能,但此类方法可能受录制条件退化的影响,例如手部快速运动导致的运动模糊以及手语者纹理外观的变化。仿生事件相机能够以高速异步捕捉亮度变化,可自然感知动态手部运动,为手语任务提供丰富的手部线索。本文旨在探索事件相机在连续手语识别(CSLR)和手语翻译(SLT)中的潜力。为推动相关研究,我们首先收集了一个基于事件的基准数据集EvSign,该数据集包含手语词汇和语音语言标注。EvSign数据集提供了大量高质量的事件流以及丰富的手语词汇和单词词汇表,从而促进手语任务的发展。此外,我们提出了一种高效的基于Transformer的框架,用于事件驱动的手语识别和翻译任务,充分利用了流式事件的优势。通过稀疏主干网络提取稀疏事件的视觉特征,再通过所提出的局部token融合和基于手语的时间聚合模块有效利用时间一致性。在模拟数据集(PHOENIX14T)和EvSign数据集上进行了大量实验。我们的方法仅以0.34%的计算成本(每视频0.84G FLOPS)和44.2%的网络参数优于现有最先进方法。项目地址:https://zhang-pengyu.github.io/EVSign
abstract_en: Sign language is one of the most effective communication tools for people with hearing difficulties. Most existing works focus on improving the performance of sign language tasks on RGB videos, which may suffer from degraded recording conditions, such as fast movement of hands with motion blur and textured signer’s appearance. The bio-inspired event camera, which asynchronously captures brightness change with high speed, could naturally perceive dynamic hand movements, providing rich manual clues for sign language tasks. In this work, we aim at exploring the potential of event camera in continuous sign language recognition (CSLR) and sign language translation (SLT). To promote the research, we first collect an event-based benchmark EvSign for those tasks with both gloss and spoken language annotations. EvSign dataset offers a substantial amount of high-quality event streams and an extensive vocabulary of glosses and words, thereby facilitating the development of sign language tasks. In addition, we propose an efficient transformer-based framework for event-based SLR and SLT tasks, which fully leverages the advantages of streaming events. The sparse backbone is employed to extract visual features from sparse events. Then, the temporal coherence is effectively utilized through the proposed local token fusion and gloss-aware temporal aggregation modules. Extensive experimental results are reported on both simulated (PHOENIX14T) and EvSign datasets. Our method performs favorably against existing state-of-the-art approaches with only 0.34% computational cost (0.84G FLOPS per video) and 44.2% network parameters. The project is available at https://zhang-pengyu.github.io/EVSign.

title: 王鹏远*, 池田隆也, 罗伯特·李, 西川浩一
title_en: Pengyuan Wang*, Takuya Ikeda, Robert Lee, Koichi Nishiwaki
abstract: 类别级姿态估计是一项具有广泛潜在应用的挑战性任务,在计算机视觉和机器人学领域。近年来,基于深度学习的方法取得了显著进展,但通常受限于需要大量带有姿态标注的真实图像数据集或精心调校的逼真模拟器。通过仅使用几何输入(如深度图像)可以避免这一问题,从而减少领域差距,但这些方法缺乏语义信息,而语义信息在姿态估计问题中至关重要。为解决这一矛盾,我们提出利用预训练基础模型获取的几何和语义特征。我们的方法将2D语义特征投影到物体模型中,生成3D语义点云。基于这种新颖的3D表示,我们进一步提出了一种自监督流程,并将融合的语义点云与合成对象模型的合成渲染部分观测进行匹配。从合成数据中学习到的知识无需任何微调即可泛化到真实场景中未见过的物体观测。我们在NOCS、Wild6D和SUN RGB-D基准数据集上进行了丰富评估,结果表明,与仅几何或仅语义基线方法相比,在训练物体数量显著减少的情况下表现出优越性能。
abstract_en: Category-level pose estimation is a challenging task with many potential applications in computer vision and robotics. Recently, deep-learning-based approaches have made great progress, but are typically hindered by the need for large datasets of either pose-labelled real images or carefully tuned photorealistic simulators. This can be avoided by using only geometry inputs such as depth images to reduce the domain-gap but these approaches suffer from a lack of semantic information, which can be vital in the pose estimation problem. To resolve this conflict, we propose to utilize both geometric and semantic features obtained from a pre-trained foundation model. Our approach projects 2D semantic features into object models as 3D semantic point clouds. Based on the novel 3D representation, we further propose a self-supervision pipeline, and match the fused semantic point clouds against their synthetic rendered partial observations from synthetic object models. The learned knowledge from synthetic data generalizes to observations of unseen objects in the real scenes, without any fine-tuning. We demonstrate this with a rich evaluation on the NOCS, Wild6D and SUN RGB-D benchmarks, showing superior performance over geometric-only and semantic-only baselines with significantly fewer training objects.

title: 李鹏志,聂强,陈颖,江溪,吴凯,林宇涵,刘勇,彭金龙,王成杰,郑峰*
title_en: Pengzhi Li, Qiang Nie, Ying Chen, Xi Jiang, Kai Wu, Yuhuan Lin, Yong Liu, Jinlong Peng, Chengjie Wang, Feng Zheng*
abstract: 尽管扩散模型在图像定制方面取得了显著进展,当前方法仍存在若干局限性:1)在重新生成整张图像时,非目标区域出现意外变化;2)仅通过参考图像或文本描述进行引导;3)耗时的微调过程限制了其实际应用。为此,我们提出了一种无需微调的框架,实现文本-图像引导的图像定制,可在数秒内精确编辑特定图像区域。我们的方法在保留参考图像主体语义特征的同时,允许基于文本描述修改详细属性。为实现这一目标,我们提出了一种创新的注意力融合策略,在去噪过程中通过UNet解码器融合自注意力特征。据我们所知,这是首个无需微调且同时利用文本和图像引导进行特定区域图像定制的方法。我们的方法在人类评估和定量评估中均优于先前方法,为图像合成、设计和创意摄影等实际应用提供了高效的解决方案。项目页面:https://zrealli.github.io/TIGIC.
abstract_en: Despite significant advancements in image customization with diffusion models, current methods still have several limitations: 1) unintended changes in non-target areas when regenerating the entire image; 2) guidance solely by a reference image or text descriptions; and 3) time-consuming fine-tuning, which limits their practical application. In response, we introduce a tuning-free framework for simultaneous text-image-guided image customization, enabling precise editing of specific image regions within seconds. Our approach preserves the semantic features of the reference image subject while allowing modification of detailed attributes based on text descriptions. To achieve this, we propose an innovative attention blending strategy that blends self-attention features in the UNet decoder during the denoising process. To our knowledge, this is the first tuning-free method that concurrently utilizes text and image guidance for image customization in specific regions. Our approach outperforms previous methods in both human and quantitative evaluations, providing an efficient solution for various practical applications, such as image synthesis, design, and creative photography. Project page: https://zrealli.github.io/TIGIC.

title: Petr Hruby*, Marc Pollefeys, Daniel Barath
title_en: Petr Hruby*, Marc Pollefeys, Daniel Barath
abstract: 我们研究了半校准相对姿态估计问题,假设主点位于图像中心,并估计两个相机的焦距、相对旋转和翻译。我们引入了第一个最小求解器,仅需要一个单个仿射对应关系以及预测的单目深度。认识到当对应关系来自正交平面时的退化情况,我们提出了一个替代求解器,能够自动在这些情况下恢复正确的解。通过将这些方法整合到GC-RANSAC框架中,我们展示了它们超越标准方法,能够在大规模、公开可用的室内和室外数据集上以相当的运行时间提供更准确的姿态和焦距。代码可在https://github.com/petrhruby97/semicalibrated 1AC D上获取。
abstract_en: We address the semi-calibrated relative pose estimation problem where we assume the principal point to be located in the center of the image and estimate the focal lengths, relative rotation, and translation of two cameras. We introduce the first minimal solver that requires only a single affine correspondence in conjunction with predicted monocular depth. Recognizing its degeneracy when the correspondence stems from a fronto-parallel plane, we present an alternative solver adept at automatically recovering the correct solution under such circumstances. By integrating these methods within the GC-RANSAC framework, we show they surpass standard approaches, delivering more accurate poses and focal lengths at comparable runtimes across large-scale, publicly available indoor and outdoor datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/petrhruby97/semicalibrated 1AC D.

title: Philip Müller*, Georgios Kaissis, Daniel Rueckert
title_en: Philip Müller*, Georgios Kaissis, Daniel Rueckert
abstract: 报告生成模型能够对医学图像(如胸部X光)提供细致的文本解释,但它们通常缺乏交互性(通过用户查询引导生成过程的能力)和局部可解释性(以可视化方式定位预测结果),我们认为这些是未来在临床实践中采用的关键要素。尽管已有研究尝试解决这些问题,但现有方法要么因不支持文本查询而限制了交互性,要么未能同时提供局部可解释性。因此,我们提出了一种新型的多任务架构和训练范式,整合文本提示和边界框,以处理解剖区域和病理等多样化方面。我们将这种方法称为胸部X光解释器(ChEX)。在涵盖9种异构胸部X光任务的评估中,包括局部图像解释和报告生成,结果显示其与最先进模型具有竞争力,进一步分析还验证了ChEX的交互能力。代码:https://github.com/philip-mueller/chex
abstract_en: Report generation models offer fine-grained textual interpretations of medical images like chest X-rays, yet they often lack interactivity (the ability to steer the generation process through user queries) and localized interpretability (visually grounding their predictions), which we deem essential for future adoption in clinical practice. While there have been efforts to tackle these issues, they are either limited in their interactivity by not supporting textual queries or fail to also offer localized interpretability. Therefore, we propose a novel multitask architecture and training paradigm integrating textual prompts and bounding boxes for diverse aspects like anatomical regions and pathologies. We call this approach the Chest X-Ray Explainer (ChEX). Evaluations across a heterogeneous set of 9 chest X-ray tasks, including localized image interpretation and report generation, showcase its competitiveness with SOTA models while additional analysis demonstrates ChEX’s interactive capabilities. Code: https://github. com/philip-mueller/chex.

title: Phillip Y. Lee, Minhyuk Sung*
title_en: Phillip Y. Lee, Minhyuk Sung*
abstract: 当图像生成过程同时受到文本提示和空间线索(如一组边界框)的引导时,这些元素是协同工作还是其中一个主导另一个?我们分析了一个集成门控自注意力机制的预训练图像扩散模型,发现由于门控自注意力到交叉注意力的序列流动,空间定位通常会超过文本定位。我们证明,通过简单地重新设计网络架构,将门控自注意力和交叉注意力从顺序结构改为并行结构,可以在不牺牲定位准确性的前提下显著减轻这种偏差。这种出人意料的简单而有效的解决方案不需要对网络进行任何微调,但大大减少了两种定位之间的权衡。我们的实验表明,与原始GLIGEN相比,重新设计的版本在文本定位和空间定位之间的权衡上取得了显著改进。项目网页地址为https://re-ground.github.io。
abstract_en: When an image generation process is guided by both a text prompt and spatial cues, such as a set of bounding boxes, do these elements work in harmony, or does one dominate the other? Our analysis of a pretrained image diffusion model that integrates gated self-attention into the U-Net reveals that spatial grounding often outweighs textual grounding due to the sequential flow from gated self-attention to cross-attention. We demonstrate that such bias can be significantly mitigated without sacrificing accuracy in either grounding by simply rewiring the network architecture, changing from sequential to parallel for gated self-attention and cross-attention. This surprisingly simple yet effective solution does not require any fine-tuning of the network but substantially reduces the trade-off between the two groundings. Our experiments demonstrate significant improvements from the original GLIGEN to the rewired version in the trade-off between textual grounding and spatial grounding. The project webpage is at https://re-ground.github.io.

title: Phuong Hoang Dam*, Jihoon Jeong*, Anh T Tran*, Daeyoung Kim*
title_en: Phuong Hoang Dam*, Jihoon Jeong*, Anh T Tran*, Daeyoung Kim*
abstract: 本研究探讨了虚拟试穿在当代电子商务和未来元宇宙中的关键问题,强调了在不同场景下保持目标人物和衣物复杂纹理细节及独特特征(如服装纹理、身份特征如纹身或配饰)的挑战。除了合成图像的保真度外,合成过程的效率也是一项重大障碍。本文探讨了各种现有方法,指出了其局限性和未解决的问题,例如身份信息缺失、不可控的伪影和低合成速度。随后提出了一种基于扩散的新型解决方案,用于在虚拟试穿过程中保留衣物纹理和用户身份特征。所提出的网络包含两个主要模块——一个对齐衣物与个体特征的变形模块,以及一个优化着装并生成缺失部分的试穿模块,结合了掩码感知的后处理技术以确保个体身份的完整性。实验结果令人印象深刻,在推理过程中速度比当前最先进的方法快近20倍,定性评估中保真度表现优异。定量评估证实了在VITON-HD和Dresscode数据集上与最新SOTA方法的性能相当。我们将模型命名为快速且保留身份的虚拟试穿模型(FIP-VITON)。
abstract_en: This study discusses the critical issues of Virtual Try-On in contemporary e-commerce and the prospective metaverse, emphasizing the challenges of preserving intricate texture details and distinctive features of the target person and the clothes in various scenarios, such as clothing texture and identity characteristics like tattoos or accessories. In addition to the fidelity of the synthesized images, the efficiency of the synthesis process presents a significant hurdle. Various existing approaches are explored, highlighting the limitations and unresolved aspects, e.g., identity information omission, uncontrollable artifacts, and low synthesis speed. It then proposes a novel diffusion-based solution that addresses garment texture preservation and user identity retention during virtual try-on. The proposed network comprises two primary modules - a warping module aligning clothing with individual features and a try-on module refining the attire and generating missing parts integrated with a mask-aware post-processing technique ensuring the integrity of the individual’s identity. It demonstrates impressive results, surpassing the state-of-the-art in speed by nearly 20 times during inference, with superior fidelity in qualitative assessments. Quantitative evaluations confirm comparable performance with the recent SOTA method on the VITON-HD and Dresscode datasets. We named our model Fast and Identity Preservation Virtual TryON (FIP-VITON).

title: Pilhyeon Lee*, Hyeran Byun
title_en: Pilhyeon Lee*, Hyeran Byun
abstract: 时序句子定位旨在定位与语言描述相关的时刻。近年来,类似DETR的方法通过预测目标时刻的中心和长度取得了显著进展。然而,它们受到时刻中心固有模糊性导致的中心错位问题的影响,导致预测不准确。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的边界导向的时刻建模方法。在我们的方法中,模型不再需要精确找到中心,而是只需预测区间内的任意锚点,从而直接估计边界。基于这一思想,我们设计了一种边界对齐的时刻检测变压器,配备了双通道解码过程。具体而言,它分别通过全局注意力和边界聚焦注意力在并行路径中细化锚点和边界。这种独立的设计使模型能够专注于理想的区域,从而实现对时刻预测的精确细化。此外,我们提出了一种基于质量的排序方法,确保高质量定位的提案优先于不完整的提案。在三个基准测试上的实验验证了所提方法的有效性。代码可在以下链接获取。
abstract_en: Temporal sentence grounding aims to localize moments relevant to a language description. Recently, DETR-like approaches achieved notable progress by predicting the center and length of a target moment. However, they suffer from the issue of center misalignment raised by the inherent ambiguity of moment centers, leading to inaccurate predictions. To remedy this problem, we propose a novel boundary-oriented moment formulation. In our paradigm, the model no longer needs to find the precise center but instead suffices to predict any anchor point within the interval, from which the boundaries are directly estimated. Based on this idea, we design a boundary-aligned moment detection transformer, equipped with a dual-pathway decoding process. Specifically, it refines the anchor and boundaries within parallel pathways using global and boundary-focused attention, respectively. This separate design allows the model to focus on desirable regions, enabling precise refinement of moment predictions. Further, we propose a quality-based ranking method, ensuring that proposals with high localization qualities are prioritized over incomplete ones. Experiments on three benchmarks validate the effectiveness of the proposed methods. The code is available here.

title: Ping Wang*, Yulun Zhang, Lishun Wang, Xin Yuan*
title_en: Ping Wang*, Yulun Zhang, Lishun Wang, Xin Yuan*
abstract: Transformer模型在解决视频的快照压缩成像(SCI)逆问题中已取得最先进性能,其病态性源于空间掩码与时间混叠的混合退化。然而,先前的Transformer模型缺乏对退化的深入理解,导致性能和效率受限。本文设计了一种无需早期层时间聚合的高效重建架构,并以分层可分离视频变换器(HiSViT)作为基本模块。HiSViT由多个交叉尺度可分离多头自注意力(CSS-MSA)和门控自调节前馈网络(GSM-FFN)组构成,通过密集连接实现多尺度交互和长程建模。CSS-MSA通过将空间操作与时间操作分离,引入了在帧内而非帧间更关注的归纳偏差,同时节省计算开销。GSM-FFN进一步通过门控机制和分解的时空卷积增强局部性。大量实验表明,我们的方法在参数和复杂度相当或更少的情况下,性能优于先前方法>0.5 dB。源代码和预训练模型已发布于https://github.com/pwangcs/HiSViT。
abstract_en: Transformers have achieved the state-of-the-art performance on solving the inverse problem of Snapshot Compressive Imaging (SCI) for video, whose ill-posedness is rooted in the mixed degradation of spatial masking and temporal aliasing. However, previous Transformers lack an insight into the degradation and thus have limited performance and efficiency. In this work, we tailor an efficient reconstruction architecture without temporal aggregation in early layers and Hierarchical Separable Video Transformer (HiSViT) as building block. HiSViT is built by multiple groups of Cross-Scale Separable Multi-head Self-Attention (CSS-MSA) and Gated Self-Modulated Feed-Forward Network (GSM-FFN) with dense connections, each of which is conducted within a separate channel portions at a different scale, for multi-scale interactions and long-range modeling. By separating spatial operations from temporal ones, CSS-MSA introduces an inductive bias of paying more attention within frames instead of between frames while saving computational overheads. GSM-FFN further enhances the locality via gated mechanism and factorized spatial-temporal convolutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms previous methods by > 0.5 dB with comparable or fewer parameters and complexity. The source codes and pretrained models are released at https://github.com/pwangcs/HiSViT.

title: 蔡平平*、张灿宇、施灵佳、王丽丽、纳斯林·伊曼普尔、王松
title_en: Pingping Cai*, Canyu Zhang, LINGJIA SHI, Lili Wang, Nasrin Imanpour, Song Wang
abstract: 扫描点云由于传感设备视场限制通常稀疏且不完整,显著阻碍了下游应用的性能。因此引入点云补全任务,旨在从不完整输入中获得密集且完整的点云。解决该任务的根本挑战涉及准确推断缺失形状并将其上采样至更高密度。本文提出一种新方法,将补全任务建模为双重问题:特征级外推问题,通过将部分点云的形状特征外推至离群区域以恢复缺失部分;以及特征级插值问题以实现点云上采样。基于此,我们提出EINet,一种新型点云补全范式,包含可预测部分点云缺失形状的新型外推模块,以及专门设计的插值模块用于点云上采样。大量实验结果表明,EINet相比先前最先进方法表现出色。代码已开源于https://github.com/corecai163/EINet。
abstract_en: Scanned point clouds are often sparse and incomplete due to the limited field of view of sensing devices, significantly impeding the performance of downstream applications. Therefore, the task of point cloud completion is introduced to obtain a dense and complete point cloud from the incomplete input. The fundamental challenges in tackling this task involve accurately inferring the missing shapes and upsampling them to higher densities. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to address this task, which formulates the completion task as a dual problem: a feature-wise extrapolation problem where the shape features of the partial point cloud are extrapolated to outlier regions for the recovery of missing portions, and a feature-wise interpolation problem to achieve point cloud upsampling. Based on these, we propose the EINet, a new point cloud completion paradigm with a novel Extrapolation module that can predict the missing shapes for the partial point cloud and a newly designed Interpolation module to upsample the point cloud. Extensive evaluation results demonstrate that EINet achieves compelling performance compared to previous state-of-the-art methods. The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/corecai163/EINet.

title: 陈平义*, 朱成露, 郑苏仪, 李红林, 杨林*
title_en: Pingyi Chen*, Chenglu Zhu, Sunyi Zheng, Honglin Li, Lin Yang*
abstract: 全切片成像被常规用于癌症诊断和预后评估。病理医生需要丰富的经验才能获得全切片图像(WSI)准确可靠的诊断结果。WSI的巨大尺寸和异质性特征使得病理阅片流程极其耗时。本文提出了一种新颖框架(WSI-VQA),通过生成式视觉问答技术来解释WSI。WSI-VQA通过将各种切片级任务重构为问答模式展现出普适性,使病理医生能够通过人机交互实现免疫组化分级、生存预测和肿瘤亚型分类。此外,我们构建了一个WSI-VQA数据集,包含977个WSI的8672个切片级问答对。除了能够处理不同切片级任务外,我们提出的生成模型Wsi2Text Transformer(W2T)在医学正确性方面优于现有判别模型,揭示了该模型在临床场景中的应用潜力。此外,我们还通过词嵌入与WSI之间的共注意力映射可视化,为诊断结果提供直观解释。数据集和相关代码可在https://github.com/cpystan/WSI-VQA获取。
abstract_en: Whole slide imaging is routinely adopted for carcinoma diagnosis and prognosis. Abundant experience is required for pathologists to achieve accurate and reliable diagnostic results of whole slide images (WSI). The huge size and heterogeneous features of WSIs make the workflow of pathological reading extremely time-consuming. In this paper, we propose a novel framework (WSI-VQA) to interpret WSIs by generative visual question answering. WSI-VQA shows universality by reframing various kinds of slide-level tasks in a question-answering pattern, in which pathologists can achieve immunohistochemical grading, survival prediction, and tumor subtyping following human-machine interaction. Furthermore, we establish a WSI-VQA dataset which contains 8672 slide-level question-answering pairs with 977 WSIs. Besides the ability to deal with different slide-level tasks, our generative model which is named Wsi2Text Transformer (W2T) outperforms existing discriminative models in medical correctness, which reveals the potential of our model to be applied in the clinical scenario. Additionally, we also visualize the co-attention mapping between word embeddings and WSIs as an intuitive explanation for diagnostic results. The dataset and related code are available at https://github.com/cpystan/WSI-VQA.

title: 陈博涵,蔡佳琪*
title_en: Po Han Chen, Chia-Chi Tsai*
abstract: 本研究中,我们引入了3D空间注意力模块(3DSA)作为解决多视角三维人体姿态估计方法缺陷的新方法。具体而言,我们利用3D空间细分算法将特征体分为多个区域,并为不同区域分配预测的3D空间注意力分数以构建具有空间注意力的特征体。3D空间注意力模块的目的是通过从对应视角获取的加权注意力调整,区分特征体中各个区域的重要性。我们在现有的基于体素的方法VoxelPose和Faster VoxelPose上进行实验。通过引入空间注意力模块,两者在CMU Panoptic Studio数据集上均实现了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: In this study, we introduce the 3D space attention module (3DSA) as a novel approach to address the drawback of multi-view 3D human pose estimation methods, which fail to recognize the object’s significance from diverse viewpoints. Specifically, we utilize the 3D space subdivision algorithm to divide the feature volume into multiple regions. Predicted 3D space attention scores are assigned to the different regions to construct the feature volume with space attention. The purpose of the 3D space attention module is to distinguish the significance of individual regions within the feature volume by applying weighted attention adjustments derived from corresponding viewpoints. We conduct experiments on existing voxel-based methods, VoxelPose and Faster VoxelPose. By incorporating the space attention module, both achieve state-of-the-art performance on the CMU Panoptic Studio dataset.

title: 古汉·普佳*, 黄宗伟, 苏冠明, 古帕拉克里希南·苏布拉达, 曼ocha·迪内什
title_en: Pooja Guhan*, Tsung-Wei Huang, Guan-Ming Su, Subhadra Gopalakrishnan, Dinesh Manocha
abstract: 我们介绍了V-Trans4Style,这是一种专为动态视频内容编辑需求设计的创新算法。它旨在将视频适配到不同的制作风格,如纪录片、剧情片、故事片或特定YouTube频道的视频制作技术。我们的算法通过更自底向上的方法推荐最佳视觉过渡,以实现这种灵活性。我们首先采用基于Transformer的编码器-解码器网络,仅使用输入视频学习推荐时间一致且视觉无缝的视觉过渡序列。随后,我们引入了一个风格条件模块,利用该模型通过激活最大化迭代调整解码器获得的视觉过渡。我们通过在新引入的AutoTransition++数据集上进行实验验证了方法的有效性。该数据集是AutoTransition数据集的6k视频版本,并额外将视频分类到不同的制作风格类别中。我们的编码器-解码器模型优于最先进的过渡推荐方法,在Recall@K和平均排名值上比基线方法提高了10%至80%。我们的风格条件模块在相似性度量下,相比其他方法平均提高了约12%的视频制作风格特征捕捉效果。我们希望我们的工作能为进一步探索和理解视频制作风格奠定基础。[项目网站]
abstract_en: We introduce V-Trans4Style, an innovative algorithm tailored for dynamic video content editing needs. It is designed to adapt videos to different production styles like documentaries, dramas, feature films, or a specific YouTube channel’s video-making technique. Our algorithm recommends optimal visual transitions to help achieve this flexibility using a more bottom-up approach. We first employ a transformer-based encoder-decoder network to learn recommending temporally consistent and visually seamless sequences of visual transitions using only the input videos. We then introduce a style conditioning module that leverages this model to iteratively adjust the visual transitions obtained from the decoder through activation maximization. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method through experiments conducted on our newly introduced AutoTransition++ dataset. It is a 6k video version of AutoTransition Dataset that additionally categorizes its videos into different production style categories. Our encoder-decoder model outperforms the state-of-the-art transition recommendation method, achieving improvements of 10% to 80% in Recall@K and mean rank values over baseline. Our style conditioning module results in visual transitions that improve the capture of the desired video production style characteristics by an average of around 12% in comparison to other methods when measured with similarity metrics. We hope that our work serves as a foundation for exploring and understanding video production styles further. [Project Website]

title: Prachi Garg*、Joseph K J、Vineeth N Balasubramanian、Necati Cihan Camgoz、Chengde Wan、Kenrick Kin、Weiguang Si、Shugao Ma、Fernando de la Torre
title_en: Prachi Garg*, Joseph K J, Vineeth N Balasubramanian, Necati Cihan Camgoz, Chengde Wan, Kenrick Kin, Weiguang Si, Shugao Ma, Fernando de la Torre
abstract: 随着扩展现实(XR)重新定义用户与计算设备的交互方式,人类动作识别的研究正在获得越来越多的关注。通常,部署在沉浸式计算设备上的模型是静态的,仅限于其默认的类别集合。我们的研究目标是为用户提供和开发者提供能力,通过不断向设备模型中添加新的动作类别来个性化他们的体验。重要的是,用户应该能够以低样本量和高效的方式添加新类别,而这一过程不应需要存储或回放任何用户的敏感训练数据。我们将这一问题形式化为隐私感知的少样本持续动作识别。为此,我们提出了POET:提示偏移调优。虽然现有的提示调优方法在图像、文本和视频模态的持续学习中表现出巨大潜力;但它们需要访问大量预训练的Transformer模型。打破这一假设,POET展示了在显著轻量级主干网络上进行提示调优的有效性,该主干网络仅在基础类别数据上进行预训练。我们提出了一种新颖的时空可学习提示偏移调优方法,并首次将此类提示调优应用于图神经网络。我们为新的人类动作识别问题设置贡献了两个新的基准:(i) NTU RGB+D数据集用于活动识别,和(ii) SHREC-2017数据集用于手部手势识别。我们发现POET在全面基准测试中表现一致优于其他方法。1 1 源代码位于POET-continual-action-recognition https://github.com/humansensinglab/
abstract_en: As extended reality (XR) is redefining how users interact with computing devices, research in human action recognition is gaining prominence. Typically, models deployed on immersive computing devices are static and limited to their default set of classes. The goal of our research is to provide users and developers with the capability to personalize their experience by adding new action classes to their device models continually. Importantly, a user should be able to add new classes in a low-shot and efficient manner, while this process should not require storing or replaying any of user’s sensitive training data. We formalize this problem as privacy-aware few-shot continual action recognition. Towards this end, we propose POET: Prompt-offset Tuning. While existing prompt tuning approaches have shown great promise for continual learning of image, text, and video modalities; they demand access to extensively pretrained transformers. Breaking away from this assumption, POET demonstrates the efficacy of prompt tuning a significantly lightweight backbone, pretrained exclusively on the base class data. We propose a novel spatio-temporal learnable prompt offset tuning approach, and are the first to apply such prompt tuning to Graph Neural Networks. We contribute two new benchmarks for our new problem setting in human action recognition: (i) NTU RGB+D dataset for activity recognition, and (ii) SHREC-2017 dataset for hand gesture recognition. We find that POET consistently outperforms comprehensive benchmarks. 1 1 Source Code at POET-continual-action-recognition https://github.com/humansensinglab/

title: Pradyumna Chari*, Anirudh Bindiganavale Harish, Adnan Armouti, Alexander Vilesov, Sanjit Sarda, Laleh Jalilian, Achuta Kadambi
title_en: Pradyumna Chari*, Anirudh Bindiganavale Harish, Adnan Armouti, Alexander Vilesov, Sanjit Sarda, Laleh Jalilian, Achuta Kadambi
abstract: 场景表示网络,或隐式神经表示(INR),在众多图像和视频应用中取得了广泛的成功。然而,作为通用函数拟合器,它们会无选择地拟合视频中的所有变化。这对于远程血流动力学测量等任务尤其成问题,该任务从面部视频中提取心率信息。由于原生信噪比较低,先前的信号处理技术性能不佳,而先前的基于学习的方法虽然提升了性能,但会产生幻觉,从而降低泛化能力。直接应用先前的INR无法解决这一信号强度不足的问题,因为它们同时拟合信号和干扰因素。在本文中,我们引入了一种INR框架,以增强该血流动力学信号强度。具体而言,我们利用架构实现选择性表示能力。我们能够将面部视频分解为血流动力学信号分量和面部外观分量。通过从该血流动力学分量推断出信号,我们在分布外样本上实现了最先进的性能,而不会牺牲分布内样本的性能。我们在一个自定义构建的多分辨率哈希编码主干上实现了该框架,通过比传统INR快50倍的速度,实现了实际数据集规模的表示。我们还提供了一个光学挑战性的分布外场景数据集,以测试对现实场景的泛化能力。代码和数据可在https://implicitppg.github.io/获取。
abstract_en: Scene representation networks, or implicit neural representations (INR) have seen a range of success in numerous image and video applications. However, being universal function fitters, they fit all variations in videos without any selectivity. This is particularly a problem for tasks such as remote plethysmography, the extraction of heart rate information from face videos. As a result of low native signal to noise ratio, previous signal processing techniques suffer from poor performance, while previous learning-based methods have improved performance but suffer from hallucinations that mitigate generalizability. Directly applying prior INRs cannot remedy this signal strength deficit, since they fit to both the signal as well as interfering factors. In this work, we introduce an INR framework that increases this plethysmograph signal strength. Specifically, we leverage architectures to have selective representation capabilities. We are able to decompose the face video into a blood plethysmograph component, and a face appearance component. By inferring the plethysmograph signal from this blood component, we show state-of-the-art performance on out-of-distribution samples without sacrificing performance for in-distribution samples. We implement our framework on a custom-built multiresolution hash encoding backbone to enable practical dataset-scale representations through a 50x speed-up over traditional INRs. We also present a dataset of optically challenging out-of-distribution scenes to test generalization to real-world scenarios. Code and data may be found at https://implicitppg.github.io/.

title: Prakash Chandra Chhipa*, Meenakshi Subhash Chippa, Kanjar De, Rajkumar Saini, Marcus Liwicki, Mubarak Shah
title_en: Prakash Chandra Chhipa*, Meenakshi Subhash Chippa, Kanjar De, Rajkumar Saini, Marcus Liwicki, Mubarak Shah
abstract: 透视失真(PD)会导致图像中视觉概念的形状、尺寸、方向、角度及其他空间关系发生前所未有的变化。精确估计相机的内参和外参是一项具有挑战性的任务,这阻碍了对透视失真的合成。缺乏专用的训练数据对开发鲁棒的计算机视觉方法构成了关键障碍。此外,失真校正方法会使其他计算机视觉任务变为多步骤流程且性能欠佳。在本工作中,我们提出通过在特定类型的莫比乌斯变换上实施细粒度参数控制,来缓解透视失真(MPD),从而在不估计相机内参和外参且无需实际失真数据的情况下建模现实世界的失真。同时,我们提出一个专用的透视失真基准数据集ImageNet-PD,用于评估深度学习模型对此新数据集的鲁棒性。所提方法在现有基准ImageNet-E和ImageNet-X上表现更优。此外,它在ImageNet-PD上显著提升性能,同时在标准数据分布上保持稳定表现。值得注意的是,我们的方法在三个受PD影响的现实应用场景——人群计数、鱼眼图像识别和行人重识别——以及一个受PD影响的挑战性计算机视觉任务:目标检测中均表现出改进性能。源代码、数据集和模型可在项目网页https://prakashchhipa.github.io/projects/mpd获取。
abstract_en: Perspective distortion (PD) causes unprecedented changes in shape, size, orientation, angles, and other spatial relationships of visual concepts in images. Precisely estimating camera intrinsic and extrinsic parameters is a challenging task that prevents synthesizing perspective distortion. Non-availability of dedicated training data poses a critical barrier to developing robust computer vision methods. Additionally, distortion correction methods make other computer vision tasks a multi-step approach and lack performance. In this work, we propose mitigating perspective distortion (MPD) by employing a fine-grained parameter control on a specific family of Möbius transform to model real-world distortion without estimating camera intrinsic and extrinsic parameters and without the need for actual distorted data. Also, we present a dedicated perspectively distorted benchmark dataset, ImageNet-PD, to benchmark the robustness of deep learning models against this new dataset. The proposed method outperforms existing benchmarks, ImageNet-E and ImageNet-X. Additionally, it significantly improves performance on ImageNet-PD while consistently performing on standard data distribution. Notably, our method shows improved performance on three PD-affected real-world applications—crowd counting, fisheye image recognition, and person re-identification—and one PD-affected challenging CV task: object detection. The source code, dataset, and models are available on the project webpage at https://prakashchhipa.github.io/projects/mpd.

title: Pramish Paudel*, Anubhav Khanal, Danda Pani Paudel, Jyoti Tandukar, Ajad Chhatkuli
title_en: Pramish Paudel*, Anubhav Khanal, Danda Pani Paudel, Jyoti Tandukar, Ajad Chhatkuli
abstract: 个性化3D虚拟形象需要可动画化的数字人类表示。直接从单目视频中实现这一目标可为广泛用户群体和大规模应用场景提供可扩展性。本文提出了一种快速、简单且有效的从单目视频创建可动画化3D数字人类的方法。我们的方法利用高斯点云的效率来建模三维几何和外观。然而,我们观察到直接优化高斯点云会导致几何不准确,从而产生较差的动画效果。本工作通过高斯点云实现了对可动画化数字化所需的人体三维网格建模的准确性和必要性。这通过开发一个具有三个关键方面的新型流程实现:(a) 表面位移的隐式建模和颜色的球面调和;(b) 将三维高斯与人体模板的相应三角面片进行绑定;(c) 一种新颖的法线渲染技术及其辅助监督。我们在三个不同的基准数据集上的详尽实验验证了该方法在有限时间设置下的最先进性能。事实上,我们的方法在训练时间上比其最接近的竞争对手快了一个数量级。同时,在姿态变化情况下,我们实现了更优的渲染和三维重建性能。我们的源代码将公开发布。
abstract_en: Personalized 3D avatars require an animatable representation of digital humans. Doing so instantly from monocular videos offers scalability to broad class of users and wide-scale applications. In this paper, we present a fast, simple, yet effective method for creating animatable 3D digital humans from monocular videos. Our method utilizes the efficiency of Gaussian splatting to model both 3D geometry and appearance. However, we observed that naively optimizing Gaussian splats results in inaccurate geometry, thereby leading to poor animations. This work achieves and illustrates the need of accurate 3D mesh-type modelling of the human body for animatable digitization through Gaussian splats. This is achieved by developing a novel pipeline that benefits from three key aspects: (a) implicit modelling of surface’s displacements and the color’s spherical harmonics; (b) binding of 3D Gaussians to the respective triangular faces of the body template; (c) a novel technique to render normals followed by their auxiliary supervision. Our exhaustive experiments on three different benchmark datasets demonstrates the state-of-the-art results of our method, in limited time settings. In fact, our method is faster by an order of magnitude (in terms of training time) than its closest competitor. At the same time, we achieve superior rendering and 3D reconstruction performance under the change of poses. Our source code will be made publicly available.

title: Pranav Gupta*, Rishubh Singh, Pradeep Shenoy, Ravi Kiran Sarvadevabhatla*
title_en: Pranav Gupta*, Rishubh Singh, Pradeep Shenoy, Ravi Kiran Sarvadevabhatla*
abstract: 多目标多部分场景分割是一项具有挑战性的任务,其复杂度随着部分粒度和场景对象数量呈指数级增长。为解决该任务,我们提出了一种即插即用方法,称为OLAF。首先,我们将输入(RGB)与包含基于对象的结构线索的通道进行增强(fg/bg掩码、边界边缘掩码)。我们提出了一种权重自适应技术,使常规(RGB)预训练模型能够以稳定的方式处理增强后的(5通道)输入。此外,我们引入了一种称为LDF的编码器模块,以提供低层次密集特征引导。这有助于分割,特别是对于较小的部分。OLAF在当前最优模型上实现了显著的mIoU提升:3.3(Pascal-Parts-58)、3.5(Pascal-Parts-108),在最具挑战性的变体(Pascal-Parts-201)上提升达到4.0。实验表明,OLAF的广泛适用性使其在多种架构(CNN、U-Net、Transformer)和数据集上均取得提升。代码可在olafseg.github.io获取
abstract_en: Multi-object multi-part scene segmentation is a challenging task whose complexity scales exponentially with part granularity and number of scene objects. To address the task, we propose a plug-and-play approach termed OLAF. First, we augment the input (RGB) with channels containing object-based structural cues (fg/bg mask, boundary edge mask). We propose a weight adaptation technique which enables regular (RGB) pre-trained models to process the augmented (5-channel) input in a stable manner during optimization. In addition, we introduce an encoder module termed LDF to provide low-level dense feature guidance. This assists segmentation, particularly for smaller parts. OLAF enables significant mIoU gains of 3.3 (Pascal-Parts-58), 3.5 (Pascal-Parts-108) over the SOTA model. On the most challenging variant (Pascal-Parts-201), the gain is 4.0. Experimentally, we show that OLAF’s broad applicability enables gains across multiple architectures (CNN, U-Net, Transformer) and datasets. The code is available at olafseg.github.io

title: Prantik Howlader*, Hieu Le, Dimitris Samaras
title_en: Prantik Howlader*, Hieu Le, Dimitris Samaras
abstract: 半监督语义分割方法通过伪标签利用未标记数据。因此,这些方法的成功取决于伪标签的可靠性。现有方法大多选择高置信度像素以避免错误伪标签。然而,高置信度并不能保证伪标签的正确性,尤其是在初始训练迭代中。本文提出了一种新颖的方法,以可靠地从伪标签中学习。首先,我们通过统一训练好的目标检测器和语义分割模型的预测结果,识别可靠的伪标签像素。其次,我们为伪标记像素分配不同的学习权重以避免噪声训练信号。为了确定这些权重,我们首先利用第一步中识别的可靠伪标签像素和标记像素为每个类别构建原型。然后,每个像素的权重是该像素与原型之间的相似度得分,该得分通过排名统计量测量。该指标对噪声具有鲁棒性,使其更适合比较未标记图像的特征,特别是在容易出现错误伪标签的初始训练阶段。我们证明了该方法可以轻松集成到四个半监督语义分割框架中,并在Cityscapes和Pascal VOC数据集上提升了这些框架的性能。代码可在https://github.com/cvlab-stonybrook/ Weighting-Pseudo-Labels获取。
abstract_en: Semi-supervised semantic segmentation methods leverage unlabeled data by pseudo-labeling them. Thus the success of these methods hinges on the reliability of the pseudo-labels. Existing methods mostly choose high-confidence pixels in an effort to avoid erroneous pseudo-labels. However, high confidence does not guarantee correct pseudo-labels especially in the initial training iterations. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to reliably learn from pseudo-labels. First, we unify the predictions from a trained object detector and a semantic segmentation model to identify reliable pseudo-label pixels. Second, we assign different learning weights to pseudo-labeled pixels to avoid noisy training signals. To determine these weights, we first use the reliable pseudo-label pixels identified from the first step and labeled pixels to construct a prototype for each class. Then, the per-pixel weight is the similarity score between the pixel and the prototype measured via rank-statistics. This metric is robust to noise, making it better suited for comparing features from unlabeled images, particularly in the initial training phases where wrong pseudo labels are prone to occur. We show that our method can be easily integrated into four semi-supervised semantic segmentation frameworks, and improves them in both Cityscapes and Pascal VOC datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/cvlab-stonybrook/ Weighting-Pseudo-Labels.

title: Prantik Howlader*, Srijan Das, Hieu Le, Dimitris Samaras
title_en: Prantik Howlader*, Srijan Das, Hieu Le, Dimitris Samaras
abstract: 融入像素上下文信息对于实现准确的分割至关重要。本文展示了一种有效的方法,即通过基于补丁的分类器来整合上下文信息。该补丁分类器被训练以识别图像区域中存在的类别,从而有助于消除干扰项并提升小物体分割的分类效果。具体而言,我们提出了一种名为多尺度补丁基多标签分类器(Multi-scale Patch-based Multi-label Classifier, MPMC)的新型插件模块,专为现有的半监督分割(SSS)框架设计。MPMC提供补丁级监督,使分类器能够在补丁内区分不同类别的像素区域。此外,MPMC通过补丁级分类学习自适应伪标签权重,以减轻教师模型噪声伪标签监督对学生模型的影响。该轻量级模块可集成至任何SSS框架中,显著提升其性能。我们通过将MPMC集成至四种SSS方法中,并在两个自然图像和一个医学分割数据集上进行改进实验,验证了所提方法的有效性,显著提升了所有三个数据集基线模型的分割结果。代码已开源:https://github.com/cvlab-stonybrook/Beyond-Pixels
abstract_en: Incorporating pixel contextual information is critical for accurate segmentation. In this paper, we show that an effective way to incorporate contextual information is through a patch-based classifier. This patch classifier is trained to identify classes present within an image region, which facilitates the elimination of distractors and enhances the classification of small object segments. Specifically, we introduce Multi-scale Patch-based Multi-label Classifier (MPMC), a novel plug-in module designed for existing semi-supervised segmentation (SSS) frameworks. MPMC offers patch-level supervision, enabling the discrimination of pixel regions of different classes within a patch. Furthermore, MPMC learns an adaptive pseudo-label weight, using patch-level classification to alleviate the impact of the teacher’s noisy pseudo-label supervision on the student. This lightweight module can be integrated into any SSS framework, significantly enhancing their performance. We demonstrate the efficacy of our proposed MPMC by integrating it into four SSS methodologies and improving them across two natural image and one medical segmentation dataset, notably improving the segmentation results of the baselines across all the three datasets. Code is available at: https://github.com/cvlab-stonybrook/Beyond-Pixels

title: Prashanth Chandran*, Agon Serifi*, Markus Gross, Moritz Bächer
title_en: Prashanth Chandran*, Agon Serifi*, Markus Gross, Moritz Bächer
abstract: 我们引入了基于样条的Transformer模型,这是一种新型的Transformer模型,消除了对位置编码的依赖。受计算机动画中使用样条的工作流程启发,我们的基于样条的Transformer将输入序列的元素嵌入为潜在空间中的平滑轨迹。克服了位置编码的缺点(如序列长度外推),基于样条的Transformer还为用户提供了一种新颖的交互方式,通过直接操控潜在控制点以生成新的潜在轨迹和序列。我们在多种数据集上展示了该方法相较于传统位置编码的优越性能,涵盖从合成二维到大规模真实世界数据集的图像、三维形状和动画。
abstract_en: We introduce Spline-based Transformers, a novel class of Transformer models that eliminate the need for positional encoding. Inspired by workflows using splines in computer animation, our Spline-based Transformers embed an input sequence of elements as a smooth trajectory in latent space. Overcoming drawbacks of positional encoding such as sequence length extrapolation, Spline-based Transformers also provide a novel way for users to interact with transformer latent spaces by directly manipulating the latent control points to create new latent trajectories and sequences. We demonstrate the superior performance of our approach in comparison to conventional positional encoding on a variety of datasets, ranging from synthetic 2D to large-scale real-world datasets of images, 3D shapes, and animations.

title: Prateek Chennuri*, Yiheng Chi, Enze Jiang, GM Dilshan Godaliyadda*, Abhiram Gnanasambandam*, Hamid R Sheikh, Istvan Gyongy, Stanley H Chan*
title_en: Prateek Chennuri*, Yiheng Chi, Enze Jiang, GM Dilshan Godaliyadda*, Abhiram Gnanasambandam*, Hamid R Sheikh, Istvan Gyongy, Stanley H Chan*
abstract: 单光子图像传感器的普及为高速低光成像应用打开了大门。然而,这些传感器采集的数据通常是1位或少量位,并且受到噪声和强运动的干扰。传统视频修复方法并未针对这种情况进行设计,而专门的量子脉冲算法在输入帧数较少时性能有限。本文提出了一种名为Quanta Video Restoration (QUIVER)的端到端可训练网络,其核心思想源自经典量子修复方法,即预滤波、运动估计、融合与优化。我们还收集并发布了I2-2000FPS高速视频数据集,该数据集具有每秒2000帧的最高时间分辨率,用于训练和测试。在模拟和真实数据上,QUIVER显著优于现有量子修复方法。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/chennuriprateek/Quanta_Video_Restoration-QUIVER-获取。
abstract_en: The proliferation of single-photon image sensors has opened the door to a plethora of high-speed and low-light imaging applications. However, data collected by these sensors are often 1-bit or few-bit, and corrupted by noise and strong motion. Conventional video restoration methods are not designed to handle this situation, while specialized quanta burst algorithms have limited performance when the number of input frames is low. In this paper, we introduce Quanta Video Restoration (QUIVER), an end-to-end trainable network built on the core ideas of classical quanta restoration methods, i.e., pre-filtering, flow estimation, fusion, and refinement. We also collect and publish I2-2000FPS, a high-speed video dataset with the highest temporal resolution of 2000 frames-per-second, for training and testing. On simulated and real data, QUIVER outperforms existing quanta restoration methods by a significant margin. Code and dataset available at https://github.com/chennuriprateek/Quanta_Video_Restoration-QUIVER-

title: Pratul Srinivasan*, Stephan J Garbin, Dor Verbin, Jonathan T Barron, Ben Mildenhall
title_en: Pratul Srinivasan*, Stephan J Garbin, Dor Verbin, Jonathan T Barron, Ben Mildenhall
abstract: 现有的UV映射算法设计用于处理行为良好的网格,而非由先进3D重建和生成技术产生的几何表示。因此,将这些方法应用于神经辐射场及相关技术恢复的体积密度(或由此场三角化的网格)会产生过于碎片化的纹理图集,难以用于视图合成或外观编辑等任务。我们提出了一种针对由3D重建和生成技术产生的几何进行UV映射的方法。与计算定义在网格顶点上的映射不同,我们的方法使用神经场表示连续的UV映射,并优化其仅对影响场景外观的可见点集有效且行为良好的映射。我们证明了模型对不良几何带来的挑战具有鲁棒性,并且能够生成可编辑的UV映射,以表示详细外观。
abstract_en: Existing UV mapping algorithms are designed to operate on well-behaved meshes, instead of the geometry representations produced by state-of-the-art 3D reconstruction and generation techniques. As such, applying these methods to the volume densities recovered by neural radiance fields and related techniques (or meshes triangulated from such fields) results in texture atlases that are too fragmented to be useful for tasks such as view synthesis or appearance editing. We present a UV mapping method designed to operate on geometry produced by 3D reconstruction and generation techniques. Instead of computing a mapping defined on a mesh’s vertices, our method uses a neural field to represent a continuous UV mapping, and optimizes it to be a valid and well-behaved mapping for just the set of visible points, only points that affect the scene’s appearance. We show that our model is robust to the challenges posed by ill-behaved geometry, and that it produces editable UV mappings that can represent detailed appearance.

title: Pulkit Kumar*, Namitha Padmanabhan, Luke Luo, Sai Saketh Rambhatla, Abhinav Shrivastava
title_en: Pulkit Kumar*, Namitha Padmanabhan, Luke Luo, Sai Saketh Rambhatla, Abhinav Shrivastava
abstract: 我们提出了一种简单而有效的少样本动作识别方法,强调运动与外观表示的解耦。通过利用跟踪领域的最新进展,特别是点轨迹和自监督表示学习,我们构建了轨迹对齐标记(TATs),以捕捉运动和外观信息。该方法显著降低了数据需求,同时保留了关键信息。为处理这些表示,我们采用掩码时空变换器(Masked Space-time Transformer),有效学习信息聚合以促进少样本动作识别。我们在多个数据集上实现了少样本动作识别的最先进结果。我们的项目页面在此处。
abstract_en: We propose a simple yet effective approach for few-shot action recognition, emphasizing the disentanglement of motion and appearance representations. By harnessing recent progress in tracking, specifically point trajectories and self-supervised representation learning, we build trajectory-aligned tokens (TATs) that capture motion and appearance information. This approach significantly reduces the data requirements while retaining essential information. To process these representations, we use a Masked Space-time Transformer that effectively learns to aggregate information to facilitate few-shot action recognition. We demonstrate state-of-the-art results on few-shot action recognition across multiple datasets. Our project page is available here.

title: Qi Guo, Hailong Shi*, Huan Li, Jinsheng Xiao, Xingyu Gao*
title_en: Qi Guo, Hailong Shi*, Huan Li, Jinsheng Xiao, Xingyu Gao*
abstract: 基于事件的合成孔径成像(E-SAI)技术因其能够捕捉高频光强度变化而被广泛应用于场景去遮挡重建任务。然而,现有方法通常需要先验信息,并对SAI采集方法中的相机运动有严格限制。本文提出了一种新颖的端到端无重聚焦可变E-SAI去遮挡图像重建方法REDIR,该方法能够对可变事件数据进行全局与局部特征对齐,有效实现纯事件流的高分辨率成像。为进一步提升遮挡目标的重建效果,我们提出了一种感知掩码门控连接模块以实现模块间信息互联,并将时空注意力机制引入SNN块中以增强模型的目标提取能力。通过大量实验验证,我们的模型在传统E-SAI数据集上无需先验信息即可达到最先进的重建质量,同时在新引入的V-ESAI数据集上验证了可变事件数据特征配准方法的有效性,该方法消除了对先验知识的依赖,并通过引入焦距变化、镜头旋转和非均匀运动扩展了SAI采集方法的应用范围。
abstract_en: The employment of the event-based synthetic aperture imaging (E-SAI) technique, which has the capability to capture high-frequency light intensity variations, has facilitated its extensive application on scene de-occlusion reconstruction tasks. However, existing methods usually require prior information and have strict restriction of camera motion on SAI acquisition methods. This paper proposes a novel end-to-end refocus-free variable E-SAI de-occlusion image reconstruction approach REDIR, which can align the global and local features of the variable event data and effectively achieve high-resolution imaging of pure event streams. To further improve the reconstruction of the occluded target, we propose a perceptual mask-gated connection module to interlink information between modules, and incorporate a spatial-temporal attention mechanism into the SNN block to enhance target extraction ability of the model. Through extensive experiments, our model achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction quality on the traditional E-SAI dataset without prior information, while verifying the effectiveness of the variable event data feature registration method on our newly introduced V-ESAI dataset, which obviates the reliance on prior knowledge and extends the applicability of SAI acquisition methods by incorporating focus changes, lens rotations, and non-uniform motion.

title: Qi Li*, Runpeng Yu*, Xinchao Wang*
title_en: Qi Li*, Runpeng Yu*, Xinchao Wang*
abstract: 本文提出了一种新的知识迁移范式,称为知识在单一提示(Knowledge in One Prompt, KiOP)。该范式将多种模型的知识封装至单一提示中,无需修改原始模型或访问训练数据,从而实现了在更现实场景下高效便捷的知识迁移。从实用性角度来看,该范式不仅首次证明了在无法访问数据情境下视觉提示的有效性,还解决了传统无数据知识迁移所面临的模型可重用性低和存储资源消耗高的问题,这意味着我们可以在不修改任何源模型的情况下实现多模型的并行知识迁移。在各类数据集和模型上的广泛实验验证了所提出的KiOP知识迁移范式的有效性。在无法访问真实训练数据且存储容量受限的情况下,其在处理跨模型骨干结构及多模型(超过2个)并行知识迁移请求时也能够取得显著成果。代码已开源至https://github.com/LiQiiiii/Encapsulating-Knowledge-In-One-Prompt。
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a new knowledge transfer paradigm called Knowledge in One Prompt (KiOP). This paradigm encapsulates knowledge from various models into a solitary prompt without altering the original models or requiring access to the training data, which enables us to achieve efficient and convenient knowledge transfer in more realistic scenarios. From a practicality standpoint, this paradigm not only for the first time proves the effectiveness of Visual Prompt in data inaccessible contexts, but also solves the problems of low model reusability and high storage resource consumption faced by traditional Data-Free Knowledge Transfer, which means that we can realize the parallel knowledge transfer of multiple models without modifying any source model. Extensive experiments across various datasets and models demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed KiOP knowledge transfer paradigm. Without access to real training data and with rigorous storage capacity constraints, it is also capable of yielding considerable outcomes when dealing with cross-model backbone setups and handling parallel knowledge transfer processing requests with multiple (more than 2) models. Code is available at https://github.com/LiQiiiii/Encapsulating-Knowledge-In-One-Prompt.

title: Qi Qian*, Juhua Hu
title_en: Qi Qian*, Juhua Hu
abstract: 基于视觉-语言预训练(如CLIP)的零样本迁移能够根据候选类别名称对图像进行分类。尽管CLIP在多种下游任务中展现出令人印象深刻的零样本性能,但目标数据的分布尚未被充分挖掘。本文研究了一种新颖的在线零样本迁移场景,其中每张图像以随机顺序到达并仅被访问一次,以立即获得预测结果而无需存储其表示。与传统的零样本分类相比,所提出的框架在考虑到达图像的统计信息作为辅助信息以捕捉目标数据分布的同时,保持了在线服务的灵活性,这有助于提升现实应用的性能。为应对有效在线优化的挑战,我们首先开发了在线标签学习以建模目标数据分布。随后,通过提出的在线代理学习方法进一步优化视觉空间中每个类别的代理,以缓解图像与文本之间的模态间隙。两种在线策略的收敛性均可从理论上得到保证。通过结合在线标签学习和代理学习的预测标签,我们的在线零样本迁移方法(OnZeta)在无需访问完整数据集的情况下,在ImageNet上达到了78.94%的准确率。此外,在其他13个下游任务上的大量实验表明,平均性能提升超过3%,验证了我们方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Vision-language pre-training such as CLIP enables zero-shot transfer that can classify images according to the candidate class names. While CLIP demonstrates an impressive zero-shot performance on diverse downstream tasks, the distribution from the target data has not been leveraged sufficiently. In this work, we study a novel online zero-shot transfer scenario, where each image arrives in a random order for classification and is visited only once to obtain prediction immediately without storing its representation. Compared with the vanilla zero-shot classification, the proposed framework preserves its flexibility for online service while considering the statistics of the arrived images as the side information to capture the distribution of target data, which can help improve the performance of real-world applications. To tackle the challenge of effective online optimization, we first develop online label learning to model the target data distribution. Then, the proxy of each class in the vision space is further optimized with the proposed online proxy learning method to mitigate the modality gap between images and text. The convergence of both online strategies can be theoretically guaranteed. By combining the predicted label from the online label learning and proxy learning, our online zero-shot transfer method (OnZeta) achieves 78.94% accuracy on ImageNet without accessing the entire data set. Moreover, extensive experiments on other 13 downstream tasks with different vision encoders show a more than 3% improvement on average, which demonstrates the effectiveness of our proposal.

title: 千琪*, 徐元红, 胡久华
title_en: Qi Qian*, Yuanhong Xu, Juhua Hu
abstract: 从预训练深度模型的某些层提取的深度特征在性能上优于传统手工特征。与能够探索多样增强方法(如随机裁剪/翻转)的微调或线性探针相比,在原始输入空间中,针对固定深度特征进行学习的适当增强方法更具挑战性且研究较少,这会降低性能。为释放固定深度特征的潜力,我们在特征空间中提出了一种新颖的语义对抗增强(SeA)方法用于优化。具体而言,梯度所隐含的对抗方向将被投影到由其他示例张成的子空间中以保留语义信息。然后,深度特征将沿语义方向进行扰动,并利用增强后的特征学习分类器。在11个基准下游分类任务上进行了实验,使用4个流行的预训练模型。我们的方法在平均性能上比无SeA的深度特征提升了2%。此外,与预期性能良好的昂贵微调方法相比,SeA在11个任务中的6个上表现出可比性能,证明了我们方法的有效性及其效率。
abstract_en: Deep features extracted from certain layers of a pre-trained deep model show superior performance over the conventional hand-crafted features. Compared with fine-tuning or linear probing that can explore diverse augmentations, , random crop/flipping, in the original input space, the appropriate augmentations for learning with fixed deep features are more challenging and have been less investigated, which degenerates the performance. To unleash the potential of fixed deep features, we propose a novel semantic adversarial augmentation (SeA) in the feature space for optimization. Concretely, the adversarial direction implied by the gradient will be projected to a subspace spanned by other examples to preserve the semantic information. Then, deep features will be perturbed with the semantic direction, and augmented features will be applied to learn the classifier. Experiments are conducted on 11 benchmark downstream classification tasks with 4 popular pre-trained models. Our method is 2% better than the deep features without SeA on average. Moreover, compared to the expensive fine-tuning that is expected to give good performance, SeA shows a comparable performance on 6 out of 11 tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of our proposal in addition to its efficiency.

title: Qi Song*, Ziyuan Luo, Ka Chun Cheung, Simon See, Renjie Wan
title_en: Qi Song*, Ziyuan Luo, Ka Chun Cheung, Simon See, Renjie Wan
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRFs)已成为三维场景表示的关键方法。随着NeRF的日益突出和影响力,保护其知识产权变得越来越重要。在本文中,我们提出了NeRFProtector,该方法采用即插即用策略,在创建NeRF过程中保护其版权。NeRFProtector利用预训练的水印基模型,使NeRF创作者在创建NeRF时能够直接嵌入二进制消息。我们的即插即用特性确保NeRF创作者可以在不进行过多修改的情况下灵活选择NeRF变体。通过我们新设计的渐进式蒸馏方法,我们展示了与几种前沿神经渲染方法相当的性能。我们的项目可在以下网址获取:https://qsong2001.github.io/NeRFProtector.
abstract_en: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) have become a key method for 3D scene representation. With the rising prominence and influence of NeRF, safeguarding its intellectual property has become increasingly important. In this paper, we propose NeRFProtector, which adopts a plug-and-play strategy to protect NeRF’s copyright during its creation. NeRFProtector utilizes a pre-trained watermarking base model, enabling NeRF creators to embed binary messages directly while creating their NeRF. Our plug-and-play property ensures NeRF creators can flexibly choose NeRF variants without excessive modifications. Leveraging our newly designed progressive distillation, we demonstrate performance on par with several leading-edge neural rendering methods. Our project is available at: https://qsong2001.github.io/NeRFProtector.

title: 孙琪*, 周航, 周文刚, 李莉, 李厚强
title_en: Qi Sun*, Hang Zhou, Wengang Zhou, Li Li, Houqiang Li
abstract: 合成逼真的三维室内场景是一项具有挑战性的任务,传统上依赖专家设计师的手动布置和标注。尽管近期自回归模型在这一过程的自动化方面取得了进展,但它们往往缺乏对现实场景中关系和层次结构的语义理解,导致性能受限。本文提出__TITLE_MATH_1__,一种将室内场景合成建模为顺序感知序列学习问题的框架。该框架将原本无序的场景对象集合组织为结构化的、有序的层次化场景树和森林。通过采用基于聚类的算法和广度优先遍历,__ABS_MATH_1__推导出有意义的顺序,并利用Transformer生成逼真的三维场景。在标准基准上的实验结果表明,__TITLE_MATH_1__在合成更逼真场景方面优于现有最佳基线,FID和KL分数均有显著提升。我们针对下游任务的额外实验和消融研究也验证了在三维场景生成中引入顺序先验的重要性。
abstract_en: Synthesizing realistic 3D indoor scenes is a challenging task that traditionally relies on manual arrangement and annotation by expert designers. Recent advances in autoregressive models have automated this process, but they often lack semantic understanding of the relationships and hierarchies present in real-world scenes, yielding limited performance. In this paper, we propose , a framework that formulates indoor scene synthesis as an order-aware sequential learning problem. organizes the inherently unordered collection of scene objects into structured, ordered hierarchical scene trees and forests. By employing a clustering-based algorithm and a breadth-first traversal, derives meaningful orderings and utilizes a transformer to generate realistic 3D scenes autoregressively. Experimental results on standard benchmarks demonstrate ’s superiority in synthesizing more realistic scenes compared to top-performing baselines, with significant improvements in FID and KL scores. Our additional experiments for downstream tasks and ablation studies also confirm the importance of incorporating order as a prior in 3D scene generation.

title: Qi WANG*, Ruijie Lu, Xudong XU, Jingbo Wang, Michael Yu Wang, Bo Dai, Gang Zeng, Dan Xu
title_en: Qi WANG*, Ruijie Lu, Xudong XU, Jingbo Wang, Michael Yu Wang, Bo Dai, Gang Zeng, Dan Xu
abstract: 扩散模型的发展推动了文本到3D物体生成的边界。虽然将物体组合到场景中并保持合理的几何结构相对简单,但由于物体间的风格不一致和遮挡问题,对这样的场景进行完美纹理化并不容易。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了一种由粗到细的3D场景纹理框架,称为RoomTex,用于生成高保真且风格一致的未纹理化组合场景网格的纹理。在粗略阶段,RoomTex首先将场景网格展开为全景深度图,并利用ControlNet生成房间全景图,该全景图作为粗略参考以确保全局纹理一致性。在精细阶段,基于全景图像和透视深度图,RoomTex会沿着一系列选定的相机视角迭代地细化和纹理化房间中的每个物体,直到该物体被完全绘制。此外,我们提出通过微妙的边缘检测方法维持RGB空间与深度空间之间的优越对齐。大量实验表明,我们的方法能够生成高质量且多样的房间纹理,更重要的是,得益于基于修复的框架和组合网格输入,支持交互式的细粒度纹理控制和灵活的场景编辑。我们的项目页面可在https://qwang666.github.io/RoomTex/访问。
abstract_en: The advancement of diffusion models has pushed the boundary of text-to-3D object generation. While it is straightforward to composite objects into a scene with reasonable geometry, it is nontrivial to texture such a scene perfectly due to style inconsistency and occlusions between objects. To tackle these problems, we propose a coarse-to-fine 3D scene texturing framework, referred to as RoomTex, to generate high-fidelity and style-consistent textures for untextured compositional scene meshes. In the coarse stage, RoomTex first unwraps the scene mesh to a panoramic depth map and leverages ControlNet to generate a room panorama, which is regarded as the coarse reference to ensure the global texture consistency. In the fine stage, based on the panoramic image and perspective depth maps, RoomTex will refine and texture every single object in the room iteratively along a series of selected camera views, until this object is completely painted. Moreover, we propose to maintain superior alignment between RGB and depth spaces via subtle edge detection methods. Extensive experiments show our method is capable of generating high-quality and diverse room textures, and more importantly, supporting interactive fine-grained texture control and flexible scene editing thanks to our inpainting-based framework and compositional mesh input. Our project page is available at https://qwang666.github.io/RoomTex/.

title: Qi Wang, Zhou Xu, Yuming Lin, Jingtao Ye, Hongsheng Li, Guangming Zhu, Syed Afaq Ali Shah, Mohammed Bennamoun, Liang Zhang*
title_en: Qi Wang, Zhou Xu, Yuming Lin, Jingtao Ye, Hongsheng Li, Guangming Zhu, Syed Afaq Ali Shah, Mohammed Bennamoun, Liang Zhang*
abstract: 神经形态传感器,特别是事件相机,通过捕捉具有极宽动态范围、最小延迟和高能效的像素强度变化,革新了视觉数据采集方式,与传统基于帧的相机相比具有显著优势。事件相机的独特能力在事件驱动动作识别领域引发了广泛关注,因其在技术发展方面展现出巨大潜力。然而,该领域的发展目前受到缺乏全面、大规模数据集的制约,而这类数据集对于构建稳健的识别框架至关重要。为弥合这一差距,我们提出了DailyDVS-200,一个专为事件驱动动作识别社区精心构建的基准数据集。DailyDVS-200涵盖200个动作类别,记录了47名参与者在现实场景中的行为,包含超过22,000个事件序列。该数据集旨在反映广泛的动作类型、场景复杂性和数据采集多样性。每个序列均标注了14个属性,确保对记录动作的详细表征。此外,DailyDVS-200的结构设计支持多种研究路径,为验证现有方法和启发新方法提供了坚实基础。通过设立新的基准,我们挑战了当前神经形态数据处理的局限性,并推动事件驱动动作识别技术的新方法涌现,为未来神经形态计算及其他领域的探索铺平道路。数据集和源代码可在https://github.com/QiWang233/DailyDVS-200获取。
abstract_en: Neuromorphic sensors, specifically event cameras, revolutionize visual data acquisition by capturing pixel intensity changes with exceptional dynamic range, minimal latency, and energy efficiency, setting them apart from conventional frame-based cameras. The distinctive capabilities of event cameras have ignited significant interest in the domain of event-based action recognition, recognizing their vast potential for advancement. However, the development in this field is currently slowed by the lack of comprehensive, large-scale datasets, which are critical for developing robust recognition frameworks. To bridge this gap, we introduces DailyDVS-200 , a meticulously curated benchmark dataset tailored for the event-based action recognition community. DailyDVS-200 is extensive, covering 200 action categories across real-world scenarios, recorded by 47 participants, and comprises more than 22,000 event sequences. This dataset is designed to reflect a broad spectrum of action types, scene complexities, and data acquisition diversity. Each sequence in the dataset is annotated with 14 attributes, ensuring a detailed characterization of the recorded actions. Moreover, DailyDVS-200 is structured to facilitate a wide range of research paths, offering a solid foundation for both validating existing approaches and inspiring novel methodologies. By setting a new benchmark in the field, we challenge the current limitations of neuromorphic data processing and invite a surge of new approaches in event-based action recognition techniques, which paves the way for future explorations in neuromorphic computing and beyond. The dataset and source code are available at https://github.com/QiWang233/DailyDVS-200.

title: Qi Zhang*, Ying Feng, HONGDONG LI*
title_en: Qi Zhang*, Ying Feng, HONGDONG LI*
abstract: 神经辐射场已成为许多3D计算机视觉和计算机图形学应用中的首选表示方法,包括新视角合成和三维重建。多摄像头系统常用于基于NeRF的多视角任务(如动态场景采集或逼真虚拟形象动画)中的图像采集设置。然而,在这种设置中常被忽视的一个关键问题是多个摄像头之间显著的色彩响应差异,这会不利地影响NeRF的重建性能。多个输入图像之间的色彩差异源于两个方面:1)场景的隐式属性(如反射和明暗对比),2)摄像头设置和光照条件的外部差异。在本文中,我们通过提出一种新颖的色彩校正模块来解决这一问题,该模块模拟摄像头中的物理色彩处理过程并嵌入到NeRF中,从而实现统一色彩的NeRF重建。除了针对外部差异的视角无关色彩校正模块外,我们预测一个视角相关函数以最小化色彩残差(包括镜面反射和明暗对比),以消除固有属性的影响。我们进一步描述了如何通过参考图像作为引导扩展该方法,以在新视角上实现审美合理的色彩一致性与色彩转换。实验验证了我们的方法在色彩校正和色彩一致性方面的定量与定性评估中均优于基线方法。
abstract_en: Neural Radiance Fields have become the representation of choice for many 3D computer vision and computer graphics applications, , novel view synthesis and 3D reconstruction. Multi-camera systems are commonly used as the image capture setup in NeRF-based multi-view tasks such as dynamic scene acquisition or realistic avatar animation. However, a critical issue that has often been overlooked in this setup is the evident differences in color responses among multiple cameras, which adversely affect the NeRF reconstruction performance. These color discrepancies among multiple input images stem from two aspects: 1) implicit properties of the scenes such as reflections and shadings, and 2) external differences in camera settings and lighting conditions. In this paper, we address this problem by proposing a novel color correction module that simulates the physical color processing in cameras to be embedded in NeRF, enabling the unified color NeRF reconstruction. Besides the view-independent color correction module for external differences, we predict a view-dependent function to minimize the color residual (including, , specular and shading) to eliminate the impact of inherent attributes. We further describe how the method can be extended with a reference image as guidance to achieve aesthetically plausible color consistency and color translation on novel views. Experiments validate that our method is superior to baseline methods in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations of color correction and color consistency.

title: Qi Zhang, Kaiyi Zhang, Antoni B. Chan, Hui Huang*
title_en: Qi Zhang, Kaiyi Zhang, Antoni B. Chan, Hui Huang*
abstract: 多视角人群定位预测场景中所有人的地面位置。典型方法通常首先在地面上估计人群密度图,然后获取人群位置。然而,现有方法的性能受到密集区域密度图模糊性的限制,其中局部峰值可能被平滑掉。为缓解密度图监督的弱点,单图像人群定位任务中提出了基于最优传输的点监督方法,但尚未在多视角人群定位中进行探索。因此,本文提出了一种专门用于多视角人群定位的基于马氏距离的多视角最优传输(M-MVOT)损失函数。首先,我们将基于欧几里得的传输成本替换为马氏距离,该距离在成本函数中定义椭圆形等值线,其长轴和短轴方向由视角射线方向引导。其次,利用每个视角中物体到相机的距离进一步调整每个位置的最优传输成本,其中远离相机的错误预测将受到更重的惩罚。最后,我们提出了一种策略,在模型损失(M-MVOT)中考虑所有输入相机视角,通过基于每个地面真实点最近相机计算最优传输成本。实验表明,所提出的方法在多个多视角人群定位数据集上优于基于密度图或常见欧几里得距离的最优传输损失。
abstract_en: Multi-view crowd localization predicts the ground locations of all people in the scene. Typical methods usually estimate the crowd density maps on the ground plane first, and then obtain the crowd locations. However, existing methods’ performances are limited by the ambiguity of the density maps in crowded areas, where local peaks can be smoothed away. To mitigate the weakness of density map supervision, optimal transport-based point supervision methods have been proposed in the single-image crowd localization tasks, but have not been explored for multi-view crowd localization yet. Thus, in this paper, we propose a novel Mahalanobis distance-based multi-view optimal transport (M-MVOT) loss specifically designed for multi-view crowd localization. First, we replace the Euclidean-based transport cost with the Mahalanobis distance, which defines elliptical iso-contours in the cost function whose long-axis and short-axis directions are guided by the view ray direction. Second, the object-to-camera distance in each view is used to adjust the optimal transport cost of each location further, where the wrong predictions far away from the camera are more heavily penalized. Finally, we propose a strategy to consider all the input camera views in the model loss (M-MVOT) by computing the optimal transport cost for each ground-truth point based on its closest camera. Experiments demonstrate the advantage of the proposed method over density map-based or common Euclidean distance-based optimal transport loss on several multi-view crowd localization datasets.

title: Qi Zuo*, Xiaodong Gu, Yuan Dong, Zhengyi Zhao, Weihao Yuan, Qiu Lingteng, Liefeng Bo, Zilong Dong
title_en: Qi Zuo*, Xiaodong Gu, Yuan Dong, Zhengyi Zhao, Weihao Yuan, Qiu Lingteng, Liefeng Bo, Zilong Dong
abstract: 三维视觉本质上具有稀疏的空间结构特征,这推动了针对三维生成的高效范式设计的必要性。另一个差异在于训练数据的规模,如果我们仅使用有限的三维数据,这无疑会影响模型的泛化能力。为了解决这些问题,我们设计了一个三维生成框架,在保持StableDiffusion大部分构建模块的基础上,仅进行少量调整以实现纹理形状的生成。我们设计了稀疏编码模块以保留细节,并设计了对抗解码模块以更好地恢复形状。此外,我们清理了数据并基于最大的三维数据集(Objaverse)构建了一个基准。我们摒弃了“特定类别”的概念,将三维纹理形状生成视为一个开放词汇问题。我们首先在ShapeNetV2数据集上验证了网络设计,该数据集包含55K样本,分别在单类别无条件生成和多类别条件生成任务中进行测试。随后我们在处理后的G-Objaverse数据集(包含200K样本)上报告了图像条件生成任务的指标。大量实验表明,我们的方法优于当前最先进的方法,并在开放词汇三维生成领域迈出了更进一步的一步。我们将在https://aigc3d.github.io/gobjaverse/发布处理后的数据。
abstract_en: 3D vision is inherently characterized by sparse spatial structures, which propels the necessity for an efficient paradigm tailored to 3D generation. Another discrepancy is the amount of training data, which undeniably affects generalization if we only use limited 3D data. To solve these, we design a 3D generation framework that maintains most of the building blocks of StableDiffusion with minimal adaptations for textured shape generation. We design a Sparse Encoding Module for details preservation and an Adversarial Decoding Module for better shape recovery. Moreover, we clean up data and build a benchmark on the biggest 3D dataset (Objaverse). We drop the concept of ‘specific class’ and treat the 3D Textured Shapes Generation as an open-vocabulary problem. We first validate our network design on ShapeNetV2 with 55K samples on single-class unconditional generation and multi-class conditional generation tasks. Then we report metrics on processed G-Objaverse with 200K samples on the image conditional generation task. Extensive experiments demonstrate our proposal outperforms SOTA methods and takes a further step towards open-vocabulary 3D generation. We release the processed data at https://aigc3d.github.io/gobjaverse/.

title: 钱晨, 石浩舒, 白云志*
title_en: Qian Chen, Shihao Shu, Xiangzhi Bai*
abstract: 基于可见光的新视角合成已被广泛研究。与可见光成像相比,热红外成像具有全天候成像和强穿透性的优势,为夜间及恶劣天气场景的重建提供了更多可能性。然而,热红外成像受大气传输效应和热传导等物理特性的影响,阻碍了热红外场景中复杂细节的精确重建,表现为合成图像中出现浮点噪声和边缘特征模糊等问题。为解决这些局限性,本文提出了一种基于物理特性的三维高斯点云方法,命名为Thermal3D-GS。Thermal3D-GS首先利用神经网络建模三维介质中的大气传输效应和热传导。此外,将温度一致性约束纳入优化目标,以提升热红外图像的重建精度。为进一步验证方法的有效性,本文构建了首个大规模基准数据集,命名为热红外新视角合成数据集(TI-NSD)。该数据集包含20个真实的热红外视频场景,涵盖室内、室外及无人机(Unmanned Aerial Vehicle)场景,总计6,664帧热红外图像数据。基于该数据集,本文实验验证了Thermal3D-GS的有效性。结果表明,与基线方法相比,本文方法在PSNR指标上提升了3.03 dB,并显著解决了基线方法中存在的浮点噪声和边缘特征模糊问题。我们的数据集和代码库将在redThermal3DGS中发布。
abstract_en: Novel-view synthesis based on visible light has been extensively studied. In comparison to visible light imaging, thermal infrared imaging offers the advantage of all-weather imaging and strong penetration, providing increased possibilities for reconstruction in nighttime and adverse weather scenarios. However, thermal infrared imaging is influenced by physical characteristics such as atmospheric transmission effects and thermal conduction, hindering the precise reconstruction of intricate details in thermal infrared scenes, manifesting as issues of floaters and indistinct edge features in synthesized images. To address these limitations, this paper introduces a physics-induced 3D Gaussian splatting method named Thermal3D-GS. Thermal3D-GS begins by modeling atmospheric transmission effects and thermal conduction in three-dimensional media using neural networks. Additionally, a temperature consistency constraint is incorporated into the optimization objective to enhance the reconstruction accuracy of thermal infrared images. Furthermore, to validate the effectiveness of our method, the first large-scale benchmark dataset for this field named Thermal Infrared Novel-view Synthesis Dataset (TI-NSD) is created. This dataset comprises 20 authentic thermal infrared video scenes, covering indoor, outdoor, and UAV(Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) scenarios, totaling 6,664 frames of thermal infrared image data. Based on this dataset, this paper experimentally verifies the effectiveness of Thermal3D-GS. The results indicate that our method outperforms the baseline method with a 3.03 dB improvement in PSNR and significantly addresses the issues of floaters and indistinct edge features present in the baseline method. Our dataset and codebase will be released in redThermal3DGS.

title: 钱亮,颜晨,杨虎*
title_en: Qian Liang, Yan Chen, Yang Hu*
abstract: 远程光电容积描记术(rPPG)近年来因其从面部视频中提取生理信号的能力而受到广泛关注。尽管现有的rPPG测量方法在数据集内和跨数据集场景中表现出令人满意的性能,但它们通常忽视了增量学习场景,其中训练数据按顺序呈现,导致灾难性遗忘问题。同时,大多数现有的类别增量学习方法不适合rPPG测量。在本文中,我们提出了一种名为ADDP的新方法,以解决rPPG测量的持续学习问题。我们首先使用适配器高效地对新任务进行微调模型。然后我们设计了比常用类别原型更适用于rPPG信号回归的领域原型。基于这些原型,我们提出了一种特征增强策略,以巩固过去的知识,并提出了一种推理简化策略,将可能被遗忘的任务转换为模型熟悉的任务。为了评估ADDP并实现公平比较,我们创建了第一个rPPG测量的持续学习协议。综合实验表明,我们的方法在rPPG持续学习中是有效的。源代码可在https://github.com/ MayYoY/rPPGDIL获取。
abstract_en: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) has gained significant attention in recent years for its ability to extract physiological signals from facial videos. While existing rPPG measurement methods have shown satisfactory performance in intra-dataset and cross-dataset scenarios, they often overlook the incremental learning scenario, where training data is presented sequentially, resulting in the issue of catastrophic forgetting. Meanwhile, most existing class incremental learning approaches are unsuitable for rPPG measurement. In this paper, we present a novel method named ADDP to tackle continual learning for rPPG measurement. We first employ adapter to efficiently finetune the model on new tasks. Then we design domain prototypes that are more applicable to rPPG signal regression than commonly used class prototypes. Based on these prototypes, we propose a feature augmentation strategy to consolidate the past knowledge and an inference simplification strategy to convert potentially forgotten tasks into familiar ones for the model. To evaluate ADDP and enable fair comparisons, we create the first continual learning protocol for rPPG measurement. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method for rPPG continual learning. Source code is available at https://github.com/ MayYoY/rPPGDIL.

title: 王强*
title_en: Qiang Wang*
abstract: 基于三维结构的方法在长期视觉定位任务中仍然是最有效的解决方案。然而,现有局部描述符的维度通常较高,地图占用大量存储空间,尤其是在大规模场景中。我们提出了一种非对称框架,该框架学习降低局部描述符的维度并联合匹配。我们能够将现有局部描述符压缩到原大小的1/256,同时保持高匹配性能。在公开视觉定位数据集上的实验表明,我们的流程在现有地图压缩方法和非结构化方法上取得了更好的结果。
abstract_en: 3D-structure based methods remain the top-performing solution for long-term visual localization tasks. However, the dimension of existing local descriptors is usually high and the map takes huge storage space, especially for large-scale scenes. We propose an asymmetric framework which learns to reduce the dimension of local descriptors and match them jointly. We can compress existing local descriptor to 1/256 of original size while maintaining high matching performance. Experiments on public visual localization datasets show that our pipeline obtains better results than existing map compression methods and non-structure based alternatives.

title: 王强*, 何宇航, 董松林, 高新源, 王少坤, 龚毅宏
title_en: Qiang Wang*, Yuhang He, Songlin Dong, Xinyuan Gao, Shaokun Wang, Yihong Gong
abstract: 现有领域增量学习(DIL)方法通过存储和复现旧领域示例来解决灾难性遗忘问题。然而,基于示例的解决方案由于数据隐私顾虑或存储限制并不总是可行。因此,非示例领域增量学习(NEDIL)作为一种解决DIL挑战的重要范式应运而生。当前NEDIL解决方案通过在新领域中扩展分类器以学习新知识,但同一特征空间内的无限制扩展会导致类间混淆。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种简单而有效的跨领域概念集成(PINA)方法。我们训练一个统一分类器(UC)作为跨所有领域的概念容器。然后,为每个增量领域提出一个领域特定对齐(DSA)模块,将特征分布对齐到基础领域。推理阶段,我们引入补丁洗牌选择器(PSS)以选择适合测试图像的DSA参数。我们开发的补丁洗牌技术破坏了类依赖信息,优于基于K近邻或最近均值分类器的领域选择器。大量实验表明,我们的方法在减少额外参数数量的同时实现了最先进的性能。源代码将在https://github.com/qwangcv/PINA发布。
abstract_en: Existing approaches to Domain Incremental Learning (DIL) address catastrophic forgetting by storing and rehearsing exemplars from old domains. However, exemplar-based solutions are not always viable due to data privacy concerns or storage limitations. Therefore, Non-Exemplar Domain Incremental Learning (NEDIL) has emerged as a significant paradigm for resolving DIL challenges. Current NEDIL solutions extend the classifier incrementally for new domains to learn new knowledge, but unrestricted extension within the same feature space leads to inter-class confusion. To tackle this issue, we propose a simple yet effective method through cross-domain concePt INtegrAtion (PINA). We train a Unified Classifier (UC) as a concept container across all domains. Then, a Domain Specific Alignment (DSA) module is proposed for each incremental domain, aligning the feature distribution to the base domain. During inference, we introduce a Patch Shuffle Selector (PSS) to select appropriate parameters of DSA for test images. Our developed patch shuffling technique disrupts class-dependent information, outperforming the domain selectors based on K-Nearest Neighbors or Nearest Mean Classifier. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing the number of additional parameters. The source code will be released in https://github.com/qwangcv/PINA.

title: Qiangqiang Wu, Yan Xia*, Jia Wan, Antoni Chan
title_en: Qiangqiang Wu, Yan Xia*, Jia Wan, Antoni Chan
abstract: 三维单目标跟踪(SOT)是自动驾驶和机器人领域的关键任务。然而,由于类别特定点云数据有限以及激光雷达扫描固有的稀疏性和不完整性,学习鲁棒的三维SOT跟踪器仍面临挑战。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种统一的三维SOT框架,该框架利用三维生成式预训练,并从二维预训练的基础跟踪器中学习鲁棒的三维匹配能力。我们的框架具有与广泛使用的二维跟踪器一致的目标匹配架构,便于迁移二维匹配知识。具体而言,我们首先提出了一种轻量级的目标感知投影(TAP)模块,使预训练的二维跟踪器能够在投影点云上无需进一步微调即可良好运行。随后,我们提出了一种新颖的IoU引导的匹配蒸馏框架,利用强大的二维预训练跟踪器指导三维跟踪器中的三维匹配学习,即三维模板-搜索匹配应与从二维预训练跟踪器获得的对应二维模板-搜索匹配保持一致。我们的设计应用于两种主流的三维SOT框架:无记忆的Siamese结构和基于上下文记忆的结构,分别命名为SiamDisst和MemDisst。大量实验表明,SiamDisst和MemDisst在KITTI、Waymo Open Dataset和nuScenes基准测试中均达到最先进性能,且在RTX3090 GPU上分别以超过25和90 FPS的实时速度运行。
abstract_en: 3D single object tracking (SOT) is an essential task in autonomous driving and robotics. However, learning robust 3D SOT trackers remains challenging due to the limited category-specific point cloud data and the inherent sparsity and incompleteness of LiDAR scans. To tackle these issues, we propose a unified 3D SOT framework that leverages 3D generative pre-training and learns robust 3D matching abilities from 2D pre-trained foundation trackers. Our framework features a consistent target-matching architecture with the widely used 2D trackers, facilitating the transfer of 2D matching knowledge. Specifically, we first propose a lightweight Target-Aware Projection (TAP) module, allowing the pre-trained 2D tracker to work well on the projected point clouds without further fine-tuning. We then propose a novel IoU-guided matching-distillation framework that utilizes the powerful 2D pre-trained trackers to guide 3D matching learning in the 3D tracker, i.e., the 3D template-to-search matching should be consistent with its corresponding 2D template-to-search matching obtained from 2D pre-trained trackers. Our designs are applied to two mainstream 3D SOT frameworks: memory-less Siamese and contextual memory-based approaches, which are respectively named SiamDisst and MemDisst. Extensive experiments show that SiamDisst and MemDisst achieve state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes benchmarks, while running at above real-time speed of 25 and 90 FPS on a RTX3090 GPU.

title: Qianjiang Hu, Zhimin Zhang, Wei Hu*
title_en: Qianjiang Hu, Zhimin Zhang, Wei Hu*
abstract: 自动驾驶需要高质量的激光雷达数据,但物理激光雷达传感器的成本带来了显著的扩展挑战。尽管近期研究尝试利用深度生成模型解决这一问题,但这些方法往往计算资源消耗大、生成速度慢且缺乏真实感。为克服这些局限性,我们提出RangeLDM,一种通过潜在扩散模型快速生成高质量范围视图激光雷达点云的新方法。我们通过霍夫投票校正范围视图数据分布,实现从点云到范围图像的准确投影,这对生成学习具有关键影响。随后,我们利用变分自编码器将范围图像压缩到潜在空间,并借助扩散模型增强表达能力。此外,我们设计了一种范围引导判别器,指导模型保持三维结构保真度。在KITTI-360和nuScenes数据集上的实验结果验证了我们激光雷达点云生成方法在表达能力和生成速度方面的优势。
abstract_en: Autonomous driving demands high-quality LiDAR data, yet the cost of physical LiDAR sensors presents a significant scaling-up challenge. While recent efforts have explored deep generative models to address this issue, they often consume substantial computational resources with slow generation speeds while suffering from a lack of realism. To address these limitations, we introduce RangeLDM, a novel approach for rapidly generating high-quality range-view LiDAR point clouds via latent diffusion models. We achieve this by correcting range-view data distribution for accurate projection from point clouds to range images via Hough voting, which has a critical impact on generative learning. We then compress the range images into a latent space with a variational autoencoder, and leverage a diffusion model to enhance expressivity. Additionally, we instruct the model to preserve 3D structural fidelity by devising a range-guided discriminator. Experimental results on KITTI-360 and nuScenes datasets demonstrate both the robust expressiveness and fast speed of our LiDAR point cloud generation.

title: Qianliang Wu*, Haobo Jiang*, Lei Luo, Jun Li, Yaqing Ding*, Jin Xie*, Jian Yang*
title_en: Qianliang Wu*, Haobo Jiang*, Lei Luo, Jun Li, Yaqing Ding*, Jin Xie*, Jian Yang*
abstract: 建立可靠的对应关系对于3D和2D-3D配准任务至关重要。现有方法通常利用几何或语义点特征生成潜在对应关系。然而,这些特征可能面临大变形、尺度不一致和模糊匹配等问题(如对称性)。此外,许多依赖单次预测的先前方法在复杂场景中可能陷入局部极小值。为缓解这些挑战,我们引入了一种扩散匹配模型以实现稳健的对应关系构建。我们的方法将对应关系估计视为双随机矩阵空间中的去噪扩散过程,通过逐步去噪(优化)双随机匹配矩阵至真实值,实现高质量的对应关系估计。该方法包含一个正向扩散过程,逐步向真实匹配矩阵引入高斯噪声,以及一个反向去噪过程,迭代优化噪声矩阵。特别地,我们在推理阶段部署了轻量级去噪策略。具体而言,一旦点/图像特征被提取并固定,我们利用其在反向采样过程中进行多轮去噪预测。在3D和2D-3D配准任务上的评估验证了方法的有效性。代码已开源至https://github.com/wuqianliang/Diff-Reg。
abstract_en: Establishing reliable correspondences is essential for 3D and 2D-3D registration tasks. Existing methods commonly leverage geometric or semantic point features to generate potential correspondences. However, these features may face challenges such as large deformation, scale inconsistency, and ambiguous matching problems (e.g., symmetry). Additionally, many previous methods, which rely on single-pass prediction, may struggle with local minima in complex scenarios.
