To mitigate these challenges, we introduce a diffusion matching model for robust correspondence construction. Our approach treats correspondence estimation as a denoising diffusion process within the doubly stochastic matrix space, which gradually denoises (refines) a doubly stochastic matching matrix to the ground-truth one for high-quality correspondence estimation. It involves a forward diffusion process that gradually introduces Gaussian noise into the ground truth matching matrix and a reverse denoising process that iteratively refines the noisy one. In particular, we deploy a lightweight denoising strategy during the inference phase. Specifically, once points/image features are extracted and fixed, we utilize them to conduct multiple-pass denoising predictions in the reverse sampling process. Evaluation of our method on both 3D and 2D-3D registration tasks confirms its effectiveness. The code is available at https://github.com/wuqianliang/Diff-Reg.

title: Qianxiong Xu*, Guosheng Lin, Chen Change Loy, Cheng Long, Ziyue Li, Rui Zhao
title_en: Qianxiong Xu*, Guosheng Lin, Chen Change Loy, Cheng Long, Ziyue Li, Rui Zhao
abstract: 近年来,少样本分割(FSS)领域取得了显著进展,通过查询和支撑特征之间的逐像素匹配,通常基于交叉注意力机制,该机制选择性地激活与同类别支撑前景(FG)特征对应的查询前景(FG)特征。然而,由于主干网络深层的较大感受野,提取的查询和支撑前景特征不可避免地与背景(BG)特征混合,阻碍了交叉注意力中的前景-前景匹配。因此,查询前景特征与较少的支撑前景特征融合,导致支撑信息未被充分利用。本文提出了一种新颖的插件,称为模糊消除网络(AENet),可插入到任何现有的基于交叉注意力的FSS方法中。其核心思想是挖掘具有判别性的查询前景区域,以校正模糊的前景特征,增加前景信息的比例,从而抑制掺杂的背景特征的负面影响。通过这种方式,前景-前景匹配自然增强。我们将AENet插入到三个基线模型CyCTR、SCCAN和HDMNet中进行评估,其得分显著提升,例如,SCCAN在PASCAL-5i和COCO-20i上的1-shot性能分别提升了3.0%+。代码可在https://github.com/Sam1224/AENet获取。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in few-shot segmentation (FSS) have exploited pixel-by-pixel matching between query and support features, typically based on cross attention, which selectively activate query foreground (FG) features that correspond to the same-class support FG features. However, due to the large receptive fields in deep layers of the backbone, the extracted query and support FG features are inevitably mingled with background (BG) features, impeding the FG-FG matching in cross attention. Hence, the query FG features are fused with less support FG features, , the support information is not well utilized. This paper presents a novel plug-in termed ambiguity elimination network (AENet), which can be plugged into any existing cross attention-based FSS methods. The main idea is to mine discriminative query FG regions to rectify the ambiguous FG features, increasing the proportion of FG information, so as to suppress the negative impacts of the doped BG features. In this way, the FG-FG matching is naturally enhanced. We plug AENet into three baselines CyCTR, SCCAN and HDMNet for evaluation, and their scores are improved by large margins, , the 1-shot performance of SCCAN can be improved by 3.0%+ on both PASCAL-5i and COCO-20i . The code is available at https://github.com/Sam1224/AENet.

title: Qianyi Wu*, Jianmin Zheng, Jianfei Cai
title_en: Qianyi Wu*, Jianmin Zheng, Jianfei Cai
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法,用于从三维高斯点云(3DGS)[?]进行表面网格重建。3DGS技术以其在新视角合成中的高效性而闻名,但在表面重建方面面临挑战。主要障碍在于缺乏几何提示来调节数百万个无序高斯点的优化,以对齐到真实表面。本文在训练过程中引入局部结构提示以解决这一挑战。我们首先利用单目法线和深度估计的先验知识,优化高斯基元的协方差和均值,提升其组织性,并为表面提取提供关键的法线信息。然而,由于高斯基元的高度离散性,这种几何引导仍不足以与真实表面对齐。我们随后提出通过移动最小二乘法(MLS)函数在每个局部区域的高斯点上构建符号距离场。更重要的是,我们进一步提出联合学习一个神经隐式网络以模拟和规范MLS函数。联合优化有助于高斯点云的优化向精确表面对齐。大量实验结果验证了我们的方法在3DGS表面重建中相比现有技术(SoTA)实现了更优的网格质量。更多资源可访问我们的项目页面:https://qianyiwu.github.io/gsrec。
abstract_en: This paper presents a novel approach for surface mesh reconstruction from 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [?], a technique renowned for its efficiency in novel view synthesis but challenged for surface reconstruction. The key obstacle is the lack of geometry hints to regulate the optimization of millions of unorganized Gaussian blobs to align to the true surface. This paper introduces local structural hints during training to address the challenge. We first leverage the prior knowledge from monocular normal and depth estimations to refine the covariance and mean of Gaussian primitives, enhancing their organization and providing crucial normal information for surface extraction. However, due to the highly discrete nature of Gaussian primitives, such geometry guidance remains insufficient for the alignment with the true surface. We then propose to construct a signed distance field by a moving least square (MLS) function over the Gaussians in each local region. More importantly, we further propose to jointly learn a neural implicit network to mimic and regularize the MLS function. The joint optimization helps the optimization of Gaussian Splatting towards accurate surface alignment. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in achieving superior mesh quality compared with the SoTA surface reconstruction for 3DGS. More resources can be found on our project page: https://qianyiwu.github.io/gsrec.

title: Qianyun He, Xinya Ji, Yicheng Gong, Yuanxun Lu, Zhengyu Diao, Linjia Huang, Yao Yao, Siyu Zhu, Zhan Ma, Songcen Xu, Xiaofei Wu, Zixiao Zhang, Xun Cao, Hao Zhu*
title_en: Qianyun He, Xinya Ji, Yicheng Gong, Yuanxun Lu, Zhengyu Diao, Linjia Huang, Yao Yao, Siyu Zhu, Zhan Ma, Songcen Xu, Xiaofei Wu, Zixiao Zhang, Xun Cao, Hao Zhu*
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法,用于合成具有可控情感的三维虚拟人脸,该方法具有增强的唇部同步性和渲染质量。尽管该领域取得了显著进展,但现有方法仍存在多视角一致性不足和情感表达性缺乏的问题。为解决这些问题,我们收集了包含校准多视角视频、情感标注和每帧三维几何数据的数据库。通过在该数据集上训练,我们提出了一种“语音到几何到外观”映射框架:首先从音频特征预测忠实的三维几何序列,然后从预测的几何结构合成由四维高斯分布表示的三维虚拟人脸外观。该外观进一步解耦为规范高斯和动态高斯,通过多视角视频学习并融合,以渲染自由视角的虚拟人脸动画。此外,我们的模型能够生成具有可控情感的虚拟人脸,并可在广泛视角下渲染。我们的方法在唇部运动生成中表现出更高的渲染质量和稳定性,同时捕捉动态面部细节如皱纹和微妙表情。实验结果验证了该方法在生成高保真、情感可控的三维虚拟人脸方面的有效性。代码和数据集已发布于 https://nju-3dv.github.io/projects/EmoTalk3D。
abstract_en: We present a novel approach for synthesizing 3D talking heads with controllable emotion, featuring enhanced lip synchronization and rendering quality. Despite significant progress in the field, prior methods still suffer from multi-view consistency and a lack of emotional expressiveness. To address these issues, we collect dataset with calibrated multi-view videos, emotional annotations, and per-frame 3D geometry. By training on the dataset, we propose a ‘Speech-to-Geometry-to-Appearance’ mapping framework that first predicts faithful 3D geometry sequence from the audio features, then the appearance of a 3D talking head represented by 4D Gaussians is synthesized from the predicted geometry. The appearance is further disentangled into canonical and dynamic Gaussians, learned from multi-view videos, and fused to render free-view talking head animation. Moreover, our model enables controllable emotion in the generated talking heads and can be rendered in wide-range views. Our method exhibits improved rendering quality and stability in lip motion generation while capturing dynamic facial details such as wrinkles and subtle expressions. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in generating high-fidelity and emotion-controllable 3D talking heads. The code and dataset are released in https://nju-3dv.github.io/ projects/EmoTalk3D.

title: Qiao Gu*, Zhaoyang Lv*, Duncan Frost, Simon Green, Julian Straub, Chris Sweeney*
title_en: Qiao Gu*, Zhaoyang Lv*, Duncan Frost, Simon Green, Julian Straub, Chris Sweeney*
abstract: 本文提出了一种新型系统,能够自动将从第一人称传感器捕获的场景分割为完整的个体三维物体分解。该系统专门设计用于第一人称数据,其中场景包含数百个由自然(非扫描)运动捕获的物体。该系统采用三维高斯分布作为三维场景和物体的基础表示,并利用分割任何模型(SAM)的分割掩码作为弱监督,学习无需任何特定物体分类法的灵活且可提示的物体实例定义。为处理第一人称视频中动态物体的挑战,我们设计了一个瞬态预测模块,学习在三维重建中过滤动态物体。结果是一个全自动的流程,能够将三维物体实例重建为三维高斯分布的集合,这些集合共同构成整个场景。我们在Aria数字孪生数据集上创建了一个新的基准,定量展示了其在自然第一人称输入下的开放世界三维分割的最先进性能。我们在各种第一人称活动数据集上运行,展示了该方法在大规模三维第一人称感知中的潜力。请访问项目页面:https://egolifter.github.io/
abstract_en: In this paper we present , a novel system that can automatically segment scenes captured from egocentric sensors into a complete decomposition of individual 3D objects. The system is specifically designed for egocentric data where scenes contain hundreds of objects captured from natural (non-scanning) motion. adopts 3D Gaussians as the underlying representation of 3D scenes and objects and uses segmentation masks from the Segment Anything Model (SAM) as weak supervision to learn flexible and promptable definitions of object instances free of any specific object taxonomy. To handle the challenge of dynamic objects in ego-centric videos, we design a transient prediction module that learns to filter out dynamic objects in the 3D reconstruction. The result is a fully automatic pipeline that is able to reconstruct 3D object instances as collections of 3D Gaussians that collectively compose the entire scene. We created a new benchmark on the Aria Digital Twin dataset that quantitatively demonstrates its state-of-the-art performance in open-world 3D segmentation from natural egocentric input. We run on various egocentric activity datasets which shows the promise of the method for 3D egocentric perception at scale. Please visit project page at https://egolifter.github.io/.

title: Qiao Mo, Yukang Ding, Jinhua Hao*, Qiang Zhu, Ming Sun, Chao Zhou, Feiyu Chen, Shuyuan Zhu*
title_en: Qiao Mo, Yukang Ding, Jinhua Hao*, Qiang Zhu, Ming Sun, Chao Zhou, Feiyu Chen, Shuyuan Zhu*
abstract: 基于深度学习的方法在单次JPEG伪影去除任务中表现出色。然而,现有方法在双JPEG图像上的性能往往下降,而双JPEG图像在现实场景中普遍存在。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种用于双JPEG伪影去除的偏移感知分区Transformer模型,称为OAPT。我们对双JPEG压缩进行了分析,发现每个8×8块内最多会出现四种模式,并设计模型对相似模式进行聚类以解决恢复的困难。OAPT包含两个组成部分:压缩偏移预测器和图像重构器。具体而言,预测器估计第一次和第二次压缩之间的像素偏移量,这些偏移量随后用于划分不同模式。重构器主要基于多个混合分区注意力块(HPAB),结合了原始窗口自注意力机制和稀疏注意力机制以处理聚类后的模式特征。大量实验表明,OAPT在双JPEG图像恢复任务中比现有最先进方法性能提升超过0.16dB。此外,无需增加任何计算成本,HPAB中的模式聚类模块可作为插件增强其他基于Transformer的图像恢复方法。代码将开源于https://github.com/QMoQ/OAPT.git。
abstract_en: Deep learning-based methods have shown remarkable performance in single JPEG artifacts removal task. However, existing methods tend to degrade on double JPEG images, which are prevalent in real-world scenarios. To address this issue, we propose Offset-Aware Partition Transformer for double JPEG artifacts removal, termed as OAPT. We conduct an analysis of double JPEG compression that results in up to four patterns within each 8×8 block and design our model to cluster the similar patterns to remedy the difficulty of restoration. Our OAPT consists of two components: compression offset predictor and image reconstructor. Specifically, the predictor estimates pixel offsets between the first and second compression, which are then utilized to divide different patterns. The reconstructor is mainly based on several Hybrid Partition Attention Blocks (HPAB), combining vanilla window-based self-attention and sparse attention for clustered pattern features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OAPT outperforms the state-of-the-art method by more than 0.16dB in double JPEG image restoration task. Moreover, without increasing any computation cost, the pattern clustering module in HPAB can serve as a plugin to enhance other transformer-based image restoration methods. The code will be available at https://github.com/QMoQ/OAPT.git.

title: Qiao Wu, Kun Sun, Pei An, Mathieu Salzmann, Yanning Zhang, Jiaqi Yang*
title_en: Qiao Wu, Kun Sun, Pei An, Mathieu Salzmann, Yanning Zhang, Jiaqi Yang*
abstract: 点云的高时间变化性是三维单目标跟踪(3D SOT)的关键挑战。现有方法依赖于点云形状变化和相邻帧间物体运动平滑性的假设,难以处理高时间变化性数据。本文提出了一种针对高时间变化性点云的三维单目标跟踪新框架,称为HVTrack。HVTrack提出三个创新组件以应对高时间变化性场景的挑战:1)相对姿态感知记忆模块,用于处理时间点云形状变化;2)基础扩展特征交叉注意力模块,用于处理扩展搜索区域中相似目标的干扰;3)上下文点引导的自注意力模块,用于抑制强背景噪声。我们通过在KITTI数据集中设置不同帧间隔进行采样,构建了一个具有高时间变化性的数据集(KITTI-HV)。在KITTI-HV(5帧间隔)上,我们的HVTrack在Success/Precision指标上分别超越了最先进的跟踪器CXTracker 11.3%/15.7%。
abstract_en: The high temporal variation of the point clouds is the key challenge of 3D single-object tracking (3D SOT). Existing approaches rely on the assumption that the shape variation of the point clouds and the motion of the objects across neighboring frames are smooth, failing to cope with high temporal variation data. In this paper, we present a novel framework for 3D SOT in point clouds with high temporal variation, called HVTrack. HVTrack proposes three novel components to tackle the challenges in the high temporal variation scenario: 1) A Relative-Pose-Aware Memory module to handle temporal point cloud shape variations; 2) a Base-Expansion Feature Cross-Attention module to deal with similar object distractions in expanded search areas; 3) a Contextual Point Guided Self-Attention module for suppressing heavy background noise. We construct a dataset with high temporal variation (KITTI-HV) by setting different frame intervals for sampling in the KITTI dataset. On the KITTI-HV with 5 frame intervals, our HVTrack surpasses the state-of-the-art tracker CXTracker by 11.3%/15.7% in Success/Precision.

title: Qiaomu Miao*, Alexandros Graikos, Jingwei Zhang, Sounak Mondal, Minh Hoai, Dimitris Samaras
title_en: Qiaomu Miao*, Alexandros Graikos, Jingwei Zhang, Sounak Mondal, Minh Hoai, Dimitris Samaras
abstract: 训练注视跟随模型需要大量由人工标注者标注注视目标坐标的图像,这是一个繁琐且本质上具有歧义的过程。我们提出了一种用于注视跟随的首个半监督方法,通过向任务中引入两个新颖的先验条件。我们通过使用大型预训练视觉问答(VQA)模型获得第一个先验条件,其中我们通过向VQA模型提出注视跟随问题来计算Grad-CAM热图。这些热图可能包含噪声且不适合直接用于训练。为了优化这些噪声标注,我们引入了第二个先验条件。我们利用在有限人工标注数据上训练的扩散模型,并修改反向采样过程以优化Grad-CAM热图。通过调整扩散过程,我们实现了人类标注先验条件与VQA热图先验条件之间的权衡,既保留了有用的VQA先验信息,又表现出与训练数据分布相似的特性。我们的方法在GazeFollow图像数据集上优于简单的伪标注生成基线。更重要的是,我们的伪标注策略应用于广泛使用的监督注视跟随模型(VAT)时,将标注需求减少了50%。我们的方法在VideoAttentionTarget数据集上也表现最佳。代码可在https://github.com/cvlab-stonybrook/GCDR-Gaze.git获取。
abstract_en: Training gaze following models requires a large number of images with gaze target coordinates annotated by human annotators, which is a laborious and inherently ambiguous process. We propose the first semi-supervised method for gaze following by introducing two novel priors to the task. We obtain the first prior using a large pretrained Visual Question Answering (VQA) model, where we compute Grad-CAM heatmaps by ‘prompting’ the VQA model with a gaze following question. These heatmaps can be noisy and not suited for use in training. The need to refine these noisy annotations leads us to incorporate a second prior. We utilize a diffusion model trained on limited human annotations and modify the reverse sampling process to refine the Grad-CAM heatmaps. By tuning the diffusion process we achieve a trade-off between the human annotation prior and the VQA heatmap prior, which retains the useful VQA prior information while exhibiting similar properties to the training data distribution. Our method outperforms simple pseudo-annotation generation baselines on the GazeFollow image dataset. More importantly, our pseudo-annotation strategy, applied to a widely used supervised gaze following model (VAT), reduces the annotation need by 50%. Our method also performs the best on the VideoAttentionTarget dataset. Code is available at https://github.com/cvlab-stonybrook/GCDR-Gaze. git

title: __TITLE_MATH_1__
title_en: Qiaoqiao Jin, Xuanhong Chen, Meiguang Jin, Ying Chen, Rui Shi, Yucheng Zheng, Yupeng Zhu, Bingbing Ni*
abstract: 当前的化妆方法主要依赖于非配对学习范式,但面临监督不准确(如面部对齐错误)和复杂面部提示(包括面部解析和关键点检测)等挑战。这些挑战阻碍了面部化妆模型的低成本部署,尤其是在移动设备上。为解决上述问题,我们提出了一种全新的学习范式,称为“数据放大学习(DAL)”,并设计了一个轻量级化妆模型“TinyBeauty”。DAL的核心思想是利用基于扩散的数据放大器(DDA)对有限图像进行“放大”,从而仅需少量标注即可实现像素级精确监督。DDA的两项关键创新使上述训练方法成为可能:(1)设计了残差扩散模型(RDM),以生成高保真细节并避免基础扩散模型中的细节消失问题;(2)提出了细粒度化妆模块(FGMM),在保留面部身份的同时实现精确的化妆控制与组合。结合DAL,TinyBeauty仅需80K参数即可在无需复杂面部提示的情况下达到最先进性能。同时,TinyBeauty在iPhone 13上实现了高达460 fps的推理速度。大量实验表明,DAL仅需5对图像即可生成具有竞争力的化妆模型。请访问https://github.com/TinyBeauty获取代码和演示。
abstract_en: Contemporary makeup approaches primarily hinge on unpaired learning paradigms, yet they grapple with the challenges of inaccurate supervision (e.g., face misalignment) and sophisticated facial prompts (including face parsing, and landmark detection). These challenges prohibit low-cost deployment of facial makeup models, especially on mobile devices. To solve above problems, we propose a brand-new learning paradigm, termed ”Data Amplify Learning (DAL),” alongside a compact makeup model named ”TinyBeauty.” The core idea of DAL lies in employing a Diffusion-based Data Amplifier (DDA) to ”amplify” limited images for the model training, thereby enabling accurate pixel-to-pixel supervision with merely a handful of annotations. Two pivotal innovations in DDA facilitate the above training approach: (1) A Residual Diffusion Model (RDM) is designed to generate high-fidelity detail and circumvent the detail vanishing problem in the vanilla diffusion models; (2) A Fine-Grained Makeup Module (FGMM) is proposed to achieve precise makeup control and combination while retaining face identity. Coupled with DAL, TinyBeauty necessitates merely 80K parameters to achieve a state-of-the-art performance without intricate face prompts. Meanwhile, TinyBeauty achieves a remarkable inference speed of up to 460 fps on the iPhone 13. Extensive experiments show that DAL can produce highly competitive makeup models using only 5 image pairs. Please visit https://github.com/TinyBeauty for code and demos.

title: Qichen Zheng, Yi Yu, SIYUAN YANG*, Jun Liu, Kwok-Yan Lam, Alex Kot
title_en: Qichen Zheng, Yi Yu, SIYUAN YANG*, Jun Liu, Kwok-Yan Lam, Alex Kot
abstract: 骨架动作识别(Skeleton Action Recognition, SAR)因其对人类骨骼结构的高效表征而受到广泛关注。尽管取得了进展,近期研究已对SAR模型的安全性提出质疑,特别是其对对抗攻击的脆弱性。然而,现有策略仅适用于数字场景,在物理攻击中效果有限,制约了其实际应用。为探究SAR在物理世界中的脆弱性,我们提出物理骨架后门攻击(Physical Skeleton Backdoor Attacks, PSBA),这是首个针对SAR的物理后门攻击研究。考虑到物理执行的实用性,我们设计了一种新颖的触发器植入方法,将罕见且难以察觉的动作作为触发器嵌入原始骨架数据中。通过在训练集中少量引入该操控数据,PSBA可使系统在存在触发动作时将任意骨架序列错误分类至目标类别。我们评估了PSBA在中毒标签和干净标签场景下的鲁棒性,验证其在多种数据集、中毒比例和模型架构中的有效性。此外,我们提出了一种触发器增强策略以提升干净标签场景下的攻击性能。PSBA的鲁棒性经受了三种不同后门防御机制的测试,其隐蔽性通过两个量化指标进行评估。进一步地,通过Kinect V2相机,我们从真实世界中采集人体动作数据以模拟物理攻击场景,实验结果证实了所提攻击方法的有效性。项目网站地址为:https://qichenzheng.github.io/psba-website。
abstract_en: Skeleton Action Recognition (SAR) has attracted significant interest for its efficient representation of the human skeletal structure. Despite its advancements, recent studies have raised security concerns in SAR models, particularly their vulnerability to adversarial attacks. However, such strategies are limited to digital scenarios and ineffective in physical attacks, limiting their real-world applicability. To investigate the vulnerabilities of SAR in the physical world, we introduce the Physical Skeleton Backdoor Attacks (PSBA), the first exploration of physical backdoor attacks against SAR. Considering the practicalities of physical execution, we introduce a novel trigger implantation method that integrates infrequent and imperceivable actions as triggers into the original skeleton data. By incorporating a minimal amount of this manipulated data into the training set, PSBA enables the system misclassify any skeleton sequences into the target class when the trigger action is present. We examine the resilience of PSBA in both poisoned and clean-label scenarios, demonstrating its efficacy across a range of datasets, poisoning ratios, and model architectures. Additionally, we introduce a trigger-enhancing strategy to strengthen attack performance in the clean label setting. The robustness of PSBA is tested against three distinct backdoor defenses, and the stealthiness of PSBA is evaluated using two quantitative metrics. Furthermore, by employing a Kinect V2 camera, we compile a dataset of human actions from the real world to mimic physical attack situations, with our findings confirming the effectiveness of our proposed attacks. Our project website can be found at https://qichenzheng.github. io/psba-website.

title: Qifeng Li*, Xiaosong Jia, Shaobo Wang, Junchi Yan
title_en: Qifeng Li*, Xiaosong Jia, Shaobo Wang, Junchi Yan
abstract: 现实世界中的自动驾驶(AD)如城市驾驶涉及许多边缘案例。最新发布的AD基准测试CARLA Leaderboard v2(简称CARLA v2)包含39个新的常见驾驶场景事件,相比CARLA Leaderboard v1提供了更接近现实的测试平台。它提出了新的挑战,迄今为止尚无文献报告在v2新场景中取得成功。在本工作中,我们主动直接训练神经规划器,希望灵活有效地处理边缘案例。据我们所知,我们开发了首个基于模型的强化学习方法(命名为Think2Drive),通过紧凑的潜在世界模型学习环境的转移,然后作为神经模拟器训练智能体(即规划器)。由于潜在世界模型中低维状态空间和张量并行计算,Think2Drive显著提升了强化学习的训练效率。Think2Drive能够在单块A6000 GPU上通过3天训练在CARLA v2中达到专家级水平,据我们所知,目前尚无报告在CARLA v2中实现100%路线完成的成功案例。我们还开发了CornerCaseRepo基准测试,支持通过场景评估驾驶模型。我们还提出了一种平衡指标,通过路线完成率、违规次数和场景密度评估性能。
abstract_en: Real-world autonomous driving (AD) like urban driving involves many corner cases. The lately released AD Benchmark CARLA Leaderboard v2 (a.k.a. CARLA v2) involves 39 new common events in the driving scene, providing a more quasi-realistic testbed compared to CARLA Leaderboard v1. It poses new challenges and so far no literature has reported any success on the new scenarios in v2. In this work, we take the initiative of directly training a neural planner and the hope is to handle the corner cases flexibly and effectively. To our best knowledge, we develop the first model-based RL method (named Think2Drive) for AD, with a compact latent world model to learn the transitions of the environment, and then it acts as a neural simulator to train the agent i.e. planner. It significantly boosts the training efficiency of RL thanks to the low dimensional state space and parallel computing of tensors in the latent world model. Think2Drive is able to run in an expert-level proficiency in CARLA v2 within 3 days of training on a single A6000 GPU, and to our best knowledge, so far there is no reported success (100% route completion) on CARLA v2. We also develop CornerCaseRepo, a benchmark that supports the evaluation of driving models by scenarios. We also propose a balanced metric to evaluate the performance by route completion, infraction number, and scenario density.

title: Qihang Yu*, Xiaohui Shen, Liang-Chieh Chen
title_en: Qihang Yu*, Xiaohui Shen, Liang-Chieh Chen
abstract: 在开放物理世界中定位和识别物体一直是机器感知领域长期存在的挑战。近期方法通过采用无类别掩码(或框)提议模型,并结合预提取文本嵌入的开放词汇分类器(如CLIP),试图解决这一问题。然而,这些开放词汇识别模型在实际应用中仍存在局限性。一方面,它们在测试时依赖于类别名称的提供,识别性能高度依赖用户预定义的语义类别集合。另一方面,在多数据集训练时,需要人工干预以缓解数据集间的标签定义冲突。本文提出(),一种基于大型语言模型(LLM)的掩码分类器,作为解决上述挑战的简单有效方案。具体而言,通过生成式方式预测类别标签,从而在训练和测试过程中无需提供类别名称。它还支持无需人工干预的跨数据集训练,由于从LLM中获取了世界知识,展现出强大的泛化能力。通过与现成的掩码提议模型结合,我们在多个基准测试中取得了有希望的结果,并展示了其处理新概念的有效性。代码和模型可在https://github.com/bytedance/OmniScient-Model获取。
abstract_en: Localizing and recognizing objects in the open-ended physical world poses a long-standing challenge within the domain of machine perception. Recent methods have endeavored to address the issue by employing a class-agnostic mask (or box) proposal model, complemented by an open-vocabulary classifier (, CLIP) using pre-extracted text embeddings. However, it is worth noting that these open-vocabulary recognition models still exhibit limitations in practical applications. On one hand, they rely on the provision of class names during testing, where the recognition performance heavily depends on this predefined set of semantic classes by users. On the other hand, when training with multiple datasets, human intervention is required to alleviate the label definition conflict between them. In this paper, we introduce the (), a novel Large Language Model (LLM) based mask classifier, as a straightforward and effective solution to the aforementioned challenges. Specifically, predicts class labels in a generative manner, thus removing the supply of class names during both training and testing. It also enables cross-dataset training without any human interference, exhibiting robust generalization capabilities due to the world knowledge acquired from the LLM. By combining with an off-the-shelf mask proposal model, we present promising results on various benchmarks, and demonstrate its effectiveness in handling novel concepts. Code and models are available at https://github. com/bytedance/OmniScient-Model.

title: Qihao Zhao, Yalun Dai, Shen Lin, Wei Hu, Fan Zhang*, Jun Liu
title_en: Qihao Zhao, Yalun Dai, Shen Lin, Wei Hu, Fan Zhang*, Jun Liu
abstract: 在现实场景中,知识分布呈现长尾特性。人类能够通过勤于复习、总结和纠正错误的实践,在不平衡的知识分布中实现知识的均匀掌握。受此学习过程启发,我们提出一种新型学习范式——反思学习,用于处理长尾识别任务。我们的方法在训练过程中集成三个核心流程:回顾历史预测、总结并利用类别间的特征关系、修正损失函数中的梯度冲突。这些设计轻量且可与现有长尾学习方法灵活结合,在主流长尾视觉基准数据集上取得SOTA性能。实验结果凸显了反思学习在处理长尾识别任务中的巨大潜力。代码将开源于https://github.com/fistyee/LTRL。
abstract_en: In real-world scenarios, where knowledge distributions exhibit long-tail. Humans manage to master knowledge uniformly across imbalanced distributions, a feat attributed to their diligent practices of reviewing, summarizing, and correcting errors. Motivated by this learning process, we propose a novel learning paradigm, called reflecting learning, in handling long-tail recognition. Our method integrates three processes for reviewing past predictions during training, summarizing and leveraging the feature relation across classes, and correcting gradient conflict for loss functions. These designs are lightweight enough to plug and play with existing long-tail learning methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance in popular long-tail visual benchmarks. The experimental results highlight the great potential of reflecting learning in dealing with long-tail recognition. The code will be available at https://github.com/fistyee/LTRL.

title: Qijie Mo, Yipeng Gao, Shenghao Fu, Junkai Yan, Ancong Wu*, Wei-Shi Zheng*
title_en: Qijie Mo, Yipeng Gao, Shenghao Fu, Junkai Yan, Ancong Wu*, Wei-Shi Zheng*
abstract: 在增量目标检测中,知识蒸馏已被证明是缓解灾难性遗忘的有效方法。然而,以往的研究主要关注保留旧模型的知识,忽视了图像可能同时包含过去、现在和未来阶段的类别。物体的共现使得不同阶段的优化目标不一致,因为各阶段对前景物体的定义不同,这极大地限制了模型的性能。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种名为“连接过去与未来”(BPF)的方法,通过对齐各阶段的模型,确保优化方向的一致性。此外,我们提出了一种新颖的未来蒸馏(DwF)损失函数,充分利用背景概率来缓解旧类别的遗忘,同时确保在学习新类别时保持高度的适应性。在Pascal VOC和MS COCO基准数据集上进行了大量实验。在无记忆的情况下,BPF在多种设置下均优于当前最先进的方法。代码可在https://github.com/iSEE-Laboratory/BPF获取。
abstract_en: In incremental object detection, knowledge distillation has been proven to be an effective way to alleviate catastrophic forgetting. However, previous works focused on preserving the knowledge of old models, ignoring that images could simultaneously contain categories from past, present, and future stages. The co-occurrence of objects makes the optimization objectives inconsistent across different stages since the definition for foreground objects differs across various stages, which limits the model’s performance greatly. To overcome this problem, we propose a method called “Bridge Past and Future” (BPF), which aligns models across stages, ensuring consistent optimization directions. In addition, we propose a novel Distillation with Future (DwF) loss, fully leveraging the background probability to mitigate the forgetting of old classes while ensuring a high level of adaptability in learning new classes. Extensive experiments are conducted on both Pascal VOC and MS COCO benchmarks. Without memory, BPF outperforms current state-of-the-art methods under various settings. The code is available at https://github.com/iSEE-Laboratory/BPF.

title: Qijin She, Shishun Zhang, Yunfan Ye, Ruizhen Hu, Kai Xu*
title_en: Qijin She, Shishun Zhang, Yunfan Ye, Ruizhen Hu, Kai Xu*
abstract: 抓取与操作是机器人操作的基本技能,但现有方法通常在特定夹爪上训练模型,无法复用到其他夹爪。本文提出了一种新颖方法,可学习一种统一策略模型,能够轻松迁移至不同灵巧夹爪。我们的方法包含两个阶段:一个与夹爪无关的策略模型,用于预测夹爪上预定义关键点的位移;以及一个夹爪特定的适应模型,将这些位移转换为控制夹爪关节的调整。通过在指尖级别使用鲁棒几何表示捕捉夹爪状态和与物体的交互,并结合基于Transformer的网络以应对夹爪形态和几何的变化。在实验中,我们在多种灵巧夹爪和多样物体上评估了该方法,结果表明我们的方法显著优于基线方法。开创性地实现了在灵巧夹爪间抓取策略的迁移,我们的方法有效展示了其在学习通用且可迁移操作技能方面的潜力,适用于各种机器人手部。
abstract_en: Reaching-and-grasping is a fundamental skill for robotic manipulation, but existing methods usually train models on a specific gripper and cannot be reused on another gripper. In this paper, we propose a novel method that can learn a unified policy model that can be easily transferred to different dexterous grippers. Our method consists of two stages: a gripper-agnostic policy model that predicts the displacements of pre-defined key points on the gripper, and a gripper-specific adaptation model that translates these displacements into adjustments for controlling the grippers’ joints. The gripper state and interactions with objects are captured at the finger level using robust geometric representations, integrated with a transformer-based network to address variations in gripper morphology and geometry. In the experiments, we evaluate our method on several dexterous grippers and diverse objects, and the result shows that our method significantly outperforms the baseline methods. Pioneering the transfer of grasp policies across dexterous grippers, our method effectively demonstrates its potential for learning generalizable and transferable manipulation skills for various robotic hands.

title: Qilang Ye, Zitong Yu*, Rui Shao, Xinyu Xie, Philip Torr, Xiaochun Cao
title_en: Qilang Ye, Zitong Yu*, Rui Shao, Xinyu Xie, Philip Torr, Xiaochun Cao
abstract: This paper focuses on the challenge of answering questions in scenarios that are composed of rich and complex dynamic audio-visual components. Although existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can respond to audio-visual content, these responses are sometimes ambiguous and fail to describe specific audio-visual events. To overcome this limitation, we introduce the CAT, which enhances MLLM in three ways: 1) besides straightforwardly bridging audio and video, we design a clue aggregator that aggregates question-related clues in dynamic audio-visual scenarios to enrich the detailed knowledge required for large language models. 2) CAT is trained on a mixed multimodal dataset, allowing direct application in audio-visual scenarios. Notably, we collect an audio-visual joint instruction dataset named AVinstruct, to further enhance the capacity of CAT to model cross-semantic correlations. 3) we propose AI-assisted ambiguity-aware direct preference optimization, a strategy specialized in retraining the model to favor the non-ambiguity response and improve the ability to localize specific audio-visual objects. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that CAT outperforms existing methods on multimodal tasks, especially in Audio-Visual Question Answering (AVQA) tasks. The codes and the collected instructions will be released soon.
abstract_en: This paper focuses on the challenge of answering questions in scenarios that are composed of rich and complex dynamic audio-visual components. Although existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can respond to audio-visual content, these responses are sometimes ambiguous and fail to describe specific audio-visual events. To overcome this limitation, we introduce the CAT, which enhances MLLM in three ways: 1) besides straightforwardly bridging audio and video, we design a clue aggregator that aggregates question-related clues in dynamic audio-visual scenarios to enrich the detailed knowledge required for large language models. 2) CAT is trained on a mixed multimodal dataset, allowing direct application in audio-visual scenarios. title: 陈启民*, 陈志强, Vladimir G. Kim, Noam Aigerman, 张浩, Siddhartha Chaudhuri
title_en: Qimin Chen*, Zhiqin Chen, Vladimir G. Kim, Noam Aigerman, Hao Zhang, Siddhartha Chaudhuri
abstract: 我们提出了一种三维建模方法,使终端用户能够利用机器学习对三维形状进行细化或增强细节,扩展AI辅助三维内容创作的能力。给定一个粗略的体素形状(例如通过简单的框体拉伸工具或生成建模生成的形状),用户可以直接“绘制”所需的目标风格,这些风格代表了引人注目的几何细节,从输入示例形状中覆盖粗略形状的不同区域。这些区域随后会被上采样为高分辨率几何体,这些几何体符合绘制的风格。为了实现这种可控且局部化的三维细节增强,我们基于金字塔生成对抗网络(Pyramid GAN)进行改进,使其具备掩码感知能力。我们设计了新颖的结构损失函数和先验条件,确保即使绘制的风格来源于不同来源(如不同的语义部分或甚至不同的形状类别),我们的方法仍能保留所需的粗略结构和细粒度特征。通过大量实验,我们展示了我们的细节定位能力能够实现新颖的交互式创作流程和应用。我们的实验进一步表明,与基于全局细节增强的先前技术相比,我们的方法生成的结构保持性更高、分辨率更高、风格化几何体具有更连贯的形状细节和风格过渡。
abstract_en: We present a 3D modeling method which enables end-users to refine or detailize 3D shapes using machine learning, expanding the capabilities of AI-assisted 3D content creation. Given a coarse voxel shape (e.g., one produced with a simple box extrusion tool or via generative modeling), a user can directly “paint” desired target styles representing compelling geometric details, from input exemplar shapes, over different regions of the coarse shape. These regions are then up-sampled into high-resolution geometries which adhere with the painted styles. To achieve such controllable and localized 3D detailization, we build on top of a Pyramid GAN by making it masking-aware. We devise novel structural losses and priors to ensure that our method preserves both desired coarse structures and fine-grained features even if the painted styles are borrowed from diverse sources, e.g., different semantic parts and even different shape categories. Through extensive experiments, we show that our ability to localize details enables novel interactive creative workflows and applications. Our experiments further demonstrate that in comparison to prior techniques built on global detailization, our method generates structure-preserving, high-resolution stylized geometries with more coherent shape details and style transitions.

title: 秦磊*, 姜中, 戴琪珠
title_en: Qin Lei*, Jiang Zhong, Qizhu Dai
abstract: 曲线物体分割在各类应用中发挥着关键作用,但该领域数据集常因数据采集与标注成本高昂而规模较小。为应对这些挑战,本文提出了一种新颖方法用于扩展曲线物体分割数据集,重点提升生成数据的信息量及语义图与生成图像之间的一致性。我们的方法通过生成曲线物体的多文本特征来丰富合成数据的信息量。通过结合原始数据集中每个样本的文本特征,我们获得超出原始数据分布的合成图像。为此创建了基于文本生成的曲线物体分割数据集(COSTG)。该数据集不仅包含标准语义图,还整合了部分曲线物体特征的文本描述。为确保合成语义图与图像之间的一致性,我们引入了语义一致性保留控制网络(SCP ControlNet)。该方法是对带有空间自适应归一化(SPADE)的ControlNet进行改进,使其能够保留通常在归一化层中被洗去的语义信息。这种改进有助于更精确的语义图像合成。实验结果在三种类型的曲线物体(血管造影、裂缝和视网膜)和六个公开数据集(CHUAC、XCAD、DCA1、DRIVE、CHASEDB1和Crack500)上验证了方法的有效性。由本方法生成的合成数据不仅扩展了数据集,还有效提升了其他曲线物体分割模型的性能。源代码和数据集可在https://github.com/tanlei0/COSTG获取。
abstract_en: Curvilinear object segmentation plays a crucial role across various applications, yet datasets in this domain often suffer from small scale due to the high costs associated with data acquisition and annotation. To address these challenges, this paper introduces a novel approach for expanding curvilinear object segmentation datasets, focusing on enhancing the informativeness of generated data and the consistency between semantic maps and generated images. Our method enriches synthetic data informativeness by generating curvilinear objects through their multiple textual features. By combining textual features from each sample in original dataset, we obtain synthetic images that beyond the original dataset’s distribution. This initiative necessitated the creation of the Curvilinear Object Segmentation based on Text Generation (COSTG) dataset. Designed to surpass the limitations of conventional datasets, COSTG incorporates not only standard semantic maps but also some textual descriptions of curvilinear object features. To ensure consistency between synthetic semantic maps and images, we introduce the Semantic Consistency Preserving ControlNet (SCP ControlNet). This involves an adaptation of ControlNet with Spatially-Adaptive Normalization (SPADE), allowing it to preserve semantic information that would typically be washed away in normalization layers. This modification facilitates more accurate semantic image synthesis. Experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of our approach across three types of curvilinear objects (angiography, crack and retina) and six public datasets (CHUAC, XCAD, DCA1, DRIVE, CHASEDB1 and Crack500). The synthetic data generated by our method not only expand the dataset, but also effectively improves the performance of other curvilinear object segmentation models. Source code and dataset are available at https://github.com/tanlei0/ COSTG.

title: Qing Jiang*, Feng Li, Zhaoyang Zeng, Shilong Liu, Tianhe Ren, Lei Zhang*
title_en: Qing Jiang*, Feng Li, Zhaoyang Zeng, Shilong Liu, Tianhe Ren, Lei Zhang*
abstract: 我们提出了一种高度实用的开放集目标检测模型。先前依赖文本提示的开放集目标检测方法能够有效封装常见物体的抽象概念,但由于数据稀缺和描述限制,难以处理罕见或复杂物体的表示。相反,视觉提示在通过具体视觉示例描述新物体方面表现出色,但在传达物体的抽象概念方面不如文本提示有效。我们认识到文本提示和视觉提示的互补优势与局限性,通过对比学习在单一模型中融合两种提示,提出了一种协同模型。该模型接受包括文本提示、视觉提示以及两者的组合在内的多种输入格式,从而能够通过切换两种提示模态应对不同场景。全面实验表明,该模型在广泛场景中展现出卓越的零样本目标检测能力。我们证明了文本提示和视觉提示在协同作用中能够相互受益,这对于覆盖海量且复杂的现实场景、推动通用目标检测的发展至关重要。API代码可在https://github.com/IDEA-Research/T-Rex获取。
abstract_en: We present , a highly practical model for open-set object detection. Previous open-set object detection methods relying on text prompts effectively encapsulate the abstract concept of common objects, but struggle with rare or complex object representation due to data scarcity and descriptive limitations. Conversely, visual prompts excel in depicting novel objects through concrete visual examples, but fall short in conveying the abstract concept of objects as effectively as text prompts. Recognizing the complementary strengths and weaknesses of both text and visual prompts, we introduce that synergizes both prompts within a single model through contrastive learning. accepts inputs in diverse formats, including text prompts, visual prompts, and the combination of both, so that it can handle different scenarios by switching between the two prompt modalities. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that exhibits remarkable zero-shot object detection capabilities across a wide spectrum of scenarios. We show that text prompts and visual prompts can benefit from each other within the synergy, which is essential to cover massive and complicated real-world scenarios and pave the way towards generic object detection. API code is available at https://github.com/IDEA-Research/T-Rex.

title: 清苏*,纪世浩
title_en: Qing Su*, Shihao Ji
abstract: 基于蒸馏的自监督学习通常由于其剧烈的聚类过程和更尖锐的目标分布实现而产生更压缩的表示。为克服这一局限性并保留更多输入信息,我们引入UDI,概念化为非压缩的基于蒸馏的自监督学习(SSL)。UDI通过鼓励从分层抽样得出的局部预测综合概况中蒸馏出的多模态预测来丰富学习到的表示。我们的评估表明,UDI不仅在图像分类任务中促进语义有意义的实例级表示,取得优于或与最先进SSL方法相当的结果,还能有效保留输入的干扰因素,在密集预测任务(包括目标检测和分割)中带来显著性能提升。此外,UDI在低样本图像分类任务中表现竞争力,提升了联合嵌入管道的可扩展性。我们提供了各种可视化结果和消融研究以进一步阐明UDI的机制。源代码可在https: //github.com/ISL-CV/udi获取。
abstract_en: Distillation-based self-supervised learning typically leads to more compressed representations due to its radical clustering process and the implementation of a sharper target distribution. To overcome this limitation and preserve more information from input, we introduce UDI, conceptualized as Unsqueezed Distillation-based self-supervised learning (SSL). UDI enriches the learned representation by encouraging multimodal prediction distilled from a consolidated profile of local predictions that are derived via stratified sampling. Our evaluations show that UDI not only promotes semantically meaningful representations at instance level, delivering superior or competitive results to state-of-the-art SSL methods in image classification, but also effectively preserves the nuisance of input, which yields significant improvement in dense prediction tasks, including object detection and segmentation. Additionally, UDI performs competitively in low-shot image classification, improving the scalability of joint-embedding pipelines. Various visualizations and ablation studies are presented to further elucidate the mechanisms behind UDI. Our source code is available at https: //github.com/ISL-CV/udi.

title: Qingfeng Shi, Jing Wei, Fei Shen*, Zhengtao Zhang
title_en: Qingfeng Shi, Jing Wei, Fei Shen*, Zhengtao Zhang
abstract: 图像生成可以解决缺陷检测中标签数据不足的问题。大多数缺陷生成方法仅在单一产品上进行训练,未考虑多产品间的一致性,导致生成结果质量与多样性较差。为解决这些问题,我们提出DefectDiffu,一种新颖的文本引导扩散方法,用于建模多产品间的内部产品背景一致性与跨产品缺陷一致性,并调节一致性扰动方向以控制产品类型和缺陷强度,实现多样化缺陷图像生成。首先,我们利用文本编码器为解耦集成架构中的背景、缺陷和融合部分分别提供一致性提示,从而分离缺陷与正常背景。其次,我们提出双自由策略,通过一致性方向的两阶段扰动生成缺陷图像,通过调整扰动尺度控制产品类型和缺陷强度。此外,DefectDiffu可利用缺陷部分的交叉注意力图生成缺陷掩码标注。最后,为提升小缺陷和掩码的生成质量,我们提出自适应注意力增强损失以增强对缺陷的关注。实验结果表明,DefectDiffu在生成质量和多样性方面超越了现有最先进的方法,从而有效提升下游缺陷检测性能。此外,缺陷扰动方向可在不同产品间迁移,实现零样本缺陷生成,这对解决数据不足问题具有重要意义。代码已开源至https://github.com/FFDD-diffusion/DefectDiffu。
abstract_en: Image generation can solve insufficient labeled data issues in defect detection. Most defect generation methods are only trained on a single product without considering the consistencies among multiple products, leading to poor quality and diversity of generated results. To address these issues, we propose DefectDiffu, a novel text-guided diffusion method to model both intra-product background consistency and inter-product defect consistency across multiple products and modulate the consistency perturbation directions to control product type and defect strength, achieving diversified defect image generation. Firstly, we leverage a text encoder to separately provide consistency prompts for background, defect, and fusion parts of the disentangled integrated architecture, thereby disentangling defects and normal backgrounds. Secondly, we propose the double-free strategy to generate defect images through two-stage perturbation of consistency direction, thereby controlling product type and defect strength by adjusting the perturbation scale. Besides, DefectDiffu can generate defect mask annotations utilizing cross-attention maps from the defect part. Finally, to improve the generation quality of small defects and masks, we propose the adaptive attention-enhance loss to increase the attention to defects. Experimental results demonstrate that DefectDiffu surpasses state-of-the-art methods in terms of generation quality and diversity, thus effectively improving downstream defection performance. Moreover, defect perturbation directions can be transferred among various products to achieve zero-shot defect generation, which is highly beneficial for addressing insufficient data issues. The code are available at https://github.com/FFDD-diffusion/DefectDiffu.

title: Qingshan Xu*, Xuanyu Yi, Jianyao Xu, Wenbing Tao, Yew Soon Ong, Hanwang Zhang
title_en: Qingshan Xu*, Xuanyu Yi, Jianyao Xu, Wenbing Tao, Yew Soon Ong, Hanwang Zhang
abstract: 使用稀疏输入进行新颖视角合成对神经辐射场(NeRF)提出了巨大挑战。近期研究证明,位置编码(PE)的频率正则化可以在少样本NeRF中取得 promising 结果。本文揭示了PE频率正则化与渲染损失之间存在不一致性,这阻碍了少样本NeRF合成高质量新颖视角。为缓解这种不一致性,我们提出了一种针对少样本NeRF的自适应渲染损失正则化方法,称为AR-NeRF。具体而言,我们提出了一个两阶段渲染监督机制和自适应渲染损失权重学习策略,以对齐PE与2D像素监督的频率关系。通过这种方式,AR-NeRF可以在训练初期更好地学习全局结构,并在训练过程中自适应地学习局部细节。大量实验表明,我们的AR-NeRF在不同数据集(包括物体级和复杂场景)上均取得了最先进的性能。我们的代码将在https://github.com/GhiXu/AR-NeRF上发布。
abstract_en: Novel view synthesis with sparse inputs poses great challenges to Neural Radiance Field (NeRF). Recent works demonstrate that the frequency regularization of Positional Encoding (PE) can achieve promising results for few-shot NeRF. In this work, we reveal that there exists an inconsistency between the frequency regularization of PE and rendering loss. This prevents few-shot NeRF from synthesizing higher-quality novel views. To mitigate this inconsistency, we propose Adaptive Rendering loss regularization for few-shot NeRF, dubbed AR-NeRF. Specifically, we present a two-phase rendering supervision and an adaptive rendering loss weight learning strategy to align the frequency relationship between PE and 2D-pixel supervision. In this way, AR-NeRF can learn global structures better in the early training phase and adaptively learn local details throughout the training process. Extensive experiments show that our AR-NeRF achieves state-of-the-art performance on different datasets, including object-level and complex scenes. Our code will be available at https://github.com/GhiXu/ AR-NeRF.

title: Qingtian Zhu, Zizhuang Wei, Zhongtian Zheng, Yifan Zhan, Zhuyu Yao, Jiawang Zhang, Kejian Wu, Yinqiang Zheng*
title_en: Qingtian Zhu, Zizhuang Wei, Zhongtian Zheng, Yifan Zhan, Zhuyu Yao, Jiawang Zhang, Kejian Wu, Yinqiang Zheng*
abstract: 基于点的表示方法在新视角合成领域近期受到广泛关注,因其独特的优势,包括直观的几何表示、简单的操作和更快的收敛速度。然而,根据我们的观察,这些基于点的神经重渲染方法仅在理想条件下才能表现出色,并且在处理噪声点、碎片化点云和无边界场景时存在困难,而这些情况在实际应用中却非常常见。为此,我们重新审视了一种具有影响力的基于点的方法——神经点基图形(NPBG),并提出了鲁棒点基图形(RPBG)。我们深入分析了阻碍NPBG在通用数据集上实现满意渲染的因素,并相应地改进了流程,使其在野外数据集中更具鲁棒性。受图像修复实践的启发,我们大幅增强了神经渲染器,仅以可接受的开销实现了基于注意力的点可见性校正和不完整光栅化的修复。我们还寻求一种简单轻量的环境建模替代方案,并采用迭代方法缓解几何建模不佳的问题。通过在不同拍摄条件和相机轨迹的广泛数据集上的全面评估,RPBG在基准方法上稳定地表现出显著优势,并展现出优于基于NeRF的最新方法的卓越鲁棒性。代码可在https://github.com/QT-Zhu/RPBG获取。
abstract_en: Point-based representations have recently gained popularity in novel view synthesis, for their unique advantages, , intuitive geometric representation, simple manipulation, and faster convergence. However, based on our observation, these point-based neural re-rendering methods are only expected to perform well under ideal conditions and suffer from noisy, patchy points and unbounded scenes, which are challenging to handle but defacto common in real applications. To this end, we revisit one such influential method, known as Neural Point-based Graphics (NPBG), as our baseline, and propose Robust Point-based Graphics (RPBG). We in-depth analyze the factors that prevent NPBG from achieving satisfactory renderings on generic datasets, and accordingly reform the pipeline to make it more robust to varying datasets in-the-wild. Inspired by the practices in image restoration, we greatly enhance the neural renderer to enable the attention-based correction of point visibility and the inpainting of incomplete rasterization, with only acceptable overheads. We also seek for a simple and lightweight alternative for environment modeling and an iterative method to alleviate the problem of poor geometry. By thorough evaluation on a wide range of datasets with different shooting conditions and camera trajectories, RPBG stably outperforms the baseline by a large margin, and exhibits its great robustness over state-of-the-art NeRF-based variants. Code available at https://github.com/QT-Zhu/RPBG.

title: Qingwang Zhang, Yingying Zhu*
title_en: Qingwang Zhang, Yingying Zhu*
abstract: 跨视角地理定位通过将地面图像与带有地理标签的航拍图像数据库进行匹配,为GPS信号不稳定或不可用时提供地理定位信息的可行替代方案。尽管在CVUSA和CVACT等常见基准上已取得显著进展,但对现实环境挑战(如恶劣天气或传感器噪声)的鲁棒性仍缺乏全面考虑。这一缺陷对在自动驾驶和机器人导航等安全关键领域部署该技术构成了重大挑战。据我们所知,目前尚无专门用于评估跨视角地理定位鲁棒性的基准。为全面、公平地评估跨视角地理定位模型在现实场景中的鲁棒性,我们引入了16种常见的数据损坏类型。通过在公开数据集上合成这些损坏,我们建立了两个细粒度的损坏鲁棒性基准(CVUSA-C和CVACT val-C)和三个全面的损坏鲁棒性基准(CVUSA-C-ALL、CVACT val-C-ALL和CVACT test-C-ALL),涵盖约150万张损坏图像。随后,我们在多种跨视角地理定位模型上开展大规模实验,评估其在损坏环境中的鲁棒性并获得新见解。最后,我们探索了两种数据增强策略作为提升模型鲁棒性的潜在解决方案。结合所提出的训练策略,这些方法有效增强了多个模型的鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Cross-view geo-localization serves as a viable alternative to providing geographical location information when GPS signals are unstable or unavailable by matching ground images with geo-tagged aerial image databases. While significant progress has been made on some common benchmarks like CVUSA and CVACT, there remains a lack of comprehensive consideration for robustness against real-world environmental challenges such as adverse weather or sensor noise. This deficiency poses a significant challenge for deploying this technology in safety-critical domains like autonomous driving and robot navigation. To the best of our knowledge, there is currently no specialized benchmark for evaluating the robustness of cross-view geo-localization. To comprehensively and fairly evaluate the robustness of cross-view geo-localization models in real-world scenarios, we introduce 16 common types of data corruption. By synthesizing these corruptions on public datasets, we establish two fine-grained corruption robustness benchmarks (CVUSA-C and CVACT val-C) and three comprehensive corruption robustness benchmarks (CVUSA-C-ALL, CVACT val-C-ALL, and CVACT test-C-ALL), covering approximately 1.5 million corrupted images. Subsequently, we conduct large-scale experiments on various cross-view geo-localization models to evaluate their robustness in corrupted environments and derive novel insights. Finally, we explore two data augmentation strategies as potential solutions to enhance model robustness. Combined with the training strategies proposed, these approaches effectively enhance the robustness of multiple models.

title: 张清文*, 杨毅, 李沛政, Olov Andersson, Patric Jensfelt
title_en: Qingwen Zhang*, Yi Yang, Peizheng Li, Olov Andersson, Patric Jensfelt
abstract: 场景流估计预测连续激光雷达扫描中每个点的三维运动。这种详细的点级信息可以帮助自动驾驶车辆准确预测和理解周围环境的动态变化。当前最先进的方法需要标注数据来训练场景流网络,而标注成本本质上限制了其可扩展性。自监督方法可以克服上述限制,但面临两个主要挑战,阻碍了其性能优化:点分布不平衡和忽略物体级运动约束。在本文中,我们提出SeFlow,一种将高效动态分类集成到基于学习的场景流管道中的自监督方法。我们证明,对静态和动态点进行分类有助于为不同的运动模式设计针对性的目标函数。我们还强调内部聚类一致性和正确的物体点关联对于优化场景流估计的重要性,特别是在物体细节方面。我们的实时方法在Argoverse 2和Waymo数据集的自监督场景流任务中达到了最先进的性能。代码已开源于https://github.com/KTH-RPL/SeFlow。
abstract_en: Scene flow estimation predicts the 3D motion at each point in successive LiDAR scans. This detailed, point-level, information can help autonomous vehicles to accurately predict and understand dynamic changes in their surroundings. Current state-of-the-art methods require annotated data to train scene flow networks and the expense of labeling inherently limits their scalability. Self-supervised approaches can overcome the above limitations, yet face two principal challenges that hinder optimal performance: point distribution imbalance and disregard for object-level motion constraints. In this paper, we propose SeFlow, a self-supervised method that integrates efficient dynamic classification into a learning-based scene flow pipeline. We demonstrate that classifying static and dynamic points helps design targeted objective functions for different motion patterns. We also emphasize the importance of internal cluster consistency and correct object point association to refine the scene flow estimation, in particular on object details. Our real-time capable method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the self-supervised scene flow task on Argoverse 2 and Waymo datasets. The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/KTH-RPL/SeFlow.

title: Qingyan Bai*, Zifan Shi, Yinghao Xu, Hao Ouyang, Qiuyu Wang, Ceyuan Yang, Xuan Wang, Gordon Wetzstein, Yujun Shen*, Qifeng Chen*
title_en: Qingyan Bai*, Zifan Shi, Yinghao Xu, Hao Ouyang, Qiuyu Wang, Ceyuan Yang, Xuan Wang, Gordon Wetzstein, Yujun Shen*, Qifeng Chen*
abstract: 本文提出了一种实用方法,能够以三维感知的方式,根据给定的提示(如参考图像或文本描述)高效编辑面部图像。为此,我们从三维肖像生成器和文本到图像模型中蒸馏出一个轻量模块,分别提供面部几何的先验知识和卓越的编辑能力。这种设计相较于现有方法具有两个显著优势。首先,我们的方法通过前馈网络实现实时编辑(即每张图像约0.04秒),速度比第二竞争对手快100倍以上。其次,得益于强大的先验知识,我们的模块能够专注于学习与编辑相关的变体,从而在训练阶段同时处理各种类型的编辑,并进一步支持在推理阶段快速适应用户指定的自定义编辑类型(例如,每种风格约需5分钟微调)。项目页面可在此处找到。
abstract_en: This work presents , a practical method that can efficiently edit a face image following given prompts, like reference images or text descriptions, in a 3D-aware manner. To this end, a lightweight module is distilled from a 3D portrait generator and a text-to-image model, which provide prior knowledge of face geometry and superior editing capability, respectively. Such a design brings two compelling advantages over existing approaches. First, our method achieves real-time editing with a feedforward network (i.e., ∼0.04s per image), over 100× faster than the second competitor. Second, thanks to the powerful priors, our module could focus on the learning of editing-related variations, such that it manages to handle various types of editing simultaneously in the training phase and further supports fast adaptation to user-specified customized types of editing during inference (e.g., with ∼5min fine-tuning per style). Project page can be found here.

title: Qingyuan Wang*, Barry Cardiff, Antoine Frappé, Benoit Larras, Deepu John*
title_en: Qingyuan Wang*, Barry Cardiff, Antoine Frappé, Benoit Larras, Deepu John*
abstract: 本文介绍了TinySaver,一种类似早期退出的动态模型压缩方法,该方法通过使用小型模型来自适应地替代大型模型。与传统压缩技术不同,像TinySaver这样的动态方法可以利用难度差异,使某些输入能够提前完成推理过程,从而节省计算资源。大多数现有的早期退出设计是通过在模型主干上附加额外的网络分支来实现的。然而,我们的研究发现,完全独立的小型模型可以以对性能影响最小的方式替代大型模型的大部分工作。将它们作为第一个退出点可以显著提高计算效率。通过搜索并采用最适合的微型模型作为特定大型模型的计算节省器,所提出的方法成为一种新颖且通用的模型压缩方法。这一发现将帮助研究社区探索新的压缩方法,以应对快速发展的AI模型所带来的日益增长的计算需求。我们在ImageNet-1k分类任务中对这种方法的评估表明,它在各种现代视觉模型中具有将计算操作数量减少高达90%的潜力,同时仅带来微乎其微的性能损失。
abstract_en: This paper introduces TinySaver, an early-exit-like dynamic model compression approach which employs tiny models to substitute large models adaptively. Distinct from traditional compression techniques, dynamic methods like TinySaver can leverage the difficulty differences to allow certain inputs to complete their inference processes early, thereby conserving computational resources. Most existing early exit designs are implemented by attaching additional network branches to the model’s backbone. Our study, however, reveals that completely independent tiny models can replace a substantial portion of the larger models’ job with minimal impact on performance. Employing them as the first exit can remarkably enhance computational efficiency. By searching and employing the most appropriate tiny model as the computational saver for a given large model, the proposed approaches work as a novel and generic method to model compression. This finding will help the research community in exploring new compression methods to address the escalating computational demands posed by rapidly evolving AI models. Our evaluation of this approach in ImageNet-1k classification demonstrates its potential to reduce the number of compute operations by up to 90%, with only negligible losses in performance, across various modern vision models.

title: Qingzheng Huang, Xilin He, Xiaole Xian, Qinliang Lin, Weicheng Xie*, Siyang Song, Linlin Shen, Zitong Yu
title_en: Qingzheng Huang, Xilin He, Xiaole Xian, Qinliang Lin, Weicheng Xie*, Siyang Song, Linlin Shen, Zitong Yu
abstract: 从噪声标签中学习是一项具有挑战性的任务,因为噪声标签可能破坏决策边界并导致次优的泛化性能。大多数以往处理噪声标签的方法基于样本选择,利用小损失准则来减少噪声标签的不利影响。然而,它们面临一个关键限制,即无法有效区分困难样本与仅被错误标记的样本。同时,关于样本在训练过程中轨迹变化的研究仍较为缺乏。为此,我们提出了一种基于移动轨迹和特征密度的置信度样本选择策略(称为MTaDCS)。与现有基于小损失的方法不同,该策略通过在移动轨迹的基础上逐步选择自信样本,探索潜在空间中样本的局部特征密度,从而构建置信度集。因此,我们的MTaDCS通过置信度集的设置逐步隔离噪声标签,实现从困难样本中学习判别性特征的目标。在包含模拟噪声和现实世界噪声的数据集上进行的大量实验验证了所提MTaDCS在多种指标上优于最先进的方法。代码已发布在https://github.com/QZ-CODER/-ECCV-24-MTaD
abstract_en: Learning from noisy labels is a challenging task, as noisy labels can compromise decision boundaries and result in suboptimal generalization performance. Most previous approaches for dealing noisy labels are based on sample selection, which utilized the small loss criterion to reduce the adverse effects of noisy labels. Nevertheless, they encounter a critical limitation in being unable to effectively separate challenging samples from those that were merely mislabeled. Meanwhile, there is a lack of researches on the trace changes of samples during training. To this end, we propose a novel moving trace and feature density-based confidence sample selection strategy (called MTaDCS). Different from existing small loss-based approaches, the local feature density of samples in the latent space is explored to construct a confidence set by selectively choosing confident samples in a progressive manner in terms of moving trace. Therefore, our MTaDCS can gradually isolate noisy labels through the setting of confidence set and achieve the goal of learning discriminative features from hard samples. Extensive experiments conducted on datasets with simulated and real-world noises validate that the proposed MTaDCS outperforms the state-of-the-art methods in terms of various metrics. The code is available at https://github.com/QZ-CODER/-ECCV-24-MTaD

title: Qinji Yu*, Yirui Wang*, Ke Yan, Haoshen Li, Dazhou Guo, Li Zhang, Na Shen, Qifeng Wang, Xiaowei Ding, Le Lu, Xianghua Ye*, Dakai Jin*
title_en: Qinji Yu*, Yirui Wang*, Ke Yan, Haoshen Li, Dazhou Guo, Li Zhang, Na Shen, Qifeng Wang, Xiaowei Ding, Le Lu, Xianghua Ye*, Dakai Jin*
abstract: 淋巴结(LN)评估是放射学和肿瘤学常规临床工作流程中一项关键但极具挑战性的任务。准确的淋巴结分析对于癌症诊断、分期和治疗规划至关重要。在三维CT图像中,即使对于经验丰富的医生而言,发现分布零散、对比度低且具有临床意义的淋巴结也极具难度,尤其是在观察者间差异较大的情况下。以往的自动淋巴结检测方法通常由于相邻解剖结构(如血管、肌肉、食管等)在图像强度、形状或纹理上相似,导致召回率有限且假阳性(FPs)较高。在本研究中,我们提出了一种新的淋巴结检测Transformer模型,命名为LN-DETR,通过位置偏置查询选择和对比学习查询机制,增强淋巴结查询的表征能力,这对于提高检测灵敏度并减少假阳性或重复检测至关重要。我们还通过引入高效的多尺度2.5D融合方案来增强LN-DETR,以整合三维上下文信息。通过结合来自不同身体部位(颈部、胸部和腹部)及不同病理/癌症类型的七个淋巴结数据集,对1067名患者的三维CT扫描进行训练和测试(包含10,000多个标注的淋巴结),我们的方法在内部和外部测试中,在相同假阳性率下,显著提升了先前领先方法的性能,平均召回率提高了4-5%。我们进一步在DeepLesion基准的通用病变检测任务中进行评估,我们的方法取得了88.46%的平均召回率,优于其他领先方法的报告结果。
abstract_en: Lymph node (LN) assessment is a critical yet very challenging task in the routine clinical workflow of radiology and oncology. Accurate LN analysis is essential for cancer diagnosis, staging and treatment planning. Finding scatteredly distributed, low-contrast clinically relevant LNs in 3D CT is difficult even for experienced physicians under high inter-observer variations. Previous automatic LN detection typically yields limited recall and high false positives (FPs) due to adjacent anatomies with similar image intensities, shapes or textures (vessels, muscles, esophagus, etc). In this work, we propose a new LN DEtection TRansformer, named LN-DETR, with location debiased query selection and contrastive query learning to enhance the representation ability of LN queries, important to increase the detection sensitivity and reduce FPs or duplicates. We also enhance LN-DETR by adapting an efficient multi-scale 2.5D fusion scheme to incorporate the 3D context. Trained and tested on 3D CT scans of 1067 patients (with 10, 000+ labeled LNs) via combining seven LN datasets from different body parts (neck, chest, and abdomen) and pathologies/cancers, our method significantly improves the performance of previous leading methods by > 4 ∼ 5% average recall at the same FP rates in both internal and external testing. We further evaluate on the universal lesion detection task using DeepLesion benchmark, and our method achieves the top performance of 88.46% averaged recall, compared with other leading reported results.

title: Qinyu Yang, Haoxin Chen, Yong Zhang*, Menghan Xia, Xiaodong Cun, Zhixun Su*, Ying Shan
title_en: Qinyu Yang, Haoxin Chen, Yong Zhang*, Menghan Xia, Xiaodong Cun, Zhixun Su*, Ying Shan
abstract: 为提升合成视频的质量,目前主流方法涉及重新训练专家扩散模型,并通过噪声添加-去噪过程进行优化。尽管训练成本较高,但保持原始视频与增强视频内容一致性仍是主要挑战。为解决该问题,我们提出一种新型框架,同时考虑视觉质量和内容一致性。内容一致性通过保持输入结构的损失函数实现,而视觉质量则借助预训练扩散模型的去噪过程进行提升。针对所构建的优化问题,我们开发了一种即插即用的噪声优化策略,称为噪声校准(Noise Calibration)。通过少量迭代优化初始随机噪声,可有效保留原始视频内容,增强效果显著提升。大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性。0 通讯作者
abstract_en: In order to improve the quality of synthesized videos, currently, one predominant method involves retraining an expert diffusion model and then implementing a noising-denoising process for refinement. Despite the significant training costs, maintaining consistency of content between the original and enhanced videos remains a major challenge. To tackle this challenge, we propose a novel formulation that considers both visual quality and consistency of content. Consistency of content is ensured by a proposed loss function that maintains the structure of the input, while visual quality is improved by utilizing the denoising process of pretrained diffusion models. To address the formulated optimization problem, we have developed a plug-and-play noise optimization strategy, referred to as Noise Calibration. By refining the initial random noise through a few iterations, the content of original video can be largely preserved, and the enhancement effect demonstrates a notable improvement. Extensive experiments have demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed method. 0 Corresponding author

title: Qinyu Zhao*, Ming Xu, Kartik Gupta, Akshay Asthana, Liang Zheng, Stephen Gould
title_en: Qinyu Zhao*, Ming Xu, Kartik Gupta, Akshay Asthana, Liang Zheng, Stephen Gould
abstract: 大规模视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)旨在理解和响应人类指令,但偶尔会因不当指令生成幻觉或有害内容。本研究采用线性探测方法,揭示LVLMs输出层中的隐藏知识。我们证明,首个标记的logit分布包含足够的信息以判断是否响应指令,包括识别无解的视觉问题、抵御 jailbreaking 攻击以及识别欺骗性问题。此类隐藏知识在响应生成过程中会逐渐在后续标记的logit中丢失。随后,我们展示了一种在生成首个标记时的简单解码策略,有效提升了生成内容的质量。实验中我们发现几个有趣发现:首先,CLIP模型已包含解决这些任务的强信号,表明现有数据集可能存在偏差。其次,利用首个logit分布可提升三个额外任务的性能,包括数学求解中的不确定性指示、缓解幻觉以及图像分类。最后,使用相同训练数据简单微调LVLMs可提升模型性能,但在此类任务中仍弱于线性探测方法。1 1 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Qinyu-Allen-Zhao/LVLM-LP 获取。
abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs), designed to interpret and respond to human instructions, occasionally generate hallucinated or harmful content due to inappropriate instructions. This study uses linear probing to shed light on the hidden knowledge at the output layers of LVLMs. We demonstrate that the logit distributions of the first tokens contain sufficient information to determine whether to respond to the instructions, including recognizing unanswerable visual questions, defending against jailbreaking attacks, and identifying deceptive questions. Such hidden knowledge is gradually lost in logits of subsequent tokens during response generation. Then, we illustrate a simple decoding strategy at the generation of the first token, effectively improving the generated content. In experiments, we find a few interesting insights: First, the CLIP model already contains a strong signal for solving these tasks, which indicates potential bias in the existing datasets. Second, we observe performance improvement by utilizing the first logit distributions on three additional tasks, including indicating uncertainty in math solving, mitigating hallucination, and image classification. Last, with the same training data, simply finetuning LVLMs improves models’ performance but is still inferior to linear probing on these tasks. 1 1 Our code is available at https://github.com/Qinyu-Allen-Zhao/LVLM-LP.

title: 崔琼洁*, 孙怀江, 李斌, 卢建峰, 李伟清
title_en: Qiongjie Cui*, Huaijiang Sun, Bin Li, Jianfeng Lu, Weiqing Li
abstract: 现有运动预测模型虽然取得进展,但难以弥合源域与目标域之间的差距。近期解决方案通常依赖于一个不现实的假设,即目标域保持静止。然而,由于环境的持续变化,现实世界测试分布可能随时间经历持续/连续的偏移,导致在适应演进域时出现灾难性遗忘和误差累积。为解决这些挑战,本文提出HoCoTTA框架,用于稳态持续测试时适应。该框架遵循知识蒸馏与参数隔离范式,能够识别领域不变知识和领域特定知识,其中前者在跨域持续测试时适应中被共享(需保留),后者则需要更新。具体而言,我们提出多域稳态评估方法,以估计模型参数在面对新域样本时的不确定性。随后,通过计算费舍尔信息矩阵衡量参数敏感性,数值越大表示参数越具有领域敏感性,反之亦然。此外,我们提出隔离参数优化策略,用于更新领域特定参数以适应新域,同时保留不变参数。在实验结果中,HoCoTTA在多个基准测试中超越了现有最先进方法,特别是在应对连续域漂移方面表现出色,取得了显著提升。
abstract_en: Existing motion forecasting models, while making progress, struggle to bridge the gap between the source and target domains. Recent solutions often rely on an unrealistic assumption that the target domain remains stationary. Due to the ever-changing environment, however, the real-world test distribution may experience ongoing/continual shifts over time, leading to catastrophic forgetting and error accumulation when adapting to evolving domains. To solve these challenges, this work introduces HoCoTTA, a framework for homeostatic continual test-time adaptation. It aligns with the knowledge distillation and parameter isolation paradigm, enabling the identification of domain-invariant and domain-specific knowledge, where the former is shared (to be retained) in continual TTA across domains, while the latter needs to be updated. Specifically, we propose a multi-domain homeostasis assessment to estimate the uncertainty of the current model parameter when faced with novel-domain samples. Then, the Fisher information matrix is computed to measure the parameter sensitivity, with larger indicating the domain-sensitive parameter, and vice versa. Moreover, we propose an isolated parameter optimization strategy to update those domain-specific parameters to adapt to the new-domain, while preserving the invariant ones. In our experimental result, HoCoTTA outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches on several benchmarks, especially excelling in addressing continuous domain drifts, achieving a large improvement.

title: Qiran Zou, Shangyuan Yuan, Shian Du, Yu Wang, Chang Liu, Yi Xu, Jie Chen, Xiangyang Ji*
title_en: Qiran Zou, Shangyuan Yuan, Shian Du, Yu Wang, Chang Liu, Yi Xu, Jie Chen, Xiangyang Ji*
abstract: 我们研究了一个具有挑战性的任务:文本到运动合成,旨在生成与文本描述一致且具有协调运动的运动。目前,基于部件的方法将部件划分引入运动合成过程以实现更细粒度的生成。然而,这些方法面临不同部件运动之间缺乏协调性以及网络难以理解部件概念等挑战。此外,引入更细粒度的部件概念会带来计算复杂性问题。在本文中,我们提出了Part-Coordinating Text-to-Motion Synthesis(ParCo),该方法具备增强的部件运动理解能力和不同部件运动生成器之间的通信能力,确保实现协调且细粒度的运动合成。具体而言,我们将全身运动离散化为多个部件运动,以建立不同部件的先验概念。随后,我们采用多个轻量级生成器合成不同部件运动,并通过我们的部件协调模块进行协调。我们的方法在常见基准测试中表现出色,计算成本经济,包括HumanML3D和KIT-ML,提供了其有效性的有力证据。代码可在:https://github.com/qrzou/ParCo 获取。
abstract_en: We study a challenging task: text-to-motion synthesis, aiming to generate motions that align with textual descriptions and exhibit coordinated movements. Currently, the part-based methods introduce part partition into the motion synthesis process to achieve finer-grained generation. However, these methods encounter challenges such as the lack of coordination between different part motions and difficulties for networks to understand part concepts. Moreover, introducing finer-grained part concepts poses computational complexity challenges. In this paper, we propose Part-Coordinating Text-to-Motion Synthesis (ParCo), endowed with enhanced capabilities for understanding part motions and communication among different part motion generators, ensuring a coordinated and fined-grained motion synthesis. Specifically, we discretize whole-body motion into multiple part motions to establish the prior concept of different parts. Afterward, we employ multiple lightweight generators designed to synthesize different part motions and coordinate them through our part coordination module. Our approach demonstrates superior performance on common benchmarks with economic computations, including HumanML3D and KIT-ML, providing substantial evidence of its effectiveness. Code is available at: https://github.com/qrzou/ParCo.

title: Qirui Wu*, Sonia Raychaudhuri, Daniel Ritchie, Manolis Savva, Angel X Chang
title_en: Qirui Wu*, Sonia Raychaudhuri, Daniel Ritchie, Manolis Savva, Angel X Chang
abstract: 我们引入了()数据集,该数据集包含合成三维场景,其场景布局与Matterport3D全景图像中的真实世界场景布局相匹配。与先前工作相比,该数据集具有更完整且密集填充的场景,其中物体与全景图像中的真实世界观测存在关联。此外,该数据集还提供了物体支撑层次结构,并为每个场景提供匹配的物体集合(例如,围绕餐桌的相同椅子)。总体而言,该数据集包含19,000个物体,由超过100个物体类别中的3,784个不同CAD模型表示。我们在场景理解任务上验证了该数据集的有效性。我们发现:1)在该数据集上训练可实现更好的泛化能力;2)使用该数据集训练的支撑关系预测性能优于基于启发式计算的支撑关系;3)该数据集为未来全景场景理解研究提供了具有挑战性的基准。
abstract_en: We introduce the () dataset of synthetic 3D scenes mirroring the real-world scene arrangements from Matterport3D panoramas. Compared to prior work, has more complete and densely populated scenes with objects linked to real-world observations in panoramas. also provides an object support hierarchy, and matching object sets (e.g., same chairs around a dining table) for each scene. Overall, contains 19K objects represented by 3,784 distinct CAD models from over 100 object categories. We demonstrate the effectiveness of on the task. We find that: 1) training on enables better generalization; 2) support relation prediction trained with improves performance compared to heuristically calculated support; and 3) offers a challenging benchmark for future work on panoramic scene understanding.

title: Qitai Wang, Jiawei He, Yuntao Chen, Zhaoxiang Zhang*
title_en: Qitai Wang, Jiawei He, Yuntao Chen, Zhaoxiang Zhang*
abstract: 现有的基于视觉的3D感知端到端跟踪器由于检测与跟踪任务之间的冲突导致性能退化。在本工作中,我们深入分析了这一冲突,此前该冲突被模糊地归因于任务特定目标特征的不兼容性。我们发现两个任务之间的冲突源于其部分相互冲突的分类梯度,这源于正样本分配的细微差异。基于这一观察,我们提出协调两个任务中具有相反极性的目标查询的冲突梯度。同时,我们根据目标查询在两个任务中的极性动态将其划分为四个组。对正样本分配存在冲突的查询集之间的注意力进行掩码处理。修改跟踪分类损失以抑制不准确的预测。为此,我们提出__TITLE_MATH_1__,这是首个一阶段联合检测与跟踪模型,在统一的目标特征表示下弥合检测与跟踪之间的差距。在nuScenes基于摄像头的目标跟踪基准测试中,__ABS_MATH_1__在验证集上以6.9%的AMOTA超越先前方法,在测试集上以3.1%的AMOTA超越先前方法。
abstract_en: Existing end-to-end trackers for vision-based 3D perception suffer from performance degradation due to the conflict between detection and tracking tasks. In this work, we get to the bottom of this conflict, which was vaguely attributed to incompatible task-specific object features previously. We find the conflict between the two tasks lies in their partially conflicted classification gradients, which stems from their subtle difference in positive sample assignments. Based on this observation, we propose to coordinate those conflicted gradients from object queries with contradicted polarity in the two tasks. We also dynamically split all object queries into four groups based on their polarity in the two tasks. Attention between query sets with conflicted positive sample assignments is masked. The tracking classification loss is modified to suppress inaccurate predictions. To this end, we propose , the first one-stage joint detection and tracking model that bridges the gap between detection and tracking under a unified object feature representation. On the nuScenes camera-based object tracking benchmark, outperforms previous works by 6.9% AMOTA on the validation set and by 3.1% AMOTA on the test set.

title: Qiuhong Shen, Xingyi Yang, Michael Bi Mi, Xinchao Wang*
title_en: Qiuhong Shen, Xingyi Yang, Michael Bi Mi, Xinchao Wang*
abstract: 我们踏上这一古老的研究:从物体可见部分的短暂瞥见中揭示其隐藏的维度。为解决这一问题,我们提出Vista3D框架,能够在短短5分钟内实现快速且一致的3D生成。Vista3D的核心是两阶段方法:粗阶段和细阶段。在粗阶段,我们从单张图像快速生成初始几何结构,采用高斯点云技术。在细阶段,我们直接从学习到的高斯点云提取符号距离函数(SDF),并利用可微等值面表示对其进行优化。此外,通过使用解耦表示和两个独立的隐式函数,捕捉物体可见与隐藏的双重特性,从而提升生成质量。同时,通过角度扩散先验组合,将2D扩散先验的梯度与3D感知扩散先验进行融合。通过广泛评估,我们证明Vista3D能够有效平衡生成3D物体的一致性与多样性。演示和代码将在https://github.com/florinshen/Vista3D上提供。
abstract_en: We embark on the age-old quest: unveiling the hidden dimensions of objects from mere glimpses of their visible parts. To address this, we present Vista3D, a framework that realizes swift and consistent 3D generation within a mere 5 minutes. At the heart of Vista3D lies a two-phase approach: the coarse phase and the fine phase. In the coarse phase, we rapidly generate initial geometry with Gaussian Splatting from a single image. In the fine phase, we extract a Signed Distance Function (SDF) directly from learned Gaussian Splatting, optimizing it with a differentiable isosurface representation. Furthermore, it elevates the quality of generation by using a disentangled representation with two independent implicit functions to capture both visible and obscured aspects of objects. Additionally, it harmonizes gradients from 2D diffusion prior with 3D-aware diffusion priors by angular diffusion prior composition. Through extensive evaluation, we demonstrate that Vista3D effectively sustains a balance between the consistency and diversity of the generated 3D objects. Demos and code will be available at https://github.com/florinshen/Vista3D.

title: 沈秋红、杨兴义、王欣超*
title_en: Qiuhong Shen, Xingyi Yang, Xinchao Wang*
abstract: 本研究针对从2D掩码准确分割3D高斯泼溅(3D-GS)的挑战。传统方法通常依赖迭代梯度下降为每个高斯分配唯一标签,导致优化过程耗时且解不理想。相反,我们提出了一种简单但全局最优的3D-GS分割求解器。我们的方法核心洞察在于,通过重建的3D-GS场景,2D掩码的渲染本质上是每个高斯标签的线性函数。因此,最优标签分配可通过闭式线性规划求解。该方案利用泼溅过程的alpha混合特性实现单步优化。通过在目标函数中引入背景偏置,我们的方法在3D分割中表现出更强的抗噪鲁棒性。值得注意的是,我们的优化过程仅需30秒,比现有最佳方法快约50倍。大量实验验证了该方法在分割各类场景中的效率和鲁棒性,以及在物体移除和修复等下游任务中的优越性能。演示和代码将在https://github.com/florinshen/FlashSplat上发布。
abstract_en: This study addresses the challenge of accurately segmenting 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS) from 2D masks. Conventional methods often rely on iterative gradient descent to assign each Gaussian a unique label, leading to lengthy optimization and sub-optimal solutions. Instead, we propose a straightforward yet globally optimal solver for 3D-GS segmentation. The core insight of our method is that, with a reconstructed 3D-GS scene , the rendering of the 2D masks is essentially a linear function with respect to the labels of each Gaussian. As such, the optimal label assignment can be solved via linear programming in closed form. This solution capitalizes on the alpha blending characteristic of the splatting process for single step optimization. By incorporating the background bias in our objective function, our method shows superior robustness in 3D segmentation against noises. Remarkably, our optimization completes within 30 seconds, about 50× faster than the best existing methods. Extensive experiments demonstrate our method’s efficiency and robustness in segmenting various scenes, and its superior performance in downstream tasks such as object removal and inpainting. Demos and code will be available at https://github.com/florinshen/FlashSplat.

title: Qiyu Chen, Huiyuan Luo, Chengkan Lv*, Zhengtao Zhang
title_en: Qiyu Chen, Huiyuan Luo, Chengkan Lv*, Zhengtao Zhang
abstract: 异常合成策略可以有效提升无监督异常检测性能。然而现有策略在异常合成的覆盖范围和可控性方面存在局限,尤其对于与正常区域非常相似的弱缺陷。本文提出了一种新型统一框架——全局与局部异常协同合成策略(GLASS),该框架在特征层面和图像层面分别基于全局异常合成(GAS)的流形与超球分布约束,以及局部异常合成(LAS)的图像级约束,实现更广泛的异常覆盖。我们的方法通过梯度上升和截断投影引导的高斯噪声,以可控方式合成近似分布的异常。GLASS在MVTec AD(检测AUROC为99.9%)、VisA和MPDD数据集上取得了最先进结果,在弱缺陷检测方面表现突出。该方法在织物缺陷检测的工业应用中进一步验证了其有效性与效率。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/cqylunlun/GLASS获取。
abstract_en: Anomaly synthesis strategies can effectively enhance unsupervised anomaly detection. However, existing strategies have limitations in the coverage and controllability of anomaly synthesis, particularly for weak defects that are very similar to normal regions. In this paper, we propose Global and Local Anomaly co-Synthesis Strategy (GLASS), a novel unified framework designed to synthesize a broader coverage of anomalies under the manifold and hypersphere distribution constraints of Global Anomaly Synthesis (GAS) at the feature level and Local Anomaly Synthesis (LAS) at the image level. Our method synthesizes near-in-distribution anomalies in a controllable way using Gaussian noise guided by gradient ascent and truncated projection. GLASS achieves state-of-the-art results on the MVTec AD (detection AUROC of 99.9%), VisA, and MPDD datasets and excels in weak defect detection. The effectiveness and efficiency have been further validated in industrial applications for woven fabric defect detection. The code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/cqylunlun/GLASS.

title: Qu Yang, Mang Ye*, Dacheng Tao
title_en: Qu Yang, Mang Ye*, Dacheng Tao
abstract: 图像多标签意图理解(MIU)是一个关键但具有挑战性的领域,主要由于意图的模糊性导致资源密集型的标注过程。当前领先的解决方案受到标注数据量有限的制约。为缓解标注数据稀缺问题,我们利用对比语言-图像预训练(CLIP)模型,该模型在文本和视觉模态中具有丰富的知识。我们提出了一种新颖框架——基于CLIP的意图理解(IntCLIP),采用双分支架构。该框架利用CLIP中固有的“视觉”导向知识来增强以“语义”为中心的MIU任务。此外,我们提出分层类别整合方法,有效管理复杂的分层标签结构,与CLIP精细的句子特征提取能力相匹配。我们的视觉辅助聚合进一步通过将语义特征图与关键视觉线索结合,提升意图理解能力。通过在标准MIU基准数据集及其他主观任务(如图像情感识别)上的大量实验,IntCLIP在多个指标上均显著优于当前最先进的技术。代码已开源至https://github.com/yan9qu/IntCLIP。
abstract_en: Multi-label Intention Understanding (MIU) for images is a critical yet challenging domain, primarily due to the ambiguity of intentions leading to a resource-intensive annotation process. Current leading approaches are held back by the limited amount of labeled data. To mitigate the scarcity of annotated data, we leverage the Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) model, renowned for its wealth knowledge in textual and visual modalities. We introduce a novel framework, Intention Understanding with CLIP (IntCLIP), which utilizes a dual-branch approach. This framework exploits the ‘Sight’-oriented knowledge inherent in CLIP to augment ‘Semantic’-centric MIU tasks. Additionally, we propose Hierarchical Class Integration to effectively manage the complex layered label structure, aligning it with CLIP’s nuanced sentence feature extraction capabilities. Our Sight-assisted Aggregation further refines this model by infusing the semantic feature map with essential visual cues, thereby enhancing the intention understanding ability. Through extensive experiments conducted on the standard MIU benchmark and other subjective tasks such as Image Emotion Recognition, IntCLIP clearly demonstrates superiority over current state-of-the-art techniques. Code is available at https://github.com/yan9qu/ IntCLIP.

title: Qu Yunpeng*, Kun Yuan, Kai Zhao, Qizhi Xie, Jinhua Hao, Ming Sun, Chao Zhou
title_en: Qu Yunpeng*, Kun Yuan, Kai Zhao, Qizhi Xie, Jinhua Hao, Ming Sun, Chao Zhou
abstract: 基于扩散的方法凭借强大的生成先验,近年来在图像超分辨率(ISR)领域受到越来越多的关注。然而,由于低分辨率(LR)图像常经历严重退化,ISR模型难以准确感知语义信息和退化特征,导致恢复图像出现内容错误或不真实的伪影。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种跨模态先验的超分辨率框架(XPSR)。在XPSR中,为获取精确且全面的语义条件,采用先进的多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)。为促进跨模态先验的更好融合,设计了语义融合注意力机制。为提取语义保留信息而非不期望的退化特征,在LR图像与其高分辨率(HR)对应图像间引入退化约束。定量和定性结果表明,XPSR能够在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上生成高保真度和高真实感的图像。代码已开源至 https: //github.com/qyp2000/XPSR。
abstract_en: Diffusion-based methods, endowed with a formidable generative prior, have received increasing attention in Image Super-Resolution (ISR) recently. However, as low-resolution (LR) images often undergo severe degradation, it is challenging for ISR models to perceive the semantic and degradation information, resulting in restoration images with incorrect content or unrealistic artifacts. To address these issues, we propose a Cross-modal Priors for Super-Resolution (XPSR) framework. Within XPSR, to acquire precise and comprehensive semantic conditions for the diffusion model, cutting-edge Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are utilized. To facilitate better fusion of cross-modal priors, a Semantic-Fusion Attention is raised. To distill semantic-preserved information instead of undesired degradations, a Degradation-Free Constraint is attached between LR and its high-resolution (HR) counterpart. Quantitative and qualitative results show that XPSR is capable of generating high-fidelity and high-realism images across synthetic and real-world datasets. Codes are released at https: //github.com/qyp2000/XPSR.

title: Quan Dao*, Binh Ta, Tung Pham, Anh Tran
title_en: Quan Dao*, Binh Ta, Tung Pham, Anh Tran
abstract: 开发对训练过程中异常值具有鲁棒性的图像生成模型近年来引起了研究社区的关注。由于将不平衡最优传输(UOT)易于集成到对抗框架中,现有工作主要集中在构建生成对抗模型(GAN)的鲁棒框架。同时,扩散模型在各类任务和数据集上最近主导了GAN。然而,据我们所知,目前尚无相关方法能够处理被污染的数据集。受DDGAN启发,我们的工作引入了首个对异常值鲁棒的扩散模型。我们建议将DDGAN中基于UOT的生成模型替换为学习反向扩散过程。此外,我们证明了框架中发散的Lipschitz性质有助于更稳定的训练收敛。值得注意的是,我们的方法不仅对被污染数据集具有鲁棒性,还在干净数据集上实现了优越的性能。
abstract_en: Developing image-generative models, which are robust to outliers in the training process, has recently drawn attention from the research community. Due to the ease of integrating unbalanced optimal transport (UOT) into adversarial framework, existing works focus mainly on developing robust frameworks for generative adversarial model (GAN). Meanwhile, diffusion models have recently dominated GAN in various tasks and datasets. However, according to our knowledge, none of them are robust to corrupted datasets. Motivated by DDGAN, our work introduces the first robust-to-outlier diffusion. We suggest replacing the UOT-based generative model for GAN in DDGAN to learn the backward diffusion process. Additionally, we demonstrate that the Lipschitz property of divergence in our framework contributes to more stable training convergence. Remarkably, our method not only exhibits robustness to corrupted datasets but also achieves superior performance on clean datasets.

title: Quan Kong*, Yuki Kawana, Rajat Saini, Ashutosh Kumar, Jingjing Pan, Ta Gu, Yohei Ozao, Balazs Opra, Yoichi Sato, Norimasa Kobori
title_en: Quan Kong*, Yuki Kawana, Rajat Saini, Ashutosh Kumar, Jingjing Pan, Ta Gu, Yohei Ozao, Balazs Opra, Yoichi Sato, Norimasa Kobori
abstract: 本文针对交通场景中细粒度视频事件理解的挑战展开研究,这对于自动驾驶和交通安全至关重要。传统数据集多关注驾驶员或车辆行为,常忽视行人视角。为填补这一空白,我们引入了WTS数据集,突出展示了超过1200个视频事件中车辆和行人的详细行为,涵盖数百个交通场景。WTS在车辆-基础设施协同环境中整合了车辆自拍视角和固定顶视摄像头的多样化视角,通过全面的文本描述和独特的3D注视数据,实现同步的2D/3D视图,聚焦行人分析。我们还为5000个公开来源的与行人相关的交通视频提供了标注。此外,我们引入了LLMScorer,这是一种基于大语言模型的评估指标,用于对齐推理描述与真实标签。借助WTS,我们建立了密集视频到文本任务的基准,探索了最先进的视觉-语言模型,并以实例感知的VideoLLM方法作为基线。WTS旨在推动细粒度视频事件理解的发展,提升交通安全和自动驾驶技术的进步。数据集页面:https://woven-visionai.github.io/wts-dataset-homepage/
abstract_en: In this paper, we address the challenge of fine-grained video event understanding in traffic scenarios, vital for autonomous driving and safety. Traditional datasets focus on driver or vehicle behavior, often neglecting pedestrian perspectives. To fill this gap, we introduce the WTS dataset, highlighting detailed behaviors of both vehicles and pedestrians across over 1.2k video events in over hundreds traffic scenarios. WTS integrates diverse perspectives from vehicle ego and fixed overhead cameras in a vehicle-infrastructure cooperative environment, enriched with comprehensive textual descriptions and unique 3D Gaze data for a synchronized 2D/3D view, focusing on pedestrian analysis. We also provide annotations for 5k publicly sourced pedestrian-related traffic videos. Additionally, we introduce LLMScorer, an LLM-based evaluation metric to align inference captions with ground truth. Using WTS, we establish a benchmark for dense video-to-text tasks, exploring state-of-the-art Vision-Language Models with an instance-aware VideoLLM method as a baseline. WTS aims to advance fine-grained video event understanding, enhancing traffic safety and autonomous driving development. Dataset page: https://woven-visionai.github.io/ wts-dataset-homepage/.

title: Qunjie Zhou*, Maxim Maximov, Or Litany, Laura Leal-Taixé
title_en: Qunjie Zhou*, Maxim Maximov, Or Litany, Laura Leal-Taixé
abstract: 本文提出将神经辐射场(Neural Radiance Fields, NeRF)作为视觉定位的场景表示方法。近年来,NeRF通过扩充训练数据库、利用渲染图像提供辅助监督或作为迭代优化模块,已被用于增强姿态回归和场景坐标回归模型。我们进一步拓展了NeRF的已知优势——其能够提供具有真实外观和精确几何结构的紧凑场景表示——通过探索NeRF内部特征在建立精确2D-3D匹配以实现定位的潜力。为此,我们对NeRF通过视图合成获得的隐式知识进行了全面分析,以适应不同条件下的匹配任务。这包括探索不同的匹配网络架构、在多个编码层提取特征以及调整训练配置。值得注意的是,我们引入了__ABS_MATH_1__,这是一种先进的2D-3D匹配函数,充分利用了通过视图合成学习到的内部知识。在基于结构的定位基准测试中,我们对__ABS_MATH_1__的评估取得了与Cambridge Landmarks定位性能相竞争的结果。我们将发布所有模型和代码。
abstract_en: In this work, we propose the use of Neural Radiance Fields () as a scene representation for visual localization.
