title: Shuting He, Henghui Ding, Xudong Jiang, Bihan Wen*
title_en: Shuting He, Henghui Ding, Xudong Jiang, Bihan Wen*
abstract: 尽管在三维点云分割领域取得了显著进展,现有方法主要针对特定任务,并依赖显式指令来识别目标,缺乏在统一框架下推断和理解隐含用户意图的能力。在本工作中,我们提出了一种名为__TITLE_MATH_i__的模型,该模型利用多模态大语言模型(LLM)的推理能力,在多种任务中生成点级分割掩码:1)三维指令分割,2)三维指称分割,3)三维语义分割,4)三维开放词汇语义分割。为推进三维指令研究,我们引入了一个新的基准数据集__ABS_MATH_i__,用于评估从复杂且隐含的指令文本中分割性能,该数据集包含点云-指令对。实验结果表明,__TITLE_MATH_i__在ScanRefer指称分割和ScanNet语义分割等现有基准测试中表现出竞争力,同时在__ABS_MATH_i__数据集上取得了优异结果。据我们所知,__TITLE_MATH_i__是首个在单一框架内处理这些多样化分割任务的模型,实现了令人满意的性能。
abstract_en: Despite significant progress in 3D point cloud segmentation, existing methods primarily address specific tasks and depend on explicit instructions to identify targets, lacking the capability to infer and understand implicit user intentions in a unified framework. In this work, we propose a model, called , that leverages the reasoning capabilities of a multi-modal Large Language Model (LLM) to produce point-wise segmentation masks across a diverse range of tasks: 1) 3D instruction segmentation, 2) 3D referring segmentation, 3) 3D semantic segmentation, and 4) 3D open-vocabulary semantic segmentation. To advance 3D instruction research, we introduce a new benchmark, , designed to evaluate segmentation performance from complex and implicit instructional texts, featuring point cloud-instruction pairs. Our experimental results demonstrate that achieves competitive performance on established benchmarks such as ScanRefer for referring segmentation and ScanNet for semantic segmentation, while delivering outstanding outcomes on the dataset. To our knowledge, is the first model to address these varied segmentation tasks within a single framework, achieving satisfactory performance.

title: Shuxiang Xie*, Shuyi Zhou, Ken Sakurada, Ryoichi Ishikawa, Masaki Onishi, Takeshi Oishi
title_en: Shuxiang Xie*, Shuyi Zhou, Ken Sakurada, Ryoichi Ishikawa, Masaki Onishi, Takeshi Oishi
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRF)方法引起了广泛关注,特别是基于网格特征编码(GFE)的方法如Instant-NGP和TensoRF的出现。传统NeRF采用位置编码(PE)并通过多层感知机(MLP)表示场景。频率正则化已被确认为一种有效的策略,用于克服基于PE的NeRF的主要挑战,包括对已知相机姿态的依赖以及需要大量图像数据集的要求。尽管已有研究尝试将频率正则化扩展到GFE方法,但这些方法仍缺乏基本的理论基础。因此,我们首先阐明频率正则化的底层机制。随后,我们对基于GFE的NeRF的表达能力进行全面研究,并尝试将频率正则化与GFE方法联系起来。此外,我们提出了一种通用策略:通用网格频率正则化,以解决GFE方法中的相机姿态优化和少样本重建问题。我们通过在各种场景中使用不同表示方法进行大量实验,验证了所提方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) methodologies have garnered considerable interest, particularly with the introduction of grid-based feature encoding (GFE) approaches such as Instant-NGP and TensoRF. Conventional NeRF employs positional encoding (PE) and represents a scene with a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP). Frequency regularization has been identified as an effective strategy to overcome primary challenges in PE-based NeRFs, including dependency on known camera poses and the requirement for extensive image datasets. While several studies have endeavored to extend frequency regularization to GFE approaches, there is still a lack of basic theoretical foundations for these methods. Therefore, we first clarify the underlying mechanisms of frequency regularization. Subsequently, we conduct a comprehensive investigation into the expressive capability of GFE-based NeRFs and attempt to connect frequency regularization with GFE methods. Moreover, we propose a generalized strategy, : Generalized Grid-based Frequency Regularization, to address issues of camera pose optimization and few-shot reconstruction with GFE methods. We validate the efficacy of our methods through an extensive series of experiments employing various representations across diverse scenarios.

title: Shuyi Zhang, Ke Liu, Jingjun Gu, Xiaoxu Cai, Zhihua Wang, Jiajun Bu, Haishuai Wang*
title_en: Shuyi Zhang, Ke Liu, Jingjun Gu, Xiaoxu Cai, Zhihua Wang, Jiajun Bu, Haishuai Wang*
abstract: 隐式神经表示(INR)作为一种数据表示方法,正日益受到关注,是创新生成模型的前提条件。与基于梯度的方法相比,后者在推理过程中效率较低,采用超网络生成多层感知机(MLP)参数以执行INR函数,已成为一种有前景且高效的替代方案。然而,作为全局连续函数,MLP在建模高度不连续信号时面临挑战,导致训练阶段收敛缓慢且重建性能不准确。此外,MLP需要大量表示参数,这暗示了数据表示的低效性。本文提出了一种基于注意力机制的局部化INR(ANR),包含局部注意力层(LAL)和一个集成坐标特征与数据特征并将其转换为有意义输出的全局MLP。随后,我们设计了一个实例表示框架,通过类似Transformer的超网络将数据实例表示为紧凑的表示向量。结合实例特定的表示向量和实例无关的ANR参数,目标信号被重建为连续函数。我们进一步通过变分坐标解决获取超分辨率推理结果时的混叠伪影问题。在四个数据集上的广泛实验验证了ANR方法的显著有效性,例如在CelebA数据集上将PSNR值从37.95dB提升至47.25dB。代码已开源于https://github.com/Roninton/ANR。
abstract_en: Implicit Neural Representation (INR) has gained increasing popularity as a data representation method, serving as a prerequisite for innovative generation models. Unlike gradient-based methods, which exhibit lower efficiency in inference, the adoption of hyper-network for generating parameters in Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLP), responsible for executing INR functions, has surfaced as a promising and efficient alternative. However, as a global continuous function, MLP is challenging in modeling highly discontinuous signals, resulting in slow convergence during the training phase and inaccurate reconstruction performance. Moreover, MLP requires massive representation parameters, which implies inefficiencies in data representation. In this paper, we propose a novel Attention-based Localized INR (ANR) composed of a localized attention layer (LAL) and a global MLP that integrates coordinate features with data features and converts them to meaningful outputs. Subsequently, we design an instance representation framework that delivers a transformer-like hyper-network to represent data instances as a compact representation vector. With instance-specific representation vector and instance-agnostic ANR parameters, the target signals are well reconstructed as a continuous function. We further address aliasing artifacts with variational coordinates when obtaining the super-resolution inference results. Extensive experimentation across four datasets showcases the notable efficacy of our ANR method, e.g. enhancing the PSNR value from 37.95dB to 47.25dB on the CelebA dataset. Code is released at https://github.com/Roninton/ANR.

title: Shuzhao Xie*, Weixiang Zhang, Chen Tang, Yunpeng Bai, Rongwei Lu, Shjia Ge, Zhi Wang
title_en: Shuzhao Xie*, Weixiang Zhang, Chen Tang, Yunpeng Bai, Rongwei Lu, Shjia Ge, Zhi Wang
abstract: 三维高斯点云在新视角合成中展现出卓越的质量和速度。然而,三维高斯点云的庞大文件尺寸给传输和存储带来了挑战。现有工作设计紧凑模型以替代三维高斯点云的大量体积和属性,并通过密集训练来蒸馏信息。这些努力需要大量的训练时间,给实际部署带来了严峻的障碍。为此,我们提出MesonGS,一种用于三维高斯点云后训练压缩的编码器。首先,我们引入一种测量标准,综合考虑视角相关和视角无关因素,评估每个高斯点对渲染输出的影响,从而移除不显著的点。随后,我们通过两种互补的变换降低属性的熵,以增强文件压缩率。具体而言,我们首先将旋转四元数替换为欧拉角;然后,对关键属性应用区域自适应分层变换以减少熵。最后,我们采用更细粒度的量化以避免过度的信息损失。此外,设计了一种精心优化的微调方案以恢复质量。大量实验表明,MesonGS显著减小了三维高斯点云的尺寸,同时保持了具有竞争力的质量。
abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting demonstrates excellent quality and speed in novel view synthesis. Nevertheless, the huge file size of the 3D Gaussians presents challenges for transmission and storage. Current works design compact models to replace the substantial volume and attributes of 3D Gaussians, along with intensive training to distill information. These endeavors demand considerable training time, presenting formidable hurdles for practical deployment. To this end, we propose MesonGS, a codec for post-training compression of 3D Gaussians. Initially, we introduce a measurement criterion that considers both view-dependent and view-independent factors to assess the impact of each Gaussian point on the rendering output, enabling the removal of insignificant points. Subsequently, we decrease the entropy of attributes through two transformations that complement subsequent entropy coding techniques to enhance the file compression rate. More specifically, we first replace rotation quaternions with Euler angles; then, we apply region adaptive hierarchical transform to key attributes to reduce entropy. Lastly, we adopt finer-grained quantization to avoid excessive information loss. Moreover, a well-crafted finetune scheme is devised to restore quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MesonGS significantly reduces the size of 3D Gaussians while preserving competitive quality.

title: Shweta Singh, Aayan Yadav, Jitesh Jain, Humphrey Shi, Justin Johnson, Karan Desai*
title_en: Shweta Singh, Aayan Yadav, Jitesh Jain, Humphrey Shi, Justin Johnson, Karan Desai*
abstract: 常见上下文对象(COCO)数据集在过去十年中一直是目标检测器基准测试的重要工具。与所有数据集一样,COCO也包含一些源于标注过程的细微错误和不完美之处。随着高性能模型的出现,我们质疑这些COCO的错误是否阻碍了其在可靠基准测试进一步进展中的实用性。为寻找答案,我们检查了数千个COCO(2017版)的掩码,并发现了多种类型的错误,例如不精确的掩码边界、未完全标注的实例以及错误标注的掩码。由于COCO的广泛使用,我们选择纠正这些错误以保持与先前研究的连续性。我们开发了COCO-ReM(优化掩码),这是一组比COCO-2017视觉质量更优的注释集。我们评估了五十种目标检测器,发现能够预测更清晰掩码的模型在COCO-ReM上得分更高,证实它们因COCO-2017的错误而被错误惩罚。此外,使用COCO-ReM训练的模型收敛速度更快且得分更高,其大型变体使用COCO-2017训练,这突显了数据质量在提升目标检测器中的重要性。基于这些发现,我们倡导在未来的物体检测研究中使用COCO-ReM。我们的数据集可在https://cocorem.xyz获取。
abstract_en: The Common Objects in Context (COCO) dataset has been instrumental in benchmarking object detectors over the past decade. Like every dataset, COCO contains subtle errors and imperfections stemming from its annotation procedure. With the advent of high-performing models, we ask whether these errors of COCO are hindering its utility in reliably benchmarking further progress. In search for an answer, we inspect thousands of masks from COCO (2017 version) and uncover different types of errors such as imprecise mask boundaries, non-exhaustively annotated instances, and mislabeled masks. Due to the prevalence of COCO, we choose to correct these errors to maintain continuity with prior research. We develop COCO-ReM (Refined Masks), a cleaner set of annotations with visibly better mask quality than COCO-2017. We evaluate fifty object detectors and find that models that predict visually sharper masks score higher on COCO-ReM, affirming that they were being incorrectly penalized due to errors in COCO-2017. Moreover, our models trained using COCO-ReM converge faster and score higher than their larger variants trained using COCO-2017, highlighting the importance of data quality in improving object detectors. With these findings, we advocate using COCO-ReM for future object detection research. Our dataset is available at https://cocorem.xyz

title: Siao Tang, Xin Wang*, Hong Chen, Chaoyu Guan, Zewen Wu, Yansong Tang, Wenwu Zhu*
title_en: Siao Tang, Xin Wang*, Hong Chen, Chaoyu Guan, Zewen Wu, Yansong Tang, Wenwu Zhu*
abstract: 扩散模型的高计算开销是一个令人困扰的问题。近期研究通过后训练量化(PTQ)技术对扩散模型进行压缩。然而,大多数研究仅关注无条件模型,而对广泛使用的预训练文本到图像模型(如Stable Diffusion)的量化仍鲜有探索。本文提出了一种针对文本到图像扩散模型的新型后训练量化方法PCR(渐进式校准与放松),该方法包含考虑时间步间累积量化误差的渐进式校准策略,以及在几乎无成本下提升性能的激活放松策略。此外,我们发现文本到图像扩散模型量化前的评估指标因分布差异而不准确。为解决该问题,我们提出了一种新型基准测试QDiffBench,其利用相同领域的数据进行更精确的评估。同时,QDiffBench还考虑了量化模型在校准数据集外的泛化性能。在Stable Diffusion和Stable Diffusion XL上的大量实验验证了我们方法和基准测试的优越性。此外,我们首次实现了在保持性能的前提下对Stable Diffusion XL的量化。
abstract_en: High computational overhead is a troublesome problem for diffusion models. Recent studies have leveraged post-training quantization (PTQ) to compress diffusion models. However, most of them only focus on unconditional models, leaving the quantization of widely-used pretrained text-to-image models, e.g., Stable Diffusion, largely unexplored. In this paper, we propose a novel post-training quantization method PCR (Progressive Calibration and Relaxing) for text-to-image diffusion models, which consists of a progressive calibration strategy that considers the accumulated quantization error across timesteps, and an activation relaxing strategy that improves the performance with negligible cost. Additionally, we demonstrate the previous metrics for text-to-image diffusion model quantization are not accurate due to the distribution gap. To tackle the problem, we propose a novel QDiffBench benchmark, which utilizes data in the same domain for more accurate evaluation. Besides, QDiffBench also considers the generalization performance of the quantized model outside the calibration dataset. Extensive experiments on Stable Diffusion and Stable Diffusion XL demonstrate the superiority of our method and benchmark. Moreover, we are the first to achieve quantization for Stable Diffusion XL while maintaining the performance.

title: Sibi Catley-Chandar*, Richard Shaw, Gregory Slabaugh, Eduardo Pérez Pellitero
title_en: Sibi Catley-Chandar*, Richard Shaw, Gregory Slabaugh, Eduardo Pérez Pellitero
abstract: 近年来神经渲染技术的进展使得高度逼真的三维场景重建和新视角合成成为可能。尽管取得了这些进展,当前最先进的方法由于辐射场的低频偏差和不准确的相机标定等因素,仍难以重建高频细节。一种缓解该问题的方法是在渲染后增强图像。2D增强器可以预先训练以恢复部分细节,但对场景几何结构不敏感且难以泛化到新的图像退化分布。相反,现有的3D增强器能够以可泛化的方式从邻近训练图像中迁移细节,但受相机标定不准确的影响,并可能将几何误差传播到渲染图像中。我们提出了一种神经渲染增强器,结合了两种范式的优点。我们的方法在预训练阶段学习通用增强器,同时通过鲁棒的3D对齐和几何感知融合利用邻近训练图像的信息。我们的方法在恢复高频纹理的同时保持几何一致性,并且对不准确的相机标定具有鲁棒性。我们证明该方法显著提升了多种神经渲染基线模型的渲染质量,例如在真实世界360v2数据集上,将MipNeRF360的PSNR提升0.63dB,将Nerfacto提升1.34dB。项目页面:https://sib1.github.io/projects/roguenerf/
abstract_en: Recent advances in neural rendering have enabled highly photorealistic 3D scene reconstruction and novel view synthesis. Despite this progress, current state-of-the-art methods struggle to reconstruct high frequency detail, due to factors such as a low-frequency bias of radiance fields and inaccurate camera calibration. One approach to mitigate this issue is to enhance images post-rendering. 2D enhancers can be pre-trained to recover some detail but are agnostic to scene geometry and do not easily generalize to new distributions of image degradation. Conversely, existing 3D enhancers are able to transfer detail from nearby training images in a generalizable manner, but suffer from inaccurate camera calibration and can propagate errors from the geometry into rendered images. We propose a neural rendering enhancer, , which exploits the best of both paradigms. Our method is pre-trained to learn a general enhancer while also leveraging information from nearby training images via robust 3D alignment and geometry-aware fusion. Our approach restores high-frequency textures while maintaining geometric consistency and is also robust to inaccurate camera calibration. We show that substantially enhances the rendering quality of a wide range of neural rendering baselines, e.g. improving the PSNR of MipNeRF360 by 0.63dB and Nerfacto by 1.34dB on the real world 360v2 dataset. Project page: https://sib1.github.io/projects/roguenerf/

title: Sidhartha Chitturi*, Venu Madhav Govindu
title_en: Sidhartha Chitturi*, Venu Madhav Govindu
abstract: 梯度非凸性(GNC)是一种稳健的估计方法,其中目标函数从平滑的凸形式逐步退火到表示所需目标函数的形式。这种退火是通过在每个阶段求解目标函数时修改目标函数中的一个尺度参数来实现的。固定的退火方案通常会导致效率与精度之间的较差权衡,而自适应退火在大规模问题上缺乏可扩展性。一个重要的大规模估计问题是平均问题,这在三维重建的背景下出现,其中使用视图图边上的成对观测来估计图顶点处的相应值。在本文中,我们提出了一种针对向量空间中平均问题的新颖自适应GNC框架,特别是向量和位移平均。我们的方法利用了图拉普拉斯矩阵的见解,并赋予了可扩展性。我们展示了自适应方法在保持效率的同时相比基线具有优越性能。
abstract_en: Graduated Non-Convexity (GNC) is a robust estimation method in which an objective function is progressively annealed starting from a smooth convex form to one that represents the desired objective function. Such annealing is achieved by modifying a scale parameter in the objective function that is solved at each stage. A fixed annealing scheme often leads to a poor efficiency vs accuracy tradeoff, whereas adaptive annealing lacks scalability for large scale problems. An important large scale estimation problem is that of averaging that arises in the context of 3D reconstruction, wherein pairwise observations on edges of a viewgraph are used to estimate the corresponding values at the graph vertices. In this paper we present a novel adaptive GNC framework tailored for averaging problems in vector spaces, specifically vector and translation averaging. Our approach leverages insights from graph Laplacians and imparts scalability. We demonstrate the superior performance of our adaptive approach while maintaining efficiency in comparison to baselines.

title: 杨思迪,黄彬晓,曹明登,纪亚泰,郭汉中,黄乃毅,杨宇久*
title_en: Sidi Yang, Binxiao Huang, Mingdeng Cao, Yatai Ji, Hanzhong Guo, Ngai Wong, Yujiu Yang*
abstract: 随着高清屏幕在边缘设备(如终端用户相机、智能手机和电视)中的广泛应用,图像增强的需求显著增加。现有的增强模型通常优化高性能,但在减少硬件推理时间和功耗方面表现不足,尤其是在计算和存储资源受限的边缘设备上。为此,我们提出了图像色彩增强查找表(ICELUT),该方法采用查找表(LUT)实现极高的边缘推理效率,无需任何卷积神经网络(CNN)。在训练过程中,我们利用点卷积(1×1)提取色彩信息,并结合分割全连接层以整合全局信息。这两个组件随后无缝转换为查找表,实现与硬件无关的部署。ICELUT实现了接近最先进的性能和显著降低的功耗。我们观察到,点卷积网络结构表现出强大的可扩展性,即使在严重下采样的32×32输入图像上也能保持性能。这些特性使ICELUT成为首个完全基于查找表的图像增强器,其在GPU上达到0.4ms的速度,在CPU上达到7ms的速度,至少比任何CNN方案快一个数量级。代码可在https://github.com/Stephen0808/ICELUT获取。
abstract_en: The widespread use of high-definition screens in edge devices, such as end-user cameras, smartphones, and televisions, is spurring a significant demand for image enhancement. Existing enhancement models often optimize for high performance while falling short of reducing hardware inference time and power consumption, especially on edge devices with constrained computing and storage resources. To this end, we propose Image Color Enhancement LookUp Table (ICELUT) that adopts LUTs for extremely efficient edge inference, without any convolutional neural network (CNN). During training, we leverage pointwise (1×1) convolution to extract color information, alongside a split fully connected layer to incorporate global information. Both components are then seamlessly converted into LUTs for hardware-agnostic deployment. ICELUT achieves near-state-of-the-art performance and remarkably low power consumption. We observe that the pointwise network structure exhibits robust scalability, upkeeping the performance even with a heavily downsampled 32 × 32 input image. These enable ICELUT, the first-ever purely LUT-based image enhancer, to reach an unprecedented speed of 0.4ms on GPU and 7ms on CPU, at least one order faster than any CNN solution. Codes are available at https://github.com/Stephen0808/ICELUT.

title: Sifan Wu*, Amir Hosein Khasahmadi, Mor Katz, Pradeep Kumar Jayaraman, Yewen Pu, Karl D.D. Willis, Bang Liu*
title_en: Sifan Wu*, Amir Hosein Khasahmadi, Mor Katz, Pradeep Kumar Jayaraman, Yewen Pu, Karl D.D. Willis, Bang Liu*
abstract: 参数化计算机辅助设计(CAD)是当代机械设计的核心。然而,其在实现精确参数化草图建模方面面临挑战,并且缺乏适用于机械设计的实用评估指标。我们利用预训练基础模型的能力,这些模型在自然语言处理和计算机视觉领域取得了显著成功,开发专门用于CAD的生成模型。这些模型擅长理解复杂几何形状和设计推理,是CAD技术的重要进展。在本文中,我们提出了CadVLM,一种用于CAD生成的端到端视觉语言模型。我们的方法涉及将预训练基础模型适应于有效操控工程草图,整合草图基本元素序列和草图图像。大量实验表明,在多个CAD草图生成任务(如CAD自动补全、CAD自动约束和图像条件生成)中表现出色。据我们所知,这是首个成功应用于参数化CAD生成的多模态大语言模型(LLM),标志着计算机辅助机械设计领域的开创性进展。
abstract_en: Parametric Computer-Aided Design (CAD) is central to contemporary mechanical design. However, it encounters challenges in achieving precise parametric sketch modeling and lacks practical evaluation metrics suitable for mechanical design. We harness the capabilities of pre-trained foundation models, renowned for their successes in natural language processing and computer vision, to develop generative models specifically for CAD. These models are adept at understanding complex geometries and design reasoning, a crucial advancement in CAD technology. In this paper, we propose CadVLM, an end-to-end vision language model for CAD generation. Our approach involves adapting pre-trained foundation models to manipulate engineering sketches effectively, integrating both sketch primitive sequences and sketch images. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior performance on multiple CAD sketch generation tasks such as CAD autocompletion, CAD autoconstraint, and image conditional generation. To our knowledge, this is the first instance of a multimodal Large Language Model (LLM) being successfully applied to parametric CAD generation, representing a pioneering step in the field of computer-aided mechanical design.

title: Silvia Zuffi*, Michael J. Black
title_en: Silvia Zuffi*, Michael J. Black
abstract: 许多经典的参数化三维形状模型存在,但使用这些模型创建新颖的形状需要对其参数的专家知识。例如,想象使用程序化图形创建特定类型的树木,或从统计形状模型中创建新的动物类型。我们的核心思想是利用语言来控制这些现有模型以生成新颖的形状。这涉及学习视觉-语言模型的潜在空间与三维模型参数空间之间的映射,我们通过一组形状和文本对来实现这一点。我们的假设是,从语言到参数的映射使我们能够生成在训练期间从未见过的对象的参数。如果语言与参数之间的映射足够平滑,那么语言中的插值或泛化应该能够适当转化为新颖的三维形状。我们通过两种非常不同的参数化形状模型(四足动物和树栖树木)来测试我们的方法。我们使用四足动物的统计形状模型,并展示如何通过文本生成训练期间未出现的新动物。特别是,我们展示了最先进的三维狗形状估计。这项工作也构成了生成三维树木的第一种语言驱动方法。最后,将图像嵌入到CLIP潜在空间中,使我们能够直接从图像生成动物和树木。
abstract_en: Many classical parametric 3D shape models exist, but creating novel shapes with such models requires expert knowledge of their parameters. For example, imagine creating a specific type of tree using procedural graphics or a new kind of animal from a statistical shape model. Our key idea is to leverage language to control such existing models to produce novel shapes. This involves learning a mapping between the latent space of a vision-language model and the parameter space of the 3D model, which we do using a small set of shape and text pairs. Our hypothesis is that mapping from language to parameters allows us to generate parameters for objects that were never seen during training. If the mapping between language and parameters is sufficiently smooth, then interpolation or generalization in language should translate appropriately into novel 3D shapes. We test our approach with two very different types of parametric shape models (quadrupeds and arboreal trees). We use a learned statistical shape model of quadrupeds and show that we can use text to generate new animals not present during training. In particular, we demonstrate state-of-the-art shape estimation of 3D dogs. This work also constitutes the first language-driven method for generating 3D trees. Finally, embedding images in the CLIP latent space enables us to generate animals and trees directly from images.

title: Silvio Galesso*, Philipp Schröppel*, Hssan Driss, Thomas Brox
title_en: Silvio Galesso*, Philipp Schröppel*, Hssan Driss, Thomas Brox
abstract: 近年来,针对语义分割的分布外检测(OoD)研究主要集中在道路场景——一个语义多样性受限的领域。在本工作中,我们挑战这一限制,将该任务的领域扩展到一般的自然图像。为此,我们引入了两项内容:1. 一个基准数据集,基于ADE20k数据集,包含语义多样性高的多领域图像;2. 一种新颖的方法,利用扩散得分匹配进行OoD检测(DOoD),并能有效应对语义多样性增加的挑战。该数据集包含室内和室外图像,定义了150个语义类别作为分布内数据,并包含多种分布外对象。对于DOoD,我们在语义分布内嵌入上训练具有MLP架构的扩散模型,并基于得分匹配解释在推理时计算像素级的OoD得分。在常见的道路场景OoD基准测试中,DOoD的性能与最先进方法相当或更优,无需使用异常值进行训练,也不需要对数据领域做出假设。在__ABS_MATH_1__,DOoD优于先前方法,但仍为未来改进留下很大空间。网页: https://ade-ood.github.io DOoD代码: https://github.com/lmb-freiburg/diffusion-for-ood
abstract_en: In recent years, research on out-of-distribution (OoD) detection for semantic segmentation has mainly focused on road scenes – a domain with a constrained amount of semantic diversity. In this work, we challenge this constraint and extend the domain of this task to general natural images. To this end, we introduce 1. the benchmark, which is based on the ADE20k dataset and includes images from diverse domains with a high semantic diversity, and 2. a novel approach that uses Diffusion score matching for OoD detection (DOoD) and is robust to the increased semantic diversity. features indoor and outdoor images, defines 150 semantic categories as in-distribution, and contains a variety of OoD objects. For DOoD, we train a diffusion model with an MLP architecture on semantic in-distribution embeddings and build on the score matching interpretation to compute pixel-wise OoD scores at inference time. On common road scene OoD benchmarks, DOoD performs on par or better than the state of the art, without using outliers for training or making assumptions about the data domain. On , DOoD outperforms previous approaches, but leaves much room for future improvements. webpage: https://ade-ood. github.io DOoD code: https://github.com/lmb-freiburg/diffusion-for-ood

title: Siming Yan*, Min Bai, Weifeng Chen, Xiong Zhou, Qixing Huang, Li Erran Li
title_en: Siming Yan*, Min Bai, Weifeng Chen, Xiong Zhou, Qixing Huang, Li Erran Li
abstract: 通过将大型语言模型在自然语言理解、生成能力和广泛知识的基础上结合图像感知,近期的大视觉语言模型(LVLMs)展现了前所未有的视觉推理能力。然而,生成的文本常常在视觉输入中存在不准确的定位问题,导致诸如虚构不存在的场景元素、遗漏重要场景部分以及错误推断物体属性和关系等错误。为了解决这些问题,我们引入了一种新颖的框架ViGoR(通过细粒度奖励建模实现视觉定位),利用细粒度奖励建模显著提升LVLMs相对于预训练基线的视觉定位能力。这种改进通过更便宜的人类评估而非全监督方式,以及自动化方法高效实现。我们通过多种评估方法和基准测试验证了该方法的有效性。此外,我们发布了包含15,440张图像和生成文本对的人类注释数据集(https://github.com/amazon-science/vigor),并附有细粒度评估,以促进社区相关研究。
abstract_en: By combining natural language understanding, generation capabilities, and breadth of knowledge of large language models with image perception, recent large vision language models (LVLMs) have shown unprecedented visual reasoning capabilities. However, the generated text often suffers from inaccurate grounding in the visual input, resulting in errors such as hallucination of nonexistent scene elements, missing significant parts of the scene, and inferring incorrect attributes of and relationships between objects. To address these issues, we introduce a novel framework, ViGoR (Visual Grounding Through Fine-Grained Reward Modeling) that utilizes fine-grained reward modeling to significantly enhance the visual grounding of LVLMs over pre-trained baselines. This improvement is efficiently achieved using much cheaper human evaluations instead of full supervisions, as well as automated methods. We show the effectiveness of our approach through a variety of evaluation methods and benchmarks. Additionally, we released our human annotation (https://github.com/amazon-science/vigor) comprising 15,440 images and generated text pairs with fine-grained evaluations to contribute to related research in the community.

title: Simon Weber*, Je Hyeong Hong, Daniel Cremers
title_en: Simon Weber*, Je Hyeong Hong, Daniel Cremers
abstract: 大多数捆绑调整(BA)求解器,如Levenberg-Marquardt算法,都需要良好的初始化。相反,无需初始化的BA仍是一个未被充分探索的领域。收敛域较广的未被充分研究的变量投影算法(VarPro)即使在没有初始化的情况下也能表现出良好的收敛性。结合目标空间误差公式,近期研究已展示了其解决小规模无需初始化的捆绑调整问题的能力。为了使此类无需初始化的BA方法具备可扩展性,我们引入了幂变量投影(PoVar),该方法基于幂级数扩展的最新逆展开方法。重要的是,我们将幂级数展开与黎曼流形优化联系起来。这种投影框架对于解决无需初始化的大规模捆绑调整问题至关重要。使用现实世界的BAL数据集,我们实验验证了我们的求解器在速度和精度方面均达到最先进水平。据我们所知,这是首个针对无需初始化的BA可扩展性进行研究的工作,为无需初始化的运动恢复结构(structure-from-motion)开辟了新途径。
abstract_en: Most Bundle Adjustment (BA) solvers like the Levenberg-Marquard algorithm require a good initialization. Instead, initialization-free BA remains a largely uncharted territory. The under-explored Variable Projection algorithm (VarPro) exhibits a wide convergence basin even without initialization. Coupled with object space error formulation, recent works have shown its ability to solve small-scale initialization-free bundle adjustment problem. To make such initialization-free BA approaches scalable, we introduce Power Variable Projection (PoVar), extending a recent inverse expansion method based on power series. Importantly, we link the power series expansion to Riemannian manifold optimization. This projective framework is crucial to solve large-scale bundle adjustment problems without initialization. Using the real-world BAL dataset, we experimentally demonstrate that our solver achieves state-of-the-art results in terms of speed and accuracy. To our knowledge, this work is the first to address the scalability of BA without initialization opening new venues for initialization-free structure-from-motion.

title: Sipeng Zheng*, Bohan Zhou, Yicheng Feng, Ye Wang, Zongqing Lu*
title_en: Sipeng Zheng*, Bohan Zhou, Yicheng Feng, Ye Wang, Zongqing Lu*
abstract: 本文提出了一种名为UniCode的新方法,该方法属于多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)领域,通过学习统一的码本以高效地对视觉、文本以及潜在的其他类型信号进行标记化。这一创新解决了现有MLLMs的一个关键限制:它们对仅文本码本的依赖,这限制了MLLMs在多模态情境下生成图像和文本的能力。为此,我们提出了一种语言驱动的迭代训练范式,并结合我们称为“图像解压缩”的上下文预训练任务,使模型能够解读压缩的视觉数据并生成高质量图像。统一的码本使我们的模型能够将视觉指令调优扩展到非语言生成任务。此外,UniCode可适配于多样化的堆叠量化方法,以将视觉信号压缩为更紧凑的标记表示。尽管在训练过程中使用了显著更少的参数和数据,UniCode在视觉重建与生成方面展现出有前景的能力,并在一系列视觉问答(VQA)基准测试中取得了与领先MLLMs相当的性能。
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose UniCode, a novel approach within the domain of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that learns a unified codebook to efficiently tokenize visual, text, and potentially other types of signals. This innovation addresses a critical limitation in existing MLLMs: their reliance on a text-only codebook, which restricts MLLMs’ ability to generate images and texts in a multimodal context. Towards this end, we propose a language-driven iterative training paradigm, coupled with an in-context pre-training task we term “image decompression”, enabling our model to interpret compressed visual data and generate high-quality images. The unified codebook empowers our model to extend visual instruction tuning to non-linguistic generation tasks. Moreover, UniCode is adaptable to diverse stacked quantization approaches in order to compress visual signals into a more compact token representation. Despite using significantly fewer parameters and less data during training, UniCode demonstrates promising capabilities in visual reconstruction and generation. It also achieves performance comparable to leading MLLMs across a spectrum of VQA benchmarks.

title: 人脸防欺骗(FAS)在保障人脸识别系统安全方面发挥着重要作用,近年来受到越来越多的关注。最近,视觉-语言模型CLIP已被证明在FAS中具有有效性,通过将类别标签转换为文本提示即可实现出色性能。在本工作中,我们从提示学习的角度出发,旨在提升基于CLIP的FAS的泛化能力。具体而言,提出了一种自底向上的领域提示调优方法(BUDoPT),该方法覆盖了包括录制设置领域和攻击类型领域在内的不同层次的领域差异。为处理录制设置领域的差异性,设计了一种上下文感知的对抗性领域泛化提示学习策略,能够学习领域不变的提示。对于包含不同攻击类型的欺骗领域,构建了细粒度的文本提示,引导CLIP关注不同攻击工具的细微细节。在包含多种相机类型、分辨率、图像质量、光照条件和录制环境的五个FAS数据集上进行了大量实验。从多个角度评估了所提方法的有效性,与使用多个或有限数量训练数据集的现有方法相比,显著提升了泛化能力。
title_en: Siqi Liu*, Qirui Wang, Pong C. Yuen
abstract_en: Face anti-spoofing (FAS) which plays an important role in securing face recognition systems has been attracting increasing attention. Recently, vision-language model CLIP has been proven to be effective for FAS, where outstanding performance can be achieved by simply transferring the class label into textual prompt. In this work, we aim to improve the generalization ability of CLIP-based FAS from a prompt learning perspective. Specifically, a Bottom-Up Domain Prompt Tuning method (BUDoPT) that covers the different levels of domain variance, including the domain of recording settings and domain of attack types is proposed. To handle domain discrepancies of recording settings, we design a context-aware adversarial domain-generalized prompt learning strategy that can learn domain-invariant prompt. For spoofing domain with different attack types, we construct a fine-grained textual prompt that guides CLIP to look through the subtle details of different attack instruments. Extensive experiments are conducted on five FAS datasets with variations of camera types, resolutions, image qualities, lighting conditions, and recording environments. The effectiveness of our proposed method is evaluated with different amounts of source domains from multiple angles, where we boost the generalizability compared with the state of the arts with multiple or limited numbers of training datasets.

title: Siqi Wan, Yehao Li, Jingwen Chen, Yingwei Pan*, Ting Yao, Yang Cao, Tao Mei
title_en: Siqi Wan, Yehao Li, Jingwen Chen, Yingwei Pan*, Ting Yao, Yang Cao, Tao Mei
abstract: 扩散模型在众多图像合成任务中引领了生成建模的革命。然而,直接应用扩散模型来合成目标人物穿着给定店内服装的图像(即基于图像的虚拟试穿(VTON)任务)并不容易。困难的根源在于扩散过程不仅要生成目标人物整体高保真度的逼真图像,还要局部保留给定服装的每处外观和纹理细节。为了解决这个问题,我们设计了一种新的扩散模型,称为GarDiff,该模型通过增强的基本视觉外观和从给定服装中提取的详细纹理(即高频细节)的引导,触发服装聚焦的扩散过程。GarDiff首先利用参考服装的CLIP和VAE编码推导出的额外外观先验重塑预训练的潜在扩散模型。同时,一种新的服装聚焦适配器被集成到扩散模型的UNet中,以追求与参考服装和人体姿态的视觉外观的局部细粒度对齐。我们特别设计了一个合成服装的外观损失,以增强关键的高频细节。在VITON-HD和DressCode数据集上的大量实验表明,与最先进的VTON方法相比,我们的GarDiff具有优越性。代码已公开在:https://github.com/siqi0905/GarDiff/tree/master。
abstract_en: Diffusion models have led to the revolutionizing of generative modeling in numerous image synthesis tasks. Nevertheless, it is not trivial to directly apply diffusion models for synthesizing an image of a target person wearing a given in-shop garment, i.e., image-based virtual try-on (VTON) task. The difficulty originates from the aspect that the diffusion process should not only produce holistically high-fidelity photorealistic image of the target person, but also locally preserve every appearance and texture detail of the given garment. To address this, we shape a new Diffusion model, namely GarDiff, which triggers the garment-focused diffusion process with amplified guidance of both basic visual appearance and detailed textures (i.e., high-frequency details) derived from the given garment. GarDiff first remoulds a pre-trained latent diffusion model with additional appearance priors derived from the CLIP and VAE encodings of the reference garment. Meanwhile, a novel garment-focused adapter is integrated into the UNet of diffusion model, pursuing local fine-grained alignment with the visual appearance of reference garment and human pose. We specifically design an appearance loss over the synthesized garment to enhance the crucial, high-frequency details. Extensive experiments on VITON-HD and DressCode datasets demonstrate the superiority of our GarDiff when compared to state-of-the-art VTON approaches. Code is publicly available at: https://github.com/siqi0905/GarDiff/tree/master.

title: Siqi Wang*, Bryan Plummer
title_en: Siqi Wang*, Bryan Plummer
abstract: 带有噪声标签的学习(LNL)旨在使用带有噪声的数据集训练高性能模型。我们观察到,对于某一类别的噪声往往来源于有限的几个类别,但许多LNL方法忽略了这一点。例如,一张被错误标记为猎豹的图像更可能是豹子而非河马,因为其视觉相似性。因此,我们探索了结合噪声源知识的带有噪声标签的学习(LNL+K),该方法利用数据集中元数据中通常提供的关于标签噪声可能来源的知识。整合噪声源知识即使在LNL方法通常失效的场景下也能提升性能。例如,LNL+K方法在噪声样本占多数的数据集上有效,这突破了大多数LNL方法的关键前提。我们的LNL+K方法即使在噪声源未从元数据中提取而是估计的情况下也能提升性能。我们提供了几种基线LNL+K方法,将噪声源知识整合到最先进的LNL模型中,并在六个多样化数据集和两种噪声类型上进行评估,结果显示与未适配方法相比性能提升最高可达23%。关键的是,我们证明了即使整合了噪声源知识,LNL方法在某些真实数据集上仍无法泛化,突显了直接探索LNL+K的重要性。1 代码可用:https://github.com/SunnySiqi/LNL_K
abstract_en: Learning with noisy labels (LNL) aims to train a high-performing model using a noisy dataset. We observe that noise for a given class often comes from a limited set of categories, yet many LNL methods overlook this. For example, an image mislabeled as a cheetah is more likely a leopard than a hippopotamus due to its visual similarity. Thus, we explore Learning with Noisy Labels with noise source Knowledge integration (LNL+K), which leverages knowledge about likely source(s) of label noise that is often provided in a dataset’s meta-data. Integrating noise source knowledge boosts performance even in settings where LNL methods typically fail. For example, LNL+K methods are effective on datasets where noise represents the majority of samples, which breaks a critical premise of most methods developed for LNL. Our LNL+K methods can boost performance even when noise sources are estimated rather than extracted from meta-data. We provide several baseline LNL+K methods that integrate noise source knowledge into state-of-the-art LNL models that are evaluated across six diverse datasets and two types of noise, where we report gains of up to 23% compared to the unadapted methods. Critically, we show that LNL methods fail to generalize on some real-world datasets, even when adapted to integrate noise source knowledge, highlighting the importance of directly exploring LNL+K1 . 1 Code available: https://github.com/SunnySiqi/LNL_K

title: Siqi Yang*, Zhaojun Huang, Yakun Chang, Bin Fan, Zhaofei Yu, Boxin Shi
title_en: Siqi Yang*, Zhaojun Huang, Yakun Chang, Bin Fan, Zhaofei Yu, Boxin Shi
abstract: 尖峰相机作为一种具有高速、高动态范围和低数据冗余特性的设备,可连续记录场景辐照度,被视为帧式高速相机的有前景替代方案。先前从单色尖峰重建彩色视频的方法受限于依赖低速RGB帧补偿颜色,导致难以获取完整的时序彩色信息。将拜耳图案彩色滤光阵列应用于尖峰传感器会产生马赛克色尖峰,这在高速条件下会复杂化噪声分布。通过验证短时帧噪声服从零均值分布,我们利用这一假设开发了一个仅基于真实数据训练的自监督去噪模块。尽管短时帧噪声被有效抑制,但仍需长期累积入射光子以构建高动态范围帧。因此,我们引入渐进式变形模块生成伪长时曝光帧。该方法有效缓解了高速条件下的运动模糊伪影。集成这些模块形成了一种基于真实数据驱动的马赛克色尖峰重建方法。在合成数据和真实数据上的大量实验表明,与现有方法相比,我们的方法在重建2000FPS彩色HDR视频时显著降低了噪声和运动模糊。
abstract_en: The spike camera continuously records scene radiance with high-speed, high dynamic range, and low data redundancy properties, as a promising replacement for frame-based high-speed cameras. Previous methods for reconstructing color videos from monochromatic spikes are constrained in capturing full-temporal color information due to their reliance on compensating colors from low-speed RGB frames. Applying a Bayer-pattern color filter array to the spike sensor yields mosaicked chromatic spikes, which complicates noise distribution in high-speed conditions. By validating that the noise of short-term frames follows a zero-mean distribution, we leverage this hypothesis to develop a self-supervised denoising module trained exclusively on real-world data. Although noise is reduced in short-term frames, the long-term accumulation of incident photons is still necessary to construct HDR frames. Therefore, we introduce a progressive warping module to generate pseudo long-term exposure frames. This approach effectively mitigates motion blur artifacts in high-speed conditions. Integrating these modules forms a real-data-driven reconstruction method for mosaicked chromatic spikes. Extensive experiments conducted on both synthetic and real-world data demonstrate that our approach is effective in reconstructing 2000FPS color HDR videos with significantly reduced noise and motion blur compared to existing methods.

title: Sirnam Swetha*, Jinyu Yang, Tal Neiman, Mamshad Nayeem Rizve, Son Tran, Benjamin Yao, Trishul A Chilimbi, Mubarak Shah
title_en: Sirnam Swetha*, Jinyu Yang, Tal Neiman, Mamshad Nayeem Rizve, Son Tran, Benjamin Yao, Trishul A Chilimbi, Mubarak Shah
abstract: 多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)的最新进展通过将视觉感知能力整合进大语言模型(LLMs),彻底革新了视觉-语言理解领域。该领域的主流趋势是采用基于视觉-语言对比学习(CL)的视觉编码器,其在捕捉整体表示方面表现出色,但在捕捉细节局部模式方面存在困难。本工作中,我们通过结合掩码图像建模(MIM)获取的高频和细节视觉表示,以及通过CL捕捉的语义丰富的低频表示,来增强MLLMs的视觉表示。为实现这一目标,我们引入了X-Former,这是一种轻量级的Transformer模块,通过创新的交互机制,利用CL和MIM的互补优势。具体而言,X-Former首先从两个冻结的视觉编码器(即基于CL的CLIP-ViT和基于MIM的MAE-ViT)中启动视觉-语言表示学习和多模态到多模态生成学习。随后,它进一步从冻结的LLM中启动视觉到语言生成学习,以确保X-Former的视觉特征能够被LLM解释。为验证我们的方法有效性,我们在需要详细视觉理解的任务上评估其性能。广泛评估表明,X-Former在GQA数据集中涉及结构化和语义类别的视觉推理任务中表现出色。在细粒度视觉感知基准测试上的评估进一步证实了其在视觉理解方面的卓越能力。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have revolutionized the field of vision-language understanding by integrating visual perception capabilities into Large Language Models (LLMs). The prevailing trend in this field involves the utilization of a vision encoder derived from vision-language contrastive learning (CL), showing expertise in capturing overall representations while facing difficulties in capturing detailed local patterns. In this work, we focus on enhancing the visual representations for MLLMs by combining high-frequency and detailed visual representations, obtained through masked image modeling (MIM), with semantically-enriched low-frequency representations captured by CL. To achieve this goal, we introduce X-Former which is a lightweight transformer module designed to exploit the complementary strengths of CL and MIM through an innovative interaction mechanism. Specifically, X-Former first bootstraps vision-language representation learning and multimodal-to-multimodal generative learning from two frozen vision encoders, i.e., CLIP-ViT (CL-based) and MAE-ViT (MIM-based). It further bootstraps vision-to-language generative learning from a frozen LLM to ensure visual features from X-Former can be interpreted by the LLM. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, we assess its performance on tasks demanding detailed visual understanding. Extensive evaluations indicate that X-Former excels in visual reasoning tasks involving both structural and semantic categories in the GQA dataset. Assessment on fine-grained visual perception benchmark further confirms its superior capabilities in visual understanding.

title: Sisi Dai, Wenhao Li, Haowen Sun, Haibin Huang, Chongyang Ma, Hui Huang, Kai Xu*, Ruizhen Hu*
title_en: Sisi Dai, Wenhao Li, Haowen Sun, Haibin Huang, Chongyang Ma, Hui Huang, Kai Xu*, Ruizhen Hu*
abstract: 本研究以零样本文本到3D的方式解决从文本描述生成3D人-物交互(HOI)的复杂任务。我们识别并解决了两个关键挑战:直接文本到3D方法在HOI中的不理想结果,主要由于缺乏配对的文本-交互数据;以及同时生成具有复杂空间关系的多个概念的固有困难。为有效解决这些问题,我们提出了InterFusion,一个专门用于HOI生成的两阶段框架。InterFusion利用从文本中推导出的人体姿态作为几何先验,简化了文本到3D的转换过程,并引入了额外约束以实现准确的物体生成。第一阶段,InterFusion从展示广泛交互的合成图像数据集中提取3D人体姿态,随后将这些姿态映射到交互描述。第二阶段利用文本到3D生成的最新进展,通过局部-全局优化过程生成逼真且高质量的3D HOI场景。该过程分别优化人体和物体的生成,并通过整个场景的全局优化进行联合精调,确保无缝且语境连贯的整合。实验结果证实,InterFusion在3D HOI生成任务中显著优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: In this study, we tackle the complex task of generating 3D human-object interactions (HOI) from textual descriptions in a zero-shot text-to-3D manner. We identify and address two key challenges: the unsatisfactory outcomes of direct text-to-3D methods in HOI, largely due to the lack of paired text-interaction data, and the inherent difficulties in simultaneously generating multiple concepts with complex spatial relationships. To effectively address these issues, we present InterFusion, a two-stage framework specifically designed for HOI generation. InterFusion involves human pose estimations derived from text as geometric priors, which simplifies the text-to-3D conversion process and introduces additional constraints for accurate object generation. At the first stage, InterFusion extracts 3D human poses from a synthesized image dataset depicting a wide range of interactions, subsequently mapping these poses to interaction descriptions. The second stage of InterFusion capitalizes on the latest developments in text-to-3D generation, enabling the production of realistic and high-quality 3D HOI scenes. This is achieved through a local-global optimization process, where the generation of human body and object is optimized separately, and jointly refined with a global optimization of the entire scene, ensuring a seamless and contextually coherent integration. Our experimental results affirm that InterFusion significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in 3D HOI generation.

title: Sixiang Chen, Tian Ye, Kai Zhang, Zhaohu Xing, Yunlong Lin, Lei Zhu*
title_en: Sixiang Chen, Tian Ye, Kai Zhang, Zhaohu Xing, Yunlong Lin, Lei Zhu*
abstract: 近年来,恶劣天气恢复技术取得了显著进展,但现实世界中天气退化组合的不可预测性和多样性仍带来重大挑战。现有方法通常难以动态处理复杂的退化组合,并精确进行背景重建,导致性能和泛化能力受限。受提示学习和“因材施教”理念启发,我们提出了一种新型框架T3-DiffWeather。具体而言,我们采用提示池机制,使网络能够自主组合子提示以构建天气提示,从而适应性地应对未预见的天气输入。此外,从场景建模角度,我们引入基于Depth-Anything特征的通用提示,为扩散过程提供场景特异性条件。进一步地,通过引入对比提示损失,我们采用相互推斥策略确保两类提示的表示具有区分性。实验结果表明,我们的方法在多种合成与真实数据集上均达到最先进性能,在计算效率方面显著优于现有扩散技术。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in adverse weather restoration have shown potential, yet the unpredictable and varied combinations of weather degradations in the real world pose significant challenges. Previous methods typically struggle with dynamically handling intricate degradation combinations and carrying on background reconstruction precisely, leading to performance and generalization limitations. Drawing inspiration from prompt learning and the ”Teaching Tailored to Talent” concept, we introduce a novel pipeline, T3 -DiffWeather. Specifically, we employ a prompt pool that allows the network to autonomously combine sub-prompts to construct weather-prompts, harnessing the necessary attributes to adaptively tackle unforeseen weather input. Moreover, from a scene modeling perspective, we incorporate general prompts constrained by Depth-Anything feature to provide the scene-specific condition for the diffusion process. Furthermore, by incorporating contrastive prompt loss, we ensures distinctive representations for both types of prompts by a mutual pushing strategy. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across various synthetic and real-world datasets, markedly outperforming existing diffusion techniques in terms of computational efficiency.

title: Siyi Du*, Shaoming Zheng, Yinsong Wang, Wenjia Bai, Declan P. O'Regan, Chen Qin*
title_en: Siyi Du*, Shaoming Zheng, Yinsong Wang, Wenjia Bai, Declan P. O'Regan, Chen Qin*
abstract: 图像和结构化表格是现实世界数据库的重要组成部分。尽管表格图像表示学习在创造新见解方面具有前景,但仍然是一个具有挑战性的任务,因为表格数据通常是异构且不完整的,与图像存在显著的模态差异。早期的工作主要集中在完整数据场景下的简单模态融合策略上,未考虑缺失数据问题,因此在实践中存在局限性。在本文中,我们提出__TITLE_MATH_1__,一种新颖的表格图像预训练框架,用于学习对不完整表格数据具有鲁棒性的多模态表示。具体而言,__ABS_MATH_1__研究了一种新颖的自监督学习(SSL)策略,包括一个掩码表格重建任务以解决数据缺失问题,以及图像-表格匹配和对比学习目标以捕捉多模态信息。此外,__TITLE_MATH_2__提出了一种适用于不完整、异构表格数据的通用表格编码器和一个用于跨模态表示学习的多模态交互模块。实验在自然和医学图像数据集上的下游多模态分类任务中进行。结果表明,__ABS_MATH_2__在完整和不完整数据场景中均优于最先进的监督/SSL图像/多模态方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/siyi-wind/TIP获取。
abstract_en: Images and structured tables are essential parts of real-world databases. Though tabular-image representation learning is promising for creating new insights, it remains a challenging task, as tabular data is typically heterogeneous and incomplete, presenting significant modality disparities with images. Earlier works have mainly focused on simple modality fusion strategies in complete data scenarios, without considering the missing data issue, and thus are limited in practice. In this paper, we propose , a novel tabular-image pre-training framework for learning multimodal representations robust to incomplete tabular data. Specifically, investigates a novel self-supervised learning (SSL) strategy, including a masked tabular reconstruction task to tackle data missingness, and image-tabular matching and contrastive learning objectives to capture multimodal information. Moreover, proposes a versatile tabular encoder tailored for incomplete, heterogeneous tabular data and a multimodal interaction module for inter-modality representation learning. Experiments are performed on downstream multimodal classification tasks using both natural and medical image datasets. The results show that outperforms state-of-the-art supervised/SSL image/multimodal methods in both complete and incomplete data scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/siyi-wind/TIP.

title: Siyu Jiao*, Hongguang Zhu, Yunchao Wei, Yao Zhao*, Jiannan Huang, Humphrey Shi
title_en: Siyu Jiao*, hongguang Zhu, Yunchao Wei, Yao Zhao*, Jiannan Huang, Humphrey Shi
abstract: 预训练的视觉-语言模型(如CLIP)已被越来越多地用于解决具有挑战性的开放词汇分割(OVS)任务,得益于其良好的视觉-文本嵌入空间对齐。典型方法要么在训练过程中冻结CLIP以单方面维持其零样本能力,要么微调CLIP视觉编码器以实现对局部区域的感知敏感性。然而,现有方法鲜有结合视觉-文本协同优化。基于此,我们提出内容依赖迁移(Content-Dependent Transfer),通过与输入图像交互来自适应增强每个文本嵌入,这提供了一种参数高效的文本表征优化方式。此外,我们还引入了表征补偿策略,以原始CLIP-V表征作为补偿,以维持CLIP的零样本能力。通过这种方式,CLIP的视觉与文本表征被协同优化,增强了视觉-文本特征空间的对齐。据我们所知,我们是首个在OVS领域建立协同视觉-文本优化机制的研究者。大量实验表明,我们的方法在主流OVS基准数据集上取得了优越性能。在开放词汇语义分割任务中,我们的方法在A-847、A-150、PC-459、PC-59和PAS-20数据集上分别以+0.5、+2.3、+3.4、+0.4和+1.1 mIoU的提升超越了先前的最先进方法。此外,在ADE20K数据集的全景设置中,我们分别取得了27.1 PQ、73.5 SQ和32.9 RQ的性能。代码将在MAFT-Plus上发布。
abstract_en: Pre-trained vision-language models, e.g. CLIP, have been increasingly used to address the challenging Open-Vocabulary Segmentation (OVS) task, benefiting from their well-aligned vision-text embedding space. Typical solutions involve either freezing CLIP during training to unilaterally maintain its zero-shot capability, or fine-tuning CLIP vision encoder to achieve perceptual sensitivity to local regions. However, few of them incorporate vision-text collaborative optimization. Based on this, we propose the Content-Dependent Transfer to adaptively enhance each text embedding by interacting with the input image, which presents a parameter-efficient way to optimize the text representation. Besides, we additionally introduce a Representation Compensation strategy, reviewing the original CLIP-V representation as compensation to maintain the zero-shot capability of CLIP. In this way, the vision and text representation of CLIP are optimized collaboratively, enhancing the alignment of the vision-text feature space. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to establish the collaborative vision-text optimizing mechanism within the OVS field. Extensive experiments demonstrate our method achieves superior performance on popular OVS benchmarks. In open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, our method outperforms the previous state-of-the-art approaches by +0.5, +2.3, +3.4, +0.4 and +1.1 mIoU, respectively on A-847, A-150, PC-459, PC-59 and PAS-20. Furthermore, in a panoptic setting on ADE20K, we achieve the performance of 27.1 PQ, 73.5 SQ, and 32.9 RQ. Code will be available at MAFT-Plus.

title: Siyuan Cheng* 等
title_en: Siyuan Cheng*, Guangyu Shen, Kaiyuan Zhang, Guanhong Tao, Shengwei An, Hanxi Guo, Shiqing Ma, Xiangyu Zhang
abstract: 深度神经网络(DNNs)在多个领域展现出有效性。然而,DNNs容易受到后门攻击,攻击者通过在输入中注入独特的触发器模式,导致模型对攻击者选定的目标标签产生误分类。尽管现有研究提出了多种缓解被污染模型后门效应的方法,但这些方法对近期高级攻击的防御效果有限。本文提出了一种新颖的后训练防御技术,可有效消除多种攻击的后门效应。具体而言,为模型中每个神经元近似一个独特且紧密的激活分布,随后主动清除显著超出近似边界的大激活值。实验结果表明,该方法仅使用5%的干净训练数据,就优于7种流行的防御方法,对14种现有后门攻击(包括2种高级攻击)均表现出色。该方法也具有成本效益。代码可在https://github.com/Megum1/UNIT访问。
abstract_en: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have demonstrated effectiveness in various fields. However, DNNs are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, which inject a unique pattern, called trigger, into the input to cause misclassification to an attack-chosen target label. While existing works have proposed various methods to mitigate backdoor effects in poisoned models, they tend to be less effective against recent advanced attacks. In this paper, we introduce a novel post-training defense technique that can effectively eliminate backdoor effects for a variety of attacks. In specific, approximates a unique and tight activation distribution for each neuron in the model. It then proactively dispels substantially large activation values that exceed the approximated boundaries. Our experimental results demonstrate that outperforms 7 popular defense methods against 14 existing backdoor attacks, including 2 advanced attacks, using only 5% of clean training data. is also cost efficient. The code is accessible at https://github.com/Megum1/UNIT.

title: Siyuan Li*, Lei Ke, Yung-Hsu Yang, Luigi Piccinelli, Mattia Segù, Martin Danelljan, Luc Van Gool
title_en: Siyuan Li*, Lei Ke, Yung-Hsu Yang, Luigi Piccinelli, Mattia Segù, Martin Danelljan, Luc Van Gool
abstract: 开放词汇多目标跟踪(Open-vocabulary Multiple Object Tracking, MOT)旨在将跟踪器泛化到训练集未包含的新类别。目前性能最佳的方法主要基于纯外观匹配。由于大词汇量场景中运动模式的复杂性以及新类别对象分类的不稳定性,现有方法在最终匹配步骤中要么忽略运动和语义线索,要么基于启发式方法应用这些线索。本文提出了一种统一框架SLAck,在关联的早期阶段联合考虑语义位置和外观先验,并通过轻量级时空对象图学习如何整合所有有价值的信息。我们的方法消除了融合不同线索的复杂后处理启发式方法,在大规模开放词汇跟踪中显著提升了关联性能。无需复杂技巧,我们在开放词汇MOT和TAO TETA基准测试中,针对新类别跟踪超越了先前最先进方法。我们的代码可在github.com/siyuanliii/SLAck获取。
abstract_en: Open-vocabulary Multiple Object Tracking (MOT) aims to generalize trackers to novel categories not in the training set. Currently, the best-performing methods are mainly based on pure appearance matching. Due to the complexity of motion patterns in the large-vocabulary scenarios and unstable classification of the novel objects, the motion and semantics cues are either ignored or applied based on heuristics in the final matching steps by existing methods. In this paper, we present a unified framework SLAck that jointly considers semantics location, and appearance priors in the early steps of association and learns how to integrate all valuable information through a lightweight spatial and temporal object graph. Our method eliminates complex post-processing heuristics for fusing different cues and boosts the association performance significantly for large-scale open-vocabulary tracking. Without bells and whistles, we outperform previous state-of-the-art methods for novel classes tracking on the open-vocabulary MOT and TAO TETA benchmarks. Our code is available at github.com/siyuanliii/SLAck.

title: Sizhuo Li, Dimitri Gominski*, Martin Brandt, Xiaoye Tong, Philippe Ciais
title_en: Sizhuo Li, Dimitri Gominski*, Martin Brandt, Xiaoye Tong, Philippe Ciais
abstract: 图像级回归是地球观测中的重要任务,其中视觉域和标签偏移是阻碍泛化能力的核心挑战。然而,由于缺乏合适的数据集,遥感数据中的跨域回归仍处于研究不足的状态。我们引入了一个包含五个国家的航空与卫星影像的新数据集,涵盖三个与森林相关的回归任务。为贴近实际应用场景,我们在训练阶段不提供目标域的先验信息,并在测试阶段仅提供有限信息进行模型适配。基于有序关系更易泛化的假设,我们提出流形扩散回归作为低数据量下转导学习的强基线方法。我们的对比实验突显了归纳法与转导法在跨域回归中的相对优势。2 数据集和代码可访问:dgominski.github.io/drift/
abstract_en: Image-level regression is an important task in Earth observation, where visual domain and label shifts are a core challenge hampering generalization. However, cross-domain regression within remote sensing data remains understudied due to the absence of suited datasets. We introduce a new dataset with aerial and satellite imagery in five countries with three forest-related regression tasks2 . To match real-world applicative interests, we compare methods through a restrictive setup where no prior on the target domain is available during training, and models are adapted with limited information during testing. Building on the assumption that ordered relationships generalize better, we propose manifold diffusion for regression as a strong baseline for transduction in low-data regimes. Our comparison highlights the comparative advantages of inductive and transductive methods in cross-domain regression. 2 Dataset and code available here: dgominski.github.io/drift/

title: Sneha Paul*, Zachary Patterson, Nizar Bouguila
title_en: Sneha Paul*, Zachary Patterson, Nizar Bouguila
abstract: 半监督学习(SSL)在利用大量未标记数据的同时,已展现出从少量标记数据中学习有效3D表示的有效性。传统半监督方法依赖于对未标记数据进行伪标签预测并将其纳入学习过程的基本概念。然而,我们发现现有方法未能充分利用所有未标记样本,从而限制了其潜在性能。为解决这一问题,我们提出AllMatch,一种基于SSL的新型3D分类框架,能够有效利用所有未标记样本。AllMatch包含三个模块:(1)自适应硬增强模块,对损失值较低的高置信度未标记样本施加相对较强的增强操作,从而提升此类样本的贡献;(2)逆向学习模块,通过学习“不应学习”的内容进一步提升未标记数据的利用率;(3)对比学习模块,确保在监督和无监督设置下均能从所有样本中进行学习。在两个流行的3D数据集上的全面实验表明,仅使用1%标记数据时性能提升高达11.2%,显著超越当前最优方法。此外,AllMatch展现出有效利用所有未标记数据的效率,证明仅需10%标记数据即可达到全监督学习(使用全部标记数据)的近似性能。我们的代码可在github.com/snehaputul/AllMatch获取。
abstract_en: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) has shown its effectiveness in learning effective 3D representation from a small amount of labelled data while utilizing large unlabelled data. Traditional semi-supervised approaches rely on the fundamental concept of predicting pseudo-labels for unlabelled data and incorporating them into the learning process. However, we identify that the existing methods do not fully utilize all the unlabelled samples and consequently limit their potential performance. To address this issue, we propose AllMatch, a novel SSL-based 3D classification framework that effectively utilizes all the unlabelled samples. AllMatch comprises three modules: (1) an adaptive hard augmentation module that applies relatively hard augmentations to the high-confident unlabelled samples with lower loss values, thereby enhancing the contribution of such samples, (2) an inverse learning module that further improves the utilization of unlabelled data by learning what not to learn, and (3) a contrastive learning module that ensures learning from all the samples in both supervised and unsupervised settings. Comprehensive experiments on two popular 3D datasets demonstrate a performance improvement of up to 11.2% with 1% labelled data, surpassing the SOTA by a significant margin. Furthermore, AllMatch exhibits its efficiency in effectively leveraging all the unlabelled data, demonstrated by the fact that only 10% of labelled data reaches nearly the same performance as fully-supervised learning with all labelled data. The code of our work is available at: github.com/snehaputul/AllMatch.

title: So Yeon Min*, Xavier Puig, Devendra Singh Chaplot, Tsung-Yen Yang, Priyam Parashar, Akshara Rai, Ruslan Salakhutdinov, Yonatan Bisk, Roozbeh Mottaghi
title_en: So Yeon Min*, Xavier Puig, Devendra Singh Chaplot, Tsung-Yen Yang, Priyam Parashar, Akshara Rai, Ruslan Salakhutdinov, Yonatan Bisk, Roozbeh Mottaghi
abstract: 语言从来不是在真空中被使用的。它是在说话者的经历、行为和环境的整体背景下被表达、理解和情境化的。由于人类习惯于使用具身语言进行高效沟通,机器人助手的实用性取决于其理解并执行隐含和情境化指令的能力。在传统的指令遵循范式中,代理人在空无一人的环境中独自行动,导致语言使用既简化又人工地“完整”。相比之下,我们提出情境化指令遵循(Situated Instruction Following, SIF),该方法接纳了现实世界交流中固有的不明确性和模糊性,并通过人类说话者的物理存在来实现。情境化指令的含义会通过涉及人类的过往行为和预期未来行为自然展开。具体而言,在我们的设置中,指令具有以下特点:(1)表述模糊;(2)意图随时间演变;(3)可通过代理的动态行为更精确地解读。实验结果表明,当前最先进的具身指令遵循(EIF)模型缺乏对情境化人类意图的整体理解。项目网站:https://soyeonm.github.io/SIF_webpage/
abstract_en: Language is never spoken in a vacuum. It is expressed, comprehended, and contextualized within the holistic backdrop of the speaker’s history, actions, and environment. Since humans are used to communicating efficiently with situated language, the practicality of robotic assistants hinge on their ability to understand and act upon implicit and situated instructions. In traditional instruction following paradigms, the agent acts alone in an empty house, leading to language use that is both simplified and artificially “complete.” In contrast, we propose situated instruction following (), which embraces the inherent underspecification and ambiguity of real-world communication with the physical presence of a human speaker. The meaning of situated instructions naturally unfold through the past actions and the expected future behaviors of the human involved. Specifically, within our settings we have instructions that (1) are ambiguously specified, (2) have temporally evolving intent, (3) can be interpreted more precisely with the agent’s dynamic actions. Our experiments indicate that state-of-the-art Embodied Instruction Following (EIF) models lack holistic understanding of situated human intention. Project website: https://soyeonm.github.io/ SIF_webpage/

title: Sogand Salehi*, Mahdi Shafiei, Roman Bachmann, Teresa Yeo, Amir Zamir
title_en: Sogand Salehi*, Mahdi Shafiei, Roman Bachmann, Teresa Yeo, Amir Zamir
abstract: 不同用户对同一提示生成的图像具有不同的偏好,这促使了个性化图像生成的发展,即创建与个体视觉偏好对齐的图像。然而,当前的生成模型被调优以产生吸引广泛受众的输出,缺乏个性化。使用这些模型生成符合个人用户偏好的图像依赖于用户进行迭代的手动提示工程,这既低效又不理想。我们提出通过一次性的过程捕捉用户的通用偏好,邀请他们对少量图像进行评论并解释为何喜欢或不喜欢每张图像。基于这些评论,我们利用大型语言模型推断用户的结构化喜好和厌恶的视觉属性,从而确定其视觉偏好。这些属性被用于指导文本到图像模型,以生成更符合个体用户视觉偏好的图像。通过一系列用户研究和大型语言模型引导的评估,我们证明了所提方法能够生成与个体用户视觉偏好高度对齐的图像。我们的代码和模型权重已开源于__ABS_MATH_1__。
abstract_en: Different users find different images generated for the same prompt desirable. This gives rise to personalized image generation which involves creating images aligned with an individual’s visual preference. Current generative models are, however, tuned to produce outputs that appeal to a broad audience are unpersonalized. Using them to generate images aligned with individual users relies on iterative manual prompt engineering by the user which is inefficient and undesirable. We propose to personalize the image generation process by, first, capturing the generic prefernces of the user in a one-time process by inviting them to comment on a small selection of images, explaining why they like or dislike each. Based on these comments, we infer a user’s structured liked and disliked visual attributes, , their visual preference, using a large language model. These attributes are used to guide a text-to-image model toward producing images that are tuned towards the individual user’s visual preference. Through a series of user studies and large language model guided evaluations, we demonstrate that the proposed method results in generations that are well aligned with individual users’ visual preferences. Our code and model weights are open sourced at .

title: Sohyun Lee, Namyup Kim, Sungyeon Kim, Suha Kwak*
title_en: Sohyun Lee, Namyup Kim, Sungyeon Kim, Suha Kwak*
abstract: 在恶劣条件下实现鲁棒的语义分割对于现实世界的应用至关重要。为了解决在实际场景中训练数据中无法获取标注正常条件图像的这一挑战性任务,我们提出FREST,这是一种用于语义分割到恶劣条件的源域无监督域适应(SFDA)的新型特征恢复框架。FREST交替执行两个步骤:(1) 学习仅从特征中分离条件信息的条件嵌入空间,(2) 在学习到的条件嵌入空间上恢复恶劣条件图像的特征。通过交替执行这两个步骤,FREST逐步恢复特征,降低恶劣条件的影响。FREST在两个公开基准(ACDC和RobotCar)上实现了针对恶劣条件的源域无监督域适应(SFDA)的最先进性能。此外,它在未见过的数据集上表现出更强的泛化能力。
abstract_en: Robust semantic segmentation under adverse conditions is crucial in real-world applications. To address this challenging task in practical scenarios where labeled normal condition images are not accessible in training, we propose FREST, a novel feature restoration framework for source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) of semantic segmentation to adverse conditions. FREST alternates two steps: (1) learning the condition embedding space that only separates the condition information from the features and (2) restoring features of adverse condition images on the learned condition embedding space. By alternating these two steps, FREST gradually restores features where the effect of adverse conditions is reduced. FREST achieved a state of the art on two public benchmarks (, ACDC and RobotCar) for SFDA to adverse conditions. Moreover, it shows superior generalization ability on unseen datasets.

title: 跨模态隐写术
title_en: Sojeong Song*, Seoyun Yang*, Chang D. Yoo*, Junmo Kim*
abstract: 跨模态隐写术致力于将一种模态的机密信息隐藏在另一种模态中。尽管深度学习的引入推动了隐写术领域的发展,但跨模态隐写术仍然是该领域面临的一项挑战。不同模态之间的不兼容性不仅使隐藏过程复杂化,还导致检测漏洞增加。为解决这些局限性,我们提出了INRSteg,一个基于隐式神经表示(INRs)的创新跨模态隐写术框架。我们引入了一种新型的网络分配框架,结合掩码参数更新机制,实现了多数据隐藏,并支持图像、音频、视频和3D形状等跨模态操作。此外,我们消除了训练深度神经网络的必要性,从而显著降低内存和计算成本,并避免了领域适应问题。据我们所知,在隐写术领域,这是首次将多种模态同时应用于机密数据和载体数据。在极端模态设置下的详细实验验证了INRSteg的灵活性、安全性和鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Cross-modal steganography is committed to hiding secret information of one modality in another modality. Despite the advancement in the field of steganography by the introduction of deep learning, cross-modal steganography still remains to be a challenge to the field. The incompatibility between different modalities not only complicate the hiding process but also results in increased vulnerability to detection. To rectify these limitations, we present INRSteg, an innovative cross-modal steganography framework based on Implicit Neural Representations (INRs). We introduce a novel network allocating framework with a masked parameter update which facilitates hiding multiple data and enables cross modality across image, audio, video and 3D shape. Moreover, we eliminate the necessity of training a deep neural network and therefore substantially reduce the memory and computational cost and avoid domain adaptation issues. To the best of our knowledge, in the field of steganography, this is the first to introduce diverse modalities to both the secret and cover data. Detailed experiments in extreme modality settings demonstrate the flexibility, security, and robustness of INRSteg.

title: Sojin Lee, Dogyun Park, Inho Kong, Hyunwoo J. Kim*
title_en: Sojin Lee, Dogyun Park, Inho Kong, Hyunwoo J. Kim*
abstract: 近年来,针对逆问题的研究提出了利用预训练扩散模型作为强大先验的后验采样器。这些尝试为在各种逆问题中使用扩散模型铺平了道路。然而,现有方法涉及计算密集型的迭代采样过程,并为每个测量值优化单独的解决方案,导致在未见样本上的可扩展性受限和泛化能力不足。为了解决这些局限性,我们提出了一种新颖的方法,基于扩散先验的自适应变分推断(DAVI),从自适应变分推断的角度解决逆问题。具体而言,与单独的测量值优化不同,我们的自适应推断学习一个直接将测量值映射到对应干净数据隐含后验分布的函数,即使对于未见测量值也能实现单步后验采样。在图像修复任务(如高斯去模糊、4×超分辨率和框填充)上的大量实验,使用两个基准数据集验证了我们方法在强基线上的优越性能。代码可在https://github.com/mlvlab/DAVI获取。
abstract_en: Recent studies on inverse problems have proposed posterior samplers that leverage the pre-trained diffusion models as powerful priors. These attempts have paved the way for using diffusion models in a wide range of inverse problems. However, the existing methods entail computationally demanding iterative sampling procedures and optimize a separate solution for each measurement, which leads to limited scalability and lack of generalization capability across unseen samples. To address these limitations, we propose a novel approach, Diffusion prior-based Amortized Variational Inference (DAVI) that solves inverse problems with a diffusion prior from an amortized variational inference perspective. Specifically, instead of separate measurement-wise optimization, our amortized inference learns a function that directly maps measurements to the implicit posterior distributions of corresponding clean data, enabling a single-step posterior sampling even for unseen measurements. Extensive experiments on image restoration tasks, , Gaussian deblur, 4× super-resolution, and box inpainting with two benchmark datasets, demonstrate our approach’s superior performance over strong baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/mlvlab/DAVI.

title: Um Soobin, Ye Jong Chul*
title_en: Soobin Um, Jong Chul Ye*
abstract: 我们提出了一种生成位于数据流形低密度区域的少数样本的新方法。我们的框架基于扩散模型,利用在推理过程中引入任意基于能量的引导的引导采样原理。我们的采样器的关键特征在于其自包含性,仅需预训练模型即可实现。这与需要昂贵附加组件(如外部分类器)的现有技术形成区别。具体而言,我们首先通过评估其后验均值的重建损失来估计中间潜在样本中特征的似然。随后通过最小化估计的似然进行生成,从而在后续时间步的潜在样本中鼓励少数特征的出现。为进一步提升采样器性能,我们提供了若干时间调度技术,合理管理引导对推理步骤的影响。在基准真实数据集上的实验表明,我们的方法在无需依赖高成本附加组件的情况下,显著提升了生成真实低似然少数实例的能力。代码已开源至 https://github.com/soobin-um/sg-minority。
abstract_en: We present a novel approach for generating minority samples that live on low-density regions of a data manifold. Our framework is built upon diffusion models, leveraging the principle of guided sampling that incorporates an arbitrary energy-based guidance during inference time. The key defining feature of our sampler lies in its self-contained nature, , implementable solely with a pretrained model. This distinguishes our sampler from existing techniques that require expensive additional components (like external classifiers) for minority generation. Specifically, we first estimate the likelihood of features within an intermediate latent sample by evaluating a reconstruction loss w.r.t. its posterior mean. The generation then proceeds with the minimization of the estimated likelihood, thereby encouraging the emergence of minority features in the latent samples of subsequent timesteps. To further improve the performance of our sampler, we provide several time-scheduling techniques that properly manage the influence of guidance over inference steps. Experiments on benchmark real datasets demonstrate that our approach can greatly improve the capability of creating realistic low-likelihood minority instances over the existing techniques without the reliance on costly additional elements. Code is available at https://github. com/soobin-um/sg-minority.

title: Soojin Jang, JungMin Yun, JuneHyoung Kwon, Eunju Lee, YoungBin Kim*
title_en: Soojin Jang, JungMin Yun, JuneHyoung Kwon, Eunju Lee, YoungBin Kim*
abstract: 弱监督语义分割(WSSS)方法通常依赖于类激活图(CAMs)进行初始种子生成,但由于图像级标签的监督有限,往往难以捕捉全局上下文信息。为解决这一问题,我们引入了DALNet(密集对齐学习网络),该网络利用文本嵌入来增强对不同粒度层级物体的全面理解和精确定位。我们的核心思想是采用双层级对齐策略:(1) 全局隐式对齐(GIA)通过最大化类标记与对应文本嵌入之间的相似性,同时最小化与背景嵌入的相似性,以捕捉全局语义;(2) 局部显式对齐(LEA)通过利用补丁标记的空间信息来提升物体定位精度。此外,我们提出了一种跨对比学习方法,通过将图像与文本模态的前景特征进行对齐并与其背景特征分离,鼓励缺失区域的激活并抑制干扰。通过在PASCAL VOC和MS COCO数据集上的大量实验,我们证明DALNet显著优于现有的弱监督语义分割方法。特别是,我们的方法作为单阶段方法,能够实现更高效的端到端处理流程。
abstract_en: Weakly supervised semantic segmentation (WSSS) approaches typically rely on class activation maps (CAMs) for initial seed generation, which often fail to capture global context due to limited supervision from image-level labels. To address this issue, we introduce DALNet, Dense Alignment Learning Network that leverages text embeddings to enhance the comprehensive understanding and precise localization of objects across different levels of granularity. Our key insight is to employ a dual-level alignment strategy: (1) Global Implicit Alignment (GIA) to capture global semantics by maximizing the similarity between the class token and the corresponding text embeddings while minimizing the similarity with background embeddings, and (2) Local Explicit Alignment (LEA) to improve object localization by utilizing spatial information from patch tokens. Moreover, we propose a cross-contrastive learning approach that aligns foreground features between image and text modalities while separating them from the background, encouraging activation in missing regions and suppressing distractions. Through extensive experiments on the PASCAL VOC and MS COCO datasets, we demonstrate that DALNet significantly outperforms state-of-the-art WSSS methods. Our approach, in particular, allows for more efficient end-to-end process as a single-stage method.

title: Sotirios Panagiotis Chytas*, Hyunwoo J Kim, Vikas Singh
title_en: Sotirios Panagiotis Chytas*, Hyunwoo J Kim, Vikas Singh
abstract: 预训练大语言模型(以及多模态模型)在广泛的任务中表现出色。尽管其效果显著,我们对其内部知识表示的理解仍十分有限。为此,我们以经典的组合零样本学习(CZSL)问题为例,首先提供了一种结构化的潜在空间视图,这是任何通用模型(LLM或其他)原则上应遵循的。我们提出了一种实用的CZSL解决方案,能够轻松处理开放世界和封闭世界单属性组合以及多属性组合,其性能与专门针对该任务设计的方法相当(即,对其他任务的适应较为困难)。随后,我们将这一视角扩展到现有大语言模型的分析,并探讨它们在多大程度上满足我们的公理定义。我们的分析显示了一些有趣且不出所料的结果,但无论如何都表明我们的标准具有意义,并可能为这些模型的训练提供更结构化的方法,以及额外数据收集策略和超越视觉检查的诊断手段。代码可在https://github.com/SPChytas/CatCom获取。
abstract_en: Pre-trained large language models (and multi-modal models) offer excellent performance across a wide range of tasks. Despite their effectiveness, we have limited knowledge of their internal knowledge representation. To get started, we use the classic problem of Compositional Zero-Shot Learning (CZSL) as an example, and first provide a structured view of the latent space that any general model (LLM or otherwise) should nominally respect. We obtain a practical solution to the CZSL problem that can deal with both Open and Closed-World single-attribute compositions as well as multi-attribute compositions with relative ease, where we achieve performance competitive with methods designed solely for that task (i.e., adaptations to other tasks are difficult). Then, we extend this perspective to analysis of existing LLMs and ask to what extent they satisfy our axiomatic definitions. Our analysis shows a mix of interesting and unsurprising findings, but nonetheless suggests that our criteria is meaningful and may yield a more structured approach for potential incorporation in training such models, strategies for additional data collection, and diagnostics beyond visual inspection. The code is available at https://github.com/SPChytas/CatCom.

title: Souhail Hadgi*, Lei Li, Maks Ovsjanikov
title_en: Souhail Hadgi*, Lei Li, Maks Ovsjanikov
abstract: 迁移学习长期以来一直是推动包括2D图像分析在内的许多领域发展的关键因素。不幸的是,其在3D数据处理中的适用性相对有限。尽管近期文献中提出了几种点云迁移学习方法,其中对比学习尤为突出,但该领域大多数现有方法仅在有限场景中被研究和评估。最重要的是,目前缺乏对点云迁移学习方法何时以及为何适用的原理性理解。值得注意的是,甚至标准监督预训练的适用性也尚未被充分理解。在本工作中,我们首次对监督和对比预训练策略及其在下游3D任务中的效用进行了深入的定量和定性研究。我们证明了对学习特征进行逐层分析能够为训练网络的下游效用提供重要见解。基于此分析,我们提出了一种简单的几何正则化策略,该策略提升了监督预训练的迁移能力。我们的工作因此揭示了点云迁移学习的具体挑战,以及克服这些挑战的策略。
abstract_en: Transfer learning has long been a key factor in the advancement of many fields including 2D image analysis. Unfortunately, its applicability in 3D data processing has been relatively limited. While several approaches for point cloud transfer learning have been proposed in recent literature, with contrastive learning gaining particular prominence, most existing methods in this domain have only been studied and evaluated in limited scenarios. Most importantly, there is currently a lack of principled understanding of both when and why point cloud transfer learning methods are applicable. Remarkably, even the applicability of standard supervised pre-training is poorly understood. In this work, we conduct the first in-depth quantitative and qualitative investigation of supervised and contrastive pre-training strategies and their utility in downstream 3D tasks. We demonstrate that layer-wise analysis of learned features provides significant insight into the downstream utility of trained networks. Informed by this analysis, we propose a simple geometric regularization strategy, which improves the transferability of supervised pre-training. Our work thus sheds light onto both the specific challenges of point cloud transfer learning, as well as strategies to overcome them.

title: Soumik Mukhopadhyay*, Matthew A Gwilliam*, Yosuke Yamaguchi, Vatsal Agarwal, Namitha Padmanabhan, Archana Swaminathan, Tianyi Zhou, Jun Ohya, Abhinav Shrivastava
title_en: Soumik Mukhopadhyay*, Matthew A Gwilliam*, Yosuke Yamaguchi, Vatsal Agarwal, Namitha Padmanabhan, Archana Swaminathan, Tianyi Zhou, Jun Ohya, Abhinav Shrivastava
abstract: 扩散模型已被证明是生成任务中最先进的方法。这些模型涉及训练一个U-Net以迭代预测并去除噪声,最终模型可以合成高保真度、多样化且新颖的图像。然而,无文本扩散模型通常未被探索用于判别任务。在本工作中,我们采用预训练的无条件扩散模型,并对其进行事后分析。我们发现,预训练U-Net的中间特征图具有多样性和隐藏的判别表示属性。为了释放扩散模型这些潜在属性的潜力,我们提出了新颖的聚合方案。首先,我们提出了一种新的注意力机制用于特征图池化,并进一步将该机制作为DifFormer,实现不同扩散U-Net块和噪声步骤的Transformer特征融合。接下来,我们还开发了DifFeed,一种针对扩散模型定制的新型反馈机制。我们发现,扩散模型优于生成对抗网络(GANs),并且通过我们的融合与反馈机制,可以与最先进的表征学习方法竞争,应用于判别任务——包括全监督和半监督图像分类、细粒度分类的迁移学习、目标检测和语义分割。我们的项目网站和代码已公开。
abstract_en: Diffusion models have proven to be state-of-the-art methods for generative tasks. These models involve training a U-Net to iteratively predict and remove noise, and the resulting model can synthesize high-fidelity, diverse, novel images. However, text-free diffusion models have typically not been explored for discriminative tasks. In this work, we take a pre-trained unconditional diffusion model and analyze its features post hoc. We find that the intermediate feature maps of the pre-trained U-Net are diverse and have hidden discriminative representation properties. To unleash the potential of these latent properties of diffusion models, we present novel aggregation schemes. Firstly, we propose a novel attention mechanism for pooling feature maps and further leverage this mechanism as DifFormer, a transformer feature fusion of different diffusion U-Net blocks and noise steps. Next, we also develop DifFeed, a novel feedback mechanism tailored to diffusion. We find that diffusion models are better than GANs, and, with our fusion and feedback mechanisms, can compete with state-of-the-art representation learning methods for discriminative tasks – image classification with full and semi-supervision, transfer for fine-grained classification, object detection, and semantic segmentation. Our project website and code are available publicly.

title: Sounak Mondal*, Seoyoung Ahn, Zhibo Yang, Niranjan Balasubramanian, Dimitris Samaras, Gregory Zelinsky, Minh Hoai
title_en: Sounak Mondal*, Seoyoung Ahn, Zhibo Yang, Niranjan Balasubramanian, Dimitris Samaras, Gregory Zelinsky, Minh Hoai
abstract: 为了使计算机系统能够通过语音语言有效与人类交互,它们需要理解生成的词语如何影响用户的即时注意力。我们的研究聚焦于增量注意力预测,即当一个人观看图像并听到一个指代表达时,预测其注视目标物体的注意力变化。为解决这一增量物体指代任务中的注视路径预测问题,我们开发了注意力指代Transformer模型(ART),该模型可预测每个指代表达中词语引发的人类注视点。ART采用多模态Transformer编码器联合学习注视行为及其底层定位任务,并通过自回归Transformer解码器,根据注视历史预测每个词语对应的可变数量注视点。为训练ART,我们构建了RefCOCO-Gaze数据集,包含19,738条人类注视路径,对应2,094组独特的图像-表达对,数据来源于220名参与者完成的指代任务。在定量和定性分析中,ART不仅在注视路径预测任务中超越现有方法,还表现出捕捉等待、扫描和验证等人类注意力模式的能力。代码和数据集可在以下链接获取:https://github.com/cvlab-stonybrook/ART。
abstract_en: For computer systems to effectively interact with humans using spoken language, they need to understand how the words being generated affect the users’ moment-by-moment attention. Our study focuses on the incremental prediction of attention as a person is seeing an image and hearing a referring expression defining the object in the scene that should be fixated by gaze. To predict the gaze scanpaths in this incremental object referral task, we developed the Attention in Referral Transformer model or ART, which predicts the human fixations spurred by each word in a referring expression. ART uses a multimodal transformer encoder to jointly learn gaze behavior and its underlying grounding tasks, and an autoregressive transformer decoder to predict, for each word, a variable number of fixations based on fixation history. To train ART, we created RefCOCO-Gaze, a large-scale dataset of 19,738 human gaze scanpaths, corresponding to 2,094 unique image-expression pairs, from 220 participants performing our referral task. In our quantitative and qualitative analyses, ART not only outperforms existing methods in scanpath prediction, but also appears to capture several human attention patterns, such as waiting, scanning, and verification. Code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/ cvlab-stonybrook/ART.

title: Souradeep Chakraborty*, Dimitris Samaras
title_en: Souradeep Chakraborty*, Dimitris Samaras
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的两阶段自监督方法,用于在无需分割注释的情况下检测图像组中的共现显著对象(CoSOD)。与现有依赖于仅利用图像块级信息(聚类图像块描述符)或计算密集型现成组件的无监督方法不同,我们的轻量级模型利用图像块和区域级别的特征对应关系,显著提升了预测性能。在第一阶段,我们训练一个自监督网络,通过计算跨图像的局部图像块级特征对应关系来检测共显著区域。我们使用基于置信度的自适应阈值法获得分割预测结果。在第二阶段,我们通过消除与所有阈值化跨注意力图(来自前一阶段)的前景特征表示平均值不相似的检测区域(每个图像内),来优化这些中间分割结果。在三个CoSOD基准数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的自监督模型在性能上显著优于相应的最先进模型(例如,在CoCA数据集上,我们的模型相比最先进的无监督CoSOD模型在F度量上提升了13.7%)。值得注意的是,我们的自监督模型在三个测试数据集上也优于多个近期的全监督CoSOD模型(例如,在CoCA数据集上,我们的模型相比近期的监督CoSOD模型在F度量上提升了4.6%)。我们的代码可在以下链接获取:https://github.com/sourachakra/SCoSPARC
abstract_en: Our paper introduces a novel two-stage self-supervised approach for detecting co-occurring salient objects (CoSOD) in image groups without requiring segmentation annotations. Unlike existing unsupervised methods that rely solely on patch-level information (clustering patch descriptors) or on computation heavy off-the-shelf components for CoSOD, our lightweight model leverages feature correspondences at both patch and region levels, significantly improving prediction performance. In the first stage, we train a self-supervised network that detects co-salient regions by computing local patch-level feature correspondences across images. We obtain the segmentation predictions using confidence-based adaptive thresholding. In the next stage, we refine these intermediate segmentations by eliminating the detected regions (within each image) whose averaged feature representations are dissimilar to the foreground feature representation averaged across all the thresholded cross-attention maps (from the previous stage). Extensive experiments on three CoSOD benchmark datasets show that our self-supervised model outperforms the corresponding state-of-the-art models by a huge margin (, on the CoCA dataset, our model has a 13.7% F-measure gain over the SOTA unsupervised CoSOD model). Notably, our self-supervised model also outperforms several recent fully supervised CoSOD models on the three test datasets (, on the CoCA dataset, our model has a 4.6% F-measure gain over a recent supervised CoSOD model). Our code is available at: https://github.com/sourachakra/ SCoSPARC

title: Soyeong Kwon, Taegyeong Lee, Taehwan Kim*
title_en: Soyeong Kwon, Taegyeong Lee, Taehwan Kim*
abstract: 文本引导的图像编辑和生成方法在现实世界中有广泛的应用。然而,文本引导的无限图像合成面临诸多挑战。首先,缺乏高分辨率且上下文多样化的文本-图像配对数据集。其次,基于文本扩展图像需要全局一致性与丰富的局部上下文理解。先前的研究主要集中在有限的类别上,如自然景观,并且需要在高分辨率配对文本图像上进行训练。为了解决这些挑战,我们提出了一种新颖的方法,利用大语言模型(LLMs)实现全局一致性与局部上下文理解,无需任何高分辨率文本-图像配对训练数据集。我们训练扩散模型,使其在LLMs生成的全局和局部描述以及视觉特征条件下扩展图像。在推理阶段,给定图像和全局描述,我们使用LLMs生成下一个局部描述以扩展输入图像。随后,我们通过全局描述、生成的局部描述和视觉特征扩展图像,以考虑全局一致性与空间局部上下文。实验表明,我们的模型在定性和定量方面均优于基线模型。此外,我们的模型展示了在LLMs引导下以零样本方式实现文本引导任意尺寸图像生成的能力。
abstract_en: Text-guided image editing and generation methods have diverse real-world applications. However, text-guided infinite image synthesis faces several challenges. First, there is a lack of text-image paired datasets with high-resolution and contextual diversity. Second, expanding images based on text requires global coherence and rich local context understanding. Previous studies have mainly focused on limited categories, such as natural landscapes, and also required to train on high-resolution images with paired text. To address these challenges, we propose a novel approach utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) for both global coherence and local context understanding, without any high-resolution text-image paired training dataset. We train the diffusion model to expand an image conditioned on global and local captions generated from the LLM and visual feature. At the inference stage, given an image and a global caption, we use the LLM to generate a next local caption to expand the input image. Then, we expand the image using the global caption, generated local caption and the visual feature to consider global consistency and spatial local context. In experiments, our model outperforms the baselines both quantitatively and qualitatively. Furthermore, our model demonstrates the capability of text-guided arbitrary-sized image generation in zero-shot manner with LLM guidance.

title: Sriram Narayanan*, Mani Ramanagopal, Mark Sheinin, Aswin C. Sankaranarayanan, Srinivasa G. Narasimhan
title_en: Sriram Narayanan*, Mani Ramanagopal, Mark Sheinin, Aswin C. Sankaranarayanan, Srinivasa G. Narasimhan
abstract: 热成像相机通过测量物体在红外光谱中发射的辐射来确定其温度。在本文中,我们提出了一种新颖的形状恢复方法,该方法利用了物体在简单灯泡照明下产生的热传导等热传输特性。尽管热传输发生在物体的整个体积内,但我们展示了一种表面近似方法,能够实现形状恢复,并对不同厚度物体的适用性进行了实证分析。我们开发了一种算法,通过求解线性方程组来从热成像视频中估计物体的内在形状拉普拉斯算子,以及包括热容量、对流系数和吸收热通量在内的多种属性,这些属性在任意形状的非校准照明条件下均有效。进一步地,我们提出了一种新颖的形状从拉普拉斯目标函数,旨在通过利用吸收热通量图像和两个未知光源的洞察力,解决形状固有的歧义性。最后,我们设计了一种由粗到细的优化策略,能够忠实恢复低频和高频的形状细节。我们通过在模拟和噪声热成像视频中对具有复杂形状和材料属性的现实物体(包括对可见光透明和半透明的物体)进行准确重建来验证该方法,其误差范围在1-2(物体尺寸≤13.5)以内。我们认为,利用热传输作为视觉的新线索可以开启新的成像能力。
abstract_en: Thermal cameras measure the temperature of objects based on radiation emitted in the infrared spectrum. In this work, we propose a novel shape recovery approach that exploits the properties of heat transport, specifically heat conduction, induced on objects when illuminated using simple light bulbs. Although heat transport occurs in the entirety of an object’s volume, we show a surface approximation that enables shape recovery and empirically analyze its validity for objects with varying thicknesses. We develop an algorithm that solves a linear system of equations to estimate the intrinsic shape Laplacian from thermal videos along with several properties including heat capacity, convection coefficient, and absorbed heat flux under uncalibrated lighting of arbitrary shapes. Further, we propose a novel shape from Laplacian objective that aims to resolve the inherent shape ambiguities by drawing insights from absorbed heat flux images using two unknown lights sources. Finally, we devise a coarse-to-fine refinement strategy that faithfully recovers both low- and high-frequency shape details.
