We further enhance this approach by proposing the Feature Guidance (FG) technique and the Universal Auto-PGD (UAPGD) optimization strategy for crafting high-quality triggers. The effectiveness of our method is validated through extensive empirical testing, demonstrating its high performance in both digital and physical environments. The code and video will be available at: https://github.com/linToTao/Out-of-bbox-attack.

title: Tao Lv*, Lihao Hu, Shiqiao Li, Chenglong Huang, Xun Cao
title_en: Tao Lv*, Lihao Hu, Shiqiao Li, Chenglong Huang, Xun Cao
abstract: 旨在解决现有单次曝光光谱成像方法中重复复杂的校准需求,同时更好地平衡系统复杂度与光谱重建精度,我们展示了一种新型并行编码无需校准孔径衍射成像光谱仪(PCCADIS),其采用最简并行架构并提升了光通量。该系统集成了单色采集的衍射诱导空间-光谱投影模糊信息与未校准色滤波引导,实现了便携轻量化的实现。在PCCADIS的逆过程处理中,孔径衍射通过全局复制和逐波段积分产生模糊图案,这给通过特征匹配与结构清晰的RGB信息对齐带来了挑战。因此,提出自感知光谱融合级联变压器(SSFCT)以实现未校准输入的融合与重建,该方法展现出显著提升单次曝光光谱成像精度的潜力,同时降低相关成本。我们的方法通过全面的仿真实验和原型机实测重建实验进行了严格验证,证实了PCCADIS的高精度与用户友好性。
abstract_en: Aiming to address the repetitive need for complex calibration in existing snapshot spectral imaging methods, while better trading off system complexity and spectral reconstruction accuracy, we demonstrate a novel Parallel Coded Calibration-free Aperture Diffraction Imaging Spectrometer (PCCADIS) with simplest parallel architecture and enhanced light throughput. The system integrates monochromatic acquisition of diffraction-induced blurred spatial-spectral projections with uncalibrated chromatic filtering for guidance, enabling portable and lightweight implementation. In the inverse process of PCCADIS, aperture diffraction produces blurred patterns through global replication and band-by-band integration, posing challenges in registration with clearly structured RGB information by feature matching. Therefore, the Self-aware Spectral Fusion Cascaded Transformer (SSFCT) is proposed to realize the fusion and reconstruction of uncalibrated inputs, which demonstrates the potential to substantially improve the accuracy of snapshot spectral imaging while concurrently reducing the associated costs. Our methodology is rigorously evaluated through comprehensive simulation experiments and real reconstruction experiments with a prototype, confirming the high accuracy and user-friendliness of PCCADIS.

title: Tao Yang*, Rongyuan Wu, Peiran Ren, Xuansong Xie, Lei Zhang
title_en: Tao Yang*, Rongyuan Wu, Peiran Ren, Xuansong Xie, Lei Zhang
abstract: 扩散模型在各类图像生成、编辑、增强和转换任务中展现出卓越的性能。特别是预训练的文本到图像稳定扩散模型,凭借其强大的生成先验知识,为具有挑战性的真实图像超分辨率(Real-ISR)和图像风格化问题提供了潜在解决方案。然而,现有方法往往难以保持像素级的图像结构。若通过在VAE编码器与解码器之间添加额外的跳连来重建细节,将需要额外的图像空间训练,限制了其在潜在空间任务(如图像风格化)中的应用。本文提出了一种像素感知稳定扩散(PASD)网络,以实现鲁棒的真实图像超分辨率和个性化图像风格化。具体而言,引入了像素感知交叉注意力模块,使扩散模型能够在像素级感知图像局部结构;同时采用降噪去除模块提取对退化不敏感的特征,结合图像高层信息引导扩散过程。引入可调节的噪声调度进一步提升图像恢复效果。通过简单替换基础扩散模型为风格化模型,PASD可在无需收集成对训练数据的情况下生成多样化的风格化图像;通过将基础模型与审美模型进行迁移,PASD可使旧照片焕发新生。在多种图像增强和风格化任务中的大量实验验证了所提PASD方法的有效性。我们的源代码可在https: //github.com/yangxy/PASD/获取。
abstract_en: Diffusion models have demonstrated impressive performance in various image generation, editing, enhancement and translation tasks. In particular, the pre-trained text-to-image stable diffusion models provide a potential solution to the challenging realistic image super-resolution (Real-ISR) and image stylization problems with their strong generative priors. However, the existing methods along this line often fail to keep faithful pixel-wise image structures. If extra skip connections between the encoder and the decoder of a VAE are used to reproduce details, additional training in image space will be required, limiting the application to tasks in latent space such as image stylization. In this work, we propose a pixel-aware stable diffusion (PASD) network to achieve robust Real-ISR and personalized image stylization. Specifically, a pixel-aware cross attention module is introduced to enable diffusion models perceiving image local structures in pixel-wise level, while a degradation removal module is used to extract degradation insensitive features to guide the diffusion process together with image high level information. An adjustable noise schedule is introduced to further improve the image restoration results. By simply replacing the base diffusion model with a stylized one, PASD can generate diverse stylized images without collecting pairwise training data, and by shifting the base model with an aesthetic one, PASD can bring old photos back to life. Extensive experiments in a variety of image enhancement and stylization tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed PASD approach. Our source codes are available at https: //github.com/yangxy/PASD/.

title: Taolin Zhang, Jiawang Bai, Zhihe Lu, Dongze Lian, genping wang*, Xinchao Wang*, Shu-Tao Xia
title_en: Taolin Zhang, Jiawang Bai, Zhihe Lu, Dongze Lian, genping wang*, Xinchao Wang*, Shu-Tao Xia
abstract: 近年来关于参数高效迁移学习(PETL)的研究表明,仅通过少量可学习参数即可将预训练的Vision Transformer适配到下游识别任务中。然而,由于它们通常在预训练模型中插入新结构,导致该模型的全部中间特征被改变,因此需要存储这些特征以参与反向传播,从而造成内存消耗大的训练过程。我们从一种新颖的解耦视角出发解决了这一问题,即将PETL分为两个方面:任务特定学习和预训练知识利用。具体而言,我们通过一个可学习且轻量的模块合成任务特定查询,该模块独立于预训练模型。配备任务特定知识的合成查询能够以仅查询的方式,从预训练模型的中间表示中提取对下游任务有用的特征。基于这些特征,我们提出了一种定制化的分类头以对输入样本进行预测。鉴于我们的方法采用极轻量级架构,并避免使用重型中间特征进行梯度下降运算,其在训练过程中表现出有限的内存占用。大量实验表明,我们的方法在内存约束下实现了最先进的性能,展示了其在现实场景中的适用性。代码可在:https://synqt.github.io/ 获取。
abstract_en: Recent works on parameter-efficient transfer learning (PETL) show the potential to adapt a pre-trained Vision Transformer to downstream recognition tasks with only a few learnable parameters. However, since they usually insert new structures into the pre-trained model, entire intermediate features of that model are changed and thus need to be stored to be involved in back-propagation, resulting in memory-heavy training. We solve this problem from a novel disentangled perspective, i.e., dividing PETL into two aspects: task-specific learning and pre-trained knowledge utilization. Specifically, we synthesize the task-specific query with a learnable and lightweight module, which is independent of the pre-trained model. The synthesized query equipped with task-specific knowledge serves to extract the useful features for downstream tasks from the intermediate representations of the pre-trained model in a query-only manner. Built upon these features, a customized classification head is proposed to make the prediction for the input sample. Given that our method employs an extremely lightweight architecture and avoids the use of heavy intermediate features for running gradient descent, it demonstrates limited memory usage in training. Extensive experiments manifest that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance under memory constraints, showcasing its applicability in real-world situations. The code is available at: https://synqt.github.io/.

title: Tarun Kalluri*, Sreyas Ravichandran, Manmohan Chandraker
title_en: Tarun Kalluri*, Sreyas Ravichandran, Manmohan Chandraker
abstract: 本文通过大规模、受控的实证研究,深入探讨影响现代无监督域适应(UDA)方法效果的多样化因素。为便于分析,我们首先开发了UDA-Bench,这是一个新型PyTorch框架,标准化了域适应的训练和评估流程,从而在多个UDA方法间实现公平比较。利用UDA-Bench,我们的全面实证研究揭示了以下发现:(i) 适应方法的收益随着主干网络的复杂度增加而减弱;(ii) 当前方法对未标记数据的利用不足;(iii) 预训练数据对监督和自监督设置下的下游适应均产生显著影响。在无监督适应的背景下,这些观察结果揭示了若干新颖且出人意料的特性,同时科学验证了此前常被视为经验启发或实践直觉的若干假设。UDA-Bench框架及训练模型已公开获取。
abstract_en: In this work, we take a deeper look into the diverse factors that influence the efficacy of modern unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) methods using a large-scale, controlled empirical study. To facilitate our analysis, we first develop UDA-Bench, a novel PyTorch framework that standardizes training and evaluation for domain adaptation enabling fair comparisons across several UDA methods. Using UDA-Bench, our comprehensive empirical study into the impact of backbone architectures, unlabeled data quantity, and pre-training datasets reveals that: (i) the benefits of adaptation methods diminish with advanced backbones, (ii) current methods underutilize unlabeled data, and (iii) pre-training data significantly affects downstream adaptation in both supervised and self-supervised settings. In the context of unsupervised adaptation, these observations uncover several novel and surprising properties, while scientifically validating several others that were often considered empirical heuristics or practitioner intuitions in the absence of a standardized training and evaluation framework. The UDA-Bench framework and trained models are publicly available.

title: Tatiana Gaintseva*, Martin Benning, Gregory Slabaugh*
title_en: Tatiana Gaintseva*, Martin Benning, Gregory Slabaugh*
abstract: 本文提出了一种对比语言-图像预训练(CLIP)指导的新型改进方法,用于背光图像增强任务。我们的工作基于当前最先进的CLIP-LIT方法,该方法通过在CLIP嵌入空间中约束提示(负样本/正样本)与对应图像(背光图像/良好照明图像)之间的文本-图像相似性,学习提示对。学习到的提示随后引导图像增强网络。在CLIP-LIT框架基础上,我们提出两种新的CLIP指导方法。首先,我们证明无需在文本嵌入空间中调整提示,而是可以直接在潜在空间中调整其嵌入,且不会损失质量。这加速了训练过程,并可能使额外编码器(不包含文本编码器)的使用成为可能。其次,我们提出了一种无需任何提示调整的新方法。基于训练数据中背光和良好照明图像的CLIP嵌入,我们计算嵌入空间中的残差向量,该向量是良好照明图像与背光图像平均嵌入的简单差值。该向量在训练期间引导增强网络,将背光图像推向良好照明图像的空间。此方法进一步显著减少训练时间,稳定训练过程,并生成无伪影的高质量增强图像。此外,我们展示了残差向量可被解释,揭示训练数据中的偏差,从而实现潜在的偏差校正。代码可在https://github.com/Atmyre/RAVE获取。
abstract_en: In this paper we propose a novel modification of Contrastive Language-Image Pre-Training (CLIP) guidance for the task of backlit image enhancement. Our work builds on the state-of-the-art CLIP-LIT approach, which learns a prompt pair by constraining the text-image similarity between a prompt (negative/positive sample) and a corresponding image (backlit image/well-lit image) in the CLIP embedding space. Learned prompts then guide an image enhancement network. Based on the CLIP-LIT framework, we propose two novel methods for CLIP guidance. First, we show that instead of tuning prompts in the space of text embeddings, it is possible to directly tune their embeddings in the latent space without any loss in quality. This accelerates training and potentially enables the use of additional encoders that do not have a text encoder. Second, we propose a novel approach that does not require any prompt tuning. Instead, based on CLIP embeddings of backlit and well-lit images from training data, we compute the residual vector in the embedding space as a simple difference between the mean embeddings of the well-lit and backlit images. This vector then guides the enhancement network during training, pushing a backlit image towards the space of well-lit images. This approach further dramatically reduces training time, stabilizes training and produces high quality enhanced images without artifacts. Additionally, we show that residual vectors can be interpreted, revealing biases in training data, and thereby enabling potential bias correction. Code is available at https://github.com/Atmyre/RAVE

title: 佐佐木太辅*, 伊藤洋树, 中岛正史
title_en: Tatsuya Sasaki*, Yoshiki Ito, Satoshi Kondo
abstract: 尽管日常动作、体育和烹饪领域的数据集非常丰富,但专注于工业领域活动的数据集却严重匮乏,尤其是区分正确与错误动作的场景。这种短缺带来了独特的挑战,需要高度精确且上下文敏感的特征提取,因为这些类别的区分比一般动作识别更为微妙。为了解决这一差距,我们引入了一个包含正确与错误动作对比对的数据集,旨在探索这些特定挑战,评估当前方法的局限性,并建立新的标准。我们的数据集不仅涵盖传统的工业任务,如高空作业,还扩展到日常情境,如篮球,突显了任务的广泛相关性。通过在该数据集上评估领先的技巧,我们旨在揭示有价值的见解,推动工业和日常情境中动作理解的边界。
abstract_en: While datasets on everyday actions, sports, and cooking are abundant, there’s a significant scarcity in datasets focused on industrial domain activities, especially for distinguishing between proper and improper actions. This shortage poses a unique challenge, necessitating highly precise, context-sensitive feature extraction due to the subtle class distinctions, which are more nuanced than in general action recognition. To address this gap, we introduce a dataset featuring contrasting pairs of proper and improper actions, aimed at exploring these specific challenges, assessing the limitations of current methods, and establishing a new standard. Our dataset not only encompasses traditional industrial tasks, such as working at heights, but also extends to everyday situations like basketball, underscoring the task’s broad relevance. By evaluating leading techniques on this dataset, we aim to unearth valuable insights, pushing the boundaries of action understanding in both industrial and everyday contexts.

title: Thang-Anh-Quan Nguyen*, Luis G Roldao Jimenez*, Nathan Piasco*, Moussab Bennehar*, Dzmitry Tsishkou*
title_en: Thang-Anh-Quan Nguyen*, Luis G Roldao Jimenez*, Nathan Piasco*, Moussab Bennehar*, Dzmitry Tsishkou*
abstract: 利用NeRFs分离动态物体与静态环境的任务近年来已得到广泛研究。然而,由于其复杂的几何结构和无约束的动态特性,大规模场景的捕捉仍面临挑战。在缺乏3D运动线索的情况下,先前方法通常需要简化设置,仅允许缓慢的相机运动和少量/单一动态主体,导致大多数城市场景下的解决方案不够理想。为克服这些局限性,我们提出RoDUS,一个用于分解城市场景中静态与动态元素的流程,其中为移动和非移动组件分别设计了精心分离的NeRF模型。我们的方法结合了鲁棒的基于核的初始化与4D语义信息,以选择性地引导学习过程。该策略实现了对场景动态的精确捕捉,通过自监督方式减少了重建背景中的浮动伪影。值得注意的是,在KITTI-360和Pandaset数据集上的实验评估表明,我们的方法在将具有挑战性的城市场景分解为精确的静态与动态组件方面具有显著效果。
abstract_en: The task of separating dynamic objects from static environments using NeRFs has been widely studied in recent years. However, capturing large-scale scenes still poses a challenge due to their complex geometric structures and unconstrained dynamics. Without the help of 3D motion cues, previous methods often require simplified setups with slow camera motion and only a few/single dynamic actors, leading to suboptimal solutions in most urban setups. To overcome such limitations, we present RoDUS, a pipeline for decomposing static and dynamic elements in urban scenes, with thoughtfully separated NeRF models for moving and non-moving components. Our approach utilizes a robust kernel-based initialization coupled with 4D semantic information to selectively guide the learning process. This strategy enables accurate capturing of the dynamics in the scene, resulting in reduced floating artifacts in the reconstructed background, all by using self-supervision. Notably, experimental evaluations on KITTI-360 and Pandaset datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in decomposing challenging urban scenes into precise static and dynamic components.

title: Thibaut Loiseau, Tuan-Hung Vu*, Mickael Chen, Patrick Pérez, Matthieu Cord
title_en: Thibaut Loiseau, Tuan-Hung Vu*, Mickael Chen, Patrick Pérez, Matthieu Cord
abstract: 评估感知模型对协变量偏移的鲁棒性及其检测分布外(OOD)输入的能力,对于自动驾驶等安全关键应用至关重要。然而,由于此类应用的特性,相关数据的收集和标注极具挑战性。本文首次展示了如何生成特定合成数据,以全面评估语义分割模型在现实场景中的可靠性。通过仅使用领域内数据对Stable Diffusion [?]进行微调,我们实现了在OOD领域进行零样本生成或通过OOD对象进行图像修复。该合成数据被用于评估预训练分割器的鲁棒性,从而揭示其在面对真实边缘情况时的性能表现。通过大量实验,我们证明了模型在我们的合成OOD数据和真实OOD输入上的性能具有高度相关性,展示了此类虚拟测试的相关性。此外,我们还展示了如何利用该方法增强分割器的校准和OOD检测能力。代码和数据已公开。
abstract_en: Assessing the robustness of perception models to covariate shifts and their ability to detect out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs is crucial for safety-critical applications such as autonomous vehicles. By nature of such applications, however, the relevant data is difficult to collect and annotate. In this paper, we show for the first time how synthetic data can be specifically generated to assess comprehensively the real-world reliability of semantic segmentation models. By fine-tuning Stable Diffusion [?] with only in-domain data, we perform zero-shot generation of visual scenes in OOD domains or inpainted with OOD objects. This synthetic data is employed to evaluate the robustness of pretrained segmenters, thereby offering insights into their performance when confronted with real edge cases. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate a high correlation between the performance of models when evaluated on our synthetic OOD data and when evaluated on real OOD inputs, showing the relevance of such virtual testing. Furthermore, we demonstrate how our approach can be utilized to enhance the calibration and OOD detection capabilities of segmenters. Code and data are made public.

title: Thiemo Alldieck*, Nikos Kolotouros, Cristian Sminchisescu
title_en: Thiemo Alldieck*, Nikos Kolotouros, Cristian Sminchisescu
abstract: 分数蒸馏采样(SDS)是一种近期但已广受欢迎的方法,它依赖于图像扩散模型通过文本提示来控制优化问题。本文对SDS损失函数进行了深入分析,识别出其公式中固有的问题,并提出了一种出人意料的简单但有效的修复方法。具体而言,我们将损失分解为不同因素,并隔离出导致噪声梯度的组件。在原始公式中,高文本引导被用来处理噪声,导致诸如过度饱和或重复细节等不想要的副作用。相反,我们训练了一个浅层网络,模仿图像扩散模型的时间步依赖频率偏差,以便有效分离该偏差。我们通过定性和定量实验展示了我们新颖损失函数的通用性和有效性,包括基于优化的图像合成与编辑、零样本图像翻译网络训练以及文本到3D合成。
abstract_en: Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) is a recent but already widely popular method that relies on an image diffusion model to control optimization problems using text prompts. aIn this paper, we conduct an in-depth analysis of the SDS loss function, identify an inherent problem with its formulation, and propose a surprisingly easy but effective fix. Specifically, we decompose the loss into different factors and isolate the component responsible for noisy gradients. In the original formulation, high text guidance is used to account for the noise, leading to unwanted side effects such as oversaturation or repeated detail. Instead, we train a shallow network mimicking the timestep-dependent frequency bias of the image diffusion model in order to effectively factor it out. We demonstrate the versatility and the effectiveness of our novel loss formulation through qualitative and quantitative experiments, including optimization-based image synthesis and editing, zero-shot image translation network training, and text-to-3D synthesis.

title: Thomas Hummel*, Shyamgopal Karthik, Mariana-Iuliana Georgescu, Zeynep Akata
title_en: Thomas Hummel*, Shyamgopal Karthik, Mariana-Iuliana Georgescu, Zeynep Akata
abstract: 在组合视频检索任务中,模型的输入包括一个视频和一个修改该视频内容的文本描述。目标是从视频数据库中检索出与修改后内容相关的视频。在这一具有挑战性的任务中,第一步是获取大规模的训练数据集并收集高质量的基准数据用于评估。本文我们引入了一个新的评估基准,用于基于大规模第一视角视频数据集的细粒度组合视频检索。该基准包含2,295个查询,特别关注高质量的时序视频理解。我们发现现有的组合视频检索框架无法实现该任务所需的高质量时序视频理解。为解决这一不足,我们采用了一种简单的无需训练的方法,提出了一种通用的重排序框架用于组合视频检索,并证明该方法在基准上取得了优异的性能。我们的代码和基准数据已开源,地址为https://github.com/ ExplainableML/EgoCVR。
abstract_en: In Composed Video Retrieval, a video and a textual description which modifies the video content are provided as inputs to the model. The aim is to retrieve the relevant video with the modified content from a database of videos. In this challenging task, the first step is to acquire large-scale training datasets and collect high-quality benchmarks for evaluation. In this work, we introduce , a new evaluation benchmark for fine-grained Composed Video Retrieval using large-scale egocentric video datasets. consists of 2,295 queries that specifically focus on high-quality temporal video understanding. We find that existing Composed Video Retrieval frameworks do not achieve the necessary high-quality temporal video understanding for this task. To address this shortcoming, we adapt a simple training-free method, propose a generic re-ranking framework for Composed Video Retrieval, and demonstrate that this achieves strong results on . Our code and benchmark are freely available at https://github.com/ ExplainableML/EgoCVR.

title: Thong Thanh Nguyen*, Yi Bin, Xiaobao Wu, Xinshuai Dong, Zhiyuan Hu, Khoi M Le, Cong-Duy Nguyen, See Kiong Ng, Anh Tuan Luu
title_en: Thong Thanh Nguyen*, Yi Bin, Xiaobao Wu, Xinshuai Dong, Zhiyuan Hu, Khoi M Le, Cong-Duy Nguyen, See Kiong Ng, Anh Tuan Luu
abstract: 数据质量是决定视频-语言表示学习效果的关键因素。然而,以往数据中的视频-文本对通常无法完美对齐,这可能导致视频-语言表示无法准确反映跨模态语义。此外,以往数据还存在概念分布不均的问题,从而阻碍了在冷门主题上的下游任务性能。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种带有减法角度边距的对比学习目标,以规范跨模态表示,使其尽可能达到完美相似性。此外,为适应非均匀概念分布,我们提出了一种多层感知机(MLP)参数化的加权函数,将损失值映射为样本权重,从而实现模型在训练过程中对关注点的动态调整。通过以少量无偏元数据为指导,并结合由大视觉-语言模型生成的视频-文本数据进行增强训练,我们提升了视频-语言表示效果,并在常用视频问答和文本-视频检索数据集上取得了优越的性能。
abstract_en: Data quality stands at the forefront of deciding the effectiveness of video-language representation learning. However, video-text pairs in previous data typically do not align perfectly with each other, which might lead to video-language representations that do not accurately reflect cross-modal semantics. Moreover, previous data also possess an uneven distribution of concepts, thereby hampering the downstream performance across unpopular subjects. To address these problems, we propose a contrastive objective with a subtractive angular margin to regularize cross-modal representations in their effort to reach perfect similarity. Furthermore, to adapt to the non-uniform concept distribution, we propose a multi-layer perceptron (MLP)-parameterized weighting function that maps loss values to sample weights which enable dynamic adjustment of the model’s focus throughout the training. With the training guided by a small amount of unbiased meta-data and augmented by video-text data generated by large vision-language model, we improve video-language representations and achieve superior performances on commonly used video question answering and text-video retrieval datasets.

title: Tianchen Zhao*, Xuefei Ning, Tongcheng Fang, Enshu Liu, Guyue Huang, Zinan Lin, Shengen Yan, Guohao Dai, Yu Wang
title_en: Tianchen Zhao*, Xuefei Ning, Tongcheng Fang, Enshu Liu, Guyue Huang, Zinan Lin, Shengen Yan, Guohao Dai, Yu Wang
abstract: 少步扩散模型通过仅需少量去噪步骤即可实现高质量的文本到图像生成,显著降低了推理时间。然而,仍需消耗大量内存(5-10GB),这限制了其在移动设备上的实际部署。后训练量化(Post-Training Quantization, PTQ)被证明是提升内存和运算复杂度效率的有效方法。但当应用于少步扩散模型时,现有针对多步扩散模型设计的方法在保持视觉质量和文本对齐方面面临挑战。本文发现量化瓶颈主要由高度敏感层引起。因此,我们提出了一种混合精度量化方法:MixDQ。首先,我们识别出部分高度敏感层由文本嵌入中的异常值导致,并设计了专门的句首(Begin-Of-Sentence, BOS)感知量化方法以解决该问题。随后,我们研究了现有敏感性度量指标的缺陷,引入了度量解耦的敏感性分析方法,以准确估计图像质量和内容的敏感性。最后,我们开发了一种基于整数规划的方法以获得最优的混合精度配置。在具有挑战性的1步Stable Diffusion XL文本到图像任务中,现有量化方法在W8A8精度下表现不足。值得注意的是,MixDQ实现了W3.66A16和W4A8量化,在视觉质量和文本对齐方面均无显著退化。与FP16相比,其模型体积和内存成本减少了3-4倍,并实现了1.5倍的延迟加速。项目网址为purplehttps://a-suozhang.xyz/mixdq.github.io/ .
abstract_en: Few-step diffusion models, which enable high-quality text-to-image generation with only a few denoising steps, have substantially reduced inference time. However, considerable memory consumption (5-10GB) still poses limitations for practical deployment on mobile devices. Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) proves to be an effective method for enhancing efficiency in both memory and operational complexity. However, when applied to few-step diffusion models, existing methods designed for multi-step diffusion face challenges in preserving both visual quality and text alignment. In this paper, we discover that the quantization is bottlenecked by highly sensitive layers. Consequently, we introduce a mixed-precision quantization method: MixDQ. Firstly, we identify some highly sensitive layers are caused by outliers in text embeddings, and design a specialized Begin-Of-Sentence (BOS)-aware quantization to address this issue. Subsequently, we investigate the drawback of existing sensitivity metrics, and introduce metric-decoupled sensitivity analysis to accurately estimate sensitivity for both image quality and content. Finally, we develop an integer-programming-based method to obtain the optimal mixed-precision configuration. In the challenging 1-step Stable Diffusion XL text-to-image task, current quantization methods fall short at W8A8. Remarkably, MixDQ achieves W3.66A16 and W4A8 quantization with negligible degradation in both visual quality and text alignment. Compared with FP16, it achieves 3-4× reduction in model size and memory costs, along with a 1.5× latency speedup. The project URL is purplehttps://a-suozhang.xyz/mixdq.github.io/ .

title: 罗天歌*,Justin Johnson,Honglak Lee
title_en: Tiange Luo*, Justin Johnson, Honglak Lee
abstract: 可扩展的标注方法对于构建大规模3D文本数据集至关重要,能够促进更广泛的应用。然而,现有方法有时会导致生成幻觉式描述,影响描述质量。本文探讨了3D物体描述中的幻觉问题,重点分析了Cap3D [?]方法,该方法利用预训练模型将3D物体渲染为2D视图进行描述。我们指出一个主要挑战:某些3D物体的渲染视图具有非典型性,偏离了标准图像描述模型的训练数据,从而导致幻觉。为解决这一问题,我们提出了DiffuRank方法,该方法利用预训练的文本到3D模型评估3D物体与其2D渲染视图之间的对齐程度,其中对齐度高的视图能更准确地反映物体特征。通过排名所有渲染视图并将排名靠前的视图输入GPT4-Vision,我们提升了描述的准确性和细节,实现了对Cap3D数据集20万条描述的修正,并将其扩展至Objaverse数据集的100万条描述及Objaverse-XL高质量子集的部分内容。此外,我们的数据集包含每条描述20张渲染图像,提供内在和外在相机参数、深度数据和掩码,总计6000万张PNG图像。除数据集外,我们通过将DiffuRank应用于预训练的文本到图像模型,展示了其在视觉问答任务中的适应性,其表现优于CLIP模型。
abstract_en: Scalable annotation approaches are crucial for constructing extensive 3D-text datasets, facilitating a broader range of applications. However, existing methods sometimes lead to the generation of hallucinated captions, compromising caption quality. This paper explores the issue of hallucination in 3D object captioning, with a focus on Cap3D [?] method, which renders 3D objects into 2D views for captioning using pre-trained models. We pinpoint a major challenge: certain rendered views of 3D objects are atypical, deviating from the training data of standard image captioning models and causing hallucinations. To tackle this, we present DiffuRank, a method that leverages a pre-trained text-to-3D model to assess the alignment between 3D objects and their 2D rendered views, where the view with high alignment closely represent the object’s characteristics. By ranking all rendered views and feeding the top-ranked ones into GPT4-Vision, we enhance the accuracy and detail of captions, enabling the correction of 200k captions in the Cap3D dataset and extending it to 1 million captions across the entire Objaverse dataset and a portion of the Objaverse-XL high-quality subset. Additionally, our dataset includes 20 rendered images per caption, providing both intrinsic and extrinsic camera details, depth data, and masks, resulting in a total of 60 million PNG images. Beyond datasets, we showcase the adaptability of DiffuRank by applying it to pre-trained text-to-image models for a Visual Question Answering task, where it outperforms the CLIP model.

title: Tianhao Wu*, Chuanxia Zheng, Qianyi Wu, Tat-Jen Cham
title_en: Tianhao Wu*, Chuanxia Zheng, Qianyi Wu, Tat-Jen Cham
abstract: 3D分解/分割仍然是一个挑战,因为大规模的3D标注数据不易获得。现有方法通常利用2D机器生成的片段,整合以实现3D一致性。本文提出__TITLE_MATH_1__,一种通过神经隐式表面表示(特别是符号距离函数SDF)实现3D分割与重建的新方法,其中分割渲染直接与神经隐式表面的体积渲染结合。虽然基于ObjectSDF++,但不再需要真实标签进行监督,同时保持重建单个物体表面的能力,仅依赖预训练模型的噪声和不一致标签。作为__TITLE_MATH_1__的核心,我们引入了一种高效的聚类机制,将2D标签提升至3D。在ScanNet和Replica数据集的挑战性场景上的实验结果表明,__TITLE_MATH_1__在显著减少训练时间的情况下,能够与最先进方法竞争。
abstract_en: 3D decomposition/segmentation remains a challenge as large-scale 3D annotated data is not readily available. Existing approaches typically leverage 2D machine-generated segments, integrating them to achieve 3D consistency. In this paper, we propose , a novel approach achieving both segmentation and reconstruction in 3D via the neural implicit surface representation, specifically the Signed Distance Function (SDF), where the segmentation rendering is directly integrated with the volume rendering of neural implicit surfaces. Although based on ObjectSDF++, no longer requires ground-truth segments for supervision while maintaining the capability of reconstructing individual object surfaces, relying purely on the noisy and inconsistent labels from pre-trained models. As the core of , we introduce a highly efficient clustering mechanism for lifting 2D labels to 3D. Experimental results on the challenging scenes from ScanNet and Replica datasets show that can achieve competitive performance compared to the state-of-the-art with significantly reduced training time.

title: Tianhe Wu, Kede Ma*, Jie Liang, Yujiu Yang*, Lei Zhang
title_en: Tianhe Wu, Kede Ma*, Jie Liang, Yujiu Yang*, Lei Zhang
abstract: 尽管多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)在视觉理解和推理方面取得了显著进展,但其作为图像质量评估(IQA)的强大学习、灵活、可解释且文本驱动模型的潜力仍 largely unexplored。本文对提示 MLLMs 进行 IQA 的全面系统研究。我们首先调查了九种提示系统,这些系统是三种标准化心理物理学测试程序(单刺激、双刺激和多刺激方法)与三种流行的自然语言处理提示策略(标准、上下文内和思维链提示)的组合。随后,我们提出了一种困难样本选择程序,考虑样本多样性和不确定性,以进一步挑战配备相应最优提示系统的 MLLMs。我们在全参考和无参考场景下,对三个开源和一个闭源 MLLMs 在图像质量的多个视觉属性(结构和纹理失真、几何变换和颜色差异)上进行评估。实验结果表明,只有闭源 GPT-4V 能够合理解释人类对图像质量的感知,但在区分细粒度质量变化(如颜色差异)和比较多张图像的视觉质量方面表现较弱,而这些任务人类可以轻松完成。
abstract_en: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have experienced significant advancement in visual understanding and reasoning, their potential to serve as powerful, flexible, interpretable, and text-driven models for Image Quality Assessment (IQA) remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive and systematic study of prompting MLLMs for IQA. We first investigate nine prompting systems for MLLMs as the combinations of three standardized testing procedures in psychophysics (, the single-stimulus, double-stimulus, and multiple-stimulus methods) and three popular prompting strategies in natural language processing (, the standard, in-context, and chain-of-thought prompting). We then present a difficult sample selection procedure, taking into account sample diversity and uncertainty, to further challenge MLLMs equipped with the respective optimal prompting systems. We assess three open-source and one closed-source MLLMs on several visual attributes of image quality (, structural and textural distortions, geometric transformations, and color differences) in both full-reference and no-reference scenarios. Experimental results show that only the closed-source GPT-4V provides a reasonable account for human perception of image quality, but is weak at discriminating fine-grained quality variations (, color differences) and at comparing visual quality of multiple images, tasks humans can perform effortlessly.

title: Tianjian Jiang*, Johsan Billingham, Sebastian Müksch, Juan J Zarate, Nicolas Evans, Martin R. Oswald, Marc Pollefeys, Otmar Hilliges, Manuel Kaufmann, Jie Song
title_en: Tianjian Jiang*, Johsan Billingham, Sebastian Müksch, Juan J Zarate, Nicolas Evans, Martin R. Oswald, Marc Pollefeys, Otmar Hilliges, Manuel Kaufmann, Jie Song
abstract: 我们提出了一项新型数据集,用于推动野外多人全局姿态估计的研究,该数据集包含2022年国际足联世界杯的视频素材。尽管先前的数据集主要关注局部姿态,通常局限于单人或受限的室内环境,但此次体育赛事部署的基础设施使得能够访问多个固定和移动摄像机在不同体育场中的数据。我们利用高清摄像机的静态多视角设置,在超过1.75英亩(7000平方米)的捕捉区域内以前所未有的精度恢复三维球员姿态和运动。随后,我们利用捕捉到的球员运动和场地标记校准移动广播摄像机。最终数据集包含88个序列,超过250万个三维姿态,总行程距离超过120公里。随后,我们对全局姿态估计的最先进方法进行了深入分析。实验结果表明,现有多人姿态估计技术面临挑战,支持该领域及其他领域(如体育分析)的新研究潜力。所有姿态注释(SMPL格式)、广播摄像机参数和视频素材将用于学术研究目的。
abstract_en: We present , a novel dataset for advancing research in multi-person global pose estimation in the wild, featuring footage from the 2022 FIFA World Cup. While previous datasets have primarily focused on local poses, often limited to a single person or in constrained, indoor settings, the infrastructure deployed for this sporting event allows access to multiple fixed and moving cameras in different stadiums. We exploit the static multi-view setup of HD cameras to recover the 3D player poses and motions with unprecedented accuracy given capture areas of more than 1.75 acres (7k m2 ). We then leverage the captured players’ motions and field markings to calibrate a moving broadcasting camera. The resulting dataset comprises 88 sequences with more than 2.5 million 3D poses and a total traveling distance of over 120 km. Subsequently, we conduct an in-depth analysis of the SOTA methods for global pose estimation. Our experiments demonstrate that challenges existing multi-person techniques, supporting the potential for new research in this area and others, such as sports analysis. All pose annotations (in SMPL format), broadcasting camera parameters and footage will be released for academic research purposes.

title: Tianpei Zou, Sanqing Qu, Zhijun Li, Alois C. Knoll, 何 良华, Guang Chen*, Changjun Jiang
title_en: Tianpei Zou, Sanqing Qu, Zhijun Li, Alois C. Knoll, 何 良华, Guang Chen*, Changjun Jiang
abstract: 3D点云分割因其日益增长的应用而受到广泛关注。然而,由于测试数据与训练数据之间的分布偏移,模型在动态场景中的泛化能力受到限制。为提升在多样化场景中的鲁棒性和适应性,测试时适应(TTA)方法近期被引入。然而,大多数现有TTA方法针对图像进行开发,适用于点云的有限方法忽略了点云流中固有的层次化几何结构,即局部(点级)、全局(物体级)和时间(帧级)结构。本文深入研究3D点云分割中的TTA,提出了一种新颖的层次化几何学习(HGL)框架。HGL以自底向上的方式包含三个互补模块,分别对应局部、全局和时间学习。技术上,我们首先构建局部几何学习模块以生成伪标签。随后,从全局几何视角构建原型以进行伪标签微调。此外,我们引入时间一致性正则化模块以缓解负迁移。在四个数据集上的大量实验验证了HGL的有效性和优越性。值得注意的是,在SynLiDAR到SemanticKITTI任务中,HGL实现了整体mIoU为46.91%,比GIPSO提升3.0%,并显著减少了所需的适应时间80%。代码可在https://github.com/tpzou/HGL获取。
abstract_en: 3D point cloud segmentation has received significant interest for its growing applications. However, the generalization ability of models suffers in dynamic scenarios due to the distribution shift between test and training data. To promote robustness and adaptability across diverse scenarios, test-time adaptation (TTA) has recently been introduced. Nevertheless, most existing TTA methods are developed for images, and limited approaches applicable to point clouds ignore the inherent hierarchical geometric structures in point cloud streams, i.e., local (point-level), global (object-level), and temporal (frame-level) structures. In this paper, we delve into TTA in 3D point cloud segmentation and propose a novel Hierarchical Geometry Learning (HGL) framework. HGL comprises three complementary modules from local, global to temporal learning in a bottom-up manner. Technically, we first construct a local geometry learning module for pseudo-label generation. Next, we build prototypes from the global geometry perspective for pseudo-label fine-tuning. Furthermore, we introduce a temporal consistency regularization module to mitigate negative transfer. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of our HGL. Remarkably, on the SynLiDAR to SemanticKITTI task, HGL achieves an overall mIoU of 46.91%, improving GIPSO by 3.0% and significantly reducing the required adaptation time by 80%. The code is available at https://github.com/tpzou/HGL.

title: Tianqi Liu, Guangcong Wang, Shoukang Hu, Liao Shen, Xinyi Ye, Yuhang Zang, Zhiguo Cao*, Wei Li, Ziwei Liu
title_en: Tianqi Liu, Guangcong Wang, Shoukang Hu, Liao Shen, Xinyi Ye, Yuhang Zang, Zhiguo Cao*, Wei Li, Ziwei Liu
abstract: 我们提出MVSGaussian,一种基于多视角立体视觉(MVS)的新型可泛化三维高斯表示方法,能够高效重建未见过的场景。具体而言,1)我们利用MVS对几何感知的高斯表示进行编码,并解码为高斯参数。2)为进一步提升性能,我们提出一种混合高斯渲染方法,结合高效的体积渲染设计以实现新视角合成。3)为支持特定场景的快速微调,我们引入多视角几何一致性聚合策略,有效聚合通用模型生成的点云,作为每场景优化的初始化参数。与以往基于NeRF的可泛化方法相比,后者通常需要每张图像数分钟的微调和数秒的渲染,MVSGaussian实现了每场景更优的合成质量与实时渲染。与原始3D-GS相比,MVSGaussian在更少的训练计算成本下实现了更好的视角合成。在DTU、Real Forward-facing、NeRF Synthetic和Tanks and Temples数据集上的大量实验验证了MVSGaussian在泛化能力、实时渲染速度和场景优化效率方面均达到最先进水平。
abstract_en: We present MVSGaussian, a new generalizable 3D Gaussian representation approach derived from Multi-View Stereo (MVS) that can efficiently reconstruct unseen scenes. Specifically, 1) we leverage MVS to encode geometry-aware Gaussian representations and decode them into Gaussian parameters. 2) To further enhance performance, we propose a hybrid Gaussian rendering that integrates an efficient volume rendering design for novel view synthesis. 3) To support fast fine-tuning for specific scenes, we introduce a multi-view geometric consistent aggregation strategy to effectively aggregate the point clouds generated by the generalizable model, serving as the initialization for per-scene optimization. Compared with previous generalizable NeRF-based methods, which typically require minutes of fine-tuning and seconds of rendering per image, MVSGaussian achieves real-time rendering with better synthesis quality for each scene. Compared with the vanilla 3D-GS, MVSGaussian achieves better view synthesis with less training computational cost. Extensive experiments on DTU, Real Forward-facing, NeRF Synthetic, and Tanks and Temples datasets validate that MVSGaussian attains state-of-the-art performance with convincing generalizability, real-time rendering speed, and fast per-scene optimization.

title: 郝天翔,丁晓涵*,冯洁晓,杨宇虹,陈慧,丁贵广*
title_en: Tianxiang Hao, Xiaohan Ding*, Juexiao Feng, Yuhong Yang, Hui Chen, Guiguang Ding*
abstract: 近年来,如CLIP的大规模预训练视觉-语言模型在多个领域取得了巨大成功。自然地,如何将此类庞大预训练模型中的丰富知识迁移至下游任务和数据集成为热门研究方向。在下游适配过程中,最具挑战性的问题是过拟合和灾难性遗忘,这会导致模型过度关注当前数据并丢失关键的领域通用知识。现有工作使用经典正则化技术解决这些问题。随着解决方案日益复杂,存储和推理成本的持续增长也成为亟需解决的重要问题。本文从一个观察出发:适当的随机噪声可以抑制过拟合和灾难性遗忘。我们将量化误差视为一种噪声,探索量化用于正则化视觉-语言模型,该方法高效且有效。进一步地,为在最小成本下保持模型专业化能力的同时提升其泛化能力,我们深入分析提示中权重分布的特征,总结出几个量化模块设计原则,并遵循这些原则创建了几个具有竞争力的基线。所提方法因其固有的轻量级特性而显著高效,使得其能够在资源受限设备上进行适配。我们的方法可成功集成到许多现有方法(如MaPLe)中,在减少存储开销的同时提升准确性,使其更加强大且多功能。在11个数据集上的大量实验充分展示了我们方法的优越性。代码可在github上获取。
abstract_en: In the past few years, large-scale pre-trained vision-language models like CLIP have achieved tremendous success in various fields. Naturally, how to transfer the rich knowledge in such huge pre-trained models to downstream tasks and datasets becomes a hot topic. During downstream adaptation, the most challenging problems are overfitting and catastrophic forgetting, which can cause the model to overly focus on the current data and lose more crucial domain-general knowledge. Existing works use classic regularization techniques to solve the problems. As solutions become increasingly complex, the ever-growing storage and inference costs are also a significant problem that urgently needs to be addressed. While in this paper, we start from an observation that proper random noise can suppress overfitting and catastrophic forgetting. Then we regard quantization error as a kind of noise, and explore quantization for regularizing vision-language model, which is quite efficiency and effective. Furthermore, to improve the model’s generalization capability while maintaining its specialization capacity at minimal cost, we deeply analyze the characteristics of the weight distribution in prompts, conclude several principles for quantization module design and follow such principles to create several competitive baselines. The proposed method is significantly efficient due to its inherent lightweight nature, making it possible to adapt on extremely resource-limited devices. Our method can be fruitfully integrated into many existing approaches like MaPLe, enhancing accuracy while reducing storage overhead, making it more powerful yet versatile. Extensive experiments on 11 datasets shows great superiority of our method sufficiently. Code is available at github

title: Tianxing Wu*, Chenyang Si, Yuming Jiang, Ziqi Huang, Ziwei Liu
title_en: Tianxing Wu*, Chenyang Si, Yuming Jiang, Ziqi Huang, Ziwei Liu
abstract: 尽管基于扩散的视频生成技术取得了快速进展,现有模型的推理结果仍存在时间一致性不足和动态不自然的问题。本文深入探讨了视频扩散模型的噪声初始化问题,发现了一个隐含的训练-推理差距,这是导致推理质量不满意的根源。我们的主要发现包括:1)推理时初始噪声的时空频率分布与训练时存在本质差异;2)去噪过程显著受到初始噪声低频成分的影响。基于这些观察,我们提出了一种简洁而有效的推理采样策略FreeInit,显著提升了扩散模型生成视频的时间一致性。通过在推理过程中迭代优化初始潜变量的时空低频成分,FreeInit能够补偿训练与推理间的初始化差距,从而有效提升生成结果的主体外观和时间一致性。大量实验表明,FreeInit在不增加额外训练的情况下,持续提升了各类文本到视频生成模型的生成效果。
abstract_en: Though diffusion-based video generation has witnessed rapid progress, the inference results of existing models still exhibit unsatisfactory temporal consistency and unnatural dynamics. In this paper, we delve deep into the noise initialization of video diffusion models, and discover an implicit training-inference gap that attributes to the unsatisfactory inference quality. Our key findings are: 1) the spatial-temporal frequency distribution of the initial noise at inference is intrinsically different from that for training, and 2) the denoising process is significantly influenced by the low-frequency components of the initial noise. Motivated by these observations, we propose a concise yet effective inference sampling strategy, FreeInit, which significantly improves temporal consistency of videos generated by diffusion models. Through iteratively refining the spatial-temporal low-frequency components of the initial latent during inference, FreeInit is able to compensate the initialization gap between training and inference, thus effectively improving the subject appearance and temporal consistency of generation results. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FreeInit consistently enhances the generation results of various text-to-video generation models without additional training.

title: Tianxing Xu*, Wenbo Hu, Yu-Kun Lai, Ying Shan, Song-Hai Zhang
title_en: Tianxing Xu*, Wenbo Hu, Yu-Kun Lai, Ying Shan, Song-Hai Zhang
abstract: 3D Gaussian splatting, emerging as a groundbreaking approach, has drawn increasing attention for its capabilities of high-fidelity reconstruction and real-time rendering. However, it couples the appearance and geometry of the scene within the Gaussian attributes, which hinders the flexibility of editing operations, such as texture swapping. To address this issue, we propose a novel approach, namely Texture-GS, to disentangle the appearance from the geometry by representing it as a 2D texture mapped onto the 3D surface, thereby facilitating appearance editing. Technically, the disentanglement is achieved by our proposed texture mapping module, which consists of a UV mapping MLP to learn the UV coordinates for the 3D Gaussian centers, a local Taylor expansion of the MLP to efficiently approximate the UV coordinates for the ray-Gaussian intersections, and a learnable texture to capture the fine-grained appearance. Extensive experiments on the DTU dataset demonstrate that our method not only facilitates high-fidelity appearance editing but also achieves real-time rendering on consumer-level devices, a single RTX 2080 Ti GPU.
abstract_en: 3D Gaussian splatting, emerging as a groundbreaking approach, has drawn increasing attention for its capabilities of high-fidelity reconstruction and real-time rendering. However, it couples the appearance and geometry of the scene within the Gaussian attributes, which hinders the flexibility of editing operations, such as texture swapping. To address this issue, we propose a novel approach, namely Texture-GS, to disentangle the appearance from the geometry by representing it as a 2D texture mapped onto the 3D surface, thereby facilitating appearance editing. Technically, the disentanglement is achieved by our proposed texture mapping module, which consists of a UV mapping MLP to learn the UV coordinates for the 3D Gaussian centers, a local Taylor expansion of the MLP to efficiently approximate the UV coordinates for the ray-Gaussian intersections, and a learnable texture to capture the fine-grained appearance. Extensive experiments on the DTU dataset demonstrate that our method not only facilitates high-fidelity appearance editing but also achieves real-time rendering on consumer-level devices, a single RTX 2080 Ti GPU.

title: Tianyi Liu, Shuaishuai S Zhuang, Jiacheng Nie, Geng Chen, Yusheng Guo, Guangquan Zhou*, Jean-Louis Coatrieux, Yang Chen*
title_en: Tianyi Liu, Shuaishuai S Zhuang, Jiacheng Nie, Geng Chen , Yusheng Guo, Guangquan Zhou*, Jean-Louis Coatrieux, Yang Chen*
abstract: 内镜超声(EUS)在感知食管壁的分层变化以诊断黏膜下肿瘤方面具有优势。然而,病变常会破坏食管层的结构完整性和细粒度纹理信息,阻碍准确诊断。此外,由于EUS成像的特性,病变可能出现在任何径向位置,进一步增加诊断难度。本研究通过为最先进的(SOTA)模型视觉变换器(ViT)配备一种新型统计旋转不变强化机制(SRRM),提出了一种自动分类模型。主要方法是自适应选择关键区域,以避免图像中无关信息的干扰。同时,该模型将直方图统计特征与旋转不变性整合到自注意力机制中,实现对任意径向位置病变的无偏细粒度信息捕获。通过内部临床数据和公开数据的验证,SRRM-ViT表现出显著的性能提升,表明我们的方法在EUS图像分类中的有效性与潜力。源代码已公开获取:https://github.com/tianyiliu-lab/SRRM-ViT/
abstract_en: Endoscopic Ultrasound (EUS) is advantageous in perceiving hierarchical changes in the esophageal tract wall for diagnosing submucosal tumors. However, the lesions often disrupt the structural integrity and fine-grained texture information of the esophageal layer, impeding the accurate diagnosis. Moreover, the lesions can appear in any radial position due to the characteristics of EUS imaging, further increasing the difficulty of diagnosis. In this study, we advance an automatic classification model by equipping the Vision Transformer (ViT), a state-of-the-art(SOTA) model, with a novel statistical rotation-invariant reinforcement mechanism dubbed SRRM. Mainly, we adaptively select crucial regions to avoid interference from irrelevant information in the image. Also, this model integrates histogram statistical features with rotation invariance into the self-attention mechanism, achieving bias-free capture of fine-grained information of lesions at arbitrary radial positions. Validated by in-house clinical and public data, SRRM-ViT has demonstrated remarkable performance improvements, suggesting our approach’s efficacy and potential in EUS image classification.The source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/tianyiliu-lab/SRRM-ViT/.

title: Tianyi Zheng*, Peng-Tao Jiang, Ben Wan, Hao Zhang, Jinwei Chen, Jia Wang*, Bo Li*
title_en: Tianyi Zheng*, Peng-Tao Jiang, Ben Wan, Hao Zhang, Jinwei Chen, Jia Wang*, Bo Li*
abstract: 扩散模型由于其生成高质量样本的能力在生成领域受到了广泛关注。然而,近期一些研究指出,在扩散模型训练中将所有分布同等对待是次优的。本文对扩散模型的前向过程进行了深入的理论分析。我们的研究发现,分布变化在整个扩散过程中是非均匀的,且分布变化最剧烈的阶段出现在初始阶段。因此,简单的均匀时间步采样策略无法与这些特性对齐,可能导致扩散模型训练效果不佳。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了基于贝塔分布的时间步采样策略的Beta调优时间步扩散模型(B-TTDM)。通过选择正确的参数,B-TTDM使时间步采样分布与前向扩散过程的特性相匹配。在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验验证了B-TTDM的有效性。
abstract_en: Diffusion models have received a lot of attention in the field of generation due to their ability to produce high-quality samples. However, several recent studies indicate that treating all distributions equally in diffusion model training is sub-optimal. In this paper, we conduct an in-depth theoretical analysis of the forward process of diffusion models. Our findings reveal that the distribution variations are non-uniform throughout the diffusion process and the most drastic variations in distribution occur in the initial stages. Consequently, simple uniform timestep sampling strategy fail to align with these properties, potentially leading to sub-optimal training of diffusion models. To address this, we propose the Beta-Tuned Timestep Diffusion Model (B-TTDM), which devises a timestep sampling strategy based on the beta distribution. By choosing the correct parameters, B-TTDM aligns the timestep sampling distribution with the properties of the forward diffusion process. Extensive experiments on different benchmark datasets validate the effectiveness of B-TTDM.

title: Tianyou Luo*, Quan Yuan*, Yuchen Xia, Guiyang Luo, Yujia Yang, Jinglin Li
title_en: Tianyou Luo*, Quan Yuan*, Yuchen Xia, Guiyang Luo, Yujia Yang, Jinglin Li
abstract: 共享中间神经特征使智能体能够有效穿透遮挡。由于智能体多样性,一些开创性工作已研究异构神经特征的领域自适应。然而,这些工作均部分替换智能体的私有神经网络组件,破坏了模型完整性及双向兼容性。本文考虑一个开放性挑战:如何为异构遗留模型学习非破坏性领域适配器,以实现协同感知,同时兼容持续涌现的新智能体模型?为克服这一挑战,我们提出首个即插即用领域适配器(PnPDA)用于异构协同感知。PnPDA基于对比学习构建语义校准器,监督领域差距桥接而无需破坏原始模型。语义转换器学习转换特征语义空间,语义增强器用于增强特征表示。通过指定标准语义,搭载PnPDA的新模型可便捷加入现有协同。在OPV2V数据集上的大量实验表明,PnPDA非破坏性桥接领域差距,超越SOTA方法9.13%。代码已开源:https://github.com/luotianyou349/PnPDA
abstract_en: Sharing intermediate neural features enables agents to effectively see through occlusions. Due to agent diversity, some pioneering works have studied domain adaption for heterogeneous neural features. Nevertheless, these works all partially replace agents’ private neural network with newly trained components, which breaks the model integrity and bidirectional compatibility of agents. In this paper, we consider an open challenge: how to learn non-destructive domain adapters for heterogeneous legacy models to achieve collaborative perception, while compatible with continually emerging new agent models? To overcome this challenge, we propose the first plug-and-play domain adapter (PnPDA) for heterogeneous collaborative perception. PnPDA builds a semantic calibrator based on contrastive learning to supervise domain gap bridging without destructing the original models. Semantic converter is learned to transform the semantic space of features, while semantic enhancer is utilized to enhance the representation of features. By specifying standard semantics, new models with PnPDA can easily join existing collaborations. Extensive experiments on OPV2V dataset show that PnPDA non-destructively bridges the domain gap and outperforms SOTA by 9.13%. The code is available at: https://github.com/luotianyou349/PnPDA.

title: Tianyu Luan, Zhongpai Gao, Luyuan Xie, Abhishek Sharma, Hao Ding, Benjamin Planche, Meng Zheng, Ange Lou, Terrence Chen, Junsong Yuan, Ziyan Wu*
title_en: Tianyu Luan, Zhongpai Gao, Luyuan Xie, Abhishek Sharma, Hao Ding, Benjamin Planche, Meng Zheng, Ange Lou, Terrence Chen, Junsong Yuan, Ziyan Wu*
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的自底向上的方法用于人体网格重建,特别针对输入图像中部分可见性和遮挡带来的挑战进行了设计。传统自顶向下的方法依赖于全身参数化模型(如SMPL),当仅可见人体小部分时会出现问题,因为它们需要大部分人体可见才能实现准确的网格重建。为克服这一局限性,我们的方法采用“()”策略,先独立重建人体各部分再进行融合,从而增强对遮挡的鲁棒性。我们设计了(),该方法能够从少量形状和全局位置参数独立重建网格,无需各部分之间的依赖关系。一个专门设计的融合模块随后无缝整合重建的部分,即使仅可见少数部分也能实现整合。我们利用大量真实SMPL数据来训练参数化网格模型。为促进方法的训练和评估,我们建立了包含部分可见人体图像及其标注的基准数据集。在这些基准数据集上的实验表明,我们的方法在遮挡严重的情况下尤为有效,传统方法在这些场景下难以维持重建质量。
abstract_en: We introduce a novel bottom-up approach for human body mesh reconstruction, specifically designed to address the challenges posed by partial visibility and occlusion in input images. Traditional top-down methods, relying on whole-body parametric models like SMPL, falter when only a small part of the human is visible, as they require visibility of most of the human body for accurate mesh reconstruction. To overcome this limitation, our method employs a “ ()” strategy, reconstructing human body parts independently before fusing them, thereby ensuring robustness against occlusions. We design () that independently reconstruct the mesh from a few shape and global-location parameters, without inter-part dependency. A specially designed fusion module then seamlessly integrates the reconstructed parts, even when only a few are visible. We harness a large volume of ground-truth SMPL data to train our parametric mesh models. To facilitate the training and evaluation of our method, we have established benchmark datasets featuring images of partially visible humans with annotations. Our experiments, conducted on these benchmark datasets, demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, particularly in scenarios with substantial invisibility, where traditional approaches struggle to maintain reconstruction quality.

title: Tianyuan Yuan*, Yucheng Mao, Jiawei Yang, Yicheng LIU, Yue Wang, Hang Zhao*
title_en: Tianyuan Yuan*, Yucheng Mao, Jiawei Yang, Yicheng LIU, Yue Wang, Hang Zhao*
abstract: 自动驾驶车辆高度依赖感知系统来导航和理解周围环境。尽管这些系统最近取得了显著进展,但在遮挡、极端光照或陌生城市区域等条件下仍存在挑战。与这些系统不同,人类并不仅依赖即时观察来感知环境。在导航新城市时,人类会逐步构建初步的心理地图,以在后续访问中补充实时感知。受此人类方法启发,我们引入了一种新颖的框架PreSight,利用过去的行驶数据构建静态先验记忆,从而增强后续导航中的在线感知。我们的方法涉及使用之前旅程的数据优化城市级神经辐射场,以生成神经先验。这些先验富含语义和几何细节,无需手动标注即可生成,并能无缝增强各种最先进的感知模型,以最小的额外计算成本提高其效果。在nuScenes数据集上的实验结果表明该框架与各种在线感知模型高度兼容。具体而言,它在HD地图构建和占用预测任务中表现出显著改进,突显了其作为自动驾驶系统新感知框架的潜力。我们的代码将在https://github.com/yuantianyuan01/PreSight发布。
abstract_en: Autonomous vehicles rely extensively on perception systems to navigate and interpret their surroundings. Despite significant advancements in these systems recently, challenges persist under conditions like occlusion, extreme lighting, or in unfamiliar urban areas. Unlike these systems, humans do not solely depend on immediate observations to perceive the environment. In navigating new cities, humans gradually develop a preliminary mental map to supplement real-time perception during subsequent visits. Inspired by this human approach, we introduce a novel framework, PreSight, that leverages past traversals to construct static prior memories, enhancing online perception in later navigations. Our method involves optimizing a city-scale neural radiance field with data from previous journeys to generate neural priors. These priors, rich in semantic and geometric details, are derived without manual annotations and can seamlessly augment various state-of-the-art perception models, improving their efficacy with minimal additional computational cost. Experimental results on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate the framework’s high compatibility with diverse online perception models. Specifically, it shows remarkable improvements in HD-map construction and occupancy prediction tasks, highlighting its potential as a new perception framework for autonomous driving systems. Our code will be released at https://github.com/yuantianyuan01/PreSight.

title: 张天元*, 于宏兴, 吴润迪, 布兰登·Y·冯, 郑昌希, 诺亚·斯纳韦利, 吴佳俊, 威廉·T·弗里曼
title_en: Tianyuan Zhang*, Hong-Xing Yu, Rundi Wu, Brandon Y Feng, Changxi Zheng, Noah Snavely, Jiajun Wu, William T. Freeman
abstract: 逼真的物体交互对于创建沉浸式的虚拟体验至关重要,但合成对新颖交互具有真实感的3D物体动态仍是一个重大挑战。与无条件或文本条件动态生成不同,动作条件动态需要感知物体的物理材料属性,并基于这些属性(如物体刚度)进行3D运动预测。然而,由于缺乏材料真实数据,估计物理材料属性仍是一个开放性问题,因为对真实物体测量这些属性极具难度。我们提出__TITLE_MATH_1__,一种基于物理的方法,通过利用视频生成模型学习到的物体动态先验,使静态3D物体具备交互动态。通过蒸馏这些先验,__TITLE_MATH_1__能够合成对新颖交互(如外部力或代理操作)的真实响应。我们在弹性物体的多样化示例上验证了我们的方法,并通过用户研究评估合成交互的真实性。__TITLE_MATH_1__通过使静态3D物体以物理合理的方式动态响应交互刺激,迈出了实现更具吸引力和真实感虚拟体验的重要一步。详见我们的项目页面:https://physdreamer.github.io/
abstract_en: Realistic object interactions are crucial for creating immersive virtual experiences, yet synthesizing realistic 3D object dynamics in response to novel interactions remains a significant challenge. Unlike unconditional or text-conditioned dynamics generation, action-conditioned dynamics requires perceiving the physical material properties of objects and grounding the 3D motion prediction on these properties, such as object stiffness. However, estimating physical material properties is an open problem due to the lack of material ground-truth data, as measuring these properties for real objects is highly difficult. We present , a physics-based approach that endows static 3D objects with interactive dynamics by leveraging the object dynamics priors learned by video generation models. By distilling these priors, enables the synthesis of realistic object responses to novel interactions, such as external forces or agent manipulations. We demonstrate our approach on diverse examples of elastic objects and evaluate the realism of the synthesized interactions through a user study. takes a step towards more engaging and realistic virtual experiences by enabling static 3D objects to dynamically respond to interactive stimuli in a physically plausible manner. See our project page at https://physdreamer.github.io/.

title: Tim Broedermann*, David Brüggemann, Christos Sakaridis, Kevin Ta, Odysseas Liagouris, Jason Corkill, Luc Van Gool
title_en: Tim Broedermann*, David Brüggemann, Christos Sakaridis, Kevin Ta, Odysseas Liagouris, Jason Corkill, Luc Van Gool
abstract: 实现L5级自动驾驶汽车的全自动驾驶需要一种强大的语义视觉感知系统,该系统能够解析不同传感器在多样化条件下的数据。然而,现有的语义感知数据集通常缺乏自动驾驶汽车中常用的非相机模态,或未能利用这些模态来辅助和提升在复杂条件下的语义标注。为了解决这一问题,我们引入了MUlti-SEnsor Semantic perception数据集(MUSES),该数据集专为恶劣条件下的驾驶不确定性增加场景设计。MUSES包含2500张在多样天气和光照条件下拍摄的图像的同步多模态记录,并提供2D全景标注。该数据集集成了帧相机、激光雷达、雷达、事件相机和IMU/GNSS传感器。我们提出的新双阶段全景标注协议能够捕捉地面真实数据中的类别级和实例级不确定性,并支持不确定性感知的全景分割新任务,以及标准的语义和全景分割任务。MUSES在多样化视觉条件下既适用于模型训练,也对模型评估具有挑战性,它为多模态和不确定性感知的密集语义感知研究开辟了新途径。我们的数据集和基准测试可在https://muses.vision.ee.ethz.ch/公开获取。
abstract_en: Achieving level-5 driving automation in autonomous vehicles necessitates a robust semantic visual perception system capable of parsing data from different sensors across diverse conditions. However, existing semantic perception datasets often lack important non-camera modalities typically used in autonomous vehicles, or they do not exploit such modalities to aid and improve semantic annotations in challenging conditions. To address this, we introduce , the MUlti-SEnsor Semantic perception dataset for driving in adverse conditions under increased uncertainty. includes synchronized multimodal recordings with 2D panoptic annotations for 2500 images captured under diverse weather and illumination. The dataset integrates a frame camera, a lidar, a radar, an event camera, and an IMU/GNSS sensor. Our new two-stage panoptic annotation protocol captures both class-level and instance-level uncertainty in the ground truth and enables the novel task of uncertainty-aware panoptic segmentation, along with standard semantic and panoptic segmentation. proves both effective for training and challenging for evaluating models under diverse visual conditions, and it opens new avenues for research in multimodal and uncertainty-aware dense semantic perception. Our dataset and benchmark are publicly available at https://muses.vision.ee.ethz.ch/.

title: Tim Elsner*, Julia Berger, Tong Wu, Victor Czech, Lin Gao, Leif Kobbelt
title_en: Tim Elsner*, Julia Berger, Tong Wu, Victor Czech, Lin Gao, Leif Kobbelt
abstract: 缝合缩放是一种图像编辑方法,能够实现内容感知的缩放,包括移除物体等操作。然而,基于动态规划或图割法的缝合查找策略限制了其在更广泛视觉数据格式和编辑自由度中的应用。我们的观察表明,通过形变场描述图像的编辑和重定向,可以实现内容感知形变的泛化。我们提出利用神经网络学习一种形变,使输出保持合理的同时,仅在信息量较低的区域进行形变。该技术适用于不同类型的视觉数据,包括图像、作为神经辐射场表示的3D场景,甚至多边形网格。在不同视觉数据上的实验表明,我们的方法在内容感知重定向方面优于先前方法。
abstract_en: Seam carving is an image editing method that enables content-aware resizing, including operations like removing objects. However, the seam-finding strategy based on dynamic programming or graph-cut limits its applications to broader visual data formats and degrees of freedom for editing. Our observation is that describing the editing and retargeting of images more generally by a deformation field yields a generalisation of content-aware deformations. We propose to learn a deformation with a neural network that keeps the output plausible while trying to deform it only in places with low information content. This technique applies to different kinds of visual data, including images, 3D scenes given as neural radiance fields, or even polygon meshes. Experiments conducted on different visual data show that our method achieves better content-aware retargeting compared to previous methods.

title: Tim Rädsch*, Annika Reinke, Vivienn Weru, Minu D. Tizabi, Nicholas Heller, Fabian Isensee, Annette Kopp-Schneider, Lena Maier-Hein*
title_en: Tim Rädsch*, Annika Reinke, Vivienn Weru, Minu D. Tizabi, Nicholas Heller, Fabian Isensee, Annette Kopp-Schneider, Lena Maier-Hein*
abstract: [width=1]figures/fig1l owr es.png 图1:本文研究的问题(RQs)。基于57,648个由924名标注员和34名质量保证(QA)人员从五个不同标注供应商处标注的实例分割掩码,我们(1)比较了标注公司与Amazon Mechanical Turk在生成高质量标注方面的有效性,(2)研究了标注公司内部质量保证(QA)及(3)现实世界图像特征对标注质量的影响。本文不描述新方法,而是研究AI图像分析可靠基准测试和实际应用的基础:生成高质量参考标注。以往研究主要关注众包作为外包标注的手段,但对标注公司的内部质量保证(QA)流程关注较少。因此,我们的目标是评估标注公司采用的QA对标注质量的影响,并制定提升数据标注效率的方法。基于从四家标注公司和Amazon Mechanical Turk(MTurk)共924名标注员和34名QA人员处获得的总计57,648个实例分割图像,我们得出以下见解:(1)与广泛使用的平台MTurk相比,标注公司在数量和质量方面表现更优。(2)标注公司的内部QA仅提供微小改进,甚至没有改进。然而,改进标注说明而非投资QA可显著提升标注性能。(3)内部QA的效益取决于特定图像特征。我们的工作可使研究人员从固定标注预算中获得更大价值,并改变标注公司进行内部QA的方式。
abstract_en: [width=1]figures/fig1l owr es.png Figure 1: Research Questions (RQs) tackled in this work. Based on 57,648 instance segmentation masks annotated by 924 annotators and 34 quality assurance (QA) workers from five different annotation providers, we (1) compared the effectiveness of generating high-quality annotations between annotation companies and Amazon Mechanical Turk and (2) investigated the effects of annotation companies’ internal QA and (3) real-world image characteristics on the annotation quality. This paper does not describe a novel method. Instead, it studies an essential foundation for reliable benchmarking and ultimately real-world application of AI-based image analysis: generating high-quality reference annotations. Previous research has focused on crowdsourcing as a means of outsourcing annotations. However, little attention has so far been given to annotation companies, specifically regarding their internal quality assurance (QA) processes. Therefore, our aim is to evaluate the influence of QA employed by annotation companies on annotation quality and devise methodologies for maximizing data annotation efficacy. Based on a total of 57,648 instance segmented images obtained from a total of 924 annotators and 34 QA workers from four annotation companies and Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk), we derived the following insights: (1) Annotation companies perform better both in terms of quantity and quality compared to the widely used platform MTurk. (2) Annotation companies’ internal QA only provides marginal improvements, if any. However, improving labeling instructions instead of investing in QA can substantially boost annotation performance. (3) The benefit of internal QA depends on specific image characteristics. Our work could enable researchers to derive substantially more value from a fixed annotation budget and change the way annotation companies conduct internal QA.

title: Tim Salzmann, Markus Ryll, Alex Bewley, Matthias Minderer*
title_en: Tim Salzmann, Markus Ryll, Alex Bewley, Matthias Minderer*
abstract: 图1:关系[宽度=]figures/hero检测到的未见过图像中的关系。顶部关系按置信度得分显示。照片由Spacejoy在Unsplash上拍摄。视觉关系检测旨在识别图像中的物体及其关系。先前方法通过在现有目标检测架构中添加独立的关系模块或解码器来处理此任务。这种分离增加了复杂性并阻碍了端到端训练,从而限制了性能。我们提出了一种简单且高度高效的无解码器架构,用于开放词汇视觉关系检测。我们的模型由基于Transformer的图像编码器组成,该编码器将物体表示为标记,并隐式建模它们的关系。为了提取关系信息,我们引入了一种注意力机制,选择可能形成关系的物体对。我们提供了一种单阶段训练方法,可在物体和关系检测数据的混合数据集上训练该模型。我们的方法在Visual Genome和大型词汇GQA基准上实现了最先进的关系检测性能,并在实时推理速度下运行。我们提供了消融实验、现实世界定性示例以及零样本性能分析。
abstract_en: f igure.pdf Figure 1: Relationships [width=]figures/hero detected by our method on an unseen image. The top relationships by confidence score are shown. Photo by Spacejoy on Unsplash. Visual relationship detection aims to identify objects and their relationships in images. Prior methods approach this task by adding separate relationship modules or decoders to existing object detection architectures. This separation increases complexity and hinders end-to-end training, which limits performance. We propose a simple and highly efficient decoder-free architecture for open-vocabulary visual relationship detection. Our model consists of a Transformer-based image encoder that represents objects as tokens and models their relationships implicitly. To extract relationship information, we introduce an attention mechanism that selects object pairs likely to form a relationship. We provide a single-stage recipe to train this model on a mixture of object and relationship detection data. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art relationship detection performance on Visual Genome and on the large-vocabulary GQA benchmark at real-time inference speeds. We provide ablations, real-world qualitative examples, and analyses of zero-shot performance.

title: Timothy Chase Jr*, Karthik Dantu
title_en: Timothy Chase Jr*, Karthik Dantu
abstract: 为了使航天器能够安全着陆或在接近天体的环境中导航,需要对地表地形进行视觉检测与跟踪。当前方法依赖于基于预收集补丁特征的模板匹配,但这些特征获取成本高昂且限制了感知能力。尽管近期文献聚焦于原位检测方法以提升导航与操作自主性,但仍需更鲁棒的描述机制。本文探索将度量学习作为轻量级特征描述机制,发现现有方法未能有效解决类别间相似性及多视角观测几何问题。我们归因于视图无关的注意力机制,提出多视角注意力正则化(Multi-view Attention Regularizations, MARs)以约束多特征视图间的通道与空间注意力,规范注意力聚焦的"what"与"where"。我们全面分析了多种现代度量学习损失函数在引入MARs前后的表现,并通过实验验证了地形特征识别性能提升高达85%。此外,我们引入Luna-1数据集,包含NASA任务数据中的月球陨石坑地标与参考导航框架,以支持该困难任务的未来研究。Luna-1数据集及源代码已公开在magentahttps: //droneslab.github.io/mars/。
abstract_en: The visual detection and tracking of surface terrain is required for spacecraft to safely land on or navigate within close proximity to celestial objects. Current approaches rely on template matching with pre-gathered patch-based features, which are expensive to obtain and a limiting factor in perceptual capability. While recent literature has focused on in-situ detection methods to enhance navigation and operational autonomy, robust description is still needed. In this work, we explore metric learning as the lightweight feature description mechanism and find that current solutions fail to address inter-class similarity and multi-view observational geometry. We attribute this to the view-unaware attention mechanism and introduce Multi-view Attention Regularizations (MARs) to constrain the channel and spatial attention across multiple feature views, regularizing the what and where of attention focus. We thoroughly analyze many modern metric learning losses with and without MARs and demonstrate improved terrain-feature recognition performance by upwards of 85%. We additionally introduce the Luna-1 dataset, consisting of Moon crater landmarks and reference navigation frames from NASA mission data to support future research in this difficult task. Luna-1 and source code are publicly available at magentahttps: //droneslab.github.io/mars/.

title: 雷婷,尹少峰,彭宇欣,刘洋*
title_en: Ting Lei, Shaofeng Yin, Yuxin Peng, Yang Liu*
abstract: 零样本人类-物体交互(HOI)检测因其能够检测超出预定义类别的HOI而成为前沿课题。该任务不仅需要识别人类-物体对的交互性并进行定位,还需识别可见和不可见的交互类别。本文提出了一种基于条件多模态提示(CMMP)的新型零样本HOI检测框架。该方法在微调用于HOI检测时,增强了大型基础模型(如CLIP)的泛化能力。与传统提示学习方法不同,我们分别提出用于交互感知视觉特征提取和可泛化交互分类的解耦视觉与语言提示学习。具体而言,我们将不同粒度的先验知识整合到条件视觉提示中,包括输入条件实例先验和全局空间模式先验。前者鼓励图像编码器对属于可见或潜在不可见HOI概念的实例进行平等处理,后者提供交互中人类与物体的代表性合理空间配置。此外,我们采用语言感知提示学习并引入一致性约束,以保留大型基础模型的知识,从而在文本分支中实现更好的泛化能力。大量实验验证了我们基于条件多模态提示检测器的有效性,在各种零样本设置下的不可见类别上超越了先前的最先进方法。代码和模型可在https://github.com/ltttpku/ CMMP获取。
abstract_en: Zero-shot Human-Object Interaction (HOI) detection has emerged as a frontier topic due to its capability to detect HOIs beyond a predefined set of categories. This task entails not only identifying the interactiveness of human-object pairs and localizing them but also recognizing both seen and unseen interaction categories. In this paper, we introduce a novel framework for zero-shot HOI detection using Conditional Multi-Modal Prompts, namely CMMP. This approach enhances the generalization of large foundation models, such as CLIP, when fine-tuned for HOI detection. Unlike traditional prompt-learning methods, we propose learning decoupled vision and language prompts for interactiveness-aware visual feature extraction and generalizable interaction classification, respectively. Specifically, we integrate prior knowledge of different granularity into conditional vision prompts, including an input-conditioned instance prior and a global spatial pattern prior. The former encourages the image encoder to treat instances belonging to seen or potentially unseen HOI concepts equally while the latter provides representative plausible spatial configuration of the human and object under interaction. Besides, we employ language-aware prompt learning with a consistency constraint to preserve the knowledge of the large foundation model to enable better generalization in the text branch. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy of our detector with conditional multi-modal prompts, outperforming previous state-of-the-art on unseen classes of various zero-shot settings. The code and models are available at https://github.com/ltttpku/ CMMP.

title: 潘婷*, 汤露露, 王新龙*, 沈树刚
title_en: Ting Pan*, Lulu Tang, Xinlong Wang*, Shiguang Shan
abstract: 我们提出了一种统一的、可提示的模型,能够同时对任何事物进行分割、识别和描述。与SAM不同,我们旨在通过视觉提示构建一种通用的区域表示。为此,我们使用大量分割掩码(包括SA-1B掩码)以及从预训练的50亿参数CLIP模型中获取的语义先验知识来训练一个具有广泛泛化能力的模型。具体而言,我们通过在每个掩码标记中添加语义标记构建了一个可提示的图像解码器。语义标记负责在预定义的概念空间中学习语义先验。通过同时优化掩码标记上的分割任务和语义标记上的概念预测,我们的模型展现出强大的区域识别和定位能力。例如,一个额外训练的3800万参数因果文本解码器在Visual Genome区域描述任务中取得了164.7的CIDEr得分,创下了新纪录。我们认为该模型可以作为通用的区域级图像分词器,能够为广泛视觉感知任务编码通用区域上下文。代码和模型可在https: //github.com/baaivision/tokenize-anything获取。
abstract_en: We present a unified, promptable model capable of simultaneously segmenting, recognizing, and captioning anything. Unlike SAM, we aim to build a versatile region representation in the wild via visual prompting. To achieve this, we train a generalizable model with massive segmentation masks, , SA-1B masks, and semantic priors from a pre-trained CLIP model with 5 billion parameters. Specifically, we construct a promptable image decoder by adding a semantic token to each mask token. The semantic token is responsible for learning the semantic priors in a predefined concept space. Through joint optimization of segmentation on mask tokens and concept prediction on semantic tokens, our model exhibits strong regional recognition and localization capabilities. For example, an additional 38M-parameter causal text decoder trained from scratch sets a new record with a CIDEr score of 164.7 on the Visual Genome region captioning task. We believe this model can be a versatile region-level image tokenizer, capable of encoding general-purpose region context for a broad range of visual perception tasks. Code and models are available at https: //github.com/baaivision/tokenize-anything.

title: Ting-Ru Liu*, Hsuan-Kung Yang, Jou-Min Liu, Chun-Wei Huang, Tsung-Chih Chiang, Quan Kong, Norimasa Kobori, Chun-Yi Lee
title_en: Ting-Ru Liu*, Hsuan-Kung Yang, Jou-Min Liu, Chun-Wei Huang, Tsung-Chih Chiang, Quan Kong, Norimasa Kobori, Chun-Yi Lee
abstract: 场景坐标回归(Scene Coordinate Regression, SCR)方法由于其在视觉定位中的潜在精度优势,已成为研究热点。然而,现有许多SCR方法在训练时使用包含动态物体和无纹理区域的全图像区域样本。在训练过程中利用这些区域进行优化可能会影响模型的整体性能和效率。本研究首先通过深入分析验证了这些区域的负面影响。受分析启发,我们引入了错误引导特征选择(Error-Guided Feature Selection, EGFS)机制,并结合使用Segment Anything Model(SAM)[?]。该机制以低重投影区域为提示,将其扩展为错误引导掩码,再通过迭代采样点和过滤问题区域的方式利用这些掩码。实验表明,我们的方法在Cambridge Landmarks和Indoor6数据集上优于不依赖3D信息的现有SCR方法。
abstract_en: Scene coordinate regression (SCR) methods have emerged as a promising area of research due to their potential for accurate visual localization. However, many existing SCR approaches train on samples from all image regions, including dynamic objects and texture-less areas. Utilizing these areas for optimization during training can potentially hamper the overall performance and efficiency of the model. In this study, we first perform an in-depth analysis to validate the adverse impacts of these areas. Drawing inspiration from our analysis, we then introduce an error-guided feature selection (EGFS) mechanism, in tandem with the use of the Segment Anything Model (SAM) [?]. This mechanism seeds low reprojection areas as prompts and expands them into error-guided masks, and then utilizes these masks to sample points and filter out problematic areas in an iterative manner. The experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing SCR approaches that do not rely on 3D information on the Cambridge Landmarks and Indoor6 datasets.

title: Tingbing Yan, Wenzheng Zeng*, Yang Xiao*, Xingyu Tong, Bo Tan, Zhiwen Fang, Zhiguo Cao, Joey Tianyi Zhou
title_en: Tingbing Yan, Wenzheng Zeng*, Yang Xiao*, Xingyu Tong, Bo Tan, Zhiwen Fang, Zhiguo Cao, Joey Tianyi Zhou
abstract: 现有大多数基于骨架的单次动作识别方法主要关注原始低级信息(如关节位置),可能面临局部信息丢失和泛化能力不足的问题。为缓解这些问题,我们提出利用大语言模型(LLM)生成的文本描述,这些文本包含高级人类知识,以全局-局部-全局的方式引导特征学习。具体而言,在训练过程中,我们设计了2个提示,从LLM中获取每个动作的全局和局部文本描述。我们首先利用全局文本描述引导骨架编码器关注信息性关节(全局到局部)。随后,我们构建局部文本与关节特征之间的非局部交互,形成最终的全局表示(局部到全局)。为进一步缓解训练阶段与推理阶段之间的不对称性问题,我们进一步设计了双分支架构,使模型能够在无任何文本输入的情况下进行新类别推理,同时相比基础骨架编码器,额外的推理成本可以忽略不计。在三个不同基准上的大量实验表明,CrossGLG在现有SOTA方法的基础上取得了显著优势,且推理成本(模型大小)仅为之前SOTA的2.8%。代码可在[RGB]255,106,106CrossGLG获取。† Yang Xiao和Wenzheng Zeng为通讯作者。
abstract_en: Most existing one-shot skeleton-based action recognition focuses on raw low-level information (, joint location), and may suffer from local information loss and low generalization ability. To alleviate these, we propose to leverage text description generated from large language models (LLM) that contain high-level human knowledge, to guide feature learning, in a global-local-global way. Particularly, during training, we design 2 prompts to gain global and local text descriptions of each action from an LLM. We first utilize the global text description to guide the skeleton encoder focus on informative joints (,global-to-local). Then we build non-local interaction between local text and joint features, to form the final global representation (, local-to-global). To mitigate the asymmetry issue between the training and inference phases, we further design a dual-branch architecture that allows the model to perform novel class inference without any text input, also making the additional inference cost neglectable compared with the base skeleton encoder. Extensive experiments on three different benchmarks show that CrossGLG consistently outperforms the existing SOTA methods with large margins, and the inference cost (model size) is only 2.8% than the previous SOTA. Code is available at [RGB]255,106,106CrossGLG. † Yang Xiao and Wenzheng Zeng are corresponding authors.

title: Tingle Li*, Renhao Wang, Po-Yao Huang, Andrew Owens, Gopala Krishna Anumanchipalli
title_en: Tingle Li*, Renhao Wang, Po-Yao Huang, Andrew Owens, Gopala Krishna Anumanchipalli
abstract: 语音声音传达了大量关于场景的信息,从而产生从混响到附加环境声音等多种效果。在本文中,我们通过给定一个从目标场景录制的音频-视觉条件示例,对输入语音进行处理,使其听起来仿佛是在不同场景中录制的。我们的模型通过自监督学习进行训练,利用自然视频中重复出现的声音事件和纹理这一特性。我们从视频中提取一段音频并进行语音增强,然后使用视频中其他位置获取的另一段音频-视觉片段作为条件提示,训练潜在扩散模型以恢复原始语音。通过这一过程,模型学习将条件示例的声音特性转移到输入语音中。我们证明了该模型可以使用未标记的野外视频成功训练,并且额外的视觉信号可以提升其声音预测能力。
abstract_en: Speech sounds convey a great deal of information about the scenes, resulting in a variety of effects ranging from reverberation to additional ambient sounds. In this paper, we manipulate input speech to sound as though it was recorded within a different scene, given an audio-visual conditional example recorded from that scene. Our model learns through self-supervision, taking advantage of the fact that natural video contains recurring sound events and textures. We extract an audio clip from a video and apply speech enhancement. We then train a latent diffusion model to recover the original speech, using another audio-visual clip taken from elsewhere in the video as a conditional hint. Through this process, the model learns to transfer the conditional example’s sound properties to the input speech. We show that our model can be successfully trained using unlabeled, in-the-wild videos, and that an additional visual signal can improve its sound prediction abilities.

title: Tingting Chen*, Beibei Lin, Yeying Jin, Wending Yan, WEI YE, Yuan Yuan, Robby T. Tan
title_en: Tingting Chen*, Beibei Lin, Yeying Jin, Wending Yan, WEI YE, Yuan Yuan, Robby T. Tan
abstract: 现有的视频去雨方法在处理雨滴积累和雨痕时,由于缺乏清晰的地面真实数据,依赖合成数据进行训练。因此,由于领域差距,它们难以处理真实世界中的雨视频。在本文中,我们提出了Dual-Rain,一种新颖的视频去雨方法,采用双教师过程。我们的创新点在于双教师框架,包含一个积极教师和一个温和教师。新颖的双教师框架通过从真实雨视频中学习,无需地面真实数据即可去除雨痕和雨滴积累。积极教师的基本思想是快速从学生中积累知识,加速去雨能力。温和教师的核心思想是缓慢积累知识,防止因积极教师导致的像素强度过度抑制。从两个教师的学习预测使学生能够有效学习较不具挑战性的区域,并逐步处理真实世界雨视频中更具挑战性的区域,而无需对应的真实数据。一旦从双教师获得高置信度的无雨区域,我们便增强其对应输入以生成更具挑战性的输入。然后,学生在这些输入上进行训练,以迭代处理更具挑战性的区域。大量实验表明,我们的方法在合成和真实世界视频上均实现了最先进的性能,定量和定性上均优于现有最先进的方法,在SynHeavyRain数据集上PSNR优于现有方法11%。
abstract_en: Existing video deraining methods addressing both rain accumulation and rain streaks rely on synthetic data for training as clear ground-truths are unavailable. Hence, they struggle to handle real-world rain videos due to domain gaps. In this paper, we present Dual-Rain, a novel video deraining method with a two-teacher process. Our novelty lies in our two-teacher framework, featuring an assertive and a gentle teacher. The novel two-teacher removes rain streaks and rain accumulation by learning from real rainy videos without the need for ground-truths. The basic idea of our assertive teacher is to rapidly accumulate knowledge from our student, accelerating deraining capabilities. The key idea of our gentle teacher is to slowly gather knowledge, preventing over-suppression of pixel intensity caused by the assertive teacher. Learning the predictions from both teachers allows the student to effectively learn from less challenging regions and gradually address more challenging regions in real-world rain videos, without requiring their corresponding ground-truths. Once high-confidence rain-free regions from our two-teacher are obtained, we augment their corresponding inputs to generate challenging inputs. Our student is then trained on these inputs to iteratively address more challenging regions. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic and real-world videos quantitatively and qualitatively, outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods by 11% of PSNR on the SynHeavyRain dataset.

title: Tingyu Qu*, Tinne Tuytelaars, Marie-Francine Moens
title_en: Tingyu Qu*, Tinne Tuytelaars, Marie-Francine Moens
abstract: 主流的参数高效微调(PEFT)方法,如LoRA或Adapter,通过将模型的隐藏状态投影到较低维度,使预训练模型能够通过这种低秩瓶颈适应新数据。然而,涉及多模态的PEFT任务(如视觉-语言(VL)任务),不仅需要适应新数据,还需要学习不同模态之间的关系。针对VL PEFT任务,我们提出了一类称为路由函数的操作,以增强低秩瓶颈中的VL对齐。这些特征路由函数采用线性操作,且不引入新的可训练参数。通过深入分析研究其行为。在各种VL PEFT设置中,路由函数显著提升了原始PEFT方法的性能,在VQAv2(RoBERTa-large + ViT-L/16)上实现超过20%的提升,在COCO Captioning(GPT2-medium+ViT-L/16)上实现30%的提升。此外,在微调预训练的多模态模型(如CLIP-BART)时,我们在一系列VL PEFT任务中观察到较小但一致的性能提升。我们的代码可在https://github.com/tingyu215/Routing_VLPEFT获取。
abstract_en: Mainstream parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, such as LoRA or Adapter, project a model’s hidden states to a lower dimension, allowing pre-trained models to adapt to new data through this low-rank bottleneck. However, PEFT tasks involving multiple modalities, like vision-language (VL) tasks, require not only adaptation to new data but also learning the relationship between different modalities. Targeting at VL PEFT tasks, we propose a family of operations, called routing functions, to enhance VL alignment in the low-rank bottlenecks. These feature routing functions adopt linear operations and do not introduce new trainable parameters. In-depth analyses are conducted to study their behavior. In various VL PEFT settings, the routing functions significantly improve performance of the original PEFT methods, achieving over 20% improvement on VQAv2 (RoBERT alarge +ViT-L/16) and 30% on COCO Captioning (GPT2-medium+ViT-L/16). Also when fine-tuning a pre-trained multimodal model such as CLIP-BART, we observe smaller but consistent improvements across a range of VL PEFT tasks. Our code is available at https://github. com/tingyu215/Routing_VLPEFT.

title: Toan D. Gian, Tien Dac Lai, Thien Van Luong, Kok-Seng Wong, Van-Dinh Nguyen*
title_en: Toan D. Gian, Tien Dac Lai, Thien Van Luong, Kok-Seng Wong, Van-Dinh Nguyen*
abstract: 基于WiFi的人体姿态估计(HPE)作为传统视觉技术的替代方案逐渐兴起,但其高昂的计算成本限制了广泛应用。本文提出了一种新颖的HPE-Li方法,利用多模态传感器(如摄像头和WiFi)生成准确的HPE三维骨骼。随后,我们开发了一种高效的深度神经网络处理原始WiFi信号。模型采用独特的多分支卷积神经网络(CNN),并结合选择性核注意力(SKA)机制。与具有固定感受野的标准CNN不同,SKA机制可根据输入数据特征动态调整核尺寸,在不增加复杂度的前提下提升适应性。在两个MM-Fi和WiPose数据集上的大量实验验证了本方法相较于现有技术的优越性,同时确保计算开销最小,使其高度适用于大规模场景。
abstract_en: WiFi-based human pose estimation (HPE) has emerged as a promising alternative to conventional vision-based techniques, yet faces the high computational cost hindering its widespread adoption. This paper introduces a novel HPE-Li approach that harnesses multi-modal sensors (e.g. camera and WiFi) to generate accurate 3D skeletal in HPE. We then develop an efficient deep neural network to process raw WiFi signals. Our model incorporates a distinctive multi-branch convolutional neural network (CNN) empowered by a selective kernel attention (SKA) mechanism. Unlike standard CNNs with fixed receptive fields, the SKA mechanism is capable of dynamically adjusting kernel sizes according to input data characteristics, enhancing adaptability without increasing complexity. Extensive experiments conducted on two MM-Fi and WiPose datasets underscore the superiority of our method over state-of-the-art approaches, while ensuring minimal computational overhead, rendering it highly suitable for large-scale scenarios.

title: Toan Nguyen, Minh Nhat Nhat Vu, Baoru Huang, An Dinh Vuong, Quan Vuong, Ngan Le, Thieu Vo, Anh Nguyen*
title_en: Toan Nguyen, Minh Nhat Nhat Vu, Baoru Huang, An Dinh Vuong, Quan Vuong, Ngan Le, Thieu Vo, Anh Nguyen*
abstract: 六自由度抓取检测一直是机器人视觉中的基础且具有挑战性的问题。尽管先前的研究主要关注确保抓取稳定性,但通常未考虑通过自然语言传达的人类意图,这阻碍了机器人与用户在复杂三维环境中的有效协作。在本文中,我们提出了一种新的方法,用于杂乱点云中的语言驱动六自由度抓取检测。我们首先引入Grasp-Anything-6D,这是一个大规模数据集,包含100万场景点云和超过20亿个与语言相关的三维抓取姿态,用于语言驱动的六自由度抓取检测任务。我们进一步引入了一种新型扩散模型,该模型结合了一种新的负提示引导学习策略。所提出的负提示策略根据语言输入引导检测过程,使机器人能够专注于目标物体并避开不需要的物体。我们的方法实现了一个端到端框架,使人类能够通过自然语言指挥机器人在杂乱场景中抓取所需物体。大量实验结果表明,我们的方法在基准测试和现实世界场景中均有效,超越了其他基线方法。此外,我们展示了该方法在现实世界机器人应用中的实用性。我们的项目可在https://airvlab.github.io/grasp-anything/获取。
abstract_en: 6-DoF grasp detection has been a fundamental and challenging problem in robotic vision. While previous works have focused on ensuring grasp stability, they often do not consider human intention conveyed through natural language, hindering effective collaboration between robots and users in complex 3D environments. In this paper, we present a new approach for language-driven 6-DoF grasp detection in cluttered point clouds. We first introduce Grasp-Anything-6D, a large-scale dataset for the language-driven 6-DoF grasp detection task with 1M point cloud scenes and more than 200M language-associated 3D grasp poses. We further introduce a novel diffusion model that incorporates a new negative prompt guidance learning strategy. The proposed negative prompt strategy directs the detection process toward the desired object while steering away from unwanted ones given the language input. Our method enables an end-to-end framework where humans can command the robot to grasp desired objects in a cluttered scene using natural language. Intensive experimental results show the effectiveness of our method in both benchmarking experiments and real-world scenarios, surpassing other baselines. In addition, we demonstrate the practicality of our approach in real-world robotic applications. Our project is available at https://airvlab.github.io/grasp-anything/

title: Tom Bekor*, Niv Nayman, Lihi Zelnik-Manor
title_en: Tom Bekor*, Niv Nayman, Lihi Zelnik-Manor
abstract: 数据增强已成为深度学习的重要组成部分,因为它被证明可以提升神经网络的泛化能力。由于不同任务和领域中最有效的图像变换集合存在差异,自动数据增强搜索旨在减轻手动寻找最优图像变换的极端负担。然而,当前方法无法同时优化所有自由度:(1)应用的变换数量,(2)变换类型,(3)变换顺序,以及(4)变换幅度。许多现有方法可能重复选择相同的变换,仅限于搜索两个变换,或以短视的方式穷举或迭代搜索变换数量。我们的方法__TITLE_MATH_1__是首个通过完全可微分方法同时实现所有四个自由度的全局优化。它高效地学习变换数量,并在变换排列上学习概率分布,从而在采样过程中固有地避免冗余重复。实验表明,所有自由度的联合学习显著提升了性能,在各种自然图像基准测试及其他领域均取得了最先进的结果。1 1 项目页面:https://tombekor.github.io/FreeAugment-web
