abstract_en: Data augmentation has become an integral part of deep learning, as it is known to improve the generalization capabilities of neural networks. Since the most effective set of image transformations differs between tasks and domains, automatic data augmentation search aims to alleviate the extreme burden of manually finding the optimal image transformations. However, current methods are not able to jointly optimize all degrees of freedom: (1) the number of transformations to be applied, their (2) types, (3) order, and (4) magnitudes. Many existing methods risk picking the same transformation more than once, limit the search to two transformations only, or search for the number of transformations exhaustively or iteratively in a myopic manner. Our approach, , is the first to achieve global optimization of all four degrees of freedom simultaneously, using a fully differentiable method. It efficiently learns the number of transformations and a probability distribution over their permutations, inherently refraining from redundant repetition while sampling. Our experiments demonstrate that this joint learning of all degrees of freedom significantly improves performance, achieving state-of-the-art results on various natural image benchmarks and beyond across other domains.1 1 Project page: https://tombekor.github.io/FreeAugment-web

title: Tom Fischer*, Yaoyao Liu, Artur Jesslen, Noor Ahmed, Prakhar Kaushik, Angtian Wang, Alan Yuille, Adam Kortylewski, Eddy Ilg
title_en: Tom Fischer*, Yaoyao Liu, Artur Jesslen, Noor Ahmed, Prakhar Kaushik, Angtian Wang, Alan Yuille, Adam Kortylewski, Eddy Ilg
abstract: 与人类特性不同,目前视觉任务仍普遍采用仅在固定数据集上初始训练深度学习模型的做法。近年来,已有多种方法针对处理持续数据流进行了研究。然而,将这些方法扩展到管理分布外(OOD)场景的有效性尚未被充分探讨。另一方面,最近研究表明,非持续神经网格模型在泛化到此类OOD场景中表现出色。为了在持续学习场景中利用这一关键特性,我们提出了一种增量神经网格模型,该模型可随时间扩展新网格。此外,我们提出了一种潜在空间初始化策略,使我们能够提前为未来未见类别分配特征空间,并引入一种位置正则化项,强制不同类别的特征持续保持在各自的潜在空间区域。通过在Pascal3D和ObjectNet3D数据集上的大量实验,我们验证了方法的有效性,并表明在领域内分类任务中,我们的方法比基线提升2−6%,在OOD设置中提升6−50%。我们的工作还提出了姿态估计领域的首个增量学习方法。代码和模型可在github.com/Fischer-Tom/iNeMo获取。
abstract_en: Different from human nature, it is still common practice today for vision tasks to train deep learning models only initially and on fixed datasets. A variety of approaches have recently addressed handling continual data streams. However, extending these methods to manage out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios has not effectively been investigated. On the other hand, it has recently been shown that non-continual neural mesh models exhibit strong performance in generalizing to such OOD scenarios. To leverage this decisive property in a continual learning setting, we propose incremental neural mesh models that can be extended with new meshes over time. In addition, we present a latent space initialization strategy that enables us to allocate feature space for future unseen classes in advance and a positional regularization term that forces the features of the different classes to consistently stay in respective latent space regions. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method through extensive experiments on the Pascal3D and ObjectNet3D datasets and show that our approach outperforms the baselines for classification by 2 − 6% in the in-domain and by 6−50% in the OOD setting. Our work also presents the first incremental learning approach for pose estimation. Our code and model can be found at github.com/Fischer-Tom/iNeMo.

title: Tomas Vojir*, Jan Sochman, Jiri Matas
title_en: Tomas Vojir*, Jan Sochman, Jiri Matas
abstract: 我们提出了一种像素级分布外检测算法,称为__TITLE_MATH_1__,该算法无需在异常数据样本上进行训练,且不针对特定应用场景,从而避免了传统训练偏差。为在像素级别建模分布内数据的类内复杂变化,我们提出了一种在线数据凝结算法,其鲁棒性优于标准K-means,并可通过SGD轻松训练。我们在广泛的问题集上进行了评估,该算法在七个数据集中的四个上达到了最先进水平,在其余数据集上也具有竞争力。源代码可在https://github.com/vojirt/PixOOD获取。
abstract_en: We propose a pixel-level out-of-distribution detection algorithm, called , which does not require training on samples of anomalous data and is not designed for a specific application which avoids traditional training biases. In order to model the complex intra-class variability of the in-distribution data at the pixel level, we propose an online data condensation algorithm which is more robust than standard K-means and is easily trainable through SGD. We evaluate on a wide range of problems. It achieved state-of-the-art results on four out of seven datasets, while being competitive on the rest. The source code is available at https://github.com/vojirt/PixOOD.

title: Tomoyuki Suzuki*, Kotaro Kikuchi, Kota Yamaguchi
title_en: Tomoyuki Suzuki*, Kotaro Kikuchi, Kota Yamaguchi
abstract: 本文提出了一种将动画图形分解为精灵图(一组基本元素或图层)的方法。我们的方法基于优化精灵参数以适配光栅视频。为提高效率,我们假设精灵使用静态纹理以减少搜索空间,同时通过纹理先验模型防止出现伪影。为进一步加速优化过程,我们引入了利用预训练视频对象分割模型和用户单帧标注输入的精灵参数初始化方法。在本研究中,我们从在线设计服务中构建了Crello Animation数据集,并定义了定量指标以评估提取精灵的质量。实验表明,我们的方法在质量/效率权衡方面显著优于类似分解任务的基线方法。
abstract_en: This paper presents an approach to decomposing animated graphics into sprites, a set of basic elements or layers. Our approach builds on the optimization of sprite parameters to fit the raster video. For efficiency, we assume static textures for sprites to reduce the search space while preventing artifacts using a texture prior model. To further speed up the optimization, we introduce the initialization of the sprite parameters utilizing a pre-trained video object segmentation model and user input of single frame annotations. For our study, we construct the Crello Animation dataset from an online design service and define quantitative metrics to measure the quality of the extracted sprites. Experiments show that our method significantly outperforms baselines for similar decomposition tasks in terms of the quality/efficiency tradeoff.

title: Tomáš Chobola*, Yu Liu, Hanyi Zhang, Julia A Schnabel, Tingying Peng*
title_en: Tomáš Chobola*, Yu Liu, Hanyi Zhang, Julia A Schnabel, Tingying Peng*
abstract: 当前基于深度学习的低光照图像增强方法在处理高分辨率图像时往往存在困难,难以满足在多样且未见过的场景中视觉感知的实际需求。本文提出了一种名为CoLIE的新方法,通过将欠曝光图像的2D坐标映射到其光照成分,并基于局部上下文进行重新定义,从而重新定义增强过程。我们提出在HSV空间中利用隐式神经函数结合嵌入式引导滤波器对增强光照图像进行重建,从而显著降低计算开销。此外,我们引入了一种基于单图像的训练损失函数,以增强模型对各种场景的适应性,进一步提升其实用性。通过严格的评估,我们分析了所提出框架的特性,证明其在图像质量和场景适应性方面均具有优势。此外,我们的评估还扩展到低光照场景下的下游任务应用,突显了CoLIE的实用价值。源代码可在https://github.com/ctom2/colie获取。
abstract_en: Current deep learning-based low-light image enhancement methods often struggle with high-resolution images, and fail to meet the practical demands of visual perception across diverse and unseen scenarios. In this paper, we introduce a novel approach termed CoLIE, which redefines the enhancement process through mapping the 2D coordinates of an underexposed image to its illumination component, conditioned on local context. We propose a reconstruction of enhanced-light images within the HSV space utilizing an implicit neural function combined with an embedded guided filter, thereby significantly reducing computational overhead. Moreover, we introduce a single image-based training loss function to enhance the model’s adaptability to various scenes, further enhancing its practical applicability. Through rigorous evaluations, we analyze the properties of our proposed framework, demonstrating its superiority in both image quality and scene adaptability. Furthermore, our evaluation extends to applications in downstream tasks within low-light scenarios, underscoring the practical utility of CoLIE. The source code is available at https://github.com/ctom2/colie.

title: Tong Shao, Zhuotao Tian*, Hang Zhao, Jingyong Su*
title_en: Tong Shao, Zhuotao Tian*, Hang Zhao, Jingyong Su*
abstract: CLIP作为一种视觉-语言模型,凭借其零样本能力显著推动了开放词汇语义分割(OVSS)的发展。尽管取得了成功,但其基于图像级对齐训练的初始设计在需要详细局部上下文的任务中仍面临挑战,影响了性能表现。本研究深入探讨了CLIP的[CLS]标记对补丁特征相关性的影响,揭示了"全局"补丁的主导地位阻碍了局部特征的区分能力。为解决这一问题,我们提出CLIPtrase,一种无需训练的语义分割策略,通过重新校准补丁间的自相关性增强局部特征感知能力。该方法在分割精度和跨物体语义连贯性保持方面均取得显著提升。实验表明,在9个分割基准测试中,我们的方法平均比CLIP高出22.3%,超越现有无需训练的最先进方法。代码已开源至https://github.com/leaves162/CLIPtrase
abstract_en: CLIP, as a vision-language model, has significantly advanced Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation (OVSS) with its zero-shot capabilities. Despite its success, its application to OVSS faces challenges due to its initial image-level alignment training, which affects its performance in tasks requiring detailed local context. Our study delves into the impact of CLIP’s [CLS] token on patch feature correlations, revealing a dominance of ”global” patches that hinders local feature discrimination. To overcome this, we propose CLIPtrase, a novel training-free semantic segmentation strategy that enhances local feature awareness through recalibrated self-correlation among patches. This approach demonstrates notable improvements in segmentation accuracy and the ability to maintain semantic coherence across objects. Experiments show that we are 22.3% ahead of CLIP on average on 9 segmentation benchmarks, outperforming existing state-of-the-art training-free methods. The code are made publicly available at https://github.com/leaves162/CLIPtrase

title: Tongkai Shi, Lianyu Hu, Fanhua Shang, Jichao Feng, 刘佩东, Wei Feng*
title_en: Tongkai Shi, Lianyu Hu, Fanhua Shang, Jichao Feng, liu peidong, Wei Feng*
abstract: 手语视频是传播和学习手语的重要媒介。然而,现有大多数人体图像合成方法生成的手语图像细节存在扭曲、模糊或结构错误等问题,生成的手语视频帧在时间一致性方面表现较差,存在前帧与后帧之间闪烁、细节突变等异常现象。为解决上述局限性,我们提出了一种新型的姿态引导运动模型(Pose-Guided Motion Model, PGMM),用于生成细节丰富且运动一致的手语视频。首先,我们提出了一种新的粗粒度运动模块(Coarse Motion Module, CMM),通过光流变形完成特征变形,从而在不改变外观的前提下传递粗粒度结构的运动;其次,我们提出了一种新的姿态融合模块(Pose Fusion Module, PFM),通过引导RGB特征与姿态特征的模态融合,完成细节生成。最后,我们设计了一种新的度量指标——时间一致性差异(Temporal Consistency Difference, TCD),通过比较重建视频帧与目标视频前后帧的差异,定量评估视频的时间一致性程度。大量定性与定量实验表明,我们的方法在多数基准测试中优于现有最先进方法,在细节表现和时间一致性方面均有显著提升。
abstract_en: Sign language videos are an important medium for spreading and learning sign language. However, most existing human image synthesis methods produce sign language images with details that are distorted, blurred, or structurally incorrect. They also produce sign language video frames with poor temporal consistency, with anomalies such as flickering and abrupt detail changes between the previous and next frames. To address these limitations, we propose a novel Pose-Guided Motion Model (PGMM) for generating fine-grained and motion-consistent sign language videos. Firstly, we propose a new Coarse Motion Module (CMM), which completes the deformation of features by optical flow warping, thus transfering the motion of coarse-grained structures without changing the appearance; Secondly, we propose a new Pose Fusion Module (PFM), which guides the modal fusion of RGB and pose features, thus completing the fine-grained generation. Finally, we design a new metric, Temporal Consistency Difference (TCD) to quantitatively assess the degree of temporal consistency of a video by comparing the difference between the frames of the reconstructed video and the previous and next frames of the target video. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods in most benchmark tests, with visible improvements in details and temporal consistency.

title: Tongkun Guan, Chengyu Lin, Wei Shen*, Xiaokang Yang
title_en: Tongkun Guan, Chengyu Lin, Wei Shen*, Xiaokang Yang
abstract: 手写数学表达式识别(HMER)在人机交互场景中具有广泛应用,如数字化教育和自动化办公。近年来,基于序列的模型结合编码器-解码器架构被广泛采用,通过直接预测表达式图像的LaTeX序列来解决这一任务。然而,这些方法仅隐式学习LaTeX提供的语法规则,可能因复杂的结构关系和多样的手写风格而无法准确描述符号间的相对位置和层次关系。为克服这一挑战,我们提出了一种位置森林变压器(PosFormer)用于HMER,该模型联合优化表达式识别和位置识别两个任务,以显式实现位置感知的符号特征表示学习。具体而言,我们首先设计了一种位置森林,将数学表达式建模为森林结构,并解析符号间的相对位置关系。无需额外标注,每个符号在森林中被赋予位置标识符以表示其相对空间位置。其次,我们提出了一种隐式注意力校正模块,以在基于序列的解码器架构中准确捕捉HMER的注意力。大量实验验证了PosFormer的优越性,在单行CROHME 2014/2016/2019、多行M2 E和复杂MNE数据集上分别实现了2.03%/1.22%/2.00%、1.83%和4.62%的性能提升,且无额外延迟或计算成本。
abstract_en: Handwritten Mathematical Expression Recognition (HMER) has wide applications in human-machine interaction scenarios, such as digitized education and automated offices. Recently, sequence-based models with encoder-decoder architectures have been commonly adopted to address this task by directly predicting LaTeX sequences of expression images. However, these methods only implicitly learn the syntax rules provided by LaTeX, which may fail to describe the position and hierarchical relationship between symbols due to complex structural relations and diverse handwriting styles. To overcome this challenge, we propose a position forest transformer (PosFormer) for HMER, which jointly optimizes two tasks: expression recognition and position recognition, to explicitly enable position-aware symbol feature representation learning. Specifically, we first design a position forest that models the mathematical expression as a forest structure and parses the relative position relationships between symbols. Without requiring extra annotations, each symbol is assigned a position identifier in the forest to denote its relative spatial position. Second, we propose an implicit attention correction module to accurately capture attention for HMER in the sequence-based decoder architecture. Extensive experiments validate the superiority of PosFormer, which consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art methods 2.03%/1.22%/2.00%, 1.83%, and 4.62% gains on the single-line CROHME 2014/2016/2019, multi-line M2 E, and complex MNE datasets, respectively, with no additional latency or computational cost.

title: Tongkun Guan, Wei Shen*, Xue Yang, Xuehui Wang, Xiaokang Yang
title_en: Tongkun Guan, Wei Shen*, Xue Yang, Xuehui Wang, Xiaokang Yang
abstract: 现有场景文本检测方法通常依赖大量真实数据进行训练。由于缺乏标注的真实图像,近期工作尝试利用大规模标注的合成数据(LSD)进行文本检测器的预训练。然而,合成到真实领域的差距进一步限制了文本检测器的性能。不同地,本文提出FreeReal,一种与真实领域对齐的预训练范式,能够充分发挥LSD和未标注真实数据(URD)的互补优势。具体而言,为弥合预训练中的真实与合成世界,设计了一种基于字形的混合机制(GlyphMix),专门用于文本图像。GlyphMix解析合成图像的字符结构,并将其作为涂鸦样式的单元嵌入到真实图像中。无需引入真实领域漂移,GlyphMix可自由生成带有部分标注的真实世界图像,这些标注源自合成标签。此外,当给予自由的细粒度合成标签时,GlyphMix能有效弥合以英语为主的LSD与多语言URD之间的语言领域差距。无需复杂设计,FreeReal在提升FCENet、PSENet、PANet和DBNet方法性能方面分别实现了平均1.97%、3.90%、3.85%和4.56%的提升,在四个公开数据集上始终显著优于先前的预训练方法。代码将发布于https://github.com/SJTU-DeepVisionLab/FreeReal。
abstract_en: Existing scene text detection methods typically rely on extensive real data for training. Due to the lack of annotated real images, recent works have attempted to exploit large-scale labeled synthetic data (LSD) for pre-training text detectors. However, a synth-to-real domain gap emerges, further limiting the performance of text detectors. Differently, in this work, we propose FreeReal, a real-domain-aligned pre-training paradigm that enables the complementary strengths of both LSD and unlabeled real data (URD). Specifically, to bridge real and synthetic worlds for pre-training, a glyph-based mixing mechanism (GlyphMix) is tailored for text images. GlyphMix delineates the character structures of synthetic images and embeds them as graffiti-like units onto real images. Without introducing real domain drift, GlyphMix freely yields real-world images with partial annotations derived from synthetic labels. Furthermore, when given free fine-grained synthetic labels, GlyphMix can effectively bridge the linguistic domain gap stemming from English-dominated LSD to URD in various languages. Without bells and whistles, FreeReal achieves average gains of 1.97%, 3.90%, 3.85%, and 4.56% in improving the performance of FCENet, PSENet, PANet, and DBNet methods, respectively, consistently outperforming previous pre-training methods by a substantial margin across four public datasets. Code will be available at https://github.com/SJTU-DeepVisionLab/FreeReal.

title: Tran Huynh*, Anh Tran, Khoa Doan, Tung Pham
title_en: Tran Huynh*, Anh Tran, Khoa Doan, Tung Pham
abstract: 深度学习(DL)模型通常体积庞大且需要大量计算资源。因此,模型量化常被用于减小其体积和复杂度,使其更适合部署在边缘设备或实现实时性能。此前已证明,标准量化框架可以被利用以在DL模型中激活后门。这意味着攻击者可以创建一个被劫持的模型,该模型在外观上正常且无后门(即使经过最先进的防御检测),但当其被量化时,后门会被激活,攻击者便可控制模型的输出。现有的针对量化模型的后门攻击方法需要对目标模型有完全访问权限,这在实际中可能不成立。本文重点设计了一种基于数据中毒的新型量化后门,该方法无需任何目标模型的知识。关键组件是一个触发模式生成器,该生成器与替代模型以交替方式联合训练。攻击效果在多个基准数据集(包括CIFAR10、CelebA和ImageNet10)以及最先进的后门防御方法上进行了测试。
abstract_en: Deep learning (DL) models are often large and require a lot of computing power. Hence, model quantization is frequently used to reduce their size and complexity, making them more suitable for deployment on edge devices or achieving real-time performance. It has been previously shown that standard quantization frameworks can be exploited to activate the backdoor in a DL model. This means that an attacker could create a hijacked model that appears normal and free from backdoors (even when examined by state-of-the-art defenses), but when it is quantized, the backdoor is activated, and the attacker can control the model’s output. Existing backdoor attack methods on quantization models require full access to the victim model, which might not hold in practice. In this work, we focus on designing a novel quantization backdoor based on data poisoning, which requires zero knowledge of the target model. The key component is a trigger pattern generator, which is trained together with a surrogate model in an alternating manner. The attack’s effectiveness is tested on multiple benchmark datasets, including CIFAR10, CelebA, and ImageNet10, as well as state-of-the-art backdoor defenses.

title: Trinh Le Ba Khanh*, Huy-Hung Nguyen, Long Hoang Pham, Duong Nguyen-Ngoc Tran, Jae Wook Jeon*
title_en: Trinh Le Ba Khanh*, Huy-Hung Nguyen, Long Hoang Pham, Duong Nguyen-Ngoc Tran, Jae Wook Jeon*
abstract: 在目标检测领域,无监督域适应(UDA)旨在将带有标签的源域知识迁移到无标签的目标域。然而,UDA对带标签源数据的依赖限制了其在隐私相关场景中的适应性。本研究聚焦于无源目标检测(SFOD),即在不使用带标签源数据的情况下,将源训练的检测器适应到无标签的目标域。近期自训练方法,特别是均值教师(MT)框架,在SFOD部署中展现出前景。然而,缺乏源监督显著削弱了这些方法的稳定性。我们识别出两个主要问题:(1)由于学生模型不当更新导致教师模型的不可控退化,(2)学生模型倾向于复制错误伪标签的错误,导致陷入局部最优解。这两个因素共同形成有害的循环依赖关系,导致近期自训练框架性能迅速下降。为解决这些挑战,我们提出动态重训练-更新(DRU)机制,主动管理学生训练和教师更新过程以实现协同进化训练。此外,我们引入历史学生损失以减轻错误伪标签的影响。我们的方法在多个域适应基准测试中实现了SFOD设置的最先进性能,与甚至超越了先进的UDA方法。代码将在https://github.com/lbktrinh/DRU发布。
abstract_en: In object detection, unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) aims to transfer knowledge from a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain. However, UDA’s reliance on labeled source data restricts its adaptability in privacy-related scenarios. This study focuses on source-free object detection (SFOD), which adapts a source-trained detector to an unlabeled target domain without using labeled source data. Recent advancements in self-training, particularly with the Mean Teacher (MT) framework, show promise for SFOD deployment. However, the absence of source supervision significantly compromises the stability of these approaches. We identify two primary issues, (1) uncontrollable degradation of the teacher model due to inopportune updates from the student model, and (2) the student model’s tendency to replicate errors from incorrect pseudo labels, leading to it being trapped in a local optimum. Both factors contribute to a detrimental circular dependency, resulting in rapid performance degradation in recent self-training frameworks. To tackle these challenges, we propose the Dynamic Retraining-Updating (DRU) mechanism, which actively manages the student training and teacher updating processes to achieve co-evolutionary training. Additionally, we introduce Historical Student Loss to mitigate the influence of incorrect pseudo labels. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in the SFOD setting on multiple domain adaptation benchmarks, comparable to or even surpassing advanced UDA methods. The code will be released at https://github.com/lbktrinh/DRU.

title: Trung Tuan Dao*, Thuan Hoang Nguyen, Thanh Van Le, Duc H Vu, Khoi Nguyen, Cuong Pham, Anh T Tran*
title_en: Trung Tuan Dao*, Thuan Hoang Nguyen, Thanh Van Le, Duc H Vu, Khoi Nguyen, Cuong Pham, Anh T Tran*
abstract: 本文旨在提升SwiftBrush这一著名的单步文本到图像扩散模型的性能,使其能够与多步Stable Diffusion模型相竞争。首先,我们探讨了SwiftBrush与SD Turbo之间的质量与多样性权衡:前者在图像多样性方面表现优异,而后者在图像质量方面更胜一筹。这一观察促使我们提出了改进的训练方法,包括更优的权重初始化和高效的LoRA训练。此外,我们引入了一种新颖的钳制CLIP损失,提升了图像与文本的对齐度,从而提高了图像质量。值得注意的是,通过结合使用高效LoRA训练和完整训练模型的权重,我们实现了一种新的单步扩散模型,取得了FID值为8.14的最先进结果,超越了所有基于GAN的模型和多步Stable Diffusion模型。
abstract_en: In this paper, we aim to enhance the performance of SwiftBrush, a prominent one-step text-to-image diffusion model, to be competitive with its multi-step Stable Diffusion counterpart. Initially, we explore the quality-diversity trade-off between SwiftBrush and SD Turbo: the former excels in image diversity, while the latter excels in image quality. This observation motivates our proposed modifications in the training methodology, including better weight initialization and efficient LoRA training. Moreover, our introduction of a novel clamped CLIP loss enhances image-text alignment and results in improved image quality. Remarkably, by combining the weights of models trained with efficient LoRA and full training, we achieve a new state-of-the-art one-step diffusion model, achieving an FID of 8.14 and surpassing all GAN-based and multi-step Stable Diffusion models.

title: Tuo Feng, Wenguan Wang, Ruijie Quan, Yi Yang*
title_en: Tuo Feng, Wenguan Wang, Ruijie Quan, Yi Yang*
abstract: 当前3D自监督学习方法在3D场景中面临数据荒漠问题,这是由于3D场景数据收集过程耗时且昂贵所致。相反,3D形状数据集更容易收集。尽管如此,现有基于形状数据的预训练策略在3D场景理解方面潜力有限,这是由于形状与场景在点数量上存在显著差异。为解决这些挑战,我们提出Shape2Scene (S2S),一种新颖的方法,从3D形状数据中学习大规模3D场景的表示。我们首先为形状和场景级别的3D任务设计多尺度和高分辨率主干网络,即MH-P(基于点)和MH-V(基于体素)。MH-P/V建立了直接路径,以捕获多尺度下的深层语义信息。这种关键特性使其适用于广泛依赖高分辨率特征的3D下游任务。随后,我们采用形状到场景策略(S2SS),将不同形状的点进行融合,生成随机伪场景(包含多个物体)作为训练数据,缓解形状与场景之间的差异。最后,应用点-点对比损失(PPC)对MH-P/V进行预训练。在PPC中,S2SS自然获得内在对应关系(如点对)。大量实验表明,MH-P/V学习的3D表示在形状级和场景级3D任务中具有良好的迁移性。MH-P在知名点云数据集上取得显著性能(ScanObjectNN上OA为93.8%,ShapeNetPart上实例mIoU为87.6%)。MH-V在3D语义分割和3D目标检测中也表现出良好的性能。
abstract_en: Current 3D self-supervised learning methods of 3D scenes face a data desert issue, resulting from the time-consuming and expensive collecting process of 3D scene data. Conversely, 3D shape datasets are easier to collect. Despite this, existing pre-training strategies on shape data offer limited potential for 3D scene understanding due to significant disparities in point quantities. To tackle these challenges, we propose Shape2Scene (S2S), a novel method that learns representations of large-scale 3D scenes from 3D shape data. We first design multi-scale and high-resolution backbones for shape and scene level 3D tasks, , MH-P (point-based) and MH-V (voxel-based). MH-P/V establishes direct paths to high-resolution features that capture deep semantic information across multiple scales. This pivotal nature makes them suitable for a wide range of 3D downstream tasks that tightly rely on high-resolution features. We then employ a Shape-to-Scene strategy (S2SS) to amalgamate points from various shapes, creating a random pseudo scene (comprising multiple objects) for training data, mitigating disparities between shapes and scenes. Finally, a point-point contrastive loss (PPC) is applied for the pre-training of MH-P/V. In PPC, the inherent correspondence (, point pairs) is naturally obtained in S2SS. Extensive experiments have demonstrated the transferability of 3D representations learned by MH-P/V across shape-level and scene-level 3D tasks. MH-P achieves notable performance on well-known point cloud datasets (93.8% OA on ScanObjectNN and 87.6% instance mIoU on ShapeNetPart). MH-V also achieves promising performance in 3D semantic segmentation and 3D object detection.

title: Uday Kamal*, Saibal Mukhopadhyay
title_en: Uday Kamal*, Saibal Mukhopadhyay
abstract: 利用基于事件相机的高时间分辨率需要高效的逐事件处理。然而,密集预测任务需要显式的像素级关联,这对基于事件的处理框架具有挑战性。现有方法将事件聚合为静态帧状表示,但代价是处理速率显著降低且计算成本高昂。为解决这一挑战,本文提出了一种基于事件的时空表示学习框架,以高效解决密集预测任务。我们采用无结构的集合方法处理稀疏、异步事件,并将其投影到分层组织的多级潜在记忆空间中,以保留像素级结构。通过显式的注意力机制空间关联,低级事件流被动态编码到这些潜在结构中。与现有方法在固定速率下更新记忆堆栈不同,我们引入了数据自适应更新速率,通过周期性跟踪过去记忆状态,仅在获取到大量新信息时更新对应记忆堆栈,从而降低整体计算延迟。我们的方法在不同基于事件的密集预测任务中均取得具有竞争力的性能,同时相比现有方法具有显著更低的延迟。
abstract_en: Leveraging the high temporal resolution of an event-based camera requires highly efficient event-by-event processing. However, dense prediction tasks require explicit pixel-level association, which is challenging for event-based processing frameworks. Existing works aggregate the events into a static frame-like representation at the cost of a much slower processing rate and high compute cost. To address this challenge, this work introduces an event-based spatiotemporal representation learning framework for efficiently solving dense prediction tasks. We uniquely handle the sparse, asynchronous events using an unstructured, set-based approach and project them into a hierarchically organized multi-level latent memory space that preserves the pixel-level structure. Low-level event streams are dynamically encoded into these latent structures through an explicit attention-based spatial association. Unlike existing works that update these memory stacks at a fixed rate, we introduce a data-adaptive update rate that recurrently keeps track of the past memory states and learns to update the corresponding memory stacks only when it has substantial new information, thereby improving the overall compute latency. Our method consistently achieves competitive performance across different event-based dense prediction tasks while ensuring much lower latency compared to the existing methods.

title: Umar Khalid*, Hasan Iqbal*, Azib Farooq, Jing Hua, Chen Chen*
title_en: Umar Khalid*, Hasan Iqbal*, Azib Farooq, Jing Hua, Chen Chen*
abstract: 我们提出3DEgo来解决一个新颖的问题:直接从单目视频中合成逼真的三维场景,并通过文本提示进行引导。传统方法通过三阶段流程构建文本条件的三维场景,包括使用基于运动结构(SfM)的库(如COLMAP)进行姿态估计、用未编辑图像初始化三维模型,以及通过迭代更新编辑后的图像数据集以实现具有文本保真度的三维场景。我们的框架通过克服对COLMAP的依赖并消除模型初始化成本,将传统多阶段三维编辑流程简化为单阶段工作流。我们应用扩散模型在创建三维场景前编辑视频帧,通过我们设计的噪声混合模块增强多视角编辑一致性,这一步骤无需额外训练或微调文本到图像(T2I)扩散模型。3DEgo利用三维高斯泼溅技术,从多视角一致的编辑帧中生成三维场景,充分利用了其固有的时间连续性和显式点云数据。在六个数据集(包括我们自行准备的GS25数据集)上的广泛评估验证了3DEgo在编辑精度、速度和适应性方面的卓越表现。项目页面:https: //3dego.github.io/
abstract_en: We introduce 3DEgo to address a novel problem of directly synthesizing photorealistic 3D scenes from monocular videos guided by textual prompts. Conventional methods construct a text-conditioned 3D scene through a three-stage process, involving pose estimation using Structure-from-Motion (SfM) libraries like COLMAP, initializing the 3D model with unedited images, and iteratively updating the dataset with edited images to achieve a 3D scene with text fidelity. Our framework streamlines the conventional multi-stage 3D editing process into a single-stage workflow by overcoming the reliance on COLMAP and eliminating the cost of model initialization. We apply a diffusion model to edit video frames prior to 3D scene creation by incorporating our designed noise blender module for enhancing multi-view editing consistency, a step that does not require additional training or fine-tuning of T2I diffusion models. 3DEgo utilizes 3D Gaussian Splatting to create 3D scenes from the multi-view consistent edited frames, capitalizing on the inherent temporal continuity and explicit point cloud data. 3DEgo demonstrates remarkable editing precision, speed, and adaptability across a variety of video sources, as validated by extensive evaluations on six datasets, including our own prepared GS25 dataset. Project Page: https: //3dego.github.io/

title: Umar Khalid*, Hasan Iqbal, Muhammad Tayyab, Md Nazmul Karim, Jing Hua, Chen Chen
title_en: Umar Khalid*, Hasan Iqbal, Muhammad Tayyab, Md Nazmul Karim, Jing Hua, Chen Chen
abstract: 尽管神经场在视图合成和场景重建方面取得了显著进展,但因其对多视角输入的几何和纹理信息进行隐式编码,对其进行编辑仍面临巨大挑战。本文提出LatentEditor,一种创新框架,使用户能够通过文本提示实现对神经场的精确且局部可控的编辑。利用去噪扩散模型,我们将真实场景嵌入潜在空间,相较于传统方法,获得了更快速且更灵活的NeRF编辑主干网络。为提升编辑精度,我们引入delta分数计算潜在空间中的2D掩码,作为局部修改的指导,同时保留无关区域。我们的新型像素级评分方法借助InstructPix2Pix(IP2P)的力量,辨别潜在空间中IP2P条件与无条件噪声预测的差异。随后,基于2D掩码的编辑潜在特征在训练集中迭代更新,实现3D局部编辑。与现有3D编辑模型相比,我们的方法在编辑速度和输出质量上均更优,弥合了文本指令与高质量3D场景编辑在潜在空间之间的差距。我们在四个基准3D数据集LLFF [?]、IN2N [?]、NeRFStudio [?] 和 NeRF-Art [?] 上验证了方法的优越性。项目页面:https: //latenteditor.github.io/
abstract_en: While neural fields have made significant strides in view synthesis and scene reconstruction, editing them poses a formidable challenge due to their implicit encoding of geometry and texture information from multi-view inputs. In this paper, we introduce LatentEditor, an innovative framework designed to empower users with the ability to perform precise and locally controlled editing of neural fields using text prompts. Leveraging denoising diffusion models, we successfully embed real-world scenes into the latent space, resulting in a faster and more adaptable NeRF backbone for editing compared to traditional methods. To enhance editing precision, we introduce a delta score to calculate the 2D mask in the latent space that serves as a guide for local modifications while preserving irrelevant regions. Our novel pixel-level scoring approach harnesses the power of InstructPix2Pix (IP2P) to discern the disparity between IP2P conditional and unconditional noise predictions in the latent space. The edited latents conditioned on the 2D masks are then iteratively updated in the training set to achieve 3D local editing. Our approach achieves faster editing speeds and superior output quality compared to existing 3D editing models, bridging the gap between textual instructions and high-quality 3D scene editing in latent space. We show the superiority of our approach on four benchmark 3D datasets, LLFF [?], IN2N [?], NeRFStudio [?] and NeRF-Art [?]. Project Page: https: //latenteditor.github.io/

title: Uriel Singer*, Amit Zohar*, Yuval Kirstain, Shelly Sheynin, Adam Polyak, Devi Parikh, Yaniv Taigman
title_en: Uriel Singer*, Amit Zohar*, Yuval Kirstain, Shelly Sheynin, Adam Polyak, Devi Parikh, Yaniv Taigman
abstract: 我们引入了一个模型,该模型在无需依赖任何监督视频编辑数据的情况下,实现了视频编辑领域的最先进水平。为开发该模型,我们分别训练了一个图像编辑适配器和一个视频生成适配器,并将两者连接到同一个文本到图像模型。随后,为使适配器对齐至视频编辑任务,我们引入了一种新的无监督蒸馏过程。该过程能够同时从一个或多个教师模型中蒸馏知识,且无需任何监督数据。我们利用这一过程通过联合蒸馏知识来教授模型编辑视频:(i)精确编辑每帧图像,利用图像编辑适配器;(ii)通过视频生成适配器确保编辑后帧之间的时间一致性。最后,为展示该方法在解锁其他能力方面的潜力,我们对齐了额外的适配器组合。
abstract_en: We introduce , a model that establishes a new state-of-the art in video editing without relying on any supervised video editing data. To develop we separately train an image editing adapter and a video generation adapter, and attach both to the same text-to-image model. Then, to align the adapters towards video editing we introduce a new unsupervised distillation procedure, . This procedure distills knowledge from one or more teachers simultaneously, without any supervised data. We utilize this procedure to teach to edit videos by jointly distilling knowledge to (i) precisely edit each individual frame from the image editing adapter, and (ii) ensure temporal consistency among the edited frames using the video generation adapter. Finally, to demonstrate the potential of our approach in unlocking other capabilities, we align additional combinations of adapters.

title: Uy Dieu Tran*, Minh N. Hoang Luu*, Phong Ha Nguyen*, Khoi Nguyen*, Binh-Son Hua*
title_en: Uy Dieu Tran*, Minh N. Hoang Luu*, Phong Ha Nguyen*, Khoi Nguyen*, Binh-Son Hua*
abstract: 文本到3D合成近年来作为一种新的方法兴起,通过采用预训练的文本到图像模型作为引导的视觉先验来采样3D模型。现有文本到3D方法中存在一个引人注目但尚未充分探索的问题,即通过优化过程获得的3D模型往往出现模式崩溃,导致结果多样性不足。本文我们对这一有限多样性进行了分析,并识别了潜在原因,这促使我们设计了一种新方法,考虑从相同文本提示联合生成不同的3D模型。我们提出通过参考图像的文本反转增强文本提示,以多样化联合生成过程。我们证明了该方法在文本到3D合成中实现了定性和定量上的多样性提升。项目页面:https://diversedream.github.io/
abstract_en: Text-to-3D synthesis has recently emerged as a new approach to sampling 3D models by adopting pretrained text-to-image models as guiding visual priors. An intriguing but underexplored problem with existing text-to-3D methods is that 3D models obtained from the sampling-by-optimization procedure tend to have mode collapses, and hence poor diversity in their results. In this paper, we provide an analysis and identify potential causes of such a limited diversity, which motivates us to devise a new method that considers the joint generation of different 3D models from the same text prompt. We propose to use augmented text prompts via textual inversion of reference images to diversify the joint generation. We show that our method leads to improved diversity in text-to-3D synthesis qualitatively and quantitatively. Project page: https://diversedream.github.io/

title: Vadim Titov*, Madina Khalmatova*, Alexandra Ivanova*, Dmitry P Vetrov, Aibek Alanov*
title_en: Vadim Titov*, Madina Khalmatova*, Alexandra Ivanova*, Dmitry P Vetrov, Aibek Alanov*
abstract: 尽管近期在大规模文本到图像生成模型方面取得了进展,但使用这些模型对真实图像进行操作仍是一个具有挑战性的问题。现有编辑方法的主要局限性在于:要么无法在广泛图像编辑中保持一致的质量,要么需要耗时的超参数调优或扩散模型的微调以保留输入图像的特定外观。我们提出了一种基于修改后的扩散采样过程的引导机制的新方法。在本工作中,我们探索了自引导技术以保持输入图像的整体结构及其不应被编辑的局部区域的外观。具体而言,我们显式引入了布局保持能量函数,旨在保存源图像的局部和全局结构。此外,我们提出了一种噪声重标度机制,通过在生成过程中平衡无分类器引导和我们提出的引导器的范数,以保持噪声分布。这种引导方法无需对扩散模型进行微调或精确的反向过程。因此,所提出的方法提供了一种快速且高质量的编辑机制。在实验中,我们通过人工评估和定量分析表明,所提出的方法能够生成更受人类青睐的编辑效果,并在编辑质量与原图保留之间取得了更好的平衡。我们的代码可在https://github.com/AIRI-Institute/Guide-and-Rescale获取。
abstract_en: Despite recent advances in large-scale text-to-image generative models, manipulating real images with these models remains a challenging problem. The main limitations of existing editing methods are that they either fail to perform with consistent quality on a wide range of image edits or require time-consuming hyperparameter tuning or fine-tuning of the diffusion model to preserve the image-specific appearance of the input image. We propose a novel approach that is built upon a modified diffusion sampling process via the guidance mechanism. In this work, we explore the self-guidance technique to preserve the overall structure of the input image and its local regions appearance that should not be edited. In particular, we explicitly introduce layout-preserving energy functions that are aimed to save local and global structures of the source image. Additionally, we propose a noise rescaling mechanism that allows to preserve noise distribution by balancing the norms of classifier-free guidance and our proposed guiders during generation. Such a guiding approach does not require fine-tuning the diffusion model and exact inversion process. As a result, the proposed method provides a fast and high-quality editing mechanism. In our experiments, we show through human evaluation and quantitative analysis that the proposed method allows to produce desired editing which is more preferable by humans and also achieves a better trade-off between editing quality and preservation of the original image. Our code is available at https://github.com/AIRI-Institute/Guide-and-Rescale.

title: Vandad Davoodnia*, Saeed Ghorbani, Marc-André Carbonneau, Alexandre Messier, Ali Etemad
title_en: Vandad Davoodnia*, Saeed Ghorbani, Marc-André Carbonneau, Alexandre Messier, Ali Etemad
abstract: 我们提出了一种名为UPose3D的新方法,用于多视角三维人体姿态估计,解决了准确性和可扩展性方面的挑战。我们的方法通过提升鲁棒性和灵活性,在无需直接3D标注的情况下改进了现有姿态估计框架。该方法的核心是一个姿态编译模块,通过利用时序和跨视角信息,对单张图像上运行的2D关键点估计器的预测结果进行优化。我们的创新性跨视角融合策略可扩展至任意数量的摄像头,而我们的合成数据生成策略确保了在多样化的演员、场景和视角下的泛化能力。最后,UPose3D利用2D关键点估计器和姿态编译模块的预测不确定性,从而对异常值和噪声数据具有鲁棒性,在分布外场景中实现了最先进的性能。此外,在分布内场景中,UPose3D的性能可与依赖3D标注数据的方法相媲美,同时在仅依赖2D监督的方法中处于最先进水平。
abstract_en: We introduce UPose3D, a novel approach for multi-view 3D human pose estimation, addressing challenges in accuracy and scalability. Our method advances existing pose estimation frameworks by improving robustness and flexibility without requiring direct 3D annotations. At the core of our method, a pose compiler module refines predictions from a 2D keypoints estimator that operates on a single image by leveraging temporal and cross-view information. Our novel cross-view fusion strategy is scalable to any number of cameras, while our synthetic data generation strategy ensures generalization across diverse actors, scenes, and viewpoints. Finally, UPose3D leverages the prediction uncertainty of both the 2D keypoint estimator and the pose compiler module. This provides robustness to outliers and noisy data, resulting in state-of-the-art performance in out-of-distribution settings. In addition, for in-distribution settings, UPose3D yields performance rivalling methods that rely on 3D annotated data while being the state-of-the-art among methods relying only on 2D supervision.

title: Vikram Voleti*, Chun-Han Yao, Mark Boss, Adam Letts, David Pankratz, Dmitrii Tochilkin, Christian Laforte, Robin Rombach, Varun Jampani*
title_en: Vikram Voleti*, Chun-Han Yao, Mark Boss, Adam Letts, David Pankratz, Dmitrii Tochilkin, Christian Laforte, Robin Rombach, Varun Jampani*
abstract: 我们提出Stable Video 3D(SV3D)——一种潜在视频扩散模型,用于高分辨率、图像到多视角生成环绕三维物体的轨道视频。近期研究提出将二维生成模型适应于新视角合成(NVS)和三维优化。然而,这些方法由于视角有限或NVS不一致,影响了三维物体生成的性能。在本工作中,我们提出SV3D,通过将图像到视频扩散模型适应于新多视角合成和三维生成,从而利用视频模型的泛化能力和多视角一致性,同时进一步增加显式的摄像机控制以实现NVS。我们还提出了改进的三维优化技术,用于基于SV3D及其NVS输出的图像到三维生成。在多个数据集上的大量实验结合二维和三维指标以及用户研究,证明了SV3D在NVS和三维重建方面相比先前工作具有最先进的性能。
abstract_en: We present Stable Video 3D (SV3D) — a latent video diffusion model for high-resolution, image-to-multi-view generation of orbital videos around a 3D object. Recent works propose to adapt 2D generative models for novel view synthesis (NVS) and 3D optimization. However, these methods have several disadvantages due to limited views or inconsistent NVS, affecting the performance of 3D object generation. In this work, we propose SV3D that adapts image-to-video diffusion model for novel multi-view synthesis and 3D generation, thereby leveraging the generalization and multi-view consistency of the video models, while further adding explicit camera control for NVS. We also propose improved 3D optimization techniques for image-to-3D generation using SV3D and its NVS outputs. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets with 2D and 3D metrics and user study demonstrate SV3D’s state-of-the-art performance on NVS as well as 3D reconstruction compared to prior works.

title: Vinayak Gupta*, Rongali Simhachala Venkata Girish, Mukund Varma T, Ayush Tewari, Kaushik Mitra
title_en: Vinayak Gupta*, Rongali Simhachala Venkata Girish, Mukund Varma T, Ayush Tewari, Kaushik Mitra
abstract: 神经渲染方法可以从带姿态的输入图像中实现接近逼真的图像合成。然而,当图像存在缺陷(例如在极低光照条件下捕获)时,最先进的方法无法重建高质量的3D场景。近期方法尝试通过在图像形成模型中建模各种退化过程来解决这一限制,但这种方法仅适用于特定的图像退化类型。本文提出了一种通用的神经渲染方法,能够在多种退化条件下实现高保真新视角合成。我们的方法GAURA基于学习,无需在测试时进行场景特定优化。它在包含多种退化类型的合成数据集上进行训练。GAURA在低光增强、去雾、去雨等基准测试中优于最先进方法,在运动模糊处理中表现相当。此外,我们的模型可以使用少量数据高效微调以适应任何新的退化类型。我们展示了在两个未见过的退化类型(去雪和去除失焦模糊)上的适应结果。代码和视频结果可在vinayak-vg.github.io/GAURA获取。
abstract_en: Neural rendering methods can achieve near-photorealistic image synthesis of scenes from posed input images. However, when the images are imperfect, e.g., captured in very low-light conditions, state-of-the-art methods fail to reconstruct high-quality 3D scenes. Recent approaches have tried to address this limitation by modeling various degradation processes in the image formation model; however, this limits them to specific image degradations. In this paper, we propose a generalizable neural rendering method that can perform high-fidelity novel view synthesis under several degradations. Our method, GAURA, is learning-based and does not require any test-time scene-specific optimization. It is trained on a synthetic dataset that includes several degradation types. GAURA outperforms state-of-the-art methods on several benchmarks for low-light enhancement, dehazing, deraining, and on-par for motion deblurring. Further, our model can be efficiently fine-tuned to any new incoming degradation using minimal data. We thus demonstrate adaptation results on two unseen degradations, desnowing and removing defocus blur. Code and video results are available at vinayak-vg.github.io/GAURA.

title: Vincent Leroy*, Yohann Cabon, Jerome Revaud
title_en: Vincent Leroy*, Yohann Cabon, Jerome Revaud
abstract: 图像匹配是三维视觉中所有表现最佳的算法和流程的核心组件。然而,尽管匹配本质上是一个三维问题,与相机姿态和场景几何密切相关,它通常被当作二维问题来处理。这在一定程度上是合理的,因为匹配的目标是建立二维像素场之间的对应关系,但这也似乎是一个潜在的危险选择。在本工作中,我们采取不同的立场,提出将匹配作为三维任务来处理,采用__TITLE_MATH_1__,这是一个基于Transformer的最新且强大的三维重建框架。基于点图回归,该方法在匹配视角变化极端的视图时表现出令人印象深刻的鲁棒性,但准确度有限。我们旨在在此基础上提升此类方法的匹配能力,同时保持其鲁棒性。为此,我们提出在网络中添加一个新头,输出密集局部特征,并通过额外的匹配损失进行训练。我们进一步解决了密集匹配中二次复杂度的问题,若不加以处理,这种复杂度对于下游应用来说会变得极其缓慢。我们引入了一种快速互惠匹配方案,不仅将匹配速度提升了多个数量级,还具有理论保证,并最终获得了改进的匹配结果。大量实验表明,我们的方法__ABS_MATH_1__在多个匹配任务上显著优于现有技术。特别是,它在具有挑战性的无地图定位数据集上大幅超越了最佳已发表方法。
abstract_en: Image Matching is a core component of all best-performing algorithms and pipelines in 3D vision. Yet despite matching being fundamentally a 3D problem, intrinsically linked to camera pose and scene geometry, it is typically treated as a 2D problem. This makes sense as the goal of matching is to establish correspondences between 2D pixel fields, but also seems like a potentially hazardous choice. In this work, we take a different stance and propose to cast matching as a 3D task with , a recent and powerful 3D reconstruction framework based on Transformers. Based on pointmaps regression, this method displayed impressive robustness in matching views with extreme viewpoint changes, yet with limited accuracy. We aim here to improve the matching capabilities of such an approach while preserving its robustness. We thus propose to augment the network with a new head that outputs dense local features, trained with an additional matching loss. We further address the issue of quadratic complexity of dense matching, which becomes prohibitively slow for downstream applications if not treated carefully. We introduce a fast reciprocal matching scheme that not only accelerates matching by orders of magnitude, but also comes with theoretical guarantees and, lastly, yields improved results. Extensive experiments show that our approach, coined , significantly outperforms the state of the art on multiple matching tasks. In particular, it largely outperforms the best published methods on the challenging Map-free localization dataset.

title: Vincent Tao Hu*, Stefan A Baumann, Ming Gui, Olga Grebenkova, Pingchuan Ma, Johannes S Fischer, Bjorn Ommer
title_en: Vincent Tao Hu*, Stefan A Baumann, Ming Gui, Olga Grebenkova, Pingchuan Ma, Johannes S Fischer, Bjorn Ommer
abstract: 扩散模型长期以来受到可扩展性和二次复杂度问题的困扰,尤其是在基于Transformer的结构中。本研究旨在利用一种称为Mamba的状态空间模型的长序列建模能力,将其扩展到视觉数据生成领域。首先,我们发现当前大多数基于Mamba的视觉方法存在一个关键疏漏,即未考虑Mamba扫描方案中的空间连续性。其次,基于这一洞察,我们提出Zigzag Mamba,这是一种简单、即插即用、参数负担最小的DiT风格解决方案,其性能优于基于Mamba的基线方法,并在速度和内存利用率方面优于基于Transformer的基线方法。此外,当考虑更多扫描路径时,这种异构层序扫描机制可实现零内存和速度负担。最后,我们将Zigzag Mamba与随机插值框架结合,以研究模型在高分辨率视觉数据集(如FacesHQ 1024 × 1024、UCF101、MultiModal-CelebA-HQ和MS COCO 256 × 256)上的可扩展性。
abstract_en: The diffusion model has long been plagued by scalability and quadratic complexity issues, especially within transformer-based structures. In this study, we aim to leverage the long sequence modeling capability of a State-Space Model called Mamba to extend its applicability to visual data generation. Firstly, we identify a critical oversight in most current Mamba-based vision methods, namely the lack of consideration for spatial continuity in the scan scheme of Mamba. Secondly, building upon this insight, we introduce Zigzag Mamba, a simple, plug-and-play, minimal-parameter burden, DiT style solution, which outperforms Mamba-based baselines and demonstrates improved speed and memory utilization compared to transformer-based baselines, also this heterogeneous layerwise scan enables zero memory and speed burden when we consider more scan paths. Lastly, we integrate Zigzag Mamba with the Stochastic Interpolant framework to investigate the scalability of the model on large-resolution visual datasets, such as FacesHQ 1024 × 1024 and UCF101, MultiModal-CelebA-HQ, and MS COCO 256 × 256.

title: Viraj Shah, Nataniel Ruiz, Forrester Cole, Erika Lu, Svetlana Lazebnik, Yuanzhen Li, Varun Jampani*
title_en: Viraj Shah, Nataniel Ruiz, Forrester Cole, Erika Lu, Svetlana Lazebnik, Yuanzhen Li, Varun Jampani*
abstract: 针对概念驱动个性化生成模型的微调方法通常在主题驱动或风格驱动生成中取得优异效果。最近,低秩适应(low-rank adaptations)被提出作为一种参数高效的实现概念驱动个性化的方法。尽管近期研究探索了结合独立LoRAs以实现学习到的风格和主题的联合生成,但现有技术无法可靠解决该问题,导致主题保真度或风格保真度受损。我们提出,一种方法可低成本且有效地融合独立训练的风格和主题LoRAs,以实现任意用户提供的主题在任意用户提供的风格中的生成。在广泛的主题和风格组合实验中,展示可在保持重新语境化能力的同时,在主题和风格保真度上实现比基线方法更具意义的改进。
abstract_en: Methods for finetuning generative models for concept-driven personalization generally achieve strong results for subject-driven or style-driven generation. Recently, low-rank adaptations () have been proposed as a parameter-efficient way of achieving concept-driven personalization. While recent work explores the combination of separate LoRAs to achieve joint generation of learned styles and subjects, existing techniques do not reliably address the problem, so that either subject fidelity or style fidelity are compromised. We propose , a method to cheaply and effectively merge independently trained style and subject LoRAs in order to achieve generation of any user-provided subject in any user-provided style. Experiments on a wide range of subject and style combinations show that can generate compelling results with meaningful improvements over baselines in subject and style fidelity while preserving the ability to recontextualize.

title: Vishal Nedungadi, Ankit Kariryaa, Stefan Oehmcke, Serge Belongie, Christian Igel, Nico Lang*
title_en: Vishal Nedungadi, Ankit Kariryaa, Stefan Oehmcke, Serge Belongie, Christian Igel, Nico Lang*
abstract: 未标记的地球观测(EO)数据量巨大,但许多重要应用缺乏标记的训练数据。然而,EO数据提供了独特的机遇,可以通过地理位置和时间自动将不同模态和传感器的数据配对,几乎不需要人工劳动成本。我们抓住这一机遇,创建了MMEarth,这是一个全球规模的多样化多模态预训练数据集。利用这一包含120万地点的新语料库,我们提出了一种多预文本掩码自编码器(MP-MAE)方法,用于学习光学卫星图像的通用表示。我们的方法基于ConvNeXt V2架构,这是一个完全卷积的掩码自编码器(MAE)。通过一系列多模态预文本任务,我们证明了我们的MP-MAE方法在ImageNet上预训练的MAE和领域特定卫星图像上预训练的MAE上表现更优。这一结论在多个下游任务中得到验证,包括图像分类和语义分割。我们发现,使用多模态预文本任务进行预训练显著提高了线性探针性能,与仅使用光学卫星图像进行预训练相比。这也有助于提高标签效率和参数效率,这对于全球规模的应用至关重要。1 1 MMEarth数据集可在项目页面访问:vishalned.github.io/mmearth。数据集构建代码可在以下链接获取:github.com/vishalned/MMEarth-data。训练和评估的MP-MAE代码可在以下链接获取:github.com/vishalned/MMEarth-train。
abstract_en: The volume of unlabelled Earth observation (EO) data is huge, but many important applications lack labelled training data. However, EO data offers the unique opportunity to pair data from different modalities and sensors automatically based on geographic location and time, at virtually no human labor cost. We seize this opportunity to create MMEarth, a diverse multi-modal pretraining dataset at global scale. Using this new corpus of 1.2 million locations, we propose a Multi-Pretext Masked Autoencoder (MP-MAE) approach to learn general-purpose representations for optical satellite images. Our approach builds on the ConvNeXt V2 architecture, a fully convolutional masked autoencoder (MAE). Drawing upon a suite of multi-modal pretext tasks, we demonstrate that our MP-MAE approach outperforms both MAEs pretrained on ImageNet and MAEs pretrained on domain-specific satellite images. This is shown on several downstream tasks including image classification and semantic segmentation. We find that pretraining with multi-modal pretext tasks notably improves the linear probing performance compared to pretraining on optical satellite images only. This also leads to better label efficiency and parameter efficiency which are crucial aspects in global scale applications. 1 1 The MMEarth dataset is available on the project page: vishalned.github.io/mmearth. The dataset construction code is available here: github.com/vishalned/MMEarth-data. The MP-MAE code for training and evaluation is available here: github.com/vishalned/MMEarth-train.

title: Vishnu Mani Hema*, Shubhra Aich, Christian Haene, Jean-Charles Bazin, Fernando de la Torre
title_en: Vishnu Mani Hema*, Shubhra Aich, Christian Haene, Jean-Charles Bazin, Fernando de la Torre
abstract: 深度隐式建模和关节模型技术的进展显著提升了从单张图像中对三维人体进行数字化建模的效率。尽管最先进的方法在几何精度上取得了显著提升,但准确推断纹理信息仍面临挑战,尤其是在正面视角图像中人体背部等遮挡区域。这种纹理预测的局限性主要源于大规模且多样化的三维数据集稀缺,而其二维对应数据则丰富且易于获取。为解决这一问题,本文提出利用广泛的二维时尚数据集来增强三维人体数字化中的纹理和形状预测。我们从时尚数据集中引入二维先验信息,结合所提出的领域对齐策略来学习遮挡区域的背部视图,并将该信息与输入图像融合,从而获得完整纹理的三维网格模型。通过在标准三维人体基准数据集上的大量实验,我们验证了所提方法在纹理和几何精度方面的优越性能。代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/humansensinglab/FAMOUS 获取。
abstract_en: The advancement in deep implicit modeling and articulated models has significantly enhanced the process of digitizing human figures in 3D from just a single image. While state-of-the-art methods have greatly improved geometric precision, the challenge of accurately inferring texture remains, particularly in obscured areas such as the back of a person in frontal-view images. This limitation in texture prediction largely stems from the scarcity of large-scale and diverse 3D datasets, whereas their 2D counterparts are abundant and easily accessible. To address this issue, our paper proposes leveraging extensive 2D fashion datasets to enhance both texture and shape prediction in 3D human digitization. We incorporate 2D priors from the fashion dataset to learn the occluded back view, refined with our proposed domain alignment strategy. We then fuse this information with the input image to obtain a fully textured mesh of the given person. Through extensive experimentation on standard 3D human benchmarks, we demonstrate the superior performance of our approach in terms of both texture and geometry. Code and dataset is available at https://github.com/humansensinglab/FAMOUS.

title: Vitali Petsiuk*, Kate Saenko
title_en: Vitali Petsiuk*, Kate Saenko
abstract: 受伦理和法律问题的驱动,科学界正在积极开发方法,以限制文本到图像扩散模型的滥用,防止生成图像中出现受版权保护、暴力、露骨或个人信息的内容。同时,研究人员通过扮演攻击者角色,对这些新开发的安全措施进行测试,以发现其中的漏洞和后门。我们利用扩散模型的组合属性,该属性允许在单张图像生成中使用多个提示。这一属性使我们能够结合其他不应受抑制的概念,重构负责目标概念生成的向量,即使该向量的直接计算已不再可访问。我们提供了理论和实证证据,解释了所提出攻击为何可行,并讨论了这些发现对安全模型部署的影响。我们认为,必须考虑所有可能的图像生成方法,这些方法可能被攻击者利用。我们的工作开启了关于概念算术和组合推理对扩散模型安全机制影响的讨论。内容提示:本文包含可能被视为冒犯的讨论和模型生成内容。建议读者谨慎阅读。项目页面:https://cs-people.bu.edu/vpetsiuk/arc
abstract_en: Motivated by ethical and legal concerns, the scientific community is actively developing methods to limit the misuse of Text-to-Image diffusion models for reproducing copyrighted, violent, explicit, or personal information in the generated images. Simultaneously, researchers put these newly developed safety measures to the test by assuming the role of an adversary to find vulnerabilities and backdoors in them. We use the compositional property of diffusion models, which allows us to leverage multiple prompts in a single image generation. This property allows us to combine other concepts that should not have been affected by the inhibition to reconstruct the vector responsible for target concept generation, even though the direct computation of this vector is no longer accessible. We provide theoretical and empirical evidence of why the proposed attacks are possible and discuss the implications of these findings for safe model deployment. We argue that it is essential to consider all possible approaches to image generation with diffusion models that can be employed by an adversary. Our work opens up the discussion about the implications of concept arithmetics and compositional inference for safety mechanisms in diffusion models. Content Advisory: This paper contains discussions and model-generated content that may be considered offensive. Reader discretion is advised. Project page: https://cs-people.bu.edu/vpetsiuk/arc

title: Vladimir Protsenko*, Vladimir Kryzhanovskiy, Alexander Filippov
title_en: Vladimir Protsenko*, Vladimir Kryzhanovskiy, Alexander Filippov
abstract: 现代深度卷积神经网络在资源受限设备上的高效部署面临卷积操作高计算需求的挑战。量化和使用针对足够大块输入的Winograd卷积是加速卷积操作的两种强大策略。然而,两者的结合会导致数值不稳定,表现为显著的质量性能退化。我们提出了一种高效的训练场景,能够完全克服或显著减少全8位量化F(4, 3)和F(6, 3) Winograd卷积的精度退化。在全局粒子群优化(PSO)框架下,我们推导出一组量化友好的Winograd变换。遵循最先进的(SOTA)训练流程[J. Fernandez-Marques, Proc. Mach. Learn. Syst. 2, 14-29 (2020)],我们将Winograd变换作为可学习参数进行网络训练。从我们PSO推导的变换出发而非标准Winograd变换进行变换演化,显著减少了数值误差并提升了精度。因此,我们的方法在各类任务中显著优于现有SOTA方法。现代深度卷积神经网络( CNNs )在资源受限设备(如移动设备)上的高效部署面临卷积操作高计算需求的挑战。量化和使用Winograd卷积是加速卷积操作的两种强大策略。量化通过将网络参数映射到低精度表示来降低计算强度,而Winograd卷积通过使用计算高效的算法执行卷积操作实现加速。理论上,量化和Winograd卷积是优化CNNs的独立路径,其优势可以结合。然而,Winograd卷积的量化会导致数值不稳定,表现为显著的质量性能退化。特别是对于最具有前景的Winograd算法F(4, 3)和F(3, 6),其允许在足够大的块输入上运行,显著降低了卷积操作的计算复杂度。在本文中,我们提出了一种高效的训练场景,能够完全克服或显著减少全8位量化F(4, 3)和F(6, 3) Winograd卷积的精度退化。为此,在全局粒子群优化(PSO)框架下,我们推导出一组无模型和无数据的量化友好的Winograd变换矩阵。我们证明,基于我们PSO推导的变换矩阵的Winograd卷积在数值误差减少和精度方面均优于使用标准Winograd矩阵。随后,我们将这些变换集成到参考文献[?]的最先进的(SOTA)训练流程中,该流程在训练过程中将Winograd变换作为可学习参数。我们展示,允许从我们的PSO推导矩阵而非标准Winograd矩阵开始演化Winograd变换,相较于原始流程,可进一步显著提升性能。因此,我们的方法在各类任务(包括分类、超分辨率和语义分割)中显著优于现有SOTA方法,同时保持相同的推理加速效果。
abstract_en: Efficient deployment of modern deep convolutional neural networks on resource-constrained devices suffers from demanding computational requirements of convolution operations. Quantization and use of Winograd convolutions operating on sufficiently large-tile inputs are two powerful strategies to speed up convolution operations. However, their combination results in numerical instability, which manifests itself in a strong quality performance degradation. We present an efficient learning scenario that either completely overcomes or strongly reduces the accuracy degradation of full 8-bit quantized F (4, 3) and F (6, 3) Winograd convolutions. Within the global particle swarm optimization (PSO), we derived a set of quantization-friendly Winograd transformations. Following the state-of-the-art (SOTA) training pipeline [J. Fernandez-Marques , Proc. Mach. Learn. Syst. 2, 14-29 (2020)], we treat Winograd transformations as learnable parameters during network training. Evolving transformations starting from our PSO-derived ones rather than the standard Winograd transformations results in significant numerical error reduction and accuracy improvement. As a consequence, our approach significantly outperforms SOTA methods on various tasks. Efficient deployment of modern deep convolutional neural networks on resource-constrained devices suffers from demanding computational requirements of convolution operations. Quantization and use of Winograd convolutions operating on sufficiently large-tile inputs are two powerful strategies to speedup convolution operations. However, their combination results in numerical instability, which manifests itself in a strong quality performance degradation. To solve this issue, we derived a set of quantization-friendly Winograd transformations (matrices A, B and G). Following SOTA training pipeline, we treat Winograd transformations as learnable parameters during network training. Initialization from our transformation matrices instead of the standard ones for quantization-aware training results in a significant numerical error reduction, a training stabilizing and accuracy improvement. As a consequence, our approach significantly outperforms SOTA methods on various tasks. Especially, we made the quantized F(4, 3) Winograd algorith ready for industrial use (?). The code will be publicly available at https://github.com/add. Efficient deployment of modern deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) on resource-constrained devices (e.g., mobile devices) suffers from the demanding computational requirements of convolution operations. Quantization and use of Winograd convolutions are two powerful strategies for accelerating convolution operations. While quantization reduces computational intensity by mapping network parameters into their low-precision representations, Winograd convolutions achieve speedup by using a computationally efficient algorithm to perform convolution operations. Theoretically, quantization and Winograd convolutions are independent paths to optimize CNNs and their advantages can be joined. However, quantization of the Winograd convolution results in their numerical instability, which manifests itself in a strong quality performance degradation. Especially this challenge is severe for the most promising Winograd algorithms F (4, 3) and F (3, 6) allowing to operate on sufficiently large tile inputs, which significantly reduces the computational complexity of convolution operations. In this paper, we present an efficient learning scenario that either completely overcomes or strongly reduces the accuracy degradation of full 8-bit quantized F (4, 3) and F (6, 3) Winograd convolutions. To this end, prior to network training within the global particle swarm optimization (PSO), we derived a set of model- and data-free quantization-friendly Winograd transformation matrices. We demonstrate that Winograd convolutions build on our PSO-derived transformation matrices significantly benefit in terms of both numerical error reduction and accuracy compared to using the standard Winograd matrices. We then integrate our transformations into the state-of-the-art (SOTA) training pipeline of Ref. [?], which treats Winograd transformations as learnable parameters during network training. We show that allowing to evolve of Winograd transformation starting from our PSO-derived matrices, rather than from standard set of Winograd matrices, as in the original pipeline, results in further substantial improvements of performance. As a consequence, our approach significantly outperforms the SOTA methods in accuracy on various tasks, including classification, super-resolution, and semantic segmentation, while retaining the same inference speedup. 2

title: Vladimir Somers*, Alexandre Alahi, Christophe De Vleeschouwer
title_en: Vladimir Somers*, Alexandre Alahi, Christophe De Vleeschouwer
abstract: 遮挡行人重识别(ReID)是一项度量学习任务,其目标是根据外观特征匹配被遮挡的个体。尽管已有大量研究针对由物体引起的遮挡问题,但多人遮挡场景仍较少被探索。在本工作中,我们识别并解决了一个被先前遮挡方法忽视的关键挑战:当同一边界框内可见多个个体时产生的多人员歧义(MPA),这使得无法在候选对象中确定目标重识别对象。受近期视觉提示研究的启发,我们提出了一种新的重识别问题表述方法——关键点可提示重识别(KPR),该方法通过一组语义关键点显式补充输入边界框,以指示目标对象。由于可提示重识别是一个未被探索的范式,现有数据集缺乏用于提示的像素级标注。为弥合这一差距并促进该领域的进一步研究,我们引入了一个新型数据集,该数据集包含关键点标注,具有强多人遮挡特性。此外,我们还为四个流行的重识别基准数据集发布了定制关键点标注。在行人检索和姿态跟踪实验中,我们的方法在各种遮挡场景中系统性地超越了先前的最先进方法。我们的代码、数据集和标注可在https://github.com/VlSomers/keypoint_promptable_reidentification获取。
abstract_en: Occluded Person Re-Identification (ReID) is a metric learning task that involves matching occluded individuals based on their appearance. While many studies have tackled occlusions caused by objects, multi-person occlusions remain less explored. In this work, we identify and address a critical challenge overlooked by previous occluded methods: the Multi-Person Ambiguity (MPA) arising when multiple individuals are visible in the same bounding box, making it impossible to determine the intended ReID target among the candidates. Inspired by recent work on prompting in vision, we introduce Keypoint Promptable ReID (KPR), a novel formulation of the ReID problem that explicitly complements the input bounding box with a set of semantic keypoints indicating the intended target. Since promptable re-identification is an unexplored paradigm, existing datasets lack the pixel-level annotations necessary for prompting. To bridge this gap and foster further research on this topic, we introduce , a novel dataset with keypoints labels, that features strong inter-person occlusions. Furthermore, we release custom keypoint labels for four popular ReID benchmarks. Experiments on person retrieval, but also on pose tracking, demonstrate that our method systematically surpasses previous state-of-the-art approaches on various occluded scenarios. Our code, dataset and annotations are available at https://github. com/VlSomers/keypoint_promptable_reidentification.

title: 面向分布外数据的可信赖预测模型设计
title_en: Vojtech Franc*, Jakub Paplham*, Daniel Prusa*
abstract: 本文针对设计可靠预测模型的问题展开研究,当面对不确定或分布外样本时,模型会主动拒绝预测——这一问题被称为在存在分布外数据情况下的选择性分类(SCOD)。我们针对SCOD问题提出了三个关键贡献。首先,我们证明了最优的SCOD策略包含两个部分:一是针对分布内(ID)数据的贝叶斯分类器,二是以i)ID分类器的条件风险和ii)ID数据与分布外数据(OOD)的似然比作为输入的二维空间中随机线性分类器表示的选取器。这与当前分布外检测方法中的次优策略以及专门为SCOD设计的Softmax信息保留组合(SIRC)形成对比。其次,我们证明在无分布假设的设定下,仅依赖ID数据样本的SCOD问题无法实现Probably Approximately Correct(PAC)可学习。第三,我们提出了一种简单方法,从ID数据样本和未标记的ID与OOD混合数据中学习最优SCOD策略的插件估计。我们的实证结果验证了理论发现,并表明所提出的方法在有效解决SCOD问题上优于现有分布外方法。
abstract_en: This paper addresses the problem of designing reliable prediction models that abstain from predictions when faced with uncertain or out-of-distribution samples - a recently proposed problem known as Selective Classification in the presence of Out-of-Distribution data (SCOD). We make three key contributions to SCOD. Firstly, we demonstrate that the optimal SCOD strategy involves a Bayes classifier for in-distribution (ID) data and a selector represented as a stochastic linear classifier in a 2D space, using i) the conditional risk of the ID classifier, and ii) the likelihood ratio of ID and out-of-distribution (OOD) data as input. This contrasts with suboptimal strategies from current OOD detection methods and the Softmax Information Retaining Combination (SIRC), specifically developed for SCOD. Secondly, we establish that in a distribution-free setting, the SCOD problem is not Probably Approximately Correct learnable when relying solely on an ID data sample. Third, we introduce , a simple method for learning a plugin estimate of the optimal SCOD strategy from both an ID data sample and an unlabeled mixture of ID and OOD data. Our empirical results confirm the theoretical findings and demonstrate that our proposed method, , outperforms existing OOD methods in effectively addressing the SCOD problem.

title: WENCAN CHENG, Eunji Kim, Jong Hwan Ko*
title_en: WENCAN CHENG, Eunji Kim, Jong Hwan Ko*
abstract: 从输入手部帧中提取关键点位置,即三维手部姿态估计,对于各种人机交互应用至关重要。然而,现有方法往往难以处理手部自遮挡和与交互物体的相互遮挡的动态特性。为解决这一挑战,本文提出了一种用于手部姿态估计的去噪自适应图变换器HandDAGT。所提出的HandDAGT利用变换器结构,从输入块中彻底探索有效的几何特征。此外,它引入了一种新颖的注意力机制,以自适应地权衡运动学对应关系和局部几何特征对特定关键点的估计贡献。这一特性使模型能够根据遮挡情况自适应地利用运动学和局部信息,从而增强其鲁棒性和准确性。此外,我们引入了一种新颖的去噪训练策略,旨在提高模型在面对遮挡挑战时的鲁棒性能。实验结果表明,所提出的模型在四个具有挑战性的手部姿态基准数据集上显著优于现有方法。代码和预训练模型已公开在https://github.com/cwc1260/HandDAGT。
abstract_en: The extraction of keypoint positions from input hand frames, known as 3D hand pose estimation, is crucial for various human-computer interaction applications. However, current approaches often struggle with the dynamic nature of self-occlusion of hands and intra-occlusion with interacting objects. To address this challenge, this paper proposes the Denoising Adaptive Graph Transformer, HandDAGT, for hand pose estimation. The proposed HandDAGT leverages a transformer structure to thoroughly explore effective geometric features from input patches. Additionally, it incorporates a novel attention mechanism to adaptively weigh the contribution of kinematic correspondence and local geometric features for the estimation of specific keypoints. This attribute enables the model to adaptively employ kinematic and local information based on the occlusion situation, enhancing its robustness and accuracy. Furthermore, we introduce a novel denoising training strategy aimed at improving the model’s robust performance in the face of occlusion challenges. Experimental results show that the proposed model significantly outperforms the existing methods on four challenging hand pose benchmark datasets. Codes and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/cwc1260/HandDAGT.

title: 王博 俞*, 李 岩, 曹艳佩, 高翔军, 李晓宇, 胡文博, 卢全龙, 山英, 天永红
title_en: Wangbo Yu*, Li Yuan, Yan-Pei Cao, Xiangjun Gao, Xiaoyu Li, Wenbo Hu, Long Quan, Ying Shan, Yonghong Tian
abstract: 近年来,扩散模型的进展使得从单张图像生成3D模型成为可能。然而,现有方法在生成新颖视角时往往产生次优结果,出现纹理模糊和与参考图像偏离的问题,限制了其实际应用。本文提出HiFi-123方法,旨在实现高保真且多视角一致的3D生成。我们的贡献主要体现在两方面:首先,我们提出参考引导的新视角增强(RGNV)技术,显著提升了基于扩散模型的零样本新视角合成方法的保真度。其次,基于RGNV,我们提出一种新颖的参考引导的状态蒸馏(RGSD)损失函数。当该方法整合到基于优化的图像到3D生成流程中时,显著提升了3D生成质量,达到最先进的性能。全面的评估结果表明,我们的方法在定性和定量指标上均优于现有方法。视频结果可在项目页面获取。
abstract_en: Recent advances in diffusion models have enabled 3D generation from a single image. However, current methods often produce suboptimal results for novel views, with blurred textures and deviations from the reference image, limiting their practical applications. In this paper, we introduce HiFi-123, a method designed for high-fidelity and multi-view consistent 3D generation. Our contributions are twofold: First, we propose a Reference-Guided Novel View Enhancement (RGNV) technique that significantly improves the fidelity of diffusion-based zero-shot novel view synthesis methods. Second, capitalizing on the RGNV, we present a novel Reference-Guided State Distillation (RGSD) loss. When incorporated into the optimization-based image-to-3D pipeline, our method significantly improves 3D generation quality, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach over existing methods, both qualitatively and quantitatively. Video results are available on the project page.

title: Wangze Xu, Huachen Gao, Shihe Shen, Rui Peng, Jianbo Jiao, Ronggang Wang*
title_en: Wangze Xu, Huachen Gao, Shihe Shen, Rui Peng, Jianbo Jiao, Ronggang Wang*
abstract: 近年来,神经辐射场(NeRF)技术的进步推动了少样本新视角合成(NVS)的发展,这是3D视觉应用中的重要挑战。尽管已有诸多尝试降低NeRF的密集输入需求,但其仍面临训练和渲染过程耗时的问题。近期,三维高斯点云(3DGS)通过显式的点云表示实现了实时高质量渲染。然而,与NeRF类似,其因缺乏约束而倾向于过拟合训练视角。本文提出MVPGS,一种基于三维高斯点云挖掘多视角先验的少样本NVS方法。我们利用近期基于学习的多视角立体视觉(MVS)技术提升3DGS的几何初始化质量。为缓解过拟合问题,我们提出一种正向变形方法,基于计算的几何信息添加符合场景的外观约束。此外,我们引入视角一致的几何约束以优化高斯参数,促进合理收敛,并采用单目深度正则化作为补偿。实验表明,所提方法在实时渲染速度下实现了最先进的性能。项目页面:https://zezeaaa.github.io/projects/MVPGS/
abstract_en: Recently, the Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) advancement has facilitated few-shot Novel View Synthesis (NVS), which is a significant challenge in 3D vision applications. Despite numerous attempts to reduce the dense input requirement in NeRF, it still suffers from time-consumed training and rendering processes. More recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves real-time high-quality rendering with an explicit point-based representation. However, similar to NeRF, it tends to overfit the train views for lack of constraints. In this paper, we propose MVPGS, a few-shot NVS method that excavates the multi-view priors based on 3D Gaussian Splatting. We leverage the recent learning-based Multi-view Stereo (MVS) to enhance the quality of geometric initialization for 3DGS. To mitigate overfitting, we propose a forward-warping method for additional appearance constraints conforming to scenes based on the computed geometry. Furthermore, we introduce a view-consistent geometry constraint for Gaussian parameters to facilitate proper optimization convergence and utilize a monocular depth regularization as compensation. Experiments show that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance with real-time rendering speed. Project page: https://zezeaaa.github.io/projects/MVPGS/

title: Wanqi Yin, Zhongang Cai, Chen Wei, Fanzhou Wang, Ruisi Wang, Haiyi Mei, Weiye Xiao, Zhitao Yang, Qingping Sun, Atsushi Yamashita, Ziwei Liu, Lei Yang*
title_en: Wanqi Yin, Zhongang Cai, Chen Wei, Fanzhou Wang, Ruisi Wang, Haiyi Mei, Weiye Xiao, Zhitao Yang, Qingping Sun, Atsushi Yamashita, Ziwei Liu, Lei Yang*
abstract: 从单目视频中准确估计人体和相机轨迹的世界坐标系尺度是一个高度理想但具有挑战性且病态的问题。在本研究中,我们旨在通过利用世界、人体和相机三个关键要素之间的协同作用,联合恢复具有表现力的参数化人体模型(如SMPL-X)及其对应的相机姿态。我们的方法基于两个关键观察:首先,相机坐标系下的SMPL-X估计方法可以轻松恢复绝对人体深度;其次,人体运动本质上提供了绝对空间线索。通过整合这些见解,我们提出了一种新的框架,称为__TITLE_MATH_1__,以在不依赖传统优化技术的情况下,实现基于世界坐标系的表达性人体姿态和形状估计(EHPS)以及相机姿态估计。此外,我们还提出了一种新的合成数据集__ABS_MATH_1__,该数据集包含精确标注的人体和相机,且具有多样化的交互式人体运动以及逼真的相机轨迹。在标准和新建立的基准数据集上的大量实验突显了我们框架的优越性和有效性。代码和数据集可在主页1获取。1 Homepage: https://wqyin.github.io/projects/WHAC/
abstract_en: Estimating human and camera trajectories with accurate scale in the world coordinate system from a monocular video is a highly desirable yet challenging and ill-posed problem. In this study, we aim to recover expressive parametric human models (, SMPL-X) and corresponding camera poses jointly, by leveraging the synergy between three critical players: the world, the human, and the camera. Our approach is founded on two key observations. Firstly, camera-frame SMPL-X estimation methods readily recover absolute human depth. Secondly, human motions inherently provide absolute spatial cues. By integrating these insights, we introduce a novel framework, referred to as , to facilitate world-grounded expressive human pose and shape estimation (EHPS) alongside camera pose estimation, without relying on traditional optimization techniques. Additionally, we present a new synthetic dataset, , which includes accurately annotated humans and cameras, and features diverse interactive human motions as well as realistic camera trajectories. Extensive experiments on both standard and newly established benchmarks highlight the superiority and efficacy of our framework. The code and dataset are available on the homepage1 . 1 Homepage: https://wqyin.github.io/projects/WHAC/.

title: Wanting Zhang, Huisi Wu*, Jing Qin
title_en: Wanting Zhang, Huisi Wu*, Jing Qin
abstract: 由于乳腺肿块与背景之间存在低对比度和模糊边界,乳腺超声图像分割是一项具有挑战性的任务。我们的目标是利用分割任何模型(SAM)强大的特征提取能力,并通过跨域调优帮助SAM区分乳腺肿块与背景。为此,我们提出了一种名为SF RecSAM的新模型,该模型继承了SAM的模型架构,但进行了改进以适应乳腺超声图像分割。首先,我们提出了一种空间-频率特征融合模块,利用融合后的空间-频率特征获得更全面的特征表示。该融合特征用于弥补SAM的ViT图像编码器在提取肿块低级特征方面的不足,补充肿块的纹理细节和边界结构信息,从而更好地分割低对比度超声图像中的目标。其次,我们提出了一种双误校正器,通过不确定性估计识别并校正误检和漏检区域,进一步提升分割精度。大量实验表明,所提出的方法在两个具有代表性的公开乳腺超声数据集(BUSI和UDIAT)上显著优于现有最先进的方法。代码已开源至https://github.com/dodooo1/SFRecSAM。
abstract_en: Breast ultrasound image segmentation is a challenging task due to the low contrast and blurred boundary between the breast mass and the background. Our goal is to utilize the powerful feature extraction capability of segment anything model (SAM) and make out-of-domain tuning to help SAM distinguish breast masses from background. To this end, we propose a novel model called SF RecSAM , which inherits the model architecture of SAM but makes improvements to adapt to breast ultrasound image segmentation. First, we propose a spatial-frequency feature fusion module, which utilizes the fused spatial-frequency features to obtain a more comprehensive feature representation. This fusion feature is used to make up for the shortcomings of SAM’s ViT image encoder in extracting low-level feature of masses. It complements the texture details and boundary structure information of masses to better segment targets in low contrast ultrasound images. Second, we propose a dual false corrector, which identifies and corrects false positive and false negative regions using uncertainty estimation, to further improve the segmentation accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on two representative public breast ultrasound datasets: BUSI and UDIAT. Codes is available at https://github.com/dodooo1/SFRecSAM.

title: Wanyun Li, Pinxue Guo, Xinyu Zhou, Lingyi Hong, Yangji He, Xiangyu Zheng, Wei Zhang*, Wenqiang Zhang*
title_en: Wanyun Li, Pinxue Guo, Xinyu Zhou, Lingyi Hong, Yangji He, Xiangyu Zheng, Wei Zhang*, Wenqiang Zhang*
abstract: 当前视频对象分割(VOS)方法通常包含特征提取、匹配、内存管理以及多对象聚合等阶段。近期先进模型要么以离散方式按顺序建模这些组件,要么通过子结构聚合优化整体流程。然而,这些现有的显式分阶段方法阻碍了VOS框架作为统一整体进行优化,导致在处理复杂视频时能力受限且性能次优。本文提出OneVOS,一种通过All-in-One Transformer统一VOS核心组件的新型框架。具体而言,为将上述所有模块统一至视觉Transformer中,我们将多对象的帧特征、掩码和内存特征建模为Transformer token,并通过灵活的注意力机制完成多对象的特征提取、匹配和内存管理。此外,通过原始注意力操作的双重解耦,提出了一种单向混合注意力机制,以修正OneVOS框架中存储token的语义错误和歧义。最后,为缓解存储负担并加速推理,提出动态token选择器,揭示OneVOS的工作机制并自然引导出更高效的OneVOS版本。大量实验验证了OneVOS的优越性,在7个数据集上均取得最先进性能,尤其在复杂LVOS和MOSE数据集上分别以70.1%和66.4%的J&F分数超越先前最先进方法4.2%和7.0%。代码已开源:https://github.com/L599wy/OneVOS. all_papers.txt decode_tex_noligatures.sh decode_tex_noligatures.sh~ decode_tex.sh decode_tex.sh~ ECCV_abstracts.csv ECCV_abstracts_good.csv ECCV.csv ECCV.csv~ ECCV_new.csv generate_list.sh generate_list.sh~ generate_overview.sh gen.sh gen.sh~ HOWTO HOWTO~ pdflist pdflist.copied RCS snippet.html Equal contribution † Corresponding authors.
abstract_en: Contemporary Video Object Segmentation (VOS) approaches typically consist stages of feature extraction, matching, memory management, and multiple objects aggregation. Recent advanced models either employ a discrete modeling for these components in a sequential manner, or optimize a combined pipeline through substructure aggregation. However, these existing explicit staged approaches prevent the VOS framework from being optimized as a unified whole, leading to the limited capacity and suboptimal performance in tackling complex videos. In this paper, we propose OneVOS, a novel framework that unifies the core components of VOS with All-in-One Transformer. Specifically, to unify all aforementioned modules into a vision transformer, we model all the features of frames, masks and memory for multiple objects as transformer tokens, and integrally accomplish feature extraction, matching and memory management of multiple objects through the flexible attention mechanism. Furthermore, a Unidirectional Hybrid Attention is proposed through a double decoupling of the original attention operation, to rectify semantic errors and ambiguities of stored tokens in OneVOS framework. Finally, to alleviate the storage burden and expedite inference, we propose the Dynamic Token Selector, which unveils the working mechanism of OneVOS and naturally leads to a more efficient version of OneVOS. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of OneVOS, achieving state-of-the-art performance across 7 datasets, particularly excelling in complex LVOS and MOSE datasets with 70.1% and 66.4% J&F scores, surpassing previous state-of-the-art methods by 4.2% and 7.0%, respectively. Code is available at: https://github.com/L599wy/OneVOS. all_papers.txt decode_tex_noligatures.sh decode_tex_noligatures.sh~ decode_tex.sh decode_tex.sh~ ECCV_abstracts.csv ECCV_abstracts_good.csv ECCV.csv ECCV.csv~ ECCV_new.csv generate_list.sh generate_list.sh~ generate_overview.sh gen.sh gen.sh~ HOWTO HOWTO~ pdflist pdflist.copied RCS snippet.html Equal contribution † Corresponding authors.

title: Wei Chen, Long Chen, Yu Wu*
title_en: Wei Chen, Long Chen, Yu Wu*
abstract: 目前最先进的视觉定位方法依赖于Transformer进行视觉-语言特征融合。然而,这些基于Transformer的方法存在显著缺陷:由于Transformer编码器中的自注意力机制,计算成本随着输入规模呈二次增长,尤其是在处理高分辨率图像或长文本上下文时。这种计算负担的二次增长限制了视觉定位在更复杂场景中的应用,例如基于对话推理的分割任务,该任务涉及长文本表达。本文提出了一种基于Transformer解码器的高效多任务视觉定位(EEVG)框架,以解决这一问题,该框架在语言和视觉方面均降低了计算成本。在语言方面,我们采用Transformer解码器进行视觉与语言特征融合,其中语言特征作为记忆输入,视觉特征作为查询,从而实现与语言表达长度线性相关的融合。在视觉方面,我们引入一种无参数方法,通过基于注意力分数消除背景视觉标记以减少计算量。随后设计了一个轻量级掩码头,直接从剩余的稀疏特征图预测分割掩码。在基准数据集上的大量实验和消融研究验证了我们方法的效率与有效性。代码可在https://github.com/chenwei746/EEVG获取。
abstract_en: Most advanced visual grounding methods rely on Transformers for visual-linguistic feature fusion. However, these Transformer-based approaches encounter a significant drawback: the computational costs escalate quadratically due to the self-attention mechanism in the Transformer Encoder, particularly when dealing with high-resolution images or long context sentences. This quadratic increase in computational burden restricts the applicability of visual grounding to more intricate scenes, such as conversation-based reasoning segmentation, which involves lengthy language expressions. In this paper, we propose an efficient and effective multi-task visual grounding (EEVG) framework based on Transformer Decoder to address this issue, which reduces the cost in both language and visual aspects. In the language aspect, we employ the Transformer Decoder to fuse visual and linguistic features, where linguistic features are input as memory and visual features as queries. This allows fusion to scale linearly with language expression length. In the visual aspect, we introduce a parameter-free approach to reduce computation by eliminating background visual tokens based on attention scores. We then design a light mask head to directly predict segmentation masks from the remaining sparse feature maps. Extensive results and ablation studies on benchmarks demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of our approach. Code is available in https://github.com/chenwei746/EEVG.

title: Wei Cong*, Yang Cong, Yuyang Liu, Gan Sun
title_en: Wei Cong*, Yang Cong, Yuyang Liu, Gan Sun
abstract: 增量语义分割旨在对新遇到的类别进行分割的同时保持对旧类别的知识。然而,现有方法要么1) 缺乏类别特定知识(即旧类别原型)的指导,导致偏向新类别,要么2) 对类别共享知识(即旧模型权重)的约束过于严格且缺乏区分性,导致偏向旧类别。在本文中,为了权衡模型性能,我们提出用于增量语义分割的类别特定与类别共享知识(Cs2 K)指导。具体而言,从类别特定知识方面,我们设计了原型引导的伪标签,利用原型的特征邻近性修正伪标签,从而克服灾难性遗忘。同时,我们开发了原型引导的类别适应,通过学习旧增强原型,对齐跨数据集的类别分布。此外,从类别共享知识方面,我们提出了一种权重引导的选择性巩固方法,通过基于权重对旧类别的相对重要性整合旧新模型权重,强化旧记忆同时保持新记忆。在公开数据集上的实验表明,我们提出的Cs2 K显著提升了分割性能,并具有即插即用特性。
abstract_en: Incremental semantic segmentation endeavors to segment newly encountered classes while maintaining knowledge of old classes. However, existing methods either 1) lack guidance from class-specific knowledge (i.e., old class prototypes), leading to a bias towards new classes, or 2) constrain class-shared knowledge (i.e., old model weights) excessively without discrimination, resulting in a preference for old classes. In this paper, to trade off model performance, we propose the Class-specific and Class-shared Knowledge (Cs2 K) guidance for incremental semantic segmentation. Specifically, from the class-specific knowledge aspect, we design a prototype-guided pseudo labeling that exploits feature proximity from prototypes to correct pseudo labels, thereby overcoming catastrophic forgetting. Meanwhile, we develop a prototype-guided class adaptation that aligns class distribution across datasets via learning old augmented prototypes. Moreover, from the class-shared knowledge aspect, we propose a weight-guided selective consolidation to strengthen old memory while maintaining new memory by integrating old and new model weights based on weight importance relative to old classes. Experiments on public datasets demonstrate that our proposed Cs2 K significantly improves segmentation performance and is plug-and-play.

title: Wei Huang*, Yilei Shi, Zhitong Xiong, Xiao Xiang Zhu
title_en: Wei Huang*, Yilei Shi, Zhitong Xiong, Xiao Xiang Zhu
abstract: 领域泛化(Domain Generalization, DG)聚焦于提升深度学习模型在多个源域上训练后的泛化能力,以适应未见过的目标域。本文通过偏差-方差分解的视角探讨领域泛化(DG),发现测试误差主要源于跨领域偏差和方差。受此启发,我们提出表示增强-稳定化(Representation Enhancement-Stabilization, RES)框架,包含表示增强(Representation Enhancement, RE)模块和表示稳定化(Representation Stabilization, RS)模块。在RE模块中,采用新颖的特征频率增强技术逐步降低特征提取过程中的跨领域偏差;同时,在RS模块中设计了新颖的互指数移动平均(Mutual Exponential Moving Average, MEMA)策略,以稳定模型优化过程,降低训练中的跨领域方差。整体而言,RES方法可显著提升模型泛化能力。我们在五个基准数据集上评估RES,结果表明其优于多种先进领域泛化方法。我们的代码将开源于https://github.com/zhu-xlab/DG-RES。
abstract_en: Domain Generalization (DG) focuses on enhancing the generalization of deep learning models trained on multiple source domains to adapt to unseen target domains. This paper explores DG through the lens of bias-variance decomposition, uncovering that test errors in DG predominantly arise from cross-domain bias and variance. Inspired by this insight, we introduce a Representation Enhancement-Stabilization (RES) framework, comprising a Representation Enhancement (RE) module and a Representation Stabilization (RS) module. In RE, a novel set of feature frequency augmentation techniques is used to progressively reduce cross-domain bias during feature extraction. Furthermore, in RS, a novel Mutual Exponential Moving Average (MEMA) strategy is designed to stabilize model optimization for diminishing cross-domain variance during training. Collectively, the whole RES method can significantly enhance model generalization. We evaluate RES on five benchmark datasets and the results show that it outperforms multiple advanced DG methods. Our code will be available at https://github. com/zhu-xlab/DG-RES.

title: Wei Shang*, Dongwei Ren*, Wanying Zhang, Yuming Fang, Wangmeng Zuo, Kede Ma
title_en: Wei Shang*, Dongwei Ren*, Wanying Zhang, Yuming Fang, Wangmeng Zuo, Kede Ma
abstract: 任意尺度视频超分辨率(AVSR)旨在提升视频帧的分辨率,可能在多种缩放因子下进行,这带来了关于空间细节重建、时间一致性以及计算复杂度等方面的挑战。本文首先通过组合三种基础构建模块的变体,描述了一个强大的AVSR基线模型:1)一个流引导的循环单元,用于从先前帧中聚合时空信息;2)一个流优化的交叉注意力单元,用于从未来帧中选择时空信息;3)一个超采样单元,生成具有尺度感知且内容无关的超采样核。随后,我们通过为基线模型配备从预训练VGG网络计算得到的多尺度结构与纹理先验,提出了ST-AVSR。该先验在不同位置和尺度下有效区分结构与纹理,对AVSR具有显著优势。综合实验表明,ST-AVSR在超分辨率质量、泛化能力和推理速度方面均显著优于现有最先进的方法。代码可在https://github.com/shangwei5/ST-AVSR获取。
abstract_en: Arbitrary-scale video super-resolution (AVSR) aims to enhance the resolution of video frames, potentially at various scaling factors, which presents several challenges regarding spatial detail reproduction, temporal consistency, and computational complexity. In this paper, we first describe a strong baseline for AVSR by putting together three variants of elementary building blocks: 1) a flow-guided recurrent unit that aggregates spatiotemporal information from previous frames, 2) a flow-refined cross-attention unit that selects spatiotemporal information from future frames, and 3) a hyper-upsampling unit that generates scale-aware and content-independent upsampling kernels. We then introduce ST-AVSR by equipping our baseline with a multi-scale structural and textural prior computed from the pre-trained VGG network.
