abstract: Yehuda等人提出的ProbCover方法是一种在低预算场景下主动学习的具有良好动机的算法,其试图通过在选定数据点上以给定半径的球体“覆盖”数据分布。然而,我们证明该算法的性能对这一半径超参数的选择极其敏感,调整该参数相当困难,原始启发式方法经常失效。因此,我们引入(并从理论上进行论证)一种广义的“覆盖”概念,包括ProbCover的目标作为特例,同时允许更鲁棒的平滑概念,对超参数选择更具鲁棒性。我们提出了一种高效的贪心方法来优化这种覆盖,该方法扩展了ProbCover的算法;由于其与核聚类的紧密联系,我们称之为“MaxHerding”。该目标也可以通过k-中位数变体进行非贪心优化,从而澄清与其他低预算主动学习方法的关系。在全面实验中,MaxHerding在多个低预算图像分类基准测试中超越现有主动学习方法,并且其计算成本低于大多数竞争方法。
abstract_en: The ProbCover method of Yehuda et al. is a well-motivated algorithm for active learning in low-budget regimes, which attempts to “cover” the data distribution with balls of a given radius at selected data points. We demonstrate, however, that the performance of this algorithm is extremely sensitive to the choice of this radius hyper-parameter, and that tuning it is quite difficult, with the original heuristic frequently failing. We thus introduce (and theoretically motivate) a generalized notion of “coverage,” including ProbCover’s objective as a special case, but also allowing smoother notions that are far more robust to hyper-parameter choice. We propose an efficient greedy method to optimize this coverage, generalizing ProbCover’s algorithm; due to its close connection to kernel herding, we call it “MaxHerding.” The objective can also be optimized non-greedily through a variant of k-medoids, clarifying the relationship to other low-budget active learning methods. In comprehensive experiments, MaxHerding surpasses existing active learning methods across multiple low-budget image classification benchmarks, and does so with less computational cost than most competitive methods.

title: Wonjae Kim*, Sanghyuk Chun, Taekyung Kim, Dongyoon Han, Sangdoo Yun
title_en: Wonjae Kim*, Sanghyuk Chun, Taekyung Kim, Dongyoon Han, Sangdoo Yun
abstract: 在数据量驱动自监督学习效果的时代,数据语义的特异性与清晰度对模型训练起着关键作用。针对这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的方法——双曲蕴含过滤(HYPE),旨在从大规模、噪声较多的图像-文本对数据集中细致提取模态层面有意义且对齐良好的数据。我们的方法利用双曲嵌入和蕴含锥的概念,评估并过滤掉语义无意义或定义不明确的样本,聚焦于提升每个数据样本的特异性。HYPE不仅在过滤效率上实现了显著提升,而且在结合现有过滤技术后,在DataComp基准测试中达到了新的最先进水平。这一突破展示了HYPE在优化数据选择过程中的潜力,从而有助于开发更准确高效的自监督学习模型。此外,图像特异性εi可独立应用于从图像-文本或纯图像数据集中诱导出纯图像数据集,用于训练纯图像自监督模型,并在与CLIP分数诱导的数据集对比时表现出优越性能。
abstract_en: In an era where the volume of data drives the effectiveness of self-supervised learning, the specificity and clarity of data semantics play a crucial role in model training. Addressing this, we introduce HYPerbolic Entailment filtering (HYPE), a novel methodology designed to meticulously extract modality-wise meaningful and well-aligned data from extensive, noisy image-text pair datasets. Our approach leverages hyperbolic embeddings and the concept of entailment cones to evaluate and filter out samples with meaningless or underspecified semantics, focusing on enhancing the specificity of each data sample. HYPE not only demonstrates a significant improvement in filtering efficiency but also sets a new state-of-the-art in the DataComp benchmark when combined with existing filtering techniques. This breakthrough showcases the potential of HYPE to refine the data selection process, thereby contributing to the development of more accurate and efficient self-supervised learning models. Additionally, the image specificity εi can be independently applied to induce an image-only dataset from an image-text or image-only data pool for training image-only self-supervised models and showed superior performance when compared to the dataset induced by CLIP score.

title: Wonjun Kang, Kevin Galim, Hyung Il Koo*
title_en: Wonjun Kang, Kevin Galim, Hyung Il Koo*
abstract: 扩散模型在文本引导图像生成领域取得了显著成果,并在近期文本引导图像编辑领域也表现出色。一种常见的图像编辑策略是通过逆扩散过程获得原始图像的噪声表示,随后进行去噪以实现所需的编辑。然而,当前的扩散逆方法往往难以生成既忠实于指定文本提示又与源图像高度相似的编辑结果。为克服这些局限性,我们引入了一种新颖且可适应的扩散逆技术,该技术基于对DDIM采样方程中η参数作用的理论分析,以增强编辑性。通过设计一个具有时间与区域依赖性的η函数的通用扩散逆方法,我们实现了对编辑程度的灵活控制。通过一系列全面的定量与定性评估,包括与多种近期方法的对比,我们证明了所提方法的优越性。我们的方法不仅在该领域设立了新基准,而且显著优于现有策略。
abstract_en: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in the domain of text-guided image generation and, more recently, in text-guided image editing. A commonly adopted strategy for editing real images involves inverting the diffusion process to obtain a noisy representation of the original image, which is then denoised to achieve the desired edits. However, current methods for diffusion inversion often struggle to produce edits that are both faithful to the specified text prompt and closely resemble the source image. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a novel and adaptable diffusion inversion technique for real image editing, which is grounded in a theoretical analysis of the role of η in the DDIM sampling equation for enhanced editability. By designing a universal diffusion inversion method with a time- and region-dependent η function, we enable flexible control over the editing extent. Through a comprehensive series of quantitative and qualitative assessments, involving a comparison with a broad array of recent methods, we demonstrate the superiority of our approach. Our method not only sets a new benchmark in the field but also significantly outperforms existing strategies.

title: Wontae Kim*, Nam Ik Cho*
title_en: Wontae Kim*, Nam Ik Cho*
abstract: 基于自适应三维查找表(3D LUTs)的图像增强与修复方法在实时推理中展现出良好效果。这些方法通过插值操作将输入像素值直接转换为增强后的像素值,利用预测的3D LUT值进行转换。然而,由于大多数3D LUT方法仅实现简单的颜色到颜色的转换,处理图像局部差异属性仍具挑战性。尽管引入空间信息可作为有效解决方案,但会显著增加参数数量和推理时间。为解决此问题,我们提出了一种高效的、具有空间感知能力的图像增强模型,结合双边网格与3D LUTs。具体而言,我们将双边网格转换至空间特征域,以在3D LUT模型中整合空间信息。为减少推理时间并节省参数,我们在网络架构中采用切片操作,而非现有研究中普遍使用的U-Net架构的长解码路径。实验结果表明,该模型在不增加参数数量的情况下实现了最先进的性能,并进一步降低了推理时间。代码已开源至https://github.com/WontaeaeKim/LUTwithBGrid
abstract_en: Image enhancement and restoration methods using adaptive 3D lookup tables (3D LUTs) have shown promising results with real-time inferencing. These methods directly transform input pixel values into enhanced ones by using interpolation operations with predicted 3D LUT values. However, it is still challenging to deal with locally different properties of images since most 3D LUT methods are simple color-to-color transforms. Although including spatial information in this transform can be a good solution, it can significantly increase the number of parameters and inference time. To address this issue, we propose an efficient spatial-aware image enhancement model that combines bilateral grids and 3D LUTs. Specifically, we transform bilateral grids into a spatial feature domain to incorporate spatial information in our 3D LUT model. To reduce inference time and save parameters, we use slicing operations in our network architecture instead of the long decoding path of the U-Net architecture used in most existing studies. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance without increasing parameters and further reduces inference time, as demonstrated by extensive results. Codes are available at https://github.com/WontaeaeKim/ LUTwithBGrid

title: Wonwoong Cho*, Hareesh Ravi*, Midhun Harikumar, Vinh Khuc, Krishna Kumar Singh, Jingwan Lu, David Iseri Inouye*, Ajinkya Kale*
title_en: Wonwoong Cho*, Hareesh Ravi*, Midhun Harikumar, Vinh Khuc, Krishna Kumar Singh, Jingwan Lu, David Iseri Inouye*, Ajinkya Kale*
abstract: 随着扩散模型展现出 promising performance(此处保留原文术语),已有大量研究致力于提升扩散模型的可控性。然而,如何训练扩散模型以获得解耦的潜在空间,以及如何在采样过程中自然地融入解耦条件,仍存在不足。本文提出了一种用于扩散模型特征解耦的训练框架(FDiff)。我们进一步提出了两种采样方法,以提升扩散模型的现实感并增强其可控性。简而言之,我们训练扩散模型,使其基于两个潜在特征、空间内容掩码和扁平化风格嵌入进行条件化。我们依赖扩散模型去噪过程的归纳偏置,将姿态/布局信息编码到内容特征中,将语义/风格信息编码到风格特征中。关于采样方法,我们首先通过打破条件独立性假设,推广可组合扩散模型(GCDM),允许条件输入之间存在一定的依赖关系,实验表明这在现实生成中是有效的。其次,我们提出针对内容和风格特征的时间步依赖权重调度,以进一步提升性能。我们还观察到,与现有方法相比,所提出的方法在图像编辑和图像翻译任务中表现出更好的可控性。
abstract_en: As Diffusion Models have shown promising performance, a lot of efforts have been made to improve the controllability of Diffusion Models. However, how to train Diffusion Models to have the disentangled latent spaces and how to naturally incorporate the disentangled conditions during the sampling process have been underexplored. In this paper, we present a training framework for feature disentanglement of Diffusion Models (FDiff). We further propose two sampling methods that can boost the realism of our Diffusion Models and also enhance the controllability. Concisely, we train Diffusion Models conditioned on two latent features, a spatial content mask, and a flattened style embedding. We rely on the inductive bias of the denoising process of Diffusion Models to encode pose/layout information in the content feature and semantic/style information in the style feature. Regarding the sampling methods, we first generalize Composable Diffusion Models (GCDM) by breaking the conditional independence assumption to allow for some dependence between conditional inputs, which is shown to be effective in realistic generation in our experiments. Second, we propose timestep-dependent weight scheduling for content and style features to further improve the performance. We also observe better controllability of our proposed methods compared to existing methods in image manipulation and image translation.

title: Woobin Im, Geonho Cha, Sebin Lee, Jumin Lee, Juhyeong Seon, Dongyoon Wee, Sungeui Yoon*
title_en: Woobin Im, Geonho Cha, Sebin Lee, Jumin Lee, Juhyeong Seon, Dongyoon Wee, Sungeui Yoon*
abstract: 本文提出了一种从单目视频中重建动态光照场的新方法。我们通过将运动学与动态光照场相结合,弥合了单目视频稀疏性与现实物理之间的差距。我们的方法引入了运动场,通过运动学量(速度、加速度和急动度)捕捉运动。运动场在不依赖运动真实值的情况下,通过最小化光度损失与动态光照场联合学习。我们进一步通过基于运动学的物理驱动正则化器增强该方法。我们提出了确保预测运动学量物理有效性的物理驱动正则化器,包括对流加速度和急动度。此外,我们基于预测的运动学量形成的刚性方程控制运动轨迹。在实验中,我们的方法在具有挑战性的现实单目视频中通过捕捉物理运动模式,优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: This paper presents a novel approach for reconstructing dynamic radiance fields from monocular videos. We integrate kinematics with dynamic radiance fields, bridging the gap between the sparse nature of monocular videos and the real-world physics. Our method introduces the kinematic field, capturing motion through kinematic quantities: velocity, acceleration, and jerk. The kinematic field is jointly learned with the dynamic radiance field by minimizing the photometric loss without motion ground truth. We further augment our method with physics-driven regularizers grounded in kinematics. We propose physics-driven regularizers that ensure the physical validity of predicted kinematic quantities, including advective acceleration and jerk. Additionally, we control the motion trajectory based on rigidity equations formed with the predicted kinematic quantities. In experiments, our method outperforms the state-of-the-arts by capturing physical motion patterns within challenging real-world monocular videos.

title: Woojin Cho, Jihyun Lee, Minjae Yi, Minje Kim, Taeyun Woo, Donghwan Kim, Taewook Ha, Hyokeun Lee, Je-Hwan Ryu, Woontack Woo, Tae-Kyun (T-K) Kim*
title_en: Woojin Cho, Jihyun Lee, Minjae Yi, Minje Kim, Taeyun Woo, Donghwan Kim, Taewook Ha, Hyokeun Lee, Je-Hwan Ryu, Woontack Woo, Tae-Kyun (T-K) Kim*
abstract: 现有三维手-物体交互数据集在数据量、交互场景中的数据多样性或标注质量方面存在局限。本文提出一个全面的新训练数据集HOGraspNet用于手-物体交互。它是唯一能够捕捉完整抓取分类学的现实数据集,提供抓取标注和广泛的同类变体。以抓取分类学作为原子动作,其空间和时间组合可表示围绕物体的复杂手部活动。我们从YCB数据集中选取22个刚性物体,并通过形状和尺寸分类学选取另外8个复合物体,确保覆盖所有手部抓取配置。该数据集包含来自10至74岁99名参与者的多样化手部形状、连续视频帧以及150万帧RGB-深度稀疏帧及标注。其提供三维手部和物体网格、三维关键点、接触图和抓取标签的标注。通过将手部参数化模型(MANO)和手部隐式函数(HALO)拟合到多视角RGBD帧,获得精确的手部和物体三维网格,仅使用MoCap系统对物体进行标注。需要注意的是,HALO拟合无需任何参数调整,可与MANO相当的精度实现数据集规模的扩展。我们在相关任务(抓取分类和三维手部姿态估计)上评估HOGraspNet。结果表明性能随抓取类型和物体类别而变化,表明了我们数据集所捕捉的交互空间的重要性。提供的数据旨在学习三维手-物体交互的通用形状先验或基础模型。我们的数据集和代码可在https://hograspnet2024.github.io/获取。
abstract_en: Existing datasets for 3D hand-object interaction are limited either in the data cardinality, data variations in interaction scenarios, or the quality of annotations. In this work, we present a comprehensive new training dataset for hand-object interaction called HOGraspNet. It is the only real dataset that captures full grasp taxonomies, providing grasp annotation and wide intraclass variations. Using grasp taxonomies as atomic actions, their space and time combinatorial can represent complex hand activities around objects. We select 22 rigid objects from the YCB dataset and 8 other compound objects using shape and size taxonomies, ensuring coverage of all hand grasp configurations. The dataset includes diverse hand shapes from 99 participants aged 10 to 74, continuous video frames, and a 1.5M RGB-Depth of sparse frames with annotations. It offers labels for 3D hand and object meshes, 3D keypoints, contact maps, and grasp labels. Accurate hand and object 3D meshes are obtained by fitting the hand parametric model (MANO) and the hand implicit function (HALO) to multi-view RGBD frames, with the MoCap system only for objects. Note that HALO fitting does not require any parameter tuning, enabling scalability to the dataset’s size with comparable accuracy to MANO. We evaluate HOGraspNet on relevant tasks: grasp classification and 3D hand pose estimation. The result shows performance variations based on grasp type and object class, indicating the potential importance of the interaction space captured by our dataset. The provided data aims at learning universal shape priors or foundation models for 3D hand-object interaction. Our dataset and code are available at https://hograspnet2024.github.io/.

title: Wouter Van Gansbeke*, Bert De Brabandere
title_en: Wouter Van Gansbeke*, Bert De Brabandere
abstract: 全景分割和实例分割网络通常通过专用的目标检测模块、复杂的损失函数以及临时的后处理步骤来管理实例掩码的排列不变性。本文基于Stable Diffusion,提出了一种用于全景分割的潜在扩散方法,从而得到一个省略了这些复杂性的简单架构。我们的训练包含两个步骤:(1) 训练一个浅层自编码器将分割掩码投影到潜在空间;(2) 训练一个扩散模型以实现潜在空间中的图像条件采样。这种生成方法解锁了掩码补全或修复的探索。在COCO和ADE20k数据集上的实验验证取得了优异的分割结果。最后,我们通过引入可学习的任务嵌入来展示模型在多任务学习中的适应性。代码和模型将公开。1 1 https://github.com/segments-ai/latent-diffusion-segmentation
abstract_en: Panoptic and instance segmentation networks are often trained with specialized object detection modules, complex loss functions, and ad-hoc post-processing steps to manage the permutation-invariance of the instance masks. This work builds upon Stable Diffusion and proposes a latent diffusion approach for panoptic segmentation, resulting in a simple architecture that omits these complexities. Our training consists of two steps: (1) training a shallow autoencoder to project the segmentation masks to latent space; (2) training a diffusion model to allow image-conditioned sampling in latent space. This generative approach unlocks the exploration of mask completion or inpainting. The experimental validation on COCO and ADE20k yields strong segmentation results. Finally, we demonstrate our model’s adaptability to multi-tasking by introducing learnable task embeddings. The code and models will be made available.1 1 https://github.com/segments-ai/latent-diffusion-segmentation

title: Wufei Ma*, Kai Li, Zhongshi Jiang, Moustafa Meshry, Qihao Liu, Huiyu Wang, Christian Haene, Alan Yuille
title_en: Wufei Ma*, Kai Li, Zhongshi Jiang, Moustafa Meshry, Qihao Liu, Huiyu Wang, Christian Haene, Alan Yuille
abstract: 近期视频-文本基础模型在多种下游视频理解任务中展现出强大的性能。这些视频-文本模型是否真正理解了自然视频的内容?标准的视频-文本评估可能具有误导性,因为许多问题仅需通过单帧中的物体和上下文即可推断,或受数据集固有偏差的影响。本文旨在更准确地评估当前视频-文本模型的能力并理解其局限性。我们提出了一种新的视频-文本理解评估任务,即从反事实增强数据中检索(RCAD),并构建了一个新的数据集。要在我们的新评估任务中取得成功,模型必须通过跨帧推理对视频内容形成全面理解。分析表明,先前的视频-文本基础模型容易被反事实增强数据欺骗,其性能远低于人类水平。为缩小视频-文本模型在RCAD任务上与人类表现的差距,我们识别出现有对比学习方法在视频-文本数据中的关键局限性,并引入了一种更有效的学习动作语义的方法,该方法通过预训练大语言模型获取的知识进行学习。实验与分析表明,我们的方法成功学习了更具判别性的动作嵌入,并在应用于多种视频-文本模型时提升了性能。我们的数据集和项目页面可在此处获取。
abstract_en: Recent video-text foundation models have demonstrated strong performance on a wide variety of downstream video understanding tasks. Can these video-text models genuinely understand the contents of natural videos? Standard video-text evaluations could be misleading as many questions can be inferred merely from the objects and contexts in a single frame or biases inherent in the datasets. In this paper, we aim to better assess the capabilities of current video-text models and understand their limitations. We propose a novel evaluation task for video-text understanding, namely retrieval from counterfactually augmented data (RCAD), and a new dataset. To succeed on our new evaluation task, models must derive a comprehensive understanding of the video from cross-frame reasoning. Analyses show that previous video-text foundation models can be easily fooled by counterfactually augmented data and are far behind human-level performance. In order to narrow the gap between video-text models and human performance on RCAD, we identify a key limitation of current contrastive approaches on video-text data and introduce , a more effective approach to learn action semantics by leveraging knowledge obtained from a pretrained large language model. Experiments and analyses show that our approach successfully learn more discriminative action embeddings and improves results on when applied to multiple video-text models. Our dataset and project page is available here.

title: 云蔚然,齐梦石,彭飞,马华东*
title_en: Wulian Yun, Mengshi Qi, Fei Peng, Huadong Ma*
abstract: 现有动作质量评估(AQA)方法通常需要大量标签注释进行全监督学习,这既繁琐又昂贵。在实践中,由于AQA标注过程需要领域专业知识,获取标注数据具有困难。本文提出了一种新颖的半监督方法,通过利用大量未标注数据和少量标注数据,可更有效地完成AQA任务。不同于传统教师-学生网络,我们提出教师-参考-学生架构,用于同时学习未标注和标注数据,其中教师网络和参考网络用于生成未标注数据的伪标签以监督学生网络。具体而言,教师网络通过捕捉未标注数据的高层特征预测伪标签。参考网络通过引用额外的动作信息为学生网络提供充分监督。此外,我们引入置信度记忆机制,通过存储教师网络和参考网络迄今为止最准确的输出来提升伪标签的可靠性。为验证我们的方法,我们在三个AQA基准数据集上进行了大量实验。实验结果表明,我们的方法取得了显著提升,并优于现有半监督AQA方法。我们的源代码可在https://github.com/wuli55555/TRS获取。
abstract_en: Existing action quality assessment (AQA) methods often require a large number of label annotations for fully supervised learning, which are laborious and expensive. In practice, the labeled data are difficult to obtain because the AQA annotation process requires domain-specific expertise. In this paper, we propose a novel semi-supervised method, which can be utilized for better assessment of the AQA task by exploiting a large amount of unlabeled data and a small portion of labeled data. Differing from the traditional teacher-student network, we propose a teacher-reference-student architecture to learn both unlabeled and labeled data, where the teacher network and the reference network are used to generate pseudo-labels for unlabeled data to supervise the student network. Specifically, the teacher predicts pseudo-labels by capturing high-level features of unlabeled data. The reference network provides adequate supervision of the student network by referring to additional action information. Moreover, we introduce confidence memory to improve the reliability of pseudo-labels by storing the most accurate ever output of the teacher network and reference network. To validate our method, we conduct extensive experiments on three AQA benchmark datasets. Experimental results show that our method achieves significant improvements and outperforms existing semi-supervised AQA methods. Our source code is available at https://github.com/wuli55555/TRS.

title: Wuyang Li, Xinyu Liu, Jiayi Ma, Yixuan Yuan*
title_en: Wuyang Li, Xinyu Liu, Jiayi Ma, Yixuan Yuan*
abstract: 开放词汇目标检测(OVD)利用图像级线索扩展区域提议的语义空间,从而促进对多样新型类别的检测。近期工作通过在判别范式中联合最小化对象-图像和对象-文本差异来适应CLIP嵌入。然而,它们忽略了图像与文本目标之间的潜在分布及分歧,导致视觉与语言子空间之间的分布错位。为解决这一缺陷,我们探索了具有分布感知的先进生成范式,并提出了一种基于扩散模型的新框架,称为持续潜在扩散(CLIFF),该框架在对象、图像和文本潜在空间中概率地建模持续分布迁移。CLIFF包含一个变分潜在采样器(VLS)用于概率建模,以及一个持续扩散模块(CDM)用于分布迁移。具体而言,在VLS中,我们首先通过估计分布参数建立概率对象空间。然后,从估计的分布中采样对象中心噪声以生成文本嵌入用于OVD。为实现这一生成过程,CDM执行从采样噪声到图像嵌入的短距离对象-图像扩散,作为中间媒介,引导长距离扩散生成文本嵌入。大量实验验证了CLIFF在基准测试中显著超越现有最先进方法。代码可在https://github.com/CUHK-AIM-Group/CLIFF获取。
abstract_en: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) utilizes image-level cues to expand the linguistic space of region proposals, thereby facilitating the detection of diverse novel classes. Recent works adapt CLIP embedding by minimizing the object-image and object-text discrepancy combinatorially in a discriminative paradigm. However, they ignore the underlying distribution and the disagreement between the image and text objective, leading to the misaligned distribution between the vision and language sub-space. To address the deficiency, we explore the advanced generative paradigm with distribution perception and propose a novel framework based on the diffusion model, coined Continual Latent Diffusion (CLIFF), which formulates a continual distribution transfer among the object, image, and text latent space probabilistically. CLIFF consists of a Variational Latent Sampler (VLS) enabling the probabilistic modeling and a Continual Diffusion Module (CDM) for the distribution transfer. Specifically, in VLS, we first establish a probabilistic object space with region proposals by estimating distribution parameters. Then, the object-centric noise is sampled from the estimated distribution to generate text embedding for OVD. To achieve this generation process, CDM conducts a short-distance object-to-image diffusion from the sampled noise to generate image embedding as the medium, which guides the long-distance diffusion to generate text embedding. Extensive experiments verify that CLIFF can significantly surpass state-of-the-art methods on benchmarks. The code is available at https://github.com/CUHK-AIM-Group/CLIFF.

title: XIANG ZHANG*, Yulun Zhang, Fisher Yu
title_en: XIANG ZHANG*, Yulun Zhang, Fisher Yu
abstract: Transformer模型在包括图像超分辨率(SR)在内的计算机视觉任务中展现出 promising performance。然而,流行的基于Transformer的SR方法通常采用具有二次计算复杂度的窗口自注意力机制,窗口尺寸固定且受限,导致接收视野有限。本文提出一种通用策略,将基于Transformer的SR网络转换为分层Transformer(HiT-SR),通过多尺度特征提升SR性能,同时保持高效设计。具体而言,我们首先将常用的固定小窗口替换为扩展的分层窗口,以聚合不同尺度的特征并建立长程依赖关系。考虑到大窗口所需的密集计算,我们进一步设计了一种空间-通道相关方法,其复杂度与窗口尺寸呈线性关系,高效地从分层窗口中收集空间和通道信息。大量实验验证了HiT-SR的有效性和效率,我们的改进版SwinIR-Light、SwinIR-NG和SRFormer-Light在参数数量、FLOPs和速度方面更优(约快7倍),取得了state-of-the-art的SR结果。
abstract_en: Transformers have exhibited promising performance in computer vision tasks including image super-resolution (SR). However, popular transformer-based SR methods often employ window self-attention with quadratic computational complexity to window sizes, resulting in fixed small windows with limited receptive fields. In this paper, we present a general strategy to convert transformer-based SR networks to hierarchical transformers (HiT-SR), boosting SR performance with multi-scale features while maintaining an efficient design. Specifically, we first replace the commonly used fixed small windows with expanding hierarchical windows to aggregate features at different scales and establish long-range dependencies. Considering the intensive computation required for large windows, we further design a spatial-channel correlation method with linear complexity to window sizes, efficiently gathering spatial and channel information from hierarchical windows. Extensive experiments verify the effectiveness and efficiency of our HiT-SR, and our improved versions of SwinIR-Light, SwinIR-NG, and SRFormer-Light yield state-of-the-art SR results with fewer parameters, FLOPs, and faster speeds (∼ 7×).

title: 陈希*, 彭思达, 杨东晨, 刘元, 潘博文, 陆成飞, 周晓伟*
title_en: Xi Chen*, Sida Peng, Dongchen Yang, Yuan Liu, Bowen Pan, Chengfei Lyu, Xiaowei Zhou*
abstract: † 通讯作者。本文旨在从在未知静态光照条件下捕获的摆姿势图像中恢复物体材料。近期方法通过可微物理基础渲染优化材料参数来解决此任务。然而,由于物体几何、材料和环境光照之间的耦合,逆渲染过程中存在固有的歧义性,导致先前方法无法获得准确结果。为克服这一病态问题,我们的关键思想是使用生成模型学习材料先验,以正则化优化过程。我们观察到,通用渲染方程可以分解为漫反射和镜面着色项,因此将材料先验建模为漫反射和镜面的扩散模型。得益于这一设计,我们的模型可以利用现有的丰富3D物体数据进行训练,并自然地作为从RGB图像恢复材料表示时解决歧义的多功能工具。此外,我们开发了一种从粗到细的训练策略,利用估计的材料引导扩散模型满足多视角一致性约束,从而获得更稳定和准确的结果。在真实世界和合成数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在材料恢复任务中达到了最先进的性能。代码将在https://zju3dv.github.io/IntrinsicAnything/上发布。
abstract_en: † Corresponding author. This paper aims to recover object materials from posed images captured under an unknown static lighting condition. Recent methods solve this task by optimizing material parameters through differentiable physically based rendering. However, due to the coupling between object geometry, materials, and environment lighting, there is inherent ambiguity during the inverse rendering process, preventing previous methods from obtaining accurate results. To overcome this ill-posed problem, our key idea is to learn the material prior with a generative model for regularizing the optimization process. We observe that the general rendering equation can be split into diffuse and specular shading terms, and thus formulate the material prior as diffusion models of albedo and specular. Thanks to this design, our model can be trained using the existing abundant 3D object data, and naturally acts as a versatile tool to resolve the ambiguity when recovering material representations from RGB images. In addition, we develop a coarse-to-fine training strategy that leverages estimated materials to guide diffusion models to satisfy multi-view consistent constraints, leading to more stable and accurate results. Extensive experiments on real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on material recovery. The code will be available at https://zju3dv.github.io/IntrinsicAnything/.

title: Xi Chen, Zhiheng Liu, Mengting Chen, Yutong Feng, Yu Liu, Yujun Shen, Hengshuang Zhao*
title_en: Xi Chen, Zhiheng Liu, Mengting Chen, Yutong Feng, Yu Liu, Yujun Shen, Hengshuang Zhao*
abstract: 尽管文本到视频生成领域近期取得了进展,现有研究通常忽视了一个问题:合成视频中仅空间内容而非时间运动受文本控制。针对这一挑战,本文提出一个实用系统,名为__TITLE_MATH_1__,允许用户通过文本描述对感兴趣图像进行动画化。我们首先建立一个强基线,帮助已训练良好的文本到图像生成器(即Stable Diffusion)进一步接受图像作为输入。随后,我们为改进的生成器配备运动模块进行时间建模,并提出精心设计的训练流程以更好地关联文本与运动。特别是考虑到(1)文本只能粗略描述运动(例如,不考虑移动速度)和(2)文本可能同时包含内容与运动描述,我们引入运动强度估计模块以及文本重加权模块以降低文本到运动映射的歧义性。实证研究表明,我们的方法能够有效将与运动相关的文本指令解码为视频,例如动作、摄像机运动,甚至凭空生成新内容(例如,将水倒入空玻璃杯)。有趣的是,得益于所提出的强度学习机制,我们的系统为视频定制提供了除文本外的额外控制信号(即运动强度)。项目页面为xavierchen34.github.io/LivePhoto-Page.
abstract_en: Despite the recent progress in text-to-video generation, existing studies usually overlook the issue that only spatial contents but not temporal motions in synthesized videos are under the control of text. Towards such a challenge, this work presents a practical system, named , which allows users to animate an image of their interest with text descriptions. We first establish a strong baseline that helps a well-learned text-to-image generator (i.e., Stable Diffusion) take an image as a further input. We then equip the improved generator with a motion module for temporal modeling and propose a carefully designed training pipeline to better link texts and motions. In particular, considering the facts that (1) text can only describe motions roughly (e.g., regardless of the moving speed) and (2) text may include both content and motion descriptions, we introduce a motion intensity estimation module as well as a text re-weighting module to reduce the ambiguity of text-to-motion mapping. Empirical evidence suggests that our approach is capable of well decoding motion-related textual instructions into videos, such as actions, camera movements, or even conjuring new contents from thin air (e.g., pouring water into an empty glass). Interestingly, thanks to the proposed intensity learning mechanism, our system offers users an additional control signal (i.e., the motion intensity) besides text for video customization. Project page is xavierchen34.github.io/LivePhoto-Page.

title: Xi Yang*, Chenhang He, Jianqi Ma, Lei Zhang
title_en: Xi Yang*, Chenhang He, Jianqi Ma, Lei Zhang
abstract: 现实世界中的低分辨率(LR)视频具有多样且复杂的退化现象,这对视频超分辨率(VSR)算法提出了巨大挑战,使其难以高质量地重建高分辨率(HR)版本。近年来,扩散模型在图像修复任务中展现出生成逼真细节的强大性能。然而,扩散过程具有随机性,使得难以控制修复图像的内容。这一问题在将扩散模型应用于VSR任务时尤为严重,因为时间一致性对视频的感知质量至关重要。本文提出了一种有效的现实世界VSR算法,利用预训练潜在扩散模型的优势。为确保相邻帧间的内容一致性,我们通过优化运动引导损失,利用LR视频中的时间动态性指导扩散过程,优化潜在采样路径,确保生成的HR视频保持连贯且连续的视觉流。为进一步缓解生成细节的不连续性,我们在解码器中插入时间模块,并通过创新的序列导向损失进行微调。所提出的基于运动引导潜在扩散(MGLD)的VSR算法在现实世界VSR基准数据集上显著优于现有最先进的方法,验证了所提出模型设计和训练策略的有效性。代码和模型可在https://github.com/IanYeung/MGLD-V获取。
abstract_en: Real-world low-resolution (LR) videos have diverse and complex degradations, imposing great challenges on video super-resolution (VSR) algorithms to reproduce their high-resolution (HR) counterparts with high quality. Recently, the diffusion models have shown compelling performance in generating realistic details for image restoration tasks. However, the diffusion process has randomness, making it hard to control the contents of restored images. This issue becomes more serious when applying diffusion models to VSR tasks because temporal consistency is crucial to the perceptual quality of videos. In this paper, we propose an effective real-world VSR algorithm by leveraging the strength of pre-trained latent diffusion models. To ensure the content consistency among adjacent frames, we exploit the temporal dynamics in LR videos to guide the diffusion process by optimizing the latent sampling path with a motion-guided loss, ensuring that the generated HR video maintains a coherent and continuous visual flow. To further mitigate the discontinuity of generated details, we insert temporal module to the decoder and fine-tune it with an innovative sequence-oriented loss. The proposed motion-guided latent diffusion (MGLD) based VSR algorithm achieves significantly better perceptual quality than state-of-the-arts on real-world VSR benchmark datasets, validating the effectiveness of the proposed model design and training strategies. Codes and models are available at https://github.com/IanYeung/MGLD-V

title: Xi Yang, Songsong Duan*, Nannan Wang, Xinbo Gao
title_en: Xi Yang, Songsong Duan*, Nannan Wang, Xinbo Gao
abstract: 弱监督目标定位(WSOL)旨在仅使用图像级标签进行目标定位,因其在实际应用中具有低成本的标注特性而受到广泛关注。当前研究主要聚焦于卷积神经网络(CNN)的类激活图(CAM)和Transformer的自注意力图,以识别目标区域。然而,CAM和自注意力图均无法学习前景目标的像素级细粒度信息,这阻碍了WSOL的进一步发展。为解决这一问题,我们主动利用Segment Anything Model(SAM)的零样本泛化能力和细粒度分割能力,以增强整体目标区域的激活。进一步地,为缓解基于单点提示的SAM中语义歧义问题,我们提出一种创新的网格点提示(Pro2SAM)网络,用于WSOL任务。首先,我们设计了一个全局标记Transformer(GTFormer),生成粗粒度前景图作为灵活的掩码提示,其中GTFormer联合嵌入块标记和新颖的全局标记以学习前景语义。其次,我们将网格点作为密集提示输入SAM,以最大化前景掩码的概率,避免单点/框提示导致的目标缺失。最后,我们提出一种像素级相似度度量方法,实现从掩码提示到SAM的掩码匹配,其中得分最高的掩码被视为最终的定位图。实验表明,所提出的Pro2SAM在CUB-200-2011和ILSVRC数据集上分别达到84.03%和66.85%的Top-1 Loc,达到最先进水平。
abstract_en: Weakly Supervised Object Localization (WSOL), which aims to localize objects by only using image-level labels, has attracted much attention because of its low annotation cost in real applications. Current studies focus on the Class Activation Map (CAM) of CNN and the self-attention map of transformer to identify the region of objects. However, both CAM and self-attention maps can not learn pixel-level fine-grained information on the foreground objects, which hinders the further advance of WSOL. To address this problem, we initiatively leverage the capability of zero-shot generalization and fine-grained segmentation in Segment Anything Model (SAM) to boost the activation of integral object regions. Further, to alleviate the semantic ambiguity issue accrued in single point prompt-based SAM, we propose an innovative mask prompt to SAM (Pro2SAM) network with grid points for WSOL task. First, we devise a Global Token Transformer (GTFormer) to generate a coarse-grained foreground map as a flexible mask prompt, where the GTFormer jointly embeds patch tokens and novel global tokens to learn foreground semantics. Secondly, we deliver grid points as dense prompts into SAM to maximize the probability of foreground mask, which avoids the lack of objects caused by a single point/box prompt. Finally, we propose a pixel-level similarity metric to come true the mask matching from mask prompt to SAM, where the mask with the highest score is viewed as the final localization map. Experiments show that the proposed Pro2SAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on both CUB-200-2011 and ILSVRC, with 84.03% and 66.85% Top-1 Loc, respectively.

title: Xiang An, Kaicheng Yang, Xiangzi Dai, Ziyong Feng, Jiankang Deng*
title_en: Xiang An, Kaicheng Yang, Xiangzi Dai, Ziyong Feng, Jiankang Deng*
abstract: 对比语言-图像预训练(CLIP)由于图像-文本对比学习带来的优越特征表示,在各类任务中展现出显著的成功。然而,CLIP采用的实例判别方法难以编码训练数据的语义结构。为解决这一局限性,通过迭代聚类分配和分类提出了聚类判别方法。尽管如此,大多数聚类判别方法仅对每张图像定义单一伪标签,忽略了图像中的多标签信号。本文提出了一种新型多标签聚类判别方法MLCD,以增强表征学习。在聚类步骤中,我们基于现成的嵌入特征,将大规模LAION-400M数据集聚类为一百万个中心。考虑到自然图像常包含多个视觉对象或属性,我们选择多个最近的中心作为辅助类别标签。在判别步骤中,我们设计了一种新颖的多标签分类损失函数,该函数优雅地分离正类和负类的损失,并缓解决策边界上的模糊性。我们在不同规模的模型和预训练数据集上验证了所提出的多标签聚类判别方法。实验结果表明,我们的方法在包括线性探针、零样本分类和图像-文本检索在内的多个下游任务中均达到最先进性能。
abstract_en: Contrastive Language Image Pre-training (CLIP) has recently demonstrated success across various tasks due to superior feature representation empowered by image-text contrastive learning. However, the instance discrimination method used by CLIP can hardly encode the semantic structure of training data. To handle this limitation, cluster discrimination has been proposed through iterative cluster assignment and classification. Nevertheless, most cluster discrimination approaches only define a single pseudo-label for each image, neglecting multi-label signals in the image. In this paper, we propose a novel Multi-Label Cluster Discrimination method named MLCD to enhance representation learning. In the clustering step, we first cluster the large-scale LAION-400M dataset into one million centers based on off-the-shelf embedding features. Considering that natural images frequently contain multiple visual objects or attributes, we select the multiple closest centers as auxiliary class labels. In the discrimination step, we design a novel multi-label classification loss, which elegantly separates losses from positive classes and negative classes, and alleviates ambiguity on decision boundary. We validate the proposed multi-label cluster discrimination method with experiments on different scales of models and pre-training datasets. Experimental results show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple downstream tasks including linear probe, zero-shot classification, and image-text retrieval.

title: Xiang Fan*, Anand Bhattad, Ranjay Krishna
title_en: Xiang Fan*, Anand Bhattad, Ranjay Krishna
abstract: 我们提出了一种无需训练的视频编辑算法__TITLE_MATH_1__,允许用户使用任何编辑软件(包括Photoshop和生成填充)修改第一帧;该算法会自动将这些更改以语义、空间和时间一致的运动方式传播到剩余帧。与现有仅通过不精确文本指令进行编辑的方法不同,__TITLE_MATH_1__允许用户以精细的控制方式添加或移除对象、语义更改对象、将库存照片插入视频等,可精确控制位置和外观。我们通过基于图像的视频编辑实现这一功能,通过噪声外推反转潜在变量,从而生成以编辑后的图像为条件的视频。在两个编辑基准测试中,使用10个评估指标,__TITLE_MATH_1__在6个基线方法上实现了更高的编辑质量。
abstract_en: We introduce , a training-free video editing algorithm for localized semantic edits. allows users to use any editing software, including Photoshop and generative inpainting, to modify the first frame; it automatically propagates those changes, with semantic, spatial, and temporally consistent motion, to the remaining frames. Unlike existing methods that enable edits only through imprecise textual instructions, allows users to add or remove objects, semantically change objects, insert stock photos into videos, etc. with fine-grained control over locations and appearance. We achieve this through image-based video editing by inverting latents with noise extrapolation, from which we generate videos conditioned on the edited image. produces higher quality edits against 6 baselines on 2 editing benchmarks using 10 evaluation metrics.

title: Xiang Fang, Zeyu Xiong, Wanlong Fang, Xiaoye Qu, Chen Chen, Jianfeng Dong, Keke Tang, Pan Zhou*, Yu Cheng, Daizong Liu*
title_en: Xiang Fang, Zeyu Xiong, Wanlong Fang, Xiaoye Qu, Chen Chen, Jianfeng Dong, Keke Tang, Pan Zhou*, Yu Cheng, Daizong Liu*
abstract: 本文研究了弱监督视频时间定位这一具有挑战性的任务。现有方法大多基于时刻提案选择框架,利用对比学习和重建范式对预定义的时刻提案进行评分。尽管这些方法取得了显著进展,但我们认为当前框架忽略了两个不可或缺的问题:1)粗粒度跨模态学习:先前方法仅捕捉视频级全局对齐与查询之间的关系,未能建模视频帧与查询词之间的详细一致性,以准确定位时刻边界。2)复杂时刻提案:其性能严重依赖提案的质量,而提案的生成也耗时且复杂。为此,本文首次尝试从新颖的游戏视角解决该任务,有效学习每对视觉-语言单元之间不同粒度和灵活组合的不确定关系,以实现多级跨模态交互。具体而言,我们创造性地将每个视频帧和查询词建模为多变量合作博弈论中的游戏参与者,以学习其对跨模态相似度评分的贡献。通过量化联盟内帧-词合作趋势的博弈论交互,我们能够评估帧与词之间所有不确定但可能的对应关系。最后,我们不再使用时刻提案,而是利用学习到的查询引导的帧级评分以实现更精确的时刻定位。实验表明,我们的方法在Charades-STA和ActivityNet Caption数据集上均取得了优越的性能。
abstract_en: This paper addresses the challenging task of weakly-supervised video temporal grounding. Existing approaches are generally based on the moment proposal selection framework that utilizes contrastive learning and reconstruction paradigm for scoring the pre-defined moment proposals. Although they have achieved significant progress, we argue that their current frameworks have overlooked two indispensable issues: 1) Coarse-grained cross-modal learning: previous methods solely capture the global video-level alignment with the query, failing to model the detailed consistency between video frames and query words for accurately grounding the moment boundaries. 2) Complex moment proposals: their performance severely relies on the quality of proposals, which are also time-consuming and complicated for selection. To this end, in this paper, we make the first attempt to tackle this task from a novel game perspective, which effectively learns the uncertain relationship between each vision-language pair with diverse granularity and flexible combination for multi-level cross-modal interaction. Specifically, we creatively model each video frame and query word as game players with multivariate cooperative game theory to learn their contribution to the cross-modal similarity score. By quantifying the trend of frame-word cooperation within a coalition via the game-theoretic interaction, we are able to value all uncertain but possible correspondence between frames and words. Finally, instead of using moment proposals, we utilize the learned query-guided frame-wise scores for better moment localization. Experiments show that our method achieves superior performance on both Charades-STA and ActivityNet Caption datasets.

title: Xiang Li*, Jian Ding, Zhaoyang Chen, Mohamed Elhoseiny
title_en: Xiang Li*, Jian Ding, Zhaoyang Chen, Mohamed Elhoseiny
abstract: 我们提出Uni3DL,这是一个用于三维视觉-语言理解的统一模型。与现有主要依赖投影多视角图像且仅支持有限任务的统一三维视觉-语言模型不同,Uni3DL直接在点云上操作,显著扩展了三维领域任务的范围,涵盖视觉任务和视觉-语言任务。Uni3DL的核心是一个查询变换器,通过关注三维视觉特征来学习任务无关的语义和掩码输出,并采用任务路由器选择性地生成多样化任务所需的特定任务输出。凭借统一的架构,我们的Uni3DL模型实现了无缝的任务分解和跨任务的大量参数共享。Uni3DL已在包括语义分割、目标检测、实例分割、视觉定位、三维字幕生成以及文本-三维跨模态检索等多样的三维视觉-语言理解任务中进行了严格评估,其性能与或超越现有最先进的(SOTA)任务专用模型。我们希望我们的基准测试和Uni3DL模型能成为推动未来三维视觉-语言理解统一模型研究的坚实一步。项目页面:https://uni3dl.github.io/
abstract_en: We present Uni3DL, a unified model for 3D Vision-Language understanding. Distinct from existing unified 3D vision-language models that mostly rely on projected multi-view images and support limited tasks, Uni3DL operates directly on point clouds and significantly broadens the spectrum of tasks in the 3D domain, encompassing both vision and vision-language tasks. At the core of Uni3DL, a query transformer is designed to learn task-agnostic semantic and mask outputs by attending to 3D visual features, and a task router is employed to selectively produce task-specific outputs required for diverse tasks. With a unified architecture, our Uni3DL model enjoys seamless task decomposition and substantial parameter sharing across tasks. Uni3DL has been rigorously evaluated across diverse 3D vision-language understanding tasks, including semantic segmentation, object detection, instance segmentation, visual grounding, 3D captioning, and text-3D cross-modal retrieval. It demonstrates performance on par with or surpassing state-of-the-art (SOTA) task-specific models. We hope our benchmark and Uni3DL model will serve as a solid step to ease future research in unified models in the realm of 3D vision-language understanding. Project page: https://uni3dl.github.io/.

title: Xiang Li*, Kai Qiu, Jinglu Wang, Xiaohao Xu, Kashu Yamazaki, Hao Chen, Rita Singh, Xiaonan Huang, Bhiksha Raj
title_en: Xiang Li*, Kai Qiu, Jinglu Wang, Xiaohao Xu, Kashu Yamazaki, Hao Chen, Rita Singh, Xiaonan Huang, Bhiksha Raj
abstract: 指称感知旨在通过多模态指称引导将视觉对象进行定位,是弥合提供指令的人类与智能系统感知环境之间鸿沟的关键。尽管该领域已取得进展,但指称感知模型(RPMs)对破坏性扰动的鲁棒性仍缺乏深入研究。本工作全面评估了RPMs在通用和特定场景下对各类扰动的抗扰能力。鉴于指称感知任务的复杂性,我们提出了一种扰动分类学,并开发了一个通用工具箱,用于合成和评估复合扰动的影响。通过该工具箱,我们构建了R2-Bench,作为评估指称感知模型在噪声条件下的鲁棒性的基准测试平台,涵盖五个关键任务。此外,我们提出了基于大语言模型(LLM)的R2-Agent,通过自然语言指令简化和自动化模型评估流程。我们的研究揭示了当前RPMs对各类扰动的脆弱性,并提供了评估模型鲁棒性的工具,有望推动智能系统在复杂现实场景中的安全可靠集成。
abstract_en: Referring perception, which aims at grounding visual objects with multimodal referring guidance, is essential for bridging the gap between humans, who provide instructions, and the environment where intelligent systems perceive. Despite progress in this field, the robustness of referring perception models (RPMs) against disruptive perturbations is not well explored. This work thoroughly assesses the resilience of RPMs against various perturbations in both general and specific contexts. Recognizing the complex nature of referring perception tasks, we present a comprehensive taxonomy of perturbations, and then develop a versatile toolbox for synthesizing and evaluating the effects of composite disturbances. Employing this toolbox, we construct R2 -Bench, a benchmark for assessing the Robustness of Referring perception models under noisy conditions across five key tasks. Moreover, we propose the R2 -Agent, an LLM-based agent that simplifies and automates model evaluation via natural language instructions. Our investigation uncovers the vulnerabilities of current RPMs to various perturbations and provides tools for assessing model robustness, potentially promoting the safe and resilient integration of intelligent systems into complex real-world scenarios.

title: Xiang Liu, Zhaoxiang Liu*, Huan Hu, Zezhou Chen, Kohou Wang, Kai Wang, Shiguo Lian*
title_en: Xiang Liu, Zhaoxiang Liu*, Huan Hu, Zezhou Chen, Kohou Wang, Kai Wang, Shiguo Lian*
abstract: 尽管对话生成式AI在提升农业专业人员决策能力方面展现出巨大潜力,但其探索主要局限于基于文本的交互方式。借助来自多源的大量图像-文本数据,多模态对话AI的发展标志着重要进展。然而,将此类先进视觉-语言模型应用于农业领域,特别是在作物病害诊断方面仍研究较少。本文提出作物病害领域多模态(CDDM)数据集,这是一个开创性资源,旨在通过多模态学习技术推动农业研究。该数据集包含137,000张各类作物病害图像,配套100万组涵盖农业知识广泛领域的问答对,从病害识别到管理实践。通过融合视觉与文本数据,CDDM促进了复杂问答系统的开发,能够为农民和农业专业人员提供精准有用的建议。我们通过微调最先进的多模态模型验证了该数据集的实用性,展示了作物病害诊断方面的显著提升。具体而言,我们采用了一种新颖的微调策略,利用低秩适应(LoRA)同时微调视觉编码器、适配器和语言模型。我们的贡献不仅包括该数据集,还包括微调策略和基准测试,以激发农业技术领域的进一步研究,旨在弥合先进AI技术与实际农业应用之间的差距。数据集可在https://github.com/UnicomAI/UnicomBenchmark/tree/main/CDDMBench获取。
abstract_en: While conversational generative AI has shown considerable potential in enhancing decision-making for agricultural professionals, its exploration has predominantly been anchored in text-based interactions. The evolution of multimodal conversational AI, leveraging vast amounts of image-text data from diverse sources, marks a significant stride forward. However, the application of such advanced vision-language models in the agricultural domain, particularly for crop disease diagnosis, remains underexplored. In this work, we present the crop disease domain multimodal (CDDM) dataset, a pioneering resource designed to advance the field of agricultural research through the application of multimodal learning techniques. The dataset comprises 137,000 images of various crop diseases, accompanied by 1 million question-answer pairs that span a broad spectrum of agricultural knowledge, from disease identification to management practices. By integrating visual and textual data, CDDM facilitates the development of sophisticated question-answering systems capable of providing precise, useful advice to farmers and agricultural professionals. We demonstrate the utility of the dataset by finetuning state-of-the-art multimodal models, showcasing significant improvements in crop disease diagnosis. Specifically, we employed a novel finetuning strategy that utilizes low-rank adaptation (LoRA) to finetune the visual encoder, adapter and language model simultaneously. Our contributions include not only the dataset but also a finetuning strategy and a benchmark to stimulate further research in agricultural technology, aiming to bridge the gap between advanced AI techniques and practical agricultural applications. The dataset is available at https://github. com/UnicomAI/UnicomBenchmark/tree/main/CDDMBench.

title: Xiang Xu*, Lingdong Kong, Hui Shuai, Wenwei Zhang, Liang Pan, Kai Chen, Ziwei Liu, Qingshan Liu*
title_en: Xiang Xu*, Lingdong Kong, Hui Shuai, Wenwei Zhang, Liang Pan, Kai Chen, Ziwei Liu, Qingshan Liu*
abstract: 在自动驾驶领域,精确的三维感知是基础。然而,开发此类模型依赖于大量的人工标注——这一过程既昂贵又耗时。为从数据表示学习的角度解决这一挑战,我们引入了SuperFlow,一个新颖的框架,旨在利用连续的激光雷达-摄像头配对以建立时空预训练目标。SuperFlow通过两个关键设计脱颖而出:1)密集到稀疏的一致性正则化,促进特征学习过程中对点云密度变化的不敏感性;2)基于流的对比学习模块,精心设计以从易获取的传感器标定中提取有意义的时间线索。为进一步提升学习效率,我们引入了一个即插即用的视图一致性模块,增强从摄像头视图中蒸馏知识的对齐效果。在11个异构激光雷达数据集上的大量对比和消融实验验证了我们的有效性与优越性。此外,我们在预训练过程中通过扩大二维和三维主干网络观察到一些有趣的新兴特性,为基于激光雷达的感知三维基础模型的未来研究提供了启示。代码已公开在https: //github.com/Xiangxu-0103/SuperFlow。
abstract_en: In the realm of autonomous driving, accurate 3D perception is the foundation. However, developing such models relies on extensive human annotations – a process that is both costly and labor-intensive. To address this challenge from a data representation learning perspective, we introduce SuperFlow, a novel framework designed to harness consecutive LiDAR-camera pairs for establishing spatiotemporal pretraining objectives. SuperFlow stands out by integrating two key designs: 1) a dense-to-sparse consistency regularization, which promotes insensitivity to point cloud density variations during feature learning, and 2) a flow-based contrastive learning module, carefully crafted to extract meaningful temporal cues from readily available sensor calibrations. To further boost learning efficiency, we incorporate a plug-and-play view consistency module that enhances the alignment of the knowledge distilled from camera views. Extensive comparative and ablation studies across 11 heterogeneous LiDAR datasets validate our effectiveness and superiority. Additionally, we observe several interesting emerging properties by scaling up the 2D and 3D backbones during pretraining, shedding light on the future research of 3D foundation models for LiDAR-based perception. Code is publicly available at https: //github.com/Xiangxu-0103/SuperFlow.

title: Xianghao Kong, Jinyu Chen, Wenguan Wang*, Hang Su, Xiaolin Hu, Yi Yang, Si Liu*
title_en: Xianghao Kong, Jinyu Chen, Wenguan Wang*, Hang Su, Xiaolin Hu, Yi Yang, Si Liu*
abstract: 指令生成是一个重要且跨学科的研究领域,具有广泛的应用。现有的指令生成模型局限于从特定数据集中生成单一风格的指令,且生成的指令风格和内容无法控制。此外,大多数现有指令生成方法也忽视了导航环境的空间建模。借助大语言模型(LLMs)的能力,我们提出C-Instructor,该模型利用思维链式提示实现风格可控且内容可控的指令生成。首先,我们提出带有地标信息的思维链(CoTL)机制,引导LLM识别关键地标并生成完整指令。CoTL使生成的指令更易于遵循,并提供了对地标物体操作的更大可控性。此外,我们提出空间拓扑建模任务以促进对环境空间结构的理解。最后,我们引入风格混合训练策略,利用LLM的先验知识,在单个模型实例中基于不同提示实现指令生成的风格控制。大量实验表明,C-Instructor生成的指令在文本指标、导航引导评估和用户研究中均优于先前方法。
abstract_en: Instruction generation is a vital and multidisciplinary research area with broad applications. Existing instruction generation models are limited to generating instructions in a single style from a particular dataset, and the style and content of generated instructions cannot be controlled. Moreover, most existing instruction generation methods also disregard the spatial modeling of the navigation environment. Leveraging the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), we propose C-Instructor, which utilizes the chain-of-thought-style prompt for style-controllable and content-controllable instruction generation. Firstly, we propose a Chain of Thought with Landmarks (CoTL) mechanism, which guides the LLM to identify key landmarks and then generate complete instructions. CoTL renders generated instructions more accessible to follow and offers greater controllability over the manipulation of landmark objects. Furthermore, we present a Spatial Topology Modeling Task to facilitate the understanding of the spatial structure of the environment. Finally, we introduce a Style-Mixed Training policy, harnessing the prior knowledge of LLMs to enable style control for instruction generation based on different prompts within a single model instance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that instructions generated by C-Instructor outperform those generated by previous methods in text metrics, navigation guidance evaluation, and user studies.

title: Xianglong He, Junyi Chen, Sida Peng, Di Huang, Yangguang Li, Xiaoshui Huang, Chun Yuan*, Wanli Ouyang, Tong He*
title_en: Xianglong He, Junyi Chen, Sida Peng, Di Huang, Yangguang Li, Xiaoshui Huang, Chun Yuan*, Wanli Ouyang, Tong He*
abstract: 近年来,三维高斯点云技术作为一种强大的三维重建与生成方法崭露头角,以其快速且高质量的渲染能力而著称。然而,这些方法往往存在局限性,要么无法生成多样化的样本,要么需要较长的推理时间。为解决这些问题,本文提出了一种新颖的基于扩散的框架GVGEN,旨在高效地从文本输入生成三维高斯表示。我们提出了两项创新技术:(1) 结构化体积表示。我们首先将无序的三维高斯点排列为结构化形式的GaussianVolume。这种转换使得在固定数量的高斯点组成的体积内能够捕捉到复杂的纹理细节。为了更好地优化这些细节的表示,我们提出了一种独特的候选池策略,通过选择性优化提升细节保真度。(2) 粗到细生成流程。为简化GaussianVolume的生成并增强模型生成具有精细三维几何结构实例的能力,我们提出了一种粗到细的生成流程。该流程首先构建基础几何结构,随后预测完整的高斯属性。我们的框架GVGEN在定性和定量评估中均优于现有的三维生成方法。同时,它保持了快速的生成速度(约7秒),有效平衡了质量和效率。我们的项目页面是https://gvgen.github.io/。∗ 等贡献。† 通讯作者。
abstract_en: In recent years, 3D Gaussian splatting has emerged as a powerful technique for 3D reconstruction and generation, known for its fast and high-quality rendering capabilities. Nevertheless, these methods often come with limitations, either lacking the ability to produce diverse samples or requiring prolonged inference times. To address these shortcomings, this paper introduces a novel diffusion-based framework, GVGEN, designed to efficiently generate 3D Gaussian representations from text input. We propose two innovative techniques: (1) Structured Volumetric Representation. We first arrange disorganized 3D Gaussian points as a structured form GaussianVolume. This transformation allows the capture of intricate texture details within a volume composed of a fixed number of Gaussians. To better optimize the representation of these details, we propose a unique pruning and densifying method named the Candidate Pool Strategy, enhancing detail fidelity through selective optimization. (2) Coarse-to-fine Generation Pipeline. To simplify the generation of GaussianVolume and empower the model to generate instances with detailed 3D geometry, we propose a coarse-to-fine pipeline. It initially constructs a basic geometric structure, followed by the prediction of complete Gaussian attributes. Our framework, GVGEN, demonstrates superior performance in qualitative and quantitative assessments compared to existing 3D generation methods. Simultaneously, it maintains a fast generation speed (∼7 seconds), effectively striking a balance between quality and efficiency. Our project page is https://gvgen.github.io/. ∗ Equal Contribution. † Corresponding Authors.

title: Xiangtian Xue, Jiasong Wu*, Youyong Kong, Lotfi Senhadji, Huazhong Shu
title_en: Xiangtian Xue, Jiasong Wu*, Youyong Kong, Lotfi Senhadji, Huazhong Shu
abstract: 我们提出了一种新型图像编辑场景,称为基于文本的物体生成(TOG),其定义为根据文本描述在真实图像空间中生成新物体。现有扩散模型在复杂现实场景中存在空间感知的局限性,依赖额外模态来施加约束,而TOG在弱语言监督下对场景理解提出了更高挑战。我们提出了一种基于Swin-Transformer的通用框架ST-LDM,可无训练地集成至任何潜在扩散模型中通过反向引导。ST-LDM包含具有自适应压缩尺度和分层视觉特征的全局感知自编码器,并与可变形多模态变换器并行,用于生成区域级引导以进行后续去噪过程。我们通过引入可变形特征对齐,超越了传统注意力机制仅关注现有视觉特征的局限性,通过多尺度视觉与语言信息融合的分层空间定位进行精细调整。大量实验表明,我们的模型在保持扩散模型固有生成能力的同时,增强了注意力机制的定位能力。
abstract_en: We present a novel image editing scenario termed Text-grounded Object Generation (TOG), defined as generating a new object in the real image spatially conditioned by textual descriptions. Existing diffusion models exhibit limitations of spatial perception in complex real-world scenes, relying on additional modalities to enforce constraints, and TOG imposes heightened challenges on scene comprehension under the weak supervision of linguistic information. We propose a universal framework ST-LDM based on Swin-Transformer, which can be integrated into any latent diffusion model with training-free backward guidance. ST-LDM encompasses a global-perceptual autoencoder with adaptable compression scales and hierarchical visual features, parallel with deformable multimodal transformer to generate region-wise guidance for the subsequent denoising process. We transcend the limitation of traditional attention mechanisms that only focus on existing visual features by introducing deformable feature alignment to hierarchically refine spatial positioning fused with multi-scale visual and linguistic information. Extensive Experiments demonstrate that our model enhances the localization of attention mechanisms while preserving the generative capabilities inherent to diffusion models.

title: Xiangxiang Chu*, Jianlin Su, Bo Zhang*, Chunhua Shen
title_en: Xiangxiang Chu*, Jianlin Su, Bo Zhang*, Chunhua Shen
abstract: 众所周知,大语言模型是基于Transformer架构构建的,用于处理文本输入。例如,LLaMA系列模型在众多开源实现中脱颖而出。那么,同样的Transformer能否用于处理2D图像?本文通过揭示一种类似LLaMA的视觉Transformer模型(以平铺和金字塔形式呈现),回答了这一问题。该模型专门为此目的设计,是一个统一且通用的建模框架,适用于解决大多数视觉任务。我们广泛评估了其在图像感知和特别是图像生成任务中的有效性,采用典型的预训练范式在大量下游任务中进行验证。在许多情况下,该模型在先前最先进的视觉Transformer基础上表现出显著性能提升。我们希望计算机视觉领域的研究者能够应用本文提出的方法,解决各种具体的图像生成与感知任务。代码地址:https://github.com/Meituan-AutoML/VisionLLaMA
abstract_en: We all know that large language models are built on top of a transformer-based architecture to process textual inputs. For example, the LLaMA family of models stands out among many open-source implementations. Can the same transformer be used to process 2D images? In this paper, we answer this question by unveiling a LLaMA-like vision transformer in plain and pyramid forms, termed , which is tailored for this purpose. is a unified and generic modeling framework for solving most vision tasks. We extensively evaluate its effectiveness using typical pre-training paradigms in a good portion of downstream tasks of image perception and especially image generation. In many cases, has exhibited substantial gains over the previous state-of-the-art vision transformers. It is our hope that researchers in computer vision can apply presented here to solve various specific image generation and perception tasks. Code is at: https://github.com/Meituan-AutoML/VisionLLaMA

title: Xiangyu Chen*, Zheyuan Li, Yuandong Pu, Yihao Liu, Jiantao Zhou*, Yu Qiao, Chao Dong*
title_en: Xiangyu Chen*, Zheyuan Li, Yuandong Pu, Yihao Liu, Jiantao Zhou*, Yu Qiao, Chao Dong*
abstract: 尽管深度模型在各种图像修复任务中取得了显著进展,现有的图像修复网络在任务泛化性方面仍面临挑战。一个直观的表现是,某些任务表现优异的网络在其他任务中往往难以取得令人满意的结果。为了说明这一点,我们选择了五个代表性的网络,并对五个经典图像修复任务进行了比较研究。首先,我们详细解释了不同图像修复任务和主干网络的特征。随后,我们提供了基准结果,并分析了不同模型在不同任务中性能差异的原因。基于此比较研究,我们提出了一种通用图像修复主干网络需要满足多样化任务的功能需求。基于这一原则,我们设计了一种新的通用图像修复主干网络,X-Restormer。大量实验表明,X-Restormer具有良好的任务泛化性,并在多种任务中取得了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Despite the significant progress made by deep models in various image restoration tasks, existing image restoration networks still face challenges in terms of task generality. An intuitive manifestation is that networks which excel in certain tasks often fail to deliver satisfactory results in others. To illustrate this point, we select five representative networks and conduct a comparative study on five classic image restoration tasks. First, we provide a detailed explanation of the characteristics of different image restoration tasks and backbone networks. Following this, we present the benchmark results and analyze the reasons behind the performance disparity of different models across various tasks. Drawing from this comparative study, we propose that a general image restoration backbone network needs to meet the functional requirements of diverse tasks. Based on this principle, we design a new general image restoration backbone network, X-Restormer. Extensive experiments demonstrate that X-Restormer possesses good task generality and achieves state-of-the-art performance across a variety of tasks.

title: Xiangyu Fan*, Jiaqi Li, Zhiqian Lin, Weiye Xiao, Lei Yang*
title_en: Xiangyu Fan*, Jiaqi Li, Zhiqian Lin, Weiye Xiao, Lei Yang*
abstract: 音频驱动的3D面部动画旨在将输入音频映射到逼真的面部运动。尽管取得了显著进展,但不一致的3D注释限制了先前模型的训练规模,使其只能在特定注释上进行训练。在本工作中,我们提出了UniTalker,这是一个具有多头架构的统一模型,旨在有效利用具有不同注释的数据集。为了增强训练稳定性并确保多头输出的一致性,我们采用了三种训练策略,即PCA、模型预热和枢轴身份嵌入。为了扩展训练规模和多样性,我们构建了A2F-Bench,包含五个公开数据集和三个新整理的数据集。这些数据集涵盖了广泛的音频领域,包括多语言语音和歌曲,从而将训练数据量从通常使用的不足1小时的数据集扩展到18.5小时。通过单个训练的UniTalker模型,我们在BIWI数据集上实现了9.2%的唇部顶点误差减少,在Vocaset数据集上实现了13.7%的误差减少。此外,预训练的UniTalker作为音频驱动面部动画任务的基础模型展现出潜力。在已见数据集上微调预训练的UniTalker可进一步提升各数据集的性能,在A2F-Bench上平均误差减少6.3%。此外,仅使用半量数据对UniTalker进行微调,在未见数据集上的表现超过了在完整数据集上训练的先前最先进模型。代码和数据集可在项目页面1获取。1 项目主页:https://github.com/X-niper/UniTalker
abstract_en: Audio-driven 3D facial animation aims to map input audio to realistic facial motion. Despite significant progress, limitations arise from inconsistent 3D annotations, restricting previous models to training on specific annotations and thereby constraining the training scale. In this work, we present UniTalker, a unified model featuring a multi-head architecture designed to effectively leverage datasets with varied annotations. To enhance training stability and ensure consistency among multi-head outputs, we employ three training strategies, namely, PCA, model warm-up, and pivot identity embedding. To expand the training scale and diversity, we assemble A2F-Bench, comprising five publicly available datasets and three newly curated datasets. These datasets contain a wide range of audio domains, covering multilingual speech voices and songs, thereby scaling the training data from commonly employed datasets, typically less than 1 hour, to 18.5 hours. With a single trained UniTalker model, we achieve substantial lip vertex error reductions of 9.2% for BIWI dataset and 13.7% for Vocaset. Additionally, the pre-trained UniTalker exhibits promise as the foundation model for audio-driven facial animation tasks. Fine-tuning the pre-trained UniTalker on seen datasets further enhances performance on each dataset, with an average error reduction of 6.3% on A2F-Bench. Moreover, fine-tuning UniTalker on an unseen dataset with only half the data surpasses prior state-of-the-art models trained on the full dataset. The code and dataset are available at the project page1 . 1 Homepage: https://github.com/X-niper/UniTalker

title: Xiangyu Liao*, Tianheng Zheng, Jiayu Zhong, Pingping Zhang, Chao Ren*
title_en: Xiangyu Liao*, Tianheng Zheng, Jiayu Zhong, Pingping Zhang, Chao Ren*
abstract: 近年来,自监督去噪方法在图像修复领域取得了显著成功,并变得至关重要。其中,基于盲点网络的方法是最典型的类型,吸引了大量研究人员的关注。尽管引入盲点操作可以防止噪声到噪声的恒等映射,但它对网络设计中的感受野提出了严格要求,从而限制了整体性能。为解决这一挑战,我们提出了一种单掩码方案用于自监督去噪训练,消除了对盲点操作的依赖,从而去除对网络结构设计的约束。此外,为实现推理过程中整幅图像的去噪,我们提出了一种多掩码方案。我们的方法在训练和推理中采用非对称掩码方案,在现有真实噪声图像数据集上实现了最先进的性能。代码将发布在https://github.com/lll143653/amsnet。
abstract_en: In recent years, self-supervised denoising methods have gained significant success and become critically important in the field of image restoration. Among them, the blind spot network based methods are the most typical type and have attracted the attentions of a large number of researchers. Although the introduction of blind spot operations can prevent identity mapping from noise to noise, it imposes stringent requirements on the receptive fields in the network design, thereby limiting overall performance. To address this challenge, we propose a single mask scheme for self-supervised denoising training, which eliminates the need for blind spot operation and thereby removes constraints on the network structure design. Furthermore, to achieve denoising across entire image during inference, we propose a multi-mask scheme. Our method, featuring the asymmetric mask scheme in training and inference, achieves state-of-the-art performance on existing real noisy image datasets. Code will be available at https://github.com/lll143653/amsnet.

title: Xianren Zhang, Dongwon Lee, Suhang Wang*
title_en: Xianren Zhang, Dongwon Lee, Suhang Wang*
abstract: 随着深度视觉模型的流行度迅速增加,对模型预测的解释性需求日益增长。固有可解释性归因方法旨在通过识别对预测有显著贡献的图像重要区域,提升对模型行为的理解。该方法通过协同训练一个选择器(生成归因图以识别重要特征)和一个预测器(利用识别出的特征进行预测)来实现。尽管已有诸多进展,现有方法仍存在两个问题:一是判别性特征被遮蔽导致的不完整性问题,二是非优化选择器初始选择噪声,导致预测器拟合噪声并形成循环的互锁问题。为解决这些问题,我们引入了一个新目标函数,通过抑制遮蔽区域中判别性特征的存在,从而增强特征选择的全面性。引入一个预训练检测器以检测遮蔽区域中的判别性特征。若选择器选择噪声而非判别性特征,检测器可通过惩罚选择器来观察并打破互锁情况。大量实验表明,我们的模型在准确率上高于常规黑盒模型,生成的归因图具有高特征覆盖度、定位能力、保真度和鲁棒性。我们的代码将在https://github.com/Zood123/COMET上发布。
abstract_en: As deep vision models’ popularity rapidly increases, there is a growing emphasis on explanations for model predictions. The inherently explainable attribution method aims to enhance the understanding of model behavior by identifying the important regions in images that significantly contribute to predictions. It is achieved by cooperatively training a selector (generating an attribution map to identify important features) and a predictor (making predictions using the identified features). Despite many advancements, existing methods suffer from the incompleteness problem, where discriminative features are masked out, and the interlocking problem, where the non-optimized selector initially selects noise, causing the predictor to fit on this noise and perpetuate the cycle. To address these problems, we introduce a new objective that discourages the presence of discriminative features in the masked-out regions thus enhancing the comprehensiveness of feature selection. A pre-trained detector is introduced to detect discriminative features in the masked-out region. If the selector selects noise instead of discriminative features, the detector can observe and break the interlocking situation by penalizing the selector. Extensive experiments show that our model makes accurate predictions with higher accuracy than the regular black-box model, and produces attribution maps with high feature coverage, localization ability, fidelity and robustness. Our code will be available at https://github.com/Zood123/COMET.

title: Xianrui Luo, Huiqiang Sun, Juewen Peng, Zhiguo Cao*
title_en: Xianrui Luo, Huiqiang Sun, Juewen Peng, Zhiguo Cao*
abstract: 从单目视频中生成动态神经辐射场(NeRF)近期被探索用于时空新视角合成并取得了优异成果。然而,由于深度变化导致的景深模糊常出现在视频采集中,这种模糊会损害动态重建质量,因为缺乏锐利细节会干扰输入视角间的时间一致性建模。为解决这一问题,我们提出__TITLE_MATH_1__,这是首个旨在从景深模糊的单目视频中恢复锐利新视角的动态NeRF方法。我们引入分层景深(DoF)体渲染来建模景深模糊,并通过景深视角监督重建锐利NeRF。该模糊模型受DoF渲染与体渲染之间关联的启发。体渲染中的不透明度与DoF渲染中的层可见性相一致。为执行模糊处理,我们将分层模糊核修改为基于光线的核,并采用优化的稀疏核高效收集输入光线,利用我们的分层DoF体渲染对优化后的光线进行渲染。我们合成了一组包含景深动态场景的数据集用于本任务,大量实验表明,我们的方法在从景深模糊中合成全焦新视角时优于现有方法,同时保持场景中的时空一致性。
abstract_en: Dynamic Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) from monocular videos has recently been explored for space-time novel view synthesis and achieved excellent results. However, defocus blur caused by depth variation often occurs in video capture, compromising the quality of dynamic reconstruction because the lack of sharp details interferes with modeling temporal consistency between input views. To tackle this issue, we propose , the first dynamic NeRF method designed to restore sharp novel views from defocused monocular videos. We introduce layered Depth-of-Field (DoF) volume rendering to model the defocus blur and reconstruct a sharp NeRF supervised by defocused views. The blur model is inspired by the connection between DoF rendering and volume rendering. The opacity in volume rendering aligns with the layer visibility in DoF rendering. To execute the blurring, we modify the layered blur kernel to the ray-based kernel and employ an optimized sparse kernel to gather the input rays efficiently and render the optimized rays with our layered DoF volume rendering. We synthesize a dataset with defocused dynamic scenes for our task, and extensive experiments on our dataset show that our method outperforms existing approaches in synthesizing all-in-focus novel views from defocus blur while maintaining spatial-temporal consistency in the scene.

title: Xianwei Zhuang*, Hongxiang Li, Xuxin Cheng, Zhihong Zhu, Yuxin Xie, Yuexian Zou
title_en: Xianwei Zhuang*, Hongxiang Li, Xuxin Cheng, Zhihong Zhu, Yuxin Xie, Yuexian Zou
abstract: 现有视频-文本检索方法主要聚焦于设计多样化的跨模态交互机制。然而,这些方法偏离了人类学习范式,人类能够从开放集合中主动搜索并关联知识,而非单纯记忆所有文本-视频实例。受此启发,我们尝试通过多粒度知识存储将知识与检索模型解耦,并识别出知识解耦策略的两个显著优势:(1) 它确保了知识记忆与检索优化之间的和谐平衡,从而提升检索性能;(2) 它能够促进融合多样化的开放世界知识以增强视频-文本检索。为高效整合知识存储中的信息,我们进一步提出一种新型检索框架KDProR,该框架利用我们提出的期望-知识最大化(EKM)算法进行优化。具体而言,在E步中,KDProR从知识存储中获取相关上下文语义,通过插值与对齐校正实现高效知识注入;在K步中,KDProR通过索引获取的前K个知识计算知识K近邻分布以优化检索分布;在M步中,KDProR通过最大化目标函数的似然性优化检索模型。在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明,KDProR在所有指标上均显著优于先前的最先进方法。值得注意的是,KDProR能够统一且高效地融合多样化开放世界知识,并兼容不同的交互机制与架构。
abstract_en: Existing video-text retrieval methods predominantly focus on designing diverse cross-modal interaction mechanisms between captions and videos. However, those approaches diverge from human learning paradigms, where humans possess the capability to seek and associate knowledge from an open set, rather than rote memorizing all text-video instances. Motivated by this, we attempt to decouple knowledge from retrieval models through multi-grained knowledge stores and identify two significant benefits of our knowledge-decoupling strategy: (1) it ensures a harmonious balance between knowledge memorization and retrieval optimization, thereby improving retrieval performance; and (2) it can promote incorporating diverse open-world knowledge to augment video-text retrieval. To efficiently integrate information from knowledge stores, we further introduce a novel retrieval framework termed KDProR, which utilizes our proposed Expectation-Knowledge-Maximization (EKM) algorithm for optimization. Specifically, in E-step, KDProR obtains relevant contextual semantics from knowledge stores and achieves efficient knowledge injection through interpolation and alignment correction. During the K-step, KDProR calculates the knowledge KNN distribution by indexing the top-K acquired knowledge to refine the retrieval distribution, and in M-step, KDProR optimizes the retrieval model by maximizing the likelihood of the objective. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks prove that KDProR significantly outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods across all metrics. Remarkably, KDProR can uniformly and efficiently incorporate diverse open-world knowledge and is compatible with different interaction mechanisms and architectures.

title: 陈显宇*, 江明, 赵琪*
title_en: Xianyu Chen*, Ming Jiang, Qi Zhao*
abstract: 在探索视觉场景时,人类的注视路径由其潜在的注意力过程驱动。理解视觉注视路径对于各种应用至关重要。传统注视路径模型仅预测注视转移的"何处"和"何时",而未提供解释,造成对注视点背后原因理解的空白。为弥合这一差距,我们引入GazeXplain,一个关于视觉注视路径预测与解释的新研究。该研究涉及对眼动追踪数据集中的注视点进行自然语言解释标注,并提出一个通用模型,其包含注意力-语言解码器,可联合预测注视路径并生成解释。该模型集成了独特的语义对齐机制以增强注视点与解释之间的一致性,同时采用跨数据集联合训练方法提升泛化能力。这些创新提出了一种全面且可适应的可解释人类视觉注视路径预测解决方案。在多样化眼动追踪数据集上的大量实验验证了GazeXplain在注视路径预测与解释方面的有效性,为理解人类视觉注意力和认知过程提供了有价值的洞见。
abstract_en: While exploring visual scenes, humans’ scanpaths are driven by their underlying attention processes. Understanding visual scanpaths is essential for various applications. Traditional scanpath models predict the where and when of gaze shifts without providing explanations, creating a gap in understanding the rationale behind fixations. To bridge this gap, we introduce GazeXplain, a novel study of visual scanpath prediction and explanation. This involves annotating natural-language explanations for fixations across eye-tracking datasets and proposing a general model with an attention-language decoder that jointly predicts scanpaths and generates explanations. It integrates a unique semantic alignment mechanism to enhance the consistency between fixations and explanations, alongside a cross-dataset co-training approach for generalization. These novelties present a comprehensive and adaptable solution for explainable human visual scanpath prediction. Extensive experiments on diverse eye-tracking datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of GazeXplain in both scanpath prediction and explanation, offering valuable insights into human visual attention and cognitive processes.

title: Xiao Fu*, Wei Yin, Mu Hu, Kaixuan Wang, Yuexin Ma, Ping Tan, Shaojie Shen, Dahua Lin, Xiaoxiao Long
title_en: Xiao Fu*, Wei Yin, Mu Hu, Kaixuan Wang, Yuexin Ma, Ping Tan, Shaojie Shen, Dahua Lin, Xiaoxiao Long
abstract: ∗ Equal contribution 我们引入了GeoWizard,这是一个新的生成式基础模型,旨在从单张图像中估计几何属性,如深度和法线。尽管该领域已开展大量研究,但进展仍受到公开数据集多样性低和质量差的显著限制。因此,先前的工作要么受限于有限的场景,要么无法捕捉几何细节。本文证明,与传统判别模型(如CNNs和Transformers)相比,生成模型能够有效解决固有的病态问题。我们进一步表明,利用扩散先验可以显著提升泛化能力、细节保留和资源使用效率。具体而言,我们将原始的Stable Diffusion模型扩展为联合预测深度和法线,允许两者表示之间的互信息交换和高一致性。更重要的是,我们提出了一种简单而有效的策略,将各种场景的复杂数据分布分割为不同的子分布。该策略使我们的模型能够识别不同的场景布局,以显著的保真度捕捉3D几何结构。GeoWizard在零样本深度和法线预测方面设定了新基准,显著增强了3D重建、2D内容创作和新视角合成等许多下游应用。
abstract_en: ∗ Equal contributionWe introduce GeoWizard, a new generative foundation model designed for estimating geometric attributes, , depth and normals, from single images. While significant research has already been conducted in this area, the progress has been substantially limited by the low diversity and poor quality of publicly available datasets. As a result, the prior works either are constrained to limited scenarios or suffer from the inability to capture geometric details. In this paper, we demonstrate that generative models, as opposed to traditional discriminative models (, CNNs and Transformers), can effectively address the inherently ill-posed problem. We further show that leveraging diffusion priors can markedly improve generalization, detail preservation, and efficiency in resource usage. Specifically, we extend the original stable diffusion model to jointly predict depth and normal, allowing mutual information exchange and high consistency between the two representations. More importantly, we propose a simple yet effective strategy to segregate the complex data distribution of various scenes into distinct sub-distributions. This strategy enables our model to recognize different scene layouts, capturing 3D geometry with remarkable fidelity. GeoWizard sets new benchmarks for zero-shot depth and normal prediction, significantly enhancing many downstream applications such as 3D reconstruction, 2D content creation, and novel viewpoint synthesis.

title: 肖丽*, 刘雨宁, 东娜, 秦思天, 胡晓林
title_en: Xiao Li*, Yining Liu, Na Dong, Sitian Qin, Xiaolin Hu
abstract: 基于深度学习的目标识别系统容易受到各种对抗性扰动的欺骗。弱鲁棒性的一个可能原因在于它们缺乏类似人类识别过程的基于部件的归纳偏置。受此启发,已提出多种基于部件的识别模型以提升识别的对抗鲁棒性。然而,由于缺乏部件标注,这些方法的有效性仅在小规模非标准数据集上得到验证。在本工作中,我们提出PIN++,即PartImageNet++,这是一个为ImageNet-1K(IN-1K)所有类别提供高质量部件分割标注的数据集。借助这些标注,我们在标准IN-1K数据集上直接构建基于部件的方法以实现鲁棒识别。与之前两阶段的基于部件模型不同,我们提出多尺度部件监督模型(MPM),通过部件标注学习鲁棒表示。实验表明,MPM在多种攻击设置下,在大规模IN-1K数据集上优于强基线模型,展现出更好的对抗鲁棒性。此外,MPM在常见腐蚀数据和多个分布外数据集上也实现了提升的鲁棒性。该数据集及其结果为研究人员探索基于部件模型在更多实际应用中的潜力提供了支持和激励。数据集和代码可在https://github.com/LixiaoTHU/PartImageNetPP获取。
abstract_en: Deep learning-based object recognition systems can be easily fooled by various adversarial perturbations. One reason for the weak robustness may be that they do not have part-based inductive bias like the human recognition process. Motivated by this, several part-based recognition models have been proposed to improve the adversarial robustness of recognition. However, due to the lack of part annotations, the effectiveness of these methods is only validated on small-scale nonstandard datasets. In this work, we propose PIN++, short for PartImageNet++, a dataset providing high-quality part segmentation annotations for all categories of ImageNet-1K (IN-1K). With these annotations, we build part-based methods directly on the standard IN-1K dataset for robust recognition. Different from previous two-stage part-based models, we propose a Multi-scale Part-supervised Model (MPM), to learn a robust representation with part annotations. Experiments show that MPM yielded better adversarial robustness on the large-scale IN-1K over strong baselines across various attack settings. Furthermore, MPM achieved improved robustness on common corruptions and several out-of-distribution datasets. The dataset, together with these results, enables and encourages researchers to explore the potential of part-based models in more real applications. The dataset and the code are available at https://github.com/LixiaoTHU/ PartImageNetPP.

title: Xiao Liu, Xiaoliu Guan, Yu Wu*, Jiaxu Miao*
title_en: Xiao Liu, Xiaoliu Guan, Yu Wu*, Jiaxu Miao*
abstract: 扩散模型因其生成新颖且高质量样本的卓越能力而广受关注,但其数据记忆行为近期引发了隐私风险的担忧。现有缓解记忆的方法要么仅关注跨模态生成任务中的文本模态问题,要么采用数据增强策略。本文从视觉模态视角提出一种新型扩散模型训练框架,该方法在缓解记忆方面更具通用性和基础性。为促进扩散模型参数中存储信息的“遗忘”,我们提出一种迭代集成训练策略,通过将数据分割为多个分片训练多个模型,并间歇性聚合这些模型参数。此外,损失分析表明,易记忆图像的训练损失往往明显更低。因此,我们提出反梯度控制方法,将当前小批量中损失值较低的样本排除,以避免记忆。在四个数据集上的大量实验和分析验证了方法的有效性,结果表明该方法成功降低了记忆容量,甚至略微提升了性能。此外,为节省计算成本,我们成功将该方法应用于有限轮次的预训练扩散模型微调,证明了方法的适用性。代码可在 https://github.com/liuxiao-guan/IET_AGC 获取。
abstract_en: Diffusion models, known for their tremendous ability to generate novel and high-quality samples, have recently raised concerns due to their data memorization behavior, which poses privacy risks. Recent approaches for memory mitigation either only focused on the text modality problem in cross-modal generation tasks or utilized data augmentation strategies. In this paper, we propose a novel training framework for diffusion models from the perspective of visual modality, which is more generic and fundamental for mitigating memorization. To facilitate “forgetting” of stored information in diffusion model parameters, we propose an iterative ensemble training strategy by splitting the data into multiple shards for training multiple models and intermittently aggregating these model parameters. Moreover, practical analysis of losses illustrates that the training loss for easily memorable images tends to be obviously lower. Thus, we propose an anti-gradient control method to exclude the sample with a lower loss value from the current mini-batch to avoid memorizing. Extensive experiments and analysis on four datasets are conducted to illustrate the effectiveness of our method, and results show that our method successfully reduces memory capacity while even improving the performance slightly. Moreover, to save the computing cost, we successfully apply our method to fine-tune the well-trained diffusion models by limited epochs, demonstrating the applicability of our method. Code is available in https://github.com/liuxiao-guan/IET_AGC.

title: Xiao Zhou, Xiaoman Zhang, Chaoyi Wu, Ya Zhang, Weidi Xie, Yan-Feng Wang*
title_en: Xiao Zhou, Xiaoman Zhang, Chaoyi Wu, Ya Zhang, Weidi Xie, Yan-Feng Wang*
abstract: 本文研究计算病理学中的视觉表示学习问题,通过利用从公共资源中收集的大规模图像-文本对,以及病理学领域的专业知识。具体而言,我们做出以下贡献:(i) 我们构建了一个包含32种人类组织中4,718种需要病理诊断的疾病的50,470个信息属性的病理知识树。据我们所知,这是首个全面的结构化病理知识库;(ii) 我们开发了一种知识增强的视觉-语言预训练方法,首先通过语言模型将病理学专业知识投影到潜在嵌入空间中,并利用其指导视觉表示学习;(iii) 我们进行了详尽的实验以验证所提出组件的有效性,结果在多种下游任务上表现出显著性能提升,包括跨模态检索、病理切片的零样本分类以及全切片图像(WSIs)上的零样本肿瘤亚型分类。
abstract_en: In this paper, we consider the problem of visual representation learning for computational pathology, by exploiting large-scale image-text pairs gathered from public resources, along with the domain-specific knowledge in pathology. Specifically, we make the following contributions: (i) We curate a pathology knowledge tree that consists of 50,470 informative attributes for 4,718 diseases requiring pathology diagnosis from 32 human tissues. To our knowledge, this is the first comprehensive structured pathology knowledge base; (ii) We develop a knowledge-enhanced visual-language pretraining approach, where we first project pathology-specific knowledge into latent embedding space via a language model, and use it to guide the visual representation learning; (iii) We conduct thorough experiments to validate the effectiveness of our proposed components, demonstrating significant performance improvement on various downstream tasks, including cross-modal retrieval, zero-shot classification on pathology patches, and zero-shot tumor subtyping on whole slide images (WSIs).

title: Xiao-Ming Wu*, Jia-Feng Cai, Jian-Jian Jiang, Dian Zheng, Yi-Lin Wei, Wei-Shi Zheng*
title_en: Xiao-Ming Wu*, Jia-Feng Cai, Jian-Jian Jiang, Dian Zheng, Yi-Lin Wei, Wei-Shi Zheng*
abstract: 在杂乱环境中实现机器人抓取是机器人操作的基本任务。本文提出了一种经济型框架用于6自由度抓取检测,旨在降低训练资源成本的同时保持有效的抓取性能。首先,我们发现密集监督是当前最先进的方法的瓶颈,严重制约了整个训练负载,同时使训练难以收敛。为解决上述问题,我们首先提出了一种经济型监督范式,用于高效且准确的抓取。该范式包括精心设计的监督选择策略,选择基本无歧义的关键标签,以及经济型流程以实现选择后的训练。此外,得益于经济型监督,我们可以专注于特定抓取,因此设计了焦点表示模块,包含交互式抓取头和复合得分估计,以更精确地生成特定抓取。综合以上内容,提出了EconomicGrasp框架。大量实验表明,EconomicGrasp在平均3AP上超越了最先进的抓取方法,并且资源成本极低,训练时间成本约为1/4,内存成本约为1/8,存储成本约为1/30。我们的代码可在https://github.com/iSEE-Laboratory/EconomicGrasp获取。
abstract_en: Robotic grasping in clutters is a fundamental task in robotic manipulation. In this work, we propose an economic framework for 6-DoF grasp detection, aiming to economize the resource cost in training and meanwhile maintain effective grasp performance. To begin with, we discover that the dense supervision is the bottleneck of current SOTA methods that severely encumbers the entire training overload, meanwhile making the training difficult to converge. To solve the above problem, we first propose an economic supervision paradigm for efficient and effective grasping. This paradigm includes a well-designed supervision selection strategy, selecting key labels basically without ambiguity, and an economic pipeline to enable the training after selection. Furthermore, benefit from the economic supervision, we can focus on a specific grasp, and thus we devise a focal representation module, which comprises an interactive grasp head and a composite score estimation to generate the specific grasp more accurately. Combining all together, the EconomicGrasp framework is proposed. Our extensive experiments show that EconomicGrasp surpasses the SOTA grasp method by about 3AP on average, and with extremely low resource cost, for about 1/4 training time cost, 1/8 memory cost and 1/30 storage cost. Our code is available at https://github.com/iSEE-Laboratory/ EconomicGrasp.

title: 魏小宝, 曹佳俊, 金一柱, 卢明, 王广宇, 张上杭*
title_en: Xiaobao Wei, Jiajun Cao, Yizhu Jin, Ming Lu, Guangyu Wang, Shanghang Zhang*
abstract: 随着深度神经网络(DNNs)的发展,许多努力已用于处理医学图像分割。传统方法如nnUNet在各个数据集上训练特定的分割模型。大量近期方法被提出,以将基础分割任何模型(SAM)适应于医学图像分割。然而,它们仍然专注于离散表示以生成逐像素预测,这些预测在空间上不够灵活且难以扩展到更高分辨率。相比之下,隐式方法学习用于分割的连续表示,这对于医学图像分割至关重要。在本文中,我们提出I-MedSAM,该方法结合了连续表示和SAM的优势,以获得更好的跨域能力和精确的边界界定。由于医学图像分割需要预测详细的分割边界,我们在参数高效微调(PEFT)过程中设计了一种新颖的适配器,以增强SAM特征的高频信息。为了将SAM特征和坐标转换为连续的分割输出,我们利用隐式神经表示(INR)学习隐式分割解码器。我们还提出了一种不确定性引导的采样策略,以高效学习INR。在2D医学图像分割任务上的广泛评估表明,我们的方法仅使用1.6M可训练参数,就优于包括离散和隐式方法在内的现有方法。代码将在:https://github.com/ucwxb/I-MedSAM 上提供。
abstract_en: With the development of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), many efforts have been made to handle medical image segmentation. Traditional methods such as nnUNet train specific segmentation models on the individual datasets. Plenty of recent methods have been proposed to adapt the foundational Segment Anything Model (SAM) to medical image segmentation. However, they still focus on discrete representations to generate pixel-wise predictions, which are spatially inflexible and scale poorly to higher resolution. In contrast, implicit methods learn continuous representations for segmentation, which is crucial for medical image segmentation. In this paper, we propose I-MedSAM, which leverages the benefits of both continuous representations and SAM, to obtain better cross-domain ability and accurate boundary delineation. Since medical image segmentation needs to predict detailed segmentation boundaries, we designed a novel adapter to enhance the SAM features with high-frequency information during Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT). To convert the SAM features and coordinates into continuous segmentation output, we utilize Implicit Neural Representation (INR) to learn an implicit segmentation decoder. We also propose an uncertainty-guided sampling strategy for efficient learning of INR. Extensive evaluations on 2D medical image segmentation tasks have shown that our proposed method with only 1.6M trainable parameters outperforms existing methods including discrete and implicit methods. The code will be available at: https://github.com/ucwxb/I-MedSAM.

title: Xiaobin Hu, Xu Peng, Donghao Luo*, Xiaozhong Ji, Jinlong Peng, ZhengKai Jiang, Jiangning Zhang, Taisong Jin*, Chengjie Wang, Rongrong Ji
title_en: Xiaobin Hu, Xu Peng, Donghao Luo*, Xiaozhong Ji, Jinlong Peng, ZhengKai Jiang, Jiangning Zhang, Taisong Jin*, Chengjie Wang, Rongrong Ji
abstract: 由于获取高精度或抠图标注具有难度且耗时,目前公开的高精度标签数量有限。为应对这一挑战,我们提出了一种名为DiffuMatting的方法,该方法继承了扩散模型强大的万物生成能力,并赋予其“任意去背”的能力。DiffuMatting可以:1)作为高精度标注的任意去背工厂;2)良好兼容社区LoRAs或各种条件控制方法,实现社区友好的艺术设计和可控生成。具体而言,受绿幕抠图启发,我们旨在训练扩散模型在固定绿幕画布上进行绘画。为此,收集了一个大规模绿幕数据集(Green100K)作为DiffuMatting的训练数据集。其次,提出了一种绿背景控制损失,以保持画布为纯绿色,从而区分前景和背景。为确保合成对象具有更多边缘细节,提出了一种过渡边界增强损失作为生成复杂边缘结构对象的指导。为了同时生成对象及其去背标注,我们构建了一个去背头模块,在VAE解码器的潜在空间中实现绿色去除。DiffuMatting展示了多种潜在应用(如去背数据生成器、社区友好的艺术设计和可控生成)。作为去背数据生成器,DiffuMatting合成了一般物体和人像去背数据集,在通用物体去背任务中有效降低了相对MSE误差15.4%。该数据集在我们的项目页面https:// diffumatting.github.io上发布。
abstract_en: Due to the difficulty and labor-consuming nature of getting highly accurate or matting annotations, there only exists a limited amount of highly accurate labels available to the public. To tackle this challenge, we propose a DiffuMatting which inherits the strong Everything generation ability of diffusion and endows the power of ‘matting anything’.
