Our DiffuMatting can 1). act as an anything matting factory with high accurate annotations 2). be well-compatible with community LoRAs or various conditional control approaches to achieve the community-friendly art design and controllable generation. Specifically, inspired by green-screen-matting, we aim to teach the diffusion model to paint on a fixed green screen canvas. To this end, a large-scale green-screen dataset (Green100K) is collected as a training dataset for DiffuMatting. Secondly, a green background control loss is proposed to keep the drawing board as a pure green color to distinguish the foreground and background. To ensure the synthesized object has more edge details, a detailed-enhancement of transition boundary loss is proposed as a guideline to generate objects with more complicated edge structures. Aiming to simultaneously generate the object and its matting annotation, we build a matting head to make a green-color removal in the latent space of the VAE decoder. Our DiffuMatting shows several potential applications (e.g., matting-data generator, community-friendly art design and controllable generation). As a matting-data generator, DiffuMatting synthesizes general object and portrait matting sets, effectively reducing the relative MSE error by 15.4% in General Object Matting. The dataset is released in our project page at https:// diffumatting.github.io.

title: Xiaofan Que, Qi Yu*
title_en: Xiaofan Que, Qi Yu*
abstract: 噪声少样本学习(NFSL)主要由于噪声标签与有限训练数据之间的相互作用而带来新的挑战。尽管数据清洗在一般学习场景中提供了解决噪声标签的可行方案,但由于训练数据有限,它加剧了少样本学习(FSL)中的信息损失,导致模型训练不足。为了最佳恢复被噪声标签破坏的潜在任务流形,我们采用设计独特的无监督辅助任务进行学习,以补偿信息损失。使用无监督任务可以有效避免额外的标注成本,并最小化引入额外标签噪声的风险。然而,随机构建的无监督任务可能会误导模型学习样本特定特征,这些特征可能因弱学习信号的噪声而损害主要的少样本学习任务。我们提出新颖的辅助任务选择方法,以确保任务内未标记样本的多样性。随后,从精心构建的辅助任务中学习领域不变特征,以最佳恢复原始数据流形。我们进行了理论分析,推导出使用辅助任务学习的新泛化界限。大量实验表明,我们的方法在各种领域内和跨领域少样本分类基准上均优于现有噪声少样本学习方法。
abstract_en: Noisy few-shot learning (NFSL) presents novel challenges primarily due to the interplay between noisy labels and limited training data. While data cleansing offers a viable solution to address noisy labels in the general learning settings, it exacerbates information loss in FSL due to limited training data, resulting in inadequate model training. To best recover the underlying task manifold corrupted by the noisy labels, we resort to learning from uniquely designed unsupervised auxiliary tasks to compensate for information loss. Using unsupervised tasks can effectively avoid additional annotation costs and minimize the risk of introducing additional label noises. However, a randomly constructed unsupervised task may misguide the model to learn sample-specific features that are likely to compromise the primary few-shot learning task due to the noisy weak learning signals. We propose to conduct novel auxiliary task selection to ensure the intra-diversity among the unlabeled samples within a task. Domain invariant features are then learned from carefully constructed auxiliary tasks to best recover the original data manifold. We conduct a theoretical analysis to derive novel generalization bounds for learning with auxiliary tasks. Extensive experiments are conducted to demonstrate that our method outperforms existing noisy few-shot learning methods under various in-domain and cross-domain few-shot classification benchmarks.

title: Xiaofei Hui, Qian Wu, Hossein Rahmani, Jun Liu*
title_en: Xiaofei Hui, Qian Wu, Hossein Rahmani, Jun Liu*
abstract: 无类别目标计数旨在利用有限信息(如少量示例或类别名称)对任意类别的目标进行计数。该任务要求模型有效获取目标对象的特征并准确进行计数,具有挑战性。本文受文本到图像扩散模型蕴含丰富知识和对现实物体全面理解的启发,提出利用预训练文本到图像扩散模型来促进无类别目标计数。具体而言,我们提出了一种名为CountDiff的创新框架,通过精心设计,利用预训练扩散模型对图像内容的全面理解实现无类别目标计数。实验表明,CountDiff在提供示例的少样本设置和仅提供类别名称的零样本设置中均表现出有效性。
abstract_en: Class-agnostic object counting aims to count objects of arbitrary classes with limited information (, a few exemplars or the class names) provided. It requires the model to effectively acquire the characteristics of the target objects and accurately perform counting, which can be challenging. In this work, inspired by that text-to-image diffusion models hold rich knowledge and comprehensive understanding of real-world objects, we propose to leverage the pre-trained text-to-image diffusion model to facilitate class-agnostic object counting. Specifically, we propose a novel framework named CountDiff with careful designs, leveraging the pre-trained diffusion model’s comprehensive understanding of image contents to perform class-agnostic object counting. The experiments show the effectiveness of CountDiff on both few-shot setting with exemplars provided and zero-shot setting with class names provided.

title: Xiaofeng Wang*, Zheng Zhu, Guan Huang, Chen Xinze, Jiagang Zhu, Jiwen Lu
title_en: Xiaofeng Wang*, Zheng Zhu, Guan Huang, Chen Xinze, Jiagang Zhu, Jiwen Lu
abstract: 世界模型,尤其是在自动驾驶领域,因其对驾驶环境的理解能力而受到广泛关注。现有的世界模型在生成高质量驾驶视频和安全驾驶策略方面展现出巨大潜力。然而,相关研究的一个关键局限在于其主要聚焦于游戏环境或模拟场景,缺乏对真实驾驶场景的表征。因此,我们引入DriveDreamer,这是一个完全基于真实驾驶场景的开创性世界模型。考虑到在复杂驾驶场景中建模世界涉及庞大的搜索空间,我们提出利用强大的扩散模型构建复杂环境的全面表征。此外,我们引入了两阶段训练流程。在初始阶段,DriveDreamer深入理解结构化的交通约束,而在后续阶段则赋予其预测未来状态的能力。大量实验验证了DriveDreamer在驾驶视频生成和动作预测方面的有效性,真实还原了现实交通约束。此外,DriveDreamer生成的视频显著提升了驾驶感知方法的训练效果。
abstract_en: World models, especially in autonomous driving, are trending and drawing extensive attention due to their capacity for comprehending driving environments. The established world model holds immense potential for the generation of high-quality driving videos, and driving policies for safe maneuvering. However, a critical limitation in relevant research lies in its predominant focus on gaming environments or simulated settings, thereby lacking the representation of real-world driving scenarios. Therefore, we introduce DriveDreamer, a pioneering world model entirely derived from real-world driving scenarios. Regarding that modeling the world in intricate driving scenes entails an overwhelming search space, we propose harnessing the powerful diffusion model to construct a comprehensive representation of the complex environment. Furthermore, we introduce a two-stage training pipeline. In the initial phase, DriveDreamer acquires a deep understanding of structured traffic constraints, while the subsequent stage equips it with the ability to anticipate future states. Extensive experiments are conducted to verify that DriveDreamer empowers both driving video generation and action prediction, faithfully capturing real-world traffic constraints. Furthermore, videos generated by DriveDreamer significantly enhance the training of driving perception methods.

title: Xiaofeng Wu*, Velibor Bojkovic, Bin Gu*, Kun Suo, Kai Zou
title_en: Xiaofeng Wu*, Velibor Bojkovic, Bin Gu*, Kun Suo, Kai Zou
abstract: 脉冲神经网络(SNNs)相比人工神经网络(ANNs),为能效计算提供了一条有前景的途径,其更贴近生物神经过程。然而,这种潜力伴随着直接通过时空反向传播训练SNNs的固有挑战——源于脉冲神经元的时间动态及其离散信号处理——这需要替代的训练方法,尤其是通过ANN到SNN的转换。在本文中,我们引入了一种轻量级的前向时间偏差校正(__TITLE_MATH_1__)技术,旨在在不增加计算开销的情况下提高转换精度。我们的方法基于提供的理论发现,即通过适当的时序偏差校准,ANN到SNN转换的预期误差可以在每个时间步减少至零。我们进一步提出了一种仅在前向传播中寻找时序偏差的启发式算法,从而消除了反向传播的计算负担,并在CIFAR-10/100和ImageNet数据集上评估了我们的方法,在所有数据集上均实现了显著的准确率提升。代码已发布在GitHub仓库(__ABS_MATH_1__)。
abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer a promising avenue for energy-efficient computing compared with Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), closely mirroring biological neural processes. However, this potential comes with inherent challenges in directly training SNNs through spatio-temporal backpropagation — stemming from the temporal dynamics of spiking neurons and their discrete signal processing — which necessitates alternative ways of training, most notably through ANN-SNN conversion. In this work, we introduce a lightweight Forward Temporal Bias Correction () technique, aimed at enhancing conversion accuracy without the computational overhead. We ground our method on provided theoretical findings that through proper temporal bias calibration the expected error of ANN-SNN conversion can be reduced to be zero after each time step. We further propose a heuristic algorithm for finding the temporal bias only in the forward pass, thus eliminating the computational burden of backpropagation and we evaluate our method on CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet datasets, achieving a notable increase in accuracy on all datasets. Codes are released at a GitHub repository.

title: Xiaofeng Yang*, Yiwen Chen, Cheng Chen, Chi Zhang, Yi Xu, Xulei Yang, Fayao Liu, Guosheng Lin
title_en: Xiaofeng Yang*, Yiwen Chen, Cheng Chen, Chi Zhang, Yi Xu, Xulei Yang, Fayao Liu, Guosheng Lin
abstract: 本文提出了一种统一框架,旨在提升三维生成任务中的扩散先验。尽管这些任务具有关键重要性,但现有方法往往难以生成高质量结果。我们首先分析了先前扩散先验的固有局限性,发现扩散先验与扩散模型训练过程之间的差异显著影响了三维生成的质量。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的统一框架,通过迭代优化三维模型和扩散先验。利用扩散先验中不同的可学习参数,我们的方法提供了多种配置,实现了性能与实现复杂度之间的多种权衡。值得注意的是,实验结果表明我们的方法显著超越现有技术,在文本到三维生成领域建立了新的最先进水平。此外,我们的框架还为近期的分数蒸馏方法(如VSD损失和CSD损失)提供了有价值的见解。代码:https://yangxiaofeng.github.io/demo_diffusion_prior
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a unified framework aimed at enhancing the diffusion priors for 3D generation tasks. Despite the critical importance of these tasks, existing methodologies often struggle to generate high-caliber results. We begin by examining the inherent limitations in previous diffusion priors. We identify a divergence between the diffusion priors and the training procedures of diffusion models that substantially impairs the quality of 3D generation. To address this issue, we propose a novel, unified framework that iteratively optimizes both the 3D model and the diffusion prior. Leveraging the different learnable parameters of the diffusion prior, our approach offers multiple configurations, affording various trade-offs between performance and implementation complexity. Notably, our experimental results demonstrate that our method markedly surpasses existing techniques, establishing new state-of-the-art in the realm of text-to-3D generation. Additionally, our framework yields insightful contributions to the understanding of recent score distillation methods, such as the VSD loss and CSD loss. Code:https://yangxiaofeng.github.io/demo_diffusion_prior

title: Xiaohan Wang*, Yuhui Zhang, Orr Zohar, Serena Yeung-Levy
title_en: Xiaohan Wang*, Yuhui Zhang, Orr Zohar, Serena Yeung-Levy
abstract: 长视频理解代表了计算机视觉领域的一个重大挑战,需要一种能够对长多模态序列进行推理的模型。受人类对长视频理解的认知过程启发,我们强调交互式推理与规划,而非仅仅处理长视觉输入的能力。我们引入了一种新颖的基于代理的系统VideoAgent,该系统利用大型语言模型作为核心代理,迭代地识别和编译关键信息以回答问题,视觉-语言基础模型作为工具用于翻译和检索视觉信息。在具有挑战性的EgoSchema和NExT-QA基准上评估,VideoAgent仅使用平均8.4和8.2帧,就实现了54.1%和71.3%的零样本准确率。这些结果展示了我们方法在当前最先进方法上的优越效果和效率,突显了基于代理的方法在推进长视频理解方面的潜力。
abstract_en: Long-form video understanding represents a significant challenge within computer vision, demanding a model capable of reasoning over long multi-modal sequences. Motivated by the human cognitive process for long-form video understanding, we emphasize interactive reasoning and planning over the ability to process lengthy visual inputs. We introduce a novel agent-based system, VideoAgent, that employs a large language model as a central agent to iteratively identify and compile crucial information to answer a question, with vision-language foundation models serving as tools to translate and retrieve visual information. Evaluated on the challenging EgoSchema and NExT-QA benchmarks, VideoAgent achieves 54.1% and 71.3% zero-shot accuracy with only 8.4 and 8.2 frames used on average. These results demonstrate superior effectiveness and efficiency of our method over the current state-of-the-art methods, highlighting the potential of agent-based approaches in advancing long-form video understanding.

title: Xiaojie Li, Yibo Yang*, Xiangtai Li, Jianlong Wu*, Yue Yu, Bernard Ghanem, Min Zhang
title_en: Xiaojie Li, Yibo Yang*, Xiangtai Li, Jianlong Wu*, Yue Yu, Bernard Ghanem, Min Zhang
abstract: 自监督学习在从无标签数据中获取高质量表示方面取得了显著成功。广泛采用的对比学习框架旨在通过最小化源自同一图像的正视图之间的距离来学习不变表示。然而,现有技术构建正视图高度依赖于手动变换,导致正视图多样性有限且可能产生虚假正样本对。为解决这些挑战,我们提出了GenView,一个可控框架,利用预训练生成模型的力量增强正视图的多样性,同时保持语义一致性。我们开发了一种自适应视图生成方法,通过动态调整采样中的噪声水平,在保持关键语义信息的同时引入可变性。此外,我们引入了一种质量驱动的对比损失,通过考虑前景相似性和背景多样性来评估正样本对的质量。该损失优先选择我们构建的高质量正样本对,同时减少低质量样本对的影响,从而缓解生成模型和激进数据增强可能引入的潜在语义不一致性。得益于改进的正视图质量和质量驱动的对比损失,GenView在各种任务中显著提升了自监督学习性能。例如,GenView在ImageNet线性/半监督分类任务中将MoCov2性能提升了2.5%/2.2%。此外,GenView甚至在使用Laion400M或ImageNet21K对ImageNet数据集进行简单增强时表现更优。
abstract_en: Self-supervised learning has achieved remarkable success in acquiring high-quality representations from unlabeled data. The widely adopted contrastive learning framework aims to learn invariant representations by minimizing the distance between positive views originating from the same image. However, existing techniques to construct positive views highly rely on manual transformations, resulting in limited diversity and potentially false positive pairs. To tackle these challenges, we present GenView, a controllable framework that augments the diversity of positive views leveraging the power of pretrained generative models while preserving semantics. We develop an adaptive view generation method that dynamically adjusts the noise level in sampling to ensure the preservation of essential semantic meaning while introducing variability. Additionally, we introduce a quality-driven contrastive loss, which assesses the quality of positive pairs by considering both foreground similarity and background diversity. This loss prioritizes the high-quality positive pairs we construct while reducing the influence of low-quality pairs, thereby mitigating potential semantic inconsistencies introduced by generative models and aggressive data augmentation. Thanks to the improved positive view quality and the quality-driven contrastive loss, GenView significantly improves self-supervised learning across various tasks. For instance, GenView improves MoCov2 performance by 2.5%/2.2% on ImageNet linear/semi-supervised classification. Moreover, GenView even performs much better than naively augmenting the ImageNet dataset with Laion400M or ImageNet21K.

title: Xiaojing Zhong, Xinyi Huang, Xiaofeng Yang, Guosheng Lin*, Qingyao Wu*
title_en: Xiaojing Zhong, Xinyi Huang, Xiaofeng Yang, Guosheng Lin*, Qingyao Wu*
abstract: 扩散模型开启了视频编辑的新时代,能够通过文本提示灵活操控视频内容。尽管在编辑以人类为中心的视频方面存在广泛的应用需求,但这些模型在处理复杂对象(如人类)时仍面临显著挑战。本文提出DeCo,一种专门设计的视频编辑框架,将人类与背景作为独立可编辑的目标进行处理,通过保持每个组件的一致性来确保全局时空一致性。具体而言,我们提出了一种解耦的动态人体表示方法,利用参数化的人体先验生成定制化的人体,同时保留与原视频一致的运动轨迹。此外,我们将背景视为分层图谱,应用文本引导的图像编辑方法进行处理。为进一步提升优化过程中人体的几何结构和纹理细节,我们将分数蒸馏采样计算扩展至法线空间和图像空间。此外,我们通过引入光照感知视频协调器解决编辑目标间的光照不一致问题,这一问题在以往的分解-编辑-合成方法中尚未被关注。大量定性和定量实验表明,DeCo在以人类为中心的视频编辑任务中优于现有方法,尤其在长视频处理中表现突出。
abstract_en: Diffusion models usher a new era of video editing, flexibly manipulating the video contents with text prompts. Despite the widespread application demand in editing human-centered videos, these models face significant challenges in handling complex objects like humans. In this paper, we introduce DeCo, a novel video editing framework specifically designed to treat humans and the background as separate editable targets, ensuring global spatial-temporal consistency by maintaining the coherence of each individual component. Specifically, we propose a decoupled dynamic human representation that utilizes a parametric human body prior to generate tailored humans while preserving the consistent motions as the original video. In addition, we consider the background as a layered atlas to apply text-guided image editing approaches on it. To further enhance the geometry and texture of humans during the optimization, we extend the calculation of score distillation sampling into normal space and image space. Moreover, we tackle inconsistent lighting between the edited targets by leveraging a lighting-aware video harmonizer, a problem previously overlooked in decompose-edit-combine approaches. Extensive qualitative and numerical experiments demonstrate that DeCo outperforms prior video editing methods in human-centered videos, especially in longer videos.

title: Xiaoming Qi*, Yuan Zhang, Tong Wang, Guanyu Yang*, Yueming Jin*, Shuo Li
title_en: Xiaoming Qi*, Yuan Zhang, Tong Wang, Guanyu Yang*, Yueming Jin*, Shuo Li
abstract: 多模态磁共振成像(MRI)通过全面分析多模态信息融合,对准确诊断疾病和制定手术计划至关重要。这种融合具有跨模态下每种疾病独特的信息聚合模式,受不同相互依赖性和信息流变化的影响。现有融合方法隐式识别不同任务下的独特聚合模式,表明开发统一且显式的聚合模式具有潜力。在本研究中,我们提出了一种新的聚合模式——能量诱导显式传播与对齐(Energy-induced Explicit Propagation and Alignment, E2 PA),以显式量化和优化多模态MRI融合的特性,以适应不同场景。在E2 PA中,(1) 能量引导的分层融合(Energy-guided Hierarchical Fusion, EHF)通过患者间的分层相同能量揭示多模态间相互依赖性传播的量化与优化;(2) 能量正则化空间对齐(Energy-regularized Space Alignment, ESA)通过空间因子化对齐和能量最小化测量多模态聚合中信息流的一致性。通过在三个公开多模态MRI数据集(包含不同模态组合和任务)上的广泛实验,E2 PA相较于现有先进方法的优越性得以验证。我们的代码可在https://github.com/JerryQseu/EEPA获取。
abstract_en: Multi-modality magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is crucial for accurate disease diagnosis and surgical planning by comprehensively analyzing multi-modality information fusion. This fusion is characterized by unique patterns of information aggregation for each disease across modalities, influenced by distinct inter-dependencies and shifts in information flow. Existing fusion methods implicitly identify distinct aggregation patterns for various tasks, indicating the potential for developing a unified and explicit aggregation pattern. In this study, we propose a novel aggregation pattern, Energy-induced Explicit Propagation and Alignment (E2 PA), to explicitly quantify and optimize the properties of multi-modality MRI fusion to adapt to different scenarios. In E2 PA, (1) An energy-guided hierarchical fusion (EHF) uncovers the quantification and optimization of inter-dependencies propagation among multi-modalities by hierarchical same energy among patients. (2) An energy-regularized space alignment (ESA) measures the consistency of information flow in multi-modality aggregation by the alignment on space factorization and energy minimization. Through the extensive experiments on three public multi-modality MRI datasets (with different modality combinations and tasks), the superiority of E2 PA can be demonstrated from the comparison with state-of-the-art methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/JerryQseu/EEPA.

title: Xiaoran Zhang*, John C. Stendahl, Lawrence H. Staib, Albert J. Sinusas, Alex Wong, James S. Duncan
title_en: Xiaoran Zhang*, John C. Stendahl, Lawrence H. Staib, Albert J. Sinusas, Alex Wong, James S. Duncan
abstract: 我们提出了一种用于无监督医学图像配准的自适应训练方案。现有方法主要依赖图像重建作为主要的监督信号。然而,干扰变量(如噪声和共视性)、物理波中违反朗伯反射假设(如超声波)以及图像采集不一致等因素,都可能导致医学图像之间的对应关系丢失。由于无监督学习方案依赖图像强度恒定性来建立重建的对应关系,这会引入未被典型训练目标建模的虚假误差残差。为缓解这一问题,我们提出了一种自适应框架,在训练过程中利用对应性评分图对误差残差进行重新加权,防止参数位移估计器因噪声梯度而漂移,从而导致性能下降。为展示我们方法的通用性和有效性,我们在三个代表性配准架构上对三个医学图像数据集及其他基线方法进行了测试。我们的自适应框架在定量和定性方面均优于其他方法。配对t检验表明,我们的改进具有统计显著性。代码可访问:https://voldemort108x.github.io/AdaCS/
abstract_en: We propose an adaptive training scheme for unsupervised medical image registration. Existing methods rely on image reconstruction as the primary supervision signal. However, nuisance variables (e.g. noise and covisibility), violation of the Lambertian assumption in physical waves (e.g. ultrasound), and inconsistent image acquisition can all cause a loss of correspondence between medical images. As the unsupervised learning scheme relies on intensity constancy between images to establish correspondence for reconstruction, this introduces spurious error residuals that are not modeled by the typical training objective. To mitigate this, we propose an adaptive framework that re-weights the error residuals with a correspondence scoring map during training, preventing the parametric displacement estimator from drifting away due to noisy gradients, which leads to performance degradation. To illustrate the versatility and effectiveness of our method, we tested our framework on three representative registration architectures across three medical image datasets along with other baselines. Our adaptive framework consistently outperforms other methods both quantitatively and qualitatively. Paired t-tests show that our improvements are statistically significant. Code available at: https://voldemort108x.github.io/AdaCS/.

title: Xiaoshi Wu, Yiming Hao, Manyuan Zhang*, Keqiang Sun, Zhaoyang Huang, Guanglu Song, Yu Liu, Hongsheng Li*
title_en: Xiaoshi Wu, Yiming Hao, Manyuan Zhang*, Keqiang Sun, Zhaoyang Huang, Guanglu Song, Yu Liu, Hongsheng Li*
abstract: 优化给定奖励函数的文本到图像扩散模型是一个重要但研究不足的领域。在本研究中,我们提出了一种名为Deep Reward Tuning (DRTune)的算法,该算法直接监督文本到图像扩散模型的最终输出图像,并通过迭代采样过程反向传播到输入噪声。我们发现,在采样过程中早期步骤的训练对于低级奖励至关重要,通过停止去噪网络输入的梯度可以高效且有效地实现深度监督。DRTune在各种奖励模型上进行了广泛评估,其表现始终优于其他算法,特别是在低级控制信号方面,所有浅层监督方法均无法实现。此外,我们通过DRTune对Stable Diffusion XL 1.0 (SDXL 1.0)模型进行微调,以优化Human Preference Score v2.1,从而得到Favorable Diffusion XL 1.0 (FDXL 1.0)模型。FDXL 1.0相比SDXL 1.0显著提升了图像质量,并与Midjourney v5.2达到相当的图像质量。__ABS_MATH_1__
abstract_en: Optimizing a text-to-image diffusion model with a given reward function is an important but underexplored research area. In this study, we propose Deep Reward Tuning (DRTune), an algorithm that directly supervises the final output image of a text-to-image diffusion model and back-propagates through the iterative sampling process to the input noise. We find that training earlier steps in the sampling process is crucial for low-level rewards, and deep supervision can be achieved efficiently and effectively by stopping the gradient of the denoising network input. DRTune is extensively evaluated on various reward models. It consistently outperforms other algorithms, particularly for low-level control signals, where all shallow supervision methods fail. Additionally, we fine-tune Stable Diffusion XL 1.0 (SDXL 1.0) model via DRTune to optimize Human Preference Score v2.1, resulting in the Favorable Diffusion XL 1.0 (FDXL 1.0) model. FDXL 1.0 significantly enhances image quality compared to SDXL 1.0 and reaches comparable quality compared with Midjourney v5.2. 1 1 Authors with all_papers.txt decode_tex_noligatures.sh decode_tex_noligatures.sh~ decode_tex.sh decode_tex.sh~ ECCV_abstracts.csv ECCV_abstracts_good.csv ECCV.csv ECCV.csv~ ECCV_new.csv generate_list.sh generate_list.sh~ generate_overview.sh gen.sh gen.sh~ HOWTO HOWTO~ pdflist pdflist.copied RCS snippet.html contributed equally to this work.

title: Xiaoshuai Hao*, Ruikai Li, Hui Zhang, Rong Yin, Dingzhe Li, Sangil Jung, Seung-In Park, ByungIn Yoo, Haimei Zhao, Jing Zhang
title_en: Xiaoshuai Hao*, Ruikai Li, Hui Zhang, Rong Yin, Dingzhe Li, Sangil Jung, Seung-In Park, ByungIn Yoo, Haimei Zhao, Jing Zhang
abstract: 在线高清(HD)地图构建是自动驾驶领域的重要且具有挑战性的任务。近年来,人们日益关注成本效益高的多视角相机方法,而无需依赖激光雷达等其他传感器。然而,这些方法缺乏显式的深度信息,需要借助大型模型才能获得令人满意的性能。为了解决这一问题,我们首次将知识蒸馏(KD)思想应用于高效HD地图构建,并提出了一种名为MapDistill的新型KD方法,将高性能的相机-激光雷达融合模型知识迁移到轻量级的纯相机模型中。具体而言,我们采用教师-学生架构,其中相机-激光雷达融合模型作为教师,轻量级相机模型作为学生,并设计了一个双BEV变换模块,以促进跨模态知识蒸馏同时保持成本效益的纯相机部署。此外,我们提出了一种全面的蒸馏方案,涵盖跨模态关系蒸馏、双层级特征蒸馏和地图头蒸馏。该方法缓解了模态间知识迁移的挑战,使学生模型能够学习到更优的特征表示以进行HD地图构建。在具有挑战性的nuScenes数据集上的实验结果验证了MapDistill的有效性,其性能超越现有竞争方法7.7 mAP或4.5倍速度提升。
abstract_en: Online high-definition (HD) map construction is an important and challenging task in autonomous driving. Recently, there has been a growing interest in cost-effective multi-view camera-based methods without relying on other sensors like LiDAR. However, these methods suffer from a lack of explicit depth information, necessitating the use of large models to achieve satisfactory performance. To address this, we employ the Knowledge Distillation (KD) idea for efficient HD map construction for the first time and introduce a novel KD-based approach called MapDistill to transfer knowledge from a high-performance camera-LiDAR fusion model to a lightweight camera-only model. Specifically, we adopt the teacher-student architecture, , a camera-LiDAR fusion model as the teacher and a lightweight camera model as the student, and devise a dual BEV transform module to facilitate cross-modal knowledge distillation while maintaining cost-effective camera-only deployment. Additionally, we present a comprehensive distillation scheme encompassing cross-modal relation distillation, dual-level feature distillation, and map head distillation. This approach alleviates knowledge transfer challenges between modalities, enabling the student model to learn improved feature representations for HD map construction. Experimental results on the challenging nuScenes dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of MapDistill, surpassing existing competitors by over 7.7 mAP or 4.5× speedup.

title: Xiaoshuai Zhang*, Zhicheng Wang, Howard Zhou, Soham Ghosh, Danushen L Gnanapragasam, Varun Jampani, Hao Su, Leonidas Guibas
title_en: Xiaoshuai Zhang*, Zhicheng Wang, Howard Zhou, Soham Ghosh, Danushen L Gnanapragasam, Varun Jampani, Hao Su, Leonidas Guibas
abstract: 为推进3D基础模型的前沿研究,本文提出了一种利用现有预训练2D网络和大规模多视角数据集的3D预训练框架。我们提出了一种新颖的2D-3D联合训练方案,在端到端流程中提取共嵌入的2D和3D特征,通过体渲染NeRF类光线行进过程强制执行2D-3D特征一致性。利用密集的每个像素特征,我们能够1) 直接将2D模型学习的先验知识蒸馏到3D模型中并构建有用的3D主干网络,2) 提取更一致且噪声更少的2D特征,3) 构建统一的嵌入空间,使2D、3D及其他模态数据(如自然语言提示)能够联合查询。此外,除了密集特征外,还可训练模型提取稀疏特征(如关键点),并保持2D-3D一致性——将3D NeRF表示压缩为紧凑的装饰关键点集合。我们证明,所提出的预训练模型为包括3D分类和分割在内的多种3D任务提供了良好的初始化,显著优于其他3D预训练方法。它还通过利用稀疏特征,使额外的下游任务成为可能,如将2D图像匹配到3D场景、检测重复3D场景以及通过自然语言查询3D场景库——所有操作均高效完成且无需每场景微调。
abstract_en: To advance the state of the art in the creation of 3D foundation models, this paper introduces the framework for 3D pre-training utilizing existing pre-trained 2D networks and large-scale multi-view datasets. We propose a novel 2D-3D joint training scheme to extract co-embedded 2D and 3D features in an end-to-end pipeline, where 2D-3D feature consistency is enforced through a volume rendering NeRF-like ray marching process. Using dense per pixel features we are able to 1) directly distill the learned priors from 2D models to 3D models and create useful 3D backbones, 2) extract more consistent and less noisy 2D features, 3) formulate a consistent embedding space where 2D, 3D, and other modalities of data (e.g., natural language prompts) can be jointly queried. Furthermore, besides dense features, can be trained to extract sparse features (e.g., key points), also with 2D-3D consistency – condensing 3D NeRF representations into compact sets of decorated key points. We demonstrate that our pre-trained model provides good initialization for various 3D tasks including 3D classification and segmentation, outperforming other 3D pre-training methods by a significant margin. It also enables, by exploiting our sparse features, additional useful downstream tasks, such as matching 2D images to 3D scenes, detecting duplicate 3D scenes, and querying a repository of 3D scenes through natural language – all quite efficiently and without any per-scene fine-tuning.

title: Xiaosu Zhu, Hualian Sheng, Sijia Cai, Bing Deng, Shaopeng Yang, Qiao Liang, Ken Chen, Lianli Gao, Jingkuan Song*, Jieping Ye*
title_en: Xiaosu Zhu, Hualian Sheng, Sijia Cai, Bing Deng, Shaopeng Yang, Qiao Liang, Ken Chen, Lianli Gao, Jingkuan Song*, Jieping Ye*
abstract: 我们介绍了RoScenes,这是目前最大的多视角路边感知数据集,旨在推动以视觉为中心的鸟瞰图(BEV)方法在更具挑战性交通场景中的发展。RoScenes的亮点包括显著扩大的感知区域、全场景覆盖和密集交通场景。具体而言,我们的数据集在64,000平方米范围内实现了令人惊讶的2113万个3D注释。为降低路边3D标注的高昂成本,我们提出了一种新颖的BEV到3D联合注释流程,高效地收集如此大规模的数据。随后,我们针对RoScenes对现有BEV方法进行了全面评估,从有效性和效率两个维度展开。测试方法因感知区域广阔及不同场景中传感器布局的差异,导致性能水平低于预期。为此,我们提出RoBEV,该方法通过特征引导的位置嵌入实现有效的2D-3D特征分配。借助该方法,我们的方案在验证集上无需额外计算开销即显著超越了现有最先进方法。我们的数据集和开发工具包可在https://roscenes.github.io获取。
abstract_en: We introduce RoScenes, the largest multi-view roadside perception dataset, which aims to shed light on the development of vision-centric Bird’s Eye View (BEV) approaches for more challenging traffic scenes. The highlights of RoScenes include significantly large perception area, full scene coverage and crowded traffic. More specifically, our dataset achieves surprising 21.13M 3D annotations within 64,000 m2 . To relieve the expensive costs of roadside 3D labeling, we present a novel BEV-to-3D joint annotation pipeline to efficiently collect such a large volume of data. After that, we organize a comprehensive study for current BEV methods on RoScenes in terms of effectiveness and efficiency. Tested methods suffer from the vast perception area and variation of sensor layout across scenes, resulting in performance levels falling below expectations. To this end, we propose RoBEV that incorporates feature-guided position embedding for effective 2D-3D feature assignment. With its help, our method outperforms state-of-the-art by a large margin without extra computational overhead on validation set. Our dataset and devkit are at https://roscenes.github.io.

title: Xiaotian Song, Peng Zeng, Yanan Sun*, Andy Song
title_en: Xiaotian Song, Peng Zeng, Yanan Sun*, Andy Song
abstract: 现有自动化符号优化器设计方法通常需要依赖代理模型,这在迁移到目标领域时往往导致显著的性能下降。本文提出了一种基于学习的模型——符号优化器学习器(SOL),该模型可以直接在目标领域发现高性能的符号优化器。SOL集成了符号系统,可直接转换为符号优化器。此外,我们引入了一种展开式优化方法用于SOL的训练。SOL可以嵌入到神经网络的训练过程中,无需任何代理模型即可直接优化目标。我们的大量实验表明,SOL在多种任务中展现出良好的性能和高泛化能力,涵盖分类、对抗攻击、图神经网络(GNN)和自然语言处理(NLP)任务。在图像分类任务中,SOL实现了约5倍的加速和约3%的准确率提升。在对抗攻击任务中,SOL在七种最先进的防御模型上取得了最佳攻击成功率。在GNN训练中,SOL发现的优化器在三个不同数据集上均优于Adam。在BERT微调任务中,SOL在五个基准测试中也优于AdamW。源代码可在https://github.com/songxt3/SOL获取。
abstract_en: Existing automated symbolic optimizer design methods necessitate the use of proxies, often resulting in significant performance degradation when transferring to a target domain. In this paper, we propose a learning based model called Symbolic Optimizer Learner (SOL) that can discover high-performance symbolic optimizers directly on the target. SOL is integrated with symbols and can be directly transformed into a symbolic optimizer. In addition, an unrolled optimization approach is introduced for SOL training. SOL can be embedded into the training process of neural networks, optimizing the target directly without any proxies. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the good performance and high generalizability of SOL through diverse tasks, ranging from classifications to adversarial attacks, from GNN to NLP tasks. On image classification, SOL achieved ∼5× speedup and ∼3% accuracy gain. On adversarial attacks, SOL achieved the best attack success rate across seven SOTA defense models. On GNN training, SOL discovered optimizers can outperform Adam on three different datasets. On BERT fine-tuning, SOL also outperformed AdamW on five benchmarks. The source code is available at https://github.com/songxt3/SOL.

title: Xiaotong Lin, Tianming Liang, Jianhuang Lai, Jian-Fang Hu*
title_en: Xiaotong Lin, Tianming Liang, Jianhuang Lai, Jian-Fang Hu*
abstract: 人类轨迹预测是预测道路上行人未来位置的实用任务,通常涵盖轨迹中从短期到长期的所有时间范围。然而,现有研究试图通过单一、统一的训练范式解决整个轨迹预测问题,忽视了人类轨迹中短期与长期动态的区别。为克服这一局限性,我们引入了一种新颖的渐进式预设任务学习(Progressive Pretext Task learning, PPT)框架,该框架逐步增强模型对短期动态和长期依赖关系的捕捉能力,以实现最终的完整轨迹预测。具体而言,我们在PPT框架中精心设计了三个阶段的训练任务。第一阶段,模型通过分步的下一步位置预测任务学习理解短期动态;第二阶段,模型进一步通过目的地预测任务增强对长期依赖关系的理解;最终阶段,模型通过充分利用前一阶段的知识,旨在解决完整的未来轨迹预测任务。为缓解知识遗忘问题,我们进一步应用了跨任务知识蒸馏。此外,我们设计了一种基于Transformer的轨迹预测器,通过整合目标驱动的预测策略和一组可学习的提示嵌入,能够实现高效两步推理。在主流基准数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在高效性方面取得了最先进的性能。代码可在https://github.com/iSEE-Laboratory/PPT获取。
abstract_en: Human trajectory prediction is a practical task of predicting the future positions of pedestrians on the road, which typically covers all temporal ranges from short-term to long-term within a trajectory. However, existing works attempt to address the entire trajectory prediction with a singular, uniform training paradigm, neglecting the distinction between short-term and long-term dynamics in human trajectories. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a novel Progressive Pretext Task learning (PPT) framework, which progressively enhances the model’s capacity of capturing short-term dynamics and long-term dependencies for the final entire trajectory prediction. Specifically, we elaborately design three stages of training tasks in the PPT framework. In the first stage, the model learns to comprehend the short-term dynamics through a stepwise next-position prediction task. In the second stage, the model is further enhanced to understand long-term dependencies through a destination prediction task. In the final stage, the model aims to address the entire future trajectory task by taking full advantage of the knowledge from previous stages. To alleviate the knowledge forgetting, we further apply a cross-task knowledge distillation. Additionally, we design a Transformer-based trajectory predictor, which is able to achieve highly efficient two-step reasoning by integrating a destination-driven prediction strategy and a group of learnable prompt embeddings. Extensive experiments on popular benchmarks have demonstrated that our proposed approach achieves state-of-the-art performance with high efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/iSEE-Laboratory/PPT.

title: Xiaoxu Xu, Yitian Yuan, Jinlong Li, Qiudan Zhang, Zequn Jie, Lin Ma, Hao Tang, Nicu Sebe, Xu Wang*
title_en: Xiaoxu Xu, Yitian Yuan, Jinlong Li, Qiudan Zhang, Zequn Jie, Lin Ma, Hao Tang, Nicu Sebe, Xu Wang*
abstract: 本文提出了一种名为3DSS-VLG的弱监督方法,用于结合二维视觉-语言引导的三维语义分割。该方法通过二维视觉-语言模型预测每个点的密集嵌入,这些嵌入与对齐的图像和文本空间共同嵌入。具体而言,我们的方法利用二维视觉-语言模型的卓越泛化能力,提出嵌入软引导阶段以隐式对齐三维嵌入和文本嵌入。此外,我们引入嵌入专业化阶段,借助给定的场景级标签纯化特征表示,明确指定由对应文本嵌入监督的更好特征。因此,三维模型能够从图像嵌入和文本嵌入中获得信息性监督,从而实现具有竞争力的分割性能。据我们所知,这是首个利用文本类别标签的文本语义信息进行三维弱监督语义分割的工作。此外,通过大量定量和定性实验,我们证明3DSS-VLG不仅在S3DIS和ScanNet数据集上实现了最先进的性能,还保持了强大的泛化能力。代码将在https://github.com/xuxiaoxxxx/3DSS-VLG/上发布。
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose 3DSS-VLG, a weakly supervised approach for 3D Semantic Segmentation with 2D Vision-Language Guidance, an alternative approach that a 3D model predicts dense-embedding for each point which is co-embedded with both the aligned image and text spaces from the 2D vision-language model. Specifically, our method exploits the superior generalization ability of the 2D vision-language models and proposes the Embeddings Soft-Guidance Stage to utilize it to implicitly align 3D embeddings and text embeddings. Moreover, we introduce the Embeddings Specialization Stage to purify the feature representation with the help of a given scene-level label, specifying a better feature supervised by the corresponding text embedding. Thus, the 3D model is able to gain informative supervisions both from the image embedding and text embedding, leading to competitive segmentation performances. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to investigate 3D weakly supervised semantic segmentation by using the textual semantic information of text category labels. Moreover, with extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments, we present that our 3DSS-VLG is able not only to achieve the state-of-the-art performance on both S3DIS and ScanNet datasets, but also to maintain strong generalization capability. The code will be available at https://github.com/xuxiaoxxxx/3DSS-VLG/.

title: Xiaoxuan He, Yifan Yang, Xinyang Jiang, Xufang Luo*, Haoji Hu, Siyun Zhao, Dongsheng Li, Yuqing Yang, Lili Qiu
title_en: Xiaoxuan He, Yifan Yang, Xinyang Jiang, Xufang Luo*, Haoji Hu, Siyun Zhao, Dongsheng Li, Yuqing Yang, Lili Qiu
abstract: 视觉-语言预训练(VLP)在分析医学图像方面展现出优势。它通过利用对应报告中的监督信息,高效地学习视觉表示,并反过来促进复杂成像数据的分析与解释。然而,这种观察主要基于单模态数据(主要是二维图像如X光片),将VLP应用于真实场景中学习医学图像的统一表示仍是一个开放性挑战。这源于医学图像通常包含多种模态,尤其是不同维度的模态(如三维图像如计算机断层扫描),且在此类数据中几乎不存在配对的多维数据。为克服上述挑战,我们提出了一种统一医学图像预训练框架,即__TITLE_MATH_1__,该框架利用诊断报告作为通用语义空间,为医学图像的多样化模态(尤其是二维和三维图像)创建统一表示。在文本的指导下,有效从复杂的三维体积中选择与文本相关的二维切片,这些切片作为伪配对,连接二维和三维数据,最终提升各类医学成像模态之间的一致性。为验证__TITLE_MATH_1__的有效性和通用性,我们在多个不同数据集上评估其在二维和三维图像上的性能,涵盖分类、分割和检索等多种医学图像任务。__TITLE_MATH_1__在下游任务中表现出卓越性能,展示了其在建立通用医学视觉表示方面的有效性。
abstract_en: Vision-Language Pre-training (VLP) has shown the merits of analysing medical images. It efficiently learns visual representations by leveraging supervisions in their corresponding reports, and in turn facilitates analysis and interpretation of intricate imaging data. However, such observation is predominantly justified on single-modality data (mostly 2D images like X-rays), adapting VLP to learning unified representations for medical images in real scenario remains an open challenge. This arises from medical images often encompass a variety of modalities, especially modalities with different dimensions (e.g., 3D images like Computed Tomography), and there are almost no paired multi-dimension data here. To overcome the aforementioned challenges, we propose an Unified Medical Image Pre-training framework, namely , which utilizes diagnostic reports as common semantic space to create unified representations for diverse modalities of medical images (especially for 2D and 3D images). Under the text’s guidance, effectively select text-related 2D slices from sophisticated 3D volume, which acts as pseudo-pairs to bridge 2D and 3D data, ultimately enhancing the consistency across various medical imaging modalities. To demonstrate the effectiveness and versatility of , we evaluate its performance on both 2D and 3D images across several different datasets, covering a wide range of medical image tasks such as classification, segmentation, and retrieval. has demonstrated superior performance in downstream tasks, showcasing its effectiveness in establishing a universal medical visual representation.

title: Xiaoyi Bao, Siyang Sun, Shuailei Ma, Kecheng Zheng, Yuxin Guo, Guosheng Zhao, Yun Zheng, Xingang Wang*
title_en: Xiaoyi Bao, Siyang Sun, Shuailei Ma, Kecheng Zheng, Yuxin Guo, Guosheng Zhao, Yun Zheng, Xingang Wang*
abstract: 需要对复杂查询进行细致理解以准确定位物体区域的推理分割任务正引起越来越多的关注。然而,多模态大语言模型(MLLM)往往难以在复杂推理语境中准确定位所描述的物体。我们认为,推理分割过程应模拟人类视觉搜索的认知阶段,其中每一步都是逐步精炼思维以最终定位物体。因此,我们引入了推理与分割链(CoReS),并发现这种自上而下的视觉层次结构确实增强了视觉搜索过程。具体而言,我们提出了一种双链结构,生成多模态、链式输出以辅助分割过程。此外,为引导MLLM的输出进入预期的层次结构,我们引入了上下文输入作为指导。大量实验表明,我们的CoReS方法性能优越,在ReasonSeg数据集上超越了最先进方法6.5%。
abstract_en: The reasoning segmentation task, which demands a nuanced comprehension of intricate queries to accurately pinpoint object regions, is attracting increasing attention. However, Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLM) often find it difficult to accurately localize the objects described in complex reasoning contexts. We believe that the act of reasoning segmentation should mirror the cognitive stages of human visual search, where each step is a progressive refinement of thought toward the final object. Thus we introduce the Chains of Reasoning and Segmenting (CoReS) and find this top-down visual hierarchy indeed enhances the visual search process. Specifically, we propose a dual-chain structure that generates multi-modal, chain-like outputs to aid the segmentation process. Furthermore, to steer the MLLM’s outputs into this intended hierarchy, we incorporate in-context inputs as guidance. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of our CoReS, which surpasses the state-of-the-art method by 6.5% on the ReasonSeg dataset.

title: 卢晓勇*, 杜松林*
title_en: Xiaoyong Lu*, Songlin Du*
abstract: 当前特征匹配方法优先提升建模能力以更好地对齐输出与真实匹配,这些真实匹配被视为匹配结果的理论上限,比喻为“天花板”。然而,这些改进未能解决直接阻碍真实匹配的根本问题,包括小尺度图像中可匹配点稀缺、密集方法中的匹配冲突以及稀疏方法对关键点可重复性的依赖。我们提出了一种名为RCM的新特征匹配方法,从三个方面提升匹配天花板。1)RCM引入动态视角切换机制,通过策略性切换图像对来解决源图像中可匹配点稀缺的问题。2)RCM提出无冲突粗匹配模块,通过多对一匹配策略解决目标图像中的匹配冲突。3)通过整合半稀疏范式和由粗到细架构,RCM保留了高效率与全局搜索的优势,缓解了对关键点可重复性的依赖。结果表明,RCM使源图像中更多可匹配点能够以穷尽且无冲突的方式在目标图像中匹配,真实匹配数量提升了260%。综合实验表明,RCM在性能和效率方面均优于现有最先进方法。
abstract_en: Current feature matching methods prioritize improving modeling capabilities to better align outputs with ground-truth matches, which are the theoretical upper bound on matching results, metaphorically depicted as the “ceiling”. However, these enhancements fail to address the underlying issues that directly hinder ground-truth matches, including the scarcity of matchable points in small scale images, matching conflicts in dense methods, and the keypoint-repeatability reliance in sparse methods. We propose a novel feature matching method named RCM, which Raises the Ceiling of Matching from three aspects. 1) RCM introduces a dynamic view switching mechanism to address the scarcity of matchable points in source images by strategically switching image pairs. 2) RCM proposes a conflict-free coarse matching module, addressing matching conflicts in the target image through a many-to-one matching strategy. 3) By integrating the semi-sparse paradigm and the coarse-to-fine architecture, RCM preserves the benefits of both high efficiency and global search, mitigating the reliance on keypoint repeatability. As a result, RCM enables more matchable points in the source image to be matched in an exhaustive and conflict-free manner in the target image, leading to a substantial 260% increase in ground-truth matches. Comprehensive experiments show that RCM exhibits remarkable performance and efficiency in comparison to state-of-the-art methods.

title: Xiaoyu Liu*, Xin Ding, Lei Yu, Yuanyuan Xi, Wei Li, Zhijun Tu, Jie Hu, Hanting Chen, Baoqun Yin, Zhiwei Xiong*
title_en: Xiaoyu Liu*, Xin Ding, Lei Yu, Yuanyuan Xi, Wei Li, Zhijun Tu, jie hu, Hanting Chen, Baoqun YIN, Zhiwei Xiong*
abstract: Segment Anything Model (SAM) 是一种有前景的基于提示的视觉基础模型,可用于分割感兴趣的目标。然而,SAM 的广泛计算需求限制了其在资源受限边缘设备中的适用性。后训练量化(PTQ)是快速部署 SAM 的有效潜在方法。然而,SAM 的十亿级预训练导致了高度不对称的激活分布,存在大量有害的异常值通道,从而导致低比特 PTQ 性能显著下降。本文提出 PQ-SAM,这是首个针对 SAM 的 PTQ 方法。为实现量化友好的张量级分布,PQ-SAM 采用基于两阶段异常值层次聚类(OHC)方案的新型分组激活分布变换(GADT),对每个通道进行缩放和偏移。首先,OHC 识别并截断极端异常值以降低不同通道的尺度方差。其次,OHC 迭代地为具有相似分布的通道组分配可学习的偏移和缩放大小,减少可学习参数数量并降低优化难度。这些偏移和缩放大小用于调整激活通道,并与量化步长联合优化以获得最佳结果。大量实验表明,PQ-SAM 在九个零样本数据集上优于现有 PTQ 方法,并将 SAM 的 4 位 PTQ 推进到可用水平。
abstract_en: Segment anything model (SAM) is a promising prompt-guided vision foundation model to segment objects of interest. However, the extensive computational requirements of SAM have limited its applicability in resource-constraint edge devices. Post-training quantization (PTQ) is an effective potential for fast-deploying SAM. Nevertheless, SAM’s billion-scale pretraining creates a highly asymmetric activation distribution with detrimental outliers in excessive channels, resulting in significant performance degradation of the low-bit PTQ. In this paper, we propose PQ-SAM, the first PTQ method customized for SAM. To achieve a quantization-friendly tensor-wise distribution, PQ-SAM incorporates a novel grouped activation distribution transformation (GADT) based on a two-stage outlier hierarchical clustering (OHC) scheme to scale and shift each channel. Firstly, OHC identifies and truncates extreme outliers to reduce the scale variance of different channels. Secondly, OHC iteratively allocates learnable shifting and scaling sizes to each group of channels with similar distributions, reducing the number of learnable parameters and easing the optimization difficulty. These shifting and scaling sizes are used to adjust activation channels, and jointly optimized with quantization step sizes for optimal results. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PQ-SAM outperforms existing PTQ methods on nine zero-shot datasets, and pushes the 4-bit PTQ of SAM to a usable level.

title: Xiaoyu Liu, Yuxiang Wei, Ming Liu*, Xianhui Lin, Peiran Ren, Xuansong Xie, Wangmeng Zuo
title_en: Xiaoyu Liu, Yuxiang Wei, Ming Liu*, Xianhui Lin, Peiran Ren, xuansong xie, Wangmeng Zuo
abstract: 近年来,诸如ControlNet等文本到图像生成方法在控制图像布局方面取得了显著成果,其中默认模型生成的图像严格遵循视觉条件(如深度图)。然而,在实际应用中,这些条件通常仅提供粗略的布局,我们认为文本提示更能忠实反映用户意图。为解决文本提示与粗略视觉条件之间的分歧,我们提出了一种新的文本到图像生成方法,称为SmartControl,该方法旨在与文本提示保持良好对齐,同时自适应保留视觉条件中的有用信息。SmartControl的核心思想是放松与文本提示冲突的视觉条件区域的约束,实现这种灵活生成需要两个主要步骤。具体而言,我们从主干模型(如ControlNet)的生成先验中提取信息,该信息有效表示文本提示与视觉条件之间的一致性。然后设计了一个Control Scale Predictor,用于识别冲突区域并预测局部控制尺度。为训练该方法,构建了一个包含文本提示和粗略视觉条件的数据集。值得注意的是,即使仅使用有限数量(例如1,000∼2,000)的训练样本,我们的SmartControl仍能很好地泛化到未见过的对象。在四种典型视觉条件类型上进行了大量实验,结果表明我们的SmartControl在性能上优于现有最先进的方法。源代码、预训练模型和数据集将公开提供。
abstract_en: Recent text-to-image generation methods such as ControlNet have achieved remarkable success in controlling image layouts, where the generated images by the default model are constrained to strictly follow the visual conditions (e.g., depth maps). However, in practice, the conditions usually provide only a rough layout, and we argue that the text prompts can more faithfully reflect user intentions. For handling the disagreements between the text prompts and rough visual conditions, we propose a novel text-to-image generation method dubbed SmartControl, which is designed to align well with the text prompts while adaptively keeping useful information from the visual conditions. The key idea of our SmartControl is to relax the constraints on areas that conflict with the text prompts in visual conditions, and two main procedures are required to achieve such a flexible generation. In specific, we extract information from the generative priors of the backbone model (e.g., ControlNet), which effectively represents consistency between the text prompt and visual conditions. Then, a Control Scale Predictor is designed to identify the conflict regions and predict the local control scales. For training the proposed method, a dataset with text prompts and rough visual conditions is constructed. It is worth noting that, even with a limited number (e.g., 1,000∼2,000) of training samples, our SmartControl can generalize well to unseen objects. Extensive experiments are conducted on four typical visual condition types, and our SmartControl can achieve a superior performance against state-of-the-art methods. Source code, pre-trained models, and datasets will be publicly available.

title: Xiaoyu Xu*, Jiayan Qiu, Baosheng Yu, Zhou Wang
title_en: Xiaoyu Xu*, Jiayan Qiu, Baosheng Yu, Zhou Wang
abstract: 在新颖视角下物体之间的关系会如何变化?我们通过研究一种新的视觉认知任务——视觉关系转换(Visual Relationship Transformation, VRT)来回答这一问题。与以往基于可见视角图像的视觉关系检测任务不同,VRT旨在从单一观测源视角预测新颖视角中的物体关系。为解决VRT问题,我们提出了一种端到端的深度学习方法,该方法在给定观测视角图像和跨视角变换后,学习预测新颖视角中的关系。具体而言,我们引入了一种等变图神经网络,通过强制学习到的关系表示的变换等变性,预测新颖视角中物体之间的关系。同时,我们学习了一个关系存在性掩码以剔除不可见关系,从而实现新颖视角中可见关系的预测。为此,VRT为完成与新颖视角相关的任务(如视觉定位(VG)、新颖视角合成(NVS)和行人意图估计(PIE))提供了补充线索。实验结果表明,将VRT作为插件模块可显著提升所有数据集上的VG、NVS和PIE性能。
abstract_en: What will be the relationships between objects in a novel view? We strive to answer this question by investigating a new visual cognition task, termed visual relationship transformation or VRT. Unlike prior visual relationship detection task that works on visible view images, VRT aims to predict the relationships in unseen novel views from a single observed source view. Towards solving VRT, we propose an end-to-end deep approach that, given an observed view image and inter-view transformations, learns to predict the relationships in novel views. Specifically, we introduce an equivariant graph neural network to predict the relationships between objects in novel views, which is achieved by enforcing the transformation equivariance of the learned relationship representations. Simultaneously, a relationship presentness mask is learned for pruning the invisible ones, thus enabling the visible relationship prediction in novel views. To this end, VRT provides supplementary cues for accomplishing novel-view-related tasks, such as visual grounding (VG), novel view synthesis (NVS), and pedestrian intention estimation (PIE). In the experiments, adopting VRT as a plug-in module results in considerable performance improvements in VG, NVS, and PIE across all datasets.

title: Xiaoyu Zhang, Guangwei Liu, Zihao Liu, Ningyi Xu, Yunhui Liu*, Ji Zhao
title_en: Xiaoyu Zhang, Guangwei Liu, Zihao Liu, Ningyi Xu, Yunhui Liu*, Ji Zhao
abstract: 在自动驾驶领域,人们对鸟瞰图(BEV)空间中端到端在线矢量地图感知技术的兴趣日益增长,期望其能够替代传统高成本的离线高精度(HD)地图。然而,仅依赖车载传感器时,这些方法在遮挡或恶劣天气等复杂条件下,其准确性和鲁棒性容易受到损害。本文提出利用低成本历史栅格化地图来增强在线矢量地图感知。历史栅格化地图可从过去预测的矢量结果中轻松构建,并提供有价值的补充信息。为充分挖掘历史地图信息,我们提出两个新颖模块以增强BEV特征和地图元素查询。对于BEV特征,我们采用特征聚合模块,将车载图像和历史地图的特征进行编码。对于地图元素查询,我们设计查询初始化模块,使查询能够从历史地图中获得先验信息。这两个模块有助于在线感知中利用地图信息。我们的方法可与大多数在线矢量地图感知方法集成。我们将其集成到两个最先进的方法中,在nuScenes和Argoverse 2数据集上显著提升了其性能。源代码已发布于https://github.com/HXMap/HRMapNet。
abstract_en: In autonomous driving, there is growing interest in end-to-end online vectorized map perception in bird’s-eye-view (BEV) space, with an expectation that it could replace traditional high-cost offline high-definition (HD) maps. However, the accuracy and robustness of these methods can be easily compromised in challenging conditions, such as occlusion or adverse weather, when relying only on onboard sensors. In this paper, we propose , leveraging a low-cost Historical Rasterized Map to enhance online vectorized map perception. The historical rasterized map can be easily constructed from past predicted vectorized results and provides valuable complementary information. To fully exploit a historical map, we propose two novel modules to enhance BEV features and map element queries. For BEV features, we employ a feature aggregation module to encode features from both onboard images and the historical map. For map element queries, we design a query initialization module to endow queries with priors from the historical map. The two modules contribute to leveraging map information in online perception. Our can be integrated with most online vectorized map perception methods. We integrate it in two state-of-the-art methods, significantly improving their performance on both the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 datasets. The source code is released at https://github.com/HXMap/HRMapNet.

title: Xiaoyu Zhu*, Hao Zhou, Pengfei Xing, Long Zhao, Hao Xu, Junwei Liang, Alexander G. Hauptmann, Ting Liu, Andrew Gallagher
title_en: Xiaoyu Zhu*, Hao Zhou, Pengfei Xing, Long Zhao, Hao Xu, Junwei Liang, Alexander G. Hauptmann, Ting Liu, Andrew Gallagher
abstract: 本文研究了在大规模图像-描述对上预训练的扩散模型在开放词汇3D语义理解中的应用。我们提出了一种新颖的方法Diff2Scene,该方法利用冻结的文本-图像生成模型表示,结合显著性感知和几何感知掩码,用于开放词汇3D语义分割和视觉定位任务。Diff2Scene无需任何标注的3D数据,能够有效识别3D场景中的物体、外观、材质、位置及其组合。我们证明了该方法在竞争基线模型上表现更优,并在现有最先进方法的基础上取得了显著提升。特别是,Diff2Scene在ScanNet200数据集上将现有最先进方法的性能提升了12%。
abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate the use of diffusion models which are pre-trained on large-scale image-caption pairs for open-vocabulary 3D semantic understanding. We propose a novel method, namely Diff2Scene, which leverages frozen representations from text-image generative models, along with salient-aware and geometric-aware masks, for open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation and visual grounding tasks. Diff2Scene gets rid of any labeled 3D data and effectively identifies objects, appearances, materials, locations and their compositions in 3D scenes. We show that it outperforms competitive baselines and achieves significant improvements over state-of-the-art methods. In particular, Diff2Scene improves the state-of-the-art method on ScanNet200 by 12%.

title: Xiayu Wang, Ke Ma, Ruiyun Zhong, Xinggang Wang, Yi Fang, Yang Xiao, Tian Xia*
title_en: Xiayu Wang, Ke Ma, Ruiyun Zhong, Xinggang Wang, Yi Fang, Yang Xiao, Tian Xia*
abstract: “双透明液体”指的是液体及其容器均为透明的场景。从任意视角准确估计此类液体的液面高度是基础且关键的任务,尤其在AI引导的自主生物医学实验室中,用于液体分配、吸取和混合等操作。然而,当前估计液面高度的方法主要针对固定视角下单一实例的场景。我们提出了一种新的双透明液体液面估计范式,包括数据集、方法和实践。该双透明液体数据集(DTLD)包含三个生物医学实验室场景中,从多视角拍摄的27,458张图像,涵盖四个物体实例。基于DTLD,我们提出了一种端到端学习方法,用于检测液体接触线,随后通过方法估计液面高度。为增强接触线检测,我们提出了一种颜色校正模块,以稳定气液界面局部区域的颜色分布。此外,我们的方法超越了当前最佳方法,将平均绝对百分比误差降低了43.4%。数据集和代码可在https://github.com/dualtransparency/TCLD获取。
abstract_en: “Dual Transparent Liquid” refers to a liquid and its container, both being transparent. Accurately estimating the levels of such a liquid from arbitrary viewpoints is fundamental and crucial, especially in AI-guided autonomous biomedical laboratories for tasks like liquid dispensing, aspiration, and mixing. However, current methods for estimating liquid level focus on scenarios of a single instance captured from a fixed view. We propose a new dual transparent liquid level estimation paradigm, including a dataset, methods, and practices. The dual transparent liquid dataset, named DTLD, comprises 27,458 images with four object instances captured from multiple views across three biomedical lab scenes. Based on DTLD, we propose an end-to-end learning method for detecting the liquid contact line, followed by an approach to estimate the liquid level. To enhance contact line detection, a color rectification module is proposed to stabilize the color distribution at the local region of the air-liquid interface. Additionally, our method surpasses the current best approach, reducing the mean absolute percentage error by a percentage of 43.4. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/dualtransparency/TCLD.

title: Xidong Peng, Runnan Chen, Feng Qiao, Lingdong Kong, Youquan Liu, Yujing Sun, Tai Wang, Xinge Zhu*, Yuexin Ma*
title_en: Xidong Peng, Runnan Chen, Feng Qiao, Lingdong Kong, Youquan Liu, Yujing Sun, Tai Wang, Xinge Zhu*, Yuexin Ma*
abstract: 在三维分割任务中,无监督域适应(UDA)面临巨大挑战,主要源于点云的稀疏性和无序性。尤其是激光雷达点云,在不同采集场景、多变的天气条件以及多样化的激光雷达设备下,域差异尤为显著。受视觉基础模型SAM在图像分割领域表现出的卓越泛化能力启发,我们的方法利用SAM中蕴含的丰富通用知识,统一不同三维域的特征表示,并进一步解决三维域适应问题。具体而言,我们借助与点云相关的对应图像促进知识迁移,提出了一种创新的混合特征增强方法,该方法在场景级和实例级增强三维特征空间与SAM特征空间的对齐效果。我们的方法在多个广泛认可的数据集上进行了评估,取得了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) in 3D segmentation tasks presents a formidable challenge, primarily stemming from the sparse and unordered nature of point clouds. Especially for LiDAR point clouds, the domain discrepancy becomes obvious across varying capture scenes, fluctuating weather conditions, and the diverse array of LiDAR devices in use. Inspired by the remarkable generalization capabilities exhibited by the vision foundation model, SAM, in the realm of image segmentation, our approach leverages the wealth of general knowledge embedded within SAM to unify feature representations across diverse 3D domains and further solves the 3D domain adaptation problem. Specifically, we harness the corresponding images associated with point clouds to facilitate knowledge transfer and propose an innovative hybrid feature augmentation methodology, which enhances the alignment between the 3D feature space and SAM’s feature space, operating at both the scene and instance levels. Our method is evaluated on many widely-recognized datasets and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

title: Xijun Wang*, Junbang Liang, Chun-Kai Wang, Kenan Deng, Yu Lou, Ming C Lin, Shan Yang
title_en: Xijun Wang*, Junbang Liang, Chun-Kai Wang, Kenan Deng, Yu Lou, Ming C Lin, Shan Yang
abstract: 我们提出了一种高效的视频-语言对齐(ViLA)网络。我们的ViLA模型以统一的方式解决了高效帧采样和有效的跨模态对齐问题。在ViLA网络中,我们设计了一个新的可学习文本引导的帧提示器(Frame-Prompter)以及一个跨模态蒸馏(QFormer-Distiller)模块。预训练的大型图像-语言模型在诸如视觉问答(VQA)等问题上表现出色。然而,如何在将预训练的大型图像-语言模型适配到视频-语言对齐时高效且有效地采样视频帧仍然是主要挑战。与先前工作相比,我们的ViLA模型展示了选择关键内容关键帧的能力,从而在提升视频-语言对齐准确率的同时减少推理延迟(在NExT-QA Temporal上提升3.3%,速度提升3.0倍)。总体而言,我们的ViLA网络在视频问答基准测试中优于现有最先进方法:在STAR Interaction上提升4.6%,在STAR平均值上提升2.2%(速度提升3.0倍),在VLEP数据集上,我们的2帧方法优于SeViLA的4帧方法(速度提升4.2倍)。代码将在https://github.com/xijun-cs/ViLA上发布。
abstract_en: We propose an efficient Video-Language Alignment (ViLA) network. Our ViLA model addresses both efficient frame sampling and effective cross-modal alignment in a unified way. In our ViLA network, we design a new learnable text-guided Frame-Prompter together with a cross-modal distillation (QFormer-Distiller) module. Pre-trained large image-language models have shown promising results on problems such as visual question answering (VQA). However, how to efficiently and effectively sample video frames when adapting pre-trained large image-language model to video-language alignment is still the major challenge. Compared with prior work, our ViLA model demonstrates the capability of selecting key frames with critical contents, thus improving the video-language alignment accuracy while reducing the inference latency (+3.3% on NExT-QA Temporal with 3.0× speed up). Overall, our ViLA network outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on the video question-answering benchmarks: +4.6% on STAR Interaction, +2.2% on STAR average with 3.0× speed up, ours 2-frames out-perform SeViLA 4-frames on the VLEP dataset with 4.2× speed-up. Code will be available at https://github.com/xijun-cs/ViLA.

title: Xin Duan, Yu Cao, Lei Zhu, Gang Fu, Xin Wang, Renjie ZHANG, Ping Li*
title_en: Xin Duan, Yu Cao, Lei Zhu, Gang Fu, Xin Wang, Renjie ZHANG, Ping Li*
abstract: 视频阴影检测(VSD)是一项重要的计算机视觉任务,专注于在整个视频序列中检测和分割阴影。尽管现有VSD方法和数据集在主导且孤立的阴影处理上表现出色,但主要聚焦于此类场景,因此复杂场景下的VSD仍是一个未被充分探索的挑战。为解决这一问题,我们构建了一个新的数据集——复杂视频阴影数据集(CVSD),包含196个视频片段,共计19,757帧,涵盖复杂的阴影模式,以提升VSD的实际应用性。我们提出了一种两阶段训练范式和一种新型网络,以应对复杂动态阴影场景。将复杂视频阴影检测视为条件特征适配问题,我们分别设计了时序和空间自适应模块,用于融合时序信息并实现高质量阴影检测。据我们所知,我们是首个构建针对复杂VSD任务的数据集和模型的研究团队。实验结果表明,我们的模型在现有SOTA VSD方法上具有优越性。我们的项目将在以下链接公开:https://hizuka590.github.io/CVSD.
abstract_en: Video Shadow Detection (VSD) is an important computer vision task focusing on detecting and segmenting shadows throughout the entire video sequence. Despite their remarkable performance, existing VSD methods and datasets mainly focus on the dominant and isolated shadows. Consequently, VSD under complex scenes is still an unexplored challenge. To address this issue, we built a new dataset, Complex Video Shadow Dataset (CVSD), which contains 196 video clips including 19,757 frames with complex shadow patterns, to enhance the practical applicability of VSD. We propose a two-stage training paradigm and a novel network to handle complex dynamic shadow scenarios. Regarding the complex video shadow detection as conditioned feature adaption, we propose temporal- and spatial-adaption blocks for incorporating temporal information and attaining high-quality shadow detection, respectively. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to construct the dataset and model tailored for the complex VSD task. Experimental results show the superiority of our model over state-of-the-art VSD methods. Our project will be publicly available at: https://hizuka590.github.io/CVSD.

title: Xin He, Chenlei Lv, Pengdi Huang, Hui Huang*
title_en: Xin He, Chenlei Lv, Pengdi Huang, Hui Huang*
abstract: 原始点云的多边形网格重建是计算机图形学和三维视觉领域的重要课题。特别是对于三维建筑模型,多边形网格能够以简洁的方式表达基本几何结构,同时有效减少数据量。然而,传统重建方法存在一些局限性:法向量依赖性、对噪声点和缺陷部分的敏感性,以及内部几何结构的丢失,这些限制降低了其在真实场景中的实用性。本文提出了一种鲁棒且高效的多边形网格重建方法,以解决建筑点云重建任务中的相关问题。该方法是一个迭代适应过程,用于从散乱点中检测平面形状。可以在构建的凸多面体空间中无需法向量辅助建立初始结构化的多边形网格。随后,我们开发了一种高效的基于多边形的缠绕数策略,以实现多边形网格的全局一致性定向。我们方法的显著优势在于为建筑点云提供结构化重建,避免了基于点的法向量分析。该方法有效提高了对噪声点和缺陷部分的鲁棒性,并在重建的多边形网格中保留了更多的几何细节。实验结果表明,我们的方法能够重建出简洁、定向且忠实的多边形网格,其效果优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Polygonal mesh reconstruction of a raw point cloud is a valuable topic in the field of computer graphics and 3D vision. Especially to 3D architectural models, polygonal mesh provides concise expressions for fundamental geometric structures while effectively reducing data volume. However, there are some limitations of traditional reconstruction methods: normal vector dependency, noisy points and defective parts sensitivity, and internal geometric structure lost, which reduce the practicality in real scene. In this paper, we propose a robust and efficient polygonal mesh reconstruction method to address the issues in architectural point cloud reconstruction task. It is an iterative adaptation process to detect planar shapes from scattered points. The initial structural polygonal mesh can be established in the constructed convex polyhedral space without assistance of normal vectors. Then, we develop an efficient polygon-based winding number strategy to orient polygonal mesh with global consistency. The significant advantage of our method is to provide a structural reconstruction for architectural point clouds and avoid point-based normal vector analysis. It effectively improves the robustness to noisy points and defective parts. More geometric details can be preserved in the reconstructed polygonal mesh. Experimental results show that our method can reconstruct concise, oriented and faithfully polygonal mesh that are better than results of state-of-the-art methods.

title: Xin Jin*, Bohan Li*, Baao Xie, Wenyao Zhang, Jinming Liu, Ziqiang Li, Tao Yang, Wenjun Zeng
title_en: Xin Jin*, Bohan Li*, Baao Xie, Wenyao Zhang, Jinming Liu, Ziqiang Li, Tao Yang, Wenjun Zeng
abstract: 表示解耦可能有助于AI从根本上理解真实世界,从而同时提升判别任务和生成任务的性能。目前该领域至少存在三个未解决的核心问题:(i) 过度依赖标签标注和合成数据——导致在自然场景中泛化能力差;(ii) 启发式/手工设计的解耦约束使难以自适应实现最优训练权衡;(iii) 缺乏合理的评估指标,尤其针对真实标签数据。为解决这些挑战,我们提出一种闭环无监督表示解耦方法,命名为CL-Dis。具体而言,我们采用基于扩散模型的自编码器(Diff-AE)作为主干网络,同时借助β-VAE作为协作者提取语义解耦表示。扩散模型强大的生成能力和VAE模型良好的解耦能力具有互补性。为强化解耦效果,VAE潜变量蒸馏与扩散模型反馈在闭环系统中相互连接,实现进一步的协同优化。随后引入自监督导航策略,用于在解耦潜空间中识别可解释的语义方向。最后设计基于内容追踪的新评估指标,用于评价解耦效果。实验表明CL-Dis在真实图像编辑和视觉分析等应用中具有优越性。
abstract_en: Representation disentanglement may help AI fundamentally understand the real world and thus benefit both discrimination and generation tasks. It currently has at least three unresolved core issues: (i) heavy reliance on label annotation and synthetic data — causing poor generalization on natural scenarios; (ii) heuristic/hand-craft disentangling constraints make it hard to adaptively achieve an optimal training trade-off; (iii) lacking reasonable evaluation metric, especially for the real label-free data. To address these challenges, we propose a Closed-Loop unsupervised representation Disentanglement approach dubbed CL-Dis. Specifically, we use diffusion-based autoencoder (Diff-AE) as a backbone while resorting to β-VAE as a co-pilot to extract semantically disentangled representations. The strong generation ability of diffusion model and the good disentanglement ability of VAE model are complementary. To strengthen disentangling, VAE-latent distillation and diffusion-wise feedback are interconnected in a closed-loop system for a further mutual promotion. Then, a self-supervised Navigation strategy is introduced to identify interpretable semantic directions in the disentangled latent space. Finally, a new metric based on content tracking is designed to evaluate the disentanglement effect. Experiments demonstrate the superiority of CL-Dis on applications like real image manipulation and visual analysis.

title: Xin Li*, Bingchen Li, Yeying Jin, Cuiling Lan, Hanxin Zhu, Yulin Ren, Zhibo Chen
title_en: Xin Li*, Bingchen Li, Yeying Jin, Cuiling Lan, Hanxin Zhu, Yulin Ren, Zhibo Chen
abstract: 压缩图像超分辨率(CSR)旨在同时对压缩图像进行超分辨率重建,并解决由压缩引起的混合失真问题。然而,现有CSR研究通常专注于单一压缩编解码器(如JPEG),忽视了实际应用中多样化的传统或基于学习的编解码器(如HEVC、VVC、HIFIC等)。在本文中,我们提出了首个通用CSR框架UCIP,采用动态提示学习,旨在支持任意压缩编解码器/模式的CSR失真。特别地,我们提出了一种高效的动态提示策略,仅使用少量1×1空间尺寸的提示,挖掘内容/空间感知的任务自适应上下文信息。为简化上下文信息挖掘,我们通过首次将主动令牌混合器(ATM)适配到CSR任务,引入了新颖的MLP-like框架主干,其中全局信息建模仅在水平和垂直方向上进行偏移预测。我们还构建了一个包含6种流行传统和基于学习的编解码器(包括JPEG、HEVC、VVC、HIFIC等)的全功能基准数据集,共产生23种常见退化现象。大量实验表明,我们的UCIP在通用CSR任务中表现出一致且优异的性能。项目地址:https://lixinustc.github.io/UCIP.github.io
abstract_en: Compressed Image Super-resolution (CSR) aims to simultaneously super-resolve the compressed images and tackle the challenging hybrid distortions caused by compression. However, existing works on CSR usually focus on single compression codec, , JPEG, ignoring the diverse traditional or learning-based codecs in the practical application, , HEVC, VVC, HIFIC, etc. In this work, we propose the first universal CSR framework, dubbed UCIP, with dynamic prompt learning, intending to jointly support the CSR distortions of any compression codecs/modes. Particularly, an efficient dynamic prompt strategy is proposed to mine the content/spatial-aware task-adaptive contextual information for the universal CSR task, using only a small amount of prompts with spatial size 1 × 1. To simplify contextual information mining, we introduce the novel MLP-like framework backbone for our UCIP by adapting the Active Token Mixer (ATM) to CSR tasks for the first time, where the global information modeling is only taken in horizontal and vertical directions with offset prediction. We also build an all-in-one benchmark dataset for the CSR task by collecting the datasets with the popular 6 diverse traditional and learning-based codecs, including JPEG, HEVC, VVC, HIFIC, etc., resulting in 23 common degradations. Extensive experiments have shown the consistent and excellent performance of our UCIP on universal CSR tasks. The project can be found in magentahttps://lixinustc. github.io/UCIP.github.io

title: Xin Liu*, Yichen Zhu, Jindong Gu, Yunshi Lan, Chao Yang, Yu Qiao
title_en: Xin Liu*, Yichen Zhu, Jindong Gu, Yunshi Lan, Chao Yang, Yu Qiao
abstract: 红色警告:本文包含有害语言和图像的示例,建议读者谨慎阅读。尽管大型语言模型(LLMs)的安全性已得到广泛研究,但多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)的安全性仍缺乏系统性探讨。本文观察到,当多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)与恶意文本查询配对时,可能被简单的相关图像轻易攻击。这种攻击无需对文本或图像进行对抗性攻击即可实现。为应对这一问题,我们提出MM-SafetyBench,一个全面的框架,用于对MLLMs进行针对图像操控的安全关键性评估。我们构建了一个包含13种场景的测试数据集,共计5,040组文本-图像对。通过对12种最先进的模型分析发现,即使配备的安全对齐大语言模型,MLLMs仍可能受到我们方法引发的攻击。为此,我们提出了一种简单而有效的提示策略,以增强MLLMs对这类攻击的鲁棒性。我们的工作强调了加强开源MLLMs安全防护措施的迫切需求,以应对潜在的恶意利用。相关资源可访问 https://github.com/isXinLiu/MM-SafetyBench。
abstract_en: redWarning: This paper contains examples of harmful language and images, and reader discretion is recommended. The security concerns surrounding Large Language Models (LLMs) have been extensively explored, yet the safety of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) remains understudied. In this paper, we observe that Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can be easily compromised by simple query-relevant images when paired with a malicious text query. This attack is achieved without the need for adversarial attacks on either the text or the images. To address this, we introduce MM-SafetyBench, a comprehensive framework designed for conducting safety-critical evaluations of MLLMs against such image-based manipulations. We have compiled a dataset comprising 13 scenarios, resulting in a total of 5,040 text-image pairs. Our analysis across 12 state-of-the-art models reveals that MLLMs are susceptible to breaches instigated by our approach, even when the equipped LLMs have been safety-aligned. In response, we propose a straightforward yet effective prompting strategy to enhance the resilience of MLLMs against these types of attacks. Our work underscores the need for a concerted effort to strengthen and enhance the safety measures of open-source MLLMs against potential malicious exploits. The resource is available at https://github.com/isXinLiu/MM-SafetyBench.

title: 辛明, 李佳伟, 凌景望, 张立波, 徐峰*
title_en: Xin Ming, Jiawei Li, Jingwang Ling, Libo Zhang, Feng Xu*
abstract: 基于网格的面部融合形状在动画管线中被广泛应用,而近期在神经几何和外观表示方面的进展使得高质量的逆渲染成为可能。基于这些观察,我们提出了一种新颖技术,利用最先进的神经逆渲染方法,从单视角或多视角稀疏视频中重建基于网格的融合形状骨骼。我们首先构建一种形变表示,将顶点位移参数化为带有四面体连接的微分坐标,从而在高分辨率网格上实现高质量的顶点形变。通过在此表示中构建一组语义约束,我们实现了融合形状与表情系数的联合优化。此外,为支持用户友好的多视角设置(包含不同步的摄像机),我们使用神经回归器建模时变运动参数。实验表明,通过单视角或多视角稀疏视频的灵活输入,我们重建了高保真度的个性化融合形状。这些融合形状在几何和语义上均准确,并且兼容工业动画管线。代码和数据可在https://github.com/grignarder/high-quality-blendshape-generation获取。
abstract_en: Mesh-based facial blendshapes have been widely used in animation pipelines, while recent advancements in neural geometry and appearance representations have enabled high-quality inverse rendering. Building upon these observations, we introduce a novel technique that reconstructs mesh-based blendshape rigs from single or sparse multi-view videos, leveraging state-of-the-art neural inverse rendering. We begin by constructing a deformation representation that parameterizes vertex displacements into differential coordinates with tetrahedral connections, allowing for high-quality vertex deformation on high-resolution meshes. By constructing a set of semantic regulations in this representation, we achieve joint optimization of blendshapes and expression coefficients. Furthermore, to enable a user-friendly multi-view setup with unsynchronized cameras, we use a neural regressor to model time-varying motion parameters. Experiments demonstrate that, with the flexible input of single or sparse multi-view videos, we reconstruct personalized high-fidelity blendshapes. These blendshapes are both geometrically and semantically accurate, and they are compatible with industrial animation pipelines. Code and data are available at https://github. com/grignarder/high-quality-blendshape-generation.

title: Xin Zhao, Xiaojun Chen*, Xudong Chen, He Li, Tingyu Fan, Zhendong Zhao
title_en: Xin Zhao, Xiaojun Chen*, Xudong Chen, He Li, Tingyu Fan, Zhendong Zhao
abstract: 扩散模型(DMs)在图像生成领域取得了最先进的合成结果,并已应用于多个领域。然而,DMs在使用过程中有时会严重侵犯用户隐私,使得隐私保护成为迫切问题。直接在DMs中使用传统的隐私计算方案如安全多方计算(MPC)面临显著的计算和通信挑战。为解决这些问题,我们提出CipherDM,这是首个将MPC技术应用于DMs的新型、通用且普适框架,用于安全采样,可广泛应用于多种基于DM的任务。我们深入分析了采样延迟分解,识别出耗时部分并设计了相应的安全MPC协议,用于计算非线性激活函数(包括SoftMax、SiLU和Mish)。在流行的架构(DDPM、DDIM)上使用MNIST数据集,在diffusers部署的SD上对CipherDM进行了评估。与直接在SPU上实现相比,我们的方法将运行时间提高了约1.084×~2.328×,并将通信成本降低了约1.212×~1.791×。代码可在https://github.com/Zhaoxinxinzi/CipherDM获取。
abstract_en: Diffusion Models (DMs) achieve state-of-the-art synthesis results in image generation and have been applied to various fields. However, DMs sometimes seriously violate user privacy during usage, making the protection of privacy an urgent issue. Using traditional privacy computing schemes like Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) directly in DMs faces significant computation and communication challenges. To address these issues, we propose CipherDM, the first novel, versatile and universal framework applying MPC technology to DMs for secure sampling, which can be widely implemented on multiple DM based tasks. We thoroughly analyze sampling latency breakdown, find time-consuming parts and design corresponding secure MPC protocols for computing nonlinear activations including SoftMax, SiLU and Mish. CipherDM is evaluated on popular architectures (DDPM, DDIM) using MNIST dataset and on SD deployed by diffusers. Compared to direct implementation on SPU, our approach improves running time by approximately 1.084× ∼ 2.328×, and reduces communication costs by approximately 1.212× ∼ 1.791×. Code is available at: https://github.com/Zhaoxinxinzi/CipherDM.

title: Xin-Jian Wu*, Ruisong Zhang, Jie Qin, Shijie Ma, Cheng-Lin Liu*
title_en: Xin-Jian Wu*, Ruisong Zhang, Jie Qin, Shijie Ma, Cheng-Lin Liu*
abstract: 在计算机视觉和机器人领域,对多样物体部件的分割与识别至关重要。尽管物体分割已取得显著进展,但因复杂边界和标注数据稀缺,部件级分割仍处于探索阶段。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新的弱监督部件分割(WPS)设置,并构建了基于大规模预训练视觉基础模型分割任何模型(SAM)的WPS-SAM方法。WPS-SAM是一个端到端框架,可直接从图像中提取提示标记,并对部件区域进行像素级分割。在训练阶段,它仅使用边界框或点形式的弱监督标签。大量实验表明,通过利用预训练基础模型中丰富的知识,WPS-SAM在像素级强标注训练的分割模型中表现更优。具体而言,WPS-SAM在PartImageNet数据集上实现了68.93%的mIOU和79.53%的mACC,其mIOU指标超越了最先进的全监督方法约4%。
abstract_en: Segmenting and recognizing diverse object parts is crucial in computer vision and robotics. Despite significant progress in object segmentation, part-level segmentation remains underexplored due to complex boundaries and scarce annotated data. To address this, we propose a novel Weakly-supervised Part Segmentation (WPS) setting and an approach called WPS-SAM, built on the large-scale pre-trained vision foundation model, Segment Anything Model (SAM). WPS-SAM is an end-to-end framework designed to extract prompt tokens directly from images and perform pixel-level segmentation of part regions. During its training phase, it only uses weakly supervised labels in the form of bounding boxes or points. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, through exploiting the rich knowledge embedded in pre-trained foundation models, WPS-SAM outperforms other segmentation models trained with pixel-level strong annotations. Specifically, WPS-SAM achieves 68.93% mIOU and 79.53% mACC on the PartImageNet dataset, surpassing state-of-the-art fully supervised methods by approximately 4% in terms of mIOU.

title: Xincheng Yao*, Ruoqi Li, Zefeng Qian, Lu Wang, Chongyang Zhang*
title_en: Xincheng Yao*, Ruoqi Li, Zefeng Qian, lu wang, Chongyang Zhang*
abstract: 统一异常检测(AD)是异常检测领域最具价值的挑战之一,其目标是通过使用来自多个类别的正常样本训练一个统一模型,以检测这些类别中的异常。对于这一具有挑战性的任务,基于归一化流(NF)的流行AD方法可能会陷入“同质映射”问题,即基于NF的AD模型倾向于为正常和异常特征生成相似的潜在表示,从而导致异常检测的高漏检率。在本文中,我们提出了一种新颖的分层高斯混合归一化流建模方法,用于实现统一异常检测,我们称之为HGAD。我们的HGAD包含两个关键组件:类间高斯混合建模和类内混合类中心学习。与之前的基于NF的AD方法相比,分层高斯混合建模方法可以增强归一化流潜在空间的表示能力。通过这种方式,我们可以避免将不同类分布映射到相同的单个高斯先验,从而有效避免或缓解“同质映射”问题。我们进一步指出,不同类中心越具有区分性,越有助于避免偏差问题。因此,我们进一步提出了一种互信息最大化损失函数,以更好地构建潜在特征空间。我们在四个现实世界AD基准数据集上评估了我们的方法,结果表明我们的方法显著优于之前的基于NF的AD方法,并且在统一AD方法中表现最佳。代码将发布在https://github.com/xcyao00/HGAD。
abstract_en: Unified anomaly detection (AD) is one of the most valuable challenges for anomaly detection, where one unified model is trained with normal samples from multiple classes with the objective to detect anomalies in these classes. For such a challenging task, popular normalizing flow (NF) based AD methods may fall into a “homogeneous mapping” issue, where the NF-based AD models are biased to generate similar latent representations for both normal and abnormal features, and thereby lead to a high missing rate of anomalies. In this paper, we propose a novel Hierarchical Gaussian mixture normalizing flow modeling method for accomplishing unified Anomaly Detection, which we call HGAD. Our HGAD consists of two key components: inter-class Gaussian mixture modeling and intra-class mixed class centers learning. Compared to the previous NF-based AD methods, the hierarchical Gaussian mixture modeling approach can bring stronger representation capability to the latent space of normalizing flows. In this way, we can avoid mapping different class distributions into the same single Gaussian prior, thus effectively avoiding or mitigating the “homogeneous mapping” issue. We further indicate that the more distinguishable different class centers, the more conducive to avoiding the bias issue. Thus, we further propose a mutual information maximization loss for better structuring the latent feature space. We evaluate our method on four real-world AD benchmarks, where we can significantly improve the previous NF-based AD methods and also outperform the SOTA unified AD methods. The code will be available at https://github.com/xcyao00/HGAD.

title: Xing Cui, Zekun Li, Peipei Li*, Huaibo Huang, Xuannan Liu, Zhaofeng He
title_en: Xing Cui, Zekun Li, Peipei Li*, Huaibo Huang, Xuannan Liu, Zhaofeng He
abstract: 风格化文本到图像生成旨在根据文本描述生成图像,同时遵循参考图像指定的风格。然而,不同参考图像中细微的风格变化会阻碍模型准确学习目标风格。本文提出了一种名为InstaStyle的新方法,该方法仅需单张参考图像即可生成高保真风格化图像。我们的方法基于以下发现:风格化参考图像的反演噪声本身携带风格信号,这通过其非零信噪比得到证实。我们采用DDIM反演从参考图像中提取该噪声,并利用扩散模型从“风格”噪声生成新的风格化图像。此外,文本提示的固有歧义性和偏差会阻碍图像反演过程中风格的精确传达。为解决这一问题,我们设计了提示优化方法,通过人类反馈学习风格标记。定性和定量实验结果表明,InstaStyle在性能上优于当前基准方法。此外,我们的方法在风格组合的创意任务中也展示了其能力,结合混合反演噪声。
abstract_en: Stylized text-to-image generation focuses on creating images from textual descriptions while adhering to a style specified by reference images. However, subtle style variations within different reference images can hinder the model from accurately learning the target style. In this paper, we propose InstaStyle, a novel approach that excels in generating high-fidelity stylized images with only a single reference image. Our approach is based on the finding that the inversion noise from a stylized reference image inherently carries the style signal, as evidenced by their non-zero signal-to-noise ratio. We employ DDIM inversion to extract this noise from the reference image and leverage a diffusion model to generate new stylized images from the “style” noise. Additionally, the inherent ambiguity and bias of textual prompts impede the precise conveying of style during image inversion. To address this, we devise prompt refinement, which learns a style token assisted by human feedback. Qualitative and quantitative experimental results demonstrate that InstaStyle achieves superior performance compared to current benchmarks. Furthermore, our approach also showcases its capability in the creative task of style combination with mixed inversion noise.

title: Xingtai Gui*, Tengteng Huang, Haonan Shao, Haotian Yao, Chi Zhang
title_en: Xingtai Gui*, Tengteng Huang, Haonan Shao, Haotian Yao, Chi Zhang
abstract: 从鸟瞰图(BEV)视角进行未来实例预测是自动驾驶中的关键组成部分,涉及未来实例分割和实例运动预测。现有方法通常依赖于冗余且复杂的流程,需要多个辅助输出和后处理步骤。此外,每个辅助预测中的估计误差会导致预测性能下降。本文提出了一种简单而有效的完全端到端框架,名为未来实例预测变换器(FipTR),将任务视为未来帧的BEV实例分割与预测。我们提出采用表示特定交通参与者的实例查询,直接估计相应的未来占用掩码,从而摆脱复杂的后处理步骤。此外,我们设计了一种流感知的BEV预测器,用于未来BEV特征预测,该预测器由流感知的可变形注意力机制组成,该机制通过反向流指导偏移采样。还提出了一种新颖的未来实例匹配策略,以进一步提高时间一致性。大量实验验证了FipTR的优越性及其在不同时间BEV编码器下的有效性。代码可在https://github.com/TabGuigui/FipTR获取。
abstract_en: The future instance prediction from a Bird’s Eye View(BEV) perspective is a vital component in autonomous driving, which involves future instance segmentation and instance motion prediction. Existing methods usually rely on a redundant and complex pipeline which requires multiple auxiliary outputs and post-processing procedures. Moreover, estimated errors on each of the auxiliary predictions will lead to degradation of the prediction performance. In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective fully end-to-end framework named Future Instance Prediction Transformer(FipTR), which views the task as BEV instance segmentation and prediction for future frames. We propose to adopt instance queries representing specific traffic participants to directly estimate the corresponding future occupied masks, and thus get rid of complex post-processing procedures. Besides, we devise a flow-aware BEV predictor for future BEV feature prediction composed of a flow-aware deformable attention that takes backward flow guiding the offset sampling. A novel future instance matching strategy is also proposed to further improve the temporal coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of FipTR and its effectiveness under different temporal BEV encoders. The code is available at https://github.com/TabGuigui/FipTR.

title: Xingyi Yang*, Xinchao Wang*
title_en: Xingyi Yang*, Xinchao Wang*
abstract: 本文介绍了一种新的学习范式,称为神经变形(NeuMeta),旨在构建可自适应形态的神经网络。与为不同架构或尺寸单独构建模型的方法不同,NeuMeta直接学习神经网络的连续权重流形。一旦训练完成,我们可以直接从流形中采样任意尺寸网络的权重,甚至对于之前未见过的配置,无需重新训练。为实现这一雄心勃勃的目标,NeuMeta将神经隐式函数训练为超网络。它们接受模型空间内的坐标作为输入,并在流形上生成相应的权重值。换句话说,隐式函数以一种方式被学习,使得预测的权重在各种模型尺寸上表现良好。在训练这些模型时,我们注意到,最终性能与学习到的流形的平滑度密切相关。为增强这种平滑度,我们采用了两种策略。首先,通过求解最短哈密顿路径问题,对权重矩阵进行排列以实现模型内部的平滑度。此外,在训练隐式函数时,我们在输入坐标上添加噪声,确保不同尺寸的模型表现出一致的输出。因此,NeuMeta在合成各种网络配置的参数方面展现出有前景的结果。我们在图像分类、语义分割和图像生成上的广泛测试表明,即使在75%的压缩率下,NeuMeta仍能维持全尺寸性能。
abstract_en: This paper introduces a new learning paradigm termed Neural Metamorphosis (NeuMeta), which aims to build self-morphable neural networks. Contrary to crafting separate models for different architectures or sizes, NeuMeta directly learns the continuous weight manifold of neural networks. Once trained, we can sample weights for any-sized network directly from the manifold, even for previously unseen configurations, without retraining. To achieve this ambitious goal, NeuMeta trains neural implicit functions as hypernetworks. They accept coordinates within the model space as input, and generate corresponding weight values on the manifold. In other words, the implicit function is learned in a way, that the predicted weights is well-performed across various models sizes. In training those models, we notice that, the final performance closely relates on smoothness of the learned manifold. In pursuit of enhancing this smoothness, we employ two strategies. First, we permute weight matrices to achieve intra-model smoothness, by solving the Shortest Hamiltonian Path problem. Besides, we add a noise on the input coordinates when training the implicit function, ensuring models with various sizes shows consistent outputs. As such, NeuMeta shows promising results in synthesizing parameters for various network configurations. Our extensive tests in image classification, semantic segmentation, and image generation reveal that NeuMeta sustains full-size performance even at a 75% compression rate.

title: Xingyu Fu*, Yushi Hu*, Bangzheng Li, Yu Feng, Haoyu Wang, Xudong Lin, Dan Roth, Noah A Smith, Wei-Chiu Ma, Ranjay Krishna
title_en: Xingyu Fu*, Yushi Hu*, Bangzheng Li, Yu Feng, Haoyu Wang, Xudong Lin, Dan Roth, Noah A Smith, Wei-Chiu Ma, Ranjay Krishna
abstract: 我们引入了一个新的多模态语言模型(LLMs)基准测试,专注于其他评估中未涵盖的核心视觉感知能力。大多数任务都可以由人类“一瞥之间”完成(如相对深度估计、视觉对应、图像鉴定和多视角推理)。然而,我们发现这些对感知要求高的任务对当前多模态LLMs构成了显著挑战,因为它们难以通过自然语言进行中介。我们将14个经典计算机视觉任务重新格式化为3,807个多项选择题,每个问题均配以单张或多张图像及视觉提示。尽管人类平均准确率达到95.70%,但该基准对现有多模态LLMs而言却异常困难:即使表现最佳的GPT-4V和Gemini模型准确率也仅为51.26%和45.72%,仅比随机猜测高出13.17%和7.63%,表明此类感知能力尚未在近期多模态LLMs中“涌现”。我们的分析还表明,专用计算机视觉模型能够更高效地解决这些问题,这为未来改进提供了潜在路径。我们相信该基准将推动社区帮助多模态LLMs达到人类水平的视觉感知能力。
abstract_en: We introduce , a new benchmark for multimodal language models (LLMs) that focuses on core visual perception abilities not found in other evaluations. Most of the tasks can be solved by humans “within a blink” (, relative depth estimation, visual correspondence, forensics detection, and multi-view reasoning). However, we find these perception-demanding tasks cast significant challenges for current multimodal LLMs because they resist mediation through natural language. reformats 14 classic computer vision tasks into 3,807 multiple-choice questions, paired with single or multiple images and visual prompting.
