While humans get 95.70% accuracy on average, is surprisingly challenging for existing multimodal LLMs: even the best-performing GPT-4V and Gemini achieve accuracies of 51.26% and 45.72%, only 13.17% and 7.63% higher than random guessing, indicating that such perception abilities have not “emerged” yet in recent multimodal LLMs. Our analysis also highlights that specialist CV models could solve these problems much better, suggesting potential pathways for future improvements. We believe will stimulate the community to help multimodal LLMs catch up with human-level visual perception.

title: Xingyu Jiang, Xiuhui Zhang, Ning Gao, Yue Deng*
title_en: Xingyu Jiang, Xiuhui Zhang, Ning Gao, Yue Deng*
abstract: 自然图像可能因不利的大气条件或独特的退化机制而遭受多种退化现象。这种多样性使得设计适用于各类修复任务的通用框架变得具有挑战性。不同于探索不同退化现象之间的共性,现有图像修复方法更关注在有限修复先验条件下对网络架构的改进。在本工作中,我们首先从频率视角回顾了各种退化现象作为先验知识。基于此,我们提出了一种高效的图像修复框架,称为SFHformer,其将快速傅里叶变换机制融入Transformer架构。具体而言,我们设计了一种双域混合结构用于多尺度感受野建模,其中空间域和频率域分别专注于局部建模和全局建模。此外,我们为每个频率成分设计了独特的位置编码和频率动态卷积,以提取丰富的频率域特征。在三十一个图像修复数据集上针对去雨、去雾、去模糊、去雪、去噪、超分辨率以及水下/低光照增强等十种修复任务进行的广泛实验表明,我们的SFHformer超越了现有最先进方法,在性能、参数量和计算成本之间实现了良好的平衡。代码已开源:https://github.com/deng-ai-lab/SFHformer
abstract_en: Natural images can suffer from various degradation phenomena caused by adverse atmospheric conditions or unique degradation mechanism. Such diversity makes it challenging to design a universal framework for kinds of restoration tasks. Instead of exploring the commonality across different degradation phenomena, existing image restoration methods focus on the modification of network architecture under limited restoration priors. In this work, we first review various degradation phenomena from a frequency perspective as prior. Based on this, we propose an efficient image restoration framework, dubbed SFHformer, which incorporates the Fast Fourier Transform mechanism into Transformer architecture. Specifically, we design a dual domain hybrid structure for multi-scale receptive fields modeling, in which the spatial domain and the frequency domain focuses on local modeling and global modeling, respectively. Moreover, we design unique positional coding and frequency dynamic convolution for each frequency component to extract rich frequency-domain features. Extensive experiments on thirty-one restoration datasets for a range of ten restoration tasks such as deraining, dehazing, deblurring, desnowing, denoising, super-resolution and underwater/low-light enhancement, demonstrate that our SFHformer surpasses the state-of-the-art approaches and achieves a favorable trade-off between performance, parameter size and computational cost. The code is available at: https://github.com/deng-ai-lab/SFHformer.

title: Xingyu Liu, Pengfei Ren, Jingyu Wang*, Qi Qi, Haifeng Sun, Zirui Zhuang*, Jianxin Liao
title_en: Xingyu Liu, Pengfei Ren, Jingyu Wang*, Qi Qi, Haifeng Sun, Zirui Zhuang*, Jianxin Liao
abstract: 近期研究探索了隐式表示(如符号距离函数SDF)用于手-物体交互重建。SDF能够建模任意拓扑结构的手持物体,并克服参数化模型的分辨率限制,实现更精细的重建。然而,直接从视觉线索建模详细SDF存在挑战,由于深度歧义和外观相似性,尤其是在杂乱的真实场景中。本文提出一种由粗到细的SDF框架用于3D手-物体重建,该框架利用RGB-D模态在视觉和几何方面的感知优势,逐步建模隐式场。具体而言,我们为整体场景的视觉感知建模粗粒度SDF。随后,我们提出一种3D点对齐隐式函数(3D PIFu)用于细粒度SDF学习,该方法结合局部几何线索和粗粒度视觉先验,捕捉复杂细节。此外,我们提出一种表面感知的高效重建策略,基于手-物体语义先验稀疏执行SDF查询。在两个具有挑战性的手-物体数据集上的实验表明,我们的方法在很大程度上优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Recent research has explored implicit representations, such as signed distance function (SDF), for interacting hand-object reconstruction. SDF enables modeling hand-held objects with arbitrary topology and overcomes the resolution limitations of parametric models, allowing for finer-grained reconstruction. However, directly modeling detailed SDFs from visual clues presents challenges due to depth ambiguity and appearance similarity, especially in cluttered real-world scenes. In this paper, we propose a coarse-to-fine SDF framework for 3D hand-object reconstruction, which leverages the perceptual advantages of RGB-D modality in visual and geometric aspects, to progressively model the implicit field. Specifically, we model a coarse SDF for visual perception of overall scenes. Then, we propose a 3D Point-Aligned Implicit Function (3D PIFu) for fine-level SDF learning, which leverages both local geometric clues and the coarse-level visual priors to capture intricate details. Additionally, we propose a surface-aware efficient reconstruction strategy that sparsely performs SDF query based on the hand-object semantic priors. Experiments on two challenging hand-object datasets show that our method outperforms existing methods by a large margin.

title: 彭星宇, 白燕, 高晨, 杨丽荣, 夏飞, 蒲北鹏, 王晓飞, 刘思*
title_en: Xingyu Peng, Yan Bai, Chen Gao, Lirong Yang, Fei Xia, Beipeng Mu, Xiaofei Wang, Si Liu*
abstract: 开放词汇检测(OVD)是指在给定场景中检测所有感兴趣对象的任务,而无需预定义的对象类别。已有大量工作针对2D RGB图像的OVD任务进行了探索,但3D OVD的研究仍较为有限。直观来看,激光雷达点云提供了对象级和场景级的3D信息,能够生成可信的检测结果。然而,先前基于激光雷达的OVD方法仅关注对象级特征的使用,忽略了场景级信息的本质。本文提出了一种基于激光雷达的OVD任务的全局-局部协作方案(GLIS),包含一个生成对象级检测结果的局部分支和一个获取场景级全局特征的全局分支。借助全局-局部信息,应用大语言模型(LLM)进行链式推理,从而对检测结果进行优化。我们进一步提出反射伪标签生成(RPLG)以生成高质量的伪标签用于监督,并提出背景感知对象定位(BAOL)以选择精确的对象提案。在ScanNetV2和SUN RGB-D数据集上的大量实验验证了我们方法的优越性。代码已开源于https://github.com/GradiusTwinbee/GLIS。
abstract_en: Open-Vocabulary Detection (OVD) is the task of detecting all interesting objects in a given scene without predefined object classes. Extensive work has been done to deal with the OVD for 2D RGB images, but the exploration of 3D OVD is still limited. Intuitively, lidar point clouds provide 3D information, both object level and scene level, to generate trustful detection results. However, previous lidar-based OVD methods only focus on the usage of object-level features, ignoring the essence of scene-level information. In this paper, we propose a Global-Local Collaborative Scheme (GLIS) for the lidar-based OVD task, which contains a local branch to generate object-level detection result and a global branch to obtain scene-level global feature. With the global-local information, a Large Language Model (LLM) is applied for chain-of-thought inference, and the detection result can be refined accordingly. We further propose Reflected Pseudo Labels Generation (RPLG) to generate high-quality pseudo labels for supervision and Background-Aware Object Localization (BAOL) to select precise object proposals. Extensive experiments on ScanNetV2 and SUN RGB-D demonstrate the superiority of our methods. Code is released at https://github.com/GradiusTwinbee/GLIS.

title: Xingyuan Li, Jinyuan Liu*, ZHIXIN CHEN, Yang Zou, Long Ma, Xin Fan, Risheng Liu
title_en: Xingyuan Li, Jinyuan Liu*, ZHIXIN CHEN, Yang Zou, Long Ma, Xin Fan, Risheng Liu
abstract: 图像超分辨率(SR)是提升图像质量的关键技术,在图像增强中发挥着重要作用。尽管近年来基于Transformer的方法等技术进步推动了该领域的发展,但红外图像SR仍是一个严峻的挑战。由于红外传感器固有的特性,如分辨率有限、温度敏感性高、噪声水平高以及环境影响等,现有深度学习方法在应用于红外图像时会产生次优的增强效果。为解决这些挑战,我们提出了一种专门针对红外图像的轮廓波残差框架,以从多尺度和多方向的红外光谱分解中恢复和增强关键细节。该框架精确捕捉并放大红外图像的高通子带,如边缘细节和纹理特征,这些对于实现卓越的重建质量至关重要。此外,鉴于传统学习技术在捕捉红外图像固有特性方面的局限性,我们引入了基于提示的学习范式。该方法通过利用视觉语言模型提供的语义理解,实现了对红外图像更细致的理解和针对性优化过程。我们的方法不仅解决了红外成像常见的弊端,还为红外图像SR设定了新的范式。大量实验表明,我们的方法取得了优越的结果,达到了最先进的性能。项目页面:https://github.com/hey-it-s-me/CoRPLE.
abstract_en: Image super-resolution (SR) is a critical technique for enhancing image quality, playing a vital role in image enhancement. While recent advancements, notably transformer-based methods, have advanced the field, infrared image SR remains a formidable challenge. Due to the inherent characteristics of infrared sensors, such as limited resolution, temperature sensitivity, high noise levels, and environmental impacts, existing deep learning methods result in suboptimal enhancement outcomes when applied to infrared images. To address these challenges, we propose a specialized Contourlet residual framework tailored for infrared images to restore and enhance the critical details from the multi-scale and multi-directional infrared spectra decomposition. It precisely captures and amplifies the high-pass subbands of infrared images, such as edge details and texture nuances, which are vital for achieving superior reconstruction quality. Moreover, recognizing the limitations of traditional learning techniques in capturing the inherent characteristics of infrared images, we incorporate a prompt-based learning paradigm. This approach facilitates a more nuanced understanding and targeted optimization process for infrared images by leveraging the semantic comprehension offered by the visual language model. Our approach not only addresses the common pitfalls associated with infrared imaging but also sets a new paradigm for infrared image SR. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach obtains superior results, attaining state-of-the-art performance. Project page: https://github.com/hey-it-s-me/CoRPLE.

title: Xinhang Liu*, Jiaben Chen, Shiu-Hong Kao, Yu-Wing Tai, Chi-Keung Tang
title_en: Xinhang Liu*, Jiaben Chen, Shiu-Hong Kao, Yu-Wing Tai, Chi-Keung Tang
abstract: 通过神经辐射场(NeRFs)或3D高斯点云(3DGS)实现的新型视图合成通常需要密集观测数据,即数百张输入图像以避免伪影。我们提出Deceptive-NeRF/3DGS1,通过利用从多视角数据集预训练的扩散模型,仅使用有限数量的输入图像即可增强稀疏视图重建。与使用扩散先验知识正则化表示优化不同,我们的方法直接使用扩散生成的图像训练NeRF/3DGS,如同这些图像为真实输入视角。具体而言,我们提出了一种欺骗性扩散模型,将来自少视角重建的噪声图像转换为高质量的逼真伪观测。为解决伪观测与真实输入视角之间的一致性问题,我们开发了一种不确定性度量来指导扩散模型的生成。我们的系统逐步将扩散生成的伪观测纳入训练图像集,最终使稀疏输入观测密度提升5到10倍。在多样且具有挑战性的数据集上的大量实验验证了我们的方法优于现有最先进的方法,并能够在少视角设置下实现超分辨率的新型视图合成。项目页面:https://xinhangliu.com/deceptive-nerf-3dgs。1 在和声进行中,欺骗性和弦(Deceptive Cadence)可能破坏和弦进行的预期但丰富音乐的情感表达。我们的Deceptive-X(其中“X”可以是NeRF、3DGS或相关3D重建框架)通过密集合成一致的伪观测来对抗稀疏输入视角的过拟合,使原始稀疏输入密度提升五到十倍。
abstract_en: Novel view synthesis via Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) or 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) typically necessitates dense observations with hundreds of input images to circumvent artifacts. We introduce Deceptive-NeRF/3DGS1 to enhance sparse-view reconstruction with only a limited set of input images, by leveraging a diffusion model pre-trained from multiview datasets. Different from using diffusion priors to regularize representation optimization, our method directly uses diffusion-generated images to train NeRF/3DGS as if they were real input views. Specifically, we propose a deceptive diffusion model turning noisy images rendered from few-view reconstructions into high-quality photorealistic pseudo-observations. To resolve consistency among pseudo-observations and real input views, we develop an uncertainty measure to guide the diffusion model’s generation. Our system progressively incorporates diffusion-generated pseudo-observations into the training image sets, ultimately densifying the sparse input observations by 5 to 10 times. Extensive experiments across diverse and challenging datasets validate that our approach outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods and is capable of synthesizing novel views with super-resolution in the few-view setting. Project page: https://xinhangliu.com/deceptive-nerf-3dgs. 1 In harmonic progression, a Deceptive Cadence may disrupt expectations of chord progression but enriches the emotional expression of the music. Our Deceptive-X, where “X” can be NeRF, 3DGS, or a pertinent 3D reconstruction framework—counters overfitting to sparse input views by densely synthesizing consistent pseudo-observations, enriching the original sparse inputs by fivefold to tenfold.

title: Xinhao Li, Yuhan Zhu, Limin Wang*
title_en: Xinhao Li, Yuhan Zhu, Limin Wang*
abstract: 将图像模型适配到视频领域已成为解决视频识别任务的有效范式。由于图像模型参数量巨大且具有良好的迁移能力,进行全量微调效率较低甚至没有必要。因此,近期研究逐渐转向参数高效的图像到视频适配方法。然而,这些适配策略不可避免地引入额外计算开销以应对视频领域的分布差异和时序建模问题。本文提出了一种新的适配范式(ZeroI2V),用于将图像变换器迁移到视频识别任务(在推理过程中对原始模型引入零额外开销)。为实现该目标,我们提出了两项核心设计。首先,为捕捉视频中的动态变化并降低图像到视频的适配难度,我们利用自注意力机制的灵活性,引入时空双头注意力(STDHA)。该方法以零额外参数和计算开销高效赋予图像变换器时序建模能力。其次,为应对图像与视频之间的分布差异,我们提出了一种线性适配策略,利用轻量级密集部署的线性适配器,将冻结的图像模型完全迁移至视频识别任务。得益于定制化的线性设计,所有新增适配器均可通过结构重参数化在训练后轻松与原始模块合并,从而在推理过程中实现零额外开销。在代表性全监督和少样本视频识别基准测试中,大量实验表明ZeroI2V在匹配甚至超越先前最先进方法的同时,展现出更优的参数和推理效率。
abstract_en: Adapting image models to the video domain has emerged as an efficient paradigm for solving video recognition tasks. Due to the huge number of parameters and effective transferability of image models, performing full fine-tuning is less efficient and even unnecessary. Thus, recent research is shifting its focus toward parameter-efficient image-to-video adaptation. However, these adaptation strategies inevitably introduce extra computational costs to deal with the domain gap and temporal modeling in videos. In this paper, we present a new adaptation paradigm (ZeroI2V) to transfer the image transformers to video recognition tasks (, introduce zero extra cost to the original models during inference). To achieve this goal, we present two core designs. First, to capture the dynamics in videos and reduce the difficulty of image-to-video adaptation, we exploit the flexibility of self-attention and introduce spatial-temporal dual-headed attention (STDHA). This approach efficiently endows the image transformers with temporal modeling capability at zero extra parameters and computation. Second, to handle the domain gap between images and videos, we propose a linear adaption strategy that utilizes lightweight densely placed linear adapters to fully transfer the frozen image models to video recognition. Thanks to the customized linear design, all newly added adapters could be easily merged with the original modules through structural reparameterization after training, enabling zero extra cost during inference. Extensive experiments on representative fully-supervised and few-shot video recognition benchmarks showcase that ZeroI2V can match or even outperform previous state-of-the-art methods while enjoying superior parameter and inference efficiency.

title: Xinhao Luo, Man Yao, Yuhong Chou, Bo Xu, Guoqi Li*
title_en: Xinhao Luo, Man Yao, Yuhong Chou, Bo Xu, Guoqi Li*
abstract: 受大脑启发的脉冲神经网络(SNNs)相比人工神经网络(ANNs)具有生物合理性和低功耗优势。目前SNNs的应用仅限于简单的分类任务,因其性能较差。本文聚焦于弥合ANNs与SNNs在目标检测任务中的性能差距。我们的设计围绕网络架构和脉冲神经元展开。首先,YOLO系列网络在转换为对应脉冲版本时,过于复杂的模块设计会导致脉冲退化。我们设计了SpikeYOLO架构,通过简化原始YOLO并引入元SNN模块来解决这一问题。其次,目标检测在膜电位转换为二进制脉冲过程中对量化误差更为敏感。为应对这一挑战,我们设计了一种新型脉冲神经元,在训练阶段激活整数值,而在推理阶段通过扩展虚拟时间步长保持脉冲驱动特性。所提方法在静态和神经形态目标检测数据集上进行了验证。在静态COCO数据集上,我们获得66.2% mAP@50和48.9% mAP@50:95,分别比先前最先进的SNN高15.0%和18.7%。在神经形态Gen1数据集上,我们达到67.2% mAP@50,比具有相同架构的ANN高2.5%,能效提升5.7倍。代码:https://github.com/BICLab/SpikeYOLO
abstract_en: Brain-inspired Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have bio-plausibility and low-power advantages over Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs). Applications of SNNs are currently limited to simple classification tasks because of their poor performance. In this work, we focus on bridging the performance gap between ANNs and SNNs on object detection. Our design revolves around network architecture and spiking neuron. First, the overly complex module design causes spike degradation when the YOLO series is converted to the corresponding spiking version. We design a SpikeYOLO architecture to solve this problem by simplifying the vanilla YOLO and incorporating meta SNN blocks. Second, object detection is more sensitive to quantization errors in the conversion of membrane potentials into binary spikes by spiking neurons. To address this challenge, we design a new spiking neuron that activates Integer values during training while maintaining spike-driven by extending virtual timesteps during inference. The proposed method is validated on both static and neuromorphic object detection datasets. On the static COCO dataset, we obtain 66.2% mAP@50 and 48.9% mAP@50:95, which is +15.0% and +18.7% higher than the prior state-of-the-art SNN, respectively. On the neuromorphic Gen1 dataset, we achieve 67.2% mAP@50, which is +2.5% greater than the ANN with equivalent architecture, and the energy efficiency is improved by 5.7×. Code: https://github.com/BICLab/SpikeYOLO

title: Xinjie Zhang, Xingtong Ge, Tongda Xu, Dailan He, Yan Wang, Hongwei Qin, Guo Lu, Jing Geng*, Jun Zhang*
title_en: Xinjie Zhang, Xingtong Ge, Tongda Xu, Dailan He, Yan Wang, Hongwei Qin, Guo Lu, Jing Geng*, Jun Zhang*
abstract: 隐式神经表示(INRs)最近在图像表示与压缩领域取得了显著成果,能够在GPU资源充足的情况下提供高视觉质量和高达10-1000帧每秒的快速渲染速度。然而,这一要求常常限制了其在内存有限的低端设备上的应用。为此,我们提出了一种基于二维高斯点云的图像表示与压缩新范式,命名为GaussianImage。我们首先引入二维高斯分布来表示图像,其中每个高斯分布包含8个参数,包括位置、协方差和颜色。随后,我们提出了一种基于累积求和的新型渲染算法。值得注意的是,我们的方法在GPU内存使用量上最低可减少3倍,拟合时间提升5倍,不仅在表示性能上可与INRs(如WIRE、I-NGP)相媲美,而且无论参数规模如何,渲染速度均可达到1500-2000帧每秒。此外,我们整合现有的向量量化技术构建了图像编解码器。实验结果表明,我们的编解码器在率失真性能上与基于压缩的INRs(如COIN和COIN++)相当,同时解码速度可达约2000帧每秒。此外,初步概念验证表明,当使用部分bits-back编码时,我们的编解码器在性能上超越了COIN和COIN++。代码已开源至https://github.com/Xinjie-Q/GaussianImage。
abstract_en: Implicit neural representations (INRs) recently achieved great success in image representation and compression, offering high visual quality and fast rendering speeds with 10-1000 FPS, assuming sufficient GPU resources are available. However, this requirement often hinders their use on low-end devices with limited memory. In response, we propose a groundbreaking paradigm of image representation and compression by 2D Gaussian Splatting, named GaussianImage. We first introduce 2D Gaussian to represent the image, where each Gaussian has 8 parameters including position, covariance and color. Subsequently, we unveil a novel rendering algorithm based on accumulated summation. Remarkably, our method with a minimum of 3× lower GPU memory usage and 5× faster fitting time not only rivals INRs (e.g., WIRE, I-NGP) in representation performance, but also delivers a faster rendering speed of 1500-2000 FPS regardless of parameter size. Furthermore, we integrate existing vector quantization technique to build an image codec. Experimental results demonstrate that our codec attains rate-distortion performance comparable to compression-based INRs such as COIN and COIN++, while facilitating decoding speeds of approximately 2000 FPS. Additionally, preliminary proof of concept shows that our codec surpasses COIN and COIN++ in performance when using partial bits-back coding. Code is available at https://github.com/Xinjie-Q/GaussianImage.

title: Xinle Cheng, Congyue Deng*, Adam Harley, Yixin Zhu*, Leonidas Guibas*
title_en: Xinle Cheng, Congyue Deng*, Adam Harley, Yixin Zhu*, Leonidas Guibas*
abstract: 对应关系来源于用于生成和判别任务的大规模视觉模型。通过计算图像对之间的对应图,并利用特征网格上的最近邻方法,已揭示并验证了这一现象。现有研究尝试通过精心混合不同来源的特征(如结合不同层或网络的特征)来提升对应图的质量。我们指出,一种更优的对应策略可用,即直接对对应场施加结构:功能映射。借助这一简单的数学工具,我们将对应问题从像素空间提升到函数空间,并直接优化全局一致的映射。我们证明,该技术不仅能够生成更平滑的对应关系,而且准确性更高,有望更好地反映所研究的大规模视觉模型中嵌入的知识。我们的方法在各种密集对应任务中设立了新的性能基准。我们还展示了该方法在关键点对应和功能映射迁移中的有效性。
abstract_en: Correspondences emerge from large-scale vision models trained for generative and discriminative tasks. This has been revealed and benchmarked by computing correspondence maps between pairs of images, using nearest neighbors on the feature grids. Existing work has attempted to improve the quality of these correspondence maps by carefully mixing features from different sources, such as by combining the features of different layers or networks. We point out that a better correspondence strategy is available, which directly imposes structure on the correspondence field: the functional map. Wielding this simple mathematical tool, we lift the correspondence problem from the pixel space to the function space and directly optimize for mappings that are globally coherent. We demonstrate that our technique yields correspondences that are not only smoother but also more accurate, with the possibility of better reflecting the knowledge embedded in the large-scale vision models that we are studying. Our approach sets a new state-of-the-art on various dense correspondence tasks. We also demonstrate our effectiveness in keypoint correspondence and affordance map transfer.

title: 任欣林*, 曹晨杰, 傅彦伟*, 薛翔阳
title_en: Xinlin Ren*, Chenjie Cao, Yanwei Fu*, Xiangyang Xue
abstract: 近年来,神经表面重建(NSR)技术在结合体渲染技术后显著提升了多视角重建效果。然而,仅依赖图像空间中的光度一致性难以应对现实数据带来的复杂性,包括遮挡和非朗伯表面等问题。为解决这些挑战,我们提出探究特征级一致性损失的研究,旨在利用多样化的预训练视觉任务中蕴含的特征先验知识,突破当前方法的局限性。需要指出的是,目前尚缺乏确定最有效预训练视觉任务以增强NSR的明确依据。本研究全面探索了七种预训练视觉任务中十三种方法的多视角特征先验知识,旨在通过考虑更广泛的可能性强化NSR训练。此外,我们评估了不同特征分辨率的影响,并对比分析了像素级与块级一致性损失的效果,为提升NSR性能提供了有效策略。通过引入MVSFormer [?] 和QuadTree [?] 的预训练表示,我们的方法可分别生成MVS-NeuS和Match-NeuS的变体。在DTU和EPFL数据集上的实验结果表明,图像匹配与多视角立体视觉任务的特征先验知识优于其他预训练任务。此外,我们发现将块级光度一致性扩展至特征级的性能超越了像素级方法。这些发现凸显了这些技术在提升NSR效果方面的有效性。代码和模型已开源至https://github.com/maybeLx/MVS_NeuS。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in Neural Surface Reconstruction (NSR) have significantly improved multi-view reconstruction when coupled with volume rendering. However, relying solely on photometric consistency in image space falls short of addressing complexities posed by real-world data, including occlusions and non-Lambertian surfaces. To tackle these challenges, we propose an investigation into feature-level consistent loss, aiming to harness valuable feature priors from diverse pretext visual tasks and overcome current limitations. It is crucial to note the existing gap in determining the most effective pretext visual task for enhancing NSR. In this study, we comprehensively explore multi-view feature priors from seven pretext visual tasks, comprising thirteen methods. Our main goal is to strengthen NSR training by considering a wide range of possibilities. Additionally, we examine the impact of varying feature resolutions and evaluate both pixel-wise and patch-wise consistent losses, providing insights into effective strategies for improving NSR performance. By incorporating pre-trained representations from MVSFormer [?] and QuadTree [?], our approach can generate variations of MVS-NeuS and Match-NeuS, respectively. Our results, analyzed on DTU and EPFL datasets, reveal that feature priors from image matching and multi-view stereo outperform other pretext tasks. Moreover, we discover that extending patch-wise photometric consistency to the feature level surpasses the performance of pixel-wise approaches. These findings underscore the effectiveness of these techniques in enhancing NSR outcomes. Codes and models are available at https://github.com/maybeLx/MVS_NeuS.

title: Xinmin Qiu, Congying Han, Zicheng Zhang, Bonan Li*, Tiande Guo, Pingyu Wang, Xuecheng Nie
title_en: Xinmin Qiu, Congying Han, Zicheng Zhang, Bonan Li*, Tiande Guo, Pingyu Wang, Xuecheng Nie
abstract: 开发盲视频去闪烁(BVD)算法以增强视频时间一致性,在图像处理和视频生成技术蓬勃发展的背景下变得尤为重要。然而,视频数据的复杂性使得深度学习方法的训练变得困难,导致资源消耗高且不稳定,尤其是在严重光照闪烁的情况下。这凸显了在像素值之外构建紧凑表示的迫切需求,以推动BVD研究和应用的发展。受经典尺度-时间均衡(STE)方法启发,我们的工作提出了一种基于直方图辅助的解决方案,称为BlazeBVD,用于实现高保真度和快速的视频去闪烁。与直接通过时间平滑颜色直方图来校正像素值的STE相比,BlazeBVD利用STE滤波中的平滑光照直方图,以减轻神经网络学习时间数据的挑战。在技术实现上,BlazeBVD首先将像素值压缩为精确捕捉闪烁和局部曝光变化的光照直方图。随后对这些直方图进行平滑处理,生成单帧集、滤波光照图和曝光图。借助这些去闪烁先验知识,BlazeBVD采用2D网络恢复受光照变化或局部曝光问题影响的忠实且一致的纹理。BlazeBVD还引入了轻量级3D网络以修正轻微的时间不一致性,避免资源消耗问题。在合成、真实世界和生成视频上的综合实验展示了BlazeBVD在定性和定量结果上的优越性,其推理速度比现有方法快达10倍。
abstract_en: Developing blind video deflickering (BVD) algorithms to enhance video temporal consistency, is gaining importance amid the flourish of image processing and video generation. However, the intricate nature of video data complicates the training of deep learning methods, leading to high resource consumption and instability, notably under severe lighting flicker. This underscores the critical need for a compact representation beyond pixel values to advance BVD research and applications. Inspired by the classic scale-time equalization (STE), our work introduces the histogram-assisted solution, called BlazeBVD, for high-fidelity and rapid BVD. Compared with STE, which directly corrects pixel values by temporally smoothing color histograms, BlazeBVD leverages smoothed illumination histograms within STE filtering to ease the challenge of learning temporal data using neural networks. In technique, BlazeBVD begins by condensing pixel values into illumination histograms that precisely capture flickering and local exposure variations. These histograms are then smoothed to produce singular frames set, filtered illumination maps, and exposure maps. Resorting to these deflickering priors, BlazeBVD utilizes a 2D network to restore faithful and consistent texture impacted by lighting changes or localized exposure issues. BlazeBVD also incorporates a lightweight 3D network to amend slight temporal inconsistencies, avoiding the resource consumption issue. Comprehensive experiments on synthetic, real-world and generated videos, showcase the superior qualitative and quantitative results of BlazeBVD, achieving inference speeds up to 10× faster than state-of-the-arts.

title: Xinpeng Liu, Haowen Hou, Yanchao Yang, Yong-Lu Li*, Cewu Lu
title_en: Xinpeng Liu, Haowen Hou, Yanchao Yang, Yong-Lu Li*, Cewu Lu
abstract: 人类-场景交互(HSI)生成是一项具有挑战性的任务,对多种下游任务至关重要。然而,其主要障碍之一是数据规模有限。同时捕捉人类和三维环境的高质量数据难以获取,导致数据多样性与复杂性受限。本文认为,与场景的交互本质上是从抽象物理视角与场景的空间占用进行交互,从而提出统一的新型人类-占用交互视角。通过将纯运动序列视为人类与不可见场景占用交互的记录,我们可以将仅运动数据聚合为大规模配对的人类-占用交互数据库:运动占用数据库(MOB)。因此,对高成本配对运动-场景数据集的需求可大幅降低。基于这一新的统一视角,提出单个运动控制器,根据周围占用情况达到目标状态。一旦在具有复杂占用布局的MOB上训练,该控制器可处理拥挤场景,并能良好泛化到复杂度有限的普通场景(如常规客厅)。无需真实3D场景数据训练,我们的方法可在多种场景中生成逼真且稳定的HSI运动,包括静态和动态场景。项目地址:https://foruck.github.io/occu-page/
abstract_en: Human-scene Interaction (HSI) generation is a challenging task and crucial for various downstream tasks. However, one of the major obstacles is its limited data scale. High-quality data with simultaneously captured human and 3D environments is hard to acquire, resulting in limited data diversity and complexity. In this work, we argue that interaction with a scene is essentially interacting with the space occupancy of the scene from an abstract physical perspective, leading us to a unified novel view of Human-Occupancy Interaction. By treating pure motion sequences as records of humans interacting with invisible scene occupancy, we can aggregate motion-only data into a large-scale paired human-occupancy interaction database: Motion Occupancy Base (MOB). Thus, the need for costly paired motion-scene datasets with high-quality scene scans can be substantially alleviated. With this new unified view of Human-Occupancy interaction, a single motion controller is proposed to reach the target state given the surrounding occupancy. Once trained on MOB with complex occupancy layout, which is stringent to human movements, the controller could handle cramped scenes and generalize well to general scenes with limited complexity like regular living rooms. With no GT 3D scenes for training, our method can generate realistic and stable HSI motions in diverse scenarios, including both static and dynamic scenes. The project is available at https://foruck.github.io/occu-page/.

title: 刘新鹏,李永路*,曾爱玲,周子政,由阳,卢策武*
title_en: Xinpeng Liu, Yong-Lu Li*, Ailing Zeng, Zizheng Zhou, Yang You, Cewu Lu*
abstract: 运动理解旨在建立运动与动作语义之间的可靠映射,而它是一个具有挑战性的多对多问题。一个抽象的动作语义(例如“向前行走”)可能通过感知上多样的运动(如双臂上举或摆动的行走)来传达。相反,同一运动可能根据其上下文和意图承载不同的语义。这使得两者之间建立优雅的映射变得困难。先前的方法采用直接映射范式,但可靠性有限。同时,当前的自动评估指标无法提供运动与动作语义之间一致性的可靠评估。我们识别出这些问题的根源在于两种模态之间的显著差距。为缓解这一差距,我们提出Kinematic Phrases(KP),它通过适当的抽象、可解释性和通用性,对人类运动的客观运动学事实进行建模。基于KP,我们可以统一运动知识库并构建运动理解系统。同时,KP可自动从运动转换为文本描述,且无主观偏差,启发了Kinematic Prompt Generation(KPG)作为新型白盒运动生成基准。在大量实验中,我们的方法优于其他方法。项目地址:https://foruck.github.io/KP/
abstract_en: Motion understanding aims to establish a reliable mapping between motion and action semantics, while it is a challenging many-to-many problem. An abstract action semantic (i.e., walk forwards) could be conveyed by perceptually diverse motions (walking with arms up or swinging). In contrast, a motion could carry different semantics w.r.t. its context and intention. This makes an elegant mapping between them difficult. Previous attempts adopted direct-mapping paradigms with limited reliability. Also, current automatic metrics fail to provide reliable assessments of the consistency between motions and action semantics. We identify the source of these problems as the significant gap between the two modalities. To alleviate this gap, we propose Kinematic Phrases (KP) that take the objective kinematic facts of human motion with proper abstraction, interpretability, and generality. Based on KP, we can unify a motion knowledge base and build a motion understanding system. Meanwhile, KP can be automatically converted from motions to text descriptions with no subjective bias, inspiring Kinematic Prompt Generation (KPG) as a novel white-box motion generation benchmark. In extensive experiments, our approach shows superiority over other methods. Our project is available at https://foruck.github.io/KP/.

title: Xinqi Lin*, Jingwen He, Ziyan Chen, Zhaoyang Lyu, Bo Dai, Fanghua Yu, Yu Qiao, Wanli Ouyang, Chao Dong*
title_en: Xinqi Lin*, Jingwen He, Ziyan Chen, Zhaoyang Lyu, Bo Dai, Fanghua Yu, Yu Qiao, Wanli Ouyang, Chao Dong*
abstract: 我们提出DiffBIR,一个通用的修复管道,能够在统一框架下处理不同的盲图像修复任务。DiffBIR将盲图像修复问题分解为两个阶段:1)退化去除:去除与图像无关的内容;2)信息再生:生成丢失的图像内容。每个阶段独立开发,但通过级联方式无缝协作。在第一阶段,我们使用修复模块去除退化内容,获得高保真度的修复结果。对于第二阶段,我们提出IRControlNet,利用潜在扩散模型的生成能力生成真实细节。具体而言,IRControlNet基于专门生成的条件图像进行训练,这些图像不含干扰性噪声内容,以确保稳定的生成性能。此外,我们设计了一种区域自适应修复引导机制,可在推理过程中修改去噪过程而无需重新训练模型,允许用户通过可调节的引导尺度在质量和保真度之间进行平衡。大量实验表明,DiffBIR在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上的盲图像超分辨率、盲人脸修复和盲图像去噪任务中均优于现有最先进方法。代码可在https://github.com/XPixelGroup/DiffBIR获取。
abstract_en: We present DiffBIR, a general restoration pipeline that could handle different blind image restoration tasks in a unified framework. DiffBIR decouples blind image restoration problem into two stages: 1) degradation removal: removing image-independent content; 2) information regeneration: generating the lost image content. Each stage is developed independently but they work seamlessly in a cascaded manner. In the first stage, we use restoration modules to remove degradations and obtain high-fidelity restored results. For the second stage, we propose IRControlNet that leverages the generative ability of latent diffusion models to generate realistic details. Specifically, IRControlNet is trained based on specially produced condition images without distracting noisy content for stable generation performance. Moreover, we design a region-adaptive restoration guidance that can modify the denoising process during inference without model re-training, allowing users to balance quality and fidelity through a tunable guidance scale. Extensive experiments have demonstrated DiffBIR’s superiority over state-of-the-art approaches for blind image super-resolution, blind face restoration and blind image denoising tasks on both synthetic and real-world datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/XPixelGroup/DiffBIR.

title: Xinru Cui, Qiming Liu, Zhe Liu, Hesheng Wang*
title_en: Xinru Cui, Qiming Liu, Zhe Liu, Hesheng Wang*
abstract: 我们提出了一种用于导航的新型图记忆结构,称为前沿增强拓扑记忆(FTM)。大多数先前研究主要关注维护已探索区域的记忆表示。相比之下,我们的方法通过将幽灵节点引入拓扑地图,以表征未探索但可见的区域。幽灵节点通过几何方法生成,用于指示几何上可探索的前沿。我们还采用在线训练的隐式表示方法,基于历史观测预测幽灵节点的感知特征。此外,我们开发了多阶段记忆提取模块(MSME),能够有效利用FTM提取与目标相关的信号。该模块特别关注任务特定信息,并生成端到端动作。通过使用FTM,智能体可以提升其环境认知和记忆利用能力。我们在逼真的Gibson环境中评估了所提出的方法,实验结果明确表明,结合FTM的导航框架能够增强智能体的探索意识,并在图像目标导航任务中提升性能。代码见https://github.com/IRMVLab/FTM-nav。
abstract_en: We present a novel graph memory structure for navigation, called Frontier-enhanced Topological Memory (FTM). Most prior research primarily focuses on maintaining memory representations for explored areas. In contrast, our approach incorporates ghost nodes into the topological map to characterize unexplored but visible regions. The ghost nodes are generated using a geometric method and serve to indicate the geometrically explorable frontiers. We also employ an online-trained implicit representation method to predict perceptual features for ghost nodes based on historical observations. In addition, we develop a Multi-Stage Memory Extraction module (MSME) that can effectively utilize the FTM to extract target-related signals. It focuses particularly on task-specific information and generates actions end-to-end. By using FTM, the agent can improve its capacity for environmental cognition and memory utilization. We evaluate the proposed approach on visual navigation in the photo-realistic Gibson environment. Experimental results conclusively demonstrate that the proposed navigation framework with FTM boosts the agent’s exploration awareness and enhances the performance in image-goal navigation tasks. Code is at https://github.com/IRMVLab/ FTM-nav.

title: Xintao Lv, Liang Xu, Yichao Yan*, Xin Jin, Congsheng Xu, Wu Shuwen, Yifan Liu, Lincheng Li, Mengxiao Bi, Wenjun Zeng, Xiaokang Yang
title_en: Xintao Lv, Liang Xu, Yichao Yan*, Xin Jin, Congsheng Xu, Wu Shuwen, Yifan Liu, Lincheng Li, Mengxiao Bi, Wenjun Zeng, Xiaokang Yang
abstract: 生成人与物体的交互(HOI)在数字化身的显著进步中至关重要。现有数据集通常仅限于人类与单个物体的交互,而忽视了对多个物体的普遍操作。因此,我们提出HIMO,一个大规模的全身体运动捕捉数据集,包含3.3K个四维人-物交互序列和4.08M个三维人-物交互帧。我们还对HIMO进行了详细的文本描述和时间片段标注,基准测试两种新颖的HOI合成任务:基于完整文本提示或分段文本提示的条件生成任务,作为细粒度时间线控制。为解决这些新任务,我们提出了一种双分支条件扩散模型,包含用于HOI合成的相互作用模块。此外,还设计了一个自回归生成流程,以实现HOI片段之间的平滑过渡。实验结果表明,该方法在未见过的物体几何形状和时间组合上具有良好的泛化能力。我们的数据、代码和模型将公开用于研究目的。
abstract_en: Generating human-object interactions (HOIs) is critical with the tremendous advances of digital avatars. Existing datasets are typically limited to humans interacting with a single object while neglecting the ubiquitous manipulation of multiple objects. Thus, we propose HIMO, a large-scale MoCap dataset of full-body human interacting with multiple objects, containing 3.3K 4D HOI sequences and 4.08M 3D HOI frames. We also annotate HIMO with detailed textual descriptions and temporal segments, benchmarking two novel tasks of HOI synthesis conditioned on either the whole text prompt or the segmented text prompts as fine-grained timeline control. To address these novel tasks, we propose a dual-branch conditional diffusion model with a mutual interaction module for HOI synthesis. Besides, an auto-regressive generation pipeline is also designed to obtain smooth transitions between HOI segments. Experimental results demonstrate the generalization ability to unseen object geometries and temporal compositions. Our data, codes, and models will be publicly available for research purposes.

title: Xinxu Ge, Xin Liu*, Zitong Yu*, Jingang Shi, Chun Qi, Jie Li, Heikki Kälviäinen
title_en: Xinxu Ge, Xin Liu*, Zitong Yu*, Jingang Shi, Chun Qi, Jie Li, Heikki Kälviäinen
abstract: 人脸防伪装(FAS)在防止人脸识别(FR)系统遭受呈现攻击中发挥着关键作用。如今,FAS系统面临领域偏移的挑战,这影响了现有FAS方法的泛化性能。本文重新审视领域偏移的本质,并将其解构为两个因素:图像风格和图像质量。质量影响伪装信息呈现的纯净度,而风格影响伪装信息呈现的方式。基于我们的分析,我们提出DiffFAS框架,将质量量化为先验信息输入网络以应对图像质量偏移,并通过基于扩散的高保真跨域和跨攻击类型生成以应对图像风格偏移。DiffFAS可将易于收集的活体人脸转化为高保真攻击人脸,并保持活体与伪装人脸身份的一致性,同时还能缓解当前FAS系统面临的新类型攻击标注数据稀缺问题。我们在具有挑战性的跨域和跨攻击FAS数据集上验证了框架的有效性,取得了最先进的性能。Available at https://github.com/murphytju/DiffFAS.
abstract_en: Face anti-spoofing (FAS) plays a vital role in preventing face recognition (FR) systems from presentation attacks. Nowadays, FAS systems face the challenge of domain shift, impacting the generalization performance of existing FAS methods. In this paper, we rethink about the inherence of domain shift and deconstruct it into two factors: image style and image quality. Quality influences the purity of the presentation of spoof information, while style affects the manner in which spoof information is presented. Based on our analysis, we propose DiffFAS framework, which quantifies quality as prior information input into the network to counter image quality shift, and performs diffusion-based high-fidelity cross-domain and cross-attack types generation to counter image style shift. DiffFAS transforms easily collectible live faces into high-fidelity attack faces with precise labels while maintaining consistency between live and spoof face identities, which can also alleviate the scarcity of labeled data with novel type attacks faced by nowadays FAS system. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework on challenging cross-domain and cross-attack FAS datasets, achieving the state-of-the-art performance. Available at https://github.com/murphytju/DiffFAS.

title: Xinya Chen, Hanlei Guo, Yanrui Bin, Shangzhan Zhang, Yuanbo Yang, Yujun Shen, Yue Wang, Yiyi Liao*
title_en: Xinya Chen, Hanlei Guo, Yanrui Bin, Shangzhan Zhang, Yuanbo Yang, Yujun Shen, Yue Wang, Yiyi Liao*
abstract: 收集训练图像的准确相机姿态已被证明能够有效服务于3D感知生成对抗网络(GANs)的学习,但在实践中可能相当昂贵。本文旨在从无姿态图像中学习3D感知GANs,为此我们提出在训练过程中实时估计图像姿态,利用学习到的模板特征场()。具体而言,除了如先前方法中使用的生成辐射场外,我们要求生成器同时从2D语义特征学习一个场,并与辐射场共享密度信息。该框架使我们能够利用生成模型发现的数据集均值获取一个规范化的3D特征模板,并进一步高效地在真实数据上估计姿态参数。在多个具有挑战性的数据集上的实验结果表明,我们的方法在定性和定量方面均优于现有最先进的方法。项目页面:https://XDimlab. github.io/TeFF.
abstract_en: Collecting accurate camera poses of training images has been shown to well serve the learning of 3D-aware generative adversarial networks (GANs) yet can be quite expensive in practice. This work targets learning 3D-aware GANs from unposed images, for which we propose to perform on-the-fly pose estimation of training images with a learned template feature field (). Concretely, in addition to a generative radiance field as in previous approaches, we ask the generator to also learn a field from 2D semantic features while sharing the density from the radiance field. Such a framework allows us to acquire a canonical 3D feature template leveraging the dataset mean discovered by the generative model, and further efficiently estimate the pose parameters on real data. Experimental results on various challenging datasets demonstrate the superiority of our approach over state-of-the-art alternatives from both the qualitative and the quantitative perspectives. Project page: https://XDimlab. github.io/TeFF.

title: Xinyu Xu*, Shengcheng Luo, Yanchao Yang, Yong-Lu Li*, Cewu Lu*
title_en: Xinyu Xu*, Shengcheng Luo, Yanchao Yang, Yong-Lu Li*, Cewu Lu*
abstract: 构建一个能够通过人类指令完成多样化任务的通用智能家庭助手机器人代理,是具身AI研究的长期蓝图,这要求任务规划、环境建模和物体交互能力。在本工作中,我们研究具身代理的基本移动操作,探索如何基于指令动词-名词对进行导航与交互。我们提出DISCO,其在上下文场景建模和高效控制方面具有非平凡的创新。特别是,DISCO融合了物体及其可操作性语义的可微分场景表示,该表示动态学习于运行过程中,有助于导航规划。此外,我们提出双层级粗到细动作控制机制,利用全局与局部线索高效完成移动操作任务。DISCO可轻松集成到具身任务中,如具身指令遵循。为验证我们的方法,我们以大规模长视距视觉-语言导航与交互任务基准ALFRED作为测试平台。在大量实验中,我们进行了全面评估,证明DISCO在未见过的场景中即使不依赖逐步指令,仍以+8.6%的成功率优势超越现有技术。我们的代码已公开在https://github.com/AllenXuuu/DISCO。
abstract_en: Building a general-purpose intelligent home-assistant agent skilled in diverse tasks by human commands is a long-term blueprint of embodied AI research, which poses requirements on task planning, environment modeling, and object interaction. In this work, we study primitive mobile manipulations for embodied agents, how to navigate and interact based on an instructed verb-noun pair. We propose DISCO, which features non-trivial advancements in contextualized scene modeling and efficient controls. In particular, DISCO incorporates differentiable scene representations of rich semantics in object and affordance, which is dynamically learned on the fly and facilitates navigation planning. Besides, we propose dual-level coarse-to-fine action controls leveraging both global and local cues to accomplish mobile manipulation tasks efficiently. DISCO easily integrates into embodied tasks such as embodied instruction following. To validate our approach, we take the ALFRED benchmark of large-scale long-horizon vision-language navigation and interaction tasks as a test bed. In extensive experiments, we make comprehensive evaluations and demonstrate that DISCO outperforms the art by a sizable +8.6% success rate margin in unseen scenes even without step-by-step instructions. Our code is publicly released at https://github.com/AllenXuuu/DISCO.

title: Xinyu Yang*, Hossein Rahmani, Dame S Black, Bryan M Williams
title_en: Xinyu Yang*, Hossein Rahmani, Dame S Black, Bryan M Williams
abstract: 类激活图(CAMs)常用于弱监督语义分割(WSSS)中生成伪标签。由于类激活图存在不完整或过度激活的问题,现有研究通常依赖离线CAM优化,引入额外阶段或提出离线模块。这会导致单阶段方法的优化困难并限制其泛化能力。本研究旨在减少观察到的CAM不一致性与误差,以降低对优化过程的依赖。我们提出了一种端到端的WSSS模型,结合引导式CAMs,其中分割模型在训练过程中同时在线优化CAMs。我们的方法交换分配协同训练(CoSA)采用双流框架,其中子网络从另一子网络生成的交换分配中学习。我们在该框架中引入三种技术:i)基于软困惑度的正则化以惩罚不确定区域;ii)阈值搜索方法动态调整置信度阈值;iii)对比分离技术解决共存问题。CoSA表现出卓越的性能,在VOC和COCO验证数据集上分别达到76.2%和51.0%的mIoU,显著超越现有基线方法。值得注意的是,CoSA是首个超越所有现有多阶段方法(包括具有额外监督的方法)的单阶段方法。源代码已公开在此。
abstract_en: Class activation maps (CAMs) are commonly employed in weakly supervised semantic segmentation (WSSS) to produce pseudo-labels. Due to incomplete or excessive class activation, existing studies often resort to offline CAM refinement, introducing additional stages or proposing offline modules. This can cause optimization difficulties for single-stage methods and limit generalizability. In this study, we aim to reduce the observed CAM inconsistency and error to mitigate reliance on refinement processes. We propose an end-to-end WSSS model incorporating guided CAMs, wherein our segmentation model is trained while concurrently optimizing CAMs online. Our method, Co-training with Swapping Assignments (CoSA), leverages a dual-stream framework, where one sub-network learns from the swapped assignments generated by the other. We introduce three techniques in this framework: i) soft perplexity-based regularization to penalize uncertain regions; ii) a threshold-searching approach to dynamically revise the confidence threshold; and iii) contrastive separation to address the coexistence problem. CoSA demonstrates exceptional performance, achieving mIoU of 76.2% and 51.0% on VOC and COCO validation datasets, respectively, surpassing existing baselines by a substantial margin. Notably, CoSA is the first single-stage approach to outperform all existing multi-stage methods including those with additional supervision. Source code is publicly available here.

title: Xinyuan Gao, Songlin Dong, Yuhang He*, Qiang Wang, Yihong Gong
title_en: Xinyuan Gao, Songlin Dong, Yuhang He*, Qiang Wang, Yihong Gong
abstract: 无需回放的持续学习(RFCL)问题旨在持续学习新知识的同时防止遗忘旧知识,且无需存储任何旧样本和原型。最新方法利用大规模预训练模型作为主干,并通过键-查询匹配生成可训练提示以学习新知识。然而,预训练数据集与下游数据集之间的领域差距会导致直接使用预训练模型生成查询时键-查询匹配提示选择出现不准确,从而阻碍新知识的学习。因此,本文提出了一种超越提示学习的RFCL方法,称为持续适配器(C-ADA)。它主要包含一个参数可扩展的持续适配器层(CAL)和与预训练模型并行的缩放与平移(S&S)模块。C-ADA通过灵活扩展CAL中的特定权重来学习每个任务的新知识,并冻结旧权重以保留先验知识,从而避免键-查询匹配引入的匹配错误和操作低效性。为减少领域差距,C-ADA采用S&S模块将特征空间从预训练数据集转移到下游数据集。此外,我们提出了一种正交损失以缓解旧知识与新知识之间的交互。我们的方法在性能和训练速度上显著提升,超越了当前最先进的(SOTA)方法。此外,我们在领域增量学习上进行了实验,超越了SOTA,展示了我们的方法在不同设置下的通用性。
abstract_en: The problem of Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning (RFCL) aims to continually learn new knowledge while preventing forgetting of the old knowledge, without storing any old samples and prototypes. The latest methods leverage large-scale pre-trained models as the backbone and use key-query matching to generate trainable prompts to learn new knowledge. However, the domain gap between the pre-training dataset and the downstream datasets can easily lead to inaccuracies in key-query matching prompt selection when directly generating queries using the pre-trained model, which hampers learning new knowledge. Thus, in this paper, we propose a beyond prompt learning approach to the RFCL task, called Continual Adapter (C-ADA). It mainly comprises a parameter-extensible continual adapter layer (CAL) and a scaling and shifting (S&S) module in parallel with the pre-trained model. C-ADA flexibly extends specific weights in CAL to learn new knowledge for each task and freezes old weights to preserve prior knowledge, thereby avoiding matching errors and operational inefficiencies introduced by key-query matching. To reduce the gap, C-ADA employs an S&S module to transfer the feature space from pre-trained datasets to downstream datasets. Moreover, we propose an orthogonal loss to mitigate the interaction between old and new knowledge. Our approach achieves significantly improved performance and training speed, outperforming the current state-of-the-art (SOTA) method. Additionally, we conduct experiments on domain-incremental learning, surpassing the SOTA, and demonstrating the generality of our approach in different settings.

title: Xinzhi Mu*, Li Chen, Bohan CHEN, Shuyang Gu, Jianmin Bao, Dong Chen, Ji Li, Yuhui Yuan
title_en: Xinzhi Mu*, Li Chen, Bohan CHEN, Shuyang Gu, Jianmin Bao, Dong Chen, Ji Li, Yuhui Yuan
abstract: 近年来,基于扩散的文本到图像生成模型在艺术字体创作中的应用,这一传统上属于专业设计师领域的任务,引起了广泛关注。与大多数专注于生成艺术字体的现有研究不同,我们的研究旨在解决一个新颖且更具挑战性的问题:多语言字体的文本效果生成。该任务本质上要求在字体形状的画布范围内生成连贯且一致的视觉内容,而非传统的矩形画布。为解决这一任务,我们提出了一种新颖的形状自适应扩散模型,能够解析给定形状并策略性地规划不规则画布中的像素分布。为此,我们构建了一个高质量的形状自适应图像-文本数据集,并将分割掩码作为视觉条件融入到不规则画布的图像生成过程中。该方法使传统基于矩形画布的扩散模型能够根据提供的几何形状生成所需概念。其次,为保持多字母间的一致性,我们还提出了一种无需训练的形状自适应效果迁移方法,用于将生成的参考字母纹理迁移到其他字母。关键洞察包括构建字体效果噪声先验,并在拼接潜在空间中传播字体效果信息。通过用户偏好研究验证了系统有效性,结果显示即使与最新无与伦比的商业产品Adobe Firefly1相比,我们的系统在美学方面仍具有显著优势(78%的胜率)。1 https://firefly.adobe.com/generate/font-styles
abstract_en: Recently, the application of modern diffusion-based text-to-image generation models for creating artistic fonts, traditionally the domain of professional designers, has garnered significant interest. Diverging from the majority of existing studies that concentrate on generating artistic typography, our research aims to tackle a novel and more demanding challenge: the generation of text effects for multilingual fonts. This task essentially requires generating coherent and consistent visual content within the confines of a font-shaped canvas, as opposed to a traditional rectangular canvas. To address this task, we introduce a novel shape-adaptive diffusion model capable of interpreting the given shape and strategically planning pixel distributions within the irregular canvas. To achieve this, we curate a high-quality shape-adaptive image-text dataset and incorporate the segmentation mask as a visual condition to steer the image generation process within the irregular-canvas. This approach enables the traditionally rectangle canvas-based diffusion model to produce the desired concepts in accordance with the provided geometric shapes. Second, to maintain consistency across multiple letters, we also present a training-free, shape-adaptive effect transfer method for transferring textures from a generated reference letter to others. The key insights are building a font effect noise prior and propagating the font effect information in a concatenated latent space. The efficacy of our system is confirmed through user preference studies, which show a marked preference (78% win-rates on aesthetics) for our system even when compared to the latest unrivaled commercial product, Adobe Firefly1 . 1 https://firefly.adobe.com/generate/font-styles

title: Xinzhou Wang, Yikai Wang*, Junliang Ye, Fuchun Sun*, Zhengyi Wang, Ling Wang, Pengkun Liu, Kai Sun, Xintong Wang, Xie wende, Fangfu Liu, Bin He
title_en: Xinzhou Wang, Yikai Wang*, Junliang Ye, Fuchun Sun*, Zhengyi Wang, Ling Wang, Pengkun Liu, Kai Sun, Xintong Wang, Xie wende, Fangfu Liu, Bin He
abstract: 三维生成技术的进步促进了序列三维模型生成(即四维生成),但其在具有大运动的可动画对象中的应用仍较为有限。我们的工作提出了AnimatableDreamer,一个文本到四维生成框架,能够从单目视频中提取的骨骼上生成多样化的非刚性对象。其核心是我们的新型优化设计——规范分数蒸馏(CSD),该设计通过提升二维扩散实现时间一致的四维生成。CSD从分数梯度视角设计,生成具有运动鲁棒性的规范模型。值得注意的是,它还通过整合扩散模型的归纳先验增强了骨骼和皮肤的逼真度。此外,借助多视角蒸馏,CSD推断不可见区域,从而提升单目非刚性重建的保真度。大量实验验证了我们的方法在从单目视频生成高灵活性的文本引导三维模型方面的有效性,同时在非刚性重建方法上也表现出更优的重建性能。项目页面:https://zz7379.github.io/AnimatableDreamer/
abstract_en: Advances in 3D generation have facilitated sequential 3D model generation (a.k.a 4D generation), yet its application for animatable objects with large motion remains scarce. Our work proposes AnimatableDreamer, a text-to-4D generation framework capable of generating diverse categories of non-rigid objects on skeletons extracted from a monocular video. At its core, AnimatableDreamer is equipped with our novel optimization design dubbed Canonical Score Distillation (CSD), which lifts 2D diffusion for temporal consistent 4D generation. CSD, designed from a score gradient perspective, generates a canonical model with warp-robustness across different articulations. Notably, it also enhances the authenticity of bones and skinning by integrating inductive priors from a diffusion model. Furthermore, with multi-view distillation, CSD infers invisible regions, thereby improving the fidelity of monocular non-rigid reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate the capability of our method in generating high-flexibility text-guided 3D models from the monocular video, while also showing improved reconstruction performance over existing non-rigid reconstruction methods. Project page https://zz7379.github.io/AnimatableDreamer/.

title: Xiufeng HUANG*, Ka Chun Cheung, Simon See, Renjie Wan*
title_en: Xiufeng HUANG*, Ka Chun Cheung, Simon See, Renjie Wan*
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRF)重着色技术的显著进展简化了修改NeRF颜色属性的过程。然而,随着NeRF作为可共享数字资产的潜力,存在恶意用户篡改NeRF模型颜色并虚假声称重着色版本为己有的风险。为防止此类所有权侵犯,使原始NeRF创作者能够对重着色NeRF建立权利至关重要。尽管已有如CopyRNeRF等方法通过嵌入二进制信息到NeRF模型中作为数字签名以实现版权保护,但重着色过程可能移除这些二进制信息。在本文中,我们提出GeometrySticker,一种将二进制信息无缝集成到辐射场几何组件中的方法,类似于贴标签。GeometrySticker可在保持这些信息对抗重着色有效性的同时,将二进制信息嵌入NeRF模型。我们的全面研究证明,GeometrySticker可适配主流NeRF架构,并对各种失真保持良好的鲁棒性。项目页面:https://kevinhuangxf.github.io/GeometrySticker.
abstract_en: Remarkable advancements in the recolorization of Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) have simplified the process of modifying NeRF’s color attributes. Yet, with the potential of NeRF to serve as shareable digital assets, there’s a concern that malicious users might alter the color of NeRF models and falsely claim the recolorized version as their own. To safeguard against such breaches of ownership, enabling original NeRF creators to establish rights over recolorized NeRF is crucial. While approaches like CopyRNeRF have been introduced to embed binary messages into NeRF models as digital signatures for copyright protection, the process of recolorization can remove these binary messages. In our paper, we present GeometrySticker, a method for seamlessly integrating binary messages into the geometry components of radiance fields, akin to applying a sticker. GeometrySticker can embed binary messages into NeRF models while preserving the effectiveness of these messages against recolorization. Our comprehensive studies demonstrate that GeometrySticker is adaptable to prevalent NeRF architectures and maintains a commendable level of robustness against various distortions. Project page: https://kevinhuangxf.github.io/GeometrySticker.

title: Xiuli Bi, Haowei Liu, Weisheng Li, Bo Liu*, Bin Xiao
title_en: Xiuli Bi, Haowei Liu, Weisheng Li, Bo Liu*, Bin Xiao
abstract: 艺术图像通常包含艺术家独特的创作风格。然而,使用风格迁移技术可以轻松地将艺术家的风格转移到任意目标图像上。为保护艺术风格,一些研究者采用对抗攻击来保护艺术家的艺术风格图像。先前方法仅考虑防御所有风格迁移模型,但艺术家可能允许特定模型适当迁移其艺术风格。为满足此类需求,我们提出了一种艺术风格保护方案(Artistic Style Protection Scheme,ASPS)。该方案利用对抗扰动,在未经授权模型提取的内容和风格特征的均值和方差中引入偏差,同时对授权模型的内容和风格特征进行对齐。此外,它采用像素级和特征级损失函数,分别增强和降低授权模型与未经授权模型的输出质量。ASPS仅需训练一次;在使用过程中无需再次查看任何风格迁移模型。同时,它确保授权模型的视觉质量不受扰动影响。实验结果表明,我们的方法有效防御了未经授权模型对艺术风格的随意使用,允许授权模型正常运行,从而有效解决了艺术家艺术风格的受控授权问题。代码可在https://github.com/CherishL-J/ASPS获取。
abstract_en: Artistic images typically contain the unique creative styles of artists. However, it is easy to transfer an artist’s style to arbitrary target images using style transfer techniques. To protect styles, some researchers use adversarial attacks to safeguard artists’ artistic style images. Prior methods only considered defending against all style transfer models, but artists may allow specific models to transfer their artistic styles properly. To meet such requirements, we propose an Artistic Style Protection Scheme (ASPS). The scheme utilizes adversarial perturbations to introduce biases in the mean and variance of content and style features extracted by unauthorized models while aligning authorized models’ content and style features. Additionally, it employs pixel-level and feature-level losses to enhance and degrade the output quality of authorized and unauthorized models, respectively. ASPS requires training only once; during usage, there is no need to see any style transfer models again. Meanwhile, it ensures that the visual quality of the authorized model is unaffected by perturbations. Experimental results demonstrate that our method effectively defends against unauthorized models’ indiscriminate use of artistic styles, allowing authorized models to operate normally, thus effectively resolving the issue of controlled authorization regarding artists’ artistic styles. The code is available at https://github.com/CherishL-J/ASPS.

title: 侯修全, 刘美琴*, 张森林, 魏平, 陈巴东, 兰绪光
title_en: Xiuquan Hou, Meiqin Liu*, Senlin Zhang, Ping Wei, Badong Chen, Xuguang Lan
abstract: 本文提出了一种通用方案,用于增强DETR(DEtection TRansformer)的收敛性和性能。我们从新视角研究了Transformer中的缓慢收敛问题,认为其源于自注意力机制在输入上引入了无结构偏差。为解决这一问题,我们探索将位置关系先验作为注意力偏差,通过提出的定量宏观相关性(MC)度量验证其统计显著性,以增强目标检测。我们的方法称为Relation-DETR,引入编码器构建位置关系嵌入,实现渐进式注意力细化,进一步将传统DETR的流式处理流程扩展为对比关系流程,以解决非重复预测与正样本监督之间的冲突。在通用和任务特定数据集上的大量实验验证了该方法的有效性。在相同配置下,Relation-DETR相比DINO提升了+2.0% AP,达到SOTA性能(1×设置下51.7% AP,2×设置下52.1% AP),并在COCO val2017上实现了显著更快的收敛速度(仅需2个训练周期即可达到超过40% AP)。此外,所提出的关联编码器作为通用插件组件,可为理论上任何DETR-like方法带来明显改进。进一步地,我们引入了一个类别无关的检测数据集SA-Det-100k。在该数据集上的实验结果表明,所提出的显式位置关系使AP提升了1.3%,凸显了其在通用目标检测中的潜力。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/xiuqhou/Relation-DETR获取。
abstract_en: This paper presents a general scheme for enhancing the convergence and performance of DETR (DEtection TRansformer). We investigate the slow convergence problem in transformers from a new perspective, suggesting that it arises from the self-attention that introduces no structural bias over inputs. To address this issue, we explore incorporating position relation prior as attention bias to augment object detection, following the verification of its statistical significance using a proposed quantitative macroscopic correlation (MC) metric. Our approach, termed Relation-DETR, introduces an encoder to construct position relation embeddings for progressive attention refinement, which further extends the traditional streaming pipeline of DETR into a contrastive relation pipeline to address the conflicts between non-duplicate predictions and positive supervision. Extensive experiments on both generic and task-specific datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Under the same configurations, Relation-DETR achieves a significant improvement (+2.0% AP compared to DINO), state-of-the-art performance (51.7% AP for 1× and 52.1% AP for 2× settings), and a remarkably faster convergence speed (over 40% AP with only 2 training epochs) than existing DETR detectors on COCO val2017. Moreover, the proposed relation encoder serves as a universal plug-in-and-play component, bringing clear improvements for theoretically any DETR-like methods. Furthermore, we introduce a class-agnostic detection dataset, SA-Det-100k. The experimental results on the dataset illustrate that the proposed explicit position relation achieves a clear improvement of 1.3% AP, highlighting its potential towards universal object detection. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/xiuqhou/Relation-DETR.

title: 陈秀媛, 林媛*, 张雨辰*, 黄伟然*
title_en: Xiuyuan Chen, Yuan Lin*, Yuchen Zhang*, Weiran Huang*
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖且具有挑战性的基准测试AutoEval-Video,以全面评估大视觉-语言模型在开放性视频问答中的表现。AutoEval-Video的全面性体现在两个方面:1)AutoEval-Video在9个技能维度上构建开放性视频问题,涵盖感知、理解和生成能力;2)AutoEval-Video包含新收集的视频,涵盖超过40个不同的主题。为了高效评估开放性问题的回答,我们采用基于大语言模型的评估方法,但不同于仅提供参考答案,我们为每个实例(视频-问题对)标注了独特的评估规则。为了最大化这些规则的鲁棒性,我们开发了一种新颖的对抗性标注机制。通过将实例特定规则作为提示,GPT-4作为自动评估器,可以实现约97.0%的稳定评估准确率,与人工评估器的94.9%至97.5%准确率相当。此外,我们评估了十一款大视觉-语言模型在AutoEval-Video上的表现。其中,GPT-4V(ision)显著优于其他模型,准确率达到32.2%。然而,与人类准确率72.8%相比,仍有显著提升空间。通过进行广泛的案例研究,我们发现了GPT-4V的一些缺点,如时间动态理解能力有限和回答过于笼统。代码可在magentahttps://github.com/Xiuyuan-Chen/A获取。
abstract_en: We propose a novel and challenging benchmark, AutoEval-Video, to comprehensively evaluate large vision-language models in open-ended video question answering. The comprehensiveness of AutoEval-Video is demonstrated in two aspects: 1) AutoEval-Video constructs open-ended video-questions across 9 skill dimensions, addressing capabilities of perception, comprehension, and generation; 2) AutoEval-Video contains newly collected videos that cover over 40 distinct themes. To efficiently evaluate responses to the open-ended questions, we employ an LLM-based evaluation approach, but instead of merely providing a reference answer, we annotate unique evaluation rules for every single instance (video-question pair). To maximize the robustness of these rules, we develop a novel adversarial annotation mechanism. By using instance-specific rules as prompt, GPT-4, as an automatic evaluator, can achieve a stable evaluation accuracy of around 97.0%, comparable to the 94.9% - 97.5% accuracy of a human evaluator. Furthermore, we assess the performance of eleven large vision-language models on AutoEval-Video. Among them, GPT-4V(ision) significantly outperforms other models, achieving an accuracy of 32.2%. However, there is still substantial room for improvement compared to human accuracy of 72.8%. By conducting an extensive case study, we uncover several drawbacks of GPT-4V, such as limited temporal and dynamic comprehension, and overly general responses. Code is available at magentahttps://github.com/Xiuyuan-Chen/A

title: 吴修哲,孙阳天,陈翰迪,周航,王景东,刘正哲,齐晓娟*
title_en: Xiuzhe Wu, Yang-Tian Sun, Handi Chen, Hang Zhou, Jingdong Wang, Zhengzhe Liu, Xiaojuan Qi*
abstract: 本文介绍了文本驱动的虚拟形象生成任务,该任务通过文本指导虚拟形象的生成与动画制作。该任务中的一个重大挑战是缺乏配对的文本与对话虚拟形象数据,限制了数据驱动方法的应用。为此,我们提出了一种零样本方法,将现有的三维感知图像生成模型(在大规模图像数据集上训练以实现高质量虚拟形象生成)适配至文本指令,并通过动画生成对话虚拟形象,从而无需配对的文本与对话虚拟形象数据。我们的方法核心在于三维感知图像生成模型(即EG3D)、显式的三维人脸模型以及新开发的自监督修复技术的无缝集成,以创建并动画化虚拟形象,生成时间一致的对话视频。详尽的评估表明,我们的方法在基于文本描述生成逼真虚拟形象以及使虚拟形象表达用户指定文本方面均有效。值得注意的是,我们的方法高度可控,能够生成丰富的表情和头部姿态。
abstract_en: This paper introduces text-driven talking avatar generation, a task that uses text to instruct both the generation and animation of an avatar. One significant obstacle in this task is the absence of paired text and talking avatar data for model training, limiting data-driven methodologies. To this end, we present a zero-shot approach that adapts an existing 3D-aware image generation model, trained on a large-scale image dataset for high-quality avatar creation, to align with textual instructions and be animated to produce talking avatars, eliminating the need for paired text and talking avatar data. Our approach’s core lies in the seamless integration of a 3D-aware image generation model (i.e., EG3D), the explicit 3DMM model, and a newly developed self-supervised inpainting technique, to create and animate the avatar and generate a temporal consistent talking video. Thorough evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach in generating realistic avatars based on textual descriptions and empowering avatars to express user-specified text. Notably, our approach is highly controllable and can generate rich expressions and head poses.

title: Xiwei Xuan*, Ziquan Deng, Hsuan-Tien Lin, Kwan-Liu Ma
title_en: Xiwei Xuan*, Ziquan Deng, Hsuan-Tien Lin, Kwan-Liu Ma
abstract: 近期研究表明,深度学习模型常常错误地学习到与标签关联的虚假特征,这在现实场景中(这些相关性不成立时)会损害其可靠性。尽管研究努力不断增加,现有解决方案通常面临两大挑战:要么需要大量标注虚假属性,要么在缺乏额外标注时,通过昂贵的训练策略获得的成果竞争力不足。本文提出,一种成本效益高且以性能为导向的方法,用于减少深度学习中的虚假相关性。我们的方法采用了一种人类参与的协议,包含一种新颖的注意力标注机制和构建的注意力表示空间。显著减少了对全面额外标注的需求,仅需对不到3%的实例进行人工输入。通过优先考虑数据质量而非复杂的训练策略,精选出一个更小但特征平衡的数据子集,促进开发对虚假性鲁棒的模型。在关键基准测试中的实验验证表明,与领先方法相比,性能相当甚至更优,同时显著降低成本。该框架为更高效地开发可靠模型提供了一条有前景的路径。我们的代码可在https://github.com/xiweix/SLIM.git/获取。
abstract_en: Recent studies highlight that deep learning models often learn spurious features mistakenly linked to labels, compromising their reliability in real-world scenarios where such correlations do not hold. Despite the increasing research effort, existing solutions often face two main challenges: they either demand substantial annotations of spurious attributes, or they yield less competitive outcomes with expensive training when additional annotations are absent. In this paper, we introduce , a cost-effective and performance-targeted approach to reducing spurious correlations in deep learning. Our method leverages a human-in-the-loop protocol featuring a novel attention labeling mechanism with a constructed attention representation space. significantly reduces the need for exhaustive additional labeling, requiring human input for fewer than 3% of instances. By prioritizing data quality over complicated training strategies, curates a smaller yet more feature-balanced data subset, fostering the development of spuriousness-robust models. Experimental validations across key benchmarks demonstrate that competes with or exceeds the performance of leading methods while significantly reducing costs. The framework thus presents a promising path for developing reliable models more efficiently. Our code is available in https://github.com/xiweix/SLIM.git/.

title: Xixi Liu*, Christopher Zach
title_en: Xixi Liu*, Christopher Zach
abstract: 分布外(OOD)检测已被广泛研究,以确保深度学习模型的可靠部署。尽管在该研究方向上取得了显著进展,但大多数工作仍集中在判别分类器上,并基于由视觉或文本特征组成的单模态表示进行OOD检测。此外,它们依赖于使用分布内(ID)数据进行训练。视觉-语言模型的出现使得通过多模态特征嵌入进行零样本OOD检测成为可能,因此仅需依赖定义ID数据的标签。已设计出几种方法,但这些方法要么需要给定的OOD标签集,这可能与实际OOD数据存在偏差,要么需要微调CLIP,这可能需要针对不同的ID数据集进行调整。在本文中,我们首先将各种为判别分类器开发的OOD分数适应于CLIP。进一步,我们提出了一种基于文本提示增强(Text prompt AuGmentation)的增强方法TAG,以放大ID数据与OOD数据之间的分离,该方法简单但有效,且可应用于各种分数函数。其性能在CIFAR-100和大规模ImageNet-1k OOD检测基准上进行了验证。在四种常用架构上,TAG在四种基线OOD分数上持续提升了CIFAR-100的AUROC和FPR95。平均AUROC和FPR95的提升分别为6.35%和10.67%。ImageNet-1k的结果呈现出类似但不那么显著的模式。代码可在以下链接获取:https://github.com/XixiLiu95/TAG。
abstract_en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection has been extensively studied for the reliable deployment of deep-learning models. Despite great progress in this research direction, most works focus on discriminative classifiers and perform OOD detection based on single-modal representations that consist of either visual or textual features. Moreover, they rely on training with in-distribution (ID) data. The emergence of vision-language models allows to perform zero-shot OOD detection by leveraging multi-modal feature embeddings and therefore only rely on labels defining ID data. Several approaches have been devised but these either need a given OOD label set, which might deviate from real OOD data, or fine-tune CLIP, which potentially has to be done for different ID datasets. In this paper, we first adapt various OOD scores developed for discriminative classifiers to CLIP. Further, we propose an enhanced method named TAG based on Text prompt AuGmentation to amplify the separation between ID and OOD data, which is simple but effective, and can be applied on various score functions. Its performance is demonstrated on CIFAR-100 and large-scale ImageNet-1k OOD detection benchmarks. It consistently improves AUROC and FPR95 on CIFAR-100 across four commonly used architectures over four baseline OOD scores. The average AUROC and FPR95 improvements are 6.35% and 10.67%, respectively. The results for ImageNet-1k follow a similar, but less pronounced pattern. The code is available at: https://github.com/XixiLiu95/TAG.

title: Xixu Hu, Runkai Zheng, Jindong Wang*, Cheuk Hang Leung, Qi Wu*, Xing Xie
title_en: Xixu Hu, Runkai Zheng, Jindong Wang*, Cheuk Hang Leung, Qi Wu*, Xing Xie
abstract: 视觉变换器(ViTs)由于其高性能在计算机视觉领域应用日益广泛,但其对对抗攻击的脆弱性是一个令人担忧的问题。现有方法缺乏坚实的理论基础,主要关注于经验性训练调整。本研究引入了__TITLE_MATH_1__,专门针对增强ViTs对对抗攻击的鲁棒性,并具有理论依据。我们为自注意力层建立了局部利普希茨界,并提出最大奇异值惩罚(MSVP)以精确管理这些界。通过将MSVP整合到ViTs的注意力层中,我们在不牺牲训练效率的前提下提升了模型的鲁棒性。实验结果表明,由此产生的SpecFormer模型在CIFAR和ImageNet数据集上的对抗攻击防御性能优于其他最先进的模型。代码已发布于https://github.com/microsoft/robustlearn。
abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) are increasingly used in computer vision due to their high performance, but their vulnerability to adversarial attacks is a concern. Existing methods lack a solid theoretical basis, focusing mainly on empirical training adjustments. This study introduces , tailored to fortify ViTs against adversarial attacks, with theoretical underpinnings. We establish local Lipschitz bounds for the self-attention layer and propose the Maximum Singular Value Penalization (MSVP) to precisely manage these bounds By incorporating MSVP into ViTs’ attention layers, we enhance the model’s robustness without compromising training efficiency. SpecFormer, the resulting model, outperforms other state-of-the-art models in defending against adversarial attacks, as proven by experiments on CIFAR and ImageNet datasets. Code is released at https://github.com/microsoft/robustlearn.

title: Xiyao Liu, Siyu Yang, Jian Zhang*, Gerald Schaefer, Jiya Li, Xunli FAN, Songtao Wu, Hui Fang*
title_en: Xiyao Liu, Siyu Yang, Jian Zhang*, Gerald Schaefer, Jiya Li, Xunli FAN, Songtao Wu, Hui Fang*
abstract: 任意神经风格迁移旨在通过参考提供的风格图像对内容图像进行风格化。尽管已有多种努力实现内容保留和风格迁移能力,但学习有效的表示对于该任务仍然具有挑战性,因为内容和风格特征的冗余会导致不愉快的图像伪影。在本文中,我们从信息理论的角度出发,学习用于风格迁移的紧凑神经表示。特别是,我们通过在可逆流网络的顺序模块中强制压缩表示,以减少特征冗余而不丢失内容保留能力。我们使用Barlow twins损失来减少通道依赖性,从而提供更好的内容表达性,并优化参考图像和目标图像之间风格表示的Jensen-Shannon散度,以避免风格化不足和过度风格化。我们全面展示了所提出方法的有效性,与其他最先进的风格迁移方法进行比较。
abstract_en: Arbitrary neural style transfer aims to stylise a content image by referencing a provided style image. Despite various efforts to achieve both content preservation and style transferability, learning effective representations for this task remains challenging since the redundancy of content and style features leads to unpleasant image artefacts. In this paper, we learn compact neural representations for style transfer motivated from an information theoretical perspective. In particular, we enforce compressive representations across sequential modules of a reversible flow network in order to reduce feature redundancy without losing content preservation capability. We use a Barlow twins loss to reduce channel dependency and thus to provide better content expressiveness, and optimise the Jensen-Shannon divergence of style representations between reference and target images to avoid under- and over-stylisation. We comprehensively demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method in comparison to other state-of-the-art style transfer approaches.

title: Xu Hang, Chen Long, Wenxiao Zhang*, Yuan Liu, Zhen Cao, Zhen Dong, Bisheng Yang
title_en: Xu Hang, Chen Long, Wenxiao Zhang*, Yuan Liu, Zhen Cao, Zhen Dong, Bisheng Yang
abstract: ∗ Equal contribution Corresponding author 本文提出了一种新颖的框架EGIInet(显式引导的信息交互网络),用于视图引导的点云补全(ViPC)任务,旨在从单视角图像中恢复完整的点云。与以往依赖输入图像全局语义的方法不同,EGIInet通过利用补全任务的几何特性,高效地融合了两种模态的信息。具体而言,我们提出了一种基于模态对齐的显式引导信息交互策略,用于点云补全。首先,与以往方法简单分别使用2D和3D主干网络编码特征不同,我们统一了编码过程以促进模态对齐。其次,我们提出了一种新颖的显式引导信息交互策略,能够帮助网络识别图像中的关键信息,从而实现更有效的补全指导。大量实验验证了我们框架的有效性,在参数量少于以往方法的情况下,我们在基准数据集上取得了新的SOTA(相比XMFnet在CD指标上提升16%)。预训练模型和代码可在https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/EGIInet获取。
abstract_en: ∗ Equal contribution Corresponding authorIn this paper, we explore a novel framework, EGIInet (Explicitly Guided Information Interaction Network), a model for View-guided Point cloud Completion (ViPC) task, which aims to restore a complete point cloud from a partial one with a single view image. In comparison with previous methods that relied on the global semantics of input images, EGIInet efficiently combines the information from two modalities by leveraging the geometric nature of the completion task. Specifically, we propose an explicitly guided information interaction strategy supported by modal alignment for point cloud completion. First, in contrast to previous methods which simply use 2D and 3D backbones to encode features respectively, we unified the encoding process to promote modal alignment. Second, we propose a novel explicitly guided information interaction strategy that could help the network identify critical information within images, thus achieving better guidance for completion. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework, and we achieved a new state-of-the-art (+16% CD over XMFnet) in benchmark datasets despite using fewer parameters than the previous methods. The pre-trained model and code and are available at https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/EGIInet.

title: Xu Zheng*, Yuanhuiyi Lyu, Lin Wang*
title_en: Xu Zheng*, Yuanhuiyi Lyu, Lin Wang*
abstract: 图像模态并非完美,常在特定条件下(如夜间和快速运动)失效,这显著限制了现有多模态(如图像+X)语义分割方法在面对模态缺失或失效时的鲁棒性和通用性,这在现实应用场景中经常发生。受多模态视觉-语言模型(MVLMs)的开放世界学习能力启发,我们通过知识蒸馏(KD)从MVLMs中探索学习模态无关表示的新方向。直观上,我们提出Any2Seg,一种新颖框架,可在任何视觉条件下,从任意模态组合实现鲁棒分割。具体而言,我们首先引入一种语言引导的语义相关性蒸馏(LSCD)模块,从MVLMs(如LanguageBind [?])的嵌入空间中迁移跨模态和同模态语义知识,这使我们能够最小化模态差异并缓解语义歧义,从而在任何视觉条件下组合任意模态。随后,我们引入一种模态无关特征融合(MFF)模块,基于跨模态相关性对多模态特征进行加权,并选择细粒度特征。通过这种方式,Any2Seg最终得到最优的模态无关表示。在两个包含四种模态的基准数据集上的大量实验表明,Any2Seg在多模态设置下达到最先进水平(+3.54 mIoU),并在具有挑战性的模态不完整设置下表现优异(+19.79 mIoU)。
abstract_en: Image modality is not perfect as it often fails in certain conditions, , night and fast motion. This significantly limits the robustness and versatility of existing multi-modal (, Image+X) semantic segmentation methods when confronting modality absence or failure, as often occurred in real-world applications. Inspired by the open-world learning capability of multi-modal vision-language models (MVLMs), we explore a new direction in learning the modality-agnostic representation via knowledge distillation (KD) from MVLMs. Intuitively, we propose Any2Seg , a novel framework that can achieve robust segmentation from any combination of modalities in any visual conditions. Specifically, we first introduce a novel language-guided semantic correlation distillation (LSCD) module to transfer both inter-modal and intra-modal semantic knowledge in the embedding space from MVLMs, , LanguageBind [?]. This enables us to minimize the modality gap and alleviate semantic ambiguity to combine any modalities in any visual conditions. Then, we introduce a modality-agnostic feature fusion (MFF) module that reweights the multi-modal features based on the inter-modal correlation and selects the fine-grained feature. This way, our Any2Seg finally yields an optimal modality-agnostic representation. Extensive experiments on two benchmarks with four modalities demonstrate that Any2Seg achieves the state-of-the-art under the multi-modal setting (+3.54 mIoU) and excels in the challenging modality-incomplete setting(+19.79 mIoU).

title: Xu Zheng*, Yuanhuiyi Lyu, jiazhou zhou, Lin Wang*
title_en: Xu Zheng*, Yuanhuiyi Lyu, jiazhou zhou, Lin Wang*
abstract: 融合任意数量的模态对于实现稳健的多模态语义分割至关重要,但目前仍较少被探索。近期研究将RGB模态作为中心,其他模态作为辅助,构建了具有两个分支的非对称架构。然而,RGB模态在某些场景(如夜间)可能表现不佳,而其他模态(如事件数据)则具有自身优势;因此,融合模型需要识别稳健与脆弱的模态,并结合最稳健和最脆弱的模态以学习一个鲁棒的多模态框架。为此,我们提出了一种名为MAGIC的新方法,可灵活适配各种主干网络,涵盖紧凑型到高性能模型。我们的方法包含两个关键的即插即用模块。首先,我们引入了多模态聚合模块,以高效处理多模态批次的特征并提取互补的场景信息。在此基础上,提出了一种统一的任意模态选择模块,利用聚合特征作为基准,根据相似度得分对多模态特征进行排序。通过这种方式,我们的方法可以消除对RGB模态的依赖,更好地克服传感器故障,同时确保分割性能。在常见的多模态设置下,我们的方法在减少60%模型参数的同时实现了最先进的性能。此外,在新颖的模态无关设置中,我们的方法表现优异,mIoU指标优于现有方法达+19.41%。
abstract_en: Fusing an arbitrary number of modalities is vital for achieving robust multi-modal fusion of semantic segmentation yet remains less explored to date. Recent endeavors regard RGB modality as the center and the others as the auxiliary, yielding an asymmetric architecture with two branches. However, the RGB modality may struggle in certain circumstances, , nighttime, while others, , event data, own their merits; thus, it is imperative for the fusion model to discern robust and fragile modalities, and incorporate the most robust and fragile ones to learn a resilient multi-modal framework. To this end, we propose a novel method, named MAGIC, that can be flexibly paired with various backbones, ranging from compact to high-performance models. Our method comprises two key plug-and-play modules. Firstly, we introduce a multi-modal aggregation module to efficiently process features from multi-modal batches and extract complementary scene information. On top, a unified arbitrary-modal selection module is proposed to utilize the aggregated features as the benchmark to rank the multi-modal features based on the similarity scores. This way, our method can eliminate the dependence on RGB modality and better overcome sensor failures while ensuring the segmentation performance. Under the commonly considered multi-modal setting, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing the model parameters by 60%. Moreover, our method is superior in the novel modality-agnostic setting, where it outperforms prior arts by a large margin of +19.41% mIoU.

title: Xuan Ju*, Xian Liu, Xintao Wang*, Yuxuan Bian, Ying Shan, Qiang Xu*
title_en: Xuan Ju*, Xian Liu, Xintao Wang*, Yuxuan Bian, Ying Shan, Qiang Xu*
abstract: 图像修复,即恢复受损图像的过程,随着扩散模型(DMs)的出现取得了显著进展。尽管如此,当前用于图像修复的DM适应方法,无论是修改采样策略还是开发专门的图像修复DM,经常面临语义不一致和图像质量下降的问题。为解决这些挑战,我们的工作引入了一种新范式:将掩码图像特征和噪声潜变量分到不同的分支。这种划分显著降低了模型的学习负担,使模型能够以分层的方式精细地融合关键的掩码图像信息。本文提出BrushNet,一种新颖的即插即用双分支模型,可将像素级掩码图像特征嵌入任何预训练的DM中,确保图像修复结果的连贯性和质量提升。此外,我们还引入了相关工具以支持基于分割的图像修复训练和性能评估。我们的广泛实验分析表明,BrushNet在图像质量、掩码区域保持和文本连贯性等七个关键指标上均优于现有模型。
abstract_en: Image inpainting, the process of restoring corrupted images, has seen significant advancements with the advent of diffusion models (DMs). Despite these advancements, current DM adaptations for inpainting, which involve modifications to the sampling strategy or the development of inpainting-specific DMs, frequently suffer from semantic inconsistencies and reduced image quality. Addressing these challenges, our work introduces a novel paradigm: the division of masked image features and noisy latent into separate branches. This division dramatically diminishes the model’s learning load, facilitating a nuanced incorporation of essential masked image information in a hierarchical fashion. Herein, we present , a novel plug-and-play dual-branch model engineered to embed pixel-level masked image features into any pre-trained DM, guaranteeing coherent and enhanced image inpainting outcomes. Additionally, we introduce and to facilitate segmentation-based inpainting training and performance assessment. Our extensive experimental analysis demonstrates BrushNet’s superior performance over existing models across seven key metrics, including image quality, mask region preservation, and textual coherence.

title: Xuan Wang, Zhong Ji*, Xiyao Liu, Yanwei Pang, Jungong Han
title_en: Xuan Wang, Zhong Ji*, Xiyao Liu, Yanwei Pang, Jungong Han
abstract: 少样本类增量学习(FSCIL)旨在以少量训练样本学习新概念,同时保留之前获得的知识。尽管已取得令人鼓舞的性能,但关于FSCIL的基本统计原理仍存在未被充分探索的方面。因此,我们全面探讨了FSCIL的近似风险,包括迁移风险和一致性风险。通过收紧这些风险的上界,我们得出了设计和训练FSCIL模型的实用指导原则。这些原则包括(1)扩展基础类的训练数据集,(2)避免过度关注特定特征,(3)优化分类边界差异,以及(4)确保基础类和新类之间的分类无偏性。利用这些见解,我们进行了全面实验以验证我们的原则,在三个FSCIL基准数据集上实现了最先进的性能。代码可在https://github.com/xwangrs/Approximation_FSCIL-ECCV2024.git获取。
abstract_en: Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL) aims to learn new concepts with few training samples while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Although promising performance has been achieved, there remains an underexplored aspect regarding the basic statistical principles underlying FSCIL. Therefore, we thoroughly explore the approximation risk of FSCIL, encompassing both transfer and consistency risks. By tightening the upper bounds of these risks, we derive practical guidelines for designing and training FSCIL models. These guidelines include (1) expanding training datasets for base classes, (2) preventing excessive focus on specific features, (3) optimizing classification margin discrepancy, and (4) ensuring unbiased classification across both base and novel classes. Leveraging these insights, we conduct comprehensive experiments to validate our principles, achieving state-of-the-art performance on three FSCIL benchmark datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/xwangrs/Approximation_FSCIL-ECCV2024. git.

title: Xuan Wu*, Hongxiang Li, Yuanjiang Luo, Xuxin Cheng, Xianwei Zhuang, Meng Cao, Keren Fu*
title_en: Xuan Wu*, Hongxiang Li, yuanjiang luo, Xuxin Cheng, Xianwei Zhuang, Meng Cao, Keren Fu*
abstract: 手语视频检索在促进聋人社区信息获取方面发挥着关键作用。尽管视频-文本检索领域取得了显著进展,但手语的复杂性和固有不确定性使得这些技术无法直接应用。先前方法通过细粒度模态对齐实现手语视频与文本的映射。然而,由于细粒度标注的稀缺性,手语视频的固有不确定性被低估,限制了手语检索任务的进一步发展。为解决这一挑战,我们提出了一种新的不确定性感知概率分布检索方法(UPRet),将手语视频与文本的映射过程概念化为概率分布,探索其潜在的相互关系,并实现灵活的映射。在三个基准数据集上的实验表明,我们的方法有效,分别在How2Sign(59.1%)、PHOENIX-2014T(72.0%)和CSL-Daily(78.4%)上达到最先进结果。我们的源代码已公开:https://github.com/xua222/UPRet
abstract_en: Sign language video retrieval plays a key role in facilitating information access for the deaf community. Despite significant advances in video-text retrieval, the complexity and inherent uncertainty of sign language preclude direct applications of these techniques. Previous methods achieve mapping between sign language videos and text through fine-grained modal alignment. However, due to the scarcity of fine-grained annotations, the uncertainty inherent in sign language videos is underestimated, limiting further development of sign language retrieval tasks. To address this challenge, we propose a new Uncertainty-aware Probability Distribution Retrieval (UPRet), which conceptualizes the mapping process of sign language videos and texts in terms of probability distributions, explores their potential interrelationships, and enables flexible mappings. Experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, which achieves state-of-the-art results on How2Sign (59.1%), PHOENIX-2014T (72.0%), and CSL-Daily (78.4%). Our source code is available: https://github.com/xua222/ UPRet.

title: Xuan-Thuy Vo*, Duy-Linh Nguyen, Adri Priadana, Kang-Hyun Jo*
title_en: Xuan-Thuy Vo*, Duy-Linh Nguyen, Adri Priadana, Kang-Hyun Jo*
abstract: 作为视觉Transformer(ViT)的核心,自注意力机制因其能够对长距离空间交互进行建模而具有高度的通用性,因为每个查询都会关注所有空间位置。尽管ViT在视觉任务中表现出色,但自注意力的复杂度与标记长度的平方成正比。这导致在将ViT模型适配到需要高输入分辨率的下游任务时面临挑战。先前的研究尝试通过引入稀疏注意力机制(如空间缩减注意力和窗口注意力)来解决这一问题。这些方法的共同点在于计算注意力权重时所有图像/窗口标记都会被合并。本文发现注意力权重之间存在高度相似性,从而导致计算冗余。为了解决这一问题,本文提出了一种新的注意力机制,称为部分注意力,通过减少注意力图中的冗余信息,更高效地学习空间交互。我们的注意力机制中,每个查询仅与一小部分相关标记进行交互。基于部分注意力,我们提出了一种高效且通用的视觉Transformer,命名为PartialFormer,在各类视觉任务中实现了准确率与计算成本之间的良好平衡。例如,在ImageNet-1K数据集上,PartialFormer-B3在Top-1准确率上超越Swin-T 1.7%,同时节省25%的GFLOPs;相比Focal-T则提升0.8%,节省30%的GFLOPs。
abstract_en: As a core of Vision Transformer (ViT), self-attention has high versatility in modeling long-range spatial interactions because every query attends to all spatial locations. Although ViT achieves promising performance in visual tasks, self-attention’s complexity is quadratic with token lengths. This leads to challenging problems when adapting ViT models to downstream tasks that require high input resolutions. Previous arts have tried to solve this problem by introducing sparse attention such as spatial reduction attention, and window attention. One common point of these methods is that all image/window tokens are joined during computing attention weights. In this paper, we find out that there exist high similarities between attention weights and incur computation redundancy. To address this issue, this paper introduces novel attention, called partial attention, that learns spatial interactions more efficiently, by reducing redundant information in attention maps. Each query in our attention only interacts with a small set of relevant tokens. Based on partial attention, we propose an efficient and general vision Transformer, named PartialFormer, that attains good trade-offs between accuracy and computational costs across vision tasks. For example, on ImageNet-1K, PartialFormer-B3 surpasses Swin-T by 1.7% Top-1 accuracy while saving 25% GFLOPs, and Focal-T by 0.8% while saving 30% GFLOPs.

title: Xuanchen Li, Yuhao Cheng, Xingyu Ren, Haozhe Jia, Di Xu, Wenhan Zhu, Yichao Yan*
title_en: Xuanchen Li, Yuhao Cheng, Xingyu Ren, Haozhe Jia, Di Xu, Wenhan Zhu, Yichao Yan*
abstract: 近年来,高质量面部重建技术取得了显著进展,但4D面部资产重建仍面临挑战。4D头部捕捉旨在从视频中生成动态拓扑网格及其对应的纹理图,因其能够模拟面部肌肉运动并恢复毛孔挤压的动态纹理,广泛应用于电影和游戏领域。业界通常采用多视角立体视觉与非刚性对齐相结合的方法。然而,该方法易产生误差,且严重依赖耗时的手动处理。为简化这一过程,我们提出Topo4D,一种新型框架,可自动生成几何结构与纹理,直接从校准的多视角时间序列图像中优化密集对齐的4D头部和8K纹理图。具体而言,我们首先将时间序列面部表示为一组具有固定拓扑的动态3D高斯分布,其中高斯中心与网格顶点绑定。随后,我们交替优化几何结构与纹理,逐帧进行动态头部捕捉,同时保持时间拓扑稳定性。最后,可从学习到的高斯分布中提取具有规律布线排列和高保真度、包含毛孔级细节的动态面部网格。大量实验表明,我们的方法在网格与纹理质量方面均优于当前最先进的面部重建方法。项目页面:https://xuanchenli.github.io/Topo4D/
abstract_en: Recent significant advances in high-quality face reconstruction have been made, but challenges remain in 4D face asset reconstruction. 4D head capture aims to generate dynamic topological meshes and corresponding texture maps from videos, which is widely utilized in movies and games for its ability to simulate facial muscle movements and recover dynamic textures in pore-squeezing. The industry often adopts a method involving multi-view stereo and non-rigid alignment. However, this approach is prone to errors and heavily relies on time-consuming manual processing by artists. To simplify this process, we propose Topo4D, a novel framework for automatic geometry and texture generation that optimizes densely aligned 4D heads and 8K texture maps directly from calibrated multi-view time-series images.
