Specifically, we first represent the time-series faces as a set of dynamic 3D Gaussians with fixed topology in which the Gaussian centers are bound to the mesh vertices. Afterward, we optimize geometry and texture frame-by-frame alternatively for dynamic head capture while maintaining temporal topology stability. Finally, we can extract dynamic facial meshes in regular wiring arrangement and high-fidelity textures with pore-level details from the learned Gaussians. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves superior results than the current SOTA face reconstruction methods in the quality of both meshes and textures. Project page: https://xuanchenli.github.io/Topo4D/.

title: Xudong Wang, Ke-Yue Zhang, Taiping Yao*, Qianyu Zhou, Shouhong Ding, Pingyang Dai*, Rongrong Ji
title_en: Xudong Wang, Ke-Yue Zhang, Taiping Yao*, Qianyu Zhou, Shouhong Ding, Pingyang Dai*, Rongrong Ji
abstract: 可泛化的人脸反欺骗(FAS)方法近年来因其在未见过场景中表现出的鲁棒性而受到广泛关注。一些近期方法将视觉-语言模型引入FAS,利用其出色的预训练性能来提升泛化能力。然而,这些方法仅使用粗粒度或单元素提示进行FAS任务的微调,未能充分挖掘语言监督的潜力,导致泛化能力不理想。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种名为TF-FAS的新框架,旨在全面探索和利用双重元素细粒度语义引导以增强泛化能力。具体而言,提出内容元素解耦模块(CEDM)以全面探索与内容相关的语义元素,随后用于监督类别特征与内容相关特征的解耦,从而提升泛化能力。此外,考虑到FAS中每个类别数据的细微差异,我们提出细粒度类别元素模块(FCEM)以探索细粒度类别元素引导,然后自适应地将它们整合以促进每个类别的分布建模。全面的实验和分析验证了我们的方法在现有先进方法上的优越性。Code:https://github.com/xudongww/TF-FAS
abstract_en: Generalizable Face anti-spoofing (FAS) approaches have recently garnered considerable attention due to their robustness in unseen scenarios. Some recent methods incorporate vision-language models into FAS, leveraging their impressive pre-trained performance to improve the generalization. However, these methods only utilize coarse-grained or single-element prompts for fine-tuning FAS tasks, without fully exploring the potential of language supervision, leading to unsatisfactory generalization ability. To address these concerns, we propose a novel framework called TF-FAS, which aims to thoroughly explore and harness twofold-element fine-grained semantic guidance to enhance generalization. Specifically, the Content Element Decoupling Module (CEDM) is proposed to comprehensively explore the semantic elements related to content. It is subsequently employed to supervise the decoupling of categorical features from content-related features, thereby enhancing the generalization abilities. Moreover, recognizing the subtle differences within the data of each class in FAS, we present a Fine-Grained Categorical Element Module (FCEM) to explore fine-grained categorical element guidance, then adaptively integrate them to facilitate the distribution modeling for each class. Comprehensive experiments and analysis demonstrate the superiority of our method over state-of-the-art competitors. Code:https://github.com/xudongww/TF-FAS

title: Xudong Xie, Yuzhe Li, Yang Liu, Zhifei Zhang, Zhaowen Wang, Wei Xiong, Xiang Bai*
title_en: Xudong Xie, Yuzhe Li, Yang Liu, Zhifei Zhang, Zhaowen Wang, Wei Xiong, Xiang Bai*
abstract: 准确的文本分割结果对于文本相关的生成任务(如文本图像生成、文本编辑、文本移除和文本风格迁移)至关重要。近年来,一些场景文本分割方法在分割常规文本方面取得了显著进展。然而,这些方法在包含艺术文本的场景中表现不佳。因此,本文聚焦更具挑战性的艺术文本分割任务,并构建了一个真实的艺术文本分割数据集。该任务的一个挑战在于艺术文本的局部笔画形状具有多样性和复杂性。我们提出了一种带有逐层动量查询的解码器,以防止模型忽略特殊形状的笔画区域。另一个挑战是全局拓扑结构的复杂性。我们进一步设计了骨架辅助头,引导模型关注全局结构。此外,为提升文本分割模型的泛化性能,我们提出了一种基于大型多模态模型和扩散模型的训练数据合成策略。实验结果表明,我们提出的方法和合成数据集显著提升了艺术文本分割性能,并在其他公开数据集上取得了最先进的结果。数据集和代码可在以下链接获取:https://github.com/xdxie/WAS WordArt-Segmentation.
abstract_en: Accurate text segmentation results are crucial for text-related generative tasks, such as text image generation, text editing, text removal, and text style transfer. Recently, some scene text segmentation methods have made significant progress in segmenting regular text. However, these methods perform poorly in scenarios containing artistic text. Therefore, this paper focuses on the more challenging task of artistic text segmentation and constructs a real artistic text segmentation dataset. One challenge of the task is that the local stroke shapes of artistic text are changeable with diversity and complexity. We propose a decoder with the layer-wise momentum query to prevent the model from ignoring stroke regions of special shapes. Another challenge is the complexity of the global topological structure. We further design a skeleton-assisted head to guide the model to focus on the global structure. Additionally, to enhance the generalization performance of the text segmentation model, we propose a strategy for training data synthesis, based on the large multi-modal model and the diffusion model. Experimental results show that our proposed method and synthetic dataset can significantly enhance the performance of artistic text segmentation and achieve state-of-the-art results on other public datasets. The datasets and codes are available at: https://github.com/xdxie/WAS WordArt-Segmentation.

title: 戴雪龙*, 肖斌
title_en: Xuelong Dai*, Bin Xiao
abstract: 近年来,将几何特征与Transformer模型结合应用于三维点云特征学习的研究显著提升了三维深度学习模型的性能。然而,这些方法对对抗攻击的鲁棒性尚未被充分研究。现有攻击方法主要聚焦于白盒场景,难以迁移到近期提出的三维深度学习模型。更糟糕的是,这些攻击对三维坐标引入扰动,生成不真实的对抗样本,导致对三维对抗防御的性能较差。本文利用扩散模型生成高质量的对抗点云。通过以部分点作为先验知识,借助对抗引导的形状补全生成逼真的对抗样本。所提出的对抗形状补全方法能够更可靠地生成对抗点云。为增强攻击迁移性,我们深入研究三维点云的特性,并通过点云的随机下采样利用模型不确定性,提升对模型分类的推理能力。我们采用集成对抗引导策略,以提高在不同网络架构间的迁移性。为保持生成质量,我们通过计算显著性分数,仅将对抗引导限制在点云的关键点上。大量实验表明,所提出的攻击方法在针对黑盒模型和防御机制时均优于现有最先进的对抗攻击方法。我们的黑盒攻击为评估各类三维点云分类模型的鲁棒性建立了新的基准。
abstract_en: Recent studies that incorporate geometric features and transformers into 3D point cloud feature learning have significantly improved the performance of 3D deep-learning models. However, their robustness against adversarial attacks has not been thoroughly explored. Existing attack methods primarily focus on white-box scenarios and struggle to transfer to recently proposed 3D deep-learning models. Even worse, these attacks introduce perturbations to 3D coordinates, generating unrealistic adversarial examples and resulting in poor performance against 3D adversarial defenses. In this paper, we generate high-quality adversarial point clouds using diffusion models. By using partial points as prior knowledge, we generate realistic adversarial examples through shape completion with adversarial guidance. The proposed adversarial shape completion allows for a more reliable generation of adversarial point clouds. To enhance attack transferability, we delve into the characteristics of 3D point clouds and employ model uncertainty for better inference of model classification through random down-sampling of point clouds. We adopt ensemble adversarial guidance for improved transferability across different network architectures. To maintain the generation quality, we limit our adversarial guidance solely to the critical points of the point clouds by calculating saliency scores. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed attacks outperform state-of-the-art adversarial attack methods against both black-box models and defenses. Our black-box attack establishes a new baseline for evaluating the robustness of various 3D point cloud classification models.

title: Xuelong Dai*, Kaisheng Liang, Bin Xiao
title_en: Xuelong Dai*, Kaisheng Liang, Bin Xiao
abstract: Unrestricted adversarial attacks present a serious threat to deep learning models and adversarial defense techniques. They pose severe security problems for deep learning applications because they can effectively bypass defense mechanisms. However, previous attack methods often directly inject Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) gradients into the sampling of generative models, which are not theoretically provable and thus generate unrealistic examples by incorporating adversarial objectives, especially for GAN-based methods on large-scale datasets like ImageNet. In this paper, we propose a new method, called AdvDiff, to generate unrestricted adversarial examples with diffusion models. We design two novel adversarial guidance techniques to conduct adversarial sampling in the reverse generation process of diffusion models. These two techniques are effective and stable in generating high-quality, realistic adversarial examples by integrating gradients of the target classifier interpretably. Experimental results on MNIST and ImageNet datasets demonstrate that AdvDiff is effective in generating unrestricted adversarial examples, which outperforms state-of-the-art unrestricted adversarial attack methods in terms of attack performance and generation quality.
abstract_en: Unrestricted adversarial attacks present a serious threat to deep learning models and adversarial defense techniques. They pose severe security problems for deep learning applications because they can effectively bypass defense mechanisms. However, previous attack methods often directly inject Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) gradients into the sampling of generative models, which are not theoretically provable and thus generate unrealistic examples by incorporating adversarial objectives, especially for GAN-based methods on large-scale datasets like ImageNet. In this paper, we propose a new method, called AdvDiff, to generate unrestricted adversarial examples with diffusion models. We design two novel adversarial guidance techniques to conduct adversarial sampling in the reverse generation process of diffusion models. These two techniques are effective and stable in generating high-quality, realistic adversarial examples by integrating gradients of the target classifier interpretably. Experimental results on MNIST and ImageNet datasets demonstrate that AdvDiff is effective in generating unrestricted adversarial examples, which outperforms state-of-the-art unrestricted adversarial attack methods in terms of attack performance and generation quality.

title: 冯雪露, 陈东东, 袁俊松, 邱春明, 华刚, 朱子欣*
title_en: Xuelu Feng, Dongdong Chen, Junsong Yuan, Chunming Qiao, Gang Hua, Zixin Zhu*
abstract: 本文探讨了从预训练的文本到视频(T2V)扩散模型中产生的视觉表示,用于视频理解任务。我们假设,从预训练的生成式T2V模型中学习到的潜在表示封装了丰富的语义和连贯的时间对应关系,从而自然地促进视频理解。我们的假设通过经典的指称视频对象分割(R-VOS)任务得到验证。我们引入了一种新型框架,称为“VD-IT”,该框架基于固定预训练的T2V模型,专门设计了专用组件。具体而言,VD-IT将文本信息作为条件输入,确保时间上的语义一致性,以实现精确的时间实例匹配。此外,VD-IT还引入图像标记作为补充的文本输入,丰富特征集以生成详细且细腻的掩码。此外,我们提出使用额外的噪声预测模块来预测视频特定的噪声,而不是使用标准高斯噪声,这有助于保持特征保真度并提升分割质量。通过大量实验,我们惊讶地发现,与通常用于视频主干网络(如Video Swin Transformer)的判别性图像/视频预任务预训练模型不同,固定的生成式T2V扩散模型在保持语义对齐和时间一致性方面展现出更大的潜力。在现有的标准基准测试中,我们的VD-IT取得了高度竞争的结果,超越了许多现有的最先进方法。代码可在https://github.com/buxiangzhiren/VD-IT获取。
abstract_en: In this paper, we explore the visual representations produced from a pre-trained text-to-video (T2V) diffusion model for video understanding tasks. We hypothesize that the latent representation learned from a pretrained generative T2V model encapsulates rich semantics and coherent temporal correspondences, thereby naturally facilitating video understanding. Our hypothesis is validated through the classic referring video object segmentation (R-VOS) task. We introduce a novel framework, termed “VD-IT”, tailored with dedicatedly designed components built upon a fixed pretrained T2V model. Specifically, VD-IT uses textual information as a conditional input, ensuring semantic consistency across time for precise temporal instance matching. It further incorporates image tokens as supplementary textual inputs, enriching the feature set to generate detailed and nuanced masks. Besides, instead of using the standard Gaussian noise, we propose to predict the video-specific noise with an extra noise prediction module, which can help preserve the feature fidelity and elevates segmentation quality. Through extensive experiments, we surprisingly observe that fixed generative T2V diffusion models, unlike commonly used video backbones (e.g., Video Swin Transformer) pretrained with discriminative image/video pre-tasks, exhibit better potential to maintain semantic alignment and temporal consistency. On existing standard benchmarks, our VD-IT achieves highly competitive results, surpassing many existing state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at https://github.com/buxiangzhiren/VD-IT.

title: Xueqi Ma, Yilin Liu, Wenjun Zhou, Ruowei Wang, Hui Huang*
title_en: Xueqi Ma, Yilin Liu, Wenjun Zhou, Ruowei Wang, Hui Huang*
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的方法,利用自回归模型生成具有语义增强的3D房屋线框结构。与传统生成模型独立处理顶点、边和面不同,我们的方法采用统一的线框表示,以提高学习3D线框结构的连贯性。通过根据语义含义重新排序线序列,我们在序列生成过程中促进无缝的语义整合。我们的两阶段技术结合基于图的自编码器与基于Transformer的解码器,以学习潜在几何标记并生成语义感知的线框。通过推理过程中的迭代预测和解码,我们的模型生成的线框可轻松分割为墙壁、屋顶和房间等不同组件,反映形状的语义本质。在全面的房屋数据集上的实证结果验证了我们的模型在准确性、新颖性和语义保真度方面优于现有生成模型。更多结果和细节请访问 https://vcc.tech/research/2024/3DWire。
abstract_en: We present a new approach for generating 3D house wireframes with semantic enrichment using an autoregressive model. Unlike conventional generative models that independently process vertices, edges, and faces, our approach employs a unified wire-based representation for improved coherence in learning 3D wireframe structures. By re-ordering wire sequences based on semantic meanings, we facilitate seamless semantic integration during sequence generation. Our two-phase technique merges a graph-based autoencoder with a transformer-based decoder to learn latent geometric tokens and generate semantic-aware wireframes. Through iterative prediction and decoding during inference, our model produces detailed wireframes that can be easily segmented into distinct components, such as walls, roofs, and rooms, reflecting the semantic essence of the shape. Empirical results on a comprehensive house dataset validate the superior accuracy, novelty, and semantic fidelity of our model compared to existing generative models. More results and details can be found on https://vcc.tech/research/2024/3DWire.

title: Xueyang Kang*, Zhaoliang Luan, Kourosh Khoshelham, Bing WANG*
title_en: Xueyang Kang*, Zhaoliang Luan, Kourosh Khoshelham, Bing WANG*
abstract: 点云配准是三维对齐与重建应用的基础任务。尽管传统方法和基于学习的配准方法都取得了成功,但利用点云数据的内在对称性(包括旋转等变性)仍关注不足。这阻碍了模型的有效学习,导致需要更多训练数据和增加模型复杂度。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种图神经网络模型,通过基于SE(3)消息传递的传播机制嵌入局部球面欧几里得3D等变性属性。我们的模型主要由描述子模块、等变图层、匹配相似度和最终回归层组成。这种模块化设计使我们能够利用稀疏采样的输入点,并通过自训练或预训练的几何特征描述子轻松初始化描述子。在3DMatch和KITTI数据集上的实验表明,与现有最先进方法相比,我们的模型表现出卓越且鲁棒的性能,同时模型复杂度保持相对较低。
abstract_en: Point cloud registration is a foundational task for 3D alignment and reconstruction applications. While both traditional and learning-based registration approaches have succeeded, leveraging the intrinsic symmetry of point cloud data, including rotation equivariance, has received insufficient attention. This prohibits the model from learning effectively, resulting in a requirement for more training data and increased model complexity. To address these challenges, we propose a graph neural network model embedded with a local Spherical Euclidean 3D equivariance property through SE(3) message passing based propagation. Our model is composed mainly of a descriptor module, equivariant graph layers, match similarity, and the final regression layers. Such modular design enables us to utilize sparsely sampled input points and initialize the descriptor by self-trained or pre-trained geometric feature descriptors easily. Experiments conducted on the 3DMatch and KITTI datasets exhibit the compelling and robust performance of our model compared to state-of-the-art approaches, while the model complexity remains relatively low at the same time.

title: 刘雪毅*,吕康博,张洁琼,杜涛,李毅*
title_en: Xueyi Liu*, Kangbo Lyu, jieqiong zhang, Tao Du, Li Yi*
abstract: 我们通过设计模拟器来探索灵巧操作迁移问题。该任务旨在将人类操作转移到灵巧机器人手的模拟中,由于其复杂的、高度约束的、不连续的动力学以及需要使用自由度控制灵巧手以准确复制人类操作,因此具有固有的难度。先前的方法在高保真黑盒模拟器或修改后的约束放宽的模拟器中优化,仅展示了有限的能力或受到模拟保真度不足的限制。我们引入了参数化的准物理模拟器和物理课程来克服这些限制。关键思想是1)通过参数化模拟器的课程平衡模拟的保真度和可优化性,以及2)在课程中的每个模拟器中解决问题,这些模拟器的属性从高任务可优化性到高保真度不等。我们成功地使灵巧手在高保真模拟环境中跟踪复杂多样的操作,将成功率提高了11%以上。项目网站可在QuasiSim上找到。
abstract_en: We explore the dexterous manipulation transfer problem by designing simulators. The task wishes to transfer human manipulations to dexterous robot hand simulations and is inherently difficult due to its intricate, highly-constrained, and discontinuous dynamics and the need to control a dexterous hand with a DoF to accurately replicate human manipulations. Previous approaches that optimize in high-fidelity black-box simulators or a modified one with relaxed constraints only demonstrate limited capabilities or are restricted by insufficient simulation fidelity. We introduce parameterized quasi-physical simulators and a physics curriculum to overcome these limitations. The key ideas are 1) balancing between fidelity and optimizability of the simulation via a curriculum of parameterized simulators, and 2) solving the problem in each of the simulators from the curriculum, with properties ranging from high task optimizability to high fidelity. We successfully enable a dexterous hand to track complex and diverse manipulations in high-fidelity simulated environments, boosting the success rate by 11%+ from the best-performed baseline. The project website is available at QuasiSim.

title: Xuhui Liu, Zhi Qiao, Runkun Liu, Hong Li, Xiantong Zhen*, Zhen Qian, Juan Zhang*, Baochang Zhang
title_en: Xuhui Liu, Zhi Qiao, Runkun Liu, Hong Li, Xiantong Zhen*, Zhen Qian, Juan Zhang*, Baochang Zhang
abstract: 计算机断层扫描(CT)因其能够提供人体的详细三维图像而在临床中广泛应用。然而,由于辐射暴露和某些手术环境的限制,进行CT扫描并不总是可行。作为一种替代方案,从超稀疏X射线重建CT图像提供了一种有价值的解决方案,并在科学研究和医学应用中引起了广泛关注。然而,这带来了巨大挑战,因为其本质上是一个不适定问题,常因X射线图像中重叠结构导致的伪影而受到损害。本文提出DiffuX2CT,将正交双平面X射线的CT重建建模为条件扩散过程。DiffuX2CT采用了一种新的隐式条件机制的三维全局一致性去噪模型。我们通过新设计的三平面解耦生成器和隐式神经解码器实现了该条件机制。通过这样做,DiffuX2CT实现了结构可控的重建,从而从二维X射线中恢复三维结构信息,生成忠实的CT图像纹理。作为额外贡献,我们收集了一个真实世界腰椎CT数据集,称为LumbarV,作为新的基准以验证从X射线重建CT的临床意义和性能。在该数据集以及三个其他公开数据集上的大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Computed tomography (CT) is widely utilized in clinical settings because it delivers detailed 3D images of the human body. However, performing CT scans is not always feasible due to radiation exposure and limitations in certain surgical environments. As an alternative, reconstructing CT images from ultra-sparse X-rays offers a valuable solution and has gained significant interest in scientific research and medical applications. However, it presents great challenges as it is inherently an ill-posed problem, often compromised by artifacts resulting from overlapping structures in X-ray images. In this paper, we propose DiffuX2CT, which models CT reconstruction from orthogonal biplanar X-rays as a conditional diffusion process. DiffuX2CT is established with a 3D global coherence denoising model with a new, implicit conditioning mechanism. We realize the conditioning mechanism by a newly designed tri-plane decoupling generator and an implicit neural decoder. By doing so, DiffuX2CT achieves structure-controllable reconstruction, which enables 3D structural information to be recovered from 2D X-rays, therefore producing faithful textures in CT images. As an extra contribution, we collect a real-world lumbar CT dataset, called LumbarV, as a new benchmark to verify the clinical significance and performance of CT reconstruction from X-rays. Extensive experiments on this dataset and three more publicly available datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposal.

title: Xulong Bai, Hainan Cui*, Shuhan Shen*
title_en: Xulong Bai, Hainan Cui*, Shuhan Shen*
abstract: 我们研究了从具有已知相机姿态的多视角中重建三维线段及其线轨迹的问题。基本流程包括:首先为每个二维线段生成三维线段提案,然后选择最佳提案,合并以生成三维线段和线轨迹,最后进行非线性优化。我们的关键贡献集中在探索和缓解经典方法中的不一致性问题。在最佳提案选择中,我们分析了多视角下从二维到三维支持关系的固有不一致性问题,并提出了一种迭代算法来处理该问题。在线轨迹构建中,我们引入二维共线性约束以增强每条线轨迹中元素的一致性。在优化过程中,我们引入共面约束,并联合优化点、线、平面和消失点,提升线图结构的一致性。实验结果表明,我们对一致性的强调使线图在完整性和准确性上达到最先进水平,同时生成更长且更鲁棒的线轨迹。代码可在 https://github.com/3dv-casia/clmap 获取。
abstract_en: We address the problem of reconstructing 3D line segments along with line tracks from multiple views with known camera poses. The basic pipeline is first generating 3D line segment proposals for each 2D line segment, then selecting the best proposals, merging them to produce 3D line segments and line tracks, and finally performing non-linear optimization. Our key contributions are focused on exploring and alleviating the inconsistency problems in classical approaches. In the best proposal selection, we analyze the inherent inconsistency problem of support relationships from 2D to 3D determined during proposal evaluation using multiple views and propose an iterative algorithm to handle it. In line track building, we impose 2D collinearity constraints to enhance the consistency of the elements in each line track. In optimization, we introduce coplanarity constraints and jointly optimize points, lines, planes, and vanishing points, enhancing the consistency of the structure of the line map. Experimental results demonstrate that our emphasis on consistency enables our line maps to achieve state-of-the-art completeness and accuracy, while also generating longer and more robust line tracks. Code is available at https://github. com/3dv-casia/clmap.

title: Xulong Wang, Siyan Dong*, Youyi Zheng, Yanchao Yang*
title_en: Xulong Wang, Siyan Dong*, Youyi Zheng, Yanchao Yang*
abstract: 从多视角图像进行三维表面重建对于场景理解和交互至关重要。然而,复杂室内场景由于观测信息有限,存在诸如歧义性等挑战。近期的隐式表面表示方法,如神经辐射场(NeRFs)和符号距离函数(SDFs),通过多种几何先验来解决观测信息不足的问题。然而,其性能严重依赖于预训练几何估计模型的质量。为缓解这种依赖性,我们提出通过显式鼓励高度相关场景点表面法线之间的互信息来正则化几何建模。这样,几何学习过程由噪声(一阶)几何先验的二阶相关性调节,从而消除因泛化能力差导致的偏差。此外,我们引入了一种简单而有效的方案,利用语义和几何特征识别相关点,相应增强其互信息。所提出的技术可作为基于SDF的神经表面表示的插件。实验结果验证了所提方法在提升主流方法表面重建质量方面的有效性。我们的代码已开源:https://github.com/Muliphein/InfoNorm.
abstract_en: 3D surface reconstruction from multi-view images is essential for scene understanding and interaction. However, complex indoor scenes pose challenges such as ambiguity due to limited observations. Recent implicit surface representations, such as Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) and signed distance functions (SDFs), employ various geometric priors to resolve the lack of observed information. Nevertheless, their performance heavily depends on the quality of the pre-trained geometry estimation models. To ease such dependence, we propose regularizing the geometric modeling by explicitly encouraging the mutual information among surface normals of highly correlated scene points. In this way, the geometry learning process is modulated by the second-order correlations from noisy (first-order) geometric priors, thus eliminating the bias due to poor generalization. Additionally, we introduce a simple yet effective scheme that utilizes semantic and geometric features to identify correlated points, enhancing their mutual information accordingly. The proposed technique can serve as a plugin for SDF-based neural surface representations. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed in improving the surface reconstruction quality of major states of the arts. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Muliphein/InfoNorm.

title: Yu Xumin, Wang Yanbo, Zhou Jie, Lu Jiwen*
title_en: Xumin Yu, Yanbo Wang, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu*
abstract: 点云补全旨在重建由各种传感器捕获的不完整点云的几何结构。传统上,训练点云模型是在合成数据集上进行的,这些数据集类别有限且与真实世界场景差异显著。这种差异通常导致现有方法在真实世界场景中难以处理不熟悉的类别和严重的不完整性。在本文中,我们提出了一种名为PrototypeCompletion的新颖基于原型的方法用于点云补全。该方法首先生成粗略的原型,随后通过添加额外的几何细节进行增强以进行最终预测。仅使用几百对不完整-完整点云数据,我们的方法在真实世界场景中有效处理了来自不同场景的点云,包括室内ScanNet和室外KITTI。此外,我们提出了一种基于ScanNet200和KITTI的新指标和测试基准,以评估模型在真实世界场景中的性能,旨在促进未来的研究。实验结果表明,我们的方法在现有的PCN基准上优于最先进的方法,并在具有不同物体类别和传感器的各种真实世界场景中表现出色。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/Yanbo-23/Proto-Comp获取。
abstract_en: Point cloud completion aims to reconstruct the geometry of partial point clouds captured by various sensors. Traditionally, training a point cloud model is carried out on synthetic datasets, which have limited categories and deviate significantly from real-world scenarios. This disparity often leads existing methods to struggle with unfamiliar categories and severe incompleteness in real-world situations. In this paper, we propose PrototypeCompletion, a novel prototype-based approach for point cloud completion. It begins by generating rough prototypes and subsequently augments them with additional geometry details for the final prediction. With just a few hundred pairs of partial-complete point cloud data, our approach effectively handles the point clouds from diverse scenarios in real-world situations, including indoor ScanNet and outdoor KITTI. Additionally, we propose a new metric and test benchmark based on ScanNet200 and KITTI to evaluate the model’s performance in real-world scenarios, aiming to promote future research. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods on existing PCN benchmark and excels in various real-world situations with different object categories and sensors. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Yanbo-23/Proto-Comp.

title: Xunjiang Gu, Guanyu Song, Igor Gilitschenski, Marco Pavone, Boris Ivanovic*
title_en: Xunjiang Gu, Guanyu Song, Igor Gilitschenski, Marco Pavone, Boris Ivanovic*
abstract: 理解道路几何结构是自动驾驶系统堆栈的关键组成部分。虽然高精度地图(HD地图)可以轻松提供此类信息,但其存在高昂的标注和维护成本。因此,许多近期研究提出了从传感器数据在线估计HD地图的方法。大多数近期方法将多摄像头观测数据编码为中间表示(例如鸟瞰图网格),并通过解码器生成向量地图元素。尽管这种架构性能良好,但会大量丢失中间表示中编码的信息,阻碍下游任务(如行为预测)利用这些信息。在本工作中,我们提出暴露在线地图估计方法的丰富内部特征,并展示这些特征如何使在线映射与轨迹预测更紧密地集成。通过这样做,我们发现直接访问内部鸟瞰图特征可使推理速度在nuScenes真实数据集上提升高达73%,预测准确率提高高达29%。1 代码:https://github.com/alfredgu001324/MapBEVPrediction
abstract_en: Understanding road geometry is a critical component of the autonomous vehicle (AV) stack. While high-definition (HD) maps can readily provide such information, they suffer from high labeling and maintenance costs. Accordingly, many recent works have proposed methods for estimating HD maps online from sensor data. The vast majority of recent approaches encode multi-camera observations into an intermediate representation, e.g., a bird’s eye view (BEV) grid, and produce vector map elements via a decoder. While this architecture is performant, it decimates much of the information encoded in the intermediate representation, preventing downstream tasks (e.g., behavior prediction) from leveraging them. In this work, we propose exposing the rich internal features of online map estimation methods and show how they enable more tightly integrating online mapping with trajectory forecasting1 . In doing so, we find that directly accessing internal BEV features yields up to 73% faster inference speeds and up to 29% more accurate predictions on the real-world nuScenes dataset. 1 Code: https://github.com/alfredgu001324/MapBEVPrediction

title: YAO YAO, Yixuan Pan, Wenjun Shi, Dongchen Zhu, Lei Wang, Jiamao Li*
title_en: YAO YAO, Yixuan Pan, Wenjun Shi, Dongchen Zhu, Lei Wang, Jiamao Li*
abstract: 重投影一致性广泛应用于自监督三维人体姿态估计。然而,针对重投影一致性的固有局限性,目前的研究仍较为有限。由于缺乏相机参数和绝对位置,自监督方法通过正交投影将三维姿态映射到二维空间,而二维输入则来源于透视投影。这种投影模型之间的差异导致了监督空间与预测空间之间存在偏移,限制了性能潜力。为解决这一问题,我们提出旋转正交投影,在正交投影前添加旋转操作以实现对透视投影的几何近似。进一步地,我们根据人体结构优化参考点选择,提出分组旋转正交投影,显著缩小了两种投影模型之间的差距。同时,重投影一致性损失未能约束三维空间中Z轴反向错误姿态。因此,我们引入联合反向约束,限制局部参考平面与末端关节之间的角度范围,惩罚不合理的三维姿态,并明确模型的Z轴方向。所提方法在Human3.6M和MPII-INF-3DHP数据集上均达到最先进的性能。特别是在Human3.6M数据集上,相较于最先进的自监督方法,将平均误差从65.9毫米降至42.9毫米(提升34.9%)。
abstract_en: Reprojection consistency is widely used for self-supervised 3D human pose estimation. However, few efforts have been made to address the inherent limitations of reprojection consistency. Lacking camera parameters and absolute position, self-supervised methods map 3D poses to 2D using orthographic projection, whereas 2D inputs are derived from perspective projection. This discrepancy among the projection models creates an offset between the supervision and prediction spaces, limiting the performance potential. To address this problem, we propose rotated orthographic projection, which achieves a geometric approximation of the perspective projection by adding a rotation operation before the orthographic projection. Further, we optimize the reference point selection according to the human body structure and propose group rotated orthographic projection, which significantly narrows the gap between the two projection models. Meanwhile, the reprojection consistency loss fails to constrain the Z-axis reverse wrong pose in 3D space. Therefore, we introduce the joint reverse constraint to limit the range of angles between the local reference plane and the end joints, penalizing unrealistic 3D poses and clarifying the Z-axis orientation of the model. The proposed method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on both Human3.6M and MPII-INF-3DHP datasets. Particularly, it reduces the mean error from 65.9mm to 42.9mm (34.9% improvement) over the SOTA self-supervised method on Human3.6M.

title: YI HUANG*、Jeremy Styborski*、Mingzhi Lyu*、Fan Wang*、Wai-Kin Adams Kong*
title_en: YI HUANG*, Jeremy Styborski*, Mingzhi Lyu*, Fan Wang*, Wai-Kin Adams Kong*
abstract: 在线数据的丰富性面临深度学习模型未经授权使用的风险。为应对这一问题,已设计出多种数据可用性攻击(DAAs),通过微妙扰动训练数据使数据对模型不可学习。然而,现有攻击方法往往在监督学习(SL)或自监督学习(SSL)场景中表现突出。其中,一种无需模型的基于卷积的不可学习数据集(CUDA)方法在SSL和SL中展现出最强的攻击效果。不过,CUDA在SSL中的效果欠佳,并面临图像质量与中毒效果之间的严重权衡。本文对CUDA进行理论分析,揭示其引入的次优梯度,并阐明其通过诱导类别偏倚实现数据中毒的策略。在此基础上,我们提出了一种新型中毒方法——不完全恢复中毒(IRP),旨在保持高质量图像的同时实现强中毒效果。通过与八种基线方法在SL和SSL中的广泛对比,以及与五种代表性防御方法的评估,我们展示了IRP的优越性。代码:https://github.com/lyumingzhi/IRP
abstract_en: The abundance of online data is at risk of unauthorized usage in training deep learning models. To counter this, various Data Availability Attacks (DAAs) have been devised to make data unlearnable for such models by subtly perturbing the training data. However, existing attacks often excel against either Supervised Learning (SL) or Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) scenarios. Among these, a model-free approach that generates a Convolution-based Unlearnable Dataset (CUDA) stands out as the most robust DAA across both SSL and SL. Nonetheless, CUDA’s effectiveness against SSL is underwhelming and it faces a severe trade-off between image quality and its poisoning effect. In this paper, we conduct a theoretical analysis of CUDA, uncovering the sub-optimal gradients it introduces and elucidating the strategy it employs to induce class-wise bias for data poisoning. Building on this, we propose a novel poisoning method named Imperfect Restoration Poisoning (IRP), aiming to preserve high image quality while achieving strong poisoning effects. Through extensive comparisons of IRP with eight baselines across SL and SSL, coupled with evaluations alongside five representative defense methods, we showcase the superiority of IRP. Code: https://github.com/ lyumingzhi/IRP

title: YIBO LIU*, Zheyuan Yang, Guile Wu, Yuan Ren, Kejian Lin, Liu Bingbing, Yang Liu, JINJUN SHAN
title_en: YIBO LIU*, Zheyuan Yang, Guile Wu, Yuan Ren, Kejian Lin, Liu Bingbing, Yang Liu, JINJUN SHAN
abstract: 从真实环境观测中生成3D车辆资产对自动驾驶至关重要。现有图像到3D方法无法有效解决此问题,因为它们仅从图像RGB信息学习生成,缺乏对真实环境中车辆(如车型、制造商等)的深入理解。这导致其在处理存在遮挡或复杂视角的真实观测时零样本预测能力较差。为解决此问题,本文提出VQA-Diff框架,利用真实环境车辆图像生成逼真3D车辆资产。VQA-Diff通过视觉问答(VQA)模型继承的现实知识实现鲁棒零样本预测,并借助扩散模型丰富的图像先验知识生成结构与外观。具体而言,我们采用多专家扩散模型策略生成结构信息,并通过主题驱动的结构控制生成机制建模外观信息。因此,无需依赖大规模真实世界图像到3D车辆数据集,VQA-Diff仍具备强大的零样本图像到新视角生成能力。我们在Pascal 3D+、Waymo和Objaverse等数据集上进行实验,结果表明VQA-Diff在定性和定量指标上均优于现有最先进方法。
abstract_en: Generating 3D vehicle assets from in-the-wild observations is crucial to autonomous driving. Existing image-to-3D methods cannot well address this problem because they learn generation merely from image RGB information without a deeper understanding of in-the-wild vehicles (such as car models, manufacturers, ). This leads to their poor zero-shot prediction capability to handle real-world observations with occlusion or tricky viewing angles. To solve this problem, in this work, we propose VQA-Diff, a novel framework that leverages in-the-wild vehicle images to create photorealistic 3D vehicle assets for autonomous driving. VQA-Diff exploits the real-world knowledge inherited from the Large Language Model in the Visual Question Answering (VQA) model for robust zero-shot prediction and the rich image prior knowledge in the Diffusion model for structure and appearance generation. In particular, we utilize a multi-expert Diffusion Models strategy to generate the structure information and employ a subject-driven structure-controlled generation mechanism to model appearance information. As a result, without the necessity to learn from a large-scale image-to-3D vehicle dataset collected from the real world, VQA-Diff still has a robust zero-shot image-to-novel-view generation ability. We conduct experiments on various datasets, including Pascal 3D+, Waymo, and Objaverse, to demonstrate that VQA-Diff outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods both qualitatively and quantitatively.

title: Yabin Zhang*, Wenjie Zhu, Chenhang He, Lei Zhang*
title_en: Yabin Zhang*, Wenjie Zhu, Chenhang He, Lei Zhang*
abstract: 分布外(OOD)检测对于模型可靠性至关重要,因为它能够识别未知类别的样本并减少由于意外输入导致的错误。视觉-语言模型(VLMs)如CLIP正逐渐成为通过整合多模态信息进行OOD检测的强大工具。然而,这类系统的实际应用受到人工提示工程的挑战,这需要领域专业知识且对语言细微差别敏感。本文提出了一种基于标签的自动提示调优(LAPT)方法,这是一种新型的OOD检测方法,可减少对人工提示工程的依赖。我们开发了具有分布感知的提示,结合分布内(ID)类别名称和自动挖掘的负标签。通过图像合成和检索方法自主收集与这些类别标签相关的训练样本,从而实现无需人工干预的提示学习。我们采用简单的交叉熵损失进行提示优化,并通过跨模态和跨分布混合策略分别减少图像噪声并探索分布间的中间空间。LAPT框架可自主运行,仅需分布内类别名称作为输入,无需人工干预。通过大量实验,LAPT在性能上持续优于人工设计的提示,为OOD检测树立了新标准。此外,LAPT不仅增强了分布内与分布外样本的区分能力,还提高了分布内分类准确率并增强了对协变量偏移的泛化鲁棒性,在具有挑战性的全频谱OOD检测任务中表现出色。代码已开源至https://github.com/YBZh/LAPT。
abstract_en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is crucial for model reliability, as it identifies samples from unknown classes and reduces errors due to unexpected inputs. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP are emerging as powerful tools for OOD detection by integrating multi-modal information. However, the practical application of such systems is challenged by manual prompt engineering, which demands domain expertise and is sensitive to linguistic nuances. In this paper, we introduce Label-driven Automated Prompt Tuning (LAPT), a novel approach to OOD detection that reduces the need for manual prompt engineering. We develop distribution-aware prompts with in-distribution (ID) class names and negative labels mined automatically. Training samples linked to these class labels are collected autonomously via image synthesis and retrieval methods, allowing for prompt learning without manual effort. We utilize a simple cross-entropy loss for prompt optimization, with cross-modal and cross-distribution mixing strategies to reduce image noise and explore the intermediate space between distributions, respectively. The LAPT framework operates autonomously, requiring only ID class names as input and eliminating the need for manual intervention. With extensive experiments, LAPT consistently outperforms manually crafted prompts, setting a new standard for OOD detection. Moreover, LAPT not only enhances the distinction between ID and OOD samples, but also improves the ID classification accuracy and strengthens the generalization robustness to covariate shifts, resulting in outstanding performance in challenging full-spectrum OOD detection tasks. Codes are available at https://github.com/YBZh/LAPT.

title: Yabo Chen, Jiemin Fang, Yuyang Huang, Taoran Yi, Xiaopeng Zhang*, Lingxi Xie, Xinggang Wang, Wenrui Dai*, Hongkai Xiong, Qi Tian
title_en: Yabo Chen, Jiemin Fang, Yuyang Huang, Taoran Yi, Xiaopeng Zhang*, Lingxi Xie, Xinggang Wang, Wenrui Dai*, Hongkai Xiong, Qi Tian
abstract: 从单张图像合成多视角3D是一项具有挑战性的任务。Zero-1-to-3方法通过将2D潜在扩散模型提升到3D领域取得了显著成功。目标视角图像以单视角源图像和相机姿态作为条件信息生成。然而,由于单输入图像的高稀疏性,Zero-1-to-3在不同视角间容易产生几何和外观不一致,尤其是对复杂物体。为解决这一问题,我们提出以自提示方式为生成模型提供更多信息条件。构建了一个级联框架,包含两个Zero-1-to-3模型,__TITLE_MATH_1__,逐步从源图像中提取3D信息。具体而言,首先通过第一模型生成多个邻近视角,然后将这些视角与源图像作为生成条件输入第二阶段模型。借助增强的自提示条件图像,我们的方法生成的新型视角图像比Zero-1-to-3更一致。实验结果表明,尤其在昆虫、人类、透明物体和堆叠多物体等复杂和具有挑战性的场景中表现显著提升。更多演示和代码请访问 https: //cascadezero123.github.io。
abstract_en: Synthesizing multi-view 3D from one single image is a significant but challenging task. Zero-1-to-3 methods have achieved great success by lifting a 2D latent diffusion model to the 3D scope. The target-view image is generated with a single-view source image and the camera pose as condition information. However, due to the high sparsity of the single input image, Zero-1-to-3 tends to produce geometry and appearance inconsistency across views, especially for complex objects. To tackle this issue, we propose to supply more condition information for the generation model but in a self-prompt way. A cascade framework is constructed with two Zero-1-to-3 models, named , which progressively extract 3D information from the source image. Specifically, several nearby views are first generated by the first model and then fed into the second-stage model along with the source image as generation conditions. With amplified self-prompted condition images, our generates more consistent novel-view images than Zero-1-to-3. Experiment results demonstrate remarkable promotion, especially for various complex and challenging scenes, involving insects, humans, transparent objects, and stacked multiple objects . More demos and code are available at https: //cascadezero123.github.io.

title: Yabo Xiao, Mingshu HE*, Dongdong Yu
title_en: Yabo Xiao, Mingshu HE*, Dongdong Yu
abstract: 现有的人体网格恢复(HMR)方法通常依赖全局或基于密集标注的局部特征,从输入图像生成单一预测。然而,压缩的全局和局部特征破坏了人体的空间几何结构,难以捕捉局部动态,导致视觉网格错位。此外,密集标注需要大量人力和成本。针对上述问题,我们提出了一种自上而下的全局到局部预测框架,以保留空间信息并实现精确的视觉网格对齐。具体而言,我们提出了一种自适应的2D关键点引导局部编码模块,使每个像素特征能够捕捉细粒度的身体部位信息,并保持结构和局部上下文。局部特征的获取仅依赖稀疏的2D关键点引导,无需密集标注或基于启发式关键点的ROI(感兴趣区域)池化。增强的像素特征用于预测残差,以校正由全局特征产生的初始估计。其次,我们引入了一种动态匹配策略,仅通过计算分类和2D关键点成本来确定正/负像素,进一步提升视觉网格对齐效果。综合实验验证了网络设计的有效性。我们的框架在Human3.6M和3DPW数据集上显著优于先前的局部回归方法,并取得了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Existing human mesh recovery (HMR) methods commonly leverage the global or dense-annotations-based local features to produce a single prediction from the input image. However, the compressed global and local features disrupt the spatial geometry of the human body and make it hard to capture the local dynamics, resulting in visual-mesh misalignment. Moreover, dense annotations are labor-intensive and expensive. Toward the above issues, we propose a global-to-local prediction framework to preserve spatial information and obtain precise visual-mesh alignments for top-down HMR. Specifically, we present an adaptive 2D Keypoint-Guided Local Encoding Module to enable per-pixel features to capture fine-grained body part information with structure and local context maintained. The acquisition of local features relies exclusively on sparse 2D keypoint guidance without dense annotations or heuristics keypoint-based ROI (Region of Interested) pooling. The enhanced pixel features are used to predict residuals for rectifying the initial estimation produced by global features. Secondly, we introduce a Dynamic Matching Strategy that determines positive/negative pixels by only calculating the classification and 2D keypoint costs to further improve visual-mesh alignments. The comprehensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of network design. Our framework outperforms previous local regression methods by a large margin and achieves state-of-the-art performance on Human3.6M and 3DPW datasets.

title: Yake Wei, Siwei Li, Ruoxuan Feng, Di Hu*
title_en: Yake Wei, Siwei Li, Ruoxuan Feng, Di Hu*
abstract: 为了解决多模态学习中模型偏向特定模态训练的不平衡问题,现有方法从不同角度控制单模态编码器的训练,以跨模态性能差异为基础。然而,忽视了模态容量的内在限制。信息量稀缺的模态可能被识别为“学习较差”的模态,这会迫使模型记忆更多噪声,反向影响多模态模型能力。此外,当前模态调制方法仅聚焦于选定的“学习较差”模态,甚至抑制其他模态的训练。因此,在平衡过程中需考虑模态容量的内在限制,并综合考虑所有模态。为此,我们提出诊断与重学习方法。首先基于单模态表征空间的可分性估计各模态的学习状态,然后用于软重初始化对应的单模态编码器。这样可避免对信息量稀缺模态的过度强调。同时增强“学习较差”模态的编码器,同时避免对其他模态的过度训练。因此,多模态学习得到有效的平衡与增强。涵盖多种模态类型和多模态框架的实验验证了我们简单而有效的平衡多模态学习方法的优越性能。源代码和数据集可在https://github.com/GeWu-Lab/Diagnosing_Relearning_ECCV2024获取。
abstract_en: To overcome the imbalanced multimodal learning problem, where models prefer the training of specific modalities, existing methods propose to control the training of uni-modal encoders from different perspectives, taking the inter-modal performance discrepancy as the basis. However, the intrinsic limitation of modality capacity is ignored. The scarcely informative modalities can be recognized as “worse-learnt” ones, which could force the model to memorize more noise, counterproductively affecting the multimodal model ability. Moreover, the current modality modulation methods narrowly concentrate on selected worse-learnt modalities, even suppressing the training of others. Hence, it is essential to consider the intrinsic limitation of modality capacity and take all modalities into account during balancing. To this end, we propose the Diagnosing & Re-learning method. The learning state of each modality is firstly estimated based on the separability of its uni-modal representation space, and then used to softly re-initialize the corresponding uni-modal encoder. In this way, the over-emphasizing of scarcely informative modalities is avoided. In addition, encoders of worse-learnt modalities are enhanced, simultaneously avoiding the over-training of other modalities. Accordingly, multimodal learning is effectively balanced and enhanced. Experiments covering multiple types of modalities and multimodal frameworks demonstrate the superior performance of our simple-yet-effective method for balanced multimodal learning. The source code and dataset are available at https://github.com/GeWu-Lab/Diagnosing_Relearning_ECCV2024.

title: Yan Hao, Florent Forest*, Olga Fink
title_en: Yan Hao, Florent Forest*, Olga Fink
abstract: 本文聚焦于计算机视觉中无源域适应的目标检测任务。该任务具有挑战性且具有重要实践价值,由于为每个新域获取标注数据集的成本较高。近期研究提出了多种无源目标检测(SFOD)解决方案,大多数方法基于教师-学生架构,采用多样化的特征对齐、正则化和伪标签选择策略。我们的工作探讨了更简单的方法及其在多种适应场景下的性能,与更复杂的SFOD方法进行比较。我们强调检测器主干网络中批量归一化层的重要性,并证明仅适应批量统计信息即可作为SFOD的强基线。我们提出了一种在无源设置下的简单扩展方法——无偏教师(SF-UT),该方法通过强弱增强策略实现,实验证明其性能优于大多数现有SFOD方法。此外,我们展示了通过固定伪标签集进行训练的更简单策略,其性能可与复杂的师生互学方法相媲美,同时计算效率更高且缓解了师生坍缩的主要问题。我们在多个适应任务上进行了实验,使用包括(雾气)Cityscapes、Sim10k和KITTI在内的基准驾驶数据集,相比最新的SFOD方法,在Cityscapes→Foggy-Cityscapes任务中AP50指标提升了4.7%。源代码可在https://github.com/EPFL-IMOS/simple-SFOD获取。
abstract_en: This paper focuses on source-free domain adaptation for object detection in computer vision. This task is challenging and of great practical interest, due to the cost of obtaining annotated data sets for every new domain. Recent research has proposed various solutions for Source-Free Object Detection (SFOD), most being variations of teacher-student architectures with diverse feature alignment, regularization and pseudo-label selection strategies. Our work investigates simpler approaches and their performance compared to more complex SFOD methods in several adaptation scenarios. We highlight the importance of batch normalization layers in the detector backbone, and show that adapting only the batch statistics is a strong baseline for SFOD. We propose a simple extension of a Mean Teacher with strong-weak augmentation in the source-free setting, Source-Free Unbiased Teacher (SF-UT), and show that it actually outperforms most of the previous SFOD methods. Additionally, we showcase that an even simpler strategy consisting in training on a fixed set of pseudo-labels can achieve similar performance to the more complex teacher-student mutual learning, while being computationally efficient and mitigating the major issue of teacher-student collapse. We conduct experiments on several adaptation tasks using benchmark driving datasets including (Foggy)Cityscapes, Sim10k and KITTI, and achieve a notable improvement of 4.7% AP50 on Cityscapes→Foggy-Cityscapes compared with the latest state-of-the-art in SFOD. Source code is available at https://github.com/EPFL-IMOS/simple-SFOD.

title: Yan Hong*, Yuxuan Duan, Bo Zhang, Haoxing Chen, Jun Lan, Huijia Zhu, Weiqiang Wang, Jianfu Zhang*
title_en: Yan Hong*, Yuxuan Duan, Bo Zhang, Haoxing Chen, Jun Lan, Huijia Zhu, Weiqiang Wang, Jianfu Zhang*
abstract: 近期在个性化文本到图像(T2I)扩散模型领域的进展表明,这些模型能够仅通过少量用户提供的示例,基于个性化视觉概念生成图像。然而,这些模型在根据文本描述修改场景时往往难以保持高视觉保真度。为解决这一挑战,我们引入了ComFusion,这是一种创新方法,利用预训练模型创建用户提供的主体图像与预定义文本场景的组合。ComFusion结合了类别-场景先验保持正则化,通过整合预训练模型中的主体类别和场景特定知识来提升生成保真度。此外,ComFusion使用粗生成图像确保与实例图像和场景文本的一致性,从而在捕捉主体本质与保持场景保真度之间实现微妙平衡。对ComFusion在T2I个性化领域与多种基线模型的广泛评估表明,其在定性和定量指标上均表现出优越性。
abstract_en: Recent progress in personalizing text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models has demonstrated their capability to generate images based on personalized visual concepts using only a few user-provided examples. However, these models often struggle with maintaining high visual fidelity, particularly when modifying scenes according to textual descriptions. To address this challenge, we introduce ComFusion, an innovative approach that leverages pretrained models to create compositions of user-supplied subject images and predefined text scenes. ComFusion incorporates a class-scene prior preservation regularization, which combines subject class and scene-specific knowledge from pretrained models to enhance generation fidelity. Additionally, ComFusion uses coarse-generated images to ensure alignment with both the instance images and scene texts, thereby achieving a delicate balance between capturing the subject’s essence and maintaining scene fidelity. Extensive evaluations of ComFusion against various baselines in T2I personalization have demonstrated its qualitative and quantitative superiority.

title: 严江,徐成*,郝宇,邢宇,郝宇,赵国英
title_en: Yan Jiang, Xu Cheng*, Hao Yu, Xingyu Liu, Haoyu Chen, Guoying Zhao
abstract: 跨模态行人重识别(ReID)是一项具有挑战性的任务,旨在跨多个摄像头视角匹配跨模态的行人图像。现有方法多针对特定任务进行优化,在可见光-红外或可见光-素描ReID中表现良好。然而,当相同方法用于多种跨模态ReID任务时,性能会出现显著下降,限制了其泛化能力和适用性。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种通用的域迁移方法(DNS)用于跨模态ReID,该方法能够实现良好的泛化性能,在可见光-红外和可见光-素描模态中均表现优异。具体而言,我们设计了异构空间迁移和公共空间迁移模块,分别用于增强异构空间和公共空间中的特定表示和共享表示,从而引导模型学习模态间的一致性。进一步地,我们开发了域对齐损失函数,通过对齐不同模态间的模式来缓解跨模态差异。此外,设计了域蒸馏损失函数,通过学习不同模态的分布来蒸馏身份不变的知识。在两个跨模态ReID任务(可见光-红外ReID、可见光-素描ReID)上的大量实验表明,所提方法显著优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Cross-modality person re-identification (ReID) is a challenging task that aims to match cross-modality pedestrian images across multiple camera views. Existing methods are tailored to specific tasks and perform well for visible-infrared or visible-sketch ReID. However, the performance exhibits a notable decline when the same method is utilized for multiple cross-modality ReIDs, limiting its generalization and applicability. To address this issue, we propose a generalized domain shifting method (DNS) for cross-modality ReID, which can address the generalization and perform well in both visible-infrared and visible-sketch modalities. Specifically, we propose the heterogeneous space shifting and common space shifting modules to augment specific and shared representations in heterogeneous space and common space, respectively, thereby regulating the model to learn the consistency between modalities. Further, a domain alignment loss is developed to alleviate the cross-modality discrepancies by aligning the patterns across modalities. In addition, a domain distillation loss is designed to distill identity-invariant knowledge by learning the distribution of different modalities. Extensive experiments on two cross-modality ReID tasks (, visible-infrared ReID, visible-sketch ReID) demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by a large margin.

title: Yan Li, Weiwei Guo*, Xue Yang, Ning Liao, Dunyun He, Jiaqi Zhou, Wenxian Yu*
title_en: Yan Li, Weiwei Guo*, Xue Yang, Ning Liao, Dunyun He, Jiaqi Zhou, Wenxian Yu*
abstract: 随着遥感图像数量的激增,开发可扩展的目标检测器变得尤为重要,这类检测器能够在不耗费成本收集新标注数据的情况下检测训练类别之外的对象。本文旨在开发一种适用于航拍图像的开放词汇目标检测(OVD)技术,以扩展超出训练数据的对象词汇量。OVD的性能高度依赖于无类别感知的区域提议和新颖对象类别的伪标签质量。为同时生成高质量的提议和伪标签,我们提出CastDet,一种基于CLIP激活的师生结构开放词汇目标检测框架。我们的端到端框架遵循师生自学习机制,采用RemoteCLIP模型作为额外的全知教师,具备丰富的知识。通过这种方式,我们的方法不仅提升了新颖对象的提议质量,还增强了分类性能。此外,我们设计了一种动态标签队列策略,在批量训练过程中维持高质量的伪标签。我们在多个现有的航拍目标检测数据集上进行了大量实验,这些数据集专门用于OVD任务。实验结果表明,CastDet在VisDroneZSD新颖类别上达到了46.5%的mAP,超越了现有最先进的开放词汇检测器21.0%的mAP。据我们所知,这是首个将开放词汇目标检测技术应用于航拍图像的工作。代码已开源,地址为https://github.com/lizzy8587/CastDet。
abstract_en: An increasingly massive number of remote-sensing images spurs the development of extensible object detectors that can detect objects beyond training categories without costly collecting new labeled data. In this paper, we aim to develop open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) technique in aerial images that scales up object vocabulary size beyond training data. The performance of OVD greatly relies on the quality of class-agnostic region proposals and pseudo-labels for novel object categories. To simultaneously generate high-quality proposals and pseudo-labels, we propose CastDet, a CLIP-activated student-teacher open-vocabulary object Detection framework. Our end-to-end framework following the student-teacher self-learning mechanism employs the RemoteCLIP model as an extra omniscient teacher with rich knowledge. By doing so, our approach boosts not only novel object proposals but also classification. Furthermore, we devise a dynamic label queue strategy to maintain high-quality pseudo labels during batch training. We conduct extensive experiments on multiple existing aerial object detection datasets, which are set up for the OVD task. Experimental results demonstrate our CastDet achieving superior open-vocabulary detection performance, e.g., reaching 46.5% mAP on VisDroneZSD novel categories, which outperforms the state-of-the-art open-vocabulary detectors by 21.0% mAP. To our best knowledge, this is the first work to apply and develop the open-vocabulary object detection technique for aerial images. The code is available at https://github.com/lizzy8587/CastDet.

title: Yan Ren*, Yanling Li, Adams Wai-Kin Kong
title_en: Yan Ren*, Yanling Li, Adams Wai-Kin Kong
abstract: 大多数少样本目标检测方法使用共享特征图进行分类和定位,尽管这两个任务存在相互冲突的要求。定位需要尺度和位置敏感的特征,而分类需要对尺度和位置变化具有鲁棒性的特征。尽管已有少数方法认识到这一挑战并尝试解决,但它们可能未能提供对该问题的全面解决方案。为了解决少样本目标检测中分类和定位之间的矛盾偏好,提出了一种自适应多任务学习方法,该方法具有新颖的精度驱动梯度平衡器。该平衡器通过动态调整两个任务的反向梯度比例,有效缓解了冲突。此外,引入了一种基于CLIP的知识蒸馏和分类优化方案,旨在通过利用大型视觉-语言模型的能力来增强各个任务。所提出方法的实验结果在基准数据集上一致优于强大的少样本检测基线。https://github.com/RY-Paper/MTL-FSOD
abstract_en: The majority of few-shot object detection methods use a shared feature map for both classification and localization, despite the conflicting requirements of these two tasks. Localization needs scale and positional sensitive features, whereas classification requires features that are robust to scale and positional variations. Although few methods have recognized this challenge and attempted to address it, they may not provide a comprehensive resolution to the issue. To overcome the contradictory preferences between classification and localization in few-shot object detection, an adaptive multi-task learning method, featuring a novel precision-driven gradient balancer, is proposed. This balancer effectively mitigates the conflicts by dynamically adjusting the backward gradient ratios for both tasks. Furthermore, a knowledge distillation and classification refinement scheme based on CLIP is introduced, aiming to enhance individual tasks by leveraging the capabilities of large vision-language models. Experimental results of the proposed method consistently show improvements over strong few-shot detection baselines on benchmark datasets. https://github.com/RY-Paper/MTL-FSOD

title: Yan Yang, Liyuan Pan*, Liu liu
title_en: Yan Yang, Liyuan Pan*, Liu liu
abstract: 本文介绍了一种自监督学习框架,旨在利用事件相机数据对神经网络进行预训练,以适应密集预测任务。我们的方法仅使用事件数据进行训练。将密集RGB预训练的成果直接迁移到事件相机数据上会导致性能不佳,这是由于事件图像(由事件数据转换而来)固有的空间稀疏性,其中许多像素不包含信息。为缓解这一稀疏性问题,我们将事件图像编码为事件块特征,自动挖掘块间的上下文相似性关系,将块特征分组为独特的上下文,并强制上下文间的相似性以学习判别性事件特征。为了训练我们的框架,我们构建了一个包含多样场景和运动模式的合成事件相机数据集。在下游密集预测任务上的迁移学习性能表明,我们的方法优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: This paper introduces a self-supervised learning framework designed for pre-training neural networks tailored to dense prediction tasks using event camera data. Our approach utilizes solely event data for training. Transferring achievements from dense RGB pre-training directly to event camera data yields subpar performance. This is attributed to the spatial sparsity inherent in an event image (converted from event data), where many pixels do not contain information. To mitigate this sparsity issue, we encode an event image into event patch features, automatically mine contextual similarity relationships among patches, group the patch features into distinctive contexts, and enforce context-to-context similarities to learn discriminative event features. For training our framework, we curate a synthetic event camera dataset featuring diverse scene and motion patterns. Transfer learning performance on downstream dense prediction tasks illustrates the superiority of our method over state-of-the-art approaches.

title: Yan-Bo Lin*, Gedas Bertasius
title_en: Yan-Bo Lin*, Gedas Bertasius
abstract: 传统的音频-视觉方法依赖于独立的音频和视觉主干网络,这成本高昂且难以扩展。在本工作中,我们研究使用音频-视觉孪生网络()进行高效且可扩展的音频-视觉预训练。我们的框架使用单一共享的视觉Transformer主干网络处理音频和视觉输入,提高了参数效率,减少了GPU内存占用,并使我们能够将方法扩展到更大的数据集和模型规模。我们使用带有多种比例随机掩码方案的对比音频-视觉匹配目标对模型进行预训练,这使模型能够处理更大的音频-视觉实例批次,有助于对比学习。与以往的音频-视觉方法不同,我们的方法可以使用单一共享的ViT主干网络稳健地处理音频、视觉和音频-视觉输入。此外,尽管对两种模态都使用了共享主干网络,该方法在AudioSet和VGGSound数据集上的音频-视觉分类和检索任务中仍能取得与以往方法相当甚至更好的结果。我们的代码可在https://github.com/GenjiB/AVSiam获取。
abstract_en: Traditional audio-visual methods rely on independent audio and visual backbones, which is costly and not scalable. In this work, we investigate using an audio-visual siamese network () for efficient and scalable audio-visual pretraining. Our framework uses a single shared vision transformer backbone to process audio and visual inputs, improving its parameter efficiency, reducing the GPU memory footprint, and allowing us to scale our method to larger datasets and model sizes. We pretrain our model using a contrastive audio-visual matching objective with a multi-ratio random masking scheme, which enables our model to process larger audio-visual instance batches, helpful for contrastive learning. Unlike prior audio-visual methods, our method can robustly handle audio, visual, and audio-visual inputs with a single shared ViT backbone. Furthermore, despite using the shared backbone for both modalities, achieves competitive or even better results than prior methods on AudioSet and VGGSound for audio-visual classification and retrieval. Our code is available at https://github.com/ GenjiB/AVSiam

title: Yanan Sun*, Yanchen Liu, Yinhao Tang, Wenjie Pei, Kai Chen
title_en: Yanan Sun*, Yanchen Liu, Yinhao Tang, Wenjie Pei, Kai Chen
abstract: 文本到图像(T2I)生成领域近年来取得了显著进展,这在很大程度上得益于扩散模型的发展。语言控制能够有效实现内容创作,但在图像生成的细粒度控制方面仍存在困难。这一挑战主要通过将用户提供的额外空间条件(如深度图和边缘图)通过额外编码整合到预训练的T2I模型中来探索。然而,多控制图像合成仍面临若干挑战。具体而言,现有方法在处理多样输入控制信号的自由组合时存在局限,忽视了多种空间条件之间的复杂关系,并且常常无法与提供的文本提示保持语义对齐。这可能导致用户体验不佳。为解决这些问题,我们提出__TITLE_MATH_1__,一个支持任意组合多样控制信号的多控制图像合成框架。__TITLE_MATH_1__开发了一种新颖的多控制编码器,提取统一的多模态嵌入以指导生成过程。该方法能够全面理解用户输入,并在多种控制信号下生成高质量、忠实的结果,如大量定量和定性评估所示。我们的项目页面可在https://any-control.github.io访问。
abstract_en: The field of text-to-image (T2I) generation has made significant progress in recent years, largely driven by advancements in diffusion models. Linguistic control enables effective content creation, but struggles with fine-grained control over image generation. This challenge has been explored, to a great extent, by incorporating additional user-supplied spatial conditions, such as depth maps and edge maps, into pre-trained T2I models through extra encoding. However, multi-control image synthesis still faces several challenges. Specifically, current approaches are limited in handling free combinations of diverse input control signals, overlook the complex relationships among multiple spatial conditions, and often fail to maintain semantic alignment with provided textual prompts. This can lead to suboptimal user experiences. To address these challenges, we propose , a multi-control image synthesis framework that supports arbitrary combinations of diverse control signals. develops a novel Multi-Control Encoder that extracts a unified multi-modal embedding to guide the generation process. This approach enables a holistic understanding of user inputs, and produces high-quality, faithful results under versatile control signals, as demonstrated by extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations. Our project page is available in https://any-control.github.io.

title: 刘燕斌*, 史蒂芬·高尔德
title_en: Yanbin Liu*, Stephen Gould
abstract: 随着自监督视觉变换器(ViT)展现出的注意力特性,归一化割(NCut)重新成为一种强大的无监督密集预测工具。然而,现有方法中预训练的ViT主干网络(如DINO)被冻结,导致特征提取器在密集预测任务中表现次优。本文提出使用可微归一化割进行自监督密集特征学习,以提升现有预训练模型的密集预测能力。首先,我们回顾了经典NCut算法的高效梯度公式。该公式仅利用前向传播中计算并存储的矩阵,使反向传播过程高度高效。其次,借助NCut梯度,我们设计了自监督密集特征学习架构以微调预训练模型。给定图像的两个随机增强裁剪,该架构通过RoIAlign和NCut生成重叠区域的两个前景掩码。最后,我们提出掩码一致性损失,以通过NCut和RoIAlign进行模型训练的反向传播。实验表明,我们的框架可推广至多种预训练方法(DINO、MoCo和MAE)、网络配置(ResNet、ViT-S和ViT-B)以及任务(无监督显著性检测、目标发现和语义分割)。此外,我们在无监督密集预测基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。
abstract_en: With the emergent attentive property of self-supervised Vision Transformer (ViT), Normalized Cuts (NCut) has resurfaced as a powerful tool for unsupervised dense prediction. However, the pre-trained ViT backbone (, DINO) is frozen in existing methods, which makes the feature extractor suboptimal for dense prediction tasks. In this paper, we propose using Differentiable Normalized Cuts for self-supervised dense feature learning that can improve the dense prediction capability of existing pre-trained models. First, we review an efficient gradient formulation for the classical NCut algorithm. This formulation only leverages matrices computed and stored in the forward pass, making the backward pass highly efficient. Second, with NCut gradients in hand, we design a self-supervised dense feature learning architecture to finetune pre-trained models. Given two random augmented crops of an image, the architecture performs RoIAlign and NCut to generate two foreground masks of their overlapping region. Last, we propose a mask-consistency loss to back-propagate through NCut and RoIAlign for model training. Experiments show that our framework generalizes to various pre-training methods (DINO, MoCo and MAE), network configurations (ResNet, ViT-S and ViT-B), and tasks (unsupervised saliency detection, object discovery and semantic segmentation). Moreover, we achieved state-of-the-art results on unsupervised dense prediction benchmarks.

title: Yanbo Wang*, Wentao Zhao, Cao Chuan, Tianchen Deng, Jingchuan Wang, Weidong Chen*
title_en: Yanbo Wang*, Wentao Zhao, Cao Chuan, Tianchen Deng, Jingchuan Wang, Weidong Chen*
abstract: 尽管激光雷达语义分割技术发展迅速,但最先进的方法通常结合了从机械旋转激光雷达基准数据集中衍生出的特定设计的归纳偏置。这可能会限制模型对其他类型激光雷达技术的泛化能力,并使超参数调优更加复杂。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了一种通用框架,通过用我们的稀疏焦点点调制替代窗口注意力机制,以适应市场上各种常见的激光雷达类型。我们的SFPNet能够提取多级上下文,并通过门控机制动态聚合这些上下文。通过实现通道级信息查询,融合局部与全局上下文的特征被编码。我们还引入了一个新型的大规模混合固态激光雷达语义分割数据集,用于机器人应用。SFPNet在传统机械旋转激光雷达基准数据集上表现出竞争力,同时在固态激光雷达基准数据集上实现了最先进的结果。此外,它在我们新数据集(源自混合固态激光雷达)上优于现有方法。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/Cavendish518/SFPNet和https://www.semanticindustry.top获取。
abstract_en: Although LiDAR semantic segmentation advances rapidly, state-of-the-art methods often incorporate specifically designed inductive bias derived from benchmarks originating from mechanical spinning LiDAR. This can limit model generalizability to other kinds of LiDAR technologies and make hyperparameter tuning more complex. To tackle these issues, we propose a generalized framework to accommodate various types of LiDAR prevalent in the market by replacing window-attention with our sparse focal point modulation. Our SFPNet is capable of extracting multi-level contexts and dynamically aggregating them using a gate mechanism. By implementing a channel-wise information query, features that incorporate both local and global contexts are encoded. We also introduce a novel large-scale hybrid-solid LiDAR semantic segmentation dataset for robotic applications. SFPNet demonstrates competitive performance on conventional benchmarks derived from mechanical spinning LiDAR, while achieving state-of-the-art results on benchmark derived from solid-state LiDAR. Additionally, it outperforms existing methods on our novel dataset sourced from hybrid-solid LiDAR. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Cavendish518/SFPNet and https://www.semanticindustry.top.

title: Yang Fu, Saihui Hou*, Shibei Meng, Xuecai Hu*, Chunshui Cao, Xu Liu, Yongzhen Huang
title_en: Yang Fu, Saihui Hou*, Shibei Meng, Xuecai Hu*, Chunshui Cao, Xu Liu, Yongzhen Huang
abstract: 近年来,基于姿态的步态识别方法通过将人体骨架作为模型输入,展现出在处理服装变化和遮挡问题上的显著潜力。然而,依赖骨架编码姿态的方法主要受两个问题限制:(1) 由于形状信息丢失导致的性能下降,(2) 泛化能力不足。为解决这些局限性,我们重新审视基于姿态的步态识别,提出GaitHeat,这是一种基于热图的框架,通过采用新的模态编码姿态而非关键点坐标,显著提升了性能和鲁棒性。我们从两个方面进行改进:流程设计和多通道热图特征提取。具体而言,在RGB空间中进行缩放和居中处理,以最大程度保留热图信息的完整性。为进一步提升跨数据集的泛化能力,我们提出了一种姿态引导的热图对齐模块,以消除与步态无关的协变量影响。此外,设计了一个融合高效融合分支的全局-局部网络,以提升语义信息的提取效果。与基于骨架的方法相比,GaitHeat在学习步态特征方面表现出色,并在不同数据集上展现出有效的泛化能力。在三个数据集上的实验表明,所提出的方法在基于姿态的步态识别中取得了最先进的结果,与基于轮廓的方法表现相当。所有源代码可在https://github.com/BNU-IVC/FastPoseGait获取。
abstract_en: Recent pose-based gait recognition methods, which utilize human skeletons as the model input, have demonstrated significant potential in handling variations in clothing and occlusions. However, methods relying on such skeleton to encode pose are constrained mainly by two problems: (1) poor performance caused by the shape loss, and (2) lack of generalizability. Addressing these limitations, we revisit pose-based gait recognition and develop GaitHeat, a heatmap-based framework that largely enhances performance and robustness by utilizing a new modality to encode pose rather than keypoint coordinates. We make our efforts from two aspects, the pipeline and the extraction of multi-channel heatmap features. Specifically, the process of resizing and centering is performed in the RGB space to largely preserve the integrity of heatmap information. To boost the generalization across various datasets further, we propose a pose-guided heatmap alignment module to eliminate the influence of gait-irrelevant covariates. Furthermore, a global-local network incorporating an efficient fusion branch is designed to improve the extraction of semantic information. Compared to skeleton-based methods, GaitHeat exhibits superior performance in learning gait features and demonstrates effective generalization across different datasets. Experiments on three datasets reveal that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art results for pose-based gait recognition, comparable to that of silhouette-based approaches. All the source code is available at https://github.com/BNU-IVC/FastPoseGait.

title: Yang Jin*, Yadong Mu*
title_en: Yang Jin*, Yadong Mu*
abstract: 本文探讨了时空视频定位(STVG)任务,该任务旨在将给定文本描述对应到未剪辑视频中的特定对象。现有方法主要依赖于对象级别的手动标注作为监督信号来解决这一挑战性任务。这种范式严重限制了处理大规模无标签数据的可扩展性。为此,我们提出了一种新颖的框架,该框架仅通过视频-句子对应关系即可实现目标对象的定位。具体而言,我们的模型将原始STVG任务重新表述为两个跨模态对齐子问题:区域-短语和帧-句子。由于训练阶段缺乏真实对齐信息,我们将它们视为潜在变量,并通过重建视频中实体的交互关系来建模联合条件分布。整个框架可通过变分期望最大化(EM)算法有效优化,该算法通过交替进行两个更新步骤,逐步最大化查询句子的似然性,从而逼近真实的跨模态分配。在两个视频基准数据集(VidSTG和HC-STVG)上的大量实验进一步验证了所提方法的有效性。
abstract_en: This paper explores the spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) task, which aims at localizing a particular object corresponding to a given textual description in an untrimmed video. Existing approaches mainly resort to object-level manual annotations as the supervision for addressing this challenging task. Such a paradigm heavily constrains the scalability of processing large-scale unlabeled data. To this end, we present a novel framework that is capable of grounding the target object relying only on the video-sentence correspondence. Specifically, our model re-formulates the original STVG task as two cross-modal alignment sub-problems: region-phrase and frame-sentence. Since the absence of ground-truth alignments during the training stage, we treat them as latent variables and learn to model the joint conditional distribution by reconstructing the interactions of entities in the video. The entire framework can be effectively optimized by the variational Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm, which alternates between two updating steps for progressively maximizing the likelihood of query sentence, thereby approximating the real cross-modal assignment. Extensive experiments on two video benchmarks (VidSTG and HC-STVG) further show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

title: Yang Jin, Lei Zhang, Shi Yan, Bin Fan, Binglu Wang*
title_en: Yang Jin, Lei Zhang, Shi Yan, Bin Fan, Binglu Wang*
abstract: 注视物体预测(GOP)旨在预测人类注视的物体类别和位置。先前方法利用框级监督来识别人类注视的物体,但难以处理语义歧义,因为当物体靠在一起时,单个框可能包含多个物品。视觉基础模型(VFM)通过框提示改进了物体分割,能够更精确地定位物体以减少混淆,为细粒度注视物体预测提供了优势。本文提出更具挑战性的注视物体分割(GOS)任务,即推断与人类注视行为对应的物体像素级掩码。特别地,我们认为VFM提供的像素级监督可以整合到注视物体预测中以缓解语义歧义。这导致了我们的注视物体检测与分割框架,实现了准确的像素级预测。与需要额外头输入或忽略头特征的先前方法不同,我们提出从场景特征中自动获取头特征,以确保模型在现实世界中的推理效率和灵活性。此外,与现有方法直接融合特征预测注视热图不同,这可能忽略物体的空间位置和细微细节,我们开发了空间到物体注视回归方法以促进人-物体注视交互。具体而言,它首先构建初始的人-物体空间连接,然后通过分割分支中语义清晰特征的交互优化该连接,最终预测精确定位的注视热图。在GOO-Synth和GOO-Real数据集上的大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性。代码将发布在https://github.com/jinyang06/SamGOP。
abstract_en: Gaze object prediction (GOP) aims to predict the category and location of the object that a human is looking at. Previous methods utilized box-level supervision to identify the object that a person is looking at, but struggled with semantic ambiguity, , a single box may contain several items since objects are close together. The Vision foundation model (VFM) has improved in object segmentation using box prompts, which can reduce confusion by more precisely locating objects, offering advantages for fine-grained prediction of gaze objects. This paper presents a more challenging gaze object segmentation (GOS) task, which involves inferring the pixel-level mask corresponding to the object captured by human gaze behavior. In particular, we propose that the pixel-level supervision provided by VFM can be integrated into gaze object prediction to mitigate semantic ambiguity. This leads to our gaze object detection and segmentation framework that enables accurate pixel-level predictions. Different from previous methods that require additional head input or ignore head features, we propose to automatically obtain head features from scene features to ensure the model’s inference efficiency and flexibility in the real world. Moreover, rather than directly fuse features to predict gaze heatmap as in existing methods, which may overlook spatial location and subtle details of the object, we develop a space-to-object gaze regression method to facilitate human-object gaze interaction. Specifically, it first constructs an initial human-object spatial connection, then refines this connection by interacting with semantically clear features in the segmentation branch, ultimately predicting a gaze heatmap for precise localization. Extensive experiments on GOO-Synth and GOO-Real datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. The code will be available at https://github. com/jinyang06/SamGOP.

title: Yang Liu*, Pengxiang Ding, Siteng Huang, Min Zhang, Han Zhao, Donglin Wang
title_en: Yang Liu*, Pengxiang Ding, Siteng Huang, Min Zhang, Han Zhao, Donglin Wang
abstract: 在大语言模型(LLMs)浪潮的推动下,大视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)作为关键进展出现,弥合了图像与文本之间的鸿沟。然而,视频使得LVLMs难以充分表现,由于语言与时空数据结构之间关系的复杂性。近期的大视频-语言模型(LVidLMs)通过通用多模态任务,将静态视觉数据(如图像)的特征对齐到语言特征的潜在空间,以充分利用LLMs的能力。在本文中,我们探索了一种基于物体轨迹的细粒度对齐方法,同时在空间和时间维度上对不同模态进行对齐。因此,我们提出了一种新颖的LVidLM,称为PiTe,通过轨迹引导的像素-时序对齐,展现出有前景的应用模型特性。为了实现细粒度的视频-语言对齐,我们构建了一个多模态预训练数据集PiTe-143k,该数据集通过我们的自动标注管道,为视频中所有出现并被提及的个体对象提供了像素级别的运动轨迹数据。同时,PiTe通过大幅超越现有最先进方法,在众多视频相关多模态任务中展现出惊人的能力。
abstract_en: Fueled by the Large Language Models (LLMs) wave, Large Visual-Language Models (LVLMs) have emerged as a pivotal advancement, bridging the gap between image and text. However, video making it challenging for LVLMs to perform adequately due to the complexity of the relationship between language and spatial-temporal data structure. Recent Large Video-Language Models (LVidLMs) align feature of static visual data like image into latent space of language feature, by general multi-modal tasks to leverage abilities of LLMs sufficiently. In this paper, we explore fine-grained alignment approach via object trajectory for different modalities across both spatial and temporal dimensions simultaneously. Thus, we propose a novel LVidLM by trajectory-guided Pixel-Temporal Alignment, dubbed PiTe, that exhibits promising applicable model property. To achieve fine-grained video-language alignment, we curate a multi-modal pre-training dataset PiTe-143k, the dataset provision of moving trajectories in pixel level for all individual objects, that appear and mention in the video and caption both, by our automatic annotation pipeline. Meanwhile, PiTe demonstrates astounding capabilities on myriad video-related multi-modal tasks through beat the state-of-the-art methods by a large margin.

title: Yang Liu, Chuanchen Luo, Lue Fan, Naiyan Wang, Junran Peng*, Zhaoxiang Zhang*
title_en: Yang Liu, Chuanchen Luo, Lue Fan, Naiyan Wang, Junran Peng*, Zhaoxiang Zhang*
abstract: 三维高斯泼溅(3DGS)显著推动了实时三维场景重建和新视角合成技术的发展。然而,有效训练大规模3DGS并在不同尺度下实现实时渲染仍面临挑战。本文提出CityGaussian(CityGS),采用新颖的分而治之训练方法和细节层次(LoD)策略,实现大规模3DGS的高效训练与渲染。具体而言,全局场景先验和自适应训练数据选择实现了高效训练与无缝融合。基于融合的高斯基础体,我们通过压缩生成不同细节层次,并通过提出的分块细节层次选择与聚合策略实现跨尺度快速渲染。在大规模场景上的大量实验结果表明,我们的方法实现了最先进的渲染质量,能够在差异巨大的尺度下实现大规模场景的一致实时渲染。我们的项目页面可在https://dekuliutesla.github.io/citygs/访问。
abstract_en: The advancement of real-time 3D scene reconstruction and novel view synthesis has been significantly propelled by 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). However, effectively training large-scale 3DGS and rendering it in real-time across various scales remains challenging. This paper introduces CityGaussian (CityGS), which employs a novel divide-and-conquer training approach and Level-of-Detail (LoD) strategy for efficient large-scale 3DGS training and rendering. Specifically, the global scene prior and adaptive training data selection enables efficient training and seamless fusion. Based on fused Gaussian primitives, we generate different detail levels through compression, and realize fast rendering across various scales through the proposed block-wise detail levels selection and aggregation strategy. Extensive experimental results on large-scale scenes demonstrate that our approach attains state-of-the-art rendering quality, enabling consistent real-time rendering of large-scale scenes across vastly different scales. Our project page is available at https://dekuliutesla.github.io/citygs/.

title: Yang Miao, Francis Engelmann, Olga Vysotska, Federico Tombari, Marc Pollefeys, Daniel Barath*
title_en: Yang Miao, Francis Engelmann, Olga Vysotska, Federico Tombari, Marc Pollefeys, Daniel Barath*
abstract: 我们引入了在由多个三维场景图组成的多模态参考地图中定位输入图像的任务。这些场景图包含多种模态,包括物体级别的点云、图像、属性以及物体之间的关系,为依赖大规模图像数据库的传统方法提供了一种轻量且高效的替代方案。基于这些模态,所提方法为场景图中的每个节点(代表物体实例)学习固定大小的嵌入,从而有效匹配输入查询图像中可见的物体。该策略显著优于其他跨模态方法,即使不将图像纳入地图表示中。引入图像后,其性能接近依赖大规模图像数据库的最先进方法,同时存储需求低三个数量级,运行速度提高多个数量级。代码和模型可在https://scenegraphloc.github.io获取。
abstract_en: We introduce the task of localizing an input image within a multi-modal reference map represented by a collection of 3D scene graphs. These scene graphs comprise multiple modalities, including object-level point clouds, images, attributes, and relationships between objects, offering a lightweight and efficient alternative to conventional methods that rely on extensive image databases. Given these modalities, the proposed method learns a fixed-sized embedding for each node (, representing object instances) in the scene graph, enabling effective matching with the objects visible in the input query image. This strategy significantly outperforms other cross-modal methods, even without incorporating images into the map representation. With images, achieves performance close to that of state-of-the-art techniques depending on large image databases, while requiring three orders-of-magnitude less storage and operating orders-of-magnitude faster. Code and models are available at https://scenegraphloc.github.io.

title: Yang Wu*, Kaihua Zhang, Jianjun Qian, Jin Xie*, Jian Yang
title_en: Yang Wu*, Kaihua Zhang, Jianjun Qian, Jin Xie*, Jian Yang
abstract: 复杂的交通环境和多样的天气条件使得激光雷达数据采集成本高昂且具有挑战性。实现高质量且可控的激光雷达数据生成迫在眉睫,文本控制是常见做法,但该领域研究仍较为有限。为此,我们提出Text2LiDAR,这是首个高效、多样且支持文本控制的激光雷达数据生成模型。具体而言,我们设计了等距柱面变压器架构,利用设计的等距柱面注意力机制以数据特征方式捕捉激光雷达特征。随后,我们设计了控制信号嵌入注入器,通过全局到聚焦的注意力机制高效整合控制信号。此外,我们开发了频率调制器以帮助模型恢复高频细节,确保生成点云的清晰度。为促进领域发展并优化文本控制生成性能,我们构建了nuLiDARtext数据集,包含来自850个场景的34,149个激光雷达点云,并提供多样化的文本描述符。在KITTI-360和nuScenes数据集上进行的无控制与文本控制生成实验验证了本方法的优越性。项目地址:https://github.com/wuyang98/Text2LiDAR
abstract_en: The complex traffic environment and various weather conditions make the collection of LiDAR data expensive and challenging. Achieving high-quality and controllable LiDAR data generation is urgently needed, controlling with text is a common practice, but there is little research in this field. To this end, we propose Text2LiDAR, the first efficient, diverse, and text-controllable LiDAR data generation model. Specifically, we design an equirectangular transformer architecture, utilizing the designed equirectangular attention to capture LiDAR features in a manner with data characteristics. Then, we design a control-signal embedding injector to efficiently integrate control signals through the global-to-focused attention mechanism. Additionally, we devise a frequency modulator to assist the model in recovering high-frequency details, ensuring the clarity of the generated point cloud. To foster development in the field and optimize text-controlled generation performance, we construct nuLiDARtext which offers diverse text descriptors for 34,149 LiDAR point clouds from 850 scenes. Experiments on uncontrolled and text-controlled generation in various forms on KITTI-360 and nuScenes datasets demonstrate the superiority of our approach. The project can be found at https://github.com/wuyang98/Text2LiDAR

title: Yang You*, 柯雄, 杨振宁, 黄正翔, 周俊伟, 史若西, 方周, Adam Harley, Leonidas Guibas, 陆岑吾*
title_en: Yang You*, kai xiong, Zhening Yang, Zhengxiang Huang, Junwei Zhou, Ruoxi Shi, Zhou FANG, Adam Harley, Leonidas Guibas, Cewu Lu*
abstract: 我们引入了PACE(杂乱环境中的姿态注释),这是一个大规模基准测试,旨在推动姿态估计方法在杂乱场景中的开发与评估。PACE为实例级和类别级设置提供了大规模的真实世界基准测试。该基准测试包含300个视频中的55,000帧和258,000个注释,涵盖43个类别中的238个物体,并包含刚性物体和可变形物体在杂乱场景中的混合。为了高效标注真实世界数据,我们开发了一种创新的标注系统,采用校准的三相机设置。此外,我们还提供了PACE-Sim,其中包含100,000帧逼真的模拟图像和240万个注释,涉及931个物体。我们在PACE上测试了最先进的算法,分为姿态估计和物体姿态跟踪两个赛道,揭示了该基准测试的挑战与研究机会。我们的基准测试代码和数据可在https://github.com/qq456cvb/PACE获取。
abstract_en: We introduce PACE (Pose Annotations in Cluttered Environments), a large-scale benchmark designed to advance the development and evaluation of pose estimation methods in cluttered scenarios. PACE provides a large-scale real-world benchmark for both instance-level and category-level settings. The benchmark consists of 55K frames with 258K annotations across 300 videos, covering 238 objects from 43 categories and featuring a mix of rigid and articulated items in cluttered scenes. To annotate the real-world data efficiently, we develop an innovative annotation system with a calibrated 3-camera setup. Additionally, we offer PACE-Sim, which contains 100K photo-realistic simulated frames with 2.4M annotations across 931 objects. We test state-of-the-art algorithms in PACE along two tracks: pose estimation, and object pose tracking, revealing the benchmark’s challenges and research opportunities. Our benchmark code and data is available on https://github.com/qq456cvb/PACE.

title: Yang Zhang*, Tze Tzun Teoh, Wei Hern Lim, Kenji Kawaguchi
title_en: Yang Zhang*, Tze Tzun Teoh, Wei Hern Lim, Kenji Kawaguchi
abstract: 近年来,扩散模型在文本到图像合成任务中生成图像的感知质量方面取得了显著进展。然而,扩散模型往往难以生成准确反映相关文本提示语义意图的图像。我们研究了扩散模型中的交叉注意力层,观察到这些层在生成过程中倾向于过度关注某些特定标记,从而损害语义保真度。为了解决注意力主导问题,我们引入了注意力调节方法,这是一种计算高效的实时优化方法,在推理阶段对齐注意力图与输入文本提示。值得注意的是,我们的方法无需额外训练或微调,可作为模型的插件模块。因此,原始模型的生成能力得以完全保留。我们在多个数据集、评估指标和扩散模型上与替代方法进行了比较。实验结果表明,我们的方法在计算开销减少的情况下,持续优于其他基线方法,生成的图像更忠实反映所需概念。代码可在 https://github.com/YaNgZhAnG-V5/attention_regulation 获取。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in diffusion models have notably improved the perceptual quality of generated images in text-to-image synthesis tasks. However, diffusion models often struggle to produce images that accurately reflect the intended semantics of the associated text prompts. We examine cross-attention layers in diffusion models and observe a propensity for these layers to disproportionately focus on certain tokens during the generation process, thereby undermining semantic fidelity. To address the issue of dominant attention, we introduce attention regulation, a computation-efficient on-the-fly optimization approach at inference time to align attention maps with the input text prompt. Notably, our method requires no additional training or fine-tuning and serves as a plug-in module on a model. Hence, the generation capacity of the original model is fully preserved. We compare our approach with alternative approaches across various datasets, evaluation metrics, and diffusion models. Experiment results show that our method consistently outperforms other baselines, yielding images that more faithfully reflect the desired concepts with reduced computation overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/YaNgZhAnG-V5/attention_regulation.

title: Yang Zhao*, Zhisheng Xiao*, Yanwu Xu, Haolin Jia, Tingbo Hou
title_en: Yang Zhao*, Zhisheng Xiao*, Yanwu Xu, Haolin Jia, Tingbo Hou
abstract: 大规模文本到图像扩散模型在移动设备上的部署受到其庞大模型体积和高延迟的阻碍。本文提出MobileDiffusion,这是一种通过在架构和采样技术方面进行广泛优化获得的超高效文本到图像扩散模型。我们对模型架构设计进行了全面分析,以最小化模型体积和FLOPs,同时保持图像生成质量。此外,我们重新审视了扩散-GAN的先进采样技术,并使单步采样兼容于基于基础模型训练的下游应用。通过定性和定量的实证研究,验证了我们提出技术的有效性。借助这些技术,MobileDiffusion实现了在移动设备上的即时文本到图像生成,建立了新的技术标杆。
abstract_en: The deployment of large-scale text-to-image diffusion models on mobile devices is impeded by their substantial model size and high latency. In this paper, we present MobileDiffusion, an ultra-efficient text-to-image diffusion model obtained through extensive optimizations in both architecture and sampling techniques. We conduct a comprehensive examination of model architecture design to minimize model size and FLOPs, while preserving image generation quality. Additionally, we revisit the advanced sampling technique by diffusion-GAN, and make one-step sampling compatible to downstream applications trained on the base model. Empirical studies, conducted both quantitatively and qualitatively, demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed technologies. With them, MobileDiffusion achieves instant text-to-image generation on mobile devices, establishing a new state of the art.

title: Yang Zheng*, Qingqing Zhao, Guandao Yang, Wang Yifan, Donglai Xiang, Florian Dubost, Dmitry Lagun, Thabo Beeler, Federico Tombari, Leonidas Guibas, Gordon Wetzstein
title_en: Yang Zheng*, Qingqing Zhao, Guandao Yang, Wang Yifan, Donglai Xiang, Florian Dubost, Dmitry Lagun, Thabo Beeler, Federico Tombari, Leonidas Guibas, Gordon Wetzstein
abstract: [width=0.9]figure/teaserv 4.pdf 图1:PhysAvatar 是一种新颖的框架,通过视觉观察捕捉穿着3D化身的物理特性,使动画、重光照和重着装等广泛应用成为可能,具有高保真渲染结果。
abstract_en: [width=0.9]figure/teaserv 4.pdf Figure 1: PhysAvatar is a novel framework that captures the physics of dressed 3D avatars from visual observations, enabling a wide spectrum of applications, such as (a) animation, (b) relighting, and (c) redressing, with high-fidelity rendering results.

title: Yang Zhou*, Yongjian Wu, Jiya Saiyin, Bingzheng Wei, Maode Lai, Eric I Chang, Yan Xu*
title_en: Yang Zhou*, Yongjian Wu, Jiya Saiyin, Bingzheng Wei, Maode Lai, Eric I Chang, Yan Xu*
abstract: 提示调优方法在参数高效的大型预训练模型微调中取得了显著成功。然而,其在基于双模态融合的视觉-语言预训练模型(VLPMs)如GLIP中的应用遇到了问题。现有提示调优方法未能有效解决不同模态中token的模态映射与对齐问题,导致迁移泛化能力较差。为解决这一问题,我们提出同步双提示调优(SDPT)。SDPT在已建立的模态对齐空间中初始化一组可学习的统一原型token,以表征文本和图像模态在下游任务中的对齐语义。此外,SDPT建立逆线性投影,无需训练即可将统一原型token的信息嵌入到不同模态的输入空间中。逆线性投影使统一原型token能够同步表征两种模态,并使SDPT能够在不同模态提示下共享文本和图像的统一语义以完成下游任务。实验结果表明,SDPT仅需0.04%的模型参数即可帮助基于融合的VLPMs在多种场景下取得优于其他单模态或多模态方法的优异效果。代码将在https://github.com/wuyongjianCODE/SDPT发布。
abstract_en: Prompt tuning methods have achieved remarkable success in parameter-efficient fine-tuning on large pre-trained models. However, their application to dual-modal fusion-based visual-language pre-trained models (VLPMs), such as GLIP, has encountered issues. Existing prompt tuning methods have not effectively addressed the modal mapping and aligning problem for tokens in different modalities, leading to poor transfer generalization. To address this issue, we propose Synchronous Dual Prompt Tuning (SDPT). SDPT initializes a single set of learnable unified prototype tokens in the established modal aligning space to represent the aligned semantics of text and image modalities for downstream tasks. Furthermore, SDPT establishes inverse linear projections that require no training to embed the information of unified prototype tokens into the input space of different modalities.
