The inverse linear projections allow the unified prototype token to synchronously represent the two modalities and enable SDPT to share the unified semantics of text and image for downstream tasks across different modal prompts. Experimental results demonstrate that SDPT assists fusion-based VLPMs to achieve superior outcomes with only 0.04% of model parameters for training across various scenarios, outperforming other single- or dual-modal methods. The code will be released at https://github.com/wuyongjianCODE/SDPT.

title: Yangchao Wu*, Tian Yu Liu, Hyoungseob Park, Stefano Soatto, Dong Lao, Alex Wong
title_en: Yangchao Wu*, Tian Yu Liu, Hyoungseob Park, Stefano Soatto, Dong Lao, Alex Wong
abstract: 无监督深度补全与估计方法通过最小化重建误差进行训练。由重采样、强度饱和和遮挡引起的块状伪影是常见数据增强方案中影响图像重建质量及训练信号的诸多不良副产物之一。因此,通常被视为其他视觉任务训练流程关键要素的典型图像增强方法,在实际应用中仅被有限使用,主要局限于小幅图像强度变化和翻转操作。由于强度变换会改变3D场景的尺度,几何变换可能在重采样过程中破坏稀疏深度数据,稀疏深度模态在深度补全任务中的应用更显受限。我们提出一种方法,使无监督深度补全与估计能够解锁此前难以实现的广泛几何增强操作。该方法通过将输出深度的坐标反向变换(即“撤销”几何变换),将深度图重新映射回原始参考系,从而能够基于原始图像和稀疏深度图计算重建损失,避免对增强输入进行简单损失计算时的陷阱,并允许扩展增强操作以提升性能。我们在室内(VOID)和室外(KITTI)数据集上验证了该方法,结果表明在两个数据集上均优于近期方法,并在四个其他数据集上展现出良好的泛化能力。代码已开源:https://github.com/alexklwong/augundo
abstract_en: Unsupervised depth completion and estimation methods are trained by minimizing reconstruction error. Block artifacts from resampling, intensity saturation, and occlusions are amongst the many undesirable by-products of common data augmentation schemes that affect image reconstruction quality, and thus the training signal. Hence, typical augmentations on images viewed as essential to training pipelines in other vision tasks have seen limited use beyond small image intensity changes and flipping. The sparse depth modality in depth completion have seen even less use as intensity transformations alter the scale of the 3D scene, and geometric transformations may decimate the sparse points during resampling. We propose a method that unlocks a wide range of previously-infeasible geometric augmentations for unsupervised depth completion and estimation. This is achieved by reversing, or “undo”-ing, geometric transformations to the coordinates of the output depth, warping the depth map back to the original reference frame. This enables computing the reconstruction losses using the original images and sparse depth maps, eliminating the pitfalls of naive loss computation on the augmented inputs and allowing us to scale up augmentations to boost performance. We demonstrate our method on indoor (VOID) and outdoor (KITTI) datasets, where we consistently improve upon recent methods across both datasets as well as generalization to four other datasets. Code available at: https://github.com/alexklwong/augundo

title: Yanguang Sun, Chunyan Xu, Jian Yang, Hanyu Xuan*, Lei Luo*
title_en: Yanguang Sun, Chunyan Xu, Jian Yang, Hanyu Xuan*, Lei Luo*
abstract: 伪装目标检测在计算机视觉领域引起了广泛关注。主要挑战在于伪装目标与周围环境在空间域中高度相似,导致识别困难。现有方法通过复杂设计最大化空间特征的区分能力以降低像素相似性的影响,但往往忽视了空间域中特征的敏感性和局部性,导致结果次优。本文提出了一种新方法,通过联合探索频率域和空间域的表示,引入频率-空间纠缠学习(FSEL)方法。该方法包含一系列精心设计的纠缠变换块(ETB)用于表示学习、联合域感知模块用于语义增强,以及双域反向解析器用于频率域和空间域的特征融合。具体而言,ETB利用频率自注意力机制有效表征不同频率带之间的关系,而纠缠前馈网络通过纠缠学习促进不同域特征间的信息交互。我们的大量实验表明,FSEL在三个广泛使用的数据集上通过全面的定量和定性对比,优于21种最先进的方法。源代码可在:bluehttps://github.com/CSYSI/FSEL 获取。
abstract_en: Camouflaged object detection has attracted a lot of attention in computer vision. The main challenge lies in the high degree of similarity between camouflaged objects and their surroundings in the spatial domain, making identification difficult. Existing methods attempt to reduce the impact of pixel similarity by maximizing the distinguishing ability of spatial features with complicated design, but often ignore the sensitivity and locality of features in the spatial domain, leading to sub-optimal results. In this paper, we propose a new approach to address this issue by jointly exploring the representation in the frequency and spatial domains, introducing the Frequency-Spatial Entanglement Learning (FSEL) method. This method consists of a series of well-designed Entanglement Transformer Blocks (ETB) for representation learning, a Joint Domain Perception Module for semantic enhancement, and a Dual-domain Reverse Parser for feature integration in the frequency and spatial domains. Specifically, the ETB utilizes frequency self-attention to effectively characterize the relationship between different frequency bands, while the entanglement feed-forward network facilitates information interaction between features of different domains through entanglement learning. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our FSEL over 21 state-of-the-art methods, through comprehensive quantitative and qualitative comparisons in three widely-used datasets. The source code is available at: bluehttps://github.com/CSYSI/FSEL.

title: 吴阳正*,Michael Alan Greenspan
title_en: Yangzheng Wu*, Michael Alan Greenspan
abstract: 我们针对六自由度位姿估计(6DoF PE)中的模拟到真实域差距问题,提出了一种新颖的基于自监督关键点投票的6DoF PE框架,通过在再生核希尔伯特空间(RKHS)中使用可学习核有效缩小该差距。我们将该域差距形式化为高维特征空间中的距离,与之前迭代匹配方法不同。我们提出了一种适配器网络,该网络在纯合成数据上预训练,使用合成的地面真实位姿,并通过该合成域演化网络参数至目标真实域。重要的是,真实数据训练仅使用伪关键点估计的伪位姿,因此无需真实地面真实数据标注。我们提出的方法称为RKHSPose,在包括LINEMOD(+4.2%)、Occlusion LINEMOD(+2%)和YCB-Video(+3%)在内的三个常用6DoF PE数据集上,取得了自监督方法中的最先进性能。它在所有六个适用的BOP核心数据集上也优于完全监督方法,达到与顶级完全监督结果相比-11.3%至+0.2%的范围。
abstract_en: We address the simulation-to-real domain gap in six degree-of-freedom pose estimation (6DoF PE), and propose a novel self-supervised keypoint voting-based 6DoF PE framework, effectively narrowing this gap using a learnable kernel in RKHS. We formulate this domain gap as a distance in high-dimensional feature space, distinct from previous iterative matching methods. We propose an adapter network, which is pre-trained on purely synthetic data with synthetic ground truth poses, and which evolves the network parameters from this source synthetic domain to the target real domain. Importantly, the real data training only uses pseudo-poses estimated by pseudo-keypoints, and thereby requires no real ground truth data annotations. Our proposed method is called RKHSPose, and achieves state-of-the-art performance among self-supervised methods on three commonly used 6DoF PE datasets including LINEMOD (+4.2%), Occlusion LINEMOD (+2%), and YCB-Video (+3%). It also compares favorably to fully supervised methods on all six applicable BOP core datasets, achieving within −11.3% to +0.2% of the top fully supervised results.

title: Yanheng Wei*, Lianghua Huang*, Zhi-Fan Wu, Wei Wang, Yu Liu, Mingda Jia, Shuailei Ma
title_en: Yanheng Wei*, Lianghua Huang*, Zhi-Fan Wu, Wei Wang, Yu Liu, Mingda Jia, Shuailei Ma
abstract: 近期生成模型在创建高质量单人图像方面表现出色,但在复杂多人体场景中表现不佳,难以准确捕捉数量、身份准确性、布局和姿态等结构细节。我们提出了一种新颖的方法Chains,通过分步过程将初始文本提示增强为详细的人体条件。Chains利用一系列条件节点——文本、数量、布局、骨架和3D网格——每个节点均独立进行扩散过程。这使得扩散模型能够实现高质量的人体生成和先进的场景布局管理。我们在复杂多人体场景合成的新基准测试中评估Chains,结果显示其在人体质量和场景准确性方面优于现有方法。值得注意的是,Chains在20步推理中仅需不到0.45秒,展示了其有效性与高效性。
abstract_en: Recent generative models excel in creating high-quality single-human images but fail in complex multi-human scenarios, failing to capture accurate structural details like quantities, identity accuracy, layouts and postures. We introduce a novel approach, Chains, which enhances initial text prompts into detailed human conditions using a step-by-step process. Chains utilize a series of condition nodes—text, quantity, layout, skeleton, and 3D mesh—each undergoing an independent diffusion process. This enables high-quality human generation and advanced scene layout management in diffusion models. We evaluate Chains against a new benchmark for complex multi-human scene synthesis, showing superior performance in human quality and scene accuracy over existing methods. Remarkably, Chains achieves this with under 0.45 seconds for a 20-step inference, demonstrating both effectiveness and efficiency.

title: Yaniv Wolf*, Amit Bracha, Ron Kimmel
title_en: Yaniv Wolf*, Amit Bracha, Ron Kimmel
abstract: 近年来,三维高斯点云(3DGS)作为一种高效准确表示场景的方法崭露头角。然而,尽管其在新视角合成方面表现出色,但直接从高斯属性中提取场景几何结构仍面临挑战,因为这些属性是基于光度损失进行优化的。虽然一些并行模型尝试在高斯优化过程中加入几何约束,但它们仍会产生噪声大、不真实的表面。我们提出了一种新颖的方法,通过将现实世界知识注入深度提取过程,弥合嘈杂的3DGS表示与平滑的3D网格表示之间的差距。我们不直接从高斯属性中提取场景几何结构,而是通过预训练的立体匹配模型提取几何结构。我们渲染与原始训练姿态对应的立体对齐图像对,将这些图像对输入立体模型以获得深度分布,最后融合所有分布得到单一网格。与其它基于高斯点云的表面重建方法相比,该方法生成的重建结果更平滑、更准确,并展现出更精细的细节,且仅需在相对较短的3DGS优化过程上增加少量开销。我们在野外场景(使用智能手机采集)中对所提方法进行了广泛测试,展示了其卓越的重建能力。此外,我们在Tanks and Temples和DTU基准数据集上测试了该方法,取得了最先进的结果。
abstract_en: Recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as an efficient approach for accurately representing scenes. However, despite its superior novel view synthesis capabilities, extracting the geometry of the scene directly from the Gaussian properties remains a challenge, as those are optimized based on a photometric loss. While some concurrent models have tried adding geometric constraints during the Gaussian optimization process, they still produce noisy, unrealistic surfaces. We propose a novel approach for bridging the gap between the noisy 3DGS representation and the smooth 3D mesh representation, by injecting real-world knowledge into the depth extraction process. Instead of extracting the geometry of the scene directly from the Gaussian properties, we instead extract the geometry through a pre-trained stereo-matching model. We render stereo-aligned pairs of images corresponding to the original training poses, feed the pairs into a stereo model to get a depth profile, and finally fuse all of the profiles together to get a single mesh. The resulting reconstruction is smoother, more accurate and shows more intricate details compared to other methods for surface reconstruction from Gaussian Splatting, while only requiring a small overhead on top of the fairly short 3DGS optimization process. We performed extensive testing of the proposed method on in-the-wild scenes, obtained using a smartphone, showcasing its superior reconstruction abilities. Additionally, we tested the method on the Tanks and Temples and DTU benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art results.

title: Yankun Xu*, Junzhe Wang, Yun-Hsuan Chen, Jie Yang, Wenjie Ming, Shuang Wang, Mohamad Sawan*
title_en: Yankun Xu*, Junzhe Wang, Yun-Hsuan Chen, Jie Yang, Wenjie Ming, Shuang Wang, Mohamad Sawan*
abstract: 准确且高效的癫痫发作起始检测可显著造福患者。传统诊断方法主要依赖脑电图(EEG),往往导致繁琐且不便于携带的解决方案,使持续患者监测变得困难。基于视频的癫痫发作检测系统有望使患者摆脱头皮或植入式EEG设备的限制,并实现在家庭环境中的远程监测。先前的基于视频的方法由于资源不足和无效的患者动作识别技术,既无法实现全天候监测,也难以提供短时检测延迟。此外,基于骨架的动作识别方法在识别细微的癫痫相关动作方面仍存在局限。为解决这些挑战,我们提出了一种基于骨架的时空视觉图神经网络(VSViG)的视频癫痫检测模型,以实现实时场景下的高效、准确和及时检测。实验结果表明,VSViG在我们收集的患者视频数据上优于先前最先进的动作识别模型,具有更高的准确率(5.9%的误差)、更低的浮点运算次数(0.4G)和更小的模型尺寸(1.4M)。此外,通过集成结合输出概率和累积函数的决策规则,我们实现了在EEG起始后5.1秒的检测延迟、临床起始前13.1秒的检测提前量以及零误检率。项目主页地址为:https://github.com/xuyankun/VSViG/
abstract_en: An accurate and efficient epileptic seizure onset detection can significantly benefit patients. Traditional diagnostic methods, primarily relying on electroencephalograms (EEGs), often result in cumbersome and non-portable solutions, making continuous patient monitoring challenging. The video-based seizure detection system is expected to free patients from the constraints of scalp or implanted EEG devices and enable remote monitoring in residential settings. Previous video-based methods neither enable all-day monitoring nor provide short detection latency due to insufficient resources and ineffective patient action recognition techniques. Additionally, skeleton-based action recognition approaches remain limitations in identifying subtle seizure-related actions. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Video-based Seizure detection model via a skeleton-based spatiotemporal Vision Graph neural network (VSViG) for its efficient, accurate and timely purpose in real-time scenarios. Our experimental results indicate VSViG outperforms previous state-of-the-art action recognition models on our collected patients’ video data with higher accuracy (5.9% error), lower FLOPs (0.4G), and smaller model size (1.4M). Furthermore, by integrating a decision-making rule that combines output probabilities and an accumulative function, we achieve a 5.1 s detection latency after EEG onset, a 13.1 s detection advance before clinical onset, and a zero false detection rate. The project homepage is available at: https://github.com/xuyankun/VSViG/

title: Yanlong LI*, Chamara Madarasingha, Kanchana Thilakarathna
title_en: Yanlong LI*, Chamara Madarasingha, Kanchana Thilakarathna
abstract: 点云流技术正日益流行,逐渐成为交互式服务交付和未来元宇宙的标准。然而,与点云相关的数据量巨大,带来了诸多挑战,尤其是在高带宽消耗和大存储容量方面。尽管迄今为止提出了多种解决方案,主要集中在点云压缩、上采样和补全等领域,但这些重建相关方法在提供高保真点云输出方面仍显不足。为此,我们提出了一种有效的点云重建架构。受自监督学习理念启发,我们将掩码自编码器与扩散模型相结合,实现对点云数据的远程重建。通过这种重建过程的特性,该方法可扩展至包括点云压缩、上采样和补全在内的诸多相关下游任务。借助包含超过60000个物体的ShapeNet-55和ModelNet数据集,我们验证了该方法在自编码及所考虑的下游任务中均超越了许多最先进的方法。我们的源代码可在以下链接获取:https://github.com/TyraelDLee/DiffPMAE
abstract_en: Point cloud streaming is increasingly getting popular, evolving into the norm for interactive service delivery and the future Metaverse. However, the substantial volume of data associated with point clouds presents numerous challenges, particularly in terms of high bandwidth consumption and large storage capacity. Despite various solutions proposed thus far, with a focus on point cloud compression, upsampling, and completion, these reconstruction-related methods continue to fall short in delivering high fidelity point cloud output. As a solution, in , we propose an effective point cloud reconstruction architecture. Inspired by self-supervised learning concepts, we combine Masked Autoencoder and Diffusion Model to remotely reconstruct point cloud data. By the nature of this reconstruction process, can be extended to many related downstream tasks including point cloud compression, upsampling and completion. Leveraging ShapeNet-55 and ModelNet datasets with over 60000 objects, we validate the performance of exceeding many state-of-the-art methods in terms of autoencoding and downstream tasks considered. Our source code is available at : https://github.com/TyraelDLee/DiffPMAE

title: Yanmeng Yao, Xiaohan Zhao, Bin Gu*
title_en: Yanmeng Yao, Xiaohan Zhao, Bin Gu*
abstract: 在计算机视觉领域,基于事件的动态视觉传感器(DVSs)因其低功耗和高时间分辨率,已成为传统像素成像的重要补充。这些传感器,特别是与脉冲神经网络(SNNs)结合使用时,为高效且快速响应的视觉系统提供了有前景的发展方向。通常,DVS数据会被转换为基于网格的格式以供SNNs处理,而这一转换过程往往在流程中是不透明的步骤。因此,网格表示成为实施攻击时的中间但不可访问阶段,突显了直接攻击原始事件数据的重要性。现有攻击方法主要针对基于网格的表示,受限于三值优化的复杂性和原始事件数据相关的广泛优化空间。本研究通过引入一种新颖的对抗性攻击方法来填补这一空白,该方法直接针对原始事件数据。我们通过策略性整合以下方法来应对三值优化的固有挑战和保持数据稀疏性的需求:1)将离散事件值视为概率样本:通过将离散事件值视为概率空间样本,实现连续优化。2)聚焦特定事件位置:我们优先选择融合原始数据与附加目标标签数据的特定事件位置,提升攻击精度。3)采用稀疏性范数:为保留原始数据的稀疏性,采用稀疏性范数确保对抗性数据的可比性。我们的实证结果证明了所提出综合方法的有效性,在定向攻击中取得显著成果,并揭示了基于原始事件数据模型的脆弱性。
abstract_en: In the field of computer vision, event-based Dynamic Vision Sensors (DVSs) have emerged as a significant complement to traditional pixel-based imaging due to their low power consumption and high temporal resolution. These sensors, particularly when combined with Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs), offer a promising direction for energy-efficient and fast-reacting vision systems. Typically, DVS data are converted into grid-based formats for processing with SNNs, with this transformation process often being an opaque step in the pipeline. As a result, the grid representation becomes an intermediate yet inaccessible stage during the implementation of attacks, highlighting the importance of attacking raw event data. Existing attack methodologies predominantly target grid-based representations, hindered by the complexity of three-valued optimization and the broad optimization space associated with raw event data. Our study addresses this gap by introducing a novel adversarial attack approach that directly targets raw event data. We tackle the inherent challenges of three-valued optimization and the need to preserve data sparsity through a strategic amalgamation of methods: 1) Treating Discrete Event Values as Probabilistic Samples: This allows for continuous optimization by considering discrete event values as probabilistic space samples. 2) Focusing on Specific Event Positions: We prioritize specific event positions that merge original data with additional target label data, enhancing attack precision. 3) Employing a Sparsity Norm: To retain the original data’s sparsity, a sparsity norm is utilized, ensuring the adversarial data’s comparability. Our empirical findings demonstrate the effectiveness of our combined approach, achieving noteworthy success in targeted attacks and highlighting vulnerabilities in models based on raw event data.

title: Yanni Ma, Hao Liu, Yun Pei, Yulan Guo*
title_en: Yanni Ma, Hao Liu, Yun Pei, Yulan Guo*
abstract: 3D场景图预测(SGP)旨在识别场景中的物体并预测其语义和空间关系。现有方法要么利用上下文信息,要么强调先验知识,在全连接的同构图框架中建模场景图。然而,这些方法可能导致图节点(即物体)之间无差别地传递消息,从而导致次优性能。本文提出了一种3D异构场景图预测(3D-HetSGP)框架,在异构方式下对3D场景图进行图推理。具体而言,我们的方法包含两个阶段:异构图结构学习(HGSL)阶段和异构图推理(HGR)阶段。在HGSL阶段,我们通过预测不同有向边的类型来学习图结构。在HGR阶段,基于学习到的图结构对节点进行消息传递以实现场景图预测。大量实验表明,我们的方法在3DSSG数据集上取得了与现有方法相当或更优的性能。
abstract_en: 3D Scene Graph Prediction (SGP) aims to recognize the objects and predict their semantic and spatial relationships in a 3D scene. Existing methods either exploit context information or emphasize knowledge prior to model the scene graph in a fully-connected homogeneous graph framework. However, these methods may lead to indiscriminate message passing among graph nodes (i.e., objects), resulting in sub-optimal performance. In this paper, we propose a 3D Heterogeneous Scene Graph Prediction (3D-HetSGP) framework, which performs graph reasoning on the 3D scene graph in a heterogeneous fashion. Specifically, our method consists of two stages: a heterogeneous graph structure learning (HGSL) stage and a heterogeneous graph reasoning (HGR) stage. In the HGSL stage, we learn the graph structure by predicting the types of different directed edges. In the HGR stage, message passing among nodes is performed on the learned graph structure for scene graph prediction. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves comparable or superior performance to existing methods on 3DSSG dataset.

title: Yannick Kirchhoff*, Maximilian R Rokuss*, Saikat Roy*, Balint Kovacs, Constantin Ulrich, Tassilo Wald, Maximilian Zenk, Philipp Vollmuth, Jens Kleesiek, Fabian Isensee, Klaus H. Maier-Hein
title_en: Yannick Kirchhoff*, Maximilian R Rokuss*, Saikat Roy*, Balint Kovacs, Constantin Ulrich, Tassilo Wald, Maximilian Zenk, Philipp Vollmuth, Jens Kleesiek, Fabian Isensee, Klaus H. Maier-Hein
abstract: 准确分割细长的管状结构(如血管、神经、道路或混凝土裂缝)是计算机视觉中的关键任务。标准的基于深度学习的分割损失函数(如Dice或交叉熵)侧重于体积重叠,往往以牺牲结构连通性或拓扑保持为代价。这可能导致分割错误,进而影响下游任务(包括流量计算、导航和结构检测)。尽管当前以拓扑为中心的损失函数有所改进,但它们引入了显著的计算和内存开销。这在3D数据中尤为相关,使得这些损失函数在较大体积以及日益重要的多类分割问题中变得不可行。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的骨架召回损失(Skeleton Recall Loss),通过使用低成本的CPU操作替代密集的GPU计算,有效应对这些挑战。该方法在五个公开数据集的拓扑保持分割任务中表现出整体更优的性能,同时将计算开销减少了超过90%。通过这样做,我们引入了首个支持多类分割的损失函数,在效率和拓扑保持效果上均表现出色。我们的代码已开源,为社区提供进一步发展的基础,地址为:https: //github.com/MIC-DKFZ/Skeleton-Recall.
abstract_en: Accurately segmenting thin tubular structures, such as vessels, nerves, roads or concrete cracks, is a crucial task in computer vision. Standard deep learning-based segmentation loss functions, such as Dice or Cross-Entropy, focus on volumetric overlap, often at the expense of preserving structural connectivity or topology. This can lead to segmentation errors that adversely affect downstream tasks, including flow calculation, navigation, and structural inspection. Although current topology-focused losses mark an improvement, they introduce significant computational and memory overheads. This is particularly relevant for 3D data, rendering these losses infeasible for larger volumes as well as increasingly important multi-class segmentation problems. To mitigate this, we propose a novel Skeleton Recall Loss, which effectively addresses these challenges by circumventing intensive GPU-based calculations with inexpensive CPU operations. It demonstrates overall superior performance to current state-of-the-art approaches on five public datasets for topology-preserving segmentation, while substantially reducing computational overheads by more than 90%. In doing so, we introduce the first multi-class capable loss function for thin structure segmentation, excelling in both efficiency and efficacy for topology-preservation. Our code is available to the community, providing a foundation for further advancements, at: https: //github.com/MIC-DKFZ/Skeleton-Recall.

title_en: Yannis Kalantidis, Diane Larlus, Mert Bulent Sariyildiz*, Philippe Weinzaepfel, Thomas LUCAS
abstract_en: Pretrained models have become a commodity and offer strong results on a broad range of tasks. In this work, we focus on classification and seek to learn a unique encoder able to take from several complementary pretrained models. We aim at even stronger generalization across a variety of classification tasks. We propose to learn such an encoder via multi-teacher distillation. We first thoroughly analyze standard distillation when driven by multiple strong teachers with complementary strengths. Guided by this analysis, we gradually propose improvements to the basic distillation setup. Among those, we enrich the architecture of the encoder with a ladder of expendable projectors, which increases the impact of intermediate features during distillation, and we introduce teacher dropping, a regularization mechanism that better balances the teachers’ influence. Our final distillation strategy leads to student models of the same capacity as any of the teachers, while retaining or improving upon the performance of the best teacher for each task.

title: Yansheng Li, Tingzhu Wang*, Kang Wu, Linlin Wang, Xin Guo, Wenbin Wang
title_en: Yansheng Li, Tingzhu Wang*, Kang Wu, Linlin Wang, Xin Guo, Wenbin Wang
abstract: 场景图生成(SGG)旨在探索图像中物体之间的关系,获取场景摘要图,从而更好地服务于下游任务。然而,长尾问题对场景图的质量产生了不利影响。预测结果主要由粗粒度关系主导,缺乏更具信息量的细粒度关系。一个物体对的联合区域(即一个样本)包含丰富且专用的上下文信息,能够预测样本特定的偏差,从而优化原始关系预测。因此,我们提出了一种新的样本级偏差预测(SBP)方法用于细粒度SGG(SBG)。首先,我们训练一个经典SGG模型,并通过计算真实标签与预测标签之间的差距构建校正偏差集。然后,我们设计了一个以偏差为导向的生成对抗网络(BGAN),该网络学习预测构建的校正偏差,可用于将原始预测从粗粒度关系修正为细粒度关系。在VG、GQA和VG-1800数据集上的大量实验结果表明,我们的SBG在三个主流SGG模型(Motif、VCtree和Transformer)的Average@K指标上均优于现有最先进方法。与VG数据集级别的校正方法相比,SBG在PredCls、SGCls和SGDet任务的Average@K指标上分别平均提升了5.6%、3.9%和3.2%。代码将发布在https://github.com/Zhuzi24/SBG。
abstract_en: Scene Graph Generation (SGG) aims to explore the relationships between objects in images and obtain scene summary graphs, thereby better serving downstream tasks. However, the long-tailed problem has adversely affected the scene graph’s quality. The predictions are dominated by coarse-grained relationships, lacking more informative fine-grained ones. The union region of one object pair (i.e., one sample) contains rich and dedicated contextual information, enabling the prediction of the sample-specific bias for refining the original relationship prediction. Therefore, we propose a novel Sample-Level Bias Prediction (SBP) method for fine-grained SGG (SBG). Firstly, we train a classic SGG model and construct a correction bias set by calculating the margin between the ground truth label and the predicted label with one classic SGG model. Then, we devise a Bias-Oriented Generative Adversarial Network (BGAN) that learns to predict the constructed correction biases, which can be utilized to correct the original predictions from coarse-grained relationships to fine-grained ones. The extensive experimental results on VG, GQA, and VG-1800 datasets demonstrate that our SBG outperforms the state-of-the-art methods in terms of Average@K across three mainstream SGG models: Motif, VCtree, and Transformer. Compared to dataset-level correction methods on VG, SBG shows a significant average improvement of 5.6%, 3.9%, and 3.2% on Average@K for tasks PredCls, SGCls, and SGDet, respectively. The code will be available at https://github.com/Zhuzi24/SBG.

title: Yanting Yang, Minghao Chen*, Qibo Qiu, Jiahao WU, Wenxiao Wang, Binbin Lin, Ziyu Guan, Xiaofei He
title_en: Yanting Yang, Minghao Chen*, Qibo Qiu, Jiahao WU, Wenxiao Wang, Binbin Lin, Ziyu Guan, Xiaofei He
abstract: 对于通用机器人在现实环境中运行,执行跨多种环境的广泛指令至关重要。强化学习和规划的核心在于可泛化的奖励函数。近年来,视觉-语言模型(如CLIP)在深度学习领域展现出卓越性能,为开放域视觉识别开辟了新途径。然而,收集机器人在多种环境中执行各类语言指令的数据仍面临挑战。本文旨在将具有强泛化能力的视频-语言模型转化为可泛化的语言条件奖励函数,仅利用单一环境中少量任务的机器人视频数据。与常用于训练奖励函数的机器人数据集不同,人类视频-语言数据集极少包含琐碎的失败视频。为增强模型区分成功与失败机器人执行的能力,我们对失败视频特征进行聚类,使模型能够识别其中的模式。对每个聚类,我们将其新训练的失败提示集成至文本编码器中,以表征相应的失败模式。我们的语言条件奖励函数在机器人规划和强化学习中展现出对新环境和新指令的出色泛化能力。
abstract_en: For a general-purpose robot to operate in reality, executing a broad range of instructions across various environments is imperative. Central to the reinforcement learning and planning for such robotic agents is a generalizable reward function. Recent advances in vision-language models, such as CLIP, have shown remarkable performance in the domain of deep learning, paving the way for open-domain visual recognition. However, collecting data on robots executing various language instructions across multiple environments remains a challenge. This paper aims to transfer video-language models with robust generalization into a generalizable language-conditioned reward function, only utilizing robot video data from a minimal amount of tasks in a singular environment. Unlike common robotic datasets used for training reward functions, human video-language datasets rarely contain trivial failure videos. To enhance the model’s ability to distinguish between successful and failed robot executions, we cluster failure video features to enable the model to identify patterns within. For each cluster, we integrate a newly trained failure prompt into the text encoder to represent the corresponding failure mode. Our language-conditioned reward function shows outstanding generalization to new environments and new instructions for robot planning and reinforcement learning.

title: 一种用于视频和图像理解的视觉语言模型(VLMs)中令牌生成挑战的新方法
title_en: Yanwei Li*, Chengyao Wang, Jiaya Jia
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法,用于解决视觉语言模型(VLMs)在视频和图像理解中的令牌生成挑战,称为LLaMA-VID。尽管当前的VLMs在图像描述生成和视觉问答等任务中表现出色,但处理长视频时由于视觉令牌过多而面临计算负担。LLaMA-VID通过为每个帧使用两个不同的令牌(即上下文令牌和内容令牌)来解决这一问题。上下文令牌基于用户输入编码整体图像上下文,而内容令牌则封装每个帧中的视觉线索。这种双令牌策略在显著降低长视频处理负担的同时保留了关键信息。总体而言,LLaMA-VID使现有框架能够支持长达一小时的视频,并通过额外的上下文令牌推动其上限。实验表明,该方法在大多数基于视频或图像的基准测试中均超越了先前方法。代码和模型可在https://github.com/dvlab-research/LLaMA-VID获取。
abstract_en: In this work, we present a novel method to tackle the token generation challenge in Vision Language Models (VLMs) for video and image understanding, called LLaMA-VID. Current VLMs, while proficient in tasks like image captioning and visual question answering, face computational burdens when processing long videos due to the excessive visual tokens. LLaMA-VID addresses this issue by representing each frame with two distinct tokens, namely context token and content token. The context token encodes the overall image context based on user input, whereas the content token encapsulates visual cues in each frame. This dual-token strategy significantly reduces the overload of long videos while preserving critical information. Generally, LLaMA-VID empowers existing frameworks to support hour-long videos and pushes their upper limit with an extra context token. It is demonstrated to surpass previous methods on most of video- or image-based benchmarks. Code and models are available at https://github.com/dvlab-research/LLaMA-VID.

title: Yanyan Li*, Chenyu Lyu, Yan Di, Guangyao Zhai, Gim Hee Lee, Federico Tombari
title_en: Yanyan Li*, Chenyu Lyu, Yan Di, Guangyao Zhai, Gim Hee Lee, Federico Tombari
abstract: 在高斯泼溅优化过程中,若未刻意保留场景几何结构,其结构会逐渐退化,尤其是在墙壁、天花板和家具表面等非纹理区域。这种退化会显著影响与训练数据中的视角差异较大的新视角的渲染质量。为缓解这一问题,我们提出了一种名为GeoGaussian的新方法。该方法基于点云中观察到的平滑连接区域,引入了一种新颖的流程来初始化与表面对齐的薄高斯分布,其中通过精心设计的密集化策略可将特征传递给新世代。最终,该流程通过具有显式几何约束的约束优化过程确保场景几何结构和纹理的保持。得益于所提出的架构,3D高斯的生成能力得到增强,尤其是在结构化区域。我们的提出流程在新视角合成和几何重建任务中实现了最先进的性能,已在公开数据集上通过定性和定量评估验证。
abstract_en: During the Gaussian Splatting optimization process, the scene geometry can gradually deteriorate if its structure is not deliberately preserved, especially in non-textured regions such as walls, ceilings, and furniture surfaces. This degradation significantly affects the rendering quality of novel views that deviate significantly from the viewpoints in the training data. To mitigate this issue, we propose a novel approach called GeoGaussian. Based on the smoothly connected areas observed from point clouds, this method introduces a novel pipeline to initialize thin Gaussians aligned with the surfaces, where the characteristic can be transferred to new generations through a carefully designed densification strategy. Finally, the pipeline ensures that the scene geometry and texture are maintained through constrained optimization processes with explicit geometry constraints. Benefiting from the proposed architecture, the generative ability of 3D Gaussians is enhanced, especially in structured regions. Our proposed pipeline achieves state-of-the-art performance in novel view synthesis and geometric reconstruction, as evaluated qualitatively and quantitatively on public datasets.

title: Yanyuan Qiao*, Qianyi Liu, Jiajun Liu, Jing Liu, Qi Wu
title_en: Yanyuan Qiao*, Qianyi Liu, Jiajun Liu, Jing Liu, Qi Wu
abstract: 视觉-语言导航(VLN)涉及通过人类提供的文本指令引导代理在室内环境中移动。粗粒度VLN凭借简短且高层级的指令获得了广泛关注,因为它更贴近现实场景。然而,一个重大挑战是这些指令往往过于简略,导致代理难以理解和执行。先前研究已探索让代理在导航过程中寻求帮助,但通常仅能从现有数据集或模拟器中获得刚性支持。大语言模型(LLMs)的出现为辅助VLN代理提供了全新途径。本文提出VLN-Copilot框架,使代理在遇到困惑时能够主动寻求帮助,LLM作为副驾驶协助导航。我们的方法引入了困惑度分数,量化代理行动决策中的不确定性,同时LLM提供实时详细导航指导。在两个粗粒度VLN数据集上的实验结果验证了该方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) involves guiding an agent through indoor environments using human-provided textual instructions. Coarse-grained VLN, with short and high-level instructions, has gained popularity as it closely mirrors real-world scenarios. However, a significant challenge is these instructions are often too concise for agents to comprehend and act upon. Previous studies have explored allowing agents to seek assistance during navigation, but typically offer rigid support from pre-existing datasets or simulators. The advent of Large Language Models (LLMs) presents a novel avenue for aiding VLN agents. This paper introduces VLN-Copilot, a framework enabling agents to actively seek assistance when encountering confusion, with the LLM serving as a copilot to facilitate navigation. Our approach includes the introduction of a confusion score, quantifying the level of uncertainty in an agent’s action decisions, while the LLM offers real-time detailed guidance for navigation. Experimental results on two coarse-grained VLN datasets show the efficacy of our method.

title: Yao DU*, Qiang Zhai, Weihang Dai, Xiaomeng Li*
title_en: Yao DU*, Qiang Zhai, Weihang Dai, Xiaomeng Li*
abstract: 序数回归是计算机视觉领域的一个基础问题,通常需要针对特定任务定制训练良好的模型。尽管预训练的视觉-语言模型(VLMs)在各种视觉任务中表现出色,但其在序数回归方面的潜力尚未得到充分探索。在本研究中,我们首先探讨了CLIP在序数回归中的潜力,期望模型能够泛化到不同的序数回归任务和场景。不幸的是,原始CLIP在该任务上表现不佳,因为当前VLMs存在一个众所周知的局限性,即难以封装如数感等组合概念。我们提出了一种简单而有效的名为NumCLIP的方法,以提升VLMs的量化理解能力。我们将精确的图像到数字特定文本匹配问题分解为粗分类和细预测两个阶段。我们通过将每个数值区间离散化并用通用语言概念进行表述,更好地利用CLIP中已有的预训练对齐能力。为了考虑序数回归的固有连续性属性,我们提出了一种新颖的细粒度跨模态排序基正则化损失,专门设计用于保持CLIP特征空间中的语义和序数对齐。在三个通用序数回归任务上的实验结果验证了NumCLIP的有效性,在历史图像年代判定和图像美学评估任务中分别实现了10%和3.83%的准确率提升。代码已公开在https://github.com/xmed-lab/NumCLIP。
abstract_en: Ordinal regression is a fundamental problem within the field of computer vision, with customised well-trained models on specific tasks. While pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) have exhibited impressive performance on various vision tasks, their potential for ordinal regression has received less exploration. In this study, we first investigate CLIP’s potential for ordinal regression, from which we expect the model could generalise to different ordinal regression tasks and scenarios. Unfortunately, vanilla CLIP fails on this task, since current VLMs have a well-documented limitation of encapsulating compositional concepts such as number sense. We propose a simple yet effective method called NumCLIP to improve the quantitative understanding of VLMs. We disassemble the exact image to number-specific text matching problem into coarse classification and fine prediction stages. We discretize and phrase each numerical bin with common language concept to better leverage the available pre-trained alignment in CLIP. To consider the inherent continuous property of ordinal regression, we propose a novel fine-grained cross-modal ranking-based regularisation loss specifically designed to keep both semantic and ordinal alignment in CLIP’s feature space. Experimental results on three general ordinal regression tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of NumCLIP, with 10% and 3.83% accuracy improvement on historical image dating and image aesthetics assessment task, respectively. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/xmed-lab/NumCLIP.

title: Yao Qiang, Chengyin Li, Prashant Khanduri, Dongxiao Zhu*
title_en: Yao Qiang, Chengyin Li, Prashant Khanduri, Dongxiao Zhu*
abstract: 视觉Transformer(ViT)因其通过注意力机制提取信息特征并建模长程依赖关系的能力,最近在解决计算机视觉(CV)问题中获得了广泛关注。尽管近期研究已探索ViT的可信性(包括其鲁棒性和可解释性),但公平性问题尚未得到充分解决。我们证明现有的针对卷积神经网络(CNNs)设计的公平性感知算法在ViT上表现不佳,这凸显了通过去偏自注意力(DSA)开发我们新框架的必要性。DSA是一种通过盲性实现公平的方法,强制ViT消除与敏感标签相关的虚假特征以缓解偏差,同时保留用于目标预测的真实特征。值得注意的是,DSA利用对抗样本定位并掩码输入图像块中的虚假特征,在训练目标中引入额外的注意力权重对齐正则化器,以鼓励学习用于目标预测的真实特征。重要的是,我们的DSA框架在多个预测任务上实现了比现有方法更优的公平性保证,而不会损害目标预测性能。代码可在https://github.com/qiangyao1988/DSA获取。
abstract_en: Vision Transformer (ViT) has recently gained significant attention in solving computer vision (CV) problems due to its capability of extracting informative features and modeling long-range dependencies through the attention mechanism. Whereas recent works have explored the trustworthiness of ViT, including its robustness and explainability, the issue of fairness has not yet been adequately addressed. We establish that the existing fairness-aware algorithms designed for CNNs do not perform well on ViT, which highlights the need to develop our novel framework via Debiased Self-Attention (DSA). DSA is a fairness-through-blindness approach that enforces ViT to eliminate spurious features correlated with the sensitive label for bias mitigation and simultaneously retain real features for target prediction. Notably, DSA leverages adversarial examples to locate and mask the spurious features in the input image patches with an additional attention weights alignment regularizer in the training objective to encourage learning real features for target prediction. Importantly, our DSA framework leads to improved fairness guarantees over prior works on multiple prediction tasks without compromising target prediction performance. Code is available at https://github.com/qiangyao1988/DSA.

title: Yao-Chih Lee*, Zhoutong Zhang, Kevin Blackburn-Matzen, Simon Niklaus, Jianming Zhang, Jia-Bin Huang, Feng Liu*
title_en: Yao-Chih Lee*, Zhoutong Zhang, Kevin Blackburn-Matzen, Simon Niklaus, Jianming Zhang, Jia-Bin Huang, Feng Liu*
abstract: 从真实场景视频中合成新视角具有挑战性,主要由于场景动态性和缺乏视差等问题。尽管现有方法在隐式神经辐射场(implicit neural radiance fields)上取得了有希望的结果,但训练和渲染速度较慢。本文重新审视显式视频表示方法,以高效地从单目视频中合成高质量的新视角。我们分别处理静态和动态视频内容。具体而言,我们使用扩展的基于平面的场景表示构建全局静态场景模型,以合成时间一致的新视角视频。我们的基于平面的场景表示通过球面调和函数和位移贴图进行增强,以捕捉视角依赖效应并建模非平面复杂表面几何。我们选择以每帧点云形式表示动态内容以提高效率。虽然此类表示可能产生不一致性,但由于运动,微小的时间不一致性在感知上被掩盖。我们开发了一种快速估计此类混合视频表示的方法,并实现实时新视角渲染。实验表明,我们的方法能够从真实场景视频中渲染出与最先进方法相当质量的新视角,且训练速度比现有方法快100倍,并支持实时渲染。项目页面:urlcolorhttps: //casual-fvs.github.io. 0 *Yao-Chih在Adobe Research实习期间完成的工作。
abstract_en: Novel view synthesis from an in-the-wild video is difficult due to challenges like scene dynamics and lack of parallax. While existing methods have shown promising results with implicit neural radiance fields, they are slow to train and render. This paper revisits explicit video representations to synthesize high-quality novel views from a monocular video efficiently. We treat static and dynamic video content separately. Specifically, we build a global static scene model using an extended plane-based scene representation to synthesize temporally coherent novel video. Our plane-based scene representation is augmented with spherical harmonics and displacement maps to capture view-dependent effects and model non-planar complex surface geometries. We opt to represent the dynamic content as per-frame point clouds for efficiency. While such representations are inconsistency-prone, minor temporal inconsistencies are perceptually masked due to motion. We develop a method to quickly estimate such a hybrid video representation and render novel views in real time. Our experiments show that our method can render high-quality novel views from an in-the-wild video with comparable quality to state-of-the-art methods while being 100× faster in training and enabling real-time rendering. Project page at urlcolorhttps: //casual-fvs.github.io. 0 *Work done while Yao-Chih was an intern at Adobe Research.

title: Yaokun Yang, Feng Lu*
title_en: Yaokun Yang, Feng Lu*
abstract: 本文介绍了一种基于头-局部-全局协调框架的新型注视目标检测方法。与传统方法依赖于估计注视方向并识别全局视图图像中的显著物体不同,我们的方法引入了基于视场角的局部视角,以更准确地预测注视目标。我们还提出了一种独特的位置与表示一致性机制,用于整合头视角、局部视角和全局视角的特征,显著提高了预测准确性。通过大量实验,我们的方法在多个重要的注视目标检测基准数据集上展示了最先进的性能,证明了其可扩展性以及局部视角和视角协调机制的有效性。该方法的可扩展性进一步通过在我们提出的头-局部-全局协调框架中提升现有注视目标检测方法的性能得到验证。
abstract_en: This paper introduces a novel approach to gaze target detection leveraging a head-local-global coordination framework. Unlike traditional methods that rely heavily on estimating gaze direction and identifying salient objects in global view images, our method incorporates a FOV-based local view to more accurately predict gaze targets. We also propose a unique global-local position and representation consistency mechanism to integrate the features from head view, local view, and global view, significantly improving prediction accuracy. Through extensive experiments, our approach demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on multiple significant gaze target detection benchmarks, showcasing its scalability and the effectiveness of the local view and view-coordination mechanisms. The method’s scalability is further evidenced by enhancing the performance of existing gaze target detection methods within our proposed head-local-global coordination framework.

title: Yaoting Wang, Peiwen Sun, Dongzhan Zhou, Guangyao Li, Honggang Zhang, Di Hu*
title_en: Yaoting Wang, Peiwen Sun, Dongzhan Zhou, Guangyao Li, Honggang Zhang, Di Hu*
abstract: 传统参考分割任务主要聚焦于无声视觉场景,忽视了多模态感知与交互在人类体验中的关键作用。本文提出了一种新型任务,称为参考音频-视觉分割(Reference Audio-Visual Segmentation, Ref-AVS),旨在基于包含多模态线索的表达形式对视觉域中的物体进行分割。此类表达形式以自然语言形式呈现,但通过音频和视觉描述等多模态线索进行丰富。为促进该研究,我们构建了首个Ref-AVS基准数据集,提供了对应多模态线索表达的物体像素级标注。为解决Ref-AVS任务,我们提出了一种新方法,充分运用多模态线索以提供精确的分割指导。最后,我们在三个测试子集上开展定量与定性实验,将我们的方法与相关任务的现有方法进行对比。实验结果验证了我们方法的有效性,突显其通过多模态线索表达实现物体精确分割的能力。数据集可在https://gewu-lab.github.io/Ref-AVS获取。
abstract_en: Traditional reference segmentation tasks have predominantly focused on silent visual scenes, neglecting the integral role of multimodal perception and interaction in human experiences. In this work, we introduce a novel task called Reference Audio-Visual Segmentation (Ref-AVS), which seeks to segment objects within the visual domain based on expressions containing multimodal cues. Such expressions are articulated in natural language forms but are enriched with multimodal cues, including audio and visual descriptions. To facilitate this research, we construct the first Ref-AVS benchmark, which provides pixel-level annotations for objects described in corresponding multimodal-cue expressions. To tackle the Ref-AVS task, we propose a new method that adequately utilizes multimodal cues to offer precise segmentation guidance. Finally, we conduct quantitative and qualitative experiments on three test subsets to compare our approach with existing methods from related tasks. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, highlighting its capability to precisely segment objects using multimodal-cue expressions. Dataset is available at https://gewu-lab.github.io/Ref-AVS.

title: 音频-视觉分割(AVS)任务旨在利用音频线索在视觉空间中分割发声物体。然而,在本工作中,我们认识到先前的AVS方法对与可听物体相关的有害分割偏好存在严重依赖,而非精确的音频引导。我们认为主要原因在于音频相比视觉缺乏稳健的语义,尤其是在多源发声场景中,导致音频对视觉空间的引导能力较弱。受文本模态已被广泛研究且包含丰富抽象语义的启发,我们提出利用视觉场景中的文本线索,通过文本内含的语义增强音频引导。我们的方法首先通过现成的图像描述生成器获取场景描述,并提示冻结的大型语言模型推断潜在发声物体作为文本线索。随后,我们引入一种新颖的语义驱动音频建模模块,结合动态掩码将音频特征与文本线索整合,从而获得具有代表性的发声物体特征。这些特征不仅包含音频线索,还具备生动的语义,为视觉空间提供更清晰的引导。在AVS基准测试中的实验结果验证了我们的方法在文本线索辅助下对音频的敏感性得到增强,在三个子集上均取得了高度竞争力的性能。项目页面:https://github.com/GeWu-Lab/Sounding-Object-Segmentation-Preference
title_en: Yaoting Wang, Peiwen Sun, Yuanchao Li, Honggang Zhang, Di Hu*
abstract_en: The Audio-Visual Segmentation (AVS) task aims to segment sounding objects in the visual space using audio cues. However, in this work, it is recognized that previous AVS methods show a heavy reliance on detrimental segmentation preferences related to audible objects, rather than precise audio guidance. We argue that the primary reason is that audio lacks robust semantics compared to vision, especially in multi-source sounding scenes, resulting in weak audio guidance over the visual space. Motivated by the the fact that text modality is well explored and contains rich abstract semantics, we propose leveraging text cues from the visual scene to enhance audio guidance with the semantics inherent in text. Our approach begins by obtaining scene descriptions through an off-the-shelf image captioner and prompting a frozen large language model to deduce potential sounding objects as text cues. Subsequently, we introduce a novel semantics-driven audio modeling module with a dynamic mask to integrate audio features with text cues, leading to representative sounding object features. These features not only encompass audio cues but also possess vivid semantics, providing clearer guidance in the visual space. Experimental results on AVS benchmarks validate that our method exhibits enhanced sensitivity to audio when aided by text cues, achieving highly competitive performance on all three subsets. Project page: https://github.com/GeWu-Lab/Sounding-Object-Segmentation-Preference

title: Yaqing Ding*, Václav Vávra, Snehal Bhayani, Qianliang Wu, Jian Yang, Zuzana Kukelova
title_en: Yaqing Ding*, Václav Vávra, Snehal Bhayani, Qianliang Wu, Jian Yang, Zuzana Kukelova
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法,从点对应及其相对深度估计基础矩阵。相对深度可以通过局部特征的尺度进行近似,这些局部特征通常可用或可通过流行深度学习方法提供的非度量单目深度估计获得。这使得所考虑的问题具有很高的相关性。为了推导高效的解决方案,我们探索了已知相对深度的基础矩阵的新几何约束,并提出了基础矩阵与平移向量之间的新代数约束。利用点对应及其相对深度,我们分别推导了针对两个完全非校准相机、两个具有不同未知焦距的相机以及两个具有相等未知焦距的相机的新型高效最小解算器。我们根据相对深度信息的来源提出了这些解算器的不同变体。我们提供了详细的分析和与最先进解算器的比较结果,包括来自三个大规模数据集的86、306对图像的结果。
abstract_en: We propose a novel approach to estimate the fundamental matrix from point correspondences and their relative depths. Relative depths can be approximated from the scales of local features, which are commonly available or can be obtained from non-metric monocular depth estimates provided by popular deep learning-based methods. This makes the considered problem very relevant. To derive efficient solutions, we explore new geometric constraints on the fundamental matrix with known relative depths and present new algebraic constraints between the fundamental matrix and the translation vector. Using point correspondences and their relative depths, we derive novel efficient minimal solvers for two fully uncalibrated cameras, two cameras with different unknown focal lengths, and two cameras with equal unknown focal lengths, respectively. We propose different variants of these solvers based on the source of the relative depth information. We present detailed analyses and comparisons with state-of-the-art solvers, including results with 86, 306 image pairs from three large-scale datasets.

title: Yarden Frenkel*, Yael Vinker, Ariel Shamir, Danny Cohen-Or
title_en: Yarden Frenkel*, Yael Vinker, Ariel Shamir, Danny Cohen-Or
abstract: 图像风格化涉及在保留其底层对象、结构和概念(内容)的同时,对图像的视觉外观和纹理(风格)进行操作。风格与内容的分离对于独立操控图像的风格而不会影响其内容至关重要,从而确保和谐且视觉上令人愉悦的结果。实现这种分离需要深入理解图像的视觉和语义特征,通常需要训练专用模型或进行复杂的优化。在本文中,我们引入了B-LoRA方法,该方法利用LoRA(低秩适应)隐式分离单张图像的风格和内容成分,从而支持多种图像风格化任务。通过分析SDXL架构与LoRA的结合,我们发现联合学习两个特定块(称为B-LoRAs)的LoRA权重能够实现无法通过独立训练每个B-LoRA实现的风格-内容分离。将训练集中于仅两个块并分离风格与内容,显著提升了风格操控能力,并克服了模型微调常伴随的过拟合问题。训练完成后,这两个B-LoRAs可作为独立组件,支持多种图像风格化任务,包括图像风格迁移、基于文本的图像风格化、一致风格生成以及风格-内容混合。
abstract_en: Image stylization involves manipulating the visual appearance and texture (style) of an image while preserving its underlying objects, structures, and concepts (content). The separation of style and content is essential for manipulating the image’s style independently from its content, ensuring a harmonious and visually pleasing result. Achieving this separation requires a deep understanding of both the visual and semantic characteristics of images, often necessitating the training of specialized models or employing heavy optimization. In this paper, we introduce B-LoRA, a method that leverages LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) to implicitly separate the style and content components of a single image, facilitating various image stylization tasks. By analyzing the architecture of SDXL combined with LoRA, we find that jointly learning the LoRA weights of two specific blocks (referred to as B-LoRAs) achieves style-content separation that cannot be achieved by training each B-LoRA independently. Consolidating the training into only two blocks and separating style and content allows for significantly improving style manipulation and overcoming overfitting issues often associated with model fine-tuning. Once trained, the two B-LoRAs can be used as independent components to allow various image stylization tasks, including image style transfer, text-based image stylization, consistent style generation, and style-content mixing.

title: Yasar U Alcalar*, Mehmet Akcakaya
title_en: Yasar U Alcalar*, Mehmet Akcakaya
abstract: 扩散模型已成为解决逆问题的强大生成技术。尽管在图像领域的多种逆问题中取得了成功,但这些模型需要许多步骤才能收敛,导致推理时间缓慢。最近,扩散模型在采用复杂噪声调度方面出现了趋势,该调度涉及在较低噪声水平下更频繁地迭代时间步,从而提高图像生成和收敛速度。然而,将这些思想应用于扩散模型解决逆问题仍面临挑战,因为这些噪声调度在使用经验调优前向模型对数似然项权重时表现不佳。为解决这些挑战,我们提出了零样本近似后验采样(ZAPS),该方法利用与零样本物理驱动深度学习的联系。ZAPS固定采样步数,并通过物理引导的损失函数进行零样本训练,以在每个不规则时间步学习对数似然权重。我们将ZAPS应用于最近提出的扩散后验采样方法作为基线,尽管ZAPS也可与其他后验采样扩散模型结合使用。我们进一步通过可学习对角项的对角化方法近似先验对数的Hessian矩阵,以提高计算效率。这些参数在固定数量的训练周期内优化,计算预算固定。我们的实验结果表明,在包括高斯和运动去模糊、图像修复和超分辨率等各类噪声逆问题中,ZAPS减少了推理时间,增强了对不规则噪声调度的鲁棒性,并提高了重建质量。代码可在https://github.com/ualcalar17/ZAPS获取。
abstract_en: Diffusion models have emerged as powerful generative techniques for solving inverse problems. Despite their success in a variety of inverse problems in imaging, these models require many steps to converge, leading to slow inference time. Recently, there has been a trend in diffusion models for employing sophisticated noise schedules that involve more frequent iterations of timesteps at lower noise levels, thereby improving image generation and convergence speed. However, application of these ideas for solving inverse problems with diffusion models remain challenging, as these noise schedules do not perform well when using empirical tuning for the forward model log-likelihood term weights. To tackle these challenges, we propose zero-shot approximate posterior sampling (ZAPS) that leverages connections to zero-shot physics-driven deep learning. ZAPS fixes the number of sampling steps, and uses zero-shot training with a physics-guided loss function to learn log-likelihood weights at each irregular timestep. We apply ZAPS to the recently proposed diffusion posterior sampling method as baseline, though ZAPS can also be used with other posterior sampling diffusion models. We further approximate the Hessian of the logarithm of the prior using a diagonalization approach with learnable diagonal entries for computational efficiency. These parameters are optimized over a fixed number of epochs with a given computational budget. Our results for various noisy inverse problems, including Gaussian and motion deblurring, inpainting, and super-resolution show that ZAPS reduces inference time, provides robustness to irregular noise schedules and improves reconstruction quality. Code is available at https://github.com/ualcalar17/ZAPS.

title: Yash Bhalgat*, Iro Laina, Joao F Henriques, Andrew Zisserman, Andrea Vedaldi
title_en: Yash Bhalgat*, Iro Laina, Joao F Henriques, Andrew Zisserman, Andrea Vedaldi
abstract: 在计算机视觉中,理解多层次抽象的复杂场景仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。为了解决这一问题,我们引入了嵌套神经特征场(Nested Neural Feature Fields),这是一种新颖的方法,通过分层监督学习单个特征场,其中同一高维特征的不同维度编码不同粒度的场景属性。我们的方法允许灵活定义层次结构,适用于物理维度、语义或两者结合,从而实现对场景的全面而细致的理解。我们利用一个2D无类别分割模型,在图像空间中提供任意尺度的语义有意义的像素分组,并查询CLIP视觉编码器以获取每个分组的语言对齐嵌入。我们提出的分层监督方法随后通过延迟体积渲染在不同物理尺度上将CLIP嵌入分配到特征场的不同嵌套维度,从而创建从粗到细的表示。大量实验表明,我们的方法在开放词汇3D分割和定位任务上优于最先进的特征场蒸馏方法,证明了所学嵌套特征场的有效性。
abstract_en: Understanding complex scenes at multiple levels of abstraction remains a formidable challenge in computer vision. To address this, we introduce Nested Neural Feature Fields (), a novel approach that employs hierarchical supervision to learn a single feature field, wherein different dimensions within the same high-dimensional feature encode scene properties at varying granularities. Our method allows for a flexible definition of hierarchies, tailored to either the physical dimensions or semantics or both, thereby enabling a comprehensive and nuanced understanding of scenes. We leverage a 2D class-agnostic segmentation model to provide semantically meaningful pixel groupings at arbitrary scales in the image space, and query the CLIP vision-encoder to obtain language-aligned embeddings for each of these segments. Our proposed hierarchical supervision method then assigns different nested dimensions of the feature field to distill the CLIP embeddings using deferred volumetric rendering at varying physical scales, creating a coarse-to-fine representation. Extensive experiments show that our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art feature field distillation methods on tasks such as open-vocabulary 3D segmentation and localization, demonstrating the effectiveness of the learned nested feature field.

title: Yash Sanghvi*, Yiheng Chi, Stanley Chan
title_en: Yash Sanghvi*, Yiheng Chi, Stanley Chan
abstract: 盲去卷积问题由于底层信号和前向算子均未知,导致问题严重不适定。传统方法通过交替估计图像和核函数,固定另一部分进行求解。本文指出该框架存在缺陷,因其易陷入局部极小值,建议采用非盲求解器的核函数估计策略。该框架通过一种扩散方法实现,该方法经训练可从条件分布中采样模糊核,并借助预训练的非盲求解器进行引导。所提出的扩散方法在合成和真实模糊数据集上均达到最先进的结果。
abstract_en: Blind deconvolution problems are severely ill-posed because neither the underlying signal nor the forward operator are not known exactly. Conventionally, these problems are solved by alternating between estimation of the image and kernel while keeping the other fixed. In this paper, we show that this framework is flawed because of its tendency to get trapped in local minima and, instead, suggest the use of a kernel estimation strategy with a non-blind solver. This framework is employed by a diffusion method which is trained to sample the blur kernel from the conditional distribution with guidance from a pre-trained non-blind solver. The proposed diffusion method leads to state-of-the-art results on both synthetic and real blur datasets.

title: Yashika Jain, Ali Dabouei*, Min Xu*
title_en: Yashika Jain, Ali Dabouei*, Min Xu*
abstract: 视频异常检测(VAD)可自动化识别监控视频中的异常事件,如安全威胁。在实际应用中,VAD模型必须在跨域场景中有效运行,识别训练数据中未充分表示的罕见异常和场景。然而,现有跨域VAD方法主要关注无监督学习,导致性能无法满足实际需求。由于获取源域的弱监督(视频级标签)成本较低,我们推测结合外部未标记数据具有显著提升跨域性能的潜力。为此,我们提出了一种新颖的弱监督框架,用于视频异常检测中的跨域学习(CDL),通过估计外部数据的预测偏差并利用预测不确定性自适应最小化该偏差来融入外部数据。我们在两个大规模VAD数据集(UCF-Crime和XD-Violence)上进行了多配置的综合实验,验证了所提CDL框架的有效性。我们的方法在跨域评估中显著超越了现有最先进方法,在UCF-Crime上平均绝对提升19.6%,在XD-Violence上提升12.87%。
abstract_en: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) automates the identification of unusual events, such as security threats in surveillance videos. In real-world applications, VAD models must effectively operate in cross-domain settings, identifying rare anomalies and scenarios not well-represented in the training data. However, existing cross-domain VAD methods focus on unsupervised learning, resulting in performance that falls short of real-world expectations. Since acquiring weak supervision, , video-level labels, for the source domain is cost-effective, we conjecture that combining it with external unlabeled data has notable potential to enhance cross-domain performance. To this end, we introduce a novel weakly-supervised framework for Cross-Domain Learning (CDL) in VAD that incorporates external data during training by estimating its prediction bias and adaptively minimizing that using the predicted uncertainty. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed CDL framework through comprehensive experiments conducted in various configurations on two large-scale VAD datasets: UCF-Crime and XD-Violence. Our method significantly surpasses the state-of-the-art works in cross-domain evaluations, achieving an average absolute improvement of 19.6% on UCF-Crime and 12.87% on XD-Violence.

title: Yasi Zhang*, Peiyu Yu, Ying Nian Wu
title_en: Yasi Zhang*, Peiyu Yu, Ying Nian Wu
abstract: 文本到图像扩散模型在生成高质量文本引导图像方面表现出显著成功。然而,这些模型仍可能无法将生成的图像与提供的文本提示进行语义对齐,导致诸如属性绑定错误和/或灾难性物体忽略等问题。鉴于文本提示中普遍存在的面向对象结构,我们引入了一种新颖的基于对象条件的Energy-Based Attention Map Alignment(EBAMA)方法以解决上述问题。我们证明,通过负采样技术的帮助,近似最大化z参数化能量模型的对数似然值可自然地产生以对象为中心的属性绑定损失。我们进一步提出了一种以对象为中心的强度正则化器,以防止对象注意力过度向其属性转移。在多个具有挑战性的基准数据集上的大量定性和定量实验(包括人工评估)表明,我们的方法在性能上优于先前的强对比方法。通过更好的注意力图对齐,我们的方法在进一步增强扩散模型的文本控制图像编辑能力方面展现出巨大潜力。代码可在https://github.com/YasminZhang/EBAMA获取。
abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models have shown great success in generating high-quality text-guided images. Yet, these models may still fail to semantically align generated images with the provided text prompts, leading to problems like incorrect attribute binding and/or catastrophic object neglect. Given the pervasive object-oriented structure underlying text prompts, we introduce a novel object-conditioned Energy-Based Attention Map Alignment (EBAMA) method to address the aforementioned problems. We show that an object-centric attribute binding loss naturally emerges by approximately maximizing the log-likelihood of a z-parameterized energy-based model with the help of the negative sampling technique. We further propose an object-centric intensity regularizer to prevent excessive shifts of objects attention towards their attributes. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments, including human evaluation, on several challenging benchmarks demonstrate the superior performance of our method over previous strong counterparts. With better aligned attention maps, our approach shows great promise in further enhancing the text-controlled image editing ability of diffusion models. The code is available at https://github.com/YasminZhang/ EBAMA.

title: 基于对比预训练的视觉-语言嵌入模型的LVLM偏好优化方法CLIP-DPO
title_en: Yassine Ouali*, Adrian Bulat*, Brais Martinez, Georgios Tzimiropoulos
abstract: 尽管近期取得了成功,大视觉语言模型(LVLMs)仍容易产生如物体及其属性或关系等细节的幻觉,限制了其在现实场景中的部署。为解决这一问题并提升其鲁棒性,我们提出了CLIP-DPO,一种基于对比预训练视觉-语言(VL)嵌入模型(如CLIP)的偏好优化方法,用于LVLMs的DPO优化。与以往解决LVLM幻觉问题的工作不同,我们的方法不依赖付费API,也不需要额外的训练数据或部署其他外部LVLMs。相反,我们从初始的监督微调数据集中生成多样化的预测结果,基于CLIP图像-文本相似性对预测结果进行排序,并通过稳健的规则方法筛选,获得用于DPO训练的正负样本对。我们将CLIP-DPO微调应用于MobileVLM-v2系列模型和LlaVA-1.5,在所有情况下均观察到与基线模型相比幻觉减少的显著提升。我们还发现零样本分类性能有所改善,表明模型的 grounding 能力增强,并验证了在标准LVLM基准测试中的原始性能总体得以保留。
abstract_en: Despite recent successes, LVLMs or Large Vision Language Models are prone to hallucinating details like objects and their properties or relations, limiting their real-world deployment. To address this and improve their robustness, we present CLIP-DPO, a preference optimization method that leverages contrastively pre-trained Vision-Language (VL) embedding models, such as CLIP, for DPO-based optimization of LVLMs. Unlike prior works tackling LVLM hallucinations, our method does not rely on paid-for APIs, and does not require additional training data or the deployment of other external LVLMs. Instead, starting from the initial pool of supervised fine-tuning data, we generate a diverse set of predictions, which are ranked based on their CLIP image-text similarities, and then filtered using a robust rule-based approach to obtain a set of positive and negative pairs for DPO-based training. We applied CLIP-DPO fine-tuning to the MobileVLM-v2 family of models and to LlaVA-1.5, in all cases observing significant improvements in terms of hallucination reduction over baseline models. We also observe better performance for zero-shot classification, suggesting improved grounding capabilities, and verify that the original performance on standard LVLM benchmarks is overall preserved.

title: Yasumasa Onoe*, Sunayana Rane, Zachary E Berger, Yonatan Bitton, Jaemin Cho, Roopal Garg, Alexander Ku, Zarana Parekh, Jordi Pont-Tuset, Garrett Tanzer, Su Wang, Jason M Baldridge
title_en: Yasumasa Onoe*, Sunayana Rane, Zachary E Berger, Yonatan Bitton, Jaemin Cho, Roopal Garg, Alexander Ku, Zarana Parekh, Jordi Pont-Tuset, Garrett Tanzer, Su Wang, Jason M Baldridge
abstract: 视觉-语言数据集对于文本到图像(T2I)和图像到文本(I2T)研究至关重要。然而,当前数据集缺乏细粒度描述,这限制了模型学习更丰富关联的能力。为填补这一空白,我们引入了描述连接与对比图像的数据集(DOCCI),该数据集包含15,000张由单一研究者拍摄、整理并捐赠的图像,每张图像均配有长达136词的英文人工标注描述。这些描述旨在清晰区分图像与其相关或相似图像,涵盖空间关系、计数、文本渲染、世界知识等关键挑战。通过定量与定性分析,我们证明DOCCI是图像到文本生成的有效训练资源——基于DOCCI微调的PaLI 5B模型表现与LLaVA-1.5 7B和InstructBLIP 7B等高性能大模型相当或更优。此外,我们还表明DOCCI是文本到图像生成的有用测试平台,突显了当前文本到图像模型在捕捉长描述和细粒度细节方面的局限性。† 等贡献。∗ 作为谷歌学生研究员完成的工作。
abstract_en: Vision-language datasets are vital for both text-to-image (T2I) and image-to-text (I2T) research. However, current datasets lack descriptions with fine-grained detail that would allow for richer associations to be learned by models. To fill the gap, we introduce Descriptions of Connected and Contrasting Images (DOCCI), a dataset with long, human-annotated English descriptions for 15k images that were taken, curated and donated by a single researcher intent on capturing key challenges such as spatial relations, counting, text rendering, world knowledge, and more. We instruct human annotators to create comprehensive descriptions for each image; these average 136 words in length and are crafted to clearly distinguish each image from those that are related or similar. Each description is highly compositional and typically encompasses multiple challenges. Through both quantitative and qualitative analyses, we demonstrate that DOCCI serves as an effective training resource for image-to-text generation – a PaLI 5B model finetuned on DOCCI shows equal or superior results compared to highly-performant larger models like LLaVA-1.5 7B and InstructBLIP 7B. Furthermore, we show that DOCCI is a useful testbed for text-to-image generation, highlighting the limitations of current text-to-image models in capturing long descriptions and fine details. † Equal contribution. ∗ Work done as a Student Researcher at Google.

title: Yaxin Luo, Jiayi Ji, Xiaofu Chen, Yuxin Zhang, Tianhe Ren, Gen Luo*
title_en: Yaxin Luo, Jiayi Ji, Xiaofu Chen, Yuxin Zhang, Tianhe Ren, Gen Luo*
abstract: 指称表达理解(REC)旨在根据给定的指称表达定位目标对象,这需要昂贵的实例级标注进行训练。为解决这一问题,近期研究探索了一种高效的单阶段弱监督REC模型RefCLIP。特别是,RefCLIP利用预训练单阶段检测网络的锚点特征表示候选对象,并通过锚点-文本排序定位指称对象。尽管效果显著,我们发现RefCLIP的视觉语义存在模糊性和不足,难以满足弱监督REC建模需求。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖方法,通过多种提示信息丰富视觉语义,称为基于锚点的提示学习(APL)。具体而言,APL包含创新的基于锚点的提示编码器(APE),生成涵盖REC建模三个方面的判别性提示,例如位置、颜色和类别。这些提示动态融合至锚点特征中以提升视觉描述能力。此外,我们提出两个新颖的辅助目标实现APL中的精准视觉-语言对齐,即文本重建损失和视觉对齐损失。为验证APL,我们在四个REC基准数据集(RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg和ReferIt)上进行大量实验。实验结果不仅展示了APL在四个基准上的SOTA性能(如在RefCOCO上比RefCLIP提升6.44%),还验证了其在弱监督指称表达分割中的强泛化能力。源代码已发布于:https://github.com/Yaxin9Luo/APL.
abstract_en: Referring Expression Comprehension (REC) aims to ground the target object based on a given referring expression, which requires expensive instance-level annotations for training. To address this issue, recent advances explore an efficient one-stage weakly supervised REC model called RefCLIP. Particularly, RefCLIP utilizes anchor features of pre-trained one-stage detection networks to represent candidate objects and conducts anchor-text ranking to locate the referent. Despite the effectiveness, we identify that visual semantics of RefCLIP are ambiguous and insufficient for weakly supervised REC modeling. To address this issue, we propose a novel method that enriches visual semantics with various prompt information, called anchor-based prompt learning (APL). Specifically, APL contains an innovative anchor-based prompt encoder (APE) to produce discriminative prompts covering three aspects of REC modeling, e.g., position, color and category. These prompts are dynamically fused into anchor features to improve the visual description power. In addition, we propose two novel auxiliary objectives to achieve accurate vision-language alignment in APL, namely text reconstruction loss and visual alignment loss. To validate APL, we conduct extensive experiments on four REC benchmarks, namely RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, RefCOCOg and ReferIt. Experimental results not only show the state-of-the-art performance of APL against existing methods on four benchmarks, e.g., +6.44% over RefCLIP on RefCOCO, but also confirm its strong generalization ability on weakly supervised referring expression segmentation. Source codes released at: https://github.com/Yaxin9Luo/APL.

title_en: Yaxuan Qin, Jiayu Xu, Ruiping Wang*, Xilin Chen
abstract: 和
abstract_en: Object placement is a task to insert a foreground object into a background scene at a suitable position and size. Existing methods mainly focus on extracting better visual features, while neglecting common sense about the objects and background. It leads to semantically unrealistic object positions. In this paper, we introduce Think Before Placement, a novel framework that effectively combines the implicit and explicit knowledge to generate placements that are both visually coherent and contextually appropriate. Specifically, we first adopt a large multi-modal model to generate a descriptive caption that identifies an appropriate position in the background for placing foreground object(Think ), then output proper position and size of the object (Place). The caption serves as an explicit semantic guidance for the subsequent placement of objects. Using this framework, we implement our model named CSENet, which outperforms baseline methods on the OPA dataset in extensive experiments. Further, we establish the OPAZ dataset to evaluate the zero-shot transfer capabilities of CSENet, where it also shows impressive performance across different foreground objects and scenes.

title: 视频时间定位与逆向递归调优
title_en: Ye Liu, Jixuan He, Wanhua Li*, Junsik Kim, Donglai Wei, Hanspeter Pfister, Chang Wen Chen*
abstract: 视频时间定位(VTG)是一项细粒度视频理解任务,旨在根据自然语言查询在未剪辑视频中定位相关片段。现有大多数VTG模型均基于帧级最终层CLIP特征构建,并借助额外的时间主干网络(如SlowFast)及复杂的时间推理机制。本文主张CLIP本身已展现出强大的细粒度时空建模潜力,因其每一层在不同粒度层级下均能提供独特且有用的信息。受此启发,我们提出逆向递归调优(R2-Tuning),这是一种参数和内存高效的视频时间定位迁移学习框架。我们的方法仅需学习一个包含总参数量1.5%的轻量模块,即可实现渐进式时空建模。从CLIP最后一层开始,通过递归聚合早期层的空域特征,再根据给定查询精炼时序相关性,形成由粗到细的方案。该方法在六个公开基准(QVHighlights、Charades-STA、Ego4D-NLQ、TACoS、YouTube Highlights和TVSum)的三个VTG任务(时刻检索、亮点检测和视频摘要)中,即使不使用额外主干网络也取得了最先进性能,验证了所提方案的显著性和有效性。我们的代码已开源于https://github.com/yeliudev/R2-Tuning。
abstract_en: Video temporal grounding (VTG) is a fine-grained video understanding problem that aims to ground relevant clips in untrimmed videos given natural language queries. Most existing VTG models are built upon frame-wise final-layer CLIP features, aided by additional temporal backbones (, SlowFast) with sophisticated temporal reasoning mechanisms. In this work, we claim that CLIP itself already shows great potential for fine-grained spatial-temporal modeling, as each layer offers distinct yet useful information under different granularity levels. Motivated by this, we propose Reversed Recurrent Tuning (), a parameter- and memory-efficient transfer learning framework for video temporal grounding. Our method learns a lightweight containing only 1.5% of the total parameters to perform progressive spatial-temporal modeling. Starting from the last layer of CLIP, recurrently aggregates spatial features from earlier layers, then refines temporal correlation conditioning on the given query, resulting in a coarse-to-fine scheme. achieves state-of-the-art performance across three VTG tasks (, moment retrieval, highlight detection, and video summarization) on six public benchmarks (, QVHighlights, Charades-STA, Ego4D-NLQ, TACoS, YouTube Highlights, and TVSum) even without the additional backbone, demonstrating the significance and effectiveness of the proposed scheme. Our code is available at https://github.com/yeliudev/ R2-Tuning.

title: 叶宇,陈峰新,余俊*,甘振
title_en: Ye Yu, Fengxin Chen, Jun Yu*, Zhen Kan
abstract: 尽管近年来低光照图像增强(LLIE)方法取得了显著进展,但在应用于复杂场景时,它们仍面临视觉质量低和泛化能力弱等挑战。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了一种基于潜在均值教师和高斯过程的半监督方法,命名为LMT-GP。我们首先设计了一个潜在均值教师框架,将带标签和不带标签的数据以及它们的潜在向量整合到模型训练中。同时,我们使用均值教师辅助的高斯过程学习策略,建立从带标签和不带标签数据中获得的潜在和伪潜在向量之间的联系。为了指导学习过程,我们利用辅助高斯过程回归(GPR)损失函数。此外,我们设计了一个伪标签适应模块(PAM),以确保网络学习的可靠性。为了验证我们方法的泛化能力和有效性,我们将其应用于多个LLIE数据集和高层视觉任务。实验结果表明,我们的方法在泛化性能和图像质量方面均表现出色。代码可在https://github.com/HFUT-CV/LMT-GP获取。
abstract_en: While recent low-light image enhancement (LLIE) methods have made significant advancements, they still face challenges in terms of low visual quality and weak generalization ability when applied to complex scenarios. To address these issues, we propose a semi-supervised method based on latent mean-teacher and Gaussian process, named LMT-GP. We first design a latent mean-teacher framework that integrates both labeled and unlabeled data, as well as their latent vectors, into model training. Meanwhile, we use a mean-teacher-assisted Gaussian process learning strategy to establish a connection between the latent and pseudo-latent vectors obtained from the labeled and unlabeled data. To guide the learning process, we utilize an assisted Gaussian process regression (GPR) loss function. Furthermore, we design a pseudo-label adaptation module (PAM) to ensure the reliability of the network learning. To demonstrate our method’s generalization ability and effectiveness, we apply it to multiple LLIE datasets and high-level vision tasks. Experiment results demonstrate that our method achieves high generalization performance and image quality. The code is available at https://github.com/HFUT-CV/LMT-GP

title: Yeji Song*, Wonsik Shin, Junsoo Lee, Jeesoo Kim, Nojun Kwak*
title_en: Yeji Song*, Wonsik Shin, Junsoo Lee, Jeesoo Kim, Nojun Kwak*
abstract: 在文本到图像(T2I)生成模型取得显著进展的推动下,文本到视频(T2V)生成技术也取得了重大突破。因此,诸如修改视频中的物体或改变视频风格等任务已成为可能。然而,以往的研究通常在简单且一致的形状上表现良好,但在面对与原始形状差异较大的复杂目标时容易崩溃。本文我们发现现有视频编辑方法中存在的偏差问题,该问题限制了新主角的选择范围,并尝试通过传统的图像级个性化方法来解决这一问题。我们采用运动个性化方法,从单一源视频中分离运动信息,并据此修改主角。为应对图像与视频之间的自然差异,我们提出了一种膨胀文本嵌入的运动词,以准确表示源视频中的运动。此外,我们通过引入一种新颖的伪光流来规范运动词,该伪光流可高效地从预计算的注意力图中计算得出。最后,我们通过一个额外的伪词将运动与源视频的外观分离。大量实验验证了我们方法的编辑能力,为更多样化和广泛的视频编辑迈出了重要一步。我们的项目页面:https://ldynx.github.io/SAVE/
abstract_en: Driven by the upsurge progress in text-to-image (T2I) generation models, text-to-video (T2V) generation has experienced a significant advance as well. Accordingly, tasks such as modifying the object or changing the style in a video have been possible. However, previous works usually work well on trivial and consistent shapes, and easily collapse on a difficult target that has a largely different body shape from the original one. In this paper, we spot the bias problem in the existing video editing method that restricts the range of choices for the new protagonist and attempt to address this issue using the conventional image-level personalization method. We adopt motion personalization that isolates the motion from a single source video and then modifies the protagonist accordingly. To deal with the natural discrepancy between image and video, we propose a motion word with an inflated textual embedding to properly represent the motion in a source video. We also regulate the motion word to attend to proper motion-related areas by introducing a novel pseudo optical flow, efficiently computed from the pre-calculated attention maps. Finally, we decouple the motion from the appearance of the source video with an additional pseudo word. Extensive experiments demonstrate the editing capability of our method, taking a step toward more diverse and extensive video editing. Our project page: https://ldynx.github.io/SAVE/

title: Yeongtak Oh, Jonghyun Lee, Jooyoung Choi, Dahuin Jung, Uiwon Hwang*, Sungroh Yoon*
title_en: Yeongtak Oh, Jonghyun Lee, Jooyoung Choi, Dahuin Jung, Uiwon Hwang*, Sungroh Yoon*
abstract: 测试时适应(TTA)解决测试过程中出现的未预见的分布偏移问题。在TTA中,性能、内存消耗和时间消耗是关键考量因素。一种近期基于扩散的TTA方法用于恢复损坏图像,涉及图像级更新。然而,使用像素空间扩散相比传统模型更新的TTA方法显著增加了资源需求,暴露出作为TTA方法的局限性。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的TTA方法,该方法基于潜在扩散模型(LDM)的图像编辑模型,并利用我们新引入的损坏建模方案对其进行微调。该方案通过创建(干净,损坏)图像对,增强扩散模型对分布偏移的鲁棒性,并微调模型以将损坏图像编辑为干净图像。此外,我们引入了蒸馏变体,仅使用4次网络功能评估(NFEs)加速损坏编辑。我们在包括图像和视频领域的多种架构和数据集上广泛验证了该方法。我们的模型在运行速度上比基于扩散的基线快100倍,并且比使用数据增强的先前模型更新TTA方法快3倍,使图像级更新方法更加可行。1 1 项目页面:magentahttps://github.com/oyt9306/Decorruptor
abstract_en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) addresses the unforeseen distribution shifts occurring during test time. In TTA, performance, memory consumption, and time consumption are crucial considerations. A recent diffusion-based TTA approach for restoring corrupted images involves image-level updates. However, using pixel space diffusion significantly increases resource requirements compared to conventional model updating TTA approaches, revealing limitations as a TTA method. To address this, we propose a novel TTA method that leverages an image editing model based on a latent diffusion model (LDM) and fine-tunes it using our newly introduced corruption modeling scheme. This scheme enhances the robustness of the diffusion model against distribution shifts by creating (clean, corrupted) image pairs and fine-tuning the model to edit corrupted images into clean ones. Moreover, we introduce a distilled variant to accelerate the model for corruption editing using only 4 network function evaluations (NFEs). We extensively validated our method across various architectures and datasets including image and video domains. Our model achieves the best performance with a 100 times faster runtime than that of a diffusion-based baseline. Furthermore, it is three times faster than the previous model updating TTA method that utilizes data augmentation, making an image-level updating approach more feasible. 1 1 Project page: magentahttps://github.com/oyt9306/Decorruptor

title: Jin Yeying*, Li Xin, Wang Jiadong, Zhan Yan, Zhang Malu*
title_en: Yeying Jin*, Xin Li, Jiadong Wang, Yan Zhan, Malu Zhang*
abstract: 现有雨滴去除数据集存在两个缺陷。首先,这些数据集主要由背景聚焦的相机拍摄图像组成,导致雨滴呈现模糊状态。据我们所知,这些数据集中没有包含专门聚焦雨滴的图像,从而导致背景模糊。其次,这些数据集主要由白天图像构成,缺乏夜间雨滴场景。因此,基于这些数据集训练的算法可能在雨滴聚焦或夜间场景中表现不佳。缺乏专门针对雨滴聚焦和夜间雨滴的数据集限制了该领域的研究。本文我们引入了一个大规模、真实世界雨滴去除数据集Raindrop Clarity。Raindrop Clarity包含15,186组高质量的配对/三元组(雨滴、模糊和背景)图像及其对应的清晰背景图像。其中包含5,442张白天雨滴图像和9,744张夜间雨滴图像。具体而言,5,442张白天图像包括3,606张雨滴聚焦图像和1,836张背景聚焦图像。而9,744张夜间图像包含4,834张雨滴聚焦图像和4,906张背景聚焦图像。我们的数据集将使社区能够探索背景聚焦和雨滴聚焦图像,包括白天和夜间条件下的独特挑战。1 1 我们的数据和代码可在以下链接获取:https://github.com/jinyeying/RaindropClarity
abstract_en: Existing raindrop removal datasets have two shortcomings. First, they consist of images captured by cameras with a focus on the background, leading to the presence of blurry raindrops. To our knowledge, none of these datasets include images where the focus is specifically on raindrops, which results in a blurry background. Second, these datasets predominantly consist of daytime images, thereby lacking nighttime raindrop scenarios. Consequently, algorithms trained on these datasets may struggle to perform effectively in raindrop-focused or nighttime scenarios. The absence of datasets specifically designed for raindrop-focused and nighttime raindrops constrains research in this area. In this paper, we introduce a large-scale, real-world raindrop removal dataset called Raindrop Clarity. Raindrop Clarity comprises 15,186 high-quality pairs/triplets (raindrops, blur, and background) of images with raindrops and the corresponding clear background images. There are 5,442 daytime raindrop images and 9,744 nighttime raindrop images. Specifically, the 5,442 daytime images include 3,606 raindropand 1,836 background-focused images. While the 9,744 nighttime images contain 4,834 raindrop- and 4,906 background-focused images. Our dataset will enable the community to explore background-focused and raindrop-focused images, including challenges unique to daytime and nighttime conditions. 1 1 Our data and code are available at: https://github.com/jinyeying/RaindropClarity

title: 基于监督学习的对抗攻击检测方法依赖大量标记数据,在将训练模型应用于新领域时性能显著下降
title_en: Yi Li*, Plamen Angelov, Neeraj Suri
abstract: 本文提出一种自监督表示学习框架,用于对抗攻击检测任务以解决上述问题。首先,我们将增强输入图像的像素映射到嵌入空间。随后,采用原型级对比估计损失对原型进行聚类作为潜在变量。此外,受记忆库概念启发,引入判别库以区分并学习共享相同或相似原型的实例表示,建立实例与原型间的关联。提出基于并行轴向注意力(PAA)的编码器,通过在注意力图的高度和宽度轴上并行训练提升训练效率。实验表明,与多种基准自监督视觉学习模型及监督对抗攻击检测方法相比,所提模型在对抗攻击检测任务中实现了最先进性能,适用于广泛图像。
abstract_en: Supervised learning-based adversarial attack detection methods rely on a large number of labeled data and suffer significant performance degradation when applying the trained model to new domains. In this paper, we propose a self-supervised representation learning framework for the adversarial attack detection task to address this drawback. Firstly, we map the pixels of augmented input images into an embedding space. Then, we employ the prototype-wise contrastive estimation loss to cluster prototypes as latent variables. Additionally, drawing inspiration from the concept of memory banks, we introduce a discrimination bank to distinguish and learn representations for each individual instance that shares the same or a similar prototype, establishing a connection between instances and their associated prototypes. We propose a parallel axial-attention (PAA)-based encoder to facilitate the training process by parallel training over height- and width-axis of attention maps. Experimental results show that, compared to various benchmark self-supervised vision learning models and supervised adversarial attack detection methods, the proposed model achieves state-of-the-art performance on the adversarial attack detection task across a wide range of images.

title: Yi Wang*, Conrad M Albrecht, Nassim Ait Ali Braham, Chenying Liu, Zhitong Xiong, Xiao Xiang Zhu
title_en: Yi Wang*, Conrad M Albrecht, Nassim Ait Ali Braham, Chenying Liu, Zhitong Xiong, Xiao Xiang Zhu
abstract: 多传感器数据的日益丰富引发了对多模态自监督学习的广泛关注。然而,大多数现有方法仅学习跨模态的通用表示,而忽视了同模态训练和模态特有表示。我们提出了一种简单而有效的多模态自监督学习方法——解耦通用与特有表示(DeCUR)。通过多模态冗余减少区分跨模态和同模态嵌入,DeCUR能够整合不同模态间的互补信息。我们在三种常见的多模态场景(雷达-光学、RGB-高程、RGB-深度)中评估DeCUR,证明其在不同架构和多模态及模态缺失设置下均能实现一致的性能提升。通过详尽的实验和全面的分析,我们希望本工作能提供有价值的见解,并激发更多关于多模态表示隐含关系的研究兴趣1。1 https://github.com/zhu-xlab/DeCUR
abstract_en: The increasing availability of multi-sensor data sparks wide interest in multimodal self-supervised learning. However, most existing approaches learn only common representations across modalities while ignoring intra-modal training and modality-unique representations. We propose Decoupling Common and Unique Representations (DeCUR), a simple yet effective method for multimodal self-supervised learning. By distinguishing inter- and intra-modal embeddings through multimodal redundancy reduction, DeCUR can integrate complementary information across different modalities. We evaluate DeCUR in three common multimodal scenarios (radar-optical, RGB-elevation, and RGB-depth), and demonstrate its consistent improvement regardless of architectures and for both multimodal and modality-missing settings. With thorough experiments and comprehensive analysis, we hope this work can provide valuable insights and raise more interest in researching the hidden relationships of multimodal representations1 . 1 https://github.com/zhu-xlab/DeCUR

title: Yi Wang*, Kunchang Li, Xinhao Li, Jiashuo Yu, Yinan He, Guo Chen, Baoqi Pei, Rongkun Zheng, Jilan Xu, Zun Wang, Yansong Shi, Tianxiang Jiang, SongZe Li, hongjie Zhang, Yifei Huang, Yu Qiao*, Yali Wang*, Limin Wang*
title_en: Yi Wang*, Kunchang Li, Xinhao Li, Jiashuo Yu, Yinan He, Guo Chen, Baoqi Pei, Rongkun Zheng, Jilan Xu, Zun Wang, Yansong Shi, Tianxiang Jiang, SongZe Li, hongjie Zhang, Yifei Huang, Yu Qiao*, Yali Wang*, Limin Wang*
abstract: 我们引入了一个新的视频基础模型(ViFM)家族,该模型在视频识别、视频-文本任务以及以视频为中心的对话任务中达到了最先进的水平。我们的核心设计是一种渐进式训练方法,统一了视频掩码建模、跨模态对比学习和下一个标记预测,将视频编码器规模扩展至60亿参数。在数据层面,我们通过语义分割视频并生成视频-音频-语音字幕,优先保证时空一致性,从而提升视频与文本的对齐效果。通过大量实验,我们验证了设计的有效性,并在超过60个视频和音频任务中展现出卓越性能。值得注意的是,我们的模型在各类视频相关对话和长视频理解基准测试中均优于其他模型,突显了其对更长上下文的推理和理解能力。*同等贡献。†通讯作者。
abstract_en: We introduce , a new family of video foundation models (ViFM) that achieve the state-of-the-art results in video recognition, video-text tasks, and video-centric dialogue. Our core design is a progressive training approach that unifies the masked video modeling, crossmodal contrastive learning, and next token prediction, scaling up the video encoder size to 6B parameters. At the data level, we prioritize spatiotemporal consistency by semantically segmenting videos and generating video-audio-speech captions. This improves the alignment between video and text. Through extensive experiments, we validate our designs and demonstrate superior performance on over 60 video and audio tasks. Notably, our model outperforms others on various video-related dialogue and long video understanding benchmarks, highlighting its ability to reason and comprehend longer contexts. *Equal contribution. †Corresponding authors.

title: Yi Wu, Ziqiang Li, Heliang Zheng, Chaoyue Wang*, Bin Li*
title_en: Yi Wu, Ziqiang Li, Heliang Zheng, Chaoyue Wang*, Bin Li*
abstract: 借鉴近期文本到图像生成领域扩散模型的最新进展,身份保持个性化在仅需单张参考图像即可准确捕捉特定身份方面取得了显著进展。然而,现有方法主要将参考图像整合到文本嵌入空间中,导致图像与文本信息的复杂纠缠,这对保持身份保真度和语义一致性提出了挑战。为解决这一问题,我们提出Infinite-ID,一种用于身份保持个性化的ID-语义解耦范式。具体而言,我们引入了身份增强训练,加入额外的图像交叉注意力模块以充分捕捉ID信息,同时停用扩散模型原有的文本交叉注意力模块。这确保了图像流能够忠实反映参考图像提供的身份信息,同时减少文本输入的干扰。此外,我们引入了一种特征交互机制,结合混合注意力模块与AdaIN-mean操作,无缝融合两个流。该机制不仅提升了身份保真度和语义一致性,还实现了对生成图像风格的便捷控制。在原始照片生成和风格图像生成的大量实验结果表明,我们提出的方法具有优越的性能。
abstract_en: Drawing on recent advancements in diffusion models for text-to-image generation, identity-preserved personalization has made significant progress in accurately capturing specific identities with just a single reference image. However, existing methods primarily integrate reference images within the text embedding space, leading to a complex entanglement of image and text information, which poses challenges for preserving both identity fidelity and semantic consistency. To tackle this challenge, we propose Infinite-ID, an ID-semantics decoupling paradigm for identity-preserved personalization. Specifically, we introduce identity-enhanced training, incorporating an additional image cross-attention module to capture sufficient ID information while deactivating the original text cross-attention module of the diffusion model. This ensures that the image stream faithfully represents the identity provided by the reference image while mitigating interference from textual input. Additionally, we introduce a feature interaction mechanism that combines a mixed attention module with an AdaIN-mean operation to seamlessly merge the two streams. This mechanism not only enhances the fidelity of identity and semantic consistency but also enables convenient control over the styles of the generated images. Extensive experimental results on both raw photo generation and style image generation demonstrate the superior performance of our proposed method.

title: Yi Yao, Chan-Feng Hsu*, Jhe-Hao Lin, Hongxia Xie, Terence Lin, Yi-Ning Huang, Hong-Han Shuai*, Wen-Huang Cheng*
title_en: Yi Yao, Chan-Feng Hsu*, Jhe-Hao Lin, Hongxia Xie, Terence Lin, Yi-Ning Huang, Hong-Han Shuai*, Wen-Huang Cheng*
abstract: 尽管文本到图像生成技术近期取得了进展,但由于训练数据的多样性和复杂性受限,仍存在处理复杂且富有想象力提示的局限性。本工作探讨了扩散模型如何从需要艺术创造力或专业知识的提示中生成图像。我们引入了现实-幻想基准(RFBench),这是一个融合现实与幻想场景的新型评估框架。为应对这些挑战,我们提出了现实-幻想网络(RFNet),这是一种无需训练的方案,将扩散模型与大型语言模型(LLMs)相结合。广泛的主观评估和基于GPT的组合评估表明,我们的方法优于现有最先进的技术。我们的代码和数据集可在https: //leo81005.github.io/Reality-and-Fantasy/获取。
abstract_en: In spite of recent advancements in text-to-image generation, limitations persist in handling complex and imaginative prompts due to the restricted diversity and complexity of training data. This work explores how diffusion models can generate images from prompts requiring artistic creativity or specialized knowledge. We introduce the Realistic-Fantasy Benchmark (RFBench), a novel evaluation framework blending realistic and fantastical scenarios.
