Benefiting from three meticulously designed modules, our method can learn dynamic and kinematic features from human movements, and further enable the precise capture of coherent human motions in open settings, making it highly applicable to real-world scenarios. Through extensive experiments, LiveHPS++ has proven to significantly surpass existing state-of-the-art methods across various datasets, establishing a new benchmark in the field. https://4dvlab.github.io/project_page/LiveHPS2. html

title: 袁明 Zhao*,连周辉*
title_en: Yiming Zhao*, Zhouhui Lian*
abstract: 基于扩散模型的文本到图像(T2I)生成近年来引起了广泛关注。尽管这些图像合成方法能够生成视觉效果吸引人的结果,但在生成图像中渲染文本时,它们经常出现拼写错误。此类错误表现为缺失、错误或多余字符,从而严重限制了基于扩散模型的文本图像生成性能。为了解决上述问题,本文提出了一种新的文本图像生成方法,利用预训练的扩散模型(即Stable Diffusion)。我们的方法包括设计和训练一个轻量级的字符级文本编码器,该编码器替代了原始的CLIP编码器,并提供更鲁棒的文本嵌入作为条件引导。随后,我们使用大规模数据集对扩散模型进行微调,并在字符级分割图的监督下引入局部注意力控制。最后,通过采用推理阶段的优化过程,我们在任意给定图像中合成文本时实现了显著的序列准确性。定性和定量结果均表明,我们的方法优于当前最先进的方法。此外,我们展示了所提出的UDiffText的几种潜在应用,包括以文本为中心的图像合成、场景文本修复等。我们的代码和模型可在https://github.com/ZYM-PKU/UDiffText获取。
abstract_en: Text-to-Image (T2I) generation based on diffusion models has garnered significant attention in the last few years. Although these image synthesis methods produce visually appealing results, they frequently exhibit spelling errors when rendering text within the generated images. Such errors manifest as missing, incorrect or extraneous characters, thereby severely constraining the performance of text image generation based on diffusion models. To address the aforementioned issue, this paper proposes a novel approach for text image generation, utilizing a pre-trained diffusion model (i.e., Stable Diffusion). Our approach involves the design and training of a light-weight character-level text encoder, which replaces the original CLIP encoder and provides more robust text embeddings as conditional guidance. Then, we fine-tune the diffusion model using a large-scale dataset, incorporating local attention control under the supervision of character-level segmentation maps. Finally, by employing an inference stage refinement process, we achieve a notably high sequence accuracy when synthesizing text in arbitrarily given images. Both qualitative and quantitative results demonstrate the superiority of our method to the state of the art. Furthermore, we showcase several potential applications of the proposed UDiffText, including text-centric image synthesis, scene text inpainting, etc. Our code and model are available at https://github.com/ZYM-PKU/UDiffText.

title: Yiming Zuo*, Jia Deng
title_en: Yiming Zuo*, Jia Deng
abstract: 深度补全任务是在给定图像和稀疏深度图作为输入的情况下生成密集深度图。本文提出OGNI-DC,一种新颖的深度补全框架。该方法的核心是“优化引导的神经迭代”(OGNI)。它包含一个递归单元,用于优化深度梯度场,并包含一个可微分的深度积分器,将深度梯度整合为深度图。OGNI-DC展现出强大的泛化能力,在未见过的数据集和各种稀疏度级别上显著优于基线方法。此外,OGNI-DC具有高精度,在NYUv2和KITTI基准测试中达到最先进水平。代码可在https://github.com/princeton-vl/OGNI-DC获取。
abstract_en: Depth completion is the task of generating a dense depth map given an image and a sparse depth map as inputs. In this paper, we present OGNI-DC, a novel framework for depth completion. The key to our method is “Optimization-Guided Neural Iterations” (OGNI). It consists of a recurrent unit that refines a depth gradient field and a differentiable depth integrator that integrates the depth gradients into a depth map. OGNI-DC exhibits strong generalization, outperforming baselines by a large margin on unseen datasets and across various sparsity levels. Moreover, OGNI-DC has high accuracy, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the NYUv2 and the KITTI benchmarks. Code is available at https:// github.com/princeton-vl/OGNI-DC.

title: Yinan Zhang*, Eric Tzeng, Yilun Du, Dmitry Kislyuk*
title_en: Yinan Zhang*, Eric Tzeng, Yilun Du, Dmitry Kislyuk*
abstract: 文本到图像扩散模型是当前最先进的深度生成模型,已展现出在生成高质量图像方面的卓越能力。然而,这些模型容易受到来自大规模文本-图像训练对的隐式偏见影响,可能导致对图像属性建模的不准确。这种易受偏见影响的表现可能表现为次优样本、模型偏见以及与人类伦理和偏好的不一致图像。在本文中,我们提出了一种可扩展的算法,利用强化学习(RL)结合多样化的奖励函数(包括人类偏好、组合性和社会多样性)来增强扩散模型。我们展示了我们的方法在对齐扩散模型与人类偏好方面显著优于现有方法。我们进一步说明了这种方法如何显著提升预训练的Stable Diffusion(SD)模型,生成的样本有80.3%的时间被人类偏好,同时增强了样本中的物体组合和多样性。
abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models are cutting-edge deep generative models that have demonstrated impressive capabilities in generating high-quality images. However, these models are susceptible to implicit biases originating from web-scale text-image training pairs, potentially leading to inaccuracies in modeling image attributes. This susceptibility can manifest as suboptimal samples, model bias, and images that do not align with human ethics and preferences. In this paper, we propose a scalable algorithm for enhancing diffusion models using Reinforcement Learning (RL) with a diverse range of reward functions, including human preference, compositionality, and social diversity over millions of images. We demonstrate how our approach significantly outperforms existing methods for aligning diffusion models with human preferences. We further illustrate how this substantially improves pretrained Stable Diffusion (SD) models, generating samples that are preferred by humans 80.3% of the time over those from the base SD model, while simultaneously enhancing object composition and diversity of the samples.

title: Yinghao Xu*, Zifan Shi, Wang Yifan, Hansheng Chen, Ceyuan Yang, Sida Peng, Yujun Shen, Gordon Wetzstein
title_en: Yinghao Xu*, Zifan Shi, Wang Yifan, Hansheng Chen, Ceyuan Yang, Sida Peng, Yujun Shen, Gordon Wetzstein
abstract: 我们提出GRM,这是一种大规模重建器,能够在约0.1秒内从稀疏视角图像中恢复3D资产。GRM是一种前馈Transformer模型,能够高效融合多视角信息,将输入像素转换为像素对齐的高斯分布,这些高斯分布未投影以创建密集分布的3D高斯分布,从而表示场景。结合我们的Transformer架构和3D高斯分布的使用,解锁了一个可扩展且高效的重建框架。大量实验结果证明了我们的方法在重建质量和效率方面均优于其他方法。我们还通过将其与现有的多视角扩散模型结合,展示了GRM在生成任务(即文本到3D和图像到3D)中的潜力。我们的项目网站为:https://justimyhxu.github.io/projects/grm/
abstract_en: We introduce GRM, a large-scale reconstructor capable of recovering a 3D asset from sparse-view images in around 0.1s. GRM is a feed-forward transformer-based model that efficiently incorporates multi-view information to translate the input pixels into pixel-aligned Gaussians, which are unprojected to create a set of densely distributed 3D Gaussians representing a scene. Together, our transformer architecture and the use of 3D Gaussians unlock a scalable and efficient reconstruction framework. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our method over alternatives regarding both reconstruction quality and efficiency. We also showcase the potential of GRM in generative tasks, i.e., text-to-3D and image-to-3D, by integrating it with existing multi-view diffusion models. Our project website is at: https://justimyhxu.github.io/projects/grm/.

title: 唐英琪,孟兆 Tie,陈国良,程尔康*
title_en: Yingqi Tang, Zhaotie Meng, Guoliang Chen, Erkang Cheng*
abstract: 自动驾驶领域对直接从多摄像头推断鸟瞰图(BEV)中三维物体的方法产生了浓厚兴趣。一些尝试也探索利用单图像的2D检测器来提升三维检测性能。然而,这些方法依赖于分阶段的流程,使用独立的检测器,其中2D检测结果仅用于一次令牌选择或查询初始化。本文提出了一种单模型SimPB,该模型同时从多摄像头中检测透视视图中的2D物体和BEV空间中的3D物体。为实现这一目标,我们引入了一个混合解码器,包含多个多视角2D解码层和多个3D解码层,专门设计用于各自的检测任务。我们提出了动态查询分配模块和自适应查询聚合模块,以循环的3D-2D-3D方式持续更新和优化2D与3D结果之间的交互。此外,利用查询组注意力机制来增强每个摄像头组内2D查询之间的交互。在实验中,我们在nuScenes数据集上评估了我们的方法,并展示了在2D和3D检测任务中的有前景结果。我们的代码可在:https: //github.com/nullmax-vision/SimPB 获取。
abstract_en: The field of autonomous driving has attracted considerable interest in approaches that directly infer 3D objects in the Bird’s Eye View (BEV) from multiple cameras. Some attempts have also explored utilizing 2D detectors from single images to enhance the performance of 3D detection. However, these approaches rely on a two-stage process with separate detectors, where the 2D detection results are utilized only once for token selection or query initialization. In this paper, we present a single model termed SimPB, which Simultaneously detects 2D objects in the Perspective view and 3D objects in the BEV space from multiple cameras. To achieve this, we introduce a hybrid decoder consisting of several multi-view 2D decoder layers and several 3D decoder layers, specifically designed for their respective detection tasks. A Dynamic Query Allocation module and an Adaptive Query Aggregation module are proposed to continuously update and refine the interaction between 2D and 3D results, in a cyclic 3D-2D-3D manner. Additionally, Query-group Attention is utilized to strengthen the interaction among 2D queries within each camera group. In the experiments, we evaluate our method on the nuScenes dataset and demonstrate promising results for both 2D and 3D detection tasks. Our code is available at: https: //github.com/nullmax-vision/SimPB.

title: Yingsen Zeng, Yujie Zhong*, Chengjian Feng, Lin Ma
title_en: Yingsen Zeng, Yujie Zhong*, Chengjian Feng, Lin Ma
abstract: 时序动作检测(TAD)聚焦于检测预定义动作,而时刻检索(MR)旨在识别未剪辑视频中由开放式自然语言描述的事件。尽管两者关注的事件不同,我们观察到它们之间存在显著关联。例如,MR中的大多数描述涉及来自TAD的多个动作。本文旨在探讨TAD与MR之间的潜在协同效应。首先,我们提出一种统一架构,称为统一时刻检测(UniMD),用于同时处理TAD和MR任务。该架构将两个任务的输入(TAD中的动作或MR中的事件)转换到共同的嵌入空间,并利用两个新颖的查询依赖解码器生成统一的输出,包括分类得分和时间片段。其次,我们探索了两种任务融合学习方法(预训练和协同训练)的有效性,以增强TAD与MR之间的相互收益。大量实验表明,所提出的任务融合学习方案使两个任务能够相互促进并超越单独训练的模型。令人印象深刻的是,UniMD在三个配对数据集Ego4D、Charades-STA和ActivityNet上取得了最先进结果。我们的代码可在https://github.com/yingsen1/UniMD获取。
abstract_en: Temporal Action Detection (TAD) focuses on detecting pre-defined actions, while Moment Retrieval (MR) aims to identify the events described by open-ended natural language within untrimmed videos. Despite that they focus on different events, we observe they have a significant connection. For instance, most descriptions in MR involve multiple actions from TAD. In this paper, we aim to investigate the potential synergy between TAD and MR. Firstly, we propose a unified architecture, termed Unified Moment Detection (UniMD), for both TAD and MR. It transforms the inputs of the two tasks, namely actions for TAD or events for MR, into a common embedding space, and utilizes two novel query-dependent decoders to generate a uniform output of classification score and temporal segments. Secondly, we explore the efficacy of two task fusion learning approaches, pre-training and co-training, in order to enhance the mutual benefits between TAD and MR. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed task fusion learning scheme enables the two tasks to help each other and outperform the separately trained counterparts. Impressively, UniMD achieves state-of-the-art results on three paired datasets Ego4D, Charades-STA, and ActivityNet. Our code is available at https://github.com/yingsen1/UniMD.

title: Yingshan Chang*, Yasi Zhang, Zhiyuan Fang, Ying Nian Wu, Yonatan Bisk, Feng Gao
title_en: Yingshan Chang*, Yasi Zhang, Zhiyuan Fang, Ying Nian Wu, Yonatan Bisk, Feng Gao
abstract: The literature on text-to-image generation is plagued by issues of faithfully composing entities with relations. But there lacks a formal understanding of how entity-relation compositions can be effectively learned. Moreover, the underlying phenomenon space that meaningfully reflects the problem structure is not well-defined, leading to an arms race for larger quantities of data in the hope that generalization emerges out of large-scale pretraining. We hypothesize that the underlying phenomenological coverage has not been proportionally scaled up, leading to a skew of the presented phenomenon which harms generalization. We introduce statistical metrics that quantify both the linguistic and visual skew of a dataset for relational learning, and show that generalization failures of text-to-image generation are a direct result of incomplete or unbalanced phenomenological coverage. We first perform experiments in a synthetic domain and demonstrate that systematically controlled metrics are strongly predictive of generalization performance. Then we move to natural images and show that simple distribution perturbations in light of our theories boost generalization without enlarging the absolute data size. This work informs an important direction towards quality-enhancing the data diversity or balance orthogonal to scaling up the absolute size. Our discussions point out important open questions on 1) Evaluation of generated entity-relation compositions, and 2) Better models for reasoning with abstract relations.

But there lacks a formal understanding of how entity-relation compositions can be effectively learned. Moreover, the underlying phenomenon space that meaningfully reflects the problem structure is not well-defined, leading to an arms race for larger quantities of data in the hope that generalization emerges out of large-scale pretraining. We hypothesize that the underlying phenomenological coverage has not been proportionally scaled up, leading to a skew of the presented phenomenon which harms generalization. We introduce statistical metrics that quantify both the linguistic and visual skew of a dataset for relational learning, and show that generalization failures of text-to-image generation are a direct result of incomplete or unbalanced phenomenological coverage. We first perform experiments in a synthetic domain and demonstrate that systematically controlled metrics are strongly predictive of generalization performance. Then we move to natural images and show that simple distribution perturbations in light of our theories boost generalization without enlarging the absolute data size. This work informs an important direction towards quality-enhancing the data diversity or balance orthogonal to scaling up the absolute size. Our discussions point out important open questions on 1) Evaluation of generated entity-relation compositions, and 2) Better models for reasoning with abstract relations.

title: Yingshu Chen, Huajian Huang*, Tuan-Anh Vu, Ka Chun Shum, Sai-Kit Yeung
title_en: Yingshu Chen, Huajian Huang*, Tuan-Anh Vu, Ka Chun Shum, Sai-Kit Yeung
abstract: 创建具有多种风格的大规模虚拟城市场景本质上具有挑战性。为促进虚拟制作原型并绕过复杂材质和光照设置的需求,我们引入了首个基于视觉和文本驱动的纹理风格化系统StyleCity,用于大规模城市场景。通过输入图像和文本作为参考,StyleCity以语义感知的方式对大规模城市场景的3D纹理网格进行风格化,并生成和谐的全景天空背景。为实现这一目标,我们提出通过将2D视觉和文本先验转移到3D全局和局部,对神经纹理场进行风格化。在3D风格化过程中,我们按不同层级逐步扩展输入3D场景的训练视图计划,以保留高质量场景内容。随后,我们通过调整风格图像的尺度与训练视图的尺度,全局优化场景风格。此外,我们通过语义感知的风格损失增强局部语义一致性,这对于逼真风格化至关重要。除了纹理风格化,我们进一步采用生成扩散模型合成风格一致的全景天空图像,提供更沉浸的氛围并辅助语义风格化过程。风格化的神经纹理场可以烘焙到任意分辨率的纹理中,实现与传统渲染管线的无缝集成,并显著简化虚拟制作原型过程。大量实验验证了我们的风格化场景在定性和定量性能及用户偏好上的优越性。项目页面:https://chenyingshu.github.io/stylecity3d.
abstract_en: Creating large-scale virtual urban scenes with variant styles is inherently challenging. To facilitate prototypes of virtual production and bypass the need for complex materials and lighting setups, we introduce the first vision-and-text-driven texture stylization system for large-scale urban scenes, StyleCity. Taking an image and text as references, StyleCity stylizes a 3D textured mesh of a large-scale urban scene in a semantics-aware fashion and generates a harmonic omnidirectional sky background. To achieve that, we propose to stylize a neural texture field by transferring 2D vision-and-text priors to 3D globally and locally. During 3D stylization, we progressively scale the planned training views of the input 3D scene at different levels in order to preserve high-quality scene content. We then optimize the scene style globally by adapting the scale of the style image with the scale of the training views. Moreover, we enhance local semantics consistency by the semantics-aware style loss which is crucial for photo-realistic stylization. Besides texture stylization, we further adopt a generative diffusion model to synthesize a style-consistent omnidirectional sky image, which offers a more immersive atmosphere and assists the semantic stylization process. The stylized neural texture field can be baked into an arbitrary-resolution texture, enabling seamless integration into conventional rendering pipelines and significantly easing the virtual production prototyping process. Extensive experiments demonstrate our stylized scenes’ superiority in qualitative and quantitative performance and user preferences. Project page: https://chenyingshu.github.io/stylecity3d.

title: Yingshuang Zou*, Yikang Ding, Xi Qiu, Haoqian Wang*, Haotian Zhang*
title_en: Yingshuang Zou*, Yikang Ding, Xi Qiu, Haoqian Wang*, Haotian Zhang*
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的自监督双帧多摄像头度量深度估计网络,称为M2 Depth,旨在预测自动驾驶中可靠的尺度感知周围深度。与之前使用单一时间步多视角图像或多时间步单一摄像头图像的工作不同,M2 Depth以多个摄像头的时序相邻双帧图像作为输入,生成高质量的周围深度。我们首先在空间域和时间域分别构建代价体,并提出一个时空融合模块,将时空信息整合以生成强大的体积表示。此外,我们结合SAM特征的神经先验与内部特征,以减少前景与背景之间的歧义并强化深度边缘。在nuScenes和DDAD基准上的大量实验结果表明,M2 Depth实现了最先进的性能。更多结果可访问项目页面。
abstract_en: This paper presents a novel self-supervised two-frame multi-camera metric depth estimation network, termed M2 Depth, which is designed to predict reliable scale-aware surrounding depth in autonomous driving. Unlike the previous works that use multi-view images from a single time-step or multiple time-step images from a single camera, M2 Depth takes temporally adjacent two-frame images from multiple cameras as inputs and produces high-quality surrounding depth. We first construct cost volumes in spatial and temporal domains individually and propose a spatial-temporal fusion module that integrates the spatial-temporal information to yield a strong volume presentation. We additionally combine the neural prior from SAM features with internal features to reduce the ambiguity between foreground and background and strengthen the depth edges. Extensive experimental results on nuScenes and DDAD benchmarks show M2 Depth achieves state-of-the-art performance. More results can be found in project page.

title: 张莹莹*, 郭欣, 老江伟, 于磊, 鲁丽香, 王健, 叶果, 何慧梅, 陈景东, 杨明*
title_en: Yingying Zhang*, Xin Guo, Jiangwei Lao, Lei Yu, Lixiang Ru, Jian Wang, Guo Ye, HUIMEI HE, Jingdong Chen, Ming Yang*
abstract: 大规模自监督预训练为单一基础模型处理多种不同的视觉任务铺平了道路。大多数预训练方法论一次仅训练特定规模的单一模型。然而,现实场景中的各种计算或存储约束要求付出大量努力开发一系列不同规模的模型进行部署。因此,在本研究中,我们提出了一种新颖的三分支自监督训练框架,称为POA(一次预训练适用于所有),以解决上述问题。我们的方法将创新的弹性学生分支引入现代自蒸馏范式。在每次预训练步骤中,我们从原始学生模型中随机采样子网络形成弹性学生分支,并以自蒸馏方式训练所有分支。预训练完成后,POA允许提取用于下游任务的多种规模的预训练模型。值得注意的是,弹性学生分支促进了不同规模多个模型的同时预训练,同时也作为不同规模模型的额外集成,以增强表征学习。广泛的实验,包括k近邻、线性探针评估以及多个下游任务的评估,证明了我们POA的有效性和优势。它在ViT、Swin Transformer和ResNet主干网络上实现了最先进性能,通过单次预训练会话生成约百种不同规模的模型。代码可在:https://github.com/Qichuzyy/POA 获取。
abstract_en: Large-scale self-supervised pre-training has paved the way for one foundation model to handle many different vision tasks. Most pre-training methodologies train a single model of a certain size at one time. Nevertheless, various computation or storage constraints in real-world scenarios require substantial efforts to develop a series of models with different sizes to deploy. Thus, in this study, we propose a novel tri-branch self-supervised training framework, termed as POA (Pre-training Once for All), to tackle this aforementioned issue. Our approach introduces an innovative elastic student branch into a modern self-distillation paradigm. At each pre-training step, we randomly sample a sub-network from the original student to form the elastic student and train all branches in a self-distilling fashion. Once pre-trained, POA allows the extraction of pre-trained models of diverse sizes for downstream tasks. Remarkably, the elastic student facilitates the simultaneous pre-training of multiple models with different sizes, which also acts as an additional ensemble of models of various sizes to enhance representation learning. Extensive experiments, including k-nearest neighbors, linear probing evaluation and assessments on multiple downstream tasks demonstrate the effectiveness and advantages of our POA. It achieves state-of-the-art performance using ViT, Swin Transformer and ResNet backbones, producing around a hundred models with different sizes through a single pre-training session. The code is available at: https://github.com/Qichuzyy/POA.

title: Yingzi Ma, Yulong Cao, Jiachen Sun, Marco Pavone, Chaowei Xiao*
title_en: Yingzi Ma, Yulong Cao, Jiachen Sun, Marco Pavone, Chaowei Xiao*
abstract: 寻求能够以类人理解与响应能力在复杂现实场景中自主导航的全自动驾驶汽车(AVs)。本文中,我们引入了一个新型视觉-语言模型架构,旨在作为对话式驾驶助手,具备类人能力。该模型擅长处理包含视频(或图像)数据、文本指令和历史控制信号的多模态输入,以生成与提供指令相匹配的有见地的输出。基于开源预训练视觉-语言模型OpenFlamingo,我们首先通过创新的基于情境的思维链(GCoT)过程在通用领域增强其推理能力。随后,我们通过构建驾驶特定指令数据并进行指令调优,将其定制化为驾驶领域。通过利用BDD-X数据集,我们设计并整合了四个不同的AV任务,以促进对复杂驾驶场景的全面理解。结果表明,该模型的特征可归纳为两个维度:(1)对复杂且长尾的开放世界驾驶场景的全面理解能力,以及解决一系列AV任务的能力;(2)类人能力的涌现,包括通过上下文学习实现的无梯度即时适应和通过反思实现的错误恢复。匿名演示可在https: //vlm-driver.github.io/获取。
abstract_en: The quest for fully autonomous vehicles (AVs) capable of navigating complex real-world scenarios with human-like understanding and responsiveness. In this paper, we introduce , a novel vision-language model architected to imbibe human-like abilities as a conversational driving assistant. is adept at processing multimodal inputs comprising video (or image) data, text instructions, and historical control signals to generate informed outputs corresponding to the provided instructions. Building upon the open-sourced pretrained Vision-Language Model, OpenFlamingo, we first enhance ’s reasoning capabilities through an innovative Grounded Chain of Thought (GCoT) process in the general domain. Then we tailored to the driving domain by constructing driving-specific instruction data and conducting instruction tuning. Through the utilization of the BDD-X dataset, we designed and consolidated four distinct AV tasks into to foster a holistic understanding of intricate driving scenarios. As a result, the distinctive features of are characterised into two dimensions: (1) the ability to provide a comprehensive understanding of complex and long-tailed open-world driving scenarios and solve a spectrum of AV tasks, and (2) the emergence of human-like capabilities including gradient-free instant adaptation via in-context learning and error recovery via reflection. The anonymous demo is available at https: //vlm-driver.github.io/.

title: 方雨妮*, 于静玲, 张浩政, Ralf van der Lans, Bertram E Shi
title_en: Yini Fang*, Jingling Yu, Haozheng Zhang, Ralf van der Lans, Bertram E Shi
abstract: 视觉搜索在我们的日常生活中至关重要。高效分配视觉注意力对于有效完成视觉搜索任务至关重要。先前的研究主要在像素级别对图像中的视觉注意力空间分配进行建模,例如使用显著性图。然而,新兴证据表明,视觉注意力是由对象而非像素强度引导的。本文引入了对象级注意力变换器(OAT),该模型可预测人类在杂乱场景中搜索目标对象时的扫视路径。OAT采用编码器-解码器架构。编码器捕捉图像中对象的位置和外观信息以及目标信息。解码器通过整合编码器和解码器的输出特征,预测注视扫视路径作为对象注视点序列。我们还提出了一种新的位置编码,更准确地反映对象间的空间关系。我们在Amazon书籍封面数据集和新收集的视觉搜索数据集上评估了OAT。与基于空间注意力的算法相比,OAT预测的注视扫视路径在现有指标和新型基于行为的指标上更贴近人类注视模式。我们的结果展示了OAT的泛化能力,因为它能准确预测未见过的布局和目标对象的扫视路径。代码可在:https://github.com/HKUST-NISL/oat_eccv24 获取。1 论文前两位作者贡献相当。
abstract_en: Visual search is important in our daily life. The efficient allocation of visual attention is critical to effectively complete visual search tasks. Prior research has predominantly modelled the spatial allocation of visual attention in images at the pixel level, e.g. using a saliency map. However, emerging evidence shows that visual attention is guided by objects rather than pixel intensities. This paper introduces the Object-level Attention Transformer (OAT), which predicts human scanpaths as they search for a target object within a cluttered scene of distractors. OAT uses an encoder-decoder architecture. The encoder captures information about the position and appearance of the objects within an image and about the target. The decoder predicts the gaze scanpath as a sequence of object fixations, by integrating output features from both the encoder and decoder. We also propose a new positional encoding that better reflects spatial relationships between objects. We evaluated OAT on the Amazon book cover dataset and a new dataset for visual search that we collected. OAT’s predicted gaze scanpaths align more closely with human gaze patterns, compared to predictions by algorithms based on spatial attention on both established metrics and a novel behavioural-based metric. Our results demonstrate the generalization ability of OAT, as it accurately predicts human scanpaths for unseen layouts and target objects. The code is available at: https://github.com/HKUST-NISL/ oat_eccv24. 1 The first two authors contributed equally in the paper.

title: Yiqi Lin, Conghui He*, Alex Jinpeng Wang, Bin Wang, Weijia Li, Mike Zheng Shou
title_en: Yiqi Lin, Conghui He*, Alex Jinpeng Wang, Bin Wang, Weijia Li, Mike Zheng Shou
abstract: 尽管CLIP [?] 是众多视觉-语言应用的基础模型,但CLIP存在严重的文本定位偏差。这种偏差导致CLIP模型在图像中“鹦鹉学舌”地复制嵌入的文本,而忽视真实的视觉语义。我们发现,在最流行的图像-文本数据集LAION-2B [?] 中,描述语句也密集地复制(拼写)图像中嵌入的文本。我们的分析表明,约50%的图像包含视觉文本内容,约30%的描述语句词汇同时嵌入在视觉内容中。基于这一观察,我们全面检查了不同版本的CLIP模型,并验证了视觉文本是衡量这些模型LAION风格图像-文本相似性的主导因素。为检验这些鹦鹉学舌式描述是否塑造了文本定位偏差,我们使用不同鹦鹉学舌式描述标准筛选的LAION子集训练了一系列CLIP模型。我们证明,使用鹦鹉学舌式描述训练容易形成此类偏差,但会损害CLIP模型在多种视觉-语言下游任务中的预期视觉-语言表征学习。这表明,亟需重新审视CLIP类模型的设计或基于CLIP评分过滤构建的现有图像-文本数据集构建流程。项目页面:https://linyq17.github.io/CLIP-Parrot-Bias/
abstract_en: Despite CLIP [?] being the foundation model in numerous vision-language applications, CLIP suffers from a severe text spotting bias. Such bias causes CLIP models to ‘Parrot’ the visual text embedded within images while disregarding the authentic visual semantics. We uncover that in the most popular image-text dataset LAION-2B [?], the captions also densely parrot (spell) the text embedded in images. Our analysis shows that around 50% of images are embedded with visual text content and around 30% of captions words are concurrently embedded in the visual content. Based on such observation, we thoroughly inspect the different released versions of CLIP models and verify that the visual text is a dominant factor in measuring the LAION-style image-text similarity for these models. To examine whether these parrot captions shape the text spotting bias, we train a series of CLIP models with LAION subsets curated by different parrot-caption-oriented criteria. We show that training with parrot captions easily shapes such bias but harms the expected visual-language representation learning in CLIP models across various vision-language downstream tasks. This suggests that it is urgent to revisit either the design of CLIP-like models or the existing image-text dataset curation pipeline built on CLIP score filtering. Project page: https://linyq17.github.io/CLIP-Parrot-Bias/

title: Yiqun Duan*, Xianda Guo*, Zheng Zhu
title_en: Yiqun Duan*, Xianda Guo*, Zheng Zhu
abstract: 单目深度估计是一项具有挑战性的任务,旨在从单张二维图像中预测每个像素的深度。当前方法通常将该问题建模为回归或分类任务。我们提出了一种新的方法DiffusionDepth,将单目深度估计重新表述为一个去噪扩散过程。该方法通过学习一个迭代的去噪过程,以单目视觉条件为指导,将随机深度分布“去噪”为深度图。该过程在由专用深度编码器和解码器编码的潜在空间中进行。与扩散真实深度(GT)不同,该模型学习反向扩散自身精炼深度到随机深度分布的过程。这种自扩散公式克服了将生成模型应用于稀疏GT深度场景的困难。所提出的方法通过逐步优化深度估计,有助于生成准确且高度详细的深度图。使用KITTI和NYU-Depth-V2数据集进行的离线和在线实验结果表明,该方法在室内和室外场景中均能实现最先进的性能,同时保持合理的推理时间。代码1可在在线获取。1 https://github.com/duanyiqun/DiffusionDepth
abstract_en: Monocular depth estimation is a challenging task that predicts the pixel-wise depth from a single 2D image. Current methods typically model this problem as a regression or classification task. We propose DiffusionDepth, a new approach that reformulates monocular depth estimation as a denoising diffusion process. It learns an iterative denoising process to ‘denoise’ random depth distribution into a depth map with the guidance of monocular visual conditions. The process is performed in the latent space encoded by a dedicated depth encoder and decoder. Instead of diffusing ground truth (GT) depth, the model learns to reverse the process of diffusing the refined depth of itself into random depth distribution. This self-diffusion formulation overcomes the difficulty of applying generative models to sparse GT depth scenarios. The proposed approach benefits this task by refining depth estimation step by step, which is superior for generating accurate and highly detailed depth maps. Experimental results from both offline and online evaluations using the KITTI and NYU-Depth-V2 datasets indicate that the proposed method can achieve state-of-the-art performance in both indoor and outdoor settings while maintaining a reasonable inference time. The codes 1 are available online. 1 https://github.com/duanyiqun/DiffusionDepth

title: Yisheng He*, Weihao Yuan*, Siyu Zhu, Zilong Dong, Liefeng Bo, Qixing Huang
title_en: Yisheng He*, Weihao Yuan*, Siyu Zhu, Zilong Dong, Liefeng Bo, Qixing Huang
abstract: 本文通过频率分解实现了高保真、可迁移的NeRF编辑。近期的NeRF编辑流程将2D风格化结果提升到3D场景,但存在模糊结果的问题,并且无法捕捉由2D编辑不一致性导致的细节结构。我们的关键洞察是,图像的低频成分在编辑后比高频部分更具多视角一致性。此外,外观风格主要体现在低频成分上,而内容细节尤其是高频部分。这促使我们在低频成分上进行编辑,从而获得高保真的编辑场景。此外,编辑在低频特征空间中进行,实现了稳定的强度控制和新颖的场景迁移。在逼真图像数据集上的综合实验验证了高保真和可迁移NeRF编辑的优越性能。项目页面位于https: //aigc3d.github.io/freditor。
abstract_en: This paper enables high-fidelity, transferable NeRF editing by frequency decomposition. Recent NeRF editing pipelines lift 2D stylization results to 3D scenes while suffering from blurry results, and fail to capture detailed structures caused by the inconsistency between 2D editings. Our critical insight is that low-frequency components of images are more multiview-consistent after editing compared with their high-frequency parts. Moreover, the appearance style is mainly exhibited on the low-frequency components, and the content details especially reside in high-frequency parts. This motivates us to perform editing on low-frequency components, which results in high-fidelity edited scenes. In addition, the editing is performed in the low-frequency feature space, enabling stable intensity control and novel scene transfer. Comprehensive experiments conducted on photorealistic datasets demonstrate the superior performance of high-fidelity and transferable NeRF editing. The project page is at https: //aigc3d.github.io/freditor.

title: Yisol Choi*, Sangkyung Kwak, Kyungmin Lee, Hyungwon Choi, Jinwoo Shin*
title_en: Yisol Choi*, Sangkyung Kwak, Kyungmin Lee, Hyungwon Choi, Jinwoo Shin*
abstract: 本文研究基于图像的虚拟试穿技术,该技术能够根据描述人物和服装的两幅图像,生成人物穿着定制服装的图像。先前的工作将现有的基于示例的修复扩散模型适配于虚拟试穿,以提升生成图像的自然度,相较于其他方法(如基于生成对抗网络的方法),但未能保留服装的身份特征。为克服这一局限性,我们提出了一种新型扩散模型,以提升服装保真度并生成真实的虚拟试穿图像。我们的方法命名为__TITLE_MATH_1__,通过两个不同的模块编码服装图像的语义;在扩散模型的基础UNet架构中,1)从视觉编码器提取的高层语义融合至交叉注意力层,2)从并行UNet提取的低层特征融合至自注意力层。此外,我们为服装和人物图像提供了详细的文本提示,以增强生成图像的真实性。最后,我们提出了一种基于人物-服装图像对的定制方法,显著提升了保真度和真实性。实验结果表明,我们的方法在保留服装细节和生成真实虚拟试穿图像方面,相较于以往方法(包括基于扩散模型和基于生成对抗网络的方法)在定性和定量上均表现更优。此外,所提出的定制方法在现实场景中也证明了其有效性。更多可视化结果可在我们的项目页面上查看。
abstract_en: This paper considers image-based virtual try-on, which renders an image of a person wearing a curated garment, given a pair of images depicting the person and the garment, respectively. Previous works adapt existing exemplar-based inpainting diffusion models for virtual try-on to improve the naturalness of the generated visuals compared to other methods (e.g., GAN-based), but they fail to preserve the identity of the garments. To overcome this limitation, we propose a novel diffusion model that improves garment fidelity and generates authentic virtual try-on images. Our method, coined , uses two different modules to encode the semantics of garment image; given the base UNet of the diffusion model, 1) the high-level semantics extracted from a visual encoder are fused to the cross-attention layer, and then 2) the low-level features extracted from parallel UNet are fused to the self-attention layer. In addition, we provide detailed textual prompts for both garment and person images to enhance the authenticity of the generated visuals. Finally, we present a customization method using a pair of person-garment images, which significantly improves fidelity and authenticity. Our experimental results show that our method outperforms previous approaches (both diffusion-based and GAN-based) in preserving garment details and generating authentic virtual try-on images, both qualitatively and quantitatively. Furthermore, the proposed customization method demonstrates its effectiveness in a real-world scenario. More visualizations are available in our project page.

title: 王毅松, 席楠*, 孟晶晶, 袁俊松
title_en: Yisong Wang, Nan Xi*, Jingjing Meng, Junsong Yuan
abstract: 理解视频中的人-物交互(HOI)是计算机视觉中的一个基础而复杂的挑战,需要在空间和时间域上进行感知和推理。尽管之前在目标检测和跟踪方面取得了成功,但多人物视频HOI识别仍面临两个主要挑战:(1)HOI的三个方面(人类、物体以及将它们联系起来的交互)具有相互关联性,并且彼此之间相互影响。(2)时空交互中多人物多物体组合的复杂性。为了解决这些问题,我们设计了一个时空上下文融合器,以更好地建模视频中人物和物体之间的交互。此外,为了使模型具备时间推理能力,我们在上下文融合器上提出了一个交互状态推理模块。考虑到交互是连接人类和物体的关键元素,我们在特征嵌入空间中提出了一种以交互为中心的超球体,以建模每种类型的交互。这有助于在超球体上学习属于同一交互的HOI样本的分布。训练后,每个交互原型球将适应测试的HOI样本以确定HOI分类结果。在多人物视频HOI数据集MPHOI-72上的实证结果表明,我们的方法在F1分数上显著超过了最先进的(SOTA)方法超过22%。同时,在单人物数据集Bimanual Actions(单人物双手HOI)和CAD-120(单人物HOI)上,我们的方法与最先进的方法相比取得了相当甚至更好的结果。源代码发布在以下链接:https://github.com/southnx/IcH-Vid-HOI。
abstract_en: Understanding human-object interaction (HOI) in videos represents a fundamental yet intricate challenge in computer vision, requiring perception and reasoning across both spatial and temporal domains. Despite previous success of object detection and tracking, multi-person video HOI recognition still faces two major challenges: (1) the three facets of HOI (human, objects, and the interactions that bind them) exhibit interconnectedness and exert mutual influence upon one another. (2) the complexity of multi-person multi-object combinations in spatio-temporal interaction. To address them, we design a spatio-temporal context fuser to better model the interactions among persons and objects in videos. Furthermore, to equip the model with temporal reasoning capacity, we propose an interaction state reasoner module on top of context fuser. Considering the interaction is a key element to bind human and object, we propose an interaction-centric hypersphere in the feature embedding space to model each category of interaction. It helps to learn the distribution of HOI samples belonging to the same interactions on the hypersphere. After training, each interaction prototype sphere will fit the testing HOI sample to determine the HOI classification result. Empirical results on multi-person video HOI dataset MPHOI-72 indicate that our method remarkably surpasses state-of-the-art (SOTA) method by more than 22% F1 score. At the same time, on single-person datasets Bimanual Actions (single-human two-hand HOI) and CAD-120 (single-human HOI), our method achieves on par or even better results compared with SOTA methods. Source code is released at the following link: https://github.com/ southnx/IcH-Vid-HOI.

title: AutoDIR:一种基于潜在扩散的全功能图像修复系统
title_en: Yitong Jiang*, Zhaoyang Zhang, Tianfan Xue, Jinwei Gu*
abstract: 我们提出AutoDIR,一种创新的全功能图像修复系统,结合了潜在扩散技术。AutoDIR在自动识别和修复遭受多种未知退化问题的图像方面表现出色。AutoDIR提供直观的开放词汇图像编辑功能,使用户能够根据个人偏好自定义和增强图像。AutoDIR包含两个关键阶段:基于语义无关视觉-语言模型的盲图像质量评估(BIQA)阶段,该阶段可自动检测输入图像的未知退化问题;以及利用结构校正潜在扩散的全功能图像修复(AIR)阶段,该阶段可处理多种类型的图像退化。广泛实验评估表明,AutoDIR在更广泛的图像修复任务中优于最先进的方法。AutoDIR的设计还实现了通过文本提示的灵活用户控制,并作为图像修复的基础模型可推广到新任务。项目地址:https://jiangyitong.github.io/ AutoDIR_webpage/
abstract_en: We present AutoDIR, an innovative all-in-one image restoration system incorporating latent diffusion. AutoDIR excels in its ability to automatically identify and restore images suffering from a range of unknown degradations. AutoDIR offers intuitive open-vocabulary image editing, empowering users to customize and enhance images according to their preferences. AutoDIR consists of two key stages: a Blind Image Quality Assessment (BIQA) stage based on a semantic-agnostic vision-language model which automatically detects unknown image degradations for input images, an All-in-One Image Restoration (AIR) stage utilizes structural-corrected latent diffusion which handles multiple types of image degradations. Extensive experimental evaluation demonstrates that AutoDIR outperforms state-of-the-art approaches for a wider range of image restoration tasks. The design of AutoDIR also enables flexible user control (via text prompt) and generalization to new tasks as a foundation model of image restoration. Project is available at: https://jiangyitong.github.io/ AutoDIR_webpage/.

title: Yiwen Tang, Ray Zhang, Jiaming Liu, Zoey Guo, Bin Zhao*, Zhigang Wang, Dong Wang*, Peng Gao, Hongsheng Li, Xuelong Li
title_en: Yiwen Tang, Ray Zhang, Jiaming Liu, Zoey Guo, Bin Zhao*, Zhigang Wang, Dong Wang*, Peng Gao, Hongsheng Li, Xuelong Li
abstract: 大规模基础模型近期已成为研究热点,在多种场景中展现出卓越性能。由于三维数据稀缺,许多研究尝试将预训练的视觉Transformer迁移到三维领域。然而,此类二维到三维的方法仍存在局限,主要由于空间几何信息可能丢失以及计算成本高昂。更重要的是,其框架主要针对二维模型设计,缺乏通用的任意模态到三维范式。本文提出Any2Point,一种参数高效方法,用于增强任意模态的大模型(视觉、语言、音频)对三维的理解能力。给定任意源模态的冻结Transformer,我们提出一种三维到任意(1D或2D)虚拟投影策略,将输入三维点与源模态中的原始1D或2D位置相关联。该机制使我们能够为每个三维token分配与预训练模型配对的位置编码,避免真实投影导致的三维几何信息丢失,并通过1D/2D位置先验更好地激励Transformer进行三维学习。随后,在每个Transformer块中插入任意到三维引导的适配器模块,实现参数高效微调。适配器通过源模态的先验空间知识引导三维token的局部特征聚合,强制任意模态Transformer的语义适配。我们进行了大量实验以展示方法的有效性和效率。代码已开源至https://github.com/Ivan-Tang-3D/Any2Point。
abstract_en: Large foundation models have recently emerged as a prominent focus of interest, attaining superior performance in widespread scenarios. Due to the scarcity of 3D data, many efforts have been made to adapt pre-trained transformers from vision to 3D domains. However, such 2D-to-3D approaches are still limited, due to the potential loss of spatial geometries and high computation cost. More importantly, their frameworks are mainly designed for 2D models, lacking a general any-to-3D paradigm. In this paper, we introduce Any2Point, a parameter-efficient method to empower any-modality large models (vision, language, audio) for 3D understanding. Given a frozen transformer from any source modality, we propose a 3D-to-any (1D or 2D) virtual projection strategy that correlates the input 3D points to the original 1D or 2D positions within the source modality. This mechanism enables us to assign each 3D token with a positional encoding paired with the pre-trained model, which avoids 3D geometry loss caused by the true projection and better motivates the transformer for 3D learning with 1D/2D positional priors. Then, within each transformer block, we insert an any-to-3D guided adapter module for parameter-efficient fine-tuning. The adapter incorporates prior spatial knowledge from the source modality to guide the local feature aggregation of 3D tokens, compelling the semantic adaption of any-modality transformers. We conduct extensive experiments to showcase the effectiveness and efficiency of our method. The code is released at https://github.com/Ivan-Tang-3D/Any2Point.

title: 邱毅翔*、方浩、余宏耀、陈斌*、邱美康、夏树涛
title_en: Yixiang Qiu*, Hao Fang, Hongyao Yu, Bin Chen*, Meikang Qiu, Shu-Tao Xia
abstract: 模型反转(MI)攻击旨在通过利用输出信息从发布的模型中重建隐私敏感的训练数据,引发了对深度神经网络(DNNs)安全性的广泛关注。近年来,生成对抗网络(GANs)在提升MI攻击性能方面取得了显著进展,这得益于其生成高保真度且语义恰当的逼真图像的强大能力。然而,先前的MI攻击仅在GAN先验的潜在空间中披露私有信息,限制了其语义提取能力及在多个目标模型和数据集间的迁移性。为解决这一挑战,我们提出了一种新颖的方法——中间特征增强的生成模型反转(IF-GMI),该方法拆解GAN结构并利用中间块之间的特征。这使我们能够将优化空间从潜在编码扩展到具有更强表达能力的中间特征。为防止GAN先验生成不真实的图像,我们在优化过程中应用了l1球约束。在多个基准测试中,实验结果表明我们的方法显著优于先前方法,并在各种设置下实现了最先进的结果,尤其是在分布外(OOD)场景中。我们的代码可在:bluehttps://github.com/final-solution/IF-GMI 获取
abstract_en: Model Inversion (MI) attacks aim to reconstruct privacy-sensitive training data from released models by utilizing output information, raising extensive concerns about the security of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs). Recent advances in generative adversarial networks (GANs) have contributed significantly to the improved performance of MI attacks due to their powerful ability to generate realistic images with high fidelity and appropriate semantics. However, previous MI attacks have solely disclosed private information in the latent space of GAN priors, limiting their semantic extraction and transferability across multiple target models and datasets. To address this challenge, we propose a novel method, Intermediate Features enhanced Generative Model Inversion (IF-GMI), which disassembles the GAN structure and exploits features between intermediate blocks. This allows us to extend the optimization space from latent code to intermediate features with enhanced expressive capabilities. To prevent GAN priors from generating unrealistic images, we apply a l1 ball constraint to the optimization process. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms previous approaches and achieves state-of-the-art results under various settings, especially in the out-of-distribution (OOD) scenario. Our code is available at: bluehttps://github.com/final-solution/IF-GMI

title: Yixiao Wang*, Chen Tang, Lingfeng Sun, Simone Rossi, Yichen Xie, Chensheng Peng, Thomas Hannagan, Stefano Sabatini, Nicola Poerio, Masayoshi TOMIZUKA, Wei Zhan
title_en: Yixiao Wang*, Chen Tang, Lingfeng Sun, Simone Rossi, Yichen Xie, Chensheng Peng, Thomas Hannagan, Stefano Sabatini, Nicola Poerio, Masayoshi TOMIZUKA, Wei Zhan
abstract: 扩散模型在自动驾驶中的联合轨迹预测和可控生成方面展现出前景,但面临推理步骤效率低下和计算需求高的挑战。为解决这些问题,我们引入了最优高斯扩散(OGD)和估计干净流形(ECM)引导。OGD通过优化小扩散时间T的先验分布,并从此分布开始逆扩散过程。ECM直接将引导梯度注入估计的干净流形,消除了网络中广泛的梯度反向传播。我们的方法简化了生成过程,使实际应用具备更低的计算开销。在大规模Argoverse 2数据集上的实验验证表明,我们的方法在性能上具有优势,为自动驾驶领域提供了计算高效且高质量的联合轨迹预测和可控生成的可行解决方案。我们的项目网页为:https://yixiaowang7.github.io/OptTrajDiff_Page/
abstract_en: Diffusion models are promising for joint trajectory prediction and controllable generation in autonomous driving, but they face challenges of inefficient inference steps and high computational demands. To tackle these challenges, we introduce Optimal Gaussian Diffusion (OGD) and Estimated Clean Manifold (ECM) Guidance. OGD optimizes the prior distribution for a small diffusion time T and starts the reverse diffusion process from it. ECM directly injects guidance gradients to the estimated clean manifold, eliminating extensive gradient backpropagation throughout the network. Our methodology streamlines the generative process, enabling practical applications with reduced computational overhead. Experimental validation on the large-scale Argoverse 2 dataset demonstrates our approach’s superior performance, offering a viable solution for computationally efficient, high-quality joint trajectory prediction and controllable generation for autonomous driving. Our project webpage is at https://yixiaowang7.github.io/OptTrajDiff_ Page/

title: Yixin Yang, Jiangxin Dong, Jinhui Tang, Jinshan Pan*
title_en: Yixin Yang, Jiangxin Dong, Jinhui Tang, Jinshan Pan*
abstract: 如何有效探索时空特征对于视频上色至关重要。不同于沿时间维度堆叠多帧或递归传播估计特征(这些特征会累积误差或无法获取远距离帧的信息),我们开发了一种基于记忆的特征传播模块,能够与远距离帧的特征建立可靠连接,并减轻不准确估计特征的影响。为提升上述特征传播中每帧特征的提取质量,我们探索大规模预训练视觉模型的特征以指导每帧的特征估计,使估计特征能够建模复杂场景。此外,我们注意到相邻帧通常包含相似内容。为更好地利用这一特性进行时空特征提取,我们设计了局部注意力模块,以在时空邻域内聚合相邻帧的特征。我们将基于记忆的特征传播模块、大规模预训练视觉模型引导的特征估计模块和局部注意力模块整合为一个端到端可训练网络(命名为ColorMNet),并在基准数据集和真实场景中验证其性能优于现有方法。我们的源代码和预训练模型可在以下链接获取:https://github.com/yyang181/colormnet
abstract_en: How to effectively explore spatial-temporal features is important for video colorization. Instead of stacking multiple frames along the temporal dimension or recurrently propagating estimated features that will accumulate errors or cannot explore information from far-apart frames, we develop a memory-based feature propagation module that can establish reliable connections with features from far-apart frames and alleviate the influence of inaccurately estimated features. To extract better features from each frame for the above-mentioned feature propagation, we explore the features from large-pretrained visual models to guide the feature estimation of each frame so that the estimated features can model complex scenarios. In addition, we note that adjacent frames usually contain similar contents. To explore this property for better spatial and temporal feature utilization, we develop a local attention module to aggregate the features from adjacent frames in a spatial-temporal neighborhood. We formulate our memory-based feature propagation module, large-pretrained visual model guided feature estimation module, and local attention module into an end-to-end trainable network (named ColorMNet) and show that it performs favorably against state-of-the-art methods on both the benchmark datasets and real-world scenarios. Our source codes and pre-trained models are available at: https://github.com/yyang181/colormnet.

title: 范毅轩*, 李亚丽, 王胜金*
title_en: Yixuan Fan*, Ya-Li Li, Shengjin Wang*
abstract: 对自身车辆的规划是自动驾驶的最终目标。尽管基于深度学习的方法已被广泛应用于预测交通场景中其他代理的未来轨迹,但直接使用它们进行自身车辆规划往往不尽如人意。这是由于训练和部署过程中目标不匹配:仅旨在模仿人类驾驶员轨迹的规划器不足以良好完成驾驶任务。我们认为现有训练过程可能未能赋予模型对物理世界演化的理解。为解决这一差距,我们提出RaSc,即风险感知自洽模仿学习。RaSc不仅模仿驾驶轨迹,还通过学习人类驾驶员行为背后的动机(以实现风险感知)和自身行为的后果(通过自洽性)来提升性能。这两个特性源于我们针对碰撞时间(TTC)的新型预测分支和训练目标。此外,我们通过检查自洽性使模型在训练过程中更有效地挖掘困难样本。在大规模真实世界nuPlan数据集上的实验表明,RaSc在开环和更关键的闭环设置中均优于先前最先进的学习方法。
abstract_en: Planning for the ego vehicle is the ultimate goal of autono-mous driving. Although deep learning-based methods have been widely applied to predict future trajectories of other agents in traffic scenes, directly using them to plan for the ego vehicle is often unsatisfactory. This is due to misaligned objectives during training and deployment: a planner that only aims to imitate human driver trajectories is insufficient to accomplish driving tasks well. We argue that existing training processes may not endow models with an understanding of how the physical world evolves. To address this gap, we propose RaSc, which stands for Risk-aware Self-consistent imitation learning. RaSc not only imitates driving trajectories, but also learns the motivations behind human driver behaviors (to be risk-aware) and the consequences of its own actions (by being self-consistent). These two properties stem from our novel prediction branch and training objectives regarding Time-To-Collision (TTC). Moreover, we enable the model to better mine hard samples during training by checking its self-consistency. Our experiments on the large-scale real-world nuPlan dataset demonstrate that RaSc outperforms previous state-of-the-art learning-based methods, in both open-loop and, more importantly, closed-loop settings.

title: Yixuan Ren*, Yang Zhou, Jimei Yang, Jing Shi, Difan Liu, Feng Liu, Mingi Kwon, Abhinav Shrivastava
title_en: Yixuan Ren*, Yang Zhou, Jimei Yang, Jing Shi, Difan Liu, Feng Liu, Mingi Kwon, Abhinav Shrivastava
abstract: 文本到图像(T2I)扩散模型在图像定制化方面已得到广泛研究,取得了令人印象深刻的成果和应用。随着文本到视频(T2V)扩散模型的出现,其时间对应物——运动定制化——尚未得到充分研究。为了解决单次视频运动定制的挑战,我们提出Customize-A-Video方法,该方法从单个参考视频中建模运动,并通过空间和时间多样性将其适配到新主体和场景中。它利用低秩适应(LoRA)对时间注意力层进行调整,以针对特定的运动建模对预训练的T2V扩散模型进行定制。为在训练过程中分离空间和时间信息,我们引入了一种新颖的概念——外观吸收器,在运动学习之前将参考视频的原始外观与运动信息分离。所提出的模块通过分阶段的流水线进行训练,并以即插即用的方式进行推理,从而便于扩展到各种下游任务,如定制视频生成与编辑、视频外观定制和多运动组合。我们的项目页面可访问https://customize-a-video.github.io。
abstract_en: Image customization has been extensively studied in text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models, leading to impressive outcomes and applications. With the emergence of text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models, its temporal counterpart, motion customization, has not yet been well investigated. To address the challenge of one-shot video motion customization, we propose Customize-A-Video that models the motion from a single reference video and adapts it to new subjects and scenes with both spatial and temporal varieties. It leverages low-rank adaptation (LoRA) on temporal attention layers to tailor the pre-trained T2V diffusion model for specific motion modeling. To disentangle the spatial and temporal information during training, we introduce a novel concept of appearance absorbers that detach the original appearance from the reference video prior to motion learning. The proposed modules are trained in a staged pipeline and inferred in a plug-and-play fashion, enabling easy extensions to various downstream tasks such as custom video generation and editing, video appearance customization and multiple motion combination. Our project page can be found at https://customize-a-video.github.io.

title: Yixuan Wu*, Yizhou Wang, Shixiang Tang, Wenhao Wu, Tong He, Wanli Ouyang, Philip Torr, Jian Wu
title_en: Yixuan Wu*, Yizhou Wang, Shixiang Tang, Wenhao Wu, Tong He, Wanli Ouyang, Philip Torr, Jian Wu
abstract: 我们提出DetToolChain,一种新颖的提示范式,以释放多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)如GPT-4V和Gemini的零样本目标检测能力。我们的方法包含一个受高精度检测先验启发的检测提示工具包,以及一种新的思维链(Chain-of-Thought)来实现这些提示。具体而言,工具包中的提示设计用于引导MLLM关注区域信息(如放大细节)、根据测量标准读取坐标(如叠加尺子和圆规),并从上下文信息中推断(如叠加场景图)。基于这些工具,新的检测思维链能够自动将任务分解为简单子任务,诊断预测结果,并规划渐进式的边界框优化。我们的框架在一系列检测任务中均表现出色,尤其是在困难案例中。与现有最先进方法相比,GPT-4V结合我们的DetToolChain在MS COCO Novel class集上的开放词汇检测AP50提升21.5%,在RefCOCO val集上的零样本指称表达理解Acc提升24.23%,在D-cube describe object detection FULL设置上的AP提升14.5%。代码将在接受后发布。
abstract_en: We present DetToolChain, a novel prompting paradigm, to unleash the zero-shot object detection ability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), such as GPT-4V and Gemini. Our approach consists of a detection prompting toolkit inspired by high-precision detection priors and a new Chain-of-Thought to implement these prompts. Specifically, the prompts in the toolkit are designed to guide the MLLM to focus on regional information (e.g., zooming in), read coordinates according to measure standards (e.g., overlaying rulers and compasses), and infer from the contextual information (e.g., overlaying scene graphs). Building upon these tools, the new detection chain-of-thought can automatically decompose the task into simple subtasks, diagnose the predictions, and plan for progressive box refinements. The effectiveness of our framework is demonstrated across a spectrum of detection tasks, especially hard cases. Compared to existing state-of-the-art methods, GPT-4V with our DetToolChain improves state-of-the-art object detectors by +21.5% AP50 on MS COCO Novel class set for open-vocabulary detection, +24.23% Acc on RefCOCO val set for zero-shot referring expression comprehension, +14.5% AP on D-cube describe object detection FULL setting. The codes shall be released upon acceptance.

title: Yiyang Chen, Siyan Dong*, Xulong Wang, Lulu Cai, Youyi Zheng, Yanchao Yang*
title_en: Yiyang Chen, Siyan Dong*, Xulong Wang, Lulu Cai, Youyi Zheng, Yanchao Yang*
abstract: 从图像中进行三维表面重建对于众多应用至关重要。近年来,神经辐射场(NeRFs)作为一种三维建模的有前景框架崭露头角。然而,NeRFs需要准确的相机姿态作为输入,现有方法在处理显著噪声姿态估计(即异常值)时表现不佳,而这类异常值在现实场景中普遍存在。为解决这一挑战,我们提出了一种新颖的方法,通过场景图优化辐射场以减轻异常值的影响。我们的方法基于场景图引入了一种自适应的内点-外点置信度估计方案,强调与邻域高度兼容且渲染质量一致的图像。我们还引入了一种有效的交并比(IoU)损失函数以优化相机姿态和表面几何结构,并结合粗到精的策略以促进训练。此外,我们提出了一种包含典型异常值姿态的新数据集用于详细评估。在多个数据集上的实验结果一致证明了我们的方法在现有方法中的有效性与优越性,展示了其在处理异常值和生成高质量三维重建方面的鲁棒性。我们的代码和数据可在以下链接获取:https://github.com/Iris-cyy/SG-NeRF
abstract_en: 3D surface reconstruction from images is essential for numerous applications. Recently, Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) have emerged as a promising framework for 3D modeling. However, NeRFs require accurate camera poses as input, and existing methods struggle to handle significantly noisy pose estimates (i.e., outliers), which are commonly encountered in real-world scenarios. To tackle this challenge, we present a novel approach that optimizes radiance fields with scene graphs to mitigate the influence of outlier poses. Our method incorporates an adaptive inlier-outlier confidence estimation scheme based on scene graphs, emphasizing images of high compatibility with the neighborhood and consistency in the rendering quality. We also introduce an effective intersection-over-union (IoU) loss to optimize the camera pose and surface geometry, together with a coarse-to-fine strategy to facilitate the training. Furthermore, we propose a new dataset containing typical outlier poses for a detailed evaluation. Experimental results on various datasets consistently demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of our method over existing approaches, showcasing its robustness in handling outliers and producing high-quality 3D reconstructions. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/Iris-cyy/SG-NeRF.

title: Yiyang Su, Minchul Kim, Feng Liu, Anil Jain, Xiaoming Liu*
title_en: Yiyang Su, Minchul Kim, Feng Liu, Anil Jain, Xiaoming Liu*
abstract: 生物识别技术主要针对封闭集识别问题,假设所有探针主体均存在于数据库中。然而,大多数实际应用涉及开放集生物识别,其中探针主体可能存在于数据库中也可能不存在。这在有效区分数据库中的个体同时最小化误检方面提出了独特挑战。尽管普遍认为强大的生物识别模型在封闭集和开放集场景中均能表现出色,但现有损失函数与开放集评估不一致。它们对真实(匹配)和冒充者(非匹配)相似度得分对称处理,并忽视了冒充者得分的相对幅度。为解决这些问题,我们在训练过程中使用小批量数据模拟开放集评估,并引入了两种新型损失函数:(1) 针对选择性阈值下开放集性能优化的识别-检测损失,(2) 相对阈值最小化以降低每个探针的最大负得分。在包括人脸识别、步态识别和行人重识别在内的多种生物识别任务中,我们的实验验证了所提损失函数的有效性,显著提升了开放集性能,同时积极影响封闭集性能。我们的代码和模型可在此处获取。
abstract_en: Biometric recognition has primarily addressed closed-set identification, assuming all probe subjects are in the gallery. However, most practical applications involve open-set biometrics, where probe subjects may or may not be present in the gallery. This poses distinct challenges in effectively distinguishing individuals in the gallery while minimizing false detections. While it is commonly believed that powerful biometric models can excel in both closed- and open-set scenarios, existing loss functions are inconsistent with open-set evaluation. They treat genuine (mated) and imposter (non-mated) similarity scores symmetrically and neglect the relative magnitudes of imposter scores. To address these issues, we simulate open-set evaluation using minibatches during training and introduce novel loss functions: (1) the identification-detection loss optimized for open-set performance under selective thresholds and (2) relative threshold minimization to reduce the maximum negative score for each probe. Across diverse biometric tasks, including face recognition, gait recognition, and person re-identification, our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed loss functions, significantly enhancing open-set performance while positively impacting closed-set performance. Our code and models are available here.

title: 马毅尧*, 陈凯*, 洪盛棠, 魏若峰, 余伦·尼, 郭家伟*, 段琪*
title_en: Yiyao Ma*, Kai Chen*, Hon-Sing Tong, Ruofeng Wei, Yui-Lun Ng, Ka-Wai Kwok*, Qi Dou*
abstract: 准确估计柔性机器人在环境中的外部方位和内部弯曲角度对于理解其状态至关重要。然而,现有基于传感器的方法在成本、环境约束和集成问题方面存在局限性。传统基于图像的方法难以应对柔性机器人的形状复杂性。本文提出了一种新颖的基于形状引导的配置感知学习框架,用于基于图像的柔性机器人位姿估计。受近期2D-3D联合表示学习进展的启发,我们利用柔性机器人的3D形状先验知识来增强其基于图像的形状表示。我们首先提取3D形状先验的部件级几何表示,然后通过查询对应不同机器人部件的图像特征,将该表示适配到图像中。此外,我们提出了一种有效的机制动态变形形状先验。该机制旨在缓解所采用形状先验与图像中描绘的柔性机器人之间的形状差异。这种更具表现力的形状引导提升了基于图像的机器人表示,可有效用于柔性机器人位姿优化。在专为内窥镜手术设计的通用柔性机器人上的大量实验验证了我们的方法相较于一系列基于关键点、基于骨架和直接回归的方法的优势。项目主页:https://poseflex.github.io/
abstract_en: Accurate estimation of both the external orientation and internal bending angle is crucial for understanding a flexible robot state within its environment. However, existing sensor-based methods face limitations in cost, environmental constraints, and integration issues. Conventional image-based methods struggle with the shape complexity of flexible robots. In this paper, we propose a novel shape-guided configuration-aware learning framework for image-based flexible robot pose estimation. Inspired by the recent advances in 2D-3D joint representation learning, we leverage the 3D shape prior of the flexible robot to enhance its image-based shape representation. We first extract the part-level geometry representation of the 3D shape prior, then adapt this representation to the image by querying the image features corresponding to different robot parts. Furthermore, we present an effective mechanism to dynamically deform the shape prior. It aims to mitigate the shape difference between the adopted shape prior and the flexible robot depicted in the image. This more expressive shape guidance boosts the image-based robot representation and can be effectively used for flexible robot pose refinement. Extensive experiments on a general flexible robot designed for endoluminal surgery demonstrate the advantages of our method over a series of keypoint-based, skeleton-based and direct regression-based methods. Project homepage: https://poseflex.github.io/.

title: Yizhe Xiong, Hui Chen*, Tianxiang Hao, Zijia Lin, Jungong Han, Yuesong Zhang, Guoxin Wang, Yongjun Bao, Guiguang Ding
title_en: Yizhe Xiong, Hui Chen*, Tianxiang Hao, Zijia Lin, Jungong Han, Yuesong Zhang, Guoxin Wang, Yongjun Bao, Guiguang Ding
abstract: 近年来,Transformer模型的规模迅速扩大,这在任务适配领域引入了显著的训练开销和推理效率挑战。现有工作分别从参数高效微调(PEFT)和模型压缩两个方向研究了这些挑战。然而,PEFT无法保证原始主干网络的推理效率,尤其对于大规模模型而言。模型压缩则需要高昂的训练成本用于结构搜索和重新训练。因此,简单地将两者结合无法在最小成本下同时实现训练效率和推理效率。本文提出了一种新颖的并行产出重激活(PYRA)方法,以应对训练-推理效率型任务适配的挑战。PYRA首先利用并行产出自适应权重,全面感知下游任务的数据分布。随后应用一种用于令牌调制的重激活策略,使令牌得以合并,从而校准令牌特征。大量实验表明,PYRA在低压缩率和高压缩率下均优于所有竞争方法,证明了其在保持大规模基础模型训练效率和推理效率方面的有效性与优越性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/THU-MIG/PYRA获取。
abstract_en: Recently, the scale of transformers has grown rapidly, which introduces considerable challenges in terms of training overhead and inference efficiency in the scope of task adaptation. Existing works, namely Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) and model compression, have separately investigated the challenges. However, PEFT cannot guarantee the inference efficiency of the original backbone, especially for large-scale models. Model compression requires significant training costs for structure searching and re-training. Consequently, a simple combination of them cannot guarantee accomplishing both training efficiency and inference efficiency with minimal costs. In this paper, we propose a novel Parallel Yielding Re-Activation (PYRA) method for such a challenge of training-inference efficient task adaptation. PYRA first utilizes parallel yielding adaptive weights to comprehensively perceive the data distribution in downstream tasks. A re-activation strategy for token modulation is then applied for tokens to be merged, leading to calibrated token features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PYRA outperforms all competing methods under both low compression rate and high compression rate, demonstrating its effectiveness and superiority in maintaining both training efficiency and inference efficiency for large-scale foundation models. Our code is available at https://github.com/ THU-MIG/PYRA.

title: Yogesh Kumar*, Pekka Marttinen
title_en: Yogesh Kumar*, Pekka Marttinen
abstract: 我们引入了eCLIP,这是CLIP模型的增强版本,通过整合放射科医生注视热图形式的专家注释。它解决了对比多模态医学影像分析中的关键挑战,特别是数据稀缺性和“模态间隙”——图像与文本嵌入之间显著的差异,这会降低表示质量并阻碍跨模态互操作性。eCLIP集成了热图处理器,并利用mixup增强技术高效利用稀缺的专家注释,从而提升模型的学习效果。eCLIP设计为可广泛应用于任何CLIP变体,无需对核心架构进行任何修改。通过在多项任务上的详细评估,包括零样本推理、线性探针、跨模态检索以及使用冻结大型语言模型进行放射科报告的检索增强生成(RAG),eCLIP展示了嵌入质量的持续提升。实验结果揭示了增强的对齐性和一致性,证实了eCLIP利用高质量注释进行医学影像领域多模态分析的能力。
abstract_en: We introduce eCLIP, an enhanced version of the CLIP model that integrates expert annotations in the form of radiologist eye-gaze heatmaps. It tackles key challenges in contrastive multi-modal medical imaging analysis, notably data scarcity and the “modality gap” – a significant disparity between image and text embeddings that diminishes the quality of representations and hampers cross-modal interoperability. eCLIP integrates a heatmap processor and leverages mixup augmentation to efficiently utilize the scarce expert annotations, thus boosting the model’s learning effectiveness. eCLIP is designed to be generally applicable to any variant of CLIP without requiring any modifications of the core architecture. Through detailed evaluations across several tasks, including zero-shot inference, linear probing, cross-modal retrieval, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) of radiology reports using a frozen Large Language Model, eCLIP showcases consistent improvements in embedding quality. The outcomes reveal enhanced alignment and uniformity, affirming eCLIP’s capability to harness high-quality annotations for enriched multi-modal analysis in the medical imaging domain.

title: Yong Zhong, Min Zhao, Zebin You, Xiaofeng Yu, Changwang Zhang, Chongxuan Li*
title_en: Yong Zhong, Min Zhao, Zebin You, Xiaofeng Yu, Changwang Zhang, Chongxuan Li*
abstract: 本文介绍了PoseCrafter,一种基于灵活姿态控制的个性化视频生成的一次性方法。该方法基于Stable Diffusion和ControlNet,我们仔细设计了推理过程,以在没有对应真实帧的情况下生成高质量视频。首先,我们从训练视频中选择适当的参考帧并将其反转以初始化所有生成的潜在变量。然后,我们通过训练的时间注意力模块将相应的训练姿态插入目标姿态序列中,以提高忠实度。此外,为了缓解训练视频姿态与推理姿态之间的差异导致的面部和手部退化,我们通过涉及面部和手部地标的关键点的仿射变换矩阵进行简单的潜在编辑。在多个数据集上的大量实验表明,PoseCrafter在8个常用指标下优于在大量视频上预训练的基线。此外,PoseCrafter可以跟随不同个体或人工编辑的姿态,并在开放域训练视频中同时保留人类身份。我们的项目页面可在https://ml-gsai.github.io/PoseCrafter-demo/上找到。
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce PoseCrafter, a one-shot method for personalized video generation following the control of flexible poses. Built upon Stable Diffusion and ControlNet, we carefully design an inference process to produce high-quality videos without the corresponding ground-truth frames. First, we select an appropriate reference frame from the training video and invert it to initialize all latent variables for generation. Then, we insert the corresponding training pose into the target pose sequences to enhance faithfulness through a trained temporal attention module. Furthermore, to alleviate the face and hand degradation resulting from discrepancies between poses of training videos and inference poses, we implement simple latent editing through an affine transformation matrix involving facial and hand landmarks. Extensive experiments on several datasets demonstrate that PoseCrafter achieves superior results to baselines pre-trained on a vast collection of videos under 8 commonly used metrics. Besides, PoseCrafter can follow poses from different individuals or artificial edits and simultaneously retain the human identity in an open-domain training video. Our project page is available at https://ml-gsai.github.io/PoseCrafter-demo/.

title: Yongcong Zhang, Bangyan Liao, Yifei Xue, Lu Chen, Peidong Liu, Yizhen Lao*
title_en: Yongcong Zhang, Bangyan Liao, Yifei Xue, Lu Chen, Peidong Liu, Yizhen Lao*
abstract: 线条是人工环境中普遍存在的元素,本质上编码了空间结构信息,因此使其成为实际应用中特征表示的更鲁棒选择。尽管具有明显优势,但先前的滚动快门光束法平差(RSBA)方法仅支持稀疏特征点,鲁棒性不足,尤其在退化环境中表现不佳。本文首次提出基于线条的滚动快门光束法平差解决方案RSL-BA。具体而言,我们首先利用Plücker线参数化建立滚动快门相机线条投影理论。随后,我们推导出一系列稳定且高效的重投影误差公式。最后,我们通过理论与实验验证,证明该方法可防止三种常见退化情况,其中一种退化情况首次在本文中被发现。大量合成与真实数据实验表明,该方法的效率和精度与现有基于点的滚动快门光束法平差方案相当。
abstract_en: The line is a prevalent element in man-made environments, inherently encoding spatial structural information, thus making it a more robust choice for feature representation in practical applications. Despite its apparent advantages, previous rolling shutter bundle adjustment (RSBA) methods have only supported sparse feature points, which lack robustness, particularly in degenerate environments. In this paper, we introduce the first rolling shutter line-based bundle adjustment solution, RSL-BA. Specifically, we initially establish the rolling shutter camera line projection theory utilizing Plücker line parameterization. Subsequently, we derive a series of reprojection error formulations which are stable and efficient. Finally, we theoretically and experimentally demonstrate that our method can prevent three common degeneracies, one of which is first discovered in this paper. Extensive synthetic and real data experiments demonstrate that our method achieves efficiency and accuracy comparable to existing point-based rolling shutter bundle adjustment solutions.

title: Yonggan Fu, Huaizhi Qu, Zhifan Ye, Chaojian Li, Kevin Zhao, Yingyan (Celine) Lin*
title_en: Yonggan Fu, Huaizhi Qu, Zhifan Ye, Chaojian Li, Kevin Zhao, Yingyan (Celine) Lin*
abstract: 近年来神经辐射场(NeRFs)的突破性进展引发了将其集成到现实世界3D应用中的显著需求。然而,不同3D应用所需的多样化功能往往需要具有不同管道的多种NeRF模型,导致针对每个目标任务进行繁琐的NeRF训练和耗时的试错实验。受新兴基础模型的泛化能力和适应性启发,我们的工作旨在开发一个通用的NeRF模型以处理多样化的3D任务。我们通过提出一个名为__TITLE_MATH_1__的框架实现这一目标,该框架具备(1)可泛化的3D重建和零样本多任务场景理解能力,以及(2)对多样化下游3D应用(如实时渲染和场景编辑)的适应性。我们的核心洞察是,一个基于图像的渲染管道,结合精确的几何和外观估计,能够将2D图像特征提升为对应的3D特征,从而以可泛化的方式将广泛探索的2D任务扩展到3D世界。具体而言,我们的__ABS_MATH_1__采用基于图像的渲染技术,包含两个解耦的分支:一个基于复杂Transformer的分支,逐步融合几何和外观特征以实现精确的几何估计;一个轻量级分支用于预测源视图的混合权重。该设计在混合权重可跨多样化任务复用的情况下,实现了最先进的(SOTA)可泛化3D表面重建质量,支持零样本多任务场景理解。此外,它还能通过将复杂几何分支烘焙为网格实现实时渲染,快速适应以达到SOTA的可泛化3D理解性能,并与2D扩散模型无缝集成,实现文本引导的3D编辑。我们的代码可在:https://github.com/GATECH-EIC/Omni-Recon 获取。
abstract_en: Recent breakthroughs in Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) have sparked significant demand for their integration into real-world 3D applications. However, the varied functionalities required by different 3D applications often necessitate diverse NeRF models with various pipelines, leading to tedious NeRF training for each target task and cumbersome trial-and-error experiments. Drawing inspiration from the generalization capability and adaptability of emerging foundation models, our work aims to develop one general-purpose NeRF for handling diverse 3D tasks. We achieve this by proposing a framework called , which is capable of (1) generalizable 3D reconstruction and zero-shot multitask scene understanding, and (2) adaptability to diverse downstream 3D applications such as real-time rendering and scene editing. Our key insight is that an image-based rendering pipeline, with accurate geometry and appearance estimation, can lift 2D image features into their 3D counterparts, thus extending widely explored 2D tasks to the 3D world in a generalizable manner. Specifically, our features a general-purpose NeRF model using image-based rendering with two decoupled branches: one complex transformer-based branch that progressively fuses geometry and appearance features for accurate geometry estimation, and one lightweight branch for predicting blending weights of source views. This design achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) generalizable 3D surface reconstruction quality with blending weights reusable across diverse tasks for zero-shot multitask scene understanding. In addition, it can enable real-time rendering after baking the complex geometry branch into meshes, swift adaptation to achieve SOTA generalizable 3D understanding performance, and seamless integration with 2D diffusion models for text-guided 3D editing. Our code is available at: https://github.com/GATECH-EIC/Omni-Recon.

title: Yonggan Wu, Ling-Chao Meng*, Yuan Zichao, Sixian Chan, Hong-Qiang Wang*
title_en: Yonggan Wu, Ling-Chao Meng*, Yuan Zichao, Sixian Chan, Hong-Qiang Wang*
abstract: 对于可见光-红外人重识别(VI-ReID)任务,主要挑战之一在于显著的跨模态差异。现有方法在模态不变信息挖掘方面存在困难,通常仅关注空间或通道等单一维度的信息挖掘,而忽视了特定模态多维信息的提取。为全面挖掘广泛范围内的模态不变信息,我们引入了宽范围信息挖掘网络(WRIM-Net),其主要包含多维交互信息挖掘(MIIM)模块和基于辅助信息的对比学习(AICL)方法。通过提出的全局区域交互(GRI),MIIM 通过维度内交互全面挖掘非局部空间和通道信息。此外,得益于低计算复杂度设计,单独的 MIIM 可定位在浅层,使网络能够更好地挖掘特定模态多维信息。AICL 通过引入新颖的跨模态关键实例对比(CMKIC)损失,有效引导网络提取模态不变信息。我们在知名 SYSU-MM01 和 RegDB 数据集以及最新大规模跨模态 LLCM 数据集上进行了大量实验。结果表明 WRIM-Net 在现有方法中具有优越性。
abstract_en: For the visible-infrared person re-identification (VI-ReID) task, one of the primary challenges lies in significant cross-modality discrepancy. Existing methods struggle to conduct modality-invariant information mining. They often focus solely on mining singular dimensions like spatial or channel, and overlook the extraction of specific-modality multi-dimension information. To fully mine modality-invariant information across a wide range, we introduce the Wide-Ranging Information Mining Network (WRIM-Net), which mainly comprises a Multi-dimension Interactive Information Mining (MIIM) module and an Auxiliary-Information-based Contrastive Learning (AICL) approach. Empowered by the proposed Global Region Interaction (GRI), MIIM comprehensively mines non-local spatial and channel information through intra-dimension interaction. Moreover, Thanks to the low computational complexity design, separate MIIM can be positioned in shallow layers, enabling the network to better mine specific-modality multi-dimension information. AICL, by introducing the novel Cross-Modality Key-Instance Contrastive (CMKIC) loss, effectively guides the network in extracting modality-invariant information. We conduct extensive experiments not only on the well-known SYSU-MM01 and RegDB datasets but also on the latest large-scale cross-modality LLCM dataset. The results demonstrate WRIM-Net’s superiority over state-of-the-art methods.

title: Yongjian Zhang, Longguang Wang, Kunhong Li, WANG Yun, Yulan Guo*
title_en: Yongjian Zhang, Longguang Wang, Kunhong Li, WANG Yun, Yulan Guo*
abstract: 基于领域内数据训练的最先进立体匹配网络在跨领域场景中往往表现不佳。直观来看,利用基础模型的零样本能力可以缓解跨领域泛化问题。将基础模型整合到立体匹配流程中的主要挑战在于缺乏从单视角粗粒度标记到跨视角细粒度成本表示的有效前向过程。本文提出FormerStereo,一个将基于视觉Transformer(ViT)的基础模型整合到立体匹配流程中的通用框架。通过该框架,我们将通用特征转换为匹配特定特征。具体而言,我们提出一种重建约束解码器,从粗粒度ViT标记中检索细粒度表示。为保持跨视角一致的表示,我们提出余弦约束拼接成本(C4)空间来构建成本体。我们将FormerStereo与最先进(SOTA)立体匹配网络集成,并在多个基准数据集上评估其有效性。实验表明,FormerStereo框架有效提升了现有立体匹配网络在未见领域中的零样本性能,并实现了SOTA表现。
abstract_en: State-of-the-art stereo matching networks trained on in-domain data often underperform on cross-domain scenes. Intuitively, leveraging the zero-shot capacity of a foundation model can alleviate the cross-domain generalization problem. The main challenge of incorporating a foundation model into stereo matching pipeline lies in the absence of an effective forward process from single-view coarse-grained tokens to cross-view fine-grained cost representations. In this paper, we propose FormerStereo, a general framework that integrates the Vision Transformer (ViT) based foundation model into the stereo matching pipeline. Using this framework, we transfer the all-purpose features to matching-specific ones. Specifically, we propose a reconstruction-constrained decoder to retrieve fine-grained representations from coarse-grained ViT tokens. To maintain cross-view consistent representations, we propose a cosine-constrained concatenation cost (C4) space to construct cost volumes. We integrate FormerStereo with state-of-the-art (SOTA) stereo matching networks and evaluate its effectiveness on multiple benchmark datasets. Experiments show that the FormerStereo framework effectively improves the zero-shot performance of existing stereo matching networks on unseen domains and achieves SOTA performance.

title: 组合宇宙:通过多模型组合生成高质量复杂3D资产
title_en: Yongwei Chen, Tengfei Wang, Tong Wu, Xingang Pan, Kui Jia*, Ziwei Liu
abstract: 从给定图像生成高质量3D资产在AR/VR等应用中具有重要价值。近期单图像三维生成技术探索了无需优化的前馈模型,通过学习推断物体的3D模型。尽管单物体生成已取得显著成果,但现有方法在建模包含多个物体的复杂3D资产时仍存在挑战。本文提出ComboVerse框架,通过学习组合多个模型生成高质量复杂组合3D资产。1)我们从模型和数据角度深入分析"多物体差距"问题。2)通过重建不同物体的3D模型,调整其尺寸、旋转角度和位置以匹配给定图像。3)为自动化该过程,我们应用预训练扩散模型的空间感知分数蒸馏采样(SSDS)指导物体定位。相比标准分数蒸馏采样,我们的框架强调物体空间对齐,从而实现更精确的生成效果。大量实验验证了ComboVerse在生成组合3D资产方面相比现有方法具有显著优势。
abstract_en: Generating high-quality 3D assets from a given image is highly desirable in various applications such as AR/VR. Recent advances in single-image 3D generation explore feed-forward models that learn to infer the 3D model of an object without optimization. Though promising results have been achieved in single object generation, these methods often struggle to model complex 3D assets that inherently contain multiple objects. In this work, we present ComboVerse, a 3D generation framework that produces high-quality 3D assets with complex compositions by learning to combine multiple models. 1) We first perform an in-depth analysis of this “multi-object gap” from both model and data perspectives. 2) Next, with reconstructed 3D models of different objects, we seek to adjust their sizes, rotation angles, and locations to create a 3D asset that matches the given image. 3) To automate this process, we apply spatially-aware score distillation sampling (SSDS) from pretrained diffusion models to guide the positioning of objects. Our proposed framework emphasizes spatial alignment of objects, compared with standard score distillation sampling, and thus achieves more accurate results. Extensive experiments validate ComboVerse achieves clear improvements over existing methods in generating compositional 3D assets.

title: Yongwei Nie, Changzhen Liu, Chengjiang Long, Qing Zhang, Guiqing Li, Hongmin Cai*
title_en: Yongwei Nie, Changzhen Liu, Chengjiang Long, Qing Zhang, Guiqing Li, Hongmin Cai*
abstract: 除了3D网格,人体网格恢复(HMR)方法通常需要估计相机以计算2D重投影损失。先前方法可能遇到以下问题:网格和相机均不正确,但其组合可能产生较低的重投影损失。为缓解此问题,我们定义包含相同人体的多个感兴趣区域(RoIs),并提出一种基于多RoI的HMR方法。我们的核心思想是:通过多个RoI作为输入,可以估计多个局部相机,并有机会设计和应用相机间的额外约束以提升相机精度,从而提高对应3D网格的准确性。为实现该思想,我们提出一种RoI感知的特征融合网络,用于估计所有RoI共享的3D网格以及对应RoI的局部相机。我们观察到局部相机可转换为全图相机,由此构建局部相机一致性损失作为对局部相机施加的额外约束。引入多RoI的另一优势是可将网络封装至对比学习框架,并应用对比损失正则化网络训练。实验验证了我们多RoI HMR方法的有效性及其优于近期方法的优越性。代码已开源至https://github.com/CptDiaos/Multi-RoI。
abstract_en: Besides a 3D mesh, Human Mesh Recovery (HMR) methods usually need to estimate a camera for computing 2D reprojection loss. Previous approaches may encounter the following problem: both the mesh and camera are not correct but the combination of them can yield a low reprojection loss. To alleviate this problem, we define multiple RoIs (region of interest) containing the same human and propose a multiple-RoI-based HMR method. Our key idea is that with multiple RoIs as input, we can estimate multiple local cameras and have the opportunity to design and apply additional constraints between cameras to improve the accuracy of the cameras and, in turn, the accuracy of the corresponding 3D mesh. To implement this idea, we propose a RoI-aware feature fusion network by which we estimate a 3D mesh shared by all RoIs as well as local cameras corresponding to the RoIs. We observe that local cameras can be converted to the camera of the full image through which we construct a local camera consistency loss as the additional constraint imposed on local cameras. Another benefit of introducing multiple RoIs is that we can encapsulate our network into a contrastive learning framework and apply a contrastive loss to regularize the training of our network. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our multi-RoI HMR method and superiority to recent prior arts. Our code is available at https://github.com/CptDiaos/Multi-RoI.

title: Yongwei Nie, Hao Huang, Chengjiang Long, Qing Zhang, Pradipta Maji, Hongmin Cai*
title_en: Yongwei Nie, Hao Huang, Chengjiang Long, Qing Zhang, Pradipta Maji, Hongmin Cai*
abstract: 视频异常检测(VAD)在单类分类(OCC)和弱监督学习(WS)的设定下已被广泛研究,但这两者均需要繁琐的人工标注的正常/异常标签。本文研究无需任何标签的无监督视频异常检测(UVAD),通过将OCC和WS结合到统一的训练框架中实现。具体而言,我们将OCC扩展为加权单类分类(wOCC),并提出一个wOCC-WS交错训练模块,其中两个模型会相互生成伪标签。为使组合有效,我们面临两个挑战:(1)由于伪标签的不可避免的随机性,模型在训练过程中性能偶尔会波动;(2)需要阈值划分伪标签,使训练依赖于用户干预的准确性。针对第一个问题,我们提出使用需要软标签的wOCC而非使用硬零/一标签训练的OCC,因为软标签在不同训练周期中表现出高度一致性,而硬标签容易发生突变。针对第二个问题,我们多次重复交错训练模块,并提出一种自适应阈值策略,可逐步将粗略阈值优化为相对最优阈值,从而减少用户交互的影响。采用OCC和WS方法组合UVAD方法的优势在于,我们可以将最新的OCC或WS模型集成到框架中。实验验证了所提UVAD框架的有效性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/benedictstar/Joint-VAD获取。
abstract_en: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) has been extensively studied under the settings of One-Class Classification (OCC) and Weakly-Supervised learning (WS), which however both require laborious human-annotated normal/abnormal labels. In this paper, we study Unsupervised VAD (UVAD) that does not depend on any label by combining OCC and WS into a unified training framework. Specifically, we extend OCC to weighted OCC (wOCC) and propose a wOCC-WS interleaving training module, where the two models automatically generate pseudo-labels for each other. We face two challenges to make the combination effective: (1) Models’ performance fluctuates occasionally during the training process due to the inevitable randomness of the pseudo labels. (2) Thresholds are needed to divide pseudo labels, making the training depend on the accuracy of user intervention. For the first problem, we propose to use wOCC requiring soft labels instead of OCC trained with hard zero/one labels, as soft labels exhibit high consistency throughout different training cycles while hard labels are prone to sudden changes. For the second problem, we repeat the interleaving training module multiple times, during which we propose an adaptive thresholding strategy that can progressively refine a rough threshold to a relatively optimal threshold, which reduces the influence of user interaction. A benefit of employing OCC and WS methods to compose a UVAD method is that we can incorporate the most recent OCC or WS model into our framework. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed UVAD framework. Our code is available at https://github.com/benedictstar/Joint-VAD.

title: Yoon Gyo Jung*, Jaewoo Park, Xingbo Dong, Hojin Park, Andrew Beng Jin Teoh, Octavia Camps*
title_en: Yoon Gyo Jung*, Jaewoo Park, Xingbo Dong, Hojin Park, Andrew Beng Jin Teoh, Octavia Camps*
abstract: 理解面部识别系统对恶意攻击的脆弱性至关重要。以往的研究主要集中在重建能够穿透目标验证系统的面部图像。然而,即使在白盒场景下,简单重建的图像仍会错误地表示身份信息,因此一旦面部系统更新或更改,攻击很容易被中和。在本文中,我们旨在重建能够对未见过的编码器进行面部攻击的面部图像。我们将此问题称为面部重建转移攻击(FRTA),并证明其可以被表述为分布外(OOD)泛化问题。受其OOD特性启发,我们提出通过伪目标平均潜在搜索与无监督验证(ALSUV)来解决FRTA。为增强对OOD未见过编码器的重建攻击,ALSUV通过多次潜在优化、潜在优化轨迹平均以及使用伪目标的无监督验证,利用变分生成器StyleGAN2的潜在空间重建面部图像。我们在广泛使用的面部数据集上展示了方法的有效性和泛化能力,并辅以大量消融研究和视觉、定性及定量分析。代码:https://github.com/jungyg/ALSUV.git
abstract_en: Understanding the vulnerability of face recognition systems to malicious attacks is of critical importance. Previous works have focused on reconstructing face images that can penetrate a targeted verification system. Even in the white-box scenario, however, naively reconstructed images misrepresent the identity information, hence the attacks are easily neutralized once the face system is updated or changed. In this paper, we aim to reconstruct face images which are capable of transferring face attacks on unseen encoders. We term this problem as Face Reconstruction Transfer Attack (FRTA) and show that it can be formulated as an out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization problem. Inspired by its OOD nature, we propose to solve FRTA by Averaged Latent Search and Unsupervised Validation with pseudo target (ALSUV). To strengthen the reconstruction attack on OOD unseen encoders, ALSUV reconstructs the face by searching the latent of amortized generator StyleGAN2 through multiple latent optimization, latent optimization trajectory averaging, and unsupervised validation with a pseudo target. We demonstrate the efficacy and generalization of our method on widely used face datasets, accompanying it with extensive ablation studies and visually, qualitatively, and quantitatively analyses. Code: https://github.com/jungyg/ALSUV.git

title: Yoonwoo Jeong, Jinwoo Lee, Chiheon Kim, Minsu Cho*, Doyup Lee*
title_en: Yoonwoo Jeong, Jinwoo Lee, Chiheon Kim, Minsu Cho*, Doyup Lee*
abstract: 近年来,基于单张图像的新视角合成(NVS)在利用预训练文本到图像(T2I)模型的生成能力方面取得了令人印象深刻的结果。然而,先前的NVS方法需要额外优化才能使用其他即插即用图像生成模块(如ControlNet和LoRA),因为它们需要微调T2I参数。在本研究中,我们提出了一种高效的即插即用适配模块NVS-Adapter,该模块无需大量微调即可与现有即插即用模块兼容。我们引入了目标视角和参考视角对齐,以提高多视角预测的几何一致性。实验结果表明,我们的NVS-Adapter与现有即插即用模块具有良好的兼容性。此外,尽管NVS-Adapter未微调预训练T2I模型的数十亿参数,它在NVS基准测试中仍表现出优于现有最先进方法的性能。代码和数据可在postech-cvlab.github.io/nvsadapter/获取。1 1 本工作是在KakaoBrain夏季实习项目期间完成的。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in Novel View Synthesis (NVS) from a single image have produced impressive results by leveraging the generation capabilities of pre-trained Text-to-Image (T2I) models. However, previous NVS approaches require extra optimization to use other plug-and-play image generation modules such as ControlNet and LoRA, as they fine-tune the T2I parameters. In this study, we propose an efficient plug-and-play adaptation module, NVS-Adapter, that is compatible with existing plug-and-play modules without extensive fine-tuning. We introduce target views and reference view alignment to improve the geometric consistency of multi-view predictions. Experimental results demonstrate the compatibility of our NVS-Adapter with existing plug-and-play modules. Moreover, our NVS-Adapter shows superior performance over state-of-the-art methods on NVS benchmarks although it does not fine-tune billions of parameters of the pre-trained T2I models. The code and data are publicly available at postech-cvlab.github.io/nvsadapter/ 1 1 This work was done during the summer internship program at KakaoBrain.

title: Yotam Nitzan*, Zongze Wu, Richard Zhang, Eli Shechtman, Danny Cohen-Or, Taesung Park, Michaël Gharbi
title_en: Yotam Nitzan*, Zongze Wu, Richard Zhang, Eli Shechtman, Danny Cohen-Or, Taesung Park, Michaël Gharbi
abstract: 我们提出了一种新型的扩散变换器,能够高效生成部分图像更新。我们的方法针对交互式图像编辑应用,用户可以从空白画布或图像出发,通过二值掩码和文本提示指定一系列局部图像修改。我们的生成器分为两个阶段:首先,上下文编码器处理当前画布和用户掩码,生成针对待生成区域的紧凑全局上下文;其次,基于该上下文,一个基于扩散的变换器解码器以“懒惰”方式合成掩码像素,即仅生成掩码区域。这与先前方法形成对比:先前方法要么重新生成整个画布,浪费时间和计算资源;要么仅在掩码周围的小矩形区域进行处理,完全忽略全局图像上下文。我们的解码器运行时间与掩码大小成比例,而掩码通常较小;编码器引入的开销可以忽略不计。我们证明,我们的方法在图像质量和保真度方面与最先进的图像修复方法具有竞争力,同时在典型用户交互中提供10倍的速度提升,其中编辑掩码仅占图像的10%。
abstract_en: We introduce a novel diffusion transformer, , that generates partial image updates efficiently. Our approach targets interactive image editing applications in which, starting from a blank canvas or an image, a user specifies a sequence of localized image modifications using binary masks and text prompts. Our generator operates in two phases. First, a context encoder processes the current canvas and user mask to produce a compact global context tailored to the region to generate. Second, conditioned on this context, a diffusion-based transformer decoder synthesizes the masked pixels in a “lazy” fashion, i.e., it only generates the masked region.
