This contrasts with previous works that either regenerate the full canvas, wasting time and computation, or confine processing to a tight rectangular crop around the mask, ignoring the global image context altogether. Our decoder’s runtime scales with the mask size, which is typically small, while our encoder introduces negligible overhead. We demonstrate that our approach is competitive with state-of-the-art inpainting methods in terms of quality and fidelity while providing a 10× speedup for typical user interactions, where the editing mask represents 10% of the image.

title: Sun Youheng, Yuan Shengming, Wang Xuanhan*, Gao Lianli, Song Jingkuan
title_en: Youheng Sun, Shengming Yuan, Xuanhan Wang*, Lianli Gao, Jingkuan Song
abstract: 有针对性的对抗攻击旨在通过难以察觉的扰动误导模型将任意图像识别为目标对象,已成为评估深度神经网络(DNNs)脆弱性的主流工具。由于现有针对性攻击方法仅能学习攻击已知目标类别,因此难以泛化到未知类别。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种通用对抗攻击者(Generalized Adversarial attacKER,GAKer),能够构建针对任何目标类别的对抗样本。GAKer的核心思想是在生成对抗样本时构造一种潜在感染的表示。为此,首先将提取的目标对象的潜在表示注入到输入图像的中间特征中,通过对抗生成器进行处理。随后,生成器被优化以确保与输入图像在视觉上保持一致,同时在特征空间中接近目标对象。由于GAKer无类依赖且无模型依赖,可被视为一种通用工具,不仅能够揭示更多DNNs的脆弱性,还能在更广泛的类别中识别DNNs的缺陷。大量实验验证了我们方法在生成已知和未知类别对抗样本方面的有效性。值得注意的是,与其它生成方法相比,我们的方法在未知类别上的攻击成功率高出约14.13%,在已知类别上的成功率高出约4.23%。我们的代码可在https://github.com/VL-Group/GAKer获取。
abstract_en: Targeted adversarial attack, which aims to mislead a model to recognize any image as a target object by imperceptible perturbations, has become a mainstream tool for vulnerability assessment of deep neural networks (DNNs). Since existing targeted attackers only learn to attack known target classes, they cannot generalize well to unknown classes. To tackle this issue, we propose Generalized Adversarial attacKER (GAKer), which is able to construct adversarial examples to any target class. The core idea behind GAKer is to craft a latently infected representation during adversarial example generation. To this end, the extracted latent representations of the target object are first injected into intermediate features of an input image in an adversarial generator. Then, the generator is optimized to ensure visual consistency with the input image while being close to the target object in the feature space. Since the GAKer is class-agnostic yet model-agnostic, it can be regarded as a general tool that not only reveals the vulnerability of more DNNs but also identifies deficiencies of DNNs in a wider range of classes. Extensive experiments have demonstrated the effectiveness of our proposed method in generating adversarial examples for both known and unknown classes. Notably, compared with other generative methods, our method achieves an approximately 14.13% higher attack success rate for unknown classes and an approximately 4.23% higher success rate for known classes. Our code is available in https://github.com/VL-Group/GAKer.

title: Young Kyun Jang*, Dat B Huynh, Ashish Shah, Wen-Kai Chen, Ser-Nam Lim*
title_en: Young Kyun Jang*, Dat B Huynh, Ashish Shah, Wen-Kai Chen, Ser-Nam Lim*
abstract: 组合图像检索(CIR)是一项复杂的任务,它通过查询来检索图像,该查询由一张图像和一个描述所需图像修改的标题组成。监督式CIR方法表现出色,但它们对昂贵的手动标注数据集的依赖限制了其可扩展性和更广泛的应用。为了解决这些问题,先前的研究提出了基于伪词标记的零样本CIR(ZS-CIR)方法,这些方法利用投影模块将图像映射到词标记。然而,我们推测这种方法存在一个缺点:投影模块会扭曲原始图像表示,并将生成的组合嵌入限制在文本侧。为了解决这一问题,我们引入了一种新颖的ZS-CIR方法,该方法使用球面线性插值(Slerp)直接合并图像和文本表示,通过识别两者的中间嵌入。此外,我们引入了文本锚定调优(TAT)方法,该方法在保持文本编码器固定的情况下微调图像编码器。TAT缩小了图像和文本之间的模态差距,使Slerp过程更加有效。值得注意的是,TAT方法不仅在训练数据集规模和训练时间方面高效,而且还能作为训练监督式CIR模型的优秀初始检查点,从而突显其更广泛的应用潜力。将基于Slerp的ZS-CIR与TAT调优模型结合,使我们的方法在CIR基准测试中实现了最先进的检索性能。代码可在https://github.com/youngkyunJang/SLERP-TAT获取。
abstract_en: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) is a complex task that retrieves images using a query, which is configured with an image and a caption that describes desired modifications to that image. Supervised CIR approaches have shown strong performance, but their reliance on expensive manually-annotated datasets restricts their scalability and broader applicability. To address these issues, previous studies have proposed pseudo-word token-based Zero-Shot CIR (ZS-CIR) methods, which utilize a projection module to map images to word tokens. However, we conjecture that this approach has a downside: the projection module distorts the original image representation and confines the resulting composed embeddings to the text-side. In order to resolve this, we introduce a novel ZS-CIR method that uses Spherical Linear Interpolation (Slerp) to directly merge image and text representations by identifying an intermediate embedding of both. Furthermore, we introduce Text-Anchored-Tuning (TAT), a method that fine-tunes the image encoder while keeping the text encoder fixed. TAT closes the modality gap between images and text, making the Slerp process much more effective. Notably, the TAT method is not only efficient in terms of the scale of the training dataset and training time, but it also serves as an excellent initial checkpoint for training supervised CIR models, thereby highlighting its wider potential. The integration of the Slerp-based ZS-CIR with a TAT-tuned model enables our approach to deliver state-of-the-art retrieval performance across CIR benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/youngkyunJang/SLERP-TAT

title: YoungJoong Kwon*, Baole Fang, Yixing Lu, Haoye Dong, Cheng Zhang, Francisco Vicente Carrasco, Albert Mosella-Montoro, Jianjin Xu, Shingo J Takagi, Daeil Kim, Aayush Prakash, Fernando de la Torre
title_en: YoungJoong Kwon*, Baole Fang, Yixing Lu, Haoye Dong, Cheng Zhang, Francisco Vicente Carrasco, Albert Mosella-Montoro, Jianjin Xu, Shingo J Takagi, Daeil Kim, Aayush Prakash, Fernando de la Torre
abstract: 神经渲染领域的最新进展催生了诸如NeRF和高斯点云等开创性方法,这些方法革新了增强现实/虚拟现实、游戏和内容创作等多个领域的视图渲染。尽管这些方法在插值训练数据方面表现出色,但如何从极稀疏的视图泛化到新场景和物体仍是一个挑战。具体而言,由于人体几何结构的固有复杂性,从稀疏视图建模3D人体面临巨大困难,导致几何和纹理重建不准确。为解决这一挑战,本文利用高斯点云的最新进展,提出了一种新的方法,通过前馈方式学习可泛化的通用人体高斯分布,从而实现从有限稀疏视图中逼真且精确地渲染新的人体主体。我们的方法的关键创新在于将3D高斯参数的学习过程重新表述为基于人体模板2D UV空间的回归过程,这使得能够利用强大的几何先验知识和2D卷积的优势。此外,我们提出了一种多骨架结构以有效表示偏移细节。我们的方法在数据集内和跨数据集的泛化设置中均优于近期方法。
abstract_en: Recent progress in neural rendering has brought forth pioneering methods, such as NeRF and Gaussian Splatting, which revolutionize view rendering across various domains like AR/VR, gaming, and content creation. While these methods excel at interpolating within the training data, the challenge of generalizing to new scenes and objects from very sparse views persists. Specifically, modeling 3D humans from sparse views presents formidable hurdles due to the inherent complexity of human geometry, resulting in inaccurate reconstructions of geometry and textures. To tackle this challenge, this paper leverages recent advancements in Gaussian Splatting and introduces a new method to learn generalizable human Gaussians that allows photorealistic and accurate view-rendering of a new human subject from a limited set of sparse views in a feed-forward manner. A pivotal innovation of our approach involves reformulating the learning of 3D Gaussian parameters into a regression process defined on the 2D UV space of a human template, which allows leveraging the strong geometry prior and the advantages of 2D convolutions. In addition, a multi-scaffold is proposed to effectively represent the offset details. Our method outperforms recent methods on both within-dataset generalization as well as cross-dataset generalization settings.

title: Youngeun Kim*, Yuhang Li, Priyadarshini Panda
title_en: Youngeun Kim*, Yuhang Li, Priyadarshini Panda
abstract: 基于提示的持续学习(PCL)因其在防止隐私泄露和内存开销问题的同时实现最先进性能,成为一种有前景的持续学习解决方案而受到广泛关注。然而,现有PCL方法由于两个视觉变换器(ViT)前馈阶段而面临显著的计算负担;一个用于生成提示查询以选择提示池内的提示的查询ViT,另一个是将选定提示与图像标记之间信息混合的主干ViT。为了解决这一问题,我们通过直接使用中间层的标记嵌入作为提示查询,引入了一种单阶段PCL框架。该设计消除了对额外查询ViT前馈阶段的需求,从而在训练和推理过程中实现约50%的计算成本降低,仅导致微小的准确率下降(≤1%)。我们进一步引入了查询池正则化(QR)损失,通过调节提示查询与提示池之间的关系来提升表示能力。QR损失仅在训练阶段应用,因此推理过程中不会产生计算开销。借助QR损失,我们的方法在推理过程中仍保持约50%的计算成本降低,并在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-R和DomainNet等公共类别增量持续学习基准上,相比现有双阶段PCL方法提升了约1.4%。
abstract_en: Prompt-based Continual Learning (PCL) has gained considerable attention as a promising continual learning solution because it achieves state-of-the-art performance while preventing privacy violations and memory overhead problems. Nonetheless, existing PCL approaches face significant computational burdens because of two Vision Transformer (ViT) feed-forward stages; one is for the query ViT that generates a prompt query to select prompts inside a prompt pool; the other one is a backbone ViT that mixes information between selected prompts and image tokens. To address this, we introduce a one-stage PCL framework by directly using the intermediate layer’s token embedding as a prompt query. This design removes the need for an additional feed-forward stage for query ViT, resulting in ∼ 50% computational cost reduction for both training and inference with marginal accuracy drop (≤ 1%). We further introduce a Query-Pool Regularization (QR) loss that regulates the relationship between the prompt query and the prompt pool to improve representation power. The QR loss is only applied during training time, so there is no computational overhead at inference from the QR loss. With the QR loss, our approach maintains ∼ 50% computational cost reduction during inference as well as outperforms the prior two-stage PCL methods by ∼ 1.4% on public class-incremental continual learning benchmarks including CIFAR-100, ImageNet-R, and DomainNet.

title: Youngeun Kim, Jun Fang*, Qin Zhang, Zhaowei Cai, Yantao Shen, Rahul Duggal, Dripta S. Raychaudhuri, Zhuowen Tu, Yifan Xing, Onkar Dabeer
title_en: Youngeun Kim, Jun Fang*, Qin Zhang, Zhaowei Cai, Yantao Shen, Rahul Duggal, Dripta S. Raychaudhuri, Zhuowen Tu, Yifan Xing, Onkar Dabeer
abstract: 开放世界本质上是动态的,其概念和分布不断演变。在这一动态开放世界环境中,持续学习(CL)面临着有效泛化到未见测试类别的重大挑战。为应对这一挑战,我们提出了一种新的实用CL设置,专门针对开放世界视觉表征学习。在此设置中,后续数据流系统性地引入与之前训练阶段所见类别不相交的新类别,同时这些新类别也与未见测试类别保持区分。为此,我们提出了动态提示与表征学习器(DPaRL),这是一种简单而有效的基于提示的持续学习(PCL)方法。我们的DPaRL学习生成用于推理的动态提示,而非依赖于先前PCL方法中静态的提示池。此外,DPaRL在每个训练阶段联合学习动态提示生成与判别性表征,而此前的PCL方法仅在整个过程中优化提示学习。实验结果表明,我们的方法在主流开放世界图像检索基准测试中超越了现有最先进方法,Recall@1性能平均提升了4.7%。
abstract_en: The open world is inherently dynamic, characterized by ever-evolving concepts and distributions. Continual learning (CL) in this dynamic open-world environment presents a significant challenge in effectively generalizing to unseen test-time classes. To address this challenge, we introduce a new practical CL setting tailored for open-world visual representation learning. In this setting, subsequent data streams systematically introduce novel classes that are disjoint from those seen in previous training phases, while also remaining distinct from the unseen test classes. In response, we present Dynamic Prompt and Representation Learner (DPaRL), a simple yet effective Prompt-based CL (PCL) method. Our DPaRL learns to generate dynamic prompts for inference, as opposed to relying on a static prompt pool in previous PCL methods. In addition, DPaRL jointly learns dynamic prompt generation and discriminative representation at each training stage whereas prior PCL methods only refine the prompt learning throughout the process. Our experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our approach, surpassing state-of-the-art methods on well-established open-world image retrieval benchmarks by an average of 4.7% improvement in Recall@1 performance.

title: Youngho Yoon, Hyun-Kurl Jang, Kuk-Jin Yoon*
title_en: Youngho Yoon, Hyun-Kurl Jang, Kuk-Jin Yoon*
abstract: 新型视图合成(NVS)旨在利用多视角图像生成任意视角的图像,近年来神经辐射场(NeRF)的最新研究显著提升了该领域的性能。近期关于可泛化NeRF(G-NeRF)的研究解决了NeRF中场景特定优化的挑战。G-NeRF在运行时构建辐射场简化了NVS流程,使其更适用于实际应用场景。然而,由于缺乏场景特定优化,即使使用纹理丰富的多视角源输入,G-NeRF在表示特定场景的细节方面仍存在困难。为此,我们提出了一种基于几何的多参考纹理迁移网络(GMT),作为可直接集成到G-NeRF中的即插即用模块。具体而言,我们提出了一种基于光线的可变形卷积(RayDCN),通过反映场景几何的输入与参考特征进行对齐。此外,所提出的纹理保持变换器(TPFormer)在聚合多视角源特征的同时保留纹理信息。因此,我们的模块在图像增强过程中实现了相邻像素之间的直接交互,这在G-NeRF模型中由于每个像素独立的渲染过程而有所缺失。这解决了限制高频率细节捕捉能力的约束。实验表明,我们的即插即用模块在多个基准数据集上持续提升了G-NeRF模型的性能。
abstract_en: Novel view synthesis (NVS) aims to generate images at arbitrary viewpoints using multi-view images, and recent insights from neural radiance fields (NeRF) have contributed to remarkable improvements. Recently, studies on generalizable NeRF (G-NeRF) have addressed the challenge of per-scene optimization in NeRFs. The construction of radiance fields on-the-fly in G-NeRF simplifies the NVS process, making it well-suited for real-world applications. Meanwhile, G-NeRF still struggles in representing fine details for a specific scene due to the absence of per-scene optimization, even with texture-rich multi-view source inputs. As a remedy, we propose a Geometry-driven Multi-reference Texture transfer network (GMT) available as a plug-and-play module designed for G-NeRF. Specifically, we propose ray-imposed deformable convolution (RayDCN), which aligns input and reference features reflecting scene geometry. Additionally, the proposed texture preserving transformer (TPFormer) aggregates multi-view source features while preserving texture information. Consequently, our module enables direct interaction between adjacent pixels during the image enhancement process, which is deficient in G-NeRF models with an independent rendering process per pixel. This addresses constraints that hinder the ability to capture high-frequency details. Experiments show that our plug-and-play module consistently improves G-NeRF models on various benchmark datasets.

title: Youngjin Oh*, Keuntek Lee, Jooyoung Lee, Dae-Hyun Lee, Nam Ik Cho
title_en: Youngjin Oh*, Keuntek Lee, Jooyoung Lee, Dae-Hyun Lee, Nam Ik Cho
abstract: 屏下摄像头(UDC)图像修复旨在修复因覆盖前置摄像头的OLED显示屏导致失真的图像。先前基于深度学习的UDC修复方法主要集中在通过收集真实或合成的RGB数据集,在RGB域内恢复图像。然而,这些数据集中的UDC图像与实际商用智能手机的UDC图像存在领域差异,同时将问题及解决方案限制在RGB域内。为解决这一问题,我们使用配备UDC的两款商用智能手机面板,采集了对齐良好的传感器级真实UDC图像。我们还提出了一种新的UDC修复方法,利用不同面板引起的退化差异,考虑到UDC退化与OLED面板类型密切相关。为此,我们采用三元组损失的无监督学习方案训练编码器,旨在从退化UDC图像中提取不同面板引起的固有退化作为隐式表示。学习到的面板特定退化表示随后作为先验信息提供给基于高效Transformer网络的修复网络。大量实验表明,我们的方法在真实原始图像数据集上达到最先进的性能,并能良好泛化到先前数据集。我们的数据集和代码可在https://github.com/OBAKSA/DREUDC获取。
abstract_en: Under-display camera (UDC) image restoration aims to restore images distorted by the OLED display panel covering the frontal camera on a smartphone. Previous deep learning-based UDC restoration methods focused on restoring the image within the RGB domain with the collection of real or synthetic RGB datasets. However, UDC images in these datasets exhibit domain differences from real commercial smartphone UDC images while inherently constraining the problem and solution within the RGB domain. To address this issue, we collect well-aligned sensor-level real UDC images using panels from two commercial smartphones equipped with UDC. We also propose a new UDC restoration method to exploit the disparities between degradations caused by different panels, considering that UDC degradations are specific to the type of OLED panel. For this purpose, we train an encoder with an unsupervised learning scheme using triplet loss that aims to extract the inherent degradations caused by different panels from degraded UDC images as implicit representations. The learned panel-specific degradation representations are then provided as priors to our restoration network based on an efficient Transformer network. Extensive experiments show that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance on our real raw image dataset and generalizes well to previous datasets. Our dataset and code is available at https://github.com/OBAKSA/ DREUDC.

title: Youngkil Song, Dongkeun Kim, Minsu Cho, Suha Kwak*
title_en: Youngkil Song, Dongkeun Kim, Minsu Cho, Suha Kwak*
abstract: 在线时序动作定位(On-TAL)任务是在流式视频中识别多个动作实例。由于现有方法每次迭代仅输入固定大小的视频片段,因此在考虑长期上下文方面存在局限性,并需要仔细调整片段大小。为克服这些限制,我们提出了一种记忆增强型变压器(MATR)。MATR利用选择性保留过去片段特征的记忆队列,从而能够利用长期上下文进行推理。我们还提出了一种新的动作定位方法,该方法通过观察当前输入片段预测正在进行动作的结束时间,并通过访问记忆队列估计动作的开始时间。我们的方法在两个数据集THUMOS14和MUSES上超越了现有方法,不仅超越了在线设置下的TAL方法,还超越了一些离线TAL方法。
abstract_en: Online temporal action localization (On-TAL) is the task of identifying multiple action instances given a streaming video. Since existing methods take as input only a video segment of fixed size per iteration, they are limited in considering long-term context and require tuning the segment size carefully. To overcome these limitations, we propose memory-augmented transformer (MATR). MATR utilizes the memory queue that selectively preserves the past segment features, allowing to leverage long-term context for inference. We also propose a novel action localization method that observes the current input segment to predict the end time of the ongoing action and accesses the memory queue to estimate the start time of the action. Our method outperformed existing methods on two datasets, THUMOS14 and MUSES, surpassing not only TAL methods in the online setting but also some offline TAL methods.

title: Youngmin Oh, Hyung-Il Kim, Seong Tae Kim*, Jung Uk Kim*
title_en: Youngmin Oh, Hyung-Il Kim, Seong Tae Kim*, Jung Uk Kim*
abstract: 单目三维目标检测是自动驾驶领域的重要挑战性任务。现有方法主要集中在理想天气条件下进行三维检测,这些场景以清晰且最佳的可视性为特征。然而,自动驾驶的挑战要求系统能够处理天气条件的变化,如雾天,而不仅仅是晴朗天气。我们提出MonoWAD,一种新型的天气鲁棒单目三维目标检测器,结合了天气自适应扩散模型。该方法包含两个组件:(1) 天气代码本,用于记忆晴朗天气的知识并为任意输入生成天气参考特征;(2) 天气自适应扩散模型,通过引入天气参考特征增强输入特征的表示。这在注意力机制中起到指示作用,表明根据天气条件输入特征需要改进的程度。为实现此目标,我们引入了天气自适应增强损失,以增强晴朗和雾天条件下的特征表示。在多种天气条件下的广泛实验表明,MonoWAD实现了天气鲁棒的单目三维目标检测。代码和数据集已发布于https://github.com/VisualAIKHU/MonoWAD。
abstract_en: Monocular 3D object detection is an important challenging task in autonomous driving. Existing methods mainly focus on performing 3D detection in ideal weather conditions, characterized by scenarios with clear and optimal visibility. However, the challenge of autonomous driving requires the ability to handle changes in weather conditions, such as foggy weather, not just clear weather. We introduce MonoWAD, a novel weather-robust monocular 3D object detector with a weather-adaptive diffusion model. It contains two components: (1) the weather codebook to memorize the knowledge of the clear weather and generate a weather-reference feature for any input, and (2) the weather-adaptive diffusion model to enhance the feature representation of the input feature by incorporating a weather-reference feature. This serves an attention role in indicating how much improvement is needed for the input feature according to the weather conditions. To achieve this goal, we introduce a weather-adaptive enhancement loss to enhance the feature representation under both clear and foggy weather conditions. Extensive experiments under various weather conditions demonstrate that MonoWAD achieves weather-robust monocular 3D object detection. The code and dataset are released at https://github.com/VisualAIKHU/MonoWAD.

title: Youngrae Kim*, Younggeol Cho, Thanh-Tung Nguyen, Seunghoon Hong, Dongman Lee*
title_en: Youngrae Kim*, Younggeol Cho, Thanh-Tung Nguyen, Seunghoon Hong, Dongman Lee*
abstract: 现实中的天气条件复杂且常同时发生。然而,大多数现有修复方法在训练数据中仅适用于特定天气条件,难以泛化到未见过的天气类型,包括现实天气条件。为解决这一问题,我们提出MetaWeather,一种通用方法,可通过单一统一模型处理多样且新颖的天气条件。基于强大的元学习框架,MetaWeather将天气退化图像修复任务建模为少样本适应问题,预测查询图像的退化模式,并通过新颖的空间-通道匹配算法学习适应未见过的天气条件。在BID Task II.A、SPA-Data和RealSnow数据集上的实验结果表明,所提方法能够适应未见过的天气条件,显著优于当前最先进的多天气图像修复方法。代码可在https://github.com/RangeWING/MetaWeather获取。
abstract_en: Real-world weather conditions are intricate and often occur concurrently. However, most existing restoration approaches are limited in their applicability to specific weather conditions in training data and struggle to generalize to unseen weather types, including real-world weather conditions. To address this issue, we introduce MetaWeather, a universal approach that can handle diverse and novel weather conditions with a single unified model. Extending a powerful meta-learning framework, MetaWeather formulates the task of weather-degraded image restoration as a few-shot adaptation problem that predicts the degradation pattern of a query image, and learns to adapt to unseen weather conditions through a novel spatial-channel matching algorithm. Experimental results on the BID Task II.A, SPA-Data, and RealSnow datasets demonstrate that the proposed method can adapt to unseen weather conditions, significantly outperforming the state-of-the-art multi-weather image restoration methods. Code is available at https://github.com/RangeWING/MetaWeather.

title: Youssef Mansour*, Xuyang Zhong, Serdar Caglar, Reinhard Heckel
title_en: Youssef Mansour*, Xuyang Zhong, Serdar Caglar, Reinhard Heckel
abstract: 端到端训练的神经网络在图像去噪任务中表现出最先进的性能。然而,当应用于训练分布之外的图像时,其性能通常会显著下降。在本文中,我们提出了一种基于掩码图像建模(MIM)的测试时训练(TTT)方法,以提升分布外图像的去噪性能。该方法称为TTT-MIM,包含训练阶段和测试时适应阶段。在训练阶段,我们最小化标准监督损失和旨在重建掩码图像块的自监督损失。在测试时,我们通过最小化自监督损失对网络进行微调,以适应单张噪声图像。实验表明,我们的方法在自然分布偏移下能提升性能,特别是在适应真实世界相机和显微镜噪声方面表现良好。与我们的方法相比,一种替代的训练和微调方法是使用无需训练数据的零样本去噪器。然而,与最先进的零样本去噪器相比,我们的方法表现出更优的性能,并且速度更快,这表明在数据极少或无数据的设置中,对测试实例进行训练和微调比零样本方法更高效。我们的GitHub页面是:https://github.com/MLI-lab/TTT Denoising.
abstract_en: Neural networks trained end-to-end give state-of-the-art performance for image denoising. However, when applied to an image outside of the training distribution, the performance often degrades significantly. In this work, we propose a test-time training (TTT) method based on masked image modeling (MIM) to improve denoising performance for out-of-distribution images. The method, termed TTT-MIM, consists of a training stage and a test time adaptation stage. At training, we minimize a standard supervised loss and a self-supervised loss aimed at reconstructing masked image patches. At test-time, we minimize a self-supervised loss to fine-tune the network to adapt to a single noisy image. Experiments show that our method can improve performance under natural distribution shifts, in particular it adapts well to real-world camera and microscope noise. A competitor to our method of training and finetuning is to use a zero-shot denoiser that does not rely on training data. However, compared to state-of-the-art zero-shot denoisers, our method shows superior performance, and is much faster, suggesting that training and finetuning on the test instance is a more efficient approach to image denoising than zero-shot methods in setups where little to no data is available. Our GitHub page is: https://github.com/MLI-lab/TTT Denoising.

title: Youwei Pang, Xiaoqi Zhao, JiaMing Zuo, Lihe Zhang*, Huchuan Lu
title_en: Youwei Pang, Xiaoqi Zhao, JiaMing Zuo, Lihe Zhang*, Huchuan Lu
abstract: 近年来,大规模视觉-语言模型(VLM)如CLIP的出现,为开放世界物体感知开辟了新途径。许多研究探索了利用预训练VLM解决具有挑战性的开放词汇密集预测任务,该任务要求在推理时感知具有新颖类别的多样化物体。现有方法基于相关任务的公开数据集构建实验,这些数据集并未针对开放词汇进行定制,且由于数据收集偏差和标注成本,很少涉及复杂场景中难以察觉的伪装物体。为填补这一空白,我们引入了一个新任务——开放词汇伪装物体分割(OVCOS),并构建了一个包含11,483张人工挑选图像的大规模复杂场景数据集(OVCamo),这些图像具有精细标注和对应的物体类别。进一步地,我们构建了一个强大的单阶段开放词汇伪装物体分割Transformer基线模型OVCoser,该模型基于参数固定的CLIP,结合迭代语义引导和结构增强。通过整合类别语义知识的引导和来自边缘与深度信息的视觉结构线索补充,所提方法能够高效捕捉伪装物体。此外,该有效框架在我们的OVCamo数据集上显著超越了先前开放词汇语义图像分割的最先进方法。通过提出的数据集和基线模型,我们希望这一更具实用价值的新任务能够进一步拓展开放词汇密集预测任务的研究。我们的代码和数据可通过链接获取。
abstract_en: Recently, the emergence of the large-scale vision-language model (VLM), such as CLIP, has opened the way towards open-world object perception. Many works have explored the utilization of pre-trained VLM for the challenging open-vocabulary dense prediction task that requires perceiving diverse objects with novel classes at inference time. Existing methods construct experiments based on the public datasets of related tasks, which are not tailored for open vocabulary and rarely involve imperceptible objects camouflaged in complex scenes due to data collection bias and annotation costs. To fill in the gaps, we introduce a new task, open-vocabulary camouflaged object segmentation (OVCOS), and construct a large-scale complex scene dataset (OVCamo) containing 11,483 hand-selected images with fine annotations and corresponding object classes. Further, we build a strong single-stage open-vocabulary camouflaged object segmentation transformer baseline OVCoser attached to the parameter-fixed CLIP with iterative semantic guidance and structure enhancement. By integrating the guidance of class semantic knowledge and the supplement of visual structure cues from the edge and depth information, the proposed method can efficiently capture camouflaged objects. Moreover, this effective framework also surpasses previous state-of-the-arts of open-vocabulary semantic image segmentation by a large margin on our OVCamo dataset. With the proposed dataset and baseline, we hope that this new task with more practical value can further expand the research on open-vocabulary dense prediction tasks. Our code and data can be found in the link.

title: Yu Bai, Bo Zhang*, Zheng Zhang, Shuo Yan, Zibo Ma, Wu Liu, Xiuzhuang Zhou, Xiangyang Gong, Wendong Wang
title_en: Yu Bai, Bo Zhang*, Zheng Zhang, Shuo Yan, Zibo Ma, Wu Liu, Xiuzhuang Zhou, Xiangyang Gong, Wendong Wang
abstract: 近年来,由于多实例学习(MIL)的成功,全切片图像(WSI)分类任务取得了显著进展。然而,基于MIL的研究通常将每个袋内的实例视为无序的,可能导致局部和全局上下文信息的缺失。为克服这一局限性,我们提出了一种噪声鲁棒的记忆增强(Norma)框架,通过序列化方法解决WSI分类任务。Norma将WSI序列化为长序列,并采用视觉Transformer(ViT)编码WSI的局部和全局上下文信息。与一次性处理长序列不同,Norma将长序列分割为多个片段,并按顺序训练这些片段,每个片段会被缓存以备后续复用。此外,考虑到片段级标签继承自滑片级标签,可能在训练过程中引入噪声,Norma进一步引入循环方法以减少标签噪声。与近期研究相比,我们在CAMELYON-16、TCGA-BRAC和TCGA-LUNG数据集上实现了最先进的性能。代码已开源至https://github.com/weiaicunzai/Norma。
abstract_en: In recent years, the Whole Slide Image (WSI) classification task has achieved great advancement due to the success of Multiple Instance Learning (MIL). However, the MIL-based studies usually consider instances within each bag as unordered, potentially resulting in the missing of local and global contextual information. To overcome this limitation, we propose a Noise Robust Memory-Augmented (Norma) framework for addressing the WSI classification task using a sequential approach. Norma serializes a WSI into a long sequence and adopts the Vision Transformer (ViT) to encode the local and global context information of the WSIs. Instead of processing long sequences at once, Norma splits the long sequence into multiple segments and sequentially trains these segments, with each segment being cached for future reuse. In addition, considering that segment-level labels are inherited from slide-level labels, which may introduce noise during training, Norma further introduces a cyclic method to reduce label noise. We achieve state-of-the-art performance on the CAMELYON-16, TCGA-BRAC and TCGA-LUNG datasets compared to recent studies. The code is available at https://github.com/weiaicunzai/Norma.

title: Yu Cao*, Shaogang Gong
title_en: Yu Cao*, Shaogang Gong
abstract: 在使用深度生成模型(DGMs)进行少样本图像生成(FSIG)的领域中,准确估计目标域的分布仅需少量样本是一个重大挑战。这需要一种能够同时捕捉目标域分布的广泛多样性和真实特征的方法。我们提出条件放松扩散逆过程(CRDI),一种创新的“无需训练”方法,旨在增强合成图像生成中的分布多样性。与传统方法不同,CRDI不依赖于仅基于少量样本的微调。相反,它专注于通过少样本学习重建每个目标图像实例并扩展多样性。该方法首先为扩散模型识别样本级引导嵌入(SGE),其作用类似于某些生成对抗网络(GAN)模型中的显式潜在码。随后,该方法涉及一个调度器,逐步向SGE引入扰动,从而增强多样性。全面的实验表明,我们的方法优于基于GAN的重建技术,并在性能上与最先进的(SOTA)少样本图像生成(FSIG)方法相当。此外,它有效缓解了过拟合和灾难性遗忘,这些是微调方法的常见缺点。代码可在GitHub上获取。
abstract_en: In the field of Few-Shot Image Generation (FSIG) using Deep Generative Models (DGMs), accurately estimating the distribution of target domain with minimal samples poses a significant challenge. This requires a method that can both capture the broad diversity and the true characteristics of the target domain distribution. We present Conditional Relaxing Diffusion Inversion (CRDI), an innovative ‘training-free’ approach designed to enhance distribution diversity in synthetic image generation. Distinct from conventional methods, CRDI does not rely on fine-tuning based on only a few samples. Instead, it focuses on reconstructing each target image instance and expanding diversity through a few-shot learning. The approach initiates by identifying a Sample-wise Guidance Embedding (SGE) for the diffusion model, which serves a purpose analogous to the explicit latent codes in certain Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) models. Subsequently, the method involves a scheduler that progressively introduces perturbations to the SGE, thereby augmenting diversity. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms GAN-based reconstruction techniques and achieves comparable performance to state-of-the-art (SOTA) FSIG methods. Additionally, it effectively mitigates overfitting and catastrophic forgetting, common drawbacks of fine-tuning approaches. Code is available at GitHub.

title: Yu Chi*, Fangneng Zhan, Sibo Wu, Christian Theobalt, Adam Kortylewski
title_en: Yu Chi*, Fangneng Zhan, Sibo Wu, Christian Theobalt, Adam Kortylewski
abstract: 三维计算机视觉任务的进步需要大量数据,但对多视角图像进行三维一致性标注,或对点云进行部件分割既耗时又具有挑战性。本文提出DatasetNeRF,一种新颖方法,能够在使用极少的二维人工标注数据的情况下,生成无限且高质量的三维一致性二维标注及三维点云分割。具体而言,我们利用三维生成模型中的语义先验训练语义解码器,仅需少量细粒度标注样本即可。训练完成后,解码器可在潜在空间中泛化,从而生成无限数据。生成的数据适用于各种计算机视觉任务,包括合成和现实场景中的视频分割和三维点云分割。我们的方法不仅在分割质量上超越了基线模型,实现了单张图像上更优的三维一致性和分割精度,还通过适用于刚性与非刚性生成模型展示了其通用性。此外,我们探索了由此方法衍生的应用,如三维感知语义编辑和三维逆向。代码可在 /GenIntel/DatasetNeRF 获取。
abstract_en: Progress in 3D computer vision tasks demands a huge amount of data, yet annotating multi-view images with 3D-consistent annotations, or point clouds with part segmentation is both time-consuming and challenging. This paper introduces DatasetNeRF, a novel approach capable of generating infinite, high-quality 3D-consistent 2D annotations alongside 3D point cloud segmentations, while utilizing minimal 2D human-labeled annotations. Specifically, we leverage the semantic prior within a 3D generative model to train a semantic decoder, requiring only a handful of fine-grained labeled samples. Once trained, the decoder generalizes across the latent space, enabling the generation of infinite data. The generated data is applicable across various computer vision tasks, including video segmentation and 3D point cloud segmentation in both synthetic and real-world scenarios. Our approach not only surpasses baseline models in segmentation quality, achieving superior 3D-Consistency and segmentation precision on individual images, but also demonstrates versatility by being applicable to both articulated and non-articulated generative models. Furthermore, we explore applications stemming from our approach, such as 3D-aware semantic editing and 3D inversion. Code can be found at /GenIntel/DatasetNeRF.

title: Yu Deng*, Duomin Wang, Baoyuan Wang
title_en: Yu Deng*, Duomin Wang, Baoyuan Wang
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的前馈单次四维头部虚拟形象合成学习方法。不同于现有方法通常通过基于3DMM引导的单目视频重建来学习,我们采用伪多视角视频以数据驱动的方式学习四维头部合成器,避免依赖可能损害合成性能的不准确3DMM重建。关键思想是首先利用合成多视角图像学习3D头部合成器,将单目真实视频转换为多视角视频,然后通过跨视角自重演利用伪多视角视频学习四维头部合成器。通过采用简单视觉Transformer主干网络与运动感知的交叉注意力机制,我们的方法在重建保真度、几何一致性和运动控制精度方面相比现有方法表现出更优的性能。我们希望该方法能为整合三维先验与二维监督以提升四维头部虚拟形象创建提供新思路。
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a novel learning approach for feed-forward one-shot 4D head avatar synthesis. Different from existing methods that often learn from reconstructing monocular videos guided by 3DMM, we employ pseudo multi-view videos to learn a 4D head synthesizer in a data-driven manner, avoiding reliance on inaccurate 3DMM reconstruction that could be detrimental to the synthesis performance. The key idea is to first learn a 3D head synthesizer using synthetic multi-view images to convert monocular real videos into multi-view ones, and then utilize the pseudo multi-view videos to learn a 4D head synthesizer via cross-view self-reenactment. By leveraging a simple vision transformer backbone with motion-aware cross-attentions, our method exhibits superior performance compared to previous methods in terms of reconstruction fidelity, geometry consistency, and motion control accuracy. We hope our method offers novel insights into integrating 3D priors with 2D supervisions for improved 4D head avatar creation.

title: Yu Guo*, Yuan Gao, Yuxu Lu, Huilin Zhu, Wen Liu, Shengfeng He
title_en: Yu Guo*, Yuan Gao, Yuxu Lu, Huilin Zhu, Wen Liu, Shengfeng He
abstract: 在现实场景中,图像退化常表现为复合退化现象,涉及低光照、雾霾、雨雪等多种因素的复杂交互。尽管如此,现有修复方法通常针对单一退化类型进行优化,难以应对多退化因素共存的复杂环境。为解决这一问题,本研究提出了一种通用成像模型,整合四种物理退化范式以精确表征复合退化场景。在此基础上,我们提出OneRestore,一种基于Transformer的新型框架,用于自适应、可控的场景修复。该框架通过独特的交叉注意力机制,将退化场景描述符与图像特征进行融合,实现精细化修复。我们的模型支持多样化的输入场景描述符,包括手动文本嵌入到基于视觉属性的自动提取。通过复合退化修复损失函数进一步优化方法,利用额外退化图像作为负样本强化模型约束。在合成数据集和真实场景数据集上的对比实验表明,OneRestore在处理复杂复合退化问题上显著优于现有方法,显著推动了当前技术水平的发展。
abstract_en: In real-world scenarios, image impairments often manifest as composite degradations, presenting a complex interplay of elements such as low light, haze, rain, and snow. Despite this reality, existing restoration methods typically target isolated degradation types, thereby falling short in environments where multiple degrading factors coexist. To bridge this gap, our study proposes a versatile imaging model that consolidates four physical corruption paradigms to accurately represent complex, composite degradation scenarios. In this context, we propose OneRestore, a novel transformer-based framework designed for adaptive, controllable scene restoration. The proposed framework leverages a unique cross-attention mechanism, merging degraded scene descriptors with image features, allowing for nuanced restoration. Our model allows versatile input scene descriptors, ranging from manual text embeddings to automatic extractions based on visual attributes. Our methodology is further enhanced through a composite degradation restoration loss, using extra degraded images as negative samples to fortify model constraints. Comparative results on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate OneRestore as a superior solution, significantly advancing the state-of-the-art in addressing complex, composite degradations.

title: Yu Liu, Baoxiong Jia*, Yixin Chen, Siyuan Huang
title_en: Yu Liu, Baoxiong Jia*, Yixin Chen, Siyuan Huang
abstract: 从复杂视觉场景中提炼以物体为中心的抽象能力是实现人类水平泛化能力的基础。尽管在以物体为中心的学习方法上取得了显著进展,但在三维物理世界中学习以物体为中心的表示仍是一个关键挑战。在本文中,我们提出__TITLE_MATH_1__,一种通过槽引导的特征提升联合实现场景重建与分解的新型以物体为中心的辐射模型。这种设计将以物体为中心的学习表示与基于图像的渲染方法相结合,在四个具有挑战性的合成数据集和四个复杂的现实世界数据集上,实现了场景分解和新视角合成的优异性能,显著超越了现有的3D以物体为中心的学习方法。通过广泛的消融实验,我们验证了__ABS_MATH_1__设计的有效性,揭示了潜在未来研究方向的关键见解。
abstract_en: The ability to distill object-centric abstractions from intricate visual scenes underpins human-level generalization. Despite the significant progress in object-centric learning methods, learning object-centric representations in the 3D physical world remains a crucial challenge. In this work, we propose , a novel object-centric radiance model addressing scene reconstruction and decomposition jointly via slot-guided feature lifting. Such a design unites object-centric learning representations and image-based rendering methods, offering performance in scene decomposition and novel-view synthesis on four challenging synthetic and four complex real-world datasets, outperforming existing 3D object-centric learning methods by a large margin. Through extensive ablative studies, we showcase the efficacy of designs in , revealing key insights for potential future directions.

title: Yu Liu, Fatimah binti Khalid, Lei Wang, Youxi Zhang, Cunrui Wang*
title_en: Yu Liu, Fatimah binti Khalid, Lei Wang, Youxi Zhang, Cunrui Wang*
abstract: 电子书写工具虽然提升了便捷性,但牺牲了手写内容的可读性和效率。在高效性与可读性之间取得平衡是一项具有挑战性的研究任务。本文提出了一种基于序列模型的方法,用于美化用户的手写轨迹。与大多数将中文手写视为图像且无法反映人类书写过程的现有方法不同,我们从少量用户手写轨迹中捕捉个体书写特征,并通过模仿其书写风格和过程来美化用户的轨迹。我们充分考虑内容字与参考字形之间的部首和部件风格,通过交叉注意力机制模块为内容字形中的笔画分配适当的细粒度风格。此外,我们发现许多风格特征对最终风格化结果的贡献微乎其微。因此,我们将风格特征分解为单维变量集的笛卡尔积,有效去除对风格化效果影响有限的冗余特征,同时保留关键风格信息。定性与定量实验均验证了我们方法的优越性。
abstract_en: The electronic writing tools, while enhancing convenience, sacrifice the readability and efficiency of handwritten content. Balancing high efficiency with readable handwriting poses a challenging research task. In this paper, we propose a method sequence-based models to beautify user handwritten traces. Unlike most existing methods that treat Chinese handwriting as images and cannot reflect the human writing process, we capture individual writing characteristics from a small amount of user handwriting trajectories and beautify the user’s traces by mimicking their writing style and process. We fully consider the style of radicals and components between the content and reference glyphs, assigning appropriate fine-grained styles to strokes in the content glyphs through a cross-attention mechanism module. Additionally, we find that many style features contribute minimally to the final stylized results. Therefore, we decompose the style features into the Cartesian product of single-dimensional variable sets, effectively removing redundant features with limited impact on the stylization effect while preserving key style information. Qualitative and quantitative experiments both demonstrate the superiority of our approach.

title: Yu Tian*, Congcong Wen, Min Shi, Muhammad Muneeb Afzal, Hao Huang, Muhammad Osama Khan, Yan Luo, Yi Fang, Mengyu Wang
title_en: Yu Tian*, Congcong Wen, Min Shi, Muhammad Muneeb Afzal, Hao Huang, Muhammad Osama Khan, Yan Luo, Yi Fang, Mengyu Wang
abstract: 在人工智能(AI)中,尤其是在医疗AI领域,解决公平性问题对于确保公平的医疗结果至关重要。近期提升公平性的努力在医疗AI中引入了新的方法和数据集。然而,在领域迁移设置下的公平性问题几乎未被探索,而临床实践中常依赖不同的成像技术(例如不同的视网膜成像模态)进行患者诊断。本文提出了FairDomain,这是对领域迁移下算法公平性进行系统研究的开创性工作,采用最先进的领域自适应(DA)和泛化(DG)算法,用于医学分割和分类任务,以理解不同领域间偏见的转移机制。我们还引入了一种新颖的即插即用公平身份注意力(FIA)模块,该模块可适配各种DA和DG算法,通过自注意力机制根据人口统计属性调整特征重要性,从而提升公平性。此外,我们整理了首个以公平性为中心的数据集,包含同一患者队列的两种配对成像模态,用于医学分割和分类任务,以严格评估领域迁移场景下的公平性。排除源域和目标域之间人口统计分布变化的混杂影响,将更清晰地量化领域迁移模型的性能。我们的广泛评估表明,所提出的FIA模块在所有领域迁移设置(即DA和DG)中显著提升了模型性能,针对不同人口统计群体的公平性表现优于现有方法。代码和数据可通过https://ophai.hms.harvard.edu/datasets/harvard-fairdomain20k访问。
abstract_en: Addressing fairness in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly in medical AI, is crucial for ensuring equitable healthcare outcomes. Recent efforts to enhance fairness have introduced new methodologies and datasets in medical AI. However, the fairness issue under the setting of domain transfer is almost unexplored, while it is common that clinics rely on different imaging technologies (e.g., different retinal imaging modalities) for patient diagnosis. This paper presents FairDomain, a pioneering systemic study into algorithmic fairness under domain shifts, employing state-of-the-art domain adaptation (DA) and generalization (DG) algorithms for both medical segmentation and classification tasks to understand how biases are transferred between different domains. We also introduce a novel plug-and-play fair identity attention (FIA) module that adapts to various DA and DG algorithms to improve fairness by using self-attention to adjust feature importance based on demographic attributes. Additionally, we curate the first fairness-focused dataset with two paired imaging modalities for the same patient cohort on medical segmentation and classification tasks, to rigorously assess fairness in domain-shift scenarios. Excluding the confounding impact of demographic distribution variation between source and target domains will allow clearer quantification of the performance of domain transfer models. Our extensive evaluations reveal that the proposed FIA significantly enhances both model performance accounted for fairness across all domain shift settings (i.e., DA and DG) with respect to different demographics, which outperforms existing methods on both segmentation and classification. The code and data can be accessed at https://ophai.hms.harvard.edu/datasets/harvard-fairdomain20k.

title: 王宇*,刘晓庚*,李宇*,陈慕浩,肖朝伟*
title_en: Yu Wang*, Xiaogeng Liu*, Yu Li*, Muhao Chen, Chaowei Xiao*
abstract: 随着多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)的出现和广泛应用,确保其安全性的需求变得愈发迫切。然而,随着额外模态的集成,MLLMs面临新的漏洞,使其容易受到基于结构的越狱攻击,其中语义内容(例如“有害文本”)被注入到图像中以误导MLLMs。在本工作中,我们旨在防御此类威胁。具体而言,我们提出了自适应防御提示(AdaShield),通过在输入前添加防御提示来保护MLLMs免受基于结构的越狱攻击,而无需对MLLMs进行微调或训练额外模块(例如后处理内容检测器)。首先,我们提出了一种手动设计的静态防御提示,该提示逐步检查图像和指令内容,并指定对恶意查询的响应方法。此外,我们引入了一种自适应自动优化框架,包括目标MLLM和基于大语言模型的防御提示生成器(Defender)。这些组件协同并迭代地通信以生成防御提示。在流行的基于结构的越狱攻击和良性数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法可以持续提高MLLMs对基于结构的越狱攻击的鲁棒性,而不会损害模型在标准良性任务上的通用能力。我们的代码可在https://rain305f.github.io/AdaShield-P red获取。免责声明:本文包含可能对某些读者造成困扰的冒犯性内容。
abstract_en: With the advent and widespread deployment of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), the imperative to ensure their safety has become increasingly pronounced. However, with the integration of additional modalities, MLLMs are exposed to new vulnerabilities, rendering them prone to structured-based jailbreak attacks, where semantic content (e.g. “harmful text”) has been injected into the images to mislead MLLMs. In this work, we aim to defend against such threats. Specifically, we propose Adaptive Shield Prompting (AdaShield), which prepends inputs with defense prompts to defend MLLMs against structure-based jailbreak attacks without fine-tuning MLLMs or training additional modules (e.g., post-stage content detector). Initially, we present a manually designed static defense prompt, which thoroughly examines the image and instruction content step by step and specifies response methods to malicious queries. Furthermore, we introduce an adaptive auto-refinement framework, consisting of a target MLLM and a LLM-based defense prompt generator (Defender). These components collaboratively and iteratively communicate to generate a defense prompt. Extensive experiments on the popular structure-based jailbreak attacks and benign datasets show that our methods can consistently improve MLLMs’ robustness against structure-based jailbreak attacks without compromising the model’s general capabilities evaluated on standard benign tasks. Our code is available at https://rain305f.github.io/AdaShield-P red Disclaimer: This paper contains offensive content that may be disturbing to some readers.

title: 于永灿, 李俊生, 何然, 梁健*
title_en: Yu Yongcan, Lijun Sheng, Ran He, Jian Liang*
abstract: 测试时适应(TTA)旨在通过仅使用测试时的未标记数据来解决训练数据与测试数据之间的分布偏移问题。现有TTA方法通常专注于提高与训练集类别相关的测试数据的识别性能。然而,在开放世界推理过程中,不可避免地会出现来自未知类别的测试数据实例,通常称为异常值(outliers)。本文关注在存在异常值的情况下,同时进行样本识别和异常值拒绝的问题。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种名为STAble Memory rePlay(STAMP)的新方法,该方法在稳定记忆库上进行优化,而非在风险性小批量上进行优化。具体而言,记忆库通过以类别平衡的方式选择低熵值且标签一致的样本进行动态更新。此外,我们开发了一种自加权熵最小化策略,为低熵值样本赋予更高的权重。大量实验结果表明,STAMP在识别性能和异常值检测性能方面均优于现有TTA方法。代码已发布在https://github.com/yuyongcan/STAMP。
abstract_en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) aims to address the distribution shift between the training and test data with only unlabeled data at test time. Existing TTA methods often focus on improving recognition performance specifically for test data associated with classes in the training set. However, during the open-world inference process, there are inevitably test data instances from unknown classes, commonly referred to as outliers. This paper pays attention to the problem that conducts both sample recognition and outlier rejection during inference while outliers exist. To address this problem, we propose a new approach called STAble Memory rePlay (STAMP), which performs optimization over a stable memory bank instead of the risky mini-batch. In particular, the memory bank is dynamically updated by selecting low-entropy and label-consistent samples in a class-balanced manner. In addition, we develop a self-weighted entropy minimization strategy that assigns higher weight to low-entropy samples. Extensive results demonstrate that STAMP outperforms existing TTA methods in terms of both recognition and outlier detection performance. The code is released at https://github.com/yuyongcan/STAMP.

title: Yu-Chu Yu*, Chi-Pin Huang, Jr-Jen Chen, Kai-Po Chang, Yung-Hsuan Lai, Fu-En Yang, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang
title_en: Yu-Chu Yu*, Chi-Pin Huang, Jr-Jen Chen, Kai-Po Chang, Yung-Hsuan Lai, Fu-En Yang, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang
abstract: 大规模视觉-语言模型(VLMs)在未见领域数据上展现出强大的零样本泛化能力。然而,将预训练的VLMs适配到一系列下游任务时,往往会导致先前学习知识的遗忘和零样本分类性能的下降。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种独特的选择性双教师知识迁移框架,利用最近微调的和原始预训练的VLMs作为双教师,分别保留先前学习的知识和零样本能力。仅通过访问无标签参考数据集,我们的框架通过测量双教师VLMs的特征差异,执行选择性知识蒸馏机制。因此,我们的选择性双教师知识蒸馏方法在缓解先前学习知识的灾难性遗忘的同时,保留了预训练VLMs的零样本能力。在基准数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的框架在防止灾难性遗忘和零样本退化方面优于最先进的持续学习方法。项目页面:https://chuyu.org/research/snd.
abstract_en: Large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) have shown a strong zero-shot generalization capability on unseen-domain data. However, adapting pre-trained VLMs to a sequence of downstream tasks often leads to the forgetting of previously learned knowledge and a reduction in zero-shot classification performance. To tackle this problem, we propose a unique Selective Dual-Teacher Knowledge Transfer framework that leverages the most recent fine-tuned and the original pre-trained VLMs as dual teachers to preserve the previously learned knowledge and zero-shot capabilities, respectively. With only access to an unlabeled reference dataset, our proposed framework performs a selective knowledge distillation mechanism by measuring the feature discrepancy from the dual-teacher VLMs. Consequently, our selective dual-teacher knowledge distillation mitigates catastrophic forgetting of previously learned knowledge while preserving the zero-shot capabilities of pre-trained VLMs. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our framework is favorable against state-of-the-art continual learning approaches for preventing catastrophic forgetting and zero-shot degradation. Project page: https://chuyu.org/research/snd.

title: Yu-Ming Tang, Yi-Xing Peng, Jingke Meng*, Wei-Shi Zheng
title_en: Yu-Ming Tang, Yi-Xing Peng, Jingke Meng*, Wei-Shi Zheng
abstract: 少样本类增量学习(FSCIL)旨在以少样本方式学习序列类。继承自经典的类增量学习设置,FSCIL的流行基准使用平均准确率(aAcc)和最后一任务平均准确率(lAcc)作为评估指标。然而,我们发现这些评估指标可能未能充分强调新类性能,且在该基准下FSCIL方法的持续学习能力可能被忽视。在本工作中,作为现有指标的补充,我们提出了一种新的指标——广义平均准确率(gAcc),该指标通过引入参数α指导下的多视角性能评估,提供更公平的评估。我们还以曲线下面积(AUC)的形式提出整体指标。在gAcc的指导下,我们释放了视觉Transformer中间特征的潜力,以提升新类性能。通过获取较少类特异性且更具泛化能力的中间层信息,我们校正了最终特征,从而构建了一个更通用的基于Transformer的FSCIL框架。无需复杂的网络设计或繁琐的训练流程,我们的方法在三个数据集上均优于现有FSCIL方法,在aAcc和gAcc指标上均取得更好表现。代码见:https://github.com/iSEE-Laboratory/Revisting_FSCIL
abstract_en: Few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) aims to learn sequential classes with limited samples in a few-shot fashion. Inherited from the classical class-incremental learning setting, the popular benchmark of FSCIL uses averaged accuracy (aAcc) and last-task averaged accuracy (lAcc) as the evaluation metrics. However, we reveal that such evaluation metrics may not provide adequate emphasis on the novel class performance, and the continual learning ability of FSCIL methods could be ignored under this benchmark. In this work, as a complement to existing metrics, we offer a new metric called generalized average accuracy (gAcc) which is designed to provide an extra equitable evaluation by incorporating different perspectives of the performance under the guidance of a parameter α. We also present an overall metric in the form of the area under the curve (AUC) along the α. Under the guidance of gAcc, we release the potential of intermediate features of the vision transformers to boost the novel-class performance. Taking information from intermediate layers which are less class-specific and more generalizable, we manage to rectify the final features, leading to a more generalizable transformer-based FSCIL framework. Without complex network designs or cumbersome training procedures, our method outperforms existing FSCIL methods at aAcc and gAcc on three datasets. See codes at 1 1 https://github.com/iSEE-Laboratory/Revisting_FSCIL

title: Yuan Chen, Zi-han Ding, Ziqin Wang, Yan Wang*, Lijun Zhang, Si Liu*
title_en: Yuan Chen, Zi-han Ding, Ziqin Wang, Yan Wang*, Lijun Zhang, Si Liu*
abstract: 尽管实时规划器在自动驾驶领域表现出卓越的性能,但大语言模型(LLMs)日益广泛的应用探索为提升运动规划的可解释性和可控性提供了新途径。然而,基于LLM的规划器仍面临显著挑战,包括资源消耗增加和推理时间延长,这严重阻碍了其实际部署。针对上述问题,我们提出AsyncDriver,一种新型异步LLM增强的闭环框架,通过利用LLM生成的场景关联指令特征引导实时规划器进行精确且可控的轨迹预测。一方面,我们的方法凸显了LLM在理解与推理向量化场景数据及一系列路径指令方面的优势,证明其对实时规划器的有效辅助作用。另一方面,所提出的框架将LLM与实时规划器的推理过程解耦。通过利用二者推理频率的异步特性,我们的方法成功降低了LLM引入的计算成本,同时保持了相当的性能表现。实验结果表明,我们的方法在nuPlan的复杂场景中实现了优越的闭环评估性能。代码和数据集可在https: //github.com/memberRE/AsyncDriver获取。
abstract_en: Despite real-time planners exhibiting remarkable performance in autonomous driving, the growing exploration of Large Language Models (LLMs) has opened avenues for enhancing the interpretability and controllability of motion planning. Nevertheless, LLM-based planners continue to encounter significant challenges, including elevated resource consumption and extended inference times, which pose substantial obstacles to practical deployment. In light of these challenges, we introduce AsyncDriver, a new asynchronous LLM-enhanced closed-loop framework designed to leverage scene-associated instruction features produced by LLM to guide real-time planners in making precise and controllable trajectory predictions. On one hand, our method highlights the prowess of LLMs in comprehending and reasoning with vectorized scene data and a series of routing instructions, demonstrating its effective assistance to real-time planners. On the other hand, the proposed framework decouples the inference processes of the LLM and real-time planners. By capitalizing on the asynchronous nature of their inference frequencies, our approach have successfully reduced the computational cost introduced by LLM, while maintaining comparable performance. Experiments show that our approach achieves superior closed-loop evaluation performance on nuPlan’s challenging scenarios. The code and dataset are available at https: //github.com/memberRE/AsyncDriver.

title: Yuan Gao, Zilei Wang*, Yixin Zhang, Bohai Tu
title_en: Yuan Gao, Zilei Wang*, Yixin Zhang, Bohai Tu
abstract: 无监督域适应(UDA)在语义分割领域已被广泛研究,旨在利用标签丰富的源数据辅助目标域中未标记样本的分割。尽管已有诸多努力,但由于缺乏目标域标注,UDA性能仍远低于全监督模型。为此,我们提出了一种高效的超像素级主动学习方法,用于域自适应语义分割,通过自动查询少量超像素进行标注以最大化分割性能。为节约标注资源,我们提出了一种新颖的低不确定性超像素融合模块,该模块基于特征亲和性融合具有低不确定性特征的超像素,从而确保高质量的超像素融合。在获取策略方面,我们的方法考虑了两种信息丰富的超像素类型:信息量大的大尺寸超像素,以及对域适应学习最具价值的超像素。此外,我们分别采用跨域混合和伪标签与一致性正则化技术来解决域偏移和标签噪声问题。大量实验表明,我们的超像素级方法在有限预算下比之前的像素级技术更高效,并以40倍更低的成本超越了现有最先进方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/EdenHazardan/ADA_superpixel获取。
abstract_en: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) for semantic segmentation has been widely studied to exploit the label-rich source data to assist the segmentation of unlabeled samples on target domain. Despite these efforts, UDA performance remains far below that of fully-supervised model owing to the lack of target annotations. To this end, we propose an efficient superpixel-level active learning method for domain adaptive semantic segmentation to maximize segmentation performance by automatically querying a small number of superpixels for labeling. To conserve annotation resources, we propose a novel low-uncertainty superpixel fusion module which amalgamates superpixels possessing low-uncertainty features based on feature affinity and thereby ensuring high-quality fusion of superpixels. As for the acquisition strategy, our method takes into account two types of information-rich superpixels: large-size superpixels with substantial information content, and superpixels with the greatest value for domain adaptation learning. Further, we employ the cross-domain mixing and pseudo label with consistency regularization techniques respectively to address the domain shift and label noise problems. Extensive experimentation demonstrates that our proposed superpixel-level method utilizes a limited budget more efficiently than previous pixel-level techniques and surpasses state-of-the-art methods at 40x lower cost. Our code is available at https://github.com/EdenHazardan/ADA_superpixel.

title: Yuan Liu*, Haodong Duan*, Yuanhan Zhang, Bo Li, Songyang Zhang, Wangbo Zhao, Yike Yuan, Jiaqi Wang, Conghui He, Ziwei Liu, Kai Chen, Dahua Lin
title_en: Yuan Liu*, Haodong Duan*, Yuanhan Zhang, Bo Li, Songyang Zhang, Wangbo Zhao, Yike Yuan, Jiaqi Wang, Conghui He, Ziwei Liu, Kai Chen, Dahua Lin
abstract: 大视觉-语言模型(VLMs)近期取得了显著进展,展现出令人印象深刻的多模态感知和推理能力。然而,有效评估这些大VLMs仍然是一个重大挑战,阻碍了该领域未来的发展。传统基准如VQAv2或COCO Caption提供了定量性能测量,但缺乏细粒度能力评估和稳健的评估指标。同时,主观基准如OwlEval通过引入人工劳动对模型能力进行全面评估,但其可扩展性较差且可能存在显著偏差。为应对这些挑战,我们提出MMBench,一个用于评估VLMs多模态能力的双语基准。MMBench系统性地构建了一个全面的评估流程,主要包含以下关键特征:1. MMBench通过精心设计的质量控制方案进行细致编纂,其评估问题和能力的种类与数量均超越现有类似基准;2. MMBench引入严谨的CircularEval策略,并结合大语言模型将自由形式预测转换为预定义选项,有助于为指令跟随能力有限的模型生成准确评估结果;3. MMBench包含中英文双语的多项选择题,使VLMs在双语语境下的性能实现直接对比。总之,MMBench是一个系统设计的客观基准,用于对视觉-语言模型进行稳健且全面的评估。我们希望MMBench能帮助研究社区更好地评估其模型,并推动该领域未来的发展。MMBench已通过VLMEvalKit1支持。1 https://github.com/open-compass/VLMEvalKit
abstract_en: Large vision-language models (VLMs) have recently achieved remarkable progress, exhibiting impressive multimodal perception and reasoning abilities. However, effectively evaluating these large VLMs remains a major challenge, hindering future development in this domain. Traditional benchmarks like VQAv2 or COCO Caption provide quantitative performance measurements but lack fine-grained ability assessment and robust evaluation metrics. Meanwhile, subjective benchmarks, such as OwlEval, offer comprehensive evaluations of a model’s abilities by incorporating human labor, which is not scalable and may display significant bias. In response to these challenges, we propose MMBench, a bilingual benchmark for assessing the multi-modal capabilities of VLMs. MMBench methodically develops a comprehensive evaluation pipeline, primarily comprised of the following key features: 1. MMBench is meticulously curated with well-designed quality control schemes, surpassing existing similar benchmarks in terms of the number and variety of evaluation questions and abilities; 2. MMBench introduces a rigorous CircularEval strategy and incorporates large language models to convert free-form predictions into pre-defined choices, which helps to yield accurate evaluation results for models with limited instruction-following capabilities. 3. MMBench incorporates multiple-choice questions in both English and Chinese versions, enabling an apples-to-apples comparison of VLMs’ performance under a bilingual context. To summarize, MMBench is a systematically designed objective benchmark for a robust and holistic evaluation of vision-language models. We hope MMBench will assist the research community in better evaluating their models and facilitate future progress in this area. MMBench has been supported in VLMEvalKit1 . 1 https://github.com/open-compass/VLMEvalKit

title: Yuan Shen*, Duygu Ceylan*, Paul Guerrero, Zexiang Xu, Niloy J. Mitra, Shenlong Wang, Anna Fruehstueck*
title_en: Yuan Shen*, Duygu Ceylan*, Paul Guerrero, Zexiang Xu, Niloy J. Mitra, Shenlong Wang, Anna Fruehstueck*
abstract: 我们提出了一种简单、模块化且通用的方法,通过添加几何和外观细节来对粗略的3D模型进行上采样。尽管生成式3D模型现在已经存在,但它们尚未达到图像和视频领域中对应模型的质量水平。我们证明了可以将现有的(预训练)视频模型直接重新用于3D超分辨率任务,从而绕过了高质量3D训练模型大型数据集不足的问题。我们描述了如何重新利用非3D一致的视频上采样模型,并将其与3D整合技术结合,以生成3D一致的结果。我们的方法输出高质量的高斯点云模型,这些模型以物体为中心且效果显著。该方法与类别无关,可以轻松集成到现有的3D工作流中。我们在多种3D输入上评估了我们的方法,这些输入在复杂度和表示形式(例如高斯点云或NeRFs)上都具有多样性,并展示了我们的简单方法显著提升了当前生成式3D模型的保真度。详情请访问我们的项目网站:supergaussian.github.io。
abstract_en: We present a simple, modular, and generic method that upsamples coarse 3D models by adding geometric and appearance details. While generative 3D models now exist, they do not yet match the quality of their counterparts in image and video domains. We demonstrate that it is possible to directly repurpose existing (pre-trained) video models for 3D super-resolution and thus sidestep the problem of the shortage of large repositories of high-quality 3D training models. We describe how to repurpose video upsampling models – which are not 3D consistent – and combine them with 3D consolidation to produce 3D-consistent results. As output, we produce high-quality Gaussian Splat models, which are object-centric and effective. Our method is category-agnostic and can be easily incorporated into existing 3D workflows. We evaluate our proposed on a variety of 3D inputs, which are diverse both in terms of complexity and representation (e.g., Gaussian Splats or NeRFs), and demonstrate that our simple method significantly improves the fidelity of current generative 3D models. Check our project website for details: supergaussian.github.io.

title: Yuan Tian*, Guo Lu*, Guangtao Zhai*
title_en: Yuan Tian*, Guo Lu*, Guangtao Zhai*
abstract: 无监督视频语义压缩(UVSC),即压缩视频以更好地支持各种分析任务,近年来受到广泛关注。然而,由于单一语义学习目标、训练数据有限等原因,先前方法的语义丰富度仍受到限制。为了解决这一问题,我们提出通过吸收现成的丰富语义(来自VFMs)来提升UVSC任务。具体而言,我们引入了一个VFMs共享的语义对齐层,并辅以VFM特定的提示,以灵活地在压缩视频与各种VFMs之间对齐语义。这使得不同的VFMs能够协同构建一个相互增强的语义空间,指导压缩模型的学习。此外,我们引入了一种基于动态轨迹的帧间压缩方案,首先基于历史内容估计语义轨迹,然后沿轨迹遍历以预测未来语义作为编码上下文。这减少了系统的总体比特成本,进一步提高了压缩效率。我们的方法在三个主流任务和六个数据集上优于先前的编码方法。
abstract_en: Unsupervised video semantic compression (UVSC), i.e., compressing videos to better support various analysis tasks, has recently garnered attention. However, the semantic richness of previous methods remains limited, due to the single semantic learning objective, limited training data, etc. To address this, we propose to boost the UVSC task by absorbing the off-the-shelf rich semantics from VFMs. Specifically, we introduce a VFMs-shared semantic alignment layer, complemented by VFM-specific prompts, to flexibly align semantics between the compressed video and various VFMs. This allows different VFMs to collaboratively build a mutually-enhanced semantic space, guiding the learning of the compression model. Moreover, we introduce a dynamic trajectory-based inter-frame compression scheme, which first estimates the semantic trajectory based on the historical content, and then traverses along the trajectory to predict the future semantics as the coding context. This reduces the overall bitcost of the system, further improving the compression efficiency. Our approach outperforms previous coding methods on three mainstream tasks and six datasets.

title: Yuan-Hao Ho, Jen-Hao Cheng, Sheng Yao Kuan, Zhongyu Jiang, Wenhao Chai, Hsiang-Wei Huang, Chih-Lung Lin, Jenq-Neng Hwang*
title_en: Yuan-Hao Ho, Jen-Hao Cheng, Sheng Yao Kuan, Zhongyu Jiang, Wenhao Chai, Hsiang-Wei Huang, Chih-Lung Lin, Jenq-Neng Hwang*
abstract: 传统的人体定位与姿态估计(HPE)方法主要依赖RGB图像作为输入模态,在现实应用中由于隐私问题面临显著局限性。相比之下,基于雷达的HPE方法作为一种有前景的替代方案,具有穿透墙壁识别和隐私保护等独特属性,使该方法更适用于实际部署。本文提出了一种基于雷达张量的人体姿态(RT-Pose)数据集和开源基准测试框架。RT-Pose数据集包含四维雷达张量、激光雷达点云和RGB图像,共采集了240个序列中72,000帧数据,涵盖六种不同复杂度级别的动作。四维雷达张量提供了原始时空信息,区别于其他基于雷达点云的数据集。我们开发了一种标注流程,利用RGB图像和激光雷达点云对三维人体骨架进行精确标注。此外,我们提出了HRRadarPose,这是首个从三维空间中提取四维雷达张量高分辨率表示的单阶段架构,以辅助人体关键点估计。HRRadarPose在RT-Pose基准测试中超越了以往基于雷达的HPE工作。RT-Pose数据集的整体HRRadarPose性能,如平均关节位置误差(MPJPE)为9.91cm,表明在复杂现实场景中实现精确HPE仍面临持续挑战。RT-Pose数据集可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/uwipl/RT-Pose获取。
abstract_en: Traditional methods for human localization and pose estimation (HPE), which mainly rely on RGB images as an input modality, confront substantial limitations in real-world applications due to privacy concerns. In contrast, radar-based HPE methods emerge as a promising alternative, characterized by distinctive attributes such as through-wall recognition and privacy-preserving, rendering the method more conducive to practical deployments. This paper presents a Radar Tensor-based human pose (RT-Pose) dataset and an open-source benchmarking framework. RT-Pose dataset comprises 4D radar tensors, LiDAR point clouds, and RGB images, and is collected for a total of 72k frames across 240 sequences with six different complexity level actions. The 4D radar tensor provides raw spatio-temporal information, differentiating it from other radar point cloud-based datasets. We develop an annotation process, which uses RGB images and LiDAR point clouds to accurately label 3D human skeletons. In addition, we propose HRRadarPose, the first single-stage architecture that extracts the high-resolution representation of 4D radar tensors in 3D space to aid human keypoint estimation. HRRadarPose outperforms previous radar-based HPE work on the RT-Pose benchmark. The overall HRRadarPose performance on the RT-Pose dataset, as reflected in a mean per joint position error (MPJPE) of 9.91cm, indicates the persistent challenges in achieving accurate HPE in complex real-world scenarios. RT-Pose is available at https://huggingface. co/datasets/uwipl/RT-Pose.

title: Yuan-Ming Li, Wei-Jin Huang, An-Lan Wang, Ling-An Zeng, Jing-Ke Meng*, Wei-Shi Zheng*
title_en: Yuan-Ming Li, Wei-Jin Huang, An-Lan Wang, Ling-An Zeng, Jing-Ke Meng*, Wei-Shi Zheng*
abstract: 我们提出EgoExo-Fitness,一个全新的全身动作理解数据集,包含通过同步的第一视角和固定第三人称(第三人称)摄像头录制的健身序列视频。与现有的全身动作理解数据集相比,EgoExo-Fitness不仅包含第一视角视频,还提供了丰富的注释。具体而言,提供了两级时间边界以定位单个动作视频及其每个动作的子步骤。更重要的是,EgoExo-Fitness引入了创新的注释用于可解释的动作判断——包括技术关键点验证、对动作执行的自然语言注释以及动作质量评分。结合所有这些特性,EgoExo-Fitness为跨“什么”、“何时”和“做得如何”三个维度研究第一视角和第三人称全身动作理解提供了新的资源。为促进第一视角和第三人称全身动作理解的研究,我们构建了涵盖一系列任务(如动作分类、动作定位、跨视角序列验证、跨视角技能判断以及新提出的基于指导的执行验证任务)的基准,并附有详细分析。数据和代码可在https://github.com/iSEE-Laboratory/EgoExo-Fitness/tree/main获取。
abstract_en: We present EgoExo-Fitness, a new full-body action understanding dataset, featuring fitness sequence videos recorded from synchronized egocentric and fixed exocentric (third-person) cameras. Compared with existing full-body action understanding datasets, EgoExo-Fitness not only contains videos from first-person perspectives, but also provides rich annotations. Specifically, two-level temporal boundaries are provided to localize single action videos along with sub-steps of each action. More importantly, EgoExo-Fitness introduces innovative annotations for interpretable action judgement–including technical keypoint verification, natural language comments on action execution, and action quality scores. Combining all of these, EgoExo-Fitness provides new resources to study egocentric and exocentric full-body action understanding across dimensions of “what”, “when”, and “how well”. To facilitate research on egocentric and exocentric full-body action understanding, we construct benchmarks on a suite of tasks (, action classification, action localization, cross-view sequence verification, cross-view skill determination, and a newly proposed task of guidance-based execution verification), together with detailed analysis. Data and code are available at https://github.com/iSEE-Laboratory/EgoExo-Fitness/tree/main.

title: Yuanchen Ju, Kaizhe Hu, Guowei Zhang, Gu Zhang, Mingrun Jiang, Huazhe Xu*
title_en: Yuanchen Ju, Kaizhe Hu, Guowei Zhang, Gu Zhang, Mingrun Jiang, Huazhe Xu*
abstract: 实现能够泛化到分布外场景的机器人操作是迈向开放世界具身智能的关键步骤。对于人类而言,这种能力源于对不同物体之间语义对应关系的理解,这有助于自然地将熟悉物体的交互经验迁移到新物体上。尽管机器人缺乏这种交互经验的储备,但互联网上大量的人类视频可能成为资源,从中我们可以提取接触点的可用性记忆。受人类自然思维方式的启发,我们提出:当面对需要泛化的不熟悉物体时,机器人可以通过从记忆中检索具有视觉和语义相似性的物体,然后将检索到物体的接触点映射到新物体上获取可用性。虽然这种对应关系在第一眼看来可能具有挑战性,但近期研究发现,这种对应关系自然地从预训练扩散模型中产生,使得即使在不同类别之间也能实现可用性映射。通过该框架,机器人可以在无需任何手动标注、额外训练、部件分割、预编码知识或视角限制的情况下,以零样本方式泛化到操控分布外物体。定量上,与最先进的端到端可用性模型相比,显著提升了视觉可用性推理的准确性,提升了28.7%。我们还进行了跨类别的物体抓取现实世界实验,取得了85.7%的成功率,证明了该方法在现实任务中的能力。
abstract_en: Enabling robotic manipulation that generalizes to out-of-distribution scenes is a crucial step toward the open-world embodied intelligence. For human beings, this ability is rooted in the understanding of semantic correspondence among different objects, which helps to naturally transfer the interaction experience of familiar objects to novel ones. Although robots lack such a reservoir of interaction experience, the vast availability of human videos on the Internet may serve as a resource, from which we extract an affordance memory of contact points. Inspired by the natural way humans think, we propose : when confronted with unfamiliar objects that require generalization, the robot can acquire affordance by retrieving objects that share visual and semantic similarities from the memory, then mapping the contact points of the retrieved objects to the new object. While such correspondence may present formidable challenges at first glance, recent research finds it naturally arises from pre-trained diffusion models, enabling affordance mapping even across disparate categories. Through the framework, robots can generalize to manipulate out-of-category objects in a zero-shot manner without any manual annotation, additional training, part segmentation, pre-coded knowledge, or viewpoint restrictions. Quantitatively, significantly enhances the accuracy of visual affordance inference by a large margin of 28.7% compared to state-of-the-art (SOTA) end-to-end affordance models. We also conduct real-world experiments of cross-category object-grasping and achieve a success rate of 85.7%, proving ’s capacity for real-world tasks.

title: 班元浩, 王若晨, 周天一, 程明浩, 龚博清, 谢俊杰*
title_en: Yuanhao Ban, Ruochen Wang, Tianyi Zhou, Minhao Cheng, Boqing Gong, Cho-Jui Hsieh*
abstract: 负提示的概念源自于像Stable Diffusion这样的条件生成模型,允许用户指定生成图像中要排除的内容。尽管负提示被广泛使用,但其内在机制仍 largely unexplored。本文首次全面研究了负提示如何以及何时生效。我们的广泛实证分析识别出负提示的两个主要行为。延迟效应:负提示的影响在正提示生成相应内容后才被观察到。中和删除:负提示通过在潜在空间中与正提示的相互抵消效应,从生成的图像中删除概念。这些见解揭示了显著的现实应用潜力;例如,我们证明负提示可以通过简单的自适应算法,以最小的背景修改来促进物体修复。我们认为我们的发现将为社区提供有价值的见解,以利用负提示的潜力。
abstract_en: The concept of negative prompts, emerging from conditional generation models like Stable Diffusion, allows users to specify what to exclude from the generated images.Despite the widespread use of negative prompts, their intrinsic mechanisms remain largely unexplored. This paper presents the first comprehensive study to uncover how and when negative prompts take effect. Our extensive empirical analysis identifies two primary behaviors of negative prompts. Delayed Effect: The impact of negative prompts is observed after positive prompts render corresponding content. Deletion Through Neutralization: Negative prompts delete concepts from the generated image through a mutual cancellation effect in latent space with positive prompts. These insights reveal significant potential real-world applications; for example, we demonstrate that negative prompts can facilitate object inpainting with minimal alterations to the background via a simple adaptive algorithm. We believe our findings will offer valuable insights for the community in capitalizing on the potential of negative prompts.

title: Yuanhao Cai*, Yixun Liang, Jiahao Wang, Angtian Wang, Yulun Zhang, Xiaokang Yang, Zongwei Zhou, Alan Yuille
title_en: Yuanhao Cai*, Yixun Liang, Jiahao Wang, Angtian Wang, Yulun Zhang, Xiaokang Yang, Zongwei Zhou, Alan Yuille
abstract: X射线因其比自然光更强的穿透性,被广泛应用于透射成像。在生成新型视图X射线投影时,现有方法主要基于NeRF,但存在训练时间长和推理速度慢的问题。本文提出了一种基于三维高斯点云的X射线新型视图合成方法,即X-Gaussian。首先,我们重新设计了一个受X射线成像各向同性特性启发的辐射高斯点云模型。该模型在学习预测三维点辐射强度时,排除了视角方向的影响。基于此模型,我们开发了具有CUDA实现的可微辐射光栅化(DRR)。其次,我们定制了一种角度姿态立方体均匀初始化(ACUI)策略,直接利用X射线扫描仪参数计算相机信息,并在包含扫描物体的立方体内均匀采样点位置。实验表明,我们的X-Gaussian在保持低于15%训练时间的同时,推理速度超过73×,比现有方法提升6.5 dB。在CT重建中的应用也验证了该方法的实用价值。代码见https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/X-Gaussian
abstract_en: X-ray is widely applied for transmission imaging due to its stronger penetration than natural light. When rendering novel view X-ray projections, existing methods mainly based on NeRF suffer from long training time and slow inference speed. In this paper, we propose a 3D Gaussian splatting-based method, namely X-Gaussian, for X-ray novel view synthesis. Firstly, we redesign a radiative Gaussian point cloud model inspired by the isotropic nature of X-ray imaging. Our model excludes the influence of view direction when learning to predict the radiation intensity of 3D points. Based on this model, we develop a Differentiable Radiative Rasterization (DRR) with CUDA implementation. Secondly, we customize an Angle-pose Cuboid Uniform Initialization (ACUI) strategy that directly uses the parameters of the X-ray scanner to compute the camera information and then uniformly samples point positions within a cuboid enclosing the scanned object. Experiments show that our X-Gaussian outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 6.5 dB while enjoying less than 15% training time and over 73× inference speed. The application on CT reconstruction also reveals the practical values of our method. Code is at https://github.com/caiyuanhao1998/X-Gaussian

title: Yuanhao Zhai*, Kevin Lin, Linjie Li, Chung-Ching Lin, Jianfeng Wang, Zhengyuan Yang, David Doermann, Junsong Yuan, Zicheng Liu, Lijuan Wang
title_en: Yuanhao Zhai*, Kevin Lin, Linjie Li, Chung-Ching Lin, Jianfeng Wang, Zhengyuan Yang, David Doermann, Junsong Yuan, Zicheng Liu, Lijuan Wang
abstract: 在以人为中心的视频生成领域已取得显著进展,但联合视频-深度生成问题仍处于探索阶段。现有大多数单目深度估计方法可能难以泛化到合成图像或视频,而基于多视角的方法在控制人体外观和运动方面存在困难。本文提出__TITLE_MATH_1__用于高质量的人为中心联合视频-深度生成。我们的方法包含两个创新设计。首先,为实现双模态生成并最大化视频与深度生成之间的信息交互,我们提出统一的双模态U-Net,这是一个用于联合视频和深度去噪的参数共享框架,其中模态标签引导去噪目标,跨模态注意力机制实现互信息流动。其次,为确保视频-深度空间对齐的精确性,我们提出运动一致性损失,强制视频与深度特征运动场之间的一致性,从而生成和谐的输出。此外,应用跨注意力图一致性损失,将视频去噪的跨注意力图与深度去噪的跨注意力图对齐,进一步促进空间对齐。在TikTok和NTU120数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在视频FVD和深度精度方面显著优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Significant advances have been made in human-centric video generation, yet the joint video-depth generation problem remains underexplored. Most existing monocular depth estimation methods may not generalize well to synthesized images or videos, and multi-view-based methods have difficulty controlling the human appearance and motion. In this work, we present () for high-quality human-centric joint video-depth generation. Our consists of two novel designs. First, to enable dual-modal generation and maximize the information exchange between video and depth generation, we propose a unified dual-modal U-Net, a parameter-sharing framework for joint video and depth denoising, wherein a modality label guides the denoising target, and cross-modal attention enables the mutual information flow. Second, to ensure a precise video-depth spatial alignment, we propose a motion consistency loss that enforces consistency between the video and depth feature motion fields, leading to harmonized outputs. Additionally, a cross-attention map consistency loss is applied to align the cross-attention map of the video denoising with that of the depth denoising, further facilitating spatial alignment. Extensive experiments on the TikTok and NTU120 datasets show our superior performance, significantly surpassing existing methods in terms of video FVD and depth accuracy.

title: 陈元宏*, 王崇, 刘雨媛, 王虎, 加斯托沃·卡内罗
title_en: Yuanhong Chen*, Chong Wang, Yuyuan Liu, Hu Wang, Gustavo Carneiro
abstract: 音频-视觉分割(AVS)是一项新兴任务,旨在基于音频-视觉线索对发声物体进行精确分割。AVS学习系统成功的关键取决于跨模态交互的有效性。这种需求可以通过利用基于Transformer的分割架构自然实现,因为其固有地能够捕捉长距离依赖关系,并灵活处理不同模态。然而,基于Transformer方法的固有训练问题,如跨注意力的低效性和二部匹配的不稳定性,在AVS中可能被放大,尤其是在学习到的音频查询未能提供明确语义线索时。在本文中,我们通过新的类条件提示机(CPM)解决这两个问题。CPM通过结合无类查询与有类查询的学习策略来改进二部匹配。同时,通过为音频、视觉和联合模态设计新的学习目标,提升了跨模态注意力的效果。我们在AVS基准数据集上进行了实验,结果表明我们的方法实现了最先进(SOTA)的分割精度1。1 本项目由澳大利亚研究理事会(ARC)通过项目编号 FT190100525 资助。
abstract_en: Audio-visual segmentation (AVS) is an emerging task that aims to accurately segment sounding objects based on audio-visual cues. The success of AVS learning systems depends on the effectiveness of cross-modal interaction. Such a requirement can be naturally fulfilled by leveraging transformer-based segmentation architecture due to its inherent ability to capture long-range dependencies and flexibility in handling different modalities. However, the inherent training issues of transformer-based methods, such as the low efficacy of cross-attention and unstable bipartite matching, can be amplified in AVS, particularly when the learned audio query does not provide a clear semantic clue. In this paper, we address these two issues with the new Class-conditional Prompting Machine (CPM). CPM improves the bipartite matching with a learning strategy combining class-agnostic queries with class-conditional queries. The efficacy of cross-modal attention is upgraded with new learning objectives for the audio, visual and joint modalities. We conduct experiments on AVS benchmarks, demonstrating that our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) segmentation accuracy1 . 1 This project is supported by the Australian Research Council (ARC) through grant FT190100525.

title: Yuanhui Huang, Wenzhao Zheng, Yunpeng Zhang, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu*
title_en: Yuanhui Huang, Wenzhao Zheng, Yunpeng Zhang, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu*
abstract: 三维语义占据预测旨在获取周围场景的三维细粒度几何结构和语义信息,是提升以视觉为中心的自动驾驶系统鲁棒性的重要任务。现有大多数方法采用体素等密集网格作为场景表示,忽略了占据的稀疏性和物体尺度的多样性,导致资源分配不均衡。为解决这一问题,我们提出一种以物体为中心的表示方法,通过稀疏的三维语义高斯分布描述三维场景,其中每个高斯分布表示一个灵活的感兴趣区域及其语义特征。我们通过注意力机制从图像中聚合信息,并迭代优化三维高斯分布的属性,包括位置、协方差和语义。随后,我们提出一种高效的高斯到体素投影方法生成三维占据预测,该方法仅对特定位置的邻近高斯分布进行聚合。我们在广泛采用的nuScenes和KITTI-360数据集上进行了大量实验。实验结果表明,GaussianFormer在仅消耗17.8%-24.8%内存的情况下,性能与现有最先进方法相当。代码已开源:https://github.com/huang-yh/GaussianFormer
abstract_en: 3D semantic occupancy prediction aims to obtain 3D fine-grained geometry and semantics of the surrounding scene and is an important task for the robustness of vision-centric autonomous driving. Most existing methods employ dense grids such as voxels as scene representations, which ignore the sparsity of occupancy and the diversity of object scales and thus lead to unbalanced allocation of resources. To address this, we propose an object-centric representation to describe 3D scenes with sparse 3D semantic Gaussians where each Gaussian represents a flexible region of interest and its semantic features. We aggregate information from images through the attention mechanism and iteratively refine the properties of 3D Gaussians including position, covariance, and semantics. We then propose an efficient Gaussian-to-voxel splatting method to generate 3D occupancy predictions, which only aggregates the neighboring Gaussians for a certain position. We conduct extensive experiments on the widely adopted nuScenes and KITTI-360 datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that GaussianFormer achieves comparable performance with state-of-the-art methods with only 17.8% - 24.8% of their memory consumption. Code is available at: https://github. com/huang-yh/GaussianFormer.

title: Yuanpeng Tu, Boshen Zhang, Liang Liu, YUXI LI, Jiangning Zhang, Yabiao Wang*, Chengjie Wang, cairong zhao*
title_en: Yuanpeng Tu, Boshen Zhang, Liang Liu, YUXI LI, Jiangning Zhang, Yabiao Wang*, Chengjie Wang, cairong zhao*
abstract: 工业异常检测通常被作为无监督任务处理,其目标是仅使用正常训练样本定位缺陷。近年来,大量基于2D的异常检测方法被提出并取得了 promising 的结果,然而,仅使用2D RGB数据作为输入不足以识别不可察觉的几何表面异常。因此,在本工作中,我们专注于多模态异常检测。具体而言,我们研究了早期的多模态方法,这些方法尝试利用在大规模视觉数据集(如ImageNet)上预训练的模型构建特征数据库。我们实证发现,直接使用这些预训练模型并非最优解,其要么无法检测细微缺陷,要么将异常特征误判为正常特征。这可能归因于目标工业数据与源数据之间的领域差距。针对这一问题,我们提出了一种局部到全局的自监督特征适应(Local-to-global Self-supervised Feature Adaptation, LSFA)方法,用于微调适配器并学习面向异常检测的任务导向表示。在LSFA中,从局部到全局的视角优化了同模态适应和跨模态对齐,以确保推理阶段表示的质量和一致性。大量实验表明,我们的方法不仅显著提升了基于特征嵌入的方法性能,还在MVTec-3D AD和Eyecandies数据集上显著优于先前的最先进方法(State-of-The-Art, SoTA),例如LSFA在MVTec-3D上达到97.1%的I-AUROC,超越先前SoTA方法+3.4%。代码可在https://github.com/yuanpengtu/LSFA获取。
abstract_en: Industrial anomaly detection is generally addressed as an unsupervised task that aims at locating defects with only normal training samples. Recently, numerous 2D anomaly detection methods have been proposed and have achieved promising results, however, using only the 2D RGB data as input is not sufficient to identify imperceptible geometric surface anomalies. Hence, in this work, we focus on multi-modal anomaly detection. Specifically, we investigate early multi-modal approaches that attempted to utilize models pre-trained on large-scale visual datasets, i.e., ImageNet, to construct feature databases. And we empirically find that directly using these pre-trained models is not optimal, it can either fail to detect subtle defects or mistake abnormal features as normal ones. This may be attributed to the domain gap between target industrial data and source data. Towards this problem, we propose a Local-to-global Self-supervised Feature Adaptation (LSFA) method to finetune the adaptors and learn task-oriented representation toward anomaly detection. Both intra-modal adaptation and cross-modal alignment are optimized from a local-to-global perspective in LSFA to ensure the representation quality and consistency in the inference stage. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method not only brings a significant performance boost to feature embedding based approaches, but also outperforms previous State-of-The-Art (SoTA) methods prominently on both MVTec-3D AD and Eyecandies datasets, e.g., LSFA achieves 97.1% I-AUROC on MVTec-3D, surpass previous SoTA by +3.4%. Code is available at https://github.com/ yuanpengtu/LSFA.

title: Yuanqi Yao* et al.
title_en: Yuanqi Yao*, Gang Wu, Kui Jiang, Siao Liu, Jian Kuai, Xianming Liu, Junjun Jiang*
abstract: 学习具有广泛泛化能力的自监督单目深度估计(MDE)模型仍然面临显著挑战。尽管对抗性增强在监督学习泛化中取得成功,但将其直接应用于自监督MDE模型可能导致过度正则化,从而引发严重性能退化。本文通过定性分析揭示了主要原因:(i) 类似UNet的深度网络固有的敏感性;(ii) 过度正则化导致的双优化冲突。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种通用对抗训练框架,命名为稳定冲突优化对抗训练(SCAT),将对抗性数据增强集成到自监督MDE方法中,以在稳定性与泛化能力之间取得平衡。具体而言,我们设计了一种有效的尺度深度网络,调节长跳连接的系数并有效稳定训练过程。随后,我们提出了一种冲突梯度手术策略,逐步整合对抗性梯度并优化模型向无冲突方向发展。在五个基准测试上的大量实验表明,SCAT能够实现最先进性能,并显著提升现有自监督MDE方法的泛化能力。
abstract_en: Learning a self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) model with great generalization remains significantly challenging. Despite the success of adversarial augmentation in the supervised learning generalization, naively incorporating it into self-supervised MDE models potentially causes over-regularization, suffering from severe performance degradation. In this paper, we conduct qualitative analysis and illuminate the main causes: (i) inherent sensitivity in the UNet-alike depth network and (ii) dual optimization conflict caused by over-regularization. To tackle these issues, we propose a general adversarial training framework, named Stabilized Conflict-optimization Adversarial Training (SCAT), integrating adversarial data augmentation into self-supervised MDE methods to achieve a balance between stability and generalization. Specifically, we devise an effective scaling depth network that tunes the coefficients of long skip connection and effectively stabilizes the training process. Then, we propose a conflict gradient surgery strategy, which progressively integrates the adversarial gradient and optimizes the model toward a conflict-free direction. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks demonstrate that SCAT can achieve state-of-the-art performance and significantly improve the generalization capability of existing self-supervised MDE methods.

title: Yuanting Fan, Chengxu Liu, Nengzhong Yin, Changlong Gao, Xueming Qian*
title_en: Yuanting Fan, Chengxu Liu, Nengzhong Yin, Changlong Gao, Xueming Qian*
abstract: 扩散模型(DMs)在单图像超分辨率和其他图像到图像翻译任务中展现出有前景的结果。得益于更多的计算资源和更长的推理时间,它们能够生成更逼真的图像。现有的基于扩散模型的超分辨率方法试图通过迭代细化实现所有区域的整体平均恢复,忽略了不同输入图像区域需要不同时间步长进行重建的考虑。在本工作中,我们注意到先前基于扩散模型的超分辨率方法存在浪费计算资源重建不可见细节的问题。为了进一步提高计算资源的利用率,我们提出AdaDiffSR,一种基于扩散模型的超分辨率管道,采用动态时间步长采样策略(DTSS)。具体而言,通过引入多指标潜在熵模块(MMLE),我们能够动态感知去噪过程中潜在空间信息增益,从而指导时间步长的动态选择。此外,我们采用渐进特征注入模块(PFJ),根据当前信息增益动态将原始图像特征注入去噪过程,以生成兼具保真度和真实感的图像。实验表明,我们的AdaDiffSR在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上均以更少的计算资源和推理时间实现了与当前最先进基于扩散模型的超分辨率方法相当的性能。
abstract_en: Diffusion models (DMs) have shown promising results on single-image super-resolution and other image-to-image translation tasks. Benefiting from more computational resources and longer inference times, they are able to yield more realistic images. Existing DMs-based super-resolution methods try to achieve an overall average recovery over all regions via iterative refinement, ignoring the consideration that different input image regions require different timesteps to reconstruct. In this work, we notice that previous DMs-based super-resolution methods suffer from wasting computational resources to reconstruct invisible details. To further improve the utilization of computational resources, we propose AdaDiffSR, a DMs-based SR pipeline with dynamic timesteps sampling strategy (DTSS). Specifically, by introducing the multi-metrics latent entropy module (MMLE), we can achieve dynamic perception of the latent spatial information gain during the denoising process, thereby guiding the dynamic selection of the timesteps. In addition, we adopt a progressive feature injection module (PFJ), which dynamically injects the original image features into the denoising process based on the current information gain, so as to generate images with both fidelity and realism. Experiments show that our AdaDiffSR achieves comparable performance over current state-of-the-art DMs-based SR methods while consuming less computational resources and inference time on both synthetic and real-world datasets.

title: Yuanwen Yue*, Anurag Das, Francis Engelmann, Siyu Tang, Jan Eric Lenssen
title_en: Yuanwen Yue*, Anurag Das, Francis Engelmann, Siyu Tang, Jan Eric Lenssen
abstract: 当前的视觉基础模型仅基于非结构化2D数据进行训练,限制了其对物体和场景三维结构的理解。在本工作中,我们展示了在具备三维感知的数据上进行微调可以提升新兴语义特征的质量。我们设计了一种方法,将语义2D特征提升为高效的3D高斯表示,从而允许我们重新渲染以适应任意视角。利用渲染后的3D感知特征,我们设计了一种微调策略,将这种三维感知转移到2D基础模型中。我们证明,通过这种方式微调的模型产生的特征,能够通过简单的线性探针显著提升语义分割和深度估计等下游任务的性能。值得注意的是,尽管在单一室内数据集上进行微调,其性能提升可迁移至多种室内数据集和领域外数据集。我们希望本研究能鼓励社区在训练2D基础模型时考虑注入三维感知。项目页面:https://ywyue.github.io/FiT3D.
