Moreover, we extensively evaluate our image watermarks in terms of both certified and empirical robustness. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhengyuan-jiang/ Watermark-Library.

title: Zhengyuan Xie, Haiquan Lu, Jia-wen Xiao, Enguang Wang, Le Zhang, Xialei Liu*
title_en: Zhengyuan Xie, Haiquan Lu, Jia-wen Xiao, Enguang Wang, Le Zhang, Xialei Liu*
abstract: 类增量语义分割旨在保留旧知识的同时学习新任务,但受到灾难性遗忘和背景漂移问题的阻碍。先前研究表明,初始化新分类器具有关键重要性,主要关注从背景分类器迁移知识或为未来类别准备分类器,忽视了新分类器的灵活性和差异性。本文提出了一种新的分类器预调优(NeST)方法,在正式训练过程之前应用,学习从旧分类器到新分类器的转换,而非直接调优新分类器的参数。我们的方法可以使新分类器与主干网络对齐并适应新数据,防止在学习新类别时特征提取器发生剧烈变化。此外,我们设计了一种考虑跨任务类别相似性的策略,用于初始化转换中的矩阵,有助于实现稳定性-可塑性权衡。在Pascal VOC 2012和ADE20K数据集上的实验表明,所提出策略能显著提升先前方法的性能。代码可在https://github.com/zhengyuan-xie/ECCV24_NeST获取。
abstract_en: Class incremental semantic segmentation aims to preserve old knowledge while learning new tasks, however, it is impeded by catastrophic forgetting and background shift issues. Prior works indicate the pivotal importance of initializing new classifiers and mainly focus on transferring knowledge from the background classifier or preparing classifiers for future classes, neglecting the flexibility and variance of new classifiers. In this paper, we propose a new classifier pre-tuning (NeST) method applied before the formal training process, learning a transformation from old classifiers to generate new classifiers for initialization rather than directly tuning the parameters of new classifiers. Our method can make new classifiers align with the backbone and adapt to the new data, preventing drastic changes in the feature extractor when learning new classes. Besides, we design a strategy considering the cross-task class similarity to initialize matrices used in the transformation, helping achieve the stability-plasticity trade-off. Experiments on Pascal VOC 2012 and ADE20K datasets show that the proposed strategy can significantly improve the performance of previous methods. The code is available at https://github.com/zhengyuan-xie/ ECCV24_NeST.

title: Zhengyuan Yang*, Jianfeng Wang, Linjie Li, Kevin Lin, Chung-Ching Lin, Zicheng Liu, Lijuan Wang
title_en: Zhengyuan Yang*, Jianfeng Wang, Linjie Li, Kevin Lin, Chung-Ching Lin, Zicheng Liu, Lijuan Wang
abstract: 我们介绍了“从想法到图像”(Idea to Image)系统,该系统能够通过多模态迭代自优化实现自动图像设计与生成。人类可以通过迭代探索快速识别不同文本到图像(T2I)模型的特征,从而高效地将高阶生成想法转化为有效的T2I提示,以生成高质量图像。我们研究基于大模型(LMMs)的系统是否能够发展出类似的多模态自优化能力,通过自优化尝试探索未知模型或环境。系统循环生成修订后的T2I提示以合成草图图像,并基于其对探查到的T2I模型特征的记忆提供方向性反馈。迭代自优化相比传统T2I模型具有多种优势。值得注意的是,系统能够处理包含交错图像-文本序列的输入想法,遵循设计指令生成语义和视觉质量更优的图像。用户偏好研究验证了多模态迭代自优化在自动图像设计与生成中的有效性。1 简称“.” 系统标志设计 [height=15pt]figure/logo1.png 由辅助。
abstract_en: We introduce “Idea to Image,”1 an agent system that enables multimodal iterative self-refinement with for automatic image design and generation. Humans can quickly identify the characteristics of different text-to-image (T2I) models via iterative explorations. This enables them to efficiently convert their high-level generation ideas into effective T2I prompts that can produce good images. We investigate if systems based on large multimodal models (LMMs) can develop analogous multimodal self-refinement abilities that enable exploring unknown models or environments via self-refining tries. cyclically generates revised T2I prompts to synthesize draft images, and provides directional feedback for prompt revision, both conditioned on its memory of the probed T2I model’s characteristics. The iterative self-refinement brings various advantages over vanilla T2I models. Notably, can process input ideas with interleaved image-text sequences, follow ideas with design instructions, and generate images of better semantic and visual qualities. The user preference study validates the efficacy of on automatic image design and generation via multimodal iterative self-refinement. 1 Short for “.” System logo design [height=15pt]figure/logo1.png assisted by .

title: Zhening Huang, Xiaoyang Wu, Xi Chen, Hengshuang Zhao*, Lei Zhu, Joan Lasenby*
title_en: Zhening Huang, Xiaoyang Wu, Xi Chen, Hengshuang Zhao*, Lei Zhu, Joan Lasenby*
abstract: 本文提出OpenIns3D,一种全新的仅3D输入框架,用于3D开放词汇场景理解。OpenIns3D框架采用“掩码-对齐-查找”方案。“掩码”模块在3D点云中学习无类别掩码提案,“对齐”模块在多尺度下生成合成场景级图像,并利用2D视觉-语言模型提取感兴趣物体,“查找”模块通过“对齐”的结果为提案掩码分配类别名称。该方法虽简单,却在室内和室外数据集上的多种3D开放词汇任务(包括识别、物体检测和实例分割)中实现了最先进的性能。此外,OpenIns3D可轻松切换不同2D检测器而无需重新训练。当与强大的2D开放世界模型集成时,其在场景理解任务中表现出色。进一步结合LLM驱动的2D模型时,OpenIns3D展现出卓越的复杂文本查询理解与处理能力,能够应对需要复杂推理和现实世界知识的查询。
abstract_en: In this work, we introduce OpenIns3D, a new 3D-input-only framework for 3D open-vocabulary scene understanding. The OpenIns3D framework employs a “Mask-Snap-Lookup” scheme. The “Mask” module learns class-agnostic mask proposals in 3D point clouds, the “Snap” module generates synthetic scene-level images at multiple scales and leverages 2D vision-language models to extract interesting objects, and the “Lookup” module searches through the outcomes of “Snap” to assign category names to the proposed masks. This approach yet simple, achieves state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of 3D open-vocabulary tasks, including recognition, object detection, and instance segmentation, on both indoor and outdoor datasets. Moreover, OpenIns3D facilitates effortless switching between different 2D detectors without requiring retraining. When integrated with powerful 2D open-world models, it achieves excellent results in scene understanding tasks. Furthermore, when combined with LLM-powered 2D models, OpenIns3D exhibits an impressive capability to comprehend and process highly complex text queries that demand intricate reasoning and real-world knowledge.

title: Zhening Liu, Xinjie Zhang, Jiawei Shao, Zehong Lin*, Jun Zhang
title_en: Zhening Liu, Xinjie Zhang, Jiawei Shao, Zehong Lin*, Jun Zhang
abstract: 随着立体视觉技术的快速发展,立体图像压缩已成为一个持续吸引广泛关注的重要领域。以往的方法主要采用单向范式,其中一幅视图的压缩依赖于另一幅视图,导致压缩不均衡。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种对称双向立体图像压缩架构,命名为BiSIC。具体而言,我们提出了一种基于3D卷积的编解码器主干网络,以捕捉局部特征,并引入双向注意力块来利用全局特征。此外,我们设计了一种新颖的跨维度熵模型,整合了包括空间上下文、通道上下文和立体依赖性在内的多种条件因素,以有效估计潜在表示的分布进行熵编码。大量实验表明,我们的BiSIC在PSNR和MS-SSIM指标上均优于传统图像/视频压缩标准以及最先进的学习方法。
abstract_en: With the rapid advancement of stereo vision technologies, stereo image compression has emerged as a crucial field that continues to draw significant attention. Previous approaches have primarily employed a unidirectional paradigm, where the compression of one view is dependent on the other, resulting in imbalanced compression. To address this issue, we introduce a symmetric bidirectional stereo image compression architecture, named BiSIC. Specifically, we propose a 3D convolution based codec backbone to capture local features and incorporate bidirectional attention blocks to exploit global features. Moreover, we design a novel cross-dimensional entropy model that integrates various conditioning factors, including the spatial context, channel context, and stereo dependency, to effectively estimate the distribution of latent representations for entropy coding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed BiSIC outperforms conventional image/video compression standards, as well as state-of-the-art learning-based methods, in terms of both PSNR and MS-SSIM.

title: Zhenliang Ni, Xinghao Chen*, Yingjie Zhai, Yehui Tang, Yunhe Wang*
title_en: Zhenliang Ni, Xinghao Chen*, Yingjie Zhai, Yehui Tang, Yunhe Wang*
abstract: 语义分割是众多应用中的重要任务,但要在有限的计算成本下实现先进性能仍颇具挑战。本文提出CGRSeg,这是一种基于上下文引导的空间特征重建的高效且具有竞争力的分割框架。精心设计了矩形自校准模块,用于空间特征重建和金字塔上下文提取。该模块在水平和垂直方向上捕捉轴向全局上下文,以显式建模矩形关键区域。此外,设计了一种形状自校准函数,使关键区域更接近前景物体。同时,提出了一种轻量级的动态原型引导头,通过显式的类别嵌入提升前景物体的分类性能。我们在ADE20K、COCO-Stuff和Pascal Context基准数据集上对CGRSeg进行了广泛评估,取得了最先进的语义分割性能。具体而言,CGRSeg在ADE20K数据集上仅需4.0 GFLOPs即可达到43.6%的mIoU,比SeaFormer和SegNeXt分别高出0.9%和2.5%的mIoU,但计算量减少了约38.0%。代码已开源至https://github.com/nizhenliang/CGRSeg。
abstract_en: Semantic segmentation is an important task for numerous applications but it is still quite challenging to achieve advanced performance with limited computational costs. In this paper, we present CGRSeg, an efficient yet competitive segmentation framework based on context-guided spatial feature reconstruction. A Rectangular Self-Calibration Module is carefully designed for spatial feature reconstruction and pyramid context extraction. It captures the axial global context in both horizontal and vertical directions to explicitly model rectangular key areas. A shape self-calibration function is designed to make the key areas closer to foreground objects. Besides, a lightweight Dynamic Prototype Guided head is proposed to improve the classification of foreground objects by explicit class embedding. Our CGRSeg is extensively evaluated on ADE20K, COCO-Stuff, and Pascal Context benchmarks, and achieves state-of-the-art semantic performance. Specifically, it achieves 43.6% mIoU on ADE20K with only 4.0 GFLOPs, which is 0.9% and 2.5% mIoU better than SeaFormer and SegNeXt but with about 38.0% fewer GFLOPs. Code is available at https://github.com/nizhenliang/ CGRSeg.

title: Zhenxiang Lin, Xidong Peng, Peishan Cong, Ge Zheng, Yujing Sun, Yuenan HOU, Xinge Zhu, Sibei Yang, Yuexin Ma*
title_en: Zhenxiang Lin, Xidong Peng, Peishan Cong, Ge Zheng, Yujing Sun, Yuenan HOU, Xinge Zhu, Sibei Yang, Yuexin Ma*
abstract: 我们引入了基于自然语言描述和在线捕获的多模态视觉数据(包括二维图像和三维激光雷达点云)的大规模动态场景中的三维视觉定位任务。我们提出了一种名为WildRefer的新方法,通过充分利用图像中的丰富外观信息、点云中的位置和几何线索以及语言描述的语义知识来解决该任务。此外,我们提出了两个新颖的数据集,即STRefer和LifeRefer,它们专注于包含丰富三维物体和自然语言注释的人类中心化日常生活场景。我们的数据集对野外三维视觉定位研究具有重要意义,并有望推动自动驾驶和服务机器人的发展。大量实验和消融研究证明,我们的方法在提出的基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。代码已开源在https://github.com/4DVLab/WildRefer。
abstract_en: We introduce the task of 3D visual grounding in large-scale dynamic scenes based on natural linguistic descriptions and online captured multi-modal visual data, including 2D images and 3D LiDAR point clouds. We present a novel method, dubbed WildRefer, for this task by fully utilizing the rich appearance information in images, the position and geometric clues in point cloud as well as the semantic knowledge of language descriptions. Besides, we propose two novel datasets, i.e., STRefer and LifeRefer, which focus on large-scale human-centric daily-life scenarios accompanied with abundant 3D object and natural language annotations. Our datasets are significant for the research of 3D visual grounding in the wild and has huge potential to boost the development of autonomous driving and service robots. Extensive experiments and ablation studies demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the proposed benchmarks. The code is provided in https://github.com/4DVLab/WildRefer.

title: 王振毅*, 沈丽*, 郭军峰, 段铁航, 郦思雨, 刘同亮, 高明晨
title_en: Zhenyi Wang*, Li Shen*, junfeng guo, Tiehang Duan, Siyu Luan, Tongliang Liu, Mingchen Gao
abstract: 无数据模型提取(DFME)的目标是通过查询访问获取预训练的黑盒模型,而无需了解受害模型的训练数据。防御DFME具有挑战性,因为攻击查询数据分布和攻击者策略在事前对防御者是未知的。然而,现有防御方法存在以下局限:(1) 计算和内存效率低下;或(2) 仅能在模型已被窃取后提供窃取证据。为解决这些限制,我们提出一种攻击感知与不确定性引导(AAUG)防御方法。AAUG旨在有效阻止DFME攻击的同时提升部署效率。其核心策略是在预测不同输入时向受害模型权重引入随机权重扰动。在防御训练中,权重扰动在模拟分布外(OOD)数据上最大化以增加模型窃取难度,而在分布内(ID)训练数据上最小化以保持模型实用性。此外,我们构建了攻击感知的防御训练目标函数,强化模型对窃取尝试的抵抗力。在防御针对软标签和硬标签DFME攻击的大量实验中,验证了AAUG的有效性。特别是,AAUG显著降低了克隆模型的准确率,并比现有防御方法更高效。
abstract_en: The objective of data-free model extraction (DFME) is to acquire a pre-trained black-box model solely through query access, without any knowledge of the training data used for the victim model. Defending against DFME is challenging because the attack query data distribution and the attacker’s strategy remain undisclosed to the defender beforehand. However, existing defense methods: (1) are computational and memory inefficient; or (2) can only provide evidence of model theft after the model has already been stolen. To address these limitations, we thus propose an Attack-Aware and Uncertainty-Guided (AAUG) defense method against DFME. AAUG is designed to effectively thwart DFME attacks while concurrently enhancing deployment efficiency. The key strategy involves introducing random weight perturbations to the victim model’s weights during predictions for various inputs. During defensive training, the weights perturbations are maximized on simulated out-of-distribution (OOD) data to heighten the challenge of model theft, while being minimized on in-distribution (ID) training data to preserve model utility. Additionally, we formulate an attack-aware defensive training objective function, reinforcing the model’s resistance to theft attempts. Extensive experiments on defending against both soft-label and hard-label DFME attacks demonstrate the effectiveness of AAUG. In particular, AAUG significantly reduces the accuracy of the clone model and is substantially more efficient than existing defense methods.

title: Zhenyu Li*, Shariq Farooq Bhat, Peter Wonka
title_en: Zhenyu Li*, Shariq Farooq Bhat, Peter Wonka
abstract: 本文介绍了PatchRefiner,一个先进的框架,用于度量单图像深度估计,旨在处理高分辨率真实域输入。尽管深度估计对于自动驾驶、3D生成建模和3D重建等应用至关重要,但在现实场景中实现准确的高分辨率深度具有挑战性,这是由于现有架构的限制以及详细真实世界深度数据的稀缺性。PatchRefiner采用基于瓦片的方法,将高分辨率深度估计重新概念化为一个细化过程,从而显著提升了性能。利用一种伪标签策略,结合合成数据,PatchRefiner引入了细节和尺度解耦(DSD)损失,以增强细节捕捉同时保持尺度准确性,从而有效转移知识从合成到真实世界数据。我们的广泛评估表明,PatchRefiner表现出色,在Unreal4KStereo数据集上比现有基准高出18.1%的均方根误差(RMSE),并在CityScape、ScanNet++和ETH3D等多样化真实世界数据集上显示出细节准确性和一致尺度估计的显著改进。
abstract_en: This paper introduces PatchRefiner, an advanced framework for metric single image depth estimation aimed at high-resolution real-domain inputs. While depth estimation is crucial for applications such as autonomous driving, 3D generative modeling, and 3D reconstruction, achieving accurate high-resolution depth in real-world scenarios is challenging due to the constraints of existing architectures and the scarcity of detailed real-world depth data. PatchRefiner adopts a tile-based methodology, reconceptualizing high-resolution depth estimation as a refinement process, which results in notable performance enhancements. Utilizing a pseudo-labeling strategy that leverages synthetic data, PatchRefiner incorporates a Detail and Scale Disentangling (DSD) loss to enhance detail capture while maintaining scale accuracy, thus facilitating the effective transfer of knowledge from synthetic to real-world data. Our extensive evaluations demonstrate PatchRefiner’s superior performance, significantly outperforming existing benchmarks on the Unreal4KStereo dataset by 18.1% in terms of the root mean squared error (RMSE) and showing marked improvements in detail accuracy and consistent scale estimation on diverse real-world datasets like CityScape, ScanNet++, and ETH3D.

title: 王振宇*, 李雅丽, TAICHI LIU, 赵恒双, 王圣金
title_en: Zhenyu Wang*, Ya-Li Li, TAICHI LIU, Hengshuang Zhao, Shengjin Wang
abstract: 在当前三维目标检测研究中,标注三维数据的严重匮乏、不同数据模态间的显著差异以及缺乏统一架构,阻碍了向通用性目标迈进的进程。本文提出OV-Uni3DETR,一种通过循环模态传播实现统一开放词汇三维检测的方法。与现有三维检测器相比,OV-Uni3DETR具有以下优势:1)开放词汇三维检测:训练阶段利用多种可获取数据,尤其是大量二维检测图像,提升训练多样性;推理阶段可检测已知和未知类别。2)模态统一:无缝兼容任意模态输入数据,有效应对异模态或传感器信息缺失场景,支持测试时模态切换。3)场景统一:为由不同传感器采集的多样化场景提供统一的多模态模型架构。具体而言,我们提出循环模态传播机制,旨在传播连接二维与三维模态的知识,以支持上述功能。来自大规模词汇学习的二维语义知识指导三维领域中新类别的发现,而三维几何知识则为二维检测图像提供定位监督。OV-Uni3DETR在多种场景中达到最先进性能,平均超越现有方法超过6%。仅使用RGB图像时,其性能与甚至超越先前基于点云的方法。代码可在https://github.com/zhenyuw16/Uni3DETR获取。
abstract_en: In the current state of 3D object detection research, the severe scarcity of annotated 3D data, substantial disparities across different data modalities, and the absence of a unified architecture, have impeded the progress towards the goal of universality. In this paper, we propose OV-Uni3DETR, a unified open-vocabulary 3D detector via cycle-modality propagation. Compared with existing 3D detectors, OV-Uni3DETR offers distinct advantages: 1) Open-vocabulary 3D detection: During training, it leverages various accessible data, especially extensive 2D detection images, to boost training diversity. During inference, it can detect both seen and unseen classes. 2) Modality unifying: It seamlessly accommodates input data from any given modality, effectively addressing scenarios involving disparate modalities or missing sensor information, thereby supporting test-time modality switching. 3) Scene unifying: It provides a unified multi-modal model architecture for diverse scenes collected by distinct sensors. Specifically, we propose the cycle-modality propagation, aimed at propagating knowledge bridging 2D and 3D modalities, to support the aforementioned functionalities. 2D semantic knowledge from large-vocabulary learning guides novel class discovery in the 3D domain, and 3D geometric knowledge provides localization supervision for 2D detection images. OV-Uni3DETR achieves the state-of-the-art performance on various scenarios, surpassing existing methods by more than 6% on average. Its performance using only RGB images is on par with or even surpasses that of previous point cloud based methods. Code is available at https://github. com/zhenyuw16/Uni3DETR.

title: Zhewei Wu, Ruilong Yu, Qihe Liu*, Shuying Cheng, Shilin Qiu, Shijie Zhou
title_en: Zhewei Wu, Ruilong Yu, Qihe Liu*, Shuying Cheng, Shilin Qiu, Shijie Zhou
abstract: 视觉目标跟踪中的对抗攻击通过在图像中引入难以察觉的扰动,显著降低了先进跟踪器的性能。然而,针对目标跟踪设计对抗防御方法的研究仍显不足。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种有效的辅助预处理防御网络AADN,在将输入图像输入跟踪器之前对其进行防御性变换。此外,它可作为即插即用模块无缝集成到其他视觉跟踪器中,无需参数调整。我们通过对抗训练训练AADN,特别采用Dua-Loss生成对抗样本,同时攻击跟踪器的分类和回归分支。在OTB100、LaSOT和VOT2018基准上的大量实验表明,AADN在自适应和非自适应攻击场景下均表现出卓越的防御鲁棒性。此外,当将防御网络迁移到异构跟踪器时,其展现出可靠的迁移性。最后,AADN的处理时间高达5ms/帧,可无缝集成到现有高速跟踪器中,且不引入显著的计算开销。
abstract_en: Adversarial attacks in visual object tracking have significantly degraded the performance of advanced trackers by introducing imperceptible perturbations into images. However, there is still a lack of research on designing adversarial defense methods for object tracking. To address these issues, we propose an effective auxiliary pre-processing defense network, AADN, which performs defensive transformations on the input images before feeding them into the tracker. Moreover, it can be seamlessly integrated with other visual trackers as a plug-and-play module without parameter adjustments. We train AADN using adversarial training, specifically employing Dua-Loss to generate adversarial samples that simultaneously attack the classification and regression branches of the tracker. Extensive experiments conducted on the OTB100, LaSOT, and VOT2018 benchmarks demonstrate that AADN maintains excellent defense robustness against adversarial attack methods in both adaptive and non-adaptive attack scenarios. Moreover, when transferring the defense network to heterogeneous trackers, it exhibits reliable transferability. Finally, AADN achieves a processing time of up to 5ms/frame, allowing seamless integration with existing high-speed trackers without introducing significant computational overhead.

title: Zheyuan Zhou, Le Wang, Naiyu Fang, Zili Wang, Lemiao Qiu*, Shuyou Zhang
title_en: Zheyuan Zhou, Le Wang, Naiyu Fang, Zili Wang, Lemiao Qiu*, Shuyou Zhang
abstract: 三维异常检测在精密制造中对监测局部固有缺陷部件具有关键作用。基于嵌入和基于重建的方法是目前最受欢迎和成功的方法。然而,当前方法在实际应用中面临两大挑战:1)嵌入模型由于内存库结构导致计算和存储开销过大;2)基于MAE机制的重建模型无法检测未掩码区域的异常。本文提出R3D-AD,通过扩散模型重建异常点云以实现精确的三维异常检测。我们的方法利用扩散过程的数据分布转换,完全掩盖输入的异常几何结构。它逐步学习严格的点级位移行为,系统性地校正异常点。为提高模型的泛化能力,我们进一步提出一种新型三维异常模拟策略Patch-Gen,生成真实且多样的缺陷形状,缩小训练与测试之间的领域差距。我们的R3D-AD确保统一的空间变换,允许通过距离比较直接生成异常结果。大量实验表明,我们的R3D-AD优于先前的最先进方法,在Real3D-AD数据集上实现73.4%的图像级AUROC,在Anomaly-ShapeNet数据集上实现74.9%的图像级AUROC,且效率卓越。
abstract_en: 3D anomaly detection plays a crucial role in monitoring parts for localized inherent defects in precision manufacturing. Embedding-based and reconstruction-based approaches are among the most popular and successful methods. However, there are two major challenges to the practical application of the current approaches: 1) the embedded models suffer the prohibitive computational and storage due to the memory bank structure; 2) the reconstructive models based on the MAE mechanism fail to detect anomalies in the unmasked regions. In this paper, we propose R3D-AD, reconstructing anomalous point clouds by diffusion model for precise 3D anomaly detection. Our approach capitalizes on the data distribution conversion of the diffusion process to entirely obscure the input’s anomalous geometry. It step-wisely learns a strict point-level displacement behavior, which methodically corrects the aberrant points. To increase the generalization of the model, we further present a novel 3D anomaly simulation strategy named Patch-Gen to generate realistic and diverse defect shapes, which narrows the domain gap between training and testing. Our R3D-AD ensures a uniform spatial transformation, which allows straightforwardly generating anomaly results by distance comparison. Extensive experiments show that our R3D-AD outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods, achieving 73.4% Image-level AUROC on the Real3D-AD dataset and 74.9% Image-level AUROC on the Anomaly-ShapeNet dataset with an exceptional efficiency.

title: Zhi Cai, Yingjie Gao, Yaoyan Zheng, Nan Zhou, Di Huang*
title_en: Zhi Cai, Yingjie Gao, Yaoyan Zheng, Nan Zhou, Di Huang*
abstract: 目标检测是一项在多种场景中广泛应用的重要任务。通常,它需要大量标签进行训练,耗时较长,尤其是在拥挤场景中。最近,分割任何模型(SAM)作为一种强大的零样本分割器崭露头角,为实例分割提供了新方法。然而,SAM及其变体在处理存在遮挡的拥挤场景中的物体时,准确性和效率往往受到限制。本文提出Crowd-SAM,一个基于SAM的框架,旨在以少量可学习参数和最少标注图像的成本提升SAM在拥挤场景中的性能。我们引入了高效的提示采样器(EPS)和部分-整体判别网络(PWD-Net),促进掩码选择并提升拥挤场景中的准确性。尽管结构简单,Crowd-SAM在包括CrowdHuman和CityPersons在内的多个基准测试中与全监督目标检测方法表现相当。我们的代码可在https://github.com/FelixCaae/CrowdSAM获取。
abstract_en: Object detection is an important task that finds its application in a wide range of scenarios. Generally, it requires extensive labels for training, which is quite time-consuming, especially in crowded scenes. Recently, Segment Anything Model (SAM) has emerged as a powerful zero-shot segmenter, offering a novel approach to instance segmentation. However, the accuracy and efficiency of SAM and its variants are often compromised when handling objects in crowded scenes where occlusions often appear. In this paper, we propose Crowd-SAM, a SAM-based framework designed to enhance the performance of SAM in crowded scenes with the cost of few learnable parameters and minimal labeled images. We introduce an efficient prompt sampler (EPS) and a part-whole discrimination network (PWD-Net), facilitating mask selection and contributing to an improvement in accuracy in crowded scenes. Despite its simplicity, Crowd-SAM rivals state-of-the-art fully-supervised object detection methods on several benchmarks including CrowdHuman and CityPersons. Our code is available at https://github.com/FelixCaae/CrowdSAM.

title: Zhi Qin Tan*, Olga Isupova, Gustavo Carneiro, Xiatian Zhu, Yunpeng Li
title_en: Zhi Qin Tan*, Olga Isupova, Gustavo Carneiro, Xiatian Zhu, Yunpeng Li
abstract: 在不受约束的图像中获取细粒度目标检测标注是一项耗时、昂贵且易受噪声干扰的任务,尤其是在众包场景中。大多数现有目标检测方法假设标注准确;少数近期研究探讨了使用带有噪声的众包标注进行目标检测,但其评估基于不同设置下的人工假设合成众包数据集。为解决这些算法限制和评估不一致性,我们首先提出了一种新颖的贝叶斯检测器组合(BDC)框架,以更有效地利用带有噪声的众包标注训练目标检测器,并具备自动推断标注者标签质量的独特能力。与以往方法不同,BDC是模型无关的,无需标注者的技能水平先验知识,并能无缝集成到现有目标检测模型中。由于真实众包数据集稀缺,我们通过模拟不同众包场景引入了大规模合成数据集。这使得可以在大规模上对不同模型进行一致评估。在真实和合成众包数据集上的大量实验表明,BDC优于现有最先进的方法,证明了其在利用众包数据进行目标检测方面的优越性。我们的代码和数据可在:https://github.com/zhiqin1998/bdc 获取。
abstract_en: Acquiring fine-grained object detection annotations in unconstrained images is time-consuming, expensive, and prone to noise, especially in crowdsourcing scenarios. Most prior object detection methods assume accurate annotations; A few recent works have studied object detection with noisy crowdsourced annotations, with evaluation on distinct synthetic crowdsourced datasets of varying setups under artificial assumptions. To address these algorithmic limitations and evaluation inconsistency, we first propose a novel Bayesian Detector Combination (BDC) framework to more effectively train object detectors with noisy crowdsourced annotations, with the unique ability of automatically inferring the annotators’ label qualities. Unlike previous approaches, BDC is model-agnostic, requires no prior knowledge of the annotators’ skill level, and seamlessly integrates with existing object detection models. Due to the scarcity of real-world crowdsourced datasets, we introduce large synthetic datasets by simulating varying crowdsourcing scenarios. This allows consistent evaluation of different models at scale. Extensive experiments on both real and synthetic crowdsourced datasets show that BDC outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating its superiority in leveraging crowdsourced data for object detection. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/zhiqin1998/bdc.

title: Zhi-Fan Wu*, Lianghua Huang, Wei Wang, Yanheng Wei, Yu Liu
title_en: Zhi-Fan Wu*, Lianghua Huang, Wei Wang, Yanheng Wei, Yu Liu
abstract: 文本到图像生成领域近年来取得了显著进展,使得仅通过文本提示即可生成高质量图像。然而,仅凭文本准确描述物体具有挑战性,需要整合坐标和图像等额外模态信息以实现更精确的图像生成。现有方法通常需要微调或仅支持单个物体作为约束条件,使得从多物体多模态提示进行零样本图像生成仍是一个未解决的难题。本文提出MultiGen,一种新颖方法以解决该问题。给定图像-文本对,我们获取物体级文本、坐标和图像,并将信息整合为每个物体的“增强标记”。增强标记作为额外条件与文本提示共同训练扩散模型,使我们的模型能够处理多物体多模态提示。为应对推理过程中模态缺失的情况,我们利用坐标模型和特征模型,基于文本提示生成物体级坐标和特征。因此,我们的方法可从文本提示或多种多模态提示组合生成图像。通过大量定性和定量实验,我们证明该方法不仅优于现有方法,还支持广泛任务。
abstract_en: The field of text-to-image generation has witnessed substantial advancements in the preceding years, allowing the generation of high-quality images based solely on text prompts. However, accurately describing objects through text alone is challenging, necessitating the integration of additional modalities like coordinates and images for more precise image generation. Existing methods often require fine-tuning or only support using single object as the constraint, leaving the zero-shot image generation from multi-object multi-modal prompts as an unresolved challenge. In this paper, we propose MultiGen, a novel method designed to address this problem. Given an image-text pair, we obtain object-level text, coordinates and images, and integrate the information into an “augmented token” for each object. The augmented tokens serve as additional conditions and are trained alongside text prompts in the diffusion model, enabling our model to handle multi-object multi-modal prompts. To manage the absence of modalities during inference, we leverage a coordinate model and a feature model to generate object-level coordinates and features based on text prompts. Consequently, our method can generate images from text prompts alone or from various combinations of multi-modal prompts. Through extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments, we demonstrate that our method not only outperforms existing methods but also enables a wide range of tasks.

title: Zhide Zhong, Jiakai Cao, songen gu, Sirui Xie, Liyi Luo, Hao Zhao, Guyue Zhou, Haoang Li, Zike Yan*
title_en: Zhide Zhong, Jiakai Cao, songen gu, Sirui Xie, Liyi Luo, Hao Zhao, Guyue Zhou, Haoang Li, Zike Yan*
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于新颖层次化场景图结构的结构化神经辐射场(Structured-NeRF),用于室内场景表示。现有以物体为中心的方法仅关注物体的固有特性,而忽视了物体间的语义和物理关系。我们的场景图擅长管理场景中物体间的复杂现实关联,使功能超越新视角合成,例如场景重排。基于层次化结构,我们引入基于语义和物理关系的优化策略,从而简化场景编辑操作,确保效率与准确性。此外,我们对物体进行阴影渲染,进一步增强渲染图像的真实性。实验结果表明,我们的结构化表示不仅在物体级和场景级渲染中达到最先进(SOTA)性能,还与LLM/VLM联合推进下游应用,如自动和指令/图像条件的场景重排,从而便捷可控地扩展NeRF至交互式编辑。
abstract_en: We present Structured Neural Radiance Field (Structured-NeRF) for indoor scene representaion based on a novel hierarchical scene graph structure to organize the neural radiance field. Existing object-centric methods focus only on the inherent characteristics of objects, while overlooking the semantic and physical relationships between them. Our scene graph is adept at managing the complex real-world correlation between objects within a scene, enabling functionality beyond novel view synthesis, such as scene re-arrangement. Based on the hierarchical structure, we introduce the optimization strategy based on semantic and physical relationships, thus simplifying the operations involved in scene editing and ensuring both efficiency and accuracy. Moreover, we conduct shadow rendering on objects to further intensify the realism of the rendered images. Experimental results demonstrate our structured representation not only achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in object-level and scene-level rendering, but also advances downstream applications in union with LLM/VLM, such as automatic and instruction/image conditioned scene re-arrangement, thereby extending the NeRF to interactive editing conveniently and controllably.

title: Zhigao Cao, Meng Li, Xiashuang Wang, Haoyu Wang, Fan Wang, Youjun Li, Zigang Huang*
title_en: Zhigao Cao, Meng Li, Xiashuang Wang, Haoyu Wang, Fan Wang, Youjun Li, Zigang Huang*
abstract: 脉冲神经网络(SNNs)是一种具有能效的新型生物可合理化神经网络。然而,SNNs是不可微的,且训练内存成本随模拟步数增加而增加。为解决这些挑战,本文引入了一种受平衡模型启发的SNNs隐式训练方法。我们的方法依赖于多并行隐式流架构(MPIS-SNNs)。在前向过程中,MPIS-SNNs驱动多个融合的并行隐式流(ISs)同时达到平衡状态。在反向过程中,MPIS-SNNs仅依赖于单时间步的SNNs模拟,避免存储大量激活值。在N-MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集上的大量实验表明,MPIS-SNNs表现出低延迟、低内存成本、低发放率和快速收敛速度等优异特性,并在最新的SNNs高效训练方法中具有竞争力。我们的代码可在匿名化的GitHub仓库中获取:https://github.com/kiritozc/MPIS-SNNs。
abstract_en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) are a novel type of bio-plausible neural network with energy efficiency. However, SNNs are non-differentiable and the training memory costs increase with the number of simulation steps. To address these challenges, this work introduces an implicit training method for SNNs inspired by equilibrium models. Our method relies on the multi-parallel implicit stream architecture (MPIS-SNNs). In the forward process, MPIS-SNNs drive multiple fused parallel implicit streams (ISs) to reach equilibrium state simultaneously. In the backward process, MPIS-SNNs solely rely on a single-time-step simulation of SNNs, avoiding the storage of a large number of activations. Extensive experiments on N-MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 demonstrate that MPIS-SNNs exhibit excellent characteristics such as low latency, low memory cost, low firing rates, and fast convergence speed, and are competitive among latest efficient training methods for SNNs. Our code is available at an anonymized GitHub repository: https://github.com/kiritozc/MPIS-SNNs.

title: Zhihang Lin, Mingbao Lin, Meng Zhao, Rongrong Ji*
title_en: Zhihang Lin, Mingbao Lin, Meng Zhao, Rongrong Ji*
abstract: 本文旨在解决基于补丁的高分辨率图像生成中的物体重复问题。我们提出AccDiffusion,一种无需训练的准确方法用于基于补丁的高分辨率图像生成。本文深入分析表明,相同文本提示对不同补丁会导致重复物体生成,而无提示则会损害图像细节。因此,AccDiffusion首次提出将原始图像内容感知提示解耦为一组补丁内容感知提示,每个提示作为对图像补丁的更精确描述。此外,AccDiffusion还引入扩张采样与窗口交互机制,以提升高分辨率图像生成的全局一致性。与现有方法的实验对比表明,AccDiffusion有效解决了物体重复生成问题,并在高分辨率图像生成中取得更好性能。我们的代码已发布于https://github.com/lzhxmu/AccDiffusion。
abstract_en: This paper attempts to address the object repetition issue in patch-wise higher-resolution image generation. We propose AccDiffusion, an accurate method for patch-wise higher-resolution image generation without training. An in-depth analysis in this paper reveals an identical text prompt for different patches causes repeated object generation, while no prompt compromises the image details. Therefore, our AccDiffusion, for the first time, proposes to decouple the vanilla image-content-aware prompt into a set of patch-content-aware prompts, each of which serves as a more precise description of an image patch. Besides, AccDiffusion also introduces dilated sampling with window interaction for better global consistency in higher-resolution image generation. Experimental comparison with existing methods demonstrates that our AccDiffusion effectively addresses the issue of repeated object generation and leads to better performance in higher-resolution image generation. Our code is released at https://github. com/lzhxmu/AccDiffusion.

title: Zhihang Zhong, Gurunandan Krishnan, Xiao Sun, Yu Qiao, Sizhuo Ma*, Jian Wang*
title_en: Zhihang Zhong, Gurunandan Krishnan, Xiao Sun, Yu Qiao, Sizhuo Ma*, Jian Wang*
abstract: 现有的视频帧插值(VFI)方法盲目地预测每个物体在特定时间步t的位置(“时间索引”),难以准确预测物体运动轨迹。给定两张棒球图像,存在无限多可能的运动轨迹:加速或减速、直线或曲线。这通常导致插值帧模糊,因为方法会平均这些可能性。与迫使网络隐式学习复杂的时间-位置映射并同时预测帧不同,我们为网络提供了一个显式的提示,即物体在起始帧和结束帧之间移动的距离,这一新方法称为“距离索引”。该方法为模型提供了更清晰的学习目标,降低了与物体速度相关的不确定性。我们进一步观察到,即使有此额外指导,当物体等距位于输入帧之间(如中间位置)时,仍可能因长距离运动中的方向歧义导致模糊。为解决此问题,我们提出了一种迭代的基于参考的估计策略,将长距离预测分解为多个短距离步骤。当将我们的即插即用策略集成到最先进的学习模型中时,使用与时间索引相同格式的统一距离索引图,在任意时间插值中表现出显著更清晰的输出和优越的感知质量。此外,距离索引可逐像素指定,使每个物体的时序操作独立进行,为视频编辑任务(如重新定时)提供了新的工具。代码可在https://zzh-tech.github.io/InterpAny-Clearer/获取。
abstract_en: Existing video frame interpolation (VFI) methods blindly predict where each object is at a specific timestep t (“time indexing”), which struggles to predict precise object movements. Given two images of a baseball, there are infinitely many possible trajectories: accelerating or decelerating, straight or curved. This often results in blurry frames as the method averages out these possibilities. Instead of forcing the network to learn this complicated time-to-location mapping implicitly together with predicting the frames, we provide the network with an explicit hint on how far the object has traveled between start and end frames, a novel approach termed “distance indexing”. This method offers a clearer learning goal for models, reducing the uncertainty tied to object speeds. We further observed that, even with this extra guidance, objects can still be blurry especially when they are equally far from both input frames (, halfway in-between), due to the directional ambiguity in long-range motion. To solve this, we propose an iterative reference-based estimation strategy that breaks down a long-range prediction into several short-range steps. When integrating our plug-and-play strategies into state-of-the-art learning-based models, they exhibit markedly sharper outputs and superior perceptual quality in arbitrary time interpolations, using a uniform distance indexing map in the same format as time indexing. Additionally, distance indexing can be specified pixel-wise, which enables temporal manipulation of each object independently, offering a novel tool for video editing tasks like re-timing. The code is available at https://zzh-tech.github.io/InterpAny-Clearer/.

title: Zhihao Li*, Biao Hou, Siteng Ma, Zitong Wu, Xianpeng Guo, Bo Ren, Licheng Jiao
title_en: Zhihao Li*, Biao Hou, Siteng Ma, zitong wu, Xianpeng Guo, bo ren, Licheng Jiao
abstract: 为克服遥感(RS)图像与自然图像之间的固有领域差异,一些自监督表征学习方法取得了 promising 进展。然而,这些方法忽略了遥感目标存在的多角度特性。本文提出掩码角度感知自编码器(MA3E),在预训练过程中感知并学习角度信息。我们设计了一种缩放中心裁剪操作,在每张原始图像上随机生成旋转裁剪,引入显式的角度变化。MA3E输入该组合图像并重建原始图像,旨在通过恢复旋转裁剪中引入的角度变化,有效学习旋转不变的表征。为避免直接重建旋转裁剪导致的偏差,我们提出最优传输(OT)损失,自动将相似的原始图像块分配给每个旋转裁剪块进行重建。MA3E1在三个下游任务的七个不同RS图像数据集上均展现出优于现有预训练方法的性能。1 我们的代码将在:https://github.com/benesakitam/MA3E 发布
abstract_en: To overcome the inherent domain gap between remote sensing (RS) images and natural images, some self-supervised representation learning methods have made promising progress. However, they have overlooked the diverse angles present in RS objects. This paper proposes the Masked Angle-Aware Autoencoder (MA3E) to perceive and learn angles during pre-training. We design a scaling center crop operation to create the rotated crop with random orientation on each original image, introducing the explicit angle variation. MA3E inputs this composite image while reconstruct the original image, aiming to effectively learn rotation-invariant representations by restoring the angle variation introduced on the rotated crop. To avoid biases caused by directly reconstructing the rotated crop, we propose an Optimal Transport (OT) loss that automatically assigns similar original image patches to each rotated crop patch for reconstruction. MA3E1 demonstrates more competitive performance than existing pre-training methods on seven different RS image datasets in three downstream tasks. 1 Our code will be released at: https://github.com/benesakitam/MA3E

title: Zhihao Liang*, Qi Zhang*, Wenbo Hu, Ying Feng, Lei ZHU, Kui Jia*
title_en: Zhihao Liang*, Qi Zhang*, Wenbo Hu, Ying Feng, Lei ZHU, Kui Jia*
abstract: 三维高斯点云(3DGS)通过结合基于基础体素和体素化的三维表示的优势,最近在三维场景渲染中获得了流行,从而提高了质量和效率。然而,3DGS并非无锯齿,当在不同分辨率下渲染时仍会产生严重的模糊或锯齿现象,这是因为所采用的离散采样方案将每个像素视为孤立的单点,对像素足迹的变化不敏感且受限于采样带宽。在本文中,我们使用条件逻辑函数作为高斯信号累积分布函数(CDF)的解析近似,并通过减去CDF来计算积分。我们将这种近似应用于二维像素着色,并提出Analytic-Splatting,该方法在二维像素窗口区域内解析近似高斯积分,以更好地捕捉每个像素的强度响应。随后,我们利用像素窗口积分区域的近似响应参与体积渲染的透射率计算,使Analytic-Splatting对不同分辨率下像素足迹的变化更加敏感。在各种数据集上的大量实验验证了我们的方法具有更好的抗锯齿能力,能够呈现更多细节和更高的保真度。
abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) recently gained popularity by combining the advantages of both primitive-based and volumetric 3D representations, resulting in improved quality and efficiency for 3D scene rendering. However, 3DGS is not alias-free and still produces severe blurring or jaggies when rendered at varying resolutions because the discrete sampling scheme used treats each pixel as an isolated single point, which is insensitive to changes in the footprints of pixels and is restricted in sampling bandwidth. In this paper, we use a conditioned logistic function as the analytic approximation of the cumulative distribution function (CDF) of the Gaussian signal and calculate the integral by subtracting the CDFs. We introduce this approximation to two-dimensional pixel shading and present Analytic-Splatting, which analytically approximates the Gaussian integral within the 2D-pixel window area to better capture the intensity response of each pixel. Then, we use the approximated response of the pixel window integral area to participate in the transmittance calculation of volume rendering, making Analytic-Splatting sensitive to the changes in pixel footprint at different resolutions. Extensive experiments on various datasets validate that our approach has better anti-aliasing capability that gives more details and better fidelity.

title: Sun Zhihao, Wang Ziwei, Liu Hongmin, Zhou Jie, Lu Jiwen*, Xu Xiuwei*
title_en: Zhihao Sun, Ziwei Wang, Hongmin Liu, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu*, Xiuwei Xu*
abstract: 本文提出了一种用于3D小物体检测的高效特征剪枝策略。传统3D物体检测方法由于小数量点提供的几何信息较弱,在小物体检测上存在困难。尽管提高特征表示的空间分辨率可以提升小物体检测性能,但额外的计算开销难以承受。通过深入研究,我们观察到计算量的增长主要来自于3D检测器解码器中的上采样操作。受此启发,我们提出了一种多级3D检测器DSPDet3D,该检测器通过高空间分辨率实现小物体检测的高精度,同时仅关注小物体区域以减少冗余计算。具体而言,我们理论推导出一种动态空间剪枝(DSP)策略,根据物体分布以级联方式剪枝3D场景的冗余空间表示。随后,我们按照该策略设计DSP模块,并构建了高效的DSPDet3D检测器。在ScanNet和TO-SCENE数据集上,我们的方法在小物体检测中取得了领先性能。此外,仅使用ScanNet房间训练的DSPDet3D能够很好地泛化到更大尺度的场景。在单块RTX 3090 GPU上,该方法处理包含超过450万点的整栋建筑仅需不到2秒,即可检测出从杯子到床等几乎所有物体。Code.
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose an efficient feature pruning strategy for 3D small object detection. Conventional 3D object detection methods struggle on small objects due to the weak geometric information from a small number of points. Although increasing the spatial resolution of feature representations can improve the detection performance on small objects, the additional computational overhead is unaffordable. With in-depth study, we observe the growth of computation mainly comes from the upsampling operation in the decoder of 3D detector. Motivated by this, we present a multi-level 3D detector named DSPDet3D which benefits from high spatial resolution to achieves high accuracy on small object detection, while reducing redundant computation by only focusing on small object areas. Specifically, we theoretically derive a dynamic spatial pruning (DSP) strategy to prune the redundant spatial representation of 3D scene in a cascade manner according to the distribution of objects. Then we design DSP module following this strategy and construct DSPDet3D with this efficient module. On ScanNet and TO-SCENE dataset, our method achieves leading performance on small object detection. Moreover, DSPDet3D trained with only ScanNet rooms can generalize well to scenes in larger scale. It takes less than 2s to directly process a whole building consisting of more than 4500k points while detecting out almost all objects, ranging from cups to beds, on a single RTX 3090 GPU. Code.

title: Zhihao Xu, Shengjie Gong, Jiapeng Tang, Lingyu Liang, Yining Huang, Haojie Li, Shuangping Huang*
title_en: Zhihao Xu, Shengjie Gong, Jiapeng Tang, Lingyu Liang, Yining Huang, Haojie Li, Shuangping Huang*
abstract: We present a novel approach for synthesizing 3D facial motions from audio sequences using key motion embeddings. Despite recent advancements in data-driven techniques, accurately mapping between audio signals and 3D facial meshes remains challenging. Direct regression of the entire sequence often leads to over-smoothed results due to the ill-posed nature of the problem. To this end, we propose a progressive learning mechanism that generates 3D facial animations by introducing key motion capture to decrease cross-modal mapping uncertainty and learning complexity. Concretely, our method integrates linguistic and data-driven priors through two modules: the linguistic-based key motion acquisition and the cross-modal motion completion. The former identifies key motions and learns the associated 3D facial expressions, ensuring accurate lip-speech synchronization. The latter extends key motions into a full sequence of 3D talking faces guided by audio features, improving temporal coherence and audio-visual consistency. Extensive experimental comparisons against existing state-of-the-art methods demonstrate the superiority of our approach in generating more vivid and consistent talking face animations. Consistent enhancements in results through the integration of our proposed learning scheme with existing methods underscore the efficacy of our approach.
abstract_en: We present a novel approach for synthesizing 3D facial motions from audio sequences using key motion embeddings. Despite recent advancements in data-driven techniques, accurately mapping between audio signals and 3D facial meshes remains challenging. Direct regression of the entire sequence often leads to over-smoothed results due to the ill-posed nature of the problem. To this end, we propose a progressive learning mechanism that generates 3D facial animations by introducing key motion capture to decrease cross-modal mapping uncertainty and learning complexity. Concretely, our method integrates linguistic and data-driven priors through two modules: the linguistic-based key motion acquisition and the cross-modal motion completion. The former identifies key motions and learns the associated 3D facial expressions, ensuring accurate lip-speech synchronization. The latter extends key motions into a full sequence of 3D talking faces guided by audio features, improving temporal coherence and audio-visual consistency. Extensive experimental comparisons against existing state-of-the-art methods demonstrate the superiority of our approach in generating more vivid and consistent talking face animations. Consistent enhancements in results through the integration of our proposed learning scheme with existing methods underscore the efficacy of our approach.

title: Zhiheng Fu, Longguang Wang, Lian Xu, Zhiyong Wang, Hamid Laga, Yulan Guo*, Farid Boussaid, Mohammed Bennamoun
title_en: Zhiheng Fu, Longguang Wang, Lian Xu, Zhiyong Wang, Hamid Laga, Yulan Guo*, Farid Boussaid, Mohammed Bennamoun
abstract: 点云补全涉及从不完整点云数据中推断3D物体缺失的部分。这需要一种能够理解物体全局结构并重建局部细节的模型。为此,我们提出了一种全局感知与局部注意力网络,称为AEDNet,用于点云补全。所提出的AEDNet在编码器和解码器中均采用设计的自适应点云嵌入与解耦(AED)模块,以全局嵌入和局部解耦给定的点云。在AED模块中,我们引入了一种全局嵌入操作,利用设计的slot attention将点云组合成不同的嵌入,每个嵌入专注于3D物体的特定部分。随后,我们提出了一种多视角感知的解耦操作,以在单位球面上生成的3D视角中从这些嵌入中解耦几何信息。这些3D视角使我们能够从外部而非内部观察点云,从而实现对其几何结构的全面理解。此外,通过改变视角数量,可以解耦任意数量的点及其特征,达到高度灵活性。实验表明,我们的方法在MVP和PCN数据集上均取得了最先进的结果。
abstract_en: Point cloud completion involves inferring missing parts of 3D objects from incomplete point cloud data. It requires a model that understands the global structure of the object and reconstructs local details. To this end, we propose a global perception and local attention network, termed AEDNet, for point cloud completion. The proposed AEDNet utilizes designed adaptive point cloud embedding and disentanglement (AED) module in both the encoder and decoder to globally embed and locally disentangle the given point cloud. In the AED module, we introduce a global embedding operator that employs the devised slot attention to compose point clouds into different embeddings, each focusing on specific parts of 3D objects. Then, we proposed a multiview-aware disentanglement operator to disentangle geometric information from those embeddings in the 3D viewpoints generated on a unit sphere. These 3D viewpoints enable us to observe point clouds from the outside rather than from within, resulting in a comprehensive understanding of their geometry. Additionally, the arbitrary number of points and point-wise features can be disentangled by changing the number of viewpoints, reaching high flexibility. Experiments show that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art results on both MVP and PCN datasets.

title: 李智恒, 李慕恒, 范继轩, 陈磊*, 唐彦松, 卢继文, 周杰
title_en: Zhiheng Li, Muheng Li, Jixuan Fan, Lei Chen*, Yansong Tang, Jiwen Lu, Jie Zhou
abstract: 基于隐式图像函数的任意尺度超分辨率技术因其能以连续方式更好地表示视觉世界而日益流行。然而,现有任意尺度工作均在模拟数据集上进行训练和评估,其中低分辨率图像通过最简单的双三次下采样从其真实图像生成。这些模型由于现实世界退化更复杂而表现出对现实场景的泛化能力有限。为解决此问题,我们构建了一个名为RealArbiSR的新现实世界超分辨率基准数据集,该数据集包含整数和非整数缩放因子,用于现实世界任意尺度超分辨率的训练和评估。此外,我们提出了一种双级可变形隐式表示(DDIR)来解决现实世界任意尺度超分辨率问题。具体而言,我们设计了外观嵌入和形变场以处理由现实世界退化引起的图像级和像素级形变。外观嵌入建模低分辨率输入的特征以处理不同尺度下的光度变化,而基于像素的形变场学习由现实世界与模拟退化偏差在任意坐标产生的RGB差异。大量实验表明,我们的训练模型在RealArbiSR和RealSR基准上实现了现实世界任意尺度超分辨率的最先进性能。数据集和代码可在https://github.com/nonozhizhiovo/RealArbiSR获取。
abstract_en: Scale arbitrary super-resolution based on implicit image function gains increasing popularity since it can better represent the visual world in a continuous manner. However, existing scale arbitrary works are trained and evaluated on simulated datasets, where low-resolution images are generated from their ground truths by the simplest bicubic downsampling. These models exhibit limited generalization to real-world scenarios due to the greater complexity of real-world degradations. To address this issue, we build a RealArbiSR dataset, a new real-world super-resolution benchmark with both integer and non-integer scaling factors fo the training and evaluation of real-world scale arbitrary super-resolution. Moreover, we propose a Dual-level Deformable Implicit Representation (DDIR) to solve real-world scale arbitrary super-resolution. Specifically, we design the appearance embedding and deformation field to handle both image-level and pixel-level deformations caused by real-world degradations. The appearance embedding models the characteristics of low-resolution inputs to deal with photometric variations at different scales, and the pixel-based deformation field learns RGB differences which result from the deviations between the real-world and simulated degradations at arbitrary coordinates. Extensive experiments show our trained model achieves state-of-the-art performance on the RealArbiSR and RealSR benchmarks for real-world scale arbitrary super-resolution. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/nonozhizhiovo/RealArbiSR.

title: Zhijian Huang, Tao Tang, Shaoxiang Chen, Sihao Lin, Zequn Jie, Lin Ma, Guangrun Wang, Xiaodan Liang*
title_en: Zhijian Huang, Tao Tang, Shaoxiang Chen, Sihao Lin, Zequn Jie, Lin Ma, Guangrun Wang, Xiaodan Liang*
abstract: 数据驱动方法在自动驾驶(AD)领域已广泛应用,但面临数据集偏差和不可解释性问题。受人类驾驶知识驱动特性的启发,近期研究探索了大语言模型(LLMs)在提升交通场景理解和决策能力方面的潜力。他们发现,通过在下游数据上采用包含思维链(CoT)推理过程的预训练-微调范式,可增强模型的可解释性和场景理解能力。然而,这种流行策略暴露出推理链与后续决策之间存在严重错位的问题,而此前基于LLM的AD方法对此尚未涉及。为解决该问题,我们提出了一种基于多模态增强LLM的端到端决策模型,该模型同时执行CoT推理并输出规划结果。此外,我们提出了一种推理-决策对齐约束,建立配对的CoT与规划结果之间的对应关系。同时,我们重新设计了CoT以使模型能够理解复杂场景并提升决策性能。我们将这种具有推理-决策对齐特性的大语言规划器命名为__TITLE_MATH_1__。在nuScenes和DriveLM-nuScenes基准上的实验评估证明了我们的方法在提升端到端AD系统性能方面的有效性。具体而言,我们的方法在nuScenes数据集上实现了0.80 L2误差和0.32碰撞率的规划性能,同时在具有挑战性的DriveLM-nuScenes基准上也取得了0.82 L2误差和0.38碰撞率的领先结果。
abstract_en: Data-driven approaches for autonomous driving (AD) have been widely adopted in the past decade but are confronted with dataset bias and uninterpretability. Inspired by the knowledge-driven nature of human driving, recent approaches explore the potential of large language models (LLMs) to improve understanding and decision-making in traffic scenarios. They find that the pretrain-finetune paradigm of LLMs on downstream data with the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning process can enhance explainability and scene understanding. However, such a popular strategy proves to suffer from the notorious problems of misalignment between the crafted CoTs against the consequent decision-making, which remains untouched by previous LLM-based AD methods. To address this problem, we motivate an end-to-end decision-making model based on multimodality-augmented LLM, which simultaneously executes CoT reasoning and carries out planning results. Furthermore, we propose a reasoning-decision alignment constraint between the paired CoTs and planning results, imposing the correspondence between reasoning and decision-making. Moreover, we redesign the CoTs to enable the model to comprehend complex scenarios and enhance decision-making performance. We dub our proposed large language planners with reasoning-decision alignment as . Experimental evaluations on the nuScenes and DriveLM-nuScenes benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our in enhancing the performance of end-to-end AD systems. Specifically, our achieves state-of-the-art planning performance on the nuScenes dataset with 0.80 L2 error and 0.32 collision rate, and also achieves leading results on challenging DriveLM-nuScenes benchmarks with 0.82 L2 error and 0.38 collision rate.

title: Zhijian Liu, Zhuoyang Zhang, Samir Khaki, Shang Yang, Haotian Tang, Chenfeng Xu, Kurt Keutzer, Song Han*
title_en: Zhijian Liu, Zhuoyang Zhang, Samir Khaki, Shang Yang, Haotian Tang, Chenfeng Xu, Kurt Keutzer, Song Han*
abstract: 语义分割赋能众多现实应用场景,如自动驾驶和增强/混合现实。这些应用通常在高分辨率图像(如8兆像素)上运行以捕捉细节。然而,这带来了显著的计算复杂性,阻碍了在延迟敏感场景中的部署。本文提出SparseRefine,一种新颖方法,通过稀疏高分辨率细化来增强密集低分辨率预测。基于粗略低分辨率输出,SparseRefine首先使用熵选择器识别具有高熵的稀疏像素集。随后,它利用稀疏特征提取器高效生成这些感兴趣像素的细化结果。最后,通过门控集成器将这些稀疏细化应用于初始粗略预测。SparseRefine可无缝集成到任何现有语义分割模型中,无论基于CNN还是ViT。在Cityscapes数据集上,当应用于HRNet-W48、SegFormer-B5、Mask2Former-T/L和SegNeXt-L时,SparseRefine实现了显著加速(1.5到3.7倍),且准确率损失可忽略或为零。我们的“密集+稀疏”范式为高效高分辨率视觉计算铺平了道路。
abstract_en: Semantic segmentation empowers numerous real-world applications, such as autonomous driving and augmented/mixed reality. These applications often operate on high-resolution images (, 8 megapixels) to capture the fine details. However, this comes at the cost of considerable computational complexity, hindering the deployment in latency-sensitive scenarios. In this paper, we introduce SparseRefine, a novel approach that enhances dense low-resolution predictions with sparse high-resolution refinements. Based on coarse low-resolution outputs, SparseRefine first uses an entropy selector to identify a sparse set of pixels with high entropy. It then employs a sparse feature extractor to efficiently generate the refinements for those pixels of interest. Finally, it leverages a gated ensembler to apply these sparse refinements to the initial coarse predictions. SparseRefine can be seamlessly integrated into any existing semantic segmentation model, regardless of CNN- or ViT-based. SparseRefine achieves significant speedup: 1.5 to 3.7 times when applied to HRNet-W48, SegFormer-B5, Mask2Former-T/L and SegNeXt-L on Cityscapes, with negligible to no loss of accuracy. Our “dense+sparse” paradigm paves the way for efficient high-resolution visual computing.

title: Zhijing Sun, Xueyang Fu, Longzhuo Huang, Aiping Liu, Zheng-Jun Zha*
title_en: Zhijing Sun, Xueyang Fu, Longzhuo Huang, Aiping Liu, Zheng-Jun Zha*
abstract: 传统图像去模糊方法由于单张模糊图像提供的运动数据有限,难以实现高质量重建。令人振奋的是,事件相机的高时间分辨率以不同模态记录运动信息,从而革新了图像去模糊技术。然而,许多基于事件相机的方法仅关注极性累积的最终值,忽视了事件生成时绝对强度变化的影响,导致在感知运动模式和有效辅助图像重建方面存在不足。为解决这一问题,本文提出了一种新的事件预处理技术,每次事件更新时均累计其与初始时刻的偏差。该过程能够区分事件顺序,提升对物体运动模式的感知能力。为补充所提出的事件表示,我们设计了一个循环模块,旨在细致提取局部和全局时间尺度上的运动特征。为进一步促进事件特征与图像特征的融合,从而辅助图像重建,我们开发了双向特征对齐与融合模块。该模块旨在减少跨模态不一致性。我们的方法已在多个分布不同的数据集上进行了严格实验验证。实验结果表明,该方法在定量和定性评估中均取得了顶尖性能。代码已开源至 https://github.com/ZhijingS/DA event deblur。
abstract_en: Traditional image deblurring struggles with high-quality reconstruction due to limited motion data from single blurred images. Excitingly, the high-temporal resolution of event cameras records motion more precisely in a different modality, transforming image deblurring. However, many event camera-based methods, which only care about the final value of the polarity accumulation, ignore the influence of the absolute intensity change where events generate so fall short in perceiving motion patterns and effectively aiding image reconstruction. To overcome this, in this work, we propose a new event preprocessing technique that accumulates the deviation from the initial moment each time the event is updated. This process can distinguish the order of events to improve the perception of object motion patterns. To complement our proposed event representation, we create a recurrent module designed to meticulously extract motion features across local and global time scales. To further facilitate the event feature and image feature integration, which assists in image reconstruction, we develop a bi-directional feature alignment and fusion module. This module works to lessen inter-modal inconsistencies. Our approach has been thoroughly tested through rigorous experiments carried out on several datasets with different distributions. These trials have delivered promising results, with our method achieving top-tier performance in both quantitative and qualitative assessments. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhijingS/DA event deblur.

title: Zhikai Zhang, Yitang Li, Haofeng Huang, Mingxian Lin, Li Yi*
title_en: Zhikai Zhang, Yitang Li, Haofeng Huang, Mingxian Lin, Li Yi*
abstract: 人体运动合成是计算机动画中的基础任务。尽管该领域近期利用深度学习和动作捕捉数据取得了进展,但现有方法始终局限于特定的运动类别、环境和风格。这种较差的泛化能力部分归因于收集大规模高质量运动数据的困难和高昂成本。同时,基于互联网规模图像和文本数据训练的基础模型在多种下游任务中展现出惊人的世界知识和推理能力。利用这些基础模型可能有助于人体运动合成,一些近期工作已初步探索这一方向。然而,这些方法未能充分揭示基础模型在该任务中的潜力,且仅支持几种简单动作和环境。本文首次无需任何运动数据,基于大规模语言模型(MLLMs),通过自然语言指令作为用户控制信号,探索开放集人体运动合成,适用于任何运动任务和环境。我们的框架可分为两个阶段:1)利用MLLMs作为关键帧设计师和动画师进行序列关键帧生成;2)通过插值和运动跟踪在关键帧间进行运动填充。我们的方法可实现多种下游任务的通用人体运动合成。有前景的结果证明了无需动作捕捉数据的人体运动合成借助MLLMs的价值,并为未来研究开辟了道路。
abstract_en: Human motion synthesis is a fundamental task in computer animation. Despite recent progress in this field utilizing deep learning and motion capture data, existing methods are always limited to specific motion categories, environments, and styles. This poor generalizability can be partially attributed to the difficulty and expense of collecting large-scale and high-quality motion data. At the same time, foundation models trained with internet-scale image and text data have demonstrated surprising world knowledge and reasoning ability for various downstream tasks. Utilizing these foundation models may help with human motion synthesis, which some recent works have superficially explored. However, these methods didn’t fully unveil the foundation models’ potential for this task and only support several simple actions and environments. In this paper, we for the first time, without any motion data, explore open-set human motion synthesis using natural language instructions as user control signals based on MLLMs across any motion task and environment. Our framework can be split into two stages: 1) sequential keyframe generation by utilizing MLLMs as a keyframe designer and animator; 2) motion filling between keyframes through interpolation and motion tracking. Our method can achieve general human motion synthesis for many downstream tasks. The promising results demonstrate the worth of mocap-free human motion synthesis aided by MLLMs and pave the way for future research.

title: Zhili Chen, Maosheng Ye, Shuangjie Xu, Tongyi Cao, Qifeng Chen*
title_en: Zhili Chen, Maosheng Ye, Shuangjie Xu, Tongyi Cao, Qifeng Chen*
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的预测与规划交互机制用于端到端自动驾驶,称为PPAD(预测与规划自主驾驶的迭代交互),该机制通过时间步级交互更好地融合预测与规划。本车在每个时间步基于周围代理(如车辆和行人)的轨迹预测及其局部道路状况执行运动规划。与现有端到端自动驾驶框架不同,PPAD通过在每个时间步交错预测与规划过程,以自回归方式建模本车、代理和动态环境之间的交互,而非先预测后规划的单一顺序流程。具体而言,我们设计了本车到代理、本车到地图以及本车到鸟瞰图(BEV)的交互机制,并采用分层动态关键对象注意力机制以更精确建模交互关系。在nuScenes基准测试中的实验表明,我们的方法优于现有最先进的方法。项目页面:https://github.com/zlichen/PPAD
abstract_en: We present a new interaction mechanism of prediction and planning for end-to-end autonomous driving, called PPAD (Iterative Interaction of Prediction and Planning Autonomous Driving), which considers the timestep-wise interaction to better integrate prediction and planning. An ego vehicle performs motion planning at each timestep based on the trajectory prediction of surrounding agents (e.g., vehicles and pedestrians) and its local road conditions. Unlike existing end-to-end autonomous driving frameworks, PPAD models the interactions among ego, agents, and the dynamic environment in an autoregressive manner by interleaving the Prediction and Planning processes at every timestep, instead of a single sequential process of prediction followed by planning. Specifically, we design ego-to-agent, ego-to-map, and ego-to-BEV interaction mechanisms with hierarchical dynamic key objects attention to better model the interactions. The experiments on the nuScenes benchmark show that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Project page at https://github.com/zlichen/PPAD.

title: 陈志利,徐双杰,叶茂生,钱子安,邹晓毅,杨迪安,陈启峰*
title_en: Zhili Chen, Shuangjie Xu, Maosheng Ye, Zian Qian, Xiaoyi Zou, Dit-Yan Yeung, Qifeng Chen*
abstract: 鸟眼视图(BEV)表示是直接影响三维目标检测性能的关键因素,但传统的BEV网格表示会导致空间分辨率增加时产生二次计算成本。为解决这一限制,我们提出了一种基于摄像头的高分辨率向量表示三维目标检测器:VectorFormer。所提出的高分辨率向量表示与低分辨率BEV表示相结合,通过我们提出的两个新模块:向量散射和汇聚,高效地从多摄像头图像中提取高分辨率的三维几何信息。为此,学习到的富含场景上下文的向量表示可作为最终预测的解码查询。我们在nuScenes数据集上进行了大量实验,展示了在NDS和推理时间上的最先进性能。此外,我们研究了结合所提出向量表示的查询-BEV方法,并观察到性能的持续提升。项目页面:https://github.com/zlichen/VectorFormer
abstract_en: The Bird’s-Eye-View (BEV) representation is a critical factor that directly impacts the 3D object detection performance, but the traditional BEV grid representation induces quadratic computational cost as the spatial resolution grows. To address this limitation, we present a new camera-based 3D object detector with high-resolution vector representation: VectorFormer. The presented high-resolution vector representation is combined with the lower-resolution BEV representation to efficiently exploit 3D geometry from multi-camera images at a high resolution through our two novel modules: vector scattering and gathering. To this end, the learned vector representation with richer scene contexts can serve as the decoding query for final predictions. We conduct extensive experiments on the nuScenes dataset and demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in NDS and inference time. Furthermore, we investigate query-BEV-based methods incorporated with our proposed vector representation and observe a consistent performance improvement. Project page at https://github.com/ zlichen/VectorFormer.

title: Zhili Liu*, Kai Chen, Yifan Zhang, Jianhua Han, Lanqing Hong, Hang Xu, Zhenguo Li, Dit-Yan Yeung, James Kwok
title_en: Zhili Liu*, Kai Chen, Yifan Zhang, Jianhua Han, Lanqing Hong, Hang Xu, Zhenguo Li, Dit-Yan Yeung, James Kwok
abstract: 文本到图像(T2I)扩散模型常常无意中生成水印、不安全图像等不需要的概念。这些概念被称为“隐式概念”,可能在训练过程中被无意学习,并在推理阶段不可控地生成。现有去除方法仍难以有效消除隐式概念,主要原因是其依赖模型识别其实际无法辨识的概念的能力。为解决这一问题,我们利用隐式概念的内在几何特性,提出了一种基于几何驱动控制的新概念去除方法。具体而言,一旦识别出不需要的隐式概念,我们借助可访问的分类器或检测模型,将概念的存在及其几何信息整合到文本提示中。随后,模型被优化以识别并分离该信息,并在生成过程中采用为负提示。此外,我们引入了隐式概念数据集(ICD),这是一个包含三种典型隐式概念(二维码、水印和文本)的新型图像-文本数据集,反映了隐式概念容易被注入的真实场景。该方法有效缓解了隐式概念的生成,在不适当图像提示(I2P)和我们挑战性的隐式概念数据集(ICD)基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。
abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models often inadvertently generate unwanted concepts such as watermarks and unsafe images. These concepts, termed “implicit concepts”, can be unintentionally learned during training and then be generated uncontrollably during inference. Existing removal methods still struggle to eliminate implicit concepts primarily due to their dependency on the model’s ability to recognize concepts it actually can not discern. To address this, we utilize the intrinsic geometric characteristics of implicit concepts and present , a novel concept removal method based on geometric-driven control. Specifically, once an unwanted implicit concept is identified, we integrate the existence and geometric information of the concept into the text prompts with the help of an accessible classifier or detector model. Subsequently, the model is optimized to identify and disentangle this information, which is then adopted as negative prompts during generation. Moreover, we introduce the Implicit Concept Dataset (ICD), a novel image-text dataset imbued with three typical implicit concepts (QR codes, watermarks, and text), reflecting real-life situations where implicit concepts are easily injected. effectively mitigates the generation of implicit concepts, achieving state-of-the-art results on the Inappropriate Image Prompts (I2P) and our challenging Implicit Concept Dataset (ICD) benchmarks.

title: Zhilin Zhu*, Xiaopeng Hong*, Zhiheng Ma, Weijun Zhuang, YaoHui Ma, Yong Dai, Yaowei Wang
title_en: Zhilin Zhu*, Xiaopeng Hong*, Zhiheng Ma, Weijun Zhuang, YaoHui Ma, Yong Dai, Yaowei Wang
abstract: 持续测试时适应(CTTA)涉及将预训练的源模型适应于不断变化的无监督目标域。本文系统分析了该任务的挑战:在线环境、无监督特性以及在持续域迁移下的误差累积和灾难性遗忘风险。为应对这些挑战,我们重塑了CTTA的在线数据缓冲与组织机制。我们提出了一种不确定性感知的缓冲方法,以从无监督的单次通过数据流中识别并聚合高置信度的显著样本。在此基础上,我们提出了一种基于图的类别关系保持约束,以克服灾难性遗忘。此外,采用伪目标重放目标来缓解误差累积。大量实验表明,我们的方法在分割和分类CTTA任务中均表现出优越性。代码可在https://github.com/z1358/OBAO获取。
abstract_en: Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) involves adapting a pre-trained source model to continually changing unsupervised target domains. In this paper, we systematically analyze the challenges of this task: online environment, unsupervised nature, and the risks of error accumulation and catastrophic forgetting under continual domain shifts. To address these challenges, we reshape the online data buffering and organizing mechanism for CTTA. We propose an uncertainty-aware buffering approach to identify and aggregate significant samples with high certainty from the unsupervised, single-pass data stream. Based on this, we propose a graph-based class relation preservation constraint to overcome catastrophic forgetting. Furthermore, a pseudo-target replay objective is used to mitigate error accumulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our method in both segmentation and classification CTTA tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/z1358/OBAO.

title: Zhipeng Hu, Yongqiang Zhang*, Chen Liu, Lincheng Li*, Sida Peng, Xiaowei Zhou, Changjie Fan, Xin Yu
title_en: Zhipeng Hu, Yongqiang Zhang*, Chen Liu, Lincheng Li*, Sida Peng, Xiaowei Zhou, Changjie Fan, Xin Yu
abstract: 可微表面渲染技术显著推动了三维重建的发展。现有表面渲染方法假设局部表面为平面,因此基于有符号距离场(SDF)值采用线性近似来预测表面点。然而,这一假设忽略了现实世界中物体表面固有的不规则性和非平面特性。因此,近似点往往偏离零等值面,影响重建形状的保真度。本文提出了一种新型表面渲染方法,称为CPT-VR,该方法利用最近点变换(CPT)和视图与反射方向向量来提升重建质量。具体而言,利用CPT的物理特性,即能够准确将表面附近的点投影到零等值面上,我们校正偏离的点,从而实现精确的几何表示。基于精确的几何表示,将反射向量纳入方法中可促进镜面区域的外观建模。此外,为使方法不再依赖任何背景先验知识,我们提出了一种背景模型以学习背景外观。与先前最先进的方法相比,CPT-VR在复杂结构和镜面高光等场景下均实现了更优的表面重建质量。
abstract_en: Differentiable surface rendering has significantly advanced 3D reconstruction. Existing surface rendering methods assume that the local surface is planar, and thus employ linear approximation based on the Singed Distance Field (SDF) values to predict the point on the surface. However, this assumption overlooks the inherently irregular and non-planar nature of object surfaces in the real world. Consequently, the approximate points tend to deviate from the zero-level set, affecting the fidelity of the reconstructed shape. In this paper, we propose a novel surface rendering method termed CPT-VR, which leverages the Closet Point Transform (CPT) and View and Reflection direction vectors to enhance the quality of reconstruction. Specifically, leveraging the physical property of CPT that accurately projects points near the surface onto the zero-level set, we correct the deviated points, thus achieving an accurate geometry representation. Based on our accurate geometry representation, incorporating the reflection vector into our method can facilitate the appearance modeling of specular regions. Moreover, to enable our method to no longer be dependent on any prior knowledge of the background, we present a background model to learn the background appearance. Compared to previous state-of-the-art methods, CPT-VR achieves better surface reconstruction quality, even for cases with complex structures and specular highlights.

title: Zhipeng Qian, Yiwei Ma, Zhekai Lin, Jiayi Ji, Xiawu Zheng, Xiaoshuai Sun*, Rongrong Ji
title_en: Zhipeng Qian, Yiwei Ma, Zhekai Lin, Jiayi Ji, Xiawu Zheng, Xiaoshuai Sun*, Rongrong Ji
abstract: 三维指称表达理解(3DREC)和分割(3DRES)任务具有重叠的目标,表明它们存在协作的潜力。然而,现有的协作方法主要依赖于一个任务的结果来预测另一个任务,限制了有效的协作。我们认为,为3DREC和3DRES任务采用独立的分支结构可以增强模型学习每个任务特定信息的能力,使它们能够获取互补的知识。因此,我们提出MCLN框架,包含独立的3DREC和3DRES任务分支。这使得每个任务能够进行专门探索,并实现分支间的有效协调。此外,为了促进这些分支间的相互强化,我们引入了相对超级点聚合(RSA)模块和自适应软对齐(ASA)模块。这些模块显著促进了两个分支预测结果的精确对齐,引导模块将更多注意力分配到关键位置。全面的实验评估表明,我们的方法在3DREC和3DRES任务上均达到最先进的性能,其中3DREC的Acc@0.5提升了2.05%,3DRES的mIoU提升了3.96%。我们的代码可在https://github.com/qzp2018/MCLN获取。
abstract_en: 3D referring expression comprehension (3DREC) and segmentation (3DRES) have overlapping objectives, indicating their potential for collaboration. However, existing collaborative approaches predominantly depend on the results of one task to make predictions for the other, limiting effective collaboration. We argue that employing separate branches for 3DREC and 3DRES tasks enhances the model’s capacity to learn specific information for each task, enabling them to acquire complementary knowledge. Thus, we propose the MCLN framework, which includes independent branches for 3DREC and 3DRES tasks. This enables dedicated exploration of each task and effective coordination between the branches. Furthermore, to facilitate mutual reinforcement between these branches, we introduce a Relative Superpoint Aggregation (RSA) module and an Adaptive Soft Alignment (ASA) module. These modules significantly contribute to the precise alignment of prediction results from the two branches, directing the module to allocate increased attention to key positions. Comprehensive experimental evaluation demonstrates that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance on both the 3DREC and 3DRES tasks, with an increase of 2.05% in Acc@0.5 for 3DREC and 3.96% in mIoU for 3DRES. Our code is available at https://github.com/qzp2018/MCLN.

title: Zhiqiu Lin*, Deepak Pathak, Baiqi Li, Jiayao Li, Xide Xia, Graham Neubig, Pengchuan Zhang, Deva Ramanan
title_en: Zhiqiu Lin*, Deepak Pathak, Baiqi Li, Jiayao Li, Xide Xia, Graham Neubig, Pengchuan Zhang, Deva Ramanan
abstract: 尽管生成式人工智能取得了显著进展,但全面评估仍面临挑战,原因在于缺乏有效的度量标准和标准化基准。例如,广泛使用的CLIPScore衡量生成图像与文本提示之间的对齐程度,但其在涉及对象、属性和关系组合的复杂提示中无法产生可靠评分。其中一个原因是CLIP的文本编码器 notorious 地充当“词袋”,将诸如“马在吃草”与“草在吃马”等提示混淆[?, ?, ?]。为了解决这一问题,我们引入了VQAScore,该方法通过计算“这张图是否显示{文本}?”这一简单问题的“是”答案概率,利用视觉问答(VQA)模型生成对齐评分。尽管比现有方法更简单,但使用现成模型计算的VQAScore在多个(8个)图像-文本对齐基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。我们还使用遵循文献最佳实践的内部模型计算VQAScore。例如,我们采用双向图像-问题编码器,使图像嵌入能够依赖于所提问题(反之亦然)。我们的内部模型CLIP-FlanT5的表现甚至优于利用专有GPT-4V的最强基线模型。有趣的是,尽管我们仅使用图像进行训练,VQAScore也能对齐文本与视频和3D模型。VQAScore使研究人员能够使用捕捉现实提示组合结构的复杂文本对文本到视觉生成进行基准测试。为此,我们引入了GenAI-Bench,这是一个更具挑战性的基准,包含1,600个组合文本提示,要求解析场景、对象、属性、关系以及比较和逻辑等高阶推理。GenAI-Bench还收集了超过15,000个人类评分,涵盖Stable Diffusion、DALL-E 3、Midjourney和Gen2等领先的图像和视频模型。我们开源了数据、模型和代码,详见链接。
abstract_en: Despite significant progress in generative AI, comprehensive evaluation remains challenging because of the lack of effective metrics and standardized benchmarks. For instance, the widely-used CLIPScore measures the alignment between a (generated) image and text prompt, but it fails to produce reliable scores for complex prompts involving compositions of objects, attributes, and relations. One reason is that text encoders of CLIP can notoriously act as a “bag of words”, conflating prompts such as the horse is eating the grass with the grass is eating the horse [?, ?, ?]. To address this, we introduce the VQAScore, which uses a visual-question-answering (VQA) model to produce an alignment score by computing the probability of a Yes answer to a simple Does this figure show {text}? question. Though simpler than prior art, VQAScore computed with off-the-shelf models produces state-of-the-art results across many (8) image-text alignment benchmarks. We also compute VQAScore with an in-house model that follows best practices in the literature. For example, we use a bidirectional image-question encoder that allows image embeddings to depend on the question being asked (and vice versa). Our in-house model, CLIP-FlanT5, outperforms even the strongest baselines that make use of the proprietary GPT-4V. Interestingly, although we train with only images, VQAScore can also align text with video and 3D models. VQAScore allows researchers to benchmark text-to-visual generation using complex texts that capture the compositional structure of real-world prompts. Towards this end, we introduce GenAI-Bench, a more challenging benchmark with 1,600 compositional text prompts that require parsing scenes, objects, attributes, relationships, and high-order reasoning such as comparison and logic. GenAI-Bench also collects over 15,000 human ratings for leading image and video models such as Stable Diffusion, DALL-E 3, Midjourney, and Gen2. We open-source our data, model, and code at link.

title: Zhixin Zhang, Yiyuan Zhang, Xiaohan Ding, Fusheng Jin*, Xiangyu Yue
title_en: Zhixin Zhang, Yiyuan Zhang, Xiaohan Ding, Fusheng Jin*, Xiangyu Yue
abstract: 在线矢量化高精度(HD)地图构建对于下游预测与规划任务至关重要。尽管近期研究已建立该任务的强基线,但道路系统中实例的几何形状与关系仍被低估,例如平行、垂直、矩形等特性。本文提出GeMap(几何地图),通过端到端学习超越基础感知的欧几里得形状与关系。具体而言,我们设计基于角度与幅值线索的几何损失函数,对驾驶场景中的刚性变换具有鲁棒性。为解决 vanilla 注意力机制在学习几何关系中的局限性,我们提出解耦自注意力机制,独立处理欧几里得形状与关系。GeMap在nuScenes和Argoverse 2数据集上取得新SOTA性能。值得注意的是,在大规模Argoverse 2数据集上达到71.8% mAP,超越MapTRv2 4.4%,首次突破70% mAP阈值。代码开源地址:https://github.com/cnzzx/GeMap
abstract_en: Online vectorized High-Definition (HD) map construction is critical for downstream prediction and planning. Recent efforts have built strong baselines for this task, however, geometric shapes and relations of instances in road systems are still under-explored, such as parallelism, perpendicular, rectangle-shape, . In our work, we propose GeMap (Geometry Map), which end-to-end learns Euclidean shapes and relations of map instances beyond fundamental perception. Specifically, we design a geometric loss based on angle and magnitude clues, robust to rigid transformations of driving scenarios. To address the limitations of the vanilla attention mechanism in learning geometry, we propose to decouple self-attention to handle Euclidean shapes and relations independently. GeMap achieves new state-of-the-art performance on the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 datasets. Remarkably, it reaches a 71.8% mAP on the large-scale Argoverse 2 dataset, outperforming MapTRv2 by +4.4% and surpassing the 70% mAP threshold for the first time. Code is available at https://github.com/cnzzx/GeMap.

title: 基于SAM的视频息肉分割方法
title_en: Zhixue Fang, Yuzhi Liu, Huisi Wu*, Jing Qin
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的模型(VP-SAM),该模型基于分割任意模型(SAM),用于视频息肉分割(VPS)。由于(1)息肉与背景之间的对比度较低,以及(2)息肉在帧到帧之间的尺寸、位置和形状变化较大,VPS是一项具有挑战性的任务。我们的目标是利用SAM强大的表示能力,同时使SAM能够有效利用结肠镜视频的时序信息,并将具有相似外观的息肉与背景分离。为实现这一目标,我们提出了两种新技术。首先,我们提出了一种新的语义解耦适配器(SDA),通过利用傅里叶谱的幅值信息,帮助SAM更有效地区分息肉与背景。其次,我们提出了一种创新的时空侧网络(STSN),为SAM提供视频的时空信息,从而帮助SAM有效跟踪息肉的运动状态。在SUN-SEG、CVC-612和CVC-300上的大量实验表明,我们的方法优于现有最先进的方法。虽然本工作专注于结肠镜视频,但所提出的方法足够通用,可用于分析具有类似挑战的其他医学视频。代码可在https://github.com/zhixue-fang/VPSAM获取。
abstract_en: We propose a novel model (VP-SAM) adapted from segment anything model (SAM) for video polyp segmentation (VPS), which is a challenging task due to (1) the low contrast between polyps and background and (2) the large frame-to-frame variations of polyp size, position, and shape. Our aim is to take advantage of the powerful representation capability of SAM while enabling SAM to effectively harness temporal information of colonoscopic videos and disentangle polyps from background with similar appearances. To achieve this, we propose two new techniques. First, we propose a new semantic disentanglement adapter (SDA) by exploiting amplitude information of the Fourier spectrum to facilitate SAM in more effectively differentiating polyps from background. Second, we propose an innovative spatio-temporal side network (STSN) to provide SAM with spatio-temporal information of videos, thus facilitating SAM in effectively tracking the motion status of polyps. Extensive experiments on SUN-SEG, CVC-612, and CVC-300 demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods. While this work focuses on colonoscopic videos, the proposed method is general enough to be used to analyze other medical videos with similar challenges. Code is available at https://github.com/zhixue-fang/ VPSAM.

title: Zhiyu Tan, Mengping Yang, Luozheng Qin, Hao Yang, Ye Qian, Qiang Zhou, Cheng Zhang, Hao Li*
title_en: Zhiyu Tan, Mengping Yang, Luozheng Qin , Hao Yang, Ye Qian , Qiang Zhou, Cheng Zhang, Hao Li*
abstract: 文本到图像生成中忠实生成的关键前提是对文本输入的准确理解。现有方法利用CLIP模型的文本编码器来表示输入提示。然而,预训练的CLIP模型只能编码英文,且最大token长度为77。此外,CLIP的文本编码器模型容量相较于大语言模型(LLMs)较为有限,而LLMs支持多语言输入、容纳更长上下文并实现更优的文本表征。本文研究将LLMs作为文本编码器以提升文本到图像生成中的语言理解能力。不幸的是,从头训练基于LLMs的文本到图像生成模型需要大量计算资源和数据。为此,我们引入了一个三阶段训练流程OmniDiffusion,有效且高效地将现有文本到图像模型与LLMs集成。具体而言,我们提出了一种轻量级适配器,使文本到图像模型能够利用LLMs的文本表征进行快速训练。大量实验表明,我们的模型不仅支持多语言,还能处理更长的输入上下文,并生成高质量的图像。项目页面:https://llm-conditioned-diffusion.github.io
abstract_en: One critical prerequisite for faithful text-to-image generation is the accurate understanding of text inputs. Existing methods leverage the text encoder of the CLIP model to represent input prompts. However, the pre-trained CLIP model can merely encode English with a maximum token length of 77. Moreover, the model capacity of the text encoder from CLIP is relatively limited compared to Large Language Models (LLMs), which offer multilingual input, accommodate longer context, and achieve superior text representation. In this paper, we investigate LLMs as the text encoder to improve the language understanding in text-to-image generation. Unfortunately, training text-to-image generative model with LLMs from scratch demands significant computational resources and data. To this end, we introduce a three-stage training pipeline, OmniDiffusion, that effectively and efficiently integrates the existing text-to-image model with LLMs. Specifically, we propose a lightweight adapter that enables fast training of the text-to-image model using the textual representations from LLMs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our model supports not only multilingual but also longer input context with superior image generation quality. Project page: https://llm-conditioned-diffusion.github.io

title: Zhiyu Wu*, Jinshi Cui*
title_en: Zhiyu Wu*, Jinshi Cui*
abstract: 图像级弱到强一致性由于其简单性和显著性能,已成为半监督学习(SSL)的主要范式。然而,该方法将所有扰动限制在图像级别,且存在大量简单样本,因此需要进一步改进。本文引入了具有不同强度和形式的特征级扰动,以扩展增强空间,建立了图像-特征弱到强一致性范式。此外,我们的范式开发了三分支结构,通过同一分支内两种扰动之间的交互增强其协同作用。同时,我们提出了一种基于置信度的识别策略,以区分简单样本和挑战性样本,从而仅对简单样本引入额外挑战。值得注意的是,我们的范式可以无缝集成到现有SSL方法中。我们将所提出的范式应用于多个代表性算法,并在包含平衡和不平衡标注样本分布的多个基准数据集上进行实验。实验结果表明,现有SSL算法的性能得到了显著提升。
abstract_en: Image-level weak-to-strong consistency serves as the predominant paradigm in semi-supervised learning (SSL) due to its simplicity and impressive performance. Nonetheless, this approach confines all perturbations to the image level and suffers from the excessive presence of naive samples, thus necessitating further improvement. In this paper, we introduce feature-level perturbation with varying intensities and forms to expand the augmentation space, establishing the image-feature weak-to-strong consistency paradigm. Furthermore, our paradigm develops a triple-branch structure, which facilitates interactions between both types of perturbations within one branch to boost their synergy. Additionally, we present a confidence-based identification strategy to distinguish between naive and challenging samples, thus introducing additional challenges exclusively for naive samples. Notably, our paradigm can seamlessly integrate with existing SSL methods. We apply the proposed paradigm to several representative algorithms and conduct experiments on multiple benchmarks, including both balanced and imbalanced distributions for labeled samples. The results demonstrate a significant enhancement in the performance of existing SSL algorithms.

title: Zhiyuan Ma*, Yuxiang Wei, Yabin Zhang, Xiangyu Zhu, Zhen Lei, Lei Zhang
title_en: Zhiyuan Ma*, Yuxiang Wei, Yabin Zhang, Xiangyu Zhu, Zhen Lei, Lei Zhang
abstract: 通过利用文本到图像的扩散先验,分数蒸馏可以在没有配对的文本-3D训练数据的情况下合成3D内容。相比于为每个文本提示花费数小时的在线优化,近期研究重点在于学习一个文本到3D的生成网络,以 amortize 多个文本-3D关系,从而在数秒内合成3D内容。然而,现有分数蒸馏方法由于难以将预训练扩散先验与来自不同文本提示的渲染图像分布对齐,难以扩展到大量文本提示。当前最先进的方法如变分分数蒸馏通过微调预训练扩散模型以最小化噪声预测误差来对齐分布,但这些方法训练不稳定且会损害模型对大量文本提示的理解能力。基于观察到扩散模型在早期时间步长(timesteps)往往具有更低的噪声预测误差,我们提出异步分数蒸馏(Asynchronous Score Distillation, ASD),通过将扩散时间步长提前以最小化噪声预测误差。ASD训练稳定且可扩展至10万条提示。它在不改变预训练扩散模型权重的情况下减少噪声预测误差,从而保持其对提示的强理解能力。我们使用不同的文本到3D架构(包括Hyper-iNGP和3DConv-Net)进行了大量实验。结果表明,ASD在稳定3D生成器训练、高质量3D内容合成以及提示一致性方面均有效,尤其是在大规模提示语料库下表现突出。代码已开源至 https://github.com/theEricMa/ScaleDreamer。
abstract_en: By leveraging the text-to-image diffusion prior, score distillation can synthesize 3D contents without paired text-3D training data. Instead of spending hours of online optimization per text prompt, recent studies have been focused on learning a text-to-3D generative network for amortizing multiple text-3D relations, which can synthesize 3D contents in seconds. However, existing score distillation methods are hard to scale up to a large amount of text prompts due to the difficulties in aligning pretrained diffusion prior with the distribution of rendered images from various text prompts. Current state-of-the-arts such as Variational Score Distillation finetune the pretrained diffusion model to minimize the noise prediction error so as to align the distributions, which are however unstable to train and will impair the model’s comprehension capability to numerous text prompts. Based on the observation that the diffusion models tend to have lower noise prediction errors at earlier timesteps, we propose Asynchronous Score Distillation (ASD), which minimizes the noise prediction error by shifting the diffusion timestep to earlier ones. ASD is stable to train and can scale up to 100k prompts. It reduces the noise prediction error without changing the weights of pre-trained diffusion model, thus keeping its strong comprehension capability to prompts. We conduct extensive experiments using different text-to-3D architectures, including Hyper-iNGP and 3DConv-Net. The results demonstrate ASD’s effectiveness in stable 3D generator training, high-quality 3D content synthesis, and its superior prompt-consistency, especially under large prompt corpus. Code is available at https://github.com/theEricMa/ScaleDreamer.

title: Zhiyuan You*, Zheyuan Li, Jinjin Gu*, Zhenfei Yin, Tianfan Xue*, Chao Dong*
title_en: Zhiyuan You*, Zheyuan Li, Jinjin Gu*, Zhenfei Yin, Tianfan Xue*, Chao Dong*
abstract: 我们引入了一种图像质量评估方法(Depicted image Quality Assessment method),克服了传统基于评分方法的限制。该方法通过利用多模态大语言模型(MLLMs),能够对图像质量进行详细、基于语言、类人化的评估。与依赖评分的常规图像质量评估(IQA)方法不同,该方法以描述性和比较性的方式解释图像内容和失真,与人类的推理过程高度一致。为构建该模型,我们建立了分层任务框架,并收集了一个多模态图像质量评估训练数据集。为应对训练数据有限和多图像处理的挑战,我们提出使用多源训练数据和专用图像标签。这些设计使该方法在多个基准测试中优于基于评分的方法。此外,与通用MLLMs相比,该方法能够生成更准确的推理描述语言。我们还证明了该全参考数据集可扩展至非参考应用。这些结果展示了多模态图像质量评估方法的研究潜力。
abstract_en: We introduce a Depicted image Quality Assessment method (), overcoming the constraints of traditional score-based methods. allows for detailed, language-based, human-like evaluation of image quality by leveraging Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Unlike conventional Image Quality Assessment (IQA) methods relying on scores, interprets image content and distortions descriptively and comparatively, aligning closely with humans’ reasoning process. To build the model, we establish a hierarchical task framework, and collect a multi-modal IQA training dataset. To tackle the challenges of limited training data and multi-image processing, we propose to use multi-source training data and specialized image tags. These designs result in a better performance of than score-based approaches on multiple benchmarks. Moreover, compared with general MLLMs, can generate more accurate reasoning descriptive languages.
