abstract_en: Current end-to-end Scene Graph Generation (SGG) relies solely on visual representations to separately detect sparse relations and entities in an image. This leads to the issue where the predictions of entities do not contribute to the prediction of relations, necessitating post-processing to assign corresponding subjects and objects to the predicted relations. In this paper, we introduce a sparse relationship matrix that bridges entity detection and relation detection. Our approach not only eliminates the need for relation matching, but also leverages the semantics and positional information of predicted entities to enhance relation prediction. Specifically, a multi-granularity sparse relationship matrix prediction network is proposed, which utilizes three gated pooling modules focusing on filtering negative samples at different granularities, thereby obtaining a sparse relationship matrix containing entity pairs most likely to form relations. Finally, a set of sparse, most probable subject-object pairs can be constructed and used for relation decoding. Experimental results on multiple datasets demonstrate that our method achieves a new state-of-the-art overall performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/wanglei0618/Mg-RMPN.

title: 李张*, 梅庆伟, 仲燕, 孔斌, 徐明良, 杜建明, 王雪, 王如静, 刘柳
title_en: li zhang*, Weiqing Meng, Yan Zhong, Bin Kong, Mingliang Xu, Jianming Du, Xue Wang, Rujing Wang, Liu Liu
abstract: 刚性物体和可变形物体在我们的日常生活中很常见。针对这两种类型的物体的姿态估计任务在各自领域内已被广泛研究。然而,能够同时估计刚性物体和关节物体姿态的通用框架尚未被报道。在本文中,我们引入了一种通用的9D类别级物体姿态估计(U-COPE)框架,旨在解决这一问题。我们的方法为刚性物体和关节物体提供了一种新的视角,重新定义它们的姿态估计问题,将它们统一为一个共同任务。通过利用三维点云或RGB-D图像输入,我们从每个物体部分独立提取点对特征(PPF)以进行端到端学习。此外,与以往方法直接预测不同,我们采用一种通用投票策略来推导出对物体姿态估计至关重要的关键参数。我们的网络通过参数投票进行端到端训练,以优化三个关键目标:关节信息、部件分割和9D姿态估计。大量实验验证了我们的方法在估计刚性物体和关节物体姿态方面的鲁棒性,也证明了其对未见过的物体实例的泛化能力。值得注意的是,我们的方法在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上均达到了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Rigid and articulated objects are common in our daily lives. Pose estimation tasks for both types of objects have been extensively studied within their respective domains. However, a universal framework capable of estimating the pose of both rigid and articulated objects has yet to be reported. In this paper, we introduce a Universal 9D Category-level Object Pose Estimation (U-COPE) framework, designed to address this gap. Our approach offers a novel perspective on rigid and articulated objects, redefining their pose estimation problems to unify them into a common task. Leveraging either 3D point cloud or RGB-D image inputs, we extract Point Pair Features (PPF) independently from each object part for end-to-end learning. Moreover, instead of direct prediction as seen in prior art, we employ a universal voting strategy to derive decisive parameters crucial for object pose estimation. Our network is trained end-to-end to optimize three key objectives: Joint Information, Part Segmentation, and 9D pose estimation through parameter voting. Extensive experiments validate the robustness of our method in estimating poses for both rigid and articulated objects, which demonstrates the generalizability to unseen object instances, too. Notably, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on synthetic datasets and real-world datasets.

title: mingjun zheng, Long Sun, Jiangxin Dong, Jinshan Pan*
title_en: mingjun zheng, Long Sun, Jiangxin Dong, Jinshan Pan*
abstract: 基于Transformer的修复方法由于Transformer的自注意力(SA)能够探索非局部信息以实现更高质量的高分辨率图像重建,从而取得了显著性能。然而,关键的点积自注意力机制需要大量计算资源,这限制了其在低功耗设备中的应用。此外,自注意力机制的低通特性限制了其捕捉局部细节的能力,从而导致重建结果过于平滑。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了一种自调制特征聚合(SMFA)模块,协同利用局部和非局部特征交互以实现更精确的重建。具体而言,SMFA模块采用自注意力的高效近似(EASA)分支来建模非局部信息,并使用局部细节估计(LDE)分支来捕捉局部细节。此外,我们进一步引入了基于部分卷积的前馈网络(PCFN)以优化SMFA提取的代表性特征。大量实验表明,所提出的SMFANet家族在公开基准数据集上实现了重建性能与计算效率之间的更好平衡。特别是,与×4 SwinIR-light相比,SMFANet+在五个公开测试集上的平均性能高出0.14dB,并且运行速度提高了10倍,模型复杂度(如FLOPs)仅为约43%。我们的源代码和预训练模型可在以下链接获取:https://github.com/Zheng-MJ/SMFANet.
abstract_en: Transformer-based restoration methods achieve significant performance as the self-attention (SA) of the Transformer can explore non-local information for better high-resolution image reconstruction. However, the key dot-product SA requires substantial computational resources, which limits its application in low-power devices. Moreover, the low-pass nature of the SA mechanism limits its capacity for capturing local details, consequently leading to smooth reconstruction results. To address these issues, we propose a self-modulation feature aggregation (SMFA) module to collaboratively exploit both local and non-local feature interactions for a more accurate reconstruction. Specifically, the SMFA module employs an efficient approximation of self-attention (EASA) branch to model non-local information and uses a local detail estimation (LDE) branch to capture local details. Additionally, we further introduce a partial convolution-based feed-forward network (PCFN) to refine the representative features derived from the SMFA. Extensive experiments show that the proposed SMFANet family achieve a better trade-off between reconstruction performance and computational efficiency on public benchmark datasets. In particular, compared to the ×4 SwinIR-light, SMFANet+ achieves 0.14dB higher performance over five public testsets on average, and ×10 times faster runtime, with only about 43% of the model complexity (e.g., FLOPs). Our source codes and pre-trained models are available at: https://github.com/Zheng-MJ/SMFANet.

title: sehyung lee*, Mijung Kim, Yeongnam Chae, Bjorn Stenger
title_en: sehyung lee*, Mijung Kim, Yeongnam Chae, Bjorn Stenger
abstract: 本文介绍了一种由无监督学习驱动的线性可控生成对抗网络(LC-GAN)方法。不同于依赖监督信号或后处理以实现潜在特征解耦的传统方法,我们的技术通过对比特征分类和谱正则化,仅使用图像数据实现无监督学习。在我们的框架中,判别器通过图像增强和对比表征学习的结合,构建几何和外观相关的特征空间。利用这些特征空间,生成器自主地将输入潜在编码分类为几何和外观相关的特征。随后,这些分类后的特征通过我们提出的谱正则化投影到子空间中,每个组件控制生成图像的不同方面。除了提供对生成模型的细粒度控制外,我们的方法在FFHQ、CelebA-HQ和AFHQ-V2等基准数据集上实现了最先进的图像生成质量。
abstract_en: This paper introduces an approach to linearly controllable generative adversarial networks (LC-GAN) driven by unsupervised learning. Departing from traditional methods relying on supervision signals or post-processing for latent feature disentanglement, our proposed technique enables unsupervised learning using only image data through contrastive feature categorization and spectral regularization. In our framework, the discriminator constructs geometry- and appearance-related feature spaces using a combination of image augmentation and contrastive representation learning. Leveraging these feature spaces, the generator autonomously categorizes input latent codes into geometry- and appearance-related features. Subsequently, the categorized features undergo projection into a subspace via our proposed spectral regularization, with each component controlling a distinct aspect of the generated image. Beyond providing fine-grained control over the generative model, our approach achieves state-of-the-art image generation quality on benchmark datasets, including FFHQ, CelebA-HQ, and AFHQ-V2.

title: sha zhang, Di Huang, Jiajun Deng*, Shixiang Tang, Wanli Ouyang, Tong He*, Yanyong Zhang*
title_en: sha zhang, Di Huang, Jiajun Deng*, Shixiang Tang, Wanli Ouyang, Tong He*, Yanyong Zhang*
abstract: 理解并推理三维真实世界的能力是迈向人工通用智能的关键里程碑。当前的常见做法是通过使用三维数据和文本对大语言模型(LLMs)进行微调,以实现三维理解。尽管这些方法有效,但它们本质上受到可用三维数据规模和多样性的限制。作为替代方案,本文提出了一种创新的三维感知代理框架__TITLE_MATH_1__,以零样本方式解决三维场景理解问题。我们的方法核心在于将三维场景感知的挑战重新概念化为通过多视角图像理解和综合洞察的过程,这一过程灵感来源于人类如何尝试理解三维场景。通过整合这一理念,我们提出了一种新颖的方法,利用大视觉语言模型(VLM)通过主动选择和分析一系列视角来实现三维理解。具体而言,给定一个输入的三维场景,首先使用自定义设计的视觉提示处理俯视图图像,然后迭代选择下一个观察视角以总结潜在知识。__TITLE_MATH_1__的显著优势在于引入了新颖的视觉提示,这显著释放了VLM识别最具信息量视角的能力,从而促进三维场景的观察。大量实验验证了所提出框架在理解多样且前所未见的三维环境中的有效性。项目页面
abstract_en: The ability to understand and reason the 3D real world is a crucial milestone towards artificial general intelligence. The current common practice is to finetune Large Language Models (LLMs) with 3D data and texts to enable 3D understanding. Despite their effectiveness, these approaches are inherently limited by the scale and diversity of the available 3D data. Alternatively, in this work, we introduce , an innovative 3D-aware agent framework addressing the 3D scene understanding in a zero-shot manner. The essence of our approach centers on reconceptualizing the challenge of 3D scene perception as a process of understanding and synthesizing insights from multiple images, inspired by how our human beings attempt to understand 3D scenes. By consolidating this idea, we propose a novel way to make use of a Large Visual Language Model (VLM) via actively selecting and analyzing a series of viewpoints for 3D understanding. Specifically, given an input 3D scene, first processes a bird’s-eye view image with custom-designed visual prompts, then iteratively chooses the next viewpoints to observe and summarize the underlying knowledge. A distinctive advantage of is the introduction of novel visual prompts, which significantly unleash the VLMs’ ability to identify the most informative viewpoints and thus facilitate observing 3D scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework in understanding diverse and previously unseen 3D environments. project page

title: 生淼*, 黄佳欣,白东峰,邱伟超,刘冰冰,Andreas Geiger,廖毅毅
title_en: sheng miao*, Jiaxin Huang, Dongfeng Bai, Weichao Qiu, Liu Bingbing, Andreas Geiger, Yiyi Liao
abstract: 近期在隐式场景表示领域的进展使得高保真街景新视角合成成为可能。然而,现有方法为每个场景单独优化神经辐射场,严重依赖密集训练图像和大量计算资源。为缓解这一缺陷,我们提出了一种名为高效深度引导城市视图合成(EDUS)的新方法,实现快速前馈推理和高效场景微调。与基于特征匹配推断几何的先前通用方法不同,EDUS利用噪声预测的几何先验作为指导,从稀疏输入图像中实现可泛化的城市视图合成。几何先验使我们能够直接在三维空间应用通用模型,从而在不同稀疏度水平上获得鲁棒性。通过在KITTI-360和Waymo数据集上的全面实验,我们展示了在新街景上的良好泛化能力。此外,我们的结果表明,当与快速测试时优化结合时,EDUS在稀疏视角设置中实现了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Recent advances in implicit scene representation enable high-fidelity street view novel view synthesis. However, existing methods optimize a neural radiance field for each scene, relying heavily on dense training images and extensive computation resources. To mitigate this shortcoming, we introduce a new method called Efficient Depth-Guided Urban View Synthesis (EDUS) for fast feed-forward inference and efficient per-scene fine-tuning. Different from prior generalizable methods that infer geometry based on feature matching, EDUS leverages noisy predicted geometric priors as guidance to enable generalizable urban view synthesis from sparse input images. The geometric priors allow us to apply our generalizable model directly in the 3D space, gaining robustness across various sparsity levels. Through comprehensive experiments on the KITTI-360 and Waymo datasets, we demonstrate promising generalization abilities on novel street scenes. Moreover, our results indicate that EDUS achieves state-of-the-art performance in sparse view settings when combined with fast test-time optimization.

title: shuangkang fang*, Yufeng Wang*, Yi-Hsuan Tsai, Yi Yang, Wenrui Ding, Shuchang Zhou, Ming-Hsuan Yang
title_en: shuangkang fang*, Yufeng Wang*, Yi-Hsuan Tsai, Yi Yang, Wenrui Ding, Shuchang Zhou, Ming-Hsuan Yang
abstract: 基于视觉-语言预训练模型的图像内容操作近期已被有效扩展至文本驱动的3D场景编辑。然而,现有3D场景编辑方案仍存在某些不足,阻碍了其进一步的交互式设计。此类方案通常遵循固定的输入模式,限制了用户在文本输入方面的灵活性。此外,其编辑能力受限于单一或少数2D视觉模型,需要复杂的管道设计将这些模型整合到3D重建过程中。为解决上述问题,我们提出一种基于对话的3D场景编辑方法,称为__TITLE_MATH_1__,其以大语言模型为核心,允许用户进行任意文本输入并解析其意图,随后自主调用相应的视觉专家模型。此外,我们设计了一种利用Hash-Atlas表示3D场景视图的方案,将3D场景编辑转移到2D图谱图像上。该设计实现了2D编辑与3D重建过程的完全解耦,使__TITLE_MATH_1__能够灵活整合广泛存在的2D或3D视觉模型,无需复杂的融合设计。实验结果表明,__TITLE_MATH_1__有效整合多种视觉模型以实现多样化的编辑视觉效果,具备强大的场景理解能力和多轮对话能力。源代码可在https://sk-fun.fun/CE3D获取。
abstract_en: Recent work on image content manipulation based on vision-language pre-training models has been effectively extended to text-driven 3D scene editing. However, existing schemes for 3D scene editing still exhibit certain shortcomings, hindering their further interactive design. Such schemes typically adhere to fixed input patterns, limiting users’ flexibility in text input. Moreover, their editing capabilities are constrained by a single or a few 2D visual models and require intricate pipeline design to integrate these models into 3D reconstruction processes. To address the aforementioned issues, we propose a dialogue-based 3D scene editing approach, termed , which is centered around a large language model that allows for arbitrary textual input from users and interprets their intentions, subsequently facilitating the autonomous invocation of the corresponding visual expert models. Furthermore, we design a scheme utilizing Hash-Atlas to represent 3D scene views, which transfers the editing of 3D scenes onto 2D atlas images. This design achieves complete decoupling between the 2D editing and 3D reconstruction processes, enabling to flexibly integrate a wide range of existing 2D or 3D visual models without necessitating intricate fusion designs. Experimental results demonstrate that effectively integrates multiple visual models to achieve diverse editing visual effects, possessing strong scene comprehension and multi-round dialog capabilities. The source codes can be made available at https://sk-fun. fun/CE3D.

title: tianyu zhang, Guocheng Qian, Jin Xie*, Jian Yang
title_en: tianyu zhang, Guocheng Qian, Jin Xie*, Jian Yang
abstract: 点云帧插值是一项具有挑战性的任务,需要在帧间进行精确的场景流估计并保持几何结构。现有技术通常依赖预训练的运动估计器或密集的测试时优化,导致插值精度下降或推理时间延长。本文提出FastPCI,引入金字塔卷积-Transformer架构用于点云帧插值。我们的混合卷积-Transformer架构提升了局部与长程特征学习能力,而金字塔网络提供多级特征并减少计算量。此外,FastPCI提出独特的双方向运动-结构模块以实现更精确的场景流估计。我们的设计基于两个事实:(1) 精确的场景流保持3D结构,(2) 前一时刻的点云应能通过未来时刻的逆运动重建。大量实验表明,FastPCI在KITTI数据集上显著优于最先进的PointINet和NeuralPCI,Chamfer距离分别减少26.6%和18.3%,同时推理速度分别快10倍和600倍。代码已开源于https://github.com/genuszty/FastPCI。
abstract_en: Point cloud frame interpolation is a challenging task that involves accurate scene flow estimation across frames and maintaining the geometry structure. Prevailing techniques often rely on pre-trained motion estimators or intensive testing-time optimization, resulting in compromised interpolation accuracy or prolonged inference. This work presents FastPCI that introduces Pyramid Convolution-Transformer architecture for point cloud frame interpolation. Our hybrid Convolution-Transformer improves the local and long-range feature learning, while the pyramid network offers multilevel features and reduces the computation. In addition, FastPCI proposes a unique Dual-Direction Motion-Structure block for more accurate scene flow estimation. Our design is motivated by two facts: (1) accurate scene flow preserves 3D structure, and (2) point cloud at the previous timestep should be reconstructable using reverse motion from future timestep. Extensive experiments show that FastPCI significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art PointINet and NeuralPCI with notable gains (26.6% and 18.3% reduction in Chamfer Distance in KITTI), while being more than 10× and 600× faster, respectively. Code is available at https://github.com/genuszty/ FastPCI.

title: xinyu sun*, Lizhao Liu, Hongyan Zhi, Ronghe Qiu, Junwei Liang*
title_en: xinyu sun*, Lizhao Liu, Hongyan Zhi, Ronghe Qiu, Junwei Liang*
abstract: 我们研究零样本实例导航,其中智能体在不使用对象标注进行训练的情况下导航到特定对象。先前的对象导航方法应用图像目标导航(__TITLE_MATH_1__)任务(前往图像的位置)进行预训练,并利用视觉语言模型将智能体转移到实现对象目标。然而,这些方法导致语义忽视问题,其中模型未能学习有意义的语义对齐。在本文中,我们提出了一种(__ABS_MATH_1__)方法来提高导航智能体的语义理解能力。具体而言,提出了一种语义增强的PSL智能体,并引入了一种选择目标图像的策略,这些图像表现出清晰的语义监督,并放松了从严格精确视图匹配的奖励函数。在推理时,设计了一种方案以保持与训练时相同的目标准确度级别。此外,对于流行的HM3D环境,我们提出了一个实例导航(__ABS_MATH_2__)任务,该任务要求前往具有详细描述的特定对象实例,而不是仅由对象类别定义目标的对象导航(__ABS_MATH_3__)任务。我们的PSL智能体在零样本任务中以66%的成功率超越了先前的最先进方法,并且在新任务中也表现优异。代码将在https://github.com/XinyuSun/PSL-InstanceNav发布。
abstract_en: We study zero-shot instance navigation, in which the agent navigates to a specific object without using object annotations for training. Previous object navigation approaches apply the image-goal navigation () task (go to the location of an image) for pretraining, and transfer the agent to achieve object goals using a vision-language model. However, these approaches lead to issues of semantic neglect, where the model fails to learn meaningful semantic alignments. In this paper, we propose a () method to improve the semantic understanding ability of navigation agents. Specifically, a semantic-enhanced PSL agent is proposed and a strategy is introduced to select goal images that exhibit clear semantic supervision and relax the reward function from strict exact view matching. At inference time, a scheme is designed to preserve the same granularity level of the goal-semantic as training. Furthermore, for the popular HM3D environment, we present an Instance Navigation () task that requires going to a specific object instance with detailed descriptions, as opposed to the Object Navigation () task where the goal is defined merely by the object category. Our PSL agent outperforms the previous state-of-the-art by 66% on zero-shot in terms of success rate and is also superior on the new task. Code will be released at https://github.com/XinyuSun/PSL-InstanceNav.

title: xunfa lai, Zhiyu Yang, Jie Hu, ShengChuan Zhang*, Liujuan Cao, Guannan Jiang, Songan Zhang, zhiyu wang, Rongrong Ji
title_en: xunfa lai, Zhiyu Yang, Jie Hu, ShengChuan Zhang*, Liujuan Cao, Guannan Jiang, Songan Zhang, zhiyu wang, Rongrong Ji
abstract: 现有伪装目标检测(COD)方法严重依赖大规模像素级标注数据。然而,由于目标固有的伪装特性,获取此类标注十分繁琐。半监督学习为这一挑战提供了有前景的解决方案。但其在COD中的应用受到显著伪标签噪声的阻碍,包括像素级和实例级噪声。我们提出CamoTeacher,一种新颖的半监督COD框架,通过双旋转一致性学习(DRCL)有效解决这些噪声问题。具体而言,DRCL通过像素级和实例级旋转视角的一致性来最小化伪标签噪声。首先,它采用像素级一致性学习(PCL),通过重新加权伪标签中不同部分来处理像素级噪声。其次,实例级一致性学习(ICL)用于调整伪标签权重,以应对实例级噪声。在四个COD基准数据集上的大量实验表明,所提出的CamoTeacher不仅在与半监督学习方法的对比中达到SOTA性能,还能与现有的全监督学习方法相媲美。我们的代码将很快发布。
abstract_en: Existing camouflaged object detection (COD) methods depend heavily on large-scale pixel-level annotations. However, acquiring such annotations is laborious due to the inherent camouflage characteristics of the objects. Semi-supervised learning offers a promising solution to this challenge. Yet, its application in COD is hindered by significant pseudo-label noise, both pixel-level and instance-level. We introduce CamoTeacher, a novel semi-supervised COD framework, utilizing Dual-Rotation Consistency Learning (DRCL) to effectively address these noise issues. Specifically, DRCL minimizes pseudo-label noise by leveraging rotation views’ consistency in pixel-level and instance-level. First, it employs Pixel-wise Consistency Learning (PCL) to deal with pixel-level noise by reweighting the different parts within the pseudo-label. Second, Instance-wise Consistency Learning (ICL) is used to adjust weights for pseudo-labels, which handles instance-level noise. Extensive experiments on four COD benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed CamoTeacher not only achieves state-of-the-art compared with semi-supervised learning methods, but also rivals established fully-supervised learning methods. Our code will be available soon.

title: yaomin huang, Faming Fang, Zaoming Yan, Chaomin Shen, Guixu Zhang*
title_en: yaomin huang, Faming Fang, Zaoming Yan, Chaomin Shen, Guixu Zhang*
abstract: 知识蒸馏(KD)因其能够将复杂网络(教师)的知识转移到轻量级网络(学生)中,且不改变网络结构,而受到越来越多的关注。在KD方法中,主要分为两类:基于特征的方法,关注中间层的特征;基于logits的方法,针对最终层的logits。本文通过统一的KD框架,引入了一种新的视角,利用多样化的知识源。具体而言,我们从中间层提取特征,整合成一个全面的表示,有效汇集不同阶段和尺度的语义信息。随后,我们从该表示中预测分布参数。这些步骤将中间层的知识转化为相应的分布形式,从而通过统一的分布约束在不同网络阶段进行知识蒸馏,确保知识传递的全面性和一致性。进行了大量实验以验证所提方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD), known for its ability to transfer knowledge from a cumbersome network (teacher) to a lightweight one (student) without altering the architecture, has been garnering increasing attention. Two primary categories emerge within KD methods: feature-based, focusing on intermediate layers’ features, and logits-based, targeting the final layer’s logits. This paper introduces a novel perspective by leveraging diverse knowledge sources within a unified KD framework. Specifically, we aggregate features from intermediate layers into a comprehensive representation, effectively gathering semantic information from different stages and scales. Subsequently, we predict the distribution parameters from this representation. These steps transform knowledge from the intermediate layers into corresponding distributive forms, thereby allowing for knowledge distillation through a unified distribution constraint at different stages of the network, ensuring the comprehensiveness and coherence of knowledge transfer. Numerous experiments were conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

title: yuehui han*, Can Xu, Rui Xu, Jianjun Qian, Jin Xie
title_en: yuehui han*, Can Xu, Rui Xu, Jianjun Qian, Jin Xie
abstract: 点云序列上的自监督表征学习由于其复杂的时空结构是一项具有挑战性的任务。大多数近期尝试通过重构点坐标或设计帧级对比学习来训练点云序列表征模型。然而,这些方法未能有效探索时间维度和全局语义信息,而这些正是点云序列中的关键组成部分。为此,本文提出了一种基于掩码运动预测与语义对比(M2PSC)的自监督表征学习框架,用于点云序列。具体而言,该方法通过将三个预设任务整合到同一掩码自编码器框架中,旨在学习表征模型。首先,运动轨迹预测,可以增强模型对点云序列中动态信息的理解能力。其次,语义对比,可以引导模型更好地探索点云序列的全局语义。第三,外观重建,可以帮助捕捉点云序列的外观信息。通过这种方式,我们的方法能够迫使模型同时编码点云序列中的空间和时间结构。在四个基准数据集上的实验结果验证了我们方法的有效性。源代码可在 https://github.com/yh-han/M2PSC.git 获取。
abstract_en: Self-supervised representation learning on point cloud sequences is a challenging task due to the complex spatio-temporal structure. Most recent attempts aim to train the point cloud sequences representation model by reconstructing the point coordinates or designing frame-level contrastive learning. However, these methods do not effectively explore the information of temporal dimension and global semantics, which are the very important components in point cloud sequences. To this end, in this paper, we propose a novel masked motion prediction and semantic contrast (M2PSC) based self-supervised representation learning framework for point cloud sequences. Specifically, it aims to learn a representation model by integrating three pretext tasks into the same masked autoencoder framework. First, motion trajectory prediction, which can enhance the model’s ability to understand dynamic information in point cloud sequences. Second, semantic contrast, which can guide the model to better explore the global semantics of point cloud sequences. Third, appearance reconstruction, which can help capture the appearance information of point cloud sequences. In this way, our method can force the model to simultaneously encode spatial and temporal structure in the point cloud sequences. Experimental results on four benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. Source code is available at https://github.com/yh-han/M2PSC.git.

title: zhao zhe*, Mengshi Qi, Huadong Ma
title_en: zhao zhe*, Mengshi Qi, Huadong Ma
abstract: 生成逼真的手部抓取是计算机图形学和机器人学中涉及物体操作应用的关键且具有挑战性的任务。现有方法往往难以生成细粒度的逼真手部抓取,确保所有手指有效与物体交互,因为它们侧重于通过整体表示编码手部,然后在单一步骤中同时估计手部姿态和位置。本文提出了一种新颖的分解向量量化变分自编码器(DVQ-VAE),通过将手部分解为多个独立部分并分别进行编码来解决这一局限性。这种部分感知的分解架构有助于更精确地管理手部各组件与物体的交互,提升生成手部抓取的整体真实感。此外,我们设计了一种新的双阶段解码策略,首先在骨骼物理约束下确定抓取类型,然后确定抓取位置,这可以显著提升模型的逼真度及其对未见过的手-物体交互的适应性。实验表明,与现有最先进方法相比,在四个广泛采用的基准测试中,我们的模型在质量指标上实现了约14.1%的相对提升。我们的源代码可在https://github.com/florasion/D-VQVAE获取。
abstract_en: Generating realistic human grasps is a crucial yet challenging task for applications involving object manipulation in computer graphics and robotics. Existing methods often struggle with generating fine-grained realistic human grasps that ensure all fingers effectively interact with objects, as they focus on encoding hand with the whole representation and then estimating both hand posture and position in a single step. In this paper, we propose a novel Decomposed Vector-Quantized Variational Autoencoder (DVQ-VAE) to address this limitation by decomposing hand into several distinct parts and encoding them separately. This part-aware decomposed architecture facilitates more precise management of the interaction between each component of hand and object, enhancing the overall reality of generated human grasps. Furthermore, we design a newly dual-stage decoding strategy, by first determining the type of grasping under skeletal physical constraints, and then identifying the location of the grasp, which can greatly improve the verisimilitude as well as adaptability of the model to unseen hand-object interaction. In experiments, our model achieved about 14.1% relative improvement in the quality index compared to the state-of-the-art methods in four widely-adopted benchmarks. Our source code is available at https://github.com/florasion/D-VQVAE.

title: zhenhua xu*, Kwan-Yee K. Wong, Hengshuang Zhao
title_en: zhenhua xu*, Kwan-Yee K. Wong, Hengshuang Zhao
abstract: 矢量化高精度(HD)地图包含周围道路元素的详细信息,对于现代自动驾驶车辆的各种下游任务(如运动规划和车辆控制)至关重要。近期研究尝试将矢量化HD地图直接检测作为点集预测任务,取得了显著的检测性能提升。然而,这些方法通常忽视并未能分析预测点之间的关键实例内部相关性,阻碍了进一步的发展。为解决这一问题,我们通过Transformer研究利用实例内部信息进行矢量化高精度地图构建,并提出了一种名为InsMapper的强大系统。该系统通过三种精巧设计(包括混合查询生成、实例内部查询融合和实例内部特征聚合)有效利用实例内部信息。前两个模块能更好地初始化线检测查询,而最后一个模块则优化预测的线实例。InsMapper具有高度适应性,可无缝修改以适配最新的HD地图检测框架。在具有挑战性的NuScenes和Argoverse 2数据集上进行了大量实验评估,结果表明InsMapper超越了先前的最先进方法,验证了其有效性与通用性。
abstract_en: Vectorized high-definition (HD) maps contain detailed information about surrounding road elements, which are crucial for various downstream tasks in modern autonomous vehicles, such as motion planning and vehicle control. Recent works attempt to directly detect the vectorized HD map as a point set prediction task, achieving notable detection performance improvements. However, these methods usually overlook and fail to analyze the important inner-instance correlations between predicted points, impeding further advancements. To address this issue, we investigate the utilization of inner-instance information for vectorized high-definition mapping through transformers, and propose a powerful system named InsMapper, which effectively harnesses inner-instance information with three exquisite designs, including hybrid query generation, inner-instance query fusion, and inner-instance feature aggregation. The first two modules can better initialize queries for line detection, while the last one refines predicted line instances. InsMapper is highly adaptable and can be seamlessly modified to align with the most recent HD map detection frameworks. Extensive experimental evaluations are conducted on the challenging NuScenes and Argoverse 2 datasets, where InsMapper surpasses the previous state-of-the-art method, demonstrating its effectiveness and generality.

title: ziyu zhu*, Zhuofan Zhang, Xiaojian Ma, Xuesong Niu, Yixin Chen, Baoxiong Jia, Zhidong Deng*, Siyuan Huang*, Qing Li*
title_en: ziyu zhu*, Zhuofan Zhang, Xiaojian Ma, Xuesong Niu, Yixin Chen, Baoxiong Jia, Zhidong Deng*, Siyuan Huang*, Qing Li*
abstract: 构建一个统一的三维视觉-语言(3D-VL)理解模型,旨在处理多种场景表示并执行三维场景中的广泛任务。然而,现有方法与这种统一模型之间仍存在显著差距,主要由于表示方法的独立应用以及对三维多任务训练的探索不足。本文提出,一个能够通过可提示查询处理广泛3D-VL任务的统一模型,从低层次实例分割到高层次推理与规划。这通过三项关键创新实现:(1) 通过分段级分组将多种三维场景表示(, 体素、点云、多视角图像)统一到共享的三维坐标空间;(2) 基于注意力机制的查询解码器,通过提示引导任务特定信息检索;(3) 支持多任务训练的通用输出头。在十个多样化3D-VL数据集上进行测试,展现出卓越性能,在多数基准测试中创下单项新纪录。特别是,在ScanNet200上提升4.9%(AP25),ScanRefer上提升5.4%(acc@0.5),Multi3DRefer上提升11.7%(F1@0.5),Scan2Cap上提升13.4%(CIDEr@0.5)。此外,支持灵活推理,可单独或组合使用可用的三维表示形式,, 仅使用体素输入。
abstract_en: A unified model for 3D vision-language (3D-VL) understanding is expected to take various scene representations and perform a wide range of tasks in a 3D scene. However, a considerable gap exists between existing methods and such a unified model, due to the independent application of representation and insufficient exploration of 3D multi-task training. In this paper, we introduce , a unified model capable of using Promptable Queries to tackle a wide range of 3D-VL tasks, from low-level instance segmentation to high-level reasoning and planning. This is achieved through three key innovations: (1) unifying various 3D scene representations (, voxels, point clouds, multi-view images) into a shared 3D coordinate space by segment-level grouping, (2) an attention-based query decoder for task-specific information retrieval guided by prompts, and (3) universal output heads for different tasks to support multi-task training. Tested across ten diverse 3D-VL datasets, demonstrates impressive performance on these tasks, setting new records on most benchmarks. Particularly, improves the state-of-the-art on ScanNet200 by 4.9% (AP25), ScanRefer by 5.4% (acc@0.5), Multi3DRefer by 11.7% (F1@0.5), and Scan2Cap by 13.4% (CIDEr@0.5). Moreover, supports flexible inference with individual or combined forms of available 3D representations, , solely voxel input.

title: 面向场景级监督的2D-3D交织变换器用于点云分割
title_en: 2D-3D Interlaced Transformer for Point Cloud Segmentation with Scene-Level Supervision
abstract: 我们提出了一种多模态交织变换器(MIT),通过仅使用场景级类别标签对弱监督点云分割进行联合2D和3D数据处理。研究显示,2D和3D特征在点云分割中具有互补性。然而,现有方法需要额外的2D标注才能实现2D-3D信息融合。考虑到点云的高标注成本,基于弱监督学习的有效2D和3D特征融合需求迫切。为此,我们提出了一种仅使用场景级类别标签的弱监督点云分割变换器模型,包含两个编码器和一个解码器。具体而言,两个编码器分别计算3D点云和2D多视角图像的自注意力特征。解码器实现交织的2D-3D交叉注意力,并进行隐式的2D和3D特征融合。我们在解码器层中交替切换查询与键值对的角色。结果表明,2D和3D特征通过相互迭代增强而得到丰富。实验显示,该方法在S3DIS和ScanNet基准上显著优于现有弱监督点云分割方法。
abstract_en: We present a Multimodal Interlaced Transformer (MIT) that jointly considers 2D and 3D data for weakly supervised point cloud segmentation. Research studies have shown that 2D and 3D features are complementary for point cloud segmentation. However, existing methods require extra 2D annotations to achieve 2D-3D information fusion. Considering the high annotation cost of point clouds, effective 2D and 3D feature fusion based on weakly supervised learning is in great demand. To this end, we propose a transformer model with two encoders and one decoder for weakly supervised point cloud segmentation using only scene-level class tags. Specifically, the two encoders compute the self-attended features for 3D point clouds and 2D multi-view images, respectively. The decoder implements interlaced 2D-3D cross-attention and carries out implicit 2D and 3D feature fusion. We alternately switch the roles of queries and key-value pairs in the decoder layers. It turns out that the 2D and 3D features are iteratively enriched by each other. Experiments show that it performs favorably against existing weakly supervised point cloud segmentation methods by a large margin on the S3DIS and ScanNet benchmarks.
authors: Cheng-Kun Yang, Min-Hung Chen, Yung-Yu Chuang, Yen-Yu Lin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 977-987

title: 2D3D-MATR:用于图像与点云无需检测配准的2D-3D匹配变换器
title_en: 2D3D-MATR: 2D-3D Matching Transformer for Detection-Free Registration Between Images and Point Clouds
abstract: 传统采用先检测后匹配的配准方法在跨模态情况下因关键点检测不兼容和特征描述不一致而面临困难。我们提出2D3D-MATR,一种无需检测的图像与点云配准方法,可实现准确且鲁棒的配准。我们的方法采用粗到细的流程,首先计算输入图像下采样块与点云之间的粗略对应关系,然后将其扩展为块区域内的像素与点的密集对应关系。粗粒度块匹配基于变换器,通过自注意力联合学习全局上下文约束,并通过跨注意力学习跨模态相关性。为解决块匹配中的尺度歧义,我们为每个图像块构建多尺度金字塔,在适当分辨率层级上学习为每个点块找到最佳匹配图像块。在两个公开基准上的大量实验表明,2D3D-MATR在内点比例上比先前最先进的P2-Net高出约20个百分点,在配准召回率上高出超过10个百分点。我们的代码和模型将公开发布。
abstract_en: The commonly adopted detect-then-match approach to registration finds difficulties in the cross-modality cases due to the incompatible keypoint detection and inconsistent feature description. We propose, 2D3D-MATR, a detection-free method for accurate and robust registration between images and point clouds. Our method adopts a coarse-to-fine pipeline where it first computes coarse correspondences between downsampled patches of the input image and the point cloud and then extends them to form dense correspondences between pixels and points within the patch region. The coarse-level patch matching is based on transformer which jointly learns global contextual constraints with self-attention and cross-modality correlations with cross-attention. To resolve the scale ambiguity in patch matching, we construct a multi-scale pyramid for each image patch and learn to find for each point patch the best matching image patch at a proper resolution level. Extensive experiments on two public benchmarks demonstrate that 2D3D-MATR outperforms the previous state-of-the-art P2-Net by around 20 percentage points on inlier ratio and over 10 points on registration recall. Our code and models will be publicly released.
authors: Minhao Li, Zheng Qin, Zhirui Gao, Renjiao Yi, Chenyang Zhu, Yulan Guo, Kai Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14128-14138

title: 360VOT:全方位视觉目标跟踪新基准数据集
title_en: 360VOT: A New Benchmark Dataset for Omnidirectional Visual Object Tracking
abstract: 360度图像可提供全方位视野,这对于稳定和长期的场景感知至关重要。本文探索使用360度图像进行视觉目标跟踪,并识别出由大畸变、拼接伪影及其他360度图像独特属性引发的新挑战。为缓解这些问题,我们采用目标定位的新表示方法,即包围视野,并引入一种通用的360度跟踪框架,该框架可采用典型跟踪器进行全方位跟踪。更重要的是,我们提出一个新的大规模全方位跟踪基准数据集360VOT,以促进未来研究。360VOT包含120个序列,等距圆柱投影下最高可达113,000高分辨率帧。跟踪目标覆盖32个类别,涵盖多种场景。此外,我们提供了4种无偏的地面真实数据,包括(旋转)包围框和(旋转)包围视野,以及专为360度图像设计的新评估指标,从而实现全方位跟踪性能的准确评估。最后,我们对20种最先进的视觉跟踪器进行了广泛评估,并提供了未来比较的新基准。Homepage: https://360vot.hkustvgd.com
abstract_en: 360deg images can provide an omnidirectional field of view which is important for stable and long-term scene perception. In this paper, we explore 360deg images for visual object tracking and perceive new challenges caused by large distortion, stitching artifacts, and other unique attributes of 360deg images. To alleviate these problems, we take advantage of novel representations of target localization, i.e., bounding field-of-view, and then introduce a general 360 tracking framework that can adopt typical trackers for omnidirectional tracking. More importantly, we propose a new large-scale omnidirectional tracking benchmark dataset, 360VOT, in order to facilitate future research. 360VOT contains 120 sequences with up to 113K high-resolution frames in equirectangular projection. And the tracking targets cover 32 categories in diverse scenarios. Moreover, we provide 4 types of unbiased ground truth, including (rotated) bounding boxes and (rotated) bounding field-of-views, as well as new metrics tailored for 360deg images which allow accurate evaluation of omnidirectional tracking performance. Finally, we extensively evaluated 20 state-of-the-art visual trackers and provided a new baseline for future comparisons. Homepage: https://360vot.hkustvgd.com
authors: Huajian Huang, Yinzhe Xu, Yingshu Chen, Sai-Kit Yeung ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20566-20576

title: 3D蒸馏:改进反射表面上单目自监督深度估计
title_en: 3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation on Reflective Surfaces
abstract: 单目自监督深度估计(SSMDE)旨在通过训练过程中利用空间邻近图像对学习最小化光度损失,预测单目图像的密集深度图。尽管SSMDE相比监督方法具有显著的可扩展性优势,但在反射表面上表现较差,因为光度损失的光度恒定性假设被违反。我们注意到反射表面的外观具有视角依赖性,且训练数据中往往存在未受强镜面反射污染的此类表面视角。因此,可以通过聚合这些视角的预测深度准确重建反射表面。受此观察启发,我们提出3D蒸馏:一种新颖的训练框架,利用重建反射表面的投影深度生成合理准确的深度伪标签。为自动识别这些表面,我们采用不确定性引导的深度融合方法,结合反射表面上更平滑且更准确的投影深度与其它区域的详细预测深度。在使用ScanNet和7-Scenes数据集的实验中,我们证明3D蒸馏不仅显著提升了预测准确性,特别是在问题表面,而且其在各种底层网络架构和新数据集上的泛化能力也表现良好。
abstract_en: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation (SSMDE) aims at predicting the dense depth maps of monocular images, by learning to minimize a photometric loss using spatially neighboring image pairs during training. While SSMDE offers a significant scalability advantage over supervised approaches, it performs poorly on reflective surfaces as the photometric constancy assumption of the photometric loss is violated. We note that the appearance of reflective surfaces is view-dependent and often there are views of such surfaces in the training data that are not contaminated by strong specular reflections. Thus, reflective surfaces can be accurately reconstructed by aggregating the predicted depth of these views. Motivated by this observation, we propose 3D distillation: a novel training framework that utilizes the projected depth of reconstructed reflective surfaces to generate reasonably accurate depth pseudo-labels. To identify those surfaces automatically, we employ an uncertainty-guided depth fusion method, combining the smoother and more accurate projected depth on reflective surfaces and the detailed predicted depth elsewhere. In our experiments using the ScanNet and 7-Scenes datasets, we show that 3D distillation not only significantly improves the prediction accuracy, especially on the problematic surfaces, but also that it generalizes well over various underlying network architectures and to new datasets.
authors: Xuepeng Shi, Georgi Dikov, Gerhard Reitmayr, Tae-Kyun Kim, Mohsen Ghafoorian ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9133-9143

title: 基于顺序全局旋转估计的三维人体网格恢复
title_en: 3D Human Mesh Recovery with Sequentially Global Rotation Estimation
abstract: 基于模型的三维人体网格恢复旨在通过从单目RGB图像中估计其参数来重建三维人体网格。大多数近期工作采用皮肤化多人物线性(SMPL)模型,沿运动学链回归每个身体关节的相对旋转。该流程需要将每个相对旋转矩阵转换为全局旋转矩阵以表达标准网格,并且沿运动学链存在累积误差问题。本文提出直接估计每个关节的全局旋转以避免误差累积并追求更高精度。所提出的顺序全局旋转估计(SGRE)直接预测运动学链上每个关节的全局旋转矩阵。SGRE包含残差学习模块,利用互补特征和父关节先前预测的旋转来指导后续子关节的估计。得益于该全局估计流程和残差学习模块,SGRE缓解了误差累积问题并生成更精确的三维人体网格。它可灵活集成到现有基于回归的方法中,并在各类基准测试中取得优越性能。例如,在3DPW数据集上,它将最新方法3DCrowdNet的MPJPE改进了3.3 mm,PVE改进了5.0 mm;在COCO数据集上,AP值提升了3.2。
abstract_en: Model-based 3D human mesh recovery aims to reconstruct a 3D human body mesh by estimating its parameters from monocular RGB images. Most of recent works adopt the Skinned Multi-Person Linear (SMPL) model to regress relative rotations for each body joint along the kinematics chain. This pipeline needs to transform each relative rotation matrix into a global rotation matrix to articulate the canonical mesh, and suffers from accumulated errors along the kinematics chain. This paper proposes to directly estimate the global rotation of each joint to avoid error accumulation and pursue better accuracy. The proposed Sequentially Global Rotation Estimation (SGRE) directly predicts the global rotation matrix of each joint on the kinematics chain. SGRE features a residual learning module to leverage complementary features and previously predicted rotations of parent joints to guide the estimation of subsequent child joints. Thanks to this global estimation pipeline and residual learning module, SGRE alleviates error accumulation and produces more accurate 3D human mesh. It can be flexibly integrated into existing regression-based methods and achieves superior performance on various benchmarks. For example, it improves the latest method 3DCrowdNet by 3.3 mm MPJPE and 5.0 mm PVE on 3DPW dataset and 3.2 AP on COCO dataset, respectively.
authors: Dongkai Wang, Shiliang Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14953-14962

title: 用于时间一致关键点发现的3D隐式传输器
title_en: 3D Implicit Transporter for Temporally Consistent Keypoint Discovery
abstract: 基于关键点的表示方法在各种视觉和机器人任务中已被证明具有优势。然而,现有的2D和3D关键点检测方法主要依赖几何一致性来实现空间对齐,忽略了时间一致性。为了解决这一问题,针对2D数据引入了传输方法,该方法从源帧重建目标帧,以结合空间和时间信息。然而,由于3D点云与2D图像在结构上的差异,直接将传输方法应用于3D点云是不可行的。因此,我们提出了传输器的第一个3D版本,该版本利用混合3D表示、交叉注意力机制和隐式重建。我们将这一新的学习系统应用于3D刚体对象/人类,并展示了所学关键点的时空一致性。此外,我们提出了一种利用所学关键点进行3D物体操作的控制策略,并展示了其优越的性能。我们的代码、数据和模型将公开发布。
abstract_en: Keypoint-based representation has proven advantageous in various visual and robotic tasks. However, the existing 2D and 3D methods for detecting keypoints mainly rely on geometric consistency to achieve spatial alignment, neglecting temporal consistency. To address this issue, the Transporter method was introduced for 2D data, which reconstructs the target frame from the source frame to incorporate both spatial and temporal information. However, the direct application of the Transporter to 3D point clouds is infeasible due to their structural differences from 2D images. Thus, we propose the first 3D version of the Transporter, which leverages hybrid 3D representation, cross attention, and implicit reconstruction. We apply this new learning system on 3D articulated objects/humans and show that learned keypoints are spatiotemporal consistent. Additionally, we propose a control policy that utilizes the learned keypoints for 3D object manipulation and demonstrate its superior performance. Our codes, data, and models will be made publicly available.
authors: Chengliang Zhong, Yuhang Zheng, Yupeng Zheng, Hao Zhao, Li Yi, Xiaodong Mu, Ling Wang, Pengfei Li, Guyue Zhou, Chao Yang, Xinliang Zhang, Jian Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3869-3880

title: 通过增强的空间与语义监督的三维实例分割
title_en: 3D Instance Segmentation via Enhanced Spatial and Semantic Supervision
abstract: 三维实例分割近期受到越来越多的关注。典型深度学习方法采用点分组方案后接手工设计的几何聚类。受变压器在各类3D任务中取得成功启发,新型混合方法采用变压器解码器与卷积主干网络结合,处理体素化场景。然而,由于稀疏特征主干的特性,提供给变压器解码器的特征缺乏空间理解能力,导致此类方法常将空间分离的对象预测为单一实例。为此,我们提出一种新型三维点云实例分割方法,解决外观相似但空间分离物体生成不同实例掩码的挑战。该方法通过空间与语义监督结合查询细化,提升混合三维实例分割模型性能。具体而言,我们为变压器模块提供空间特征以区分相似物体查询,并通过语义监督提升基于物体类别的预测精度。所提方法在ScanNet V2和ScanNet200数据集验证集上超越现有方法,建立该任务的新最先进水平。
abstract_en: 3D instance segmentation has recently garnered increased attention. Typical deep learning methods adopt point grouping schemes followed by hand-designed geometric clustering. Inspired by the success of transformers for various 3D tasks, newer hybrid approaches have utilized transformer decoders coupled with convolutional backbones that operate on voxelized scenes. However, due to the nature of sparse feature backbones, the extracted features provided to the transformer decoder are lacking in spatial understanding. Thus, such approaches often predict spatially separate objects as single instances. To this end, we introduce a novel approach for 3D point clouds instance segmentation that addresses the challenge of generating distinct instance masks for objects that share similar appearances but are spatially separated. Our method leverages spatial and semantic supervision with query refinement to improve the performance of hybrid 3D instance segmentation models. Specifically, we provide the transformer block with spatial features to facilitate differentiation between similar object queries and incorporate semantic supervision to enhance prediction accuracy based on object class. Our proposed approach outperforms existing methods on the validation sets of ScanNet V2 and ScanNet200 datasets, establishing a new state-of-the-art for this task.
authors: Salwa Al Khatib, Mohamed El Amine Boudjoghra, Jean Lahoud, Fahad Shahbaz Khan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 541-550

title: 3D运动放大:从时变辐射场中可视化细微运动
title_en: 3D Motion Magnification: Visualizing Subtle Motions from Time-Varying Radiance Fields
abstract: 运动放大技术帮助我们可视化细微且难以察觉的运动。然而,现有方法仅适用于固定相机拍摄的2D视频。我们提出了一种3D运动放大方法,能够放大由移动相机捕获场景中的细微运动,同时支持新视角渲染。我们使用时变辐射场表示场景,并利用欧拉原理进行运动放大,以提取并增强固定点随时间变化的嵌入表示的差异。我们通过隐式和基于三平面的辐射场作为底层3D场景表示,研究并验证了所提出的3D运动放大原理。我们在不同相机设置下合成和真实场景中评估了该方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Motion magnification helps us visualize subtle, imperceptible motion. However, prior methods only work for 2D videos captured with a fixed camera. We present a 3D motion magnification method that can magnify subtle motions from scenes captured by a moving camera, while supporting novel view rendering. We represent the scene with time-varying radiance fields and leverage the Eulerian principle for motion magnification to extract and amplify the variation of the embedding of a fixed point over time. We study and validate our proposed principle for 3D motion magnification using both implicit and tri-plane-based radiance fields as our underlying 3D scene representation. We evaluate the effectiveness of our method on both synthetic and real-world scenes captured under various camera setups.
authors: Brandon Y. Feng, Hadi Alzayer, Michael Rubinstein, William T. Freeman, Jia-bin Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9837-9846

title: 3D神经嵌入似然:用于鲁棒6自由度姿态估计的概率逆图形
title_en: 3D Neural Embedding Likelihood: Probabilistic Inverse Graphics for Robust 6D Pose Estimation
abstract: 感知和理解三维场景对于计算机视觉和机器人领域的许多应用至关重要。逆图形方法是一种引人注目的三维场景理解途径,旨在从二维图像推断三维场景结构。本文将概率建模引入逆图形框架,以量化不确定性并实现6自由度姿态估计任务的鲁棒性。具体而言,我们提出3D神经嵌入似然(3DNEL)作为覆盖RGB-D图像的统一概率模型,并开发针对三维场景描述的高效推断过程。3DNEL有效结合了从RGB图像中学习的神经嵌入与深度信息,从而提升RGB-D图像在仿真到现实的6自由度物体姿态估计中的鲁棒性。在YCB-Video数据集上的表现与最先进方法相当,但在挑战性场景中具有显著更高的鲁棒性。与判别方法不同,3DNEL的概率生成式框架联合建模场景中的多个物体,以原理化方式量化不确定性,并在严重遮挡条件下处理物体姿态跟踪。最后,3DNEL提供了一个原理化框架,用于融合对场景和物体的先验知识,这使得自然扩展到诸如从视频中进行相机姿态跟踪等附加任务成为可能。
abstract_en: The ability to perceive and understand 3D scenes is crucial for many applications in computer vision and robotics. Inverse graphics is an appealing approach to 3D scene understanding that aims to infer the 3D scene structure from 2D images. In this paper, we introduce probabilistic modeling to the inverse graphics framework to quantify uncertainty and achieve robustness in 6D pose estimation tasks. Specifically, we propose 3D Neural Embedding Likelihood (3DNEL) as a unified probabilistic model over RGB-D images, and develop efficient inference procedures on 3D scene descriptions. 3DNEL effectively combines learned neural embeddings from RGB with depth information to improve robustness in sim-to-real 6D object pose estimation from RGB-D images. Performance on the YCB-Video dataset is on par with state-of-the-art yet is much more robust in challenging regimes. In contrast to discriminative approaches, 3DNEL's probabilistic generative formulation jointly models multiple objects in a scene, quantifies uncertainty in a principled way, and handles object pose tracking under heavy occlusion. Finally, 3DNEL provides a principled framework for incorporating prior knowledge about the scene and objects, which allows natural extension to additional tasks like camera pose tracking from video.
authors: Guangyao Zhou, Nishad Gothoskar, Lirui Wang, Joshua B. Tenenbaum, Dan Gutfreund, Miguel Lázaro-Gredilla, Dileep George, Vikash K. Mansinghka ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21625-21636

title: 基于合成数据的点云中人体三维分割
title_en: 3D Segmentation of Humans in Point Clouds with Synthetic Data
abstract: 随着以人类为中心的机器人技术和增强现实/虚拟现实应用的兴起,对人体在三维室内场景中的分割变得越来越重要。为此,我们提出了联合三维人体语义分割、实例分割和多人体部位分割的任务。目前很少有工作直接尝试对人体在杂乱的三维场景中进行分割,这主要是由于缺乏人体与三维场景交互的标注训练数据。我们解决了这一挑战,并提出了一种生成合成人体与真实三维场景交互训练数据的框架。此外,我们提出了一种新颖的基于Transformer的模型Human3D,这是首个能够统一分割多个人体实例及其身体部位的端到端模型。我们合成数据生成框架的关键优势在于其能够生成多样且逼真的人体-场景交互,具有高度准确的地面真实数据。实验表明,在合成数据上进行预训练可以提升多种三维人体分割任务的性能。最后,我们证明Human3D在性能上超越了甚至专门任务的最先进三维分割方法。
abstract_en: Segmenting humans in 3D indoor scenes has become increasingly important with the rise of human-centered robotics and AR/VR applications. To this end, we propose the task of joint 3D human semantic segmentation, instance segmentation and multi-human body-part segmentation. Few works have attempted to directly segment humans in cluttered 3D scenes, which is largely due to the lack of annotated training data of humans interacting with 3D scenes. We address this challenge and propose a framework for generating training data of synthetic humans interacting with real 3D scenes. Furthermore, we propose a novel transformer-based model, Human3D, which is the first end-to-end model for segmenting multiple human instances and their body-parts in a unified manner. The key advantage of our synthetic data generation framework is its ability to generate diverse and realistic human-scene interactions, with highly accurate ground truth. Our experiments show that pre-training on synthetic data improves performance on a wide variety of 3D human segmentation tasks. Finally, we demonstrate that Human3D outperforms even task-specific state-of-the-art 3D segmentation methods.
authors: Ayça Takmaz, Jonas Schult, Irem Kaftan, Mertcan Akçay, Bastian Leibe, Robert Sumner, Francis Engelmann, Siyu Tang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1292-1304

title: 三维语义子空间遍历器:赋予三维生成模型形状编辑能力
title_en: 3D Semantic Subspace Traverser: Empowering 3D Generative Model with Shape Editing Capability
abstract: 形状生成是为三维内容创作生成各种三维形状表示的方法。先前关于三维形状生成的研究主要关注形状质量和结构,较少考虑语义信息的重要性。因此,此类生成模型往往无法保持形状结构的语义一致性,或在生成过程中无法操控形状的语义属性。本文提出了一种新型语义生成模型,名为三维语义子空间遍历器,该模型利用语义属性实现特定类别的三维形状生成与编辑。我们的方法采用隐式函数作为三维形状表示,并结合新颖的潜在空间GAN与线性子空间模型,在三维形状的局部潜在空间中发现语义维度。每个子空间维度对应特定的语义属性,通过遍历这些维度的系数可编辑生成形状的属性。实验结果表明,我们的方法能够生成具有复杂结构的合理形状,并实现语义属性的编辑。代码和训练模型可在https://github.com/TrepangCat/3D_Semantic_Subspace_Traverser获取。
abstract_en: Shape generation is the practice of producing 3D shapes as various representations for 3D content creation. Previous studies on 3D shape generation have focused on shape quality and structure, without or less considering the importance of semantic information. Consequently, such generative models often fail to preserve the semantic consistency of shape structure or enable manipulation of the semantic attributes of shapes during generation. In this paper, we proposed a novel semantic generative model named 3D Semantic Subspace Traverser that utilizes semantic attributes for category-specific 3D shape generation and editing. Our method utilizes implicit functions as the 3D shape representation and combines a novel latent-space GAN with a linear subspace model to discover semantic dimensions in the local latent space of 3D shapes. Each dimension of the subspace corresponds to a particular semantic attribute, and we can edit the attributes of generated shapes by traversing the coefficients of those dimensions. Experimental results demonstrate that our method can produce plausible shapes with complex structures and enable the editing of semantic attributes. The code and trained models are available at https://github.com/TrepangCat/3D_Semantic_Subspace_Traverser.
authors: Ruowei Wang, Yu Liu, Pei Su, Jianwei Zhang, Qijun Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14406-14417

title: 三维VR草图引导的三维形状原型设计与探索
title_en: 3D VR Sketch Guided 3D Shape Prototyping and Exploration
abstract: 三维形状建模是一项耗时且需要多年专业技能的工作。为促进三维形状建模,我们提出了一种以三维VR草图为条件的三维形状生成网络。我们假设这些草图由未经艺术训练的初学者创建,并旨在重建给定类别的几何上真实的三维形状。为处理潜在的草图歧义,我们的方法生成多个与原始草图结构一致的三维形状。我们精心设计了该方法,分步骤训练模型,并利用多模态三维形状表示来支持有限训练数据下的训练。为确保生成的三维形状的真实性,我们利用归一化流来建模三维形状的潜在空间分布。为鼓励生成的三维形状与输入草图的一致性,我们提出了一种专用的损失函数,并在训练的不同阶段部署该损失函数。代码可在 https://github.com/Rowl1ng/3Dsketch2shape 获取。
abstract_en: 3D shape modeling is labor-intensive, time-consuming, and requires years of expertise. To facilitate 3D shape modeling, we propose a 3D shape generation network that takes a 3D VR sketch as a condition. We assume that sketches are created by novices without art training and aim to reconstruct geometrically realistic 3D shapes of a given category. To handle potential sketch ambiguity, our method creates multiple 3D shapes that align with the original sketch's structure. We carefully design our method, training the model step-by-step and leveraging multi-modal 3D shape representation to support training with limited training data. To guarantee the realism of generated 3D shapes we leverage the normalizing flow that models the distribution of the latent space of 3D shapes. To encourage the fidelity of the generated 3D shapes to an input sketch, we propose a dedicated loss that we deploy at different stages of the training process. The code is available at https://github.com/Rowl1ng/3Dsketch2shape.
authors: Ling Luo, Pinaki Nath Chowdhury, Tao Xiang, Yi-Zhe Song, Yulia Gryaditskaya ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9267-9276

title: 面向改进侧视图图像合成的三维感知生成模型
title_en: 3D-Aware Generative Model for Improved Side-View Image Synthesis
abstract: 尽管近期的三维感知生成模型在多视角一致性方面已展现出照片级真实的图像合成能力,但合成图像质量会随相机姿态变化而退化(例如侧视角下人脸边界模糊且噪声显著)。这种退化主要源于从严重不平衡姿态分布的数据集中同时学习姿态一致性和照片真实性的困难。本文提出SideGAN,一种新型三维生成对抗网络(GAN)训练方法,能够生成与相机姿态无关的逼真图像,尤其针对侧视角角度的人脸。为缓解学习逼真且姿态一致图像合成的挑战性问题,我们将问题拆分为两个子问题,每个子问题均可更易求解。具体而言,我们将问题建模为两个简单判别任务的组合:其一学习判断合成图像是否逼真,其二学习判断合成图像是否符合相机姿态。基于此,我们提出包含两个判别分支的双分支判别器。此外,我们提出姿态匹配损失以学习三维GAN的姿态一致性。同时,我们设计姿态采样策略以提升姿态不平衡数据集中陡峭角度的学习机会。通过广泛验证,我们证明该方法使三维GAN能够生成高质量几何结构和逼真图像,无论相机姿态如何。
abstract_en: While recent 3D-aware generative models have shown photo-realistic image synthesis with multi-view consistency, the synthesized image quality degrades depending on the camera pose (e.g., a face with a blurry and noisy boundary at a side viewpoint). Such degradation is mainly caused by the difficulty of learning both pose consistency and photo-realism simultaneously from a dataset with heavily imbalanced poses. In this paper, we propose SideGAN, a novel 3D GAN training method to generate photo-realistic images irrespective of the camera pose, especially for faces of side-view angles. To ease the challenging problem of learning photo-realistic and pose-consistent image synthesis, we split the problem into two subproblems, each of which can be solved more easily. Specifically, we formulate the problem as a combination of two simple discrimination problems, one of which learns to discriminate whether a synthesized image looks real or not, and the other learns to discriminate whether a synthesized image agrees with the camera pose. Based on this, we propose a dual-branched discriminator with two discrimination branches. We also propose a pose-matching loss to learn the pose consistency of 3D GANs. In addition, we present a pose sampling strategy to increase learning opportunities for steep angles in a pose-imbalanced dataset. With extensive validation, we demonstrate that our approach enables 3D GANs to generate high-quality geometries and photo-realistic images irrespective of the camera pose.
authors: Kyungmin Jo, Wonjoon Jin, Jaegul Choo, Hyunjoon Lee, Sunghyun Cho ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22862-22872

title: 面向遮挡鲁棒的三维人体姿态估计的三维感知神经体拟合
title_en: 3D-Aware Neural Body Fitting for Occlusion Robust 3D Human Pose Estimation
abstract: 基于回归的三维人体姿态估计方法通过深度网络直接从2D图像预测三维姿态参数。尽管在标准基准上实现了最先进性能,但其在遮挡场景下性能会下降。相比之下,基于优化的方法通过迭代方式将参数化身体模型拟合到2D特征。局部重建损失可能使其对遮挡具有鲁棒性,但会受到2D-3D歧义的影响。受生成模型在刚性物体姿态估计中近期成功应用的启发,我们提出3D-aware Neural Body Fitting(3DNBF)——一种具有最先进性能和遮挡鲁棒性的三维人体姿态估计的近似分析-综合方法。具体而言,我们提出基于体积人体表示和高斯椭球核发射三维姿态依赖特征向量的深度特征生成模型。神经特征通过对比学习训练以实现三维感知,从而克服2D-3D歧义。实验表明,3DNBF在遮挡和标准基准上均优于其他方法。
abstract_en: Regression-based methods for 3D human pose estimation directly predict the 3D pose parameters from a 2D image using deep networks. While achieving state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks, their performance degrades under occlusion. In contrast, optimization-based methods fit a parametric body model to 2D features in an iterative manner. The localized reconstruction loss can potentially make them robust to occlusion, but they suffer from the 2D-3D ambiguity. Motivated by the recent success of generative models in rigid object pose estimation, we propose 3D-aware Neural Body Fitting (3DNBF) - an approximate analysis-by-synthesis approach to 3D human pose estimation with SOTA performance and occlusion robustness. In particular, we propose a generative model of deep features based on a volumetric human representation with Gaussian ellipsoidal kernels emitting 3D pose-dependent feature vectors. The neural features are trained with contrastive learning to become 3D-aware and hence to overcome the 2D-3D ambiguity. Experiments show that 3DNBF outperforms other approaches on both occluded and standard benchmarks.
authors: Yi Zhang, Pengliang Ji, Angtian Wang, Jieru Mei, Adam Kortylewski, Alan Yuille ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9399-9410

title: 3D-VisTA:面向三维视觉与文本对齐的预训练Transformer
title_en: 3D-VisTA: Pre-trained Transformer for 3D Vision and Text Alignment
abstract: 三维视觉-语言接地(3D-VL)是一个新兴领域,旨在将三维物理世界与自然语言连接,这对于实现具身智能至关重要。当前的3D-VL模型高度依赖复杂的模块、辅助损失函数和优化技巧,这呼唤一个简单且统一的模型。本文提出3D-VisTA,一种面向三维视觉与文本对齐的预训练Transformer,可轻松适配各类下游任务。3D-VisTA仅通过自注意力层实现单模态建模和多模态融合,无需任何复杂的任务特定设计。为进一步提升其在3D-VL任务上的性能,我们构建了ScanScribe,首个面向3D-VL预训练的大规模三维场景-文本对数据集。ScanScribe包含来自ScanNet和3R-Scan数据集的2,995个RGB-D扫描,涵盖1,185个独特室内场景,以及278K个场景描述,这些描述由现有3D-VL任务、模板和GPT-3生成。3D-VisTA通过掩码语言/对象建模和场景-文本匹配在ScanScribe上进行预训练,在视觉接地、问答到情境推理等多种3D-VL任务上取得最先进结果。此外,3D-VisTA展现出卓越的数据效率,在下游任务微调时即使标注有限也能保持强劲性能。
abstract_en: 3D vision-language grounding (3D-VL) is an emerging field that aims to connect the 3D physical world with natural language, which is crucial for achieving embodied intelligence. Current 3D-VL models rely heavily on sophisticated modules, auxiliary losses, and optimization tricks, which calls for a simple and unified model. In this paper, we propose 3D-VisTA, a pre-trained Transformer for 3D Vis ion and Text Alignment that can be easily adapted to various downstream tasks. 3D-VisTA simply utilizes self-attention layers for both single-modal modeling and multi-modal fusion without any sophisticated task-specific design. To further enhance its performance on 3D-VL tasks, we construct ScanScribe, the first large-scale 3D scene-text pairs dataset for 3D-VL pre-training. ScanScribe contains 2,995 RGB-D scans for 1,185 unique indoor scenes originating from ScanNet and 3R-Scan datasets, along with paired 278K scene descriptions generated from existing 3D-VL tasks, templates, and GPT-3. 3D-VisTA is pre-trained on ScanScribe via masked language/object modeling and scene-text matching. It achieves state-of-the-art results on various 3D-VL tasks, ranging from visual grounding and question answering to situated reasoning. Moreover, 3D-VisTA demonstrates superior data efficiency, obtaining strong performance even with limited annotations during downstream task fine-tuning.
authors: Ziyu Zhu, Xiaojian Ma, Yixin Chen, Zhidong Deng, Siyuan Huang, Qing Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2911-2921

title: 基于生成NeRF的三维感知融合
title_en: 3D-aware Blending with Generative NeRFs
abstract: 图像融合旨在无缝地结合多张图像。现有基于二维的方法在处理此类问题时仍面临挑战,尤其是在输入图像因三维相机姿态和物体形状差异而错位的情况下。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种基于生成神经辐射场(NeRF)的三维感知融合方法,包含两个关键组件:三维感知对齐和三维感知融合。对于三维感知对齐,我们首先估计参考图像相对于生成NeRF的相机姿态,然后进行物体姿态对齐。为进一步利用生成NeRF的三维信息,我们提出三维感知融合方法,该方法利用体密度并在NeRF的潜在空间中进行融合,而非原始像素空间。综合来看,我们的方法在FFHQ和AFHQ-Cat数据集上的大量定量和定性评估中均优于现有二维基线。
abstract_en: Image blending aims to combine multiple images seamlessly. It remains challenging for existing 2D-based methods, especially when input images are misaligned due to differences in 3D camera poses and object shapes. To tackle these issues, we propose a 3D-aware blending method using generative Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), including two key components: 3D-aware alignment and 3D-aware blending. For 3D-aware alignment, we first estimate the camera pose of the reference image with respect to generative NeRFs and then perform pose alignment for objects. To further leverage 3D information of the generative NeRF, we propose 3D-aware blending that utilizes volume density and blends on the NeRF's latent space, rather than raw pixel space. Collectively, our method outperforms existing 2D baselines, as validated by extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations with FFHQ and AFHQ-Cat.
authors: Hyunsu Kim, Gayoung Lee, Yunjey Choi, Jin-Hwa Kim, Jun-Yan Zhu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22906-22918

title: 基于二维扩散模型的三维感知图像生成方法
title_en: 3D-aware Image Generation using 2D Diffusion Models
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的三维感知图像生成方法,该方法利用二维扩散模型。我们将三维感知图像生成任务形式化为多视角二维图像集生成,并进一步转化为顺序的无条件-有条件多视角图像生成过程。这使得我们能够利用二维扩散模型增强方法的生成建模能力。此外,我们结合单目深度估计器的深度信息,仅使用静态图像构建条件扩散模型的训练数据。我们在大规模非结构化数据集ImageNet上训练该方法,该数据集未被先前方法处理。该方法生成的高质量图像显著优于先前方法。此外,我们的方法展示了其生成大视角角度实例的能力,尽管训练图像多样且未对齐,来源于"真实世界"环境中的野外数据。
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce a novel 3D-aware image generation method that leverages 2D diffusion models. We formulate the 3D-aware image generation task as multiview 2D image set generation, and further to a sequential unconditional-conditional multiview image generation process. This allows us to utilize 2D diffusion models to boost the generative modelling power of the method. Additionally, we incorporate depth information from monocular depth estimators to construct the training data for the conditional diffusion model using only still images. We train our method on a large-scale unstructured dataset, i.e., ImageNet, which is not addressed by previous methods. It produces high-quality images that significantly outperform prior methods. Furthermore, our approach showcases its capability to generate instances with large view angles, even though the training images are diverse and unaligned, gathered from "in-the-wild" real-world environments.
authors: Jianfeng Xiang, Jiaolong Yang, Binbin Huang, Xin Tong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2383-2393

title: 3DHacker:基于频谱的硬标签3D点云攻击决策边界生成方法
title_en: 3DHacker: Spectrum-based Decision Boundary Generation for Hard-label 3D Point Cloud Attack
abstract: 随着深度传感器的成熟,3D点云模型的脆弱性在自动驾驶、机器人导航等应用中受到了越来越多的关注。先前的3D对抗攻击者要么遵循白盒设置,基于梯度迭代更新坐标扰动,要么利用输出模型logits在黑盒设置中估计噪声梯度。然而,这些攻击方法难以部署在现实场景中,因为真实的3D应用不会向用户共享任何模型细节。因此,我们探索了一个更具挑战性但更实用的3D攻击设置,即使用黑盒硬标签攻击点云,在这种设置下攻击者只能访问输入的预测标签。为应对这一设置,我们提出了一种基于开发的决策边界算法的新型3D攻击方法,称为3D硬标签攻击者(3DHacker),仅通过类别标签知识生成对抗样本。具体而言,为构建类别感知的模型决策边界,3DHacker首先在频谱域中随机融合两个不同类别的点云,生成具有高不可察觉性的中间样本,然后通过二分查找将其投影到决策边界。为限制最终扰动大小,3DHacker进一步引入迭代优化策略,沿决策边界移动中间样本,生成具有最小微小扰动的对抗点云。大量评估表明,即使在具有挑战性的硬标签设置下,3DHacker在攻击性能和对抗样本质量方面仍优于现有3D攻击方法。
abstract_en: With the maturity of depth sensors, the vulnerability of 3D point cloud models has received increasing attention in various applications such as autonomous driving and robot navigation. Previous 3D adversarial attackers either follow the white-box setting to iteratively update the coordinate perturbations based on gradients, or utilize the output model logits to estimate noisy gradients in the black-box setting. However, these attack methods are hard to be deployed in real-world scenarios since realistic 3D applications will not share any model details to users. Therefore, we explore a more challenging yet practical 3D attack setting, i.e., attacking point clouds with black-box hard labels, in which the attacker can only have access to the prediction label of the input. To tackle this setting, we propose a novel 3D attack method, termed 3D Hard-label attacker (3DHacker), based on the developed decision boundary algorithm to generate adversarial samples solely with the knowledge of class labels. Specifically, to construct the class-aware model decision boundary, 3DHacker first randomly fuses two point clouds of different classes in the spectral domain to craft their intermediate sample with high imperceptibility, then projects it onto the decision boundary via binary search. To restrict the final perturbation size, 3DHacker further introduces an iterative optimization strategy to move the intermediate sample along the decision boundary for generating adversarial point clouds with smallest trivial perturbations. Extensive evaluations show that, even in the challenging hard-label setting, 3DHacker still competitively outperforms existing 3D attacks regarding the attack performance as well as adversary quality.
authors: Yunbo Tao, Daizong Liu, Pan Zhou, Yulai Xie, Wei Du, Wei Hu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14340-14350

title: 3DHumanGAN:基于三维姿态映射的三维感知人体图像生成
title_en: 3DHumanGAN: 3D-Aware Human Image Generation with 3D Pose Mapping
abstract: 我们提出3DHumanGAN,一种具有三维感知能力的生成对抗网络,能够合成在不同视角和身体姿态下具有一致外观的全身逼真图像。为了解决合成人体关节结构时面临的表示和计算挑战,我们提出了一种新颖的生成器架构,其中二维卷积主干网络由三维姿态映射网络所调制。该三维姿态映射网络被建模为一个可渲染的隐式函数,其条件基于具有姿态的三维人体网格。该设计具有以下优势:i)它利用二维GAN的优势生成高质量图像;ii)它能够在不同视角和姿态下生成一致的图像;iii)模型可以融合三维人体先验知识并实现姿态条件生成。项目页面:https://3dhumangan.github.io/
abstract_en: We present 3DHumanGAN, a 3D-aware generative adversarial network that synthesizes photorealistic images of full-body humans with consistent appearances under different view-angles and body-poses. To tackle the representational and computational challenges in synthesizing the articulated structure of human bodies, we propose a novel generator architecture in which a 2D convolutional backbone is modulated by a 3D pose mapping network. The 3D pose mapping network is formulated as a renderable implicit function conditioned on a posed 3D human mesh. This design has several merits: i) it leverages the strength of 2D GANs to produce high-quality images; ii) it generates consistent images under varying view-angles and poses; iii) the model can incorporate the 3D human prior and enable pose conditioning. Project page: https://3dhumangan.github.io/.
authors: Zhuoqian Yang, Shikai Li, Wayne Wu, Bo Dai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23008-23019

title: 3DMOTFormer:用于在线三维多目标跟踪的图变换器
title_en: 3DMOTFormer: Graph Transformer for Online 3D Multi-Object Tracking
abstract: 对自动驾驶车辆而言,准确且一致地跟踪三维物体至关重要,能够实现轨迹预测和运动规划等更可靠的下游任务。近年来,随着目标检测技术的显著进展,基于检测的跟踪范式因其简单性和高效性而成为一种流行的选择。当前最先进的三维多目标跟踪(MOT)方法通常依赖于卡尔曼滤波器等非学习型模型算法,但需要大量手动调整的参数。另一方面,基于学习的方法面临将训练适应在线设置的问题,导致训练与推理之间的分布不匹配以及次优性能。在本工作中,我们提出3DMOTFormer,这是一种基于学习的几何方法的三维多目标跟踪(MOT)框架,构建于变换器架构之上。我们使用边增强图变换器对轨道-检测二分图进行逐帧推理,并通过边分类进行数据关联。为减少训练与推理之间的分布不匹配,我们提出了一种新颖的在线训练策略,包括自回归和递归前向传递以及顺序批量优化。利用CenterPoint检测结果,我们的方法在nuScenes验证集和测试集上分别实现了71.2%和68.2%的AMOTA。此外,训练后的3DMOTFormer模型在不同目标检测器上具有良好的泛化能力。代码可在以下链接获取:https://github.com/dsx0511/3DMOTFormer
abstract_en: Tracking 3D objects accurately and consistently is crucial for autonomous vehicles, enabling more reliable downstream tasks such as trajectory prediction and motion planning. Based on the substantial progress in object detection in recent years, the tracking-by-detection paradigm has become a popular choice due to its simplicity and efficiency. State-of-the-art 3D multi-object tracking (MOT) approaches typically rely on non-learned model-based algorithms such as Kalman Filter but require many manually tuned parameters. On the other hand, learning-based approaches face the problem of adapting the training to the online setting, leading to inevitable distribution mismatch between training and inference as well as suboptimal performance. In this work, we propose 3DMOTFormer, a learned geometry-based 3D MOT framework building upon the transformer architecture. We use an Edge-Augmented Graph Transformer to reason on the track-detection bipartite graph frame-by-frame and conduct data association via edge classification. To reduce the distribution mismatch between training and inference, we propose a novel online training strategy with an autoregressive and recurrent forward pass as well as sequential batch optimization. Using CenterPoint detections, our approach achieves 71.2% and 68.2% AMOTA on the nuScenes validation and test split, respectively. In addition, a trained 3DMOTFormer model generalizes well across different object detectors. Code is available at: https://github.com/dsx0511/3DMOTFormer.
authors: Shuxiao Ding, Eike Rehder, Lukas Schneider, Marius Cordts, Juergen Gall ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9784-9794

title: 3DMiner:从大规模未标注图像数据集中发现形状
title_en: 3DMiner: Discovering Shapes from Large-Scale Unannotated Image Datasets
abstract: 我们提出3DMiner——一种从具有挑战性的大规模未标注图像数据集中挖掘3D形状的管道。与其他无监督3D重建方法不同,我们假设在足够大的数据集中,必定存在形状相似但背景、纹理和视角各异的物体图像。我们的方法利用近期在学习自监督图像表示方面的进展,对几何形状相似的图像进行聚类,并找到它们之间的共同图像对应关系。随后,我们利用这些对应关系获取粗略的相机估计作为捆绑调整的初始化参数。最后,对于每个图像簇,我们应用渐进式捆绑调整重建方法,学习表示底层形状的神经占用场。我们证明该过程对前一步骤中引入的多种错误(如错误的相机姿态、包含不相似形状的图像等)具有鲁棒性,从而使我们能够为野外图像获取形状和姿态标注。当使用Pix3D椅子数据集的图像时,我们的方法在定量和定性方面均显著优于最先进的无监督3D重建技术。此外,我们展示了如何将3DMiner应用于野外数据,通过重建LAION-5B数据集中图像中存在的形状来实现这一目标。
abstract_en:
We present 3DMiner -- a pipeline for mining 3D shapes from challenging large-scale unannotated image datasets. Unlike other unsupervised 3D reconstruction methods, we assume that, within a large-enough dataset, there must exist images of objects with similar shapes but varying backgrounds, textures, and viewpoints. Our approach leverages the recent advances in learning self-supervised image representations to cluster images with geometrically similar shapes and find common image correspondences between them. We then exploit these correspondences to obtain rough camera estimates as initialization for bundle-adjustment. Finally, for every image cluster, we apply a progressive bundle-adjusting reconstruction method to learn a neural occupancy field representing the underlying shape. We show that this procedure is robust to several types of errors introduced in previous steps (e.g., wrong camera poses, images containing dissimilar shapes, etc.), allowing us to obtain shape and pose annotations for images in-the-wild.
 When using images from Pix3D chairs, our method is capable of producing significantly better results than state-of-the-art unsupervised 3D
 reconstruction techniques, both quantitatively and qualitatively. Furthermore, we show how 3DMiner can be applied to in-the-wild data by reconstructing shapes present in images from the LAION-5B dataset.
authors: Ta-Ying Cheng, Matheus Gadelha, Sören Pirk, Thibault Groueix, Radomír Měch, Andrew Markham, Niki Trigoni ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9331-9341

title: 3DPPE:基于Transformer的多摄像头三维目标检测的三维点位置编码
title_en: 3DPPE: 3D Point Positional Encoding for Transformer-based Multi-Camera 3D Object Detection
abstract: 基于Transformer的方法在图像上的2D和3D检测基准测试中占据主导地位。由于在注意力机制前的分词处理会丢失空间信息,位置编码对于这些方法变得至关重要。近期研究发现,基于三维视图光线样本的编码可以显著提升多摄像头三维目标检测的质量。我们假设三维点位置能够提供比光线更多的信息。因此,我们将三维点位置编码(3DPPE)引入到三维检测Transformer解码器中。尽管单目三维目标检测在推理阶段无法获得三维测量数据,3DPPE利用预测的深度来近似真实点位置。我们的混合深度模块结合直接深度和分类深度,以估计每个像素的精细深度。尽管存在近似,3DPPE在竞争性的nuScenes数据集上实现了46.0 mAP和51.4 NDS,显著优于基于光线样本的编码。代码可在https://github.com/drilistbox/3DPPE获取。
abstract_en: Transformer-based methods have swept the benchmarks on 2D and 3D detection on images. Because tokenization before the attention mechanism drops the spatial information, positional encoding becomes critical for those methods. Recent works found that encodings based on samples of the 3D viewing rays can significantly improve the quality of multi-camera 3D object detection. We hypothesize that 3D point locations can provide more information than rays. Therefore, we introduce 3D point positional encoding, 3DPPE, to the 3D detection Transformer decoder. Although 3D measurements are not available at the inference time of monocular 3D object detection, 3DPPE uses predicted depth to approximate the real point positions. Our hybrid-depth module combines direct and categorical depth to estimate the refined depth of each pixel. Despite the approximation, 3DPPE achieves 46.0 mAP and 51.4 NDS on the competitive nuScenes dataset, significantly outperforming encodings based on ray samples. The codes are available at https://github.com/drilistbox/3DPPE.
authors: Changyong Shu, Jiajun Deng, Fisher Yu, Yifan Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3580-3589

title: 基于解耦运动与形状模型的4D心肌重建
title_en: 4D Myocardium Reconstruction with Decoupled Motion and Shape Model
abstract: 心肌的形状和运动状态估计对于诊断心血管疾病至关重要。然而,电影磁共振成像(CMR)主要依赖二维切片,其较大的切片间距对层间形状重建和运动获取构成挑战。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种4D重建方法,通过解耦运动与形状,可从有限切片获得的稀疏点云序列中预测层间/层内形状和运动估计。我们的框架包含神经运动模型和舒张末期(ED)形状模型。隐式ED形状模型能够学习连续边界并鼓励运动模型在无真实变形监督的情况下进行预测,而运动模型通过将任意相位的任意点变形至ED相位,为形状模型提供规范化的输入。此外,构建的ED空间使形状模型能够进行预训练,从而指导运动模型并解决数据稀缺问题。我们提出了首个4D心肌数据集,并在该公开且跨模态数据集上验证了我们的方法,展示了优越的重建性能并支持多种临床应用。
abstract_en: Estimating the shape and motion state of the myocardium is essential in diagnosing cardiovascular diseases. However, cine magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging is dominated by 2D slices, whose large slice spacing challenges inter-slice shape reconstruction and motion acquisition. To address this problem, we propose a 4D reconstruction method that decouples motion and shape, which can predict the inter-/intra- shape and motion estimation from a given sparse point cloud sequence obtained from limited slices. Our framework comprises a neural motion model and an end-diastolic (ED) shape model. The implicit ED shape model can learn a continuous boundary and encourage the motion model to predict without the supervision of ground truth deformation, and the motion model enables canonical input of the shape model by deforming any point from any phase to the ED phase. Additionally, the constructed ED-space enables pre-training of the shape model, thereby guiding the motion model and addressing the issue of data scarcity. We propose the first 4D myocardial dataset as we know and verify our method on the proposed, public, and cross-modal datasets, showing superior reconstruction performance and enabling various clinical applications.
authors: Xiaohan Yuan, Cong Liu, Yangang Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21252-21262

title: 4D全景分割作为不变量与协变量场预测
title_en: 4D Panoptic Segmentation as Invariant and Equivariant Field Prediction
abstract: 本文开发了用于4D全景分割的旋转协变神经网络。4D全景分割是自动驾驶的基准任务,要求基于激光雷达扫描识别道路上的语义类别和物体实例,并为实例在时间上分配一致的ID。我们观察到驾驶场景在地面平面上对旋转对称,因此旋转协变性可提供更好的泛化能力和更鲁棒的特征学习。具体而言,我们回顾了物体实例聚类策略,将基于中心度的方法和基于偏移量的方法重新表述为不变量标量场预测和协变量向量场预测。其他子任务也从这一视角统一,设计了不同的不变量和协变量层以促进其预测。通过在SemanticKITTI标准4D全景分割基准上的评估,我们证明了所提出的协变模型在计算成本更低的情况下相比非协变模型实现了更高的准确性。此外,我们的方法设定了新的最先进性能,并在SemanticKITTI 4D全景分割排行榜上取得第一名。
abstract_en: In this paper, we develop rotation-equivariant neural networks for 4D panoptic segmentation. 4D panoptic segmentation is a benchmark task for autonomous driving that requires recognizing semantic classes and object instances on the road based on LiDAR scans, as well as assigning temporally consistent IDs to instances across time. We observe that the driving scenario is symmetric to rotations on the ground plane. Therefore, rotation-equivariance could provide better generalization and more robust feature learning. Specifically, we review the object instance clustering strategies and restate the centerness-based approach and the offset-based approach as the prediction of invariant scalar fields and equivariant vector fields. Other sub-tasks are also unified from this perspective, and different invariant and equivariant layers are designed to facilitate their predictions. Through evaluation on the standard 4D panoptic segmentation benchmark of SemanticKITTI, we show that our equivariant models achieve higher accuracy with lower computational costs compared to their non-equivariant counterparts. Moreover, our method sets the new state-of-the-art performance and achieves 1st place on the SemanticKITTI 4D Panoptic Segmentation leaderboard.
authors: Minghan Zhu, Shizhong Han, Hong Cai, Shubhankar Borse, Maani Ghaffari, Fatih Porikli ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22488-22498

title: 事件相机相对运动估计的五点最小求解器
title_en: A 5-Point Minimal Solver for Event Camera Relative Motion Estimation
abstract: 基于事件的相机非常适合基于线条的运动估计,因为它们主要响应场景中的边缘。然而,基于事件确定相机位移仍是一个开放性问题。这是由于在使用事件相机时,线特征提取和动态估计紧密耦合,且目前尚无精确模型能描述事件时空体积中由线条生成的复杂结构。我们通过推导此类流形的正确非线性参数化方法(我们称之为eventails),并将其应用于基于事件的线性运动估计(已知惯性测量单元的旋转),解决了这一问题。利用该参数化方法,我们引入了一种新颖的五点最小求解器,可联合估计线参数和线性相机速度投影,当考虑多条线时,这些投影可融合为单一的平均线性速度。我们在合成数据和真实数据上验证了该求解器,结果表明其生成的相对运动估计比其他方法更稳定,并且在基于时空平面聚类的内点数量上更多。特别是,我们的方法在估计线性速度时始终达到100%的成功率,而现有闭式求解器的成功率仅为23%至70%。所提出的eventails有助于更好地理解时空事件生成的几何结构,因此我们相信它将成为未来基于事件的运动估计算法的核心构建模块。
abstract_en: Event-based cameras are ideal for line-based motion estimation, since they predominantly respond to edges in the scene. However, accurately determining the camera displacement based on events continues to be an open problem. This is because line feature extraction and dynamics estimation are tightly coupled when using event cameras, and no precise model is currently available for describing the complex structures generated by lines in the space-time volume of events. We solve this problem by deriving the correct non-linear parametrization of such manifolds, which we term eventails, and demonstrate its application to event-based linear motion estimation, with known rotation from an Inertial Measurement Unit. Using this parametrization, we introduce a novel minimal 5-point solver that jointly estimates line parameters and linear camera velocity projections, which can be fused into a single, averaged linear velocity when considering multiple lines. We demonstrate on both synthetic and real data that our solver generates more stable relative motion estimates than other methods while capturing more inliers than clustering based on spatio-temporal planes. In particular, our method consistently achieves a 100% success rate in estimating linear velocity where existing closed-form solvers only achieve between 23% and 70%. The proposed eventails contribute to a better understanding of spatio-temporal event-generated geometries and we thus believe it will become a core building block of future event-based motion estimation algorithms.
authors: Ling Gao, Hang Su, Daniel Gehrig, Marco Cannici, Davide Scaramuzza, Laurent Kneip ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8049-8059

title: 面向中英场景文本图像超分辨率的基准数据集
title_en: A Benchmark for Chinese-English Scene Text Image Super-Resolution
abstract: 场景文本图像超分辨率(STISR)旨在从给定的低分辨率(LR)输入中恢复具有视觉愉悦且可读文本内容的高分辨率(HR)场景文本图像。现有大多数工作聚焦于恢复结构简单的英文文本,而针对结构复杂且多样的中文文本的研究较少。本文提出一个面向STISR任务的真实世界中英场景文本基准数据集Real-CE,重点在于恢复结构复杂的中文字符。该基准提供1,935/783对真实世界LR-HR文本图像对(总计包含33,789条文本行),支持2倍和4倍放大模式的训练/测试,配套详细的标注信息,包括检测框和文本转录。此外,我们设计了一种边缘感知学习方法,通过图像和特征域的结构监督有效重建中文字符的密集结构。我们在提出的Real-CE基准上进行实验,评估现有STISR模型在加入/不加入我们的边缘感知损失时的性能。该基准(包含数据和源代码)将公开发布。
abstract_en: Scene Text Image Super-resolution (STISR) aims to recover high-resolution (HR) scene text images with visually pleasant and readable text content from the given low-resolution (LR) input. Most existing works focus on recovering English texts, which have simple structures in the characters, while little work has been done on the more challenging Chinese texts with diverse and complex character structures. In this paper, we propose a real-world Chinese-English benchmark dataset, namely Real-CE, for the task of STISR with the emphasis on restoring structurally complex Chinese characters. The benchmark provides 1,935/783 real-world LR-HR text image pairs (contains 33,789 text lines in total) for training/testing in 2x and 4x zooming modes, complemented by detailed annotations, including detection boxes and text transcripts. Moreover, we design an edge-aware learning method, which provides structural supervision in image and feature domain, to effectively reconstruct the dense structures of Chinese characters. We conduct experiments on the proposed Real-CE benchmark and evaluate the existing STISR models with and without our edge-aware loss. The benchmark, including data and source code, will be made publicly available.
authors: Jianqi Ma, Zhetong Liang, Wangmeng Xiang, Xi Yang, Lei Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19452-19461

title: 扩散生成模型的完整配方
title_en: A Complete Recipe for Diffusion Generative Models
abstract: 基于分数的生成模型(SGMs)在各类任务中展现出卓越的合成效果。然而,当前前向扩散过程的设计范式仍存在较大探索空间,通常依赖物理启发式方法或简化假设。借鉴可扩展贝叶斯后验采样器的发展见解,我们提出了一套完整的前向过程构建方案,确保收敛至目标分布。我们的方法揭示了若干现有SGMs可视为该框架的特定实现。在此基础上,我们引入相空间朗之万扩散(PSLD),其在增强空间中通过辅助变量(类似物理相空间)进行分数建模。实验证明,PSLD在标准图像合成基准测试中相比其他方法展现出更优的样本质量与速度-质量权衡。值得注意的是,PSLD在无条件CIFAR-10生成中达到与最先进SGMs相当的样本质量(FID: 2.10)。最后,我们展示了PSLD在预训练分数网络下的条件合成适用性,为未来进展提供了有吸引力的SGMs骨干方案。代码和模型检查点可访问https://github.com/mandt-lab/PSLD。
abstract_en: Score-based Generative Models (SGMs) have demonstrated exceptional synthesis outcomes across various tasks. However, the current design landscape of the forward diffusion process remains largely untapped and often relies on physical heuristics or simplifying assumptions. Utilizing insights from the development of scalable Bayesian posterior samplers, we present a complete recipe for formulating forward processes in SGMs, ensuring convergence to the desired target distribution. Our approach reveals that several existing SGMs can be seen as specific manifestations of our framework. Building upon this method, we introduce Phase Space Langevin Diffusion (PSLD), which relies on score-based modeling within an augmented space enriched by auxiliary variables akin to physical phase space. Empirical results exhibit the superior sample quality and improved speed-quality trade-off of PSLD compared to various competing approaches on established image synthesis benchmarks. Remarkably, PSLD achieves sample quality akin to state-of-the-art SGMs (FID: 2.10 for unconditional CIFAR-10 generation).
