This paper proposes a novel recurrent framework called AccFlow, which recursively backward accumulates local flows using a deformable module called as AccPlus. In addition, an adaptive blending module is designed along with AccPlus to alleviate the occlusion effect by backward accumulation and rectify the accumulation error. Notably, we demonstrate the superiority of backward accumulation over conventional forward accumulation, which to the best of our knowledge has not been explicitly established before. To train and evaluate the proposed AccFlow, we have constructed a large-scale high-quality dataset named CVO, which provides ground-truth optical flow labels between adjacent and distant frames. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of AccFlow in handling long-range optical flow estimation. Codes are available at https://github.com/mulns/AccFlow.
authors: Guangyang Wu, Xiaohong Liu, Kunming Luo, Xi Liu, Qingqing Zheng, Shuaicheng Liu, Xinyang Jiang, Guangtao Zhai, Wenyi Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12119-12128

title: 基于面部组件标记的高精度三维人脸重建
title_en: Accurate 3D Face Reconstruction with Facial Component Tokens
abstract: 从单目图像和视频中准确重建三维人脸对数字头像创建等应用至关重要。然而,当前基于深度学习的方法在实现解耦的面部参数准确重建以及视频数据上单帧方法的时序稳定性方面面临显著挑战。本文提出TokenFace,一种基于Transformer的单目三维人脸重建模型。TokenFace为不同面部部件使用独立标记以捕捉不同面部参数信息,并采用时间Transformer捕捉视频数据中的时序信息。该设计可自然解耦不同面部部件,且兼容2D和3D训练数据。在混合2D和3D数据上训练的模型展现出强大的性能,能够准确重建图像人脸并为视频数据生成稳定结果。在NoW和Stirling等流行基准数据集上的实验结果表明,TokenFace实现了最先进性能,在所有指标上均显著优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Accurately reconstructing 3D faces from monocular images and videos is crucial for various applications, such as digital avatar creation. However, the current deep learning-based methods face significant challenges in achieving accurate reconstruction with disentangled facial parameters and ensuring temporal stability in single-frame methods for 3D face tracking on video data. In this paper, we propose TokenFace, a transformer-based monocular 3D face reconstruction model. TokenFace uses separate tokens for different facial components to capture information about different facial parameters and employs temporal transformers to capture temporal information from video data. This design can naturally disentangle different facial components and is flexible to both 2D and 3D training data. Trained on hybrid 2D and 3D data, our model shows its power in accurately reconstructing faces from images and producing stable results for video data. Experimental results on popular benchmarks NoW and Stirling demonstrate that TokenFace achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing methods on all metrics by a large margin.
authors: Tianke Zhang, Xuangeng Chu, Yunfei Liu, Lijian Lin, Zhendong Yang, Zhengzhuo Xu, Chengkun Cao, Fei Yu, Changyin Zhou, Chun Yuan, Yu Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9033-9042

title: 准确且快速的压缩视频字幕生成
title_en: Accurate and Fast Compressed Video Captioning
abstract: 现有视频字幕生成方法通常需要先从解码视频中采样视频帧,再进行后续处理(如特征提取和/或字幕生成模型学习)。在该流程中,手动帧采样可能忽略视频中的关键信息,从而降低性能。此外,采样帧中的冗余信息会导致视频字幕推理效率低下。针对这一问题,我们从压缩域的角度研究视频字幕生成,相较于现有流程具有多方面优势:1)与解码视频的原始图像相比,由I帧、运动向量和残差组成的压缩视频具有高度可区分性,允许通过专门的模型设计无需手动采样即可利用整个视频进行学习;2)字幕生成模型在推理时更高效,因处理的信息更小且冗余更少。我们提出了一种简单而有效的压缩域端到端Transformer模型,用于视频字幕生成,使模型能够从压缩视频中进行学习。我们证明,即使采用简单设计,我们的方法在不同基准测试中均能实现最先进水平的性能,且运行速度几乎是现有方法的两倍。代码已开源至https://github.com/acherstyx/CoCap。
abstract_en: Existing video captioning approaches typically require to first sample video frames from a decoded video and then conduct a subsequent process (e.g., feature extraction and/or captioning model learning). In this pipeline, manual frame sampling may ignore key information in videos and thus degrade performance. Additionally, redundant information in the sampled frames may result in low efficiency in the inference of video captioning. Addressing this, we study video captioning from a different perspective in compressed domain, which brings multi-fold advantages over the existing pipeline: 1) Compared to raw images from the decoded video, the compressed video, consisting of I-frames, motion vectors and residuals, is highly distinguishable, which allows us to leverage the entire video for learning without manual sampling through a specialized model design; 2) The captioning model is more efficient in inference as smaller and less redundant information is processed. We propose a simple yet effective end-to-end transformer in the compressed domain for video captioning that enables learning from the compressed video for captioning. We show that even with a simple design, our method can achieve state-of-the-art performance on different benchmarks while running almost 2x faster than existing approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/acherstyx/CoCap.
authors: Yaojie Shen, Xin Gu, Kai Xu, Heng Fan, Longyin Wen, Libo Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15558-15567

title: 基于成就的多任务学习训练进度平衡
title_en: Achievement-Based Training Progress Balancing for Multi-Task Learning
abstract: 多任务学习面临两个挑战性问题:(1) 为所有任务标注标签的高成本和(2) 不同性质任务的训练进度平衡。为解决标签标注问题,我们通过结合任务特定数据集构建了一个大规模的"部分标注"多任务数据集。然而,各任务的标注数量存在不平衡,这可能导致训练进度的不平衡。为平衡训练进度,我们提出了一种基于成就的多任务损失函数,通过"成就"(当前准确率与单任务准确率的比率)调节训练速度。随后,我们将多任务损失公式化为各任务损失的加权几何平均而非加权和,以防止任何任务主导损失。实验中,我们在大规模多任务数据集上评估了所提多任务损失的准确率和训练速度,与近期多任务损失进行对比。所提损失在不增加训练时间开销的情况下实现了最佳多任务准确率。与单任务模型相比,在目标检测、语义分割和深度估计任务中分别实现了1.28%、1.65%和1.18%的准确率提升,同时计算量降低至33.73%。源代码可在https://github.com/samsung/Achievement-based-MTL获取。
abstract_en:
Multi-task learning faces two challenging issues: (1) the high cost of annotating labels for all tasks and (2) balancing the training progress of various tasks with different natures. To resolve the label annotation issue, we construct a large-scale "partially annotated" multi-task dataset by combining task-specific datasets. However, the numbers of annotations for individual tasks are imbalanced, which
 may escalate an imbalance in training progress. To balance the training progress, we propose an achievement-based multi-task loss to modulate training speed based on the "achievement," defined as the ratio of current accuracy to single-task accuracy. Then, we formulate the multitask loss as a weighted geometric mean of individual task losses instead of a weighted sum to prevent any task from dominating the loss. In experiments, we evaluated the accuracy and training speed of the proposed multi-task loss on the large-scale multi-task dataset against recent multitask losses. The proposed loss achieved the best multi-task accuracy without incurring training time overhead. Compared to single-task models, the proposed one achieved 1.28%, 1.65%, and 1.18% accuracy improvement in object detection, semantic segmentation, and depth estimation, respectively, while reducing computations to 33.73%. Source code is available at https://github.com/
 samsung/Achievement-based-MTL.
authors: Hayoung Yun, Hanjoo Cho ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16935-16944

title: ActFormer:面向通用动作条件三维人体运动生成的生成对抗网络变换器
title_en: ActFormer: A GAN-based Transformer towards General Action-Conditioned 3D Human Motion Generation
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于生成对抗网络的变换器,用于通用动作条件下的三维人体运动生成,包括单人动作和多人交互动作。我们的方法在生成对抗网络训练方案下构建了一个强大的动作条件运动变换器(ActFormer),其配备了高斯过程潜在先验。这种设计结合了变换器强大的时空表示能力、生成对抗网络在生成建模中的优势以及潜在先验固有的时间相关性。此外,ActFormer可以通过变换器编码器交替建模时间相关性和人际互动,自然扩展到多人运动生成。为进一步促进多人运动生成研究,我们引入了一个包含复杂多人战斗行为的新合成数据集。在NTU-13、NTU RGB+D 120、BABEL以及所提出的战斗数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法能够适应各种人体运动表示,并在单人和多人运动生成任务中均优于当前最先进方法,展示了向通用人体运动生成器迈出的有希望的一步。
abstract_en: We present a GAN-based Transformer for general action-conditioned 3D human motion generation, including not only single-person actions but also multi-person interactive actions. Our approach consists of a powerful Action-conditioned motion TransFormer (ActFormer) under a GAN training scheme, equipped with a Gaussian Process latent prior. Such a design combines the strong spatio-temporal representation capacity of Transformer, superiority in generative modeling of GAN, and inherent temporal correlations from the latent prior. Furthermore, ActFormer can be naturally extended to multi-person motions by alternately modeling temporal correlations and human interactions with Transformer encoders. To further facilitate research on multi-person motion generation, we introduce a new synthetic dataset of complex multi-person combat behaviors. Extensive experiments on NTU-13, NTU RGB+D 120, BABEL and the proposed combat dataset show that our method can adapt to various human motion representations and achieve superior performance over the state-of-the-art methods on both single-person and multi-person motion generation tasks, demonstrating a promising step towards a general human motion generator.
authors: Liang Xu, Ziyang Song, Dongliang Wang, Jing Su, Zhicheng Fang, Chenjing Ding, Weihao Gan, Yichao Yan, Xin Jin, Xiaokang Yang, Wenjun Zeng, Wei Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2228-2238

title: 基于动作敏感性学习的时序动作定位
title_en: Action Sensitivity Learning for Temporal Action Localization
abstract: 时序动作定位(TAL),即识别和定位动作实例,是视频理解中的挑战性任务。现有大多数方法直接预测动作类别并回归边界偏移量,而忽视了各帧的重要性差异。本文提出一种动作敏感性学习框架(ASL)来解决该任务,旨在评估每帧的价值,然后利用生成的动作敏感性重新校准训练过程。我们首先引入一种轻量级动作敏感性评估器,分别在类别级和实例级学习动作敏感性。两个分支的输出结合以重新加权两个子任务的梯度。此外,基于每帧的动作敏感性,我们设计了一种动作敏感对比损失以增强特征,其中动作感知帧被采样为正样本对,以远离动作无关帧。在多种动作定位基准数据集(如MultiThumos、Charades、Ego4D-Moment Queries v1.0、Epic-Kitchens 100、Thumos14和ActivityNet1.3)上的大量实验表明,ASL在多种场景类型(如单标签、密集标签和第一视角)下的平均mAP均超越了现有最先进方法。
abstract_en:
Temporal action localization (TAL), which involves recognizing and locating action instances, is a challenging task in video understanding.
 Most existing approaches directly predict action classes and regress offsets to boundaries, while overlooking the discrepant importance of each frame.
 In this paper, we propose an Action Sensitivity Learning framework (ASL) to tackle this task, which aims to assess the value of each frame and then leverage the generated action sensitivity to recalibrate the training procedure. We first introduce a lightweight Action Sensitivity Evaluator to learn the action sensitivity at the class level and instance level, respectively. The outputs of the two branches are combined to reweight the gradient of the two sub-tasks. Moreover, based on the action sensitivity of each frame, we design an Action Sensitive Contrastive Loss to enhance features, where the action-aware frames are sampled as positive pairs to push away the action-irrelevant frames. The extensive studies on various action localization benchmarks (i.e., MultiThumos, Charades, Ego4D-Moment Queries v1.0, Epic-Kitchens 100, Thumos14 and ActivityNet1.3) show that ASL surpasses the state-of-the-art in terms of average-mAP under multiple types of scenarios, e.g., single-labeled, densely-labeled and egocentric.
authors: Jiayi Shao, Xiaohan Wang, Ruijie Quan, Junjun Zheng, Jiang Yang, Yi Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13457-13469

title: 激活与拒绝:面向类别偏移下安全领域泛化的研究
title_en: Activate and Reject: Towards Safe Domain Generalization under Category Shift
abstract: 尽管深度神经网络在领域内测试点上表现出色,但在开放世界部署时,面对新出现的领域和物体类别,实现令人满意的准确率仍具有挑战性。本文研究了类别偏移下的领域泛化(DGCS)这一实际问题,旨在同时检测目标领域中的未知类别样本并分类已知类别样本。与以往的领域泛化工作相比,我们面临两个新挑战:1)如何仅利用源域已知类别样本在训练中学习"未知"的概念;2)如何将源域训练的模型适应到未见过的环境中以实现安全的模型部署。为此,我们提出了一种新颖的激活与拒绝(ART)框架,通过重塑模型的决策边界以适应未知类别,并利用无标签测试数据进行事后修改以进一步区分已知和未知类别。具体而言,在训练阶段,我们通过优化未知概率来增强对未知类别的响应,然后平滑整体输出以缓解过自信问题。在测试阶段,我们引入了一种分步在线适应方法,通过跨域最近邻和类别原型信息预测标签,而无需更新网络参数或使用基于阈值的机制。实验表明,ART在不同视觉任务中持续提升了深度网络的泛化能力。在图像分类任务中,ART相比先前最佳方法平均提升了6.1%的H-score。在目标检测和语义分割任务中,我们建立了新的基准并取得了具有竞争力的性能。
abstract_en: Albeit the notable performance on in-domain test points, it is non-trivial for deep neural networks to attain satisfactory accuracy when deploying in the open world, where novel domains and object classes often occur. In this paper, we study a practical problem of Domain Generalization under Category Shift (DGCS), which aims to simultaneously detect unknown-class samples and classify known-class samples in the target domains. Compared to prior DG works, we face two new challenges: 1) how to learn the concept of "unknown" during training with only source known-class samples, and 2) how to adapt the source-trained model to unseen environments for safe model deployment. To this end, we propose a novel Activate and Reject (ART) framework to reshape the model's decision boundary to accommodate unknown classes and conduct post hoc modification to further discriminate known and unknown classes using unlabeled test data. Specifically, during training, we promote the response to the unknown by optimizing the unknown probability and then smoothing the overall output to mitigate the overconfidence issue. At test time, we introduce a step-wise online adaptation method that predicts the label by virtue of the cross-domain nearest neighbor and class prototype information without updating the network's parameters or using threshold-based mechanisms. Experiments reveal that ART consistently improves the generalization capability of deep networks on different vision tasks. For image classification, ART improves the H-score by 6.1% on average compared to the previous best method. For object detection and semantic segmentation, we establish new benchmarks and achieve competitive performance.
authors: Chaoqi Chen, Luyao Tang, Leitian Tao, Hong-Yu Zhou, Yue Huang, Xiaoguang Han, Yizhou Yu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11552-11563

title: 主动神经映射
title_en: Active Neural Mapping
abstract: 我们针对一种持续学习的神经场景表示的主动映射问题进行研究,即主动神经映射。关键在于通过高效的智能体运动主动寻找待探索的目标空间,从而在先前未见过的环境中实时最小化地图不确定性。本文研究了持续学习的神经场的权重空间,实证表明神经可变性(即对随机权重扰动的预测鲁棒性)可直接用于衡量神经地图的即时不确定性。结合神经地图中继承的连续几何信息,智能体可被引导找到可通行路径,逐步获取环境知识。我们首次提出了一种基于坐标隐式神经表示的在线主动映射系统。在视觉逼真的Gibson和Matterport3D环境中进行的实验验证了所提方法的有效性。
abstract_en: We address the problem of active mapping with a continually-learned neural scene representation, namely Active Neural Mapping. The key lies in actively finding the target space to be explored with efficient agent movement, thus minimizing the map uncertainty on-the-fly within a previously unseen environment. In this paper, we examine the weight space of the continually-learned neural field, and show empirically that the neural variability, the prediction robustness against random weight perturbation, can be directly utilized to measure the instant uncertainty of the neural map. Together with the continuous geometric information inherited in the neural map, the agent can be guided to find a traversable path to gradually gain knowledge of the environment. We present for the first time an online active mapping system with a coordinate-based implicit neural representation. Experiments in the visually-realistic Gibson and Matterport3D environment demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed method.
authors: Zike Yan, Haoxiang Yang, Hongbin Zha ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10981-10992

title: 主动自监督学习:只需少数低成本关系即可满足需求
title_en: Active Self-Supervised Learning: A Few Low-Cost Relationships Are All You Need
abstract: 自监督学习(SSL)已成为从无标签数据中学习可迁移表示的首选解决方案。然而,SSL需要构建已知语义相近的样本,即正样本视图。要求此类知识是SSL的主要局限性,通常通过临时性策略解决,例如对同一输入应用已知的数据增强方法。在本工作中,我们通过正主动学习(PAL)原则进行推广和形式化,其中 oracle 查询样本间的语义关系。PAL实现三个主要目标。首先,它是一个理论基础扎实的学习框架,既包含标准SSL,也根据所采用的 oracle 包含监督学习和半监督学习。其次,它提供了一种一致的算法,可将先验知识(如部分观察到的标签)嵌入任何SSL损失函数中,而无需改变训练流程。第三,它提供了一个合适的主动学习框架,以低成本标注数据集,有望弥合基于非专家可简单回答的输入间语义关系查询的主动学习理论与实践之间的差距。
abstract_en:
Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) has emerged as the solution of choice to learn transferable representations from unlabeled data. However, SSL requires to build samples that are known to be semantically akin, i.e. positive views.
 Requiring such knowledge is the main limitation of SSL and is often tackled by ad-hoc strategies e.g. applying known data-augmentations to the same input.
 In this work, we generalize and formalize this principle through Positive Active Learning (PAL) where an oracle queries semantic relationships between samples.
 PAL achieves three main objectives. First, it is a theoretically grounded learning framework that encapsulates standard SSL but also supervised and semi-supervised learning depending on the employed oracle.
 Second, it provides a consistent algorithm to embed a priori knowledge, e.g. some observed labels, into any SSL losses without any change in the training pipeline.
 Third, it provides a proper active learning framework yielding low-cost solutions to annotate datasets, arguably bringing the gap between theory and practice of active learning that is based on simple-to-answer-by-non-experts queries of semantic relationships between inputs.
authors: Vivien Cabannes, Leon Bottou, Yann Lecun, Randall Balestriero ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16274-16283

title: 无需模式投影仪的主动立体视觉
title_en: Active Stereo Without Pattern Projector
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖框架,将标准被动相机系统中主动立体视觉的原理整合到无需物理模式投影仪的系统中。我们根据深度传感器获取的稀疏测量值,在左、右图像上虚拟投影模式。任何此类设备均可无缝集成到我们的框架中,从而在任何可能环境中部署虚拟主动立体视觉系统,克服了模式投影仪的局限性,如工作范围或环境条件的限制。在包含远距离和近距离的室内外数据集上的实验验证了我们方法的无缝有效性,提升了立体视觉算法和深度网络的准确性。
abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel framework integrating the principles of active stereo in standard passive camera systems without a physical pattern projector. We virtually project a pattern over the left and right images according to the sparse measurements obtained from a depth sensor. Any such devices can be seamlessly plugged into our framework, allowing for the deployment of a virtual active stereo setup in any possible environment, overcoming the limitation of pattern projectors, such as limited working range or environmental conditions. Experiments on indoor/outdoor datasets, featuring both long and close-range, support the seamless effectiveness of our approach, boosting the accuracy of both stereo algorithms and deep networks.
authors: Luca Bartolomei, Matteo Poggi, Fabio Tosi, Andrea Conti, Stefano Mattoccia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18470-18482

title: ActorsNeRF:基于通用NeRF的可动画化少样本人体渲染
title_en: ActorsNeRF: Animatable Few-shot Human Rendering with Generalizable NeRFs
abstract: 尽管基于NeRF的人体表示在新视角合成任务中展现出令人印象深刻的结果,但大多数方法仍依赖大量图像/视角进行训练。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新型可动画化NeRF——ActorsNeRF。该方法首先在多样化人体主体上进行预训练,随后通过少量单目视频帧适配新演员的未见过的姿态。基于先前使用卷积网络编码器进行参数共享的通用NeRF,ActorsNeRF进一步采用两个人体先验来捕捉大规模的人体外观、形状和姿态变化。具体而言,在编码特征空间中,我们首先将同一类别下的不同人体主体对齐到类别级规范空间,再将同一人体在不同帧间对齐到实例级规范空间以进行渲染。我们定量和定性地证明,ActorsNeRF在多个数据集上显著优于现有最先进的少样本泛化方法。
abstract_en: While NeRF-based human representations have shown impressive novel view synthesis results, most methods still rely on a large number of images / views for training. In this work, we propose a novel animatable NeRF called ActorsNeRF. It is first pre-trained on diverse human subjects, and then adapted with few-shot monocular video frames for a new actor with unseen poses. Building on previous generalizable NeRFs with parameter sharing using a ConvNet encoder, ActorsNeRF further adopts two human priors to capture the large human appearance, shape, and pose variations. Specifically, in the encoded feature space, we will first align different human subjects in a category-level canonical space, and then align the same human from different frames in an instance-level canonical space for rendering. We quantitatively and qualitatively demonstrate that ActorsNeRF significantly outperforms the existing state-of-the-art on few-shot generalization to new people and poses on multiple datasets.
authors: Jiteng Mu, Shen Sang, Nuno Vasconcelos, Xiaolong Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18391-18401

title: AdVerb:视觉引导的音频去混响
title_en: AdVerb: Visually Guided Audio Dereverberation
abstract: 我们提出AdVerb,一种新颖的音频-视觉去混响框架,该框架在利用混响声音的同时,通过视觉线索估计干净音频。尽管纯音频去混响是一个已广泛研究的问题,但我们的方法通过引入互补的视觉模态来执行音频去混响。给定记录混响声音信号的环境图像,AdVerb采用了一种新颖的几何感知跨模态Transformer架构,该架构捕捉场景几何信息和音频-视觉跨模态关系,生成复杂理想比率掩码。该掩码应用于混响音频时,可预测干净声音。通过广泛的定量和定性评估验证了我们方法的有效性。我们的方法在三个下游任务(语音增强、语音识别和说话人验证)中显著优于传统纯音频和音频-视觉基线方法,在LibriSpeech测试干净数据集上相对提升范围为18%-82%。我们在AVSpeech数据集上也取得了高度满意的RT60误差评分。
abstract_en: We present AdVerb, a novel audio-visual dereverberation framework that uses visual cues in addition to the reverberant sound to estimate clean audio. Although audio-only dereverberation is a well-studied problem, our approach incorporates the complementary visual modality to perform audio dereverberation. Given an image of the environment where the reverberated sound signal has been recorded, AdVerb employs a novel geometry-aware cross-modal transformer architecture that captures scene geometry and audio-visual cross-modal relationship to generate a complex ideal ratio mask, which, when applied to the reverberant audio predicts the clean sound. The effectiveness of our method is demonstrated through extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations. Our approach significantly outperforms traditional audio-only and audio-visual baselines on three downstream tasks: speech enhancement, speech recognition, and speaker verification, with relative improvements in the range of 18% - 82% on the LibriSpeech test-clean set. We also achieve highly satisfactory RT60 error scores on the AVSpeech dataset.
authors: Sanjoy Chowdhury, Sreyan Ghosh, Subhrajyoti Dasgupta, Anton Ratnarajah, Utkarsh Tyagi, Dinesh Manocha ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7884-7896

title: Ada3D : 利用自适应推理挖掘空间冗余以实现高效的三维目标检测
title_en: Ada3D : Exploiting the Spatial Redundancy with Adaptive Inference for Efficient 3D Object Detection
abstract: 基于体素的方法在自动驾驶中的三维目标检测中已达到最先进性能。然而,其显著的计算和内存成本对资源受限车辆的应用提出了挑战。这一高资源消耗的一个原因是Lidar点云中存在大量冗余背景点,导致三维体素和密集鸟瞰图(BEV)地图表示中出现空间冗余。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种自适应推理框架Ada3D,专注于挖掘输入层面的空间冗余。Ada3D通过轻量级重要性预测器和Lidar点云的独特属性引导,自适应过滤冗余输入。此外,我们通过引入稀疏性保持批归一化来利用BEV特征的内在稀疏性。使用Ada3D,我们实现了三维体素40%的减少,并将二维BEV特征图密度从100%降低至20%,而无需牺牲精度。Ada3D使模型计算和内存成本降低5倍,分别在三维和二维主干网络中实现1.52x/1.45x端到端GPU延迟优化和1.5x/4.5x GPU峰值内存优化。
abstract_en: Voxel-based methods have achieved state-of-the-art performance for 3D object detection in autonomous driving. However, their significant computational and memory costs pose a challenge for their application to resource-constrained vehicles. One reason for this high resource consumption is the presence of a large number of redundant background points in Lidar point clouds, resulting in spatial redundancy in both 3D voxel and dense BEV map representations. To address this issue, we propose an adaptive inference framework called Ada3D, which focuses on exploiting the input-level spatial redundancy. Ada3D adaptively filters the redundant input, guided by a lightweight importance predictor and the unique properties of the Lidar point cloud. Additionally, we utilize the BEV features' intrinsic sparsity by introducing the Sparsity Preserving Batch Normalization. With Ada3D, we achieve 40% reduction for 3D voxels and decrease the density of 2D BEV feature maps from 100% to 20% without sacrificing accuracy. Ada3D reduces the model computational and memory cost by 5x, and achieves 1.52x/1.45x end-to-end GPU latency and 1.5x/4.5x GPU peak memory optimization for the 3D and 2D backbone respectively.
authors: Tianchen Zhao, Xuefei Ning, Ke Hong, Zhongyuan Qiu, Pu Lu, Yali Zhao, Linfeng Zhang, Lipu Zhou, Guohao Dai, Huazhong Yang, Yu Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17728-17738

title: AdaMV-MoE:自适应多任务视觉混合专家模型
title_en: AdaMV-MoE: Adaptive Multi-Task Vision Mixture-of-Experts
abstract: 稀疏激活的混合专家(MoE)正逐渐成为多任务学习(MTL)的有前景范式。与将多个任务知识压缩到单一模型中不同,MoE通过分离参数空间,仅根据任务类型及其输入激活相关模型组件,从而提供稳定的MTL训练和超高效推理。然而,现有MoE方法为所有任务采用固定网络容量(如通常的两个专家)。这可能导致简单任务过拟合或复杂场景欠拟合,尤其是在任务复杂度差异显著时。本文提出了一种自适应MoE框架用于多任务视觉识别,命名为AdaMV-MoE。基于训练动态,它自动确定每个任务激活的专家数量,避免了手动调优最优模型规模的繁琐过程。为验证该方法,我们在ImageNet分类和COCO目标检测与实例分割任务上进行基准测试,这两个任务因差异显著而难以联合学习。在多种视觉Transformer上的大量实验表明,AdaMV-MoE相比共享主干的MTL方法和最新MoE MTL方法均展现出优越性能。代码已开源:https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/moe_mtl
abstract_en: Sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is becoming a promising paradigm for multi-task learning (MTL). Instead of compressing multiple tasks' knowledge into a single model, MoE separates the parameter space and only utilizes the relevant model pieces given task type and its input, which provides stabilized MTL training and ultra-efficient inference. However, current MoE approaches adopt a fixed network capacity (e.g., two experts in usual) for all tasks. It potentially results in the over-fitting of simple tasks or the under-fitting of challenging scenarios, especially when tasks are significantly distinctive in their complexity. In this paper, we propose an adaptive MoE framework for multi-task vision recognition, dubbed AdaMV-MoE. Based on the training dynamics, it automatically determines the number of activated experts for each task, avoiding the laborious manual tuning of optimal model size. To validate our proposal, we benchmark it on ImageNet classification and COCO object detection & instance segmentation which are notoriously difficult to learn in concert, due to their discrepancy. Extensive experiments across a variety of vision transformers demonstrate a superior performance of AdaMV-MoE, compared to MTL with a shared backbone and the recent state-of-the-art (SoTA) MTL MoE approach. Codes are available online: https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/moe_mtl.
authors: Tianlong Chen, Xuxi Chen, Xianzhi Du, Abdullah Rashwan, Fan Yang, Huizhong Chen, Zhangyang Wang, Yeqing Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17346-17357

title: AdaNIC: 通过动态变换路由实现实用的神经图像压缩
title_en: AdaNIC: Towards Practical Neural Image Compression via Dynamic Transform Routing
abstract: 压缩自编码器(CAEs)在基于深度学习的图像压缩中起着重要作用,但大规模CAEs计算成本较高。我们提出一个包含三种技术的框架,以实现高效的CAE图像编码:1)空间自适应卷积和归一化操作使块级非线性变换能够根据变换容量图在压缩图像上不均匀地分配FLOPs。2)无惩罚模型容量(JUMC)通过率失真复杂度优化,优化每个CAE块的变换容量,找到源图像内容的最佳容量。3)轻量级路由代理模型通过近似JUMC目标预测CAEs的变换容量图。通过在可裁剪超网络中激活最佳尺寸的子CAE,我们的方法在BD-Rate增加最小的情况下实现最高40%的计算加速,验证了其以内容感知方式节省计算资源的能力。
abstract_en: Compressive autoencoders (CAEs) play an important role in deep learning-based image compression, but large-scale CAEs are computationally expensive. We propose a framework with three techniques to enable efficient CAE-based image coding: 1) Spatially-adaptive convolution and normalization operators enable block-wise nonlinear transform to spend FLOPs unevenly across the image to be compressed, according to a transform capacity map. 2) Just-unpenalized model capacity (JUMC) optimizes the transform capacity of each CAE block via rate-distortion-complexity optimization, finding the optimal capacity for the source image content. 3) A lightweight routing agent model predicts the transform capacity map for the CAEs by approximating JUMC targets. By activating the best-sized sub-CAE inside the slimmable supernet, our approach achieves up to 40% computational speed-up with minimal BD-Rate increase, validating its ability to save computational resources in a content-aware manner.
authors: Lvfang Tao, Wei Gao, Ge Li, Chenhao Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16879-16888

title: 自适应校准器集成:在分布外场景中应对测试集难度
title_en: Adaptive Calibrator Ensemble: Navigating Test Set Difficulty in Out-of-Distribution Scenarios
abstract: 模型校准通常需要优化某些参数(例如温度)以最小化负对数似然等目标函数。本工作揭示了一个常被忽视的重要方面:目标函数受校准集难度的影响,即误分类样本与正确分类样本的比例。如果测试集的难度水平与校准集差异显著,分布外(OOD)数据常表现出的现象是:两个数据集的最优校准参数会不同,导致在校准集上最优的校准器在OOD测试集上表现次优,从而降低校准性能。基于此认识,我们提出了一种简单有效的名为自适应校准器集成(ACE)的方法,用于校准通常比校准集难度更高的OOD数据集。具体而言,训练两个校准函数:一个用于分布内数据(低难度),另一个用于严重分布外数据(高难度)。为在新OOD数据集上实现理想的校准,ACE采用自适应加权方法,在两个极端函数之间取得平衡。实验表明,ACE通常能提升若干先进校准方案在多个OOD基准测试中的性能。重要的是,这种提升不会以牺牲分布内校准性能为代价。项目网站:https://github.com/insysgroup/Adaptive-Calibrators-Ensemble.git
abstract_en: Model calibration usually requires optimizing some parameters (e.g., temperature) w.r.t an objective function like negative log-likelihood. This work uncovers a significant aspect often overlooked that the objective function is influenced by calibration set difficulty: the ratio of misclassified to correctly classified samples. If a test set has a drastically different difficulty level from the calibration set, a phenomenon out-of-distribution (OOD) data often exhibit: the optimal calibration parameters of the two datasets would be different, rendering an optimal calibrator on the calibration set suboptimal on the OOD test set and thus degraded calibration performance. With this knowledge, we propose a simple and effective method named adaptive calibrator ensemble (ACE) to calibrate OOD datasets whose difficulty is usually higher than the calibration set. Specifically, two calibration functions are trained, one for in-distribution data (low difficulty), and the other for severely OOD data (high difficulty). To achieve desirable calibration on a new OOD dataset, ACE uses an adaptive weighting method that strikes a balance between the two extreme functions. When plugged in, ACE generally improves the performance of a few state-of-the-art calibration schemes on a series of OOD benchmarks. Importantly, such improvement does not come at the cost of the in-distribution calibration performance. Project Website: https://github.com/insysgroup/Adaptive-Calibrators-Ensemble.git.
authors: Yuli Zou, Weijian Deng, Liang Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19333-19342

title: 自适应频率滤波器作为高效的全局标记混合器
title_en: Adaptive Frequency Filters As Efficient Global Token Mixers
abstract: 近期的视觉Transformer、大核CNN和MLP在广泛视觉任务中取得了显著成功,得益于其在全局范围内的有效信息融合。然而,其高效部署,尤其是在移动设备上,仍面临显著挑战,由于自注意力机制、大核或全连接层的高计算成本。在本工作中,我们将传统卷积定理应用于深度学习以解决这一问题,并揭示自适应频率滤波器可以作为高效的全局标记混合器。基于这一见解,我们提出自适应频率滤波(AFF)标记混合器。该神经算子通过傅里叶变换将潜在表示转换到频率域,并通过逐元素乘法进行语义自适应频率滤波,这在数学上等同于在原始潜在空间中使用动态卷积核进行标记混合操作,动态卷积核的大小等于该潜在表示的空间分辨率。我们将AFF标记混合器作为主要神经算子构建轻量级神经网络,称为AFFNet。大量实验验证了我们提出的AFF标记混合器的有效性,并表明在包括视觉识别和密集预测任务在内的广泛视觉任务中,AFFNet在准确率与效率的权衡上优于其他轻量级网络设计。
abstract_en: Recent vision transformers, large-kernel CNNs and MLPs have attained remarkable successes in broad vision tasks thanks to their effective information fusion in the global scope. However, their efficient deployments, especially on mobile devices, still suffer from noteworthy challenges due to the heavy computational costs of self-attention mechanisms, large kernels, or fully connected layers. In this work, we apply conventional convolution theorem to deep learning for addressing this and reveal that adaptive frequency filters can serve as efficient global token mixer. With this insight, we propose Adaptive Frequency Filtering (AFF) token mixer. This neural operator transfers a latent representation to the frequency domain via a Fourier transform and performs semantic-adaptive frequency filtering via an elementwise multiplication, which mathematically equals to a token mixing operation in the original latent space with a dynamic convolution kernel as large as the spatial resolution of this latent representation. We take AFF token mixers as primary neural operators to build a lightweight neural network, dubbed AFFNet. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed AFF token mixer and show that AFFNet achieve superior accuracy and efficiency trade-offs compared to other lightweight network designs on broad visual tasks, including visual recognition and dense prediction tasks.
authors: Zhipeng Huang, Zhizheng Zhang, Cuiling Lan, Zheng-Jun Zha, Yan Lu, Baining Guo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6049-6059

title: 原始图像中的阴影检测的自适应光照映射
title_en: Adaptive Illumination Mapping for Shadow Detection in Raw Images
abstract: 阴影检测方法依赖于多尺度对比度,尤其是全局对比度信息来正确定位阴影。然而,我们观察到相机图像信号处理器(ISP)在原始图像到sRGB的转换过程中,倾向于通过牺牲全局对比度信息来保留更多局部对比度信息。这通常会导致现有方法在阴影区域局部对比度较低但全局对比度较高的场景中失效。本文提出了一种新颖的原始图像阴影检测方法。我们的核心思想是:与其像ISP过程那样进行多对一映射,我们可以通过学习从高动态范围原始图像到不同光照条件sRGB图像的多对多映射,从而保留多尺度对比度以实现精确的阴影检测。为此,我们首先构建了一个包含7000张原始图像和阴影掩码的新阴影数据集。随后提出了一种新型网络,包括一个新颖的自适应光照映射(AIM)模块,用于将输入原始图像投影到不同强度范围的sRGB图像,以及一个利用保留的多尺度对比度信息进行阴影检测的模块。为学习阴影感知的自适应光照映射过程,我们提出了一种新颖的反馈机制来指导训练期间AIM的优化。实验表明,我们的方法优于现有的最先进的阴影检测器。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/jiayusun/SARA获取。
abstract_en: Shadow detection methods rely on multi-scale contrast, especially global contrast, information to locate shadows correctly. However, we observe that the camera image signal processor (ISP) tends to preserve more local contrast information by sacrificing global contrast information during the raw-to-sRGB conversion process. This often causes existing methods to fail in scenes with high global contrast but low local contrast in shadow regions. In this paper, we propose a novel method to detect shadows from raw images. Our key idea is that instead of performing a many-to-one mapping like the ISP process, we can learn a many-to-many mapping from the high dynamic range raw images to the sRGB images of different illumination, which is able to preserve multi-scale contrast for accurate shadow detection. To this end, we first construct a new shadow dataset with  7000 raw images and shadow masks. We then propose a novel network, which includes a novel adaptive illumination mapping (AIM) module to project the input raw images into sRGB images of different intensity ranges and a shadow detection module to leverage the preserved multi-scale contrast information to detect shadows. To learn the shadow-aware adaptive illumination mapping process, we propose a novel feedback mechanism to guide the AIM during training. Experiments show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art shadow detectors. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/jiayusun/SARA.
authors: Jiayu Sun, Ke Xu, Youwei Pang, Lihe Zhang, Huchuan Lu, Gerhard Hancke, Rynson Lau ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12709-12718

title: 神经网络图像分类背景下自适应图像匿名化
title_en: Adaptive Image Anonymization in the Context of Image Classification with Neural Networks
abstract: 基于深度学习的方法已成为各种计算机视觉任务的事实标准。然而,它们反复显示出对各种形式输入扰动(如像素修改、区域匿名化等)的脆弱性,这些扰动与对抗攻击密切相关。本研究特别关注图像匿名化这一案例,这对于保护隐私、确保个人数字信息免受不同服务的暴露和潜在滥用具有重要意义。然而,应用匿名化会导致分类器在应用前后产生不同的类别决策,从而降低分类器的可靠性和可用性。为实现对该问题的稳健解决方案,我们提出了一种新颖的匿名化流程,使现有分类器在不修改分类模型的情况下,对匿名化图像实现类别决策不变性。我们在流行的ImageNet基准以及大规模工业通行费分类问题的数据集上进行了大量实验。获得的结果证实了所提方法的有效性,其在两个数据集上均实现了0%的类别决策变化率,相比之下,使用朴素匿名化方法在ImageNet上为15.95%,在通行费数据集上为0.18%。此外,该方法展现出在不同领域类似问题中应用的巨大潜力。
abstract_en: Deep learning based methods have become the de-facto standard for various computer vision tasks. Nevertheless, they have repeatedly shown their vulnerability to various form of input perturbations such as pixels modification, region anonymization, etc. which are closely related to the adversarial attacks. This research particularly addresses the case of image anonymization, which is significantly important to preserve privacy and hence to secure digitized form of personal information from being exposed and potentially misused by different services that have captured it for various purposes. However, applying anonymization causes the classifier to provide different class decisions before and after applying it and therefore reduces the classifier's reliability and usability. In order to achieve a robust solution to this problem we propose a novel anonymization procedure that allows the existing classifiers to become class decision invariant on the anonymized images without any modification requires to apply on the classification models. We conduct numerous experiments on the popular ImageNet benchmark as well as on a large scale industrial toll classification problem's dataset. Obtained results confirm the efficiency and effectiveness of the proposed method as it obtained 0% rate of class decision change for both datasets compared to 15.95% on ImageNet and 0.18% on toll dataset obtained by applying the naive anonymization approaches. Moreover, it has shown a great potential to be applied to similar problems from different domains.
authors: Nadiya Shvai, Arcadi Llanza Carmona, Amir Nakib ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5074-5083

title: 用于条件面部编辑的自适应非线性潜在变换
title_en: Adaptive Nonlinear Latent Transformation for Conditional Face Editing
abstract: 近期的面部编辑工作通常通过线性语义方向操作StyleGAN的潜在空间。然而,这些方法通常面临面部属性的纠缠问题,需要调整最佳编辑强度,并且受限于具有强监督信号的二元属性。本文提出了一种新颖的自适应非线性潜在变换方法,用于解缠绕和条件面部编辑,称为AdaTrans。具体而言,我们的AdaTrans将操作过程细分为多个更精细的步骤;即,每一步的方向和大小同时依赖于面部属性和潜在代码。通过这种方式,AdaTrans描述了一条自适应的非线性变换轨迹,能够在保持其他属性不变的情况下,将面部编辑至目标属性。随后,AdaTrans利用预定义的密度模型,通过最大化转换后潜在代码的似然,约束学习到的轨迹分布于潜在代码的分布中。此外,我们还提出了一种基于互信息框架的解缠绕学习策略,以消除属性间的纠缠,从而进一步降低对标注数据的需求。因此,AdaTrans实现了可控的面部编辑,具有解缠绕、支持非二元属性的灵活性以及高保真度的优势。在各种面部属性上的大量实验结果验证了所提AdaTrans在现有最先进方法上的定性和定量有效性,尤其是在存在较大年龄差距和少量标注示例的最具挑战性场景中。源代码可在https://github.com/Hzzone/AdaTrans获取。
abstract_en: Recent works for face editing usually manipulate the latent space of StyleGAN via the linear semantic directions. However, they usually suffer from the entanglement of facial attributes, need to tune the optimal editing strength, and are limited to binary attributes with strong supervision signals. This paper proposes a novel adaptive nonlinear latent transformation for disentangled and conditional face editing, termed AdaTrans. Specifically, our AdaTrans divides the manipulation process into several finer steps; i.e., the direction and size at each step are conditioned on both the facial attributes and the latent codes. In this way, AdaTrans describes an adaptive nonlinear transformation trajectory to manipulate the faces into target attributes while keeping other attributes unchanged. Then, AdaTrans leverages a predefined density model to constrain the learned trajectory in the distribution of latent codes by maximizing the likelihood of transformed latent code. Moreover, we also propose a disentangled learning strategy under a mutual information framework to eliminate the entanglement among attributes, which can further relax the need for labeled data. Consequently, AdaTrans enables a controllable face editing with the advantages of disentanglement, flexibility with non-binary attributes, and high fidelity. Extensive experimental results on various facial attributes demonstrate the qualitative and quantitative effectiveness of the proposed AdaTrans over existing state-of-the-art methods, especially in the most challenging scenarios with a large age gap and few labeled examples. The source code is available at https://github.com/Hzzone/AdaTrans.
authors: Zhizhong Huang, Siteng Ma, Junping Zhang, Hongming Shan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21022-21031

title: 用于光束法平差神经辐射场的自适应位置编码
title_en: Adaptive Positional Encoding for Bundle-Adjusting Neural Radiance Fields
abstract: 神经辐射场展现出巨大的潜力,仅通过少量离散的图像观测即可合成新颖的视角。然而,学习场景表示所需的精确相机参数限制了其进一步应用。本文提出了一种自适应位置编码(APE),用于光束法平差神经辐射场,以从未知的相机姿态(甚至内参)重建神经辐射场。受傅里叶级数回归的启发,我们研究了其与位置编码方法的关系,因此提出了APE,其中所有频率带都是可训练的。此外,我们引入了周期激活的多层感知机(PMLPs),以构建隐式网络,用于反向传播过程中高阶场景表示和细粒度梯度。在公开数据集上的实验结果表明,结合APE和PMLPs的所提方法在精确的相机姿态和高保真视角合成方面均优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Neural Radiance Fields have shown great potential to synthesize novel views with only a few discrete image observations of the world. However, the requirement of accurate camera parameters to learn scene representations limits its further application. In this paper, we present adaptive positional encoding (APE) for bundle-adjusting neural radiance fields to reconstruct the neural radiance fields from unknown camera poses (or even intrinsics). Inspired by Fourier series regression, we investigate its relationship with the positional encoding method and therefore propose APE where all frequency bands are trainable. Furthermore, we introduce period-activated multilayer perceptrons (PMLPs) to construct the implicit network for the high-order scene representations and fine-grain gradients during backpropagation. Experimental results on public datasets demonstrate that the proposed method with APE and PMLPs can outperform the state-of-the-art methods in accurate camera poses and high-fidelity view synthesis.
authors: Zelin Gao, Weichen Dai, Yu Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3284-3294

title: 基于神经引导的MAGSAC自适应重排序采样器
title_en: Adaptive Reordering Sampler with Neurally Guided MAGSAC
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的采样器,用于鲁棒估计器,始终选择仅由内点组成的概率最高的样本。在每次不成功的迭代后,通过贝叶斯方法以一种原理性的方式更新内点概率。深度网络获得的概率被用作采样器内部的先验(所谓的神经引导)。此外,我们引入了一种新的损失函数,以几何上合理的方式利用任何类型特征(例如SIFT或SuperPoint)可估计的方向和尺度,来估计双视角几何。新的损失函数有助于学习底层场景几何的高阶信息。得益于新的采样器和提出的损失函数,我们将神经引导与最先进的MAGSAC++相结合。基于神经引导的MAGSAC自适应重排序采样器(ARS-MAGSAC)在PhotoTourism和KITTI数据集上,针对本质矩阵和基础矩阵估计,在准确性和运行时间方面均优于最先进的方法。代码和训练好的模型可在https://github.com/weitong8591/ars_magsac获取。
abstract_en: We propose a new sampler for robust estimators that always selects the sample with the highest probability of consisting only of inliers. After every unsuccessful iteration, the inlier probabilities are updated in a principled way via a Bayesian approach. The probabilities obtained by the deep network are used as prior (so-called neural guidance) inside the sampler. Moreover, we introduce a new loss that exploits, in a geometrically justifiable manner, the orientation and scale that can be estimated for any type of feature, e.g., SIFT or SuperPoint, to estimate two-view geometry. The new loss helps to learn higher-order information about the underlying scene geometry. Benefiting from the new sampler and the proposed loss, we combine the neural guidance with the state-of-the-art MAGSAC++. Adaptive Reordering Sampler with Neurally Guided MAGSAC (ARS-MAGSAC) is superior to the state-of-the-art in terms of accuracy and run-time on the PhotoTourism and KITTI datasets for essential and fundamental matrix estimation. The code and trained models are available at https://github.com/weitong8591/ars_magsac.
authors: Tong Wei, Jiri Matas, Daniel Barath ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18163-18173

title: 自适应旋转卷积在旋转目标检测中的应用
title_en: Adaptive Rotated Convolution for Rotated Object Detection
abstract: 旋转目标检测旨在识别和定位图像中任意方向的目标。在此场景中,不同图像中目标的朝向差异显著,且单幅图像中存在多种目标朝向。这种固有特性使得标准骨干网络难以提取这些任意方向目标的高质量特征。本文提出自适应旋转卷积(ARC)模块以应对上述挑战。在我们的ARC模块中,卷积核自适应旋转以提取不同图像中不同方向的目标特征,并引入高效的条件计算机制以适应图像内目标的大幅方向变化。两种设计无缝融合于旋转目标检测问题。此外,ARC可便捷地作为即插即用模块集成到各种视觉骨干网络中,提升其对定向目标的表征能力。在常用基准(DOTA和HRSC2016)上的实验表明,搭载所提出的ARC模块的骨干网络显著提升了多种流行定向目标检测器的性能(例如:在旋转RetinaNet上mAP提升3.03%,在CFA上提升4.16%)。结合具有竞争力的Oriented R-CNN方法,所提方法在DOTA数据集上达到81.77% mAP的最先进性能。代码详见https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/ARC。
abstract_en: Rotated object detection aims to identify and locate objects in images with arbitrary orientation. In this scenario, the oriented directions of objects vary considerably across different images, while multiple orientations of objects exist within an image. This intrinsic characteristic makes it challenging for standard backbone networks to extract high-quality features of these arbitrarily orientated objects. In this paper, we present Adaptive Rotated Convolution (ARC) module to handle the aforementioned challenges. In our ARC module, the convolution kernels rotate adaptively to extract object features with varying orientations in different images, and an efficient conditional computation mechanism is introduced to accommodate the large orientation variations of objects within an image. The two designs work seamlessly in rotated object detection problem. Moreover, ARC can conveniently serve as a plug-and-play module in various vision backbones to boost their representation ability to detect oriented objects accurately. Experiments on commonly used benchmarks (DOTA and HRSC2016) demonstrate that equipped with our proposed ARC module in the backbone network, the performance of multiple popular oriented object detectors is significantly improved (e.g. +3.03% mAP on Rotated RetinaNet and +4.16% on CFA). Combined with the highly competitive method Oriented R-CNN, the proposed approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on the DOTA dataset with 81.77% mAP. Code is available at https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/ARC.
authors: Yifan Pu, Yiru Wang, Zhuofan Xia, Yizeng Han, Yulin Wang, Weihao Gan, Zidong Wang, Shiji Song, Gao Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6589-6600

title: 基于自蒸馏的表示学习的自适应相似性自举方法
title_en: Adaptive Similarity Bootstrapping for Self-Distillation Based Representation Learning
abstract: 大多数用于表示学习的自监督方法采用跨视图一致性目标,即最大化给定图像增强视图的表示相似性。近期工作NNCLR超越了跨视图范式,在对比学习设置中使用最近邻自举获取的不同图像的正样本对。我们实证表明,与依赖负样本的对比学习设置不同,将最近邻自举纳入自蒸馏方案可能导致性能下降甚至崩溃。我们深入分析了这种意外行为的原因并提出了解决方案。我们提出根据潜在空间估计质量自适应地自举邻居。与朴素自举方法和原始基线相比,我们的方法实现了持续改进。我们的方法在各种自蒸馏方法/主干组合和标准下游任务中均取得性能提升。我们的代码已公开在https://github.com/tileb1/AdaSim。
abstract_en: Most self-supervised methods for representation learning leverage a cross-view consistency objective i.e., they maximize the representation similarity of a given image's augmented views. Recent work NNCLR goes beyond the cross-view paradigm and uses positive pairs from different images obtained via nearest neighbor bootstrapping in a contrastive setting. We empirically show that as opposed to the contrastive learning setting which relies on negative samples, incorporating nearest neighbor bootstrapping in a self-distillation scheme can lead to a performance drop or even collapse. We scrutinize the reason for this unexpected behavior and provide a solution. We propose to adaptively bootstrap neighbors based on the estimated quality of the latent space. We report consistent improvements compared to the naive bootstrapping approach and the original baselines. Our approach leads to performance improvements for various self-distillation method/backbone combinations and standard downstream tasks. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/tileb1/AdaSim.
authors: Tim Lebailly, Thomas Stegmüller, Behzad Bozorgtabar, Jean-Philippe Thiran, Tinne Tuytelaars ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16505-16514

title: 面向网格的高效3D表示学习自适应螺旋层
title_en: Adaptive Spiral Layers for Efficient 3D Representation Learning on Meshes
abstract: 深度学习模型在结构化数据上的成功引发了将其扩展到非欧几里得领域的广泛兴趣。本文提出了一种适用于3D网格表示学习的新颖内禀算子。我们的算子专门针对底层图的不规则结构进行定制,能够有效利用其长程依赖性,同时确保计算效率和优化便捷性。具体而言,受螺旋卷积框架的启发,该框架按照局部螺旋顺序提取并转换3D网格顶点,我们提出了一种通用算子,动态调整每个处理顶点和网格的螺旋轨迹长度及转换参数。随后,通过多阶分解将密集权重张量分解为一系列轻量线性层,分别处理特征和顶点信息,从而显著降低计算复杂度而无需引入严格归纳偏置。值得注意的是,我们利用动态门控实现空间自适应性,并通过基于累加面积表的高效动态池化机制,在常数时间复杂度下实现全局推理。作为现有形状对应架构的直接替代方案,我们的算子显著提升了性能-效率权衡,在使用可变形模型的3D形状生成中实现了参数数量减少三倍的最先进性能。项目页面:https://github.com/Fb2221/DFC
abstract_en: The success of deep learning models on structured data has generated significant interest in extending their application to non-Euclidean domains. In this work, we introduce a novel intrinsic operator suitable for representation learning on 3D meshes. Our operator is specifically tailored to adapt its behavior to the irregular structure of the underlying graph and effectively utilize its long-range dependencies, while at the same time ensuring computational efficiency and ease of optimization. In particular, inspired by the framework of Spiral Convolution, which extracts and transforms the vertices in the 3D mesh following a local spiral ordering, we propose a general operator that dynamically adjusts the length of the spiral trajectory and the parameters of the transformation for each processed vertex and mesh. Then, we use polyadic decomposition to factorize its dense weight tensor into a sequence of lighter linear layers that separately process features and vertices information, hence significantly reducing the computational complexity without introducing any stringent inductive biases. Notably, we leverage dynamic gating to achieve spatial adaptivity and induce global reasoning with constant time complexity benefitting from an efficient dynamic pooling mechanism based on Summed-Area-tables. Used as a drop-in replacement on existing architectures for shape correspondence our operator significantly improves the performance-efficiency trade-off, and in 3D shape generation with morphable models achieves state-of-the-art performance with a three-fold reduction in the number of parameters required. Project page: https://github.com/Fb2221/DFC
authors: Francesca Babiloni, Matteo Maggioni, Thomas Tanay, Jiankang Deng, Ales Leonardis, Stefanos Zafeiriou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14620-14631

title: 用于语义分割主动学习的自适应超像素
title_en: Adaptive Superpixel for Active Learning in Semantic Segmentation
abstract: 学习语义分割需要逐像素标注,这通常耗时且昂贵。为降低标注成本,我们提出了一种基于超像素的主动学习(AL)框架,该框架通过为每个超像素收集一个主导标签来替代逐像素标注。具体而言,该框架由自适应超像素和筛选机制组成,完全专注于主动学习。在每次主动学习轮次中,我们自适应地将具有相似学习特征的相邻像素合并为超像素。随后,我们使用获取函数查询这些超像素的一个选定子集,假设超像素大小不均匀。这种方法比现有方法更高效,现有方法仅依赖于固有特征(如RGB颜色)并假设超像素大小均匀。为每个超像素获取一个主导标签大大减轻了标注者的负担,因为它需要更少的点击操作。然而,由于超像素与真实分割之间的不匹配,这种方法不可避免地引入噪声标注。为了解决这个问题,我们进一步设计了一种筛选机制,用于识别并排除潜在的噪声标注。我们在Cityscapes和PASCAL VOC数据集上的实验验证了自适应超像素和筛选机制的有效性。
abstract_en: Learning semantic segmentation requires pixel-wise annotations, which can be time-consuming and expensive. To reduce the annotation cost, we propose a superpixel-based active learning (AL) framework, which collects a dominant label per superpixel instead. To be specific, it consists of adaptive superpixel and sieving mechanisms, fully dedicated to AL. At each round of AL, we adaptively merge neighboring pixels of similar learned features into superpixels. We then query a selected subset of these superpixels using an acquisition function assuming no uniform superpixel size. This approach is more efficient than existing methods, which rely only on innate features such as RGB color and assume uniform superpixel sizes. Obtaining a dominant label per superpixel drastically reduces annotators' burden as it requires fewer clicks. However, it inevitably introduces noisy annotations due to mismatches between superpixel and ground truth segmentation. To address this issue, we further devise a sieving mechanism that identifies and excludes potentially noisy annotations from learning. Our experiments on both Cityscapes and PASCAL VOC datasets demonstrate the efficacy of adaptive superpixel and sieving mechanisms.
authors: Hoyoung Kim, Minhyeon Oh, Sehyun Hwang, Suha Kwak, Jungseul Ok ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 943-953

title: 电子显微镜图像中线粒体分割的自适应模板变换器
title_en: Adaptive Template Transformer for Mitochondria Segmentation in Electron Microscopy Images
abstract: 线粒体作为细胞内的微小结构,对研究细胞功能在生物和临床分析中具有重要意义。探索如何在电子显微镜(EM)图像中自动分割线粒体引起了越来越多的关注。然而,由于传统卷积神经网络架构的固有局限性,现有方法难以适应输入的不同尺度和外观。为缓解这些局限性,我们提出了一种新颖的自适应模板变换器(ATFormer)用于线粒体分割。所提出的ATFormer模型具有多项优势。首先,设计的结构模板学习模块可以获取背景、前景和轮廓的外观自适应模板,以感知线粒体不同形状的特征。我们进一步采用最优传输算法扩大不同模板之间的差异,以充分激活对应区域。其次,我们引入层次化注意力学习机制,以吸收多级信息,使模板成为自适应尺度感知分类器,用于密集预测。在包括MitoEM、Lucchi和NucMM-Z数据集在内的三个具有挑战性的基准上的大量实验结果表明,我们的ATFormer优于最先进的线粒体分割方法。
abstract_en: Mitochondria, as tiny structures within the cell, are of significant importance to study cell functions for biological and clinical analysis. And exploring how to automatically segment mitochondria in electron microscopy (EM) images has attracted increasing attention. However, most of existing methods struggle to adapt to different scales and appearances of the input due to the inherent limitations of the traditional CNN architecture. To mitigate these limitations, we propose a novel adaptive template transformer (ATFormer) for mitochondria segmentation. The proposed ATFormer model enjoys several merits. First, the designed structural template learning module can acquire appearance-adaptive templates of background, foreground and contour to sense the characteristics of different shapes of mitochondria. And we further adopt an optimal transport algorithm to enlarge the discrepancy among diverse templates to fully activate corresponding regions. Second, we introduce a hierarchical attention learning mechanism to absorb multi-level information for templates to be adaptive scale-aware classifiers for dense prediction. Extensive experimental results on three challenging benchmarks including MitoEM, Lucchi and NucMM-Z datasets demonstrate that our ATFormer performs favorably against state-of-the-art mitochondria segmentation methods.
authors: Yuwen Pan, Naisong Luo, Rui Sun, Meng Meng, Tianzhu Zhang, Zhiwei Xiong, Yongdong Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21474-21484

title: 计算机视觉模型的自适应测试
title_en: Adaptive Testing of Computer Vision Models
abstract: 视觉模型常常在具有共同语义特征的数据组(例如罕见物体或异常场景)上系统性失效,但识别这些失效模式具有挑战性。我们引入AdaVision,一种交互式测试视觉模型的流程,帮助用户识别并修复一致的失效模式。给定一个描述一致数据组的自然语言描述,AdaVision利用CLIP从LAION-5B中检索相关图像。用户随后对少量数据进行标注以验证模型正确性,这些标注数据用于后续检索轮次,向高错误区域攀升,从而精炼数据组定义。当数据组达到饱和时,AdaVision使用GPT-3为用户提供新的数据组描述建议。我们在用户研究中展示了AdaVision的实用性和通用性,用户在此过程中发现了当前最先进的分类、目标检测和图像描述生成模型中的主要缺陷。这些由用户发现的数据组的失效率是自动错误聚类方法发现的2-3倍。最后,在使用AdaVision发现的示例上进行微调,可以在未见过的示例上修复发现的缺陷,而不会降低分布内准确率,同时还能提升分布外数据集的性能。
abstract_en: Vision models often fail systematically on groups of data that share common semantic characteristics (e.g., rare objects or unusual scenes), but identifying these failure modes is a challenge. We introduce AdaVision, an interactive process for testing vision models which helps users identify and fix coherent failure modes. Given a natural language description of a coherent group, AdaVision retrieves relevant images from LAION-5B with CLIP. The user then labels a small amount of data for model correctness, which is used in successive retrieval rounds to hill-climb towards high-error regions, refining the group definition. Once a group is saturated, AdaVision uses GPT-3 to suggest new group descriptions for the user to explore. We demonstrate the usefulness and generality of AdaVision in user studies, where users find major bugs in state-of-the-art classification, object detection, and image captioning models. These user-discovered groups have failure rates 2-3x higher than those surfaced by automatic error clustering methods. Finally, finetuning on examples found with AdaVision fixes the discovered bugs when evaluated on unseen examples, without degrading in-distribution accuracy, and while also improving performance on out-of-distribution datasets.
authors: Irena Gao, Gabriel Ilharco, Scott Lundberg, Marco Tulio Ribeiro ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4003-4014

title: 自适应且背景感知的视觉Transformer在实时无人机跟踪中的应用
title_en: Adaptive and Background-Aware Vision Transformer for Real-Time UAV Tracking
abstract: 尽管基于判别相关滤波器(DCF)的跟踪器因其良好的效率在无人机跟踪中占据主导地位,但采用滤波器剪枝的轻量级卷积神经网络(CNN)跟踪器也展现出显著的效率和精度。然而,纯视觉Transformer模型(ViTs)在无人机跟踪中的应用尚未被探索,这与ViTs在图像分类中表现出优于CNN的性能和效率形成鲜明对比。本文提出了一种高效的ViT-based跟踪框架Aba-ViTrack用于无人机跟踪。在我们的框架中,特征学习与模板搜索耦合被整合到单流ViT中,以避免额外的重关系建模模块。所提出的Aba-ViT采用自适应且背景感知的标记计算方法以减少推理时间。该方法根据学习到的停止概率自适应丢弃标记,其中背景标记的先验停止概率高于目标标记。在六个无人机跟踪基准上的广泛实验表明,所提出的Aba-ViTrack在无人机跟踪中达到最先进性能。代码可在https://github.com/xyyang317/Aba-ViTrack获取。
abstract_en: While discriminative correlation filters (DCF)-based trackers prevail in UAV tracking for their favorable efficiency, lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN)-based trackers using filter pruning have also demonstrated remarkable efficiency and precision. However, the use of pure vision transformer models (ViTs) for UAV tracking remains unexplored, which is a surprising finding given that ViTs have been shown to produce better performance and greater efficiency than CNNs in image classification. In this paper, we propose an efficient ViT-based tracking framework, Aba-ViTrack, for UAV tracking. In our framework, feature learning and template-search coupling are integrated into an efficient one-stream ViT to avoid an extra heavy relation modeling module. The proposed Aba-ViT exploits an adaptive and background-aware token computation method to reduce inference time. This approach adaptively discards tokens based on learned halting probabilities, which a priori are higher for background tokens than target ones. Extensive experiments on six UAV tracking benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed Aba-ViTrack achieves state-of-the-art performance in UAV tracking. Code is available at https://github.com/xyyang317/Aba-ViTrack.
authors: Shuiwang Li, Yangxiang Yang, Dan Zeng, Xucheng Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13989-14000

title: 向文本到图像扩散模型引入条件控制
title_en: Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
abstract: 我们提出ControlNet,一种神经网络架构,用于向大型预训练文本到图像扩散模型添加空间条件控制。ControlNet锁定生产就绪的大型扩散模型,并重用其通过数十亿张图像预训练的深层且稳健的编码层作为强主干,以学习多样化的条件控制。该神经架构通过"零卷积"(零初始化卷积层)连接,这些层逐步从零增长参数并确保在微调过程中不会受到有害噪声的影响。我们使用Stable Diffusion测试了各种条件控制,例如边缘、深度、分割、人体姿态等,采用单条件或多条件,有或无提示词。我们展示了ControlNet在小(<50k)和大(>1m)数据集上的训练具有鲁棒性。大量实验结果表明,ControlNet可能促进对图像扩散模型更广泛的应用。
abstract_en: We present ControlNet, a neural network architecture to add spatial conditioning controls to large, pretrained text-to-image diffusion models. ControlNet locks the production-ready large diffusion models, and reuses their deep and robust encoding layers pretrained with billions of images as a strong backbone to learn a diverse set of conditional controls. The neural architecture is connected with "zero convolutions" (zero-initialized convolution layers) that progressively grow the parameters from zero and ensure that no harmful noise could affect the finetuning. We test various conditioning controls, e.g., edges, depth, segmentation, human pose, etc., with Stable Diffusion, using single or multiple conditions, with or without prompts. We show that the training of ControlNets is robust with small (<50k) and large (>1m) datasets. Extensive results show that ControlNet may facilitate wider applications to control image diffusion models.
authors: Lvmin Zhang, Anyi Rao, Maneesh Agrawala ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3836-3847

title: AdvDiffuser:基于扩散模型的自然对抗样本生成
title_en: AdvDiffuser: Natural Adversarial Example Synthesis with Diffusion Models
abstract: 以往对抗样本的研究通常涉及固定的范数扰动预算,这未能反映人类对扰动的感知方式。近期研究转向探索突破l_p扰动界限但语义上合理的自然无限制对抗样本(UAEs)。当前方法通过扰动潜在编码使用GAN或VAE生成UAEs,但导致高层信息丢失,生成的UAEs质量较低且不自然。针对此问题,我们提出AdvDiffuser,一种利用扩散模型合成自然UAEs的新方法。该方法可从头生成或基于参考图像条件生成UAEs。为生成自然UAEs,我们通过扰动预测图像,将潜在编码引导至特定分类器的对抗样本空间。此外,我们提出基于类激活映射的对抗性修复方法,在扰动不重要区域的同时保留图像显著区域。我们的方法在CIFAR-10、CelebA和ImageNet上取得显著成果,并证明其能在RobustBench排行榜上以近100%的成功率击败最鲁棒的模型。此外,合成的UAEs不仅比当前最先进攻击方法更自然,且更强。具体而言,与GA-attack相比,AdvDiffuser生成的UAEs表现出6倍更小的LPIPS扰动、2~3倍更小的FID分数以及0.28更高的SSIM指标,使其在感知上更具隐蔽性。最后,该方法能够生成无限数量的自然对抗样本。更多详情请访问我们的项目页面:Link to follow.
abstract_en: Previous work on adversarial examples typically involves a fixed norm perturbation budget, which fails to capture the way humans perceive perturbations. Recent work has shifted towards investigating natural unrestricted adversarial examples (UAEs) that breaks l_p perturbation bounds but nonetheless remain semantically plausible. Current methods use GAN or VAE to generate UAEs by perturbing latent codes. However, this leads to loss of high-level information, resulting in low-quality and unnatural UAEs. In light of this, we propose AddDiffuser, a new method for synthesizing natural UAEs using diffusion models. It can generate UAEs from scratch or conditionally based on reference images. To generate natural UAEs, we perturb predicted images to steer their latent code towards the adversarial sample space of a particular classifier. In addition, we propose adversarial inpainting based on class activation mapping to retain the salient regions of the image while perturbing less important areas. Our method achieves impressive results on CIFAR-10, CelebA and ImageNet, and we demonstrate that it can defeat the most robust models on the RobustBench leaderboard with near 100% success rates. Furthermore, The synthesized UAEs are not only more natural but also stronger compared to the current state-of-the-art attacks. Specifically, compared with GA-attack, the UAEs generated with AdvDiffuser exhibit 6xsmaller LPIPS perturbations, 2 ~ 3 xsmaller FID scores and 0.28 higher in SSIM metrics, making them perceptually stealthier. Lastly, it is capable of generating an unlimited number of natural adversarial examples. For more please visit our project page: Link to follow.
authors: Xinquan Chen, Xitong Gao, Juanjuan Zhao, Kejiang Ye, Cheng-Zhong Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4562-4572

title: 推进示例利用可缓解对抗训练中的关键挑战
title_en: Advancing Example Exploitation Can Alleviate Critical Challenges in Adversarial Training
abstract: 深度神经网络在各种任务中取得了显著成果。然而,它们容易受到对抗样本的影响,这些样本是通过向原始数据添加对抗扰动生成的。对抗训练(AT)是应对对抗样本最有效的防御机制,并已受到广泛关注。近期研究强调了示例利用的重要性,即通过调整模型对特定示例的学习强度来扩展经典AT方法。然而,这些研究采用的分析方法各异且存在矛盾,可能给未来研究带来困惑。为解决这一问题,我们提供了一个统一框架下的代表性策略综合总结,重点聚焦于示例利用。此外,我们探讨了示例在AT中的作用,发现主要贡献于准确率或鲁棒性的示例是不同的。基于这一发现,我们提出了一种新颖的示例利用理念,可进一步提升先进AT方法的性能。这一新理念表明,对抗训练中的关键挑战,如准确率-鲁棒性权衡、鲁棒过拟合和灾难性过拟合,可以从示例利用的角度同时缓解。代码可在https://github.com/geyao1995/advancing-example-exploitation-in-adversarial-training获取。
abstract_en: Deep neural networks have achieved remarkable results across various tasks. However, they are susceptible to adversarial examples, which are generated by adding adversarial perturbations to original data. Adversarial training (AT) is the most effective defense mechanism against adversarial examples and has received significant attention. Recent studies highlight the importance of example exploitation, where the model's learning intensity is altered for specific examples to extend classic AT approaches. However, the analysis methodologies employed by these studies are varied and contradictory, which may lead to confusion in future research. To address this issue, we provide a comprehensive summary of representative strategies focusing on exploiting examples within a unified framework. Furthermore, we investigate the role of examples in AT and find that examples which contribute primarily to accuracy or robustness are distinct. Based on this finding, we propose a novel example-exploitation idea that can further improve the performance of advanced AT methods. This new idea suggests that critical challenges in AT, such as the accuracy-robustness trade-off, robust overfitting, and catastrophic overfitting, can be alleviated simultaneously from an example-exploitation perspective. The code can be found in https://github.com/geyao1995/advancing-example-exploitation-in-adversarial-training.
authors: Yao Ge, Yun Li, Keji Han, Junyi Zhu, Xianzhong Long ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 145-154

title: 超越单图像的引用表达分割进展
title_en: Advancing Referring Expression Segmentation Beyond Single Image
abstract: 引用表达分割(RES)是一项广泛研究的多模态任务,旨在通过给定的语言表达对单图像中已存在的目标物体进行分割。然而,在更广泛的现实场景中,无法确定描述的对象是否存在于特定图像中。通常情况下,可以获取到一组图像,其中一些可能包含目标对象。为此,我们提出了一种更现实的设置,称为组级引用表达分割(GRES),将RES扩展到一组相关图像,允许描述的对象存在于输入图像组的子集中。为支持这一新设置,我们引入了一个精心编纂的数据集,称为组级引用数据集(GRD),其中包含由给定表达描述的目标对象的完整组级注释。此外,我们还提出了一种基线方法,称为组级引用分割器(GRSer),该方法明确捕捉语言-视觉和组内视觉-视觉交互,在所提出的GRES设置及相关任务(如共显著物体检测和传统RES)上实现了最先进结果。我们的数据集和代码已在https://github.com/shikras/d-cube公开发布。
abstract_en: Referring Expression Segmentation (RES) is a widely explored multi-modal task, which endeavors to segment the pre-existing object within a single image with a given linguistic expression. However, in broader real-world scenarios, it is not always possible to determine if the described object exists in a specific image. Generally, a collection of images is available, some of which potentially contain the target objects. To this end, we propose a more realistic setting, named Group-wise Referring Expression Segmentation (GRES), which expands RES to a group of related images, allowing the described objects to exist in a subset of the input image group. To support this new setting, we introduce an elaborately compiled dataset named Grouped Referring Dataset (GRD), containing complete group-wise annotations of the target objects described by given expressions. Moreover, we also present a baseline method named Grouped Referring Segmenter (GRSer), which explicitly captures the language-vision and intra-group vision-vision interactions to achieve state-of-the-art results on the proposed GRES setting and related tasks, such as Co-Salient Object Detection and traditional RES. Our dataset and codes are publicly released in https://github.com/shikras/d-cube.
authors: Yixuan Wu, Zhao Zhang, Chi Xie, Feng Zhu, Rui Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2628-2638

title: 单源域泛化的对抗贝叶斯增强
title_en: Adversarial Bayesian Augmentation for Single-Source Domain Generalization
abstract: 将模型泛化到未见过的图像域是一个具有挑战性的问题,主要由于训练数据多样性不足、目标数据不可访问以及许多现实场景中可能存在的显著域偏移。因此,数据增强是域泛化方法中解决该问题的关键组成部分。我们提出了一种新颖的算法——对抗贝叶斯增强(Adversarial Bayesian Augmentation, ABA),用于在具有挑战性的单源域泛化场景中学习生成图像增强。ABA结合了对抗学习和贝叶斯神经网络的优势,指导生成多样化的数据增强——这些合成的图像域有助于分类器泛化到未见过的域。我们在多种类型的域偏移(包括风格偏移、子群体偏移以及医学影像中的偏移)上验证了ABA的有效性。ABA在包括预定义增强、基于像素和基于卷积的增强在内的所有先前最先进的方法上均取得更好性能。代码:https://github.com/shengcheng/ABA
abstract_en: Generalizing to unseen image domains is a challenging problem primarily due to the lack of diverse training data, inaccessible target data, and the large domain shift that may exist in many real-world settings. As such data augmentation is a critical component of domain generalization methods that seek to address this problem. We present Adversarial Bayesian Augmentation (ABA), a novel algorithm that learns to generate image augmentations in the challenging single-source domain generalization setting. ABA draws on the strengths of adversarial learning and Bayesian neural networks to guide the generation of diverse data augmentations - these synthesized image domains aid the classifier in generalizing to unseen domains. We demonstrate the strength of ABA on several types of domain shift including style shift, subpopulation shift, and shift in the medical imaging setting. ABA outperforms all previous state-of-the-art methods, including pre-specified augmentations, pixel-based and convolutional-based augmentations. Code: https://github.com/shengcheng/ABA.
authors: Sheng Cheng, Tejas Gokhale, Yezhou Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11400-11410

title: 基于潜在表示约束的对抗微调以缓解准确率-鲁棒性权衡
title_en: Adversarial Finetuning with Latent Representation Constraint to Mitigate Accuracy-Robustness Tradeoff
abstract: 本文针对深度神经网络(DNNs)中干净样本的标准准确率与对抗样本鲁棒性之间的权衡问题展开研究。尽管对抗训练(AT)能够提升鲁棒性,但会降低标准准确率,从而产生该权衡。为缓解这一权衡,我们提出了一种新型对抗训练方法ARREST,其包含三个组成部分:(i) 对抗微调(AFT),(ii) 表示引导的知识蒸馏(RGKD),以及(iii) 噪声回放(NR)。AFT通过以标准预训练在干净样本上的DNN参数初始化,对DNN进行对抗样本训练。RGKD和NR分别包含一个正则化项和一个算法,在AFT过程中保持干净样本的潜在表示。RGKD惩罚标准预训练DNN与AFT DNN表示之间的距离。NR在AFT过程中当表示发生显著变化时,将输入的对抗样本切换为非对抗样本。通过结合这些组件,ARREST实现了高标准准确率与鲁棒性的双重目标。实验结果表明,ARREST比以往基于对抗训练的方法更有效地缓解了该权衡。
abstract_en:
This paper addresses the tradeoff between standard accuracy on clean examples and robustness against adversarial examples in deep neural networks (DNNs).
 Although adversarial training (AT) improves robustness, it degrades the standard accuracy, thus yielding the tradeoff.
 To mitigate this tradeoff, we propose a novel AT method called ARREST, which comprises three components: (i) adversarial finetuning (AFT), (ii) representation-guided knowledge distillation (RGKD), and (iii) noisy replay (NR).
 AFT trains a DNN on adversarial examples by initializing its parameters with a DNN that is standardly pretrained on clean examples.
 RGKD and NR respectively entail a regularization term and an algorithm to preserve latent representations of clean examples during AFT.
 RGKD penalizes the distance between the representations of the standardly pretrained and AFT DNNs.
 NR switches input adversarial examples to nonadversarial ones when the representation changes significantly during AFT.
 By combining these components, ARREST achieves both high standard accuracy and robustness.
 Experimental results demonstrate that ARREST mitigates the tradeoff more effectively than previous AT-based methods do.
authors: Satoshi Suzuki, Shin'ya Yamaguchi, Shoichiro Takeda, Sekitoshi Kanai, Naoki Makishima, Atsushi Ando, Ryo Masumura ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4390-4401

title: 基于码本先验的恶劣天气去除
title_en: Adverse Weather Removal with Codebook Priors
abstract: 尽管统一恶劣天气去除方法取得了近期进展,但实现逼真细粒度纹理和可靠背景重建仍面临重大挑战,以减轻严重失真。受码本和向量量化(VQ)技术最新进展启发,我们提出了一种基于码本先验的恶劣天气去除网络(AWRCP),以解决统一恶劣天气去除问题。AWRCP利用从无失真图像中提取的高质量码本先验,以恢复生动的纹理细节和忠实的背景结构。然而,简单利用码本中的高质量特征并不能保证在细粒度细节和结构保真度方面取得良好效果。因此,我们开发了一种可变形跨注意力机制与稀疏采样机制,以实现退化特征与码本先验高质量特征之间的灵活特征交互。为有效融合高质量纹理特征同时保持码本先验生成细节的真实性,我们提出了一种层次化纹理变形头,在最终恢复阶段逐步将层次化码本先验特征融合到高分辨率特征中。通过利用VQ码本作为高质量特征字典以及所提出的设计,AWRCP在多个恶劣天气去除基准测试中显著提升了纹理细节的恢复质量,实现了最先进性能。
abstract_en:
Despite recent advancements in unified adverse weather removal methods, there remains a significant challenge of achieving realistic fine-grained texture and reliable background reconstruction to mitigate serious distortions.
 
 Inspired by recent advancements in codebook and vector quantization (VQ) techniques, we present a novel Adverse Weather Removal network with Codebook Priors (AWRCP) to address the problem of unified adverse weather removal. AWRCP leverages high-quality codebook priors derived from undistorted images to recover vivid texture details and faithful background structures. However, simply utilizing high-quality features from the codebook does not guarantee good results in terms of fine-grained details and structural fidelity. Therefore, we develop a deformable cross-attention with sparse sampling mechanism for flexible perform feature interaction between degraded features and high-quality features from codebook priors. In order to effectively incorporate high-quality texture features while maintaining the realism of the details generated by codebook priors, we propose a hierarchical texture warping head that gradually fuses hierarchical codebook prior features into high-resolution features at final restoring stage.
 
 With the utilization of the VQ codebook as a feature dictionary of high quality and the proposed designs, AWRCP can largely improve the restored quality of texture details, achieving the state-of-the-art performance across multiple adverse weather removal benchmark.
authors: Tian Ye, Sixiang Chen, Jinbin Bai, Jun Shi, Chenghao Xue, Jingxia Jiang, Junjie Yin, Erkang Chen, Yun Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12653-12664

title: 空中视觉-语言导航:面向无人机的应用
title_en: AerialVLN: Vision-and-Language Navigation for UAVs
abstract: 近年来兴起的视觉-语言导航(VLN)任务在计算机视觉和自然语言处理领域引起了广泛关注。现有VLN任务主要针对地面导航代理,包括室内外环境。然而,许多任务需要智能代理在空中执行,例如基于无人机的货物配送、交通/安防巡逻以及观光游览等。在空中导航比地面导航更为复杂,因为代理需要考虑飞行高度和更复杂的空间关系推理。为填补这一空白并促进该领域研究,我们提出了一种新的任务AerialVLN,该任务面向户外环境并基于无人机。我们开发了一个由25个城市级场景的近真实图像渲染的3D模拟器。我们的模拟器支持连续导航、环境扩展和配置。我们还提出了一种基于广泛使用的跨模态对齐(CMA)导航方法的扩展基线模型。我们发现基线模型与人类表现之间仍存在显著差距,这表明AerialVLN是一个新的具有挑战性的任务。
abstract_en: Recently emerged Vision-and-Language Navigation(VLN) tasks have drawn significant attention in both computer vision and natural language processing communities. Existing VLN tasks are built for agents that navigate on the ground, either indoors or outdoors. However, many tasks require intelligent agents to carry out in the sky, such as UAV-based goods delivery, traffic/security patrol, and scenery tour, to name a few. Navigating in the sky is more complicated than on the ground because agents need to consider the flying height and more complex spatial relationship reasoning. To fill this gap and facilitate research in this field, we propose a new task named AerialVLN, which is UAV-based and towards outdoor environments. We develop a 3D simulator rendered by near-realistic pictures of 25 city-level scenarios. Our simulator supports continuous navigation, environment extension and configuration. We also proposed an extended baseline model based on the widely-used cross modal-alignment (CMA) navigation methods. We find that there is still a significant gap between the baseline model and human performance, which suggests AerialVLN is a new challenging task.
authors: Shubo Liu, Hongsheng Zhang, Yuankai Qi, Peng Wang, Yanning Zhang, Qi Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15384-15394

title: AesPA-Net:美学模式感知的风格迁移网络
title_en: AesPA-Net: Aesthetic Pattern-Aware Style Transfer Networks
abstract: 为了传达目标风格的艺术表达,近期研究利用注意力机制,因其能够将风格图像的局部块映射到内容图像的对应块。然而,由于任意内容与艺术品之间的低语义对应性,注意力模块反复滥用风格图像的特定局部块,导致不协调且明显的重复伪影。为克服这一限制并实现完美的艺术风格迁移,我们专注于增强注意力机制并捕捉组织风格的模式的节奏。本文提出了一种新的度量标准,即模式可重复性,用于量化风格图像中模式的重复性。基于模式可重复性,我们提出了美学模式感知的风格迁移网络(AesPA-Net),以发现局部和全局风格表达的最佳平衡点。此外,我们提出了一种新的自监督任务,以鼓励注意力机制学习精确且有意义的语义对应关系。最后,我们引入了基于块的风格损失,以迁移局部模式的精致节奏。通过定性和定量评估,我们验证了所提出的模式可重复性与人类感知的一致性,并展示了所提框架的优越性。
abstract_en: To deliver the artistic expression of the target style, recent studies exploit the attention mechanism owing to its ability to map the local patches of the style image to the corresponding patches of the content image. However, because of the low semantic correspondence between arbitrary content and artworks, the attention module repeatedly abuses specific local patches from the style image, resulting in disharmonious and evident repetitive artifacts. To overcome this limitation and accomplish impeccable artistic style transfer, we focus on enhancing the attention mechanism and capturing the rhythm of patterns that organize the style. In this paper, we introduce a novel metric, namely pattern repeatability, that quantifies the repetition of patterns in the style image. Based on the pattern repeatability, we propose Aesthetic Pattern-Aware style transfer Networks (AesPA-Net) that discover the sweet spot of local and global style expressions. In addition, we propose a novel self-supervisory task to encourage the attention mechanism to learn precise and meaningful semantic correspondence. Lastly, we introduce the patch-wise style loss to transfer the elaborate rhythm of local patterns. Through qualitative and quantitative evaluations, we verify the reliability of the proposed pattern repeatability that aligns with human perception, and demonstrate the superiority of the proposed framework.
authors: Kibeom Hong, Seogkyu Jeon, Junsoo Lee, Namhyuk Ahn, Kunhee Kim, Pilhyeon Lee, Daesik Kim, Youngjung Uh, Hyeran Byun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22758-22767

title: 情感图像滤镜:从文本到图像的情感反映
title_en: Affective Image Filter: Reflecting Emotions from Text to Images
abstract: 理解文本中的情感并将其可视化呈现是一个极具挑战性的问题,需要同时深入理解自然语言和高质量图像合成。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新型模型Affective Image Filter(AIF),该模型能够理解文本中的视觉抽象情感,并通过适当的色彩和纹理将其反映为视觉具体的图像。我们基于多模态Transformer架构构建模型,将图像和文本统一为token并编码情感先验知识。我们提出了多种损失函数以理解复杂情感并生成合适的可视化结果。此外,我们收集并贡献了一个包含丰富审美图像和情感文本的新数据集用于AIF模型的训练与评估。我们精心设计了四个定量评估指标并开展用户研究,全面评估模型性能,实验结果表明我们的AIF模型优于现有最先进方法,能够引发人类观察者特定的情感反应。
abstract_en: Understanding the emotions in text and presenting them visually is a very challenging problem that requires a deep understanding of natural language and high-quality image synthesis simultaneously. In this work, we propose Affective Image Filter (AIF), a novel model that is able to understand the visually-abstract emotions from the text and reflect them to visually-concrete images with appropriate colors and textures. We build our model based on the multi-modal transformer architecture, which unifies both images and texts into tokens and encodes the emotional prior knowledge. Various loss functions are proposed to understand complex emotions and produce appropriate visualization. In addition, we collect and contribute a new dataset with abundant aesthetic images and emotional texts for training and evaluating the AIF model. We carefully design four quantitative metrics and conduct a user study to comprehensively evaluate the performance, which demonstrates our AIF model outperforms state-of-the-art methods and could evoke specific emotional responses from human observers.
authors: Shuchen Weng, Peixuan Zhang, Zheng Chang, Xinlong Wang, Si Li, Boxin Shi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10810-10819

title: 用于多类细胞核检测的仿射一致变换器
title_en: Affine-Consistent Transformer for Multi-Class Cell Nuclei Detection
abstract: 多类细胞核检测是病理诊断的基本前提。在数字病理图像中高效定位和识别形态和分布多样的细胞至关重要。现有方法大多以复杂的中间表示作为学习目标,依赖于不灵活的后处理优化,而对不同细胞密度和视野范围的关注不足。本文提出了一种新颖的仿射一致变换器(AC-Former),该方法直接输出细胞核位置序列,并通过全局网络和局部网络两个子网络协同训练。局部分支学习对小尺度失真输入图像进行推理,而全局网络输出大尺度预测作为额外监督信号。我们进一步引入了自适应仿射变换器(AAT)模块,该模块能够自动学习关键空间变换以对原始图像进行仿射变换,供局部网络训练使用。AAT模块通过学习捕捉对模型训练更具价值的变换图像区域来实现这一目标。实验结果表明,所提方法在多个基准数据集上显著优于现有最先进的算法。
abstract_en: Multi-class cell nuclei detection is a fundamental prerequisite in the diagnosis of histopathology. It is critical to efficiently locate and identify cells with diverse morphology and distributions in digital pathological images. Most existing methods take complex intermediate representations as learning targets and rely on inflexible post-refinements while paying less attention to various cell density and fields of view. In this paper, we propose a novel Affine-Consistent Transformer (AC-Former), which directly yields a sequence of nucleus positions and is trained collaboratively through two sub-networks, a global and a local network. The local branch learns to infer distorted input images of smaller scales while the global network outputs the large-scale predictions as extra supervision signals. We further introduce an Adaptive Affine Transformer (AAT) module, which can automatically learn the key spatial transformations to warp original images for local network training. The AAT module works by learning to capture the transformed image regions that are more valuable for training the model. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art algorithms on various benchmarks.
authors: Junjia Huang, Haofeng Li, Xiang Wan, Guanbin Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21384-21393

title: AffordPose:基于功能驱动的手-物体交互大规模数据集
title_en: AffordPose: A Large-Scale Dataset of Hand-Object Interactions with Affordance-Driven Hand Pose
abstract: 人类与物体的交互依赖于目标物体的功能角色,这引出了功能感知的手-物体交互问题。这需要大量的人类示范来学习和理解合理且适当的手-物体交互。在本工作中,我们提出了AffordPose,一个包含功能驱动手部姿态的手-物体交互大规模数据集。我们首先为每个物体标注具体的部件级功能标签,例如扭转、拉动、手柄抓取等,而非通用意图如使用或交接,以指示目的并指导手-物体交互的定位。细粒度的手-物体交互揭示了以手为中心的功能对手部姿态详细排列的影响,同时也表现出一定程度的多样性。我们共收集了26.7K个手-物体交互,每个交互包含3D物体形状、部件级功能标签和手动调整的手部姿态。全面的数据分析通过参数统计和接触计算展示了每种功能的手-物体交互的共性与多样性。我们还在手-物体功能理解及功能导向的手-物体交互生成任务上进行了实验,以验证我们的数据集在学习细粒度手-物体交互中的有效性。项目页面:https://github.com/GentlesJan/AffordPose
abstract_en: How human interact with objects depends on the functional roles of the target objects, which introduces the problem of affordance-aware hand-object interaction. It requires a large number of human demonstrations for the learning and understanding of plausible and appropriate hand-object interactions. In this work, we present AffordPose, a large-scale dataset of hand-object interactions with affordance-driven hand pose. We first annotate the specific part-level affordance labels for each object, e.g. twist, pull, handle-grasp, etc, instead of the general intents such as use or handover, to indicate the purpose and guide the localization of the hand-object interactions. The fine-grained hand-object interactions reveal the influence of hand-centered affordances on the detailed arrangement of the hand poses, yet also exhibit a certain degree of diversity.
