We collect a total of 26.7K hand-object interactions, each including the 3D object shape, the part-level affordance label, and the manually adjusted hand poses. The comprehensive data analysis shows the common characteristics and diversity of hand-object interactions per affordance via the parameter statistics and contacting computation. We also conduct experiments on the tasks of hand-object affordance understanding and affordance-oriented hand-object interaction generation, to validate the effectiveness of our dataset in learning the fine-grained hand-object interactions. Project page: https://github.com/GentlesJan/AffordPose .
authors: Juntao Jian, Xiuping Liu, Manyi Li, Ruizhen Hu, Jian Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14713-14724

title: 用于人体-物体交互检测的凝聚式Transformer
title_en: Agglomerative Transformer for Human-Object Interaction Detection
abstract: 我们提出了一种凝聚式Transformer(AGER),首次使基于Transformer的人体-物体交互(HOI)检测器能够以单阶段和端到端的方式灵活利用额外的实例级线索。AGER通过动态聚类图像块令牌并借助文本引导对聚类中心与实例进行对齐,从而获得实例令牌,具有两项优势:1)完整性:每个实例令牌被鼓励包含实例的所有判别性特征区域,这在实例级线索提取方面实现了显著提升,并随后在HICO-Det数据集上取得了36.75 mAP的HOI检测新SOTA性能。2)效率:动态聚类机制允许AGER在Transformer编码器的特征学习过程中联合生成实例令牌,消除了先前方法中额外目标检测器或实例解码器的需求,从而在单阶段和端到端流程中实现对HOI检测所需额外线索的提取。具体而言,AGER相比无额外线索提取的vanilla DETR类流程,减少了8.5%的GFLOPs并提升了36%的FPS。
abstract_en: We propose an agglomerative Transformer (AGER) that enables Transformer-based human-object interaction (HOI) detectors to flexibly exploit extra instance-level cues in a single-stage and end-to-end manner for the first time. AGER acquires instance tokens by dynamically clustering patch tokens and aligning cluster centres to instances with textual guidance, thus enjoying two benefits: 1) Intergrality: each instance token is encouraged to contain all discriminative feature regions of an instance, which demonstrates a significant improvement in the extraction of different instance-level cues, and subsequently leads to a new state-of-the-art performance of HOI detection with 36.75 mAP on HICO-Det. 2) Efficiency: the dynamical clustering mechanism allows AGER to generate instance tokens jointly with the feature learning of the Transformer encoder, eliminating the need of an additional object detector or instance decoder in prior methods, thus allowing the extraction of desirable extra cues for HOI detection in a single-stage and end-to-end pipeline. Concretely, AGER reduces GFLOPs by 8.5% and improves FPS by 36%, even compared to a vanilla DETR-like pipeline without extra cue extraction.
authors: Danyang Tu, Wei Sun, Guangtao Zhai, Wei Shen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21614-21624

title: 特征点云聚合用于深度补全
title_en: Aggregating Feature Point Cloud for Depth Completion
abstract: 引导式深度补全旨在通过在RGB图像的指导下,将给定像素的深度信息传播到剩余像素,以恢复密集的深度图。然而,现有方法大多通过大量迭代细化或堆叠重复模块来实现这一目标。由于传统卷积的感受野有限,输入深度图不同稀疏程度下的泛化能力受到限制。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了一种特征点云聚合框架,直接在给定点和缺失点之间传播3D深度信息。我们从图像中提取2D特征图,并将稀疏深度图转换为点云以提取稀疏3D特征。通过将提取的特征视为两组特征点云,可以利用交叉注意力聚合已知点的相邻稀疏3D特征,从而重建目标位置的深度信息。基于此,我们设计了一个名为PointDC的神经网络,以完成整个深度信息重建过程。实验结果表明,我们的PointDC在KITTI基准和NYUv2数据集上取得了优越或具有竞争力的结果。此外,所提出的PointDC展示了其对输入深度图不同稀疏程度和跨数据集评估的更高泛化能力。
abstract_en: Guided depth completion aims to recover dense depth maps by propagating depth information from the given pixels to the remaining ones under the guidance of RGB images. However, most of the existing methods achieve this using a large number of iterative refinements or stacking repetitive blocks. Due to the limited receptive field of conventional convolution, the generalizability with respect to different sparsity levels of input depth maps is impeded. To tackle these problems, we propose a feature point cloud aggregation framework to directly propagate 3D depth information between the given points and the missing ones. We extract 2D feature map from images and transform the sparse depth map to point cloud to extract sparse 3D features. By regarding the extracted features as two sets of feature point clouds, the depth information for a target location can be reconstructed by aggregating adjacent sparse 3D features from the known points using cross attention. Based on this, we design a neural network, called as PointDC, to complete the entire depth information reconstruction process. Experimental results show that, our PointDC achieves superior or competitive results on the KITTI benchmark and NYUv2 dataset. In addition, the proposed PointDC demonstrates its higher generalizability to different sparsity levels of the input depth maps and cross-dataset evaluation.
authors: Zhu Yu, Zehua Sheng, Zili Zhou, Lun Luo, Si-Yuan Cao, Hong Gu, Huaqi Zhang, Hui-Liang Shen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8732-8743

title: 敏捷建模:从概念到分类器的分钟级流程
title_en: Agile Modeling: From Concept to Classifier in Minutes
abstract: 计算机视觉方法在处理具有细微差别和主观性的概念方面应用日益广泛。尽管众包技术在大多数客观任务(如标注“斑马”)中为视觉研究社区提供了良好支持,但在涉及概念主观性较强的任务(如识别“高级金枪鱼”)时却表现不足。然而,使任何用户都能为其概念开发分类器在技术上具有挑战性:用户既非机器学习专家,也缺乏对数千个示例进行标注的耐心。对此,我们引入了敏捷建模问题:通过实时用户参与的交互流程,将任何主观视觉概念转化为计算机视觉模型。我们为图像分类构建了敏捷建模原型,并通过用户研究(N=14)表明,用户可在30分钟内以最小努力创建分类器。我们将此用户驱动过程与传统众包范式进行对比,发现群体认知往往与用户认知存在差异,尤其在概念主观性增强时。最后,我们通过模拟用户为ImageNet21k类别训练分类器的实验扩展了研究,进一步验证了方法的有效性。
abstract_en: The application of computer vision methods to nuanced, subjective concepts is growing. While crowdsourcing has served the vision community well for most objective tasks (such as labeling a "zebra"), it now falters on tasks where there is substantial subjectivity in the concept (such as identifying "gourmet tuna"). However, empowering any user to develop a classifier for their concept is technically difficult: users are neither machine learning experts nor have the patience to label thousands of examples. In reaction, we introduce the problem of Agile Modeling: the process of turning any subjective visual concept into a computer vision model through a real-time user-in-the-loop interactions. We instantiate an Agile Modeling prototype for image classification and show through a user study (N=14) that users can create classifiers with minimal effort under 30 minutes. We compare this user driven process with the traditional crowdsourcing paradigm and find that the crowd's notion often differs from that of the user's, especially as the concepts become more subjective. Finally, we scale our experiments with simulations of users training classifiers for ImageNet21k categories to further demonstrate the efficacy.
authors: Otilia Stretcu, Edward Vendrow, Kenji Hata, Krishnamurthy Viswanathan, Vittorio Ferrari, Sasan Tavakkol, Wenlei Zhou, Aditya Avinash, Emming Luo, Neil Gordon Alldrin, MohammadHossein Bateni, Gabriel Berger, Andrew Bunner, Chun-Ta Lu, Javier Rey, Giulia DeSalvo, Ranjay Krishna, Ariel Fuxman‎ ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22323-22334

title: 基于四元数的代数严谨框架用于神经网络姿态估计问题
title_en: Algebraically Rigorous Quaternion Framework for the Neural Network Pose Estimation Problem
abstract: 三维姿态估计问题——对噪声3D点云对进行配准——在现实世界中有广泛的应用。本文重点探讨使用基于四元数的神经网络方法解决该问题,并分析先前研究中出现的明显异常现象。在解决这些异常时,我们大量借鉴了关于闭式方法解决该问题的广泛文献。我们认为,可以通过从Bar-Itzhack旋转到四元数映射的严格理论性质中导出的简单多值训练目标来解决主要关注的问题。该多值训练目标在模拟和ModelNet目标上均表现出良好的性能。我们通过四元数伴随矩阵提供全面的理论背景,以确认并确立用扩展多图流形域中的四元数替代单值四元数函数的必要性。
abstract_en: The 3D pose estimation problem -- aligning pairs of noisy 3D point clouds -- is a problem with a wide variety of real-world applications. Here we focus on the use of quaternion-based neural network approaches to this problem and apparent anomalies that have arisen in previous efforts to resolve them. In addressing these anomalies, we draw heavily from the extensive literature on closed-form methods to solve this problem. We suggest that the major concerns that have been put forward could be resolved using a simple multi-valued training target derived from rigorous theoretical properties of the rotation-to-quaternion map of Bar-Itzhack. This multi-valued training target is then demonstrated to have good performance for both simulated and ModelNet targets. We provide a comprehensive theoretical context, using the quaternion adjugate, to confirm and establish the necessity of replacing single-valued quaternion functions by quaternions treated in the extended domain of multiple-charted manifolds.
authors: Chen Lin, Andrew J. Hanson, Sonya M. Hanson ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14097-14106

title: AlignDet: 对齐预训练与微调的物体检测方法
title_en: AlignDet: Aligning Pre-training and Fine-tuning in Object Detection
abstract: 大规模预训练后进行下游微调的范式已被广泛应用于各种物体检测算法中。本文揭示了现有实践中预训练与微调过程在数据、模型和任务方面存在的差异,这些差异隐式地限制了检测器的性能、泛化能力和收敛速度。为此,我们提出AlignDet,一个统一的预训练框架,可适配于各种现有检测器以缓解上述差异。AlignDet将预训练过程解耦为两个阶段,即图像域预训练和框域预训练。图像域预训练优化检测主干网络以捕捉整体视觉抽象,框域预训练学习实例级语义和任务感知概念以初始化主干网络之外的部分。通过结合自监督预训练主干网络,我们可以在无监督范式下对各类检测器的所有模块进行预训练。如图1所示,大量实验表明,AlignDet在多种协议下均能取得显著提升,包括检测算法、模型主干、数据设置和训练调度。例如,在更少的训练轮次下,AlignDet分别将FCOS的mAP提升5.3、RetinaNet提升2.1、Faster R-CNN提升3.3、DETR提升2.3。
abstract_en: The paradigm of large-scale pre-training followed by downstream fine-tuning has been widely employed in various object detection algorithms. In this paper, we reveal discrepancies in data, model, and task between the pre-training and fine-tuning procedure in existing practices, which implicitly limit the detector's performance, generalization ability, and convergence speed. To this end, we propose AlignDet, a unified pre-training framework that can be adapted to various existing detectors to alleviate the discrepancies. AlignDet decouples the pre-training process into two stages, i.e., image-domain and box-domain pre-training. The image-domain pre-training optimizes the detection backbone to capture holistic visual abstraction, and box-domain pre-training learns instance-level semantics and task-aware concepts to initialize the parts out of the backbone. By incorporating the self-supervised pre-trained backbones, we can pre-train all modules for various detectors in an unsupervised paradigm. As depicted in Figure 1, extensive experiments demonstrate that AlignDet can achieve significant improvements across diverse protocols, such as detection algorithm, model backbone, data setting, and training schedule. For example, AlignDet improves FCOS by 5.3 mAP, RetinaNet by 2.1 mAP, Faster R-CNN by 3.3 mAP, and DETR by 2.3 mAP under fewer epochs.
authors: Ming Li, Jie Wu, Xionghui Wang, Chen Chen, Jie Qin, Xuefeng Xiao, Rui Wang, Min Zheng, Xin Pan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6866-6876

title: 先对齐后聚合:视频对象分割的轨迹记忆检索网络
title_en: Alignment Before Aggregation: Trajectory Memory Retrieval Network for Video Object Segmentation
abstract: 基于记忆的方法在半监督视频对象分割任务中通过查询帧与记忆帧之间的密集匹配实现竞争力表现。然而,现有大多数方法忽视了视频中蕴含丰富的时间信息却存在冗余空间信息的特性。在这种情况下,直接像素级全局匹配会导致模糊的对应关系。本文通过协调空间与时间信息的固有张力,沿对象轨迹检索记忆帧信息,并提出一种新颖且连贯的轨迹记忆检索网络(TMRN),该网络包含空间对齐模块和时间聚合模块,以融入轨迹信息。所提出的TMRN具有以下优势:首先,TMRN以数据驱动的方式表征符合视频特性的时序对应关系;其次,我们通过将SVD初始化与代理级相关性耦合,优雅地定制空间对齐模块,分别用于构建代表性代理和修正由直接像素级成对相关性导致的错误匹配。在具有挑战性的基准数据集(包括DAVIS 2017验证/测试集和Youtube-VOS 2018/2019)上的大量实验结果表明,作为通用插件模块,我们的TMRN在多个领先方法上实现了持续改进。
abstract_en:
Memory-based methods in semi-supervised video object segmentation task achieve competitive performance by performing dense matching between query and memory frames. However, most of the existing methods neglect the fact that videos carry rich temporal information yet redundant spatial information. In this case, direct pixel-level global matching will lead to ambiguous correspondences. In this work, we reconcile the inherent tension of spatial and temporal information to retrieve memory frame information along the object trajectory, and propose a novel and coherent Trajectory Memory Retrieval Network (TMRN) to equip with the trajectory information, including a spatial alignment module and a temporal aggregation module. The proposed TMRN enjoys several merits. First, TMRN 
 is empowered to characterize the temporal correspondence which is in line with the nature of video in a data-driven manner. Second, we elegantly customize the spatial alignment module by coupling SVD initialization with agent-level correlation for representative agent construction and rectifying false matches caused by direct pairwise pixel-level correlation, respectively. Extensive experimental results
 on challenging benchmarks including DAVIS 2017 validation / test and Youtube-VOS 2018 / 2019 demonstrate that our TMRN, as a general plugin module, achieves consistent improvements over several leading methods.
authors: Rui Sun, Yuan Wang, Huayu Mai, Tianzhu Zhang, Feng Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1218-1228

title: 无需对齐的语义一致变换器高动态范围去鬼影
title_en: Alignment-free HDR Deghosting with Semantics Consistent Transformer
abstract: 高动态范围(HDR)成像旨在从多个低动态范围输入中提取信息以生成逼真的输出。其本质是利用上下文信息,包括动态和静态语义,以提升图像生成质量。现有方法多关注由前景和/或相机运动导致的输入帧间空间错位问题。然而,尚无研究同时联合利用动态与静态上下文信息。为深入探讨该问题,我们提出一种无需对齐的新型网络架构,其核心为包含空间与通道注意力模块的语义一致变换器(SCTNet)。空间注意力旨在处理图像内相关性以建模动态运动,而通道注意力则实现帧间信息交织以增强语义一致性。此外,我们引入了一个新型真实HDR数据集,包含更多前景物体变化、环境因素及更大运动范围。在传统数据集和本数据集上的大量对比实验验证了方法的有效性,在性能与计算成本间实现了最佳平衡。源代码和数据集可在https://github.com/Zongwei97/SCTNet获取。
abstract_en: High dynamic range (HDR) imaging aims to retrieve information from multiple low-dynamic range inputs to generate realistic output. The essence is to leverage the contextual information, including both dynamic and static semantics, for better image generation. Existing methods often focus on the spatial misalignment across input frames caused by the foreground and/or camera motion. However, there is no research on jointly leveraging the dynamic and static context in a simultaneous manner. To delve into this problem, we propose a novel alignment-free network with a Semantics Consistent Transformer (SCTNet) with both spatial and channel attention modules in the network. The spatial attention aims to deal with the intra-image correlation to model the dynamic motion, while the channel attention enables the inter-image intertwining to enhance the semantic consistency across frames. Aside from this, we introduce a novel realistic HDR dataset with more variations in foreground objects, environmental factors, and larger motions. Extensive comparisons on both conventional datasets and ours validate the effectiveness of our method, achieving the best trade-off on the performance and the computational cost. The source code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Zongwei97/SCTNet.
authors: Steven Tel, Zongwei Wu, Yulun Zhang, Barthélémy Heyrman, Cédric Demonceaux, Radu Timofte, Dominique Ginhac ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12836-12845

title: All in Tokens: 通过软标记统一视觉任务的输出空间
title_en: All in Tokens: Unifying Output Space of Visual Tasks via Soft Token
abstract: 我们引入了AiT,这是一种适用于各种视觉任务的统一输出表示,是通用视觉任务求解器的关键步骤。尽管高维且任务特定的输出带来了挑战,我们展示了使用离散表示(VQ-VAE)将许多计算机视觉任务的密集输出建模为离散标记序列的潜力。这受到VQ-VAE能够通过少量离散代码保留跨多个像素结构的已建立能力的启发。为此,我们提出了一种修改后的更浅层VQ-VAE架构,在保持预测准确性的同时提高了效率。我们的方法还通过软融合码本条目将不确定性纳入解码过程,提供了更稳定的训练过程,显著提高了预测准确性。我们在深度估计和实例分割任务上对AiT进行了评估,使用连续和离散标签,结果表明其优于其他统一模型。代码和模型可在https://github.com/SwinTransformer/AiT获取。
abstract_en: We introduce AiT, a unified output representation for various vision tasks, which is a crucial step towards general-purpose vision task solvers. Despite the challenges posed by the high-dimensional and task-specific outputs, we showcase the potential of using discrete representation (VQ-VAE) to model the dense outputs of many computer vision tasks as a sequence of discrete tokens. This is inspired by the established ability of VQ-VAE to conserve the structures spanning multiple pixels using few discrete codes. To that end, we present a modified shallower architecture for VQ-VAE that improves efficiency while keeping prediction accuracy. Our approach also incorporates uncertainty into the decoding process by using a soft fusion of the codebook entries, providing a more stable training process, which notably improved prediction accuracy. Our evaluation of AiT on depth estimation and instance segmentation tasks, with both continuous and discrete labels, demonstrates its superiority compared to other unified models. The code and models are available at https://github.com/SwinTransformer/AiT.
authors: Jia Ning, Chen Li, Zheng Zhang, Chunyu Wang, Zigang Geng, Qi Dai, Kun He, Han Hu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19900-19910

title: 全到键注意力机制用于任意风格迁移
title_en: All-to-Key Attention for Arbitrary Style Transfer
abstract: 基于注意力的任意风格迁移研究在合成生动的局部风格细节方面展现出 promising performance。它们通常采用全到全注意力机制---内容特征的每个位置与风格特征的所有位置进行完全匹配。然而,全到全注意力容易生成扭曲的风格模式且具有二次复杂度,限制了任意风格迁移的有效性和效率。本文提出了一种新颖的全到键注意力机制---内容特征的每个位置与风格特征的稳定键位置进行匹配,更符合风格迁移的特性。具体而言,该机制集成了两种新提出的注意力形式:分布式注意力和渐进式注意力。分布式注意力将注意力分配给描述局部区域风格分布的关键风格表示;渐进式注意力从粗粒度区域逐步关注到细粒度键位置。所提出的模块StyA2K在保持语义结构和渲染一致风格模式方面表现出色。与最先进方法的定性和定量比较验证了本方法的优越性。代码和模型可在https://github.com/LearningHx/StyA2K获取。
abstract_en: Attention-based arbitrary style transfer studies have shown promising performance in synthesizing vivid local style details. They typically use the all-to-all attention mechanism---each position of content features is fully matched to all positions of style features. However, all-to-all attention tends to generate distorted style patterns and has quadratic complexity, limiting the effectiveness and efficiency of arbitrary style transfer. In this paper, we propose a novel all-to-key attention mechanism---each position of content features is matched to stable key positions of style features---that is more in line with the characteristics of style transfer. Specifically, it integrates two newly proposed attention forms: distributed and progressive attention. Distributed attention assigns attention to key style representations that depict the style distribution of local regions; Progressive attention pays attention from coarse-grained regions to fine-grained key positions. The resultant module, dubbed StyA2K, shows extraordinary performance in preserving the semantic structure and rendering consistent style patterns. Qualitative and quantitative comparisons with state-of-the-art methods demonstrate the superior performance of our approach. Codes and models are available on https://github.com/LearningHx/StyA2K.
authors: Mingrui Zhu, Xiao He, Nannan Wang, Xiaoyu Wang, Xinbo Gao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23109-23119

title: All4One:基于自注意力机制与冗余减少的共生邻域对比学习
title_en: All4One: Symbiotic Neighbour Contrastive Learning via Self-Attention and Redundancy Reduction
abstract: 基于最近邻的方法由于其强大的泛化能力,已被证明是自监督学习(SSL)最成功的方法之一。然而,当使用多个邻域时,其计算效率会下降。本文提出了一种新颖的对比自监督学习方法All4One,通过自注意力机制创建"质心"来减少邻域表示之间的距离。我们结合了质心对比目标、单邻域对比目标和特征对比目标。质心有助于从多个邻域中学习上下文信息,而邻域对比使模型能够直接从邻域中学习表示,特征对比则允许学习特征特有的表示。这种组合使All4One在主流基准数据集的线性分类评估中超越了流行的实例判别方法超过1%,并取得了最先进的(SoTA)结果。最后,我们证明All4One对嵌入维度和增强策略具有鲁棒性,在低维度和弱增强设置下超越了NNCLR和Barlow Twins超过5%。
abstract_en: Nearest neighbour based methods have proved to be one of the most successful self-supervised learning (SSL) approaches due to their high generalization capabilities. However, their computational efficiency decreases when more than one neighbour is used. In this paper, we propose a novel contrastive SSL approach, which we call All4One, that reduces the distance between neighbour representations using "centroids" created through a self-attention mechanism. We use a Centroid Contrasting objective along with single Neighbour Contrasting and Feature Contrasting objectives. Centroids help in learning contextual information from multiple neighbours whereas the neighbour contrast enables learning representations directly from the neighbours and the feature contrast allows learning representations unique to the features.This combination enables All4One to outperform popular instance discrimination approaches by more than 1% on linear classification evaluation for popular benchmark datasets and obtains state-of-the-art (SoTA) results. Finally, we show that All4One is robust towards embedding dimensionalities and augmentations, surpassing NNCLR and Barlow Twins by more than 5% on low dimensionality and weak augmentation settings.
authors: Imanol G. Estepa, Ignacio Sarasua, Bhalaji Nagarajan, Petia Radeva ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16243-16253

title: 通过类内与类间知识蒸馏缓解增量目标检测中的灾难性遗忘
title_en: Alleviating Catastrophic Forgetting of Incremental Object Detection via Within-Class and Between-Class Knowledge Distillation
abstract: 增量目标检测(IOD)任务要求模型能够持续从新增数据中学习。然而,直接在新任务上微调一个已训练好的检测模型会导致旧任务性能显著下降,这种现象被称为灾难性遗忘。知识蒸馏,包括特征蒸馏和响应蒸馏,已被证明是缓解灾难性遗忘的有效方法。然而,以往的特征蒸馏工作主要依赖于低层次特征信息,而对高层次语义信息的重要性探索不足。在本文中,我们讨论了IOD任务中灾难性遗忘的原因,即语义特征空间的破坏。我们提出了一种基于Transformer检测器的方法,通过考虑类间可区分性和类内一致性,动态蒸馏语义和特征信息。类间可区分性通过蒸馏各类别间的类别级语义距离和特征距离得以保留,而类内一致性则通过蒸馏每个类别内的实例级语义信息和特征信息得以保持。我们在Pascal VOC和MS COCO基准数据集上进行了大量实验。我们的方法在多种实验场景下均优于所有先前的CNN基线方法,尤其在单步IOD任务中,mAP从36.90%显著提升至39.80%。
abstract_en: Incremental object detection (IOD) task requires a model to learn continually from newly added data. However, directly fine-tuning a well-trained detection model on a new task will sharply decrease the performance on old tasks, which is known as catastrophic forgetting. Knowledge distillation, including feature distillation and response distillation, has been proven to be an effective way to alleviate catastrophic forgetting. However, previous works on feature distillation heavily rely on low-level feature information, while under-exploring the importance of high-level semantic information. In this paper, we discuss the cause of catastrophic forgetting in IOD task as destruction of semantic feature space. We propose a method that dynamically distills both semantic and feature information with consideration of both between-class discriminativeness and within-class consistency on Transformer-based detector. Between-class discriminativeness is preserved by distilling class-level semantic distance and feature distance among various categories, while within-class consistency is preserved by distilling instance-level semantic information and feature information within each category. Extensive experiments are conducted on both Pascal VOC and MS COCO benchmarks. Our method outperforms all the previous CNN-based SOTA methods under various experimental scenarios, with a remarkable mAP improvement from 36.90% to 39.80% under one-step IOD task.
authors: Mengxue Kang, Jinpeng Zhang, Jinming Zhang, Xiashuang Wang, Yang Chen, Zhe Ma, Xuhui Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18894-18904

title: Among Us:基于共识的对抗鲁棒协作感知
title_en: Among Us: Adversarially Robust Collaborative Perception by Consensus
abstract: 多个机器人通过协作感知场景(例如检测物体)通常比个体感知效果更好,但使用深度学习时容易受到对抗攻击。这可通过对抗防御方法解决,但其训练需要通常未知的攻击机制。不同地,我们提出ROBOSAC,一种可推广至未知攻击者的新型基于采样的防御策略。我们的核心思想是,与个体感知相比,协作感知应导致共识而非分歧。这引导我们构建假设-验证框架:通过随机子集队友的协作与非协作感知结果进行比较,直至达成共识。在该框架中,采样子集中的队友数量越多,感知性能通常越好,但需要更长的采样时间以排除潜在攻击者。因此,我们推导出确保无攻击者子集所需采样次数,或等价地,给定采样次数下可成功采样的最大无攻击者子集尺寸。我们在自动驾驶场景的协作3D物体检测任务中验证了该方法。
abstract_en: Multiple robots could perceive a scene (e.g., detect objects) collaboratively better than individuals, although easily suffer from adversarial attacks when using deep learning. This could be addressed by the adversarial defense, but its training requires the often-unknown attacking mechanism. Differently, we propose ROBOSAC, a novel sampling-based defense strategy generalizable to unseen attackers. Our key idea is that collaborative perception should lead to consensus rather than dissensus in results compared to individual perception. This leads to our hypothesize-and-verify framework: perception results with and without collaboration from a random subset of teammates are compared until reaching a consensus. In such a framework, more teammates in the sampled subset often entail better perception performance but require longer sampling time to reject potential attackers. Thus, we derive how many sampling trials are needed to ensure the desired size of an attacker-free subset, or equivalently, the maximum size of such a subset that we can successfully sample within a given number of trials. We validate our method on the task of collaborative 3D object detection in autonomous driving scenarios.
authors: Yiming Li, Qi Fang, Jiamu Bai, Siheng Chen, Felix Juefei-Xu, Chen Feng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 186-195

title: 一种提升对抗样本迁移性的自适应模型集成对抗攻击
title_en: An Adaptive Model Ensemble Adversarial Attack for Boosting Adversarial Transferability
abstract: 尽管对抗样本的迁移性属性使攻击者能够实施黑盒攻击(即攻击者对目标模型缺乏知识),但基于迁移的对抗攻击方法已引起广泛关注。先前的研究主要通过梯度变化或图像变换来放大输入关键部分的扰动。这些方法在模型差异较小的跨模型迁移(如从CNN到CNN)中有效,但在模型差异较大的跨模型迁移(如从CNN到ViTs)中始终失效。为此,提出了模型集成对抗攻击方法,通过融合具有不同架构的替代模型的输出以获得集成损失,使生成的对抗样本更可能迁移至其他模型,因其能同时欺骗多个模型。然而,现有集成攻击方法简单地均匀融合替代模型的输出,无法有效捕捉和放大对抗样本的内在迁移信息。本文提出了一种自适应集成攻击方法AdaEA,通过监控各模型对对抗目标的贡献差异比率来自适应控制输出融合。此外,引入了一个额外的差异降低滤波器以进一步同步更新方向。实验结果表明,AdaEA在各类数据集上显著优于现有集成攻击方法,且可提升现有基于迁移的攻击效果,进一步验证了其有效性与通用性。
abstract_en: While the transferability property of adversarial examples allows the adversary to perform black-box attacks i.e., the attacker has no knowledge about the target model), the transfer-based adversarial attacks have gained great attention. Previous works mostly study gradient variation or image transformations to amplify the distortion on critical parts of inputs. These methods can work on transferring across models with limited differences, i.e., from CNNs to CNNs, but always fail in transferring across models with wide differences, such as from CNNs to ViTs. Alternatively, model ensemble adversarial attacks are proposed to fuse outputs from surrogate models with diverse architectures to get an ensemble loss, making the generated adversarial example more likely to transfer to other models as it can fool multiple models concurrently. However, existing ensemble attacks simply fuse the outputs of the surrogate models evenly, thus are not efficacious to capture and amplify the intrinsic transfer information of adversarial examples. In this paper, we propose an adaptive ensemble attack, dubbed AdaEA, to adaptively control the fusion of the outputs from each model, via monitoring the discrepancy ratio of their contributions towards the adversarial objective. Furthermore, an extra disparity-reduced filter is introduced to further synchronize the update direction. As a result, we achieve considerable improvement over the existing ensemble attacks on various datasets, and the proposed AdaEA can also boost existing transfer-based attacks, which further demonstrates its efficacy and versatility.
authors: Bin Chen, Jiali Yin, Shukai Chen, Bohao Chen, Ximeng Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4489-4498

title: 一种针对自监督学习的令人震惊的简单后门攻击
title_en: An Embarrassingly Simple Backdoor Attack on Self-supervised Learning
abstract: 作为一种新的机器学习范式,自监督学习(SSL)能够在不依赖标签的情况下学习复杂数据的高质量表示。除了消除对带标签数据的需求外,研究发现SSL由于缺乏标签,使对手更难以操控模型预测,因此在对抗鲁棒性方面优于监督学习。然而,这种鲁棒性优势在多大程度上适用于其他类型的攻击仍是一个开放性问题。我们在此背景下探讨这一问题,具体设计并评估了CTRL,一种极其简单却高度有效的自监督后门攻击方法。通过仅污染极小比例的训练数据(<1%)的不可区分的中毒样本,CTRL在推理时使任何包含触发器的输入以高概率(>99%)被误分类到对手指定的类别。我们的发现表明,SSL与监督学习在后门攻击面前具有相似的脆弱性。更重要的是,通过CTRL的视角,我们研究了SSL对后门攻击的固有脆弱性。结合实证和分析证据,我们揭示了SSL的表示不变性属性,这一属性虽有益于对抗鲁棒性,但也可能是SSL高度易受后门攻击的根本原因。我们的发现还暗示,现有的监督后门攻击防御方法难以直接适配SSL特有的脆弱性。
abstract_en: As a new paradigm in machine learning, self-supervised learning (SSL) is capable of learning high-quality representations of complex data without relying on labels. In addition to eliminating the need for labeled data, research has found that SSL improves the adversarial robustness over supervised learning since lacking labels makes it more challenging for adversaries to manipulate model predictions. However, the extent to which this robustness superiority generalizes to other types of attacks remains an open question. We explore this question in the context of backdoor attacks. Specifically, we design and evaluate CTRL, an embarrassingly simple yet highly effective self-supervised backdoor attack. By only polluting a tiny fraction of training data (<1%) with indistinguishable poisoning samples, CTRL causes any trigger-embedded input to be misclassified to the adversary's designated class with a high probability (>99%) at inference time. Our findings suggest that SSL and supervised learning are comparably vulnerable to backdoor attacks. More importantly, through the lens of CTRL, we study the inherent vulnerability of SSL to backdoor attacks. With both empirical and analytical evidence, we reveal that the representation invariance property of SSL, which benefits adversarial robustness, may also be the very reason making SSL highly susceptible to backdoor attacks. Our findings also imply that the existing defenses against supervised backdoor attacks are not easily retrofitted to the unique vulnerability of SSL.
authors: Changjiang Li, Ren Pang, Zhaohan Xi, Tianyu Du, Shouling Ji, Yuan Yao, Ting Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4367-4378

title: 面向三维医学图像分析的自监督学习中的解剖不变性建模与语义对齐
title_en: Anatomical Invariance Modeling and Semantic Alignment for Self-supervised Learning in 3D Medical Image Analysis
abstract: 自监督学习(SSL)近年来在三维医学图像分析任务中取得了有希望的性能。大多数现有方法遵循最初为摄影图像或自然图像设计的SSL范式,这无法显式且彻底地利用不同医学图像间的内在相似解剖结构。这实际上可能通过最大化包含空间错位信息和不同解剖语义特征间的相似性,降低所学深度表征的质量。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新的自监督学习框架,即Alice,通过精心结合判别性与生成性目标,显式实现解剖不变性建模和语义对齐。Alice引入了一种新的对比学习策略,鼓励通过多样化挖掘但具有相同高层语义的视图之间的相似性,以学习不变的解剖特征。此外,我们设计了一个条件解剖特征对齐模块,通过局部图像内容分布条件,将损坏的嵌入与具有全局匹配语义和跨块拓扑信息的嵌入进行补充,从而创建更优的对比对。我们在三个三维医学图像分析任务上的大量定量实验验证了Alice的性能优势,超越了先前最佳的SSL对应方法,并展示了其在联合表征学习方面的良好潜力。代码可在https://github.com/alibaba-damo-academy/alice获取。
abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has recently achieved promising performance for 3D medical image analysis tasks. Most current methods follow existing SSL paradigm originally designed for photographic or natural images, which cannot explicitly and thoroughly exploit the intrinsic similar anatomical structures across varying medical images. This may in fact degrade the quality of learned deep representations by maximizing the similarity among features containing spatial misalignment information and different anatomical semantics. In this work, we propose a new self-supervised learning framework, namely Alice, that explicitly fulfills Anatomical invariance modeling and semantic alignment via elaborately combining discriminative and generative objectives. Alice introduces a new contrastive learning strategy which encourages the similarity between views that are diversely mined but with consistent high-level semantics, in order to learn invariant anatomical features. Moreover, we design a conditional anatomical feature alignment module to complement corrupted embeddings with globally matched semantics and inter-patch topology information, conditioned by the distribution of local image content, which permits to create better contrastive pairs. Our extensive quantitative experiments on three 3D medical image analysis tasks demonstrate and validate the performance superiority of Alice, surpassing the previous best SSL counterpart methods and showing promising ability for united representation learning. Codes are available at https://github.com/alibaba-damo-academy/alice.
authors: Yankai Jiang, Mingze Sun, Heng Guo, Xiaoyu Bai, Ke Yan, Le Lu, Minfeng Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15859-15869

title: 基于增强张量秩最小化的锚结构正则化诱导多视图子空间聚类
title_en: Anchor Structure Regularization Induced Multi-view Subspace Clustering via Enhanced Tensor Rank Minimization
abstract: 基于张量的多视图子空间聚类算法由于其强大的跨视图高阶相关性捕捉能力而受到广泛关注。尽管此类算法取得了显著成果,但仍存在三个主要问题:1)极高的计算复杂度使基于张量的方法难以处理大规模数据集。2)常用的张量核范数(TNN)对不同奇异值一视同仁,导致噪声成分被低估,从而产生次优表示张量。3)基于子空间的方法通常忽略原始数据的局部几何结构。针对这些问题,我们提出了一种基于增强张量秩最小化的锚结构正则化诱导多视图子空间聚类方法(ASR-ETR)。具体而言,通过采用锚表示策略而非自表示策略构建锚表示张量以降低时间复杂度,并引入锚结构正则化(ASR)以增强学习到的锚表示张量中的局部几何结构。我们进一步定义了增强张量秩(ETR),该指标是更紧致的张量秩替代函数,能更有效地驱除噪声。此外,设计了一种高效的迭代优化算法求解ASR-ETR,该算法兼具线性复杂度和良好的收敛性。在多个数据集上的大量实验结果验证了所提算法相较于现有先进方法的优越性。
abstract_en: The tensor-based multi-view subspace clustering algorithms have received widespread attention due to the powerful ability to capture high-order correlation across views. Although such algorithms have achieved remarkable success, they still suffer from three main issues: 1) The extremely high computational complexity makes tensor-based methods difficult to handle large-scale data sets. 2) The commonly used Tensor Nuclear Norm (TNN) treats different singular values equally and under-penalizes the noise components, resulting in a sub-optimal representation tensor. 3) The subspace-based methods usually ignore the local geometric structure of the original data. Being aware of these, we propose Anchor Structure Regularitation Induced Multi-view Subspace Clustering via Enhanced Tensor Rank Minimization (ASR-ETR). Specifically, an anchor representation tensor is constructed by using the anchor representation strategy rather than the self-representation strategy to reduce the time complexity, and an Anchor Structure Regularization (ASR) is employed to enhance the local geometric structure in the learned anchor-representation tensor. We further define an Enhanced Tensor Rank (ETR), which is a tighter surrogate of the tensor rank and more effective to drive the noise out. Moreover, an efficient iterative optimization algorithm is designed to solve the ASR-ETR, which enjoys both linear complexity and favorable convergence. Extensive experimental results on various data sets demonstrate the superiority of the proposed algorithm as compared to state-of-the-art methods.
authors: Jintian Ji, Songhe Feng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19343-19352

title: 锚框-中间检测器:通过解耦与耦合边界框实现精确目标检测
title_en: Anchor-Intermediate Detector: Decoupling and Coupling Bounding Boxes for Accurate Object Detection
abstract: 基于锚框的目标检测器在目标检测领域持续发展。然而,单个锚框使得准确预测边界偏移量变得困难。我们不将每个边界框视为独立个体,而是通过多个框的组合来获取预测框。为此,本文在推理过程中提出边界框解耦-耦合(BDC)策略,不再丢弃重叠框,而是将这些框的角点进行解耦。随后,根据每个角点的得分,将角点进行耦合以选择最准确的角点对。为满足BDC策略,设计了一个简单但新颖的模型,命名为锚框-中间检测器(AID),其包含两个头部网络,即基于锚框的头部和无锚框的角点感知头部。角点感知头部能够对每个边界框的角点进行评分,以促进角点之间的耦合。在MS COCO数据集上的大量实验表明,所提出的锚框-中间检测器在MS COCO test-dev数据集上分别超越了其基线RetinaNet和GFL方法2.4和1.2 AP,且无需任何额外技巧。
abstract_en: Anchor-based detectors have been continuously developed for object detection. However, the individual anchor box makes it difficult to predict the boundary's offset accurately. Instead of taking each bounding box as a closed individual, we consider using multiple boxes together to get prediction boxes. To this end, this paper proposes the Box Decouple-Couple(BDC) strategy in the inference, which no longer discards the overlapping boxes, but decouples the corner points of these boxes. Then, according to each corner's score, we couple the corner points to select the most accurate corner pairs. To meet the BDC strategy, a simple but novel model is designed named the Anchor-Intermediate Detector(AID), which contains two head networks, i.e., an anchor-based head and an anchor-free Corner-aware head. The corner-aware head is able to score the corners of each bounding box to facilitate the coupling between corner points. Extensive experiments on MS COCO show that the proposed anchor-intermediate detector respectively outperforms their baseline RetinaNet and GFL method by  2.4 and  1.2 AP on the MS COCO test-dev dataset without any bells and whistles.
authors: Yilong Lv, Min Li, Yujie He, Shaopeng Li, Zhuzhen He, Aitao Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6275-6284

title: Animal3D:三维动物姿态与形状的综合性数据集
title_en: Animal3D: A Comprehensive Dataset of 3D Animal Pose and Shape
abstract: 准确估计三维姿态与形状是理解动物行为的关键步骤,有望为许多下游应用(如野生动物保护)带来潜在益处。然而,由于缺乏综合性且多样化的高质量三维姿态与形状标注数据集,该领域的研究受到阻碍。本文提出Animal3D,这是首个用于哺乳动物三维姿态与形状估计的综合性数据集。Animal3D包含从40种哺乳动物物种中采集的3379张图像、26个关键点的高质量标注,以及重要的是SMAL模型的姿态与形状参数。所有标注均通过多阶段流程手动完成标注和检查,以确保最高质量的结果。基于Animal3D数据集,我们对代表性形状和姿态估计模型进行基准测试,包括:(1)仅使用Animal3D数据的监督学习,(2)从合成生成图像进行合成到真实迁移,(3)微调人类姿态与形状估计模型。实验结果表明,尽管在人类姿态估计和特定物种动物姿态估计方面取得了显著进展,但跨物种预测动物的三维形状和姿态仍是一项极具挑战性的任务。我们的结果进一步表明,合成预训练是一种可行的策略,可有效提升模型性能。总体而言,Animal3D为促进未来动物三维姿态与形状估计的研究开辟了新方向,并已公开获取。
abstract_en: Accurately estimating the 3D pose and shape is an essential step towards understanding animal behavior, and can potentially benefit many downstream applications, such as wildlife conservation. However, research in this area is held back by the lack of a comprehensive and diverse dataset with high-quality 3D pose and shape annotations. In this paper, we propose Animal3D, the first comprehensive dataset for mammal animal 3D pose and shape estimation. Animal3D consists of 3379 images collected from 40 mammal species, high-quality annotations of 26 keypoints, and importantly the pose and shape parameters of the SMAL model. All annotations were labeled and checked manually in a multi-stage process to ensure highest quality results. Based on the Animal3D dataset, we benchmark representative shape and pose estimation models at: (1) supervised learning from only the Animal3D data, (2) synthetic to real transfer from synthetically generated images, and (3) fine-tuning human pose and shape estimation models. Our experimental results demonstrate that predicting the 3D shape and pose of animals across species remains a very challenging task, despite significant advances in human pose estimation and animal pose estimation for specific species. Our results further demonstrate that synthetic pre-training is a viable strategy to boost the model performance. Overall, Animal3D opens new directions for facilitating future research in animal 3D pose and shape estimation, and is publicly available.
authors: Jiacong Xu, Yi Zhang, Jiawei Peng, Wufei Ma, Artur Jesslen, Pengliang Ji, Qixin Hu, Jiehua Zhang, Qihao Liu, Jiahao Wang, Wei Ji, Chen Wang, Xiaoding Yuan, Prakhar Kaushik, Guofeng Zhang, Jie Liu, Yushan Xie, Yawen Cui, Alan Yuille, Adam Kortylewski ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9099-9109

title: 分布偏移下的异常检测
title_en: Anomaly Detection Under Distribution Shift
abstract: 异常检测(AD)是一项关键的机器学习任务,旨在从一组正常训练样本中学习模式,以识别测试数据中的异常样本。大多数现有AD研究假设训练数据和测试数据来自同一数据分布,但实际应用中由于光照条件、物体姿态或背景外观等自然变化,测试数据可能出现显著的分布偏移,导致现有AD方法失效。本文考虑了分布偏移下的异常检测问题,并在四个广泛使用的AD和分布外(OOD)泛化数据集上建立了性能基准。我们证明,简单地将最先进的OOD泛化方法适配到AD场景中由于缺乏标注的异常数据而无法有效工作。我们进一步提出了一种新颖的鲁棒AD方法,通过在训练和推理阶段以无监督方式最小化分布内与分布外正常样本之间的分布差距,以应对多样化的分布偏移。我们在四个数据集上的广泛实证结果表明,我们的方法在具有各种分布偏移的数据上显著优于现有AD方法和OOD泛化方法,同时在分布内数据上保持检测精度。代码和数据可在https://github.com/mala-lab/ADShift获取。
abstract_en: Anomaly detection (AD) is a crucial machine learning task that aims to learn patterns from a set of normal training samples to identify abnormal samples in test data. Most existing AD studies assume that the training and test data are drawn from the same data distribution, but the test data can have large distribution shifts arising in many real-world applications due to different natural variations such as new lighting conditions, object poses, or background appearances, rendering existing AD methods ineffective in such cases. In this paper, we consider the problem of anomaly detection under distribution shift and establish performance benchmarks on four widely-used AD and out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization datasets. We demonstrate that simple adaptation of state-of-the-art OOD generalization methods to AD settings fails to work effectively due to the lack of labeled anomaly data. We further introduce a novel robust AD approach to diverse distribution shifts by minimizing the distribution gap between in-distribution and OOD normal samples in both the training and inference stages in an unsupervised way. Our extensive empirical results on the four datasets show that our approach substantially outperforms state-of-the-art AD methods and OOD generalization methods on data with various distribution shifts, while maintaining the detection accuracy on in-distribution data. Code and data are available at https://github.com/mala-lab/ADShift.
authors: Tri Cao, Jiawen Zhu, Guansong Pang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6511-6523

title: 基于分数的扰动鲁棒性异常检测
title_en: Anomaly Detection using Score-based Perturbation Resilience
abstract: 无监督异常检测因其难以获取异常数据而在工业应用中被广泛研究。特别是当没有使用外部知识(如额外数据集或预训练模型)的选项时,基于重建的异常检测可以成为可行的解决方案。然而,由于检测性能较差,基于重建的方法存在局限性。近年来,被称为去噪扩散模型的分数模型在生成任务中展现出高质量的样本生成能力。本文提出了一种利用分数模型的新型无监督异常检测方法。该方法有望在无需外部知识的情况下实现良好的性能。分数(即对数似然的梯度)具有可用于异常检测的特性。即使数据流形上的样本被随机扰动,也可以通过分数即时恢复。我们称此为基于分数的扰动鲁棒性。另一方面,偏离流形的样本无法以相同方式恢复。样本位置依赖的鲁棒性变化可作为区分异常的指标。我们从几何视角推导了这一结论。我们的方法在三个工业异常检测基准数据集上展现出优越性能。具体而言,在MVTec AD数据集上,我们实现了图像级AUROC为97.7%、像素级AUROC为97.4%的优异结果,超越了不使用外部知识的先前方法。
abstract_en: Unsupervised anomaly detection is widely studied for industrial applications since it is difficult to obtain anomalous data. In particular, reconstruction-based anomaly detection can be a feasible solution if there is no option to use external knowledge, such as extra datasets or pre-trained models. However, reconstruction-based methods have limited utility due to poor detection performance. A score-based model, also known as a denoising diffusion model, recently has shown a high sample quality in the generation task. In this paper, we propose a novel unsupervised anomaly detection method leveraging the score-based model. This method promises good performance without external knowledge. The score, a gradient of the log-likelihood, has a property that is available for anomaly detection. The samples on the data manifold can be restored instantly by the score, even if they are randomly perturbed. We call this a score-based perturbation resilience. On the other hand, the samples that deviate from the manifold cannot be restored in the same way. The variation of resilience depending on the sample position can be an indicator to discriminate anomalies. We derive this statement from a geometric perspective. Our method shows superior performance on three benchmark datasets for industrial anomaly detection. Specifically, on MVTec AD, we achieve image-level AUROC of 97.7% and pixel-level AUROC of 97.4% outperforming previous works that do not use external knowledge.
authors: Woosang Shin, Jonghyeon Lee, Taehan Lee, Sangmoon Lee, Jong Pil Yun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23372-23382

title: Anti-DreamBooth: 保护用户免受个性化文本到图像合成的侵害
title_en: Anti-DreamBooth: Protecting Users from Personalized Text-to-image Synthesis
abstract: 文本到图像扩散模型无疑是一场革命,使任何人都能通过简单的文本输入创建逼真图像,即使没有设计技能。借助如DreamBooth等强大的个性化工具,仅需学习少量参考图像即可生成特定人物的图像。然而,当被恶意使用时,这种强大便捷的工具可能生成针对任何个人受害者的虚假新闻或令人不安的内容,造成严重的负面社会影响。本文探讨了一种名为Anti-DreamBooth的防御系统,旨在通过在用户图像发布前添加细微的噪声扰动,干扰基于这些扰动图像训练的任何DreamBooth模型的生成质量。我们研究了多种扰动优化算法,并在两个面部数据集上针对多种文本到图像模型版本进行了广泛评估。尽管DreamBooth和基于扩散的文本到图像模型的公式复杂,我们的方法仍能有效保护用户免受这些模型的恶意使用。其有效性甚至在训练与测试阶段模型或提示/术语不匹配等不利条件下依然成立。我们的代码将在https://github.com/VinAIResearch/Anti-DreamBooth上发布
abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models are nothing but a revolution, allowing anyone, even without design skills, to create realistic images from simple text inputs. With powerful personalization tools like DreamBooth, they can generate images of a specific person just by learning from his/her few reference images. However, when misused, such a powerful and convenient tool can produce fake news or disturbing content targeting any individual victim, posing a severe negative social impact. In this paper, we explore a defense system called Anti-DreamBooth against such malicious use of DreamBooth. The system aims to add subtle noise perturbation to each user's image before publishing in order to disrupt the generation quality of any DreamBooth model trained on these perturbed images. We investigate a wide range of algorithms for perturbation optimization and extensively evaluate them on two facial datasets over various text-to-image model versions. Despite the complicated formulation of DreamBooth and Diffusion-based text-to-image models, our methods effectively defend users from the malicious use of those models. Their effectiveness withstands even adverse conditions, such as model or prompt/term mismatching between training and testing. Our code will be available at https://github.com/VinAIResearch/Anti-DreamBooth
authors: Thanh Van Le, Hao Phung, Thuan Hoang Nguyen, Quan Dao, Ngoc N. Tran, Anh Tran ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2116-2127

title: 紧凑型瞬时光谱成像中的孔径衍射
title_en: Aperture Diffraction for Compact Snapshot Spectral Imaging
abstract: 我们展示了一种名为Aperture Diffraction Imaging Spectrometer (ADIS)的紧凑、低成本瞬时光谱成像系统,仅由一个配备超薄正交孔径掩模的成像透镜和马赛克滤光传感器组成,其物理占用空间与普通RGB相机相当。随后,我们引入了一种新的光学设计,通过正交掩模生成的基于衍射的空间光谱投影工程,将物体空间中的每个点复用到马赛克滤光传感器的离散编码位置。正交投影被均匀采用以获得弱校准依赖的数据形式,从而增强调制鲁棒性。同时,设计了一种对衍射退化具有强感知能力的Cascade Shift-Shuffle Spectral Transformer (CSST),用于解决稀疏约束逆问题,实现从存在大量混叠的二维测量数据中进行体积重建。通过详细阐述成像光学理论和重建算法,并展示单次曝光下的实验成像结果,对系统进行了评估。最终实现了亚超像素空间分辨率和高光谱分辨率成像。代码将发布在:https://github.com/Krito-ex/CSST。
abstract_en: We demonstrate a compact, cost-effective snapshot spectral imaging system named Aperture Diffraction Imaging Spectrometer (ADIS), which consists only of an imaging lens with an ultra-thin orthogonal aperture mask and a mosaic filter sensor, requiring no additional physical footprint compared to common RGB cameras. Then we introduce a new optical design that each point in the object space is multiplexed to discrete encoding locations on the mosaic filter sensor by diffraction-based spatial-spectral projection engineering generated from the orthogonal mask. The orthogonal projection is uniformly accepted to obtain a weakly calibration-dependent data form to enhance modulation robustness. Meanwhile, the Cascade Shift-Shuffle Spectral Transformer (CSST) with strong perception of the diffraction degeneration is designed to solve a sparsity-constrained inverse problem, realizing the volume reconstruction from 2D measurements with Large amount of aliasing. Our system is evaluated by elaborating the imaging optical theory and reconstruction algorithm with demonstrating the experimental imaging under a single exposure. Ultimately, we achieve the sub-super-pixel spatial resolution and high spectral resolution imaging. The code will be available at: https://github.com/Krito-ex/CSST.
authors: Tao Lv, Hao Ye, Quan Yuan, Zhan Shi, Yibo Wang, Shuming Wang, Xun Cao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10574-10584

title: Aria数字孪生:一种用于第一视角三维机器感知的新基准数据集
title_en: Aria Digital Twin: A New Benchmark Dataset for Egocentric 3D Machine Perception
abstract: 我们介绍了Aria数字孪生(ADT)——一个通过Aria眼镜采集的第一视角数据集,包含丰富的物体、环境和人类级别的真实标签。此次发布的ADT包含200个真实世界活动序列,由Aria佩戴者在两个真实室内场景中完成,包含398个物体实例(其中344个静态物体和74个动态物体)。每个序列包含:a)两个单色摄像头流的原始数据、一个RGB摄像头流、两个惯性测量单元(IMU)流;b)完整的传感器校准数据;c)真实标签数据,包括Aria设备的连续六自由度(6DoF)姿态、物体的6DoF姿态、三维眼动向量、三维人体姿态、二维图像分割、图像深度图;d)照片级逼真合成渲染。据我们所知,目前尚无其他第一视角数据集在精度、照片级真实感和全面性方面能与ADT相媲美。通过将ADT贡献给研究社区,我们的目标是为第一视角机器感知领域建立新的评估标准,涵盖诸如三维物体检测与跟踪、场景重建与理解、模拟到现实学习、人体姿态预测等极具挑战性的研究问题,同时启发新的机器感知任务用于增强现实(AR)应用。为启动ADT研究用例的探索,我们评估了若干现有的先进方法在物体检测、分割和图像翻译任务中的表现,证明了ADT作为基准数据集的实用性。
abstract_en: We introduce the Aria Digital Twin (ADT) - an egocentric dataset captured using Aria glasses with extensive object, environment, and human level ground truth. This ADT release contains 200 sequences of real-world activities conducted by Aria wearers in two real indoor scenes with 398 object instances (344 stationary and 74 dynamic). Each sequence consists of: a) raw data of two monochrome camera streams, one RGB camera stream, two IMU streams; b) complete sensor calibration; c) ground truth data including continuous 6-degree-of-freedom (6DoF) poses of the Aria devices, object 6DoF poses, 3D eye gaze vectors, 3D human poses, 2D image segmentations, image depth maps; and d) photo-realistic synthetic renderings. To the best of our knowledge, there is no existing egocentric dataset with a level of accuracy, photo-realism and comprehensiveness comparable to ADT. By contributing ADT to the research community, our mission is to set a new standard for evaluation in the egocentric machine perception domain, which includes very challenging research problems such as 3D object detection and tracking, scene reconstruction and understanding, sim-to-real learning, human pose prediction - while also inspiring new machine perception tasks for augmented reality (AR) applications. To kick start exploration of the ADT research use cases, we evaluated several existing state-of-the-art methods for object detection, segmentation and image translation tasks that demonstrate the usefulness of ADT as a benchmarking dataset.
authors: Xiaqing Pan, Nicholas Charron, Yongqian Yang, Scott Peters, Thomas Whelan, Chen Kong, Omkar Parkhi, Richard Newcombe, Yuheng (Carl) Ren ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20133-20143

title: AssetField:基于地面特征平面表示的资产挖掘与重新配置
title_en: AssetField: Assets Mining and Reconfiguration in Ground Feature Plane Representation
abstract: 室内和室外环境本质上具有结构化和重复性。传统建模流程通过维护一个存储唯一物体模板的资产库,在实践中既灵活又节省内存。受此观察启发,我们提出AssetField,一种新颖的神经场景表示方法,通过学习一组对象感知的地面特征平面来表示场景,其中可以通过无监督方式构建存储模板特征块的资产库。与需要对象掩码来查询空间点以进行物体编辑的现有方法不同,我们的地面特征平面表示提供了场景的自然俯视图可视化,允许对物体进行多种操作(如平移、复制、变形)以配置新场景。借助模板特征块,可对包含大量重复项的场景启用分组编辑,避免对单个物体进行重复工作。我们证明AssetField不仅在新视角合成任务中表现出竞争力,还能生成新场景配置的逼真渲染效果。
abstract_en: Both indoor and outdoor environments are inherently structured and repetitive. Traditional modeling pipelines keep an asset library storing unique object templates, which is both versatile and memory efficient in practice. Inspired by this observation, we propose AssetField, a novel neural scene representation that learns a set of object-aware ground feature planes to represent the scene, where an asset library storing template feature patches can be constructed in an unsupervised manner. Unlike existing methods which require object masks to query spatial points for object editing, our ground feature plane representation offers a natural visualization of the scene in the bird-eye view, allowing a variety of operations (e.g. translation, duplication, deformation) on objects to configure a new scene. With the template feature patches, group editing is enabled for scenes with many recurring items to avoid repetitive work on object individuals. We show that AssetField not only achieves competitive performance for novel-view synthesis but also generates realistic renderings for new scene configurations.
authors: Yuanbo Xiangli, Linning Xu, Xingang Pan, Nanxuan Zhao, Bo Dai, Dahua Lin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3251-3261

title: 大气传输与热惯性诱导的盲路分割:基于大规模数据集TBRSD
title_en: Atmospheric Transmission and Thermal Inertia Induced Blind Road Segmentation with a Large-Scale Dataset TBRSD
abstract: 基于计算机视觉的步行辅助系统是帮助视障人士导航的重要工具。盲路分割是这些步行辅助系统的关键组成部分。然而,大多数步行辅助系统依赖可见光图像,在黑暗或雾气等弱光照环境中存在安全隐患。为解决这一问题并提升基于视觉的步行辅助系统安全性,我们开发了热红外盲路分割神经网络(TINN)。与传统主要聚焦于特征提取与感知增强的分割技术不同,我们的方法旨在保留热成像过程中固有的辐射特性。首先,我们建模了热红外成像中的两个关键因素——热光大气传输与热惯性效应。随后,我们采用编码器-解码器架构融合两个模块提取的特征。此外,为训练网络并评估所提方法的有效性,我们构建了一个大规模热红外盲路分割数据集TBRSD,包含5180个像素级手动标注。实验结果表明,我们的方法优于现有技术,在MFNet和SODA等基准热红外语义分割数据集上实现了热盲路分割的最先进性能。该数据集及代码已公开在https://github.com/chenjzBUAA/TBRSD或http://xzbai.buaa.edu.cn/datasets.html。
abstract_en: Computer vision-based walking assistants are prominent tools for aiding visually impaired people in navigation. Blind road segmentation is a key element in these walking assistant systems. However, most walking assistant systems rely on visual light images, which is dangerous in weak illumination environments such as darkness or fog. To address this issue and enhance the safety of vision-based walking assistant systems, we developed a thermal infrared blind road segmentation neural network (TINN). In contrast to conventional segmentation techniques that primarily concentrate on enhancing feature extraction and perception, our approach is geared towards preserving the inherent radiation characteristics within the thermal imaging process. Initially, we modelled two critical factors in thermal infrared imaging - thermal light atmospheric transmission and thermal inertia effect. Subsequently, we use an encoder-decoder architecture to fuse the feathers extracted by the two modules. Additionally, to train the network and evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed method, we constructed a large-scale thermal infrared blind road segmentation dataset named TBRSD consists 5180 pixel-level manual annotations. The experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms existing techniques and achieves state-of-the-art performance in thermal blind road segmentation, as validated on benchmark thermal infrared semantic segmentation datasets such as MFNet and SODA. The dataset and our code are both publicly available in https://github.com/chenjzBUAA/TBRSD or http://xzbai.buaa.edu.cn/datasets.html.
authors: Junzhang Chen, Xiangzhi Bai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1053-1063

title: AttT2M: 基于多视角注意力机制的文本驱动人体运动生成
title_en: AttT2M: Text-Driven Human Motion Generation with Multi-Perspective Attention Mechanism
abstract: 基于文本描述生成三维人体运动近年来一直是研究重点。该任务要求生成的运动具有多样性、自然性,并符合文本描述。由于人体运动具有复杂的时空特性,且文本与运动之间的跨模态关系学习存在困难,文本驱动的运动生成仍是一个具有挑战性的问题。为解决这些问题,我们提出AttT2M,一种包含多视角注意力机制的两阶段方法:身体部位注意力和全局-局部运动-文本注意力。前者聚焦于运动嵌入视角,即引入身体部位时空编码器至VQ-VAE中以学习更具表现力的离散潜在空间。后者从跨模态视角出发,用于学习句子级和词级的运动-文本跨模态关系。最终通过生成式变压器生成文本驱动的运动。在HumanML3D和KIT-ML上进行的大量实验表明,我们的方法在定性与定量评估中均优于当前最先进的方法,实现了细粒度合成与动作到运动的转换。我们的代码将公开发布。
abstract_en: Generating 3D human motion based on textual descriptions has been a research focus in recent years. It requires the generated motion to be diverse, natural, and conform to the textual description. Due to the complex spatio-temporal nature of human motion and the difficulty in learning the cross-modal relationship between text and motion, text-driven motion generation is still a challenging problem. To address these issues, we propose AttT2M, a two-stage method with multi-perspective attention mechanism: body-part attention and global-local motion-text attention. The former focuses on the motion embedding perspective, which means introducing a body-part spatio-temporal encoder into VQ-VAE to learn a more expressive discrete latent space. The latter is from the cross-modal perspective, which is used to learn the sentence-level and word-level motion-text cross-modal relationship. The text-driven motion is finally generated with a generative transformer. Extensive experiments conducted on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate that our method outperforms the current state-of-the-art works in terms of qualitative and quantitative evaluation, and achieve fine-grained synthesis and action2motion. Our code will be publicly available.
authors: Chongyang Zhong, Lei Hu, Zihao Zhang, Shihong Xia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 509-519

title: 点云的注意力判别采样
title_en: Attention Discriminant Sampling for Point Clouds
abstract: 本文描述了一种基于注意力机制的三维点云采样方法。我们建立的方法基于结构感知的注意力判别分析,探索点及其聚类间的几何和语义关系。所提出的注意力判别采样(ADS)首先高效地将给定点云分解为聚类,以隐式编码点间的结构和几何相关性。通过将每个聚类视为结构组件,ADS随后评估两个层次的自注意力:聚类内和聚类间。前者反映了每个聚类中点的学得特征所蕴含的语义复杂性,而后者揭示了聚类间的语义相似性。在结构上保持点分布的驱动下,这两个自注意力方面有助于避免采样冗余,并决定每个聚类中采样的点数。大量实验表明,ADS在ModelNet40上将分类性能提升至95.1%,在ScanObjectNN上提升至87.5%,并在ShapeNet Part Segmentation上达到86.9%的mIoU。对于场景分割,ADS在S3DIS上取得91.1%的准确率,mIoU优于当前最优方法,且在ScanNetV2上达到75.6%的mIoU。此外,ADS在ScanNetV2目标检测中以55.0%的mAP50超越当前最优方法。
abstract_en: This paper describes an attention-driven approach to 3-D point cloud sampling. We establish our method based on a structure-aware attention discriminant analysis that explores geometric and semantic relations embodied among points and their clusters. The proposed attention discriminant sampling (ADS) starts by efficiently decomposing a given point cloud into clusters to implicitly encode its structural and geometric relatedness among points. By treating each cluster as a structural component, ADS then draws on evaluating two levels of self-attention: within-cluster and between-cluster. The former reflects the semantic complexity entailed by the learned features of points within each cluster, while the latter reveals the semantic similarity between clusters. Driven by structurally preserving the point distribution, these two aspects of self-attention help avoid sampling redundancy and decide the number of sampled points in each cluster. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ADS significantly improves classification performance to 95.1% on ModelNet40 and 87.5% on ScanObjectNN and achieves 86.9% mIoU on ShapeNet Part Segmentation. For scene segmentation, ADS yields 91.1% accuracy on S3DIS with higher mIoU to the state-of-the-art and 75.6% mIoU on ScanNetV2. Furthermore, ADS surpasses the state-of-the-art with 55.0% mAP50 on ScanNetV2 object detection.
authors: Cheng-Yao Hong, Yu-Ying Chou, Tyng-Luh Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14429-14440

title: 聚焦关键区域:重新审视视觉文档理解的选择性区域集中
title_en: Attention Where It Matters: Rethinking Visual Document Understanding with Selective Region Concentration
abstract: 我们提出了一种名为SeRum(SElective Region Understanding Model)的新型端到端文档理解模型,用于从文档图像中提取有意义的信息,包括文档分析、检索和办公自动化。与依赖多阶段技术方案且计算成本高昂的现有方法不同,SeRum将文档图像理解和识别任务转化为对感兴趣视觉标记的局部解码过程,采用内容感知的标记合并模块。该机制使模型能够更关注由查询解码器生成的兴趣区域,提升模型效果并加快生成方案的解码速度。我们还设计了若干预训练任务以增强模型的理解能力和局部感知能力。实验结果表明,SeRum在文档理解任务中达到最先进性能,在文本定位任务中也取得具有竞争力的结果。SeRum代表了向实现高效且有效的端到端文档理解的重要进展。
abstract_en: We propose a novel end-to-end document understanding model called SeRum (SElective Region Understanding Model) for extracting meaningful information from document images, including document analysis, retrieval, and office automation. Unlike state-of-the-art approaches that rely on multi-stage technical schemes and are computationally expensive, SeRum converts document image understanding and recognition tasks into a local decoding process of the vision tokens of interest, using a content-aware token merge module. This mechanism enables the model to pay more attention to regions of interest generated by the query decoder, improving the model's effectiveness and speeding up the decoding speed of the generative scheme. We also designed several pre-training tasks to enhance the understanding and local awareness of the model. Experimental results demonstrate that SeRum achieves state-of-the-art performance on document understanding tasks and competitive results on text spotting tasks. SeRum represents a substantial advancement towards enabling efficient and effective end-to-end document understanding.
authors: Haoyu Cao, Changcun Bao, Chaohu Liu, Huang Chen, Kun Yin, Hao Liu, Yinsong Liu, Deqiang Jiang, Xing Sun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19517-19527

title: Attentive Mask CLIP
title_en: Attentive Mask CLIP
abstract: 在视觉-语言建模中,图像标记移除是一种高效的增强技术,可降低图像特征编码的成本。然而,CLIP风格模型被发现会受到该技术的负面影响。我们假设移除大量图像标记可能会无意中破坏与给定文本描述相关的语义信息,导致CLIP训练中配对数据对齐错误。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种注意力标记移除方法,该方法保留与对应文本描述具有强语义关联的少量标记。相关性得分通过EMA更新的视觉编码器动态评估。我们的方法称为注意力掩码CLIP,在节省训练时间的同时,优于原始CLIP及采用随机标记移除的CLIP变体。此外,我们的方法还支持高效的多视角对比学习。实验表明,在YFCC-15M数据集上训练ViT-B模型,我们的方法在ImageNet-1K零样本分类任务中达到43.9%的top-1准确率,在Flickr30K和MS COCO数据集上分别实现62.7/42.1和38.0/23.2的I2T/T2I检索准确率,分别优于SLIP模型+1.1%、+5.5/+0.9和+4.4/+1.3,同时训练速度提升2.30倍。该方法的高效版本运行速度比原始CLIP模型快1.16倍,在这些基准测试中分别取得+5.3%、+11.3/+8.0和+9.5/+4.9的显著提升。
abstract_en: In vision-language modeling, image token removal is an efficient augmentation technique to reduce the cost of encoding image features. The CLIP-style models, however, have been found to be negatively impacted by this technique. We hypothesize that removing a large portion of image tokens may inadvertently destroy the semantic information associated to a given text description, resulting in misaligned paired data in CLIP training. To address this issue, we propose an attentive token removal approach, which retains a small number of tokens that have a strong semantic correlation to the corresponding text description. The correlation scores are dynamically evaluated through an EMA-updated vision encoder. Our method, termed attentive mask CLIP, outperforms original CLIP and CLIP variant with random token removal while saving the training time. In addition, our approach also enables efficient multi-view contrastive learning. Experimentally, by training ViT-B on YFCC-15M dataset, our approach achieves 43.9% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K zero-shot classification, 62.7/42.1 and 38.0/23.2 I2T/T2I retrieval accuracy on Flickr30K and MS COCO, outperforming SLIP by +1.1%,+5.5/+0.9, and +4.4/+1.3, respectively, while being 2.30x faster. An efficient version of our approach runs 1.16x faster than the plain CLIP model, while achieving significant gains of +5.3%, +11.3/+8.0, and +9.5/+4.9 on these benchmarks, respectively.
authors: Yifan Yang, Weiquan Huang, Yixuan Wei, Houwen Peng, Xinyang Jiang, Huiqiang Jiang, Fangyun Wei, Yin Wang, Han Hu, Lili Qiu, Yuqing Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2771-2781

title: 基于文本条件特征对齐的音频增强文本到视频检索
title_en: Audio-Enhanced Text-to-Video Retrieval using Text-Conditioned Feature Alignment
abstract: 文本到视频检索系统近期通过利用大规模图像-文本对预训练模型取得了显著进展。然而,大多数最新方法主要关注视频模态而忽视了该任务中的音频信号。尽管如此,EclipSE的最新进展通过开发视听视频表示提升了长程文本到视频检索性能。但文本到视频检索任务的目标是捕捉与文本查询相关的互补音频和视频信息,而非单纯实现更好的音频视频对齐。为解决这一问题,我们提出TEFAL(TExt-conditioned Feature ALignment),一种基于文本条件的特征对齐方法,能够生成受文本查询条件约束的音频和视频表示。与仅使用音频视觉注意力块可能抑制文本查询相关音频信息不同,我们的方法采用两个独立的跨模态注意力块,使文本能够分别关注音频和视频表示。所提方法在包含音频的四个基准数据集(MSR-VTT、LSMDC、VATEX和Charades)上进行了验证,且在四个数据集上均优于当前最先进性能。这归因于额外的文本查询条件音频表示及其对文本查询条件视频表示的互补信息增强。
abstract_en: Text-to-video retrieval systems have recently made significant progress by utilizing pre-trained models trained on large-scale image-text pairs. However, most of the latest methods primarily focus on the video modality while disregarding the audio signal for this task. Nevertheless, a recent advancement by EclipSE has improved long-range text-to-video retrieval by developing an audiovisual video representation. Nonetheless, the objective of the text-to-video retrieval task is to capture the complementary audio and video information that is pertinent to the text query rather than simply achieving better audio and video alignment. To address this issue, we introduce TEFAL, a TExt-conditioned Feature ALignment method that produces both audio and video representations conditioned on the text query. Instead of using only an audiovisual attention block, which could suppress the audio information relevant to the text query, our approach employs two independent cross-modal attention blocks that enable the text to attend to the audio and video representations separately. Our proposed method's efficacy is demonstrated on four benchmark datasets that include audio: MSR-VTT, LSMDC, VATEX, and Charades, and achieves better than state-of-the-art performance consistently across the four datasets. This is attributed to the additional text-query-conditioned audio representation and the complementary information it adds to the text-query-conditioned video representation.
authors: Sarah Ibrahimi, Xiaohang Sun, Pichao Wang, Amanmeet Garg, Ashutosh Sanan, Mohamed Omar ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12054-12064

title: Audio-Visual Class-Incremental Learning
title_en: Audio-Visual Class-Incremental Learning
abstract: 本文提出音频-视觉类增量学习,这是一种面向音频-视觉视频识别的类增量学习场景。我们证明联合音频-视觉建模能够提升类增量学习效果,但现有方法在增量步骤增加时无法保持音频与视觉特征间的语义相似性。此外,我们观察到随着增量步骤推进,先前任务中学习到的音频-视觉关联性可能被遗忘,导致性能下降。为解决这些问题,我们提出AV-CIL方法,通过双模态语义相似性约束(D-AVSC)维持音频-视觉模态间的实例感知与类别感知语义相似性,并利用视觉注意力蒸馏(VAD)保留先前学习的音频引导视觉注意力能力。基于AVE、Kinetics-Sounds和VGGSound数据集,我们构建了三个音频-视觉类增量数据集:AVE-Class-Incremental(AVE-CI)、Kinetics-Sounds-Class-Incremental(K-S-CI)和VGGSound100-Class-Incremental(VS100-CI)。在AVE-CI、K-S-CI和VS100-CI上的实验表明,AV-CIL在音频-视觉类增量学习任务中显著优于现有方法。代码和数据可访问:https://github.com/weiguoPian/AV-CIL_ICCV2023。
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce audio-visual class-incremental learning, a class-incremental learning scenario for audio-visual video recognition. We demonstrate that joint audio-visual modeling can improve class-incremental learning, but current methods fail to preserve semantic similarity between audio and visual features as incremental step grows. Furthermore, we observe that audio-visual correlations learned in previous tasks can be forgotten as incremental steps progress, leading to poor performance. To overcome these challenges, we propose AV-CIL, which incorporates Dual-Audio-Visual Similarity Constraint (D-AVSC) to maintain both instance-aware and class-aware semantic similarity between audio-visual modalities and Visual Attention Distillation (VAD) to retain previously learned audio-guided visual attentive ability. We create three audio-visual class-incremental datasets, AVE-Class-Incremental (AVE-CI), Kinetics-Sounds-Class-Incremental (K-S-CI), and VGGSound100-Class-Incremental (VS100-CI) based on the AVE, Kinetics-Sounds, and VGGSound datasets, respectively. Our experiments on AVE-CI, K-S-CI, and VS100-CI demonstrate that AV-CIL significantly outperforms existing class-incremental learning methods in audio-visual class-incremental learning. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/weiguoPian/AV-CIL_ICCV2023.
authors: Weiguo Pian, Shentong Mo, Yunhui Guo, Yapeng Tian ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7799-7811

title: 视听欺骗检测:DOLOS数据集与参数高效跨模态学习
title_en: Audio-Visual Deception Detection: DOLOS Dataset and Parameter-Efficient Crossmodal Learning
abstract: 对话中的欺骗检测是一项具有挑战性但重要的任务,在商业可信度评估、多媒体反欺诈和定制安全等领域具有关键应用价值。然而,欺骗检测研究受到高质量欺骗数据集匮乏以及多模态特征有效学习困难的制约。为解决这一问题,我们引入了DOLOS,这是目前最大的游戏节目欺骗检测数据集,包含丰富的欺骗性对话。DOLOS包含1,675个视频片段,涉及213名受试者,并附有音频-视觉特征标注。我们提供了训练-测试、时长和性别协议以研究不同因素的影响。我们在之前提出的欺骗检测方法上对数据集进行了基准测试。为进一步通过微调更少参数提升性能,我们提出参数高效跨模态学习(PECL),其中统一时间适配器(UT-Adapter)在基于Transformer的架构中探索时间注意力机制,而跨模态融合模块插件音频-视觉融合(PAVF)结合音频-视觉特征的跨模态信息。基于DOLOS丰富的细粒度音频-视觉标注,我们还利用多任务学习通过同时预测欺骗和音频-视觉特征来增强性能。实验结果验证了DOLOS数据集的高质量和PECL的有效性。DOLOS数据集和源代码已公开。
abstract_en: Deception detection in conversations is a challenging yet important task, having pivotal applications in many fields such as credibility assessment in business, multimedia anti-frauds, and custom security. Despite this, deception detection research is hindered by the lack of high-quality deception datasets, as well as the difficulties of learning multimodal features effectively. To address this issue, we introduce DOLOS, the largest gameshow deception detection dataset with rich deceptive conversations. DOLOS includes 1,675 video clips featuring 213 subjects, and it has been labeled with audio-visual feature annotations. We provide train-test, duration, and gender protocols to investigate the impact of different factors. We benchmark our dataset on previously proposed deception detection approaches. To further improve the performance by fine-tuning fewer parameters, we propose Parameter-Efficient Crossmodal Learning (PECL), where a Uniform Temporal Adapter (UT-Adapter) explores temporal attention in transformer-based architectures, and a crossmodal fusion module, Plug-in Audio-Visual Fusion (PAVF), combines crossmodal information from audio-visual features. Based on the rich fine-grained audio-visual annotations on DOLOS, we also exploit multi-task learning to enhance performance by concurrently predicting deception and audio-visual features. Experimental results demonstrate the desired quality of the DOLOS dataset and the effectiveness of the PECL. The DOLOS dataset and the source codes are available.
authors: Xiaobao Guo, Nithish Muthuchamy Selvaraj, Zitong Yu, Adams Wai-Kin Kong, Bingquan Shen, Alex Kot ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22135-22145

title: 视听注视网络:高效视频识别
title_en: Audio-Visual Glance Network for Efficient Video Recognition
abstract: 深度学习在视频理解任务中取得了显著进展,但使用基于片段的视频分类器对长时序和大规模视频进行分类所需的计算量仍然不切实际且成本高昂。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种视听注视网络(Audio-Visual Glance Network, AVGN),该网络利用普遍可用的音频和视觉模态,高效处理视频中的时空重要部分。AVGN首先将视频分割为图像-音频片段对,并采用轻量级单模态编码器提取全局视觉特征和音频特征。为识别重要时序片段,我们使用音频-视觉时序显著性Transformer(Audio-Visual Temporal Saliency Transformer, AV-TeST)估计每帧的显著性得分。为进一步提升空间维度的效率,AVGN仅处理重要块而非整张图像。我们采用音频增强空间块注意力(Audio-Enhanced Spatial Patch Attention, AESPA)模块生成增强的粗粒度视觉特征,这些特征输入策略网络以生成重要块的坐标。该方法使我们能够专注于视频中最关键的时空部分,从而实现更高效的视频识别。此外,我们结合多种训练技术与多模态特征融合策略,以增强AVGN的鲁棒性与有效性。通过整合这些策略,我们的AVGN在多个视频识别基准测试中取得了新的最先进性能,同时实现了更快的处理速度。
abstract_en:
Deep learning has made significant strides in video understanding tasks, but the computation required to classify lengthy and massive videos using clip-level video classifiers remains impractical and prohibitively expensive.
 To address this issue, we propose Audio-Visual Glance Network (AVGN), which leverages the commonly available audio and visual modalities to efficiently process the spatio-temporally important parts of a video. AVGN firstly divides the video into snippets of image-audio clip pair and employs lightweight unimodal encoders to extract global visual features and audio features. To identify the important temporal segments, we use an Audio-Visual Temporal Saliency Transformer (AV-TeST) that estimates the saliency scores of each frame. To further increase efficiency in the spatial dimension, AVGN processes only the important patches instead of the whole images. We use an Audio-Enhanced Spatial Patch Attention (AESPA) module to produce a set of enhanced coarse visual features, which are fed to a policy network that produces the coordinates of the important patches. This approach enables us to focus only on the most important spatio-temporally parts of the video, leading to more efficient video recognition. Moreover, we incorporate various training techniques and multi-modal feature fusion to enhance the robustness and effectiveness of our AVGN. By combining these strategies, our AVGN sets new state-of-the-art performance in multiple video recognition benchmarks while achieving faster processing speed.
authors: Muhammad Adi Nugroho, Sangmin Woo, Sumin Lee, Changick Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10150-10159

title: 视听掩码自编码器
title_en: Audiovisual Masked Autoencoders
abstract: 我们能否利用视频中已有的视听信息来提升自监督表示学习?为回答这一问题,我们研究了多种基于掩码自编码框架的预训练架构和目标,受自然语言和图像理解中类似方法成功的启发。我们证明了在视听下游分类任务中可以实现显著改进,在VGGSound和AudioSet上超越了当前最佳性能。此外,我们还可以利用视听预训练方案,通过单一的视听预训练模型处理多种单模态下游任务。我们进一步展示了表示的可迁移性,在无需针对此数据集进行特定预训练的情况下,实现了Epic Kitchens上的视听最先进结果。
abstract_en: Can we leverage the audiovisual information already present in video to improve self-supervised representation learning? To answer this question, we study various pretraining architectures and objectives within the masked autoencoding framework, motivated by the success of similar methods in natural language and image understanding. We show that we can achieve significant improvements on audiovisual downstream classification tasks, surpassing the state-of-the-art on VGGSound and AudioSet. Furthermore, we can leverage our audiovisual pretraining scheme for multiple unimodal downstream tasks using a single audiovisual pretrained model. We additionally demonstrate the transferability of our representations, achieving state-of-the-art audiovisual results on Epic Kitchens without pretraining specifically for this dataset.
authors: Mariana-Iuliana Georgescu, Eduardo Fonseca, Radu Tudor Ionescu, Mario Lucic, Cordelia Schmid, Anurag Arnab ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16144-16154

title: 增强框回放:克服增量目标检测中的前景偏移
title_en: Augmented Box Replay: Overcoming Foreground Shift for Incremental Object Detection
abstract: 在增量学习中,将先前任务存储的样本与当前任务样本一起回放是解决灾难性遗忘最有效的方法之一。然而,与增量分类不同,图像回放尚未成功应用于增量目标检测(IOD)。本文识别出被忽视的前景偏移问题作为这一现象的主要原因。前景偏移仅在回放先前任务图像时发生,指的是其背景可能包含当前任务的前景对象。为克服这一问题,我们开发了一种新颖且高效的增强框回放(ABR)方法,该方法仅存储和回放前景对象,从而规避前景偏移问题。此外,我们提出了一种创新的注意力RoI蒸馏损失,利用区域感兴趣(RoI)特征的空间注意力,约束当前模型专注于旧模型中最重要信息。ABR在显著减少先前类别遗忘的同时,保持当前类别的高可塑性。此外,与标准图像回放相比,它大大降低了存储需求。在Pascal-VOC和COCO数据集上的综合实验验证了我们模型的最先进性能。
abstract_en: In incremental learning, replaying stored samples from previous tasks together with current task samples is one of the most efficient approaches to address catastrophic forgetting. However, unlike incremental classification, image replay has not been successfully applied to incremental object detection (IOD). In this paper, we identify the overlooked problem of foreground shift as the main reason for this. Foreground shift only occurs when replaying images of previous tasks and refers to the fact that their background might contain foreground objects of the current task. To overcome this problem, a novel and efficient Augmented Box Replay (ABR) method is developed that only stores and replays foreground objects and thereby circumvents the foreground shift problem. In addition, we propose an innovative Attentive RoI Distillation loss that uses spatial attention from region-of-interest (RoI) features to constrain current model to focus on the most important information from old model. ABR significantly reduces forgetting of previous classes while maintaining high plasticity in current classes. Moreover, it considerably reduces the storage requirements when compared to standard image replay. Comprehensive experiments on Pascal-VOC and COCO datasets support the state-of-the-art performance of our model.
authors: Yuyang Liu, Yang Cong, Dipam Goswami, Xialei Liu, Joost van de Weijer ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11367-11377

title: 少样本视频领域适应中的片段增强与对齐
title_en: Augmenting and Aligning Snippets for Few-Shot Video Domain Adaptation
abstract: 为使视频模型能够无缝迁移并应用于不同环境中的视频任务,已引入视频无监督领域适应(Video Unsupervised Domain Adaptation, VUDA)以提升视频模型的鲁棒性与迁移能力。然而,当前VUDA方法依赖大量高质量的未标记目标数据,这在现实场景中可能不可用。因此,我们考虑更现实的少样本视频领域适应(Few-Shot Video-based Domain Adaptation, FSVDA)场景,即仅使用少量目标视频样本对视频模型进行适应。尽管已有少数方法涉及图像领域的少样本领域适应(Few-Shot Domain Adaptation, FSDA)和FSVDA,但它们主要依赖空间增强扩展目标域,并在实例级别进行统计对齐。然而,视频包含更丰富的时序和语义信息,这些信息应在FSVDA中增强目标域和进行对齐时被充分考虑。我们提出了一种新颖的SSA2lign方法,在片段级别解决FSVDA问题,其中通过简单的片段级增强扩展目标域,并通过语义和统计上的注意力对齐实现片段对齐,其中片段语义对齐通过多视角进行。实验结果表明,SSA2lign在多个跨领域动作识别基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: For video models to be transferred and applied seamlessly across video tasks in varied environments, Video Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (VUDA) has been introduced to improve the robustness and transferability of video models. However, current VUDA methods rely on a vast amount of high-quality unlabeled target data, which may not be available in real-world cases. We thus consider a more realistic Few-Shot Video-based Domain Adaptation (FSVDA) scenario where we adapt video models with only a few target video samples. While a few methods have touched upon Few-Shot Domain Adaptation (FSDA) in images and in FSVDA, they rely primarily on spatial augmentation for target domain expansion with alignment performed statistically at the instance level. However, videos contain more knowledge in terms of rich temporal and semantic information, which should be fully considered while augmenting target domains and performing alignment in FSVDA. We propose a novel SSA2lign to address FSVDA at the snippet level, where the target domain is expanded through a simple snippet-level augmentation followed by the attentive alignment of snippets both semantically and statistically, where semantic alignment of snippets is conducted through multiple perspectives. Empirical results demonstrate state-of-the-art performance of SSA2lign across multiple cross-domain action recognition benchmarks.
authors: Yuecong Xu, Jianfei Yang, Yunjiao Zhou, Zhenghua Chen, Min Wu, Xiaoli Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13445-13456

title: AutoAD II:续篇——电影音频描述中的“谁”、“何时”与“何事”
title_en: AutoAD II: The Sequel - Who, When, and What in Movie Audio Description
abstract: 音频描述(AD)是为视觉障碍观众生成视觉内容描述的任务,需在合适的时间间隔进行。对于电影而言,这带来了显著挑战——AD必须仅在现有对话停顿期间生成,需通过角色姓名进行指代,并应有助于整体剧情的理解。为此,我们开发了一种新的模型,基于帧的CLIP视觉特征、演员名单以及语音的时间位置,自动生成电影音频描述,解决“谁”、“何时”与“何事”三个问题:(i) 谁——我们构建了一个包含角色姓名、扮演该角色的演员及其面部CLIP特征的字符库,用于主要演员阵容,并展示了如何利用该库提升生成描述中的命名准确性;(ii) 何时——我们研究了多种模型,根据时间间隔及其邻近区域的视觉内容判断是否生成AD;(iii) 何事——我们实现了一种新的视觉-语言模型,该模型可通过交叉注意力机制基于视觉特征处理字符库的建议,并在与先前架构的直接对比中展示了其在AD文本生成方面的改进效果。
abstract_en:
Audio Description (AD) is the task of generating descriptions of visual content, at suitable time intervals, for the benefit of visually impaired audiences. For movies, this presents notable challenges -- AD must occur only during existing pauses in dialogue, should refer to characters by name, and ought to aid understanding of the storyline as a whole.
 To this end, we develop a new model for automatically generating movie AD, given CLIP visual features of the frames, the cast list, and the temporal locations of the speech; addressing all three of the `who', `when', and `what' questions: (i) who -- we introduce a character bank consisting of the character's name, the actor that played the part, and a CLIP feature of their face, for the principal cast of each movie, and demonstrate how this can be used to improve naming in the generated AD; (ii) when -- we investigate several models for determining whether an AD should be generated for a time interval or not, based on the visual content of the interval and its neighbours; and (iii) what -- we implement a new vision-language model for this task, that can ingest the proposals from the character bank, whilst conditioning on the visual features using cross-attention, and demonstrate how this improves over previous architectures for AD text generation in an apples-to-apples comparison.
authors: Tengda Han, Max Bain, Arsha Nagrani, Gul Varol, Weidi Xie, Andrew Zisserman ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13645-13655

title: AutoDiffusion: 无需训练的扩散模型加速方法:时间步与架构的优化
title_en: AutoDiffusion: Training-Free Optimization of Time Steps and Architectures for Automated Diffusion Model Acceleration
abstract: 扩散模型是新兴的表达能力强大的生成模型,其中单张图像生成需要大量的时间步(推理步骤)。为加速这一繁琐过程,统一减少时间步被视为扩散模型的公认原则。我们认为这种统一假设在实践中并非最优解,即我们可以为不同模型找到不同的最优时间步。因此,我们提出在一个统一框架中搜索最优时间步序列和压缩模型架构,以实现无需进一步训练的有效图像生成。具体而言,我们首先设计一个包含所有可能时间步和各种架构的统一搜索空间。然后引入两阶段进化算法在设计的搜索空间中寻找最优解。为进一步加速搜索过程,我们采用生成样本与真实样本之间的FID分数来估计采样实例的性能。结果表明,所提方法具有以下特点:(i) 无需训练,通过任何训练过程即可获得最优时间步和模型架构;(ii) 与大多数先进扩散采样器正交,可集成以获得更优样本质量;(iii) 具有通用性,搜索到的时间步和架构可直接应用于相同引导尺度的不同扩散模型。实验结果表明,我们的方法仅使用少量时间步即可实现优异性能,例如在ImageNet 64x64上仅用四步即可获得17.86的FID分数,相比DDIM的138.66显著提升。
abstract_en: Diffusion models are emerging expressive generative models, in which a large number of time steps (inference steps) are required for a single image generation. To accelerate such tedious process, reducing steps uniformly is considered as an undisputed principle of diffusion models. We consider that such a uniform assumption is not the optimal solution in practice; i.e., we can find different optimal time steps for different models. Therefore, we propose to search the optimal time steps sequence and compressed model architecture in a unified framework to achieve effective image generation for diffusion models without any further training. Specifically, we first design a unified search space that consists of all possible time steps and various architectures. Then, a two stage evolutionary algorithm is introduced to find the optimal solution in the designed search space. To further accelerate the search process, we employ FID score between generated and real samples to estimate the performance of the sampled examples.
