Despite its simplicity, our approach can even surpass soft-prompt learning methods as shown by extensive experiments on 11 image and 2 video datasets.
authors: Yassine Ouali, Adrian Bulat, Brais Matinez, Georgios Tzimiropoulos ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15534-15546

title: 基于双向阿特金森-希夫林记忆的黑盒无监督域适应
title_en: Black-Box Unsupervised Domain Adaptation with Bi-Directional Atkinson-Shiffrin Memory
abstract: 黑盒无监督域适应(UDA)在训练过程中无需访问源数据或源模型,仅通过目标数据的源预测进行学习,其在数据隐私保护和目标网络选择灵活性方面具有明显优势。然而,目标数据的源预测往往存在噪声,基于此类预测的训练容易导致学习崩溃。本文提出BiMem,一种双向记忆机制,通过实时记忆有用且具有代表性的信息以校正噪声伪标签,从而实现鲁棒的黑盒UDA方法,可在不同视觉识别任务中实现泛化。BiMem构建了三种类型的记忆,包括感官记忆、短期记忆和长期记忆,这些记忆以双向交互方式实现对学习特征的全面且鲁棒的记忆。其包含前向记忆流,用于识别和存储有用特征,以及后向校准流,用于逐步修正特征的伪标签。大量实验表明,BiMem在图像分类、语义分割和目标检测等各类视觉识别任务中均实现了卓越的域适应性能。
abstract_en: Black-box unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) learns with source predictions of target data without accessing either source data or source models during training, and it has clear superiority in data privacy and flexibility in target network selection. However, the source predictions of target data are often noisy and training with them is prone to learning collapses. We propose BiMem, a bi-directional memorization mechanism that learns to remember useful and representative information to correct noisy pseudo labels on the fly, leading to robust black-box UDA that can generalize across different visual recognition tasks. BiMem constructs three types of memory, including sensory memory, short-term memory, and long-term memory, which interact in a bi-directional manner for comprehensive and robust memorization of learnt features. It includes a forward memorization flow that identifies and stores useful features and a backward calibration flow that rectifies features' pseudo labels progressively. Extensive experiments show that BiMem achieves superior domain adaptation performance consistently across various visual recognition tasks such as image classification, semantic segmentation and object detection.
authors: Jingyi Zhang, Jiaxing Huang, Xueying Jiang, Shijian Lu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11771-11782

title: BlendFace:重新设计身份编码器用于人脸交换
title_en: BlendFace: Re-designing Identity Encoders for Face-Swapping
abstract: 生成对抗网络和人脸识别模型在计算机视觉领域的重大进展使得从单一来源图像中进行身份交换成为可能。尽管许多研究似乎提出了几乎令人满意的解决方案,但我们注意到先前方法仍存在身份属性纠缠问题,这会导致不期望的属性交换,因为广泛使用的身份编码器(如ArcFace)由于在人脸识别任务上的预训练,存在关键属性偏差。为了解决这一问题,我们设计了BlendFace,一种新型的人脸交换身份编码器。BlendFace的核心思想是通过训练属性被替换为另一人的混合图像的人脸识别模型,以减轻发型、头部形状等人际偏差。BlendFace将解耦的身份特征输入生成器,并作为身份损失函数引导生成器。大量实验表明,BlendFace在提升人脸交换模型的身份属性解耦效果方面优于现有方法,同时保持与先前方法相当的定量性能。
abstract_en: The great advancements of generative adversarial networks and face recognition models in computer vision have made it possible to swap identities on images from single sources. Although a lot of studies seems to have proposed almost satisfactory solutions, we notice previous methods still suffer from an identity-attribute entanglement that causes undesired attributes swapping because widely used identity encoders, e.g., ArcFace, have some crucial attribute biases owing to their pretraining on face recognition tasks. To address this issue, we design BlendFace, a novel identity encoder for face-swapping. The key idea behind BlendFace is training face recognition models on blended images whose attributes are replaced with those of another mitigates inter-personal biases such as hairsyles and head shapes. BlendFace feeds disentangled identity features into generators and guides generators properly as an identity loss function. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BlendFace improves the identity-attribute disentanglement in face-swapping models, maintaining a comparable quantitative performance to previous methods.
authors: Kaede Shiohara, Xingchao Yang, Takafumi Taketomi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7634-7644

title: Blending-NeRF:基于文本驱动的神经辐射场局部编辑
title_en: Blending-NeRF: Text-Driven Localized Editing in Neural Radiance Fields
abstract: 对3D物体进行文本驱动的局部编辑尤为困难,因为在不扭曲物体形态的前提下,将原始3D物体与预期的新物体及风格效果进行局部混合并非易事。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种基于NeRF的新模型Blending-NeRF,该模型包含两个NeRF网络:预训练NeRF和可编辑NeRF。此外,我们引入了新的混合操作,使Blending-NeRF能够对通过文本定位的目标区域进行适当编辑。通过使用预训练的视觉-语言对齐模型CLIP,我们引导Blending-NeRF添加具有不同颜色和密度的新物体、修改纹理并移除原始物体的部分区域。我们的大量实验表明,Blending-NeRF能够从各种文本提示中生成自然且局部编辑的3D物体。
abstract_en: Text-driven localized editing of 3D objects is particularly difficult as locally mixing the original 3D object with the intended new object and style effects without distorting the object's form is not a straightforward process. To address this issue, we propose a novel NeRF-based model, Blending-NeRF, which consists of two NeRF networks: pretrained NeRF and editable NeRF. Additionally, we introduce new blending operations that allow Blending-NeRF to properly edit target regions which are localized by text. By using a pretrained vision-language aligned model, CLIP, we guide Blending-NeRF to add new objects with varying colors and densities, modify textures, and remove parts of the original object. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that Blending-NeRF produces naturally and locally edited 3D objects from various text prompts.
authors: Hyeonseop Song, Seokhun Choi, Hoseok Do, Chul Lee, Taehyeong Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14383-14393

title: BlindHarmony:通过流模型实现的“盲”磁共振图像谐调
title_en: BlindHarmony: "Blind" Harmonization for MR Images via Flow Model
abstract: 在磁共振成像(MRI)中,同一受试者相同对比度(例如T1)的图像,使用不同硬件、序列或扫描参数获取时会表现出明显差异。这些图像差异造成了域差距,需要通过称为图像谐调的步骤来弥合,以成功处理图像(例如分割)。已有包括基于深度学习的方法在内的多种方法实现图像谐调。然而,这些方法通常需要多域数据集进行深度学习训练,当应用于未见域图像时仍可能失败。为解决这一局限性,我们提出了一种新概念称为“盲谐调”(Blind Harmonization),该方法仅利用目标域数据进行训练,但仍具备对未见域图像的谐调能力。为实现盲谐调,我们开发了BlindHarmony,采用无条件流模型训练于目标域数据。谐调后的图像在保持与输入源域图像相关性的同时,确保流模型的潜在向量接近高斯分布中心。BlindHarmony在模拟和真实数据集上进行了评估,并与传统方法进行了比较。在两个数据集上,BlindHarmony均表现出显著性能,凸显了其在临床环境中的应用潜力。源代码可在:https://github.com/SNU-LIST/BlindHarmony 获取
abstract_en: In MRI, images of the same contrast (e.g., T1) from the same subject can exhibit noticeable differences when acquired using different hardware, sequences, or scan parameters. These differences in images create a domain gap that needs to be bridged by a step called image harmonization, to process the images successfully using conventional or deep learning-based image analysis (e.g., segmentation). Several methods, including deep learning-based approaches, have been proposed to achieve image harmonization. However, they often require datasets from multiple domains for deep learning training and may still be unsuccessful when applied to images from unseen domains. To address this limitation, we propose a novel concept called 'Blind Harmonization', which utilizes only target domain data for training but still has the capability to harmonize images from unseen domains. For the implementation of blind harmonization, we developed BlindHarmony using an unconditional flow model trained on target domain data. The harmonized image is optimized to have a correlation with the input source domain image while ensuring that the latent vector of the flow model is close to the center of the Gaussian distribution. BlindHarmony was evaluated on both simulated and real datasets and compared to conventional methods. BlindHarmony demonstrated noticeable performance on both datasets, highlighting its potential for future use in clinical settings. The source code is available at: https://github.com/SNU-LIST/BlindHarmony
authors: Hwihun Jeong, Heejoon Byun, Dong Un Kang, Jongho Lee ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21129-21139

title: BoMD: 多标签描述符袋用于噪声胸X光分类
title_en: BoMD: Bag of Multi-label Descriptors for Noisy Chest X-ray Classification
abstract: 深度学习方法在医学成像问题中表现出卓越的分类准确性,这在很大程度上归功于大规模人工标注干净标签的数据集。然而,鉴于此类人工标注的高成本,新的医学成像分类问题可能需要依赖从放射报告中提取的机器生成噪声标签。事实上,许多胸X光(CXR)分类器是从带有噪声标签的数据集中建模的,但它们的训练过程通常对噪声标签样本不具有鲁棒性,导致模型性能不理想。此外,CXR数据集大多是多标签的,因此当前的多类噪声标签学习方法难以直接适应。在本文中,我们提出了一种新的方法,专门用于噪声多标签CXR学习,该方法能够检测并平滑地重新标注数据集中的噪声样本,以用于常见多标签分类器的训练。所提出的方法优化多标签描述符袋(BoMD),以提升其与由多标签图像注释生成的语言模型语义描述符的相似性。我们在噪声多标签训练集和干净测试集上的实验表明,我们的模型在多个CXR多标签分类基准测试中表现出最先进的准确性和鲁棒性,包括我们提出的新基准,用于系统评估噪声多标签方法。
abstract_en: Deep learning methods have shown outstanding classification accuracy in medical imaging problems, which is largely attributed to the availability of large-scale datasets manually annotated with clean labels. However, given the high cost of such manual annotation, new medical imaging classification problems may need to rely on machine-generated noisy labels extracted from radiology reports. Indeed, many Chest X-Ray (CXR) classifiers have been modelled from datasets with noisy labels, but their training procedure is in general not robust to noisy-label samples, leading to sub-optimal models. Furthermore, CXR datasets are mostly multi-label, so current multi-class noisy-label learning methods cannot be easily adapted. In this paper, we propose a new method designed for noisy multi-label CXR learning, which detects and smoothly re-labels noisy samples from the dataset to be used in the training of common multi-label classifiers. The proposed method optimises a bag of multi-label descriptors (BoMD) to promote their similarity with the semantic descriptors produced by language models from multi-label image annotations. Our experiments on noisy multi-label training sets and clean testing sets show that our model has state-of-the-art accuracy and robustness in many CXR multi-label classification benchmarks, including a new benchmark that we propose to systematically assess noisy multi-label methods.
authors: Yuanhong Chen, Fengbei Liu, Hu Wang, Chong Wang, Yuyuan Liu, Yu Tian, Gustavo Carneiro ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21284-21295

title: 基于人体先验知识与不确定性建模的单目三维人体重建
title_en: Body Knowledge and Uncertainty Modeling for Monocular 3D Human Body Reconstruction
abstract: 近年来,三维人体重建方法取得了显著进展,但获取足够准确且数量充足的三维监督数据仍具挑战性。本文提出KNOWN框架,通过有效利用人体先验知识和不确定性建模来补偿三维监督数据的不足。KNOWN利用从成熟人体知识中提取的通用身体约束集,这些约束精确且明确地表征了重建的合理性,使三维重建模型无需任何三维数据即可进行训练。此外,现有方法通常在训练中使用多数据集图像,可能导致数据噪声(如关节标注不一致)和数据不平衡(如少数异常姿态或挑战性视角图像)。KNOWN通过新颖的概率框架解决这些问题,该框架同时建模偶然不确定性与认知不确定性。偶然不确定性通过鲁棒的负对数似然(NLL)训练损失进行编码,而认知不确定性则用于指导模型优化。实验结果表明,KNOWN的人体重建性能优于先前的弱监督方法,特别是在处理具有挑战性的少数异常图像时表现突出。
abstract_en: While 3D body reconstruction methods have made remarkable progress recently, it remains difficult to acquire the sufficiently accurate and numerous 3D supervisions required for training. In this paper, we propose KNOWN, a framework that effectively utilizes body KNOWledge and uNcertainty modeling to compensate for insufficient 3D supervisions. KNOWN exploits a comprehensive set of generic body constraints derived from well-established body knowledge. These generic constraints precisely and explicitly characterize the reconstruction plausibility and enable 3D reconstruction models to be trained without any 3D data. Moreover, existing methods typically use images from multiple datasets during training, which can result in data noise (e.g., inconsistent joint annotation) and data imbalance (e.g., minority images representing unusual poses or captured from challenging camera views). KNOWN solves these problems through a novel probabilistic framework that models both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty. Aleatoric uncertainty is encoded in a robust Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) training loss, while epistemic uncertainty is used to guide model refinement. Experiments demonstrate that KNOWN's body reconstruction outperforms prior weakly-supervised approaches, particularly on the challenging minority images.
authors: Yufei Zhang, Hanjing Wang, Jeffrey O. Kephart, Qiang Ji ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9020-9032

title: 大胆而谨慎:通过谨慎激进的协作释放个性化联邦学习的潜力
title_en: Bold but Cautious: Unlocking the Potential of Personalized Federated Learning through Cautiously Aggressive Collaboration
abstract: 个性化联邦学习(PFL)通过允许每个客户端在与其他客户端协作时训练个性化模型,减轻了客户端间非独立同分布(non-IID)数据的影响。在PFL中,一个关键问题是决定客户端的哪些参数应本地化或与其他客户端共享。当前主流方法通常将所有对non-IID数据敏感的层(如分类器层)都进行个性化处理。这种做法的合理性在于,本地化易受non-IID数据影响的参数可避免协作可能带来的负面影响。然而,我们认为这种做法在协作中过于保守。例如,对于某个客户端而言,即使其参数易受non-IID数据影响,通过与具有相似数据分布的客户端共享这些参数仍能获得收益。这一观察强调了在确定PFL中应本地化的参数时,不仅需要考虑对non-IID数据的敏感性,还需考虑数据分布的相似性。本文提出了一种新颖的PFL客户端协作指南。与现有禁止所有敏感参数协作的方法不同,我们的指南允许客户端共享更多参数,从而提升模型性能。此外,我们提出了一种名为FedCAC的新PFL方法,该方法通过量化指标评估每个参数对non-IID数据的敏感性,并据此谨慎选择协作伙伴。实验结果表明,FedCAC使客户端能够共享更多参数,相较于现有最先进方法在客户端分布多样化的场景中表现出更优性能。
abstract_en: Personalized federated learning (PFL) reduces the impact of non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data among clients by allowing each client to train a personalized model when collaborating with others. A key question in PFL is to decide which parameters of a client should be localized or shared with others. In current mainstream approaches, all layers that are sensitive to non-IID data (such as classifier layers) are generally personalized. The reasoning behind this approach is understandable, as localizing parameters that are easily influenced by non-IID data can prevent potential negative effects of collaboration. However, we believe that this approach is too conservative for collaboration. For example, for a certain client, even if its parameters are easily influenced by non-IID data, it can still benefit by sharing these parameters with clients having similar data distribution. This observation emphasizes the importance of considering not only the sensitivity to non-IID data but also the similarity of data distribution when determining which parameters should be localized in PFL. This paper introduces a novel guideline for client collaboration in PFL. Unlike existing approaches that prohibit all collaboration of sensitive parameters, our guideline allows clients to share more parameters with others, leading to improved model performance. Additionally, we propose a new PFL method named FedCAC, which employs a quantitative metric to evaluate each parameter's sensitivity to non-IID data and carefully selects collaborators based on this evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that FedCAC enables clients to share more parameters with others, resulting in superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, particularly in scenarios where clients have diverse distributions.
authors: Xinghao Wu, Xuefeng Liu, Jianwei Niu, Guogang Zhu, Shaojie Tang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19375-19384

title: 基于几何引导跨视图变换器提升三自由度地面到卫星相机定位精度
title_en: Boosting 3-DoF Ground-to-Satellite Camera Localization Accuracy via Geometry-Guided Cross-View Transformer
abstract: 基于图像检索的跨视图定位方法常因数据库卫星图像的采样密度有限而导致相机位姿估计非常粗略。本文提出一种方法,通过估计地面图像与其匹配/检索到的卫星图像之间的相对旋转和位移,提升地面相机的定位与姿态精度。我们的方法设计了一种几何引导的跨视图变换器,结合传统几何方法和可学习的跨视图变换器的优势,将地面视角观测映射到俯视视角。在合成的俯视视角和观测到的卫星特征图基础上,我们构建了一个具有强全局信息嵌入能力的神经姿态优化器,以估计二者之间的相对旋转。在对齐旋转后,我们开发了一种不确定性引导的空间相关性,生成车辆位置的概率图,从而确定相对位移。实验结果表明,我们的方法显著优于现有技术。值得注意的是,在跨视图KITTI数据集上,车辆横向姿态限制在真实值(GT)1米范围内的可能性从35.54%提升至76.44%,车辆姿态限制在真实值1度范围内的可能性从19.64%提升至99.10%。
abstract_en:
Image retrieval-based cross-view localization methods often lead to very coarse camera pose estimation, due to the limited sampling density of the database satellite images. In this paper, we propose a method to increase the accuracy of a ground camera's location and orientation by estimating the relative rotation and translation between the ground-level image and its matched/retrieved satellite image.
 Our approach designs a geometry-guided cross-view transformer that combines the benefits of conventional geometry and learnable cross-view transformers to map the ground-view observations to an overhead view. 
 Given the synthesized overhead view and observed satellite feature maps, we construct a neural pose optimizer with strong global information embedding ability to estimate the relative rotation between them. After aligning their rotations, we develop an uncertainty-guided spatial correlation to generate a probability map of the vehicle locations, from which the relative translation can be determined.
 Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art. Notably, the likelihood of restricting the vehicle lateral pose to be within 1m of its Ground Truth (GT) value on the cross-view KITTI dataset has been improved from 35.54% to 76.44%, and the likelihood of restricting the vehicle orientation to be within 1 degree of its GT value has been improved from 19.64% to 99.10%.
authors: Yujiao Shi, Fei Wu, Akhil Perincherry, Ankit Vora, Hongdong Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21516-21526

title: 基于梯度相关性攻击提升对抗迁移性
title_en: Boosting Adversarial Transferability via Gradient Relevance Attack
abstract: 大量对抗攻击研究揭示了深度神经网络(DNNs)的脆弱性,其中难以察觉的扰动会导致输出发生剧烈变化。在多种攻击方法中,基于梯度的攻击方法因其强大性和易实现性而引发对DNNs安全问题的广泛关注。然而,在黑盒设置下,现有基于梯度的攻击方法在突破具有防御技术的DNN模型时面临诸多困难,尤其是对抗训练模型。为提升对抗样本的迁移性,本文探讨了生成对抗样本过程中对抗扰动像素正负号波动现象,并提出了一种巧妙的梯度相关性攻击(Gradient Relevance Attack, GRA)。具体而言,提出了两种梯度相关性框架以更有效地利用输入邻域信息,可自适应校正更新方向。随后通过衰减指标调整每次迭代的更新步长以抑制波动。在ILSVRC 2012验证集子集上的实验结果有力验证了GRA的有效性。进一步地,GRA在腾讯云和百度AI云上的攻击成功率分别达到68.7%和64.8%,进一步表明GRA能够生成具备跨数据集和模型架构迁移能力的对抗样本。代码已开源于https://github.com/RYC-98/GRA。
abstract_en: Plentiful adversarial attack researches have revealed the fragility of deep neural networks (DNNs), where the imperceptible perturbations can cause drastic changes in the output. Among the diverse types of attack methods, gradient-based attacks are powerful and easy to implement, arousing wide concern for the security problem of DNNs. However, under the black-box setting, the existing gradient-based attacks have much trouble in breaking through DNN models with defense technologies, especially those adversarially trained models. To make adversarial examples more transferable, in this paper, we explore the fluctuation phenomenon on the plus-minus sign of the adversarial perturbations' pixels during the generation of adversarial examples, and propose an ingenious Gradient Relevance Attack (GRA). Specifically, two gradient relevance frameworks are presented to better utilize the information in the neighborhood of the input, which can correct the update direction adaptively. Then we adjust the update step at each iteration with a decay indicator to counter the fluctuation. Experiment results on a subset of the ILSVRC 2012 validation set forcefully verify the effectiveness of GRA. Furthermore, the attack success rates of 68.7% and 64.8% on Tencent Cloud and Baidu AI Cloud further indicate that GRA can craft adversarial examples with the ability to transfer across both datasets and model architectures. Code is released at https://github.com/RYC-98/GRA.
authors: Hegui Zhu, Yuchen Ren, Xiaoyan Sui, Lianping Yang, Wuming Jiang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4741-4750

title: 基于图引导混合匹配的少样本动作识别增强方法
title_en: Boosting Few-shot Action Recognition with Graph-guided Hybrid Matching
abstract: 类原型构建与匹配是少样本动作识别的核心方面。先前方法主要聚焦于设计时空关系建模模块或复杂的时序对齐算法。尽管取得了有希望的结果,但它们忽视了类原型构建与匹配的价值,导致在每个任务中识别相似类别时表现不佳。本文提出GgHM,一种基于图引导混合匹配的新框架。具体而言,我们在类原型构建过程中通过图神经网络的指导学习任务导向的特征,显式优化类内和类间特征相关性。随后,我们设计了一种混合匹配策略,结合帧级和元组级匹配以分类具有多变量风格的视频。我们还提出了一种可学习的密集时序建模模块,以增强视频特征的时序表示,为匹配过程建立更坚实的基础。GgHM在多个少样本数据集上对其他具有挑战性的基线模型表现出持续改进,证明了我们方法的有效性。代码将在https://github.com/jiazheng-xing/GgHM公开。
abstract_en: Class prototype construction and matching are core aspects of few-shot action recognition. Previous methods mainly focus on designing spatiotemporal relation modeling modules or complex temporal alignment algorithms. Despite the promising results, they ignored the value of class prototype construction and matching, leading to unsatisfactory performance in recognizing similar categories in every task. In this paper, we propose GgHM, a new framework with Graph-guided Hybrid Matching. Concretely, we learn task-oriented features by the guidance of a graph neural network during class prototype construction, optimizing the intra- and inter-class feature correlation explicitly. Next, we design a hybrid matching strategy, combining frame-level and tuple-level matching to classify videos with multivariate styles. We additionally propose a learnable dense temporal modeling module to enhance the video feature temporal representation to build a more solid foundation for the matching process. GgHM shows consistent improvements over other challenging baselines on several few-shot datasets, demonstrating the effectiveness of our method. The code will be publicly available at https://github.com/jiazheng-xing/GgHM.
authors: Jiazheng Xing, Mengmeng Wang, Yudi Ruan, Bofan Chen, Yaowei Guo, Boyu Mu, Guang Dai, Jingdong Wang, Yong Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1740-1750

title: 基于平滑尾数据分步学习提升长尾目标检测
title_en: Boosting Long-tailed Object Detection via Step-wise Learning on Smooth-tail Data
abstract: 现实世界数据往往遵循长尾分布,类别不平衡导致训练过程中头部类别占据主导地位。本文提出一种令人沮丧地简单但有效的分步学习框架,逐步增强模型对长尾数据集所有类别的检测能力。具体而言,我们构建平滑尾数据,使类别长尾分布平滑衰减以纠正对头部类别的偏倚。我们首先在完整长尾数据上预训练模型以保持所有类别间的可区分性。随后,我们在头部类别主导的重放数据上微调预训练模型的类别无关模块,获得具有改进决策边界的头部类别专家模型。最后,我们在尾部类别主导的重放数据上训练统一模型,并通过迁移头部类别专家模型的知识以确保所有类别的准确检测。在长尾数据集LVIS v0.5和LVIS v1.0上的大量实验验证了我们方法的优越性,其中使用ResNet-50主干网络时AP指标从27.0%提升至30.3%,尤其是稀有类别从15.5%提升至24.9%。基于ResNet-101主干网络的最优模型可达到30.7% AP,优于所有使用相同主干网络的现有检测器。
abstract_en: Real-world data tends to follow a long-tailed distribution, where the class imbalance results in dominance of the head classes during training. In this paper, we propose a frustratingly simple but effective step-wise learning framework to gradually enhance the capability of the model in detecting all categories of long-tailed datasets. Specifically, we build smooth-tail data where the long-tailed distribution of categories decays smoothly to correct the bias towards head classes. We pre-train a model on the whole long-tailed data to preserve discriminability between all categories. We then fine-tune the class-agnostic modules of the pre-trained model on the head class dominant replay data to get a head class expert model with improved decision boundaries from all categories. Finally, we train a unified model on the tail class dominant replay data while transferring knowledge from the head class expert model to ensure accurate detection of all categories. Extensive experiments on long-tailed datasets LVIS v0.5 and LVIS v1.0 demonstrate the superior performance of our method, where we can improve the AP with ResNet-50 backbone from 27.0% to 30.3% AP, and especially for the rare categories from 15.5% to 24.9% AP. Our best model using ResNet-101 backbone can achieve 30.7% AP, which suppresses all existing detectors using the same backbone.
authors: Na Dong, Yongqiang Zhang, Mingli Ding, Gim Hee Lee ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6940-6949

title: 通过自适应梯度调制提升多模态模型性能
title_en: Boosting Multi-modal Model Performance with Adaptive Gradient Modulation
abstract: 尽管多模态学习领域持续快速发展,近期研究揭示了标准联合训练范式的不足。他们将联合训练模型次优性能归因于模态竞争现象。现有工作尝试通过调节训练过程来改进联合训练模型。尽管这些方法有效,但仅适用于晚期融合模型。更重要的是,模态竞争的机制仍未被深入探索。本文首先提出一种自适应梯度调制方法,可提升采用各种融合策略的多模态模型性能。大量实验表明,我们的方法超越了所有现有调制方法。此外,为定量理解模态竞争及其调制方法有效性的机制,我们引入了一种新颖的度量指标来衡量竞争强度。该指标基于单模态概念,设计了一个函数以表示模态无竞争状态。通过系统性研究,我们的结果验证了直觉:调制鼓励模型依赖更具信息量的模态。此外,我们发现联合训练模型通常存在一个竞争较弱的偏好模态,但该偏好模态无需主导其他模态。我们的代码将在https://github.com/lihong2303/AGM_ICCV2023发布。
abstract_en: While the field of multi-modal learning keeps growing fast, the deficiency of the standard joint training paradigm has become clear through recent studies. They attribute the sub-optimal performance of the jointly trained model to the modality competition phenomenon. Existing works attempt to improve the jointly trained model by modulating the training process. Despite their effectiveness, those methods can only apply to late fusion models. More importantly, the mechanism of the modality competition remains unexplored. In this paper, we first propose an adaptive gradient modulation method that can boost the performance of multi-modal models with various fusion strategies. Extensive experiments show that our method surpasses all existing modulation methods. Furthermore, to have a quantitative understanding of the modality competition and the mechanism behind the effectiveness of our modulation method, we introduce a novel metric to measure the competition strength. This metric is built on the mono-modal concept, a function that is designed to represent the competition-less state of a modality. Through systematic investigation, our results confirm the intuition that the modulation encourages the model to rely on the more informative modality. In addition, we find that the jointly trained model typically has a preferred modality on which the competition is weaker than other modalities. However, this preferred modality need not dominate others. Our code will be available at https://github.com/lihong2303/AGM_ICCV2023.
authors: Hong Li, Xingyu Li, Pengbo Hu, Yinuo Lei, Chunxiao Li, Yi Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22214-22224

title: 基于软对比学习和一体化分类器的跨域新类别发现增强
title_en: Boosting Novel Category Discovery Over Domains with Soft Contrastive Learning and All in One Classifier
abstract: 无监督域适应(UDA)在将标注丰富的源域知识迁移到标注稀缺的目标域中已被证明非常有效。然而,目标域中存在额外的新类别促使了开放集域适应(ODA)和通用域适应(UNDA)的发展。现有ODA和UNDA方法将所有新类别视为单一统一的未知类,并尝试在训练过程中检测该类。然而,我们发现域方差会导致无监督数据增强中出现更显著的视图噪声,这会降低对比学习(CL)的有效性,并使模型在新类别发现中过度自信。为解决这些问题,提出了一种名为Soft-contrastive All-in-one Network(SAN)的框架用于ODA和UNDA任务。SAN包含一种基于数据增强的软对比学习(SCL)损失,用于微调主干网络以实现特征迁移,并采用更符合人类直觉的一体化分类器(AIO)以提升新类发现能力。SCL损失减弱了数据增强视图噪声问题在域迁移任务中被放大的负面影响。AIO分类器克服了当前主流闭集和开集分类器的过度自信问题。可视化和消融实验验证了所提创新的有效性。此外,大量实验结果表明,SAN在ODA和UNDA任务中均优于现有最先进方法。
abstract_en: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) has proven to be highly effective in transferring knowledge from a label-rich source domain to a label-scarce target domain. However, the presence of additional novel categories in the target domain has led to the development of open-set domain adaptation (ODA) and universal domain adaptation (UNDA). Existing ODA and UNDA methods treat all novel categories as a single, unified unknown class and attempt to detect it during training. However, we found that domain variance can lead to more significant view-noise in unsupervised data augmentation, which affects the effectiveness of contrastive learning (CL) and causes the model to be overconfident in novel category discovery. To address these issues, a framework nameded Soft-contrastive All-in-one Network (SAN) is proposed for ODA and UNDA tasks. SAN includes a novel data-augmentation-based soft contrastive learning (SCL) loss to fine-tune the backbone for feature transfer and a more human-intuitive classifier to improve new class discovery capability. The SCL loss weakens the adverse effects of the data augmentation view-noise problem which is amplified in domain transfer tasks. The All-in-One (AIO) classifier overcomes the overconfidence problem of current mainstream closed-set and open-set classifiers. Visualization and ablation experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed innovations. Furthermore, extensive experiment results on ODA and UNDA show that SAN outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods.
authors: Zelin Zang, Lei Shang, Senqiao Yang, Fei Wang, Baigui Sun, Xuansong Xie, Stan Z. Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11858-11867

title: 弱监督音频-视觉视频解析中的正样本片段增强
title_en: Boosting Positive Segments for Weakly-Supervised Audio-Visual Video Parsing
abstract: 本文针对弱监督音频-视觉视频解析(AVVP)问题,旨在对可听或可见的事件进行时间定位并将其分类到已知事件类别中。这是一个具有挑战性的任务,因为在训练时仅能获得视频级事件标签,而在评估时需要预测片段级事件标签。现有基于多实例学习(MIL)的方法通过在片段级预测上使用注意力池化形式进行建模。这些方法仅优化满足弱监督约束的最判别性片段子集,从而遗漏了正样本片段的识别。为解决这一问题,我们专注于提高视频中检测到的正样本片段比例。为此,我们将视频中的正样本片段数量建模为潜在变量,并证明其可建模为片段级预测的泊松二项分布,且可精确计算。鉴于缺乏细粒度监督,我们提出一种期望最大化方法,通过最大化证据下界(ELBO)来学习模型参数。我们迭代估计视频中的最小正样本片段并对其进行优化以捕获更多正样本片段。我们在AVVP任务上进行了大量实验以评估所提方法的有效性,结果清楚表明与现有方法相比,该方法能捕获更多正样本片段。此外,我们在时间动作定位(TAL)任务上的实验验证了该方法在类似MIL任务中的泛化潜力。
abstract_en: In this paper, we address the problem of weakly supervised Audio-Visual Video Parsing (AVVP), where the goal is to temporally localize events that are audible or visible and simultaneously classify them into known event categories. This is a challenging task, as we only have access to the video-level event labels during training but need to predict event labels at the segment level during evaluation. Existing multiple-instance learning (MIL) based methods use a form of attentive pooling over segment-level predictions. These methods only optimize for a subset of most discriminative segments that satisfy the weak-supervision constraints, which miss identifying positive segments. To address this, we focus on improving the proportion of positive segments detected in a video. To this end, we model the number of positive segments in a video as a latent variable and show that it can be modeled as Poisson binomial distribution over segment-level predictions, which can be computed exactly. Given the absence of fine-grained supervision, we propose an Expectation-Maximization approach to learn the model parameters by maximizing the evidence lower bound (ELBO). We iteratively estimate the minimum positive segments in a video and refine them to capture more positive segments. We conducted extensive experiments on AVVP tasks to evaluate the effectiveness of our proposed approach, and the results clearly demonstrate that it increases the number of positive segments captured compared to existing methods. Additionally, our experiments on Temporal Action Localization (TAL) demonstrate the potential of our method for generalization to similar MIL tasks.
authors: Kranthi Kumar Rachavarapu, Rajagopalan A. N. ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10192-10202

title: 从显式类别嵌入视角提升语义分割
title_en: Boosting Semantic Segmentation from the Perspective of Explicit Class Embeddings
abstract: 语义分割是计算机视觉任务,其将每个图像像素与标签关联。现代方法倾向于将类别嵌入引入语义分割以深度利用类别语义,并将监督类别掩码视为最终预测。本文探索了类别嵌入的机制,获得一个洞见:可基于监督类别掩码刻意生成更显式且有意义的类别嵌入。基于此观察,我们提出ECENet(显式类别嵌入网络),一种新的分割范式,在与多阶段图像特征交互过程中显式获取并增强类别嵌入。在此基础上,我们重新审视传统解码过程,探索分割掩码与类别嵌入之间的逆向信息流。此外,为确保主干网络特征的可区分性和信息性,我们提出特征重建模块,将内在与多样分支结合以确保特征的多样性与冗余性相统一。实验表明,我们的ECENet在ADE20K数据集上以更少的计算成本超越同类方法,并在PASCAL-Context数据集上取得新SOTA结果。代码将发布于https://gitee.com/mindspore/models和https://github.com/Carol-lyh/ECENet。
abstract_en: Semantic segmentation is a computer vision task that associates a label with each pixel in an image. Modern approaches tend to introduce class embeddings into semantic segmentation for deeply utilizing category semantics, and regard supervised class masks as final predictions. In this paper, we explore the mechanism of class embeddings and have an insight that more explicit and meaningful class embeddings can be generated based on class masks purposely. Following this observation, we propose ECENet, a new segmentation paradigm, in which class embeddings are obtained and enhanced explicitly during interacting with multi-stage image features. Based on this, we revisit the traditional decoding process and explore inverted information flow between segmentation masks and class embeddings. Furthermore, to ensure the discriminability and informativity of features from backbone, we propose a Feature Reconstruction module, which combines intrinsic and diverse branches together to ensure the concurrence of diversity and redundancy in features. Experiments show that our ECENet outperforms its counterparts on the ADE20K dataset with much less computational cost and achieves new state-of-the-art results on PASCAL-Context dataset. The code will be released at https://gitee.com/mindspore/models and https://github.com/Carol-lyh/ECENet.
authors: Yuhe Liu, Chuanjian Liu, Kai Han, Quan Tang, Zengchang Qin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 821-831

title: 基于部分通道移位的单图像超分辨率提升
title_en: Boosting Single Image Super-Resolution via Partial Channel Shifting
abstract: 尽管深度学习近年来显著推动了单图像超分辨率(SISR)的发展,但随着模型规模的持续增长,进一步提升SR性能仍面临瓶颈。因此,构建高效SISR模型以提升特征表示有效性成为该领域的热点。本文提出一种简单且通用的特征增强方法,可有效提升SR模型性能,命名为部分通道移位(PCS)。具体而言,该方法受视频理解中时间移位的启发,沿空间维度移动部分通道,从而在几乎零成本下扩大有效感受野并增强特征多样性。此外,该方法可作为即插即用组件集成到现有模型中,无需额外网络参数和计算开销即可提升性能。然而,使用PCS调节特征时仍存在一些问题,如移位方向和幅度、移位通道比例及模式等。我们对这些问题施加技术约束以简化通用通道移位。大量且全面的实验表明,PCS确实扩大了有效感受野,增强了特征多样性,从而高效提升SR恢复性能,并可为现有模型带来显著性能增益。
abstract_en: Although deep learning has significantly facilitated the progress of single image super-resolution (SISR) in recent years, it still hits bottlenecks to further improve SR performance with the continuous growth of model scale. Therefore, one of the hotspots in the field is to construct efficient SISR models by elevating the effectiveness of feature representation. In this work, we present a straightforward and generic approach for feature enhancement that can effectively promote the performance of SR models, dubbed partial channel shifting (PCS). Specifically, it is inspired by the temporal shifting in video understanding and displaces part of the channels along the spatial dimensions, thus allowing the effective receptive field to be amplified and the feature diversity to be augmented at almost zero cost. Also, it can be assembled into off-the-shelf models as a plug-and-play component for performance boosting without extra network parameters and computational overhead. However, regulating the features with PCS encounters some issues, like shifting directions and amplitudes, proportions, and patterns of shifted channels, etc. We impose some technical constraints on the issues to simplify the general channel shifting. Extensive and throughout experiments illustrate that the PCS indeed enlarges the effective receptive field, augments the feature diversity for efficiently enhancing SR recovery, and can endow obvious performance gains to existing models.
authors: Xiaoming Zhang, Tianrui Li, Xiaole Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13223-13232

title: 从分布、相关性与放大倍数视角提升全切片图像分类
title_en: Boosting Whole Slide Image Classification from the Perspectives of Distribution, Correlation and Magnification
abstract: 基于Bag的多实例学习(MIL)方法已成为全切片图像(WSI)分类的主流方法。然而,仍存在三个重要问题尚未完全解决:(1)正样本袋中正实例比例较低时易受大量负实例影响;(2)病理图像局部与全局特征之间的相关性尚未被充分建模;(3)不同放大倍数间缺乏有效的信息交互。本文提出MILBooster,一种强大的双尺度多阶段MIL框架,从分布、相关性与放大倍数三个视角解决上述问题。具体而言,针对问题(1),我们提出一种即插即用的样本袋过滤器,有效提升正样本袋的正实例比例。针对问题(2),我们提出一种新型基于窗口的Transformer架构PiceBlock,用于建模病理图像局部与全局特征之间的相关性。针对问题(3),我们提出双分支架构处理不同放大倍数,并设计信息交互模块Scale Mixer实现高效的信息交互。我们在三个数据集上的四个临床WSI分类任务中进行了大量实验,MILBooster在所有任务中均取得了新的SOTA性能。代码将公开。
abstract_en: Bag-based multiple instance learning (MIL) methods have become the mainstream for Whole Slide Image (WSI) classification. However, there are still three important issues that have not been fully addressed: (1) positive bags with a low positive instance ratio are prone to the influence of a large number of negative instances; (2) the correlation between local and global features of pathology images has not been fully modeled; and (3) there is a lack of effective information interaction between different magnifications. In this paper, we propose MILBooster, a powerful dual-scale multi-stage MIL framework to address these issues from the perspectives of distribution, correlation, and magnification. Specifically, to address issue (1), we propose a plug-and-play bag filter that effectively increases the positive instance ratio of positive bags. For issue (2), we propose a novel window-based Transformer architecture called PiceBlock to model the correlation between local and global features of pathology images. For issue (3), we propose a dual-branch architecture to process different magnifications and design an information interaction module called Scale Mixer for efficient information interaction between them. We conducted extensive experiments on four clinical WSI classification tasks using three datasets. MILBooster achieved new state-of-the-art performance on all these tasks. Codes will be available.
authors: Linhao Qu, Zhiwei Yang, Minghong Duan, Yingfan Ma, Shuo Wang, Manning Wang, Zhijian Song ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21463-21473

title: 基于自洽约束的自引导运动预测框架
title_en: Bootstrap Motion Forecasting With Self-Consistent Constraints
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的框架,通过自洽约束(MISC)实现运动预测的自引导。运动预测任务旨在通过结合过去的空间和时间信息来预测车辆的未来轨迹。MISC的关键设计是提出的双一致性约束,该约束在训练过程中通过空间和时间扰动对预测轨迹进行正则化。此外,为建模运动预测中的多模态特性,我们设计了一种新颖的自集成方案,以获取精确的教师目标,通过多模态监督强制执行自约束。在多个教师目标的显式约束下,我们观察到预测性能的显著提升。在Argoverse运动预测基准和Waymo Open Motion数据集上的大量实验表明,MISC显著优于当前最优方法。由于所提出的策略具有通用性且易于集成到其他运动预测方法中,我们还证明了所提出的方案能够持续提升现有方法的预测性能。
abstract_en: We present a novel framework to bootstrap Motion forecasting with Self-consistent Constraints (MISC). The motion forecasting task aims at predicting future trajectories of vehicles by incorporating spatial and temporal information from the past. A key design of MISC is the proposed Dual Consistency Constraints that regularize the predicted trajectories under spatial and temporal perturbation during training. Also, to model the multi-modality in motion forecasting, we design a novel self-ensembling scheme to obtain accurate teacher targets to enforce the self-constraints with multi-modality supervision. With explicit constraints from multiple teacher targets, we observe a clear improvement in the prediction performance. Extensive experiments on the Argoverse motion forecasting benchmark and Waymo Open Motion dataset show that MISC significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art methods. As the proposed strategies are general and can be easily incorporated into other motion forecasting approaches, we also demonstrate that our proposed scheme consistently improves the prediction performance of several existing methods.
authors: Maosheng Ye, Jiamiao Xu, Xunnong Xu, Tengfei Wang, Tongyi Cao, Qifeng Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8504-8514

title: 从预训练语言模型中借用知识:一种新的数据高效视觉学习范式
title_en: Borrowing Knowledge From Pre-trained Language Model: A New Data-efficient Visual Learning Paradigm
abstract: 现实应用中视觉模型的发展受到注释数据稀缺的挑战,这促使人们采用半监督学习等数据高效视觉学习技术。然而,普遍使用的交叉熵监督存在局限性,其仅关注类别区分而忽视概念间的语义关联,最终导致稀缺标注数据的次优利用。为解决这一问题,本文提出了一种新颖的方法,旨在通过语言知识实现数据高效的视觉学习。所提出的BorLan方法借助现成的预训练语言模型,这些模型已从大规模语料库中提取出丰富的语义,以弥补视觉训练中因标注有限导致的语义缺陷。具体而言,我们设计了一个分布对齐目标,通过语言知识引导视觉模型学习语义感知且领域无关的表示。该范式的一个显著优势在于其灵活结合各类视觉与语言模型的能力。在半监督学习、单域泛化和少样本学习上的大量实验验证了其有效性。
abstract_en: The development of vision models for real-world applications is hindered by the challenge of annotated data scarcity, which has necessitated the adoption of data-efficient visual learning techniques such as semi-supervised learning. Unfortunately, the prevalent cross-entropy supervision is limited by its focus on category discrimination while disregarding the semantic connection between concepts, which ultimately results in the suboptimal exploitation of scarce labeled data. To address this issue, this paper presents a novel approach that seeks to leverage linguistic knowledge for data-efficient visual learning. The proposed approac, BorLan, Borrows knowledge from off-the-shelf pretrained Language models that are already endowed with rich semantics extracted from large corpora, to compensate the semantic deficiency due to limited annotation in visual training. Specifically, we design a distribution alignment objective, which guides the vision model to learn both semantic-aware and domain-agnostic representations for the task through linguistic knowledge. One significant advantage of this paradigm is its flexibility in combining various visual and linguistic models. Extensive experiments on semi-supervised learning, single domain generalization and few-shot learning validate its effectiveness.
authors: Wenxuan Ma, Shuang Li, JinMing Zhang, Chi Harold Liu, Jingxuan Kang, Yulin Wang, Gao Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18786-18797

title: 多样性与真实感并重:雨图像生成中的物理属性与风格对齐
title_en: Both Diverse and Realism Matter: Physical Attribute and Style Alignment for Rainy Image Generation
abstract: 尽管在合成数据下的去雨任务已取得显著进展,但真实雨场景下的去雨仍是一个具有挑战性的问题,这主要归因于合成数据与真实数据之间的领域差距。此外,收集和标注多样化的真实雨图像的困难也阻碍了该领域的发展。因此,我们尝试从雨图像生成(RIG)的角度推动真实雨去除。现有RIG方法主要侧重于多样性而忽视真实感,或侧重真实感而忽略多样性。为解决这一困境,我们提出了一种物理对齐与可控生成网络(PCGNet),用于生成多样化且真实感强的雨图像。我们的核心思想是同时利用合成数据的属性可控性与真实数据的外观真实感。具体而言,我们设计了一个统一框架,从合成和真实数据中解耦背景、雨属性和外观风格。随后,我们通过一种新颖的半监督权重移动策略对属性进行协同对齐,并采用显式分布建模方法对真实雨风格进行建模。进一步地,我们将这些对齐因素整合到生成模型中,实现从属性到真实雨的物理可控映射,并通过图像级和属性级一致性损失确保生成结果的一致性。大量实验表明,PCGNet能够有效生成具有吸引力的雨图像,显著提升了现有去雨方法在合成和真实场景下的性能。
abstract_en: Although considerable progress has been made in the deraining task under synthetic data, it is still a tough problem under real rain scenes, due to the domain gap between the synthetic and real data. Besides, difficulties in collecting and labeling diverse real rain images hinder the progress of this field. Consequently, we attempt to promote real rain removal from rain image generation (RIG) perspective. Existing RIG methods mainly focus on diversity but miss realistic, or the realistic but neglect diversity of the generation. To solve this dilemma, we propose a physical alignment and controllable generation network (PCGNet) for diverse and realistic rain generation. Our key idea is to simultaneously utilize the controllability of attributes from synthetic and the realism of appearance from real data. Specifically, we devise a unified framework to disentangle background, rain attributes, and appearance style from synthetic and real data. Then we collaboratively align the factors with a novel semi-supervised weight moving strategy for attribute, an explicit distribution modeling method for real rain style. Furthermore, we pack these aligned factors into the generation model, achieving physical controllable mapping from the attributes to real rainy with image-level and attribute-level consistency loss. Extensive experiments show that PCGNet can effectively generate appealing rainy results, which sifnicantltly improve the performance under synthetic and real scenes for all existing deraining methods.
authors: Changfeng Yu, Shiming Chen, Yi Chang, Yibing Song, Luxin Yan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12387-12397

title: 边界感知分而治之:一种基于扩散的无监督阴影去除方法
title_en: Boundary-Aware Divide and Conquer: A Diffusion-Based Solution for Unsupervised Shadow Removal
abstract: 近期深度学习方法在阴影去除任务中取得了显著成果。然而,大多数监督方法依赖于在大量阴影与无阴影图像对上进行训练,这需要繁琐的标注工作,可能导致模型泛化能力不足。实际上,阴影仅造成图像的部分退化,而非阴影区域提供了可用于无监督学习的丰富结构信息。本文提出了一种基于扩散的无监督阴影去除新方法,分别建模阴影、非阴影及其边界区域。我们采用融合非退化信息的预训练无条件扩散模型生成自然的无阴影图像。扩散模型可通过利用相邻非退化上下文信息恢复边界区域的清晰结构,但因非退化上下文的隔离而无法处理内部阴影区域。因此,我们进一步提出阴影不变内在分解模块,通过挖掘阴影区域的潜在反射率以保持扩散采样过程中的结构一致性。在公开的阴影去除数据集上的大量实验表明,所提方法相比现有无监督方法取得了显著提升,甚至在某些情况下可与部分监督方法相媲美。
abstract_en: Recent deep learning methods have achieved superior results in shadow removal. However, most of these supervised methods rely on training over a huge amount of shadow and shadow-free image pairs, which require laborious annotations and may end up with poor model generalization. Shadows, in fact, only form partial degradation in images, while their non-shadow regions provide rich structural information potentially for unsupervised learning. In this paper, we propose a novel diffusion-based solution for unsupervised shadow removal, which separately models the shadow, non-shadow, and their boundary regions. We employ a pretrained unconditional diffusion model fused with non-corrupted information to generate the natural shadow-free image. While the diffusion model can restore the clear structure in the boundary region by utilizing its adjacent non-corrupted contextual information, it fails to address the inner shadow area due to the isolation of the non-corrupted contexts. Thus we further propose a Shadow-Invariant Intrinsic Decomposition module to exploit the underlying reflectance in the shadow region to maintain structural consistency during the diffusive sampling. Extensive experiments on the publicly available shadow removal datasets show that the proposed method achieves a significant improvement compared to existing unsupervised methods, and even is comparable with some existing supervised methods.
authors: Lanqing Guo, Chong Wang, Wenhan Yang, Yufei Wang, Bihan Wen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13045-13054

title: 基于框的弱监督与无监督定位任务细化方法
title_en: Box-based Refinement for Weakly Supervised and Unsupervised Localization Tasks
abstract: 已有研究表明,训练基于框的检测器网络可以提升弱监督和无监督方法的定位性能。此外,我们拓展了这一认识,证明这些检测器可用于改进原始网络,为后续进展奠定基础。为此,我们在原始网络输出的基础上训练检测器,而非直接使用图像数据,并应用合适的损失反向传播。我们的研究发现,在"what is where by looking"任务中,短语定位性能显著提升,同时为无监督目标发现提供了多种方法。
abstract_en: It has been established that training a box-based detector network can enhance the localization performance of weakly supervised and unsupervised methods. Moreover, we extend this understanding by demonstrating that these detectors can be utilized to improve the original network, paving the way for further advancements. To accomplish this, we train the detectors on top of the network output instead of the image data and apply suitable loss backpropagation. Our findings reveal a significant improvement in phrase grounding for the "what is where by looking" task, as well as various methods of unsupervised object discovery.
authors: Eyal Gomel, Tal Shaharbany, Lior Wolf ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16044-16054

title: BoxDiff:无需训练的文本到图像合成与框约束扩散方法
title_en: BoxDiff: Text-to-Image Synthesis with Training-Free Box-Constrained Diffusion
abstract: 近期文本到图像扩散模型展现出生成高质量图像的惊人能力。然而,研究者主要聚焦于仅使用文本提示的图像合成方式。尽管一些工作尝试利用其他模态作为条件,但需要大量配对数据(例如框/掩码图像对)和微调时间来培养模型。由于此类数据获取耗时且劳动密集,且受限于封闭集,这可能成为开放世界应用的瓶颈。本文关注用户提供的最简单条件形式,例如框或涂鸦。为缓解上述问题,我们提出一种无需训练的方法,通过给定空间条件控制合成图像中的对象和上下文。具体设计了三种空间约束,即内框约束、外框约束和角落约束,并无缝集成到扩散模型的去噪步骤中,无需额外训练和大量标注布局数据。大量实验结果表明,所提出的约束能够在保持扩散模型高保真和多样化概念覆盖能力的同时,控制图像中呈现的内容和位置。代码已公开在https://github.com/showlab/BoxDiff。
abstract_en: Recent text-to-image diffusion models have demonstrated an astonishing capacity to generate high-quality images. However, researchers mainly studied the way of synthesizing images with only text prompts. While some works have explored using other modalities as conditions, considerable paired data, e.g., box/mask-image pairs, and fine-tuning time are required for nurturing models. As such paired data is time-consuming and labor-intensive to acquire and restricted to a closed set, this potentially becomes the bottleneck for applications in an open world. This paper focuses on the simplest form of user-provided conditions, e.g., box or scribble. To mitigate the aforementioned problem, we propose a training-free method to control objects and contexts in the synthesized images adhering to the given spatial conditions. Specifically, three spatial constraints, i.e., Inner-Box, Outer-Box, and Corner Constraints, are designed and seamlessly integrated into the denoising step of diffusion models, requiring no additional training and massive annotated layout data. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed constraints can control what and where to present in the images while retaining the ability of Diffusion models to synthesize with high fidelity and diverse concept coverage. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/showlab/BoxDiff.
authors: Jinheng Xie, Yuexiang Li, Yawen Huang, Haozhe Liu, Wentian Zhang, Yefeng Zheng, Mike Zheng Shou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7452-7461

title: BoxSnake:基于边界框监督的多边形实例分割
title_en: BoxSnake: Polygonal Instance Segmentation with Box Supervision
abstract: 基于边界框的实例分割因其仅需简单的边界框标注而非成本高昂的掩膜或多边形标注而受到广泛关注。然而,现有的基于边界框的实例分割模型主要集中在基于掩膜的框架上。我们提出了一种新的端到端训练技术,称为BoxSnake,首次仅使用边界框标注实现有效的多边形实例分割。我们的方法包含两个损失函数:(1)一种基于点的单目损失,通过约束预测多边形的边界框以实现粗粒度分割;(2)一种距离感知的成对损失,鼓励预测多边形适应物体边界。与基于掩膜的弱监督方法相比,BoxSnake进一步缩小了预测分割与边界框之间的性能差距,并在Cityscapes数据集上展现出显著优势。
abstract_en:
Box-supervised instance segmentation has gained much attention as it requires only simple box annotations instead of costly mask or polygon annotations. However, existing box-supervised instance segmentation models mainly focus on mask-based frameworks. We propose a new end-to-end training technique, termed BoxSnake, to achieve effective polygonal instance segmentation using only box annotations for the first time. Our method consists of two loss functions: (1) a point-based unary loss that constrains the bounding box of predicted polygons to achieve coarse-grained segmentation; and (2) a distance-aware pairwise loss that encourages the predicted polygons to fit the object boundaries. 
 Compared with the mask-based weakly-supervised methods, BoxSnake further reduces the performance gap between the predicted segmentation and the bounding box, and shows significant superiority on the Cityscapes dataset.
authors: Rui Yang, Lin Song, Yixiao Ge, Xiu Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 766-776

title: 打破常识:WHOOPS!一个合成与组合图像的视觉-语言基准测试
title_en: Breaking Common Sense: WHOOPS! A Vision-and-Language Benchmark of Synthetic and Compositional Images
abstract: 怪异、非常规和诡异的图像会引发观察者的兴趣,因为它们挑战了我们的常识。例如,在2022年世界杯期间发布的一张图片中,著名足球明星利昂内尔·梅西和克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多正在下棋,这种画面戏谑地违背了我们对他们竞争应在足球场发生的预期。人类可以轻松识别并解释这些非常规图像,但人工智能模型是否能做到?我们引入了WHOOPS!,一个全新的视觉常识基准数据集。该数据集包含由设计师使用公开可用的图像生成工具(如Midjourney)有意创造的挑战常识的图像。我们针对该数据集提出了多项任务,除图像描述生成、跨模态匹配和视觉问答外,我们还引入了一个困难的解释生成任务,要求模型识别并解释为何某张图像显得异常。我们的实验结果表明,当前最先进的模型如GPT3和BLIP2在WHOOPS!上的表现仍落后于人类水平。我们希望本数据集能激励开发具备更强视觉常识推理能力的AI模型。
abstract_en:
Weird, unusual, and uncanny images pique the curiosity of observers because they challenge commonsense. For example, an image released during the 2022 world cup depicts the famous soccer stars Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo playing chess, which playfully violates our expectation that their competition should occur on the football field.
 Humans can easily recognize and interpret these unconventional images, but can AI models do the same?
 We introduce WHOOPS!, a new dataset and benchmark for visual commonsense. The dataset is comprised of purposefully commonsense-defying images created by designers using publicly-available image generation tools like Midjourney.
 We consider several tasks posed over the dataset.
 In addition to image captioning, cross-modal matching, and visual question answering, we introduce a difficult explanation generation task, where models must identify and explain why a given image is unusual. Our results show that state-of-the-art models such as GPT3 and BLIP2 still lag behind human performance on WHOOPS!.
 We hope our dataset will inspire the development of AI models with stronger visual commonsense reasoning abilities.
authors: Nitzan Bitton-Guetta, Yonatan Bitton, Jack Hessel, Ludwig Schmidt, Yuval Elovici, Gabriel Stanovsky, Roy Schwartz ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2616-2627

title: 打破时间一致性:利用图像模型生成视频通用对抗扰动
title_en: Breaking Temporal Consistency: Generating Video Universal Adversarial Perturbations Using Image Models
abstract: 随着深度学习模型在视频分析中的应用日益广泛,此类模型对对抗攻击的脆弱性已成为亟需关注的问题。特别是通用对抗扰动(Universal Adversarial Perturbation, UAP),因其单个扰动即可误导深度学习模型对整个数据集的处理而构成重大威胁。我们提出了一种基于图像数据和图像模型的新型视频UAP方法,这使我们能够利用现有丰富的图像数据和基于图像模型的研究成果应用于视频领域。然而,图像模型在分析视频的时间特性方面存在局限性,而这是成功实施视频攻击的关键。为解决这一挑战,我们引入了打破时间一致性(Breaking Temporal Consistency, BTC)方法,这是首次尝试利用图像模型将时间信息纳入视频攻击的方案。我们的目标是生成与原始视频模式相反的对抗视频。具体而言,BTC-UAP通过最小化视频中相邻帧之间的特征相似性来实现这一目标。我们的方法简单但能有效攻击未见过的视频模型。此外,该方法适用于不同长度的视频,并且对时间偏移具有鲁棒性。在ImageNet、UCF-101和Kinetics-400等多个数据集上,我们的方法在有效性方面均超越现有方法。
abstract_en:
As video analysis using deep learning models becomes more widespread, the vulnerability of such models to adversarial attacks is becoming a pressing concern. 
 In particular, Universal Adversarial Perturbation (UAP) poses a significant threat, as a single perturbation can mislead deep learning models on entire datasets. 
 We propose a novel video UAP using image data and image model. 
 This enables us to take advantage of the rich image data and image model-based studies available for video applications. 
 However, there is a challenge that image models are limited in their ability to analyze the temporal aspects of videos, which is crucial for a successful video attack. 
 To address this challenge, we introduce the Breaking Temporal Consistancy (BTC) method, which is the first attempt to incorporate temporal information into video attacks using image models. 
 We aim to generate adversarial videos that have opposite patterns to the original. Specifically, BTC-UAP minimizes the feature similarity between neighboring frames in videos. 
 Our approach is simple but effective at attacking unseen video models. 
 Additionally, it is applicable to videos of varying lengths and invariant to temporal shifts. 
 Our approach surpasses existing methods in terms of effectiveness on various datasets, including ImageNet, UCF-101, and Kinetics-400.
authors: Hee-Seon Kim, Minji Son, Minbeom Kim, Myung-Joon Kwon, Changick Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4325-4334

title: 突破文本条件下的三维运动合成限制:基于详细描述的精细运动合成模型
title_en: Breaking The Limits of Text-conditioned 3D Motion Synthesis with Elaborative Descriptions
abstract: 鉴于其广泛应用,生成基于文本描述的三维人体运动受到越来越多的关注。与大多数先前工作不同,这些工作将动作视为单一实体且只能生成简单动作的短序列,我们提出EMS,一种基于详细自然语言描述的精细运动合成模型。该模型通过将复杂动作分解为原子动作组,生成自然流畅的长序列运动。同时,它理解原子动作级别的属性(如运动方向、速度和身体部位),并使用户能够通过独立设置属性和时间的已知原子动作序列,生成未见过的复杂动作序列。我们在KIT Motion-Language和BABEL基准测试中评估了该方法,结果显著优于所有先前的最先进方法。
abstract_en: Given its wide applications, there is increasing focus on generating 3D human motions from textual descriptions. Differing from the majority of previous works, which regard actions as single entities and can only generate short sequences for simple motions, we propose EMS, an elaborative motion synthesis model conditioned on detailed natural language descriptions. It generates natural and smooth motion sequences for long and complicated actions by factorizing them into groups of atomic actions. Meanwhile, it understands atomic-action level attributes (e.g., motion direction, speed, and body parts) and enables users to generate sequences of unseen complex actions from unique sequences of known atomic actions with independent attribute settings and timings applied. We evaluate our method on the KIT Motion-Language and BABEL benchmarks, where it outperforms all previous state-of-the-art with noticeable margins.
authors: Yijun Qian, Jack Urbanek, Alexander G. Hauptmann, Jungdam Won ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2306-2316

title: 弥合密集目标检测中蒸馏的跨任务协议不一致性
title_en: Bridging Cross-task Protocol Inconsistency for Distillation in Dense Object Detection
abstract: 知识蒸馏(KD)在密集目标检测中学习紧凑模型展现出潜力。然而,常用的基于softmax的蒸馏方法忽略了单个类别的绝对分类得分。因此,蒸馏损失的最优解并不必然导致密集目标检测器的最优学生分类得分。这种跨任务协议不一致性在密集目标检测中尤为关键,因为前景类别极度不平衡。为解决蒸馏与分类之间的协议差异问题,我们提出了一种针对密集目标检测的新型蒸馏方法,其采用跨任务一致的协议。对于分类蒸馏,我们通过将教师和学生模型的分类logit图表示为多个二分类图,并对每个图应用二分类蒸馏损失,来解决跨任务协议不一致性问题。对于定位蒸馏,我们设计了一种基于IoU的定位蒸馏损失,该损失与特定网络结构无关,可与现有定位蒸馏损失进行比较。我们的方法简单而有效,实验结果证明其优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) has shown potential for learning compact models in dense object detection. However, the commonly used softmax-based distillation ignores the absolute classification scores for individual categories. Thus, the optimum of the distillation loss does not necessarily lead to the optimal student classification scores for dense object detectors. This cross-task protocol inconsistency is critical, especially for dense object detectors, since the foreground categories are extremely imbalanced. To address the issue of protocol differences between distillation and classification, we propose a novel distillation method with cross-task consistent protocols, tailored for the dense object detection. For classification distillation, we address the cross-task protocol inconsistency problem by formulating the classification logit maps in both teacher and student models as multiple binary-classification maps and applying a binary-classification distillation loss to each map. For localization distillation, we design an IoU-based Localization Distillation Loss that is free from specific network structures and can be compared with existing localization distillation losses. Our proposed method is simple but effective, and experimental results demonstrate its superiority over existing methods.
authors: Longrong Yang, Xianpan Zhou, Xuewei Li, Liang Qiao, Zheyang Li, Ziwei Yang, Gaoang Wang, Xi Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17175-17184

title: 连接视觉与语言编码器:用于指称图像分割的参数高效调优
title_en: Bridging Vision and Language Encoders: Parameter-Efficient Tuning for Referring Image Segmentation
abstract: 参数高效调优(PET)因其在减少需更新参数数量的同时保持竞争力性能并提供更好的硬件资源节省而受到广泛关注。尽管已取得显著进展,现有研究主要聚焦于单模态任务或简单分类任务,较少关注密集预测任务及不同模态间的交互。因此,本文对指称图像分割中的高效调优问题进行了深入研究。首先,考虑到双编码器间缺乏交互,我们设计了一种新型适配器Bridger以促进跨模态信息交换。该模块在保持预训练模型原始参数不变的前提下,同时注入视觉特定归纳偏置和任务特定信息。其次,我们设计了轻量级解码器用于指称图像分割,以进一步对齐视觉与语言特征。为进行全面评估并推动后续研究,我们在多个具有挑战性的基准数据集上评估了所提框架。实验结果验证了所提方法的有效性。仅更新1.61%至3.38%的参数,所提框架在性能上达到与现有基于相同主干网络的全量微调方法相当甚至更优的表现。
abstract_en: Parameter efficient tuning (PET) has received considerable attention owing to its applicability to reduce the number of parameters that need to be updated while maintaining competitive performance and providing better hardware resource savings. Although substantial progress has been made, most existing studies mainly focus on either single-modal tasks or simple classification tasks, with few works paying attention to the dense prediction tasks and the interaction between different modalities. Therefore, in this paper, we do an in-depth investigation of the efficient tuning problem on referring image segmentation. First, considering the absence of interaction between the dual encoder, we design a novel adapter named Bridger to facilitate the exchange of cross-modal information. This module also plays a role in injecting vision-specific inductive biases and task-specific information into the pre-trained model while keeping its original parameters fixed. Second, we design a lightweight decoder for referring image segmentation to make further alignment on visual and linguistic features. To perform a comprehensive assessment and promote further research, we evaluate the proposed framework on several challenging benchmarks. Experimental results illustrate the effectiveness of our approach. Updating only 1.61% to 3.38% parameters, the proposed framework gains comparable or even superior performance compared to existing full fine-tuning methods that utilize the same backbone.
authors: Zunnan Xu, Zhihong Chen, Yong Zhang, Yibing Song, Xiang Wan, Guanbin Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17503-17512

title: 让剪贴画栩栩如生
title_en: Bring Clipart to Life
abstract: 自StyleGAN诞生以来,人脸编辑技术得到了显著发展。尽管先前的研究探索了多种交互方法,如素描和示例照片,但这些方法在表达能力和通用性方面存在局限。本文提出了一种新的交互方法,通过抽象剪贴画引导编辑,该剪贴画由一组简单的语义部分组成,使用户能够通过简单点击控制多张人脸照片。然而,由于彩色人脸照片与数据有限的抽象剪贴画之间存在较大的领域差距,这是一项具有挑战性的任务。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了基于StyleGAN的框架ClipFaceShop。其核心思想是利用W+潜在代码编码的丰富且解耦的视觉特征,并创建一种新的轻量级选择性特征适配器,以预测可修改路径以生成目标输出照片。由于不存在成对标注数据进行训练,我们设计了一组损失函数以提供监督信号来学习可修改路径。实验结果表明,ClipFaceShop生成的逼真且忠实的人脸照片与参考剪贴画共享相同的面部属性。我们证明了ClipFaceShop支持多样化的剪贴画风格,甚至可以处理自由手绘草图形式。
abstract_en: The development of face editing has been boosted since the birth of StyleGAN. While previous works have explored different interactive methods, such as sketching and exemplar photos, they have been limited in terms of expressiveness and generality. In this paper, we propose a new interaction method by guiding the editing with abstract clipart, composed of a set of simple semantic parts, allowing users to control across face photos with simple clicks. However, this is a challenging task given the large domain gap between colorful face photos and abstract clipart with limited data. To solve this problem, we introduce a framework called ClipFaceShop built on top of StyleGAN. The key idea is to take advantage of W+ latent code encoded rich and disentangled visual features, and create a new lightweight selective feature adaptor to predict a modifiable path toward the target output photo. Since no pairwise labeled data exists for training, we design a set of losses to provide supervision signals for learning the modifiable path. Experimental results show that ClipFaceShop generates realistic and faithful face photos, sharing the same facial attributes as the reference clipart. We demonstrate that ClipFaceShop supports clipart in diverse styles, even in form of a free-hand sketch.
authors: Nanxuan Zhao, Shengqi Dang, Hexun Lin, Yang Shi, Nan Cao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23341-23350

title: 跨越时空的桥梁:野外壁画的破坏与修复
title_en: Building Bridge Across the Time: Disruption and Restoration of Murals In the Wild
abstract: 本文聚焦于壁画修复任务,旨在检测壁画中的受损区域并自动进行修复。与传统图像修复任务(如内外/盲绘画和图像翻新)不同,受损壁画面临更复杂的退化问题。然而,现有壁画修复方法和数据集仍主要关注简单的遮挡退化。这种显著的差距阻碍了壁画修复在实际场景中的应用。为填补这一空白,本文提出一个系统框架,用于模拟受损壁画的物理过程,并提供一个新的壁画修复基准数据集。受限于数据合成过程的简化,先前的壁画修复方法在我们提出的数据集上表现不佳。为解决这一问题,我们提出注意力扩散框架(ADF)用于该具有挑战性的任务。在该框架中,设计了损伤注意力图模块以估计损伤程度。针对缺陷的多样性,我们提出一系列损失函数以自适应选择修复策略。最终,实验结果验证了所提框架在壁画合成与修复方面的有效性。
abstract_en: In this paper, we focus on the mural-restoration task, which aims to detect damaged regions in the mural and repaint them automatically. Different from traditional image restoration tasks like in/out/blind-painting and image renovation, the corrupted mural suffers from more complicated degradation. However, existing mural-restoration methods and datasets still focus on simple degradation like masking. Such a significant gap prevents mural-restoration from being applied to real scenarios. To fill this gap, in this work, we propose a systematic framework to simulate the physical process for damaged murals and provide a new benchmark dataset for mural-restoration. Limited by the simplification of the data synthesis process, the previous mural-restoration methods suffer from poor performance in our proposed dataset. To handle this problem, we propose the Attention Diffusion Framework (ADF) for this challenging task. Within the framework, a damage attention map module is proposed to estimate the damage extent. Facing the diversity of defects, we propose a series of loss functions to choose repair strategies adaptively. Finally, experimental results support the effectiveness of the proposed framework in terms of both mural synthesis and restoration.
authors: Huiyang Shao, Qianqian Xu, Peisong Wen, Peifeng Gao, Zhiyong Yang, Qingming Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20259-20269

title: 基于层次感知特征聚合的视觉Transformer构建
title_en: Building Vision Transformers with Hierarchy Aware Feature Aggregation
abstract: 得益于注意力机制出色的全局建模能力,视觉Transformer在许多计算机视觉任务中取得了优于卷积网络(ConvNet)的成果。然而,在生成层次化特征图时,Transformer仍采用卷积网络的特征聚合方案。这导致图像网格区域的语义信息在特征聚合后出现混淆,使得注意力机制难以准确建模全局关系。为解决这一问题,我们提出层次感知特征聚合框架(HAFA)。HAFA在语义信息较弱的浅层自适应增强局部特征提取能力,同时在深层聚合具有相似语义的图像块。聚合后的清晰语义信息使注意力机制能够更准确地在语义层面建模全局信息。大量实验表明,采用HAFA框架后,在图像分类、目标检测和语义分割任务中相对于基线模型取得了显著提升。
abstract_en: Thanks to the excellent global modeling capability of attention mechanisms, the Vision Transformer has achieved better results than ConvNet in many computer tasks. However, in generating hierarchical feature maps, the Transformer still adopts the ConvNet feature aggregation scheme. This leads to the problem that the semantic information of the grid area of image becomes confused after feature aggregation, making it difficult for attention to accurately model global relationships. To address this, we propose the Hierarchy Aware Feature Aggregation framework (HAFA). HAFA enhances the extraction of local features adaptively in shallow layers where semantic information is weak, while is able to aggregate patches with similar semantics in deep layers. The clear semantic information of the aggregated patches, enables the attention mechanism to more accurately model global information at the semantic level. Extensive experiments show that after using the HAFA framework, significant improvements have been achieved relative to the baseline models in image classification, object detection, and semantic segmentation tasks.
authors: Yongjie Chen, Hongmin Liu, Haoran Yin, Bin Fan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5908-5918

title: 构建最优团队:使用子模转移性估计方法选择源模型集合
title_en: Building a Winning Team: Selecting Source Model Ensembles using a Submodular Transferability Estimation Approach
abstract: 估计公开可用的预训练模型向目标任务的迁移性近年来在迁移学习任务中占据了重要地位。现有研究提出了允许用户在无需单独微调每个模型的情况下,从预训练模型池中选择一个模型的指标,并明确识别出一个模型。随着可用预训练模型数量的增长和模型集合的流行,研究多个源模型对给定目标任务的迁移性也变得至关重要。现有少数研究在这样的多源集合设置中仅使用分类层的输出来研究迁移性,忽视了可能的领域或任务不匹配。此外,他们忽略了选择源模型时最重要的因素,即集合中模型之间的凝聚力,这会影响集合预测的性能和置信度。为了解决这些不足,我们提出了一种基于最优运输的子模迁移性度量方法(OSBORN),用于估计模型集合向下游任务的迁移性。OSBORN综合考虑图像领域差异、任务差异以及集合中模型的凝聚力,以提供可靠的迁移性估计。我们在图像分类和语义分割任务中评估了OSBORN的性能。我们的实验设置包括28个源数据集、11个目标数据集、5种模型架构和2种预训练方法。我们将方法与当前最先进的MS-LEEP和E-LEEP指标进行基准测试,并通过所提出的方法一致超越了它们。
abstract_en: Estimating the transferability of publicly available pre-trained models to a target task has assumed an important place for transfer learning tasks in recent years. Existing efforts propose metrics that allow a user to choose one model from a pool of pre-trained models without having to fine-tune each model individually and identify one explicitly. With the growth in the number of available pre-trained models and the popularity of model ensembles, it also becomes essential to study the transferability of multiple-source models for a given target task. The few existing efforts study transferability in such multi-source ensemble settings using just the outputs of the classification layer and neglect possible domain or task mismatch. Moreover, they overlook the most important factor while selecting the source models, viz., the cohesiveness factor between them, which can impact the performance and confidence in the prediction of the ensemble. To address these gaps, we propose a novel Optimal tranSport-based suBmOdular tRaNsferability metric (OSBORN) to estimate the transferability of an ensemble of models to a downstream task. OSBORN collectively accounts for image domain difference, task difference, and cohesiveness of models in the ensemble to provide reliable estimates of transferability. We gauge the performance of OSBORN on both image classification and semantic segmentation tasks. Our setup includes 28 source datasets, 11 target datasets, 5 model architectures, and 2 pre-training methods. We benchmark our method against current state-of-the-art metrics MS-LEEP and E-LEEP, and outperform them consistently using the proposed approach.
authors: Vimal K B, Saketh Bachu, Tanmay Garg, Niveditha Lakshmi Narasimhan, Raghavan Konuru, Vineeth N Balasubramanian ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11609-11620

title: Building3D: 一个用于从点云中学习屋顶结构的城市级数据集和基准
title_en: Building3D: A Urban-Scale Dataset and Benchmarks for Learning Roof Structures from Point Clouds
abstract: 从LiDAR点云进行城市建模是计算机视觉、计算机图形学、摄影测量和遥感领域的重要课题。三维城市模型已广泛应用于智慧城市、自主导航、城市规划和制图等领域。然而,现有的三维建模数据集主要关注家具或汽车等常见物体。缺乏建筑数据集已成为将深度学习技术应用于城市建模等特定领域的主要障碍。本文提出一个城市级数据集,包含超过16万座建筑及其对应的点云、网格和线框模型,覆盖爱沙尼亚16个城市约998平方公里区域。我们广泛评估了包括手工特征和深度特征方法在内的最先进算法性能。实验结果表明,Building3D存在高类内方差、数据不平衡和大规模噪声等挑战。Building3D是首个也是最大的城市级建筑建模基准,允许比较监督学习和自监督学习方法。我们相信,Building3D将促进未来关于城市建模、空中路径规划、网格简化和语义/部件分割等领域的研究。
abstract_en: Urban modeling from LiDAR point clouds is an important topic in computer vision, computer graphics, photogrammetry and remote sensing. 3D city models have found a wide range of applications in smart cities, autonomous navigation, urban planning and mapping etc. However, existing datasets for 3D modeling mainly focus on common objects such as furniture or cars. Lack of building datasets has become a major obstacle for applying deep learning technology to specific domains such as urban modeling. In this paper, we present a urban-scale dataset consisting of more than 160 thousands buildings along with corresponding point clouds, mesh and wire-frame models, covering 16 cities in Estonia about 998 Km2. We extensively evaluate performance of state-of-the-art algorithms including handcrafted and deep feature based methods. Experimental results indicate that Building3D has challenges of high intra-class variance, data imbalance and large-scale noises. The Building3D is the first and largest urban-scale building modeling benchmark, allowing a comparison of supervised and self-supervised learning methods. We believe that our Building3D will facilitate future research on urban modeling, aerial path planning, mesh simplification, and semantic/part segmentation etc.
authors: Ruisheng Wang, Shangfeng Huang, Hongxin Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20076-20086

title: C2F2NeUS:级联成本棱柱融合用于高保真与可泛化神经表面重建
title_en: C2F2NeUS: Cascade Cost Frustum Fusion for High Fidelity and Generalizable Neural Surface Reconstruction
abstract: 当前有新兴研究尝试将多视角立体视觉(MVS)与神经隐式表面(NIS)两种流行的3D框架结合,特别关注少样本/稀疏视角设置。本文提出了一种新颖的集成方案,将多视角立体视觉与神经符号距离函数表示相结合,有望克服两种方法的局限性。MVS通过每视角深度估计和跨视角融合生成精确的表面,而NIS依赖于统一的坐标体积。基于此策略,我们提出构建每视角成本棱柱以实现更精细的几何估计,随后融合跨视角棱柱并估计隐式符号距离函数,以解决由噪声和孔洞引起的表面重建伪影。我们进一步应用级联棱柱融合策略,有效捕捉全局-局部信息和结构一致性。最后,我们应用级联采样和伪几何损失以增强两种架构之间的强集成。大量实验表明,我们的方法能够重建鲁棒的表面,并优于现有最先进方法。
abstract_en: There is an emerging effort to combine the two popular 3D frameworks using Multi-View Stereo (MVS) and Neural Implicit Surfaces (NIS) with a specific focus on the few-shot / sparse view setting. In this paper, we introduce a novel integration scheme that combines the multi-view stereo with neural signed distance function representations, which potentially overcomes the limitations of both methods. MVS uses per-view depth estimation and cross-view fusion to generate accurate surfaces, while NIS relies on a common coordinate volume. Based on this strategy, we propose to construct per-view cost frustum for finer geometry estimation, and then fuse cross-view frustums and estimate the implicit signed distance functions to tackle artifacts that are due to noise and holes in the produced surface reconstruction. We further apply a cascade frustum fusion strategy to effectively captures global-local information and structural consistency. Finally, we apply cascade sampling and a pseudo-geometric loss to foster stronger integration between the two architectures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method reconstructs robust surfaces and outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods.
authors: Luoyuan Xu, Tao Guan, Yuesong Wang, Wenkai Liu, Zhaojie Zeng, Junle Wang, Wei Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18291-18301

title: C2ST:面向连续手语识别的跨模态上下文化序列转换
title_en: C2ST: Cross-Modal Contextualized Sequence Transduction for Continuous Sign Language Recognition
abstract: 连续手语识别(CSLR)旨在将未剪辑视频中的手语动作转录为书面文字或手语词。主流的CSLR框架包含用于视觉表征学习的空间模块、聚合帧序列局部与全局时序信息的时间模块,以及将视频特征与手语词序列对齐的连接主义时序分类(CTC)损失。不幸的是,手语词序列中隐含的语言先验在整个建模过程中被忽略。此外,对齐学习中进一步忽略了手语词的上下文化,因为CTC假设手语词之间相互独立。本文提出了一种面向CSLR的跨模态上下文化序列转换(C2ST)方法,有效将手语词序列知识融入视频表征学习和序列转换过程。具体而言,我们引入了针对CSLR的跨模态上下文学习框架,其中通过语言模型提取手语词序列的语义特征,并通过循环机制与视觉特征进行视频建模。此外,我们引入了融合手语词序列上下文信息的上下文化序列转换损失,在标签预测中无需假设手语词之间的独立性。我们的方法在三个广泛使用的大型手语识别数据集Phoenix-2014、Phoenix-2014-T和CSL-Daily上均取得新SOTA。在CSL-Daily数据集上,我们的方法相比最佳发表结果实现了4.9%的词错误率(WER)绝对提升。
abstract_en: Continuous Sign Language Recognition (CSLR) aims to transcribe the signs of an untrimmed video into written words or glosses. The mainstream framework for CSLR consists of a spatial module for visual representation learning, a temporal module aggregating the local and global temporal information of frame sequence, and the connectionist temporal classification (CTC) loss, which aligns video features with gloss sequence. Unfortunately, the language prior implicit in the gloss sequence is ignored throughout the modeling process. Furthermore, the contextualization of glosses is further ignored in alignment learning, as CTC makes an independence assumption between glosses. In this paper, we propose a Cross-modal Contextualized Sequence Transduction (C2ST) for CSLR, which effectively incorporates the knowledge of gloss sequence into the process of video representation learning and sequence transduction. Specifically, we introduce a cross-modal context learning framework for CSLR, in which the linguistic features of gloss sequences is extracted by a language model, and recurrently integrate with visual features for video modelling. Moreover, we introduce the contextualized sequence transduction loss that incorporates the contextual information of gloss sequences in label prediction, without making any independence assumptions between the glosses. Our method sets the new state of the art on three widely used large-scale sign language recognition datasets: Phoenix-2014, Phoenix-2014-T, and CSL-Daily. On CSL-Daily, our approach achieves an absolute gain of 4.9% WER compared to the best published results.
authors: Huaiwen Zhang, Zihang Guo, Yang Yang, Xin Liu, De Hu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21053-21062

title: CAD-Estate:RGB视频中的大规模CAD模型标注
title_en: CAD-Estate: Large-scale CAD Model Annotation in RGB Videos
abstract: 我们提出了一种方法,用于对包含复杂多物体场景的视频进行标注,该方法使用全局一致的3D物体表示。我们从数据库中为每个物体标注一个CAD模型,并通过9自由度姿态变换将其放置在场景的3D坐标系中。我们的方法是半自动的,适用于常见的RGB视频,无需深度传感器。许多步骤由系统自动完成,人类执行的任务简单、定义明确且仅需有限的3D推理。这使得该方法适合众包,从而使我们能够通过标注YouTube上的房地产视频构建大规模数据集。我们的数据集CAD-Estate提供了20k视频的3D表示中放置的12k独特CAD模型的101k实例。与现有最大的真实场景CAD模型标注数据集Scan2CAD相比,CAD-Estate的实例数量多7倍,独特CAD模型数量多4倍。我们展示了在CAD-Estate上预训练Mask2CAD模型对自动3D物体重建和姿态估计任务的优势,证明其在流行的Scan2CAD基准测试中实现了性能提升。该数据集可在https://github.com/google-research/cad-estate获取。
abstract_en:
We propose a method for annotating videos of complex multi-object scenes with a globally-consistent 3D representation of the objects. We annotate each object with a CAD model from a database, and place it in the 3D coordinate frame of the scene with a 9-DoF pose transformation. Our method is semi-automatic and works on commonly-available RGB videos, without requiring a depth sensor. Many steps are performed automatically, and the tasks performed by humans are simple, well-specified, and require only limited reasoning in 3D. This makes them feasible for crowd-sourcing and has allowed us to construct a large-scale dataset by annotating real-estate videos from YouTube. Our dataset CAD-Estate offers 101k instances of 12k unique CAD models placed in the 3D representations of 20k videos. In comparison to Scan2CAD, the largest existing dataset with CAD model annotations on real 
 scenes, CAD-Estate has 7x more instances and 4x more unique CAD models. We showcase the benefits of pre-training a Mask2CAD model on CAD-Estate for the task of automatic 
 3D object reconstruction and pose estimation, demonstrating that it leads to performance improvements on the popular Scan2CAD benchmark. The dataset is available at https://github.com/google-research/cad-estate.
authors: Kevis-Kokitsi Maninis, Stefan Popov, Matthias Nießner, Vittorio Ferrari ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20189-20199

title: CAFA:面向测试时适应的类感知特征对齐
title_en: CAFA: Class-Aware Feature Alignment for Test-Time Adaptation
abstract: 尽管深度学习取得了近期进展,深度神经网络在应用于与训练数据不同的新数据时仍会遭受性能退化。测试时适应(TTA)旨在通过在测试阶段对未标记数据进行模型适应来解决这一挑战。TTA可以应用于预训练网络,而无需修改其训练过程,使它们能够利用良好的源分布进行适应。一种可能的方法是将测试样本的表征空间对齐到源分布(即特征对齐)。然而,在TTA中进行特征对齐尤其具有挑战性,因为在适应过程中无法访问带标签的源数据。也就是说,模型没有机会以类区分的方式学习测试数据,这在其他适应任务(如无监督域适应)中是可行的,可以通过源数据上的监督损失实现。基于这一观察,我们提出了一种简单而有效的特征对齐损失,称为类感知特征对齐(CAFA),它同时 1)鼓励模型以类区分的方式学习目标表征,并 2)有效缓解测试时的分布偏移。我们的方法不需要任何超参数或额外损失,而这是先前方法所必需的。我们在6个不同的数据集上进行了大量实验,结果表明我们的方法始终优于现有基线。
abstract_en: Despite recent advancements in deep learning, deep neural networks continue to suffer from performance degradation when applied to new data that differs from training data. Test-time adaptation (TTA) aims to address this challenge by adapting a model to unlabeled data at test time. TTA can be applied to pretrained networks without modifying their training procedures, enabling them to utilize a well-formed source distribution for adaptation. One possible approach is to align the representation space of test samples to the source distribution (i.e., feature alignment). However, performing feature alignment in TTA is especially challenging in that access to labeled source data is restricted during adaptation. That is, a model does not have a chance to learn test data in a class-discriminative manner, which was feasible in other adaptation tasks (e.g., unsupervised domain adaptation) via supervised losses on the source data. Based on this observation, we propose a simple yet effective feature alignment loss, termed as Class-Aware Feature Alignment (CAFA), which simultaneously 1) encourages a model to learn target representations in a class-discriminative manner and 2) effectively mitigates the distribution shifts at test time. Our method does not require any hyper-parameters or additional losses, which are required in previous approaches. We conduct extensive experiments on 6 different datasets and show our proposed method consistently outperforms existing baselines.
authors: Sanghun Jung, Jungsoo Lee, Nanhee Kim, Amirreza Shaban, Byron Boots, Jaegul Choo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19060-19071

title: CAME:对比自动模型评估
title_en: CAME: Contrastive Automated Model Evaluation
abstract: 自动模型评估(AutoEval)框架探索在不依赖带标签测试集的情况下评估训练好的机器学习模型的可能性。尽管具有前景且取得了一些不错的结果,现有AutoEval方法严重依赖于计算未标记测试集与训练集之间的分布偏移。我们认为这种对训练集的依赖成为将该技术应用于实际机器学习开发的障碍。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新型AutoEval框架——对比自动模型评估(CAME),该框架无需涉及训练集。CAME的核心思想基于一种理论分析,将模型性能与对比损失联系起来。进一步地,通过广泛的实证验证,我们成功建立了两者之间的可预测关系,仅需在未标记/未见过的测试集上进行推导即可实现。所提出的框架CAME通过显著超越先前工作,建立了AutoEval领域的当前最优结果。
abstract_en:
The Automated Model Evaluation (AutoEval) framework entertains the possibility of evaluating a trained machine learning model without resorting to a labeled testing set.
 Despite the promise and some decent results, the existing AutoEval methods heavily rely on computing distribution shifts between the unlabelled testing set and the training set. 
 We believe this reliance on the training set becomes another obstacle in shipping this technology to real-world ML development.
 In this work, we propose Contrastive Automatic Model Evaluation (CAME), a novel AutoEval framework that is rid of involving training set in the loop.
 The core idea of CAME bases on a theoretical analysis which bonds the model performance with a contrastive loss.
 Further, with extensive empirical validation, we manage to set up a predictable relationship between the two, simply by deducing on the unlabeled/unseen testing set.
 The resulting framework CAME establishes a new SOTA results for AutoEval by surpassing prior work significantly.
authors: Ru Peng, Qiuyang Duan, Haobo Wang, Jiachen Ma, Yanbo Jiang, Yongjun Tu, Xiu Jiang, Junbo Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20121-20132

title: CASSPR:基于交叉注意力的单次扫描场景识别
title_en: CASSPR: Cross Attention Single Scan Place Recognition
