abstract: 基于点云(激光雷达)的场景识别是自主机器人或自动驾驶车辆的重要组成部分。当前最先进的性能是通过使用基于点或基于体素的结构对累积的激光雷达子图进行处理实现的。虽然基于体素的方法能够很好地整合多尺度的空间上下文,但它们无法表现出基于点方法的局部精度。因此,现有方法在稀疏单次扫描激光雷达中难以实现对细微几何特征的精细匹配。为克服这些局限性,我们提出CASSPR方法,通过交叉注意力变换器融合基于点和基于体素的方法。CASSPR利用稀疏体素分支提取和聚合低分辨率信息,并通过点级分支获取细粒度局部信息。CASSPR使用一个分支的查询来尝试匹配另一个分支的结构,确保两个分支都能提取点云的自包含描述符(而非由一个分支主导),但利用两者共同生成点云的全局描述符。大量实验表明,CASSPR在多个数据集(Oxford RobotCar、TUM、USyd)上显著超越了现有最先进方法。例如,在TUM数据集上,其AR@1达到85.6%,超越最强的先前模型15%。我们的代码已公开。
abstract_en: Place recognition based on point clouds (LiDAR) is an important component for autonomous robots or self-driving vehicles. Current SOTA performance is achieved on accumulated LiDAR submaps using either point-based or voxel-based structures. While voxel-based approaches nicely integrate spatial context across multiple scales, they do not exhibit the local precision of point-based methods. As a result, existing methods struggle with fine-grained matching of subtle geometric features in sparse single-shot LiDAR scans. To overcome these limitations, we propose CASSPR as a method to fuse point-based and voxel-based approaches using cross attention transformers. CASSPR leverages a sparse voxel branch for extracting and aggregating information at lower resolution and a point-wise branch for obtaining fine-grained local information. CASSPR uses queries from one branch to try to match structures in the other branch, ensuring that both extract self-contained descriptors of the point cloud (rather than one branch dominating), but using both to inform the output global descriptor of the point cloud. Extensive experiments show that CASSPR surpasses the state-of-the-art by a large margin on several datasets (Oxford RobotCar, TUM, USyd). For instance, it achieves AR@1 of 85.6% on the TUM dataset, surpassing the strongest prior model by  15%. Our code is publicly available.
authors: Yan Xia, Mariia Gladkova, Rui Wang, Qianyun Li, Uwe Stilla, João F Henriques, Daniel Cremers ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8461-8472

title: CBA: 通过持续偏差适配器改进在线持续学习
title_en: CBA: Improving Online Continual Learning via Continual Bias Adaptor
abstract: 在线持续学习(CL)旨在从非平稳数据流中学习新知识并巩固之前学习的知识。由于时间变化的训练设置,模型从变化的分布中学习时容易遗忘之前学习的知识,并偏向于新接收的任务。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种持续偏差适配器(CBA)模块,以增强分类器网络,使其在训练过程中能够适应灾难性分布变化,从而实现对之前学习任务的稳定巩固。在测试阶段,CBA模块可以移除,不会引入额外的计算成本和内存开销。我们从理论上揭示了所提方法能够有效缓解灾难性分布偏移的原因,并通过基于四种重放机制基线和三个公开持续学习基准的大量实验,实证验证了其有效性。
abstract_en: Online continual learning (CL) aims to learn new knowledge and consolidate previously learned knowledge from non-stationary data streams. Due to the time-varying training setting, the model learned from a changing distribution easily forgets the previously learned knowledge and biases towards the newly received task. To address this problem, we propose a Continual Bias Adaptor (CBA) module to augment the classifier network to adapt to catastrophic distribution change during training, such that the classifier network is able to learn a stable consolidation of previously learned tasks. In the testing stage, CBA can be removed which introduces no additional computation cost and memory overhead. We theoretically reveal the reason why the proposed method can effectively alleviate catastrophic distribution shifts, and empirically demonstrate its effectiveness through extensive experiments based on four rehearsal-based baselines and three public continual learning benchmarks.
authors: Quanziang Wang, Renzhen Wang, Yichen Wu, Xixi Jia, Deyu Meng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19082-19092

title: CC3D:基于布局的组合三维场景生成
title_en: CC3D: Layout-Conditioned Generation of Compositional 3D Scenes
abstract: 本文提出CC3D,这是一种条件生成模型,能够基于二维语义场景布局合成复杂的三维场景,利用单视角图像进行训练。不同于大多数现有仅适用于对齐单个物体的3D GANs,我们专注于生成包含多个物体的复杂场景,通过建模三维场景的组合性质。通过设计基于二维布局的三维合成方法,并实现具有更强几何归纳偏置的新三维场表示,我们创建了一个高效且高质量的3D GAN,同时允许更可控的生成过程。我们在合成3D-FRONT和真实世界KITTI-360数据集上的评估表明,与之前的工作相比,我们的模型生成的场景在视觉和几何质量上均有提升。
abstract_en: In this work, we introduce CC3D, a conditional generative model that synthesizes complex 3D scenes conditioned on 2D semantic scene layouts, trained using single-view images. Different from most existing 3D GANs that limit their applicability to aligned single objects, we focus on generating complex scenes with multiple objects, by modeling the compositional nature of 3D scenes. By devising a 2D layout-based approach for 3D synthesis and implementing a new 3D field representation with a stronger geometric inductive bias, we have created a 3D GAN that is both efficient and of high quality, while allowing for a more controllable generation process. Our evaluations on synthetic 3D-FRONT and real-world KITTI-360 datasets demonstrate that our model generates scenes of improved visual and geometric quality in comparison to previous works.
authors: Sherwin Bahmani, Jeong Joon Park, Despoina Paschalidou, Xingguang Yan, Gordon Wetzstein, Leonidas Guibas, Andrea Tagliasacchi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7171-7181

title: CDAC:基于Transformer的跨域注意力一致性在域自适应语义分割中的应用
title_en: CDAC: Cross-domain Attention Consistency in Transformer for Domain Adaptive Semantic Segmentation
abstract: 尽管Transformer在语义分割任务中显著提升了性能,但域自适应Transformer的研究仍不充分。我们发现域差距会导致自注意力机制产生不一致性。由于这种差距,Transformer可能关注到虚假区域或像素,从而降低目标域的准确性。我们提出跨域注意力一致性(CDAC),通过跨域注意力层在注意力图上进行适应,实现源域与目标域特征的共享。具体而言,我们通过在跨域注意力与自注意力模块的预测结果之间施加一致性约束,鼓励模型在注意力和输出层面实现跨域分布的一致性,即注意力层面和输出层面的对齐。同时,我们还在不同增强视角的注意力图之间施加一致性约束,进一步强化基于注意力的对齐。结合这两个组件,CDAC缓解了跨域注意力图的差异,并在无监督域适应设置下进一步提升了Transformer的性能。我们的方法在多个广泛使用的基准数据集上进行了评估,优于现有最先进的基线方法。当与两个竞争性的Transformer基模型结合时,在GTAV-to-Cityscapes任务中提升1.3和1.5个百分点(pp),在Synthia-to-Cityscapes任务中提升0.6 pp和2.9 pp。我们的代码将在https://github.com/wangkaihong/CDAC公开。
abstract_en: While transformers have greatly boosted performance in semantic segmentation, domain adaptive transformers are not yet well explored. We identify that the domain gap can cause discrepancies in self-attention. Due to this gap, the transformer attends to spurious regions or pixels, which deteriorates accuracy on the target domain. We propose Cross-Domain Attention Consistency (CDAC), to perform adaptation on attention maps using cross-domain attention layers that share features between source and target domains. Specifically, we impose consistency between predictions from cross-domain attention and self-attention modules to encourage similar distributions across domains in both the attention and output of the model, i.e., attention-level and output-level alignment. We also enforce consistency in attention maps between different augmented views to further strengthen the attention-based alignment. Combining these two components, CDAC mitigates the discrepancy in attention maps across domains and further boosts the performance of the transformer under unsupervised domain adaptation settings. Our method is evaluated on various widely used benchmarks and outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines, including GTAV-to-Cityscapes by 1.3 and 1.5 percent point (pp) and Synthia-to-Cityscapes by 0.6 pp and 2.9 pp when combining with two competitive Transformer-based backbones, respectively. Our code will be publicly available at https://github.com/wangkaihong/CDAC.
authors: Kaihong Wang, Donghyun Kim, Rogerio Feris, Margrit Betke ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11519-11529

title: CDFSL-V:面向视频的跨域少样本学习
title_en: CDFSL-V: Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning for Videos
abstract: 少样本视频动作识别是一种有效的方法,能够仅通过少量标注样本识别新类别,从而降低大规模视频数据集收集和标注的挑战。现有视频动作识别方法依赖于同一领域的大型标注数据集。然而,这种设置并不现实,因为新类别可能来自不同的数据域,这些域可能具有不同的空间和时间特征。源域与目标域之间的这种差异性可能带来显著挑战,使传统少样本动作识别技术失效。为解决这一问题,本文提出了一种新颖的跨域少样本视频动作识别方法,该方法利用自监督学习和课程学习来平衡源域和目标域的信息。具体而言,我们的方法采用基于掩码自编码器的自监督训练目标,以自监督方式从源域和目标域数据中进行学习。随后,渐进式课程平衡从源数据集中学习的判别信息与从目标域中学习的通用信息。初始阶段,我们的课程利用监督学习从源数据中学习类别判别特征。随着训练的进行,我们逐步转向学习目标域特定特征。我们提出渐进式课程,基于源域中的类别判别监督特征,鼓励目标域中丰富特征的涌现。我们在多个具有挑战性的基准数据集上评估了我们的方法,并证明我们的方法优于现有的跨域少样本学习技术。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Sarinda251/CDFSL-V获取
abstract_en:
Few-shot video action recognition is an effective approach to recognizing new categories with only a few labeled examples, thereby reducing the challenges associated with collecting and annotating large-scale video datasets. Existing methods in video action recognition rely on large labeled datasets from the same domain. However, this setup is not realistic as novel categories may come from different data domains that may have different spatial and temporal characteristics. This dissimilarity between the source and target domains can pose a significant challenge, rendering traditional few-shot action recognition techniques ineffective. To address this issue, in this work, we propose a novel cross-domain few-shot video action recognition method that leverages self-supervised learning and curriculum learning to balance the information from the source and target domains. To be particular, our method employs a masked autoencoder-based self-supervised training objective to learn from both source and target data in a self-supervised manner. Then a progressive curriculum balances learning the discriminative information from the source dataset with the generic information learned from the target domain. Initially, our curriculum utilizes supervised learning to learn class discriminative features from the source data. As the training progresses, we transition to learning target-domain-specific features. We propose a progressive curriculum to encourage the emergence of rich features in the target domain based on class discriminative supervised features in
 the source domain. We evaluate our method on several challenging benchmark datasets and demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing cross-domain few-shot learning techniques. Our code is available at https://github.com/Sarinda251/CDFSL-V
authors: Sarinda Samarasinghe, Mamshad Nayeem Rizve, Navid Kardan, Mubarak Shah ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11643-11652

title: CDUL:基于CLIP的无监督多标签图像分类方法
title_en: CDUL: CLIP-Driven Unsupervised Learning for Multi-Label Image Classification
abstract: 本文提出了一种基于CLIP的无监督学习方法,用于无需标注的多标签图像分类,包含初始化、训练和推理三个阶段。在初始化阶段,我们充分利用强大的CLIP模型,提出了一种新颖的方法,基于全局-局部图像-文本相似度聚合扩展CLIP以实现多标签预测。具体而言,我们将每张图像分割为片段,并利用CLIP生成整张图像(全局)及每个片段(局部)的相似度向量。随后引入相似度聚合器,利用全局和局部相似度向量。在训练阶段,使用聚合后的相似度得分作为初始伪标签,提出优化框架训练分类网络参数并优化未观测标签的伪标签。推理阶段仅使用分类网络预测输入图像的标签。大量实验表明,我们的方法在MS-COCO、PASCAL VOC 2007、PASCAL VOC 2012和NUS数据集上优于现有最先进的无监督方法,甚至达到弱监督分类方法的可比结果。
abstract_en: This paper presents a CLIP-based unsupervised learning method for annotation-free multi-label image classification, including three stages: initialization, training, and inference. At the initialization stage, we take full advantage of the powerful CLIP model and propose a novel approach to extend CLIP for multi-label predictions based on global-local image-text similarity aggregation. To be more specific, we split each image into snippets and leverage CLIP to generate the similarity vector for the whole image (global) as well as each snippet (local). Then a similarity aggregator is introduced to leverage the global and local similarity vectors. Using the aggregated similarity scores as the initial pseudo labels at the training stage, we propose an optimization framework to train the parameters of the classification network and refine pseudo labels for unobserved labels. During inference, only the classification network is used to predict the labels of the input image. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art unsupervised methods on MS-COCO, PASCAL VOC 2007, PASCAL VOC 2012, and NUS datasets and even achieves comparable results to weakly supervised classification methods.
authors: Rabab Abdelfattah, Qing Guo, Xiaoguang Li, Xiaofeng Wang, Song Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1348-1357

title: CFCG:基于交叉融合与轮廓引导监督的半监督语义分割
title_en: CFCG: Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation via Cross-Fusion and Contour Guidance Supervision
abstract: 当前最先进的半监督语义分割(SSSS)方法通常采用不同扰动下的多学习者之间的伪标签和一致性正则化。尽管性能表现良好,但仍存在诸多问题:(1)单一学习者的监督容易产生噪声,导致不可靠的一致性正则化;(2)现有基于像素级置信度的可靠性度量方法在训练过程中可能引发潜在误差累积。本文提出了一种新型SSSS框架,称为CFCG,通过结合交叉融合与轮廓引导监督来解决这些问题。具体而言,我们采用图像级和特征级扰动来扩展特征分布,从而推动一致性正则化的潜在极限。随后,提出两个特定模块以在严重相干扰动下实现有效的半监督学习。首先,交叉融合监督(CFS)机制利用多个学习者提升伪标签的质量。其次,我们引入自适应轮廓引导模块(ACGM)以有效识别伪标签中的不可靠空间区域。最终,我们的CFCG方法在PASCAL VOC 2012和Cityscapes数据集上分别在1/8协议下通过单学习者推理获得mIoU提升+1.40%、+0.89%,通过融合推理获得+1.85%、+1.33%,明显超越先前方法并达到当前最优水平。
abstract_en:
Current state-of-the-art semi-supervised semantic segmentation (SSSS) methods typically adopt pseudo labeling and consistency regularization between multiple learners with different perturbations. Although the performance is desirable, many issues remain: (1) supervisions from a single learner tend to be noisy which causes unreliable consistency regularization (2) existing pixel-wise confidence-score-based reliability measurement causes potential error accumulation as the training proceeds. In this paper, we propose a novel SSSS framework, called CFCG, which combines cross-fusion and contour guidance supervision to tackle these issues. 
 Concretely, we adopt both image-level and feature-level perturbations to expand feature distribution thus pushing the potential limits of consistency regularization. Then, two particular modules are proposed to enable effective semi-supervised learning under heavy coherent perturbations. Firstly, Cross-Fusion Supervision (CFS) mechanism leverages multiple learners to enhance the quality of pseudo labels. Secondly, we introduce an adaptive contour guidance module (ACGM) to effectively identify unreliable spatial regions in pseudo labels. Finally, our proposed CFCG achieves gains of mIoU +1.40%, +0.89% with a single learner and +1.85%, +1.33% by fusion inference on PASCAL VOC 2012 and on Cityscapes respectively under 1/8 protocols, clearly surpassing previous methods and reaching the state-of-the-art.
authors: Shuo Li, Yue He, Weiming Zhang , Wei Zhang, Xiao Tan, Junyu Han, Errui Ding, Jingdong Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16348-16358

title: CGBA:曲率感知几何黑盒攻击
title_en: CGBA: Curvature-aware Geometric Black-box Attack
abstract: 基于决策的黑盒攻击通常需要大量查询来生成对抗样本。此外,基于在估计法向量方向查询边界点的决策基攻击往往存在效率低下和收敛问题。本文提出了一种新颖的查询高效的曲率感知几何决策基黑盒攻击(CGBA),其在受限的二维平面上沿半圆形路径进行边界搜索,确保无论边界曲率如何都能成功找到边界点。虽然所提出的CGBA攻击可适用于任意决策边界,但其特别擅长利用低曲率生成高质量对抗样本,这在非目标攻击中被广泛观察并实验验证。相比之下,决策边界在目标攻击下通常表现出更高的曲率。因此,我们开发了一种新的查询高效的变体CGBA-H,专门适应目标攻击。此外,我们进一步设计了一种算法以牺牲少量额外查询为代价获取更优的初始边界点,显著提升了目标攻击的性能。在ImageNet和CIFAR10数据集上进行了大量实验,评估了所提方法对知名分类器的性能,结果表明CGBA和CGBA-H分别优于现有的非目标和目标攻击方法。源代码可在https://github.com/Farhamdur/CGBA获取。
abstract_en: Decision-based black-box attacks often necessitate a large number of queries to craft an adversarial example. Moreover, decision-based attacks based on querying boundary points in the estimated normal vector direction often suffer from inefficiency and convergence issues. In this paper, we propose a novel query-efficient curvature-aware geometric decision-based black-box attack (CGBA) that conducts boundary search along a semicircular path on a restricted 2D plane to ensure finding a boundary point successfully irrespective of the boundary curvature. While the proposed CGBA attack can work effectively for an arbitrary decision boundary, it is particularly efficient in exploiting the low curvature to craft high-quality adversarial examples, which is widely seen and experimentally verified in commonly used classifiers under non-targeted attacks. In contrast, the decision boundaries often exhibit higher curvature under targeted attacks. Thus, we develop a new query-efficient variant, CGBA-H, that is adapted for the targeted attack. In addition, we further design an algorithm to obtain a better initial boundary point at the expense of some extra queries, which considerably enhances the performance of the targeted attack. Extensive experiments are conducted to evaluate the performance of our proposed methods against some well-known classifiers on the ImageNet and CIFAR10 datasets, demonstrating the superiority of CGBA and CGBA-H over state-of-the-art non-targeted and targeted attacks, respectively. The source code is available at https://github.com/Farhamdur/CGBA.
authors: Md Farhamdur Reza, Ali Rahmati, Tianfu Wu, Huaiyu Dai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 124-133

title: CHAMPAGNE: 从大规模网络视频中学习真实世界对话
title_en: CHAMPAGNE: Learning Real-world Conversation from Large-Scale Web Videos
abstract: 视觉信息在对话中至关重要:例如,身体手势和物理行为会贡献超越文字本身的意义。然而,迄今为止,大多数神经对话模型仅限于文本。我们引入CHAMPAGNE,一个能够考虑视觉语境的对话生成模型。为了训练CHAMPAGNE,我们收集并发布了YTD-18M,一个包含1800万视频对话的大规模语料库。YTD-18M源自网络视频:在我们的数据收集流程中,一个预训练语言模型将易出错的自动转录文本转换为更清晰的对话格式,同时保持语义。人工评估表明,YTD-18M比先前资源(MMDialog,100万对话)更具合理性且更具体,同时保持视觉基础性。实验表明:1)CHAMPAGNE能够从YTD-18M中学习进行对话;2)微调后,它在四个聚焦真实世界对话的视觉-语言任务上达到最先进水平。我们发布数据、模型和代码。
abstract_en:
Visual information is central to conversation: body gestures and physical behaviour, for example, contribute to meaning that transcends words alone. To date, however, most neural conversational models are limited to just text. We introduce CHAMPAGNE, a generative model of conversations that can account for visual contexts. To train CHAMPAGNE, we collect and release YTD-18M, a large-scale corpus of 18M video-based dialogues. YTD-18M is constructed from web videos: crucial to our data collection pipeline is a pretrained language model that converts error-prone automatic transcripts to a cleaner dialogue format while maintaining meaning.
 Human evaluation reveals that YTD-18M is more sensible and specific than prior resources (MMDialog, 1M dialogues), while maintaining visual-groundedness. Experiments demonstrate that 1) CHAMPAGNE learns to conduct conversation from YTD-18M; and 2) when fine-tuned, it achieves state-of-the-art results on four vision-language tasks focused on real-world conversations. We release data, models, and code.
authors: Seungju Han, Jack Hessel, Nouha Dziri, Yejin Choi, Youngjae Yu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15498-15509

title: CHORD:基于形状变形的类别级手持物体重建
title_en: CHORD: Category-level Hand-held Object Reconstruction via Shape Deformation
abstract: 在日常生活中,人类通过手操作物体。建模被手操作的物体形状对于AI理解日常任务和学习操作技能至关重要。然而,先前方法在重建手持物体的精确形状时遇到了困难,主要由于形状先验知识不足和训练数据匮乏。如所示,以特定类型的工具(如杯子)为例,尽管其形状和外观存在无限变化,人类仅具有有限的"有效"模式和姿态来进行操作。这归因于人类掌握了"杯子"类别的形状先验知识,并能快速建立不同杯子实例与先验之间的对应关系,例如杯沿和把手的位置。基于此,我们提出了一种新的方法CHORD,用于通过形状变形实现类别级手持物体重建。CHORD通过变形类别形状先验来重建同类物体。为确保精确重建,我们为CHORD赋予三种意识:外观、形状和交互姿态。此外,我们构建了一个新的类别级手-物体交互数据集COMIC,包含丰富的物体实例、材质、手交互方式和视角。大量评估表明,CHORD在定量和定性指标上均优于现有方法。代码、模型和数据集可在https://kailinli.github.io/CHORD获取。
abstract_en: In daily life, humans utilize hands to manipulate objects. Modeling the shape of objects that are manipulated by the hand is essential for AI to comprehend daily tasks and to learn manipulation skills. However, previous approaches have encountered difficulties in reconstructing the precise shapes of hand-held objects, primarily owing to a deficiency in prior shape knowledge and inadequate data for training. As illustrated, given a particular type of tool, such as a mug, despite its infinite variations in shape and appearance, humans have a limited number of 'effective' modes and poses for its manipulation. This can be attributed to the fact that humans have mastered the shape prior of the 'mug' category, and can quickly establish the corresponding relations between different mug instances and the prior, such as where the rim and handle are located. In light of this, we propose a new method, CHORD, for Category-level Hand-held Object Reconstruction via shape Deformation. CHORD deforms a categorical shape prior for reconstructing the intra-class objects. To ensure accurate reconstruction, we empower CHORD with three types of awareness: appearance, shape, and interacting pose. In addition, we have constructed a new dataset, COMIC, of category-level hand-object interaction. COMIC contains a rich array of object instances, materials, hand interactions, and viewing directions. Extensive evaluation shows that CHORD outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in both quantitative and qualitative measures. Code, model, and datasets are available at https://kailinli.github.io/CHORD.
authors: Kailin Li, Lixin Yang, Haoyu Zhen, Zenan Lin, Xinyu Zhan, Licheng Zhong, Jian Xu, Kejian Wu, Cewu Lu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9444-9454

title: CHORUS : 从无界合成图像中学习规范化的三维人-物体空间关系
title_en: CHORUS : Learning Canonicalized 3D Human-Object Spatial Relations from Unbounded Synthesized Images
abstract: 我们提出了一种方法,使机器能够以自监督方式理解并建模三维空间中多样的人-物体交互的底层空间常识。这是一个具有挑战性的任务,因为存在可被视为类人且自然的交互流形,但即使对于相似的交互,人体姿态和物体几何形状仍可能变化。这种多样性使得3D交互的标注任务困难且难以扩展,从而限制了在监督方式下对这些交互进行推理的潜力。一种学习交互中人类与物体之间三维空间关系的方法是通过展示多个从不同视角捕捉到的2D图像,当人类与相同类型的物体交互时。我们方法的核心思想是利用一个生成模型,该模型能够根据任意文本提示输入生成高质量的2D图像,作为具有有效可控性和视角多样性的"无界"数据生成器。尽管合成图像的质量不如真实图像,但我们证明这些合成图像足以学习三维人-物体空间关系。我们提出了多种利用合成图像的策略,包括(1)首个利用生成图像模型进行三维人-物体空间关系学习的方法;(2)通过三维占据推理与姿态规范化的框架,以自监督方式从不一致的2D线索中推理三维空间关系;(3)语义聚类以区分相同物体类型的不同交互类型;以及(4)评估交互三维空间学习质量的新颖度量标准。项目页面: https://jellyheadandrew.github.io/projects/chorus
abstract_en: We present a method for teaching machines to understand and model the underlying spatial common sense of diverse human-object interactions in 3D in a self-supervised way. This is a challenging task, as there exist specific manifolds of the interactions that can be considered human-like and natural, but the human pose and the geometry of objects can vary even for similar interactions. Such diversity makes the annotating task of 3D interactions difficult and hard to scale, which limits the potential to reason about that in a supervised way. One way of learning the 3D spatial relationship between humans and objects during interaction is by showing multiple 2D images captured from different viewpoints when humans interact with the same type of objects. The core idea of our method is to leverage a generative model that produces high-quality 2D images from an arbitrary text prompt input as an "unbounded" data generator with effective controllability and view diversity. Despite its imperfection of the image quality over real images, we demonstrate that the synthesized images are sufficient to learn the 3D human-object spatial relations. We present multiple strategies to leverage the synthesized images, including (1) the first method to leverage a generative image model for 3D human-object spatial relation learning; (2) a framework to reason about the 3D spatial relations from inconsistent 2D cues in a self-supervised manner via 3D occupancy reasoning with pose canonicalization; (3) semantic clustering to disambiguate different types of interactions with the same object types; and (4) a novel metric to assess the quality of 3D spatial learning of interaction. Project Page: https://jellyheadandrew.github.io/projects/chorus
authors: Sookwan Han, Hanbyul Joo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15835-15846

title: CIRI: 课程式失活用于残差感知单次视频修复
title_en: CIRI: Curricular Inactivation for Residue-aware One-shot Video Inpainting
abstract: 视频修复旨在填补视频中缺失的区域。然而,在处理包含相机或物体运动的动态场景时,标注修复目标变得繁琐且不切实际。本文解决了仅提供一个标注初始帧的单次视频修复问题。一种直观的解决方案是通过目标跟踪等技术将初始目标传播到其他帧。在此背景下,主要障碍包括不可靠的传播和由于掩码不准确导致的部分修复伪影。针对前一个问题,我们提出课程式失活机制,替代硬掩码机制来指示修复目标,该方法在长时视频修复中对错误预测具有鲁棒性。针对后一个问题,我们探索修复残差的特性,并以迭代的检测-精修方式提出一种在线残差去除方法。在多个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验验证了所提方法在单次视频修复任务中的定量和定性优越性。更重要的是,我们的方法具有极高的灵活性,可与任意传统修复模型集成,激活其执行可靠的单次视频修复任务。视频演示可参考我们的补充材料,代码仓库地址为https://github.com/Arise-zwy/CIRI。
abstract_en: Video inpainting aims at filling in missing regions of a video. However, when dealing with dynamic scenes with camera or object movements, annotating the inpainting target becomes laborious and impractical. In this paper, we resolve the one-shot video inpainting problem in which only one annotated first frame is provided. A naive solution is to propagate the initial target to the other frames with techniques like object tracking. In this context, the main obstacles are the unreliable propagation and the partially inpainted artifacts due to the inaccurate mask. For the former problem, we propose curricular inactivation to replace the hard masking mechanism for indicating the inpainting target, which is robust to erroneous predictions in long-term video inpainting. For the latter, we explore the properties of inpainting residue and present an online residue removal method in an iterative detect-and-refine manner. Extensive experiments on several real-world datasets demonstrate the quantitative and qualitative superiorities of our proposed method in one-shot video inpainting. More importantly, our method is extremely flexible that can be integrated with arbitrary traditional inpainting models, activating them to perform the reliable one-shot video inpainting task. Video demonstrations can be found in our supplement, and our code can be found at https://github.com/Arise-zwy/CIRI.
authors: Weiying Zheng, Cheng Xu, Xuemiao Xu, Wenxi Liu, Shengfeng He ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13012-13022

title: CL-MVSNet:基于双级对比学习的无监督多视角立体视觉
title_en: CL-MVSNet: Unsupervised Multi-View Stereo with Dual-Level Contrastive Learning
abstract: 无监督多视角立体视觉(MVS)方法近期取得了显著进展。然而,先前方法主要依赖光度一致性假设,这可能面临两个局限:难以区分的区域和视角依赖效应,例如低纹理区域和反射。为解决这些问题,本文提出了一种新的双级对比学习方法,命名为CL-MVSNet。具体而言,我们的模型将两个对比分支整合到无监督MVS框架中,以构建额外的监督信号。一方面,我们提出一个图像级对比分支,引导模型获取更多上下文感知,从而在难以区分的区域实现更完整的深度估计。另一方面,我们利用场景级对比分支提升表示能力,增强对视角依赖效应的鲁棒性。此外,为恢复更精确的3D几何结构,我们引入L0.5光度一致性损失,鼓励模型更关注准确点,同时减轻不期望点的梯度惩罚。在DTU和Tanks&Temples基准上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在所有端到端无监督MVS框架中达到最先进性能,并且在无需微调的情况下显著优于其监督对应方法。
abstract_en: Unsupervised Multi-View Stereo (MVS) methods have achieved promising progress recently. However, previous methods primarily depend on the photometric consistency assumption, which may suffer from two limitations: indistinguishable regions and view-dependent effects, e.g., low-textured areas and reflections. To address these issues, in this paper, we propose a new dual-level contrastive learning approach, named CL-MVSNet. Specifically, our model integrates two contrastive branches into an unsupervised MVS framework to construct additional supervisory signals. On the one hand, we present an image-level contrastive branch to guide the model to acquire more context awareness, thus leading to more complete depth estimation in indistinguishable regions. On the other hand, we exploit a scene-level contrastive branch to boost the representation ability, improving robustness to view-dependent effects. Moreover, to recover more accurate 3D geometry, we introduce an L0.5 photometric consistency loss, which encourages the model to focus more on accurate points while mitigating the gradient penalty of undesirable ones. Extensive experiments on DTU and Tanks&Temples benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance among all end-to-end unsupervised MVS frameworks and outperforms its supervised counterpart by a considerable margin without fine-tuning.
authors: Kaiqiang Xiong, Rui Peng, Zhe Zhang, Tianxing Feng, Jianbo Jiao, Feng Gao, Ronggang Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3769-3780

title: CLIP-Cluster: 基于CLIP引导的属性幻觉的人脸聚类
title_en: CLIP-Cluster: CLIP-Guided Attribute Hallucination for Face Clustering
abstract: 监督人脸聚类中最重要却鲜有研究的挑战之一是由于年龄、姿态和表情等不同人脸属性导致的类内方差过大。同一身份但具有不同人脸属性的图像通常倾向于被聚类到不同的子簇中。首次,我们提出了一种属性幻觉框架CLIP-Cluster来解决这一问题,该框架首先利用强大的CLIP模型对不同属性进行多表示幻觉,然后通过学习邻域自适应注意力进行池化。具体而言,CLIP-Cluster首先引入了文本驱动的属性幻觉模块,允许用户以自然语言作为接口,基于对齐良好的图像-语言CLIP空间,对给定人脸图像进行新颖属性的幻觉生成。此外,我们开发了邻域感知的代理生成器,将描述各种属性的特征融合为代理特征,以建立不同子簇间的桥梁并降低类内方差。该代理特征通过基于局部邻域信息自适应关注幻觉生成的视觉特征和源特征来生成。在此基础上,利用代理表示构建的图用于后续聚类操作。大量实验表明,我们的方法在推理效率方面优于现有最先进的面部聚类方法。
abstract_en: One of the most important yet rarely studied challenges for supervised face clustering is the large intra-class variance caused by different face attributes such as age, pose, and expression. Images of the same identity but with different face attributes usually tend to be clustered into different sub-clusters. For the first time, we proposed an attribute hallucination framework named CLIP-Cluster to address this issue, which first hallucinates multiple representations for different attributes with the powerful CLIP model and then pools them by learning neighbor-adaptive attention. Specifically, CLIP-Cluster first introduces a text-driven attribute hallucination module, which allows one to use natural language as the interface to hallucinate novel attributes for a given face image based on the well-aligned image-language CLIP space. Furthermore, we develop a neighbor-aware proxy generator that fuses the features describing various attributes into a proxy feature to build a bridge among different sub-clusters and reduce the intra-class variance. The proxy feature is generated by adaptively attending to the hallucinated visual features and the source one based on the local neighbor information. On this basis, a graph built with the proxy representations is used for subsequent clustering operations. Extensive experiments show our proposed approach outperforms state-of-the-art face clustering methods with high inference efficiency.
authors: Shuai Shen, Wanhua Li, Xiaobing Wang, Dafeng Zhang, Zhezhu Jin, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20786-20795

title: CLIP驱动的通用器官分割与肿瘤检测模型
title_en: CLIP-Driven Universal Model for Organ Segmentation and Tumor Detection
abstract: 越来越多的公共数据集显示出对自动化器官分割和肿瘤检测的显著影响。然而,由于每个数据集规模较小且部分标注问题,以及对多样化肿瘤类型的有限研究,所得到的模型往往局限于特定器官/肿瘤的分割,忽视了解剖结构的语义信息,也无法扩展到新领域。为解决这些问题,我们提出CLIP驱动的通用模型,该模型将对比语言-图像预训练(CLIP)学习到的文本嵌入整合到分割模型中。这种基于CLIP的标签编码捕捉了解剖关系,使模型能够学习结构化的特征嵌入,并分割25种器官和6种类型的肿瘤。所提出的模型基于14个数据集的集合开发,使用3,410例CT扫描进行训练,然后在3个额外数据集的6,162例外部CT扫描上进行评估。我们在医学分割挑战赛(Medical Segmentation Decathlon, MSD)公共排行榜上排名第一,并在Beyond The Cranial Vault(BTCV)上取得了最先进结果。此外,与数据集专用模型相比,通用模型在计算效率上提高了6倍,对不同部位的CT扫描具有更好的泛化能力,并在新任务上表现出更强的迁移学习性能。
abstract_en:
An increasing number of public datasets have shown a marked impact on automated organ segmentation and tumor detection. However, due to the small size and partially labeled problem of each dataset, as well as a limited investigation of diverse types of tumors, the resulting models are often limited to segmenting specific organs/tumors and ignore the semantics of anatomical structures, nor can they be extended to novel domains. 
 To address these issues, we propose the CLIP-Driven Universal Model, which incorporates text embedding learned from Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) to segmentation models. This CLIP-based label encoding captures anatomical relationships, enabling the model to learn a structured feature embedding and segment 25 organs and 6 types of tumors. The proposed model is developed from an assembly of 14 datasets, using a total of 3,410 CT scans for training and then evaluated on 6,162 external CT scans from 3 additional datasets. We rank first on the Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) public leaderboard and achieve state-of-the-art results on Beyond The Cranial Vault (BTCV). Additionally, the Universal Model is computationally more efficient (6xfaster) compared with dataset-specific models, generalized better to CT scans from varying sites, and shows stronger transfer learning performance on novel tasks.
authors: Jie Liu, Yixiao Zhang, Jie-Neng Chen, Junfei Xiao, Yongyi Lu, Bennett A Landman, Yixuan Yuan, Alan Yuille, Yucheng Tang, Zongwei Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21152-21164

title: CLIP2Point:基于图像与深度联合预训练的CLIP向点云分类迁移
title_en: CLIP2Point: Transfer CLIP to Point Cloud Classification with Image-Depth Pre-Training
abstract: 由于训练数据有限,跨三维视觉与语言的预训练仍处于发展阶段。近期研究尝试将视觉-语言(V-L)预训练方法迁移至三维视觉领域。然而,三维与图像之间的领域差距尚未解决,导致视觉-语言预训练模型在三维下游任务中受到限制。为了解决这一问题,我们提出CLIP2Point,这是一种基于对比学习的图像-深度预训练方法,用于将CLIP迁移至三维领域,并适配于点云分类任务。我们引入了一种新的深度渲染设置,形成更佳的视觉效果,并从ShapeNet渲染了52,460对图像与深度图用于预训练。CLIP2Point的预训练方案结合跨模态学习以强化深度特征对表达视觉与文本特征的捕捉能力,同时通过同模态学习增强深度聚合的不变性。此外,我们提出了一种新颖的门控双路径适配器(GDPA),即一种包含全局视角聚合器与门控融合的双路径结构,用于下游表征学习。它允许CLIP与CLIP2Point的集成,以高效适应方式调整预训练知识至下游任务。实验结果表明,CLIP2Point在将CLIP知识迁移至三维视觉方面具有有效性。我们的CLIP2Point在零样本、少样本和全监督分类任务中均优于其他三维迁移学习与预训练网络,取得了最先进的结果。
abstract_en: Pre-training across 3D vision and language remains under development because of limited training data. Recent works attempt to transfer vision-language (V-L) pre-training methods to 3D vision. However, the domain gap between 3D and images is unsolved, so that V-L pre-trained models are restricted in 3D downstream tasks. To address this issue, we propose CLIP2Point, an image-depth pre-training method by contrastive learning to transfer CLIP to the 3D domain, and adapt it to point cloud classification. We introduce a new depth rendering setting that forms a better visual effect, and then render 52,460 pairs of images and depth maps from ShapeNet for pre-training. The pre-training scheme of CLIP2Point combines cross-modality learning to enforce the depth features for capturing expressive visual and textual features and intra-modality learning to enhance the invariance of depth aggregation. Additionally, we propose a novel Gated Dual-Path Adapter (GDPA), i.e., a dual-path structure with global-view aggregators and gated fusion for downstream representative learning. It allows the ensemble of CLIP and CLIP2Point, tuning pre-training knowledge to downstream tasks in an efficient adaptation. Experimental results show that CLIP2Point is effective in transferring CLIP knowledge to 3D vision. Our CLIP2Point outperforms other 3D transfer learning and pre-training networks, achieving state-of-the-art results on zero-shot, few-shot, and fully-supervised classification.
authors: Tianyu Huang, Bowen Dong, Yunhan Yang, Xiaoshui Huang, Rynson W.H. Lau, Wanli Ouyang, Wangmeng Zuo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22157-22167

title: 面向零样本分布外检测的CLIPN:教会CLIP说不
title_en: CLIPN for Zero-Shot OOD Detection: Teaching CLIP to Say No
abstract: 分布外(OOD)检测指的是在分布内(ID)数据集上训练模型以判断输入图像是否来自未知类别。已有大量研究致力于设计基于卷积神经网络或Transformer模型的各种分布外检测方法。然而,依赖CLIP的零样本分布外检测方法,其仅需ID类别的名称,却较少受到关注。本文提出了一种新颖方法,即CLIP说不(CLIPN),其在CLIP中引入"否"的逻辑。我们的核心动机是通过正语义提示和负语义提示,使CLIP具备区分分布外与分布内样本的能力。具体而言,我们设计了一个可学习的"否"提示和"否"文本编码器以捕捉图像中的负语义。随后,我们引入两种损失函数:图像-文本二元对立损失和文本语义对立损失,用于教导CLIPN将图像与"否"提示关联,从而实现对未知样本的识别。此外,我们提出两种无需阈值的推理算法,通过利用"否"提示和文本编码器中的负语义进行分布外检测。在9个基准数据集(3个ID数据集和6个OOD数据集)上的实验结果表明,CLIPN在ImageNet-1K零样本分布外检测任务中,AUROC和FPR95指标分别优于7种常用算法至少1.1%和7.37%。我们的CLIPN可作为有效利用CLIP进行下游分布外任务的坚实基础。
abstract_en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection refers to training the model on in-distribution (ID) dataset to classify if the input images come from unknown classes. Considerable efforts have been invested in designing various OOD detection methods based on either convolutional neural networks or transformers. However, Zero-shot OOD detection methods driven by CLIP, which require only class names for ID, have received less attention. This paper presents a novel method, namely CLIP saying no (CLIPN), which empowers "no" logic within CLIP. Our key motivation is to equip CLIP with the capability of distinguishing OOD and ID samples via positive-semantic prompts and negation-semantic prompts. To be specific, we design a novel learnable "no" prompt and a "no" text encoder to capture the negation-semantic with images. Subsequently, we introduce two loss functions: the image-text binary-opposite loss and the text semantic-opposite loss, which we use to teach CLIPN to associate images with "no" prompts, thereby enabling it to identify unknown samples. Furthermore, we propose two threshold-free inference algorithms to perform OOD detection via using negation semantics from "no" prompts and text encoder. Experimental results on 9 benchmark datasets (3 ID datasets and 6 OOD datasets) for the OOD detection task demonstrate that CLIPN outperforms 7 well-used algorithms by at least 1.1% and 7.37% on AUROC and FPR95 on zero-shot OOD detection of ImageNet-1K. Our CLIPN can serve as a solid foundation for leveraging CLIP effectively in downstream OOD tasks.
authors: Hualiang Wang, Yi Li, Huifeng Yao, Xiaomeng Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1802-1812

title: CLIPTER:场景文本识别中的全局视角
title_en: CLIPTER: Looking at the Bigger Picture in Scene Text Recognition
abstract: 现实场景中的文本阅读往往需要理解其周围的上下文,尤其是在处理低质量文本时。然而,当前的场景文本识别器由于仅基于裁剪后的文本图像进行操作,无法感知整体上下文。在本研究中,我们利用现代视觉-语言模型(如CLIP)的代表性能力,为基于裁剪的识别器提供场景级信息。我们通过门控交叉注意力机制,将视觉-语言模型获得的整张图像的丰富表示与识别器的词级特征进行融合。该组件逐步转向上下文增强的表示,从而实现预训练识别器的稳定微调。我们在领先的文本识别架构上验证了我们模型无关框架CLIPTER(CLIP TExt Recognition)的有效性,并在多个基准测试中取得了最先进结果。此外,我们的分析表明,该方法在词汇表外单词的鲁棒性得到提升,并在低数据量场景下表现出更强的泛化能力。
abstract_en: Reading text in real-world scenarios often requires understanding the context surrounding it, especially when dealing with poor-quality text. However, current scene text recognizers are unaware of the bigger picture as they operate on cropped text images. In this study, we harness the representative capabilities of modern vision-language models, such as CLIP, to provide scene-level information to the crop-based recognizer. We achieve this by fusing a rich representation of the entire image, obtained from the vision-language model, with the recognizer word-level features via a gated cross-attention mechanism. This component gradually shifts to the context-enhanced representation, allowing for stable fine-tuning of a pretrained recognizer. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our model-agnostic framework, CLIPTER (CLIP TExt Recognition), on leading text recognition architectures and achieve state-of-the-art results across multiple benchmarks. Furthermore, our analysis highlights improved robustness to out-of-vocabulary words and enhanced generalization in low-data regimes.
authors: Aviad Aberdam, David Bensaid, Alona Golts, Roy Ganz, Oren Nuriel, Royee Tichauer, Shai Mazor, Ron Litman ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21706-21717

title: CLIPTrans:利用预训练模型进行多模态机器翻译中的视觉知识迁移
title_en: CLIPTrans: Transferring Visual Knowledge with Pre-trained Models for Multimodal Machine Translation
abstract: 近年来,开发能够通过视觉知识增强神经机器翻译(NMT)的多模态机器翻译(MMT)系统引起了广泛关注。该问题设置涉及在训练过程中使用图像作为辅助信息,而近期研究则在推理阶段不再使用图像。为此,先前的工作面临从头训练强大MMT模型的挑战,由于多语言视觉-语言数据的稀缺性,尤其是低资源语言。同时,多语言预训练模型(用于NMT)和多模态预训练模型(用于视觉-语言任务)在英语领域大量涌现,展现出卓越的泛化能力。然而,这些模型无法直接应用于MMT,因为它们未提供生成任务所需的对齐多模态多语言特征。为缓解这一问题,我们提出CLIPTrans,无需设计复杂的MMT模块,而是简单地适应独立预训练的多模态M-CLIP和多语言mBART。为对齐其嵌入空间,通过轻量级映射网络生成的前缀序列,将mBART条件化于M-CLIP特征。我们采用两阶段管道进行训练,先通过图像描述生成预热模型,再进行实际翻译任务。实验表明该框架的优势,并在标准基准上将最先进水平平均提升+2.67 BLEU。代码可在www.github.com/devaansh100/CLIPTrans获取。
abstract_en: There has been a growing interest in developing multimodal machine translation (MMT) systems that enhance neural machine translation (NMT) with visual knowledge. This problem setup involves using images as auxiliary information during training, and more recently, eliminating their use during inference. Towards this end, previous works face a challenge in training powerful MMT models from scratch due to the scarcity of annotated multilingual vision-language data, especially for low-resource languages. Simultaneously, there has been an influx of multilingual pre-trained models for NMT and multimodal pre-trained models for vision-language tasks, primarily in English, which have shown exceptional generalisation ability. However, these are not directly applicable to MMT since they do not provide aligned multimodal multilingual features for generative tasks. To alleviate this issue, instead of designing complex modules for MMT, we propose CLIPTrans, which simply adapts the independently pre-trained multimodal M-CLIP and the multilingual mBART. In order to align their embedding spaces, mBART is conditioned on the M-CLIP features by a prefix sequence generated through a lightweight mapping network. We train this in a two-stage pipeline which warms up the model with image captioning before the actual translation task. Through experiments, we demonstrate the merits of this framework and consequently push forward the state-of-the-art across standard benchmarks by an average of +2.67 BLEU. The code can be found at www.github.com/devaansh100/CLIPTrans.
authors: Devaansh Gupta, Siddhant Kharbanda, Jiawei Zhou, Wanhua Li, Hanspeter Pfister, Donglai Wei ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2875-2886

title: CLIPascene:基于不同类型和层次的抽象场景素描
title_en: CLIPascene: Scene Sketching with Different Types and Levels of Abstraction
abstract: 本文提出了一种将给定场景图像转换为素描的方法,该方法通过不同类型的抽象和多个层次的抽象实现。我们区分了两种类型的抽象。第一种关注素描的保真度,其表示从对输入的精确描绘逐渐过渡到更松散的描绘。第二种由素描的视觉简洁性定义,从详细描绘逐渐过渡到稀疏素描。通过显式解耦为两个抽象轴(每个轴包含多个层次),为用户提供了基于个人目标和偏好的更多控制,以选择所需的素描。为了在给定的保真度和简化层次上生成素描,我们训练了两个多层感知机(MLP)网络。第一个网络学习所需笔画的放置位置,而第二个网络学习在不损害素描的可识别性和语义的情况下逐步移除笔画。我们的方法能够生成复杂场景的素描,包括具有复杂背景(如自然和城市环境)和主体(如动物和人物)的场景,同时在保真度和简洁性方面对输入场景进行渐进式抽象。
abstract_en:
In this paper, we present a method for converting a given scene image into a sketch using different types and multiple levels of abstraction. We distinguish between two types of abstraction.
 The first considers the fidelity of the sketch, varying its representation from a more precise portrayal of the input to a looser depiction.
 The second is defined by the visual simplicity of the sketch, moving from a detailed depiction to a sparse sketch.
 Using an explicit disentanglement into two abstraction axes --- and multiple levels for each one --- provides users additional control over selecting the desired sketch based on their personal goals and preferences.
 To form a sketch at a given level of fidelity and simplification, we train two MLP networks. The first network learns the desired placement of strokes, while the second network learns to gradually remove strokes from the sketch without harming its recognizability and semantics.
 Our approach is able to generate sketches of complex scenes including those with complex backgrounds (e.g. natural and urban settings) and subjects (e.g. animals and people) while depicting gradual abstractions of the input scene in terms of fidelity and simplicity.
authors: Yael Vinker, Yuval Alaluf, Daniel Cohen-Or, Ariel Shamir ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4146-4156

title: CLNeRF:持续学习与NeRF的结合
title_en: CLNeRF: Continual Learning Meets NeRF
abstract: 新视角合成旨在根据一组校准图像生成未见过的视角。在实际应用中,场景的覆盖范围、外观或几何结构可能随时间变化,新的图像会持续被捕捉。高效地整合这种持续变化是一个开放性挑战。标准NeRF基准测试仅涉及场景覆盖范围的扩展。为研究其他实际场景变化,我们提出了一种新的数据集——跨时间世界(WAT),包含随时间变化外观和几何结构的场景。我们还提出了一种简单而有效的CLNeRF方法,将持续学习(CL)引入神经辐射场(NeRF)。CLNeRF结合生成性重放和即时神经图形原语(NGP)架构,有效防止灾难性遗忘,并在新数据到达时高效更新模型。我们还向NGP添加了可训练的外观和几何嵌入,使单个紧凑模型能够处理复杂的场景变化。无需存储历史图像,CLNeRF在连续多次扫描的动态场景上进行训练,其性能与一次性训练所有扫描的上限模型相当。与其它CL基线方法相比,CLNeRF在标准基准测试和WAT数据集上表现显著更好。源代码、演示和WAT数据集可在https://github.com/IntelLabs/CLNeRF获取。
abstract_en: Novel view synthesis aims to render unseen views given a set of calibrated images. In practical applications, the coverage, appearance or geometry of the scene may change over time, with new images continuously being captured. Efficiently incorporating such continuous change is an open challenge. Standard NeRF benchmarks only involve scene coverage expansion. To study other practical scene changes, we propose a new dataset, World Across Time (WAT), consisting of scenes that change in appearance and geometry over time. We also propose a simple yet effective method, CLNeRF, which introduces continual learning (CL) to Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs). CLNeRF combines generative replay and the Instant Neural Graphics Primitives (NGP) architecture to effectively prevent catastrophic forgetting and efficiently update the model when new data arrives. We also add trainable appearance and geometry embeddings to NGP, allowing a single compact model to handle complex scene changes. Without the need to store historical images, CLNeRF trained sequentially over multiple scans of a changing scene performs on-par with the upper bound model trained on all scans at once. Compared to other CL baselines CLNeRF performs much better across standard benchmarks and WAT. The source code, a demo, and the WAT dataset are available at https://github.com/IntelLabs/CLNeRF.
authors: Zhipeng Cai, Matthias Müller ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23185-23194

title: CLR: 通道级轻量级重编程用于持续学习
title_en: CLR: Channel-wise Lightweight Reprogramming for Continual Learning
abstract: 持续学习旨在模拟人类在连续任务中持续积累知识的能力。主要挑战是在学习新任务后保持对先前学习任务的性能,即避免灾难性遗忘。我们提出了一种通道级轻量级重编程(CLR)方法,帮助卷积神经网络(CNN)在持续学习过程中克服灾难性遗忘。我们证明,通过使用我们提出的轻量级(非常廉价)重编程参数,一个在旧任务(或自监督代理任务)上训练的CNN模型可以被“重编程”以解决新任务。借助CLR,我们实现了更好的稳定性-可塑性权衡以解决持续学习问题:为保持稳定性并保留先前任务能力,我们使用一个通用任务无关的不可变部分作为共享的“锚”参数集。随后,我们添加任务特定的轻量级重编程参数,以重新解释不可变部分的输出,从而实现可塑性并整合新知识。为了学习连续任务,我们仅训练轻量级重编程参数以学习每个新任务。重编程参数是任务特定且专属于每个任务的,这使我们的方法免受灾难性遗忘的影响。为了最小化重编程参数的需求以学习新任务,我们通过仅调整关键卷积核并从锚参数学习通道级线性映射来实现重编程的轻量化。我们证明,对于通用CNN,CLR参数增加量小于任何新任务的0.6%。我们的方法在包含53个图像分类数据集的新挑战性任务序列上优于13种最先进的持续学习基线。代码和数据见:https://github.com/gyhandy/Channel-wise-Lightweight-Reprogramming
abstract_en: Continual learning aims to emulate the human ability to continually accumulate knowledge over sequential tasks. The main challenge is to maintain performance on previously learned tasks after learning new tasks, i.e., to avoid catastrophic forgetting. We propose a Channel-wise Lightweight Reprogramming (CLR) approach that helps convolutional neural networks (CNNs) overcome catastrophic forgetting during continual learning. We show that a CNN model trained on an old task (or self-supervised proxy task) could be "reprogrammed" to solve a new task by using our proposed lightweight (very cheap) reprogramming parameter. With the help of CLR, we have a better stability-plasticity trade-off to solve continual learning problems: To maintain stability and retain previous task ability, we use a common task-agnostic immutable part as the shared "anchor" parameter set. We then add task-specific lightweight reprogramming parameters to reinterpret the outputs of the immutable parts, to enable plasticity and integrate new knowledge. To learn sequential tasks, we only train the lightweight reprogramming parameters to learn each new task. Reprogramming parameters are task-specific and exclusive to each task, which makes our method immune to catastrophic forgetting. To minimize the parameter requirement of reprogramming to learn new tasks, we make reprogramming lightweight by only adjusting essential kernels and learning channel-wise linear mappings from anchor parameters to task-specific domain knowledge. We show that, for general CNNs, the CLR parameter increase is less than 0.6% for any new task. Our method outperforms 13 state-of-the-art continual learning baselines on a new challenging sequence of 53 image classification datasets. Code and data are here: https://github.com/gyhandy/Channel-wise-Lightweight-Reprogramming
authors: Yunhao Ge, Yuecheng Li, Shuo Ni, Jiaping Zhao, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Laurent Itti ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18798-18808

title: CMDA:面向夜间语义分割的跨模态域适应
title_en: CMDA: Cross-Modality Domain Adaptation for Nighttime Semantic Segmentation
abstract: 大多数夜间语义分割研究基于域适应方法和图像输入。然而,受限于传统相机的低动态范围,图像在低光条件下无法捕捉结构细节和边界信息。事件相机作为一种新型视觉传感器,其高动态范围与传统相机具有互补性。为此,我们提出了一种新颖的无监督跨模态域适应(CMDA)框架,仅利用白天图像的标签,通过融合多模态(图像与事件)信息实现夜间语义分割。在CMDA中,我们设计了图像运动提取器以提取运动信息,图像内容提取器以提取内容信息,从而弥合不同模态(图像到事件)和领域(白天到夜晚)之间的差距。此外,我们引入了首个图像-事件夜间语义分割数据集。在公开图像数据集和所提出图像-事件数据集上的大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性。我们的代码、模型和数据集已开源,详见https://github.com/XiaRho/CMDA。
abstract_en: Most nighttime semantic segmentation studies are based on domain adaptation approaches and image input. However, limited by the low dynamic range of conventional cameras, images fail to capture structural details and boundary information in low-light conditions. Event cameras, as a new form of vision sensors, are complementary to conventional cameras with their high dynamic range. To this end, we propose a novel unsupervised Cross-Modality Domain Adaptation (CMDA) framework to leverage multi-modality (Images and Events) information for nighttime semantic segmentation, with only labels on daytime images. In CMDA, we design the Image Motion-Extractor to extract motion information and the Image Content-Extractor to extract content information from images, in order to bridge the gap between different modalities (Images to Events) and domains (Day to Night). Besides, we introduce the first image-event nighttime semantic segmentation dataset. Extensive experiments on both the public image dataset and the proposed image-event dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach. We open-source our code, models, and dataset at https://github.com/XiaRho/CMDA.
authors: Ruihao Xia, Chaoqiang Zhao, Meng Zheng, Ziyan Wu, Qiyu Sun, Yang Tang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21572-21581

title: CO-Net: 通过统一网络一次学习多个点云任务
title_en: CO-Net: Learning Multiple Point Cloud Tasks at Once with A Cohesive Network
abstract: 我们提出CO-Net,这是一个统一框架,能够在异构数据集领域中联合优化多个点云任务。CO-Net保持了高存储效率的特性,因为具有大量共享参数的模型可以组合成单一模型。具体而言,我们利用残差MLP(Res-MLP)模块进行有效的特征提取,并在深度和宽度上优雅地扩展网络以满足不同任务的需求。基于该模块,我们提出了一种新颖的嵌套逐层处理策略,该策略在每个任务中识别出最优架构,同时在模块每一层中提供部分共享参数和部分非共享参数。这种策略解决了点云多任务学习固有的挑战,例如任务偏斜导致的多样化模型拓扑结构以及异构数据集领域引发的冲突梯度。最后,我们提出了一种基于符号的梯度手术以促进CO-Net的训练,从而强调任务共享参数的使用并确保每个任务都能被彻底优化。实验结果表明,通过CO-Net联合优化所有点云任务的模型在计算成本和总体存储成本方面显著低于先前方法,同时在性能上具有显著优势。我们还证明了CO-Net支持增量学习,并在适应新点云任务时防止灾难性遗忘。
abstract_en: We present CO-Net, a cohesive framework that optimizes multiple point cloud tasks collectively across heterogeneous dataset domains. CO-Net maintains the characteristics of high storage efficiency since models with the preponderance of shared parameters can be assembled into a single model. Specifically, we leverage residual MLP (Res-MLP) block for effective feature extraction and scale it gracefully along the depth and width of the network to meet the demands of different tasks. Based on the block, we propose a novel nested layer-wise processing policy, which identifies the optimal architecture for each task while provides partial sharing parameters and partial non-sharing parameters inside each layer of the block. Such policy tackles the inherent challenges of multi-task learning on point cloud, e.g., diverse model topologies resulting from task skew and conflicting gradients induced by heterogeneous dataset domains. Finally, we propose a sign-based gradient surgery to promote the training of CO-Net, thereby emphasizing the usage of task-shared parameters and guaranteeing that each task can be thoroughly optimized. Experimental results reveal that models optimized by CO-Net jointly for all point cloud tasks maintain much fewer computation cost and overall storage cost yet outpace prior methods by a significant margin. We also demonstrate that CO-Net allows incremental learning and prevents catastrophic amnesia when adapting to a new point cloud task.
authors: Tao Xie, Ke Wang, Siyi Lu, Yukun Zhang, Kun Dai, Xiaoyu Li, Jie Xu, Li Wang, Lijun Zhao, Xinyu Zhang, Ruifeng Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3523-3533

title: CO-PILOT:基于条件邻域聚合的动态自上而下点云用于多吉像素病理图像表示
title_en: CO-PILOT: Dynamic Top-Down Point Cloud with Conditional Neighborhood Aggregation for Multi-Gigapixel Histopathology Image Representation
abstract: 基于多吉像素病理图像预测生存率是数字病理学中最具有挑战性的任务之一。由于计算复杂性,多实例学习(MIL)已成为该过程的常规方法,因为它将图像分割为更小的块。然而,这种技术未能考虑每个块中存在的个体细胞,而这些细胞是组织的基本组成部分。在本工作中,我们开发了一种新颖的动态分层点云方法(CO-PILOT),用于处理从常规病理图像中提取的细胞图。通过自下而上的信息传播和自上而下的条件注意力机制,我们的模型能够在不同组织层次上实现自适应关注。通过全面的实验,我们证明了我们的模型在仅使用半参数量的情况下,能够在两个数据集和四个评估指标上超越所有最先进的方法,包括分层视觉变换器(ViT)。重要的是,我们的模型能够将患者分为具有统计学显著差异结果的不同风险队列,这一任务此前仅能通过基因组信息实现。此外,我们发布了一个包含188名患者873个细胞图的大规模数据集,以及其生存信息,使其成为该领域最大的公开数据集之一。
abstract_en: Predicting survival rates based on multi-gigapixel histopathology images is one of the most challenging tasks in digital pathology. Due to the computational complexities, Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) has become the conventional approach for this process as it breaks the image into smaller patches. However, this technique fails to account for the individual cells present in each patch, while they are the fundamental part of the tissue. In this work, we developed a novel dynamic and hierarchical point-cloud-based method (CO-PILOT) for the processing of cellular graphs extracted from routine histopathology images. By using bottom-up information propagation and top-down conditional attention, our model gains access to an adaptive focus across different levels of tissue hierarchy. Through comprehensive experiments, we demonstrate that our model can outperform all the state-of-the-art methods in survival prediction, including the hierarchical Vision Transformer (ViT), across two datasets and four metrics with only half of the parameters of the closest baseline. Importantly, our model is able to stratify the patients into different risk cohorts with statistically different outcomes across two large datasets, a task that was previously achievable only using genomic information. Furthermore, we publish a large dataset containing 873 cellular graphs from 188 patients, along with their survival information, making it one of the largest publicly available datasets in this context.
authors: Ramin Nakhli, Allen Zhang, Ali Mirabadi, Katherine Rich, Maryam Asadi, Blake Gilks, Hossein Farahani, Ali Bashashati ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21063-21073

title: COCO-O: 面向自然分布偏移的物体检测基准
title_en: COCO-O: A Benchmark for Object Detectors under Natural Distribution Shifts
abstract: 实际物体检测应用在具有自然分布偏移的图像输入上可能失去有效性。该问题促使研究社区更加关注检测器在分布外(OOD)输入下的鲁棒性。现有工作构建数据集以基准特定应用场景下检测器的OOD鲁棒性,例如自动驾驶。然而,这些数据集缺乏通用性,难以对基于通用任务(如COCO)构建的通用检测器进行基准测试。为了提供更全面的鲁棒性评估,我们引入COCO-O(Out-of-distribution),一个基于COCO的测试数据集,包含6种自然分布偏移类型。COCO-O与训练数据存在较大分布差距,导致Faster R-CNN检测器性能相对下降55.7%。我们利用COCO-O对超过100种现代物体检测器进行实验,研究其改进是否可信或仅仅是过拟合COCO测试集。不幸的是,早期大多数经典检测器均未表现出强OOD泛化能力。我们进一步研究检测器架构设计、增强和预训练技术近期突破对鲁棒性的影响。一些实证发现揭示:1)与检测头或颈部相比,主干网络是鲁棒性最重要的部分;2)端到端检测Transformer设计未带来增强,甚至可能降低鲁棒性;3)大规模基础模型在鲁棒物体检测方面取得重大突破。我们希望COCO-O能为物体检测的鲁棒性研究提供丰富的测试平台。数据集将在https://github.com/alibaba/easyrobust/tree/main/benchmarks/coco_o获取。
abstract_en: Practical object detection application can lose its effectiveness on image inputs with natural distribution shifts. This problem leads the research community to pay more attention on the robustness of detectors under Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) inputs. Existing works construct datasets to benchmark the detector's OOD robustness for a specific application scenario, e.g., Autonomous Driving. However, these datasets lack universality and are hard to benchmark general detectors built on common tasks such as COCO. To give a more comprehensive robustness assessment, we introduce COCO-O(ut-of-distribution), a test dataset based on COCO with 6 types of natural distribution shifts. COCO-O has a large distribution gap with training data and results in a significant 55.7% relative performance drop on a Faster R-CNN detector. We leverage COCO-O to conduct experiments on more than 100 modern object detectors to investigate if their improvements are credible or just over-fitting to the COCO test set. Unfortunately, most classic detectors in early years do not exhibit strong OOD generalization. We further study the robustness effect on recent breakthroughs of detector's architecture design, augmentation and pre-training techniques. Some empirical findings are revealed: 1) Compared with detection head or neck, backbone is the most important part for robustness; 2) An end-to-end detection transformer design brings no enhancement, and may even reduce robustness; 3) Large-scale foundation models have made a great leap on robust object detection. We hope our COCO-O could provide a rich testbed for robustness study of object detection. The dataset will be available at https://github.com/alibaba/easyrobust/tree/main/benchmarks/coco_o.
authors: Xiaofeng Mao, Yuefeng Chen, Yao Zhu, Da Chen, Hang Su, Rong Zhang, Hui Xue ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6339-6350

title: COMPASS:高效深度图像压缩与任意尺度空间可扩展性
title_en: COMPASS: High-Efficiency Deep Image Compression with Arbitrary-scale Spatial Scalability
abstract: 近年来,基于神经网络(NN)的图像压缩研究取得了积极进展,并在与传统方法的对比中展现出显著性能。然而,大多数工作集中于不可扩展的图像压缩(单层编码),而空间可扩展图像压缩尽管具有广泛的应用场景却受到较少关注。本文提出了一种新型基于神经网络的空间可扩展图像压缩方法,称为COMPASS,支持任意尺度空间可扩展性。我们的COMPASS具有非常灵活的结构,其中层数及其对应的尺度因子可在推理过程中任意确定。为减少任意尺度因子下相邻层之间的空间冗余,我们的COMPASS采用了一种基于隐式神经表示的层间任意尺度预测方法,称为LIFF。我们提出了一种联合RD损失函数以有效训练多层结构。实验结果表明,与SHVC及现有最先进的基于神经网络的空间可扩展图像压缩方法相比,我们的COMPASS在最大尺度因子组合下分别实现了-58.33%和-47.17%的BD-rate增益。此外,我们的COMPASS在多种尺度因子下展现出与单层编码相当甚至更优的编码效率。
abstract_en: Recently, neural network (NN)-based image compression studies have actively been made and has shown impressive performance in comparison to traditional methods. However, most of the works have focused on non-scalable image compression (single-layer coding) while spatially scalable image compression has drawn less attention although it has many applications. In this paper, we propose a novel NN-based spatially scalable image compression method, called COMPASS, which supports arbitrary-scale spatial scalability. Our proposed COMPASS has a very flexible structure where the number of layers and their respective scale factors can be arbitrarily determined during inference. To reduce the spatial redundancy between adjacent layers for arbitrary scale factors, our COMPASS adopts an inter-layer arbitrary scale prediction method, called LIFF, based on implicit neural representation. We propose a combined RD loss function to effectively train multiple layers. Experimental results show that our COMPASS achieves BD-rate gain of -58.33% and -47.17% at maximum compared to SHVC and the state-of-the-art NN-based spatially scalable image compression method, respectively, for various combinations of scale factors. Our COMPASS also shows comparable or even better coding efficiency than the single-layer coding for various scale factors.
authors: Jongmin Park, Jooyoung Lee, Munchurl Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12826-12835

title: COOL-CHIC:基于坐标的低复杂度分层图像编码器
title_en: COOL-CHIC: Coordinate-based Low Complexity Hierarchical Image Codec
abstract: 我们引入了COOL-CHIC,一种基于坐标的低复杂度分层图像编码器。它是一种基于学习的自编码器替代方案,具有629个参数和每解码像素680次乘法运算。COOL-CHIC的压缩性能接近现代传统MPEG编码器(如HEVC),并且与流行的基于自编码器的系统具有竞争力。该方法受到基于坐标的神经表示的启发,其中图像被表示为一个学习到的函数,该函数将像素坐标映射到RGB值。然后通过熵编码发送该映射函数的参数。在接收端,通过评估所有像素坐标的映射函数获得压缩图像。COOL-CHIC的实现已开源。
abstract_en: We introduce COOL-CHIC, a Coordinate-based Low Complexity Hierarchical Image Codec. It is a learned alternative to autoencoders with 629 parameters and 680 multiplications per decoded pixel. COOL-CHIC offers compression performance close to modern conventional MPEG codecs such as HEVC and is competitive with popular autoencoder-based systems. This method is inspired by Coordinate-based Neural Representations, where an image is represented as a learned function which maps pixel coordinates to RGB values. The parameters of the mapping function are then sent using entropy coding. At the receiver side, the compressed image is obtained by evaluating the mapping function for all pixel coordinates. COOL-CHIC implementation is made open-source.
authors: Théo Ladune, Pierrick Philippe, Félix Henry, Gordon Clare, Thomas Leguay ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13515-13522

title: COOP: 全身抓取姿态生成的解耦与耦合
title_en: COOP: Decoupling and Coupling of Whole-Body Grasping Pose Generation
abstract: 生成逼真全身人类抓取姿态在计算机图形学领域引起了广泛关注。现有研究已证明关键帧引导的运动生成框架在建模人类在目标物体置于面前时的时间序列抓取动作方面的有效性。然而,关键帧中生成的人体抓取姿态存在局限性,无法捕捉人类所能实现的全部抓取姿态范围。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种名为COOP(DeCOupling and COupling of Whole-Body GrasPing Pose Generation)的新框架,用于合成覆盖最广泛人类抓取能力的逼真全身姿态。在该框架中,我们首先将全身姿态解耦为身体姿态和手部姿态并分别建模,这使得我们可以轻松地使用领域外数据对身体模型进行预训练。随后,我们通过统一优化算法将这两个生成的身体部分进行耦合。此外,我们设计了一种简单的评估方法,用于评估模型在生成不同位置物体抓取姿态时的泛化能力。实验结果验证了我们方法的有效性和优越性。COOP作为全身姿态生成的即插即用组件在其他领域具有巨大潜力。我们的模型和代码可在https://github.com/zhengyanzhao1997/COOP获取。
abstract_en:
Generating life-like whole-body human grasping has garnered significant attention in the field of computer graphics. Existing works have demonstrated the effectiveness of keyframe-guided motion generation framework, witch focus on modeling the grasping motions of humans in temporal sequence when the target objects are placed in front of them. However, the generated grasping poses of the human body in the key-frames are limited, failing to capture the full range of grasping poses that humans are capable of.
 To address this issue, we propose a novel framework called COOP (DeCOupling and COupling of Whole-Body GrasPing Pose Generation) to synthesize life-like whole-body poses that cover the widest range of human grasping capabilities. In this framework, we first decouple the whole-body pose into body pose and hand pose and model them separately, which allows us to pre-train the body model with out-of-domain data easily. Then, we couple these two generated body parts through a unified optimization algorithm.
 Furthermore, we design a simple evaluation method to evaluate the generalization ability of models in generating grasping poses for objects placed at different positions. The experimental results demonstrate the efficacy and superiority of our method. And COOP holds great potential as a plug-and-play component for other domains in whole-body pose generation. Our models and code are available at https://github.com/zhengyanzhao1997/COOP.
authors: Yanzhao Zheng, Yunzhou Shi, Yuhao Cui, Zhongzhou Zhao, Zhiling Luo, Wei Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2163-2173

title: COPILOT:基于第一视角视频的人-环境碰撞预测与定位
title_en: COPILOT: Human-Environment Collision Prediction and Localization from Egocentric Videos
abstract: 从第一视角观测中预测人-环境碰撞的能力对于在虚拟现实(VR)、增强现实(AR)和可穿戴辅助机器人等应用中实现碰撞规避至关重要。在本研究中,我们引入了从佩戴式摄像头捕获的多视角第一视角视频中预测多样化环境中碰撞的具有挑战性的问题。解决这一问题需要一个可泛化的感知系统,该系统能够分类哪些人体关节会发生碰撞,并估计碰撞区域热图以在环境中定位碰撞。为此,我们提出了一种名为COPILOT的基于Transformer的模型,用于同时进行碰撞预测和定位,该模型通过新颖的四维时空视角注意力机制在多视角输入中积累信息。为了训练我们的模型并推动该任务的未来研究,我们开发了一个合成数据生成框架,该框架可生成虚拟人类在多样化三维环境中移动和碰撞的第一视角视频。该框架随后用于建立一个包含860万帧第一视角RGB-D图像的大规模数据集。大量实验表明,COPILOT能够泛化到未见过的合成场景和现实场景。我们进一步通过简单的闭环控制展示了COPILOT的输出对下游碰撞规避的实用性。请访问我们的项目网页:https://sites.google.com/stanford.edu/copilot。
abstract_en: The ability to forecast human-environment collisions from egocentric observations is vital to enable collision avoidance in applications such as VR, AR, and wearable assistive robotics. In this work, we introduce the challenging problem of predicting collisions in diverse environments from multi-view egocentric videos captured from body-mounted cameras. Solving this problem requires a generalizable perception system that can classify which human body joints will collide and estimate a collision region heatmap to localize collisions in the environment. To achieve this, we propose a transformer-based model called COPILOT to perform collision prediction and localization simultaneously, which accumulates information across multi-view inputs through a novel 4D space-time-viewpoint attention mechanism. To train our model and enable future research on this task, we develop a synthetic data generation framework that produces egocentric videos of virtual humans moving and colliding within diverse 3D environments. This framework is then used to establish a large-scale dataset consisting of 8.6M egocentric RGBD frames. Extensive experiments show that COPILOT generalizes to unseen synthetic as well as real-world scenes. We further demonstrate COPILOT outputs are useful for downstream collision avoidance through simple closed-loop control. Please visit our project webpage at https://sites.google.com/stanford.edu/copilot.
authors: Boxiao Pan, Bokui Shen, Davis Rempe, Despoina Paschalidou, Kaichun Mo, Yanchao Yang, Leonidas J. Guibas ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5262-5272

title: CORE:基于共面性正则化的单目几何弱监督估计
title_en: CORE: Co-planarity Regularized Monocular Geometry Estimation with Weak Supervision
abstract: 单目3D几何(深度图和表面法线)估计的不适定性使其主要依赖数据驱动方法如深度神经网络(DNN)。然而,表面法线(尤其是可靠法线)的数据获取被公认为困难。通常,高质量表面法线重建是启发式且耗时的。这一事实促使方法论减少对真实法线的依赖以预测3D几何。本文提出共面性正则化(CORE)损失函数和结构感知法线估计器(SANE)。无需任何真实法线知识,这两个设计使像素级3D几何估计仅通过真实深度图实现弱监督。对于CORE损失函数,核心思想是利用球坐标下局部线性深度-法线正交性作为像素级约束,并采用设计的自适应极坐标正则化(APR)解决潜在数值退化。同时,SANE通过CORE损失函数在深度和表面法线估计上建立多任务学习,实现整体性能跃升。大量实验验证了方法在各类DNN架构和数据基准上的有效性。实验结果表明,深度估计在室内场景所有指标上达到SOTA性能,户外场景表现相当。此外,表面法线估计整体更优。
abstract_en: The ill-posed nature of monocular 3D geometry (depth map and surface normals) estimation makes it rely mostly on data-driven approaches such as Deep Neural Networks (DNN). However, data acquisition of surface normals, especially the reliable normals, is acknowledged difficult. Commonly, reconstruction of surface normals with high quality is heuristic and time-consuming. Such fact urges methodologies to minimize dependency on ground-truth normals when predicting 3D geometry. In this work, we devise CO-planarity REgularized (CORE) loss functions and Structure-Aware Normal Estimator (SANE). Without involving any knowledge of ground-truth normals, these two designs enable pixel-wise 3D geometry estimation weakly supervised by only ground-truth depth map. For CORE loss functions, the key idea is to exploit locally linear depth-normal orthogonality under spherical coordinates as pixel-level constraints, and utilize our designed Adaptive Polar Regularization (APR) to resolve underlying numerical degeneracies. Meanwhile, SANE easily establishes multi-task learning with CORE loss functions on both depth and surface normal estimation, leading to the whole performance leap. Extensive experiments present the effectiveness of our method on various DNN architectures and data benchmarks. The experimental results demonstrate that our depth estimation achieves the state-of-the-art performance across all metrics on indoor scenes and comparable performance on outdoor scenes. In addition, our surface normal estimation is overall superior.
authors: Yuguang Li, Kai Wang, Hui Li, Seon-Min Rhee, Seungju Han, Jihye Kim, Min Yang, Ran Yang, Feng Zhu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8796-8805

title: CORE:多智能体感知的协同重建
title_en: CORE: Cooperative Reconstruction for Multi-Agent Perception
abstract: 本文提出CORE,这是一个概念上简单、有效且通信高效的多智能体协同感知模型。它从协同重建的新视角出发,基于两个关键洞察:1)合作智能体共同提供更全面的环境观察,2)全面的观察可作为有价值的监督,明确指导模型学习如何基于协作重建理想观察。CORE通过三个主要组件实现该理念:每个智能体的压缩器用于创建更紧凑的特征表示以实现高效广播,轻量级注意力协作组件用于跨智能体消息聚合,以及基于聚合特征表示的重建模块。这种学习重建的理念与任务无关,能提供清晰合理的监督以激发更有效的协作,最终促进感知任务。我们在两个大规模多智能体感知数据集OPV2V和V2X-Sim的两个任务(即3D目标检测和语义分割)中验证了CORE。结果表明,CORE实现了最先进性能,并具有更高的通信效率。
abstract_en: This paper presents CORE, a conceptually simple, effective and communication-efficient model for multi-agent cooperative perception. It addresses the task from a novel perspective of cooperative reconstruction, based on two key insights: 1) cooperating agents together provide a more holistic observation of the environment, and 2) the holistic observation can serve as valuable supervision to explicitly guide the model learning how to reconstruct the ideal observation based on collaboration. CORE instantiates the idea with three major components: a compressor for each agent to create more compact feature representation for efficient broadcasting, a lightweight attentive collaboration component for cross-agent message aggregation, and a reconstruction module to reconstruct the observation based on aggregated feature representations. This learning-to-reconstruct idea is task-agnostic, and offers clear and reasonable supervision to inspire more effective collaboration, eventually promoting perception tasks. We validate CORE on two large-scale multi-agent percetion dataset, OPV2V and V2X-Sim, in two tasks, i.e., 3D object detection and semantic segmentation. Results demonstrate that CORE achieves state-of-the-art performance, and is more communication-efficient.
authors: Binglu Wang, Lei Zhang, Zhaozhong Wang, Yongqiang Zhao, Tianfei Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8710-8720

title: CPCM:面向弱监督点云语义分割的上下文点云建模
title_en: CPCM: Contextual Point Cloud Modeling for Weakly-supervised Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation
abstract: 我们研究了在稀疏标注(例如少于0.1%的点被标注)条件下弱监督点云语义分割任务,旨在降低密集标注的高昂成本。不幸的是,由于标注点极其稀疏,对于场景理解(如语义分割)提取上下文和物体信息变得非常困难。受图像和视频表示学习中掩码建模(如MAE)的启发,我们试图赋予掩码建模能力,从稀疏标注的点中学习上下文信息。然而,直接将MAE应用于稀疏标注的3D点云可能无法有效工作。首先,从3D点云中有效掩码出信息量大的视觉上下文具有非平凡的挑战性。其次,如何充分利用稀疏标注进行上下文建模仍是一个开放性问题。本文提出了一种简单而有效的上下文点云建模(CPCM)方法,包含两个部分:区域级掩码(RegionMask)策略和上下文掩码训练(CMT)方法。具体而言,RegionMask在几何空间中连续掩码点云,以构建有意义的掩码预测任务用于后续上下文学习。CMT分离监督分割学习与无监督掩码上下文预测的学习过程,分别有效学习有限的标注点和大量未标注点。在广泛测试的ScanNet V2和S3DIS基准上的大量实验验证了CPCM优于现有最先进方法的优越性。
abstract_en: We study the task of weakly-supervised point cloud semantic segmentation with sparse annotations (e.g., less than 0.1% points are labeled), aiming to reduce the expensive cost of dense annotations. Unfortunately, with extremely sparse annotated points, it is very difficult to extract both contextual and object information for scene understanding such as semantic segmentation. Motivated by masked modeling (e.g., MAE) in image and video representation learning, we seek to endow the power of masked modeling to learn contextual information from sparsely-annotated points. However, directly applying MAE to 3D point clouds with sparse annotations may fail to work. First, it is nontrivial to effectively mask out the informative visual context from 3D point clouds. Second, how to fully exploit the sparse annotations for context modeling remains an open question. In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective Contextual Point Cloud Modeling (CPCM) method that consists of two parts: a region-wise masking (RegionMask) strategy and a contextual masked training (CMT) method. Specifically, RegionMask masks the point cloud continuously in geometric space to construct a meaningful masked prediction task for subsequent context learning. CMT disentangles the learning of supervised segmentation and unsupervised masked context prediction for effectively learning the very limited labeled points and mass unlabeled points, respectively. Extensive experiments on the widely-tested ScanNet V2 and S3DIS benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of CPCM over the state-of-the-art.
authors: Lizhao Liu, Zhuangwei Zhuang, Shangxin Huang, Xunlong Xiao, Tianhang Xiang, Cen Chen, Jingdong Wang, Mingkui Tan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18413-18422

title: CRN: 用于高精度、鲁棒性、高效三维感知的相机雷达网络
title_en: CRN: Camera Radar Net for Accurate, Robust, Efficient 3D Perception
abstract: 自动驾驶需要一个准确且快速的三维感知系统,包括三维目标检测、跟踪和分割。尽管近期低成本相机方法已取得 promising results,但其易受光照条件差或恶劣天气影响,并存在较大的定位误差。因此,融合提供精确长距离测量且在所有环境下均能可靠运行的低成本雷达,具有前景但尚未被充分研究。本文提出 Camera Radar Net (CRN),一种新颖的相机-雷达融合框架,可为多种任务生成语义丰富且空间精确的鸟瞰图(BEV)特征图。为克服图像中空间信息的缺失,我们借助稀疏但精确的雷达点,将透视视图图像特征转换为 BEV。进一步地,我们通过多模态可变形注意力机制在 BEV 中聚合图像与雷达特征图,以解决输入间的空间错位问题。在实时设置下,CRN 以 20 FPS 运行,其在 nuScenes 数据集上的性能与激光雷达检测器相当,甚至在 100m 设置下表现更优。此外,在离线设置下,CRN 在 nuScenes 测试集上取得 62.4% NDS 和 57.5% mAP,位列所有相机及相机-雷达三维目标检测器之首。
abstract_en: Autonomous driving requires an accurate and fast 3D perception system that includes 3D object detection, tracking, and segmentation. Although recent low-cost camera-based approaches have shown promising results, they are susceptible to poor illumination or bad weather conditions and have a large localization error. Hence, fusing camera with low-cost radar, which provides precise long-range measurement and operates reliably in all environments, is promising but has not yet been thoroughly investigated. In this paper, we propose Camera Radar Net (CRN), a novel camera-radar fusion framework that generates a semantically rich and spatially accurate bird's-eye-view (BEV) feature map for various tasks. To overcome the lack of spatial information in an image, we transform perspective view image features to BEV with the help of sparse but accurate radar points. We further aggregate image and radar feature maps in BEV using multi-modal deformable attention designed to tackle the spatial misalignment between inputs. CRN with real-time setting operates at 20 FPS while achieving comparable performance to LiDAR detectors on nuScenes, and even outperforms at a far distance on 100m setting. Moreover, CRN with offline setting yields 62.4% NDS, 57.5% mAP on nuScenes test set and ranks first among all camera and camera-radar 3D object detectors.
authors: Youngseok Kim, Juyeb Shin, Sanmin Kim, In-Jae Lee, Jun Won Choi, Dongsuk Kum ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17615-17626

title: CROSSFIRE: 基于隐式表示自监督特征的相机重定位
title_en: CROSSFIRE: Camera Relocalization On Self-Supervised Features from an Implicit Representation
abstract: 超越新视角合成,神经辐射场对与现实世界交互的应用具有重要价值。本文将神经辐射场作为给定场景的隐式映射,提出一种针对该表示方法量身定制的相机重定位算法。所提方法能够在设备导航过程中,通过单个RGB摄像头实时计算其精确位置。与以往工作不同,我们不依赖姿态回归或光度对齐,而是通过体渲染获取的密集局部特征,以自监督目标对场景进行专业化处理。因此,我们的算法在精度上优于竞争对手,能够适应动态户外环境中的变化光照条件,并可便捷集成至任何体神经渲染器。
abstract_en: Beyond novel view synthesis, Neural Radiance Fields are useful for applications that interact with the real world. In this paper, we use them as an implicit map of a given scene and propose a camera relocalization algorithm tailored for this representation. The proposed method enables to compute in real-time the precise position of a device using a single RGB camera, during its navigation. In contrast with previous work, we do not rely on pose regression or photometric alignment but rather use dense local features obtained through volumetric rendering which are specialized on the scene with a self-supervised objective. As a result, our algorithm is more accurate than competitors, able to operate in dynamic outdoor environments with changing lightning conditions and can be readily integrated in any volumetric neural renderer.
authors: Arthur Moreau, Nathan Piasco, Moussab Bennehar, Dzmitry Tsishkou, Bogdan Stanciulescu, Arnaud de La Fortelle ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 252-262

title: CSDA:面向领域自适应目标检测的类别-尺度联合特征学习
title_en: CSDA: Learning Category-Scale Joint Feature for Domain Adaptive Object Detection
abstract: 领域自适应目标检测(DAOD)旨在通过最小化源域和目标域之间的特征分布来提升目标域的检测性能。近期方法通常通过对抗学习在类别层面对齐此类分布并取得了一定进展。然而,当物体在不同尺度上非均匀分布时,此类类别级对齐会导致物体特征学习失衡,称为不同尺度下的类别对齐不一致性。为实现更优的类别级特征对齐,我们提出了一种联合类别与尺度信息的新型DAOD框架,称为CSDA。该设计使不同尺度下的物体学习更加有效。具体而言,我们的框架由两个紧密关联的模块实现:1)SGFF(尺度引导特征融合)融合不同域的类别表征以学习类别特异性特征,其中特征通过判别器在三个尺度上对齐。2)SAFE(尺度辅助特征增强)将尺度坐标编码为一组token,并通过自注意力机制增强不同尺度下类别特异性特征的表征。基于基于锚点的Faster-RCNN和无锚点的FCOS检测器,实验表明我们的方法在三个DAOD基准数据集上取得了最先进的结果。
abstract_en: Domain Adaptive Object Detection (DAOD) aims to improve the detection performance of target domains by minimizing the feature distribution between the source and target domain. Recent approaches usually align such distributions in terms of categories through adversarial learning and some progress has been made. However, when objects are non-uniformly distributed at different scales, such category-level alignment causes imbalanced object feature learning, refer as the inconsistency of category alignment at different scales. For better category-level feature alignment, we propose a novel DAOD framework of joint category and scale information, dubbed CSDA, such a design enables effective object learning for different scales. Specifically, our framework is implemented by two closely-related modules: 1) SGFF (Scale-Guided Feature Fusion) fuses the category representations of different domains to learn category-specific features, where the features are aligned by discriminators at three scales. 2) SAFE (Scale-Auxiliary Feature Enhancement) encodes scale coordinates into a group of tokens and enhances the representation of category-specific features at different scales by self-attention. Based on the anchor-based Faster-RCNN and anchor-free FCOS detectors, experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art results on three DAOD benchmarks.
authors: Changlong Gao, Chengxu Liu, Yujie Dun, Xueming Qian ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11421-11430

title: CTP: 通过兼容动量对比与拓扑保持实现视觉-语言持续预训练
title_en: CTP:Towards Vision-Language Continual Pretraining via Compatible Momentum Contrast and Topology Preservation
abstract: 视觉-语言预训练(VLP)通过在大规模数据集上进行离线训练,在多样化的下游任务中展现出显著效果。然而,面对现实世界数据的持续增长特性,这种离线训练范式在数据不断扩展的场景下难以持续,因为模型缺乏持续学习能力以不断积累知识。然而,大多数持续学习研究局限于单模态分类,现有多模态数据集无法模拟持续非平稳数据流场景。为支持视觉-语言持续预训练(VLCP)研究,我们首先贡献了一个全面且统一的基准数据集P9D,包含来自9个行业的超过一百万的产品图像-文本对。每个行业对应的数据作为独立任务支持持续学习,并符合现实世界的长尾特性以模拟网络数据预训练。我们全面研究了VLCP的特性与挑战,并提出了一种新算法:兼容动量对比与拓扑保持(CTP)。兼容动量模型通过吸收当前任务和先前任务模型的知识,灵活更新模态特征。此外,拓扑保持在任务间转移嵌入知识的同时保留特征调整的灵活性。实验结果表明,我们的方法不仅在与其他基线模型的对比中表现出优越性能,且未带来高昂的训练负担。数据集和代码已开源,详见https://github.com/KevinLight831/CTP。
abstract_en: Vision-Language Pretraining (VLP) has shown impressive results on diverse downstream tasks by offline training on large-scale datasets. Regarding the growing nature of real-world data, such an offline training paradigm on ever-expanding data is unsustainable, because models lack the continual learning ability to accumulate knowledge constantly. However, most continual learning studies are limited to uni-modal classification and existing multi-modal datasets cannot simulate continual non-stationary data stream scenarios. To support the study of Vision-Language Continual Pretraining (VLCP), we first contribute a comprehensive and unified benchmark dataset P9D which contains over one million product image-text pairs from 9 industries. The data from each industry as an independent task supports continual learning and conforms to the real-world long-tail nature to simulate pretraining on web data. We comprehensively study the characteristics and challenges of VLCP, and propose a new algorithm: Compatible momentum contrast with Topology Preservation, dubbed CTP. The compatible momentum model absorbs the knowledge of the current and previous-task models to flexibly update the modal feature. Moreover, Topology Preservation transfers the knowledge of embedding across tasks while preserving the flexibility of feature adjustment. The experimental results demonstrate our method not only achieves superior performance compared with other baselines but also does not bring an expensive training burden. Dataset and codes are available at https://github.com/KevinLight831/CTP.
authors: Hongguang Zhu, Yunchao Wei, Xiaodan Liang, Chunjie Zhang, Yao Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22257-22267

title: CTVIS:在线视频实例分割的一致性训练
title_en: CTVIS: Consistent Training for Online Video Instance Segmentation
abstract: 实例嵌入的区分能力在在线视频实例分割(VIS)中关联跨时间实例起着至关重要的作用。实例嵌入学习直接通过对比项(CIs)计算的对比损失进行监督,这些对比项(CIs)是锚点/正样本/负样本嵌入的集合。近期的在线VIS方法仅从单一参考帧获取CIs,我们认为这不足以学习高度区分性的嵌入。直观上,增强CIs的一种可能策略是在训练中复制推理阶段。为此,我们提出了一种简单而有效的训练策略,称为在线VIS一致性训练(CTVIS),致力于在构建CIs方面对齐训练和推理流程。具体而言,CTVIS通过参考动量平均嵌入和内存库存储机制,并对相关嵌入添加噪声来构建CIs。这种扩展使得当前实例嵌入与历史实例稳定表示之间的可靠比较成为可能,从而在建模遮挡、重识别和形变等VIS挑战方面具有优势。实证结果表明,CTVIS在三个VIS基准测试(YTVIS19(55.1% AP)、YTVIS21(50.1% AP)和OVIS(35.5% AP))中超越了SOTA VIS模型,最高提升达+5.0个百分点。此外,我们发现从图像转换而来的伪视频可以训练出超越全监督模型的鲁棒模型。
abstract_en: The discrimination of instance embeddings plays a vital role in associating instances across time for online video instance segmentation (VIS).
