To achieve general low-light video enhancement, we also propose a novel Retinex-based method named Light Adjustable Network (LAN). LAN iteratively refines the illumination and adaptively adjusts it under varying lighting conditions, leading to visually appealing results even in diverse real-world scenarios. The extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our low-light video dataset and enhancement method. Our dataset and code will be publicly available.
authors: Huiyuan Fu, Wenkai Zheng, Xicong Wang, Jiaxuan Wang, Heng Zhang, Huadong Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12877-12886

title: DandelionNet: 领域组合与实例自适应分类的领域泛化
title_en: DandelionNet: Domain Composition with Instance Adaptive Classification for Domain Generalization
abstract: 领域泛化(DG)旨在学习一个在源域上训练的模型,使其能够良好地泛化到未见过但不同的目标域。多个源域在分布上本就存在差异,但内在上相互关联,例如来自相同的标签空间。为了获得可泛化的特征,现有方法大多通过学习领域不变特征或额外挖掘领域特定特征来减少领域差异。在这些特征空间中,多个源域要么紧密对齐,要么完全不对齐,这两种方式都无法充分利用多域间的互补信息。为了在减少领域差异的同时保留更多多域互补信息,我们提出多个领域不应紧密对齐而是组合在一起,其中所有领域被拉近但各自保持个体性。这通过为每个实例的分类指定实例自适应分类器实现,其中实例自适应分类器略微偏离所有域样本共享的通用分类器。这种自适应分类器偏差使得同一类别但不同域的实例能够围绕类别中心分散分布而非紧密挤压,从而提升对未见域样本的泛化能力。最终,多个领域和谐地组合在通用核心上,如同蒲公英,因此该方法称为DandelionNet。在多个DG基准上的实验表明,所提方法能够学习到泛化性能更优的模型,源域无监督域适应实验也验证了其通用性。
abstract_en: Domain generalization (DG) attempts to learn a model on source domains that can well generalize to unseen but different domains. The multiple source domains are innately different in distribution but intrinsically related to each other, e.g., from the same label space. To achieve a generalizable feature, most existing methods attempt to reduce the domain discrepancy by either learning domain-invariant feature, or additionally mining domain-specific feature. In the space of these features, the multiple source domains are either tightly aligned or not aligned at all, which both cannot fully take the advantage of complementary information from multiple domains. In order to preserve more complementary information from multiple domains at the meantime of reducing their domain gap, we propose that the multiple domains should not be tightly aligned but composite together, where all domains are pulled closer but still preserve their individuality respectively. This is achieved by using instance-adaptive classifier specified for each instance's classification, where the instance-adaptive classifier is slightly deviated from a universal classifier shared by samples from all domains. This adaptive classifier deviation allows all instances from the same category but different domains to be dispersed around the class center rather than squeezed tightly, leading to better generalization for unseen domain samples. In result, the multiple domains are harmoniously composite centered on a universal core, like a dandelion, so this work is referred to as DandelionNet. Experiments on multiple DG benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method can learn a model with better generalization and experiments on source free domain adaption also indicate the versatility.
authors: Lanqing Hu, Meina Kan, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19050-19059

title: DarSwin: 失真感知径向Swin Transformer
title_en: DarSwin: Distortion Aware Radial Swin Transformer
abstract: 广角镜头常用于需要大视野的感知任务中。不幸的是,这些镜头会产生显著的失真,使得忽略失真效应的传统模型难以适应广角图像。本文提出了一种新型的基于Transformer的模型,能够自动适应广角镜头产生的失真。我们利用此类镜头的物理特性(通过径向失真曲线分析定义,假设已知),开发了失真感知径向Swin Transformer(DarSwin)。与传统Transformer架构不同,DarSwin包含径向分块划分、基于失真的采样技术用于创建token嵌入,以及用于径向分块合并的角位置编码。我们在使用合成失真ImageNet数据的分类任务上验证了我们的方法,并通过大量实验表明,DarSwin能够实现对未见过的广角镜头失真的零样本适应。与其它基线方法相比,当在有限失真水平(非常低、低、中、高)上训练并在所有包括分布外失真上测试时,DarSwin在Top-1准确率方面取得了显著提升的最佳结果。代码和模型已公开在https://lvsn.github.io/darswin/上。
abstract_en: Wide-angle lenses are commonly used in perception tasks requiring a large field of view. Unfortunately, these lenses produce significant distortions making conventional models that ignore the distortion effects unable to adapt to wide-angle images. In this paper, we present a novel transformer-based model that automatically adapts to the distortion produced by wide-angle lenses. We leverage the physical characteristics of such lenses, which are analytically defined by the radial distortion profile (assumed to be known), to develop a distortion aware radial swin transformer (DarSwin). In contrast to conventional transformer-based architectures, DarSwin comprises a radial patch partitioning, a distortion-based sampling technique for creating token embeddings, and an angular position encoding for radial patch merging. We validate our method on classification tasks using synthetically distorted ImageNet data and show through extensive experiments that DarSwin can perform zero-shot adaptation to unseen distortions of different wide-angle lenses. Compared to other baselines, DarSwin achieves the best results (in terms of Top-1 accuracy) with significant gains when trained on bounded levels of distortions (very-low, low, medium, and high) and tested on all including out-of-distribution distortions. The code and models are publicly available at https://lvsn.github.io/darswin/
authors: Akshaya Athwale, Arman Afrasiyabi, Justin Lagüe, Ichrak Shili, Ola Ahmad, Jean-François Lalonde ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5929-5938

title: 暗面增强:生成多样化夜间示例用于度量学习
title_en: Dark Side Augmentation: Generating Diverse Night Examples for Metric Learning
abstract: 基于CNN描述符的图像检索方法依赖于从大量正负图像对的多样化示例中进行的度量学习。像夜间图像这样的领域,由于训练数据的可用性和多样性有限,即使在标准基准上表现良好的方法也会导致检索性能下降。我们提出训练一种基于GAN的合成图像生成器,将可用的白天图像示例转换为夜间图像。此类生成器作为增强手段用于度量学习,为数据稀缺的领域提供训练数据。我们评估并分析了各种类型的生成器。我们贡献了一种新颖的轻量级GAN架构,通过边缘一致性强制原始图像与转换图像之间的一致性。所提出的架构还允许同时训练一种在夜间和白天图像上均能运行的边缘检测器。为了进一步增加训练示例的多样性并最大化训练模型的泛化能力,我们提出了一种新颖的多样化锚点挖掘方法。所提出的方法在标准的Tokyo 24/7昼夜检索基准上超越了现有最先进的结果,同时保持了在Oxford和Paris数据集上的性能。这一成果无需匹配昼夜图像的训练对即可实现。源代码可在https://github.com/mohwald/gandtr获取。
abstract_en:
Image retrieval methods based on CNN descriptors rely on metric learning from a large number of diverse examples of positive and negative image pairs. Domains, such as night-time images, with limited availability and variability of training data suffer from poor retrieval performance even with methods performing well on standard benchmarks. We propose to train a GAN-based synthetic-image generator, translating available day-time image examples into night images. Such a generator is used in metric learning as a form of augmentation, supplying training data to the scarce domain. Various types of generators are evaluated and analyzed. We contribute with a novel light-weight GAN architecture that enforces the consistency between the original and translated image through edge consistency. The proposed architecture also allows a simultaneous training of an edge detector that operates on both night and day images. To further increase the variability in the training examples and to maximize the generalization of the trained model, we propose a novel method of diverse anchor mining. 
  
 The proposed method improves over the state-of-the-art results on a standard Tokyo 24/7 day-night retrieval benchmark while preserving the performance on Oxford and Paris datasets. This is achieved without the need of training image pairs of matching day and night images. The source code is available at https://github.com/mohwald/gandtr .
authors: Albert Mohwald, Tomas Jenicek, Ondřej Chum ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11153-11163

title: 面向持续学习的数据增强平坦性感知梯度投影方法
title_en: Data Augmented Flatness-aware Gradient Projection for Continual Learning
abstract: 持续学习(CL)的目标是在不遗忘先前学习的老任务的前提下持续学习新任务。为缓解灾难性遗忘,基于梯度投影的CL方法要求新任务的梯度更新与老任务张成的子空间正交。这限制了学习过程并导致因投影约束过强而新任务性能下降。本文首先从损失曲面平坦性的视角重新审视梯度投影方法,发现当投影约束被降低以提升新任务性能时,损失曲面的非平坦性会导致老任务的灾难性遗忘。基于此发现,我们提出一种数据增强平坦性感知梯度投影(DFGP)方法来解决问题,该方法包含三个模块:数据和权重扰动、平坦性感知优化和梯度投影。具体而言,我们首先对任务数据和当前权重进行平坦性感知扰动以找到使任务损失最差的情形。随后,平坦性感知优化在原始和最坏情况扰动数据上同时优化损失和损失曲面的平坦性,以获得平坦性感知梯度。最后,梯度投影沿与老任务子空间正交的方向使用平坦性感知梯度更新网络。在四个数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法提升了损失曲面的平坦性与新任务性能,并在所有任务的平均准确率上达到了最先进(SOTA)水平。
abstract_en: The goal of continual learning (CL) is to continuously learn new tasks without forgetting previously learned old tasks. To alleviate catastrophic forgetting, gradient projection based CL methods require that the gradient updates of new tasks are orthogonal to the subspace spanned by old tasks. This limits the learning process and leads to poor performance on the new task due to the projection constraint being too strong. In this paper, we first revisit the gradient projection method from the perspective of flatness of loss surface, and find that unflatness of the loss surface leads to catastrophic forgetting of the old tasks when the projection constraint is reduced to improve the performance of new tasks. Based on our findings, we propose a Data Augmented Flatness-aware Gradient Projection (DFGP) method to solve the problem, which consists of three modules: data and weight perturbation, flatness-aware optimization, and gradient projection. Specifically, we first perform a flatness-aware perturbation on the task data and current weights to find the case that makes the task loss worst. Next, flatness-aware optimization optimizes both the loss and the flatness of the loss surface on raw and worst-case perturbed data to obtain a flatness-aware gradient. Finally, gradient projection updates the network with the flatness-aware gradient along directions orthogonal to the subspace of the old tasks. Extensive experiments on four datasets show that our method improves the flatness of loss surface and the performance of new tasks, and achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in the average accuracy of all tasks.
authors: Enneng Yang, Li Shen, Zhenyi Wang, Shiwei Liu, Guibing Guo, Xingwei Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5630-5639

title: 无数据类增量手部手势识别
title_en: Data-Free Class-Incremental Hand Gesture Recognition
abstract: 本文研究了用于从三维骨架序列进行手部手势识别的无数据类增量学习(DFCIL)。在该类增量学习(CIL)设置中,当逐步注册新类别时,由于隐私问题,我们无法访问已知类别的训练样本(即无数据)。现有DFCIL方法主要关注通过知识蒸馏的各种形式进行模型反演以缓解灾难性遗忘。与现有最先进的方法不同,我们更深入地探讨了用于反演的最佳样本选择。受最大边距分类理论的坚实基础启发,我们发现最佳样本倾向于位于合理边距内的近似决策边界附近。为此,我们提出了BOAT-MI——一种简单有效的边界感知原型采样机制,用于DFCIL的模型反演。我们的采样方案在两个三维骨架手势数据集——公开可用的SHREC 2017和我们从公开可用RGBD数据集中提取的EgoGesture3D上显著优于现有最先进的方法。我们的代码库和EgoGesture3D骨架数据集均公开可用:https://github.com/humansensinglab/dfcil-hgr
abstract_en:
This paper investigates data-free class-incremental learning (DFCIL) 
 for hand gesture recognition from 3D skeleton sequences. 
 In this class-incremental learning (CIL) setting, while incrementally 
 registering the new classes, we do not have access to the training 
 samples (i.e. data-free) of the already known classes due to privacy. 
 Existing DFCIL methods primarily focus on various forms of 
 knowledge distillation for model inversion to mitigate 
 catastrophic forgetting. Unlike SOTA methods, 
 we delve deeper into the choice of the best samples for inversion. 
 Inspired by the well-grounded theory of max-margin classification, 
 we find that the best samples tend to lie close to the approximate 
 decision boundary within a reasonable margin. To this end, 
 we propose BOAT-MI -- a simple and effective boundary-aware prototypical 
 sampling mechanism for model inversion for DFCIL. 
 Our sampling scheme outperforms SOTA methods significantly 
 on two 3D skeleton gesture datasets, the publicly available 
 SHREC 2017, and EgoGesture3D -- which we extract from a publicly 
 available RGBD dataset. Both our codebase and the EgoGesture3D 
 skeleton dataset are publicly available: https://github.com/humansensinglab/dfcil-hgr
authors: Shubhra Aich, Jesus Ruiz-Santaquiteria, Zhenyu Lu, Prachi Garg, K J Joseph, Alvaro Fernandez Garcia, Vineeth N Balasubramanian, Kenrick Kin, Chengde Wan, Necati Cihan Camgoz, Shugao Ma, Fernando De la Torre ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20958-20967

title: 无数据知识蒸馏用于细粒度视觉分类
title_en: Data-free Knowledge Distillation for Fine-grained Visual Categorization
abstract: 无数据知识蒸馏(DFKD)是解决模型压缩、安全隐私及传输限制等问题的有前景方法。尽管现有基于DFKD的方法在粗粒度分类任务中取得了显著成果,但在需要更细致区分相似类别的细粒度分类实际应用中,仍存在次优表现。为解决此问题,我们提出DFKD-FGVC方法,将DFKD扩展至细粒度视觉分类(FGVC)任务。本方法采用包含注意力生成器的对抗性蒸馏框架,结合混合高阶注意力蒸馏与语义特征对比学习。具体而言,我们向生成器引入空间注意力机制,合成包含更多判别部分细节的细粒度图像;同时利用混合高阶注意力机制捕捉部件间的复杂交互关系及细粒度类别判别特征的细微差异,兼顾局部特征与语义上下文关系。此外,我们通过蒸馏框架中的教师-学生模型,在超空间中对比高层语义特征图,比较不同类别的特征方差。我们在三个广泛使用的FGVC基准数据集(Aircraft、Cars196和CUB200)上评估了该方法,验证了其优越性能。
abstract_en: Data-free knowledge distillation (DFKD) is a promising approach for addressing issues related to model compression, security privacy, and transmission restrictions. Although the existing methods exploiting DFKD have achieved inspiring achievements in coarse-grained classification, in practical applications involving fine-grained classification tasks that require more detailed distinctions between similar categories, sub-optimal results are obtained. To address this issue, we propose an approach called DFKD-FGVC that extends DFKD to fine-grained vision categorization (FGVC) tasks. Our approach utilizes an adversarial distillation framework with attention generator, mixed high-order attention distillation, and semantic feature contrast learning. Specifically, we introduce a spatial-wise attention mechanism to the generator to synthesize fine-grained images with more details of discriminative parts. We also utilize the mixed high-order attention mechanism to capture complex interactions among parts and the subtle differences among discriminative features of the fine-grained categories, paying attention to both local features and semantic context relationships. Moreover, we leverage the teacher and student models of the distillation framework to contrast high-level semantic feature maps in the hyperspace, comparing variances of different categories. We evaluate our approach on three widely-used FGVC benchmarks (Aircraft, Cars196, and CUB200) and demonstrate its superior performance.
authors: Renrong Shao, Wei Zhang, Jianhua Yin, Jun Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1515-1525

title: DataDAM:基于注意力匹配的高效数据集蒸馏
title_en: DataDAM: Efficient Dataset Distillation with Attention Matching
abstract: 研究人员长期致力于在保持多样化数据集强泛化能力的同时最小化深度学习的训练成本。新兴的数据集蒸馏研究通过创建包含较大真实数据集信息的小型合成数据集来降低训练成本,最终实现与在完整数据集上训练模型相当的测试精度。不幸的是,先前方法生成的合成数据无法保证与原始训练数据在分布和区分能力上的表现,并且计算成本显著。尽管取得有前景的结果,但使用压缩合成数据集训练的模型与完整数据集训练的模型之间仍存在显著性能差距。本文通过高效的注意力匹配数据集蒸馏(DataDAM)方法解决这些挑战,在降低训练成本的同时达到最先进性能。具体而言,我们通过匹配不同层在随机初始化神经网络家族中生成的真实数据与合成数据的空间注意力图来学习合成图像。我们的方法在多个数据集(包括CIFAR10/100、TinyImageNet、ImageNet-1K及其子集)上超越了先前方法,在CIFAR100和ImageNet-1K上分别实现了6.5%和4.1%的性能提升。我们还证明了高质量的蒸馏图像对下游应用(如持续学习和神经架构搜索)具有实际价值。
abstract_en: Researchers have long tried to minimize training costs in deep learning while maintaining strong generalization across diverse datasets. Emerging research on dataset distillation aims to reduce training costs by creating a small synthetic set that contains the information of a larger real dataset and ultimately achieves test accuracy equivalent to a model trained on the whole dataset. Unfortunately, the synthetic data generated by previous methods are not guaranteed to distribute and discriminate as well as the original training data, and they incur significant computational costs. Despite promising results, there still exists a significant performance gap between models trained on condensed synthetic sets and those trained on the whole dataset. In this paper, we address these challenges using efficient Dataset Distillation with Attention Matching (DataDAM), achieving state-of-the-art performance while reducing training costs. Specifically, we learn synthetic images by matching the spatial attention maps of real and synthetic data generated by different layers within a family of randomly initialized neural networks. Our method outperforms the prior methods on several datasets, including CIFAR10/100, TinyImageNet, ImageNet-1K, and subsets of ImageNet-1K across most of the settings, and achieves improvements of up to 6.5% and 4.1% on CIFAR100 and ImageNet-1K, respectively. We also show that our high-quality distilled images have practical benefits for downstream applications, such as continual learning and neural architecture search.
authors: Ahmad Sajedi, Samir Khaki, Ehsan Amjadian, Lucy Z. Liu, Yuri A. Lawryshyn, Konstantinos N. Plataniotis ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17097-17107

title: 数据集量化
title_en: Dataset Quantization
abstract: 当前最先进的深度神经网络需要使用大量(数百万甚至数十亿)数据进行训练。高昂的计算和内存成本使得在有限的硬件资源上训练这些模型变得困难,尤其是近期流行的大语言模型(LLM)和计算机视觉模型(CV)。因此,近期流行的数据集蒸馏方法被开发出来,旨在通过梯度匹配合成小规模数据集以减少训练样本数量。然而,由于梯度计算与特定网络架构密切相关,合成的数据集存在偏差,在用于训练未见过的架构时表现不佳。为了解决这些局限性,我们提出了数据集量化(DQ),一种新的框架,可将大规模数据集压缩为小子集,可用于训练任何神经网络架构。大量实验表明,DQ能够以无损模型训练的最先进压缩率生成用于训练未见过网络架构的浓缩小数据集。据我们所知,DQ是首个能够成功蒸馏如ImageNet-1k等大规模数据集并实现最先进压缩率的方法。值得注意的是,使用ImageNet的60%数据和Alpaca指令调优数据的20%,模型在视觉任务(包括分类、语义分割和目标检测)以及语言任务(包括BBH和DROP等指令调优任务)中均可实现几乎无性能下降或无性能下降的训练。
abstract_en:
State-of-the-art deep neural networks are trained with large amounts (millions or even billions) of data. The expensive computation and memory costs make it difficult to train them on limited hardware resources, especially for recent popular large language models (LLM) and computer vision models (CV). Recent popular dataset distillation methods are thus developed, aiming to reduce the number of training samples via synthesizing small-scale datasets via gradient matching. However, as the gradient calculation is coupled with the specific network architecture, the synthesized dataset is biased and performs poorly when used for training unseen architectures. To address these limitations, we present dataset quantization (DQ), a
 new framework to compress large-scale datasets into small subsets which can be used for training any neural network architectures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DQ is able to generate condensed small datasets for training
 unseen network architectures with state-of-the-art compression ratios for lossless model training. To the best of our knowledge, DQ is the first method that can successfully distill large-scale datasets such as ImageNet-1k with a state-of-the-art compression ratio. Notably, with 60% data from ImageNet and 20% data from Alpaca's instruction tuning data, the models can be trained with negligible or no performance drop for both vision tasks (including classification, semantic segmentation, and object detection) as well as language tasks (including instruction tuning tasks such as BBH and DROP).
authors: Daquan Zhou, Kai Wang, Jianyang Gu, Xiangyu Peng, Dongze Lian, Yifan Zhang, Yang You, Jiashi Feng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17205-17216

title: DeFormer:将Transformer与可变形模型结合实现单图像三维形状抽象
title_en: DeFormer: Integrating Transformers with Deformable Models for 3D Shape Abstraction from a Single Image
abstract: 从单张二维图像中显式提取三维形状是计算机视觉与图形学领域长期存在的难题。通过利用一组基础元素表示目标形状,近期方法已取得 promising results(__ABS_MATH_1__)。然而,这些方法要么需要较多基础元素,要么因基础元素低维表达能力不足而缺乏几何灵活性。本文提出一种新型双通道 Transformer 架构,集成参数化可变形模型,命名为 DeFormer,可同时估计全局与局部形变。这样,DeFormer 可以在使用少量基础元素的情况下抽象复杂物体形状,这些基础元素具有更广的几何覆盖范围和更精细的细节。随后,我们引入力驱动的动态拟合和循环一致性重投影损失来优化基础元素参数。在 ShapeNet 上的大量实验表明,DeFormer 在多种设置下均优于现有方法,且通过一致的语义对应关系可视化,提升了可解释性。
abstract_en: Explicit 3D shape abstraction from a single 2D image is a long-standing problem in computer vision and graphics. By leveraging a set of primitives to represent the target shape, recent methods have achieved promising results. However, these methods either use a relatively larger number of primitives or lack geometric flexibility due to the low-dimensional expressibility of the primitives. In this paper, we propose a novel bi-channel Transformer architecture, integrated with parameterized deformable models, termed DeFormer, to simultaneously estimate global and local deformations. In this way, DeFormer can abstract complex object shapes while using a small number of primitives which offer a broader geometry coverage and finer details. Then, we introduce a force-driven dynamic fitting and a cycle-consistent re-projection loss to optimize the primitive parameters. Extensive experiments on ShapeNet across various settings show that DeFormer achieves better reconstruction accuracy over the state-of-the-art, and visualizes with consistent semantic correspondences for improved interpretability.
authors: Di Liu, Xiang Yu, Meng Ye, Qilong Zhangli, Zhuowei Li, Zhixing Zhang, Dimitris N. Metaxas ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14236-14246

title: DeLiRa:自监督深度、光照与辐射场
title_en: DeLiRa: Self-Supervised Depth, Light, and Radiance Fields
abstract: 可微体积渲染是三维重建和新视角合成的强大范式。然而,标准体积渲染方法在视角多样性有限时难以处理退化几何结构,这在机器人应用中是常见场景。本文提出利用自监督深度估计文献中的多视角光度目标作为体积渲染的几何正则化项,显著提升新视角合成效果而无需额外信息。在此基础上,我们探索使用通用Transformer显式建模场景几何结构,通过一组共享潜在编码联合学习辐射场以及深度和光照场。我们证明跨任务共享几何信息具有相互促进作用,在不增加网络复杂度的前提下实现超越单任务学习的性能提升。我们的DeLiRa架构在ScanNet基准测试中达到当前最优水平,实现了高质量体积渲染以及在有限视角多样性场景下的实时新视角与深度合成。
abstract_en: Differentiable volumetric rendering is a powerful paradigm for 3D reconstruction and novel view synthesis. However, standard volume rendering approaches struggle with degenerate geometries in the case of limited viewpoint diversity, a common scenario in robotics applications. In this work, we propose to use the multi-view photometric objective from the self-supervised depth estimation literature as a geometric regularizer for volumetric rendering, significantly improving novel view synthesis without requiring additional information. Building upon this insight, we explore the explicit modeling of scene geometry using a generalist Transformer, jointly learning a radiance field as well as depth and light fields with a set of shared latent codes. We demonstrate that sharing geometric information across tasks is mutually beneficial, leading to improvements over single-task learning without an increase in network complexity. Our DeLiRa architecture achieves state-of-the-art results on the ScanNet benchmark, enabling high quality volumetric rendering as well as real-time novel view and depth synthesis in the limited viewpoint diversity setting.
authors: Vitor Guizilini, Igor Vasiljevic, Jiading Fang, Rares Ambrus, Sergey Zakharov, Vincent Sitzmann, Adrien Gaidon ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17935-17945

title: Dec-Adapter: 探索高效的解码器侧适配器以连接屏幕内容与自然图像压缩
title_en: Dec-Adapter: Exploring Efficient Decoder-Side Adapter for Bridging Screen Content and Natural Image Compression
abstract: 自然图像压缩在深度学习时代取得了显著提升。然而,若直接将预训练编码器应用于屏幕内容图像压缩,其压缩性能将严重下降。同时,我们观察到参数高效迁移学习(PETL)方法在高层视觉任务中展现出强大的适应能力。因此,我们提出了一种Dec-Adapter,这是一种开创性的熵高效迁移学习模块,用于连接自然图像与屏幕内容压缩。适配器参数在编码过程中学习并传输至解码器以实现图像自适应解码。我们的Dec-Adapter具有轻量化、领域迁移性及架构无关性,在连接两个领域方面表现出良好的泛化性能。实验表明,我们的方法在屏幕内容图像压缩的BD率性能上显著优于现有所有方法。具体而言,当迁移到屏幕内容图像压缩时,我们的方法相比基线模型实现了超过2 dB的增益。
abstract_en: Natural image compression has been greatly improved in the deep learning era. However, the compression performance will be heavily degraded if the pretrained encoder is directly applied on screen content image compression. Meanwhile, we observe that parameter-efficient trans-fer learning (PETL) methods have shown great adaptation ability in high-level vision tasks. Therefore, we propose a Dec-Adapter, a pioneering entropy-efficient transfer learning module for the decoder to bridge natural image and screen content compression. The adapter's parameters are learned during encoding and transmitted to the decoder for image-adaptive decoding. Our Dec-Adapter is lightweight, domain-transferable, and architecture-agnostic with generalized performance in bridging the two domains. Experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms all existing methods by a large margin in terms of BD-rate performance on screen content image compression. Specifically, our method achieves over 2 dB gain compared with the baseline when transferred to screen content image com-pression.
authors: Sheng Shen, Huanjing Yue, Jingyu Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12887-12896

title: 基于分解的变分网络在多对比度MRI超分辨率与重建中的应用
title_en: Decomposition-Based Variational Network for Multi-Contrast MRI Super-Resolution and Reconstruction
abstract: 多对比度MRI超分辨率(SR)与重建方法旨在从参考图像中探索互补信息以帮助目标图像的重建。现有基于深度学习的方法通常手动设计融合规则以聚合多对比度图像,未能准确建模其相关性且缺乏一定的可解释性。针对这些问题,我们提出了一种多对比度变分网络(MC-VarNet),以显式建模多对比度图像之间的关系。我们的模型基于一个直观的动机构建,即多对比度图像包含一致的(边缘和结构)和不一致的(对比度)信息。因此,我们构建了一个模型,用于重建目标图像并将参考图像分解为公共成分和独特成分。在特征交互阶段,仅将公共成分传递到目标图像。我们求解变分模型,并将迭代解展开为深度网络。因此,所提出的方法结合了基于模型方法的良好可解释性和基于深度学习方法的强大表示能力。在多对比度MRI重建和SR任务上的实验结果验证了所提出模型的有效性。特别是,由于我们显式建模多对比度图像,我们的模型对带有噪声和大不一致结构的参考图像更具鲁棒性。代码可在https://github.com/lpcccc-cv/MC-VarNet获取。
abstract_en: Multi-contrast MRI super-resolution (SR) and reconstruction methods aim to explore complementary information from the reference image to help the reconstruction of the target image. Existing deep learning-based methods usually manually design fusion rules to aggregate the multi-contrast images, fail to model their correlations accurately and lack certain interpretations. Against these issues, we propose a multi-contrast variational network (MC-VarNet) to explicitly model the relationship of multi-contrast images. Our model is constructed based on an intuitive motivation that multi-contrast images have consistent (edges and structures) and inconsistent (contrast) information. We thus build a model to reconstruct the target image and decompose the reference image as a common component and a unique component. In the feature interaction phase, only the common component is transferred to the target image. We solve the variational model and unfold the iterative solutions into a deep network. Hence, the proposed method combines the good interpretability of model-based methods with the powerful representation ability of deep learning-based methods. Experimental results on the multi-contrast MRI reconstruction and SR demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model. Especially, since we explicitly model the multi-contrast images, our model is more robust to the reference images with noises and large inconsistent structures. The code is available at https://github.com/lpcccc-cv/MC-VarNet.
authors: Pengcheng Lei, Faming Fang, Guixu Zhang, Tieyong Zeng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21296-21306

title: 先解耦后交互:面向持续视觉问答的多模态提示学习
title_en: Decouple Before Interact: Multi-Modal Prompt Learning for Continual Visual Question Answering
abstract: 在现实世界中,理想的视觉问答模型应能在持续设置下(被认定为CL-VQA)为新问题和图像提供正确答案。然而现有工作从单一视觉或语言视角出发构建CLVQA,并直接将单模态持续学习(CL)策略应用于该多模态任务,这种做法不恰当且次优。一方面,这种片面的建模方式可能导致评估受限;另一方面,忽视模态间交互会带来性能下降。为解决这些挑战性问题,我们从多模态视觉-语言融合视角提出CL-VQA的综合建模框架。基于该框架,我们进一步提出基于预训练视觉-语言模型的新型方法MulTi-Modal PRompt LearnIng with DecouPLing bEfore InTeraction(TRIPLET),该方法包含解耦提示与提示交互策略,以捕捉模态间复杂交互。具体而言,解耦提示包含针对不同方面的可学习参数,提示交互策略负责建模输入与提示间的交互关系。此外,我们构建了两个CL-VQA基准以实现更全面的评估。大量实验表明,我们的TRIPLET方法在CL-VQA的单模态和多模态持续设置中均优于现有最先进方法。
abstract_en: In the real world, a desirable Visual Question Answering model is expected to provide correct answers to new questions and images in a continual setting (recognized as CL-VQA). However, existing works formulate CLVQA from a vision-only or language-only perspective, and straightforwardly apply the uni-modal continual learning (CL) strategies to this multi-modal task, which is improper and suboptimal. On the one hand, such a partial formulation may result in limited evaluations. On the other hand, neglecting the interactions between modalities will lead to poor performance. To tackle these challenging issues, we propose a comprehensive formulation for CL-VQA from the perspective of multi-modal vision-language fusion. Based on our formulation, we further propose MulTi-Modal PRompt LearnIng with DecouPLing bEfore InTeraction (TRIPLET), a novel approach that builds on a pre-trained vision-language model and consists of decoupled prompts and prompt interaction strategies to capture the complex interactions between modalities. In particular, decoupled prompts contain learnable parameters that are decoupled w.r.t different aspects, and the prompt interaction strategies are in charge of modeling interactions between inputs and prompts. Additionally, we build two CL-VQA benchmarks for a more comprehensive evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our TRIPLET outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both uni-modal and multi-modal continual settings for CL-VQA.
authors: Zi Qian, Xin Wang, Xuguang Duan, Pengda Qin, Yuhong Li, Wenwu Zhu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2953-2962

title: 解耦DETR:通过空间解耦定位与分类以提升端到端目标检测性能
title_en: Decoupled DETR: Spatially Disentangling Localization and Classification for Improved End-to-End Object Detection
abstract: DETR的引入为目标检测提供了一种新的范式。然而,其解码器通过共享查询和交叉注意力层同时进行分类和边界框定位,导致性能欠佳。我们观察到,视觉特征图中不同感兴趣区域适合执行查询分类和边界框定位任务,即使是同一物体。显著区域为分类提供关键信息,而其周围边界则更有利于边界框回归。不幸的是,这种两个任务间的空间错位严重阻碍了DETR的训练。因此,本工作中我们专注于解耦DETR中的定位与分类任务。为此,我们引入了一种新设计方案,称为空间解耦DETR(SD-DETR),其包含任务感知查询生成模块和解耦特征学习过程。我们精心设计了任务感知查询初始化过程,并将解码器中的交叉注意力块分割,以允许任务感知查询匹配不同视觉区域。同时,我们还观察到高分类置信度和精确定位存在预测错位问题,因此提出了一种对齐损失以进一步指导空间解耦DETR的训练。通过大量实验,我们证明了我们的方法在MSCOCO数据集上相比先前工作取得了显著提升。例如,我们将条件DETR的性能提升了4.5%。通过空间解耦两个任务,我们的方法克服了错位问题,大幅提升了DETR在目标检测中的性能。
abstract_en:
The introduction of DETR represents a new paradigm for object detection.
  However, its decoder conducts classification and box localization using shared queries and cross-attention layers, leading to suboptimal results. We observe that different regions of interest in the visual feature map are suitable for performing query classification and box localization tasks, even for the same object. Salient regions provide vital information for classification, while the boundaries around them are more favorable for box regression. Unfortunately, such spatial misalignment between these two tasks greatly hinders DETR's training.
  Therefore, in this work, we focus on decoupling localization and classification tasks in DETR. To achieve this, we introduce a new design scheme called spatially decoupled DETR (SD-DETR), which includes a task-aware query generation module and a disentangled feature learning process. 
 We elaborately design the task-aware query initialization process and divide the cross-attention block in the decoder to allow the task-aware queries to match different visual regions.
  Meanwhile, we also observe that the prediction misalignment problem for high classification confidence and precise localization exists, so we propose an alignment loss to further guide the spatially decoupled DETR training.
 Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our approach achieves a significant improvement in MSCOCO datasets compared to previous work. For instance, we improve the performance of Conditional DETR by 4.5%. By spatially disentangling the two tasks, our method overcomes the misalignment problem and greatly improves the performance of DETR for object detection.
authors: Manyuan Zhang, Guanglu Song, Yu Liu, Hongsheng Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6601-6610

title: 单张RGB图像中交互手重建的解耦迭代优化框架
title_en: Decoupled Iterative Refinement Framework for Interacting Hands Reconstruction from a Single RGB Image
abstract: 从单张RGB图像中重建交互手是一项极具挑战性的任务。一方面,双手间的严重相互遮挡和相似局部外观会干扰视觉特征的提取,导致估计的手部网格与图像的错位。另一方面,交互手之间存在复杂的空间关系,显著扩大了手部姿态的解空间,增加了网络学习的难度。本文提出了一种解耦迭代优化框架,以实现像素对齐的手部重建,同时高效建模手部间空间关系。具体而言,我们定义了两种具有不同特性的特征空间,即2D视觉特征空间和3D关节特征空间。首先,我们从视觉特征图中获取关节级特征,并利用图卷积网络和Transformer分别在3D关节特征空间中进行手内和手间信息交互。然后,我们将包含全局信息的关节特征以无遮蔽方式投影回2D视觉特征空间,并利用2D卷积进行像素级增强。通过在两个特征空间中进行多次交替增强,我们的方法能够实现交互手的精确且鲁棒的重建。在InterHand2.6M数据集上,我们的方法显著优于所有现有的双手重建方法。
abstract_en: Reconstructing interacting hands from a single RGB image is a very challenging task. On the one hand, severe mutual occlusion and similar local appearance between two hands confuse the extraction of visual features, resulting in the misalignment of estimated hand meshes and the image. On the other hand, there are complex spatial relationship between interacting hands, which significantly increases the solution space of hand poses and increases the difficulty of network learning. In this paper, we propose a decoupled iterative refinement framework to achieve pixel-alignment hand reconstruction while efficiently modeling the spatial relationship between hands. Specifically, we define two feature spaces with different characteristics, namely 2D visual feature space and 3D joint feature space. First, we obtain joint-wise features from the visual feature map and utilize a graph convolution network and a transformer to perform intra- and inter-hand information interaction in the 3D joint feature space, respectively. Then, we project the joint features with global information back into the 2D visual feature space in an obfuscation-free manner and utilize the 2D convolution for pixel-wise enhancement. By performing multiple alternate enhancements in the two feature spaces, our method can achieve an accurate and robust reconstruction of interacting hands. Our method outperforms all existing two-hand reconstruction methods by a large margin on the InterHand2.6M dataset.
authors: Pengfei Ren, Chao Wen, Xiaozheng Zheng, Zhou Xue, Haifeng Sun, Qi Qi, Jingyu Wang, Jianxin Liao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8014-8025

title: DeePoint:视觉指针识别与方向估计
title_en: DeePoint: Visual Pointing Recognition and Direction Estimation
abstract: 本文实现了指针的自动视觉识别与方向估计。我们引入了首个基于两个关键贡献的神经指针理解方法。第一是构建了一个用于指针识别和方向估计的首个大规模数据集,我们称之为DP数据集。DP数据集包含超过200万帧视频,涵盖33名受试者以不同风格进行指针动作,每帧均标注了指针时间戳和三维方向。第二是DeePoint,一种新型深度网络模型,用于联合识别和三维方向估计。DeePoint是一种基于Transformer的网络,充分利用了身体部位的时空协调性,而不仅限于手部。通过大量实验,我们验证了DeePoint的准确性和效率。我们相信DP数据集和DeePoint将为视觉人类意图理解提供坚实的基础。
abstract_en: In this paper, we realize automatic visual recognition and direction estimation of pointing. We introduce the first neural pointing understanding method based on two key contributions. The first is the introduction of a first-of-its-kind large-scale dataset for pointing recognition and direction estimation, which we refer to as the DP Dataset. DP Dataset consists of more than 2 million frames of 33 people pointing in various styles annotated for each frame with pointing timings and 3D directions. The second is DeePoint, a novel deep network model for joint recognition and 3D direction estimation of pointing. DeePoint is a Transformer-based network which fully leverages the spatio-temporal coordination of the body parts, not just the hands. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of DeePoint. We believe DP Dataset and DeePoint will serve as a sound foundation for visual human intention understanding.
authors: Shu Nakamura, Yasutomo Kawanishi, Shohei Nobuhara, Ko Nishino ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20577-20587

title: 面向实时六自由度目标跟踪的深度主动轮廓模型
title_en: Deep Active Contours for Real-time 6-DoF Object Tracking
abstract: 本文解决了从RGB视频中实现实时六自由度目标跟踪的问题。传统基于优化的方法通过手工特征对齐投影模型到图像平面来优化目标姿态,容易陷入局部最优解。近期基于学习的方法使用神经网络预测姿态,但存在泛化能力有限或计算效率低的问题。我们提出一种基于学习的主动轮廓模型,融合两者优势。具体而言,给定初始姿态,我们将物体模型投影到图像平面获得初始轮廓,利用轻量网络预测轮廓应如何移动以匹配真实物体边界,为优化物体姿态提供梯度。我们还设计了高效的优化算法,实现端到端姿态监督训练。在半合成和现实世界六自由度目标跟踪数据集上的实验结果表明,我们的模型在姿态精度上显著优于现有方法,同时在移动设备上实现实时性能。代码可在项目页面获取:https://zju3dv.github.io/deep_ac/
abstract_en: This paper solves the problem of real-time 6-DoF object tracking from an RGB video. Prior optimization-based methods optimize the object pose by aligning the projected model to the image based on handcrafted features, which are prone to suboptimal solutions. Recent learning-based methods use neural networks to predict the pose, which suffer from limited generalizability or computational efficiency. We propose a learning-based active contour model to make the best use of both worlds. Specifically, given an initial pose, we project the object model to the image plane to obtain the initial contour and use a lightweight network to predict how the contour should move to match the true object boundary, which provides the gradients to optimize the object pose. We also devise an efficient optimization algorithm to train our model end-to-end with pose supervision. Experimental results on semi-synthetic and real-world 6-DoF object tracking datasets demonstrate that our model outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a substantial margin in pose accuracy, while achieving real-time performance on mobile devices. Code is available on our project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/deep_ac/.
authors: Long Wang, Shen Yan, Jianan Zhen, Yu Liu, Maojun Zhang, Guofeng Zhang, Xiaowei Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14034-14044

title: 面向目标检测的深度直接训练脉冲神经网络
title_en: Deep Directly-Trained Spiking Neural Networks for Object Detection
abstract: 脉冲神经网络(SNNs)是一种受脑启发的能效高模型,通过时空动态编码信息。近期,直接训练的深度SNN在分类任务中展现出在极少时间步长下实现高性能的显著成果。然而,如何设计直接训练的SNN用于目标检测的回归任务仍是一个具有挑战性的问题。为解决这一问题,我们提出EMS-YOLO,一种面向目标检测的新型直接训练SNN框架,这是首次尝试使用替代梯度直接训练深度SNN进行目标检测,而非依赖ANN-SNN转换策略。具体而言,我们设计了全脉冲残差块EMS-ResNet,该模块能以低功耗有效扩展直接训练SNN的深度。进一步地,我们从理论上分析并证明EMS-ResNet可避免梯度消失或爆炸。实验结果表明,我们的方法在极少数时间步长(仅4个时间步长)下超越了最先进的ANN-SNN转换方法(至少需要500个时间步长)。结果显示,我们的模型在基于帧的COCO数据集和基于事件的Gen1数据集上,以相同架构实现与ANN相当的性能,同时能耗仅为ANN的5.83倍。我们的代码可在https://github.com/BICLab/EMS-YOLO获取。
abstract_en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) are brain-inspired energy-efficient models that encode information in spatiotemporal dynamics. Recently, deep SNNs trained directly have shown great success in achieving high performance on classification tasks with very few time steps. However, how to design a directly-trained SNN for the regression task of object detection still remains a challenging problem. To address this problem, we propose EMS-YOLO, a novel directly-trained SNN framework for object detection, which is the first trial to train a deep SNN with surrogate gradients for object detection rather than ANN-SNN conversion strategies. Specifically, we design a full-spike residual block, EMS-ResNet, which can effectively extend the depth of the directly-trained SNN with low power consumption. Furthermore, we theoretically analyze and prove the EMS-ResNet could avoid gradient vanishing or exploding. The results demonstrate that our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art ANN-SNN conversion methods (at least 500 time steps) in extremely fewer time steps (only 4 time steps). It is shown that our model could achieve comparable performance to the ANN with the same architecture while consuming 5.83x less energy on the frame-based COCO Dataset and the event-based Gen1 Dataset. Our code is available in https://github.com/BICLab/EMS-YOLO.
authors: Qiaoyi Su, Yuhong Chou, Yifan Hu, Jianing Li, Shijie Mei, Ziyang Zhang, Guoqi Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6555-6565

title: 深度平衡目标检测
title_en: Deep Equilibrium Object Detection
abstract: 基于查询的目标检测器通过一组可学习的查询直接将图像特征解码为目标实例。这些查询向量通过一系列解码器层逐步优化为稳定的有意义表示,然后用于通过简单的前馈网络头直接预测目标位置和类别。本文提出了一种新的基于查询的目标检测器(DEQDet),通过设计深度平衡解码器实现。我们的DEQ解码器将查询向量优化建模为隐式层的固定点求解,等价于应用无限步的优化。为了更具体地针对目标解码,我们使用两步展开的平衡方程显式捕捉查询向量优化。因此,我们能够通过不精确梯度反向传播(RAG)将优化意识纳入DEQ训练。此外,为了稳定DEQDet的训练并提升其泛化能力,我们设计了基于优化路径的深度监督方案(RAP),结合优化意识扰动。实验表明,DEQDet收敛更快、内存消耗更少且优于基线模型(AdaMixer)。特别是,我们的DEQDet在ResNet50主干网络和300个查询下,在2x训练方案(24个epoch)的MS COCO基准测试中达到49.5 mAP和33.0 APs。
abstract_en:
Query-based object detectors directly decode image features into object instances with a set of learnable queries. These query vectors are progressively refined to stable meaningful representations through a sequence of decoder layers, and then used to directly predict object locations and categories with simple FFN heads. 
 In this paper, we present a new query-based object detector (DEQDet) by designing a deep equilibrium decoder. Our DEQ decoder models the query vector refinement as the fixed point solving of an implicit layer and is equivalent to applying infinite steps of refinement.
 To be more specific to object decoding, we use a two-step unrolled equilibrium equation to explicitly capture the query vector refinement. Accordingly, we are able to incorporate refinement awareness into the DEQ training with the inexact gradient back-propagation (RAG). In addition, to stabilize the training of our DEQDet and improve its generalization ability, we devise the deep supervision scheme on the optimization path of DEQ with refinement-aware perturbation (RAP).
 Our experiments demonstrate DEQDet converges faster, consumes less memory, and achieves better results than the baseline counterpart (AdaMixer). In particular, our DEQDet with ResNet50 backbone and 300 queries achieves the 49.5 mAP and 33.0 APs on the MS COCO benchmark under 2x training scheme (24 epochs).
authors: Shuai Wang, Yao Teng, Limin Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6296-6306

title: 用于检测分布外对象的深度特征去模糊扩散方法
title_en: Deep Feature Deblurring Diffusion for Detecting Out-of-Distribution Objects
abstract: 为促进检测器的安全应用,近期提出了无监督分布外目标检测(OOD-OD)任务,其目标是在不访问任何辅助分布外(OOD)数据的情况下检测未见过的OOD对象。对于该任务,主要挑战在于如何仅利用已知的分布内(ID)数据准确检测OOD对象,同时不影响ID对象的检测,这可以被框架为深度特征合成的扩散问题。因此,此类挑战可通过扩散模型中的正向和反向过程来解决。本文提出了一种新的深度特征去模糊扩散(DFDD)方法,包含正向模糊和反向去模糊过程。具体而言,正向过程逐步对提取的特征进行高斯模糊处理,这有助于保留足够的输入相关信息。通过这种方式,正向过程可合成接近ID与OOD对象分类边界的人造OOD特征,从而提升检测OOD对象的性能。在反向过程中,基于模糊特征设计专用的去模糊模型,持续恢复正向过程丢失的细节。将去模糊特征和原始特征均作为训练输入,增强判别能力。在实验中,我们的方法在OOD-OD、开放集目标检测和增量目标检测任务中进行了评估。与基线方法相比的显著性能提升证明了本方法的优势。源代码将公开在:https://github.com/AmingWu/DFDD-OOD。
abstract_en: To promote the safe application of detectors, a task of unsupervised out-of-distribution object detection (OOD-OD) is recently proposed, whose goal is to detect unseen OOD objects without accessing any auxiliary OOD data. For this task, the challenge mainly lies in how to only leverage the known in-distribution (ID) data to detect OOD objects accurately without affecting the detection of ID objects, which can be framed as the diffusion problem for deep feature synthesis. Accordingly, such challenge could be addressed by the forward and reverse processes in the diffusion model. In this paper, we propose a new approach of Deep Feature Deblurring Diffusion (DFDD), consisting of forward blurring and reverse deblurring processes. Specifically, the forward process gradually performs Gaussian Blur on the extracted features, which is instrumental in retaining sufficient input-relevant information. By this way, the forward process could synthesize virtual OOD features that are close to the classification boundary between ID and OOD objects, which improves the performance of detecting OOD objects. During the reverse process, based on the blurred features, a dedicated deblurring model is designed to continually recover the lost details in the forward process. Both the deblurred features and original features are taken as the input for training, strengthening the discrimination ability. In the experiments, our method is evaluated on OOD-OD, open-set object detection, and incremental object detection. The significant performance gains over baselines demonstrate the superiorities of our method. The source code will be made available at: https://github.com/AmingWu/DFDD-OOD.
authors: Aming Wu, Da Chen, Cheng Deng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13381-13391

title: 基于加权向量级关键点投票的深度融合Transformer网络在鲁棒6D物体位姿估计中的应用
title_en: Deep Fusion Transformer Network with Weighted Vector-Wise Keypoints Voting for Robust 6D Object Pose Estimation
abstract: 从单张RGBD图像进行6D物体位姿估计的关键挑战之一是高效融合两种不同模态(即颜色和深度)的信息。本文通过提出一种新颖的深度融合Transformer(DFTr)模块来解决该问题,该模块能够聚合跨模态特征以提升位姿估计性能。与现有融合方法不同,所提出的DFTr通过利用语义相似性更好地建模跨模态语义相关性,使得来自不同模态的全局增强特征能够更有效地融合,从而提升信息提取效果。此外,为进一步提高鲁棒性和效率,我们引入了一种新颖的加权向量级投票算法,采用非迭代全局优化策略实现精确的3D关键点定位,同时达到近实时推理性能。大量实验结果表明了所提出的3D关键点投票算法的有效性及强泛化能力。在四个广泛使用的基准数据集上的实验结果也证明,我们的方法在多个指标上显著优于现有最先进方法。
abstract_en: One critical challenge in 6D object pose estimation from a single RGBD image is efficient integration of two different modalities, i.e., color and depth. In this work, we tackle this problem by a novel Deep Fusion Transformer (DFTr) block that can aggregate cross-modality features for improving pose estimation. Unlike existing fusion methods, the proposed DFTr can better model cross-modality semantic correlation by leveraging their semantic similarity, such that globally enhanced features from different modalities can be better integrated for improved information extraction. Moreover, to further improve robustness and efficiency, we introduce a novel weighted vector-wise voting algorithm that employs a non-iterative global optimization strategy for precise 3D keypoint localization while achieving near real-time inference. Extensive experiments show the effectiveness and strong generalization capability of our proposed 3D keypoint voting algorithm. Results on four widely used benchmarks also demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by large margins.
authors: Jun Zhou, Kai Chen, Linlin Xu, Qi Dou, Jing Qin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13967-13977

title: 深度几何化卡通线条中间帧生成
title_en: Deep Geometrized Cartoon Line Inbetweening
abstract: 我们旨在解决动漫产业中一个重要但研究不足的问题,即卡通线条的中间帧生成。中间帧生成涉及在两个黑白线条画之间生成中间帧,是一个耗时且昂贵的过程,可以通过自动化获得效益。然而,依赖于匹配和扭曲整个光栅图像的现有帧插值方法不适合线条中间帧生成,通常会产生模糊伪影,损害复杂的线条结构。为了保持线条画的精度和细节,我们提出了一种新方法,称为AnimeInbet,将光栅线条画几何化为端点图,并将中间帧生成任务重新表述为具有顶点重定位的图融合问题。我们的方法能够有效捕捉线条画的稀疏性和独特结构,同时在中间帧生成过程中保持细节。这得益于我们提出的新型模块,即顶点编码、顶点对应Transformer、有效的顶点重定位机制和可见性预测器。为了训练我们的方法,我们引入了MixamoLine240,这是一个包含真实向量化和匹配标签的新型线条画数据集。我们的实验表明,AnimeInbet合成高质量、干净且完整的中间线条画,在定量和定性方面均优于现有方法,尤其是在大运动情况下表现尤为突出。
abstract_en: We aim to address a significant but understudied problem in the anime industry, namely the inbetweening of cartoon line drawings. Inbetweening involves generating intermediate frames between two black-and-white line drawings and is a time-consuming and expensive process that can benefit from automation. However, existing frame interpolation methods that rely on matching and warping whole raster images are unsuitable for line inbetweening and often produce blurring artifacts that damage the intricate line structures. To preserve the precision and detail of the line drawings, we propose a new approach, called AnimeInbet, which geometrizes raster line drawings into graphs of endpoints and reframes the inbetweening task as a graph fusion problem with vertex repositioning. Our method can effectively capture the sparsity and unique structure of line drawings while preserving the details during inbetweening. This is made possible through our novel modules, i.e., vertex encoding, a vertex correspondence Transformer, an effective mechanism for vertex repositioning and a visibility predictor. To train our method, we introduce MixamoLine240, a new dataset of line drawings with ground truth vectorization and matching labels. Our experiments demonstrate that AnimeInbet synthesizes high-quality, clean, and complete intermediate line drawings, outperforming existing methods quantitatively and qualitatively, especially in cases with large motions.
authors: Li Siyao, Tianpei Gu, Weiye Xiao, Henghui Ding, Ziwei Liu, Chen Change Loy ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7291-7300

title: 基于视频的深度几何感知相机自标定方法
title_en: Deep Geometry-Aware Camera Self-Calibration from Video
abstract: 准确的内参标定对于基于相机的三维感知至关重要,但通常需要已知几何结构的目标。本文提出了一种相机自标定方法,能够在实际应用中从单目视频中推断相机内参。我们提出显式建模投影函数和多视角几何,同时利用深度神经网络的能力进行特征提取和匹配。为实现这一目标,我们基于近期将光束法平差集成到深度学习模型中的研究,引入了一种自标定光束法平差层。该自标定光束法平差层通过经典高斯-牛顿法步骤优化相机内参,并可适配不同相机模型而无需重新训练。作为具体实现,我们将在深度视觉SLAM系统DROID-SLAM中实现该层,并展示所得到的模型DroidCalib在多个公开数据集上达到了最先进的标定精度。我们的结果表明,该模型能够泛化到未见过的环境和不同相机模型,包括显著的镜头畸变。因此,该方法使无需先验相机知识即可执行三维感知任务成为可能。代码可在https://github.com/boschresearch/droidcalib获取。
abstract_en: Accurate intrinsic calibration is essential for camera-based 3D perception, yet, it typically requires targets of well-known geometry. Here, we propose a camera self-calibration approach that infers camera intrinsics during application, from monocular videos in the wild. We propose to explicitly model projection functions and multi-view geometry, while leveraging the capabilities of deep neural networks for feature extraction and matching. To achieve this, we build upon recent research on integrating bundle adjustment into deep learning models, and introduce a self-calibrating bundle adjustment layer. The self-calibrating bundle adjustment layer optimizes camera intrinsics through classical Gauss-Newton steps and can be adapted to different camera models without re-training. As a specific realization, we implemented this layer within the deep visual SLAM system DROID-SLAM, and show that the resulting model, DroidCalib, yields state-of-the-art calibration accuracy across multiple public datasets. Our results suggest that the model generalizes to unseen environments and different camera models, including significant lens distortion. Thereby, the approach enables performing 3D perception tasks without prior knowledge about the camera. Code is available at https://github.com/boschresearch/droidcalib.
authors: Annika Hagemann, Moritz Knorr, Christoph Stiller ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3438-3448

title: 用于单图像滚动快门校正的深度单应性混合模型
title_en: Deep Homography Mixture for Single Image Rolling Shutter Correction
abstract: 我们提出了一种用于单图像滚动快门校正的深度单应性混合运动模型。滚动快门(RS)效应通常由广泛采用的CMOS传感器的逐行曝光延迟引起。先前方法往往需要多帧进行校正,导致对数据质量的要求。少数方法针对更具挑战性的单图像RS校正任务,通常采用轨迹估计或长矩形核等设计,以学习RS图像的相机运动参数,恢复全局快门(GS)图像。在本工作中,我们采用更直接的方法,学习RS图像与其对应GS图像之间的深度单应性混合运动,无需大解空间或对图像特征的严格限制。我们证明将图像划分为具有块扫描线高斯权重的块,适合RS设置。此外,我们不直接学习运动映射,而是学习组合多个运动基的系数以生成校正运动,其中这些基从自然视频的连续帧中预先学习得到。实验表明,我们的方法在合成和真实RS图像上,统计上和视觉上均优于现有单RS方法。
abstract_en: We present a deep homography mixture motion model for single image rolling shutter correction. Rolling shutter (RS) effects are often caused by row-wise exposure delay in the widely adopted CMOS sensor. Previous methods often require more than one frame for the correction, leading to data quality requirements. Few approaches address the more challenging task of single image RS correction, which often adopt designs like trajectory estimation or long rectangular kernels, to learn the camera motion parameters of an RS image, to restore the global shutter (GS) image. In this work, we adopt a more straightforward method to learn deep homography mixture motion between an RS image and its corresponding GS image, without large solution space or strict restrictions on image features. We show that dividing an image into blocks with a Gaussian weight of block scanlines fits well for the RS setting. Moreover, instead of directly learning the motion mapping, we learn coefficients that assemble several motion bases to produce the correction motion, where these bases are learned from the consecutive frames of natural videos beforehand. Experiments show that our method outperforms existing single RS methods statistically and visually, in both synthesized and real RS images.
authors: Weilong Yan, Robby T. Tan, Bing Zeng, Shuaicheng Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9868-9877

title: 基于全局引导特征变换与关系蒸馏的深度图像和谐化
title_en: Deep Image Harmonization with Globally Guided Feature Transformation and Relation Distillation
abstract: 给定一张合成图像,图像和谐化旨在调整前景光照以与背景保持一致。先前方法已通过变换前景特征实现了具有竞争力的性能。在本工作中,我们证明利用全局信息引导前景特征变换可取得显著提升。此外,我们提出将真实图像中的前景-背景关系迁移至合成图像,这可为变换后的编码器特征提供中间监督。同时,考虑到现有和谐化数据集的不足,我们还贡献了一个ccHarmony数据集,该数据集模拟了自然光照变化。在iHarmony4和我们贡献的数据集上的大量实验验证了我们方法的优越性。我们的ccHarmony数据集已发布于https://github.com/bcmi/Image-Harmonization-Dataset-ccHarmony。
abstract_en: Given a composite image, image harmonization aims to adjust the foreground illumination to be consistent with background. Previous methods have explored transforming foreground features to achieve competitive performance. In this work, we show that using global information to guide foreground feature transformation could achieve significant improvement. Besides, we propose to transfer the foreground-background relation from real images to composite images, which can provide intermediate supervision for the transformed encoder features. Additionally, considering the drawbacks of existing harmonization datasets, we also contribute a ccHarmony dataset which simulates the natural illumination variation. Extensive experiments on iHarmony4 and our contributed dataset demonstrate the superiority of our method. Our ccHarmony dataset is released at https://github.com/bcmi/Image-Harmonization-Dataset-ccHarmony.
authors: Li Niu, Linfeng Tan, Xinhao Tao, Junyan Cao, Fengjun Guo, Teng Long, Liqing Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7723-7732

title: 基于可学习增强的深度图像协调
title_en: Deep Image Harmonization with Learnable Augmentation
abstract: 图像协调的目标是调整合成图像中前景的外观,使整个图像和谐。为构建配对训练图像,现有数据集采用不同方法调整真实图像的前景光照统计以生成合成图像。然而,不同数据集存在显著领域差异,且小规模数据集的性能受限于训练数据不足。本工作中,我们探索可学习增强方法以丰富小规模数据集的光照多样性,从而提升协调效果。具体而言,我们设计的SYthetic COmposite Network(SycoNet)输入真实图像、前景掩码和随机向量,学习适合的颜色变换,将其应用于真实图像的前景以生成合成图像。综合实验验证了所提可学习增强方法在图像协调中的有效性。SycoNet的代码已开源于https://github.com/bcmi/SycoNet-Adaptive-Image-Harmonization。
abstract_en: The goal of image harmonization is adjusting the foreground appearance in a composite image to make the whole image harmonious. To construct paired training images, existing datasets adopt different ways to adjust the illumination statistics of foregrounds of real images to produce synthetic composite images. However, different datasets have considerable domain gap and the performances on small-scale datasets are limited by insufficient training data. In this work, we explore learnable augmentation to enrich the illumination diversity of small-scale datasets for better harmonization performance. In particular, our designed SYthetic COmposite Network (SycoNet) takes in a real image with foreground mask and a random vector to learn suitable color transformation, which is applied to the foreground of this real image to produce a synthetic composite image. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed learnable augmentation for image harmonization. The code of SycoNet is released at https://github.com/bcmi/SycoNet-Adaptive-Image-Harmonization.
authors: Li Niu, Junyan Cao, Wenyan Cong, Liqing Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7482-7491

title: 深度孵化:通过分而治之训练大型模型
title_en: Deep Incubation: Training Large Models by Divide-and-Conquering
abstract: 近年来,大型深度学习模型取得了显著成功。然而,由于高昂的计算成本、令人痛苦的收敛速度以及过拟合问题,训练这些模型具有挑战性。本文提出了一种名为深度孵化的新方法,通过将模型划分为更小的子模块,这些子模块可以分别训练并无缝组装,从而实现大型模型的高效有效训练。实现这一想法的关键挑战在于确保独立训练的子模块之间的兼容性。为解决这一问题,我们首先引入了一个全局共享的元模型,该模型被用来隐式连接所有模块,并可设计为一个计算开销可以忽略不计的极小网络。随后,我们提出了一种模块孵化算法,该算法训练每个子模块以替换元模型中的相应组件并完成给定的学习任务。尽管方法简单,但我们的方法有效促使每个子模块意识到其在目标大型模型中的作用,使得最终学习的子模块在组装后能够顺畅协作。实验表明,我们的方法在标准训练设置中优于端到端(E2E)训练,并在下游任务(如COCO和ADE20K上的目标检测和图像分割)中展现出可迁移的性能提升。我们的代码可在https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/Deep-Incubation获取。
abstract_en: Recent years have witnessed a remarkable success of large deep learning models. However, training these models is challenging due to high computational costs, painfully slow convergence, and overfitting issues. In this paper, we present Deep Incubation, a novel approach that enables the efficient and effective training of large models by dividing them into smaller sub-modules which can be trained separately and assembled seamlessly. A key challenge for implementing this idea is to ensure the compatibility of the independently trained sub-modules. To address this issue, we first introduce a global, shared meta model, which is leveraged to implicitly link all the modules together, and can be designed as an extremely small network with negligible computational overhead. Then we propose a module incubation algorithm, which trains each sub-module to replace the corresponding component of the meta model and accomplish a given learning task. Despite the simplicity, our approach effectively encourages each sub-module to be aware of its role in the target large model, such that the finally-learned sub-modules can collaborate with each other smoothly after being assembled. Empirically, our method can outperform end-to-end (E2E) training in well-established training setting and shows transferable performance gain for downstream tasks (e.g., object detection and image segmentation on COCO and ADE20K). Our code is available at https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/Deep-Incubation.
authors: Zanlin Ni, Yulin Wang, Jiangwei Yu, Haojun Jiang, Yue Cao, Gao Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17335-17345

title: 基于渐进式参数共享的深度多任务学习
title_en: Deep Multitask Learning with Progressive Parameter Sharing
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的渐进式参数共享策略(MPPS),用于有效训练在多种计算机视觉任务上同时进行的多任务学习模型。具体而言,我们基于引入的独占容量概念,提出对不同任务的分布进行参数化以控制共享机制。还设计了一种遵循课程学习概念的调度机制,以逐步改变共享策略,在学习过程中提高共享程度。我们进一步提出了一种新的损失函数,用于正则化网络参数的优化以及每个任务中每个神经元的共享概率。我们的方法可以与许多最先进的多任务学习方案结合,以实现更好的联合任务性能。综合实验表明,该方法在三种具有挑战性的数据集(Multi-CIFAR100、NYUv2 和 Cityscapes)上使用各种卷积神经网络架构时具有竞争力的性能。
abstract_en:
We propose a novel progressive parameter-sharing strategy (MPPS) in this paper for effectively training multitask learning models on diverse computer vision tasks simultaneously. Specifically, we propose to parameterize distributions for different tasks to control the sharings, based on the concept of Exclusive Capacity that we introduce. A scheduling mechanism following the concept of curriculum learning
 is also designed to progressively change the sharing strategy to increase the level of sharing during the learning process. We further propose a novel loss function to regularize the optimization of network parameters as well as the sharing probabilities of each neuron for each task. Our approach can be combined with many state-of-the-art multitask learning solutions to achieve better joint task performance.
 Comprehensive experiments show that it has competitive performance on three challenging datasets (Multi-CIFAR100, NYUv2, and Cityscapes) using various convolution neural network architectures.
authors: Haosen Shi, Shen Ren, Tianwei Zhang, Sinno Jialin Pan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19924-19935

title: 通过对比聚类分配的深度多视图聚类
title_en: Deep Multiview Clustering by Contrasting Cluster Assignments
abstract: 多视图聚类(MVC)旨在通过将数据样本分类到聚类中,揭示多视图数据的潜在结构。基于深度学习的方法在大规模数据集上表现出强大的特征学习能力。对于大多数现有的深度多视图聚类方法,探索多视图的不变表示仍然是一个难以解决的问题。在本文中,我们提出了一种跨视图对比学习(CVCL)方法,该方法通过对比多个视图间的聚类分配来学习视图不变表示并生成聚类结果。具体而言,我们首先在预训练阶段使用深度自编码器提取视图依赖特征。然后,在微调阶段提出了一种基于聚类级别的CVCL策略,以探索多视图间的一致语义标签信息。因此,所提出的CVCL方法能够通过这种学习策略生成更具判别性的聚类分配。此外,我们提供了软聚类分配对齐的理论分析。在多个数据集上的大量实验结果表明,所提出的CVCL方法优于几种最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Multiview clustering (MVC) aims to reveal the underlying structure of multiview data by categorizing data samples into clusters. Deep learning-based methods exhibit strong feature learning capabilities on large-scale datasets. For most existing deep MVC methods, exploring the invariant representations of multiple views is still an intractable problem. In this paper, we propose a cross-view contrastive learning (CVCL) method that learns view-invariant representations and produces clustering results by contrasting the cluster assignments among multiple views. Specifically, we first employ deep autoencoders to extract view-dependent features in the pretraining stage. Then, a cluster-level CVCL strategy is presented to explore consistent semantic label information among the multiple views in the fine-tuning stage. Thus, the proposed CVCL method is able to produce more discriminative cluster assignments by virtue of this learning strategy. Moreover, we provide a theoretical analysis of soft cluster assignment alignment. Extensive experimental results obtained on several datasets demonstrate that the proposed CVCL method outperforms several state-of-the-art approaches.
authors: Jie Chen, Hua Mao, Wai Lok Woo, Xi Peng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16752-16761

title: 深度光学用于视频压缩成像
title_en: Deep Optics for Video Snapshot Compressive Imaging
abstract: 视频压缩成像(SCI)旨在仅通过单次二维探测器拍摄即可捕获视频帧序列,其核心依赖于光学调制图案(也称为掩模)和计算重建算法。先进的深度学习算法和成熟的硬件正在将视频SCI推向实际应用。然而,SCI的阳光中仍有两朵乌云:i)高时序复用导致的低动态范围问题,ii)现有深度学习算法在真实系统中的退化。为解决这些挑战,本文提出了一种深度光学框架,联合优化掩模和重建网络。具体而言,我们首先提出了一种新型结构掩模,以实现运动感知和全动态范围测量。考虑到测量域中的运动感知特性,我们开发了一种基于Transformer的高效网络用于视频SCI重建,命名为Res2former。此外,将传感器响应引入视频SCI的前向模型,以确保接近真实系统的端到端模型训练。最后,我们将学习到的结构掩模部署在数字微镜设备上。在合成数据和真实数据上的实验结果验证了所提框架的有效性。我们认为这为现实世界的视频SCI奠定了里程碑。源代码和数据可在https://github.com/pwangcs/DeepOpticsSCI获取。
abstract_en: Video snapshot compressive imaging (SCI) aims to capture a sequence of video frames with only a single shot of a 2D detector, whose backbones rest in optical modulation patterns (also known as masks) and a computational reconstruction algorithm. Advanced deep learning algorithms and mature hardware are putting video SCI into practical applications. Yet, there are two clouds in the sunshine of SCI: i) low dynamic range as a victim of high temporal multiplexing, and ii) existing deep learning algorithms' degradation on real system. To address these challenges, this paper presents a deep optics framework to jointly optimize masks and a reconstruction network. Specifically, we first propose a new type of structural mask to realize motionaware and full-dynamic-range measurement. Considering the motion awareness property in measurement domain, we develop an efficient network for video SCI reconstruction using Transformer to capture long-term temporal dependencies, dubbed Res2former. Moreover, sensor response is introduced into the forward model of video SCI to guarantee end-to-end model training close to real system. Finally, we implement the learned structural masks on a digital micro-mirror device. Experimental results on synthetic and real data validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. We believe this is a miestone for real-world video SCI. The source code and data are available at https://github.com/pwangcs/DeepOpticsSCI.
authors: Ping Wang, Lishun Wang, Xin Yuan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10646-10656

title: 基于紧凑可逆二元分解的深度视频去摩尔纹
title_en: Deep Video Demoireing via Compact Invertible Dyadic Decomposition
abstract: 从屏幕或复杂纹理记录的视频中去除摩尔纹图案被称为视频去摩尔纹。该任务具有挑战性,因为图像的结构和纹理通常表现出强烈的周期性图案,这些图案容易与摩尔纹混淆,并可能在去除过程中被显著消除。通过将视频去摩尔纹解释为多帧分解问题,我们提出了一种名为CIDNet的紧凑可逆二元网络,该网络能够逐步从输入视频序列中分离潜在帧与摩尔纹图案。利用针对多尺度处理设计的二元跨尺度耦合结构,CIDNet旨在在不同尺度上分离图像图案与摩尔纹图案的特征,同时保留所有潜在图像特征以促进重建。此外,引入了网络输出的压缩形式以降低计算复杂度并缓解过拟合。实验表明,CIDNet在性能上优于现有方法,并在模型规模和计算效率方面具有优势。
abstract_en: Removing moire patterns from videos recorded on screens or complex textures is known as video demoireing. It is a challenging task as both structures and textures of an image usually exhibit strong periodic patterns, which thus are easily confused with moire patterns and can be significantly erased in the removal process. By interpreting video demoireing as a multi-frame decomposition problem, we propose a compact invertible dyadic network called CIDNet that progressively decouples latent frames and the moire patterns from an input video sequence. Using a dyadic cross-scale coupling structure with coupling layers tailored for multi-scale processing, CIDNet aims at disentangling the features of image patterns from that of moire patterns at different scales, while retaining all latent image features to facilitate reconstruction. In addition, a compressed form for the network's output is introduced to reduce computational complexity and alleviate overfitting. The experiments show that CIDNet outperforms existing methods and enjoys the advantages in model size and computational efficiency.
authors: Yuhui Quan, Haoran Huang, Shengfeng He, Ruotao Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12677-12686

title: DeepChange:具有服装变化的长期行人重识别基准数据集
title_en: DeepChange: A Long-Term Person Re-Identification Benchmark with Clothes Change
abstract: 在监控AI中,具有服装变化的长期行人重识别是一个具有挑战性的问题。目前,该领域的主要瓶颈是仍缺乏大型现实基准数据集。在本工作中,我们贡献了一个大型、现实的长期行人重识别基准数据集,称为DeepChange。其独特特性包括:(1) 真实且丰富的个人外观(如服装和发型)及其变化:高度多样的服装变化和风格,时间重出现间隔从几分钟到季节不等,不同天气条件(如晴天、多云、风天、雨天、雪天、极寒)和事件(如工作、休闲、日常活动);(2) 丰富的相机布置:原始视频由17台户外不同分辨率的相机在真实世界监控系统中录制;(3) 目前最大的相机数量(17台)、身份数量(1,121个)和边界框数量(178,407个),覆盖最长的时间跨度(12个月)。我们在该数据集上基准测试了代表性监督和无监督重识别方法。此外,我们研究了针对服装变化挑战的多模态融合策略。大量实验表明,我们的融合模型在DeepChange上优于多种最先进的模型。我们的数据集和文档可在https://github.com/PengBoXiangShang/deepchange获取。
abstract_en: Long-term re-id with clothes change is a challenging problem in surveillance AI. Currently, its major bottleneck is that this field is still missing a large realistic benchmark. In this work, we contribute a large, realistic long-term person re-identification benchmark, termed DeepChange. Its unique characteristics are: (1) Realistic and rich personal appearance (e.g., clothes and hair style) and variations: Highly diverse clothes change and styles, with varying reappearing gaps in time from minutes to seasons, different weather conditions (e.g., sunny, cloudy, windy, rainy, snowy, extremely cold) and events (e.g., working, leisure, daily activities). (2) Rich camera setups: Raw videos were recorded by 17 outdoor varying-resolution cameras operating in a real-world surveillance system. (3) The currently largest number of (17) cameras, (1, 121) identities, and (178, 407) bounding boxes, over the longest time span (12 months). We benchmark the representative supervised and unsupervised re-id methods on our dataset. In addition, we investigate multimodal fusion strategies for tackling the clothes change challenge. Extensive experiments show that our fusion models outperform a wide variety of state-of-the-art models on DeepChange. Our dataset and documents are available at https://github.com/PengBoXiangShang/deepchange.
authors: Peng Xu, Xiatian Zhu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11196-11205

title: DeformToon3D:面向三维卡通化的可变形神经辐射场
title_en: DeformToon3D: Deformable Neural Radiance Fields for 3D Toonification
abstract: 本文针对三维卡通化这一具有挑战性的问题展开研究,该问题涉及将艺术领域风格迁移至目标三维人脸,使其具有风格化几何结构和纹理。尽管对艺术领域预训练的3D GAN进行微调可以产生合理的性能,但该策略在三维领域存在局限性。特别是微调会破坏原始GAN潜在空间,影响后续语义编辑,并需要为每种新风格进行独立优化和存储,限制了灵活性和高效部署。为克服这些挑战,我们提出DeformToon3D,一种针对分层3D GAN的高效卡通化框架。我们的方法将三维卡通化分解为几何和纹理风格化子问题,以更好地保留原始潜在空间。具体而言,我们设计了一种新颖的StyleField,预测条件3D形变以将真实空间NeRF对齐至风格空间进行几何风格化。得益于StyleField的表述,该方法已能良好处理几何风格化,可通过自适应风格混合方便地实现纹理风格化,将艺术领域信息注入预训练3D GAN的解码器。由于独特的设计,我们的方法实现了灵活的风格程度控制和形状-纹理特定的风格交换。此外,我们无需任何真实世界2D-3D训练对即可实现高效训练,仅通过现成2D卡通化模型合成的代理样本即可完成。
abstract_en: In this paper, we address the challenging problem of 3D toonification, which involves transferring the style of an artistic domain onto a target 3D face with stylized geometry and texture. Although fine-tuning a pre-trained 3D GAN on the artistic domain can produce reasonable performance, this strategy has limitations in the 3D domain. In particular, fine-tuning can deteriorate the original GAN latent space, which affects subsequent semantic editing, and requires independent optimization and storage for each new style, limiting flexibility and efficient deployment. To overcome these challenges, we propose DeformToon3D, an effective toonification framework tailored for hierarchical 3D GAN. Our approach decomposes 3D toonification into subproblems of geometry and texture stylization to better preserve the original latent space. Specifically, we devise a novel StyleField that predicts conditional 3D deformation to align a real-space NeRF to the style space for geometry stylization. Thanks to the StyleField formulation, which already handles geometry stylization well, texture stylization can be achieved conveniently via adaptive style mixing that injects information of the artistic domain into the decoder of the pre-trained 3D GAN. Due to the unique design, our method enables flexible style degree control and shape-texture-specific style swap. Furthermore, we achieve efficient training without any real-world 2D-3D training pairs but proxy samples synthesized from off-the-shelf 2D toonification models.
authors: Junzhe Zhang, Yushi Lan, Shuai Yang, Fangzhou Hong, Quan Wang, Chai Kiat Yeo, Ziwei Liu, Chen Change Loy ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9144-9154

title: 低视角设置下基于可变形模型驱动的神经渲染高保真人体头部三维重建
title_en: Deformable Model-Driven Neural Rendering for High-Fidelity 3D Reconstruction of Human Heads Under Low-View Settings
abstract: 在低视角设置下重建三维人体头部面临技术挑战,主要由于有限视角和高频信号易导致过拟合风险。为解决这一问题,我们提出几何分解方法,并采用由粗到细的两阶段训练策略,逐步捕捉高频几何细节。我们使用组合符号距离场的零水平集表示三维人体头部,该场由平滑模板、非刚性变形和高频位移场组成。模板捕捉与身份和表情无关的特征,并与变形网络在多个个体的稀疏随机视角下联合训练。位移场捕捉个体特异性细节,针对每个人进行单独训练。我们的网络训练无需3D监督或物体掩码。实验结果验证了我们几何分解方法和两阶段训练策略的有效性与鲁棒性。在低视角设置下,我们的方法在重建精度和新视角合成方面优于现有神经渲染方法。此外,预训练模板为模型在遇到未见过的个体时提供了良好的初始化。
abstract_en: Reconstructing 3D human heads in low-view settings presents technical challenges, mainly due to the pronounced risk of overfitting with limited views and high-frequency signals. To address this, we propose geometry decomposition and adopt a two-stage, coarse-to-fine training strategy, allowing for progressively capturing high-frequency geometric details. We represent 3D human heads using the zero level-set of a combined signed distance field, comprising a smooth template, a non-rigid deformation, and a high-frequency displacement field. The template captures features that are independent of both identity and expression and is co-trained with the deformation network across multiple individuals with sparse and randomly selected views. The displacement field, capturing individual-specific details, undergoes separate training for each person. Our network training does not require 3D supervision or object masks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our geometry decomposition and two-stage training strategy. Our method outperforms existing neural rendering approaches in terms of reconstruction accuracy and novel view synthesis under low-view settings. Moreover, the pre-trained template serves a good initialization for our model when encountering unseen individuals.
authors: Baixin Xu, Jiarui Zhang, Kwan-Yee Lin, Chen Qian, Ying He ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17924-17934

title: 基于RGB和事件相机的可变形神经辐射场
title_en: Deformable Neural Radiance Fields using RGB and Event Cameras
abstract: 仅通过视觉数据建模快速移动可变形物体的神经辐射场是一个具有挑战性的问题。主要问题源于高变形和低采样率。为解决这一问题,我们提出使用事件相机,其以异步方式提供非常快速的视觉变化采集。在本工作中,我们开发了一种新颖的方法,利用RGB和事件相机对可变形神经辐射场进行建模。所提方法使用异步事件流和校准的稀疏RGB帧。在此设置中,单个事件的姿态——用于将其整合到辐射场中——仍需未知。我们的方法通过一次收集事件并主动采样事件来高效联合优化姿态和辐射场。在真实渲染和真实世界数据集上的实验表明,所提方法相比现有方法和对比基线具有显著优势。这表明了在真实世界动态场景中建模可变形神经辐射场的有前景方向。我们的代码和数据将公开可用。
abstract_en: Modeling Neural Radiance Fields for fast-moving deformable objects from visual data alone is a challenging problem. A major issue arises due to the high deformation and low acquisition rates. To address this problem, we propose to use event cameras that offer very fast acquisition of visual change in an asynchronous manner. In this work, we develop a novel method to model the deformable neural radiance fields using RGB and Event cameras. The proposed method uses the asynchronous stream of events and calibrated sparse RGB frames. In this setup, the pose of the individual events --required to integrate them into the radiance fields-- remains to be unknown. Our method jointly optimizes the pose and the radiance field, in an efficient manner by leveraging the collection of events at once and actively sampling the events during learning. Experiments conducted on both realistically rendered and real-world datasets demonstrate a significant benefit of the proposed method over the state-of-the-art and the compared baseline. This shows a promising direction for modeling deformable neural radiance fields in real-world dynamic scenes. Our code and data will be publicly available.
authors: Qi Ma, Danda Pani Paudel, Ajad Chhatkuli, Luc Van Gool ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3590-3600

title: 变形器:用于鲁棒手部姿态估计的动态融合变换器
title_en: Deformer: Dynamic Fusion Transformer for Robust Hand Pose Estimation
abstract: 准确估计三维手部姿态对于理解人类如何与世界互动至关重要。尽管取得了显著进展,现有方法在手部严重遮挡或模糊时往往难以生成合理的手部姿态。在视频中,手部运动使我们能够观察到在单帧中可能被遮挡或模糊的手部不同部分。为实现鲁棒手部姿态估计,我们提出Deformer:一个框架,该框架隐式推理同一图像(空间维度)和不同时间步(时间维度)中手部各部分之间的关系,以自适应利用遮挡或模糊前后的视觉线索。我们表明,直接应用Transformer自注意力机制是不够的,因为某些帧中的运动模糊或遮挡会导致手部特征严重扭曲,并生成不精确的键和查询。为解决这一挑战,我们在Deformer中引入了动态融合模块,该模块预测手部变形,并对邻近帧的手部网格预测进行变形,以明确支持当前帧的估计。此外,我们观察到误差在不同手部部分之间分布不均,指尖周围的顶点误差显著高于手掌周围的顶点。我们通过引入一种名为maxMSE的新损失函数来缓解这一问题,该函数自动调整每个顶点的权重,使模型关注关键手部部分。大量实验表明,我们的方法在准确率上比最先进方法提高了10%,并且对遮挡更具鲁棒性(超过14%)。
abstract_en: Accurately estimating 3D hand pose is crucial for understanding how humans interact with the world. Despite remarkable progress, existing methods often struggle to generate plausible hand poses when the hand is heavily occluded or blurred. In videos, the movements of the hand allow us to observe various parts of the hand that may be occluded or blurred in a single frame. To adaptively leverage the visual clue before and after the occlusion or blurring for robust hand pose estimation, we propose the Deformer: a framework that implicitly reasons about the relationship between hand parts within the same image (spatial dimension) and different timesteps (temporal dimension). We show that a naive application of the transformer self-attention mechanism is not sufficient because motion blur or occlusions in certain frames can lead to heavily distorted hand features and generate imprecise keys and queries. To address this challenge, we incorporate a Dynamic Fusion Module into Deformer, which predicts the deformation of the hand and warps the hand mesh predictions from nearby frames to explicitly support the current frame estimation. Furthermore, we have observed that errors are unevenly distributed across different hand parts, with vertices around fingertips having disproportionately higher errors than those around the palm. We mitigate this issue by introducing a new loss function called maxMSE that automatically adjusts the weight of every vertex to focus the model on critical hand parts. Extensive experiments show that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 10%, and is more robust to occlusions (over 14%).
authors: Qichen Fu, Xingyu Liu, Ran Xu, Juan Carlos Niebles, Kris M. Kitani ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23600-23611

title: 面向异构图像融合的抗退化展开网络
title_en: Degradation-Resistant Unfolding Network for Heterogeneous Image Fusion
abstract: 异构图像融合(HIF)技术旨在通过合并不同传感器捕获的互补信息来提升图像质量。在这些算法中,基于深度展开网络(DUN)的方法表现出色,但仍存在两个问题:缺乏面向抗退化的融合模型,且难以充分考虑DUN的结构特性,导致其在退化场景中表现脆弱。本文提出一种面向HIF任务的抗退化展开网络(DeRUN),即使在退化场景中也能生成高质量的融合图像。具体而言,我们引入了一种新型HIF模型以实现抗退化能力,并推导其优化过程。随后,我们将优化展开过程整合到所提出的DeRUN中,实现端到端训练。为确保DeRUN的鲁棒性和效率,我们采用联合约束策略和轻量级部分权重共享模块。为进一步训练DeRUN,我们提出了一种基于梯度方向的熵损失函数,具有强大的纹理表征能力。大量实验表明,DeRUN在四个HIF任务及下游应用中显著优于现有方法,且具有更低的计算和内存成本。
abstract_en: Heterogeneous image fusion (HIF) techniques aim to enhance image quality by merging complementary information from images captured by different sensors. Among these algorithms, deep unfolding network (DUN)-based methods achieve promising performance but still suffer from two issues: they lack a degradation-resistant-oriented fusion model and struggle to adequately consider the structural properties of DUNs, making them vulnerable to degradation scenarios. In this paper, we propose a Degradation-Resistant Unfolding Network (DeRUN) for the HIF task to generate high-quality fused images even in degradation scenarios. Specifically, we introduce a novel HIF model for degradation resistance and derive its optimization procedures. Then, we incorporate the optimization unfolding process into the proposed DeRUN for end-to-end training. To ensure the robustness and efficiency of DeRUN, we employ a joint constraint strategy and a lightweight partial weight sharing module. To train DeRUN, we further propose a gradient direction-based entropy loss with powerful texture representation capacity. Extensive experiments show that DeRUN significantly outperforms existing methods on four HIF tasks, as well as downstream applications, with cheaper computational and memory costs.
authors: Chunming He, Kai Li, Guoxia Xu, Yulun Zhang, Runze Hu, Zhenhua Guo, Xiu Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12611-12621

title: 基于自适应表面细化的NeRF纹理网格恢复
title_en: Delicate Textured Mesh Recovery from NeRF via Adaptive Surface Refinement
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRF)在基于图像的三维重建领域取得了显著突破。然而,其隐式体积表示与广泛采用的多边形网格存在显著差异,并缺乏常见三维软件和硬件的支持,导致其渲染和操作效率低下。为克服这一局限性,我们提出了一种新颖的框架,从图像中生成纹理表面网格。我们的方法首先通过NeRF高效初始化几何结构和视图依赖分解的外观。随后提取粗网格,并开发了一种迭代表面细化算法,根据重新投影的渲染误差自适应调整顶点位置和面密度。我们将外观与几何结构联合优化,并烘焙到纹理图像中以实现实时渲染。大量实验表明,我们的方法在网格质量和渲染质量方面均表现出色。
abstract_en:
Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) have constituted a remarkable breakthrough in image-based 3D reconstruction. 
 However, their implicit volumetric representations differ significantly from the widely-adopted polygonal meshes and lack support from common 3D software and hardware, making their rendering and manipulation inefficient.
 To overcome this limitation, we present a novel framework that generates textured surface meshes from images. 
 Our approach begins by efficiently initializing the geometry and view-dependency decomposed appearance with a NeRF.
 Subsequently, a coarse mesh is extracted, and an iterative surface refinement algorithm is developed to adaptively adjust both vertex positions and face density based on re-projected rendering errors. 
 We jointly refine the appearance with geometry and bake it into texture images for real-time rendering.
 Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior mesh quality and competitive rendering quality.
authors: Jiaxiang Tang, Hang Zhou, Xiaokang Chen, Tianshu Hu, Errui Ding, Jingdong Wang, Gang Zeng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17739-17749

title: Delta去噪评分
title_en: Delta Denoising Score
abstract: 本文介绍了Delta去噪评分(DDS),一种基于扩散的新型评分技术,用于优化参数模型以执行图像编辑任务。与现有的分数蒸馏采样(SDS)不同,后者通过单一图像-文本对查询生成模型,DDS利用额外的固定查询参考图像-文本对,生成表示两个查询输出差异的delta评分。通过利用源图像及其文本描述估计SDS引入的噪声梯度方向,DDS提供了更清晰的梯度方向,仅修改图像的编辑部分而保持其他部分不变,从而实现源图像的蒸馏式编辑。本文提出的分析支持了新评分在图像到图像翻译中的强大能力。我们进一步表明,新评分可用于训练有效的零样本图像翻译模型。实验结果表明,所提出的损失项在稳定性和质量方面均优于现有方法,突显了其在实际应用中的潜力。
abstract_en:
This paper introduces Delta Denoising Score (DDS), a novel diffusion-based scoring technique that optimizes a parametric model for the task of image editing. Unlike the existing Score Distillation Sampling (SDS), which queries the generative model with a single image-text pair, DDS utilizes an additional fixed query of a reference image-text pair to generate delta scores that represent the difference between the outputs of the two queries. 
 By estimating noisy gradient directions introduced by SDS using the source image and its text description, DDS provides cleaner gradient directions that modify the edited portions of the image while leaving others unchanged, yielding a distilled edit of the source image.
 The analysis presented in this paper supports the power of the new score for image-to-image translation. We further show that the new score can be used to train an effective zero-shot image translation model.
