abstract: 随着基于Transformer的模型规模持续扩大,对这些大规模预训练视觉模型进行新任务微调所需的参数量日益增加。参数高效学习方法被提出以减少微调过程中的可调参数数量。尽管这些方法展现出 promising 结果,但与完整微调相比仍存在显著的性能差距。为应对这一挑战,我们提出了一种面向大规模Transformer模型适应的高效且有效的视觉提示调优(E^2VPT)方法。具体而言,我们分别在自注意力机制和输入层中引入一组可学习的键值提示和视觉提示,以提升模型微调的有效性。此外,我们设计了一种提示剪枝过程,系统性地剪除低重要性提示同时保持模型性能,从而大幅提升模型效率。实验证明,我们的方法在两个基准测试中显著优于多个SOTA基线,参数使用率极低(例如在VTAB-1k上仅需0.32%的模型参数)。我们期待这项工作能激发对大规模模型先预训练后微调范式的进一步探索。
abstract_en: As the size of transformer-based models continues to grow, fine-tuning these large-scale pre-trained vision models for new tasks has become increasingly parameter-intensive. Parameter-efficient learning has been developed to reduce the number of tunable parameters during fine-tuning. Although these methods show promising results, there is still a significant performance gap compared to full fine-tuning. To address this challenge, we propose an Effective and Efficient Visual Prompt Tuning (E^2VPT) approach for large-scale transformer-based model adaptation. Specifically, we introduce a set of learnable key-value prompts and visual prompts into self-attention and input layers, respectively, to improve the effectiveness of model fine-tuning. Moreover, we design a prompt pruning procedure to systematically prune low importance prompts while preserving model performance, which largely enhances the model's efficiency. Empirical results demonstrate that our approach outperforms several state-of-the-art baselines on two benchmarks, with considerably low parameter usage (e.g., 0.32% of model parameters on VTAB-1k). We anticipate that this work will inspire further exploration within the pretrain-then-finetune paradigm for large-scale models.
authors: Cheng Han, Qifan Wang, Yiming Cui, Zhiwen Cao, Wenguan Wang, Siyuan Qi, Dongfang Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17491-17502

title: EdaDet: 基于早期密集对齐的开放词汇目标检测
title_en: EdaDet: Open-Vocabulary Object Detection Using Early Dense Alignment
abstract: 诸如CLIP之类的视觉-语言模型显著提升了开放词汇目标检测性能,其中检测器在基础类别上训练但需检测新类别。现有方法利用CLIP的强零样本识别能力,将物体级嵌入与类别文本嵌入对齐。然而,我们观察到使用CLIP进行物体级对齐会导致对基础类别的过拟合,即与基础类别最相似的新类别表现显著下降,因其被误认为相似的基础类别。本文首先识别出关键细粒度局部图像语义的损失阻碍了现有方法实现强基础到新类泛化。随后,我们提出早期密集对齐(EDA)以弥合可泛化局部语义与物体级预测之间的差距。在EDA中,我们通过物体级监督学习密集级而非物体级对齐,以保持局部细粒度语义。大量实验表明,在相同严格设置下且无需外部训练资源时,我们的方法优于竞争方法,即在COCO数据集上将新类别框AP50提升+8.4%,在LVIS数据集上将罕见掩码AP提升+3.9%。
abstract_en: Vision-language models such as CLIP have boosted the performance of open-vocabulary object detection, where the detector is trained on base categories but required to detect novel categories. Existing methods leverage CLIP's strong zero-shot recognition ability to align object-level embeddings with textual embeddings of categories. However, we observe that using CLIP for object-level alignment results in overfitting to base categories, i.e., novel categories most similar to base categories have particularly poor performance as they are recognized as similar base categories. In this paper, we first identify that the loss of critical fine-grained local image semantics hinders existing methods from attaining strong base-to-novel generalization. Then, we propose Early Dense Alignment (EDA) to bridge the gap between generalizable local semantics and object-level prediction. In EDA, we use object-level supervision to learn the dense-level rather than object-level alignment to maintain the local fine-grained semantics. Extensive experiments demonstrate our superior performance to competing approaches under the same strict setting and without using external training resources, i.e., improving the +8.4% novel box AP50 on COCO and +3.9% rare mask AP on LVIS.
authors: Cheng Shi, Sibei Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15724-15734

title: 基于神经基础元素组装的可编辑图像几何抽象
title_en: Editable Image Geometric Abstraction via Neural Primitive Assembly
abstract: 本工作探索了一种基于预定义简单参数化基础元素(即三角形、矩形、圆形和半圆形)组合装配的新型图像几何抽象范式,实现对图像中形状的可控编辑。该任务被建模为混合组合与连续优化问题,但通过标记转换神经框架进行近似重述,该框架以图像到集合的方式同时输出基础元素分配及其对应的变换和颜色参数,从而绕过复杂的非可微分图匹配迭代过程。为放松搜索空间并解决梯度消失问题,引入了一种新颖的神经软分配方案,深入探索二部b匹配中的分配与具有透明度感知的加权多重光栅化组合之间的近似等价关系,显著降低优化复杂度。无需真实图像抽象标注(即矢量表示),整个流程基于可微光栅化技术的关联性,以自监督方式实现端到端训练。在多个数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的框架仅通过四种简单基础元素的组合即可预测出高度引人注目的矢量几何抽象结果,并且通过简单替换基础元素类型即可实现非常直观的形状编辑能力,相较以往的图像抽象和图像矢量化方法具有显著优势。
abstract_en: This work explores a novel image geometric abstraction paradigm based on assembly out of a pool of pre-defined simple parametric primitives (i.e., triangle, rectangle, circle and semicircle), facilitating controllable shape editing in images. While cast as a mixed combinatorial and continuous optimization problem, the above task is approximately reformulated within a token translation neural framework that simultaneously outputs primitive assignments and corresponding transformation and color parameters in an image-to-set manner, thus bypassing complex/non-differentiable graph-matching iterations. To relax the searching space and address the gradient vanishing issue, a novel Neural Soft Assignment scheme that well explores the quasi-equivalence between the assignment in Bipartite b-Matching and opacity-aware weighted multiple rasterization combination is introduced, drastically reducing the optimization complexity. Without ground-truth image abstraction labeling (i.e., vectorized representation), the whole pipeline is end-to-end trainable in a self-supervised manner, based on the linkage of differentiable rasterization techniques. Extensive experiments on several datasets well demonstrate that our framework is able to predict highly compelling vectorized geometric abstraction results with a combination of ONLY four simple primitives, also with VERY straightforward shape editing capability by simple replacement of primitive type, compared to previous image abstraction and image vectorization methods.
authors: Ye Chen, Bingbing Ni, Xuanhong Chen, Zhangli Hu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23514-23523

title: 编辑文本到图像扩散模型中的隐式假设
title_en: Editing Implicit Assumptions in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
abstract: 文本到图像扩散模型在生成图像时常常会基于世界做出隐式假设。虽然某些假设是有用的(例如天空是蓝色的),但它们也可能过时、错误,或反映训练数据中存在的社会偏见。因此,需要在不依赖用户显式输入或昂贵重训练的情况下控制这些假设。本文旨在编辑预训练扩散模型中的给定隐式假设。我们的文本到图像模型编辑方法(简称TIME)接收一对输入:一个"源"提示,该提示未明确指定且模型对其做出隐式假设(例如"一束玫瑰"),以及一个"目标"提示,该提示描述相同场景但指定了期望属性(例如"一束蓝色玫瑰")。TIME随后更新模型的交叉注意力层,因为这些层为文本标记赋予视觉意义。我们编辑这些层的投影矩阵,使源提示投影到目标提示附近。我们的方法效率很高,仅在不到一秒内修改模型参数的2.2%。为评估模型编辑方法,我们引入了TIMED(TIME数据集),包含来自不同领域的147对源和目标提示。实验(使用Stable Diffusion)表明,TIME在模型编辑中取得成功,能够很好地泛化到编辑过程中未见过的相关提示,并对无关生成产生最小影响。
abstract_en:
Text-to-image diffusion models often make implicit assumptions about the world when generating images.
 While some assumptions are useful (e.g., the sky is blue), they can also be outdated, incorrect, or reflective of social biases present in the training data.
 Thus, there is a need to control these assumptions without requiring explicit user input or costly re-training.
 In this work, we aim to edit a given implicit assumption in a pre-trained diffusion model.
 Our Text-to-Image Model Editing method, TIME for short, receives a pair of inputs: a "source" under-specified prompt for which the model makes an implicit assumption (e.g., "a pack of roses"), and a "destination" prompt that describes the same setting, but with a specified desired attribute (e.g., "a pack of blue roses").
 TIME then updates the model's cross-attention layers, as these layers assign visual meaning to textual tokens.
 We edit the projection matrices in these layers such that the source prompt is projected close to the destination prompt.
 Our method is highly efficient, as it modifies a mere 2.2% of the model's parameters in under one second.
 To evaluate model editing approaches, we introduce TIMED (TIME Dataset), containing 147 source and destination prompt pairs from various domains.
 Our experiments (using Stable Diffusion) show that TIME is successful in model editing, generalizes well for related prompts unseen during editing, and imposes minimal effect on unrelated generations.
authors: Hadas Orgad, Bahjat Kawar, Yonatan Belinkov ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7053-7061

title: 基于加速迭代扩散逆过程的真实图像编辑
title_en: Effective Real Image Editing with Accelerated Iterative Diffusion Inversion
abstract: 尽管近年来取得了诸多进展,但使用现代生成模型对自然图像进行编辑和操控仍面临挑战。当使用生成对抗网络(GAN)时,一个主要障碍在于逆过程将真实图像映射到潜在空间中的对应噪声向量,因为需要能够重建图像以编辑其内容。同样地,对于去噪扩散隐式模型(DDIM),每个逆步骤中的线性化假设使得整个确定性逆过程不可靠。现有解决逆过程稳定性的方法往往在计算效率上存在显著权衡。在本工作中,我们提出了一种加速迭代扩散逆方法(AIDI),在空间和时间复杂度仅有最小额外开销的情况下显著提升了重建精度。通过使用一种新颖的混合引导技术,我们证明无需大范围的无条件分类引导即可在多种图像编辑任务中获得有效结果。此外,与其它基于扩散逆的文献相比,我们的方法在10和20步扩散范围内的快速图像编辑中表现出更强的鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Despite all recent progress, it is still challenging to edit and manipulate natural images with modern generative models. When using Generative Adversarial Network (GAN), one major hurdle is in the inversion process mapping a real image to its corresponding noise vector in the latent space, since its necessary to be able to reconstruct an image to edit its contents. Likewise for Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models (DDIM), the linearization assumption in each inversion step makes the whole deterministic inversion process unreliable. Existing approaches that have tackled the problem of inversion stability often incur in significant trade-offs in computational efficiency. In this work we propose an Accelerated Iterative Diffusion Inversion method, dubbed AIDI, that significantly improves reconstruction accuracy with minimal additional overhead in space and time complexity. By using a novel blended guidance technique, we show that effective results can be obtained on a large range of image editing tasks without large classifier-free guidance in inversion. Furthermore, when compared with other diffusion inversion based works, our proposed process is shown to be more robust for fast image editing in the 10 and 20 diffusion steps' regimes.
authors: Zhihong Pan, Riccardo Gherardi, Xiufeng Xie, Stephen Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15912-15921

title: 基于超级点变换器的高效三维语义分割
title_en: Efficient 3D Semantic Segmentation with Superpoint Transformer
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于超级点的变换器架构,用于高效分割大规模三维场景。我们的方法采用快速算法将点云划分为层次化超级点结构,使预处理速度比现有基于超级点的方法快7倍。此外,我们利用自注意力机制在多尺度上捕捉超级点之间的关系,在三个具有挑战性的基准数据集上取得最先进性能:S3DIS(六折验证mIoU 76.0%)、KITTI-360(Val集63.5%)和DALES(79.6%)。仅需21.2万个参数,我们的方法在保持相似性能的同时,比其他最先进模型紧凑200倍。此外,我们的模型可在单块GPU上3小时内完成S3DIS数据集一个折的训练,所需GPU小时数比最佳方法少7到70倍。我们的代码和模型可在github.com/drprojects/superpoint_transformer获取。
abstract_en: We introduce a novel superpoint-based transformer architecture for efficient semantic segmentation of large-scale 3D scenes. Our method incorporates a fast algorithm to partition point clouds into a hierarchical superpoint structure, which makes our preprocessing 7 times faster than existing superpoint-based approaches. Additionally, we leverage a self-attention mechanism to capture the relationships between superpoints at multiple scales, leading to state-of-the-art performance on three challenging benchmark datasets: S3DIS (76.0% mIoU 6-fold validation), KITTI-360 (63.5% on Val), and DALES (79.6%). With only 212k parameters, our approach is up to 200 times more compact than other state-of-the-art models while maintaining similar performance. Furthermore, our model can be trained on a single GPU in 3 hours for a fold of the S3DIS dataset, which is 7x to 70x fewer GPU-hours than the best-performing methods. Our code and models are accessible at github.com/drprojects/superpoint_transformer.
authors: Damien Robert, Hugo Raguet, Loic Landrieu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17195-17204

title: 基于概念引导记忆的高效自适应人-物交互检测
title_en: Efficient Adaptive Human-Object Interaction Detection with Concept-guided Memory
abstract: 人-物交互(HOI)检测旨在定位并推断人与物体之间的关系。据认为,从头开始训练监督模型进行此任务存在挑战,因为稀有类别的性能下降以及处理现实场景中复杂HOI场景中HOI长尾分布所需的高计算成本和时间消耗。这一观察促使我们设计一种HOI检测器,即使在长尾标注数据下也能进行训练,并能利用预训练模型的现有知识。受大型视觉-语言模型(VLM)在分类和检索任务中强大泛化能力的启发,我们提出了一种高效的自适应HOI检测器(ADA-CM),其具有概念引导记忆机制。ADA-CM包含两种运行模式。第一种模式在无需训练的范式中使其可调,无需学习新参数。第二种模式结合了实例感知适配器机制,如果可以负担更新一组轻量级参数,该机制可进一步高效提升性能。我们的方法在HICO-DET和V-COCO数据集上取得了与最先进水平相当的结果,且训练时间显著减少。代码可在https://github.com/ltttpku/ADA-CM获取。
abstract_en: Human Object Interaction (HOI) detection aims to localize and infer the relationships between a human and an object. Arguably, training supervised models for this task from scratch presents challenges due to the performance drop over rare classes and the high computational cost and time required to handle long-tailed distributions of HOIs in complex HOI scenes in realistic settings. This observation motivates us to design an HOI detector that can be trained even with long-tailed labeled data and can leverage existing knowledge from pre-trained models. Inspired by the powerful generalization ability of the large Vision-Language Models (VLM) on classification and retrieval tasks, we propose an efficient Adaptive HOI Detector with Concept-guided Memory (ADA-CM). ADA-CM has two operating modes. The first mode makes it tunable without learning new parameters in a training-free paradigm. Its second mode incorporates an instance-aware adapter mechanism that can further efficiently boost performance if updating a lightweight set of parameters can be afforded. Our proposed method achieves competitive results with state-of-the-art on the HICO-DET and V-COCO datasets with much less training time. Code can be found at https://github.com/ltttpku/ADA-CM.
authors: Ting Lei, Fabian Caba, Qingchao Chen, Hailin Jin, Yuxin Peng, Yang Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6480-6490

title: 多任务视觉场景理解中的高效计算共享
title_en: Efficient Computation Sharing for Multi-Task Visual Scene Understanding
abstract: 使用独立模型解决多个视觉任务可能需要大量资源,而多任务学习通过跨任务共享知识可有效节省资源。尽管多任务学习具有优势,但此类技术在平衡各任务损失方面可能面临挑战,导致潜在的性能退化。我们提出了一种新颖的计算和参数共享框架,在保持效率与准确性的平衡下,利用单独训练的单任务Transformer模型执行多种视觉任务。该方法受迁移学习方案启发,旨在降低计算和参数存储成本,同时维持所需性能。我们的方法通过将任务划分为基础任务和其他子任务,并在基础任务与子任务间共享大量激活和参数/权重,以减少任务间冗余并增强知识共享。在NYUD-v2和PASCAL-context数据集上的评估表明,我们的方法在准确率更高且计算资源更少的情况下优于现有基于Transformer的多任务学习技术。此外,我们的方法扩展至视频流输入,通过在时间域和任务域间高效共享信息,进一步降低计算成本。我们的代码可在https://github.com/sarashoouri/EfficientMTL获取。
abstract_en: Solving multiple visual tasks using individual models can be resource-intensive, while multi-task learning can conserve resources by sharing knowledge across different tasks. Despite the benefits of multi-task learning, such techniques can struggle with balancing the loss for each task, leading to potential performance degradation. We present a novel computation- and parameter-sharing framework that balances efficiency and accuracy to perform multiple visual tasks utilizing individually-trained single-task transformers. Our method is motivated by transfer learning schemes to reduce computational and parameter storage costs while maintaining the desired performance. Our approach involves splitting the tasks into a base task and the other sub-tasks, and sharing a significant portion of activations and parameters/weights between the base and sub-tasks to decrease inter-task redundancies and enhance knowledge sharing. The evaluation conducted on NYUD-v2 and PASCAL-context datasets shows that our method is superior to the state-of-the-art transformer-based multi-task learning techniques with higher accuracy and reduced computational resources. Moreover, our method is extended to video stream inputs, further reducing computational costs by efficiently sharing information across the temporal domain as well as the task domain. Our codes are available at https://github.com/sarashoouri/EfficientMTL.
authors: Sara Shoouri, Mingyu Yang, Zichen Fan, Hun-Seok Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17130-17141

title: 高效可控的多任务架构
title_en: Efficient Controllable Multi-Task Architectures
abstract: 我们旨在训练一个多任务模型,使用户在部署后能够调整所需的计算预算和任务性能的相对重要性,而无需重新训练。这使得能够针对动态变化的用户需求优化性能,而无需为各种场景训练和保存模型所带来的沉重计算开销。为此,我们提出了一种多任务模型,包含共享编码器和任务特定解码器,其中编码器和解码器的通道宽度均可缩放。我们的核心思想是通过调整任务特定解码器的容量来控制任务重要性,同时通过联合调整编码器容量来控制总计算成本。这通过在给定预算下允许更强的编码器来提高整体准确性,增强对计算成本的控制,并基于用户的约束生成高质量的轻量化子架构。我们的训练策略涉及一种新颖的`配置不变知识蒸馏`损失函数,强制主干表示在不同运行时宽度配置下保持不变以提升准确性。此外,我们提出了一种简单但有效的搜索算法,将用户约束转换为共享编码器和任务解码器的运行时宽度配置,以采样子架构。搜索算法的关键规则是为更受青睐的任务解码器提供更大的计算预算,同时搜索增强整体多任务学习(MTL)性能的共享编码器配置。在三个具有不同主干架构的多任务基准(PASCALContext、NYUDv2和CIFAR100-MTL)上的各种实验验证了我们方法的优势。例如,在NYUD-v2数据集上,我们的方法相比先前方法在可控性方面提高了33.5%,同时计算成本显著降低。
abstract_en: We aim to train a multi-task model such that users can adjust the desired compute budget and relative importance of task performances after deployment, without retraining. This enables optimizing performance for dynamically varying user needs, without heavy computational overhead to train and save models for various scenarios. To this end, we propose a multi-task model consisting of a shared encoder and task-specific decoders where both encoder and decoder channel widths are slimmable. Our key idea is to control the task importance by varying the capacities of task-specific decoders, while controlling the total computational cost by jointly adjusting the encoder capacity. This improves overall accuracy by allowing a stronger encoder for a given budget, increases control over computational cost, and delivers high-quality slimmed sub-architectures based on user's constraints. Our training strategy involves a novel `Configuration-Invariant Knowledge Distillation' loss that enforces backbone representations to be invariant under different runtime width configurations to enhance accuracy. Further, we present a simple but effective search algorithm that translates user constraints to runtime width configurations of both the shared encoder and task decoders, for sampling the sub-architectures. The key rule for the search algorithm is to provide a larger computational budget to the higher preferred task decoder, while searching a shared encoder configuration that enhances the overall MTL performance. Various experiments on three multi-task benchmarks (PASCALContext, NYUDv2, and CIFAR100-MTL) with diverse backbone architectures demonstrate the advantage of our approach. For example, our method shows a higher controllability by   33.5% in the NYUD-v2 dataset over prior methods, while incurring much less compute cost.
authors: Abhishek Aich, Samuel Schulter, Amit K. Roy-Chowdhury, Manmohan Chandraker, Yumin Suh ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5740-5751

title: 高效转换脉冲神经网络在三维与二维分类中的应用
title_en: Efficient Converted Spiking Neural Network for 3D and 2D Classification
abstract: 脉冲神经网络(SNNs)因其低功耗和生物合理性而受到广泛关注。现有ANN-SNN转换方法可通过将训练良好的人工神经网络(ANN)转换为SNN实现无损转换。然而,转换后的SNN需要大量时间步才能达到与训练良好的ANN相当的性能,这意味着较大的延迟。本文提出了一种高效的统一ANN-SNN转换方法,用于点云分类和图像分类,以显著减少时间步,满足快速且无损的ANN-SNN转换需求。具体而言,我们首先根据脉冲神经元的激活状态自适应调整阈值,确保每个时间步激活一定比例的脉冲神经元,从而减少膜电位积累时间。随后,我们采用自适应放电机制扩大脉冲输出范围,在短时间内获取更多判别特征。大量实验结果在具有挑战性的点云和图像数据集上表明,所提出的方法显著优于最先进的ANN-SNN转换方法。
abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have attracted enormous research interest due to their low-power and biologically plausible nature. Existing ANN-SNN conversion methods can achieve lossless conversion by converting a well-trained Artificial Neural Network (ANN) into an SNN. However, converted SNN requires a large amount of time steps to achieve competitive performance with the well-trained ANN, which means a large latency. In this paper, we propose an efficient unified ANN-SNN conversion method for point cloud classification and image classification to significantly reduce the time step to meet the fast and lossless ANN-SNN transformation. Specifically, we first adaptively adjust the threshold according to the activation state of spiking neurons, ensuring a certain proportion of spiking neurons are activated at each time step to reduce the time for accumulation of membrane potential. Next, we use an adaptive firing mechanism to enlarge the range of spiking output, getting more discrimination features in short time steps. Extensive experimental results on challenging point cloud and image datasets demonstrate that the suggested approach significantly outmatches state-of-the-art ANN-SNN conversion based methods.
authors: Yuxiang Lan, Yachao Zhang, Xu Ma, Yanyun Qu, Yun Fu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9211-9220

title: 面向视频识别的高效基于决策的黑盒补丁攻击
title_en: Efficient Decision-based Black-box Patch Attacks on Video Recognition
abstract: 尽管深度神经网络(DNNs)表现出色,但它们易受对抗补丁攻击,这些补丁通过在输入中引入可感知且局部的扰动来实现攻击。图像上的对抗补丁生成已获得广泛关注,而视频上的对抗补丁研究尚未得到充分探索。此外,基于决策的攻击(攻击者仅通过查询威胁模型获取预测的硬标签)在视频模型上的研究也尚未深入,尽管其在实际视频识别场景中具有实用性。此类研究的缺失导致视频模型鲁棒性评估存在巨大差距。为弥合这一差距,本文首先探索视频模型的基于决策的补丁攻击。我们分析发现,视频带来的巨大参数空间和基于决策模型返回的最小信息均显著增加了攻击难度和查询负担。为实现查询高效的攻击,我们提出时空差分进化(STDE)框架。首先,STDE将目标视频作为补丁纹理,并仅在通过时序差异自适应选择的关键帧上添加补丁。其次,STDE以最小化补丁面积为优化目标,采用时空变异和交叉操作搜索全局最优解,避免陷入局部最优。实验表明,STDE在威胁性、效率和不可察觉性方面均展现出最先进的性能。因此,STDE有望成为评估视频识别模型鲁棒性的强大工具。
abstract_en: Although Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have demonstrated excellent performance, they are vulnerable to adversarial patches that introduce perceptible and localized perturbations to the input. Generating adversarial patches on images has received much attention, while adversarial patches on videos have not been well investigated. Further, decision-based attacks, where attackers only access the predicted hard labels by querying threat models, have not been well explored on video models either, even if they are practical in real-world video recognition scenes. The absence of such studies leads to a huge gap in the robustness assessment for video models. To bridge this gap, this work first explores decision-based patch attacks on video models. We analyze that the huge parameter space brought by videos and the minimal information returned by decision-based models both greatly increase the attack difficulty and query burden. To achieve a query-efficient attack, we propose a spatial-temporal differential evolution (STDE) framework. First, STDE introduces target videos as patch textures and only adds patches on keyframes that are adaptively selected by temporal difference. Second, STDE takes minimizing the patch area as the optimization objective and adopts spatial-temporal mutation and crossover to search for the global optimum without falling into the local optimum. Experiments show STDE has demonstrated state-of-the-art performance in terms of threat, efficiency and imperceptibility. Hence, STDE has the potential to be a powerful tool for evaluating the robustness of video recognition models.
authors: Kaixun Jiang, Zhaoyu Chen, Hao Huang, Jiafeng Wang, Dingkang Yang, Bo Li, Yan Wang, Wenqiang Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4379-4389

title: 高效深度空间填充曲线
title_en: Efficient Deep Space Filling Curve
abstract: 空间填充曲线(SFCs)作为一种线性化方法,将高维空间中的数据映射到低维空间,被广泛应用于计算机视觉领域,如图像/点云压缩、哈希等。目前,研究者将寻找最优SFC的问题转化为在图像网格图上寻找单一哈密顿回路的问题。现有方法采用图神经网络(GNN)进行SFC搜索。通过将像素网格建模为图,首先利用GNN预测边权重,再基于预测结果生成最小生成树(MST),进一步构建SFC。然而,基于GNN的方法存在计算成本高和内存占用大的问题。此外,MST生成过程不可微,无法通过梯度下降进行优化。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种基于GNN的SFC搜索框架,结合定制算法大幅降低GNN的计算成本。同时,我们提出了一种孪生网络学习方案,以端到端方式优化基于深度神经网络(DNN)的模型。大量实验表明,我们的方法在多种基准测试中显著优于基于DNN的方法和传统SFCs(如希尔伯特曲线)。
abstract_en:
Space-filling curves (SFCs) act as a linearization approach to map data in higher dimensional space to lower dimensional space, which is used comprehensively in computer vision, such as image/point cloud compression, hashing and etc. Currently, researchers formulate the problem of searching for an optimal SFC to the problem of finding a single Hamiltonian circuit on the image grid graph. Existing methods adopt graph neural networks (GNN) for SFC search. By modeling the pixel grid as a graph, they first adopt GNN to predict the edge weights and then generate a minimum spanning tree (MST) based on the predictions, which is further used to construct the SFC. However, GNN-based methods suffer from high computational costs and memory footprint usage. Besides, MST generation is un-differentiable, which is infeasible to optimize via gradient descent. To remedy these issues, we propose a GNN-based SFC-search framework with a tailored algorithm that largely reduces computational cost of GNN.
  Additionally, we propose a siamese network learning scheme to optimize DNN-based models in an end-to-end fashion. 
  Extensive experiments show that our proposed method outperforms both DNN-based methods and traditional SFCs, e.g. Hilbert curve, by a large margin on various benchmarks.
authors: Wanli Chen, Xufeng Yao, Xinyun Zhang, Bei Yu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17525-17534

title: 基于最小信噪比加权策略的高效扩散训练
title_en: Efficient Diffusion Training via Min-SNR Weighting Strategy
abstract: 去噪扩散模型已成为图像生成的主流方法,然而训练这些模型常面临收敛速度慢的问题。本文发现,收敛速度慢部分源于时间步之间优化方向的冲突。为解决这一问题,我们将扩散训练视为多任务学习问题,并引入一种简单而有效的策略,称为Min-SNR-g。该方法基于钳制的信噪比调整时间步的损失权重,有效平衡了时间步间的冲突。实验结果表明,该方法在收敛速度上显著提升,比之前的方法快3.4倍。同时,其效果更优,在ImageNet 256x256基准测试中,使用比先前最先进方法更小的架构,创下了新的FID分数记录2.06。
abstract_en: Denoising diffusion models have been a mainstream approach for image generation, however, training these models often suffers from slow convergence. In this paper, we discovered that the slow convergence is partly due to conflicting optimization directions between timesteps. To address this issue, we treat the diffusion training as a multi-task learning problem, and introduce a simple yet effective approach referred to as Min-SNR-g. This method adapts loss weights of timesteps based on clamped signal-to-noise ratios, which effectively balances the conflicts among timesteps. Our results demonstrate a significant improvement in converging speed, 3.4x faster than previous weighting strategies. It is also more effective, achieving a new record FID score of 2.06 on the ImageNet 256x256 benchmark using smaller architectures than that employed in previous state-of-the-art.
authors: Tiankai Hang, Shuyang Gu, Chen Li, Jianmin Bao, Dong Chen, Han Hu, Xin Geng, Baining Guo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7441-7451

title: 高效发现与有效评估视觉感知相似性:基准与超越
title_en: Efficient Discovery and Effective Evaluation of Visual Perceptual Similarity: A Benchmark and Beyond
abstract: 视觉相似性发现(VSD)是一项具有广泛应用的电子商务重要任务。给定某一物体的图像,VSD的目标是检索出具有高感知视觉相似性的不同物体图像。尽管该问题已受到广泛关注,但现有方法的评估通常基于识别-检索任务的代理指标,仅评估模型检索同一物体不同图像的能力。我们认为基于识别任务评估VSD方法存在局限性,忠实的评估必须依赖专家标注。本文我们引入了首个大规模时尚视觉相似性基准数据集,包含超过110K的专家标注图像对。除这一主要贡献外,我们分享了在构建该数据集过程中遇到的挑战所带来的见解。基于这些见解,我们提出了一种新颖且高效的标注流程,可应用于任何数据集。我们的分析探讨了其局限性与归纳偏置,并基于这些发现提出了缓解这些局限性的度量指标。尽管我们的主要关注点在于视觉相似性,但所提出的方法论在跨领域发现和评估感知相似性方面具有更广泛的应用价值。
abstract_en: Visual similarities discovery (VSD) is an important task with broad e-commerce applications. Given an image of a certain object, the goal of VSD is to retrieve images of different objects with high perceptual visual similarity. Although being a highly addressed problem, the evaluation of proposed methods for VSD is often based on a proxy of an identification-retrieval task, evaluating the ability of a model to retrieve different images of the same object. We posit that evaluating VSD methods based on identification tasks is limited, and faithful evaluation must rely on expert annotations. In this paper, we introduce the first large-scale fashion visual similarity benchmark dataset, consisting of more than 110K expert-annotated image pairs. Besides this major contribution, we share insight from the challenges we faced while curating this dataset. Based on these insights, we propose a novel and efficient labeling procedure that can be applied to any dataset. Our analysis examines its limitations and inductive biases, and based on these findings, we propose metrics to mitigate those limitations. Though our primary focus lies on visual similarity, the methodologies we present have broader applications for discovering and evaluating perceptual similarity across various domains.
authors: Oren Barkan, Tal Reiss, Jonathan Weill, Ori Katz, Roy Hirsch, Itzik Malkiel, Noam Koenigstein ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20007-20018

title: 音频驱动虚拟头像生成的高效情感适配
title_en: Efficient Emotional Adaptation for Audio-Driven Talking-Head Generation
abstract: 音频驱动虚拟头像合成是虚拟人类相关应用中的热门研究课题。然而,现有方法存在灵活性差和效率低下的问题,需要昂贵的端到端训练才能将引导视频中的情感转移到虚拟头像预测中,这成为显著限制。在本工作中,我们提出了一种面向音频驱动虚拟头像的(Emotional Adaptation for Audio-driven Talking-head,EAT)方法,通过参数高效的适配方式,将情感无关的虚拟头像模型转化为情感可控的模型。我们的方法采用预训练的情感无关虚拟头像Transformer,并从不同角度引入三种轻量级适配模块(深度情感提示、情感变形网络和情感适配模块),以实现精确且逼真的情感控制。实验表明,我们的方法在广泛使用的基准数据集(包括LRW和MEAD)上达到了最先进的性能。此外,我们的参数高效适配方法展现出卓越的泛化能力,即使在情感训练视频稀缺或缺失的场景下也能保持良好效果。项目网站:https://yuangan.github.io/eat/
abstract_en: Audio-driven talking-head synthesis is a popular research topic for virtual human-related applications. However, the inflexibility and inefficiency of existing methods, which necessitate expensive end-to-end training to transfer emotions from guidance videos to talking-head predictions, are significant limitations. In this work, we propose the Emotional Adaptation for Audio-driven Talking-head (EAT) method, which transforms emotion-agnostic talking-head models into emotion-controllable ones in a cost-effective and efficient manner through parameter-efficient adaptations. Our approach utilizes a pretrained emotion-agnostic talking-head transformer and introduces three lightweight adaptations (the Deep Emotional Prompts, Emotional Deformation Network, and Emotional Adaptation Module) from different perspectives to enable precise and realistic emotion controls. Our experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on widely-used benchmarks, including LRW and MEAD. Additionally, our parameter-efficient adaptations exhibit remarkable generalization ability, even in scenarios where emotional training videos are scarce or nonexistent. Project website: https://yuangan.github.io/eat/
authors: Yuan Gan, Zongxin Yang, Xihang Yue, Lingyun Sun, Yi Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22634-22645

title: 深度神经网络中层自适应权重剪枝的高效联合优化
title_en: Efficient Joint Optimization of Layer-Adaptive Weight Pruning in Deep Neural Networks
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的层自适应权重剪枝方法,用于深度神经网络(DNNs),以解决在满足目标剪枝比例约束条件下最小化输出失真的挑战。我们的方法考虑所有层的综合影响,设计了一种层自适应剪枝方案。我们发现并利用了由多层剪枝权重引起的输出失真具有非常重要的可加性属性。这一属性使我们能够将剪枝建模为组合优化问题,并通过动态规划高效求解。通过将问题分解为子问题,我们实现了线性时间复杂度,使我们的优化算法在CPU上快速且可行。大量实验表明,我们的方法在ImageNet和CIFAR-10数据集上优于现有方法。在CIFAR-10上,我们的方法取得了显著改进,在ResNet-32、VGG-16和DenseNet-121的top-1准确率上分别比其他方法高出1.0%、0.5%和0.7%。在ImageNet上,与其它方法相比,我们的方法在VGG-16和ResNet-50上的top-1准确率分别高出4.7%和4.6%。这些结果突显了我们的方法通过层自适应权重剪枝增强DNN性能的有效性和实用性。代码将在https://github.com/Akimoto-Cris/RD_VIT_PRUNE上发布。
abstract_en:
In this paper, we propose a novel layer-adaptive weight-pruning approach for Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) that addresses the challenge of optimizing the output distortion minimization while adhering to a target pruning ratio constraint. Our approach takes into account the collective influence of all layers to design a layer-adaptive pruning scheme. We discover and utilize a very important additivity property of output distortion caused by pruning weights on multiple layers. This property enables us to formulate the pruning as a combinatorial optimization problem and efficiently solve it through dynamic programming. By decomposing the problem into sub-problems, we achieve linear time complexity, making our optimization algorithm fast and feasible to run on CPUs. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our approach over existing methods on the ImageNet and CIFAR-10 datasets. On CIFAR-10, our method achieves remarkable improvements, outperforming others by up to 1.0% for ResNet-32, 0.5% for VGG-16, and 0.7% for DenseNet-121 in terms of top-1 accuracy. On ImageNet, we achieve up to 4.7% and 4.6% higher top-1 accuracy compared to other methods for VGG-16 and ResNet-50, respectively. These results highlight the effectiveness and practicality of our approach for enhancing DNN performance through layer-adaptive weight pruning.
 Code will be available on https://github.com/Akimoto-Cris/RD_VIT_PRUNE.
authors: Kaixin Xu, Zhe Wang, Xue Geng, Min Wu, Xiaoli Li, Weisi Lin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17447-17457

title: 高效LiDAR点云过分割网络
title_en: Efficient LiDAR Point Cloud Oversegmentation Network
abstract: 点云过分割是一项具有挑战性的任务,因为它需要生成感知上有意义的分区(即超点)。现有大多数过分割方法由于复杂且低效的处理流程,难以高效地从大规模LiDAR点云中生成超点。本文提出了一种简单而高效的端到端LiDAR过分割网络,该网络通过基于低级点嵌入对点进行分组,从LiDAR点云中分割出超点。具体而言,我们首先通过局部判别损失从构建的局部邻域中学习点的相似性,以获得低级点嵌入。然后,为了从稀疏的LiDAR点云中生成同质超点,我们提出了一种LiDAR点分组算法,该算法同时考虑点嵌入的相似性以及三维空间中点的欧几里得距离。最后,我们设计了一个超点细化模块,用于准确地将硬边界点分配到对应的超点。在两个大规模户外数据集SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上的大量实验结果表明,我们的方法在LiDAR过分割任务中达到了新的最先进水平。值得注意的是,我们的方法推理速度比其他方法快100倍。此外,我们将学习到的超点应用于LiDAR语义分割任务,实验结果表明,使用超点可以显著提升基线网络的LiDAR语义分割性能。代码已开源在https://github.com/fpthink/SuperLiDAR。
abstract_en: Point cloud oversegmentation is a challenging task since it needs to produce perceptually meaningful partitions (i.e., superpoints) of a point cloud. Most existing oversegmentation methods cannot efficiently generate superpoints from large-scale LiDAR point clouds due to complex and inefficient procedures. In this paper, we propose a simple yet efficient end-to-end LiDAR oversegmentation network, which segments superpoints from the LiDAR point cloud by grouping points based on low-level point embeddings. Specifically, we first learn the similarity of points from the constructed local neighborhoods to obtain low-level point embeddings through the local discriminative loss. Then, to generate homogeneous superpoints from the sparse LiDAR point cloud, we propose a LiDAR point grouping algorithm that simultaneously considers the similarity of point embeddings and the Euclidean distance of points in 3D space. Finally, we design a superpoint refinement module for accurately assigning the hard boundary points to the corresponding superpoints. Extensive results on two large-scale outdoor datasets, SemanticKITTI and nuScenes, show that our method achieves a new state-of-the-art in LiDAR oversegmentation. Notably, the inference time of our method is 100x faster than that of other methods. Furthermore, we apply the learned superpoints to the LiDAR semantic segmentation task and the results show that using superpoints can significantly improve the LiDAR semantic segmentation of the baseline network. Code is available at https://github.com/fpthink/SuperLiDAR.
authors: Le Hui, Linghua Tang, Yuchao Dai, Jin Xie, Jian Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18003-18012

title: 基于客户端特定提示生成的联邦学习高效模型个性化
title_en: Efficient Model Personalization in Federated Learning via Client-Specific Prompt Generation
abstract: 联邦学习(FL)作为一种去中心化的学习框架,通过在不共享数据的情况下从多个分布式客户端训练模型,以保护隐私。近年来,大规模预训练模型(如Vision Transformer)展现出强大的鲁棒表示能力。然而,客户端间的数据异质性、有限的计算资源和通信带宽限制了大规模模型在FL框架中的部署。为利用大规模模型的鲁棒表示并实现对异构客户端的高效模型个性化,我们提出了一种新颖的个性化FL框架——客户端特定提示生成(pFedPG),该框架在服务器端学习部署个性化提示生成器,以生成适应本地数据分布的客户端特定视觉提示。我们的框架联合优化本地个性化提示适应阶段和全局个性化提示生成阶段。前者旨在训练适应每个客户端的基础模型的视觉提示,后者通过观察本地优化方向为所有客户端生成个性化提示。通过在基准数据集上的大量实验,我们证明pFedPG在各种类型的数据异质性下优于现有最先进的个性化FL方法,实现了计算和通信高效的模型个性化。
abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) emerges as a decentralized learning framework which trains models from multiple distributed clients without sharing their data to preserve privacy. Recently, large-scale pre-trained models (e.g., Vision Transformer) have shown a strong capability of deriving robust representations. However, the data heterogeneity among clients, the limited computation resources, and the communication bandwidth restrict the deployment of large-scale models in FL frameworks. To leverage robust representations from large-scale models while enabling efficient model personalization for heterogeneous clients, we propose a novel personalized FL framework of client-specific Prompt Generation (pFedPG), which learns to deploy a personalized prompt generator at the server for producing client-specific visual prompts that efficiently adapts frozen backbones to local data distributions. Our proposed framework jointly optimizes the stages of personalized prompt adaptation locally and personalized prompt generation globally. The former aims to train visual prompts that adapt foundation models to each client, while the latter observes local optimization directions to generate personalized prompts for all clients. Through extensive experiments on benchmark datasets, we show that our pFedPG is favorable against state-of-the-art personalized FL methods under various types of data heterogeneity, allowing computation and communication efficient model personalization.
authors: Fu-En Yang, Chien-Yi Wang, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19159-19168

title: 基于新型游戏数据集的高效神经超采样
title_en: Efficient Neural Supersampling on a Novel Gaming Dataset
abstract: 由于需要更高的分辨率、帧率和逼真度,视频游戏的实时渲染变得越来越具有挑战性。超采样已成为解决这一挑战的有效方案。我们的工作引入了一种新型的神经超采样算法,该算法在保持相同精度水平的同时,比现有方法高效4倍。此外,我们引入了一个新数据集,该数据集提供了诸如通过视口抖动和mipmap偏移等图形渲染特性在不同分辨率下生成的运动向量和深度等辅助模态。我们认为,该数据集填补了当前数据集领域的空白,可作为衡量该领域进展和推动游戏内容超分辨率技术前沿的宝贵资源。
abstract_en: Real-time rendering for video games has become increasingly challenging due to the need for higher resolutions, framerates and photorealism. Supersampling has emerged as an effective solution to address this challenge. Our work introduces a novel neural algorithm for supersampling rendered content that is 4x more efficient than existing methods while maintaining the same level of accuracy. Additionally, we introduce a new dataset which provides auxiliary modalities such as motion vectors and depth generated using graphics rendering features like viewport jittering and mipmap biasing at different resolutions. We believe that this dataset fills a gap in the current dataset landscape and can serve as a valuable resource to help measure progress in the field and advance the state-of-the-art in super-resolution techniques for gaming content.
authors: Antoine Mercier, Ruan Erasmus, Yashesh Savani, Manik Dhingra, Fatih Porikli, Guillaume Berger ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 296-306

title: 高效区域感知神经辐射场在高保真说话肖像合成中的应用
title_en: Efficient Region-Aware Neural Radiance Fields for High-Fidelity Talking Portrait Synthesis
abstract: 本文提出ER-NeRF,一种基于条件神经辐射场(NeRF)的新型说话肖像合成架构,能够在小模型尺寸下实现快速收敛、实时渲染和最先进性能。我们的核心思想是显式利用空间区域的不等贡献来指导说话肖像建模。具体而言,为提升动态头部重建的准确性,通过三个平面哈希编码器剪枝空闲空间区域,引入了紧凑且表达力强的NeRF基三平面哈希表示。针对语音音频,我们提出区域注意力模块,通过注意力机制生成区域感知的条件特征。与现有方法利用MLP编码器隐式学习跨模态关系不同,注意力机制建立了音频特征与空间区域之间的显式连接,以捕捉局部运动的先验知识。此外,引入了直接且快速的自适应姿态编码,通过将头部姿态的复杂变换映射到空间坐标中,优化头部-躯干分离问题。大量实验表明,与现有方法相比,我们的方法能够生成细节逼真且音频-嘴唇同步的高保真说话肖像视频,并具有更高的效率。
abstract_en: This paper presents ER-NeRF, a novel conditional Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) based architecture for talking portrait synthesis that can concurrently achieve fast convergence, real-time rendering, and state-of-the-art performance with small model size. Our idea is to explicitly exploit the unequal contribution of spatial regions to guide talking portrait modeling. Specifically, to improve the accuracy of dynamic head reconstruction, a compact and expressive NeRF-based Tri-Plane Hash Representation is introduced by pruning empty spatial regions with three planar hash encoders. For speech audio, we propose a Region Attention Module to generate region-aware condition feature via an attention mechanism. Different from existing methods that utilize an MLP-based encoder to learn the cross-modal relation implicitly, the attention mechanism builds an explicit connection between audio features and spatial regions to capture the priors of local motions. Moreover, a direct and fast Adaptive Pose Encoding is introduced to optimize the head-torso separation problem by mapping the complex transformation of the head pose into spatial coordinates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method renders better high-fidelity and audio-lips synchronized talking portrait videos, with realistic details and high efficiency compared to previous methods.
authors: Jiahe Li, Jiawei Zhang, Xiao Bai, Jun Zhou, Lin Gu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7568-7578

title: 基于Transformer的高效三维目标检测与动态令牌停止
title_en: Efficient Transformer-based 3D Object Detection with Dynamic Token Halting
abstract: 在部署深度学习模型时,平衡效率与准确性是一个长期存在的问题。这种权衡在实时安全关键系统(如自动驾驶车辆)中尤为重要。本文提出了一种有效方法,通过根据令牌对检测任务的贡献动态停止不同层的令牌,以加速基于Transformer的三维目标检测器。尽管停止令牌是一种不可微操作,但我们的方法通过利用等效的可微前向传递,实现了端到端可微学习。此外,我们的框架允许停止的令牌通过简单的令牌回收机制被重新利用,以告知模型的预测。与现有方法相比,我们的方法显著提升了效率与准确性的帕累托前沿。通过停止令牌并增加模型容量,我们能够在Waymo Open数据集上在不增加模型延迟的情况下提升基线模型的性能。
abstract_en: Balancing efficiency and accuracy is a long-standing problem for deploying deep learning models. The trade-off is even more important for real-time safety-critical systems like autonomous vehicles. In this paper, we propose an effective approach for accelerating transformer-based 3D object detectors by dynamically halting tokens at different layers depending on their contribution to the detection task. Although halting a token is a non-differentiable operation, our method allows for differentiable end-to-end learning by leveraging an equivalent differentiable forward-pass. Furthermore, our framework allows halted tokens to be reused to inform the model's predictions through a straightforward token recycling mechanism. Our method significantly improves the Pareto frontier of efficiency versus accuracy when compared with the existing approaches. By halting tokens and increasing model capacity, we are able to improve the baseline model's performance without increasing the model's latency on the Waymo Open Dataset.
authors: Mao Ye, Gregory P. Meyer, Yuning Chai, Qiang Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8438-8450

title: 高效统一去马赛克方法用于拜耳与非拜耳图案图像传感器
title_en: Efficient Unified Demosaicing for Bayer and Non-Bayer Patterned Image Sensors
abstract: 随着近期CMOS图像传感器(CIS)物理尺寸的缩小,最新移动相机采用独特的非拜耳颜色滤光阵列(CFA)模式(如Quad、Nona、QxQ),这些模式由相邻像素组成的同色单元构成。相比传统拜耳CFA,非拜耳传感器因其可变像素分组大小适应不同光照条件而具有优势,但其固有像素图案结构和传感器硬件特性可能在去马赛克过程中引入视觉伪影。先前的去马赛克方法主要针对固定像素分组大小的拜耳CFA,需要为非拜耳模式CIS专门设计重建方法,并根据光照条件执行多种CFA模式。本文提出一种高效的统一去马赛克方法,可应用于传统拜耳RAW数据及多种非拜耳CFA在不同操作模式下的RAW数据。我们提出的基于知识学习的自适应模式去马赛克模型(KLAP)仅在每个CFA中使用网络中1%的关键滤波器进行CFA自适应滤波,仍能有效去马赛克所有CFA,性能与大规模模型相当。此外,通过在推理过程中采用元学习(KLAP-M),我们的模型能够消除未知的传感器通用伪影,有效弥合合成图像与真实传感器RAW数据之间的差距。KLAP和KLAP-M方法在拜耳和非拜耳CFA的合成与真实RAW数据中均实现了最先进的去马赛克性能。
abstract_en: As the physical size of recent CMOS image sensors (CIS) gets smaller, the latest mobile cameras are adopting unique non-Bayer color filter array (CFA) patterns (e.g., Quad, Nona, QxQ), which consist of homogeneous color units with adjacent pixels. These non-Bayer sensors are superior to conventional Bayer CFA thanks to their changeable pixel-bin sizes for different light conditions, but may introduce visual artifacts during demosaicing due to their inherent pixel pattern structures and sensor hardware characteristics. Previous demosaicing methods have primarily focused on fixed pixel-bin sizes of Bayer CFA, requiring specialized reconstruction methods for non-Bayer patterned CIS and executing multiple CFA modes depending on lighting conditions. In this work, we propose an efficient unified demosaicing method that can be applied to both conventional Bayer RAW and various non-Bayer CFAs' RAW data in different operation modes. Our Knowledge Learning-based demosaicing model for Adaptive Patterns, namely KLAP, utilizes CFA-adaptive filters for only 1% key filters in the network for each CFA, but still manages to effectively demosaic all the CFAs, yielding comparable performance to the large-scale models. Furthermore, by employing meta-learning during inference (KLAP-M), our model is able to eliminate unknown sensor-generic artifacts in real RAW data, effectively bridging the gap between synthetic images and real sensor RAW. Our KLAP and KLAP-M methods achieved state-of-the-art demosaicing performance in both synthetic and real RAW data of Bayer and non-Bayer CFAs.
authors: Haechang Lee, Dongwon Park, Wongi Jeong, Kijeong Kim, Hyunwoo Je, Dongil Ryu, Se Young Chun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12750-12759

title: 基于标记丢弃与上下文精炼的高效视频动作检测
title_en: Efficient Video Action Detection with Token Dropout and Context Refinement
abstract: 包含大规模视频标记的流式视频片段阻碍了视觉变换器(ViTs)在高效识别中的应用,尤其是在需要充分时空表征以精确识别行为者的视频动作检测中。本文提出了一种基于原始ViT的端到端高效视频动作检测框架(EVAD)。我们的EVAD包含两个针对视频动作检测的专用设计。首先,我们从关键帧中心视角提出了一种时空标记丢弃方法。在视频片段中,我们保留关键帧的所有标记,保留其他帧中与行为者运动相关的标记,并丢弃该片段中其余的标记。其次,我们通过利用剩余标记来优化场景上下文,以更好地识别行为者身份。我们的动作检测器中的感兴趣区域(RoI)扩展到时域。捕获的时空行为者身份表征通过解码器中的注意力机制与场景上下文进行优化。这两个设计使我们的EVAD在保持准确性的前提下提高了效率,已在三个基准数据集(即AVA、UCF101-24、JHMDB)上进行了验证。与原始ViT主干网络相比,我们的EVAD将总体GFLOPs减少了43%,并在无性能下降的情况下将实时推理速度提高了40%。此外,即使在相似的计算成本下,我们的EVAD在更高分辨率输入下性能提升1.1 mAP。代码可在https://github.com/MCG-NJU/EVAD获取。
abstract_en: Streaming video clips with large-scale video tokens impede vision transformers (ViTs) for efficient recognition, especially in video action detection where sufficient spatiotemporal representations are required for precise actor identification. In this work, we propose an end-to-end framework for efficient video action detection (EVAD) based on vanilla ViTs. Our EVAD consists of two specialized designs for video action detection. First, we propose a spatiotemporal token dropout from a keyframe-centric perspective. In a video clip, we maintain all tokens from its keyframe, preserve tokens relevant to actor motions from other frames, and drop out the remaining tokens in this clip. Second, we refine scene context by leveraging remaining tokens for better recognizing actor identities. The region of interest (RoI) in our action detector is expanded into temporal domain. The captured spatiotemporal actor identity representations are refined via scene context in a decoder with the attention mechanism. These two designs make our EVAD efficient while maintaining accuracy, which is validated on three benchmark datasets (i.e., AVA, UCF101-24, JHMDB). Compared to the vanilla ViT backbone, our EVAD reduces the overall GFLOPs by 43% and improves real-time inference speed by 40% with no performance degradation. Moreover, even at similar computational costs, our EVAD can improve the performance by 1.1 mAP with higher resolution inputs. Code is available at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/EVAD.
authors: Lei Chen, Zhan Tong, Yibing Song, Gangshan Wu, Limin Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10388-10399

title: 基于稀疏条件流匹配的高效视频预测
title_en: Efficient Video Prediction via Sparsely Conditioned Flow Matching
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于潜在流匹配的新型生成模型,用于视频预测,这是一种比扩散模型更高效的替代方案。与以往的工作相比,我们在图像生成过程的每个积分步骤中仅对一小部分随机过去的帧进行条件约束,从而在训练和推理过程中避免了建模过去高成本的问题。此外,为了生成高分辨率视频并加速训练,我们使用预训练VQGAN的潜在空间进行操作。最后,我们提出用之前的噪声帧近似流ODE的初始条件。这使得可以减少积分步骤的数量,从而加快推理时的采样速度。我们将该模型称为用于视频预测的随机帧条件流积分模型,简称为RIVER。我们在常见的视频预测基准测试中展示了RIVER相比以往工作具有优越或相当的性能,同时所需的计算资源少了一个数量级。项目网站:https://araachie.github.io/river
abstract_en: We introduce a novel generative model for video prediction based on latent flow matching, an efficient alternative to diffusion-based models. In contrast to prior work, we keep the high costs of modeling the past during training and inference at bay by conditioning only on a small random set of past frames at each integration step of the image generation process. Moreover, to enable the generation of high-resolution videos and to speed up the training, we work in the latent space of a pretrained VQGAN. Finally, we propose to approximate the initial condition of the flow ODE with the previous noisy frame. This allows to reduce the number of integration steps and hence, speed up the sampling at inference time. We call our model Random frame conditioned flow Integration for VidEo pRediction, or, in short, RIVER. We show that RIVER achieves superior or on par performance compared to prior work on common video prediction benchmarks, while requiring an order of magnitude fewer computational resources. Project website: https://araachie.github.io/river.
authors: Aram Davtyan, Sepehr Sameni, Paolo Favaro ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23263-23274

title: 基于神经辐射分布场的高效视图合成
title_en: Efficient View Synthesis with Neural Radiance Distribution Field
abstract: 近期关于神经辐射场(NeRF)的研究在高质量视图合成方面取得了显著进展。NeRF的主要局限在于其渲染效率低下,这是由于渲染单个像素需要多次网络前向传播。现有方法通过减少所需采样数量或优化实现以加速网络前向传播来改进NeRF。尽管如此,由于辐射场的内在表示,多采样问题依然存在。相比之下,神经光场(NeLF)通过每个像素仅查询一次网络前向传播来降低NeRF的计算成本。为了实现与NeRF相近的视觉质量,现有NeLF方法需要显著更大的网络容量,这在实践中限制了其渲染效率。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新的表示方法——神经辐射分布场(NeRDF),旨在实现实时高效的视图合成。具体而言,我们使用一个与NeRF相似的小型网络,同时通过每个像素单次网络前向传播保持渲染速度,如NeLF所示。关键在于利用频率基底建模每条射线上的辐射分布,并通过网络预测频率权重。随后,通过在辐射分布上进行体积渲染计算像素值。实验表明,我们的方法在速度、质量和网络规模之间提供了更好的平衡:在相似网络规模下,我们的方法相比NeRF实现了254倍的加速,仅带来微小的性能下降。我们的项目页面位于yushuang-wu.github.io/NeRDF。
abstract_en: Recent work on Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) has demonstrated significant advances in high-quality view synthesis. A major limitation of NeRF is its low rendering efficiency due to the need for multiple network forwardings to render a single pixel. Existing methods to improve NeRF either reduce the number of required samples or optimize the implementation to accelerate the network forwarding. Despite these efforts, the problem of multiple sampling persists due to the intrinsic representation of radiance fields. In contrast, Neural Light Fields (NeLF) reduce the computation cost of NeRF by querying only one single network forwarding per pixel. To achieve a close visual quality to NeRF, existing NeLF methods require significantly larger network capacities which limits their rendering efficiency in practice. In this work, we propose a new representation called Neural Radiance Distribution Field (NeRDF) that targets efficient view synthesis in real-time. Specifically, we use a small network similar to NeRF while preserving the rendering speed with a single network forwarding per pixel as in NeLF. The key is to model the radiance distribution along each ray with frequency basis and predict frequency weights using the network. Pixel values are then computed via volume rendering on radiance distributions. Experiments show that our proposed method offers a better trade-off among speed, quality, and network size than existing methods: we achieve a  254x speed-up over NeRF with similar network size, with only a marginal performance decline. Our project page is at yushuang-wu.github.io/NeRDF.
authors: Yushuang Wu, Xiao Li, Jinglu Wang, Xiaoguang Han, Shuguang Cui, Yan Lu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18506-18515

title: Efficient-VQGAN:面向高分辨率图像生成的高效视觉Transformer
title_en: Efficient-VQGAN: Towards High-Resolution Image Generation with Efficient Vision Transformers
abstract: 向量量化图像建模在合成高质量图像方面展现出巨大潜力。然而,由于自注意力过程的二次计算开销,生成高分辨率图像仍是一项具有挑战性的任务。在本研究中,我们探索了一种更高效的两阶段框架,以改进以下三个方面实现高分辨率图像生成。(1) 基于第一量化阶段具有坚实的局部特性这一观察结果,我们采用基于局部注意力的量化模型,替代先前方法中使用的全局注意力机制,从而实现更好的效率和重建质量。(2) 我们强调图像生成过程中多粒度特征交互的重要性,并引入一种结合全局注意力(整张图像内的长程语义一致性)和局部注意力(精细粒度细节)的高效注意力机制。该方法实现了更快的生成速度、更高的生成保真度和改进的分辨率。(3) 我们提出了一种新的生成管道,结合自编码训练和自回归生成策略,展示了更优的图像合成范式。大量实验验证了我们的方法在高质量和高分辨率图像重建与生成中的优越性。
abstract_en: Vector-quantized image modeling has shown great potential in synthesizing high-quality images. However, generating high-resolution images remains a challenging task due to the quadratic computational overhead of the self-attention process. In this study, we seek to explore a more efficient two-stage framework for high-resolution image generation with improvements in the following three aspects. (1) Based on the observation that the first quantization stage has solid local property, we employ a local attention-based quantization model instead of the global attention mechanism used in previous methods, leading to better efficiency and reconstruction quality. (2) We emphasize the importance of multi-grained feature interaction during image generation and introduce an efficient attention mechanism that combines global attention (long-range semantic consistency within the whole image) and local attention (fined-grained details). This approach results in faster generation speed, higher generation fidelity, and improved resolution. (3) We propose a new generation pipeline incorporating autoencoding training and autoregressive generation strategy, demonstrating a better paradigm for image synthesis. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our approach in high-quality and high-resolution image reconstruction and generation.
authors: Shiyue Cao, Yueqin Yin, Lianghua Huang, Yu Liu, Xin Zhao, Deli Zhao, Kaigi Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7368-7377

title: EfficientTrain:探索通用课程学习用于视觉骨干网络训练
title_en: EfficientTrain: Exploring Generalized Curriculum Learning for Training Visual Backbones
abstract: 现代深度网络的卓越性能通常伴随着高昂的训练成本。本文提出了一种新的课程学习方法,用于高效训练视觉骨干网络(如视觉Transformer)。我们的工作受深度网络固有学习动态的启发:实验表明,在早期训练阶段,模型主要学习识别每个示例中的"更容易学习"的判别模式,例如图像的低频成分和数据增强前的原始信息。基于这一现象,我们提出了一种课程学习方案,模型在每个epoch中始终使用全部训练数据,但课程学习从仅暴露每个示例的"更容易学习"模式开始,逐步引入更难的模式。为实现这一思想,我们1)在输入的傅里叶谱中引入裁剪操作,使模型能够高效地从低频成分学习;2)证明暴露原始图像特征等同于采用较弱的数据增强;3)整合1)和2)并设计基于贪心搜索算法的课程学习计划。所提出的方法EfficientTrain简单、通用且效果显著。作为开箱即用的方法,它在ImageNet-1K/22K上将ResNet、ConvNeXt、DeiT、PVT、Swin和CSWin等主流模型的训练时间成本降低>1.5倍,且不牺牲准确率。它也适用于自监督学习(如MAE)。代码已开源至https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/EfficientTrain。
abstract_en: The superior performance of modern deep networks usually comes with a costly training procedure. This paper presents a new curriculum learning approach for the efficient training of visual backbones (e.g., vision Transformers). Our work is inspired by the inherent learning dynamics of deep networks: we experimentally show that at an earlier training stage, the model mainly learns to recognize some 'easier-to-learn' discriminative patterns within each example, e.g., the lower-frequency components of images and the original information before data augmentation. Driven by this phenomenon, we propose a curriculum where the model always leverages all the training data at each epoch, while the curriculum starts with only exposing the 'easier-to-learn' patterns of each example, and introduces gradually more difficult patterns. To implement this idea, we 1) introduce a cropping operation in the Fourier spectrum of the inputs, which enables the model to learn from only the lower-frequency components efficiently, 2) demonstrate that exposing the features of original images amounts to adopting weaker data augmentation, and 3) integrate 1) and 2) and design a curriculum learning schedule with a greedy-search algorithm. The resulting approach, EfficientTrain, is simple, general, yet surprisingly effective. As an off-the-shelf method, it reduces the wall-time training cost of a wide variety of popular models (e.g., ResNet, ConvNeXt, DeiT, PVT, Swin, and CSWin) by >1.5x on ImageNet-1K/22K without sacrificing accuracy. It is also effective for self-supervised learning (e.g., MAE). Code is available at https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/EfficientTrain.
authors: Yulin Wang, Yang Yue, Rui Lu, Tianjiao Liu, Zhao Zhong, Shiji Song, Gao Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5852-5864

title: EfficientViT: 轻量级多尺度注意力机制用于高分辨率密集预测
title_en: EfficientViT: Lightweight Multi-Scale Attention for High-Resolution Dense Prediction
abstract: 高分辨率密集预测能够实现计算摄影、自动驾驶等许多引人注目的现实应用场景。然而,巨大的计算成本使得在硬件设备上部署最先进的高分辨率密集预测模型变得困难。本文提出EfficientViT,这是一种新型的高分辨率视觉模型家族,采用创新的轻量级多尺度注意力机制。与依赖重型自注意力机制、硬件效率低的大核卷积或复杂拓扑结构的先前高分辨率密集预测模型不同,我们的轻量级多尺度注意力机制仅通过轻量且硬件高效的运算即可实现全局感受野和多尺度学习(这两个对高分辨率密集预测至关重要的特征)。因此,EfficientViT在多种硬件平台上(包括移动CPU、边缘GPU和云GPU)相比先前最先进的高分辨率密集预测模型实现了显著的性能提升和速度提升。在Cityscapes数据集上保持性能不变的前提下,我们的EfficientViT相比SegFormer和SegNeXt分别提供了高达8.8倍和3.8倍的GPU延迟降低。对于超分辨率任务,EfficientViT相比Restormer提供了高达6.4倍的速度提升,同时PSNR指标提升了0.11dB。
abstract_en: High-resolution dense prediction enables many appealing real-world applications, such as computational photography, autonomous driving, etc. However, the vast computational cost makes deploying state-of-the-art high-resolution dense prediction models on hardware devices difficult. This work presents EfficientViT, a new family of high-resolution vision models with novel lightweight multi-scale attention. Unlike prior high-resolution dense prediction models that rely on heavy self-attention, hardware-inefficient large-kernel convolution, or complicated topology structure to obtain good performances, our lightweight multi-scale attention achieves a global receptive field and multi-scale learning (two critical features for high-resolution dense prediction) with only lightweight and hardware-efficient operations. As such, EfficientViT delivers remarkable performance gains over previous state-of-the-art high-resolution dense prediction models with significant speedup on diverse hardware platforms, including mobile CPU, edge GPU, and cloud GPU. Without performance loss on Cityscapes, our EfficientViT provides up to 8.8x and 3.8x GPU latency reduction over SegFormer and SegNeXt, respectively. For super-resolution, EfficientViT provides up to 6.4x speedup over Restormer while providing 0.11dB gain in PSNR.
authors: Han Cai, Junyan Li, Muyan Hu, Chuang Gan, Song Han ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17302-17313

title: 高效增强预训练模型的鲁棒性
title_en: Efficiently Robustify Pre-Trained Models
abstract: 深度学习算法近期的趋势是训练大规模模型,这些模型具有高参数量并基于大数据集进行训练。然而,此类大规模模型在现实场景下的鲁棒性仍是一个较少探索的领域。在本工作中,我们首先对这些模型在不同扰动和数据集下的性能进行基准测试,以表征现实场景的分布偏移,并突出其在这些偏移下的性能退化。随后,我们讨论基于完整模型微调的现有鲁棒性增强方案在面对超大规模网络时可能不具备可扩展性,且可能导致模型遗忘部分期望的特性。最后,我们提出了一种简单且成本效益高的方法,受知识迁移文献启发。该方法通过在较低计算成本下增强小型模型,再将其作为教师模型来微调部分大规模网络,从而降低整体计算开销。我们在包括ImageNet-C、R、S、A数据集在内的多种视觉扰动场景下,以及迁移学习和零样本评估设置的不同数据集上评估了所提方法。基准结果表明,我们的方法能够高效地增强大规模模型的鲁棒性,所需时间显著减少,同时保留原始模型的迁移学习和零样本特性,这是现有方法无法实现的。
abstract_en: A recent trend in deep learning algorithms has been towards training large scale models, having high parameter count and trained on big dataset. However, robustness of such large scale models towards real-world settings is still a less-explored topic. In this work, we first benchmark the performance of these models under different perturbations and datasets thereby representing real-world shifts, and highlight their degrading performance under these shifts. We then discuss on how complete model fine-tuning based existing robustification schemes might not be a scalable option given very large scale networks and can also lead them to forget some of the desired characterstics. Finally, we propose a simple and cost-effective method to solve this problem, inspired by knowledge transfer literature. It involves robustifying smaller models, at a lower computation cost, and then use them as teachers to tune a fraction of these large scale networks, reducing the overall computational overhead. We evaluate our proposed method under various vision perturbations including ImageNet-C,R,S,A datasets and also for transfer learning, zero-shot evaluation setups on different datasets. Benchmark results show that our method is able to induce robustness to these large scale models efficiently, requiring significantly lower time and also preserves the transfer learning, zero-shot properties of the original model which none of the existing methods are able to achieve.
authors: Nishant Jain, Harkirat Behl, Yogesh Singh Rawat, Vibhav Vineet ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5505-5515

title: 自摄人类:一种以自我为中心的三维多人体基准
title_en: Ego-Humans: An Ego-Centric 3D Multi-Human Benchmark
abstract: 我们提出EgoHumans,一个全新的多视角多人体视频基准数据集,旨在推动以自我为中心的人体三维姿态估计与跟踪的最新进展。现有以自我为中心的基准数据集要么仅捕捉单人,要么仅限于室内场景,这限制了计算机视觉算法在现实应用中的泛化能力。我们提出了一种新颖的三维捕捉设置,构建了一个包含野外场景的全面以自我为中心的多人体基准数据集,并提供标注以支持包括人体检测、跟踪、二维/三维姿态估计和网格恢复在内的多样化任务。我们利用消费级可穿戴相机眼镜实现以自我为中心的视角,从而能够捕捉网球、击剑、排球等动态活动。此外,我们的多视角设置即使在严重或完全遮挡的情况下也能生成精确的三维真实值。该数据集包含超过125,000张以自我为中心的图像,涵盖多样化的场景,特别关注具有挑战性的非编排多人体活动和快速移动的以自我为中心视角。我们严格评估现有最先进的方法,并在以自我为中心的场景中突出其局限性,特别是在多人体跟踪方面。为解决这些局限性,我们提出EgoFormer,一种基于多流Transformer架构和显式三维空间推理的新方法,用于估计和跟踪人体姿态。EgoFormer在EgoHumans数据集上以IDF1指标超越先前方法13.6%。
abstract_en:
We present EgoHumans, a new multi-view multi-human video benchmark to advance the state-of-the-art of egocentric human 3D pose estimation and tracking. Existing egocentric benchmarks either capture single subject or indoor-only scenarios, which limit the generalization of computer vision algorithms for real-world applications. We propose a novel 3D capture setup to construct a comprehensive egocentric multi-human benchmark in the wild with annotations to support diverse tasks such as human detection, tracking, 2D/3D pose estimation, and mesh recovery. We leverage consumer-grade wearable camera-equipped glasses for the egocentric view, which enables us to capture dynamic activities like playing tennis, fencing, volleyball, etc. Furthermore, our multi-view setup generates accurate 3D ground truth even under severe or complete occlusion. The dataset consists of more than 125k egocentric images, spanning diverse scenes with a particular focus on challenging and unchoreographed multi-human activities and fast-moving egocentric views. We rigorously evaluate existing state-of-the-art methods and highlight their limitations in the egocentric scenario, specifically on multi-human tracking. 
 To address such limitations, we propose EgoFormer, a novel approach with a multi-stream transformer architecture and explicit 3D spatial reasoning to estimate and track the human pose. EgoFormer significantly outperforms prior art by 13.6% IDF1 on the EgoHumans dataset.
authors: Rawal Khirodkar, Aayush Bansal, Lingni Ma, Richard Newcombe, Minh Vo, Kris Kitani ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19807-19819

title: Ego-Only:无需外摄迁移的自摄视角动作检测
title_en: Ego-Only: Egocentric Action Detection without Exocentric Transferring
abstract: 我们提出Ego-Only,这是首个能够在自摄视角(第一人称)视频上实现最先进动作检测的方法,且无需任何形式的外摄视角(第三人称)迁移。尽管两个领域间存在内容和外观差异,大规模外摄迁移一直是自摄动作检测的默认选择。这是因为先前研究发现,自摄模型难以从头训练,而从外摄表示迁移能够提升检测精度。然而,在本文中,我们重新审视这一普遍观点。受两个领域间巨大差异的启发,我们提出了一种策略,使无需外摄迁移即可有效训练自摄模型。我们的Ego-Only方法简单,它通过用于时间分割的掩码自编码器微调模型训练视频表示。学习到的特征随后输入现成的时间动作定位方法以检测动作。我们发现,这种简单的Ego-Only方法无需外摄迁移即可取得显著效果,这在三个已建立的自摄视频数据集(Ego4D、EPIC-Kitchens-100和Charades-Ego)上均表现出色。在动作检测和动作识别任务中,Ego-Only均超越了使用数量级更多标签的先前最佳外摄迁移方法。Ego-Only在这些数据集和基准测试中无需外摄数据即取得新SOTA结果。
abstract_en: We present Ego-Only, the first approach that enables state-of-the-art action detection on egocentric (first-person) videos without any form of exocentric (third-person) transferring. Despite the content and appearance gap separating the two domains, large-scale exocentric transferring has been the default choice for egocentric action detection. This is because prior works found that egocentric models are difficult to train from scratch and that transferring from exocentric representations leads to improved accuracy. However, in this paper, we revisit this common belief. Motivated by the large gap separating the two domains, we propose a strategy that enables effective training of egocentric models without exocentric transferring. Our Ego-Only approach is simple. It trains the video representation with a masked autoencoder finetuned for temporal segmentation. The learned features are then fed to an off-the-shelf temporal action localization method to detect actions. We find that this renders exocentric transferring unnecessary by showing remarkably strong results achieved by this simple Ego-Only approach on three established egocentric video datasets: Ego4D, EPIC-Kitchens-100, and Charades-Ego. On both action detection and action recognition, Ego-Only outperforms previous best exocentric transferring methods that use orders of magnitude more labels. Ego-Only sets new state-of-the-art results on these datasets and benchmarks without exocentric data.
authors: Huiyu Wang, Mitesh Kumar Singh, Lorenzo Torresani ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5250-5261

title: EgoLoc: 重新审视基于第一视角视频与视觉查询的三维物体定位
title_en: EgoLoc: Revisiting 3D Object Localization from Egocentric Videos with Visual Queries
abstract: 随着视频和3D理解技术的最新进展,融合时空概念的新型四维时空方法逐渐出现。在此方向上,Ego4D事件记忆基准测试提出了一个结合三维定位的视觉查询任务(VQ3D)。给定一段第一视角视频片段和一张描绘查询物体的图像裁剪,目标是确定该查询物体中心相对于查询帧相机姿态的三维位置。当前方法通过将视觉查询与二维定位任务(VQ2D)的二维定位结果反投影到三维预测来解决VQ3D问题。然而,我们指出由于先前VQ3D方法中相机重定位导致的相机姿态数量不足,严重制约了其整体成功率。在本工作中,我们提出了一种更紧密融合三维多视角几何与第一视角视频中二维物体检索的流程(我们称之为EgoLoc)。我们的方法通过利用二维检测置信度估计更鲁棒的相机姿态,并聚合多视角三维位移,从而提升物体查询的成功率,并显著改善VQ3D基准性能。具体而言,我们的方法实现了高达87.12%的整体成功率,创下了VQ3D任务的新SOTA结果。我们对VQ3D任务及现有解决方案进行了全面的实证分析,并指出了该任务仍面临的挑战。代码已开源至https://github.com/Wayne-Mai/EgoLoc。
abstract_en: With the recent advances in video and 3D understanding, novel 4D spatio-temporal methods fusing both concepts have emerged. Towards this direction, the Ego4D Episodic Memory Benchmark proposed a task for Visual Queries with 3D Localization (VQ3D). Given an egocentric video clip and an image crop depicting a query object, the goal is to localize the 3D position of the center of that query object with respect to the camera pose of a query frame. Current methods tackle the problem of VQ3D by unprojecting the 2D localization results of the sibling task Visual Queries with 2D Localization (VQ2D) into 3D predictions. Yet, we point out that the low number of camera poses caused by camera re-localization from previous VQ3D methods severally hinders their overall success rate. In this work, we formalize a pipeline (we dub EgoLoc) that better entangles 3D multiview geometry with 2D object retrieval from egocentric videos. Our approach involves estimating more robust camera poses and aggregating multi-view 3D displacements by leveraging the 2D detection confidence, which enhances the success rate of object queries and leads to a significant improvement in the VQ3D baseline performance. Specifically, our approach achieves an overall success rate of up to 87.12%, which sets a new state-of-the-art result in the VQ3D task. We provide a comprehensive empirical analysis of the VQ3D task and existing solutions, and highlight the remaining challenges in VQ3D. The code is available at https://github.com/Wayne-Mai/EgoLoc.
authors: Jinjie Mai, Abdullah Hamdi, Silvio Giancola, Chen Zhao, Bernard Ghanem ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 45-57

title: EgoObjects:面向细粒度物体理解的大规模第一视角数据集
title_en: EgoObjects: A Large-Scale Egocentric Dataset for Fine-Grained Object Understanding
abstract: 可以说,第一视角视觉数据中的物体理解是第一视角视觉领域的一个基础研究课题。然而,现有的物体数据集要么是非第一视角的,要么在物体类别、视觉内容和标注粒度方面存在局限性。在本工作中,我们引入了EgoObjects,这是一个面向细粒度物体理解的大规模第一视角数据集。其试点版本包含由来自50多个国家的250名参与者使用4种可穿戴设备采集的超过9000个视频,以及来自368个物体类别的超过650000个物体标注。与仅包含物体类别标签的先前数据集不同,EgoObjects还为每个物体标注了实例级标识符,并包含超过14000个独特物体实例。EgoObjects的设计旨在捕捉在多样化背景复杂性、周围物体、距离、光照和相机运动下的同一物体。在数据采集的同时,我们通过开发多阶段联邦标注流程进行数据标注,以适应数据集的增长性。为了启动EgoObjects的研究,我们围绕第一视角物体理解提出了4个基准任务,包括一个新颖的实例级物体检测任务和传统的类别级物体检测任务。此外,我们还引入了2个新颖的持续学习物体检测任务。数据集和API可在https://github.com/facebookresearch/EgoObjects获取。
abstract_en: Object understanding in egocentric visual data is arguably a fundamental research topic in egocentric vision. However, existing object datasets are either non-egocentric or have limitations in object categories, visual content, and annotation granularities. In this work, we introduce EgoObjects, a large-scale egocentric dataset for fine-grained object understanding. Its Pilot version contains over 9K videos collected by 250 participants from 50+ countries using 4 wearable devices, and over 650K object annotations from 368 object categories. Unlike prior datasets containing only object category labels, EgoObjects also annotates each object with an instance-level identifier, and includes over 14K unique object instances. EgoObjects was designed to capture the same object under diverse background complexities, surrounding objects, distance, lighting and camera motion. In parallel to the data collection, we conducted data annotation by developing a multi-stage federated annotation process to accommodate the growing nature of the dataset. To bootstrap the research on EgoObjects, we present a suite of 4 benchmark tasks around the egocentric object understanding, including a novel instance level- and the classical category level object detection. Moreover, we also introduce 2 novel continual learning object detection tasks. The dataset and API are available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/EgoObjects.
authors: Chenchen Zhu, Fanyi Xiao, Andres Alvarado, Yasmine Babaei, Jiabo Hu, Hichem El-Mohri, Sean Culatana, Roshan Sumbaly, Zhicheng Yan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20110-20120

title: EgoPCA:一种新的以自我为中心的手-物体交互理解框架
title_en: EgoPCA: A New Framework for Egocentric Hand-Object Interaction Understanding
abstract: 随着对以自我为中心的手-物体交互(Ego-HOI)关注度的激增,诸如Ego4D和EPIC-KITCHENS等大规模数据集已被提出。然而,当前大多数研究仍基于第三人称视频动作识别资源。这种第一人称与第三人称动作视频之间的固有领域差距尚未被充分解决,导致当前Ego-HOI效果欠佳。本文重新思考并提出一种新的框架——通过探测、整理与适应(EgoPCA)作为基础设施,以推进Ego-HOI识别。我们贡献了全面的预训练集、平衡的测试集和新的基线,包含完整的训练-微调策略。借助我们的新框架,我们不仅在Ego-HOI基准上实现了最先进性能,还构建了多个新机制和设置以促进进一步研究。我们相信,我们的数据和发现将为Ego-HOI理解开辟新途径。代码和数据可在https://mvig-rhos.com/ego_pca获取。
abstract_en: With the surge in attention to Egocentric Hand-Object Interaction (Ego-HOI), large-scale datasets such as Ego4D and EPIC-KITCHENS have been proposed. However, most current research is built on resources derived from third-person video action recognition. This inherent domain gap between first- and third-person action videos, which have not been adequately addressed before, makes current Ego-HOI suboptimal. This paper rethinks and proposes a new framework as an infrastructure to advance Ego-HOI recognition by Probing, Curation and Adaption (EgoPCA). We contribute comprehensive pre-train sets, balanced test sets and a new baseline, which are complete with a training-finetuning strategy. With our new framework, we not only achieve state-of-the-art performance on Ego-HOI benchmarks but also build several new and effective mechanisms and settings to advance further research. We believe our data and the findings will pave a new way for Ego-HOI understanding. Code and data are available at https://mvig-rhos.com/ego_pca.
authors: Yue Xu, Yong-Lu Li, Zhemin Huang, Michael Xu Liu, Cewu Lu, Yu-Wing Tai, Chi-Keung Tang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5273-5284

title: EgoTV: 从自然语言任务描述中进行第一视角任务验证
title_en: EgoTV: Egocentric Task Verification from Natural Language Task Descriptions
abstract: 为推动具备理解日常任务能力的第一视角智能体的发展,我们提出了一种基准测试和名为EgoTV的合成数据集。EgoTV的目标是根据自然语言任务描述验证第一视角视频中任务的执行情况。EgoTV包含多步骤任务的视频与任务描述配对数据——这些任务包含多个子任务分解、状态变化、物体交互和子任务顺序约束。此外,EgoTV还提供了仅包含任务完成方式部分细节的抽象任务描述。因此,EgoTV需要对视频和语言模态进行因果、时序和组合推理,这是现有数据集所缺失的。我们发现现有的视觉-语言模型在EgoTV任务验证所需的全方位推理方面存在困难。受EgoTV需求的启发,我们提出了一种新颖的神经符号接地(Neuro-Symbolic Grounding, NSG)方法,利用符号表示捕捉任务的组合和时序结构。我们在EgoTV数据集和源自CrossTask的现实世界数据集CTV上展示了NSG在任务追踪与验证方面的能力。我们开源了EgoTV和CTV数据集以及NSG模型,供未来研究第一视角辅助智能体使用。
abstract_en: To enable progress towards egocentric agents capable of understanding everyday tasks specified in natural language, we propose a benchmark and a synthetic dataset called Egocentric Task Verification (EgoTV). The goal in EgoTV is to verify the execution of tasks from egocentric videos based on the natural language description of these tasks. EgoTV contains pairs of videos and their task descriptions for multi-step tasks -- these tasks contain multiple sub-task decompositions, state changes, object interactions, and sub-task ordering constraints. In addition, EgoTV also provides abstracted task descriptions that contain only partial details about ways to accomplish a task. Consequently, EgoTV requires causal, temporal, and compositional reasoning of video and language modalities, which is missing in existing datasets. We also find that existing vision-language models struggle at such all round reasoning needed for task verification in EgoTV. Inspired by the needs of EgoTV, we propose a novel Neuro-Symbolic Grounding (NSG) approach that leverages symbolic representations to capture the compositional and temporal structure of tasks. We demonstrate NSG's capability towards task tracking and verification on our EgoTV dataset and a real-world dataset derived from CrossTask (CTV). We open-source the EgoTV and CTV datasets and the NSG model for future research on egocentric assistive agents.
authors: Rishi Hazra, Brian Chen, Akshara Rai, Nitin Kamra, Ruta Desai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15417-15429

title: EgoVLPv2:基于主干网络融合的第一视角视频-语言预训练
title_en: EgoVLPv2: Egocentric Video-Language Pre-training with Fusion in the Backbone
abstract: 视频-语言预训练(VLP)因其能够泛化到各种视觉和语言任务而变得日益重要。然而,现有第一视角VLP框架采用分离的视频和语言编码器,并仅在微调阶段学习任务特定的跨模态信息,限制了统一系统的开发。在本工作中,我们引入了第一视角视频-语言预训练的第二代模型(EgoVLPv2),通过将跨模态融合直接集成到视频和语言主干网络中,实现了对前一代的显著改进。EgoVLPv2在预训练阶段学习强大的视频-文本表征,并复用跨模态注意力模块以灵活高效地支持多种下游任务,降低微调成本。此外,我们提出的主干网络融合策略相比堆叠额外的融合专用层更加轻量且计算效率更高。在广泛VL任务上的大量实验验证了EgoVLPv2的有效性,在所有下游任务中均取得超越强基线的一致最先进水平。
abstract_en: Video-language pre-training (VLP) has become increasingly important due to its ability to generalize to various vision and language tasks. However, existing egocentric VLP frameworks utilize separate video and language encoders and learn task-specific cross-modal information only during fine-tuning, limiting the development of a unified system. In this work, we introduce the second generation of egocentric video-language pre-training (EgoVLPv2), a significant improvement from the previous generation, by incorporating cross-modal fusion directly into the video and language backbones. EgoVLPv2 learns strong video-text representation during pre-training and reuses the cross-modal attention modules to support different downstream tasks in a flexible and efficient manner, reducing fine-tuning costs. Moreover, our proposed fusion in the backbone strategy is more lightweight and compute-efficient than stacking additional fusion-specific layers. Extensive experiments on a wide range of VL tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of EgoVLPv2 by achieving consistent state-of-the-art performance over strong baselines across all downstream.
authors: Shraman Pramanick, Yale Song, Sayan Nag, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Hardik Shah, Mike Zheng Shou, Rama Chellappa, Pengchuan Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5285-5297

title: EigenPlaces: 基于视角鲁棒模型的视觉地点识别训练
title_en: EigenPlaces: Training Viewpoint Robust Models for Visual Place Recognition
abstract: 视觉地点识别是一项旨在通过图像的视觉特征预测其所属地点(称为查询图像)的任务。通常通过图像检索实现,即利用学习到的全局描述符将查询图像与大规模地理标记照片数据库中最为相似的图像进行匹配。该任务的主要挑战在于识别从不同视角观察的地点。为克服这一局限性,我们提出了一种新方法,称为EigenPlaces,通过在不同视角的图像上训练神经网络,将视角鲁棒性嵌入到学习到的全局描述符中。其核心思想是通过聚类训练数据,显式地向模型展示同一兴趣点的不同视角。该兴趣点的选择无需额外监督。随后,我们在文献中最全面的数据集集合上进行了实验,发现EigenPlaces在多数数据集上均优于先前的最先进方法,同时训练所需GPU内存减少60%,使用的描述符体积缩小50%。EigenPlaces的代码和训练模型可在https://github.com/gmberton/EigenPlaces获取,而其他基准方法的结果可通过代码库https://github.com/gmberton/auto_VPR计算得出。
abstract_en:
Visual Place Recognition is a task that aims to predict the place of an image (called query) based solely on its visual features.
 This is typically done through image retrieval, where the query is matched to the most similar images from a large database of geotagged photos, using learned global descriptors.
 A major challenge in this task is recognizing places seen from different viewpoints. To overcome this limitation, we propose a new method, called EigenPlaces, to train our neural network on images from different point of views, which embeds viewpoint robustness into the learned global descriptors. The underlying idea is to cluster the training data so as to explicitly present the model with different views of the same points of interest. The selection of this points of interest is done without the need for extra supervision.
 We then present experiments on the most comprehensive set of datasets in literature, finding that EigenPlaces is able to outperform previous state of the art on the majority of datasets, while requiring 60% less GPU memory for training and using 50% smaller descriptors.
 The code and trained models for EigenPlaces are available at https://github.com/gmberton/EigenPlaces, while results with any other baseline can be computed with the codebase at https://github.com/gmberton/auto_VPR.
authors: Gabriele Berton, Gabriele Trivigno, Barbara Caputo, Carlo Masone ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11080-11090

title: EigenTrajectory:面向多模态轨迹预测的低秩描述符
title_en: EigenTrajectory: Low-Rank Descriptors for Multi-Modal Trajectory Forecasting
abstract: 捕捉高维社会交互和可行的未来场景对于轨迹预测至关重要。为应对这一复杂特性,已有研究尝试通过参数曲线拟合(如贝塞尔曲线和B样条函数)来降低输出变量的维度。然而,这些起源于计算机图形学领域的函数并不适合描述符合社会规范的人类动态行为。本文提出了一种名为EigenTrajectory(ET)的轨迹预测方法,该方法通过一种新颖的轨迹描述符构建紧凑空间——即ET空间,以替代欧几里得空间,用于表示行人运动。我们首先通过低秩近似来降低轨迹描述符的复杂度。我们将行人的历史轨迹转换为由时空主成分表示的ET空间,并将其输入到现成的轨迹预测模型中。模型的输入输出以及社会交互均被收集并聚合到相应的ET空间中。最后,我们提出了一种基于轨迹锚点的优化方法,以覆盖所提出的ET空间中的所有可能未来场景。大量实验表明,我们的EigenTrajectory预测器在公开基准数据集上显著提升了现有轨迹预测模型的预测精度和可靠性,表明所提出的描述符适合表示行人行为。代码已公开在https://github.com/inhwanbae/EigenTrajectory。
abstract_en: Capturing high-dimensional social interactions and feasible futures is essential for predicting trajectories. To address this complex nature, several attempts have been devoted to reducing the dimensionality of the output variables via parametric curve fitting such as the Bezier curve and B-spline function. However, these functions, which originate in computer graphics fields, are not suitable to account for socially acceptable human dynamics. In this paper, we present EigenTrajectory (ET), a trajectory prediction approach that uses a novel trajectory descriptor to form a compact space, known here as ET space, in place of Euclidean space, for representing pedestrian movements. We first reduce the complexity of the trajectory descriptor via a low-rank approximation. We transform the pedestrians' history paths into our ET space represented by spatio-temporal principle components, and feed them into off-the-shelf trajectory forecasting models. The inputs and outputs of the models as well as social interactions are all gathered and aggregated in the corresponding ET space. Lastly, we propose a trajectory anchor-based refinement method to cover all possible futures in the proposed ET. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our EigenTrajectory predictor can significantly improve both the prediction accuracy and reliability of existing trajectory forecasting models on public benchmarks, indicating that the proposed descriptor is suited to represent pedestrian behaviors. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/inhwanbae/EigenTrajectory.
authors: Inhwan Bae, Jean Oh, Hae-Gon Jeon ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10017-10029

title: ElasticViT: 针对多样化移动设备部署快速视觉Transformer的冲突感知超网训练
title_en: ElasticViT: Conflict-aware Supernet Training for Deploying Fast Vision Transformer on Diverse Mobile Devices
abstract: 神经架构搜索(NAS)在自动设计超过1G FLOPs的视觉Transformer(ViT)方面展现出 promising performance。然而,为多样化移动设备设计轻量级且低延迟的ViT模型仍是一个重大挑战。在本工作中,我们提出ElasticViT,一种两阶段NAS方法,首先在非常大的搜索空间中训练高质量的ViT超网以覆盖广泛移动设备,然后搜索最优子网络(subnet)直接部署。然而,依赖均匀采样的现有超网训练方法存在梯度冲突问题:采样的子网可能具有截然不同的模型规模(例如,50M vs. 2G FLOPs),导致不同优化方向和较差性能。为解决这一挑战,我们提出两种新颖的采样技术:复杂度感知采样和性能感知采样。复杂度感知采样限制相邻训练步骤中采样子网的FLOPs差异,同时覆盖不同规模的子网;性能感知采样进一步选择具有良好准确率的子网,可减少梯度冲突并提升超网质量。我们发现的ElasticViT模型在无需额外微调的情况下,从60M到800M FLOPs的范围内,在ImageNet上实现67.2%至80.0%的top-1准确率,优于所有先前的CNN和ViT模型在准确率和延迟方面。我们的微型和小型模型也是首个在移动设备上显著低于延迟的ViT模型,超越了最先进的CNN。例如,ElasticViT-S1以0.1%更高的准确率比EfficientNet-B0快2.62倍。
