abstract_en: This work dedicates to continuous sign language recognition (CSLR), which is a weakly supervised task dealing with the recognition of continuous signs from videos, without any prior knowledge about the temporal boundaries between consecutive signs. Data scarcity heavily impedes the progress of CSLR. Existing approaches typically train CSLR models on a monolingual corpus, which is orders of magnitude smaller than that of speech recognition. In this work, we explore the feasibility of utilizing multilingual sign language corpora to facilitate monolingual CSLR. Our work is built upon the observation of cross-lingual signs, which originate from different sign languages but have similar visual signals (e.g., hand shape and motion). The underlying idea of our approach is to identify the cross-lingual signs in one sign language and properly leverage them as auxiliary training data to improve the recognition capability of another. To achieve the goal, we first build two sign language dictionaries containing isolated signs that appear in two datasets. Then we identify the sign-to-sign mappings between two sign languages via a well-optimized isolated sign language recognition model. At last, we train a CSLR model on the combination of the target data with original labels and the auxiliary data with mapped labels. Experimentally, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on two widely-used CSLR datasets: Phoenix-2014 and Phoenix-2014T.
authors: Fangyun Wei, Yutong Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23612-23621

title: 通过语义变化提升零样本GAN适应的多样性
title_en: Improving Diversity in Zero-Shot GAN Adaptation with Semantic Variations
abstract: 训练深度生成模型通常需要大量数据。为缓解数据收集成本,零样本GAN适应任务旨在复用已训练的生成器,在无需额外训练样本的情况下合成未见过的目标域图像。由于缺乏目标域数据,利用目标域的文本描述及视觉-语言模型(如CLIP)有效引导生成器。然而,仅使用单一代表性的文本特征而非真实图像,合成图像的多样性会随着模型优化逐渐下降,这被称为模式崩溃。为解决该问题,我们提出一种新方法,在CLIP空间中寻找目标文本的语义变化。具体而言,我们基于目标域的信息性文本特征探索多样化的语义变化,同时规范语义信息的无控偏差。通过获得的变化,我们设计了一种新颖的方向矩损失,匹配图像与文本方向分布的一阶和二阶矩。此外,我们引入弹性权重巩固和关系一致性损失,有效保留源域中的有价值内容信息(如外观)。通过大量实验,我们验证了所提方法在不同零样本GAN适应场景中确保样本多样性的有效性。我们还进行了消融研究以验证各组件的效果。值得注意的是,我们的模型在零样本GAN适应的多样性和质量方面均取得了新的SOTA结果。
abstract_en: Training deep generative models usually requires a large amount of data. To alleviate the data collection cost, the task of zero-shot GAN adaptation aims to reuse well-trained generators to synthesize images of an unseen target domain without any further training samples. Due to the data absence, the textual description of the target domain and the vision-language models, e.g., CLIP, are utilized to effectively guide the generator. However, with only a single representative text feature instead of real images, the synthesized images gradually lose diversity as the model is optimized, which is also known as mode collapse. To tackle the problem, we propose a novel method to find semantic variations of the target text in the CLIP space. Specifically, we explore diverse semantic variations based on the informative text feature of the target domain while regularizing the uncontrolled deviation of the semantic information. With the obtained variations, we design a novel directional moment loss that matches the first and second moments of image and text direction distributions. Moreover, we introduce elastic weight consolidation and a relation consistency loss to effectively preserve valuable content information from the source domain, e.g., appearances. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed methods in ensuring sample diversity in various scenarios of zero-shot GAN adaptation. We also conduct ablation studies to validate the effect of each proposed component. Notably, our model achieves a new state-of-the-art on zero-shot GAN adaptation in terms of both diversity and quality.
authors: Seogkyu Jeon, Bei Liu, Pilhyeon Lee, Kibeom Hong, Jianlong Fu, Hyeran Byun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7258-7267

title: 改进最先进的监督深度和法线预测器的等变性
title_en: Improving Equivariance in State-of-the-Art Supervised Depth and Normal Predictors
abstract: 密集深度和表面法线预测器应具备对裁剪和缩放的等变性质——裁剪输入图像应导致输出图像的相同裁剪。然而,我们发现尽管最先进的深度和法线预测器具有强大的性能,却意外地不遵循等变性。即使在训练过程中采用裁剪和缩放的数据增强方法,该问题依然存在。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种等变正则化技术,包括平均过程和自一致性损失,以显式促进深度和法线网络中的裁剪和缩放等变性。我们的方法可同时应用于CNN和Transformer架构,在测试阶段不会产生额外成本,并显著提升了Taskonomy任务中密集预测器的监督和半监督学习性能。最后,在无标签图像上使用我们的损失进行微调,不仅提升了最先进的深度和法线预测器的等变性,还在NYU-v2数据集上的评估中提高了其准确性。
abstract_en: Dense depth and surface normal predictors should possess the equivariant property to cropping-and-resizing -- cropping the input image should result in cropping the same output image. However, we find that state-of-the-art depth and normal predictors, despite having strong performances, surprisingly do not respect equivariance. The problem exists even when crop-and-resize data augmentation is employed during training. To remedy this, we propose an equivariant regularization technique, consisting of an averaging procedure and a self-consistency loss, to explicitly promote cropping-and-resizing equivariance in depth and normal networks. Our approach can be applied to both CNN and Transformer architectures, does not incur extra cost during testing, and notably improves the supervised and semi-supervised learning performance of dense predictors on Taskonomy tasks. Finally, finetuning with our loss on unlabeled images improves not only equivariance but also accuracy of state-of-the-art depth and normal predictors when evaluated on NYU-v2.
authors: Yuanyi Zhong, Anand Bhattad, Yu-Xiong Wang, David Forsyth ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21775-21785

title: 通过冲突感知梯度一致性增强提升视觉强化学习的泛化能力
title_en: Improving Generalization in Visual Reinforcement Learning via Conflict-aware Gradient Agreement Augmentation
abstract: 在视觉强化学习中,学习具有强大泛化能力的策略仍面临挑战但至关重要。尽管增强组合方法在监督学习泛化中取得成功,但直接将其应用于视觉强化学习算法可能会损害训练效率,导致严重性能下降。本文首先进行定性分析,揭示了主要原因:(i) 高方差梯度幅值和 (ii) 各种增强方法中存在梯度冲突。为缓解这些问题,我们提出了一种通用策略梯度优化框架,命名为冲突感知梯度一致性增强(CG2A),并更好地将增强组合集成到视觉强化学习算法中以解决泛化偏差。具体而言,CG2A开发了梯度一致性求解器以自适应平衡变化的梯度幅值,并引入了软梯度手术策略以缓解梯度冲突。大量实验表明,CG2A显著提升了视觉强化学习算法的泛化性能和样本效率。
abstract_en: Learning a policy with great generalization to unseen environments remains challenging but critical in visual reinforcement learning. Despite the success of augmentation combination in the supervised learning generalization, naively applying it to visual RL algorithms may damage the training efficiency, suffering from serve performance degradation. In this paper, we first conduct qualitative analysis and illuminate the main causes: (i) high-variance gradient magnitudes and (ii) gradient conflicts existed in various augmentation methods. To alleviate these issues, we propose a general policy gradient optimization framework, named Conflict-aware Gradient Agreement Augmentation (CG2A), and better integrate augmentation combination into visual RL algorithms to address the generalization bias. In particular, CG2A develops a Gradient Agreement Solver to adaptively balance the varying gradient magnitudes, and introduces a Soft Gradient Surgery strategy to alleviate the gradient conflicts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CG2A significantly improves the generalization performance and sample efficiency of visual RL algorithms.
authors: Siao Liu, Zhaoyu Chen, Yang Liu, Yuzheng Wang, Dingkang Yang, Zhile Zhao, Ziqing Zhou, Xie Yi, Wei Li, Wenqiang Zhang, Zhongxue Gan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23436-23446

title: 通过鲁棒关键微调提升对抗训练的泛化能力
title_en: Improving Generalization of Adversarial Training via Robust Critical Fine-Tuning
abstract: 深度神经网络容易受到对抗样本的影响,这在关键应用中构成了重大安全风险。对抗训练(AT)是一种提升对抗鲁棒性的成熟技术,但通常以降低泛化能力为代价。本文提出了一种新型方法——鲁棒关键微调(RiFT),旨在在不损害对抗鲁棒性的前提下增强泛化能力。RiFT的核心思想是通过微调对抗训练模型的非鲁棒关键模块,利用冗余容量提升鲁棒性。为此,我们引入了模块鲁棒关键性(MRC)度量,该度量评估模块在最坏情况权重扰动下对模型鲁棒性的贡献。通过该度量,我们识别出MRC值最低的模块作为非鲁棒关键模块,并微调其权重以获得微调权重。随后,我们通过线性插值对抗训练权重与微调权重,推导出最优微调模型权重。我们在CIFAR10、CIFAR100和Tiny-ImageNet数据集上对ResNet18、ResNet34和WideResNet34-10模型验证了RiFT的有效性。实验表明,RiFT在保持或略微增强对抗鲁棒性的前提下,可使泛化能力和分布外鲁棒性提升约1.5%。代码已开源至https://github.com/Immortalise/RiFT。
abstract_en: Deep neural networks are susceptible to adversarial examples, posing a significant security risk in critical applications. Adversarial Training (AT) is a well-established technique to enhance adversarial robustness, but it often comes at the cost of decreased generalization ability. This paper proposes Robustness Critical Fine-Tuning (RiFT), a novel approach to enhance generalization without compromising adversarial robustness. The core idea of RiFT is to exploit the redundant capacity for robustness by fine-tuning the adversarially trained model on its non-robust-critical module. To do so, we introduce module robust criticality (MRC), a measure that evaluates the significance of a given module to model robustness under worst-case weight perturbations. Using this measure, we identify the module with the lowest MRC value as the non-robust-critical module and fine-tune its weights to obtain fine-tuned weights. Subsequently, we linearly interpolate between the adversarially trained weights and fine-tuned weights to derive the optimal fine-tuned model weights. We demonstrate the efficacy of RiFT on ResNet18, ResNet34, and WideResNet34-10 models trained on CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and Tiny-ImageNet datasets. Our experiments show that RiFT can significantly improve both generalization and out-of-distribution robust- ness by around 1.5% while maintaining or even slightly enhancing adversarial robustness. Code is available at https://github.com/Immortalise/RiFT .
authors: Kaijie Zhu, Xixu Hu, Jindong Wang, Xing Xie, Ge Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4424-4434

title: 基于通用处理流程与多光源恢复的镜头光晕去除方法改进
title_en: Improving Lens Flare Removal with General-Purpose Pipeline and Multiple Light Sources Recovery
abstract: 在强光源环境下拍摄的图像常包含异质光晕伪影,这些伪影会显著影响图像视觉质量及后续计算机视觉任务。尽管收集真实光晕污染/无光晕图像对用于训练光晕去除模型具有挑战性,现有方法通过直接相加方式合成数据。然而这些方法未考虑图像信号处理流程(ISP)中的自动曝光和色调映射,导致基于此类数据训练的深度模型泛化能力受限。此外,现有方法难以处理多光源场景,因不同光源具有差异化的尺寸、形状和照度特性。本文通过重新审视ISP流程并重构合成流程中的自动曝光原理,设计更可靠的光源恢复策略,以提升镜头光晕去除性能。新流程通过凸组合方法区分局部与全局光照,避免全局光照偏移和局部过饱和问题。我们的多光源恢复策略基于照度等级对神经网络输入输出进行凸组合平均,从而无需硬阈值即可识别光源。我们还贡献了一个包含十种消费电子设备拍摄的光晕污染图像的新测试数据集,该数据集可验证光晕去除方法的泛化能力。大量实验表明,我们的方案能有效提升镜头光晕去除性能,并推动方法向更通用场景发展。
abstract_en:
When taking images against strong light sources, the resulting images often contain heterogeneous flare artifacts. These artifacts can importantly affect image visual quality and downstream computer vision tasks. While collecting real data pairs of flare-corrupted/flare-free images for training flare removal models is challenging, current methods utilize the direct-add approach to synthesize data. 
 However, these methods do not consider automatic exposure and tone mapping in image signal processing pipeline (ISP), leading to the limited generalization capability of deep models training using such data. Besides, existing methods struggle to handle multiple light sources due to the different sizes, shapes and illuminance of various light sources. In this paper, we propose a solution to improve the performance of lens flare removal by revisiting the ISP and remodeling the principle of automatic exposure in the synthesis pipeline and design a more reliable light sources recovery strategy. The new pipeline approaches realistic imaging by discriminating the local and global illumination through convex combination, avoiding global illumination shifting and local over-saturation. Our strategy for recovering multiple light sources convexly averages the input and output of the neural network based on illuminance levels, thereby avoiding the need for a hard threshold in identifying light sources. We also contribute a new flare removal testing dataset containing the flare-corrupted images captured by ten types of consumer electronics. The dataset facilitates the verification of the generalization capability of flare removal methods. Extensive experiments show that our solution can effectively improve the performance of lens flare removal and push the frontier toward more general situations.
authors: Yuyan Zhou, Dong Liang, Songcan Chen, Sheng-Jun Huang, Shuo Yang, Chongyi Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12969-12979

title: 通过对象-车道聚类改进在线车道图提取
title_en: Improving Online Lane Graph Extraction by Object-Lane Clustering
abstract: 自动驾驶需要准确的局部场景理解信息。为此,自主代理在其感知堆栈中部署目标检测和在线鸟眼视图车道图提取方法。在本工作中,我们提出了一种架构和损失函数设计,通过使用3D目标检测输出来提高局部车道图估计的准确性。所提方法通过将车道中心线视为聚类中心,目标视为需要分配到聚类中心的概率分布数据点,从而学习将目标分配到中心线。这种训练方案确保了对车道与目标之间关系的直接监督,从而实现更好的性能。所提方法在车道图估计方面显著优于现有最先进的方法。广泛的消融实验表明,通过使用现有3D目标检测方法的输出,我们的方法可以实现显著的性能提升。由于我们的方法使用检测输出而非检测方法的中间表示,因此我们的单个模型在测试时可以使用任何检测方法。代码将公开发布。
abstract_en: Autonomous driving requires accurate local scene understanding information. To this end, autonomous agents deploy object detection and online BEV lane graph extraction methods as a part of their perception stack. In this work, we propose an architecture and loss formulation to improve the accuracy of local lane graph estimates by using 3D object detection outputs. The proposed method learns to assign the objects to centerlines by considering the centerlines as cluster centers and the objects as data points to be assigned a probability distribution over the cluster centers. This training scheme ensures direct supervision on the relationship between lanes and objects, thus leading to better performance. The proposed method improves lane graph estimation substantially over state-of-the-art methods. The extensive ablations show that our method can achieve significant performance improvements by using the outputs of existing 3D object detection methods. Since our method uses the detection outputs rather than detection method intermediate representations, a single model of our method can use any detection method at test time. The code will be made publicly available.
authors: Yigit Baran Can, Alexander Liniger, Danda Pani Paudel, Luc Van Gool ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8591-8601

title: 通过减少冗余建模能力提升基于像素的掩码图像建模
title_en: Improving Pixel-based MIM by Reducing Wasted Modeling Capability
abstract: 在掩码图像建模(MIM)领域已取得显著进展。现有MIM方法可根据重建目标分为两类:基于像素的方法和基于分词器的方法。前者具有更简单的流程和更低的计算成本,但已知其偏向于高频细节。本文通过一系列实证研究验证了基于像素的MIM的这一局限性,并提出了一种新方法,该方法显式利用浅层的低级特征辅助像素重建。通过将此设计整合到我们的基线方法MAE中,我们减少了基于像素的MIM的冗余建模能力,提升了其收敛性,并在各类下游任务中实现了显著改进。据我们所知,我们是首个系统研究适用于各向同性架构(如标准视觉Transformer(ViT))的多级特征融合方法的团队。值得注意的是,当应用于较小模型(如ViT-S)时,我们的方法在微调中获得1.2%的提升,在线性探针中获得2.8%的提升,在语义分割中获得2.6%的提升。
abstract_en: There has been significant progress in Masked Image Modeling (MIM). Existing MIM methods can be broadly categorized into two groups based on the reconstruction target: pixel-based and tokenizer-based approaches. The former offers a simpler pipeline and lower computational cost, but it is known to be biased toward high-frequency details. In this paper, we provide a set of empirical studies to confirm this limitation of pixel-based MIM and propose a new method that explicitly utilizes low-level features from shallow layers to aid pixel reconstruction. By incorporating this design into our base method, MAE, we reduce the wasted modeling capability of pixel-based MIM, improving its convergence and achieving non-trivial improvements across various downstream tasks. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to systematically investigate multi-level feature fusion for isotropic architectures like the standard Vision Transformer (ViT). Notably, when applied to a smaller model (e.g., ViT-S), our method yields significant performance gains, such as 1.2% on fine-tuning, 2.8% on linear probing, and 2.6% on semantic segmentation.
authors: Yuan Liu, Songyang Zhang, Jiacheng Chen, Zhaohui Yu, Kai Chen, Dahua Lin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5361-5372

title: 基于聚类约束改进病理图像的表征学习
title_en: Improving Representation Learning for Histopathologic Images with Cluster Constraints
abstract: 全切片图像(WSI)扫描仪和计算能力的最新进展显著推动了人工智能在病理切片分析中的应用。尽管这些进展具有前景,但当前WSI分析的监督学习方法仍面临高分辨率切片全面标注的挑战——这一过程既耗时又耗力。相比之下,自监督学习(SSL)预训练策略正成为可行的替代方案,因为它们无需显式数据标注。这些SSL策略正在迅速缩小与监督方法的性能差距。在此背景下,我们提出了一种SSL框架。该框架通过在WSI分析中结合不变性损失和聚类损失,旨在实现可迁移的表征学习和语义有意义的聚类。值得注意的是,我们的方法在Camelyon16数据集和胰腺癌数据集上的下游分类与聚类任务中均优于常见SSL方法。
abstract_en: Recent advances in whole-slide image (WSI) scanners and computational capabilities have significantly propelled the application of artificial intelligence in histopathology slide analysis. While these strides are promising, current supervised learning approaches for WSI analysis come with the challenge of exhaustively labeling high-resolution slides--a process that is both labor-intensive and time-consuming. In contrast, self-supervised learning (SSL) pretraining strategies are emerging as a viable alternative, given that they don't rely on explicit data annotations. These SSL strategies are quickly bridging the performance disparity with their supervised counterparts. In this context, we introduce an SSL framework. This framework aims for transferable representation learning and semantically meaningful clustering by synergizing invariance loss and clustering loss in WSI analysis. Notably, our approach outperforms common SSL methods in downstream classification and clustering tasks, as evidenced by tests on the Camelyon16 and a pancreatic cancer dataset.
authors: Weiyi Wu, Chongyang Gao, Joseph DiPalma, Soroush Vosoughi, Saeed Hassanpour ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21404-21414

title: 利用自注意力引导提升扩散模型样本质量
title_en: Improving Sample Quality of Diffusion Models Using Self-Attention Guidance
abstract: 去噪扩散模型(DDMs)因其卓越的生成质量和多样性而受到关注。这种成功主要归功于基于类别或文本条件的扩散引导方法,如分类器引导和无分类器引导。本文提出了一种超越传统引导方法的更全面视角。从这一广义视角出发,我们引入了新颖的条件无关且无需训练的策略,以提升生成图像的质量。作为一种简单解决方案,模糊引导通过改善中间样本对细尺度信息和结构的适配性,使扩散模型能够在适中引导尺度下生成更高质量的样本。在此基础上,自注意力引导(SAG)利用扩散模型的中间自注意力图来增强其稳定性和有效性。具体而言,SAG在每次迭代中仅对抗性模糊扩散模型关注的区域,并据此进行引导。实验结果表明,我们的SAG提升了包括ADM、IDDPM、Stable Diffusion和DiT在内的多种扩散模型的性能。此外,将SAG与传统引导方法结合可进一步提升性能。
abstract_en: Denoising diffusion models (DDMs) have attracted attention for their exceptional generation quality and diversity. This success is largely attributed to the use of class- or text-conditional diffusion guidance methods, such as classifier and classifier-free guidance. In this paper, we present a more comprehensive perspective that goes beyond the traditional guidance methods. From this generalized perspective, we introduce novel condition- and training-free strategies to enhance the quality of generated images. As a simple solution, blur guidance improves the suitability of intermediate samples for their fine-scale information and structures, enabling diffusion models to generate higher quality samples with a moderate guidance scale. Improving upon this, Self-Attention Guidance (SAG) uses the intermediate self-attention maps of diffusion models to enhance their stability and efficacy. Specifically, SAG adversarially blurs only the regions that diffusion models attend to at each iteration and guides them accordingly. Our experimental results show that our SAG improves the performance of various diffusion models, including ADM, IDDPM, Stable Diffusion, and DiT. Moreover, combining SAG with conventional guidance methods leads to further improvement.
authors: Susung Hong, Gyuseong Lee, Wooseok Jang, Seungryong Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7462-7471

title: 通过级联捕捉空间信息关键点改进基于Transformer的图像匹配
title_en: Improving Transformer-based Image Matching by Cascaded Capturing Spatially Informative Keypoints
abstract: 学习鲁棒的局部图像特征匹配是一项基础的低级视觉任务,近年来得到了广泛研究。最近,基于Transformer的无检测器局部特征匹配方法展现出有前景的结果,其性能显著优于纯卷积神经网络(CNN)方法。但基于Transformer的方法由于高昂的注意力学习成本,生成的相关性在源视图的粗略块中心存在空间限制。在本工作中,我们重新审视这一问题,发现这种匹配公式会降低姿态估计性能,尤其在低分辨率图像中表现更差。因此,我们提出了一种基于Transformer的级联匹配模型——级联特征匹配Transformer(CasMTR),以高效学习密集特征相关性,从而为相对姿态估计选择更可靠的匹配对。我们未重新训练新检测器,而是通过置信度图使用简单有效的非极大值抑制(NMS)后处理来过滤关键点,大幅提升了匹配精度。CasMTR在室内和室外姿态估计以及视觉定位任务中均取得了最先进的性能。此外,全面的消融实验验证了所提出组件和技术的有效性。
abstract_en: Learning robust local image feature matching is a fundamental low-level vision task, which has been widely explored in the past few years. Recently, detector-free local feature matchers based on transformers have shown promising results, which largely outperform pure Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based ones. But correlations produced by transformer-based methods are spatially limited to the center of source views' coarse patches, because of the costly attention learning. In this work, we rethink this issue and find that such matching formulation degrades pose estimation, especially for low-resolution images. So we propose a transformer-based cascade matching model -- Cascade feature Matching TRansformer (CasMTR), to efficiently learn dense feature correlations, which allows us to choose more reliable matching pairs for the relative pose estimation. Instead of re-training a new detector, we use a simple yet effective Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) post-process to filter keypoints through the confidence map, and largely improve the matching precision. CasMTR achieves state-of-the-art performance in indoor and outdoor pose estimation as well as visual localization. Moreover, thorough ablations show the efficacy of the proposed components and techniques.
authors: Chenjie Cao, Yanwei Fu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12129-12139

title: 通过代码重写家族改进无监督视觉程序推理
title_en: Improving Unsupervised Visual Program Inference with Code Rewriting Families
abstract: 程序因其紧凑性和结构化特性,成为视觉数据的有吸引力的表示形式。我们探讨了代码重写如何用于改进从视觉数据中推断程序的系统。我们首先提出稀疏间歇重写注入(SIRI),这是一种无监督引导学习框架。SIRI在训练程序数据集上稀疏地应用代码重写操作,并将改进后的程序重新注入训练集。我们为视觉编程领域设计了一组重写器:参数优化、代码修剪和代码嫁接。在二维和三维的三种形状编程语言中,我们实验证明使用SIRI结合我们的重写器家族可提升性能:相比不使用重写器或简单使用重写器的引导学习方法,实现了更好的重建效果和更快的收敛速度。最后,我们证明该重写器家族可在测试阶段有效提升SIRI预测的输出质量。在二维和三维CSG中,我们的方法在重建性能上超越或匹配了近期领域特定神经架构,同时生成了更简洁的程序,使用的原始构件显著更少。
abstract_en: Programs offer compactness and structure that makes them an attractive representation for visual data. We explore how code rewriting can be used to improve systems for inferring programs from visual data. We first propose Sparse Intermittent Rewrite Injection (SIRI), a framework for unsupervised bootstrapped learning. SIRI sparsely applies code rewrite operations over a dataset of training programs, injecting the improved programs back into the training set. We design a family of rewriters for visual programming domains: parameter optimization, code pruning, and code grafting. For three shape programming languages in 2D and 3D, we experimentally validate that using SIRI with our family of rewriters improves performance: better reconstructions and faster convergence rates, compared with bootstrapped learning methods that do not use rewriters or use them naively. Finally, we demonstrate that our family of rewriters can be effectively employed at test time to improve the output of SIRI predictions. For 2D and 3D CSG, we outperform or match the reconstruction performance of recent domain-specific neural architectures, while producing more parsimonious programs, that use significantly fewer primitives.
authors: Aditya Ganeshan, R. Kenny Jones, Daniel Ritchie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15791-15801

title: In-Style:通过风格迁移连接文本与未整理视频以实现文本-视频检索
title_en: In-Style: Bridging Text and Uncurated Videos with Style Transfer for Text-Video Retrieval
abstract: 大规模噪声网络图像-文本数据集已被证明能有效学习鲁棒的视觉-语言模型。然而,将其迁移至视频检索任务时,模型仍需在手工整理的配对文本-视频数据上微调以适应视频描述的多样化风格。为解决无需手工标注对的问题,我们提出新的设置:使用未整理且未配对数据的文本-视频检索,仅在训练时使用文本查询与未整理网络视频,无需任何配对文本-视频数据。为此,我们提出In-Style方法,该方法学习文本查询的风格并将其迁移至未整理网络视频。此外,为提升泛化能力,我们证明单个模型可同时训练多种文本风格。为此,我们引入多风格对比训练过程,该过程可同时提升多个数据集的泛化能力。我们在多个数据集上评估模型检索性能,验证了风格迁移框架在未整理且未配对文本-视频检索新任务中的优势,并在零样本文本-视频检索中提升了最先进性能。
abstract_en: Large-scale noisy web image-text datasets have been proven to be efficient for learning robust vision-language models. However, to transfer them to the task of video retrieval, models still need to be fine-tuned on hand-curated paired text-video data to adapt to the diverse styles of video descriptions. To address this problem without the need for hand-annotated pairs, we propose a new setting, text-video retrieval with uncurated & unpaired data, that uses only text queries together with uncurated web videos during training without any paired text-video data. To this end, we propose an approach, In-Style, that learns the style of the text queries and transfers it to uncurated web videos. Moreover, to improve generalization, we show that one model can be trained with multiple text styles. To this end, we introduce a multi-style contrastive training procedure, that improves the generalizability over several datasets simultaneously. We evaluate our model on retrieval performance over multiple datasets to demonstrate the advantages of our style transfer framework on the new task of uncurated & unpaired text-video retrieval and improve state-of-the-art performance on zero-shot text-video retrieval.
authors: Nina Shvetsova, Anna Kukleva, Bernt Schiele, Hilde Kuehne ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21981-21992

title: 增量式广义类别发现
title_en: Incremental Generalized Category Discovery
abstract: 我们探讨了增量式广义类别发现(Incremental Generalized Category Discovery, IGCD)问题。这是一个具有挑战性的类别增量学习场景,目标是开发能够正确分类之前见过的类别图像,同时发现新类别的模型。学习过程在一系列时间步长上进行,模型在每次迭代中获取新的带标签和无标签数据,并丢弃旧数据。在我们的广义设置中,问题难度进一步增加,因为无标签数据可能包含之前未见过或已见过的类别图像。我们提出了一种新的IGCD模型,结合非参数分类与高效图像采样以缓解灾难性遗忘。为量化性能,我们提出了一种名为iNatIGCD的新基准数据集,该数据集受现实世界细粒度视觉分类任务启发。在实验中,我们的方法优于现有相关方法。
abstract_en: We explore the problem of Incremental Generalized Category Discovery (IGCD). This is a challenging category-incremental learning setting where the goal is to develop models that can correctly categorize images from previously seen categories, in addition to discovering novel ones. Learning is performed over a series of time steps where the model obtains new labeled and unlabeled data, and discards old data, at each iteration. The difficulty of the problem is compounded in our generalized setting as the unlabeled data can contain images from categories that may or may not have been observed before. We present a new model for IGCD which combines non-parametric categorization with efficient image sampling to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. To quantify performance, we propose a new benchmark dataset named iNatIGCD that is motivated by a real-world fine-grained visual categorization task. In our experiments we outperform existing related methods.
authors: Bingchen Zhao, Oisin Mac Aodha ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19137-19147

title: 基于深度展开的室内深度恢复方法:非局部先验
title_en: Indoor Depth Recovery Based on Deep Unfolding with Non-Local Prior
abstract: 近年来,基于深度网络的深度恢复技术取得了显著进展。然而,现有最先进的网络设计在深度恢复任务中表现出类似黑箱的特性,缺乏明确的机制。利用深度图像中存在大量非局部共同特征的性质,我们提出了一种新型的模型引导深度恢复方法,即DC-NLAR模型。同时,我们还在模型中嵌入了非局部自回归正则项以捕捉更多非局部深度信息。为充分发挥神经网络的优异性能,我们开发了一种深度图像先验以更准确地描述深度图像的特征。此外,我们引入了隐式数据一致性项以解决高异质性退化算子的问题。随后,我们通过半二次分裂算法将所提模型展开为网络结构。该方法在NYU-Depth V2和SUN RGB-D数据集上进行了实验,实验结果与深度学习方法的性能相当。
abstract_en:
In recent years, depth recovery based on deep networks has achieved great success. However, the existing state-of-the-art network designs perform like black boxes in depth recovery tasks, lacking a clear mechanism. Utilizing the property that there is a large amount of non-local common characteristics in depth images, 
 we propose a novel model-guided depth recovery method, namely the DC-NLAR model. A non-local auto-regressive regular term is also embedded into our model to capture more non-local depth information. To fully use the excellent performance of neural networks, we develop a deep image prior to better describe the characteristic of depth images. We also introduce an implicit data consistency term to tackle the degenerate operator with high heterogeneity. We then unfold the proposed model into networks by using the half-quadratic splitting algorithm. This proposed method is experimented on the NYU-Depth V2 and SUN RGB-D datasets, and the experimental results achieve comparable performance to that of deep learning methods.
authors: Yuhui Dai, Junkang Zhang, Faming Fang, Guixu Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12355-12364

title: 诱导神经塌陷至固定层次感知框架以降低错误严重性
title_en: Inducing Neural Collapse to a Fixed Hierarchy-Aware Frame for Reducing Mistake Severity
abstract: 最近发现了一种引人注目的现象称为神经塌陷:在深度神经网络进行分类训练的末期,所有平坦类别的类内倒数第二层特征均值及其关联分类器向量会塌陷至等角紧框架(ETF)的顶点。近期研究尝试通过将相关分类器权重固定至预计算的ETF来利用这一现象,以诱导神经塌陷并在处理不平衡数据时最大化所学特征的分离度。在本工作中,我们提出将深度神经网络的线性分类器固定至层次感知框架(HAFrame)而非ETF,并采用基于余弦相似度的辅助损失函数学习塌陷至HAFrame的层次感知倒数第二层特征。我们证明该方法在具有3至12层层次结构的多尺度数据集上,能够在保持top-1准确率的同时降低模型预测的错误严重性。代码:https://github.com/ltong1130ztr/HAFrame
abstract_en: There is a recently discovered and intriguing phenomenon called Neural Collapse: at the terminal phase of training a deep neural network for classification, the within-class penultimate feature means and the associated classifier vectors of all flat classes collapse to the vertices of a simplex Equiangular Tight Frame (ETF). Recent work has tried to exploit this phenomenon by fixing the related classifier weights to a pre-computed ETF to induce neural collapse and maximize the separation of the learned features when training with imbalanced data. In this work, we propose to fix the linear classifier of a deep neural network to a Hierarchy-Aware Frame (HAFrame), instead of an ETF, and use a cosine similarity-based auxiliary loss to learn hierarchy-aware penultimate features that collapse to the HAFrame. We demonstrate that our approach reduces the mistake severity of the model's predictions while maintaining its top-1 accuracy on several datasets of varying scales with hierarchies of heights ranging from 3 to 12. Code: https://github.com/ltong1130ztr/HAFrame.
authors: Tong Liang, Jim Davis ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1443-1452

title: InfiniCity:无限尺度城市合成
title_en: InfiniCity: Infinite-Scale City Synthesis
abstract: 面向无限尺度三维城市合成,我们提出了一种新颖框架InfiniCity,该框架从随机噪声中构建并渲染出无约束的大规模且三维 grounded 的环境。InfiniCity将看似不切实际的任务分解为三个可行模块,同时利用了2D和3D数据。首先,一个无限像素图像合成模块从俯视图生成任意尺度的2D地图。接着,一个基于八叉树的体素补全模块将生成的2D地图提升为三维八叉树。最后,一个基于体素的神经渲染模块对体素进行纹理化并渲染2D图像。因此,InfiniCity能够合成任意尺度且可遍历的三维城市环境。我们通过定量和定性实验验证了所提框架的有效性。
abstract_en: Toward infinite-scale 3D city synthesis, we propose a novel framework, InfiniCity, which constructs and renders an unconstrainedly large and 3D-grounded environment from random noises. InfiniCity decomposes the seemingly impractical task into three feasible modules, taking advantage of both 2D and 3D data. First, an infinite-pixel image synthesis module generates arbitrary-scale 2D maps from the bird's-eye view. Next, an octree-based voxel completion module lifts the generated 2D map to 3D octrees. Finally, a voxel-based neural rendering module texturizes the voxels and renders 2D images. InfiniCity can thus synthesize arbitrary-scale and traversable 3D city environments. We quantitatively and qualitatively demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed framework.
authors: Chieh Hubert Lin, Hsin-Ying Lee, Willi Menapace, Menglei Chai, Aliaksandr Siarohin, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Sergey Tulyakov ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22808-22818

title: 用于单次跨域语义分割的启发式数据挖掘
title_en: Informative Data Mining for One-Shot Cross-Domain Semantic Segmentation
abstract: 当前的领域自适应提供了一种实用的解决方案,用于在标记源数据和未标记目标数据之间实现跨域语义分割的迁移。这些解决方案获得了显著关注;然而,当测试环境变化时,模型需要重新训练。这在某些应用中可能导致不可接受的成本,由于耗时的训练过程和数据隐私方面的担忧。单次领域自适应方法通过仅使用一个目标数据将预训练源模型迁移到目标域,试图克服这些挑战。尽管如此,引用风格迁移模块仍面临计算成本和过拟合问题。为了解决这个问题,我们提出了一种名为启发式数据挖掘(IDM)的新框架,用于实现高效的单次领域自适应语义分割。具体而言,IDM提供了一种基于不确定性的选择标准,以识别最具信息量的样本,这有助于快速适应并减少冗余训练。然后,我们使用这些选定的样本执行模型适应方法,包括分块混合和基于原型的信息最大化,以更新模型。这种方法有效增强了适应性并缓解了过拟合问题。总体而言,我们提供了IDM有效性和效率的实证证据。我们的方法优于现有方法,并在GTA5/SYNTHIA到Cityscapes的适应任务中分别实现了新的单次最先进性能56.7%/55.4%。代码将在https://github.com/yxiwang/IDM发布。
abstract_en:
Contemporary domain adaptation offers a practical solution for achieving cross-domain transfer of semantic segmentation between labelled source data and unlabeled target data. These solutions have gained significant popularity; however, they require the model to be retrained when the test environment changes. This can result in unbearable costs in certain applications due to the time-consuming training process and concerns regarding data privacy. One-shot domain adaptation methods attempt to overcome these challenges by transferring the pre-trained source model to the target domain using only one target data. Despite this, the referring style transfer module still faces issues with computation cost and over-fitting problems.
  To address this problem, we propose a novel framework called Informative Data Mining (IDM) that enables efficient one-shot domain adaptation for semantic segmentation. Specifically, IDM provides an uncertainty-based selection criterion to identify the most informative samples, which facilitates quick adaptation and reduces redundant training. We then perform a model adaptation method using these selected samples, which includes patch-wise mixing and prototype-based information maximization to update the model. This approach effectively enhances adaptation and mitigates the overfitting problem.
  In general, we provide empirical evidence of the effectiveness and efficiency of IDM. Our approach outperforms existing methods and achieves a new state-of-the-art one-shot performance of 56.7%/55.4% on the GTA5/SYNTHIA to Cityscapes adaptation tasks, respectively. The code will be released at https://github.com/yxiwang/IDM.
authors: Yuxi Wang, Jian Liang, Jun Xiao, Shuqi Mei, Yuran Yang, Zhaoxiang Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1064-1074

title: 脉冲神经网络中的固有冗余
title_en: Inherent Redundancy in Spiking Neural Networks
abstract: 脉冲神经网络(SNNs)作为传统人工神经网络的高效能替代方案广受关注。由于人们普遍认为SNNs具有稀疏放电特性,其固有冗余的分析与优化长期被忽视,从而干扰了基于脉冲的神经形态计算在准确性和能效方面的潜在优势。本文提出并聚焦于三个关于SNNs固有冗余的关键问题。我们论证冗余源于SNNs的时空不变性,该特性虽提升了参数利用效率,但也引入大量噪声脉冲。进一步,我们分析了时空不变性对SNNs时空动态及脉冲放电的影响。受此启发,我们提出一种Advance Spatial Attention(ASA)模块以利用SNNs的冗余特性,该模块通过一对独立的时空注意力子模块自适应优化其膜电位分布,从而精准调控噪声脉冲特征。实验结果表明,所提方法在保持性能优势的同时显著降低了脉冲放电频率,优于现有最先进的基线方法。我们的代码已开源于https://github.com/BICLab/ASA-SNN。
abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are well known as a promising energy-efficient alternative to conventional artificial neural networks. Subject to the preconceived impression that SNNs are sparse firing, the analysis and optimization of inherent redundancy in SNNs have been largely overlooked, thus the potential advantages of spike-based neuromorphic computing in accuracy and energy efficiency are interfered. In this work, we pose and focus on three key questions regarding the inherent redundancy in SNNs. We argue that the redundancy is induced by the spatio-temporal invariance of SNNs, which enhances the efficiency of parameter utilization but also invites lots of noise spikes. Further, we analyze the effect of spatio-temporal invariance on the spatio-temporal dynamics and spike firing of SNNs. Then, motivated by these analyses, we propose an Advance Spatial Attention (ASA) module to harness SNNs' redundancy, which can adaptively optimize their membrane potential distribution by a pair of individual spatial attention sub-modules. In this way, noise spike features are accurately regulated. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can significantly drop the spike firing with better performance than state-of-the-art baselines. Our code is available in https://github.com/BICLab/ASA-SNN.
authors: Man Yao, Jiakui Hu, Guangshe Zhao, Yaoyuan Wang, Ziyang Zhang, Bo Xu, Guoqi Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16924-16934

title: 基于双扩散架构的真实鱼眼图像校正创新
title_en: Innovating Real Fisheye Image Correction with Dual Diffusion Architecture
abstract: 鱼眼图像校正受合成模型在现实场景中产生较差结果的限制。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种双扩散架构(DDA)用于鱼眼校正,以提升实际应用效果。该DDA利用去噪扩散概率模型(DDPMs)逐步引入双向噪声,使合成图像与真实图像发展为一致的噪声分布。因此,我们的网络无需依赖迁移网络即可感知未标记真实鱼眼图像的分布,从而提升真实鱼眼校正性能。此外,我们设计了一个无监督单次通过网络,生成合理的新型条件以增强引导作用,并解决先验条件与目标间的非忽略不确定性。该网络可显著影响校正任务,尤其在径向失真导致显著伪影的情况下。该网络可视为无需迭代推理即可快速生成可靠结果的替代方案。与现有最先进方法相比,我们的方法在合成和真实鱼眼图像校正中均实现了优越性能。
abstract_en: Fisheye image rectification is hindered by synthetic models producing poor results for real-world correction. To address this, we propose a Dual Diffusion Architecture (DDA) for fisheye rectification that offers better practicality. The DDA leverages Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs) to gradually introduce bidirectional noise, allowing the synthesized and real images to develop into a consistent noise distribution. As a result, our network can perceive the distribution of unlabelled real fisheye images without relying on a transfer network, thus improving the performance of real fisheye correction. Additionally, we design an unsupervised one-pass network that generates a plausible new condition to strengthen guidance and address the non-negligible indeterminacy between the prior condition and the target. It can significantly affect the rectification task, especially in cases where radial distortion causes significant artifacts. This network can be regarded as an alternate scheme for fast producing reliable results without iterative inference. Compared to the state-of-the-art methods, our approach achieves superior performance in both synthetic and real fisheye image corrections.
authors: Shangrong Yang, Chunyu Lin, Kang Liao, Yao Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12699-12708

title: 检验文本到图像模型生成图像的地理代表性
title_en: Inspecting the Geographical Representativeness of Images from Text-to-Image Models
abstract: 近年来生成模型的进展使得模型能够为大多数文本输入生成既逼真又相关的图像。这些模型被用于每天生成数百万张图像,可能对生成艺术、数字营销和数据增强等领域产生重大影响。鉴于其巨大影响,确保生成内容反映全球各地的文物和环境,而非过度代表某些地区至关重要。本文通过一项包含27个国家540名参与者的众包研究,测量了通过DALL.E 2和Stable Diffusion模型生成的常见名词(如房屋)的地理代表性。对于未指定国家名称的模糊输入,生成的图像主要反映美国和印度的环境,而生成的图像很少涵盖其他所有国家的环境(平均得分低于5分中的3分)。在输入中指定国家名称可使DALL.E 2的地理代表性平均提升1.44分(5分李克特量表),Stable Diffusion则提升0.75分,但许多国家的总体得分仍较低,凸显了未来模型需更具地理包容性的需求。最后,我们探讨了在不进行用户研究的情况下量化生成图像地理代表性的可行性。
abstract_en: Recent progress in generative models has resulted in models that produce both realistic as well as relevant images for most textual inputs. These models are being used to generate millions of images everyday, and hold the potential to drastically impact areas such as generative art, digital marketing and data augmentation. Given their outsized impact, it is important to ensure that the generated content reflects the artifacts and surroundings across the globe, rather than over-representing certain parts of the world. In this paper, we measure the geographical representativeness of common nouns (e.g., a house) generated through DALL.E 2 and Stable Diffusion models using a crowdsourced study comprising 540 participants across 27 countries. For deliberately underspecified inputs without country names, the generated images most reflect the surroundings of the United States followed by India, and the top generations rarely reflect surroundings from all other countries (average score less than 3 out of 5). Specifying the country names in the input increases the representativeness by 1.44 points on average on a 5-point Likert scale for DALL.E 2 and 0.75 for Stable Diffusion, however, the overall scores for many countries still remain low, highlighting the need for future models to be more geographically inclusive. Lastly, we examine the feasibility of quantifying the geographical representativeness of generated images without conducting user studies.
authors: Abhipsa Basu, R. Venkatesh Babu, Danish Pruthi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5136-5147

title: 实例神经辐射场
title_en: Instance Neural Radiance Field
abstract: 本文提出了一种基于学习的NeRF 3D实例分割流程,称为实例神经辐射场(Instance-NeRF)。以从多视角RGB图像预训练的NeRF作为输入,Instance-NeRF能够学习给定场景的3D实例分割,表示为NeRF模型的实例场组件。为此,我们采用基于3D提议的掩码预测网络,作用于从NeRF采样的体素特征,生成离散的3D实例掩码。随后,将粗略的3D掩码预测投影到图像空间,以匹配由现有全景分割模型生成的不同视角的2D分割掩码,这些掩码用于监督实例场的训练。值得注意的是,除了从新视角生成一致的2D分割图,Instance-NeRF还能在任意3D点查询实例信息,这大大增强了NeRF对象分割和操作能力。我们的方法也是首批在纯推理阶段实现此类结果的之一。在合成和真实世界NeRF数据集(包含复杂室内场景)上进行实验,Instance-NeRF在未见过的视角上超越了先前的NeRF分割方法和具有竞争力的2D分割方法。代码和数据可在https://github.com/lyclyc52/Instance_NeRF获取。
abstract_en: This paper presents one of the first learning-based NeRF 3D instance segmentation pipelines, dubbed as Instance Neural Radiance Field, or Instance-NeRF. Taking a NeRF pretrained from multi-view RGB images as input, Instance-NeRF can learn 3D instance segmentation of a given scene, represented as an instance field component of the NeRF model. To this end, we adopt a 3D proposal-based mask prediction network on the sampled volumetric features from NeRF, which generates discrete 3D instance masks. The coarse 3D mask prediction is then projected to image space to match 2D segmentation masks from different views generated by existing panoptic segmentation models, which are used to supervise the training of the instance field. Notably, beyond generating consistent 2D segmentation maps from novel views, Instance-NeRF can query instance information at any 3D point, which greatly enhances NeRF object segmentation and manipulation. Our method is also one of the first to achieve such results in pure inference. Experimented on synthetic and real-world NeRF datasets with complex indoor scenes, Instance-NeRF surpasses previous NeRF segmentation works and competitive 2D segmentation methods in segmentation performance on unseen views. Code and data are available at https://github.com/lyclyc52/Instance_NeRF.
authors: Yichen Liu, Benran Hu, Junkai Huang, Yu-Wing Tai, Chi-Keung Tang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 787-796

title: 实例与类别监督是持续学习的交替学习者
title_en: Instance and Category Supervision are Alternate Learners for Continual Learning
abstract: 持续学习(CL)是通过基于先前获得的技能来持续发展复杂行为的过程。然而,当前的CL算法往往在标签信息被新知识快速覆盖时导致类别级别的遗忘。这促使人们尝试通过采用近期的自监督学习(SSL)技术来挖掘实例级别的区分性。然而,先前的研究指出,自监督学习目标本质上是在对扰动的不变性和保留样本信息之间进行权衡,这严重阻碍了实例级别区分性的发挥。在本工作中,我们从信息论视角重新表述SSL,通过解耦实例级别区分性的目标来处理这一权衡,以促进具有最大扰动不变性的紧凑表示。在此基础上,我们开发了一种新颖的交替学习范式,融合实例级别和类别级别的监督优势,从而提升对遗忘的鲁棒性并更好地适应每个任务。为验证所提方法,我们在四个不同的基准上进行了广泛的实验,采用类别增量和任务增量两种设置,其中性能的显著提升和全面的消融研究验证了我们建模策略的有效性和效率。
abstract_en:
Continual Learning (CL) is the constant development of complex behaviors by building upon previously acquired skills. Yet, current CL algorithms tend to incur class-level forgetting as the label information is often quickly overwritten by new knowledge. This motivates attempts to mine instance-level discrimination by resorting to recent self-supervised learning (SSL) techniques. However, previous works have pointed that the self-supervised learning objective is essentially a trade-off between invariance to distortion and preserving sample information, which seriously hinders the unleashing of instance-level discrimination.
 
 In this work, we reformulate SSL from the information-theoretic perspective by disentangling the goal of instance-level discrimination, and tackle the trade-off to promote compact representations with maximally preserved invariance to distortion. On this basis, we develop a novel alternate learning paradigm to enjoy the complementary merits of instance-level and category-level supervision, which yields improved robustness against forgetting and better adaptation to each task. To verify the proposed method, we conduct extensive experiments on four different benchmarks using both class-incremental and task-incremental settings, where the leap in performance and thorough ablation studies demonstrate the efficacy and efficiency of our modeling strategy.
authors: Xudong Tian, Zhizhong Zhang, Xin Tan, Jun Liu, Chengjie Wang, Yanyun Qu, Guannan Jiang, Yuan Xie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5596-5605

title: 面向预训练点云模型的实例感知动态提示调优
title_en: Instance-aware Dynamic Prompt Tuning for Pre-trained Point Cloud Models
abstract: 预训练点云模型在物体分类和部分分割等3D理解任务中已得到广泛应用。然而,下游任务中普遍采用的全量微调策略会导致每个任务的存储开销显著增加,这限制了大规模预训练模型的应用效率。受视觉提示调优(VPT)近期成功启发,本文尝试在预训练点云模型上探索提示调优方法,以追求性能与参数效率之间的优雅平衡。我们发现,虽然实例无关的静态提示(如VPT)在下游迁移中表现出一定效果,但其易受现实点云数据中各种噪声导致的分布多样性影响。为克服这一局限,我们提出了一种面向预训练点云模型的新型实例感知动态提示调优(IDPT)策略。IDPT的核心在于开发动态提示生成模块,以感知每个点云实例的语义先验特征并生成自适应提示标记,从而增强模型的鲁棒性。值得注意的是,大量实验表明,IDPT在大多数任务中仅使用7%的可训练参数就优于全量微调,为预训练点云模型的参数高效学习提供了有前景的解决方案。代码已开源至https://github.com/zyh16143998882/ICCV23-IDPT。
abstract_en: Pre-trained point cloud models have found extensive applications in 3D understanding tasks like object classification and part segmentation. However, the prevailing strategy of full fine-tuning in downstream tasks leads to large per-task storage overhead for model parameters, which limits the efficiency when applying large-scale pre-trained models. Inspired by the recent success of visual prompt tuning (VPT), this paper attempts to explore prompt tuning on pre-trained point cloud models, to pursue an elegant balance between performance and parameter efficiency. We find while instance-agnostic static prompting, e.g. VPT, shows some efficacy in downstream transfer, it is vulnerable to the distribution diversity caused by various types of noises in real-world point cloud data. To conquer this limitation, we propose a novel Instance-aware Dynamic Prompt Tuning (IDPT) strategy for pre-trained point cloud models. The essence of IDPT is to develop a dynamic prompt generation module to perceive semantic prior features of each point cloud instance and generate adaptive prompt tokens to enhance the model's robustness. Notably, extensive experiments demonstrate that IDPT outperforms full fine-tuning in most tasks with a mere 7% of the trainable parameters, providing a promising solution to parameter-efficient learning for pre-trained point cloud models. Code is available at https://github.com/zyh16143998882/ICCV23-IDPT.
authors: Yaohua Zha, Jinpeng Wang, Tao Dai, Bin Chen, Zhi Wang, Shu-Tao Xia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14161-14170

title: 基于指令的NeRF2NeRF:使用指令编辑3D场景
title_en: Instruct-NeRF2NeRF: Editing 3D Scenes with Instructions
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于文本指令编辑NeRF场景的方法。给定一个场景的NeRF表示及其用于重建的图像集合,我们的方法利用图像条件扩散模型(InstructPix2Pix)迭代编辑输入图像并优化底层场景,最终生成一个符合编辑指令的优化3D场景。我们证明了所提出的方法能够编辑大规模、真实世界场景,并能实现比现有方法更真实、有针对性的编辑效果。
abstract_en: We propose a method for editing NeRF scenes with text-instructions. Given a NeRF of a scene and the collection of images used to reconstruct it, our method uses an image-conditioned diffusion model (InstructPix2Pix) to iteratively edit the input images while optimizing the underlying scene, resulting in an optimized 3D scene that respects the edit instruction. We demonstrate that our proposed method is able to edit large-scale, real-world scenes, and is able to accomplish more realistic, targeted edits than prior work.
authors: Ayaan Haque, Matthew Tancik, Alexei A. Efros, Aleksander Holynski, Angjoo Kanazawa ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19740-19750

title: 基于整体迁移预训练Transformer编码器-解码器的视觉目标检测
title_en: Integrally Migrating Pre-trained Transformer Encoder-decoders for Visual Object Detection
abstract: 现代目标检测器已充分利用了在大规模数据集上预训练的骨干网络。然而,除了骨干网络之外,检测头和特征金字塔网络(FPN)等其他组件仍需从头开始训练,这限制了检测器的泛化能力。本研究提出将预训练的Transformer编码器-解码器(imTED)整体迁移至检测器,构建一条"完全预训练"的特征提取路径,以最大化检测器的泛化能力。imTED与基线检测器的核心差异体现在两方面:(1) 将预训练的Transformer解码器迁移至检测头,同时移除特征提取路径中的随机初始化FPN;(2) 定义多尺度特征调制器(MFM)以增强尺度适应性。此类设计不仅显著减少了随机初始化参数,还实现了检测器训练与表征学习的统一。在MS COCO目标检测数据集上的实验表明,imTED在AP指标上持续优于其同类方法2.4个点。无需复杂优化,imTED在少样本目标检测中将SOTA方法提升高达7.6个AP。代码已开源于https://github.com/LiewFeng/imTED。
abstract_en: Modern object detectors have taken the advantages of backbone networks pre-trained on large scale datasets. Except for the backbone networks, however, other components such as the detector head and the feature pyramid network (FPN) remain trained from scratch, which hinders the generalization capacity of detectors. In this study, we propose to integrally migrate pre-trained transformer encoder-decoders (imTED) to a detector, constructing a feature extraction path which is "fully pre-trained" so that detectors' generalization capacity is maximized. The essential differences between imTED with the baseline detector are twofold: (1) migrating the pre-trained transformer decoder to the detector head while removing the randomly initialized FPN from the feature extraction path; and (2) defining a multi-scale feature modulator (MFM) to enhance scale adaptability. Such designs not only reduce randomly initialized parameters significantly but also unify detector training with representation learning intendedly. Experiments on the MS COCO object detection dataset show that imTED consistently outperforms its counterparts by  2.4 AP. Without bells and whistles, imTED improves the state-of-the-art of few-shot object detection by up to 7.6 AP. Code is released at https://github.com/LiewFeng/imTED.
authors: Feng Liu, Xiaosong Zhang, Zhiliang Peng, Zonghao Guo, Fang Wan, Xiangyang Ji, Qixiang Ye ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6825-6834

title: 融合边界框与掩码:面向统一视觉跟踪与分割的多目标框架
title_en: Integrating Boxes and Masks: A Multi-Object Framework for Unified Visual Tracking and Segmentation
abstract: 在视觉目标跟踪(VOT)和视频目标分割(VOS)中,对任意给定目标(对象)进行空间与时间上的跟踪是常见目标。尽管已有研究尝试联合跟踪与分割,但它们往往缺乏初始化和预测阶段对边界框与掩码的完整兼容性,且主要聚焦于单目标场景。为解决这些局限性,本文提出一种面向统一跟踪与分割的多目标掩码-边界框集成框架,命名为MITS。首先,设计了统一识别模块以支持边界框与掩码的初始化参考,其中对象详细信息通过边界框推断或直接从掩码保留。此外,提出了一种新型精准边界框预测器,用于准确的多目标边界框预测,促进目标导向的表征学习。所有目标对象均从编码到传播和解码过程同步处理,构成统一的VOT与VOS处理流程。实验结果表明,MITS在VOT和VOS基准测试中均达到最先进性能。值得注意的是,MITS在GOT-10k测试集上超越最佳先前VOT竞争者约6%,并在VOS基准测试中显著提升了边界框初始化性能。代码已开源于https://github.com/yoxu515/MITS。
abstract_en: Tracking any given object(s) spatially and temporally is a common purpose in Visual Object Tracking (VOT) and Video Object Segmentation (VOS). Joint tracking and segmentation have been attempted in some studies but they often lack full compatibility of both box and mask in initialization and prediction, and mainly focus on single-object scenarios. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a Multi-object Mask-box Integrated framework for unified Tracking and Segmentation, dubbed MITS. Firstly, the unified identification module is proposed to support both box and mask reference for initialization, where detailed object information is inferred from boxes or directly retained from masks. Additionally, a novel pinpoint box predictor is proposed for accurate multi-object box prediction, facilitating target-oriented representation learning. All target objects are processed simultaneously from encoding to propagation and decoding, as a unified pipeline for VOT and VOS. Experimental results show MITS achieves state-of-the-art performance on both VOT and VOS benchmarks. Notably, MITS surpasses the best prior VOT competitor by around 6% on the GOT-10k test set, and significantly improves the performance of box initialization on VOS benchmarks. The code is available at https://github.com/yoxu515/MITS.
authors: Yuanyou Xu, Zongxin Yang, Yi Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9738-9751

title: 意图问答:上下文感知的视频意图推理
title_en: IntentQA: Context-aware Video Intent Reasoning
abstract: 本文提出了一种新型任务IntentQA,这是专注于视频意图推理的特殊视频问答(VideoQA)任务。该任务因其在赋予AI代理超越单纯识别的推理能力方面的优势,对于AI的发展日益重要。我们还为该任务贡献了一个大规模的视频问答数据集。我们提出了一种上下文感知的视频意图推理模型(CaVIR),包含三个模块:i)视频查询语言(VQL)用于更好地实现情境上下文的跨模态表示,ii)对比学习模块用于利用对比上下文,iii)常识推理模块用于融合常识上下文。在这一具有挑战性的任务上的全面实验验证了各模型组件的有效性,展示了我们的完整模型相较于其他基线模型的优越性,并证明了模型在新视频问答任务上的泛化能力。数据集和代码已开源:https://github.com/JoseponLee/IntentQA.git
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a novel task IntentQA, a special VideoQA task focusing on video intent reasoning, which has become increasingly important for AI with its advantages in equipping AI agents with the capability of reasoning beyond mere recognition in daily tasks. We also contribute a large-scale VideoQA dataset for this task. We propose a Context-aware Video Intent Reasoning model (CaVIR) consisting of i) Video Query Language (VQL) for better cross-modal representation of the situational context, ii) Contrastive Learning module for utilizing the contrastive context, and iii) Commonsense Reasoning module for incorporating the commonsense context. Comprehensive experiments on this challenging task demonstrate the effectiveness of each model component, the superiority of our full model over other baselines, and the generalizability of our model to a new VideoQA task. The dataset and codes are open-sourced at: https://github.com/JoseponLee/IntentQA.git
authors: Jiapeng Li, Ping Wei, Wenjuan Han, Lifeng Fan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11963-11974

title: 跨实现通道:超越单类分类的无监督异常检测
title_en: Inter-Realization Channels: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection Beyond One-Class Classification
abstract: 图像中的无监督异常检测与定位是一个具有挑战性的问题,这促使先前方法尝试采用更简单的监督单类分类形式化。假设训练图像为底层图像分布的实现,由此可推断这些实现中的正常块将在实现间具有良好的关联性,并在不同实现中得到良好表示。基于此,我们提出跨实现通道(InReaCh),一种完全无监督的异常检测与定位方法。InReaCh通过将训练数据中的块在实现间关联形成通道,提取高置信度的正常块,仅将具有高跨度和低离散度的通道视为正常。随后,我们基于这些通道的块构建正常模型,用于测试新块。InReaCh从MVTec AD数据集中以99.9%的精度提取正常块,在损坏训练数据下实现0.968 AUROC的定位性能和0.923 AUROC的检测性能,与当前最先进的监督单类分类方法相当。我们测试了模型在包含40%异常数据的训练数据下的性能,其影响可忽略不计。转向完全无监督训练简化了数据集创建并拓展了潜在应用。
abstract_en: Unsupervised anomaly detection and localization in images is a challenging problem, leading previous methods to attempt an easier supervised one-class classification formalization. Assuming training images to be realizations of the underlying image distribution, it follows that nominal patches from these realizations will be well associated between and represented across realizations. From this, we propose Inter-Realization Channels (InReaCh), a fully unsupervised method of detecting and localizing anomalies. InReaCh extracts high-confidence nominal patches from training data by associating them between realizations into channels, only considering channels with high spans and low spread as nominal. We then create our nominal model from the patches of these channels to test new patches against. InReaCh extracts nominal patches from the MVTec AD dataset with 99.9% precision, then archives 0.968 AUROC in localization and 0.923 AUROC in detection with corrupted training data, competitive with current state-of-the-art supervised one-class classification methods. We test our model up to 40% of training data containing anomalies with negligibly affected performance. The shift to fully unsupervised training simplifies dataset creation and broadens possible applications.
authors: Declan McIntosh, Alexandra Branzan Albu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6285-6295

title: InterDiff:基于物理信息的扩散生成三维人-物体交互
title_en: InterDiff: Generating 3D Human-Object Interactions with Physics-Informed Diffusion
abstract: 本文针对预测三维人-物体交互(HOI)这一新颖任务展开研究。现有大多数关于HOI合成的研究缺乏对动态物体的全面全身交互,例如通常局限于操作小型或静态物体。我们的任务更具挑战性,因为它需要建模具有各种形状的动态物体、捕捉全身运动,并确保物理上有效的交互。为此,我们提出InterDiff框架,包含两个关键步骤:(i) 交互扩散,我们利用扩散模型编码未来人-物体交互的分布;(ii) 交互校正,我们引入物理信息引导的预测器以校正扩散步骤中的去噪HOI。我们的核心洞察是:相对于接触点的参考交互遵循简单模式且易于预测。在多个人-物体交互数据集上的实验验证了我们方法的有效性,能够生成逼真、生动且具有显著长期性的三维HOI预测。
abstract_en: This paper addresses a novel task of anticipating 3D human-object interactions (HOIs). Most existing research on HOI synthesis lacks comprehensive whole-body interactions with dynamic objects, e.g., often limited to manipulating small or static objects. Our task is significantly more challenging, as it requires modeling dynamic objects with various shapes, capturing whole-body motion, and ensuring physically valid interactions. To this end, we propose InterDiff, a framework comprising two key steps: (i) interaction diffusion, where we leverage a diffusion model to encode the distribution of future human-object interactions; (ii) interaction correction, where we introduce a physics-informed predictor to correct denoised HOIs in a diffusion step. Our key insight is to inject prior knowledge that the interactions under reference with respect to contact points follow a simple pattern and are easily predictable. Experiments on multiple human-object interaction datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method for this task, capable of producing realistic, vivid, and remarkably long-term 3D HOI predictions.
authors: Sirui Xu, Zhengyuan Li, Yu-Xiong Wang, Liang-Yan Gui ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14928-14940

title: InterFormer:实时交互图像分割
title_en: InterFormer: Real-time Interactive Image Segmentation
abstract: 交互图像分割使标注者能够高效地进行像素级标注以完成分割任务。然而,现有交互分割流程由于以下两个问题导致计算效率低下。首先,标注者的后续点击依赖于模型对先前点击的反馈,这种串行交互无法利用模型的并行处理能力。其次,在每次交互步骤中,模型需处理固定图像与稀疏变量点击,导致高度重复冗余的处理过程。为实现高效计算,我们提出一种名为InterFormer的新方法,通过改进流程解决上述问题。InterFormer提取并预处理计算耗时的部分,即图像处理。具体而言,InterFormer在高性能设备上采用大视觉Transformer(ViT)并行预处理图像,随后使用轻量级模块交互多头自注意力(I-MSA)进行交互分割。此外,I-MSA模块在低功耗设备上的部署拓展了交互分割的实际应用。该模块利用预处理特征实时高效响应标注者输入。在多个数据集上的实验验证了InterFormer的有效性,其在计算效率和分割质量方面均优于以往交互分割模型,可在仅CPU设备上实现实时高质量交互分割。代码已开源至https://github.com/YouHuang67/InterFormer。
abstract_en: Interactive image segmentation enables annotators to efficiently perform pixel-level annotation for segmentation tasks. However, the existing interactive segmentation pipeline suffers from inefficient computations of interactive models because of the following two issues. First, annotators' later click is based on models' feedback of annotators' former click. This serial interaction is unable to utilize model's parallelism capabilities. Second, in each interaction step, the model handles the invariant image along with the sparse variable clicks, resulting in a process that's highly repetitive and redundant. For efficient computations, we propose a method named InterFormer that follows a new pipeline to address these issues. InterFormer extracts and preprocesses the computationally time-consuming part i.e. image processing from the existing process. Specifically, InterFormer employs a large vision transformer (ViT) on high-performance devices to preprocess images in parallel, and then uses a lightweight module called interactive multi-head self attention (I-MSA) for interactive segmentation. Furthermore, the I-MSA module's deployment on low-power devices extends the practical application of interactive segmentation. The I-MSA module utilizes the preprocessed features to efficiently response to the annotator inputs in real-time. The experiments on several datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of InterFormer, which outperforms previous interactive segmentation models in terms of computational efficiency and segmentation quality, achieve real-time high-quality interactive segmentation on CPU-only devices. The code is available at https://github.com/YouHuang67/InterFormer.
authors: You Huang, Hao Yang, Ke Sun, Shengchuan Zhang, Liujuan Cao, Guannan Jiang, Rongrong Ji ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22301-22311

title: 基于人物属性的交互感知联合注意力估计
title_en: Interaction-aware Joint Attention Estimation Using People Attributes
abstract: 本文提出了一种单图像中的联合注意力估计方法。与现有工作仅独立使用与注视相关的属性不同,(I) 我们同时利用人物的位置和动作作为上下文线索来加权其属性,(ii) 明确建模所有属性间的交互关系。针对交互建模,我们提出了一种基于Transformer的注意力网络,将联合注意力编码为低维特征。我们向Transformer引入了带有位置嵌入的专用MLP头,以预测联合注意力的像素级置信度,生成置信度热图。这种像素级预测通过避免从低维特征预测高维热图的病态问题,提高了热图精度。进一步地,通过与基于图像的通用注意力估计方法集成,提升了联合注意力估计效果。在对比实验中,我们的方法在定量指标上超越了现有最先进方法。Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/anonymized_codes-ECA4.
abstract_en: This paper proposes joint attention estimation in a single image. Different from related work in which only the gaze-related attributes of people are independently employed, (I) their locations and actions are also employed as contextual cues for weighting their attributes, and (ii) interactions among all of these attributes are explicitly modeled in our method. For the interaction modeling, we propose a novel Transformer-based attention network to encode joint attention as low-dimensional features. We introduce a specialized MLP head with positional embedding to the Transformer so that it predicts pixelwise confidence of joint attention for generating the confidence heatmap. This pixelwise prediction improves the heatmap accuracy by avoiding the ill-posed problem in which the high-dimensional heatmap is predicted from the low-dimensional features. The estimated joint attention is further improved by being integrated with general image-based attention estimation. Our method outperforms SOTA methods quantitatively in comparative experiments. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/anonymized_codes-ECA4.
authors: Chihiro Nakatani, Hiroaki Kawashima, Norimichi Ukita ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10224-10233

title: 交互式无类别物体计数
title_en: Interactive Class-Agnostic Object Counting
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的交互式无类别物体计数框架,其中人类用户可以通过提供反馈来提升计数器的准确性。该框架包含两个主要组件:一个用户友好的可视化工具以收集反馈,以及一个高效的机制以整合反馈。在每次迭代中,我们生成密度图以展示当前预测结果,并将其分割为非重叠区域,每个区域内的物体数量易于验证。用户可以通过选择明显计数错误的区域并指定该区域内物体数量的估计范围来提供反馈。为提升计数结果,我们开发了一种新颖的自适应损失函数,强制视觉计数器输出的预测数量落在用户指定的范围内。为实现高效且有效的自适应,我们提出了一种优化模块,可与任何基于密度的视觉计数器结合使用,且仅优化模块中的参数会在自适应过程中更新。我们在两个具有挑战性的无类别物体计数基准数据集FSCD-LVIS和FSC-147上的实验表明,我们的方法在极小用户输入下,可将多个最先进的视觉计数器的平均绝对误差降低约30%至40%。我们的项目可在https://yifehuang97.github.io/ICACountProjectPage/访问。
abstract_en: We propose a novel framework for interactive class-agnostic object counting, where a human user can interactively provide feedback to improve the accuracy of a counter. Our framework consists of two main components: a user-friendly visualizer to gather feedback and an efficient mechanism to incorporate it. In each iteration, we produce a density map to show the current prediction result, and we segment it into non-overlapping regions with an easily verifiable number of objects. The user can provide feedback by selecting a region with obvious counting errors and specifying the range for the estimated number of objects within it. To improve the counting result, we develop a novel adaptation loss to force the visual counter to output the predicted count within the user-specified range. For effective and efficient adaptation, we propose a refinement module that can be used with any density-based visual counter, and only the parameters in the refinement module will be updated during adaptation. Our experiments on two challenging class-agnostic object counting benchmarks, FSCD-LVIS and FSC-147, show that our method can reduce the mean absolute error of multiple state-of-the-art visual counters by roughly 30% to 40% with minimal user input. Our project can be found at https://yifehuang97.github.io/ICACountProjectPage/.
authors: Yifeng Huang, Viresh Ranjan, Minh Hoai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22312-22322

title: IntrinsicNeRF:学习用于可编辑新视角合成的内在神经辐射场
title_en: IntrinsicNeRF: Learning Intrinsic Neural Radiance Fields for Editable Novel View Synthesis
abstract: 现有结合逆渲染与神经渲染的方法仅能在物体特定场景中实现可编辑新视角合成,而我们提出内在神经辐射场(IntrinsicNeRF),将内在分解引入基于NeRF的神经渲染方法,使其可扩展至房间尺度场景。由于内在分解本质上是欠约束的逆问题,我们提出一种新颖的距离感知点采样与自适应反射率迭代聚类优化方法,使IntrinsicNeRF能够在无监督方式下训练,获得多视角一致的内在分解结果。为解决场景中相似反射率相邻实例被错误聚类的问题,进一步提出粗到精优化的分层聚类方法,以获得快速分层索引表示。该方法支持重着色与光照变化等 compelling 的实时增强应用。在物体特定/房间尺度场景及合成/真实数据上的大量实验与编辑样本表明,即使对挑战性序列,我们也能获得一致的内在分解结果和高保真新视角合成。
abstract_en: Existing inverse rendering combined with neural rendering methods can only perform editable novel view synthesis on object-specific scenes, while we present intrinsic neural radiance fields, dubbed IntrinsicNeRF, which introduce intrinsic decomposition into the NeRF-based neural rendering method and can extend its application to room-scale scenes. Since intrinsic decomposition is a fundamentally under-constrained inverse problem, we propose a novel distance-aware point sampling and adaptive reflectance iterative clustering optimization method, which enables IntrinsicNeRF with traditional intrinsic decomposition constraints to be trained in an unsupervised manner, resulting in multi-view consistent intrinsic decomposition results. To cope with the problem that different adjacent instances of similar reflectance in a scene are incorrectly clustered together, we further propose a hierarchical clustering method with coarse-to-fine optimization to obtain a fast hierarchical indexing representation. It supports compelling real-time augmented applications such as recoloring and illumination variation. Extensive experiments and editing samples on both object-specific/room-scale scenes and synthetic/real-word data demonstrate that we can obtain consistent intrinsic decomposition results and high-fidelity novel view synthesis even for challenging sequences.
authors: Weicai Ye, Shuo Chen, Chong Bao, Hujun Bao, Marc Pollefeys, Zhaopeng Cui, Guofeng Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 339-351

title: 基于提示的持续学习中的语言引导引入
title_en: Introducing Language Guidance in Prompt-based Continual Learning
abstract: 持续学习旨在在一个任务序列上学习单一模型,而无需访问先前任务的数据。该领域最大的挑战仍然是灾难性遗忘:在早期任务中已见过的类别上的性能损失。一些现有方法依赖于昂贵的重放缓冲区来存储先前任务的数据片段。尽管这种方法前景良好,但当任务数量增加或因隐私原因无法存储数据时,其成本会变得很高。作为一种替代方案,已提出基于提示的方法,通过可学习的提示池存储任务信息。该提示池指导冻结的图像编码器如何解决每个任务。尽管在该设置下模型在每个任务中面临不相交的类别集合,我们认为这些类别可以被编码到预训练语言编码器的相同嵌入空间中。在本工作中,我们提出语言引导的基于提示的持续学习(LGCL)作为基于提示方法的插件。LGCL与模型无关,并在提示池的层级引入任务级的语言引导,在视觉编码器输出特征的层级引入类别级的语言引导。通过广泛的实验验证,我们证明LGCL能够持续提升基于提示的持续学习方法的性能,达到新的最先进水平。LGCL在无需任何额外可学习参数的情况下实现这些性能提升。
abstract_en: Continual Learning aims to learn a single model on a sequence of tasks without having access to data from previous tasks. The biggest challenge in the domain still remains catastrophic forgetting: a loss in performance on seen classes of earlier tasks. Some existing methods rely on an expensive replay buffer to store a chunk of data from previous tasks. This, while promising, becomes expensive when the number of tasks becomes large or data can not be stored for privacy reasons. As an alternative, prompt-based methods have been proposed that store the task information in a learnable prompt pool. This prompt pool instructs a frozen image encoder on how to solve each task. While the model faces a disjoint set of classes in each task in this setting, we argue that these classes can be encoded to the same embedding space of a pre-trained language encoder. In this work, we propose Language Guidance for Prompt-based Continual Learning (LGCL) as a plug-in for prompt-based methods. LGCL is model agnostic and introduces language guidance at the task level in the prompt pool and at the class level on the output feature of the vision encoder. We show with extensive experimentation that LGCL consistently improves the performance of prompt-based continual learning methods to set a new state-of-the-art. LGCL achieves these performance improvements without needing any additional learnable parameters.
authors: Muhammad Gul Zain Ali Khan, Muhammad Ferjad Naeem, Luc Van Gool, Didier Stricker, Federico Tombari, Muhammad Zeshan Afzal ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11463-11473

title: 面向公平面部识别的不变特征正则化
title_en: Invariant Feature Regularization for Fair Face Recognition
abstract: 公平面部识别的核心在于学习能够泛化到任何人口统计群体中未见过的面孔的不变特征。不幸的是,面部数据集不可避免地捕捉到普遍存在的人口统计属性不平衡现象,导致模型学习到的特征在少数群体中泛化能力较差。我们指出,这种偏差源于混杂的人口统计属性,这些属性误导模型捕获虚假的人口统计特定特征。混杂效应只能通过因果干预来消除,这需要混杂因子注释。然而,由于人口统计属性的多样性,此类注释成本可能极高。为解决这一问题,我们提出以无监督方式迭代生成多样化数据分区。每个数据分区作为自标注的混杂因子,使我们的不变特征正则化(INV-REG)方法能够去混杂。INV-REG与现有方法正交,结合两个强基线(Arcface和CIFP)可实现新最先进水平,显著提升多种人口统计群体的面部识别性能。代码已开源于https://github.com/milliema/InvReg。
abstract_en: Fair face recognition is all about learning invariant feature that generalizes to unseen faces in any demographic group. Unfortunately, face datasets inevitably capture the imbalanced demographic attributes that are ubiquitous in real-world observations, and the model learns biased feature that generalizes poorly in the minority group. We point out that the bias arises due to the confounding demographic attributes, which mislead the model to capture the spurious demographic-specific feature. The confounding effect can only be removed by causal intervention, which requires the confounder annotations. However, such annotations can be prohibitively expensive due to the diversity of the demographic attributes. To tackle this, we propose to generate diverse data partitions iteratively in an unsupervised fashion. Each data partition acts as a self-annotated confounder, enabling our Invariant Feature Regularization (INV-REG) to deconfound. INV-REG is orthogonal to existing methods, and combining INV-REG with two strong baselines (Arcface and CIFP) leads to new state-of-the-art that improves face recognition on a variety of demographic groups. Code is available at https://github.com/milliema/InvReg.
authors: Jiali Ma, Zhongqi Yue, Kagaya Tomoyuki, Suzuki Tomoki, Karlekar Jayashree, Sugiri Pranata, Hanwang Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20861-20870

title: 面向少样本点云识别的2D-3D联合困难样本不变性训练
title_en: Invariant Training 2D-3D Joint Hard Samples for Few-Shot Point Cloud Recognition
abstract: 我们通过传统3D模型与良好预训练2D模型的联合预测,解决少样本点云识别中3D物体的数据稀缺挑战。令人惊讶的是,这种集成方法尽管看似简单,却在近期2D-3D模型中鲜有有效验证。我们发现关键问题在于"联合困难样本"的训练效果不足,这些样本在不同错误标签上具有高置信度预测,表明2D和3D模型协作不佳。为此,我们提出的不变性训练策略INVJOINT不仅强调在困难样本上的训练,还寻求冲突的2D和3D模糊预测之间的不变性。INVJOINT能够学习更协作的2D和3D表示以提升集成效果。在ModelNet10/40、ScanObjectNN和Toys4K进行的3D形状分类实验,以及ShapeNet-Core进行的形状检索实验验证了INVJOINT的优越性。
abstract_en: We tackle the data scarcity challenge in few-shot point cloud recognition of 3D objects by using a joint prediction from a conventional 3D model and a well-pretrained 2D model. Surprisingly, such an ensemble, though seems trivial, has hardly been shown effective in recent 2D-3D models. We find out the crux is the less effective training for the "joint hard samples", which have high confidence prediction on different wrong labels, implying that the 2D and 3D models do not collaborate well. To this end, our proposed invariant training strategy, called INVJOINT, does not only emphasize the training more on the hard samples, but also seeks the invariance between the conflicting 2D and 3D ambiguous predictions. INVJOINT can learn more collaborative 2D and 3D representations for better ensemble. Extensive experiments on 3D shape classification with widely-adopted ModelNet10/40, ScanObjectNN and Toys4K, and shape retrieval with ShapeNet-Core validate the superiority of our INVJOINT.
authors: Xuanyu Yi, Jiajun Deng, Qianru Sun, Xian-Sheng Hua, Joo-Hwee Lim, Hanwang Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14463-14474

title: 弱监督关系定位的逆合成学习
title_en: Inverse Compositional Learning for Weakly-supervised Relation Grounding
abstract: 视频关系定位(VRG)是跨模态学习和视频理解领域具有重要意义且具有挑战性的问题。在本研究中,我们提出了一种名为逆合成学习(ICL)的新方法,用于弱监督视频关系定位。我们的方法在整体和局部层面表示关系,将VRG建模为一个联合优化问题,涵盖两个层面的推理。对于整体层面的推理,我们提出了一种逆注意力机制和合成编码器以生成合成相关性特征。此外,我们引入了逆损失函数来评估和学习视觉特征与关系特征之间的相关性。在局部层面推理中,我们引入了通过分类进行定位的方案。通过利用学习到的整体层面特征和局部层面特征,我们以端到端的方式训练整个模型。我们在两个具有挑战性的数据集上进行了评估,结果表明我们的方法显著优于现有最先进的方法。广泛的消融研究验证了我们方法的有效性。
abstract_en:
Video relation grounding (VRG) is a significant and challenging problem in the domains of cross-modal learning and video understanding. In this study, we introduce a novel approach called inverse compositional learning (ICL) for weakly-supervised video relation grounding. Our approach represents relations at both the holistic and partial levels, formulating VRG as a joint optimization problem that encompasses reasoning at both levels.
 For holistic-level reasoning, we propose an inverse attention mechanism and a compositional encoder to generate compositional relevance features. Additionally, we introduce an inverse loss to evaluate and learn the relevance between visual features and relation features.
 At the partial-level reasoning, we introduce a grounding by classification scheme. By leveraging the learned holistic-level features and partial-level features, we train the entire model in an end-to-end manner.
 We conduct evaluations on two challenging datasets and demonstrate the substantial superiority of our proposed method over state-of-the-art methods. Extensive ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of our approach.
authors: Huan Li, Ping Wei, Zeyu Ma, Nanning Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15477-15487

title: 基于分层变分自编码器的逆问题正则化
title_en: Inverse Problem Regularization with Hierarchical Variational Autoencoders
abstract: 本文提出利用深度分层变分自编码器(HVAE)作为图像先验,对不适定逆问题进行正则化。所提方法融合了i) 基于去噪器的即插即用方法和ii) 基于生成模型的逆问题求解方法的优势。首先,我们利用变分自编码器的特性设计了一种高效的算法,该算法受益于即插即用(PnP)方法的收敛性保证。其次,我们的方法不局限于特定数据集,提出的PnP-HVAE模型能够解决任意尺寸自然图像的恢复问题。实验结果表明,所提出的PnP-HVAE方法在性能上与最先进的基于去噪器的PnP方法以及其他基于生成模型的恢复方法具有竞争力。本项目的代码可在https://github.com/jprost76/PnP-HVAE获取。
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose to regularize ill-posed inverse problems using a deep hierarchical Variational AutoEncoder (HVAE) as an image prior. The proposed method synthesizes the advantages of i) denoiser-based Plug & Play approaches and ii) generative model based approaches to inverse problems. First, we exploit VAE properties to design an efficient algorithm that benefits from convergence guarantees of Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods. Second, our approach is not restricted to specialized datasets and the proposed PnP-HVAE model is able to solve image restoration problems on natural images of any size. Our experiments show that the proposed PnP-HVAE method is competitive with both SOTA denoiser-based PnP approaches, and other SOTA restoration methods based on generative models. The code for this project is available at https://github.com/jprost76/PnP-HVAE.
authors: Jean Prost, Antoine Houdard, Andrés Almansa, Nicolas Papadakis ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22894-22905

title: 模仿真的足够吗?基于双阶段训练的通用决策方法
title_en: Is Imitation All You Need? Generalized Decision-Making with Dual-Phase Training
abstract: 我们提出DualMind,这是一种通用代理,旨在解决各种决策任务中当前方法面临的挑战,如过拟合行为和对任务特定微调的依赖。DualMind采用了一种新颖的"双阶段"训练策略,模拟人类如何学习在世界中行动。该模型首先通过针对控制任务设计的自监督目标学习基础通用知识,然后通过模仿基于给定提示的条件行为来学习如何根据不同情境进行决策。DualMind仅使用单一模型权重即可处理跨领域、场景和实体的任务,并且能够执行零样本提示而无需任务特定微调。我们在MetaWorld和Habitat上进行了大量实验评估,结果表明其泛化能力优于先前技术,在Habitat和MetaWorld上分别超过其他通用代理50%和70%。在MetaWorld的45项任务中,DualMind实现了30项任务的成功率超过90%。我们的源代码可在https://github.com/yunyikristy/DualMind获取。
abstract_en: We introduce DualMind, a generalist agent designed to tackle various decision-making tasks that addresses challenges posed by current methods, such as overfitting behaviors and dependence on task-specific fine-tuning. DualMind uses a novel "Dual-phase" training strategy that emulates how humans learn to act in the world. The model first learns fundamental common knowledge through a self-supervised objective tailored for control tasks and then learns how to make decisions based on different contexts through imitating behaviors conditioned on given prompts. DualMind can handle tasks across domains, scenes, and embodiments using just a single set of model weights and can execute zero-shot prompting without requiring task-specific fine-tuning. We evaluate DualMind on MetaWorld and Habitat through extensive experiments and demonstrate its superior generalizability compared to previous techniques, outperforming other generalist agents by over 50% and 70% on Habitat and MetaWorld, respectively. On the 45 tasks in MetaWorld, DualMind achieves over 30 tasks at a 90% success rate. Our source code is available at https://github.com/yunyikristy/DualMind.
authors: Yao Wei, Yanchao Sun, Ruijie Zheng, Sai Vemprala, Rogerio Bonatti, Shuhang Chen, Ratnesh Madaan, Zhongjie Ba, Ashish Kapoor, Shuang Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16221-16231

title: Isomer:用于零样本视频对象分割的同构Transformer
title_en: Isomer: Isomerous Transformer for Zero-shot Video Object Segmentation
abstract: 近期领先的零样本视频对象分割(ZVOS)方法致力于通过精心设计特征融合模块并在多个特征阶段一致应用,整合外观与运动信息。我们的初步实验表明,利用Transformer强大的长程依赖建模能力,简单拼接两种模态特征并输入原始Transformer进行特征融合,虽能显著提升性能,但会带来较大的计算开销。通过进一步的实证分析,我们发现Transformer在不同阶段学习的注意力依赖具有完全不同的特性:低级阶段为全局查询无关依赖,高级阶段为语义特定依赖。受此观察启发,我们提出两种Transformer变体:i)上下文共享Transformer(CST),通过轻量级计算学习图像帧内的全局共享上下文信息;ii)语义聚合-散射Transformer(SGST),分别对前景和背景建模语义相关性,并通过软令牌合并机制降低计算成本。我们将CST与SGST分别应用于低级和高级特征融合,构建了面向ZVOS任务的层次同构Transformer框架。与使用原始Transformer进行多阶段融合的基线方法相比,我们的方法速度提升13倍,并取得了新的最先进ZVOS性能。代码已开源于https://github.com/DLUT-yyc/Isomer。
abstract_en: Recent leading zero-shot video object segmentation (ZVOS) works devote to integrating appearance and motion information by elaborately designing feature fusion modules and identically applying them in multiple feature stages. Our preliminary experiments show that with the strong long-range dependency modeling capacity of Transformer, simply concatenating the two modality features and feeding them to vanilla Transformers for feature fusion can distinctly benefit the performance but at a cost of heavy computation. Through further empirical analysis, we find that attention dependencies learned in Transformer in different stages exhibit completely different properties: global query-independent dependency in the low-level stages and semantic-specific dependency in the high-level stages. Motivated by the observations, we propose two Transformer variants: i) Context-Sharing Transformer (CST) that learns the global-shared contextual information within image frames with a lightweight computation. ii) Semantic Gathering-Scattering Transformer (SGST) that models the semantic correlation separately for the foreground and background and reduces the computation cost with a soft token merging mechanism. We apply CST and SGST for low-level and high-level feature fusions, respectively, formulating a level-isomerous Transformer framework for ZVOS task. Compared with the baseline that uses vanilla Transformers for multi-stage fusion, ours significantly increase the speed by 13 times and achieves new state-of-the-art ZVOS performance. Code is available at https://github.com/DLUT-yyc/Isomer.
authors: Yichen Yuan, Yifan Wang, Lijun Wang, Xiaoqi Zhao, Huchuan Lu, Yu Wang, Weibo Su, Lei Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 966-976

title: 自监督图像去噪的迭代去噪器与噪声估计器
title_en: Iterative Denoiser and Noise Estimator for Self-Supervised Image Denoising
abstract: 随着强大深度学习工具的出现,越来越多高效的深度去噪器推动了图像去噪领域的发展。然而,这些基于学习的方法所取得的巨大进展严重依赖于大规模且高质量的噪声/干净训练对,这限制了其在现实场景中的实用性。为克服这一问题,研究人员正在探索无需配对数据的自监督方法。然而,噪声先验的不可用和低效的特征提取使这些方法远离高实用性和精度。本文提出了一种自监督图像去噪框架Denoise-Corrupt-Denoise管道(DCD-Net)。具体而言,我们设计了一种迭代训练策略,通过仅使用单张噪声图像且无需任何噪声先验,迭代优化去噪器和噪声估计器,逐步接近高性能去噪效果。所提出的自监督图像去噪框架在广泛使用的合成和现实世界图像去噪基准测试中,与最先进的方法相比提供了非常具有竞争力的结果。
abstract_en: With the emergence of powerful deep learning tools, more and more effective deep denoisers have advanced the field of image denoising. However, the huge progress made by these learning-based methods severely relies on large-scale and high-quality noisy/clean training pairs, which limits the practicality in real-world scenarios. To overcome this, researchers have been exploring self-supervised approaches that can denoise without paired data. However, the unavailable noise prior and inefficient feature extraction take these methods away from high practicality and precision. In this paper, we propose a Denoise-Corrupt-Denoise pipeline (DCD-Net) for self-supervised image denoising.
