 Experiments on datasets of Matterport3D, ScanNet, and ICL-NUIM demonstrate that our method can generate better completion results, and our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods quantitatively and qualitatively.
authors: Ziqi Wang, Fei Luo, Xiaoxiao Long, Wenxiao Zhang, Chunxia Xiao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18569-18579

title: 基于语义地图监督的导航视觉表征学习
title_en: Learning Navigational Visual Representations with Semantic Map Supervision
abstract: 能够感知环境的语义和空间结构对于家庭机器人的视觉导航至关重要。然而,大多数现有工作仅采用预训练的视觉主干网络,这些网络要么通过独立图像进行分类任务预训练,要么通过自监督学习方法适应室内导航领域,均忽略了对导航学习至关重要的空间关系。受人类在导航过程中自然构建具有语义和空间意义的认知地图行为启发,本文提出了一种新型的导航专用视觉表征学习方法,通过对比智能体的视角视图与语义地图(Ego^2-Map)。我们采用视觉Transformer作为主干编码器,并在大规模Habitat-Matterport3D环境中收集的数据上训练模型。Ego^2-Map学习将地图中的紧凑且丰富的信息(如物体、结构和转移关系)转移到智能体的视角表征中,以支持导航。实验表明,在目标物体导航任务中,使用我们学习到的表征的智能体优于近期的视觉预训练方法。此外,我们的表征在连续环境中显著提升了视觉-语言导航性能,无论是在高层还是低层动作空间均取得新最优结果,在测试服务器上达到47%的SR和41%的SPL。
abstract_en: Being able to perceive the semantics and the spatial structure of the environment is essential for visual navigation of a household robot. However, most existing works only employ visual backbones pre-trained either with independent images for classification or with self-supervised learning methods to adapt to the indoor navigation domain, both neglecting the spatial relationships that are essential to the learning of navigation. Inspired by the behavior that human naturally build semantically and spatially meaningful cognitive maps in their brain during navigation, in this paper, we propose a novel navigational-specific visual representation learning method by contrasting the agent's egocentric views and semantic maps (Ego^2-Map). We apply the visual transformer as the backbone encoder and train the model with data collected from the large-scale Habitat-Matterport3D environments. Ego^2-Map learning transfers the compact and rich information from a map, such as objects, structure and transition, to the agent's egocentric representations for navigation. Experiments show that agents using our learned representations on object-goal navigation outperforms recent visual pre-training methods. Moreover, our representations lead to a significant improvement in vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments for both high-level and low-level action spaces, achieving new state-of-the-art results of 47% SR and 41% SPL on the test server.
authors: Yicong Hong, Yang Zhou, Ruiyi Zhang, Franck Dernoncourt, Trung Bui, Stephen Gould, Hao Tan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3055-3067

title: 基于神经本征函数的无监督语义分割方法
title_en: Learning Neural Eigenfunctions for Unsupervised Semantic Segmentation
abstract: 无监督语义分割是计算机视觉领域长期存在的挑战性问题,具有重要研究价值。谱聚类作为一种理论基础坚实的解决方案,通过计算像素的谱嵌入来构建不同的聚类簇。尽管近期通过强大的预训练模型增强谱聚类取得了进展,但现有方法仍存在谱分解效率低下和难以灵活应用于测试数据的不足。本文通过将谱聚类建模为参数化方法,采用基于神经网络的本征函数生成谱嵌入,解决了上述问题。神经本征函数的输出进一步被限制为指示聚类分配的离散向量。因此,一种端到端的神经网络范式的谱聚类方法得以实现。在实践中,神经本征函数具有轻量化特性,以预训练模型的特征作为输入,提升了训练效率并释放了预训练模型在密集预测任务中的潜力。我们进行了广泛的实证研究以验证方法有效性,在Pascal Context、Cityscapes和ADE20K基准上均显著优于竞争基线。代码已开源至https://github.com/thudzj/NeuralEigenfunctionSegmentor。
abstract_en: Unsupervised semantic segmentation is a long-standing challenge in computer vision with great significance. Spectral clustering is a theoretically grounded solution to it where the spectral embeddings for pixels are computed to construct distinct clusters. Despite recent progress in enhancing spectral clustering with powerful pre-trained models, current approaches still suffer from inefficiencies in spectral decomposition and inflexibility in applying them to the test data. This work addresses these issues by casting spectral clustering as a parametric approach that employs neural network-based eigenfunctions to produce spectral embeddings. The outputs of the neural eigenfunctions are further restricted to discrete vectors that indicate clustering assignments directly. As a result, an end-to-end NN-based paradigm of spectral clustering emerges. In practice, the neural eigenfunctions are lightweight and take the features from pre-trained models as inputs, improving training efficiency and unleashing the potential of pre-trained models for dense prediction. We conduct extensive empirical studies to validate the effectiveness of our approach and observe significant performance gains over competitive baselines on Pascal Context, Cityscapes, and ADE20K benchmarks. The code is available at https://github.com/thudzj/NeuralEigenfunctionSegmentor.
authors: Zhijie Deng, Yucen Luo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 551-561

title: 基于面向物体的辐射场学习神经隐式曲面
title_en: Learning Neural Implicit Surfaces with Object-Aware Radiance Fields
abstract: 近期多视角3D物体重建领域的进展主要通过学习高保真辐射场来实现神经隐式曲面。然而,大多数方法依赖于由成本高昂的轮廓掩码推导出的视觉凸包来获取物体表面。本文提出了一种新颖的面向物体的辐射场(Object-aware Radiance Fields, ORF),以自动学习面向物体的几何重建。此外,我们还利用多视角2D物体区域与3D隐式/显式物体表面之间的几何对应关系,以提升物体表面的学习效果。技术上,设计了一个关键的透明度判别器,基于估计的2D物体区域区分物体相交与物体绕过的光线,从而生成3D隐式物体表面。此类隐式曲面可通过Marching Cubes算法直接转换为显式物体表面(如网格)。随后,我们通过光栅化建立2D平面与3D网格间的几何对应关系,并通过多视角聚合物体信息,将估计的物体区域投影到3D显式物体表面。进一步地,将3D显式物体表面中的聚合物体信息重新投影回2D平面,旨在更新2D物体区域并使其保持多视角一致性。在DTU和BlendedMVS数据集上的大量实验验证了ORF在无需轮廓掩码的情况下,能够生成与现有最先进模型相当的物体表面的能力。
abstract_en: Recent progress on multi-view 3D object reconstruction has featured neural implicit surfaces via learning high-fidelity radiance fields. However, most approaches hinge on the visual hull derived from cost-expensive silhouette masks to obtain object surfaces. In this paper, we propose a novel Object-aware Radiance Fields (ORF) to automatically learn an object-aware geometry reconstruction. The geometric correspondences between multi-view 2D object regions and 3D implicit/explicit object surfaces are additionally exploited to boost the learning of object surfaces. Technically, a critical transparency discriminator is designed to distinguish the object-intersected and object-bypassed rays based on the estimated 2D object regions, leading to 3D implicit object surfaces. Such implicit surfaces can be directly converted into explicit object surfaces (e.g., meshes) via marching cubes. Then, we build the geometric correspondence between 2D planes and 3D meshes by rasterization, and project the estimated object regions into 3D explicit object surfaces by aggregating the object information across multiple views. The aggregated object information in 3D explicit object surfaces is further reprojected back to 2D planes, aiming to update 2D object regions and enforce them to be multi-view consistent. Extensive experiments on DTU and BlendedMVS verify the capability of ORF to produce comparable surfaces against the state-of-the-art models that demand silhouette masks.
authors: Yiheng Zhang, Zhaofan Qiu, Yingwei Pan, Ting Yao, Tao Mei ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17893-17902

title: 学习光场图像超分辨率中的非局部空间-角度相关性
title_en: Learning Non-Local Spatial-Angular Correlation for Light Field Image Super-Resolution
abstract: 利用空间-角度相关性对光场(LF)图像超分辨率(SR)至关重要,但由于光场图像中的视差差异导致的非局部特性,这一过程极具挑战性。尽管已有许多深度神经网络(DNNs)被开发用于LF图像SR并持续提升性能,但现有方法无法有效利用长距离空间-角度相关性,导致在处理大视差变化场景时性能显著下降。本文提出了一种简单而有效的方法来学习LF图像SR中的非局部空间-角度相关性。我们的方法采用极线平面图像(EPI)表示,将4D空间-角度相关性投影到多个2D EPI平面上,然后开发了一个带有重复自注意力操作的Transformer网络,通过建模每对EPI像素之间的依赖关系来学习空间-角度相关性。我们的方法能够充分利用所有角度视图的信息,并在极线线上实现全局感受野。我们通过深入的可视化实验验证了方法的有效性。在五个公开数据集上的对比实验结果表明,我们的方法不仅实现了最先进的SR性能,还对视差变化具有鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Exploiting spatial-angular correlation is crucial to light field (LF) image super-resolution (SR), but is highly challenging due to its non-local property caused by the disparities among LF images. Although many deep neural networks (DNNs) have been developed for LF image SR and achieved continuously improved performance, existing methods cannot well leverage the long-range spatial-angular correlation and thus suffer a significant performance drop when handling scenes with large disparity variations. In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective method to learn the non-local spatial-angular correlation for LF image SR. In our method, we adopt the epipolar plane image (EPI) representation to project the 4D spatial-angular correlation onto multiple 2D EPI planes, and then develop a Transformer network with repetitive self-attention operations to learn the spatial-angular correlation by modeling the dependencies between each pair of EPI pixels. Our method can fully incorporate the information from all angular views while achieving a global receptive field along the epipolar line. We conduct extensive experiments with insightful visualizations to validate the effectiveness of our method. Comparative results on five public datasets show that our method not only achieves state-of-the-art SR performance, but also performs robust to disparity variations.
authors: Zhengyu Liang, Yingqian Wang, Longguang Wang, Jungang Yang, Shilin Zhou, Yulan Guo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12376-12386

title: 从渲染数据集学习事件相机的光流
title_en: Learning Optical Flow from Event Camera with Rendered Dataset
abstract: 我们研究了从事件相机估计光流的问题。一个重要问题是如何构建包含准确事件值和光流标签的高质量事件-光流数据集。先前的数据集要么通过事件相机捕捉真实场景,要么通过图像合成带有前景物体的场景。前者可以产生真实的事件值但计算出的光流标签稀疏且不准确,后者则能生成密集的光流标签但插值事件容易出错。在本工作中,我们提出使用计算机图形模型渲染物理正确的事件-光流数据集。具体而言,我们首先通过Blender创建包含丰富场景内容变化的室内和室外3D场景。其次,在虚拟捕捉中包含多样化的相机运动,生成图像和准确的光流标签。第三,我们渲染图像之间的高帧率视频以获得精确的事件。该渲染数据集可根据事件密度进行调整,基于此我们进一步引入自适应密度模块(ADM)。实验表明,我们的数据集能够促进事件-光流学习,而当先前方法在我们的数据集上训练时,其性能可显著提升。此外,配备我们ADM的事件-光流管线还能进一步提升性能。我们的代码和数据集将公开可用。
abstract_en: We study the problem of estimating optical flow from event cameras. One important issue is how to build a high-quality event-flow dataset with accurate event values and flow labels. Previous datasets are created by either capturing real scenes by event cameras or synthesizing from images with pasted foreground objects. The former case can produce real event values but with calculated flow labels, which are sparse and inaccurate. The later case can generate dense flow labels but the interpolated events are prone to errors. In this work, we propose to render a physically correct event-flow dataset using computer graphics models. In particular, we first create indoor and outdoor 3D scenes by Blender with rich scene content variations. Second, diverse camera motions are included for the virtual capturing, producing images and accurate flow labels. Third, we render high-framerate videos between images for accurate events. The rendered dataset can adjust the density of events, based on which we further introduce an adaptive density module (ADM). Experiments show that our proposed dataset can facilitate event-flow learning, whereas previous approaches when trained on our dataset can improve their performances constantly by a relatively large margin. In addition, event-flow pipelines when equipped with our ADM can further improve performances. Our code and dataset will be publicly available.
authors: Xinglong Luo, Kunming Luo, Ao Luo, Zhengning Wang, Ping Tan, Shuaicheng Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9847-9857

title: 无需完整点云的点云补全:一种姿态感知方法
title_en: Learning Point Cloud Completion without Complete Point Clouds: A Pose-Aware Approach
abstract: 点云补全旨在从不完整的观测或有限的传感器数据中恢复完整的3D场景和物体。现有的全监督方法依赖于不完整和完整点云的配对数据集,而这些数据集的获取耗时耗力。虽然已有无配对方法被提出,但它们仍需要一组完整点云作为参考。为此,本文提出了一种全新的点云补全框架,完全不使用任何完整点云。我们的核心思想是生成多个不同姿态的不完整点云,并将其整合为一个完整的点云。我们基于循环一致性训练框架,生成一个不完整点云,使其满足:1)与输入不完整点云共享相同的物体;2)对应于任意给定的姿态。此外,我们设计了一种基于姿态的新型投影方法,从编码器提取的体素特征中收集可见特征。大量实验表明,所提方法在性能上可与现有无配对方法相媲美甚至更优。此外,我们还展示了该方法也可应用于真实不完整点云。
abstract_en: Point cloud completion is to restore complete 3D scenes and objects from incomplete observations or limited sensor data. Existing fully-supervised methods rely on paired datasets of incomplete and complete point clouds, which are labor-intensive to obtain. Unpaired methods have been proposed, but still require a set of complete point clouds as a reference. As a remedy, in this paper, we propose a novel point cloud completion framework without using any complete point cloud at all. Our main idea is to generate multiple incomplete point clouds of various poses and integrate them into a complete point cloud. We train our framework based on cycle consistency, to generate an incomplete point cloud such that 1) shares the same object as the input incomplete point cloud and 2) corresponds to an arbitrarily given pose. In addition, we devise a novel projection method conditioned by pose to gather visible features, from a volumetric feature extracted by an encoder. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves comparable or better results than existing unpaired methods. Further, we show that our method also can be applied to real incomplete point clouds.
authors: Jihun Kim, Hyeokjun Kweon, Yunseo Yang, Kuk-Jin Yoon ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14203-14213

title: 跨域语义分割中的伪关系学习
title_en: Learning Pseudo-Relations for Cross-domain Semantic Segmentation
abstract: 域自适应语义分割旨在将在一个带标签的源域上训练的模型适应到无标签的目标域。自训练在该领域展现出竞争力的潜力。现有方法主要集中在通过选择目标数据上的可靠预测作为伪标签用于类别学习,而忽略了像素间有用的关系用于关系学习。本文提出了一种伪关系学习框架Relation Teacher(RTea),该框架能够利用可利用的像素关系,高效地利用不可靠像素并学习通用表示。在该框架中,我们在局部网格上构建合理的伪关系,并将其与图像空间中的低层次关系融合,这受到可靠局部关系先验和可用低层次关系先验的启发。随后,我们设计了一种伪关系学习策略,并通过寻找最优子图划分来优化类别概率,以满足关系一致性。通过这种方式,模型在目标域上的预测确定性和一致性得到增强,进一步消除了跨域不适应性。在三个数据集上的大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性。
abstract_en:
Domain adaptive semantic segmentation aims to adapt a model trained on labeled source domain to the unlabeled target domain. Self-training shows competitive potential in this field. Existing methods along this stream mainly focus on selecting reliable predictions on target data as pseudo-labels for category learning, while ignoring the useful relations between pixels for relation learning. In this paper, we propose a pseudo-relation learning framework, Relation Teacher (RTea), which can exploitable pixel relations to efficiently use unreliable pixels and learn generalized representations. In this framework, we build reasonable pseudo-relations on local grids and fuse them with low-level relations in the image space, which are motivated by the reliable local relations prior and available low-level relations prior. Then, we design a pseudo-relation learning strategy and optimize the class probability to meet the relation consistency by finding the optimal sub-graph division. In this way, the model's certainty and consistency of prediction are
 enhanced on the target domain, and the cross-domain inadaptation is further eliminated. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
authors: Dong Zhao, Shuang Wang, Qi Zang, Dou Quan, Xiutiao Ye, Rui Yang, Licheng Jiao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19191-19203

title: 学习雨位置先验用于夜间去雨
title_en: Learning Rain Location Prior for Nighttime Deraining
abstract: 雨可以显著降低图像质量和能见度,使去雨成为计算机视觉领域的重要研究方向。尽管基于学习的去雨方法取得了近期进展,但由于人工光源引起的非均匀局部光照带来的独特挑战,夜间去雨仍缺乏足够关注。这些场景中的雨痕具有多样的外观,且与雨痕相对于光源的位置密切相关,使得现有去雨方法难以有效处理。本文强调了雨痕位置信息在夜间去雨中的重要性。具体而言,我们提出了一种通过循环残差模型从雨天图像中隐式学习的雨位置先验(Rain Location Prior, RLP)。该先验包含雨痕的位置信息,当注入去雨模型时可显著提升其性能。为进一步提高所学先验的有效性,我们还提出了一种雨先验注入模块(Rain Prior Injection Module, RPIM),用于在注入前调节先验,增强雨痕区域特征的重要性。实验结果表明,我们的方法在性能上优于现有最先进的方法约1dB,并有效提升了去雨模型的性能。我们还在真实夜间雨天图像上评估了该方法,展示了其利用全合成数据训练处理真实场景的能力。我们的方法在夜间去雨领域迈出了重要一步,并突显了位置信息在这一具有挑战性问题中的重要性。代码已公开在https://github.com/zkawfanx/RLP。
abstract_en: Rain can significantly degrade image quality and visibility, making deraining a critical area of research in computer vision. Despite recent progress in learning-based deraining methods, there is a lack of focus on nighttime deraining due to the unique challenges posed by non-uniform local illuminations from artificial light sources. Rain streaks in these scenes have diverse appearances that are tightly related to their relative positions to light sources, making it difficult for existing deraining methods to effectively handle them. In this paper, we highlight the importance of rain streak location information in nighttime deraining. Specifically, we propose a Rain Location Prior (RLP) that is learned implicitly from rainy images using a recurrent residual model. This learned prior contains location information of rain streaks and, when injected into deraining models, can significantly improve their performance. To further improve the effectiveness of the learned prior, we also propose a Rain Prior Injection Module (RPIM) to modulate the prior before injection, increasing the importance of features within rain streak areas. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods by about 1dB and effectively improves the performance of deraining models. We also evaluate our method on real night rainy images to show the capability to handle real scenes with fully synthetic data for training. Our method represents a significant step forward in the area of nighttime deraining and highlights the importance of location information in this challenging problem. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/zkawfanx/RLP.
authors: Fan Zhang, Shaodi You, Yu Li, Ying Fu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13148-13157

title: 基于信息瓶颈与记忆网络的鲁棒表示学习用于基于RGB-D的手势识别
title_en: Learning Robust Representations with Information Bottleneck and Memory Network for RGB-D-based Gesture Recognition
abstract: 尽管先前基于RGB-D的手势识别方法已展现出有希望的性能,但研究者常忽视光照和背景等任务无关线索的干扰。这些不必要的因素与预测性因素一同被网络学习,阻碍了准确识别。本文提出一个便捷且分析性的框架,以学习一种对手势无关因素具有鲁棒性的特征表示。基于信息瓶颈理论,我们推导出充分性与紧凑性两个规则,开发出新的信息论损失函数,从特征编码中培养出更充分且紧凑的表示,减轻手势无关信息的影响。为进一步突出预测信息,我们进一步集成记忆网络。利用所提出的基于内容和上下文的记忆寻址方案,我们削弱了干扰因素同时保留任务相关信息,为优化特征表示提供指导。在三个公开数据集上的实验表明,我们的方法获得了更优的特征表示,并在性能上优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Although previous RGB-D-based gesture recognition methods have shown promising performance, researchers often overlook the interference of task-irrelevant cues like illumination and background. These unnecessary factors are learned together with the predictive ones by the network and hinder accurate recognition. In this paper, we propose a convenient and analytical framework to learn a robust feature representation that is impervious to gesture-irrelevant factors. Based on the Information Bottleneck theory, two rules of Sufficiency and Compactness are derived to develop a new information-theoretic loss function, which cultivates a more sufficient and compact representation from the feature encoding and mitigates the impact of gesture-irrelevant information. To highlight the predictive information, we further integrate a memory network. Using our proposed content-based and contextual memory addressing scheme, we weaken the nuisances while preserving the task-relevant information, providing guidance for refining the feature representation. Experiments conducted on three public datasets demonstrate that our approach leads to a better feature representation and achieves better performance than state-of-the-art methods.
authors: Yunan Li, Huizhou Chen, Guanwen Feng, Qiguang Miao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20968-20978

title: 基于半监督高斯混合模型的广义类别发现研究
title_en: Learning Semi-supervised Gaussian Mixture Models for Generalized Category Discovery
abstract: 本文针对广义类别发现(GCD)问题展开研究,即给定一组图像,其中部分图像已标注,其余未标注,任务是利用标注数据的信息对未标注数据进行自动聚类,同时未标注数据包含来自标注类别的图像以及新类别图像。GCD与半监督学习(SSL)相似,但更具现实意义和挑战性,因为SSL假设所有未标注图像均来自标注类别。我们不假设未标注数据的类别数已知,使GCD问题更加复杂。为解决类别数未知的GCD问题,我们提出一种类似EM算法的框架,在表示学习和类别数估计之间交替进行。我们提出了一种半监督高斯混合模型(GMM)变体,通过随机分裂和合并机制动态确定原型,通过分析簇的紧密性和可分性来确定原型。利用这些原型,我们通过原型对比学习对部分标注数据进行表示学习,并受标注数据约束。框架在两个步骤间交替进行直至收敛。未标注实例的聚类分配可通过识别其最近原型获得。我们在通用图像分类数据集和具有挑战性的细粒度物体识别数据集上对框架进行全面评估,取得了最先进的性能。
abstract_en:
In this paper, we address the problem of generalized category discovery (GCD), i.e., given a set of images where part of them are labelled and the rest are not, the task is to automatically cluster the images in the unlabelled data, leveraging the information from the labelled data, while the unlabelled data contain images from the labelled classes and also new ones. GCD is similar to semi-supervised learning (SSL) but is more realistic and challenging, as SSL assumes all the unlabelled images are from the same classes as the labelled ones. 
 We also do not assume the class number in the unlabelled data is known a-priori, making the GCD problem even harder. 
 To tackle the problem of GCD without knowing the class number, we propose an EM-like framework that alternates between representation learning and class number estimation. We propose a semi-supervised variant of the Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) with a stochastic splitting and merging mechanism to dynamically determine the prototypes by examining the cluster compactness and separability. With these prototypes, we leverage prototypical contrastive learning for representation learning on the partially labelled data subject to the constraints imposed by the labelled data. Our framework alternates between these two steps until convergence. The cluster assignment for an unlabelled instance can then be retrieved by identifying its nearest prototype. We comprehensively evaluate our framework on both generic image classification datasets and challenging fine-grained object recognition datasets, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
authors: Bingchen Zhao, Xin Wen, Kai Han ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16623-16633

title: 通过隐式凸性正则化学习形状基元
title_en: Learning Shape Primitives via Implicit Convexity Regularization
abstract: 形状基元分解是三维形状分析中一个重要且长期存在的任务。现有方法严重依赖于三维点云或体素数据进行形状基元提取,这在实际场景中实用性较低。本文提出通过引入隐式曲面渲染从多视角图像中学习形状基元。由于隐式形状具有高度自由度,这违背了形状基元的简洁性属性,因此该任务具有挑战性。本文提出了一种新的正则化项,称为隐式凸性正则化(Implicit Convexity Regularization, ICR),用于解决这一问题。我们从一般三维形状的凸性定义出发,推导出符号距离函数(SDFs)表示的隐式形状的等价表达式。进一步地,为了避免直接约束输出SDF值导致的优化不稳定,我们转而对形状内部线段上的二阶方向导数施加约束,这被证明是三维凸性的更紧致条件。通过所有基元SDFs的softmax加权求和操作,受所提ICR约束的隐式基元被组合成完整物体。在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上的实验表明,我们的方法能够在无需分割标签或三维数据的情况下,将物体分解为简单且合理的形状基元。代码和数据已公开在https://github.com/seanywang0408/ICR。
abstract_en: Shape primitives decomposition has been an important and long-standing task in 3D shape analysis. Prior arts heavily rely on 3D point clouds or voxel data for shape primitives extraction, which are less practical in real-world scenarios. This paper proposes to learn shape primitives from multi-view images by introducing implicit surface rendering. It is challenging since implicit shapes have a high degree of freedom, which violates the simplicity property of shape primitives. In this work, a novel regularization term named Implicit Convexity Regularization (ICR) imposed on implicit primitive learning is proposed to tackle this problem. We start with the convexity definition of general 3D shapes, and then derive the equivalent expression for implicit shapes represented by signed distance functions (SDFs). Further, instead of directly constraining the output SDF values which cause unstable optimization, we alternatively impose constraint on second order directional derivatives on line segments inside the shapes, which proves to be a tighter condition for 3D convexity. Implicit primitives constrained by the proposed ICR are combined into a whole object via softmax-weighted-sum operation over all primitive SDFs. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that our method is able to decompose objects into simple and reasonable shape primitives without the need of segmentation labels or 3D data. Code and data is publicly available in https://github.com/seanywang0408/ICR.
authors: Xiaoyang Huang, Yi Zhang, Kai Chen, Teng Li, Wenjun Zhang, Bingbing Ni ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3642-3651

title: 学习空间上下文感知的全局视觉特征表示用于实例图像检索
title_en: Learning Spatial-context-aware Global Visual Feature Representation for Instance Image Retrieval
abstract: 在实例图像检索中,考虑图像内的局部空间信息已被证明能有效提升检索性能,这通过基于局部视觉描述符的几何验证得到证实。然而,使普通全局图像表示具备空间上下文感知能力极具价值,因为基于全局表示的图像检索因其算法简单、内存成本低且适合复杂的数据结构而受到青睐。为此,我们提出了一种新的特征学习框架用于实例图像检索,该框架将局部空间上下文信息嵌入到学习到的全局特征表示中。具体而言,在CNN主干的视觉特征分支并行设计了一个空间上下文分支,该分支包含两个模块:在线标记学习和距离编码。对于CNN中学习到的每个局部描述符,前者用于指示其周围描述符的类型,而后者则捕捉其空间分布信息。随后,视觉特征分支与空间上下文分支融合,生成每张图像的单一全局特征表示。实验结果表明,通过空间上下文感知特性,我们能够在保持其所有吸引人的特性的同时,显著提升基于全局表示的图像检索性能。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Zy-Zhang/SpCa获取
abstract_en: In instance image retrieval, considering local spatial information within an image has proven effective to boost retrieval performance, as demonstrated by local visual descriptor based geometric verification. Nevertheless, it will be highly valuable to make ordinary global image representations spatial-context-aware because global representation based image retrieval is appealing thanks to its algorithmic simplicity, low memory cost, and being friendly to sophisticated data structures. To this end, we propose a novel feature learning framework for instance image retrieval, which embeds local spatial context information into the learned global feature representations. Specifically, in parallel to the visual feature branch in a CNN backbone, we design a spatial context branch that consists of two modules called online token learning and distance encoding. For each local descriptor learned in CNN, the former module is used to indicate the types of its surrounding descriptors, while their spatial distribution information is captured by the latter module. After that, the visual feature branch and the spatial context branch are fused to produce a single global feature representation per image. As experimentally demonstrated, with the spatial-context-aware characteristic, we can well improve the performance of global representation based image retrieval while maintaining all of its appealing properties. Our code is available at https://github.com/Zy-Zhang/SpCa
authors: Zhongyan Zhang, Lei Wang, Luping Zhou, Piotr Koniusz ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11250-11259

title: 面向可解释图像分类的支持与平凡原型学习
title_en: Learning Support and Trivial Prototypes for Interpretable Image Classification
abstract: 原型部分网络(ProtoPNet)方法通过将预测与一组训练原型关联来实现可解释分类,我们称这些原型为平凡原型,因为它们被训练以远离特征空间中的分类边界。需要注意的是,由于两种方法的分类均依赖于与一组训练点计算相似性(即ProtoPNet中的平凡原型和支持向量机(SVM)中的支持向量),因此可以将ProtoPNet与SVM进行类比。然而,尽管平凡原型位于分类边界远处,支持向量则靠近该边界,我们认为这种与经典SVM理论的差异可能导致ProtoPNet模型的分类准确率较低。本文旨在通过一种新方法改进ProtoPNet的分类性能,该方法学习位于特征空间分类边界附近的支撑原型,这与SVM理论建议一致。此外,我们提出了一种新模型ST-ProtoPNet,通过利用支撑原型和平凡原型提供更有效的分类。在CUB-200-2011、Stanford Cars和Stanford Dogs数据集上的实验结果表明,ST-ProtoPNet实现了最先进的分类准确率和可解释性结果。我们还证明所提出的支撑原型更倾向于定位在感兴趣对象而非背景区域。代码可在https://github.com/cwangrun/ST-ProtoPNet获取。
abstract_en: Prototypical part network (ProtoPNet) methods have been designed to achieve interpretable classification by associating predictions with a set of training prototypes, which we refer to as trivial prototypes because they are trained to lie far from the classification boundary in the feature space. Note that it is possible to make an analogy between ProtoPNet and support vector machine (SVM) given that the classification from both methods relies on computing similarity with a set of training points (i.e., trivial prototypes in ProtoPNet, and support vectors in SVM). However, while trivial prototypes are located far from the classification boundary, support vectors are located close to this boundary, and we argue that this discrepancy with the well-established SVM theory can result in ProtoPNet models with inferior classification accuracy. In this paper, we aim to improve the classification of ProtoPNet with a new method to learn support prototypes that lie near the classification boundary in the feature space, as suggested by the SVM theory. In addition, we target the improvement of classification results with a new model, named ST-ProtoPNet, which exploits our support prototypes and the trivial prototypes to provide more effective classification. Experimental results on CUB-200-2011, Stanford Cars, and Stanford Dogs datasets demonstrate that ST-ProtoPNet achieves state-of-the-art classification accuracy and interpretability results. We also show that the proposed support prototypes tend to be better localised in the object of interest rather than in the background region. Code is available at https://github.com/cwangrun/ST-ProtoPNet.
authors: Chong Wang, Yuyuan Liu, Yuanhong Chen, Fengbei Liu, Yu Tian, Davis McCarthy, Helen Frazer, Gustavo Carneiro ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2062-2072

title: 学习对称感知的几何对应关系以进行6D物体位姿估计
title_en: Learning Symmetry-Aware Geometry Correspondences for 6D Object Pose Estimation
abstract: 当前6D位姿估计方法专注于处理之前训练过的物体,这限制了其在真实动态世界中的应用。为此,我们提出了一种基于几何对应关系的框架,称为GCPose,用于在无需重新训练的情况下估计任意未见过物体的6D位姿。具体而言,所提出的方法借鉴点云配准的思想,利用与对象无关的几何特征在物体-场景点云与物体-模型点云之间建立3D-3D对应关系。然后通过最小二乘拟合算法求解6D位姿参数。考虑到物体的对称性属性,我们设计了一种对称感知的匹配损失函数,以促进密集点级几何特征的学习并显著提升性能。此外,我们引入了一种在线训练数据生成方法,结合特殊的数据增强和归一化处理,以增强网络对多样几何先验的学习能力。在ShapeNet合成物体上进行训练后,我们的方法在T-LESS、LINEMOD、Occluded-LINEMOD和TUD-L数据集上,显著优于先前的未见过物体位姿估计方法。代码可在https://github.com/hikvision-research/GCPose获取。
abstract_en: Current 6D pose estimation methods focus on handling objects that are previously trained, which limits their applications in real dynamic world. To this end, we propose a geometry correspondence-based framework, termed GCPose, to estimate 6D pose of arbitrary unseen objects without any re-training. Specifically, the proposed method draws the idea from point cloud registration and resorts to object-agnostic geometry features to establish the 3D-3D correspondences between the object-scene point cloud and object-model point cloud. Then the 6D pose parameters are solved by a least-squares fitting algorithm. Taking the symmetry properties of objects into consideration, we design a symmetry-aware matching loss to facilitate the learning of dense point-wise geometry features and improve the performance considerably. Moreover, we introduce an online training data generation with special data augmentation and normalization to empower the network to learn diverse geometry prior. With training on synthetic objects from ShapeNet, our method outperforms previous approaches for unseen object pose estimation by a large margin on T-LESS, LINEMOD, Occluded-LINEMOD, and TUD-L datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/hikvision-research/GCPose.
authors: Heng Zhao, Shenxing Wei, Dahu Shi, Wenming Tan, Zheyang Li, Ye Ren, Xing Wei, Yi Yang, Shiliang Pu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14045-14054

title: 面向视频-语言任务的轨迹-词对齐学习
title_en: Learning Trajectory-Word Alignments for Video-Language Tasks
abstract: 在视频中,物体通常以轨迹形式出现,即跨越多个空间但更长的时间片段,包含丰富的时空上下文。然而,现代视频-语言BERT(VDL-BERT)通常遵循图像-语言BERT(IL-BERT)部署块到词(P2W)注意力机制,可能过度利用琐碎的空间上下文而忽视重要的时间上下文。为解决此问题,我们提出了一种新型TW-BERT,通过新设计的轨迹到词(T2W)注意力机制学习轨迹-词对齐以解决视频-语言任务。此外,先前的VDL-BERT通常均匀采样少量帧,但不同轨迹具有不同的粒度,即某些轨迹跨越更长帧数而某些跨越较短帧数,使用少量帧会丢失部分有用的时间上下文。然而,简单增加帧数会导致预训练不可行,因训练负担大幅增加。为缓解此问题,我们在微调阶段将新型分层帧选择器(HFS)模块插入视频编码器。HFS根据文本上下文逐步选择适合的帧,供后续跨模态编码器学习更优的轨迹-词对齐。通过提出的T2W注意力机制和HFS,我们的TW-BERT在文本到视频检索任务中达到最先进性能,并在视频问答任务中与部分使用更多数据训练的VDL-BERT表现相当。代码将在补充材料中提供。
abstract_en: In a video, an object usually appears as the trajectory, i.e., it spans over a few spatial but longer temporal patches, that contains abundant spatiotemporal contexts. However, modern Video-Language BERTs (VDL-BERTs) neglect this trajectory characteristic that they usually follow image-language BERTs (IL-BERTs) to deploy the patch-to-word (P2W) attention that may over-exploit trivial spatial contexts and neglect significant temporal contexts. To amend this, we propose a novel TW-BERT to learn Trajectory-Word alignment by a newly designed trajectory-to-word (T2W) attention for solving video-language tasks. Moreover, previous VDL-BERTs usually uniformly sample a few frames into the model while different trajectories have diverse graininess, i.e., some trajectories span longer frames and some span shorter, and using a few frames will lose certain useful temporal contexts. However, simply sampling more frames will also make pre-training infeasible due to the largely increased training burdens. To alleviate the problem, during the fine-tuning stage, we insert a novel Hierarchical Frame-Selector (HFS) module into the video encoder. HFS gradually selects the suitable frames conditioned on the text context for the later cross-modal encoder to learn better trajectory-word alignments. By the proposed T2W attention and HFS, our TW-BERT achieves SOTA performances on text-to-video retrieval tasks, and comparable performances on video question-answering tasks with some VDL-BERTs trained on much more data. The code will be available in the supplementary material.
authors: Xu Yang, Zhangzikang Li, Haiyang Xu, Hanwang Zhang, Qinghao Ye, Chenliang Li, Ming Yan, Yu Zhang, Fei Huang, Songfang Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2504-2514

title: 学习统一的分解式与组合式NeRF用于可编辑的新视角合成
title_en: Learning Unified Decompositional and Compositional NeRF for Editable Novel View Synthesis
abstract: 隐式神经表示在建模真实世界3D场景方面展现出强大能力,为新视角合成任务提供了优越性能。本文针对更具挑战性的场景:基于隐式神经场景表示的联合场景新视角合成与编辑。当前先进方法通常为这两个任务(即视角合成与编辑)分别构建独立网络,导致任务间交互与相关性的建模非常有限,而这对于学习高质量场景表示至关重要。为解决该问题,本文提出统一的Neural Radiance Field(NeRF)框架,有效实现真实场景的联合场景分解与组合建模。分解旨在学习不同物体与背景的解耦3D表示,支持场景编辑;而场景组合则建模完整场景表示用于新视角合成。具体而言,通过两阶段NeRF框架,我们首先学习粗粒度阶段以预测全局辐射场作为点采样指导,随后在细粒度阶段,通过新颖的单热物体辐射场正则化模块和基于图像修复的伪监督处理物体遮挡的模糊背景区域。分解后的物体级辐射场进一步通过分解模块的激活进行组合。大量定量与定性实验结果验证了方法在场景分解与组合的有效性,优于现有先进方法在新视角合成与编辑任务中的表现。
abstract_en: Implicit neural representations have shown powerful capacity in modeling real-world 3D scenes, offering superior performance in novel view synthesis. In this paper, we target a more challenging scenario, i.e., joint scene novel view synthesis and editing based on implicit neural scene representations. State-of-the-art methods in this direction typically consider building separate networks for these two tasks (i.e., view synthesis and editing). Thus, the modeling of interactions and correlations between these two tasks is very limited, which, however, is critical for learning high-quality scene representations.To tackle this problem, in this paper, we propose a unified Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) framework to effectively perform joint scene decomposition and composition for modeling real-world scenes. The decomposition aims at learning disentangled 3D representations of different objects and the background, allowing for scene editing, while scene composition models an entire scene representation for novel view synthesis. Specifically, with a two-stage NeRF framework, we learn a coarse stage for predicting a global radiance field as guidance for point sampling, and in the second fine-grained stage, we perform scene decomposition by a novel one-hot object radiance field regularization module and a pseudo supervision via inpainting to handle ambiguous background regions occluded by objects. The decomposed object-level radiance fields are further composed by using activations from the decomposition module. Extensive quantitative and qualitative results show the effectiveness of our method for scene decomposition and composition, outperforming state-of-the-art methods for both novel-view synthesis and editing tasks.
authors: Yuxin Wang, Wayne Wu, Dan Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18247-18256

title: Learning Versatile 3D Shape Generation with Improved Auto-regressive Models
title_en: Learning Versatile 3D Shape Generation with Improved Auto-regressive Models
abstract: Auto-Regressive (AR) models have achieved impressive results in 2D image generation by modeling joint distributions in the grid space. While this approach has been extended to the 3D domain for powerful shape generation, it still has two limitations: expensive computations on volumetric grids and ambiguous auto-regressive order along grid dimensions. To overcome these limitations, we propose the Improved Auto-regressive Model (ImAM) for 3D shape generation, which applies discrete representation learning based on a latent vector instead of volumetric grids. Our approach not only reduces computational costs but also preserves essential geometric details by learning the joint distribution in a more tractable order. Moreover, thanks to the simplicity of our model architecture, we can naturally extend it from unconditional to conditional generation by concatenating various conditioning inputs, such as point clouds, categories, images, and texts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ImAM can synthesize diverse and faithful shapes of multiple categories, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
abstract_en: Auto-Regressive (AR) models have achieved impressive results in 2D image generation by modeling joint distributions in the grid space. While this approach has been extended to the 3D domain for powerful shape generation, it still has two limitations: expensive computations on volumetric grids and ambiguous auto-regressive order along grid dimensions. To overcome these limitations, we propose the Improved Auto-regressive Model (ImAM) for 3D shape generation, which applies discrete representation learning based on a latent vector instead of volumetric grids. Our approach not only reduces computational costs but also preserves essential geometric details by learning the joint distribution in a more tractable order. Moreover, thanks to the simplicity of our model architecture, we can naturally extend it from unconditional to conditional generation by concatenating various conditioning inputs, such as point clouds, categories, images, and texts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ImAM can synthesize diverse and faithful shapes of multiple categories, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
authors: Simian Luo, Xuelin Qian, Yanwei Fu, Yinda Zhang, Ying Tai, Zhenyu Zhang, Chengjie Wang, Xiangyang Xue ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14139-14149

title: 从YouTube视频中学习视觉-语言导航
title_en: Learning Vision-and-Language Navigation from YouTube Videos
abstract: 视觉-语言导航(VLN)要求具身智能体使用自然语言指令在现实三维环境中进行导航。现有VLN方法受限于在小规模环境或不合理路径-指令数据集上的训练,导致其泛化能力不足。YouTube上存在大量房屋巡游视频,提供了丰富的实际导航经验和布局信息。然而,这些视频尚未被用于VLN研究。本文提出通过构建包含房屋巡游视频中合理路径-指令对的大规模数据集,从这些视频中学习智能体,并在该数据集上进行预训练。为实现这一目标,我们需要解决自动构建路径-指令对以及从原始未标注视频中提取真实布局知识的挑战。为此,我们首先利用基于熵的方法构建路径轨迹的节点;然后提出一种动作感知生成器,用于从未标注轨迹生成指令;最后设计一种轨迹判断的预训练任务,鼓励智能体挖掘布局知识。实验结果表明,我们的方法在两个流行基准(R2R和REVERIE)上达到了最先进性能。代码已开源:https://github.com/JeremyLinky/YouTube-VLN
abstract_en: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to navigate in realistic 3D environments using natural language instructions. Existing VLN methods suffer from training on small-scale environments or unreasonable path-instruction datasets, limiting the generalization to unseen environments. There are massive house tour videos on YouTube, providing abundant real navigation experiences and layout information. However, these videos have not been explored for VLN before. In this paper, we propose to learn an agent from these videos by creating a large-scale dataset which comprises reasonable path-instruction pairs from house tour videos and pre-training the agent on it. To achieve this, we have to tackle the challenges of automatically constructing path-instruction pairs and exploiting real layout knowledge from raw and unlabeled videos. To address these, we first leverage an entropy-based method to construct the nodes of a path trajectory. Then, we propose an action-aware generator for generating instructions from unlabeled trajectories. Last, we devise a trajectory judgment pretext task to encourage the agent to mine the layout knowledge. Experimental results show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on two popular benchmarks (R2R and REVERIE). Code is available at https://github.com/JeremyLinky/YouTube-VLN.
authors: Kunyang Lin, Peihao Chen, Diwei Huang, Thomas H. Li, Mingkui Tan, Chuang Gan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8317-8326

title: 通过水平集投影学习更连续的无符号距离场中的零水平集
title_en: Learning a More Continuous Zero Level Set in Unsigned Distance Fields through Level Set Projection
abstract: 最新方法使用无符号距离函数(UDFs)以开放表面表示形状。它们训练神经网络学习UDFs,并通过UDF零水平集周围的梯度重建表面。然而,微分网络在学习UDF不可微的零水平集时面临困难,导致零水平集周围无符号距离和梯度出现较大误差,从而产生高度碎片化和不连续的表面。为解决此问题,我们提出通过水平集投影学习更连续的UDF零水平集。我们的洞察是通过投影过程利用其余非零水平集指导零水平集的学习。我们的想法源于观察到非零水平集比零水平集更平滑且连续。我们通过梯度约束将非零水平集拉向零水平集,对齐不同水平集的梯度并校正零水平集上的无符号距离误差,从而获得更平滑且连续的无符号距离场。我们在点云、真实扫描或深度图的表面重建中进行了全面实验,并进一步探索了利用学习到的UDF在无监督点云上采样和无监督点法线估计中的性能,结果表明我们的方法在现有方法上实现了非平凡的改进。代码可在https://github.com/junshengzhou/LevelSetUDF获取。
abstract_en: Latest methods represent shapes with open surfaces using unsigned distance functions (UDFs). They train neural networks to learn UDFs and reconstruct surfaces with the gradients around the zero level set of the UDF. However, the differential networks struggle from learning the zero level set where the UDF is not differentiable, which leads to large errors on unsigned distances and gradients around the zero level set, resulting in highly fragmented and discontinuous surfaces. To resolve this problem, we propose to learn a more continuous zero level set in UDFs with level set projections. Our insight is to guide the learning of zero level set using the rest non-zero level sets via a projection procedure. Our idea is inspired from the observations that the non-zero level sets are much smoother and more continuous than the zero level set. We pull the non-zero level sets onto the zero level set with gradient constraints which align gradients over different level sets and correct unsigned distance errors on the zero level set, leading to a smoother and more continuous unsigned distance field. We conduct comprehensive experiments in surface reconstruction for point clouds, real scans or depth maps, and further explore the performance in unsupervised point cloud upsampling and unsupervised point normal estimation with the learned UDF, which demonstrate our non-trivial improvements over the state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/junshengzhou/LevelSetUDF.
authors: Junsheng Zhou, Baorui Ma, Shujuan Li, Yu-Shen Liu, Zhizhong Han ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3181-3192

title: 基于Occ-SDF混合方法的房间学习:有符号距离函数与占用表示的结合有助于场景表示
title_en: Learning a Room with the Occ-SDF Hybrid: Signed Distance Function Mingled with Occupancy Aids Scene Representation
abstract: 利用有符号距离函数(SDF)表示和几何先验(如深度或表面法线)的隐式神经渲染,在大规模场景的表面重建中取得了显著进展。然而,将该方法应用于从图像重建房间级场景时,可能会遗漏低强度区域或小薄物体的结构。我们在三个数据集上进行了实验,以识别原始颜色渲染损失和嵌入先验的SDF场景表示的局限性。我们的发现表明,颜色渲染损失会对低强度区域产生优化偏差,导致梯度消失并使这些区域未被优化。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种基于特征的颜色渲染损失,利用非零特征值恢复优化信号。此外,SDF表示可能受射线路径上物体的影响,当存在单个物体时会破坏SDF值的单调性变化。因此,我们探索使用占用表示,该表示对查询射线上的物体不敏感,单独编码每个点。实验结果表明,基于特征的渲染损失与Occ-SDF混合表示方案的结合能够提供高质量的重建结果,特别是在具有挑战性的房间级场景中。代码可在https://github.com/shawLyu/Occ-SDF_Hybrid获取。
abstract_en: Implicit neural rendering, using signed distance function (SDF) representation with geometric priors like depth or surface normal, has made impressive strides in the surface reconstruction of large-scale scenes. However, applying this method to reconstruct a room-level scene from images may miss structures in low-intensity areas and/or small, thin objects. We have conducted experiments on three datasets to identify limitations of the original color rendering loss and priors-embedded SDF scene representation.Our findings show that the color rendering loss creates an optimization bias against low-intensity areas, resulting in gradient vanishing and leaving these areas unoptimized. To address this issue, we propose a feature-based color rendering loss that utilizes non-zero feature values to bring back optimization signals. Additionally, the SDF representation can be influenced by objects along a ray path, disrupting the monotonic change of SDF values when a single object is present. Accordingly, we explore using the occupancy representation, which encodes each point separately and is unaffected by objects along a querying ray. Our experimental results demonstrate that the joint forces of the feature-based rendering loss and Occ-SDF hybrid representation scheme can provide high-quality reconstruction results, especially in challenging room-level scenarios. The code is available at https://github.com/shawLyu/Occ-SDF_Hybrid.
authors: Xiaoyang Lyu, Peng Dai, Zizhang Li, Dongyu Yan, Yi Lin, Yifan Peng, Xiaojuan Qi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8940-8950

title: 通过排序学习:具有组排序约束的自监督学习
title_en: Learning by Sorting: Self-supervised Learning with Group Ordering Constraints
abstract: 对比学习已成为从无标签数据中学习表示的重要工具,主要依赖于最小化正样本对(如同一图像的不同视图)之间的距离,以及最大化负样本对(如不同图像的视图)之间的距离。本文提出了一种对比学习目标的新变体——组排序约束(GroCo),该方法利用对正负样本对的距离进行排序,并根据正样本对距离大于负样本对的数量来计算相应的损失,从而识别未正确排序的样本对。为此,GroCo损失基于可微排序网络,通过将由给定得分集排序生成的可微排列矩阵与相应的地面真实排列矩阵进行匹配,实现排序监督的训练。将这一思想应用于多组预排序的正负样本对输入,可以引入具有隐式强调强正负样本对的GroCo损失,从而更好地优化局部邻域。我们在各种自监督学习基准上评估了所提出的公式,结果表明它不仅比传统的对比学习方法取得了更好的效果,而且在线性探针任务中表现出与可比方法相当的性能,并在k-NN性能上超越了当前方法。
abstract_en: Contrastive learning has become an important tool in learning representations from unlabeled data mainly relying on the idea of minimizing distance between positive data pairs, e.g., views from the same images, and maximizing distance between negative data pairs, e.g., views from different images. This paper proposes a new variation of the contrastive learning objective, Group Ordering Constraints (GroCo), that leverages the idea of sorting the distances of positive and negative pairs and computing the respective loss based on how many positive pairs have a larger distance than the negative pairs, and thus are not ordered correctly. To this end, the GroCo loss is based on differentiable sorting networks, which enable training with sorting supervision by matching a differentiable permutation matrix, which is produced by sorting a given set of scores, to a respective ground truth permutation matrix. Applying this idea to groupwise pre-ordered inputs of multiple positive and negative pairs allows introducing the GroCo loss with implicit emphasis on strong positives and negatives, leading to better optimization of the local neighborhood. We evaluate the proposed formulation on various self-supervised learning benchmarks and show that it not only leads to improved results compared to vanilla contrastive learning but also shows competitive performance to comparable methods in linear probing and outperforms current methods in k-NN performance.
authors: Nina Shvetsova, Felix Petersen, Anna Kukleva, Bernt Schiele, Hilde Kuehne ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16453-16463

title: 基于噪声数据学习的半监督三维目标检测
title_en: Learning from Noisy Data for Semi-Supervised 3D Object Detection
abstract: 伪标签(PL)是半监督三维目标检测(SSOD)中的关键方法。在PL中,教师模型生成的精心选择的伪标签被提供给学生模型以监督半监督检测框架。然而,这种范式可能会引入误分类标签或松散的定位框预测,导致检测性能的次优解。本文从噪声学习视角出发重新审视PL:而非直接应用原始伪标签,我们设计了一个抗噪实例监督模块以提升泛化能力。具体而言,我们通过综合考虑伪标签质量与网络学习能力来软化分类目标,并将回归任务转化为概率建模问题。此外,考虑到自监督学习在无标签情况下的工作特性,我们引入密集像素级特征一致性约束以消除噪声标签的负面影响。为此,我们提出NoiseDet,一个简单而有效的半监督三维目标检测框架。在竞争性的ONCE和Waymo基准数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法显著优于现有半监督方法。值得注意的是,NoiseDet在ONCE数据集上于不同数据集规模下均取得最先进性能。例如,NoiseDet将其NoiseyStudent基线从55.5 mAP提升至58.0 mAP,并通过增强伪标签生成进一步达到60.2 mAP。代码将开源于https://github.com/zehuichen123/NoiseDet。
abstract_en: Pseudo-Labeling (PL) is a critical approach in semi-supervised 3D object detection (SSOD). In PL, delicately selected pseudo-labels, generated by the teacher model, are provided for the student model to supervise the semi-supervised detection framework. However, such a paradigm may introduce misclassified labels or loose localized box predictions, resulting in a sub-optimal solution of detection performance. In this paper, we take PL from a noisy learning perspective: instead of directly applying vanilla pseudo-labels, we design a noise-resistant instance supervision module for better generalization. Specifically, we soften the classification targets by considering both the quality of pseudo labels and the network learning ability, and convert the regression task into a probabilistic modeling problem. Besides, considering that self-supervised learning works in the absence of labels, we incorporate dense pixel-wise feature consistency constraints to eliminate the negative impact of noisy labels. To this end, we propose NoiseDet, a simple yet effective framework for semi-supervised 3D object detection. Extensive experiments on competitive ONCE and Waymo benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms current semi-supervised approaches by a large margin. Notably, our NoiseDet achieves state-of-the-art performance under various dataset scales on ONCE dataset. For example, NoiseDet improves its NoiseyStudent baseline from 55.5 mAP to 58.0 mAP, and further reaches 60.2 mAP with enhanced pseudo-label generation. Code will be available at https://github.com/zehuichen123/NoiseDet.
authors: Zehui Chen, Zhenyu Li, Shuo Wang, Dengpan Fu, Feng Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6929-6939

title: 基于噪声伪标签的学习用于半监督时序动作定位
title_en: Learning from Noisy Pseudo Labels for Semi-Supervised Temporal Action Localization
abstract: 半监督时序动作定位(SS-TAL)旨在通过大规模未标注视频提升动作检测器的泛化能力。尽管近年来取得了进展,但主要挑战之一仍然存在:噪声伪标签阻碍了对大量未标注视频的高效学习,表现为位置偏差和类别错误。本文深入探讨这一重要但研究不足的困境。为此,我们提出一个统一框架,称为噪声伪标签学习,以处理位置偏差和类别错误。具体而言,我们的方法具有(1)噪声标签排序:根据语义置信度和边界可靠性对伪标签进行排序;(2)噪声标签过滤:解决由类别错误引起的伪标签类别不平衡问题;(3)噪声标签学习:通过惩罚不一致的边界预测来实现对严重位置偏差的噪声容忍学习。因此,我们的方法能够有效处理标签噪声问题并提升对大量未标注视频的利用效率。在THUMOS14和ActivityNet v1.3上的大量实验验证了方法的有效性。代码已开源于github.com/kunnxia/NPL。
abstract_en: Semi-Supervised Temporal Action Localization (SS-TAL) aims to improve the generalization ability of action detectors with large-scale unlabeled videos. Albeit the recent advancement, one of the major challenges still remains: noisy pseudo labels hinder efficient learning on abundant unlabeled videos, embodied as location biases and category errors. In this paper, we dive deep into such an important but understudied dilemma. To this end, we propose a unified framework, termed Noisy Pseudo-Label Learning, to handle both location biases and category errors. Specifically, our method is featured with (1) Noisy Label Ranking to rank pseudo labels based on the semantic confidence and boundary reliability, (2) Noisy Label Filtering to address the class-imbalance problem of pseudo labels caused by category errors, (3) Noisy Label Learning to penalize inconsistent boundary predictions to achieve noise-tolerant learning for heavy location biases. As a result, our method could effectively handle the label noise problem and improve the utilization of a large amount of unlabeled videos. Extensive experiments on THUMOS14 and ActivityNet v1.3 demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. The code is available at github.com/kunnxia/NPL.
authors: Kun Xia, Le Wang, Sanping Zhou, Gang Hua, Wei Tang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10160-10169

title: 基于无配对多视角语义对齐的第一视角视频识别学习
title_en: Learning from Semantic Alignment between Unpaired Multiviews for Egocentric Video Recognition
abstract: 我们关注无配对多视角视频学习中的一个具有挑战性的场景。在这种情况下,模型旨在学习全面的多视角表示,而跨视角语义信息存在差异。我们提出语义引导的无配对多视角学习方法(SUM-L)来解决这一问题。其核心思想是通过利用视频的语义信息构建跨视角伪配对,并进行视角不变的对齐。为进一步提升多视角学习的数据效率,我们对第一视角和第三人称视频进行视频-文本对齐,充分挖掘语义知识以提升视频表示。在多个基准数据集上的大量实验验证了我们框架的有效性。我们的方法在比典型配对或无配对多模态或多视角学习更具挑战性的场景下,优于多种现有视角对齐方法。我们的代码已开源在https://github.com/wqtwjt1996/SUM-L。
abstract_en: We are concerned with a challenging scenario in unpaired multiview video learning. In this case, the model aims to learn comprehensive multiview representations while the cross-view semantic information exhibits variations. We propose Semantics-based Unpaired Multiview Learning (SUM-L) to tackle this unpaired multiview learning problem. The key idea is to build cross-view pseudo-pairs and do view-invariant alignment by leveraging the semantic information of videos. To facilitate the data efficiency of multiview learning, we further perform video-text alignment for first-person and third-person videos, to fully leverage the semantic knowledge to improve video representations. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets verify the effectiveness of our framework. Our method also outperforms multiple existing view-alignment methods, under the more challenging scenario than typical paired or unpaired multimodal or multiview learning. Our code is available at https://github.com/wqtwjt1996/SUM-L.
authors: Qitong Wang, Long Zhao, Liangzhe Yuan, Ting Liu, Xi Peng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3307-3317

title: 在不完美环境中的学习:具有长尾分布和部分标签的多标签分类
title_en: Learning in Imperfect Environment: Multi-Label Classification with Long-Tailed Distribution and Partial Labels
abstract: 传统多标签分类(MLC)方法假设所有样本均为完全标记且分布一致。不幸的是,这一假设在具有长尾(LT)分布和部分标签(PL)的大规模MLC数据中并不现实。为解决该问题,我们引入了一种新任务:部分标签与长尾多标签分类(PLT-MLC),以联合考虑上述两种不完美学习环境。不出所料,我们发现大多数LT-MLC和PL-MLC方法无法解决PLT-MLC问题,导致在提出的两个PLT-MLC基准数据集上性能显著下降。因此,我们提出了一种端到端学习框架:校正 -> 修正 -> 平衡(COMC)。我们的自举哲学是通过类感知阈值上的置信预测信心同时校正缺失标签(校正),并在训练过程中从这些召回标签中学习。随后,我们提出了一种新颖的多焦点修正损失函数,同时解决头部-尾部不平衡和正负样本不平衡问题,以在长尾类分布下自适应地修正不同样本的注意力(修正)。我们还通过从头部和尾部样本中蒸馏模型的学习效果开发了平衡训练策略,并据此设计了基于头部和尾部学习效果的平衡分类器(平衡)以维持稳定性能。实验研究表明,所提出的方法在我们新创建的PLT-MLC数据集上显著优于通用MLC、LT-MLC和ML-MLC方法,在有效性与鲁棒性方面均表现出色。
abstract_en:
Conventional multi-label classification (MLC) methods assume that all samples are fully labeled and identically distributed. Unfortunately, this assumption is unrealistic in large-scale MLC data 
 that has long-tailed (LT) distribution and partial labels (PL).
 To address the problem, we introduce a novel task, Partial labeling and Long-Tailed Multi-Label Classification (PLT-MLC), to jointly consider the above two imperfect learning environments. Not surprisingly, we find that most LT-MLC and PL-MLC approaches fail to solve the PLT-MLC, resulting in significant performance degradation on the two proposed PLT-MLC benchmarks. Therefore, we propose an end-to-end learning framework: COrrection -> ModificatIon -> balanCe, abbreviated as COMC. 
 Our bootstrapping philosophy is to simultaneously correct the missing labels (Correction) with convinced prediction confidence over a class-aware threshold and to learn from these recall labels during training. 
 We next propose a novel multi-focal modifier loss that simultaneously addresses head-tail imbalance and positive-negative imbalance to adaptively modify the attention to different samples (Modification) under the LT class distribution.
 We also develop a balanced training strategy by distilling the model's learning effect from head and tail samples, and thus design the balanced classifier (Balance) conditioned on the head and tail learning effect to maintain a stable performance. 
 Our experimental study shows that the proposed method significantly outperforms the general MLC, LT-MLC and ML-MLC methods in terms of effectiveness and robustness on our newly created PLT-MLC datasets.
authors: Wenqiao Zhang, Changshuo Liu, Lingze Zeng, Bengchin Ooi, Siliang Tang, Yueting Zhuang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1423-1432

title: 学习稀疏视角CT的全局表示蒸馏
title_en: Learning to Distill Global Representation for Sparse-View CT
abstract: 稀疏视角计算机断层扫描(CT)---使用少量投影进行断层重建---能够显著降低患者辐射剂量并加速数据采集。然而重建图像存在强伪影,严重限制其诊断价值。当前稀疏视角CT研究趋势转向原始数据以获得更优信息恢复。但由此产生的双域方法在超稀疏视角场景中存在二次伪影问题,且其泛化能力受限于其他扫描仪/协议。一个关键问题浮现:图像后处理方法是否已达到极限?我们的回答是否定的。本文基于图像后处理方法的灵活性,提出针对稀疏视角CT的全局表示(GloRe)蒸馏框架,命名为GloReDi。首先,我们通过傅里叶卷积学习GloRe,使每个GloRe元素具有全图像感受野。其次,不同于仅使用全视角图像进行监督的方法,我们提出从中间视角重建图像(未被前人研究的可获取数据)蒸馏GloRe。GloRe蒸馏的成功归功于两个关键组件:表示方向蒸馏以对齐GloRe方向,以及带通特定对比蒸馏以获取临床重要细节。大量实验验证了所提GloReDi方法在包括双域方法在内的当前最佳方法上的优越性。源代码可在https://github.com/longzilicart/GloReDi获取。
abstract_en: Sparse-view computed tomography (CT)---using a small number of projections for tomographic reconstruction---enables much lower radiation dose to patients and accelerated data acquisition. The reconstructed images, however, suffer from strong artifacts, greatly limiting their diagnostic value. Current trends for sparse-view CT turn to the raw data for better information recovery. The resultant dual-domain methods, nonetheless, suffer from secondary artifacts, especially in ultra-sparse view scenarios, and their generalization to other scanners/protocols is greatly limited. A crucial question arises: have the image post-processing methods reached the limit? Our answer is not yet. In this paper, we stick to image post-processing methods due to great flexibility and propose global representation (GloRe) distillation framework for sparse-view CT, termed GloReDi. First, we propose to learn GloRe with Fourier convolution, so each element in GloRe has an image-wide receptive field. Second, unlike methods that only use the full-view images for supervision, we propose to distill GloRe from intermediate-view reconstructed images that are readily available but not explored in previous literature. The success of GloRe distillation is attributed to two key components: representation directional distillation to align the GloRe directions, and band-pass-specific contrastive distillation to gain clinically important details. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of the proposed GloReDi over the state-of-the-art methods, including dual-domain ones. The source code is available at https://github.com/longzilicart/GloReDi.
authors: Zilong Li, Chenglong Ma, Jie Chen, Junping Zhang, Hongming Shan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21196-21207

title: 学习生成语义布局以提升文本-图像对应性在文本到图像合成中的应用
title_en: Learning to Generate Semantic Layouts for Higher Text-Image Correspondence in Text-to-Image Synthesis
abstract: 现有文本到图像生成方法在逼真度和文本-图像对应性方面设定了高标准,这主要得益于网络规模的文本-图像数据集,这些数据集可包含多达50亿对文本-图像。然而,使用领域特定数据集(如城市场景、医学图像和人脸)训练的文本到图像生成模型,由于缺乏文本-图像对,仍存在低文本-图像对应性问题。此外,为特定领域收集数十亿对文本-图像数据耗时且成本高昂。因此,不依赖网络规模文本-图像数据集确保高文本-图像对应性仍是一项具有挑战性的任务。本文提出了一种新颖方法,通过利用可用的语义布局来增强文本-图像对应性。具体而言,我们提出了一种高斯-分类扩散过程,该过程同时生成图像及其对应的布局对。实验表明,通过训练模型为每个像素生成语义标签,可以引导文本到图像生成模型关注不同图像区域的语义。我们在文本-图像对稀缺的Multi-Modal CelebA-HQ和Cityscapes数据集上验证了所提方法,结果表明其文本-图像对应性优于现有文本到图像生成方法。
abstract_en: Existing text-to-image generation approaches have set high standards for photorealism and text-image correspondence, largely benefiting from web-scale text-image datasets, which can include up to 5 billion pairs. However, text-to-image generation models trained on domain-specific datasets, such as urban scenes, medical images, and faces, still suffer from low text-image correspondence due to the lack of text-image pairs. Additionally, collecting billions of text-image pairs for a specific domain can be time-consuming and costly. Thus, ensuring high text-image correspondence without relying on web-scale text-image datasets remains a challenging task. In this paper, we present a novel approach for enhancing text-image correspondence by leveraging available semantic layouts. Specifically, we propose a Gaussian-categorical diffusion process that simultaneously generates both images and corresponding layout pairs. Our experiments reveal that we can guide text-to-image generation models to be aware of the semantics of different image regions, by training the model to generate semantic labels for each pixel. We demonstrate that our approach achieves higher text-image correspondence compared to existing text-to-image generation approaches in the Multi-Modal CelebA-HQ and the Cityscapes dataset, where text-image pairs are scarce.
authors: Minho Park, Jooyeol Yun, Seunghwan Choi, Jaegul Choo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7591-7600

title: 通过叙述学习将教学文章定位到视频中
title_en: Learning to Ground Instructional Articles in Videos through Narrations
abstract: 本文提出了一种方法,用于在叙述型教学视频中定位程序性活动的步骤。为应对大规模标记数据的稀缺性,我们从包含大量程序性任务教学文章的语言知识库(wikiHow)中获取步骤描述。无需任何人工监督,我们的模型通过匹配帧、叙述和步骤描述三种模态,学习将程序性文章的步骤时间定位到教学视频中。具体而言,我们的方法通过融合两条独立路径的信息对步骤进行视频对齐:i)直接将步骤描述与帧对齐,ii)通过组合步骤到叙述的映射与叙述到视频的对应关系获得间接对齐。值得注意的是,我们的方法通过利用顺序信息一次性对文章中所有步骤进行全局时间定位,并使用迭代优化和严格过滤的步骤伪标签进行训练。为验证我们的模型,我们引入了一个新的基准测试——HT-Step,该基准测试通过对HowTo100M数据集的124小时子集进行人工标注,其中步骤来源于wikiHow文章。在该基准测试以及CrossTask上的零样本评估实验表明,我们的多模态对齐方法在多个基线和先前工作中取得了显著提升。最后,我们展示了我们的叙述到视频匹配模块在HTM-Align叙述-视频对齐基准测试中显著优于现有最佳方法。
abstract_en:
In this paper we present an approach for localizing steps of procedural activities in narrated how-to videos. To deal with the scarcity of labeled data at scale, we source the step descriptions from a language knowledge base (wikiHow) containing instructional articles for a large variety of procedural tasks. Without any form of manual supervision, our model learns to temporally ground the steps of procedural articles in how-to videos by matching three modalities: frames, narrations, and step descriptions. Specifically, our method 
 aligns steps to video by fusing information from two distinct pathways: i) direct alignment of step descriptions to frames, ii) indirect alignment obtained by composing steps-to-narrations with narrations-to-video correspondences. 
 Notably, our approach performs global temporal grounding of all steps in an article at once by exploiting order information, and is trained with step pseudo-labels which are iteratively refined and aggressively filtered.
 In order to validate our model we introduce a new benchmark -- HT-Step -- obtained by manually annotating a 124-hour subset of HowTo100M with steps sourced from wikiHow articles. Experiments on this benchmark as well as zero-shot evaluations on CrossTask demonstrate that our multi-modality alignment yields dramatic gains over several baselines and prior works. Finally, we show that our inner module for matching narration-to-video outperforms by a large margin the state of the art on the HTM-Align narration-video alignment benchmark.
authors: Effrosyni Mavroudi, Triantafyllos Afouras, Lorenzo Torresani ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15201-15213

title: 从视频中学习识别强化学习的关键状态
title_en: Learning to Identify Critical States for Reinforcement Learning from Videos
abstract: 近期关于深度强化学习(DRL)的研究指出,可以从缺乏显式执行动作信息的离线数据中提取有关优质策略的算法信息。例如,人类或机器人的视频可能传达大量关于奖励动作序列的隐含信息,但希望从这类视频中获益的DRL机器必须首先自主学习识别和识别相关状态/动作/奖励。无需依赖真实标注,我们提出的新方法Deep State Identifier学习从编码为视频的回合中预测回报。随后,它使用一种基于掩码的敏感性分析来提取/识别重要关键状态。大量实验展示了我们方法在理解和改进智能体行为方面的潜力。源代码和生成的数据集可在https://github.com/AI-Initiative-KAUST/VideoRLCS获取。
abstract_en: Recent work on deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has pointed out that algorithmic information about good policies can be extracted from offline data which lack explicit information about executed actions. For example, videos of humans or robots may convey a lot of implicit information about rewarding action sequences, but a DRL machine that wants to profit from watching such videos must first learn by itself to identify and recognize relevant states/actions/rewards. Without relying on ground-truth annotations, our new method called Deep State Identifier learns to predict returns from episodes encoded as videos. Then it uses a kind of mask-based sensitivity analysis to extract/identify important critical states. Extensive experiments showcase our method's potential for understanding and improving agent behavior. The source code and the generated datasets are available at https://github.com/AI-Initiative-KAUST/VideoRLCS.
authors: Haozhe Liu, Mingchen Zhuge, Bing Li, Yuhui Wang, Francesco Faccio, Bernard Ghanem, Jürgen Schmidhuber ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1955-1965

title: 学会学习:如何持续地教授人类与机器
title_en: Learning to Learn: How to Continuously Teach Humans and Machines
abstract: 课程设计是教育的基本组成部分。例如,当我们在学校学习数学时,我们会基于加法知识来学习乘法。这些及其他概念必须在首次代数课程之前掌握,这也强化了我们的加法和乘法技能。为人类或机器设计课程的共同目标是最大化从早期任务到后期任务的知识迁移,同时最小化已学任务的遗忘。以往关于图像分类课程设计的研究主要关注单次离线任务中训练示例的顺序。在此,我们研究了在序列中学习多个不同任务的顺序对学习效果的影响。我们聚焦于在线类增量持续学习场景,其中算法或人类必须在单次数据集遍历中逐个学习图像类别。我们发现课程设计对人类和多种持续机器学习算法在多个基准数据集上的学习结果均有持续影响。我们引入了一个新型物体识别数据集用于人类课程学习实验,并观察到对人类有效的课程设计与对机器有效的课程设计高度相关。作为向在线类增量学习自动化课程设计的初步步骤,我们提出了一种新算法,称为课程设计者(Curriculum Designer, CD),该算法基于类间特征相似性设计并排序课程。我们发现经验上高度有效的课程与CD高度排名的课程之间存在显著重叠。本研究建立了进一步研究使用优化课程持续教授人类与机器学习的框架。
abstract_en: Curriculum design is a fundamental component of education. For example, when we learn mathematics at school, we build upon our knowledge of addition to learn multiplication. These and other concepts must be mastered before our first algebra lesson, which also reinforces our addition and multiplication skills. Designing a curriculum for teaching either a human or a machine shares the underlying goal of maximizing knowledge transfer from earlier to later tasks, while also minimizing forgetting of learned tasks. Prior research on curriculum design for image classification focuses on the ordering of training examples during a single offline task. Here, we investigate the effect of the order in which multiple distinct tasks are learned in a sequence. We focus on the online class-incremental continual learning setting, where algorithms or humans must learn image classes one at a time during a single pass through a dataset. We find that curriculum consistently influences learning outcomes for humans and for multiple continual machine learning algorithms across several benchmark datasets. We introduce a novel-object recognition dataset for human curriculum learning experiments and observe that curricula that are effective for humans are highly correlated with those that are effective for machines. As an initial step towards automated curriculum design for online class-incremental learning, we propose a novel algorithm, dubbed Curriculum Designer (CD), that designs and ranks curricula based on inter-class feature similarities. We find significant overlap between curricula that are empirically highly effective and those that are highly ranked by our CD. Our study establishes a framework for further research on teaching humans and machines to learn continuously using optimized curricula.
authors: Parantak Singh, You Li, Ankur Sikarwar, Stan Weixian Lei, Difei Gao, Morgan B. Talbot, Ying Sun, Mike Zheng Shou, Gabriel Kreiman, Mengmi Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11708-11719

title: 学习变换以实现可泛化的实例级不变性
title_en: Learning to Transform for Generalizable Instance-wise Invariance
abstract: 计算机视觉研究长期致力于构建对自然数据中变换具有鲁棒性的系统。传统方法通过数据增强或在架构中硬编码不变性来实现这一目标。然而,过多或过少的不变性都可能产生负面影响,且正确的不变性程度无法预先确定且依赖于实例。理想情况下,应从数据中学习适当的不变性并在测试时进行推断。我们将不变性视为预测问题:给定任意图像,预测变换的分布。通过变分推断学习该分布,并结合图模型方法,形成一种灵活、可泛化且自适应的不变性形式。实验表明,该方法可用于对齐数据集、发现原型、适应分布外姿态,并在不同类别间泛化不变性。当用于数据增强时,该方法在CIFAR 10、CIFAR10-LT和TinyImageNet上展现出一致的准确率和鲁棒性提升。
abstract_en:
Computer vision research has long aimed to build systems that are robust to transformations found in natural data. Traditionally, this is done using data augmentation or hard-coding invariances into the architecture. 
 However, too much or too little invariance can hurt, and the correct amount is unknown a priori and dependent on the instance. Ideally, the appropriate invariance would be learned from data and inferred at test-time.
 
 We treat invariance as a prediction problem. Given any image, we predict a distribution over transformations. We use variational inference to learn this distribution end-to-end. Combined with a graphical model approach, this distribution forms a flexible, generalizable, and adaptive form of invariance. Our experiments show that it can be used to align datasets and discover prototypes, adapt to out-of-distribution poses, and generalize invariances across classes. When used for data augmentation, our method shows consistent gains in accuracy and robustness on CIFAR 10, CIFAR10-LT, and TinyImageNet.
authors: Utkarsh Singhal, Carlos Esteves, Ameesh Makadia, Stella X. Yu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6211-6221

title: 通过学习采样来学习上采样
title_en: Learning to Upsample by Learning to Sample
abstract: 我们提出DySample,这是一种超轻量且有效的动态上采样器。尽管基于核的动态上采样器(如CARAFE、FADE和SAPA)最近取得了令人印象深刻的性能提升,但它们引入了大量计算负担,主要由于耗时的动态卷积以及用于生成动态核的额外子网络。此外,FADE和SAPA对高分辨率特征的依赖在某种程度上限制了其应用场景。为了解决这些问题,我们绕过动态卷积,从点采样的视角出发构建上采样方法,这种方法更节省资源且可通过PyTorch标准内置函数轻松实现。我们首先展示了一个朴素设计,然后逐步演示如何强化其上采样行为,最终形成我们的新型上采样器DySample。与之前的基于核的动态上采样器相比,DySample无需定制CUDA包,参数数量、FLOPs、GPU内存和延迟均显著减少。除了轻量特性外,DySample在语义分割、目标检测、实例分割、全景分割和单目深度估计五个密集预测任务中均优于其他上采样器。代码已开源至https://github.com/tiny-smart/dysample。
abstract_en: We present DySample, an ultra-lightweight and effective dynamic upsampler. While impressive performance gains have been witnessed from recent kernel-based dynamic upsamplers such as CARAFE, FADE, and SAPA, they introduce much workload, mostly due to the time-consuming dynamic convolution and the additional sub-network used to generate dynamic kernels. Further, the need for high-res feature guidance of FADE and SAPA somehow limits their application scenarios. To address these concerns, we bypass dynamic convolution and formulate upsampling from the perspective of point sampling, which is more resource-efficient and can be easily implemented with the standard built-in function in PyTorch. We first showcase a naive design, and then demonstrate how to strengthen its upsampling behavior step by step towards our new upsampler, DySample. Compared with former kernel-based dynamic upsamplers, DySample requires no customized CUDA package and has much fewer parameters, FLOPs, GPU memory, and latency. Besides the light-weight characteristics, DySample outperforms other upsamplers across five dense prediction tasks, including semantic segmentation, object detection, instance segmentation, panoptic segmentation, and monocular depth estimation. Code is available at https://github.com/tiny-smart/dysample.
authors: Wenze Liu, Hao Lu, Hongtao Fu, Zhiguo Cao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6027-6037

title: 多样性学习:自扩展均衡以提升深度度量学习的泛化能力
title_en: Learning with Diversity: Self-Expanded Equalization for Better Generalized Deep Metric Learning
abstract: 探索良好的泛化能力在深度度量学习(DML)中至关重要。现有大多数DML方法聚焦于提升模型对类别迁移的鲁棒性,以保持对未见类别的性能。然而,除了类别迁移外,领域迁移在现实场景中也广泛存在。因此,学习更优的泛化能力仍是深度度量学习模型面临的具有挑战性却现实的问题。本文提出一种新的自扩展均衡(SEE)方法,有效提升DML模型对未见类别和领域的泛化能力。具体而言,我们采用最小-最大策略结合基于代理的损失函数,自适应地增强大量分布外样本,显著扩展原始训练数据的跨度。为充分利用源样本与增强样本之间的隐式跨领域关系,我们引入领域感知均衡模块,通过在度量空间中正则化特征分布,诱导领域不变的距离度量。在两个基准数据集和一个大规模多领域数据集上的大量实验验证了SEE方法相较于现有DML方法的优越性。
abstract_en: Exploring good generalization ability is essential in deep metric learning (DML). Most existing DML methods focus on improving the model robustness against category shift to keep the performance on unseen categories. However, in addition to category shift, domain shift also widely exists in real-world scenarios. Therefore, learning better generalization ability for the DML model is still a challenging yet realistic problem. In this paper, we propose a new self-expanded equalization (SEE) method to effectively generalize the DML model to both unseen categories and domains. Specifically, we take a `min-max' strategy combined with a proxy-based loss to adaptively augment diverse out-of-distribution samples that vastly expand the span of original training data. To take full advantage of the implicit cross-domain relations between source and augmented samples, we introduce a domain-aware equalization module to induce the domain-invariant distance metric by regularizing the feature distribution in the metric space. Extensive experiments on two benchmarks and a large-scale multi-domain dataset demonstrate the superiority of our SEE over the existing DML methods.
authors: Jiexi Yan, Zhihui Yin, Erkun Yang, Yanhua Yang, Heng Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19365-19374

title: 讲座演示多模态数据集:探索教育视频中的多模态理解
title_en: Lecture Presentations Multimodal Dataset: Towards Understanding Multimodality in Educational Videos
abstract: 许多教育视频使用幻灯片演示,这是一种包含文本和图表并配以口语的视觉页面序列,经过精心构建和展示以最优地向学生传递知识。多媒体和心理学领域的先前研究将讲座演示的有效性归因于其多模态特性。作为开发辅助学生学习的智能教师助手视觉-语言模型的一步,我们引入了讲座演示多模态(LPM)数据集作为大规模基准,用于测试视觉-语言模型在教育视频多模态理解方面的能力。我们的数据集包含180多个小时的视频和9000多张幻灯片的对齐幻灯片与口语内容,涵盖计算机科学、牙科、生物学等10个学科的讲师。我们提出了三个研究任务:(1) 图表到文本检索,(2) 文本到图表检索,(3) 幻灯片解释生成,这些任务基于多媒体学习和心理学原理,用于测试视觉-语言模型对多模态内容的理解。我们提供了手动标注以帮助实现这些任务并建立基准。通过比较基准模型和人类学生的表现,我们发现当前最先进的视觉-语言模型(零样本和微调)在以下方面存在困难:(1) 幻灯片与口语文本之间的弱跨模态对齐,(2) 学习新型视觉媒介,(3) 专业术语,(4) 长程序列。我们引入了PolyViLT,这是一种采用多实例学习损失训练的新型多模态Transformer,其在检索任务中比现有方法更有效。最后,我们探讨了教育演示视频多模态理解的挑战与机遇。
abstract_en: Many educational videos use slide presentations, a sequence of visual pages that contain text and figures accompanied by spoken language, which are constructed and presented carefully in order to optimally transfer knowledge to students. Previous studies in multimedia and psychology attribute the effectiveness of lecture presentations to their multimodal nature. As a step toward developing vision-language models to aid in student learning as intelligent teacher assistants, we introduce the Lecture Presentations Multimodal (LPM) Dataset as a large-scale benchmark testing the capabilities of vision-and-language models in multimodal understanding of educational videos. Our dataset contains aligned slides and spoken language, for 180+ hours of video and 9000+ slides, with 10 lecturers from various subjects (e.g., computer science, dentistry, biology). We introduce three research tasks, (1) figure-to-text retrieval, (2) text-to-figure retrieval, and (3) generation of slide explanations, which are grounded in multimedia learning and psychology principles to test a vision-language model's understanding of multimodal content. We provide manual annotations to help implement these tasks and establish baselines on them. Comparing baselines and human student performances, we find that state-of-the-art vision-language models (zero-shot and fine-tuned) struggle in (1) weak crossmodal alignment between slides and spoken text, (2) learning novel visual mediums, (3) technical language, and (4) long-range sequences. We introduce PolyViLT, a novel multimodal transformer trained with a multi-instance learning loss that is more effective than current approaches for retrieval. We conclude by shedding light on the challenges and opportunities in multimodal understanding of educational presentation videos.
authors: Dong Won Lee, Chaitanya Ahuja, Paul Pu Liang, Sanika Natu, Louis-Philippe Morency ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20087-20098

title: 面向真实景深建模的镜头参数估计
title_en: Lens Parameter Estimation for Realistic Depth of Field Modeling
abstract: 我们提出了一种从单张图像中估计景深效果的方法。大多数现有方法在此任务中仅提供每像素的模糊和/或深度估计。相反,我们进一步提出使用基于镜头的表示方法,通过两个参数(模糊因子和焦点差异)建模景深效果。这两个参数与带符号的失焦表示相结合,形成更直观且线性的表示方式,我们通过新颖的加权网络求解。此外,我们的方法显式地强制保持估计的失焦模糊、镜头参数和深度图之间的一致性。最后,我们在混合真实图像与合成景深效果以及全合成图像的数据集上训练深度学习模型。这些改进使我们的方法更加鲁棒和准确,如我们的最先进结果所示。特别是,我们的镜头参数化方法使若干应用成为可能,例如AR环境的3D布景和无缝物体合成。
abstract_en: We present a method to estimate the depth of field effect from a single image. Most existing methods related to this task provide either a per-pixel estimation of blur and/or depth. Instead, we go further and propose to use a lens-based representation that models the depth of field using two parameters: the blur factor and focus disparity. Those two parameters, along with the signed defocus representation, result in a more intuitive and linear representation which we solve using a novel weighting network. Furthermore, our method explicitly enforces consistency between the estimated defocus blur, the lens parameters, and the depth map. Finally, we train our deep-learning-based model on a mix of real images with synthetic depth of field and fully synthetic images. These improvements result in a more robust and accurate method, as demonstrated by our state-of-the-art results. In particular, our lens parametrization enables several applications, such as 3D staging for AR environments and seamless object compositing.
authors: Dominique Piché-Meunier, Yannick Hold-Geoffroy, Jianming Zhang, Jean-François Lalonde ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 499-508

title: 少即是多:面向高效DETR的注意力聚焦
title_en: Less is More: Focus Attention for Efficient DETR
abstract: 类似DETR的模型显著提升了检测器性能,甚至超越了经典卷积模型。然而,传统编码器结构中所有令牌均被平等对待,缺乏区分性导致冗余计算负担。近期的稀疏化策略通过选取信息性令牌子集降低注意力复杂度,在保持性能的同时采用稀疏编码器。但这些方法往往依赖不可靠的模型统计量。此外,简单减少令牌数量会显著损害检测性能,限制了这些稀疏模型的应用。我们提出Focus-DETR,通过聚焦信息性更强的令牌实现计算效率与模型精度之间的更好平衡。具体而言,我们重构编码器采用双注意力机制,包含考虑多尺度特征图中目标定位与类别语义信息的令牌评分机制。基于评分结果,我们高效剔除背景查询并增强细粒度目标查询的语义交互。与相同设置下的最先进稀疏DETR-like检测器相比,我们的Focus-DETR在保持相近复杂度的同时,在COCO数据集上达到50.4AP(+2.2)的性能。代码已开源:https://github.com/huawei-noah/noah-research/tree/master/Focus-DETR 和 https://gitee.com/mindspore/models/tree/master/research/cv/Focus-DETR。
abstract_en:
DETR-like models have significantly boosted the performance of detectors and even outperformed classical convolutional models. However, all tokens are treated equally without discrimination brings a redundant computational burden in the traditional encoder structure. The recent sparsification strategies exploit a subset of informative tokens to reduce attention
 complexity maintaining performance through the sparse encoder. But these methods tend to rely on unreliable model statistics. Moreover, simply reducing the token population hinders the detection performance to a large extent, limiting the application of these sparse models. We propose Focus-DETR, which focuses attention on more informative tokens for a better trade-off between computation efficiency and model accuracy. Specifically, we reconstruct the encoder with dual attention, which includes a token scoring mechanism that considers both localization and category semantic information of the objects from multi-scale feature maps. We efficiently abandon the background queries and enhance the semantic interaction of the fine-grained object queries based on the scores. Compared with the state-of-the-art sparse DETR-like detectors under the same setting, our Focus-DETR gets comparable complexity while achieving 50.4AP (+2.2) on COCO. The code is available at https://github.com/huawei-noah/noah-research/tree/master/Focus-DETR and https://gitee.com/mindspore/models/tree/master/research/cv/Focus-DETR.
authors: Dehua Zheng, Wenhui Dong, Hailin Hu, Xinghao Chen, Yunhe Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6674-6683

title: 利用图像修复进行单图像阴影去除
title_en: Leveraging Inpainting for Single-Image Shadow Removal
abstract: 全监督阴影去除方法在公开数据集上实现了最佳的修复质量,但仍会产生一定阴影残留。原因之一是缺乏大规模的阴影与无阴影图像对。无监督方法虽能缓解该问题,但其修复质量远低于全监督方法。本工作中我们发现,通过在图像修复数据集上预训练阴影去除网络可显著减少阴影残留:仅使用10%的阴影与无阴影图像对,一个简单的编码器-解码器网络即可达到与最先进方法相当的修复质量。通过分析权重中存储的信息(IIW)对比有/无图像修复预训练的网络,我们发现图像修复预训练可显著提升非阴影区域的修复质量并增强网络的泛化能力。此外,阴影去除微调使网络能够填充阴影区域的细节。受这些观察启发,我们将阴影去除建模为一种自适应融合任务,结合阴影去除与图像修复的优势。具体而言,我们开发了一个包含两个编码器、一个自适应融合模块和一个解码器的自适应融合网络。两个编码器分别提取阴影图像和阴影掩码图像的特征,自适应融合模块以自适应方式结合这些特征,最终解码器将自适应融合特征转换为所需的无阴影结果。大量实验表明,我们的方法在阴影去除任务中优于所有现有最先进方法。
abstract_en: Fully-supervised shadow removal methods achieve the best restoration qualities on public datasets but still generate some shadow remnants. One of the reasons is the lack of large-scale shadow & shadow-free image pairs. Unsupervised methods can alleviate the issue but their restoration qualities are much lower than those of fully-supervised methods. In this work, we find that pretraining shadow removal networks on the image inpainting dataset can reduce the shadow remnants significantly: a naive encoder-decoder network gets competitive restoration quality w.r.t. the state-of-the-art methods via only 10% shadow & shadow-free image pairs.
