authors: Yunlong Liu, Tao Huang, Weisheng Dong, Fangfang Wu, Xin Li, Guangming Shi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12140-12149

title: 面向多曝光校正的亮度感知颜色变换
title_en: Luminance-aware Color Transform for Multiple Exposure Correction
abstract: 使用不规则曝光拍摄的图像不可避免地会出现不满意的视觉效果,例如色相失真和色调失真。然而,大多数近期研究主要集中在欠曝校正上,这限制了它们在曝光水平变化的现实场景中的适用性。此外,一些处理多曝光的方法依赖于编码器-解码器架构,导致在下采样和上采样过程中输入图像的细节丢失。针对这一问题,本研究提出了一种新颖的多曝光校正算法,称为亮度感知颜色变换(LACT)。首先,我们基于亮度比较模块推断图像之间的相对曝光条件,以获取亮度特征。接下来,我们从亮度特征中编码一组变换函数,从而实现对过曝和欠曝图像的复杂颜色变换。最后,我们将变换后的表示投影到RGB颜色空间,以生成曝光校正结果。大量实验表明,所提出的LACT在两个多曝光数据集上达到了新的最先进水平。
abstract_en: Images captured with irregular exposures inevitably present unsatisfactory visual effects, such as distorted hue and color tone. However, most recent studies mainly focus on underexposure correction, which limits their applicability to real-world scenarios where exposure levels vary. Furthermore, some works to tackle multiple exposure rely on the encoder-decoder architecture, resulting in losses of details in input images during down-sampling and up-sampling processes. With this regard, a novel correction algorithm for multiple exposure, called luminance-aware color transform (LACT), is proposed in this study. First, we reason the relative exposure condition between images to obtain luminance features based on a luminance comparison module. Next, we encode the set of transformation functions from the luminance features, which enable complex color transformations for both overexposure and underexposure images. Finally, we project the transformed representation onto RGB color space to produce exposure correction results. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed LACT yields new state-of-the-arts on two multiple exposure datasets.
authors: Jong-Hyeon Baek, DaeHyun Kim, Su-Min Choi, Hyo-jun Lee, Hanul Kim, Yeong Jun Koh ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6156-6165

title: M2T:双掩码Transformer实现更快解码
title_en: M2T: Masking Transformers Twice for Faster Decoding
abstract: 我们展示了如何将用于掩码标记预测的双向Transformer应用于神经图像压缩以实现最先进结果。此类模型此前通过根据不确定性自适应调度逐步采样掩码标记组,用于图像生成。与这些工作不同,我们证明预定义的确定性调度在图像压缩中表现同样或更优。这一见解使我们能够在训练中使用掩码注意力(除掩码输入外),并在推理过程中使用激活缓存,从而显著提升模型速度(推理速度提高4倍),仅小幅增加码率。
abstract_en:
We show how bidirectional transformers trained for masked token prediction can be applied to neural image compression to achieve state-of-the-art results.
 Such models were previously used for image_generation_ by progressive sampling groups of masked tokens according to uncertainty-adaptive schedules.
 Unlike these works, we demonstrate that predefined, deterministic schedules perform as well or better for image compression. 
 This insight allows us to use masked attention during training in addition to masked inputs, and activation caching during inference, to significantly speed up our models (4x higher inference speed) at a small increase in bitrate.
authors: Fabian Mentzer, Eirikur Agustson, Michael Tschannen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5340-5349

title: MAAL:面向3D仿生物体的多模态感知自编码器效用学习
title_en: MAAL: Multimodality-Aware Autoencoder-Based Affordance Learning for 3D Articulated Objects
abstract: 推断3D仿生物体的效用是具有挑战性且具有实际意义的问题。它是将机器人应用于现实场景中的基础问题。探索可以总结为确定作用位置和作用方式。相应地,该任务主要要求根据给定的3D物体信息和机器人信息生成可操作性评分、动作提案和成功可能性评分。当前方法通常通过早期融合直接处理多模态输入,并应用批评网络生成评分,导致多模态学习能力不足且多阶段迭代训练效率低下。本文提出了一种新颖的基于多模态感知自编码器的效用学习方法(MAAL),用于解决3D物体效用问题。该方法是一个高效的处理流程,可一次性训练,并且仅需少量正样本即可完成训练。更重要的是,MAAL包含一个用于提升多模态学习能力的多模态能量编码器(MME)。它全面建模来自3D物体和机器人动作的所有多模态输入。通过联合考虑多模态信息,编码器进一步学习机器人与物体之间的交互。MME增强了对物体效用的理解能力。基于大规模数据集PartNet-Mobility的实验结果和可视化分析表明,MAAL在学习多模态数据和解决3D仿生物体效用问题方面具有有效性。
abstract_en: Inferring affordance for 3D articulated objects is a challenging and practical problem. It is a primary problem for applying robots to real-world scenarios. The exploration can be summarized as figuring out where to act and how to act. Correspondingly, the task mainly requires producing actionability scores, action proposals, and success likelihood scores according to the given 3D object information and robotic information. Current works usually directly process multi-modal inputs with early fusion and apply critic networks to produce scores, which leads to insufficient multi-modal learning ability and inefficiently iterative training in multiple stages. This paper proposes a novel Multimodality-Aware Autoencoder-based affordance Learning (MAAL) for the 3D object affordance problem. It is an efficient pipeline, trained in one go, and only requires a few positive samples in training data. More importantly, MAAL contains a MultiModal Energized Encoder (MME) for better multi-modal learning. It comprehensively models all multi-modal inputs from 3D objects and robotic actions. Jointly considering information from multiple modalities, the encoder further learns interactions between robots and objects. MME empowers the better multi-modal learning ability for understanding object affordance. Experimental results and visualizations, based on a large-scale dataset PartNet-Mobility, show the effectiveness of MAAL in learning multi-modal data and solving the 3D articulated object affordance problem.
authors: Yuanzhi Liang, Xiaohan Wang, Linchao Zhu, Yi Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 217-227

title: MAGI:多标注解释引导学习
title_en: MAGI: Multi-Annotated Explanation-Guided Learning
abstract: 解释监督是一种在训练过程中通过人工生成的解释引导模型的技术。该技术旨在通过将人类对预测过程的理解融入训练阶段,提高模型的可预测性。这是一个具有挑战性的任务,因为它依赖于人工标注标签的准确性。为获得高质量的解释标注,使用多标注进行解释监督是一种合理的方法。然而,如何利用多标注提高准确性尤为具有挑战性,原因如下:1)不同标注者生成的标注存在噪声;2)缺乏关于标注与标注者之间对应关系的预给信息;3)由于部分图像未被所有标注者标注,导致标注缺失。为解决这些挑战,我们提出了一种多标注解释引导学习(MAGI)框架,通过生成高质量的综合标注进行解释监督。我们首先提出了一种新颖的生成模型,从所有标注者生成标注,并通过学习每个标注者的特征,利用新提出的基于变分推断的技术进行推断。我们还在生成模型中引入了对齐机制,以在训练过程中推断标注与标注者之间的对应关系。在医学影像领域的两个数据集上的大量实验验证了我们提出框架在处理噪声标注方面的有效性,并在预测性能上优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Explanation supervision is a technique in which the model is guided by human-generated explanations during training. This technique aims to improve the predictability of the model by incorporating human understanding of the prediction process into the training phase. This is a challenging task since it relies on the accuracy of human annotation labels. To obtain high-quality explanation annotations, using multiple annotations to do explanation supervision is a reasonable method. However, how to use multiple annotations to improve accuracy is particularly challenging due to the following: 1) The noisiness of annotations from different annotators; 2) The lack of pre-given information about the corresponding relationship between annotations and annotators; 3) Missing annotations since some images are not labeled by all annotators. To solve these challenges, we propose a Multi-annotated explanation-guided learning (MAGI) framework to do explanation supervision with comprehensive and high-quality generated annotations. We first propose a novel generative model to generate annotations from all annotators and infer them using a newly proposed variational inference-based technique by learning the characteristics of each annotator. We also incorporate an alignment mechanism into the generative model to infer the correspondence between annotations and annotators in the training process. Extensive experiments on two datasets from the medical imaging domain demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed framework in handling noisy annotations while obtaining superior prediction performance compared with previous SOTA.
authors: Yifei Zhang, Siyi Gu, Yuyang Gao, Bo Pan, Xiaofeng Yang, Liang Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1977-1987

title: MAMo:利用记忆与注意力进行单目视频深度估计
title_en: MAMo: Leveraging Memory and Attention for Monocular Video Depth Estimation
abstract: 我们提出MAMo,一种新颖的记忆与注意力框架,用于单目视频深度估计。MAMo能够增强并改进任何单图像深度估计网络,将其转化为视频深度估计模型,使其能够利用时序信息预测更准确的深度。在MAMo中,我们通过记忆模块增强模型,该模块在模型逐帧处理视频时辅助深度预测。具体而言,记忆模块存储先前时间实例学习到的视觉和位移标记。这使得深度网络在预测当前帧深度时,能够参考过去的相关特征。我们引入了一种新颖的方案,持续更新记忆模块,优化其保留与过去和当前视觉信息均相关的标记。我们采用基于注意力的方法处理记忆特征,首先利用自注意力模块学习所得视觉和位移记忆标记的时空关系。进一步地,通过交叉注意力将自注意力的输出特征与当前视觉特征进行聚合。最终,交叉注意力特征被输入解码器,以预测当前帧的深度。通过在KITTI、NYU-Depth V2和DDAD等多个基准数据集上的大量实验,我们证明MAMo持续提升单目深度估计网络性能,并取得新的最先进(SOTA)精度。值得注意的是,与最先进基于代价体积的视频深度模型相比,我们的MAMo视频深度估计在保持更高精度的同时具有更低的延迟。
abstract_en: We propose MAMo, a novel memory and attention framework for monocular video depth estimation. MAMo can augment and improve any single-image depth estimation networks into video depth estimation models, enabling them to take advantage of the temporal information to predict more accurate depth. In MAMo, we augment model with memory which aids the depth prediction as the model streams through the video. Specifically, the memory stores learned visual and displacement tokens of the previous time instances. This allows the depth network to cross-reference relevant features from the past when predicting depth on the current frame. We introduce a novel scheme to continuously update the memory, optimizing it to keep tokens that correspond with both the past and the present visual information. We adopt attention-based approach to process memory features where we first learn the spatio-temporal relation among the resultant visual and displacement memory tokens using self-attention module. Further, the output features of self-attention are aggregated with the current visual features through cross-attention. The cross-attended features are finally given to a decoder to predict depth on the current frame. Through extensive experiments on several benchmarks, including KITTI, NYU-Depth V2, and DDAD, we show that MAMo consistently improves monocular depth estimation networks and sets new state-of-the-art (SOTA) accuracy. Notably, our MAMo video depth estimation provides higher accuracy with lower latency, when comparing to SOTA cost-volume-based video depth models.
authors: Rajeev Yasarla, Hong Cai, Jisoo Jeong, Yunxiao Shi, Risheek Garrepalli, Fatih Porikli ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8754-8764

title: MAP:通过模型无关适配器实现IID与OOD的平衡泛化
title_en: MAP: Towards Balanced Generalization of IID and OOD through Model-Agnostic Adapters
abstract: 深度学习近年来取得了巨大成功,但大多数这些成功都是基于独立同分布(IID)假设。这在一定程度上阻碍了深度学习在更具挑战性的分布外(OOD)场景中的应用。尽管已提出许多OOD方法来解决这一问题,并在训练分布与测试分布存在显著偏移的数据上取得了良好性能,但有趣的是,我们实验发现这些方法通过牺牲IID性能来实现优异的OOD性能。我们将这一发现称为IID-OOD困境。显然,在现实应用中,训练数据与测试数据的分布偏移往往是不确定的,其中偏移可能较小,甚至接近IID场景,因此设计具有IID与OOD之间平衡泛化能力的深度模型至关重要。为此,本文研究了平衡IID与OOD泛化这一引人入胜的问题,并提出了一种新颖的模型无关适配器(MAP)方法,该方法对分布偏移无关的现实数据更加可靠和有效。我们的关键技术贡献是利用辅助适配器层将IID的归纳偏置引入OOD方法中。为实现这一目标,我们采用双层优化显式建模和优化OOD模型与辅助适配器层之间的耦合关系。我们还从理论上给出了一个一阶近似以节省计算时间。在六个数据集上的实验结果成功证明,MAP在提升IID性能的同时能够实现良好的OOD性能。
abstract_en: Deep learning has achieved tremendous success in recent years, but most of these successes are built on an independent and identically distributed (IID) assumption. This somewhat hinders the application of deep learning to the more challenging out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. Although many OOD methods have been proposed to address this problem and have obtained good performance on testing data that is of major shifts with training distributions, interestingly, we experimentally find that these methods achieve excellent OOD performance by making a great sacrifice of the IID performance. We call this finding the IID-OOD dilemma. Clearly, in real-world applications, distribution shifts between training and testing data are often uncertain, where shifts could be minor, and even close to the IID scenario, and thus it is truly important to design a deep model with the balanced generalization ability between IID and OOD. To this end, in this paper, we investigate an intriguing problem of balancing IID and OOD generalizations and propose a novel Model Agnostic adaPters (MAP) method, which is more reliable and effective for distribution-shift-agnostic real-world data. Our key technical contribution is to use auxiliary adapter layers to incorporate the inductive bias of IID into OOD methods. To achieve this goal, we apply a bilevel optimization to explicitly model and optimize the coupling relationship between the OOD model and auxiliary adapter layers. We also theoretically give a first-order approximation to save computational time. Experimental results on six datasets successfully demonstrate that MAP can greatly improve the performance of IID while achieving good OOD performance.
authors: Min Zhang, Junkun Yuan, Yue He, Wenbin Li, Zhengyu Chen, Kun Kuang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11921-11931

title: MAPConNet: 基于网格与点对比学习的自监督3D姿态迁移
title_en: MAPConNet: Self-supervised 3D Pose Transfer with Mesh and Point Contrastive Learning
abstract: 3D姿态迁移是一项具有挑战性的生成任务,旨在将源几何体的姿态转移到目标几何体上,同时保持目标身份特征。许多现有方法需要关键点标注以建立源与目标之间的对应关系。当前姿态迁移方法虽允许端到端对应学习,但需要将期望的最终输出作为监督信号。已提出针对图卷积模型的无监督方法,但这些方法仍需要源与目标输入之间的对应关系作为真实标签。我们提出了一种新颖的自监督框架用于3D姿态迁移,该框架可在无监督、半监督或全监督设置下进行训练,无需任何对应关系标签。我们在潜在空间中引入了两种对比学习约束:一种网格级损失用于解耦包含姿态与身份的全局模式,另一种点级损失用于区分局部语义。我们定量和定性地证明,我们的方法在监督3D姿态迁移任务中达到最先进的结果,在无监督和半监督设置中也取得了可比的性能。我们的方法还可推广到具有复杂拓扑结构的未见过的人体和动物数据。
abstract_en: 3D pose transfer is a challenging generation task that aims to transfer the pose of a source geometry onto a target geometry with the target identity preserved. Many prior methods require keypoint annotations to find correspondence between the source and target. Current pose transfer methods allow end-to-end correspondence learning but require the desired final output as ground truth for supervision. Unsupervised methods have been proposed for graph convolutional models but they require ground truth correspondence between the source and target inputs. We present a novel self-supervised framework for 3D pose transfer which can be trained in unsupervised, semi-supervised, or fully supervised settings without any correspondence labels. We introduce two contrastive learning constraints in the latent space: a mesh-level loss for disentangling global patterns including pose and identity, and a point-level loss for discriminating local semantics. We demonstrate quantitatively and qualitatively that our method achieves state-of-the-art results in supervised 3D pose transfer, with comparable results in unsupervised and semi-supervised settings. Our method is also generalisable to unseen human and animal data with complex topologies.
authors: Jiaze Sun, Zhixiang Chen, Tae-Kyun Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14452-14462

title: MARS:无需额外监督的模型无关偏置对象移除方法用于弱监督语义分割
title_en: MARS: Model-agnostic Biased Object Removal without Additional Supervision for Weakly-Supervised Semantic Segmentation
abstract: 弱监督语义分割旨在通过使用弱监督(如图像级类别标签)训练语义分割模型来降低标注成本。然而,大多数方法在生成准确定位图时存在困难,并且在类别相关背景(即偏置对象)中易产生误预测(如将铁轨误识别为火车)。近期去除偏置对象的方法需要额外监督来手动识别每个问题类别中的偏置对象,并通过审查预测结果收集数据集,这限制了其在具有多重标签和复杂偏置关系的真实数据集中的适用性。基于第一个观察——即通过匹配数据集中相同偏置对象与背景可分离并消除偏置特征,我们提出了一种全自动/模型无关的偏置移除框架MARS(Model-Agnostic Biased Object Removal without Additional Supervision),该框架利用无监督技术的语义一致特征消除伪标签中的偏置对象。令人惊讶的是,我们证明MARS在两个流行基准(PASCAL VOC 2012:val 77.7%、test 77.2%;MS COCO 2014:val 49.4%)上实现了新的SOTA结果,通过无需额外监督即可持续提升各类WSSS模型性能至少30%。代码已开源于https://github.com/shjo-april/MARS。
abstract_en: Weakly-supervised semantic segmentation aims to reduce labeling costs by training semantic segmentation models using weak supervision, such as image-level class labels. However, most approaches struggle to produce accurate localization maps and suffer from false predictions in class-related backgrounds (i.e., biased objects), such as detecting a railroad with the train class. Recent methods that remove biased objects require additional supervision for manually identifying biased objects for each problematic class and collecting their datasets by reviewing predictions, limiting their applicability to the real-world dataset with multiple labels and complex relationships for biasing. Following the first observation that biased features can be separated and eliminated by matching biased objects with backgrounds in the same dataset, we propose a fully-automatic/model-agnostic biased removal framework called MARS (Model-Agnostic biased object Removal without additional Supervision), which utilizes semantically consistent features of an unsupervised technique to eliminate biased objects in pseudo labels. Surprisingly, we show that MARS achieves new state-of-the-art results on two popular benchmarks, PASCAL VOC 2012 (val: 77.7%, test: 77.2%) and MS COCO 2014 (val: 49.4%), by consistently improving the performance of various WSSS models by at least 30% without additional supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/shjo-april/MARS.
authors: Sanghyun Jo, In-Jae Yu, Kyungsu Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 614-623

title: MAS:面向资源高效联邦多任务学习
title_en: MAS: Towards Resource-Efficient Federated Multiple-Task Learning
abstract: 联邦学习(FL)是一种新兴的分布式机器学习方法,能够实现在分布式边缘设备上的本地模型训练。然而,多个同时进行的FL任务可能会导致资源受限设备过载。在本工作中,我们提出了首个能够有效协调和训练多个同时FL任务的FL系统。我们首先形式化了训练同时FL任务的问题。随后,我们提出了新的方法MAS(Merge and Split),以优化多任务同时训练的性能。MAS首先将FL任务合并为一个包含多任务架构的综合FL任务。经过几轮训练后,MAS通过在综合训练期间测量的任务间亲和度,将综合FL任务分割为两个或更多FL任务。然后,基于综合训练的模型参数继续训练每个分割后的FL任务。大量实验表明,MAS在减少训练时间2倍和降低能耗40%的同时,优于其他方法。我们希望这项工作能激励社区进一步研究和优化同时训练FL任务。
abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) is an emerging distributed machine learning method that empowers in-situ model training on decentralized edge devices. However, multiple simultaneous FL tasks could overload resource-constrained devices. In this work, we propose the first FL system to effectively coordinate and train multiple simultaneous FL tasks. We first formalize the problem of training simultaneous FL tasks. Then, we present our new approach, MAS (Merge and Split), to optimize the performance of training multiple simultaneous FL tasks. MAS starts by merging FL tasks into an all-in-one FL task with a multi-task architecture. After training for a few rounds, MAS splits the all-in-one FL task into two or more FL tasks by using the affinities among tasks measured during the all-in-one training. It then continues training each split of FL tasks based on model parameters from the all-in-one training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MAS outperforms other methods while reducing training time by 2x and reducing energy consumption by 40%. We hope this work will inspire the community to further study and optimize training simultaneous FL tasks.
authors: Weiming Zhuang, Yonggang Wen, Lingjuan Lyu, Shuai Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23414-23424

title: MATE: 掩码自编码器是在线3D测试时学习者
title_en: MATE: Masked Autoencoders are Online 3D Test-Time Learners
abstract: 我们的MATE是首个针对3D数据设计的测试时训练(TTT)方法,使点云分类的深度网络对测试数据中的分布变化具有鲁棒性。与现有来自2D图像领域的TTT方法类似,MATE也利用测试数据进行适应。其测试时目标是掩码自编码器:在输入网络前,每个测试点云的大部分会被移除,任务是重建完整的点云。网络更新后,用于对点云进行分类。我们在多个3D物体分类数据集上测试MATE,结果表明其显著提升了深度网络对常见于3D点云的多种损坏类型的鲁棒性。我们证明MATE在适应所需点云比例方面非常高效,仅需每个测试样本5%的token即可有效适应,使其极度轻量。实验表明,MATE通过稀疏适应测试数据也能实现竞争力的性能,进一步降低其计算开销,使其非常适合实时应用。
abstract_en: Our MATE is the first Test-Time-Training (TTT) method designed for 3D data, which makes deep networks trained for point cloud classification robust to distribution shifts occurring in test data. Like existing TTT methods from the 2D image domain, MATE also leverages test data for adaptation. Its test-time objective is that of a Masked Autoencoder: a large portion of each test point cloud is removed before it is fed to the network, tasked with reconstructing the full point cloud. Once the network is updated, it is used to classify the point cloud. We test MATE on several 3D object classification datasets and show that it significantly improves robustness of deep networks to several types of corruptions commonly occurring in 3D point clouds. We show that MATE is very efficient in terms of the fraction of points it needs for the adaptation. It can effectively adapt given as few as 5% of tokens of each test sample, making it extremely lightweight. Our experiments show that MATE also achieves competitive performance by adapting sparsely on the test data, which further reduces its computational overhead, making it ideal for real-time applications.
authors: M. Jehanzeb Mirza, Inkyu Shin, Wei Lin, Andreas Schriebl, Kunyang Sun, Jaesung Choe, Mateusz Kozinski, Horst Possegger, In So Kweon, Kuk-Jin Yoon, Horst Bischof ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16709-16718

title: Match, Expand and Improve: 无监督微调用于结合语言知识的零样本动作识别
title_en: MAtch, eXpand and Improve: Unsupervised Finetuning for Zero-Shot Action Recognition with Language Knowledge
abstract: 大规模视觉-语言(VL)模型在对齐视觉和文本模态表示方面取得了巨大成功,这推动了零样本识别、图像生成与编辑等任务的显著进展。然而,VL模型往往过度表征物体而忽视动词,且需要在视频数据上进行额外微调才能实现最佳零样本动作识别性能。尽管先前工作依赖大规模全标注数据,本文提出了一种无监督方法。我们利用未标注视频和未配对动作词典,将VL模型适配于零样本和少样本动作识别。基于此,我们通过匹配、文本扩展和描述生成,利用大语言模型和VL模型为每个未标注视频构建文本袋。在多实例学习框架下,我们使用这些文本袋将图像-文本主干网络适配到视频数据。尽管模型仅在未标注视频数据上进行微调,但所获得的模型在众多未见零样本下游任务中展现出高迁移能力,性能较基础VL模型提升最高可达14%,并在零样本和少样本视频识别迁移任务中优于全监督基线。代码已提供于补充材料,接受后将公开发布。
abstract_en: Large scale Vision-Language (VL) models have shown tremendous success in aligning representations between visual and text modalities. This enables remarkable progress in zero-shot recognition, image generation & editing, and many other exciting tasks. However, VL models tend to over-represent objects while paying much less attention to verbs, and require additional tuning on video data for best zero-shot action recognition performance. While previous work relied on large-scale, fully-annotated data, in this work we propose an unsupervised approach. We adapt a VL model for zero-shot and few-shot action recognition using a collection of unlabeled videos and an unpaired action dictionary. Based on that, we leverage Large Language Models and VL models to build a text bag for each unlabeled video via matching, text expansion and captioning. We use those bags in a Multiple Instance Learning setup to adapt an image-text backbone to video data. Although finetuned on unlabeled video data, our resulting models demonstrate high transferability to numerous unseen zero-shot downstream tasks, improving the base VL model performance by up to 14%, and even comparing favorably to fully-supervised baselines in both zero-shot and few-shot video recognition transfer. The code is provided in supplementary and will be released upon acceptance.
authors: Wei Lin, Leonid Karlinsky, Nina Shvetsova, Horst Possegger, Mateusz Kozinski, Rameswar Panda, Rogerio Feris, Hilde Kuehne, Horst Bischof ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2851-2862

title: MB-TaylorFormer:基于泰勒公式扩展的多分支高效Transformer用于图像去雾
title_en: MB-TaylorFormer: Multi-Branch Efficient Transformer Expanded by Taylor Formula for Image Dehazing
abstract: 近年来,由于Transformer网络具有全局感受野和对输入的适应性,它们开始在计算机视觉领域逐步取代纯卷积神经网络(CNNs)。然而,softmax-attention的二次计算复杂度限制了其在图像去雾任务中的广泛应用,尤其是在高分辨率图像中。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新的Transformer变体,通过应用泰勒展开近似softmax-attention,从而实现线性计算复杂度。我们提出了一个多尺度注意力精炼模块作为补充,以纠正泰勒展开的误差。此外,我们向所提出的Transformer引入了一种多分支架构,该架构采用多尺度补丁嵌入,通过不同尺度的重叠可变形卷积来嵌入特征。多尺度补丁嵌入的设计基于三个关键思想:1)感受野的各种尺寸;2)感受野的灵活形状;3)多级语义信息。我们的模型命名为基于泰勒公式扩展的多分支Transformer(MB-TaylorFormer),它在补丁嵌入阶段能够更灵活地嵌入从粗到细的特征,并以有限的计算成本捕捉长距离像素交互。在多个去雾基准测试中,实验结果表明MB-TaylorFormer在轻量级计算负担下实现了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: In recent years, Transformer networks are beginning to replace pure convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in the field of computer vision due to their global receptive field and adaptability to input. However, the quadratic computational complexity of softmax-attention limits the wide application in image dehazing task, especially for high-resolution images. To address this issue, we propose a new Transformer variant, which applies the Taylor expansion to approximate the softmax-attention and achieves linear computational complexity. A multi-scale attention refinement module is proposed as a complement to correct the error of the Taylor expansion. Furthermore, we introduce a multi-branch architecture with multi-scale patch embedding to the proposed Transformer, which embeds features by overlapping deformable convolution of different scales. The design of multi-scale patch embedding is based on three key ideas: 1) various sizes of the receptive field; 2) flexible shapes of the receptive field; 3) multi-level semantic information. Our model, named Multi-branch Transformer expanded by Taylor formula (MB-TaylorFormer), can embed coarse to fine features more flexibly at the patch embedding stage and capture long-distance pixel interactions with limited computational cost. Experimental results on several dehazing benchmarks show that MB-TaylorFormer achieves state-of-the-art performance with a light computational burden.
authors: Yuwei Qiu, Kaihao Zhang, Chenxi Wang, Wenhan Luo, Hongdong Li, Zhi Jin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12802-12813

title: MBPTrack: 通过记忆网络与框先验提升三维点云跟踪
title_en: MBPTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracking with Memory Networks and Box Priors
abstract: 三维单目标跟踪作为自动驾驶等应用中的关键问题,已研究数十年。尽管应用广泛,但该任务仍面临挑战,因跟踪目标间的遮挡和尺寸差异导致显著的外观变化。为解决这些问题,我们提出MBPTrack,采用记忆机制利用历史信息,并通过第一帧提供的框先验制定粗到细的定位方案。具体而言,带有目标性掩码的历史帧作为外部记忆,基于Transformer的模块将跟踪目标提示从记忆传播至当前帧。为精确定位不同尺寸目标,MBPTrack首先通过霍夫投票预测目标中心。利用第一帧提供的框先验,我们自适应地在目标中心周围采样参考点,大致覆盖不同尺寸的目标。随后,通过将点特征聚合至参考点获得密集特征图,从而更有效地进行定位。大量实验表明,MBPTrack在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo Open Dataset上达到最先进性能,且在单块RTX3090 GPU上以50 FPS运行。
abstract_en: 3D single object tracking has been a crucial problem for decades with numerous applications such as autonomous driving. Despite its wide-ranging use, this task remains challenging due to the significant appearance variation caused by occlusion and size differences among tracked targets. To address these issues, we present MBPTrack, which adopts a Memory mechanism to utilize past information and formulates localization in a coarse-to-fine scheme using Box Priors given in the first frame. Specifically, past frames with targetness masks serve as an external memory, and a transformer-based module propagates tracked target cues from the memory to the current frame. To precisely localize objects of all sizes, MBPTrack first predicts the target center via Hough voting. By leveraging box priors given in the first frame, we adaptively sample reference points around the target center that roughly cover the target of different sizes. Then, we obtain dense feature maps by aggregating point features into the reference points, where localization can be performed more effectively. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MBPTrack achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, nuScenes and Waymo Open Dataset, while running at 50 FPS on a single RTX3090 GPU.
authors: Tian-Xing Xu, Yuan-Chen Guo, Yu-Kun Lai, Song-Hai Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9911-9920

title: MDCS:面向长尾识别的更多样化专家与一致性自蒸馏
title_en: MDCS: More Diverse Experts with Consistency Self-distillation for Long-tailed Recognition
abstract: 近期,多专家方法在长尾识别(LTR)中取得了显著提升。我们总结出两个需要进一步增强的方面以促进LTR性能提升:(1)更多样化的专家;(2)更低的模型方差。然而,先前方法未能有效处理这些问题。为此,我们提出More Diverse Experts with Consistency Self-distillation(MDCS),以弥补早期方法的不足。我们的MDCS方法包含两个核心组件:多样性损失(DL)和一致性自蒸馏(CS)。具体而言,DL通过控制专家对不同类别的关注来促进专家多样性。为降低模型方差,我们采用Kullback-Leibler散度蒸馏弱增强实例中更丰富的知识,用于专家的自蒸馏。特别地,我们设计了置信实例采样(CIS)选择正确分类的实例用于CS,以避免偏倚/噪声知识。在分析和消融实验中,我们证明与先前工作相比,我们的方法能有效提升专家多样性,显著降低模型方差,并提高识别准确率。此外,我们的DL和CS作用相互强化且耦合:专家多样性受益于CS,而CS在无DL的情况下无法取得显著效果。实验表明,我们的MDCS在CIFAR10-LT、CIFAR100-LT、ImageNet-LT、Places-LT和iNaturalist 2018等五个流行长尾基准数据集上,超越了最先进的方法1%至2%。代码可在https://github.com/fistyee/MDCS获取。
abstract_en: Recently, multi-expert methods have led to significant improvements in long-tail recognition (LTR). We summarize two aspects that need further enhancement to contribute to LTR boosting: (1) More diverse experts; (2) Lower model variance. However, the previous methods didn't handle them well. To this end, we propose More Diverse experts with Consistency Self-distillation (MDCS) to bridge the gap left by earlier methods. Our MDCS approach consists of two core components: Diversity Loss (DL) and Consistency Self-distillation (CS). In detail, DL promotes diversity among experts by controlling their focus on different categories. To reduce the model variance, we employ KL divergence to distill the richer knowledge of weakly augmented instances for the experts' self-distillation. In particular, we design Confident Instance Sampling (CIS) to select the correctly classified instances for CS to avoid biased/noisy knowledge. In the analysis and ablation study, we demonstrate that our method compared with previous work can effectively increase the diversity of experts, significantly reduce the variance of the model, and improve recognition accuracy. Moreover, the roles of our DL and CS are mutually reinforcing and coupled: the diversity of experts benefits from the CS, and the CS cannot achieve remarkable results without the DL. Experiments show our MDCS outperforms the state-of-the-art by 1%   2% on five popular long-tailed benchmarks, including CIFAR10-LT, CIFAR100-LT, ImageNet-LT, Places-LT, and iNaturalist 2018. The code is available at https://github.com/fistyee/MDCS.
authors: Qihao Zhao, Chen Jiang, Wei Hu, Fan Zhang, Jun Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11597-11608

title: MEFLUT:无监督的一维查找表用于多曝光图像融合
title_en: MEFLUT: Unsupervised 1D Lookup Tables for Multi-exposure Image Fusion
abstract: 本文提出了一种新的高质量多曝光图像融合(MEF)方法。我们证明了曝光的融合权重可以编码为一维查找表(LUT),该查找表以像素强度值为输入,输出融合权重。我们为每个曝光学习一个一维LUT,然后不同曝光的所有像素可以独立查询对应曝光的一维LUT以实现高质量且高效的融合。具体而言,为学习这些一维LUT,我们在帧、通道和空间等多个维度引入注意力机制,从而在当前最先进的方法(SOTA)上实现显著的质量提升。此外,我们收集了一个包含960个样本的新MEF数据集,其中155个样本由专业人士手动调整作为评估的真实值。我们的网络以无监督方式基于该数据集进行训练。通过大量实验验证了所有新提出的组件的有效性,结果表明我们的方法在我们的数据集和另一个代表性数据集SICE上均在定性和定量指标上优于SOTA。此外,我们的1D LUT方法在PC GPU上运行4K图像耗时不足4ms。鉴于其高质量、高效性和鲁棒性,我们的方法已部署到全球多个品牌数百万台Android手机中。代码可在https://github.com/Hedlen/MEFLUT获取。
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce a new approach for high-quality multi-exposure image fusion (MEF). We show that the fusion weights of an exposure can be encoded into a 1D lookup table (LUT), which takes pixel intensity value as input and produces fusion weight as output. We learn one 1D LUT for each exposure, then all the pixels from different exposures can query 1D LUT of that exposure independently for high-quality and efficient fusion. Specifically, to learn these 1D LUTs, we involve attention mechanism in various dimensions including frame, channel and spatial ones into the MEF task so as to bring us significant quality improvement over the state-of-the-art (SOTA). In addition, we collect a new MEF dataset consisting of 960 samples, 155 of which are manually tuned by professionals as ground-truth for evaluation. Our network is trained by this dataset in an unsupervised manner. Extensive experiments are conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of all the newly proposed components, and results show that our approach outperforms the SOTA in our and another representative dataset SICE, both qualitatively and quantitatively. Moreover, our 1D LUT approach takes less than 4ms to run a 4K image on a PC GPU. Given its high quality, efficiency and robustness, our method has been shipped into millions of Android mobiles across multiple brands world-wide. Code is available at: https://github.com/Hedlen/MEFLUT.
authors: Ting Jiang, Chuan Wang, Xinpeng Li, Ru Li, Haoqiang Fan, Shuaicheng Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10542-10551

title: MEGA:面向电影视频分割的多模态对齐聚合与蒸馏
title_en: MEGA: Multimodal Alignment Aggregation and Distillation For Cinematic Video Segmentation
abstract: 先前研究已探讨将电影视频分割为场景和叙事片段的任务。然而,这些研究忽视了处理长视频(>60分钟)时多模态对齐与融合这一关键任务。本文提出多模态对齐聚合与蒸馏(MEGA)方法,用于电影长视频分割。MEGA通过利用多种媒体模态应对该挑战。该方法采用对齐位置编码粗略对齐不同长度和模态的输入。为在减少计算量的同时保持时间同步,我们进一步引入了增强型瓶颈融合层,该层使用时间对齐技术。此外,MEGA采用新颖的对比损失,在模态间同步并迁移标签,从而实现从标注的剧情句子到视频镜头的片段分割。实验结果表明,MEGA在MovieNet数据集上的场景分割任务中优于现有方法(平均精度提升+1.19%),在TRIPOD数据集上的片段分割任务中表现更优(总一致性提升+5.51%)。
abstract_en: Previous research has studied the task of segmenting cinematic videos into scenes and into narrative acts. However, these studies have overlooked the essential task of multimodal alignment and fusion for effectively and efficiently processing long-form videos (>60min). In this paper, we introduce Multimodal alignmEnt aGgregation and distillAtion (MEGA) for cinematic long-video segmentation. MEGA tackles the challenge by leveraging multiple media modalities. The method coarsely aligns inputs of variable lengths and different modalities with alignment positional encoding. To maintain temporal synchronization while reducing computation, we further introduce an enhanced bottleneck fusion layer which uses temporal alignment. Additionally, MEGA employs a novel contrastive loss to synchronize and transfer labels across modalities, enabling act segmentation from labeled synopsis sentences on video shots. Our experimental results show that MEGA outperforms state-of-the-art methods on MovieNet dataset for scene segmentation (with an Average Precision improvement of +1.19%) and on TRIPOD dataset for act segmentation (with a Total Agreement improvement of +5.51%).
authors: Najmeh Sadoughi, Xinyu Li, Avijit Vajpayee, David Fan, Bing Shuai, Hector Santos-Villalobos, Vimal Bhat, Rohith MV ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23331-23340

title: MGMAE:运动引导的视频掩码自编码
title_en: MGMAE: Motion Guided Masking for Video Masked Autoencoding
abstract: 掩码自编码在自监督视频表示学习中表现出色。时间冗余导致VideoMAE具有较高的掩码比率和定制化掩码策略。本文旨在通过引入运动引导的掩码策略进一步提升视频掩码自编码性能。我们的核心洞察是运动是视频中通用且独特的先验信息,在掩码预训练过程中应加以考虑。我们的运动引导掩码策略通过显式融合运动信息构建时间一致的掩码体。基于该掩码体,我们可在时间维度追踪未掩码标记并从视频中采样一组时间一致的立方体。这些时间对齐的未掩码标记将进一步缓解时间维度的信息泄露问题,并鼓励MGMAE学习更多有用的结构信息。我们采用在线高效的光流估计器和反向掩码图变形策略实现MGMAE。在Something-Something V2和Kinetics-400数据集上的实验表明,MGMAE相比原始VideoMAE具有优越性能。此外,我们提供了可视化分析以说明MGMAE能够以运动自适应方式采样时间一致的立方体,从而实现更有效的视频预训练。
abstract_en: Masked autoencoding has shown excellent performance on self-supervised video representation learning. Temporal redundancy has led to a high masking ratio and customized masking strategy in VideoMAE. In this paper, we aim to further improve the performance of video masked autoencoding by introducing a motion guided masking strategy. Our key insight is that motion is a general and unique prior in video, which should be taken into account during masked pre-training. Our motion guided masking explicitly incorporates motion information to build temporal consistent masking volume. Based on this masking volume, we can track the unmasked tokens in time and sample a set of temporal consistent cubes from videos. These temporal aligned unmasked tokens will further relieve the information leakage issue in time and encourage the MGMAE to learn more useful structure information. We implement our MGMAE with an online efficient optical flow estimator and backward masking map warping strategy. We perform experiments on the datasets of Something-Something V2 and Kinetics-400, demonstrating the superior performance of our MGMAE to the original VideoMAE. In addition, we provide the visualization analysis to illustrate that our MGMAE can sample temporal consistent cubes in a motion-adaptive manner for more effective video pre-training.
authors: Bingkun Huang, Zhiyu Zhao, Guozhen Zhang, Yu Qiao, Limin Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13493-13504

title: MHCN:一种用于多视角层次聚类的双曲神经网络模型
title_en: MHCN: A Hyperbolic Neural Network Model for Multi-view Hierarchical Clustering
abstract: 多视角层次聚类(MCHC)在理解多视角数据中的结构方面起着关键作用,其核心在于多视角特征学习与综合表征学习之间的有效交互。然而,现有方法常因采用简单的启发式凝聚策略或解耦多视角表征学习与层次建模,而忽视了这种交互关系,导致表征学习不足。为解决这些问题,本文提出了一种新型多视角层次聚类网络(MHCN)模型,通过同时进行多视角学习与层次建模。具体而言,为揭示所有视角间的高效树状结构,我们推导出多个双曲自编码器,其潜在空间映射至Poincare球。随后,相应的双曲嵌入进一步进行正则化,以实现多视角表征学习原则,既涵盖视角共性信息,也包含视角私有信息,并通过平衡的层次结构确保双曲均匀性,从而提升可解释性。在真实世界和合成多视角数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法能够实现最先进的层次聚类性能,并赋予聚类结果良好的可解释性。
abstract_en: Multi-view hierarchical clustering (MCHC) plays a pivotal role in comprehending the structures within multi-view data, which hinges on the skillful interaction between hierarchical feature learning and comprehensive representation learning across multiple views. However, existing methods often overlook this interplay due to the simple heuristic agglomerative strategies or the decoupling of multi-view representation learning and hierarchical modeling, thus leading to insufficient representation learning. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel Multi-view Hierarchical Clustering Network (MHCN) model by performing simultaneous multi-view learning and hierarchy modeling. Specifically, to uncover efficient tree-like structures among all views, we derive multiple hyperbolic autoencoders with latent space mapped onto the Poincare ball. Then, the corresponding hyperbolic embeddings are further regularized to achieve the multi-view representation learning principles for both view-common and view-private information, and to ensure hyperbolic uniformity with a well-balanced hierarchy for better interpretability. Extensive experiments on real-world and synthetic multi-view datasets have demonstrated that our method can achieve state-of-the-art hierarchical clustering performance, and empower the clustering results with good interpretability.
authors: Fangfei Lin, Bing Bai, Yiwen Guo, Hao Chen, Yazhou Ren, Zenglin Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16525-16535

title: MHEntropy: 熵与多假设结合的姿态与形状恢复
title_en: MHEntropy: Entropy Meets Multiple Hypotheses for Pose and Shape Recovery
abstract: 对于基于单目RGB的3D姿态与形状估计,由于遮挡和截断等因素,通常存在多种可行解。本文提出了一种多假设概率框架,通过优化数据分布与模型分布之间的Kullback-Leibler散度(KLD)来实现。我们的公式揭示了姿态熵与多假设多样性之间的联系,这一联系被先前研究忽视。为全面评估,除了最佳假设(BH)指标外,我们还引入可见性指标来评估多样性。此外,我们的框架具有标签友好性,能够仅从部分可见的2D关键点中进行学习。在模糊和真实世界基准数据集上的实验表明,我们的方法在全面评估中优于其他最先进的多假设方法。项目页面地址为:https://gloryyrolg.github.io/MHEntropy
abstract_en: For monocular RGB-based 3D pose and shape estimation, multiple solutions are often feasible due to factors like occlusion and truncation. This work presents a multi-hypothesis probabilistic framework by optimizing the Kullback-Leibler divergence (KLD) between the data and model distribution. Our formulation reveals a connection between the pose entropy and diversity in the multiple hypotheses that has been neglected by previous works. For a comprehensive evaluation, besides the best hypothesis (BH) metric, we factor in visibility for evaluating diversity. Additionally, our framework is label-friendly, in that it can be learned from only partial 2D keypoints, e.g., those that are visible. Experiments on both ambiguous and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms other state-of-the-art multi-hypothesis methods in a comprehensive evaluation. The project page is at https://gloryyrolg.github.io/MHEntropy.
authors: Rongyu Chen, Linlin Yang, Angela Yao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14840-14849

title: MI-GAN:面向移动设备的图像修复简易基线
title_en: MI-GAN: A Simple Baseline for Image Inpainting on Mobile Devices
abstract: 近年来,研究社区开发了许多基于深度学习的图像修复方法。其中一些方法展现了令人印象深刻的图像补全能力。然而,据我们所知,目前尚无专门设计用于移动设备运行的图像修复模型。本文提出了一种简单的图像修复基线模型——移动图像修复生成对抗网络(Mobile Inpainting GAN,简称MI-GAN)。该模型在计算成本上比现有最先进的图像修复模型低一个数量级,且模型体积更小,可高效部署于移动设备。大量的定量和定性评估表明,MI-GAN的性能与近期最先进的方法相当,甚至在某些情况下更优。此外,我们通过用户研究将MI-GAN的修复结果与多个商业移动图像修复应用的结果进行对比,结果清晰地展示了MI-GAN相较于现有应用的优势。为了实现高质量且高效的图像修复,我们采用了一种有效的对抗训练、模型重参数化和知识蒸馏的组合策略。我们的模型和代码已公开在https://github.com/Picsart-AI-Research/MI-GAN。
abstract_en: In recent years, many deep learning based image inpainting methods have been developed by the research community. Some of those methods have shown impressive image completion abilities. Yet, to the best of our knowledge, there is no image inpainting model designed to run on mobile devices. In this paper we present a simple image inpainting baseline, Mobile Inpainting GAN (MI-GAN), which is approximately one order of magnitude computationally cheaper and smaller than existing state-of-the-art inpainting models, and can be efficiently deployed on mobile devices. Excessive quantitative and qualitative evaluations show that MI-GAN performs comparable or, in some cases, better than recent state-of-the-art approaches. Moreover, we perform a user study comparing MI-GAN results with results from several commercial mobile inpainting applications, which clearly shows the advantage of MI-GAN in comparison to existing apps. With the purpose of high quality and efficient inpainting, we utilize an effective combination of adversarial training, model re-parametrization, and knowledge distillation. Our models and code are publicly available at https://github.com/Picsart-AI-Research/MI-GAN.
authors: Andranik Sargsyan, Shant Navasardyan, Xingqian Xu, Humphrey Shi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7335-7345

title: MIMO-NeRF:基于多输入多输出神经辐射场的快速神经渲染
title_en: MIMO-NeRF: Fast Neural Rendering with Multi-input Multi-output Neural Radiance Fields
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRFs)在新视角合成任务中展现出显著效果。然而,它们依赖于重复使用单输入单输出多层感知机(SISO MLP),该模型以样本级方式将3D坐标和视角方向映射到颜色和体密度,这导致渲染速度变慢。我们提出了一种多输入多输出NeRF(MIMO-NeRF),通过用MIMO MLP替代SISO MLP,并按组方式进行映射,从而减少运行的MLP数量。该方法的一个显著挑战是,同一组中不同输入坐标的选取会导致每个点的颜色和体密度出现差异,从而产生一定的歧义。我们还提出了一种自监督学习方法,通过多个快速重构的MLPs对MIMO MLP进行正则化,以缓解这种歧义且无需使用预训练模型。通过包含对比实验和消融研究的综合实验评估,结果表明MIMO-NeRF在合理训练时间内实现了速度与质量的良好平衡。我们进一步验证了MIMO-NeRF与先前NeRF进展的兼容性与互补性,将其应用于两个代表性快速NeRF,即带有采样网络的NeRF(DONeRF)和带有替代表示的NeRF(TensoRF)。
abstract_en: Neural radiance fields (NeRFs) have shown impressive results for novel view synthesis. However, they depend on the repetitive use of a single-input single-output multilayer perceptron (SISO MLP) that maps 3D coordinates and view direction to the color and volume density in a sample-wise manner, which slows the rendering. We propose a multi-input multi-output NeRF (MIMO-NeRF) that reduces the number of MLPs running by replacing the SISO MLP with a MIMO MLP and conducting mappings in a group-wise manner. One notable challenge with this approach is that the color and volume density of each point can differ according to a choice of input coordinates in a group, which can lead to some notable ambiguity. We also propose a self-supervised learning method that regularizes the MIMO MLP with multiple fast reformulated MLPs to alleviate this ambiguity without using pretrained models. The results of a comprehensive experimental evaluation including comparative and ablation studies are presented to show that MIMO-NeRF obtains a good trade-off between speed and quality with a reasonable training time. We then demonstrate that MIMO-NeRF is compatible with and complementary to previous advancements in NeRFs by applying it to two representative fast NeRFs, i.e., a NeRF with a sampling network (DONeRF) and a NeRF with alternative representations (TensoRF).
authors: Takuhiro Kaneko ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3273-3283

title: MMST-ViT:基于多模态时空视觉Transformer的气候变化感知作物产量预测
title_en: MMST-ViT: Climate Change-aware Crop Yield Prediction via Multi-Modal Spatial-Temporal Vision Transformer
abstract: 精确的作物产量预测为农业规划和决策过程提供了重要信息。然而,及时预测作物产量仍具有挑战性,因为作物生长对生长季气象变化和气候变化高度敏感。在本工作中,我们开发了一种基于深度学习的解决方案,即多模态时空视觉Transformer(MMST-ViT),用于预测美国各郡的作物产量。该方法通过考虑生长季短期气象变化和长期气候变化对作物的影响。具体而言,我们的MMST-ViT由多模态Transformer、空间Transformer和时间Transformer组成。多模态Transformer利用视觉遥感数据和短期气象数据,建模生长季气象变化对作物生长的影响。空间Transformer学习郡级高分辨率空间依赖关系以实现精准农业追踪。时间Transformer捕捉长程时间依赖关系,以学习长期气候变化对作物的影响。同时,我们还设计了一种新颖的多模态对比学习技术,无需大量人工监督即可预训练模型。因此,我们的MMST-ViT通过结合卫星图像和气象数据,捕捉了短期气象变化和长期气候变化对作物的双重影响。我们在美国200多个郡进行了广泛实验,实验结果表明,我们的MMST-ViT在三个关注的性能指标上均优于其他方法。
abstract_en: Precise crop yield prediction provides valuable information for agricultural planning and decision-making processes. However, timely predicting crop yields remains challenging as crop growth is sensitive to growing season weather variation and climate change. In this work, we develop a deep learning-based solution, namely Multi-Modal Spatial-Temporal Vision Transformer (MMST-ViT), for predicting crop yields at the county level across the United States, by considering the effects of short-term meteorological variations during the growing season and the long-term climate change on crops. Specifically, our MMST-ViT consists of a Multi-Modal Transformer, a Spatial Transformer, and a Temporal Transformer. The Multi-Modal Transformer leverages both visual remote sensing data and short-term meteorological data for modeling the effect of growing season weather variations on crop growth. The Spatial Transformer learns the high-resolution spatial dependency among counties for accurate agricultural tracking. The Temporal Transformer captures the long-range temporal dependency for learning the impact of long-term climate change on crops. Meanwhile, we also devise a novel multi-modal contrastive learning technique to pre-train our model without extensive human supervision. Hence, our MMST-ViT captures the impacts of both short-term weather variations and long-term climate change on crops by leveraging both satellite images and meteorological data. We have conducted extensive experiments on over 200 counties in the United States, with the experimental results exhibiting that our MMST-ViT outperforms its counterparts under three performance metrics of interest.
authors: Fudong Lin, Summer Crawford, Kaleb Guillot, Yihe Zhang, Yan Chen, Xu Yuan, Li Chen, Shelby Williams, Robert Minvielle, Xiangming Xiao, Drew Gholson, Nicolas Ashwell, Tri Setiyono, Brenda Tubana, Lu Peng, Magdy Bayoumi, Nian-Feng Tzeng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5774-5784

title: 基于运动矩阵的视频预测(MMVP)
title_en: MMVP: Motion-Matrix-Based Video Prediction
abstract: 视频预测的核心挑战在于系统需要从图像帧推断物体的未来运动,同时保持其外观在帧间的一致性。本文提出了一种端到端可训练的双流视频预测框架——基于运动矩阵的视频预测(MMVP),以解决这一挑战。与以往通常在相同模块中处理运动预测和外观维护的方法不同,MMVP通过构建外观无关的运动矩阵来分离运动与外观信息。运动矩阵表示输入帧中每对特征块的时间相似性,并作为MMVP中运动预测模块的唯一输入。该设计在准确性和效率上均提升了视频预测性能,同时减少了模型规模。大量实验结果表明,MMVP在显著更小的模型尺寸(84%或更小)下,于公开数据集上显著优于现有系统(在PSNR、UCF Sports等指标上提升约1分贝)。请参考https://github.com/Kay1794/MMVP-motion-matrix-based-video-prediction获取官方代码及本文使用的数据集。
abstract_en: A central challenge of video prediction lies where the system has to reason the object's future motion from image frames while simultaneously maintaining the consistency of its appearance across frames. This work introduces an end-to-end trainable two-stream video prediction framework, Motion-Matrix-based Video Prediction (MMVP), to tackle this challenge. Unlike previous methods that usually handle motion prediction and appearance maintenance within the same set of modules, MMVP decouples motion and appearance information by constructing appearance-agnostic motion matrices. The motion matrices represent the temporal similarity of each and every pair of feature patches in the input frames, and are the sole input of the motion prediction module in MMVP. This design improves video prediction in both accuracy and efficiency, and reduces the model size. Results of extensive experiments demonstrate that MMVP outperforms state-of-the-art systems on public data sets by non-negligible large margins (approx. 1 db in PSNR, UCF Sports) in significantly smaller model sizes (84% the size or smaller). Please refer to https://github.com/Kay1794/MMVP-motion-matrix-based-video-prediction for the official code and the datasets used in this paper.
authors: Yiqi Zhong, Luming Liang, Ilya Zharkov, Ulrich Neumann ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4273-4283

title: MODA:基于双注意力机制的一次映射音频驱动肖像动画
title_en: MODA: Mapping-Once Audio-driven Portrait Animation with Dual Attentions
abstract: 音频驱动的肖像动画旨在合成由给定音频条件驱动的肖像视频。对高保真和多模态视频肖像进行动画制作具有多种应用。先前方法尝试通过训练不同模型或从给定视频中采样信号来捕捉不同运动模式并生成高保真肖像视频。然而,缺乏唇同步与其他运动(如头部姿态/眨眼)之间的关联学习通常会导致不自然的结果。在本文中,我们提出了一种用于多人、多样化和高保真对话肖像生成的统一系统。我们的方法包含三个阶段,即1)带有双注意力机制的一次映射网络(MODA)从给定音频中生成对话表示。在MODA中,我们设计了一个双注意力模块,以编码精确的口部运动和多种模态。2)面部合成网络生成密集且详细的面部关键点,3)时间引导的渲染合成稳定视频。广泛评估表明,所提出的系统生成的视频肖像比先前方法更加自然且逼真。
abstract_en: Audio-driven portrait animation aims to synthesize portrait videos that are conditioned by given audio. Animating high-fidelity and multimodal video portraits has a variety of applications. Previous methods have attempted to capture different motion modes and generate high-fidelity portrait videos by training different models or sampling signals from given videos. However, lacking correlation learning between lip-sync and other movements (e.g., head pose/eye blinking) usually leads to unnatural results. In this paper, we propose a unified system for multi-person, diverse, and high-fidelity talking portrait generation. Our method contains three stages, i.e., 1) Mapping-Once network with Dual Attentions (MODA) generates talking representation from given audio. In MODA, we design a dual-attention module to encode accurate mouth movements and diverse modalities. 2) Facial composer network generates dense and detailed face landmarks, and 3) temporal-guided render syntheses stable videos. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that the proposed system produces more natural and realistic video portraits compared to previous methods.
authors: Yunfei Liu, Lijian Lin, Fei Yu, Changyin Zhou, Yu Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23020-23029

title: MOSE:一种用于复杂场景视频对象分割的新数据集
title_en: MOSE: A New Dataset for Video Object Segmentation in Complex Scenes
abstract: 视频对象分割(VOS)旨在对视频片段序列中的特定对象进行分割。最先进的VOS方法在现有数据集上已取得优异性能(例如,90%以上的J&F)。然而,由于现有数据集中的目标对象通常相对显著、主导且孤立,复杂场景下的VOS研究较少。为重新审视VOS并使其更适用于现实世界,我们收集了一个新的VOS数据集,称为复杂视频对象分割(MOSE),以研究复杂环境中的对象跟踪与分割。MOSE包含来自36个类别的2,149个视频片段和5,200个对象,共431,725个高质量对象分割掩膜。MOSE数据集最显著的特征是包含密集和遮挡对象的复杂场景。视频中的目标对象常被其他对象遮挡,并在某些帧中消失。为分析提出的MOSE数据集,我们在该数据集上对18种现有VOS方法进行了4种不同设置的基准测试,并进行了全面比较。实验表明,当前VOS算法在复杂场景中难以准确感知对象。例如,在半监督VOS设置下,现有最先进的VOS方法在MOSE上的最高J&F仅为59.4%,远低于其在DAVIS上的90% J&F性能。结果表明,尽管在现有基准上已取得优异性能,但在复杂场景下仍存在未解决的挑战,未来需要更多努力探索这些挑战。
abstract_en: Video object segmentation (VOS) aims at segmenting a particular object throughout the entire video clip sequence. The state-of-the-art VOS methods have achieved excellent performance (e.g., 90+% J&F) on existing datasets. However, since the target objects in these existing datasets are usually relatively salient, dominant, and isolated, VOS under complex scenes has rarely been studied. To revisit VOS and make it more applicable in the real world, we collect a new VOS dataset called coMplex video Object SEgmentation (MOSE) to study the tracking and segmenting objects in complex environments. MOSE contains 2,149 video clips and 5,200 objects from 36 categories, with 431,725 high-quality object segmentation masks. The most notable feature of MOSE dataset is complex scenes with crowded and occluded objects. The target objects in the videos are commonly occluded by others and disappear in some frames. To analyze the proposed MOSE dataset, we benchmark 18 existing VOS methods under 4 different settings on the proposed MOSE dataset and conduct comprehensive comparisons. The experiments show that current VOS algorithms cannot well perceive objects in complex scenes. For example, under the semi-supervised VOS setting, the highest J&F by existing state-of-the-art VOS methods is only 59.4% on MOSE, much lower than their  90% J&F performance on DAVIS. The results reveal that although excellent performance has been achieved on existing benchmarks, there are unresolved challenges under complex scenes and more efforts are desired to explore these challenges in the future.
authors: Henghui Ding, Chang Liu, Shuting He, Xudong Jiang, Philip H.S. Torr, Song Bai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20224-20234

title: MOST:基于自监督Transformer的多物体定位与物体发现
title_en: MOST: Multiple Object Localization with Self-Supervised Transformers for Object Discovery
abstract: 本文针对具有挑战性的无监督物体定位任务进行了研究。近期研究表明,通过自监督学习训练的Transformer模型即使未专门针对该任务进行训练,也表现出物体定位属性。本文提出Multiple Object localization with Self-supervised Transformers(MOST)方法,利用自监督学习训练的Transformer模型特征,实现现实世界图像中多个物体的定位。MOST通过盒计数法对特征相似性图进行分析,这是一种分形分析工具,用于识别位于前景块上的标记。识别出的标记随后被聚类,每个聚类的标记用于生成前景区域的边界框。与近期最先进的物体定位方法不同,MOST能够对单张图像进行多物体定位,并在PASCAL-VOC 07、12和COCO20k数据集上的多个物体定位与发现基准测试中超越当前最先进的算法(SOTA)。此外,我们证明MOST可用于物体检测器的自监督预训练,并在全监督、半监督物体检测和无监督区域提议生成中取得一致性能提升。本项目已公开在rssaketh.github.io/most。
abstract_en: We tackle the challenging task of unsupervised object localization in this work. Recently, transformers trained with self-supervised learning have been shown to exhibit object localization properties without being trained for this task. In this work, we present Multiple Object localization with Self-supervised Transformers (MOST) that uses features of transformers trained using self-supervised learning to localize multiple objects in real world images. MOST analyzes the similarity maps of the features using box counting; a fractal analysis tool to identify tokens lying on foreground patches. The identified tokens are then clustered together, and tokens of each cluster are used to generate bounding boxes on foreground regions. Unlike recent state-of-the-art object localization methods, MOST can localize multiple objects per image and outperforms SOTA algorithms on several object localization and discovery benchmarks on PASCAL-VOC 07, 12 and COCO20k datasets. Additionally, we show that MOST can be used for self-supervised pretraining of object detectors, and yields consistent improvements on fully, semi-supervised object detection and unsupervised region proposal generation.Our project is publicly available at rssaketh.github.io/most.
authors: Sai Saketh Rambhatla, Ishan Misra, Rama Chellappa, Abhinav Shrivastava ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15823-15834

title: MPCViT:基于异构注意力的多方安全计算友好型视觉Transformer搜索
title_en: MPCViT: Searching for Accurate and Efficient MPC-Friendly Vision Transformer with Heterogeneous Attention
abstract: 多方安全计算(MPC)能够在加密数据上直接进行计算,保护深度学习推理中的数据和模型隐私。然而,现有神经网络架构(包括视觉Transformer(ViTs))并未针对MPC进行设计或优化,导致显著的延迟开销。我们观察到Softmax由于高通信复杂度成为主要延迟瓶颈,但可以通过选择性替换或线性化处理而不影响模型精度。因此,本文提出一种MPC友好的视觉Transformer(MPCViT),以实现准确且高效的MPC推理。基于对Softmax注意力及其他注意力变体的系统延迟和精度评估,我们提出异构注意力优化空间。同时开发了一种简单而有效的MPC感知神经架构搜索算法,用于快速帕累托优化。为进一步提升推理效率,我们提出MPCViT+,联合优化Softmax注意力及其他网络组件(如GeLU、矩阵乘法等)。大量实验表明,MPCViT在Tiny-ImageNet数据集上相比基线ViT、MPCFormer和THE-X分别实现1.9%、1.3%和3.6%的精度提升,同时延迟降低6.2x、2.9x和1.9x。MPCViT+相比MPCViT进一步实现了更优的帕累托前沿。评估代码和模型可在https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/mpcvit获取。
abstract_en: Secure multi-party computation (MPC) enables computation directly on encrypted data and protects both data and model privacy in deep learning inference. However, existing neural network architectures, including Vision Transformers (ViTs), are not designed or optimized for MPC and incur significant latency overhead. We observe Softmax accounts for the major latency bottleneck due to a high communication complexity, but can be selectively replaced or linearized without compromising the model accuracy. Hence, in this paper, we propose an MPC-friendly ViT, dubbed MPCViT, to enable accurate yet efficient ViT inference in MPC. Based on a systematic latency and accuracy evaluation of the Softmax attention and other attention variants, we propose a heterogeneous attention optimization space. We also develop a simple yet effective MPC-aware neural architecture search algorithm for fast Pareto optimization. To further boost the inference efficiency, we propose MPCViT+, to jointly optimize the Softmax attention and other network components, including GeLU, matrix multiplication, etc. With extensive experiments, we demonstrate that MPCViT achieves 1.9%, 1.3% and 3.6% higher accuracy with 6.2x, 2.9x and 1.9x latency reduction compared with baseline ViT, MPCFormer and THE-X on the Tiny-ImageNet dataset, respectively. MPCViT+ further achieves a better Pareto front compared with MPCViT. The code and models for evaluation are available at https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/mpcvit.
authors: Wenxuan Zeng, Meng Li, Wenjie Xiong, Tong Tong, Wen-jie Lu, Jin Tan, Runsheng Wang, Ru Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5052-5063

title: MPI-Flow:基于多平面图像的学习真实光流
title_en: MPI-Flow: Learning Realistic Optical Flow with Multiplane Images
abstract: 基于学习的光流估计模型的准确性严重依赖于训练数据集的真实性。当前生成此类数据集的方法要么采用合成数据,要么生成真实感有限的图像。然而,这些数据与真实场景之间的域差距限制了训练模型在真实场景应用中的泛化能力。为解决这一问题,我们研究从真实场景图像生成真实光流数据集的方法。首先,为生成高度真实的新型图像,我们从单视角图像构建分层深度表示,即多平面图像(MPI)。这使我们能够生成高度真实的新型视角图像。为生成与新型图像准确对应的光流图,我们利用相机矩阵和平面深度计算每个平面的光流。随后通过体积渲染将这些分层光流投影到输出光流图中。其次,为确保运动的真实性,我们提出独立物体运动模块,可分离MPI中的相机运动与动态物体运动。该模块解决了基于MPI的单视角方法的缺陷,即仅通过相机运动生成光流而不考虑物体运动。我们还设计了深度感知修复模块,用于融合包含动态物体的新图像并解决不自然的运动遮挡。通过在真实场景数据集上的大量实验验证了我们方法的优越性。此外,我们的方法在基于学习模型的无监督和监督训练中均达到最先进性能。代码将公开在:https://github.com/Sharpiless/MPI-Flow
abstract_en: The accuracy of learning-based optical flow estimation models heavily relies on the realism of the training datasets. Current approaches for generating such datasets either employ synthetic data or generate images with limited realism. However, the domain gap of these data with real-world scenes constrains the generalization of the trained model to real-world applications. To address this issue, we investigate generating realistic optical flow datasets from real-world images. Firstly, to generate highly realistic new images, we construct a layered depth representation, known as multiplane images (MPI), from single-view images. This allows us to generate novel view images that are highly realistic. To generate optical flow maps that correspond accurately to the new image, we calculate the optical flows of each plane using the camera matrix and plane depths. We then project these layered optical flows into the output optical flow map with volume rendering. Secondly, to ensure the realism of motion, we present an independent object motion module that can separate the camera and dynamic object motion in MPI. This module addresses the deficiency in MPI-based single-view methods, where optical flow is generated only by camera motion and does not account for any object movement. We additionally devise a depth-aware inpainting module to merge new images with dynamic objects and address unnatural motion occlusions. We show the superior performance of our method through extensive experiments on real-world datasets. Moreover, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance in both unsupervised and supervised training of learning-based models. The code will be made publicly available at: https://github.com/Sharpiless/MPI-Flow.
authors: Yingping Liang, Jiaming Liu, Debing Zhang, Ying Fu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13857-13868

title: MRM:基于遗传学的医学图像预训练掩码关系建模
title_en: MRM: Masked Relation Modeling for Medical Image Pre-Training with Genetics
abstract: 现代深度学习技术在自动多模态医学诊断中的应用依赖于大量专家标注,这既耗时又难以实现。近期基于掩码图像建模(MIM)的预训练方法在从无标签数据中学习有意义表示并迁移到下游任务方面取得了显著进展。然而,这些方法主要针对自然图像,忽视了医学数据的特定属性,导致在下游医学诊断任务中泛化性能不佳。本文旨在利用遗传学提升图像预训练,提出一种掩码关系建模(MRM)框架。与先前MIM方法通过显式掩码输入数据导致疾病相关语义丢失不同,我们设计关系掩码以在自模态和跨模态层面掩码token级特征关系,从而保留输入中的完整语义并使模型学习丰富的疾病相关信息。此外,为增强语义关系建模,我们提出关系匹配以对齐完整特征与掩码特征的样本级关系。关系匹配通过在特征空间中鼓励全局约束来利用样本间关系,从而为特征表示生成充分的语义关系。大量实验表明,所提出的框架简单而强大,在多种下游诊断任务中均达到最先进的迁移性能。
abstract_en: Modern deep learning techniques on automatic multimodal medical diagnosis rely on massive expert annotations, which is time-consuming and prohibitive. Recent masked image modeling (MIM)-based pre-training methods have witnessed impressive advances for learning meaningful representations from unlabeled data and transferring to downstream tasks. However, these methods focus on natural images and ignore the specific properties of medical data, yielding unsatisfying generalization performance on downstream medical diagnosis. In this paper, we aim to leverage genetics to boost image pre-training and present a masked relation modeling (MRM) framework. Instead of explicitly masking input data in previous MIM methods leading to loss of disease-related semantics, we design relation masking to mask out token-wise feature relation in both self- and cross-modality levels, which preserves intact semantics within the input and allows the model to learn rich disease-related information. Moreover, to enhance semantic relation modeling, we propose relation matching to align the sample-wise relation between the intact and masked features. The relation matching exploits inter-sample relation by encouraging global constraints in the feature space to render sufficient semantic relation for feature representation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework is simple yet powerful, achieving state-of-the-art transfer performance on various downstream diagnosis tasks.
authors: Qiushi Yang, Wuyang Li, Baopu Li, Yixuan Yuan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21452-21462

title: MRN:用于增量多语言文本识别的多路复用路由网络
title_en: MRN: Multiplexed Routing Network for Incremental Multilingual Text Recognition
abstract: 多语言文本识别(MLTR)系统通常专注于固定语言集,这使得处理新增语言或适应不断变化的数据分布变得困难。本文在增量学习(IL)的背景下提出增量MLTR(IMLTR)任务,其中不同语言按批次引入。IMLTR由于回放不平衡问题而极具挑战性,这指的是回放集中样本字符分布不均,用于保留少量旧数据作为过去记忆。为解决这一问题,我们提出多路复用路由网络(MRN)。MRN为每个当前看到的语言训练一个识别器,随后基于回放集学习语言域预测器以加权识别器。由于识别器源自原始数据,MRN有效减少了对旧数据的依赖,更好地应对灾难性遗忘这一IL核心问题。我们在MLT17和MLT19数据集上广泛评估MRN,结果表明其在不同设置下平均准确率提升幅度达10.3%至35.8%,显著优于现有通用IL方法。代码可在https://github.com/simplify23/MRN获取。
abstract_en: Multilingual text recognition (MLTR) systems typically focus on a fixed set of languages, which makes it difficult to handle newly added languages or adapt to ever-changing data distribution. In this paper, we propose the Incremental MLTR (IMLTR) task in the context of incremental learning (IL), where different languages are introduced in batches. IMLTR is particularly challenging due to rehearsal-imbalance, which refers to the uneven distribution of sample characters in the rehearsal set, used to retain a small amount of old data as past memories. To address this issue, we propose a Multiplexed Routing Network (MRN). MRN trains a recognizer for each language that is currently seen. Subsequently, a language domain predictor is learned based on the rehearsal set to weigh the recognizers. Since the recognizers are derived from the original data, MRN effectively reduces the reliance on older data and better fights against catastrophic forgetting, the core issue in IL. We extensively evaluate MRN on MLT17 and MLT19 datasets. It outperforms existing general-purpose IL methods by large margins, with average accuracy improvements ranging from 10.3% to 35.8% under different settings. Code is available at https://github.com/simplify23/MRN.
authors: Tianlun Zheng, Zhineng Chen, Bingchen Huang, Wei Zhang, Yu-Gang Jiang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18644-18653

title: MSI:最大化支持集信息用于少样本分割
title_en: MSI: Maximize Support-Set Information for Few-Shot Segmentation
abstract: 少样本分割(FSS)旨在使用少量标注图像(支持集)对目标类别进行分割。为提取与目标类别相关的信息,当前最优FSS方法的主流策略是通过支持掩码剔除背景特征。我们观察到,这种通过限制性支持掩码进行的特征剔除会在某些具有挑战性的FSS案例中引入信息瓶颈,例如小目标和/或不准确的目标边界。为此,我们提出了一种新颖方法(MSI),通过利用两个互补的特征来源生成超相关图谱,从而最大化支持集信息。我们将该方法实例化到三种近期强效的FSS方法中以验证其有效性。在多个公开FSS基准数据集上的实验结果表明,所提方法在性能上实现了显著提升,并加速了收敛过程。我们的代码和训练模型可在:https://github.com/moonsh/MSI-Maximize-Support-Set-Information 获取。
abstract_en: FSS (Few-shot segmentation) aims to segment a target class using a small number of labeled images (support set). To extract the information relevant to target class, a dominant approach in best performing FSS methods removes background features using a support mask. We observe that this feature excision through a limiting support mask introduces an information bottleneck in several challenging FSS cases, e.g., for small targets and/or inaccurate target boundaries. To this end, we present a novel method (MSI), which maximizes the support-set information by exploiting two complementary sources of features to generate super correlation maps. We validate the effectiveness of our approach by instantiating it into three recent and strong FSS methods. Experimental results on several publicly available FSS benchmarks show that our proposed method consistently improves performance by visible margins and leads to faster convergence. Our code and trained models are available at: https://github.com/moonsh/MSI-Maximize-Support-Set-Information
authors: Seonghyeon Moon, Samuel S. Sohn, Honglu Zhou, Sejong Yoon, Vladimir Pavlovic, Muhammad Haris Khan, Mubbasir Kapadia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19266-19276

title: MST压缩:基于最小生成树的二值神经网络压缩与加速
title_en: MST-compression: Compressing and Accelerating Binary Neural Networks with Minimum Spanning Tree
abstract: 二值神经网络(BNNs)通过使用单比特表示激活值和权重,被广泛采用以降低边缘计算设备上的计算成本和内存存储需求。然而,随着神经网络变得更宽或更深以提高精度并满足实际需求,即使在二值版本中,计算负担仍是一个显著挑战。为解决这些问题,本文提出了一种名为最小生成树(MST)压缩的新方法,用于学习压缩和加速BNNs。所提出的架构利用了先前工作的观察结果:二值卷积中的输出通道可以通过另一个输出通道和与重用通道权重不同的权重进行XNOR操作来计算。我们首先构建一个全连接图,其中顶点对应输出通道,两个顶点之间的距离是用于这些输出的权重集之间不同值的数量。然后,提出具有最小深度的图的MST以重新排序输出计算顺序,旨在减少计算成本和延迟。此外,我们提出了一种新的学习算法,在训练过程中减少总MST距离。在基准模型上的实验结果表明,我们的方法实现了显著的压缩比,且精度损失微乎其微,使其成为资源受限边缘计算设备的有前景方法。
abstract_en: Binary neural networks (BNNs) have been widely adopted to reduce the computational cost and memory storage on edge-computing devices by using one bit representation for activations and weights. However, as neural networks become wider/deeper to improve accuracy and meet practical requirements, the computational burden remains a significant challenge even on the binary version. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel method called Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) compression that learns to compress and accelerate BNNs. The proposed architecture leverages an observation from previous works that an output channel in a binary convolution can be computed using another output channel and XNOR operations with weights that differ from the weights of the reused channel. We first construct a fully connected graph with vertices corresponding to output channels, where the distance between two vertices is the number of different values between the weight sets used for these outputs. Then, the MST of the graph with the minimum depth is proposed to reorder output calculations, aiming to reduce computational cost and latency. Moreover, we propose a new learning algorithm to reduce the total MST distance during training. Experimental results on benchmark models demonstrate that our method achieves significant compression ratios with negligible accuracy drops, making it a promising approach for resource-constrained edge-computing devices.
authors: Quang Hieu Vo, Linh-Tam Tran, Sung-Ho Bae, Lok-Won Kim, Choong Seon Hong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6091-6100

title: MULLER:用于视觉的多层拉普拉斯缩放器
title_en: MULLER: Multilayer Laplacian Resizer for Vision
abstract: 图像缩放操作是现代计算机视觉中的基本预处理模块。在深度学习革命过程中,研究者们忽视了除常用缩放方法(如最近邻、双线性、双三次)之外其他缩放方法的潜力。我们关注的核心问题是:前端缩放器是否会影响深度视觉模型的性能?在本文中,我们提出了一种极其轻量的多层拉普拉斯缩放器(MULLER),其仅包含少量可训练参数。MULLER具有带通特性,能够学习增强对下游识别模型有益的特定频率子带细节。我们证明MULLER可以轻松集成到各种训练流程中,并且能以几乎无额外成本有效提升底层视觉任务的性能。具体而言,我们选择最先进的视觉Transformer模型MaxViT作为基准,在使用MULLER训练后,MaxViT在ImageNet-1k上获得最高达0.6%的top-1准确率,同时实现36%的推理成本节省以达到相似准确率。值得注意的是,MULLER的性能也随着模型规模和训练数据规模(如ImageNet-21k和JFT)而扩展,并可广泛应用于图像分类、目标检测与分割以及图像质量评估等多类视觉任务。代码已开源至https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/muller。
abstract_en:
Image resizing operation is a fundamental preprocessing module in modern computer vision. Throughout the deep learning revolution, researchers have overlooked the potential of alternative resizing methods beyond the commonly used resizers that are readily available, such as nearest-neighbors, bilinear, and bicubic. The key question of our interest is whether the front-end resizer affects the performance of deep vision models? In this paper, we present an extremely lightweight multilayer Laplacian resizer with only a handful of trainable parameters, dubbed MULLER resizer. MULLER has a bandpass nature in that it learns to boost details in certain frequency subbands that benefit the downstream recognition models. We show that MULLER can be easily plugged into various training pipelines, and it effectively boosts the performance of the underlying vision task with little to no extra cost. Specifically, we select a state-of-the-art vision Transformer, MaxViT, as the baseline, and show that, if trained with MULLER, MaxViT gains up to 0.6% top-1 accuracy, and meanwhile enjoys 36% inference cost saving to achieve similar top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1k, as compared to the standard training scheme. Notably, MULLER's performance also scales with model size and training data size such as ImageNet-21k and JFT, and it is widely applicable to multiple vision tasks, including image classification, object detection and segmentation, as well as image quality assessment.
 The code is available at https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/muller.
authors: Zhengzhong Tu, Peyman Milanfar, Hossein Talebi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6877-6887

title: MUVA: 一种新的大规模多视角无遮挡实例分割购物场景基准数据集
title_en: MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Multi-View Amodal Instance Segmentation in the Shopping Scenario
abstract: 无遮挡实例分割(AIS)旨在准确推断部分或完全遮挡的物体完整形状。然而,单视角数据集的固有病态性在确定遮挡形状时存在挑战。多视角框架可能有助于缓解这一问题,因为人类在遇到遮挡物体时通常会调整视角。目前,现有方法和数据集尚未探索这一方法。为弥合这一差距,我们提出了一种新的任务——多视角无遮挡实例分割(MAIS),并引入了MUVA数据集,这是首个以购物场景为实例的多视角AIS数据集。MUVA提供了全面的标注,包括多视角无遮挡/可见分割掩码、三维模型和深度图,使其成为图像级AIS数据集中图像和实例数量最多的数据集。此外,我们提出了一种新的方法,用于跨不同实例和视角聚合代表性特征,该方法通过利用其他视角的信息,在单视角下准确预测遮挡物体方面表现出有前景的结果。此外,我们还证明MUVA能够受益于现实场景中的AIS任务。
abstract_en: Amodal Instance Segmentation (AIS) endeavors to accurately deduce complete object shapes that are partially or fully occluded. However, the inherent ill-posed nature of single-view datasets poses challenges in determining occluded shapes. A multi-view framework may help alleviate this problem, as humans often adjust their perspective when encountering occluded objects. At present, this approach has not yet been explored by existing methods and datasets. To bridge this gap, we propose a new task called Multi-view Amodal Instance Segmentation (MAIS) and introduce the MUVA dataset, the first MUlti-View AIS dataset that takes the shopping scenario as instantiation. MUVA provides comprehensive annotations, including multi-view amodal/visible segmentation masks, 3D models, and depth maps, making it the largest image-level AIS dataset in terms of both the number of images and instances. Additionally, we propose a new method for aggregating representative features across different instances and views, which demonstrates promising results in accurately predicting occluded objects from one viewpoint by leveraging information from other viewpoints. Besides, we also demonstrate that MUVA can benefit the AIS task in real-world scenarios.
authors: Zhixuan Li, Weining Ye, Juan Terven, Zachary Bennett, Ying Zheng, Tingting Jiang, Tiejun Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23504-23513

title: MUter:对抗训练模型上的机器遗忘
title_en: MUter: Machine Unlearning on Adversarially Trained Models
abstract: 机器遗忘是一项新兴任务,旨在通过数据删除请求移除已训练模型中选定训练数据点的影响,这呼应了广泛实施的数据法规中规定的被遗忘权。近年来已提出许多遗忘方法,相较于从头开始重新训练的简单基线,这些方法在效率上取得了显著提升。然而,现有方法仅专注于标准训练模型的遗忘,而无法应用于对抗训练模型(ATMs),尽管ATMs作为对抗样本的有效防御手段而广受欢迎。在对抗训练过程中,训练数据不仅参与外层循环以最小化训练损失,还参与内层循环以生成对抗性扰动。这种双层优化极大复杂化了待删除数据的影响度量,使遗忘任务比单层优化的标准模型训练更具挑战性。本文提出了一种名为MUter的新方法,用于对抗训练模型的遗忘。我们基于总Hessian相关数据影响度量推导出闭式遗忘步骤,而现有方法可能误判与间接Hessian部分相关的数据影响。我们进一步通过引入一系列近似和转换来降低计算成本,避免最耗时的Hessian求逆部分。通过在四个数据集上使用线性模型和神经网络模型进行实验,验证了MUter的效率和有效性。
abstract_en:
Machine unlearning is an emerging task of removing the influence of selected training datapoints from a trained model upon data deletion requests, which echoes the widely enforced data regulations mandating the Right to be Forgotten. Many unlearning methods have been proposed recently, achieving significant efficiency gains over the naive baseline of retraining from scratch. However, existing methods focus exclusively on unlearning from standard training models and do not apply to adversarial training models (ATMs) despite their popularity as effective defenses against adversarial examples. During adversarial training, the training data are involved in not only an outer loop for minimizing the training loss, but also an inner loop for generating the adversarial perturbation. Such bi-level optimization greatly complicates the influence measure for the data to be deleted and renders the unlearning more challenging than standard model training with single-level optimization. 
 This paper proposes a new approach called MUter for unlearning from ATMs. We derive a closed-form unlearning step underpinned by a total Hessian-related data influence measure, while existing methods can mis-capture the data influence associated with the indirect Hessian part. We further alleviate the computational cost by introducing a series of approximations and conversions to avoid the most computationally demanding parts of Hessian inversions. The efficiency and effectiveness of MUter have been validated through experiments on four datasets using both linear and neural network models.
authors: Junxu Liu, Mingsheng Xue, Jian Lou, Xiaoyu Zhang, Li Xiong, Zhan Qin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4892-4902

title: MV-DeepSDF:基于多扫描点云的隐式建模在自动驾驶中的3D车辆重建
title_en: MV-DeepSDF: Implicit Modeling with Multi-Sweep Point Clouds for 3D Vehicle Reconstruction in Autonomous Driving
abstract: 从噪声大且稀疏的部分点云中重建3D车辆对自动驾驶具有重要意义。现有大多数3D重建方法无法直接应用于该问题,因为它们是专门设计用于处理具有微小噪声的密集输入的。本文提出了一种新颖的框架,称为MV-DeepSDF,该框架从多扫描点云中估计最优的符号距离函数(SDF)形状表示,以在真实场景中重建车辆。尽管已有部分基于SDF的隐式建模方法,但它们仅关注单视角重建,导致重建保真度较低。相比之下,我们首先分析多扫描在潜在特征空间中的__TITLE_MATH_1__和__ABS_MATH_1__,并提出将隐式空间形状估计问题转化为元素到集合的特征提取问题。随后,我们设计了一种新架构,提取个体元素级表示并聚合生成集合级预测潜在代码。该集合级潜在代码是隐式空间中最优3D形状的表达,可进一步解码为车辆的连续SDF。通过这种方式,我们的方法学习了多扫描间的__TITLE_MATH_2__和__ABS_MATH_2__信息,用于3D车辆重建。我们在两个真实世界自动驾驶数据集(Waymo和KITTI)上进行了详尽实验,结果表明我们的方法在定性和定量上均优于现有最先进的替代方法。
abstract_en:
Reconstructing 3D vehicles from noisy and sparse partial point clouds is of great significance to autonomous driving. Most existing 3D reconstruction methods cannot be directly applied to this problem because they are elaborately designed to deal with dense inputs with trivial noise. In this work, we propose a novel framework, dubbed MV-DeepSDF, which estimates the optimal Signed Distance Function (SDF) shape representation from multi-sweep point clouds
 to reconstruct vehicles in the wild. Although there have been some SDF-based implicit modeling methods, they only focus on single-view-based reconstruction, resulting in low fidelity. In contrast, we first analyze multi-sweep consistency and complementarity in the latent feature space and propose to transform the implicit space shape estimation problem into an element-to-set feature extraction problem. Then, we devise a new architecture to extract individual element-level representations and aggregate them to generate a set-level predicted latent code. This set-level latent code is an expression of the optimal 3D shape in the implicit space, and can be subsequently decoded to a continuous SDF of the vehicle. In this way, our approach learns consistent and complementary information among multi-sweeps for 3D vehicle reconstruction. We conduct thorough experiments on two real-world autonomous driving datasets (Waymo and KITTI) to demonstrate the superiority of our approach over state-of-the-art alternative methods both qualitatively and quantitatively.
authors: Yibo Liu, Kelly Zhu, Guile Wu, Yuan Ren, Bingbing Liu, Yang Liu, Jinjun Shan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8306-8316

title: MV-Map:基于多视角一致性的离车高精地图生成
title_en: MV-Map: Offboard HD-Map Generation with Multi-view Consistency
abstract: 虽然俯视视角(BEV)感知模型可以用于以较少人工劳动构建高精地图(HD-Maps),但其结果往往不可靠,并且在不同视角预测的HD-Maps中表现出明显的不一致性。这是因为BEV感知通常以“车载”方式设置,这限制了计算能力,从而阻碍了算法对多视角的同时推理。本文克服了这些限制,倡导一种更实用的“离车”HD-Map生成设置,该设置通过高精地图通常是数据中心离线构建的可复用基础设施这一事实,消除了计算约束。为此,我们提出了一种名为MV-Map的新型离车流水线,该流水线利用多视角一致性,并通过“以区域为中心”的框架设计可处理任意数量的帧。在MV-Map中,目标HD-Maps通过聚合所有车载预测帧,其权重由“不确定性网络”分配的置信度得分确定。为进一步增强多视角一致性,我们通过体素化神经辐射场(Voxel-NeRF)优化的全局3D结构对不确定性网络进行了增强。在nuScenes上的大量实验表明,我们的MV-Map显著提升了HD-Maps的质量,进一步突显了离车方法在HD-Map生成中的重要性。
abstract_en:
While bird's-eye-view (BEV) perception models can be useful for building high-definition maps (HD-Maps) with less human labor, their results are often unreliable and demonstrate noticeable inconsistencies in the predicted HD-Maps from different viewpoints. This is because BEV perception is typically set up in an "onboard" manner, which restricts the computation and consequently prevents algorithms from reasoning multiple views simultaneously. This paper overcomes these limitations and advocates a more practical "offboard" HD-Map generation setup that removes the computation constraints, based on the fact that HD-Maps are commonly reusable infrastructures built offline in data centers. 
 To this end, we propose a novel offboard pipeline called MV-Map that capitalizes multi-view consistency and can handle an arbitrary number of frames with the key desgin of a "region-centric" framework. In MV-Map, the target HD-Maps are created by aggregating all the frames of onboard predictions, weighted by the confidence scores assigned by an "uncertainty network." To further enhance multi-view consistency, we augment the uncertainty network with the global 3D structure optimized by a voxelized neural radiance field (Voxel-NeRF). Extensive experiments on nuScenes show that our MV-Map significantly improves the quality of HD-Maps, further highlighting the importance of offboard methods for HD-Map generation.
authors: Ziyang Xie, Ziqi Pang, Yu-Xiong Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8658-8668

title: MVPSNet:快速且可泛化的多视角光度立体视觉
title_en: MVPSNet: Fast Generalizable Multi-view Photometric Stereo
abstract: 我们提出了一种快速且可泛化的多视角光度立体视觉(MVPS)解决方案,称为MVPSNet。我们的方法核心是一个特征提取网络,能够有效融合同一视角下多光照条件下的图像,从光照线索中提取几何特征用于立体匹配。我们证明这些被称为"光照聚合特征图"(LAFM)的特征,即使在传统多视角立体视觉方法常失效的无纹理区域,也能实现有效的特征匹配。我们的方法在推理速度上比最先进的MVPS方法PS-NeRF快411倍(105秒 vs. 12小时),同时产生相似的重建结果。此外,我们引入了一个新的MVPS合成数据集sMVPS,实验证明该数据集对训练可泛化的MVPS方法具有有效性。
abstract_en: We propose a fast and generalizable solution to Multiview Photometric Stereo (MVPS), called MVPSNet. The key to our approach is a feature extraction network that effectively combines images from the same view captured under multiple lighting conditions to extract geometric features from shading cues for stereo matching. We demonstrate these features, termed 'Light Aggregated Feature Maps' (LAFM), are effective for feature matching even in textureless regions, where traditional multi-view stereo methods often fail. Our method produces similar reconstruction results to PS-NeRF, a state-of-the-art MVPS method that optimizes a neural network per-scene, while being 411x faster (105 seconds vs. 12 hours) in inference. Additionally, we introduce a new synthetic dataset for MVPS, sMVPS, which is shown to be effective for training a generalizable MVPS method.
authors: Dongxu Zhao, Daniel Lichy, Pierre-Nicolas Perrin, Jan-Michael Frahm, Soumyadip Sengupta ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12525-12536

title: MagicFusion:通过融合扩散模型提升文本到图像生成性能
title_en: MagicFusion: Boosting Text-to-Image Generation Performance by Fusing Diffusion Models
