abstract: 开源AI社区的兴起催生了丰富多样的强大文本引导扩散模型,这些模型在各种数据集上进行训练。尽管对集成此类模型以结合其优势的研究仍较为有限。在本研究中,我们提出了一种简单而有效的称为显著性感知噪声融合(SNB)的方法,该方法能够增强融合后的文本引导扩散模型,实现更可控的生成。具体而言,我们通过实验发现,无分类器引导的响应与生成图像的显著性高度相关。因此,我们通过以显著性感知的方式融合两个扩散模型的预测噪声,来信任各自在专业领域内的不同模型。SNB无需训练,可在DDIM采样过程中完成。此外,它可以在无需额外标注(如掩码)的情况下自动对齐两个噪声空间的语义。大量实验表明,SNB在各种应用中表现出显著的效果。项目页面可在https://magicfusion.github.io访问。
abstract_en: The advent of open-source AI communities has produced a cornucopia of powerful text-guided diffusion models that are trained on various datasets. While few explorations have been conducted on ensembling such models to combine their strengths. In this work, we propose a simple yet effective method called Saliency-aware Noise Blending (SNB) that can empower the fused text-guided diffusion models to achieve more controllable generation. Specifically, we experimentally find that the responses of classifier-free guidance are highly related to the saliency of generated images. Thus we propose to trust different models in their areas of expertise by blending the predicted noises of two diffusion models in a saliency-aware manner. SNB is training-free and can be completed within a DDIM sampling process. Additionally, it can automatically align the semantics of two noise spaces without requiring additional annotations such as masks. Extensive experiments show the impressive effectiveness of SNB in various applications. The project page is available at https://magicfusion.github.io.
authors: Jing Zhao, Heliang Zheng, Chaoyue Wang, Long Lan, Wenjing Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22592-22602

title: 通过几何与遮挡感知编码使编码器在3D GAN反演中重获新生
title_en: Make Encoder Great Again in 3D GAN Inversion through Geometry and Occlusion-Aware Encoding
abstract: 3D GAN反演旨在从单张图像输入中同时实现高重建保真度和合理的3D几何结构。然而,现有3D GAN反演方法需要对每个单独案例进行耗时的优化。在本工作中,我们引入了一种基于EG3D的新型编码器反演框架,EG3D是目前最广泛使用的3D GAN模型之一。我们利用EG3D潜在空间的固有特性设计了判别器和背景深度正则化。这使我们能够训练出一种几何感知编码器,将输入图像转换为对应的潜在编码。此外,我们探索了EG3D的特征空间,并开发了一种自适应细化阶段,提升EG3D特征表示能力以增强细粒度纹理细节的恢复。最后,我们提出了一种遮挡感知融合操作以防止未观测区域的失真。我们的方法在速度上可达优化方法的500倍,同时取得了与优化方法相当的优异结果。我们的框架非常适合语义编辑等应用场景。
abstract_en: 3D GAN inversion aims to achieve high reconstruction fidelity and reasonable 3D geometry simultaneously from a single image input. However, existing 3D GAN inversion methods rely on time-consuming optimization for each individual case. In this work, we introduce a novel encoder-based inversion framework based on EG3D, one of the most widely-used 3D GAN models. We leverage the inherent properties of EG3D's latent space to design a discriminator and a background depth regularization. This enables us to train a geometry-aware encoder capable of converting the input image into corresponding latent code. Additionally, we explore the feature space of EG3D and develop an adaptive refinement stage that improves the representation ability of features in EG3D to enhance the recovery of fine-grained textural details. Finally, we propose an occlusion-aware fusion operation to prevent distortion in unobserved regions. Our method achieves impressive results comparable to optimization-based methods while operating up to 500 times faster. Our framework is well-suited for applications such as semantic editing.
authors: Ziyang Yuan, Yiming Zhu, Yu Li, Hongyu Liu, Chun Yuan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2437-2447

title: Make-An-Animation: 大规模文本条件三维人体运动生成
title_en: Make-An-Animation: Large-Scale Text-conditional 3D Human Motion Generation
abstract: 文本引导的人体运动生成因其在动画和机器人领域的广泛应用而受到广泛关注。近期,扩散模型在运动生成中的应用显著提升了生成运动的质量。然而,现有方法受限于对相对小规模动作捕捉数据的依赖,导致在更多样化、真实场景的提示下表现不佳。本文提出Make-An-Animation,这是一种基于文本条件的人体运动生成模型,通过从大规模图像-文本数据集中学习更多样化的姿态和提示,显著超越了先前方法的性能。Make-An-Animation的训练分为两个阶段:首先,在从图像-文本数据集中提取的(文本,静态伪姿态)大规模数据集上进行训练;其次,在动作捕捉数据上进行微调,增加额外层以建模时间维度。与先前的运动生成扩散模型不同,Make-An-Animation采用类似于近期文本到视频生成模型的U-Net架构。对运动真实性和与输入文本一致性的评估表明,我们的模型在文本到运动生成任务中达到了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Text-guided human motion generation has drawn significant interest because of its impactful applications spanning animation and robotics. Recently, application of diffusion models for motion generation has enabled improvements in the quality of generated motions. However, existing approaches are limited by their reliance on relatively small-scale motion capture data, leading to poor performance on more diverse, in-the-wild prompts. In this paper, we introduce Make-An-Animation, a text-conditioned human motion generation model which learns more diverse poses and prompts from large-scale image-text datasets, enabling significant improvement in performance over prior works. Make-An-Animation is trained in two stages. First, we train on a curated large-scale dataset of (text, static pseudo-pose) pairs extracted from image-text datasets. Second, we fine-tune on motion capture data, adding additional layers to model the temporal dimension. Unlike prior diffusion models for motion generation, Make-An-Animation uses a U-Net architecture similar to recent text-to-video generation models. Human evaluation of motion realism and alignment with input text shows that our model reaches state-of-the-art performance on text-to-motion generation.
authors: Samaneh Azadi, Akbar Shah, Thomas Hayes, Devi Parikh, Sonal Gupta ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15039-15048

title: Make-It-3D:基于单张图像与扩散先验的高保真3D创作
title_en: Make-It-3D: High-fidelity 3D Creation from A Single Image with Diffusion Prior
abstract: 本文探讨了仅凭单张图像生成高保真3D内容的问题。这一任务本质上具有挑战性:它本质上需要估计底层3D几何结构同时生成未见纹理。为解决这一挑战,我们利用经过良好训练的2D扩散模型中的先验知识,作为3D创作的三维感知监督。我们提出的方法Make-It-3D采用两阶段优化流程:第一阶段在参考图像和扩散先验约束下优化神经辐射场;第二阶段从粗略模型构建带纹理的点云,并进一步利用参考图像中高质量纹理的可用性,通过扩散先验增强纹理。大量实验表明,我们的方法在先前工作中实现了显著提升,展现出忠实重建和出色的视觉质量。我们的方法首次尝试实现通用物体的单图像高质量3D创作,并支持文本到3D创作和纹理编辑等应用。
abstract_en: In this work, we investigate the problem of creating high-fidelity 3D content from only a single image. This is inherently challenging: it essentially involves estimating the underlying 3D geometry while hallucinating unseen textures. To address this challenge, we leverage prior knowledge in a well-trained 2D diffusion model to serve as a 3D-aware supervision for 3D creation. Our proposed method, Make-It-3D, employs a two-stage optimization pipeline: the first stage optimizes a neural radiance field with constraints from the reference image and diffusion prior; the second stage builds textured point clouds from the coarse model and further enhances the textures with diffusion prior leveraging the availability of high-quality textures from the reference image. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves a clear improvement over previous works, displaying faithful reconstruction and impressive visual quality. Our method presents the first attempt to achieve high-quality 3D creation from a single image for general objects, and enables various applications such as text-to-3D creation and texture editing.
authors: Junshu Tang, Tengfei Wang, Bo Zhang, Ting Zhang, Ran Yi, Lizhuang Ma, Dong Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22819-22829

title: 通过视觉进行操作:基于预训练表示的操作控制器构建方法
title_en: Manipulate by Seeing: Creating Manipulation Controllers from Pre-Trained Representations
abstract: 近年来,视觉表征学习领域取得了爆炸性发展,但其在机器人领域的应用仍显有限。先前工作利用通用视觉表征作为基础,学习任务特定的机器人动作策略(例如通过行为克隆)。尽管视觉表征能加速学习,但其主要作用是编码视觉观测。因此,动作信息必须纯粹从机器人数据中推导,而数据收集成本高昂!本文提出了一种可扩展的替代方案,其中视觉表征可直接用于推断机器人动作。我们观察到,视觉编码器通过嵌入点积等方法将图像观测表示为距离关系,可用于高效规划机器人行为。我们对这一洞察进行实操化,通过微调预训练表示在人类收集的视频序列上,开发了一种简单算法以获取距离函数和动力学预测器。最终方法在多种真实世界操作任务中显著优于传统机器人学习基线(例如在抓取-放置任务中,成功率达到70% vs 行为克隆的50%)。它还能在训练过程中无需任何机器人演示数据的情况下泛化到新物体。学习策略的可视化请查看:https://agi-labs.github.io/manipulate-by-seeing/
abstract_en: The field of visual representation learning has seen explosive growth in the past years, but its benefits in robotics have been surprisingly limited so far. Prior work uses generic visual representations as a basis to learn (task-specific) robot action policies (e.g., via behavior cloning). While the visual representations do accelerate learning, they are primarily used to encode visual observations. Thus, action information has to be derived purely from robot data, which is expensive to collect! In this work, we present a scalable alternative where the visual representations can help directly infer robot actions. We observe that vision encoders express relationships between image observations as distances (e.g., via embedding dot product) that could be used to efficiently plan robot behavior. We operationalize this insight and develop a simple algorithm for acquiring a distance function and dynamics predictor, by fine-tuning a pre-trained representation on human collected video sequences. The final method is able to substantially outperform traditional robot learning baselines (e.g., 70% success v.s. 50% for behavior cloning on pick-place) on a suite of diverse real-world manipulation tasks. It can also generalize to novel objects, without using any robot demonstrations during train time. For visualizations of the learned policies please check: https://agi-labs.github.io/manipulate-by-seeing/
authors: Jianren Wang, Sudeep Dasari, Mohan Kumar Srirama, Shubham Tulsiani, Abhinav Gupta ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3859-3868

title: MapFormer:利用预变化信息提升变化检测
title_en: MapFormer: Boosting Change Detection by Using Pre-change Information
abstract: 遥感影像的变化检测对于城市规划、灾害管理及气候研究等众多应用至关重要。然而,现有方法在识别语义变化区域时忽略了现有地图中以语义信息形式描述地表特征的可用性。本文利用这种信息进行双时相影像的变化检测。我们证明,通过潜在表示拼接的简单集成即可显著超越最先进的变化检测方法。受此观察启发,我们提出了新的任务——条件变化检测,其中预变化语义信息作为双时相影像的输入。为充分挖掘额外信息,我们提出MapFormer,一种基于多模态特征融合模块的新型架构,允许根据可用语义信息进行特征处理。我们进一步采用监督的跨模态对比损失来指导视觉表示的学习。我们的方法在DynamicEarthNet和HRSCD数据集上的二值变化IoU分别比现有方法高出绝对值11.7%和18.4%。此外,我们展示了该方法对预变化语义信息质量及缺乏预变化影像的鲁棒性。代码可在https://github.com/mxbh/mapformer获取。
abstract_en: Change detection in remote sensing imagery is essential for a variety of applications such as urban planning, disaster management, and climate research. However, existing methods for identifying semantically changed areas overlook the availability of semantic information in the form of existing maps describing features of the earth's surface. In this paper, we leverage this information for change detection in bi-temporal images. We show that the simple integration of the additional information via concatenation of latent representations suffices to significantly outperform state-of-the-art change detection methods. Motivated by this observation, we propose the new task of Conditional Change Detection, where pre-change semantic information is used as input next to bi-temporal images. To fully exploit the extra information, we propose MapFormer, a novel architecture based on a multi-modal feature fusion module that allows for feature processing conditioned on the available semantic information. We further employ a supervised, cross-modal contrastive loss to guide the learning of visual representations. Our approach outperforms existing change detection methods by an absolute 11.7% and 18.4% in terms of binary change IoU on DynamicEarthNet and HRSCD, respectively. Furthermore, we demonstrate the robustness of our approach to the quality of the pre-change semantic information and the absence pre-change imagery. The code is available at https://github.com/mxbh/mapformer.
authors: Maximilian Bernhard, Niklas Strauß, Matthias Schubert ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16837-16846

title: MapPrior:基于生成模型的俯视图地图布局估计
title_en: MapPrior: Bird's-Eye View Map Layout Estimation with Generative Models
abstract: 尽管俯视图(BEV)感知技术取得了巨大进展,现有模型在生成真实且连贯的语义地图布局方面仍存在不足,且未能充分考虑由部分传感器信息(如遮挡或有限覆盖范围)引发的不确定性。在本工作中,我们引入了MapPrior,这是一种新颖的BEV感知框架,将传统判别式BEV感知模型与学习到的语义地图布局生成模型相结合。我们的MapPrior在准确性、真实性和不确定性感知方面均表现出更优的预测效果。我们在大规模nuScenes基准数据集上评估了该模型。在投稿时,MapPrior在基于摄像头和激光雷达的BEV感知中显著超越了最强的竞争方法,MMD和ECE得分均有明显提升。此外,我们的方法还可通过无条件采样持续生成地图布局。
abstract_en: Despite tremendous advancements in bird's-eye view (BEV) perception, existing models fall short in generating realistic and coherent semantic map layouts, and they fail to account for uncertainties arising from partial sensor information (such as occlusion or limited coverage). In this work, we introduce MapPrior, a novel BEV perception framework that combines a traditional discriminative BEV perception model with a learned generative model for semantic map layouts. Our MapPrior delivers predictions with better accuracy, realism, and uncertainty awareness. We evaluate our model on the large-scale nuScenes benchmark. At the time of submission, MapPrior outperforms the strongest competing method, with significantly improved MMD and ECE scores in camera- and LiDAR-based BEV perception. Furthermore, our method can be used to perpetually generate layouts with unconditional sampling.
authors: Xiyue Zhu, Vlas Zyrianov, Zhijian Liu, Shenlong Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8228-8239

title: March in Chat:远程具身指称表达的交互式提示
title_en: March in Chat: Interactive Prompting for Remote Embodied Referring Expression
abstract: 近年来,许多视觉-语言导航(VLN)任务被提出,从基于房间的到基于物体的,从室内到室外。REVERIE(远程具身指称表达)具有研究价值,因为它仅向智能体提供高层次指令,这些指令更贴近人类的实际指令。然而,这比其他VLN任务更具挑战性,因为智能体需要仅基于简短指令推断导航计划。大语言模型(LLMs)通过提供适当的提示,在机器人动作规划中展现出巨大潜力。然而,这一策略尚未在REVERIE设置下进行探索。存在若干新挑战。例如,LLM需要具备环境感知能力,以便根据当前视觉观察调整导航计划。此外,LLM规划的动作应适应更庞大且复杂的REVERIE环境。本文提出了一种March-in-Chat(MiC)模型,该模型可实时与LLM交互,并基于新提出的房间和物体感知场景感知器(ROASP)动态规划。在REVERIE基准测试中,MiC模型在SPL和RGSPL指标上大幅超越了先前的最先进方法。源代码可在https://github.com/YanyuanQiao/MiC获取
abstract_en: Many Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) tasks have been proposed in recent years, from room-based to object-based and indoor to outdoor. The REVERIE (Remote Embodied Referring Expression) is interesting since it only provides high-level instructions to the agent, which are closer to human commands in practice. Nevertheless, this poses more challenges than other VLN tasks since it requires agents to infer a navigation plan only based on a short instruction. Large Language Models (LLMs) show great potential in robot action planning by providing proper prompts. Still, this strategy has not been explored under the REVERIE settings. There are several new challenges. For example, the LLM should be environment-aware so that the navigation plan can be adjusted based on the current visual observation. Moreover, the LLM planned actions should be adaptable to the much larger and more complex REVERIE environment. This paper proposes a March-in-Chat (MiC) model that can talk to the LLM on the fly and plan dynamically based on a newly proposed Room-and-Object Aware Scene Perceiver (ROASP). Our MiC model outperforms the previous state-of-the-art by large margins by SPL and RGSPL metrics on the REVERIE benchmark. The source code is available at https://github.com/YanyuanQiao/MiC
authors: Yanyuan Qiao, Yuankai Qi, Zheng Yu, Jing Liu, Qi Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15758-15767

title: 基于马尔可夫博弈的视频增强方法用于动作分割
title_en: Markov Game Video Augmentation for Action Segmentation
abstract: 本文针对动作分割的数据增强问题展开研究。我们的核心创新点在于:在深度特征空间对原始训练视频进行增强,而非如先前工作那样在视觉时空域进行增强。在增强过程中,我们修改视频帧的原始深度特征,使得生成的嵌入结果更接近类别决策边界。同时,我们通过插入、删除和替换动作,编辑原始训练视频的动作序列(即转录文本),使得生成的转录文本在编辑距离上更接近真实标签。由于缺乏可靠的监督源(即无法获得深度特征空间中最优数据修改的监督信息),我们采用强化学习而非更常见的监督学习方法进行数据增强。为修改帧嵌入,我们构建了一个以马尔可夫博弈形式表述的元模型,包含多个自利智能体。同时,利用快速、无参数的蒙特卡洛树搜索生成新的转录文本。实验结果表明,所提出的增强方法在Breakfast、GTEA和50Salads数据集上显著提升了多个先进动作分割模型的性能。
abstract_en: This paper addresses data augmentation for action segmentation. Our key novelty is that we augment the original training videos in the deep feature space, not in the visual spatiotemporal domain as done by previous work. For augmentation, we modify original deep features of video frames such that the resulting embeddings fall closer to the class decision boundaries. Also, we edit action sequences of the original training videos (a.k.a. transcripts) by inserting, deleting, and replacing actions such that the resulting transcripts are close in edit distance to the ground truth ones. For our data augmentation we resort to reinforcement learning, instead of more common supervised learning, since we do not have access to reliable oracles which would provide supervision about the optimal data modifications in the deep feature space. For modifying frame embeddings, we use a meta-model formulated as a Markov Game with multiple self-interested agents. Also, new transcripts are generated using a fast, parameter-free Monte Carlo tree search. Our experiments show that the proposed data augmentation of the Breakfast, GTEA, and 50Salads datasets leads to significant performance gains of several state of the art action segmenters.
authors: Nicolas Aziere, Sinisa Todorovic ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13505-13514

title: 面向开放词汇的通用图像分割方法MasQCLIP
title_en: MasQCLIP for Open-Vocabulary Universal Image Segmentation
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的开放词汇通用图像分割方法,该方法能够在统一框架下实现实例分割、语义分割和全景分割。我们的方法称为MasQCLIP,通过利用预训练CLIP模型的密集特征,无缝集成于该模型,从而避免了对大量参数训练的需求。在构建基于CLIP模型的图像分割方法时,MasQCLIP强调了两个新方面:1)通过从基础(已见)类别中蒸馏信息来处理新颖(未见)类别的掩码的学生-教师模块;2)对CLIP模型中查询Q进行参数微调的过程。得益于这两个简单直观的设计,MasQCLIP在开放词汇实例、语义和全景分割三个任务中均显著超越了竞争方法,实现了最先进的性能。项目页面位于https://masqclip.github.io/。
abstract_en: We present a new method for open-vocabulary universal image segmentation, which is capable of performing instance, semantic, and panoptic segmentation under a unified framework. Our approach, called MasQCLIP, seamlessly integrates with a pre-trained CLIP model by utilizing its dense features, thereby circumventing the need for extensive parameter training. MasQCLIP emphasizes two new aspects when building an image segmentation method with a CLIP model: 1) a student-teacher module to deal with masks of the novel (unseen) classes by distilling information from the base (seen) classes; 2) a fine-tuning process to update model parameters for the queries Q within the CLIP model. Thanks to these two simple and intuitive designs, MasQCLIP is able to achieve state-of-the-art performances with a substantial gain over the competing methods by a large margin across all three tasks, including open-vocabulary instance, semantic, and panoptic segmentation. Project page is at https://masqclip.github.io/.
authors: Xin Xu, Tianyi Xiong, Zheng Ding, Zhuowen Tu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 887-898

title: MasaCtrl: 无需调优的互注意力控制用于一致图像生成与编辑
title_en: MasaCtrl: Tuning-Free Mutual Self-Attention Control for Consistent Image Synthesis and Editing
abstract: 尽管在大规模文本到图像生成和文本条件图像编辑方面取得了成功,现有方法仍难以生成一致的生成和编辑结果。例如,生成方法通常无法合成同一对象/角色但不同视角或姿态的多张图像。同时,现有编辑方法要么在保持整体纹理和身份的前提下难以实现有效的复杂非刚性编辑,要么需要耗时的微调来捕捉图像特定外观。在本文中,我们开发了MasaCtrl,一种无需调优的方法,可同时实现一致图像生成和复杂非刚性图像编辑。具体而言,MasaCtrl将扩散模型中的现有自注意力转换为互注意力,从而能够从源图像查询相关局部内容和纹理以实现一致性。为进一步缓解前景与背景之间的查询混淆,我们提出了一种掩码引导的互注意力策略,其中掩码可轻松从交叉注意力图中提取。大量实验表明,所提出的MasaCtrl在一致图像生成和复杂非刚性真实图像编辑中均能产生令人印象深刻的结果。
abstract_en: Despite the success in large-scale text-to-image generation and text-conditioned image editing, existing methods still struggle to produce consistent generation and editing results. For example, generation approaches usually fail to synthesize multiple images of the same objects/characters but with different views or poses. Meanwhile, existing editing methods either fail to achieve effective complex non-rigid editing while maintaining the overall textures and identity, or require time-consuming fine-tuning to capture the image-specific appearance. In this paper, we develop MasaCtrl, a tuning-free method to achieve consistent image generation and complex non-rigid image editing simultaneously. Specifically, MasaCtrl converts existing self-attention in diffusion models into mutual self-attention, so that it can query correlated local contents and textures from source images for consistency. To further alleviate the query confusion between foreground and background, we propose a mask-guided mutual self-attention strategy, where the mask can be easily extracted from the cross-attention maps. Extensive experiments show that the proposed MasaCtrl can produce impressive results in both consistent image generation and complex non-rigid real image editing.
authors: Mingdeng Cao, Xintao Wang, Zhongang Qi, Ying Shan, Xiaohu Qie, Yinqiang Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22560-22570

title: 无需掩码注意力的Transformer用于3D实例分割
title_en: Mask-Attention-Free Transformer for 3D Instance Segmentation
abstract: 近年来,基于Transformer的方法在3D实例分割领域占据主导地位,其中掩码注意力机制被广泛采用。具体而言,对象查询通过初始实例掩码在首次交叉注意力中进行引导,随后以类似方式迭代优化自身。然而,我们观察到掩码注意力流程通常因初始实例掩码的低召回率而导致收敛缓慢。因此,我们摒弃了掩码注意力设计,转而采用辅助的中心回归任务。通过中心回归,我们有效克服了低召回率问题,并通过施加位置先验进行交叉注意力操作。为实现该目标,我们开发了一系列位置感知设计。首先,我们学习3D位置的空间分布作为初始位置查询。这些查询在3D空间中密集分布,从而能够以高召回率捕获场景中的物体。此外,我们为交叉注意力引入相对位置编码,并通过迭代优化实现更精确的位置查询。实验表明,我们的方法收敛速度是现有方法的4倍,在ScanNetv2 3D实例分割基准上达到新最先进水平,并在多种数据集上展现出优越性能。代码和模型可在https://github.com/dvlab-research/Mask-Attention-Free-Transformer获取。
abstract_en: Recently, transformer-based methods have dominated 3D instance segmentation, where mask attention is commonly involved. Specifically, object queries are guided by the initial instance masks in the first cross-attention, and then iteratively refine themselves in a similar manner. However, we observe that the mask-attention pipeline usually leads to slow convergence due to low-recall initial instance masks. Therefore, we abandon the mask attention design and resort to an auxiliary center regression task instead. Through center regression, we effectively overcome the low-recall issue and perform cross-attention by imposing positional prior. To reach this goal, we develop a series of position-aware designs. First, we learn a spatial distribution of 3D locations as the initial position queries. They spread over the 3D space densely, and thus can easily capture the objects in a scene with a high recall. Moreover, we present relative position encoding for the cross-attention and iterative refinement for more accurate position queries. Experiments show that our approach converges 4x faster than existing work, sets a new state of the art on ScanNetv2 3D instance segmentation benchmark, and also demonstrates superior performance across various datasets. Code and models are available at https://github.com/dvlab-research/Mask-Attention-Free-Transformer.
authors: Xin Lai, Yuhui Yuan, Ruihang Chu, Yukang Chen, Han Hu, Jiaya Jia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3693-3703

title: 掩码自编码器是更强的知识蒸馏器
title_en: Masked Autoencoders Are Stronger Knowledge Distillers
abstract: 知识蒸馏(KD)在通过模仿高容量教师模型的中间输出来提升学生模型性能方面取得了显著成功,例如在细粒度视觉任务(如目标检测)中。本文提出了一种名为掩码知识蒸馏(MKD)的技术,该技术通过掩码自编码方案增强这一过程。在MKD中,对输入图像的随机块进行掩码处理,并通过强制其模仿教师模型的输出来恢复缺失的特征。MKD基于两个核心设计。首先,以学生模型作为编码器,开发了一种自适应解码器架构,包括在特征金字塔网络(FPN)的多尺度特征上操作的空间对齐模块、一个简单的解码器,以及从潜在表示和掩码标记中模仿教师输出的空间恢复模块。其次,我们在每个卷积块中引入掩码卷积,以确保掩码块不受其他块的影响。通过结合这两种设计,我们可以进一步提升教师知识学习的完整性和有效性。我们在不同架构上进行了广泛的实验,包括目标检测和语义分割。结果表明,所有学生模型相比传统KD均实现了进一步提升。值得注意的是,我们通过提升RetinaNet ResNet-18和ResNet-50模型,分别将mAP从33.4提升至37.5,从37.4提升至41.5,建立了新的最先进结果。
abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) has shown great success in improving student's performance by mimicking the intermediate output of the high-capacity teacher in fine-grained visual tasks, e.g. object detection. This paper proposes a technique called Masked Knowledge Distillation (MKD) that enhances this process using a masked autoencoding scheme. In MKD, random patches of the input image are masked, and the corresponding missing feature is recovered by forcing it to imitate the output of the teacher. MKD is based on two core designs. First, using the student as the encoder, we develop an adaptive decoder architecture, which includes a spatial alignment module that operates on the multi-scale features in the feature pyramid network (FPN), a simple decoder, and a spatial recovery module that mimics the teacher's output from the latent representation and mask tokens. Second, we introduce the masked convolution in each convolution block to keep the masked patches unaffected by others. By coupling these two designs, we can further improve the completeness and effectiveness of teacher knowledge learning. We conduct extensive experiments on different architectures with object detection and semantic segmentation. The results show that all the students can achieve further improvements compared to the conventional KD. Notably, we establish the new state-of-the-art results by boosting RetinaNet ResNet-18, and ResNet-50 from 33.4 to 37.5 mAP, and 37.4 to 41.5 mAP, respectively.
authors: Shanshan Lao, Guanglu Song, Boxiao Liu, Yu Liu, Yujiu Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6384-6393

title: 掩码自编码器是高效的类别增量学习器
title_en: Masked Autoencoders are Efficient Class Incremental Learners
abstract: 类别增量学习(CIL)旨在顺序学习新类别的同时避免先前知识的灾难性遗忘。我们提出使用掩码自编码器(MAEs)作为CIL的高效学习器。MAEs最初设计用于通过重构性无监督学习学习有用表示,且可轻松与分类的监督损失结合。此外,MAEs能够可靠地从随机选择的块中重建原始输入图像,我们利用这一特性更高效地存储过去任务的示例以用于CIL。我们还提出了一种双通道MAE框架,通过图像级和嵌入级融合进行学习,生成更高质量的重建图像和更稳定的表示。实验结果证实,我们的方法在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset和ImageNet-Full数据集上均优于现有最先进方法。代码已开源至https://github.com/scok30/MAE-CIL。
abstract_en:
Class Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to sequentially learn new classes 
  while avoiding catastrophic forgetting of previous knowledge. 
  We propose to use Masked Autoencoders (MAEs) as efficient learners for CIL. 
  MAEs were originally designed to learn useful representations 
  through reconstructive unsupervised learning, 
  and they can be easily integrated with a supervised loss for classification. 
  Moreover, MAEs can reliably reconstruct original input images from 
  randomly selected patches, 
  which we use to store exemplars from past tasks more efficiently for CIL. 
  We also propose a bilateral MAE framework to learn from image-level 
  and embedding-level fusion, 
  which produces better-quality reconstructed images and 
  more stable representations. 
  Our experiments confirm that our approach performs better than 
 the state-of-the-art on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-Subset, and ImageNet-Full. The code is available at https://github.com/scok30/MAE-CIL.
authors: Jiang-Tian Zhai, Xialei Liu, Andrew D. Bagdanov, Ke Li, Ming-Ming Cheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19104-19113

title: 掩码扩散变换器是一种强大的图像合成器
title_en: Masked Diffusion Transformer is a Strong Image Synthesizer
abstract: 尽管在图像合成中取得了成功,我们观察到扩散概率模型(DPMs)往往缺乏上下文推理能力,难以学习图像中物体部件之间的关系,导致学习过程缓慢。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种掩码扩散变换器(MDT),通过引入掩码潜在建模方案,显式增强DPMs在图像对象语义部件之间上下文关系学习的能力。在训练过程中,MDT在潜在空间中对某些标记进行掩码处理,随后设计了非对称掩码扩散变换器,从未掩码的标记中预测被掩码的标记,同时保持扩散生成过程。我们的MDT能够从不完整的上下文输入中重建图像的完整信息,从而使其能够学习图像标记之间的相关关系。实验结果表明,MDT在图像合成性能上表现出色,例如在ImageNet数据集上实现了新的SOTA FID分数,并且其学习速度比之前的SOTA DiT快约3倍。源代码已发布在https://github.com/sail-sg/MDT。
abstract_en: Despite its success in image synthesis, we observe that diffusion probabilistic models (DPMs) often lack contextual reasoning ability to learn the relations among object parts in an image, leading to a slow learning process. To solve this issue, we propose a Masked Diffusion Transformer (MDT) that introduces a mask latent modeling scheme to explicitly enhance the DPMs' ability to contextual relation learning among object semantic parts in an image. During training, MDT operates in the latent space to mask certain tokens. Then, an asymmetric masking diffusion transformer is designed to predict masked tokens from unmasked ones while maintaining the diffusion generation process. Our MDT can reconstruct the full information of an image from its incomplete contextual input, thus enabling it to learn the associated relations among image tokens. Experimental results show that MDT achieves superior image synthesis performance, e.g., a new SOTA FID score in the ImageNet data set, and has about 3x faster learning speed than the previous SOTA DiT. The source code is released at https://github.com/sail-sg/MDT.
authors: Shanghua Gao, Pan Zhou, Ming-Ming Cheng, Shuicheng Yan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23164-23173

title: 掩码运动预测器是强大的三维动作表示学习者
title_en: Masked Motion Predictors are Strong 3D Action Representation Learners
abstract: 在三维人体动作识别中,有限的监督数据使得充分挖掘如Transformer等强大网络的建模潜力变得具有挑战性。因此,研究者们积极探讨有效的自监督预训练策略。本文表明,与遵循普遍的预文本任务进行人体关节的掩码自成分重建不同,显式的上下文运动建模是学习有效特征表示以实现三维动作识别成功的关键。形式化地,我们提出掩码运动预测(MAMP)框架。具体而言,所提出的MAMP以掩码时空骨架序列为输入,并预测对应掩码人体关节的时序运动。考虑到骨架序列的高时间冗余性,在我们的MAMP中,运动信息也作为经验语义丰富性先验,引导掩码过程,促进对语义丰富时间区域的更好关注。在NTU-60、NTU-120和PKU-MMD数据集上的大量实验表明,所提出的MAMP预训练显著提升了采用的原始Transformer模型性能,实现了无需复杂技巧的最先进结果。我们的MAMP源代码可在https://github.com/maoyunyao/MAMP获取。
abstract_en: In 3D human action recognition, limited supervised data makes it challenging to fully tap into the modeling potential of powerful networks such as transformers. As a result, researchers have been actively investigating effective self-supervised pre-training strategies. In this work, we show that instead of following the prevalent pretext task to perform masked self-component reconstruction in human joints, explicit contextual motion modeling is key to the success of learning effective feature representation for 3D action recognition. Formally, we propose the Masked Motion Prediction (MAMP) framework. To be specific, the proposed MAMP takes as input the masked spatio-temporal skeleton sequence and predicts the corresponding temporal motion of the masked human joints. Considering the high temporal redundancy of the skeleton sequence, in our MAMP, the motion information also acts as an empirical semantic richness prior that guide the masking process, promoting better attention to semantically rich temporal regions. Extensive experiments on NTU-60, NTU-120, and PKU-MMD datasets show that the proposed MAMP pre-training substantially improves the performance of the adopted vanilla transformer, achieving state-of-the-art results without bells and whistles. The source code of our MAMP is available at https://github.com/maoyunyao/MAMP.
authors: Yunyao Mao, Jiajun Deng, Wengang Zhou, Yao Fang, Wanli Ouyang, Houqiang Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10181-10191

title: 面向领域自适应目标检测的掩码重训练教师-学生框架
title_en: Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framework for Domain Adaptive Object Detection
abstract: 领域自适应目标检测(DAOD)利用带标签的领域(源域)学习能够泛化到无标注新领域(目标域)的目标检测器。近期进展采用教师-学生框架,即学生模型由教师模型生成的伪标签进行监督。尽管取得显著成果,但受限于领域迁移导致的伪框数量不足及错误预测,会误导学生模型获得次优结果。为缓解该问题,我们提出掩码重训练教师-学生框架(MRT),在检测Transformer中引入掩码自编码器和选择性重训练机制。具体而言,我们设计定制化的掩码自编码器分支,对目标图像的多尺度特征图进行掩码,并通过学生模型的编码器和辅助解码器重构特征。这有助于学生模型捕捉目标域特征,成为更高效的数据学习者,从有限伪框中获取知识。此外,我们采用选择性重训练机制,定期使用掩码自编码器优化后的权重重新初始化学生模型的部分参数,使模型跳出受错误伪标签偏倚的局部最优解。实验结果在三个DAOD基准数据集上验证了方法的有效性。代码可访问https://github.com/JeremyZhao1998/MRT-release。
abstract_en: Domain adaptive Object Detection (DAOD) leverages a labeled domain (source) to learn an object detector generalizing to a novel domain without annotation (target). Recent advances use a teacher-student framework, i.e., a student model is supervised by the pseudo labels from a teacher model. Though great success, they suffer from the limited number of pseudo boxes with incorrect predictions caused by the domain shift, misleading the student model to get sub-optimal results. To mitigate this problem, we propose Masked Retraining Teacher-student framework (MRT) which leverages masked autoencoder and selective retraining mechanism on detection transformer. Specifically, we present a customized design of masked autoencoder branch, masking the multi-scale feature maps of target images and reconstructing features by the encoder of the student model and an auxiliary decoder. This helps the student model capture target domain characteristics and become a more data-efficient learner to gain knowledge from the limited number of pseudo boxes. Furthermore, we adopt selective retraining mechanism, periodically re-initializing certain parts of the student parameters with masked autoencoder refined weights to allow the model to jump out of the local optimum biased to the incorrect pseudo labels. Experimental results on three DAOD benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. Code can be found at https://github.com/JeremyZhao1998/MRT-release.
authors: Zijing Zhao, Sitong Wei, Qingchao Chen, Dehui Li, Yifan Yang, Yuxin Peng, Yang Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19039-19049

title: 面向点云视频的自监督学习的掩码时空结构预测方法
title_en: Masked Spatio-Temporal Structure Prediction for Self-supervised Learning on Point Cloud Videos
abstract: 近期,研究社区在开发有效的点云视频理解方法方面取得了显著进展,这些方法通过大量标注数据进行学习。然而,标注点云视频通常成本高昂。此外,仅通过一个或少数传统任务(如分类)进行训练可能不足以学习点云视频中存在的时间空间结构的细微细节。本文提出了一种掩码时空结构预测(MaST-Pre)方法,无需人工标注即可捕捉点云视频的结构。MaST-Pre基于时空点管掩码,包含两个自监督学习任务。首先,通过重建掩码点管,我们的方法能够捕捉点云视频的外观信息。其次,为学习运动,我们提出了一种时间基数差异预测任务,用于估计点管内点数的变化。通过这种方式,MaST-Pre被强制建模点云视频中的空间和时间结构。在MSRAction-3D、NTU-RGBD、NvGesture和SHREC'17数据集上的大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Recently, the community has made tremendous progress in developing effective methods for point cloud video understanding that learn from massive amounts of labeled data. However, annotating point cloud videos is usually notoriously expensive. Moreover, training via one or only a few traditional tasks (e.g., classification) may be insufficient to learn subtle details of the spatio-temporal structure existing in point cloud videos. In this paper, we propose a Masked Spatio-Temporal Structure Prediction (MaST-Pre) method to capture the structure of point cloud videos without human annotations. MaST-Pre is based on spatio-temporal point-tube masking and consists of two self-supervised learning tasks. First, by reconstructing masked point tubes, our method is able to capture the appearance information of point cloud videos. Second, to learn motion, we propose a temporal cardinality difference prediction task that estimates the change in the number of points within a point tube. In this way, MaST-Pre is forced to model the spatial and temporal structure in point cloud videos. Extensive experiments on MSRAction-3D, NTU-RGBD, NvGesture, and SHREC'17 demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
authors: Zhiqiang Shen, Xiaoxiao Sheng, Hehe Fan, Longguang Wang, Yulan Guo, Qiong Liu, Hao Wen, Xi Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16580-16589

title: Masked Spiking Transformer
title_en: Masked Spiking Transformer
abstract: 脉冲神经网络(SNNs)与Transformer的结合由于其在高能效和高性能方面的潜力而引起了广泛关注。然而,现有相关研究通常依赖直接训练,这可能导致次优性能。为解决这一问题,我们提出利用ANN到SNN转换方法的优势,将SNNs与Transformer相结合,从而在现有最先进SNN模型的基础上实现显著性能提升。此外,受神经系统中观察到的量子突触失败现象启发,该现象通过减少突触间脉冲传输数量来降低能耗,我们引入了一种新颖的掩码脉冲Transformer(MST)框架。该框架集成了随机脉冲掩码(RSM)方法,通过剪枝冗余脉冲在不牺牲性能的前提下降低能耗。实验结果表明,当掩码比率为75%时,所提出的MST模型在保持与未掩码模型相同性能水平的同时,实现了26.8%的功耗降低。代码已开源:https://github.com/bic-L/Masked-Spiking-Transformer
abstract_en: The combination of Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) and Transformers has attracted significant attention due to their potential for high energy efficiency and high-performance nature. However, existing works on this topic typically rely on direct training, which can lead to suboptimal performance. To address this issue, we propose to leverage the benefits of the ANN-to-SNN conversion method to combine SNNs and Transformers, resulting in significantly improved performance over existing state-of-the-art SNN models. Furthermore, inspired by the quantal synaptic failures observed in the nervous system, which reduce the number of spikes transmitted across synapses, we introduce a novel Masked Spiking Transformer (MST) framework. This incorporates a Random Spike Masking (RSM) method to prune redundant spikes and reduce energy consumption without sacrificing performance. Our experimental results demonstrate that the proposed MST model achieves a significant reduction of 26.8% in power consumption when the masking ratio is 75% while maintaining the same level of performance as the unmasked model. The code is available at: https://github.com/bic-L/Masked-Spiking-Transformer.
authors: Ziqing Wang, Yuetong Fang, Jiahang Cao, Qiang Zhang, Zhongrui Wang, Renjing Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1761-1771

title: 掌握道路网络的空间图预测
title_en: Mastering Spatial Graph Prediction of Road Networks
abstract: 从卫星图像中准确预测道路网络需要对网络拓扑结构具有全局理解。我们提出通过引入一种基于图的框架来捕捉此类高层信息,该框架在给定部分生成的图的基础上,按顺序添加新边。为了解决模型预测与预期目标之间的错位,并优化复杂、非连续的兴趣度量指标,我们采用强化学习(RL)方法,提名能够最大化累积奖励的修改方案。与通常受限于常用替代损失函数的监督技术不同,我们的框架能够更有力且灵活地编码与问题相关的知识。在多个基准数据集上的实证结果表明,使用基于树的搜索方法可提升对图拓扑结构的高层推理能力。我们进一步证明了该方法在处理存在显著遮挡的示例中的优越性,并提供了证据表明我们的预测更符合地面数据集的统计特性。
abstract_en: Accurately predicting road networks from satellite images requires a global understanding of the network topology. We propose to capture such high-level information by introducing a graph-based framework that given a partially generated graph, sequentially adds new edges. To deal with misalignment between the model predictions and the intended purpose, and to optimize over complex, non-continuous metrics of interest, we adopt a reinforcement learning (RL) approach that nominates modifications that maximize a cumulative reward. As opposed to standard supervised techniques that tend to be more restricted to commonly used surrogate losses, our framework yields more power and flexibility to encode problem-dependent knowledge. Empirical results on several benchmark datasets demonstrate enhanced performance and increased high-level reasoning about the graph topology when using a tree-based search. We further demonstrate the superiority of our approach in handling examples with substantial occlusion and additionally provide evidence that our predictions better match the statistical properties of the ground dataset.
authors: Anagnostidis Sotiris, Aurelien Lucchi, Thomas Hofmann ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5408-5418

title: MatrixCity:面向城市级神经渲染及更广泛应用的大规模城市数据集
title_en: MatrixCity: A Large-scale City Dataset for City-scale Neural Rendering and Beyond
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRF)及其后续变体在神经渲染领域取得了显著进展。尽管近期大多数神经渲染研究聚焦于物体和小规模场景,但开发适用于城市级场景的神经渲染方法在许多现实应用中具有巨大潜力。然而,这一研究方向受到缺乏全面且高质量数据集的阻碍,而收集真实城市级场景的数据集成本高昂、敏感且技术上不可行。为此,我们构建了一个大规模、全面且高质量的合成数据集,用于城市级神经渲染研究。借助Unreal Engine 5 City Sample项目,我们开发了一套流程,可轻松采集航拍和街道视角的城市视图,并附带真实相机姿态及多种附加数据模态。我们的流程还支持对光照、天气、人群等环境因素的灵活控制,满足城市级神经渲染及相关任务的多样化需求。最终生成的试点数据集MatrixCity包含来自两个城市地图(总面积28平方公里)的67,000张航拍图像和452,000张街道图像。在MatrixCity基础上,我们还进行了全面的基准测试,不仅揭示了城市级神经渲染任务的独特挑战,也指出了未来工作的潜在改进方向。数据集和代码将在项目页面公开:https://city-super.github.io/matrixcity/
abstract_en: Neural radiance fields (NeRF) and its subsequent variants have led to remarkable progress in neural rendering. While most of recent neural rendering works focus on objects and small-scale scenes, developing neural rendering methods for city-scale scenes is of great potential in many real-world applications. However, this line of research is impeded by the absence of a comprehensive and high-quality dataset, yet collecting such a dataset over real city-scale scenes is costly, sensitive, and technically infeasible. To this end, we build a large-scale, comprehensive, and high-quality synthetic dataset for city-scale neural rendering researches. Leveraging the Unreal Engine 5 City Sample project, we developed a pipeline to easily collect aerial and street city views, accompanied by ground-truth camera poses and a range of additional data modalities. Flexible controls on environmental factors like light, weather, human and car crowd are also available in our pipeline, supporting the need of various tasks covering city-scale neural rendering and beyond. The resulting pilot dataset, MatrixCity, contains 67k aerial images and 452k street images from two city maps of total size 28km^2. On top of MatrixCity, a thorough benchmark is also conducted, which not only reveals unique challenges of the task of city-scale neural rendering, but also highlights potential improvements for future works. The dataset and code will be publicly available at the project page: https://city-super.github.io/matrixcity/.
authors: Yixuan Li, Lihan Jiang, Linning Xu, Yuanbo Xiangli, Zhenzhi Wang, Dahua Lin, Bo Dai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3205-3215

title: MatrixVT:面向三维感知的高效多摄像头至鸟眼视图变换方法
title_en: MatrixVT: Efficient Multi-Camera to BEV Transformation for 3D Perception
abstract: 本文提出了一种高效的多摄像头至鸟眼视图(BEV)变换方法用于三维感知,命名为MatrixVT。现有视图变换器要么存在较差的变换效率,要么依赖设备特定的操作符,阻碍了BEV模型的广泛应用。相比之下,我们的方法仅通过卷积和矩阵乘法(MatMul)高效生成BEV特征。具体而言,我们提出将BEV特征描述为图像特征与稀疏特征传输矩阵(FTM)的矩阵乘积。随后引入主成分提取模块以压缩图像特征维度并降低FTM的稀疏性。此外,我们提出环与射线分解方法,将FTM替换为两个矩阵并重构流程以进一步减少计算量。与现有方法相比,MatrixVT在保持部署友好性的同时实现了更快的速度和更小的内存占用。在nuScenes基准上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在保持高效性的同时,在目标检测和地图分割任务中取得了与SOTA方法相当的结果。代码将公开。
abstract_en:
This paper proposes an efficient multi-camera to Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) view transformation method for 3D perception, dubbed MatrixVT.
 Existing view transformers either suffer from poor transformation efficiency or rely on device-specific operators, hindering the broad application of BEV models. In contrast, our method generates BEV features efficiently with only convolutions and matrix multiplications (MatMul). Specifically, we propose describing the BEV feature as the MatMul of image feature and a sparse Feature Transporting Matrix (FTM). A Prime Extraction module is then introduced to compress the dimension of image features and reduce FTM's sparsity. Moreover, we propose the Ring & Ray Decomposition to replace the FTM with two matrices and reformulate our pipeline to reduce calculation further. Compared to existing methods, MatrixVT enjoys a faster speed and less memory footprint while remaining deploy-friendly. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes benchmark demonstrate that our method is highly efficient but obtains results on par with the SOTA method in object detection and map segmentation tasks. Code will be available.
authors: Hongyu Zhou, Zheng Ge, Zeming Li, Xiangyu Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8548-8557

title: MeMOTR:基于长期记忆增强的Transformer多目标跟踪方法
title_en: MeMOTR: Long-Term Memory-Augmented Transformer for Multi-Object Tracking
abstract: 作为视频任务,多目标跟踪(MOT)旨在有效捕捉目标的时序信息。不幸的是,大多数现有方法仅显式利用相邻帧之间的对象特征,缺乏建模长期时序信息的能力。本文提出MeMOTR,一种用于多目标跟踪的长期记忆增强Transformer。我们的方法通过引入定制的记忆注意力层进行长期记忆注入,使同一对象的跟踪嵌入更加稳定和可区分。这显著提升了模型的目标关联能力。在DanceTrack数据集上的实验结果表明,MeMOTR在HOTA和AssA指标上分别超越了最先进方法7.9%和13.0%。此外,我们的模型在MOT17数据集上的关联性能也优于其他基于Transformer的方法,并在BDD100K数据集上表现出良好的泛化能力。代码已开源至https://github.com/MCG-NJU/MeMOTR。
abstract_en: As a video task, Multiple Object Tracking (MOT) is expected to capture temporal information of targets effectively. Unfortunately, most existing methods only explicitly exploit the object features between adjacent frames, while lacking the capacity to model long-term temporal information. In this paper, we propose MeMOTR, a long-term memory-augmented Transformer for multi-object tracking. Our method is able to make the same object's track embedding more stable and distinguishable by leveraging long-term memory injection with a customized memory-attention layer. This significantly improves the target association ability of our model. Experimental results on DanceTrack show that MeMOTR impressively surpasses the state-of-the-art method by 7.9% and 13.0% on HOTA and AssA metrics, respectively. Furthermore, our model also outperforms other Transformer-based methods on association performance on MOT17 and generalizes well on BDD100K. Code is available at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/MeMOTR.
authors: Ruopeng Gao, Limin Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9901-9910

title: MeViS: 一种基于运动表达的视频分割大规模基准数据集
title_en: MeViS: A Large-scale Benchmark for Video Segmentation with Motion Expressions
abstract: 本文致力于运动表达引导的视频分割研究,重点在于基于描述物体运动的句子对视频内容中的物体进行分割。现有引用视频对象数据集通常聚焦于显著物体,并使用包含过多静态属性的语言表达,这些属性可能使目标物体在单帧中被识别。这些数据集弱化了运动在视频内容中对语言引导视频对象分割的重要性。为探究利用运动表达在视频中定位和分割物体的可行性,我们提出一个大规模数据集MeViS,其中包含大量运动表达以指示复杂环境中的目标物体。我们对5种现有的引用视频对象分割(RVOS)方法进行了基准测试,并在MeViS数据集上进行了全面比较。结果表明,当前RVOS方法无法有效解决运动表达引导的视频分割问题。我们进一步分析了挑战并提出了针对MeViS数据集的基线方法。本基准的目标是提供一个平台,促进开发有效的语言引导视频分割算法,利用运动表达作为复杂视频场景中物体分割的主要线索。提出的MeViS数据集已发布于https://henghuiding.github.io/MeViS。
abstract_en: This paper strives for motion expressions guided video segmentation, which focuses on segmenting objects in video content based on a sentence describing the motion of the objects. Existing referring video object datasets typically focus on salient objects and use language expressions that contain excessive static attributes that could potentially enable the target object to be identified in a single frame. These datasets downplay the importance of motion in video content for language-guided video object segmentation. To investigate the feasibility of using motion expressions to ground and segment objects in videos, we propose a large-scale dataset called MeViS, which contains numerous motion expressions to indicate target objects in complex environments. We benchmarked 5 existing referring video object segmentation (RVOS) methods and conducted a comprehensive comparison on the MeViS dataset. The results show that current RVOS methods cannot effectively address motion expression-guided video segmentation. We further analyze the challenges and propose a baseline approach for the proposed MeViS dataset. The goal of our benchmark is to provide a platform that enables the development of effective language-guided video segmentation algorithms that leverage motion expressions as a primary cue for object segmentation in complex video scenes. The proposed MeViS dataset has been released at https://henghuiding.github.io/MeViS.
authors: Henghui Ding, Chang Liu, Shuting He, Xudong Jiang, Chen Change Loy ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2694-2703

title: 测量并行持续学习中的非对称梯度差异
title_en: Measuring Asymmetric Gradient Discrepancy in Parallel Continual Learning
abstract: 在并行持续学习(PCL)中,由于并行多任务的训练开始和结束时间不可预测,导致训练冲突和灾难性遗忘问题。这两个问题的产生源于并行任务的梯度在方向和幅度上存在差异。因此,本文将PCL转化为梯度间的最小距离优化问题,并提出显式的非对称梯度距离(AGD)来评估PCL中的梯度差异。AGD同时考虑梯度幅度比和方向,并在更新时对反向小梯度具有容忍性,从而减少梯度不平衡对并行任务训练的影响。此外,我们提出了一种新颖的最大差异优化(MaxDO)策略,用于最小化多个梯度间的最大差异。通过AGD结合MaxDO求解,平行训练可降低训练冲突的影响并抑制已完成任务的灾难性遗忘。大量实验验证了我们的方法在三个图像识别数据集上的有效性。
abstract_en: In Parallel Continual Learning (PCL), the parallel multiple tasks start and end training unpredictably, thus suffering from training conflict and catastrophic forgetting issues. The two issues are raised because the gradients from parallel tasks differ in directions and magnitudes. Thus, in this paper, we formulate the PCL into a minimum distance optimization problem among gradients and propose an explicit Asymmetric Gradient Distance (AGD) to evaluate the gradient discrepancy in PCL. AGD considers both gradient magnitude ratios and directions, and has a tolerance when updating with a small gradient of inverse direction, which reduces the imbalanced influence of gradients on parallel task training. Moreover, we propose a novel Maximum Discrepancy Optimization (MaxDO) strategy to minimize the maximum discrepancy among multiple gradients. Solving by MaxDO with AGD, parallel training reduces the influence of the training conflict and suppresses the catastrophic forgetting of finished tasks. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach on three image recognition datasets.
authors: Fan Lyu, Qing Sun, Fanhua Shang, Liang Wan, Wei Feng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11411-11420

title: MedKLIP: 基于医学知识增强的X线诊断语言-图像预训练
title_en: MedKLIP: Medical Knowledge Enhanced Language-Image Pre-Training for X-ray Diagnosis
abstract: 本文考虑通过利用放射科日常实践中配对的图像-文本报告,增强医学视觉-语言预训练(VLP)与领域特定知识。具体而言,我们做出以下贡献:首先,不同于现有工作直接处理原始报告,我们采用新颖的三元组提取模块提取医学相关信息,避免语言语法带来的冗余复杂性,增强监督信号;其次,我们提出基于知识库查询的实体翻译新型三元组编码模块,以挖掘医学领域的丰富领域知识,并在语言嵌入空间中隐式构建医学实体间关系;第三,我们提出采用基于Transformer的融合模型,在图像块级别对实体描述与视觉信号进行空间对齐,实现医学诊断能力;第四,我们开展系统实验验证架构有效性,并在多个公共基准数据集(如ChestX-ray14、RSNA肺炎、SIIM-ACR气胸、COVIDx CXR-2、COVID Rural和水肿严重程度)上进行基准测试。在零样本和微调设置下,我们的模型在疾病分类和定位任务中均展现出优于前序方法的性能。
abstract_en:
In this paper, we consider enhancing medical visual-language pre-training (VLP) with domain-specific knowledge, by exploiting the paired image-text reports from the radiological daily practice. In particular, we make the following contributions: First, unlike existing works that directly process the raw reports, we adopt a novel triplet extraction module to extract the medical-related information, avoiding unnecessary complexity from language grammar and enhancing the supervision signals; Second, we propose a novel triplet encoding module with entity translation
 by querying a knowledge base, to exploit the rich domain knowledge in medical field, and implicitly build relationships between medical entities in the language embedding space; Third, we propose to use a Transformer-based fusion model for spatially aligning the entity description with visual signals at the image patch level, enabling the ability for medical diagnosis; Fourth, we conduct thorough experiments to validate the effectiveness of our architecture, and benchmark on numerous public benchmarks e.g., ChestX-ray14, RSNA Pneumonia, SIIM-ACR Pneumothorax, COVIDx CXR-2, COVID Rural, and EdemaSeverity. In both zero-shot and fine-tuning settings, our model has demonstrated strong performance compared with the former methods on disease classification and grounding.
authors: Chaoyi Wu, Xiaoman Zhang, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang, Weidi Xie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21372-21383

title: 面向脉冲神经网络的膜电位批量归一化
title_en: Membrane Potential Batch Normalization for Spiking Neural Networks
abstract: 作为传统神经网络(CNNs)能效更高的替代方案,脉冲神经网络(SNNs)近年来获得了越来越多的关注。为训练深度模型,一些有效的批量归一化(BN)技术被提出应用于SNNs。所有这些BN方法均建议在卷积层后使用,如同在CNNs中常规操作。然而,脉冲神经元具有更复杂的时空动态特性。在BN层后的调控数据流将再次受到放电函数前膜电位更新操作(即非线性激活)的干扰。因此,我们主张在放电函数前增加另一层BN,对膜电位进行二次归一化,称为MPBN。为消除MPBN引入的时间成本,我们还提出一种训练-推理解耦的重参数化技术,将训练好的MPBN折叠至放电阈值中。通过该重参数化技术,MPBN在推理阶段不会引入额外的时间负担。此外,MPBN还可采用逐元素形式,而卷积层后的BN仅能使用通道-wise形式。实验结果表明,所提出的MPBN在主流非脉冲静态数据集和神经形态数据集上均表现出色。
abstract_en: As one of the energy-efficient alternatives of conventional neural networks (CNNs), spiking neural networks (SNNs) have gained more and more interest recently. To train the deep models, some effective batch normalization (BN) techniques are proposed in SNNs. All these BNs are suggested to be used after the convolution layer as usually doing in CNNs. However, the spiking neuron is much more complex with spatiotemporal dynamics. The regulated data flow after the BN layer will be disturbed again by the membrane potential updating operation before the firing function, i.e., the nonlinear activation. Therefore, we advocate adding another BN layer before the firing function to normalize the membrane potential again, called MPBN. To eliminate the induced time cost of MPBN, we also propose a training-inference-decoupled re-parameterization technique to fold the trained MPBN into the firing threshold. With the re-parameterization technique, the MPBN will not induce any extra time burden in the inference. Furthermore, the MPBN can also adopt the element-wised form, while the BN after the convolution layer can only use the channel-wised form. Experimental results show that the proposed MPBN performs well on both popular non-spiking static and neuromorphic datasets.
authors: Yufei Guo, Yuhan Zhang, Yuanpei Chen, Weihang Peng, Xiaode Liu, Liwen Zhang, Xuhui Huang, Zhe Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19420-19430

title: 基于记忆与预判的Transformer在线动作理解
title_en: Memory-and-Anticipation Transformer for Online Action Understanding
abstract: 现有大多数预测系统均为基于记忆的方法,其通过采用多种记忆机制模仿人类预测能力,并在记忆依赖的时间建模方面取得进展。然而,该范式的明显弱点在于仅能建模有限的历史依赖性,无法超越过去。本文重新思考事件演化的时序依赖性,提出一种新型基于记忆与预判的范式,以建模包含过去、现在和未来的完整时间结构。基于此思想,我们提出Memory-and-Anticipation Transformer(MAT),一种基于记忆与预判的方法,用于解决在线动作检测与预判任务。此外,由于MAT的固有优势,其可统一处理在线动作检测与预判任务。所提出的MAT模型在四个具有挑战性的基准数据集TVSeries、THUMOS'14、HDD和EPIC-Kitchens-100上进行在线动作检测与预判任务测试,显著优于所有现有方法。代码已开源至https://github.com/Echo0125/Memory-and-Anticipation-Transformer。
abstract_en: Most existing forecasting systems are memory-based methods, which attempt to mimic human forecasting ability by employing various memory mechanisms and have progressed in temporal modeling for memory dependency. Nevertheless, an obvious weakness of this paradigm is that it can only model limited historical dependence and can not transcend the past. In this paper, we rethink the temporal dependence of event evolution and propose a novel memory-anticipation-based paradigm to model an entire temporal structure, including the past, present, and future. Based on this idea, we present Memory-and-Anticipation Transformer (MAT), a memory-anticipation-based approach, to address the online action detection and anticipation tasks. In addition, owing to the inherent superiority of MAT, it can process online action detection and anticipation tasks in a unified manner. The proposed MAT model is tested on four challenging benchmarks TVSeries, THUMOS'14, HDD, and EPIC-Kitchens-100, for online action detection and anticipation tasks, and it significantly outperforms all existing methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Echo0125/Memory-and-Anticipation-Transformer .
authors: Jiahao Wang, Guo Chen, Yifei Huang, Limin Wang, Tong Lu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13824-13835

title: MemorySeg:基于潜在记忆的在线激光雷达语义分割
title_en: MemorySeg: Online LiDAR Semantic Segmentation with a Latent Memory
abstract: 近年来,激光雷达点云的语义分割已被广泛研究,现有大多数方法集中于通过单次环境扫描来解决该任务。然而,利用时间序列的观测数据可以为可见性差的场景区域(如遮挡)或观测稀疏的区域(如远距离)提供非常丰富的上下文信息,并有助于减少逐帧冗余计算。本文旨在通过在线方式利用过去帧的信息来提升当前帧的预测效果。为解决这一挑战,我们提出了一种新颖的框架,用于对激光雷达点云时间序列进行语义分割,该框架利用记忆网络存储、更新和检索过去信息。我们的框架还包括一个新颖的正则化器,用于惩罚点云邻域中的预测变化。先前的工作尝试将记忆整合到范围视图表示中进行语义分割,但这些方法未能有效处理遮挡问题,且当附近代理移动时,场景的范围视图表示会发生剧烈变化。我们提出的框架通过构建周围环境的稀疏3D潜在表示克服了这些局限性。我们在SemanticKITTI、nuScenes和PandaSet数据集上评估了我们的方法。实验结果表明,与现有最先进的方法相比,所提出的框架具有有效性。如需更多信息,请访问项目网站:https://waabi.ai/research/memoryseg。
abstract_en: Semantic segmentation of LiDAR point clouds has been widely studied in recent years, with most existing methods focusing on tackling this task using a single scan of the environment. However, leveraging the temporal stream of observations can provide very rich contextual information on regions of the scene with poor visibility (e.g., occlusions) or sparse observations (e.g., at long range), and can help reduce redundant computation frame after frame. In this paper, we tackle the challenge of exploiting the information from the past frames to improve the predictions of the current frame in an online fashion. To address this challenge, we propose a novel framework for semantic segmentation of a temporal sequence of LiDAR point clouds that utilizes a memory network to store, update and retrieve past information. Our framework also includes a novel regularizer that penalizes prediction variations in the neighborhood of the point cloud. Prior works have attempted to incorporate memory in range view representations for semantic segmentation, but these methods fail to handle occlusions and the range view representation of the scene changes drastically as agents nearby move. Our proposed framework overcomes these limitations by building a sparse 3D latent representation of the surroundings. We evaluate our method on SemanticKITTI, nuScenes, and PandaSet. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework compared to the state-of-the-art. For more information, visit the project website: https://waabi.ai/research/memoryseg.
authors: Enxu Li, Sergio Casas, Raquel Urtasun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 745-754

title: Mesh2Tex: 从图像查询生成网格纹理
title_en: Mesh2Tex: Generating Mesh Textures from Image Queries
abstract: 近期在学习表征物体几何的神经表示方面取得了显著进展,但生成适用于下游应用和3D渲染的纹理化物体仍处于早期阶段。特别是从真实物体图像中重建纹理几何是一个重大挑战——重建的几何通常不精确,使得真实纹理化变得尤为困难。我们提出Mesh2Tex,通过混合网格-神经场纹理表示,从不相关的3D物体几何和逼真RGB图像集合中学习现实物体的纹理流形。我们的纹理表示能够在网格面的重心坐标系统中,以神经场形式紧凑编码高分辨率纹理。所学习的纹理流形能够有效导航,为给定的3D物体几何生成与输入RGB图像匹配的物体纹理,在网格几何近似与RGB图像底层几何不精确匹配的挑战性现实场景下仍能保持鲁棒性。Mesh2Tex能够有效生成真实物体纹理,使物体网格匹配真实图像观测,显著优于先前的最先进方法。
abstract_en: Remarkable advances have been achieved recently in learning neural representations that characterize object geometry, while generating textured objects suitable for downstream applications and 3D rendering remains at an early stage. In particular, reconstructing textured geometry from images of real objects is a significant challenge - reconstructed geometry is often inexact, making realistic texturing a significant challenge. We present Mesh2Tex, which learns a realistic object texture manifold from uncorrelated collections of 3D object geometry and photorealistic RGB images, by leveraging a hybrid mesh-neural-field texture representation. Our texture representation enables compact encoding of high-resolution textures as a neural field in the barycentric coordinate system of the mesh faces. The learned texture manifold enables effective navigation to generate an object texture for a given 3D object geometry that matches to an input RGB image, which maintains robustness even under challenging real-world scenarios where the mesh geometry approximates an inexact match to the underlying geometry in the RGB image. Mesh2Tex can effectively generate realistic object textures for an object mesh to match real images observations towards digitization of real environments, significantly improving over previous state of the art.
authors: Alexey Bokhovkin, Shubham Tulsiani, Angela Dai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8918-8928

title: 面向持续自适应分布外检测的元分布外学习
title_en: Meta OOD Learning For Continuously Adaptive OOD Detection
abstract: 分布外(OOD)检测对于现代深度学习应用至关重要,其核心功能是识别并预警不应被测试或用于预测的分布外样本。当前的分布外检测方法在分布内(ID)和分布外样本来自静态分布时取得了显著进展。然而,当应用于现实系统时,这种假设往往不现实,因为现实系统中的分布内和分布外分布通常会随时间持续变化和迁移。因此,为了在现实系统中有效应用,开发能够适应这些动态演变分布的分布外检测方法至关重要。本文提出了一种新颖且更贴近现实的设置,称为持续自适应分布外(CAOOD)检测,旨在开发一种能够在部署期间ID样本不足的情况下,实现对新到达分布的动态快速适应的分布外检测模型。为解决CAOOD问题,我们通过设计一种学习-适应图示,提出了元分布外学习(MOL)方法,使得在训练过程中能够学习到良好的初始分布外检测模型。在测试过程中,MOL通过少量适应快速适应新分布,从而确保在迁移分布上的分布外检测性能。在多个分布外基准数据集上的大量实验验证了我们方法在保持分布内分类准确性和持续迁移分布上的分布外检测性能方面的有效性。
abstract_en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is crucial to modern deep learning applications by identifying and alerting about the OOD samples that should not be tested or used for making predictions. Current OOD detection methods have made significant progress when in-distribution (ID) and OOD samples are drawn from static distributions. However, this can be unrealistic when applied to real-world systems which often undergo continuous variations and shifts in ID and OOD distributions over time. Therefore, for an effective application in real-world systems, the development of OOD detection methods that can adapt to these dynamic and evolving distributions is essential. In this paper, we propose a novel and more realistic setting called continuously adaptive out-of-distribution (CAOOD) detection which targets on developing an OOD detection model that enables dynamic and quick adaptation to a new arriving distribution, with insufficient ID samples during deployment time. To address CAOOD, we develop meta OOD learning (MOL) by designing a learning-to-adapt diagram such that a good initialized OOD detection model is learned during the training process. In the testing process, MOL ensures OOD detection performance over shifting distributions by quickly adapting to new distributions with a few adaptations. Extensive experiments on several OOD benchmarks endorse the effectiveness of our method in preserving both ID classification accuracy and OOD detection performance on continuously shifting distributions.
authors: Xinheng Wu, Jie Lu, Zhen Fang, Guangquan Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19353-19364

title: Meta-ZSDETR:基于元学习的零样本DETR
title_en: Meta-ZSDETR: Zero-shot DETR with Meta-learning
abstract: 零样本目标检测旨在定位和识别未见过的类别中的物体。现有大多数方法面临两个问题:在未见过的类别中区域提议网络(RPN)的召回率较低,以及未见过的类别与背景的混淆。本文提出了一种结合DETR和元学习进行零样本目标检测的方法,命名为Meta-ZSDETR,其中模型训练被形式化为基于单个episode的元学习任务。与首先生成类别无关提议并利用视觉语义对齐模块进行分类的基于Faster R-CNN的方法不同,Meta-ZSDETR直接使用类别特定查询预测类别特定的边界框,并进一步通过分类头预测的准确率进行过滤。模型采用元对比学习进行优化,包含一个回归头生成类别特定边界框的坐标,一个分类头预测生成边界框的准确率,以及一个利用所提出的对比重建损失进一步在视觉空间中分离不同类别的对比头。我们在两个基准数据集MS COCO和PASCAL VOC上进行了大量实验。实验结果表明,我们的方法在现有零样本检测(ZSD)方法上具有显著优势。
abstract_en: Zero-shot object detection aims to localize and recognize objects of unseen classes. Most of existing works face two problems: the low recall of RPN in unseen classes and the confusion of unseen classes with background. In this paper, we present the first method that combines DETR and meta-learning to perform zero-shot object detection, named Meta-ZSDETR, where model training is formalized as an individual episode based meta-learning task. Different from Faster R-CNN based methods that firstly generate class-agnostic proposals, and then classify them with visual-semantic alignment module, Meta-ZSDETR directly predict class-specific boxes with class-specific queries and further filter them with the predicted accuracy from classification head. The model is optimized with meta-contrastive learning, which contains a regression head to generate the coordinates of class-specific boxes, a classification head to predict the accuracy of generated boxes, and a contrastive head that utilizes the proposed contrastive-reconstruction loss to further separate different classes in visual space. We conduct extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets MS COCO and PASCAL VOC. Experimental results show that our method outperforms the existing ZSD methods by a large margin.
authors: Lu Zhang, Chenbo Zhang, Jiajia Zhao, Jihong Guan, Shuigeng Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6845-6854

title: MetaBEV:解决3D检测与地图分割中的传感器故障
title_en: MetaBEV: Solving Sensor Failures for 3D Detection and Map Segmentation
abstract: 现代自动驾驶车辆的感知系统通常采用互补的多模态传感器,例如LiDAR和摄像头。然而,在实际应用中,传感器损坏和故障会导致性能下降,从而影响自动驾驶安全。本文提出了一种鲁棒框架,称为MetaBEV,以应对包含六种传感器损坏和两种极端传感器缺失情况的极端现实环境。在MetaBEV中,多传感器信号首先通过模态特定编码器进行处理。随后,初始化一组密集的BEV查询,称为meta-BEV。这些查询随后通过BEV演化解码器进行迭代处理,该解码器选择性地从LiDAR、摄像头或两者融合的深层特征中聚合信息。更新后的BEV表示进一步用于多种3D预测任务。此外,我们引入了一种新的__ABS_MATH_1__结构以缓解多任务联合学习中不同任务的性能下降。最后,MetaBEV在nuScenes数据集上进行了评估,包含3D目标检测和BEV地图分割任务。实验表明,MetaBEV在完整和损坏模态下均显著优于现有方法。例如,当LiDAR信号缺失时,MetaBEV在vanilla BEVFusion模型基础上将检测NDS提升35.5%、分割mIoU提升17.7%;当摄像头信号缺失时,MetaBEV仍可达到69.2% NDS和53.7% mIoU,甚至高于在完整模态下表现的先前方法。此外,MetaBEV在常规感知和多任务学习设置中均表现出色,刷新了nuScenes BEV地图分割的最先进水平,达到70.4% mIoU。
abstract_en: Perception systems in modern autonomous driving vehicles typically take inputs from complementary multi-modal sensors, e.g., LiDAR and cameras. However, in real-world applications, sensor corruptions and failures lead to inferior performances, thus compromising autonomous safety. In this paper, we propose a robust framework, called MetaBEV, to address extreme real-world environments, involving overall six sensor corruptions and two extreme sensor-missing situations. In MetaBEV, signals from multiple sensors are first processed by modal-specific encoders. Subsequently, a set of dense BEV queries are initialized, termed meta-BEV. These queries are then processed iteratively by a BEV-Evolving decoder, which selectively aggregates deep features from either LiDAR, cameras, or both modalities. The updated BEV representations are further leveraged for multiple 3D prediction tasks. Additionally, we introduce a new \moe   structure to alleviate the performance drop on distinct tasks in multi-task joint learning. Finally, MetaBEV is evaluated on the nuScenes dataset with 3D object detection and BEV map segmentation tasks. Experiments show MetaBEV outperforms prior arts by a large margin on both full and corrupted modalities. For instance, when the LiDAR signal is missing, MetaBEV improves 35.5% detection NDS and 17.7% segmentation mIoU upon the vanilla BEVFusion model; and when the camera signal is absent, MetaBEV still achieves 69.2% NDS and 53.7%mIoU, which is even higher than previous works that perform on full-modalities. Moreover, MetaBEV performs moderately against previous methods in both canonical perception and multi-task learning settings, refreshing state-of-the-art nuScenes BEV map segmentation with 70.4% mIoU.
authors: Chongjian Ge, Junsong Chen, Enze Xie, Zhongdao Wang, Lanqing Hong, Huchuan Lu, Zhenguo Li, Ping Luo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8721-8731

title: MetaF2N:通过从人脸中学习高效模型适应实现盲图像超分辨率
title_en: MetaF2N: Blind Image Super-Resolution by Learning Efficient Model Adaptation from Faces
abstract: 由于高度结构化特性,人脸在盲图像超分辨率任务中比自然场景更容易恢复。因此,我们可以通过低质量与恢复人脸配对中提取图像的退化表示。利用该退化表示,可合成逼真的低质量图像以微调超分辨率模型,从而适应真实场景中的低质量图像。然而,这一过程耗时且繁琐,且恢复人脸与真实图像之间的差异进一步增加了优化不确定性。为促进针对图像特异性退化的高效模型适应,我们提出一种名为MetaF2N的方法,该方法在元学习框架中利用包含的人脸微调模型参数,以适应整个自然图像。因此,在MetaF2N中避开了退化提取和低质量图像合成步骤,仅需一次微调即可获得良好的性能。考虑到恢复人脸与真实图像之间的差异,我们进一步部署了MaskNet,用于自适应预测不同位置的损失权重,以降低低置信度区域的影响。为评估所提出的MetaF2N,我们收集了一个包含单张或多张人脸的真实低质量图像数据集,且MetaF2N在合成数据集和真实场景数据集上均表现出优越性能。源代码、预训练模型和收集的数据集可在https://github.com/yinzhicun/MetaF2N获取。
abstract_en: Due to their highly structured characteristics, faces are easier to recover than natural scenes for blind image super-resolution. Therefore, we can extract the degradation representation of an image from the low-quality and recovered face pairs. Using the degradation representation, realistic low-quality images can then be synthesized to fine-tune the super-resolution model for the real-world low-quality image. However, such a procedure is time-consuming and laborious, and the gaps between recovered faces and the ground-truths further increase the optimization uncertainty. To facilitate efficient model adaptation towards image-specific degradations, we propose a method dubbed MetaF2N, which leverages the contained faces to fine-tune model parameters for adapting to the whole natural image in a meta-learning framework. The degradation extraction and low-quality image synthesis steps are thus circumvented in our MetaF2N, and it requires only one fine-tuning step to get decent performance. Considering the gaps between the recovered faces and ground-truths, we further deploy a MaskNet for adaptively predicting loss weights at different positions to reduce the impact of low-confidence areas. To evaluate our proposed MetaF2N, we have collected a real-world low-quality dataset with one or multiple faces in each image, and our MetaF2N achieves superior performance on both synthetic and realworld datasets. Source code, pre-trained models, and collected datasets are available at https://github.com/yinzhicun/MetaF2N.
authors: Zhicun Yin, Ming Liu, Xiaoming Li, Hui Yang, Longan Xiao, Wangmeng Zuo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13033-13044

title: MetaGCD:在广义类别发现中学习持续学习
title_en: MetaGCD: Learning to Continually Learn in Generalized Category Discovery
abstract: 本文考虑一个现实场景,其中在预定义类别上训练的模型持续遇到包含已知和新类别的未标记数据。目标是在保持已知类别性能的同时持续发现新类别。我们将该设置命名为持续广义类别发现(C-GCD)。现有新类别发现方法由于一些不现实的假设(如未标记数据仅包含新类别)无法直接处理C-GCD设置,且未能以持续方式发现新类别。在本工作中,我们摒弃所有这些假设,提出一种名为MetaGCD的方法,以学习如何增量发现并减少遗忘。我们的方法采用元学习框架,利用离线标记数据模拟测试增量学习过程。定义了一个元目标,围绕两个冲突的学习目标以实现新类别发现而不遗忘。此外,提出了一种基于软邻域的对比网络,用于区分不相关图像并吸引相关图像。我们构建了强基线,并在三个广泛使用的基准上进行了大量实验,以证明方法的优越性。
abstract_en: In this paper, we consider a real-world scenario where a model that is trained on pre-defined classes continually encounters unlabeled data that contains both known and novel classes. The goal is to continually discover novel classes while maintaining the performance in known classes. We name the setting Continual Generalized Category Discovery (C-GCD). Existing methods for novel class discovery cannot directly handle the C-GCD setting due to some unrealistic assumptions, such as the unlabeled data only containing novel classes. Furthermore, they fail to discover novel classes in a continual fashion. In this work, we lift all these assumptions and propose an approach, called MetaGCD, to learn how to incrementally discover with less forgetting. Our proposed method uses a meta-learning framework and leverages the offline labeled data to simulate the testing incremental learning process. A meta-objective is defined to revolve around two conflicting learning objectives to achieve novel class discovery without forgetting. Furthermore, a soft neighborhood-based contrastive network is proposed to discriminate uncorrelated images while attracting correlated images. We build strong baselines and conduct extensive experiments on three widely used benchmarks to demonstrate the superiority of our method.
authors: Yanan Wu, Zhixiang Chi, Yang Wang, Songhe Feng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1655-1665

title: Metric3D: 面向单图像零样本度量三维预测
title_en: Metric3D: Towards Zero-shot Metric 3D Prediction from A Single Image
abstract: 从图像重建精确的三维场景是长期存在的视觉任务。由于单图像重建问题的病态性,大多数成熟方法均基于多视角几何。当前最先进的单目度量深度估计方法仅能处理单一相机模型,且因度量歧义问题无法进行混合数据训练。同时,基于大规模混合数据集训练的当前最优单目方法通过学习仿射不变深度实现零样本泛化,但无法恢复真实世界度量。本文表明,零样本单视角度量深度模型的关键在于大规模数据训练与从多种相机模型中解决度量歧义的结合。我们提出了一种规范相机空间变换模块,该模块显式解决歧义问题,并可轻松集成到现有单目模型中。借助我们的模块,单目模型可在800万张图像和数千种相机模型上稳定训练,实现对野外图像中未见过的相机设置的零样本泛化。实验结果表明,我们的方法在7个零样本基准测试中均达到最先进的性能。我们的方法可恢复随机采集的互联网图像的度量三维结构,实现合理的单图像计量。下游任务通过简单集成我们的模型也可显著提升。例如,我们的模型缓解了单目SLAM的尺度漂移问题(图1),实现了高精度的度量尺度密集映射。
abstract_en: Reconstructing accurate 3D scenes from images is a long-standing vision task. Due to the ill-posedness of the single-image reconstruction problem, most well-established methods are built upon multi-view geometry. State-of-the-art (SOTA) monocular metric depth estimation methods can only handle a single camera model and are unable to perform mixed-data training due to the metric ambiguity. Meanwhile, SOTA monocular methods trained on large mixed datasets achieve zero-shot generalization by learning affine-invariant depths, which cannot recover real-world metrics. In this work, we show that the key to a zero-shot single-view metric depth model lies in the combination of large-scale data training and resolving the metric ambiguity from various camera models. We propose a canonical camera space transformation module, which explicitly addresses the ambiguity problems and can be effortlessly plugged into existing monocular models. Equipped with our module, monocualr models can be stably trained over 8 millions of images with thousands of camera models, resulting in zero-shot generalization to in-the-wild images with unseen camera settings. Experiments demonstrate SOTA performance of our method on 7 zero-shot benchmarks. Our method can recover the metric 3D structure on randomly collected Internet images, enabling plausible single-image metrology. Downstream tasks can also be significantly improved by naively plug-in our model. E.g., our model relieves the scale drift issues of monocular-SLAM (Fig. 1), leading to metric scale high-quality dense mapping.
authors: Wei Yin, Chi Zhang, Hao Chen, Zhipeng Cai, Gang Yu, Kaixuan Wang, Xiaozhi Chen, Chunhua Shen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9043-9053

title: Mimic3D: 通过三维到二维模仿实现三维感知生成对抗网络的卓越表现
title_en: Mimic3D: Thriving 3D-Aware GANs via 3D-to-2D Imitation
abstract: 生成兼具照片级真实感和多视角三维一致性的图像对三维感知生成对抗网络(3D-aware GANs)至关重要,但现有方法难以同时实现这两者。通过基于卷积神经网络的二维超分辨率提升照片级真实感可能会破坏严格的三维一致性,而通过学习高分辨率三维表示进行直接渲染以保持三维一致性则往往牺牲图像质量。本文提出了一种新颖的学习策略,即三维到二维模仿(3D-to-2D imitation),通过让生成器的三维渲染分支生成的图像模仿其二维超分辨率分支生成的图像,使三维感知GAN能够生成高质量图像并保持严格的三维一致性。我们还将在生成器中引入三维感知卷积以提升三维表示学习效果,进一步提高图像生成质量。通过上述策略,我们的方法在FFHQ和AFHQ-v2 Cats数据集上分别达到512x512分辨率下的FID分数5.4和4.3,显著优于基于直接三维渲染的现有三维感知GANs,并接近利用二维超分辨率的先前最先进方法。项目网站: https://seanchenxy.github.io/Mimic3DWeb.
abstract_en: Generating images with both photorealism and multiview 3D consistency is crucial for 3D-aware GANs, yet existing methods struggle to achieve them simultaneously. Improving the photorealism via CNN-based 2D super-resolution can break the strict 3D consistency, while keeping the 3D consistency by learning high-resolution 3D representations for direct rendering often compromises image quality. In this paper, we propose a novel learning strategy, namely 3D-to-2D imitation, which enables a 3D-aware GAN to generate high-quality images while maintaining their strict 3D consistency, by letting the images synthesized by the generator's 3D rendering branch mimic those generated by its 2D super-resolution branch. We also introduce 3D-aware convolutions into the generator for better 3D representation learning, which further improves the image generation quality. With the above strategies, our method reaches FID scores of 5.4 and 4.3 on FFHQ and AFHQ-v2 Cats, respectively, at 512x512 resolution, largely outperforming existing 3D-aware GANs using direct 3D rendering and coming very close to the previous state-of-the-art method that leverages 2D super-resolution. Project website: https://seanchenxy.github.io/Mimic3DWeb.
authors: Xingyu Chen, Yu Deng, Baoyuan Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2338-2348

title: MiniROAD: 最小RNN框架用于在线动作检测
title_en: MiniROAD: Minimal RNN Framework for Online Action Detection
abstract: 在线动作检测(OAD)是识别流媒体视频中动作的任务,且无法访问未来帧。大量研究致力于有效捕捉长程依赖关系,Transformer模型因其能够捕捉长程时序结构而受到关注。相比之下,RNNs近期受到的关注较少,因其性能低于基于Transformer的方法。本文研究了RNNs性能劣于基于Transformer算法的根本原因。我们的发现表明,训练与推理阶段的差异是阻碍RNNs有效训练的主要因素。为解决这一问题,我们提出对每个时间步计算的损失应用非均匀权重,使RNN模型能够在更接近推理阶段的环境中学习预测结果。在三个基准数据集THUMOS、TVSeries和FineAction上的大量实验表明,采用所提方法训练的最小RNN模型在效率显著提升的情况下,性能与现有最佳方法相当或更优。代码已开源至https://github.com/jbistanbul/MiniROAD。
abstract_en: Online Action Detection (OAD) is the task of identifying actions in streaming videos without access to future frames. Much effort has been devoted to effectively capturing long-range dependencies, with transformers receiving the spotlight for their ability to capture long-range temporal structures. In contrast, RNNs have received less attention lately, due to their lower performance compared to recent methods that utilize transformers. In this paper, we investigate the underlying reasons for the inferior performance of RNNs compared to transformer-based algorithms. Our findings indicate that the discrepancy between training and inference is the primary hindrance to the effective training of RNNs. To address this, we propose applying non-uniform weights to the loss computed at each time step, which allows the RNN model to learn from the predictions made in an environment that better resembles the inference stage. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets, THUMOS, TVSeries, and FineAction demonstrate that a minimal RNN-based model trained with the proposed methodology performs equally or better than the existing best methods with a significant increase in efficiency. The code is available at https://github.com/jbistanbul/MiniROAD.
authors: Joungbin An, Hyolim Kang, Su Ho Han, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Seon Joo Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10341-10350

title: 广义三视角相对位姿问题的最小解
title_en: Minimal Solutions to Generalized Three-View Relative Pose Problem
abstract: 对于广义(或非中心)相机模型,两视角六点的最小问题已有高效求解器。然而,三视角四点和三视角六线的最小问题尚未被探索和解决,尽管计算机视觉领域已进行了诸多努力。本文开发了这两个最小问题的公式化表达,并展示了如何有效利用同伦持续求解器的GPU实现。所提出的方法在合成数据集和真实数据集上进行了评估,实验结果表明,这些方法在合成数据集和真实数据集上均表现出快速、准确的性能,并在假设与测试框架下提升了运动结构估计的精度。
abstract_en: For a generalized (or non-central) camera model, the minimal problem for two views of six points has efficient solvers. However, minimal problems of three views with four points and three views of six lines have not yet been explored and solved, despite the efforts from the computer vision community. This paper develops the formulations of these two minimal problems and shows how state-of-the-art GPU implementations of Homotopy Continuation solver can be used effectively. The proposed methods are evaluated on both synthetic and real datasets, demonstrating that they are fast, accurate and that they improve on structure from motion estimations, when employed in an hypothesis and test setting.
authors: Yaqing Ding, Chiang-Heng Chien, Viktor Larsson, Karl Åström, Benjamin Kimia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8156-8164

title: 已知共轭点的未校准双视图几何的最简解
title_en: Minimal Solutions to Uncalibrated Two-view Geometry with Known Epipoles
abstract: 本文提出了一种已知共轭点的未校准双视图几何的最简解方法。通过利用共轭点,我们可以减少求解基础矩阵及内参(焦距和径向镜头畸变)所需点对应数量。我们根据可用共轭点数量和未知内参数量定义了四种情况,然后为每种情况推导出单变量高阶多项式形式的闭式解。所提出的求解器在数值稳定性上优于传统6点或7点算法,并且速度提升数个数量级。此外,我们在人体姿态数据集上的实验表明,该方法即使在点定位噪声比一般特征点检测器更大的2D人体姿态情况下,仍能有效求解双视图几何。
abstract_en: This paper proposes minimal solutions to uncalibrated two-view geometry with known epipoles. Exploiting the epipoles, we can reduce the number of point correspondences needed to find the fundamental matrix together with the intrinsic parameters: the focal length and the radial lens distortion. We define four cases by the number of available epipoles and unknown intrinsic parameters, then derive a closed-form solution for each case formulated as a higher-order polynomial in a single variable. The proposed solvers are more numerically stable and faster by orders of magnitude than the conventional 6- or 7-point algorithms. Moreover, we demonstrate by experiments on the human pose dataset that the proposed method can solve two-view geometry even with 2D human pose, of which point localization is noisier than general feature point detectors.
authors: Gaku Nakano ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13361-13370

title: 最小延迟深度在线视频稳定化
title_en: Minimum Latency Deep Online Video Stabilization
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的摄像机路径优化框架,用于在线视频稳定化任务。通常,稳定化流程包括三个步骤:运动估计、路径平滑和新视角渲染。大多数先前方法集中在运动估计上,提出了各种全局或局部运动模型。相比之下,路径优化受到的关注相对较少,尤其是在重要的在线设置中,此时无法获取未来帧。在本工作中,我们采用近期现成的高质量深度运动模型进行运动估计以恢复摄像机轨迹,并专注于后两个步骤。我们的网络以滑动窗口中的短2D摄像机路径作为输入,输出窗口中最后一帧的稳定化变形场,该变形场将即将到达的帧变形到其稳定位置。定义了一种混合损失函数以约束空间和时间一致性。此外,我们构建了一个包含稳定与不稳定运动对的运动数据集用于训练。大量实验表明,我们的方法在定性和定量方面均显著优于最先进的在线方法,并且在性能上与离线方法相当。
abstract_en: We present a novel camera path optimization framework for the task of online video stabilization. Typically, a stabilization pipeline consists of three steps: motion estimating, path smoothing, and novel view rendering. Most previous methods concentrate on motion estimation, proposing various global or local motion models. In contrast, path optimization receives relatively less attention, especially in the important online setting, where no future frames are available. In this work, we adopt recent off-the-shelf high-quality deep motion models for motion estimation to recover the camera trajectory and focus on the latter two steps. Our network takes a short 2D camera path in a sliding window as input and outputs the stabilizing warp field of the last frame in the window, which warps the coming frame to its stabilized position. A hybrid loss is well-defined to constrain the spatial and temporal consistency. In addition, we build a motion dataset that contains stable and unstable motion pairs for the training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art online methods both qualitatively and quantitatively and achieves comparable performance to offline methods.
authors: Zhuofan Zhang, Zhen Liu, Ping Tan, Bing Zeng, Shuaicheng Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23030-23039

title: 从Voronoi单元中挖掘偏差-目标对齐
