title_en: Mining bias-target Alignment from Voronoi Cells
abstract: 尽管已有大量研究,深度神经网络仍易受偏差影响:这引发了对其公平性的担忧并限制了其泛化能力。本文提出了一种无偏差依赖的方法,以减轻深度神经网络中的偏差影响。与传统去偏差方法不同,我们依赖一个度量标准来量化目标类别上的"偏差对齐/错位",并利用该信息阻止偏差-目标对齐信息在网络中的传播。我们在多个常用的去偏差数据集上进行实验,并将我们的方法与监督学习和特定偏差方法进行比较。结果表明,尽管是无偏差依赖方法,所提方法在样本中存在多重偏差的情况下仍能实现与最先进监督方法相当的性能。
abstract_en:
Despite significant research efforts, deep neural networks remain vulnerable to biases: this raises concerns about their fairness and limits their generalization. In this paper, we propose a bias-agnostic approach to mitigate the impact of biases in deep neural networks. Unlike traditional debiasing approaches, we rely on a metric to quantify "bias alignment/misalignment" on target classes and use this information to discourage the propagation of bias-target alignment information through the network. We conduct experiments on several commonly used datasets for debiasing and compare our method with supervised and bias-specific
 approaches. Our results indicate that the proposed method achieves comparable performance to state-of-the-art supervised approaches, despite being bias-agnostic, even in the presence of multiple biases in the same sample.
authors: Rémi Nahon, Van-Tam Nguyen, Enzo Tartaglione ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4946-4955

title: 错位、对比然后蒸馏:重新思考语言-图像预训练中的对齐偏差
title_en: Misalign, Contrast then Distill: Rethinking Misalignments in Language-Image Pre-training
abstract: 对比语言-图像预训练已成为一种主流方法,用于通过网络上的非结构化图像-文本对训练视觉和文本编码器。为提高数据效率,近期研究引入了额外的监督项,涉及图像的随机增强视图。然而,由于图像增强过程未考虑其对应的文本信息,这一过程可能在训练中导致不同程度的图像-文本错位。先前方法要么忽略这一差异,要么引入外部模型以缓解训练中的错位影响。相反,我们提出了一种新的度量学习方法,利用这些错位作为额外的训练源,称为"错位、对比然后蒸馏(MCD)"。与先前将增强图像及其文本对应项视为简单正样本的方法不同,MCD预测由增强引起的连续错位尺度。大量实验结果表明,我们提出的MCD方法在多个分类和检索下游数据集上实现了最先进的迁移性能。
abstract_en: Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining has emerged as a prominent approach for training vision and text encoders with uncurated image-text pairs from the web. To enhance data-efficiency, recent efforts have introduced additional supervision terms that involve random-augmented views of the image. However, since the image augmentation process is unaware of its text counterpart, this procedure could cause various degrees of image-text misalignments during training. Prior methods either disregarded this discrepancy or introduced external models to mitigate the impact of misalignments during training. In contrast, we propose a novel metric learning approach that capitalizes on these misalignments as an additional training source, which we term "Misalign, Contrast then Distill (MCD)". Unlike previous methods that treat augmented images and their text counterparts as simple positive pairs, MCD predicts the continuous scales of misalignment caused by the augmentation. Our extensive experimental results show that our proposed MCD achieves state-of-the-art transferability in multiple classification and retrieval downstream datasets.
authors: Bumsoo Kim, Yeonsik Jo, Jinhyung Kim, Seunghwan Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2563-2572

title: 通过对抗双机器学习进行因果参数估计以缓解对抗脆弱性
title_en: Mitigating Adversarial Vulnerability through Causal Parameter Estimation by Adversarial Double Machine Learning
abstract: 通过在视觉输入上故意设计的扰动生成的对抗样本可以轻易损害深度神经网络的决策过程。为防止潜在威胁,基于对抗训练的防御方法迅速发展并成为提升鲁棒性的事实标准。尽管近期取得了竞争性成果,我们观察到对抗脆弱性在不同目标间存在差异,某些脆弱性仍普遍存在。有趣的是,即使采用更深层的架构和先进的防御方法,这种特殊现象仍无法缓解。为解决这一问题,本文引入了一种称为对抗双机器学习(ADML)的因果方法,该方法使我们能够量化网络预测的对抗脆弱性程度,并捕捉处理对目标结果的影响。ADML可直接估计对抗扰动本身的因果参数,并减轻可能损害鲁棒性的负面影响,将因果视角引入对抗脆弱性。通过在各种CNN和Transformer架构上的大量实验,我们证实ADML显著提升了对抗鲁棒性,并缓解了实证观察结果。
abstract_en: Adversarial examples derived from deliberately crafted perturbations on visual inputs can easily harm decision process of deep neural networks. To prevent potential threats, various adversarial training-based defense methods have grown rapidly and become a de facto standard approach for robustness. Despite recent competitive achievements, we observe that adversarial vulnerability varies across targets and certain vulnerabilities remain prevalent. Intriguingly, such peculiar phenomenon cannot be relieved even with deeper architectures and advanced defense methods. To address this issue, in this paper, we introduce a causal approach called Adversarial Double Machine Learning (ADML), which allows us to quantify the degree of adversarial vulnerability for network predictions and capture the effect of treatments on outcome of interests. ADML can directly estimate causal parameter of adversarial perturbations per se and mitigate negative effects that can potentially damage robustness, bridging a causal perspective into the adversarial vulnerability. Through extensive experiments on various CNN and Transformer architectures, we corroborate that ADML improves adversarial robustness with large margins and relieve the empirical observation.
authors: Byung-Kwan Lee, Junho Kim, Yong Man Ro ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4499-4509

title: 缓解与评估动作表示中的背景与前景静态偏差
title_en: Mitigating and Evaluating Static Bias of Action Representations in the Background and the Foreground
abstract: 在视频动作识别中,捷径静态特征会干扰运动特征的学习,导致分布外(OOD)泛化能力较差。视频背景显然是静态偏差的来源,但视频前景(如演员的服装)也可能提供静态偏差。本文通过创建包含静态和运动部分冲突信号的测试视频,实证验证了前景静态偏差的存在。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种简单而有效的技术StillMix,用于学习鲁棒的动作表示。具体而言,StillMix利用2D参考网络识别导致偏差的视频帧,并将其与视频混合用于训练,即使无法在每个视频帧中显式提取偏差源或列举偏差类型,也能有效抑制偏差。最后,为精确评估静态偏差,我们合成两个新基准:SCUBA用于背景中的静态提示,SCUFO用于前景中的静态提示。通过大量实验,我们证明StillMix能够缓解两种类型的静态偏差,并提升视频表示在下游应用中的性能。
abstract_en: In video action recognition, shortcut static features can interfere with the learning of motion features, resulting in poor out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. The video background is clearly a source of static bias, but the video foreground, such as the clothing of the actor, can also provide static bias. In this paper, we empirically verify the existence of foreground static bias by creating test videos with conflicting signals from the static and moving portions of the video. To tackle this issue, we propose a simple yet effective technique, StillMix, to learn robust action representations. Specifically, StillMix identifies bias-inducing video frames using a 2D reference network and mixes them with videos for training, serving as effective bias suppression even when we cannot explicitly extract the source of bias within each video frame or enumerate types of bias. Finally, to precisely evaluate static bias, we synthesize two new benchmarks, SCUBA for static cues in the background, and SCUFO for static cues in the foreground. With extensive experiments, we demonstrate that StillMix mitigates both types of static bias and improves video representations for downstream applications.
authors: Haoxin Li, Yuan Liu, Hanwang Zhang, Boyang Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19911-19923

title: MixBag:基于袋级数据增强的从标签比例学习方法
title_en: MixBag: Bag-Level Data Augmentation for Learning from Label Proportions
abstract: 从标签比例学习(LLP)是一种有前景的弱监督学习问题。在LLP中,一组实例(袋)具有标签比例但没有实例级标签。LLP的目标是通过利用袋的标签比例来训练实例级分类器。本文提出了一种针对LLP的袋级数据增强方法MixBag,该方法基于我们初步实验中的关键观察:即使总实例数固定,随着标记袋数量的增加,实例级分类准确率也会提高。我们还设计了一种基于统计理论的置信区间损失函数,以有效利用增强后的袋。据我们所知,这是首次尝试为LLP提出袋级数据增强方法。MixBag的优势在于可以应用于实例级数据增强技术以及任何使用比例损失的LLP方法。实验结果验证了该优势并证明了我们方法的有效性。
abstract_en:
Learning from label proportions (LLP) is a promising weakly supervised learning problem. In LLP, a set of instances (bag) has label proportions but no instance-level labels.
 LLP aims to train an instance-level classifier by using the label proportions of the bag.
 In this paper, we propose a bag-level data augmentation method for LLP called MixBag, which is based on the key observation from our preliminary experiments; that the instance-level classification accuracy improves as the number of labeled bags increases even though the total number of instances is fixed. 
 We also propose a confidence interval loss designed based on statistical theory in order to use the augmented bags effectively.
 To the best of our knowledge, this is the first attempt to propose bag-level data augmentation for LLP.
 The advantage of MixBag is that it can be applied to instance-level data augmentation techniques and any LLP method that uses the proportion loss.
 Experimental results demonstrate this advantage and the effectiveness of our method.
authors: Takanori Asanomi, Shinnosuke Matsuo, Daiki Suehiro, Ryoma Bise ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16570-16579

title: MixCycle: 基于Mixup辅助的半监督三维单目标跟踪与循环一致性
title_en: MixCycle: Mixup Assisted Semi-Supervised 3D Single Object Tracking with Cycle Consistency
abstract: 三维单目标跟踪(SOT)是自动驾驶系统不可或缺的关键技术。现有方法严重依赖大规模密集标注数据集。然而,点云标注既昂贵又耗时。受无监督二维SOT中循环跟踪技术巨大成功启发,我们首次将半监督方法引入三维SOT。具体而言,我们提出两种循环一致性策略用于监督:1)自跟踪循环,利用标签帮助模型在训练初期更好地收敛;2)前向-后向循环,增强跟踪器对运动变化及模板更新策略引起的模板噪声的鲁棒性。此外,我们提出一种名为SOTMixup的数据增强策略,以提升跟踪器对点云多样性的鲁棒性。SOTMixup通过在两个点云中以混合率采样点生成训练样本,并根据混合率分配合理的损失权重进行训练。所提出的MixCycle方法可泛化至基于外观匹配的跟踪器。在KITTI基准测试中,基于P2B跟踪器,MixCycle仅使用10%标签训练的性能优于使用100%标签训练的P2B,且在使用1%标签时实现28.4%的精度提升。我们的代码将在https://github.com/Mumuqiao/MixCycle发布。
abstract_en: 3D single object tracking (SOT) is an indispensable part of automated driving. Existing approaches rely heavily on large, densely labeled datasets. However, annotating point clouds is both costly and time-consuming. Inspired by the great success of cycle tracking in unsupervised 2D SOT, we introduce the first semi-supervised approach to 3D SOT. Specifically, we introduce two cycle-consistency strategies for supervision: 1) Self tracking cycles, which leverage labels to help the model converge better in the early stages of training; 2) forward-backward cycles, which strengthen the tracker's robustness to motion variations and the template noise caused by the template update strategy. Furthermore, we propose a data augmentation strategy named SOTMixup to improve the tracker's robustness to point cloud diversity. SOTMixup generates training samples by sampling points in two point clouds with a mixing rate and assigns a reasonable loss weight for training according to the mixing rate. The resulting MixCycle approach generalizes to appearance matching-based trackers. On the KITTI benchmark, based on the P2B tracker, MixCycle trained with 10% labels outperforms P2B trained with 100% labels, and achieves a 28.4% precision improvement when using 1% labels. Our code will be released at https://github.com/Mumuqiao/MixCycle.
authors: Qiao Wu, Jiaqi Yang, Kun Sun, Chu'ai Zhang, Yanning Zhang, Mathieu Salzmann ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13956-13966

title: MixPath:一种用于单次神经架构搜索的统一方法
title_en: MixPath: A Unified Approach for One-shot Neural Architecture Search
abstract: 在神经架构设计中,融合多个卷积核已被证明是有益的。然而,当前的两阶段神经架构搜索方法主要局限于单路径搜索空间。如何高效搜索多路径结构的模型仍是一个难题。在本文中,我们旨在训练一个单次多路径超网络以准确评估候选架构。具体而言,我们发现,在所研究的搜索空间中,来自多路径的特征向量总和几乎等于单路径特征向量的倍数。这种差异会干扰超网络的训练及其排序能力。因此,我们提出了一种名为Shadow Batch Normalization(SBN)的新机制,用于规范差异化的特征统计量。大量实验表明,SBN能够稳定优化过程并提升排序性能。我们将这种统一的多路径单次方法称为MixPath,该方法生成一系列在ImageNet上取得最先进结果的模型。
abstract_en: Blending multiple convolutional kernels is proved advantageous in neural architecture design. However, current two-stage neural architecture search methods are mainly limited to single-path search spaces. How to efficiently search models of multi-path structures remains a difficult problem. In this paper, we are motivated to train a one-shot multi-path supernet to accurately evaluate the candidate architectures. Specifically, we discover that in the studied search spaces, feature vectors summed from multiple paths are nearly multiples of those from a single path. Such disparity perturbs the supernet training and its ranking ability. Therefore, we propose a novel mechanism called Shadow Batch Normalization (SBN) to regularize the disparate feature statistics. Extensive experiments prove that SBNs are capable of stabilizing the optimization and improving ranking performance. We call our unified multi-path one-shot approach as MixPath, which generates a series of models that achieve state-of-the-art results on ImageNet.
authors: Xiangxiang Chu, Shun Lu, Xudong Li, Bo Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5972-5981

title: MixReorg: 跨模态混合补丁重组是开放世界语义分割的优秀掩码学习方法
title_en: MixReorg: Cross-Modal Mixed Patch Reorganization is a Good Mask Learner for Open-World Semantic Segmentation
abstract: 近期,采用图像级文本监督训练的语义分割模型在具有挑战性的开放世界场景中展现出 promising results。然而,这些模型在学习像素级细粒度语义对齐和预测准确物体掩码方面仍面临困难。为解决这一问题,我们提出 MixReorg,一种新颖且简洁的语义分割预训练范式,通过增强模型对跨图像混合补丁的重组能力,探索局部视觉相关性与全局语义一致性。我们的方法通过混合图像补丁并保持补丁与文本之间的对应关系,生成细粒度补丁-文本对数据。模型随后被训练以最小化混合图像的分割损失以及原始特征与恢复特征的两个对比损失。以 MixReorg 作为掩码学习者,传统文本监督语义分割模型可实现高度可泛化的像素-语义对齐能力,这对开放世界分割至关重要。在大规模图像-文本数据训练后,MixReorg 模型可直接用于分割任意类别的视觉对象,无需进一步微调。我们的框架在流行的零样本语义分割基准上展现出强大性能,在 PASCAL VOC2012、PASCAL Context、MS COCO 和 ADE20K 数据集上分别以 5.0%、6.2%、2.5% 和 3.4% 的 mIoU 超越 GroupViT。
abstract_en: Recently, semantic segmentation models trained with image-level text supervision have shown promising results in challenging open-world scenarios. However, these models still face difficulties in learning fine-grained semantic alignment at the pixel level and predicting accurate object masks. To address this issue, we propose MixReorg, a novel and straightforward pre-training paradigm for semantic segmentation that enhances a model's ability to reorganize patches mixed across images, exploring both local visual relevance and global semantic coherence. Our approach involves generating fine-grained patch-text pairs data by mixing image patches while preserving the correspondence between patches and text. The model is then trained to minimize the segmentation loss of the mixed images and the two contrastive losses of the original and restored features. With MixReorg as a mask learner, conventional text-supervised semantic segmentation models can achieve highly generalizable pixel-semantic alignment ability, which is crucial for open-world segmentation. After training with large-scale image-text data, MixReorg models can be applied directly to segment visual objects of arbitrary categories, without the need for further fine-tuning. Our proposed framework demonstrates strong performance on popular zero-shot semantic segmentation benchmarks, outperforming GroupViT by significant margins of 5.0%, 6.2%, 2.5%, and 3.4% mIoU on PASCAL VOC2012, PASCAL Context, MS COCO, and ADE20K, respectively.
authors: Kaixin Cai, Pengzhen Ren, Yi Zhu, Hang Xu, Jianzhuang Liu, Changlin Li, Guangrun Wang, Xiaodan Liang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1196-1205

title: MixSpeech: 基于音频-视觉流混合的跨模态自学习用于视觉语音翻译与识别
title_en: MixSpeech: Cross-Modality Self-Learning with Audio-Visual Stream Mixup for Visual Speech Translation and Recognition
abstract: 多模态通信促进了全球范围内的交流互动。然而,尽管研究者探索了诸如机器翻译和音频语音翻译等跨语言翻译技术以克服语言障碍,但针对视觉语音的跨语言研究仍显不足。这种研究缺失主要源于缺乏包含视觉语音与翻译文本对的数据集。本文提出AVMuST-TED,这是首个用于音频-视觉多语言语音翻译的数据集,源自TED演讲。然而,视觉语音的可区分性不如音频语音,使得从源语音音素到目标语言文本的映射难以建立。为解决这一问题,我们提出MixSpeech,一种利用音频语音对视觉语音任务进行训练正则化的跨模态自学习框架。为进一步缩小跨模态差距及其对知识迁移的影响,我们建议采用通过插值音频与视觉流生成的混合语音,以及根据需求调整混合比例的课程学习策略。MixSpeech在噪声环境中提升了语音翻译性能,在AVMuST-TED数据集上对四种语言的BLEU分数提升了+1.4至+4.2。此外,它在CMLR(11.1%)、LRS2(25.5%)和LRS3(28.0%)数据集的唇读任务中达到了最先进水平。
abstract_en: Multi-media communications facilitate global interaction among people. However, despite researchers exploring cross-lingual translation techniques such as machine translation and audio speech translation to overcome language barriers, there is still a shortage of cross-lingual studies on visual speech. This lack of research is mainly due to the absence of datasets containing visual speech and translated text pairs. In this paper, we present AVMuST-TED, the first dataset for Audio-Visual Multilingual Speech Translation, derived from TED talks. Nonetheless, visual speech is not as distinguishable as audio speech, making it difficult to develop a mapping from source speech phonemes to the target language text. To address this issue, we propose MixSpeech, a cross-modality self-learning framework that utilizes audio speech to regularize the training of visual speech tasks. To further minimize the cross-modality gap and its impact on knowledge transfer, we suggest adopting mixed speech, which is created by interpolating audio and visual streams, along with a curriculum learning strategy to adjust the mixing ratio as needed. MixSpeech enhances speech translation in noisy environments, improving BLEU scores for four languages on AVMuST-TED by +1.4 to +4.2. Moreover, it achieves state-of-the-art performance in lip reading on CMLR (11.1%), LRS2 (25.5%), and LRS3 (28.0%).
authors: Xize Cheng, Tao Jin, Rongjie Huang, Linjun Li, Wang Lin, Zehan Wang, Ye Wang, Huadai Liu, Aoxiong Yin, Zhou Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15735-15745

title: MixSynthFormer: 一种基于混合合成自注意力机制的类似Transformer编码器结构用于高效人体姿态估计
title_en: MixSynthFormer: A Transformer Encoder-like Structure with Mixed Synthetic Self-attention for Efficient Human Pose Estimation
abstract: 视频中的人体姿态估计在多个领域具有广泛的应用价值,其中许多场景需要在资源受限设备上实现快速推理,因此亟需开发高效且精确的算法。先前的研究表明,基于Transformer模型可以利用运动连续性,通过稀疏采样的帧进行姿态估计。然而,这些方法仅考虑时间关系而忽视空间注意力,且Transformer中点积自注意力计算的复杂度与嵌入维度呈二次方正比关系。为解决上述局限性,我们提出MixSynthFormer,一种基于MLP的混合合成注意力机制的类似Transformer编码器模型。通过融合合成的空间与时间注意力,我们的模型能够结合关节间与帧间的重要性信息,从而从稀疏采样的帧中准确估计完整视频序列的人体姿态。此外,模型灵活的设计使其可扩展至其他运动合成任务。我们在2D/3D姿态估计、身体网格恢复和运动预测等任务上的大量实验验证了MixSynthFormer的有效性与效率。
abstract_en: Human pose estimation in videos has wide-ranging practical applications across various fields, many of which require fast inference on resource-scarce devices, necessitating the development of efficient and accurate algorithms. Previous works have demonstrated the feasibility of exploiting motion continuity to conduct pose estimation using sparsely sampled frames with transformer-based models. However, these methods only consider the temporal relation while neglecting spatial attention, and the complexity of dot product self-attention calculations in transformers are quadratically proportional to the embedding size. To address these limitations, we propose MixSynthFormer, a transformer encoder-like model with MLP-based mixed synthetic attention. By mixing synthesized spatial and temporal attentions, our model incorporates inter-joint and inter-frame importance and can accurately estimate human poses in an entire video sequence from sparsely sampled frames. Additionally, the flexible design of our model makes it versatile for other motion synthesis tasks. Our extensive experiments on 2D/3D pose estimation, body mesh recovery, and motion prediction validate the effectiveness and efficiency of MixSynthFormer.
authors: Yuran Sun, Alan William Dougherty, Zhuoying Zhang, Yi King Choi, Chuan Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14884-14893

title: 混合神经体素用于快速多视角视频合成
title_en: Mixed Neural Voxels for Fast Multi-view Video Synthesis
abstract: 从真实多视角输入合成高保真视频具有挑战性,这归因于真实环境的复杂性和高动态运动。基于神经辐射场的先前工作已展示了对动态场景的高质量重建。然而,在真实场景上训练此类模型耗时,通常需要几天或几周。在本文中,我们提出了一种名为MixVoxels的新方法,以高效表示动态场景,从而实现快速训练和渲染速度。所提出的MixVoxels将4D动态场景表示为静态体素和动态体素的混合,并通过不同的网络处理它们。这样,静态体素所需模态的计算可以由轻量级模型处理,这本质上减少了计算量,因为许多日常动态场景主要由静态背景主导。为区分两种体素,我们提出了一种新的变化场来估计每个体素的时间方差。对于动态表示,我们设计了一种内积时间查询方法,以高效查询多个时间步,这对于恢复高动态运动至关重要。结果表明,对于输入为300帧视频的动态场景,MixVoxels仅需15分钟训练时间即可实现比先前方法更高的PSNR。在渲染方面,MixVoxels可在1K分辨率下以37帧每秒的速度渲染新视角视频。代码和训练模型可在https://github.com/fengres/mixvoxels获取。
abstract_en:
Synthesizing high-fidelity videos from real-world multiview input is challenging due to the complexities of real-world environments and high-dynamic movements. Previous works based on neural radiance fields have demonstrated high-quality reconstructions of dynamic scenes. However, training such models on real-world scenes is time-consuming, usually taking days or weeks. In this paper, we present a novel method named MixVoxels to efficiently represent dynamic scenes which leads to fast training and rendering speed. The proposed MixVoxels represents the 4D dynamic scenes as a mixture of static and dynamic voxels and processes them with different networks. In this way, the computation of the required modalities for static voxels can be processed by a lightweight model, which essentially reduces
 the amount of computation as many daily dynamic scenes are dominated by static backgrounds. To distinguish the two kinds of voxels, we propose a novel variation field to estimate the temporal variance of each voxel. For the dynamic representations, we design an inner-product time query method to efficiently query multiple time steps, which is essential to recover the high-dynamic movements. As
 a result, with 15 minutes of training for dynamic scenes with inputs of 300-frame videos, MixVoxels achieves better PSNR than previous methods. For rendering, MixVoxels can render a novel view video with 1K resolution at 37 fps. Codes and trained models are available at https://github.com/fengres/mixvoxels.
authors: Feng Wang, Sinan Tan, Xinghang Li, Zeyue Tian, Yafei Song, Huaping Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19706-19716

title: MoTIF: 基于局部隐式神经函数的连续时空视频超分辨率运动轨迹学习
title_en: MoTIF: Learning Motion Trajectories with Local Implicit Neural Functions for Continuous Space-Time Video Super-Resolution
abstract: 本工作针对连续时空视频超分辨率(C-STVSR)问题,旨在通过任意缩放因子对输入视频进行空间和时间维度的放大。C-STVSR的关键挑战在于如何在输入视频帧之间进行时间信息传播。为此,我们引入了一种时空局部隐式神经函数。该函数具有显著特点,即能够学习连续像素的前向运动。我们从学习个体运动轨迹的视角出发,提出使用前向运动,而非学习包含反向运动的混合运动轨迹。为简化运动插值,我们将从输入视频中提取的稀疏采样前向运动编码为上下文输入。结合可靠性感知的点喷涂与解码方案,我们的框架MoTIF在C-STVSR任务中实现了最先进性能。MoTIF的源代码可在https://github.com/sichun233746/MoTIF获取。
abstract_en: This work addresses continuous space-time video super-resolution (C-STVSR) that aims to up-scale an input video both spatially and temporally by any scaling factors. One key challenge of C-STVSR is to propagate information temporally among the input video frames. To this end, we introduce a space-time local implicit neural function. It has the striking feature of learning forward motion for a continuum of pixels. We motivate the use of forward motion from the perspective of learning individual motion trajectories, as opposed to learning a mixture of motion trajectories with backward motion. To ease motion interpolation, we encode sparsely sampled forward motion extracted from the input video as the contextual input. Along with a reliability-aware splatting and decoding scheme, our framework, termed MoTIF, achieves the state-of-the-art performance on C-STVSR. The source code of MoTIF is available at https://github.com/sichun233746/MoTIF.
authors: Yi-Hsin Chen, Si-Cun Chen, Yi-Hsin Chen, Yen-Yu Lin, Wen-Hsiao Peng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23131-23141

title: 面向可见光-红外人重识别的模态统一网络
title_en: Modality Unifying Network for Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
abstract: 可见光-红外人重识别(VI-ReID)由于存在显著的跨模态差异和类内变化,是一项具有挑战性的任务。现有方法主要通过将不同模态嵌入到同一特征空间中来学习模态共享表示。因此,所学特征强调跨模态的共性模式,而抑制了对重识别有价值的模态特异性与身份感知信息。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新颖的模态统一网络(MUN),以探索用于VI-ReID的鲁棒辅助模态。首先,通过结合所提出的跨模态学习器和同模态学习器生成辅助模态,该方法能够动态建模模态特异性与模态共享表示,从而缓解跨模态和同模态变化。其次,通过对三个模态的身份中心进行对齐,提出了一种身份对齐损失函数以发现具有判别性的特征表示。第三,引入模态对齐损失,通过模态原型建模一致地减少可见光与红外图像的分布距离。在多个公开数据集上的大量实验表明,所提方法显著超越了当前最先进方法。
abstract_en: Visible-infrared person re-identification (VI-ReID) is a challenging task due to large cross-modality discrepancies and intra-class variations. Existing methods mainly focus on learning modality-shared representations by embedding different modalities into the same feature space. As a result, the learned feature emphasizes the common patterns across modalities while suppressing modality-specific and identity-aware information that is valuable for Re-ID. To address these issues, we propose a novel Modality Unifying Network (MUN) to explore a robust auxiliary modality for VI-ReID. First, the auxiliary modality is generated by combining the proposed cross-modality learner and intra-modality learner, which can dynamically model the modality-specific and modality-shared representations to alleviate both cross-modality and intra-modality variations. Second, by aligning identity centres across the three modalities, an identity alignment loss function is proposed to discover the discriminative feature representations. Third, a modality alignment loss is introduced to consistently reduce the distribution distance of visible and infrared images by modality prototype modeling. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets demonstrate that the proposed method surpasses the current state-of-the-art methods by a significant margin.
authors: Hao Yu, Xu Cheng, Wei Peng, Weihao Liu, Guoying Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11185-11195

title: 密集分类中的自适应标签扰动模型校准
title_en: Model Calibration in Dense Classification with Adaptive Label Perturbation
abstract: 在安全相关应用中,生成具有可信度的深度神经网络至关重要,其预测结果与置信度相关联,能够表征后续决策的正确性可能性。现有密集二元分类模型容易产生过高的置信度。为提升模型校准度,我们提出自适应随机标签扰动(Adaptive Stochastic Label Perturbation, A-SLP),该方法为每个训练图像学习独特的标签扰动级别。ASLP采用我们提出的自校准二元交叉熵(Self-Calibrating Binary Cross Entropy, SC-BCE)损失函数,该函数统一了包括随机方法(如DisturbLabel)和标签平滑在内的标签扰动过程,以校正校准度同时保持分类准确率。ASLP遵循经典统计力学中的最大熵推断方法,以最大化对缺失信息的预测熵。其在以下两种方式中实现此目标:(1) 作为保守解决方案,在已知数据上保持分类准确率;或(2) 通过最小化预测准确率与目标训练标签预期置信度之间的差距,具体提升模型校准程度。大量实验结果表明,ASLP能够显著提升密集二元分类模型在分布内和分布外数据上的校准度。
abstract_en: For safety-related applications, it is crucial to produce trustworthy deep neural networks whose prediction is associated with confidence that can represent the likelihood of correctness for subsequent decision-making. Existing dense binary classification models are prone to being over-confident. To improve model calibration, we propose Adaptive Stochastic Label Perturbation (ASLP) which learns a unique label perturbation level for each training image. ASLP employs our proposed Self-Calibrating Binary Cross Entropy (SC-BCE) loss, which unifies label perturbation processes including stochastic approaches (like DisturbLabel), and label smoothing, to correct calibration while maintaining classification rates. ASLP follows Maximum Entropy Inference of classic statistical mechanics to maximise prediction entropy with respect to missing information. It performs this while: (1) preserving classification accuracy on known data as a conservative solution, or (2) specifically improves model calibration degree by minimising the gap between the prediction accuracy and expected confidence of target training label. Extensive results demonstrate that ASLP can significantly improve calibration degrees of dense binary classification models on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data.
authors: Jiawei Liu, Changkun Ye, Shan Wang, Ruikai Cui, Jing Zhang, Kaihao Zhang, Nick Barnes ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1173-1184

title: ModelGiF:用于模型功能距离的梯度场
title_en: ModelGiF: Gradient Fields for Model Functional Distance
abstract: 过去十年见证了深度学习的成功以及大量预训练模型的公开发布,这 necessitates 对模型功能距离进行量化以满足各种需求。然而,由于模型内部机制的不透明性以及架构和任务的异质性,量化模型功能距离始终具有挑战性。受物理学中"场"的概念启发,本文提出 Model Gradient Field(简称 ModelGiF)以从异构的预训练模型中提取同质表示。我们的核心假设是,每个预训练深度模型在输入空间上唯一确定一个 ModelGiF。因此,模型间的距离可以通过其 ModelGiF 的相似性进行度量。我们为模型功能距离的 ModelGiF 提供了理论洞察,并通过包括任务相关性估计、知识产权保护和模型遗忘验证在内的多个测试平台验证了所提 ModelGiF 的有效性。实验结果表明,所提 ModelGiF 在这些任务中展现出显著优于现有先进方法的性能。代码可在 https://github.com/zju-vipa/modelgif 获取。
abstract_en: The last decade has witnessed the success of deep learning and the surge of publicly released trained models, which necessitates the quantification of the model functional distance for various purposes. However, quantifying the model functional distance is always challenging due to the opacity in inner workings and the heterogeneity in architectures and tasks. Inspired by the concept of "field" in physics, in this work we introduce Model Gradient Field (abbr. ModelGiF) to extract homogeneous representations from the heterogeneous pre-trained models. Our main assumption underlying ModelGiF is that each pre-trained deep model uniquely determines a ModelGiF over the input space. The distance between models can thus be measured by the similarity between their ModelGiFs. We provide theoretical insights into the proposed ModelGiFs for model functional distance, and validate the effectiveness of the proposed ModelGiF with a suite of testbeds, including task relatedness estimation, intellectual property protection, and model unlearning verification. Experimental results demonstrate the versatility of the proposed ModelGiF on these tasks, with significantly superiority performance to state-of-the-art competitors. Codes are available at https://github.com/zju-vipa/modelgif.
authors: Jie Song, Zhengqi Xu, Sai Wu, Gang Chen, Mingli Song ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6125-6135

title: 基于骨架的自监督动作识别中的相对视觉节奏建模
title_en: Modeling the Relative Visual Tempo for Self-supervised Skeleton-based Action Recognition
abstract: 视觉节奏表征了动作的动态特性与时间演化过程,有助于描述动作。近期方法直接在骨架序列上进行视觉节奏预测,可能面临特征表示不足的问题。本文观察到相对视觉节奏更符合人类直觉,能提供更有效的监督信号。基于此,我们提出了一种新的相对视觉节奏对比学习框架用于骨架动作表征(RVTCLR)。具体而言,我们设计了相对视觉节奏学习(RVTL)任务以探索视频片段内的运动信息,并设计外观一致性(AC)任务同步学习外观信息,从而获得更具代表性的时空特征。此外,骨架序列数据相比RGB数据更为稀疏,导致网络学习捷径并过度拟合骨架尺度等低级信息。为学习高阶语义,我们进一步设计了新的分布一致性(DC)分支,包含三个组件:骨架特异性数据增强(SDA)、细粒度骨架编码模块(FSEM)和分布感知多样性(DD)损失。我们将整个方法(RVTCLR与DC结合)命名为RVTCLR+。在NTU RGB+D 60和NTU RGB+D 120数据集上的大量实验表明,RVTCLR+在现有方法中取得了具有竞争力的结果。代码已开源至https://github.com/Zhuysheng/RVTCLR。
abstract_en: Visual tempo characterizes the dynamics and the temporal evolution, which helps describe actions. Recent approaches directly perform visual tempo prediction on skeleton sequences, which may suffer from insufficient feature representation issue. In this paper, we observe that relative visual tempo is more in line with human intuition, and thus providing more effective supervision signals. Based on this, we propose a novel Relative Visual Tempo Contrastive Learning framework for skeleton action Representation (RVTCLR). Specifically, we design a Relative Visual Tempo Learning (RVTL) task to explore the motion information in intra-video clips, and an Appearance-Consistency (AC) task to learn appearance information simultaneously, resulting in more representative spatiotemporal features. Furthermore, skeleton sequence data is much sparser than RGB data, making the network learn shortcuts, and overfit to low-level information such as skeleton scales. To learn high-order semantics, we further design a new Distribution-Consistency (DC) branch, containing three components: Skeleton-specific Data Augmentation (SDA), Fine-grained Skeleton Encoding Module (FSEM), and Distribution-aware Diversity (DD) Loss. We term our entire method (RVTCLR with DC) as RVTCLR+. Extensive experiments on NTU RGB+D 60 and NTU RGB+D 120 datasets demonstrate that our RVTCLR+ can achieve competitive results over the state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Zhuysheng/RVTCLR.
authors: Yisheng Zhu, Hu Han, Zhengtao Yu, Guangcan Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13913-13922

title: MolGrapher:基于图的化学结构视觉识别
title_en: MolGrapher: Graph-based Visual Recognition of Chemical Structures
abstract: 化学文献的自动分析具有加速新材料和药物发现的巨大潜力。专利文件和科学文章中的关键信息大多包含在图表中,这些图表描绘了分子结构。然而,由于详细信息量大、绘图风格多样以及需要训练数据,自动解析精确的化学结构是一项艰巨的挑战。在本工作中,我们引入MolGrapher以实现化学结构的视觉识别。首先,使用深度关键点检测器检测原子。其次,将所有候选原子和键作为节点并放入图中。这种构建方式允许自然地对分子进行图表示。最后,利用图神经网络对图中的原子和键节点进行分类。为了解决真实训练数据不足的问题,我们提出了一种合成数据生成管道,能够产生多样且逼真的结果。此外,我们引入了一个大规模标注的真实分子图像基准数据集USPTO-30K,以推动该关键领域研究。在五个数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在大多数设置中显著优于经典方法和基于学习的方法。代码、模型和数据集均可获取。
abstract_en: The automatic analysis of chemical literature has immense potential to accelerate the discovery of new materials and drugs. Much of the critical information in patent documents and scientific articles is contained in figures, depicting the molecule structures. However, automatically parsing the exact chemical structure is a formidable challenge, due to the amount of detailed information, the diversity of drawing styles, and the need for training data. In this work, we introduce MolGrapher to recognize chemical structures visually. First, a deep keypoint detector detects the atoms. Second, we treat all candidate atoms and bonds as nodes and put them in a graph. This construct allows a natural graph representation of the molecule. Last, we classify atom and bond nodes in the graph with a Graph Neural Network. To address the lack of real training data, we propose a synthetic data generation pipeline producing diverse and realistic results. In addition, we introduce a large-scale benchmark of annotated real molecule images, USPTO-30K, to spur research on this critical topic. Extensive experiments on five datasets show that our approach significantly outperforms classical and learning-based methods in most settings. Code, models, and datasets are available.
authors: Lucas Morin, Martin Danelljan, Maria Isabel Agea, Ahmed Nassar, Valery Weber, Ingmar Meijer, Peter Staar, Fisher Yu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19552-19561

title: 长教程视频中的时刻检测
title_en: Moment Detection in Long Tutorial Videos
abstract: 教程视频在专业发展和自主教育中发挥着越来越重要的作用。为了让用户充分实现这一媒介的价值,教程视频必须具备高效的检索能力。本工作中,我们聚焦于时刻检测任务,其目标是在给定的教程视频中定位特定事件发生的时间窗口。此前关于时刻检测的研究主要集中在短视频(通常为三分钟以内的视频)上。然而,许多教程视频时长显著更长(可达数小时),这对现有时刻检测方法提出了重大挑战。为研究这一问题,我们提出了首个用于时刻检测任务的未剪辑长篇教程视频数据集,称为Behance Moment Detection(BMD)数据集。BMD视频的平均时长超过一小时,其特点包括视觉内容缓慢演变和广泛对话。为应对该数据集的特殊挑战,我们提出了一种新的框架LongMoment-DETR,并证明其优于强大的基线方法。此外,我们引入了包含YouTube章节注释的数据集变体,并展示了我们的框架所获得的特征可以成功用于提升章节检测任务的性能。代码和数据可在https://github.com/ioanacroi/longmoment-detr获取。
abstract_en: Tutorial videos play an increasingly important role in professional development and self-directed education. For users to realise the full benefits of this medium, tutorial videos must be efficiently searchable. In this work, we focus on the task of moment detection, in which the goal is to localise the temporal window where a given event occurs within a given tutorial video. Prior work on moment detection has focused primarily on short videos (typically on videos shorter than three minutes). However, many tutorial videos are substantially longer (stretching to hours in duration), presenting significant challenges for existing moment detection approaches. To study this problem, we propose the first dataset of untrimmed, long-form tutorial videos for the task of Moment Detection called the Behance Moment Detection (BMD) dataset. BMD videos have an average duration of over one hour and are characterised by slowly evolving visual content and wide-ranging dialogue. To meet the unique challenges of this dataset, we propose a new framework, LongMoment-DETR, and demonstrate that it outperforms strong baselines. Additionally, we introduce a variation of the dataset that contains YouTube Chapter annotations and show that the features obtained by our framework can be successfully used to boost the performance on the task of chapter detection. Code and data can be found at https://github.com/ioanacroi/longmoment-detr.
authors: Ioana Croitoru, Simion-Vlad Bogolin, Samuel Albanie, Yang Liu, Zhaowen Wang, Seunghyun Yoon, Franck Dernoncourt, Hailin Jin, Trung Bui ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2594-2604

title: MonoDETR:深度引导的Transformer用于单目三维目标检测
title_en: MonoDETR: Depth-guided Transformer for Monocular 3D Object Detection
abstract: 单目三维目标检测一直是自动驾驶领域具有挑战性的任务。现有大多数方法遵循传统2D检测器的范式,首先定位物体中心,再通过邻近特征预测3D属性。然而,仅使用局部视觉特征不足以理解场景级别的三维空间结构,并忽略了物体间的长距离深度关系。本文提出首个用于单目检测的DETR框架,命名为MonoDETR,其采用深度引导的Transformer架构。我们修改原始Transformer使其具备深度感知能力,并通过上下文深度线索引导整个检测过程。具体而言,在捕获物体外观的视觉编码器并行运行时,我们引入前景深度图预测模块,并专门化深度编码器提取非局部深度嵌入。随后,我们将3D目标候选建模为可学习查询,并提出深度引导解码器以实现物体-场景深度交互。通过这种方式,每个物体查询可自适应地从图像上的深度引导区域估计其3D属性,不再受限于局部视觉特征。在KITTI基准测试中,MonoDETR以单目图像为输入取得最先进性能,且无需额外密集深度标注。此外,我们的深度引导模块可插拔式增强nuScenes数据集上的多视角3D目标检测器,验证了其优越的泛化能力。代码已开源至https://github.com/ZrrSkywalker/MonoDETR。
abstract_en: Monocular 3D object detection has long been a challenging task in autonomous driving. Most existing methods follow conventional 2D detectors to first localize object centers, and then predict 3D attributes by neighboring features. However, only using local visual features is insufficient to understand the scene-level 3D spatial structures and ignores the long-range inter-object depth relations. In this paper, we introduce the first DETR framework for Monocular DEtection with a depth-guided TRansformer, named MonoDETR. We modify the vanilla transformer to be depth-aware and guide the whole detection process by contextual depth cues. Specifically, concurrent to the visual encoder that captures object appearances, we introduce to predict a foreground depth map, and specialize a depth encoder to extract non-local depth embeddings. Then, we formulate 3D object candidates as learnable queries and propose a depth-guided decoder to conduct object-scene depth interactions. In this way, each object query estimates its 3D attributes adaptively from the depth-guided regions on the image and is no longer constrained to local visual features. On KITTI benchmark with monocular images as input, MonoDETR achieves state-of-the-art performance and requires no extra dense depth annotations. Besides, our depth-guided modules can also be plug-and-play to enhance multi-view 3D object detectors on nuScenes dataset, demonstrating our superior generalization capacity. Code is available at https://github.com/ZrrSkywalker/MonoDETR.
authors: Renrui Zhang, Han Qiu, Tai Wang, Ziyu Guo, Ziteng Cui, Yu Qiao, Hongsheng Li, Peng Gao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9155-9166

title: MonoNeRD:用于单目三维目标检测的NeRF风格表示
title_en: MonoNeRD: NeRF-like Representations for Monocular 3D Object Detection
abstract: 在单目三维检测领域,利用场景几何线索提升检测器性能是常见做法。然而,许多现有工作显式采用这些线索,如估计深度图并将其反投影到三维空间。这种显式方法由于从二维到三维维度的增加,会导致三维表示的稀疏性,并造成大量信息丢失,尤其是对远处和被遮挡的目标。为了解决这一问题,我们提出MonoNeRD,一种新颖的检测框架,可推断密集的三维几何和占用信息。具体而言,我们使用符号距离函数(SDF)建模场景,从而生成密集的三维表示。我们将这些表示视为神经辐射场(NeRF),然后通过体积渲染恢复RGB图像和深度图。据我们所知,本工作首次将体积渲染引入M3D领域,展示了基于隐式重建的图像三维感知潜力。在KITTI-3D基准和Waymo Open Dataset上的大量实验验证了MonoNeRD的有效性。代码已开源至https://github.com/cskkxjk/MonoNeRD。
abstract_en: In the field of monocular 3D detection, it is common practice to utilize scene geometric clues to enhance the detector's performance. However, many existing works adopt these clues explicitly such as estimating a depth map and back-projecting it into 3D space. This explicit methodology induces sparsity in 3D representations due to the increased dimensionality from 2D to 3D, and leads to substantial information loss, especially for distant and occluded objects. To alleviate this issue, we propose MonoNeRD, a novel detection framework that can infer dense 3D geometry and occupancy. Specifically, we model scenes with Signed Distance Functions (SDF), facilitating the production of dense 3D representations. We treat these representations as Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and then employ volume rendering to recover RGB images and depth maps. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first to introduce volume rendering for M3D, and demonstrates the potential of implicit reconstruction for image-based 3D perception. Extensive experiments conducted on the KITTI-3D benchmark and Waymo Open Dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of MonoNeRD. Codes are available at https://github.com/cskkxjk/MonoNeRD.
authors: Junkai Xu, Liang Peng, Haoran Cheng, Hao Li, Wei Qian, Ke Li, Wenxiao Wang, Deng Cai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6814-6824

title: MonoNeRF:从单目视频中学习可泛化的动态辐射场
title_en: MonoNeRF: Learning a Generalizable Dynamic Radiance Field from Monocular Videos
abstract: 本文旨在解决从单目视频中学习可泛化的动态辐射场的问题。与大多数基于多视角的现有NeRF方法不同,单目视频在每个时间戳仅包含一个视角,因此在估计点特征和场景流时沿视角方向存在歧义。先前的研究如DynNeRF通过位置编码来消除点特征的歧义,但这种方法不可迁移且严重限制了泛化能力。因此,这些方法需要为每个场景训练独立模型,在实际应用中处理越来越多的单目视频时面临高昂的计算成本。为了解决这一问题,我们提出MonoNeRF,通过帧间点轨迹和特征对应约束,同时学习点特征和场景流。更具体地说,我们学习一个隐式速度场,利用Neural ODE从时序特征中估计点轨迹,随后通过基于流的特征聚合模块获取点轨迹上的空间特征。我们以端到端的方式联合优化时序和空间特征。实验表明,我们的MonoNeRF能够从多个场景中学习,并支持场景编辑、未见帧合成和快速新场景适应等新应用。代码可在https://github.com/tianfr/MonoNeRF获取
abstract_en: In this paper, we target at the problem of learning a generalizable dynamic radiance field from monocular videos. Different from most existing NeRF methods that are based on multiple views, monocular videos only contain one view at each timestamp, thereby suffering from ambiguity along the view direction in estimating point features and scene flows. Previous studies such as DynNeRF disambiguate point features by positional encoding, which is not transferable and severely limits the generalization ability. As a result, these methods have to train one independent model for each scene and suffer from heavy computational costs when applying to increasing monocular videos in real-world applications. To address this, We propose MonoNeRF to simultaneously learn point features and scene flows with point trajectory and feature correspondence constraints across frames. More specifically, we learn an implicit velocity field to estimate point trajectory from temporal features with Neural ODE, which is followed by a flow-based feature aggregation module to obtain spatial features along the point trajectory. We jointly optimize temporal and spatial features in an end-to-end manner. Experiments show that our MonoNeRF is able to learn from multiple scenes and support new applications such as scene editing, unseen frame synthesis, and fast novel scene adaptation. Codes are available at https://github.com/tianfr/MonoNeRF
authors: Fengrui Tian, Shaoyi Du, Yueqi Duan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17903-17913

title: 基于Perceiver的单目3D目标检测与三维边界框去噪
title_en: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Bounding Box Denoising in 3D by Perceiver
abstract: 单目3D目标检测的主要挑战在于三维中心的精确定位。受一项新的强观测启发,即在理想情况下可通过三维空间局部网格搜索方案解决该挑战,我们提出了一种分阶段方法,通过自上而下的方式融合2D到3D(利用单张2D图像生成3D边界框提案)和3D到2D(通过三维到二维上下文去噪验证提案)的信息流。具体而言,我们首先从现成的单目3D检测器主干网络中获取初始提案。随后,通过局部网格采样从初始提案中生成三维锚点空间。最后,在三维到二维提案验证阶段执行三维边界框去噪。为有效学习用于去噪高度重叠提案的判别性特征,本文提出利用Perceiver I/O模型融合三维到二维几何信息与二维外观信息。通过提案的编码潜在表示,验证头采用自注意力模块实现。我们的方法命名为MonoXiver,具有通用性且可轻松适配任何单目3D检测器主干网络。在广泛使用的KITTI数据集和具有挑战性的大规模Waymo数据集上的实验结果表明,MonoXiver在计算开销有限的情况下持续取得性能提升。
abstract_en: The main challenge of monocular 3D object detection is the accurate localization of 3D center. Motivated by a new and strong observation that this challenge can be remedied by a 3D-space local-grid search scheme in an ideal case, we propose a stage-wise approach, which combines the information flow from 2D-to-3D (3D bounding box proposal generation with a single 2D image) and 3D-to-2D (proposal verification by denoising with 3D-to-2D contexts) in a top-down manner. Specifically, we first obtain initial proposals from off-the-shelf backbone monocular 3D detectors. Then, we generate a 3D anchor space by local-grid sampling from the initial proposals. Finally, we perform 3D bounding box denoising at the 3D-to-2D proposal verification stage. To effectively learn discriminative features for denoising highly overlapped proposals, this paper presents a method of using the Perceiver I/O model to fuse the 3D-to-2D geometric information and the 2D appearance information. With the encoded latent representation of a proposal, the verification head is implemented with a self-attention module. Our method, named as MonoXiver, is generic and can be easily adapted to any backbone monocular 3D detectors. Experimental results on the well-established KITTI dataset and the challenging large-scale Waymo dataset show that MonoXiver consistently achieves improvement with limited computation overhead.
authors: Xianpeng Liu, Ce Zheng, Kelvin B Cheng, Nan Xue, Guo-Jun Qi, Tianfu Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6436-6446

title: 蒙特卡洛线性聚类与单点监督足以实现红外小目标检测
title_en: Monte Carlo Linear Clustering with Single-Point Supervision is Enough for Infrared Small Target Detection
abstract: 单帧红外小目标(SIRST)检测旨在从红外图像的杂波背景中分离出小目标。近年来,基于深度学习的方法在SIRST检测中取得了 promising performance,但需要大量带有昂贵像素级标注的训练数据。为降低标注负担,我们提出首个仅需单点监督的SIRST检测方法。本工作的核心思想是通过聚类方法从给定的单点标签中恢复每个目标的逐像素掩码,这一看似简单但实际具有挑战性,因为目标通常不显著且伴随背景杂波。为解决此问题,我们通过向输入图像添加噪声引入随机性,然后通过对聚类结果取平均获得更可靠的伪掩码。得益于这种"蒙特卡洛"聚类方法,我们的方法能够准确恢复伪掩码,从而将任意全监督的SIRST检测网络转化为仅需单点标注的弱监督网络。在四个数据集上的实验表明,我们的方法可应用于现有SIRST检测网络,实现与全监督方法相当的性能,这揭示了单点监督对于SIRST检测的充分性。
abstract_en: Single-frame infrared small target (SIRST) detection aims at separating small targets from clutter backgrounds on infrared images. Recently, deep learning based methods have achieved promising performance on SIRST detection, but at the cost of a large amount of training data with expensive pixel-level annotations. To reduce the annotation burden, we propose the first method to achieve SIRST detection with single-point supervision. The core idea of this work is to recover the per-pixel mask of each target from the given single point label by using clustering approaches, which looks simple but is indeed challenging since targets are always insalient and accompanied with background clutters. To handle this issue, we introduce randomness to the clustering process by adding noise to the input images, and then obtain much more reliable pseudo masks by averaging the clustered results. Thanks to this "Monte Carlo" clustering approach, our method can accurately recover pseudo masks and thus turn arbitrary fully supervised SIRST detection networks into weakly supervised ones with only single point annotation. Experiments on four datasets demonstrate that our method can be applied to existing SIRST detection networks to achieve comparable performance with their fully-supervised counterparts, which reveals that single-point supervision is strong enough for SIRST detection.
authors: Boyang Li, Yingqian Wang, Longguang Wang, Fei Zhang, Ting Liu, Zaiping Lin, Wei An, Yulan Guo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1009-1019

title: MoreauGrad:基于莫雷包络的神经网络稀疏且鲁棒解释
title_en: MoreauGrad: Sparse and Robust Interpretation of Neural Networks via Moreau Envelope
abstract: 深度神经网络预测的解释在计算机视觉文献中一直是研究热点。尽管已有多种基于梯度的解释方案被提出以揭示神经网络预测中的关键变量,但标准的基于梯度的解释框架通常被观察到在输入扰动下的鲁棒性不足,并且在整合稀疏性和组稀疏性先验知识方面缺乏灵活性。在本文中,我们提出MoreauGrad作为一种基于分类器神经网络的莫雷包络的解释方案。我们证明MoreauGrad能够为多层神经网络生成平滑且鲁棒的解释,并可通过一阶优化方法高效计算。此外,我们展示了MoreauGrad可以自然地与L1范数正则化技术结合,输出稀疏或组稀疏的解释,这些解释作为先验条件适用于广泛深度学习应用。我们在标准计算机视觉数据集上对提出的MoreauGrad方案进行了实证评估,展示了其在与标准基于梯度的解释方法相比的定性和定量成功。
abstract_en: Explaining the predictions of deep neural nets has been a topic of great interest in the computer vision literature. While several gradient-based interpretation schemes have been proposed to reveal the influential variables in a neural net's prediction, standard gradient-based interpretation frameworks have been commonly observed to lack robustness to input perturbations and flexibility for incorporating prior knowledge of sparsity and group-sparsity structures. In this work, we propose MoreauGrad as an interpretation scheme based on the classifier neural net's Moreau envelope. We demonstrate that MoreauGrad results in a smooth and robust interpretation of a multi-layer neural network and can be efficiently computed through first-order optimization methods. Furthermore, we show that MoreauGrad can be naturally combined with L1-norm regularization techniques to output a sparse or group-sparse explanation which are prior conditions applicable to a wide range of deep learning applications. We empirically evaluate the proposed MoreauGrad scheme on standard computer vision datasets, showing the qualitative and quantitative success of the MoreauGrad approach in comparison to standard gradient-based interpretation methods.
authors: Jingwei Zhang, Farzan Farnia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2021-2030

title: MosaiQ: 用于NISQ计算机图像生成的量子生成对抗网络
title_en: MosaiQ: Quantum Generative Adversarial Networks for Image Generation on NISQ Computers
abstract: 近年来,量子机器学习和视觉技术逐渐成为研究热点,硬件的进步使得量子机器的能力迅速提升。近期,量子图像生成技术因其相较于非量子技术的诸多潜在优势而受到关注;然而,先前方法在图像质量和鲁棒性方面存在不足。为解决这些问题,我们提出MosaiQ,一种高质量的量子图像生成生成对抗网络(GAN)框架,可在当前的近期中间规模量子(NISQ)计算机上执行。
abstract_en: Quantum machine learning and vision have come to the fore recently, with hardware advances enabling rapid advancement in the capabilities of quantum machines. Recently, quantum image generation has been explored with many potential advantages over non-quantum techniques; however, previous techniques have suffered from poor quality and robustness. To address these problems, we introduce MosaiQ a high-quality quantum image generation GAN framework that can be executed on today's Near-term Intermediate Scale Quantum (NISQ) computers.
authors: Daniel Silver, Tirthak Patel, William Cutler, Aditya Ranjan, Harshitta Gandhi, Devesh Tiwari ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7030-7039

title: 基于最重要人物引导的双分支跨块注意力机制的群体情感识别
title_en: Most Important Person-Guided Dual-Branch Cross-Patch Attention for Group Affect Recognition
abstract: 群体情感是指群体在外部刺激下产生的主观情绪,是塑造群体行为和结果的重要因素。群体情感识别涉及识别人群中的重要个体和显著物体,这些个体和物体能够引发情绪。然而,现有大多数方法忽视了群体动态中的情感意义,未能充分考虑群体级图像中人脸和物体的上下文相关性。本工作中,我们通过引入心理学中的最重要人物(Most Important Person, MIP)概念提出解决方案,MIP代表人群中最值得关注的面部,并具有情感语义意义。我们提出了双分支跨块注意力Transformer(Dual-branch Cross-Patch Attention Transformer, DCAT),将全局图像和MIP共同作为输入。具体而言,我们首先分别学习MIP产生的信息性面部区域和全局上下文。随后,提出跨块注意力模块融合MIP和全局上下文特征以实现互补。我们的方法在GAF 3.0、GroupEmoW和HECO数据集上均优于现有最先进的方法。此外,我们通过展示模型可迁移至另一群体情感任务——群体凝聚力,并取得可比结果,证明了其潜在的广泛应用前景。
abstract_en: Group affect refers to the subjective emotion that is evoked by an external stimulus in a group, which is an important factor that shapes group behavior and outcomes. Recognizing group affect involves identifying important individuals and salient objects among a crowd that can evoke emotions. However, most existing methods lack attention to affective meaning in group dynamics and fail to account for the contextual relevance of faces and objects in group-level images. In this work, we propose a solution by incorporating the psychological concept of the Most Important Person (MIP), which represents the most noteworthy face in a crowd and has affective semantic meaning. We present the Dual-branch Cross-Patch Attention Transformer (DCAT) which uses global image and MIP together as inputs. Specifically, we first learn the informative facial regions produced by the MIP and the global context separately. Then, the Cross-Patch Attention module is proposed to fuse the features of MIP and global context together to complement each other. Our proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art methods on GAF 3.0, GroupEmoW, and HECO datasets. Moreover, we demonstrate the potential for broader applications by showing that our proposed model can be transferred to another group affect task, group cohesion, and achieve comparable results.
authors: Hongxia Xie, Ming-Xian Lee, Tzu-Jui Chen, Hung-Jen Chen, Hou-I Liu, Hong-Han Shuai, Wen-Huang Cheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20598-20608

title: 运动引导的掩码用于时空表征学习
title_en: Motion-Guided Masking for Spatiotemporal Representation Learning
abstract: 近年来,一些研究直接将图像掩码自编码器(MAE)的随机掩码策略扩展到视频领域,取得了有希望的结果。然而,与图像不同,视频理解需要同时考虑空间和时间信息。这表明继承自图像MAE的随机掩码策略在视频MAE中效果有限。这促使我们设计了一种新的掩码算法,以更高效地利用视频显著性。具体而言,我们提出了一种运动引导的掩码算法(MGM),该算法利用运动向量在时间上引导每个掩码的位置。关键的是,这些基于运动的对应关系可以直接从视频压缩格式中存储的信息中获得,这使得我们的方法高效且可扩展。在两个具有挑战性的大规模视频基准数据集(Kinetics-400和Something-Something V2)上,我们将视频MAE与MGM结合,相比之前最先进的方法提升了高达+1.3%。此外,我们的MGM在使用最多66%更少训练轮次的情况下,实现了与之前视频MAE相当的性能。最后,我们在UCF101、HMDB51和Diving48数据集上展示了MGM在下游迁移学习和领域适应任务中的泛化能力,相比基线方法提升了高达+4.9%。
abstract_en: Several recent works have directly extended the image masked autoencoder (MAE) with random masking into video domain, achieving promising results. However, unlike images, both spatial and temporal information are important for video understanding. This suggests that the random masking strategy that is inherited from the image MAE is less effective for video MAE. This motivates the design of a novel masking algorithm that can more efficiently make use of video saliency. Specifically, we propose a motion-guided masking algorithm (MGM) which leverages motion vectors to guide the position of each mask over time. Crucially, these motion-based correspondences can be directly obtained from information stored in the compressed format of the video, which makes our method efficient and scalable. On two challenging large-scale video benchmarks (Kinetics-400 and Something-Something V2), we equip video MAE with our MGM and achieve up to +1.3% improvement compared to previous state-of-the-art methods. Additionally, our MGM achieves equivalent performance to previous video MAE using up to 66% fewer training epochs. Lastly, we show that MGM generalizes better to downstream transfer learning and domain adaptation tasks on the UCF101, HMDB51, and Diving48 datasets, achieving up to +4.9% improvement compared to baseline methods.
authors: David Fan, Jue Wang, Shuai Liao, Yi Zhu, Vimal Bhat, Hector Santos-Villalobos, Rohith MV, Xinyu Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5619-5629

title: MotionBERT:学习人类运动表示的统一视角
title_en: MotionBERT: A Unified Perspective on Learning Human Motion Representations
abstract: 我们提出了一种统一视角,通过从大规模且异构的数据资源中学习人类运动表示,来解决各种以人类为中心的视频任务。具体而言,我们提出了一种预训练阶段,其中运动编码器被训练以从噪声干扰的局部2D观测中恢复底层3D运动。通过这种方式获得的运动表示融合了关于人类运动的几何、运动学和物理知识,可以轻松迁移到多个下游任务中。我们采用双流时空变换器(DSTformer)神经网络实现运动编码器。该网络能够全面且自适应地捕捉骨骼关节间的长程时空关系,如从头训练时取得的最低三维姿态估计误差所示。此外,通过仅对预训练的运动编码器添加简单的回归头(1-2层)进行微调,我们的框架在三个下游任务上均实现了最先进的性能,这证明了所学运动表示的通用性。代码和模型可在https://motionbert.github.io/获取。
abstract_en: We present a unified perspective on tackling various human-centric video tasks by learning human motion representations from large-scale and heterogeneous data resources. Specifically, we propose a pretraining stage in which a motion encoder is trained to recover the underlying 3D motion from noisy partial 2D observations. The motion representations acquired in this way incorporate geometric, kinematic, and physical knowledge about human motion, which can be easily transferred to multiple downstream tasks. We implement the motion encoder with a Dual-stream Spatio-temporal Transformer (DSTformer) neural network. It could capture long-range spatio-temporal relationships among the skeletal joints comprehensively and adaptively, exemplified by the lowest 3D pose estimation error so far when trained from scratch. Furthermore, our proposed framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on all three downstream tasks by simply finetuning the pretrained motion encoder with a simple regression head (1-2 layers), which demonstrates the versatility of the learned motion representations. Code and models are available at https://motionbert.github.io/
authors: Wentao Zhu, Xiaoxuan Ma, Zhaoyang Liu, Libin Liu, Wayne Wu, Yizhou Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15085-15099

title: MotionDeltaCNN:基于球形缓冲区和填充卷积的移动摄像机视频稀疏CNN帧差异推理
title_en: MotionDeltaCNN: Sparse CNN Inference of Frame Differences in Moving Camera Videos with Spherical Buffers and Padded Convolutions
abstract: 在视频输入上进行卷积神经网络推理计算成本高昂且需要高内存带宽。最近,DeltaCNN通过仅处理与前一帧有显著更新的像素成功降低了成本。然而,DeltaCNN依赖于静态摄像机输入。移动摄像机在如何高效融合新暴露的图像区域与已处理区域方面带来了新挑战,以最小化更新率——无需增加内存开销,且无需了解未来帧的摄像机外参。在本工作中,我们提出MotionDeltaCNN,一种支持移动摄像机的稀疏CNN推理框架。我们引入球形缓冲区和填充卷积,以实现新暴露区域与已处理区域的无缝融合——而不会增加内存占用。我们的评估结果表明,在移动摄像机视频上,我们的方法性能比DeltaCNN高出高达90%。
abstract_en: Convolutional neural network inference on video input is computationally expensive and requires high memory bandwidth. Recently, DeltaCNN managed to reduce the cost by only processing pixels with significant updates over the previous frame. However, DeltaCNN relies on static camera input. Moving cameras add new challenges in how to fuse newly unveiled image regions with already processed regions efficiently to minimize the update rate - without increasing memory overhead and without knowing the camera extrinsics of future frames. In this work, we propose MotionDeltaCNN, a sparse CNN inference framework that supports moving cameras. We introduce spherical buffers and padded convolutions to enable seamless fusion of newly unveiled regions and previously processed regions - without increasing memory footprint. Our evaluation shows that we outperform DeltaCNN by up to 90% for moving camera videos.
authors: Mathias Parger, Chengcheng Tang, Thomas Neff, Christopher D. Twigg, Cem Keskin, Robert Wang, Markus Steinberger ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17292-17301

title: MotionLM:将多智能体运动预测作为语言建模任务
title_en: MotionLM: Multi-Agent Motion Forecasting as Language Modeling
abstract: 可靠预测道路智能体的未来行为是自动驾驶车辆安全规划的关键组成部分。在此,我们将连续轨迹表示为离散运动标记序列,并将多智能体运动预测建模为该领域的语言建模任务。我们的模型MotionLM具有以下优势:首先,它无需锚点或显式潜在变量优化即可学习多模态分布。相反,我们利用单一标准语言建模目标,最大化序列标记的平均对数概率。其次,我们的方法绕过了事后交互启发式方法,其中个体智能体轨迹生成在交互评分之前进行。相反,MotionLM通过单一自回归解码过程生成交互智能体未来的联合分布。此外,模型的序列分解功能使时间因果条件展开成为可能。所提出的方法在Waymo Open Motion数据集上建立了多智能体运动预测的新最先进性能,在交互挑战排行榜上排名第一。
abstract_en: Reliable forecasting of the future behavior of road agents is a critical component to safe planning in autonomous vehicles. Here, we represent continuous trajectories as sequences of discrete motion tokens and cast multi-agent motion prediction as a language modeling task over this domain. Our model, MotionLM, provides several advantages: First, it does not require anchors or explicit latent variable optimization to learn multimodal distributions. Instead, we leverage a single standard language modeling objective, maximizing the average log probability over sequence tokens. Second, our approach bypasses post-hoc interaction heuristics where individual agent trajectory generation is conducted prior to interactive scoring. Instead, MotionLM produces joint distributions over interactive agent futures in a single autoregressive decoding process. In addition, the model's sequential factorization enables temporally causal conditional rollouts. The proposed approach establishes new state-of-the-art performance for multi-agent motion prediction on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, ranking 1st on the interactive challenge leaderboard.
authors: Ari Seff, Brian Cera, Dian Chen, Mason Ng, Aurick Zhou, Nigamaa Nayakanti, Khaled S. Refaat, Rami Al-Rfou, Benjamin Sapp ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8579-8590

title: 面向多尺度视频特征表示的运动增强时序动作检测方法
title_en: Movement Enhancement toward Multi-Scale Video Feature Representation for Temporal Action Detection
abstract: 边界定位是时序动作检测(TAD)中的一个具有挑战性的问题,其中存在两个主要问题。首先,运动特征的淹没现象,即片段中的运动信息被场景信息所覆盖。其次,动作的尺度,即动作片段在整个视频中所占的比例具有显著的可变性。在本工作中,我们首先设计了一个运动增强模块(MEM),以突出运动特征从而更好地进行动作定位;然后,我们提出了一种尺度特征金字塔网络(SFPN),用于检测视频中的多尺度动作。对于运动增强模块,首先设计了运动特征提取器(MFE)以获取运动特征;其次,我们提出了一种多关系增强模块(MREM),以捕捉局部和时序上的有价值的信息相关性。对于尺度特征金字塔网络,我们设计了U型模块以建模不同尺度的动作,此外,我们设计了不同尺度的训练和推理策略,确保每个金字塔层仅负责特定尺度的动作。这两个创新集成形成了运动增强网络(MENet),并在两个具有挑战性的基准数据集上进行的大量实验验证了其有效性。MENet在ActivityNet-1.3和THUMOS-14数据集上优于其他代表性TAD方法。
abstract_en: Boundary localization is a challenging problem in Temporal Action Detection (TAD), in which there are two main issues. First, the submergence of movement feature, i.e. the movement information in a snippet is covered by the scene information. Second, the scale of action, that is, the proportion of action segments in the entire video, is considerably variable. In this work, we first design a Movement Enhance Module (MEM) to highlight movement feature for better action location, and then, we propose a Scale Feature Pyramid Network (SFPN) to detect multi-scale actions in videos. For Movement Enhance Module, firstly, Movement Feature Extractor (MFE) is designed to get the movement feature. Secondly, we propose a Multi-Relation Enhance Module (MREM) to grasp valuable information correlation both locally and temporally. For Scale Feature Pyramid Network, we design a U-Shape Module to model different scale actions, moreover, we design the training and inference strategy of different scales, ensuring that each pyramid layer is only responsible for actions at a specific scale. These two innovations are integrated as the Movement Enhance Network (MENet), and extensive experiments conducted on two challenging benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness. MENet outperforms other representative TAD methods on ActivityNet-1.3 and THUMOS-14.
authors: Zixuan Zhao, Dongqi Wang, Xu Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13555-13564

title: 风格空间中的多方向子空间编辑
title_en: Multi-Directional Subspace Editing in Style-Space
abstract: 本文描述了一种在StyleGAN潜在空间中寻找解耦语义方向的新技术。我们的方法识别出有意义的正交子空间,允许在编辑单个人脸属性时最小化对其他属性的不期望变化。我们的模型能够以多方向编辑单个属性,从而生成多种可能的图像。我们将方案与三种最先进的模型进行比较,结果表明我们的方法在人脸编辑和解耦能力方面优于这些模型。此外,我们提出了用于评估属性分离和解耦的量化指标,并展示了模型在这些指标上的优越性。
abstract_en: This paper describes a new technique for finding disentangled semantic directions in the latent space of StyleGAN. Our method identifies meaningful orthogonal subspaces that allow editing of one human face attribute, while minimizing undesired changes in other attributes. Our model is capable of editing a single attribute in multiple directions, resulting in a range of possible generated images. We compare our scheme with three state-of-the-art models and show that our method outperforms them in terms of face editing and disentanglement capabilities. Additionally, we suggest quantitative measures for evaluating attribute separation and disentanglement, and exhibit the superiority of our model with respect to those measures.
authors: Chen Naveh ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7138-7148

title: 多事件视频-文本检索
title_en: Multi-Event Video-Text Retrieval
abstract: 视频-文本检索(VTR)是一项关键的多模态任务,随着互联网上海量视频-文本数据的兴起而变得尤为重要。大量工作采用双流视觉-语言模型架构,通过学习视频-文本对的联合表示,已成为VTR任务的主流方法。然而,这些模型基于视频-文本一一对应关系的假设,忽视了更实际的场景:视频内容通常包含多个事件,而文本如用户查询或网页元数据往往具体且对应单一事件。这导致了先前训练目标与实际应用之间的差距,使得早期模型在推理过程中可能出现性能下降。本研究引入了多事件视频-文本检索(MeVTR)任务,作为传统视频-文本检索任务的一个细分场景,针对每个视频包含多个不同事件的情况。我们提出了一种简单模型Me-Retriever,结合关键事件视频表示和新的MeVTR损失函数。全面实验表明,该框架在视频到文本和文本到视频任务中均优于其他模型,有效建立了MeVTR任务的稳健基线。我们认为本工作为未来研究奠定了坚实基础。代码可在https://github.com/gengyuanmax/MeVTR获取。
abstract_en:
Video-Text Retrieval (VTR) is a crucial multi-modal task in an era of massive video-text data on the Internet.
 A plethora of work characterized by using a two-stream Vision-Language model architecture that learns a joint representation of video-text pairs has become a prominent approach for the VTR task.
 However, these models operate under the assumption of bijective video-text correspondences and neglect a more practical scenario where video content usually encompasses multiple events, while texts like user queries or webpage metadata tend to be specific and correspond to single events.
 This establishes a gap between the previous training objective and real-world applications, leading to the potential performance degradation of earlier models during inference.
 In this study, we introduce the Multi-event Video-Text Retrieval (MeVTR) task, addressing scenarios in which each video contains multiple different events, as a niche scenario of the conventional Video-Text Retrieval Task. We present a simple model, Me-Retriever, which incorporates key event video representation and a new MeVTR loss for the MeVTR task. Comprehensive experiments show that this straightforward framework outperforms other models in the Video-to-Text and Text-to-Video tasks, effectively establishing a robust baseline for the MeVTR task. We believe this work serves as a strong foundation for future studies.
 Code is available at https://github.com/gengyuanmax/MeVTR.
authors: Gengyuan Zhang, Jisen Ren, Jindong Gu, Volker Tresp ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22113-22123

title: 基于特权信息的多频域表示增强视频超分辨率
title_en: Multi-Frequency Representation Enhancement with Privilege Information for Video Super-Resolution
abstract: 卷积神经网络(CNN)有限的感受野限制了其捕捉长程时空依赖关系的能力,导致视频超分辨率性能不佳。为解决这一挑战,本文提出了一种新颖的多频域表示增强模块(MFE),在频域中进行时空信息聚合。具体而言,MFE主要包括一个空间频域表示增强分支,用于捕捉空间维度的长程依赖关系,以及一个能量频域表示增强分支以获取通道间特征关系。此外,提出了一种名为特权训练的新模型训练方法,用于编码高分辨率视频中的特权信息以促进模型训练。通过这两种方法,我们引入了一种新的VSR模型MFPI,在REDs4、Vimeo、Vid4和UDM10等多个数据集上,该模型在保持良好效率的同时显著优于现有最先进方法。
abstract_en: CNN's limited receptive field restricts its ability to capture long-range spatial-temporal dependencies, leading to unsatisfactory performance in video super-resolution. To tackle this challenge, this paper presents a novel multi-frequency representation enhancement module (MFE) that performs spatial-temporal information aggregation in the frequency domain. Specifically, MFE mainly includes a spatial-frequency representation enhancement branch which captures the long-range dependency in the spatial dimension, and an energy frequency representation enhancement branch to obtain the inter-channel feature relationship. Moreover, a novel model training method named privilege training is proposed to encode the privilege information from high-resolution videos to facilitate model training. With these two methods, we introduce a new VSR model named MFPI, which outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin while maintaining good efficiency on various datasets, including REDS4, Vimeo, Vid4, and UDM10.
authors: Fei Li, Linfeng Zhang, Zikun Liu, Juan Lei, Zhenbo Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12814-12825

title: 多标签知识蒸馏
title_en: Multi-Label Knowledge Distillation
abstract: 现有知识蒸馏方法通常通过将教师网络的输出logits或中间特征图的知识传递给学生网络来实现,这在多类单标签学习中取得了巨大成功。然而,这些方法难以扩展到多标签学习场景,因为在该场景下每个实例与多个语义标签相关联,预测概率总和不为1,且整个示例的特征图可能忽略次要类别。本文提出了一种新颖的多标签知识蒸馏方法。一方面,通过将多标签学习问题分解为一系列二分类问题,利用logits中的信息性语义知识;另一方面,通过利用标签级别的嵌入结构信息增强学习到的特征表示的区分性。在多个基准数据集上的实验结果验证了所提方法能够避免标签间的知识抵消,从而在多种对比方法中取得优越性能。
abstract_en: Existing knowledge distillation methods typically work by imparting the knowledge of output logits or intermediate feature maps from the teacher network to the student network, which is very successful in multi-class single-label learning. However, these methods can hardly be extended to the multi-label learning scenario, where each instance is associated with multiple semantic labels, because the prediction probabilities do not sum to one and feature maps of the whole example may ignore minor classes in such a scenario. In this paper, we propose a novel multi-label knowledge distillation method. On one hand, it exploits the informative semantic knowledge from the logits by dividing the multi-label learning problem into a set of binary classification problems; on the other hand, it enhances the distinctiveness of the learned feature representations by leveraging the structural information of label-wise embeddings. Experimental results on multiple benchmark datasets validate that the proposed method can avoid knowledge counteraction among labels, thus achieving superior performance against diverse comparing methods.
authors: Penghui Yang, Ming-Kun Xie, Chen-Chen Zong, Lei Feng, Gang Niu, Masashi Sugiyama, Sheng-Jun Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17271-17280

title: 基于场景图像的多标签自监督学习
title_en: Multi-Label Self-Supervised Learning with Scene Images
abstract: 自监督学习(SSL)方法在场景图像领域近年来迅速发展,主要依赖于专用的密集匹配机制或成本高昂的无监督对象发现模块。本文表明,无需依赖这些繁琐操作,可通过将场景/多标签图像自监督学习简单视为多标签分类问题来学习高质量的图像表示,这大大简化了学习框架。具体而言,通过将输入图像的嵌入向量与两个字典中的嵌入向量进行比较,为每个输入图像分配多个二元伪标签,并使用二元交叉熵损失优化网络。所提出的方法命名为多标签自监督学习(MLS)。可视化结果定性表明,MLS生成的伪标签能够自动在不同图像间找到语义相似的伪正样本对,以促进对比学习。MLS在MS-COCO数据集上学习到高质量表示,并在分类、检测和分割基准测试中取得最先进结果。同时,MLS比现有方法更简单,使其更容易部署和进一步探索。
abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) methods targeting scene images have seen a rapid growth recently, and they mostly rely on either a dedicated dense matching mechanism or a costly unsupervised object discovery module. This paper shows that instead of hinging on these strenuous operations, quality image representations can be learned by treating scene/multi-label image SSL simply as a multi-label classification problem, which greatly simplifies the learning framework. Specifically, multiple binary pseudo-labels are assigned for each input image by comparing its embeddings with those in two dictionaries, and the network is optimized using the binary cross entropy loss. The proposed method is named Multi-Label Self-supervised learning (MLS). Visualizations qualitatively show that clearly the pseudo-labels by MLS can automatically find semantically similar pseudo-positive pairs across different images to facilitate contrastive learning. MLS learns high quality representations on MS-COCO and achieves state-of-the-art results on classification, detection and segmentation benchmarks. At the same time, MLS is much simpler than existing methods, making it easier to deploy and for further exploration.
authors: Ke Zhu, Minghao Fu, Jianxin Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6694-6703

title: 多度量自适应识别联邦学习中的后门
title_en: Multi-Metrics Adaptively Identifies Backdoors in Federated Learning
abstract: 联邦学习(FL)的去中心化和隐私保护特性使其容易受到后门攻击,攻击者旨在操控最终模型在特定对抗性输入上的行为。然而,大多数基于统计差异的现有防御方法仅对特定攻击有效,尤其是在恶意梯度与良性梯度相似或数据高度非独立同分布(non-IID)时。本文重新审视基于距离的防御方法,发现i)欧几里得距离在高维空间中变得无意义,ii)具有多样特征的恶意梯度无法通过单一度量识别。为此,我们提出一种简单而有效的多度量与动态加权防御策略,以自适应识别后门。此外,我们的新防御方法无需对攻击设置或数据分布做出预设假设,且对良性性能影响极小。为评估方法有效性,我们在不同数据集和多种攻击设置下进行综合实验,结果表明我们的方法在防御性能上达到最佳。例如,在困难的Edge-case PGD攻击下,我们实现了最低的后门准确率3.06%,显著优于先前防御方法。实验结果还表明,我们的方法可良好适应各种非IID程度,而不会牺牲良性性能。
abstract_en: The decentralized and privacy-preserving nature of federated learning (FL) makes it vulnerable to backdoor attacks aiming to manipulate the behavior of the resulting model on specific adversary-chosen inputs. However, most existing defenses based on statistical differences take effect only against specific attacks, especially when the malicious gradients are similar to benign ones or the data are highly non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID). In this paper, we revisit the distance-based defense methods and discover that i) Euclidean distance becomes meaningless in high dimensions and ii) malicious gradients with diverse characteristics cannot be identified by a single metric. To this end, we present a simple yet effective defense strategy with multi-metrics and dynamic weighting to identify backdoors adaptively. Furthermore, our novel defense has no reliance on predefined assumptions over attack settings or data distributions and little impact on benign performance. To evaluate the effectiveness of our approach, we conduct comprehensive experiments on different datasets under various attack settings, where our method achieves the best defensive performance. For instance, we achieve the lowest backdoor accuracy of 3.06% under the difficult Edge-case PGD, showing significant superiority over previous defenses. The results also demonstrate that our method can be well-adapted to a wide range of non-IID degrees without sacrificing the benign performance.
authors: Siquan Huang, Yijiang Li, Chong Chen, Leyu Shi, Ying Gao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4652-4662

title: 面向三维语义分割的多模态持续测试时适应
title_en: Multi-Modal Continual Test-Time Adaptation for 3D Semantic Segmentation
abstract: 持续测试时适应(CTTA)通过假设目标域随时间动态变化而非静态,扩展了传统测试时适应(TTA)。本文探索多模态持续测试时适应(MM-CTTA)作为CTTA在三维语义分割领域的新扩展。MM-CTTA的关键在于持续域迁移过程中,通过自适应关注可靠模态并避免灾难性遗忘,这超越了先前TTA或CTTA方法的能力。为解决这一缺口,我们提出名为持续跨模态自适应聚类(CoMAC)的MM-CTTA方法,从两个视角处理该任务。一方面,我们提出自适应双阶段机制,通过基于潜在空间类别级特征中心距离关注可靠模态,生成可靠的跨模态预测。另一方面,为实现无灾难性遗忘的测试时适应,我们设计类别级动量队列,捕获自信的目标特征用于适应,同时随机恢复伪源特征以重新访问源知识。我们进一步引入两个新基准数据集,以促进未来对MM-CTTA的探索。实验结果表明,我们的方法在两个基准上均达到最先进性能。访问项目网站:https://sites.google.com/view/mmcotta
abstract_en: Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) generalizes conventional Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) by assuming that the target domain is dynamic over time rather than stationary. In this paper, we explore Multi-Modal Continual Test-Time Adaptation (MM-CTTA) as a new extension of CTTA for 3D semantic segmentation. The key to MM-CTTA is to adaptively attend to the reliable modality while avoiding catastrophic forgetting during continual domain shifts, which is out of the capability of previous TTA or CTTA methods. To fulfill this gap, we propose an MM-CTTA method called Continual Cross-Modal Adaptive Clustering (CoMAC) that addresses this task from two perspectives. On one hand, we propose an adaptive dual-stage mechanism to generate reliable cross-modal predictions by attending to the reliable modality based on the class-wise feature-centroid distance in the latent space. On the other hand, to perform test-time adaptation without catastrophic forgetting, we design class-wise momentum queues that capture confident target features for adaptation while stochastically restoring pseudo-source features to revisit source knowledge. We further introduce two new benchmarks to facilitate the exploration of MM-CTTA in the future. Our experimental results show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on both benchmarks. Visit our project website at https://sites.google.com/view/mmcotta.
authors: Haozhi Cao, Yuecong Xu, Jianfei Yang, Pengyu Yin, Shenghai Yuan, Lihua Xie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18809-18819

title: 基于局部至全局专家门控混合的多模态动态图像融合方法
title_en: Multi-Modal Gated Mixture of Local-to-Global Experts for Dynamic Image Fusion
abstract: 红外与可见光图像融合旨在整合多源信息以在诸如检测等实际任务中实现优于单一模态的性能。然而,现有方法大多直接融合不同模态的纹理细节与目标对比度,忽视了现实中的动态变化,导致在良好光照条件下可见纹理信息丢失以及低光照条件下红外对比度不足。为填补这一空白,我们提出一种基于多模态门控局部至全局专家混合的动态图像融合框架,称为MoE-Fusion,以动态提取各模态的有效综合信息。我们的模型包含由多模态门引导的局部专家混合(MoLE)和全局专家混合(MoGE)。MoLE通过多模态局部特征的专门化学习,使融合图像以样本自适应方式保留局部信息;而MoGE则专注于补充融合图像的整体纹理细节与对比度的全局信息。大量实验表明,我们的MoE-Fusion通过局部至全局动态学习范式,在保持多模态图像纹理与对比度方面优于现有方法,并在检测任务中取得优越性能。我们的代码已开源:https://github.com/SunYM2020/MoE-Fusion
abstract_en: Infrared and visible image fusion aims to integrate comprehensive information from multiple sources to achieve superior performances on various practical tasks, such as detection, over that of a single modality. However, most existing methods directly combined the texture details and object contrast of different modalities, ignoring the dynamic changes in reality, which diminishes the visible texture in good lighting conditions and the infrared contrast in low lighting conditions. To fill this gap, we propose a dynamic image fusion framework with a multi-modal gated mixture of local-to-global experts, termed MoE-Fusion, to dynamically extract effective and comprehensive information from the respective modalities. Our model consists of a Mixture of Local Experts (MoLE) and a Mixture of Global Experts (MoGE) guided by a multi-modal gate. The MoLE performs specialized learning of multi-modal local features, prompting the fused images to retain the local information in a sample-adaptive manner, while the MoGE focuses on the global information that complements the fused image with overall texture detail and contrast. Extensive experiments show that our MoE-Fusion outperforms state-of-the-art methods in preserving multi-modal image texture and contrast through the local-to-global dynamic learning paradigm, and also achieves superior performance on detection tasks. Our code is available: https://github.com/SunYM2020/MoE-Fusion.
authors: Bing Cao, Yiming Sun, Pengfei Zhu, Qinghua Hu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23555-23564

title: 用于单目稠密SLAM的多模态神经辐射场与轻量级飞行时间传感器
title_en: Multi-Modal Neural Radiance Field for Monocular Dense SLAM with a Light-Weight ToF Sensor
abstract: 轻量级飞行时间(ToF)深度传感器体积小且成本低,因此被广泛用于移动设备的自动对焦和障碍物检测等任务。然而,由于稀疏且噪声较大的深度测量值,这些传感器很少被用于稠密几何重建。在本工作中,我们提出了首个结合单目相机和轻量级ToF传感器的稠密SLAM系统。具体而言,我们提出了一种多模态隐式场景表示方法,该方法支持从RGB相机和轻量级ToF传感器获取信号的渲染,并通过与原始传感器输入进行比较来驱动优化。此外,为确保姿态跟踪和重建的成功,我们利用预测深度作为中间监督,并开发了粗到细的优化策略以高效学习隐式表示。最后,显式利用时间信息处理轻量级ToF传感器的噪声信号,以提高系统的精度和鲁棒性。实验表明,我们的系统有效利用了轻量级ToF传感器的信号,在相机跟踪和稠密场景重建方面均取得了具有竞争力的结果。项目页面:https://zju3dv.github.io/tof_slam/
abstract_en: Light-weight time-of-flight (ToF) depth sensors are compact and cost-efficient, and thus widely used on mobile devices for tasks such as autofocus and obstacle detection. However, due to the sparse and noisy depth measurements, these sensors have rarely been considered for dense geometry reconstruction. In this work, we present the first dense SLAM system with a monocular camera and a light-weight ToF sensor. Specifically, we propose a multi-modal implicit scene representation that supports rendering both the signals from the RGB camera and light-weight ToF sensor which drives the optimization by comparing with the raw sensor inputs. Moreover, in order to guarantee successful pose tracking and reconstruction, we exploit a predicted depth as an intermediate supervision and develop a coarse-to-fine optimization strategy for efficient learning of the implicit representation. At last, the temporal information is explicitly exploited to deal with the noisy signals from light-weight ToF sensors to improve the accuracy and robustness of the system. Experiments demonstrate that our system well exploits the signals of light-weight ToF sensors and achieves competitive results both on camera tracking and dense scene reconstruction. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/tof_slam/.
authors: Xinyang Liu, Yijin Li, Yanbin Teng, Hujun Bao, Guofeng Zhang, Yinda Zhang, Zhaopeng Cui ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1-11

title: 基于低维目标运动的多目标发现
title_en: Multi-Object Discovery by Low-Dimensional Object Motion
abstract: 近期无监督多目标分割工作通过从单张图像预测运动取得了显著成果,尽管在缺乏下一帧图像的情况下预测运动存在固有歧义。另一方面,通过考虑场景结构和其中的运动物体,图像的可能运动集合可以被约束到低维空间。我们提出建模像素级几何和目标运动以消除从单张图像重构光流的歧义。具体而言,我们将图像划分为相干运动区域,并利用深度构造能够最佳解释每个区域观测到的光流的光流基。通过建模场景结构和目标运动,我们在合成和真实世界数据集上实现了无监督多目标分割的最先进结果。对预测深度图的评估显示在单目深度估计中具有可靠性能。
abstract_en: Recent work in unsupervised multi-object segmentation shows impressive results by predicting motion from a single image despite the inherent ambiguity in predicting motion without the next image. On the other hand, the set of possible motions for an image can be constrained to a low-dimensional space by considering the scene structure and moving objects in it. We propose to model pixel-wise geometry and object motion to remove ambiguity in reconstructing flow from a single image. Specifically, we divide the image into coherently moving regions and use depth to construct flow bases that best explain the observed flow in each region. We achieve state-of-the-art results in unsupervised multi-object segmentation on synthetic and real-world datasets by modeling the scene structure and object motion. Our evaluation of the predicted depth maps shows reliable performance in monocular depth estimation.
authors: Sadra Safadoust, Fatma Güney ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 734-744

title: 基于动态学习的神经隐式表示的多目标导航
title_en: Multi-Object Navigation with Dynamically Learned Neural Implicit Representations
abstract: 理解并构建新环境是任何自主导航智能体的核心能力。虽然经典机器人学通常通过SLAM变体独立估计地图,维持拓扑或度量表示,但端到端导航学习则在神经网络中保留某种形式的记忆。网络通常被赋予归纳偏置,其范围可从向量表示到俯视图度量张量或拓扑结构。在本工作中,我们提出通过两种神经隐式表示结构化神经网络,这些表示在每个episode中动态学习,并映射场景内容:(i) 语义查找器预测先前见过的查询物体位置;(ii) 占用与探索隐式表示封装已探索区域和障碍物信息,并通过新颖的全局读取机制查询,该机制直接从函数空间映射到可用嵌入空间。这两种表示均被强化学习(RL)训练的智能体利用,并在每个episode中在线学习。我们在多目标导航任务中评估该智能体,展示了使用神经隐式表示作为记忆源的显著效果。
abstract_en: Understanding and mapping a new environment are core abilities of any autonomously navigating agent.
