While classical robotics usually estimates maps in a stand-alone manner with SLAM variants, which maintain a topological or metric representation, end-to-end learning of navigation keeps some form of memory in a neural network. Networks are typically imbued with inductive biases, which can range from vectorial representations to birds-eye metric tensors or topological structures. In this work, we propose to structure neural networks with two neural implicit representations, which are learned dynamically during each episode and map the content of the scene: (i) the Semantic Finder predicts the position of a previously seen queried object; (ii) the Occupancy and Exploration Implicit Representation encapsulates information about explored area and obstacles, and is queried with a novel global read mechanism which directly maps from function space to a usable embedding space. Both representations are leveraged by an agent trained with Reinforcement Learning (RL) and learned online during each episode. We evaluate the agent on Multi-Object Navigation and show the high impact of using neural implicit representations as a memory source.
authors: Pierre Marza, Laetitia Matignon, Olivier Simonin, Christian Wolf ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11004-11015

title: 基于点云的场景流估计的多尺度双向循环网络与混合相关性
title_en: Multi-Scale Bidirectional Recurrent Network with Hybrid Correlation for Point Cloud Based Scene Flow Estimation
abstract: 场景流估计提供了动态场景的基础运动感知,在许多计算机视觉应用中具有实际重要性。本文提出了一种新颖的多尺度双向循环架构,通过迭代优化实现由粗到细的场景流估计。在每个分辨率尺度的估计中,提出了一种新型双向门控循环单元,用于双向且迭代地增强点特征并产生逐步优化的场景流。每次迭代的优化与混合相关性相结合,该相关性不仅捕捉局部相关性,还捕捉语义相关性,以实现更精确的估计。实验结果表明,所提出的架构在FlyingThings3D和KITTI基准测试中显著优于现有最先进的方法,同时保持了优越的时间效率。代码和预训练模型可在https://github.com/cwc1260/MSBRN公开获取。
abstract_en: Scene flow estimation provides the fundamental motion perception of a dynamic scene, which is of practical importance in many computer vision applications. In this paper, we propose a novel multi-scale bidirectional recurrent architecture that iteratively optimizes the coarse-to-fine scene flow estimation. In each resolution scale of estimation, a novel bidirectional gated recurrent unit is proposed to bidirectionally and iteratively augment point features and produce progressively optimized scene flow. The optimization of each iteration is integrated with the hybrid correlation that captures not only local correlation but also semantic correlation for more accurate estimation. Experimental results indicate that our proposed architecture significantly outperforms the existing state-of-the-art approaches on both FlyingThings3D and KITTI benchmarks while maintaining superior time efficiency. Codes and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/cwc1260/MSBRN.
authors: Wencan Cheng, Jong Hwan Ko ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10041-10050

title: 多尺度残差低通滤波器网络用于图像去模糊
title_en: Multi-Scale Residual Low-Pass Filter Network for Image Deblurring
abstract: 我们提出了一种简单且有效的多尺度残差低通滤波器网络(MRLPFNet),用于联合探索图像细节和主要结构以实现图像去模糊。我们的工作受到以下观察的启发:模糊图像与清晰图像之间的差异不仅包含高频内容(注意,图像中的高频内容对应图像细节,而低频内容表示图像的主要结构),还由于模糊的影响包含低频信息,而使用标准残差学习在建模模糊导致的主结构失真时效果不佳。考虑到低频内容通常对应空间可变的主要全局结构,我们首先提出了一种基于自注意力机制的可学习低通滤波器,以自适应地探索全局上下文,从而更好地建模低频信息。随后,我们将其嵌入到残差低通滤波器(RLPF)模块中,该模块包含一个额外的全卷积神经网络,结合标准残差学习以建模高频信息。我们基于编码器-解码器架构将RLPF模块公式化为端到端可训练网络,并开发了基于小波的特征融合方法以融合多尺度特征。实验结果表明,我们的方法在常用基准上优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: We present a simple and effective Multi-scale Residual Low-Pass Filter Network (MRLPFNet) that jointly explores the image details and main structures for image deblurring. Our work is motivated by an observation that the difference between the blurry image and the clear one not only contains high-frequency contents(Note that the high-frequency contents in an image correspond to the image details, while the low-frequency ones denote the main structures of an image.) but also includes low-frequency information due to the influence of blur, while using the standard residual learning is less effective for modeling the main structure distorted by the blur. Considering that the low-frequency contents usually correspond to main global structures that are spatially variant, we first propose a learnable low-pass filter based on a self-attention mechanism to adaptively explore the global contexts for better modeling the low-frequency information. Then we embed it into a Residual Low-Pass Filter (RLPF) module, which involves an additional fully convolutional neural network with the standard residual learning to model the high-frequency information. We formulate the RLPF module into an end-to-end trainable network based on an encoder and decoder architecture and develop a wavelet-based feature fusion to fuse the multi-scale features. Experimental results show that our method performs favorably against state-of-the-art ones on commonly-used benchmarks.
authors: Jiangxin Dong, Jinshan Pan, Zhongbao Yang, Jinhui Tang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12345-12354

title: 基于知识蒸馏的多任务学习用于密集预测
title_en: Multi-Task Learning with Knowledge Distillation for Dense Prediction
abstract: 尽管多任务学习(MTL)已成为一个引人注目的研究课题,但其训练过程通常比单任务情况更具挑战性。如何成功地将知识蒸馏应用于MTL以提升训练效率和模型性能仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。本文提出了一种新的知识蒸馏流程,基于两个简单的设计原则,用于密集预测的多任务学习中的替代匹配。首先,为了提高内存和训练效率,我们在训练过程中使用单一强多任务模型作为教师模型,而非现有研究中广泛采用的多个教师模型。其次,我们采用对噪声更鲁棒的柯西-施瓦茨(CS)散度,而非Kullback-Leibler(KL)散度,并据此提出相应的CS蒸馏损失函数。通过这种更鲁棒的散度,我们的基于替代匹配的知识蒸馏方法能够捕捉教师模型与每个任务的学生模型之间的任务间和任务内信息,从而学习更多"暗知识"以实现有效的蒸馏。我们在包含NYUD-v2和PASCAL-Context的数据集上进行了大量实验,涵盖语义分割、人体部件分割、深度估计、表面法线估计和边界检测等多视觉任务。实验结果表明,所提出的方法显著提升了模型性能和实际推理效率。
abstract_en: While multi-task learning (MTL) has become an attractive topic, its training usually poses more difficulties than the single-task case. How to successfully apply knowledge distillation into MTL to improve training efficiency and model performance is still a challenging problem. In this paper, we introduce a new knowledge distillation procedure with an alternative match for MTL of dense prediction based on two simple design principles. First, for memory and training efficiency, we use a single strong multi-task model as a teacher during training instead of multiple teachers, as widely adopted in existing studies. Second, we employ a less sensitive Cauchy-Schwarz (CS) divergence instead of the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence and propose a CS distillation loss accordingly. With the less sensitive divergence, our knowledge distillation with an alternative match is applied for capturing inter-task and intra-task information between the teacher model and the student model of each task, thereby learning more "dark knowledge" for effective distillation. We conducted extensive experiments on dense prediction datasets, including NYUD-v2 and PASCAL-Context, for multiple vision tasks, such as semantic segmentation, human parts segmentation, depth estimation, surface normal estimation, and boundary detection. The results show that our proposed method decidedly improves model performance and the practical inference efficiency.
authors: Yangyang Xu, Yibo Yang, Lefei Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21550-21559

title: 多视角主动细粒度视觉识别
title_en: Multi-View Active Fine-Grained Visual Recognition
abstract: 尽管细粒度视觉分类(FGVC)在多年的发展中取得了显著进展,但其仍局限于识别2张图像。识别物理世界中的物体(即三维环境)提出了独特的挑战——判别信息不仅存在于可见的局部区域,还存在于其他未见视角。因此,除了从当前视角中找到可区分的部分外,高效准确的识别还需要通过最少的观察推断关键视角。例如,一个人可能通过一瞥车的侧面就识别出一辆“福特轿车”,然后知道查看车前部有助于确定其具体型号。本文面向真实物理世界的FGVC问题,提出了多视角主动细粒度视觉识别(MAFR)问题,并分三步完成研究:(i)收集多视角细粒度车辆数据集作为测试平台,(ii)设计试点实验验证MAFR的必要性与研究价值,(iii)提出基于策略梯度的框架及动态退出策略,以实现主动视角选择的高效识别。我们的综合实验表明,所提方法优于先前的多视角识别工作,可扩展现有最先进的FGVC方法和先进神经网络,使其成为三维环境中的FGVC专家。
abstract_en: Despite the remarkable progress of Fine-grained visual classification (FGVC) with years of history, it is still limited to recognizing 2 images. Recognizing objects in the physical world (i.e., 3D environment) poses a unique challenge -- discriminative information is not only present in visible local regions but also in other unseen views. Therefore, in addition to finding the distinguishable part from the current view, efficient and accurate recognition requires inferring the critical perspective with minimal glances. E.g., a person might recognize a "Ford sedan" with a glance at its side and then know that looking at the front can help tell which model it is. In this paper, towards FGVC in the real physical world, we put forward the problem of multi-view active fine-grained visual recognition (MAFR) and complete this study in three steps: (i) a multi-view, fine-grained vehicle dataset is collected as the testbed, (ii) a pilot experiment is designed to validate the need and research value of MAFR, (iii) a policy-gradient-based framework along with a dynamic exiting strategy is proposed to achieve efficient recognition with active view selection. Our comprehensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms previous multi-view recognition works and can extend existing state-of-the-art FGVC methods and advanced neural networks to become FGVC experts in the 3D environment.
authors: Ruoyi Du, Wenqing Yu, Heqing Wang, Ting-En Lin, Dongliang Chang, Zhanyu Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1568-1578

title: 多体深度与相机姿态的多视角估计
title_en: Multi-body Depth and Camera Pose Estimation from Multiple Views
abstract: 传统和深度结构从运动(SfM)方法通常假设场景是刚性的,即环境是静态或仅包含单个运动物体。少数多体SfM方法解决了场景中多个刚体的重建问题,但受SfM固有尺度模糊的限制,导致物体在不一致的尺度下重建。我们提出了一种深度和相机姿态估计框架,以解决多体场景中的尺度模糊问题。具体而言,从无序图像出发,我们提出了一种新颖的多视角尺度估计器以解决相机姿态模糊,并设计了多体平面扫描网络以将深度估计推广到动态场景。实验表明,我们的方法在多体场景中优于现有SfM框架,在静态场景中也取得了可比的结果。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/andreadalcin/MultiBodySfM获取。
abstract_en: Traditional and deep Structure-from-Motion (SfM) methods typically operate under the assumption that the scene is rigid, i.e., the environment is static or consists of a single moving object. Few multi-body SfM approaches address the reconstruction of multiple rigid bodies in a scene but suffer from the inherent scale ambiguity of SfM, such that objects are reconstructed at inconsistent scales. We propose a depth and camera pose estimation framework to resolve the scale ambiguity in multi-body scenes. Specifically, starting from disorganized images, we present a novel multi-view scale estimator that resolves the camera pose ambiguity and a multi-body plane sweep network that generalizes depth estimation to dynamic scenes. Experiments demonstrate the advantages of our method over state-of-the-art SfM frameworks in multi-body scenes and show that it achieves comparable results in static scenes. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/andreadalcin/MultiBodySfM.
authors: Andrea Porfiri Dal Cin, Giacomo Boracchi, Luca Magri ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17804-17814

title: 少样本视频对象分割的多粒度时间原型学习
title_en: Multi-grained Temporal Prototype Learning for Few-shot Video Object Segmentation
abstract: 少样本视频对象分割(FSVOS)旨在利用少量标注的支持图像对查询视频中的同一类对象进行分割。然而,这一任务鲜有研究。在本工作中,基于IPMT(一种结合外部支持引导信息与自适应查询引导线索的最新少样本图像分割方法),我们提出利用多粒度时间引导信息来处理视频数据的时间相关性。我们将查询视频信息分解为片段原型和记忆原型,分别捕捉局部和长期内部时间引导。帧原型进一步用于每个帧独立处理,以实现细粒度自适应引导并建立双向片段-帧原型通信。为减少噪声记忆的影响,我们提出利用不同预测区域间的结构相似性关系及支持机制选择可靠记忆帧。此外,还提出新的分割损失函数以增强学习原型的类别可区分性。实验结果表明,所提出的视频IPMT模型在两个基准数据集上显著优于先前方法。代码可在https://github.com/nankepan/VIPMT获取。
abstract_en: Few-Shot Video Object Segmentation (FSVOS) aims to segment objects in a query video with the same category defined by a few annotated support images. However, this task was seldom explored. In this work, based on IPMT, a state-of-the-art few-shot image segmentation method that combines external support guidance information with adaptive query guidance cues, we propose to leverage multi-grained temporal guidance information for handling the temporal correlation nature of video data. We decompose the query video information into a clip prototype and a memory prototype for capturing local and long-term internal temporal guidance, respectively. Frame prototypes are further used for each frame independently to handle fine-grained adaptive guidance and enable bidirectional clip-frame prototype communication. To reduce the influence of noisy memory, we propose to leverage the structural similarity relation among different predicted regions and the support for selecting reliable memory frames. Furthermore, a new segmentation loss is also proposed to enhance the category discriminability of the learned prototypes. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed video IPMT model significantly outperforms previous models on two benchmark datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/nankepan/VIPMT.
authors: Nian Liu, Kepan Nan, Wangbo Zhao, Yuanwei Liu, Xiwen Yao, Salman Khan, Hisham Cholakkal, Rao Muhammad Anwer, Junwei Han, Fahad Shahbaz Khan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18862-18871

title: 无监督交互分割的多粒度交互模拟
title_en: Multi-granularity Interaction Simulation for Unsupervised Interactive Segmentation
abstract: 交互分割通过提供物体线索使用户能够按需进行分割,这为图像编辑和医学图像分析等多个领域引入了人机交互。通常,通过与手动标注的物体掩码进行面向对象的交互,需要大量且广泛的像素级标注来训练深度模型。在本工作中,我们揭示了在无监督范式中,通过语义一致且多样的区域探索可以生成具有信息量的交互。具体而言,我们引入了一种多粒度交互模拟(MIS)方法,为无监督交互分割开辟了有前景的方向。基于近期自监督模型生成的高质量密集特征,我们提出逐步合并相似特征的块或区域以形成更广泛的区域,从而每个合并区域都作为语义有意义的多粒度提案。通过随机采样这些提案并基于其模拟可能的交互,我们为模型提供多粒度有意义的交互以教导其理解交互。我们的MIS显著优于非深度学习无监督方法,并且在无需任何标注的情况下甚至可与某些先前的深度监督方法相媲美。
abstract_en: Interactive segmentation enables users to segment as needed by providing cues of objects, which introduces human-computer interaction for many fields, such as image editing and medical image analysis. Typically, massive and expansive pixel-level annotations are spent to train deep models by object-oriented interactions with manually labeled object masks. In this work, we reveal that informative interactions can be made by simulation with semantic-consistent yet diverse region exploration in an unsupervised paradigm. Concretely, we introduce a Multi-granularity Interaction Simulation (MIS) approach to open up a promising direction for unsupervised interactive segmentation. Drawing on the high-quality dense features produced by recent self-supervised models, we propose to gradually merge patches or regions with similar features to form more extensive regions and thus, every merged region serves as a semantic-meaningful multi-granularity proposal. By randomly sampling these proposals and simulating possible interactions based on them, we provide meaningful interaction at multiple granularities to teach the model to understand interactions. Our MIS significantly outperforms non-deep learning unsupervised methods and is even comparable with some previous deep-supervised methods without any annotation.
authors: Kehan Li, Yian Zhao, Zhennan Wang, Zesen Cheng, Peng Jin, Xiangyang Ji, Li Yuan, Chang Liu, Jie Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 666-676

title: 多交互特征学习与全天候多模态基准:图像融合与分割
title_en: Multi-interactive Feature Learning and a Full-time Multi-modality Benchmark for Image Fusion and Segmentation
abstract: 多模态图像融合与分割在自动驾驶和机器人操作中发挥着至关重要的作用。早期研究主要聚焦于单一任务的性能提升,例如仅优化融合或分割,难以实现`兼顾两者优势`。为解决这一问题,本文提出了一种用于图像融合与分割的多交互特征学习架构,命名为SegMiF,并利用双任务相关性提升两项任务的性能。SegMiF采用级联结构,包含一个融合子网络和常用分割子网络。通过巧妙地在两个组件间传递中间特征,分割任务所学到的知识可以有效辅助融合任务。同时,受益的融合网络也支持分割任务更精准地执行。此外,建立了一种层次化交互注意力模块,确保两个任务间所有关键信息的细粒度映射,使模态/语义特征能够充分互交互。另外,引入动态权重因子自动调整各任务的对应权重,可平衡交互特征对应关系并突破繁琐调参的限制。进一步地,我们构建了智能多波段双目成像系统,并收集了一个包含15个像素级标注类别的全天候多模态基准。在多个公开数据集和我们构建的基准上的大量实验表明,所提方法输出的融合图像视觉效果优异,在真实场景中分割mIoU平均高于现有最先进方法7.66%。源代码和基准数据可在https://github.com/JinyuanLiu-CV/SegMiF获取。
abstract_en: Multi-modality image fusion and segmentation play a vital role in autonomous driving and robotic operation. Early efforts focus on boosting the performance for only one task, e.g., fusion or segmentation, making it hard to reach `Best of Both Worlds'. To overcome this issue, in this paper, we propose a Multi-interactive Feature learning architecture for image fusion and segmentation, namely SegMiF, and exploit dual-task correlation to promote the performance of both tasks. The SegMiF is of a cascade structure, containing a fusion sub-network and a commonly used segmentation sub-network. By slickly bridging intermediate features between two components, the knowledge learned from the segmentation task can effectively assist the fusion task. Also, the benefited fusion network supports the segmentation one to perform more pretentiously. Besides, a hierarchical interactive attention block is established to ensure fine-grained mapping of all the vital information between two tasks, so that the modality/semantic features can be fully mutual-interactive. In addition, a dynamic weight factor is introduced to automatically adjust the corresponding weights of each task, which can balance the interactive feature correspondence and break through the limitation of laborious tuning. Furthermore, we construct a smart multi-wave binocular imaging system and collect a full-time multi-modality benchmark with 15 annotated pixel-level categories for image fusion and segmentation. Extensive experiments on several public datasets and our benchmark demonstrate that the proposed method outputs visually appealing fused images and perform averagely 7.66% higher segmentation mIoU in the real-world scene than the state-of-the-art approaches. The source code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/JinyuanLiu-CV/SegMiF.
authors: Jinyuan Liu, Zhu Liu, Guanyao Wu, Long Ma, Risheng Liu, Wei Zhong, Zhongxuan Luo, Xin Fan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8115-8124

title: 基于第一视角视觉的多标签可供性映射
title_en: Multi-label Affordance Mapping from Egocentric Vision
abstract: 精确的可供性检测与像素级分割是基于交互的复杂系统(如机器人和辅助设备)中的重要组成部分。我们提出了一种新的可供性感知方法,能够实现精确的多标签分割。我们的方法可以利用环境的三维地图,从第一视角交互视频中自动标注基于场景的可供性,并提供像素级精度的可供性位置信息。我们使用该方法构建了基于EPIC-Kitchen数据集的最大且最完整的可供性数据集EPIC-Aff,该数据集提供了自动的、基于交互的、多标签的、度量的和空间的可供性标注。随后,我们提出了一种基于多标签检测的可供性分割新方法,使得同一空间中可以共存多个可供性(例如与同一物体相关联的可供性)。我们展示了多种多标签检测策略,采用多种分割架构进行实现。实验结果强调了多标签检测的重要性。最后,我们展示了如何利用我们的度量表示构建空间动作中心区域的交互热点地图,并利用该表示进行任务导向的导航。
abstract_en: Accurate affordance detection and segmentation with pixel precision is an important piece in many complex systems based on interactions, such as robots and assitive devices. We present a new approach to affordance perception which enables accurate multi-label segmentation. Our approach can be used to automatically annotate grounded affordances from first person videos of interactions using a 3D map of the environment providing pixel level precision for the affordance location. We use this method to build the largest and most complete dataset on affordances based on the EPIC-Kitchen dataset, EPIC-Aff, which provides automatic, interaction-grounded, multi-label, metric and spatial affordance annotations. Then, we propose a new approach to affordance segmentation based on multi-label detection which enables multiple affordances to co-exists in the same space, for example if they are associated with the same object. We present several strategies of multi-label detection using several segmentation architectures. The experimental results highlights the importance of the multi-label detection. Finally, we show how our metric representation can be exploited for build a map of interaction hotspots in spatial action-centric zones and use that representation to perform a task-oriented navigation.
authors: Lorenzo Mur-Labadia, Jose J. Guerrero, Ruben Martinez-Cantin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5238-5249

title: 基于神经辐射场的多任务视图合成
title_en: Multi-task View Synthesis with Neural Radiance Fields
abstract: 多任务视觉学习是计算机视觉的关键方面。然而当前研究主要集中在多任务密集预测设置上,忽视了内在三维世界及其多视角一致结构,且缺乏对多样化想象能力的支持。为应对这些局限性,我们提出了一种新型问题设定——多任务视图合成(MTVS),将多任务预测重新诠释为对多种场景属性(包括RGB)的新型视图合成任务集合。为解决MTVS问题,我们提出了MuvieNeRF框架,该框架融合多任务与跨视角知识,可同时合成多种场景属性。MuvieNeRF集成了两个关键模块:跨任务注意力(CTA)模块和跨视角注意力(CVA)模块,实现了多视角与多任务间信息的高效利用。在合成与真实基准数据集上的广泛评估表明,MuvieNeRF能够同时合成不同场景属性并具有良好的视觉质量,甚至在多种设置下超越传统判别模型。值得注意的是,我们展示了MuvieNeRF在多种NeRF主干网络上的普适性。我们的代码已开源在https://github.com/zsh2000/MuvieNeRF。
abstract_en: Multi-task visual learning is a critical aspect of computer vision. Current research, however, predominantly concentrates on the multi-task dense prediction setting, which overlooks the intrinsic 3D world and its multi-view consistent structures, and lacks the capacity for versatile imagination. In response to these limitations, we present a novel problem setting -- multi-task view synthesis (MTVS), which reinterprets multi-task prediction as a set of novel-view synthesis tasks for multiple scene properties, including RGB. To tackle the MTVS problem, we propose MuvieNeRF, a framework that incorporates both multi-task and cross-view knowledge to simultaneously synthesize multiple scene properties. MuvieNeRF integrates two key modules, the Cross-Task Attention (CTA) and Cross-View Attention (CVA) modules, enabling the efficient use of information across multiple views and tasks. Extensive evaluations on both synthetic and realistic benchmarks demonstrate that MuvieNeRF is capable of simultaneously synthesizing different scene properties with promising visual quality, even outperforming conventional discriminative models in various settings. Notably, we show that MuvieNeRF exhibits universal applicability across a range of NeRF backbones. Our code is available at https://github.com/zsh2000/MuvieNeRF.
authors: Shuhong Zheng, Zhipeng Bao, Martial Hebert, Yu-Xiong Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21538-21549

title: 面向通用图像去噪的多视图自监督解耦方法
title_en: Multi-view Self-supervised Disentanglement for General Image Denoising
abstract: 随着性能的显著提升,深度学习范式已成为现代图像去噪器的标准工具。尽管在已知噪声分布上展现出良好的性能,现有方法常面临对未知噪声类型或通用真实噪声的泛化能力不足的问题。这源于模型设计旨在学习配对映射(例如从噪声图像到其干净版本)。本文提出通过学习解耦噪声图像来解决该问题,基于直观假设:同一干净图像的不同退化版本共享潜在空间。我们提出一种自监督学习框架以实现该目标,无需直接观察潜在干净图像。通过将同一图像的两个不同退化版本作为输入,所提出的多视图自监督解耦(MeD)方法能够学习从退化中分离潜在干净特征,并最终恢复干净图像。在合成和真实噪声上的大量实验分析表明,所提方法优于现有自监督方法,尤其在未知新型噪声类型上表现突出。在真实噪声场景中,该方法甚至超越其监督学习对应方法超过3dB。
abstract_en: With its significant performance improvements, the deep learning paradigm has become a standard tool for modern image denoisers. While promising performance has been shown on seen noise distributions, existing approaches often suffer from generalisation to unseen noise types or general and real noise. It is understandable as the model is designed to learn paired mapping (e.g. from a noisy image to its clean version). In this paper, we instead propose to learn to disentangle the noisy image, under the intuitive assumption that different corrupted versions of the same clean image share a common latent space. A self-supervised learning framework is proposed to achieve the goal, without looking at the latent clean image. By taking two different corrupted versions of the same image as input, the proposed Multi-view Self-supervised Disentanglement (MeD) approach learns to disentangle the latent clean features from the corruptions and recover the clean image consequently. Extensive experimental analysis on both synthetic and real noise shows the superiority of the proposed method over prior self-supervised approaches, especially on unseen novel noise types. On real noise, the proposed method even outperforms its supervised counterparts by over 3dB.
authors: Hao Chen, Chenyuan Qu, Yu Zhang, Chen Chen, Jianbo Jiao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12281-12291

title: 多视角光谱偏振传播用于视频玻璃分割
title_en: Multi-view Spectral Polarization Propagation for Video Glass Segmentation
abstract: 本文提出了一种偏振引导的视频玻璃分割传播方法(PGVS-Net),该方法能够稳健且一致地在RGB-P视频序列中传播玻璃分割。通过利用时空偏振和颜色信息,我们的方法结合了多视角偏振线索,从而可以缓解单输入强度变化对玻璃物体的视角依赖性。我们证明了我们的模型在RGB-only视频序列上的玻璃分割性能优于现有方法,并且比逐帧RGB-P单图像分割方法产生更鲁棒的分割结果。为训练和验证PGVS-Net,我们引入了一个新颖的RGB-P玻璃视频数据集(PGV-117),包含117个不同摄像机路径、光照条件、动态和玻璃类型的场景视频序列。
abstract_en:
In this paper, we present the first polarization-guided video glass segmentation propagation solution (PGVS-Net) that can robustly and coherently propagate glass segmentation in RGB-P video sequences. By leveraging spatiotemporal polarization and color information, our method combines multi-view polarization cues and thus can alleviate the view dependence of single-input intensity variations on glass objects. We demonstrate that our model can outperform glass segmentation on RGB-only video sequences as well as produce more robust segmentation than per-frame RGB-P single-image segmentation methods. To
 train and validate PGVS-Net, we introduce a novel RGB-P Glass Video dataset (PGV-117) containing 117 video sequences of scenes captured with different types of camera paths, lighting conditions, dynamics, and glass types.
authors: Yu Qiao, Bo Dong, Ao Jin, Yu Fu, Seung-Hwan Baek, Felix Heide, Pieter Peers, Xiaopeng Wei, Xin Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23218-23228

title: 基于域迁移的多天气图像修复
title_en: Multi-weather Image Restoration via Domain Translation
abstract: 雨、雾霾、雪等天气退化条件可能降低大多数计算机视觉系统的性能。因此,有效修复多天气退化图像对于此类系统的成功运行是必不可少的前提。当前的多天气图像修复方法采用一个在包含雨天、雪天和雾霾等单个天气退化图像的综合数据集上训练的模型。这些方法在处理现实世界中可能包含多种复杂天气条件的图像时可能面临挑战。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种基于域迁移的统一多天气图像修复方法。在该方法中,所提出的网络能够同时学习多种天气退化情况,从而适应现实世界条件。具体而言,我们首先提出了一种实例级域(天气)迁移与多注意力特征学习方法,以获取同一场景的不同天气退化变体。随后,原始图像和迁移后的图像作为输入,送入所提出的新型多天气修复网络,该网络采用渐进式多域可变形对齐(PMDA)与级联多头注意力(CMA)。所提出的PMDA有助于修复网络有效学习天气不变的线索。此外,通过所提出的CMA模块将PMDA和相应的解码器特征进行融合以实现修复。在合成和真实世界雾霾、雨天和雪天图像数据库上的大量实验结果清楚地表明,我们的模型优于现有的多天气图像修复方法。我们的代码URL见补充材料,将在接受后公开。
abstract_en: Weather degraded conditions such as rain, haze, snow, etc. may degrade the performance of most computer vision systems. Therefore, effective restoration of multi-weather degraded images is an essential prerequisite for successful functioning of such systems. The current multi-weather image restoration approaches utilize a model that is trained on a combined dataset consisting of individual images for rainy, snowy, and hazy weather degradations. These methods may face challenges when dealing with real-world situations where the images may have multiple, more intricate weather conditions. To address this issue, we propose a domain translation-based unified method for multi-weather image restoration. In this approach, the proposed network learns multiple weather degradations simultaneously, making it immune for real-world conditions. Specifically, we first propose an instance-level domain (weather) translation with multi-attentive feature learning approach to get different weather-degraded variants of the same scenario. Next, the original and translated images are used as input to the proposed novel multi-weather restoration network which utilizes a progressive multi-domain deformable alignment (PMDA) with cascaded multi-head attention (CMA). The proposed PMDA facilitates the restoration network to learn weather-invariant clues effectively. Further, PMDA and respective decoder features are merged via proposed CMA module for restoration. Extensive experimental results on synthetic and real-world hazy, rainy, and snowy image databases clearly demonstrate that our model outperforms the state-of-the-art multi-weather image restoration methods. The URL for our code is provided in the supplementary material and will be made public upon acceptance.
authors: Prashant W. Patil, Sunil Gupta, Santu Rana, Svetha Venkatesh, Subrahmanyam Murala ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21696-21705

title: Multi3DRefer: 文本描述到多个三维对象的定位
title_en: Multi3DRefer: Grounding Text Description to Multiple 3D Objects
abstract: 我们引入了在真实世界三维场景中使用自然语言描述定位可变数量对象的任务。现有三维视觉定位任务主要关注给定文本描述时定位唯一对象。然而,这种严格设置并不自然,因为在实际场景和机器人任务(如视觉导航和物体重新排列)中,定位潜在的多个对象是一个常见需求。为应对这一场景,我们提出了Multi3DRefer,扩展了ScanRefer数据集和任务。我们的数据集包含11609个对象的61926个描述,每个描述可能引用零个、单个或多个目标对象。我们还引入了新的评估指标和从先前工作引入的基准方法,以促进多模态三维场景理解的进一步研究。此外,我们开发了一个更优的基线方法,通过对比学习在线生成对象建议,利用CLIP的2D特征,该方法在ScanRefer基准上超越了当前最佳方法。
abstract_en: We introduce the task of localizing a flexible number of objects in real-world 3D scenes using natural language descriptions. Existing 3D visual grounding tasks focus on localizing a unique object given a text description. However, such a strict setting is unnatural as localizing potentially multiple objects is a common need in real-world scenarios and robotic tasks (e.g., visual navigation and object rearrangement). To address this setting we propose Multi3DRefer, generalizing the ScanRefer dataset and task. Our dataset contains 61926 descriptions of 11609 objects, where zero, single or multiple target objects are referenced by each description. We also introduce a new evaluation metric and benchmark methods from prior work to enable further investigation of multi-modal 3D scene understanding. Furthermore, we develop a better baseline leveraging 2D features from CLIP by rendering object proposals online with contrastive learning, which outperforms the state of the art on the ScanRefer benchmark.
authors: Yiming Zhang, ZeMing Gong, Angel X. Chang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15225-15236

title: 面向第一视角动作识别的多模态知识蒸馏
title_en: Multimodal Distillation for Egocentric Action Recognition
abstract: 第一视角视频理解的核心在于建模手-物体交互。标准模型(如CNNs或Vision Transformers)以RGB帧作为输入表现良好,但通过引入提供互补信息的额外输入模态(如物体检测、光流、音频等)可进一步提升性能。然而,模态特定模块的复杂性使得这些模型在部署时存在实际困难。本工作的目标是在推理时仅使用RGB帧作为输入,同时保留多模态方法的性能。我们证明,在Epic-Kitchens和Something-Something数据集上的第一视角动作识别任务中,由多模态教师模型指导训练的学生模型相较于以地面真实标签进行单模态或多模态训练的等效架构模型,通常具有更高的准确性与更好的校准效果。我们进一步提出了一种基于原理的多模态知识蒸馏框架,能够有效解决在简单应用多模态知识蒸馏时出现的问题。最后,我们展示了计算复杂度的降低效果,并证明在减少输入视角数量的同时,我们的方法仍能保持更高的性能。
abstract_en:
The focal point of egocentric video understanding is modelling hand-object interactions. Standard models, e.g. CNNs or Vision Transformers, which receive RGB frames as input perform well, however, their performance improves
 further by employing additional input modalities that provide complementary cues, such as object detections, optical flow, audio, etc. The added complexity of the modality-specific modules, on the other hand, makes these models impractical for deployment. The goal of this work is to retain the performance of such a multimodal approach, while using only the RGB frames as input at inference time. We demonstrate that for egocentric action recognition on the Epic-Kitchens and the Something-Something datasets, students which are taught by multimodal teachers tend to be more accurate and better calibrated than architecturally equivalent models trained on ground truth labels in a unimodal or multimodal fashion. We further present a principled multimodal knowledge distillation framework, allowing us to deal with issues which occur when applying multimodal knowledge distillation in a naive manner. Lastly, we demonstrate the achieved reduction in computational complexity, and show that our approach maintains higher performance with the reduction of the number of input views.
authors: Gorjan Radevski, Dusan Grujicic, Matthew Blaschko, Marie-Francine Moens, Tinne Tuytelaars ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5213-5224

title: 多模态服装设计:面向人类的潜在扩散模型用于时尚图像编辑
title_en: Multimodal Garment Designer: Human-Centric Latent Diffusion Models for Fashion Image Editing
abstract: 时尚插图被设计师用来传达其愿景,并将设计概念转化为实际成果,展示服装与人体的互动方式。在此背景下,计算机视觉可用于改进时尚设计流程。与以往主要关注服装虚拟试穿的研究不同,我们提出多模态条件的时尚图像编辑任务,通过遵循文本、人体姿态和服装草图等多模态提示来指导以人类为中心的时尚图像生成。我们通过提出一种基于潜在扩散模型的新架构来解决该问题,这一方法此前尚未在时尚领域应用。鉴于缺乏适合该任务的现有数据集,我们还通过半自动方式扩展了两个现有时尚数据集,即Dress Code和VITON-HD,增加了多模态注释。在这些新数据集上的实验结果证明了我们方法的有效性,无论是在真实感还是与给定多模态输入的一致性方面。源代码和收集的多模态注释可在以下链接公开获取:https://github.com/aimagelab/multimodal-garment-designer.
abstract_en: Fashion illustration is used by designers to communicate their vision and to bring the design idea from conceptualization to realization, showing how clothes interact with the human body. In this context, computer vision can thus be used to improve the fashion design process. Differently from previous works that mainly focused on the virtual try-on of garments, we propose the task of multimodal-conditioned fashion image editing, guiding the generation of human-centric fashion images by following multimodal prompts, such as text, human body poses, and garment sketches. We tackle this problem by proposing a new architecture based on latent diffusion models, an approach that has not been used before in the fashion domain. Given the lack of existing datasets suitable for the task, we also extend two existing fashion datasets, namely Dress Code and VITON-HD, with multimodal annotations collected in a semi-automatic manner. Experimental results on these new datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposal, both in terms of realism and coherence with the given multimodal inputs. Source code and collected multimodal annotations are publicly available at: https://github.com/aimagelab/multimodal-garment-designer.
authors: Alberto Baldrati, Davide Morelli, Giuseppe Cartella, Marcella Cornia, Marco Bertini, Rita Cucchiara ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23393-23402

title: 多模态高阶关系变换器用于场景边界检测
title_en: Multimodal High-order Relation Transformer for Scene Boundary Detection
abstract: 场景边界检测将长视频分解为有意义的叙事单元,并在高层视频理解中发挥关键作用。尽管该领域已取得显著进展,但该任务仍是一个具有挑战性的问题,因为它需要全面理解多模态线索和高层语义。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种多模态高阶关系变换器,该变换器在一个统一框架中集成了高阶编码器和自适应解码器。通过建模多模态线索并探索镜头间的相似性,编码器能够捕捉镜头间的高阶关系,并提取具有上下文语义的镜头特征。通过自适应聚类镜头,解码器可以发现连续场景之间更普遍的切换模式,从而有助于场景边界检测。在三个标准基准上的广泛实验结果表明,所提出的模型在最先进的视频场景检测方法上表现优异。
abstract_en: Scene boundary detection breaks down long videos into meaningful story-telling units and plays a crucial role in high-level video understanding. Despite significant advancements in this area, this task remains a challenging problem as it requires a comprehensive understanding of multimodal cues and high-level semantics. To tackle this issue, we propose a multimodal high-order relation transformer, which integrates a high-order encoder and an adaptive decoder in a unified framework. By modeling the multimodal cues and exploring similarities between the shots, the encoder is capable of capturing high-order relations between shots and extracting shot features with context semantics. By clustering the shots adaptively, the decoder can discover more universal switch pattern between successive scenes, thus helping scene boundary detection. Extensive experimental results on three standard benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed model performs favorably against state-of-the-art video scene detection methods.
authors: Xi Wei, Zhangxiang Shi, Tianzhu Zhang, Xiaoyuan Yu, Lei Xiao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22081-22090

title: 基于骨架的视频异常检测的多模态运动条件扩散模型
title_en: Multimodal Motion Conditioned Diffusion Model for Skeleton-based Video Anomaly Detection
abstract: 异常现象具有罕见性,因此异常检测常被框架为一类分类(OCC),即仅在正常样本上进行训练。领先的OCC技术通过限制正常运动的潜在表示空间体积来实现,将超出该空间的任何内容判定为异常,这在一定程度上满足了异常的开放集特性。但正常性同样具有开放集属性,因为人类可以以多种方式执行相同动作,而领先技术忽略了这一特性。我们提出了一种新的生成模型用于视频异常检测(VAD),假设正常性与异常性均为多模态。我们考虑骨架表示,并利用最先进的扩散概率模型生成多模态的未来人体姿态。我们贡献了一种基于人们过去运动的条件化方法,并利用扩散过程改进的模式覆盖能力生成不同但合理的未来运动。在对未来模式进行统计聚合时,当生成的运动集合与实际未来不相关时判定为异常。我们在4个基准数据集(UBnormal、HR-UBnormal、HR-STC和HR-Avenue)上验证了我们的模型,实验结果超越了现有最先进方法。
abstract_en:
Anomalies are rare and anomaly detection is often therefore framed as One-Class Classification (OCC), i.e. trained solely on normalcy. Leading OCC techniques constrain the latent representations of normal motions to limited volumes and detect as abnormal anything outside, which accounts satisfactorily for the openset'ness of anomalies. But normalcy shares the same openset'ness property, since humans can perform the same action in several ways, which the leading techniques neglect.
 We propose a novel generative model for video anomaly detection (VAD), which assumes that both normality and abnormality are multimodal. We consider skeletal representations and leverage state-of-the-art diffusion probabilistic models to generate multimodal future human poses. We contribute a novel conditioning on the past motion of people and exploit the improved mode coverage capabilities of diffusion processes to generate different-but-plausible future motions. Upon the statistical aggregation of future modes, an anomaly is detected when the generated set of motions is not pertinent to the actual future. We validate our model on 4 established benchmarks: UBnormal, HR-UBnormal, HR-STC, and HR-Avenue, with extensive experiments surpassing state-of-the-art results.
authors: Alessandro Flaborea, Luca Collorone, Guido Maria D'Amely di Melendugno, Stefano D'Arrigo, Bardh Prenkaj, Fabio Galasso ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10318-10329

title: 基于多模态最优传输协同注意力变换器与全局结构一致性的生存预测方法
title_en: Multimodal Optimal Transport-based Co-Attention Transformer with Global Structure Consistency for Survival Prediction
abstract: 生存预测是一项复杂的序数回归任务,旨在预测死亡风险的排序,通常受益于组织学与基因组数据的整合。尽管在病理学与基因组学联合学习方面取得了进展,现有方法仍面临挑战性问题:1)由于病理图像尺寸庞大,难以有效表示吉像素全切片图像(WSIs)。2)组织学中肿瘤微环境(TME)内的交互对生存分析至关重要。尽管当前方法尝试通过组织学与基因组数据间的协同注意力建模这些交互,但仅关注模态间的密集局部相似性,无法捕捉潜在结构间的全局一致性,即组织学TME相关交互与基因组共表达之间的关系。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种基于多模态最优传输协同注意力变换器的框架,具有全局结构一致性,其中最优传输(OT)用于匹配WSI的图像块与基因嵌入,以选择信息量大的图像块表示吉像素WSI。更重要的是,基于OT的协同注意力为有效捕捉TME内结构交互提供了全局感知能力,以进行生存预测。为克服OT的高计算复杂度,我们提出在WSI图像块的微批次上进行鲁棒且高效的实现,通过用不平衡微批次OT近似原始OT。大量实验表明,与现有方法相比,我们的方法在五个基准数据集上表现出优越性。代码将被发布。
abstract_en: Survival prediction is a complicated ordinal regression task that aims to predict the ranking risk of death, which generally benefits from the integration of histology and genomic data. Despite the progress in joint learning from pathology and genomics, existing methods still suffer from challenging issues: 1) Due to the large size of pathological images, it is difficult to effectively represent the gigapixel whole slide images (WSIs). 2) Interactions within tumor microenvironment (TME) in histology are essential for survival analysis. Although current approaches attempt to model these interactions via co-attention between histology and genomic data, they focus on only dense local similarity across modalities, which fails to capture global consistency between potential structures, i.e. TME-related interactions of histology and co-expression of genomic data. To address these challenges, we propose a Multimodal Optimal Transport-based Co-Attention Transformer framework with global structure consistency, in which optimal transport (OT) is applied to match patches of a WSI and genes embeddings for selecting informative patches to represent the gigapixel WSI. More importantly, OT-based co-attention provides a global awareness to effectively capture structural interactions within TME for survival prediction. To overcome high computational complexity of OT, we propose a robust and efficient implementation over micro-batch of WSI patches by approximating the original OT with unbalanced mini-batch OT. Extensive experiments show the superiority of our method on five benchmark datasets compared to the state-of-the-art methods. The code will be released.
authors: Yingxue Xu, Hao Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21241-21251

title: 基于多模态变分自编码器的音频-视觉分割
title_en: Multimodal Variational Auto-encoder based Audio-Visual Segmentation
abstract: 我们提出了一种显式条件多模态变分自编码器(ECMVAE),用于音频-视觉分割(AVS),旨在对视频序列中的声源进行分割。现有AVS方法主要关注隐式特征融合策略,模型被训练以拟合数据集中的离散样本。由于数据集有限且多样性不足,导致性能通常不理想。相反,我们从有效的表征学习角度出发,旨在显式建模各模态的贡献。具体而言,我们发现音频包含声源的关键类别信息,而视觉数据提供候选声源。它们的共享信息对应于视觉数据中显示的目标声源。在此情况下,跨模态共享表征学习对AVS尤为重要。为实现这一目标,我们的ECMVAE通过共享表征和模态特异性表征对每个模态的表征进行分解。在共享与特异性表征之间应用正交性约束,以保持分解后的潜在编码的独占属性。进一步引入互信息最大化正则化器,以实现各模态的广泛探索。在AVSBench上的定量和定性评估验证了我们方法的有效性,实现了AVS的新SOTA,在具有挑战性的MS3子集上,多声源分割的mIOU性能提升了3.84。代码和预训练模型将发布,以提供我们提出方法的完整细节。
abstract_en: We propose an Explicit Conditional Multimodal Variational Auto-Encoder (ECMVAE) for audio-visual segmentation (AVS), aiming to segment sound sources in the video sequence. Existing AVS methods focus on implicit feature fusion strategies, where models are trained to fit the discrete samples in the dataset. With a limited and less diverse dataset, the resulting performance is usually unsatisfactory. In contrast, we address this problem from an effective representation learning perspective, aiming to model the contribution of each modality explicitly. Specifically, we find that audio contains critical category information of the sound producers, and visual data provides candidate sound producer(s). Their shared information corresponds to the target sound producer(s) shown in the visual data. In this case, cross-modal shared representation learning is especially important for AVS. To achieve this, our ECMVAE factorizes the representations of each modality with a modality-shared representation and a modality-specific representation. An orthogonality constraint is applied between the shared and specific representations to maintain the exclusive attribute of the factorized latent code. Further, a mutual information maximization regularizer is introduced to achieve extensive exploration of each modality. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on the AVSBench demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, leading to a new state-of-the-art for AVS, with a 3.84 mIOU performance leap on the challenging MS3 subset for multiple sound source segmentation. Code and pre-train model will release to provide full details of our proposed method.
authors: Yuxin Mao, Jing Zhang, Mochu Xiang, Yiran Zhong, Yuchao Dai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 954-965

title: 基于掩码难实例挖掘的多实例学习框架用于全切片图像分类
title_en: Multiple Instance Learning Framework with Masked Hard Instance Mining for Whole Slide Image Classification
abstract: 全切片图像(WSI)分类通常被建模为多实例学习(MIL)问题。由于正组织仅占吉像素级WSI的一小部分,现有MIL方法直观地通过注意力机制识别显著实例。然而,这种做法会导致对易分类实例的偏向性,而忽视了难分类实例。一些文献表明,难例有助于准确建模判别边界。通过在实例层面应用这一思想,我们提出了一种新颖的MIL框架——掩码难实例挖掘(MHIM-MIL),该框架采用具有一致性约束的双胞胎结构(教师-学生)来探索潜在的难实例。通过基于注意力分数的多种实例掩码策略,MHIM-MIL利用动量教师隐式挖掘难实例以训练学生模型,该学生模型可以是任意基于注意力的MIL模型。这种反直觉策略本质上使学生能够学习到更优的判别边界。此外,学生模型通过指数移动平均(EMA)更新教师模型,从而在后续训练迭代中识别新的难实例并稳定优化过程。在CAMELYON-16和TCGA肺癌数据集上的实验结果表明,MHIM-MIL在性能和训练成本方面均优于其他最新方法。代码已开源:https://github.com/DearCaat/MHIM-MIL
abstract_en: The whole slide image (WSI) classification is often formulated as a multiple instance learning (MIL) problem. Since the positive tissue is only a small fraction of the gigapixel WSI, existing MIL methods intuitively focus on identifying salient instances via attention mechanisms. However, this leads to a bias towards easy-to-classify instances while neglecting hard-to-classify instances. Some literature has revealed that hard examples are beneficial for modeling a discriminative boundary accurately. By applying such an idea at the instance level, we elaborate a novel MIL framework with masked hard instance mining (MHIM-MIL), which uses a Siamese structure (Teacher-Student) with a consistency constraint to explore the potential hard instances. With several instance masking strategies based on attention scores, MHIM-MIL employs a momentum teacher to implicitly mine hard instances for training the student model, which can be any attention-based MIL model. This counter-intuitive strategy essentially enables the student to learn a better discriminating boundary. Moreover, the student is used to update the teacher with an exponential moving average (EMA), which in turn identifies new hard instances for subsequent training iterations and stabilizes the optimization. Experimental results on the CAMELYON-16 and TCGA Lung Cancer datasets demonstrate that MHIM-MIL outperforms other latest methods in terms of performance and training cost. The code is available at: https://github.com/DearCaat/MHIM-MIL.
authors: Wenhao Tang, Sheng Huang, Xiaoxian Zhang, Fengtao Zhou, Yi Zhang, Bo Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4078-4087

title: 多平面物体跟踪
title_en: Multiple Planar Object Tracking
abstract: 对多平面物体(MPOT)的位置和姿态进行跟踪对于众多现实世界应用具有重要意义。与普通物体相比,平面物体具有更高的自由度,使得MPOT比已研究成熟的物体跟踪更具挑战性,尤其是在发生遮挡时。为解决这一挑战性任务,我们受到人类无模态感知的启发,即同时跟踪目标的可见和不可见部分,提出了一种统一外观感知与遮挡推理的跟踪框架。具体而言,我们设计了一个双分支网络来跟踪平面物体的可见部分,包括顶点和掩码。随后,我们开发了一种遮挡区域定位策略以推断不可见部分,即遮挡区域,最后通过双流注意力网络进一步优化预测结果。为缓解该领域数据不足的问题,我们构建了首个大规模基准数据集MPOT-3K。该数据集包含356个视频中的3,717个平面物体,共148,896帧和687,417个标注。收集的平面物体具有9种运动模式,视频拍摄于6种室内和室外场景。大量实验验证了所提方法在新构建的MPOT-3K数据集及其他两个流行的单平面物体跟踪数据集上的优越性。代码和MPOT-3K数据集已发布于https://zzcheng.top/MPOT。
abstract_en: Tracking both location and pose of multiple planar objects (MPOT) is of great significance to numerous real-world applications. The greater degree-of-freedom of planar objects compared with common objects makes MPOT far more challenging than well-studied object tracking, especially when occlusion occurs. To address this challenging task, we are inspired by amodal perception that humans jointly track visible and invisible parts of the target, and propose a tracking framework that unifies appearance perception and occlusion reasoning. Specifically, we present a dual-branch network to track the visible part of planar objects, including vertexes and mask. Then, we develop an occlusion area localization strategy to infer the invisible part, i.e., the occluded region, followed by a two-stream attention network finally refining the prediction. To alleviate the lack of data in this field, we build the first large-scale benchmark dataset, namely MPOT-3K. It consists of 3,717 planar objects from 356 videos and contains 148,896 frames together with 687,417 annotations. The collected planar objects have 9 motion patterns and the videos are shot in 6 types of indoor and outdoor scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our proposed method on the newly developed MPOT-3K as well as other two popular single planar object tracking datasets. The code and MPOT-3K dataset are released on https://zzcheng.top/MPOT.
authors: Zhicheng Zhang, Shengzhe Liu, Jufeng Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23460-23470

title: 面向实时抗锯齿神经渲染的多尺度表示
title_en: Multiscale Representation for Real-Time Anti-Aliasing Neural Rendering
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRF)的渲染方案通过将光线投射到场景中有效渲染像素。然而,当训练图像在非均匀尺度下捕获时,NeRF会产生模糊的渲染结果;若测试图像在远距离视角下采集,则会产生走样伪影。为解决此问题,Mip-NeRF提出以圆锥台作为多尺度表示来编码尺度信息。然而,该方法仅适用于离线渲染,因其依赖集成位置编码(IPE)查询多层感知机(MLP)。为克服这一局限性,我们提出mip体素网格(Mip-VoG),一种具有延迟架构的显式多尺度表示,用于实时抗锯齿渲染。我们的方法包含用于场景几何的密度Mip-VoG和用于视角相关颜色的小型MLP的特征Mip-VoG。Mip-VoG通过光线微分导出的细节层次(LOD)表示场景尺度,并利用四线性插值将查询的3D位置映射到相邻下采样体素网格的特征和密度。据我们所知,我们的方法是首个同时实现多尺度训练和实时抗锯齿渲染的方案。我们在多尺度数据集上进行了实验,结果表明我们的方法优于最先进的实时渲染基线。
abstract_en: The rendering scheme in neural radiance field (NeRF) is effective in rendering a pixel by casting a ray into the scene. However, NeRF yields blurred rendering results when the training images are captured at non-uniform scales, and produces aliasing artifacts if the test images are taken in distant views. To address this issue, Mip-NeRF proposes a multiscale representation as a conical frustum to encode scale information. Nevertheless, this approach is only suitable for offline rendering since it relies on integrated positional encoding (IPE) to query a multilayer perceptron (MLP). To overcome this limitation, we propose mip voxel grids (Mip-VoG), an explicit multiscale representation with a deferred architecture for real-time anti-aliasing rendering. Our approach includes a density Mip-VoG for scene geometry and a feature Mip-VoG with a small MLP for view-dependent color. Mip-VoG represents scene scale using the level of detail (LOD) derived from ray differentials and uses quadrilinear interpolation to map a queried 3D location to its features and density from two neighboring down-sampled voxel grids. To our knowledge, our approach is the first to offer multiscale training and real-time anti-aliasing rendering simultaneously. We conducted experiments on multiscale dataset, results show that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art real-time rendering baselines.
authors: Dongting Hu, Zhenkai Zhang, Tingbo Hou, Tongliang Liu, Huan Fu, Mingming Gong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17772-17783

title: 多尺度结构引导扩散图像去模糊方法
title_en: Multiscale Structure Guided Diffusion for Image Deblurring
abstract: 扩散概率模型(DPMs)最近被用于图像去模糊,其形式化为一种图像条件生成过程,将高斯噪声映射到高质量图像,该过程以模糊输入为条件。当在领域内成对数据上训练时,图像条件DPMs(icDPMs)比基于回归的方法表现出更逼真的结果。然而,当面对领域外图像时,它们在恢复图像方面的鲁棒性尚不明确,因为它们不施加特定的退化模型或中间约束。为此,我们引入了一种简单而有效的多尺度结构引导作为隐式偏差,以告知icDPM在中间层关于锐利图像的粗结构。这种引导的公式在未见过的领域中显著提升了去模糊结果。该引导是从一个回归网络的潜在空间中提取的,该网络被训练以在多个较低分辨率下预测干净锐利的目标,从而保持最显著的锐利结构。结合模糊输入和多尺度引导,icDPM模型能够更好地理解模糊并恢复干净图像。我们在多样化数据集上评估单数据集训练的模型,并在未见过的数据上展示了更鲁棒的去模糊结果,伪影更少。我们的方法优于现有基线,在保持具有竞争力的失真度量的同时实现了最先进的感知质量。
abstract_en: Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DPMs) have recently been employed for image deblurring, formulated as an image-conditioned generation process that maps Gaussian noise to the high-quality image, conditioned on the blurry input. Image-conditioned DPMs (icDPMs) have shown more realistic results than regression-based methods when trained on pairwise in-domain data. However, their robustness in restoring images is unclear when presented with out-of-domain images as they do not impose specific degradation models or intermediate constraints. To this end, we introduce a simple yet effective multiscale structure guidance as an implicit bias that informs the icDPM about the coarse structure of the sharp image at the intermediate layers. This guided formulation leads to a significant improvement of the deblurring results, particularly on unseen domain. The guidance is extracted from the latent space of a regression network trained to predict the clean-sharp target at multiple lower resolutions, thus maintaining the most salient sharp structures. With both the blurry input and multiscale guidance, the icDPM model can better understand the blur and recover the clean image. We evaluate a single-dataset trained model on diverse datasets and demonstrate more robust deblurring results with fewer artifacts on unseen data. Our method outperforms existing baselines, achieving state-of-the-art perceptual quality while keeping competitive distortion metrics.
authors: Mengwei Ren, Mauricio Delbracio, Hossein Talebi, Guido Gerig, Peyman Milanfar ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10721-10733

title: Muscles in Action
title_en: Muscles in Action
abstract: 人体运动由肌肉驱动并受其约束。我们首次尝试构建计算机视觉方法,以表示导致运动的内部肌肉活动。我们提出了一种新的数据集Muscles in Action (MIA),用于学习将肌肉活动纳入人体运动表示。该数据集包含10名受试者进行各种运动的12.5小时同步视频和表面肌电图(sEMG)数据。利用该数据集,我们学习了一种双向表示,可从视频预测肌肉激活,并反向从肌肉激活重建运动。我们在分布内和分布外的受试者及运动任务上评估了模型。我们展示了联合建模两种模态的进展如何作为肌肉一致运动生成的条件。将肌肉纳入计算机视觉系统将使虚拟人类模型更加丰富,应用领域包括体育、健身和AR/VR。
abstract_en: Human motion is created by, and constrained by, our muscles. We take a first step at building computer vision methods that represent the internal muscle activity that causes motion. We present a new dataset, Muscles in Action (MIA), to to learn to incorporate muscle activity into human motion representations. The dataset consists of 12.5 hours of synchronized video and surface electromyography (sEMG) data of 10 subjects performing various exercises. Using this dataset, we learn a bidirectional representation that predicts muscle activation from video, and conversely, reconstructs motion from muscle activation. We evaluate our model on in-distribution subjects and exercises, as well as on out-of-distribution subjects and exercises. We demonstrate how advances in modeling both modalities jointly can serve as conditioning for muscularly consistent motion generation. Putting muscles into computer vision systems will enable richer models of virtual humans, with applications in sports, fitness, and AR/VR.
authors: Mia Chiquier, Carl Vondrick ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22091-22101

title: NAPA-VQ:基于向量量化的邻域感知原型增强持续学习方法
title_en: NAPA-VQ: Neighborhood-Aware Prototype Augmentation with Vector Quantization for Continual Learning
abstract: 灾难性遗忘;在获取新知识时丢失旧知识,是深度神经网络在现实应用中面临的一个难题。许多现有解决方案依赖于存储示例(先前遇到的数据),这在内存受限或隐私受限的应用中可能不可行。因此,近期研究重点转向非示例类增量学习(NECIL),其中模型无需使用任何过去示例即可逐步学习新类。然而,由于缺乏旧数据,NECIL方法在区分旧类和新类时存在困难,导致其特征表示重叠。我们提出NAPA-VQ:基于向量量化的邻域感知原型增强框架,用于减少NECIL中的类别重叠。我们借鉴神经气体方法,在特征空间中学习拓扑关系,识别最可能相互混淆的邻近类别。利用该邻域信息,我们强化邻近类别的分离,并生成能更好辅助建立旧类与新类判别边界的老类代表性原型。我们在CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet和ImageNet-Subset上的综合实验表明,NAPA-VQ在准确率上分别比最先进NECIL方法平均提升5%、2%和4%,在遗忘率上分别提升10%、3%和9%。我们的代码可在https://github.com/TamashaM/NAPA-VQ.git获取。
abstract_en: Catastrophic forgetting; the loss of old knowledge upon acquiring new knowledge, is a pitfall faced by deep neural networks in real-world applications. Many prevailing solutions to this problem rely on storing exemplars (previously encountered data), which may not be feasible in applications with memory limitations or privacy constraints. Therefore, the recent focus has been on Non-Exemplar based Class Incremental Learning (NECIL) where a model incrementally learns about new classes without using any past exemplars. However, due to the lack of old data, NECIL methods struggle to discriminate between old and new classes causing their feature representations to overlap. We propose NAPA-VQ: Neighborhood Aware Prototype Augmentation with Vector Quantization, a framework that reduces this class overlap in NECIL. We draw inspiration from Neural Gas to learn the topological relationships in the feature space, identifying the neighboring classes that are most likely to get confused with each other. This neighborhood information is utilized to enforce strong separation between the neighboring classes as well as to generate old class representative prototypes that can better aid in obtaining a discriminative decision boundary between old and new classes. Our comprehensive experiments on CIFAR-100, TinyImageNet, and ImageNet-Subset demonstrate that NAPA-VQ outperforms the State-of-the-art NECIL methods by an average improvement of 5%, 2%, and 4% in accuracy and 10%, 3%, and 9% in forgetting respectively. Our code can be found in https://github.com/TamashaM/NAPA-VQ.git.
authors: Tamasha Malepathirana, Damith Senanayake, Saman Halgamuge ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11674-11684

title: NCHO:人类与物体的神经3D组合的无监督学习
title_en: NCHO: Unsupervised Learning for Neural 3D Composition of Humans and Objects
abstract: 深度生成模型近期被扩展用于合成3D数字人类。然而,以往的方法将穿着衣物的人视为单一几何体,而未考虑服装和配饰的组合性。结果导致生成式3D虚拟形象的表现力和可控性受限。尽管已有方法尝试通过合成数据解决这一问题,但由于域差距,人与物体的交互不真实,且手动资产创建难以扩展到大量物体。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新颖框架,从真实世界3D扫描中学习人类与物体(背包、外套、围巾等)的组合生成模型。我们的组合模型是交互感知的,即完全考虑了人与物体之间的空间关系以及物理接触导致的相互形状变化。关键挑战在于,由于人与物体接触,其3D扫描被合并为单一物体。为无需手动标注地分解它们,我们提出利用同一人的两组3D扫描数据(含物体与不含物体)。我们的方法在无监督方式下学习分解物体,并自然地将其组合回生成式人类模型。尽管我们的简单设置仅需捕获单个受试者与物体的扫描,实验结果展示了模型强大的泛化能力,能够自然地将物体组合到多样化身份的各类姿态中,并实现多物体组合,这在训练数据中未见。项目页面可在https://taeksuu.github.io/ncho访问。
abstract_en: Deep generative models have been recently extended to synthesizing 3D digital humans. However, previous approaches treat clothed humans as a single chunk of geometry without considering the compositionality of clothing and accessories. As a result, individual items cannot be naturally composed into novel identities, leading to limited expressiveness and controllability of generative 3D avatars. While several methods attempt to address this by leveraging synthetic data, the interaction between humans and objects is not authentic due to the domain gap, and manual asset creation is difficult to scale for a wide variety of objects. In this work, we present a novel framework for learning a compositional generative model of humans and objects (backpacks, coats, scarves, and more) from real-world 3D scans. Our compositional model is interaction-aware, meaning the spatial relationship between humans and objects, and the mutual shape change by physical contact is fully incorporated. The key challenge is that, since humans and objects are in contact, their 3D scans are merged into a single piece. To decompose them without manual annotations, we propose to leverage two sets of 3D scans of a single person with and without objects. Our approach learns to decompose objects and naturally compose them back into a generative human model in an unsupervised manner. Despite our simple setup requiring only the capture of a single subject with objects, our experiments demonstrate the strong generalization of our model by enabling the natural composition of objects to diverse identities in various poses and the composition of multiple objects, which is unseen in training data. The project page is available at https://taeksuu.github.io/ncho.
authors: Taeksoo Kim, Shunsuke Saito, Hanbyul Joo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14817-14828

title: NDC-Scene: 提升归一化设备坐标空间中的单目三维语义场景补全
title_en: NDC-Scene: Boost Monocular 3D Semantic Scene Completion in Normalized Device Coordinates Space
abstract: 单目三维语义场景补全(SSC)因其能够从单张图像中预测复杂语义和几何形状的潜力,近年来受到广泛关注,且无需3D输入。本文识别出现有最先进方法中的几个关键问题,包括射线到3D空间投影2D特征的特征模糊性、3D卷积的姿态模糊性,以及不同深度层级间3D卷积的计算不平衡。为解决这些问题,我们设计了一种新颖的归一化设备坐标场景补全网络(NDC-Scene),通过反卷积操作逐步恢复深度维度,将2D特征图直接扩展到归一化设备坐标(NDC)空间,而非直接扩展到世界空间。实验结果表明,将大部分计算从目标3D空间转移到所提出的归一化设备坐标空间,有助于单目SSC任务。此外,我们设计了深度自适应双解码器,同时对2D和3D特征图进行上采样与融合,进一步提升整体性能。我们的大量实验验证了所提方法在户外SemanticKITTI和室内NYUv2数据集上均优于现有最先进方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Jiawei-Yao0812/NDCScene获取。
abstract_en: Monocular 3D Semantic Scene Completion (SSC) has garnered significant attention in recent years due to its potential to predict complex semantics and geometry shapes from a single image, requiring no 3D inputs. In this paper, we identify several critical issues in current state-of-the-art methods, including the Feature Ambiguity of projected 2D features in the ray to the 3D space, the Pose Ambiguity of the 3D convolution, and the Computation Imbalance in the 3D convolution across different depth levels. To address these problems, we devise a novel Normalized Device Coordinates scene completion network (NDC-Scene) that directly extends the 2D feature map to a Normalized Device Coordinates (NDC) space, rather than to the world space directly, through progressive restoration of the dimension of depth with deconvolution operations. Experiment results demonstrate that transferring the majority of computation from the target 3D space to the proposed normalized device coordinates space benefits monocular SSC tasks. Additionally, we design a Depth-Adaptive Dual Decoder to simultaneously upsample and fuse the 2D and 3D feature maps, further improving overall performance. Our extensive experiments confirm that the proposed method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both outdoor SemanticKITTI and indoor NYUv2 datasets. Our code are available at https://github.com/Jiawei-Yao0812/NDCScene.
authors: Jiawei Yao, Chuming Li, Keqiang Sun, Yingjie Cai, Hao Li, Wanli Ouyang, Hongsheng Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9455-9465

title: NDDepth: 法线距离辅助单目深度估计
title_en: NDDepth: Normal-Distance Assisted Monocular Depth Estimation
abstract: 单目深度估计因其广泛的应用场景而受到视觉研究社区的广泛关注。本文提出了一种新颖的物理(几何)驱动深度学习框架用于单目深度估计,假设3D场景由分段平面构成。特别地,我们引入了一个新的法线距离头部,输出像素级表面法线和平面到原点距离以推导每个位置的深度。同时,法线和距离通过开发的平面感知一致性约束进行正则化。我们进一步集成了一个额外的深度头部以提升所提框架的鲁棒性。为充分挖掘这两个头部的优势,我们开发了一个有效的对比迭代优化模块,根据深度不确定性以互补方式优化深度。大量实验表明,所提方法在NYU-Depth-v2、KITTI和SUN RGB-D数据集上超越了先前的最先进方法。值得注意的是,在KITTI深度预测在线基准测试中,该方法在提交时排名首位。源代码可在https://github.com/ShuweiShao/NDDepth获取。
abstract_en: Monocular depth estimation has drawn widespread attention from the vision community due to its broad applications. In this paper, we propose a novel physics (geometry)-driven deep learning framework for monocular depth estimation by assuming that 3D scenes are constituted by piece-wise planes. Particularly, we introduce a new normal-distance head that outputs pixel-level surface normal and plane-to-origin distance for deriving depth at each position. Meanwhile, the normal and distance are regularized by a developed plane-aware consistency constraint. We further integrate an additional depth head to improve the robustness of the proposed framework. To fully exploit the strengths of these two heads, we develop an effective contrastive iterative refinement module that refines depth in a complementary manner according to the depth uncertainty. Extensive experiments indicate that the proposed method exceeds previous state-of-the-art competitors on the NYU-Depth-v2, KITTI and SUN RGB-D datasets. Notably, it ranks 1st among all submissions on the KITTI depth prediction online benchmark at the submission time. The source code is available at https://github.com/ShuweiShao/NDDepth.
authors: Shuwei Shao, Zhongcai Pei, Weihai Chen, Xingming Wu, Zhengguo Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7931-7940

title: NEMTO:面向透明物体新视角与重照明合成的神经环境抠图
title_en: NEMTO: Neural Environment Matting for Novel View and Relighting Synthesis of Transparent Objects
abstract: 我们提出NEMTO,这是首个端到端神经渲染管线,用于建模具有复杂几何形状和未知折射率的3D透明物体。常用的外观建模方法如迪士尼BSDF模型无法准确解决这一具有挑战性的问题,因为复杂的光路在折射中弯曲,且表面外观对光照有强依赖性。以透明物体的2D图像作为输入,我们的方法能够实现高质量的新视角和重照明合成。我们利用隐式符号距离函数(SDF)建模物体几何,并提出一种折射感知的光线弯曲网络来建模物体内部的光折射效应。我们的光线弯曲网络比传统基于物理的方法在渲染透明物体时对几何不准确更宽容。我们在合成和真实世界数据集上进行了广泛评估,以展示我们的高质量合成和方法的适用性。
abstract_en: We propose NEMTO, the first end-to-end neural rendering pipeline to model 3D transparent objects with complex geometry and unknown indices of refraction. Commonly used appearance modeling such as the Disney BSDF model cannot accurately address this challenging problem due to the complex light paths bending through refractions and the strong dependency of surface appearance on illumination. With 2D images of the transparent object as input, our method is capable of high-quality novel view and relighting synthesis. We leverage implicit Signed Distance Functions (SDF) to model the object geometry and propose a refraction-aware ray bending network to model the effects of light refraction within the object. Our ray bending network is more tolerant to geometric inaccuracies than traditional physically-based methods for rendering transparent objects. We provide extensive evaluations on both synthetic and real-world datasets to demonstrate our high-quality synthesis and the applicability of our method.
authors: Dongqing Wang, Tong Zhang, Sabine Süsstrunk ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 317-327

title: 基于非配对24小时数据的近红外辅助视频增强
title_en: NIR-assisted Video Enhancement via Unpaired 24-hour Data
abstract: 可见光(VIS)范围内的低光照视频增强具有重要性但技术挑战性,通过引入近红外(NIR)信息辅助可能使其更易处理,这反过来又带来了如何获取合适多光谱数据用于模型训练的新挑战。本文首次使用未配对的24小时数据证明了近红外辅助低光照视频增强的可行性与优越性,显著简化了数据收集并提升了野外数据的泛化性能。通过考虑未配对白天与夜间视频间的物理特性差异,我们首次提出将白天NIR与VIS转换为"夜间模式"。具体而言,我们设计了一种启发式且物理启发的重照明算法以生成逼真的伪夜间NIR,并采用重采样策略后接noiseGAN进行夜间VIS转换。我们进一步设计了时间感知网络用于视频增强,该网络提取并融合双向时间流,使用真实白天视频与伪夜间视频进行训练。我们通过共轴相机采集多光谱数据,并贡献了首个包含对齐24小时NIR与VIS视频的Fulltime Multi-Spectral Video Dataset (FMSVD)数据集。与替代方法相比,我们在评估指标和视觉判断上均实现了显著提升的视频质量及野外数据泛化能力。代码与数据:https://github.com/MyNiuuu/NVEU.
abstract_en: Low-light video enhancement in the visible (VIS) range is important yet technically challenging, and it is likely to become more tractable by introducing near-infrared (NIR) information for assistance, which in turn arouses a new challenge on how to obtain appropriate multispectral data for model training. In this paper, we defend the feasibility and superiority of NIR-assisted low-light video enhancement results by using unpaired 24-hour data for the first time, which significantly eases data collection and improves generalization performance on in-the-wild data. By accounting for different physical characteristics between unpaired daytime and nighttime videos, we first propose to turn daytime NIR & VIS into "nighttime mode". Specifically, we design a heuristic yet physics-inspired relighting algorithm to produce realistic pseudo nighttime NIR, and use a resampling strategy followed by a noiseGAN for nighttime VIS conversion. We further devise a temporal-aware network for video enhancement that extracts and fuses bi-directional temporal streams and is trained using real daytime videos and pseudo nighttime videos. We capture multi-spectral data using a co-axial camera and contribute Fulltime Multi-Spectral Video Dataset (FMSVD), the first dataset including aligned 24-hour NIR & VIS videos. Compared to alternative methods, we achieve significantly improved video quality as well as generalization ability on in-the-wild data in terms of both evaluation metrics and visual judgment. Codes and Data Available: https://github.com/MyNiuuu/NVEU.
authors: Muyao Niu, Zhihang Zhong, Yinqiang Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10778-10788

title: NLOS-NeuS:非视线内神经隐式表面
title_en: NLOS-NeuS: Non-line-of-sight Neural Implicit Surface
abstract: 非视线内(NLOS)成像旨在通过可见物体上的间接光推断不可见场景。神经瞬态场(NeTF)被提出用于在非视线内场景中将场景表示为神经辐射场。我们提出NLOS神经隐式表面(NLOS-NeuS),该方法将NeTF扩展为使用符号距离函数(SDF)的神经隐式表面,以在非视线内场景中重建三维表面。我们引入两种约束作为损失函数,以正确学习SDF并避免非零水平集表面。我们还基于首次返回光子的几何特性引入了SDF的下界约束。实验结果表明,这些约束对于在非视线内场景中学习正确的SDF至关重要。与之前采用离散表示的方法相比,NLOS-NeuS采用神经连续表示,使我们能够在非视线内场景中重建光滑表面并保留细节。据我们所知,这是首次在非视线内场景中研究结合体积渲染的神经隐式表面。项目页面:https://yfujimura.github.io/nlos-neus/
abstract_en: Non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging is conducted to infer invisible scenes from indirect light on visible objects. The neural transient field (NeTF) was proposed for representing scenes as neural radiance fields in NLOS scenes. We propose NLOS neural implicit surface (NLOS-NeuS), which extends the NeTF to neural implicit surfaces with a signed distance function (SDF) for reconstructing three-dimensional surfaces in NLOS scenes. We introduce two constraints as loss functions for correctly learning an SDF to avoid non-zero level-set surfaces. We also introduce a lower bound constraint of an SDF based on the geometry of the first-returning photons. The experimental results indicate that these constraints are essential for learning a correct SDF in NLOS scenes. Compared with previous methods with discretized representation, NLOS-NeuS with the neural continuous representation enables us to reconstruct smooth surfaces while preserving fine details in NLOS scenes. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study on neural implicit surfaces with volume rendering in NLOS scenes. Project page: https://yfujimura. github.io/nlos-neus/
authors: Yuki Fujimura, Takahiro Kushida, Takuya Funatomi, Yasuhiro Mukaigawa ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10532-10541

title: NPC: 基于视频的神经点字符
title_en: NPC: Neural Point Characters from Video
abstract: 高保真的人体3D模型现在可以直接从视频中学习到,通常通过结合基于模板的表面模型与神经表示方法。然而,获取模板表面需要昂贵的多视角捕捉系统、激光扫描或严格控制的条件。先前方法避免使用模板,但依赖于从观测到规范空间的高成本或病态映射。我们提出了一种混合的点基表示方法,用于可动画化的人体,无需显式的表面模型,同时可推广到新颖姿态。对于给定视频,我们的方法会自动生成一组表示近似规范几何的显式3D点,并学习一个可变形模型,该模型能产生依赖姿态的点变换。这些点既作为高频神经特征的骨架,也作为高效映射观测空间与规范空间的锚点。我们在基准测试中证明,我们的表示方法克服了先前在规范空间或观测空间操作方法的局限性。此外,我们的自动点提取方法使学习人类和动物角色模型成为可能,其性能与使用绑定表面模板的方法相当,同时更具通用性。项目网站:https: //lemonatsu.github.io/npc/
abstract_en: High-fidelity human 3D models can now be learned directly from videos, typically by combining a template-based surface model with neural representations. However, obtaining a template surface requires expensive multi-view capture systems, laser scans, or strictly controlled conditions. Previous methods avoid using a template but rely on a costly or ill-posed mapping from observation to canonical space. We propose a hybrid point-based representation for animatable humans that does not require an explicit surface model, while being generalizable to novel poses. For a given video, our method automatically produces an explicit set of 3D points representing approximate canonical geometry, and learns an articulated deformation model that produces pose-dependent point transformations. The points serve both as a scaffold for high-frequency neural features and an anchor for efficiently mapping between observation and canonical space. We demonstrate on established benchmarks that our representation overcomes limitations of prior work operating in either canonical or in observation space. Moreover, our automatic point extraction approach enables learning models of human and animal characters alike, matching the performance of the methods using rigged surface templates despite being more general. Project website: https: //lemonatsu.github.io/npc/.
authors: Shih-Yang Su, Timur Bagautdinov, Helge Rhodin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14795-14805

title: NSF: 基于单目深度的神经表面场人体建模
title_en: NSF: Neural Surface Fields for Human Modeling from Monocular Depth
abstract: 从单目相机获取个性化的3D可动画化化身在游戏、虚拟试穿、动画和VR/XR等领域具有实际应用价值。然而,从稀疏数据中建模动态且细粒度的服装变形极具挑战性。现有基于深度数据建模3D人体的方法在计算效率、网格连贯性以及分辨率和拓扑结构的灵活性方面存在局限。例如,使用隐式函数重建形状并逐帧提取显式网格的计算成本高昂,且无法保证帧间网格的连贯性。此外,基于离散表面在预设人体模板上预测顶点变形缺乏分辨率和拓扑结构的灵活性。为克服这些局限,我们提出了一种新型方法"NSF: 神经表面场",用于从单目深度建模3D着装人体。NSF仅在基础表面上定义神经场,建模连续且灵活的位移场。NSF可在不同分辨率和拓扑结构的基础表面进行适应,推理时无需重新训练。与现有方法相比,我们的方法消除了昂贵的逐帧表面提取过程,同时保持网格连贯性,并能够重建任意分辨率的网格而无需重新训练。为促进该方向的研究,我们发布了代码项目页面:https://yuxuan-xue.com/nsf
abstract_en: Obtaining personalized 3D animatable avatars from a monocular camera has several real world applications in gaming, virtual try-on, animation, and VR/XR, etc. However, it is very challenging to model dynamic and fine-grained clothing deformations from such sparse data. Existing methods for modeling 3D humans from depth data have limitations in terms of computational efficiency, mesh coherency, and flexibility in resolution and topology. For instance, reconstructing shapes using implicit functions and extracting explicit meshes per frame is computationally expensive and cannot ensure coherent meshes across frames. Moreover, predicting per-vertex deformations on a pre-designed human template with a discrete surface lacks flexibility in resolution and topology. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel method 'NSF: Neural Surface Fields' for modeling 3D clothed humans from monocular depth. NSF defines a neural field solely on the base surface which models a continuous and flexible displacement field. NSF can be adapted to the base surface with different resolution and topology without retraining at inference time. Compared to existing approaches, our method eliminates the expensive per-frame surface extraction while maintaining mesh coherency, and is capable of reconstructing meshes with arbitrary resolution without retraining. To foster research in this direction, we release our code in project page at: https://yuxuan-xue.com/nsf.
authors: Yuxuan Xue, Bharat Lal Bhatnagar, Riccardo Marin, Nikolaos Sarafianos, Yuanlu Xu, Gerard Pons-Moll, Tony Tung ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15049-15060

title: 为任务命名你的颜色:通过色彩量化变换器人工发现色彩命名
title_en: Name Your Colour For the Task: Artificially Discover Colour Naming via Colour Quantisation Transformer
abstract: 长期存在的理论认为,色彩命名系统在高效通信和感知机制的双重压力下演化,这一理论得到了越来越多语言学研究的支持,包括分析纳法纳拉语四十年的历时数据。这启发我们探索机器学习是否能够通过优化以高级识别性能为代表的通信效率,进化并发现类似的色彩命名系统。本文提出了一种新颖的色彩量化变换器CQFormer,在量化色彩空间的同时保持量化图像上的机器识别准确性。给定一个RGB图像,注释分支将其映射为索引图,随后生成带有色彩调色板的量化图像;同时,调色板分支利用关键点检测方法在整体色彩空间中寻找合适的调色板色彩。通过与色彩注释的交互,CQFormer能够在机器视觉准确性与色彩感知结构(如发现色彩系统的鲜明且稳定的色彩分布)之间取得平衡。有趣的是,我们甚至观察到人工色彩系统与人类语言基本色彩项之间存在一致的演化模式。此外,我们的色彩量化方法还提供了一种高效的量化方法,能够在压缩图像存储的同时保持分类和检测等高级识别任务的高性能。大量实验验证了我们的方法在极低比特率颜色下的优越性能,显示出将其整合到量化网络以从图像到网络激活进行量化的潜力。源代码可在https://github.com/ryeocthiv/CQFormer获取。
abstract_en: The long-standing theory that a colour-naming system evolves under dual pressure of efficient communication and perceptual mechanism is supported by more and more linguistic studies, including analysing four decades of diachronic data from the Nafaanra language. This inspires us to explore whether machine learning could evolve and discover a similar colour-naming system via optimising the communication efficiency represented by high-level recognition performance. Here, we propose a novel colour quantisation transformer, CQFormer, that quantises colour space while maintaining the accuracy of machine recognition on the quantised images. Given an RGB image, Annotation Branch maps it into an index map before generating the quantised image with a colour palette; meanwhile the Palette Branch utilises a key-point detection way to find proper colours in the palette among the whole colour space. By interacting with colour annotation, CQFormer is able to balance both the machine vision accuracy and colour perceptual structure such as distinct and stable colour distribution for discovered colour system. Very interestingly, we even observe the consistent evolution pattern between our artificial colour system and basic colour terms across human languages. Besides, our colour quantisation method also offers an efficient quantisation method that effectively compresses the image storage while maintaining high performance in high-level recognition tasks such as classification and detection. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of our method with extremely low bit-rate colours, showing potential to integrate into quantisation network to quantities from image to network activation. The source code is available at https://github.com/ryeocthiv/CQFormer.
authors: Shenghan Su, Lin Gu, Yue Yang, Zenghui Zhang, Tatsuya Harada ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12021-12031

title: Narrator: 通过关系推理实现自然控制的人机场景交互生成
title_en: Narrator: Towards Natural Control of Human-Scene Interaction Generation via Relationship Reasoning
abstract: 自然可控的人机场景交互(HSI)生成在VR/AR内容创作和以人为中心的AI等领域具有重要作用。然而,现有方法在可控性方面存在不自然且不直观的问题,这严重限制了其实际应用。因此,我们聚焦于从文本描述中自然且可控地生成真实且多样的HSI这一具有挑战性的任务。基于人类认知,理想的生成模型应能正确推理空间关系和交互动作。为此,我们提出Narrator,一种基于关系推理的生成方法,利用条件变分自编码器实现自然可控的生成,给定三维场景和文本描述。此外,我们分别基于场景图建模三维场景和文本描述中的全局与局部空间关系,并引入部件级动作机制以原子身体部件状态表示交互。特别是,得益于我们的关系推理,我们进一步提出一种简单而有效的多人体生成策略,这是可控多人体场景交互生成的首次探索。我们的大量实验和感知研究显示,Narrator能够可控生成多样交互,并显著优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Naturally controllable human-scene interaction (HSI) generation has an important role in various fields, such as VR/AR content creation and human-centered AI. However, existing methods are unnatural and unintuitive in their controllability, which heavily limits their application in practice. Therefore, we focus on a challenging task of naturally and controllably generating realistic and diverse HSIs from textual descriptions. From human cognition, the ideal generative model should correctly reason about spatial relationships and interactive actions. To that end, we propose Narrator, a novel relationship reasoning-based generative approach using a conditional variation autoencoder for naturally controllable generation given a 3D scene and a textual description. Also, we model global and local spatial relationships in a 3D scene and a textual description respectively based on the scene graph, and introduce a part-level action mechanism to represent interactions as atomic body part states. In particular, benefiting from our relationship reasoning, we further propose a simple yet effective multi-human generation strategy, which is the first exploration for controllable multi-human scene interaction generation. Our extensive experiments and perceptual studies show that Narrator can controllably generate diverse interactions and significantly outperform existing works.
authors: Haibiao Xuan, Xiongzheng Li, Jinsong Zhang, Hongwen Zhang, Yebin Liu, Kun Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22268-22278

title: NaviNeRF:基于潜在语义导航的NeRF三维表示解耦
title_en: NaviNeRF: NeRF-based 3D Representation Disentanglement by Latent Semantic Navigation
abstract: 三维表示解耦旨在识别、分解和操控三维数据的潜在解释因素,这有助于AI从根本上理解我们的三维世界。该任务目前研究不足且面临巨大挑战:(i) 三维表示复杂且通常包含比二维图像更多的信息;(ii) 许多三维表示不适合基于梯度的优化,更不用说解耦了。为应对这些挑战,我们采用NeRF作为可微三维表示,并引入自监督导航以识别潜在空间中的可解释语义方向。据我们所知,这种新颖方法命名为NaviNeRF,是首个无需任何先验或监督即可实现细粒度三维解耦的工作。具体而言,NaviNeRF基于生成式NeRF流程,并配备外导航分支和内精炼分支。二者互补——外导航用于识别全局视角语义方向,内精炼专注于细粒度属性。进一步设计了协同损失函数以协调两个分支。大量实验表明,NaviNeRF在细粒度三维解耦能力上优于先前的三维感知模型。其性能也与依赖语义或几何先验的编辑导向模型相当。
abstract_en: 3D representation disentanglement aims to identify, decompose, and manipulate the underlying explanatory factors of 3D data, which helps AI fundamentally understand our 3D world. This task is currently under-explored and poses great challenges: (i) the 3D representations are complex and in general contains much more information than 2D image; (ii) many 3D representations are not well suited for gradient-based optimization, let alone disentanglement. To address these challenges, we use NeRF as a differentiable 3D representation, and introduce a self-supervised Navigation to identify interpretable semantic directions in the latent space. To our best knowledge, this novel method, dubbed NaviNeRF, is the first work to achieve fine-grained 3D disentanglement without any priors or supervision. Specifically, NaviNeRF is built upon the generative NeRF pipeline, and equipped with an Outer Navigation Branch and an Inner Refinement Branch. They are complementary ---- the outer navigation is to identify global-view semantic directions, and the inner refinement dedicates to fine-grained attributes. A synergistic loss is further devised to coordinate two branches. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NaviNeRF has a superior fine-grained 3D disentanglement ability than the previous 3D-aware models. Its performance is also comparable to editing-oriented models relying on semantic or geometry priors.
authors: Baao Xie, Bohan Li, Zequn Zhang, Junting Dong, Xin Jin, Jingyu Yang, Wenjun Zeng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17992-18002

title: 基于图像指定目标的导航
title_en: Navigating to Objects Specified by Images
abstract: 图像是一种便捷的方式,用于指定具身智能体应导航到的特定物体实例。解决此任务需要语义视觉推理和未知环境的探索。我们提出了一种系统,可在仿真环境和现实世界中执行此任务。我们的模块化方法解决了探索、目标实例重新识别、目标定位和局部导航等子任务。我们通过特征匹配在第一视角视觉中重新识别目标实例,并通过将匹配特征投影到地图上定位目标实例。每个子任务均通过无需微调的现成组件解决。在HM3D InstanceImageNav基准测试中,该系统性能优于基线端到端强化学习策略7倍,并优于最先进的ImageNav模型2.3倍(56% vs. 25%成功率)。我们将该系统部署到移动机器人平台,并在现实世界中展示了其有效性,在家庭和办公室环境中实现了88%的成功率。
abstract_en: Images are a convenient way to specify which particular object instance an embodied agent should navigate to. Solving this task requires semantic visual reasoning and exploration of unknown environments. We present a system that can perform this task in both simulation and the real world. Our modular method solves sub-tasks of exploration, goal instance re-identification, goal localization, and local navigation. We re-identify the goal instance in egocentric vision using feature-matching and localize the goal instance by projecting matched features to a map. Each sub-task is solved using off-the-shelf components requiring zero fine-tuning. On the HM3D InstanceImageNav benchmark, this system outperforms a baseline end-to-end RL policy 7x and outperforms a state-of-the-art ImageNav model 2.3x (56% vs. 25% success). We deploy this system to a mobile robot platform and demonstrate effective performance in the real world, achieving an 88% success rate across a home and an office environment.
authors: Jacob Krantz, Theophile Gervet, Karmesh Yadav, Austin Wang, Chris Paxton, Roozbeh Mottaghi, Dhruv Batra, Jitendra Malik, Stefan Lee, Devendra Singh Chaplot ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10916-10925

title: NeILF++:用于几何与材质估计的互反射光场
title_en: NeILF++: Inter-Reflectable Light Fields for Geometry and Material Estimation
