abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的可微渲染框架,用于从多视角图像中联合估计几何、材质和光照。与之前假设简化环境贴图或共置闪光灯的方法不同,本工作中我们将静态场景的光照建模为一个神经入射光场(NeILF)和一个神经辐射场(NeRF)。所提方法的关键洞察在于通过基于物理的渲染和表面间互反射将入射与出射光场进行联合,从而以基于物理的方式从图像观测中解耦场景几何、材质和光照。所提出的入射光场与互反射框架可轻松应用于其他NeRF系统。我们证明该方法不仅能将出射辐射分解为入射光与表面材质,还可作为表面细化模块,进一步提升神经表面的重建细节。我们在多个数据集上的实验表明,该方法在几何重建质量、材质估计精度和新视角渲染保真度方面均达到最先进水平。
abstract_en: We present a novel differentiable rendering framework for joint geometry, material, and lighting estimation from multi-view images. In contrast to previous methods which assume a simplified environment map or co-located flashlights, in this work, we formulate the lighting of a static scene as one neural incident light field (NeILF) and one outgoing neural radiance field (NeRF). The key insight of the proposed method is the union of the incident and outgoing light fields through physically-based rendering and inter-reflections between surfaces, making it possible to disentangle the scene geometry, material, and lighting from image observations in a physically-based manner. The proposed incident light and inter-reflection framework can be easily applied to other NeRF systems. We show that our method can not only decompose the outgoing radiance into incident lights and surface materials, but also serve as a surface refinement module that further improves the reconstruction detail of the neural surface. We demonstrate on several datasets that the proposed method is able to achieve state-of-the-art results in terms of the geometry reconstruction quality, material estimation accuracy, and the fidelity of novel view rendering.
authors: Jingyang Zhang, Yao Yao, Shiwei Li, Jingbo Liu, Tian Fang, David McKinnon, Yanghai Tsin, Long Quan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3601-3610

title: NeMF: 基于神经微片场的逆体积渲染
title_en: NeMF: Inverse Volume Rendering with Neural Microflake Field
abstract: 从未知光照条件下捕获的图像中恢复物体外观的物理属性是一项具有挑战性却至关重要的任务,对于实现逼真的照片渲染至关重要。近期方法采用新兴的隐式场景表示技术,并取得了令人印象深刻的结果。然而,它们普遍采用基于表面的表示方式,因此难以有效处理具有非常复杂几何结构、半透明物体等场景。本文提出通过微片体积表示场景,开展与基于表面的逆体积渲染相对的方法。该方法假设空间被无限小的微片填充,光线在每个空间位置根据微片分布进行反射或散射。我们进一步采用坐标网络对微片体积进行隐式编码,并开发了可微分的微片体积渲染器,以端到端的方式训练网络。我们的NeMF能够有效恢复高度复杂几何结构和散射物体的外观属性,实现高质量的重光照、材质编辑,尤其能模拟体积渲染效果(如散射),这是基于表面的方法无法实现的。我们的数据和代码已开源:https://github.com/YoujiaZhang/NeMF
abstract_en: Recovering the physical attributes of an object's appearance from its images captured under an unknown illumination is challenging yet essential for photo-realistic rendering.Recent approaches adopt the emerging implicit scene representations and have shown impressive results.However, they unanimously adopt a surface-based representation,and hence can not well handle scenes with very complex geometry, translucent object and etc.In this paper, we propose to conduct inverse volume rendering, in contrast to surface-based, by representing a scene using microflake volume, which assumes the space is filled with infinite small flakes and light reflects or scatters at each spatial location according to microflake distributions. We further adopt the coordinate networks to implicitly encode the microflake volume, and develop a differentiable microflake volume renderer to train the network in an end-to-end way in principle.Our NeMF enables effective recovery of appearance attributes for highly complex geometry and scattering object, enables high-quality relighting, material editing, and especially simulates volume rendering effects, such as scattering, which is infeasible for surface-based approaches. Our data and code are available at: https://github.com/YoujiaZhang/NeMF.
authors: Youjia Zhang, Teng Xu, Junqing Yu, Yuteng Ye, Yanqing Jing, Junle Wang, Jingyi Yu, Wei Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22919-22929

title: NeO 360:户外场景稀疏视角合成的神经场
title_en: NeO 360: Neural Fields for Sparse View Synthesis of Outdoor Scenes
abstract: 近年来,隐式神经表示在新视角合成方面取得了显著成果。然而,现有方法需要从多个视角进行昂贵的每场景优化,因此限制了其在真实世界无界城市环境中应用,这些环境中感兴趣的物体或背景通常仅从极少数视角观察。为应对这一挑战,我们引入了一种新方法,称为NeO 360,即用于户外场景稀疏视角合成的神经场。NeO 360是一种通用方法,能够从单张或多张带姿态的RGB图像重建360度场景。我们的方法核心在于捕捉复杂真实世界户外3D场景的分布,并采用一种混合图像条件三平面表示,可从任意世界点进行查询。我们的表示结合了基于体素和鸟瞰图(BEV)表示的优势,比单独使用更有效且更具表现力。NeO 360的表示使我们能够从大量无界3D场景中学习,同时在推理过程中仅需单张图像即可实现对新视角和新场景的泛化。我们在提出的具有挑战性的360度无界数据集NeRDS 360上验证了我们的方法,并展示了NeO 360在新视角合成方面优于现有通用方法,同时具备编辑和组合能力。项目页面:zubair-irshad.github.io/projects/neo360.html
abstract_en: Recent implicit neural representations have shown great results for novel view synthesis. However, existing methods require expensive per-scene optimization from many views hence limiting their application to real-world unbounded urban settings where the objects of interest or backgrounds are observed from very few views. To mitigate this challenge, we introduce a new approach called NeO 360, Neural fields for sparse view synthesis of outdoor scenes. NeO 360 is a generalizable method that reconstructs 360deg scenes from a single or a few posed RGB images. The essence of our approach is in capturing the distribution of complex real-world outdoor 3D scenes and using a hybrid image-conditional triplanar representation that can be queried from any world point. Our representation combines the best of both voxel-based and bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations and is more effective and expressive than each. NeO 360's representation allows us to learn from a large collection of unbounded 3D scenes while offering generalizability to new views and novel scenes from as few as a single image during inference. We demonstrate our approach on the proposed challenging 360deg unbounded dataset, called NeRDS 360, and show that NeO 360 outperforms state-of-the-art generalizable methods for novel view synthesis while also offering editing and composition capabilities. Project page: zubair-irshad.github.io/projects/neo360.html
authors: Muhammad Zubair Irshad, Sergey Zakharov, Katherine Liu, Vitor Guizilini, Thomas Kollar, Adrien Gaidon, Zsolt Kira, Rares Ambrus ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9187-9198

title: NeRF-Det: 学习几何感知的体素表示用于多视角三维目标检测
title_en: NeRF-Det: Learning Geometry-Aware Volumetric Representation for Multi-View 3D Object Detection
abstract: 我们提出NeRF-Det,一种以带姿态的RGB图像为输入的室内三维检测新方法。与现有室内三维检测方法难以建模场景几何不同,我们的方法以端到端方式创新性地利用NeRF,显式估计三维几何,从而提升三维检测性能。具体而言,为避免NeRF每场景优化带来的显著额外延迟,我们引入充分的几何先验以增强NeRF-MLP的泛化能力。此外,我们通过共享MLP微妙连接检测分支与NeRF分支,实现NeRF对检测的高效适配,生成几何感知的体素表示用于三维检测。我们的方法在ScanNet和ARKITScenes基准上分别超越现有SOTA方法3.9 mAP和3.1 mAP。我们提供了详尽分析以阐明NeRF-Det的工作原理。得益于联合训练设计,NeRF-Det无需每场景优化即可良好泛化到未见场景,适用于目标检测、视角合成和深度估计任务。代码已开源至https://github.com/facebookresearch/NeRF-Det。
abstract_en: We present NeRF-Det, a novel method for indoor 3D detection with posed RGB images as input. Unlike existing indoor 3D detection methods that struggle to model scene geometry, our method makes novel use of NeRF in an end-to-end manner to explicitly estimate 3D geometry, thereby improving 3D detection performance. Specifically, to avoid the significant extra latency associated with per-scene optimization of NeRF, we introduce sufficient geometry priors to enhance the generalizability of NeRF-MLP. Furthermore, we subtly connect the detection and NeRF branches through a shared MLP, enabling an efficient adaptation of NeRF to detection and yielding geometry-aware volumetric representations for 3D detection. Our method outperforms state-of-the-arts by 3.9 mAP and 3.1 mAP on the ScanNet and ARKITScenes benchmarks, respectively. We provide extensive analysis to shed light on how NeRF-Det works. As a result of our joint-training design, NeRF-Det is able to generalize well to unseen scenes for object detection, view synthesis, and depth estimation tasks without requiring per-scene optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/NeRF-Det.
authors: Chenfeng Xu, Bichen Wu, Ji Hou, Sam Tsai, Ruilong Li, Jialiang Wang, Wei Zhan, Zijian He, Peter Vajda, Kurt Keutzer, Masayoshi Tomizuka ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23320-23330

title: NeRF-LOAM:面向大规模增量式激光雷达里程计与建图的神经隐式表示
title_en: NeRF-LOAM: Neural Implicit Representation for Large-Scale Incremental LiDAR Odometry and Mapping
abstract: 利用激光雷达数据同时进行里程计与建图是移动系统在大规模环境中实现全自主的重要任务。然而,大多数现有的激光雷达方法更注重跟踪质量而非重建质量。尽管近期发展的神经辐射场(NeRF)在室内环境的隐式重建中展现出 promising 进展,但使用增量式激光雷达数据进行大规模场景的同步里程计与建图问题仍未被探索。为弥合这一差距,本文提出了一种基于 NeRF 的激光雷达里程计与建图方法 NeRF-LOAM,包含三个模块:神经里程计、神经建图和网格重建。所有模块均采用我们提出的神经符号距离函数,该函数将激光雷达点分为地面点与非地面点以减少 Z 轴漂移,同时优化里程计与体素嵌入,并最终生成环境的密集平滑网格地图。此外,这种联合优化使我们的 NeRF-LOAM 可以无需预训练即可应用,并在不同环境中展现出强大的泛化能力。在三个公开数据集上的大量评估表明,我们的方法在大规模环境中利用激光雷达数据实现了最先进的里程计与建图性能,并具有显著的泛化能力。此外,我们进行了多项消融实验以验证网络设计的有效性。我们的实现将在 https://github.com/JunyuanDeng/NeRF-LOAM 上公开。
abstract_en: Simultaneously odometry and mapping using LiDAR data is an important task for mobile systems to achieve full autonomy in large-scale environments. However, most existing LiDAR-based methods prioritize tracking quality over reconstruction quality. Although the recently developed neural radiance fields (NeRF) have shown promising advances in implicit reconstruction for indoor environments, the problem of simultaneous odometry and mapping for large-scale scenarios using incremental LiDAR data remains unexplored. To bridge this gap, in this paper, we propose a novel NeRF-based LiDAR odometry and mapping approach, NeRF-LOAM, consisting of three modules neural odometry, neural mapping, and mesh reconstruction. All these modules utilize our proposed neural signed distance function, which separates LiDAR points into ground and non-ground points to reduce Z-axis drift, optimizes odometry and voxel embeddings concurrently, and in the end generates dense smooth mesh maps of the environment. Moreover, this joint optimization allows our NeRF-LOAM to be pre-trained free and exhibit strong generalization abilities when applied to different environments. Extensive evaluations on three publicly available datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art odometry and mapping performance, as well as a strong generalization in large-scale environments utilizing LiDAR data. Furthermore, we perform multiple ablation studies to validate the effectiveness of our network design. The implementation of our approach will be made available at https://github.com/JunyuanDeng/NeRF-LOAM.
authors: Junyuan Deng, Qi Wu, Xieyuanli Chen, Songpengcheng Xia, Zhen Sun, Guoqing Liu, Wenxian Yu, Ling Pei ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8218-8227

title: NeRF-MS:基于多序列的神经辐射场
title_en: NeRF-MS: Neural Radiance Fields with Multi-Sequence
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRF)在仅使用单序列数据进行训练时,已在新视角合成任务中展现出卓越的性能。然而,利用不同时段不同相机捕获的多序列数据对于提升重建性能至关重要。多序列数据面临两个主要挑战:由于光照条件差异导致的外观变化以及非静态物体(如行人)带来的影响。为解决这些问题,我们提出NeRF-MS,一种新型多序列数据训练NeRF的方法。具体而言,我们采用三元组损失来正则化每张图像的外观代码分布,从而获得更优的高频纹理和一致的外观表现,例如镜面反射。随后,我们显式建模非静态物体以减少浮点误差。大量实验结果表明,NeRF-MS不仅在户外和合成场景的新视角合成任务中超越了现有最先进的方法,还实现了三维一致渲染和鲁棒的外观控制。项目页面:https://nerf-ms.github.io/
abstract_en: Neural radiance fields (NeRF) achieve impressive performance in novel view synthesis when trained on only single sequence data. However, leveraging multiple sequences captured by different cameras at different times is essential for better reconstruction performance. Multi-sequence data takes two main challenges: appearance variation due to different lighting conditions and non-static objects like pedestrians. To address these issues, we propose NeRF-MS, a novel approach to training NeRF with multi-sequence data. Specifically, we utilize a triplet loss to regularize the distribution of per-image appearance code, which leads to better high-frequency texture and consistent appearance, such as specular reflections. Then, we explicitly model non-static objects to reduce floaters. Extensive results demonstrate that NeRF-MS not only outperforms state-of-the-art view synthesis methods on outdoor and synthetic scenes, but also achieves 3D consistent rendering and robust appearance controlling. Project page: https://nerf-ms.github.io/.
authors: Peihao Li, Shaohui Wang, Chen Yang, Bingbing Liu, Weichao Qiu, Haoqian Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18591-18600

title: NeRFrac: 通过折射表面的神经辐射场
title_en: NeRFrac: Neural Radiance Fields through Refractive Surface
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRF)是一种用于新型视图合成的流行神经表示方法。通过查询空间点和视角方向,一个多层感知机(MLP)可以被训练以输出每个点的体积密度和辐射度,从而实现场景的新型视图渲染。然而,原始NeRF及其近期变体主要针对由漫反射表面主导的不透明场景,难以有效处理复杂折射表面。我们提出NeRFrac,以实现通过折射表面(通常为水面)捕捉场景的神经新型视图合成。对于每个查询光线,基于多层感知机的折射场被训练以估计光线原点到折射表面的距离。根据输入光线和近似局部法线,通过斯涅尔定律计算每个交点处的折射光线。场景点沿折射光线进行采样,并发送至辐射场以进一步估计辐射度。我们证明,从稀疏图像集,我们的模型能够准确合成折射表面下的场景新型视图,同时重建折射表面。我们通过水下场景的合成和真实场景评估方法的有效性。实验结果表明,NeRFrac在建模通过波浪状折射表面观察的场景时具有较高的准确性。
abstract_en: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) is a popular neural expression for novel view synthesis. By querying spatial points and view directions, a multilayer perceptron (MLP) can be trained to output the volume density and radiance at each point, which lets us render novel views of the scene. The original NeRF and its recent variants, however, target opaque scenes dominated by diffuse reflection surfaces and cannot handle complex refractive surfaces well. We introduce NeRFrac to realize neural novel view synthesis of scenes captured through refractive surfaces, typically water surfaces. For each queried ray, an MLP-based Refractive Field is trained to estimate the distance from the ray origin to the refractive surface. A refracted ray at each intersection point is then computed by Snell's Law, given the input ray and the approximated local normal. Points of the scene are sampled along the refracted ray and are sent to a Radiance Field for further radiance estimation. We show that from a sparse set of images, our model achieves accurate novel view synthesis of the scene underneath the refractive surface and simultaneously reconstructs the refractive surface. We evaluate the effectiveness of our method with synthetic and real scenes seen through water surfaces. Experimental results demonstrate the accuracy of NeRFrac for modeling scenes seen through wavy refractive surfaces.
authors: Yifan Zhan, Shohei Nobuhara, Ko Nishino, Yinqiang Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18402-18412

title: NeSS-ST: 利用神经稳定性评分与Shi-Tomasi检测器检测优良且稳定的关键点
title_en: NeSS-ST: Detecting Good and Stable Keypoints with a Neural Stability Score and the Shi-Tomasi detector
abstract: 学习特征点检测器面临双重挑战:关键点定义的模糊性以及需要专门准备的真实标签。在本工作中,我们通过结合手工设计的Shi-Tomasi检测器、专门设计的评估关键点质量的指标(稳定性评分,SS)以及神经网络来解决这两个问题。我们基于Shi-Tomasi检测器提供的原理性局部关键点,通过稳定性评分训练神经网络选择优良特征点。神经网络以神经稳定性评分(NeSS)的形式融入训练目标的知识。因此,我们的方法命名为NeSS-ST,因其结合了Shi-Tomasi检测器和神经稳定性评分的特性。该方法仅需图像集进行训练,无需数据集预标注或重建对应标签。我们在HPatches、ScanNet、MegaDepth和IMC-PT数据集上评估NeSS-ST,展示了最先进性能和良好的下游任务泛化能力。项目仓库地址:https://github.com/KonstantinPakulev/NeSS-ST
abstract_en: Learning a feature point detector presents a challenge both due to the ambiguity of the definition of a keypoint and, correspondingly, the need for specially prepared ground truth labels for such points. In our work, we address both of these issues by utilizing a combination of a hand-crafted Shi-Tomasi detector, a specially designed metric that assesses the quality of keypoints, the stability score (SS), and a neural network. We build on the principled and localized keypoints provided by the Shi-Tomasi detector and learn the neural network to select good feature points via the stability score. The neural network incorporates the knowledge from the training targets in the form of the neural stability score (NeSS). Therefore, our method is named NeSS-ST since it combines the Shi-Tomasi detector and the properties of the neural stability score. It only requires sets of images for training without dataset pre-labeling or the need for reconstructed correspondence labels. We evaluate NeSS-ST on HPatches, ScanNet, MegaDepth and IMC-PT demonstrating state-of-the-art performance and good generalization on downstream tasks. The project repository is available at: https://github.com/KonstantinPakulev/NeSS-ST.
authors: Konstantin Pakulev, Alexander Vakhitov, Gonzalo Ferrer ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9578-9588

title: NeTO:基于自遮挡感知折射追踪的透明物体神经重建
title_en: NeTO:Neural Reconstruction of Transparent Objects with Self-Occlusion Aware Refraction-Tracing
abstract: 我们提出了一种名为NeTO的新方法,通过体渲染从二维图像中捕捉实体透明物体的三维几何结构。透明物体的重建是一项极具挑战性的任务,由于镜面光传输现象,难以适用于通用的重建技术。尽管现有的基于折射追踪的方法在该任务中取得了令人印象深刻的结果,但由于采用的显式表面表示难以优化,且忽略了折射追踪中的自遮挡问题,仍存在优化不稳定和细节丢失的问题。本文提出利用隐式符号距离函数(SDF)作为表面表示,并通过自遮挡感知的折射光线追踪优化SDF场。隐式表示使我们的方法能够在有限视角下实现高质量重建,而自遮挡感知策略则使得方法能够准确重建自遮挡区域。实验表明,我们的方法实现了忠实的重建结果,并在多个指标上显著优于现有方法。访问我们的项目页面:https://www.xxlong.site/NeTO/
abstract_en: We present a novel method called NeTO, for capturing the 3D geometry of solid transparent objects from 2D images via volume rendering. Reconstructing transparent objects is a very challenging task, which is ill-suited for general-purpose reconstruction techniques due to the specular light transport phenomena. Although existing refraction-tracing-based methods, designed especially for this task, achieve impressive results, they still suffer from unstable optimization and loss of fine details since the explicit surface representation they adopted is difficult to be optimized, and the self-occlusion problem is ignored for refraction-tracing. In this paper, we propose to leverage implicit Signed Distance Function (SDF) as surface representation and optimize the SDF field via volume rendering with a self-occlusion aware refractive ray tracing. The implicit representation enables our method to be capable of reconstructing high-quality reconstruction even with a limited set of views, and the self-occlusion aware strategy makes it possible for our method to accurately reconstruct the self-occluded regions. Experiments show that our method achieves faithful reconstruction results and outperforms prior works by a large margin. Visit our project page at https://www.xxlong.site/NeTO/.
authors: Zongcheng Li, Xiaoxiao Long, Yusen Wang, Tuo Cao, Wenping Wang, Fei Luo, Chunxia Xiao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18547-18557

title: 分布外检测的最近邻引导
title_en: Nearest Neighbor Guidance for Out-of-Distribution Detection
abstract: 在开放世界环境中部署的机器学习模型,检测分布外(OOD)样本至关重要。基于分类器的得分因其细粒度检测能力,是分布外检测的标准方法。然而,这些得分常因过度自信问题而误将远离分布内区域的分布外样本分类为正常样本。为了解决这一挑战,我们提出了一种名为最近邻引导(NNGuide)的方法,该方法引导基于分类器的得分尊重数据流形的边界几何结构。NNGuide在降低分布外样本的过度自信的同时,保留了基于分类器的得分的细粒度检测能力。我们在多样化的设置下对ImageNet分布外检测基准进行了大量实验,包括ID数据经历自然分布偏移的场景。我们的结果表明,NNGuide在基础检测得分上显著提升了性能,在AUROC、FPR95和AUPR指标上均达到了最先进的结果。
abstract_en: Detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) samples are crucial for machine learning models deployed in open-world environments. Classifier-based scores are a standard approach for OOD detection due to their fine-grained detection capability. However, these scores often suffer from overconfidence issues, misclassifying OOD samples distant from the in-distribution region. To address this challenge, we propose a method called Nearest Neighbor Guidance (NNGuide) that guides the classifier-based score to respect the boundary geometry of the data manifold. NNGuide reduces the overconfidence of OOD samples while preserving the fine-grained capability of the classifier-based score. We conduct extensive experiments on ImageNet OOD detection benchmarks under diverse settings, including a scenario where the ID data undergoes natural distribution shift. Our results demonstrate that NNGuide provides a significant performance improvement on the base detection scores, achieving state-of-the-art results on both AUROC, FPR95, and AUPR metrics.
authors: Jaewoo Park, Yoon Gyo Jung, Andrew Beng Jin Teoh ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1686-1695

title: 被忽视的免费午餐——利用标注副产品学习图像分类器
title_en: Neglected Free Lunch - Learning Image Classifiers Using Annotation Byproducts
abstract: 图像分类器的监督学习通过图像与对应标签(X,Y)的配对,将人类知识提炼为参数化模型。我们认为这种简单且广泛使用的知识表示方式忽视了标注过程中的丰富辅助信息,例如图像选择后留下的鼠标轨迹和点击时间序列。我们的洞察是,这些标注副产品Z提供了近似的人类注意力,弱引导模型关注前景线索,减少虚假相关性并抑制捷径学习。为验证这一观点,我们创建了ImageNet-AB和COCO-AB。它们是通过复制原始标注任务收集的标注副产品增强的ImageNet和COCO训练集。我们将使用标注副产品训练模型的新范式称为利用标注副产品学习(LUAB)。我们表明,对Z和Y进行联合回归的简单多任务损失已能提升所学模型的泛化能力和鲁棒性。与原始监督学习相比,LUAB无需额外标注成本。ImageNet-AB和COCO-AB可在https://github.com/naver-ai/NeglectedFreeLunch获取。
abstract_en: Supervised learning of image classifiers distills human knowledge into a parametric model through pairs of images and corresponding labels (X,Y). We argue that this simple and widely used representation of human knowledge neglects rich auxiliary information from the annotation procedure, such as the time-series of mouse traces and clicks left after image selection. Our insight is that such annotation byproducts Z provide approximate human attention that weakly guides the model to focus on the foreground cues, reducing spurious correlations and discouraging shortcut learning. To verify this, we create ImageNet-AB and COCO-AB. They are ImageNet and COCO training sets enriched with sample-wise annotation byproducts, collected by replicating the respective original annotation tasks. We refer to the new paradigm of training models with annotation byproducts as learning using annotation byproducts (LUAB). We show that a simple multitask loss for regressing Z together with Y already improves the generalisability and robustness of the learned models. Compared to the original supervised learning, LUAB does not require extra annotation costs. ImageNet-AB and COCO-AB are at https://github.com/naver-ai/NeglectedFreeLunch.
authors: Dongyoon Han, Junsuk Choe, Seonghyeok Chun, John Joon Young Chung, Minsuk Chang, Sangdoo Yun, Jean Y. Song, Seong Joon Oh ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20200-20212

title: NerfAcc: 高效采样加速NeRF
title_en: NerfAcc: Efficient Sampling Accelerates NeRFs
abstract: 由于体积渲染需要大量样本,优化和渲染神经辐射场(NeRF)在计算上成本高昂。近期研究引入了替代采样方法以加速其方法,但通常并非研究重点。本文调查并比较了多种采样方法,证明改进的采样方法在统一的透射率估计器概念下可普遍适用于各类NeRF变体。为促进未来实验,我们开发了NerfAcc,一个提供灵活API接口的Python工具箱,用于将高级采样方法整合到NeRF相关方法中。我们通过展示其灵活性,表明仅需对现有代码库进行少量修改即可将几种近期NeRF方法的训练时间减少1.5到20倍。此外,高度定制的NeRF(如Instant-NGP)可使用NerfAcc在原生PyTorch中实现。我们的代码已开源于https://www.nerfacc.com。
abstract_en: Optimizing and rendering Neural Radiance Fields is computationally expensive due to the vast number of samples required by volume rendering. Recent works have included alternative sampling approaches to help accelerate their methods, however, they are often not the focus of the work. In this paper, we investigate and compare multiple sampling approaches and demonstrate that improved sampling is generally applicable across NeRF variants under an unified concept of transmittance estimator. To facilitate future experiments, we develop NerfAcc, a Python toolbox that provides flexible APIs for incorporating advanced sampling methods into NeRF related methods. We demonstrate its flexibility by showing that it can reduce the training time of several recent NeRF methods by 1.5x to 20x with minimal modifications to the existing codebase. Additionally, highly customized NeRFs, such as Instant-NGP, can be implemented in native PyTorch using NerfAcc. Our code are open-sourced at https://www.nerfacc.com.
authors: Ruilong Li, Hang Gao, Matthew Tancik, Angjoo Kanazawa ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18537-18546

title: Nerfbusters: 去除随意捕捉NeRFs中的幽灵伪影
title_en: Nerfbusters: Removing Ghostly Artifacts from Casually Captured NeRFs
abstract: 随意捕捉的神经辐射场(NeRFs)在超出输入相机轨迹的渲染中会出现漂浮物或几何缺陷等伪影。现有评估协议通常无法捕捉到这些效果,因为它们通常仅在训练捕捉的每8帧进行图像质量评估。为促进新型视图合成方法的开发与评估,我们提出一个新的数据集和评估流程,其中记录了场景的两条相机轨迹:一条用于训练,另一条用于评估。在这一更具挑战性的野外场景设置中,我们发现现有的手工设计正则化方法无法去除漂浮物或改善场景几何结构。因此,我们提出了一种基于3D扩散的方法,利用局部3D先验和一种新颖的基于密度的得分蒸馏采样损失,在NeRF优化过程中抑制伪影。我们证明了这种数据驱动的先验能够去除随意捕捉中的漂浮物并改善场景几何结构。
abstract_en: Casually captured Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) suffer from artifacts such as floaters or flawed geometry when rendered outside the input camera trajectory. Existing evaluation protocols often do not capture these effects, since they usually only assess image quality at every 8th frame of the training capture. To aid in the development and evaluation of new methods in novel-view synthesis, we propose a new dataset and evaluation procedure, where two camera trajectories are recorded of the scene: one used for training, and the other for evaluation. In this more challenging in-the-wild setting, we find that existing hand-crafted regularizers do not remove floaters nor improve scene geometry. Thus, we propose a 3D diffusion-based method that leverages local 3D priors and a novel density-based score distillation sampling loss to discourage artifacts during NeRF optimization. We show that this data-driven prior removes floaters and improves scene geometry for casual captures.
authors: Frederik Warburg, Ethan Weber, Matthew Tancik, Aleksander Holynski, Angjoo Kanazawa ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18120-18130

title: NeuRBF:一种基于自适应径向基函数的神经场表示方法
title_en: NeuRBF: A Neural Fields Representation with Adaptive Radial Basis Functions
abstract: 我们提出了一种新型神经场,利用通用径向基函数进行信号表示。当前最先进的神经场通常依赖基于网格的表示方法存储局部神经特征,并采用N维线性核函数在连续查询点插值特征。其神经特征的空间位置固定在网格节点上,难以良好适应目标信号。我们的方法则基于具有灵活核位置和形状的一般径向基函数,具有更高的空间自适应性,能够更紧密地拟合目标信号。为进一步提升径向基函数的通道容量,我们提出将其与多频正弦函数组合。该技术无需额外参数即可将径向基函数扩展为不同频段的多个傅里叶径向基函数,有利于细节表示。此外,通过将自适应径向基函数与基于网格的表示方法相结合,我们的混合方案继承了自适应性和插值平滑性。我们精心设计了加权方案,使径向基函数能够有效适应不同类型信号。在2D图像和3D有符号距离场表示的实验中,我们的方法在准确性和紧凑性方面均优于现有方法。当应用于神经辐射场重建时,我们的方法在模型规模小且训练速度相近的前提下,实现了最先进的渲染质量。
abstract_en: We present a novel type of neural fields that uses general radial bases for signal representation. State-of-the-art neural fields typically rely on grid-based representations for storing local neural features and N-dimensional linear kernels for interpolating features at continuous query points. The spatial positions of their neural features are fixed on grid nodes and cannot well adapt to target signals. Our method instead builds upon general radial bases with flexible kernel position and shape, which have higher spatial adaptivity and can more closely fit target signals. To further improve the channel-wise capacity of radial basis functions, we propose to compose them with multi-frequency sinusoid functions. This technique extends a radial basis to multiple Fourier radial bases of different frequency bands without requiring extra parameters, facilitating the representation of details. Moreover, by marrying adaptive radial bases with grid-based ones, our hybrid combination inherits both adaptivity and interpolation smoothness. We carefully designed weighting schemes to let radial bases adapt to different types of signals effectively. Our experiments on 2D image and 3D signed distance field representation demonstrate the higher accuracy and compactness of our method than prior arts. When applied to neural radiance field reconstruction, our method achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality, with small model size and comparable training speed.
authors: Zhang Chen, Zhong Li, Liangchen Song, Lele Chen, Jingyi Yu, Junsong Yuan, Yi Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4182-4194

title: NeuS2:面向多视角重建的神经隐式曲面快速学习
title_en: NeuS2: Fast Learning of Neural Implicit Surfaces for Multi-view Reconstruction
abstract: 近期用于神经曲面表示与渲染的方法(例如NeuS)已展现出对静态场景的高质量重建能力。然而,NeuS的训练过程耗时极长(8小时),这使其难以应用于包含数千帧的动态场景。我们提出了一种快速神经曲面重建方法,称为NeuS2,在加速方面实现了两个数量级的提升,同时不牺牲重建质量。为加速训练过程,我们通过多分辨率哈希编码参数化神经曲面表示,并提出了一种针对网络特性的轻量级二阶导数计算方法,利用CUDA并行计算实现了两倍速度提升。为进一步稳定和加快训练,我们提出了一种渐进式学习策略,从粗到细优化多分辨率哈希编码。我们还扩展了该方法以实现动态场景的快速训练,提出了一种增量训练策略和新型全局变换预测模块,使方法能够处理具有大幅运动和形变的长序列挑战。我们在多个数据集上的实验表明,NeuS2在静态和动态场景的曲面重建精度和训练速度方面均显著优于现有方法。代码可在我们的网站获取:https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/NeuS2/
abstract_en: Recent methods for neural surface representation and rendering, for example NeuS, have demonstrated the remarkably high-quality reconstruction of static scenes. However, the training of NeuS takes an extremely long time (8 hours), which makes it almost impossible to apply them to dynamic scenes with thousands of frames. We propose a fast neural surface reconstruction approach, called NeuS2, which achieves two orders of magnitude improvement in terms of acceleration without compromising reconstruction quality. To accelerate the training process, we parameterize a neural surface representation by multi-resolution hash encodings and present a novel lightweight calculation of second-order derivatives tailored to our networks to leverage CUDA parallelism, achieving a factor two speed up. To further stabilize and expedite training, a progressive learning strategy is proposed to optimize multi-resolution hash encodings from coarse to fine. We extend our method for fast training of dynamic scenes, with a proposed incremental training strategy and a novel global transformation prediction component, which allow our method to handle challenging long sequences with large movements and deformations. Our experiments on various datasets demonstrate that NeuS2 significantly outperforms the state-of-the-arts in both surface reconstruction accuracy and training speed for both static and dynamic scenes. The code is available at our website: https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/NeuS2/.
authors: Yiming Wang, Qin Han, Marc Habermann, Kostas Daniilidis, Christian Theobalt, Lingjie Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3295-3306

title: 基于神经特征函数学习的条件图像生成
title_en: Neural Characteristic Function Learning for Conditional Image Generation
abstract: 条件生成对抗网络(cGANs)的出现通过对抗学习数据与辅助信息的联合分布,彻底改变了我们对生成过程的处理和控制方式。尽管取得了成功,cGANs由于分布间存在病态差异度量问题,始终面临模式崩溃和训练不稳定等挑战。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新型条件特征函数生成对抗网络(CCF-GAN),通过特征函数(CFs)减少分布差异,能够在理论严谨性基础上学习准确的联合分布距离度量。具体而言,首先证明了特征函数差异的完备性和优化友好性,用于衡量两个联合分布的差异。为缓解计算特征函数差异时的维度灾难问题,我们提出采用神经网络——神经特征函数(NCF)——高效最小化差异的上界。基于NCF,我们构建了CCF-GAN框架,显式分解联合分布的特征函数,从而能够学习具有分类重要性的数据分布与辅助信息。在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上的实验结果验证了CCF-GAN在生成质量与训练稳定性方面的优越性能。
abstract_en: The emergence of conditional generative adversarial networks (cGANs) has revolutionised the way we approach and control the generation, by means of adversarially learning joint distributions of data and auxiliary information. Despite the success, cGANs have been consistently put under scrutiny due to their ill-posed discrepancy measure between distributions, leading to mode collapse and instability problems in training. To address this issue, we propose a novel conditional characteristic function generative adversarial network (CCF-GAN) to reduce the discrepancy by the characteristic functions (CFs), which is able to learn accurate distance measure of joint distributions under theoretical soundness. More specifically, the difference between CFs is first proved to be complete and optimisation-friendly, for measuring the discrepancy of two joint distributions. To relieve the problem of curse of dimensionality in calculating CF difference, we propose to employ the neural network, namely neural CF (NCF), to efficiently minimise an upper bound of the difference. Based on the NCF, we establish the CCF-GAN framework to explicitly decompose CFs of joint distributions, which allows for learning the data distribution and auxiliary information with classified importance. The experimental results on synthetic and real-world datasets verify the superior performances of our CCF-GAN, on both the generation quality and stability.
authors: Shengxi Li, Jialu Zhang, Yifei Li, Mai Xu, Xin Deng, Li Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7204-7214

title: 神经拼贴转移:通过材料操控的艺术重构
title_en: Neural Collage Transfer: Artistic Reconstruction via Material Manipulation
abstract: 拼贴是一种以多样化的材料碎片为基本单元来构成单幅图像的创作艺术形式。尽管逐像素生成技术可以复现拼贴风格的目标图像,但由于拼贴形式具有逐笔绘制的固有特性,这种方法并不适用。虽然一些基于笔触的渲染方法能够生成相当不错的草图和绘画,但拼贴艺术在研究中却鲜有关注,尽管其作为风格具有很高的流行度。在本文中,我们提出了一种无需演示或拼贴艺术品数据即可通过强化学习学习制作拼贴的方法。我们设计了拼贴马尔可夫决策过程(MDP),使智能体能够处理各种材料,并提出基于模型的软演员-评论家算法以缓解源于拼贴复杂动态的智能体训练负担。此外,我们还设计了主动材料选择和基于复杂度的多尺度拼贴等附加技术,以处理任意尺寸的目标图像,并通过在高复杂度区域放置相对更多的碎片来提升结果的美学效果。实验结果表明,训练后的智能体能够适当选择和粘贴材料,将目标图像重构为拼贴作品,并在内容和风格评估中获得比逐像素生成方法更高的评分。代码可在https://github.com/northadventure/CollageRL获取。
abstract_en:
Collage is a creative art form that uses diverse material scraps as a base unit to compose a single image.
 Although pixel-wise generation techniques can reproduce a target image in collage style, it is not a suitable method due to the solid stroke-by-stroke nature of the collage form.
 While some previous works for stroke-based rendering produced decent sketches and paintings, collages have received much less attention in research despite their popularity as a style.
 In this paper, we propose a method for learning to make collages via reinforcement learning without the need for demonstrations or collage artwork data.
 We design the collage Markov Decision Process (MDP), which allows the agent to handle various materials and propose a model-based soft actor-critic to mitigate the agent's training burden derived from the sophisticated dynamics of collage.
 Moreover, we devise additional techniques such as active material selection and complexity-based multi-scale collage to handle target images at any size and enhance the results' aesthetics by placing relatively more scraps in areas of high complexity.
 Experimental results show that the trained agent appropriately selected and pasted materials to regenerate the target image into a collage and obtained a higher evaluation score on content and style than pixel-wise generation methods. Code is available at https://github.com/northadventure/CollageRL.
authors: Ganghun Lee, Minji Kim, Yunsu Lee, Minsu Lee, Byoung-Tak Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2394-2405

title: 面向从二维稀疏心脏磁共振成像重建和建模双心室心脏形状的神经可变形模型
title_en: Neural Deformable Models for 3D Bi-Ventricular Heart Shape Reconstruction and Modeling from 2D Sparse Cardiac Magnetic Resonance Imaging
abstract: 我们提出了一种新型神经可变形模型(NDM),旨在从二维稀疏心脏磁共振(CMR)成像数据中重建和建模心脏的三维双心室形状。我们采用融合可变形超二次曲面来建模双心室形状,这些曲面通过一组几何参数函数进行参数化,能够实现全局和局部变形。全局几何参数函数和变形捕捉来自视觉数据的总体形状特征,而局部变形则通过神经微分同胚点流进行参数化,可以学习以恢复详细的心脏形状。与传统可变形模型公式中使用的迭代优化方法不同,NDM可以从形状分布流形中训练以学习此类几何参数函数、全局和局部变形。我们的NDM能够学习对任意尺度的稀疏心脏点云进行密集化,并自动生成高质量的三角网格。它还支持在不同心脏形状实例之间隐式学习密集对应关系,以实现精确的心脏形状配准。此外,NDM的参数直观,可由医生直接使用而无需复杂的后处理。在大型CMR数据集上的实验结果验证了NDM相比传统方法的性能提升。
abstract_en: We propose a novel neural deformable model (NDM) targeting at the reconstruction and modeling of 3D bi-ventricular shape of the heart from 2D sparse cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging data. We model the bi-ventricular shape using blended deformable superquadrics, which are parameterized by a set of geometric parameter functions and are capable of deforming globally and locally. While global geometric parameter functions and deformations capture gross shape features from visual data, local deformations, parameterized as neural diffeomorphic point flows, can be learned to recover the detailed heart shape. Different from iterative optimization methods used in conventional deformable model formulations, NDMs can be trained to learn such geometric parameter functions, global and local deformations from a shape distribution manifold. Our NDM can learn to densify a sparse cardiac point cloud with arbitrary scales and generate high-quality triangular meshes automatically. It also enables the implicit learning of dense correspondences among different heart shape instances for accurate cardiac shape registration. Furthermore, the parameters of NDM are intuitive, and can be used by a physician without sophisticated post-processing. Experimental results on a large CMR dataset demonstrate the improved performance of NDM over traditional methods.
authors: Meng Ye, Dong Yang, Mikael Kanski, Leon Axel, Dimitris Metaxas ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14247-14256

title: 结构光的神经场方法
title_en: Neural Fields for Structured Lighting
abstract: 我们提出了一种图像形成模型和优化过程,结合了神经辐射场和结构光成像的优势。现有的深度监督神经模型依赖于深度传感器来准确捕捉场景的几何结构。然而,这些传感器恢复的深度图可能容易出错,甚至完全失效。与其依赖结构光系统处理后的深度图的保真度,更合理的方法是显式建模原始结构光图像本身。我们的方法能够估计高保真深度图,包括对具有复杂材料属性的对象(如部分透明表面)。除了计算深度外,原始结构光图像还提供了其他有用的辐射度线索,这使得预测表面法线和将场景外观分解为直接、间接和环境成分成为可能。我们在多种真实和合成场景上对框架进行了定性和定量评估,并将场景分解为其组成成分以生成新视角。
abstract_en: We present an image formation model and optimization procedure that combines the advantages of neural radiance fields and structured light imaging. Existing depth-supervised neural models rely on depth sensors to accurately capture the scene's geometry. However, the depth maps recovered by these sensors can be prone to error, or even fail outright. Instead of depending on the fidelity of processed depth maps from a structured light system, a more principled approach is to explicitly model the raw structured light images themselves. Our proposed approach enables the estimation of high-fidelity depth maps, including for objects with complex material properties (e.g., partially-transparent surfaces). Besides computing depth, the raw structured light images also confer other useful radiometric cues, which enable predicting surface normals and decomposing scene appearance in terms of a direct, indirect, and ambient component. We evaluate our framework quantitatively and qualitatively on a range of real and synthetic scenes, and decompose scenes into their constituent components for novel views.
authors: Aarrushi Shandilya, Benjamin Attal, Christian Richardt, James Tompkin, Matthew O'toole ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3512-3522

title: 神经发型:基于先验引导的发丝级发型重建
title_en: Neural Haircut: Prior-Guided Strand-Based Hair Reconstruction
abstract: 利用图像或视频数据生成逼真的人体三维重建对于各种通信和娱乐应用至关重要。尽管现有方法在身体和面部区域取得了令人印象深刻的结果,但由于其高度的机械复杂性,逼真的发型建模仍然具有挑战性。本文提出了一种方法,能够从单目视频或多视角图像(在不受控光照条件下捕获)中进行精确的发丝级几何重建。我们的方法包含两个阶段,第一阶段使用隐式体积表示联合重建粗略的发型和身体形状及发丝方向。第二阶段则通过在一个优化过程中协调粗略的体积约束与从合成数据中学习到的发丝和发型先验,估计发丝级的发型重建。为了进一步提高重建保真度,我们使用新的可微渲染器将基于图像的损失纳入拟合过程。所提出的系统命名为Neural Haircut,能够实现重建发型的高真实感和个性化。
abstract_en: Generating realistic human 3D reconstructions using image or video data is essential for various communication and entertainment applications. While existing methods achieved impressive results for body and facial regions, realistic hair modeling still remains challenging due to its high mechanical complexity. This work proposes an approach capable of accurate hair geometry reconstruction at a strand level from a monocular video or multi-view images captured in uncontrolled lighting conditions. Our method has two stages, with the first stage performing joint reconstruction of coarse hair and bust shapes and hair orientation using implicit volumetric representations. The second stage then estimates a strand-level hair reconstruction by reconciling in a single optimization process the coarse volumetric constraints with hair strand and hairstyle priors learned from the synthetic data. To further increase the reconstruction fidelity, we incorporate image-based losses into the fitting process using a new differentiable renderer. The combined system, named Neural Haircut, achieves high realism and personalization of the reconstructed hairstyles.
authors: Vanessa Sklyarova, Jenya Chelishev, Andreea Dogaru, Igor Medvedev, Victor Lempitsky, Egor Zakharov ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19762-19773

title: 神经隐式曲面演化
title_en: Neural Implicit Surface Evolution
abstract: 本文研究利用光滑神经网络对水平集方程(LSE)下隐式曲面动态变化的建模。为此,将神经隐式曲面的表示扩展到时空域,从而开启连续几何变换的机制。示例包括将初始曲面向通用向量场演化、利用平均曲率方程进行平滑和锐化,以及初始条件的插值。网络训练考虑两个约束条件。数据项负责将初始条件拟合到对应的时间点。随后,LSE项迫使网络在无监督情况下逼近由LSE描述的底层几何演化。网络还可基于先前训练的初始条件进行初始化,相比标准方法可实现更快的收敛速度。
abstract_en: This work investigates the use of smooth neural networks for modeling dynamic variations of implicit surfaces under the level set equation (LSE). For this, it extends the representation of neural implicit surfaces to the space-time, which opens up mechanisms for continuous geometric transformations. Examples include evolving an initial surface towards general vector fields, smoothing and sharpening using the mean curvature equation, and interpolations of initial conditions. The network training considers two constraints. A data term is responsible for fitting the initial condition to the corresponding time instant. Then, a LSE term forces the network to approximate the underlying geometric evolution given by the LSE, without any supervision. The network can also be initialized based on previously trained initial conditions, resulting in faster convergence compared to the standard approach.
authors: Tiago Novello, Vinicius da Silva, Guilherme Schardong, Luiz Schirmer, Helio Lopes, Luiz Velho ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14279-14289

title: 神经交互式关键点检测
title_en: Neural Interactive Keypoint Detection
abstract: 本文提出了一种端到端的神经交互式关键点检测框架,命名为Click-Pose,该框架相比仅靠人工标注,可显著降低超过10倍的2D关键点标注成本。Click-Pose探索了用户反馈如何与神经关键点检测器协作,以交互式方式修正预测关键点,从而实现更快更有效的标注过程。具体而言,我们设计了姿态误差建模策略,将真实姿态与四种典型姿态误差输入解码器,并训练模型重建正确姿态,增强模型的自校正能力。随后,我们附加了一个交互式人类反馈循环,允许接收用户点击以修正一个或多个预测关键点,并通过最小点击次数(NoC)迭代利用解码器更新所有其他关键点,实现高效标注。我们在领域内、领域外场景及关键点适应新任务中验证了Click-Pose。对于标注,Click-Pose在COCO和Human-Art数据集上分别仅需1.97和6.45 NoC@95(精度95%),相比SOTA模型(ViTPose)在人工修正下分别减少了31.4%和36.3%的标注工作量。此外,在无需用户点击的情况下,Click-Pose在COCO和Human-Art数据集上分别超越了先前的端到端模型1.4 AP和3.0 AP。
abstract_en: This work proposes an end-to-end neural interactive keypoint detection framework named Click-Pose, which can significantly reduce more than 10 times labeling costs of 2D keypoint annotation compared with manual-only annotation. Click-Pose explores how user feedback can cooperate with a neural keypoint detector to correct the predicted keypoints in an interactive way for a faster and more effective annotation process. Specifically, we design the pose error modeling strategy that inputs the ground truth pose combined with four typical pose errors into the decoder and trains the model to reconstruct the correct poses, which enhances the self-correction ability of the model. Then, we attach an interactive human-feedback loop that allows receiving users' clicks to correct one or several predicted keypoints and iteratively utilizes the decoder to update all other keypoints with a minimum number of clicks (NoC) for efficient annotation. We validate Click-Pose in in-domain, out-of-domain scenes, and a new task of keypoint adaptation. For annotation, Click-Pose only needs 1.97 and 6.45 NoC@95 (at precision 95%) on COCO and Human-Art, reducing 31.4% and 36.3% efforts than the SOTA model (ViTPose) with manual correction, respectively. Besides, without user clicks, Click-Pose surpasses the previous end-to-end model by 1.4 AP on COCO and 3.0 AP on Human-Art.
authors: Jie Yang, Ailing Zeng, Feng Li, Shilong Liu, Ruimao Zhang, Lei Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15122-15132

title: 用于新视角合成的神经LiDAR场
title_en: Neural LiDAR Fields for Novel View Synthesis
abstract: 我们提出LiDAR神经场(NFL),一种从LiDAR测量中优化神经场场景表示的方法,旨在从新视角合成逼真的LiDAR扫描。NFL结合了神经场的渲染能力与对LiDAR传感过程的详细物理模型,从而能够准确再现光束发散、二次返回和射线丢失等关键传感器行为。我们在合成和真实LiDAR扫描上评估NFL,结果表明其在LiDAR新视角合成任务中优于显式重建-再模拟方法及其他NeRF风格方法。此外,我们证明合成视角的增强现实性缩小了与真实扫描的领域差距,并提升了配准和语义分割性能。
abstract_en: We present Neural Fields for LiDAR (NFL), a method to optimise a neural field scene representation from LiDAR measurements, with the goal of synthesizing realistic LiDAR scans from novel viewpoints. NFL combines the rendering power of neural fields with a detailed, physically motivated model of the LiDAR sensing process, thus enabling it to accurately reproduce key sensor behaviors like beam divergence, secondary returns, and ray dropping. We evaluate NFL on synthetic and real LiDAR scans and show that it outperforms explicit reconstruct-then-simulate methods as well as other NeRF-style methods on LiDAR novel view synthesis task. Moreover, we show that the improved realism of the synthesized views narrows the domain gap to real scans and translates to better registration and semantic segmentation performance.
authors: Shengyu Huang, Zan Gojcic, Zian Wang, Francis Williams, Yoni Kasten, Sanja Fidler, Konrad Schindler, Or Litany ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18236-18246

title: 神经微面元场用于逆渲染
title_en: Neural Microfacet Fields for Inverse Rendering
abstract: 我们提出了一种名为神经微面元场的方法,用于从场景的一组图像中恢复材料、几何结构(体积密度)和环境光照。我们的方法通过将光线路径上的每个样本视为表面而非发射体,在体积设置中应用微面元反射模型。在体积环境中使用基于表面的蒙特卡洛渲染,使我们的方法能够高效地进行逆渲染,并受益于体积渲染领域的最新进展。我们的方法在新型视角合成任务中表现出与最先进方法相当的性能,并在逆渲染任务中超越了先前的工作,能够捕捉高保真几何结构和高频光照细节。
abstract_en: We present Neural Microfacet Fields, a method for recovering materials, geometry (volumetric density), and environmental illumination from a collection of images of a scene. Our method applies a microfacet reflectance model within a volumetric setting by treating each sample along the ray as a surface, rather than an emitter. Using surface-based Monte Carlo rendering in a volumetric setting enables our method to perform inverse rendering efficiently and enjoy recent advances in volume rendering. Our approach obtains similar performance as state-of-the-art methods for novel view synthesis and outperforms prior work in inverse rendering, capturing high fidelity geometry and high frequency illumination details.
authors: Alexander Mai, Dor Verbin, Falko Kuester, Sara Fridovich-Keil ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 408-418

title: 结合激光雷达地图的神经辐射场
title_en: Neural Radiance Field with LiDAR maps
abstract: 我们研究结合激光雷达地图的户外神经辐射场(NeRF)。现有NeRF方法通常需要专门采集的超采样源视图,并且在开源的相机-激光雷达数据集上表现不佳——这显著限制了该方法的实际应用价值。本文中,我们展示了一种方法,使得这些数据集能够用于高质量的神经渲染。我们的设计利用了1)激光雷达传感器提供的强3D几何先验知识,显著提升了光线采样局部性,以及2)条件对抗网络(cGANs)来恢复图像细节,因为从不完美的激光雷达地图中聚合嵌入会导致合成图像出现伪影。实验表明,尽管NeRF基线方法在Argoverse 2数据集上会产生噪声或模糊的结果,但我们的系统合成的图像不仅在干净和噪声条件下均优于基线方法的图像质量指标,而且与真实图像的Detectron2结果更加接近。此外,为了展示我们系统的广泛适用性,我们证明该系统可用于姿态回归网络的训练数据增强和多季节视图合成。我们的数据集和代码将被发布
abstract_en: We address outdoor Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) with LiDAR maps. Existing NeRF methods usually require specially collected hypersampled source views and do not perform well with the open source camera-LiDAR datasets - significantly limiting the approach's practical utility. In this paper, we demonstrate an approach that allows for these datasets to be utilized for high quality neural renderings. Our design leverages 1) LiDAR sensors for strong 3D geometry priors that significantly improve the ray sampling locality, and 2) Conditional Adversarial Networks (cGANs) to recover image details since aggregating embeddings from imperfect LiDAR maps causes artifacts in the synthesized images. Our experiments show that while NeRF baselines produce either noisy or blurry results on Argoverse 2, the images synthesized by our system not only outperform baselines in image quality metrics under both clean and noisy conditions, but also obtain closer Detectron2 results to the ground truth images. Furthermore, to show the substantial applicability of our system, we demonstrate that our system can be used in data augmentation for training a pose regression network and multi-season view synthesis. Our dataset and code will be released
authors: MingFang Chang, Akash Sharma, Michael Kaess, Simon Lucey ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17914-17923

title: 从单目视频中进行可重新照明人体模型的神经重建
title_en: Neural Reconstruction of Relightable Human Model from Monocular Video
abstract: 以低成本从单目视频中创建可重新照明且可动画化的人体角色是数字人建模和虚拟现实应用中的关键任务。该任务因复杂的关节运动、广泛的环境光照条件以及与姿态相关的衣物变形而具有挑战性。本文提出了一种新颖的自监督框架,该框架以移动人体的单目视频作为输入,生成能够以任意光照条件下进行新姿态渲染的3D神经表示。我们的框架将动态人体在变化光照下的分解为规范空间中的神经场,考虑了几何结构和空间变化的双向反射分布函数(BRDF)材料属性。此外,我们引入了姿态驱动的变形场,实现了规范空间与观测空间之间的双向映射。通过利用所提出的外观分解和变形场,我们的框架以自监督方式学习。最终,基于姿态驱动的变形、恢复的外观和基于物理的渲染,重建的人体模型成为可重新照明的,并且可以被新的姿态显式驱动。我们在性能上显著超越了先前的工作,并在具有挑战性的非受控捕获场景中提供了从移动人体单目视频中重新照明的有说服力的示例。
abstract_en: Creating relightable and animatable human characters from monocular video at a low cost is a critical task for digital human modeling and virtual reality applications. This task is complex due to intricate articulation motion, a wide range of ambient lighting conditions, and pose-dependent clothing deformations. In this paper, we introduce a novel self-supervised framework that takes a monocular video of a moving human as input and generates a 3D neural representation capable of being rendered with novel poses under arbitrary lighting conditions. Our framework decomposes dynamic humans under varying illumination into neural fields in canonical space, taking into account geometry and spatially varying BRDF material properties. Additionally, we introduce pose-driven deformation fields, enabling bidirectional mapping between canonical space and observation. Leveraging the proposed appearance decomposition and deformation fields, our framework learns in a self-supervised manner. Ultimately, based on pose-driven deformation, recovered appearance, and physically-based rendering, the reconstructed human figure becomes relightable and can be explicitly driven by novel poses. We demonstrate significant performance improvements over previous works and provide compelling examples of relighting from monocular videos of moving humans in challenging, uncontrolled capture scenarios.
authors: Wenzhang Sun, Yunlong Che, Han Huang, Yandong Guo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 397-407

title: 神经视频深度稳定器
title_en: Neural Video Depth Stabilizer
abstract: 视频深度估计旨在推断时间一致的深度。一些方法通过在测试时利用几何和重投影约束对单图像深度模型进行微调来实现时间一致性,但这种方法效率低下且不够稳健。另一种方法是通过数据学习如何强制时间一致性,但需要精心设计的模型和充足的视频深度数据。为解决这些挑战,我们提出了一种即插即用框架,称为神经视频深度稳定器(NVDS),该框架可稳定不一致的深度估计,并且无需额外努力即可应用于不同的单图像深度模型。我们还引入了一个大规模数据集Video Depth in the Wild(VDW),包含14,203个视频和超过两百万帧,据我们所知,这是目前最大的自然场景视频深度数据集。我们在VDW数据集以及两个公开基准上评估了我们的方法,结果表明与之前的方法相比,在一致性、准确性和效率方面均有显著提升。我们的工作为基于学习的视频深度模型提供了坚实的基准和数据基础。我们将发布我们的数据集和代码供未来研究使用。
abstract_en: Video depth estimation aims to infer temporally consistent depth. Some methods achieve temporal consistency by finetuning a single-image depth model during test time using geometry and re-projection constraints, which is inefficient and not robust. An alternative approach is to learn how to enforce temporal consistency from data, but this requires well-designed models and sufficient video depth data. To address these challenges, we propose a plug-and-play framework called Neural Video Depth Stabilizer (NVDS) that stabilizes inconsistent depth estimations and can be applied to different single-image depth models without extra effort. We also introduce a large-scale dataset, Video Depth in the Wild (VDW), which consists of 14,203 videos with over two million frames, making it the largest natural-scene video depth dataset to our knowledge. We evaluate our method on the VDW dataset as well as two public benchmarks and demonstrate significant improvements in consistency, accuracy, and efficiency compared to previous approaches. Our work serves as a solid baseline and provides a data foundation for learning-based video depth models. We will release our dataset and code for future research.
authors: Yiran Wang, Min Shi, Jiaqi Li, Zihao Huang, Zhiguo Cao, Jianming Zhang, Ke Xian, Guosheng Lin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9466-9476

title: 基于Neural-PBIR的形状、材质与光照重建
title_en: Neural-PBIR Reconstruction of Shape, Material, and Illumination
abstract: 基于二维图像(如照片)重建物理世界物体的形状、空间变化的表面外观及其周围光照一直是计算机视觉与图形学中的长期挑战。本文提出了一种结合基于神经网络的物体重建与基于物理的逆渲染(PBIR)的高精度高效物体重建流程。我们的流程首先利用基于神经SDF的形状重建生成高质量但可能不完美的物体形状;随后引入神经材质与光照蒸馏阶段以实现材质与光照的高质量预测;最后由神经预测初始化,通过PBIR优化初始结果,获得物体形状、材质与光照的最终高质量重建。实验结果表明,我们的流程在重建质量与性能方面均显著优于现有方法。代码:https://neural-pbir.github.io/
abstract_en: Reconstructing the shape and spatially varying surface appearances of a physical-world object as well as its surrounding illumination based on 2D images (e.g., photographs) of the object has been a long-standing problem in computer vision and graphics. In this paper, we introduce an accurate and highly efficient object reconstruction pipeline combining neural based object reconstruction and physics-based inverse rendering (PBIR). Our pipeline firstly leverages a neural SDF based shape reconstruction to produce high-quality but potentially imperfect object shape. Then, we introduce a neural material and lighting distillation stage to achieve high-quality predictions for material and illumination. In the last stage, initialized by the neural predictions, we perform PBIR to refine the initial results and obtain the final high-quality reconstruction of object shape, material, and illumination. Experimental results demonstrate our pipeline significantly outperforms existing methods quality-wise and performance-wise. Code: https://neural-pbir.github.io/
authors: Cheng Sun, Guangyan Cai, Zhengqin Li, Kai Yan, Cheng Zhang, Carl Marshall, Jia-Bin Huang, Shuang Zhao, Zhao Dong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18046-18056

title: 无需畏惧分类器偏差:基于神经塌缩的联邦学习方法与合成固定分类器
title_en: No Fear of Classifier Biases: Neural Collapse Inspired Federated Learning with Synthetic and Fixed Classifier
abstract: 数据异质性是固有的挑战,阻碍了联邦学习(FL)的性能。近期研究已识别出本地模型的偏差分类器是关键瓶颈。先前尝试在联邦学习训练后进行分类器校准,但这种方法在改善由训练时分类器偏差导致的劣质特征表示方面存在不足。解决联邦学习中的分类器偏差困境需要全面理解分类器背后的机制。近期神经塌缩的进展表明,在理想训练场景下,分类器和特征原型会塌缩到一个称为简单形等角紧框架(ETF)的最优结构。基于这一神经塌缩洞察,我们提出在训练过程中利用合成且固定的ETF分类器来解决联邦学习的分类器偏差问题。最优分类器结构使所有客户端即使在极端异质数据下也能学习统一且最优的特征表示。我们设计了若干有效模块以更好地适应FL中的ETF结构,实现高泛化与个性化。大量实验表明,我们的方法在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet上达到最先进性能。代码可在https://github.com/ZexiLee/ICCV-2023-FedETF获取。
abstract_en: Data heterogeneity is an inherent challenge that hinders the performance of federated learning (FL). Recent studies have identified the biased classifiers of local models as the key bottleneck. Previous attempts have used classifier calibration after FL training, but this approach falls short in improving the poor feature representations caused by training-time classifier biases. Resolving the classifier bias dilemma in FL requires a full understanding of the mechanisms behind the classifier. Recent advances in neural collapse have shown that the classifiers and feature prototypes under perfect training scenarios collapse into an optimal structure called simplex equiangular tight frame (ETF). Building on this neural collapse insight, we propose a solution to the FL's classifier bias problem by utilizing a synthetic and fixed ETF classifier during training. The optimal classifier structure enables all clients to learn unified and optimal feature representations even under extremely heterogeneous data. We devise several effective modules to better adapt the ETF structure in FL, achieving both high generalization and personalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performances on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny-ImageNet. The code is available at https://github.com/ZexiLee/ICCV-2023-FedETF.
authors: Zexi Li, Xinyi Shang, Rui He, Tao Lin, Chao Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5319-5329

title: 基于网络爬取图像-文本数据的噪声感知图像描述生成方法
title_en: Noise-Aware Learning from Web-Crawled Image-Text Data for Image Captioning
abstract: 图像描述生成是能够直接利用大规模网络爬取数据的典型任务,这些数据为描述模型提供了丰富的视觉世界知识。然而,由于网络爬取数据包含对齐级别不同的图像-文本配对,固有噪声(如错位配对)使得学习精确的描述模型变得困难。虽然过滤策略可以有效去除噪声数据,但会导致可学习知识的减少,有时还会引发数据不足的新问题。为兼顾两者优势,我们提出了一种噪声感知描述生成(Noise-aware Captioning, NoC)框架,该框架在学习过程中能够从完整网络爬取数据中获取丰富知识,同时减少噪声影响。这通过提出的对齐级别可控描述生成器实现,该生成器在训练时利用图像-文本配对的对齐级别作为控制信号进行学习。基于对齐级别的条件训练使模型在推理时只需设置控制信号为期望的对齐级别即可生成高质量描述。深入分析表明,我们的框架在处理噪声方面具有有效性。通过零样本描述生成和利用生成描述进行文本到图像检索(即自检索)两个任务,我们进一步验证了模型在描述性和独特性方面生成高质量描述的能力。代码已开源至https://github.com/kakaobrain/noc。
abstract_en:
Image captioning is one of the straightforward tasks that can take advantage of large-scale web-crawled data which provides rich knowledge about the visual world for a captioning model. However, since web-crawled data contains image-text pairs that are aligned at different levels, the inherent noises (e.g., misaligned pairs) make it difficult to learn a precise captioning model. While the filtering strategy can effectively remove noisy data, it leads to a decrease in learnable knowledge and sometimes brings about a new problem of data deficiency.
 To take the best of both worlds, we propose a Noise-aware Captioning (NoC) framework, which learns rich knowledge from the whole web-crawled data while being less affected by the noises. This is achieved by the proposed alignment-level-controllable captioner, which is learned using alignment levels of the image-text pairs as a control signal during training. The alignment-level-conditioned training allows the model to generate high-quality captions by simply setting the control signal to the desired alignment level at inference time.
 An in-depth analysis shows the effectiveness of our framework in handling noise.
 With two tasks of zero-shot captioning and text-to-image retrieval using generated captions (i.e., self-retrieval), we also demonstrate our model can produce high-quality captions in terms of descriptiveness and distinctiveness. The code is available at https://github.com/kakaobrain/noc.
authors: Wooyoung Kang, Jonghwan Mun, Sungjun Lee, Byungseok Roh ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2942-2952

title: Noise2Info: 从噪声图像中提取噪声信息用于自监督图像去噪
title_en: Noise2Info: Noisy Image to Information of Noise for Self-Supervised Image Denoising
abstract: 无监督图像去噪方法被提出,以缓解广泛存在的噪声问题,而无需干净图像。现有工作主要采用自监督方式,尝试在不依赖x知识的情况下重建噪声图像中的每个像素x。近期,一些先驱性工作进一步强调了x的重要性,提出在恢复x时需权衡从x和其他像素中提取的信息。然而,此类方法对注入干净图像的噪声标准差σ_n高度敏感,而σ_n在不知晓干净图像的情况下不可获取。因此,假设σ_n已知以追求高模型性能是不现实的。为缓解这一问题,我们提出Noise2Info,仅基于噪声图像提取关键信息——注入噪声的标准差σ_n。具体而言,我们首先从理论上提供σ_n的上界,而该界需要干净图像。随后,我们提出一种新颖方法,仅使用噪声图像来估计σ_n的界。此外,我们证明了随着模型训练,我们的估计值与真实偏差的差异逐渐减小。实证研究表明,Noise2Info在基准数据集上表现出色且鲁棒,且在模型训练过程中能准确估计噪声标准差。
abstract_en:
Unsupervised image denoising has been proposed to alleviate the widespread noise problem without requiring clean images. Existing works mainly follow the self-supervised way, which tries to reconstruct each pixel x of noisy images without the knowledge of x. More recently, some pioneer works further emphasize the importance of x and propose to weigh the information extracted from x and other pixels when recovering x. However, such a method is highly sensitive to the standard deviation \sigma_n of noises injected to clean images, where \sigma_n is inaccessible without knowing clean images. Thus, it is unrealistic to assume that \sigma_n is known for pursuing high model performance.
 To alleviate this issue, we propose Noise2Info to extract the critical information, the standard deviation \sigma_n of injected noise, only based on the noisy images. Specifically, we first theoretically provide an upper bound on \sigma_n, while the bound requires clean images. Then, we propose a novel method to estimate the bound of \sigma_n by only using noisy images. Besides, we prove that the difference between our estimation with the true deviation goes smaller as the model training. Empirical studies show that Noise2Info is effective and robust on benchmark data sets and closely estimates the standard deviation of noises during model training.
authors: Jiachuan Wang, Shimin Di, Lei Chen, Charles Wang Wai Ng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16034-16043

title: 非共轴事件引导运动去模糊与空间对齐
title_en: Non-Coaxial Event-Guided Motion Deblurring with Spatial Alignment
abstract: 从模糊图像中恢复运动去模糊是计算机视觉中的挑战性问题,因为基于帧的相机在模糊过程中会丢失信息。已有研究尝试通过使用具有高时间分辨率的仿生传感器事件相机来补偿运动信息的损失。尽管大多数研究假设图像和事件数据是逐像素对齐的,但这种对齐仅在低质量主动像素传感器(APS)图像和合成数据集中才有可能实现。在真实场景中,由于事件相机和帧相机具有不同的光学轴,获取逐像素对齐的事件-RGB数据存在技术挑战。针对事件相机的应用,我们提出了首个非共轴事件引导图像去模糊(NEID)方法,该方法利用由标准帧相机与非共轴单事件相机组成的相机系统。为在无需额外设备的情况下考虑图像与事件之间的逐像素对齐,我们提出了首个NEID网络,该网络在空间对齐事件到图像的同时,通过时序密集事件特征优化图像特征。为了训练和评估我们的网络,我们还提出了首个大规模数据集,包含非对齐事件的RGB帧,旨在推动事件相机运动去模糊技术的突破。在多个数据集上的大量实验表明,所提出的方法在性能和速度方面均显著优于现有方法,且可应用于事件相机的实用场景。
abstract_en: Motion deblurring from a blurred image is a challenging computer vision problem because frame-based cameras lose information during the blurring process. Several attempts have compensated for the loss of motion information by using event cameras, which are bio-inspired sensors with a high temporal resolution. Even though most studies have assumed that image and event data are pixel-wise aligned, this is only possible with low-quality active-pixel sensor (APS) images and synthetic datasets. In real scenarios, obtaining per-pixel aligned event-RGB data is technically challenging since event and frame cameras have different optical axes. For the application of the event camera, we propose the first Non-coaxial Event-guided Image Deblurring (NEID) approach that utilizes the camera setup composed of a standard frame-based camera with a non-coaxial single event camera. To consider the per-pixel alignment between the image and event without additional devices, we propose the first NEID network that spatially aligns events to images while refining the image features from temporally dense event features. For training and evaluation of our network, we also present the first large-scale dataset, consisting of RGB frames with non-aligned events aimed at a breakthrough in motion deblurring with an event camera. Extensive experiments on various datasets demonstrate that the proposed method achieves significantly better results than the prior works in terms of performance and speed, and it can be applied for practical uses of event cameras.
authors: Hoonhee Cho, Yuhwan Jeong, Taewoo Kim, Kuk-Jin Yoon ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12492-12503

title: 面向无监督视频语义压缩的非语义抑制掩码学习
title_en: Non-Semantics Suppressed Mask Learning for Unsupervised Video Semantic Compression
abstract: 大多数视频压缩方法旨在提升解码视频的视觉质量,而非特别保证语义完整性,这会损害下游视频分析任务(如动作识别)。本文聚焦于一种新颖的无监督视频语义压缩问题,其中视频语义以与下游任务无关的方式进行压缩。为解决该问题,我们首先提出语义挖掘后补偿(SMC)框架,以增强基础视频编解码器的语义编码能力。随后,我们仅利用未标记视频数据优化该框架,通过掩码压缩视频的一部分并重建原始视频的掩码区域,这一方法受近期掩码图像建模(MIM)方法启发。尽管MIM方案能学习通用语义特征,其内部生成式学习范式可能也促使编码框架以额外比特成本记忆非语义信息。为抑制这一缺陷,我们通过将解码视频特征的非语义信息熵建模为条件于挖掘视频语义的参数化高斯混合模型,显式降低其熵值。综合实验结果表明,所提方法在三个视频分析任务和七个数据集上,相较于传统、可学习及感知质量导向的视频编解码器展现出显著优势。
abstract_en: Most video compression methods aim to improve the decoded video visual quality, instead of particularly guaranteeing the semantic-completeness, which deteriorates downstream video analysis tasks, e.g., action recognition. In this paper, we focus on a novel unsupervised video semantic compression problem, where video semantics is compressed in a downstream task-agnostic manner. To tackle this problem, we first propose a Semantic-Mining-then-Compensation (SMC) framework to enhance the plain video codec with powerful semantic coding capability. Then, we optimize the framework with only unlabeled video data, by masking out a proportion of the compressed video and reconstructing the masked regions of the original video, which is inspired by recent masked image modeling (MIM) methods. Although the MIM scheme learns generalizable semantic features, its inner generative learning paradigm may also facilitate the coding framework memorizing non-semantic information with extra bitcosts. To suppress this deficiency, we explicitly decrease the non-semantic information entropy of the decoded video features, by formulating it as a parametrized Gaussian Mixture Model conditioned on the mined video semantics. Comprehensive experimental results demonstrate the proposed approach shows remarkable superiority over previous traditional, learnable and perceptual-quality-oriented video codecs, on three video analysis tasks and seven datasets.
authors: Yuan Tian, Guo Lu, Guangtao Zhai, Zhiyong Gao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13610-13622

title: 基于区域展开变换器的非刚性物体接触估计
title_en: Nonrigid Object Contact Estimation With Regional Unwrapping Transformer
abstract: 获取手与非刚性物体之间的接触模式是视觉和机器人学领域的一个常见问题。然而,现有基于学习的方法更侧重于从单目图像中估计与刚性物体的接触。当将其应用于非刚性接触时,主要问题在于现有接触表示受限于物体的几何形状。因此,接触邻域以无序方式存储,接触特征难以与图像线索对齐。我们的方法核心是一种新颖的手-物体接触表示方法,称为RUPs(区域展开轮廓),它将粗略估计的手-物体表面展开为多个高分辨率2D区域轮廓。区域分组策略与手的运动学骨骼划分一致,因为它们是复合接触模式的基本发起者。基于此表示,我们的区域展开变换器(RUFormer)从单目输入中学习区域间的相关先验,并预测对应的接触和形变变换。实验表明,所提出的框架能够稳健地估计形变程度和形变变换,使其适用于非刚性和刚性接触。
abstract_en: Acquiring contact patterns between hands and nonrigid objects is a common concern in the vision and robotics community. However, existing learning-based methods focus more on contact with rigid ones from monocular images. When adopting them for nonrigid contact, a major problem is that the existing contact representation is restricted by the geometry of the object. Consequently, contact neighborhoods are stored in an unordered manner and contact features are difficult to align with image cues. At the core of our approach lies a novel hand-object contact representation called RUPs (Region Unwrapping Profiles), which unwrap the roughly estimated hand-object surfaces as multiple high-resolution 2D regional profiles. The region grouping strategy is consistent with the hand kinematic bone division because they are the primitive initiators for a composite contact pattern. Based on this representation, our Regional Unwrapping Transformer (RUFormer) learns the correlation priors across regions from monocular inputs and predicts corresponding contact and deformed transformations. Our experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework can robustly estimate the deformed degrees and deformed transformations, which make it suitable for both nonrigid and rigid contact.
authors: Wei Xie, Zimeng Zhao, Shiying Li, Binghui Zuo, Yangang Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9342-9351

title: 基于归一化流的人体姿态异常检测
title_en: Normalizing Flows for Human Pose Anomaly Detection
abstract: 视频异常检测是一个病态问题,因为它依赖于外观、姿态、相机角度、背景等众多参数。我们将问题简化为人体姿态的异常检测,从而降低外观等干扰参数对结果的影响风险。专注于姿态本身还具有减少对特定少数群体偏见的附加优势。我们的模型直接处理人体姿态图序列,参数量极低(1K参数),可在任何能运行姿态估计的机器上运行,几乎不增加额外资源。我们利用归一化流框架中的高度紧凑姿态表示,扩展其以应对时空姿态数据的独特特性,并在该应用场景中展示了其优势。该算法具有通用性,可处理仅包含正常示例的训练数据,以及包含标记正常和异常示例的监督设置。我们在两个异常检测基准上取得了最先进结果——无监督的ShanghaiTech数据集和最近的监督UBnormal数据集。代码可访问 https://github.com/orhir/STG-NF
abstract_en:
Video anomaly detection is an ill-posed problem because it relies on many parameters such as appearance, pose, camera angle, background, and more.
 We distill the problem to anomaly detection of human pose, thus decreasing the risk of nuisance parameters such as appearance affecting the result. Focusing on pose alone also has the side benefit of reducing bias against distinct minority groups.
 Our model works directly on human pose graph sequences and is exceptionally lightweight ( 1K parameters), capable of running on any machine able to run the pose estimation with negligible additional resources.
 We leverage the highly compact pose representation in a normalizing flows framework, which we extend to tackle the unique characteristics of spatio-temporal pose data and show its advantages in this use case.
 The algorithm is quite general and can handle training data of only normal examples as well as a supervised setting that consists of labeled normal and abnormal examples.
 We report state-of-the-art results on two anomaly detection benchmarks - the unsupervised ShanghaiTech dataset and the recent supervised UBnormal dataset. 
 Code available at https://github.com/orhir/STG-NF.
authors: Or Hirschorn, Shai Avidan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13545-13554

title: 并非所有特征都重要:通过自适应先验细化增强少样本CLIP
title_en: Not All Features Matter: Enhancing Few-shot CLIP with Adaptive Prior Refinement
abstract: 对比语言-图像预训练(CLIP)的流行推动了其在多样化的下游视觉任务中的应用。为提升其在下游任务中的能力,少样本学习已成为广泛采用的技术。然而,现有方法要么性能有限,要么存在过多可学习参数。本文提出APE(Adaptive Prior rEfinement),一种针对CLIP预训练知识的自适应先验细化方法,在保持高计算效率的同时实现优越的准确率。通过先验细化模块,我们分析下游数据中的类别间差异,并将领域特定知识与CLIP提取的缓存模型分离。在此基础上,我们引入两种模型变体:无需训练的APE和需要训练的APE-T。我们探索测试图像、先验缓存模型与文本表征之间的三重亲和力,并仅启用轻量级类别残差模块进行训练。在11个基准测试中,APE和APE-T的平均准确率分别超越次优方法+1.59%和+1.99%,且在16个样本下使用x30更少的可学习参数。
abstract_en: The popularity of Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) has propelled its application to diverse downstream vision tasks. To improve its capacity on downstream tasks, few-shot learning has become a widely-adopted technique. However, existing methods either exhibit limited performance or suffer from excessive learnable parameters. In this paper, we propose APE, an Adaptive Prior rEfinement method for CLIP's pre-trained knowledge, which achieves superior accuracy with high computational efficiency. Via a prior refinement module, we analyze the inter-class disparity in the downstream data and decouple the domain-specific knowledge from the CLIP-extracted cache model. On top of that, we introduce two model variants, a training-free APE and a training-required APE-T. We explore the trilateral affinities between the test image, prior cache model, and textual representations, and only enable a lightweight category-residual module to be trained. For the average accuracy over 11 benchmarks, both APE and APE-T attain state-of-the-art and respectively outperform the second-best by +1.59% and +1.99% under 16 shots with x30 less learnable parameters.
authors: Xiangyang Zhu, Renrui Zhang, Bowei He, Aojun Zhou, Dong Wang, Bin Zhao, Peng Gao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2605-2615

title: 并非所有步骤都同等重要:面向图像操作的选择性扩散蒸馏
title_en: Not All Steps are Created Equal: Selective Diffusion Distillation for Image Manipulation
abstract: 条件扩散模型在图像操作任务中展现出卓越性能。通用流程涉及对图像添加噪声并进行去噪处理。然而,该方法面临权衡问题:添加过多噪声会损害图像保真度,添加过少噪声则影响编辑灵活性。这在很大程度上限制了其实际应用价值。本文提出一种新颖框架——选择性扩散蒸馏(Selective Diffusion Distillation, SDD),确保图像的保真度与编辑灵活性。我们不直接使用扩散模型编辑图像,而是在扩散模型指导下训练前馈图像操作网络。此外,我们提出有效指标选择语义相关时间步,从扩散模型中获取正确语义指导。该方法成功避免了扩散过程带来的困境。大量实验验证了我们框架的优势。
abstract_en: Conditional diffusion models have demonstrated impressive performance in image manipulation tasks. The general pipeline involves adding noise to the image and then denoising it. However, this method faces a trade-off problem: adding too much noise affects the fidelity of the image while adding too little affects its editability. This largely limits their practical applicability. In this paper, we propose a novel framework, Selective Diffusion Distillation (SDD), that ensures both the fidelity and editability of images. Instead of directly editing images with a diffusion model, we train a feedforward image manipulation network under the guidance of the diffusion model. Besides, we propose an effective indicator to select the semantic-related timestep to obtain the correct semantic guidance from the diffusion model. This approach successfully avoids the dilemma caused by the diffusion process. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the advantages of our framework.
authors: Luozhou Wang, Shuai Yang, Shu Liu, Ying-cong Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7472-7481

title: 并非所有边都相等:半监督3D目标检测的定位不确定性估计
title_en: Not Every Side Is Equal: Localization Uncertainty Estimation for Semi-Supervised 3D Object Detection
abstract: 从点云中进行半监督3D目标检测旨在使用少量标注数据和大量未标注数据训练检测器。现有方法的核心在于如何通过设计的质量评估标准选择高质量伪标签。然而,这些方法将每个伪边界框视为整体,在训练过程中对每条边赋予同等重要性,这会因许多边的定位质量较差而损害模型性能。此外,现有方法过滤掉大量低质量伪标签,而这些标签中可能包含有助于模型训练的正确回归值。为解决上述问题,我们提出了一种边感知框架,包含三个关键设计:3D边界框参数化方法、不确定性估计模块和伪标签选择策略。这些模块协同工作,显式估计每条边的定位质量,并在训练阶段赋予不同重要性。大量实验结果表明,所提方法在不同场景和评估标准下均优于基线模型。此外,我们的方法在三个具有不同标注比例的数据集上达到了最先进性能。
abstract_en: Semi-supervised 3D object detection from point cloud aims to train a detector with a small number of labeled data and a large number of unlabeled data. The core of existing methods lies in how to select high-quality pseudo-labels using the designed quality evaluation criterion. However, these methods treat each pseudo bounding box as a whole and assign equal importance to each side during training, which is detrimental to model performance due to many sides having poor localization quality. Besides, existing methods filter out a large number of low-quality pseudo-labels, which also contain some correct regression values that can help with model training. To address the above issues, we propose a side-aware framework for semi-supervised 3D object detection consisting of three key designs: a 3D bounding box parameterization method, an uncertainty estimation module, and a pseudo-label selection strategy. These modules work together to explicitly estimate the localization quality of each side and assign different levels of importance during the training phase. Extensive experiment results demonstrate that the proposed method can consistently outperform baseline models under different scenes and evaluation criteria. Moreover, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on three datasets with different labeled ratios.
authors: Chuxin Wang, Wenfei Yang, Tianzhu Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3814-3824

title: 新颖场景与类别:面向自适应开放集目标检测
title_en: Novel Scenes & Classes: Towards Adaptive Open-set Object Detection
abstract: 领域自适应目标检测(DAOD)将目标检测器迁移到无标签的新领域。然而,在现实世界中,除了遇到新颖场景,新颖领域通常包含新颖类别对象,这一事实被现有研究忽略。因此,我们提出并研究了一个更实用的设定——自适应开放集目标检测(AOOD),同时考虑新颖场景和类别。直接结合现有跨域和开放集方法是次优的,因为它们的低阶依赖(如置信度得分)不足以处理包含双维度新颖信息的AOOD。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的结构化基序匹配(SOMA)框架用于AOOD,通过基序(即统计显著子图)建模高阶关系,并将AOOD解决方案形式化为基序匹配以学习高阶模式。简言之,SOMA包含结构感知新颖类别学习(SNL)和结构感知迁移学习(STL)。对于SNL,我们建立实例导向图以捕捉不同基础类别中隐含的类别无关对象特征。随后提出高阶度量以匹配最显著基序作为高阶模式,用于基序引导的新颖类别学习。在STL中,我们建立语义导向图以建模跨域的类别相关关系,并通过高阶基序匹配未标记对象,以结构感知方式对齐跨域分布。大量实验表明,所提出的SOMA方法达到最先进性能。代码将公开发布以供进一步研究。
abstract_en: Domain Adaptive Object Detection (DAOD) transfers an object detector to a novel domain free of labels. However, in the real world, besides encountering novel scenes, novel domains always contain novel-class objects de facto, which are ignored in existing research. Thus, we formulate and study a more practical setting, Adaptive Open-set Object Detection (AOOD), considering both novel scenes and classes. Directly combing off-the-shelled cross-domain and open-set approaches is sub-optimal since their low-order dependence, e.g., the confidence score, is insufficient for the AOOD with two dimensions of novel information. To address this, we propose a novel Structured mOtif MAtching (SOMA) framework for AOOD, which models the high-order relation with motifs, i.e., a statistically significant subgraph, and formulates AOOD solution as motif matching to learn with high-order patterns. In a nutshell, SOMA consists of Structure-aware Novel-class Learning (SNL) and Structure-aware Transfer Learning (STL). As for SNL, we establish an instance-oriented graph to capture the class-independent object feature hidden in different base classes. Then, a high-order metric is proposed to match the most significant motif as high-order patterns, serving for motif-guided novel-class learning. In STL, we set up a semantic-oriented graph to model the class-dependent relation across domains, and match unlabelled objects with high-order motifs to align the cross-domain distribution with structural awareness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed SOMA achieves state-of-the-art performance. Codes will be released publicly for further study.
authors: Wuyang Li, Xiaoqing Guo, Yixuan Yuan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15780-15790

title: 基于稀疏视角的手-物体交互新视角合成与姿态估计
title_en: Novel-View Synthesis and Pose Estimation for Hand-Object Interaction from Sparse Views
abstract: 手-物体交互理解以及尚未充分解决的新视角合成在沉浸式通信中具有高度需求,但由于手部高度变形以及手与物体间的严重遮挡,实现该目标面临挑战。本文提出了一种从稀疏视角进行手-物体交互的神经渲染与姿态估计系统,该系统还可实现3D手-物体交互编辑。我们借鉴近期场景理解工作的启发,发现预先构建的场景特定模型能显著提升和突破输入稀疏时的视觉任务,将其扩展至动态手-物体交互场景,并提出分两阶段解决问题的方案。首先在离线阶段分别通过神经表示学习手和物体的形状与外观先验知识。在线阶段设计基于渲染的联合模型拟合框架,利用预先构建的手和物体模型以及交互先验知识理解动态手-物体交互,从而克服手与物体间的穿透和分离问题并实现新视角合成。为在序列中获得稳定的接触区域,我们提出稳定接触损失以保持接触区域的一致性。实验表明,我们的方法优于现有最先进方法。代码和数据集可在项目网页https://iscas3dv.github.io/HO-NeRF获取。
abstract_en: Hand-object interaction understanding and the barely addressed novel view synthesis are highly desired in the immersive communication, whereas it is challenging due to the high deformation of hand and heavy occlusions between hand and object. In this paper, we propose a neural rendering and pose estimation system for hand-object interaction from sparse views, which can also enable 3D hand-object interaction editing. We share the inspiration from recent scene understanding work that shows a scene specific model built beforehand can significantly improve and unblock vision tasks especially when inputs are sparse, and extend it to the dynamic hand-object interaction scenario and propose to solve the problem in two stages. We first learn the shape and appearance prior knowledge of hands and objects separately with the neural representation at the offline stage. During the online stage, we design a rendering-based joint model fitting framework to understand the dynamic hand-object interaction with the pre-built hand and object models as well as interaction priors, which thereby overcomes penetration and separation issues between hand and object and also enables novel view synthesis. In order to get stable contact during the hand-object interaction process in a sequence, we propose a stable contact loss to make the contact region to be consistent. Experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods. Code and dataset are available in project webpage https://iscas3dv.github.io/HO-NeRF.
authors: Wentian Qu, Zhaopeng Cui, Yinda Zhang, Chenyu Meng, Cuixia Ma, Xiaoming Deng, Hongan Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15100-15111

title: OCHID-Fi:基于射频视觉的3D抗遮挡手部姿态估计
title_en: OCHID-Fi: Occlusion-Robust Hand Pose Estimation in 3D via RF-Vision
abstract: 手部姿态估计(HPE)对许多应用至关重要,但传统的基于摄像头的CM-HPE方法完全依赖于视线(LoS),因为摄像头无法捕捉被遮挡的物体。在本文中,我们提出利用能够绕过障碍物的射频视觉(RF-vision)以实现遮挡场景下的手部姿态估计,并引入OCHID-Fi作为首个具备3D姿态估计能力的RF-HPE方法。OCHID-Fi采用广泛存在于智能设备(如iPhone)上的宽带RF传感器,探测3D人体手部姿态并提取障碍物后的人体骨骼。为克服RF成像标签的挑战(因其人类不可理解的特性),OCHID-Fi采用跨模态和跨域训练过程。它使用预训练的CM-HPE网络和同步的CM/RF数据集,指导其复数值RF-HPE网络在LoS条件下的训练。进一步通过对抗学习将从标注LoS域学到的知识迁移至未标注的遮挡域,使OCHID-Fi能够泛化到未见过的遮挡场景。实验结果验证了OCHID-Fi的优越性:在正常条件下其精度与CM-HPE相当,即使在遮挡场景中也能保持此类精度,实证表明其对新域的泛化能力。
abstract_en: Hand Pose Estimation (HPE) is crucial to many applications, but conventional cameras-based CM-HPE methods are completely subject to Line-of-Sight (LoS), as cameras cannot capture occluded objects. In this paper, we propose to exploit Radio-Frequency-Vision (RF-vision) capable of bypassing obstacles for achieving occluded HPE, and we introduce OCHID-Fi as the first RF-HPE method with 3D pose estimation capability. OCHID-Fi employs wideband RF sensors widely available on smart devices (e.g., iPhones) to probe 3D human hand pose and extract their skeletons behind obstacles. To overcome the challenge in labeling RF imaging given its human incomprehensible nature, OCHID-Fi employs a cross-modality and cross-domain training process. It uses a pre-trained CM-HPE network and a synchronized CM/RF dataset, to guide the training of its complex-valued RF-HPE network under LoS conditions. It further transfers knowledge learned from labeled LoS domain to unlabeled occluded domain via adversarial learning, enabling OCHID-Fi to generalize to unseen occluded scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of OCHID-Fi: it achieves comparable accuracy to CM-HPE under normal conditions while maintaining such accuracy even in occluded scenarios, with empirical evidence for its generalizability to new domains.
