abstract: 视频标签旨在为给定视频推断多个覆盖相关内容的标签。通常视频标签由多种用户自由定义并上传,因此具有两个特征:数量丰富且视频内标签顺序混乱。现有方法难以直接适应该任务。本文根据上述特征提出一种新型生成模型,顺序提示标签序列生成(OP-TSG)。该模型将视频标签视为由样本依赖顺序提示引导的标签序列生成问题。这些提示与标签语义对齐,能够解耦标签生成顺序,使模型聚焦于建模标签依赖关系。此外,基于词的生成策略使模型能够生成新颖标签。为验证所提方法的有效性与泛化性,建立了中文视频标签基准CREATE-tagging和英文图像标签基准Pexel-tagging。大量实验结果表明,OP-TSG显著优于其他方法,尤其在罕见标签上的结果分别比SOTA方法在CREATE-tagging和Pexel-tagging上提升3.3%和3%,且在CREATE-tagging上生成的新标签表现出7.04%的标签增益。
abstract_en: Video Tagging intends to infer multiple tags spanning relevant content for a given video. Typically, video tags are freely defined and uploaded by a variety of users, so they have two characteristics: abundant in quantity and disordered intra-video. It is difficult for the existing multi-label classification and generation methods to adapt directly to this task. This paper proposes a novel generative model, Order-Prompted Tag Sequence Generation (OP-TSG), according to the above characteristics. It regards video tagging as a tag sequence generation problem guided by sample-dependent order prompts. These prompts are semantically aligned with tags and enable to decouple tag generation order, making the model focus on modeling the tag dependencies. Moreover, the word-based generation strategy enables the model to generate novel tags. To verify the effectiveness and generalization of the proposed method, a Chinese video tagging benchmark CREATE-tagging, and an English image tagging benchmark Pexel-tagging are established. Extensive results show that OP-TSG is significantly superior to other methods, especially the results on rare tags improve by 3.3% and 3% over SOTA methods on CREATE-tagging and Pexel-tagging, and novel tags generated on CREATE-tagging exhibit a tag gain of 7.04%.
authors: Zongyang Ma, Ziqi Zhang, Yuxin Chen, Zhongang Qi, Yingmin Luo, Zekun Li, Chunfeng Yuan, Bing Li, Xiaohu Qie, Ying Shan, Weiming Hu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15681-15690

title: 面向领域适应与泛化的有序保持一致性正则化
title_en: Order-preserving Consistency Regularization for Domain Adaptation and Generalization
abstract: 深度学习模型若对领域特定属性(如闪电、背景、相机角度等)过于敏感,则会在跨领域挑战中表现不佳。为解决这一问题,通常采用数据增强结合一致性正则化的方法,使模型减少对领域特定属性的敏感性。一致性正则化强制模型对同一图像的两个视图输出相同的表示或预测。然而,这些约束要么过于严格,要么无法保持分类概率的顺序。本文针对跨领域任务提出有序保持一致性正则化(OCR)。预测的有序保持性使模型对任务无关的变换具有鲁棒性,从而降低对领域特定属性的敏感性。全面实验表明,我们的方法在五个不同的跨领域任务中均展现出显著优势。
abstract_en: Deep learning models fail on cross-domain challenges if the model is oversensitive to domain-specific attributes, e.g., lightning, background, camera angle, etc. To alleviate this problem, data augmentation coupled with consistency regularization are commonly adopted to make the model less sensitive to domain-specific attributes. Consistency regularization enforces the model to output the same representation or prediction for two views of one image. These constraints, however, are either too strict or not order-preserving for the classification probabilities. In this work, we propose the Order-preserving Consistency Regularization (OCR) for cross-domain tasks. The order-preserving property for the prediction makes the model robust to task-irrelevant transformations. As a result, the model becomes less sensitive to the domain-specific attributes. The comprehensive experiments show that our method achieves clear advantages on five different cross-domain tasks.
authors: Mengmeng Jing, Xiantong Zhen, Jingjing Li, Cees G. M. Snoek ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18916-18927

title: 面向细粒度交互式交通场景理解的有序原子活动
title_en: Ordered Atomic Activity for Fine-grained Interactive Traffic Scenario Understanding
abstract: 我们引入了一种名为有序原子活动的新表示方法,用于交互式场景理解。该表示方法将每个场景分解为一组有序原子活动,其中每个活动包含一个动作及其对应的参与者,并通过顺序表示场景的时间发展过程。该设计还有助于识别重要的交互关系,如让行。动作是一种基于周围道路拓扑的高层语义运动模式,我们将其分解为具有唯一ID的区域和角落。例如,一组在左侧过马路的行人被表示为C1 - C4: P+,如图1所示。我们收集了一个新的大规模数据集,称为OATS(交互式交通场景中的有序原子活动),包含在交叉路口拍摄的1026个视频片段(20秒)。每个片段均使用所提出的语言进行标注,最终形成59个活动类别和6512个标注的活动实例。我们提出了三个细粒度场景理解任务,即多标签原子活动识别、活动顺序预测和交互场景检索。我们实现了多种最先进的算法,并在OATS数据集上进行了大量实验。我们发现现有方法无法达到令人满意的性能,这表明社区有新的机会开发针对这些任务的新算法,以实现更优的交互式场景理解。
abstract_en: We introduce a novel representation called Ordered Atomic Activity for interactive scenario understanding. The representation decomposes each scenario into a set of ordered atomic activities, where each activity consists of an action and the corresponding actors involved and the order denotes the temporal development of the scenario. The design also helps in identifying important interactive relationships such as yielding. The action is a high-level semantic motion pattern that is grounded in the surrounding road topology, which we decompose into zones and corners with unique IDs. For example, a group of pedestrians crossing on the left side is denoted as C1 - C4: P+, as depicted in Figure 1. We collect a new large-scale dataset called OATS (Ordered Atomic Activities in interactive Traffic Scenarios), comprising 1026 video clips (  20s) captured at intersections. Each clip is labeled with the proposed language, resulting in 59 activity categories and 6512 annotated activity instances. We propose three fine-grained scenario understanding tasks, i.e., multi-label Atomic Activity recognition, recognition, activity order prediction, and interactive scenario retrieval. We implement various state-of-the-art algorithms and conduct extensive experiments on OATS. We found the existing methods cannot achieve satisfactory performance, indicating new opportunities for the community to develop new algorithms for these tasks toward better interactive scenario understanding
authors: Nakul Agarwal, Yi-Ting Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8624-8636

title: 序数标签分布学习
title_en: Ordinal Label Distribution Learning
abstract: 标签分布学习(LDL)是近年来的研究热点,其通过标签的描述程度建模模糊性。然而,在常见的LDL任务中,例如年龄估计,标签具有内在的顺序关系。传统的LDL范式采用逐标签方式进行优化,忽略了标签的内部序列模式。因此,我们提出了一种新的范式,称为序数标签分布学习(OLDL)。我们从空间、语义和时间顺序关系三个方面建模标签的序列模式。空间顺序描述任意标签之间的相对位置,我们构建跨标签分布的转换,该转换由标签的空间边距决定。标签自然具有不同的语义,因此通过构建任意标签之间的语义关联来表示语义顺序。时间顺序描述标签的存在由其顺序决定,即五在四之后。特定标签的值包含先前标签的信息,我们采用累积分布来构建这种关系。基于序数标签的这些特性,我们提出了OLDL的学习目标和评估指标,即CAD、QFD和CJS。在四个任务上的综合实验表明,OLDL在传统和新提出的指标上均优于其他现有LDL方法。我们的项目页面可在https://downdric23.github.io/找到。
abstract_en: Label distribution learning (LDL) is a recent hot topic, in which ambiguity is modeled via description degrees of the labels. However, in common LDL tasks, e.g., age estimation, labels are in an intrinsic order. The conventional LDL paradigm adopts a per-label manner for optimization, neglecting the internal sequential patterns of labels. Therefore, we propose a new paradigm, termed ordinal label distribution learning (OLDL). We model the sequential patterns of labels from aspects of spatial, semantic, and temporal order relationships. The spatial order depicts the relative position between arbitrary labels. We build cross-label transformation between distributions, which is determined by the spatial margin in labels. Labels naturally yield different semantics, so the semantic order is represented by constructing semantic correlations between arbitrary labels. The temporal order describes that the presence of labels is determined by their order, i.e. five after four. The value of a particular label contains information about previous labels, and we adopt cumulative distribution to construct this relationship. Based on these characteristics of ordinal labels, we propose the learning objectives and evaluation metrics for OLDL, namely CAD, QFD, and CJS. Comprehensive experiments conducted on four tasks demonstrate the superiority of OLDL against other existing LDL methods in both traditional and newly proposed metrics. Our project page can be found at https://downdric23.github.io/.
authors: Changsong Wen, Xin Zhang, Xingxu Yao, Jufeng Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23481-23491

title: OrthoPlanes: 一种提升GANs三维感知能力的新表示方法
title_en: OrthoPlanes: A Novel Representation for Better 3D-Awareness of GANs
abstract: 我们提出了一种新方法,从2D图像集合中生成具有精细几何结构且视角一致的逼真图像。我们的方法提出了一种混合显式-隐式表示方法OrthoPlanes,该方法通过修改2D StyleGANs高效生成的特征图编码细粒度3D信息。与之前表示方法相比,我们的方法在可扩展性和表达能力方面具有明显优势,信息清晰且明确。因此,我们的方法能够处理更具挑战性的视角角度,并合成具有高空间自由度的可运动物体。实验结果表明,我们的方法在FFHQ和SHHQ数据集上均实现了定量和定性上的最先进水平结果。
abstract_en: We present a new method for generating realistic and view-consistent images with fine geometry from 2D image collections. Our method proposes a hybrid explicit-implicit representation called OrthoPlanes, which encodes fine-grained 3D information in feature maps that can be efficiently generated by modifying 2D StyleGANs. Compared to previous representations, our method has better scalability and expressiveness with clear and explicit information. As a result, our method can handle more challenging view-angles and synthesize articulated objects with high spatial degree of freedom. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art results on FFHQ and SHHQ datasets, both quantitatively and qualitatively.
authors: Honglin He, Zhuoqian Yang, Shikai Li, Bo Dai, Wayne Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22996-23007

title: 单目深度估计的分布外检测
title_en: Out-of-Distribution Detection for Monocular Depth Estimation
abstract: 在单目深度估计中,不确定性估计方法主要针对由图像噪声引入的数据不确定性。与以往工作不同,我们处理由于知识不足导致的不确定性,这与检测未被训练分布表示的数据(即所谓的分布外数据)相关。受异常检测启发,我们提出基于重建误差从编码器-解码器深度估计模型中检测分布外图像。给定通过固定深度编码器提取的特征,我们仅使用分布内数据训练图像解码器进行图像重建。因此,分布外图像会导致较高的重建误差,我们利用该误差来区分分布内与分布外样本。我们的实验基于标准的NYU Depth V2和KITTI基准作为分布内数据。我们的事后方法在不同模型上表现优异,且在不修改训练好的编码器-解码器深度估计模型的情况下优于现有不确定性估计方法。
abstract_en: In monocular depth estimation, uncertainty estimation approaches mainly target the data uncertainty introduced by image noise. In contrast to prior work, we address the uncertainty due to lack of knowledge, which is relevant for the detection of data not represented by the training distribution, the so-called out-of-distribution (OOD) data. Motivated by anomaly detection, we propose to detect OOD images from an encoder-decoder depth estimation model based on the reconstruction error. Given the features extracted with the fixed depth encoder, we train an image decoder for image reconstruction using only in-distribution data. Consequently, OOD images result in a high reconstruction error, which we use to distinguish between in- and out-of-distribution samples. We built our experiments on the standard NYU Depth V2 and KITTI benchmarks as in-distribution data. Our post hoc method performs astonishingly well on different models and outperforms existing uncertainty estimation approaches without modifying the trained encoder-decoder depth estimation model.
authors: Julia Hornauer, Adrian Holzbock, Vasileios Belagiannis ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1911-1921

title: 基于可逆性分解的跨域GAN反演用于逼真人脸操控
title_en: Out-of-Domain GAN Inversion via Invertibility Decomposition for Photo-Realistic Human Face Manipulation
abstract: 生成对抗网络(GAN)反演的保真度受图像中跨域(Out-Of-Domain, OOD)区域(如背景、配饰)的影响。检测超出预训练模型生成能力的OOD区域,并将这些区域与输入图像进行融合可提升保真度。"可逆性掩码"能够识别这些OOD区域,现有方法通过重建误差预测掩码。然而,由于域内(In-Domain, ID)区域的重建误差影响,估计的掩码通常不准确。本文提出了一种新框架,通过设计新型模块,利用可逆性掩码将输入图像分解为ID和OOD分区,以提升人脸反演的保真度。与先前方法不同,我们的可逆性检测器与空间对齐模块同时学习。我们迭代地将生成特征对齐到输入几何结构,并减少ID区域的重建误差。因此,OOD区域更易区分且可精确预测。随后,我们通过将输入图像中的OOD区域与ID GAN反演结果进行融合,提升结果的保真度。我们的方法实现了真实世界人脸图像的逼真反演与操控。大量实验验证了我们的方法在GAN反演质量与属性操控方面优于现有方法。
abstract_en:
The fidelity of Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) inversion is impeded by Out-Of-Domain (OOD) areas (e.g., background, accessories) in the image.
 Detecting the OOD areas beyond the generation ability of the pre-trained model and blending these regions with the input image can enhance fidelity. The "invertibility mask" figures out these OOD areas, and existing methods predict the mask with the reconstruction error. However, the estimated mask is usually inaccurate due to the influence of the reconstruction error in the In-Domain (ID) area. In this paper, we propose a novel framework that enhances the fidelity of human face inversion by designing a new module to decompose the input images to ID and OOD partitions with invertibility masks. Unlike previous works, our invertibility detector is simultaneously learned with a spatial alignment module. We iteratively align the generated features to the input geometry and reduce the reconstruction error in the ID regions. Thus, the OOD areas are more distinguishable and can be precisely predicted. Then, we improve the fidelity of our results by blending the OOD areas from the input image with the ID GAN inversion results.
 Our method produces photo-realistic results for real-world human face image inversion and manipulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate our method's superiority over existing methods in the quality of GAN inversion and attribute manipulation.
authors: Xin Yang, Xiaogang XU, Yingcong Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7492-7501

title: 量化感知训练中的灾难性遗忘克服
title_en: Overcoming Forgetting Catastrophe in Quantization-Aware Training
abstract: 量化是通过将网络压缩到较低位数来降低内存成本的有效方法。然而,现有量化过程仅从当前数据学习,容易在流数据上出现灾难性遗忘,即在新任务训练后,旧任务数据性能显著下降。因此,我们提出了一种终身量化过程LifeQuant来解决该问题。我们从数据任务变化导致的量化搜索空间偏移角度理论分析了灾难性遗忘。为克服该问题,我们首先最小化量化过程中的空间偏移,提出邻近量化空间搜索(ProxQ),通过正则化量化搜索空间使其接近预定义标准空间。随后,我们利用回放数据(旧任务数据的子集)在新任务中进行重新训练以缓解遗忘问题。然而,有限的回放数据通常导致量化性能偏向新任务。为解决该不平衡问题,我们设计了平衡终身学习(BaLL)损失函数,通过利用类别分布重新加权(增强)回放数据在新任务学习中的影响。实验结果表明,LifeQuant在低遗忘率下实现了出色的准确率性能。
abstract_en: Quantization is an effective approach for memory cost reduction by compressing networks to lower bits. However, existing quantization processes learned only from the current data tend to suffer from forgetting catastrophe on streaming data, i.e., significant performance decrement on old task data after being trained on new tasks. Therefore, we propose a lifelong quantization process, LifeQuant, to address the problem. We theoretically analyze the forgetting catastrophe from the shift of quantization search space with the change of data tasks. To overcome the forgetting catastrophe, we first minimize the space shift during quantization and propose Proximal Quantization Space Search (ProxQ), for regularizing the search space during quantization to be close to a pre-defined standard space. Afterward, we exploit replay data (a subset of old task data) for retraining in new tasks to alleviate the forgetting problem. However, the limited amount of replay data usually leads to biased quantization performance toward the new tasks. To address the imbalance issue, we design a Balanced Lifelong Learning (BaLL) Loss to reweight (to increase) the influence of replay data in new task learning, by leveraging the class distributions. Experimental results show that LifeQuant achieves outstanding accuracy performance with a low forgetting rate.
authors: Ting-An Chen, De-Nian Yang, Ming-Syan Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17358-17367

title: 通过微调数据覆盖预训练偏差
title_en: Overwriting Pretrained Bias with Finetuning Data
abstract: 迁移学习通过允许在大规模数据集上预训练的模型的表达性特征被微调以适应目标任务,对小而领域特定的数据集具有优势。然而,存在担忧这些预训练模型可能自带偏差,这些偏差会传播至微调模型中。在本工作中,我们从两个角度研究偏差:其一是目标任务与敏感属性之间的虚假相关性,其二是数据集中特定群体的代表性不足。在两种偏差定义下,我们发现:(1) 基于预训练模型微调的模型确实会继承其偏差,但(2) 通过相对轻微的微调数据集干预即可纠正该偏差,且通常对性能影响可忽略。我们的发现表明,对微调数据集的精心策划对于减少下游任务的偏差至关重要,这种做法甚至可以弥补预训练模型中的偏差。
abstract_en: Transfer learning is beneficial by allowing the expressive features of models pretrained on large-scale datasets to be finetuned for the target task of smaller, more domain-specific datasets. However, there is a concern that these pretrained models may come with their own biases which would propagate into the finetuned model. In this work, we investigate bias when conceptualized as both spurious correlations between the target task and a sensitive attribute as well as underrepresentation of a particular group in the dataset. Under both notions of bias, we find that (1) models finetuned on top of pretrained models can indeed inherit their biases, but (2) this bias can be corrected for through relatively minor interventions to the finetuning dataset, and often with a negligible impact to performance. Our findings imply that careful curation of the finetuning dataset is important for reducing biases on a downstream task, and doing so can even compensate for bias in the pretrained model.
authors: Angelina Wang, Olga Russakovsky ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3957-3968

title: OxfordTVG-HIC:机器能否从图像中生成幽默的描述?
title_en: OxfordTVG-HIC: Can Machine Make Humorous Captions from Images?
abstract: 本文提出了OxfordTVG-HIC(幽默图像描述),一个用于幽默生成与理解的大规模数据集。幽默是一种抽象、主观且依赖于上下文的认知结构,涉及多种认知因素,使得生成与解读幽默成为一项具有挑战性的任务。因此,幽默生成与理解可作为评估深度学习方法处理抽象与主观信息能力的新任务。由于相关数据稀缺,如图像描述等与幽默相关的生成任务仍研究不足。为解决这一问题,OxfordTVG-HIC提供了约290万张包含幽默评分的图像-文本对,以训练可推广的幽默描述模型。与现有描述数据集不同,OxfordTVG-HIC具有广泛的情感与语义多样性,产生了大量脱离上下文的示例,特别有利于生成幽默。此外,OxfordTVG-HIC在编纂过程中剔除了具有冒犯性内容。我们还展示了如何利用OxfordTVG-HIC评估生成文本的幽默性。通过训练模型的可解释性分析,我们识别了激发幽默预测(及生成)的视觉与语言线索。我们观察到这些线索与认知心理学中幽默的良性违反理论相一致。
abstract_en: This paper presents OxfordTVG-HIC (Humorous Image Captions), a large-scale dataset for humour generation and understanding. Humour is an abstract, subjective, and context-dependent cognitive construct involving several cognitive factors, making it a challenging task to generate and interpret. Hence, humour generation and understanding can serve as a new task for evaluating the ability of deep-learning methods to process abstract and subjective information. Due to the scarcity of data, humour-related generation tasks such as captioning remain underexplored. To address this gap, OxfordTVG-HIC offers approximately 2.9M image-text pairs with humour scores to train a generalizable humour captioning model. Contrary to existing captioning datasets, OxfordTVG-HIC features a wide range of emotional and semantic diversity resulting in out-of-context examples that are particularly conducive to generating humour. Moreover, OxfordTVG-HIC is curated devoid of offensive content. We also show how OxfordTVGHIC can be leveraged for evaluating the humour of a generated text. Through explainability analysis of the trained models, we identify the visual and linguistic cues influential for evoking humour prediction (and generation). We observe qualitatively that these cues are aligned with the benign violation theory of humour in cognitive psychology.
authors: Runjia Li, Shuyang Sun, Mohamed Elhoseiny, Philip Torr ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20293-20303

title: P1AC:基于单个仿射对应的绝对位姿重新审视
title_en: P1AC: Revisiting Absolute Pose From a Single Affine Correspondence
abstract: 仿射对应传统上被用于改善宽基线下的特征匹配。尽管近期研究已成功利用仿射对应解决多种相对相机位姿估计问题,但对其在绝对位姿估计中的应用却关注较少。我们提出了首个通用解决方案,用于在给定一个方向点观测和一个仿射对应的情况下估计校准相机的位姿。我们的方法(P1AC)的优势在于仅需单个对应关系,相较于传统基于点的方法(P3P),显著减少了鲁棒估计中的组合复杂度。P1AC提供了一种通用解决方案,消除了先前工作的限制性假设,并适用于大规模基于图像的定位。我们提出了P1AC问题的最小解,并在合成数据上评估了我们的新型求解器,展示了其数值稳定性和在各种噪声类型下的性能。在标准基于图像的定位基准测试中,我们证明P1AC比广泛使用的P3P算法实现了更精确的结果。我们的方法代码可在https://github.com/jonathanventura/P1AC/获取。
abstract_en: Affine correspondences have traditionally been used to improve feature matching over wide baselines. While recent work has successfully used affine correspondences to solve various relative camera pose estimation problems, less attention has been given to their use in absolute pose estimation. We introduce the first general solution to the problem of estimating the pose of a calibrated camera given a single observation of an oriented point and an affine correspondence. The advantage of our approach (P1AC) is that it requires only a single correspondence, in comparison to the traditional point-based approach (P3P), significantly reducing the combinatorics in robust estimation. P1AC provides a general solution that removes restrictive assumptions made in prior work and is applicable to large-scale image-based localization. We propose a minimal solution to the P1AC problem and evaluate our novel solver on synthetic data, showing its numerical stability and performance under various types of noise. On standard image-based localization benchmarks we show that P1AC achieves more accurate results than the widely used P3P algorithm. Code for our method is available at https://github.com/jonathanventura/P1AC/.
authors: Jonathan Ventura, Zuzana Kukelova, Torsten Sattler, Dániel Baráth ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19751-19761

title: P2C:基于单个不完整点云的自监督点云补全
title_en: P2C: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Completion from Single Partial Clouds
abstract: 点云补全旨在基于不完整的观测数据恢复完整的形状。现有方法需要完整点云或多视角数据进行学习。与之前的方法不同,我们提出了Partial2Complete(P2C),这是首个使用仅包含单个不完整点云的训练样本完成点云对象的自监督框架。具体而言,我们的框架将不完整的点云分组为局部块作为输入,并通过从不同不完整对象中学习先验信息来预测被遮挡的块。我们还提出了区域感知的Chamfer距离以规范形状不匹配问题,同时不限制补全能力,并设计了法向一致性约束以结合局部平面性假设,鼓励恢复的形状表面连续且完整。通过这种方式,P2C不再需要多个观测数据或完整点云作为真实标签。相反,从类别特定数据集中学习结构线索以补全对象的不完整点云。我们在合成ShapeNet数据和真实世界ScanNet数据上验证了我们的方法有效性,结果表明P2C产生的效果与使用完整形状训练的方法相当,并且优于使用多视角不完整观测学习的方法。代码可在https://github.com/CuiRuikai/Partial2Complete获取。
abstract_en: Point cloud completion aims to recover the complete shape based on a partial observation. Existing methods require either complete point clouds or multiple partial observations of the same object for learning. In contrast to previous approaches, we present Partial2Complete (P2C), the first self-supervised framework that completes point cloud objects using training samples consisting of only a single incomplete point cloud per object. Specifically, our framework groups incomplete point clouds into local patches as input and predicts masked patches by learning prior information from different partial objects. We also propose Region-Aware Chamfer Distance to regularize shape mismatch without limiting completion capability, and devise the Normal Consistency Constraint to incorporate a local planarity assumption, encouraging the recovered shape surface to be continuous and complete. In this way, P2C no longer needs multiple observations or complete point clouds as ground truth. Instead, structural cues are learned from a category-specific dataset to complete partial point clouds of objects. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on both synthetic ShapeNet data and real-world ScanNet data, showing that P2C produces comparable results to methods trained with complete shapes, and outperforms methods learned with multiple partial observations. Code is available at https://github.com/CuiRuikai/Partial2Complete.
authors: Ruikai Cui, Shi Qiu, Saeed Anwar, Jiawei Liu, Chaoyue Xing, Jing Zhang, Nick Barnes ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14351-14360

title: PADCLIP:基于CLIP的自适应去偏伪标签方法用于无监督域适应
title_en: PADCLIP: Pseudo-labeling with Adaptive Debiasing in CLIP for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
abstract: 传统无监督域适应(UDA)借助带标签的源域来解决无标签目标域上的学习任务。当源域与目标域之间存在显著域差距时,这一过程更具挑战性。更实际的设置是利用大规模预训练模型来填补域差距。例如,CLIP展示了显著的零样本泛化能力以弥合这一差距。然而,传统微调方法在专门调整CLIP以适配目标域后,会引发灾难性遗忘问题,即新域知识可能迅速覆盖CLIP的预训练知识,导致准确率下降一半。我们提出灾难性遗忘度量(Catastrophic Forgetting Measurement, CFM)以调整学习率,避免过度训练(从而缓解灾难性遗忘问题)。随后,我们通过结合动量与CFM对因果推断进行调整,利用CLIP的零样本预测构建基于CLIP的自适应去偏伪标签方法(PADCLIP)。我们的PADCLIP可在源域和目标域上实现端到端训练,且无需额外开销,在四个公开数据集上取得最佳结果,DomainNet数据集的准确率提升了18.5%。
abstract_en: Traditional Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) leverages the labeled source domain to tackle the learning tasks on the unlabeled target domain. It can be more challenging when a large domain gap exists between the source and the target domain. A more practical setting is to utilize a large-scale pre-trained model to fill the domain gap. For example, CLIP shows promising zero-shot generalizability to bridge the gap. However, after applying traditional fine-tuning to specifically adjust CLIP on a target domain, CLIP suffers from catastrophic forgetting issues where the new domain knowledge can quickly override CLIP's pre-trained knowledge and decreases the accuracy by half. We propose Catastrophic Forgetting Measurement (CFM) to adjust the learning rate to avoid excessive training (thus mitigating the catastrophic forgetting issue). We then utilize CLIP's zero-shot prediction to formulate a Pseudo-labeling setting with Adaptive Debiasing in CLIP (PADCLIP) by adjusting causal inference with our momentum and CFM. Our PADCLIP allows end-to-end training on source and target domains without extra overhead, and we achieved the best results on four public datasets, with a significant improvement (+18.5% accuracy) on DomainNet.
authors: Zhengfeng Lai, Noranart Vesdapunt, Ning Zhou, Jun Wu, Cong Phuoc Huynh, Xuelu Li, Kah Kuen Fu, Chen-Nee Chuah ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16155-16165

title: PADDLES:面向噪声标签学习的相位-振幅谱解耦早停策略
title_en: PADDLES: Phase-Amplitude Spectrum Disentangled Early Stopping for Learning with Noisy Labels
abstract: 卷积神经网络(CNNs)在学习不同视觉任务的模式方面表现出强大能力,但其对标签噪声敏感,在训练过程中可能对噪声标签过拟合。早停策略通过在训练初期阶段暂停更新CNNs,被广泛应用于存在噪声标签的场景。受生物发现启发,即频域中振幅谱(AS)和相位谱(PS)在动物视觉系统中扮演不同角色,我们观察到能够捕捉更多语义信息的相位谱(PS)相较于振幅谱(AS)能更有效增强CNNs对标签噪声的鲁棒性。因此,我们提出在训练过程中通过离散傅里叶变换(DFT)将某些层的特征解耦为AS和PS,并为AS和PS分别设置不同的早停时间点。实验表明,我们提出的相位-振幅谱解耦早停(PADDLES)方法在合成和真实世界标签噪声数据集上均表现出色。PADDLES优于其他早停方法,取得了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are powerful in learning patterns of different vision tasks, but they are sensitive to label noise and may overfit to noisy labels during training. The early stopping strategy averts updating CNNs during the early training phase and is widely employed in the presence of noisy labels. Motivated by biological findings that the amplitude spectrum (AS) and phase spectrum (PS) in the frequency domain play different roles in the animal's vision system, we observe that PS, which captures more semantic information, can increase the robustness of CNNs to label noise, more so than AS can. We thus propose early stops at different times for AS and PS by disentangling the features of some layer(s) into AS and PS using Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) during training. Our proposed Phase-AmplituDe DisentangLed Early Stopping (PADDLES) method is shown to be effective on both synthetic and real-world label-noise datasets. PADDLES outperforms other early stopping methods and obtains state-of-the-art performance.
authors: Huaxi Huang, Hui Kang, Sheng Liu, Olivier Salvado, Thierry Rakotoarivelo, Dadong Wang, Tongliang Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16719-16730

title: PARF: 基于基本体感知的辐射融合用于室内场景新视角合成
title_en: PARF: Primitive-Aware Radiance Fusion for Indoor Scene Novel View Synthesis
abstract: 本文提出了一种方法,用于快速场景辐射场重建,具有强大的新视角合成性能和便捷的场景编辑功能。其核心思想是充分利用语义分割和基本体提取,对辐射场重建过程进行约束和加速。为实现该目标,我们提出了一种基于基本体感知的混合渲染策略,以兼顾体素渲染和基本体渲染的优势。我们进一步贡献了一个重建流程,对每个输入帧进行基本体解析和辐射场学习的迭代处理,成功将语义、基本体和辐射信息融合到单一框架中。大量评估实验验证了本方法在快速重建能力、高质量渲染效果和便捷编辑功能方面的优势。
abstract_en: This paper proposes a method for fast scene radiance field reconstruction with strong novel view synthesis performance and convenient scene editing functionality. The key idea is to fully utilize semantic parsing and primitive extraction for constraining and accelerating the radiance field reconstruction process. To fulfill this goal, a primitive-aware hybrid rendering strategy was proposed to enjoy the best of both volumetric and primitive rendering. We further contribute a reconstruction pipeline conducts primitive parsing and radiance field learning iteratively for each input frame which successfully fuses semantic, primitive, and radiance information into a single framework. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the fast reconstruction ability, high rendering quality, and convenient editing functionality of our method.
authors: Haiyang Ying, Baowei Jiang, Jinzhi Zhang, Di Xu, Tao Yu, Qionghai Dai, Lu Fang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17706-17716

title: PARIS: 可变形物体的部件级重建与运动分析
title_en: PARIS: Part-level Reconstruction and Motion Analysis for Articulated Objects
abstract: 我们针对可变形物体的部件级重建与运动参数估计任务进行研究。给定一个物体在两种静态关节状态下的多视角图像集合,我们分离可动部件与静态部件,同时重建形状与外观并预测运动参数。为解决该问题,我们提出PARIS:一种自监督、端到端架构,无需任何3D监督、运动或语义标注,即可联合学习部件级隐式形状与外观模型并优化运动参数。实验表明,我们的方法在跨物体类别泛化能力上优于现有方法,且在输入为3D点云的基线方法和先前工作中表现更优。与现有最先进基线方法相比,我们的方法在物体重建中将Chamfer-L1距离减少3.94(45.2%),在部件重建中减少26.79(84.5%),并在10个物体类别上实现了5%的运动估计误差率。
abstract_en: We address the task of simultaneous part-level reconstruction and motion parameter estimation for articulated objects. Given two sets of multi-view images of an object in two static articulation states, we decouple the movable part from the static part and reconstruct shape and appearance while predicting the motion parameters. To tackle this problem, we present PARIS: a self-supervised, end-to-end architecture that learns part-level implicit shape and appearance models and optimizes motion parameters jointly without any 3D supervision, motion, or semantic annotation. Our experiments show that our method generalizes better across object categories, and outperforms baselines and prior work that are given 3D point clouds as input. Our approach improves reconstruction relative to state-of-the-art baselines with a Chamfer-L1 distance reduction of 3.94 (45.2%) for objects and 26.79 (84.5%) for parts, and achieves 5% error rate for motion estimation across 10 object categories.
authors: Jiayi Liu, Ali Mahdavi-Amiri, Manolis Savva ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 352-363

title: PARTNER:提升激光雷达三维目标检测中的极坐标表示
title_en: PARTNER: Level up the Polar Representation for LiDAR 3D Object Detection
abstract: 近年来,基于极坐标的表示方法在感知任务中展现出 promising 的特性。除了将点云不均匀分割的基于笛卡尔坐标的方案,将点云表示为极坐标网格已被认为是替代方法,因其(1)在不同分辨率下具有鲁棒性能的优势,以及(2)在流式处理方法中的优越性。然而,最先进的基于极坐标检测方法不可避免地受到极坐标表示非均匀划分导致的特征失真问题的影响,从而与基于笛卡尔坐标的方案相比产生不可忽视的性能差距。为解决这一问题,我们提出 PARTNER,一种基于极坐标的新型三维目标检测器。PARTNER 通过全局表示重新对齐缓解特征失真问题,并通过将实例级几何信息引入检测头以促进回归。大量实验表明其在流式检测和不同分辨率下具有显著优势。此外,我们的方法在 Waymo 和 ONCE 验证集上分别超越先前极坐标方法 3.68% 和 9.15%,从而在与最先进方法相比具有竞争力的结果。
abstract_en: Recently, polar-based representation has shown promising properties in perceptual tasks. In addition to Cartesian-based approaches, which separate point clouds unevenly, representing point clouds as polar grids has been recognized as an alternative due to (1) its advantage in robust performance under different resolutions and (2) its superiority in streaming-based approaches. However, state-of-the-art polar-based detection methods inevitably suffer from the feature distortion problem because of the non-uniform division of polar representation, resulting in a non-negligible performance gap compared to Cartesian-based approaches. To tackle this issue, we present PARTNER, a novel 3D object detector in the polar coordinate. PARTNER alleviates the dilemma of feature distortion with global representation re-alignment and facilitates the regression by introducing instance-level geometric information into the detection head. Extensive experiments show overwhelming advantages in streaming-based detection and different resolutions. Furthermore, our method outperforms the previous polar-based works with remarkable margins of 3.68% and 9.15% on Waymo and ONCE validation set, thus achieving competitive results over the state-of-the-art methods.
authors: Ming Nie, Yujing Xue, Chunwei Wang, Chaoqiang Ye, Hang Xu, Xinge Zhu, Qingqiu Huang, Michael Bi Mi, Xinchao Wang, Li Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3801-3813

title: PASTA:用于合成到真实域泛化的比例幅值谱训练增强
title_en: PASTA: Proportional Amplitude Spectrum Training Augmentation for Syn-to-Real Domain Generalization
abstract: 合成数据为在标注真实数据稀缺的场景下提供了低成本且丰富的训练数据。然而,当在真实数据上评估时,基于合成数据训练的模型表现显著不足。本文提出了一种简单有效的增强策略——比例幅值谱训练增强(PASTA),以提升开箱即用的合成到真实(syn-to-real)泛化性能。PASTA通过在傅里叶域对合成图像的幅值谱进行扰动生成增强视图。具体而言,我们提出了一种结构化扰动策略,其中高频成分的扰动程度高于低频成分。在语义分割(GTAV-Real)、目标检测(Sim10K-Real)和目标识别(VisDA-C Syn-Real)任务中,针对总共5种syn-to-real转换,我们发现PASTA在性能上超越了更复杂的最新泛化方法,同时与相同方法具有互补性。
abstract_en: Synthetic data offers the promise of cheap and bountiful training data for settings where labeled real-world data is scarce. However, models trained on synthetic data significantly underperform when evaluated on real-world data. In this paper, we propose Proportional Amplitude Spectrum Training Augmentation (PASTA), a simple and effective augmentation strategy to improve out-of-the-box synthetic-to-real (syn-to-real) generalization performance. PASTA perturbs the amplitude spectra of synthetic images in the Fourier domain to generate augmented views. Specifically, with PASTA we propose a structured perturbation strategy where high-frequency components are perturbed relatively more than the low-frequency ones. For the tasks of semantic segmentation (GTAV-Real), object detection (Sim10K-Real), and object recognition (VisDA-C Syn-Real), across a total of 5 syn-to-real shifts, we find that PASTA outperforms more complex state-of-the-art generalization methods while being complementary to the same.
authors: Prithvijit Chattopadhyay, Kartik Sarangmath, Vivek Vijaykumar, Judy Hoffman ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19288-19300

title: PATMAT:面向人物的掩码感知Transformer在人脸补全中的应用
title_en: PATMAT: Person Aware Tuning of Mask-Aware Transformer for Face Inpainting
abstract: StyleGAN2和Stable Diffusion等生成模型在图像合成、补全和去噪等计算机视觉任务中取得了最先进性能。然而,当前用于人脸补全的生成模型尽管能生成具有视觉吸引力的图像结构和纹理,却常常难以保持精细面部细节和人物身份。本文提出了一种面向人物的掩码感知Transformer(PAT)方法用于人脸补全,以解决这一问题。我们提出的PATMAT方法通过结合被摄对象的参考图像并微调在人脸数据集上训练的掩码感知Transformer架构,有效保持了人物身份。通过使用40张参考图像,PATMAT在MAT的风格模块中创建锚点,并利用固定锚点调整模型以适配新的人脸身份。此外,PATMAT在训练过程中每个锚点使用多张图像,使得模型能够以比竞争方法更少的参考图像实现效果。实验表明,PATMAT在图像质量、人物特定细节保持和身份保持方面均优于现有最先进模型。我们的结果表明,PATMAT可作为提升个性化人脸补全质量的有前景方法。
abstract_en: Generative models such as StyleGAN2 and Stable Diffusion have achieved state-of-the-art performance in computer vision tasks such as image synthesis, inpainting, and de-noising. However, current generative models for face inpainting often fail to preserve fine facial details and the identity of the person, despite creating aesthetically convincing image structures and textures. In this work, we propose Person Aware Tuning (PAT) of Mask-Aware Transformer (MAT) for face inpainting, which addresses this issue. Our proposed method, PATMAT, effectively preserves identity by incorporating reference images of a subject and fine-tuning a MAT architecture trained on faces. By using  40 reference images, PATMAT creates anchor points in MAT's style module, and tunes the model using the fixed anchors to adapt the model to a new face identity. Moreover, PATMAT's use of multiple images per anchor during training allows the model to use fewer reference images than competing methods. We demonstrate that PATMAT outperforms state-of-the-art models in terms of image quality, the preservation of person-specific details, and the identity of the subject. Our results suggest that PATMAT can be a promising approach for improving the quality of personalized face inpainting.
authors: Saman Motamed, Jianjin Xu, Chen Henry Wu, Christian Häne, Jean-Charles Bazin, Fernando De la Torre ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22778-22787

title: PC-Adapter: 拓扑感知的点云领域自适应校正伪标签适配器
title_en: PC-Adapter: Topology-Aware Adapter for Efficient Domain Adaption on Point Clouds with Rectified Pseudo-label
abstract: 由于物体尺度、传感器角度和自遮挡导致的数据分布变化,理解来自现实世界的点云数据具有挑战性。先前研究通过结合自监督学习、自训练和对抗训练等最新学习原则来解决这一问题,但导致显著的计算开销。为实现简洁而强大的点云领域自适应,我们重新审视领域迁移场景下点云数据的独特挑战,发现源数据的全局几何结构和目标伪标签相对于源标签分布的趋势至关重要。受此启发,我们提出一种适配器引导的领域自适应方法PC-Adapter,通过基于注意力机制的适配器保留源域的全局形状信息,同时利用配备图卷积的另一适配器学习目标域的局部特征。此外,我们提出一种新颖的伪标签策略,通过调整类别级置信度分布来调整置信度分数,以缓解分类器偏差的影响。我们的方法在基准数据集PointDA、GraspNetPC和PointSegDA的多种领域迁移设置中均优于基线方法。
abstract_en: Understanding point clouds captured from the real-world is challenging due to shifts in data distribution caused by varying object scales, sensor angles, and self-occlusion. Prior works have addressed this issue by combining recent learning principles such as self-supervised learning, self-training and adversarial training, which leads to to significant computational overhead. Toward succinct yet powerful domain adaptation for point clouds, we revisit the unique challenges of point cloud data under domain shift scenarios and discover the importance of the global geometry of source data and trends of target pseudo-labels biased to the source label distribution. Motivated by our observations, we propose an adapter-guided domain adaptation method, PC-Adapter, that preserves the global shape information of the source domain using an attention-based adapter, while learning the local characteristics of the target domain via another adapter equipped with graph convolution. Additionally, we propose a novel pseudo-labeling strategy resilient to the classifier bias by adjusting confidence scores using their class-wise confidence distributions to consider relative confidences. Our method demonstrates superiority over baselines on various domain shift settings in benchmark datasets - PointDA, GraspNetPC, and PointSegDA.
authors: Joonhyung Park, Hyunjin Seo, Eunho Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11530-11540

title: PDiscoNet:面向细粒度识别的语义一致部件发现
title_en: PDiscoNet: Semantically consistent part discovery for fine-grained recognition
abstract: 细粒度分类通常需要识别特定物体部件,例如鸟类的喙形状和翅膀图案。鼓励细粒度分类模型首先检测这些部件,然后利用它们来推断类别,这有助于我们更好地判断模型是否确实关注了正确的细节,而不仅仅是依赖提供单一归因图的可解释性方法。我们提出PDiscoNet,仅通过图像级类别标签和鼓励部件具备以下特性的先验知识来发现物体部件:具有判别性、紧凑、彼此不同、对刚性变换等变,并且在至少部分图像中活跃。除了使用适当的损失函数来编码这些先验知识外,我们还提出使用部件丢弃(part-dropout),即一次性丢弃完整的部件特征向量以防止单个部件在分类中占据主导地位,以及部件特征向量调制(part feature vector modulation),使来自每个部件的信息从分类器的角度来看是不同的。我们在CUB、CelebA和PartImageNet上的实验结果表明,所提出的方法在无需任何额外超参数调优且不损害分类性能的前提下,显著优于以往的方法。
abstract_en:
Fine-grained classification often requires recognizing specific object parts, such as beak shape and wing patterns for birds. Encouraging a fine-grained classification model to first detect such parts and then using them to infer the class could help us gauge whether the model is indeed looking at the right details better than with interpretability methods that provide a single attribution map.
 We propose PDiscoNet to discover object parts by using only image-level class labels along with priors encouraging the parts to be: discriminative, compact, distinct from each other, equivariant to rigid transforms, and active in at least some of the images. In addition to using the appropriate losses to encode these priors, we propose to use part-dropout, where full part feature vectors are dropped at once to prevent a single part from dominating in the classification, and part feature vector modulation, which makes the information coming from each part distinct from the perspective of the classifier.
 Our results on CUB, CelebA, and PartImageNet show that the proposed method provides substantially better part discovery performance than previous methods while not requiring any additional hyper-parameter tuning and without penalizing the classification performance.
authors: Robert van der Klis, Stephan Alaniz, Massimiliano Mancini, Cassio F. Dantas, Dino Ienco, Zeynep Akata, Diego Marcos ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1866-1876

title: PEANUT:预测与导航至未观察到的目标
title_en: PEANUT: Predicting and Navigating to Unseen Targets
abstract: 在新颖环境中实现高效的ObjectGoal导航(ObjectNav)需要理解环境布局中的空间和语义规律。本文提出了一种直接从不完整的语义地图预测未观察对象位置的简单方法,以学习这些规律。与前沿潜力预测或以自我为中心的地图补全等基于预测的导航方法不同,我们的方法通过利用所有先前探索区域的全局上下文,直接预测未观察到的目标。我们的预测模型轻量且可通过相对少量的被动收集数据以监督方式训练。训练完成后,该模型可集成到ObjectNav的模块化流程中,无需任何强化学习。我们在HM3D和MP3D ObjectNav数据集上验证了方法的有效性。尽管未使用任何额外训练数据,我们的方法在两个数据集上均达到了最先进水平。
abstract_en: Efficient ObjectGoal navigation (ObjectNav) in novel environments requires an understanding of the spatial and semantic regularities in environment layouts. In this work, we present a straightforward method for learning these regularities by predicting the locations of unobserved objects from incomplete semantic maps. Our method differs from previous prediction-based navigation methods, such as frontier potential prediction or egocentric map completion, by directly predicting unseen targets while leveraging the global context from all previously explored areas. Our prediction model is lightweight and can be trained in a supervised manner using a relatively small amount of passively collected data. Once trained, the model can be incorporated into a modular pipeline for ObjectNav without the need for any reinforcement learning. We validate the effectiveness of our method on the HM3D and MP3D ObjectNav datasets. We find that it achieves the state-of-the-art on both datasets, despite not using any additional data for training.
authors: Albert J. Zhai, Shenlong Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10926-10935

title: PETRv2:一种多摄像头图像的三维感知统一框架
title_en: PETRv2: A Unified Framework for 3D Perception from Multi-Camera Images
abstract: 本文提出PETRv2,一种用于多视角图像三维感知的统一框架。基于PETR,PETRv2探索了时序建模的有效性,利用前一帧的时间信息提升三维目标检测性能。更具体地说,我们扩展了PETR中的三维位置嵌入(3D PE)以进行时序建模。3D PE实现了不同帧间目标位置的时间对齐。为支持多任务学习(例如,鸟瞰图分割和三维车道检测),PETRv2通过引入任务特定的查询(在不同空间中初始化)提供了一种简单而有效的解决方案。PETRv2在三维目标检测、鸟瞰图分割和三维车道检测任务中均达到最先进的性能。同时,对PETR框架进行了详细的鲁棒性分析。代码可在https://github.com/megvii-research/PETR获取。
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose PETRv2, a unified framework for 3D perception from multi-view images. Based on PETR, PETRv2 explores the effectiveness of temporal modeling, which utilizes the temporal information of previous frames to boost 3D object detection. More specifically, we extend the 3D position embedding (3D PE) in PETR for temporal modeling. The 3D PE achieves the temporal alignment on object position of different frames. To support for multi-task learning (e.g., BEV segmentation and 3D lane detection), PETRv2 provides a simple yet effective solution by introducing task-specific queries, which are initialized under different spaces. PETRv2 achieves state-of-the-art performance on 3D object detection, BEV segmentation and 3D lane detection. Detailed robustness analysis is also conducted on PETR framework. Code is available at https://github.com/megvii-research/PETR.
authors: Yingfei Liu, Junjie Yan, Fan Jia, Shuailin Li, Aqi Gao, Tiancai Wang, Xiangyu Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3262-3272

title: PG-RCNN:三维目标检测的语义表面点生成
title_en: PG-RCNN: Semantic Surface Point Generation for 3D Object Detection
abstract: 基于激光雷达的三维目标检测面临的主要挑战是,由于距离较远和遮挡,传感器往往无法完整捕获目标的空间信息。采用点云补全方法的两阶段检测器通过预训练网络在感兴趣区域(RoIs)添加更多点来解决这一问题。然而,这些方法为所有区域提议生成密集的物体点云,假设物体始终存在于RoIs中,这导致对错误提议也进行无差别点生成。受此启发,我们提出了一种新型端到端检测器Point Generation R-CNN(PG-RCNN),用于生成前景物体的语义表面点以实现精确检测。我们的方法使用联合训练的RoI点生成模块处理RoIs的上下文信息,并估计前景物体的完整形状和位移。对于每个生成的点,PG-RCNN分配一个语义特征以指示估计的前景概率。大量实验表明,由我们的方法生成的点云在几何和语义上提供了丰富的信息,用于优化误检和错位提议。PG-RCNN在KITTI基准上取得了具有竞争力的性能,其参数数量显著少于最先进的模型。代码可在https://github.com/quotation2520/PG-RCNN获取。
abstract_en:
One of the main challenges in LiDAR-based 3D object detection is that the sensors often fail to capture the complete spatial information about the objects due to long distance and occlusion.
 Two-stage detectors with point cloud completion approaches tackle this problem by adding more points to the regions of interest (RoIs) with a pre-trained network.
 However, these methods generate dense point clouds of objects for all region proposals, assuming that objects always exist in the RoIs. This leads to the indiscriminate point generation for incorrect proposals as well.
 Motivated by this, we propose Point Generation R-CNN (PG-RCNN), a novel end-to-end detector that generates semantic surface points of foreground objects for accurate detection.
 Our method uses a jointly trained RoI point generation module to process the contextual information of RoIs and estimate the complete shape and displacement of foreground objects.
 For every generated point, PG-RCNN assigns a semantic feature that indicates the estimated foreground probability.
 Extensive experiments show that the point clouds generated by our method provide geometrically and semantically rich information for refining false positive and misaligned proposals.
 PG-RCNN achieves competitive performance on the KITTI benchmark, with significantly fewer parameters than state-of-the-art models.
 The code is available at https://github.com/quotation2520/PG-RCNN.
authors: Inyong Koo, Inyoung Lee, Se-Ho Kim, Hee-Seon Kim, Woo-jin Jeon, Changick Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18142-18151

title: PGFed: 为联邦学习个性化每个客户端的全局目标
title_en: PGFed: Personalize Each Client's Global Objective for Federated Learning
abstract: 由于传统联邦学习(FL)在异构数据上表现平平,个性化联邦学习受到了广泛关注。与传统联邦学习仅训练单一全局共识模型不同,个性化联邦学习允许为不同客户端训练不同的模型。然而,现有个性化联邦学习算法仅通过将知识嵌入聚合模型或正则化中隐式地在联邦中传输协作知识。我们观察到,这种隐式知识传输未能最大化每个客户端的经验风险对其他客户端的潜在价值。基于这一观察,本文提出了一种新型个性化联邦学习框架——个性化全局联邦学习(PGFed),该框架通过显式且自适应地聚合自身与其他客户端的经验风险,使每个客户端能够个性化其全局目标。为避免产生大量(O(N^2))通信开销和潜在隐私泄露,同时实现这一目标,每个客户端的风险通过一阶近似估计用于其他客户端的自适应风险聚合。在PGFed基础上,我们开发了一种动量升级方法,称为PGFedMo,以更高效地利用客户端的经验风险。我们在不同联邦设置下的四个数据集上的广泛实验表明,PGFed在现有最先进方法上实现了持续改进。代码已公开在https://github.com/ljaiverson/pgfed。
abstract_en: Personalized federated learning has received an upsurge of attention due to the mediocre performance of conventional federated learning (FL) over heterogeneous data. Unlike conventional FL which trains a single global consensus model, personalized FL allows different models for different clients. However, existing personalized FL algorithms only implicitly transfer the collaborative knowledge across the federation by embedding the knowledge into the aggregated model or regularization. We observed that this implicit knowledge transfer fails to maximize the potential of each client's empirical risk toward other clients. Based on our observation, in this work, we propose Personalized Global Federated Learning (PGFed), a novel personalized FL framework that enables each client to personalize its own global objective by explicitly and adaptively aggregating the empirical risks of itself and other clients. To avoid massive (O(N^2)) communication overhead and potential privacy leakage while achieving this, each client's risk is estimated through a first-order approximation for other clients' adaptive risk aggregation. On top of PGFed, we develop a momentum upgrade, dubbed PGFedMo, to more efficiently utilize clients' empirical risks. Our extensive experiments on four datasets under different federated settings show consistent improvements of PGFed over previous state-of-the-art methods. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/ljaiverson/pgfed.
authors: Jun Luo, Matias Mendieta, Chen Chen, Shandong Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3946-3956

title: PHRIT:基于隐式模板的参数化手部表示
title_en: PHRIT: Parametric Hand Representation with Implicit Template
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法PHRIT,用于参数化手部网格建模,该方法结合了参数化网格和隐式表示的优势,采用隐式模板。我们的方法利用有符号距离场(SDFs)和基于部分的形状先验来表示可变形的手部形状,通过变形场执行变形。该模型通过在无限分辨率下变形规范模板,实现高效高保真手部重建。此外,该模型是完全可微的,由于可以由骨骼和形状潜在代码驱动,因此易于用于手部建模。我们在多个下游任务上评估了PHRIT,包括骨骼驱动的手部重建、点云形状和单视角3D重建,证明我们的方法在真实感和沉浸式手部建模方面达到了最先进性能。
abstract_en: We propose PHRIT, a novel approach for parametric hand mesh modeling with an implicit template that combines the advantages of both parametric meshes and implicit representations. Our method represents deformable hand shapes using signed distance fields (SDFs) with part-based shape priors, utilizing a deformation field to execute the deformation. The model offers efficient high-fidelity hand reconstruction by deforming the canonical template at infinite resolution. Additionally, it is fully differentiable and can be easily used in hand modeling since it can be driven by the skeleton and shape latent codes. We evaluate PHRIT on multiple downstream tasks, including skeleton-driven hand reconstruction, shapes from point clouds, and single-view 3D reconstruction, demonstrating that our approach achieves realistic and immersive hand modeling with state-of-the-art performance.
authors: Zhisheng Huang, Yujin Chen, Di Kang, Jinlu Zhang, Zhigang Tu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14974-14984

title: PIDRo: 基于并行同构注意力与动态路由的文本-视频检索
title_en: PIDRo: Parallel Isomeric Attention with Dynamic Routing for Text-Video Retrieval
abstract: 文本-视频检索是多模态研究中具有高实用价值的基础任务。受预训练图文模型(如CLIP)在大规模数据上取得巨大成功启发,许多方法被提出以将CLIP强大的表征学习能力迁移至文本-视频检索领域。然而,由于视频与图像模态的差异,如何有效适配CLIP至视频领域仍处于探索阶段。本文从两个方面研究该问题。首先,我们以无缝方式增强CLIP的迁移图像编码器,实现细粒度视频理解。其次,我们从模型改进与损失设计两方面开展视频与文本的细粒度对比。特别地,我们提出一种配备并行同构注意力与动态路由的细粒度对比模型PIDRo用于文本-视频检索。并行同构注意力模块作为视频编码器,包含两个并行分支,分别从图像块和帧级建模视频的时空信息。动态路由模块用于增强CLIP的文本编码器,通过将细粒度信息分配至句子中相关词标记,生成信息丰富的词表示。此类模型设计为我们提供了信息丰富的图像块、帧和词表示。随后,我们在此基础上进行词级交互。借助增强的编码器和词级损失,我们实现了更细粒度的文本-视频对齐和更准确的检索。PIDRo在MSR-VTT、MSVD、LSMDC、DiDeMo和ActivityNet等多个文本-视频检索基准数据集上取得了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Text-video retrieval is a fundamental task with high practical value in multi-modal research. Inspired by the great success of pre-trained image-text models with large-scale data, such as CLIP, many methods are proposed to transfer the strong representation learning capability of CLIP to text-video retrieval. However, due to the modality difference between videos and images, how to effectively adapt CLIP to the video domain is still underexplored. In this paper, we investigate this problem from two aspects. First, we enhance the transferred image encoder of CLIP for fine-grained video understanding in a seamless fashion. Second, we conduct fine-grained contrast between videos and texts from both model improvement and loss design. Particularly, we propose a fine-grained contrastive model equipped with parallel isomeric attention and dynamic routing, namely PIDRo, for text-video retrieval. The parallel isomeric attention module is used as the video encoder, which consists of two parallel branches modeling the spatial-temporal information of videos from both patch and frame levels. The dynamic routing module is constructed to enhance the text encoder of CLIP, generating informative word representations by distributing the fine-grained information to the related word tokens within a sentence. Such model design provides us with informative patch, frame and word representations. We then conduct token-wise interaction upon them. With the enhanced encoders and the token-wise loss, we are able to achieve finer-grained text-video alignment and more accurate retrieval. PIDRo obtains state-of-the-art performance over various text-video retrieval benchmarks, including MSR-VTT, MSVD, LSMDC, DiDeMo and ActivityNet.
authors: Peiyan Guan, Renjing Pei, Bin Shao, Jianzhuang Liu, Weimian Li, Jiaxi Gu, Hang Xu, Songcen Xu, Youliang Yan, Edmund Y. Lam ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11164-11173

title: PIRNet:基于小波提升的隐私保护图像修复网络
title_en: PIRNet: Privacy-Preserving Image Restoration Network via Wavelet Lifting
abstract: 基于云的多媒体服务在过去十年中日益流行,但其对客户端隐私构成了严重威胁。为解决这一问题,许多方法采用图像加密作为防御机制。然而,加密图像与自然图像差异显著,使其易受攻击者攻击。本文提出了一种名为PIRNet的新方法,该方法在隐写域中实现隐私保护的图像修复。与现有方法相比,我们的方法在隐蔽性和安全性方面具有显著优势。具体而言,我们首先提出一种基于小波提升的可逆隐藏(LIH)网络,将秘密图像嵌入到隐写图像中。随后,采用基于小波提升的保密修复(LSR)网络在隐写域中执行图像修复。由于秘密图像在整个图像修复过程中始终保持隐藏状态,客户端的隐私可得到充分保障。此外,由于隐写图像在视觉上与载体图像几乎相同,攻击者难以察觉其存在,这显著提升了安全性。在不同数据集上的实验结果表明,我们的PIRNet在包括图像去噪、去模糊和超分辨率在内的多种隐私保护图像修复任务中,均优于现有方法。
abstract_en:
The cloud-based multimedia service becomes increasingly popular in the last decade, however, it poses a serious threat to the client's privacy. To address this issue, many methods utilized image encryption as a defense mechanism.
 However, the encrypted images look quite different from the natural images, making them vulnerable to attackers. In this paper, we propose a novel method namely PIRNet, which operates privacy-preserving image restoration in the
 steganographic domain. Compared to existing methods, our method offers significant advantages in terms of invisibility and security. Specifically, we first propose a wavelet Lifting-based Invertible Hiding (LIH) network to conceal
 the secret image into the stego image. Then, a Lifting-based Secure Restoration (LSR) network is utilized to perform image restoration in the steganographic domain. Since the secret image remains hidden throughout the whole image
 restoration process, the privacy of clients can be largely ensured. In addition, since the stego image looks visually the same as the cover image, the attackers can hardly discover it, which significantly improves the security. The experimental results on different datasets show the superiority of our PIRNet over the existing methods on various privacy-preserving image restoration tasks, including image denoising, deblurring and super-resolution.
authors: Xin Deng, Chao Gao, Mai Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22368-22377

title: PNI : 基于位置与邻域信息的工业异常检测
title_en: PNI : Industrial Anomaly Detection using Position and Neighborhood Information
abstract: 由于异常样本无法用于训练,许多异常检测与定位方法采用预训练网络和非参数建模来估计编码特征分布。然而,这些方法忽视了位置和邻域信息对正常特征分布的影响。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新算法PNI,该算法通过多层感知机网络建模基于邻域特征的条件概率来估计正常分布。此外,通过在每个位置创建代表性特征直方图来利用位置信息。与简单地调整异常图不同,所提出的方法采用在合成异常图像上训练的额外精修网络,以更好地插值并考虑输入图像的形状和边缘。我们在MVTec AD基准数据集上进行了实验,取得了最先进的性能,异常检测和定位的AUROC分数分别为99.56%和98.98%。代码可在https://github.com/wogur110/PNI_Anomaly_Detection获取。
abstract_en:
Because anomalous samples cannot be used for training,
 many anomaly detection and localization methods use
 pre-trained networks and non-parametric modeling to estimate
 encoded feature distribution. However, these methods
 neglect the impact of position and neighborhood information
 on the distribution of normal features. To overcome
 this, we propose a new algorithm, PNI, which estimates
 the normal distribution using conditional probability given
 neighborhood features, modeled with a multi-layer perceptron
 network. Moreover, position information is utilized by
 creating a histogram of representative features at each position.
 Instead of simply resizing the anomaly map, the proposed
 method employs an additional refine network trained
 on synthetic anomaly images to better interpolate and account
 for the shape and edge of the input image. We conducted
 experiments on the MVTec AD benchmark dataset
 and achieved state-of-the-art performance, with 99.56%
 and 98.98% AUROC scores in anomaly detection and localization,
 respectively. Code is available at https://github.com/wogur110/PNI_Anomaly_Detection.
authors: Jaehyeok Bae, Jae-Han Lee, Seyun Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6373-6383

title: PODA: 提示驱动的零样本领域适应
title_en: PODA: Prompt-driven Zero-shot Domain Adaptation
abstract: 领域适应在计算机视觉中已被广泛研究,但在训练时仍需要访问目标图像,这在某些特殊情况下可能难以处理。本文提出“提示驱动的零样本领域适应”任务,即利用对目标领域的自然语言通用描述(即提示)来适应在源领域上训练的模型。首先,我们利用预训练的对比视觉-语言模型(CLIP)优化源特征的仿射变换,将它们引导至目标文本嵌入,同时保留其内容和语义。为实现这一目标,我们提出提示驱动实例归一化(Prompt-driven Instance Normalization, PIN)。其次,我们证明这些提示驱动的增强方法可用于执行语义分割的零样本领域适应。实验表明,我们的方法在多个数据集上显著优于基于CLIP的风格迁移基线方法,甚至超越了单次无监督领域适应。在目标检测和图像分类任务中也观察到类似的性能提升。代码可在https://github.com/astra-vision/PODA获取。
abstract_en: Domain adaptation has been vastly investigated in computer vision but still requires access to target images at train time, which might be intractable in some uncommon conditions. In this paper, we propose the task of 'Prompt-driven Zero-shot Domain Adaptation', where we adapt a model trained on a source domain using only a general description in natural language of the target domain, i.e., a prompt. First, we leverage a pretrained contrastive vision-language model (CLIP) to optimize affine transformations of source features, steering them towards the target text embedding while preserving their content and semantics. To achieve this, we propose Prompt-driven Instance Normalization (PIN). Second, we show that these prompt-driven augmentations can be used to perform zero-shot domain adaptation for semantic segmentation. Experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms CLIP-based style transfer baselines on several datasets for the downstream task at hand, even surpassing one-shot unsupervised domain adaptation. A similar boost is observed on object detection and image classification. The code is available at https://github.com/astra-vision/PODA .
authors: Mohammad Fahes, Tuan-Hung Vu, Andrei Bursuc, Patrick Pérez, Raoul de Charette ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18623-18633

title: PODIA-3D:基于姿态保持的文本到图像扩散的三维生成模型跨大领域差距领域适应
title_en: PODIA-3D: Domain Adaptation of 3D Generative Model Across Large Domain Gap Using Pose-Preserved Text-to-Image Diffusion
abstract: 近期,三维生成模型取得了显著进展,然而在跨多样领域训练这些模型时面临挑战,需要大量训练数据和对姿态分布的知识。文本引导的领域适应方法允许生成器通过文本提示适应目标领域,从而无需组装大量数据。最近,DATID-3D在文本引导领域中展示了出色的样本质量,通过利用文本到图像扩散保持文本多样性。然而,由于当前文本到图像扩散模型存在以下问题,将三维生成器适应到与源领域存在显著领域差距的目标领域仍具挑战性:1)基于扩散的翻译中的形状-姿态权衡,2)姿态偏差,3)目标领域的实例偏差,导致生成样本的三维形状质量较低、文本-图像对应度差以及领域内多样性不足。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种名为PODIA-3D的新颖流程,该流程使用姿态保持的文本到图像扩散进行三维生成模型的领域适应。我们构建了一个姿态保持的文本到图像扩散模型,允许使用极高层次的噪声实现显著的领域变化。我们还提出了专门到通用的采样策略以提升生成样本的细节。此外,为克服实例偏差,我们引入了一种文本引导的去偏差方法以提升领域内多样性。因此,我们的方法成功实现了跨显著领域差距的三维生成器适应。我们的定性结果和用户研究表明,与现有三维文本引导领域适应方法相比,我们的方法在文本-图像对应度、真实感、渲染图像的多样性以及生成样本中三维形状的深度感方面均表现出色。
abstract_en: Recently, significant advancements have been made in 3D generative models, however training these models across diverse domains is challenging and requires an huge amount of training data and knowledge of pose distribution. Text-guided domain adaptation methods have allowed the generator to be adapted to the target domains using text prompts, thereby obviating the need for assembling numerous data. Recently, DATID-3D presents impressive quality of samples in text-guided domain, preserving diversity in text by leveraging text-to-image diffusion. However, adapting 3D generators to domains with significant domain gaps from the source domain still remains challenging due to issues in current text-to-image diffusion models as following: 1) shape-pose trade-off in diffusion-based translation, 2) pose bias, and 3) instance bias in the target domain, resulting in inferior 3D shapes, low text-image correspondence, and low intra-domain diversity in the generated samples. To address these issues, we propose a novel pipeline called PODIA-3D, which uses pose-preserved text-to-image diffusion-based domain adaptation for 3D generative models. We construct a pose-preserved text-to-image diffusion model that allows the use of extremely high-level noise for significant domain changes. We also propose specialized-to-general sampling strategies to improve the details of the generated samples. Moreover, to overcome the instance bias, we introduce a text-guided debiasing method that improves intra-domain diversity. Consequently, our method successfully adapts 3D generators across significant domain gaps. Our qualitative results and user study demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing 3D text-guided domain adaptation methods in terms of text-image correspondence, realism, diversity of rendered images, and sense of depth of 3D shapes in the generated samples.
authors: Gwanghyun Kim, Ji Ha Jang, Se Young Chun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22603-22612

title: PPR:基于单目视频的物理合理重建
title_en: PPR: Physically Plausible Reconstruction from Monocular Videos
abstract: 基于单目视频,我们构建可运动物体和环境的3D模型,其3D配置满足动力学和接触约束。我们的方法核心在于利用可微物理模拟来辅助视觉重建。通过坐标下降法将可微物理模拟与可微渲染相结合,实现了不仅对3D重建,而且对物理系统参数的端到端优化。我们在四足动物和人类的单目视频上验证了物理信息引导重建的有效性。该方法减少了仅靠视觉线索难以解决的重建伪影(如尺度歧义、不平衡姿态和脚部交换),并提升了足部接触估计的准确性。
abstract_en: Given monocular videos, we build 3D models of articulated objects and environments whose 3D configurations satisfy dynamics and contact constraints. At its core, our method leverages differentiable physics simulation to aid visual reconstructions. We couple differentiable physics simulation with differentiable rendering via coordinate descent, which enables end-to-end optimization of, not only 3D reconstructions, but also physical system parameters from videos. We demonstrate the effectiveness of physics-informed reconstruction on monocular videos of quadruped animals and humans. It reduces reconstruction artifacts (e.g., scale ambiguity, unbalanced poses, and foot swapping) that are challenging to address by visual cues alone, and produces better foot contact estimation.
authors: Gengshan Yang, Shuo Yang, John Z. Zhang, Zachary Manchester, Deva Ramanan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3914-3924

title: PRANC:用于深度模型压缩的伪随机网络
title_en: PRANC: Pseudo RAndom Networks for Compacting Deep Models
abstract: 我们证明深度模型可以重新参数化为多个随机初始化并冻结的深度模型在权重空间中的线性组合。在训练过程中,我们寻求位于这些随机模型(即“基”网络)张成子空间内的局部极小值。我们的框架PRANC能够显著压缩深度模型。该模型可通过单个标量“种子”生成伪随机“基”网络,以及学习到的线性混合系数进行重建。在实际应用中,PRANC解决了高效存储和通信深度模型的挑战,这是多智能体学习、持续学习器、联邦系统和边缘设备等场景中的常见瓶颈。在本研究中,我们利用PRANC压缩图像分类模型并压缩其关联的隐式神经网络。当将深度模型压缩近100倍时,PRANC在图像分类任务上显著优于基线方法。此外,我们证明PRANC可通过逐层生成权重实现内存高效的推理。PRANC的源代码见:https://github.com/UCDvision/PRANC
abstract_en: We demonstrate that a deep model can be reparametrized as a linear combination of several randomly initialized and frozen deep models in the weight space. During training, we seek local minima that reside within the subspace spanned by these random models (i.e., `basis' networks). Our framework, PRANC, enables significant compaction of a deep model. The model can be reconstructed using a single scalar `seed,' employed to generate the pseudo-random `basis' networks, together with the learned linear mixture coefficients. In practical applications, PRANC addresses the challenge of efficiently storing and communicating deep models, a common bottleneck in several scenarios, including multi-agent learning, continual learners, federated systems, and edge devices, among others. In this study, we employ PRANC to condense image classification models and compress images by compacting their associated implicit neural networks. PRANC outperforms baselines with a large margin on image classification when compressing a deep model almost 100 times. Moreover, we show that PRANC enables memory-efficient inference by generating layer-wise weights on the fly. The source code of PRANC is here: https://github.com/UCDvision/PRANC
authors: Parsa Nooralinejad, Ali Abbasi, Soroush Abbasi Koohpayegani, Kossar Pourahmadi Meibodi, Rana Muhammad Shahroz Khan, Soheil Kolouri, Hamed Pirsiavash ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17021-17031

title: PRIOR:基于原型表示的医学图像与报告联合学习
title_en: PRIOR: Prototype Representation Joint Learning from Medical Images and Reports
abstract: 基于对比学习的视觉-语言联合预训练已成为一种成功的表示学习策略。本文提出了一种原型表示学习框架,该框架结合了医学图像与报告之间的全局与局部对齐。与标准的全局多模态对齐方法不同,我们采用局部对齐模块进行细粒度表示学习。此外,设计了一个跨模态条件重建模块,在训练阶段通过重建被掩码的图像和报告来实现模态间信息交互。为重建长报告,构建了基于句子的原型记忆库,使网络能够聚焦于低层次的局部视觉特征和高层次的临床语言特征。此外,提出了一种非自回归生成范式用于重建非序列化报告。在包括监督分类、零样本分类、图像-文本检索、语义分割和目标检测在内的五个下游任务上的实验结果表明,所提方法在多个数据集和不同数据集规模设置下均优于其他最先进的方法。代码已开源于 https://github.com/QtacierP/PRIOR。
abstract_en: Contrastive learning based vision-language joint pre-training has emerged as a successful representation learning strategy. In this paper, we present a prototype representation learning framework incorporating both global and local alignment between medical images and reports. In contrast to standard global multi-modality alignment methods, we employ a local alignment module for fine-grained representation. Furthermore, a cross-modality conditional reconstruction module is designed to interchange information across modalities in the training phase by reconstructing masked images and reports. For reconstructing long reports, a sentence-wise prototype memory bank is constructed, enabling the network to focus on low-level localized visual and high-level clinical linguistic features. Additionally, a non-auto-regressive generation paradigm is proposed for reconstructing non-sequential reports. Experimental results on five downstream tasks, including supervised classification, zero-shot classification, image-to-text retrieval, semantic segmentation, and object detection, show the proposed method outperforms other state-of-the-art methods across multiple datasets and under different dataset size settings. The code is available at https://github.com/QtacierP/PRIOR.
authors: Pujin Cheng, Li Lin, Junyan Lyu, Yijin Huang, Wenhan Luo, Xiaoying Tang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21361-21371

title: PVT++:一种简单的端到端延迟感知视觉跟踪框架
title_en: PVT++: A Simple End-to-End Latency-Aware Visual Tracking Framework
abstract: 视觉目标跟踪对于智能机器人至关重要。大多数现有方法忽略了在线延迟,这种延迟在实际处理过程中会导致严重性能退化。尤其是对于无人机(UAVs),其中鲁棒跟踪更具挑战性且机载计算资源有限,延迟问题可能致命。在本工作中,我们提出了一种端到端延迟感知跟踪的简单框架,即端到端预测视觉跟踪(PVT++)。与现有方法简单地在跟踪器后附加卡尔曼滤波器不同,PVT++可以联合优化,不仅利用运动信息,还能借助大多数预训练跟踪模型中丰富的视觉知识进行鲁棒预测。此外,为弥合训练-评估领域差距,我们提出相对运动因子,使PVT++能够泛化到具有挑战性和复杂性的无人机跟踪场景。这些精心设计使小容量轻量级的PVT++成为广泛有效的解决方案。此外,本工作还提出了一种扩展的延迟感知评估基准,用于在线环境下任意速度跟踪器的评估。从空中视角的机器人平台实验证明,PVT++在多种跟踪器上实现了显著性能提升,并表现出比先前解决方案更高的精度,大幅缓解了延迟带来的性能退化。我们的代码将公开。
abstract_en: Visual object tracking is essential to intelligent robots. Most existing approaches have ignored the online latency that can cause severe performance degradation during real-world processing. Especially for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), where robust tracking is more challenging and onboard computation is limited, the latency issue can be fatal. In this work, we present a simple framework for end-to-end latency-aware tracking, i.e., end-to-end predictive visual tracking (PVT++). Unlike existing solutions that naively append Kalman Filters after trackers, PVT++ can be jointly optimized, so that it takes not only motion information but can also leverage the rich visual knowledge in most pre-trained tracker models for robust prediction. Besides, to bridge the training-evaluation domain gap, we propose a relative motion factor, empowering PVT++ to generalize to the challenging and complex UAV tracking scenes. These careful designs have made the small-capacity lightweight PVT++ a widely effective solution. Additionally, this work presents an extended latency-aware evaluation benchmark for assessing an any-speed tracker in the online setting. Empirical results on a robotic platform from the aerial perspective show that PVT++ can achieve significant performance gain on various trackers and exhibit higher accuracy than prior solutions, largely mitigating the degradation brought by latency. Our code will be made public.
authors: Bowen Li, Ziyuan Huang, Junjie Ye, Yiming Li, Sebastian Scherer, Hang Zhao, Changhong Fu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10006-10016

title: 成对相似性学习是SimPLE
title_en: Pairwise Similarity Learning is SimPLE
abstract: 本文聚焦于一个通用且重要的学习问题——成对相似性学习(PSL)。PSL涵盖了开放集人脸识别、说话人验证、图像检索和行人重识别等广泛且重要的应用。PSL的目标是学习一个成对相似性函数,为正样本对(即标签相同的样本对)分配更高的相似性得分,而为负样本对(即标签不同的样本对)分配较低的得分。我们首先确定PSL的一个关键目标,然后讨论现有方法如何实现这一目标。随后,我们提出了一种令人惊讶的简单无代理方法SimPLE,该方法无需特征/代理归一化或角度边距,却能在开放集识别中表现出良好的泛化能力。我们将所提方法应用于三个具有挑战性的PSL任务:开放集人脸识别、图像检索和说话人验证。在大规模基准数据集上的综合实验结果表明,我们的方法显著优于当前最先进的方法。
abstract_en: In this paper, we focus on a general yet important learning problem, pairwise similarity learning (PSL). PSL subsumes a wide range of important applications, such as open-set face recognition, speaker verification, image retrieval and person re-identification. The goal of PSL is to learn a pairwise similarity function assigning a higher similarity score to positive pairs (i.e., a pair of samples with the same label) than to negative pairs (i.e., a pair of samples with different label). We start by identifying a key desideratum for PSL, and then discuss how existing methods can achieve this desideratum. We then propose a surprisingly simple proxy-free method, called SimPLE, which requires neither feature/proxy normalization nor angular margin and yet is able to generalize well in open-set recognition. We apply the proposed method to three challenging PSL tasks: open-set face recognition, image retrieval and speaker verification. Comprehensive experimental results on large-scale benchmarks show that our method performs significantly better than current state-of-the-art methods.
authors: Yandong Wen, Weiyang Liu, Yao Feng, Bhiksha Raj, Rita Singh, Adrian Weller, Michael J. Black, Bernhard Schölkopf ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5308-5318

title: PanFlowNet:一种基于流的全色锐化深度网络
title_en: PanFlowNet: A Flow-Based Deep Network for Pan-Sharpening
abstract: 全色锐化旨在通过整合低分辨率多光谱(LRMS)图像的光谱信息与高分辨率全色(PAN)图像的纹理细节,生成高分辨率多光谱(HRMS)图像。其本质上继承了超分辨率(SR)任务的不适定性,即多样化的HRMS图像可以退化为LRMS图像。然而,现有的基于深度学习的方法通过确定性映射仅从LRMS图像和PAN图像中恢复单一的HRMS图像,从而忽略了HRMS图像的多样性。本文为缓解这一不适定问题,提出了一种基于流的全色锐化网络(PanFlowNet),直接学习给定LRMS图像和PAN图像的HRMS图像条件分布,而非学习确定性映射。具体而言,我们首先通过一个可逆网络将未知的条件分布转换为给定的高斯分布,从而显式定义条件分布。随后,我们设计了一个可逆的条件仿射耦合块(CACB),并通过堆叠一系列CACB构建PanFlowNet的架构。最后,通过最大化给定训练集的条件分布对数似然来训练PanFlowNet,从而可以预测多样化的HRMS图像。实验结果验证了所提出的PanFlowNet能够根据LRMS图像和PAN图像生成多种HRMS图像。此外,不同种类的卫星数据集上的实验结果也表明,与其它最先进方法相比,我们的PanFlowNet在视觉和定量上均具有优越性。代码可在Github上获取。
abstract_en: Pan-sharpening aims to generate a high-resolution multispectral (HRMS) image by integrating the spectral information of a low-resolution multispectral (LRMS) image with the texture details of a high-resolution panchromatic (PAN) image. It essentially inherits the ill-posed nature of the super-resolution (SR) task that diverse HRMS images can degrade into an LRMS image. However, existing deep learning-based methods recover only one HRMS image from the LRMS image and PAN image using a deterministic mapping, thus ignoring the diversity of the HRMS image. In this paper, to alleviate this ill-posed issue, we propose a flow-based pan-sharpening network (PanFlowNet) to directly learn the conditional distribution of HRMS image given LRMS image and PAN image instead of learning a deterministic mapping. Specifically, we first transform this unknown conditional distribution into a given Gaussian distribution by an invertible network, and the conditional distribution can thus be explicitly defined. Then, we design an invertible Conditional Affine Coupling Block (CACB) and further build the architecture of PanFlowNet by stacking a series of CACBs. Finally, the PanFlowNet is trained by maximizing the log-likelihood of the conditional distribution given a training set and can then be used to predict diverse HRMS images. The experimental results verify that the proposed PanFlowNet can generate various HRMS images given an LRMS image and a PAN image. Additionally, the experimental results on different kinds of satellite datasets also demonstrate the superiority of our PanFlowNet compared with other state-of-the-art methods both visually and quantitatively. Code is available at Github.
authors: Gang Yang, Xiangyong Cao, Wenzhe Xiao, Man Zhou, Aiping Liu, Xun Chen, Deyu Meng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16857-16867

title: 光子全景图
title_en: Panoramas from Photons
abstract: 在高速运动和低光照条件下进行场景重建对于增强现实、虚拟现实、无人机导航和自主机器人等应用至关重要。传统运动估计技术在这些条件下失效,因高速运动导致过度模糊,低光照条件下则受到强噪声干扰。单光子相机近年来作为一种有前景的技术出现,得益于其高速度和极高的灵敏度,能够每秒捕获数万个光子帧。不幸的是,传统计算机视觉技术并不适合处理这些相机捕获的二值化光子数据,因为这些数据受到极端泊松噪声的干扰。本文提出了一种方法,能够从单光子相机捕获的高速图像序列中,估计极端场景运动,适用于低光照或高动态范围等挑战性条件。我们的方法通过分层方式,在事后对帧进行分组和聚合,迭代改进运动估计。我们展示了在快速运动和极低光照条件下创建高质量全景图的结果,并使用定制单光子相机原型实现了超分辨率效果。
abstract_en: Scene reconstruction in the presence of high-speed motion and low illumination is important in many applications such as augmented and virtual reality, drone navigation, and autonomous robotics. Traditional motion estimation techniques fail in such conditions, suffering from too much blur in the presence of high-speed motion and strong noise in low-light conditions. Single-photon cameras have recently emerged as a promising technology capable of capturing hundreds of thousands of photon frames per second thanks to their high speed and extreme sensitivity. Unfortunately, traditional computer vision techniques are not well suited for dealing with the binary-valued photon data captured by these cameras because these are corrupted by extreme Poisson noise. Here we present a method capable of estimating extreme scene motion under challenging conditions, such as low light or high dynamic range, from a sequence of high-speed image frames such as those captured by a single-photon camera. Our method relies on iteratively improving a motion estimate by grouping and aggregating frames after-the-fact, in a stratified manner. We demonstrate the creation of high-quality panoramas under fast motion and extremely low light, and super-resolution results using a custom single-photon camera prototype.
authors: Sacha Jungerman, Atul Ingle, Mohit Gupta ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10626-10636

title: ParCNetV2:超大卷积核与增强注意力机制
title_en: ParCNetV2: Oversized Kernel with Enhanced Attention
abstract: Transformer模型在各种计算机视觉任务中展现出巨大潜力。通过借鉴Transformer的设计概念,许多研究革新了CNN并取得了显著成果。本文延续了这一研究方向。具体而言,我们提出了一种新的卷积神经网络ParCNetV2,通过弥合CNN与ViT之间的差距,延续了ParCNetV1的研究方向。该网络引入了两项关键设计:1)超大卷积(OC),其尺寸为输入的两倍;2)分叉门单元(BGU)以确保模型具备输入自适应性。通过在统一的CNN中融合OC和BGU,ParCNetV2能够像ViT一样灵活提取全局特征,同时保持更低的延迟和更高的准确性。大量实验验证了我们的方法在与其他卷积神经网络及混合模型(结合CNN与Transformer)相比的优越性。代码已公开在https://github.com/XuRuihan/ParCNetV2。
abstract_en: Transformers have shown great potential in various computer vision tasks. By borrowing design concepts from transformers, many studies revolutionized CNNs and showed remarkable results. This paper falls in this line of studies. Specifically, we propose a new convolutional neural network, ParCNetV2, that extends the research line of ParCNetV1 by bridging the gap between CNN and ViT. It introduces two key designs: 1) Oversized Convolution (OC) with twice the size of the input, and 2) Bifurcate Gate Unit (BGU) to ensure that the model is input adaptive. Fusing OC and BGU in a unified CNN, ParCNetV2 is capable of flexibly extracting global features like ViT, while maintaining lower latency and better accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our method over other convolutional neural networks and hybrid models that combine CNNs and transformers. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/XuRuihan/ParCNetV2.
authors: Ruihan Xu, Haokui Zhang, Wenze Hu, Shiliang Zhang, Xiaoyu Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5752-5762

title: 抗视差无监督深度图像拼接技术
title_en: Parallax-Tolerant Unsupervised Deep Image Stitching
abstract: 传统图像拼接方法倾向于利用日益复杂的几何特征(点、线、边缘等)以提升性能。然而,这些手工设计的特征仅适用于具有充足几何结构的特定自然场景。相比之下,深度拼接方案通过自适应学习鲁棒语义特征来克服不利条件,但无法处理大视差情况。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种抗视差无监督深度图像拼接技术。首先,我们提出一种鲁棒且灵活的图像变形模型,从全局单应性变换到局部薄板样条运动,以联合优化对齐与失真,实现重叠区域的精确对齐和非重叠区域的形状保持。随后,为提升泛化能力,我们设计了一种简单但有效的迭代策略,增强跨数据集和跨分辨率应用中的变形适应性。最后,为进一步消除视差伪影,我们通过无监督学习生成接缝驱动的合成掩膜,实现无缝拼接。与现有方法相比,我们的方案具有抗视差特性,无需针对特定场景设计复杂的几何特征。大量实验表明,我们的方法在定量和定性指标上均优于当前最优方法。代码将很快发布。
abstract_en:
Traditional image stitching approaches tend to leverage increasingly complex geometric features (point, line, edge, etc.) for better performance. However, these hand-crafted features are only suitable for specific natural scenes with adequate geometric structures. In contrast, deep stitching schemes overcome adverse conditions by adaptively learning robust semantic features, but they cannot handle large-parallax cases.
  To solve these issues, we propose a parallax-tolerant unsupervised deep image stitching technique. First, we propose a robust and flexible warp to model the image registration from global homography to local thin-plate spline motion. It provides accurate alignment for overlapping regions and shape preservation for non-overlapping regions by joint optimization concerning alignment and distortion. Subsequently, to improve the generalization capability, we design a simple but effective iterative strategy to enhance the warp adaption in cross-dataset and cross-resolution applications. Finally, to further eliminate the parallax artifacts, we propose to composite the stitched image seamlessly by unsupervised learning for seam-driven composition masks. Compared with existing methods, our solution is parallax-tolerant and free from laborious designs of complicated geometric features for specific scenes. Extensive experiments show our superiority over the SoTA methods, both quantitatively and qualitatively. The code will be available soon.
authors: Lang Nie, Chunyu Lin, Kang Liao, Shuaicheng Liu, Yao Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7399-7408

title: 用于少样本基于骨架的动作识别的并行注意力交互网络
title_en: Parallel Attention Interaction Network for Few-Shot Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
abstract: 从极少量标注样本中学习判别性特征以识别新类别在基于骨架的动作识别中受到越来越多的关注。现有方法通过利用骨架内或骨架间的空间关联来学习动作特定的嵌入,这可能导致判别性表示不足。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新颖的并行注意力交互网络(PAINet),该网络包含两个互补分支以通过骨架间和骨架内的相关性增强匹配。具体而言,提出了一种利用拓扑和物理信息的拓扑编码模块,以增强两个分支中交互部分和关节对的建模。在交叉空间对齐分支中,我们采用空间交叉注意力模块建立序列间的关节关联,并引入方向平均对称表面度量以定位最近的时序相似性。同时,交叉时间对齐分支结合空间自注意力模块聚合序列内的空间上下文,并应用时间交叉注意力网络校正时间错位并计算相似性。在三个骨架基准数据集NTU-T、NTU-S和Kinetics上的大量实验验证了我们框架的优越性,并且在多个指标上均优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Learning discriminative features from very few labeled samples to identify novel classes has received increasing attention in skeleton-based action recognition. Existing works aim to learn action-specific embeddings by exploiting either intra-skeleton or inter-skeleton spatial associations, which may lead to less discriminative representations. To address these issues, we propose a novel Parallel Attention Interaction Network (PAINet) that incorporates two complementary branches to strengthen the match by inter-skeleton and intra-skeleton correlation. Specifically, a topology encoding module utilizing topology and physical information is proposed to enhance the modeling of interactive parts and joint pairs in both branches. In the Cross Spatial Alignment branch, we employ a spatial cross-attention module to establish joint associations across sequences, and a directional Average Symmetric Surface Metric is introduced to locate the closest temporal similarity. In parallel, the Cross Temporal Alignment branch incorporates a spatial self-attention module to aggregate spatial context within sequences as well as applies the temporal cross-attention network to correct misalignment temporally and calculate similarity. Extensive experiments on three skeleton benchmarks, namely NTU-T, NTU-S, and Kinetics, demonstrate the superiority of our framework and consistently outperform state-of-the-art methods.
authors: Xingyu Liu, Sanping Zhou, Le Wang, Gang Hua ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1379-1388

title: 参数化代价体用于立体匹配
title_en: Parameterized Cost Volume for Stereo Matching
abstract: 当处理大视差范围时,立体匹配变得计算复杂。先前方法主要通过动态代价体聚焦于局部视差空间来缓解计算负担,但由于缺乏全局视角,需要多次迭代才能接近真实值。我们发现动态代价体在每次迭代中近似将视差空间编码为具有固定小方差的单个高斯分布,导致视差空间全局视角不足且每次迭代更新步长较小。本文提出参数化代价体,通过多高斯分布编码整个视差空间。每个像素的视差分布由权重、均值和方差参数化。均值和方差用于采样视差候选值进行代价计算,权重和均值用于计算视差输出。上述参数通过基于JS散度的优化计算,该优化在前馈微分模块中实现为梯度下降更新。实验表明,我们的方法将RAFT-Stereo的运行时间加速了4.15倍,实现了实时性能和可比的精度。
abstract_en: Stereo matching becomes computationally challenging when dealing with a large disparity range. Prior methods mainly alleviate the computation through dynamic cost volume by focusing on a local disparity space, but it requires many iterations to get close to the ground truth due to the lack of a global view. We find that the dynamic cost volume approximately encodes the disparity space as a single Gaussian distribution with a fixed and small variance at each iteration, which results in an inadequate global view over disparity space and a small update step at every iteration.
