abstract: 标准语义分割模型的成功依赖于精心策划的数据集,其固定语义类别集合未考虑识别新类别未知对象的可能性。现有异常检测方法由于每像素分类范式的限制,其预测缺乏平滑性和物体性。此外,额外训练用于检测异常会损害已知类别的性能。本文探索了另一种基于区域级分类的范式以更好地分割未知对象。我们证明掩码分类中的对象查询倾向于表现出一对一分类器的特性。基于这一发现,我们通过将异常事件定义为被所有已知类别拒绝的情况,提出了一种新颖的异常评分函数RbA。大量实验表明,掩码分类提升了现有异常检测方法的性能,且采用RbA可获得最佳结果。我们还提出了一种目标函数以最小异常监督优化RbA。进一步使用异常数据微调可提升未知对象性能,且与以往方法不同,不会损害内点性能。项目页面:https://kuis-ai.github.io/RbA
abstract_en:
Standard semantic segmentation models owe their success to curated datasets with a fixed set of semantic categories, without contemplating the possibility of identifying unknown objects from novel categories. Existing methods in outlier detection suffer from a lack of smoothness and objectness in their predictions, due to limitations of the per-pixel classification paradigm. Furthermore, additional training for detecting outliers harms the performance of known classes. In this paper, we explore another paradigm with region-level classification to better segment unknown objects. We show that the object queries in mask classification tend to behave like one vs. all classifiers. Based on this finding, we propose a novel outlier scoring function called RbA by defining the event of being an outlier as being rejected by all known classes. Our extensive experiments show that mask classification improves the performance of the existing outlier detection methods, and the best results are achieved with the proposed RbA. We also propose an objective to optimize RbA using minimal outlier supervision. Further fine-tuning with outliers improves the unknown performance, and unlike previous methods, it does not degrade the inlier performance. 
 Project page: https://kuis-ai.github.io/RbA
authors: Nazir Nayal, Misra Yavuz, João F. Henriques, Fatma Güney ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 711-722

title: Re-ReND:跨设备的神经辐射场实时渲染
title_en: Re-ReND: Real-Time Rendering of NeRFs across Devices
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法,用于在资源受限设备上实时渲染预训练的神经辐射场(NeRF)。我们引入了Re-ReND,一种实现跨设备神经辐射场实时渲染的方法。Re-ReND通过将NeRF转换为可被标准图形管线高效处理的表示形式,设计实现实时性能。所提方法通过将学习到的密度信息蒸馏至网格,同时将学习到的颜色信息分解为一组表示场景光场的矩阵,从而实现这一目标。分解意味着通过低成本的无需多层感知机(MLP)的矩阵乘法查询场,而使用光场可仅通过一次查询即可渲染像素——与采用辐射场时需进行数百次查询相比。由于所提出的表示形式可通过片段着色器实现,因此可直接集成到标准光栅化框架中。我们的灵活实现可在低内存需求下,于包括移动设备和AR/VR头显在内的广泛资源受限设备上实现NeRF的实时渲染。值得注意的是,我们发现Re-ReND在不明显影响质量的情况下,相较于现有最先进方法的渲染速度提升了2.6倍以上。
abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel approach for rendering a pre-trained Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) in real-time on resource-constrained devices. We introduce Re-ReND, a method enabling Real-time Rendering of NeRFs across Devices. Re-ReND is designed to achieve real-time performance by converting the NeRF into a representation that can be efficiently processed by standard graphics pipelines. The proposed method distills the NeRF by extracting the learned density into a mesh, while the learned color information is factorized into a set of matrices that represent the scene's light field. Factorization implies the field is queried via inexpensive MLP-free matrix multiplications, while using a light field allows rendering a pixel by querying the field a single time--as opposed to hundreds of queries when employing a radiance field. Since the proposed representation can be implemented using a fragment shader, it can be directly integrated with standard rasterization frameworks. Our flexible implementation can render a NeRF in real-time with low memory requirements and on a wide range of resource-constrained devices, including mobiles and AR/VR headsets. Notably, we find that Re-ReND can achieve over a 2.6-fold increase in rendering speed versus the state-of-the-art without perceptible losses in quality.
authors: Sara Rojas, Jesus Zarzar, Juan C. Pérez, Artsiom Sanakoyeu, Ali Thabet, Albert Pumarola, Bernard Ghanem ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3632-3641

title: 重新挖掘、学习与推理:探索跨模态语义相关性以实现语言引导的HOI检测
title_en: Re-mine, Learn and Reason: Exploring the Cross-modal Semantic Correlations for Language-guided HOI detection
abstract: 人-物交互(HOI)检测是一项具有挑战性的计算机视觉任务,要求视觉模型处理人与物体之间的复杂交互关系并预测<人, 动作, 物体>三元组。尽管存在大量交互组合带来的挑战,但同时也为视觉文本的多模态学习提供了机会。本文提出了一种系统且统一的框架(RmLR),通过引入结构化文本知识提升HOI检测性能。首先,我们定性与定量分析了两阶段HOI检测器中交互信息的损失,并提出重新挖掘策略以生成更全面的视觉表征。其次,我们设计了更细粒度的句子级和词级对齐与知识迁移策略,有效解决多交互与多文本间的多对多匹配问题。这些策略缓解了多交互同时发生时的匹配混淆问题,从而提升对齐过程的有效性。最后,通过视觉特征与文本知识融合的HOI推理显著提升了交互理解能力。实验结果验证了所提方法的有效性,在公开基准测试中取得了最先进性能。
abstract_en: Human-Object Interaction (HOI) detection is a challenging computer vision task that requires visual models to address the complex interactive relationship between humans and objects and predict <human, action, object> triplets. Despite the challenges posed by the numerous interaction combinations, they also offer opportunities for multi-modal learning of visual texts. In this paper, we present a systematic and unified framework (RmLR) that enhances HOI detection by incorporating structured text knowledge. Firstly, we qualitatively and quantitatively analyze the loss of interaction information in the two-stage HOI detector and propose a re-mining strategy to generate more comprehensive visual representation. Secondly, we design more fine-grained sentence- and word-level alignment and knowledge transfer strategies to effectively address the many-to-many matching problem between multiple interactions and multiple texts. These strategies alleviate the matching confusion problem that arises when multiple interactions occur simultaneously, thereby improving the effectiveness of the alignment process. Finally, HOI reasoning by visual features augmented with textual knowledge substantially improves the understanding of interactions. Experimental results illustrate the effectiveness of our approach, where state-of-the-art performance is achieved on public benchmarks.
authors: Yichao Cao, Qingfei Tang, Feng Yang, Xiu Su, Shan You, Xiaobo Lu, Chang Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23492-23503

title: Re:PolyWorld - 一种用于多边形场景解析的图神经网络
title_en: Re:PolyWorld - A Graph Neural Network for Polygonal Scene Parsing
abstract: 尽管大多数最先进的实例分割方法生成像素级分割掩码,但众多应用需求检测对象的精确矢量多边形而非光栅化输出。本文提出Re:PolyWorld,作为PolyWorld的重制和改进版本。PolyWorld是一种神经网络,从图像中提取物体顶点并将其最优连接以生成精确多边形。本工作的目标是克服原始模型的缺陷,并引入改进的多边形表示,以获得通用的图像多边形提取方法。该架构重新设计,不仅利用顶点特征,还利用边的视觉外观。为此,一种边感知图神经网络预测每对顶点之间的连接强度,进一步通过求解可微最优传输问题来计算分配。所提出的多边形场景重新定义使该方法成为一种强大的通用方法,可应用于大量任务和问题设置,如建筑物提取、平面图重建甚至线框解析。Re:PolyWorld不仅由于所提出的顶点与边的联合分析,在航拍图像的建筑物提取中优于原始模型,还在多个其他领域超越了当前最先进的方法。
abstract_en: While most state-of-the-art instance segmentation methods produce pixel-wise segmentation masks, numerous applications demand precise vector polygons of detected objects instead of rasterized output. This paper proposes Re:PolyWorld as a remastered and improved version of PolyWorld, a neural network that extracts object vertices from an image and connects them optimally to generate precise polygons. The objective of this work was to overcome weaknesses and shortcomings of the original model, as well as introducing an improved polygonal representation to obtain a general-purpose method for polygon extraction in images. The architecture has been redesigned to not only exploit vertex features, but to also make use of the visual appearance of edges. To this end, an edge-aware Graph Neural Network predicts the connection strength between each pair of vertices, which is further used to compute the assignment by solving a differentiable optimal transport problem. The proposed redefinition of the polygonal scene turns the method into a powerful generalized approach that can be applied to a large variety of tasks and problem settings, such as building extraction, floorplan reconstruction and even wireframe parsing. Re:PolyWorld not only outperforms the original model on building extraction in aerial images, thanks to the proposed joint analysis of vertices and edges, but also beats the state-of-the-art in multiple other domains.
authors: Stefano Zorzi, Friedrich Fraundorfer ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16762-16771

title: ReFit:用于三维人体重建的循环拟合网络
title_en: ReFit: Recurrent Fitting Network for 3D Human Recovery
abstract: 我们提出了一种名为ReFit的神经网络架构,用于单图像参数化三维人体重建。ReFit学习了一个反馈更新循环,该循环模拟了通过优化解决逆问题的策略。在每次迭代步骤中,它将人体模型的关键点重新投影到特征图中以查询反馈,并使用基于循环的更新器调整模型以更好地拟合图像。由于ReFit编码了强大的逆问题知识,因此其训练速度比之前的回归模型更快。同时,ReFit在标准基准测试中提升了最先进的性能。此外,ReFit还可应用于其他优化设置,如多视角拟合和单视角形状拟合。项目网站:https://yufu-wang.github.io/refit_humans/
abstract_en: We present Recurrent Fitting (ReFit), a neural network architecture for single-image, parametric 3D human reconstruction. ReFit learns a feedback-update loop that mirrors the strategy of solving an inverse problem through optimization. At each iterative step, it reprojects keypoints from the human model to feature maps to query feedback, and uses a recurrent-based updater to adjust the model to fit the image better. Because ReFit encodes strong knowledge of the inverse problem, it is faster to train than previous regression models. At the same time, ReFit improves state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks. Moreover, ReFit applies to other optimization settings, such as multi-view fitting and single-view shape fitting. Project website: https://yufu-wang.github.io/refit_humans/
authors: Yufu Wang, Kostas Daniilidis ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14644-14654

title: ReGen: 一个优秀的生成式零样本视频分类器应受到奖励
title_en: ReGen: A good Generative Zero-Shot Video Classifier Should be Rewarded
abstract: 本文旨在解决以下问题:如何将生成式视频描述模型转化为开放世界视频/动作分类模型?视频描述模型可以自然地生成给定视频的开放性自由形式描述,然而这些描述可能不足以用于视频/动作识别。不幸的是,当直接微调以自回归生成类别名称时,视频描述模型会过拟合基础类别,从而失去其开放世界零样本能力。为缓解基础类别过拟合问题,本文提出使用强化学习来增强视频描述模型输出的类级区分性。具体而言,我们提出ReGen,一个基于强化学习的创新框架,包含三重目标和奖励函数:(1) 类级区分奖励,强制生成的描述能够正确分类到对应动作类别;(2) CLIP奖励,鼓励生成的描述持续保持对输入视频的描述性(即视频特定性);(3) 语法奖励,保持描述的语法正确性。我们证明ReGen能够训练出生成具有区分性、视频特定性和语法正确的描述的模型。重要的是,当在零样本和少样本动作分类的标准基准测试中评估时,ReGen显著优于先前的最先进方法。
abstract_en: This paper sets out to solve the following problem: How can we turn a generative video captioning model into an open-world video/action classification model? Video captioning models can naturally produce open-ended free-form descriptions of a given video which, however, might not be discriminative enough for video/action recognition. Unfortunately, when fine-tuned to auto-regress the class names directly, video captioning models overfit the base classes losing their open-world zero-shot capabilities. To alleviate base class overfitting, in this work, we propose to use reinforcement learning to enforce the output of the video captioning model to be more class-level discriminative. Specifically, we propose ReGen, a novel reinforcement learning based framework with a three-fold objective and reward functions: (1) a class-level discrimination reward that enforces the generated caption to be correctly classified into the corresponding action class, (2) a CLIP reward that encourages the generated caption to continue to be descriptive of the input video (i.e. video-specific), and (3) a grammar reward that preserves the grammatical correctness of the caption. We show that ReGen can train a model to produce captions that are: discriminative, video-specific and grammatically correct. Importantly, when evaluated on standard benchmarks for zero- and few-shot action classification, ReGen significantly outperforms the previous state-of-the-art.
authors: Adrian Bulat, Enrique Sanchez, Brais Martinez, Georgios Tzimiropoulos ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13523-13533

title: ReLeaPS:基于强化学习的通用光度立体光照规划
title_en: ReLeaPS : Reinforcement Learning-based Illumination Planning for Generalized Photometric Stereo
abstract: 光度立体中的光照规划旨在通过选择最优光照配置,在表面法线估计精度与图像捕获效率之间取得平衡。该过程依赖于目标物体的未知形状和一般反射率、全局光照以及光度立体主干的选择等复杂因素,这些因素使得现有基于手工制定光照规划规则的方法难以处理。本文提出一种基于学习的光照规划方法,通过整合神经网络与通用图像形成模型,联合考虑上述因素。由于真实光照配置的搜索空间过于庞大,难以进行监督学习,因此我们将光照规划建模为强化学习问题,以光度立体感知和奖励驱动的方式探索光照空间。在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上的实验表明,使用我们方法的20个光照配置进行光度立体重建,其效果可与甚至优于使用所有可用方向光照配置的结果。
abstract_en: Illumination planning in photometric stereo aims to find a balance between tween surface normal estimation accuracy and image capturing efficiency by selecting optimal light configurations. It depends on factors such as the unknown shape and general reflectance of the target object, global illumination, and the choice of photometric stereo backbones, which are too complex to be handled by existing methods based on handcrafted illumination planning rules. This paper proposes a learning-based illumination planning method that jointly considers these factors via integrating a neural network and a generalized image formation model. As it is impractical to supervise illumination planning due to the enormous search space for ground truth light configurations, we formulate illumination planning using reinforcement learning, which explores the light space in a photometric stereo-aware and reward-driven manner. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that photometric stereo under the 20-light configurations from our method is comparable to, or even surpasses that of using lights from all available directions.
authors: Jun Hoong Chan, Bohan Yu, Heng Guo, Jieji Ren, Zongqing Lu, Boxin Shi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9167-9175

title: ReMoDiffuse:基于检索的运动扩散模型
title_en: ReMoDiffuse: Retrieval-Augmented Motion Diffusion Model
abstract: 三维人体运动生成对于创意产业至关重要。近期进展依赖于具有领域知识的生成模型进行文本驱动的运动生成,从而在捕捉常见运动方面取得了显著进展。然而,对于更多样化的运动,其性能仍不令人满意。在本工作中,我们提出ReMoDiffuse,这是一种基于扩散模型的运动生成框架,集成了检索机制以优化去噪过程。ReMoDiffuse通过三项关键设计增强文本驱动运动生成的泛化能力和多样性:1)混合检索从数据库中根据语义和运动学相似性找到合适的参考;2)语义调制变压器选择性吸收检索知识,适应检索样本与目标运动序列之间的差异;3)条件混合在推理过程中更有效地利用检索数据库,克服分类器无引导指导中的尺度敏感性。大量实验表明,\name通过在文本-运动一致性和运动质量之间取得平衡,优于现有最先进的方法,尤其是在更多样化的运动生成方面。
abstract_en: 3D human motion generation is crucial for creative industry. Recent advances rely on generative models with domain knowledge for text-driven motion generation, leading to substantial progress in capturing common motions. However, the performance on more diverse motions remains unsatisfactory. In this work, we propose ReMoDiffuse, a diffusion-model-based motion generation framework that integrates a retrieval mechanism to refine the denoising process. ReMoDiffuse enhances the generalizability and diversity of text-driven motion generation with three key designs:1) Hybrid Retrieval finds appropriate references from the database in terms of both semantic and kinematic similarities. 2) Semantic-Modulated Transformer selectively absorbs retrieval knowledge, adapting to the difference between retrieved samples and the target motion sequence. 3) Condition Mixture better utilizes the retrieval database during inference, overcoming the scale sensitivity in classifier-free guidance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \name outperforms state-of-the-art methods by balancing both text-motion consistency and motion quality, especially for more diverse motion generation.
authors: Mingyuan Zhang, Xinying Guo, Liang Pan, Zhongang Cai, Fangzhou Hong, Huirong Li, Lei Yang, Ziwei Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 364-373

title: ReNeRF:支持近场照明的可重新照明神经辐射场
title_en: ReNeRF: Relightable Neural Radiance Fields with Nearfield Lighting
abstract: 近期关于辐射场和体积逆渲染(如NeRF)的研究在构建具有高逼真度的新型视角合成数据驱动真实场景模型方面取得了优异成果。虽然实现了对视角的完全控制,但场景光照通常"烘焙"进模型中无法更改;其他方法仅能捕捉有限的光照变化或对捕捉场景做出限制性假设。这些局限性阻碍了其在任意材质和具有复杂、独特光照的新型三维环境中的应用。本文针对在受控摄影棚条件下捕捉高保真资产用于神经重新照明的应用场景,但无需密集的光照舞台。相反,我们利用摄影测量中常用的少量区域光源。我们提出ReNeRF,一种基于基于图像的重新照明直观且强大的方法的可重新照明辐射场模型,该方法隐式捕捉全局光照传输(适用于任意物体),无需复杂的、易出错的模拟。因此,我们的新方法简单且提供了对视角和光照的完全控制,无需对光照与场景相互作用的简单假设。此外,ReNeRF不依赖于通常的远距离光照假设——在训练过程中,我们明确考虑了体积中三维点与光源上采样点之间的距离。因此,在测试时,我们实现了对新型连续光照方向更好的泛化能力,包括近场照明效果。
abstract_en: Recent work on radiance fields and volumetric inverse rendering (e.g., NeRFs) has provided excellent results in building data-driven models of real scenes for novel view synthesis with high photorealism. While full control over viewpoint is achieved, scene lighting is typically "baked" into the model and cannot be changed; other methods only capture limited variation in lighting or make restrictive assumptions about the captured scene. These limitations prevent the application on arbitrary materials and novel 3D environments with complex, distinct lighting. In this paper, we target the application scenario of capturing high-fidelity assets for neural relighting in controlled studio conditions, but without requiring a dense light stage. Instead, we leverage a small number of area lights commonly used in photogrammetry. We propose ReNeRF, a relightable radiance field model based on the intuitive and powerful approach of image-based relighting, which implicitly captures global light transport (for arbitrary objects) without complex, error-prone simulations. Thus, our new method is simple and provides full control over viewpoint and lighting, without simplistic assumptions about how light interacts with the scene. In addition, ReNeRF does not rely on the usual assumption of distant lighting - during training, we explicitly account for the distance between 3D points in the volume and point samples on the light sources. Thus, at test time, we achieve better generalization to novel, continuous lighting directions, including nearfield lighting effects.
authors: Yingyan Xu, Gaspard Zoss, Prashanth Chandran, Markus Gross, Derek Bradley, Paulo Gotardo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22581-22591

title: ReST:一种用于多摄像机多目标跟踪的可重构时空图模型
title_en: ReST: A Reconfigurable Spatial-Temporal Graph Model for Multi-Camera Multi-Object Tracking
abstract: 多摄像机多目标跟踪(MC-MOT)利用多视角信息以更好地处理遮挡和拥挤场景问题。近年来,基于图的方法在解决跟踪问题方面变得非常流行。然而,许多现有基于图的方法未能有效利用空间和时间一致性信息,而是依赖单摄像机跟踪器作为输入,容易产生碎片化和ID切换错误。本文提出了一种新颖的可重构图模型,首先在空间上关联所有摄像机检测到的目标,随后将其重构为时间图进行时间关联。这种两阶段关联方法使我们能够提取鲁棒的空间和时间感知特征,并解决碎片化轨迹片段的问题。此外,我们的模型专为在线跟踪设计,适用于实际应用场景。实验结果表明,所提出的图模型能够提取更具判别性的目标跟踪特征,在多个公开数据集上实现了最先进性能。代码可在https://github.com/chengche6230/ReST获取。
abstract_en: Multi-Camera Multi-Object Tracking (MC-MOT) utilizes information from multiple views to better handle problems with occlusion and crowded scenes. Recently, the use of graph-based approaches to solve tracking problems has become very popular. However, many current graph-based methods do not effectively utilize information regarding spatial and temporal consistency. Instead, they rely on single-camera trackers as input, which are prone to fragmentation and ID switch errors. In this paper, we propose a novel reconfigurable graph model that first associates all detected objects across cameras spatially before reconfiguring it into a temporal graph for Temporal Association. This two-stage association approach enables us to extract robust spatial and temporal-aware features and address the problem with fragmented tracklets. Furthermore, our model is designed for online tracking, making it suitable for real-world applications. Experimental results show that the proposed graph model is able to extract more discriminating features for object tracking, and our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on several public datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/chengche6230/ReST.
authors: Cheng-Che Cheng, Min-Xuan Qiu, Chen-Kuo Chiang, Shang-Hong Lai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10051-10060

title: ReactioNet:通过二元关系推理从普遍刺激反应中学习高阶面部行为
title_en: ReactioNet: Learning High-Order Facial Behavior from Universal Stimulus-Reaction by Dyadic Relation Reasoning
abstract: 多样化的视觉刺激可引发不同的人类情感状态,这些状态通常表现为个体的肌肉动作和面部表情。在实验室控制的情感数据集中,这一关键成分(即刺激)通常以有限的方式设计,使研究者无法概括刺激反应的普遍相关性与因果性,也无法从上下文、时间点和关系中预测可能的情绪。本文我们收集了一个大规模的自发面部行为数据库ReactioNet,其中包含110万对耦合的刺激反应元组(来自刺激和受试者的视觉/音频/标题)。我们引入了一种新的面部行为检测场景——二元关系推理(DRR),旨在通过推理与刺激的关系来检测面部动作。通过聚合二元信息,我们的方法本质上形成了一种关系原型通用刺激反应(U-SR),该原型编码了刺激代理与面部反应之间的低阶和高阶关系。进一步开发了一个包含非图模块和图模块的框架,以评估基于DRR的面部动作单元检测、面部表情识别和场景分类。具体而言,为学习“什么”引发面部反应,非图模块利用跨域对比学习将细粒度的刺激反应特征关联并投影到公共子空间;为学习“如何”刺激反应相互关联,图模块采用图卷积网络在两种关系假设(即同质性与异质性)下表示、汇聚并推断二元U-SR关系。大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性。该新数据集将向研究社区开放。
abstract_en: Diverse visual stimuli can evoke various human affective states, which are usually manifested in an individual's muscular actions and facial expressions. In lab-controlled emotion datasets, such a critical component (i.e., stimulus) was commonly designed in a limited way, making researchers incapable of generalizing the universal correlation and causation of stimulus-reaction as well as predicting possible emotions from context, timing, and relation. In this paper, we collected a large-scale spontaneous facial behavior database ReactioNet, which contains 1.1 million coupled stimulus-reaction tuples (visual/audio/caption from both stimuli and subjects). We introduce a new facial behavior detection scenario, Dyadic Relation Reasoning (DRR), which aims to detect facial actions by reasoning their relations with stimuli. By aggregating the dyadic information, our method essentially forms a relation prototype Universal Stimulus Reaction (U-SR), which encodes the low-order and high-order relationships between stimulus agents and facial reactions. A framework with both non-graph and graph modules is further developed to evaluate DRR-based facial action unit detection, facial expression recognition, and scene classification. Specifically, to learn "what" arouses a facial reaction, the non-graph module associates and projects the fine-grained stimulus-reaction features into common subspaces using cross-domain contrastive learning. To learn "how" stimulus-reaction are mutually related, the graph module adopts Graph Convolution Network to represent, converge, and infer the dyadic U-SR relation under two relation assumptions (i.e., homophily and heterophily). Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed work. The new dataset will be available for the research community.
authors: Xiaotian Li, Taoyue Wang, Geran Zhao, Xiang Zhang, Xi Kang, Lijun Yin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20774-20785

title: 视觉-语言少样本学习的只读提示优化
title_en: Read-only Prompt Optimization for Vision-Language Few-shot Learning
abstract: 近年来,提示调优已被证明在将预训练视觉-语言模型适配到下游任务中具有有效性。这些方法旨在通过引入可学习提示来适配预训练模型,同时保持预训练权重冻结。然而,可学习提示可能会影响自注意力模块内的内部表示,这可能对性能方差和泛化能力产生负面影响,尤其是在数据匮乏的场景中。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新颖的方法——只读提示优化(RPO)。RPO利用掩码注意力来防止预训练模型内部表示的偏移。进一步地,为了促进RPO的优化,只读提示基于预训练模型的特殊标记进行初始化。我们的大量实验表明,RPO在基到新泛化和领域泛化方面优于CLIP和CoCoOp,同时展现出更好的鲁棒性。此外,所提出的方法在极端数据匮乏的场景中实现了更好的泛化能力,同时提升了参数效率和计算开销。代码已开源至https://github.com/mlvlab/RPO。
abstract_en:
In recent years, prompt tuning has proven effective in adapting pre-trained vision-language models to down- stream tasks. These methods aim to adapt the pre-trained models by introducing learnable prompts while keeping pre- trained weights frozen. However, learnable prompts can affect the internal representation within the self-attention module, which may negatively impact performance vari- ance and generalization, especially in data-deficient set- tings. To address these issues, we propose a novel ap- proach, Read-only Prompt Optimization (RPO). RPO lever- ages masked attention to prevent the internal representa- tion shift in the pre-trained model. Further, to facilitate the optimization of RPO, the read-only prompts are ini- tialized based on special tokens of the pre-trained model. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that RPO outper- forms CLIP and CoCoOp in base-to-new generalization and domain generalization while displaying better robust- ness. Also, the proposed method achieves better generaliza- tion on extremely data-deficient settings, while improving parameter efficiency and computational overhead. Code is
 available at https://github.com/mlvlab/RPO.
authors: Dongjun Lee, Seokwon Song, Jihee Suh, Joonmyeong Choi, Sanghyeok Lee, Hyunwoo J. Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1401-1411

title: 实时神经光栅化用于大场景
title_en: Real-Time Neural Rasterization for Large Scenes
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的方法,用于大规模场景的逼真实时新视角合成(NVS)。现有快速神经渲染方法能够生成逼真结果,但主要适用于小规模场景(<50平方米),在大规模场景(>10000平方米)中存在困难。传统基于图形的光栅化渲染在大规模场景中速度快,但缺乏真实感且需要昂贵的手动创建资产。我们的方法结合了两者的优点,以中等质量的骨架网格作为输入,学习神经纹理场和着色器以建模视角依赖效应来增强真实感,同时仍使用标准图形管线进行实时渲染。我们的方法优于现有神经渲染方法,在大规模自动驾驶和无人机场景中,提供了至少快30倍的渲染速度,且真实感相当或更优。我们的工作是首个实现大规模真实世界场景实时可视化的研究。
abstract_en: We propose a new method for realistic real-time novel-view synthesis (NVS) of large scenes. Existing fast neural rendering methods generate realistic results, but primarily work for small scale scenes (<50 square meter) and have difficulty at large scale (>10000 square meter). Traditional graphics-based rasterization rendering is fast for large scenes but lacks realism and requires expensive manually created assets. Our approach combines the best of both worlds by taking a moderate-quality scaffold mesh as input and learning a neural texture field and shader to model view-dependant effects to enhance realism, while still using the standard graphics pipeline for real-time rendering. Our method outperforms existing neural rendering methods, providing at least 30x faster rendering with comparable or better realism for large self-driving and drone scenes. Our work is the first to enable real-time visualization of large real-world scenes.
authors: Jeffrey Yunfan Liu, Yun Chen, Ze Yang, Jingkang Wang, Sivabalan Manivasagam, Raquel Urtasun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8416-8427

title: RealGraph: 一种面向四维真实世界上下文图生成的多视角数据集
title_en: RealGraph: A Multiview Dataset for 4D Real-world Context Graph Generation
abstract: 本文提出了一种全新的场景理解范式,称为"上下文图生成(CGG)",旨在抽象化复杂四维世界中的整体语义信息。CGG任务基于动态场景的校准多视角视频,目标是通过四维空间中的时空上下文图形式恢复呈现物体的语义信息(协调关系、轨迹和关联)。我们还提出了首个针对CGG任务的基准四维视频数据集"RealGraph"。RealGraph的原始数据由校准并同步的多视角视频组成。我们专门提供了包括物体2D&3D边界框、类别标签和语义关系的手动注释。我们确保每个物体的注释ID在时间和空间上保持一致。我们提出了首个CGG基线算法——基于多视角的上下文图生成网络(MCGNet),在RealGraph数据集上实证研究CGG任务的合法性。我们同时揭示了该任务背后的巨大挑战,并鼓励社区超越我们的解决方案。
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a brand new scene understanding paradigm called "Context Graph Generation (CGG)", aiming at abstracting holistic semantic information in the complicated 4D world. The CGG task capitalizes on the calibrated multiview videos of a dynamic scene, and targets at recovering semantic information (coordination, trajectories and relationships) of the presented objects in the form of spatio-temporal context graph in 4D space. We also present a benchmark 4D video dataset "RealGraph", the first dataset tailored for the proposed CGG task. The raw data of RealGraph is composed of calibrated and synchronized multiview videos. We exclusively provide manual annotations including object 2D&3D bounding boxes, category labels and semantic relationships. We also make sure the annotated ID for every single object is temporally and spatially consistent. We propose the first CGG baseline algorithm, Multiview-based Context Graph Generation Network (MCGNet), to empirically investigate the legitimacy of CGG task on RealGraph dataset. We nevertheless reveal the great challenges behind this task and encourage the community to explore beyond our solution.
authors: Haozhe Lin, Zequn Chen, Jinzhi Zhang, Bing Bai, Yu Wang, Ruqi Huang, Lu Fang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3758-3768

title: 基于关节级建模的稀疏观测全身真实追踪
title_en: Realistic Full-Body Tracking from Sparse Observations via Joint-Level Modeling
abstract: 为实现快速发展的VR/AR应用中物理世界与虚拟世界的衔接,真实驱动3D全身avatar的能力具有重要意义。尽管仅通过头戴显示设备(HMDs)和手柄进行实时身体追踪存在严重欠约束问题,但经过精心设计的端到端神经网络通过从大规模运动数据中学习,展现出解决该问题的巨大潜力。为此,我们提出一个两阶段框架,仅通过头部和手部的三个追踪信号即可获得准确且平滑的全身运动。我们的框架在第一阶段显式建模关节级特征,并将其作为时空标记用于交替的时空变换块,以在第二阶段捕捉关节级相关性。此外,我们设计了一组损失项来约束高自由度任务,从而充分挖掘关节级建模的潜力。在AMASS运动数据集和真实捕捉数据上的大量实验验证了我们设计的有效性,结果表明所提方法相比现有方法能够实现更准确且平滑的运动。
abstract_en: To bridge the physical and virtual worlds for rapidly developed VR/AR applications, the ability to realistically drive 3D full-body avatars is of great significance. Although real-time body tracking with only the head-mounted displays (HMDs) and hand controllers is heavily under-constrained, a carefully designed end-to-end neural network is of great potential to solve the problem by learning from large-scale motion data. To this end, we propose a two-stage framework that can obtain accurate and smooth full-body motions with the three tracking signals of head and hands only. Our framework explicitly models the joint-level features in the first stage and utilizes them as spatiotemporal tokens for alternating spatial and temporal transformer blocks to capture joint-level correlations in the second stage. Furthermore, we design a set of loss terms to constrain the task of a high degree of freedom, such that we can exploit the potential of our joint-level modeling. With extensive experiments on the AMASS motion dataset and real-captured data, we validate the effectiveness of our designs and show our proposed method can achieve more accurate and smooth motion compared to existing approaches.
authors: Xiaozheng Zheng, Zhuo Su, Chao Wen, Zhou Xue, Xiaojie Jin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14678-14688

title: RecRecNet:基于薄板样条模型和基于自由度的课程学习的宽角图像直角化
title_en: RecRecNet: Rectangling Rectified Wide-Angle Images by Thin-Plate Spline Model and DoF-based Curriculum Learning
abstract: 宽角镜头在VR技术中展现出广泛应用,但其捕获图像会引入严重的径向失真。为恢复真实场景,先前研究致力于校正宽角图像内容。然而,此类校正方案不可避免地扭曲图像边界,改变相关几何分布并误导当前视觉感知模型。本工作中,我们通过提出一种新的学习模型——直角化校正网络(RecRecNet),探索在内容与边界之间构建双赢表示。具体而言,我们提出薄板样条(TPS)模块以构建直角化图像的非线性和非刚性变换。通过学习校正图像的控制点,我们的模型可灵活地将源结构变形至目标域,实现端到端无监督变形。为缓解结构逼近的复杂性,我们进一步启发RecRecNet通过基于自由度(DoF)的课程学习逐步学习变形规则。通过在每个课程阶段增加自由度,即从相似变换(4-DoF)到单应性变换(8-DoF),网络能够探索更细致的变形,为最终直角化任务提供快速收敛。实验表明,我们的方法在定量和定性评估中均优于对比方法。代码和数据集将公开提供。
abstract_en: The wide-angle lens shows appealing applications in VR technologies, but it introduces severe radial distortion into its captured image. To recover the realistic scene, previous works devote to rectifying the content of the wide-angle image. However, such a rectification solution inevitably distorts the image boundary, which changes related geometric distributions and misleads the current vision perception models. In this work, we explore constructing a win-win representation on both content and boundary by contributing a new learning model, i.e., Rectangling Rectification Network (RecRecNet). In particular, we propose a thin-plate spline (TPS) module to formulate the non-linear and non-rigid transformation for rectangling images. By learning the control points on the rectified image, our model can flexibly warp the source structure to the target domain and achieves an end-to-end unsupervised deformation. To relieve the complexity of structure approximation, we then inspire our RecRecNet to learn the gradual deformation rules with a DoF (Degree of Freedom)-based curriculum learning. By increasing the DoF in each curriculum stage, namely, from similarity transformation (4-DoF) to homography transformation (8-DoF), the network is capable of investigating more detailed deformations, offering fast convergence on the final rectangling task. Experiments show the superiority of our solution over the compared methods on both quantitative and qualitative evaluations. The code and dataset will be made available.
authors: Kang Liao, Lang Nie, Chunyu Lin, Zishuo Zheng, Yao Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10800-10809

title: 协调对象级与全局级目标以实现长尾检测
title_en: Reconciling Object-Level and Global-Level Objectives for Long-Tail Detection
abstract: 大词汇量目标检测器常面临长尾标签分布问题,严重削弱其对罕见类别检测的能力。一方面,罕见目标易被误分类为高频类别;另一方面,由于每张图像的检测总数受限,检测器通常全局排序所有置信度得分并过滤低排名结果。这可能导致推理时漏检,尤其是对自然得分较低的罕见类别。现有方法主要关注前一问题,设计多种分类损失以提升对象级分类精度,却 largely overlooks 全局级排序任务。本文提出一种新型框架 Reconciles Object-level and Global-level (ROG),同时解决这两个问题。作为多任务学习框架,ROG同时训练模型完成两项任务:独立分类每个对象提案和全局排序所有置信度得分。具体而言,除对象级分类损失用于模型区分外,我们设计广义平均精度(GAP)损失显式优化跨对象的全局级得分排序。对每个类别,GAP损失生成平衡梯度以修正排序错误。实验表明,GAP损失可高度适配于各类先进方法并带来显著增益。
abstract_en: Large vocabulary object detectors are often faced with the long-tailed label distributions, seriously degrading their ability to detect rarely seen categories. On one hand, the rare objects are prone to be misclassified as frequent categories. On the other hand, due to the limitation on the total number of detections per image, detectors usually rank all the confidence scores globally and filter out the lower-ranking ones. This may result in missed detection during inference, especially for the rare categories that naturally come with lower scores. Existing methods mainly focus on the former problem and design various classification loss to enhance the object-level classification accuracy, but largely overlook the global-level ranking task. In this paper, we propose a novel framework that Reconciles Object-level and Global-level (ROG) objectives to address both problems. As a multi-task learning framework, ROG simultaneously trains the model with two tasks: classifying each object proposal individually and ranking all the confidence scores globally. Specifically, complementary to the object-level classification loss for model discrimination, we design a generalized average precision (GAP) loss to explicitly optimize the global-level score ranking across different objects. For each category, GAP loss generates balanced gradients to rectify the ranking errors. In experiments, we show that GAP loss is highly versatile to be plugged into various advanced methods and brings considerable benefits.
authors: Shaoyu Zhang, Chen Chen, Silong Peng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18982-18992

title: 基于重建卷积模块的查找表用于高效图像超分辨率
title_en: Reconstructed Convolution Module Based Look-Up Tables for Efficient Image Super-Resolution
abstract: 基于查找表(LUT)的方法在单图像超分辨率(SR)任务中表现出显著的效果。然而,先前的方法并未深入探讨LUT中受限感受野(RF)大小的根本原因,这源于标准卷积中空间和通道特征的相互作用。为了在保持查找表大小的前提下扩大感受野,我们提出了一种新颖的重建卷积(RC)模块,该模块解耦了通道和空间计算。该模块可表示为n2个1D查找表,以维持n×n的感受野,这显然比之前提出的n×n D查找表更小。由我们的RC模块生成的查找表存储量仅为SR-LUT基线的1/10000以下。所提出的基于重建卷积模块的查找表方法(称为RCLUT)可将感受野大小扩大9倍,优于最先进的基于查找表的超分辨率方法,并在五个流行的基准数据集上表现出色。此外,高效且鲁棒的RC模块可作为插件用于提升其他基于查找表的超分辨率方法。代码可在https://github.com/RC-LUT/RC-LUT.git获取。
abstract_en:
Look-up table (LUT)-based methods have shown the great efficacy in single image super-resolution (SR) task. 
 However, previous methods don't delve into the essential reason of restricted receptive field (RF) size in LUT, which is caused by the interaction of space and channel features in vanilla convolution.
 To enlarge RF with contained LUT sizes, we propose a novel Reconstructed Convolution(RC) module, which decouples channel-wise and spatial calculation. It can be formulated as n^2 1D LUTs to maintain nxn receptive field, which is obviously smaller than nxn D LUT formulated before. The LUT generated by our RC module reaches less than 1/10000 storage compared with SR-LUT baseline. The proposed Reconstructed Convolution module based LUT method, termed as RCLUT, can enlarge the RF size by 9 times than the state-of-the-art LUT-based SR method and achieve superior performance on five popular benchmark dataset. Moreover, the efficient and robust RC module can be used as a plugin to improve other LUT-based SR methods. The code is available at https://github.com/RC-LUT/RC-LUT.git.
authors: Guandu Liu, Yukang Ding, Mading Li, Ming Sun, Xing Wen, Bin Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12217-12226

title: 基于超图关系推理的人群群体重建
title_en: Reconstructing Groups of People with Hypergraph Relational Reasoning
abstract: 由于相互遮挡、严重尺度变化和复杂空间分布,现有的多人体网格恢复方法在大规模拥挤场景中无法生成精确的绝对身体姿态和形状。为解决这一问题,我们充分利用人群特征,从单目图像中重建人群群体。提出了一种新颖的超图关系推理网络,用于建模人群中的个体与群体之间复杂的高阶关系关联。我们首先从原始高分辨率图像中提取紧凑的人体特征和位置信息。通过对提取的个体特征进行关系推理,底层人群集体性和交互关系可为重建提供额外的群体信息。最后,利用更新后的个体特征和定位信息回归相机坐标系下的人体网格。为促进网络训练,我们进一步在两个人群数据集上构建伪真实标注,这可能也推动未来拥挤场景中姿态估计和人体行为理解的研究。实验结果表明,我们的方法在拥挤场景和常规场景中均优于其他基线方法。代码和数据集已公开在https://github.com/boycehbz/GroupRec。
abstract_en: Due to the mutual occlusion, severe scale variation, and complex spatial distribution, the current multi-person mesh recovery methods cannot produce accurate absolute body poses and shapes in large-scale crowded scenes. To address the obstacles, we fully exploit crowd features for reconstructing groups of people from a monocular image. A novel hypergraph relational reasoning network is proposed to formulate the complex and high-order relation correlations among individuals and groups in the crowd. We first extract compact human features and location information from the original high-resolution image. By conducting the relational reasoning on the extracted individual features, the underlying crowd collectiveness and interaction relationship can provide additional group information for the reconstruction. Finally, the updated individual features and the localization information are used to regress human meshes in camera coordinates. To facilitate the network training, we further build pseudo ground-truth on two crowd datasets, which may also promote future research on pose estimation and human behavior understanding in crowded scenes. The experimental results show that our approach outperforms other baseline methods both in crowded and common scenarios. The code and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/boycehbz/GroupRec.
authors: Buzhen Huang, Jingyi Ju, Zhihao Li, Yangang Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14873-14883

title: 从单目图像中利用交互先验重建交互手
title_en: Reconstructing Interacting Hands with Interaction Prior from Monocular Images
abstract: 从单目图像中重建交互手对于AR/VR应用至关重要。现有大多数方法依赖于每个骨骼关节的精确定位。然而,这些方法由于严重遮挡和相邻手部部件的相似性混淆而往往不可靠。这也违背了人类感知,因为人类可以在不定位所有关节的情况下快速模仿交互模式。我们的核心思想是首先构建双手交互先验,并将交互重建任务重新表述为从先验中的条件采样。为扩展更多交互状态,提出了一种具有物理合理性的大规模多模态数据集。随后训练变分自编码器(VAE),进一步将这些交互模式压缩为先验分布中的潜在编码。在寻找对交互先验采样有贡献的图像线索时,我们提出交互邻接热图(IAH)。与用于定位的关节级热图相比,IAH为不可见关节分配更密集的可见特征。与整体可见热图相比,它在每个交互区域提供更细粒度的局部交互信息。最后,通过视觉Transformer(ViT)模块将提取的特征与对应的交互编码之间的相关性进行关联。在基准数据集上的综合评估验证了该框架的有效性。代码和数据集已公开在:https://github.com/binghui-z/InterPrior_pytorch。
abstract_en: Reconstructing interacting hands from monocular images is indispensable in AR/VR applications. Most existing solutions rely on the accurate localization of each skeleton joint. However, these methods tend to be unreliable due to the severe occlusion and confusing similarity among adjacent hand parts. This also defies human perception because humans can quickly imitate an interaction pattern without localizing all joints. Our key idea is to first construct a two-hand interaction prior and recast the interaction reconstruction task as the conditional sampling from the prior. To expand more interaction states, a large-scale multimodal dataset with physical plausibility is proposed. Then a VAE is trained to further condense these interaction patterns as latent codes in a prior distribution. When looking for image cues that contribute to interaction prior sampling, we propose the interaction adjacency heatmap (IAH). Compared with a joint-wise heatmap for localization, IAH assigns denser visible features to those invisible joints. Compared with an all-in-one visible heatmap, it provides more fine-grained local interaction information in each interaction region. Finally, the correlations between the extracted features and corresponding interaction codes are linked by the ViT module. Comprehensive evaluations on benchmark datasets have verified the effectiveness of this framework. The code and dataset are publicly available at: https://github.com/binghui-z/InterPrior_pytorch.
authors: Binghui Zuo, Zimeng Zhao, Wenqian Sun, Wei Xie, Zhou Xue, Yangang Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9054-9064

title: 从液相电子显微镜电影中重建分子的三维动态
title_en: Recovering a Molecule's 3D Dynamics from Liquid-phase Electron Microscopy Movies
abstract: 生物分子的动态特性对于理解其在生命系统中的功能至关重要。然而,当前的三维成像技术(如冷冻电镜)需要对样品进行冷冻处理,这限制了对其构象变化的实时观测。创新的液相电子显微镜(liquid-phase EM)技术能够将分子置于其天然的液相环境中,为观测其动态特性提供了独特机会。本文提出TEMPOR算法,这是一种面向液相电镜的时序电子显微镜物体重建算法,利用隐式神经表示(INR)和动态变分自编码器(DVAE)来恢复分子结构的时间序列。我们在两个模拟数据集7bcq和Cas9上展示了该方法在恢复不同运动动态方面的优势。据我们所知,本工作是首个直接从液相电镜电影中恢复时变粒子三维结构的尝试。它为结构生物学中研究分子的三维动态提供了有前景的新方法。
abstract_en: The dynamics of biomolecules are crucial for our understanding of their functioning in living systems. However, current 3D imaging techniques, such as cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM), require freezing the sample, which limits the observation of their conformational changes in real time. The innovative liquid-phase electron microscopy (liquid-phase EM) technique allows molecules to be placed in the native liquid environment, providing a unique opportunity to observe their dynamics. In this paper, we propose TEMPOR, a Temporal Electron MicroscoPy Object Reconstruction algorithm for liquid-phase EM that leverages an implicit neural representation (INR) and a dynamical variational auto-encoder (DVAE) to recover time series of molecular structures. We demonstrate its advantages in recovering different motion dynamics from two simulated datasets, 7bcq and Cas9. To our knowledge, our work is the first attempt to directly recover 3D structures of a temporally-varying particle from liquid-phase EM movies. It provides a promising new approach for studying molecules' 3D dynamics in structural biology.
authors: Enze Ye, Yuhang Wang, Hong Zhang, Yiqin Gao, Huan Wang, He Sun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10767-10777

title: 递归视频车道检测
title_en: Recursive Video Lane Detection
abstract: 本文提出了一种新型视频车道检测算法,称为递归视频车道检测器(RVLD),该算法通过递归传播当前帧的状态到下一帧。RVLD由帧内车道检测器(ILD)和预测车道检测器(PLD)组成。首先,我们设计ILD以在静态帧中定位车道。其次,我们开发PLD以利用前一帧的信息进行当前帧的车道检测。为此,我们估计运动场并将前一帧的输出变形到当前帧。利用变形后的信息,我们优化当前帧的特征图以更可靠地检测车道。实验结果表明,RVLD在视频车道数据集上优于现有检测器。我们的代码可在https://github.com/dongkwonjin/RVLD获取。
abstract_en: A novel algorithm to detect road lanes in videos, called recursive video lane detector (RVLD), is proposed in this paper, which propagates the state of a current frame recursively to the next frame. RVLD consists of an intra-frame lane detector (ILD) and a predictive lane detector (PLD). First, we design ILD to localize lanes in a still frame. Second, we develop PLD to exploit the information of the previous frame for lane detection in a current frame. To this end, we estimate a motion field and warp the previous output to the current frame. Using the warped information, we refine the feature map of the current frame to detect lanes more reliably. Experimental results show that RVLD outperforms existing detectors on video lane datasets. Our codes are available at https://github.com/dongkwonjin/RVLD.
authors: Dongkwon Jin, Dahyun Kim, Chang-Su Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8473-8482

title: RecursiveDet: 端到端基于区域的递归目标检测
title_en: RecursiveDet: End-to-End Region-Based Recursive Object Detection
abstract: 像Sparse R-CNN这样的端到端基于区域的目标检测器通常包含多个级联边界框解码阶段,这些阶段会根据前一阶段的结果细化当前预测。每个阶段内的模型参数相互独立,导致巨大的计算成本。本文发现解码阶段的一般设置实际上是冗余的。通过简单地共享参数并构建递归解码器,检测器即可获得显著性能提升。进一步地,通过提案框的位置编码(PE)可以增强递归解码器,使其感知输入边界框的精确位置和尺寸,从而在递归过程中适应不同阶段的提案。此外,我们还设计了基于中心度的位置编码,以区分边界框内不同位置的RoI特征元素和动态卷积核。为验证所提方法的有效性,我们进行了大量消融实验,并在三个近期主流的基于区域的检测器上构建完整模型。RecursiveDet在模型参数更少且计算成本略有增加的情况下,能够实现明显的性能提升。
abstract_en: End-to-end region-based object detectors like Sparse R-CNN usually have multiple cascade bounding box decoding stages, which refine the current predictions according to their previous results. Model parameters within each stage are independent, evolving a huge cost. In this paper, we find the general setting of decoding stages is actually redundant. By simply sharing parameters and making a recursive decoder, the detector already obtains a significant improvement. The recursive decoder can be further enhanced by positional encoding (PE) of the proposal box, which makes it aware of the exact locations and sizes of input bounding boxes, thus becoming adaptive to proposals from different stages during the recursion. Moreover, we also design centerness-based PE to distinguish the RoI feature element and dynamic convolution kernels at different positions within the bounding box. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, we conduct intensive ablations and build the full model on three recent mainstream region-based detectors. The RecusiveDet is able to achieve obvious performance boosts with even fewer model parameters and slightly increased computation cost.
authors: Jing Zhao, Li Sun, Qingli Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6307-6316

title: 利用多图拓扑结构减少跨数据孤岛联邦学习的训练时间
title_en: Reducing Training Time in Cross-Silo Federated Learning Using Multigraph Topology
abstract: 联邦学习由于能够使多个参与者在不共享本地数据的情况下共同训练模型,已成为一个活跃的研究领域。目前,跨数据孤岛联邦学习是一种流行的训练设置,它利用数百个可靠的数据孤岛和高速访问链路来训练模型。尽管这种方法已在实际场景中广泛应用,但设计一种能够减少训练时间的稳健拓扑结构仍然是一个开放性问题。本文提出了一种新的多图拓扑结构用于跨数据孤岛联邦学习。我们首先使用覆盖图构建多图,然后将该多图解析为包含孤立节点的不同简单图。孤立节点的存在使我们能够在无需等待其他节点的情况下执行模型聚合,从而有效减少训练时间。在三个公开数据集上的大量实验表明,与最近最先进的拓扑结构相比,所提出的方法显著减少了训练时间,同时保持了所学模型的准确性。
abstract_en: Federated learning is an active research topic since it enables several participants to jointly train a model without sharing local data. Currently, cross-silo federated learning is a popular training setting that utilizes a few hundred reliable data silos with high-speed access links to training a model. While this approach has been widely applied in real-world scenarios, designing a robust topology to reduce the training time remains an open problem. In this paper, we present a new multigraph topology for cross-silo federated learning. We first construct the multigraph using the overlay graph. We then parse this multigraph into different simple graphs with isolated nodes. The existence of isolated nodes allows us to perform model aggregation without waiting for other nodes, hence effectively reducing the training time. Intensive experiments on three public datasets show that our proposed method significantly reduces the training time compared with recent state-of-the-art topologies while maintaining the accuracy of the learned model.
authors: Tuong Do, Binh X. Nguyen, Vuong Pham, Toan Tran, Erman Tjiputra, Quang D. Tran, Anh Nguyen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19409-19419

title: Ref-NeuS:面向带反射多视角重建的歧义减少神经隐式曲面学习
title_en: Ref-NeuS: Ambiguity-Reduced Neural Implicit Surface Learning for Multi-View Reconstruction with Reflection
abstract: 神经隐式曲面学习在多视角三维重建中取得了显著进展,其中物体通过多层感知机表示,提供连续隐式曲面表示和视角依赖的辐射度。然而,现有方法常难以准确重建反射表面,导致严重歧义。为解决这一问题,我们提出Ref-NeuS,旨在通过减弱反射表面的影响来降低歧义。具体而言,我们利用异常检测器结合多视角上下文估计显式的反射得分以定位反射表面。随后,我们设计了一种反射感知的光度损失,通过将渲染颜色建模为高斯分布,以反射得分为方差,自适应地减少歧义。我们证明,结合反射方向依赖的辐射度,我们的模型在反射表面上实现了高质量的曲面重建,并在多个基准测试中显著超越了现有最先进方法。此外,我们的模型在一般表面上也具有竞争力。
abstract_en: Neural implicit surface learning has shown significant progress in multi-view 3D reconstruction, where an object is represented by multilayer perceptrons that provide continuous implicit surface representation and view-dependent radiance. However, current methods often fail to accurately reconstruct reflective surfaces, leading to severe ambiguity. To overcome this issue, we propose Ref-NeuS, which aims to reduce ambiguity by attenuating the effect of reflective surfaces. Specifically, we utilize an anomaly detector to estimate an explicit reflection score with the guidance of multi-view context to localize reflective surfaces. Afterward, we design a reflection-aware photometric loss that adaptively reduces ambiguity by modeling rendered color as a Gaussian distribution, with the reflection score representing the variance. We show that together with a reflection direction-dependent radiance, our model achieves high-quality surface reconstruction on reflective surfaces and outperforms the state-of-the-arts by a large margin. Besides, our model is also comparable on general surfaces.
authors: Wenhang Ge, Tao Hu, Haoyu Zhao, Shu Liu, Ying-Cong Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4251-4260

title: RefEgo: 基于Ego4D第一人称感知的指称表达理解数据集
title_en: RefEgo: Referring Expression Comprehension Dataset from First-Person Perception of Ego4D
abstract: 在第一人称视角下将文本表达与场景物体进行关联是一项真正具有挑战性的能力,这对于能够感知环境并遵循直观文本指令的智能体开发至关重要。这种能力对于玻璃设备或自主机器人在现实世界中定位所指物体是必不可少的。然而,在传统的图像指称表达理解任务中,数据集多基于网络爬取数据,未能反映现实世界中多样化的结构,难以有效支持在不同物体上进行文本表达的场景理解。近期,Ego4D提出了一种大规模的以自我为中心的视频数据集,覆盖全球范围内的多样化现实场景,包括购物、烹饪、行走、交谈、制造等众多室内外情境。基于Ego4D的以自我为中心视频,我们构建了一个基于视频的指称表达理解数据集RefEgo,该数据集包含超过12000个视频片段和41小时的视频指称表达理解标注。实验中,我们将最先进的2D指称表达理解模型与目标跟踪算法相结合,实现了视频级的所指物体跟踪,即使在困难条件下(如所指物体在视频中间移出画面或视频中出现多个相似物体)也能有效工作。
abstract_en:
Grounding textual expressions on scene objects from first-person views is a truly demanding capability in developing agents that are aware of their surroundings and behave following intuitive text instructions. Such capability is of necessity for glass-devices or autonomous robots to localize referred objects in the real-world. In the conventional referring expression comprehension tasks of images, however, datasets are mostly constructed based on the web-crawled data and don't reflect diverse real-world structures on the task of grounding textual expressions in diverse objects in the real world. Recently, a massive-scale egocentric video dataset of Ego4D was proposed. Ego4D covers around the world diverse real-world scenes including numerous indoor and outdoor situations such as shopping, cooking, walking, talking, manufacturing, etc. Based on egocentric videos of Ego4D, we constructed a broad coverage of the video-based referring expression comprehension dataset: RefEgo. Our dataset includes more than 12k video clips and 41 hours for video-based referring expression comprehension annotation.
 In experiments, we combine the state-of-the-art 2D referring expression comprehension models with the object tracking algorithm, achieving the video-wise referred object tracking even in difficult conditions: the referred object becomes out-of-frame in the middle of the video or multiple similar objects are presented in the video.
authors: Shuhei Kurita, Naoki Katsura, Eri Onami ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15214-15224

title: 基于参考的可控神经辐射场修复
title_en: Reference-guided Controllable Inpainting of Neural Radiance Fields
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRFs)在视图合成中的流行促使了对NeRF编辑工具的需求。本文聚焦于以视图一致且可控的方式进行区域修复。除了典型的NeRF输入和在每个视图中界定不需要区域的掩码外,我们仅需要一个修复的视图,即参考视图。我们使用单目深度估计器将修复的视图反投影到正确的3D位置。随后,通过一种新颖的渲染技术,双边求解器可以在非参考视图中构建视图依赖效果,使修复区域从任意视角看起来一致。对于无法由单个参考视图监督的非参考遮挡区域,我们设计了一种基于图像修复器的方法来同时引导几何结构和外观特征。我们的方法在NeRF修复基线方法上表现出更优的性能,且具有额外优势:用户可通过单个修复图像控制生成场景。
abstract_en: The popularity of Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) for view synthesis has led to a desire for NeRF editing tools. Here, we focus on inpainting regions in a view-consistent and controllable manner. In addition to the typical NeRF inputs and masks delineating the unwanted region in each view, we require only a single inpainted view of the scene, i.e., a reference view. We use monocular depth estimators to back-project the inpainted view to the correct 3D positions. Then, via a novel rendering technique, a bilateral solver can construct view-dependent effects in non-reference views, making the inpainted region appear consistent from any view. For non-reference disoccluded regions, which cannot be supervised by the single reference view, we devise a method based on image inpainters to guide both the geometry and appearance. Our approach shows superior performance to NeRF inpainting baselines, with the additional advantage that a user can control the generated scene via a single inpainted image.
authors: Ashkan Mirzaei, Tristan Aumentado-Armstrong, Marcus A. Brubaker, Jonathan Kelly, Alex Levinshtein, Konstantinos G. Derpanis, Igor Gilitschenski ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17815-17825

title: 基于文本监督的引用图像分割
title_en: Referring Image Segmentation Using Text Supervision
abstract: 现有引用图像分割(RIS)方法通常需要昂贵的像素级或框级标注进行监督。本文观察到,RIS中使用的引用文本已能提供足够的信息以定位目标对象。因此,我们提出了一种新颖的弱监督RIS框架,将目标定位问题建模为分类过程,以区分正负文本表达。对于图像的引用文本表达作为正样本表达,其他图像的引用文本表达可作为该图像的负样本表达。我们的框架有三个主要创新点。首先,我们提出了一种双边提示方法,通过协调视觉特征与语言特征之间的领域差异来促进分类过程。其次,我们提出了一种校准方法,以减少噪声背景信息并提高目标对象定位的响应图正确性。第三,我们提出了一种正响应图选择策略,从增强的响应图中生成高质量的伪标签,用于训练RIS推理的分割网络。在评估方面,我们提出了一种新的度量标准来衡量定位准确性。在四个基准数据集上的实验表明,我们的框架在性能上与现有全监督RIS方法相当,同时超越了从相关领域迁移的最先进弱监督方法。代码可在https://github.com/fawnliu/TRIS获取。
abstract_en: Existing Referring Image Segmentation (RIS) methods typically require expensive pixel-level or box-level annotations for supervision. In this paper, we observe that the referring texts used in RIS already provide sufficient information to localize the target object. Hence, we propose a novel weakly-supervised RIS framework to formulate the target localization problem as a classification process to differentiate between positive and negative text expressions. While the referring text expressions for an image are used as positive expressions, the referring text expressions from other images can be used as negative expressions for this image. Our framework has three main novelties. First, we propose a bilateral prompt method to facilitate the classification process, by harmonizing the domain discrepancy between visual and linguistic features. Second, we propose a calibration method to reduce noisy background information and improve the correctness of the response maps for target object localization. Third, we propose a positive response map selection strategy to generate high-quality pseudo-labels from the enhanced response maps, for training a segmentation network for RIS inference. For evaluation, we propose a new metric to measure localization accuracy. Experiments on four benchmarks show that our framework achieves promising performances to existing fully-supervised RIS methods while outperforming state-of-the-art weakly-supervised methods adapted from related areas. Code is available at https://github.com/fawnliu/TRIS.
authors: Fang Liu, Yuhao Liu, Yuqiu Kong, Ke Xu, Lihe Zhang, Baocai Yin, Gerhard Hancke, Rynson Lau ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22124-22134

title: RegFormer:一种高效的投影感知Transformer网络用于大规模点云配准
title_en: RegFormer: An Efficient Projection-Aware Transformer Network for Large-Scale Point Cloud Registration
abstract: 尽管点云配准在物体级和室内场景中取得了显著进展,但大规模配准方法仍鲜有探索。挑战主要源于户外激光雷达扫描中巨大的点数、复杂的分布和异常值。此外,大多数现有配准工作通常采用两阶段范式:首先通过提取判别性局部特征寻找对应关系,然后利用估计器(如RANSAC)过滤异常值,这高度依赖于精心设计的描述符和后处理选择。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种无需进一步后处理的端到端Transformer网络(RegFormer)用于大规模点云对齐。具体而言,提出了一种投影感知的层次化Transformer,通过全局提取点特征来捕捉长程依赖关系并过滤异常值。我们的Transformer具有线性复杂度,即使在大规模场景中也能保证高效率。此外,为有效减少误匹配,设计了一种双射关联Transformer用于回归初始变换。在KITTI和NuScenes数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的RegFormer在准确性和效率方面均表现出竞争力。代码可在https://github.com/IRMVLab/RegFormer获取。
abstract_en: Although point cloud registration has achieved remarkable advances in object-level and indoor scenes, large-scale registration methods are rarely explored. Challenges mainly arise from the huge point number, complex distribution, and outliers of outdoor LiDAR scans. In addition, most existing registration works generally adopt a two-stage paradigm: They first find correspondences by extracting discriminative local features and then leverage estimators (eg. RANSAC) to filter outliers, which are highly dependent on well-designed descriptors and post-processing choices. To address these problems, we propose an end-to-end transformer network (RegFormer) for large-scale point cloud alignment without any further post-processing. Specifically, a projection-aware hierarchical transformer is proposed to capture long-range dependencies and filter outliers by extracting point features globally. Our transformer has linear complexity, which guarantees high efficiency even for large-scale scenes. Furthermore, to effectively reduce mismatches, a bijective association transformer is designed for regressing the initial transformation. Extensive experiments on KITTI and NuScenes datasets demonstrate that our RegFormer achieves competitive performance in terms of both accuracy and efficiency. Codes are available at https://github.com/IRMVLab/RegFormer.
authors: Jiuming Liu, Guangming Wang, Zhe Liu, Chaokang Jiang, Marc Pollefeys, Hesheng Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8451-8460

title: 正则化掩码调优:揭示预训练视觉-语言模型中的隐藏知识
title_en: Regularized Mask Tuning: Uncovering Hidden Knowledge in Pre-Trained Vision-Language Models
abstract: 提示调优和适配器调优在将预训练视觉-语言模型(VLMs)迁移至各类下游任务中展现出巨大潜力。本文设计了一种新型调优方法,称为正则化掩码调优,其通过可学习选择机制对网络参数进行掩码处理。受神经通路启发,我们认为下游任务所需的知识已存在于预训练权重中,只是在上游预训练阶段被隐藏。为使有用知识重现,我们首先识别出对特定下游任务关键的参数集合,随后为每个参数附加二值掩码,并在冻结参数的情况下,利用下游数据对这些掩码进行优化。在更新掩码时,我们引入新颖的梯度丢弃策略以正则化参数选择,从而防止模型遗忘旧知识并过拟合下游数据。在11个数据集上的实验结果表明,我们的方法相较以往方法具有持续优势。值得注意的是,通过仅平均掩码2.56%的参数,我们便实现了相较零样本CLIP 18.73%的性能提升。此外,我们的方法与大多数现有参数高效调优方法具有协同效应,可进一步提升其性能。代码将公开发布。
abstract_en: Prompt tuning and adapter tuning have shown great potential in transferring pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) to various downstream tasks. In this work, we design a new type of tuning method, termed as regularized mask tuning, which masks the network parameters through a learnable selection. Inspired by neural pathways, we argue that the knowledge required by a downstream task already exists in the pre-trained weights but just gets concealed in the upstream pre-training stage. To bring the useful knowledge back into light, we first identify a set of parameters that are important to a given downstream task, then attach a binary mask to each parameter, and finally optimize these masks on the downstream data with the parameters frozen. When updating the mask, we introduce a novel gradient dropout strategy to regularize the parameter selection, in order to prevent the model from forgetting old knowledge and overfitting the downstream data. Experimental results on 11 datasets demonstrate the consistent superiority of our method over previous alternatives. It is noteworthy that we manage to deliver 18.73% performance improvement compared to the zero-shot CLIP via masking an average of only 2.56% parameters. Furthermore, our method is synergistic with most existing parameter-efficient tuning methods and can boost the performance on top of them. Code will be made publicly available.
authors: Kecheng Zheng, Wei Wu, Ruili Feng, Kai Zhu, Jiawei Liu, Deli Zhao, Zheng-Jun Zha, Wei Chen, Yujun Shen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11663-11673

title: 面向统一矢量映射的正则化原始图学习
title_en: Regularized Primitive Graph Learning for Unified Vector Mapping
abstract: 大规模矢量映射是交通和城市规划的基础。现有大多数映射方法由于对形状正则化和拓扑重建的任务特定需求,通常针对单一映射任务进行定制化设计。我们提出GraphMapper,一个用于从卫星图像中端到端提取矢量地图的统一框架。我们的核心思想是将原始图作为矢量地图的统一表示,并将形状正则化和拓扑重建建模为原始图重建问题,从而在统一框架中求解。具体而言,形状正则化被建模为原始方向与其成对关系之间的一致性。基于原始图,我们设计了一种学习方法,分阶段重建原始图。GraphMapper能够充分挖掘原始元素级和成对信息,用于形状正则化和拓扑重建,从而提升原始图学习能力。我们在两个具有挑战性的映射任务(建筑物轮廓和道路网络)上实证验证了GraphMapper的有效性。在共享大部分架构设计和少量任务特定设计的前提下,我们的模型在公开基准测试中均优于现有最先进方法。我们的代码将公开可用。
abstract_en: Large-scale vector mapping is the foundation for transportation and urban planning. Most existing mapping methods are tailored to one specific mapping task, due to task-specific requirements on shape regularization and topology reconstruction. We propose GraphMapper, a unified framework for end-to-end vector map extraction from satellite images. Our key idea is using primitive graph as a unified representation of vector maps and formulating shape regularization and topology reconstruction as primitive graph reconstruction problems that can be solved in the same framework. Specifically, shape regularization is modeled as the consistency between primitive directions and their pairwise relationship. Based on the primitive graph, we design a learning approach to reconstruct primitive graphs in multiple stages. GraphMapper can fully explore primitive-wise and pairwise information for shape regularization and topology reconstruction, resulting improved primitive graph learning capabilities. We empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of GraphMapper on two challenging mapping tasks for building footprints and road networks. With the premise of sharing the majority design of the architecture and a few task-specific designs, our model outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both tasks on public benchmarks. Our code will be publicly available.
authors: Lei Wang, Min Dai, Jianan He, Jingwei Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16817-16826

title: 无需回放的领域持续人脸防伪:提升泛化能力,减少遗忘
title_en: Rehearsal-Free Domain Continual Face Anti-Spoofing: Generalize More and Forget Less
abstract: 人脸防伪(FAS)最近在持续学习框架下进行了研究,其中FAS模型在遇到新领域数据后需要持续进化。然而,现有方法需要额外的回放缓冲区来存储先前数据以进行回放,当因隐私问题导致先前数据不可用时,这种方法变得不可行。在本文中,我们提出了首个无需回放的领域持续学习(DCL)方法,用于FAS,该方法同时解决灾难性遗忘和未见领域泛化问题。为提升对未见领域的泛化能力,我们设计了动态中心差分卷积适配器(DCDCA),在持续学习过程中适配视觉Transformer(ViT)模型。为在不使用先前数据的情况下缓解先前领域遗忘,我们提出了代理原型对比正则化(PPCR),通过代理原型中的先前领域知识约束持续学习。模拟实际DCL场景,我们设计了两种新协议,用于评估模型的泛化能力和抗遗忘性能。大量实验结果表明,所提方法可提升对未见领域的泛化性能,并缓解先前知识的灾难性遗忘。代码和协议文件已发布于https://github.com/RizhaoCai/DCL-FAS-ICCV2023。
abstract_en: Face Anti-Spoofing (FAS) is recently studied under the continual learning setting, where the FAS models are expected to evolve after encountering data from new domains. However, existing methods need extra replay buffers to store previous data for rehearsal, which becomes infeasible when previous data is unavailable because of privacy issues. In this paper, we propose the first rehearsal-free method for Domain Continual Learning (DCL) of FAS, which deals with catastrophic forgetting and unseen domain generalization problems simultaneously. For better generalization to unseen domains, we design the Dynamic Central Difference Convolutional Adapter (DCDCA) to adapt Vision Transformer (ViT) models during the continual learning sessions. To alleviate the forgetting of previous domains without using previous data, we propose the Proxy Prototype Contrastive Regularization (PPCR) to constrain the continual learning with previous domain knowledge from the proxy prototypes. Simulating practical DCL scenarios, we devise two new protocols which evaluate both generalization and anti-forgetting performance. Extensive experimental results show that our proposed method can improve the generalization performance in unseen domains and alleviate the catastrophic forgetting of previous knowledge. The code and protocol files are released on https://github.com/RizhaoCai/DCL-FAS-ICCV2023.
authors: Rizhao Cai, Yawen Cui, Zhi Li, Zitong Yu, Haoliang Li, Yongjian Hu, Alex Kot ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8037-8048

title: 强化数据,倍增影响:通过数据强化提升模型精度与鲁棒性
title_en: Reinforce Data, Multiply Impact: Improved Model Accuracy and Robustness with Dataset Reinforcement
abstract: 我们提出了一种数据强化策略,旨在通过一次改进数据集,使得在强化后的数据集上训练的任何模型架构的准确率得到提升,而无需用户进行额外的训练成本。我们提出了一种基于数据增强和知识蒸馏的数据强化策略。我们的通用策略是基于对CNN和Transformer模型的广泛分析,并进行了大规模的蒸馏研究,结合各种数据增强方法和最先进的模型。我们创建了ImageNet训练数据集的强化版本,称为ImageNet+,以及CIFAR-100+、Flowers-102+和Food-101+等强化数据集。使用ImageNet+训练的模型在准确率、鲁棒性和校准性方面表现更优,并能良好地迁移到下游任务(如分割和检测)。例如,ResNet-50模型在ImageNet验证集上的准确率提升了1.7%,在ImageNetV2上提升了3.5%,在ImageNet-R上提升了10.0%。ImageNet验证集的预期校准误差(ECE)也降低了9.9%。使用该主干网络与Mask-RCNN在MS-COCO上进行目标检测,平均精度(mAP)提升了0.8%。我们还为MobileNets、ViTs和Swin-Transformers实现了类似的效果。对于MobileNetV3和Swin-Tiny,我们在ImageNet-R/A/C上观察到高达20%的鲁棒性提升。在ImageNet+上预训练并在CIFAR-100+、Flowers-102+和Food-101+上微调的模型,准确率提升了最多3.4%。代码、数据集和预训练模型可在https://github.com/apple/ml-dr获取。
abstract_en: We propose Dataset Reinforcement, a strategy to improve a dataset once such that the accuracy of any model architecture trained on the reinforced dataset is improved at no additional training cost for users. We propose a Dataset Reinforcement strategy based on data augmentation and knowledge distillation. Our generic strategy is designed based on extensive analysis across CNN- and transformer-based models and performing large-scale study of distillation with state-of-the-art models with various data augmentations. We create a reinforced version of the ImageNet training dataset, called ImageNet+, as well as reinforced datasets CIFAR-100+, Flowers-102+, and Food-101+. Models trained with ImageNet+ are more accurate, robust, and calibrated, and transfer well to downstream tasks (e.g., segmentation and detection). As an example, the accuracy of ResNet-50 improves by 1.7% on the ImageNet validation set, 3.5% on ImageNetV2, and 10.0% on ImageNet-R. Expected Calibration Error (ECE) on the ImageNet validation set is also reduced by 9.9%. Using this backbone with Mask-RCNN for object detection on MS-COCO, the mean average precision improves by 0.8%. We reach similar gains for MobileNets, ViTs, and Swin-Transformers. For MobileNetV3 and Swin-Tiny, we observe significant improvements on ImageNet-R/A/C of up to 20% improved robustness. Models pretrained on ImageNet+ and fine-tuned on CIFAR-100+, Flowers-102+, and Food-101+, reach up to 3.4% improved accuracy. The code, datasets, and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/apple/ml-dr.
authors: Fartash Faghri, Hadi Pouransari, Sachin Mehta, Mehrdad Farajtabar, Ali Farhadi, Mohammad Rastegari, Oncel Tuzel ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17032-17043

title: 无需跳连的面部交换增强解耦方法
title_en: Reinforced Disentanglement for Face Swapping without Skip Connection
abstract: 当前最先进的面部交换模型仍存在两个问题:要么目标身份(即形状)被泄露,要么目标非身份属性(即背景、发型)未能在最终结果中充分保留。我们证明,这种不足的解耦是由于先前模型中普遍采用的两种设计缺陷导致的:(1) 仅依赖一个压缩编码器同时表征语义级非身份面部属性(即姿态)和像素级非面部区域细节,这在逻辑上存在矛盾;(2) 高度依赖编码器与最终生成器之间的长跳连,导致一定量的目标面部身份信息泄露。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新的面部交换框架"WSC-swap",摒弃跳连并采用两个目标编码器分别捕捉像素级非面部区域属性和面部区域语义非身份属性。为进一步强化目标编码器的解耦学习,我们结合对抗训练(即GAN)实现身份移除损失和基于先验3DMM模型实现的非身份属性保留损失。在FaceForensics++和CelebA-HQ上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在包括一种全新的用于衡量身份一致性的指标在内的多项指标上显著优于先前工作。
abstract_en:
The SOTA face swap models still suffer the problem of either target identity (i.e., shape) being leaked or the target non-identity attributes (i.e., background, hair) failing to be fully preserved in the final results. We show that
 this insufficient disentanglement is caused by two flawed designs that were commonly adopted in prior models: (1) counting on only one compressed encoder to represent both the semantic-level non-identity facial attributes(i.e., pose) and the pixel-level non-facial region details, which is contradictory to satisfy at the same time; (2) highly relying on long skip-connections between the encoder and the final generator, leaking a certain amount of target face identity into the result. To fix them, we introduce a new face swap framework called "WSC-swap" that gets rid of skip connections and uses two target encoders to respectively
 capture the pixel-level non-facial region attributes and the semantic non-identity attributes in the face region. To further reinforce the disentanglement learning for the target encoder, we employ both identity removal loss via adversarial training (i.e., GAN) and the non-identity preservation loss via prior 3DMM models like. Extensive experiments on both FaceForensics++ and CelebA-HQ show that our results significantly outperform previous works on a rich set of metrics, including one novel metric for measuring identity consistency that was completely neglected before.
authors: Xiaohang Ren, Xingyu Chen, Pengfei Yao, Heung-Yeung Shum, Baoyuan Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20665-20675

title: Relightify: 通过扩散模型从单张图像生成可重新照明的3D人脸
title_en: Relightify: Relightable 3D Faces from a Single Image via Diffusion Models
abstract: 在扩散模型在图像生成领域取得显著成功之后,近期研究也展示了其在无监督方式下解决多种逆问题的出色能力,通过基于条件输入对采样过程进行适当约束。受此启发,本文提出了首个利用扩散模型作为先验,从单张图像实现高精度3D人脸BRDF重建的方法。我们首先利用高质量的面部反射率UV数据集(漫反射和镜面反射率及法线),在不同光照条件下进行渲染以模拟自然RGB纹理,随后在拼接的渲染纹理与反射率成分对上训练无条件扩散模型。在测试阶段,我们对输入图像拟合3D可变形模型并展开为部分UV纹理。通过从扩散模型中采样,同时保留观测到的纹理部分不变,模型能够在单次去噪步骤序列中不仅修复自遮挡区域,还能重建未知的反射率成分。与现有方法不同,我们直接从输入图像获取观测到的纹理,从而实现了更忠实且一致的反射率估计。通过一系列定性和定量对比实验,我们在纹理补全和反射率重建任务中均展现出优越的性能。
abstract_en: Following the remarkable success of diffusion models on image generation, recent works have also demonstrated their impressive ability to address a number of inverse problems in an unsupervised way, by properly constraining the sampling process based on a conditioning input. Motivated by this, in this paper, we present the first approach to use diffusion models as a prior for highly accurate 3D facial BRDF reconstruction from a single image. We start by leveraging a high-quality UV dataset of facial reflectance (diffuse and specular albedo and normals), which we render under varying illumination settings to simulate natural RGB textures and, then, train an unconditional diffusion model on concatenated pairs of rendered textures and reflectance components. At test time, we fit a 3D morphable model to the given image and unwrap the face in a partial UV texture. By sampling from the diffusion model, while retaining the observed texture part intact, the model inpaints not only the self-occluded areas but also the unknown reflectance components, in a single sequence of denoising steps. In contrast to existing methods, we directly acquire the observed texture from the input image, thus, resulting in more faithful and consistent reflectance estimation. Through a series of qualitative and quantitative comparisons, we demonstrate superior performance in both texture completion as well as reflectance reconstruction tasks.
authors: Foivos Paraperas Papantoniou, Alexandros Lattas, Stylianos Moschoglou, Stefanos Zafeiriou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8806-8817

title: 铭记正常性:基于记忆引导的知识蒸馏用于无监督异常检测
title_en: Remembering Normality: Memory-guided Knowledge Distillation for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
abstract: 知识蒸馏(KD)在无监督异常检测(AD)中已被广泛研究。假设学生模型持续生成训练数据中典型模式的表示,称为“正常性”,而教师模型与学生模型表示之间的差异被识别为异常。然而,该方法存在“正常性遗忘”问题。在无异常数据上训练的学生模型仍能良好重构异常表示,并对正常数据中的细粒度模式敏感,这些模式在训练数据中也存在。为缓解这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的基于记忆引导的知识蒸馏(MemKD)框架,通过自适应调节学生特征的正常性来检测异常。具体而言,我们首先提出一种正常性回忆记忆(NR Memory),通过回忆存储的正常信息来增强学生生成特征的正常性。在此意义上,表示将不会呈现异常,细粒度模式将被良好描述。随后,我们采用正常性嵌入学习策略以促进NR Memory的信息学习。它构建一个正常示例集,使NR Memory能够从无异常数据中记忆先验知识,并在后续查询特征中召回这些知识。因此,综合实验表明,所提出的MemKD在五个基准数据集(即MVTec AD、VisA、MPDD、MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies)上取得了有前景的结果。
abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) has been widely explored in unsupervised anomaly detection (AD). The student is assumed to constantly produce representations of typical patterns within trained data, named "normality", and the representation discrepancy between the teacher and student model is identified as anomalies. However, it suffers from the "normality forgetting" issue. Trained on anomaly-free data, the student still well reconstructs anomalous representations for anomalies and is sensitive to fine patterns in normal data, which also appear in training. To mitigate this issue, we introduce a novel Memory-guided Knowledge-Distillation (MemKD) framework that adaptively modulates the normality of student features in detecting anomalies. Specifically, we first propose a normality recall memory (NR Memory) to strengthen the normality of student-generated features by recalling the stored normal information. In this sense, representations will not present anomalies and fine patterns will be well described. Subsequently, we employ a normality embedding learning strategy to promote information learning for the NR Memory. It constructs a normal exemplar set so that the NR Memory can memorize prior knowledge in anomaly-free data and later recall them from the query feature. Consequently, comprehensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed MemKD achieves promising results on five benchmarks, i.e., MVTec AD, VisA, MPDD, MVTec 3D-AD, and Eyecandies.
authors: Zhihao Gu, Liang Liu, Xu Chen, Ran Yi, Jiangning Zhang, Yabiao Wang, Chengjie Wang, Annan Shu, Guannan Jiang, Lizhuang Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16401-16409

title: 将异常视为噪声进行工业缺陷定位
title_en: Removing Anomalies as Noises for Industrial Defect Localization
abstract: 无监督异常检测旨在仅使用无异常图像训练模型,以检测和定位未见过的异常。先前基于重建的方法受限于不准确的重建结果。本文提出一种去噪模型,利用生成扩散模型检测和定位异常。特别地,我们引入随机噪声以掩盖异常像素,并从中间去噪过程中获得逐像素精确的异常分数。我们发现,扩散模型的KL散度作为异常分数优于传统的RGB空间分数。此外,我们从预训练的深度特征提取器中重建特征作为特征级分数,以提升定位性能。此外,我们提出梯度去噪过程,以平滑地将异常图像转换为正常图像。我们的去噪模型在MVTec-AD基准测试中,优于最先进的基于重建的异常检测方法,实现了精确的异常定位和高质量的正常图像重建。
abstract_en: Unsupervised anomaly detection aims to train models with only anomaly-free images to detect and localize unseen anomalies. Previous reconstruction-based methods have been limited by inaccurate reconstruction results. This work presents a denoising model to detect and localize the anomalies with a generative diffusion model. In particular, we introduce random noise to overwhelm the anomalous pixels and obtain pixel-wise precise anomaly scores from the intermediate denoising process. We find that the KL divergence of the diffusion model serves as a better anomaly score compared with the traditional RGB space score. Furthermore, we reconstruct the features from a pre-trained deep feature extractor as our feature level score to improve localization performance. Moreover, we propose a gradient denoising process to smoothly transform an anomalous image into a normal one. Our denoising model outperforms the state-of-the-art reconstruction-based anomaly detection methods for precise anomaly localization and high-quality normal image reconstruction on the MVTec-AD benchmark.
authors: Fanbin Lu, Xufeng Yao, Chi-Wing Fu, Jiaya Jia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16166-16175

title: RenderIH: 一个用于3D交互手姿态估计的大规模合成数据集
title_en: RenderIH: A Large-Scale Synthetic Dataset for 3D Interacting Hand Pose Estimation
abstract: 当前的交互手(IH)数据集在背景和纹理方面相对简单,手关节由机器标注员标注,可能导致不准确,且姿态分布的多样性有限。然而,背景、姿态分布和纹理的可变性会显著影响泛化能力。因此,我们提出一个大规模合成数据集--RenderIH--用于交互手,具有准确且多样的姿态标注。该数据集包含100万张逼真图像,具有多样化的背景、视角和手部纹理。为生成自然且多样的交互姿态,我们提出了一种新的姿态优化算法。此外,为了提高姿态估计精度,我们引入了基于Transformer的姿态估计网络TransHand,利用交互手之间的相关性,并验证RenderIH在提升结果方面的有效性。我们的数据集是模型无关的,相比其他真实或合成数据集,可以提升任何手姿态估计方法的准确性。实验表明,使用我们的合成数据预训练可显著将误差从6.76mm降低至5.79mm,且我们的TransHand超越了当前方法。我们的数据集和代码可在https://github.com/adwardlee/RenderIH获取。
abstract_en: The current interacting hand (IH) datasets are relatively simplistic in terms of background and texture, with hand joints being annotated by a machine annotator, which may result in inaccuracies, and the diversity of pose distribution is limited. However, the variability of background, pose distribution, and texture can greatly influence the generalization ability. Therefore, we present a large-scale synthetic dataset --RenderIH-- for interacting hands with accurate and diverse pose annotations. The dataset contains 1M photo-realistic images with varied backgrounds, perspectives, and hand textures. To generate natural and diverse interacting poses, we propose a new pose optimization algorithm. Additionally, for better pose estimation accuracy, we introduce a transformer-based pose estimation network, TransHand, to leverage the correlation between interacting hands and verify the effectiveness of RenderIH in improving results. Our dataset is model-agnostic and can improve more accuracy of any hand pose estimation method in comparison to other real or synthetic datasets. Experiments have shown that pretraining on our synthetic data can significantly decrease the error from 6.76mm to 5.79mm, and our Transhand surpasses contemporary methods. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/adwardlee/RenderIH.
authors: Lijun Li, Linrui Tian, Xindi Zhang, Qi Wang, Bang Zhang, Liefeng Bo, Mengyuan Liu, Chen Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20395-20405

title: 从物体遮挡单目视频中渲染人体
title_en: Rendering Humans from Object-Occluded Monocular Videos
abstract: 从单目视频中对运动人体进行三维理解和渲染是一项具有挑战性的任务。尽管近期进展在一定程度上实现了该任务,但在现实场景中仍难以保证满意的结果,因为障碍物可能遮挡相机视角,导致捕获视频中出现部分遮挡。现有方法由于以下两个原因无法处理此类缺陷。首先,标准渲染策略依赖点对点映射,可能导致人体可见区域与遮挡区域之间出现显著差异。其次,简单的直接回归方法未考虑任何可行性准则(即先验信息)以处理遮挡情况。为解决上述问题,我们提出OccNeRF,一种能够更好渲染严重遮挡场景中人体的神经渲染方法。作为对两个缺陷的直接解决方案,我们通过整合几何和可见性先验提出基于表面的渲染方法。我们在模拟和真实遮挡场景中验证了我们的方法,并展示了其优越性。
abstract_en: 3D understanding and rendering of moving humans from monocular videos is a challenging task. Although recent progress has enabled this task to some extent, it is still difficult to guarantee satisfactory results in real-world scenarios, where obstacles may block the camera view and cause partial occlusions in the captured videos. Existing methods cannot handle such defects due to two reasons. Firstly, the standard rendering strategy relies on point-point mapping, which could lead to dramatic disparities between the visible and occluded areas of the body. Secondly, the naive direct regression approach does not consider any feasibility criteria (i.e., prior information) for rendering under occlusions. To tackle the above drawbacks, we present OccNeRF, a neural rendering method that achieves better rendering of humans in severely occluded scenes. As direct solutions to the two drawbacks, we propose surface-based rendering by integrating geometry and visibility priors. We validate our method on both simulated and real-world occlusions and demonstrate our method's superiority.
authors: Tiange Xiang, Adam Sun, Jiajun Wu, Ehsan Adeli, Li Fei-Fei ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3239-3250

title: RepQ-ViT:面向视觉Transformer模型后训练量化的尺度重参数化方法
title_en: RepQ-ViT: Scale Reparameterization for Post-Training Quantization of Vision Transformers
abstract: 后训练量化(PTQ)仅需极小校准数据集且无需端到端再训练,是一种轻量且实用的模型压缩技术。近期已出现多种针对视觉Transformer(ViT)的PTQ方案;然而这些方法通常面临显著的精度下降问题,尤其在低比特场景下。本文提出RepQ-ViT,一种基于量化尺度重参数化的新型ViT PTQ框架,以解决上述问题。RepQ-ViT将量化与推理过程解耦,其中量化过程采用复杂量化器,推理过程采用尺度重参数化的简化量化器。这确保了高精度量化与高效推理,区别于现有方法为满足目标硬件而牺牲量化性能。具体而言,我们聚焦两个分布极端的组件:具有严重通道间变化的后LayerNorm激活和具有幂律特征的后Softmax激活,并分别首次应用逐通道量化和log(sqrt(2))量化。随后,我们将尺度重参数化为适用于硬件的层间量化和log2量化以实现推理,仅带来轻微的精度或计算开销。在多个不同模型变体的视觉任务上进行的大量实验表明,RepQ-ViT无需超参数和昂贵的重建过程,即可超越现有强基线,并有望将ViT的4比特PTQ精度提升至可用水平。代码已开源于https://github.com/zkkli/RepQ-ViT。
abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ), which only requires a tiny dataset for calibration without end-to-end retraining, is a light and practical model compression technique. Recently, several PTQ schemes for vision transformers (ViTs) have been presented; unfortunately, they typically suffer from non-trivial accuracy degradation, especially in low-bit cases. In this paper, we propose RepQ-ViT, a novel PTQ framework for ViTs based on quantization scale reparameterization, to address the above issues. RepQ-ViT decouples the quantization and inference processes, where the former employs complex quantizers and the latter employs scale-reparameterized simplified quantizers. This ensures both accurate quantization and efficient inference, which distinguishes it from existing approaches that sacrifice quantization performance to meet the target hardware. More specifically, we focus on two components with extreme distributions: post-LayerNorm activations with severe inter-channel variation and post-Softmax activations with power-law features, and initially apply channel-wise quantization and log(sqrt(2)) quantization, respectively. Then, we reparameterize the scales to hardware-friendly layer-wise quantization and log2 quantization for inference, with only slight accuracy or computational costs.
