We thus manually insert the dense uniform attention to each layer of the ViT models to supply the much-needed dense interactions. We call this method Context Broadcasting, CB. Our study demonstrates the inclusion of CB takes the role of dense attention, and thereby reduces the degree of density in the original attention maps by complying softmax in MSA. We also show that, with negligible costs of CB (1 line in your model code and no additional parameters), both the capacity and generalizability of the ViT models are increased.
authors: Nam Hyeon-Woo, Kim Yu-Ji, Byeongho Heo, Dongyoon Han, Seong Joon Oh, Tae-Hyun Oh ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5807-5818

title: Seal-3D:神经辐射场的交互式像素级编辑
title_en: Seal-3D: Interactive Pixel-Level Editing for Neural Radiance Fields
abstract: 随着隐式神经表示(或神经辐射场,NeRF)的流行,对于交互式编辑方法的需求日益迫切,以应对重建场景后处理和三维内容创作等任务。尽管已有研究从不同角度探索了NeRF编辑,但其在编辑灵活性、质量和速度方面存在局限,无法提供直接的编辑响应和即时预览。关键挑战在于设计一种能够直接反映编辑指令并实现即时更新的局部可编辑神经表示。为弥合这一差距,我们提出了一种新的交互式编辑方法和系统,称为Seal-3D,该系统允许用户以像素级和自由的方式编辑NeRF模型,并使用多种NeRF-like主干网络进行即时预览。为实现该效果,我们通过代理函数将编辑指令映射到教师模型中NeRF模型的原始空间,并采用包含局部预训练和全局微调的两阶段训练策略。构建了一个NeRF编辑系统以展示多种编辑类型。我们的系统可实现令人信服的编辑效果,交互速度约为1秒。
abstract_en: With the popularity of implicit neural representations, or neural radiance fields (NeRF), there is a pressing need for editing methods to interact with the implicit 3D models for tasks like post-processing reconstructed scenes and 3D content creation. While previous works have explored NeRF editing from various perspectives, they are restricted in editing flexibility, quality, and speed, failing to offer direct editing response and instant preview. The key challenge is to conceive a locally editable neural representation that can directly reflect the editing instructions and update instantly. To bridge the gap, we propose a new interactive editing method and system for implicit representations, called Seal-3D, which allows users to edit NeRF models in a pixel-level and free manner with a wide range of NeRF-like backbone and preview the editing effects instantly. To achieve the effects, the challenges are addressed by our proposed proxy function mapping the editing instructions to the original space of NeRF models in the teacher model and a two-stage training strategy for the student model with local pretraining and global finetuning. A NeRF editing system is built to showcase various editing types. Our system can achieve compelling editing effects with an interactive speed of about 1 second.
authors: Xiangyu Wang, Jingsen Zhu, Qi Ye, Yuchi Huo, Yunlong Ran, Zhihua Zhong, Jiming Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17683-17693

title: 搜索还是导航?面向物体导航的双适应性思维
title_en: Search for or Navigate to? Dual Adaptive Thinking for Object Navigation
abstract: "搜索"还是"导航至"?当我们在一个未知环境中寻找特定物体时,这两种选择总会潜意识地浮现。在看到目标之前,我们基于先验经验进行搜索;一旦看到目标,我们可以通过记忆目标位置进行导航。然而,近期的物体导航方法主要利用物体关联来增强"搜索"阶段,而忽视了"导航至"阶段的重要性。因此,本文提出了一种双适应性思维(DAT)方法,该方法能够根据不同导航阶段灵活调整思维策略。双思维包括基于物体关联能力的搜索思维和基于目标位置能力的导航思维。为了使导航思维更有效,我们设计了目标导向记忆图(TOMG)(存储历史目标信息)和目标感知多尺度聚合器(TAMSA)(编码目标的相对位置)。我们在AI2-Thor和RoboTHOR数据集上评估了我们的方法。与最先进的方法(SOTA)相比,我们的方法显著提升了整体成功率(SR)和路径长度加权的成功率(SPL),同时增强了代理在"导航至"阶段的性能。
abstract_en: "Search for" or "Navigate to"? When we find a specific object in an unknown environment, the two choices always arise in our subconscious mind. Before we see the target, we search for the target based on prior experience. Once we have seen the target, we can navigate to it by remembering the target location. However, recent object navigation methods consider using object association mostly to enhance the "search for" phase while neglecting the importance of the "navigate to" phase. Therefore, this paper proposes a dual adaptive thinking (DAT) method that flexibly adjusts thinking strategies in different navigation stages. Dual thinking includes both search thinking according to the object association ability and navigation thinking according to the target location ability. To make navigation thinking more effective, we design a target-oriented memory graph (TOMG) (which stores historical target information) and a target-aware multi-scale aggregator (TAMSA) (which encodes the relative position of the target). We assess our methods based on the AI2-Thor and RoboTHOR datasets. Compared with state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, our approach significantly raises the overall success rate (SR) and success weighted by path length (SPL) while enhancing the agent's performance in the "navigate to" phase.
authors: Ronghao Dang, Liuyi Wang, Zongtao He, Shuai Su, Jiagui Tang, Chengju Liu, Qijun Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8250-8259

title: 见多识广:基于多模态视觉数据的零样本点云分割
title_en: See More and Know More: Zero-shot Point Cloud Segmentation via Multi-modal Visual Data
abstract: 零样本点云分割旨在使深度模型能够识别训练阶段未见过的点云中新物体。近期趋势倾向于通过从有标签的类别向无标签的类别迁移知识的流程。它们通常通过有标签类别的注释监督,将视觉特征与从词嵌入获得的语义特征对齐。然而,点云包含的信息有限,难以完全匹配语义特征。事实上,图像丰富的外观信息是无纹理点云的天然补充,这在先前文献中尚未得到充分探索。受此启发,我们提出了一种新颖的多模态零样本学习方法,以更好地利用点云和图像的互补信息,实现更精确的视觉-语义对齐。在两个流行基准SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上进行了大量实验,我们的方法在未见类别的mIoU上分别平均提升了52%和49%,超越了当前最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Zero-shot point cloud segmentation aims to make deep models capable of recognizing novel objects in point cloud that are unseen in the training phase. Recent trends favor the pipeline which transfers knowledge from seen classes with labels to unseen classes without labels. They typically align visual features with semantic features obtained from word embedding by the supervision of seen classes' annotations. However, point cloud contains limited information to fully match with semantic features. In fact, the rich appearance information of images is a natural complement to the textureless point cloud, which is not well explored in previous literature. Motivated by this, we propose a novel multi-modal zero-shot learning method to better utilize the complementary information of point clouds and images for more accurate visual-semantic alignment. Extensive experiments are performed in two popular benchmarks, i.e, SemanticKITTI and nuScenes, and our method outperforms current SOTA methods with 52% and 49% improvement on average for unseen class mIoU, respectively.
authors: Yuhang Lu, Qi Jiang, Runnan Chen, Yuenan Hou, Xinge Zhu, Yuexin Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21674-21684

title: SeeABLE:基于软差异与有界对比学习的深度伪造检测方法
title_en: SeeABLE: Soft Discrepancies and Bounded Contrastive Learning for Exposing Deepfakes
abstract: 现代深度伪造检测器在训练集与测试集来自同一数据集时已取得令人鼓舞的成果。然而,当这些检测器应用于由未知深度伪造生成技术产生的图像时,通常会观察到显著的性能退化。本文提出了一种新型深度伪造检测器SeeABLE,将检测问题形式化为(单类)分布外检测任务,并在未见过的深度伪造数据上表现出更好的泛化能力。具体而言,SeeABLE首先生成局部图像扰动(称为软差异),然后通过新颖的基于回归的有界对比损失将扰动的面部推向预定义原型。为增强SeeABLE对未知深度伪造类型的泛化能力,我们生成丰富的软差异并训练检测器:(i) 定位面部被修改的部分,(ii) 识别修改类型。为验证SeeABLE的能力,我们在多个广泛使用的深度伪造数据集上进行了严格实验,结果表明我们的模型在性能上显著优于现有最先进的检测器,同时展现出高度可喜的泛化能力。SeeABLE的源代码可在:https://github.com/anonymous-author-sub/seeable 获取。
abstract_en: Modern deepfake detectors have achieved encouraging results, when training and test images are drawn from the same data collection. However, when these detectors are applied to images produced with unknown deepfake-generation techniques, considerable performance degradations are commonly observed. In this paper, we propose a novel deepfake detector, called SeeABLE, that formalizes the detection problem as a (one-class) out-of-distribution detection task and generalizes better to unseen deepfakes. Specifically, SeeABLE first generates local image perturbations (referred to as soft-discrepancies) and then pushes the perturbed faces towards predefined prototypes using a novel regression-based bounded contrastive loss. To strengthen the generalization performance of SeeABLE to unknown deepfake types, we generate a rich set of soft discrepancies and train the detector: (i) to localize, which part of the face was modified, and (ii) to identify the alteration type. To demonstrate the capabilities of SeeABLE, we perform rigorous experiments on several widely-used deepfake datasets and show that our model convincingly outperforms competing state-of-the-art detectors, while exhibiting highly encouraging generalization capabilities. The source code for SeeABLE is available from: https://github.com/anonymous-author-sub/seeable.
authors: Nicolas Larue, Ngoc-Son Vu, Vitomir Struc, Peter Peer, Vassilis Christophides ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21011-21021

title: 超越局部区域:基于强化学习的高分辨率遥感影像尺度自适应语义分割方法
title_en: Seeing Beyond the Patch: Scale-Adaptive Semantic Segmentation of High-resolution Remote Sensing Imagery based on Reinforcement Learning
abstract: 在遥感影像分析中,基于局部块的方法在获取滑动窗口外的信息时存在局限性。这一缺陷在处理复杂多变的地理对象时提出了重大挑战,导致分割结果出现语义不一致。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种动态尺度感知框架GeoAgent,该框架可根据不同地理对象自适应地获取图像块外的适当尺度上下文信息。在GeoAgent中,每个图像块的状态通过全局缩略图和位置掩码进行表征。全局缩略图提供块外的上下文信息,位置掩码引导感知的空间关系。尺度选择动作通过尺度控制代理(SCA)执行。我们提出了一种特征索引模块以增强代理区分当前图像块位置的能力。该动作会切换双分支分割网络的块尺度和上下文分支,该网络提取并融合多尺度块的特征。GeoAgent根据所选尺度获得的奖励调整网络参数,执行适当的尺度选择动作。实验结果表明,在两个公开数据集和我们新构建的WUSU数据集上,GeoAgent均优于先前的分割方法,特别是在大比例尺制图应用中表现突出。
abstract_en: In remote sensing imagery analysis, patch-based methods have limitations in capturing information beyond the sliding window. This shortcoming poses a significant challenge in processing complex and variable geo-objects, which results in semantic inconsistency in segmentation results. To address this challenge, we propose a dynamic scale perception framework, named GeoAgent, which adaptively captures appropriate scale context information outside the image patch based on the different geo-objects. In GeoAgent, each image patch's states are represented by a global thumbnail and a location mask. The global thumbnail provides context beyond the patch, and the location mask guides the perceived spatial relationships. The scale-selection actions are performed through a Scale Control Agent (SCA). A feature indexing module is proposed to enhance the ability of the agent to distinguish the current image patch's location. The action switches the patch scale and context branch of a dual-branch segmentation network that extracts and fuses the features of multi-scale patches. The GeoAgent adjusts the network parameters to perform the appropriate scale-selection action based on the reward received for the selected scale. The experimental results, using two publicly available datasets and our newly constructed dataset WUSU, demonstrate that GeoAgent outperforms previous segmentation methods, particularly for large-scale mapping applications.
authors: Yinhe Liu, Sunan Shi, Junjue Wang, Yanfei Zhong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16868-16878

title: SegGPT:在上下文中分割一切
title_en: SegGPT: Towards Segmenting Everything in Context
abstract: 我们提出SegGPT,这是一种通用模型,可在上下文中实现一切的分割。我们将各种分割任务统一到一个通用的上下文学习框架中,通过将不同类型的分割数据转换为相同格式的图像,从而适应不同类型的分割数据。SegGPT的训练被表述为一个上下文着色问题,每个数据样本采用随机颜色映射。目标是根据上下文完成多样化任务,而非依赖特定颜色。训练完成后,SegGPT可通过上下文推理在图像或视频中执行任意分割任务,如物体实例、stuff、部分、轮廓和文本分割。SegGPT在广泛的任务上进行了评估,包括少样本语义分割、视频物体分割、语义分割和全景分割。我们的结果表明,SegGPT在领域内和领域外目标的分割方面展现出强大的能力,无论是定性还是定量分析。
abstract_en: We present SegGPT, a generalist model for segmenting everything in context. We unify various segmentation tasks into a generalist in-context learning framework that accommodates different kinds of segmentation data by transforming them into the same format of images. The training of SegGPT is formulated as an in-context coloring problem with random color mapping for each data sample. The objective is to accomplish diverse tasks according to the context, rather than relying on specific colors. After training, SegGPT can perform arbitrary segmentation tasks in images or videos via in-context inference, such as object instance, stuff, part, contour, and text. SegGPT is evaluated on a broad range of tasks, including few-shot semantic segmentation, video object segmentation, semantic segmentation, and panoptic segmentation. Our results show strong capabilities in segmenting in-domain and out-of-domain targets, either qualitatively or quantitatively.
authors: Xinlong Wang, Xiaosong Zhang, Yue Cao, Wen Wang, Chunhua Shen, Tiejun Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1130-1140

title: SegPrompt:通过类别级提示学习提升开放世界分割
title_en: SegPrompt: Boosting Open-World Segmentation via Category-Level Prompt Learning
abstract: 当前闭集实例分割模型在训练和评估过程中依赖预定义的类别标签,限制了其检测新物体的能力。开放世界实例分割(OWIS)模型通过无类别依赖方式检测未知物体来解决这一挑战。然而,先前的OWIS方法在训练过程中完全擦除类别信息以保持模型对未知物体的泛化能力。在本工作中,我们提出了一种名为SegPrompt的新颖训练机制,利用类别信息提升模型对已知和未知类别的无类别依赖分割能力。此外,先前的OWIS训练设置将未知类别暴露于训练集,导致信息泄露,这在现实世界中是不合理的。因此,我们通过将数据集类别划分为已知-见过-未见过三部分,提供了一个更接近现实场景的新开放世界基准。首次我们关注模型发现训练集图像中从未出现过的物体的能力。实验表明,SegPrompt在我们的新基准上无需影响推理效率,即可将整体和未见过检测性能分别提升5.6%和6.1%。我们进一步在现有跨数据集迁移和强监督设置上验证了方法的有效性,分别实现5.5%和12.3%的相对提升。
abstract_en: Current closed-set instance segmentation models rely on predefined class labels for each mask during training and evaluation, limiting their ability to detect novel objects. Open-world instance segmentation (OWIS) models address this challenge by detecting unknown objects in a class-agnostic manner. However, previous OWIS approaches completely erase category information during training to keep the model's ability to generalize to unknown objects. In this work, we propose a novel training mechanism called SegPrompt that utilizes category information to improve the model's class-agnostic segmentation ability for both known and unknown categories. In addition, the previous OWIS training setting exposes the unknown classes to the training set and brings information leakage, which is unreasonable in the real world. Therefore, we provide a new open-world benchmark closer to a real-world scenario by dividing the dataset classes into known-seen-unseen parts. For the first time we focus on the model's ability to discover objects that never appear in the training set images. Experiments show that SegPrompt can improve the overall and unseen detection performance by 5.6% and 6.1% in AR on our new benchmark without affecting the inference efficiency. We further demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on existing cross-dataset transfer and strongly supervised settings, leading to 5.5% and 12.3% relative improvement.
authors: Muzhi Zhu, Hengtao Li, Hao Chen, Chengxiang Fan, Weian Mao, Chenchen Jing, Yifan Liu, Chunhua Shen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 999-1008

title: SegRCDB: 通过公式驱动的监督学习实现语义分割
title_en: SegRCDB: Semantic Segmentation via Formula-Driven Supervised Learning
abstract: 预训练是增强视觉模型以在有限标注图像下高效训练的强大策略。在语义分割中,创建标注掩码需要大量的人力和时间,因此构建大规模带有语义标签的预训练数据集相当困难。此外,语义分割预训练的关键要素尚未被充分研究。本文提出了一种分割径向轮廓数据库(SegRCDB),首次将公式驱动的监督学习应用于语义分割。SegRCDB能够在没有真实图像或任何人工语义标签的情况下实现语义分割的预训练。SegRCDB基于对语义分割预训练关键要素的洞察,允许高效的预训练。使用SegRCDB进行预训练,在相同训练图像数量下,于ADE-20k和Cityscapes数据集上的微调结果均取得了比使用COCO-Stuff预训练更高的mIoU。SegRCDB通过无需人工标注即可创建大规模数据集,具有推动语义分割预训练和研究的高潜力。SegRCDB数据集将在允许研究和商业用途的许可下发布。
abstract_en: Pre-training is a strong strategy for enhancing visual models to efficiently train them with a limited number of labeled images. In semantic segmentation, creating annotation masks requires an intensive amount of labor and time, and therefore, a large-scale pre-training dataset with semantic labels is quite difficult to construct. Moreover, what matters in semantic segmentation pre-training has not been fully investigated. In this paper, we propose the Segmentation Radial Contour DataBase (SegRCDB), which for the first time applies formula-driven supervised learning for semantic segmentation. SegRCDB enables pre-training for semantic segmentation without real images or any manual semantic labels. SegRCDB is based on insights about what is important in pre-training for semantic segmentation and allows efficient pre-training. Pre-training with SegRCDB achieved higher mIoU than the pre-training with COCO-Stuff for fine-tuning on ADE-20k and Cityscapes with the same number of training images. SegRCDB has a high potential to contribute to semantic segmentation pre-training and investigation by enabling the creation of large datasets without manual annotation. The SegRCDB dataset will be released under a license that allows research and commercial use.
authors: Risa Shinoda, Ryo Hayamizu, Kodai Nakashima, Nakamasa Inoue, Rio Yokota, Hirokatsu Kataoka ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20054-20063

title: 分割万物
title_en: Segment Anything
abstract: 我们介绍了分割万物(Segment Anything, SA)项目:一个全新的图像分割任务、模型和数据集。通过在数据收集循环中使用我们的高效模型,我们构建了迄今为止最大的分割数据集(迄今为止),包含超过1100万张经过授权且尊重隐私的图像上的10亿个掩码。该模型被设计和训练为可提示的,因此可以零样本迁移到新的图像分布和任务。我们在多个任务上评估其能力,发现其零样本性能令人印象深刻——通常与甚至优于先前完全监督的结果相竞争。我们将在https://segment-anything.com发布分割万物模型(SAM)及对应的数据集(SA-1B),包含10亿个掩码和1100万张图像,以促进计算机视觉基础模型的研究。我们建议阅读完整论文:https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.02643。
abstract_en: We introduce the Segment Anything (SA) project: a new task, model, and dataset for image segmentation. Using our efficient model in a data collection loop, we built the largest segmentation dataset to date (by far), with over 1 billion masks on 11M licensed and privacy respecting images. The model is designed and trained to be promptable, so it can transfer zero-shot to new image distributions and tasks. We evaluate its capabilities on numerous tasks and find that its zero-shot performance is impressive -- often competitive with or even superior to prior fully supervised results. We are releasing the Segment Anything Model (SAM) and corresponding dataset (SA-1B) of 1B masks and 11M images at https://segment-anything.com to foster research into foundation models for computer vision. We recommend reading the full paper at: https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.02643.
authors: Alexander Kirillov, Eric Mintun, Nikhila Ravi, Hanzi Mao, Chloe Rolland, Laura Gustafson, Tete Xiao, Spencer Whitehead, Alexander C. Berg, Wan-Yen Lo, Piotr Dollar, Ross Girshick ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4015-4026

title: 空间与时间域中每个参考对象的分割
title_en: Segment Every Reference Object in Spatial and Temporal Spaces
abstract: 参照图像分割(RIS)、参照视频对象分割(RVOS)和视频对象分割(VOS)等基于参考对象的分割任务,旨在通过语言或标注掩码等参考信息对特定对象进行分割。尽管各领域均取得显著进展,但现有方法多为任务特定设计,发展方向各异,阻碍了这些任务的多任务能力协同。本文结束当前碎片化局面,提出UniRef架构,统一实现三种基于参考对象的分割任务。我们的方法核心在于针对不同任务的指定参考信息进行多路融合,并采用统一的Transformer架构进行实例级分割。通过统一设计,UniRef可在多种基准数据集上联合训练,并在运行时通过指定对应参考信息灵活执行多任务。我们在多个基准数据集上评估联合训练网络,实验结果表明,UniRef在RIS和RVOS任务上达到SOTA性能,在VOS任务中也展现出竞争力。
abstract_en:
The reference-based object segmentation tasks, namely referring image segmentation (RIS), referring video object segmentation (RVOS), and video object segmentation (VOS), aim to segment a specific object by utilizing either
 language or annotated masks as references. Despite significant progress in each respective field, current methods are task-specifically designed and developed in different directions, which hinders the activation of multi-task capabilities for these tasks. In this work, we end the current fragmented situation and propose UniRef to unify the three reference-based object segmentation tasks with a single architecture. At the heart of our approach is the multiway-fusion for handling different task with respect to their specified references. And a unified Transformer architecture is then adopted for performing instance-level segmentation. With the unified designs, UniRef can be jointly trained on a broad range of benchmarks and can flexibly perform multiple tasks at runtime by specifying the corresponding references. We evaluate the jointly trained network on various benchmarks. Extensive experimental results indicate that our proposed UniRef achieves state-of-the-art performance on RIS and RVOS, and performs competitively on VOS with a single network.
authors: Jiannan Wu, Yi Jiang, Bin Yan, Huchuan Lu, Zehuan Yuan, Ping Luo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2538-2550

title: 基于定制样本迭代训练的管状结构分割方法
title_en: Segmentation of Tubular Structures Using Iterative Training with Tailored Samples
abstract: 我们提出了一种最小路径方法,用于同时计算管状结构分割掩码并提取具有线拓扑结构的中心线。最小路径方法广泛应用于管状结构的分割任务中。近期方法通常利用卷积神经网络(CNN)提取的特征,且在多数情况下优于使用手工调优特征的方法。然而,对于基于CNN的方法,训练所用样本可能生成不当,导致其与推理过程中遇到的样本存在显著差异。我们通过引入一种新颖的迭代训练方案来解决这一问题,该方案能够在不修改现有标注的前提下,生成更适合最小路径方法的定制化训练样本。在我们的方法中,分割掩码和中心线并非通过后处理依次确定,而是通过相同的步骤共同获得。该方法仅需极少的标注训练图像。在包含卫星图像和医学图像的三个公开数据集上与七种先前方法的比较表明,我们的方法在分割掩码和中心线提取方面均达到了最先进水平。
abstract_en: We propose a minimal path method to simultaneously compute segmentation masks and extract centerlines of tubular structures with line-topology. Minimal path methods are commonly used for the segmentation of tubular structures in a wide variety of applications. Recent methods use features extracted by CNNs, and often outperform methods using hand-tuned features. However, for CNN-based methods, the samples used for training may be generated inappropriately, so that they can be very different from samples encountered during inference. We approach this discrepancy by introducing a novel iterative training scheme, which enables generating better training samples specifically tailored for the minimal path methods without changing existing annotations. In our method, segmentation masks and centerlines are not determined after one another by post-processing, but obtained using the same steps. Our method requires only very few annotated training images. Comparison with seven previous approaches on three public datasets, including satellite images and medical images, shows that our method achieves state-of-the-art results both for segmentation masks and centerlines.
authors: Wei Liao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23643-23652

title: 无需先验知识的已知对象与未知未知对象分割
title_en: Segmenting Known Objects and Unseen Unknowns without Prior Knowledge
abstract: 全景分割方法为输入中的每个像素分配已知类别。即使对于最先进的方法而言,这不可避免地强制做出系统性错误预测的决策,导致对训练类别之外的对象产生错误预测。然而,在安全关键场景中,对分布外样本和边缘情况的鲁棒性至关重要,以避免危险后果。由于现实世界数据集无法包含足够的数据点来充分采样底层分布的长尾,模型必须能够处理未见过的未知场景。先前方法通过重新识别已见过的未标记对象来应对这一挑战。在本文中,我们提出扩展分割以适应新设置的必要步骤,该设置我们称为整体分割。整体分割旨在在没有任何先验知识的情况下识别并分离未知类别对象实例,同时执行已知类别的全景分割。我们通过U3HS方法解决这一新问题,该方法将未知对象识别为高度不确定的区域,并将相应的实例感知嵌入聚类为独立对象。通过这样做,我们的U3HS首次在包含未知对象的全景分割中无需未知类别进行训练,减少了假设并使设置尽可能接近现实场景。在MS COCO、Cityscapes和Lost&Found等公共数据集上的大量实验验证了U3HS在这一新、具有挑战性且无假设设置(称为整体分割)中的有效性。项目页面:https://holisticseg.github.io
abstract_en: Panoptic segmentation methods assign a known class to each pixel given in input. Even for state-of-the-art approaches, this inevitably enforces decisions that systematically lead to wrong predictions for objects outside the training categories. However, robustness against out-of-distribution samples and corner cases is crucial in safety-critical settings to avoid dangerous consequences. Since real-world datasets cannot contain enough data points to adequately sample the long tail of the underlying distribution, models must be able to deal with unseen and unknown scenarios as well. Previous methods targeted this by re-identifying already-seen unlabeled objects. In this work, we propose the necessary step to extend segmentation with a new setting which we term holistic segmentation. Holistic segmentation aims to identify and separate objects of unseen, unknown categories into instances without any prior knowledge about them while performing panoptic segmentation of known classes. We tackle this new problem with U3HS, which finds unknowns as highly uncertain regions and clusters their corresponding instance-aware embeddings into individual objects. By doing so, for the first time in panoptic segmentation with unknown objects, our U3HS is trained without unknown categories, reducing assumptions and leaving the settings as unconstrained as in real-life scenarios. Extensive experiments on public data from MS COCO, Cityscapes, and Lost&Found demonstrate the effectiveness of U3HS for this new, challenging, and assumptions-free setting called holistic segmentation. Project page: https://holisticseg.github.io.
authors: Stefano Gasperini, Alvaro Marcos-Ramiro, Michael Schmidt, Nassir Navab, Benjamin Busam, Federico Tombari ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19321-19332

title: SeiT: 基于令牌的存储高效视觉训练方法,仅需原始像素存储的1%
title_en: SeiT: Storage-Efficient Vision Training with Tokens Using 1% of Pixel Storage
abstract: 为实现更具泛化能力且突破性的视觉模型,我们需要十亿级图像数据集,以及大规模数据集存储来分发这些图像(例如,LAION-4B数据集需要240TB存储空间)。然而,受限于存储基础设施,处理无限数据集存储变得极具挑战性。尽管已有多种存储高效训练方法被提出,但它们要么难以扩展,要么严重损害性能。本文提出了一种针对大规模数据集(如ImageNet)的存储高效训练策略,该方法每个实例仅使用1024个令牌,无需原始像素级数据;我们的令牌存储需求仅为原始JPEG压缩像素的<1%。我们还提出了令牌增强方法和Stem-adaptor模块,使我们的方法能够通过仅对Stem层进行微小修改和精心调优的优化设置,使用与像素级方法相同的架构。在ImageNet-1K上的实验结果表明,我们的方法显著优于其他存储高效训练方法。我们进一步验证了该方法在其他实际场景(存储高效预训练和持续学习)中的有效性。论文接受后,我们将公开实现代码和令牌化数据集。
abstract_en:
We need billion-scale images to achieve more generalizable and ground-breaking vision models, as well as massive dataset storage to ship the images (e.g., the LAION-4B dataset needs 240TB storage space). However, it has become challenging to deal with unlimited dataset storage with limited storage infrastructure. A number of storage-efficient training methods have been proposed to tackle the problem, but they are rarely scalable or suffer from severe damage to performance. In this paper, we propose a storage-efficient training strategy for vision classifiers for large-scale datasets (e.g., ImageNet) that only uses 1024 tokens per instance without using the raw level pixels; our token storage only needs <1% of the original JPEG-compressed raw pixels. We also propose token augmentations and a Stem-adaptor module to make our approach able to use the same architecture as pixel-based approaches with only minimal modifications on the stem layer and the carefully tuned optimization settings. Our experimental results on ImageNet-1K show that our method significantly outperforms other storage-efficient training methods with a large gap. We further show the effectiveness of our method in other practical scenarios, storage-efficient pre-training, and continual learning.
 We will make our implementation and tokenized dataset publicly after the acceptance.
authors: Song Park, Sanghyuk Chun, Byeongho Heo, Wonjae Kim, Sangdoo Yun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17248-17259

title: 自校准交叉注意力网络用于少样本分割
title_en: Self-Calibrated Cross Attention Network for Few-Shot Segmentation
abstract: 少样本分割(FSS)成功的关键在于如何有效利用支持样本。大多数解决方案将支持前景(FG)特征压缩为原型,但丢失了一些空间细节。相反,其他方法使用交叉注意力将查询特征与未压缩的支持FG融合。查询FG能够安全地与支持FG融合,然而查询背景(BG)无法在支持FG中找到匹配的BG特征,却不可避免地整合了不相似的特征。此外,由于查询FG和BG均与支持FG结合,它们会相互纠缠,从而导致分割效果不佳。为解决这些问题,我们设计了一个自校准交叉注意力(SCCA)模块。为了实现高效的基于补丁的注意力,首先将查询和支持特征分割为补丁。然后,我们设计了一个补丁对齐模块,将每个查询补丁与其最相似的支持补丁对齐,以获得更好的交叉注意力。具体而言,SCCA以查询补丁作为Q,并将同一查询图像中的补丁以及对齐的支持图像补丁作为K&V。这样,查询BG特征将与匹配的BG特征(来自查询补丁)融合,从而缓解上述问题。此外,在计算SCCA时,我们设计了一种缩放余弦机制,以更好地利用支持特征进行相似度计算。在PASCAL-5^i和COCO-20^i上进行的大量实验验证了我们模型的优越性,例如在COCO-20^i的5-shot设置下,mIoU得分比先前的最先进方法高出5.6%+。代码可在https://github.com/Sam1224/SCCAN获取。
abstract_en: The key to the success of few-shot segmentation (FSS) lies in how to effectively utilize support samples. Most solutions compress support foreground (FG) features into prototypes, but lose some spatial details. Instead, others use cross attention to fuse query features with uncompressed support FG. Query FG is safely fused with support FG, however, query background (BG) cannot find matched BG features in support FG, yet it inevitably integrates dissimilar features. Besides, as both query FG and BG are combined with support FG, they get entangled, thereby leading to ineffective segmentation. To cope with these issues, we design a self-calibrated cross attention (SCCA) block. For efficient patch-based attention, query and support features are firstly split into patches. Then, we design a patch alignment module to align each query patch with its most similar support patch for better cross attention. Specifically, SCCA takes a query patch as Q, and groups the patches from the same query image and the aligned patches from the support image as K&V. In this way, the query BG features are fused with matched BG features (from query patches), and thus the aforementioned issues will be mitigated. Moreover, when calculating SCCA, we design a scaled-cosine mechanism to better utilize the support features for similarity calculation. Extensive experiments conducted on PASCAL-5^i and COCO-20^i demonstrate the superiority of our model, e.g., the mIoU score under 5-shot setting on COCO-20^i is 5.6%+ better than previous state-of-the-arts. The code is available at https://github.com/Sam1224/SCCAN.
authors: Qianxiong Xu, Wenting Zhao, Guosheng Lin, Cheng Long ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 655-665

title: 无任务持续学习的自进化动态扩展模型
title_en: Self-Evolved Dynamic Expansion Model for Task-Free Continual Learning
abstract: 无任务持续学习(TFCL)旨在从数据流中学习新概念而无需任何任务信息。动态扩展模型(DEM)通过动态扩展模型容量以应对数据分布变化,在TFCL中展现出 promising results。然而现有方法仅将输入偏移的识别作为扩展信号,忽视了新输入数据与先前学习知识之间的相关性,导致添加和训练不必要的参数。本文提出了一种新颖有效的TFCL框架,通过自评估机制评估现有专家知识的多样性作为扩展信号,动态扩展DEM模型架构。该机制确保以紧凑模型结构学习额外的潜在数据分布。提出了一种新颖性感知的样本选择方法,用于管理强制新添加专家从数据流中学习新颖信息的记忆缓冲区,进一步促进专家间的多样性。此外,我们还提出通过知识迁移在TFCL中重用先前学习的表征信息以学习新输入数据,这一方法尚未被探索。通过梯度更新机制对DEM扩展和训练进行正则化,逐步探索正向迁移,进一步提升性能。在TFCL基准上的实证结果表明,所提框架在使用合理参数数量的情况下优于现有最先进方法。代码可在https://github.com/dtuzi123/SEDEM/获取。
abstract_en: Task-Free Continual Learning (TFCL) aims to learn new concepts from a stream of data without any task information. The Dynamic Expansion Model (DEM) has shown promising results in TFCL by dynamically expanding the model's capacity to deal with shifts in the data distribution. However, existing approaches only consider the recognition of the input shift as the expansion signal and ignore the correlation between the newly incoming data and previously learned knowledge, resulting in adding and training unnecessary parameters. In this paper, we propose a novel and effective framework for TFCL, which dynamically expands the architecture of a DEM model through a self-assessment mechanism evaluating the diversity of knowledge among existing experts as expansion signals. This mechanism ensures learning additional underlying data distributions with a compact model structure. A novelty-aware sample selection approach is proposed to manage the memory buffer that forces the newly added expert to learn novel information from a data stream, which further promotes the diversity among experts. Moreover, we also propose to reuse previously learned representation information for learning new incoming data by using knowledge transfer in TFCL, which has not been explored before. The DEM expansion and training are regularized through a gradient updating mechanism to gradually explore the positive forward transfer, further improving the performance. Empirical results on TFCL benchmarks show that the proposed framework outperforms the state-of-the-art while using a reasonable number of parameters. The code is available at https://github.com/dtuzi123/SEDEM/.
authors: Fei Ye, Adrian G. Bors ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22102-22112

title: 面向时序动作检测的自反馈DETR
title_en: Self-Feedback DETR for Temporal Action Detection
abstract: 时序动作检测(TAD)是具有挑战性但对现实世界视频应用至关重要的任务。近期虽有基于DETR的模型被设计用于TAD,但其性能仍不理想。本文指出DETR在TAD中自注意力机制存在的问题;注意力模块过度聚焦于少数关键元素,称为时间坍缩问题。这导致编码器和解码器的能力下降,因其自注意力模块完全失效。为解决该问题,我们提出了一种新颖框架Self-DETR,利用解码器的交叉注意力图重新激活自注意力模块。通过交叉注意力图与其转置的简单矩阵乘法,我们恢复了编码器特征间的关联关系。同样,我们也能获取解码器查询中的信息。通过利用计算得到的引导图指导坍缩的自注意力图,我们有效解决了编码器和解码器中自注意力模块的时间坍缩问题。大量实验表明,Self-DETR通过保持各层注意力的高多样性,成功解决了时间坍缩问题。
abstract_en: Temporal Action Detection (TAD) is challenging but fundamental for real-world video applications. Recently, DETR-based models have been devised for TAD but have not performed well yet. In this paper, we point out the problem in the self-attention of DETR for TAD; the attention modules focus on a few key elements, called temporal collapse problem. It degrades the capability of the encoder and decoder since their self-attention modules play no role. To solve the problem, we propose a novel framework, Self-DETR, which utilizes cross-attention maps of the decoder to reactivate self-attention modules. We recover the relationship between encoder features by simple matrix multiplication of the cross-attention map and its transpose. Likewise, we also get the information within decoder queries. By guiding collapsed self-attention maps with the guidance map calculated, we settle down the temporal collapse of self-attention modules in the encoder and decoder. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that Self-DETR resolves the temporal collapse problem by keeping high diversity of attention over all layers.
authors: Jihwan Kim, Miso Lee, Jae-Pil Heo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10286-10296

title: 点云的自排序
title_en: Self-Ordering Point Clouds
abstract: 本文通过逐点排序的方法解决在三维点云中寻找代表性点子集的任务。目前仅有少数工作尝试解决这一具有挑战性的视觉问题,且均依赖难以获取的点和云标签。与这些工作不同,我们通过自监督方法引入三维点云中的逐点排序任务,称为自排序。我们进一步贡献了首个端到端可训练网络,该网络以自监督方式学习逐点排序。它采用了一种新颖的可微点评分-排序策略,并构建了分层对比方案以获取自监督信号。我们对方法进行了广泛消融实验,并在多个数据集和任务上展示了其优越性能,包括从未见过类别中点云的零样本排序。
abstract_en: In this paper we address the task of finding representative subsets of points in a 3D point cloud by means of a point-wise ordering. Only a few works have tried to address this challenging vision problem, all with the help of hard to obtain point and cloud labels. Different from these works, we introduce the task of point-wise ordering in 3D point clouds through self-supervision, which we call self-ordering. We further contribute the first end-to-end trainable network that learns a point-wise ordering in a self-supervised fashion. It utilizes a novel differentiable point scoring-sorting strategy and it constructs an hierarchical contrastive scheme to obtain self-supervision signals. We extensively ablate the method and show its superior performance even compared to supervised ordering methods on multiple datasets and tasks including zero-shot ordering of point clouds from unseen categories.
authors: Pengwan Yang, Cees G. M. Snoek, Yuki M. Asano ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15813-15822

title: 面向非示例类增量学习的自组织路径扩展方法
title_en: Self-Organizing Pathway Expansion for Non-Exemplar Class-Incremental Learning
abstract: 非示例类增量学习旨在无需访问旧类样本的情况下识别新旧类。由于共享神经路径只能通过增量样本进行区分,旧类与新类优化之间的冲突被进一步加剧。为解决该问题,我们提出了一种新颖的自组织路径扩展方案。该方案包含两类策略:一类是类特定路径组织策略,通过降低不同类间优化路径的耦合度以增强特征表示的独立性;另一类是路径引导的特征优化机制,用于缓解新旧类间的更新干扰。在四个数据集上的大量实验表明,该方法在性能上取得显著提升,分别超越现有最先进方法1%、3%、2%和2%。
abstract_en: Non-exemplar class-incremental learning aims to recognize both the old and new classes without access to old class samples. The conflict between old and new class optimization is exacerbated since the shared neural pathways can only be differentiated by the incremental samples. To address this problem, we propose a novel self-organizing pathway expansion scheme. Our scheme consists of a class-specific pathway organization strategy that reduces the coupling of optimization pathway among different classes to enhance the independence of the feature representation, and a pathway-guided feature optimization mechanism to mitigate the update interference between the old and new classes. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate significant performance gains, outperforming the state-of-the-art methods by a margin of 1%, 3%, 2% and 2%, respectively.
authors: Kai Zhu, Kecheng Zheng, Ruili Feng, Deli Zhao, Yang Cao, Zheng-Jun Zha ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19204-19213

title: 自监督突发超分辨率
title_en: Self-Supervised Burst Super-Resolution
abstract: 我们提出了一种自监督训练策略用于突发超分辨率,该策略仅在训练过程中使用噪声低分辨率突发序列。我们的方法消除了对合成数据模拟流程进行精细调参的需求,因为这些流程通常无法匹配真实世界的图像统计特性。与需要静态场景的噪声智能手机突发照片与三脚架固定数码单反相机获取的干净参考图像进行弱配对的训练策略相比,我们的方法更具可扩展性,并避免了智能手机与数码单反相机之间的色彩不匹配问题。为实现这一目标,我们提出了一种新的自监督目标函数,利用正向成像模型从突发序列中的混叠高频恢复高分辨率图像。我们的方法无需手动调整正向模型的参数,而是从数据中学习这些参数。此外,我们证明了我们的训练策略对突发序列中的动态场景运动具有鲁棒性,这使得可以使用真实世界数据训练突发超分辨率模型。在真实和合成数据上的大量实验表明,尽管仅在训练过程中使用噪声突发序列,通过我们的自监督策略训练的模型在质量上与使用合成数据或弱配对真实数据训练的全监督基线模型相匹配,有时甚至更优。最后,我们展示了我们的训练策略在四种不同的突发超分辨率架构中具有通用性。
abstract_en: We introduce a self-supervised training strategy for burst super-resolution that only uses noisy low-resolution bursts during training. Our approach eliminates the need to carefully tune synthetic data simulation pipelines, which often do not match real-world image statistics. Compared to weakly-paired training strategies, which require noisy smartphone burst photos of static scenes, paired with a clean reference obtained from a tripod-mounted DSLR camera, our approach is more scalable, and avoids the color mismatch between the smartphone and DSLR. To achieve this, we propose a new self-supervised objective that uses a forward imaging model to recover a high-resolution image from aliased high frequencies in the burst. Our approach does not require any manual tuning of the forward model's parameters; we learn them from data. Furthermore, we show our training strategy is robust to dynamic scene motion in the burst, which enables training burst super-resolution models using in-the-wild data. Extensive experiments on real and synthetic data show that, despite only using noisy bursts during training, models trained with our self-supervised strategy match, and sometimes surpass, the quality of fully-supervised baselines trained with synthetic data or weakly-paired ground-truth. Finally, we show our training strategy is general using four different burst super-resolution architectures.
authors: Goutam Bhat, Michaël Gharbi, Jiawen Chen, Luc Van Gool, Zhihao Xia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10605-10614

title: 基于自监督的字符到字符蒸馏的文本识别方法
title_en: Self-Supervised Character-to-Character Distillation for Text Recognition
abstract: 在处理复杂文本图像(例如不规则结构、低分辨率、严重遮挡和光照不均)时,现有监督文本识别方法对数据需求量大。尽管这些方法通过使用大规模合成文本图像来减少对标注真实图像的依赖,但领域差距仍限制了识别性能。因此,通过自监督学习探索未标注真实图像上的鲁棒文本特征表示是一个良好解决方案。然而,现有自监督文本识别方法通过沿水平轴粗略分割视觉特征进行序列到序列表示学习,这限制了增强的灵活性,因为基于几何的增强可能导致序列到序列特征不一致。受此启发,我们提出了一种新颖的自监督字符到字符蒸馏方法CCD,使多样化增强能够促进通用文本表示学习。具体而言,我们通过设计自监督字符分割模块来描述未标注真实图像的字符结构。随后,CCD利用图像两个增强视图之间的变换矩阵,在灵活增强下保持字符对齐的同时丰富局部字符多样性。实验表明,CCD取得了最先进的结果,在文本识别中平均性能提升1.38%,文本分割中提升1.7%,文本超分辨率中PSNR提升0.24 dB、SSIM提升0.0321。代码将很快发布。
abstract_en: When handling complicated text images (e.g., irregular structures, low resolution, heavy occlusion, and uneven illumination), existing supervised text recognition methods are data-hungry. Although these methods employ large-scale synthetic text images to reduce the dependence on annotated real images, the domain gap still limits the recognition performance. Therefore, exploring the robust text feature representations on unlabeled real images by self-supervised learning is a good solution. However, existing self-supervised text recognition methods conduct sequence-to-sequence representation learning by roughly splitting the visual features along the horizontal axis, which limits the flexibility of the augmentations, as large geometric-based augmentations may lead to sequence-to-sequence feature inconsistency. Motivated by this, we propose a novel self-supervised Character-to-Character Distillation method, CCD, which enables versatile augmentations to facilitate general text representation learning. Specifically, we delineate the character structures of unlabeled real images by designing a self-supervised character segmentation module. Following this, CCD easily enriches the diversity of local characters while keeping their pairwise alignment under flexible augmentations, using the transformation matrix between two augmented views from images. Experiments demonstrate that CCD achieves state-of-the-art results, with average performance gains of 1.38% in text recognition, 1.7% in text segmentation, 0.24 dB (PSNR) and 0.0321 (SSIM) in text super-resolution. Code will be released soon.
authors: Tongkun Guan, Wei Shen, Xue Yang, Qi Feng, Zekun Jiang, Xiaokang Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19473-19484

title: 基于方向感知累积卷积网络的自监督单目深度估计
title_en: Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation by Direction-aware Cumulative Convolution Network
abstract: 单目深度估计被认为是一个不适定任务,二维图像中的物体通常缺乏足够的信息来预测其深度。因此,它在许多方面与其他任务(如分类和分割)有所不同。本文发现,自监督单目深度估计在特征表示中表现出方向敏感性和环境依赖性。但当前从其他任务借用的CNN主干网络无法高效处理不同类型环境信息,限制了整体深度准确性。为弥合这一差距,我们提出了一种新的方向感知累积卷积网络(DaCCN),从两个方面改进深度特征表示。首先,我们提出一个方向感知模块,能够学习在每个方向调整特征提取,促进不同类型信息的编码。其次,我们设计了一种新的累积卷积以提高重要环境信息聚合的效率。实验表明,我们的方法在三个广泛使用的基准测试中实现了显著提升,并在包含三种自监督方式的流行基准测试中取得了新的最先进性能。
abstract_en: Monocular depth estimation is known as an ill-posed task that objects in a 2D image usually do not contain sufficient information to predict their depth. Thus, it acts differently from other tasks (e.g., classification and segmentation) in many ways. In this paper, we find that self-supervised monocular depth estimation shows a direction sensitivity and environmental dependency in the feature representation. But the current CNN backbones borrowed from other tasks cannot handle different types of environmental information efficiently, limiting the overall depth accuracy. To bridge this gap, we propose a new Direction-aware Cumulative Convolution Network (DaCCN), which improves the depth feature representation in two aspects. First, we propose a direction-aware module, which can learn to adjust the feature extraction in each direction, facilitating the encoding of different types of information. Secondly, we design a new cumulative convolution to improve the efficiency for aggregating important environmental information. Experiments show that our method achieves significant improvements on three widely used benchmarks and sets a new state-of-the-art performance on the popular benchmarks with all three types of self-supervision.
authors: Wencheng Han, Junbo Yin, Jianbing Shen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8613-8623

title: 基于第一人称视频的自监督目标检测
title_en: Self-Supervised Object Detection from Egocentric Videos
abstract: 从人类视角(第一人称)理解视觉世界一直是计算机视觉领域的长期挑战。与典型视频理解任务相比,第一人称视频表现出更高的场景复杂度和不规则的运动流。针对第一人称领域,我们解决了自监督、无类别目标检测问题,旨在无需任何标注或预训练权重的情况下,定位给定视角中的所有物体,无论其类别。我们的方法——自监督第一人称视频目标检测(DEVI)——通过端到端方式,将基于外观的方法推广到从高度模糊环境中学习类别特定且对视角和光照条件不变的特征。我们的方法利用典型人类行为及其第一人称感知,为多视角和尺度回归损失函数采样同一物体的多样化视图。通过我们学习的聚类残差模块,能够有效描述多类别片段以提升复杂场景理解。DEVI在近期第一人称数据集上实现了性能提升,AP50提升4.11%,AR1提升0.11%,AR10提升1.32%,AR100提升5.03%,同时显著降低模型复杂度。我们在无需额外训练或微调的情况下,也展示了在领域外数据集上的竞争力表现。
abstract_en: Understanding the visual world from the perspective of humans (egocentric) has been a long-standing challenge in computer vision. Egocentric videos exhibit high scene complexity and irregular motion flows compared to typical video understanding tasks. With the egocentric domain in mind, we address the problem of self-supervised, class-agnostic object detection, which aims to locate all objects in a given view, regardless of category, without any annotations or pre-training weights. Our method, self-supervised object Detection from Egocentric VIdeos (DEVI), generalizes appearance-based methods to learn features that are category-specific and invariant to viewing angles and illumination conditions from highly ambiguous environments in an end-to-end manner. Our approach leverages typical human behavior and its egocentric perception to sample diverse views of the same objects for our multi-view and scale-regression loss functions. With our learned cluster residual module, we are able to effectively describe multi-category patches for better complex scene understanding. DEVI provides a boost in performance on recent egocentric datasets, with performance gains up to 4.11% AP50, 0.11% AR1, 1.32% AR10, and 5.03% AR100, while significantly reducing model complexity. We also demonstrate competitive performance on out-of-domain datasets without additional training or fine-tuning.
authors: Peri Akiva, Jing Huang, Kevin J Liang, Rama Kovvuri, Xingyu Chen, Matt Feiszli, Kristin Dana, Tal Hassner ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5225-5237

title: 自调节提示:基础模型适应而不遗忘
title_en: Self-regulating Prompts: Foundational Model Adaptation without Forgetting
abstract: 提示学习已作为一种高效替代方案出现,用于对CLIP等基础模型进行微调以应对各种下游任务。传统方法通过任务特定目标(即交叉熵损失)进行训练,提示倾向于过拟合下游数据分布,并难以从冻结的CLIP中捕捉任务无关的通用特征,这导致模型原有泛化能力的丧失。为解决这一问题,我们的工作提出了一种名为PromptSRC(带自调节约束的提示)的自正则化框架。PromptSRC通过三重策略引导提示同时优化任务特定和任务无关的通用表示:(a) 通过与冻结模型的互惠协议最大化调节提示表示,(b) 通过提示在训练轨迹上的自集成编码其互补优势,(c) 通过文本多样性调节以缓解与视觉分支的样本多样性失衡。据我们所知,这是首个通过联合关注预训练模型特征、提示训练轨迹和文本多样性来避免过拟合的提示学习正则化框架。PromptSRC明确引导提示学习一个在下游任务上最大化性能且不损害CLIP泛化能力的表示空间。我们在4个基准数据集上进行了大量实验,结果表明PromptSRC整体表现优于现有方法。我们的代码和预训练模型已公开。
abstract_en: Prompt learning has emerged as an efficient alternative for fine-tuning foundational models, such as CLIP, for various downstream tasks. Conventionally trained using the task-specific objective, i.e., cross-entropy loss, prompts tend to overfit downstream data distributions and find it challenging to capture task-agnostic general features from the frozen CLIP. This leads to the loss of the model's original generalization capability. To address this issue, our work introduces a self-regularization framework for prompting called PromptSRC (Prompting with Self-regulating Constraints). PromptSRC guides the prompts to optimize for both task-specific and task-agnostic general representations using a three-pronged approach by: (a) regulating prompted representations via mutual agreement maximization with the frozen model, (b) regulating with self-ensemble of prompts over the training trajectory to encode their complementary strengths, and (c) regulating with textual diversity to mitigate sample diversity imbalance with the visual branch. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first regularization framework for prompt learning that avoids overfitting by jointly attending to pre-trained model features, the training trajectory during prompting, and the textual diversity. PromptSRC explicitly steers the prompts to learn a representation space that maximizes performance on downstream tasks without compromising CLIP generalization. We perform extensive experiments on 4 benchmarks where PromptSRC overall performs favorably well compared to the existing methods. Our code and pre-trained models are publicly available.
authors: Muhammad Uzair Khattak, Syed Talal Wasim, Muzammal Naseer, Salman Khan, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Fahad Shahbaz Khan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15190-15200

title: 基于自相似性驱动的尺度不变学习用于弱监督人物搜索
title_en: Self-similarity Driven Scale-invariant Learning for Weakly Supervised Person Search
abstract: 弱监督人物搜索旨在仅使用边界框标注的情况下联合检测和匹配人物。现有方法通常通过探索人物之间的关系来改进特征。然而,尺度变化问题是一个更为严重且研究不足的障碍,因为一个人通常拥有不同尺度(分辨率)的图像。一方面,小尺度图像包含较少的人物信息,从而影响生成的伪标签的准确性;另一方面,人物跨尺度图像之间的相似性差异增加了匹配难度。本文通过提出一种新颖的一步框架,名为自相似性驱动的尺度不变学习(SSL)来解决该问题。基于图像在不同尺度下具有相同统计特性的自相似性先验,可以探索尺度不变性。为此,我们引入了一个多尺度示例分支,通过困难示例挖掘引导网络专注于前景并学习尺度不变特征。为进一步增强所学特征的判别能力,我们进一步引入了动态伪标签预测,逐步寻找真实标签进行训练。在两个标准基准数据集PRW和CUHK-SYSU上的实验结果表明,所提方法能够有效解决尺度变化问题,并在与最先进方法的对比中表现出色。代码可在https://github.com/Wangbenzhi/SSL.git获取。
abstract_en: Weakly supervised person search aims to jointly detect and match persons with only bounding box annotations. Existing approaches typically focus on improving the features by exploring the relations of persons. However, scale variation problem is a more severe obstacle and under-studied that a person often owns images with different scales (resolutions). For one thing, small-scale images contain less information of a person, thus affecting the accuracy of the generated pseudo labels. For another, different similarities between cross-scale images of a person increase the difficulty of matching. In this paper, we address it by proposing a novel one-step framework, named Self-similarity driven Scale-invariant Learning (SSL). Scale invariance can be explored based on the self-similarity prior that it shows the same statistical properties of an image at different scales. To this end, we introduce a Multi-scale Exemplar Branch to guide the network in concentrating on the foreground and learning scale-invariant features by hard exemplars mining. To enhance the discriminative power of the learned features, we further introduce a dynamic pseudo label prediction that progressively seeks true labels for training. Experimental results on two standard benchmarks, i.e., PRW and CUHK-SYSU datasets, demonstrate that the proposed method can solve scale variation problem effectively and perform favorably against state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Wangbenzhi/SSL.git.
authors: Benzhi Wang, Yang Yang, Jinlin Wu, Guo-jun Qi, Zhen Lei ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1813-1822

title: 自监督跨视角表示重建用于变化描述
title_en: Self-supervised Cross-view Representation Reconstruction for Change Captioning
abstract: 变化描述旨在描述一对相似图像之间的差异。其关键挑战在于如何在由视角变化引起的伪变化下学习稳定的差异表示。本文通过提出一种自监督跨视角表示重建(SCORER)网络来解决这一问题。具体而言,我们首先设计多头token级匹配以建模相似/不相似图像的跨视角特征关系。随后,通过最大化相似图像的跨视角对比对齐,SCORER以自监督方式学习两种视角不变的图像表示。基于这些表示,我们通过交叉注意力重建未变化物体的表示,从而学习稳定的差异表示用于描述生成。进一步,我们设计了跨模态逆向推理模块以提升描述质量。该模块逆向建模描述与"before"表示的"幻觉"表示。通过将其推向"after"表示,我们以自监督方式强制描述对差异具有信息性。大量实验表明,我们的方法在四个数据集上取得了最先进结果。代码已开源于https://github.com/tuyunbin/SCORER。
abstract_en: Change captioning aims to describe the difference between a pair of similar images. Its key challenge is how to learn a stable difference representation under pseudo changes caused by viewpoint change. In this paper, we address this by proposing a self-supervised cross-view representation reconstruction (SCORER) network. Concretely, we first design a multi-head token-wise matching to model relationships between cross-view features from similar/dissimilar images. Then, by maximizing cross-view contrastive alignment of two similar images, SCORER learns two view-invariant image representations in a self-supervised way. Based on these, we reconstruct the representations of unchanged objects by cross-attention, thus learning a stable difference representation for caption generation. Further, we devise a cross-modal backward reasoning to improve the quality of caption. This module reversely models a "hallucination" representation with the caption and "before" representation. By pushing it closer to the "after" representation, we enforce the caption to be informative about the difference in a self-supervised manner. Extensive experiments show our method achieves the state-of-the-art results on four datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/tuyunbin/SCORER.
authors: Yunbin Tu, Liang Li, Li Su, Zheng-Jun Zha, Chenggang Yan, Qingming Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2805-2815

title: 基于下采样不变性损失和条件盲点网络的自监督图像去噪
title_en: Self-supervised Image Denoising with Downsampled Invariance Loss and Conditional Blind-Spot Network
abstract: 已有许多利用深度神经网络的图像去噪器,其性能远超传统基于模型的方法。近期,自监督方法受到关注,因为构建大规模真实噪声数据集进行监督训练是一项巨大负担。最具代表性的自监督去噪器基于盲点网络,该网络排除感受野中心像素。然而,排除任何输入像素都会舍弃部分信息,尤其是当排除对应输出位置的输入像素时。此外,标准盲点网络由于噪声的像素级相关性,无法有效降低真实相机噪声,尽管其能成功去除独立分布的合成噪声。因此,为实现更实用的去噪器,我们提出了一种新型自监督训练框架,能够去除真实噪声。为此,我们推导了网络由下采样盲化输出引导的监督损失的理论上界。同时,我们设计了条件盲点网络(C-BSN),该网络可有条件地控制网络的盲化程度,以利用中心像素信息。此外,我们利用随机子采样器对噪声进行空间去相关,使C-BSN摆脱了基于下采样的方法常出现的视觉伪影。大量实验表明,所提出的C-BSN在真实世界数据集上作为自监督去噪器实现了最先进的性能,并在无需后处理或优化的情况下展现出定性令人满意的结果。
abstract_en: There have been many image denoisers using deep neural networks, which outperform conventional model-based methods by large margins. Recently, self-supervised methods have attracted attention because constructing a large real noise dataset for supervised training is an enormous burden. The most representative self-supervised denoisers are based on blind-spot networks, which exclude the receptive field's center pixel. However, excluding any input pixel is abandoning some information, especially when the input pixel at the corresponding output position is excluded. In addition, a standard blind-spot network fails to reduce real camera noise due to the pixel-wise correlation of noise, though it successfully removes independently distributed synthetic noise. Hence, to realize a more practical denoiser, we propose a novel self-supervised training framework that can remove real noise. For this, we derive the theoretic upper bound of a supervised loss where the network is guided by the downsampled blinded output. Also, we design a conditional blind-spot network (C-BSN), which selectively controls the blindness of the network to use the center pixel information. Furthermore, we exploit a random subsampler to decorrelate noise spatially, making the C-BSN free of visual artifacts that were often seen in downsample-based methods. Extensive experiments show that the proposed C-BSN achieves state-of-the-art performance on real-world datasets as a self-supervised denoiser and shows qualitatively pleasing results without any post-processing or refinement.
authors: Yeong Il Jang, Keuntek Lee, Gu Yong Park, Seyun Kim, Nam Ik Cho ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12196-12205

title: 基于密集对应的可变形物体隐式形状表示的自监督学习
title_en: Self-supervised Learning of Implicit Shape Representation with Dense Correspondence for Deformable Objects
abstract: 学习可变形物体的具有密集对应关系的3D形状表示是计算机视觉的基础性问题。现有方法通常需要特定语义领域的额外标注,例如人体或动物的骨骼姿态,这需要额外的标注工作且容易产生误差累积,且受限于特定领域。本文提出了一种新颖的自监督方法,用于学习可变形物体的神经隐式形状表示,该方法能够通过模板形状和密集对应关系在3D空间中表示形状。我们的方法无需骨骼和皮肤权重的先验知识,仅需一组以符号距离场表示的形状。为处理大变形,我们约束学习到的模板形状与训练形状处于同一潜在空间,设计了一种新的局部刚性约束公式,强制局部区域的刚性变换并解决局部反射问题,同时提出了一种新的层次化刚性约束以减少模板形状与对应关系联合学习导致的歧义。大量实验表明,我们的模型能够表示具有大变形的形状。我们还展示了该形状表示在纹理迁移和形状编辑等典型应用中的竞争力。代码和模型将公开发布。
abstract_en: Learning 3D shape representation with dense correspondence for deformable objects is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Existing approaches often need additional annotations of specific semantic domain, e.g., skeleton pose for human body or animals, which require extra annotation effort and suffer from error accumulation, and they are limited to specific domain. In this paper, we propose a novel self-supervised approach to learn neural implicit shape representation for deformable objects, which can represent shapes with a template shape and dense correspondence in 3D. Our method does not require the priors of skeleton and skinning weight, and only requires a collection of shapes represented in signed distance fields. To handle the large deformation, we constrain the learned template shape in the same latent space with the training shapes, design a new formulation of local rigid constraint that enforces rigid transformation in local region and addresses local reflection issue, and present a new hierarchical rigid constraint to reduce the ambiguity due to the joint learning of template shape and correspondence. Extensive experiments show that our model can represent shapes with large deformations. We also show that our shape representation can support two typical applications, such as texture transfer and shape editing, with competitive performance. The code and models will be publicly released.
authors: Baowen Zhang, Jiahe Li, Xiaoming Deng, Yinda Zhang, Cuixia Ma, Hongan Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14268-14278

title: 自监督学习使双反转滚动快门图像焕发生机
title_en: Self-supervised Learning to Bring Dual Reversed Rolling Shutter Images Alive
abstract: 现代消费级相机通常采用滚动快门(RS)机制,通过逐行扫描场景捕捉图像,导致动态场景出现RS失真。为纠正RS失真,现有方法采用全监督学习方式,需收集高帧率全局快门(GS)图像作为监督信号。本文提出一种自监督学习框架用于双反转RS失真校正(SelfDRSC),其中DRSC网络可通过仅基于具有反转失真的双RS图像学习生成高帧率GS视频。具体而言,提出双向失真变形模块用于重建双反转RS图像,随后通过增强输入与重建双反转RS图像之间的循环一致性,部署自监督损失函数训练DRSC网络。此外,SelfDRSC还可对起始和结束RS扫描时间之外的任意中间扫描时间的GS图像进行监督,从而使学习到的DRSC网络能够生成高帧率GS视频。此外,在自监督损失中引入了一种简单而有效的自蒸馏策略,以减轻生成GS图像中的边界伪影。在合成数据集上,SelfDRSC在定量指标上优于或与全监督训练的最先进方法相当。在真实世界RS场景中,我们的SelfDRSC可生成具有更精细校正纹理和更好时间一致性的高帧率GS视频。源代码和训练模型已公开在https://github.com/shangwei5/SelfDRSC。
abstract_en: Modern consumer cameras usually employ the rolling shutter (RS) mechanism, where images are captured by scanning scenes row-by-row, yielding RS distortions for dynamic scenes. To correct RS distortions, existing methods adopt a fully supervised learning manner, where high framerate global shutter (GS) images should be collected as ground-truth supervision. In this paper, we propose a Self-supervised learning framework for Dual reversed RS distortions Correction (SelfDRSC), where a DRSC network can be learned to generate a high framerate GS video only based on dual RS images with reversed distortions. In particular, a bidirectional distortion warping module is proposed for reconstructing dual reversed RS images, and then a self-supervised loss can be deployed to train DRSC network by enhancing the cycle consistency between input and reconstructed dual reversed RS images. Besides start and end RS scanning time, GS images at arbitrary intermediate scanning time can also be supervised in SelfDRSC, thus enabling the learned DRSC network to generate a high framerate GS video. Moreover, a simple yet effective self-distillation strategy is introduced in self-supervised loss for mitigating boundary artifacts in generated GS images. On synthetic dataset, SelfDRSC achieves better or comparable quantitative metrics in comparison to state-of-the-art methods trained in the full supervision manner. On real-world RS cases, our SelfDRSC can produce high framerate GS videos with finer correction textures and better temporary consistency. The source code and trained models are made publicly available at https://github.com/ shangwei5/SelfDRSC.
authors: Wei Shang, Dongwei Ren, Chaoyu Feng, Xiaotao Wang, Lei Lei, Wangmeng Zuo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13086-13094

title: 自监督单目深度估计:让我们谈谈天气的影响
title_en: Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation: Let's Talk About The Weather
abstract: 当前,自监督深度估计架构依赖于晴朗无云的天气场景来训练深度神经网络。然而,在许多地区,这一假设过于强烈。例如,在英国(2021年),有149天为降雨天气。为了使这些架构在实际应用中有效,我们必须创建能够泛化到所有天气条件、昼夜时段和图像质量的模型。通过结合计算机图形学和生成模型,可以以多种方式增强现有晴天数据,以模拟恶劣天气效果。虽然使用此类数据增强进行自监督深度估计颇具吸引力,但过去的研究表明这反而会降低性能而非提升。在本文中,我们提出了一种方法,利用增强技术来解决这一问题。通过利用未增强数据与增强数据之间的对应关系,我们为深度和姿态估计引入了伪监督损失。这在不依赖任何标签的情况下恢复了部分监督学习的优势。我们还提出了一系列实用建议,共同构建了一个可靠且高效的框架,用于单目视频自监督深度的天气相关增强。我们进行了广泛的测试,结果表明我们的方法Robust-Depth在KITTI数据集上实现了SotA性能,同时在具有挑战性的恶劣条件数据(如DrivingStereo、Foggy CityScape和NuScenes-Night)上显著超越了SotA。项目网站可访问https://kieran514.github.io/Robust-Depth-Project/。
abstract_en: Current, self-supervised depth estimation architectures rely on clear and sunny weather scenes to train deep neural networks. However, in many locations, this assumption is too strong. For example in the UK (2021), 149 days consisted of rain. For these architectures to be effective in real-world applications, we must create models that can generalise to all weather conditions, times of the day and image qualities. Using a combination of computer graphics and generative models, one can augment existing sunny-weather data in a variety of ways that simulate adverse weather effects. While it is tempting to use such data augmentations for self-supervised depth, in the past this was shown to degrade performance instead of improving it. In this paper, we put forward a method that uses augmentations to remedy this problem. By exploiting the correspondence between unaugmented and augmented data we introduce a pseudo-supervised loss for both depth and pose estimation. This brings back some of the benefits of supervised learning while still not requiring any labels. We also make a series of practical recommendations which collectively offer a reliable, efficient framework for weather-related augmentation of self-supervised depth from monocular video. We present extensive testing to show that our method, Robust-Depth, achieves SotA performance on the KITTI dataset while significantly surpassing SotA on challenging, adverse condition data such as DrivingStereo, Foggy CityScape and NuScenes-Night. The project website can be found at https://kieran514.github.io/Robust-Depth-Project/.
authors: Kieran Saunders, George Vogiatzis, Luis J. Manso ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8907-8917

title: 自监督单目水下深度恢复、图像修复及真实海域视频数据集
title_en: Self-supervised Monocular Underwater Depth Recovery, Image Restoration, and a Real-sea Video Dataset
abstract: 由于其本质的不适定性和缺乏真实大规模水下配对数据集,水下(UW)深度估计和图像修复是一项具有挑战性的任务。此前,水下深度估计主要通过利用雾霾信息、立体图像的几何线索或视频中相邻帧的信息来实现。为从单目水下图像中获得更精确的深度估计,我们提出了一种深度学习(DL)方法,在训练过程中同时利用雾霾和几何信息。通过结合水下图像形成的物理模型与单目视频中相邻帧的视图合成约束,我们对输入图像进行解耦,同时获得场景辐射度的估计。所提出的方法完全自监督,能够实时(55 fps)同时输出深度图和修复后的图像。我们将这一首次实现水下深度与图像同步恢复的自监督深度学习网络命名为USe-ReDI-Net。为促进单目自监督,我们收集了一个真实海域水下文物视频数据集(DRUVA),该数据集包含20种不同水下文物的视频序列,每个文物几乎具有完整的方位覆盖。在DRUVA及其他水下数据集上的大量实验验证了所提USe-ReDI-Net在水下深度和图像恢复任务中优于现有方法。数据集DRUVA可在https://github.com/nishavarghese15/DRUVA获取
abstract_en: Underwater (UW) depth estimation and image restoration is a challenging task due to its fundamental ill-posedness and the unavailability of real large-scale UW-paired datasets. UW depth estimation has been attempted before by utilizing either the haze information present or the geometry cue from stereo images or the adjacent frames in a video. To obtain improved estimates of depth from a single UW image, we propose a deep learning (DL) method that utilizes both haze and geometry during training. By harnessing the physical model for UW image formation in conjunction with the view-synthesis constraint on neighboring frames in monocular videos, we perform disentanglement of the input image to also get an estimate of the scene radiance. The proposed method is completely self-supervised and simultaneously outputs the depth map and the restored image in real-time (55 fps). We call this first-ever Underwater Self-supervised deep learning network for simultaneous Recovery of Depth and Image as USe-ReDI-Net. To facilitate monocular self-supervision, we collected a Dataset of Real-world Underwater Videos of Artifacts (DRUVA) in shallow sea waters. DRUVA is the first UW video dataset that contains video sequences of 20 different submerged artifacts with almost full azimuthal coverage of each artifact. Extensive experiments on our DRUVA dataset and other UW datasets establish the superiority of our proposed USe-ReDI-Net over prior art for both UW depth and image recovery. The dataset DRUVA is available at https://github.com/nishavarghese15/DRUVA
authors: Nisha Varghese, Ashish Kumar, A. N. Rajagopalan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12248-12258

title: 面向镜面检测的自监督预训练
title_en: Self-supervised Pre-training for Mirror Detection
abstract: 现有镜面检测方法需要通过监督式ImageNet预训练以获取良好的通用图像特征。然而,监督式ImageNet预训练侧重于类别级判别,可能因过拟合上游任务(如监督式图像分类)而不适合下游任务如镜面检测。我们观察到镜面反射对于人类感知镜面存在至关重要,此类中层特征可通过自监督预训练模型更有效地迁移。受此观察启发,本文旨在通过提出一种新的自监督学习(SSL)预训练框架来改进镜面检测方法,该框架在预训练过程中逐步建模镜面反射的表示。我们的框架包含三个不同层级的预训练阶段:1)图像级预训练阶段,将镜面反射特征全局融入预训练模型;2)块级预训练阶段,通过图像块空间模拟并学习局部镜面反射;3)像素级预训练阶段,通过基于镜内外关系重建损坏镜像来逐像素捕捉镜面反射。大量实验表明,我们的SSL预训练框架显著优于先前最先进的基于CNN的SSL预训练框架,甚至在迁移至镜面检测任务时超越监督式ImageNet预训练。代码和模型可在https://jiaying.link/iccv2023-sslmirror/获取
abstract_en:
Existing mirror detection methods require supervised ImageNet pre-training to obtain good general-purpose image features. However, supervised ImageNet pre-training focuses on category-level discrimination and may not be suitable for downstream tasks like mirror detection, due to the overfitting upstream tasks (e.g., supervised image classification). We observe that mirror reflection is crucial to how people perceive the presence of mirrors, and such mid-level features can be better transferred from self-supervised pre-trained models. Inspired by this observation, in this paper we aim to improve mirror detection methods by proposing a new self-supervised learning (SSL) pre-training framework for modeling the representation of mirror reflection progressively in the pre-training process. 
 Our framework consists of three pre-training stages at different levels: 
 1) an image-level pre-training stage to globally incorporate mirror reflection features into the pre-trained model; 
 2) a patch-level pre-training stage to spatially simulate and learn local mirror reflection from image patches; and 
 3) a pixel-level pre-training stage to pixel-wisely capture mirror reflection via reconstructing corrupted mirror images based on the relationship between the inside and outside of mirrors.
 Extensive experiments show that our SSL pre-training framework significantly outperforms previous state-of-the-art CNN-based SSL pre-training frameworks and even outperforms supervised ImageNet pre-training when transferred to the mirror detection task. 
 Code and models are available at https://jiaying.link/iccv2023-sslmirror/
authors: Jiaying Lin, Rynson W.H. Lau ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12227-12236

title: SemARFlow:将语义注入无监督光流估计以用于自动驾驶
title_en: SemARFlow: Injecting Semantics into Unsupervised Optical Flow Estimation for Autonomous Driving
abstract: 无监督光流估计在遮挡区域、运动边界和低纹理区域尤其困难。我们证明额外信息如语义和领域知识有助于更好地约束该问题。我们引入SemARFlow,一个针对自动驾驶数据设计的无监督光流网络,其输入包含估计的语义分割掩码作为额外信息。该额外信息被注入到编码器和学习到的上采样器中以细化流输出。此外,一个简单而有效的语义增强模块在学习车辆、杆子和天空的流及其边界时提供自我监督。这些语义信息的注入将KITTI-2015光流测试错误率从11.80%提升至8.38%。我们还展示了在物体边界处的明显改进以及更强的跨数据集泛化能力。代码可在https://github.com/duke-vision/semantic-unsup-flow-release获取。
abstract_en: Unsupervised optical flow estimation is especially hard near occlusions and motion boundaries and in low-texture regions. We show that additional information such as semantics and domain knowledge can help better constrain this problem. We introduce SemARFlow, an unsupervised optical flow network designed for autonomous driving data that takes estimated semantic segmentation masks as additional inputs. This additional information is injected into the encoder and into a learned upsampler that refines the flow output. In addition, a simple yet effective semantic augmentation module provides self-supervision when learning flow and its boundaries for vehicles, poles, and sky. Together, these injections of semantic information improve the KITTI-2015 optical flow test error rate from 11.80% to 8.38%. We also show visible improvements around object boundaries as well as a greater ability to generalize across datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/duke-vision/semantic-unsup-flow-release.
authors: Shuai Yuan, Shuzhi Yu, Hannah Kim, Carlo Tomasi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9566-9577

title: 单目动态场景分解的语义注意力流场
title_en: Semantic Attention Flow Fields for Monocular Dynamic Scene Decomposition
abstract: 从视频中,我们重建一个神经体积以捕捉时变颜色、密度、场景流、语义和注意力信息。语义和注意力信息使我们能够跨时空将显著的前景物体与背景分离。为缓解低分辨率语义和注意力特征的问题,我们计算金字塔结构以在细节与全图像上下文之间进行权衡。优化后,我们进行显著性感知聚类以分解场景。为评估真实场景,我们在NVIDIA Dynamic Scene和DyCheck数据集中标注对象掩码。我们证明该方法能够以无监督方式分解动态场景,其性能与监督方法具有竞争力,并且在前景/背景分割上优于近期的静态/动态分割方法。项目网页: https://visual.cs.brown.edu/saff
abstract_en: From video, we reconstruct a neural volume that captures time-varying color, density, scene flow, semantics, and attention information. The semantics and attention let us identify salient foreground objects separately from the background across spacetime. To mitigate low resolution semantic and attention features, we compute pyramids that trade detail with whole-image context. After optimization, we perform a saliency-aware clustering to decompose the scene. To evaluate real-world scenes, we annotate object masks in the NVIDIA Dynamic Scene and DyCheck datasets. We demonstrate that this method can decompose dynamic scenes in an unsupervised way with competitive performance to a supervised method, and that it improves foreground/background segmentation over recent static/dynamic split methods. Project webpage: https://visual.cs.brown.edu/saff
authors: Yiqing Liang, Eliot Laidlaw, Alexander Meyerowitz, Srinath Sridhar, James Tompkin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21797-21806

title: 对比学习中的语义信息
title_en: Semantic Information in Contrastive Learning
abstract: 本文探讨了对比学习(SemCL)中语义信息的功能。设计了一种先进的预训练任务:在场景中对每个物体与其环境进行对比。这使得SemCL预训练模型能够在图像中从环境中提取物体,显著提升预训练模型的空间理解能力。在PASCAl VOC、Cityscapes、COCO、KITTI等数据集上实现了语义/实例分割、目标检测和深度估计等下游任务。SemCL预训练模型在下游任务中显著优于ImageNet预训练模型,并与知名工作具有竞争力。结果表明,利用语义信息的专门预训练任务在与空间理解相关的基准测试中具有强大能力。代码可在https://github.com/sjiang95/semcl获取。
abstract_en: This work investigates the functionality of Semantic information in Contrastive Learning (SemCL). An advanced pretext task is designed: a contrast is performed between each object and its environment, taken from a scene. This allows the SemCL pretrained model to extract objects from their environment in an image, significantly improving the spatial understanding of the pretrained models. Downstream tasks of semantic/instance segmentation, object detection and depth estimation are implemented on PASCAl VOC, Cityscapes, COCO, KITTI, etc. SemCL pretrained models substantially outperform ImageNet pretrained counterparts and are competitive with well-known works on downstream tasks. The results suggest that a dedicated pretext task leveraging semantic information can be powerful in benchmarks related to spatial understanding. The code is available at https://github.com/sjiang95/semcl.
authors: Shengjiang Quan, Masahiro Hirano, Yuji Yamakawa ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5686-5696

title: 语义感知的视频修复变换器动态参数
title_en: Semantic-Aware Dynamic Parameter for Video Inpainting Transformer
abstract: 近期基于学习的视频修复方法取得了显著进展。然而,它们仍无法充分挖掘视频帧内的语义信息,导致场景布局预测不当,难以恢复混合场景中清晰的物体边界。为缓解这一问题,我们提出了一种基于变换器的新型视频修复技术,能够有效利用输入中的语义信息,显著提升重建质量。本研究采用专家混合方案,训练多个专家处理包含多种语义的混合场景,并通过这些专家生成局部(token-wise)差异化的网络参数,实现语义感知的修复效果。在YouTube-VOS和DAVIS基准数据集上的大量实验表明,与现有传统视频修复方法相比,所提方法在合成视觉愉悦的视频方面表现出色,具有更清晰的语义结构和纹理。
abstract_en: Recent learning-based video inpainting approaches have achieved considerable progress. However, they still cannot fully utilize semantic information within the video frames and predict improper scene layout, failing to restore clear object boundaries for mixed scenes. To mitigate this problem, we introduce a new transformer-based video inpainting technique that can exploit semantic information within the input and considerably improve reconstruction quality. In this study, we use the mixture-of-experts scheme and train multiple experts to handle mixed scenes, including various semantics. We leverage these multiple experts and produce locally (token-wise) different network parameters to achieve semantic-aware inpainting results. Extensive experiments on YouTube-VOS and DAVIS benchmark datasets demonstrate that, compared with existing conventional video inpainting approaches, the proposed method has superior performance in synthesizing visually pleasing videos with much clearer semantic structures and textures.
authors: Eunhye Lee, Jinsu Yoo, Yunjeong Yang, Sungyong Baik, Tae Hyun Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12949-12958

title: 基于部件形变一致性的语义感知隐式模板学习
title_en: Semantic-Aware Implicit Template Learning via Part Deformation Consistency
abstract: 将隐式模板作为神经场进行学习在无监督形状对应任务中最近展现了令人印象深刻的表现。尽管取得了成功,我们观察到当前仅依赖几何信息的方法在具有高度结构变异性的通用物体形状上往往学习到次优的形变。在本文中,我们强调部件形变一致性的重要性,并提出一种语义感知的隐式模板学习框架以实现语义合理的形变。通过利用自监督特征提取器提供的语义先验,我们建议通过新颖的语义感知形变编码进行局部条件化,并引入关于部件形变、全局形变和全局缩放的形变一致性正则化。我们的大量实验表明,所提方法在关键点迁移、部件标签迁移和纹理迁移等任务中均优于基线方法。更有趣的是,我们的框架在更具挑战性的设置下表现出更大的性能提升。我们还提供了定性分析以验证语义感知形变的有效性。代码可在https://github.com/mlvlab/PDC获取。
abstract_en: Learning implicit templates as neural fields has recently shown impressive performance in unsupervised shape correspondence. Despite the success, we observe current approaches, which solely rely on geometric information, often learn suboptimal deformation across generic object shapes, which have high structural variability. In this paper, we highlight the importance of part deformation consistency and propose a semantic-aware implicit template learning framework to enable semantically plausible deformation. By leveraging semantic prior from a self-supervised feature extractor, we suggest local conditioning with novel semantic-aware deformation code and deformation consistency regularizations regarding part deformation, global deformation, and global scaling. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method over baselines in various tasks: keypoint transfer, part label transfer, and texture transfer. More interestingly, our framework shows a larger performance gain under more challenging settings. We also provide qualitative analyses to validate the effectiveness of semantic-aware deformation. The code is available at https://github.com/mlvlab/PDC.
authors: Sihyeon Kim, Minseok Joo, Jaewon Lee, Juyeon Ko, Juhan Cha, Hyunwoo J. Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 593-603

title: 基于不规则分组解耦的语义结构化图像压缩
title_en: Semantically Structured Image Compression via Irregular Group-Based Decoupling
abstract: 图像压缩技术通常聚焦于压缩矩形图像以满足人类视觉需求,但由此导致下游应用传输冗余内容。为克服这一局限,部分先前工作提出语义结构化比特流,通过选择性传输与重建满足特定应用需求。然而,它们根据语义将输入图像划分为多个矩形区域,忽略避免区域间信息交互,导致码率浪费与区域边界失真重建。本文提出基于定制分组掩码将图像解耦为多个不规则形状组,并独立压缩各组。我们的分组掩码以更细粒度描述图像,通过减少冗余内容传输实现显著码率节省。此外,为确保选择性重建的保真度,本文提出组独立变换概念,维持不同组间的独立性,并通过所提出的组独立Swin块(GI Swin-Block)进行实例化。实验结果表明,我们的框架以微小代价结构化比特流,在视觉质量与智能任务支持方面均表现出优越性能。
abstract_en: Image compression techniques typically focus on compressing rectangular images for human consumption, however, resulting in transmitting redundant content for downstream applications. To overcome this limitation, some previous works propose to semantically structure the bitstream, which can meet specific application requirements by selective transmission and reconstruction. Nevertheless, they divide the input image into multiple rectangular regions according to semantics and ignore avoiding information interaction among them, causing waste of bitrate and distorted reconstruction of region boundaries. In this paper, we propose to decouple an image into multiple groups with irregular shapes based on a customized group mask and compress them independently. Our group mask describes the image at a finer granularity, enabling significant bitrate saving by reducing the transmission of redundant content. Moreover, to ensure the fidelity of selective reconstruction, this paper proposes the concept of group-independent transform that maintain the independence among distinct groups. And we instantiate it by the proposed Group-Independent Swin-Block (GI Swin-Block). Experimental results demonstrate that our framework structures the bitstream with negligible cost, and exhibits superior performance on both visual quality and intelligent task supporting.
authors: Ruoyu Feng, Yixin Gao, Xin Jin, Runsen Feng, Zhibo Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17237-17247

title: 语义与时间对应性融合:视频中的自监督对象中心学习
title_en: Semantics Meets Temporal Correspondence: Self-supervised Object-centric Learning in Videos
abstract: 自监督方法在学习高层语义和低层时间对应性方面取得了显著进展。基于这些成果,我们进一步探索将这两种特征整合以增强对象中心表示的可能性。我们的初步实验表明,查询槽注意力机制可以从RGB特征图中提取不同的语义成分,而基于随机采样的槽注意力机制则能利用帧间的时间对应性线索辅助实例识别。受此启发,我们在融合的语义特征和对应性图上提出了一种新颖的语义感知掩码槽注意力机制。该机制包含两个槽注意力阶段,并共享一组可学习的高斯分布。在第一阶段,我们使用均值向量作为槽初始化,通过迭代注意力分解潜在语义并生成语义分割掩码。在第二阶段,针对每个语义,我们从对应的高斯分布中随机采样槽,并在语义区域内执行掩码特征聚合,以利用时间对应性模式进行实例识别。我们采用语义级和实例级的时间一致性作为自监督信号,以鼓励时间一致性的对象中心表示。我们的模型能够有效识别具有语义结构的多个对象实例,在无监督视频对象发现任务中取得了有前景的结果。此外,我们在密集标签传播任务中实现了最先进性能,证明了对象中心分析的潜力。__TITLE_MATH_1__ __ABS_MATH_1__
abstract_en: Self-supervised methods have shown remarkable progress in learning high-level semantics and low-level temporal correspondence. Building on these results, we take one step further and explore the possibility of integrating these two features to enhance object-centric representations. Our preliminary experiments indicate that query slot attention can extract different semantic components from the RGB feature map, while random sampling based slot attention can exploit temporal correspondence cues between frames to assist instance identification. Motivated by this, we propose a novel semantic-aware masked slot attention on top of the fused semantic features and correspondence maps. It comprises two slot attention stages with a set of shared learnable Gaussian distributions. In the first stage, we use the mean vectors as slot initialization to decompose potential semantics and generate semantic segmentation masks through iterative attention. In the second stage, for each semantics, we randomly sample slots from the corresponding Gaussian distribution and perform masked feature aggregation within the semantic area to exploit temporal correspondence patterns for instance identification. We adopt semantic- and instance-level temporal consistency as self-supervision to encourage temporally coherent object-centric representations. Our model effectively identifies multiple object instances with semantic structure, reaching promising results on unsupervised video object discovery. Furthermore, we achieve state-of-the-art performance on dense label propagation tasks, demonstrating the potential for object-centric analysis.
authors: Rui Qian, Shuangrui Ding, Xian Liu, Dahua Lin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16675-16687

title: 自监督视觉表征学习中的语义一致特征搜索
title_en: Semantics-Consistent Feature Search for Self-Supervised Visual Representation Learning
abstract: 在对比自监督学习中,学习判别性表征的常规方法是通过拉近同一图像的不同增强"视图"并推远其他图像,已被证明是有效的。然而,在增强过程中不可避免地会产生包含不同语义概念的不良视图。若在特征空间中无差别地拉近这些增强视图,将破坏表征的语义一致性。本研究引入特征级增强,提出一种新颖的语义一致特征搜索(SCFS)方法以缓解这一负面影响。SCFS的核心思想是自适应搜索语义一致特征,增强不同增强视图中语义一致区域的对比度。因此,训练模型能够学习关注有意义的物体区域,提升语义表征能力。在不同数据集和任务上的大量实验表明,SCFS有效提升了自监督学习的性能,并在不同下游任务中达到最先进水平。
abstract_en:
In contrastive self-supervised learning, the common way to learn discriminative representation is to pull different augmented "views" of the same image closer while pushing all other images further apart, which has been proven to be effective. However, it is unavoidable to construct undesirable views containing different semantic concepts during the augmentation procedure. It would damage the semantic consistency of representation to pull these augmentations closer in
 the feature space indiscriminately. In this study, we introduce feature-level augmentation and propose a novel semantics-consistent feature search (SCFS) method to mitigate this negative effect. The main idea of SCFS is to adaptively
 search semantics-consistent features to enhance the contrast between semantics-consistent regions in different augmentations. Thus, the trained model can learn to focus on meaningful object regions, improving the semantic representation ability. Extensive experiments conducted on different datasets and tasks demonstrate that SCFS effectively improves the performance of self-supervised learning and achieves state-of-the-art performance on different downstream tasks.
authors: Kaiyou Song, Shan Zhang, Zimeng Luo, Tong Wang, Jin Xie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16099-16108

title: Semantify:利用CLIP简化3D可变形模型的控制
title_en: Semantify: Simplifying the Control of 3D Morphable Models Using CLIP
abstract: 我们提出Semantify:一种自监督方法,利用CLIP语言-视觉基础模型的语义能力来简化3D可变形模型的控制。给定一个参数化模型,通过随机采样模型参数生成训练数据,创建各种形状并进行渲染。在CLIP的潜在空间中计算输出图像与一组单词描述符之间的相似度。我们的核心思想是首先选择一组语义有意义且解耦的描述符来表征3DMM,然后学习从该描述符集合的得分到给定3DMM参数系数的非线性映射。该非线性映射通过训练一个无需人类参与的神经网络来定义。我们在众多3DMM上展示了结果:包括身体形状模型、面部形状与表情模型以及动物形状模型。我们展示了该方法如何定义一个直观的滑块界面进行建模,并展示了该映射如何用于即时拟合3D参数化身体形状到野外图像。
