abstract_en: We present Semantify: a self-supervised method that utilizes the semantic power of CLIP language-vision foundation model to simplify the control of 3D morphable models. Given a parametric model, training data is created by randomly sampling the model's parameters, creating various shapes and rendering them. The similarity between the output images and a set of word descriptors is calculated in CLIP's latent space. Our key idea is first to choose a small set of semantically meaningful and disentangled descriptors that characterize the 3DMM, and then learn a non-linear mapping from scores across this set to the parametric coefficients of the given 3DMM. The non-linear mapping is defined by training a neural network without a human-in-the-loop. We present results on numerous 3DMMs: body shape models, face shape and expression models, as well as animal shapes. We demonstrate how our method defines a simple slider interface for intuitive modeling, and show how the mapping can be used to instantly fit a 3D parametric body shape to in-the-wild images.
authors: Omer Gralnik, Guy Gafni, Ariel Shamir ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14554-14564

title: 基于类别分布不匹配的加权感知蒸馏半监督学习
title_en: Semi-Supervised Learning via Weight-Aware Distillation under Class Distribution Mismatch
abstract: 类别分布不匹配下的半监督学习(SSL)旨在解决一个具有挑战性的问题,即未标记数据中包含大量在标记数据中未出现的未知类别。在这样的不匹配场景中,传统SSL由于未知类别实例对目标分类器的有害入侵而遭受严重性能下降。在本研究中,通过严格的数学推导,我们揭示了类别分布不匹配下的SSL误差由伪标签误差和入侵误差共同构成,二者共同界定了SSL总体风险。为缓解SSL误差,我们提出了一种鲁棒的SSL框架,称为加权感知蒸馏(WAD),通过权重选择性地从无监督对比表示中迁移对目标任务有益的知识到目标分类器。具体而言,WAD通过在表示空间中探索点互信息(PMI)来捕捉自适应权重和高质量伪标签,以最大化未标记数据的作用并过滤未知类别。理论上,我们证明了WAD在类别分布不匹配下具有紧致的总体风险上界。实验上,大量结果表明,WAD在两个基准数据集CIFAR10和CIFAR100以及一个人工跨数据集上,优于五种最先进的SSL方法和一个标准基线。代码可在https://github.com/RUC-DWBI-ML/research/tree/main/WAD-master获取。
abstract_en:
Semi-Supervised Learning (SSL) under class distribution mismatch aims to tackle a challenging problem wherein unlabeled data contain lots of unknown categories unseen in the labeled ones. In such mismatch scenarios, traditional SSL suffers severe performance damage due to the harmful invasion of the instances with unknown categories into the target classifier. In this study, by strict mathematical reasoning, we reveal that the SSL error under class distribution mismatch is composed of pseudo-labeling error and invasion error, both of which jointly bound the SSL population risk. To alleviate the SSL error, we propose a robust SSL framework called Weight-Aware Distillation (WAD) that, by weights, selectively transfers knowledge beneficial to the target task from unsupervised contrastive representation to the target classifier. Specifically, WAD captures adaptive weights and high-quality pseudo-labels to target instances by exploring point mutual information (PMI) in representation space to maximize the role of unlabeled data and filter unknown categories. Theoretically, we prove that WAD has a tight upper bound of population risk under class distribution mismatch. Experimentally, extensive results demonstrate that WAD outperforms five state-of-the-art SSL approaches
 and one standard baseline on two benchmark datasets, CIFAR10 and CIFAR100, and an artificial cross-dataset. The code is available at https://github.com/RUC-DWBI-ML/research/tree/main/WAD-master.
authors: Pan Du, Suyun Zhao, Zisen Sheng, Cuiping Li, Hong Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16410-16420

title: 基于多样化学习组的半监督语义分割方法在标签噪声下的研究
title_en: Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation under Label Noise via Diverse Learning Groups
abstract: 半监督语义分割方法利用少量干净的像素级标注来指导对大量未标注图像数据的解释。在大规模提供像素级精确标注存在挑战的情况下,标签通常包含噪声,这会污染最终结果。本文提出了一种对标注数据中的标签噪声具有鲁棒性的方法。该方法采用两个具有不同网络架构的多样化学习组,有效处理标签噪声和未标注图像。每个学习组包含一个教师网络、一个学生网络和一个新颖的过滤模块。每个学习组的过滤模块利用教师网络的像素级特征来检测错误标注的像素。为减少确认偏误,我们采用一个学习组过滤模块清理后的标签来训练另一个学习组。在两个不同基准和设置上的实验结果证明了我们的方法优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en:
Semi-supervised semantic segmentation methods use a small amount of clean pixel-level annotations to guide the interpretation of a larger quantity of unlabelled image data. The challenges of providing pixel-accurate annotations at scale mean that the labels are typically noisy, and this contaminates the final results. In this work, we propose an approach that is robust to label noise in the annotated data.
 The method uses two diverse learning groups with different network architectures to effectively handle both label noise and unlabelled images. Each learning group consists of a teacher network, a student network and a novel filter module. The filter module of each learning group utilizes pixel-level features from the teacher network to detect incorrectly labelled pixels. To reduce confirmation bias, we employ the labels cleaned by the filter module from one learning group to train the other learning group. Experimental results on two different benchmarks and settings demonstrate the superiority of our method over state-of-the-art approaches.
authors: Peixia Li, Pulak Purkait, Thalaiyasingam Ajanthan, Majid Abdolshah, Ravi Garg, Hisham Husain, Chenchen Xu, Stephen Gould, Wanli Ouyang, Anton van den Hengel ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1229-1238

title: 半监督语义引导对抗训练在鲁棒轨迹预测中的应用
title_en: Semi-supervised Semantics-guided Adversarial Training for Robust Trajectory Prediction
abstract: 预测周围物体的轨迹是自动驾驶车辆及其他许多自主系统的关键任务。近期研究表明,针对轨迹预测的对抗攻击,即在历史轨迹中引入精心设计的扰动,可能显著误导未来轨迹预测并引发不安全的规划。然而,鲜有研究针对这一重要的安全关键任务提升其鲁棒性。本文提出了一种新型的轨迹预测对抗训练方法。与图像任务中的典型对抗训练相比,我们的工作面临更具随机性的输入、丰富的上下文信息以及缺乏类别标签的挑战。为解决这些挑战,我们提出基于半监督对抗自编码器的方法,利用领域知识建模解耦的语义特征,并为对抗训练提供额外的潜在标签。不同类型的攻击实验表明,我们的半监督语义引导对抗训练(SSAT)方法可将对抗攻击的影响降低高达73%,并优于其他流行的防御方法。此外,实验表明我们的方法可显著提升系统对未见过的攻击模式的鲁棒泛化能力。我们认为,这种语义引导的架构及对鲁棒泛化的进展是开发鲁棒预测模型和实现安全决策的重要一步。
abstract_en: Predicting the trajectories of surrounding objects is a critical task for self-driving vehicles and many other autonomous systems. Recent works demonstrate that adversarial attacks on trajectory prediction, where small crafted perturbations are introduced to history trajectories, may significantly mislead the prediction of future trajectories and induce unsafe planning. However, few works have addressed enhancing the robustness of this important safety-critical task. In this paper, we present a novel adversarial training method for trajectory prediction. Compared with typical adversarial training on image tasks, our work is challenged by more random input with rich context and a lack of class labels. To address these challenges, we propose a method based on a semi-supervised adversarial autoencoder, which models disentangled semantic features with domain knowledge and provides additional latent labels for the adversarial training. Extensive experiments with different types of attacks demonstrate that our Semisupervised Semantics-guided Adversarial Training (SSAT) method can effectively mitigate the impact of adversarial attacks by up to 73% and outperform other popular defense methods. In addition, experiments show that our method can significantly improve the system's robust generalization to unseen patterns of attacks. We believe that such semantics-guided architecture and advancement on robust generalization is an important step for developing robust prediction models and enabling safe decision-making.
authors: Ruochen Jiao, Xiangguo Liu, Takami Sato, Qi Alfred Chen, Qi Zhu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8207-8217

title: 通过跨模态编码的半监督语音驱动三维面部动画
title_en: Semi-supervised Speech-driven 3D Facial Animation via Cross-modal Encoding
abstract: 现有语音驱动三维面部动画方法通常遵循监督范式,涉及从语音到三维面部动画的回归。该范式面临两大挑战:监督获取的高成本,以及语音与唇部运动映射的模糊性。为解决这些问题,本研究提出了一种新颖的跨模态半监督框架,包含语音到图像转换器和面部到几何回归器。前者联合学习语音和图像领域的共同表征空间,实现语音到语义一致的面部图像的转换。后者负责从转换后的图像重建三维面部网格。两个模块均需极小努力获取必要训练数据,从而摆脱对昂贵监督数据的依赖。此外,联合学习方案使复杂视觉特征能够融合到语音编码中,从而实现细微语音变化到细腻唇部运动的转换,最终提升三维面部重建的保真度。因此,语音到动画的直接映射模糊性显著降低,实现了连贯且高保真的唇部运动生成。大量实验表明,我们的方法相比监督方法取得了具有竞争力的结果。
abstract_en: Existing Speech-driven 3D facial animation methods typically follow the supervised paradigm, involving regression from speech to 3D facial animation. This paradigm faces two major challenges: the high cost of supervision acquisition, and the ambiguity in mapping between speech and lip movements. To address these challenges, this study proposes a novel cross-modal semi-supervised framework, comprising a Speech-to-Image Transcoder and a Face-to-Geometry Regressor. The former jointly learns a common representation space from speech and image domains, enabling the transformation of speech into semantically-consistent facial images. The latter is responsible for reconstructing 3D facial meshes from the transformed images. Both modules require minimal effort to acquire the necessary training data, thereby obviating the dependence on costly supervised data. Furthermore, the joint learning scheme enables the fusion of intricate visual features into speech encoding, thereby facilitating the transformation of subtle speech variations into nuanced lip movements, ultimately enhancing the fidelity of 3D face reconstructions. Consequently, the ambiguity of the direct mapping of speech-to-animation is significantly reduced, leading to coherent and high-fidelity generation of lip motion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach produces competitive results compared to supervised methods.
authors: Peiji Yang, Huawei Wei, Yicheng Zhong, Zhisheng Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21032-21041

title: 敏感性感知的视觉参数高效微调
title_en: Sensitivity-Aware Visual Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
abstract: 视觉参数高效微调(PEFT)已成为全量微调的有力替代方案,用于将预训练视觉模型适配下游任务,其仅调整少量参数而冻结大部分参数以减轻存储负担和优化难度。然而,现有PEFT方法依赖人类启发式方法在不同任务中将可训练参数引入相同位置,忽视了领域差异。为此,我们通过提出一种新颖的敏感性感知视觉参数高效微调(SPT)方案,研究如何引入和分配可训练参数。该方案在给定可调参数预算下,自适应地将可训练参数分配到任务特定的重要位置。具体而言,我们的SPT首先以数据依赖的方式快速识别给定任务中需要调整的敏感参数。随后,对于敏感参数数量超过预定义阈值的权重矩阵,我们的SPT通过利用现有结构化调优方法(如LoRA或Adapter)提升表示能力,以替代直接调整选定敏感参数(无结构调优)的预算限制。在广泛下游识别任务上的大量实验表明,我们的SPT与现有PEFT方法具有互补性,并显著提升了其性能。例如,SPT在监督预训练ViT-B/16主干网络上改进Adapter,分别提升4.2%和1.4%的平均Top-1准确率,在FGVC和VTAB-1k基准测试中达到最先进性能。源代码见https://github.com/ziplab/SPT。
abstract_en: Visual Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has become a powerful alternative for full fine-tuning so as to adapt pre-trained vision models to downstream tasks, which only tunes a small number of parameters while freezing the vast majority ones to ease storage burden and optimization difficulty. However, existing PEFT methods introduce trainable parameters to the same positions across different tasks depending solely on human heuristics and neglect the domain gaps. To this end, we study where to introduce and how to allocate trainable parameters by proposing a novel Sensitivity-aware visual Parameter-efficient fine-Tuning (SPT) scheme, which adaptively allocates trainable parameters to task-specific important positions given a desired tunable parameter budget. Specifically, our SPT first quickly identifies the sensitive parameters that require tuning for a given task in a data-dependent way. Next, our SPT further boosts the representational capability for the weight matrices whose number of sensitive parameters exceeds a pre-defined threshold by utilizing existing structured tuning methods, e.g., LoRA or Adapter, to replace directly tuning the selected sensitive parameters (unstructured tuning) under the budget. Extensive experiments on a wide range of downstream recognition tasks show that our SPT is complementary to the existing PEFT methods and largely boosts their performance, e.g., SPT improves Adapter with supervised pre-trained ViT-B/16 backbone by 4.2% and 1.4% mean Top-1 accuracy, reaching SOTA performance on FGVC and VTAB-1k benchmarks, respectively. Source code is at https://github.com/ziplab/SPT.
authors: Haoyu He, Jianfei Cai, Jing Zhang, Dacheng Tao, Bohan Zhuang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11825-11835

title: Sentence Attention Blocks for Answer Grounding
title_en: Sentence Attention Blocks for Answer Grounding
abstract: 答案接地是视觉问答任务中定位相关视觉证据的任务。尽管已引入多种注意力方法用于该任务,但它们存在以下三个问题:设计不支持预训练网络且无法受益于大规模数据预训练,基于非标准化前设计的定制化设计限制了网络的学习能力,或复杂的设计使重新实现或改进变得困难。本文提出了一种新型架构块,称为句子注意力块,以解决这些问题。所提出的块通过显式建模图像特征图与句子嵌入之间的相互依赖性,重新校准通道级图像特征图。我们通过可视化展示该块如何基于句子嵌入过滤掉无关特征图通道。我们以一种知名注意力方法为基础,通过小幅修改提升了结果,实现了最先进精度。该方法的灵活性使其易于使用不同的预训练主干网络,其简洁性使其易于理解和重新实现。我们在TextVQA-X、VQS、VQA-X和VizWiz-VQA-Grounding数据集上验证了方法的有效性,并通过多项消融实验展示了设计选择的有效性。
abstract_en: Answer grounding is the task of locating relevant visual evidence for the Visual Question Answering task. While a wide variety of attention methods have been introduced for this task, they suffer from the following three problems: designs that do not allow the usage of pre-trained networks and do not benefit from large data pre-training, custom designs that are not based on well-grounded previous designs, therefore limiting the learning power of the network, or complicated designs that make it challenging to re-implement or improve them. In this paper, we propose a novel architectural block, which we term Sentence Attention Block, to solve these problems. The proposed block re-calibrates channel-wise image feature-maps by explicitly modeling inter-dependencies between the image feature-maps and sentence embedding. We visually demonstrate how this block filters out irrelevant feature-maps channels based on sentence embedding. We start our design with a well-known attention method, and by making minor modifications, we improve the results to achieve state-of-the-art accuracy. The flexibility of our method makes it easy to use different pre-trained backbone networks, and its simplicity makes it easy to understand and be re-implemented. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on the TextVQA-X, VQS, VQA-X, and VizWiz-VQA-Grounding datasets. We perform multiple ablation studies to show the effectiveness of our design choices.
authors: Seyedalireza Khoshsirat, Chandra Kambhamettu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6080-6090

title: 基于序列文本的连贯动作合成与自然过渡
title_en: Sequential Texts Driven Cohesive Motions Synthesis with Natural Transitions
abstract: 日常生活的智能动作序列合成/生成是许多VR/元宇宙相关应用的基础且迫切需要的技术。然而现有方法通常基于单条指令式文本生成单调动作(如行走、跳跃等),仍不够智能且无法满足实际需求。为此,我们提出一种基于自由形式序列文本的连贯动作序列合成框架,确保相邻动作间的语义连接与自然过渡。在技术层面,我们探索前后文本的局部到全局语义特征以提取相关信息,该信息用于指导框架理解当前时刻的语义。此外,我们提出可学习标记以自适应学习前序动作对自然过渡的影响范围。这些标记可训练编码相关信息至精心设计的过渡损失中。为验证方法有效性,我们在公开数据集及自建数据集上开展大量实验与全面评估。所有实验均证实,我们的方法在语义匹配、真实感与过渡流畅度方面均优于现有最先进方法。项目已公开:https://druthrie.github.io/sequential-texts-to-motion/
abstract_en: The intelligent synthesis/generation of daily-life motion sequences is fundamental and urgently needed for many VR/metaverse-related applications. However, existing approaches commonly focus on monotonic motion generation (e.g., walking, jumping, etc.) based on single instruction-like text, which is still not intelligent enough and can't meet practical demands. To this end, we propose a cohesive human motion sequence synthesis framework based on free-form sequential texts while ensuring semantic connection and natural transitions between adjacent motions. At the technical level, we explore the local-to-global semantic features of previous and current texts to extract relevant information. This information is used to guide the framework in understanding the semantics of the current moment. Moreover, we propose learnable tokens to adaptively learn the influence range of the previous motions towards natural transitions. These tokens can be trained to encode the relevant information into well-designed transition loss. To demonstrate the efficacy of our method, we conduct extensive experiments and comprehensive evaluations on the public dataset as well as a new dataset produced by us. All the experiments confirm that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods in terms of semantic matching, realism, and transition fluency. Our project is public available. https://druthrie.github.io/sequential-texts-to-motion/
authors: Shuai Li, Sisi Zhuang, Wenfeng Song, Xinyu Zhang, Hejia Chen, Aimin Hao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9498-9508

title: 集合级引导攻击:提升视觉-语言预训练模型的对抗迁移性
title_en: Set-level Guidance Attack: Boosting Adversarial Transferability of Vision-Language Pre-training Models
abstract: 视觉-语言预训练(VLP)模型在多模态任务中表现出对对抗样本的脆弱性。此外,恶意攻击者可以故意迁移至攻击其他黑盒模型。然而,现有研究主要集中在白盒攻击的探究上。本文首次研究了近期VLP模型的对抗迁移性。我们观察到,现有方法的迁移性显著低于白盒设置下的强攻击性能。迁移性下降部分归因于跨模态交互的利用不足。特别是,与单模态学习不同,VLP模型高度依赖跨模态交互,且多模态对齐是多对多关系,例如,一张图像可以用多种自然语言描述。为此,我们提出了一种高度可迁移的集合级引导攻击(SGA),该方法充分利用模态交互,并结合跨模态引导的对齐保持增强。实验结果表明,SGA能够生成对抗样本,在多个下游视觉-语言任务中实现跨不同VLP模型的强迁移攻击。在图像-文本检索任务中,SGA相比现有最优方法,将从ALBEF到TCL的迁移攻击成功率显著提升(至少9.78%,最高达30.21%)。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Zoky-2020/SGA获取。
abstract_en: Vision-language pre-training (VLP) models have shown vulnerability to adversarial examples in multimodal tasks. Furthermore, malicious adversaries can be deliberately transferred to attack other black-box models. However, existing work has mainly focused on investigating white-box attacks. In this paper, we present the first study to investigate the adversarial transferability of recent VLP models. We observe that existing methods exhibit much lower transferability, compared to the strong attack performance in white-box settings. The transferability degradation is partly caused by the under-utilization of cross-modal interactions. Particularly, unlike unimodal learning, VLP models rely heavily on cross-modal interactions and the multimodal alignments are many-to-many, e.g., an image can be described in various natural languages. To this end, we propose a highly transferable Set-level Guidance Attack (SGA) that thoroughly leverages modality interactions and incorporates alignment-preserving augmentation with cross-modal guidance. Experimental results demonstrate that SGA could generate adversarial examples that can strongly transfer across different VLP models on multiple downstream vision-language tasks. On image-text retrieval, SGA significantly enhances the attack success rate for transfer attacks from ALBEF to TCL by a large margin (at least 9.78% and up to 30.21%), compared to the state-of-the-art. Our code is available at https://github.com/Zoky-2020/SGA.
authors: Dong Lu, Zhiqiang Wang, Teng Wang, Weili Guan, Hongchang Gao, Feng Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 102-111

title: 基于弗伦特-塞雷框架的欧几里得曲线形状分析
title_en: Shape Analysis of Euclidean Curves under Frenet-Serret Framework
abstract: 几何框架在分析曲线的应用中很常见,因为它们关注不变特征并为计算不变距离、平均曲线或注册曲线等标准问题提供视觉上令人满意的解决方案。我们证明,对于R^d中任意光滑曲线(d>1),与弗伦特-塞雷特方程相关的广义曲率可用于定义一种黎曼几何,该几何考虑了形状的所有几何特征。这种几何基于平方根曲率变换,扩展了欧几里得曲线(在任意维度)的平方根速度变换,并提供了可能的测地线,避免了仅使用一阶几何信息表示时遇到的伪影。我们的分析通过模拟数据支持,尤其适用于分析人体运动。我们考虑了手语轨迹数据,并展示了在分析中考虑曲率和扭率的重要性,两者在物理上均有意义。
abstract_en: Geometric frameworks for analyzing curves are common in applications as they focus on invariant features and provide visually satisfying solutions to standard problems such as computing invariant distances, averaging curves, or registering curves. We show that for any smooth curve in R^d, d>1, the generalized curvatures associated with the Frenet-Serret equation can be used to define a Riemannian geometry that takes into account all the geometric features of the shape. This geometry is based on a Square Root Curvature Transform that extends the square root-velocity transform for Euclidean curves (in any dimensions) and provides likely geodesics that avoid artefacts encountered by representations using only first-order geometric information. Our analysis is supported by simulated data and is especially relevant for analyzing human motions. We consider trajectories acquired from sign language, and show the interest of considering curvature and also torsion in their analysis, both being physically meaningful.
authors: Perrine Chassat, Juhyun Park, Nicolas Brunel ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4027-4036

title: 基于形状锚点的全面室内场景理解
title_en: Shape Anchor Guided Holistic Indoor Scene Understanding
abstract: 本文提出了一种基于形状锚点引导的学习策略(AncLearn),用于鲁棒的全面室内场景理解。我们观察到,当前方法为提案特征分组和实例点采样构建的搜索空间往往引入大量噪声,影响实例检测和网格重建。为此,我们开发了AncLearn,通过动态拟合实例表面生成锚点,以(i)分离噪声与目标相关特征,为检测阶段提供可靠的提案;(ii)减少物体点采样中的异常值,直接提供无需分割的结构化几何先验。我们将AncLearn嵌入到一种从检测到重建的学习系统(AncRec)中,以实例为导向生成高质量的语义场景模型。在ScanNetv2数据集(包含Scan2CAD和SceneCAD的真实标注)上的实验表明,我们的基于形状锚点的方法在3D目标检测、布局估计和形状重建方面均取得最先进的性能。
abstract_en: This paper proposes a shape anchor guided learning strategy (AncLearn) for robust holistic indoor scene understanding. We observe that the search space constructed by current methods for proposal feature grouping and instance point sampling often introduces massive noise to instance detection and mesh reconstruction. Accordingly, we develop AncLearn to generate anchors that dynamically fit instance surfaces to (i) unmix noise and target-related features for offering reliable proposals at the detection stage, and (ii) reduce outliers in object point sampling for directly providing well-structured geometry priors without segmentation during reconstruction. We embed AncLearn into a reconstruction-from-detection learning system (AncRec) to generate high-quality semantic scene models in a purely instance-oriented manner. Experiments conducted on the ScanNetv2 dataset (with ground truths from Scan2CAD and SceneCAD) demonstrate that our shape anchor-based method consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of 3D object detection, layout estimation, and shape reconstruction.
authors: Mingyue Dong, Linxi Huan, Hanjiang Xiong, Shuhan Shen, Xianwei Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21916-21926

title: ShapeScaffolder:结构感知的从文本生成3D形状方法
title_en: ShapeScaffolder: Structure-Aware 3D Shape Generation from Text
abstract: 我们提出ShapeScaffolder,一种基于结构的神经网络,用于根据文本输入生成彩色3D形状。该方法类似于提供作为内部结构支撑的支架并在此基础上添加更多细节,旨在捕捉更精细的文本-形状关联并提升生成形状的质量。传统文本到形状的方法通常将3D形状作为整体生成。然而,人类倾向于将形状和文本都视为结构化的。例如,桌子被理解为由腿、座位和靠背组成;同样,文本具有内在的语义结构,可以分析为依赖图,描述文本中实体之间的关系。我们认为结构感知的形状生成能够带来更精细的文本-形状关联并提升形状生成质量。然而,缺乏显式的形状结构和文本结构的高自由度使得跨模态学习具有挑战性。为解决这些挑战,我们首先以无监督方式构建结构化的形状隐式场。随后,我们提出形状部件与文本图节点之间的部件级注意力机制,以结构层面对齐两种模态。最后,我们采用形状细化器对预测的结构添加更多细节,得到最终结果。大量实验表明,我们的方法在形状保真度和形状-文本匹配度方面均优于现有最先进的方法。我们的方法还支持部件级操作并提升了部件级完整性。
abstract_en: We present ShapeScaffolder, a structure-based neural network for generating colored 3D shapes based on text input. The approach, similar to providing scaffolds as internal structural supports and adding more details to them, aims to capture finer text-shape connections and improve the quality of generated shapes. Traditional text-to-shape methods often generate 3D shapes as a whole. However, humans tend to understand both shape and text as being structure-based. For example, a table is interpreted as being composed of legs, a seat, and a back; similarly, texts possess inherent linguistic structures that can be analyzed as dependency graphs, depicting the relationships between entities within the text. We believe structure-aware shape generation can bring finer text-shape connections and improve shape generation quality. However, the lack of explicit shape structure and the high freedom of text structure make cross-modality learning challenging. To address these challenges, we first build the structured shape implicit fields in an unsupervised manner. We then propose the part-level attention mechanism between shape parts and textual graph nodes to align the two modalities at the structural level. Finally, we employ a shape refiner to add further detail to the predicted structure, yielding the final results. Extensive experimentation demonstrates that our approaches outperform state-of-the-art methods in terms of both shape fidelity and shape-text matching. Our methods also allow for part-level manipulation and improved part-level completeness.
authors: Xi Tian, Yong-Liang Yang, Qi Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2715-2724

title: 破碎与聚合:基于文本监督的指称图像分割学习
title_en: Shatter and Gather: Learning Referring Image Segmentation with Text Supervision
abstract: 指称图像分割任务旨在对自由形式文本中描述的任意实体进行分割,从而拓展了多种视觉应用。然而,该任务的训练数据手动标注成本过高,导致缺乏足够的标注数据。我们通过弱监督学习方法解决这一问题,仅以训练图像的文本描述作为监督源。为此,我们首先提出一种新模型,该模型在输入图像中发现语义实体,并将与文本查询相关的实体组合以预测指称对象的掩码。我们还提出了一种新的损失函数,使模型能够在无需额外监督的情况下进行训练。我们的方法在四个公开的指称图像分割基准数据集上进行了评估,在所有基准测试中均明显优于现有方法及近期的开放词汇分割模型。
abstract_en:
Referring image segmentation, the task of segmenting any arbitrary entities described in free-form texts, opens up a variety of vision applications.
 However, manual labeling of training data for this task is prohibitively costly, leading to lack of labeled data for training. We address this issue by a weakly supervised learning approach using text descriptions of training images as the only source of supervision. To this end, we first present a new model that discovers semantic entities in input image and then combines such entities relevant to text query to predict the mask of the referent.
 We also present a new loss function that allows the model to be trained without any further supervision. Our method was evaluated on four public benchmarks for referring image segmentation, where it clearly outperformed the existing method for the same task and recent open-vocabulary segmentation models on all the benchmarks.
authors: Dongwon Kim, Namyup Kim, Cuiling Lan, Suha Kwak ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15547-15557

title: 从纹理偏倚到形状偏倚:基于边缘变形的增强方法用于鲁棒物体识别
title_en: Shift from Texture-bias to Shape-bias: Edge Deformation-based Augmentation for Robust Object Recognition
abstract: 近期研究表明,卷积神经网络(CNN)在扰动噪声下的脆弱性部分源于其过度依赖物体纹理特征,即主要基于纹理线索进行预测。为减少这种纹理偏倚,现有研究通过学习高度扰动纹理的增强样本,使网络更偏向于相对稳定的形状线索。然而,此类方法通常因形状线索的多样性不足而难以实现真正的形状偏倚网络。本文提出通过基于形状变形的在线增强方法(SDbOA)生成语义有意义的形状和样本,以扩充训练数据集。所生成的SDbOA样本具有两个主要优势:首先,具有更多样化形状变化的增强样本使网络能够更精细地学习形状线索,从而鼓励网络形成形状偏倚;其次,通过联合正则化生成器与物体纹理和边缘引导的软约束,可生成语义有意义的形状增强样本,其中边缘通过自信息引导映射更鲁棒地表示,以更好地抵抗其上的噪声。在多种扰动噪声下的大量实验验证了我们以形状偏倚为导向的模型在鲁棒性性能上明显优于现有方法。我们的代码已附在补充材料中。
abstract_en: Recent studies have shown the vulnerability of CNNs under perturbation noises, which is partially caused by the reason that the well-trained CNNs are too biased toward the object texture, i.e., they make predictions mainly based on texture cues. To reduce this texture-bias, current studies resort to learning augmented samples with heavily perturbed texture to make networks be more biased toward relatively stable shape cues. However, such methods usually fail to achieve real shape-biased networks due to the insufficient diversity of the shape cues. In this paper, we propose to augment the training dataset by generating semantically meaningful shapes and samples, via a shape deformation-based online augmentation, namely as SDbOA. The samples generated by our SDbOA have two main merits. First, the augmented samples with more diverse shape variations enable networks to learn the shape cues more elaborately, which encourages the network to be shape-biased. Second, semantic-meaningful shape-augmentation samples could be produced by jointly regularizing the generator with object texture and edge-guidance soft constraint, where the edges are represented more robustly with a self information guided map to better against the noises on them. Extensive experiments under various perturbation noises demonstrate the obvious superiority of our shape-bias-motivated model over the state of the arts in terms of robustness performance. Our code is appended in the supplementary material.
authors: Xilin He, Qinliang Lin, Cheng Luo, Weicheng Xie, Siyang Song, Feng Liu, Linlin Shen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1526-1535

title: ShiftNAS: 基于概率迁移的单次神经架构搜索
title_en: ShiftNAS: Improving One-shot NAS via Probability Shift
abstract: 单次神经架构搜索(One-shot NAS)被提出作为一种时间高效的方法,通过仅训练一次即可在不同复杂度情况下获得最优的子网络架构和权重。然而,通过权重共享获得的子网络性能通常不如通过重新训练获得的性能。在本文中,我们研究了这一性能差距,并将其归因于超网络训练中常用的均匀采样方法。均匀采样会将训练资源集中在具有中间计算资源的子网络上,这些子网络被高概率采样。然而,不同复杂度区域的子网络需要不同的最优训练策略以实现最佳性能。为了解决均匀采样的问题,我们提出了ShiftNAS,一种可以根据子网络复杂度调整采样概率的方法。我们通过评估不同复杂度子网络的性能变化,并设计一种能够准确高效地提供所需复杂度子网络的架构生成器来实现这一目标。采样概率和架构生成器均可通过基于梯度的端到端方式进行训练。借助ShiftNAS,我们可以直接获得给定计算复杂度下的最优模型架构和参数。我们在多个视觉网络模型(包括卷积神经网络(CNNs)和视觉Transformer(ViTs))上评估了我们的方法,并证明ShiftNAS是模型无关的。在ImageNet上的实验结果表明,ShiftNAS可以在不增加额外计算消耗的情况下提升单次NAS的性能。源代码可在GitHub上获取。
abstract_en:
One-shot Neural architecture search (One-shot NAS) has been proposed as a time-efficient approach to obtain optimal subnet architectures and weights under different complexity cases by training only once. However, the subnet performance obtained by weight sharing is often inferior to the performance achieved by retraining. In this paper, we investigate the performance gap and attribute it to the use of uniform sampling, which is a common approach in supernet training. Uniform sampling concentrates training resources on subnets with intermediate computational resources, which are sampled with high probability. However, subnets with different complexity regions require different optimal training strategies for optimal performance.
 To address the problem of uniform sampling, we propose ShiftNAS, a method that can adjust the sampling probability based on the complexity of subnets. We achieve this by evaluating the performance variation of subnets with different complexity and designing an architecture generator that can accurately and efficiently provide subnets with the desired complexity. Both the sampling probability and the architecture generator can be trained end-to-end in a gradient-based manner. With ShiftNAS, we can directly obtain the optimal model architecture and parameters for a given computational complexity. We evaluate our approach on multiple visual network models, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and vision transformers (ViTs), and demonstrate that ShiftNAS is model-agnostic. Experimental results on ImageNet show that ShiftNAS can improve the performance of one-shot NAS without additional computational consumption. Source codes are available at GitHub.
authors: Mingyang Zhang, Xinyi Yu, Haodong Zhao, Linlin Ou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5919-5928

title: Shortcut-V2V:基于时间冗余减少的视频到视频翻译压缩框架
title_en: Shortcut-V2V: Compression Framework for Video-to-Video Translation Based on Temporal Redundancy Reduction
abstract: 视频到视频翻译旨在从输入视频生成目标域的视频帧。尽管其具有实用性,现有网络需要巨大的计算量,因此需要进行模型压缩以实现广泛应用。尽管存在提升各种图像/视频任务计算效率的压缩方法,但针对视频到视频翻译的通用压缩方法尚未得到充分研究。为此,我们提出Shortcut-V2V,一种通用的视频到视频翻译压缩框架。Shortcut-V2V通过从前一帧的特征近似当前帧的中间特征,避免对每个相邻视频帧进行完整推理。此外,在我们的框架中,一个名为AdaBD的新提出模块能够自适应地融合和变形相邻帧的特征,从而更准确地预测中间特征。我们使用知名视频到视频翻译模型在各种任务上进行定量和定性评估,以证明框架的通用性。结果表明,Shortcut-V2V在测试时节省了3.2-5.7倍的计算成本和7.8-44倍的内存,同时与原始视频到视频翻译模型相比性能相当。我们的代码和视频可在https://shortcut-v2v.github.io/获取。
abstract_en: Video-to-video translation aims to generate video frames of a target domain from an input video. Despite its usefulness, the existing networks require enormous computations, necessitating their model compression for wide use. While there exist compression methods that improve computational efficiency in various image/video tasks, a generally applicable compression method for video-to-video translation has not been studied much. In response, we present Shortcut-V2V, a general-purpose compression framework for video-to-video translation. Shortcut-V2V avoids full inference for every neighboring video frame by approximating the intermediate features of a current frame from those of the previous frame. Moreover, in our framework, a newly-proposed block called AdaBD adaptively blends and deforms features of neighboring frames, which makes more accurate predictions of the intermediate features possible. We conduct quantitative and qualitative evaluations using well-known video-to-video translation models on various tasks to demonstrate the general applicability of our framework. The results show that Shortcut-V2V achieves comparable performance compared to the original video-to-video translation model while saving 3.2-5.7x computational cost and 7.8-44x memory at test time. Our code and videos are available at https://shortcut-v2v.github.io/.
authors: Chaeyeon Chung, Yeojeong Park, Seunghwan Choi, Munkhsoyol Ganbat, Jaegul Choo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7612-7622

title: 用于半监督学习中提升确定性的类别空间缩小方法
title_en: Shrinking Class Space for Enhanced Certainty in Semi-Supervised Learning
abstract: 半监督学习因其在结合无标签数据方面的成功而受到广泛关注。为缓解潜在错误伪标签的影响,近期框架大多设置固定置信度阈值以剔除不确定样本。这种做法确保了高质量伪标签,但导致无标签数据集的整体利用率相对较低。本文的关键洞察是:只要检测并移除top-1类别的混淆类别,这些不确定样本即可转化为确定样本。基于此,我们提出一种新型方法ShrinkMatch以学习不确定样本。对于每个不确定样本,它自适应地寻求一个仅包含原始top-1类别及剩余可能性较低类别的缩小类别空间。由于该空间中已移除混淆类别,重新计算的top-1置信度可满足预定义阈值。随后,我们在缩小空间中对强增强与弱增强样本对施加一致性正则化,以追求判别性表征。此外,考虑到不确定样本的可靠性差异及训练过程中模型的逐步提升,我们相应设计了两种不确定损失的重加权原则。我们的方法在广泛采用的基准测试中展现出卓越性能。代码已开源至https://github.com/LiheYoung/ShrinkMatch。
abstract_en: Semi-supervised learning is attracting blooming attention, due to its success in combining unlabeled data. To mitigate potentially incorrect pseudo labels, recent frameworks mostly set a fixed confidence threshold to discard uncertain samples. This practice ensures high-quality pseudo labels, but incurs a relatively low utilization of the whole unlabeled set. In this work, our key insight is that these uncertain samples can be turned into certain ones, as long as the confusion classes for the top-1 class are detected and removed. Invoked by this, we propose a novel method dubbed ShrinkMatch to learn uncertain samples. For each uncertain sample, it adaptively seeks a shrunk class space, which merely contains the original top-1 class, as well as remaining less likely classes. Since the confusion ones are removed in this space, the re-calculated top-1 confidence can satisfy the pre-defined threshold. We then impose a consistency regularization between a pair of strongly and weakly augmented samples in the shrunk space to strive for discriminative representations. Furthermore, considering the varied reliability among uncertain samples and the gradually improved model during training, we correspondingly design two reweighting principles for our uncertain loss. Our method exhibits impressive performance on widely adopted benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/LiheYoung/ShrinkMatch.
authors: Lihe Yang, Zhen Zhao, Lei Qi, Yu Qiao, Yinghuan Shi, Hengshuang Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16187-16196

title: SiLK:简单学习关键点
title_en: SiLK: Simple Learned Keypoints
abstract: 关键点检测与描述符是图像匹配、三维重建和视觉里程计等计算机视觉任务的基础性技术。手工设计的方法如Harris角点、SIFT和HOG描述符已使用数十年;近年来,出现了引入学习以改进关键点检测器的趋势。然而,经检查发现,这些方法的结果难以解释;近期基于学习的方法采用了大量不同的实验设置和设计选择:实证结果常使用不同的主干网络、协议、数据集、监督类型或任务进行报告。由于这些差异往往相互关联,自然引发了一个问题:什么使得一个优秀的学习关键点检测器?在本工作中,我们通过解构现有关键点检测器的方法并识别其关键组件,重新审视其设计。我们从第一性原理重新设计每个组件,并提出Simple Learned Keypoints(SiLK),该方法完全可微、轻量且灵活。尽管其设计简单,SiLK在HPatches数据集上的检测可重复性任务和单应性估计任务中取得了新的SOTA,在ScanNet数据集上的三维点云配准任务中也取得新进展,并在2022图像匹配挑战赛和ScanNet的相机位姿估计任务中实现了与SOTA相当的性能。
abstract_en: Keypoint detection & descriptors are foundational technologies for computer vision tasks like image matching, 3D reconstruction and visual odometry. Hand-engineered methods like Harris corners, SIFT, and HOG descriptors have been used for decades; more recently, there has been a trend to introduce learning in an attempt to improve keypoint detectors. On inspection however, the results are difficult to interpret; recent learning-based methods employ a vast diversity of experimental setups and design choices: empirical results are often reported using different backbones, protocols, datasets, types of supervisions or tasks. Since these differences are often coupled together, it raises a natural question on what makes a good learned keypoint detector. In this work, we revisit the design of existing keypoint detectors by deconstructing their methodologies and identifying the key components. We re-design each component from first-principle and propose Simple Learned Keypoints (SiLK) that is fully-differentiable, lightweight, and flexible. Despite its simplicity, SiLK advances new state-of-the-art on Detection Repeatability and Homography Estimation tasks on HPatches and 3D Point-Cloud Registration task on ScanNet, and achieves competitive performance to state-of-the-art on camera pose estimation in 2022 Image Matching Challenge and ScanNet.
authors: Pierre Gleize, Weiyao Wang, Matt Feiszli ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22499-22508

title: 语言图像预训练的Sigmoid损失
title_en: Sigmoid Loss for Language Image Pre-Training
abstract: 我们提出了一种简单的成对Sigmoid损失用于图像-文本预训练。与采用Softmax归一化的标准对比学习不同,Sigmoid损失仅作用于图像-文本对,无需对成对相似性进行全局视图归一化。Sigmoid损失同时允许进一步扩大批量大小,同时在较小批量大小下表现更好。仅使用四块TPUv4芯片,我们即可在4k批量大小下训练Base CLIP模型,在20k批量大小下训练Large LiT模型,后者在两天内达到84.5%的ImageNet零样本准确率。这种将批量大小与损失解耦的特性进一步使我们能够研究样本与对之间的关系以及负样本与正样本的比例影响。最后,我们将批量大小推至极端,达到一百万级别,发现批量大小增长带来的好处迅速 diminishing,32k的合理批量大小已足够。我们希望我们的研究能激励进一步探索提升语言-图像预训练的质量与效率。
abstract_en: We propose a simple pairwise sigmoid loss for image-text pre-training. Unlike standard contrastive learning with softmax normalization, the sigmoid loss operates solely on image-text pairs and does not require a global view of the pairwise similarities for normalization. The sigmoid loss simultaneously allows further scaling up the batch size, while also performing better at smaller batch sizes. With only four TPUv4 chips, we can train a Base CLIP model at 4k batch size and a Large LiT model at 20k batch size, the latter achieves 84.5% ImageNet zero-shot accuracy in two days. This disentanglement of the batch size from the loss further allows us to study the impact of examples vs pairs and negative to positive ratio. Finally, we push the batch size to the extreme, up to one million, and find that the benefits of growing batch size quickly diminish, with a more reasonable batch size of 32k being sufficient. We hope our research motivates further explorations in improving the quality and efficiency of language-image pre-training.
authors: Xiaohua Zhai, Basil Mustafa, Alexander Kolesnikov, Lucas Beyer ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11975-11986

title: 基于迭代原型的手语翻译
title_en: Sign Language Translation with Iterative Prototype
abstract: 本文提出IP-SLT,一种简单而有效的手语翻译(SLT)框架。我们的IP-SLT采用循环结构,并通过迭代优化方式增强输入手语视频的语义表示(原型)。我们的方法模仿人类阅读行为,即通过反复理解句子直至达到准确理解。技术上,IP-SLT包含特征提取、原型初始化和迭代原型优化三个模块。初始化模块基于特征提取模块提取的视觉特征生成初始原型。随后,迭代优化模块利用交叉注意力机制,通过聚合原始视频特征对前一原型进行优化。经过多次优化后,原型最终收敛至更稳定准确的状态,从而实现流畅恰当的翻译。此外,为利用原型的序列依赖性,我们进一步提出迭代蒸馏损失,将最终迭代的知识压缩至先前迭代中。由于自回归解码过程在推理阶段仅执行一次,我们的IP-SLT可有效提升各类SLT系统,且具有可接受的计算开销。在公开基准数据集上进行了大量实验,以验证IP-SLT的有效性。
abstract_en: This paper presents IP-SLT, a simple yet effective framework for sign language translation (SLT). Our IP-SLT adopts a recurrent structure and enhances the semantic representation (prototype) of the input sign language video via an iterative refinement manner. Our idea mimics the behavior of human reading, where a sentence can be digested repeatedly, till reaching accurate understanding. Technically, IP-SLT consists of feature extraction, prototype initialization, and iterative prototype refinement. The initialization module generates the initial prototype based on the visual feature extracted by the feature extraction module. Then, the iterative refinement module leverages the cross-attention mechanism to polish the previous prototype by aggregating it with the original video feature. Through repeated refinement, the prototype finally converges to a more stable and accurate state, leading to a fluent and appropriate translation. In addition, to leverage the sequential dependence of prototypes, we further propose an iterative distillation loss to compress the knowledge of the final iteration into previous ones. As the autoregressive decoding process is executed only once in inference, our IP-SLT is ready to improve various SLT systems with acceptable overhead. Extensive experiments are conducted on public benchmarks to demonstrate the effectiveness of the IP-SLT.
authors: Huijie Yao, Wengang Zhou, Hao Feng, Hezhen Hu, Hao Zhou, Houqiang Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15592-15601

title: SimFIR:一种基于自监督表征学习的鱼眼图像校正简单框架
title_en: SimFIR: A Simple Framework for Fisheye Image Rectification with Self-supervised Representation Learning
abstract: 在鱼眼图像中,丰富的独特畸变模式在图像平面上规律分布。这些畸变模式独立于视觉内容,为校正提供了信息性线索。为充分利用此类校正线索,我们引入了SimFIR,一种基于自监督表征学习的鱼眼图像校正简单框架。技术上,我们首先将鱼眼图像分割为多个块,并利用视觉Transformer(ViT)提取其表征。为进一步学习细粒度畸变表征,我们基于鱼眼模型将不同图像块与其特定畸变模式关联,并创新性地设计了一个统一的畸变感知预训练任务。下游校正任务的迁移性能显著提升,验证了所学表征的有效性。通过大量实验,定量和定性结果均证明了我们的方法在鱼眼图像校正任务中优于现有先进算法,并展现出强大的现实场景泛化能力。
abstract_en: In fisheye images, rich distinct distortion patterns are regularly distributed in the image plane. These distortion patterns are independent of the visual content and provide informative cues for rectification. To make the best of such rectification cues, we introduce SimFIR, a simple framework for fisheye image rectification based on self-supervised representation learning. Technically, we first split a fisheye image into multiple patches and extract their representations with a Vision Transformer (ViT). To learn fine-grained distortion representations, we then associate different image patches with their specific distortion patterns based on the fisheye model, and further subtly design an innovative unified distortion-aware pretext task for their learning. The transfer performance on the downstream rectification task is remarkably boosted, which verifies the effectiveness of the learned representations. Extensive experiments are conducted, and the quantitative and qualitative results demonstrate the superiority of our method over the state-of-the-art algorithms as well as its strong generalization ability on real-world fisheye images.
authors: Hao Feng, Wendi Wang, Jiajun Deng, Wengang Zhou, Li Li, Houqiang Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12418-12427

title: SimMatchV2:基于图一致性的半监督学习
title_en: SimMatchV2: Semi-Supervised Learning with Graph Consistency
abstract: 半监督图像分类是计算机视觉领域最基础性的问题之一,能够显著降低对人工劳动的依赖。本文提出了一种新的半监督学习算法——SimMatchV2,从图视角对有标签数据与无标签数据之间的多种一致性正则化进行建模。在SimMatchV2中,我们将样本的增强视图视为节点,每个节点包含标签及其对应的表示。不同节点通过边连接,边的权重由节点表示的相似性度量。受图论中消息传递与节点分类的启发,我们提出四种一致性类型:1)节点-节点一致性,2)节点-边一致性,3)边-边一致性,4)边-节点一致性。我们还发现,简单的特征归一化可以显著缩小不同增强视图间特征范数的差异,从而显著提升SimMatchV2的性能。我们的SimMatchV2已在多个半监督学习基准数据集上进行了验证。值得注意的是,使用ResNet-50作为主干网络并训练300个epoch后,SimMatchV2在ImageNet数据集上分别以1%和10%的有标签样本达到71.9%和76.2%的Top-1准确率,显著超越了先前方法并取得了当前最优性能。
abstract_en: Semi-Supervised image classification is one of the most fundamental problem in computer vision, which significantly reduces the need for human labor. In this paper, we introduce a new semi-supervised learning algorithm - SimMatchV2, which formulates various consistency regularizations between labeled and unlabeled data from the graph perspective. In SimMatchV2, we regard the augmented view of a sample as a node, which consists of a label and its corresponding representation. Different nodes are connected with the edges, which are measured by the similarity of the node representations. Inspired by the message passing and node classification in graph theory, we propose four types of consistencies, namely 1) node-node consistency, 2) node-edge consistency, 3) edge-edge consistency, and 4) edge-node consistency. We also uncover that a simple feature normalization can reduce the gaps of the feature norm between different augmented views, significantly improving the performance of SimMatchV2. Our SimMatchV2 has been validated on multiple semi-supervised learning benchmarks. Notably, with ResNet-50 as our backbone and 300 epochs of training, SimMatchV2 achieves 71.9% and 76.2% Top-1 Accuracy with 1% and 10% labeled examples on ImageNet, which significantly outperforms the previous methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance.
authors: Mingkai Zheng, Shan You, Lang Huang, Chen Luo, Fei Wang, Chen Qian, Chang Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16432-16442

title: SimNP: 学习神经点间的自相似先验
title_en: SimNP: Learning Self-Similarity Priors Between Neural Points
abstract: 现有用于3D物体重建的神经场表示方法要么(1)采用对象级表示,但因依赖全局潜在代码导致细节质量低下,要么(2)能够完美重建观测数据,却无法利用对象级先验知识推断未观测区域。我们提出SimNP方法,通过连接神经点辐射场与类别级自相似性表示,结合两种方法的优势。我们的贡献包含两方面:(1)设计首个基于类别级的神经点表示,利用相干点云概念,使神经点辐射场能够存储局部支持物体区域的高细节信息。(2)以无约束和无监督方式学习神经点间的信息共享机制,从而在重建过程中从给定观测数据推导出未观测区域。实验表明,SimNP在重建对称未见物体区域方面优于现有方法,超越基于类别级或像素对齐辐射场的方法,同时提供实例间的语义对应关系。
abstract_en: Existing neural field representations for 3D object reconstruction either (1) utilize object-level representations, but suffer from low-quality details due to conditioning on a global latent code, or (2) are able to perfectly reconstruct the observations, but fail to utilize object-level prior knowledge to infer unobserved regions. We present SimNP, a method to learn category-level self-similarities, which combines the advantages of both worlds by connecting neural point radiance fields with a category-level self-similarity representation. Our contribution is two-fold. (1) We design the first neural point representation on a category level by utilizing the concept of coherent point clouds. The resulting neural point radiance fields store a high level of detail for locally supported object regions. (2) We learn how information is shared between neural points in an unconstrained and unsupervised fashion, which allows to derive unobserved regions of an object during the reconstruction process from given observations. We show that SimNP is able to outperform previous methods in reconstructing symmetric unseen object regions, surpassing methods that build upon category-level or pixel-aligned radiance fields, while providing semantic correspondences between instances.
authors: Christopher Wewer, Eddy Ilg, Bernt Schiele, Jan Eric Lenssen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8841-8852

title: 相似性最小-最大:零样本日-夜领域适应
title_en: Similarity Min-Max: Zero-Shot Day-Night Domain Adaptation
abstract: 低光条件不仅妨碍人类视觉体验,还会降低模型在下游视觉任务中的性能。尽管现有工作在日-夜领域适应方面取得了显著进展,但它们严重依赖于从任务特定夜间数据集中提取的领域知识。本文挑战了一个更复杂的场景,即具有边界适用性的零样本日-夜领域适应,该方法消除了对任何夜间数据的依赖。与之前强调图像级转换或模型级适应的零样本适应方法不同,我们提出了一种相似性最小-最大范式,在统一框架下综合考虑这两方面。在图像级,我们通过减小特征相似性来暗化图像,以扩大领域差距;然后在模型级,我们最大化暗化图像与其正常光照对应图像之间的特征相似性,以提高模型适应性。据我们所知,本工作首次联合优化这两个方面,显著提升了模型的泛化能力。大量实验验证了我们的方法在各种夜间视觉任务(包括分类、语义分割、视觉位置识别和视频动作识别)中的有效性与广泛适用性。我们的项目页面可在https://red-fairy.github.io/ZeroShotDayNightDA-Webpage/访问。
abstract_en: Low-light conditions not only hamper human visual experience but also degrade the model's performance on downstream vision tasks. While existing works make remarkable progress on day-night domain adaptation, they rely heavily on domain knowledge derived from the task-specific nighttime dataset. This paper challenges a more complicated scenario with border applicability, i.e., zero-shot day-night domain adaptation, which eliminates reliance on any nighttime data. Unlike prior zero-shot adaptation approaches emphasizing either image-level translation or model-level adaptation, we propose a similarity min-max paradigm that considers them under a unified framework. On the image level, we darken images towards minimum feature similarity to enlarge the domain gap. Then on the model level, we maximize the feature similarity between the darkened images and their normal-light counterparts for better model adaptation. To the best of our knowledge, this work represents the pioneering effort in jointly optimizing both aspects, resulting in a significant improvement of model generalizability. Extensive experiments demonstrate our method's effectiveness and broad applicability on various nighttime vision tasks, including classification, semantic segmentation, visual place recognition, and video action recognition. Our project page is available at https://red-fairy.github.io/ZeroShotDayNightDA-Webpage/.
authors: Rundong Luo, Wenjing Wang, Wenhan Yang, Jiaying Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8104-8114

title: Simoun:面向基于视觉的强化学习的协同交互式运动-外观理解
title_en: Simoun: Synergizing Interactive Motion-appearance Understanding for Vision-based Reinforcement Learning
abstract: 高效的运动和外观建模对于基于视觉的强化学习(RL)至关重要。然而,现有方法难以在单一观察编码器学习的状态表示中协调运动与外观信息。为解决该问题,我们提出协同交互式运动-外观理解(Simoun),一个统一的基于视觉的RL框架。给定连续的观察帧,Simoun通过双路径网络架构主动且交互式地学习运动与外观特征。学习过程与结构交互模块协作,该模块从两个网络路径中探索潜在的运动-外观结构,利用其互补性。为提升样本效率,我们进一步设计了一致性引导的好奇心模块,鼓励探索未充分学习的观察。训练过程中,好奇心模块根据环境时序动态的一致性提供内在奖励,这些动态由运动和外观网络路径共同推导得出。在DeepMind控制套件和CARLA自动驾驶基准测试中进行的实验验证了Simoun的有效性,其表现优于现有先进方法。
abstract_en: Efficient motion and appearance modeling are critical for vision-based Reinforcement Learning (RL). However, existing methods struggle to reconcile motion and appearance information within the state representations learned from a single observation encoder. To address the problem, we present Synergizing Interactive Motion-appearance Understanding (Simoun), a unified framework for vision-based RL. Given consecutive observation frames, Simoun deliberately and interactively learns both motion and appearance features through a dual-path network architecture. The learning process collaborates with a structural interactive module, which explores the latent motion-appearance structures from the two network paths to leverage their complementarity. To promote sample efficiency, we further design a consistency-guided curiosity module to encourage the exploration of under-learned observations. During training, the curiosity module provides intrinsic rewards according to the consistency of environmental temporal dynamics, which are deduced from both motion and appearance network paths. Experiments conducted on the DeepMind control suite and CARLA automatic driving benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of Simoun, where it performs favorably against state-of-the-art methods.
authors: Yangru Huang, Peixi Peng, Yifan Zhao, Yunpeng Zhai, Haoran Xu, Yonghong Tian ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 176-185

title: 基于问答的交互式视频检索简单基线
title_en: Simple Baselines for Interactive Video Retrieval with Questions and Answers
abstract: 迄今为止,大多数视频检索系统均针对"单次查询"场景进行优化,即用户独立提交查询而忽略与系统的先前交互。近期,交互系统再次受到关注以提升检索效果,但现有方法复杂且性能提升有限。本文重新探讨该课题,提出若干简单而有效的基于问答的交互式视频检索基线。我们采用视频问答模型模拟用户交互,并展示该方法无需真实对话数据即可有效研究交互式检索任务。在MSR-VTT、MSVD和AVSD数据集上的实验表明,基于问题的交互框架显著提升了基于文本的视频检索系统性能。代码已开源至https://github.com/kevinliang888/IVR-QA-baselines。
abstract_en: To date, the majority of video retrieval systems have been optimized for a "single-shot" scenario in which the user submits a query in isolation, ignoring previous interactions with the system. Recently, there has been renewed interest in interactive systems to enhance retrieval, but existing approaches are complex and deliver limited gains in performance. In this work, we revisit this topic and propose several simple yet effective baselines for interactive video retrieval via question-answering. We employ a VideoQA model to simulate user interactions and show that this enables the productive study of the interactive retrieval task without access to ground truth dialogue data. Experiments on MSR-VTT, MSVD, and AVSD show that our framework using question-based interaction significantly improves the performance of text-based video retrieval systems. Code is available at https://github.com/kevinliang888/IVR-QA-baselines.
authors: Kaiqu Liang, Samuel Albanie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11091-11101

title: 基于余弦Softmax损失的简单有效的分布外检测方法
title_en: Simple and Effective Out-of-Distribution Detection via Cosine-based Softmax Loss
abstract: 深度学习模型需要在推理阶段检测分布外(OOD)数据,因为它们是通过估计训练分布并推断从该分布采样的数据进行训练的。已有许多方法被提出,但它们存在一些局限性,例如需要额外数据、输入处理或高计算成本。此外,大多数方法需要用户设置影响检测率的超参数。我们通过结合基于分类模型(使用基于余弦的Softmax损失训练)获得的特征范数和马氏距离,提出了一种简单有效的OOD检测方法。我们的方法具有实用性,因为它不需要额外数据进行训练,推理速度大约是使用输入处理方法的三倍,并且易于应用,因为它不涉及任何OOD检测的超参数。通过实验验证,我们的方法在性能上优于或至少与最先进的OOD检测方法相当。
abstract_en: Deep learning models need to detect out-of-distribution (OOD) data in the inference stage because they are trained to estimate the train distribution and infer the data sampled from the distribution. Many methods have been proposed, but they have some limitations, such as requiring additional data, input processing, or high computational cost. Moreover, most methods have hyperparameters to be set by users, which have a significant impact on the detection rate. We propose a simple and effective OOD detection method by combining the feature norm and the Mahalanobis distance obtained from classification models trained with the cosine-based softmax loss. Our method is practical because it does not use additional data for training, is about three times faster when inferencing than the methods using the input processing, and is easy to apply because it does not have any hyperparameters for OOD detection. We confirm that our method is superior to or at least comparable to state-of-the-art OOD detection methods through the experiments.
authors: SoonCheol Noh, DongEon Jeong, Jee-Hyong Lee ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16560-16569

title: SimpleClick:基于简单视觉Transformer的交互式图像分割
title_en: SimpleClick: Interactive Image Segmentation with Simple Vision Transformers
abstract: 基于点击的交互式图像分割旨在通过有限的用户点击操作提取目标对象。层次化主干网络是当前方法的主流架构。近期,简单、非层次化的视觉Transformer(ViT)已作为密集预测任务的有力主干网络出现。这种设计使原始ViT能够作为基础模型,无需为预训练重新设计层次化主干网络即可进行下游任务的微调。尽管这种设计简单且已被证明有效,但尚未被用于交互式分割领域。为填补这一空白,我们提出SimpleClick,这是首个采用简单主干网络的交互式分割方法。除简单主干网络外,我们还探索了多种简单的特征金字塔网络变体,这些网络仅以主干网络的最后特征表示作为输入。通过将简单主干网络预训练为掩码自编码器(MAE),SimpleClick实现了最先进的性能。值得注意的是,我们的方法在SBD数据集上达到4.15 NoC@90,比之前最佳结果提升了21.8%。在医学图像上的广泛评估验证了我们方法的通用性。我们进一步为SimpleClick开发了一个极小的ViT主干网络,并提供了详细的计算分析,突显其作为实用标注工具的适用性。
abstract_en: Click-based interactive image segmentation aims at extracting objects with a limited user clicking. A hierarchical backbone is the de-facto architecture for current methods. Recently, the plain, non-hierarchical Vision Transformer (ViT) has emerged as a competitive backbone for dense prediction tasks. This design allows the original ViT to be a foundation model that can be finetuned for downstream tasks without redesigning a hierarchical backbone for pretraining. Although this design is simple and has been proven effective, it has not yet been explored for interactive segmentation. To fill this gap, we propose SimpleClick, the first plain-backbone method for interactive segmentation. Other than the plain backbone, we also explore several variants of simple feature pyramid networks that only take as input the last feature representation of the backbone. With the plain backbone pretrained as a masked autoencoder (MAE), SimpleClick achieves state-of-the-art performance. Remarkably, our method achieves 4.15 NoC@90 on SBD, improving 21.8% over the previous best result. Extensive evaluation on medical images demonstrates the generalizability of our method. We further develop an extremely tiny ViT backbone for SimpleClick and provide a detailed computational analysis, highlighting its suitability as a practical annotation tool.
authors: Qin Liu, Zhenlin Xu, Gedas Bertasius, Marc Niethammer ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22290-22300

title: 真实世界静态图像中的流体模拟
title_en: Simulating Fluids in Real-World Still Images
abstract: 本文针对从静态图像生成真实世界流体动画的问题展开研究。系统的核心在于一种基于表面的分层表示方法,将场景解耦为表面流体层与不可渗透背景层,并通过对应的透明度表征两层的组成关系。通过根据流体运动估计对表面流体层进行变形,并将其与背景重新组合,即可生成动画视频。此外,我们引入了仅表面流体模拟的2.5D流体计算方法,作为运动估计的替代方案。具体而言,我们基于单目深度估计器构建三角网格以表示流体表面层,并受经典物理理论中混合拉格朗日-欧拉方法的启发,结合可学习网络以适应复杂的真实世界图像纹理。大量实验不仅验证了该方法在常见流体场景中的竞争力,也展现出在复杂透明流体场景中更优的鲁棒性与合理性。此外,所提出的基于表面的分层表示方法与仅表面流体模拟技术自然解耦场景,使得添加物体、纹理替换等交互式编辑操作可轻松实现,并能生成逼真的结果。
abstract_en:
In this work, we tackle the problem of real-world fluid animation from a still image. The key of our system is a surface-based layered representation, where the scene is decoupled into a surface fluid layer and an impervious background layer with corresponding transparencies to characterize the composition of the two layers. The animated video can be produced by warping only the surface fluid layer according to the estimation of fluid motions and recombining it with the background. In addition, we introduce surface-only fluid simulation, a 2.5D fluid calculation, as a replacement for motion estimation. 
 Specifically, we leverage triangular mesh based on a monocular depth estimator to represent fluid surface layer and simulate the motion with the inspiration of classic physics theory of hybrid Lagrangian-Eulerian method, along with a learnable network so as to adapt to complex real-world image textures.Extensive experiments not only indicate our method's competitive performance for common fluid scenes but also better robustness and reasonability under complex transparent fluid scenarios. Moreover, as proposed surface-based layer representation and surface-only fluid simulation naturally disentangle the scene, interactive editing such as adding objects and texture replacing could be easily achieved with realistic results.
authors: Siming Fan, Jingtan Piao, Chen Qian, Hongsheng Li, Kwan-Yee Lin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15922-15931

title: 单深度图像三维反射对称性与形状预测
title_en: Single Depth-image 3D Reflection Symmetry and Shape Prediction
abstract: 本文提出了一种单深度图像形状补全方法——迭代对称补全网络(ISCNet),该方法通过利用反射对称性线索获取更详细的形状。单深度图像形状补全方法的有效性通常依赖于对称平面的准确性。因此,ISCNet通过迭代方式联合估计对称平面和形状补全;更完整的形状有助于更鲁棒的对称平面估计,反之亦然。此外,我们的形状补全方法在图像域中进行操作,能够实现更高效、高分辨率的详细几何重建。我们通过强化学习代理预测的关于对称平面反射的两个视角对进行形状补全,以提高鲁棒性并同时显式利用对称性。我们在合成和真实扫描数据集上对多种物体类别验证了ISCNet的有效性。
abstract_en: In this paper, we present Iterative Symmetry Completion Network (ISCNet), a single depth-image shape completion method that exploits reflective symmetry cues to obtain more detailed shapes. The efficacy of single depth-image shape completion methods is often sensitive to the accuracy of the symmetry plane. ISCNet therefore jointly estimates the symmetry plane and shape completion iteratively; more complete shapes contribute to more robust symmetry plane estimates and vice versa. Furthermore, our shape completion method operates in the image domain, enabling more efficient high-resolution, detailed geometry reconstruction. We perform the shape completion from pairs of viewpoints, reflected across the symmetry plane, predicted by a reinforcement learning agent to improve robustness and to simultaneously explicitly leverage symmetry. We demonstrate the effectiveness of ISCNet on a variety of object categories on both synthetic and real-scanned datasets.
authors: Zhaoxuan Zhang, Bo Dong, Tong Li, Felix Heide, Pieter Peers, Baocai Yin, Xin Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8896-8906

title: 基于行依赖模糊幅度的单图像去模糊
title_en: Single Image Deblurring with Row-dependent Blur Magnitude
abstract: 在快速相机或物体运动过程中,无论采用全局快门(GS)还是滚动快门(RS)曝光模式,图像退化往往会发生。由于这两种曝光模式导致固有不同退化,因此分别探索了两种修复方法:GS图像的运动去模糊和RS图像的畸变校正,这些均为具有挑战性的恢复任务,尤其是在仅输入单张图像的情况下。本文探索了一种新型中间曝光模式,称为全局重置释放(GRR)快门,其产生类似GS的模糊效果但具有行依赖的模糊幅度。我们利用GRR这一独特特性,在单张图像中探索潜在帧并仅依靠这些潜在上下文恢复清晰图像。具体而言,我们提出了一种残差空间补偿和频谱增强Transformer(RSS-T)块,用于单张GRR图像的行依赖去模糊。其分层位置编码补偿窗口的全局位置上下文,并实现局部像素位置的顺序感知,同时结合新型前馈网络,通过同时利用空间和频谱信息获取混合全局上下文。大量实验结果表明,我们的方法在单张GRR输入上优于当前最先进的GS去模糊和RS校正方法。
abstract_en:
Image degradation often occurs during fast camera or object movements, regardless of the exposure modes: global shutter (GS) or rolling shutter (RS). Since these two exposure modes give rise to intrinsically different degradations, two restoration threads have been explored separately, i.e. motion deblurring of GS images and distortion correction of RS images, both of which are challenging restoration tasks, especially in the presence of a single input image. In this paper,
 we explore a novel in-between exposure mode, called global reset release (GRR) shutter, which produces GS-like blur but with row-dependent blur magnitude. We take advantage of this unique characteristic of GRR to explore the latent frames
 within a single image and restore a clear counterpart by only relying on these latent contexts. Specifically, we propose a residual spatially-compensated and spectrally-enhanced Transformer (RSS-T) block for row-dependent deblurring of
 a single GRR image. Its hierarchical positional encoding compensates global positional context of windows and enables order-awareness of the local pixel's position, along with a novel feed-forward network that simultaneously uses spatial and spectral information for gaining mixed global context. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art GS deblurring and RS correction methods on single GRR input.
authors: Xiang Ji, Zhixiang Wang, Shin'ichi Satoh, Yinqiang Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12269-12280

title: 基于隐式神经逆核的单图像景深去模糊
title_en: Single Image Defocus Deblurring via Implicit Neural Inverse Kernels
abstract: 单图像景深去模糊(SIDD)是一项具有挑战性的任务,由于景深模糊的空间变化特性,其特征是每个像素的点扩散函数(PSFs)。现有基于深度学习的SIDD方法受限于模型约束不足导致的过拟合或参数不足限制其在真实图像中的适用性。为解决这些局限性,本文提出一种可解释的方法,通过结构正则化显式预测逆核。受图像中景深PSF通常具有相似形状但不同尺寸的观察启发,我们利用隐式神经表示参数化的多尺度字典对逆核进行线性表示。通过双尺度循环神经网络预测对应的表示系数,该网络联合执行从细到粗和从粗到细的估计。大量实验表明,我们的方法使用轻量级模型即可实现优异性能。
abstract_en: Single image defocus deblurring (SIDD) is a challenging task due to the spatially-varying nature of defocus blur, characterized by per-pixel point spread functions (PSFs). Existing deep-learning-based methods for SIDD are limited by either over-fitting due to the lack of model constraints or under-parametrization that restricts their applicability to real-world images. To address the limitations, this paper proposes an interpretable approach that explicitly predicts inverse kernels with structural regularization. Motivated by the observation that defocus PSFs within an image often have similar shapes but different sizes, we represent the inverse kernels linearly over a multi-scale dictionary parameterized by implicit neural representations. We predict the corresponding representation coefficients via a duplex scale-recurrent neural network that jointly performs fine-to-coarse and coarse-to-fine estimations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves excellent performance using a lightweight model.
authors: Yuhui Quan, Xin Yao, Hui Ji ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12600-12610

title: 基于成分协同的单图像反射分离
title_en: Single Image Reflection Separation via Component Synergy
abstract: 反射叠加现象在现实世界中复杂且广泛分布,由此衍生出多种简化的线性和非线性问题表述形式。本文基于对现有模型缺陷的分析,通过引入可学习的残差项提出更为通用的叠加模型,该模型能够在分解过程中有效捕捉残差信息,引导分离层实现完整性。为充分挖掘其优势,我们进一步精心设计网络结构,包括新颖的双流交互机制和具备语义金字塔编码器的强大分解网络。在多个现实世界基准数据集上开展了大量实验与消融研究,验证了我们的方法相较于现有先进方法的优越性。
abstract_en: The reflection superposition phenomenon is complex and widely distributed in the real world, which derives various simplified linear and nonlinear formulations of the problem. In this paper, based on the investigation of the weaknesses of existing models, we propose a more general form of the superposition model by introducing a learnable residue term, which can effectively capture residual information during decomposition, guiding the separated layers to be complete. In order to fully capitalize on its advantages, we further design the network structure elaborately, including a novel dual-stream interaction mechanism and a powerful decomposition network with a semantic pyramid encoder. Extensive experiments and ablation studies are conducted to verify our superiority over state-of-the-art approaches on multiple real-world benchmark datasets.
authors: Qiming Hu, Xiaojie Guo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13138-13147

title: 单阶段扩散NeRF:面向三维生成与重建的统一方法
title_en: Single-Stage Diffusion NeRF: A Unified Approach to 3D Generation and Reconstruction
abstract: 三维感知图像合成涵盖场景生成、从图像生成新视角等多样化任务。尽管已有大量针对特定任务的方法,但开发一个全面的模型仍具挑战性。本文提出SSDNeRF,一种统一方法,通过表达力强的扩散模型,从多视角图像中学习神经辐射场(NeRF)的通用先验。先前研究采用两阶段方法,依赖预训练NeRF作为真实数据训练扩散模型。相反,我们提出新的单阶段训练范式,通过端到端目标联合优化NeRF自解码器和潜在扩散模型,实现从稀疏视角同时进行三维重建与先验学习。测试时,可直接采样扩散先验进行无条件生成,或结合任意未见过对象的观测进行NeRF重建。SSDNeRF在无条件生成和单/稀疏视角三维重建中展现出与领先任务特定方法相当甚至更优的鲁棒性。
abstract_en: 3D-aware image synthesis encompasses a variety of tasks, such as scene generation and novel view synthesis from images. Despite numerous task-specific methods, developing a comprehensive model remains challenging. In this paper, we present SSDNeRF, a unified approach that employs an expressive diffusion model to learn a generalizable prior of neural radiance fields (NeRF) from multi-view images of diverse objects. Previous studies have used two-stage approaches that rely on pretrained NeRFs as real data to train diffusion models. In contrast, we propose a new single-stage training paradigm with an end-to-end objective that jointly optimizes a NeRF auto-decoder and a latent diffusion model, enabling simultaneous 3D reconstruction and prior learning, even from sparsely available views. At test time, we can directly sample the diffusion prior for unconditional generation, or combine it with arbitrary observations of unseen objects for NeRF reconstruction. SSDNeRF demonstrates robust results comparable to or better than leading task-specific methods in unconditional generation and single/sparse-view 3D reconstruction.
authors: Hansheng Chen, Jiatao Gu, Anpei Chen, Wei Tian, Zhuowen Tu, Lingjie Liu, Hao Su ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2416-2425

title: 尺寸至关重要:基于面向服装的变换试穿网络的尺寸感知虚拟试穿
title_en: Size Does Matter: Size-aware Virtual Try-on via Clothing-oriented Transformation Try-on Network
abstract: 虚拟试穿任务旨在通过将目标服装套在人体上合成逼真的试穿结果。大多数先前的工作依赖于薄板样条或外观流来变形服装以适应人体形状。然而,这两种方法均无法处理复杂变形,导致过度扭曲或错位。此外,存在一个关键未被解决的挑战,即调整服装尺寸以进行试穿。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种面向服装的变换试穿网络(COTTON)。COTTON利用服装结构、地标和分割设计了一种新型地标引导的变换,允许在试穿过程中精确变形服装并调整尺寸。此外,为在去除人体图像中的服装区域时不丢失显著人体特征,我们提出了一种基于变换服装和人体分割的服装消除策略。该方法使用户能够试穿贴身或宽松的服装,同时保留更多人体特征。定性与定量结果表明,COTTON优于最先进的高分辨率虚拟试穿方法。所有代码可在https://github.com/cotton6/COTTON-size-does-matter获取。
abstract_en: Virtual try-on tasks aim at synthesizing realistic try-on results by trying target clothes on humans. Most previous works relied on the Thin Plate Spline or appearance flows to warp clothes to fit human body shapes. However, both approaches cannot handle complex warping, leading to over distortion or misalignment. Furthermore, there is a critical unaddressed challenge of adjusting clothing sizes for try-on. To tackle these issues, we propose a Clothing-Oriented Transformation Try-On Network (COTTON). COTTON leverages clothing structure with landmarks and segmentation to design a novel landmark-guided transformation for precisely deforming clothes, allowing for size adjustment during try-on. Additionally, to properly remove the clothing region from the human image without losing significant human characteristics, we propose a clothing elimination policy based on both transformed clothes and human segmentation. This method enables users to try on clothes tucked-in or untucked while retaining more human characteristics. Both qualitative and quantitative results show that COTTON outperforms the state-of-the-art high-resolution virtual try-on approaches. All the code is available at https://github.com/cotton6/COTTON-size-does-matter.
authors: Chieh-Yun Chen, Yi-Chung Chen, Hong-Han Shuai, Wen-Huang Cheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7513-7522

title: SkeleTR: 面向自然场景的基于骨架的动作识别
title_en: SkeleTR: Towards Skeleton-based Action Recognition in the Wild
abstract: 我们提出SkeleTR,一种新的基于骨架的动作识别框架。与以往主要关注受控环境的研究不同,我们针对自然场景中的动作识别任务,这类场景通常涉及人数可变以及人物间多种交互形式。SkeleTR采用两阶段范式:首先利用图卷积建模每个骨架序列的个体骨架动态,随后通过堆叠的Transformer编码器捕捉对自然场景动作识别至关重要的人员交互信息。为减轻不准确骨架关联的负面影响,SkeleTR采用较短的骨架序列作为输入并增加序列数量。作为统一解决方案,SkeleTR可直接应用于多种基于骨架的动作任务,包括视频级动作分类、实例级动作检测和群体级活动识别。它还支持跨不同动作任务和数据集的迁移学习与联合训练,从而实现性能提升。在多个基于骨架的动作识别基准测试中,SkeleTR取得了最先进性能。
abstract_en: We present SkeleTR, a new framework for skeleton-based action recognition. In contrast to prior work, which focuses mainly on controlled environments, we target in-the-wild scenarios that typically involve a variable number of people and various forms of interaction between people. SkeleTR works with a two-stage paradigm. It first models the intra-person skeleton dynamics for each skeleton sequence with graph convolutions, and then uses stacked Transformer encoders to capture person interactions that are important for action recognition in the wild. To mitigate the negative impact of inaccurate skeleton associations, SkeleTR takes relative short skeleton sequences as input and increases the number of sequences. As a unified solution, SkeleTR can be directly applied to multiple skeleton-based action tasks, including video-level action classification, instance-level action detection, and group-level activity recognition. It also enables transfer learning and joint training across different action tasks and datasets, which results in performance improvement. When evaluated on various skeleton-based action recognition benchmarks, SkeleTR achieves the state-of-the-art performance.
authors: Haodong Duan, Mingze Xu, Bing Shuai, Davide Modolo, Zhuowen Tu, Joseph Tighe, Alessandro Bergamo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13634-13644

title: SkeletonMAE:基于图的掩码自编码器用于骨架序列预训练
title_en: SkeletonMAE: Graph-based Masked Autoencoder for Skeleton Sequence Pre-training
abstract: 骨架序列表示学习因其在建模人体关节和拓扑结构方面的潜力,在动作识别中展现出显著优势。然而,当前方法通常需要大量标注数据来训练计算成本高昂的模型。此外,这些方法忽略了如何利用不同骨架关节之间的细粒度依赖关系,以预训练一种在不同数据集上具有良好泛化能力的高效骨架序列学习模型。本文提出了一种高效的骨架序列学习框架,命名为骨架序列学习(SSL)。为全面捕捉人体姿态并获取具有判别性的骨架序列表示,我们构建了一个非对称的基于图的编码器-解码器预训练架构,命名为SkeletonMAE。该架构将骨架关节序列嵌入图卷积网络,并基于先验的人体拓扑知识重建被掩码的骨架关节和边。随后,将预训练的SkeletonMAE编码器与时空表示学习(STRL)模块集成,构建SSL框架。大量实验结果表明,我们的SSL在不同数据集上具有良好的泛化能力,在FineGym、Diving48、NTU 60和NTU 120数据集上超越了最先进的自监督骨架方法。此外,我们还获得了与部分全监督方法相当的性能。代码已开源至https://github.com/HongYan1123/SkeletonMAE。
abstract_en: Skeleton sequence representation learning has shown great advantages for action recognition due to its promising ability to model human joints and topology. However, the current methods usually require sufficient labeled data for training computationally expensive models. Moreover, these methods ignore how to utilize the fine-grained dependencies among different skeleton joints to pre-train an efficient skeleton sequence learning model that can generalize well across different datasets. In this paper, we propose an efficient skeleton sequence learning framework, named Skeleton Sequence Learning (SSL). To comprehensively capture the human pose and obtain discriminative skeleton sequence representation, we build an asymmetric graph-based encoder-decoder pre-training architecture named SkeletonMAE, which embeds skeleton joint sequence into graph convolutional network and reconstructs the masked skeleton joints and edges based on the prior human topology knowledge. Then, the pre-trained SkeletonMAE encoder is integrated with the Spatial-Temporal Representation Learning (STRL) module to build the SSL framework. Extensive experimental results show that our SSL generalizes well across different datasets and outperforms the state-of-the-art self-supervised skeleton-based methods on FineGym, Diving48, NTU 60 and NTU 120 datasets. Moreover, we obtain comparable performance to some fully supervised methods. The code is avaliable at https://github.com/HongYan1123/SkeletonMAE.
authors: Hong Yan, Yang Liu, Yushen Wei, Zhen Li, Guanbin Li, Liang Lin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 5606-5618

title: 基于草图和文本引导的扩散模型用于彩色点云生成
title_en: Sketch and Text Guided Diffusion Model for Colored Point Cloud Generation
abstract: 扩散概率模型在文本引导的图像生成中取得了显著成功。然而,由于缺乏包含3D模型及其描述的充足数据,生成3D形状仍然具有挑战性。此外,基于文本的3D形状描述本质上存在歧义且缺乏细节。本文提出了一种基于草图和文本引导的概率扩散模型,用于彩色点云生成,该模型通过对象的手绘草图及其文本描述联合条件化去噪过程。我们通过联合扩散过程逐步扩散点坐标和颜色值,以达到高斯分布。因此,彩色点云生成等价于学习由草图和文本条件化的逆扩散过程,以迭代恢复所需的形状和颜色。具体而言,为了学习有效的草图-文本嵌入,我们的模型基于胶囊注意力网络,根据文本提示和草图的联合嵌入自适应聚合。我们的模型采用分阶段扩散生成形状,然后根据外观提示为不同部分分配颜色,同时保留第一阶段的精确形状。这使我们的模型能够灵活扩展到多个任务,如外观重新编辑和部件分割。实验结果表明,我们的模型在点云生成任务中优于近期最先进的方法。
abstract_en:
Diffusion probabilistic models have achieved remarkable success in text guided image generation. However, generating 3D shapes is still challenging due to the lack of sufficient data containing 3D models along with their descriptions. Moreover, text based descriptions of 3D shapes are inherently ambiguous and lack details. 
 In this paper, we propose a sketch and text guided probabilistic diffusion model for colored point cloud generation that conditions the denoising process jointly with a hand drawn sketch of the object and its textual description.
 We incrementally diffuse the point coordinates and color values in a joint diffusion process to reach a Gaussian distribution. Colored point cloud generation thus amounts to learning the reverse diffusion process, conditioned by the sketch and text, to iteratively recover the desired shape and color. 
 Specifically, to learn effective sketch-text embedding, our model adaptively aggregates the joint embedding of text prompt and the sketch based on a capsule attention network. Our model uses staged diffusion to generate the shape and then assign colors to different parts conditioned on the appearance prompt while preserving precise shapes from the first stage. This gives our model the flexibility to extend to multiple tasks, such as appearance re-editing and part segmentation. Experimental results demonstrate that our model outperforms the recent state-of-the-art in point cloud generation.
authors: Zijie Wu, Yaonan Wang, Mingtao Feng, He Xie, Ajmal Mian ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8929-8939

title: Skill Transformer:用于移动操作的单体策略
title_en: Skill Transformer: A Monolithic Policy for Mobile Manipulation
abstract: 我们提出Skill Transformer,一种通过结合条件序列建模和技能模块化来解决长时域机器人任务的方法。基于机器人第一人称和本体感觉观测,Skill Transformer通过使用解决完整任务的Transformer架构和示范轨迹,端到端地训练以预测高阶技能(如导航、抓取、放置)和全身低阶动作(如基座和机械臂运动)。通过技能预测模块对低阶动作进行推理并避免交接错误(模块化方法中常见的问题),Skill Transformer保留了整体任务的可组合性和模块化特性。我们在具身重排基准测试中测试Skill Transformer,发现其在新场景中能够执行鲁棒的任务规划和低阶控制,在困难的重排问题中,成功率比基线方法高出2.5倍。
abstract_en: We present Skill Transformer, an approach for solving long-horizon robotic tasks by combining conditional sequence modeling and skill modularity. Conditioned on egocentric and proprioceptive observations of a robot, Skill Transformer is trained end-to-end to predict both a high-level skill (e.g., navigation, picking, placing), and a whole-body low-level action (e.g., base and arm motion), using a transformer architecture and demonstration trajectories that solve the full task. It retains the composability and modularity of the overall task through a skill predictor module while reasoning about low-level actions and avoiding hand-off errors, common in modular approaches. We test Skill Transformer on an embodied rearrangement benchmark and find it performs robust task planning and low-level control in new scenarios, achieving a 2.5x higher success rate than baselines in hard rearrangement problems.
authors: Xiaoyu Huang, Dhruv Batra, Akshara Rai, Andrew Szot ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10852-10862

title: Skip-Plan: 通过压缩动作空间学习实现教学视频中的过程规划
title_en: Skip-Plan: Procedure Planning in Instructional Videos via Condensed Action Space Learning
abstract: 本文提出Skip-Plan,一种用于教学视频过程规划的压缩动作空间学习方法。当前过程规划方法均依赖于每个时间步的状态-动作对预测,并依次生成动作。尽管这符合人类直觉,但该方法在高维状态监督和动作序列误差累积方面始终存在困难。本工作中,我们将过程规划问题抽象为数学链模型。通过跳过动作链中的不确定节点和边,我们以两种方式将长且复杂的序列函数转化为短而可靠的函数。首先,我们跳过所有中间状态监督,仅关注动作预测。其次,通过跳过不可靠的中间动作,将相对较长的链分解为多个短子链。通过这种方式,我们的模型在压缩动作空间中探索动作序列内各种可靠子关系。大量实验表明,Skip-Plan在CrossTask和COIN基准测试中实现了过程规划的最先进性能。
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose Skip-Plan, a condensed action space learning method for procedure planning in instructional videos. Current procedure planning methods all stick to the state-action pair prediction at every timestep and generate actions adjacently. Although it coincides with human intuition, such a methodology consistently struggles with high-dimensional state supervision and error accumulation on action sequences. In this work, we abstract the procedure planning problem as a mathematical chain model. By skipping uncertain nodes and edges in action chains, we transfer long and complex sequence functions into short but reliable ones in two ways. First, we skip all the intermediate state supervision and only focus on action predictions. Second, we decompose relatively long chains into multiple short sub-chains by skipping unreliable intermediate actions. By this means, our model explores all sorts of reliable sub-relations within an action sequence in the condensed action space. Extensive experiments show Skip-Plan achieves state-of-the-art performance on the CrossTask and COIN benchmarks for procedure planning.
authors: Zhiheng Li, Wenjia Geng, Muheng Li, Lei Chen, Yansong Tang, Jiwen Lu, Jie Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10297-10306

title: SlaBins:基于倾斜分箱的鱼眼深度估计在道路环境中的应用
title_en: SlaBins: Fisheye Depth Estimation using Slanted Bins on Road Environments
abstract: 尽管自动驾驶车辆的3D感知主要关注正面视角信息,但实际中超过一半的致命事故由侧向碰撞(如T型碰撞)引发。基于这一事实,我们研究了侧视深度估计问题,特别是针对提供宽视场信息的单目鱼眼相机。然而,由于鱼眼相机主要观测道路区域,导致物体区域(如车辆或行人)出现严重畸变。为缓解这些问题,我们提出了一种新的鱼眼深度估计网络SlaBins,该网络基于道路环境的几何特性(即大多数物体垂直于道路环境)推断出准确且密集的深度图。具体而言,我们引入了倾斜多圆柱图像(MCI)表示方法,该方法允许将距离描述为与地面垂直的圆柱层半径,无论相机视角方向如何。基于倾斜MCI,我们估计了一组自适应分箱和每个像素的概率图用于深度估计。随后,通过结合估计的视角倾斜角,我们直接推断出鱼眼相机的密集且准确的深度图。实验表明,SlaBins在SynWoodScape和KITTI-360深度数据集的定性和定量评估中均优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Although 3D perception for autonomous vehicles has focused on frontal-view information, more than half of fatal accidents occur due to side impacts in practice (e.g., T-bone crash). Motivated by this fact, we investigate the problem of side-view depth estimation, especially for monocular fisheye cameras, which provide wide FoV information. However, since fisheye cameras head road areas, it observes road areas mostly and results in severe distortion on object areas, such as vehicles or pedestrians. To alleviate these issues, we propose a new fisheye depth estimation network, SlaBins, that infers an accurate and dense depth map based on a geometric property of road environments; most objects are standing (i.e., orthogonal) on the road environments. Concretely, we introduce a slanted multi-cylindrical image (MCI) representation, which allows us to describe a distance as a radius to a cylindrical layer orthogonal to the ground regardless of the camera viewing direction. Based on the slanted MCI, we estimate a set of adaptive bins and a per-pixel probability map for depth estimation. Then by combining it with the estimated slanted angle of viewing direction, we directly infer a dense and accurate depth map for fisheye cameras. Experiments demonstrate that SlaBins outperforms the state-of-the-art methods in both qualitative and quantitative evaluation on the SynWoodScape and KITTI-360 depth datasets.
authors: Jongsung Lee, Gyeongsu Cho, Jeongin Park, Kyongjun Kim, Seongoh Lee, Jung-Hee Kim, Seong-Gyun Jeong, Kyungdon Joo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8765-8774

title: 基于粗到细提议生成与模仿学习的小目标检测
title_en: Small Object Detection via Coarse-to-fine Proposal Generation and Imitation Learning
