Extensive experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the challenging MVTec dataset, especially in localization accuracy.
authors: Xinyi Zhang, Naiqi Li, Jiawei Li, Tao Dai, Yong Jiang, Shu-Tao Xia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6782-6791

title: 基于事件相机的无监督视频去雨方法
title_en: Unsupervised Video Deraining with An Event Camera
abstract: 当前无监督视频去雨方法在建模雨的复杂时空特性时效率低下,导致结果不理想。本文提出一种新方法,将生物启发的事件相机集成到无监督视频去雨流程中,从而捕捉高时间分辨率信息并建模复杂雨特征。具体而言,我们首先设计了一个端到端学习网络,包含两个模块:非对称分离模块和跨模态融合模块。两个模块分别负责分离雨-背景层特征,并从跨模态视角实现正向增强与负向抑制。其次,为规范网络训练,我们精心设计了跨模态对比学习方法,利用事件相机的互补信息,探索不同域中雨-背景层的互斥性与相似性。这促使去雨网络聚焦各层的特征差异,学习更具判别性的表示。此外,我们构建了首个包含雨景视频与事件数据的真实世界数据集,使用混合成像系统。大量实验验证了该方法在合成数据集和真实数据集上的优越性能。
abstract_en: Current unsupervised video deraining methods are inefficient in modeling the intricate spatio-temporal properties of rain, which leads to unsatisfactory results. In this paper, we propose a novel approach by integrating a bio-inspired event camera into the unsupervised video deraining pipeline, which enables us to capture high temporal resolution information and model complex rain characteristics. Specifically, we first design an end-to-end learning-based network consisting of two modules, the asymmetric separation module and the cross-modal fusion module. The two modules are responsible for segregating the features of the rain-background layer, and for positive enhancement and negative suppression from a cross-modal perspective, respectively. Second, to regularize the network training, we elaborately design a cross-modal contrastive learning method that leverages the complementary information from event cameras, exploring the mutual exclusion and similarity of rain-background layers in different domains. This encourages the deraining network to focus on the distinctive characteristics of each layer and learn a more discriminative representation. Moreover, we construct the first real-world dataset comprising rainy videos and events using a hybrid imaging system. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of our method on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
authors: Jin Wang, Wenming Weng, Yueyi Zhang, Zhiwei Xiong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10831-10840

title: 无监督视频对象分割的在线对抗自调优
title_en: Unsupervised Video Object Segmentation with Online Adversarial Self-Tuning
abstract: 现有无监督视频对象分割方法严重依赖于在带标签训练视频集上离线训练的分割模型,难以良好泛化到来自不同领域且可能存在分布偏移的测试视频。我们提出在预训练分割模型上进行在线微调,以适应测试时的任意即兴视频。为此,我们设计了一种离线半监督对抗训练过程,利用无标签视频帧提升模型泛化能力,同时对齐带标签视频帧与无标签视频帧的特征。在训练好的分割模型基础上,我们进一步进行在线自监督对抗微调,其中教师模型和学生模型首先使用预训练分割模型权重初始化,教师模型生成的伪标签用于在对抗学习框架中监督学生模型。通过在线微调,学生模型根据每个测试视频中出现的新模式逐步更新,显著缩小了测试时的领域差距。我们将离线训练与在线微调整合到统一框架中,用于无监督视频对象分割,并将该方法命名为在线对抗自调优(OAST)。实验表明,我们的方法在主流视频对象分割数据集上显著优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en:
The existing unsupervised video object segmentation methods depend heavily on the segmentation model trained offline on a labeled training video set, and cannot well generalize to the test videos from a different domain with possible distribution shifts. We propose to perform online fine-tuning on the pre-trained segmentation model to adapt to any ad-hoc videos at the test time. To achieve this, we design an offline semi-supervised adversarial training process, which leverages the unlabeled video frames to improve the model generalizability while aligning the features of the labeled video frames with the features of the unlabeled video frames. With the trained segmentation model, we further conduct an online self-supervised adversarial finetuning, in which a teacher model and a student model are first initialized with the pre-trained segmentation model weights, and the pseudo label produced by the teacher model is used to supervise the student model in an adversarial learning framework. Through online finetuning, the student model is progressively updated according to the emerging patterns in
 each test video, which significantly reduces the test-time domain gap. We integrate our offline training and online fine-tuning in a unified framework for unsupervised video object segmentation and dub our method Online Adversarial Self-Tuning (OAST). The experiments show that our method out-performs the state-of-the-arts with significant gains on the popular video object segmentation datasets.
authors: Tiankang Su, Huihui Song, Dong Liu, Bo Liu, Qingshan Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 688-698

title: UpCycling:无需共享原始级别未标记场景的半监督三维目标检测
title_en: UpCycling: Semi-supervised 3D Object Detection without Sharing Raw-level Unlabeled Scenes
abstract: 半监督学习(SSL)在自动驾驶领域受到越来越多的关注,以减少三维标注的巨大负担。本文提出UpCycling,一种无需额外原始级别点云的新型SSL框架:通过学习未标记的去标识化中间特征(即“碎裂”数据)来保护隐私。由于这些中间特征由推理流程自然生成,因此在自动驾驶车辆上无需额外计算。然而,为未标记的特征级场景生成有效的自洽损失却是一个关键挑战。最新用于三维目标检测的SSL框架通过在未标记原始点场景的不同增强之间施加自洽正则化,但当应用于中间特征时却变得有害。为了解决这一问题,我们引入了一种混合伪标签与特征级真实值采样(F-GT)的新型组合,安全地增强未标记的多类型三维场景特征,并提供高质量的监督。我们在两个代表性的三维目标检测模型SECOND-IoU和PV-RCNN上实现了UpCycling。在广泛使用的数据集(Waymo、KITTI和Lyft)上的实验验证了UpCycling在特征级应用的其他增强方法上的优越性。此外,在保护隐私的同时,UpCycling在领域适应和部分标签场景中,其性能优于或与利用原始级别未标记数据的最先进方法相当。
abstract_en: Semi-supervised Learning (SSL) has received increasing attention in autonomous driving to reduce the enormous burden of 3D annotation. In this paper, we propose UpCycling, a novel SSL framework for 3D object detection with zero additional raw-level point cloud: learning from unlabeled de-identified intermediate features (i.e., "smashed" data) to preserve privacy. Since these intermediate features are naturally produced by the inference pipeline, no additional computation is required on autonomous vehicles. However, generating effective consistency loss for unlabeled feature-level scene turns out to be a critical challenge. The latest SSL frameworks for 3D object detection that enforce consistency regularization between different augmentations of an unlabeled raw-point scene become detrimental when applied to intermediate features. To solve the problem, we introduce a novel combination of hybrid pseudo labels and feature-level Ground Truth sampling (F-GT), which safely augments unlabeled multi-type 3D scene features and provides high-quality supervision. We implement UpCycling on two representative 3D object detection models: SECOND-IoU and PV-RCNN. Experiments on widely-used datasets (Waymo, KITTI, and Lyft) verify that UpCycling outperforms other augmentation methods applied at the feature level. In addition, while preserving privacy, UpCycling performs better or comparably to the state-of-the-art methods that utilize raw-level unlabeled data in both domain adaptation and partial-label scenarios.
authors: Sunwook Hwang, Youngseok Kim, Seongwon Kim, Saewoong Bahk, Hyung-Sin Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 23351-23361

title: 基于可变形神经网格原语的城市光照场表示
title_en: Urban Radiance Field Representation with Deformable Neural Mesh Primitives
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRFs)在过去几年中取得了显著成功。然而,大多数现有方法仍需大量资源,因为其基于光线行进的渲染。为了高效构建城市级光照场,我们设计了可变形神经网格原语(DNMP),并提出使用此类原语对整个场景进行参数化。DNMP是经典网格表示的灵活且紧凑的神经变体,兼具基于光栅化的渲染效率和强大的神经表示能力,适用于逼真图像合成。具体而言,DNMP由一组连接的可变形网格顶点及其配对的顶点特征组成,用于参数化局部区域的几何形状和光照信息。为约束优化的自由度并降低存储预算,我们强制每个原语的形状从相对低维的潜在空间解码。渲染颜色通过视图依赖的多层感知机从顶点特征(经光栅化插值)解码。DNMP为城市级场景表示提供了新的范式,具有以下优势:(1) 高质量渲染。我们的方法在城市场景的新视角合成中实现了领先性能。(2) 低计算成本。我们的表示支持快速渲染(2.07ms/1k像素)和低峰值内存使用(110MB/1k像素)。我们还提出了一种轻量版本,运行速度比原始NeRF快33倍,且与高度优化的Instant-NGP(0.61 vs 0.71ms/1k像素)相当。
abstract_en: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) have achieved great success in the past few years. However, most current methods still require intensive resources due to ray marching-based rendering. To construct urban-level radiance fields efficiently, we design Deformable Neural Mesh Primitive (DNMP), and propose to parameterize the entire scene with such primitives. The DNMP is a flexible and compact neural variant of classic mesh representation, which enjoys both the efficiency of rasterization-based rendering and the powerful neural representation capability for photo-realistic image synthesis. Specifically, a DNMP consists of a set of connected deformable mesh vertices with paired vertex features to parameterize the geometry and radiance information of a local area. To constrain the degree of freedom for optimization and lower the storage budgets, we enforce the shape of each primitive to be decoded from a relatively low-dimensional latent space. The rendering colors are decoded from the vertex features (interpolated with rasterization) by a view-dependent MLP. The DNMP provides a new paradigm for urban-level scene representation with appealing properties: (1) High-quality rendering. Our method achieves leading performance for novel view synthesis in urban scenarios. (2) Low computational costs. Our representation enables fast rendering (2.07ms/1k pixels) and low peak memory usage (110MB/1k pixels). We also present a lightweight version that can run 33xfaster than vanilla NeRFs, and comparable to the highly-optimized Instant-NGP (0.61 vs 0.71ms/1k pixels).
authors: Fan Lu, Yan Xu, Guang Chen, Hongsheng Li, Kwan-Yee Lin, Changjun Jiang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 465-476

title: UrbanGIRAFFE:将城市场景表示为组合式生成神经特征场
title_en: UrbanGIRAFFE: Representing Urban Scenes as Compositional Generative Neural Feature Fields
abstract: 生成具有可控相机姿态和场景内容的逼真图像对于增强现实/虚拟现实和模拟等应用至关重要。尽管三维感知生成模型取得了快速进展,但大多数现有方法专注于以物体为中心的图像,无法用于自由相机视角控制和场景编辑的城市场景生成。为解决这一挑战性任务,我们提出UrbanGIRAFFE,该模型利用粗粒度的三维全景先验,包括不可计数事物和可计数物体的布局分布,以提供语义和几何先验。我们的模型具有组合性和可控性,因为它将场景分解为事物、物体和天空。通过语义体素网格形式的事物先验,我们构建了条件事物生成器,有效融合了粗粒度的语义和几何信息。物体布局先验进一步使我们能够从杂乱场景中学习物体生成器。借助适当的损失函数,我们的方法实现了具有多样可控性的逼真三维感知图像合成,包括大范围相机运动、事物编辑和物体操作。我们在合成和真实世界数据集上验证了模型的有效性,包括具有挑战性的KITTI-360数据集。
abstract_en: Generating photorealistic images with controllable camera pose and scene contents is essential for many applications including AR/VR and simulation. Despite the fact that rapid progress has been made in 3D-aware generative models, most existing methods focus on object-centric images and are not applicable to generating urban scenes for free camera viewpoint control and scene editing. To address this challenging task, we propose UrbanGIRAFFE, which uses a coarse 3D panoptic prior, including the layout distribution of uncountable stuff and countable objects, to provide semantic and geometric prior. Our model is compositional and controllable as it breaks down the scene into stuff, objects, and sky. Using stuff prior in the form of semantic voxel grids, we build a conditioned stuff generator that effectively incorporates the coarse semantic and geometry information. The object layout prior further allows us to learn an object generator from cluttered scenes. With proper loss functions, our approach facilitates photorealistic 3D-aware image synthesis with diverse controllability, including large camera movement, stuff editing, and object manipulation. We validate the effectiveness of our model on both synthetic and real-world datasets, including the challenging KITTI-360 dataset.
authors: Yuanbo Yang, Yifei Yang, Hanlei Guo, Rong Xiong, Yue Wang, Yiyi Liao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9199-9210

title: 使用华夫铁进行汽车点云语义分割
title_en: Using a Waffle Iron for Automotive Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation
abstract: 在自动驾驶数据集中的点云语义分割需要能够高效处理大量点的技术。稀疏3D卷积已成为构建此类深度神经网络的主流工具:它们利用点云的稀疏性来减少内存和计算负载,并成为当前最佳方法的核心。在本文中,我们提出了一种替代方法,其性能达到最先进的水平而无需使用稀疏卷积。我们实际上证明,通过依赖事先被认为不适合大规模和高性能3D感知的工具,可以实现这种水平的性能。具体而言,我们提出了一种新颖的3D主干网络WaffleIron,几乎完全由多层感知机(MLPs)和密集2D卷积组成,并展示了如何在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上训练它以达到高性能。我们认为,WaffleIron是稀疏3D卷积主干网络的有力替代方案,尤其是在那些稀疏卷积不可用的框架和硬件上。
abstract_en: Semantic segmentation of point clouds in autonomous driving datasets requires techniques that can process large numbers of points efficiently. Sparse 3D convolutions have become the de-facto tools to construct deep neural networks for this task: they exploit point cloud sparsity to reduce the memory and computational loads and are at the core of today's best methods. In this paper, we propose an alternative method that reaches the level of state-of-the-art methods without requiring sparse convolutions. We actually show that such level of performance is achievable by relying on tools a priori unfit for large scale and high-performing 3D perception. In particular, we propose a novel 3D backbone, WaffleIron, made almost exclusively of MLPs and dense 2D convolutions and present how to train it to reach high performance on SemanticKITTI and nuScenes. We believe that WaffleIron is a compelling alternative to backbones using sparse 3D convolutions, especially in frameworks and on hardware where those convolutions are not readily available.
authors: Gilles Puy, Alexandre Boulch, Renaud Marlet ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3379-3389

title: V-FUSE: 体积深度图融合与长程约束
title_en: V-FUSE: Volumetric Depth Map Fusion with Long-Range Constraints
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于学习的深度图融合框架,该框架接受由多视角立体(MVS)算法生成的一组深度图和置信度图作为输入,并对其进行优化。这通过将编码不同视角间长程表面关系的体积可见性约束整合到端到端可训练架构中来实现。我们还引入了一个与较大融合子网络联合训练的深度搜索窗口估计子网络,以减少每条射线上的深度假设搜索空间。我们的方法直接从数据中学习建模深度共识和可见性约束的违反情况,有效消除了对融合参数微调的必要性。在MVS数据集上的大量实验表明,输出融合深度图和置信度图的准确性得到了显著提升。
abstract_en: We introduce a learning-based depth map fusion framework that accepts a set of depth and confidence maps generated by a Multi-View Stereo (MVS) algorithm as input and improves them. This is accomplished by integrating volumetric visibility constraints that encode long-range surface relationships across different views into an end-to-end trainable architecture. We also introduce a depth search window estimation sub-network trained jointly with the larger fusion sub-network to reduce the depth hypothesis search space along each ray. Our method learns to model depth consensus and violations of visibility constraints directly from the data; effectively removing the necessity of fine-tuning fusion parameters. Extensive experiments on MVS datasets show substantial improvements in the accuracy of the output fused depth and confidence maps.
authors: Nathaniel Burgdorfer, Philippos Mordohai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3449-3458

title: V3Det:海量词汇视觉检测数据集
title_en: V3Det: Vast Vocabulary Visual Detection Dataset
abstract: 近期在现实世界中检测任意目标的研究进展通常基于具有受限词汇量的目标检测数据集进行训练和评估。为促进更通用的视觉目标检测方法的发展,我们提出V3Det,一个包含海量词汇量的视觉检测数据集,其在大量图像上提供了精确标注的边界框。V3Det具有以下显著特性:1)海量词汇量:它包含来自13,204个类别的目标边界框,覆盖真实世界图像,其规模是现有大规模词汇量目标检测数据集(如LVIS)的10倍。2)层次化类别组织:V3Det的海量词汇量通过层次化类别树进行组织,标注了类别间的包含关系,鼓励在海量和开放词汇量目标检测中探索类别关系。3)丰富标注:V3Det包含243,000张图像中精确标注的目标,以及由人类专家和专业聊天机器人撰写的每个类别的描述文本。通过提供广阔的探索空间,V3Det能够支持海量和开放词汇量目标检测的广泛基准测试,为未来研究带来新的观察、实践和见解。该数据集有望成为开发更通用视觉感知系统的重要基石。V3Det可在https://v3det.openxlab.org.cn/获取。
abstract_en: Recent advances in detecting arbitrary objects in the real world are trained and evaluated on object detection datasets with a relatively restricted vocabulary. To facilitate the development of more general visual object detection, we propose V3Det, a vast vocabulary visual detection dataset with precisely annotated bounding boxes on massive images. V3Det has several appealing properties: 1) Vast Vocabulary: It contains bounding boxes of objects from 13,204 categories on real-world images, which is 10 times larger than the existing large vocabulary object detection dataset, e.g., LVIS. 2) Hierarchical Category Organization: The vast vocabulary of V3Det is organized by a hierarchical category tree which annotates the inclusion relationship among categories, encouraging the exploration of category relationships in vast and open vocabulary object detection. 3) Rich Annotations: V3Det comprises precisely annotated objects in 243k images and professional descriptions of each category written by human experts and a powerful chatbot. By offering a vast exploration space, V3Det enables extensive benchmarks on both vast and open vocabulary object detection, leading to new observations, practices, and insights for future research. It has the potential to serve as a cornerstone dataset for developing more general visual perception systems. V3Det is available at https://v3det.openxlab.org.cn/.
authors: Jiaqi Wang, Pan Zhang, Tao Chu, Yuhang Cao, Yujie Zhou, Tong Wu, Bin Wang, Conghui He, Dahua Lin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19844-19854

title: VAD:面向高效自动驾驶的矢量化场景表示
title_en: VAD: Vectorized Scene Representation for Efficient Autonomous Driving
abstract: 自动驾驶需要对周围环境有全面的理解以实现可靠的轨迹规划。先前的研究依赖于密集的栅格化场景表示(如代理占用和语义地图)来进行规划,这计算成本高且忽略了实例级结构信息。本文提出VAD,一种面向自动驾驶的端到端矢量化范式,将驾驶场景建模为完全矢量化的表示。所提出的矢量化范式具有两个显著优势。一方面,VAD利用矢量化的代理运动和地图元素作为显式的实例级规划约束,有效提升了规划安全性。另一方面,VAD通过摆脱计算密集型的栅格化表示和人工设计的后处理步骤,运行速度远超先前的端到端规划方法。VAD在nuScenes数据集上实现了最先进的端到端规划性能,显著超越了先前最佳方法。我们的基础模型VAD-Base将平均碰撞率降低了29.0%,运行速度提升了2.5倍。此外,轻量级变体VAD-Tiny在保持相近规划性能的同时,推理速度提升了高达9.3倍。我们认为VAD的卓越性能和高效率对于自动驾驶系统的实际部署至关重要。代码和模型可在https://github.com/hustvl/VAD获取以促进未来研究。
abstract_en: Autonomous driving requires a comprehensive understanding of the surrounding environment for reliable trajectory planning. Previous works rely on dense rasterized scene representation (e.g., agent occupancy and semantic map) to perform planning, which is computationally intensive and misses the instance-level structure information. In this paper, we propose VAD, an end-to-end vectorized paradigm for autonomous driving, which models the driving scene as a fully vectorized representation. The proposed vectorized paradigm has two significant advantages. On one hand, VAD exploits the vectorized agent motion and map elements as explicit instance-level planning constraints which effectively improves planning safety. On the other hand, VAD runs much faster than previous end-to-end planning methods by getting rid of computation-intensive rasterized representation and hand-designed post-processing steps. VAD achieves state-of-the-art end-to-end planning performance on the nuScenes dataset, outperforming the previous best method by a large margin. Our base model, VAD-Base, greatly reduces the average collision rate by 29.0% and runs 2.5x faster. Besides, a lightweight variant, VAD-Tiny, greatly improves the inference speed (up to 9.3x) while achieving comparable planning performance. We believe the excellent performance and the high efficiency of VAD are critical for the real-world deployment of an autonomous driving system. Code and models are available at https://github.com/hustvl/VAD for facilitating future research.
authors: Bo Jiang, Shaoyu Chen, Qing Xu, Bencheng Liao, Jiajie Chen, Helong Zhou, Qian Zhang, Wenyu Liu, Chang Huang, Xinggang Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8340-8350

title: VADER:视频对齐差异分析与检索
title_en: VADER: Video Alignment Differencing and Retrieval
abstract: 我们提出VADER,一种时空匹配、对齐和变化总结方法,以帮助打击通过篡改视频传播的虚假信息。VADER利用鲁棒的视觉描述符和可扩展的搜索,在自适应分块的视频内容上匹配并粗略对齐部分视频片段至候选视频。基于Transformer的对齐模块随后细化查询片段在匹配视频中的时间定位。时空比较模块识别对齐内容间的篡改区域,不受任何由于残余时间错位或内容非编辑性变化导致的改变影响。鲁棒地将视频与可信来源进行匹配,能够推断视频溯源信息,从而对遇到的内容做出明智的信任决策。代码和数据可在https://github.com/AlexBlck/vader获取
abstract_en: We propose VADER, a spatio-temporal matching, alignment, and change summarization method to help fight misinformation spread via manipulated videos. VADER matches and coarsely aligns partial video fragments to candidate videos using a robust visual descriptor and scalable search over adaptively chunked video content. A transformer-based alignment module then refines the temporal localization of the query fragment within the matched video. A space-time comparator module identifies regions of manipulation between aligned content, invariant to any changes due to any residual temporal misalignments or artifacts arising from non-editorial changes of the content. Robustly matching video to a trusted source enables conclusions to be drawn on video provenance, enabling informed trust decisions on content encountered. Code and data are available at https://github.com/AlexBlck/vader
authors: Alexander Black, Simon Jenni, Tu Bui, Md. Mehrab Tanjim, Stefano Petrangeli, Ritwik Sinha, Viswanathan Swaminathan, John Collomosse ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22357-22367

title: VAPCNet:视角感知的三维点云补全
title_en: VAPCNet: Viewpoint-Aware 3D Point Cloud Completion
abstract: 现有基于学习的三维点云补全方法通常忽略了一个事实:补全过程高度依赖于部分扫描的视角。然而,在现实应用场景中,未完全扫描物体的各种视角通常是未知的,直接估计每个不完整物体的视角通常耗时且需要大量标注成本。为此,本文提出了一种无需显式视角估计的无监督视角表示学习方案。具体而言,我们学习部分扫描的抽象表示,在表示空间中区分不同视角,而非在三维空间中显式估计。我们还基于学习到的表示提出了一种视角感知点云补全网络(VAPCNet),该网络能够灵活适应各种视角。所提出的视角表示学习方案能够提取具有判别性的表示以获取精确的视角信息。在两个流行公开数据集上的实验结果表明,我们的VAPCNet在点云补全任务中达到了最先进水平。源代码可在https://github.com/FZH92128/VAPCNet获取。
abstract_en:
Most existing learning-based 3D point cloud completion methods ignore the fact that the completion process is highly coupled with the viewpoint of a partial scan. However, the various viewpoints of incompletely scanned objects in real-world applications are normally unknown and directly estimating the viewpoint of each incomplete object is usually time-consuming and leads to huge annotation cost. In this paper, we thus propose an unsupervised viewpoint representation learning scheme for 3D point cloud completion without explicit viewpoint estimation. To be specific, we learn abstract representations of partial scans to distinguish various viewpoints in the representation space rather than the explicit estimation in the 3D space. We also introduce a Viewpoint-Aware Point cloud Completion Network (VAPCNet) with flexible adaption to various viewpoints based on the learned
 representations. The proposed viewpoint representation learning scheme can extract discriminative representations to obtain accurate viewpoint information. Reported experiments on two popular public datasets show that our VAPCNet achieves state-of-the-art performance for the point cloud completion task. Source code is available at https://github.com/FZH92128/VAPCNet.
authors: Zhiheng Fu, Longguang Wang, Lian Xu, Zhiyong Wang, Hamid Laga, Yulan Guo, Farid Boussaid, Mohammed Bennamoun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12108-12118

title: VI-Net: 通过学习球面表示上的解耦旋转提升类别级6D物体姿态估计
title_en: VI-Net: Boosting Category-level 6D Object Pose Estimation via Learning Decoupled Rotations on the Spherical Representations
abstract: 从RGB-D物体观测中高精度地估计旋转是6D物体姿态估计中的巨大挑战,由于在SO(3)非线性空间中学习的困难性。本文提出了一种新颖的旋转估计网络,称为VI-Net,通过将旋转分解为视角旋转和面内旋转的组合来简化任务。具体而言,VI-Net基于球面进行特征学习,采用两个独立分支分别估计两个因子化旋转,其中V-Branch通过球面信号上的二分类学习视角旋转,而I-Branch则通过将信号转换为天顶方向视角来估计面内旋转。为处理球面信号,基于新型设计的SPAtial Spherical Convolution(SPA-SConv)构建了球面特征金字塔网络,通过特征填充解决球面信号的边界问题,并通过对称卷积操作实现视角等变特征提取。我们将提出的VI-Net应用于具有挑战性的类别级6D物体姿态估计任务,用于预测无可用CAD模型的未知物体姿态;在基准数据集上的实验验证了方法的有效性,在高精度范围内显著优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Rotation estimation of high precision from an RGB-D object observation is a huge challenge in 6D object pose estimation, due to the difficulty of learning in the non-linear space of SO(3). In this paper, we propose a novel rotation estimation network, termed as VI-Net, to make the task easier by decoupling the rotation as the combination of a viewpoint rotation and an in-plane rotation. More specifically, VI-Net bases the feature learning on the sphere with two individual branches for the estimates of two factorized rotations, where a V-Branch is employed to learn the viewpoint rotation via binary classification on the spherical signals, while another I-Branch is used to estimate the in-plane rotation by transforming the signals to view from the zenith direction. To process the spherical signals, a Spherical Feature Pyramid Network is constructed based on a novel design of SPAtial Spherical Convolution (SPA-SConv), which settles the boundary problem of spherical signals via feature padding and realizesviewpoint-equivariant feature extraction by symmetric convolutional operations. We apply the proposed VI-Net to the challenging task of category-level 6D object pose estimation for predicting the poses of unknown objects without available CAD models; experiments on the benchmarking datasets confirm the efficacy of our method, which outperforms the existing ones with a large margin in the regime of high precision.
authors: Jiehong Lin, Zewei Wei, Yabin Zhang, Kui Jia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14001-14011

title: VL-Match: 基于词级和实例级匹配的视觉-语言预训练增强方法
title_en: VL-Match: Enhancing Vision-Language Pretraining with Token-Level and Instance-Level Matching
abstract: 视觉-语言预训练(VLP)通过图像与文本的匹配显著提升了各类视觉-语言任务的性能。本文提出VL-Match,一种增强词级和实例级匹配的视觉-语言框架。在词级层面,设计了视觉-语言替换词检测任务以增强文本词元与图像的交互,其中VLP的文本编码器作为生成器生成被破坏的文本,而VLP的多模态编码器作为判别器预测被破坏文本中每个词元是否与图像匹配。在实例层面,针对图像-文本匹配任务中判断图像-文本对是否匹配的场景,提出一种新颖的自举方法生成与正样本仅在词级不同的困难负样本。通过这种方式,可迫使网络检测图像与文本之间的细粒度差异。值得注意的是,VL-Match在参数量更少的情况下,显著超越了先前的SOTA方法,在所有图像-文本检索任务中均取得优异表现。
abstract_en: Vision-Language Pretraining (VLP) has significantly improved the performance of various vision-language tasks with the matching of images and texts. In this paper, we propose VL-Match, a Vision-Language framework with Enhanced Token-level and Instance-level Matching. At the token level, a Vision-Language Replaced Token Detection task is designed to boost the substantial interaction between text tokens and images, where the text encoder of VLP works as a generator to generate a corrupted text, and the multimodal encoder of VLP works as a discriminator to predict whether each text token in the corrupted text matches the image. At the instance level, in the Image-Text Matching task that judges whether an image-text pair is matched, we propose a novel bootstrapping method to generate hard negative text samples that are different from the positive ones only at the token level. In this way, we can force the network to detect fine-grained differences between images and texts. Notably, with a smaller amount of parameters, VL-Match significantly outperforms previous SOTA on all image-text retrieval tasks.
authors: Junyu Bi, Daixuan Cheng, Ping Yao, Bochen Pang, Yuefeng Zhan, Chuanguang Yang, Yujing Wang, Hao Sun, Weiwei Deng, Qi Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2584-2593

title: VL-PET:基于粒度调控的视觉-语言参数高效调优
title_en: VL-PET: Vision-and-Language Parameter-Efficient Tuning via Granularity Control
abstract: 随着预训练语言模型(PLMs)规模的快速膨胀,全量微调在模型训练和存储方面变得成本高昂。在视觉-语言(VL)领域,提出了参数高效调优(PET)技术,将模块化修改(如Adapter)集成到编码器-解码器PLMs中。通过调整少量可训练参数,这些技术在性能上可与全量微调相媲美。然而,过度的模块化修改以及忽视编码器和解码器的独特能力可能导致性能退化,而现有PET技术(如VL-Adapter)忽略了这些问题。本文提出了一种视觉-语言参数高效调优(VL-PET)框架,通过新颖的粒度调控机制对模块化修改进行有效控制。考虑到该机制生成的不同粒度调控矩阵,可以从我们的框架中实例化多种模型无关的VL-PET模块,以实现更优的效率与效果平衡。我们进一步提出轻量级设计,以增强编码器的VL对齐与建模能力,并保持解码器的文本生成能力。在四个图像-文本任务和四个视频-文本任务上进行的大量实验验证了我们VL-PET框架的效率、有效性、可扩展性与可迁移性。特别地,我们的VL-PET-large在图像-文本任务中,使用BART-base(T5-base)时,相比全量微调分别提升2.39%(2.61%),相比VL-Adapter分别提升2.92%(3.41%),同时使用更少的可训练参数。此外,我们验证了采用VL-PET设计(如粒度调控机制和轻量级设计)对现有PET技术的增强效果,使它们能够实现显著的性能提升。
abstract_en: As the model size of pre-trained language models (PLMs) grows rapidly, full fine-tuning becomes prohibitively expensive for model training and storage. In vision-and-language (VL), parameter-efficient tuning (PET) techniques are proposed to integrate modular modifications (e.g., Adapter) into encoder-decoder PLMs. By tuning a small set of trainable parameters, these techniques perform on par with full fine-tuning. However, excessive modular modifications and neglecting the unique abilities of the encoders and decoders can lead to performance degradation, while existing PET techniques (e.g., VL-Adapter) overlook these issues. In this paper, we propose a Vision-and-Language Parameter-Efficient Tuning (VL-PET) framework to impose effective control over modular modifications via a novel granularity-controlled mechanism. Considering different granularity-controlled matrices generated by this mechanism, a variety of model-agnostic VL-PET modules can be instantiated from our framework for better efficiency and effectiveness trade-offs. We further propose lightweight designs to enhance VL alignment and modeling for the encoders and maintain text generation for the decoders. Extensive experiments conducted on four image-text tasks and four video-text tasks demonstrate the efficiency, effectiveness, scalability and transferability of our VL-PET framework. In particular, our VL-PET-large significantly outperforms full fine-tuning by 2.39% (2.61%) and VL-Adapter by 2.92% (3.41%) with BART-base (T5-base) on image-text tasks, while utilizing fewer trainable parameters. Furthermore, we validate the enhanced effect of employing our VL-PET designs (e.g., granularity-controlled mechanism and lightweight designs) on existing PET techniques, enabling them to achieve significant performance improvements.
authors: Zi-Yuan Hu, Yanyang Li, Michael R. Lyu, Liwei Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3010-3020

title: VLN-PETL:面向视觉-语言导航的参数高效迁移学习
title_en: VLN-PETL: Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning for Vision-and-Language Navigation
abstract: 得益于大规模预训练视觉-语言模型的应用,视觉-语言导航(VLN)任务的性能近年来取得了快速进展。然而,由于模型规模较大,对每个下游VLN任务进行全量微调的成本正在变得高昂。近期参数高效迁移学习(Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning, PETL)研究热点展现出在通用计算机视觉和自然语言处理任务中高效调优大规模预训练模型的潜力,其核心在于充分利用预训练模型中蕴含的表征知识,仅需微调最小参数集。然而,简单地将现有PETL方法应用于更具挑战性的VLN任务可能导致非微不足道的性能退化。因此,我们首次探索PETL方法在VLN任务中的应用,提出面向VLN的专用PETL方法VLN-PETL。具体而言,我们设计了两个PETL模块:历史交互增强模块(Historical Interaction Booster, HIB)和跨模态交互增强模块(Cross-modal Interaction Booster, CIB)。随后,我们将这两个模块与若干现有PETL方法结合,形成集成化的VLN-PETL框架。在四个主流VLN任务(R2R、REVERIE、NDH、RxR)上的大量实验结果验证了我们提出的VLN-PETL的有效性,其中VLN-PETL在性能上达到与全量微调相当甚至更优的水平,并在与其他PETL方法的对比中展现出显著优势。源代码已开源于https://github.com/YanyuanQiao/VLN-PETL
abstract_en: The performance of the Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) tasks has witnessed rapid progress recently thanks to the use of large pre-trained vision-and-language models. However, full fine-tuning the pre-trained model for every downstream VLN task is becoming costly due to the considerable model size. Recent research hotspot of Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning (PETL) shows great potential in efficiently tuning large pre-trained models for the common CV and NLP tasks, which exploits the most of the representation knowledge implied in the pre-trained model while only tunes a minimal set of parameters. However, simply utilizing existing PETL methods for the more challenging VLN tasks may bring non-trivial degeneration to the performance. Therefore, we present the first study to explore PETL methods for VLN tasks and propose a VLN-specific PETL method named VLN-PETL. Specifically, we design two PETL modules: Historical Interaction Booster (HIB) and Cross-modal Interaction Booster (CIB). Then we combine these two modules with several existing PETL methods as the integrated VLN-PETL. Extensive experimental results on four mainstream VLN tasks (R2R, REVERIE, NDH, RxR) demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed VLN-PETL, where VLN-PETL achieves comparable or even better performance to full fine-tuning and outperforms other PETL methods with promising margins. The source code is available at https://github.com/YanyuanQiao/VLN-PETL
authors: Yanyuan Qiao, Zheng Yu, Qi Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15443-15452

title: VLSlice:交互式视觉-语言子群发现系统
title_en: VLSlice: Interactive Vision-and-Language Slice Discovery
abstract: 近期视觉-语言领域研究证明,大规模预训练可以学习到可泛化且能高效迁移至下游任务的模型。尽管这可能提升数据集规模的聚合指标,但分析针对特定偏差维度的手工构建子群的性能表现,却揭示了系统性不良行为。然而,这种子群分析常因标注工作而受阻,其需要大量时间和资源收集必要数据。现有方法尝试自动发现子群以规避这些限制,但通常依赖于现有任务特定标注下的模型行为,并在超出"表格数据"的复杂输入上迅速退化,且均未研究视觉-语言模型。本文提出VLSlice,一个交互式系统,使用户能够引导发现具有一致视觉-语言行为的连贯表征级子群(称为视觉-语言切片),从未标注图像集中。我们展示VLSlice在用户研究(n=22)中使用户快速生成多样且高连贯性的切片,并公开发布该工具。
abstract_en: Recent work in vision-and-language demonstrates that large-scale pretraining can learn generalizable models that are efficiently transferable to downstream tasks. While this may improve dataset-scale aggregate metrics, analyzing performance around hand-crafted subgroups targeting specific bias dimensions reveals systemic undesirable behaviors. However, this subgroup analysis is frequently stalled by annotation efforts, which require extensive time and resources to collect the necessary data. Prior art attempts to automatically discover subgroups to circumvent these constraints but typically leverages model behavior on existing task-specific annotations and rapidly degrades on more complex inputs beyond "tabular" data, none of which study vision-and-language models. This paper presents VLSlice, an interactive system enabling user-guided discovery of coherent representation-level subgroups with consistent visiolinguistic behavior, denoted as vision-and-language slices, from unlabeled image sets. We show that VLSlice enables users to quickly generate diverse high-coherency slices in a user study (n=22) and release the tool publicly.
authors: Eric Slyman, Minsuk Kahng, Stefan Lee ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15291-15301

title: VQ3D:在ImageNet上学习三维感知生成模型
title_en: VQ3D: Learning a 3D-Aware Generative Model on ImageNet
abstract: 近期研究表明,可以从包含单个物体类别的小数据集(如人脸、动物脸或汽车)的2D图像集合中训练生成3D内容的模型。然而,这些模型在更大、更复杂的数据集上表现不佳。为建模如ImageNet这样的多样化且无约束的图像集合,我们提出VQ3D,其将基于NeRF的解码器引入两阶段向量量化自编码器。我们的第一阶段支持输入图像的重建及围绕图像的相机位置变化,第二阶段则能够生成新的3D场景。VQ3D可从包含120万张训练图像的1000类ImageNet数据集中生成和重建三维感知图像,并取得16.8的ImageNet生成FID分数。
abstract_en: Recent work has shown the possibility of training generative models of 3D content from 2D image collections on small datasets corresponding to a single object class, such as human faces, animal faces, or cars. However, these models struggle on larger, more complex datasets. To model diverse and unconstrained image collections such as ImageNet, we present VQ3D, which introduces a NeRF-based decoder into a two-stage vector-quantized autoencoder. Our Stage 1 allows for the reconstruction of an input image and the ability to change the camera position around the image, and our Stage 2 allows for the generation of new 3D scenes. VQ3D is capable of generating and reconstructing 3D-aware images from the 1000-class ImageNet dataset of 1.2 million training images, and achieves a competitive ImageNet generation FID score of 16.8.
authors: Kyle Sargent, Jing Yu Koh, Han Zhang, Huiwen Chang, Charles Herrmann, Pratul Srinivasan, Jiajun Wu, Deqing Sun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4240-4250

title: VQA疗法:通过视觉 grounding 探索答案差异
title_en: VQA Therapy: Exploring Answer Differences by Visually Grounding Answers
abstract: 视觉问答是预测针对图像问题的答案的任务。鉴于不同的人对视觉问题可能提供不同的答案,我们旨在通过答案 grounding 更好地理解其原因。我们引入了首个对每个视觉问题的每个独特答案进行视觉 grounding 的数据集,我们称之为VQAAnswerTherapy。随后,我们提出了两个新问题:预测视觉问题是否具有单一答案 grounding,以及定位所有答案 grounding。我们对这些新问题的现代算法进行基准测试,以展示其成功与不足之处。该数据集和评估服务器可在https://vizwiz.org/tasks-and-datasets/vqa-answer-therapy/公开获取。
abstract_en: Visual question answering is a task of predicting the answer to a question about an image. Given that different people can provide different answers to a visual question, we aim to better understand why with answer groundings. We introduce the first dataset that visually grounds each unique answer to each visual question, which we call VQAAnswerTherapy. We then propose two novel problems of predicting whether a visual question has a single answer grounding and localizing all answer groundings. We benchmark modern algorithms for these novel problems to show where they succeed and struggle. The dataset and evaluation server can be found publicly at https://vizwiz.org/tasks-and-datasets/vqa-answer-therapy/.
authors: Chongyan Chen, Samreen Anjum, Danna Gurari ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15315-15325

title: VQA-GNN:基于图神经网络的多模态知识推理用于视觉问答
title_en: VQA-GNN: Reasoning with Multimodal Knowledge via Graph Neural Networks for Visual Question Answering
abstract: 视觉问答(VQA)要求系统通过统一非结构化(例如,问题与答案中的上下文;"QA上下文")和结构化(例如,QA上下文和场景的知识图谱;"概念图")多模态知识来执行概念级推理。现有方法通常通过连接相应的视觉节点和概念节点,将场景图与概念图结合,然后引入QA上下文表示进行问答。然而,这些方法仅从非结构化知识向结构化知识进行单向融合,限制了其在异构模态知识联合推理中的潜力。为了实现更强大的推理能力,我们提出VQA-GNN,这是一种新的VQA模型,通过在非结构化和结构化多模态知识之间进行双向融合,获取统一的知识表示。具体而言,我们通过一个代表QA上下文的超级节点将场景图与概念图互联,并引入一种新的多模态GNN技术,执行跨模态信息传递以进行推理,缓解模态间的表征差距。在两个具有挑战性的VQA任务(VCR和GQA)上,我们的方法在VCR(Q-AR)任务中超越了强大的基线VQA方法3.2%,在GQA任务中超越4.6%,表明其在概念级推理方面的优势。消融研究进一步验证了双向融合和多模态GNN方法在统一非结构化与结构化多模态知识中的有效性。
abstract_en: Visual question answering (VQA) requires systems to perform concept-level reasoning by unifying unstructured (e.g., the context in question and answer; "QA context") and structured (e.g., knowledge graph for the QA context and scene; "concept graph") multimodal knowledge. Existing works typically combine a scene graph and a concept graph of the scene by connecting corresponding visual nodes and concept nodes, then incorporate the QA context representation to perform question answering. However, these methods only perform a unidirectional fusion from unstructured knowledge to structured knowledge, limiting their potential to capture joint reasoning over the heterogeneous modalities of knowledge. To perform more expressive reasoning, we propose VQA-GNN, a new VQA model that performs bidirectional fusion between unstructured and structured multimodal knowledge to obtain unified knowledge representations. Specifically, we inter-connect the scene graph and the concept graph through a super node that represents the QA context, and introduce a new multimodal GNN technique to perform inter-modal message passing for reasoning that mitigates representational gaps between modalities. On two challenging VQA tasks (VCR and GQA), our method outperforms strong baseline VQA methods by 3.2% on VCR (Q-AR) and 4.6% on GQA, suggesting its strength in performing concept-level reasoning. Ablation studies further demonstrate the efficacy of the bidirectional fusion and multimodal GNN method in unifying unstructured and structured multimodal knowledge.
authors: Yanan Wang, Michihiro Yasunaga, Hongyu Ren, Shinya Wada, Jure Leskovec ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21582-21592

title: 基于先验重力方向的未校准图像消失点估计
title_en: Vanishing Point Estimation in Uncalibrated Images with Prior Gravity Direction
abstract: 我们利用先验垂直方向解决未校准图像中曼哈顿框架(即三个正交消失点)和未知相机焦距的估计问题。该方向可来自惯性测量单元(IMU),这是近期消费类设备(如智能手机)的标准组件。我们对最小线配置进行了详尽分析,推导出两种新的双线求解器,其中一种避免了影响现有求解器的奇异性。此外,我们设计了一种新的非最小方法,可在任意数量的线基础上运行,以提升局部优化性能。通过将所有求解器结合到混合鲁棒估计器中,即使在粗略先验条件下,我们的方法也实现了更高的精度。在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上的实验表明,与现有方法相比,我们的方法在精度上具有优势,同时保持相近的运行时间。我们进一步展示了所提出求解器在相对旋转估计中的适用性。代码可在https://github.com/cvg/VP-Estimation-with-Prior-Gravity获取。
abstract_en: We tackle the problem of estimating a Manhattan frame, i.e. three orthogonal vanishing points, and the unknown focal length of the camera, leveraging a prior vertical direction. The direction can come from an Inertial Measurement Unit that is a standard component of recent consumer devices, e.g., smartphones. We provide an exhaustive analysis of minimal line configurations and derive two new 2-line solvers, one of which does not suffer from singularities affecting existing solvers. Additionally, we design a new non-minimal method, running on an arbitrary number of lines, to boost the performance in local optimization. Combining all solvers in a hybrid robust estimator, our method achieves increased accuracy even with a rough prior. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the superior accuracy of our method compared to the state of the art, while having comparable runtimes. We further demonstrate the applicability of our solvers for relative rotation estimation. The code is available at https://github.com/cvg/VP-Estimation-with-Prior-Gravity.
authors: Rémi Pautrat, Shaohui Liu, Petr Hruby, Marc Pollefeys, Daniel Barath ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 14118-14127

title: 基于变分因果推理网络的解释性视觉问答
title_en: Variational Causal Inference Network for Explanatory Visual Question Answering
abstract: 解释性视觉问答(EVQA)是一种新兴的多模态推理任务,要求回答视觉问题并生成多模态解释以说明推理过程。与仅关注回答的传统视觉问答(VQA)不同,EVQA旨在提供用户友好的解释,以增强推理模型的可解释性和可信度。然而,现有EVQA方法通常分别预测答案和解释,忽略了二者间的因果关联。此外,它们忽视了问题词、视觉区域和解释标记之间的复杂关系。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种变分因果推理网络(VCIN),建立预测答案与解释间的因果关联,并捕捉跨模态关系以生成合理解释。首先,我们利用视觉-语言预训练模型提取视觉特征和问题特征。其次,我们提出多模态解释门控变压器,构建跨模态关系并生成合理解释。最后,我们提出变分因果推理以建立目标因果结构并预测答案。全面实验表明,VCIN在现有EVQA方法中具有优越性。
abstract_en: Explanatory Visual Question Answering (EVQA) is a recently proposed multimodal reasoning task that requires answering visual questions and generating multimodal explanations for the reasoning processes. Unlike traditional Visual Question Answering (VQA) which focuses solely on answering, EVQA aims to provide user-friendly explanations to enhance the explainability and credibility of reasoning models. However, existing EVQA methods typically predict the answer and explanation separately, which ignores the causal correlation between them. Moreover, they neglect the complex relationships among question words, visual regions, and explanation tokens. To address these issues, we propose a Variational Causal Inference Network (VCIN) that establishes the causal correlation between predicted answers and explanations, and captures cross-modal relationships to generate rational explanations. First, we utilize a vision-and-language pretrained model to extract visual features and question features. Secondly, we propose a multimodal explanation gating transformer that constructs cross-modal relationships and generates rational explanations. Finally, we propose a variational causal inference to establish the target causal structure and predict the answers. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of VCIN over state-of-the-art EVQA methods.
authors: Dizhan Xue, Shengsheng Qian, Changsheng Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2515-2525

title: 变分退化到结构细化:叠加图像分解的统一框架
title_en: Variational Degeneration to Structural Refinement: A Unified Framework for Superimposed Image Decomposition
abstract: 将单张混合图像分解为个体图像层是图像修复领域经典任务类别的核心问题。已有多个统一框架被提出以处理叠加图像分解中的不同退化类型。然而,在处理复杂退化模式时,分离出的图像仍存在不期望的结构失真。本文提出了一种统一框架,能够自适应处理复杂的退化模式。考虑到各层之间的不同混合模式,我们在潜在空间中引入退化表示以挖掘叠加图像与退化模式之间的内在关系。此外,通过从叠加图像中提取结构引导知识,我们进一步提出结构引导细化方法以避免因结构失真导致的混淆内容。大量实验表明,我们的方法在图像分离任务中显著优于其他流行框架。该方法在图像去雨、图像反光去除和图像阴影去除等相关应用中也取得了具有竞争力的结果,验证了框架的泛化能力。
abstract_en: Decomposing a single mixed image into individual image layers is the common crux of a classical category of tasks in image restoration. Several unified frameworks have been proposed that can handle different types of degradation in superimposed image decomposition. However, there are always undesired structural distortions in the separated images when dealing with complicated degradation patterns. In this paper, we propose a unified framework for superimposed image decomposition that can cope with intricate degradation patterns adaptively. Considering the different mixing patterns between the layers, we introduce a degeneration representation in the latent space to mine the intrinsic relationship between the superimposed image and the degeneration pattern. Moreover, by extracting structure-guided knowledge from the superimposed image, we further propose structural guidance refinement to avoid confusing content caused by structure distortion. Extensive experiments have demonstrated that our method remarkably outperforms other popular image separation frameworks. The method also achieves competitive results on related applications including image deraining, image reflection removal, and image shadow removal, which validates the generalization of the framework.
authors: Wenyu Li, Yan Xu, Yang Yang, Haoran Ji, Yue Lang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12206-12216

title: VeRi3D: 基于顶点的生成辐射场用于三维可控人体图像合成
title_en: VeRi3D: Generative Vertex-based Radiance Fields for 3D Controllable Human Image Synthesis
abstract: 近期三维感知生成对抗网络的无监督学习取得了显著进展。一些最新工作展示了利用神经结构化辐射场学习人体生成模型的有前景结果,但其泛化能力与可控性仍落后于参数化人体模型,即在推广到新颖姿态/形状时表现不佳,且不具备部分可控性。为解决这些问题,我们提出VeRi3D,一种基于顶点的生成人体辐射场,其参数化基于参数化人体模板SMPL的顶点。我们将每个三维点映射到其邻近顶点定义的局部坐标系,并利用对应的顶点特征和局部坐标将其映射到颜色和密度值。我们证明,我们的简单方法能够生成逼真的人体图像,并实现对相机姿态、人体姿态、形状的自由控制,以及支持部件级编辑。
abstract_en: Unsupervised learning of 3D-aware generative adversarial networks has lately made much progress. Some recent work demonstrates promising results of learning human generative models using neural articulated radiance fields, yet their generalization ability and controllability lag behind parametric human models, i.e., they do not perform well when generalizing to novel pose/shape and are not part controllable. To solve these problems, we propose VeRi3D, a generative human vertex-based radiance field parameterized by vertices of the parametric human template, SMPL. We map each 3D point to the local coordinate system defined on its neighboring vertices, and use the corresponding vertex feature and local coordinates for mapping it to color and density values. We demonstrate that our simple approach allows for generating photorealistic human images with free control over camera pose, human pose, shape, as well as enabling part-level editing.
authors: Xinya Chen, Jiaxin Huang, Yanrui Bin, Lu Yu, Yiyi Liao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8986-8997

title: 动词在行动中:提升视频语言模型中的动词理解
title_en: Verbs in Action: Improving Verb Understanding in Video-Language Models
abstract: 理解动词对于建模人与物体如何通过时空与环境互动至关重要。最近,基于CLIP的最先进视频语言模型被证明在动词理解方面存在局限,并且高度依赖名词,这限制了其在需要动作和时间理解的真实视频应用中的表现。在本工作中,我们通过提出一种新的动词聚焦对比(Verb-Focused Contrastive, VFC)框架,来提升基于CLIP的视频语言模型的动词理解能力。该框架包含两个主要组件:(1) 利用预训练大语言模型(LLMs)生成跨模态对比学习的硬负样本,同时结合校准策略以平衡正负样本对中概念的出现频率;(2) 强制实施细粒度的动词短语对齐损失。我们的方法在三个聚焦于动词理解的下游任务(包括视频-文本匹配、视频问答和视频分类)中实现了最先进的零样本性能,同时保持了名词聚焦场景下的表现。据我们所知,这是首个提出缓解动词理解问题的方法,而非仅仅强调该问题。我们的代码已公开可用。
abstract_en: Understanding verbs is crucial to modelling how people and objects interact with each other and the environment through space and time. Recently, state-of-the-art video-language models based on CLIP have been shown to have limited verb understanding and to rely extensively on nouns, restricting their performance in real-world video applications that require action and temporal understanding. In this work, we improve verb understanding for CLIP-based video-language models by proposing a new Verb-Focused Contrastive (VFC) framework. This consists of two main components: (1) leveraging pretrained large language models (LLMs) to create hard negatives for cross-modal contrastive learning, together with a calibration strategy to balance the occurrence of concepts in positive and negative pairs; and (2) enforcing a fine-grained, verb phrase alignment loss. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results for zero-shot performance on three downstream tasks that focus on verb understanding, including video-text matching, video question-answering and video classification; while maintaining performance on noun-focused settings. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work which proposes a method to alleviate the verb understanding problem, and does not simply highlight it. Our code is publicly available.
authors: Liliane Momeni, Mathilde Caron, Arsha Nagrani, Andrew Zisserman, Cordelia Schmid ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15579-15591

title: 多功能扩散:文本、图像与变体一体化扩散模型
title_en: Versatile Diffusion: Text, Images and Variations All in One Diffusion Model
abstract: 近年来扩散模型的进展在许多生成任务中树立了显著的里程碑,热门研究如DALL-E2、Imagen和Stable Diffusion引起了广泛关注。尽管技术发展迅速,近期新方法更侧重于扩展性和性能而非模型容量,因此需要为不同任务单独训练模型。在本工作中,我们将现有的单流扩散流程扩展为多任务多模态网络,命名为多功能扩散(VD),该模型在一个统一框架中处理文本到图像、图像到文本以及变体生成等多流程。VD的流程设计实现了统一的多流扩散框架,包含可共享和可替换的层模块,从而超越图像和文本的跨模态泛化能力。通过大量实验,我们证明VD成功实现了以下目标:a)VD优于基线方法,并以竞争力的质量处理所有基础任务;b)VD支持风格与语义解耦、双上下文及多上下文融合等新型扩展;c)我们的多流多模态框架在图像和文本上的成功可能启发进一步的扩散基础通用人工智能研究。我们的代码和模型已开源,地址为https://github.com/SHI-Labs/Versatile-Diffusion。
abstract_en: Recent advances in diffusion models have set an impressive milestone in many generation tasks, and trending works such as DALL-E2, Imagen, and Stable Diffusion have attracted great interest. Despite the rapid landscape changes, recent new approaches focus on extensions and performance rather than capacity, thus requiring separate models for separate tasks. In this work, we expand the existing single-flow diffusion pipeline into a multi-task multimodal network, dubbed Versatile Diffusion (VD), that handles multiple flows of text-to-image, image-to-text, and variations in one unified model. The pipeline design of VD instantiates a unified multi-flow diffusion framework, consisting of sharable and swappable layer modules that enable the crossmodal generality beyond images and text. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that VD successfully achieves the following: a) VD outperforms the baseline approaches and handles all its base tasks with competitive quality; b) VD enables novel extensions such as disentanglement of style and semantics, dual- and multi-context blending, etc.; c) The success of our multi-flow multimodal framework over images and text may inspire further diffusion-based universal AI research. Our code and models are open-sourced at https://github.com/SHI-Labs/Versatile-Diffusion.
authors: Xingqian Xu, Zhangyang Wang, Gong Zhang, Kai Wang, Humphrey Shi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7754-7765

title: VertexSerum:针对链接推断的图神经网络投毒攻击
title_en: VertexSerum: Poisoning Graph Neural Networks for Link Inference
abstract: 图神经网络(GNNs)在利用图结构数据的各种应用中表现出卓越性能,如社交分析和欺诈检测。图链接(如社交关系和交易历史)是敏感且有价值的信息,使用GNNs时会引发隐私担忧。为利用这些漏洞,我们提出VertexSerum,一种新型图投毒攻击方法,通过放大链接连通性泄露来提升图链接窃取效果。为更准确地推断节点邻接关系,我们提出一种可嵌入到链接检测网络中的注意力机制。实验表明,VertexSerum显著优于现有SOTA链接推断攻击,在四个真实数据集和三种不同GNN结构上平均提升AUC分数9.8%。此外,实验验证了VertexSerum在黑盒和在线学习场景中的有效性,进一步证明其在现实场景中的适用性。
abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) have brought superb performance to various applications utilizing graph structural data, such as social analysis and fraud detection. The graph links, e.g., social relationships and transaction history, are sensitive and valuable information, which raises privacy concerns when using GNNs. To exploit these vulnerabilities, we propose VertexSerum, a novel graph poisoning attack that increases the effectiveness of graph link stealing by amplifying the link connectivity leakage. To infer node adjacency more accurately, we propose an attention mechanism that can be embedded into the link detection network. Our experiments demonstrate that VertexSerum significantly outperforms the SOTA link inference attack, improving the AUC scores by an average of 9.8% across four real-world datasets and three different GNN structures. Furthermore, our experiments reveal the effectiveness of VertexSerum in both black-box and online learning settings, further validating its applicability in real-world scenarios.
authors: Ruyi Ding, Shijin Duan, Xiaolin Xu, Yunsi Fei ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4532-4541

title: ViLLA:从真实世界数据中学习细粒度视觉-语言表示
title_en: ViLLA: Fine-Grained Vision-Language Representation Learning from Real-World Data
abstract: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs),如CLIP和ALIGN,通常是在由网络上获取的图像-描述对组成的语料库上进行训练的。然而,真实世界多模态数据集,如医疗数据,要复杂得多:每张图像(例如X光片)通常与描述图像中细粒度区域中多个不同属性的文本(例如医生报告)配对。我们将这些样本称为具有高成对复杂度,因为每个图像-文本对都可以分解为大量区域-属性配对。VLMs在基于此类数据进行训练时捕捉图像区域与文本属性之间细粒度关系的能力尚未被评估。本工作的第一个关键贡献是通过系统评估证明,随着训练数据集的成对复杂度增加,标准VLMs在学习区域-属性关系时会遇到困难,在检索任务中性能下降高达37%。为了解决这一问题,我们引入ViLLA作为第二个关键贡献。ViLLA是一种从复杂数据集中捕捉细粒度区域-属性关系的模型,包含两个组件:(a) 一个轻量级的自监督映射模型,用于将图像-文本样本分解为区域-属性对;(b) 一个对比学习VLM,从生成的区域-属性对中学习表示。我们在四个领域(合成、产品、医疗和自然图像)的实验表明,ViLLA在细粒度推理任务(如零样本目标检测(在COCO上最高提升3.6 AP50点,在LVIS上最高提升0.6 mAP点)和检索(最高提升14.2 R-Precision点))上优于其他可比的VLMs。
abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs), such as CLIP and ALIGN, are generally trained on datasets consisting of image-caption pairs obtained from the web. However, real-world multimodal datasets, such as healthcare data, are significantly more complex: each image (e.g. X-ray) is often paired with text (e.g. physician report) that describes many distinct attributes occurring in fine-grained regions of the image. We refer to these samples as exhibiting high pairwise complexity, since each image-text pair can be decomposed into a large number of region-attribute pairings. The extent to which VLMs can capture fine-grained relationships between image regions and textual attributes when trained on such data has not been previously evaluated. The first key contribution of this work is to demonstrate through systematic evaluations that as the pairwise complexity of the training dataset increases, standard VLMs struggle to learn region-attribute relationships, exhibiting performance degradations of up to 37% on retrieval tasks. In order to address this issue, we introduce ViLLA as our second key contribution. ViLLA, which is trained to capture fine-grained region-attribute relationships from complex datasets, involves two components: (a) a lightweight, self-supervised mapping model to decompose image-text samples into region-attribute pairs, and (b) a contrastive VLM to learn representations from generated region-attribute pairs. We demonstrate with experiments across four domains (synthetic, product, medical, and natural images) that ViLLA outperforms comparable VLMs on fine-grained reasoning tasks, such as zero-shot object detection (up to 3.6 AP50 points on COCO and 0.6 mAP points on LVIS) and retrieval (up to 14.2 R-Precision points).
authors: Maya Varma, Jean-Benoit Delbrouck, Sarah Hooper, Akshay Chaudhari, Curtis Langlotz ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22225-22235

title: ViLTA:通过文本增强提升视觉-语言预训练
title_en: ViLTA: Enhancing Vision-Language Pre-training through Textual Augmentation
abstract: 视觉-语言预训练(VLP)方法近年来蓬勃发展,其核心目标是通过基于Transformer的架构联合学习视觉与文本特征,在多种视觉-语言任务中展现出显著性能提升。现有研究多聚焦于视觉与文本特征的对齐策略,但提升模型鲁棒性与加速模型收敛的方案仍研究不足。本文提出一种新型方法ViLTA,包含两个组件以进一步促进模型学习图像-文本对的细粒度表示。针对掩码语言建模(MLM),我们提出交叉蒸馏方法生成软标签以增强模型鲁棒性,缓解将掩码词同义词视为one-hot标签负样本的问题。针对图像-文本匹配(ITM),我们利用当前语言编码器基于语言输入上下文合成硬负样本,通过提升ITM任务难度促使模型学习高质量表示。实验表明,ViLTA在多种视觉-语言任务中均取得更优性能。在基准数据集上的大量实验验证了ViLTA的有效性及其在视觉-语言预训练中的广阔前景。
abstract_en:
Vision-language pre-training (VLP) methods are blossoming recently, and its crucial goal is to jointly learn visual and textual features via a transformer-based architecture, demonstrating promising improvements on a variety of vision-language tasks. Prior arts usually focus on how to align visual and textual features, but strategies for improving the robustness of model and speeding up model convergence are left insufficiently explored.
 
 In this paper, we propose a novel method ViLTA, comprising of two components to further facilitate the model to learn fine-grained representations among image-text pairs. For Masked Language Modeling (MLM), we propose a cross-distillation method to generate soft labels to enhance the robustness of model, which alleviates the problem of treating synonyms of masked words as negative samples in one-hot labels. For Image-Text Matching (ITM), we leverage the current language encoder to synthesize hard negatives based on the context of language input, encouraging the model to learn high-quality representations by increasing the difficulty of the ITM task. By leveraging the above techniques, our ViLTA can achieve better performance on various vision-language tasks. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that the effectiveness of ViLTA and its promising potential for vision-language pre-training.
authors: Weihan Wang, Zhen Yang, Bin Xu, Juanzi Li, Yankui Sun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3158-3169

title: ViM:面向统一下游迁移的视觉中间件
title_en: ViM: Vision Middleware for Unified Downstream Transferring
abstract: 基础模型是在大量数据上预训练的,并通过微调转移到下游任务中。本文提出了一种新的学习范式——视觉中间件(ViM),旨在实现从单一基础模型到多种下游任务的统一迁移。ViM由一组轻量级插件模块组成,每个模块均独立地在中游数据集上进行训练,共享一个冻结的主干网络。由于从中游任务继承了丰富的知识,下游任务可以通过对模块集合的充分聚合而受益。这种设计具有三大优势。从效率角度,上游主干网络只需训练一次,即可无需调整地重复用于所有下游任务。从可扩展性角度,我们可以轻松地向ViM添加额外模块,且不会影响现有模块。从性能角度,ViM可以包含尽可能多的中游任务,从而缩小上游与下游任务之间的差距。考虑到这些优势,我们认为ViM作为一种社区可以共同维护和发展的工具,将为基础模型提供强大的辅助作用。
abstract_en: Foundation models are pre-trained on massive data and transferred to downstream tasks via fine-tuning. This work presents Vision Middleware (ViM), a new learning paradigm that targets unified transferring from a single foundation model to a variety of downstream tasks. ViM consists of a zoo of lightweight plug-in modules, each of which is independently learned on a midstream dataset with a shared frozen backbone. Downstream tasks can then benefit from an adequate aggregation of the module zoo thanks to the rich knowledge inherited from midstream tasks. There are three major advantages of such a design. From the efficiency aspect, the upstream backbone can be trained only once and reused for all downstream tasks without tuning. From the scalability aspect, we can easily append additional modules to ViM with no influence on existing modules. From the performance aspect, ViM can include as many midstream tasks as possible, narrowing the task gap between upstream and downstream. Considering these benefits, we believe that ViM, which the community could maintain and develop together, would serve as a powerful tool to assist foundation models.
authors: Yutong Feng, Biao Gong, Jianwen Jiang, Yiliang Lv, Yujun Shen, Deli Zhao, Jingren Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11696-11707

title: VidStyleODE:基于StyleGAN与神经微分方程的解耦视频编辑
title_en: VidStyleODE: Disentangled Video Editing via StyleGAN and NeuralODEs
abstract: 我们提出VidStyleODE,这是一种基于StyleGAN和神经微分方程的时空连续解耦视频表示方法。有效的潜在空间遍历是近期图像编辑领域突破的基础。然而,此类进展在视频领域的应用受到在GANs潜在空间中表示和控制视频的困难的阻碍。特别是,视频由内容(即外观)和复杂运动成分组成,需要特殊机制进行解耦和控制。为实现这一目标,VidStyleODE将视频内容编码到预训练的StyleGAN W+空间,并利用潜在ODE组件总结输入视频的时空动态。我们的新型连续视频生成过程将两者结合,生成高质量且时间一致的视频,支持不同帧率。我们证明所提方法在真实视频上实现了多种应用:文本引导的外观操控、运动操控、图像动画以及视频插值与外推。
abstract_en: We propose VidStyleODE, a spatiotemporally continuous disentangled video representation based upon StyleGAN and Neural-ODEs. Effective traversal of the latent space learned by Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) has been the basis for recent breakthroughs in image editing. However, the applicability of such advancements to the video domain has been hindered by the difficulty of representing and controlling videos in the latent space of GANs. In particular, videos are composed of content (i.e., appearance) and complex motion components that require a special mechanism to disentangle and control. To achieve this, VidStyleODE encodes the video content in a pre-trained StyleGAN W+ space and benefits from a latent ODE component to summarize the spatiotemporal dynamics of the input video. Our novel continuous video generation process then combines the two to generate high-quality and temporally consistent videos with varying frame rates. We show that our proposed method enables a variety of applications on real videos: text-guided appearance manipulation, motion manipulation, image animation, and video interpolation and extrapolation.
authors: Moayed Haji Ali, Andrew Bond, Tolga Birdal, Duygu Ceylan, Levent Karacan, Erkut Erdem, Aykut Erdem ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 7523-7534

title: 基于注意力语义单元的视频动作识别
title_en: Video Action Recognition with Attentive Semantic Units
abstract: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)显著推动了视频动作识别的发展。通过动作标签的语义进行监督,近期研究通过调整VLMs的视觉分支来学习视频表示。尽管这些方法已证明其有效性,但我们认为VLMs的潜力尚未被充分挖掘。为此,我们利用动作标签背后隐藏的语义单元(SU),并借助其与帧中细粒度项的相关性以实现更精确的动作识别。SU是从整个动作集的语言描述中提取的实体,包括身体部位、物体、场景和动作。为进一步增强视觉内容与SU之间的对齐,我们在VLMs的视觉分支中引入了多区域模块(MRA)。MRA使模型能够感知超越原始全局特征的区域感知视觉特征。我们的方法通过视觉特征自适应关注并选择相关SU。借助跨模态解码器,所选SU用于解码时空视频表示。总体而言,SU作为中介可提升判别能力和迁移能力。具体而言,在全监督学习中,我们的方法在Kinetics-400数据集上达到87.8%的Top-1准确率。在K=2少样本实验中,我们的方法在HMDB-51和UCF-101数据集上分别超越先前最先进方法7.1%和15.0%。
abstract_en: Visual-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly advanced video action recognition. Supervised by the semantics of action labels, recent works adapt the visual branch of VLMs to learn video representations. Despite the effectiveness proved by these works, we believe that the potential of VLMs has yet to be fully harnessed. In light of this, we exploit the semantic units (SU) hiding behind the action labels and leverage their correlations with fine-grained items in frames for more accurate action recognition. SUs are entities extracted from the language descriptions of the entire action set, including body parts, objects, scenes, and motions. To further enhance the alignments between visual contents and the SUs, we introduce a multi-region module (MRA) to the visual branch of the VLM. The MRA allows the perception of region-aware visual features beyond the original global feature. Our method adaptively attends to and selects relevant SUs with visual features of frames. With a cross-modal decoder, the selected SUs serve to decode spatiotemporal video representations. In summary, the SUs as the medium can boost discriminative ability and transferability. Specifically, in fully-supervised learning, our method achieved 87.8% top-1 accuracy on Kinetics-400. In K=2 few-shot experiments, our method surpassed the previous state-of-the-art by +7.1% and +15.0% on HMDB-51 and UCF-101, respectively.
authors: Yifei Chen, Dapeng Chen, Ruijin Liu, Hao Li, Wei Peng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10170-10180

title: 基于上下文细化时间关键点的视频动作分割
title_en: Video Action Segmentation via Contextually Refined Temporal Keypoints
abstract: 视频动作分割是指将未剪辑视频中的每个视频帧或短片段密集地映射到预定义的动作类别中。尽管近年来动作分割技术取得了显著进展,但大量现有方法仍依赖帧级分割,容易导致碎片化结果(即过分割)。为有效解决上述问题,本文提出了一种视频动作分割模型,通过引入新型的细化时间关键点(Refined Temporal Keypoints, RTK)方法克服现有方法的局限性。为实现有效分割,该模型首先通过提取视频中的非局部线索,而非像许多竞争方法那样进行帧级分类,寻找高质量、稀疏的时间关键点。随后,通过进一步细化和重组操作,对初始时间关键点进行显著改进,并将其作为主要贡献。具体而言,我们开发了一个图匹配模块,通过学习时间源图与标注目标图之间的对应关系,聚合不同时间关键点间的结构信息。初始时间关键点通过图匹配模块编码的结构信息进行细化。此外,我们利用一组先验规则对所有时间关键点进行后处理和重组。经过所有细化步骤后剩余的时间关键点用于生成最终的动作分割结果。我们在三个流行数据集(50salads、GTEA 和 Breakfast)上进行了实验,结果表明我们的方法显著优于现有方法,尤其在三个数据集上分别取得了83.4%、79.5%和60.5%的F1@50分数,达到当前最优水平。
abstract_en: Video action segmentation refers to the task of densely casting each video frame or short segment in an untrimmed video into some pre-specified action categories. Although recent years have witnessed a great promise in the development of action segmentation techniques.A large body of existing methods still rely on frame-wise segmentation, which tends to render fragmentary results (i.e., over-segmentation).To effectively address above issues, we here propose a video action segmentation model that implements the novel idea of Refined Temporal Keypoints (RTK) for overcoming caveats of existing methods.To act effectively, the proposed model initially seeks for high-quality, sparse temporal keypoints by extracting non-local cues from the video, rather than conducting frame-wise classification as in many competing methods.Afterwards, large improvements over the inital temporal keypoints are pin-pointed as contributions by further refining and re-assembling operations. In specific, we develop a graph matching module that aggregates structural information between different temporal keypoints by learning the corresponding relationship of the temporal source graphs and the annotated target graphs. The initial temporal keypoints are refined by the encoded structural information reusing the graph matching module.A few set of prior rules are harnessed for post-processing and re-assembling all temporal keypoints.The remaining temporal keypoiting going through all refinement are used to generate the final action segmentation results.We perform experiments on three popular datasets: 50salads, GTEA and Breakfast, and our methods significantly outperforms the current methods, particularly achieves the state-of-the-art F1@50 scores of 83.4%, 79.5%, and 60.5% on three datasets, respectively.
authors: Borui Jiang, Yang Jin, Zhentao Tan, Yadong Mu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13836-13845

title: 基于天气信使与对抗性反向传播的视频恶劣天气成分抑制网络
title_en: Video Adverse-Weather-Component Suppression Network via Weather Messenger and Adversarial Backpropagation
abstract: 尽管卷积神经网络(CNN)已被提出用于通过单一预训练权重集去除单张图像中的恶劣天气条件,但由于缺乏时序信息,它们无法恢复天气视频。此外,现有去除视频中恶劣天气条件(如雨、雾和雪)的方法只能处理单一类型的恶劣天气。在本工作中,我们提出了首个能够从所有恶劣天气条件中恢复视频的框架,即视频恶劣天气成分抑制网络(ViWS-Net)。为此,我们首先设计了一个天气无关的视频Transformer编码器,包含多个Transformer阶段。此外,我们设计了长短期时序建模机制用于天气信使,以早期融合输入相邻视频帧并学习天气特定信息。我们进一步引入了带有梯度反转的天气判别器,通过对抗性预测天气类型,以保持天气不变的公共信息并抑制像素特征中的天气特定信息。最后,我们开发了由信使驱动的视频Transformer解码器,以检索残余天气特定特征,该特征与分层像素特征在时空上聚合并优化,以预测输入视频的干净目标帧。在基准数据集和真实世界天气视频上的实验结果表明,我们的ViWS-Net在恢复任何天气条件退化的视频方面均优于当前最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Although convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have been proposed to remove adverse weather conditions in single images using a single set of pre-trained weights, they fail to restore weather videos due to the absence of temporal information. Furthermore, existing methods for removing adverse weather conditions (e.g., rain, fog, and snow) from videos can only handle one type of adverse weather. In this work, we propose the first framework for restoring videos from all adverse weather conditions by developing a video adverse-weather-component suppression network (ViWS-Net). To achieve this, we first devise a weather-agnostic video transformer encoder with multiple transformer stages. Moreover, we design a long short-term temporal modeling mechanism for weather messenger to early fuse input adjacent video frames and learn weather-specific information. We further introduce a weather discriminator with gradient reversion, to maintain the weather-invariant common information and suppress the weather-specific information in pixel features, by adversarially predicting weather types. Finally, we develop a messenger-driven video transformer decoder to retrieve the residual weather-specific feature, which is spatiotemporally aggregated with hierarchical pixel features and refined to predict the clean target frame of input videos. Experimental results, on benchmark datasets and real-world weather videos, demonstrate that our ViWS-Net outperforms current state-of-the-art methods in terms of restoring videos degraded by any weather condition.
authors: Yijun Yang, Angelica I. Aviles-Rivero, Huazhu Fu, Ye Liu, Weiming Wang, Lei Zhu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13200-13210

title: 通过按顺序学习多个预训练任务的视频异常检测
title_en: Video Anomaly Detection via Sequentially Learning Multiple Pretext Tasks
abstract: 学习多个预训练任务是解决无监督视频异常检测中非对齐问题的流行方法。然而,传统的同时学习多个预训练任务的方法容易陷入次优解,导致性能显著下降。本文提出根据预训练任务的难度按升序顺序学习多个预训练任务,以提升异常检测性能。核心思想是通过早期阶段先学习简单的预训练任务来放松学习目标,随后逐步引入更具挑战性的预训练任务以精细化学习目标。这样,我们的方法能够降低学习难度并避免收敛到次优解。具体而言,我们为三个广泛使用的预训练任务设计了定制化的顺序学习顺序:首先进行帧预测任务,随后进行帧重建任务,最后进行帧顺序分类任务。我们进一步引入了一种新的对比损失,通过将正常样本与伪异常样本分开,使学习到的正常性表示更具判别性。在三个数据集上的大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Learning multiple pretext tasks is a popular approach to tackle the nonalignment problem in unsupervised video anomaly detection. However, the conventional learning method of simultaneously learning multiple pretext tasks, is prone to sub-optimal solutions, incurring sharp performance drops. In this paper, we propose to sequentially learn multiple pretext tasks according to their difficulties in an ascending manner to improve the performance of anomaly detection. The core idea is to relax the learning objective by starting with easy pretext tasks in the early stage and gradually refine it by involving more challenging pretext tasks later on. In this way, our method is able to reduce the difficulties of learning and avoid converging to sub-optimal solutions. Specifically, we design a tailored sequential learning order for three widely-used pretext tasks. It starts with frame prediction task, then moves on to frame reconstruction task and last ends with frame-order classification task. We further introduce a new contrastive loss which makes the learned representations of normality more discriminative by pushing normal and pseudo-abnormal samples apart. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
authors: Chenrui Shi, Che Sun, Yuwei Wu, Yunde Jia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10330-10340

title: 视频背景音乐生成:数据集、方法与评估
title_en: Video Background Music Generation: Dataset, Method and Evaluation
abstract: 音乐在视频编辑中至关重要,但手动选择音乐既困难又耗时。因此,我们寻求在给定视频输入的情况下自动生成背景音乐轨道。这是一个具有挑战性的任务,因为它需要音乐视频数据集、高效的视频到音乐生成架构以及合理的评估指标,而这些目前都不存在。为了解决这一问题,我们引入了一个完整的解决方案,包括数据集、基准模型和评估指标。我们提出了SymMV,一个包含多种音乐注释的视频和符号音乐数据集。据我们所知,这是首个具有丰富音乐注释的视频-音乐数据集。我们还提出了一种名为V-MusProd的基准视频背景音乐生成框架,该框架利用和声、旋律和伴奏的音乐先验知识,以及语义、颜色和运动特征的视频-音乐关系。为了解决视频-音乐对应性缺乏客观评估指标的问题,我们设计了一种基于检索的评估指标VMCP,该指标建立在强大的视频-音乐表示学习模型之上。实验表明,使用我们的数据集,V-MusProd在音乐质量和与视频的对应性方面均优于现有最先进的方法。我们相信,我们的数据集、基准模型和评估指标将推动视频背景音乐生成的发展。我们的数据集和代码可在https://github.com/zhuole1025/SymMV获取。
abstract_en: Music is essential when editing videos, but selecting music manually is difficult and time-consuming. Thus, we seek to automatically generate background music tracks given video input. This is a challenging task since it requires music-video datasets, efficient architectures for video-to-music generation, and reasonable metrics, none of which currently exist. To close this gap, we introduce a complete recipe including dataset, benchmark model, and evaluation metric for video background music generation. We present SymMV, a video and symbolic music dataset with various musical annotations. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first video-music dataset with rich musical annotations. We also propose a benchmark video background music generation framework named V-MusProd, which utilizes music priors of chords, melody, and accompaniment along with video-music relations of semantic, color, and motion features. To address the lack of objective metrics for video-music correspondence, we design a retrieval-based metric VMCP built upon a powerful video-music representation learning model. Experiments show that with our dataset, V-MusProd outperforms the state-of-the-art method in both music quality and correspondence with videos. We believe our dataset, benchmark model, and evaluation metric will boost the development of video background music generation. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/zhuole1025/SymMV.
authors: Le Zhuo, Zhaokai Wang, Baisen Wang, Yue Liao, Chenxi Bao, Stanley Peng, Songhao Han, Aixi Zhang, Fei Fang, Si Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15637-15647

title: Video OWL-ViT: 视频中的时间一致开放世界定位
title_en: Video OWL-ViT: Temporally-consistent Open-world Localization in Video
abstract: 我们提出了一种架构和训练方案,将预训练的开放世界图像模型适配到视频定位任务中。理解开放视觉世界(不受固定标签空间的约束)对于许多现实世界的视觉任务至关重要。近期在大规模图像-文本数据集上的对比预训练已显著提升了图像级任务的性能。对于需要更结构化处理的对象定位任务,应用预训练模型更具挑战性。这在视频任务中尤为明显,因为任务特定数据有限。我们通过构建在OWL-ViT开放词汇检测模型基础上,添加Transformer解码器来实现开放世界模型的成功迁移。该解码器通过时间递归传播对象表示,利用当前帧的输出标记作为下一帧的对象查询。我们的模型可端到端训练视频数据,在时间一致性方面优于基于检测的跟踪基线方法,同时保留了主干检测器的开放世界能力。我们在具有挑战性的TAO-OW基准上评估了该模型,证明了从大规模图像-文本预训练中学习的开放世界能力可以成功迁移至多样化视频的开放世界定位任务。
abstract_en: We present an architecture and a training recipe that adapts pretrained open-world image models to localization in videos. Understanding the open visual world (without being constrained by fixed label spaces) is crucial for many real-world vision tasks. Contrastive pre-training on large image-text datasets has recently led to significant improvements for image-level tasks. For more structured tasks involving object localization applying pre-trained models is more challenging. This is particularly true for video tasks, where task-specific data is limited. We show successful transfer of open-world models by building on the OWL-ViT open-vocabulary detection model and adapting it to video by adding a transformer decoder. The decoder propagates object representations recurrently through time by using the output tokens for one frame as the object queries for the next. Our model is end-to-end trainable on video data and enjoys improved temporal consistency compared to tracking-by-detection baselines, while retaining the open-world capabilities of the backbone detector. We evaluate our model on the challenging TAO-OW benchmark and demonstrate that open-world capabilities, learned from large-scale image-text pretraining, can be transferred successfully to open-world localization across diverse videos.
authors: Georg Heigold, Matthias Minderer, Alexey Gritsenko, Alex Bewley, Daniel Keysers, Mario Lučić, Fisher Yu, Thomas Kipf ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13802-13811

title: 视频对象分割感知的视频帧插值
title_en: Video Object Segmentation-aware Video Frame Interpolation
abstract: 视频帧插值(VFI)是一个非常活跃的研究领域,因其在许多应用中的广泛适用性,包括视频增强、视频编码和慢动作效果。通过提高具有遮挡、大运动和动态纹理等挑战性序列的整体图像质量,VFI方法取得了进展。这一主流研究方向忽视了前景和背景区域在感知图像质量中的不同重要性。此外,运动对象的精确合成在计算机视觉应用中可能至关重要。在本文中,我们提出了一种视频对象分割(VOS)感知的训练框架,称为VOS-VFI,使VFI模型能够以更精确的对象边界进行帧插值。具体而言,我们利用VOS作为辅助任务,通过提供额外的损失函数(包括分割损失和双向一致性损失)来帮助训练VFI模型。从大量实验中,我们证明VOS-VFI可以通过生成清晰的对象边界提升现有VFI模型的性能。此外,VOS-VFI在多个基准测试中展示了其有效性,适用于不同的应用,包括视频对象分割、对象姿态估计和视觉跟踪。
abstract_en: Video frame interpolation (VFI) is a very active research topic due to its broad applicability to many applications, including video enhancement, video encoding, and slow-motion effects. VFI methods have been advanced by improving the overall image quality for challenging sequences containing occlusions, large motion, and dynamic texture. This mainstream research direction neglects that foreground and background regions have different importance in perceptual image quality. Moreover, accurate synthesis of moving objects can be of utmost importance in computer vision applications. In this paper, we propose a video object segmentation (VOS)-aware training framework called VOS-VFI that allows VFI models to interpolate frames with more precise object boundaries. Specifically, we exploit VOS as an auxiliary task to help train VFI models by providing additional loss functions, including segmentation loss and bi-directional consistency loss. From extensive experiments, we demonstrate that VOS-VFI can boost the performance of existing VFI models by rendering clear object boundaries. Moreover, VOS-VFI displays its effectiveness on multiple benchmarks for different applications, including video object segmentation, object pose estimation, and visual tracking.
authors: Jun-Sang Yoo, Hongjae Lee, Seung-Won Jung ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 12322-12333

title: 视频状态变化物体分割
title_en: Video State-Changing Object Segmentation
abstract: 日常物体通常会经历状态变化。例如,切黄瓜会使其状态从完整变为切片。在视频物体分割(VOS)中学习物体状态变化对于理解并交互于视觉世界至关重要。传统VOS基准测试未考虑这一具有挑战性但至关重要的问题。本文首次提出视频状态变化物体分割(VSCOS)的弱监督基准测试。我们通过从现有数据集中选取状态变化视频构建VSCOS基准测试。为倡导一种标注效率高的状态变化物体分割方法,我们仅标注训练视频的首帧和末帧,这与传统VOS不同。值得注意的是,包含开放词汇设置以评估对新类型物体或状态变化的泛化能力。我们实证表明,当前最先进的VOS模型在处理状态变化物体时表现不佳,在状态变化后容易丢失跟踪。我们分析了VSCOS任务的主要困难,并识别出三项技术改进:微调策略、表征学习以及融合运动信息。应用这些改进方法可获得一个强大的基线模型,能够一致地分割状态变化物体。我们的基准测试和基线方法已公开在https://github.com/venom12138/VSCOS。
abstract_en: Daily objects commonly experience state changes. For example, slicing a cucumber changes its state from whole to sliced. Learning about object state changes in Video Object Segmentation (VOS) is crucial for understanding and interacting with the visual world. Conventional VOS benchmarks do not consider this challenging yet crucial problem. This paper makes a pioneering effort to introduce a weakly-supervised benchmark on Video State-Changing Object Segmentation (VSCOS). We construct our VSCOS benchmark by selecting state-changing videos from existing datasets. In advocate of an annotation-efficient approach towards state-changing object segmentation, we only annotate the first and last frames of training videos, which is different from conventional VOS. Notably, an open-vocabulary setting is included to evaluate the generalization to novel types of objects or state changes. We empirically illustrate that state-of-the-art VOS models struggle with state-changing objects and lose track after the state changes. We analyze the main difficulties of our VSCOS task and identify three technical improvements, namely, fine-tuning strategies, representation learning, and integrating motion information. Applying these improvements results in a strong baseline for segmenting state-changing objects consistently. Our benchmark and baseline methods are publicly available at https://github.com/venom12138/VSCOS.
authors: Jiangwei Yu, Xiang Li, Xinran Zhao, Hongming Zhang, Yu-Xiong Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20439-20448

title: 视频任务十项全能:统一自动驾驶中的图像与视频任务
title_en: Video Task Decathlon: Unifying Image and Video Tasks in Autonomous Driving
abstract: 在动态场景中执行多种异构视觉任务是人类感知能力的标志。尽管在表征学习的推动下,图像和视频识别取得了显著进展,但当前研究仍侧重于为单一、同构或简单组合的任务设计专用网络。我们则探索构建一个统一模型,用于自动驾驶中具有多样输入和输出结构的主要图像和视频识别任务。为实现这一研究,我们设计了一个新挑战——视频任务十项全能(VTD),其中包括涵盖分类、分割、定位和像素关联的十项代表性图像和视频任务。在VTD上,我们开发了统一网络VTDNet,该网络对所有十项任务使用单一结构和单一权重集。VTDNet将相似任务分组,并采用任务交互阶段,在任务组内和组间交换信息。鉴于在所有帧上标注所有任务的不切实际性,以及多任务联合训练导致的性能退化,我们设计了课程训练、伪标签和微调(CPF)方案,以成功训练VTDNet完成所有任务并缓解性能损失。借助CPF,VTDNet在仅使用20%总体计算量的情况下,在大多数任务上显著优于其单任务对应模型。VTD为探索自动驾驶中感知任务的统一提供了有前景的新方向。
abstract_en: Performing multiple heterogeneous visual tasks in dynamic scenes is a hallmark of human perception capability. Despite remarkable progress in image and video recognition via representation learning, current research still focuses on designing specialized networks for singular, homogeneous, or simple combination of tasks. We instead explore the construction of a unified model for major image and video recognition tasks in autonomous driving with diverse input and output structures. To enable such an investigation, we design a new challenge, Video Task Decathlon (VTD), which includes ten representative image and video tasks spanning classification, segmentation, localization, and association of objects and pixels. On VTD, we develop our unified network, VTDNet, that uses a single structure and a single set of weights for all ten tasks. VTDNet groups similar tasks and employs task interaction stages to exchange information within and between task groups. Given the impracticality of labeling all tasks on all frames, and the performance degradation associated with joint training of many tasks, we design a Curriculum training, Pseudo-labeling, and Fine-tuning (CPF) scheme to successfully train VTDNet on all tasks and mitigate performance loss. Armed with CPF, VTDNet significantly outperforms its single-task counterparts on most tasks with only 20% overall computations. VTD is a promising new direction for exploring the unification of perception tasks in autonomous driving.
authors: Thomas E. Huang, Yifan Liu, Luc Van Gool, Fisher Yu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 8647-8657

title: Video-FocalNets:基于时空聚焦调制的视频动作识别
title_en: Video-FocalNets: Spatio-Temporal Focal Modulation for Video Action Recognition
abstract: 近年来,视频识别模型采用Transformer模型进行长距离时空上下文建模。视频Transformer设计基于自注意力机制,该机制能够以高计算成本建模全局上下文。相比之下,视频卷积设计提供了高效的替代方案,但缺乏长距离依赖建模。为了结合两种设计的优势,本文提出Video-FocalNet,这是一种高效且有效的视频识别架构,能够同时建模局部和全局上下文。Video-FocalNet基于一种时空聚焦调制架构,通过反转自注意力机制的交互和聚合步骤以提高效率。此外,聚合步骤和交互步骤均通过高效卷积和逐元素乘法操作实现,这些操作在视频表示上的计算成本低于其自注意力机制的对应操作。我们广泛探索了基于聚焦调制的时空上下文建模设计空间,并证明我们的并行空间和时间编码设计是最佳选择。Video-FocalNets在五个大规模数据集(Kinetics-400、Kinetics-600、SS-v2、Diving-48和ActivityNet-1.3)上以更低的计算成本优于最先进的基于Transformer的视频识别模型。我们的代码/模型已发布在https://github.com/TalalWasim/Video-FocalNets。
