We derive theoretical results to discuss the effectiveness of our representation calibration. Experiments on multiple benchmarks justify our claims and confirm the superiority of the proposed method.
authors: Manyi Zhang, Xuyang Zhao, Jun Yao, Chun Yuan, Weiran Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15890-15900

title: 当基于提示的增量学习无法满足强预训练时
title_en: When Prompt-based Incremental Learning Does Not Meet Strong Pretraining
abstract: 增量学习旨在通过序列任务学习深度网络时克服灾难性遗忘。凭借出色的的学习效率和性能,基于提示的方法通过学习任务特定的提示,采用固定主干网络处理序列任务。然而,现有基于提示的方法严重依赖强预训练(通常在ImageNet-21k上训练),我们发现当预训练任务与未知未来任务之间的潜在差距较大时,其模型可能陷入困境。在本工作中,我们开发了一个可学习的自适应提示生成器(APG)。关键在于将提示检索与提示学习过程统一到一个可学习的提示生成器中。因此,整个提示过程可以被优化,有效减少任务间差距带来的负面影响。为使APG避免学习无效知识,我们维护一个知识池,通过每个类别的特征分布对APG进行正则化。大量实验表明,我们的方法在无示例增量学习中显著优于先进方法,且无需(强)预训练。此外,在强重训练下,我们的方法也表现出与现有基于提示模型相当的性能,表明我们的方法仍能受益于预训练。代码可在https://github.com/TOM-tym/APG获取
abstract_en: Incremental learning aims to overcome catastrophic forgetting when learning deep networks from sequential tasks. With impressive learning efficiency and performance, prompt-based methods adopt a fixed backbone to sequential tasks by learning task-specific prompts. However, existing prompt-based methods heavily rely on strong pretraining (typically trained on ImageNet-21k), and we find that their models could be trapped if the potential gap between the pretraining task and unknown future tasks is large. In this work, we develop a learnable Adaptive Prompt Generator (APG). The key is to unify the prompt retrieval and prompt learning processes into a learnable prompt generator. Hence, the whole prompting process can be optimized to reduce the negative effects of the gap between tasks effectively. To make our APG avoid learning ineffective knowledge, we maintain a knowledge pool to regularize APG with the feature distribution of each class. Extensive experiments show that our method significantly outperforms advanced methods in exemplar-free incremental learning without (strong) pretraining. Besides, under strong retraining, our method also has comparable performance to existing prompt-based models, showing that our method can still benefit from pretraining. Codes can be found at https://github.com/TOM-tym/APG
authors: Yu-Ming Tang, Yi-Xing Peng, Wei-Shi Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1706-1716

title: 何时学习什么:模型自适应数据增强课程
title_en: When to Learn What: Model-Adaptive Data Augmentation Curriculum
abstract: 数据增强(DA)通过强制输入数据的预定义变换的不变性和对称性,被广泛用于提高神经网络的泛化能力。然而,固定增强策略可能在不同训练阶段对每个样本产生不同影响,但现有方法无法调整策略以适应每个样本和训练模型。本文提出"模型自适应数据增强(MADAug)",联合训练增强策略网络以教导模型"何时学习什么"。与先前工作不同,MADAug通过在训练阶段间变化的模型自适应策略为每个输入图像选择增强操作,生成优化泛化能力的数据增强课程。在MADAug中,我们通过双层优化方案训练策略,旨在最小化使用策略生成数据增强训练的模型的验证集损失。我们在多个图像分类任务和网络架构上对MADAug进行了广泛评估,并与现有DA方法进行了深入比较。MADAug优于或与其它基线方法相当,并表现出更好的公平性:它对所有类别均带来提升,尤其对困难类别提升更显著。此外,MADAug学习的策略在迁移到细粒度数据集时表现出更好性能。此外,MADAug中的自优化策略逐步引入增加的扰动,自然形成由易到难的课程。
abstract_en: Data augmentation (DA) is widely used to improve the generalization of neural networks by enforcing the invariances and symmetries to pre-defined transformations applied to input data. However, a fixed augmentation policy may have different effects on each sample in different training stages but existing approaches cannot adjust the policy to be adaptive to each sample and the training model. In this paper, we propose "Model-Adaptive Data Augmentation (MADAug)" that jointly trains an augmentation policy network to teach the model "when to learn what". Unlike previous work, MADAug selects augmentation operators for each input image by a model-adaptive policy varying between training stages, producing a data augmentation curriculum optimized for better generalization. In MADAug, we train the policy through a bi-level optimization scheme, which aims to minimize a validation set loss of a model trained using the policy-produced data augmentations. We conduct an extensive evaluation of MADAug on multiple image classification tasks and network architectures with thorough comparisons to existing DA approaches. MADAug outperforms or is on par with other baselines and exhibits better fairness: it brings improvement to all classes and more to the difficult ones. Moreover, MADAug learned policy shows better performance when transferred to fine-grained datasets. In addition, the auto-optimized policy in MADAug gradually introduces increasing perturbations and naturally forms an easy-to-hard curriculum.
authors: Chengkai Hou, Jieyu Zhang, Tianyi Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1717-1728

title: 你指的是谁?图像叙述中的共指消解
title_en: Who Are You Referring To? Coreference Resolution In Image Narrations
abstract: 共指消解旨在识别文本中指代同一实体的词语和短语,是自然语言处理的核心任务之一。本文将该任务扩展至视觉场景的长篇叙述中的共指消解。首先,我们引入一个包含标注共指链及其边界框的新数据集,因为大多数现有图像-文本数据集仅包含无共指表达的短句或未标注链。我们提出了一种新方法,仅通过图像-文本对和利用先验语言知识的正则化,采用弱监督学习来识别共指链。我们的模型在共指消解任务中显著超越了多个强基线模型。我们还证明了共指消解有助于提升图像中的叙事定位。
abstract_en:
Coreference resolution aims to identify words and phrases which refer to the same entity in a text, a core task in natural language processing. In this paper, we extend this task to resolving coreferences in long-form narrations of visual scenes. First, we introduce a new dataset with annotated coreference chains and their bounding boxes, as most existing image-text datasets only contain short sentences without coreferring expressions or labeled chains. We propose a new technique that learns to identify coreference chains using weak supervision, only from image-text pairs and a regularization using prior linguistic knowledge. Our model yields large performance gains over several strong baselines in resolving coreferences. 
 We also show that coreference resolution helps improve grounding narratives in images.
authors: Arushi Goel, Basura Fernando, Frank Keller, Hakan Bilen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15247-15258

title: 为什么视觉-语言模型的提示调优对噪声标签具有鲁棒性?
title_en: Why Is Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models Robust to Noisy Labels?
abstract: 例如CLIP的视觉-语言模型通过大规模训练数据学习通用的文本-图像嵌入。视觉-语言模型可以通过少样本提示调优适应新的分类任务。我们发现这种提示调优过程对标签噪声具有高度鲁棒性。这促使我们研究提示调优范式鲁棒性的关键原因。我们进行了大量实验来探索这一特性,并发现关键因素包括:1. 固定的类别名标记为模型优化提供了强正则化,减少了由噪声样本引起的梯度;2. 从多样且通用的网络数据中学习到的强大的预训练图像-文本嵌入为图像分类提供了强先验知识。进一步,我们证明CLIP的噪声零样本预测可用于调整自身的提示,在无监督设置下显著提升预测准确性。
abstract_en: Vision-language models such as CLIP learn a generic text-image embedding from large-scale training data. A vision-language model can be adapted to a new classification task through few-shot prompt tuning. We find that such prompt tuning process is highly robust to label noises. This intrigues us to study the key reasons contributing to the robustness of the prompt tuning paradigm. We conducted extensive experiments to explore this property and find the key factors are: 1. the fixed classname tokens provide a strong regularization to the optimization of the model, reducing gradients induced by the noisy samples; 2. the powerful pre-trained image-text embedding that is learned from diverse and generic web data provides strong prior knowledge for image classification. Further, we demonstrate that noisy zero-shot predictions from CLIP can be used to tune its own prompt, significantly enhancing prediction accuracy in the unsupervised setting.
authors: Cheng-En Wu, Yu Tian, Haichao Yu, Heng Wang, Pedro Morgado, Yu Hen Hu, Linjie Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15488-15497

title: 为什么网络具有抑制/负连接?
title_en: Why do networks have inhibitory/negative connections?
abstract: 为什么大脑具有抑制性连接?为什么深度网络具有负权重?我们从表示能力的角度提出一个答案。我们认为,表示函数是(i)大脑在自然智能中的主要功能,以及(ii)深度网络在人工智能中的核心作用。我们关于为何存在抑制/负权重的答案是:为了学习更多函数。我们证明,在没有负权重的情况下,具有非递减激活函数的神经网络不是通用逼近器。尽管这可能对某些人来说是直观的结果,但据我们所知,目前在机器学习或神经科学领域尚无正式理论能够证明负权重在表示能力背景下的关键性。此外,我们提供了关于非负深度网络无法表示的表示空间几何特性的见解。我们期望这些见解将有助于更深入地理解对权重分布施加的更复杂的归纳先验,从而提高生物和机器学习的效率。
abstract_en: Why do brains have inhibitory connections? Why do deep networks have negative weights? We propose an answer from the perspective of representation capacity. We believe representing functions is the primary role of both (i) the brain in natural intelligence, and (ii) deep networks in artificial intelligence. Our answer to why there are inhibitory/negative weights is: to learn more functions. We prove that, in the absence of negative weights, neural networks with non-decreasing activation functions are not universal approximators. While this may be an intuitive result to some, to the best of our knowledge, there is no formal theory, in either machine learning or neuroscience, that demonstrates why negative weights are crucial in the context of representation capacity. Further, we provide insights on the geometric properties of the representation space that non-negative deep networks cannot represent. We expect these insights will yield a deeper understanding of more sophisticated inductive priors imposed on the distribution of weights that lead to more efficient biological and machine learning.
authors: Qingyang Wang, Mike A. Powell, Ali Geisa, Eric Bridgeford, Carey E. Priebe, Joshua T. Vogelstein ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22551-22559

title: 大规模生成模型会破坏未来数据集吗?
title_en: Will Large-scale Generative Models Corrupt Future Datasets?
abstract: 近期提出的大型文本到图像生成模型(如DALLE 2、Midjourney和StableDiffusion)能够根据用户提示生成高质量且逼真的图像。不仅限于研究社区,普通互联网用户也享受这些生成模型,因此大量生成的图像已被分享到互联网上。同时,当前计算机视觉领域深度学习的成功很大程度上依赖于从互联网上收集的图像数据。这些趋势引导我们提出一个研究问题:“这些生成的图像会对未来数据集的质量和计算机视觉模型的性能产生正面还是负面影响?”本文通过模拟污染实证性地回答了这一问题。具体而言,我们使用最先进的生成模型生成ImageNet级和COCO级数据集,并评估在“受污染”数据集上训练的模型在图像分类和图像生成等任务上的表现。通过实验,我们得出结论:生成的图像会对下游任务性能产生负面影响,而影响程度取决于任务类型和生成图像的数量。生成的数据集及实验代码将公开发布以供未来研究使用。生成的数据集和源代码可从https://github.com/moskomule/dataset-contamination获取。
abstract_en: Recently proposed large-scale text-to-image generative models such as DALLE 2, Midjourney, and StableDiffusion can generate high-quality and realistic images from users' prompts. Not limited to the research community, ordinary Internet users enjoy these generative models, and consequently, a tremendous amount of generated images have been shared on the Internet. Meanwhile, today's success of deep learning in the computer vision field owes a lot to images collected from the Internet. These trends lead us to a research question: "will such generated images impact the quality of future datasets and the performance of computer vision models positively or negatively?" This paper empirically answers this question by simulating contamination. Namely, we generate ImageNet-scale and COCO-scale datasets using a state-of-the-art generative model and evaluate models trained with "contaminated" datasets on various tasks, including image classification and image generation. Throughout experiments, we conclude that generated images negatively affect downstream performance, while the significance depends on tasks and the amount of generated images. The generated datasets and the codes for experiments will be publicly released for future research. Generated datasets and source codes are available from https://github.com/moskomule/dataset-contamination.
authors: Ryuichiro Hataya, Han Bao, Hiromi Arai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20555-20565

title: 基于窗口的早期退出级联用于不确定性估计:当深度集成比单模型更高效时
title_en: Window-Based Early-Exit Cascades for Uncertainty Estimation: When Deep Ensembles are More Efficient than Single Models
abstract: 深度集成是一种简单、可靠且有效的方法,能够提升深度学习方法的预测性能和不确定性估计。然而,它们因需要部署多个独立模型而被广泛批评计算成本高昂。近期研究挑战了这一观点,表明在预测准确性方面,集成模型在推理过程中可能比在同一架构家族内扩展单模型更具计算效率。这是通过早期退出方法级联集成成员实现的。在本工作中,我们研究将这些效率增益扩展到与不确定性估计相关的任务。由于许多此类任务(如选择性分类)是二分类问题,我们的关键创新见解是仅将接近二分类决策边界的样本传递到后续级联阶段。在多个网络架构和不确定性任务上,使用ImageNet规模数据的实验表明,所提出的基于窗口的早期退出方法相比扩展单模型能够实现更优的不确定性-计算量权衡。例如,级联的EfficientNet-B2集成模型在5%风险下可达到与单个EfficientNet-B4模型相似的覆盖率,且MACs数量仅为后者的<30%。我们还发现,级联/集成模型在OOD数据上比扩展模型提供更可靠的性能提升。
abstract_en: Deep Ensembles are a simple, reliable, and effective method of improving both the predictive performance and uncertainty estimates of deep learning approaches. However, they are widely criticised as being computationally expensive, due to the need to deploy multiple independent models. Recent work has challenged this view, showing that for predictive accuracy, ensembles can be more computationally efficient (at inference) than scaling single models within an architecture family. This is achieved by cascading ensemble members via an early-exit approach. In this work, we investigate extending these efficiency gains to tasks related to uncertainty estimation. As many such tasks, e.g. selective classification, are binary classification, our key novel insight is to only pass samples within a window close to the binary decision boundary to later cascade stages. Experiments on ImageNet-scale data across a number of network architectures and uncertainty tasks show that the proposed window-based early-exit approach is able to achieve a superior uncertainty-computation trade-off compared to scaling single models. For example, a cascaded EfficientNet-B2 ensemble is able to achieve similar coverage at 5% risk as a single EfficientNet-B4 with <30% the number of MACs. We also find that cascades/ensembles give more reliable improvements on OOD data vs scaling models up.
authors: Guoxuan Xia, Christos-Savvas Bouganis ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 17368-17380

title: 借助自身过往的帮助:用于图像描述的原型记忆网络
title_en: With a Little Help from Your Own Past: Prototypical Memory Networks for Image Captioning
abstract: 图像描述任务,如同许多涉及视觉和语言的任务一样,目前依赖于基于Transformer的架构来提取图像语义并将其转化为语言上连贯的描述。尽管取得了成功,注意力操作符仅考虑当前输入样本的加权求和投影,因此忽略了可能来自其他样本联合观察的相关语义信息。在本文中,我们设计了一种网络,通过原型记忆模型对处理其他训练样本时获得的激活进行注意力计算。我们的记忆模型通过定义具有判别性和紧凑性的原型向量,来建模过去键和值的分布。实验上,我们在COCO数据集上评估了所提出模型的性能,与精心设计的基线和最先进的方法进行比较,并通过研究各个提出的组件的作用。我们证明,当仅使用交叉熵训练和使用自批评序列训练微调时,我们的方法可以使编码器-解码器Transformer的性能分别提升3.7个CIDEr分数。源代码和训练模型可在以下链接获取:https://github.com/aimagelab/PMA-Net。
abstract_en: Image captioning, like many tasks involving vision and language, currently relies on Transformer-based architectures for extracting the semantics in an image and translating it into linguistically coherent descriptions. Although successful, the attention operator only considers a weighted summation of projections of the current input sample, therefore ignoring the relevant semantic information which can come from the joint observation of other samples. In this paper, we devise a network which can perform attention over activations obtained while processing other training samples, through a prototypical memory model. Our memory models the distribution of past keys and values through the definition of prototype vectors which are both discriminative and compact. Experimentally, we assess the performance of the proposed model on the COCO dataset, in comparison with carefully designed baselines and state-of-the-art approaches, and by investigating the role of each of the proposed components. We demonstrate that our proposal can increase the performance of an encoder-decoder Transformer by 3.7 CIDEr points both when training in cross-entropy only and when fine-tuning with self-critical sequence training. Source code and trained models are available at: https://github.com/aimagelab/PMA-Net.
authors: Manuele Barraco, Sara Sarto, Marcella Cornia, Lorenzo Baraldi, Rita Cucchiara ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3021-3031

title: Workie-Talkie: 通过对比正则化实现计算与通信重叠加速联邦学习
title_en: Workie-Talkie: Accelerating Federated Learning by Overlapping Computing and Communications via Contrastive Regularization
abstract: 联邦学习(FL)在移动设备上的应用是一种有前景的分布式学习范式,适用于各种移动应用。然而,由于(i)传统联邦学习因模型更新的计算与通信交织导致移动设备产生巨大的训练延迟,(ii)移动设备间存在异构训练数据,以及(iii)移动设备在计算和通信能力方面存在硬件异构性,因此在移动设备上实际部署联邦学习面临巨大挑战。为解决上述问题,本文提出了一种新颖的"workie-talkie"联邦学习方案,该方案通过对比正则化(FedCR)实现本地计算与无线通信的重叠,从而加速联邦学习的训练。FedCR能够减少联邦学习的训练延迟并几乎消除拖尾问题,因为它将通信的时间消耗嵌入到本地训练过程中。为解决模型陈旧与数据异构性共存的问题,我们在FedCR中引入了类别级对比正则化以校正本地训练。此外,我们联合利用对比正则化和子网络进一步扩展FedCR方法,以适应具有硬件异构性的边缘设备。我们在FL测试平台中部署FedCR并进行了大量实验。结果表明,FedCR在各种数据集和模型上均优于现有联邦学习方法。
abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) over mobile devices is a promising distributed learning paradigm for various mobile applications. However, practical deployment of FL over mobile devices is very challenging because (i) conventional FL incurs huge training latency for mobile devices due to interleaved local computing and communications of model updates, (ii) there are heterogeneous training data across mobile devices, and (iii) mobile devices have hardware heterogeneity in terms of computing and communication capabilities. To address aforementioned challenges, in this paper, we propose a novel "workie-talkie" FL scheme, which can accelerate FL's training by overlapping local computing and wireless communications via contrastive regularization (FedCR). FedCR can reduce FL's training latency and almost eliminate straggler issues since it buries/embeds the time consumption of communications into that of local training. To resolve the issue of model staleness and data heterogeneity co-existing, we introduce class-wise contrastive regularization to correct the local training in FedCR. Besides, we jointly exploit contrastive regularization and subnetworks to further extend our FedCR approach to accommodate edge devices with hardware heterogeneity. We deploy FedCR in our FL testbed and conduct extensive experiments. The results show that FedCR outperforms its status quo FL approaches on various datasets and models.
authors: Rui Chen, Qiyu Wan, Pavana Prakash, Lan Zhang, Xu Yuan, Yanmin Gong, Xin Fu, Miao Pan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16999-17009

title: X-Mesh: 通过动态文本引导实现快速准确的文本驱动3D风格化
title_en: X-Mesh: Towards Fast and Accurate Text-driven 3D Stylization via Dynamic Textual Guidance
abstract: 文本驱动的3D风格化是计算机视觉(CV)和计算机图形学(CG)领域复杂且关键的任务,旨在将基础网格转换为符合目标文本的样式。现有方法采用文本无关的多层感知机(MLPs)在CLIP损失监督下预测目标网格属性。然而,这种文本无关架构在属性预测过程中缺乏文本引导,导致风格化效果不理想且收敛速度缓慢。为解决这些局限性,我们提出X-Mesh,一个创新的文本驱动3D风格化框架,其核心是新型文本引导动态注意力模块(TDAM)。TDAM通过在顶点特征提取过程中利用文本相关空间与通道注意力,动态整合目标文本的指导,从而实现更精确的属性预测和更快的收敛速度。此外,现有研究缺乏标准基准和自动化评估指标,通常依赖主观且不可复现的用户研究来评估风格化3D资产质量。为克服这一局限,我们引入新的标准文本-网格基准MIT-30和两个自动化评估指标,使未来研究能够实现公平客观的对比。我们的大量定性与定量实验表明,X-Mesh优于先前最先进方法。
abstract_en: Text-driven 3D stylization is a complex and crucial task in the fields of computer vision (CV) and computer graphics (CG), aimed at transforming a bare mesh to fit a target text. Prior methods adopt text-independent multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) to predict the attributes of the target mesh with the supervision of CLIP loss. However, such text-independent architecture lacks textual guidance during predicting attributes, thus leading to unsatisfactory stylization and slow convergence. To address these limitations, we present X-Mesh, an innovative text-driven 3D stylization framework that incorporates a novel Text-guided Dynamic Attention Module (TDAM). The TDAM dynamically integrates the guidance of the target text by utilizing text-relevant spatial and channel-wise attentions during vertex feature extraction, resulting in more accurate attribute prediction and faster convergence speed. Furthermore, existing works lack standard benchmarks and automated metrics for evaluation, often relying on subjective and non-reproducible user studies to assess the quality of stylized 3D assets. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a new standard text-mesh benchmark, namely MIT-30, and two automated metrics, which will enable future research to achieve fair and objective comparisons. Our extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that X-Mesh outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods.
authors: Yiwei Ma, Xiaoqing Zhang, Xiaoshuai Sun, Jiayi Ji, Haowei Wang, Guannan Jiang, Weilin Zhuang, Rongrong Ji ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2749-2760

title: X-VoE:测量物理事件中的解释性期望违背
title_en: X-VoE: Measuring eXplanatory Violation of Expectation in Physical Events
abstract: 直觉物理对人类理解物理世界至关重要,使人类能够在婴儿期就能预测和解释事件。然而,在人工智能(AI)中复现这一水平的直觉物理仍是一个重大挑战。本研究引入了X-VoE,一个全面的基准数据集,用于评估AI代理对直觉物理的理解。X-VoE基于根植于发展心理学的期望违背(VoE)范式,为直觉物理模型的解释能力设立了更高的标准。X-VoE中的每个VoE场景包含三个不同的设置,探查模型对事件及其潜在解释的理解。除了模型评估,我们还提出了一种基于解释的学习系统,该系统仅通过视觉序列捕捉物理动态并推断被遮挡物体的状态,无需显式的遮挡标签。实验结果表明,我们的模型在X-VoE测试中与人类常识高度一致。一个显著特点是模型能够通过重建隐藏场景,直观阐释VoE事件。最后,我们讨论了研究发现的意义,并概述了未来的研究方向。通过X-VoE,我们推动了具备类人直觉物理能力的AI的发展。
abstract_en: Intuitive physics is pivotal for human understanding of the physical world, enabling prediction and interpretation of events even in infancy. Nonetheless, replicating this level of intuitive physics in artificial intelligence (AI) remains a formidable challenge. This study introduces X-VoE, a comprehensive benchmark dataset, to assess AI agents' grasp of intuitive physics. Built on the developmental psychology-rooted Violation of Expectation (VoE) paradigm, X-VoE establishes a higher bar for the explanatory capacities of intuitive physics models. Each VoE scenario within X-VoE encompasses three distinct settings, probing models' comprehension of events and their underlying explanations. Beyond model evaluation, we present an explanation-based learning system that captures physics dynamics and infers occluded object states solely from visual sequences, without explicit occlusion labels. Experimental outcomes highlight our model's alignment with human commonsense when tested against X-VoE. A remarkable feature is our model's ability to visually expound VoE events by reconstructing concealed scenes. Concluding, we discuss the findings' implications and outline future research directions. Through X-VoE, we catalyze the advancement of AI endowed with human-like intuitive physics capabilities.
authors: Bo Dai, Linge Wang, Baoxiong Jia, Zeyu Zhang, Song-Chun Zhu, Chi Zhang, Yixin Zhu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3992-4002

title: XMem++:基于少量标注帧的生产级视频分割
title_en: XMem++: Production-level Video Segmentation From Few Annotated Frames
abstract: 尽管用户引导的视频分割技术取得了进展,但对高度复杂场景中复杂对象的持续提取仍是一项耗时费力的任务,尤其是在生产环境中。常见的情况是需要对多数帧进行标注。我们引入了一种新颖的半监督视频对象分割(SSVOS)模型XMem++,通过永久记忆模块改进了现有基于记忆的模型。大多数现有方法侧重于单帧标注,而我们的方法能够有效处理多个用户选择的帧,这些帧可能包含同一对象或区域的不同外观。我们的方法能够在保持所需标注帧数量较低的同时提取高度一致的结果。我们进一步引入了一种迭代且基于注意力的帧建议机制,用于计算下一个最佳标注帧。我们的方法具备实时性,且无需在每次用户输入后重新训练。我们还引入了一个新数据集PUMaVOS,涵盖了之前基准测试中未出现的新挑战性用例。我们在具有挑战性的(部分和多类别)分割场景以及长视频上展示了最先进(SOTA)性能,同时显著减少了标注帧数量。项目页面:https://max810.github.io/xmem2-project-page/
abstract_en: Despite advancements in user-guided video segmentation, extracting complex objects consistently for highly complex scenes is still a labor-intensive task, especially for production. It is not uncommon that a majority of frames need to be annotated. We introduce a novel semi-supervised video object segmentation (SSVOS) model, XMem++, that improves existing memory-based models, with a permanent memory module. Most existing methods focus on single frame annotations, while our approach can effectively handle multiple user-selected frames with varying appearances of the same object or region. Our method can extract highly consistent results while keeping the required number of frame annotations low. We further introduce an iterative and attention-based frame suggestion mechanism, which computes the next best frame for annotation. Our method is real-time and does not require retraining after each user input. We also introduce a new dataset, PUMaVOS, which covers new challenging use cases not found in previous benchmarks. We demonstrate SOTA performance on challenging (partial and multi-class) segmentation scenarios as well as long videos, while ensuring significantly fewer frame annotations than any existing method. Project page: https://max810.github.io/xmem2-project-page/
authors: Maksym Bekuzarov, Ariana Bermudez, Joon-Young Lee, Hao Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 635-644

title: XNet:基于小波的低频与高频融合网络用于生物医学图像的全监督和半监督语义分割
title_en: XNet: Wavelet-Based Low and High Frequency Fusion Networks for Fully- and Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation of Biomedical Images
abstract: 深度神经网络(DNNs)的发展推动了生物医学图像的全监督和半监督语义分割。然而目前DNN模型通常仅支持这两种学习方案中的一种,能够同时支持全监督和半监督分割的统一模型仍较为有限。此外,很少有全监督模型关注图像的固有低频(LF)和高频(HF)信息以提升性能。基于一致性的半监督模型中的扰动往往人工设计,可能引入不利于训练的负面学习偏差。本研究提出了一种基于小波的LF和HF融合模型XNet,该模型支持全监督和半监督语义分割,在两个领域均优于现有最先进模型。其强调通过提取LF和HF信息进行一致性训练,以缓解人工扰动导致的学习偏差。在两个2D和两个3D数据集上的广泛实验验证了模型的有效性。代码可在https://github.com/Yanfeng-Zhou/XNet获取。
abstract_en: Fully- and semi-supervised semantic segmentation of biomedical images have been advanced with the development of deep neural networks (DNNs). So far, however, DNN models are usually designed to support one of these two learning schemes, unified models that support both fully- and semi-supervised segmentation remain limited. Furthermore, few fully-supervised models focus on the intrinsic low frequency (LF) and high frequency (HF) information of images to improve performance. Perturbations in consistency-based semi-supervised models are often artificially designed. They may introduce negative learning bias that are not beneficial for training. In this study, we propose a wavelet-based LF and HF fusion model XNet, which supports both fully- and semi-supervised semantic segmentation and outperforms state-of-the-art models in both fields. It emphasizes extracting LF and HF information for consistency training to alleviate the learning bias caused by artificial perturbations. Extensive experiments on two 2D and two 3D datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our model. Code is available at https://github.com/Yanfeng-Zhou/XNet.
authors: Yanfeng Zhou, Jiaxing Huang, Chenlong Wang, Le Song, Ge Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21085-21096

title: XVO:基于跨模态自训练的通用视觉里程计
title_en: XVO: Generalized Visual Odometry via Cross-Modal Self-Training
abstract: 我们提出XVO,一种半监督学习方法,用于训练具有跨多样化数据集和场景鲁棒性的通用单目视觉里程计(VO)模型。与通常在单一数据集中研究已知校准的标准单目VO方法不同,XVO通过从视觉场景语义中学习,高效地恢复真实尺度的相对位姿,即无需依赖任何已知的相机参数。我们通过自训练从YouTube上大量无约束且异构的行车记录仪视频中优化运动估计模型。我们的主要贡献包括两方面:首先,我们实证展示了半监督训练对学习通用直接VO回归网络的优势;其次,我们展示了包括分割、光流、深度和音频辅助预测任务的多模态监督,以促进VO任务的通用表示。具体而言,我们发现音频预测任务显著增强了半监督学习过程,同时缓解了噪声伪标签,特别是在高度动态和领域外视频数据中。我们提出的教师网络在常用的KITTI基准测试中实现了最先进的性能,尽管没有多帧优化或相机参数知识。结合提出的半监督步骤,XVO在KITTI、nuScenes和Argoverse数据集上实现了无需微调的多样化条件知识迁移。
abstract_en: We propose XVO, a semi-supervised learning method for training generalized monocular Visual Odometry (VO) models with robust off-the-self operation across diverse datasets and settings. In contrast to standard monocular VO approaches which often study a known calibration within a single dataset, XVO efficiently learns to recover relative pose with real-world scale from visual scene semantics, i.e., without relying on any known camera parameters. We optimize the motion estimation model via self-training from large amounts of unconstrained and heterogeneous dash camera videos available on YouTube. Our key contribution is twofold. First, we empirically demonstrate the benefits of semi-supervised training for learning a general-purpose direct VO regression network. Second, we demonstrate multi-modal supervision, including segmentation, flow, depth, and audio auxiliary prediction tasks, to facilitate generalized representations for the VO task. Specifically, we find audio prediction task to significantly enhance the semi-supervised learning process while alleviating noisy pseudo-labels, particularly in highly dynamic and out-of-domain video data. Our proposed teacher network achieves state-of-the-art performance on the commonly used KITTI benchmark despite no multi-frame optimization or knowledge of camera parameters. Combined with the proposed semi-supervised step, XVO demonstrates off-the-shelf knowledge transfer across diverse conditions on KITTI, nuScenes, and Argoverse without fine-tuning.
authors: Lei Lai, Zhongkai Shangguan, Jimuyang Zhang, Eshed Ohn-Bar ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 10094-10105

title: XiNet:面向tinyML的高效神经网络
title_en: XiNet: Efficient Neural Networks for tinyML
abstract: 近期对端到云连续体范式的关注强调了在计算受限设备上实现最优性能所需的简单且可扩展的架构。然而,资源高效的神经网络通常仅优化参数数量,因此使用如深度卷积等操作,这些操作未能充分挖掘资源受限设备的效率潜力。在本文中,我们提出XiNet,一种面向边缘设备的新型卷积神经网络架构。我们通过广泛的实际效率分析各种神经网络操作符(如标准、深度和点卷积)推导出XiNet架构。与其它移动架构相比,我们的方法通过优化操作数量、参数和工作内存(RAM),显著改善了性能与复杂度的权衡。此外,我们展示了如何借助硬件感知缩放(HAS)轻松适应不同设备,该方法实现了RAM、FLASH和操作数量的独立优化。我们分析了该架构在不同硬件约束下的扩展特性,并在图像分类任务上进行了验证。最后,我们在MS-COCO和VOC-2012基准上评估了XiNet在目标检测任务中的性能,并与最先进的移动神经网络进行比较,实现了70%的能耗降低,同时保持相似的性能。
abstract_en: The recent interest in the edge-to-cloud continuum paradigm has emphasized the need for simple and scalable architectures to deliver optimal performance on computationally constrained devices. However, resource-efficient neural networks usually optimize for parameter count and thus use operators such as depthwise convolutions, which do not maximally exploit the efficiency of resource-constrained devices. In this article, we propose XiNet, a novel convolutional neural architecture that targets edge devices. We derived the XiNet architecture from an extensive real-world efficiency analysis of various neural network operators (e.g., standard, depthwise, and pointwise convolutions). Compared to other mobile architectures, our approach substantially improves the performance-complexity trade-off by optimizing the number of operations, parameters, and working memory (RAM). Moreover, we show how XiNet can be easily adapted to different devices thanks to Hardware Aware Scaling (HAS), which enables disjoint optimization of RAM, FLASH, and operations count. We analyze the scaling properties of our architecture under different hardware constraints and validate it on the image classification task. Finally, we evaluate the performance of XiNet for object detection on the MS-COCO and VOC-2012 benchmarks and compare it with state-of-the-art mobile neural networks, achieving a 70% reduction in energy requirements with similar performance.
authors: Alberto Ancilotto, Francesco Paissan, Elisabetta Farella ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 16968-16977

title: 是的,我们CANN:基于局部特征的视觉定位的约束近似最近邻
title_en: Yes, we CANN: Constrained Approximate Nearest Neighbors for Local Feature-Based Visual Localization
abstract: 大规模视觉定位系统仍依赖于通过运动结构恢复从图像集合构建的3D点云。尽管这些模型中的3D点使用局部图像特征表示,但由于最近邻搜索问题的规模,直接将查询图像的局部特征与点云进行匹配具有挑战性。因此,许多近期的视觉定位方法提出了一种混合方法:首先使用全局(每图像)嵌入检索一小部分数据库图像,然后仅将查询的局部特征与这些图像进行匹配。尽管需要为每个查询图像计算两种特征类型带来了显著的缺点,但人们普遍认为全局嵌入对于视觉定位中的图像检索至关重要。在本文中,我们摒弃这一假设,提出约束近似最近邻(CANN),这是一种仅使用局部特征在几何空间和外观空间中联合进行k近邻搜索的解决方案。我们首先推导出跨多种度量的k近邻检索的理论基础,然后展示CANN如何提升视觉定位性能。我们在公开定位基准上的实验表明,我们的方法在准确率上显著优于最先进的全局特征检索方法和基于局部特征聚合方案的方法。此外,与这些数据集的特征聚合方案相比,CANN在索引和查询时间上快了一个数量级。代码将被发布。
abstract_en: Large-scale visual localization systems continue to relyon 3D point clouds built from image collections usingstructure-from-motion. While the 3D points in these modelsare represented using local image features, directly match-ing a query image's local features against the point cloud ischallenging due to the scale of the nearest-neighbor searchproblem. Many recent approaches to visual localization havethus proposed a hybrid method, where first a global (per im-age) embedding is used to retrieve a small subset of databaseimages, and local features of the query are matched onlyagainst those. It seems to have become common belief thatglobal embeddings are critical for said image-retrieval invisual localization, despite the significant downside of hav-ing to compute two feature types for each query image. Inthis paper, we take a step back from this assumption and pro-pose Constrained Approximate Nearest Neighbors (CANN),a joint solution of k-nearest-neighbors across both the ge-ometry and appearance space using only local features. Wefirst derive the theoretical foundation for k-nearest-neighborretrieval across multiple metrics and then showcase howCANN improves visual localization. Our experiments onpublic localization benchmarks demonstrate that our methodsignificantly outperforms both state-of-the-art global feature-based retrieval and approaches using local feature aggrega-tion schemes. Moreover, it is an order of magnitude faster inboth index and query time than feature aggregation schemesfor these datasets. Code will be released.
authors: Dror Aiger, Andre Araujo, Simon Lynen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 13339-13349

title: 你永远没有第二次机会留下好印象:为3D语义分割的主动学习进行种子选择
title_en: You Never Get a Second Chance To Make a Good First Impression: Seeding Active Learning for 3D Semantic Segmentation
abstract: 我们提出SeedAL,一种用于高效标注3D点云语义分割的主动学习种子选择方法。主动学习(AL)通过迭代选择相关数据子集在给定预算内进行标注,但需要首先对数据集的一部分(称为"种子")进行标注,以估计标注其他数据子集的收益。我们首先证明种子选择对许多AL方法的性能有显著影响。随后,我们提出一种自动构建种子的方法,以确保AL的良好性能。假设点云图像可用(这是常见情况),我们的方法依赖强大的无监督图像特征来衡量点云的多样性。它通过在标注预算下优化多样性来选择种子点云,这可以通过求解线性优化问题实现。我们的实验在S3DIS和SemanticKitti数据集上验证了该方法相比随机种子和现有方法的有效性。代码可在https://github.com/nerminsamet/seedal获取。
abstract_en: We propose SeedAL, a method to seed active learning for efficient annotation of 3D point clouds for semantic segmentation. Active Learning (AL) iteratively selects relevant data fractions to annotate within a given budget, but requires a first fraction of the dataset (a 'seed') to be already annotated to estimate the benefit of annotating other data fractions. We first show that the choice of the seed can significantly affect the performance of many AL methods. We then propose a method for automatically constructing a seed that will ensure good performance for AL. Assuming that images of the point clouds are available, which is common, our method relies on powerful unsupervised image features to measure the diversity of the point clouds. It selects the point clouds for the seed by optimizing the diversity under an annotation budget, which can be done by solving a linear optimization problem. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach compared to random seeding and existing methods on both the S3DIS and SemanticKitti datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/nerminsamet/seedal.
authors: Nermin Samet, Oriane Siméoni, Gilles Puy, Georgy Ponimatkin, Renaud Marlet, Vincent Lepetit ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18445-18457

title: 你的扩散模型其实是一个零样本分类器
title_en: Your Diffusion Model is Secretly a Zero-Shot Classifier
abstract: 近期大规模文本到图像扩散模型的兴起显著提升了我们的基于文本的图像生成能力。这些模型能够为大量提示生成逼真的图像,并展现出令人印象深刻的组合泛化能力。迄今为止,几乎所有用例都仅关注采样;然而,扩散模型还能提供条件密度估计,这对图像生成以外的任务具有重要价值。在本文中,我们展示了大规模文本到图像扩散模型(如Stable Diffusion)的密度估计可用于无需额外训练的零样本分类。我们提出的生成式分类方法(称为Diffusion Classifier)在多种基准测试中取得了优异结果,并优于其他从扩散模型中提取知识的方法。尽管生成式与判别式方法在零样本识别任务中仍存在差距,但我们的扩散模型方法在多模态组合推理能力上优于竞争的判别式方法。最后,我们使用Diffusion Classifier从在ImageNet上训练的类别条件扩散模型中提取标准分类器。这些模型的性能接近当前最优判别式分类器,并展现出对分布偏移的强"有效鲁棒性"。总体而言,我们的结果是向使用生成模型而非判别模型进行下游任务迈出的一步。
abstract_en: The recent wave of large-scale text-to-image diffusion models has dramatically increased our text-based image generation abilities. These models can generate realistic images for a staggering variety of prompts and exhibit impressive compositional generalization abilities. Almost all use cases thus far have solely focused on sampling; however, diffusion models can also provide conditional density estimates, which are useful for tasks beyond image generation. In this paper, we show that the density estimates from large-scale text-to-image diffusion models like Stable Diffusion can be leveraged to perform zero-shot classification without any additional training. Our generative approach to classification, which we call Diffusion Classifier, attains strong results on a variety of benchmarks and outperforms alternative methods of extracting knowledge from diffusion models. Although a gap remains between generative and discriminative approaches on zero-shot recognition tasks, our diffusion-based approach has stronger multimodal compositional reasoning abilities than competing discriminative approaches. Finally, we use Diffusion Classifier to extract standard classifiers from class-conditional diffusion models trained on ImageNet. These models approach the performance of SOTA discriminative classifiers and exhibit strong "effective robustness" to distribution shift. Overall, our results are a step toward using generative over discriminative models for downstream tasks.
authors: Alexander C. Li, Mihir Prabhudesai, Shivam Duggal, Ellis Brown, Deepak Pathak ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2206-2217

title: Zenseact开放数据集:用于自动驾驶的大型多样化多模态数据集
title_en: Zenseact Open Dataset: A Large-Scale and Diverse Multimodal Dataset for Autonomous Driving
abstract: 现有自动驾驶(AD)数据集往往缺乏多样性与长距离感知能力,主要聚焦于360°感知与时序推理。为解决这一不足,我们引入了ZOD数据集,该数据集历时两年在多个欧洲国家采集,覆盖面积是现有数据集的9倍。ZOD配备了同类数据集中最高范围和分辨率的传感器,结合了2D和3D物体(最高达245米)的关键帧标注、道路实例/语义分割、交通标志识别及道路分类。我们相信这种独特组合将推动长距离感知与多任务学习的突破。该数据集由帧(Frames)、序列(Sequences)和驾驶场景(Drives)组成,旨在兼顾数据多样性并支持时空学习、传感器融合、定位与地图构建。帧包含10万张精选的摄像头图像及两秒的其他辅助传感器数据,而1473个序列和29个驾驶场景分别包含20秒和数分钟的完整传感器套件。ZOD是唯一在宽松CC BY-SA 4.0许可下发布的AD数据集,允许研究与商业用途。更多信息及完整开发工具包可访问zod.zenseact.com。
abstract_en: Existing datasets for autonomous driving (AD) often lack diversity and long-range capabilities, focusing instead on 360* perception and temporal reasoning. To address this gap, we introduce ZOD, a large-scale and diverse multimodal dataset collected over two years in various European countries, covering an area 9x that of existing datasets. ZOD boasts the highest range and resolution sensors among comparable datasets, coupled with detailed keyframe annotations for 2D and 3D objects (up to 245m), road instance/semantic segmentation, traffic sign recognition, and road classification. We believe that this unique combination will facilitate breakthroughs in long-range perception and multi-task learning. The dataset is composed of Frames, Sequences, and Drives, designed to encompass both data diversity and support for spatio-temporal learning, sensor fusion, localization, and mapping. Frames consist of 100k curated camera images with two seconds of other supporting sensor data, while the 1473 Sequences and 29 Drives include the entire sensor suite for 20 seconds and a few minutes, respectively. ZOD is the only AD dataset released under the permissive CC BY-SA 4.0 license, allowing for both research and commercial use. More information, and an extensive devkit, can be found at zod.zenseact.com.
authors: Mina Alibeigi, William Ljungbergh, Adam Tonderski, Georg Hess, Adam Lilja, Carl Lindström, Daria Motorniuk, Junsheng Fu, Jenny Widahl, Christoffer Petersson ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 20178-20188

title: Zero-1-to-3:零样本单图像到三维物体
title_en: Zero-1-to-3: Zero-shot One Image to 3D Object
abstract: 我们提出Zero-1-to-3框架,该框架仅需单张RGB图像即可改变物体的相机视角。在欠约束场景下进行新视角合成时,我们利用大规模扩散模型学习到的自然图像几何先验知识。我们的条件扩散模型通过合成数据集学习相对相机视角的控制,从而能够在指定相机变换下生成同一物体的新图像。尽管模型是在合成数据集上训练的,但其仍具备强大的零样本泛化能力,能够超越分布外数据集及真实场景图像(包括印象派绘画)的表现。我们的视角条件扩散方法还可用于单图像三维重建任务。定性与定量实验表明,通过互联网级预训练,我们的方法在单视角三维重建和新视角合成任务中显著优于现有最先进的模型。
abstract_en: We introduce Zero-1-to-3, a framework for changing the camera viewpoint of an object given just a single RGB image. To perform novel view synthesis in this underconstrained setting, we capitalize on the geometric priors that large-scale diffusion models learn about natural images. Our conditional diffusion model uses a synthetic dataset to learn controls of the relative camera viewpoint, which allow new images to be generated of the same object under a specified camera transformation. Even though it is trained on a synthetic dataset, our model retains a strong zero-shot generalization ability to out-of-distribution datasets as well as in-the-wild images, including impressionist paintings. Our viewpoint-conditioned diffusion approach can further be used for the task of 3D reconstruction from a single image. Qualitative and quantitative experiments show that our method significantly outperforms stateof- the-art single-view 3D reconstruction and novel view synthesis models by leveraging Internet-scale pre-training.
authors: Ruoshi Liu, Rundi Wu, Basile Van Hoorick, Pavel Tokmakov, Sergey Zakharov, Carl Vondrick ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 9298-9309

title: 基于文本反转的零样本组合图像检索
title_en: Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval with Textual Inversion
abstract: 组合图像检索(CIR)旨在根据由参考图像和描述两幅图像之间差异的相对描述组成的查询,检索目标图像。由于CIR数据集的标注需要大量人力和成本,现有方法的广泛应用受到阻碍,因为它们依赖监督学习。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新任务——零样本组合图像检索(ZS-CIR),旨在在无需标注训练数据的情况下解决CIR问题。我们的方法名为零样本组合图像检索与文本反转SEARLE(zero-Shot composEd imAge Retrieval with textuaL invErsion SEARLE),将参考图像的视觉特征映射为CLIP标记嵌入空间中的伪词标记,并将其与相对描述进行整合。为支持ZS-CIR的研究,我们引入了一个开放域基准数据集,名为上下文中的常见物体组合图像检索(CIRCO),这是首个包含每个查询多个真实标签的CIR数据集。实验表明,SEARLE在CIR任务的两个主要数据集FashionIQ和CIRR以及所提出的CIRCO上均优于基线方法。数据集、代码和模型可在https://github.com/miccunifi/SEARLE公开获取。
abstract_en: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image based on a query composed of a reference image and a relative caption that describes the difference between the two images. The high effort and cost required for labeling datasets for CIR hamper the widespread usage of existing methods, as they rely on supervised learning. In this work, we propose a new task, Zero-Shot CIR (ZS-CIR), that aims to address CIR without requiring a labeled training dataset. Our approach, named zero-Shot composEd imAge Retrieval with textuaL invErsion SEARLE, maps the visual features of the reference image into a pseudo-word token in CLIP token embedding space and integrates it with the relative caption. To support research on ZS-CIR, we introduce an open-domain benchmarking dataset named Composed Image Retrieval on Common Objects in context (CIRCO), which is the first dataset for CIR containing multiple ground-truths for each query. The experiments show that SEARLE exhibits better performance than the baselines on the two main datasets for CIR tasks, FashionIQ and CIRR, and on the proposed CIRCO. The dataset, the code and the model are publicly available at https://github.com/miccunifi/SEARLE.
authors: Alberto Baldrati, Lorenzo Agnolucci, Marco Bertini, Alberto Del Bimbo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 15338-15347

title: 基于文本引导的扩散图像风格迁移的零样本对比损失
title_en: Zero-Shot Contrastive Loss for Text-Guided Diffusion Image Style Transfer
abstract: 扩散模型在文本引导的图像风格迁移中展现出巨大潜力,但其随机性导致风格转换与内容保留之间存在权衡。现有方法需要计算成本高昂的扩散模型微调或额外神经网络。为解决这一问题,我们提出一种无需额外微调或辅助网络的零样本对比损失。通过利用预训练扩散模型中生成样本与原始图像嵌入的块级对比损失,我们的方法可在零样本方式下生成与源图像语义内容相同的图像。该方法在无需额外训练的情况下优于现有方法,不仅适用于图像风格迁移,也适用于图像到图像的转换与操作。实验结果验证了所提方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Diffusion models have shown great promise in text-guided image style transfer, but there is a trade-off between style transformation and content preservation due to their stochastic nature. Existing methods require computationally expensive fine-tuning of diffusion models or additional neural network. To address this, here we propose a zero-shot contrastive loss for diffusion models that doesn't require additional fine-tuning or auxiliary networks. By leveraging patch-wise contrastive loss between generated samples and original image embeddings in the pre-trained diffusion model, our method can generate images with the same semantic content as the source image in a zero-shot manner. Our approach outperforms existing methods while preserving content and requiring no additional training, not only for image style transfer but also for image-to-image translation and manipulation. Our experimental results validate the effectiveness of our proposed method.
authors: Serin Yang, Hyunmin Hwang, Jong Chul Ye ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22873-22882

title: 基于语义-视觉感知合成的零样本点云分割
title_en: Zero-Shot Point Cloud Segmentation by Semantic-Visual Aware Synthesis
abstract: 本文提出了一种用于零样本三维点云语义分割的特征合成方法,能够对之前未见过的类别进行泛化。仅给定未见物体的类别级语义信息,我们致力于增强视觉空间与语义空间之间的对应关系、对齐和一致性,以合成多样、通用且可迁移的视觉特征。我们开发了一种掩码学习策略,以促进同一类别视觉特征的多样性并增强不同类别之间的分离。进一步地,我们将视觉特征映射到原型空间中,以建模其分布并与其对应的语义空间对齐。最后,我们开发了一种一致性正则化器,以保持真实见过特征与合成未见过特征之间的语义-视觉关系。我们的方法在ScanNet、S3DIS和SemanticKITTI基准测试中表现出显著的语义分割性能提升。我们的代码可在:https://github.com/leolyj/3DPC-GZSL 获取。
abstract_en: This paper proposes a feature synthesis approach for zero-shot semantic segmentation of 3D point clouds, enabling generalization to previously unseen categories. Given only the class-level semantic information for unseen objects, we strive to enhance the correspondence, alignment and consistency between the visual and semantic spaces, to synthesise diverse, generic and transferable visual features. We develop a masked learning strategy to promote diversity within the same class visual features and enhance the separation between different classes. We further cast the visual features into a prototypical space to model their distribution for alignment with the corresponding semantic space. Finally, we develop a consistency regularizer to preserve the semantic-visual relationships between the real-seen features and synthetic-unseen features. Our approach shows considerable semantic segmentation gains on ScanNet, S3DIS and SemanticKITTI benchmarks. Our code is available at: https://github.com/leolyj/3DPC-GZSL
authors: Yuwei Yang, Munawar Hayat, Zhao Jin, Hongyuan Zhu, Yinjie Lei ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 11586-11596

title: 零样本文本到图像扩散模型的空间布局条件化
title_en: Zero-Shot Spatial Layout Conditioning for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
abstract: 大规模文本到图像扩散模型显著提升了生成图像建模的最先进水平,并允许通过直观且强大的用户界面驱动图像生成过程。使用文本表达空间约束(例如将特定物体放置在特定位置)较为繁琐;当前基于文本的图像生成模型无法准确遵循此类指令。本文考虑从与图像画布上区域相关联的文本进行图像生成,该方法结合了直观的自然语言界面与对生成内容的精确空间控制。我们提出ZestGuide,一种"零样本"分割引导方法,可插入预训练的文本到图像扩散模型中,且无需额外训练。该方法利用可以从交叉注意力层中提取的隐式分割图,将生成内容与输入掩码对齐。我们的实验结果结合了高质量图像与生成内容与输入分割的准确对齐,并在定量和定性方面均优于先前工作,包括需要在带有对应分割的图像上进行训练的方法。与之前最先进的零样本分割引导图像生成方法Paint with Words相比,在COCO数据集上我们的方法在mIoU指标上提高了5到10个点,同时保持相似的FID分数。
abstract_en: Large-scale text-to-image diffusion models have significantly improved the state of the art in generative image modeling and allow for an intuitive and powerful user interface to drive the image generation process. Expressing spatial constraints, e.g. to position specific objects in particular locations, is cumbersome using text; and current text-based image generation models are not able to accurately follow such instructions. In this paper we consider image generation from text associated with segments on the image canvas, which combines an intuitive natural language interface with precise spatial control over the generated content. We propose ZestGuide, a "ZEro-shot" SegmenTation Guidance approach that can be plugged into pre-trained text-to-image diffusion models, and does not require any additional training. It leverages implicit segmentation maps that can be extracted from cross-attention layers, and uses them to align the generation with input masks. Our experimental results combine high image quality with accurate alignment of generated content with input segmentations, and improve over prior work both quantitatively and qualitatively, including methods that require training on images with corresponding segmentations. Compared to Paint with Words, the previous state-of-the art in image generation with zero-shot segmentation conditioning, we improve by 5 to 10 mIoU points on the COCO dataset with similar FID scores.
authors: Guillaume Couairon, Marlène Careil, Matthieu Cord, Stéphane Lathuilière, Jakob Verbeek ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 2174-2183

title: 基于零分割标签的零引导分割
title_en: Zero-guidance Segmentation Using Zero Segment Labels
abstract: 联合视觉-语言模型CLIP使新应用成为可能,例如开放词汇分割,该技术可根据任意文本查询定位任意分割区域。我们的研究探讨是否能够在不使用文本查询或预定义类别的形式的用户引导下发现语义分割,并通过自然语言自动标注?我们提出了一种新颖的零引导分割问题,并提出了首个基线方法,该方法利用两个预训练通用模型DINO和CLIP解决此问题,无需任何微调或分割数据集。总体思路是首先将图像分割为小的过分割区域,将其编码到CLIP的视觉-语言空间中,转换为文本标签,并合并语义相似的分割区域。然而关键挑战在于如何将视觉分割编码为平衡全局和局部上下文信息的分割特定嵌入,这两种信息对识别均有益。我们的主要贡献是一种新颖的注意力掩码技术,通过分析CLIP内部的注意力层来平衡这两种上下文。我们还引入了几个用于评估此新任务的指标。借助CLIP的固有知识,我们的方法能够精确定位博物馆人群中的蒙娜丽莎画作。
abstract_en: The joint visual-language model CLIP has enabled new and exciting applications, such as open-vocabulary segmentation, which can locate any segment given an arbitrary text query. In our research, we ask whether it is possible to discover semantic segments without any user guidance in the form of text queries or predefined classes, and label them using natural language automatically? We propose a novel problem zero-guidance segmentation and the first baseline that leverages two pre-trained generalist models, DINO and CLIP, to solve this problem without any fine-tuning or segmentation dataset. The general idea is to first segment an image into small over-segments, encode them into CLIP's visual-language space, translate them into text labels, and merge semantically similar segments together. The key challenge, however, is how to encode a visual segment into a segment-specific embedding that balances global and local context information, both useful for recognition. Our main contribution is a novel attention-masking technique that balances the two contexts by analyzing the attention layers inside CLIP. We also introduce several metrics for the evaluation of this new task. With CLIP's innate knowledge, our method can precisely locate the Mona Lisa painting among a museum crowd.
authors: Pitchaporn Rewatbowornwong, Nattanat Chatthee, Ekapol Chuangsuwanich, Supasorn Suwajanakorn ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 1162-1172

title: Zip-NeRF:基于网格的抗混叠神经辐射场
title_en: Zip-NeRF: Anti-Aliased Grid-Based Neural Radiance Fields
abstract: 通过在NeRF的学习映射中使用基于网格的表示方法,可以加速神经辐射场的训练过程。然而,这些基于网格的方法缺乏对尺度的显式理解,因此通常会引入混叠现象,通常表现为锯齿或缺失的场景内容。抗混叠问题此前已被mip-NeRF 360所解决,该方法通过考虑圆锥体内的子体积而非射线上的点,但这种方法并不原生兼容当前的基于网格的技术。我们展示了如何结合渲染和信号处理领域的思想,构建一种结合mip-NeRF 360和基于网格的模型(如Instant NGP)的技术,该技术的误差率比前两种方法分别降低了8%-77%,且训练速度比mip-NeRF 360快24倍。
abstract_en: Neural Radiance Field training can be accelerated through the use of grid-based representations in NeRF's learned mapping from spatial coordinates to colors and volumetric density. However, these grid-based approaches lack an explicit understanding of scale and therefore often introduce aliasing, usually in the form of jaggies or missing scene content. Anti-aliasing has previously been addressed by mip-NeRF 360, which reasons about sub-volumes along a cone rather than points along a ray, but this approach is not natively compatible with current grid-based techniques. We show how ideas from rendering and signal processing can be used to construct a technique that combines mip-NeRF 360 and grid-based models such as Instant NGP to yield error rates that are 8%-77% lower than either prior technique, and that trains 24x faster than mip-NeRF 360.
authors: Jonathan T. Barron, Ben Mildenhall, Dor Verbin, Pratul P. Srinivasan, Peter Hedman ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19697-19705

title: Zolly:正确校正变焦焦距以实现透视失真人体网格重建
title_en: Zolly: Zoom Focal Length Correctly for Perspective-Distorted Human Mesh Reconstruction
abstract: 由于野外单视角RGB图像难以校准,现有3D人体网格重建(3DHMR)方法要么使用固定的大焦距,要么基于背景环境上下文估计焦距,这无法解决当相机靠近人体时,透视投影导致躯干、四肢、手部或面部失真的问题。错误的焦距假设会通过错误构建的投影矩阵损害该任务。为解决此问题,我们提出Zolly,这是首个专注于透视失真图像的3DHMR方法。我们的方法首先分析透视失真的原因,发现其主要由人体与相机中心的相对位置引起。我们提出新的相机模型和一种新颖的2D表示方法,称为失真图像,用于描述人体的2D密集失真尺度。随后,我们基于失真尺度特征而非环境上下文特征估计距离。之后,我们将失真特征与图像特征融合以重建人体网格。为构建正确的投影矩阵并定位人体位置,我们同时使用透视投影和弱透视投影损失。由于现有数据集无法处理此任务,我们提出首个合成数据集PDHuman,并扩展两个针对该任务的现实数据集,所有数据集均包含透视失真的人体图像。大量实验表明,Zolly在透视失真数据集和标准基准(3DPW)上均优于现有最先进方法。代码和数据集将在https://wenjiawang0312.github.io/projects/zolly/发布。
abstract_en: As it is hard to calibrate single-view RGB images in the wild, existing 3D human mesh reconstruction (3DHMR) methods either use a constant large focal length or estimate one based on the background environment context, which can not tackle the problem of the torso, limb, hand or face distortion caused by perspective camera projection when the camera is close to the human body. The naive focal length assumptions can harm this task with the incorrectly formulated projection matrices. To solve this, we propose Zolly, the first 3DHMR method focusing on perspective-distorted images. Our approach begins with analysing the reason for perspective distortion, which we find is mainly caused by the relative location of the human body to the camera center. We propose a new camera model and a novel 2D representation, termed distortion image, which describes the 2D dense distortion scale of the human body. We then estimate the distance from distortion scale features rather than environment context features. Afterwards, We integrate the distortion feature with image features to reconstruct the body mesh. To formulate the correct projection matrix and locate the human body position, we simultaneously use perspective and weak-perspective projection loss. Since existing datasets could not handle this task, we propose the first synthetic dataset PDHuman and extend two real-world datasets tailored for this task, all containing perspective-distorted human images. Extensive experiments show that Zolly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods on both perspective-distorted datasets and the standard benchmark (3DPW). Code and dataset will be released at https://wenjiawang0312.github.io/projects/zolly/.
authors: Wenjia Wang, Yongtao Ge, Haiyi Mei, Zhongang Cai, Qingping Sun, Yanjun Wang, Chunhua Shen, Lei Yang, Taku Komura ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 3925-3935

title: eP-ALM:语言模型的高效感知增强
title_en: eP-ALM: Efficient Perceptual Augmentation of Language Models
abstract: 大语言模型(LLMs)迄今为止已令人印象深刻,其在大规模模型中涌现出前所未有的能力。在视觉领域,Transformer模型(即ViT)也遵循这一趋势,在具有挑战性的基准测试中取得最佳性能。随着大量单模态模型的出现,一个自然的问题随之产生:是否也需要遵循这一趋势来处理多模态任务?在本工作中,我们提出应将努力方向转向现有模型的高效适配,并提出通过感知能力增强语言模型。现有的针对视觉-语言任务的预训练模型适配方法仍依赖于几个关键组件,这些组件阻碍了其效率。特别是,它们仍需训练大量参数,依赖大规模多模态预训练,使用在庞大图像-文本数据集上训练的编码器(如CLIP),并增加了显著的推理开销。此外,大多数方法都专注于零样本学习和上下文学习,对直接微调投入了极少或几乎没有努力。我们研究了将单模态模型适配为多模态任务所需的最小计算成本,并提出了一种新的具有挑战性的设置及多种方法,以高效地适配单模态预训练模型。我们表明,通过冻结超过99%的总参数、仅训练一个线性投影层,并仅添加一个可训练标记,我们的方法(称为eP-ALM)在图像、视频和音频模态的视觉问答(VQA)和图像描述生成(Captioning)任务中显著优于其他基线模型,遵循所提出的设置。代码已开源:https://github.com/mshukor/eP-ALM
abstract_en:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have so far impressed the world, with unprecedented capabilities that emerge in models at large scales. On the vision side, transformer models (i.e., ViT) are following the same trend, achieving the best performance on challenging benchmarks. With the abundance of such unimodal models, a natural question arises; do we need also to follow this trend to tackle multimodal tasks? In this work, we propose to rather direct effort to efficient adaptations of existing models, and propose to augment Language Models with perception. Existing approaches for adapting pretrained models for vision-language tasks still rely on several key components that hinder their efficiency. In particular, they still train a large number of parameters, rely on large multimodal pretraining, use encoders (e.g., CLIP) trained on huge image-text datasets, and add significant inference overhead. In addition, most of these approaches have focused on Zero-Shot and In Context Learning, with little to no effort on direct finetuning. We investigate the minimal computational effort needed to adapt unimodal models for multimodal tasks and propose a new challenging setup, alongside different approaches, that efficiently adapts unimodal pretrained models. 
 We show that by freezing more than 99% of total parameters, training only one linear projection layer, and prepending only one trainable token, our approach (dubbed eP-ALM) significantly outperforms other baselines on VQA and Captioning across Image, Video, and Audio modalities, following the proposed setup. The code is available here: https://github.com/mshukor/eP-ALM.
authors: Mustafa Shukor, Corentin Dancette, Matthieu Cord ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22056-22069

title: iDAG:用于领域泛化的不变DAG搜索
title_en: iDAG: Invariant DAG Searching for Domain Generalization
abstract: 现有机器学习(ML)模型在开放环境中往往脆弱,因为数据分布频繁变化。为解决这一问题,领域泛化(DG)旨在探索跨领域的底层不变模式以实现稳定预测。本工作中,我们首先指出传统ML模型在DG中的失效归因于对因果结构的识别不足。我们进一步提出一种新颖且具有理论基础的不变有向无环图(iDAG)搜索框架,通过不变图形关系作为内在数据生成过程因果结构的代理。为实现可计算性,iDAG基于一组代表性类条件原型构建约束优化目标。此外,我们集成了一种分层对比学习模块,该模块具有显著的聚类效果,可增强原型并提升预测稳定性。在合成数据和现实世界基准上的大量实验表明,iDAG优于现有最先进方法,验证了因果结构识别在领域泛化中的优越性。iDAG的代码可在https://github.com/lccurious/iDAG获取。
abstract_en: Existing machine learning (ML) models are often fragile in open environments because the data distribution frequently shifts. To address this problem, domain generalization (DG) aims to explore underlying invariant patterns for stable prediction across domains. In this work, we first characterize that this failure of conventional ML models in DG is attributed to an inadequate identification of causal structures. We further propose a novel and theoretically grounded invariant Directed Acyclic Graph (dubbed iDAG) searching framework that attains an invariant graphical relation as the proxy to the causality structure from the intrinsic data-generating process. To enable tractable computation, iDAG solves a constrained optimization objective built on a set of representative class-conditional prototypes. Additionally, we integrate a hierarchical contrastive learning module, which poses a strong effect of clustering, for enhanced prototypes as well as stabler prediction. Extensive experiments on the synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that iDAG outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches, verifying the superiority of causal structure identification for DG. The code of iDAG is available at https://github.com/lccurious/iDAG.
authors: Zenan Huang, Haobo Wang, Junbo Zhao, Nenggan Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 19169-19179

title: iVS-Net: 从互联网视频中学习人体视图合成
title_en: iVS-Net: Learning Human View Synthesis from Internet Videos
abstract: 近期在隐式神经表示领域的进展使得从稀疏视图图像生成自由视点视频成为可能。为避免针对每个人物进行昂贵的训练,先前方法采用可泛化的通用人体模型并取得了显著成果。然而,这些方法通常依赖于在工作室或商业高质量3D扫描中采集的有限多视角图像进行训练,这严重限制了其在野外图像中的泛化能力。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新方法,从互联网视频这一新的数据源中学习可泛化的人体模型。这些视频捕捉了各种人体外观和姿态,并从丰富视角记录表演者。为利用这些视频,我们提出了一种时间自监督管道,强制同一视频不同帧中每个身体部位的局部外观一致性。一旦学习完成,该人体模型即可从单张输入图像生成逼真自由视点视频。实验表明,我们的方法仅需单目视频训练即可在野外图像上生成高质量的视图合成。
abstract_en: Recent advances in implicit neural representations make it possible to generate free-viewpoint videos of the human from sparse view images. To avoid the expensive training for each person, previous methods adopt the generalizable human model and demonstrate impressive results. However, these methods usually rely on limited multi-view images typically collected in the studio or commercial high-quality 3D scans for training, which heavily prohibits their generalization capability for in-the-wild images. To solve this problem, we propose a new approach to learn a generalizable human model from a new source of data, i.e., Internet videos. These videos capture various human appearances and poses and record the performers from abundant viewpoints. To exploit these videos, we present a temporal self-supervised pipeline to enforce the local appearance consistency of each body part over different frames of the same video. Once learned, the human model enables creating photorealistic free-viewpoint videos from a single input image. Experiments show that our method can generate high-quality view synthesis on in-the-wild images while only training on monocular videos.
authors: Junting Dong, Qi Fang, Tianshuo Yang, Qing Shuai, Chengyu Qiao, Sida Peng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 22942-22951

title: s-自适应解耦原型用于少样本目标检测
title_en: s-Adaptive Decoupled Prototype for Few-Shot Object Detection
abstract: 基于元学习的少样本检测器在区域建议网络(RPN)和检测头(DH)中均使用一个K均值池化原型(沿K-shot维度进行平均)进行查询检测。这种简单操作会从两个方面损害FSOD性能:1)原型质量较差,2)由于RPN与DH之间的矛盾导致指导模糊。本文深入分析了这些关键问题,并提出s-自适应解耦原型(s-ADP)作为解决方案。为生成高质量原型,我们通过访问K支持样本的角度距离和幅度离散度(s),优先保留显著表征并弱化无关变化。为提供精确查询信息,原型被解耦为任务特定原型,分别提供"关注何处"和"关注何物"的定制化指导。此外,我们发现s-ADP可在元训练中逐步增强编码网络的泛化能力,使其在元测试阶段仅需简单的K均值池化即可生成高质量原型。我们提供了理论分析以支持其合理性。在Pascal VOC、MS-COCO和FSOD数据集上的大量实验表明,所提方法取得了新的SOTA性能。值得注意的是,我们的方法在新类别上超越基线模型达约5.0% AP50和8.0% AP75。
abstract_en:
Meta-learning-based few-shot detectors use one K-average-pooled prototype (averaging along K-shot dimension) in both Region Proposal Network (RPN) and Detection head (DH) for query detection. Such plain operation would harm the FSOD performance in two aspects: 1) the poor quality of the prototype, and 2) the equivocal guidance due to the contradictions between RPN and DH. In this paper, we look closely into those critical issues and propose the s-Adaptive Decoupled Prototype (s-ADP) as a solution. To generate the high-quality prototype, we prioritize salient representations and deemphasize trivial variations by accessing both angle distance and magnitude dispersion (s) across K-support samples. To provide precise information for the query image, the prototype is decoupled into task-specific ones, which provide tailored guidance for 'where to look' and 'what to look for', respectively. 
 Beyond that, we find our s-ADP can gradually strengthen the generalization power of encoding network during meta-training. So it can robustly deal with intra-class variations and a simple K- average pooling is enough to generate a high-quality prototype at meta-testing. We provide theoretical analysis to support its rationality. Extensive experiments on Pascal VOC, MS-COCO and FSOD datasets demonstrate that the proposed method achieves new state-of-the-art performance. Notably, our method surpasses the baseline model by a large margin - up to around 5.0% AP50 and 8.0% AP75 on novel classes.
authors: Jinhao Du, Shan Zhang, Qiang Chen, Haifeng Le, Yanpeng Sun, Yao Ni, Jian Wang, Bin He, Jingdong Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 18950-18960

title: uSplit:荧光显微镜图像分解
title_en: uSplit: Image Decomposition for Fluorescence Microscopy
abstract: 我们提出mSplit,一种专门用于荧光显微镜图像训练图像分解的专门方法。我们发现,使用常规深度架构时,当训练过程中采用大图像块时可以获得最佳结果,但内存消耗成为进一步提升性能的限制因素。因此,我们引入横向上下文化(LC),一种新颖的元架构,能够以内存高效的方式整合大图像上下文,我们观察到这是解决当前图像分解任务的关键要素。我们将LC与U-Nets、分层自编码器(Hierarchical AEs)和分层变分自编码器(Hierarchical VAEs)相结合,并为此制定了改进的ELBO损失函数。此外,LC使我们能够训练比常规方法更深层的层次模型,有趣的是,它还帮助减少在使用拼接VAE预测时固有的拼接伪影。我们将mSplit应用于五个分解任务,其中一个是合成数据集,另外四个来自真实显微镜数据。我们的方法在保持显著降低GPU内存需求的同时,始终取得最佳结果(平均比最佳基线提升2.25 dB PSNR)。我们的代码和数据集可在https://github.com/juglab/uSplit获取。
abstract_en: We present mSplit, a dedicated approach for trained image decomposition in the context of fluorescence microscopy images. We find that best results using regular deep architectures are achieved when large image patches are used during training, making memory consumption the limiting factor to further improving performance. We therefore introduce lateral contextualization (LC), a novel meta-architecture that enables the memory efficient incorporation of large image-context, which we observe is a key ingredient to solving the image decomposition task at hand. We integrate LC with U-Nets, Hierarchical AEs, and Hierarchical VAEs, for which we formulate a modified ELBO loss. Additionally, LC enables training deeper hierarchical models than otherwise possible and, interestingly, helps to reduce tiling artefacts that are inherently impossible to avoid when using tiled VAE predictions. We apply mSplit to five decomposition tasks, one on a synthetic dataset, four others derived from real microscopy data. Our method consistently achieves best results (average improvements to the best baseline of 2.25 dB PSNR), while simultaneously requiring considerably less GPU memory. Our code and datasets can be found at https://github.com/juglab/uSplit.
authors: Ashesh Ashesh, Alexander Krull, Moises Di Sante, Francesco Pasqualini, Florian Jug ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 21219-21229

title: zPROBE:面向联邦学习的零窥探鲁棒性检查
title_en: zPROBE: Zero Peek Robustness Checks for Federated Learning
abstract: 隐私保护的联邦学习允许多个用户在中央服务器的协调下联合训练模型。服务器仅学习最终的聚合结果,从而防止用户的(私有)训练数据通过个体模型更新泄露。然而,保持个体更新的私密性允许恶意用户在未被检测到的情况下降低模型精度,这种攻击也被称为拜占庭攻击。现有最佳防御拜占庭工作者的方法依赖于鲁棒的基于排名的统计量,例如通过更新的中位数设置鲁棒边界,以识别恶意更新。然而,实现隐私保护的基于排名的统计量,尤其是基于中位数的统计量,在安全领域实施起来并不容易且不可扩展,因为需要对所有个体更新进行排序。我们建立了首个基于聚合模型更新的高断点排名统计量的隐私保护鲁棒性检查。通过利用随机聚类,我们在不损害隐私的前提下显著提高了防御的可扩展性。我们利用推导出的统计边界在零知识证明中检测并移除恶意更新,而无需暴露私有用户更新。我们的创新框架zPROBE实现了拜占庭鲁棒且安全的联邦学习。我们在多个计算机视觉基准上展示了zPROBE的有效性。实证评估表明,zPROBE提供了一种低开销的解决方案,能够防御最先进的拜占庭攻击,同时保持隐私。
abstract_en: Privacy-preserving federated learning allows multiple users to jointly train a model with coordination of a central server. The server only learns the final aggregation result, thereby preventing leakage of the users' (private) training data from the individual model updates. However, keeping the individual updates private allows malicious users to degrade the model accuracy without being detected, also known as Byzantine attacks. Best existing defenses against Byzantine workers rely on robust rank-based statistics, e.g., setting robust bounds via the median of updates, to find malicious updates. However, implementing privacy-preserving rank-based statistics, especially median-based, is nontrivial and unscalable in the secure domain, as it requires sorting of all individual updates. We establish the first private robustness check that uses high break point rank-based statistics on aggregated model updates. By exploiting randomized clustering, we significantly improve the scalability of our defense without compromising privacy. We leverage the derived statistical bounds in zero-knowledge proofs to detect and remove malicious updates without revealing the private user updates. Our novel framework, zPROBE, enables Byzantine resilient and secure federated learning. We show the effectiveness of zPROBE on several computer vision benchmarks. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that zPROBE provides a low overhead solution to defend against state-of-the-art Byzantine attacks while preserving privacy.
authors: Zahra Ghodsi, Mojan Javaheripi, Nojan Sheybani, Xinqiao Zhang, Ke Huang, Farinaz Koushanfar ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 4860-4870

title: "主成分分析"赋能图像的新语言
title_en: "Principal Components" Enable A New Language of Images
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的视觉标记框架,将可证明的PCA类结构嵌入到潜在标记空间中。尽管现有视觉标记器主要优化重建保真度,但往往忽视潜在空间的结构属性——这对可解释性及下游任务至关重要。我们的方法为图像生成1D因果标记序列,其中每个后续标记以数学上保证的递减方差解释量提供非重叠信息,类似于主成分分析。这种结构约束确保标记器优先提取最显著的视觉特征,后续标记则逐步补充互补信息。此外,我们识别并解决了语义-光谱耦合效应,该效应会导致扩散解码器中高层语义内容与低层光谱细节的非期望纠缠。实验表明,我们的方法实现了最先进的重建性能,并能更好地与人类视觉系统对齐。此外,基于我们标记序列训练的自回归模型在性能上与当前最先进方法相当,同时训练和推理所需的标记数量更少。
abstract_en: We introduce a novel visual tokenization framework that embeds a provable PCA-like structure into the latent token space. While existing visual tokenizers primarily optimize for reconstruction fidelity, they often neglect the structural properties of the latent space--a critical factor for both interpretability and downstream tasks. Our method generates a 1D causal token sequence for images, where each successive token contributes non-overlapping information with mathematically guaranteed decreasing explained variance, analogous to principal component analysis. This structural constraint ensures the tokenizer extracts the most salient visual features first, with each subsequent token adding diminishing yet complementary information. Additionally, we identified and resolved a semantic-spectrum coupling effect that causes the unwanted entanglement of high-level semantic content and low-level spectral details in the tokens by leveraging a diffusion decoder. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance and enables better interpretability to align with the human vision system. Moreover, autoregressive models trained on our token sequences achieve performance comparable to current state-of-the-art methods while requiring fewer tokens for training and inference.
authors: Xin Wen, Bingchen Zhao, Ismail Elezi, Jiankang Deng, Xiaojuan Qi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16641-16651

title: 课堂中的两年半:一种用于视觉-语言预训练的多模态教材
title_en: 2.5 Years in Class: A Multimodal Textbook for Vision-Language Pretraining
abstract: 与图像-文本对数据相比,交错语料库使视觉-语言模型(VLMs)能够更自然地像人类一样理解世界。然而,现有数据集多通过网页爬取,面临知识密度低、图像-文本关系松散以及图像间逻辑连贯性差等挑战。另一方面,互联网上存在大量教学视频(如在线几何课程),这些资源被人类广泛用于学习基础学科,但尚未被充分应用于VLM训练。本文提出一种高质量的多模态教材语料库,包含更丰富的基础知识,用于VLM预训练。该语料库收集了超过2.5年的教学视频,总计22,000课时。我们首先利用大语言模型提出的分类体系系统性地采集教学视频,随后逐步提取并精炼视频中的视觉(关键帧)、音频(ASR)和文本知识(OCR),并基于时间顺序组织为交错的图像-文本语料库。与现有方法相比,以视频为中心的教材提供了更连贯的上下文、更丰富的知识以及更优的图像-文本对齐效果。实验表明其在知识密集型和推理密集型任务(如ScienceQA和MathVista)中展现出卓越的预训练性能。此外,基于本教材预训练的VLMs在交错上下文感知方面表现出色,能够利用少量样本上下文中的视觉和文本线索解决任务。代码和数据集可在https://multimodal-interleaved-textbook.github.io获取。
abstract_en: Compared to image-text pair data, interleaved corpora enable Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to understand the world more naturally like humans. However, such existing datasets are crawled from webpage, facing challenges like low knowledge density, loose image-text relations, and poor logical coherence between images. On the other hand, the internet hosts vast instructional videos (e.g., online geometry courses) that are widely used by humans to learn foundational subjects, yet these valuable resources remain underexplored in VLM training. In this paper, we introduce a high-quality multimodal textbook corpus with richer foundational knowledge for VLM pretraining. It collects over 2.5 years of instructional videos, totaling 22,000 class hours. We first use an LLM-proposed taxonomy to systematically gather instructional videos. Then we progressively extract and refine visual (keyframes), audio (ASR), and textual knowledge (OCR) from the videos, and organize as an image-text interleaved corpus based on temporal order. Compared to its counterparts, our video-centric textbook offers more coherent context, richer knowledge, and better image-text alignment. Experiments demonstrate its superb pretraining performance, particularly in knowledge- and reasoning-intensive tasks like ScienceQA and MathVista. Moreover, VLMs pre-trained on our textbook exhibit outstanding interleaved context awareness, leveraging visual and textual cues in their few-shot context for task solving. Code and dataset are available on https://multimodal-interleaved-textbook.github.io.
authors: Wenqi Zhang, Hang Zhang, Xin Li, Jiashuo Sun, Yongliang Shen, Weiming Lu, Deli Zhao, Yueting Zhuang, Lidong Bing ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4647-4658

title: 基于物理模拟的稀疏视角透明物体深度重建方法
title_en: 2D Gaussian Splatting-based Sparse-view Transparent Object Depth Reconstruction via Physics Simulation for Scene Update
abstract: 从RGB图像中理解透明物体的3D几何结构具有挑战性,因其固有的物理特性如反射和折射。为解决这些困难,特别是在稀疏视角和动态环境场景中,我们提出TRAN-D,一种基于2D高斯点云的透明物体深度重建方法。我们的核心洞察在于将透明物体与背景分离,从而对物体对应的高斯点进行针对性优化。我们通过物体感知损失缓解伪影,将高斯点放置在遮挡区域,确保覆盖不可见表面同时减少过拟合。此外,我们引入基于物理的模拟,在数秒内细化重建,有效处理物体移除和剩余物体的连锁运动,无需重新扫描。TRAN-D在合成和真实世界序列上进行了评估,始终展现出优于现有GS基线方法的显著改进。与基线方法相比,TRAN-D在合成TRansPose序列上将平均绝对误差降低了39%以上。此外,尽管仅使用单张图像进行更新,TRAN-D在d < 2.5 cm精度上达到48.46%,超过基线方法(使用六张图像)的1.5倍。代码和更多结果可访问https://jeongyun0609.github.io/TRAN-D/。
abstract_en: Understanding the 3D geometry of transparent objects from RGB images is challenging due to their inherent physical properties, such as reflection and refraction. To address these difficulties, especially in scenarios with sparse views and dynamic environments, we introduce TRAN-D, a novel 2D Gaussian Splatting-based depth reconstruction method for transparent objects. Our key insight lies in separating transparent objects from the background, enabling focused optimization of Gaussians corresponding to the object. We mitigate artifacts with an object-aware loss that places Gaussians in obscured regions, ensuring coverage of invisible surfaces while reducing overfitting. Furthermore, we incorporate a physics-based simulation that refines the reconstruction in just a few seconds, effectively handling object removal and chain-reaction movement of remaining objects without the need for rescanning. TRAN-D is evaluated on both synthetic and real-world sequences, and it consistently demonstrated robust improvements over existing GS-based state-of-the-art methods. In comparison with baselines, TRAN-D reduces the mean absolute error by over 39% for the synthetic TRansPose sequences. Furthermore, despite being updated using only one image, TRAN-D reaches a d < 2.5 cm accuracy of 48.46%, over 1.5 times that of baselines, which uses six images. Code and more results are available at https://jeongyun0609.github.io/TRAN-D/.
authors: Jeongyun Kim, Seunghoon Jeong, Giseop Kim, Myung-Hwan Jeon, Eunji Jun, Ayoung Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27927-27936

title: 2HandedAfforder: 从人类视频中学习精确的双手可操作性
title_en: 2HandedAfforder: Learning Precise Actionable Bimanual Affordances from Human Videos
abstract: 在与物体交互时,人类能够有效推理哪些物体区域适合执行预期动作,即物体的可操作性区域。他们还能根据执行任务的差异以及是否需要使用一只手或双手来区分物体区域的细微差别。然而,当前基于视觉的可操作性预测方法往往将问题简化为简单的对象部分分割。在本工作中,我们提出了一种从人类活动视频数据集中提取可操作性数据的框架。我们提取的2HANDS数据集包含精确的物体可操作性区域分割以及作为活动描述的可操作性类别标签。该数据还考虑了双手操作,即双手协调与一个或多个物体的交互。我们提出了基于视觉语言模型(VLM)的可操作性预测模型2HandedAfforder,并在该数据集上进行训练,展示了其在多种活动的可操作性区域分割任务中优于基线模型的性能。最后,我们通过在机器人操作场景中的演示,证明了所预测的可操作性区域具有可执行性,即可以用于执行任务的智能体。
abstract_en: When interacting with objects, humans effectively reason about which regions of objects are viable for an intended action, i.e., the affordance regions of the object. They can also account for subtle differences in object regions based on the task to be performed and whether one or two hands need to be used. However, current vision-based affordance prediction methods often reduce the problem to naive object part segmentation. In this work, we propose a framework for extracting affordance data from human activity video datasets. Our extracted 2HANDS dataset contains precise object affordance region segmentations and affordance class-labels as narrations of the activity performed. The data also accounts for bimanual actions, i.e., two hands co-ordinating and interacting with one or more objects. We present a VLM-based affordance prediction model, 2HandedAfforder, trained on the dataset and demonstrate superior performance over baselines in affordance region segmentation for various activities. Finally, we show that our predicted affordance regions are actionable, i.e., can be used by an agent performing a task, through demonstration in robotic manipulation scenarios.
authors: Marvin Heidinger, Snehal Jauhri, Vignesh Prasad, Georgia Chalvatzaki ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14743-14753

title: 基于开放集语义分组的三维高斯图视觉-语言导航
title_en: 3D Gaussian Map with Open-Set Semantic Grouping for Vision-Language Navigation
abstract: 视觉-语言导航(VLN)要求代理根据自然语言指令在复杂三维环境中移动,需要深入的场景理解。尽管现有工作为代理提供了多种场景表示以增强空间感知,但往往忽视了VLN场景中复杂的三维几何结构和丰富的语义信息,限制了在多样且未见过的环境中泛化能力。为解决这些挑战,本文提出一种三维高斯图,将环境表示为可微分的三维高斯分布,并相应地开发了VLN的导航策略。具体而言,通过从稀疏伪激光点云初始化三维高斯分布,构建在线以自我为中心的场景图,为场景理解提供信息几何先验。每个高斯基元进一步通过开放集语义分组操作进行丰富,该操作基于开放世界中物体实例或stuff类别的成员关系对三维高斯分布进行分组,形成统一的三维高斯图。在此图基础上,设计了结合多粒度空间-语义线索的多级动作预测策略,以辅助代理决策。在三个公开基准(即R2R、R4R和REVERIE)上的大量实验验证了本文方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Vision-language navigation (VLN) requires an agent to traverse complex 3D environments based on natural language instructions, necessitating a thorough scene understanding. While existing works equip agents with various scene representations to enhance spatial awareness, they often neglect the complex 3D geometry and rich semantics in VLN scenarios, limiting the ability to generalize across diverse and unseen environments. To address these challenges, this work proposes a 3D Gaussian Map that represents the environment as a set of differentiable 3D Gaussians and accordingly develops a navigation strategy for VLN. Specifically, Egocentric Scene Map is constructed online by initializing 3D Gaussians from sparse pseudo-lidar point clouds, providing informative geometric priors for scene understanding. Each Gaussian primitive is further enriched through Open-Set Semantic Grouping operation, which groups 3D Gaussians based on their membership in object instances or stuff categories within the open world, resulting in a unified 3D Gaussian Map. Building on this map, Multi-Level Action Prediction strategy, which combines spatial-semantic cues at multiple granularities, is designed to assist agents in decision-making. Extensive experiments conducted on three public benchmarks (i.e., R2R, R4R, and REVERIE) validate the effectiveness of our method.
authors: Jianzhe Gao, Rui Liu, Wenguan Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9252-9262

title: 基于三维高斯点云的多视角鲁棒物理对抗性伪装生成方法
title_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting Driven Multi-View Robust Physical Adversarial Camouflage Generation
abstract: 物理对抗攻击方法暴露了深度神经网络的脆弱性,对自动驾驶等安全关键场景构成重大威胁。基于伪装的物理攻击相比贴片式攻击更具前景,能在复杂物理环境中实现更强的对抗效果。然而,多数前期工作依赖目标物体的网格先验和模拟器构建的虚拟环境,这些获取过程耗时且与现实世界存在差异。此外,由于训练图像背景的限制,先前方法常无法生成多视角鲁棒的对抗性伪装,易陷入局部最优解。鉴于上述原因,前期工作在多视角和物理环境下的对抗有效性与鲁棒性存在不足。我们提出基于三维高斯点云(3DGS)的物理攻击框架PGA,可在少量图像下实现快速精确重建并具备照片级渲染能力。框架通过防止高斯点间的相互与自遮挡,并采用最小-最大优化方法调整各视角成像背景,帮助算法过滤非鲁棒对抗性特征,进一步提升跨视角鲁棒性与对抗有效性。大量实验验证了PGA的有效性与优越性。我们的代码开源地址为:https://github.com/TRLou/PGA
abstract_en: Physical adversarial attack methods expose the vulnerabilities of deep neural networks and pose a significant threat to safety-critical scenarios such as autonomous driving. Camouflage-based physical attack is a more promising approach compared to the patch-based attack, offering stronger adversarial effectiveness in complex physical environments. However, most prior work relies on mesh priors of the target object and virtual environments constructed by simulators, which are time-consuming to obtain and inevitably differ from the real world. Moreover, due to the limitations of the backgrounds in training images, previous methods often fail to produce multi-view robust adversarial camouflage and tend to fall into sub-optimal solutions. Due to these reasons, prior work lacks adversarial effectiveness and robustness across diverse viewpoints and physical environments. We propose a physical attack framework based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), named PGA, which provides rapid and precise reconstruction with few images, along with photo-realistic rendering capabilities. Our framework further enhances cross-view robustness and adversarial effectiveness by preventing mutual and self-occlusion among Gaussians and employing a min-max optimization approach that adjusts the imaging background of each viewpoint, helping the algorithm filter out non-robust adversarial features. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness and superiority of PGA. Our code is available at: https://github.com/TRLou/PGA.
authors: Tianrui Lou, Xiaojun Jia, Siyuan Liang, Jiawei Liang, Ming Zhang, Yanjun Xiao, Xiaochun Cao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28752-28762

title: 基于掩码大重建模型的3D网格编辑
title_en: 3D Mesh Editing using Masked LRMs
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的网格形状编辑方法,该方法建立在近期多视角图像三维重建技术进展的基础上。我们将形状编辑形式化为一个条件重建问题,其中模型必须在指定的3D区域外重建输入形状,而在该区域中,几何结构应从条件信号生成。为此,我们使用从随机生成的3D遮挡渲染得到的多视角一致掩码,训练一个条件大重建模型(LRM)进行掩码重建,并将一个干净视角作为条件信号。在推理过程中,我们手动定义要编辑的3D区域,并提供一个规范视角的编辑图像以填充该区域。我们证明,通过单次前向传播,我们的方法不仅在未掩码区域通过与SOTA相当的重建能力保留输入几何结构,而且还能从单张图像引导中执行多种网格编辑操作,这超越了以往方法的局限性,同时比最先进方法快2-10倍。
