We introduce a novel active selection criterion to select the most valuable samples for annotation on seen classes, which not only considers both uncertainty and diversity of unlabeled samples, but also ensures that the generated prototypes of ProZS can effectively summarize both seen and unseen classes during inference. We evaluate our method on two pathology datasets (TNBC and HPBC) as well as a natural dataset (Pascal VOC 2012), and the experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our method in comparison with the existing studies.
authors: Jiao Tang, Junjie Zhou, Bo Qian, Peng Wan, Yingli Zuo, Wei Shao, Daoqiang Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23508-23518

title: 通过零样本注意力键剪枝加速3D目标检测模型
title_en: Accelerate 3D Object Detection Models via Zero-Shot Attention Key Pruning
abstract: 基于查询且具有密集特征的方法在3D目标检测任务中表现出显著优势。然而,这些模型的计算需求,尤其是在大尺寸图像和多层Transformer结构下,对边缘设备的高效运行构成重大挑战。现有剪枝和蒸馏方法要么需要重新训练,要么专为ViT模型设计,难以迁移到3D检测器。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种针对3D目标检测模型中Transformer解码器的零样本运行时剪枝方法。该方法称为tgGBC(基于分类分数逐步引导的键修剪),通过分类分数扩展并将其与注意力图相乘,得到每个键的重要性分数,随后根据重要性分数在每个Transformer层中剪枝部分键。我们的方法在最新ToC3D模型的Transformer解码器中实现了1.99倍的速度提升,仅损失不到1%的性能。有趣的是,对于某些模型,该方法甚至提升了其性能。此外,我们将带有tgGBC的3D检测器部署在边缘设备上,进一步验证了方法的有效性。代码可在https://github.com/iseri27/tg_gbc获取。
abstract_en: Query-based methods with dense features have demonstrated remarkable success in 3D object detection tasks. However, the computational demands of these models, particularly with large image sizes and multiple transformer layers, pose significant challenges for efficient running on edge devices. Existing pruning and distillation methods either need retraining or are designed for ViT models, which are hard to migrate to 3D detectors. To address this issue, we propose a zero-shot runtime pruning method for transformer decoders in 3D object detection models. The method, termed tgGBC (trim keys gradually Guided By Classification scores), systematically trims keys in transformer modules based on their importance. We expand the classification score to multiply it with the attention map to get the importance score of each key and then prune certain keys after each transformer layer according to their importance scores. Our method achieves a 1.99x speedup in the transformer decoder of the latest ToC3D model, with only a minimal performance loss of less than 1%. Interestingly, for certain models, our method even enhances their performance. Moreover, we deploy 3D detectors with tgGBC on an edge device, further validating the effectiveness of our method. The code can be found at https://github.com/iseri27/tg_gbc.
authors: Lizhen Xu, Xiuxiu Bai, Xiaojun Jia, Jianwu Fang, Shanmin Pang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23085-23094

title: 通过利用局部转移一致性加速扩散采样
title_en: Accelerating Diffusion Sampling via Exploiting Local Transition Coherence
abstract: 基于文本的扩散模型在从文本描述生成高质量图像和视频方面取得了显著突破。然而,去噪过程的长时间采样仍然是实际应用中的重要瓶颈。先前方法要么忽略相邻步骤间的统计关系,要么依赖于它们之间的注意力或特征相似性,这通常仅适用于特定网络结构。为解决这一问题,我们发现相邻步骤间转移算子中存在新的统计关系,重点关注网络输出之间的关系。该关系对网络结构无任何要求。基于这一观察,我们提出了一种名为LTC-Accel的无训练加速方法,利用识别的关系通过相邻步骤估计当前转移算子。由于对网络结构无特定假设,LTC-Accel可适用于几乎所有基于扩散的方法,并与现有几乎所有加速技术正交,便于与之结合。实验结果表明,LTC-Accel在文本到图像和文本到视频合成中显著加速采样过程,同时保持具有竞争力的样本质量。具体而言,LTC-Accel在Stable Diffusion v2中实现1.67倍加速,在视频生成模型中实现1.55倍加速。当与蒸馏模型结合时,LTC-Accel在视频生成中实现显著的10倍加速,允许超过16 FPS的实时生成。我们的代码(包含Colab版本)可在https://zhushangwen.github.io/LTC-accel.io/获取。
abstract_en: Text-based diffusion models have made significant breakthroughs in generating high-quality images and videos from textual descriptions. However, the lengthy sampling time of the denoising process remains a significant bottleneck in practical applications. Previous methods either ignore the statistical relationships between adjacent steps or rely on attention or feature similarity between them, which often only works with specific network structures. To address this issue, we discover a new statistical relationship in the transition operator between adjacent steps, focusing on the relationship of the outputs from the network. This relationship does not impose any requirements on the network structure. Based on this observation, we propose a novel training-free acceleration method called LTC-Accel, which uses the identified relationship to estimate the current transition operator based on adjacent steps. Due to no specific assumptions regarding the network structure, LTC-Accel is applicable to almost all diffusion-based methods and orthogonal to almost all existing acceleration techniques, making it easy to combine with them. Experimental results demonstrate that LTC-Accel significantly speeds up sampling in text-to-image and text-to-video synthesis while maintaining competitive sample quality. Specifically, LTC-Accel achieves a speedup of 1.67 times in Stable Diffusion v2 and a speedup of 1.55 times in video generation models. When combined with distillation models, LTC-Accel achieves a remarkable 10 times speedup in video generation, allowing real-time generation of more than 16 FPS. Our code (include colab version) is available on https://zhushangwen.github.io/LTC-accel.io/.
authors: Shangwen Zhu, Han Zhang, Zhantao Yang, Qianyu Peng, Zhao Pu, Huangji Wang, Fan Cheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18284-18293

title: 通过梯度优化缓存加速扩散变换器
title_en: Accelerating Diffusion Transformer via Gradient-Optimized Cache
abstract: 特征缓存已作为一种有效策略被提出,通过时间特征复用加速扩散变换器(DiT)采样。这是一个具有挑战性的问题,因为(1)从缓存块中产生的渐进误差累积显著降低了生成质量,特别是在超过50%的块被缓存时;(2)当前的误差补偿方法忽略了缓存过程中动态扰动模式,导致次优的误差校正。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了梯度优化缓存(GOC),包含两个关键创新:(1)缓存梯度传播:梯度队列动态计算缓存特征与重新计算特征之间的梯度差异。这些梯度被加权并传播到后续步骤,直接补偿缓存引入的近似误差。(2)拐点感知优化:通过对特征变化模式的统计分析,我们识别出去噪轨迹方向变化的关键拐点。通过将梯度更新与检测到的阶段对齐,我们防止了误差校正过程中的梯度方向冲突。在ImageNet上的广泛评估表明,GOC在效率与质量之间实现了优越的平衡。在50%缓存块的情况下,GOC相比基线DiT实现了IS 216.28(26.3%|)和FID 3.907(43%|),同时保持相同的计算成本。这些改进在各种缓存比例下持续存在,证明了GOC对不同加速需求的鲁棒适应性。代码可在https://github.com/qiujx0520/GOC_ICCV2025.git获取。
abstract_en: Feature caching has emerged as an effective strategy to accelerate diffusion transformer (DiT) sampling through temporal feature reuse. It is a challenging problem since (1) Progressive error accumulation from cached blocks significantly degrades generation quality, particularly when over 50% of blocks are cached; (2) Current error compensation approaches neglect dynamic perturbation patterns during the caching process, leading to suboptimal error correction. To solve these problems, we propose the Gradient-Optimized Cache (GOC) with two key innovations: (1) Cached Gradient Propagation: A gradient queue dynamically computes the gradient differences between cached and recomputed features. These gradients are weighted and propagated to subsequent steps, directly compensating for the approximation errors introduced by caching. (2) Inflection-Aware Optimization: Through statistical analysis of feature variation patterns, we identify critical inflection points where the denoising trajectory changes direction. By aligning gradient updates with these detected phases, we prevent conflicting gradient directions during error correction. Extensive evaluations on ImageNet demonstrate GOC's superior trade-off between efficiency and quality. With 50% cached blocks, GOC achieves IS 216.28 (26.3%|) and FID 3.907 (43%|) compared to baseline DiT, while maintaining identical computational costs. These improvements persist across various cache ratios, demonstrating robust adaptability to different acceleration requirements. Code is available at https://github.com/qiujx0520/GOC_ICCV2025.git.
authors: Junxiang Qiu, Lin Liu, Shuo Wang, Jinda Lu, Kezhou Chen, Yanbin Hao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17608-17617

title: AccidentalGS: 从意外相机运动中实现三维高斯点云
title_en: AccidentalGS: 3D Gaussian Splatting from Accidental Camera Motion
abstract: 基于神经辐射场(NeRF)或三维高斯点云(3DGS)的神经三维建模与新视角合成通常需要宽基线且具有准确相机姿态的多视角图像作为输入。然而,针对意外相机运动的场景研究较少。本文提出AccidentalGS,这是首个从意外相机运动中实现神经三维建模与新视角合成的方法。为实现该目标,我们提出了一种新颖的联合优化框架,考虑几何和光度误差,采用简化的相机模型以提高稳定性。我们还引入了一种新颖的在线自适应深度一致性损失,以防止高斯模型对输入图像的过拟合。在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明,与现有方法相比,AccidentalGS实现了更精确的相机姿态和更逼真的新视角,并支持对月球等天体的三维建模和神经渲染,即使仅使用望远镜类图像。
abstract_en: Neural 3D modeling and novel view synthesis with Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) or 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) typically requires the multi-view images with wide baselines and accurate camera poses as input. However, scenarios with accidental camera motions are rarely studied. In this paper, we propose AccidentalGS, the first method for neural 3D modeling and novel view synthesis from accidental camera motions. To achieve this, we present a novel joint optimization framework that considers geometric and photometric errors, using a simplified camera model for stability. We also introduce a novel online adaptive depth-consistency loss to prevent the overfitting of the Gaussian model to input images. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets show that AccidentalGS achieves more accurate camera poses and realistic novel views compared to existing methods, and supports 3D modeling and neural rendering even for the Moon with telescope-like images.
authors: Mao Mao, Xujie Shen, Guyuan Chen, Boming Zhao, Jiarui Hu, Hujun Bao, Zhaopeng Cui ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27445-27455

title: 以更少实现更多:无需回放的类增量学习中的加法提示调优
title_en: Achieving More with Less: Additive Prompt Tuning for Rehearsal-Free Class-Incremental Learning
abstract: 类增量学习(CIL)使模型能够逐步学习新类别同时保留先前学习的知识。该领域的最新进展转向了参数高效微调技术,许多方法基于维护可学习提示池的框架。尽管有效,这些方法引入了显著的计算开销,主要源于提示池查询和提示拼接导致的输入序列长度增加。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新型基于提示的方法以解决这一限制。我们的方法在所有任务中训练单一共享提示集,而非将提示拼接到输入中,而是通过将提示直接添加到CLS标记的注意力计算中进行修改。这种简单且轻量的设计不仅显著降低了计算复杂度——在推理成本和可训练参数数量方面均如此——还消除了为不同下游任务优化提示长度的必要性,为无需回放的类增量学习提供了一种更高效且强大的解决方案。在多种CIL基准数据集上的广泛实验验证了我们方法的有效性,凸显了其建立新型基于提示的CIL范式的潜力。此外,在CIL设置之外的一般识别基准实验也表现出强劲性能,使我们的方法成为通用参数高效微调方法的有前景候选方案。
abstract_en: Class-incremental learning (CIL) enables models to learn new classes progressively while preserving knowledge of previously learned ones. Recent advances in this field have shifted towards parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques, with many approaches building upon the framework that maintains a pool of learnable prompts. Although effective, these methods introduce substantial computational overhead, primarily due to prompt pool querying and increased input sequence lengths from prompt concatenation. In this work, we present a novel prompt-based approach that addresses this limitation. Our method trains a single set of shared prompts across all tasks and, rather than concatenating prompts to the input, directly modifies the CLS token's attention computation by adding the prompts to it. This simple and lightweight design not only significantly reduces computational complexity--both in terms of inference costs and the number of trainable parameters--but also eliminates the need to optimize prompt lengths for different downstream tasks, offering a more efficient yet powerful solution for rehearsal-free class-incremental learning. Extensive experiments across a diverse range of CIL benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, highlighting its potential to establish a new prompt-based CIL paradigm. Furthermore, experiments on general recognition benchmarks beyond the CIL setting also show strong performance, positioning our method as a promising candidate for a general parameter-efficient fine-tuning approach.
authors: Haoran Chen, Ping Wang, Zihan Zhou, Xu Zhang, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 340-349

title: 视觉问题中的焦点歧义识别
title_en: Acknowledging Focus Ambiguity in Visual Questions
abstract: 目前尚无已发表的视觉问答(VQA)研究考虑问题中描述内容在图像中的位置存在歧义。为填补这一空白,我们引入了VQ-FocusAmbiguity数据集,这是首个在视觉上定位每个可能图像区域的数据集,这些区域是当问题得出有效答案时可能被引用的。随后,我们分析并比较该数据集与现有数据集,揭示其独特属性。最后,我们针对两个与识别焦点歧义相关的新型任务对现代模型进行基准测试:判断视觉问题是否存在焦点歧义,以及定位图像中所有可能的焦点区域。结果表明该数据集对现代模型具有挑战性。为促进未来在这些任务上的进展,我们公开分享该数据集及评估服务器,网址为https://vizwiz.org/tasks-and-datasets/focus-ambiguity-in-visual-questions/。
abstract_en: No published work on visual question answering (VQA) accounts for ambiguity regarding where the content described in the question is located in the image. To fill this gap, we introduce VQ-FocusAmbiguity, the first VQA dataset that visually grounds each plausible image region a question could refer to when arriving at valid answers. We next analyze and compare our dataset to existing datasets to reveal its unique properties. Finally, we benchmark modern models for two novel tasks related to acknowledging focus ambiguity: recognizing whether a visual question has focus ambiguity and locating all plausible focus regions within the image. Results show that the dataset is challenging for modern models. To facilitate future progress on these tasks, we publicly share the dataset with an evaluation server at https://vizwiz.org/tasks-and-datasets/focus-ambiguity-in-visual-questions/.
authors: Chongyan Chen, Yu-Yun Tseng, Zhuoheng Li, Anush Venkatesh, Danna Gurari ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1228-1238

title: 激活子空间用于分布外检测
title_en: Activation Subspaces for Out-of-Distribution Detection
abstract: 为确保深度模型在现实应用中的可靠性,分布外(OOD)检测方法旨在区分接近训练分布(分布内,ID)的样本与距离更远的样本(OOD)。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新颖的OOD检测方法,利用分类头权重矩阵的奇异值分解,将模型激活分解为关键成分和不显著成分,分别对最终分类器输出贡献最大和最小。我们发现,在大分布偏移(Far-OOD)情况下,不显著成分子空间比原始激活更有效地区分ID与OOD数据。这是因为分类目标对不显著子空间影响较小,产生"未受目标分类任务污染"的特征。相反,在小分布偏移(Near-OOD)情况下,我们发现仅考虑关键子空间的激活塑造方法更有利,因为不显著成分可能在激活空间中造成干扰。通过将这两个发现整合为一种方法(称为ActSub),我们在各种标准OOD基准测试中实现了最先进的结果。
abstract_en: To ensure the reliability of deep models in real-world applications, out-of-distribution (OOD) detection methods aim to distinguish samples close to the training distribution (in-distribution, ID) from those farther away (OOD). In this work, we propose a novel OOD detection method that utilizes singular value decomposition of the weight matrix of the classification head to decompose the model's activations into decisive and insignificant components, which contribute maximally, respectively minimally, to the final classifier output. We find that the subspace of insignificant components more effectively distinguishes ID from OOD data than raw activations in regimes of large distribution shifts (Far-OOD). This occurs because the classification objective leaves the insignificant subspace largely unaffected, yielding features that are "untainted" by the target classification task. Conversely, in regimes of smaller distribution shifts (Near-OOD), we find that activation shaping methods profit from only considering the decisive subspace, as the insignificant component can cause interference in the activation space. By combining two findings into a single approach, termed ActSub, we achieve state-of-the-art results in various standard OOD benchmarks.
authors: Barış Zöngür, Robin Hesse, Stefan Roth ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3509-3519

title: 主动学习与基础模型的结合:遥感数据快速标注方法用于目标检测
title_en: Active Learning Meets Foundation Models: Fast Remote Sensing Data Annotation for Object Detection
abstract: 遥感中的目标检测需要大量高质量的标注——这一过程既劳动密集又耗时。在本工作中,我们引入了一种实时主动学习与半自动标注框架,利用基础模型简化遥感影像目标检测数据集的标注流程。例如,通过集成Segment Anything Model (SAM),我们的方法生成基于掩码的边界框,作为双采样的基础:(a) 不确定性估计以定位具有挑战性的样本,(b) 多样性评估以确保广泛的数据覆盖。此外,我们的动态边界框切换模块(DBS)通过用SAM生成的掩码替换次优的初始预测,解决了目标检测模型中众所周知的冷启动问题,从而提升早期定位精度。在多个遥感数据集及实际用户研究中的广泛评估表明,我们的框架不仅减少了标注工作量,还显著优于传统主动学习采样方法的检测性能。训练代码和用户界面将公开提供。
abstract_en: Object detection in remote sensing demands extensive, high-quality annotations--a process that is both labor-intensive and time-consuming. In this work, we introduce a real-time active learning and semi-automated labeling framework that leverages foundation models to streamline dataset annotation for object detection in remote sensing imagery. For example, by integrating a Segment Anything Model (SAM), our approach generates mask-based bounding boxes that serve as the basis for dual sampling: (a) uncertainty estimation to pinpoint challenging samples, and (b) diversity assessment to ensure broad data coverage. Furthermore, our Dynamic Box Switching Module (DBS) addresses the well-known cold start problem for object detection models by replacing its suboptimal initial predictions with SAM-derived masks, thereby enhancing early-stage localization accuracy. Extensive evaluations on multiple remote sensing datasets plus a real-world user study, demonstrate that our framework not only reduces annotation effort, but also significantly boosts detection performance compared to traditional active learning sampling methods. The code for training and the user interface will be made available.
authors: Marvin Burges, Philipe Ambrozio Dias, Carson Woody, Sarah Walters, Dalton Lunga ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6058-6068

title: 主动成员推理测试(aMINT):利用多任务学习增强模型可审计性
title_en: Active Membership Inference Test (aMINT): Enhancing Model Auditability with Multi-Task Learning.
abstract: 主动成员推理测试(aMINT)是一种旨在检测给定数据是否在机器学习模型训练过程中使用的方法。在主动MINT中,我们提出了一种新颖的多任务学习过程,该过程同时训练两个模型:原始或被审计模型,以及一个称为MINT模型的辅助模型,负责识别用于训练被审计模型的数据。这种新颖的多任务学习方法在神经网络训练过程中将模型的可审计性作为优化目标进行设计。所提出的方法将中间激活图作为输入传递给MINT层,这些层经过训练以增强对训练数据的检测能力。我们在5个公开基准上评估了从轻量级架构(如MobileNet)到复杂架构(如Vision Transformers)的广泛神经网络。我们的主动MINT方法在检测给定数据是否用于训练时实现了超过80%的准确率,显著优于文献中的先前方法。我们的aMINT及相关方法论发展有助于提升AI模型的透明度,为AI部署提供更强的保障,以实现适当的网络安全、隐私保护和版权保护(代码可用在https://github.com/DanieldeAlcala/Membership-Inference-Test.git)
abstract_en: Active Membership Inference Test (aMINT) is a method designed to detect whether given data were used during the training of machine learning models. In Active MINT, we propose a novel multitask learning process that involves training simultaneously two models: the original or Audited Model, and a secondary model, referred to as the MINT Model, responsible for identifying the data used for training the Audited Model. This novel multi-task learning approach has been designed to incorporate the auditability of the model as an optimization objective during the training process of neural networks. The proposed approach incorporates intermediate activation maps as inputs to the MINT layers, which are trained to enhance the detection of training data. We present results using a wide range of neural networks, from lighter architectures such as MobileNet to more complex ones such as Vision Transformers, evaluated in 5 public benchmarks. Our proposed Active MINT achieves over 80% accuracy in detecting if given data was used for training, significantly outperforming previous approaches in the literature. Our aMINT and related methodological developments contribute to increasing transparency in AI models, facilitating stronger safeguards in AI deployments to achieve proper security, privacy, and copyright protection (Code available in https://github.com/DanieldeAlcala/Membership-Inference-Test.git)
authors: Daniel DeAlcala, Aythami Morales, Julian Fierrez, Gonzalo Mancera, Ruben Tolosana, Javier Ortega-Garcia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 647-656

title: 主动感知与规则引导强化学习结合:复杂环境中的精确物体导航两阶段方法
title_en: Active Perception Meets Rule-Guided RL: A Two-Phase Approach for Precise Object Navigation in Complex Environments
abstract: 未知环境中的物体目标导航(ObjectNav)面临重大挑战,特别是在开放词汇移动操作(OVMM)中,机器人需要高效探索大空间、定位小型物体,并准确定位以进行后续操作。现有方法难以满足这些需求:基于规则的方法提供结构化探索但缺乏适应性,而基于强化学习(RL)的方法增强适应性却无法确保有效的长期导航。此外,两种方法通常忽视精确停止位置,这对成功操作至关重要。为解决这些挑战,我们提出APRR(主动感知与规则引导强化学习结合),一个两阶段框架,设计了新的规则引导强化学习策略用于探索阶段,以及新颖的主动目标感知策略用于最后一公里导航阶段。受人类搜索行为启发,我们的规则引导强化学习策略通过结合结构化启发式方法与基于学习的决策制定,实现高效且自适应的探索。在最后一公里导航阶段,我们引入了增强主动目标感知的强化学习策略,使机器人能够根据实时检测反馈动态调整位置。实验结果表明,APRR将成功率提高了13%,显著优于现有方法。此外,现实世界实验验证了APRR在实际移动操作场景中的实用性和有效性,为精确物体导航提供了稳健且可适应的解决方案。代码可在https://github.com/qinliangql/APRR获取。
abstract_en: Object Goal Navigation (ObjectNav) in unknown environments presents significant challenges, particularly in Open-Vocabulary Mobile Manipulation (OVMM), where robots must efficiently explore large spaces, locate small objects, and accurately position themselves for subsequent manipulation. Existing approaches struggle to meet these demands: rule-based methods offer structured exploration but lack adaptability, while reinforcement learning (RL)-based methods enhance adaptability but fail to ensure effective long-term navigation. Moreover, both approaches often overlook precise stopping positions, which are critical for successful manipulation.To address these challenges, we propose APRR (Active Perception Meets Rule-Guided RL), a two-phase framework that designs a new rule-guided RL policy for the exploration phase and a novel active target perception policy for the last-mile navigation phase. Inspired by human search behavior, our rule-guided RL policy enables efficient and adaptive exploration by combining structured heuristics with learning-based decision-making. In the last-mile navigation phase, we introduce an RL-based policy enhanced with active target perception, allowing the robot to refine its position dynamically based on real-time detection feedback. Experimental results demonstrate that APRR improves the success rate by 13%, significantly outperforming existing methods. Furthermore, real-world experiments validate the practicality and effectiveness of APRR in real-world mobile manipulation scenarios, offering a robust and adaptable solution for precise object navigation. The code is available at https://github.com/qinliangql/APRR.
authors: Liang Qin, Min Wang, Peiwei Li, Wengang Zhou, Houqiang Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7603-7612

title: AdaDCP: 基于离散余弦先验学习适配器的清晰到恶劣环境领域泛化
title_en: AdaDCP: Learning an Adapter with Discrete Cosine Prior for Clear-to-Adverse Domain Generalization
abstract: 视觉基础模型(VFM)为下游任务提供了对未见领域的固有泛化能力。然而,将VFM微调以解析各种恶劣场景(如雾、雪、夜间)极具挑战性,因为这些样本难以收集。使用易于获取的清晰场景作为源域是可行方案,但清晰与恶劣场景之间存在巨大的领域差距,因其外观差异显著。为解决这一挑战,本文提出AdaDCP,一种具有离散余弦先验的VFM适配器。创新点源于观察到,VFM的频率成分在离散余弦变换后,对恶劣天气条件表现出变异性或不变性特性。技术上,天气不变性属性学习感知了大部分与恶劣条件无关的场景内容;而天气变异性属性学习则感知不同恶劣条件的特定天气信息。最后,天气不变性属性对齐隐式强制天气变异性成分融合天气不变性信息,从而缓解清晰到恶劣领域的差距。在八个未见恶劣场景分割数据集上的实验验证了其最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Vision Foundation Model (VFM) provides an inherent generalization ability to unseen domains for downstream tasks. However, fine-tuning VFM to parse various adverse scenes (e.g., fog, snow, night) is particularly challenging, as these samples are difficult to collect. Using easy-to-acquire clear scenes as the source domain is a feasible solution, but a huge domain gap exists between clear and adverse scenes due to their dramatically different appearances. To address this challenge, this paper proposes AdaDCP, a VFM adapter with discrete cosine prior. The innovation originates from the observation that, the frequency components from a VFM exhibit either variant or invariant properties on adverse weather conditions after discrete cosine transform. Technically, the weather-invariant property learning preceives most of the scene content that is invariant to the adverse condition. The weather-variant property learning, in contrast, perceives the weather-specific information from different types of adverse conditions. Finally, the weather-invariant property alignment implicitly enforces the weather-variant components to incorporate the weather-invariant information, therefore mitigating the clear-to-adverse domain gap. Experiments conducted on eight unseen adverse scene segmentation datasets show its state-of-the-art performance.
authors: Qi Bi, Yixian Shen, Jingjun Yi, Gui-Song Xia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12997-13008

title: AdaDrive:一种自适应慢快系统用于基于语言的自主驾驶
title_en: AdaDrive: Self-Adaptive Slow-Fast System for Language-Grounded Autonomous Driving
abstract: 将大型语言模型(LLMs)有效整合到自动驾驶系统中需要在利用高级推理能力与保持实时效率之间取得平衡。现有方法要么过于频繁地激活LLMs导致计算开销过大,要么采用固定调度策略无法适应动态驾驶场景。为解决这些挑战,我们提出AdaDrive,一种自适应协作的慢快框架,可优化LLMs在决策过程中的贡献时机与方式。(1) 激活时机:AdaDrive采用新颖的自适应激活损失,基于比较学习机制动态决定LLM调用,仅在复杂或关键场景激活。(2) 整合方式:不同于刚性的二元激活,AdaDrive引入自适应融合策略,根据场景复杂度和预测置信度调节连续缩放的LLM影响,确保与传统规划器无缝协作。通过这些策略,AdaDrive提供了一种灵活的上下文感知框架,在保证实时性能的同时最大化决策准确性。在基于语言的自动驾驶基准测试中,大量实验验证了AdaDrive在驾驶准确性和计算效率方面均达到最先进水平。代码已开源至https://github.com/ReaFly/AdaDrive。
abstract_en: Effectively integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into autonomous driving requires a balance between leveraging high-level reasoning and maintaining real-time efficiency. Existing approaches either activate LLMs too frequently, causing excessive computational overhead, or use fixed schedules, failing to adapt to dynamic driving conditions. To address these challenges, we propose AdaDrive, an adaptively collaborative slow-fast framework that optimally determines when and how LLMs contribute to decision-making. (1) When to activate the LLM: AdaDrive employs a novel adaptive activation loss that dynamically determines LLM invocation based on a comparative learning mechanism, ensuring activation only in complex or critical scenarios. (2) How to integrate LLM assistance: Instead of rigid binary activation, AdaDrive introduces an adaptive fusion strategy that modulates a continuous, scaled LLM influence based on scene complexity and prediction confidence, ensuring seamless collaboration with conventional planners. Through these strategies, AdaDrive provides a flexible, context-aware framework that maximizes decision accuracy without compromising real-time performance. Extensive experiments on language-grounded autonomous driving benchmarks demonstrate that AdaDrive state-of-the-art performance in terms of both driving accuracy and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/ReaFly/AdaDrive.
authors: Ruifei Zhang, Junlin Xie, Wei Zhang, Weikai Chen, Xiao Tan, Xiang Wan, Guanbin Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5112-5121

title: AdaHuman: 基于组合多视角扩散的可动画化详细三维人体生成
title_en: AdaHuman: Animatable Detailed 3D Human Generation with Compositional Multiview Diffusion
abstract: 现有图像到三维化身生成方法难以生成适用于现实场景的高细节、可动画化化身。我们提出AdaHuman,一种新颖框架,可从单张野外图像生成高保真度可动画化三维化身。AdaHuman包含两项关键创新:(1) 基于姿态的三维关节扩散模型,可在任意姿态下合成一致的多视角图像,并在每一步扩散过程中生成对应的三维高斯点云(3DGS)重建;(2) 组合式三维高斯点云优化模块,通过图像到图像优化增强局部身体部位细节,并利用新型裁剪感知相机射线图无缝融合,生成连贯的详细三维化身。这些组件使AdaHuman能够生成高真实感标准化A姿态化身,最小化自遮挡,支持任意输入运动的绑定与动画制作。在公开基准和野外图像上的广泛评估表明,AdaHuman在化身重建与姿态重设任务中均显著优于现有最先进方法。代码和模型将用于研究目的公开发布。
abstract_en: Existing methods for image-to-3D avatar generation struggle to produce highly detailed, animation-ready avatars suitable for real-world applications. We introduce AdaHuman, a novel framework that generates high-fidelity animatable 3D avatars from a single in-the-wild image. AdaHuman incorporates two key innovations: (1) A pose-conditioned 3D joint diffusion model that synthesizes consistent multi-view images in arbitrary poses alongside corresponding 3D Gaussian Splats (3DGS) reconstruction at each diffusion step; (2) A compositional 3DGS refinement module that enhances the details of local body parts through image-to-image refinement and seamlessly integrates them using a novel crop-aware camera ray map, producing a cohesive detailed 3D avatar. These components allow AdaHuman to generate highly realistic standardized A-pose avatars with minimal self-occlusion, enabling rigging and animation with any input motion. Extensive evaluation on public benchmarks and in-the-wild images demonstrates that AdaHuman significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both avatar reconstruction and reposing. Code and models will be publicly available for research purposes.
authors: Yangyi Huang, Ye Yuan, Xueting Li, Jan Kautz, Umar Iqbal ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13533-13543

title: 基于异构搜索空间的基准分割模型适配方法
title_en: Adapt Foundational Segmentation Models with Heterogeneous Searching Space
abstract: 基础分割模型(FSMs)在非常规图像领域(如伪装目标)中表现出次优性能。由于数据准备挑战、时间限制和优化问题,微调往往难以实施。为在保持零样本特征的前提下提升分割性能,一种方法是通过预增强图像来优化分割模型。然而现有图像增强方法主要依赖规则方法,限制了增强效果。尽管基于学习的方法能增强增强多样性,但规则方法具有度可描述性(如轻微/强烈增亮),而基于学习的方法通常预测非度可描述的真实值(如深度估计),二者结合时会形成异构搜索空间。为此,我们提出"增强以适应"范式,用最优异构增强策略替代传统规则增强方法以提升分割性能。我们的方法采用32种增强技术(22种规则方法,10种学习方法)以缓解参数错位,构建稳健的多离散异构搜索空间。为在实际场景中应用最优策略,我们将增强过程蒸馏以加速预处理。在多样化的数据集和领域上的广泛评估表明,我们的方法通过领域特定增强策略显著提升了模型适应性。我们将发布代码以支持进一步研究。
abstract_en: Foundation Segmentation Models (FSMs) show suboptimal performance on unconventional image domains like camouflage objects. Fine-tuning is often impractical due to data preparation challenges, time limits, and optimization issues. To boost segmentation performance while keeping zero-shot features, one approach is pre-augmenting images for the segmentation model. However, existing image augmentations mainly depend on rule-based methods, restricting augmentation effectiveness. Though learning-based methods can diversify augmentation, rule-based ones are degree-describable (e.g., slight/intense brightening), while learning-based methods usually predict non-degree-describable ground truths (e.g., depth estimation), creating a heterogeneous search space when combined. To this end, we propose an "Augmenting-to-Adapt" paradigm, replacing traditional rule-based augmentation with an optimal heterogeneous augmentation policy to enhance segmentation. Our method uses 32 augmentation techniques (22 rule-based, 10 learning-based) to ease parameter misalignment, forming a robust, multi-discrete heterogeneous search space.To apply the optimal policy in real-world scenarios, we distill the augmentation process to speed up the preprocess. Extensive evaluations across diverse datasets and domains show our method significantly improves model adaptation with a domain-specific augmentation strategy. We will release our code to support further research.
authors: Li Yi, Jie Hu, Songan Zhang, Guannan Jiang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23364-23373

title: 将域内少样本分割适配到新域无需源域重新训练
title_en: Adapting In-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation to New Domains without Source Domain Retraining
abstract: 跨域少样本分割(CD-FSS)旨在对新域中的新类别对象进行分割,这通常具有挑战性,因为目标域具有多样的特征且支持数据有限。大多数CD-FSS方法通过使用源域的丰富基础数据重新设计和重新训练域内FSS模型,这些方法虽然有效但训练成本高昂。为解决这些问题,我们提出通过在推理过程中从少量标注的支持样本中学习域特征,将已训练良好的FSS模型的具有信息量的模型结构适配到目标域,从而无需源域重新训练。具体而言,我们首先通过数据依赖的方式使用新颖的结构Fisher分数测量参数重要性,自适应地识别域特定的模型结构。然后,我们逐步使用分层构建的训练样本训练选定的具有信息量的模型结构,从较少到较多支持样本逐步推进。所提出的Informative Structure Adaptation(ISA)方法有效解决了域偏移问题,并为现有的域内FSS模型赋予灵活的新域适应能力,无需重新设计或在基础数据上重新训练CD-FSS模型。大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性,在多个CD-FSS基准测试中均表现出优越性能。代码见https://github.com/fanq15/ISA
abstract_en: Cross-domain few-shot segmentation (CD-FSS) aims to segment objects of novel classes in new domains, which is often challenging due to the diverse characteristics of target domains and the limited availability of support data. Most CD-FSS methods redesign and retrain in-domain FSS models using abundant base data from the source domain, which are effective but costly to train. To address these issues, we propose adapting informative model structures of the well-trained FSS model for target domains by learning domain characteristics from few-shot labeled support samples during inference, thereby eliminating the need for source domain retraining. Specifically, we first adaptively identify domain-specific model structures by measuring parameter importance using a novel structure Fisher score in a data-dependent manner. Then, we progressively train the selected informative model structures with hierarchically constructed training samples, progressing from fewer to more support shots. The resulting Informative Structure Adaptation (ISA) method effectively addresses domain shifts and equips existing well-trained in-domain FSS models with flexible adaptation capabilities for new domains, eliminating the need to redesign or retrain CD-FSS models on base data. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our method, demonstrating superior performance across multiple CD-FSS benchmarks. Codes are at https://github.com/fanq15/ISA
authors: Qi Fan, Kaiqi Liu, Nian Liu, Hisham Cholakkal, Rao Muhammad Anwer, Wenbin Li, Yang Gao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21429-21439

title: 基于弱监督的航拍图像车辆检测器在未见过领域中的适应方法
title_en: Adapting Vehicle Detectors for Aerial Imagery to Unseen Domains with Weak Supervision
abstract: 在航拍图像中检测车辆是交通监控、城市规划和国防情报等领域的关键任务。深度学习方法为该应用提供了最先进的(SOTA)结果。然而,当模型在某一地理区域的数据上训练后,难以有效泛化到其他区域时,会面临显著挑战。环境条件、城市布局、道路网络、车辆类型和图像采集参数(如分辨率、光照和角度)的差异会导致领域偏移,从而降低模型性能。本文提出了一种新颖方法,利用生成式人工智能合成高质量的航拍图像及其标签,通过数据增强提升检测器的训练效果。我们的主要贡献是开发了一种多阶段、多模态的知识迁移框架,利用微调后的潜在扩散模型(LDMs)来缓解源环境与目标环境之间的分布差异。在多个多样化的航拍图像领域中进行的广泛实验表明,与在源域数据上进行监督学习、弱监督适应方法、无监督领域适应方法以及开放集目标检测器相比,AP50指标分别提升了4-23%、6-10%、7-40%和超过50%。此外,我们还引入了来自新西兰和犹他州的两个新标注航拍数据集,以支持该领域的进一步研究。项目页面地址为:https://humansensinglab.github.io/AGenDA
abstract_en: Detecting vehicles in aerial imagery is a critical task with applications in traffic monitoring, urban planning, and defense intelligence. Deep learning methods have provided state-of-the-art (SOTA) results for this application. However, a significant challenge arises when models trained on data from one geographic region fail to generalize effectively to other areas. Variability in factors such as environmental conditions, urban layouts, road networks, vehicle types, and image acquisition parameters (e.g., resolution, lighting, and angle) leads to domain shifts that degrade model performance. This paper proposes a novel method that uses generative AI to synthesize high-quality aerial images and their labels, improving detector training through data augmentation. Our key contribution is the development of a multi-stage, multi-modal knowledge transfer framework utilizing fine-tuned latent diffusion models (LDMs) to mitigate the distribution gap between the source and target environments. Extensive experiments across diverse aerial imagery domains show consistent performance improvements in AP50 over supervised learning on source domain data, weakly supervised adaptation methods, unsupervised domain adaptation methods, and open-set object detectors by 4-23%, 6-10%, 7-40%, and more than 50%, respectively. Furthermore, we introduce two newly annotated aerial datasets from New Zealand and Utah to support further research in this field. Project page is available at: https://humansensinglab.github.io/AGenDA
authors: Xiao Fang, Minhyek Jeon, Zheyang Qin, Stanislav Panev, Celso De Melo, Shuowen Hu, Shayok Chakraborty, Fernando De La Torre ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8088-8099

title: 基于基础模型推理与部件定位的实时可变形物体自适应操作
title_en: Adaptive Articulated Object Manipulation On The Fly with Foundation Model Reasoning and Part Grounding
abstract: 可变形物体对机器人操作提出了多样化的挑战。由于其内部结构无法直接观测,机器人必须通过自适应探索和动作优化来生成成功的操作轨迹。尽管现有研究尝试在自适应可变形物体操作中实现跨类别泛化,但存在两个主要挑战:(1) 实际场景中可变形物体的几何多样性加剧了视觉感知与理解的复杂性;(2) 物体功能与机制的差异阻碍了统一自适应操作策略的开发。为解决这些问题,我们提出AdaRPG框架,该框架利用基础模型提取物体部件,这些部件相较于完整物体具有更高的局部几何相似性,从而增强功能原始技能的视觉可操作性泛化能力。为此,我们构建了部件级可操作性标注数据集以训练可操作性模型。此外,AdaRPG通过基础模型嵌入的通用知识对复杂机制进行推理,并基于部件可操作性推断生成调用原始技能函数的高层控制代码。仿真与真实世界实验验证了AdaRPG在新型可变形物体类别上的强泛化能力。
abstract_en: Articulated objects pose diverse manipulation challenges for robots. Since their internal structures are not directly observable, robots must adaptively explore and refine actions to generate successful manipulation trajectories. While existing works have attempted cross-category generalization in adaptive articulated object manipulation, two major challenges persist: (1) the geometric diversity of real-world articulated objects complicates visual perception and understanding, and (2) variations in object functions and mechanisms hinder the development of a unified adaptive manipulation strategy.To address these challenges, we propose AdaRPG, a novel framework that leverages foundation models to extract object parts, which exhibit greater local geometric similarity than entire objects, thereby enhancing visual affordance generalization for functional primitive skills. To support this, we construct a part-level affordance annotation dataset to train the affordance model. Additionally, AdaRPG utilizes the common knowledge embedded in foundation models to reason about complex mechanisms and generate high-level control codes that invoke primitive skill functions based on part affordance inference.Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate AdaRPG's strong generalization ability across novel articulated object categories.
authors: Xiaojie Zhang, Yuanfei Wang, Ruihai Wu, Kunqi Xu, Yu Li, Liuyu Xiang, Hao Dong, Zhaofeng He ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13032-13042

title: 基于扩散变换器的自适应缓存加速视频生成
title_en: Adaptive Caching for Faster Video Generation with Diffusion Transformers
abstract: 生成时间一致的高保真视频在计算上具有较高成本,尤其是在较长的时间跨度下。尽管近期的扩散变换器(DiTs)在该领域取得了显著进展,但其依赖更大的模型和更复杂的注意力机制,反而加剧了这一挑战,导致推理速度变慢。本文提出了一种加速视频DiTs的方法,称为自适应缓存(AdaCache),其动机源于"并非所有视频都相同"这一事实:即某些视频通过较少的去噪步骤即可达到合理质量。在此基础上,我们不仅通过扩散过程缓存计算,还为每个视频生成设计定制化的缓存调度策略,最大化质量-延迟的权衡。进一步地,我们引入运动正则化(MoReg)方案,利用AdaCache中的视频信息,本质上根据运动内容控制计算分配。总体而言,我们的即插即用贡献在多个视频DiT基线模型上实现了显著的推理加速(例如在Open-Sora 720p - 2s视频生成中达到4.7倍速度提升),而不会牺牲生成质量。
abstract_en: Generating temporally-consistent high-fidelity videos can be computationally expensive, especially over longer temporal spans. More-recent Diffusion Transformers (DiTs)--- despite making significant headway in this context--- have only heightened such challenges as they rely on larger models and heavier attention mechanisms, resulting in slower inference speeds. In this paper, we introduce a method to accelerate video DiTs, termed Adaptive Caching (AdaCache), which is motivated by the fact that 'not all videos are created equal': meaning, some videos require fewer denoising steps to attain a reasonable quality than others. Building on this, we not only cache computations through the diffusion process, but also devise a caching schedule tailored to each video generation, maximizing the quality-latency trade-off. We further introduce a Motion Regularization (MoReg) scheme to utilize video information within AdaCache, essentially controlling the compute allocation based on motion content. Altogether, our plug-and-play contributions grant significant inference speedups (e.g. up to 4.7x on Open-Sora 720p - 2s video generation) without sacrificing the generation quality, across multiple video DiT baselines.
authors: Kumara Kahatapitiya, Haozhe Liu, Sen He, Ding Liu, Menglin Jia, Chenyang Zhang, Michael S. Ryoo, Tian Xie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15240-15252

title: 自适应双不确定性优化:提升测试时域偏移下的单目三维目标检测
title_en: Adaptive Dual Uncertainty Optimization: Boosting Monocular 3D Object Detection under Test-Time Shifts
abstract: 单目三维目标检测(M3OD)在安全关键应用(如自动驾驶)中至关重要,但其可靠性在由环境或传感器变化引起的现实世界域偏移下会显著下降。为应对这些偏移,测试时适应(TTA)方法应运而生,使模型能够在推理过程中适应目标分布。尽管先前的TTA方法认识到低不确定性与高泛化能力之间的正相关关系,但未能解决M3OD固有的双不确定性:语义不确定性(模糊的类别预测)和几何不确定性(不稳定的空间定位)。为弥合这一差距,我们提出双不确定性优化(DUO),这是首个旨在联合最小化两种不确定性的TTA框架,以实现稳健的M3OD。通过凸优化视角,我们引入了焦点损失的创新凸结构,并进一步推导出一种新颖的共轭损失,实现标签无关的不确定性加权和高不确定性对象的平衡学习。同时,我们设计了一种语义感知的法线场约束,在具有明确语义线索的区域中保持几何一致性,从而减少来自不稳定三维表示的不确定性。这种双分支机制形成互补循环:增强的空间感知提升语义分类,而稳健的语义预测进一步优化空间理解。大量实验表明,DUO在多种数据集和域偏移类型上均优于现有方法。源代码可在https://github.com/hzcar/DUO获取。
abstract_en: Accurate monocular 3D object detection (M3OD) is pivotal for safety-critical applications like autonomous driving, yet its reliability deteriorates significantly under real-world domain shifts caused by environmental or sensor variations. To address these shifts, Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) methods have emerged, enabling models to adapt to target distributions during inference. While prior TTA approaches recognize the positive correlation between low uncertainty and high generalization ability, they fail to address the dual uncertainty inherent to M3OD: semantic uncertainty (ambiguous class predictions) and geometric uncertainty (unstable spatial localization). To bridge this gap, we propose Dual Uncertainty Optimization (DUO), the first TTA framework designed to jointly minimize both uncertainties for robust M3OD. Through a convex optimization lens, we introduce an innovative convex structure of the focal loss and further derive a novel conjugate loss, enabling label-agnostic uncertainty weighting and balanced learning for high-uncertainty objects. In parallel, we design a semantic-aware normal field constraint that preserves geometric coherence in regions with clear semantic cues, reducing uncertainty from the unstable 3D representation. This dual-branch mechanism forms a complementary loop: enhanced spatial perception improves semantic classification, and robust semantic predictions further refine spatial understanding. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of DUO over existing methods across various datasets and domain shift types. The source code is available at https://github.com/hzcar/DUO.
authors: Zixuan Hu, Dongxiao Li, Xinzhu Ma, Shixiang Tang, Xiaotong Li, Wenhan Yang, Ling-Yu Duan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7273-7283

title: 基于虚拟连接的自适应超图卷积网络在基于骨架的人体动作识别中的应用
title_en: Adaptive Hyper-Graph Convolution Network for Skeleton-based Human Action Recognition with Virtual Connections
abstract: 人体骨架的共享拓扑结构推动了近期对图卷积网络(GCN)解决方案在动作识别中的研究。然而,大多数现有GCN依赖于由边(骨骼)形成的两个相邻顶点(关节)的二元连接,忽视了构建多顶点卷积结构的潜力。尽管一些研究尝试利用超图表示拓扑结构,但它们依赖固定的构建策略,限制了其在揭示动作中复杂潜在关系方面的适应性。本文针对这一缺陷,探索自适应超图卷积网络(Hyper-GCN)的优势,以聚合骨架顶点传递的丰富语义信息。具体而言,我们的Hyper-GCN在训练过程中自适应优化超图,揭示动作驱动的多顶点关系。此外,虚拟连接通常被设计用于支持高效的特征聚合,隐式扩展骨架中的依赖关系谱。通过将虚拟连接注入超图,可以突出不同动作类别的语义线索。在NTU-60、NTU-120和NW-UCLA数据集上的实验结果验证了Hyper-GCN相较于现有最先进方法的优势。代码可在https://github.com/6UOOON9/Hyper-GCN获取。
abstract_en: The shared topology of human skeletons motivated the recent investigation of graph convolutional network (GCN) solutions for action recognition.However, most of the existing GCNs rely on the binary connection of two neighboring vertices (joints) formed by an edge (bone), overlooking the potential of constructing multi-vertex convolution structures.Although some studies have attempted to utilize hyper-graphs to represent the topology, they rely on a fixed construction strategy, which limits their adaptivity in uncovering the intricate latent relationships within the action.In this paper, we address this oversight and explore the merits of an adaptive hyper-graph convolutional network (Hyper-GCN) to achieve the aggregation of rich semantic information conveyed by skeleton vertices.In particular, our Hyper-GCN adaptively optimises the hyper-graphs during training, revealing the action-driven multi-vertex relations. Besides, virtual connections are often designed to support efficient feature aggregation, implicitly extending the spectrum of dependencies within the skeleton.By injecting virtual connections into hyper-graphs, the semantic clues of diverse action categories can be highlighted. The results of experiments conducted on the NTU-60, NTU-120, and NW-UCLA datasets demonstrate the merits of our Hyper-GCN, compared to the state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at https://github.com/6UOOON9/Hyper-GCN.
authors: Youwei Zhou, Tianyang Xu, Cong Wu, Xiaojun Wu, Josef Kittler ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12648-12658

title: 面向半监督医学图像分割的高价值区域自适应学习
title_en: Adaptive Learning of High-Value Regions for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
abstract: 现有半监督学习方法通常通过抑制低置信度区域来减轻不可靠预测的影响。然而,这些方法未能探索哪些区域具有更高的学习价值以及如何为这些区域设计自适应学习策略。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新颖的高价值区域自适应学习(ALHVR)框架。通过利用双分支网络预测的多样性,将预测区域划分为三类:可靠稳定区域、可靠不稳定区域和不可靠稳定区域。针对高价值区域(可靠不稳定区域和不可靠稳定区域),设计了不同的训练策略。具体而言,对于可靠不稳定区域,我们提出了一种基于置信度的跨原型一致性学习(CG-CPCL)模块,该模块在特征空间中施加原型一致性约束。通过利用置信度信息,一个网络的高置信度预测可选择性地监督另一个网络的低置信度预测,从而帮助模型更稳定地学习类间判别性。此外,针对不可靠稳定区域,我们设计了动态教师竞争教学(DTCT)模块,该模块通过评估双网络的未扰动预测,动态选择最可靠的像素作为教师。这些选定的像素随后用于监督扰动预测,从而增强模型在不可靠区域的学习能力。实验结果表明,我们的方法在三个公开数据集上优于现有最先进的方法。代码可在https://github.com/ziziyao/ALHVR获取。
abstract_en: Existing semi-supervised learning methods typically mitigate the impact of unreliable predictions by suppressing low-confidence regions. However, these methods fail to explore which regions hold higher learning value and how to design adaptive learning strategies for these regions. To address these issues, we propose a novel adaptive learning of high-value regions (ALHVR) framework. By exploiting the diversity of predictions from dual-branch networks, the prediction regions are classified into three groups: reliable stable region, reliable unstable region, and unreliable stable region. For high-value regions (reliable unstable region and unreliable stable region), different training strategies are designed. Specifically, for reliable unstable region, we propose a confidence-guided cross-prototype consistency learning (CG-CPCL) module, which enforces prototype consistency constraints in the feature space. By leveraging confidence information, the high-confidence predictions from one network selectively supervise the low-confidence predictions from the other, thus helping the model learn inter-class discrimination more stably. Additionally, for unreliable stable region, we design a dynamic teacher competition teaching (DTCT) module, which dynamically selects the most reliable pixels as teachers by evaluating the unperturbed predictions from both networks. These selected pixels are then used to supervise perturbed predictions, thereby enhancing the model's learning capability in unreliable region. Experimental results show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches on three public datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/ziziyao/ALHVR.
authors: Tao Lei, Ziyao Yang, Xingwu Wang, Yi Wang, Xuan Wang, Feiman Sun, Asoke K. Nandi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21450-21459

title: 基于高斯异常合成的自适应提示学习用于分布外检测
title_en: Adaptive Prompt Learning via Gaussian Outlier Synthesis for Out-of-distribution Detection
abstract: 分布外(OOD)检测旨在区分检测到的对象是否属于已知类别。现有方法从分布内(ID)数据中提取OOD样本以正则化模型的决策边界。然而,由于模型对OOD数据分布缺乏充分知识,决策边界并未得到充分正则化。为解决上述问题,我们提出了一种基于高斯异常合成的自适应提示学习框架(APLGOS)用于OOD检测。具体而言,我们利用视觉-语言模型(VLM)通过从预定义的问答对中采样标准化结果来初始化可学习的ID提示。在类别条件高斯分布的低似然区域合成区域级提示。这些提示随后用于初始化可学习的OOD提示,并通过自适应提示学习进行优化。此外,通过高斯异常合成生成OOD伪样本。上述方法论使模型学习到更紧凑的ID和OOD类别的决策边界。大量实验表明,APLGOS在四个主流数据集上以更少的ID数据实现了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection aims to distinguish whether detected objects belong to known categories or not. Existing methods extract OOD samples from In-distribution (ID) data to regularize the model's decision boundaries. However, the decision boundaries are not adequately regularized because the model does not have sufficient knowledge about the distribution of OOD data. To address the above issue, we propose an Adaptive Prompt Learning framework via Gaussian Outlier Synthesis (APLGOS) for OOD detection. Specifically, we leverage the Vision-Language Model (VLM) to initialize learnable ID prompts by sampling standardized results from pre-defined Q&A pairs. Region-level prompts are synthesised in low-likelihood regions of class-conditional gaussian distributions. These prompts are then utilized to initialize learnable OOD prompts and optimized with adaptive prompt learning. Also, OOD pseudo-samples are synthesised via gaussian outlier synthesis. The aforementioned methodology regularizes the model to learn more compact decision boundaries for ID and OOD categories. Extensive experiments show that APLGOS achieves state-of-the-art performance with less ID data on four mainstream datasets.
authors: Yongkang Zhang, Dongyu She, Zhong Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3235-3244

title: 文本到图像生成请求在大型云模型与轻量级边缘模型间的自适应路由
title_en: Adaptive Routing of Text-to-Image Generation Requests Between Large Cloud Model and Light-Weight Edge Model
abstract: 大型文本到图像模型展现出卓越的生成能力;然而其庞大的体积需要昂贵的云服务器进行部署。相反,轻量级模型可低成本部署于边缘设备,但常因复杂用户提示而生成质量欠佳。为平衡性能与成本,我们提出一种路由框架RouteT2I,动态为每个用户提示选择大型云模型或轻量级边缘模型。由于生成图像质量难以直接测量和比较,RouteT2I建立多维质量指标,特别是通过评估生成图像与描述特定质量指标的正负文本之间的相似性。RouteT2I通过识别提示中的关键词并比较其对质量的影响来预测生成图像的预期质量。进一步引入帕累托相对优势以比较生成图像的多维质量指标。基于此比较及预定义的成本约束,RouteT2I将提示分配至边缘或云模型。评估结果表明,RouteT2I显著减少请求大型云模型的次数,同时保持高质量图像生成。
abstract_en: Large text-to-image models demonstrate impressive generation capabilities; however, their substantial size necessitates expensive cloud servers for deployment. Conversely, light-weight models can be deployed on edge devices at lower cost but often with inferior generation quality for complex user prompts. To strike a balance between performance and cost, we propose a routing framework, called RouteT2I, which dynamically selects either the large cloud model or the light-weight edge model for each user prompt. Since generated image quality is challenging to measure and compare directly, RouteT2I establishes multi-dimensional quality metrics, particularly, by evaluating the similarity between the generated images and both positive and negative texts that describe each specific quality metric. RouteT2I then predicts the expected quality of the generated images by identifying key tokens in the prompt and comparing their impact on the quality. RouteT2I further introduces the Pareto relative superiority to compare the multi-metric quality of the generated images. Based on this comparison and predefined cost constraints, RouteT2I allocates prompts to either the edge or the cloud. Evaluation reveals that RouteT2I significantly reduces the number of requesting large cloud model while maintaining high-quality image generation.
authors: Zewei Xin, Qinya Li, Chaoyue Niu, Fan Wu, Guihai Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19482-19491

title: AdaptiveAE:一种动态场景中高动态范围成像的自适应曝光策略
title_en: AdaptiveAE: An Adaptive Exposure Strategy for HDR Capturing in Dynamic Scenes
abstract: 主流高动态范围成像技术通常依赖于融合不同曝光参数设置(快门速度和ISO值)拍摄的多张图像。快门速度与ISO值之间的良好平衡对于实现高质量HDR至关重要,高ISO值会引入大量噪声,而长快门速度可能导致明显的运动模糊。然而现有方法往往忽视快门速度与ISO值之间的复杂交互关系,并未考虑动态场景中的运动模糊效应。本文提出AdaptiveAE,一种基于强化学习的方法,通过优化快门速度和ISO值组合选择,在动态环境中最大化HDR重建质量。AdaptiveAE集成了包含运动模糊和噪声模拟的图像合成流程,利用语义信息和曝光直方图进行训练。它可根据用户定义的曝光时间预算自适应选择最优ISO值和快门速度序列,相较于传统方案找到更优的曝光方案。在多个数据集上的实验结果表明,其性能达到最先进水平。
abstract_en: Mainstream high dynamic range imaging techniques typically rely on fusing multiple images captured with different exposure setups (shutter speed and ISO). A good balance between shutter speed and ISO is crucial for achieving high-quality HDR, as high ISO values introduce significant noise, while long shutter speeds can lead to noticeable motion blur. However, existing methods often overlook the complex interaction between shutter speed and ISO and fail to account for motion blur effects in dynamic scenes. In this work, we propose AdaptiveAE, a reinforcement learning-based method that optimizes the selection of shutter speed and ISO combinations to maximize HDR reconstruction quality in dynamic environments. AdaptiveAE integrates an image synthesis pipeline that incorporates motion blur and noise simulation into our training procedure, leveraging semantic information and exposure histograms. It can adaptively select optimal ISO and shutter speed sequences based on a user-defined exposure time budget, and find a better exposure schedule than traditional solutions. Experimental results across multiple datasets demonstrate that it achieves the state-of-the-art performance.
authors: Tianyi Xu, Fan Zhang, Boxin Shi, Tianfan Xue, Yujin Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25176-25185

title: 向一步扩散模型添加额外控制:基于联合分布匹配的方法
title_en: Adding Additional Control to One-Step Diffusion with Joint Distribution Matching
abstract: 尽管扩散蒸馏通过变分得分蒸馏等方法实现了一步生成,但将蒸馏模型适配新兴的*新控制*——如新颖的结构约束或最新的用户偏好——仍具挑战性。传统方法通常需要修改基础扩散模型并重新蒸馏——这一过程既计算密集又耗时。为解决这些问题,我们引入了联合分布匹配(JDM),这是一种通过最小化图像条件联合分布之间的反向KL散度的新方法。通过推导出一个可处理的上界,JDM将保真度学习与条件学习解耦。这种非对称蒸馏方案使我们的一步学生模型能够处理教师模型未知的控制,并促进改进的分类器自由引导(CFG)使用和人类反馈学习(HFL)的无缝集成。实验结果表明,JDM在大多数情况下仅需一步即可超越多步ControlNet等基线方法,同时通过改进CFG或HFL集成,在一步文本到图像合成中实现了最先进性能。
abstract_en: While diffusion distillation has enabled one-step generation through methods like Variational Score Distillation, adapting distilled models to emerging *new controls* -- such as novel structural constraints or latest user preferences -- remains challenging. Conventional approaches typically requires modifying the base diffusion model and redistilling it -- a process that is both computationally intensive and time-consuming. To address these challenges, we introduce Joint Distribution Matching (JDM), a novel approach that minimizes the reverse KL divergence between image-condition joint distributions. By deriving a tractable upper bound, JDM decouples fidelity learning from condition learning. This asymmetric distillation scheme enables our one-step student to handle controls unknown to the teacher model and facilitates improved classifier-free guidance (CFG) usage and seamless integration of human feedback learning (HFL). Experimental results demonstrate that JDM surpasses baseline methods such as multi-step ControlNet by mere one-step in most cases, while achieving state-of-the-art performance in one-step text-to-image synthesis through improved usage of CFG or HFL integration.
authors: Yihong Luo, Tianyang Hu, Yifan Song, Jiacheng Sun, Zhenguo Li, Jing Tang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4009-4018

title: 通过一个线性层解决向量量化模型中的表示坍塌问题
title_en: Addressing Representation Collapse in Vector Quantized Models with One Linear Layer
abstract: 向量量化(VQ)在无监督学习中对于离散化连续表示至关重要,但会受到表示坍塌的影响,导致码本利用率低下并限制可扩展性。现有解决方案通常依赖复杂的优化方法或降低潜在维度,这会损害模型容量并无法彻底解决问题。我们识别出根本原因是分离的码本优化,即仅通过梯度下降更新少量码向量。为了解决这一问题,我们提出SimpleVQ,通过在潜在基上应用可学习的线性变换层对码向量进行重新参数化,优化整个线性空间而非最近的单个码向量。尽管两个线性矩阵的乘法等同于应用一个线性层,但这种简单方法有效防止了坍塌。在图像和音频任务上的大量实验表明,SimpleVQ提高了码本利用率,易于实现,并且在不同模态和架构上具有良好的泛化能力。
abstract_en: Vector Quantization (VQ) is essential for discretizing continuous representations in unsupervised learning but suffers from representation collapse, causing low codebook utilization and limiting scalability. Existing solutions often rely on complex optimizations or reduce latent dimensionality, which compromises model capacity and fails to fully solve the problem. We identify the root cause as disjoint codebook optimization, where only a few code vectors are updated via gradient descent. To fix this, we propose SimpleVQ, which reparameterizes code vectors through a learnable linear transformation layer over a latent basis, optimizing the entire linear space rather than nearest individual code vectors. Although the multiplication of two linear matrices is equivalent to applying a single linear layer, this simple approach effectively prevents collapse. Extensive experiments on image and audio tasks demonstrate that SimVQ improves codebook usage, is easy to implement, and generalizes well across modalities and architectures.
authors: Yongxin Zhu, Bocheng Li, Yifei Xin, Zhihua Xia, Linli Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22968-22977

title: 解决扩散模型图像编辑中的文本嵌入泄露问题
title_en: Addressing Text Embedding Leakage in Diffusion-based Image Editing
abstract: 基于生成扩散模型的文本驱动图像编辑技术,使用户能够通过自然语言提示修改图像,极大地简化了传统工作流程。尽管取得了这些进展,现有方法仍面临一个关键问题:属性泄露,即针对特定对象的编辑无意中影响无关区域或其他目标对象。我们的分析揭示了根本原因在于自回归文本编码器生成的结束符(EOS)嵌入固有的语义纠缠,这些嵌入无差别地聚合了不同提示的属性。为解决这一问题,我们提出属性泄露消除编辑(ALE)框架,从源头上处理属性泄露。ALE结合对象受限嵌入(ORE)以解耦文本嵌入,采用区域引导融合(RGB-CAM)实现空间精确的注意力控制,并通过背景融合(BB)保留未编辑内容。为定量评估不同编辑方法的属性泄露情况,我们提出属性泄露评估基准(ALE-Bench),包含全面的编辑场景和新指标。大量实验表明,ALE显著降低了属性泄露,从而实现了准确的多对象文本驱动图像编辑,同时忠实保留非目标内容。
abstract_en: Text-based image editing, powered by generative diffusion models, lets users modify images through natural-language prompts and has dramatically simplified traditional workflows. Despite these advances, current methods still suffer from a critical problem: attribute leakage, where edits meant for specific objects unintentionally affect unrelated regions or other target objects. Our analysis reveals the root cause as the semantic entanglement inherent in End-of-Sequence (EOS) embeddings generated by autoregressive text encoders, which indiscriminately aggregate attributes across prompts. To address this issue, we introduce Attribute-Leakage-Free Editing (ALE), a framework that tackles attribute leakage at its source. ALE combines Object-Restricted Embeddings (ORE) to disentangle text embeddings, Region-Guided Blending for Cross-Attention Masking (RGB-CAM) for spatially precise attention, and Background Blending (BB) to preserve non-edited content. To quantitatively evaluate attribute leakage across various editing methods, we propose the Attribute-Leakage Evaluation Benchmark (ALE-Bench), featuring comprehensive editing scenarios and new metrics. Extensive experiments show that ALE reduces attribute leakage by large margins, thereby enabling accurate, multi-object, text-driven image editing while faithfully preserving non-target content.
authors: Sunung Mun, Jinhwan Nam, Sunghyun Cho, Jungseul Ok ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16451-16460

title: AdsQA: 面向广告视频理解的探索
title_en: AdsQA: Towards Advertisement Video Understanding
abstract: 大语言模型(LLMs)在通向通用人工智能(AGI)的道路上取得了重大进展。同时,越来越多的领域特定问题(如数学和编程)促使这些通用模型通过学习更深层次的专业知识持续进化。因此,现在是时候进一步拓展知识型LLMs在多样化专业应用中的能力,尽管收集具有意外性和信息量的高质量数据仍具挑战性。本文提出利用广告(ad)视频作为具有挑战性的测试平台,以探究LLMs超越常规视觉领域客观物理内容的感知能力。我们的动机是充分利用线索丰富且信息密集的广告视频特性,例如营销逻辑、说服策略和受众参与度。我们的贡献体现在三个方面:(1)据我们所知,这是首次尝试使用精心设计的任务对广告视频进行评估。我们贡献了AdsQA,一个源自1,544条广告视频、包含10,962个片段(总计22.7小时)的挑战性广告视频问答基准,提供5项具有挑战性的任务。(2)我们提出了ReAd-R,一种受Deepseek-R1启发的强化学习模型,该模型通过奖励驱动优化反思问题并生成答案。(3)我们在AdsQA上对14个顶级LLMs进行了基准测试,我们的ReAd-R在长链推理能力方面显著超越了其他强竞争者,取得了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have taken a great step towards AGI. Meanwhile, an increasing number of domain-specific problems such as math and programming boost these general-purpose models to continuously evolve via learning deeper expertise. Now is thus the time further to extend the diversity of specialized applications for knowledgeable LLMs, though collecting high quality data with unexpected and informative tasks is challenging. In this paper, we propose to use advertisement (ad) videos as a challenging test-bed to probe the ability of LLMs in perceiving beyond the objective physical content of common visual domain. Our motivation is to take full advantage of the clue-rich and information-dense ad videos' traits, e.g., marketing logic, persuasive strategies, and audience engagement. Our contribution is three-fold: (1) To our knowledge, this is the first attempt to use ad videos with well-designed tasks to evaluate LLMs. We contribute AdsQA, a challenging ad Video QA benchmark derived from 1,544 ad videos with 10,962 clips, totaling 22.7 hours, providing 5 challenging tasks. (2) We propose ReAd-R, a Deepseek-R1 styled RL model that reflects on questions, and generates answers via reward-driven optimization. (3) We benchmark  14  top-tier LLMs on AdsQA, and our ReAd-R achieves the state-of-the-art outperforming strong competitors equipped with long-chain reasoning capabilities by a clear margin.
authors: Xinwei Long, Kai Tian, Peng Xu, Guoli Jia, Jingxuan Li, Sa Yang, Yihua Shao, Kaiyan Zhang, Che Jiang, Hao Xu, Yang Liu, Jiaheng Ma, Bowen Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23396-23407

title: AdvDreamer揭示:视觉-语言模型是否真正准备好应对现实世界中的三维变化?
title_en: AdvDreamer Unveils: Are Vision-Language Models Truly Ready for Real-World 3D Variations?
abstract: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)展现出显著的泛化能力,但其在动态现实场景中的鲁棒性仍缺乏系统研究。为系统评估VLMs对现实世界三维变化的鲁棒性,我们提出AdvDreamer,首个能够从单视角观测生成可物理复现的对抗性三维变换(Adv-3DT)样本的框架。在AdvDreamer中,我们集成三项关键创新:首先,为在有限先验知识下精确表征现实世界三维变化,我们设计基于生成式三维先验的零样本单目姿态操控管道。其次,为确保最坏情况Adv-3DT样本的视觉质量,我们提出自然性奖励模型,在对抗优化过程中提供连续的自然性正则化,有效防止收敛至幻觉或非自然元素。第三,为实现跨多样VLM架构和视觉-语言任务的系统评估,我们引入逆语义概率损失作为对抗优化目标,该目标仅在基础视觉-文本对齐空间中运行。基于捕获的高攻击性与可迁移性Adv-3DT样本,我们建立MM3DTBench,首个专门用于评估VLM在挑战性三维变化下鲁棒性的VQA基准数据集。对具有不同架构的代表性VLMs的广泛评估表明,现实世界三维变化可能对各类任务的模型性能构成严重威胁。
abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have exhibited remarkable generalization capabilities, yet their robustness in dynamic real-world scenarios remains largely unexplored. To systematically evaluate VLMs' robustness to real-world 3D variations, we propose AdvDreamer, the first framework capable of generating physically reproducible Adversarial 3D Transformation (Adv-3DT) samples from single-view observations. In AdvDreamer, we integrate three key innovations: Firstly, to characterize real-world 3D variations with limited prior knowledge precisely, we design a zero-shot Monocular Pose Manipulation pipeline built upon generative 3D priors. Secondly, to ensure the visual quality of worst-case Adv-3DT samples, we propose Naturalness Reward Model that provides continuous naturalness regularization during adversarial optimization, effectively preventing convergence to hallucinated or unnatural elements. Thirdly, to enable systematic evaluation across diverse VLM architectures and visual-language tasks, we introduce the Inverse Semantic Probability loss as the adversarial optimization objective, which solely operates in the fundamental visual-textual alignment space. Based on the captured Adv-3DT samples with high aggressiveness and transferability, we establish MM3DTBench, the first VQA benchmark dataset tailored to evaluate VLM robustness under challenging 3D variations. Extensive evaluations of representative VLMs with varying architectures reveal that real-world 3D variations can pose severe threats to model performance across various tasks.
authors: Shouwei Ruan, Hanqing Liu, Yao Huang, Xiaoqi Wang, Caixin Kang, Hang Su, Yinpeng Dong, Xingxing Wei ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7894-7904

title: 基于线性化前瞻变分得分蒸馏的文本到3D生成方法研究
title_en: Advancing Text-to-3D Generation with Linearized Lookahead Variational Score Distillation
abstract: 基于预训练2D扩散模型的得分蒸馏的文本到3D生成技术日益受到关注,其中变分得分蒸馏(VSD)是一个显著的范例。VSD证明通过引入额外的基于得分的模型,该模型表征从3D模型渲染图像的分布,可以改进传统的得分蒸馏方法,从而校正蒸馏梯度。尽管具有理论基础,但VSD在实践中可能面临收敛缓慢且有时病态的问题。本文深入研究了引入的得分模型与3D模型之间的相互作用,发现实际实现中LoRA与3D分布存在不匹配问题。通过简单调整其优化顺序即可提升生成质量。这样,得分模型能够前瞻当前3D状态,从而产生更合理的校正。然而,朴素的前瞻VSD可能因潜在过拟合而出现训练不稳定。为解决此问题,我们提出使用模型的线性化变体进行得分蒸馏,提出线性化前瞻变分得分蒸馏(L^2-VSD)。L^2-VSD可通过现有深度学习库的前向模式自动微分功能高效实现。大量实验验证了L^2-VSD的有效性,揭示其相较于先前基于得分蒸馏的方法具有明显优势。我们还表明该方法可无缝集成到任何其他基于VSD的文本到3D框架中。
abstract_en: Text-to-3D generation based on score distillation of pre-trained 2D diffusion models has gained increasing interest, with variational score distillation (VSD) as a remarkable example. VSD proves that vanilla score distillation can be improved by introducing an extra score-based model, which characterizes the distribution of images rendered from 3D models, to correct the distillation gradient. Despite the theoretical foundations, VSD, in practice, is likely to suffer from slow and sometimes ill-posed convergence.In this paper, we perform an in-depth investigation of the interplay between the introduced score model and the 3D model, and find that there exists a mismatching problem between LoRA and 3D distributions in practical implementation. We can simply adjust their optimization order to improve the generation quality. By doing so, the score model looks ahead to the current 3D state and hence yields more reasonable corrections. Nevertheless, naive lookahead VSD may suffer from unstable training in practice due to the potential over-fitting. To address this, we propose to use a linearized variant of the model for score distillation, giving rise to the Linearized Lookahead Variational Score Distillation (L^2-VSD). L^2-VSD can be realized efficiently with forward-mode autodiff functionalities of existing deep learning libraries. Extensive experiments validate the efficacy of L^2-VSD, revealing its clear superiority over prior score distillation-based methods. We also show that our method can be seamlessly incorporated into any other VSD-based text-to-3D framework.
authors: Yu Lei, Bingde Liu, Qingsong Xie, Haonan Lu, Zhijie Deng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19567-19576

title: 基于锚定属性的文本提示学习方法
title_en: Advancing Textual Prompt Learning with Anchored Attributes
abstract: 基于文本的提示学习方法主要通过级联方式将多个可学习的软提示和硬类别标记作为文本输入,旨在对齐图像与文本(类别)空间以服务于下游任务。然而,当前训练受限于仅能对齐预定义的已知类别,无法关联未知类别。在本工作中,我们提出利用通用属性作为桥梁,增强图像与未知类别的对齐。具体而言,我们为视觉-语言模型提出一种基于属性锚定的文本提示学习方法,命名为ATPrompt。该方法通过将多个属性标记整合到可学习软提示中,将软提示的学习空间从原始的一维类别层面扩展到多维属性层面。通过这种修改,我们将文本提示从以类别为中心的形式转换为属性-类别混合形式。此外,我们引入了一种简单且可微分的属性搜索方法,以识别适用于下游任务的代表性属性。作为一种易于使用的插件技术,ATPrompt可无缝替代现有基于文本方法中的基础提示格式,在计算成本可忽略的情况下提供通用性能提升。在11个数据集上的广泛实验验证了我们方法的有效性。代码已公开在https://github.com/zhengli97/ATPrompt。
abstract_en: Textual-based prompt learning methods primarily employ multiple learnable soft prompts and hard class tokens in a cascading manner as text inputs, aiming to align image and text (category) spaces for downstream tasks. However, current training is restricted to aligning images with predefined known categories and cannot be associated with unknown categories. In this work, we propose utilizing universal attributes as a bridge to enhance the alignment between images and unknown categories. Specifically, we introduce an Attribute-anchored Textual Prompt learning method for vision-language models, named ATPrompt. This approach expands the learning space of soft prompts from the original one-dimensional category level into the multi-dimensional attribute level by incorporating multiple attribute tokens into the learnable soft prompts. Through this modification, we transform the text prompt from a category-centric form to an attribute-category hybrid form. Additionally, we introduce a straightforward differentiable attribute search method to identify representative and suitable attributes for downstream tasks. As an easy-to-use plug-in technique, ATPrompt can seamlessly replace the existing basic prompt format in textual-based methods, providing general improvements at a negligible computational cost. Extensive experiments across 11 datasets validate the effectiveness of our method. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/zhengli97/ATPrompt.
authors: Zheng Li, Yibing Song, Ming-Ming Cheng, Xiang Li, Jian Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3618-3627

title: 面向多粒度多功能感知的视觉大语言模型进展
title_en: Advancing Visual Large Language Model for Multi-granular Versatile Perception
abstract: 感知是计算机视觉领域的基础任务,涵盖多种子任务,可基于两个维度(预测类型和指令类型)系统划分为四个 distinct 组。值得注意的是,现有研究往往仅聚焦于这些潜在组合中的有限子集,这限制了其在不同场景下的适用性和通用性。为应对这一挑战,我们提出 MVL-LM 框架,该框架融合视觉大语言模型,实现多粒度多功能感知。我们的框架设计于单一架构中集成基于词和基于句子的感知任务,以及框和掩码预测。MVL-LM 特征包含创新的多粒度解码器与受思维链启发的数据集统一策略,支持全景分割、检测、定位、指称表达分割等广泛任务的无缝监督微调。此外,我们引入查询增强策略,旨在利用视觉大语言模型(VLLMs)的解码与生成能力。在基于词和基于句子的感知任务的多个基准测试中进行的广泛实验验证了框架的有效性。代码将开源于 https://github.com/xiangwentao666/MVP-LM。
abstract_en: Perception is a fundamental task in the field of computer vision, encompassing a diverse set of subtasks that can be systematically categorized into four distinct groups based on two dimensions: prediction type and instruction type. Notably, existing researches often focus solely on a limited subset of these potential combinations, which constrains their applicability and versatility across various contexts. In response to this challenge, we present MVL-LM, a Multi-granular and Versatile Perception framework incorporating Visual Large Language Model. Our framework is designed to integrate both word-based and sentence-based perception tasks alongside box and mask predictions within a single architecture. MVL-LM features an innovative multi-granularity decoder in conjunction with a CoT-inspired dataset unification strategy, enabling seamless supervised fine-tuning across a wide spectrum of tasks, including but not limited to panoptic segmentation, detection, grounding, and referring expression segmentation. Furthermore, we introduce a query enhancement strategy aimed at harnessing the decoding and generative capabilities inherent in VLLMs. Extensive experiments conducted across a range of benchmarks in both word-based and sentence-based perception tasks substantiate the efficacy of our framework. The code will be available at https://github.com/xiangwentao666/MVP-LM.
authors: Wentao Xiang, Haoxian Tan, Yujie Zhong, Cong Wei, Dengjie Li, Yujiu Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22153-22164

title: 针对大型目标检测Transformer的对抗性注意力扰动
title_en: Adversarial Attention Perturbations for Large Object Detection Transformers
abstract: 对抗性扰动是揭示神经网络漏洞的有用工具。现有的目标检测对抗性扰动方法要么仅限于攻击基于CNN的检测器,要么对基于Transformer的检测器效果不佳。本文提出了一种针对目标检测Transformer的注意力聚焦攻击梯度(AFOG)攻击方法。从设计上,AFOG与神经网络架构无关,并通过统一的对抗性注意力框架,有效攻击大型基于Transformer的目标检测器和传统基于CNN的检测器。本文做出三项原创贡献。首先,AFOG利用可学习的注意力机制,专注于多框检测任务中脆弱的图像区域,相较于非注意力基线方法,性能提升高达30.6%。其次,AFOG的攻击损失通过可学习注意力更新,结合两种类型的特征损失,并通过对抗性扰动的迭代注入进行建模。最后,AFOG是一种高效且隐蔽的对抗性扰动方法。它通过添加策略性生成且视觉不可察觉的扰动,探测检测Transformer的薄弱环节,使训练良好的目标检测模型失效。在COCO数据集上对十二种大型检测Transformer进行的广泛实验验证了AFOG的有效性。我们的实证结果表明,AFOG在基于Transformer和CNN的目标检测器攻击中,性能优于现有方法高达83%,且具有更优的速度和隐蔽性。代码已开源:https://github.com/zacharyyahn/AFOG
abstract_en: Adversarial perturbations are useful tools for exposing vulnerabilities in neural networks. Existing adversarial perturbation methods for object detection are either limited to attacking CNN-based detectors or weak against transformer-based detectors. This paper presents an Attention-Focused Offensive Gradient (AFOG) attack against object detection transformers. By design, AFOG is neural-architecture agnostic and effective for attacking both large transformer-based object detectors and conventional CNN-based detectors with a unified adversarial attention framework. This paper makes three original contributions. First, AFOG utilizes a learnable attention mechanism that focuses perturbations on vulnerable image regions in multi-box detection tasks, increasing performance over non-attention baselines by up to 30.6%. Second, AFOG's attack loss is formulated by integrating two types of feature loss through learnable attention updates with iterative injection of adversarial perturbations. Finally, AFOG is an efficient and stealthy adversarial perturbation method. It probes the weak spots of detection transformers by adding strategically generated and visually imperceptible perturbations which can cause well-trained object detection models to fail. Extensive experiments conducted with twelve large detection transformers on COCO demonstrate the efficacy of AFOG. Our empirical results also show that AFOG outperforms existing attacks on transformer-based and CNN-based object detectors by up to 83% with superior speed and imperceptibility. Code is available at: https://github.com/zacharyyahn/AFOG
authors: Zachary Yahn, Selim Furkan Tekin, Fatih Ilhan, Sihao Hu, Tiansheng Huang, Yichang Xu, Margaret Loper, Ling Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3184-3193

title: 基于李雅普诺夫指数引导优化的单域泛化对抗性数据增强
title_en: Adversarial Data Augmentation for Single Domain Generalization via Lyapunov Exponent-Guided Optimization
abstract: 单域泛化(SDG)旨在仅使用单一源域开发能够泛化到未见目标域的模型,这一任务因显著的域偏移和有限的数据多样性而复杂。现有SDG方法主要依赖数据增强技术,但难以有效调整训练动态以适应大规模域偏移。为解决这一问题,我们提出LEAwareSGD,一种受动力系统理论启发的李雅普诺夫指数(LE)引导优化方法。通过利用LE测量值调节学习率,LEAwareSGD鼓励模型在混沌边缘附近进行训练,这一关键状态在稳定性和适应性之间达到最佳平衡。这种动态调整使模型能够探索更宽的参数空间并捕捉更多可泛化的特征,最终提升模型的泛化能力。在PACS、OfficeHome和DomainNet上的大量实验表明,LEAwareSGD在低数据量场景下实现显著的泛化提升,在PACS数据集上达到最高9.47%的改进。这些结果突显了在混沌边缘附近训练对增强SDG任务中模型泛化能力的有效性。
abstract_en: Single Domain Generalization (SDG) aims to develop models capable of generalizing to unseen target domains using only one source domain, a task complicated by substantial domain shifts and limited data diversity. Existing SDG approaches primarily rely on data augmentation techniques, which struggle to effectively adapt training dynamics to accommodate large domain shifts. To address this, we propose LEAwareSGD, a novel Lyapunov Exponent (LE)-guided optimization approach inspired by dynamical systems theory. By leveraging LE measurements to modulate the learning rate, LEAwareSGD encourages model training near the edge of chaos, a critical state that optimally balances stability and adaptability. This dynamic adjustment allows the model to explore a wider parameter space and capture more generalizable features, ultimately enhancing the model's generalization capability. Extensive experiments on PACS, OfficeHome, and DomainNet demonstrate that LEAwareSGD yields substantial generalization gains, achieving up to 9.47% improvement on PACS in low-data regimes. These results underscore the effectiveness of training near the edge of chaos for enhancing model generalization capability in SDG tasks.
authors: Zuyu Zhang, Ning Chen, Yongshan Liu, Qinghua Zhang, Xu Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 552-561

title: 对抗分布匹配用于扩散蒸馏:面向高效图像与视频合成
title_en: Adversarial Distribution Matching for Diffusion Distillation Towards Efficient Image and Video Synthesis
abstract: 分布匹配蒸馏(DMD)是一种有前景的分数蒸馏技术,能够将预训练的教师扩散模型压缩为高效的单步或多步学生生成器。然而,其依赖于反向Kullback-Leibler(KL)散度最小化可能在某些应用中导致模式坍缩(或模式寻求)。为克服这一固有缺陷,我们提出对抗分布匹配(ADM),一种新颖框架,利用基于扩散的判别器以对抗方式对齐真实与伪造分数估计器的潜在预测,实现分数蒸馏。在极具挑战性的单步蒸馏场景中,我们进一步通过结合潜在空间和像素空间的混合判别器进行对抗蒸馏,改进预训练生成器。不同于DMD2预训练中使用的均方误差,我们的方法引入了从教师模型收集的常微分方程对的分布损失,从而为后续分数蒸馏微调提供更好的初始化。通过将对抗蒸馏预训练与ADM微调结合为统一流程DMDX,我们的方法在SDXL上实现了优于DMD2的单步性能,同时消耗更少的GPU时间。此外,对SD3-Medium、SD3.5-Large和CogVideoX应用多步ADM蒸馏的额外实验,为高效图像和视频合成设定了新基准。
abstract_en: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) is a promising score distillation technique that compresses pre-trained teacher diffusion models into efficient one-step or multi-step student generators.Nevertheless, its reliance on the reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence minimization potentially induces mode collapse (or mode-seeking) in certain applications.To circumvent this inherent drawback, we propose Adversarial Distribution Matching (ADM), a novel framework that leverages diffusion-based discriminators to align the latent predictions between real and fake score estimators for score distillation in an adversarial manner.In the context of extremely challenging one-step distillation, we further improve the pre-trained generator by adversarial distillation with hybrid discriminators in both latent and pixel spaces.Different from the mean squared error used in DMD2 pre-training, our method incorporates the distributional loss on ODE pairs collected from the teacher model, and thus providing a better initialization for score distillation fine-tuning in the next stage.By combining the adversarial distillation pre-training with ADM fine-tuning into a unified pipeline termed DMDX, our proposed method achieves superior one-step performance on SDXL compared to DMD2 while consuming less GPU time.Additional experiments that apply multi-step ADM distillation on SD3-Medium, SD3.5-Large, and CogVideoX set a new benchmark towards efficient image and video synthesis.
authors: Yanzuo Lu, Yuxi Ren, Xin Xia, Shanchuan Lin, Xing Wang, Xuefeng Xiao, Andy J. Ma, Xiaohua Xie, Jian-Huang Lai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16818-16829

title: 利用数据多样性进行对抗性训练提升视觉定位
title_en: Adversarial Exploitation of Data Diversity Improves Visual Localization
abstract: 视觉定位,即估计相机在已知场景中的位姿,是自主系统的基本能力。尽管绝对位姿回归(APR)方法在高效推理方面展现出潜力,但它们通常在泛化能力上存在不足。近期方法通过采用多视角数据增强来应对这一问题,却忽略了关键因素:外观多样性。在本工作中,我们将外观变化识别为实现鲁棒定位的关键。具体而言,我们首先将真实2D图像提升为具有不同外观和去模糊能力的3D高斯点云,从而合成出在姿态和环境条件(如光照和天气)方面均具有多样性的训练数据。为充分释放外观多样性数据的潜力,我们构建了一个包含两个分支的联合训练管道,并通过对抗性判别器弥合合成到真实场景的差距。大量实验表明,我们的方法显著优于现有最先进方法,在室内数据集上将平移和旋转误差分别降低50%和22%,在室外数据集上分别降低37%和42%。值得注意的是,我们的方法在动态驾驶场景(不同天气条件)和昼夜场景中展现出显著的鲁棒性,而此前的APR方法在这些场景中均失效。
abstract_en: Visual localization, which estimates a camera's pose within a known scene, is a fundamental capability for autonomous systems. While absolute pose regression (APR) methods have shown promise for efficient inference, they often struggle with generalization. Recent approaches attempt to address this through data augmentation with varied viewpoints, yet they overlook a critical factor: appearance diversity.In this work, we identify appearance variation as the key to robust localization. Specifically, we first lift real 2D images into 3D Gaussian Splats with varying appearance and deblurring capabilities, enabling the synthesis of diverse training data that varies not just in poses but also in environmental conditions such as lighting and weather. To fully unleash the potential of the appearance-diverse data, we build a two-branch joint training pipeline with an adversarial discriminator to bridge the syn-to-real gap.Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, reducing translation and rotation errors by 50% and 22% on indoor datasets, and 37% and 42% on outdoor datasets. Most notably, our method shows remarkable robustness in dynamic driving scenarios under varying weather conditions and in day-to-night scenarios, where previous APR methods fail.
authors: Sihang Li, Siqi Tan, Bowen Chang, Jing Zhang, Chen Feng, Yiming Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26848-26858

title: 基于超分辨率与扩散的对抗净化
title_en: Adversarial Purification via Super-Resolution and Diffusion
abstract: 深度神经网络广泛应用于各类计算机视觉任务,但其对对抗扰动的脆弱性仍是可靠决策的重要挑战。对抗净化作为一种测试时防御策略,通过扩散模型去除噪声展现出对抗威胁的潜力。采用现成模型的即插即用方法表现出高度有效性。然而,扩散模型净化后的数据往往偏离原始数据更远,导致关键信息丢失并引发误分类。本研究提出,通过超分辨率(SR)上采样后下采样的方式,也可辅助消除对抗噪声,类似于扩散模型中的噪声添加与去除过程。尽管SR单独效果不及扩散过程,但其更有效地恢复与网络早期层相关联的原始特征。通过结合初始缓解对抗攻击对早期层信息损害的SR与扩散模型,我们观察到协同效应,从而在性能上超越单纯使用扩散模型。综合评估表明,该联合方法PuriFlow显著提升准确率与鲁棒性,与前沿方法协同工作。
abstract_en: Deep neural networks are widely used in various computer vision tasks, but their vulnerability to adversarial perturbations remains a significant challenge for reliable decision-making. Adversarial purification, a test-time defense strategy, has shown potential in countering these threats by removing noise through diffusion models. This plug-and-play method, using off-the-shelf models, appears highly effective. However, the purified data from diffusion often deviates more from the original data than the adversarial examples, leading to missing critical information and causing misclassification. In this study, we propose that upsampling with Super-Resolution (SR), followed by downsampling, can also aid in eliminating adversarial noise, similar to the noise addition and removal process in diffusion models. While SR alone is not as effective as the diffusion process, it better restores the original features typically associated with the early layers of networks. By combining SR, which initially mitigates damage to early-layer information from adversarial attacks, with diffusion, we observe a synergistic effect, leading to enhanced performance over diffusion models alone. Our comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that this combined approach, PuriFlow, significantly improves accuracy and robustness, working synergistically with state-of-the-art methods.
authors: Mincheol Park, Cheonjun Park, Seungseop Lim, Mijin Koo, Hyunwuk Lee, Won Woo Ro, Suhyun Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4605-4615

title: 对抗性重建反馈用于鲁棒细粒度泛化
title_en: Adversarial Reconstruction Feedback for Robust Fine-grained Generalization
