We also introduce a pose modulation strategy that enables the model to handle more diverse motion patterns. Experimental results demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed method.
authors: Li Hu, Guangyuan Wang, Zhen Shen, Xin Gao, Dechao Meng, Lian Zhuo, Peng Zhang, Bang Zhang, Liefeng Bo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10207-10217

title: AnimateAnyMesh: 一种用于文本驱动通用网格动画的前馈四维基础模型
title_en: AnimateAnyMesh: A Feed-Forward 4D Foundation Model for Text-Driven Universal Mesh Animation
abstract: 近年来,四维内容生成领域取得了显著进展,引起了广泛关注,但高质量的动画3D模型生成仍面临挑战,这归因于时空分布建模的复杂性以及四维训练数据的稀缺性。本文提出AnimateAnyMesh,这是首个能够高效实现任意3D网格文本驱动动画的前馈框架。我们的方法采用了一种新颖的DyMeshVAE架构,在分离空间与时间特征的同时保持局部拓扑结构,从而有效压缩和重建动态网格序列。为实现高质量的文本条件生成,我们在压缩的潜在空间中采用基于修正流的训练策略。此外,我们贡献了DyMesh数据集,包含超过400万个带有文本注释的多样化动态网格序列。实验结果表明,我们的方法可在数秒内生成语义准确且时间连贯的网格动画,在质量和效率方面显著优于现有方法。我们的工作标志着四维内容创作更加易用和实用的重要进展。所有数据、代码和模型将开放发布。
abstract_en: Recent advances in 4D content generation have attracted increasing attention, yet creating high-quality animated 3D models remains challenging due to the complexity of modeling spatio-temporal distributions and the scarcity of 4D training data. In this paper, we present AnimateAnyMesh, the first feed-forward framework that enables efficient text-driven animation of arbitrary 3D meshes. Our approach leverages a novel DyMeshVAE architecture that effectively compresses and reconstructs dynamic mesh sequences by disentangling spatial and temporal features while preserving local topological structures. To enable high-quality text-conditional generation, we employ a Rectified Flow-based training strategy in the compressed latent space. Additionally, we contribute the DyMesh Dataset, containing over 4M diverse dynamic mesh sequences with text annotations. Experimental results demonstrate that our method generates semantically accurate and temporally coherent mesh animations in a few seconds, significantly outperforming existing approaches in both quality and efficiency. Our work marks a substantial step forward in making 4D content creation more accessible and practical. All the data, code, and models will be open-released.
authors: Zijie Wu, Chaohui Yu, Fan Wang, Xiang Bai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13557-13568

title: AnimeGamer:基于下一步游戏状态预测的无限动漫生命模拟
title_en: AnimeGamer: Infinite Anime Life Simulation with Next Game State Prediction
abstract: 图像和视频合成领域的最新进展为生成式游戏开辟了新的可能性。其中特别引人注目的应用是将动画电影角色转化为可交互、可操作的实体。这使玩家能够通过语言指令,以自己喜爱的角色身份沉浸于动态的动漫世界中进行生命模拟。此类游戏被定义为"无限游戏",因其消除了预设的边界和固定的游戏规则,玩家可通过开放性语言与游戏世界互动,体验不断演化的故事情节和环境。近期,一种开创性的无限动漫生命模拟方法采用大语言模型(LLMs)将多轮文本对话转化为图像生成的语言指令。然而该方法忽略了历史视觉上下文,导致游戏体验不一致。此外,其仅生成静态图像,未能融入动态元素以实现沉浸式游戏体验。本文提出AnimeGamer,基于多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)生成每个游戏状态,包括描绘角色动作和状态更新的动态动画镜头,如图1所示。我们引入了新颖的动作感知多模态表示方法,可解码为高质量视频片段。通过将历史动画镜头表示作为上下文并预测后续表示,AnimeGamer能够生成具有上下文一致性和满意动态效果的游戏。通过自动化指标和人工评估的广泛测试表明,AnimeGamer在多个游戏体验维度上均优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in image and video synthesis have opened up new promise in generative games. One particularly intriguing application is transforming characters from anime films into interactive, playable entities. This allows players to immerse themselves in the dynamic anime world as their favorite characters for life simulation through language instructions. Such games are defined as "infinite game" since they eliminate predetermined boundaries and fixed gameplay rules, where players can interact with the game world through open-ended language and experience ever-evolving storylines and environments. Recently, a pioneering approach for infinite anime life simulation employs large language models (LLMs) to translate multi-turn text dialogues into language instructions for image generation. However, it neglects historical visual context, leading to inconsistent gameplay. Furthermore, it only generates static images, failing to incorporate the dynamics necessary for an engaging gaming experience. In this work, we propose AnimeGamer, which is built upon Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to generate each game state, including dynamic animation shots that depict character movements and updates to character states, as illustrated in Figure 1. We introduce novel action-aware multimodal representations to represent animation shots, which can be decoded into high-quality video clips using a video diffusion model. By taking historical animation shot representations as context and predicting subsequent representations, AnimeGamer can generate games with contextual consistency and satisfactory dynamics. Extensive evaluations using both automated metrics and human evaluations demonstrate that AnimeGamer outperforms existing methods in various aspects of the gaming experience.
authors: Junhao Cheng, Yuying Ge, Yixiao Ge, Jing Liao, Ying Shan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10875-10885

title: AnnofreeOD:无需人工标注的低帧率下所有类别检测
title_en: AnnofreeOD: Detecting All Classes at Low Frame Rates Without Human Annotations
abstract: 在大规模3D场景中手动标注3D边界框成本高昂且耗时。这促使我们探索使用未标注点云数据的无标注3D目标检测方法。现有无监督3D检测框架主要通过场景流识别运动物体,存在显著局限性:(1) 检测类别有限(<=3),(2) 难以检测静止物体,(3) 依赖高帧率。为解决这些局限性,我们提出AnnofreeOD,一种基于2D到3D知识蒸馏的新型无标注目标检测框架。首先,我们探索了利用单帧2D知识生成高质量伪框的有效策略。其次,我们观察到前一步骤中的噪声,并基于框增强(Box Augmentation)引入噪声鲁棒回归(Noise-Resistant Regression)。AnnofreeOD在多项实验中达到最先进性能。在nuScenes数据集上,我们建立了首个无标注10类目标检测基准,达到完全监督方法性能的40%。此外,在3类和类别无关目标检测任务中,我们的方法分别以+9.3% mAP(+12.2% NDS)和+6.0% AP(+4.2% NDS)超越现有最先进方法,显著提升精度。
abstract_en: Manual annotation of 3D bounding boxes in large-scale 3D scenes is expensive and time-consuming. This motivates the exploration of annotation-free 3D object detection using unlabeled point cloud data. Existing unsupervised 3D detection frameworks predominantly identify moving objects via scene flow, which has significant limitations: (1) limited detection classes (<=3), (2) difficulty in detecting stationary objects, and (3) reliance on high frame rates. To address these limitations, we propose AnnofreeOD, a novel Annotation-free Object Detection framework based on 2D-to-3D knowledge distillation. First, we explore an effective strategy to generate high-quality pseudo boxes using single-frame 2D knowledge. Second, we observe the noise from the previous step and introduce Noise-Resistant Regression (NRR) based on Box Augmentation (BA). AnnofreeOD achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple experiments. On the nuScenes dataset, we established the first annotation-free 10-class object detection baseline, achieving 40% of fully supervised performance. Furthermore, in 3-class and class-agnostic object detection tasks, our approach surpasses prior state-of-the-art methods by +9.3% mAP (+12.2% NDS) and +6.0% AP (+4.2% NDS), significantly improving precision.
authors: Boyi Sun, Yuhang Liu, Houxin He, Yonglin Tian, Fei-Yue Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5315-5325

title: 基于大视觉模型SAIC的集成电路封装基板异常检测:数据集构建、方法论与应用
title_en: Anomaly Detection of Integrated Circuits Package Substrates Using the Large Vision Model SAIC: Dataset Construction, Methodology, and Application
abstract: 异常检测在工业领域发挥着关键作用,特别是在确保集成电路(IC)质量方面,这对产品可靠性与性能至关重要。随着对更高质量标准的需求增加,异常检测在IC制造过程中已成为重要的研究方向。然而,由于缺陷样本稀缺和标注定义不明确,IC异常检测的进展受到阻碍。为应对这一挑战,本文聚焦于IC领域研究,特别是陶瓷封装基板(CPS)。我们构建了一套系统化的自动化光学检测(AOI)设备,并基于此收集了大规模CPS 2D图像,构建了一个新型异常检测数据集(CPS2D-AD),该数据集包含大量精确标注的样本,包括类别、掩码和边界框。据我们所知,CPS2D-AD是目前IC领域最大的数据集。同时,我们对CPS2D-AD进行了广泛基准测试,旨在通过提供高分辨率陶瓷封装基板异常检测与定位的基准,补充现有研究。此外,我们基于CPS2D-AD数据集开发了一种新型大视觉模型——Segment Any Integrated Circuits(SAIC),该模型通过嵌入式蒸馏机制实现。我们的CPS2D-AD是首个公开的陶瓷封装基板异常检测数据集,可通过https://github.com/Bingyang0410/CPS2D-AD访问。
abstract_en: Anomaly detection plays a crucial role in the industrial sector, especially in ensuring the quality of integrated circuits (IC), which are critical for product reliability and performance. With increasing demands for higher quality standards, anomaly detection during the IC manufacturing process has become a significant research focus. However, the progress of IC anomaly detection is hampered by the scarcity of defective samples and the shortage of well-defined annotations. To address this challenge, this paper focuses on the research in the field of IC, especially on ceramic package substrates (CPS). We construct a systematic automated optical inspection (AOI) equipment, and based on this, collected large-scale CPS 2D images to build a novel anomaly detection dataset (CPS2D-AD), which offers copious samples with precise annotations, including category, mask, and bounding box. To the best of our knowledge, CPS2D-AD is the largest dataset in the field of IC. Meanwhile, we conduct an extensive benchmark of CPS2D-AD, intending to supplement existing research by providing a baseline for the detection and localization of anomalies in high-resolution data of ceramic package substrates. In addition, we have developed a novel large vision model, Segment Any Integrated Circuits (SAIC), by embedding-based distillation mechanism based on CPS2D-AD datasets. Our CPS2D-AD is the first open-source anomaly detection dataset about ceramic package substrates, which can be accessed at https://github.com/Bingyang0410/CPS2D-AD.
authors: Ruiyun Yu, Bingyang Guo, Haoyuan Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22563-22574

title: 针对未经授权的个人图像生成的反篡改保护
title_en: Anti-Tamper Protection for Unauthorized Individual Image Generation
abstract: 随着个性化图像生成技术的发展,关于侵犯肖像权和隐私的伪造攻击的担忧日益增加。为应对这些担忧,已开发出保护扰动算法以干扰伪造生成。然而,当伪造攻击者应用净化技术绕过保护时,保护算法将失效。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的方法Anti-Tamper Perturbation (ATP)。ATP在扰动中引入了防篡改机制,包含保护扰动和授权扰动。其中,保护扰动用于防御伪造攻击,而授权扰动用于检测基于净化的篡改。在掩码的指导下,两种扰动均在频域中应用,确保保护扰动不会干扰授权扰动。这种设计还使授权扰动能够分布于所有图像像素,保持其对基于净化的篡改的敏感性。通过大量实验,ATP在各种攻击场景中验证了其防御伪造攻击的有效性,为保护个人肖像权和隐私提供了稳健的解决方案。我们的代码可在:https://github.com/Seeyn/Anti-Tamper-Perturbation 获取。
abstract_en: With the advancement of personalized image generation technologies, concerns about forgery attacks that infringe on portrait rights and privacy are growing. To address these concerns, protection perturbation algorithms have been developed to disrupt forgery generation. However, the protection algorithms would become ineffective when forgery attackers apply purification techniques to bypass the protection. To address this issue, we present a novel approach, Anti-Tamper Perturbation (ATP). ATP introduces a tamper-proof mechanism within the perturbation. It consists of protection and authorization perturbations, where the protection perturbation defends against forgery attacks, while the authorization perturbation detects purification-based tampering. Both protection and authorization perturbations are applied in the frequency domain under the guidance of a mask, ensuring that the protection perturbation does not disrupt the authorization perturbation. This design also enables the authorization perturbation to be distributed across all image pixels, preserving its sensitivity to purification-based tampering. ATP demonstrates its effectiveness in defending forgery attacks across various attack settings through extensive experiments, providing a robust solution for protecting individuals' portrait rights and privacy. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Seeyn/Anti-Tamper-Perturbation.
authors: Zelin Li, Ruohan Zong, Yifan Liu, Ruichen Yao, Yaokun Liu, Yang Zhang, Dong Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15501-15510

title: Any-SSR:递归最小二乘法在大语言模型持续学习中的作用
title_en: Any-SSR: How Recursive Least Squares Works in Continual Learning of Large Language Model
abstract: 大语言模型(LLMs)具备广泛的能力,能够处理多样化的语言相关任务。然而,对LLMs进行微调会削弱其通用能力,持续微调将进一步导致积累知识的严重退化。近期,大语言模型的持续学习(CL)技术应运而生,旨在在适应新任务的同时保持已学习知识并继承通用能力。现有技术要么通过回放历史数据导致额外计算成本,要么利用单一参数高效模块学习下游任务,不同任务间的干扰限制了新知识的吸收。针对这些问题,本文提出分析子空间路由(Any-SSR)方法以解决这些挑战。对于每个任务,我们通过低秩适应在深度层特征的子空间内隔离学习,消除不同任务间的知识干扰。此外,我们提出分析路由机制以合理利用不同子空间中学习到的知识。我们的方法采用递归最小二乘法训练多任务路由模型,使路由器无需访问历史数据即可动态适应新数据。同时,路由器能有效将当前任务分配至合适子空间,并具有坚实的理论保障的非遗忘特性。实验结果表明,我们的方法在几乎完美保留先前知识的同时无缝整合新信息,有效克服了现有方法的核心局限性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/ZHUANGHP/Any-SSR获取
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) possess encompassing capabilities that can process diverse language-related tasks. However, finetuning on LLMs will diminish this general skills and continual finetuning will further cause severe degradation on accumulated knowledge. Recently, Continual Learning (CL) in Large Language Models (LLMs) arises which aims to continually adapt the LLMs to new tasks while maintaining previously learned knowledge and inheriting general skills. Existing techniques either leverage previous data to replay, leading to extra computational costs, or utilize a single parameter-efficient module to learn the downstream task, constraining new knowledge absorption with interference between different tasks. Toward these issues, this paper proposes Analytic Subspace Routing(Any-SSR) to address these challenges. For each task, we isolate the learning within a subspace of deep layers' features via low-rank adaptation, eliminating knowledge interference between different tasks. Additionally, we propose an analytic routing mechanism to properly utilize knowledge learned in different subspaces. Our approach employs Recursive Least Squares to train a multi-task router model, allowing the router to dynamically adapt to incoming data without requiring access to historical data. Also, the router effectively assigns the current task to an appropriate subspace and has a non-forgetting property of previously learned tasks with a solid theoretical guarantee. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves near-perfect retention of prior knowledge while seamlessly integrating new information, effectively overcoming the core limitations of existing methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZHUANGHP/Any-SSR
authors: Kai Tong, Kang Pan, Xiao Zhang, Erli Meng, Run He, Yawen Cui, Nuoyan Guo, Huiping Zhuang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3047-3057

title: Any2AnyTryon: 利用自适应位置嵌入实现多功能虚拟服装任务
title_en: Any2AnyTryon: Leveraging Adaptive Position Embeddings for Versatile Virtual Clothing Tasks
abstract: 基于图像的虚拟试衣(VTON)旨在通过将输入服装转移到目标人物图像上生成虚拟试衣结果。然而,配对服装-模型数据的稀缺性使得现有方法在VTON中难以实现高泛化能力和高质量结果。此外,这还限制了无需掩码的试衣生成能力。为解决数据稀缺问题,Stable Garment和MMTryon等方法采用合成数据策略,有效增加了模型侧的配对数据量。然而,现有方法通常局限于执行特定试衣任务且缺乏用户友好性。为增强VTON生成的泛化能力和可控性,我们提出Any2AnyTryon,该方法可根据不同文本指令和模型服装图像生成试衣结果以满足多样化需求,消除对掩码、姿势或其他条件的依赖。具体而言,我们首先构建了虚拟试衣数据集LAION-Garment,这是目前已知的最大开源服装试衣数据集。随后,我们引入自适应位置嵌入,使模型能够基于不同尺寸和类别的输入图像生成满意的服装模型图像或服装图像,显著提升了VTON生成的泛化能力和可控性。在实验中,我们验证了Any2AnyTryon的有效性并与其他现有方法进行对比。结果表明,Any2AnyTryon实现了灵活、可控且高质量的基于图像的虚拟试衣生成。
abstract_en: Image-based virtual try-on (VTON) aims to generate a virtual try-on result by transferring an input garment onto a target person's image. However, the scarcity of paired garment-model data makes it challenging for existing meth ods to achieve high generalization and quality in VTON.Also, it limits the ability to generate mask-free try-ons. To tackle the data scarcity problem, approaches such as Stable Garment and MMTryon use a synthetic data strategy, effectively increasing the amount of paired data on the model side. However, existing methods are typically limited to performing specific try-on tasks and lack user-friendliness.To enhance the generalization and controllability of VTON generation, we propose Any2AnyTryon, which can generate try-on results based on different textual instructions and model garment images to meet various needs,eliminating the reliance on masks, poses, or other conditions. Specifically, we first construct the virtual try-on dataset LAION-Garment, the largest known open-source garment try-on dataset. Then, we introduce adaptive position embedding, which enables the model to generate satisfactory outfitted model images or garment images based on input images of different sizes and categories, significantly enhancing the generalization and controllability of VTON generation. In our experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our Any2AnyTryon and compare it with existing methods. The results show that Any2AnyTryon enables flexible, controllable, and high-quality image-based virtual try-on generation.
authors: Hailong Guo, Bohan Zeng, Yiren Song, Wentao Zhang, Jiaming Liu, Chuang Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19085-19096

title: AnyBimanual:单臂策略迁移用于通用双臂操作
title_en: AnyBimanual: Transferring Unimanual Policy for General Bimanual Manipulation
abstract: 通用双臂操作由于高维动作空间和昂贵的数据收集而具有挑战性。相比之下,单臂策略由于扩展的模型参数和训练数据,最近在广泛的任务中展示了出色的泛化能力,能够为双臂系统提供可共享的操作知识。我们提出了一种名为AnyBimanual的即插即用方法,该方法通过少量双臂演示,将预训练的单臂策略迁移至通用双臂操作策略。具体来说,我们首先引入一个技能管理器,动态调度从预训练单臂策略中发现的技能表示,用于双臂操作任务,该管理器通过线性结合技能原语与任务导向的补偿,来表示双臂操作指令。为缓解单臂与双臂系统间的观测差异,我们提出一个视觉对齐器,生成视觉嵌入的软掩码,旨在对齐单臂策略模型每臂的视觉输入与预训练阶段的视觉输入。AnyBimanual在RLBench2的12个模拟任务中表现出优越性,成功率达到前方法的17.33%以上。在9个现实任务上的实验进一步验证了其实用性,平均成功率为84.62%。
abstract_en: General-purpose bimanual manipulation is challenging due to high-dimensional action spaces and expensive data collection. In contrast, unimanual policy has recently demonstrated impressive generalizability across a wide range of tasks because of scaled model parameters and training data, which can provide sharable manipulation knowledge for bimanual systems. We propose a plug-and-play method named AnyBimanual, which transfers pretrained unimanual policy to general bimanual manipulation policy with few bimanual demonstrations. Specifically, we first introduce a skill manager to dynamically schedule the skill representations discovered from pretrained unimanual policy for bimanual manipulation tasks, which linearly combines skill primitives with task-oriented compensation to represent the bimanual manipulation instruction. To mitigate the observation discrepancy between unimanual and bimanual systems, we present a visual aligner to generate soft masks for visual embedding, which aims to align visual input of unimanual policy model for each arm with those during pretraining stage. AnyBimanual shows superiority on 12 simulated tasks from RLBench2 with a sizable 17.33% improvement in success rate over previous methods. Experiments on 9 real-world tasks further verify its practicality with an average success rate of 84.62%.
authors: Guanxing Lu, Tengbo Yu, Haoyuan Deng, Season Si Chen, Yansong Tang, Ziwei Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13662-13672

title: AnyCalib:面向模型无关单视角相机校准的流形学习
title_en: AnyCalib: On-Manifold Learning for Model-Agnostic Single-View Camera Calibration
abstract: 我们提出AnyCalib,一种从单张真实场景图像中校准相机内参的方法,该方法与相机模型无关。当前方法主要针对特定相机模型或需要外部线索(如重力方向)在图像中可见。相反,我们认为图像中固有的透视和失真线索足以实现模型无关的相机校准。为验证这一点,我们将校准过程框架为回归每个像素对应的光线。我们首次证明,这种中间表示可实现多种相机模型(包括但不限于针孔、Brown-Conrady和Kannala-Brandt模型)内参的闭式恢复。我们的方法也适用于编辑后的图像(如裁剪和拉伸图像)。实验表明,尽管训练数据量比其他方法少几个数量级,AnyCalib仍能持续超越替代方法(包括3D基础模型)。代码已开源至https://github.com/javrtg/AnyCalib。
abstract_en: We present AnyCalib, a method for calibrating the intrinsic parameters of a camera from a single in-the-wild image, that is agnostic to the camera model. Current methods are predominantly tailored to specific camera models and/or require extrinsic cues, such as the direction of gravity, to be visible in the image. In contrast, we argue that the perspective and distortion cues inherent in images are sufficient for model-agnostic camera calibration. To demonstrate this, we frame the calibration process as the regression of the rays corresponding to each pixel. We show, for the first time, that this intermediate representation allows for a closed-form recovery of the intrinsics for a wide range of camera models, including but not limited to: pinhole, Brown-Conrady and Kannala-Brandt. Our approach also applies to edited---cropped and stretched---images. Experimentally, we demonstrate that AnyCalib consistently outperforms alternative methods, including 3D foundation models, despite being trained on orders of magnitude less data. Code is available at https://github.com/javrtg/AnyCalib.
authors: Javier Tirado-Garín, Javier Civera ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8044-8055

title: AnyI2V: 任意条件图像的运动控制动画生成
title_en: AnyI2V: Animating Any Conditional Image with Motion Control
abstract: 近期视频生成领域,特别是扩散模型的进展,推动了文本到视频(T2V)和图像到视频(I2V)合成取得显著突破。然而在有效整合动态运动信号和灵活空间约束方面仍存在挑战。现有T2V方法通常依赖文本提示,其本质缺乏对生成内容空间布局的精确控制。相比之下,I2V方法受限于对真实图像的依赖,限制了合成内容的可编辑性。尽管部分方法通过ControlNet引入基于图像的条件,但往往缺乏显式运动控制且需要计算成本高昂的训练。为解决这些局限,我们提出AnyI2V,一个无需训练的框架,可基于用户定义的运动轨迹对任意条件图像进行动画化。AnyI2V支持更广泛的条件图像模态,包括ControlNet不支持的网格、点云等数据类型,实现更灵活多样的视频生成。此外,它支持混合条件输入,并通过LoRA和文本提示实现风格迁移与编辑。大量实验表明,所提出的AnyI2V在性能上具有优势,为空间与运动控制视频生成提供了新视角。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in video generation, particularly in diffusion models, have driven notable progress in text-to-video (T2V) and image-to-video (I2V) synthesis. However, challenges remain in effectively integrating dynamic motion signals and flexible spatial constraints. Existing T2V methods typically rely on text prompts, which inherently lack precise control over the spatial layout of generated content. In contrast, I2V methods are limited by their dependence on real images, which restricts the editability of the synthesized content. Although some methods incorporate ControlNet to introduce image-based conditioning, they often lack explicit motion control and require computationally expensive training. To address these limitations, we propose AnyI2V, a training-free framework that animates any conditional images with user-defined motion trajectories. AnyI2V supports a broader range of modalities as the conditional image, including data types such as meshes and point clouds that are not supported by ControlNet, enabling more flexible and versatile video generation. Additionally, it supports mixed conditional inputs and enables style transfer and editing via LoRA and text prompts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed AnyI2V achieves superior performance and provides a new perspective in spatial- and motion-controlled video generation.
authors: Ziye Li, Hao Luo, Xincheng Shuai, Henghui Ding ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17302-17311

title: AnyPortal:零样本一致视频背景替换
title_en: AnyPortal: Zero-Shot Consistent Video Background Replacement
abstract: 尽管视频生成技术快速发展,创建精确符合用户意图的高质量视频仍是一个重大挑战。现有方法往往难以实现对视频细节的细粒度控制,限制了其实际应用价值。我们提出AnyPortal,一种新型零样本视频背景替换框架,该框架利用预训练扩散模型。我们的框架在零样本设置下,协同整合视频扩散模型的时间先验与图像扩散模型的重新照明能力。为解决前景一致性这一关键挑战,我们提出精细化投影算法,实现像素级细节操控以确保精确前景保留。AnyPortal无需训练,克服了实现前景一致性和时间连贯重新照明的挑战。实验结果表明,AnyPortal在消费级GPU上可实现高质量结果,为视频内容创作与编辑提供了实用高效的解决方案。
abstract_en: Despite the rapid advancements in video generation technology, creating high-quality videos that precisely align with user intentions remains a significant challenge. Existing methods often fail to achieve fine-grained control over video details, limiting their practical applicability. We introduce AnyPortal, a novel zero-shot framework for video background replacement that leverages pre-trained diffusion models. Our framework collaboratively integrates the temporal prior of video diffusion models with the relighting capabilities of image diffusion models in a zero-shot setting. To address the critical challenge of foreground consistency, we propose a Refinement Projection Algorithm, which enables pixel-level detail manipulation to ensure precise foreground preservation. AnyPortal is training-free and overcomes the challenges of achieving foreground consistency and temporally coherent relighting. Experimental results demonstrate that AnyPortal achieves high-quality results on consumer-grade GPUs, offering a practical and efficient solution for video content creation and editing.
authors: Wenshuo Gao, Xicheng Lan, Shuai Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18990-18999

title: ArchiSet:面向特定窗墙比的可编辑且一致的单视角建筑三维重建基准测试
title_en: ArchiSet: Benchmarking Editable and Consistent Single-View 3D Reconstruction of Buildings with Specific Window-to-Wall Ratios
abstract: 基于图像的三维生成技术在典型场景中已取得显著进展,能够高保真地捕捉复杂纹理。然而,在建筑、工程与施工(AEC)设计阶段,现有技术仍面临诸多挑战,特别是在处理特定窗墙比、确保窗户细节一致性以及实现交互式编辑方面。为解决这一研究空白并吸引更多社区关注这一实际建筑问题,我们提出新任务:特定窗墙比的可编辑且一致的单视角建筑三维生成。为实现该目标:1)我们引入ArchiSet数据集,这是首个公开的现实世界建筑设计方案数据集,包含13,728个三维建筑形式,格式包括点云、体素、网格及窗墙比信息,为三维建筑研究提供全面支持。数据集还包含超过1,482,624张图像,分为草图、彩色块图和渲染图三种类型,并配有配对的窗户掩码用于详细评估。2)我们在ArchiSet上评估了最先进的单视角三维生成算法,发现若干局限性,如体积细节丢失、窗户细节不完整及编辑性受限。3)我们提出BuildingMesh,一种专门用于从单张图像生成和编辑三维建筑形式的扩散模型,支持自定义窗墙比,适用于动态建筑设计流程。我们提出正则化方法以确保窗户一致性。框架还包含交互模块,便于进一步编辑,提升专业建筑设计流程的平台效率与准确性。实验结果表明,BuildingMesh实现了高质量三维生成并提升了设计灵活性。
abstract_en: Image-based 3D Genetation has made significant progress in typical scenarios, achieving high fidelity in capturing intricate textures. However, in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) design stages, existing technologies still face considerable challenges, particularly in handling specific window-to-wall ratios, ensuring window detail consistency, and enabling interactive editing. To address this research gap and encourage greater community attention on this practical architectural design problem, we propose a new task: Editable and Consistent Single-View 3D Genetation of Buildings with Specific Window-to-Wall Ratios. To accomplish this: 1) We introduce the ArchiSet dataset, the first public, real-world architectural design dataset, including 13,728 3D building forms in the format of point clouds, voxels, meshes, and window-to-wall ratio information, providing comprehensive support for 3D architectural design research. The dataset also contains over 1,482,624 images in three types--sketches, color block diagrams, and renderings--accompanied by paired window masks for detailed evaluation. 2) We evaluated state-of-the-art single-view 3D Genetation algorithms on ArchiSet, identifying several limitations, such as the loss of volumetric detail, incomplete window details, and limited editability. 3) We introduce BuildingMesh, a diffusion model specifically designed for generating and editing 3D architectural forms from a single image with customizable window-to-wall ratios, suitable for dynamic architectural design workflows. We propose an regularized method to ensure window consistency. Our framework also includes an interactive module for easy further editing, enhancing platform efficiency and accuracy in professional architectural design workflows. Experimental results demonstrate that BuildingMesh achieves high-quality 3D generation with improved design flexibility.
authors: Jun Yin, Pengyu Zeng, Licheng Shen, Miao Zhang, Jing Zhong, Yuxing Han, Shuai Lu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26004-26014

title: 它们相同吗?探索多模态大语言模型的视觉对应性缺陷
title_en: Are They the Same? Exploring Visual Correspondence Shortcomings of Multimodal LLMs
abstract: 近期多模态大语言模型(MLLM)在视觉感知、推理能力和视觉-语言理解方面展现出强大能力。然而,尽管物体视觉对应性是计算机视觉的核心,MLLM的视觉匹配能力却鲜有研究。我们的研究揭示,即使当前最强的MLLM模型GPT-4o,其匹配能力仍存在系统性不足。特别地,我们构建了多模态视觉匹配(MMVM)基准测试,涵盖30余个不同MLLM的公平评估。该基准基于15个开源数据集和互联网视频,并包含人工标注。此外,我们设计了自动标注流水线生成MMVM SFT数据集,包含22万条含推理标注的视觉匹配数据。据我们所知,这是首个针对MLLM社区的MLLM数据集和基准测试。最后,我们提出CoLVA,一种新型对比式MLLM,包含两项创新技术:基于物体级对比学习的细粒度视觉专家和指令增强策略。前者学习实例判别性标记,后者进一步提升指令遵循能力。CoLVA-InternVL2-4B在MMVM基准测试中达到49.80%的整体准确率(OA),分别超过GPT-4o和最佳开源MLLM Qwen2VL-72B 7.15%和11.72%。这些结果验证了我们MMVM SFT数据集和创新技术设计的有效性。代码、基准测试、数据集和模型将公开发布。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in multimodal large language models (MLLM) have shown a strong ability in visual perception, reasoning abilities, and vision-language understanding. However, the visual matching ability of MLLMs is rarely studied, despite finding the visual correspondence of objects is essential in computer vision. Our research reveals that the matching capabilities in recent MLLMs still exhibit systematic shortcomings, even with current strong MLLMs models, GPT-4o. In particular, we construct a Multimodal Visual Matching (MMVM) benchmark to fairly benchmark over 30 different MLLMs. The MMVM benchmark is built from 15 open-source datasets and Internet videos with manual annotation. In addition, we have designed an automatic annotation pipeline to generate the MMVM SFT dataset, including 220K visual matching data with reasoning annotation. To our knowledge, this is the first MLLMs dataset and benchmark for the MLLM community. Finally, we present CoLVA, a novel contrastive MLLM with two novel technical designs: fine-grained vision expert with object-level contrastive learning and instruction augmentation strategy. The former learns instance discriminative tokens, while the latter further improves instruction following ability. CoLVA-InternVL2-4B achieves an overall accuracy (OA) of 49.80% on the MMVM benchmark, surpassing GPT-4o and the best open-source MLLM, Qwen2VL-72B, by 7.15% and 11.72% OA, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our MMVM SFT dataset and our novel technical designs. Code, benchmark, dataset, and models will be released.
authors: Yikang Zhou, Tao Zhang, Shilin Xu, Shihao Chen, Qianyu Zhou, Yunhai Tong, Shunping Ji, Jiangning Zhang, Lu Qi, Xiangtai Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17663-17674

title: 视觉语言模型是否准备好用于自动驾驶?一项从可靠性、数据和指标视角的实证研究
title_en: Are VLMs Ready for Autonomous Driving? An Empirical Study from the Reliability, Data and Metric Perspectives
abstract: 近期视觉-语言模型(VLMs)的进展激发了其在自动驾驶应用中的兴趣,尤其是可解释的决策制定领域。然而,假设VLMs能提供基于视觉且可靠的驾驶解释仍缺乏实证检验。为此,我们引入DriveBench基准测试,评估了12种VLMs在17种场景下的表现,涵盖19,200张图像、20,498个问答对及四个关键驾驶任务。研究发现,VLMs常基于通用知识或文本线索生成合理响应,而非真正的视觉 grounding,尤其在视觉输入退化或缺失时更为明显。这种行为因数据集不平衡和评估指标不足而被掩盖,在安全关键场景如自动驾驶中存在重大风险。我们进一步观察到,VLMs具有内在的抗损坏意识,但仅在直接提示时才会显式承认这些问题。鉴于挑战并受其内在抗损坏意识启发,我们提出鲁棒代理利用(Robust Agentic Utilization, RAU),通过结合VLMs的抗损坏意识与外部工具的代理规划,提升下游任务的感知可靠性。本研究挑战现有评估范式,为构建更鲁棒和可解释的自动驾驶系统提供路径图。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have fueled interest in autonomous driving applications, particularly for interpretable decision-making. However, the assumption that VLMs provide visually grounded and reliable driving explanations remains unexamined. To address this, we introduce DriveBench, a benchmark evaluating 12 VLMs across 17 settings, covering 19,200 images, 20,498 QA pairs, and four key driving tasks. Our findings reveal that VLMs often generate plausible responses from general knowledge or textual cues rather than true visual grounding, especially under degraded or missing visual inputs. This behavior, concealed by dataset imbalances and insufficient evaluation metrics, poses significant risks in safety-critical scenarios like autonomous driving. We further observe that VLMs possess inherent corruption-awareness but only explicitly acknowledge these issues when directly prompted. Given the challenges and inspired by the inherent corruption awareness, we propose Robust Agentic Utilization (RAU), leveraging VLMs' corruption awareness and agentic planning with external tools to enhance perception reliability for downstream tasks. Our study challenges existing evaluation paradigms and provides a roadmap toward more robust and interpretable autonomous driving systems.
authors: Shaoyuan Xie, Lingdong Kong, Yuhao Dong, Chonghao Sima, Wenwei Zhang, Qi Alfred Chen, Ziwei Liu, Liang Pan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6585-6597

title: ArgMatch: 自适应细化汇聚用于高效密集匹配
title_en: ArgMatch: Adaptive Refinement Gathering for Efficient Dense Matching
abstract: 在多视角任务中,建立密集对应关系至关重要却计算成本高昂。尽管由粗到细方案缓解了计算成本,但其效率仍受限于重型特征提取器和全局匹配器的显著需求。本文提出自适应细化汇聚(Adaptive Refinement Gathering),一种减少对这些高成本组件依赖的细化流程,同时不牺牲精度。该流程包括(i)内容感知偏移估计器,利用内容信息实现轻量级相关体积编码与解码;(ii)局部一致匹配校正器,对大范围全局初始误差具有鲁棒性;(iii)局部一致上采样器,减少深度不连续边缘处的伪影。此外,我们引入自适应门控策略,结合局部一致性动态调节不同组件和像素的贡献。这使网络能够实现自适应梯度反向传播,充分挖掘其容量。与最先进方法相比,我们的轻量级网络ArgMatch在多个任务中取得具有竞争力的性能,同时显著降低计算成本。代码可在https://github.com/ACuOoOoO/argmatch获取。
abstract_en: Establishing dense correspondences is crucial yet computationally demanding in multi-view tasks. Although coarse-to-fine schemes mitigate computational costs, their efficiency remains limited by the substantial demands of heavy feature extractors and global matchers. In this paper, we propose Adaptive Refinement Gathering, a refinement pipeline that reduces reliance on these costly components without sacrificing accuracy. The pipeline consists of (i) a content-aware offset estimator that leverages content information for lightweight correlation volume encoding and decoding; (ii) a locally consistent match rectifier robust to large global initial errors; (iii) a locally consistent upsampler that yields fewer artifacts around depth-discontinuous edges. Additionally, we introduce an adaptive gating strategy that, in conjunction with local consistency, dynamically modulates the contribution of different components and pixels. This enables adaptive gradient backpropagation and allows the network to fully exploit its capacity. Compared to the state-of-the-art, our lightweight network, termed ArgMatch, achieves competitive performance in serval tasks, while significantly reducing the computational cost. Codes are available in https://github.com/ACuOoOoO/argmatch.
authors: Yuxin Deng, Kaining Zhang, Linfeng Tang, Jiaqi Yang, Jiayi Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27369-27379

title: ArgoTweak:通过结构化先验实现自更新高精度地图
title_en: ArgoTweak: Towards Self-Updating HD Maps through Structured Priors
abstract: 可靠地整合先验信息对于自验证和自更新的高精度地图至关重要。然而,目前尚无公开数据集包含所需的先验地图、当前地图和传感器数据的三元组。因此,现有方法必须依赖合成先验,这会导致不一致并产生显著的仿真到现实差距。为了解决这一问题,我们引入ArgoTweak,这是首个使用现实主义地图先验完成三元组的数据集。ArgoTweak的核心是一个双射映射框架,将大规模修改分解为地图元素级别的细粒度原子级变化,从而确保可解释性。这种范式转变实现了准确的变化检测与整合,同时以高保真度保留未变化元素。实验表明,在ArgoTweak上训练模型显著减少了与合成先验相比的仿真到现实差距。广泛的消融实验进一步突出了结构化先验和详细变化注释的影响。通过建立可解释、先验辅助高精度地图的基准,ArgoTweak推动了可扩展、自改进的映射解决方案。数据集、基线、地图修改工具箱及更多资源可在https://KTH-RPL.github.io/ArgoTweak/获取。
abstract_en: Reliable integration of prior information is crucial for self-verifying and self-updating HD maps. However, no public dataset includes the required triplet of prior maps, current maps, and sensor data. As a result, existing methods must rely on synthetic priors, which create inconsistencies and lead to a significant sim2real gap. To address this, we introduce ArgoTweak, the first dataset to complete the triplet with realistic map priors. At its core, ArgoTweak employs a bijective mapping framework, breaking down large-scale modifications into fine-grained atomic changes at the map element level, thus ensuring interpretability. This paradigm shift enables accurate change detection and integration while preserving unchanged elements with high fidelity. Experiments show that training models on ArgoTweak significantly reduces the sim2real gap compared to synthetic priors. Extensive ablations further highlight the impact of structured priors and detailed change annotations. By establishing a benchmark for explainable, prior-aided HD mapping, ArgoTweak advances scalable, self-improving mapping solutions. The dataset, baselines, map modification toolbox, and further resources are available at https://KTH-RPL.github.io/ArgoTweak/.
authors: Lena Wild, Rafael Valencia, Patric Jensfelt ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6091-6100

title: ArtEditor:基于少样本示例学习定制化指令图像编辑器
title_en: ArtEditor: Learning Customized Instructional Image Editor from Few-Shot Examples
abstract: 我们引入ArtEditor,一种基于指令的图像编辑新框架,能够从少样本示例中学习独特的编辑风格。尽管图像编辑技术已取得显著进展,但定制化指令编辑仍处于探索阶段。现有方法通常依赖复杂的多阶段流程,难以适配特定风格。此外,该领域缺乏标准化基准,使得评估进展变得困难。为解决这些问题,我们提出ArtEditor,一种两阶段训练框架。第一阶段,我们在大规模数据集上训练通用图像编辑模型ArtEditor-Base,构建强大的基础能力。第二阶段,通过轻量级适配模块ArtEditor-LoRA,在少量前后对比图像对数据集上微调该模型。这种策略使模型能以极少数据高效学习独特编辑风格与技术。为提升预训练扩散Transformer(DiT)模型性能,我们引入两项关键创新:位置编码克隆与无噪声条件范式。这些技术确保即使适配新风格也能实现稳定连贯的编辑。为支持该领域研究,我们贡献了DoodleArt数据集,这是首个专门设计用于定制化图像编辑的基准。DoodleArt包含六种专业艺术家与设计师创作的高质量艺术风格,为评估与推进未来工作提供了宝贵资源。大量实验表明,ArtEditor在定制化图像编辑中实现了优越的性能与鲁棒性。我们的框架为艺术创作开辟了新可能,为艺术家提供直观灵活的工具,使其愿景得以实现。
abstract_en: We introduce ArtEditor, a novel framework for instruction-based image editing that learns unique editing styles from few-shot examples. While image editing has seen significant advancements, customized instructional editing remains underexplored. Existing methods often rely on complex, multi-stage pipelines that are difficult to adapt to specific styles. Additionally, this domain lacks a standardized benchmark, making it challenging to evaluate progress. To address these issues, we propose ArtEditor, a two-stage training framework. In the first stage, we train ArtEditor-Base, a general-purpose image editing model, on large-scale datasets to build a strong foundational capability. In the second stage, we fine-tune this model using ArtEditor-LoRA, a lightweight adaptation module, on a small dataset of before-and-after image pairs. This approach enables the model to efficiently learn distinct editing styles and techniques with minimal data. To enhance the performance of a pre-trained Diffusion Transformer (DiT) model, we introduce two key innovations: position encoding cloning and a noise-free conditioning paradigm. These techniques ensure stable and coherent edits, even when adapting to new styles. To support research in this area, we contribute the DoodleArt dataset, the first benchmark specifically designed for customized image editing. DoodleArt features six high-quality artistic styles created by professional artists and designers, providing a valuable resource for evaluating and advancing future work. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ArtEditor achieves superior performance and robustness in customized image editing. Our framework opens new possibilities for artistic creation, offering artists intuitive and flexible tools to bring their visions to life.
authors: Shijie Huang, Yiren Song, Yuxuan Zhang, Hailong Guo, Xueyin Wang, Jiaming Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17651-17662

title: Arti-PG:一种用于程序化合成大规模多样可动物体的工具箱,附有丰富注释
title_en: Arti-PG: A Toolbox for Procedurally Synthesizing Large-Scale and Diverse Articulated Objects with Rich Annotations
abstract: 大量三维可动物体数据的获取成本高昂且耗时,因此三维可动物体数据的稀缺性成为深度学习方法在各类可动物体理解任务中取得显著性能的障碍。同时,将这些物体数据与详细注释配对以支持多种任务的训练也具有困难且劳动密集的特点。为快速收集大量具有全面详细注释的三维可动物体数据用于训练,我们提出了一种可动物体程序化生成工具箱,即Arti-PG工具箱。Arti-PG工具箱包含三个组成部分:i)通过通用结构程序描述可动物体及其与物体点云的解析对应关系;ii)关于对结构程序进行操作的程序化规则,以合成大规模且多样的新可动物体;iii)知识(如可用性、语义等)的数学描述,以提供合成物体的注释。Arti-PG为可动物体理解任务提供训练数据具有两个显著优势:i)通过面向程序的结构操作,物体可创建出无限形状变化;ii)Arti-PG可通过轻松提供全面详细注释广泛适用于各类任务。目前Arti-PG支持26类可动物体的程序化生成,并提供涵盖视觉与操作任务的广泛注释,我们提供了详尽实验以充分验证其优势。我们的代码已开源于https://github.com/Analytic-Concept-Group/ArtiPG。
abstract_en: The acquisition of substantial volumes of 3D articulated object data is expensive and time-consuming, and consequently the scarcity of 3D articulated object data becomes an obstacle for deep learning methods to achieve remarkable performance in various articulated object understanding tasks. Meanwhile, pairing these object data with detailed annotations to enable training for various tasks is also difficult and labor-intensive to achieve. In order to expeditiously gather a significant number of 3D articulated objects with comprehensive and detailed annotations for training, we propose Articulated Object Procedural Generation toolbox, a.k.a. Arti-PG toolbox. Arti-PG toolbox consists of i) descriptions of articulated objects by means of a generalized structure program along with their analytic correspondence to the objects' point cloud, ii) procedural rules about manipulations on the structure program to synthesize large-scale and diverse new articulated objects, and iii) mathematical descriptions of knowledge (e.g. affordance, semantics, etc.) to provide annotations to the synthesized object. Arti-PG has two appealing properties for providing training data for articulated object understanding tasks: i) objects are created with unlimited variations in shape through program-oriented structure manipulation, ii) Arti-PG is widely applicable to diverse tasks by easily providing comprehensive and detailed annotations. Arti-PG now supports the procedural generation of 26 categories of articulate objects and provides annotations across a wide range of both vision and manipulation tasks, and we provide exhaustive experiments which fully demonstrate its advantages. Our code is released at https://github.com/Analytic-Concept-Group/ArtiPG.
authors: Jianhua Sun, Yuxuan Li, Jiude Wei, Longfei Xu, Nange Wang, Yining Zhang, Cewu Lu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6396-6405

title: Articulate3D:三维场景的全面理解作为通用场景描述
title_en: Articulate3D: Holistic Understanding of 3D Scenes as Universal Scene Description
abstract: 三维场景理解是计算机视觉领域长期存在的挑战,也是实现混合现实、可穿戴计算和具身AI的关键组成部分。为这些应用提供解决方案需要涵盖以场景为中心、以对象为中心以及以交互为中心的多维度方法。尽管已有大量数据集针对前两个问题进行了研究,但对可交互和可运动对象的理解仍存在不足,相关研究仅部分覆盖。在本工作中,我们通过引入以下内容来解决这一缺陷:(1) Articulate3D,一个经过专家整理的三维数据集,包含280个室内场景的高质量手动注释。Articulate3D为可运动对象提供8种注释类型,涵盖部件和详细运动信息,所有数据均以标准化的场景表示格式存储,该格式专为可扩展的三维内容创作、交换以及无缝集成到仿真环境而设计。(2) USDNet,一种新型统一框架,能够同时预测部件分割及可运动对象的完整运动属性规格。我们在Articulate3D以及两个现有数据集上评估USDNet,验证了我们统一密集预测方法的优势。此外,我们通过跨数据集和跨领域评估突显了Articulate3D的价值,并展示了其在下游任务(如通过LLM提示进行场景编辑和可运动对象操作的机器人策略训练)中的适用性。我们提供数据集、基准测试和方法源代码的开放访问。
abstract_en: 3D scene understanding is a long-standing challenge in computer vision and a key component in enabling mixed reality, wearable computing, and embodied AI. Providing a solution to these applications requires a multifaceted approach that covers scene-centric, object-centric, as well as interaction-centric capabilities. While there exist numerous datasets approaching the former two problems, the task of understanding interactable and articulated objects is underrepresented and only partly covered in the research field. In this work, we address this shortcoming by introducing: (1) Articulate3D, an expertly curated 3D dataset featuring high-quality manual annotations on 280 indoor scenes. Articulate3D provides 8 types of annotations for articulated objects, covering parts and detailed motion information,all stored in a standardized scene representation format designed for scalable 3D content creation, exchange and seamless integration into simulation environments. (2) USDNet, a novel unified framework capable of simultaneously predicting part segmentation along with a full specification of motion attributes for articulated objects. We evaluate USDNet on Articulate3D as well as two existing datasets, demonstrating the advantage of our unified dense prediction approach. Furthermore, we highlight the value of Articulate3D through cross-dataset and cross-domain evaluations and showcase its applicability in downstream tasks such as scene editing through LLM prompting and robotic policy training for articulated object manipulation. We provide open access to our dataset, benchmark, and method's source code.
authors: Anna-Maria Halacheva, Yang Miao, Jan-Nico Zaech, Xi Wang, Luc Van Gool, Danda Pani Paudel ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5633-5644

title: 提问与记忆:一种仅基于问题的重放策略用于持续视觉问答
title_en: Ask and Remember: A Questions-Only Replay Strategy for Continual Visual Question Answering
abstract: 视觉问答(VQACL)中的持续学习要求模型在获取新视觉-语言技能(可塑性)的同时保持先前学习的知识(稳定性)。VQACL的固有多模态特性加剧了这一挑战,因为模型必须在视觉和文本领域之间平衡稳定性,同时适应新对象和推理任务。现有方法主要针对单模态设置设计,往往难以满足这一双重需求。本文提出QUestion-only replay with Attention Distillation(QUAD),一种针对VQACL的新方法,仅利用过去任务的问题进行正则化。通过消除存储视觉数据的需要,QUAD不仅减少了内存开销,还缓解了隐私担忧。我们的方法引入了Question-only Replay机制,选择性地重用先前任务的问题以对抗对当前任务答案空间的过拟合,解决答案集外的问题。此外,我们提出Attention Consistency Distillation来强制跨任务的同模态和异模态注意力一致性,保持关键的视觉-语言关联。在VQAv2和NExT-QA上的大量实验表明,QUAD显著优于现有最先进方法,在持续视觉问答中表现出鲁棒性能。
abstract_en: Continual Learning in Visual Question Answering (VQACL) requires models to acquire new visual-linguistic skills (plasticity) while preserving previously learned knowledge (stability). The inherent multimodality of VQACL exacerbates this challenge, as models must balance stability across visual and textual domains while adapting to novel objects and reasoning tasks. Existing methods, primarily designed for unimodal settings, often fall short in addressing this dual requirement. In this work, we present QUestion-only replay with Attention Distillation (QUAD), a novel approach for VQACL that leverages only past task questions for regularization. By eliminating the need to store visual data, QUAD not only reduces memory overhead, but also alleviates privacy concerns. Our method introduces a Question-only Replay mechanism that selectively reuses prior task questions to counteract overfitting to the answer space of the current task, addressing the problem out of answer set. Complementing this, we propose Attention Consistency Distillation to enforce both intra-modal and inter-modal attention consistency across tasks, preserving essential visual-linguistic associations. Extensive experiments on VQAv2 and NExT-QA demonstrate that QUAD significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving robust performance in continual VQA.
authors: Imad Eddine Marouf, Enzo Tartaglione, Stéphane Lathuilière, Joost Van De Weijer ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18078-18089

title: AstroLoc:鲁棒的空间到地面图像定位器
title_en: AstroLoc: Robust Space to Ground Image Localizer
abstract: 宇航员每天从国际空间站拍摄数万张地球照片。对这些照片进行定位,过去几十年一直依赖人工操作,近年来通过图像检索方案进行了探索:给定一张宇航员拍摄的照片,目标是在包含地理标签的卫星图像大型数据库中找到最相似的匹配项,这一任务被称为宇航员摄影定位(APL)。然而,现有的APL方法仅使用卫星图像进行训练,未利用数百万张开源宇航员照片。本文提出首个能够利用宇航员照片进行训练的APL流程。我们首先通过自动化流程为30万张手动弱标签的宇航员照片生成完整的定位信息,然后使用这些图像训练一个名为AstroLoc的模型。AstroLoc通过两个目标函数学习地球表面特征的鲁棒表示:一是通过成对损失将宇航员照片与其匹配的卫星图像进行配对,二是通过无监督挖掘对卫星图像集群进行加权,其权重基于与宇航员摄影的相关性。AstroLoc在召回率@1指标上相比先前SOTA方法实现了惊人的35%平均提升,在现有数据集上召回率@100始终超过99%。此外,无需微调,AstroLoc在相关任务如太空失联卫星问题和历史航天图像定位中也表现出色。
abstract_en: Thousands of photos of Earth are taken every day by astronauts from the International Space Station. Localizing these photos, which has been performed manually for decades, has recently been approached through image retrieval solutions: given an astronaut photo, the goal is to find its most similar match among a large database of geo-tagged satellite images, in a task called Astronaut Photography Localization (APL). Yet, existing APL approaches are trained only using satellite images, without taking advantage of the millions of open-source astronaut photos. In this work we present the first APL pipeline capable of leveraging astronaut photos for training. We first produce full localization information for 300,000 manually weakly-labeled astronaut photos through an automated pipeline, and then use these images to train a model, called AstroLoc. AstroLoc learns a robust representation of Earth's surface features through two objective functions: pairing astronaut photos with their matching satellite counterparts in a pairwise loss, and a second loss on clusters of satellite imagery weighted by their relevance to astronaut photography through unsupervised mining. AstroLoc achieves a staggering 35% average improvement in recall@1 over previous SOTA, reaching a recall@100 consistently over 99% for existing datasets. Moreover, without fine-tuning, AstroLoc provides excellent results for related tasks like the lost-in-space satellite problem and historical space imagery localization.
authors: Gabriele Berton, Alex Stoken, Carlo Masone ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5811-5820

title: 用于保护事件数据集的异步事件误差最小化噪声
title_en: Asynchronous Event Error-Minimizing Noise for Safeguarding Event Dataset
abstract: 随着越来越多的事件数据集在线发布,防止事件数据集被未经授权使用的安全问题已成为数据所有者的重大关切。不可学习示例被提出以防止图像数据集的未经授权利用。然而,如何创建不可学习的异步事件流以防止事件滥用尚不明确。在本工作中,我们提出了首个用于防止从事件数据集进行未经授权训练的不可学习事件流生成方法。提出了一种新的异步事件误差最小化噪声形式,用于扰动事件流,使未经授权的模型学习嵌入的噪声而非真实特征。为了与稀疏事件兼容,提出了一种投影策略来稀疏化噪声,从而生成我们的不可学习事件流(UEvs)。大量实验表明,我们的方法有效保护了事件数据免受未经授权的利用,同时保持其在合法使用中的效用。我们希望我们的UEvs能促进安全且可信的事件数据集共享的发展。代码可在https://github.com/rfww/uevs获取。
abstract_en: With more event datasets being released online, safeguarding the event dataset against unauthorized usage has become a serious concern for data owners. Unlearnable Examples are proposed to prevent the unauthorized exploitation of image datasets. However, it's unclear how to create unlearnable asynchronous event streams to prevent event misuse. In this work, we propose the first unlearnable event stream generation method to prevent unauthorized training from event datasets. A new form of asynchronous event error-minimizing noise is proposed to perturb event streams, tricking the unauthorized model into learning embedded noise instead of realistic features. To be compatible with the sparse event, a projection strategy is presented to sparsify the noise to render our unlearnable event streams (UEvs). Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method effectively protects event data from unauthorized exploitation, while preserving their utility for legitimate use. We hope our UEvs contribute to the advancement of secure and trustworthy event dataset sharing. Code is available at: https://github.com/rfww/uevs.
authors: Ruofei Wang, Peiqi Duan, Boxin Shi, Renjie Wan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10141-10150

title: Att-Adapter: 一种基于条件变分自编码器的鲁棒且精确的领域特定多属性文本到图像扩散适配器
title_en: Att-Adapter: A Robust and Precise Domain-Specific Multi-Attributes T2I Diffusion Adapter via Conditional Variational Autoencoder
abstract: 文本到图像(T2I)扩散模型在生成高质量图像方面取得了显著成果。然而,在仅通过文本引导的新领域(如眼睛开合程度或汽车宽度等数值属性)中实现对连续属性的精确控制,尤其是同时控制多个属性,仍是一个重大挑战。为解决这一问题,我们引入了**属性(Att)适配器**,这是一种新颖的即插即用模块,旨在使预训练扩散模型实现细粒度、多属性控制。我们的方法从一组样本图像中学习单个控制适配器,这些图像可以是未配对的且包含多个视觉属性。Att-Adapter利用解耦的交叉注意力模块,自然地将多个领域属性与文本条件进行协调。我们进一步将条件变分自编码器(CVAE)引入Att-Adapter以缓解过拟合,匹配视觉世界的多样性。在两个公开数据集上的评估表明,Att-Adapter在控制连续属性方面优于所有基于LoRA的基线方法。此外,我们的方法实现了更广的控制范围,并改进了多属性间的解耦效果,超越了基于StyleGAN的技术。值得注意的是,Att-Adapter具有灵活性,无需配对合成数据进行训练,并且可轻松扩展至单个模型中的多个属性。
abstract_en: Text-to-Image (T2I) Diffusion Models have achieved remarkable performance in generating high quality images. However, enabling precise control of continuous attributes, especially multiple attributes simultaneously, in a new domain (e.g., numeric values like eye openness or car width) with text-only guidance remains a significant challenge. To address this, we introduce the **Attribute (Att) Adapter**, a novel plug-and-play module designed to enable fine-grained, multi-attributes control in pretrained diffusion models. Our approach learns a single control adapter from a set of sample images that can be unpaired and contain multiple visual attributes. The Att-Adapter leverages the decoupled cross attention module to naturally harmonize the multiple domain attributes with text conditioning.We further introduce Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) to the Att-Adapter to mitigate overfitting, matching the diverse nature of the visual world.Evaluations on two public datasets show that Att-Adapter outperforms all LoRA-based baselines in controlling continuous attributes. Additionally, our method enables a broader control range and also improves disentanglement across multiple attributes, surpassing StyleGAN-based techniques. Notably, Att-Adapter is flexible, requiring no paired synthetic data for training, and is easily scalable to multiple attributes within a single model.
authors: Wonwoong Cho, Yan-Ying Chen, Matthew Klenk, David I. Inouye, Yanxia Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15626-15635

title: 关注神经剽窃:扩散模型可以剽窃您的版权图像!
title_en: Attention to Neural Plagiarism: Diffusion Models Can Plagiarize Your Copyrighted Images!
abstract: 本文突出新兴神经模型带来的关键威胁——数据剽窃。我们展示了现代神经模型(如扩散模型)如何轻松复制受版权保护的图像,即使这些图像采用了先进的水印技术。为暴露版权保护的脆弱性并促进未来研究,我们提出了一种通用的神经剽窃方法,该方法既能伪造受版权保护数据的副本,也能引入版权模糊性。我们的方法基于“锚点和 shim”,以逆向潜变量作为锚点,并找到shim扰动以逐渐偏离锚点潜变量,从而规避水印或版权检测。通过在不同时间步对交叉注意力机制施加扰动,我们的方法在受版权保护的图像中诱导不同程度的语义修改,使其能够绕过从可见商标、签名到不可见水印的多种保护措施。值得注意的是,我们的方法是一种纯粹的基于梯度的搜索,无需额外训练或微调。在MS-COCO和真实世界版权图像上的实验证明,扩散模型可以复制版权图像,凸显了对抗神经剽窃的迫切需求。源代码可在:https://github.com/zzzucf/Neural-Plagiarism 获取。
abstract_en: In this paper, we highlight a critical threat posed by emerging neural models--data plagiarism. We demonstrate how modern neural models (e.g., diffusion models) can effortlessly replicate copyrighted images, even when protected by advanced watermarking techniques. To expose the vulnerability in copyright protection and facilitate future research, we propose a general approach regarding neural plagiarism that can either forge replicas of copyrighted data or introduce copyright ambiguity. Our method, based on "anchors and shims", employs inverse latents as anchors and finds shim perturbations that can gradually deviate the anchor latents, thereby evading watermark or copyright detection. By applying perturbation to the cross-attention mechanism at different timesteps, our approach induces varying degrees of semantic modifications in copyrighted images, making it to bypass protections ranging from visible trademarks, signatures to invisible watermarks. Notably, our method is a purely gradient-based search that requires no additional training or fine-tuning. Empirical experiments on MS-COCO and real-world copyrighted images show that diffusion models can replicate copyrighted images, underscoring the urgent need for countermeasures against neural plagiarism. Source code is available at: https://github.com/zzzucf/Neural-Plagiarism.
authors: Zihang Zou, Boqing Gong, Liqiang Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19546-19556

title: 关注轨迹:轨迹感知的开放词汇跟踪
title_en: Attention to Trajectory: Trajectory-Aware Open-Vocabulary Tracking
abstract: 开放词汇多目标跟踪(Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking, OV-MOT)旨在使方法能够跟踪对象而不受预定义类别集合的限制。当前OV-MOT方法通常主要依赖实例级检测与关联,往往忽视了对目标跟踪任务独特且关键的轨迹信息。利用轨迹信息可以增强关联稳定性与分类准确性,特别是在遮挡和类别歧义情况下,从而提升对新类别的适应能力。受此启发,本文提出TRACT,一种基于轨迹信息的开放词汇跟踪器,通过提升OV-MOT中的目标关联与分类性能。具体而言,我们引入轨迹一致性强化(Trajectory Consistency Reinforcement, TCR)策略,通过提升目标身份与类别一致性来优化跟踪性能。此外,我们提出TraCLIP,一种即插即用的轨迹分类模块。它整合轨迹特征聚合(Trajectory Feature Aggregation, TFA)与轨迹语义增强(Trajectory Semantic Enrichment, TSE)策略,从视觉与语言视角充分挖掘轨迹信息以提升分类结果。在OV-TAO数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的TRACT显著提升了跟踪性能,突显轨迹信息作为OV-MOT的重要资产。我们将开源TRACT代码至https://github.com/Nathan-Li123/TRACT。
abstract_en: Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking (OV-MOT) aims to enable approaches to track objects without being limited to a predefined set of categories. Current OV-MOT methods typically rely primarily on instance-level detection and association, often overlooking trajectory information that is unique and essential for object tracking tasks. Utilizing trajectory information can enhance association stability and classification accuracy, especially in cases of occlusion and category ambiguity, thereby improving adaptability to novel classes. Thus motivated, in this paper we propose TRACT, an open-vocabulary tracker that leverages trajectory information to improve both object association and classification in OV-MOT. Specifically, we introduce a Trajectory Consistency Reinforcement (TCR) strategy, that benefits tracking performance by improving target identity and category consistency. In addition, we present TraCLIP, a plug-and-play trajectory classification module. It integrates Trajectory Feature Aggregation (TFA) and Trajectory Semantic Enrichment (TSE) strategies to fully leverage trajectory information from visual and language perspectives for enhancing the classification results. Extensive experiments on OV-TAO show that our TRACT significantly improves tracking performance, highlighting trajectory information as a valuable asset for OV-MOT. We will release TRACT at https://github.com/Nathan-Li123/TRACT.
authors: Yunhao Li, Yifan Jiao, Dan Meng, Heng Fan, Libo Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14390-14398

title: 关注视觉提示调优中的突发性!
title_en: Attention to the Burstiness in Visual Prompt Tuning!
abstract: 视觉提示调优(VPT)是一种参数高效的微调技术,通过在输入空间中学习少量参数(称为提示)来适应预训练的视觉Transformer(ViT)。在VPT中,我们发现图像块嵌入与Transformer自注意力模块中的键和查询投影器交互所产生的值中存在“突发性”。有趣的是,图像块嵌入的值和键、查询投影器分别呈现出拉普拉斯分布和超拉普拉斯分布。直观来看,这些非高斯分布对提示学习提出了挑战。为解决这一问题,我们提出对数据进行白化处理,去相关并使方差均等化,使其更接近高斯分布后再进行提示学习。我们推导了针对随机图像块嵌入和ViT键、查询投影器的白化矩阵,并以双线性方式将其与待学习的提示相乘。令人惊讶的是,该方法显著加速了提示调优并提升了准确率,例如在CUB数据集上提升了>25个点;有趣的是,它学习到了“突发性提示”。由于双线性模型已知会引入突发性,我们提出了一种紧凑方法,通过学习两个小规模参数集,其乘积即为最终提示。我们将该方法称为双线性提示调优(BPT)。大量实验表明,BPT方法不仅在多个基准数据集上优于各种VPT方法,还减少了参数数量和计算开销。
abstract_en: Visual Prompt Tuning (VPT) is a parameter-efficient finetuning technique that adapts a pre-trained vision Transformer (ViT) by learning a small set of parameters in the input space, known as prompts. In VPT, we uncover "burstiness" in the values arising from the interaction of image patch embeddings, and the key and query projectors within Transformer's self-attention module. Interestingly, the values of patch embeddings and the key and query projectors exhibit Laplacian and hyper-Laplacian distribution, respectively. Intuitively, these non-Gaussian distributions pose challenges for learning prompts. To address this, we propose whitening these data, de-correlating them and equalizing their variance towards more Gaussian before learning prompts. We derive the whitening matrix over random image patch embeddings and ViT's key and query projectors, and multiply it with the prompt to be learned in a bilinear manner.Surprisingly, this method significantly accelerates prompt tuning and boosts accuracy, e.g., >25 points on the CUB dataset; interestingly, it learns "bursty prompts".As bilinear models are known to introduce burstiness, we present a compact method by learning two small sets of parameters whose multiplication yields the final prompts. We call the proposed methods Bilinear Prompt Tuning (BPT). Extensive experiments demonstrate that BPT methods not only outperform various VPT methods across multiple benchmark datasets but also reduce parameter count and computation overhead.
authors: Yuzhu Wang, Manni Duan, Shu Kong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4253-4263

title: 基于掩码选择状态空间建模的视听控制视频扩散用于自然说话头生成
title_en: Audio-visual Controlled Video Diffusion with Masked Selective State Spaces Modeling for Natural Talking Head Generation
abstract: 说话头合成对于虚拟化身和人机交互至关重要。然而,大多数现有方法通常受限于单一主模态的控制,限制了其实际应用价值。为此,我们引入ACTalker,一种端到端的视频扩散框架,支持说话头视频生成的多信号控制和单信号控制。对于多信号控制,我们设计了一个并行mamba结构,包含多个分支,每个分支利用独立的驱动信号控制特定面部区域。门控机制应用于所有分支,提供对视频生成的灵活控制。为确保受控视频在时序和空间上的自然协调,我们采用mamba结构,使驱动信号能够在每个分支中跨两个维度操控特征标记。此外,我们引入了掩码丢弃策略,允许每个驱动信号在mamba结构中独立控制其对应的面部区域,防止控制冲突。实验结果表明,我们的方法能够生成由多样化信号驱动的自然外观面部视频,且mamba层无缝整合多种驱动模态而无冲突。
abstract_en: Talking head synthesis is vital for virtual avatars and human-computer interaction. However, most existing methods are typically limited to accepting control from a single primary modality, restricting their practical utility. To this end, we introduce ACTalker, an end-to-end video diffusion framework that supports both multi-signals control and single-signal control for talking head video generation. For multiple control, we design a parallel mamba structure with multiple branches, each utilizing a separate driving signal to control specific facial regions. A gate mechanism is applied across all branches, providing flexible control over video generation. To ensure natural coordination of the controlled video both temporally and spatially, we employ the mamba structure, which enables driving signals to manipulate feature tokens across both dimensions in each branch. Additionally, we introduce a mask-drop strategy that allows each driving signal to independently control its corresponding facial region within the mamba structure, preventing control conflicts. Experimental results demonstrate that our method produces natural-looking facial videos driven by diverse signals and that the mamba layer seamlessly integrates multiple driving modalities without conflict.
authors: Fa-Ting Hong, Zunnan Xu, Zixiang Zhou, Jun Zhou, Xiu Li, Qin Lin, Qinglin Lu, Dan Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12549-12558

title: 增强的质量弹簧模型用于实时密集发丝模拟
title_en: Augmented Mass-Spring Model for Real-Time Dense Hair Simulation
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的增强质量弹簧(AMS)模型,用于实时的发丝级密集发丝模拟。我们的方法考虑了传统质量弹簧系统中的边、弯曲和扭转自由度,但引入了一种额外的单向双相耦合机制,结合幽灵静止形状配置。通过在多种动力学设置下的多组评估实验,我们证明AMS相比质量弹簧离散化方法在模拟稳定性方面有所提升,能够保持全局特征,并实现非胡克效应的模拟。利用所得矩阵的七对角分解,我们的方法在保持质量弹簧系统效率优势的同时,相较于更复杂的本构发丝模型,实现了对多根发丝配置的更鲁棒模拟。最后,我们的结果表明,该框架能够实时生成、复杂交互及编辑可模拟的密集发丝资产。
abstract_en: We propose a novel Augmented Mass-Spring (AMS) model for real-time simulation of dense hair at the strand level. Our approach considers the traditional edge, bending, and torsional degrees of freedom in mass-spring systems, but incorporates an additional one-way biphasic coupling with a ghost rest-shape configuration. Through multiple evaluation experiments with varied dynamical settings, we show that AMS improves the stability of the simulation in comparison to mass-spring discretizations, preserves global features, and enables the simulation of non-Hookean effects. Using a heptadiagonal decomposition of the resulting matrix, our approach provides the efficiency advantages of mass-spring systems over more complex constitutive hair models, while enabling a more robust simulation of multiple strand configurations. Finally, our results demonstrate that our framework enables the generation, complex interactivity, and editing of simulation-ready dense hair assets in real time.
authors: J. Alejandro Amador H., Yi Zhou, Xin Sun, Zhixin Shu, Chengan He, Soren Pirk, Dominik L. Michels ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11339-11347

title: 无监督可见光-红外行人重识别中的增强与软化匹配
title_en: Augmented and Softened Matching for Unsupervised Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
abstract: 颜色变化是无监督可见光-红外行人重识别(UVI-ReID)任务中的关键挑战,已引起广泛关注。尽管现有UVI-ReID方法在优化阶段已作出大量努力以增强模型对颜色变化的鲁棒性,但往往忽视颜色变化对伪标签获取的影响。为解决这一问题,本文聚焦于通过数据增强提升伪标签对颜色变化的鲁棒性,提出增强与软化匹配(ASM)方法。具体而言,我们首先开发跨模态增强匹配(CAM)模块,对可见光图像进行通道增强以生成增强图像。随后,基于可见光-红外与增强红外中心相似度矩阵的融合,CAM建立对颜色变化鲁棒的跨模态对应关系。为提升训练稳定性,设计软标签动量更新(SMU)策略,通过动量更新将传统one-hot标签转化为软标签,从而适配CAM。在优化阶段,引入跨模态软对比损失和跨模态硬对比损失,分别从共享特征和多样化特征视角促进模态不变性学习。大量实验结果验证了所提方法的有效性,表明ASM不仅超越了现有无监督方法,还与部分监督方法竞争。
abstract_en: Color variations, a key challenge in the unsupervised visible-infrared person re-identification (UVI-ReID) task, have garnered significant attention. While existing UVI-ReID methods have made substantial efforts during the optimization phase to enhance the model's robustness to color variations, they often overlook the impact of color variations on the acquisition of pseudo-labels. To address this, in this paper, we focus on improving the robustness of pseudo-labels to color variations through data augmentation and propose an augmented and softened matching (ASM) method. Specifically, we first develop the cross-modality augmented matching (CAM) module, which performs channel augmentation on visible images to generate augmented images. Then, based on the fusion of the visible-infrared and augmented-infrared centroid similarity matrices, CAM establishes cross-modality correspondences that are robust to color variations. To increase training stability, we design a soft-labels momentum update (SMU) strategy, which converts traditional one-hot labels into soft-labels through momentum updates, thus adapting to CAM. During the optimization phase, we introduce the cross-modality soft contrastive loss and cross-modality hard contrastive loss to promote modality-invariant learning from the perspectives of shared and diversified features, respectively. Extensive experimental results validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, showing that ASM not only outperforms state-of-the-art unsupervised methods but also competes with some supervised methods.
authors: Zhiqi Pang, Chunyu Wang, Lingling Zhao, Junjie Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11100-11109

title: 增强型片段检索:零依赖性两阶段学习
title_en: Augmenting Moment Retrieval: Zero-Dependency Two-Stage Learning
abstract: 现有片段检索方法面临三个关键瓶颈:(1) 数据稀缺迫使模型陷入浅层关键词-特征关联;(2) 相邻事件间过渡区域的边界模糊性;(3) 细粒度语义区分不足(例如区分"踢球"与"抛球")。本文提出一种零外部依赖的增强型片段检索框架AMR,旨在克服因数据标注不足和边界/语义区分能力薄弱导致的局部最优问题。AMR基于两个核心洞察:(1) 在无需额外数据的情况下解决现有标注中的边界模糊与语义混淆(避免高昂的人工标注成本);(2) 在训练中增强边界与语义区分能力的同时,实现对现实场景的泛化,显著提升性能。此外,我们提出包含冷启动与蒸馏适配的两阶段训练框架。冷启动阶段通过增强数据的课程学习构建基础边界/语义感知;蒸馏阶段引入双查询集:原始查询保持基于DETR的定位,使用冷启动模型冻结的基查询;主动查询动态适配真实数据分布。跨阶段蒸馏损失强制原始查询与基查询保持一致性,防止知识遗忘并实现现实泛化。在多个基准测试中,AMR展现出优于现有最先进方法的性能。
abstract_en: Existing Moment Retrieval methods face three critical bottlenecks: (1) data scarcity forces models into shallow keyword-feature associations; (2) boundary ambiguity in transition regions between adjacent events; (3) insufficient discrimination of fine-grained semantics (e.g., distinguishing "kicking" vs. "throwing" a ball). In this paper, we propose a zero-external-dependency Augmented Moment Retrieval framework, AMR, designed to overcome local optima caused by insufficient data annotations and the lack of robust boundary and semantic discrimination capabilities. AMR is built upon two key insights: (1) it resolves ambiguous boundary information and semantic confusion in existing annotations without additional data (avoiding costly manual labeling), and (2) it preserves boundary and semantic discriminative capabilities enhanced by training while generalizing to real-world scenarios, significantly improving performance. Furthermore, we propose a two-stage training framework with cold-start and distillation adaptation. The cold-start stage employs curriculum learning on augmented data to build foundational boundary/semantic awareness. The distillation stage introduces dual query sets: Original Queries maintain DETR-based localization using frozen Base Queries from the cold-start model, while Active Queries dynamically adapt to real-data distributions. A cross-stage distillation loss enforces consistency between Original and Base Queries, preventing knowledge forgetting while enabling real-world generalization. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that AMR achieves improved performance over prior state-of-the-art approaches.
authors: Zhengxuan Wei, Jiajin Tang, Sibei Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3401-3412

title: 基于视频生成模型的真实四维驾驶模拟
title_en: Authentic 4D Driving Simulation with a Video Generation Model
abstract: 在四维空间中模拟驾驶环境对于开发准确且沉浸式的自动驾驶系统至关重要。尽管在生成驾驶场景方面取得了进展,但视角转换和时空动态建模仍面临挑战。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新颖的方法,通过重建真实驾驶环境并利用生成网络实现四维模拟。该方法通过利用自动驾驶车辆的环视数据构建连续的四维点云场景。通过分离空间和时间元素,生成平滑的关键帧序列。此外,采用视频生成技术,从任意视角生成逼真的四维模拟视频。为了扩展可能的视角范围,我们采用分解的相机姿态进行训练,从而增强远距离场景的建模能力。此外,我们合并相机轨迹数据以同步连续帧之间的3D点,从而促进对场景演变的更深入理解。通过多层级场景训练,我们的方法能够从任意视角模拟场景,并在一致的时空框架中提供对场景随时间演变的深入洞察。与现有方法相比,该方法在视角一致性、背景连贯性和整体准确性方面表现优异,显著推动了更真实自动驾驶模拟的发展。
abstract_en: Simulating driving environments in 4D is crucial for developing accurate and immersive autonomous driving systems. Despite progress in generating driving scenes, challenges in transforming views and modeling the dynamics of space and time remain. To tackle these issues, we propose a fresh methodology that reconstructs real-world driving environments and utilizes a generative network to enable 4D simulation. This approach builds continuous 4D point cloud scenes by leveraging surround-view data from autonomous vehicles. By separating the spatial and temporal elements, it creates smooth keyframe sequences. Furthermore, video generation techniques are employed to produce lifelike 4D simulation videos from any given perspective. To extend the range of possible viewpoints, we incorporate training using decomposed camera poses, which allows for enhanced modeling of distant scenes. Additionally, we merge camera trajectory data to synchronize 3D points across consecutive frames, fostering a richer understanding of the evolving scene. With training across multiple scene levels, our method is capable of simulating scenes from any viewpoint and offers deep insight into the evolution of scenes over time in a consistent spatial-temporal framework. In comparison with current methods, this approach excels in maintaining consistency across views, background coherence, and overall accuracy, significantly contributing to the development of more realistic autonomous driving simulations.
authors: Lening Wang, Wenzhao Zheng, Dalong Du, Yunpeng Zhang, Yilong Ren, Han Jiang, Zhiyong Cui, Haiyang Yu, Jie Zhou, Shanghang Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28892-28902

title: 通过视觉感知标记实现MLLMs的自动控制图像感知
title_en: Auto-Controlled Image Perception in MLLMs via Visual Perception Tokens
abstract: 在MLLMs中,视觉感知指的是MLLMs对视觉输入(如图像)进行编码,并将其对齐到文本嵌入空间的过程。目前,MLLMs仍缺乏自主控制其自身视觉感知过程的能力。例如,它们无法选择性地重新编码图像的特定区域,或专注于与特定物体类别相关的信息。在本工作中,我们提出视觉感知标记的概念,旨在为MLLMs提供控制其视觉感知过程的机制。我们设计了两种类型的视觉感知标记,分别称为区域选择标记和视觉重编码标记。MLLMs自主生成这些标记,如同生成自然语言标记一样,并利用它们触发额外的视觉感知过程。区域选择标记明确标识需要进一步处理的感兴趣区域,而视觉重编码标记则利用其隐藏状态引导额外的视觉编码过程。大量实验验证了这些标记在增强空间推理、细粒度理解、文本/OCR相关VQA以及广泛其他视觉任务中的有效性。平均而言,引入视觉感知标记使2B参数模型的性能提升30.9%(得分从0.572提升至0.749),甚至在某些任务上超越了7B参数模型20.0%(得分从0.624)。
abstract_en: In MLLMs, Visual perception refers to the process by which MLLMs encode visual inputs, such as images, and align them with the text embedding space. Currently, MLLMs still lack the capability to autonomously control their own visual perception processes. For example, they cannot selectively re-encode specific regions of an image or focus on information related to specific object categories. In this work, we propose the concept of Visual Perception Token, aiming to empower MLLM with a mechanism to control its visual perception processes. We design two types of Visual Perception Tokens, termed the Region Selection Token and the Vision Re-Encoding Token. MLLMs autonomously generate these tokens, just as they generate natural language tokens, and use them to trigger additional visual perception process. The Region Selection Token explicitly identifies regions of interest that require further processing, while the Vision Re-Encoding Token utilizes its hidden states to guide an additional vision encoding process. Extensive experiments highlight the effectiveness of these tokens in enhancing spatial reasoning, fine-grained understanding, Text/OCR-related VQA, and a wide range of other visual tasks. On average, the introduction of Visual Perception Tokens improves the performance of a 2B model by 30.9%, increasing its score from 0.572 to 0.749, and even outperforms a 7B parameter model by 20.0% (from 0.624).
authors: Runpeng Yu, Xinyin Ma, Xinchao Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21822-21831

title: 自回归变换用于图像配准
title_en: Auto-Regressive Transformation for Image Alignment
abstract: 现有图像配准方法在特征稀疏区域、极端尺度和视场差异以及大变形等情况下表现不佳,常导致次优精度。通过在多尺度图像表示中关注关键区域并迭代优化变换场参数,可提升对这些挑战的鲁棒性。因此,我们提出自回归变换(ART),这是一种新颖方法,通过自回归流程迭代估计由粗到细的变换。利用层次化的多尺度特征,我们的网络在每个尺度上通过随机采样的点优化变换场参数。通过结合交叉注意力层的指导,模型聚焦关键区域,即使在具有挑战性的特征受限条件下也能确保精确配准。大量实验表明,ART在平面图像上显著优于最先进方法,并在3D场景图像上取得相当性能,确立其为精确图像配准的强大且多功能解决方案。
abstract_en: Existing methods for image alignment struggle in cases involving feature-sparse regions, extreme scale and field-of-view differences, and large deformations, often resulting in suboptimal accuracy. Robustness to these challenges can be improved through iterative refinement of the transform field while focusing on critical regions in multi-scale image representations. We thus propose Auto-Regressive Transformation (ART), a novel method that iteratively estimates the coarse-to-fine transformations through an auto-regressive pipeline. Leveraging hierarchical multi-scale features, our network refines the transform field parameters using randomly sampled points at each scale. By incorporating guidance from the cross-attention layer, the model focuses on critical regions, ensuring accurate alignment even in challenging, feature-limited conditions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ART significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on planar images and achieves comparable performance on 3D scene images, establishing it as a powerful and versatile solution for precise image alignment.
authors: Kanggeon Lee, Soochahn Lee, Kyoung Mu Lee ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13569-13579

title: 自回归生成多视角一致图像
title_en: Auto-Regressively Generating Multi-View Consistent Images
abstract: 从人类指令生成多视角图像对3D内容创作至关重要。主要挑战在于保持多视角间的一致性,并在多样化条件下有效合成形状与纹理。本文提出多视角自回归(MV-AR)方法,利用自回归模型从任意提示中逐步生成一致的多视角图像。首先,AR模型的下一个token预测能力显著增强了其在渐进式多视角合成中的有效性。当生成广泛分离视角时,MV-AR可利用所有先前视角提取有效参考信息。随后,我们提出统一模型,通过架构设计与训练策略支持多种提示。为应对多条件场景,引入文本、相机姿态、图像和形状的条件注入模块。为同时管理多模态条件,采用渐进式训练策略。该策略首先以文本到多视角(t2mv)模型为基线,通过随机丢弃和组合条件,逐步发展出全面的X到多视角(X2mv)模型。最后,为缓解有限高质量数据导致的过拟合问题,提出"Shuffle View"数据增强技术,从而将训练数据量扩展数倍。实验验证了MV-AR的性能与通用性,其在多种条件下持续生成一致的多视角图像,并与领先的扩散基多视角图像生成模型表现相当。代码和模型已开源于https://github.com/MILab-PKU/MVAR。
abstract_en: Generating multi-view images from human instructions is crucial for 3D content creation. The primary challenges involve maintaining consistency across multiple views and effectively synthesizing shapes and textures under diverse conditions. In this paper, we propose the Multi-View AutoRegressive (MV-AR) method, which leverages an autoregressive model to progressively generate consistent multiview images from arbitrary prompts. Firstly, the next-tokenprediction capability of the AR model significantly enhances its effectiveness in facilitating progressive multi-view synthesis. When generating widely-separated views, MV-AR can utilize all its preceding views to extract effective reference information. Subsequently, we propose a unified model that accommodates various prompts via architecture designing and training strategies. To address multiple conditions, we introduce condition injection modules for text, camera pose, image, and shape. To manage multi-modal conditions simultaneously, a progressive training strategy is employed. This strategy initially adopts the text-to-multiview (t2mv) model as a baseline to enhance the development of a comprehensive X-to-multi-view (X2mv) model through the randomly dropping and combining conditions. Finally, to alleviate the overfitting problem caused by limited high-quality data, we propose the "Shuffle View" data augmentation technique, thus significantly expanding the training data by several magnitudes. Experiments demonstrate the performance and versatility of our MV-AR, which consistently generates consistent multi-view images across a range of conditions and performs on par with leading diffusion-based multi-view image generation models. The code and models are released at https://github.com/MILab-PKU/MVAR.
authors: JiaKui Hu, Yuxiao Yang, Jialun Liu, Jinbo Wu, Chen Zhao, Yanye Lu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2556-2566

title: 自动词汇语义分割
title_en: Auto-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
abstract: 开放词汇分割(OVS)方法能够在不依赖固定词汇表的情况下执行语义分割,某些情况下甚至无需训练或微调。然而,OVS方法通常需要人工参与以根据任务或数据集指定词汇表。本文提出自动词汇语义分割(AVS),通过消除对分割对象类别预定义的必要性,推进开放性图像理解。我们的方法AutoSeg提出了一种框架,利用语义增强的BLIP嵌入自主识别相关类别名称,并随后进行分割。鉴于开放性对象类别预测无法直接与固定真实值比较,我们开发了基于大语言模型的自动词汇评估器(LAVE),以高效评估自动生成的类别及其对应分割结果。通过AVS,我们的方法在PASCAL VOC、Context、ADE20K和Cityscapes数据集上设立了新的基准,同时在需要指定类别名称的OVS方法中展现出具有竞争力的性能。所有代码已发布于https://github.com/ozzyou/AutoSeg。
abstract_en: Open-Vocabulary Segmentation (OVS) methods are capable of performing semantic segmentation without relying on a fixed vocabulary, and in some cases, without training or fine-tuning. However, OVS methods typically require a human in the loop to specify the vocabulary based on the task or dataset at hand. In this paper, we introduce Auto-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation (AVS), advancing open-ended image understanding by eliminating the necessity to predefine object categories for segmentation. Our approach, AutoSeg, presents a framework that autonomously identifies relevant class names using semantically enhanced BLIP embeddings and segments them afterwards. Given that open-ended object category predictions cannot be directly compared with a fixed ground truth, we develop a Large Language Model-based Auto-Vocabulary Evaluator (LAVE) to efficiently evaluate the automatically generated classes and their corresponding segments. With AVS, our method sets new benchmarks on datasets PASCAL VOC, Context, ADE20K, and Cityscapes, while showing competitive performance to OVS methods that require specified class names. All code is released at https://github.com/ozzyou/AutoSeg.
authors: Osman Ülger, Maksymilian Kulicki, Yuki Asano, Martin R. Oswald ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24266-24275

title: AutoComPose: 基于多模态大语言模型的组合姿态检索中姿态过渡描述的自动生成
title_en: AutoComPose: Automatic Generation of Pose Transition Descriptions for Composed Pose Retrieval Using Multimodal LLMs
abstract: 组合姿态检索(CPR)允许用户通过指定参考姿态和过渡描述来搜索人体姿态,但该领域进展受限于标注姿态过渡数据的稀缺性和不一致性。现有CPR数据集依赖昂贵的人工标注或基于启发式规则的生成方法,二者均限制了可扩展性和多样性。在本文中,我们提出了AutoComPose,这是首个利用多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)自动生成丰富且结构化姿态过渡描述的框架。我们的方法通过将过渡分解为细粒度身体部位运动并引入交换/镜像变体来提升标注质量,同时循环一致性约束确保正向与反向过渡之间的逻辑一致性。为推进CPR研究,我们构建并发布了两个专用基准测试数据集AIST-CPR和PoseFixCPR,补充了先前数据集的增强属性。大量实验表明,使用AutoComPose训练检索模型在性能上优于人工标注和启发式方法,显著降低了标注成本并提升了检索质量。我们的工作开创了姿态过渡的自动标注先河,为未来CPR研究奠定了可扩展的基础。
abstract_en: Composed pose retrieval (CPR) enables users to search for human poses by specifying a reference pose and a transition description, but progress in this field is hindered by the scarcity and inconsistency of annotated pose transitions. Existing CPR datasets rely on costly human annotations or heuristic-based rule generation, both of which limit scalability and diversity. In this work, we introduce AutoComPose, the first framework that leverages multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to automatically generate rich and structured pose transition descriptions. Our method enhances annotation quality by structuring transitions into fine-grained body part movements and introducing swapped/mirrored variations, while a cyclic consistency constraint ensures logical coherence between forward and reverse transitions. To advance CPR research, we construct and release two dedicated benchmarks, AIST-CPR and PoseFixCPR, supplementing prior datasets with enhanced attributes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that training retrieval models with AutoComPose yields superior performance over human-annotated and heuristic-based methods, significantly reducing annotation costs while improving retrieval quality. Our work pioneers the automatic annotation of pose transitions, establishing a scalable foundation for future CPR research.
authors: Yi-Ting Shen, Sungmin Eum, Doheon Lee, Rohit Shete, Chiao-Yi Wang, Heesung Kwon, Shuvra S. Bhattacharyya ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7409-7418

title: AutoOcc: 基于视觉-语言引导的高斯点云渲染的开放语义占据自动标注方法
title_en: AutoOcc: Automatic Open-Ended Semantic Occupancy Annotation via Vision-Language Guided Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 从原始传感器数据中获取高质量的3D语义占据仍是一个关键且具有挑战性的任务,通常需要大量人工标注。在本文中,我们提出AutoOcc,一种以视觉为中心的自动化开放语义占据标注管道,该管道整合了由视觉-语言模型引导的可微分高斯点云渲染。我们将开放语义3D占据重建任务形式化为通过结合视觉-语言模型和基础视觉模型的注意力图来自动生成场景占据。我们设计了语义感知的高斯分布作为中间几何描述符,并提出了一种累积高斯到体素的点云渲染算法,实现了高效且有效的占据标注。我们的框架在无需人工标注的情况下超越了现有自动化占据标注方法。AutoOcc还支持开放语义占据的自动标注,在静态和动态复杂场景中均表现出鲁棒的性能。
abstract_en: Obtaining high-quality 3D semantic occupancy from raw sensor data remains an essential yet challenging task, often requiring extensive manual labeling. In this work, we propose AutoOcc, a vision-centric automated pipeline for open-ended semantic occupancy annotation that integrates differentiable Gaussian splatting guided by vision-language models.
