We formulate the open-ended semantic 3D occupancy reconstruction task to automatically generate scene occupancy by combining attention maps from vision-language models and foundation vision models. We devise semantic-aware Gaussians as intermediate geometric descriptors and propose a cumulative Gaussian-to-voxel splatting algorithm that enables effective and efficient occupancy annotation. Our framework outperforms existing automated occupancy annotation methods without human labels. AutoOcc also enables open-ended semantic occupancy auto-labeling, achieving robust performance in both static and dynamically complex scenarios.
authors: Xiaoyu Zhou, Jingqi Wang, Yongtao Wang, Yufei Wei, Nan Dong, Ming-Hsuan Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3367-3377

title: AutoPrompt:通过大语言模型驱动的对抗性提示实现文本到图像模型的自动化红队测试
title_en: AutoPrompt: Automated Red-Teaming of Text-to-Image Models via LLM-Driven Adversarial Prompts
abstract: 尽管文本到图像(T2I)模型取得了快速进展,但其安全机制易受对抗性提示攻击,这些提示会恶意生成不安全图像。当前用于主动评估此类漏洞的红队测试方法通常需要白盒访问T2I模型,并依赖低效的每个提示优化,且不可避免地生成语义无意义的提示,容易被过滤器拦截。本文提出APT(AutoPrompT),一种黑盒框架,利用大语言模型(LLMs)自动生成可读的对抗性后缀,用于良性提示。我们首先引入对抗性后缀优化与利用优化后缀微调LLM的交替优化-微调流程。此外,在优化阶段集成双规避策略,实现对基于困惑度过滤器和黑名单词过滤器的绕过:(1)通过辅助LLM困惑度评分约束LLM生成可读提示,这与先前的逐词无意义文本形成鲜明对比;(2)我们还引入被禁词惩罚,抑制黑名单中被禁词的显式生成。大量实验验证了我们可读、抗过滤的对抗性提示在红队测试中的卓越性能,以及卓越的零样本迁移能力,使系统能够即时适应未见过的提示,并暴露出商业API(如Leonardo.Ai)中的关键漏洞。
abstract_en: Despite rapid advancements in text-to-image (T2I) models, their safety mechanisms are vulnerable to adversarial prompts, which maliciously generate unsafe images. Current red-teaming methods for proactively assessing such vulnerabilities usually require white-box access to T2I models, and rely on inefficient per-prompt optimization, as well as inevitably generate semantically meaningless prompts easily blocked by filters. In this paper, we propose APT (AutoPrompT), a black-box framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to automatically generate human-readable adversarial suffixes for benign prompts. We first introduce an alternating optimization-finetuning pipeline between adversarial suffix optimization and fine-tuning the LLM utilizing the optimized suffix. Furthermore, we integrate a dual-evasion strategy in the optimization phase, enabling the bypass of both perplexity-based filter and blacklist word filter: (1) we constrain the LLM generating human-readable prompts through an auxiliary LLM perplexity scoring, which starkly contrasts with prior token-level gibberish, and (2) we also introduce banned-token penalties to suppress the explicit generation of banned-tokens in the blacklist. Extensive experiments demonstrate the excellent red-teaming performance of our human-readable, filter-resistant adversarial prompts, as well as superior zero-shot transferability which enables instant adaptation to unseen prompts and exposes critical vulnerabilities even in commercial APIs (e.g., Leonardo.Ai.).
authors: Yufan Liu, Wanqian Zhang, Huashan Chen, Lin Wang, Xiaojun Jia, Zheng Lin, Weiping Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17557-17566

title: AutoScape:几何一致的长视野场景生成
title_en: AutoScape: Geometry-Consistent Long-Horizon Scene Generation
abstract: 本文提出AutoScape,一种长视野驾驶场景生成框架。其核心是一个新颖的RGB-D扩散模型,通过迭代生成稀疏且几何一致的关键帧,作为场景外观和几何的可靠锚点。为保持长程几何一致性,该模型1)在共享潜在空间中联合处理图像和深度信息,2)显式条件于先前生成关键帧所渲染的场景几何(即点云),3)通过位移一致的引导控制采样过程。给定高质量的RGB-D关键帧,视频扩散模型随后在它们之间进行插值,生成密集且连贯的视频帧。AutoScape生成超过20秒的逼真且几何一致的驾驶视频,其长视野FID和FVD得分分别比先前最先进方法提升了48.6%和43.0%。
abstract_en: This paper proposes AutoScape, a long-horizon driving scene generation framework. At its core is a novel RGB-D diffusion model that iteratively generates sparse, geometrically consistent keyframes, serving as reliable anchors for the scene's appearance and geometry. To maintain long-range geometric consistency, the model 1) jointly handles image and depth in a shared latent space, 2) explicitly conditions on the existing scene geometry (i.e., rendered point clouds) from previously generated keyframes, and 3) steers the sampling process with a warp-consistent guidance. Given high-quality RGB-D keyframes, a video diffusion model then interpolates between them to produce dense and coherent video frames. AutoScape generates realistic and geometrically consistent driving videos of over 20 seconds, improving the long-horizon FID and FVD scores over the prior state-of-the-art by 48.6% and 43.0%, respectively.
authors: Jiacheng Chen, Ziyu Jiang, Mingfu Liang, Bingbing Zhuang, Jong-Chyi Su, Sparsh Garg, Ying Wu, Manmohan Chandraker ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25700-25711

title: 基于预测一致性和可靠性的目标检测自动化模型评估
title_en: Automated Model Evaluation for Object Detection via Prediction Consistency and Reliability
abstract: 计算机视觉领域的最新进展使训练目标检测器更加高效和有效;然而,在现实应用中评估其性能仍然依赖于成本高昂的手动标注。为了解决这一局限性,我们开发了一种用于目标检测的自动化模型评估(AutoEval)框架。我们提出预测一致性与可靠性(PCR),该方法利用传统检测器在非最大值抑制(NMS)之前的多个候选边界框。PCR通过联合测量1)NMS前后边界框的空间一致性,以及2)通过重叠边界框的置信度分数评估保留边界框的可靠性,无需真实标签即可估计检测性能。为了实现更现实且可扩展的评估,我们通过应用不同严重程度的图像损坏构建了一个元数据集。实验结果表明,PCR比现有AutoEval方法提供了更准确的性能估计,且所提出的元数据集覆盖了更广泛的检测性能范围。代码可在https://github.com/YonseiML/autoeval-det获取。
abstract_en: Recent advances in computer vision have made training object detectors more efficient and effective; however, assessing their performance in real-world applications still relies on costly manual annotation. To address this limitation, we develop an automated model evaluation (AutoEval) framework for object detection. We propose Prediction Consistency and Reliability (PCR), which leverages the multiple candidate bounding boxes that conventional detectors generate before non-maximum suppression (NMS). PCR estimates detection performance without ground-truth labels by jointly measuring 1) the spatial consistency between boxes before and after NMS, and 2) the reliability of the retained boxes via the confidence scores of overlapping boxes. For a more realistic and scalable evaluation, we construct a meta-dataset by applying image corruptions of varying severity. Experimental results demonstrate that PCR yields more accurate performance estimates than existing AutoEval methods, and the proposed meta-dataset covers a wider range of detection performance. The code is available at https://github.com/YonseiML/autoeval-det.
authors: Seungju Yoo, Hyuk Kwon, Joong-Won Hwang, Kibok Lee ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19764-19773

title: 基于反馈引导提示迭代的文本到图像模型自动化红队技术
title_en: Automated Red Teaming for Text-to-Image Models through Feedback-Guided Prompt Iteration with Vision-Language Models
abstract: 文本到图像模型在从文本提示生成高质量图像方面取得了显著进展,但其生成不安全内容等潜在滥用风险仍是一个关键问题。现有安全机制如过滤和微调在防止对抗性提示暴露的漏洞方面仍显不足。为系统评估这些弱点,我们提出了一种自动化红队框架——反馈引导提示迭代(FGPI),该框架采用视觉-语言模型(VLM)作为红队代理,遵循反馈引导重写范式进行迭代提示优化。红队VLM基于评估结果分析提示-图像对,提供反馈和修改策略以增强对抗有效性同时保持安全约束,并迭代优化提示。为实现此功能,我们构建了一个包含6000多个实例的多轮对话式视觉问答数据集,涵盖七种攻击类型,便于红队VLM的微调。大量实验验证了我们的方法有效性,在五次迭代内实现超过90%的攻击成功率,同时保持提示隐蔽性和安全性。实验还验证了FGPI的适应性、多样性、可迁移性和可解释性。源代码和数据集可在https://github.com/Weiww-Xu/FGPI获取。
abstract_en: Text-to-image models have achieved remarkable progress in generating high-quality images from textual prompts, yet their potential for misuse like generating unsafe content remains a critical concern. Existing safety mechanisms, such as filtering and fine-tuning, remain insufficient in preventing vulnerabilities exposed by adversarial prompts. To systematically evaluate these weaknesses, we propose an automated red-teaming framework, Feedback-Guided Prompt Iteration (FGPI), which utilizes a Vision-Language Model (VLM) as the red-teaming agent following a feedback-guide-rewrite paradigm for iterative prompt optimization. The red-teaming VLM analyzes prompt-image pairs based on evaluation results, provides feedback and modification strategies to enhance adversarial effectiveness while preserving safety constraints, and iteratively improves prompts. To enable this functionality, we construct a multi-turn conversational VQA dataset with over 6,000 instances, covering seven attack types and facilitating the fine-tuning of the red-teaming VLM. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, achieving over 90% attack success rate within five iterations while maintaining prompt stealthiness and safety. The experiments also validate the adaptability, diversity, transferability, and explainability of FGPI. The source code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Weiww-Xu/FGPI.
authors: Wei Xu, Kangjie Chen, Jiawei Qiu, Yuyang Zhang, Run Wang, Jin Mao, Tianwei Zhang, Lina Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18575-18584

title: 自回归去噪得分匹配是优秀的视频异常检测器
title_en: Autoregressive Denoising Score Matching is a Good Video Anomaly Detector
abstract: 视频异常检测(VAD)是重要的计算机视觉问题。得益于生成模型的模式覆盖能力,基于似然的范式正受到越来越多的关注,因为它能够建模正常分布并检测分布外异常。然而,这些基于似然的方法对位于学习分布附近局部模式中的异常具有盲区。为处理这些"未见"异常,我们深入研究VAD中特有的三个空白:场景、运动和外观。具体而言,我们首先构建了一个噪声条件得分变换器用于去噪得分匹配。接着,我们通过将输入序列的场景条件嵌入模型并基于输入序列关键帧差异分配运动权重,引入了场景依赖且运动感知的得分函数。随后,为解决原理上的盲区问题,我们通过新颖的自回归去噪得分匹配机制整合未受影响的视觉信息。通过自回归地向去噪数据注入增强高斯噪声并估计相应的得分函数,我们将去噪数据与原始数据进行对比获取差异,并将其与得分函数聚合以增强外观感知并积累异常上下文。综合考虑这三个空白后,我们可以计算出更全面的异常指标。在三个流行VAD基准上的实验验证了我们方法的最先进性能。
abstract_en: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is an important computer vision problem. Thanks to the mode coverage capabilities of generative models, the likelihood-based paradigm is catching growing interest, as it can model normal distribution and detect out-of-distribution anomalies. However, these likelihood-based methods are blind to the anomalies located in local modes near the learned distribution. To handle these "unseen" anomalies, we dive into three gaps uniquely existing in VAD regarding scene, motion and appearance. Specifically, we first build a noise-conditioned score transformer for denoising score matching. Then, we introduce a scene-dependent and motion-aware score function by embedding the scene condition of input sequences into our model and assigning motion weights based on the difference between key frames of input sequences. Next, to solve the problem of blindness in principle, we integrate unaffected visual information via a novel autoregressive denoising score matching mechanism for inference. Through autoregressively injecting intensifying Gaussian noise into the denoised data and estimating the corresponding score function, we compare the denoised data with the original data to get a difference and aggregate it with the score function for an enhanced appearance perception and accumulate the abnormal context. With all three gaps considered, we can compute a more comprehensive anomaly indicator. Experiments on three popular VAD benchmarks demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of our method.
authors: Hanwen Zhang, Congqi Cao, Qinyi Lv, Lingtong Min, Yanning Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12057-12067

title: 基于少样本分布外检测的视觉-语言模型辅助提示调优
title_en: Auxiliary Prompt Tuning of Vision-Language Models for Few-Shot Out-of-Distribution Detection
abstract: 近期基于CLIP的分布外(OOD)检测方法通过在提示调优中引入正则化,利用少量分布内(ID)样本提取的背景特征作为分布外特征的代理,取得了有前景的结果。然而,这些方法存在固有局限性:从少样本ID数据中提取的分布外特征缺乏多样性。为解决这一问题,我们提出利用外部数据集作为辅助异常数据(即伪分布外样本),提取包含背景区域和前景物体区域特征的丰富且多样的分布外特征,从而支持更具有判别性的提示调优用于分布外检测。我们进一步提出辅助提示调优(APT),一种新颖框架,可作为插件模块使现有基于提示调优的方法利用辅助数据实现更精确的分布外检测。利用辅助数据进行提示调优存在两个关键挑战:I)对包含多样异常物体的无标签辅助数据进行前景-背景分解;II)优化前景分布外特征。APT通过基于自适应logit的Kullback-Leibler散度方法解决挑战I,并通过为每个前景区域构建前景-背景对来解决挑战II,从而有效利用前景分布外特征。在标准和困难分布外基准测试中进行的大量实验表明,APT取得了最先进的性能,在困难分布外检测和1-shot检测等挑战性场景中实现了显著提升。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in CLIP-based out-of-distribution (OOD) detection have shown promising results via regularization on prompt tuning, leveraging background features extracted from a few in-distribution (ID) samples as proxies for OOD features.However, these methods suffer from an inherent limitation: a lack of diversity in the extracted OOD features from the few-shot ID data.To address this issue, we propose to leverage external datasets as auxiliary outlier data (i.e., pseudo OOD samples) to extract rich, diverse OOD features, with the features from not only background regions but also foreground object regions, thereby supporting more discriminative prompt tuning for OOD detection. We further introduce Auxiliary Prompt Tuning (APT), a novel framework that can be used as a plug-in module to enable existing prompt tuning-based methods to utilize the auxiliary data for more accurate OOD detection.There are two key challenges of utilizing those auxiliary data in prompt tuning, including I) foreground-background decomposition of unlabeled auxiliary data with diverse outlying objects and II) optimization of foreground OOD features. APT tackles challenge I with an adaptive logit-based Kullback-Leibler divergence method and challenge II by constructing foreground-background pairs for each foreground region to enable effective exploitation of foreground OOD features. Extensive experiments on standard and hard OOD benchmarks show that APT achieves state-of-the-art performance, obtaining significant improvements in challenging scenarios, e.g., hard OOD and 1-shot detection.
authors: Wenjun Miao, Guansong Pang, Zihan Wang, Jin Zheng, Xiao Bai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4776-4785

title: Avat3r: 大规模可动画高斯重建模型用于高保真3D头部虚拟形象
title_en: Avat3r: Large Animatable Gaussian Reconstruction Model for High-fidelity 3D Head Avatars
abstract: 传统上,创建逼真3D头部虚拟形象需要工作室级的多视角捕捉设备和昂贵的测试时优化过程,这限制了数字人双胞胎技术的应用仅限于影视特效行业或离线渲染。为解决这一缺陷,我们提出Avat3r,该方法仅需少量输入图像即可回归高质量且可动画的3D头部虚拟形象,大幅降低推理过程中的计算需求。更具体而言,我们使大规模重建模型具备动画能力,并从大规模多视角视频数据集中学习强大的3D人头先验知识。为提升3D头部重建效果,我们采用DUSt3R的位置图和人类基础模型Sapiens的通用特征图。对3D头部进行动画处理时,我们的关键发现是:对表情编码的简单交叉注意力机制已足够。最后,我们通过在训练过程中输入不同表情的图像来增强鲁棒性,使模型能够从不一致的输入(如带有意外移动的不完美手机拍摄或单目视频帧)重建3D头部虚拟形象。我们对比了Avat3r与当前最先进的方法在少量输入和单输入场景下的表现,发现我们的方法在两项任务中均具有竞争优势。最后,我们展示了所提模型的广泛应用性,可从不同来源的图像、智能手机拍摄、单张图像甚至领域外输入(如古董雕像)创建3D头部虚拟形象。
abstract_en: Traditionally, creating photo-realistic 3D head avatars requires a studio-level multi-view capture setup and expensive optimization during test-time, limiting the use of digital human doubles to the VFX industry or offline renderings. To address this shortcoming, we present Avat3r, which regresses a high-quality and animatable 3D head avatar from just a few input images, vastly reducing compute requirements during inference. More specifically, we make Large Reconstruction Models animatable and learn a powerful prior over 3D human heads from a large multi-view video dataset. For better 3D head reconstructions, we employ position maps from DUSt3R and generalized feature maps from the human foundation model Sapiens. To animate the 3D head, our key discovery is that simple cross-attention to an expression code is already sufficient. Finally, we increase robustness by feeding input images with different expressions to our model during training, enabling the reconstruction of 3D head avatars from inconsistent inputs, e.g., an imperfect phone capture with accidental movement, or frames from a monocular video. We compare Avat3r with current state-of-the-art methods for few-input and single-input scenarios, and find that our method has a competitive advantage in both tasks. Finally, we demonstrate the wide applicability of our proposed model, creating 3D head avatars from images of different sources, smartphone captures, single images, and even out-of-domain inputs like antique busts.
authors: Tobias Kirschstein, Javier Romero, Artem Sevastopolsky, Matthias Nießner, Shunsuke Saito ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12089-12100

title: 基于群等变表示的轴级对称性检测
title_en: Axis-level Symmetry Detection with Group-Equivariant Representation
abstract: 对称性是一个基础概念,已得到广泛研究,但在复杂场景中检测对称性仍是对计算机视觉的重大挑战。近期基于热图的方法可以定位潜在的对称轴区域,但往往在识别单个对称轴时缺乏精度。本文提出了一种新颖框架,通过将反射对称性和旋转对称性表示为显式的几何基元(即线和点),实现轴级检测。我们的方法采用双分支架构,该架构对二面体群等变,每个分支专门利用二面体群等变特征的结构来处理其对应的对称类型。对于反射对称性,我们引入方向锚点(orientational anchors),与群成分对齐,以实现方向特定的检测,并提出反射匹配(reflectional matching)来衡量候选轴两侧模式与镜像对之间的相似性。对于旋转对称性,我们提出旋转匹配(rotational matching),通过比较固定角度间隔处的模式以识别旋转中心。大量实验表明,我们的方法在性能上达到最先进水平,优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Symmetry is a fundamental concept that has been extensively studied, yet detecting it in complex scenes remains a significant challenge in computer vision. Recent heatmap-based approaches can localize potential regions of symmetry axes but often lack precision in identifying individual axes. In this work, we propose a novel framework for axis-level detection of the two most common symmetry types--reflection and rotation--by representing them as explicit geometric primitives, i.e., lines and points. Our method employs a dual-branch architecture that is equivariant to the dihedral group, with each branch specialized to exploit the structure of dihedral group-equivariant features for its respective symmetry type. For reflection symmetry, we introduce \orientational anchors, aligned with group components, to enable orientation-specific detection, and a reflectional matching that measures similarity between patterns and their mirrored counterparts across candidate axes. For rotational symmetry, we propose a rotational matching that compares patterns at fixed angular intervals to identify rotational centers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing approaches.
authors: Wongyun Yu, Ahyun Seo, Minsu Cho ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24791-24800

title: B-VLLM:一种平衡时空标记的视觉大语言模型
title_en: B-VLLM: A Vision Large Language Model with Balanced Spatio-Temporal Tokens
abstract: 近期,集成视觉编码器的视觉大语言模型(VLLMs)在视觉理解任务中展现出良好性能。它们将视觉内容编码为视觉标记序列,从而实现视觉与文本数据的联合处理。然而,视频理解,尤其是长视频的理解仍面临挑战,因视频编码过程中视觉标记的快速增长可能超出VLLMs的上下文窗口长度限制,并显著增加计算成本。为限制视觉标记数量,现有VLLMs主要采用两种策略:(1) 均匀下采样视频至固定帧数或 (2) 减少每帧编码的视觉标记数量。我们认为前者忽视了视频的时序动态特性,而后者则无法保留单帧内的空间细节。本文提出Balanced-VLLM(B-VLLM),一种新型VLLM框架,旨在建模任务相关的时空线索,同时控制视觉标记数量在VLLM的上下文窗口长度内。框架核心是一个文本条件自适应帧选择模块,动态识别任务相关帧,随后通过时序帧标记合并策略进行去重。这些帧的视觉标记再经过空间标记采样和可选的空间标记合并策略,实现对标记预算的精细控制。实验表明,B-VLLM在平衡帧数与视觉标记数量方面具有有效性,且我们的方法在MVBench上实现了10%的性能提升。我们的代码将公开发布。
abstract_en: Recently, Vision Large Language Models (VLLMs) with integrated vision encoders have shown promising performance in vision understanding. They encode visual content into sequences of visual tokens, enabling joint processing of visual and textual data. However, understanding videos, especially long videos, remains a challenge as the rapid growth of visual tokens during video encoding risks exceeding VLLMs' context window length and significantly escalates computational cost. To restrict the number of visual tokens, existing VLLMs either: (1) uniformly downsample videos into a fixed number of frames or (2) reducing the number of visual tokens encoded from each frame. We argue that the former neglects temporal dynamics in videos, while the latter fails to preserve spatial details within individual frame. In this work, we propose Balanced-VLLM (B-VLLM), a novel VLLM framework designed to model task relevant spatio-temporal cues, while restricting the number of visual tokens within the VLLM's context window length. Central to our framework is a text-conditioned adaptive frame selection module that dynamically identifies task-relevant frames, which are further de-duplicated with a temporal frame token merging strategy.The visual tokens of these frames then undergo spatial token sampling and an optional spatial token merging strategy for granular control against the token budget. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of B-VLLM in balancing the number of frames and visual tokens, moreover, our proposed method introduce 10% performance gain on MVBench. Our code will be publicly available.
authors: Zhuqiang Lu, Zhenfei Yin, Mengwei He, Zhihui Wang, Zicheng Liu, Zhiyong Wang, Kun Hu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24549-24558

title: BANet:面向移动立体匹配的双边聚合网络
title_en: BANet: Bilateral Aggregation Network for Mobile Stereo Matching
abstract: 最先进的立体匹配方法通常使用高成本的3D卷积来聚合完整的代价体,但其计算需求使得在移动设备上的部署面临挑战。直接使用2D卷积进行代价聚合常导致边缘模糊、细节丢失以及无纹理区域的匹配错误。一些复杂操作,如可变形卷积和迭代形变,可以部分缓解这一问题;然而,这些操作并不具备移动友好性,限制了其在移动设备上的部署。本文提出了一种面向移动立体匹配的新型双边聚合网络(BANet),该网络仅使用2D卷积即可生成具有清晰边缘和精细细节的高质量结果。具体而言,我们首先通过空间注意力图将完整的代价体分离为细节体和平滑体,然后分别进行细节聚合和平滑聚合,最终融合两者以获得最终的视差图。实验结果表明,我们的BANet-2D显著优于其他移动友好型方法,在KITTI 2015排行榜上比MobileStereoNet-2D的准确率高出35.3%,且在移动设备上的运行速度更快。
abstract_en: State-of-the-art stereo matching methods typically use costly 3D convolutions to aggregate a full cost volume, but their computational demands make mobile deployment challenging. Directly applying 2D convolutions for cost aggregation often results in edge blurring, detail loss, and mismatches in textureless regions. Some complex operations, like deformable convolutions and iterative warping, can partially alleviate this issue; however, they are not mobile-friendly, limiting their deployment on mobile devices. In this paper, we present a novel bilateral aggregation network (BANet) for mobile stereo matching that produces high-quality results with sharp edges and fine details using only 2D convolutions. Specifically, we first separate the full cost volume into detailed and smooth volumes using a spatial attention map, then perform detailed and smooth aggregations accordingly, ultimately fusing both to obtain the final disparity map. Experimental results demonstrate that our BANet-2D significantly outperforms other mobile-friendly methods, achieving 35.3% higher accuracy on the KITTI 2015 leaderboard than MobileStereoNet-2D, with faster runtime on mobile devices.
authors: Gangwei Xu, Jiaxin Liu, Xianqi Wang, Junda Cheng, Yong Deng, Jinliang Zang, Yurui Chen, Xin Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28870-28880

title: BASIC:多模态大语言模型中通过内在精细嵌入提升视觉对齐
title_en: BASIC: Boosting Visual Alignment with Intrinsic Refined Embeddings in Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: 主流多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)通过视觉投影器将预训练良好的视觉编码器与大语言模型(LLMs)连接,以实现视觉理解。视觉与文本模态之间的固有差异使得视觉投影器生成的嵌入对视觉理解至关重要。然而,当前对齐方法将视觉嵌入视为上下文线索,仅对文本输出应用自回归监督,忽视了引入等效直接视觉监督的必要性,这阻碍了视觉嵌入的潜在精细对齐。本文基于对LLM浅层中视觉嵌入精炼过程的分析,提出BASIC方法,利用LLM中的精细视觉嵌入作为监督,直接指导投影器生成初始视觉嵌入。具体而言,指导从两个视角展开:(i) 通过减小初始嵌入与监督嵌入在语义空间中的夹角优化嵌入方向;(ii) 通过最小化两种视觉嵌入的logit分布差异提升语义匹配。无需额外监督模型或人工标注,BASIC在多个基准测试中显著提升了MLLMs的性能,验证了我们引入的直接视觉监督的有效性。
abstract_en: Mainstream Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve visual understanding by using a vision projector to bridge well-pretrained vision encoders and large language models (LLMs). The inherent gap between visual and textual modalities makes the embeddings from the vision projector critical for visual comprehension. However, current alignment approaches treat visual embeddings as contextual cues and merely apply auto-regressive supervision to textual outputs, neglecting the necessity of introducing equivalent direct visual supervision, which hinders the potential finer alignment of visual embeddings. In this paper, based on our analysis of the refinement process of visual embeddings in the LLM's shallow layers, we propose BASIC, a method that utilizes refined visual embeddings within the LLM as supervision to directly guide the projector in generating initial visual embeddings. Specifically, the guidance is conducted from two perspectives: (i) optimizing embedding directions by reducing angles between initial and supervisory embeddings in semantic space; (ii) improving semantic matching by minimizing disparities between the logit distributions of both visual embeddings. Without additional supervisory models or artificial annotations, BASIC significantly improves the performance of MLLMs across a wide range of benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of our introduced direct visual supervision.
authors: Jianting Tang, Yubo Wang, Haoyu Cao, Linli Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20582-20592

title: BATCLIP:面向CLIP的双模在线测试时适应
title_en: BATCLIP: Bimodal Online Test-Time Adaptation for CLIP
abstract: 尽管像对比语言-图像预训练(CLIP)这样的开放词汇分类模型已展现出强大的零样本学习能力,但其对常见图像损坏的鲁棒性仍不明确。通过大量实验,我们证明零样本CLIP在测试时对常见图像损坏缺乏鲁棒性,需要使用测试时适应(TTA)将CLIP适配到未标记的损坏图像。然而,我们发现现有TTA方法由于单模态特性在适配CLIP时存在严重局限。为解决这些局限,我们提出\texttt{BATCLIP},一种双模态在线TTA方法,旨在提升CLIP对常见图像损坏的鲁棒性。我们的方法核心在于不仅适配视觉编码器以改进图像特征,还通过强化伪标签计算的图像类原型与对应文本特征之间的关联,加强图像与文本特征的对齐。我们在基准图像损坏数据集上评估了该方法,并在CLIP的在线TTA中取得了最先进结果。此外,我们在多种领域泛化数据集上评估了所提出的TTA方法,以展示其泛化能力。我们的代码可在https://github.com/sarthaxxxxx/BATCLIP获取。
abstract_en: Although open-vocabulary classification models like Contrastive Language Image Pretraining (CLIP) have demonstrated strong zero-shot learning capabilities, their robustness to common image corruptions remains poorly understood. Through extensive experiments, we show that zero-shot CLIP lacks robustness to common image corruptions during test-time, necessitating the adaptation of CLIP to unlabeled corrupted images using test-time adaptation (TTA). However, we found that existing TTA methods have severe limitations in adapting CLIP due to their unimodal nature. To address these limitations, we propose \texttt BATCLIP , a bimodal online TTA method designed to improve CLIP's robustness to common image corruptions. The key insight of our approach is not only to adapt the visual encoders for improving image features but also to strengthen the alignment between image and text features by promoting a stronger association between the image class prototype, computed using pseudo-labels, and the corresponding text feature. We evaluate our approach on benchmark image corruption datasets and achieve state-of-the-art results in online TTA for CLIP. Furthermore, we evaluate our proposed TTA approach on various domain generalization datasets to demonstrate its generalization capabilities. Our code is available at https://github.com/sarthaxxxxx/BATCLIP
authors: Sarthak Maharana, Baoming Zhang, Leonid Karlinsky, Rogerio Feris, Yunhui Guo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1569-1579

title: BUFFER-X:面向多样化场景的零样本点云配准方法
title_en: BUFFER-X: Towards Zero-Shot Point Cloud Registration in Diverse Scenes
abstract: 近年来基于深度学习的点云配准方法在泛化能力上取得进展,但大多数方法仍需针对新环境进行重新训练或手动参数调优。本文识别出限制泛化能力的三个关键因素:(a) 对环境特定体素大小和搜索半径的依赖,(b) 基于学习的关键点检测器领域外鲁棒性不足,(c) 原始坐标使用加剧尺度差异。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种零样本配准管道BUFFER-X,通过(a) 自适应确定体素大小/搜索半径,(b) 使用最远点采样绕过学习检测器,(c) 利用块级尺度归一化实现坐标范围一致性。特别地,我们提出了多尺度块描述符生成方法和跨尺度层次内点搜索机制,以提升多样化场景下的鲁棒性。同时提出了一种新型通用性基准测试,包含覆盖多种室内/室外场景和传感器模态的11个数据集,实验证明BUFFER-X在无需先验信息或手动参数调优的情况下,对测试数据集具有显著的泛化能力。我们的代码已开源于https://github.com/MIT-SPARK/BUFFER-X。
abstract_en: Recent advances in deep learning-based point cloud registration have improved generalization, yet most methods still require retraining or manual parameter tuning for each new environment. In this paper, we identify three key factors limiting generalization: (a) reliance on environment-specific voxel size and search radius, (b) poor out-of-domain robustness of learning-based keypoint detectors,and (c) raw coordinate usage, which exacerbates scale discrepancies. To address these issues, we present a zero-shot registration pipeline called BUFFER-X by (a) adaptively determining voxel size/search radii, (b) using farthest point sampling to bypass learned detectors, and (c) leveraging patch-wise scale normalization for consistent coordinate bounds. In particular, we present a multi-scale patch-based descriptor generation and a hierarchical inlier search across scales to improve robustness in diverse scenes. We also propose a novel generalizability benchmark using 11 datasets that cover various indoor/outdoor scenarios and sensor modalities, demonstrating that BUFFER-X achieves substantial generalization without prior information or manual parameter tuning for the test datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/MIT-SPARK/BUFFER-X.
authors: Minkyun Seo, Hyungtae Lim, Kanghee Lee, Luca Carlone, Jaesik Park ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3851-3862

title: BVINet:无需标注的盲视频修复技术
title_en: BVINet: Unlocking Blind Video Inpainting with Zero Annotations
abstract: 视频修复旨在用合理的内容填充视频中的损坏区域。现有方法通常假设损坏区域的位置已知,主要关注"如何进行修复"。这种依赖性需要使用二值掩码手动标注损坏区域以指示"修复何处"。然而,这些掩码的标注过程耗时耗力且成本高昂,限制了当前方法的实用性。本文期望通过定义新的盲视频修复设置来放松这一假设,使网络能够直接学习从损坏视频到修复结果的映射,无需损坏区域标注。具体而言,我们提出了一种端到端的盲视频修复网络(BVINet),同时解决"修复何处"和"如何修复"两个问题。一方面,BVINet通过检测帧中的语义不连续区域并利用视频的时间一致性先验来预测损坏区域的掩码;另一方面,预测的掩码被整合到BVINet中,使其能够从未损坏区域获取有效上下文信息以填充损坏区域。此外,我们引入了一致性损失来规范BVINet的训练参数。这样,掩码预测与视频补全相互约束,从而最大化训练模型的整体性能。鉴于现有数据集因包含先验知识(如损坏内容和清晰边界)而不适用于盲视频修复任务,我们贡献了一个专门设计用于盲视频修复的新数据集。大量实验结果验证了我们方法的有效性和优越性。
abstract_en: Video inpainting aims to fill in corrupted regions of the video with plausible contents. Existing methods generally assume that the locations of corrupted regions are known, focusing primarily on the "how to inpaint". This reliance necessitates manual annotation of the corrupted regions using binary masks to indicate "where to inpaint". However, the annotation of these masks is labor-intensive and expensive, limiting the practicality of current methods. In this paper, we expect to relax this assumption by defining a new blind video inpainting setting, enabling the networks to learn the mapping from corrupted video to inpainted result directly, eliminating the need of corrupted region annotations. Specifically, we propose an end-to-end blind video inpainting network (BVINet) to address both "where to inpaint" and "how to inpaint" simultaneously. On the one hand, BVINet can predict the masks of corrupted regions by detecting semantic-discontinuous regions of the frame and utilizing temporal consistency prior of the video. On the other hand, the predicted masks are incorporated into the BVINet, allowing it to capture valid context information from uncorrupted regions to fill in corrupted ones. Besides, we introduce a consistency loss to regularize the training parameters of BVINet. In this way, mask prediction and video completion mutually constrain each other, thereby maximizing the overall performance of the trained model. Recognizing that existing datasets are unsuitable for the blind video inpainting task due to the presence of prior knowledge (e.g., corrupted contents and clear borders), we contribute a new dataset specifically designed for blind video inpainting. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of our method.
authors: Zhiliang Wu, Kerui Chen, Kun Li, Hehe Fan, Yi Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14017-14027

title: BabyVLM:受婴儿学习启发的数据高效视觉语言模型预训练
title_en: BabyVLM: Data-Efficient Pretraining of VLMs Inspired by Infant Learning
abstract: 人类婴儿能够从极小的输入中快速发展视觉推理能力,这表明以发展规律为启发的预训练方法可显著提升视觉语言模型(VLMs)的效率。尽管近期研究已利用类似SAYCam的婴儿启发数据集,但现有评估基准仍存在偏差——它们要么过于简单,要么范围狭窄,要么专门针对大规模预训练模型。此外,仅使用SAYCam数据集进行训练忽略了婴儿自然学习过程中更广泛、多样化的输入来源。为解决这些局限性,我们提出BabyVLM框架,包含多样化的领域内评估基准和通过儿童导向转换生成的合成训练数据集。实验表明,使用我们合成数据集训练的VLM在BabyVLM任务上的表现优于仅基于SAYCam或通用数据的模型。因此,BabyVLM提供了稳健且符合发展规律的评估工具,展示了如何通过精心筛选的数据训练紧凑模型以实现有效泛化,为数据高效的视觉语言学习范式开辟了新路径。
abstract_en: Human infants rapidly develop visual reasoning skills from minimal input, suggesting that developmentally inspired pretraining could significantly enhance the efficiency of vision-language models (VLMs). Although recent efforts have leveraged infant-inspired datasets like SAYCam, existing evaluation benchmarks remain misaligned--they are either too simplistic, narrowly scoped, or tailored for large-scale pretrained models. Additionally, training exclusively on SAYCam overlooks the broader, diverse input from which infants naturally learn. To address these limitations, we propose BabyVLM, a novel framework comprising diverse in-domain evaluation benchmarks and a synthetic training dataset created via child-directed transformations of existing datasets. We demonstrate that VLMs trained with our synthetic dataset achieve superior performance on BabyVLM tasks compared to models trained solely on SAYCam or general-purpose data of the SAYCam size. BabyVLM thus provides a robust, developmentally aligned evaluation tool and illustrates how compact models trained on carefully curated data can generalize effectively, opening pathways toward data-efficient vision-language learning paradigms.
authors: Shengao Wang, Arjun Chandra, Aoming Liu, Venkatesh Saligrama, Boqing Gong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1380-1390

title: 重回正轨:动态场景重建的捆绑调整
title_en: Back on Track: Bundle Adjustment for Dynamic Scene Reconstruction
abstract: 传统依赖捆绑调整的SLAM系统在处理常见于日常视频中的高度动态场景时面临挑战。此类视频将动态元素的运动交织在一起,破坏了传统系统所依赖的静态环境假设。现有技术要么过滤掉动态元素,要么独立建模其运动。然而前者常导致重建不完整,后者可能产生运动估计不一致。本工作采用新颖方法,利用三维点追踪器将相机诱导运动与观测到的动态物体运动分离。通过仅考虑相机诱导成分,捆绑调整可在所有场景元素上可靠运行。我们进一步基于尺度图进行轻量级后处理,确保视频帧间的深度一致性。我们的框架将传统SLAM的核心——捆绑调整——与鲁棒的学习型三维追踪器相结合。通过整合运动分解、捆绑调整和深度优化,我们的统一框架BA-Track能够精确追踪相机运动,生成时间一致且尺度一致的密集重建,同时兼容静态和动态元素。在具有挑战性的数据集上的实验表明,我们的方法在相机位姿估计和三维重建精度方面取得了显著提升。
abstract_en: Traditional SLAM systems, which rely on bundle adjustment, struggle with the highly dynamic scenes commonly found in casual videos. Such videos entangle the motion of dynamic elements, undermining the assumption of static environments required by traditional systems. Existing techniques either filter out dynamic elements or model their motion independently. However, the former often results in incomplete reconstructions, while the latter can lead to inconsistent motion estimates. Taking a novel approach, this work leverages a 3D point tracker to separate camera-induced motion from the observed motion of dynamic objects. By considering only the camera-induced component, bundle adjustment can operate reliably on all scene elements. We further ensure depth consistency across video frames with lightweight post-processing based on scale maps. Our framework combines the core of traditional SLAM---bundle adjustment---with a robust learning-based 3D tracker. Integrating motion decomposition, bundle adjustment, and depth refinement, our unified framework, BA-Track, accurately tracks camera motion and produces temporally coherent and scale-consistent dense reconstructions, accommodating both static and dynamic elements. Our experiments on challenging datasets reveal significant improvements in camera pose estimation and 3D reconstruction accuracy.
authors: Weirong Chen, Ganlin Zhang, Felix Wimbauer, Rui Wang, Nikita Araslanov, Andrea Vedaldi, Daniel Cremers ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4951-4960

title: 通过单比特翻转的神经网络后门攻击
title_en: Backdoor Attacks on Neural Networks via One-Bit Flip
abstract: 传统针对深度神经网络(DNNs)的后门攻击通常假设攻击者可以操控训练数据或流程。然而,近期研究通过在推理阶段注入后门提出更实用的威胁模型。这些方法利用比特翻转攻击,借助Rowhammer等内存故障注入技术修改模型权重。尽管效果显著,但存在显著局限性——需要同时翻转大量比特,这在实践中极具挑战性。为克服这一限制,我们提出SOLEFLIP,这是首个针对量化模型的单比特翻转后门攻击方法。与依赖优化搜索的先前方法不同,我们的算法识别攻击目标权重并仅翻转单个比特以植入后门。我们在CIFAR-10、SVHN和ImageNet数据集上对多种DNN架构(包括视觉Transformer)进行评估。结果表明,SOLEFLIP实现高攻击成功率(高达99.9%,平均98.9%),同时对良性准确率影响极小(平均0.0%)。此外,SOLEFLIP对后门防御机制具有鲁棒性。我们的发现揭示了DNNs的关键威胁:在量化模型中仅翻转单个比特即可成功执行后门攻击。
abstract_en: Conventional backdoor attacks on deep neural networks (DNNs) typically assume that an attacker can manipulate the training data or process. However, recent research introduces a more practical threat model by injecting backdoors at the inference stage. These approaches leverage bit flip attacks to modify model weights using memory fault injection techniques such as Rowhammer. Despite their effectiveness, they suffer from a significant limitation---the need to flip a relatively large number of bits simultaneously, which is highly challenging in practice. To overcome this constraint, we propose SOLEFLIP, the first one-bit-flip backdoor attack on quantized models. Unlike prior methods that rely on optimization-based bit searches and require flipping multiple bits, our algorithm identifies a promising weight for the attack and flips a single bit to insert a backdoor. We evaluate SOLEFLIP on CIFAR-10, SVHN, and ImageNet across various DNN architectures, including a vision transformer. The results show that SOLEFLIP achieves high attack success rates (up to 99.9%, with an average of 98.9%) while causing minimal degradation to benign accuracy (0.0% on average). Furthermore, SOLEFLIP is resilient to backdoor defenses. Our findings reveal a critical threat to DNNs: flipping just one bit in quantized models is sufficient to execute a successful backdoor attack.
authors: Xiang Li, Lannan Luo, Qiang Zeng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4328-4338

title: 基于增强分割与陷阱隔离的后门防御方法
title_en: Backdoor Defense via Enhanced Splitting and Trap Isolation
abstract: 后门攻击对深度神经网络(DNNs)构成重大威胁,攻击者仅需篡改少量样本即可注入后门。后门攻击的多样性使得全面防御极具挑战性。先前的防御方法通常假设后门样本为良性样本的分布外(OOD)数据。然而,后门样本也可能是良性样本的分布内(ID)数据,难以被识别为异常值,可能导致防御失效。为解决这一问题,我们提出基于增强分割与陷阱隔离(ESTI)的两阶段后门防御方法,利用攻击者的篡改行为进行防御。第一阶段,我们引入后门模型与良性模型结合,将数据集分割为可靠干净子集和被污染子集。第二阶段,引入陷阱机制将被污染子集隔离为陷阱类别以训练陷阱模型。该陷阱模型可将被污染样本的预测结果从攻击者的目标类别翻转为陷阱类别。通过在三个基准数据集和五种模型架构上的大量实验,我们证明ESTI方法能有效防御各类后门攻击,同时保持对良性数据的模型性能,验证了本方法的优越性。我们的代码已包含在补充材料中。
abstract_en: Backdoor attacks pose a significant threat to deep neural networks (DNNs), as attackers can inject a backdoor by tampering with only a few samples. The variety of backdoor attacks makes comprehensive defense extremely challenging. Previous defenses typically assume that backdoor samples are out-of-distribution (OOD) data of benign samples. However, backdoor samples can also be in-distribution (ID) data of benign samples and hard to identify as outliers, potentially causing defenses to fail. To address this issue, we propose a two-stage backdoor defense based on Enhanced Splitting and Trap Isolation (ESTI), leveraging attackers' tampering to defend against their attacks. In the first stage, we introduce backdoored models in conjunction with a benign model to split the dataset into a reliable clean subset and a poisoned subset. In the second stage, we introduce a trap mechanism to isolate the poisoned subset into a trap class to train a trap-model. The trap-model can flip the predictions of poisoned samples from the attacker's target class to the trap class. Through extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets and five model architectures, we demonstrate that ESTI effectively defends against various backdoor attacks while maintaining model performance on benign data, proving the superiority of our approach. Our code is available in the supplementary material.
authors: Hongrui Yu, Lu Qi, Wanyu Lin, Jian Chen, Hailong Sun, Chengbin Sun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1708-1717

title: 基于距离驱动的净化方法缓解后门攻击
title_en: Backdoor Mitigation by Distance-Driven Detoxification
abstract: 后门攻击通过允许攻击者利用被污染的训练数据操控预测,破坏机器学习模型的完整性。此类攻击在存在特定触发器时会导致有针对性的误分类,而在其他情况下模型行为正常。本文考虑后训练阶段的后门防御任务,旨在净化预训练模型中的后门。我们首先分析了常规微调方法的潜在问题,观察到其常陷入清洁样本和被污染样本损失均较低的区域。受此启发,我们提出距离驱动净化(D3),一种将后门防御重新表述为约束优化问题的创新方法。具体而言,D3促使模型远离初始权重的邻域,有效降低后门的影响。在多种模型架构和数据集上针对最先进的(SOTA)后门攻击进行的大量实验表明,D3不仅匹配甚至超越现有SOTA后训练防御技术的性能。
abstract_en: Backdoor attacks undermine the integrity of machine learning models by allowing attackers to manipulate predictions using poisoned training data. Such attacks lead to targeted misclassification when specific triggers are present, while the model behaves normally under other conditions. This paper considers a post-training backdoor defense task, aiming to detoxify the backdoors in pre-trained models. We begin by analyzing the underlying issues of vanilla fine-tuning and observe that it is often trapped in regions with low loss for both clean and poisoned samples. Motivated by such observations, we propose Distance-Driven Detoxification (D3), an innovative approach that reformulates backdoor defense as a constrained optimization problem. Specifically, D3 promotes the model's departure from the vicinity of its initial weights, effectively reducing the influence of backdoors. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art (SOTA) backdoor attacks across various model architectures and datasets demonstrate that D3 not only matches but often surpasses the performance of existing SOTA post-training defense techniques.
authors: Shaokui Wei, Jiayin Liu, Hongyuan Zha ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4465-4474

title: 通过噪声对齐植入自监督对比学习后门
title_en: Backdooring Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning by Noisy Alignment
abstract: 自监督对比学习(CL)能有效从包含图像或图像-文本对的无标签数据中学习可迁移表示,但易受数据中毒后门攻击(DPCLs)的影响。攻击者可通过向预训练数据集中注入污染图像,导致受损的CL编码器在下游任务中表现出针对性的异常行为。然而现有DPCL方法因依赖脆弱的后门与目标对象隐式共现关系,且对污染图像中判别性特征抑制不足,效果有限。我们提出Noisy Alignment(NA),一种DPCL方法,通过显式抑制污染图像中的噪声成分实现攻击。受强大训练可控CL攻击的启发,我们识别并提取噪声对齐的核心目标,将其有效适配到数据中毒场景中。我们的方法通过策略性操控对比学习的随机裁剪机制实现噪声对齐,将此过程建模为具有理论推导最优参数的图像布局优化问题。所提方法简单而有效,在保持干净数据准确率的同时,相较现有DPCL方法取得最先进性能。此外,Noisy Alignment对常见后门防御机制表现出鲁棒性。代码可访问https://github.com/jsrdcht/Noisy-Alignment。
abstract_en: Self-supervised contrastive learning (CL) effectively learns transferable representations from unlabeled data containing images or image-text pairs but suffers vulnerability to data poisoning backdoor attacks (DPCLs). An adversary can inject poisoned images into pretraining datasets, causing compromised CL encoders to exhibit targeted misbehavior in downstream tasks. Existing DPCLs, however, achieve limited efficacy due to their dependence on fragile implicit co-occurrence between backdoor and target object and inadequate suppression of discriminative features in backdoored images. We propose Noisy Alignment (NA), a DPCL method that explicitly suppresses noise components in poisoned images. Inspired by powerful training-controllable CL attacks, we identify and extract the critical objective of noisy alignment, adapting it effectively into data-poisoning scenarios. Our method implements noisy alignment by strategically manipulating contrastive learning's random cropping mechanism, formulating this process as an image layout optimization problem with theoretically derived optimal parameters. The resulting method is simple yet effective, achieving state-of-the-art performance compared to existing DPCLs, while maintaining clean-data accuracy. Furthermore, Noisy Alignment demonstrates robustness against common backdoor defenses. Codes can be found at https://github.com/jsrdcht/Noisy-Alignment.
authors: Tuo Chen, Jie Gui, Minjing Dong, Ju Jia, Lanting Fang, Jian Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3684-3693

title: 基于语义邻近性的背景不变性测试
title_en: Background Invariance Testing According to Semantic Proximity
abstract: 在许多应用中,机器学习(ML)模型需要具备某些不变性特性,如旋转、尺寸和强度不变性。其中,背景不变性测试由于其涵盖的庞大且复杂的数据空间,构成了显著挑战。为评估不变性特性,我们首先采用基于可视化的测试框架,使人工分析人员能够评估并就ML模型的不变性特性做出知情决策。我们证明,这种信息丰富的测试框架更受青睐,因为具有相同全局统计特征(如准确率得分)的ML模型可能表现出不同行为,并具有不同的可视化测试模式。然而,在缺乏系统采样方法选择代表性测试套件的情况下,人工分析人员可能无法达成一致决策。在本工作中,我们提出了一种技术方案,根据目标图像中待测试前景物体的语义邻近性选择背景场景。我们通过关联分析构建本体,存储不同物体间关系的知识。该本体使我们能够高效且有意义地搜索与目标图像语义距离不同的背景场景,从而选择出既多样又合理的测试套件。与随机采样、最近邻算法或其他视觉-语言模型(VLMs)采样的测试套件相比,我们的方法在人类注释的多样性与一致性之间取得了更优的平衡,从而提升了背景不变性测试的可靠性与全面性。
abstract_en: In many applications, machine-learned (ML) models are required to hold some invariance qualities, such as rotation, size, and intensity invariance. Among these, testing for background invariance presents a significant challenge due to the vast and complex data space it encompasses. To evaluate invariance qualities, we first use a visualization-based testing framework which allows human analysts to assess and make informed decisions about the invariance properties of ML models. We show that such informative testing framework is preferred as ML models with the same global statistics (e.g., accuracy scores) can behave differently and have different visualized testing patterns. However, such human analysts might not lead to consistent decisions without a systematic sampling approach to select representative testing suites. In this work, we present a technical solution for selecting background scenes according to their semantic proximity to a target image that contains a foreground object being tested. We construct an ontology for storing knowledge about relationships among different objects using association analysis. This ontology enables an efficient and meaningful search for background scenes of different semantic distances to a target image, enabling the selection of a test suite that is both diverse and reasonable. Compared with other testing techniques, e.g., random sampling, nearest neighbors, or other sampled test suites by visual-language models (VLMs), our method achieved a superior balance between diversity and consistency of human annotations, thereby enhancing the reliability and comprehensiveness of background invariance testing.
authors: Zukang Liao, Min Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8056-8065

title: BadVideo:针对文本到视频生成的隐蔽后门攻击
title_en: BadVideo: Stealthy Backdoor Attack against Text-to-Video Generation
abstract: 文本到视频(T2V)生成模型已迅速发展并在娱乐、教育和营销等领域得到广泛应用。然而,这些模型的对抗性漏洞仍鲜有研究。我们观察到,在T2V生成任务中,生成的视频通常包含大量未在文本提示中明确指定的冗余信息,如环境元素、次要物体和附加细节,这为恶意攻击者嵌入隐藏有害内容提供了机会。利用这一固有冗余性,我们引入了BadVideo,这是首个针对T2V生成的后门攻击框架。我们的攻击通过两项关键策略设计目标对抗性输出:(1) 时空组合,通过结合不同的时空特征编码恶意信息;(2) 动态元素变换,在冗余元素随时间引入变换以传递恶意信息。基于这些策略,攻击者的恶意目标无缝融合到用户的文本指令中,具有高隐蔽性。此外,通过利用视频的时间维度,我们的攻击成功规避了主要分析单帧空间信息的传统内容审核系统。大量实验表明,BadVideo在保持原始语义并维持对干净输入的优秀性能的同时,实现了高攻击成功率。总体而言,我们的工作揭示了T2V模型的对抗性漏洞,引起了对潜在风险和滥用的关注。我们的项目页面位于https://wrt2000.github.io/BadVideo2025/。
abstract_en: Text-to-video (T2V) generative models have rapidly advanced and found widespread applications across fields like entertainment, education, and marketing. However, the adversarial vulnerabilities of these models remain rarely explored. We observe that in T2V generation tasks, the generated videos often contain substantial redundant information not explicitly specified in the text prompts, such as environmental elements, secondary objects, and additional details, providing opportunities for malicious attackers to embed hidden harmful content. Exploiting this inherent redundancy, we introduce BadVideo, the first backdoor attack framework tailored for T2V generation. Our attack focuses on designing target adversarial outputs through two key strategies: (1) Spatio-Temporal Composition, which combines different spatiotemporal features to encode malicious information; (2) Dynamic Element Transformation, which introduces transformations in redundant elements over time to convey malicious information. Based on these strategies, the attacker's malicious target seamlessly integrates with the user's textual instructions, providing high stealthiness. Moreover, by exploiting the temporal dimension of videos, our attack successfully evades traditional content moderation systems that primarily analyze spatial information within individual frames. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BadVideo achieves high attack success rates while preserving original semantics and maintaining excellent performance on clean inputs. Overall, our work reveals the adversarial vulnerability of T2V models, calling attention to potential risks and misuse. Our project page is at https://wrt2000.github.io/BadVideo2025/.
authors: Ruotong Wang, Mingli Zhu, Jiarong Ou, Rui Chen, Xin Tao, Pengfei Wan, Baoyuan Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19075-19084

title: 将高斯点云融入扩散去噪器以实现快速可扩展的单阶段图像到3D生成与重建
title_en: Baking Gaussian Splatting into Diffusion Denoiser for Fast and Scalable Single-stage Image-to-3D Generation and Reconstruction
abstract: 现有前馈图像到3D方法主要依赖于二维多视角扩散模型,无法保证三维一致性。这些方法在改变提示视角方向时容易崩溃,且主要处理以物体为中心的案例。本文提出了一种新颖的单阶段3D扩散模型DiffusionGS,用于从单视角生成物体和重建场景。DiffusionGS在每个时间步直接输出三维高斯点云,以强制视角一致性,并使模型能够根据任意方向的提示视角生成鲁棒结果,超越以物体为中心的输入。此外,为提升DiffusionGS的能力和通用性,我们通过开发场景-物体混合训练策略扩展3D训练数据。实验表明,与现有方法相比,DiffusionGS在物体和场景的PSNR/FID指标上分别提升了2.20 dB/23.25和1.34 dB/19.16,且无需使用二维扩散先验和深度估计器。此外,我们的方法速度超过现有方法5倍(在A100 GPU上仅需6秒)。项目页面位于https://caiyuanhao1998.github.io/project/DiffusionGS/
abstract_en: Existing feedforward image-to-3D methods mainly rely on 2D multi-view diffusion models that cannot guarantee 3D consistency. These methods easily collapse when changing the prompt view direction and mainly handle object-centric cases. In this paper, we propose a novel single-stage 3D diffusion model, DiffusionGS, for object generation and scene reconstruction from a single view. DiffusionGS directly outputs 3D Gaussian point clouds at each timestep to enforce view consistency and allow the model to generate robustly given prompt views of any directions, beyond object-centric inputs. Plus, to improve the capability and generality of DiffusionGS, we scale up 3D training data by developing a scene-object mixed training strategy. Experiments show that DiffusionGS yields improvements of 2.20 dB/23.25 and 1.34 dB/19.16 in PSNR/FID for objects and scenes than the state-of-the-art methods, without using 2D diffusion prior and depth estimator. Plus, our method enjoys over 5x faster speed ( 6s on an A100 GPU). The project page is at https://caiyuanhao1998.github.io/project/DiffusionGS/
authors: Yuanhao Cai, He Zhang, Kai Zhang, Yixun Liang, Mengwei Ren, Fujun Luan, Qing Liu, Soo Ye Kim, Jianming Zhang, Zhifei Zhang, Yuqian Zhou, Yulun Zhang, Xiaokang Yang, Zhe Lin, Alan Yuille ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25062-25072

title: 基于风格匹配分数的平衡图像风格化
title_en: Balanced Image Stylization with Style Matching Score
abstract: 我们提出了一种名为风格匹配分数(Style Matching Score, SMS)的新颖优化方法,用于扩散模型的图像风格化。在有效风格迁移与内容保留之间取得平衡是一个长期存在的挑战。与现有方法不同,我们的方法将图像风格化重新表述为风格分布匹配问题。目标风格分布通过精心设计的分数函数,从现成的风格依赖LoRAs中估计得到。为适应性地保留内容信息,我们提出了渐进频谱正则化(Progressive Spectrum Regularization),该方法在频域中操作,引导风格化从低频布局逐步过渡到高频细节。此外,我们设计了一种语义感知梯度细化技术(Semantic-Aware Gradient Refinement),该技术利用扩散语义先验生成的相关性图,选择性地对语义重要的区域进行风格化。所提出的优化公式将风格化从像素空间扩展到参数空间,可直接应用于轻量级前馈生成器,实现高效的单步风格化。SMS有效平衡了风格对齐与内容保留,通过大量实验验证,其性能优于现有最先进方法。
abstract_en: We present Style Matching Score (SMS), a novel optimization method for image stylization with diffusion models. Balancing effective style transfer with content preservation is a long-standing challenge. Unlike existing efforts, our method reframes image stylization as a style distribution matching problem. The target style distribution is estimated from off-the-shelf style-dependent LoRAs via carefully designed score functions. To preserve content information adaptively, we propose Progressive Spectrum Regularization, which operates in the frequency domain to guide stylization progressively from low-frequency layouts to high-frequency details. In addition, we devise a Semantic-Aware Gradient Refinement technique that leverages relevance maps derived from diffusion semantic priors to selectively stylize semantically important regions. The proposed optimization formulation extends stylization from pixel space to parameter space, readily applicable to lightweight feedforward generators for efficient one-step stylization. SMS effectively balances style alignment and content preservation, outperforming state-of-the-art approaches, verified by extensive experiments.
authors: Yuxin Jiang, Liming Jiang, Shuai Yang, Jia-Wei Liu, Ivor W. Tsang, Mike Zheng Shou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17346-17355

title: 用于不平衡回归的平衡尖锐感知最小化方法
title_en: Balanced Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Imbalanced Regression
abstract: 回归是计算机视觉中的基础任务,广泛应用于年龄估计、深度估计、目标定位等场景。然而,现实数据常表现出分布不平衡特性,导致回归模型在罕见目标值观测(称为不平衡回归问题)上的性能显著下降。本文将不平衡回归重新定义为不平衡泛化问题。为解决该问题,我们从观测空间中回归模型的损失尖锐性属性出发,通过分析模型参数扰动下不同目标观测的损失值对模型性能的影响。我们提出了一种简单而有效的平衡尖锐感知最小化(BSAM)方法,以确保回归模型在整个观测空间中具有统一的泛化能力。具体而言,我们从传统尖锐感知最小化方法出发,引入新颖的针对性重加权策略,使观测空间中泛化能力趋于均质化,从而保证理论泛化界。在包括年龄和深度估计在内的多个视觉回归任务上的广泛实验表明,我们的BSAM方法在各项指标上均优于现有方法。代码已开源,地址为__ABS_MATH_1__。
abstract_en: Regression is fundamental in computer vision and is widely used in various tasks including age estimation, depth estimation, target localization, etc. However, real-world data often exhibits imbalanced distribution, making regression models perform poorly especially for target values with rare observations (known as the imbalanced regression problem). In this paper, we reframe imbalanced regression as an imbalanced generalization problem. To tackle that, we look into the loss sharpness property for measuring the generalization ability of regression models in the observation space. Namely, given a certain perturbation on the model parameters, we check how model performance changes according to the loss values of different target observations. We propose a simple yet effective approach called Balanced Sharpness-Aware Minimization (BSAM) to enforce the uniform generalization ability of regression models for the entire observation space. In particular, we start from the traditional sharpness-aware minimization and then introduce a novel targeted reweighting strategy to homogenize the generalization ability across the observation space, which guarantees a theoretical generalization bound. Extensive experiments on multiple vision regression tasks, including age and depth estimation, demonstrate that our BSAM method consistently outperforms existing approaches. The code is available here.
authors: Yahao Liu, Qin Wang, Lixin Duan, Wen Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6242-6251

title: 平衡保守性与激进性:面向少样本分割的原型-亲和力混合网络
title_en: Balancing Conservatism and Aggressiveness: Prototype-Affinity Hybrid Network for Few-Shot Segmentation
abstract: 本文研究少样本分割(FSS)任务,旨在通过在少量标注良好的支持样本上学习模型,对查询图像中属于未见过类别的目标进行分割。我们对两种主流FSS范式进行分析发现,原型学习方法生成的预测通常较为保守,而亲和力学习方法则倾向于更具激进性。这一观察促使我们平衡这两种类型FSS框架所捕捉的保守性与激进性信息,以提升分割性能。为此,我们提出了一种原型-亲和力混合网络(PAHNet),该网络在亲和力学习模型(称为亲和力学习器)的每个注意力块中引入了原型引导的特征增强(PFE)模块和注意力分数校准(ASC)模块。这两个模块分别利用预训练原型学习模型(称为原型预测器)生成的预测结果,增强支持图像和查询图像表示中的前景信息,并抑制二者之间的不匹配前景-背景(FG-BG)关系。通过这种方式,可以有效缓解亲和力学习器的激进性,从而最终提升PAHNet方法的分割精度。实验结果表明,PAHNet在PASCAL-5^i和COCO-20^i数据集的1-shot和5-shot设置中均优于大多数近期提出的方法,证明了其有效性。代码已开源:https://github.com/tianyu-zou/PAHNet
abstract_en: This paper studies the few-shot segmentation (FSS) task, which aims to segment objects belonging to unseen categories in a query image by learning a model on a small number of well-annotated support samples. Our analysis of two mainstream FSS paradigms reveals that the predictions made by prototype learning methods are usually conservative, while those of affinity learning methods tend to be more aggressive. This observation motivates us to balance the conservative and aggressive information captured by these two types of FSS frameworks so as to improve the segmentation performance. To achieve this, we propose a Prototype-Affinity Hybrid Network (PAHNet), which introduces a Prototype-guided Feature Enhancement (PFE) module and an Attention Score Calibration (ASC) module in each attention block of an affinity learning model (called affinity learner). These two modules utilize the predictions generated by a pre-trained prototype learning model (called prototype predictor) to enhance the foreground information in support and query image representations and suppress the mismatched foreground-background (FG-BG) relationships between them, respectively. In this way, the aggressiveness of the affinity learner can be effectively mitigated, thereby eventually increasing the segmentation accuracy of our PAHNet method. Experimental results show that PAHNet outperforms most recently proposed methods across 1-shot and 5-shot settings on both PASCAL-5^i and COCO-20^i datasets, suggesting its effectiveness. The code is available at: https://github.com/tianyu-zou/PAHNet.
authors: Tianyu Zou, Shengwu Xiong, Ruilin Yao, Yi Rong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20561-20571

title: 统一图像融合中的任务不变交互与任务特定适应的平衡
title_en: Balancing Task-invariant Interaction and Task-specific Adaptation for Unified Image Fusion
abstract: 统一图像融合旨在通过统一框架整合多源图像中的互补信息,提升图像质量并适用于多样化融合任务。尽管将所有融合任务视为统一问题有助于任务不变知识共享,但往往忽视任务特定特征,从而限制整体性能。现有通用图像融合方法通过显式任务识别实现对不同融合任务的适应,但这种依赖在推理过程中限制了模型对未见过的融合任务的泛化能力。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新型统一图像融合框架" TITA ",动态平衡任务不变交互与任务特定适应。对于任务不变交互,我们引入交互增强像素注意力(IPA)模块以增强像素级交互,更有效地提取多源互补信息;对于任务特定适应,基于操作的自适应融合(OAF)模块根据任务特性动态调整操作权重。此外,我们结合快速自适应多任务优化(FAMO)策略,在联合训练中缓解任务间梯度冲突的影响。大量实验表明,TITA不仅在三个图像融合场景中与专用方法相比表现出竞争力,还展现出对未见过融合任务的强泛化能力。
abstract_en: Unified image fusion aims to integrate complementary information from multi-source images, enhancing image quality through a unified framework applicable to diverse fusion tasks. While treating all fusion tasks as a unified problem facilitates task-invariant knowledge sharing, it often overlooks task-specific characteristics, thereby limiting the overall performance. Existing general image fusion methods incorporate explicit task identification to enable adaptation to different fusion tasks. However, this dependence during inference restricts the model's generalization to unseen fusion tasks. To address these issues, we propose a novel unified image fusion framework named "TITA", which dynamically balances both Task-invariant Interaction and Task-specific Adaptation. For task-invariant interaction, we introduce the Interaction-enhanced Pixel Attention (IPA) module to enhance pixel-wise interactions for better multi-source complementary information extraction. For task-specific adaptation, the Operation-based Adaptive Fusion (OAF) module dynamically adjusts operation weights based on task properties. Additionally, we incorporate the Fast Adaptive Multitask Optimization (FAMO) strategy to mitigate the impact of gradient conflicts across tasks during joint training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TITA not only achieves competitive performance compared to specialized methods across three image fusion scenarios but also exhibits strong generalization to unseen fusion tasks.
authors: Xingyu Hu, Junjun Jiang, Chenyang Wang, Kui Jiang, Xianming Liu, Jiayi Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11262-11272

title: 贝叶斯启发式时空超像素
title_en: Bayesian-Inspired Space-Time Superpixels
abstract: 本文提出了一种受贝叶斯启发的时空超像素方法(BIST):一种快速、最先进的时空超像素计算方法。BIST是单图像贝叶斯方法BASS的创新扩展,其灵感来源于向狄利克雷过程高斯混合模型(DP-GMM)局部模式进行爬山。该方法仅受贝叶斯启发,而非实际贝叶斯方法,因为它包含对理论正确采样器的启发式修改。与现有方法类似,BIST可通过分割合并步骤适应单帧的超像素数量。关键创新在于分割步骤中引入的新时间一致性项,该项减少了传播超像素的分割概率。该项在传播区域强制时间一致性,但在遮挡区域允许无约束适应。一个超参数决定了该新项的强度,无需特殊调参即可在视频数据集上返回一致结果。BIST的实时时钟运行时间比BASS快两倍以上,比最快开源时空超像素方法快30倍以上。
abstract_en: This paper presents Bayesian-inspired Space-Time Superpixels (BIST): a fast, state-of-the-art method to compute space-time superpixels. BIST is a novel extension of a single-image Bayesian method named BASS, and it is inspired by hill-climbing to a local mode of a Dirichlet-Process Gaussian Mixture Model (DP-GMM). The method is only Bayesian-inspired, rather than actually Bayesian, because it includes heuristic modifications to the theoretically correct sampler. Similar to existing methods, BIST can adapt the number of superpixels to an individual frame using split-merge steps. A key novelty is a new temporal coherence term in the split step, which reduces the chance of splitting propagated superpixels. This term enforces temporal coherence in propagated regions, but allows for unconstrained adaptation in disoccluded regions. A hyperparameter determines the strength of this new term, which does not require special tuning to return consistent results across a dataset of videos. The wall-clock runtime of BIST is over twice as fast as BASS and over 30 times faster than the next fastest space-time superpixel method with open-source code.
authors: Kent Gauen, Stanley Chan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5382-5391

title: 偏振图像突发超分辨率基准测试:噪声数据集与分析
title_en: Benchmarking Burst Super-Resolution for Polarization Images: Noise Dataset and Analysis
abstract: 快照偏振成像通过线偏振子图像计算偏振状态。为实现此目的,偏振相机采用双Bayer模式传感器同时捕获颜色和偏振信息。该方法表现出低光效率和低空间分辨率,导致噪声增加和偏振测量精度下降。尽管突发超分辨率技术能有效降低噪声并提升空间分辨率,但将其应用于偏振成像面临挑战,主要由于缺乏专门的数据集和可靠的噪声真实统计信息。为解决这些问题,我们引入了PolarNS和PolarBurstSR两个专为偏振成像设计的创新数据集。PolarNS提供偏振噪声统计特性表征,便于深入分析;PolarBurstSR则作为偏振图像突发超分辨率的基准。这些数据集在多种真实场景条件下采集,支持全面评估。此外,我们提出了一种分析偏振噪声的模型,用于量化噪声传播,该模型在暗室环境中捕获的大规模数据集上进行了测试。作为应用的一部分,我们比较了最新的突发超分辨率模型,突显了针对偏振特性进行训练相较于基于RGB的方法的优势。本工作建立了偏振突发超分辨率的基准,并提供了关于噪声传播的关键见解,从而提升偏振图像重建质量。代码和数据集已公开在https://github.com/KAIST-VCLAB/polarns上。
abstract_en: Snapshot polarization imaging calculates polarization states from linearly polarized subimages. To achieve this, a polarization camera employs a double Bayer-patterned sensor to capture both color and polarization. It demonstrates low light efficiency and low spatial resolution, resulting in increased noise and compromised polarization measurements. Although burst super-resolution effectively reduces noise and enhances spatial resolution, applying it to polarization imaging poses challenges due to the lack of tailored datasets and reliable ground truth noise statistics. To address these issues, we introduce PolarNS and PolarBurstSR, two innovative datasets developed specifically for polarization imaging. PolarNS provides characterization of polarization noise statistics, facilitating thorough analysis, while PolarBurstSR functions as a benchmark for burst superresolution in polarization images. These datasets, collected under various real-world conditions, enable comprehensive evaluation. Additionally, we present a model for analyzing polarization noise to quantify noise propagation, tested on a large dataset captured in a darkroom environment. As part of our application, we compare the latest burst superresolution models, highlighting the advantages of training tailored to polarization compared to RGB-based methods. This work establishes a benchmark for polarization burst super-resolution and offers critical insights into noise propagation, thereby enhancing polarization image reconstruction. Both code and dataset are publicly available on https://github.com/KAIST-VCLAB/polarns.
authors: Inseung Hwang, Kiseok Choi, Hyunho Ha, Min H. Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24899-24909

title: 城市尺度下第一人称视角视觉惯性SLAM的基准测试
title_en: Benchmarking Egocentric Visual-Inertial SLAM at City Scale
abstract: 从车载传感器获取精确的六自由度同步定位与建图(SLAM)对于采集第一人称视角数据的可穿戴设备至关重要,这类数据具有特定挑战,如更广泛的动作和视角多样性、普遍存在的动态视觉内容,或受时变传感器校准影响的长时间会话。尽管SLAM领域近期进展迅速,但学术研究仍受限于无法反映这些挑战或提供足够精确地面真值姿态的基准测试。本文引入了一个新的数据集和基准测试,用于第一人称视角、多模态的视觉惯性SLAM。我们通过佩戴类似眼镜的设备,在城市中心记录了数小时、数十公里的轨迹,该设备配备了多种传感器。我们利用测绘工具获取控制点作为间接姿态注释,这些注释具有厘米级精度,并可在城市尺度上获得。这使得评估涉及夜间行走或车辆行驶等极端轨迹成为可能。我们证明了学术界开发的最先进系统对这些挑战缺乏鲁棒性,并识别了导致这一问题的组件。此外,我们设计了不同难度级别的测试集,以方便对不成熟方法进行深入分析和评估。该数据集和基准测试可在www.lamaria.ethz.ch获取。
abstract_en: Precise 6-DoF simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) from onboard sensors is critical for wearable devices capturing egocentric data, which exhibits specific challenges, such as a wider diversity of motions and viewpoints, prevalent dynamic visual content, or long sessions affected by time-varying sensor calibration. While recent progress on SLAM has been swift, academic research is still driven by benchmarks that do not reflect these challenges or do not offer sufficiently accurate ground truth poses. In this paper, we introduce a new dataset and benchmark for visual-inertial SLAM with egocentric, multi-modal data. We record hours and kilometers of trajectories through a city center with glasses-like devices equipped with various sensors. We leverage surveying tools to obtain control points as indirect pose annotations that are metric, centimeter-accurate, and available at city scale. This makes it possible to evaluate extreme trajectories that involve walking at night or traveling in a vehicle. We show that state-of-the-art systems developed by academia are not robust to these challenges and we identify components that are responsible for this. In addition, we design tracks with different levels of difficulty to ease in-depth analysis and evaluation of less mature approaches. The dataset and benchmark are available at www.lamaria.ethz.ch.
authors: Anusha Krishnan, Shaohui Liu, Paul-Edouard Sarlin, Oscar Gentilhomme, David Caruso, Maurizio Monge, Richard Newcombe, Jakob Engel, Marc Pollefeys ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25207-25217

title: 基于视觉程序的多模态思维链奖励模型分步基准测试
title_en: Benchmarking Multimodal CoT Reward Model Stepwise by Visual Program
abstract: 近年来,奖励信号在大语言模型(LLMs)中的应用取得了显著进展。然而,当将奖励信号迁移至多模态领域时仍存在重大挑战,包括耗时的标注任务、对单步奖励的过度依赖以及评估体系不完善。为解决这些问题,我们提出SVIP,一种新颖的自动训练分步多维思维链(CoT)奖励模型的方法。该方法生成解决视觉任务的代码,并将代码块分析转化为CoT步骤的评估作为训练样本。随后,我们采用名为TriAtt-CoT的多头注意力机制训练SVIP-Reward模型。SVIP-Reward的优势贯穿于整个大语言模型(MLLM)的训练过程。我们还引入了用于思维链奖励模型训练和测试的基准测试集。实验结果表明,SVIP-Reward在训练和推理时的扩展性方面均提升了MLLM性能,在基准测试中取得更优结果,同时减少了幻觉现象并增强了推理能力。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in reward signal usage for Large Language Models (LLMs) are remarkable. However, significant challenges exist when transitioning reward signal to the multimodal domain, including labor-intensive annotations, over-reliance on one-step rewards, and inadequate evaluation. To address these issues, we propose SVIP, a novel approach to train a step-level multi-dimensional Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reward model automatically. It generates code for solving visual tasks and transforms the analysis of code blocks into the evaluation of CoT step as training samples. Then, we train SVIP-Reward model using a multi-head attention mechanism called TriAtt-CoT. The advantages of SVIP-Reward are evident throughout the entire process of MLLM. We also introduce a benchmark for CoT reward model training and testing. Experimental results demonstrate that SVIP-Reward improves MLLM performance across training and inference-time scaling, yielding better results on benchmarks while reducing hallucinations and enhancing reasoning ability.
authors: Minghe Gao, Xuqi Liu, Zhongqi Yue, Yang Wu, Shuang Chen, Juncheng Li, Siliang Tang, Fei Wu, Tat-Seng Chua, Yueting Zhuang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1718-1728

title: 多模态大语言模型在图像退化中的评估
title_en: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models Against Image Corruptions
abstract: 多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)在视觉和语言任务中取得了显著进展。然而,尽管它们在标准数据集上表现出色,但在处理退化图像时仍面临显著的鲁棒性挑战,这引发了对其在安全关键应用中可靠性的担忧。为了解决这一问题,我们引入了MLLM-IC基准测试,专门用于评估MLLMs在图像退化场景下的性能。MLLM-IC相比现有基准测试提供了更全面的退化鲁棒性评估,能够对多种退化类型下各种MLLM能力进行多维评估。它包含40种不同的退化类型和34种低级多模态能力,每种能力均组织为三级层次结构。值得注意的是,这是首个专门设计用于评估细粒度MLLM能力的退化鲁棒性基准测试。我们进一步评估了几种主流的MLLMs,并得出了关于其特性的宝贵见解。我们相信,MLLM-IC基准测试将为MLLMs处理退化图像的鲁棒性提供关键见解,并有助于开发更具鲁棒性的MLLMs。
abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made significant strides in visual and language tasks. However, despite their impressive performance on standard datasets, these models encounter considerable robustness challenges when processing corrupted images, raising concerns about their reliability in safety-critical applications. To address this issue, we introduce the MLLM-IC benchmark, specifically designed to assess the performance of MLLMs under image corruption scenarios. MLLM-IC offers a more comprehensive evaluation of corruption robustness compared to existing benchmarks, enabling a multi-dimensional assessment of various MLLM capabilities across a broad range of corruption types. It includes 40 distinct corruption types and 34 low-level multimodal capabilities, each organized into a three-level hierarchical structure. Notably, it is the first corruption robustness benchmark designed to facilitate the evaluation of fine-grained MLLM capabilities. We further evaluate several prominent MLLMs and derive valuable insights into their characteristics. We believe the MLLM-IC benchmark will provide crucial insights into the robustness of MLLMs in handling corrupted images and contribute to the development of more resilient MLLMs.
authors: Xinkuan Qiu, Meina Kan, Yongbin Zhou, Shiguang Shan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9014-9023

title: 文本到3D生成的多维质量评估器基准测试与学习
title_en: Benchmarking and Learning Multi-Dimensional Quality Evaluator for Text-to-3D Generation
abstract: 文本到3D生成近年来取得了显著进展,但评估这些方法仍面临两大挑战:i) 现有基准测试缺乏对不同提示类别和评估维度的细粒度评估;ii) 以往的评估指标仅关注单一维度(如文本-3D对齐),无法实现多维质量评估。为解决这些问题,我们首先提出一个全面的基准测试MATE-3D。该基准包含八个精心设计的提示类别,涵盖单物体和多物体生成,共生成1280个纹理网格。我们从四个不同评估维度进行了大规模主观实验,收集了107520个注释,并对结果进行了详细分析。基于MATE-3D,我们提出了一种新型质量评估器HyperScore。通过超网络为每个评估维度生成特定映射函数,我们的指标能够有效进行多维质量评估。HyperScore在MATE-3D上表现出优于现有指标的性能,使其成为评估和改进文本到3D生成的有前景的指标。
abstract_en: Text-to-3D generation has achieved remarkable progress in recent years, yet evaluating these methods remains challenging for two reasons: i) existing benchmarks lack fine-grained evaluation on different prompt categories and evaluation dimensions; ii) previous evaluation metrics only focus on a single aspect (e.g., text-3D alignment) and fail to perform multi-dimensional quality assessment. To address these problems, we first propose a comprehensive benchmark named MATE-3D. The benchmark contains eight well-designed prompt categories that cover single and multiple object generation, resulting in 1,280 generated textured meshes. We have conducted a large-scale subjective experiment from four different evaluation dimensions and collected 107,520 annotations, followed by detailed analyses of the results. Based on MATE-3D, we propose a novel quality evaluator named HyperScore. Utilizing hypernetwork to generate specified mapping functions for each evaluation dimension, our metric can effectively perform multi-dimensional quality assessment. HyperScore presents superior performance over existing metrics on MATE-3D, making it a promising metric for assessing and improving text-to-3D generation.
authors: Yujie Zhang, Bingyang Cui, Qi Yang, Zhu Li, Yiling Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18563-18574

title: 从已见中获益:通过融合视觉与文本共现知识提升开放词汇目标检测
title_en: Benefit From Seen: Enhancing Open-Vocabulary Object Detection by Bridging Visual and Textual Co-Occurrence Knowledge
abstract: 开放词汇目标检测(OVOD)旨在定位和识别已知和新类别的物体。然而,现有方法严重依赖视觉-语言模型(VLMs)的内部知识,由于上下文理解有限,限制了其对未见类别的泛化能力。为了解决这一问题,我们提出CODet,这是一个即插即用框架,通过整合物体共现——一种在现实场景中普遍存在外部上下文知识——来增强OVOD。具体而言,CODet从图像中提取视觉共现模式,将其与由大语言模型(LLMs)验证的文本依赖关系对齐,并将上下文共现伪标签作为外部知识注入以指导检测。无需架构更改,CODet在两个基准测试中持续提升五种最先进的基于VLM的检测器,取得显著提升(在新类别上最高提升+2.3 AP)。进一步分析证实了其编码有意义上下文指导的能力,通过融合视觉与文本共现知识,推动开放世界感知的发展。
abstract_en: Open-Vocabulary Object Detection (OVOD) aims to localize and recognize objects from both known and novel categories. However, existing methods rely heavily on internal knowledge from Vision-Language Models (VLMs), restricting their generalization to unseen categories due to limited contextual understanding. To address this, we propose CODet, a plug-and-play framework that enhances OVOD by integrating object co-occurrence ---- a form of external contextual knowledge pervasive in real-world scenes. Specifically, CODet extracts visual co-occurrence patterns from images, aligns them with textual dependencies validated by Large Language Models (LLMs), and injects contextual co-occurrence pseudo-labels as external knowledge to guide detection. Without architectural changes, CODet consistently improves five state-of-the-art VLM-based detectors across two benchmarks, achieving notable gains (up to +2.3 AP on novel categories). Analyses further confirm its ability to encode meaningful contextual guidance, advancing open-world perception by bridging visual and textual co-occurrence knowledge.
authors: Yanqi Li, Jianwei Niu, Tao Ren ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22110-22119

title: 超越模糊:生成扩散模型的流体视角
title_en: Beyond Blur: A Fluid Perspective on Generative Diffusion Models
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的、由偏微分方程(PDE)驱动的图像生成腐蚀过程,该方法扩展了现有的PDE基础方法。我们的前向过程通过一个物理驱动的PDE来建模图像腐蚀,该方程将方向性对流与各向同性扩散和高斯噪声耦合,由无量纲数控制。我们通过GPU加速的格子玻尔兹曼求解器数值求解该PDE以实现快速评估。为诱导真实的"湍流",我们生成随机速度场,引入相干运动并捕捉多尺度混合。在生成过程中,神经网络学习逆转对流-扩散算子,从而构成一种新型生成模型。我们讨论了先前方法如何作为我们算子的特例出现,证明了我们的框架扩展了先前的PDE基础腐蚀技术。我们展示了对流如何在保持整体色谱不变的前提下提升生成图像的多样性和质量。本工作连接了流体力学、无量纲PDE理论和深度生成建模,为基于物理的逆问题提供了新的视角。
abstract_en: We propose a novel, Partial Differential Equation (PDE) driven, corruption process for generative image synthesis which generalizes existing PDE-based approaches. Our forward pass formulates image corruption via a physically motivated PDE that couples directional advection with isotropic diffusion and Gaussian noise, controlled by dimensionless numbers. We solve this PDE numerically through a GPU-accelerated Lattice Boltzmann solver for fast evaluation. To induce realistic "turbulence," we generate stochastic velocity fields that introduce coherent motion and capture multi-scale mixing. In the generative process, a neural network learns to reverse the advection-diffusion operator thus constituting a novel generative model.We discuss how previous methods emerge as specific cases of our operator, demonstrating that our framework generalizes prior PDE-based corruption techniques. We illustrate how advection improves the diversity and quality of the generated images while keeping the overall color palette unaffected. This work bridges fluid dynamics, dimensionless PDE theory, and deep generative modeling, offering a fresh perspective on physically based inverse problems.
authors: Grzegorz Gruszczynski, Jakub Meixner, Michal Wlodarczyk, Przemyslaw Musialski ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17818-17827

title: 超越脑解码:基于fMRI的视觉语义重建与心智创造扩展
title_en: Beyond Brain Decoding: Visual-Semantic Reconstructions to Mental Creation Extension Based on fMRI
abstract: 从fMRI信号解码视觉信息是理解大脑如何表征世界的重要途径,也是人工通用智能的前沿领域。fMRI解码不应局限于重建视觉刺激,还应进一步将其转化为描述、生成动作,甚至创造未见过的内容。我们提出了一种新颖高效的脑多模态架构NeuroCreat,结合大语言模型(LLM)强大的视觉与文本能力,从fMRI中捕捉细粒度语义信息,并将其转化为不同神经表征的具身实现。具体而言,我们创新性设计了脑专家适配(BEA)模块,通过共享/路由专家的协同学习,有效捕捉受试者间的共性与差异。受人类视觉工作记忆启发,我们从高级视觉皮层提取"创造"信息以生成创意。我们进一步构建了提示变体对齐模块,无缝整合fMRI-视觉-语义-创造信息至LLM,实现神经表征解码中不同语义的灵活融合。在不同fMRI数据集上的实验表明,NeuroCreat在多项脑解码任务中达到最先进水平。更重要的是,我们创新性实现了少样本脑视频生成,为展示大脑想象力能力开辟了新方向。
abstract_en: Decoding visual information from fMRI signals is an important pathway to understand how the brain represents the world, and is a cutting-edge field of artificial general intelligence. Decoding fMRI should not be limited to reconstructing visual stimuli, but also further transforming them into descriptions, creating actions, and even generating unseen content. We purposefully propose a novel and efficient brain multimodal architecture, NeuroCreat, which combines the powerful visual and textual abilities of LLM to capture fine-grained semantic information from fMRI, transformed it into embodied implementation of different neural representations. Specifically, we innovatively designed a brain expert adaption (BEA) module, effectively capturing commonalities and individual differences among subjects through the collaborative learning of shared/routed experts. Inspired by human visual working memory, we extracted "creation" information from higher visual cortex for idea generation. We further constructed a prompt variant alignment module, seamlessly integrates fMRI-visual-semantic-creation into LLM to achieve flexible incorporation of different semantics in the decoding of neural representations. Experiments on different fMRI datasets show that NeuroCreat achieves SOTA performance on multiple brain decoding tasks. More importantly, we have innovatively achieved few-shot brain video creation, which opens up a new direction for demonstrating the brain's imaginative ability.
authors: Haodong Jing, Dongyao Jiang, Yongqiang Ma, Haibo Hua, Bo Huang, Nanning Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19258-19268

title: 超越孤立单词:用于手写文本行生成的扩散笔刷
title_en: Beyond Isolated Words: Diffusion Brush for Handwritten Text-Line Generation
abstract: 现有手写文本生成方法主要聚焦于孤立单词。然而,现实中的手写文本不仅需要关注单个单词,还需要注意单词之间的关系,如垂直对齐和水平间距。因此,生成完整的文本行成为一个更具前景且全面的任务。然而,这一任务面临显著挑战,包括对复杂风格模式的准确建模——涵盖单词内和单词间的相互关系——以及在大量字符中保持内容准确性。为解决这些挑战,我们提出DiffBrush,一种用于手写文本行生成的新型扩散模型。与现有方法不同,DiffBrush通过两项关键策略在风格模仿和内容准确性方面表现出色:(1) 内容解耦的风格学习,通过列和行方向的掩码将风格与内容分离,以更好地捕捉单词内和单词间的风格模式;(2) 多尺度内容学习,采用行和词判别器确保文本内容的全局一致性和局部准确性。大量实验表明,DiffBrush在生成高质量文本行方面表现出色,特别是在风格再现和内容保持方面。代码可在https://github.com/dailenson/DiffBrush获取。
abstract_en: Existing handwritten text generation methods primarily focus on isolated words. However, realistic handwritten text demands attention not only to individual words but also to the relationships between them, such as vertical alignment and horizontal spacing. Therefore, generating entire text line emerges as a more promising and comprehensive task. However, this task poses significant challenges, including the accurate modeling of complex style patterns--encompassing both intra- and inter-word relationships--and maintaining content accuracy across numerous characters. To address these challenges, we propose DiffBrush, a novel diffusion-based model for handwritten text-line generation. Unlike existing methods, DiffBrush excels in both style imitation and content accuracy through two key strategies: (1) content-decoupled style learning, which disentangles style from content to better capture intra-word and inter-word style patterns by using column- and row-wise masking; and (2) multi-scale content learning, which employs line and word discriminators to ensure global coherence and local accuracy of textual content. Extensive experiments show that DiffBrush excels in generating high-quality text-lines, particularly in style reproduction and content preservation. Code is available at https://github.com/dailenson/DiffBrush.
authors: Gang Dai, Yifan Zhang, Yutao Qin, Qiangya Guo, Shuangping Huang, Shuicheng Yan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19054-19064

title: 超越标签语义:面向少样本动作识别的语言引导动作解剖学
title_en: Beyond Label Semantics: Language-Guided Action Anatomy for Few-shot Action Recognition
abstract: 少样本动作识别(FSAR)旨在通过每个类别仅有少量标注样本的视频对人类动作进行分类。训练数据的稀缺性推动了近期研究引入额外模态,尤其是文本。然而,人类姿态的细微变化、运动动态以及不同阶段中物体交互等关键内在知识,无法仅通过动作标签完全挖掘。本文提出语言引导动作解剖学(LGA),一种超越标签语义的新框架,通过大语言模型(LLMs)解析隐藏在动作标签下的本质表征特征。在LLM编码的先验知识指导下,LGA有效捕捉少样本场景中的丰富时空线索。具体而言,对于文本,我们通过提示现成LLM将标签解构为原子动作描述序列,聚焦动作的三个核心要素(主体、运动、客体)。对于视频,视觉解剖模块将动作分割为原子视频阶段以捕捉动作的序列结构。随后,细粒度融合策略在原子层面整合文本与视觉特征,生成更具泛化能力的原型。最后,我们引入包含视频-视频和视频-文本匹配的多模态匹配机制,确保鲁棒的少样本分类。实验结果表明,LGA在多个FSAR基准测试中实现了最先进性能。
abstract_en: Few-shot action recognition (FSAR) aims to classify human actions in videos with only a small number of labeled samples per category. The scarcity of training data has driven recent efforts to incorporate additional modalities, particularly text. However, the subtle variations in human posture, motion dynamics, and the object interactions that occur during different phases, are critical inherent knowledge of actions that cannot be fully exploited by action labels alone. In this work, we propose Language-Guided Action Anatomy (LGA), a novel framework that goes beyond label semantics by leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to dissect the essential representational characteristics hidden beneath action labels. Guided by the prior knowledge encoded in LLM, LGA effectively captures rich spatiotemporal cues in few-shot scenarios. Specifically, for text, we prompt an off-the-shelf LLM to anatomize labels into sequences of atomic action descriptions, focusing on the three core elements of action (subject, motion, object). For videos, a Visual Anatomy Module segments actions into atomic video phases to capture the sequential structure of actions. A fine-grained fusion strategy then integrates textual and visual features at the atomic level, resulting in more generalizable prototypes.
