In this study, we propose a cross-view two-stage fusion network called CVFusion. In the first stage, we design a radar guided iterative (RGIter) BEV fusion module to generate high-recall 3D proposal boxes. In the second stage, we aggregate features from multiple heterogeneous views including points, image, and BEV for each proposal. These comprehensive instance level features greatly help refine the proposals and generate high-quality predictions. Extensive experiments on public datasets show that our method outperforms the previous state-of-the-art methods by a large margin, with 9.10% and 3.68% mAP improvements on View-of-Delft (VoD) and TJ4DRadSet, respectively. Our code will be available at https://github.com/zhzhzhzhzhz/CVFusion.
authors: Hanzhi Zhong, Zhiyu Xiang, Ruoyu Xu, Jingyun Fu, Peng Xu, Shaohong Wang, Zhihao Yang, Tianyu Pu, Eryun Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28188-28197

title: CVPT: 跨视觉提示调优
title_en: CVPT: Cross Visual Prompt Tuning
abstract: 参数高效微调(PEFT)已出现以缓解大规模模型的计算需求。在计算机视觉领域,基于适配器的PEFT方法通常比基于提示的方法(如视觉提示调优VPT)更受青睐,因为后者在性能和效率方面存在局限。我们的分析表明,VPT的不足源于其提示部署策略,该策略会扭曲模型固有的自注意力机制。为解决这一问题,我们提出跨视觉提示调优(CVPT)。CVPT引入交叉注意力模块,直接建模提示与图像标记之间的交互。该设计将提示与输入序列解耦,在保持原始自注意力完整性的同时实现高效特征融合。此外,我们采用权重共享机制进行交叉注意力初始化,这在不增加大量参数开销的情况下增强了表征能力。在25个数据集上的广泛实验表明,CVPT显著优于VPT。例如,在VTAB-1K基准测试中,CVPT实现超过4%的平均准确率提升,其性能和效率可与领先的适配器方法相媲美。我们的工作证实了基于提示的方法在视觉微调中可取得卓越效果。代码已开源至https://github.com/Lingyun0419/CVPT
abstract_en: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has emerged to mitigate the computational demands of large-scale models. Within computer vision, adapter-based PEFT methods are often favored over prompt-based approaches like Visual Prompt Tuning (VPT) due to the latter's performance and efficiency limitations. Our analysis reveals that VPT's shortcomings stem from its prompt deployment strategy, which can distort the model's inherent self-attention mechanism. To address this, we propose Cross Visual Prompt Tuning (CVPT). CVPT introduces a cross-attention module to directly model interactions between prompts and image tokens. This design decouples the prompts from the input sequence, preserving the original self-attention integrity while enabling efficient feature integration. Furthermore, we employ a weight-sharing mechanism for cross-attention initialization, which enhances representative capability without a large parameter overhead. Extensive experiments across 25 datasets show that CVPT significantly outperforms VPT. For instance, on the VTAB-1K benchmark, CVPT achieves over 4% higher average accuracy, rivaling leading adapter-based methods in both performance and efficiency. Our work confirms that prompt-based methods can achieve exceptional results in visual fine-tuning. The code is available at https://github.com/Lingyun0419/CVPT
authors: Lingyun Huang, Jianxu Mao, Junfei Yi, Ziming Tao, Yaonan Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 848-858

title: CWNet: 基于因果小波网络的低光照图像增强
title_en: CWNet: Causal Wavelet Network for Low-Light Image Enhancement
abstract: 传统低光照图像增强(LLIE)方法主要关注均匀亮度调整,往往忽视实例级语义信息和不同特征的固有特性。为解决这些局限性,我们提出CWNet(因果小波网络),一种利用小波变换进行因果推理的新架构。具体而言,我们的方法包含两个关键组件:1)受因果干预概念启发,我们采用因果推理视角揭示低光照增强中的潜在因果关系。从全局视角,我们采用度量学习策略确保因果嵌入遵循因果原则,将其与非因果混杂因素分离,同时关注因果因素的不变性。在局部层面,我们引入实例级CLIP语义损失以精确保持因果因素一致性。2)基于因果分析,我们提出基于小波变换的主干网络,有效优化频率信息恢复,确保针对小波变换特定属性的精确增强。大量实验表明,CWNet在多个数据集上显著优于当前最先进方法,展现出在多样场景中的鲁棒性能。代码可在https://github.com/bywlzts/CWNet-Causal-Wavelet-Network获取。
abstract_en: Traditional Low-Light Image Enhancement (LLIE) methods primarily focus on uniform brightness adjustment, often neglecting instance-level semantic information and the inherent characteristics of different features. To address these limitations, we propose CWNet (Causal Wavelet Network), a novel architecture that leverages wavelet transforms for causal reasoning. Specifically, our approach comprises two key components: 1) Inspired by the concept of intervention in causality, we adopt a causal reasoning perspective to reveal the underlying causal relationships in low-light enhancement. From a global perspective, we employ a metric learning strategy to ensure causal embeddings adhere to causal principles, separating them from non-causal confounding factors while focusing on the invariance of causal factors. At the local level, we introduce an instance-level CLIP semantic loss to precisely maintain causal factor consistency. 2) Based on our causal analysis, we present a wavelet transform-based backbone network that effectively optimizes the recovery of frequency information, ensuring precise enhancement tailored to the specific attributes of wavelet transforms. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CWNet significantly outperforms current state-of-the-art methods across multiple datasets, showcasing its robust performance across diverse scenes. Code is available at https://github.com/bywlzts/CWNet-Causal-Wavelet-Network.
authors: Tongshun Zhang, Pingping Liu, Yubing Lu, Mengen Cai, Zijian Zhang, Zhe Zhang, Qiuzhan Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8789-8799

title: CaO2: 修正基于扩散的数据集蒸馏中的不一致性
title_en: CaO2: Rectifying Inconsistencies in Diffusion-Based Dataset Distillation
abstract: 扩散模型在数据集蒸馏中的最新应用展现出在创建紧凑的替代数据集方面的巨大潜力,能够为大型高分辨率目标数据集提供更高效且性能更优的解决方案,超越传统双层/单层优化方法。然而,当前基于扩散的数据集蒸馏方法忽视了评估过程,并在蒸馏过程中存在两个关键不一致性:(1) 目标不一致性,即蒸馏过程与评估目标脱节;(2) 条件不一致性,导致生成图像与其对应条件之间出现不匹配。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种基于扩散的两阶段框架Condition-aware Optimization with Objective-guided Sampling (CaO_2),该框架将蒸馏过程与评估目标对齐。第一阶段采用基于概率的样本选择流程,第二阶段优化相应的潜在表示以提升条件似然。CaO_2在ImageNet及其子集上实现了最先进的性能,平均准确率超过最佳基线模型2.3%。
abstract_en: The recent introduction of diffusion models in dataset distillation has shown promising potential in creating compact surrogate datasets for large, high-resolution target datasets, offering improved efficiency and performance over traditional bi-level/uni-level optimization methods. However, current diffusion-based dataset distillation approaches overlook the evaluation process and exhibit two critical inconsistencies in the distillation process: (1) Objective Inconsistency, where the distillation process diverges from the evaluation objective, and (2) Condition Inconsistency, leading to mismatches between generated images and their corresponding conditions. To resolve these issues, we introduce Condition-aware Optimization with Objective-guided Sampling (CaO_2), a two-stage diffusion-based framework that aligns the distillation process with the evaluation objective. The first stage employs a probability-informed sample selection pipeline, while the second stage refines the corresponding latent representations to improve conditional likelihood.CaO_2 achieves state-of-the-art performance on ImageNet and its subsets, surpassing the best-performing baselines by an average of 2.3% accuracy.
authors: Haoxuan Wang, Zhenghao Zhao, Junyi Wu, Yuzhang Shang, Gaowen Liu, Yan Yan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4722-4731

title: CaliMatch:通过自适应校准提升安全半监督学习
title_en: CaliMatch: Adaptive Calibration for Improving Safe Semi-supervised Learning
abstract: 半监督学习(SSL)利用未标记数据在标记数据稀缺时提升机器学习模型的性能。然而,其实际应用常面临标签分布不匹配问题,即未标记数据集包含的实例的真值标签在标记训练数据集中缺失。近期研究(称为安全SSL)通过结合分类和分布外(OOD)检测解决了这一问题。然而,现有方法可能因深度神经网络的过度自信导致SSL错误率增加,这源于对错误伪标签或OOD检测的高置信度。为解决此问题,我们提出了一种新方法CaliMatch,通过校准分类器和OOD检测器以促进安全SSL。CaliMatch引入自适应标签平滑和温度缩放,消除了手动调整平滑程度以实现有效校准的需要。我们给出了为何提升分类器和OOD检测器校准对安全SSL至关重要的理论依据。在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、SVHN、TinyImageNet和ImageNet上的广泛评估表明,CaliMatch在安全SSL任务中优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) uses unlabeled data to improve the performance of machine learning models when labeled data is scarce. However, its real-world applications often face the label distribution mismatch problem, in which the unlabeled dataset includes instances whose ground-truth labels are absent from the labeled training dataset. Recent studies, referred to as safe SSL, have addressed this issue by using both classification and out-of-distribution (OOD) detection. However, the existing methods may suffer from overconfidence in deep neural networks, leading to increased SSL errors because of high confidence in incorrect pseudo-labels or OOD detection. To address this, we propose a novel method, CaliMatch, which calibrates both the classifier and the OOD detector to foster safe SSL. CaliMatch presents adaptive label smoothing and temperature scaling, which eliminates the need to manually tune the smoothing degree for effective calibration. We give a theoretical justification for why improving the calibration of both the classifier and the OOD detector is crucial in safe SSL. Extensive evaluations on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, TinyImageNet, and ImageNet demonstrate that CaliMatch outperforms the existing methods in safe SSL tasks.
authors: Jinsoo Bae, Seoung Bum Kim, Hyungrok Do ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2867-2876

title: 基于多模态贝叶斯提示集成的多模态大语言模型作为评判者的校准
title_en: Calibrating MLLM-as-a-judge via Multimodal Bayesian Prompt Ensembles
abstract: 多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)正被越来越多地用于评估文本到图像(TTI)生成系统,通过视觉和文本上下文提供自动判断。然而,这些"评判者"模型常存在偏差、过度自信以及在多样化图像领域中表现不一致的问题。尽管提示集成方法在单模态文本场景中显示出缓解这些问题的潜力,但我们的实验表明,标准集成方法在TTI任务中难以有效泛化。为解决这些局限性,我们提出了一种新的多模态感知方法,称为**多模态贝叶斯提示集成**(MMB)。我们的方法通过图像聚类增强的贝叶斯提示集成方法,使评判者能够根据每个样本的视觉特征动态分配提示权重。我们证明MMB在成对偏好判断中提高了准确性,并显著增强了校准能力,使评估评判者真实不确定性变得更加容易。在两个TTI基准测试集HPSv2和MJBench上的评估表明,MMB在与人类标注的一致性及多样化图像内容的校准方面均优于现有基线。我们的研究结果突显了针对评判者校准的多模态特定策略的重要性,并为可靠的大规模TTI评估提供了有前景的发展路径。
abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate text-to-image (TTI) generation systems, providing automated judgments based on visual and textual context. However, these "judge" models often suffer from biases, overconfidence, and inconsistent performance across diverse image domains. While prompt ensembling has shown promise for mitigating these issues in unimodal, text-only settings, our experiments reveal that standard ensembling methods fail to generalize effectively for TTI tasks. To address these limitations, we propose a new multimodal-aware method called **M**ultimodal **M**ixture-of-**B**ayesian Prompt Ensembles (MMB). Our approach uses a Bayesian prompt ensemble approach augmented by image clustering, allowing the judge to dynamically assign prompt weights based on the visual characteristics of each sample. We show that MMB improves accuracy in pairwise preference judgments and greatly enhances calibration, making it easier to gauge the judge's true uncertainty. In evaluations on two TTI benchmarks, HPSv2 and MJBench, MMB outperforms existing baselines in alignment with human annotations and calibration across varied image content. Our findings highlight the importance of multimodal-specific strategies for judge calibration and suggest a promising path forward for reliable large-scale TTI evaluation.
authors: Eric Slyman, Mehrab Tanjim, Kushal Kafle, Stefan Lee ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17224-17234

title: CalliReader: 通过嵌入对齐视觉-语言模型实现中国书法的上下文化
title_en: CalliReader: Contextualizing Chinese Calligraphy via an Embedding-Aligned Vision-Language Model
abstract: 中国书法作为联合国教科文组织遗产,因视觉歧义性和文化复杂性仍面临计算挑战。现有AI系统因标注数据有限和视觉语义对齐不足,难以实现书法的上下文化。我们提出CalliReader,一种通过三项创新解决中国书法上下文化(CC2)问题的视觉-语言模型(VLM):(1)字符级切片实现精准字符提取与排序,(2)CalliAlign进行视觉-文本token压缩与对齐,(3)嵌入指令调优(e-IT)提升对齐效果并应对数据稀缺。我们还构建了CalliBench,首个全页书法上下文基准,解决先前OCR和VQA方法的三大关键问题:碎片化上下文、浅层推理和幻觉。通过用户研究等大量实验验证,CalliReader在页面级书法识别与解释中超越其他SOTA方法,甚至超过专业人工,实现更高准确率并减少幻觉。与推理模型的对比凸显了精准识别作为可靠理解的前提重要性。定量分析验证了CalliReader的效率;在文档和现实场景基准上的评估证实其强大的泛化能力。
abstract_en: Chinese calligraphy, a UNESCO Heritage, remains computationally challenging due to visual ambiguity and cultural complexity. Existing AI systems fail to contextualize their intricate scripts, because of limited annotated data and poor visual-semantic alignment. We propose CalliReader, a vision-language model (VLM) that solves the Chinese Calligraphy Contextualization (CC^2) problem through three innovations: (1) character-wise slicing for precise character extraction and sorting, (2) CalliAlign for visual-text token compression and alignment, (3) embedding instruction tuning (e-IT) for improving alignment and addressing data scarcity. We also build CalliBench, the first benchmark for full-page calligraphic contextualization, addressing three critical issues in previous OCR and VQA approaches: fragmented context, shallow reasoning, and hallucination. Extensive experiments including user studies have been conducted to verify our CalliReader's superiority to other state-of-the-art methods and even human professionals in page-level calligraphy recognition and interpretation, achieving higher accuracy while reducing hallucination. Comparisons with reasoning models highlight the importance of accurate recognition as a prerequisite for reliable comprehension. Quantitative analyses validate CalliReader's efficiency; evaluations on document and real-world benchmarks confirm its robust generalization ability.
authors: Yuxuan Luo, Jiaqi Tang, Chenyi Huang, Feiyang Hao, Zhouhui Lian ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23030-23040

title: CameraCtrl II:基于相机控制视频扩散模型的动态场景探索
title_en: CameraCtrl II: Dynamic Scene Exploration via Camera-controlled Video Diffusion Models
abstract: 本文介绍了CameraCtrl II框架,该框架通过相机控制的视频扩散模型实现连续且动态的场景探索。先前基于相机条件的视频生成模型在生成具有大范围相机运动的视频时存在视频动态性减弱和视角范围有限的问题。我们采用逐步扩展动态场景生成的方法——首先增强单个片段内的动态内容,然后将这些能力扩展到创建广阔视角范围内的无缝探索。具体而言,我们构建了一个包含大量动态内容且带有相机标注的数据集用于训练,同时设计了轻量级相机注入模块和训练方案以增强预训练模型的动态性。在提升单片段能力的基础上,我们通过允许用户迭代指定相机轨迹来生成连贯的视频序列,从而实现扩展场景探索。在多种场景的实验中表明,CameraCtrl II能够实现比先前方法更广泛的空间探索和增强的动态性。我们将发布数据集和代码。
abstract_en: This paper introduces CameraCtrl II, a framework that enables continuous and dynamic scene exploration through a camera-controlled video diffusion model. Previous camera-conditioned video generative models suffer from diminished video dynamics and limited range of viewpoints when generating videos with large camera motion. We take an approach that progressively expands the generation of dynamic scenes---first enhancing dynamic content within individual clips, then extending these capabilities to create seamless explorations across broad viewpoint ranges. Specifically, we construct a dataset featuring a large degree of dynamics with camera annotation for training while designing a lightweight camera injection module and training scheme to enhance dynamics from pretrained models. Building on these improved single-clip capabilities, we enable extended scene exploration by allowing users to iteratively specify camera trajectories for generating coherent video sequences. Experiments across diverse scenarios demonstrate that CameraCtrl II enables dynamic scene synthesis with substantially wider spatial exploration and enhanced dynamics than previous approaches. We will release the dataset and code.
authors: Hao He, Ceyuan Yang, Shanchuan Lin, Yinghao Xu, Meng Wei, Liangke Gui, Qi Zhao, Gordon Wetzstein, Lu Jiang, Hongsheng Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13416-13426

title: 生成式地理空间扩散模型能否胜任判别式地理空间基础模型?
title_en: Can Generative Geospatial Diffusion Models Excel as Discriminative Geospatial Foundation Models?
abstract: 自监督学习(SSL)已彻底革新了遥感(RS)中的表征学习,推动地理空间基础模型(GFMs)利用海量未标注的卫星影像数据,服务于多样化的下游任务。目前,GFMs主要采用对比学习或掩码图像建模等目标,因其在学习可迁移表征方面已取得显著成功。然而,生成式扩散模型在图像生成过程中展现出捕捉遥感任务所需多粒度语义的潜力,但其在判别式应用中的探索仍显不足。这引出了一个关键问题:生成式扩散模型是否也能胜任并成为具备充分判别能力的地理空间基础模型?在本工作中,我们通过SatDiFuser框架回答这一问题,该框架将基于扩散的生成式地理空间基础模型转化为强大的判别式遥感预训练工具。通过系统分析多阶段、噪声依赖的扩散特征,我们开发了三种融合策略以有效利用这些多样化表征。在遥感基准测试中广泛实验表明,SatDiFuser超越了最先进的GFMs,在语义分割任务中实现高达+5.7%的mIoU提升,在分类任务中实现+7.9%的F1-score提升,证明了基于扩散的生成式基础模型具备与判别式GFMs竞争甚至超越的能力。源代码可在:https://github.com/yurujaja/SatDiFuser 获取。
abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has revolutionized representation learning in Remote Sensing (RS), advancing Geospatial Foundation Models (GFMs) to leverage vast unlabeled satellite imagery for diverse downstream tasks. Currently, GFMs primarily employ objectives like contrastive learning or masked image modeling, owing to their proven success in learning transferable representations. However, generative diffusion models, which demonstrate the potential to capture multi-grained semantics essential for RS tasks during image generation, remain underexplored for discriminative applications. This prompts the question: can generative diffusion models also excel and serve as GFMs with sufficient discriminative power? In this work, we answer this question with SatDiFuser, a framework that transforms a diffusion-based generative geospatial foundation model into a powerful pretraining tool for discriminative RS. By systematically analyzing multi-stage, noise-dependent diffusion features, we develop three fusion strategies to effectively leverage these diverse representations. Extensive experiments on remote sensing benchmarks show that SatDiFuser outperforms state-of-the-art GFMs, achieving gains of up to +5.7% mIoU in semantic segmentation and +7.9% F1-score in classification, demonstrating the capacity of diffusion-based generative foundation models to rival or exceed discriminative GFMs. The source code is available at: https://github.com/yurujaja/SatDiFuser.
authors: Yuru Jia, Valerio Marsocci, Ziyang Gong, Xue Yang, Maarten Vergauwen, Andrea Nascetti ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8429-8440

title: 知识能否从单模态传递到多模态?探究多模态知识编辑的可传递性
title_en: Can Knowledge be Transferred from Unimodal to Multimodal? Investigating the Transitivity of Multimodal Knowledge Editing
abstract: 多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)包含大量事实知识,这些知识可能随时间变得过时或不准确。因此,已提出多种知识编辑技术来更新模型中编码的知识。先前方法在编辑和测试阶段均保持模态一致性。然而,在实际应用中,希望知识能在不同模态间传递,这可以增强知识编辑的鲁棒性,并可能通过文本信息实现多模态知识的低成本编辑。为解决这一问题,我们引入多模态知识编辑的可传递性(TMKE)概念,并设计相应的评估标准。随后,我们通过自动化流程构建了相应的TMKE基准测试集。我们评估了三种MLLMs和五种知识编辑方法,揭示了当前模型和方法在可传递性方面的局限性。此外,我们基于知识神经元分析模型在编辑过程中的内在表征,以解释实验现象。
abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) contain a substantial amount of factual knowledge, which may become outdated or inaccurate over time. Consequently, various knowledge editing techniques have been proposed to update the knowledge encoded within these models. Previous approaches maintain modality consistency during both the editing and testing phases. However, in practical applications, it is desirable for knowledge to be transferable across different modalities, which can enhance the robustness of knowledge editing and potentially allow for cost-effective editing of multimodal knowledge using textual information. To address this, we introduce the concept of Transitivity of Multimodal Knowledge Editing (TMKE) and design corresponding evaluation criteria. Subsequently, we construct a corresponding TMKE Benchmark through an automated pipeline. We evaluate three MLLMs and five knowledge editing methods, uncovering limitations in the current models and methods concerning transitivity. Additionally, we analyze the intrinsic representations of the model during the editing process based on Knowledge Neurons to interpret the experimental phenomena.
authors: Lingyong Fang, Xinzhong Wang, Depeng Wang, Zongru Wu, Ya Guo, Huijia Zhu, Zhuosheng Zhang, Gongshen Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2482-2490

title: 我们能否在不使用自注意力的情况下实现高效扩散?将自注意力蒸馏到卷积中
title_en: Can We Achieve Efficient Diffusion Without Self-Attention? Distilling Self-Attention into Convolutions
abstract: 基于U-Net或扩散Transformer(DiT)架构的当代扩散模型通过基于Transformer的注意力机制革新了图像生成。主流范式普遍采用具有二次计算复杂度的自注意力机制来处理复杂图像中的全局空间关系,从而合成具有连贯视觉语义的高保真图像。与传统观点相反,我们的系统分层分析揭示了一个有趣的差异:预训练扩散模型中的自注意力主要表现出局部注意力模式,与卷积归纳偏差高度相似。尽管自注意力中的全局交互是平滑且低强度的,可能不如通常假设的那么关键。基于此,我们提出(\Delta)ConvFusion,通过金字塔卷积块((\Delta)ConvBlocks)替代传统自注意力模块。通过将注意力模式蒸馏到局部卷积操作同时冻结其他组件,(\Delta)ConvFusion在保持生成保真度的同时,实现与基于Transformer的对应方法相当的性能,计算成本降低6929倍,并在效率上超越LinFusion 5.42倍。
abstract_en: Contemporary diffusion models built upon U-Net or Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architectures have revolutionized image generation through transformer-based attention mechanisms. The prevailing paradigm has commonly employed self-attention with quadratic computational complexity to handle global spatial relationships in complex images, thereby synthesizing high-fidelity images with coherent visual semantics. Contrary to conventional wisdom, our systematic layer-wise analysis reveals an interesting discrepancy: self-attention in pre-trained diffusion models predominantly exhibits localized attention patterns, closely resembling convolutional inductive biases. While the global interactions in self-attention is smooth and low-intensity and may be less critical than commonly assumed. Driven by this, we propose (\Delta)ConvFusion to replace conventional self-attention modules with Pyramid Convolution Blocks ((\Delta)ConvBlocks). By distilling attention patterns into localized convolutional operations while keeping other components frozen, (\Delta)ConvFusion achieves performance comparable to transformer-based counterparts while reducing computational cost by 6929x and surpassing LinFusion by 5.42x in efficiency--all without compromising generative fidelity.
authors: Ziyi Dong, Chengxing Zhou, Weijian Deng, Pengxu Wei, Xiangyang Ji, Liang Lin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17401-17410

title: Can3Tok: 场景级三维高斯分布的规范三维标记化与潜在建模
title_en: Can3Tok: Canonical 3D Tokenization and Latent Modeling of Scene-Level 3D Gaussians
abstract: 三维生成技术已取得显著进展,但其仍主要局限于物体级。由于缺乏能够对三维场景级数据进行潜在表示学习扩展的模型,前馈式三维场景级生成研究较少。与在规范空间中使用良好标注的三维数据训练的物体级生成模型不同,使用三维高斯点云(3DGS)表示的场景级生成具有无界特性,并在不同场景间存在尺度不一致性,这使得统一潜在表示学习对于生成任务极具挑战性。本文提出Can3Tok,这是首个能够将大量高斯基元编码为低维潜在嵌入的三维场景级变分自编码器(VAE),有效捕捉输入的语义与空间信息。除模型设计外,我们还提出通用的三维场景数据处理流程以解决尺度不一致性问题。我们在最近的场景级三维数据集DL3DV-10K上验证了该方法,发现只有Can3Tok能够泛化到新场景,而对比方法在训练时甚至无法在数百个场景输入上收敛,推理阶段也表现出零泛化能力。最后,我们通过图像到三维高斯点云(image-to-3DGS)和文本到三维高斯点云(text-to-3DGS)生成应用,展示了其对下游生成任务的促进能力。代码将公开发布。
abstract_en: 3D generation has made significant progress, however, it still largely remains at the object-level. Feedforward 3D scene-level generation has been rarely explored due to the lack of models capable of scaling-up latent representation learning on 3D scene-level data. Unlike object-level generative models, which are trained on well-labeled 3D data in a bounded canonical space, scene-level generations with 3D scenes represented by 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) are unbounded and exhibit scale inconsistency across different scenes, making unified latent representation learning for generative purposes extremely challenging. In this paper, we introduce Can3Tok, the first 3D scene-level variational autoencoder (VAE) capable of encoding a large number of Gaussian primitives into a low-dimensional latent embedding, which effectively captures both semantic and spatial information of the inputs. Beyond model design, we propose a general pipeline for 3D scene data processing to address scale inconsistency issue. We validate our method on the recent scene-level 3D dataset DL3DV-10K, where we found that only Can3Tok successfully generalizes to novel 3D scenes, while compared methods fail to converge on even a few hundred scene inputs during training and exhibit zero generalization ability during inference. Finally, we demonstrate image-to-3DGS and text-to-3DGS generation as our applications to demonstrate it's ability to faciliate downstream generation tasks. Code will be released.
authors: Quankai Gao, Iliyan Georgiev, Tuanfeng Y. Wang, Krishna Kumar Singh, Ulrich Neumann, Jae Shin Yoon ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9320-9331

title: CanFields: 整合微分同胚流用于任意长度序列的非刚性4D插值
title_en: CanFields: Consolidating Diffeomorphic Flows for Non-Rigid 4D Interpolation from Arbitrary-Length Sequences
abstract: 我们引入了规范整合场(Canonical Consolidation Fields, CanFields)。该新颖方法可将任意长度的独立采样3D点云序列插值为一个统一、连续且连贯的变形形状。与先前方法相比,CanFields在无监督拟合中通过两个新颖的定制模块联合优化精细几何结构和变形,避免了过度平滑几何或产生拓扑与几何伪影的问题。首先,我们引入了一个动态整合器模块,用于调整输入并分配置信度分数,平衡规范形状及其运动的优化。其次,我们将运动表示为由平滑速度场参数化的微分同胚流。我们在超过50个多样化序列上验证了方法的鲁棒性和准确性,即使在存在缺失区域、噪声原始扫描和稀疏数据的情况下,也表现出卓越的性能。我们的项目页面位于:https://wangmiaowei.github.io/CanFields.github.io/。
abstract_en: We introduce Canonical Consolidation Fields (CanFields). This novel method interpolates arbitrary-length sequences of independently sampled 3D point clouds into a unified, continuous, and coherent deforming shape. Unlike prior methods that oversmooth geometry or produce topological and geometric artifacts, CanFields optimizes fine-detailed geometry and deformation jointly in an unsupervised fitting with two novel bespoke modules. First, we introduce a dynamic consolidator module that adjusts the input and assigns confidence scores, balancing the optimization of the canonical shape and its motion. Second, we represent the motion as a diffeomorphic flow parameterized by a smooth velocity field. We have validated our robustness and accuracy on more than 50 diverse sequences, demonstrating its superior performance even with missing regions, noisy raw scans, and sparse data. Our project page is at: https://wangmiaowei.github.io/CanFields.github.io/.
authors: Miaowei Wang, Changjian Li, Amir Vaxman ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28587-28598

title: CanonSwap: 通过规范空间调制实现高保真且一致的视频人脸换脸
title_en: CanonSwap: High-Fidelity and Consistent Video Face Swapping via Canonical Space Modulation
abstract: 视频人脸换脸旨在解决两个主要挑战:有效将源身份转移到目标视频中,并准确保持目标人脸的动态属性,如头部姿态、面部表情、唇同步等。现有方法主要聚焦于实现高质量的身份转移,但往往在保持目标人脸动态属性方面存在不足,导致结果不一致。我们将这一问题归因于视频中面部外观与运动的固有耦合。为解决这一问题,我们提出CanonSwap,一种新颖的视频人脸换脸框架,通过将运动信息与外观信息解耦。具体而言,CanonSwap首先消除与运动相关的信息,使身份修改能够在统一的规范空间中进行。随后,将换脸后的身份重新整合到原始视频空间中,确保目标人脸动态属性的保留。为进一步实现精确的身份转移,减少伪影并增强真实感,我们设计了一个部分身份调制模块,通过空间掩码自适应整合源身份特征,限制修改仅限于面部区域。此外,我们引入了若干细粒度同步度量指标,全面评估视频人脸换脸方法的性能。大量实验表明,我们的方法在视觉质量、时间一致性和身份保留方面显著优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Video face swapping aims to address two primary challenges: effectively transferring the source identity to the target video and accurately preserving the dynamic attributes of the target face, such as head poses, facial expressions, lip-sync, etc..Existing methods mainly focus on achieving high-quality identity transfer but often fall short in maintaining the dynamic attributes of the target face, leading to inconsistent results. We attribute this issue to the inherent coupling of facial appearance and motion in videos. To address this, we propose CanonSwap, a novel video face-swapping framework that decouples motion information from appearance information. Specifically, CanonSwap first eliminates motion-related information, enabling identity modification within a unified canonical space. Subsequently, the swapped identity is reintegrated into the original video space, ensuring the preservation of the target face's dynamic attributes. To further achieve precise identity transfer with minimal artifacts and enhanced realism, we design a Partial Identity Modulation module that adaptively integrates source identity features using a spatial mask to restrict modifications to facial regions.Additionally, we introduce several fine-grained synchronization metrics to comprehensively evaluate the performance of video face swapping methods.Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing approaches in terms of visual quality, temporal consistency, and identity preservation.
authors: Xiangyang Luo, Ye Zhu, Yunfei Liu, Lijian Lin, Cong Wan, Zijian Cai, Yu Li, Shao-Lun Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10064-10074

title: CapeLLM:无需支持的类别无关姿态估计多模态大语言模型
title_en: CapeLLM: Support-Free Category-Agnostic Pose Estimation with Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: 类别无关姿态估计(CAPE)传统上依赖于带有标注关键点的支持图像,这一过程通常繁琐且可能无法充分捕捉跨多样物体类别的必要对应关系。近期研究探索了使用文本查询的方法,利用其增强的稳定性和泛化能力。然而,现有方法往往受限于对支持查询的依赖、未能充分利用预训练大语言模型中嵌入的丰富先验知识,以及参数化分布假设带来的局限性。为解决这些挑战,我们引入了CapeLLM,这是首个专为CAPE设计的多模态大语言模型(MLLM)。我们的方法仅使用查询图像和详细文本描述作为输入以估计类别无关关键点,包含有效的训练策略和精心设计的指令用于将MLLM应用于CAPE。此外,我们提出了一种推理机制,进一步增强对未见关键点的推理过程,同时灵活建模其潜在的空间分布和不确定性,从而根据上下文线索进行自适应优化。我们进行了大量实验,有效将MLLM应用于CAPE,不仅关注模型架构和提示设计,还确保在输入变化下的鲁棒性。我们的方法在MP-100基准测试的1-shot甚至5-shot设置中取得了新的最先进水平,标志着类别无关姿态估计领域的重大进展。代码可在https://github.com/Junhojuno/CapeLLM获取
abstract_en: Category-agnostic pose estimation (CAPE) has traditionally relied on support images with annotated keypoints, a process that is often cumbersome and may fail to fully capture the necessary correspondences across diverse object categories. Recent efforts have explored the use of text queries, leveraging their enhanced stability and generalization capabilities. However, existing approaches often remain constrained by their reliance on support queries, their failure to fully utilize the rich priors embedded in pre-trained large language models, and the limitations imposed by their parametric distribution assumptions. To address these challenges, we introduce CapeLLM, the first multimodal large language model (MLLM) designed for CAPE. Our method only employs query image and detailed text descriptions as an input to estimate category-agnostic keypoints. Our method encompasses effective training strategies and carefully designed instructions for applying the MLLM to CAPE. Moreover, we propose an inference mechanism that further enhances the reasoning process for unseen keypoints. while flexibly modeling their underlying spatial distribution and uncertainty, allowing for adaptive refinement based on contextual cues. We conducted extensive experiments to apply the MLLM to CAPE effectively, focusing not only on the model architecture and prompt design but also on ensuring robustness across input variations. Our approach sets a new state-of-the-art on the MP-100 benchmark in the 1-shot and even 5-shot setting, marking a significant advancement in the field of category-agnostic pose estimation. Code is available https://github.com/Junhojuno/CapeLLM
authors: Junho Kim, Hyungjin Chung, Byung-Hoon Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22889-22898

title: CaptionSmiths:图像描述中灵活控制语言模式
title_en: CaptionSmiths: Flexibly Controlling Language Pattern in Image Captioning
abstract: 一种能够灵活切换语言模式(如描述性和长度)的图像描述模型应具有广泛应用价值。然而,尽管生成式视觉-语言模型取得了显著进展,但对生成描述属性的精细控制仍面临两大挑战:(i) 现有模型在训练时未将属性作为条件输入,(ii) 现有模型难以在不同语言模式状态间实现平滑过渡。针对这一挑战,我们提出CaptionSmiths新方法,构建单一描述模型以处理多样化的语言模式。首先,我们的方法通过连续标量值量化每个描述的三个属性:长度、描述性和词汇独特性,无需人工标注。基于这些值,我们通过在表示极端状态的两个端点向量(如极短描述与极长描述)之间进行插值来实现条件控制。实验证明,所提出的模型可平滑调节输出描述的属性,并在词汇对齐度上优于基线方法。例如,CaptionSmiths在控制描述长度时错误率降低506%,同时保持更优的词汇对齐度。代码将开源于https://github.com/omronsinicx/captionsmiths。
abstract_en: An image captioning model flexibly switching its language pattern, e.g., descriptiveness and length, should be useful since it can be applied to diverse applications. However, despite the dramatic improvement in generative vision-language models, fine-grained control over the properties of generated captions is not easy due to two reasons: (i) existing models are not given the properties as a condition during training and (ii) existing models cannot smoothly transition its language pattern from one state to the other. Given this challenge, we propose a new approach, CaptionSmiths, to acquire a single captioning model that can handle diverse language patterns. First, our approach quantifies three properties of each caption, length, descriptiveness, and uniqueness of a word, as continuous scalar values, without human annotation. Given the values, we represent the conditioning via interpolation between two endpoint vectors corresponding to the extreme states, e.g., one for a very short caption and one for a very long caption. Empirical results demonstrate that the resulting model can smoothly change the properties of the output captions and show higher lexical alignment than baselines. For instance, CaptionSmiths reduces the error in controlling caption length by 506% despite better lexical alignment. Code will be available on https://github.com/omronsinicx/captionsmiths.
authors: Kuniaki Saito, Donghyun Kim, Kwanyong Park, Atsushi Hashimoto, Yoshitaka Ushiku ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19872-19881

title: 从单目视频中捕捉手部接触的头部虚拟形象
title_en: Capturing head avatar with hand contacts from a monocular video
abstract: 逼真的3D头部虚拟形象对于远程临场、游戏和虚拟现实至关重要。然而,大多数方法仅关注面部区域,忽略了自然的手部-面部互动,如手部置于下巴或手指轻触脸颊等动作,这些互动能够传达沉思等认知状态。本文提出了一种新颖框架,联合学习头部虚拟形象及手部-面部互动引起的非刚性变形。该任务面临两个主要挑战。首先,单独跟踪手部和面部无法捕捉其相对姿态。为解决此问题,我们在姿态跟踪中结合深度顺序损失与接触正则化,确保面部与手部的空间关系正确。其次,缺乏手部引起的变形的公开先验,使得从单目视频中学习此类变形具有挑战性。为此,我们从手部-面部互动数据集中学习特定于手部引起的面部变形的PCA基,将问题简化为估计紧凑的PCA参数集而非完整的空间变形场。此外,受物理模拟启发,我们引入接触损失提供额外监督,显著减少穿透伪影并增强结果的物理合理性。我们在iPhone拍摄的RGB-D视频上评估该方法,同时构建包含多种手部互动类型的合成数据集以更准确地评估重建几何。实验表明,我们的方法在面部外观和变形几何精度上均优于最先进的表面重建方法。
abstract_en: Photorealistic 3D head avatars are vital for telepresence, gaming, and VR. However, most methods focus solely on facial regions, ignoring natural hand-face interactions, such as a hand resting on the chin or fingers gently touching the cheek, which convey cognitive states like pondering. In this work, we present a novel framework that jointly learns detailed head avatars and the non-rigid deformations induced by hand-face interactions.There are two principal challenges in this task. First, naively tracking hand and face separately fails to capture their relative poses. To overcome this, we propose to combine depth order loss with contact regularization during pose tracking, ensuring correct spatial relationships between the face and hand. Second, no publicly available priors exist for hand-induced deformations, making them non-trivial to learn from monocular videos. To address this, we learn a PCA basis specific to hand-induced facial deformations from a face-hand interaction dataset. This reduces the problem to estimating a compact set of PCA parameters rather than a full spatial deformation field. Furthermore, inspired by physics-based simulation, we incorporate a contact loss that provides additional supervision, significantly reducing interpenetration artifacts and enhancing the physical plausibility of the results.We evaluate our approach on RGB(D) videos captured by an iPhone. Additionally, to better evaluate the reconstructed geometry, we construct a synthetic dataset of avatars with various types of hand interactions. We show that our method can capture better appearance and more accurate deforming geometry of the face than SOTA surface reconstruction methods.
authors: Haonan He, Yufeng Zheng, Jie Song ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13099-13108

title: CarGait:基于交叉注意力的步态识别重排序方法
title_en: CarGait: Cross-Attention based Re-ranking for Gait recognition
abstract: 步态识别是一种计算机视觉任务,通过个体的行走模式来识别身份。其性能通常通过候选集的排名并在第K名处测量识别准确率进行评估。现有模型通常是单阶段的,通过全局特征表示在候选集中搜索探针的最近邻。虽然这些模型在前K个预测中能够出色地检索到正确身份,但当困难负样本出现在前K短名单中时,往往会导致最高排名(例如第1名)的性能相对较低。本文提出CarGait,一种用于步态识别的重排序方法(重新排序前K列表),通过步态条之间的交叉注意力机制,利用步态序列对之间的细粒度相关性。该重排序方案可适配现有单阶段模型以提升最终结果。我们在三个常见步态数据集Gait3D、GREW和OU-MVLP以及七种不同步态模型上进行了大量实验,展示了CarGait在第1、5名准确率上的一致提升,优于现有重排序方法,并建立了强大的基线。
abstract_en: Gait recognition is a computer vision task that identifies individuals based on their walking patterns. Its performance is commonly evaluated by ranking a gallery of candidates and measuring the identification accuracy at Rank-K. Existing models are typically single-staged, searching for the probe's nearest neighbors in a gallery, using a global feature representation. While these models can excel at retrieving the correct identity within the top-K predictions, they often struggle when hard negatives are among the top shortlist, leading to relatively low performance at the highest ranks (e.g., Rank-1). In this paper, we introduce CarGait, a Re-ranking (re-ordering the top-K list) method for gait recognition, leveraging the fine-grained correlations between pairs of gait sequences, through cross-attention between gait strips. This re-ranking scheme can be adapted to existing single-stage models to enhance their final results. We demonstrate the capabilities of CarGait by extensive experiments on three common gait datasets, Gait3D, GREW, and OU-MVLP, and seven different gait models, showing consistent gains in Rank-1,5 accuracy, while outperforming existing re-ranking approaches, and a strong baseline.
authors: Gavriel Habib, Noa Barzilay, Or Shimshi, Rami Ben-Ari, Nir Darshan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11884-11894

title: CasP: 基于级联对应先验引导的半稠密特征匹配流程改进
title_en: CasP: Improving Semi-Dense Feature Matching Pipeline Leveraging Cascaded Correspondence Priors for Guidance
abstract: 半稠密特征匹配方法在挑战性场景中展现出强大性能。然而现有流程依赖于在整个特征图上进行全局搜索以建立粗略匹配,限制了准确性和效率的进一步提升。受此局限启发,我们提出了一种新型流程CasP,通过级联对应先验进行引导。具体而言,匹配阶段被分解为两个渐进阶段,通过基于区域的选择性交叉注意力机制连接,该机制旨在增强特征可区分性。在第二阶段,通过将搜索范围限制在第一阶段识别的一对多先验区域,确定一对一匹配。此外,该流程通过引入高层特征,有助于降低低层特征提取的计算成本。CasP的加速效果随分辨率提高而增强,在1152分辨率下,我们的轻量模型相比最高效方法ELoFTR的加速效果约为2.2倍。此外,大量实验验证了其在几何估计中的优越性,特别是在跨域泛化方面表现突出。这些优势凸显了其在延迟敏感和高鲁棒性应用(如SLAM和无人机系统)中的潜力。
abstract_en: Semi-dense feature matching methods have shown strong performance in challenging scenarios. However, the existing pipeline relies on a global search across the entire feature map to establish coarse matches, limiting further improvements in accuracy and efficiency. Motivated by this limitation, we propose a novel pipeline, CasP, which leverages cascaded correspondence priors for guidance. Specifically, the matching stage is decomposed into two progressive phases, bridged by a region-based selective cross-attention mechanism designed to enhance feature discriminability. In the second phase, one-to-one matches are determined by restricting the search range to the one-to-many prior areas identified in the first phase. Additionally, this pipeline benefits from incorporating high-level features, which helps reduce the computational costs of low-level feature extraction. The acceleration gains of CasP increase with higher resolution, and our lite model achieves a speedup of ~2.2xat a resolution of 1152 compared to the most efficient method, ELoFTR. Furthermore, extensive experiments demonstrate its superiority in geometric estimation, particularly with impressive cross-domain generalization. These advantages highlight its potential for latency-sensitive and high-robustness applications, such as SLAM and UAV systems.
authors: Peiqi Chen, Lei Yu, Yi Wan, Yingying Pei, Xinyi Liu, Yongxiang Yao, Yingying Zhang, Lixiang Ru, Liheng Zhong, Jingdong Chen, Ming Yang, Yongjun Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28063-28072

title: Cassic:面向学习图像压缩的内容自适应状态空间模型
title_en: Cassic: Towards Content-Adaptive State-Space Models for Learned Image Compression
abstract: 基于学习的图像压缩(LIC)在率失真(RD)性能方面优于传统方法。近期方法MambaVC尝试将Mamba(一种状态空间模型变体)引入该领域,旨在建立超越卷积神经网络和Transformer的新范式。然而,该方法依赖预定义的四方向扫描,优先考虑空间邻近性而非内容和语义关系,导致次优的冗余消除。此外,其仅关注非线性变换,忽视了熵模型改进对熵编码中准确概率估计的关键作用。为解决这些局限性,我们通过双创新提出基于内容自适应视觉状态空间模型的新型框架Cassic。首先,我们设计基于加权激活图和比特分配图的内容自适应选择性扫描,随后构建内容自适应视觉状态空间块。其次,我们提出基于Mamba的通道自回归熵模型,充分利用片间比特分配一致性以提升概率估计。大量实验结果表明,我们的方法在三个数据集上实现了最先进的性能,同时保持比现有MambaVC方法更快的处理速度。
abstract_en: Learned image compression (LIC) demonstrates superior rate-distortion (RD) performance compared to traditional methods. Recent method MambaVC attempts to introduce Mamba, a variant of state space models, into this field aim to establish a new paradigm beyond convolutional neural networks and transformers. However, this approach relies on predefined four-directional scanning, which prioritizes spatial proximity over content and semantic relationships, resulting in suboptimal redundancy elimination. Additionally, it focuses solely on nonlinear transformations, neglecting entropy model improvements crucial for accurate probability estimation in entropy coding. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework based on content-adaptive visual state space model, Cassic, through dual innovation.First, we design a content-adaptive selective scan based on weighted activation maps and bit allocation maps, subsequently developing a content-adaptive visual state space block. Second, we present a mamba-based channel-wise auto-regressive entropy model to fully leverage inter-slice bit allocation consistency for enhanced probability estimation. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across three datasets while maintaining faster processing speeds than existing MambaVC approach.
authors: Shiyu Qin, Jinpeng Wang, Yimin Zhou, Bin Chen, Tianci Luo, Baoyi An, Tao Dai, Shu-Tao Xia, Yaowei Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15727-15736

title: 面向类别的选择性特征增强长尾多标签图像分类
title_en: Category-Specific Selective Feature Enhancement for Long-Tailed Multi-Label Image Classification
abstract: 由于现实世界中的多标签数据常表现出显著的标签不平衡性,长尾多标签图像分类已成为计算机视觉领域的研究热点。传统观点认为深度神经网络的分类器对长尾分布敏感,而特征提取主干网络相对稳健。然而,从特征学习视角的分析表明,主干网络难以维持对样本稀缺类别的高灵敏度,但能有效定位特定区域。基于此观察,我们提出一种新型长尾多标签图像分类模型,命名为面向类别的选择性特征增强(CSSFE)。首先,利用主干网络保留的定位能力捕捉标签依赖的类别激活图;随后引入从头部到中尾类别的渐进式注意力增强机制,以解决中尾类别置信度不足的问题;最后,根据优化后的类别激活图提取视觉特征,并结合语义信息执行分类任务。在两个基准数据集上的大量实验验证了我们发现的通用性和所提出CSSFE方法的优越性能。
abstract_en: Since real-world multi-label data often exhibit significant label imbalance, long-tailed multi-label image classification has emerged as a prominent research area in computer vision. Traditionally, it is considered that deep neural networks' classifiers are vulnerable to long-tailed distributions, whereas the feature extraction backbone remains relatively robust. However, our analysis from the feature learning perspective reveals that the backbone struggles to maintain high sensitivity to sample-scarce categories but retains the ability to localize specific areas effectively. Based on this observation, we propose a new model for long-tailed multi-label image classification named category-specific selective feature enhancement (CSSFE). First, it utilizes the retained localization capability of the backbone to capture label-dependent class activation maps. Then, a progressive attention enhancement mechanism, updating from head to medium to tail categories, is introduced to address the low-confidence issue in medium and tail categories. Finally, visual features are extracted according to the optimized class activation maps and combined with semantic information to perform the classification task. Extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets highlight our findings' generalizability and the proposed CSSFE's superior performance.
authors: Ruiqi Du, Xu Tang, Xiangrong Zhang, Jingjing Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3757-3766

title: 因果解缠与跨模态对齐增强的少样本学习
title_en: Causal Disentanglement and Cross-Modal Alignment for Enhanced Few-Shot Learning
abstract: 少样本学习(FSL)通常需要在有限标注数据下有效适配模型。然而,现有大多数FSL方法依赖纠缠表示,要求模型通过隐式恢复混叠过程,在有限监督下获得解缠表示,这阻碍了有效适配。近期理论研究表明,多模态对比学习方法(如CLIP)可将潜在表示解缠至线性变换级别。基于此,我们提出因果CLIP适配器(CCA),一种新颖框架,通过无监督独立成分分析(ICA)显式解缠CLIP提取的视觉特征。这消除了从标注数据中学习混叠过程的必要性,从而减少可训练参数数量并缓解过拟合。进一步地,尽管ICA可获得视觉解缠表示,但可能破坏CLIP的同模态与跨模态对齐。为应对这一问题,CCA进一步通过两种方式增强CLIP的固有跨模态对齐:单向通过微调基于CLIP的文本分类器,双向则通过跨注意力机制,通过相互作用丰富视觉与文本表示。单模态与跨模态分类输出均可通过线性组合有效融合以提升分类精度。在11个基准数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在少样本性能和分布偏移鲁棒性方面均优于现有最先进的方法,同时保持计算效率。代码将发布于https://github.com/tianjiao-j/CCA。
abstract_en: Few-shot learning (FSL) often requires effective adaptation of models using limited labeled data. However, most existing FSL methods rely on entangled representations, requiring the model to implicitly recover the unmixing process to obtain disentangled representations using only limited supervision, which hinders effective adaptation. Recent theoretical studies show that multimodal contrastive learning methods, such as CLIP, can disentangle latent representations up to linear transformations. In light of this, we propose the Causal CLIP Adapter (CCA), a novel framework that explicitly disentangles visual features extracted from CLIP using unsupervised Independent Component Analysis (ICA). This removes the need to learn the unmixing process from the labeled data, thereby reducing the number of trainable parameters and mitigating overfitting. Taking a step further, while ICA can obtain visual disentangled representations, it may also disrupt CLIP's intra- and inter-modal alignment. To counteract this, CCA further leverages CLIP's inherent cross-modal alignment by enhancing it in two ways: unidirectionally, through fine-tuning a CLIP-based text classifier, and bidirectionally, via a cross-attention mechanism that enriches visual and textual representations through mutual interaction. Both unimodal and cross-modal classification outputs can be effectively combined linearly to improve classification accuracy. Extensive experiments on 11 benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in terms of few-shot performance and robustness to distributional shifts, while maintaining computational efficiency. Code will be available at https://github.com/tianjiao-j/CCA.
authors: Tianjiao Jiang, Zhen Zhang, Yuhang Liu, Javen Qinfeng Shi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 890-900

title: 因果实体反映的第一视角交通事故视频合成
title_en: Causal-Entity Reflected Egocentric Traffic Accident Video Synthesis
abstract: 第一视角理解汽车事故的原因与结果对自动驾驶汽车的安全至关重要,合成因果实体反映的事故视频可促进应对现实世界中不可预见事故的能力测试。然而,将现实视频中观察到的因果关系融入合成视频仍具挑战性。本文认为,精确识别事故参与者并捕捉其相关行为至关重要。为此,我们提出了一种新型扩散模型Causal-VidSyn,用于合成第一视角交通事故视频。为实现视频扩散中的因果实体定位,Causal-VidSyn利用因果描述和驾驶员注视信息识别事故参与者与行为,通过事故原因回答模块和基于注视条件的选择模块实现。为支持Causal-VidSyn,我们进一步构建了Drive-Gaze,这是最大的驾驶事故场景驾驶员注视数据集(包含154万帧注视数据)。大量实验表明,Causal-VidSyn在事故视频编辑、正常到事故视频扩散和文本到视频生成等任务中,均在帧质量与因果敏感性方面超越了最先进的视频扩散模型。
abstract_en: Egocentricly comprehending the causes and effects of car accidents is crucial for the safety of self-driving cars, and synthesizing causal-entity reflected accident videos can facilitate the capability test to respond to unaffordable accidents in reality. However, incorporating causal relations as seen in real-world videos into synthetic videos remains challenging. This work argues that precisely identifying the accident participants and capturing their related behaviors are of critical importance. In this regard, we propose a novel diffusion model Causal-VidSyn for synthesizing egocentric traffic accident videos. To enable causal entity grounding in video diffusion, Causal-VidSyn leverages the cause descriptions and driver fixations to identify the accident participants and behaviors, facilitated by accident reason answering and gaze-conditioned selection modules. To support Causal-VidSyn, we further construct Drive-Gaze, the largest driver gaze dataset (with 1.54M frames of fixations) in driving accident scenarios. Extensive experiments show that Causal-VidSyn surpasses state-of-the-art video diffusion models in terms of frame quality and causal sensitivity in various tasks, including accident video editing, normal-to-accident video diffusion, and text-to-video generation.
authors: Lei-Lei Li, Jianwu Fang, Junbin Xiao, Shanmin Pang, Hongkai Yu, Chen Lv, Jianru Xue, Tat-Seng Chua ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11208-11218

title: 基于视觉粒化的因果引导提示学习方法用于视觉-语言模型
title_en: Causality-guided Prompt Learning for Vision-language Models via Visual Granulation
abstract: 提示学习近期受到广泛关注,用于将预训练的视觉-语言模型(如CLIP)适配到下游识别任务。然而,现有大多数基于CLIP的提示学习方法在处理细粒度数据集时表现出有限的能力。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种基于视觉粒化的因果引导文本提示学习方法,称为CaPL。该方法通过因果推理构建视觉颗粒集合,使文本提示能够捕捉不同细粒度类别间的细微差异。CaPL方法包含以下两个模块:(1) 提出属性解缠模块,利用布朗桥扩散模型将视觉特征分解为非个体化属性(部分类别共享)和个体化属性(特定于单个类别);(2) 提出颗粒学习模块,通过整合上述属性,在两种因果推理策略下构建视觉颗粒以实现识别。得益于学习到的视觉颗粒,预期能够获得更具判别性的文本提示。在15个数据集上的大量实验结果表明,我们的CaPL方法显著优于最先进的提示学习方法,尤其在细粒度数据集上表现突出。代码已开源:https://github.com/GaoMY-521/CaPL_Code
abstract_en: Prompt learning has recently attracted much attention for adapting pre-trained vision-language models (e.g., CLIP) to downstream recognition tasks. However, most of the existing CLIP-based prompt learning methods only show a limited ability for handling fine-grained datasets. To address this issue, we propose a causality-guided text prompt learning method via visual granulation for CLIP, called CaPL, where the explored visual granulation technique could construct sets of visual granules for the text prompt to capture subtle discrepancies among different fine-grained classes through casual inference. The CaPL method contains the following two modules: (1) An attribute disentanglement module is proposed to decompose visual features into non-individualized attributes (shared by some classes) and individualized attributes (specific to single classes) using a Brownian Bridge Diffusion Model; (2) A granule learning module is proposed to construct visual granules by integrating the aforementioned attributes for recognition under two causal inference strategies. Thanks to the learned visual granules, more discriminative text prompt is expected to be learned. Extensive experimental results on 15 datasets demonstrate that our CaPL method significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art prompt learning methods, especially on fine-grained datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/GaoMY-521/CaPL_Code.
authors: Mengyu Gao, Qiulei Dong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1141-1151

title: 可验证最优的各向异性旋转平均
title_en: Certifiably Optimal Anisotropic Rotation Averaging
abstract: 旋转平均是计算机视觉和机器人学应用中的关键子问题。已有多种方法用于解决该问题,同时也有若干理论结果分析了问题的难度和最优性。然而,这些方法大多聚焦于各向同性设置,其中测量中的固有不确定性未被充分纳入优化任务。近期实证结果表明,转向各向异性框架,其中这些不确定性被显式包含,可以提升解的质量。然而,在这种场景下,旋转平均的全局优化仍是一个挑战。本文展示了如何在可验证最优的旋转平均中引入各向异性成本。我们还证明了现有针对各向同性情况设计的求解器在各向异性设置中失效。最后,我们提出了一种更强的松弛方法,并实证表明该方法能够在所有测试数据集中恢复全局最优解,并在除一个场景外的所有场景中实现更精确的重建。
abstract_en: Rotation averaging is a key subproblem in applications of computer vision and robotics. Many methods for solving this problem exist, and there are also several theoretical results analyzing difficulty and optimality. However, one aspect that most of these have in common is a focus on the isotropic setting, where the intrinsic uncertainties in the measurements are not fully incorporated into the resulting optimization task. Recent empirical results suggest that moving to an anisotropic framework, where these uncertainties are explicitly included, can result in an improvement of solution quality. However, global optimization for rotation averaging has remained a challenge in this scenario.In this paper we show how anisotropic costs can be incorporated in certifiably optimal rotation averaging. We also demonstrate how existing solvers, designed for isotropic situations, fail in the anisotropic setting. Finally, we propose a stronger relaxation and show empirically that it is able to recover global optima in all tested datasets and leads to a more accurate reconstruction in all but one of the scenes.
authors: Carl Olsson, Yaroslava Lochman, Johan Malmport, Christopher Zach ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14856-14865

title: CharaConsist:细粒度一致角色生成
title_en: CharaConsist: Fine-Grained Consistent Character Generation
abstract: 在文本到图像生成领域,生成一系列保持同一身份的一致内容对实际应用场景具有重要价值。尽管已有部分研究探索了无需训练的方法以提升生成主体的一致性,但我们观察到这些方法存在以下问题。首先,它们无法保持背景细节的一致性,限制了其适用性。此外,当前景角色经历大幅度运动变化时,身份和服装细节的不一致性会变得明显。为解决这些问题,我们提出CharaConsist,该方法结合了点跟踪注意力和自适应标记合并,并采用前景与背景的解耦控制。CharaConsist实现了前景与背景的细粒度一致性,支持在固定场景中连续镜头或跨不同场景的离散镜头中生成单个角色。此外,CharaConsist是首个针对文本到图像DiT模型(Diffusion Transformer)设计的一致生成方法。其保持细粒度一致性的能力,结合最新基础模型更大的容量,使其能够生成高质量的视觉输出,拓展了其在更广泛实际场景中的适用性。
abstract_en: In text-to-image generation, producing a series of consistent contents that preserve the same identity is highly valuable for real-world applications. Although a few works have explored training-free methods to enhance the consistency of generated subjects, we observe that they suffer from the following problems.First, they fail to maintain consistent background details, which limits their applicability. Furthermore, when the foreground character undergoes large motion variations, inconsistencies in identity and clothing details become evident. To address these problems, we propose CharaConsist, which employs point-tracking attention and adaptive token merge along with decoupled control of the foreground and background.CharaConsist enables fine-grained consistency for both foreground and background, supporting the generation of one character in continuous shots within a fixed scene or in discrete shots across different scenes.Moreover, CharaConsist is the first consistent generation method tailored for text-to-image DiT model. Its ability to maintain fine-grained consistency, combined with the larger capacity of latest base model, enables it to produce high-quality visual outputs, broadening its applicability to a wider range of real-world scenarios.
authors: Mengyu Wang, Henghui Ding, Jianing Peng, Yao Zhao, Yunpeng Chen, Yunchao Wei ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16058-16067

title: ChartCap:缓解密集图表描述中的幻觉
title_en: ChartCap: Mitigating Hallucination of Dense Chart Captioning
abstract: 生成准确、信息丰富且无幻觉的图表描述对于视觉语言模型仍具挑战性,主要由于缺乏大规模高质量的真实图表数据集。然而,现有真实图表数据集存在包含无法从图表推断的冗余信息以及未能充分捕捉结构元素和关键见解的问题。因此,我们引入ChartCap,一个包含56.5万张真实图表图像的大规模数据集,每张图像均配以类型特定的密集描述,排除冗余信息并详细突出结构元素和关键见解。为构建ChartCap,我们设计了四阶段流程,仅利用图表中可辨识数据生成描述,并采用基于循环一致性的人员验证,加速质量控制而不牺牲准确性。此外,我们提出新型指标——视觉一致性得分,通过测量由描述生成的图表与原图表的相似性评估描述质量,独立于参考描述。大量实验表明,基于ChartCap微调的模型持续生成更准确、信息更丰富的描述,幻觉减少,超越开源和专有模型,甚至超过人工标注的描述。
abstract_en: Generating accurate, informative, and hallucination-free captions for charts remains challenging for vision language models, primarily due to the lack of large-scale, high-quality datasets of real-world charts. However, existing real-world chart datasets suffer from the inclusion of extraneous information that cannot be inferred from the chart and failure to sufficiently capture structural elements and key insights. Therefore, we introduce ChartCap, a large-scale dataset of 565K real-world chart images paired with type-specific, dense captions that exclude extraneous information and highlight both structural elements and key insights in detail. To build ChartCap, we design a four-stage pipeline that generates captions using only the discernible data from the chart and employ a cycle consistency-based human verification, which accelerates quality control without sacrificing accuracy. Additionally, we propose a novel metric, the Visual Consistency Score, which evaluates caption quality by measuring the similarity between the chart regenerated from a caption and the original chart, independent of reference captions. Extensive experiments confirms that models fine-tuned on ChartCap consistently generate more accurate and informative captions with reduced hallucinations, surpassing both open-source and proprietary models and even human-annotated captions.
authors: Junyoung Lim, Jaewoo Ahn, Gunhee Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13171-13182

title: ChartPoint:基于定位反思引导多模态大语言模型进行图表推理
title_en: ChartPoint: Guiding MLLMs with Grounding Reflection for Chart Reasoning
abstract: 多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)已成为图表理解的强大工具。然而,它们严重依赖光学字符识别(OCR)提取的内容,当图表文本注释稀疏时会导致数值幻觉。尽管现有方法侧重于扩展指令,但未能解决根本性挑战,即基于视觉感知的推理。本文识别出一个关键观察:MLLMs在图表元素和比例关系的定位 grounding 上表现薄弱,这体现在其无法将关键位置定位与推理过程匹配。为弥合这一差距,我们提出PointCoT,将反思交互集成到图表的思维链推理中。通过提示MLLMs生成边界框并基于位置注释重新渲染图表,我们建立了文本推理步骤与视觉 grounding 区域之间的联系。我们进一步引入自动化流程构建ChartPoint-SFT-62k数据集,该数据集包含19.2K高质量图表样本,包含逐步思维链(CoT)、边界框和重新渲染的可视化结果。利用该数据,我们开发了两个指令微调模型ChartPoint_Q2和ChartPoint_Q2.5,在多个图表基准测试中超越了现有最先进方法,例如在ChartBench上提升+5.04%。
abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for chart comprehension. However, they heavily rely on extracted content via OCR, which leads to numerical hallucinations when chart textual annotations are sparse. While existing methods focus on scaling instructions, they fail to address the fundamental challenge, i.e., reasoning with visual perception. In this paper, we identify a critical observation: MLLMs exhibit weak grounding in chart elements and proportional relationships, as evidenced by their inability to localize key positions to match their reasoning. To bridge this gap, we propose PointCoT, which integrates reflective interaction into chain-of-thought reasoning in charts. By prompting MLLMs to generate bounding boxes and re-render charts based on location annotations, we establish connections between textual reasoning steps and visual grounding regions. We further introduce an automated pipeline to construct ChartPoint-SFT-62k, a dataset featuring 19.2K high-quality chart samples with step-by-step CoT, bounding box, and re-rendered visualizations. Leveraging this data, we develop two instruction-tuned models, ChartPoint_Q2 and ChartPoint_Q2.5, which outperform state-of-the-art across several chart benchmarks, e.g., +5.04% on ChartBench.
authors: Zhengzhuo Xu, SiNan Du, Yiyan Qi, Siwen Lu, Chengjin Xu, Chun Yuan, Jian Guo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 426-436

title: ChatReID: 基于分层渐进式调优的视觉-语言模型开放交互式人员检索
title_en: ChatReID: Open-ended Interactive Person Retrieval via Hierarchical Progressive Tuning for Vision Language Models
abstract: 人员重识别(Re-ID)是计算机视觉中的关键任务,旨在跨非重叠摄像头视角识别个体。尽管近期先进的视觉-语言模型(VLMs)在逻辑推理和多任务泛化方面表现出色,其在Re-ID任务中的应用仍有限。它们要么难以基于身份相关特征进行准确匹配,要么仅作为图像主导分支的辅助语义。本文提出了一种新型框架ChatReID,转向以文本为主的检索范式,实现灵活的交互式重识别。为将语言模型的推理能力整合到Re-ID流程中,我们首先构建了一个大规模指令数据集,包含超过800万条提示以促进模型微调。随后,我们引入了分层渐进式调优策略,通过三个阶段的调优赋予Re-ID能力,即从人员属性理解到细粒度图像检索,再到多模态任务推理。在十个流行基准上的广泛实验表明,ChatReID优于现有方法,在所有Re-ID任务中均达到最先进性能。更多实验表明,ChatReID不仅具备识别细粒度细节的能力,还能将其整合到连贯的推理过程中。
abstract_en: Person re-identification (Re-ID) is a crucial task in computer vision, aiming to recognize individuals across non-overlapping camera views. While recent advanced vision-language models (VLMs) excel in logical reasoning and multi-task generalization, their applications in Re-ID tasks remain limited. They either struggle to perform accurate matching based on identity-relevant features or assist image-dominated branches as auxiliary semantics. In this paper, we propose a novel framework ChatReID, that shifts the focus towards a text-side-dominated retrieval paradigm, enabling flexible and interactive re-identification. To integrate the reasoning abilities of language models into Re-ID pipelines, We first present a large-scale instruction dataset, which contains more than 8 million prompts to promote the model fine-tuning. Next. we introduce a hierarchical progressive tuning strategy, which endows Re-ID ability through three stages of tuning, i.e., from person attribute understanding to fine-grained image retrieval and to multi-modal task reasoning.Extensive experiments across ten popular benchmarks demonstrate that ChatReID outperforms existing methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance in all Re-ID tasks. More experiments demonstrate that ChatReID not only has the ability to recognize fine-grained details but also to integrate them into a coherent reasoning process.
authors: Ke Niu, Haiyang Yu, Mengyang Zhao, Teng Fu, Siyang Yi, Wei Lu, Bin Li, Xuelin Qian, Xiangyang Xue ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24245-24254

title: 奇美拉:通过领域特定专家提升通用模型
title_en: Chimera: Improving Generalist Model with Domain-Specific Experts
abstract: 在主要由自然图像组成的网络规模数据集上训练的大型多模态模型(LMMs)在通用任务上表现出色。然而,这些模型在需要大量领域先验知识的领域特定任务中往往表现出有限的专用能力。直观的解决方案是对LMMs在特定领域进行微调,但通常面临耗时的标注过程和私有训练数据不可用的问题。直接集成针对这些任务定制的专家模型也因表征差距和不平衡优化而具有挑战性。为了解决这些挑战,我们引入了奇美拉,这是一种可扩展且低成本的多模态流程,旨在通过领域特定专家提升现有LMMs的能力。具体而言,我们设计了一种渐进式训练策略,将专家模型的特征集成到通用LMM的输入中。为了解决由对齐良好的通用视觉编码器引起的不平衡优化问题,我们引入了一种新颖的通用-专家协作掩码(GSCM)机制。这使得模型在图表、表格、数学和文档等领域表现出色,在多模态推理和视觉内容提取任务中均达到最先进性能,这两项任务都是评估现有LMMs的挑战性任务。我们将发布模型权重以及用于训练和评估的数据,以促进未来对LMMs的研究。
abstract_en: Large Multi-modal Models (LMMs), trained on web-scale datasets predominantly composed of natural images, have demonstrated remarkable performance on general tasks. However, these models often exhibit limited specialized capabilities for domain-specific tasks that require extensive domain prior knowledge. An intuitive solution is to post-train LMMs on a specific domain, but often suffers from the labor-intensive annotating process and the inaccessibility of private training data. Directly integrating expert models tailored for those tasks is also challenging due to representational gaps and imbalanced optimization. To address these challenges, we introduce Chimera, a scalable and low-cost multi-modal pipeline designed to boost the ability of existing LMMs with domain-specific experts. Specifically, we design a progressive training strategy to integrate features from expert models into the input of a generalist LMM. To address the imbalanced optimization caused by the well-aligned general visual encoder, we introduce a novel Generalist-Specialist Collaboration Masking (GSCM) mechanism. This results in a versatile model that excels across the chart, table, math, and document domains, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multi-modal reasoning and visual content extraction tasks, both of which are challenging tasks for assessing existing LMMs. We will release model weights, along with the data used for training and evaluation, to facilitate future research on LMMs.
authors: Tianshuo Peng, Mingsheng Li, Jiakang Yuan, Hongbin Zhou, Renqiu Xia, Renrui Zhang, Lei Bai, Song Mao, Bin Wang, Aojun Zhou, Botian Shi, Tao Chen, Bo Zhang, Xiangyu Yue ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3011-3022

title: CityGS-X: 一种高效且几何精度高的大规模场景重建可扩展架构
title_en: CityGS-X: A Scalable Architecture for Efficient and Geometrically Accurate Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction
abstract: 尽管在大规模场景重建领域取得了显著成就,三维高斯点云仍面临处理速度慢、计算成本高和几何精度有限等核心挑战。这些问题源于其固有的非结构化设计及缺乏高效的并行化机制。为同时解决这些挑战,我们提出CityGS-X,一种基于新型并行化混合层次3D表示(PH2-3D)的可扩展架构。作为早期尝试,CityGS-X摒弃了繁琐的合并-分割流程,转而采用新设计的批级多任务渲染流程。该架构通过动态细节层次体素分配实现多GPU高效渲染,显著提升了可扩展性与性能。通过大量实验验证,CityGS-X在训练速度、渲染容量及大规模场景几何细节精度方面均优于现有方法。为进一步提升整体质量与几何精度,CityGS-X提出渐进式RGB-深度-法线训练策略。该方法通过批级训练中的多视角约束及现成深度先验,联合优化外观与几何表示,增强3D一致性。值得注意的是,CityGS-X仅需四张4090 GPU即可在五小时内完成超过5000张图像的场景训练与渲染,而其他方法则会因内存溢出而完全失败。这表明CityGS-X的性能远超现有方法。
abstract_en: Despite its significant achievements in large-scale scene reconstruction, 3D Gaussian Splatting still faces substantial challenges, including slow processing, high computational costs, and limited geometric accuracy. These core issues arise from its inherently unstructured design and the absence of efficient parallelization. To overcome these challenges simultaneously, we introduce CityGS-X, a scalable architecture built on a novel parallelized hybrid hierarchical 3D representation (PH2-3D). As an early attempt, CityGS-X abandons the cumbersome merge-and-partition process and instead adopts a newly designed batch-level multi-task rendering process. This architecture enables efficient multi-GPU rendering through dynamic Level-of-Detail voxel allocations, significantly improving scalability and performance. Through extensive experiments, CityGS-X consistently outperforms existing methods in terms of faster training times, larger rendering capacities, and more accurate geometric details in large-scale scenes. To further enhance both overall quality and geometric accuracy, CityGS-X presents a progressive RGB-Depth-Normal training strategy. This approach enhances 3D consistency by jointly optimizing appearance and geometry representation through multi-view constraints and off-the-shelf depth priors within batch-level training. Notably, CityGS-X can train and render a scene with more than 5000 images in just five hours using only four 4090 GPUs, a task that would make other alternative methods encounter out-of-memory issues and fail completely. This implies that CityGS-X is far beyond the capacity of other existing methods.
authors: Yuanyuan Gao, Hao Li, Jiaqi Chen, Zhengyu Zou, Zhihang Zhong, Dingwen Zhang, Xiao Sun, Junwei Han ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27187-27196

title: CityNav:面向现实世界空中导航的大规模数据集
title_en: CityNav: A Large-Scale Dataset for Real-World Aerial Navigation
abstract: 视觉-语言导航(VLN)旨在开发能够在真实环境中导航的智能体。尽管近期跨模态训练方法在室内外场景中显著提升了导航性能,但现实城市中的空中导航仍鲜有研究,主要受限于数据集不足以及视觉与地理信息融合的难度。为填补这一空白,我们引入了CityNav,这是首个面向现实世界空中VLN的大规模数据集。我们的数据集包含32,637条人类示范轨迹,每条轨迹均配有自然语言描述,覆盖剑桥和伯明翰两个真实城市共计4.65 km2的区域。与由合成场景构成的现有数据集(如AerialVLN)不同,我们的数据集提出了独特挑战:智能体必须理解现实地标与导航目标之间的空间关系,使CityNav成为推进空中VLN研究的关键基准。此外,作为应对这一挑战的初步步骤,我们提供了一种创建地理语义地图的方法,该地图可作为导航过程中的辅助模态输入。在实验中,我们比较了三种代表性空中VLN智能体(Seq2seq、CMA和AerialVLN模型)的性能,并证明语义地图表示显著提升了其导航效果。
abstract_en: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) aims to develop agents capable of navigating in realistic environments. While recent cross-modal training approaches have significantly improved navigation performance in both indoor and outdoor scenarios, aerial navigation over real-world cities remains underexplored primarily due to limited datasets and the difficulty of integrating visual and geographic information. To fill this gap, we introduce CityNav, the first large-scale real-world dataset for aerial VLN. Our dataset consists of 32,637 human demonstration trajectories, each paired with a natural language description, covering 4.65 km2 across two real cities: Cambridge and Birmingham. In contrast to existing datasets composed of synthetic scenes such as AerialVLN, our dataset presents a unique challenge because agents must interpret spatial relationships between real-world landmarks and the navigation destination, making CityNav an essential benchmark for advancing aerial VLN. Furthermore, as an initial step toward addressing this challenge, we provide a methodology of creating geographic semantic maps that can be used as an auxiliary modality input during navigation. In our experiments, we compare performance of three representative aerial VLN agents (Seq2seq, CMA and AerialVLN models) and demonstrate that the semantic map representation significantly improves their navigation performance.
authors: Jungdae Lee, Taiki Miyanishi, Shuhei Kurita, Koya Sakamoto, Daichi Azuma, Yutaka Matsuo, Nakamasa Inoue ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5912-5922

title: ClaraVid: 从空视角的全面场景重建基准测试集与基于差熵的复杂度分析
title_en: ClaraVid: A Holistic Scene Reconstruction Benchmark From Aerial Perspective With Delentropy-Based Complexity Profiling
abstract: 空中全面场景理解算法的发展受限于缺乏能够实现语义与几何重建的综合性数据集。尽管合成数据集提供了替代方案,但现有选项存在任务特定局限性、不真实的场景构成以及渲染伪影等问题,影响实际应用效果。我们提出ClaraVid,一个专门设计用于克服这些局限性的合成空数据集。该数据集包含16,917张高分辨率图像,分辨率达4032x3024,涵盖多种地形的多视角拍摄,提供密集深度图、全景分割、稀疏点云和动态物体掩码,同时减少常见渲染伪影。为进一步推进神经重建技术,我们引入差熵场景剖面(DSP),一种基于微分熵分析的新颖复杂度度量指标,用于定量评估场景难度并指导重建任务。通过DSP,我们系统性地对神经重建方法进行基准测试,发现场景复杂度与重建精度之间存在一致且可测量的关联性。实验证明,更高的差熵与更大的重建误差显著相关,验证了DSP作为可靠复杂度先验的有效性。数据和代码可在项目页面获取:https://rdbch.github.com/claravid
abstract_en: The development of aerial holistic scene understanding algorithms is hindered by the scarcity of comprehensive datasets that enable both semantic and geometric reconstruction. While synthetic datasets offer an alternative, existing options exhibit task-specific limitations, unrealistic scene compositions, and rendering artifacts that compromise real-world applicability. We introduce ClaraVid, a synthetic aerial dataset specifically designed to overcome these limitations. Comprising 16,917 high-resolution images captured at 4032x3024 from multiple viewpoints across diverse landscapes, ClaraVid provides dense depth maps, panoptic segmentation, sparse point clouds, and dynamic object masks, while mitigating common rendering artifacts. To further advance neural reconstruction, we introduce the Delentropic Scene Profile (DSP), a novel complexity metric derived from differential entropy analysis, designed to quantitatively assess scene difficulty and inform reconstruction tasks. Utilizing DSP, we systematically benchmark neural reconstruction methods, uncovering a consistent, measurable correlation between scene complexity and reconstruction accuracy. Empirical results indicate that higher delentropy strongly correlates with increased reconstruction errors, validating DSP as a reliable complexity prior. The data and code are available on the project page: https://rdbch.github.com/claravid.
authors: Radu Beche, Sergiu Nedevschi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26015-26025

title: 类别标记作为代理:基于最优传输的代理学习用于弱监督语义分割
title_en: Class Token as Proxy: Optimal Transport-assisted Proxy Learning for Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation
abstract: 弱监督语义分割(WSSS)利用类别激活图(CAMs)从图像级标签中提取空间线索。然而,CAMs仅突出显示最具判别性的前景区域,导致结果不完整。近期基于视觉Transformer的方法通过类-块注意力机制增强CAMs,但仍然因标记差距问题存在部分激活现象:分类聚焦的类标记优先关注判别性特征,而块标记则捕捉判别性与非判别性特征。这种不匹配阻碍了类标记激活所有相关特征,尤其当判别性与非判别性区域差异显著时。为解决此问题,我们提出基于最优传输的代理学习(OTPL),一种通过学习自适应代理桥接标记差距的新框架。OTPL引入两项关键策略:(1) 基于最优传输的代理学习,将类标记与其最相关块标记结合生成全面的CAMs;(2) 基于最优传输增强的对比学习,通过与置信块标记对齐实现有限代理探索。我们的框架克服了类标记激活块标记的局限性,提供更完整准确的CAM结果。在WSSS基准(PASCAL VOC和MS COCO)上的实验表明,我们的方法显著提升了CAM质量并达到最先进性能。
abstract_en: Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation (WSSS) utilizes Class Activation Maps (CAMs) to extract spatial cues from image-level labels. However, CAMs highlight only the most discriminative foreground regions, leading to incomplete results. Recent Vision Transformer-based methods leverage class-patch attention to enhance CAMs, yet they still suffer from partial activation due to the token gap: classification-focused class tokens prioritize discriminative features, while patch tokens capture both discriminative and non-discriminative characteristics. This mismatch prevents class tokens from activating all relevant features, especially when discriminative and non-discriminative regions exhibit significant differences. To address this issue, we propose Optimal Transport-assisted Proxy Learning (OTPL), a novel framework that bridges the token gap by learning adaptive proxies. OTPL introduces two key strategies: (1) optimal transport-assisted proxy learning, which combines class tokens with their most relevant patch tokens to produce comprehensive CAMs, and (2) optimal transport-enhanced contrastive learning, aligning proxies with confident patch tokens for bounded proxy exploration. Our framework overcomes the limitation of class tokens in activating patch tokens, providing more complete and accurate CAM results. Experiments on WSSS benchmarks (PASCAL VOC and MS COCO) demonstrate that our method significantly improves the CAM quality and achieves state-of-the-art performances.
authors: Jian Wang, Tianhong Dai, Bingfeng Zhang, Siyue Yu, Eng Gee Lim, Jimin Xiao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21645-21654

title: 面向高效个性化的按类别联邦平均
title_en: Class-Wise Federated Averaging for Efficient Personalization
abstract: 联邦学习(FL)能够在不集中数据的情况下,使分布式客户端协同进行模型训练。然而,现有的方法如联邦平均(FedAvg)在处理异构数据分布时表现不佳,无法有效捕捉类别特定信息,导致无法实现个性化。我们提出了一种名为按类别联邦平均(cwFedAvg)的新颖个性化联邦学习(PFL)框架,通过为每个类别执行联邦平均,以克服FedAvg在个性化方面的局限性。cwFedAvg通过利用类别分布对本地模型进行加权聚合,创建类别特定的全局模型,并随后结合这些模型以生成个性化的本地模型。我们进一步提出权重分布正则化器(WDR),通过对齐由输出层权重导出的经验性和近似类别分布,鼓励深度网络高效编码类别特定信息,以促进有效的类别级聚合。我们的实验表明,cwFedAvg在保持FedAvg的通信成本并避免额外的本地训练和成对计算的同时,通过高效的个性化,在现有PFL方法中表现出优越的性能。
abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without centralizing data. However, existing approaches like Federated Averaging (FedAvg) often perform poorly with heterogeneous data distributions, failing to achieve personalization owing to their inability to capture class-specific information effectively. We propose Class-wise Federated Averaging (cwFedAvg), a novel personalized FL (PFL) framework that performs Federated Averaging for each class, to overcome the personalization limitations of FedAvg. cwFedAvg creates class-specific global models via weighted aggregation of local models using class distributions, and subsequently combines them to generate personalized local models. We further propose Weight Distribution Regularizer (WDR), which encourages deep networks to encode class-specific information efficiently by aligning empirical and approximated class distributions derived from output layer weights, to facilitate effective class-wise aggregation. Our experiments demonstrate the superior performance of cwFedAvg over existing PFL methods through efficient personalization while maintaining the communication cost of FedAvg and avoiding additional local training and pairwise computations.
authors: Gyuejeong Lee, Daeyoung Choi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1773-1782

title: CleanPose:通过因果学习与知识蒸馏实现类别级物体姿态估计
title_en: CleanPose: Category-Level Object Pose Estimation via Causal Learning and Knowledge Distillation
abstract: 为实现鲁棒且可泛化的类别级物体姿态估计,近期方法主要聚焦于从数据中学习基础表示。然而,数据中的固有偏差常被忽视:重复训练样本和相似环境可能导致模型过度依赖特定模式,从而阻碍其在新实例上的表现。本文提出CleanPose,一种通过整合因果学习与知识蒸馏来缓解数据偏差、提升类别级姿态估计的新方法。通过将关键因果变量(结构信息和隐藏混杂因素)纳入因果建模,我们提出基于前门调整的因果推理模块,通过降低潜在虚假相关性以实现无偏估计。此外,为在特征层面进一步应对数据偏差,我们设计了基于残差的知识蒸馏方法,从3D基础模型迁移无偏语义知识,提供全面的因果监督。在多个基准测试(REAL275、CAMERA25和HouseCat6D)上的大量实验验证了所提CleanPose方法优于现有最先进方法。代码将开源于https://github.com/chrislin0621/CleanPose。
abstract_en: In the effort to achieve robust and generalizable category-level object pose estimation, recent methods primarily focus on learning fundamental representations from data. However, the inherent biases within the data are often overlooked: the repeated training samples and similar environments may mislead the models to over-rely on specific patterns, hindering models' performance on novel instances. In this paper, we present CleanPose, a novel method that mitigates the data biases to enhance category-level pose estimation by integrating causal learning and knowledge distillation. By incorporating key causal variables (structural information and hidden confounders) into causal modeling, we propose the causal inference module based on front-door adjustment, which promotes unbiased estimation by reducing potential spurious correlations. Additionally, to further confront the data bias at the feature level, we devise a residual-based knowledge distillation approach to transfer unbiased semantic knowledge from 3D foundation model, providing comprehensive causal supervision. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks (REAL275, CAMERA25 and HouseCat6D) hightlight the superiority of proposed CleanPose over state-of-the-art methods. Code will be available at https://github.com/chrislin0621/CleanPose.
authors: Xiao Lin, Yun Peng, Liuyi Wang, Xianyou Zhong, Minghao Zhu, Yi Feng, Jingwei Yang, Chengju Liu, Qijun Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5990-6000

title: ClearSight:受人类视觉启发的基于事件的运动去模糊解决方案
title_en: ClearSight: Human Vision-Inspired Solutions for Event-Based Motion Deblurring
abstract: 运动去模糊旨在解决由相机或场景运动引起的图像模糊问题。事件相机提供以异步事件流编码的运动信息。为高效利用事件流的时间信息,我们采用脉冲神经网络(SNNs)进行运动特征提取,采用人工神经网络(ANNs)进行色彩信息处理。由于事件数据的非均匀分布和固有冗余性,现有跨模态特征融合方法存在一定局限。受人类视觉系统中视觉注意机制启发,本研究引入了生物启发的双驱动混合网络(BDHNet)。具体而言,神经配置模块(NCM)设计为根据跨模态特征动态调整神经元配置,从而在模糊区域聚焦脉冲并动态适应不同模糊场景。此外,引入模糊区域注意力模块(RBAM)以无监督方式生成模糊掩码,有效从事件特征中提取运动线索并引导更精确的跨模态特征融合。大量主观和客观评估表明,我们的方法在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上均优于当前最先进方法。
abstract_en: Motion deblurring addresses the challenge of image blur caused by camera or scene movement. Event cameras provide motion information that is encoded in the asynchronous event streams. To efficiently leverage the temporal information of event streams, we employ Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) for motion feature extraction and Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) for color information processing. Due to the non-uniform distribution and inherent redundancy of event data, existing cross-modal feature fusion methods exhibit certain limitations. Inspired by the visual attention mechanism in the human visual system, this study introduces a bioinspired dual-drive hybrid network (BDHNet). Specifically, the Neuron Configurator Module (NCM) is designed to dynamically adjust neuron configurations based on cross-modal features, thereby focusing the spikes in blurry regions and adapting to varying blurry scenarios dynamically. Additionally, the Region of Blurry Attention Module (RBAM) is introduced to generate a blurry mask in an unsupervised manner, effectively extracting motion clues from the event features and guiding more accurate cross-modal feature fusion. Extensive subjective and objective evaluations demonstrate that our method outperforms current state-of-the-art methods on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
authors: Xiaopeng Lin, Yulong Huang, Hongwei Ren, Zunchang Liu, Hongxiang Huang, Yue Zhou, Haotian Fu, Bojun Cheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7462-7471

title: Client2Vec: 通过分布偏移感知的客户端索引改进联邦学习
title_en: Client2Vec: Improving Federated Learning by Distribution Shifts Aware Client Indexing
abstract: 联邦学习(FL)是一种隐私保护的分布式机器学习范式。然而,客户端之间的显著分布偏移对当前联邦学习算法的性能构成了重大挑战。为缓解这一挑战,已提出多种方法以增强联邦学习的训练过程。本文旨在从另一个角度解决数据异质性问题——通过在实际训练阶段之前改进联邦学习算法。具体而言,我们引入了Client2Vec机制,该机制在联邦学习训练开始前为每个客户端生成一个包含其分布偏移信息的独特客户端索引。随后,我们利用生成的客户端索引来增强后续的联邦学习训练过程。为验证所提出的Client2Vec方法的有效性,我们进行了三个案例研究,以评估客户端索引对联邦学习训练过程的影响。这些案例研究涵盖了增强的客户端采样、模型聚合和本地训练。在多种数据集和模型架构上进行的广泛实验表明,Client2Vec在所有三个案例研究中均有效。我们的代码可在https://github.com/LINs-lab/client2vec获取。
abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) is a privacy-preserving distributed machine learning paradigm. Nonetheless, the substantial distribution shifts among clients pose a considerable challenge to the performance of current FL algorithms. To mitigate this challenge, various methods have been proposed to enhance the FL training process. This paper endeavors to tackle the issue of data heterogeneity from another perspective---by improving FL algorithms prior to the actual training stage. Specifically, we introduce the Client2Vec mechanism, which generates a unique client index that contains clients' distribution shifts information for each client before the commencement of FL training. Subsequently, we leverage the generated client index to enhance the subsequent FL training process. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed Client2Vec method, we conduct three case studies that assess the impact of the client index on the FL training process. These case studies encompass enhanced client sampling, model aggregation, and local training. Extensive experiments conducted on diverse datasets and model architectures show the efficacy of Client2Vec across all three case studies. Our code is available at https://github.com/LINs-lab/client2vec.
authors: Yongxin Guo, Lin Wang, Xiaoying Tang, Tao Lin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1433-1443

title: 叮!剁!咚!——从现实世界交互中学习物体声音
title_en: Clink! Chop! Thud! - Learning Object Sounds from Real-World Interactions
abstract: 模型能否区分勺子敲击硬木地板与地毯时的声音?日常物体间的交互会产生与物体相关的独特声音。我们引入了发声物体检测任务,以评估模型将这些声音与直接相关的物体进行关联的能力。受人类感知启发,我们的多模态物体感知框架从野外第一视角视频中学习。为鼓励以物体为中心的方法,我们首先开发了一个自动流程,计算涉及物体的分割掩码,以在训练过程中引导模型关注交互中最具信息量的区域。我们使用槽注意力视觉编码器进一步强化物体先验。我们在新任务及现有多模态动作理解任务上展示了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Can a model distinguish between the sound of a spoon hitting a hardwood floor versus a carpeted one? Everyday object interactions produce sounds unique to the objects involved. We introduce the sounding object detection task to evaluate a model's ability to link these sounds to the objects directly involved. Inspired by human perception, our multimodal object-aware framework learns from in-the-wild egocentric videos.
