abstract: 尽管LiDAR(光探测和测距)作为隐私保护的RGB摄像头替代方案在感知人体活动方面表现出有效性,但在多模态对比预训练框架下,其在人体活动理解任务(如人体活动识别(HAR)、检索或人员重识别(RE-ID))中的研究仍显不足。为弥补这一差距,我们的工作探索了在联合嵌入空间中学习LiDAR点云、人体骨架姿态、IMU数据和文本之间的对应关系。具体而言,我们提出了DeSPITE,一个__TITLE_MATH_1__深度骨架-点云-IMU-文本嵌入模型,该模型有效学习了这四种模态的联合嵌入空间。在实证探索的核心,我们结合了现有的LIPD和Babel数据集,使我们能够同步四种模态的数据,从而探索新的联合嵌入空间的学习。实验表明,通过DeSPITE,实现了针对点云序列的新型人体活动理解任务,包括骨架↔点云↔IMU匹配、检索及时间点检索。此外,我们通过在MSR-Action3D和HMPEAR数据集上的实验表明,DeSPITE是点云HAR的有效预训练策略。代码和模型已公开在https://github.com/thkreutz/despite。
abstract_en: Despite LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) being an effective privacy-preserving alternative to RGB cameras to perceive human activities, it remains largely underexplored in the context of multi-modal contrastive pre-training for human activity understanding tasks, such as human activity recognition (HAR), retrieval, or person re-identification (RE-ID). To close this gap, our work explores learning the correspondence between LiDAR point clouds, human skeleton poses, IMU data, and text in a joint embedding space. More specifically, we present DeSPITE, a \underline De ep \underline S keleton-\underline P ointcloud-\underline I MU-\underline T ext \underline E mbedding model, which effectively learns a joint embedding space across these four modalities. At the heart of our empirical exploration, we have combined the existing LIPD and Babel datasets, which enabled us to synchronize data of all four modalities, allowing us to explore the learning of a new joint embedding space. Our experiments demonstrate novel human activity understanding tasks for point cloud sequences enabled through DeSPITE, including Skeleton\leftrightarrowPointcloud\leftrightarrowIMU matching, retrieval, and temporal moment retrieval. Furthermore, we show that DeSPITE is an effective pre-training strategy for point cloud HAR through experiments in MSR-Action3D and HMPEAR. Code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/thkreutz/despite.
authors: Thomas Kreutz, Max Mühlhäuser, Alejandro Sanchez Guinea ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14633-14643

title: 用于胸部X光分类安全迁移学习的无偏课程适应
title_en: Debiased Curriculum Adaptation for Safe Transfer Learning in Chest X-ray Classification
abstract: 胸部X光分类在医学图像分析领域被广泛使用。然而,手动标注胸部X光图像耗时且成本高昂。领域适应方法旨在通过相关领域迁移知识,可提供有前景的解决方案。现有方法采用特征适应或自训练进行知识迁移。然而,由于类别不平衡和分布偏移的交织,观察到负迁移现象。本文提出去偏课程适应框架,从两个方面缓解负迁移:(1) 课程适应,旨在以由易到难的方式迁移知识,以减轻自训练中的确认偏倚;(2) 引入谱去偏技术,以协调源域与目标域的特征空间,并平衡正负样本的特征空间。在72个迁移任务(包括6种疾病和4个领域)上的大量实验验证了我们方法的优越性。与先进方法相比,我们的方法有效缓解了负迁移,确保安全的知识迁移。
abstract_en: Chest X-ray classification is extensively utilized within the field of medical image analysis. However, manually labeling chest X-ray images is time-consuming and costly. Domain adaptation, which is designed to transfer knowledge from related domains, could offer a promising solution. Existing methods employ feature adaptation or self-training for knowledge transfer. Nonetheless, negative transfer is observed due to the entanglement of class imbalance and distribution shift in chest X-ray classification. In this paper, we propose Debiased Curriculum Adaptation framework to mitigate negative transfer in two aspects: (1) Curriculum Adaptation, which is designed to transfer knowledge in an easy-to-hard way, is proposed to alleviate confirmation bias in self-training. (2) Spectral Debiasing is introduced to harmonize the feature space between the source and target domains, as well as balance the feature space of positive and negative samples. Extensive experiments on 72 transfer tasks (including 6 diseases and 4 domains) demonstrate our superiority over state-of-the-art methods. In comparison to advanced methods, our approach effectively mitigates negative transfer, ensuring safe knowledge transfer.
authors: Mingyang Liu, Xinyang Chen, Yang Shu, Xiucheng Li, Weili Guan, Liqiang Nie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22610-22619

title: 日到夜领域自适应目标检测的去偏教师
title_en: Debiased Teacher for Day-to-Night Domain Adaptive Object Detection
abstract: 日到夜领域自适应目标检测(DN-DAOD)由于夜间低能见度和信噪比问题,是一个具有重大挑战性的任务。尽管近期自训练方法取得了有希望的成果,但未能解决三个关键偏差:分布偏差、训练偏差和确认偏差。因此,我们提出了一种去偏教师,从领域转换、表示补偿和伪标签校准三个方面解决上述偏差。具体而言,日到夜领域转换模块(DNDT)利用物理先验建模关键的日夜间领域差异,从而将白天图像转换为夜景图像。随后,跨领域表示补偿模块(CDRC)选择性混合夜间和夜景图像中的物体,以补偿模型对夜间物体的泛化表示。进一步地,为纠正由不准确伪标签学习导致的确认偏差,设计了伪标签确认校准模块(ConCal)以获取更准确的伪标签,从而提升夜间知识学习效果。在三个基准数据集上的实验结果表明,我们的方法显著优于当前最先进方法。
abstract_en: Day-to-Night Domain Adaptive Object Detection (DN-DAOD) is a significant challenge due to the low visibility and signal-to-noise ratio at night. Although recent self-training approaches achieve promising results, they fail to address three critical biases: distribution bias, training bias, and confirmation bias. Therefore, we propose a Debiased Teacher to address the above biases from three aspects: domain transforming, representation compensating, and pseudo label calibrating. Concretely, the day-to-night domain transforming module (DNDT) leverages physical priors to model some key day-night domain differences, thus transforming daytime images into night-like images. Then, the cross-domain representation compensating module (CDRC) selectively mixes objects from nighttime and night-like images to compensate for the model's general representation of nighttime objects. Further, to correct confirmation bias caused by learning from inaccurate pseudo labels, the pseudo label confirmation calibrating module (ConCal) is designed to obtain accurate pseudo labels for better nighttime knowledge learning. Experimental results on three benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms current SOTA methods by a large margin.
authors: Yiming Cui, Liang Li, Haibing Yin, Yuhan Gao, Yaoqi Sun, Chenggang Yan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2577-2587

title: 去偏迹引导:面向无监督多类别异常检测的自上而下迹蒸馏与自下而上速度对齐
title_en: Debiasing Trace Guidance: Top-down Trace Distillation and Bottom-up Velocity Alignment for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
abstract: 输入条件中异常信息的泄露对基于重建的异常检测方法构成了重大挑战。近期基于扩散的方法通过抑制异常信息进行条件注入或采样逆过程来应对这一问题。然而,由于它们将条件视为时间不变的先验,导致在异常抑制与正常模式一致性之间陷入权衡困境。为解决该问题,我们提出基于流匹配的去偏迹引导(DTG)框架,以实现更精确的无监督多类别异常检测。总体而言,DTG通过自上而下迹蒸馏提取对异常鲁棒的低维生成子迹,随后利用其时变速度特征通过自下而上速度对齐引导去偏生成。迹蒸馏通过可学习小波滤波器过滤高频异常,并通过保持样本间全局一致性使用Skinhorn距离保留结构信息。随后,通过KV注入注意力机制将原始迹的速度场与子迹的速度场对齐。模型通过对齐掩码被强制从对应的低维上下文中生成正常细节。在多个基准测试中的实验结果验证了所提方法的有效性。
abstract_en: The leak of anomalous information from input condition poses a great challenge to reconstruction-based anomaly detection. Recent diffusion-based methods respond to this issue by suppressing anomaly information for condition injection or in-sampling inversion. However, since they treat conditions as a time-invariant prior, they fall into a trade-off problem between anomaly suppression and normal pattern consistency. To address this probelm, we propose Debiasing Trace Guidance (DTG) framework based on Flow Matching towards debiasing generation for more accurate unsupervised multi-class anomaly detection. Generally, DTG distills a low-dimensional generation sub-trace robust to anomalies by Top-down Trace Distillation, and then utilizes its time-varying velocity features to guide a debiasing generation by Bottom-up Velocity Alignment. The trace distillation filters out high-frequency anomalies via learnable wavelet filters and reserving structural information by keeping global consistency across samples using Skinhorn Distance. Subsequently, the velocity field of original trace is aligned with the one of sub-trace through KV-Injection Attention mechanism. The model is forced to generate normal details from corresponding low-dimensional contexts via Alignment Mask. Experimental results on several benchmarks have demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed method.
authors: Xingjian Wang, Li Chai, Jiming Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22989-22998

title: DecAD:在潜在空间中解耦异常以实现多类无监督异常检测
title_en: DecAD: Decoupling Anomalies in Latent Space for Multi-Class Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
abstract: 现有基于蒸馏和重建的方法存在关键局限性:仅使用正常样本训练的自编码器框架意外地能够重建异常特征,导致检测性能下降。我们识别这一现象为"异常泄漏"(AL):通过重建损失优化的解码器倾向于直接复制编码输入,无论输入是正常还是异常特征。为解决此问题,我们提出一种新框架,通过先验潜在空间中的特殊可逆映射显式将编码特征解耦为正常和异常成分。随后移除异常成分,利用正常余量进行特征重建。与现有方法相比,可逆结构可逐点消除异常信息而不损害邻近块的信息,提升重建效果。在此过程中,有效的合成异常特征对训练解耦过程至关重要。因此,我们提出应用对抗训练以寻找合适的扰动来模拟特征级异常。在MVTec AD、VisA和Real-IAD等基准数据集上的大量实验评估表明,我们的方法相比现有先进方法具有竞争力。代码可在:DecAD 获取。
abstract_en: Existing distillation-based and reconstruction-based methods have a critical limitation: Autoencoder-based frameworks trained exclusively on normal samples unexpectedly well reconstruct abnormal features, leadingto degraded detection performance. We identify this phenomenon as 'anomaly leakage' (AL): the decoder optimized by reconstruction loss tends to directly copy the encoded input, regardless of whether the input is a normal or abnormal feature. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework that explicitly decouples encoded features into normal and abnormal components through a special invertible mapping in a prior latent space. Next, we remove abnormal components and leverage normal remainders for feature reconstruction. Compared to previous methods, the invertible structure can eliminate anomalous information point-to-point without damaging the information of neighboring patches, improving reconstruction. In this process, effective synthetic abnormal features are essential for training the decoupling process. Therefore, we propose applying adversarial training to find suitable perturbations to simulate feature-level anomalies. Extensive experimental evaluations on benchmark datasets, including MVTec AD, VisA, and Real-IAD, demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art approaches. Code is available at: DecAD.
authors: Xiaolei Wang, Xiaoyang Wang, Huihui Bai, Eng Gee Lim, Jimin Xiao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21568-21577

title: 通过模态融合率解析大视觉-语言模型中的跨模态对齐
title_en: Deciphering Cross-Modal Alignment in Large Vision-Language Models via Modality Integration Rate
abstract: 多模态预训练的早期阶段在大视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)中对齐两种模态起着关键作用,而评估其训练质量通常需要成本高昂的监督微调(SFT)阶段来验证下游基准得分。损失、困惑度和上下文评估结果是大语言模型(LLMs)常用的预训练指标,但我们观察到这些指标在量化预训练LVLMs时效果较差。由于缺乏合适的指标,LVLMs在多模态融合阶段的研究受到极大阻碍,包括训练数据选择、高效模块设计等。本文首先提出模态融合率(MIR),这是一种有效、鲁棒且通用的指标,可在不进行SFT的情况下指示LVLMs的多模态对齐质量。该指标从跨模态分布距离的角度评估LVLM预训练,具有以下特点:1)有效表示融合质量并表现出与SFT后基准性能的正相关关系;2)对不同训练/评估数据具有鲁棒性;3)可跨训练配置和架构选择进行泛化。补充MIR,我们进一步提出可学习的模态校准(MoCa),这是一个轻量模块,可在训练过程中每个语言模型层缩小模态差距。一系列实验探索了MIR和MoCa的有效性,证明MIR高度指示训练数据选择、训练策略调度和模型架构设计以获得更好的预训练结果。代码可在\href https://github.com/shikiw/Modality-Integration-Rate shikiw/Modality-Integration-Rate获取
abstract_en: The early stage of multi-modal pre-training plays a pivotal role in aligning two modalities for Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), while evaluating its training quality usually requires the costly supervised fine-tuning (SFT) stage to verify the downstream benchmark scores. Loss, perplexity, and in-context evaluation results are commonly used pre-training metrics for Large Language Models (LLMs), while we observed that these metrics are less indicative when quantifying the pre-trained LVLMs. Due to the lack of proper metrics, the research of LVLMs in the multi-modal fusion stage is hindered greatly, including the training data choice, efficient module design, etc.In this paper, we first present Modality Integration Rate (MIR), an effective, robust, and generalized metric to indicate the multi-modal alignment quality of LVLMs without SFT. This metric evaluates LVLM pre-training from the inter-modal distribution distance perspective, which is 1) Effective to represent the fusion quality and show a positive relation with the benchmark performance after SFT, 2) Robust toward different training/evaluation data, and 3) Generalize across training configurations and architecture choices. Complementing MIR, we further propose learnable Modality Calibration (MoCa), a lightweight module to narrow the modality gap at each language model layer during training. A series of experiments are conducted to explore the effectiveness of MIR and MoCa, demonstrating that MIR is highly indicative about training data selection, training strategy schedule, and model architecture design to get better pre-training results. The code is avaliable at \href https://github.com/shikiw/Modality-Integration-Rate  shikiw/Modality-Integration-Rate
authors: Qidong Huang, Xiaoyi Dong, Pan Zhang, Yuhang Zang, Yuhang Cao, Jiaqi Wang, Weiming Zhang, Nenghai Yu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 218-227

title: 解码文本到图像生成中Stable Diffusion工作流程的相关性引起的对齐偏差
title_en: Decoding Correlation-Induced Misalignment in the Stable Diffusion Workflow for Text-to-Image Generation
abstract: 文本到图像生成的基本要求是将生成的图像与提供的文本进行对齐。在大规模数据上,预训练的Stable Diffusion(SD)模型在该任务中取得了显著性能。这些模型将输入提示作为文本控制,引导视觉模型执行去噪操作以从纯噪声中恢复干净图像。然而,我们观察到当文本标记之间存在相关性时,SD生成的图像无法准确表征输入提示的语义:简单但关键的物体可能被遗漏,从而破坏文本-图像对齐。我们将此问题称为"物体遗漏"。在缺乏额外外部知识的情况下,先前方法在解决此问题上均不奏效。为探究该问题,我们分析SD中的注意力图并发现,处理相关标记时偏差的文本表示会误导视觉去噪过程,阻碍物体生成。此外,我们观察到即使两个提示具有相同语义,标记序列的微小变化会显著改变注意力分数,从而影响最终生成的图像。基于这些发现,我们提出了一种简单而有效的微调方法,通过对文本模块中的自注意力图进行去相关处理,从而减少标记间的依赖关系。我们的方法无需外部先验知识,易于实现,且仅在SD模型的文本模块上运行。大量实验验证了我们的方法在文本相关性下有效缓解物体遗漏问题,从而提升文本-图像对齐效果。
abstract_en: The fundamental requirement for text-to-image generation is aligning the generated images with the provided text. With large-scale data, pre-trained Stable Diffusion (SD) models have achieved remarkable performance in this task. These models process an input prompt as text control, guiding a vision model to perform denoising operations that recover a clean image from pure noise. However, we observe that when there is correlation among text tokens, SD's generated images fail to accurately represent the semantics of the input prompt: simple yet crucial objects may be omitted, thereby disrupting text-image alignment. We refer to this problem as "object omission". Without additional external knowledge, previous methods have been ineffective at addressing this issue. To investigate this problem, we analyze the attention maps in SD and find that biased text representations mislead the visual denoising process when handling correlated tokens, impeding object generation. Moreover, we observe that even when two prompts share the same semantics, slight variations in token sequence significantly alter attention scores, consequently affecting the final generated images. Based on these findings, we propose a simple yet effective fine-tuning method that applies decorrelation to the self-attention maps in the text module, thus reducing dependencies between tokens. Our approach requires no external prior knowledge, is straightforward to implement, and operates solely on the text module of the SD model. Extensive experiments confirm that our method effectively alleviates the object omission problem under text correlations, thereby enhancing text-image alignment.
authors: Yunze Tong, Fengda Zhang, Didi Zhu, Jun Xiao, Kun Kuang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18187-18196

title: 解耦与追踪:视频扩散变换器在运动迁移中的基准测试与改进
title_en: Decouple and Track: Benchmarking and Improving Video Diffusion Transformers For Motion Transfer
abstract: 运动迁移任务旨在将源视频中的运动转移到新生成的视频中,要求模型将运动与外观解耦。先前基于扩散的方法主要依赖于3D U-Net内部的独立空间与时间注意力机制。相比之下,最先进的视频扩散变换器(DiT)模型采用3D全注意力机制,未显式分离时间与空间信息。因此,空间与时间维度的交互使得DiT模型在解耦运动与外观时更具挑战性。本文提出DeT方法,通过改进DiT模型以增强运动迁移能力。我们的方法引入了一个简单而有效的时序核,沿时间维度平滑DiT特征,促进前景运动与背景外观的解耦。同时,时序核有效捕捉DiT特征中的时间变化,这些变化与运动密切相关。此外,我们在潜在特征空间中引入密集轨迹的显式监督,进一步提升运动一致性。我们还提出了MTBench,一个通用且具有挑战性的运动迁移基准测试。同时引入混合运动保真度度量,综合考虑全局与局部运动相似性。因此,我们的工作提供了比以往更全面的评估。在MTBench上的大量实验表明,DeT在运动保真度与编辑保真度之间取得了最佳平衡。
abstract_en: The motion transfer task aims to transfer motion from a source video to newly generated videos, requiring the model to decouple motion from appearance. Previous diffusion-based methods primarily rely on separate spatial and temporal attention mechanisms within the 3D U-Net. In contrast, state-of-the-art video Diffusion Transformers (DiT) models use 3D full attention, which does not explicitly separate temporal and spatial information. Thus, the interaction between spatial and temporal dimensions makes decoupling motion and appearance more challenging for DiT models. In this paper, we propose DeT, a method that adapts DiT models to improve motion transfer ability. Our approach introduces a simple yet effective temporal kernel to smooth DiT features along the temporal dimension, facilitating the decoupling of foreground motion from background appearance. Meanwhile, the temporal kernel effectively captures temporal variations in DiT features, which are closely related to motion. Moreover, we introduce explicit supervision along dense trajectories in the latent feature space to further enhance motion consistency. Additionally, we present MTBench, a general and challenging benchmark for motion transfer. We also introduce a hybrid motion fidelity metric that considers both the global and local motion similarity. Therefore, our work provides a more comprehensive evaluation than previous works. Extensive experiments on MTBench demonstrate that DeT achieves the best trade-off between motion fidelity and edit fidelity.
authors: Qingyu Shi, Jianzong Wu, Jinbin Bai, Jiangning Zhang, Lu Qi, Yunhai Tong, Xiangtai Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10995-11005

title: 解耦重构:通过主动特征解耦与可逆融合实现高质量超高清图像修复
title_en: Decouple to Reconstruct: High Quality UHD Restoration via Active Feature Disentanglement and Reversible Fusion
abstract: 超高清(UHD)图像修复常因极端高分辨率而面临计算瓶颈和信息损失问题。基于变分自编码器(VAE)的现有研究通过将图像修复过程从像素空间迁移至潜在空间以提升效率。然而,退化图像中退化成分与背景元素固有耦合,压缩过程中的信息损失与补偿过程中的信息增益均难以控制。这导致修复图像常出现细节丢失和退化去除不彻底的问题。为解决该问题,我们提出一种受控微分解耦VAE,通过分层对比解耦学习和正交门控投影模块引导VAE主动丢弃易恢复的背景信息,将难以恢复的退化信息编码至潜在空间。此外,我们设计了复杂可逆多尺度融合网络处理背景特征,确保其一致性,并利用潜在空间修复网络转换退化潜在特征,从而获得更精确的修复结果。大量实验结果表明,我们的方法有效缓解了VAE模型的信息损失问题,同时保证计算效率,显著提升了超高清图像修复质量,在仅100万参数的情况下于六个超高清修复任务中达到最先进水平。Our code will be available here.
abstract_en: Ultra-high-definition (UHD) image restoration often faces computational bottlenecks and information loss due to its extremely high resolution. Existing studies based on Variational Autoencoders (VAE) improve efficiency by transferring the image restoration process from pixel space to latent space. However, degraded components are inherently coupled with background elements in degraded images, both information loss during compression and information gain during compensation remain uncontrollable. These lead to restored images often exhibiting image detail loss and incomplete degradation removal. To address this issue, we propose a Controlled Differential Disentangled VAE, which utilizes Hierarchical Contrastive Disentanglement Learning and an Orthogonal Gated Projection Module to guide the VAE to actively discard easily recoverable background information while encoding more difficult-to-recover degraded information into the latent space. Additionally, we design a Complex Invertible Multiscale Fusion Network to handle background features, ensuring their consistency, and utilize a latent space restoration network to transform the degraded latent features, leading to more accurate restoration results. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method effectively alleviates the information loss problem in VAE models while ensuring computational efficiency, significantly improving the quality of UHD image restoration, and achieves state-of-the-art results in six UHD restoration tasks with only 1M parameters.Our code will be available here.
authors: Yidi Liu, Dong Li, Yuxin Ma, Jie Huang, Wenlong Zhang, Xueyang Fu, Zheng-Jun Zha ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11622-11631

title: 解耦扩散激发自适应场景生成
title_en: Decoupled Diffusion Sparks Adaptive Scene Generation
abstract: 可控场景生成可大幅降低自动驾驶中多样化数据采集的成本。先前工作将交通布局生成建模为预测过程,要么通过一次性去噪整个序列,要么通过迭代预测下一帧。然而,全序列去噪阻碍了在线响应,而后者短视的下一帧预测缺乏精确的目标状态引导。此外,由于开放数据集中大量安全且普通的驾驶行为,所学模型在生成复杂或具有挑战性的场景时存在困难。为克服这些局限,我们引入Nexus,一个解耦场景生成框架,通过从细粒度标记中独立噪声状态模拟序数和挑战性场景,提升反应性和目标条件。解耦管道的核心是整合部分噪声掩码训练策略和噪声感知调度,确保去噪过程中环境的及时更新。为补充挑战性场景生成,我们收集了一个包含复杂边缘案例的数据集,涵盖540小时的模拟数据,包括切线变道、紧急制动和碰撞等高风险交互。Nexus在保持反应性和目标导向的同时实现了卓越的生成真实性,位移误差减少40%。我们进一步通过数据增强证明Nexus在闭环规划中性能提升20%,并展示了其在安全关键数据生成中的能力。
abstract_en: Controllable scene generation could reduce the cost of diverse data collection substantially for autonomous driving. Prior works formulate the traffic layout generation as a predictive progress, either by denoising entire sequences at once or by iteratively predicting the next frame. However, full sequence denoising hinders online reaction, while the latter's short-sighted next-frame prediction lacks precise goal-state guidance. Further, the learned model struggles to generate complex or challenging scenarios due to a large number of safe and ordinary driving behaviors from open datasets. To overcome these, we introduce Nexus, a decoupled scene generation framework that improves reactivity and goal conditioning by simulating both ordinal and challenging scenarios from fine-grained tokens with independent noise states. At the core of the decoupled pipeline is the integration of a partial noise-masking training strategy and a noise-aware schedule that ensures timely environmental updates throughout the denoising process. To complement challenging scenario generation, we collect a dataset consisting of complex corner cases. It covers 540 hours of simulated data, including high-risk interactions such as cut-in, sudden braking, and collision. Nexus achieves superior generation realism while preserving reactivity and goal orientation, with a 40% reduction in displacement error. We further demonstrate that Nexus improves closed-loop planning by 20% through data augmentation and showcase its capability in safety-critical data generation.
authors: Yunsong Zhou, Naisheng Ye, William Ljungbergh, Tianyu Li, Jiazhi Yang, Zetong Yang, Hongzi Zhu, Christoffer Petersson, Hongyang Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27760-27770

title: 用于推理高效模型调优的解耦多预测器优化
title_en: Decoupled Multi-Predictor Optimization for Inference-Efficient Model Tuning
abstract: 近期在大规模预训练模型调优领域取得了显著进展,推理效率在实际部署中变得愈发关键。早期退出与多阶段预测器相结合,配合参数高效微调策略,为实现推理高效模型提供了一种直接方法。然而,一个关键挑战仍未解决:如何使早期阶段同时为深层阶段提供低级基础特征,并为早期预测器提供高级判别特征?为解决此问题,我们提出了解耦多预测器优化(DMPO)方法,有效分离早期阶段的低级表征能力与高级判别能力。首先,在架构设计上,我们引入轻量级旁路模块用于多阶段预测器的浅层特征功能分解,同时开发基于高阶统计的预测器以增强早期阶段的判别能力。为合理训练多预测器架构,提出解耦优化方法,在模型调优过程中为多阶段预测器分配双阶段损失权重,其中初始训练阶段通过强调早期阶段的表征能力,使模型优先获取深层阶段的判别能力;后续训练阶段则尽可能将判别能力向早期阶段转移。因此,DMPO在架构设计和模型优化层面有效解耦了早期阶段的表征与判别能力。在多种数据集和预训练主干网络上的实验表明,DMPO在降低计算成本时明显优于其他方法。特别是,DMPO在30% FLOPs下性能可比甚至超越70% FLOPs的对比方法。
abstract_en: Recently, remarkable progress has been made in large-scale pre-trained model tuning, and inference efficiency is becoming more crucial for practical deployment. Early exiting in conjunction with multi-stage predictors, when cooperated with a parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategy, offers a straightforward way to achieve an inference-efficient model. However, a key challenge remains unresolved: How can early stages provide low-level fundamental features to deep stages while simultaneously supplying high-level discriminative features to early-stage predictors? To address this problem, we propose a Decoupled Multi-Predictor Optimization (DMPO) method to effectively decouple the low-level representative ability and high-level discriminative ability in early stages. First, in terms of architecture, we introduce a lightweight bypass module into multi-stage predictors for functional decomposition of shallow features from early stages, while a high-order statistics-based predictor is developed for early stages to effectively enhance their discriminative ability. To reasonably train our multi-predictor architecture, a decoupled optimization is proposed to allocate two-phase loss weights for multi-stage predictors during model tuning, where the initial training phase enables the model to prioritize the acquisition of discriminative ability of deep stages via emphasizing representative ability of early stages, and the latter training phase drives discriminative ability towards earlier stages as much as possible. As such, our DMPO can effectively decouple representative and discriminative abilities in early stages in terms of architecture design and model optimization. Experiments across various datasets and pre-trained backbones demonstrate that DMPO clearly outperforms its counterparts when reducing computational cost. Particularly, DMPO with 30% FLOPs is comparable with or even suppresses counterparts with 70% FLOPs.
authors: Liwei Luo, Shuaitengyuan Li, Dongwei Ren, Qilong Wang, Pengfei Zhu, Qinghua Hu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3628-3638

title: 基于空间形态剥离与光谱滤波的深度自适应展开网络用于全色锐化
title_en: Deep Adaptive Unfolded Network via Spatial Morphology Stripping and Spectral Filtration for Pan-sharpening
abstract: 在全色锐化领域,现有深度方法在中间特征的跨模态互补性深化方面存在局限,缺乏有效策略利用网络整体以获得最优解,其黑箱设计导致可行性与可解释性受限。此外,由于缺乏数据集,难以在高阶语义任务中验证全色锐化性能。为解决这些问题,我们提出一种基于空间形态剥离与光谱滤波的深度自适应展开网络用于全色锐化,其概念被建模为由空间与光谱先验约束的线性逆问题。具体而言,我们将相位导向约束融入空间先验,通过本征分解提取模态不变的空间形态;并利用与光谱先验对齐的物理驱动光谱滤波注意力机制挖掘内在光谱相关性。在将模型透明展开为多阶段网络后,设计了自适应阶段退出机制,通过聚合候选阶段中的最优图像块以利用融合多样性。为系统完成评估,我们构建了首个全景分割数据集作为全色锐化性能验证的语义级基准。大量实验验证了本方法的优势,代码已开源至https://github.com/Baixuzx7/DAPNet。
abstract_en: In the field of pan-sharpening, existing deep methods are hindered in deepening cross-modal complementarity in the intermediate feature, and lack effective strategies to harness the network entirety for optimal solutions, exhibiting limited feasibility and interpretability due to their black-box designs. Besides, validating pan-sharpening performance in high-level semantic tasks is intractable for the absence of datasets. To tackle these issues, we propose a deep adaptive unfolded network via spatial morphology stripping and spectral filtration for pan-sharpening, which is conceptualized as a linear inverse problem regularized by spatial and spectral priors. Specifically, we incorporate phase-oriented constraints into the spatial prior to facilitate the extraction of modal-invariant spatial morphology by intrinsic decomposition and leverage a physics-driven spectral filtration attention mechanism aligned with the spectral prior to mine the inherent spectral correlation. After transparently unfolding the model into a multi-stage network, an adaptive stage-exiting mechanism is designed to capitalize on fusion diversity by aggregating optimal image patches across candidate stages. To systematically complete the assessment, we construct the first panoptic segmentation dataset as a semantic-level benchmark for pan-sharpening performance validation. Extensive experiments are conducted to verify the merits of our method with state-of-the-arts. Code is available at https://github.com/Baixuzx7/DAPNet.
authors: Hebaixu Wang, Jiayi Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10730-10740

title: 基于分布双一致性恢复引导的深度不完全多视图聚类
title_en: Deep Incomplete Multi-view Clustering with Distribution Dual-Consistency Recovery Guidance
abstract: 多视图聚类通过融合多源互补表征提升性能。然而现实数据常因隐私问题和设备故障等导致不完全情况。关键挑战在于有效利用现有样本恢复缺失视图。现有方法在恢复过程中常忽视视图间的异质性,导致恢复数据与真实数据存在显著分布差异。此外多数方法侧重跨视图相关性,忽视了视图内可靠结构和跨视图聚类结构的启示。为解决这些问题,我们提出BURG方法,一种基于分布双一致性恢复引导的不完全多视图聚类新方法。我们将每个样本视为独立类别,通过跨视图分布迁移预测缺失视图的分布空间。为补偿可靠类别信息的缺失,设计了双一致性引导的恢复策略,包括基于邻域感知一致性的视图内对齐和基于原型一致性的跨视图对齐。在基准数据集上的大量实验验证了BURG在不完全多视图场景中的优越性。
abstract_en: Multi-view clustering leverages complementary representations from diverse sources to enhance performance. However, real-world data often suffer incomplete cases due to factors like privacy concerns and device malfunctions. A key challenge is effectively utilizing available instances to recover missing views. Existing methods frequently overlook the heterogeneity among views during recovery, leading to significant distribution discrepancies between recovered and true data. Additionally, many approaches focus on cross-view correlations, neglecting insights from intra-view reliable structure and cross-view clustering structure. To address these issues, we propose BURG, a novel method for incomplete multi-view clustering with distriBution dUal-consistency Recovery Guidance. We treat each sample as a distinct category and perform cross-view distribution transfer to predict the distribution space of missing views. To compensate for the lack of reliable category information, we design a dual-consistency guided recovery strategy that includes intra-view alignment guided by neighbor-aware consistency and cross-view alignment guided by prototypical consistency. Extensive experiments on benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of BURG in the incomplete multi-view scenario.
authors: Jiaqi Jin, Siwei Wang, Zhibin Dong, Xihong Yang, Xinwang Liu, En Zhu, Kunlun He ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1016-1026

title: 深空天气模型:基于多波段图像的长程太阳耀斑预测
title_en: Deep Space Weather Model: Long-Range Solar Flare Prediction from Multi-Wavelength Images
abstract: 准确可靠的太阳耀斑预测对于减轻对关键基础设施的潜在干扰至关重要,而太阳耀斑预测仍是一个重大挑战。现有基于启发式物理特征的方法往往缺乏从太阳图像中进行表征学习的能力。另一方面,端到端学习方法难以建模太阳图像中的长程时空依赖关系。本研究提出了一种基于多深状态空间模型的Deep Space Weather Model(Deep SWM),用于处理十通道太阳图像和长程时空依赖关系。Deep SWM还引入了稀疏掩码自编码器,这是一种新颖的预训练策略,采用双阶段掩码方法,在压缩空间信息的同时保留关键区域(如黑子)。此外,我们构建了FlareBench,一个覆盖完整11年太阳活动周期的新公开基准数据集,以验证我们的方法。我们的方法在标准指标上超越了基线方法,甚至超过了人类专家的性能。项目页面可访问 https://keio-smilab25.github.io/DeepSWM。
abstract_en: Accurate, reliable solar flare prediction is crucial for mitigating potential disruptions to critical infrastructure, while predicting solar flares remains a significant challenge. Existing methods based on heuristic physical features often lack representation learning from solar images. On the other hand, end-to-end learning approaches struggle to model long-range temporal dependencies in solar images.In this study, we propose Deep Space Weather Model (Deep SWM), which is based on multiple deep state space models for handling both ten-channel solar images and long-range spatio-temporal dependencies. Deep SWM also features a sparse masked autoencoder, a novel pretraining strategy that employs a two-phase masking approach to preserve crucial regions such as sunspots while compressing spatial information.Furthermore, we built FlareBench, a new public benchmark for solar flare prediction covering a full 11-year solar activity cycle, to validate our method.Our method outperformed baseline methods and even human expert performance on standard metrics in terms of performance and reliability. The project page can be found at https://keio-smilab25.github.io/DeepSWM.
authors: Shunya Nagashima, Komei Sugiura ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9396-9405

title: DeepMesh:基于强化学习的自回归艺术网格生成
title_en: DeepMesh: Auto-Regressive Artist-mesh Creation with Reinforcement Learning
abstract: 三角网格在3D应用中起着关键作用,能够实现高效的操作和渲染。尽管自回归方法通过预测离散顶点标记生成结构化网格,但它们常受制于有限的面数和网格不完整性。为了解决这些挑战,我们提出了DeepMesh框架,通过两项关键创新优化网格生成:(1) 一种高效的预训练策略,结合新颖的标记算法,并改进了数据整理和处理;(2) 将强化学习(RL)引入3D网格生成,通过直接偏好优化(DPO)实现人类偏好对齐。我们设计了一种评分标准,结合人工评估和三维指标来收集DPO的偏好对,确保视觉吸引力和几何精度。基于点云和图像,DeepMesh生成具有精细细节和精确拓扑结构的网格,在精度和质量方面均优于最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Triangle meshes play a crucial role in 3D applications for efficient manipulation and rendering. While auto-regressive methods generate structured meshes by predicting discrete vertex tokens, they are often constrained by limited face counts and mesh incompleteness. To address these challenges, we propose DeepMesh, a framework that optimizes mesh generation through two key innovations: (1) an efficient pre-training strategy incorporating a novel tokenization algorithm, along with improvements in data curation and processing, and (2) the introduction of Reinforcement Learning (RL) into 3D mesh generation to achieve human preference alignment via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). We design a scoring standard that combines human evaluation with 3D metrics to collect preference pairs for DPO, ensuring both visual appeal and geometric accuracy. Conditioned on point clouds and images, DeepMesh generates meshes with intricate details and precise topology, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in both precision and quality.
authors: Ruowen Zhao, Junliang Ye, Zhengyi Wang, Guangce Liu, Yiwen Chen, Yikai Wang, Jun Zhu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10612-10623

title: DeepShield:通过局部与全局伪造分析强化深度伪造视频检测
title_en: DeepShield: Fortifying Deepfake Video Detection with Local and Global Forgery Analysis
abstract: 近年来,深度生成模型的进展使得操纵人脸视频变得更加容易,引发了对其可能被用于欺诈和虚假信息传播的严重担忧。现有检测器在领域内场景中通常表现良好,但由于依赖伪造特定的痕迹,难以跨多样化的操纵技术进行泛化。在本工作中,我们引入DeepShield,一种新颖的深度伪造检测框架,通过平衡局部敏感性和全局泛化能力,提升对未见过的伪造内容的鲁棒性。DeepShield通过两个关键组件增强CLIP-ViT编码器:局部补丁引导(Local Patch Guidance, LPG)和全局伪造多样化(Global Forgery Diversification, GFD)。LPG通过时空痕迹建模和补丁级监督捕捉常被全局模型忽略的细粒度不一致性。GFD引入领域特征增强,利用领域桥接和边界扩展特征生成合成多样化的伪造内容,缓解过拟合并增强跨领域适应性。通过整合新型局部与全局分析方法,DeepShield在跨数据集和跨操纵技术评估中超越了现有最先进方法,展现出对未见过深度伪造攻击的卓越鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Recent advances in deep generative models have made it easier to manipulate face videos, raising significant concerns about their potential misuse for fraud and misinformation. Existing detectors often perform well in in-domain scenarios but fail to generalize across diverse manipulation techniques due to their reliance on forgery-specific artifacts. In this work, we introduce DeepShield, a novel deepfake detection framework that balances local sensitivity and global generalization to improve robustness across unseen forgeries. DeepShield enhances the CLIP-ViT encoder through two key components: Local Patch Guidance (LPG) and Global Forgery Diversification (GFD). LPG applies spatiotemporal artifact modeling and patch-wise supervision to capture fine-grained inconsistencies often overlooked by global models. GFD introduces domain feature augmentation, leveraging domain-bridging and boundary-expanding feature generation to synthesize diverse forgeries, mitigating overfitting and enhancing cross-domain adaptability. Through the integration of novel local and global analysis for deepfake detection, DeepShield outperforms state-of-the-art methods in cross-dataset and cross-manipulation evaluations, achieving superior robustness against unseen deepfake attacks.
authors: Yinqi Cai, Jichang Li, Zhaolun Li, Weikai Chen, Rushi Lan, Xi Xie, Xiaonan Luo, Guanbin Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12524-12534

title: 深度监督的基于流的生成模型
title_en: Deeply Supervised Flow-Based Generative Models
abstract: 基于流的生成模型通过遵循一个简单原则:学习线性插值的速率表示,在多个视觉生成任务中取得了显著进展。然而,我们观察到仅从最终层输出训练速率会低估层间表示的丰富性,这可能阻碍模型收敛。为解决这一局限性,我们引入了DeepFlow,这是一种通过层间通信增强速率表示的新框架。DeepFlow将Transformer层划分为平衡分支并实施深度监督,在相邻分支间插入轻量级的带有加速度的(VeRA)速度精炼模块,以对齐Transformer块内的中间速率特征。得益于内部速率对齐带来的改进深度监督,DeepFlow在ImageNet-256x256数据集上收敛速度提升8倍且性能相当,同时相比无分类器引导的先前流模型,训练时间减半且FID降低2.6。DeepFlow在文本到图像生成任务中也优于基线模型,如MS-COCO和零样本GenEval的评估结果所示。代码将公开发布。
abstract_en: Flow-based generative models have charted an impressive path across multiple visual generation tasks by adhering to a simple principle: learning velocity representations of a linear interpolant. However, we observe that training velocity solely from the final layer's output under-utilizes the rich inter-layer representations, potentially impeding model convergence. To address this limitation, we introduce DeepFlow, a novel framework that enhances velocity representation through inter-layer communication. DeepFlow partitions transformer layers into balanced branches with deep supervision and inserts a lightweight Velocity Refiner with Acceleration (VeRA) block between adjacent branches, which aligns the intermediate velocity features within transformer blocks. Powered by the improved deep supervision via the internal velocity alignment, DeepFlow converges 8x faster on ImageNet-256x256 with equivalent performance and further reduces FID by 2.6 while halving training time compared to previous flow-based models without a classifier-free guidance. DeepFlow also outperforms baselines in text-to-image generation tasks, as evidenced by evaluations on MS-COCO and zero-shot GenEval. The code will be made publicly available.
authors: Inkyu Shin, Chenglin Yang, Liang-Chieh Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16535-16544

title: 基于退化建模的多路径扩散可调金属透镜摄影
title_en: Degradation-Modeled Multipath Diffusion for Tunable Metalens Photography
abstract: 金属透镜在超紧凑计算成像领域展现出巨大潜力,但面临复杂的光学退化和计算恢复困难等挑战。现有方法通常依赖精确的光学校准或大规模配对数据集,这对现实世界成像系统而言并不容易。此外,推理过程中缺乏控制常导致不期望的幻觉伪影。我们提出基于退化建模的多路径扩散方法用于可调金属透镜摄影,利用预训练模型中的强大自然图像先验而非大规模数据集。我们的框架通过正、中性和负提示路径平衡高频细节生成、结构保真度与金属透镜特有退化的抑制,结合伪数据增强。可调解码器实现保真度与感知质量之间的可控权衡。此外,设计了空间变化的退化感知注意力(SVDA)模块,自适应建模复杂的光学与传感器诱导退化。最后,我们设计并构建了毫米级MetaCamera进行实际验证。大量实验结果表明,我们的方法优于现有技术,实现了高保真、锐利的图像重建。更多材料:https://dmdiff.github.io/
abstract_en: Metalenses offer significant potential for ultra-compact computational imaging but face challenges from complex optical degradation and computational restoration difficulties. Existing methods typically rely on precise optical calibration or massive paired datasets, which are non-trivial for real-world imaging systems. Furthermore, lack of control over the inference process often results in undesirable hallucinated artifacts. We introduce Degradation-Modeled Multipath Diffusion for tunable metalens photography, leveraging powerful natural image priors from pretrained models instead of large datasets. Our framework uses positive, neutral, and negative-prompt paths to balance high-frequency detail generation, structural fidelity, and suppression of metalens-specific degradation, alongside pseudo data augmentation. A tunable decoder enables controlled trade-offs between fidelity and perceptual quality. Additionally, a spatially varying degradation-aware attention (SVDA) module adaptively models complex optical and sensor-induced degradation. Finally, we design and build a millimeter-scale MetaCamera for real-world validation. Extensive results show that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving high-fidelity and sharp image reconstruction. More materials: https://dmdiff.github.io/.
authors: Jianing Zhang, Jiayi Zhu, Feiyu Ji, Xiaokang Yang, Xiaoyun Yuan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25914-25924

title: Demeter:一种源于现实世界的作物植物形态参数化模型
title_en: Demeter: A Parametric Model of Crop Plant Morphology from the Real World
abstract: 学习三维参数化形状模型在视觉与图形学领域日益流行,并在三维重建、生成、理解与模拟中展现出广泛应用。尽管已有强大的人体和动物模型,但对植物建模的同样表达能力的方法仍显不足。在本工作中,我们提出了Demeter,这是一种数据驱动的参数化模型,将植物形态学的关键因素——拓扑结构、形状、关节运动和形变——编码为紧凑的学得表示。与以往参数化模型不同,Demeter处理不同物种间的形状拓扑变化,并建模三种形状变化来源:关节运动、子部件形状变化和非刚性形变。为推进作物植物建模,我们从大豆农场收集了一个大规模、真实标注的数据集作为测试平台。实验表明,Demeter能有效合成形状、重建结构并模拟生物物理过程。代码和数据将开源。
abstract_en: Learning 3D parametric shape models of objects has gained popularity in vision and graphics and has showed broad utility in 3D reconstruction, generation, understanding, and simulation. While powerful models exist for humans and animals, equally expressive approaches for modeling plants are lacking. In this work, we present Demeter, a data-driven parametric model that encodes key factors of a plant morphology, including topology, shape, articulation, and deformation into a compact learned representation. Unlike previous parametric models, Demeter handles varying shape topology across various species and models three sources of shape variation: articulation, subcomponent shape variation, and non-rigid deformation. To advance crop plant modeling, we collected a large-scale, ground-truthed dataset from a soybean farm as a testbed. Experiments show that Demeter effectively synthesizes shapes, reconstructs structures, and simulates biophysical processes. Code and data will be open-sourced.
authors: Tianhang Cheng, Albert J. Zhai, Evan Z. Chen, Rui Zhou, Yawen Deng, Zitong Li, Kejie Zhao, Janice Shiu, Qianyu Zhao, Yide Xu, Xinlei Wang, Yuan Shen, Sheng Wang, Lisa Ainsworth, Kaiyu Guan, Shenlong Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28740-28751

title: 高保真共语音手势视频生成的普及
title_en: Democratizing High-Fidelity Co-Speech Gesture Video Generation
abstract: 共语音手势视频生成旨在合成与音频对齐的、包含同步面部表情和身体手势的逼真说话人视频。该任务因音频与视觉内容之间存在显著的一对多映射关系而面临挑战,且由于大规模公开数据集稀缺和高计算需求而更加复杂。我们提出了一种轻量级框架,利用2D全身骨骼作为高效的辅助条件,以桥接音频信号与视觉输出。我们的方法引入了基于细粒度音频片段和从说话人参考图像中提取的骨骼的扩散模型,通过骨骼-音频特征融合预测骨骼运动,以确保严格的音频同步和身体形状一致性。生成的骨骼随后输入现成的人类视频生成模型,并结合说话人参考图像合成高保真视频。为普及研究,我们发布了CSG-405--首个包含71种语音类型、405小时高分辨率视频、标注有2D骨骼和多样化说话人人口统计信息的公开数据集。实验表明,我们的方法在视觉质量和同步性方面超越了现有最先进方法,并在说话人和上下文中具有良好的泛化能力。代码、模型和CSG-405可在https://mpi-lab.github.io/Democratizing-CSG获取。
abstract_en: Co-speech gesture video generation aims to synthesize realistic, audio-aligned videos of speakers, complete with synchronized facial expressions and body gestures. This task presents challenges due to the significant one-to-many mapping between audio and visual content, further complicated by the scarcity of large-scale public datasets and high computational demands. We propose a lightweight framework that utilizes 2D full-body skeletons as an efficient auxiliary condition to bridge audio signals with visual outputs. Our approach introduces a diffusion model conditioned on fine-grained audio segments and a skeleton extracted from the speaker's reference image, predicting skeletal motions through skeleton-audio feature fusion to ensure strict audio coordination and body shape consistency. The generated skeletons are then fed into an off-the-shelf human video generation model with the speaker's reference image to synthesize high-fidelity videos. To democratize research, we present CSG-405--the first public dataset with 405 hours of high-resolution videos across 71 speech types, annotated with 2D skeletons and diverse speaker demographics. Experiments show that our method exceeds state-of-the-art approaches in visual quality and synchronization while generalizing across speakers and contexts. Code, models, and CSG-405 are publicly released at https://mpi-lab.github.io/Democratizing-CSG
authors: Xu Yang, Shaoli Huang, Shenbo Xie, Xuelin Chen, Yifei Liu, Changxing Ding ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14283-14292

title: 民主化文本到图像掩码生成模型的紧凑型文本感知一维标记
title_en: Democratizing Text-to-Image Masked Generative Models with Compact Text-Aware One-Dimensional Tokens
abstract: 图像分词器是现代文本到图像生成模型的基础,但训练起来极具挑战性。此外,大多数现有的文本到图像模型依赖于大规模高质量的私有数据集,这使得它们难以复现。在本工作中,我们引入了基于文本感知Transformer的一维分词器(TA-TiTok),这是一种高效且强大的图像分词器,能够利用离散或连续的一维标记。TA-TiTok在分词器解码阶段(即反向分词)独特地整合文本信息,加速收敛并提升性能。TA-TiTok还受益于一种简化但有效的单阶段训练流程,消除了先前一维分词器中复杂的双阶段蒸馏需求。这种设计使得其能够无缝扩展到大规模数据集。在此基础上,我们引入了一类基于开放数据训练的文本到图像掩码生成模型(MaskGen),其性能可与基于私有数据训练的模型相媲美。我们旨在发布高效的强大学习TA-TiTok分词器和开放数据、开放权重的MaskGen模型,以促进更广泛的访问并民主化文本到图像掩码生成模型领域。
abstract_en: Image tokenizers form the foundation of modern text-toimage generative models but are notoriously difficult to train. Furthermore, most existing text-to-image models rely on large-scale, high-quality private datasets, making them challenging to replicate. In this work, we introduce **T**ext-**A**ware **T**ransformer-based 1-D**i**mensional **Tok**enizer (TA-TiTok), an efficient and powerful image tokenizer that can utilize either discrete or continuous 1-dimensional tokens. TA-TiTok uniquely integrates textual information during the tokenizer decoding stage (i.e., de-tokenization), accelerating convergence and enhancing performance. TA-TiTok also benefits from a simplified, yet effective, one-stage training process, eliminating the need for the complex two-stage distillation used in previous 1-dimensional tokenizers. This design allows for seamless scalability to large datasets. Building on this, we introduce a family of text-to-image **Mask**ed **Gen**erative Models (MaskGen), trained exclusively on open data while achieving comparable performance to models trained on private data. We aim to release both the efficient, strong TA-TiTok tokenizers and the open-data, open-weight MaskGen models to promote broader access and democratize the field of text-to-image masked generative models.
authors: Dongwon Kim, Ju He, Qihang Yu, Chenglin Yang, Xiaohui Shen, Suha Kwak, Liang-Chieh Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18442-18452

title: 掩码自回归模型中的去噪标记预测
title_en: Denoising Token Prediction in Masked Autoregressive Models
abstract: 自回归模型正处于一个转折点,有望在视觉生成领域取得突破。本文提出在掩码自回归模型中,利用扩散过程对标记预测进行建模,用于图像生成。我们从两个关键视角探讨该问题:一方面,通过自回归模型中的去噪头逐步优化未掩码标记的预测;另一方面,通过扩散头利用掩码与未掩码标记之间的依赖性,表示掩码标记的概率分布。我们的方法具有内在优势,在序列预测速度方面保持竞争力,并通过利用去噪扩散过程的原则,显著提升了生成高质量样本的能力。在类别条件和文本到图像任务的大量实验表明其优越性,在ImageNet和MSCOCO数据集上分别取得1.47和5.27的最先进FID分数。更值得注意的是,与扩散模型(如DiT-XL/2)相比,我们的方法在图像生成推理时间上实现了45%的加速。
abstract_en: Autoregressive models are just at a tipping point where they could really take off for visual generation. In this paper, we propose to model token prediction using diffusion procedure particularly in masked autoregressive models for image generation. We look into the problem from two critical perspectives: progressively refining the unmasked tokens prediction via a denoising head with the autoregressive model, and representing masked tokens probability distribution by capitalizing on the interdependency across masked and unmasked tokens through a diffusion head. Our proposal harbors an innate agency that remains advantageous in the speed of sequence prediction, and strongly favors high capability in generating quality samples by leveraging the principles of denoising diffusion process. Extensive experiments on both class-conditional and text-to-image tasks demonstrate its superiority, achieving the state-of-the-art FID score of 1.47 and 5.27 on ImageNet and MSCOCO datasets, respectively. More remarkably, our approach leads to 45% speedup in the inference time of image generation against the diffusion models such as DiT-XL/2.
authors: Ting Yao, Yehao Li, Yingwei Pan, Zhaofan Qiu, Tao Mei ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18024-18033

title: 密集策略:动作的双向自回归学习
title_en: Dense Policy: Bidirectional Autoregressive Learning of Actions
abstract: 主流视觉运动策略主要依赖生成模型进行整体动作预测,而当前自回归策略在预测下一个标记或块时表现出次优效果。这促使我们寻找更有效的学习方法,以释放自回归策略在机器人操作中的潜力。本文提出一种双向扩展学习方法,称为密集策略(Dense Policy),以建立自回归策略在动作预测中的新范式。该方法采用轻量级仅编码器架构,以对数时间推理逐步展开动作序列,从初始单帧到目标序列,采用由粗到细的方式。大量实验验证了我们的密集策略具有优越的自回归学习能力,并可超越现有整体生成策略。我们的策略、示例数据和训练代码将在发表后公开。
abstract_en: Mainstream visuomotor policies predominantly rely on generative models for holistic action prediction, while current autoregressive policies, predicting the next token or chunk, have shown suboptimal results. This motivates a search for more effective learning methods to unleash the potential of autoregressive policies for robotic manipulation. This paper introduces a bidirectionally expanded learning approach, termed Dense Policy, to establish a new paradigm for autoregressive policies in action prediction. It employs a lightweight encoder-only architecture to iteratively unfold the action sequence from an initial single frame into the target sequence in a coarse-to-fine manner with logarithmic-time inference. Extensive experiments validate that our dense policy has superior autoregressive learning capabilities and can surpass existing holistic generative policies. Our policy, example data, and training code will be publicly available upon publication.
authors: Yue Su, Xinyu Zhan, Hongjie Fang, Han Xue, Hao-Shu Fang, Yong-Lu Li, Cewu Lu, Lixin Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14486-14495

title: Dense2MoE: 重构扩散变换器为专家混合模型以实现高效文本到图像生成
title_en: Dense2MoE: Restructuring Diffusion Transformer to MoE for Efficient Text-to-Image Generation
abstract: 扩散变换器(DiT)在文本到图像生成中表现出色;然而,其庞大的参数量导致了显著的推理开销。现有参数压缩方法主要聚焦于剪枝,但激进的剪枝往往因模型容量减少而导致严重性能下降。为解决这一局限性,我们开创性地将密集型DiT转换为专家混合模型(MoE)以实现结构化稀疏化,在减少激活参数数量的同时保持模型容量。具体而言,我们将DiT块中的前馈网络(FFNs)替换为MoE层,使FFNs中激活参数数量减少62.5%。此外,我们提出块混合(MoB)机制以选择性激活DiT块,从而进一步增强稀疏性。为确保有效的密集到MoE转换,我们设计了多阶段蒸馏流程,包含基于泰勒度量的专家初始化、负载均衡的知识蒸馏以及用于MoB优化的组特征损失。我们将大型扩散变换器(如FLUX.1 [dev])转换为MoE结构,在减少激活参数60%的同时保持原始性能,并在大量实验中超越基于剪枝的方法。总体而言,Dense2MoE建立了高效文本到图像生成的新范式。
abstract_en: Diffusion Transformer (DiT) has demonstrated remarkable performance in text-to-image generation; however, its large parameter size results in substantial inference overhead. Existing parameter compression methods primarily focus on pruning, but aggressive pruning often leads to severe performance degradation due to reduced model capacity. To address this limitation, we pioneer the transformation of a dense DiT into a Mixture of Experts (MoE) for structured sparsification, reducing the number of activated parameters while preserving model capacity. Specifically, we replace the Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs) in DiT Blocks with MoE layers, reducing the number of activated parameters in the FFNs by 62.5%.Furthermore, we propose the Mixture of Blocks (MoB) to selectively activate DiT blocks, thereby further enhancing sparsity.To ensure an effective dense-to-MoE conversion, we design a multi-step distillation pipeline, incorporating Taylor metric-based expert initialization, knowledge distillation with load balancing, and group feature loss for MoB optimization. We transform large diffusion transformers (e.g., FLUX.1 [dev]) into an MoE structure, reducing activated parameters by 60% while maintaining original performance and surpassing pruning-based approaches in extensive experiments. Overall, Dense2MoE establishes a new paradigm for efficient text-to-image generation.
authors: Youwei Zheng, Yuxi Ren, Xin Xia, Xuefeng Xiao, Xiaohua Xie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18661-18670

title: DepR:基于深度引导的单视角场景重建与实例级扩散方法
title_en: DepR: Depth Guided Single-view Scene Reconstruction with Instance-level Diffusion
abstract: 我们提出DepR,这是一种在组合范式中整合实例级扩散的深度引导单视角场景重建框架。与以往方法仅在推理过程中利用深度进行物体布局估计而未能充分挖掘其丰富的几何信息不同,DepR在训练和推理过程中均充分利用深度信息。具体而言,我们引入深度引导的条件编码,以有效将形状先验编码至扩散模型中。在推理阶段,深度进一步引导DDIM采样和布局优化,增强重建结果与输入图像之间的对齐。尽管仅在有限的合成数据上进行训练,DepR在单视角场景重建中仍达到最先进性能,并通过在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上的评估展现出强大的泛化能力。
abstract_en: We propose DepR, a depth-guided single-view scene reconstruction framework that integrates instance-level diffusion within a compositional paradigm. Instead of reconstructing the entire scene holistically, DepR generates individual objects and subsequently composes them into a coherent 3D layout. Unlike previous methods that use depth solely for object layout estimation during inference and therefore fail to fully exploit its rich geometric information, DepR leverages depth throughout both training and inference. Specifically, we introduce depth-guided conditioning to effectively encode shape priors into diffusion models. During inference, depth further guides DDIM sampling and layout optimization, enhancing alignment between the reconstruction and the input image. Despite being trained on limited synthetic data, DepR achieves state-of-the-art performance and demonstrates strong generalization in single-view scene reconstruction, as shown through evaluations on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
authors: Qingcheng Zhao, Xiang Zhang, Haiyang Xu, Zeyuan Chen, Jianwen Xie, Yuan Gao, Zhuowen Tu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5722-5733

title: Depth Any Event Stream: 基于密集到稀疏蒸馏的事件相机单目深度估计增强
title_en: Depth Any Event Stream: Enhancing Event-based Monocular Depth Estimation via Dense-to-Sparse Distillation
abstract: 凭借事件相机对高速运动和极端光照条件的卓越灵敏度,基于事件的单目深度估计在复杂环境中预测场景结构信息方面日益受到关注。然而,标记事件数据的稀缺性限制了传统监督学习方法的应用。为充分释放现有基于RGB的深度基础模型DAM的潜力,我们提出任意事件流深度估计(EventDAM),实现无需标注的高性能事件相机单目深度估计。EventDAM通过融合三个关键跨模态组件:稀疏感知特征混合(SFM)、稀疏感知特征蒸馏(SFD)和稀疏不变一致性模块(SCM),有效结合配对的密集RGB图像与稀疏事件数据。借助提出的稀疏度度量,SFM混合RGB图像与事件数据特征生成辅助深度预测,而SFD实现自适应特征蒸馏。此外,SCM确保事件数据在不同稀疏度水平下的输出一致性,从而使EventDAM具备跨多场景的零样本能力。在多种基准数据集上的广泛实验表明,与采用多样化输入模态的方法相比,EventDAM展现出卓越的泛化能力和零样本性能。
abstract_en: With the superior sensitivity of event cameras to high-speed motion and extreme lighting conditions, event-based monocular depth estimation has gained popularity to predict structural information about surrounding scenes in challenging environments. However, the scarcity of labeled event data constrains prior supervised learning methods. Unleashing the promising potential of the existing RGB-based depth foundation model, DAM, we propose Depth Any Event stream (EventDAM) to achieve high-performance event based monocular depth estimation in an annotation-free manner. EventDAM effectively combines paired dense RGB images with sparse event data by incorporating three key cross-modality components: Sparsity-aware Feature Mixture (SFM), Sparsity-aware Feature Distillation (SFD), and Sparsity-invariant Consistency Module (SCM). With the proposed sparsity metric, SFM mixes features from RGB images and event data to generate auxiliary depth predictions, while SFD facilitates adaptive feature distillation. Furthermore, SCM ensures output consistency across varying sparsity levels in event data, thereby endowing EventDAM with zero shot capabilities across diverse scenes. Extensive experiments across a variety of benchmark datasets, compared to approaches using diverse input modalities, robustly substantiate the generalization and zero-shot capabilities of EventDAM.
authors: Jinjing Zhu, Tianbo Pan, Zidong Cao, Yexin Liu, James T. Kwok, Hui Xiong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5146-5155

title: Depth AnyEvent:一种基于跨模态蒸馏范式的事件驱动单目深度估计方法
title_en: Depth AnyEvent: A Cross-Modal Distillation Paradigm for Event-Based Monocular Depth Estimation
abstract: 事件相机捕捉稀疏的高时间分辨率视觉信息,使其特别适合高速运动和强烈光照变化等具有挑战性的环境。然而,缺乏具有密集真实深度标注的大规模数据集阻碍了基于学习的单目深度估计从事件数据中进行。为解决这一限制,我们提出一种跨模态蒸馏范式,利用视觉基础模型(VFM)生成密集的代理标签。我们的策略需要与RGB帧空间对齐的事件流,这是一个即使现成设备也能实现的简单设置,并利用大规模VFM的鲁棒性。此外,我们提出适应VFM,无论是采用如Depth Anything v2(DAv2)的原始模型,还是由此衍生出一种新颖的循环架构以从单目事件相机推断深度。我们使用合成和真实世界数据集评估了我们的方法,证明了i) 我们的跨模态范式在无需昂贵深度标注的情况下,与全监督方法相比表现出竞争力的性能,以及ii) 我们的基于VFM的模型实现了最先进的性能
abstract_en: Event cameras capture sparse, high-temporal-resolution visual information, making them particularly suitable for challenging environments with high-speed motion and strongly varying lighting conditions. However, the lack of large datasets with dense ground-truth depth annotations hinders learning-based monocular depth estimation from event data. To address this limitation, we propose a cross-modal distillation paradigm to generate dense proxy labels leveraging a Vision Foundation Model (VFM). Our strategy requires an event stream spatially aligned with RGB frames, a simple setup even available off-the-shelf, and exploits the robustness of large-scale VFMs.Additionally, we propose to adapt VFMs, either a vanilla one like Depth Anything v2 (DAv2), or deriving from it a novel recurrent architecture to infer depth from monocular event cameras. We evaluate our approach using synthetic and real-world datasets, demonstrating that i) our cross-modal paradigm achieves competitive performance compared to fully supervised methods without requiring expensive depth annotations, and ii) our VFM-based models achieve state-of-the-art performance
authors: Luca Bartolomei, Enrico Mannocci, Fabio Tosi, Matteo Poggi, Stefano Mattoccia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19669-19678

title: DepthSync: 基于扩散引导的深度同步方法用于尺度和几何一致的视频深度估计
title_en: DepthSync: Diffusion Guidance-Based Depth Synchronization for Scale- and Geometry-Consistent Video Depth Estimation
abstract: 基于扩散的视频深度估计方法凭借强大的泛化能力取得了显著成功。然而,预测长视频的深度仍面临挑战。现有方法通常将视频分割为重叠的滑动窗口,导致不同窗口间累积的尺度差异,尤其在窗口数量增加时更为明显。此外,这些方法仅依赖二维扩散先验,忽视了视频深度固有的三维几何结构,从而导致几何不一致的预测。本文提出DepthSync,一种无需训练的新型框架,利用扩散引导实现长视频的尺度和几何一致的深度预测。具体而言,我们引入尺度引导以同步窗口间的深度尺度,并基于视频深度固有的三维约束,通过几何引导强制窗口内几何对齐。这两个项协同作用,引导去噪过程朝向一致的深度预测。在多个数据集上的实验验证了我们的方法在提升长视频深度估计的尺度和几何一致性方面的有效性。
abstract_en: Diffusion-based video depth estimation methods have achieved remarkable success with strong generalization ability. However, predicting depth for long videos remains challenging. Existing methods typically split videos into overlapping sliding windows, leading to accumulated scale discrepancies across different windows, particularly as the number of windows increases. Additionally, these methods rely solely on 2D diffusion priors, overlooking the inherent 3D geometric structure of video depths, which results in geometrically inconsistent predictions.In this paper, we propose DepthSync, a novel, training-free framework using diffusion guidance to achieve scale- and geometry-consistent depth predictions for long videos. Specifically, we introduce scale guidance to synchronize the depth scale across windows and geometry guidance to enforce geometric alignment within windows based on the inherent 3D constraints in video depths. These two terms work synergistically, steering the denoising process toward consistent depth predictions. Experiments on various datasets validate the effectiveness of our method in producing depth estimates with improved scale and geometry consistency, particularly for long videos.
authors: Yue-Jiang Dong, Wang Zhao, Jiale Xu, Ying Shan, Song-Hai Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5415-5425

title: Derm1M:面向皮肤病学的百万级视觉-语言数据集,与临床本体知识对齐
title_en: Derm1M: A Million-scale Vision-Language Dataset Aligned with Clinical Ontology Knowledge for Dermatology
abstract: 视觉-语言模型的出现改变了医学AI,推动了诊断能力与临床应用的突破性进展。然而,由于缺乏标准图像-文本对,皮肤病学领域的发展滞后于其他医学领域。现有皮肤病学数据集在规模和深度上均存在局限,仅提供狭窄疾病范围内的单标签注释而非丰富的文本描述,且缺乏实际应用所需的临床背景信息。为解决这些局限,我们提出Derm1M,首个面向皮肤病学的百万级视觉-语言数据集,包含1,029,761对图像-文本对。该数据集基于专家共同开发的标准本体结构构建,涵盖4个层级、130个临床概念及390多种皮肤状况,包含医疗史、症状、肤色等丰富的上下文信息。为验证Derm1M在推动AI研究与临床应用方面的潜力,我们在该数据集上预训练了系列CLIP-like模型,统称为DermLIP。DermLIP家族在零样本皮肤疾病分类、临床与伪影概念识别、少样本/全样本学习及跨模态检索等8个多样化数据集上均显著超越现有最先进基础模型。我们的数据集与代码已开源于https://github.com/SiyuanYan1/Derm1M。
abstract_en: The emergence of vision-language models has transformed medical AI, enabling unprecedented advances in diagnostic capability and clinical applications. However, progress in dermatology has lagged behind other medical domains due to the lack of standard image-text pairs. Existing dermatological datasets are limited in both scale and depth, offering only single-label annotations across a narrow range of diseases instead of rich textual descriptions, and lacking the crucial clinical context needed for real-world applications. To address these limitations, we present Derm1M, the first large-scale vision-language dataset for dermatology, comprising 1,029,761 image-text pairs. Built from diverse educational resources and structured around a standard ontology collaboratively developed by experts, Derm1M provides comprehensive coverage for over 390 skin conditions across four hierarchical levels and 130 clinical concepts with rich contextual information such as medical history, symptoms, and skin tone. To demonstrate Derm1M's potential in advancing both AI research and clinical application, we pretrained a series of CLIP-like models, collectively called DermLIP, on this dataset. The DermLIP family significantly outperforms state-of-the-art foundation models on eight diverse datasets across multiple tasks, including zero-shot skin disease classification, clinical and artifacts concept identification, few-shot/full-shot learning, and cross-modal retrieval. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/SiyuanYan1/Derm1M.
authors: Siyuan Yan, Ming Hu, Yiwen Jiang, Xieji Li, Hao Fei, Philipp Tschandl, Harald Kittler, Zongyuan Ge ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12681-12690

title: Describe Anything: 详细定位图像与视频描述生成
title_en: Describe Anything: Detailed Localized Image and Video Captioning
abstract: 生成图像和视频中特定区域的详细准确描述仍然是视觉-语言模型的基本挑战。我们引入了Describe Anything模型(DAM),该模型专门设计用于详细定位描述(DLC)。DAM通过两项关键创新保持局部细节与全局上下文:焦点提示,确保目标区域的高分辨率编码;局部视觉主干网络,将精确定位与更广泛的上下文整合。为应对高质量DLC数据稀缺问题,我们提出基于半监督学习(SSL)的数据管道(DLC-SDP)。DLC-SDP以现有分割数据集为基础,通过SSL扩展至未标记的网络图像。我们引入DLC-Bench基准测试,专门用于无需参考描述的DLC评估。DAM在涵盖关键词级、短语级和详细多句定位图像与视频描述的7个基准测试中均达到最先进水平。
abstract_en: Generating detailed and accurate descriptions for specific regions in images and videos remains a fundamental challenge for vision-language models. We introduce the Describe Anything Model (DAM), a model designed for detailed localized captioning (DLC). DAM preserves both local details and global context through two key innovations: a focal prompt, which ensures high-resolution encoding of targeted regions, and a localized vision backbone, which integrates precise localization with its broader context. To tackle the scarcity of high-quality DLC data, we propose a Semi-supervised learning (SSL)-based Data Pipeline (DLC-SDP). DLC-SDP starts with existing segmentation datasets and expands to unlabeled web images using SSL. We introduce DLC-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate DLC without relying on reference captions. DAM sets new state-of-the-art on 7 benchmarks spanning keyword-level, phrase-level, and detailed multi-sentence localized image and video captioning.
authors: Long Lian, Yifan Ding, Yunhao Ge, Sifei Liu, Hanzi Mao, Boyi Li, Marco Pavone, Ming-Yu Liu, Trevor Darrell, Adam Yala, Yin Cui ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21766-21777

title: Describe, Adapt and Combine: Empowering CLIP Encoders for Open-set 3D Object Retrieval
title_en: Describe, Adapt and Combine: Empowering CLIP Encoders for Open-set 3D Object Retrieval
abstract: 开放集3D物体检索(3DOR)是一项新兴任务,旨在检索训练集之外的未见过类别的3D物体。现有方法通常利用所有模态(即体素、点云、多视角图像)并在融合前训练特定主干网络。然而,由于3D训练数据不足,它们仍难以生成泛化表示。在大规模网络图像-文本对上对比预训练的CLIP模型,能够为广泛下游任务生成泛化表示。在此基础上,我们提出了一种简单而有效的框架,名为Describe, Adapt and Combine(DAC),仅使用多视角图像进行开放集3DOR。DAC创新性地将CLIP模型与多模态大语言模型(MLLM)协同,学习泛化3D表示,其中MLLM用于双重目的。首先,在训练过程中,它描述已见类别信息以对齐CLIP的训练目标进行适配;其次,在推理过程中,它提供补充视觉线索的未知物体外部提示。为增强协同效果,我们引入了加性偏置低秩适配(AB-LoRA),缓解过拟合并进一步提升对未见类别的泛化能力。仅使用多视角图像,DAC在四个开放集3DOR数据集上平均超越现有方法10.01% mAP。此外,其泛化能力也在基于图像和跨数据集设置中得到验证。代码可在https://github.com/wangzhichuan123/DAC获取。
abstract_en: Open-set 3D object retrieval (3DOR) is an emerging task aiming to retrieve 3D objects of unseen categories beyond the training set. Existing methods typically utilize all modalities (i.e., voxels, point clouds, multi-view images) and train specific backbones before fusion. However, they still struggle to produce generalized representations due to insufficient 3D training data. Being contrastively pre-trained on web-scale image-text pairs, CLIP inherently produces generalized representations for a wide range of downstream tasks. Building upon it, we present a simple yet effective framework named Describe, Adapt and Combine (DAC) by taking only multi-view images for open-set 3DOR. DAC innovatively synergizes a CLIP model with a multi-modal large language model (MLLM) to learn generalized 3D representations, where the MLLM is used for dual purposes. First, it describes the seen category information to align with CLIP's training objective for adaptation during training. Second, it provides external hints about unknown objects complementary to visual cues during inference. To improve the synergy, we introduce an Additive-Bias Low-Rank adaptation (AB-LoRA), which alleviates overfitting and further enhances the generalization to unseen categories. With only multi-view images, DAC significantly surpasses prior arts by an average of +10.01% mAP on four open-set 3DOR datasets. Moreover, its generalization is also validated on image-based and cross-dataset setups. Code is available at https://github.com/wangzhichuan123/DAC.
authors: Zhichuan Wang, Yang Zhou, Zhe Liu, Rui Yu, Song Bai, Yulong Wang, Xinwei He, Xiang Bai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21026-21036

title: 描述,而非指令:基于自然语言意图的语义图像编辑
title_en: Describe, Don't Dictate: Semantic Image Editing with Natural Language Intent
abstract: 尽管文本到图像生成技术取得了进展,语义图像编辑仍面临挑战。基于反演的算法不可避免地引入重建误差,而基于指令的模型主要受制于数据集质量与规模的限制。为解决这些问题,我们提出一种基于描述提示的编辑框架,命名为DescriptiveEdit。其核心思想是将"基于指令的图像编辑"重新定义为"基于参考图像的文本到图像生成",在无需架构修改或反演的情况下保留训练良好的文本到图像模型的生成能力。具体而言,输入参考图像和提示后,我们引入交叉注意力UNet,新增注意力桥梁将参考图像特征注入到提示到编辑图像的生成过程中。得益于其文本到图像的本质特性,DescriptiveEdit克服了指令数据集质量的局限性,可无缝集成ControlNet、IP-Adapter等扩展模块,并具有更好的可扩展性。在Emu Edit基准测试中,实验结果表明其提升了编辑的准确性与一致性。
abstract_en: Despite the progress in text-to-image generation, semantic image editing remains a challenge. Inversion-based algorithms unavoidably introduce reconstruction errors, while instruction-based models mainly suffer from limited dataset quality and scale. To address these problems, we propose a descriptive-prompt-based editing framework, named DescriptiveEdit. The core idea is to re-frame `instruction-based image editing' as `reference-image-based text-to-image generation', which preserves the generative power of well-trained Text-to-Image models without architectural modifications or inversion. Specifically, taking the reference image and a prompt as input, we introduce a Cross-Attentive UNet, which newly adds attention bridges to inject reference image features into the prompt-to-edit-image generation process. Owing to its text-to-image nature, DescriptiveEdit overcomes limitations in instruction dataset quality, integrates seamlessly with ControlNet, IP-Adapter, and other extensions, and is more scalable. Experiments on the Emu Edit benchmark show it improves editing accuracy and consistency.
authors: En Ci, Shanyan Guan, Yanhao Ge, Yilin Zhang, Wei Li, Zhenyu Zhang, Jian Yang, Ying Tai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19185-19194

title: 细节对室内开放词汇三维实例分割的重要性
title_en: Details Matter for Indoor Open-vocabulary 3D Instance Segmentation
abstract: 与通常端到端训练的封闭词汇三维实例分割不同,开放词汇三维实例分割(OV-3DIS)常利用视觉-语言模型(VLMs)生成三维实例提案并进行分类。尽管已有研究提出了多种概念,但我们观察到这些个体概念并非互斥而是互补的。本文通过精心设计组合这些概念的方案并对其进行优化以解决关键挑战,提出了一种新的OV-3DIS最先进解决方案。我们的方法采用两阶段方案:三维提案生成和实例分类。我们采用基于鲁棒三维跟踪的提案聚合生成三维提案,并通过迭代合并/移除去除重叠或部分提案。在分类阶段,我们将标准CLIP模型替换为Alpha-CLIP,其将物体掩码作为alpha通道以降低背景噪声并获得以物体为中心的表示。此外,我们引入标准化最大相似度(SMS)分数对文本-提案相似度进行归一化,有效过滤假阳性并提升精度。我们的框架在ScanNet200和S3DIS数据集上所有AP和AR指标均达到最先进性能,甚至超越了端到端封闭词汇方法。
abstract_en: Unlike closed-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation that is often trained end-to-end, open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation (OV-3DIS) often leverages vision-language models (VLMs) to generate 3D instance proposals and classify them. While various concepts have been proposed from existing research, we observe that these individual concepts are not mutually exclusive but complementary. In this paper, we propose a new state-of-the-art solution for OV-3DIS by carefully designing a recipe to combine the concepts together and refining them to address key challenges. Our solution follows the two-stage scheme: 3D proposal generation and instance classification. We employ robust 3D tracking-based proposal aggregation to generate 3D proposals and remove overlapped or partial proposals by iterative merging/removal. For the classification stage, we replace the standard CLIP model with Alpha-CLIP, which incorporates object masks as an alpha channel to reduce background noise and obtain object-centric representation. Additionally, we introduce the standardized maximum similarity (SMS) score to normalize text-to-proposal similarity, effectively filtering out false positives and boosting precision. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on ScanNet200 and S3DIS across all AP and AR metrics, even surpassing an end-to-end closed-vocabulary method.
authors: Sanghun Jung, Jingjing Zheng, Ke Zhang, Nan Qiao, Albert Y. C. Chen, Lu Xia, Chi Liu, Yuyin Sun, Xiao Zeng, Hsiang-Wei Huang, Byron Boots, Min Sun, Cheng-Hao Kuo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9627-9637

title: 在开放场景中检测任意3D目标
title_en: Detect Anything 3D in the Wild
abstract: 尽管深度学习在封闭集3D目标检测中取得了成功,现有方法在零样本泛化到新物体和相机配置时仍存在困难。我们提出DetAny3D,一种可提示的3D检测基础模型,仅通过单目输入即可在任意相机配置下检测任意新物体。训练3D检测基础模型本质上受标注3D数据有限的制约,这促使DetAny3D利用广泛预训练2D基础模型中嵌入的丰富先验知识来弥补这一不足。为有效实现2D到3D的知识迁移,DetAny3D包含两个核心模块:2D聚合器,用于对齐不同2D基础模型的特征;以及带有零嵌入映射的3D解释器,用于稳定2D到3D知识迁移的早期训练。实验结果验证了DetAny3D的强泛化能力,不仅在未见过的类别和新相机配置上达到最先进性能,还在领域内数据上超越了大多数竞争对手。DetAny3D展示了3D基础模型在现实场景多样化应用的潜力,例如自动驾驶中的稀有物体检测,并展示了其在开放世界环境下进一步探索3D中心任务的前景。更多可视化结果可访问我们的代码仓库。
abstract_en: Despite the success of deep learning in close-set 3D object detection, existing approaches struggle with zero-shot generalization to novel objects and camera configurations. We introduce DetAny3D, a promptable 3D detection foundation model capable of detecting any novel object under arbitrary camera configurations using only monocular inputs. Training a foundation model for 3D detection is fundamentally constrained by the limited availability of annotated 3D data, which motivates DetAny3D to leverage the rich prior knowledge embedded in extensively pre-trained 2D foundation models to compensate for this scarcity. To effectively transfer 2D knowledge to 3D, DetAny3D incorporates two core modules: the 2D Aggregator, which aligns features from different 2D foundation models, and the 3D Interpreter with Zero-Embedding Mapping, which stabilizes early training in 2D-to-3D knowledge transfer. Experimental results validate the strong generalization of our DetAny3D, which not only achieves state-of-the-art performance on unseen categories and novel camera configurations, but also surpasses most competitors on in-domain data. DetAny3D sheds light on the potential of the 3D foundation model for diverse applications in real-world scenarios, e.g., rare object detection in autonomous driving, and demonstrates promise for further exploration of 3D-centric tasks in open-world settings. More visualization results can be found at our code repository.
authors: Hanxue Zhang, Haoran Jiang, Qingsong Yao, Yanan Sun, Renrui Zhang, Hao Zhao, Hongyang Li, Hongzi Zhu, Zetong Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5048-5059

title: 多体检测、姿态估计与分割:构建良性循环
title_en: Detection, Pose Estimation and Segmentation for Multiple Bodies: Closing the Virtuous Circle
abstract: 人体姿态估计方法在孤立个体上表现良好,但在近距离多体场景中存在困难。先前工作通过检测到的边界框或关键点来条件姿态估计,但忽略了实例掩码。我们提出通过迭代强化边界框、实例掩码和姿态之间的相互一致性。引入的BBox-Mask-Pose(BMP)方法使用三个专用模型,在闭环中相互提升输出质量。所有模型均适配相互条件约束,从而提升多体场景的鲁棒性。新型基于掩码条件的姿态估计模型MaskPose在OCHuman数据集的自顶向下方法中表现最佳。BBox-Mask-Pose在OCHuman数据集的检测、实例分割和姿态估计三项任务中均达到当前最优性能,同时在COCO姿态估计任务中也取得当前最优结果。该方法在大实例重叠场景中表现尤为突出,相比基线检测器检测性能提升39%。凭借小型专用模型和更快的运行速度,BMP成为大型人体中心基础模型的有效替代方案。代码和权重可在项目网站获取:MiraPurkrabek.github.io/BBox-Mask-Pose/
abstract_en: Human pose estimation methods work well on isolated people but struggle with multiple-bodies-in-proximity scenarios. Previous work has addressed this problem by conditioning pose estimation by detected bounding boxes or keypoints, but overlooked instance masks. We propose to iteratively enforce mutual consistency of bounding boxes, instance masks, and poses. The introduced BBox-Mask-Pose (BMP) method uses three specialized models that improve each other's output in a closed loop. All models are adapted for mutual conditioning, which improves robustness in multi-body scenes. MaskPose, a new mask-conditioned pose estimation model, is the best among top-down approaches on OCHuman. BBox-Mask-Pose pushes SOTA on OCHuman dataset in all three tasks - detection, instance segmentation, and pose estimation. It also achieves SOTA performance on COCO pose estimation. The method is especially good in scenes with large instances overlap, where it improves detection by 39% over the baseline detector. With small specialized models and faster runtime, BMP is an effective alternative to large human-centered foundational models. Code and weights are available on the project website: MiraPurkrabek.github.io/BBox-Mask-Pose/
authors: Miroslav Purkrabek, Jiri Matas ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9004-9013

title: 确定性物体姿态置信区域估计
title_en: Deterministic Object Pose Confidence Region Estimation
abstract: 六维姿态置信区域估计已成为一个关键研究方向,旨在通过不确定性量化来评估估计姿态的可靠性。然而,当前基于采样的方法存在严重限制,严重阻碍了其实际部署:1)随着采样数量的增加,采样速度显著下降。2)推导出的置信区域往往过大。为解决这些挑战,我们提出了一种确定性且高效的姿态置信区域估计方法。我们的方法利用归纳一致性预测,将确定性回归的高斯关键点分布校准为二维关键点置信区域。随后,我们借助隐函数定理将这些关键点置信区域直接传播为六维姿态置信区域。该方法避免了采样和集成所带来的低效性和区域尺寸膨胀问题。它提供了紧凑的置信区域,以用户定义的置信水平覆盖真实姿态。在LineMOD Occlusion和SPEED数据集上的实验结果表明,我们的方法在减少计算时间的同时实现了更高的姿态估计精度。对于相同的覆盖率,我们的方法生成显著更小的置信区域体积,旋转方向减少高达99.9%,平移方向减少高达99.8%。代码将在不久后发布。
abstract_en: 6D pose confidence region estimation has emerged as a critical direction, aiming to perform uncertainty quantification for assessing the reliability of estimated poses. However, current sampling-based approach suffers from critical limitations that severely impede their practical deployment: 1) the sampling speed significantly decreases as the number of samples increases. 2) the derived confidence regions are often excessively large. To address these challenges, we propose a deterministic and efficient method for estimating pose confidence regions. Our approach uses inductive conformal prediction to calibrate the deterministically regressed Gaussian keypoint distributions into 2D keypoint confidence regions. We then leverage the implicit function theorem to propagate these keypoint confidence regions directly into 6D pose confidence regions. This method avoids the inefficiency and inflated region sizes associated with sampling and ensembling. It provides compact confidence regions that cover the ground-truth poses with a user-defined confidence level. Experimental results on the LineMOD Occlusion and SPEED datasets show that our method achieves higher pose estimation accuracy with reduced computational time. For the same coverage rate, our method yields significantly smaller confidence region volumes, reducing them by up to 99.9% for rotations and 99.8% for translations. The code will be available soon.
authors: Jinghao Wang, Zhang Li, Zi Wang, Banglei Guan, Yang Shang, Qifeng Yu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14866-14875

title: 魔鬼藏在统一性中:基于Transformer的多样化学习者探索用于图像修复
title_en: Devil is in the Uniformity: Exploring Diverse Learners within Transformer for Image Restoration
abstract: 基于Transformer的方法在图像修复领域受到广泛关注,其中核心组件即多头注意力机制(MHA)在捕捉多样化特征和恢复高质量结果方面发挥着关键作用。在MHA中,各头在统一划分的子空间中独立进行注意力计算,由此引发冗余问题,阻碍模型获得满意输出。本文提出通过探索多样化学习者并引入头之间的多种交互来改进MHA,从而构建一种分层多头注意力驱动的Transformer模型(HINT),用于图像修复。HINT包含两个模块,即分层多头注意力机制(HMHA)和查询-键缓存更新模块(QKCU),以解决源于原始MHA的冗余问题。具体而言,HMHA通过让各头从不同尺寸且包含不同信息的子空间中学习,提取多样化上下文特征。此外,QKCU模块包含层内与层间方案,通过促进注意力头在层内及跨层间的增强交互,进一步降低冗余问题。在包括低光照增强、去雾、去雪、去噪和去雨在内的5类图像修复任务的12个基准数据集上进行了大量实验,以验证HINT的优越性。源代码见补充材料。
abstract_en: Transformer-based approaches have gained significant attention in image restoration, where the core component, i.e, Multi-Head Attention (MHA), plays a crucial role in capturing diverse features and recovering high-quality results. In MHA, heads perform attention calculation independently from uniform split subspaces, and a redundancy issue is triggered to hinder the model from achieving satisfactory outputs. In this paper, we propose to improve MHA by exploring diverse learners and introducing various interactions between heads, which results in a Hierarchical multI-head atteNtion driven Transformer model, termed HINT, for image restoration. HINT contains two modules, i.e., the Hierarchical Multi-Head Attention (HMHA) and the Query-Key Cache Updating (QKCU) module, to address the redundancy problem that is rooted in vanilla MHA. Specifically, HMHA extracts diverse contextual features by employing heads to learn from subspaces of varying sizes and containing different information. Moreover, QKCU, comprising intra- and inter-layer schemes, further reduces the redundancy problem by facilitating enhanced interactions between attention heads within and across layers. Extensive experiments are conducted on 12 benchmarks across 5 image restoration tasks, including low-light enhancement, dehazing, desnowing, denoising, and deraining, to demonstrate the superiority of HINT. The source code is available in the supplementary materials.
authors: Shihao Zhou, Dayu Li, Jinshan Pan, Juncheng Zhou, Jinglei Shi, Jufeng Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12307-12317

title: DexH2R:人机交接中的动态灵巧抓取基准
title_en: DexH2R: A Benchmark for Dynamic Dexterous Grasping in Human-to-Robot Handover
abstract: 人与灵巧机械手之间的交接是人机协作中的基础且具有挑战性的任务。它需要处理动态环境和多样化的物体,并要求具备鲁棒且自适应的抓取策略。然而,有效动态灵巧抓取方法的发展受限于缺乏高质量、真实世界的人机交接数据集。现有数据集主要关注静态物体的抓取或依赖合成交接动作,这与真实世界机器人运动模式存在显著差异,导致应用适配性存在较大差距。本文提出DexH2R,一个基于灵巧机械手的全面真实世界人机交接数据集。我们的数据集涵盖了多样化的交互物体、动态运动模式、丰富的视觉传感器数据和详细的标注信息。此外,为确保自然且类人化的灵巧运动,我们采用远程操作进行数据采集,使机器人运动与人类行为习惯保持一致,这是智能人形机器人的重要特征。同时,我们提出有效的解决方案DynamicGrasp用于人机交接,并评估了多种前沿方法,包括自回归模型和扩散策略方法,提供了全面的对比分析。我们相信,本基准将通过提供高质量数据集、有效解决方案和全面评估指标,推动人机交接研究的发展。项目地址为https://dexh2r.github.io。
abstract_en: Handover between a human and a dexterous robotic hand is a fundamental yet challenging task in human-robot collaboration. It requires handling dynamic environments and a wide variety of objects and demands robust and adaptive grasping strategies. However, progress in developing effective dynamic dexterous grasping methods is limited by the absence of high-quality, real-world human-to-robot handover datasets. Existing datasets primarily focus on grasping static objects or rely on synthesized handover motions, which differ significantly from real-world robot motion patterns, creating a substantial gap in applicability. In this paper, we introduce DexH2R, a comprehensive real-world dataset for human-to-robot handovers, built on a dexterous robotic hand. Our dataset captures a diverse range of interactive objects, dynamic motion patterns, rich visual sensor data, and detailed annotations. Additionally, to ensure natural and human-like dexterous motions, we utilize teleoperation for data collection, enabling the robot's movements to align with human behaviors and habits, which is a crucial characteristic for intelligent humanoid robots. Furthermore, we propose an effective solution, DynamicGrasp, for human-to-robot handover and evaluate various state-of-the-art approaches, including auto-regressive models and diffusion policy methods, providing a thorough comparison and analysis. We believe our benchmark will drive advancements in human-to-robot handover research by offering a high-quality dataset, effective solutions, and comprehensive evaluation metrics. Project is at https://dexh2r.github.io.
authors: Youzhuo Wang, Jiayi Ye, Chuyang Xiao, Yiming Zhong, Heng Tao, Hang Yu, Yumeng Liu, Jingyi Yu, Yuexin Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12702-12712

title: DexVLG:大规模灵巧视觉-语言-抓取模型
title_en: DexVLG: Dexterous Vision-Language-Grasp Model at Scale
abstract: 随着大模型的广泛应用,视觉-语言模型正在使机器人能够处理日益复杂的任务。然而,受限于数据收集的难度,研究主要集中在控制简单的夹爪末端执行器上。针对类人灵巧手的功能抓取,基于大模型的研究仍较为有限。本文提出DexVLG,这是一种基于单视角RGBD输入,通过语言指令对齐预测灵巧抓取姿态的大规模视觉-语言-抓取模型。为此,我们在模拟环境中生成包含174,000个物体的1.7亿个灵巧抓取姿态数据集,这些姿态与语义部件映射,并配有详细的部件级描述。该大规模数据集命名为DexGraspNet 3.0,用于训练一个基于流匹配的位姿头的视觉语言模型,生成与指令对齐的桌面物体抓取姿态。为评估DexVLG的性能,我们在模拟环境中创建基准测试并进行实际场景实验。大量实验表明,DexVLG具有强大的零样本泛化能力,在模拟环境中实现超过76%的零样本执行成功率,达到最先进的部件抓取精度,并在实际场景中成功实现部件对齐抓取。
abstract_en: As large models gain traction, vision-language models are enabling robots to tackle increasingly complex tasks. However, limited by the difficulty of data collection, progress has mainly focused on controlling simple gripper end-effectors.
