abstract: 扩散变换器(DiTs)已成为文本到图像合成的领先架构,能够生成高质量且逼真的图像。然而,DiTs中注意力的二次扩展特性阻碍了高分辨率图像生成或资源受限设备的使用。本文提出了一种高效的扩散变换器(EDiT),以缓解传统DiTs和多模态DiTs(MM-DiTs)中的效率瓶颈。首先,我们提出了一种新颖的线性压缩注意力方法,通过多层卷积网络利用局部信息调节查询,同时对键和值进行空间聚合。其次,我们为多模态输入设计了一种混合注意力方案,结合线性注意力处理图像到图像交互,以及标准缩放点积注意力处理与提示的交互。将这两种方法结合,得到一种表达能力强、线性时间复杂度的多模态高效扩散变换器(MM-EDiT)。通过将EDiT和MM-EDiT集成到PixArt-Sigma(传统DiT)和Stable Diffusion 3.5-Medium(MM-DiT)中,我们实现了蒸馏后图像质量相当的情况下最高达2.2倍的速度提升。
abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have emerged as a leading architecture for text-to-image synthesis, producing high-quality and photorealistic images. However, the quadratic scaling properties of the attention in DiTs hinder image generation with higher resolution or devices with limited resources. This work introduces an efficient diffusion transformer (EDiT) to alleviate these efficiency bottlenecks in conventional DiTs and Multimodal DiTs (MM-DiTs). First, we present a novel linear compressed attention method that uses a multi-layer convolutional network to modulate queries with local information while keys and values are spatially aggregated. Second, we formulate a hybrid attention scheme for multi-modal inputs that combines linear attention for image-to-image interactions and standard scaled dot-product attention for interactions involving prompts. Merging these two approaches leads to an expressive, linear-time Multimodal Efficient Diffusion Transformer (MM-EDiT). We demonstrate the effectiveness of the EDiT and MM-EDiT architectures by integrating them into PixArt-Sigma (conventional DiT) and Stable Diffusion 3.5-Medium (MM-DiT), achieving up to 2.2x speedup with comparable image quality after distillation.
authors: Philipp Becker, Abhinav Mehrotra, Ruchika Chavhan, Malcolm Chadwick, Luca Morreale, Mehdi Noroozi, Alberto Gil C. P. Ramos, Sourav Bhattacharya ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19608-19616

title: EEGMirror:通过无导联依赖的自监督在野外利用EEG数据进行EEG到视频解码
title_en: EEGMirror: Leveraging EEG Data in the Wild via Montage-Agnostic Self-Supervision for EEG to Video Decoding
abstract: 从脑活动生成高保真视频是脑解码研究的重要里程碑。先前的工作主要基于功能性磁共振成像(fMRI),其低时间分辨率限制了对快速脑活动的忠实反映,这促使我们转向具有高时间分辨率的脑信号如脑电图(EEG)。然而,由于EEG信号的复杂性和非平稳性以及数据标注的稀缺性,EEG到视频的转换面临挑战。为解决这些问题,我们提出**EEGMirror**。首先,我们采用神经量化技术将非平稳的原始EEG信号转换为鲁棒的离散表示。随后,引入一种无导联依赖的位置嵌入(MAPE)的掩码自监督方法。通过MAPE,EEGMirror可以处理不同导联配置(通道数量和位置)的EEG数据,从而灵活利用不同EEG数据集获取有效的EEG编码器,缓解标注良好的EEG数据不足的问题。接下来,应用多模态对比学习以对齐脑模态与动态变化和语义信息。最后,采用经过微调的膨胀Stable Diffusion模型,根据从EEG信号解码的视觉和语义信息重建视频刺激。我们证明EEGMirror在语义(82.1% vs 79.8%)和像素(0.261 vs 0.256)层面均优于现有最先进方法。还进行了详尽的消融研究以分析我们的框架。Code: https://github.com/XuanhaoLiu/EEGMirror.
abstract_en: Generating high fidelity video from brain activity is an important milestone in brain decoding research. Previous works were mostly based on functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI), whose low temporal resolution confines the ability of faithfully reflecting rapid brain activity, motivating us to turn to high temporal resolution brain signals like electroencephalography (EEG). However, EEG-to-video is challenging due to the complexity and nonstationarity of EEG signals and the scarcity of data annotations. Addressing these issues, we present **EEGMirror**. Firstly, we adopt neural quantization for converting nonstationary raw EEG signals into robust discrete representation. Afterwards, a masked self-supervision method with montage-agnostic position embedding (MAPE) is introduced. By MAPE, EEGMirror can process EEG data with various montages (number and position of channels) and thus can flexibly leverage different EEG datasets to acquire an effective EEG encoder, mitigating the lack of well-annotated EEG data. Next, multimodal contrastive learning is applied to align brain modality with dynamic changes and semantic information. Lastly, a fine-tuned inflated Stable Diffusion model is adopted to reconstruct video stimuli guided by visual and semantic information decoded from EEG signals. We show that EEGMirror outperforms the state-of-the-art performance in both semantic (82.1% vs 79.8%) and pixel (0.261 vs 0.256) levels. An exhaustive ablation study is also conducted to analyze our framework. Code: https://github.com/XuanhaoLiu/EEGMirror.
authors: Xuan-Hao Liu, Bao-Liang Lu, Wei-Long Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18273-18283

title: EEdit : 重新思考基于空间与时间冗余的高效图像编辑
title_en: EEdit : Rethinking the Spatial and Temporal Redundancy for Efficient Image Editing
abstract: 基于反演的图像编辑技术正快速发展,但其显著的计算开销限制了其在实时交互场景中的应用。本文重新审视了基于反演的图像编辑中存在空间与时间冗余问题,例如未编辑区域的冗余计算和反演过程的冗余步骤。为解决这些挑战,我们提出了一种高效的编辑框架EEdit,实现高效图像编辑。具体而言,我们引入了三种技术逐一解决这些问题。针对空间冗余,引入了空间局部性缓存技术,通过跳过未编辑区域计算编辑区域及其邻近区域,并设计标记索引预处理进一步加速缓存。针对时间冗余,提出反演步骤跳过技术,通过复用潜在表示实现高效编辑。实验表明,在包括提示引导图像编辑、拖拽和图像合成在内的广泛编辑任务中,我们的方法在保持性能不变的情况下平均加速了2.46倍。代码已开源至https://github.com/yuriYanZeXuan/EEdit。
abstract_en: Inversion-based image editing is rapidly gaining momentum while suffering from significant computation overhead, hindering its application in real-time interactive scenarios. In this paper, we rethink that the redundancy in inversion-based image editing exists in both the spatial and temporal dimensions, such as the unnecessary computation in unedited regions and the redundancy in the inversion progress. To tackle these challenges, we propose an Efficient Editing framework, named EEdit, to achieve efficient image editing. Specifically, we introduce three techniques to solve them one by one. For spatial redundancy, spatial locality caching is introduced to compute the edited region and its neighboring regions while skipping the unedited regions, and token indexing preprocessing is designed to further accelerate the caching. For temporal redundancy, inversion step skipping is proposed to reuse the latent for efficient editing. Our experiments demonstrate an average of 2.46x acceleration without performance drop in a wide range of editing tasks including prompt-guided image editing, dragging and image composition. Our codes are available at https://github.com/yuriYanZeXuan/EEdit.
authors: Zexuan Yan, Yue Ma, Chang Zou, Wenteng Chen, Qifeng Chen, Linfeng Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17474-17484

title: EFTViT:面向资源受限客户端的高效视觉变换器联邦训练方法
title_en: EFTViT: Efficient Federated Training of Vision Transformers with Masked Images on Resource-Constrained Clients
abstract: 联邦学习研究近期因视觉变换器(ViTs)的卓越容量特性,已从卷积神经网络(CNNs)转向ViTs。由于缺乏CNN固有的2D归纳偏置,ViTs训练对计算资源需求更高。然而,针对资源受限客户端的高效ViTs联邦训练仍属研究空白。本文提出EFTViT,一种基于掩码图像的分层联邦框架,可在资源受限客户端实现高效全参数训练,为异构数据学习提供显著优势。总体而言,我们对图像进行分块处理并随机掩码部分块,观察到排除这些块进行训练对性能影响极小,同时显著降低计算成本并增强数据内容隐私保护。具体而言,EFTViT包含一系列轻量级本地模块和一个更大规模的全局模块,分别在客户端和中心服务器上独立更新。本地模块基于未掩码图像块进行训练,而全局模块则基于本地客户端上传的中间块特征进行训练,通过提出的中位数采样策略平衡,以消除客户端数据分布隐私。我们分析了EFTViT的计算复杂度和隐私保护特性。在主流基准测试中,大量实验表明EFTViT可将本地训练计算成本降低最高达5.6倍,本地训练时间缩短最高达3.1倍,并相较现有方法实现最高2.46%的准确率提升。
abstract_en: Federated learning research has recently shifted from Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to Vision Transformers (ViTs) due to their superior capacity. ViTs training demands higher computational resources due to the lack of 2D inductive biases inherent in CNNs. However, efficient federated training of ViTs on resource-constrained clients remains unexplored in the community. In this paper, we propose EFTViT, a hierarchical federated framework that leverages masked images to enable efficient, full-parameter training on resource-constrained clients, offering substantial benefits for learning on heterogeneous data. In general, we patchify images and randomly mask a portion of the patches, observing that excluding them from training has minimal impact on performance while substantially reducing computation costs and enhancing data content privacy protection. Specifically, EFTViT comprises a series of lightweight local modules and a larger global module, updated independently on clients and the central server, respectively. The local modules are trained on unmasked image patches, while the global module is trained on intermediate patch features uploaded from the local client, balanced through a proposed median sampling strategy to erase client data distribution privacy. We analyze the computational complexity and privacy protection of EFTViT. We analyze the computational complexity and privacy protection of EFTViT. Extensive experiments on popular benchmarks show that EFTViT reduces local training computational cost by up to 5.6x, cuts local training time by up to 3.1x, and achieves up to 2.46% accuracy improvement compared to existing methods.
authors: Meihan Wu, Tao Chang, Cui Miao, Jie Zhou, Chun Li, Xiangyu Xu, Ming Li, Xiaodong Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1815-1824

title: EMD:面向高质量街道高斯点云的显式运动建模
title_en: EMD: Explicit Motion Modeling for High-Quality Street Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 街道场景的逼真重建对于开发自动驾驶的现实世界模拟器至关重要。尽管基于3D/4D高斯点云(GS)的最新方法已展现出有希望的结果,但它们在复杂街道场景中仍面临动态物体不可预测运动带来的挑战。现有方法通常将街道场景分解为静态和动态物体,通过监督方式(如配合3D边界框)或自监督方式(如不配合3D边界框)学习高斯分布。然而,这些方法未能有效建模动态物体的运动(例如行人运动速度与车辆明显不同),导致场景分解效果欠佳。为解决这一问题,我们提出显式运动分解(EMD),通过向高斯分布引入可学习的运动嵌入来建模动态物体的运动,提升街道场景的分解效果。所提出的即插即用EMD模块弥补了自监督街道高斯点云方法在运动建模方面的不足。我们还引入定制化训练策略以扩展EMD至监督方法。综合实验验证了我们方法的有效性,在自监督设置下实现了最先进的新视角合成性能。代码已开源:https://qingpowuwu.github.io/emd
abstract_en: Photorealistic reconstruction of street scenes is essential for developing real-world simulators in autonomous driving. While recent methods based on 3D/4D Gaussian Splatting (GS) have demonstrated promising results, they still encounter challenges in complex street scenes due to the unpredictable motion of dynamic objects. Current methods typically decompose street scenes into static and dynamic objects, learning the Gaussians in either a supervised manner (e.g., w/ 3D bounding-box) or a self-supervised manner (e.g., w/o 3D bounding-box). However, these approaches do not effectively model the motions of dynamic objects (e.g., the motion speed of pedestrians is clearly different from that of vehicles), resulting in suboptimal scene decomposition. To address this, we propose Explicit Motion Decomposition (EMD), which models the motions of dynamic objects by introducing learnable motion embeddings to the Gaussians, enhancing the decomposition in street scenes. The proposed plug-and-play EMD module compensates for the lack of motion modeling in self-supervised street Gaussian splatting methods. We also introduce tailored training strategies to extend EMD to supervised approaches. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, achieving state-of-the-art novel view synthesis performance in self-supervised settings. The code is available at: https://qingpowuwu.github.io/emd
authors: Xiaobao Wei, Qingpo Wuwu, Zhongyu Zhao, Zhuangzhe Wu, Nan Huang, Ming Lu, Ningning Ma, Shanghang Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28462-28472

title: EMatch:基于事件的光流与立体匹配的统一框架
title_en: EMatch: A Unified Framework for Event-based Optical Flow and Stereo Matching
abstract: 事件相机在光流估计和立体匹配等视觉应用中展现出巨大潜力,许多研究提出了专门的架构。然而,现有工作仅局限于任务特定领域的事件数据,忽视了时域和空域任务间的关联性。本文提出了一种新颖的基于匹配的框架,用于事件相机在共享表征空间中同时估计光流和视差,将其重新表述为统一的像素级对应匹配问题。具体而言,我们的方法利用时序循环网络聚合时域或空域中的异步事件特征,并通过时域或空域交互增强事件流间的知识迁移。通过共享的像素级特征相似性模块,我们的网络可同时从时序事件片段进行光流估计,从空域事件片段进行立体匹配。该统一模型天然支持多任务统一和跨任务迁移,有利于训练和部署。无需针对特定任务重新训练,我们的模型可有效处理基于事件的光流和立体估计,在两项任务中均达到最先进性能。我们的代码将在接受后发布。
abstract_en: Event cameras have shown promise in vision applications like optical flow estimation and stereo matching with many specialized architectures. However, existing works only focus event data within the confines of task-specific domains, overlooking the correlations between tasks across the temporal and spatial domains. In this paper, we propose a novel matching-based framework for event cameras to estimate flow and disparity simultaneously in a shared representation space, reformulating them as a unified pixel-wise correspondence matching problem. Specifically, our method utilizes a Temporal Recurrent Network to aggregate asynchronous event features across temporal or spatial domains, and a Spatial Contextual Attention to enhance knowledge transfer across event flows via temporal or spatial interactions. By utilizing a shared pixel-wise feature similarities module, our network performs optical flow estimation from temporal event segments and stereo matching from spatial event segments simultaneously. Our unified model inherently supports multi-task unification and cross-task transfer, which facilitate training and streamline deployment. Without the need for retraining on specific tasks, our model can effectively handle both event-based flow and stereo estimation, achieving state-of-the-art performance on both tasks. Our code will be released upon acceptance.
authors: Pengjie Zhang, Lin Zhu, Xiao Wang, Lizhi Wang, Hua Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5845-5855

title: EMoTive:基于事件的轨迹建模用于三维运动估计
title_en: EMoTive: Event-guided Trajectory Modeling for 3D Motion Estimation
abstract: 视觉三维运动估计旨在基于视觉线索推断二维像素在三维空间中的运动。主要挑战源于深度变化引起的时空运动不一致性,破坏了先前运动估计框架中对局部空间或时间运动平滑性的假设。相比之下,事件相机通过连续自适应的像素级响应场景变化,为三维运动估计提供了新可能性。本文提出EMoTive,一种新颖的基于事件的框架,通过事件引导的非均匀参数化曲线建模时空轨迹,有效表征局部异质时空运动。具体而言,我们首先引入事件条纹图(Event Kymograph)——一种事件投影方法,利用连续时间投影核并解耦空间观测以显式编码细粒度时间演化。在运动表示方面,我们引入密度感知的自适应机制,在事件引导下融合空间与时间特征,并结合非均匀有理曲线参数化框架以自适应建模异质轨迹。最终通过参数轨迹的多时序采样实现三维运动估计,生成光流与深度运动场。为便于评估,我们提出CarlaEvent3D,一个多动态合成数据集用于全面验证。在该数据集和真实场景基准上的大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Visual 3D motion estimation aims to infer the motion of 2D pixels in 3D space based on visual cues. The key challenge arises from depth variation induced spatio-temporal motion inconsistencies, disrupting the assumptions of local spatial or temporal motion smoothness in previous motion estimation frameworks. In contrast, event cameras offer new possibilities for 3D motion estimation through continuous adaptive pixel-level responses to scene changes. This paper presents EMoTive, a novel event-based framework that models spatio-temporal trajectories via event-guided non-uniform parametric curves, effectively characterizing locally heterogeneous spatio-temporal motion. Specifically, we first introduce Event Kymograph - an event projection method that leverages a continuous temporal projection kernel and decouples spatial observations to encode fine-grained temporal evolution explicitly. For motion representation, we introduce a density-aware adaptation mechanism to fuse spatial and temporal features under event guidance, coupled with a non-uniform rational curve parameterization framework to adaptively model heterogeneous trajectories. The final 3D motion estimation is achieved through multi-temporal sampling of parametric trajectories, yielding optical flow and depth motion fields. To facilitate evaluation, we introduce CarlaEvent3D, a multi-dynamic synthetic dataset for comprehensive validation. Extensive experiments on both this dataset and a real-world benchmark demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
authors: Zengyu Wan, Wei Zhai, Yang Cao, Zhengjun Zha ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9342-9351

title: ERNet: 面向点序列的高效非刚性配准网络
title_en: ERNet: Efficient Non-Rigid Registration Network for Point Sequences
abstract: 将物体形状配准到经历非刚性形变的点云序列是一个长期存在的挑战。关键困难源于两个因素:(i) 由于配准目标的非凸性导致局部极小值的存在,特别是在噪声或部分输入情况下,这阻碍了准确且鲁棒的形变估计;(ii) 在长序列中误差累积导致跟踪失败。为解决这些挑战,我们采用可扩展的数据驱动方法,提出\methodname,一种高效的前馈模型,其在大形变数据集上进行训练。该模型设计用于处理噪声和部分输入,同时有效利用时序信息实现准确且一致的序列配准。我们设计的核心在于通过两阶段管道预测形变图序列,首先估计帧级粗略图节点以实现鲁棒初始化,随后以滑动窗口方式在时间维度上优化其轨迹。大量实验表明,我们提出的方法(i)在DeformingThings4D和D-FAUST数据集上均超越先前最先进方法,(ii)相比先前最佳方法实现超过4倍的速度提升,显著提高了效率。
abstract_en: Registering an object shape to a sequence of point clouds undergoing non-rigid deformation is a long-standing challenge. The key difficulties stem from two factors: (i) the presence of local minima due to the non-convexity of registration objectives, especially under noisy or partial inputs, which hinders accurate and robust deformation estimation, and (ii) error accumulation over long sequences, leading to tracking failures. To address these challenges, we introduce to adopt a scalable data-driven approach and propose \methodname, an efficient feed-forward model trained on large deformation datasets.It is designed to handle noisy and partial inputs while effectively leveraging temporal information for accurate and consistent sequential registration. The key to our design is predicting a sequence of deformation graphs through a two-stage pipeline, which first estimates frame-wise coarse graph nodes for robust initialization, before refining their trajectories over time in a sliding-window fashion. Extensive experiments show that our proposed approach (i) outperforms previous state of the art on both the DeformingThings4D and D-FAUST datasets, and (ii) achieves more than 4x speedup compared to the previous best, offering significant efficiency improvement.
authors: Guangzhao He, Yuxi Xiao, Zhen Xu, Xiaowei Zhou, Sida Peng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27156-27165

title: ESCNet:面向伪装目标检测的边缘-语义协同网络
title_en: ESCNet:Edge-Semantic Collaborative Network for Camouflaged Object Detection
abstract: 伪装目标检测(COD)面临独特挑战,目标边界因与背景的纹理相似性而本质模糊。现有依赖单模态特征的方法常因边界约束不足导致预测碎片化。为解决此问题,我们提出ESCNet,其动态耦合的边缘-纹理感知机制。框架包含三项核心创新:1)自适应边缘-纹理感知器(AETP),基于图像多尺度特征与Transformer全局语义上下文,实现边缘与纹理信息的相互增强;2)双流特征增强器(DSFA),根据局部纹理复杂度与边缘方向动态调整核采样位置,精准增强分形边界与非晶态纹理区域的特征信息;3)多特征调制模块(MFMM),通过增强的边缘感知表征与多尺度纹理分层集成,建立特征校准与模型预测的渐进细粒度优化。该互联系统形成反馈回路,增强的边缘感知表征提升模型纹理预测能力,反之亦然。实验表明,ESCNet在三个权威数据集上均展现出显著性能优势。
abstract_en: Camouflaged object detection (COD) faces unique challenges where target boundaries are intrinsically ambiguous due to their textural similarity to backgrounds. Existing methods relying on single-modality features often produce fragmented predictions due to insufficient boundary constraints.To address this, we propose ESCNet with dynamically coupled edge-texture perception. Our framework introduces three core innovations that work in concert:1) Adaptive Edge-Texture Perceptor (AETP), which creates an edge prediction behaviour where edge and texture information are mutually reinforcing based on the multi-scale features of the image integrated with the global semantic context of the Transformer;2) Dual-Stream Feature Augmentor (DSFA), which dynamically adjusts the kernel sampling position according to the local texture complexity and edge orientation, thus accurately enhancing the feature information at fractal boundaries and amorphous texture locations;3) Multi-Feature Modulation Module (MFMM), which establishes incremental fine-grained improvements for feature calibration and model prediction through enhanced characterisation of edge perception and hierarchical integration of multiple textures. This interconnected system forms a feedback loop where enhanced representations of edge perception enhance model texture prediction and vice versa. Our ESCNet demonstrates significant performance advantages on all three authoritative datasets.
authors: Sheng Ye, Xin Chen, Yan Zhang, Xianming Lin, Liujuan Cao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20053-20063

title: ESSENTIAL:视频分类增量学习中的情景与语义记忆整合
title_en: ESSENTIAL: Episodic and Semantic Memory Integration for Video Class-Incremental Learning
abstract: 本文针对视频类增量学习(VCIL)问题展开研究。现有许多VCIL方法通过重放训练来缓解灾难性遗忘,这些方法利用情景记忆存储少量时间密集型样本,但存在内存效率低下的问题。另一种方法则存储时间稀疏型样本,虽节省内存却牺牲了关键的时间信息,导致性能下降。为解决内存效率与性能之间的权衡,我们提出了一种视频类增量学习中的情景与语义记忆整合方法(ESSENTIAL)。ESSENTIAL包含情景记忆用于存储时间稀疏特征,以及语义记忆用于存储由可学习提示表示的一般知识。我们引入了一种新颖的记忆检索(MR)模块,通过交叉注意力机制整合情景记忆与语义提示,从而从时间稀疏特征中检索出时间密集型特征。我们在多个基准数据集上严格验证了ESSENTIAL:TCD基准的UCF-101、HMDB51和Something-Something-V2,以及vCLIMB基准的UCF-101、ActivityNet和Kinetics-400。值得注意的是,ESSENTIAL在显著降低内存使用的情况下,在基准测试中取得了优异的性能。
abstract_en: In this work, we tackle the problem of video class-incremental learning (VCIL). Many existing VCIL methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting by rehearsal training with a few temporally dense samples stored in episodic memory, which is memory-inefficient. Alternatively, some methods store temporally sparse samples, sacrificing essential temporal information and thereby resulting in inferior performance. To address this trade-off between memory-efficiency and performance, we propose EpiSodic and SEmaNTIc memory integrAtion for video class-incremental Learning (ESSENTIAL). ESSENTIAL consists of episodic memory for storing temporally sparse features and semantic memory for storing general knowledge represented by learnable prompts. We introduce a novel memory retrieval (MR) module that integrates episodic memory and semantic prompts through cross-attention, enabling the retrieval of temporally dense features from temporally sparse features. We rigorously validate ESSENTIAL on diverse datasets: UCF-101, HMDB51, and Something-Something-V2 from the TCD benchmark and UCF-101, ActivityNet, and Kinetics-400 from the vCLIMB benchmark. Remarkably, with significantly reduced memory, ESSENTIAL achieves favorable performance on the benchmarks.
authors: Jongseo Lee, Kyungho Bae, Kyle Min, Gyeong-Moon Park, Jinwoo Choi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17546-17556

title: ETA:通过前瞻实现效率,基于大模型的自动驾驶双模方法
title_en: ETA: Efficiency through Thinking Ahead, A Dual Approach to Self-Driving with Large Models
abstract: 如何在不牺牲推理速度的前提下利用大模型的优势,是自动驾驶系统中常见的难题?一种常见方案是双系统架构,采用小模型进行快速反应决策,大模型进行较慢但信息量更大的分析。现有双系统设计多采用并行架构,推理过程要么在当前帧直接使用大模型,要么从之前存储的推理结果中检索。然而这些方法仍难以实现大模型对每个在线帧的及时响应。我们的核心洞察是将当前帧的密集计算转移到先前时间步,通过多时间步的批量推理使大模型能够及时响应每个时间步。为实现这一转移,我们提出Efficiency through Thinking Ahead (ETA)异步系统,其设计包含三个关键步骤:(1) 利用大模型的未来预测将过去的信息特征传播到当前帧;(2) 使用小模型提取当前帧特征以实现实时响应能力;(3) 通过动作掩码机制融合双特征,强调动作关键图像区域。在Bench2Drive CARLA Leaderboard-v2基准测试中,ETA在保持近实时推理速度(50毫秒)的同时,以驾驶得分69.53超越现有最先进方法8%。
abstract_en: How can we benefit from large models without sacrificing inference speed, a common dilemma in self-driving systems? A prevalent solution is a dual-system architecture, employing a small model for rapid, reactive decisions and a larger model for slower but more informative analyses. Existing dual-system designs often implement parallel architectures where inference is either directly conducted using the large model at each current frame or retrieved from previously stored inference results. However, these works still struggle to enable large models for a timely response to every online frame. Our key insight is to shift intensive computations of the current frame to previous time steps and perform a batch inference of multiple time steps to make large models respond promptly to each time step. To achieve the shifting, we introduce Efficiency through Thinking Ahead (ETA), an asynchronous system designed to: (1) propagate informative features from the past to the current frame using future predictions from the large model, (2) extract current frame features using a small model for real-time responsiveness, and (3) integrate these dual features via an action mask mechanism that emphasizes action-critical image regions. Evaluated on the Bench2Drive CARLA Leaderboard-v2 benchmark, ETA advances state-of-the-art performance by 8% with a driving score of 69.53 while maintaining a near-real-time inference speed at 50 ms.
authors: Shadi Hamdan, Chonghao Sima, Zetong Yang, Hongyang Li, Fatma Guney ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26529-26538

title: ETA: 基于能量的测试时适应方法用于深度补全
title_en: ETA: Energy-based Test-time Adaptation for Depth Completion
abstract: 我们提出了一种在无监督方式下将预训练深度补全模型适应到测试时数据的方法。深度补全模型在理想捕获条件(源域)下(预)训练,以从RGB图像和稀疏深度图对中生成密集深度图,例如良好照明和高信噪比的条件。当模型转移到非理想捕获条件(目标域)时,由于协变量偏移,会产生错误的输出密集深度图。为识别分布外误差情况,我们在源域中学习一个能量模型,为输出的密集深度图分配表示其可能性的标量。该能量模型进一步用于在测试时适应预训练的深度补全模型,从而提出我们的方法:基于能量的测试时适应(ETA)。ETA将误差区域定位为高能量区域;测试时适应涉及更新模型权重以最小化能量,从而减轻协变量偏移。我们在3个室内和3个户外数据集上评估ETA,结果表明在户外场景中平均提升6.94%,在室内场景中平均提升10.23%。
abstract_en: We propose a method of adapting pretrained depth completion models to test time data in an unsupervised manner. Depth completion models are (pre)trained to produce dense depth maps from pairs of RGB image and sparse depth maps in ideal capture conditions (source domain), e.g., well-illuminated, high signal-to-noise. When models are transferred to capture conditions out of ideal case (target domain), they produce erroneous output dense depth maps due to the covariate shift. To identify cases of out-of-distribution errors, we propose an learn an energy model in the source domain that assigns scalars that represent the likelihood of the output dense depth maps. This energy model is further used to adapt the pretrained depth completion models at test time, leading to our method: Energy-based Test-time Adaptation (ETA). ETA can localize regions of errors as high energy; test-time adaptation involves updating the model weights to minimize the energy, which in turn mitigates the covariate shift. We evaluate ETA across 3 indoor and 3 outdoor datasets, where ETA improves over the previous state of the art by an average of 6.94% on outdoor and 10.23% on indoor settings.
authors: Younjoon Chung, Hyoungseob Park, Patrick Rim, Xiaoran Zhang, Jihe He, Ziyao Zeng, Safa Cicek, Byung-Woo Hong, James S. Duncan, Alex Wong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6001-6012

title: 通过等变紧贴度将人体拟合推广到着装人类:ETCH
title_en: ETCH: Generalizing Body Fitting to Clothed Humans via Equivariant Tightness
abstract: 将人体拟合到3D着装人类点云是一项常见但具有挑战性的任务。传统基于优化的方法使用多阶段流程,对姿态初始化敏感,而近期基于学习的方法往往在多样化姿态和服装类型上的泛化能力不足。我们提出了一种针对着装人类的等变紧贴度拟合方法(Equivariant Tightness Fitting for Clothed Humans, ETCH),这是一种新颖的流程,通过局部近似SE(3)等变性估计衣物到人体的表面映射,将紧贴度编码为从衣物表面到基础人体的位移向量。基于此映射,姿态不变的人体特征回归稀疏人体标记,将着装人类拟合简化为内体标记拟合任务。在CAPE和4D-Dress数据集上的大量实验表明,ETCH在松散服装(16.7% 69.5%)和形状精度(平均49.9%)上显著优于现有最先进的方法(包括不依赖紧贴度和依赖紧贴度的方法)。我们的等变紧贴度设计甚至能在单次(或分布外)设置(1%数据)中减少方向误差(67.2% 89.8%)。定性结果表明,ETCH在挑战性姿态、未见过的形状、松散服装和非刚性动态等场景下均展现出强大的泛化能力。我们将在boqian-li.github.io/ETCH上发布代码和模型供研究使用。
abstract_en: Fitting a body to a 3D clothed human point cloud is a common yet challenging task. Traditional optimization-based approaches use multi-stage pipelines that are sensitive to pose initialization, while recent learning-based methods often struggle with generalization across diverse poses and garment types. We propose Equivariant Tightness Fitting for Clothed Humans, or ETCH, a novel pipeline that estimates cloth-to-body surface mapping through locally approximate SE(3) equivariance, encoding tightness as displacement vectors from the cloth surface to the underlying body. Following this mapping, pose-invariant body features regress sparse body markers, simplifying clothed human fitting into an inner-body marker fitting task. Extensive experiments on CAPE and 4D-Dress show that ETCH significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods -- both tightness-agnostic and tightness-aware -- in body fitting accuracy on loose clothing (16.7%   69.5%) and shape accuracy (average 49.9%). Our equivariant tightness design can even reduce directional errors by (67.2%   89.8%) in one-shot (or out-of-distribution) settings ( 1% data). Qualitative results demonstrate strong generalization of ETCH, regardless of challenging poses, unseen shapes, loose clothing, and non-rigid dynamics. We will release the code and models soon for research purposes at boqian-li.github.io/ETCH.
authors: Boqian Li, Haiwen Feng, Zeyu Cai, Michael J. Black, Yuliang Xiu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8264-8274

title: ETVA:基于细粒度问题生成与回答的文本到视频对齐评估
title_en: ETVA: Evaluation of Text-to-Video Alignment via Fine-grained Question Generation and Answering
abstract: 在文本到视频(T2V)生成中,精确评估文本提示与生成视频之间的语义对齐仍是一个挑战。现有文本到视频对齐度量指标如CLIPScore仅生成粗粒度得分,缺乏细粒度对齐细节,无法与人类偏好对齐。为解决这一局限性,我们提出ETVA,一种通过细粒度问题生成与回答进行文本到视频对齐评估的新方法。首先,多智能体系统将提示解析为语义场景图以生成原子问题。然后我们设计了一个知识增强的多阶段推理框架用于问题回答,其中辅助大语言模型首先检索相关常识知识(如物理定律),随后通过多阶段推理机制由视频大语言模型回答生成的问题。大量实验表明,ETVA达到58.47的斯皮尔曼相关系数,显著高于现有指标(仅31.0)与人类判断的相关性。我们还构建了一个专门用于文本到视频对齐评估的综合性基准,包含2000个多样提示和12000个跨10类别的原子问题。通过系统评估15个现有文本到视频模型,我们识别了其关键能力与局限性,为下一代T2V生成铺平道路。所有代码和数据集将很快公开。
abstract_en: Precisely evaluating semantic alignment between text prompts and generated videos remains a challenge in Text-to-Video (T2V) Generation. Existing text-to-video alignment metrics like CLIPScore only generate coarse-grained scores without fine-grained alignment details, failing to align with human preference. To address this limitation, we propose ETVA, a novel Evaluation method of Text-to-Video Alignment via fine-grained question generation and answering. First, a multi-agent system parses prompts into semantic scene graphs to generate atomic questions. Then we design a knowledge-augmented multi-stage reasoning framework for question answering, where an auxiliary LLM first retrieves relevant common-sense knowledge (e.g., physical laws), and then video LLM answers the generated questions through a multi-stage reasoning mechanism. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ETVA achieves a Spearman's correlation coefficient of 58.47, showing a much higher correlation with human judgment than existing metrics, which attain only 31.0. We also construct a comprehensive benchmark specifically designed for text-to-video alignment evaluation, featuring 2k diverse prompts and 12k atomic questions spanning 10 categories. Through a systematic evaluation of 15 existing text-to-video models, we identify their key capabilities and limitations, paving the way for next-generation T2V generation. All codes and datasets will be publicly available soon.
authors: Kaisi Guan, Zhengfeng Lai, Yuchong Sun, Peng Zhang, Wei Liu, Kieran Liu, Meng Cao, Ruihua Song ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21299-21309

title: EVDM:基于事件的现实世界视频去模糊方法与Mamba模型
title_en: EVDM: Event-based Real-world Video Deblurring with Mamba
abstract: 现有基于事件的视频去模糊方法在提取和融合长程时空运动信息时存在局限,主要由于受限的感受野或计算效率低下,导致去模糊效果不理想。为解决这些问题,我们引入状态空间模型,该模型通过线性复杂度和全局感受野实现长程建模,并提出EVDM,一种基于Mamba的新型事件视频去模糊框架。该框架包含:(1) 运动线索提取Mamba(MCEM),通过事件自重建损失确保提取长程运动信息时细节的完整性;(2) 运动感知帧内融合Mamba(MIFM)和帧间时序传播Mamba(ITPM),利用运动感知状态空间进行跨模态融合和基于运动线索的帧间信息交换。因此,EVDM在模糊区域实现更优的细节恢复,同时确保帧间时间运动一致性。此外,为克服现有事件-帧配对数据集中固定曝光比的局限性,我们引入T-RED,一个高质量、高分辨率且具有不同曝光时间比的数据集。T-RED为基于事件的视频去模糊研究提供了更真实复杂的实验数据。在多个数据集上的实验表明,EVDM优于先前的SOTA方法。
abstract_en: Existing event-based video deblurring methods face limitations in extracting and fusing long-range spatiotemporal motion information from events, primarily due to restricted receptive fields or low computational efficiency, resulting in suboptimal deblurring performance.To address these issues, we introduce the state space model, which leverages linear complexity and global receptive fields for long-range modeling, and propose EVDM, a novel Event-based Video Deblurring framework with Mamba. The framework consists of: (1) Motion Clue Extraction Mamba (MCEM), which employs an event self-reconstruction loss to ensure the completeness of details when extracting long-range motion information. (2) Motion-aware Intra-frame Fusion Mamba (MIFM) and Inter-frame Temporal Propagation Mamba (ITPM), which utilize the motion-aware state space to perform cross-modal fusion and inter-frame information exchange guided by motion clues. Consequently, EVDM achieves superior detail restoration in blurred regions while ensuring temporal motion consistency across frames. Additionally, to overcome the limitation of fixed exposure ratios in existing event-frame paired datasets, we introduce T-RED, a high-quality, high-resolution dataset with varying exposure time ratios. T-RED provides more realistic and complex data for event-based video deblurring research. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that EVDM outperforms previous SOTA methods.
authors: Zhijing Sun, Senyan Xu, Kean Liu, Runze Tian, Xueyang Fu, Zheng-Jun Zha ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13793-13803

title: EVER:实时视图合成的精确体积椭球渲染
title_en: EVER: Exact Volumetric Ellipsoid Rendering for Real-time View Synthesis
abstract: 我们提出了一种实时三维重建方法——精确体积椭球渲染(EVER)。EVER能够准确地在三维空间中融合无限数量的重叠基础体素,消除三维高斯点云渲染(3DGS)及其他相关方法所表现出的弹跳伪影。EVER将辐射场表示为一组常密度体积椭球体,通过两次相交(一次在光线进入时,另一次在光线离开时)对每个基础体素进行光线追踪,并沿光线累积密度和颜色的导数。由于EVER基于光线追踪构建,它还能够实现失焦模糊和鱼眼相机畸变等效果,同时在NVIDIA RTX4090上以720p分辨率实现30 FPS的帧率。我们在Zip-NeRF数据集的具有挑战性的大规模场景中展示了该方法的优越性,其SSIM指标达到最先进的水平,甚至超过了Zip-NeRF。
abstract_en: We present Exact Volumetric Ellipsoid Rendering (EVER), a method for real-time 3D reconstruction.EVER accurately blends an unlimited number of overlapping primitives together in 3D space, eliminating the popping artifacts that 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) and other related methods exhibit.EVER represents a radiance field as a set of constant-density volumetric ellipsoids, which are raytraced by intersecting each primitive twice (once upon ray entrance and another on ray exit) and accumulating the derivatives of the densities and colors along the ray.Because EVER is built around ray tracing, it also enables effects such as defocus blur and fish-eye camera distortion, while still achieving frame rates of  30 FPS at 720p on an NVIDIA RTX4090. We show that our method is more accurate on the challenging large-scale scenes from the Zip-NeRF dataset, where it achieves state of the art SSIM, even higher than Zip-NeRF.
authors: Alexander Mai, Peter Hedman, George Kopanas, Dor Verbin, David Futschik, Qiangeng Xu, Falko Kuester, Jonathan T. Barron, Yinda Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4930-4939

title: EVEv2:无需编码器视觉-语言模型的改进基线
title_en: EVEv2: Improved Baselines for Encoder-Free Vision-Language Models
abstract: 现有无需编码器的视觉-语言模型(VLMs)正在迅速缩小与基于编码器模型的性能差距,凸显了具有结构简洁性和高效部署能力的统一多模态系统的广阔前景。我们系统地澄清了使用预训练视觉编码器、离散分词器和从头开始构建的极简视觉层的VLMs之间的性能差距,深入挖掘了无需编码器VLMs尚未被充分研究的特性。我们开发了高效的策略,使无需编码器VLMs能够与主流基于编码器的模型相媲美。经过深入研究,我们推出了EVEv2.0,这一新的改进型无需编码器VLMs家族。我们证明:(i) 在统一模型中正确分解并分层关联视觉与语言可减少模态间的干扰;(ii) 一个精心设计的训练策略可实现无需编码器VLMs的有效优化。通过广泛评估,我们的EVEv2.0展示了跨模态仅解码器架构的全面研究,表现出卓越的数据效率和强大的视觉推理能力。代码已公开在:https://github.com/baaivision/EVE。
abstract_en: Existing encoder-free vision-language models (VLMs) are rapidly narrowing the performance gap with their encoder-based counterparts, highlighting the promising potential for unified multimodal systems with structural simplicity and efficient deployment. We systematically clarify the performance gap between VLMs using pre-trained vision encoders, discrete tokenizers, and minimalist visual layers from scratch, deeply excavating the under-examined characteristics of encoder-free VLMs. We develop efficient strategies for encoder-free VLMs that rival mainstream encoder-based ones. After an in-depth investigation, we launch EVEv2.0, a new and improved family of encoder-free VLMs. We show that: (i) Properly decomposing and hierarchically associating vision and language within a unified model reduces interference between modalities. (ii) A well-designed training strategy enables effective optimization for encoder-free VLMs. Through extensive evaluation, our EVEv2.0 represents a thorough study for developing a decoder-only architecture across modalities, demonstrating superior data efficiency and strong vision-reasoning capability. Code is publicly available at: https://github.com/baaivision/EVE.
authors: Haiwen Diao, Xiaotong Li, Yufeng Cui, Yueze Wang, Haoge Deng, Ting Pan, Wenxuan Wang, Huchuan Lu, Xinlong Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21014-21025

title: EVOLVE: 事件引导的可变形特征迁移与双记忆精炼用于低光照视频对象分割
title_en: EVOLVE: Event-Guided Deformable Feature Transfer and Dual-Memory Refinement for Low-Light Video Object Segmentation
abstract: 低光照场景下的视频对象分割(VOS)仍面临巨大挑战,由于显著的纹理丢失和严重噪声,常导致图像特征生成不可靠及分割性能下降。为解决该问题,我们提出EVOLVE,一种新颖的事件引导的可变形特征迁移与双记忆精炼框架用于低光照VOS。EVOLVE通过利用事件驱动线索解决帧间空间错位问题,并提升对象表征。事件引导的可变形特征迁移(EDFT)模块通过事件驱动的可变形卷积增强特征对齐,其中由事件特征导出的偏移量实现运动感知的空间调整,从而在参考帧中更精确地传播对象特征。此外,双记忆对象变换器(DMOT)通过维护和更新图像基和事件基的记忆表征,迭代优化对象表征。通过其记忆精炼模块(MRM),DMOT选择性增强相关对象特征并抑制背景噪声,从而获得稳定且时间一致的分割结果。在低光照VOS基准数据集上的大量实验表明,EVOLVE实现了最先进的分割性能,在准确率和计算效率方面均超越了基于事件和基于图像的VOS方法。
abstract_en: Video Object Segmentation (VOS) in low-light scenarios remains highly challenging due to significant texture loss and severe noise, which often lead to unreliable image feature generation and degraded segmentation performance. To address this issue, we propose EVOLVE, a novel event-guided deformable feature transfer and dual-memory refinement framework for low-light VOS. EVOLVE addresses spatial misalignment between frames and improves object representation by utilizing event-driven cues. The event-guided deformable feature transfer (EDFT) module enhances feature alignment through event-driven deformable convolutions, where offsets derived from event features enable motion-aware spatial adjustments, leading to more precise propagation of object features in reference frames. Furthermore, the dual-memory object transformer (DMOT) iteratively refines object representations by maintaining and updating both image-based and event-based memory representations. Through its memory refinement module (MRM), DMOT selectively enhances relevant object features while suppressing background noise, resulting in stable and temporally coherent segmentation results. Extensive experiments on low-light VOS benchmarks demonstrate that EVOLVE achieves state-of-the-art segmentation performance, surpassing both event-based and image-based VOS methods in accuracy and computational efficiency.
authors: Jong-Hyeon Baek, Jiwon Oh, Yeong Jun Koh ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11273-11282

title: EVT: 多模态三维目标检测的高效视角变换
title_en: EVT: Efficient View Transformation for Multi-Modal 3D Object Detection
abstract: 在鸟瞰图(BEV)表示下的多模态传感器融合已成为三维目标检测的主流方法。然而,现有方法常依赖深度估计器或Transformer编码器将图像特征转换至BEV空间,这会降低鲁棒性或引入显著的计算开销。此外,视角变换中几何指导不足导致射线方向错位,限制了BEV表示的有效性。为解决这些挑战,我们提出高效视角变换(EVT),一种新型三维目标检测框架,构建结构良好的BEV表示,提升准确率与效率。我们的方法聚焦两个关键方面。首先,自适应采样与自适应投影(ASAP),利用激光雷达指导生成三维采样点和自适应核,实现更有效的图像特征向BEV空间转换及精细化的BEV表示。其次,改进的基于查询的检测框架,结合组间混合查询选择与几何感知交叉注意力,有效捕捉Transformer解码器中目标的共性特征与几何结构。在nuScenes测试集上,EVT实现75.3% NDS的最先进性能,并具备实时推理速度。
abstract_en: Multi-modal sensor fusion in Bird's Eye View (BEV) representation has become the leading approach for 3D object detection. However, existing methods often rely on depth estimators or transformer encoders to transform image features into BEV space, which reduces robustness or introduces significant computational overhead. Moreover, the insufficient geometric guidance in view transformation results in ray-directional misalignments, limiting the effectiveness of BEV representations. To address these challenges, we propose Efficient View Transformation (EVT), a novel 3D object detection framework that constructs a well-structured BEV representation, improving both accuracy and efficiency. Our approach focuses on two key aspects. First, Adaptive Sampling and Adaptive Projection (ASAP), which utilizes LiDAR guidance to generate 3D sampling points and adaptive kernels, enables more effective transformation of image features into BEV space and a refined BEV representation. Second, an improved query-based detection framework, incorporating group-wise mixed query selection and geometry-aware cross-attention, effectively captures both the common properties and the geometric structure of objects in the transformer decoder. On the nuScenes test set, EVT achieves state-of-the-art performance of 75.3% NDS with real-time inference speed.
authors: Yongjin Lee, Hyeon-Mun Jeong, Yurim Jeon, Sanghyun Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26632-26642

title: EYE3:将任何内容转化为裸眼3D
title_en: EYE3:Turn Anything into Naked-eye 3D
abstract: 光场显示(LFDs),尽管在硬件技术上实现了更大视场角和多视角的支持,仍面临内容可用性不足的关键挑战。在这些显示设备上生成自立体3D内容需要将多视角图像折射到不同的空间角度,对多视角间空间一致性有严格要求,这对非专业人士而言技术难度较高。现有图像/视频生成模型和基于辐射场的方法无法直接从单一2D资源生成符合光场显示硬件严格要求的显示内容。我们提出了首个专为3D光场显示设计的生成框架__TITLE_MATH_1__,能够将任意2D图像、视频或文本转换为适配这些屏幕的高质量显示内容。该框架采用基于点的表示并通过离轴视角渲染,确保精确的光线折射与硬件光学要求的匹配。为维持多视角间的3D一致性,我们通过渲染掩膜对遮挡区域进行视频扩散模型的微调。实验结果表明,我们的方法优于现有最先进方法,显著简化了LFDs的内容创作。该方法在娱乐、广告和沉浸式显示技术等领域具有广泛应用潜力,为内容稀缺问题提供了稳健解决方案,并大幅提升了LFDs的视觉体验。
abstract_en: Light Field Displays (LFDs), despite significant advances in hardware technology supporting larger fields of view and multiple viewpoints, still face a critical challenge of limited content availability. Producing autostereoscopic 3D content on these displays requires refracting multi-perspective images into different spatial angles, with strict demands for spatial consistency across views, which is technically challenging for non-experts. Existing image/video generation models and radiance field-based methods cannot directly generate display content that meets the strict requirements of light field display hardware from a single 2D resource.We introduces the first generative framework  \rm EYE ^ 3  specifically designed for 3D light field displays, capable of converting any 2D images, videos, or texts into high-quality display content tailored for these screens. The framework employs a point-based representation rendered through off-axis perspective, ensuring precise light refraction and alignment with the hardware's optical requirements. To maintain consistent 3D coherence across multiple viewpoints, we finetune a video diffusion model to fill occluded regions based on the rendered masks.Experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods, significantly simplifying content creation for LFDs. With broad potential in industries such as entertainment, advertising, and immersive display technologies, our method offers a robust solution to content scarcity and greatly enhances the visual experience on LFDs.
authors: Yingde Song, Zongyuan Yang, Baolin Liu, Yongping Xiong, Sai Chen, Lan Yi, Zhaohe Zhang, Xunbo Yu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27862-27871

title: 指令引导图像编辑中的早期时间步零样本候选选择
title_en: Early Timestep Zero-Shot Candidate Selection for Instruction-Guided Image Editing
abstract: 尽管扩散模型取得了近期进展,但由于采样过程中随机噪声固有的多样性,实现可靠的图像生成和编辑结果仍面临挑战。特别是,基于扩散模型的指令引导图像编辑提供了用户友好的编辑能力,但诸如背景失真等编辑失败现象在不同尝试中频繁出现。用户通常依赖试错法,调整种子或提示以获得满意结果,这效率低下。虽然存在针对文本到图像(T2I)生成的种子选择方法,但它们依赖外部验证器,限制了适用性,且评估多个种子会增加计算复杂度,降低实用性。为解决这一问题,我们首先通过背景一致性分数建立新的多种子图像编辑基线,实现无需监督的Best-of-N性能。在此基础上,我们提出ELECT(早期时间步潜在评估用于候选选择),这是一种零样本框架,通过在早期扩散时间步估计背景不匹配来选择可靠种子,识别保留背景仅修改前景的种子。ELECT通过背景不一致性分数对种子候选进行排序,在保持编辑性的同时,基于背景一致性早期过滤不合适的样本。超越独立种子选择,ELECT整合到指令引导编辑流程中,并扩展到多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)进行联合种子+提示选择,当单独种子选择不足时进一步提升结果。实验表明,ELECT在减少计算成本(平均降低41%,最高达61%)的同时提升背景一致性与指令遵循度,在先前失败案例中实现约40%的成功率——无需任何外部监督或训练。
abstract_en: Despite recent advances in diffusion models, achieving reliable image generation and editing results remains challenging due to the inherent diversity induced by stochastic noise in the sampling process. Particularly, instruction-guided image editing with diffusion models offers user-friendly editing capabilities, yet editing failures, such as background distortion, frequently occur across different attempts. Users often resort to trial and error, adjusting seeds or prompts to achieve satisfactory results, which is inefficient.While seed selection methods exist for Text-to-Image (T2I) generation, they depend on external verifiers, limiting their applicability, and evaluating multiple seeds increases computational complexity, reducing practicality.To address this, we first establish a new multiple-seed-based image editing baseline using background consistency scores, achieving Best-of-N performance without supervision. Building on this, we introduce ELECT (Early-timestep Latent Evaluation for Candidate Selection), a zero-shot framework that selects reliable seeds by estimating background mismatches at early diffusion timesteps, identfying the seed that retains the background while modifying only the foreground. ELECT ranks seed candidates by a background inconsistency score, filtering unsuitable samples early based on background consistency while fully preserving editability.Beyond standalone seed selection, ELECT integrates into instruction-guided editing pipelines and extends to Multimodal Large-Language Models (MLLMs) for joint seed + prompt selection, further improving results when seed selection alone is insufficient. Experiments show that ELECT reduces computational costs (by 41% on average and up to 61%) while improving background consistency and instruction adherence, achieving around 40% success rates in previously failed cases--without any external supervision or training.
authors: Joowon Kim, Ziseok Lee, Donghyeon Cho, Sanghyun Jo, Yeonsung Jung, Kyungsu Kim, Eunho Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18844-18854

title: Easi3R:无需训练的DUSt3R解耦运动估计
title_en: Easi3R: Estimating Disentangled Motion from DUSt3R Without Training
abstract: 近期DUSt3R的进展使得静态场景的密集点云和相机参数估计变得稳健,其利用Transformer网络架构和大规模3D数据集的直接监督。相比之下,可用4D数据集的有限规模和多样性成为训练高度通用4D模型的主要瓶颈。这一限制促使传统4D方法在可扩展的动态视频数据上微调3D模型,并结合光流和深度等几何先验知识。本文采取相反路径,提出Easi3R,一种简单且高效的免训练4D重建方法。我们的方法在推理过程中应用注意力适应,无需从头预训练或网络微调。我们发现DUSt3R的注意力层固有地编码了丰富的相机和物体运动信息。通过仔细解耦这些注意力图,我们实现了精确的动态区域分割、相机位姿估计和4D密集点云重建。在真实动态视频上的大量实验表明,我们的轻量级注意力适应显著优于之前在大规模动态数据集上训练或微调的最先进方法。
abstract_en: Recent advances in DUSt3R have enabled robust estimation of dense point clouds and camera parameters of static scenes, leveraging Transformer network architectures and direct supervision on large-scale 3D datasets.In contrast, the limited scale and diversity of available 4D datasets present a major bottleneck for training a highly generalizable 4D model. This constraint has driven conventional 4D methods to fine-tune 3D models on scalable dynamic video data with additional geometric priors such as optical flow and depths. In this work, we take an opposite path and introduce Easi3R, a simple yet efficient training-free method for 4D reconstruction. Our approach applies attention adaptation during inference, eliminating the need for from-scratch pre-training or network fine-tuning. We find that the attention layers in DUSt3R inherently encode rich information about camera and object motion. By carefully disentangling these attention maps, we achieve accurate dynamic region segmentation, camera pose estimation, and 4D dense point map reconstruction. Extensive experiments on real-world dynamic videos demonstrate that our lightweight attention adaptation significantly outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods that are trained or fine-tuned on extensive dynamic datasets.
authors: Xingyu Chen, Yue Chen, Yuliang Xiu, Andreas Geiger, Anpei Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9158-9168

title: Easy3D:一种简单而有效的三维交互分割方法
title_en: Easy3D: A Simple Yet Effective Method for 3D Interactive Segmentation
abstract: 随着数字三维环境的日益普及,无论是通过图像重建、生成还是通过激光或机器人获取的扫描数据,都在推动各领域的创新。在众多应用中,存在对支持三维交互的功能的显著需求,例如三维交互分割,这对于物体选择和操作等任务具有重要价值。此外,仍需持续寻求高效、精确且在多样化场景下表现稳定的解决方案,特别是在未见过的环境和陌生物体中。在本工作中,我们提出了一种方法,在领域内和领域外数据集上均超越了先前最先进的技术。我们的简单方法结合了基于体素的稀疏编码器与轻量级的基于Transformer的解码器,实现了隐式点击融合,从而获得卓越的性能并最大化效率。我们的方法在ScanNet、ScanNet++、S3DIS和KITTI-360等基准数据集上取得了显著提升,并在高斯点云等未见过的几何分布上也表现出色。
abstract_en: The increasing availability of digital 3D environments, whether through image reconstruction, generation, or scans obtained via lasers or robots, is driving innovation across various fields. Among the numerous applications, there is a significant demand for those that enable 3D interaction, such as 3D Interactive Segmentation, which is useful for tasks like object selection and manipulation. Additionally, there is a persistent need for solutions that are efficient, precise, and consistently perform well across diverse settings, particularly in unseen environments and with unfamiliar objects. In this work, we introduce a method that consistently surpasses previous state-of-the-art techniques on both in-domain and out-of-domain datasets. Our simple approach integrates a voxel-based sparse encoder with a lightweight transformer-based decoder that implements implicit click fusion, achieving superior performance and maximizing efficiency. Our method demonstrates substantial improvements on benchmark datasets, including ScanNet, ScanNet++, S3DIS, and KITTI-360, and also on unseen geometric distributions such as Gaussian Splatting.
authors: Andrea Simonelli, Norman Müller, Peter Kontschieder ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24707-24716

title: EasyControl: 为扩散Transformer添加高效且灵活的控制
title_en: EasyControl: Adding Efficient and Flexible Control for Diffusion Transformer
abstract: 基于Unet的扩散模型近期进展,如ControlNet和IP-Adapter,已引入有效的空间和主体控制机制。然而,DiT(扩散Transformer)架构在高效且灵活的控制方面仍存在困难。为解决这一问题,我们提出EasyControl,一个旨在统一条件引导扩散Transformer的新型框架,具有高效率和灵活性。我们的框架基于三项关键创新。首先,我们引入了一个轻量级的条件注入LoRA模块。该模块独立处理条件信号,作为即插即用方案。它避免修改基础模型的权重,确保与定制模型的兼容性,并支持灵活注入多样条件。值得注意的是,该模块即使仅在单条件数据上训练,也能实现和谐且稳健的零样本多条件泛化。其次,我们提出了一种位置感知训练范式。该方法将输入条件标准化为固定分辨率,允许生成任意宽高比和灵活分辨率的图像。同时,它优化了计算效率,使框架更适用于实际应用。第三,我们开发了一种结合KV缓存技术的因果注意力机制,适用于条件生成任务。这一创新显著降低了图像合成的延迟,提高了框架的整体效率。通过大量实验,我们证明EasyControl在各种应用场景中均表现出卓越性能。这些创新使我们的框架具有高度效率、灵活性,适用于广泛任务。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in Unet-based diffusion models, such as ControlNet and IP-Adapter, have introduced effective spatial and subject control mechanisms. However, the DiT (Diffusion Transformer) architecture still struggles with efficient and flexible control. To tackle this issue, we propose EasyControl, a novel framework designed to unify condition-guided diffusion transformers with high efficiency and flexibility. Our framework is built on three key innovations. First, we introduce a lightweight Condition Injection LoRA Module. This module processes conditional signals in isolation, acting as a plug-and-play solution. It avoids modifying the base model's weights, ensuring compatibility with customized models and enabling the flexible injection of diverse conditions. Notably, this module also supports harmonious and robust zero-shot multi-condition generalization, even when trained only on single-condition data. Second, we propose a Position-Aware Training Paradigm. This approach standardizes input conditions to fixed resolutions, allowing the generation of images with arbitrary aspect ratios and flexible resolutions. At the same time, it optimizes computational efficiency, making the framework more practical for real-world applications. Third, we develop a Causal Attention Mechanism combined with the KV Cache technique, adapted for conditional generation tasks. This innovation significantly reduces the latency of image synthesis, improving the overall efficiency of the framework. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that EasyControl achieves exceptional performance across various application scenarios. These innovations collectively make our framework highly efficient, flexible, and suitable for a wide range of tasks.
authors: Yuxuan Zhang, Yirui Yuan, Yiren Song, Haofan Wang, Jiaming Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19513-19524

title: Edicho:野外一致图像编辑
title_en: Edicho: Consistent Image Editing in the Wild
abstract: 作为已验证的需求,跨野外图像的一致性编辑仍是一个技术挑战,源于诸如物体姿态、光照条件和摄影环境等不可控因素。Edicho 提出了一种无需训练的解决方案,基于扩散模型,其核心设计原则是利用显式图像对应关系来指导编辑。具体而言,关键组件包括一个注意力操控模块和经过精心优化的无分类器引导(CFG)去噪策略,两者均考虑了预先估计的对应关系。此类推理阶段算法具有即插即用特性,并兼容大多数基于扩散模型的编辑方法,如 ControlNet 和 BrushNet。大量实验结果验证了 Edicho 在多种场景下进行一致跨图像编辑的有效性。
abstract_en: As a verified need, consistent editing across in-the-wild images remains a technical challenge arising from various unmanageable factors, like object poses, lighting conditions, and photography environments. Edicho steps in with a training-free solution based on diffusion models, featuring a fundamental design principle of using explicit image correspondence to direct editing. Specifically, the key components include an attention manipulation module and a carefully refined classifier-free guidance (CFG) denoising strategy, both of which take into account the pre-estimated correspondence. Such an inference-time algorithm enjoys a plug-and-play nature and is compatible to most diffusion-based editing methods, such as ControlNet and BrushNet. Extensive results demonstrate the efficacy of Edicho in consistent cross-image editing under diverse settings.
authors: Qingyan Bai, Hao Ouyang, Yinghao Xu, Qiuyu Wang, Ceyuan Yang, Ka Leong Cheng, Yujun Shen, Qifeng Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15277-15287

title: Edit360:从任意角度将2D图像编辑转换为3D资产
title_en: Edit360: 2D Image Edits to 3D Assets from Any Angle
abstract: 近年来,扩散模型的进展显著提升了图像生成与编辑能力,但将其扩展到3D资产仍面临挑战,尤其是需要多视角一致性的精细编辑。现有方法通常限制编辑至预设视角,严重限制了其灵活性和实际应用。我们提出Edit360,一个无需调参的框架,可将2D修改扩展为多视角一致的3D编辑。基于视频扩散模型,Edit360支持从任意视角进行用户定制的编辑,同时确保所有视角的结构一致性。该框架选择锚点视角进行2D修改,并在360度范围内传播编辑。为实现这一目标,Edit360引入了新颖的锚点视角编辑传播机制,有效对齐并融合扩散模型潜在空间和注意力空间中的多视角信息。最终的编辑多视角序列可重建高质量3D资产,实现可定制的3D内容创作。
abstract_en: Recent advances in diffusion models have significantly improved image generation and editing, but extending these capabilities to 3D assets remains challenging, especially for fine-grained edits that require multi-view consistency. Existing methods typically restrict editing to predetermined viewing angles, severely limiting their flexibility and practical applications.We introduce Edit360, a tuning-free framework that extends 2D modifications to multi-view consistent 3D editing. Built upon video diffusion models, Edit360 enables user-specific editing from arbitrary viewpoints while ensuring structural coherence across all views. The framework selects anchor views for 2D modifications and propagates edits across the entire 360-degree range. To achieve this, Edit360 introduces a novel Anchor-View Editing Propagation mechanism, which effectively aligns and merges multi-view information within the latent and attention spaces of diffusion models. The resulting edited multi-view sequences facilitate the reconstruction of high-quality 3D assets, enabling customizable 3D content creation.
authors: Junchao Huang, Xinting Hu, Shaoshuai Shi, Zhuotao Tian, Li Jiang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16618-16628

title: EditCLIP:图像编辑的表征学习
title_en: EditCLIP: Representation Learning for Image Editing
abstract: 我们提出EditCLIP,一种新颖的图像编辑表征学习方法。我们的方法通过联合编码输入图像及其编辑后的版本,学习一种统一的编辑表征,有效捕捉其变换关系。为评估其有效性,我们利用EditCLIP解决两个任务:基于示例的图像编辑和自动化编辑评估。在基于示例的图像编辑中,我们将InstructPix2Pix中的文本指令替换为从参考示例图像对计算得到的EditCLIP嵌入。实验表明,我们的方法在性能上优于现有最先进的方法,同时更加高效且具有更强的通用性。对于自动化评估,EditCLIP通过测量给定图像对的EditCLIP嵌入与文本编辑指令或另一参考图像对的EditCLIP嵌入之间的相似性来评估图像编辑。实验表明,EditCLIP比现有基于CLIP的指标更贴近人类判断,提供了可靠的编辑质量与结构保持度度量。
abstract_en: We introduce EditCLIP, a novel representation-learning approach for image editing. Our method learns a unified representation of edits by jointly encoding an input image and its edited counterpart, effectively capturing their transformation. To evaluate its effectiveness, we employ EditCLIP to solve two tasks: exemplar-based image editing and automated edit evaluation. In exemplar-based image editing, we replace text-based instructions in InstructPix2Pix with EditCLIP embeddings computed from a reference exemplar image pair. Experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods while being more efficient and versatile. For automated evaluation, EditCLIP assesses image edits by measuring the similarity between the EditCLIP embedding of a given image pair and either a textual editing instruction or the EditCLIP embedding of another reference image pair. Experiments show that EditCLIP aligns more closely with human judgments than existing CLIP-based metrics, providing a reliable measure of edit quality and structural preservation.
authors: Qian Wang, Aleksandar Cvejić, Abdelrahman Eldesokey, Peter Wonka ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15960-15970

title: 提升多模态大语言模型图表理解能力的有效训练数据合成
title_en: Effective Training Data Synthesis for Improving MLLM Chart Understanding
abstract: 能够有效阅读科学图表,或图表理解,是构建科学有效代理的关键部分。然而,现有的多模态大语言模型(MLLMs),尤其是开源模型,在具有挑战性的基准测试中通常成功率仅为30%-50%。以往关于使用合成图表微调MLLMs的研究往往受限于其与真实图表的相似度不足,这可能会影响模型在复杂真实世界图表上的训练和性能。本研究显示,模块化图表生成和多样化视觉细节可以提升图表理解能力。具体而言,我们设计了一个五步数据合成流程,其中单图表生成时分离数据和功能创建,多子图图表生成时根据先前子图条件生成后续子图,视觉上多样化生成的图表,过滤低质量数据,并最终使用GPT-4o生成问答(QA)对。这种方法使我们能够优化微调数据集的生成,并引入有效的图表数据集(ECD),该数据集包含10k+图表图像和300k+问答对,涵盖25个主题,具有250+图表类型组合和高视觉复杂度。我们证明ECD在多种真实世界和合成测试集上持续提升各类MLLMs的性能。代码、数据和模型可在:https://github.com/yuweiyang-anu/ECD 获取。
abstract_en: Being able to effectively read scientific plots, or chart understanding, is a central part toward building effective agents for science. However, existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs), especially open-source ones, are still falling behind with a typical success rate of 30%-50% on challenging benchmarks. Previous studies on fine-tuning MLLMs with synthetic charts are often restricted by their inadequate similarity to the real charts, which could compromise model training and performance on complex real-world charts. In this study, we show that modularizing chart generation and diversifying visual details improves chart understanding capabilities. In particular, we design a five-step data synthesis pipeline, where we separate data and function creation for single plot generation, condition the generation of later subplots on earlier ones for multi-subplot figures, visually diversify the generated figures, filter out low quality data, and finally generate the question-answer (QA) pairs with GPT-4o. This approach allows us to streamline the generation of fine-tuning datasets and introduce the effective chart dataset (ECD), which contains 10k+ chart images and 300k+ QA pairs, covering 25 topics and featuring 250+ chart type combinations with high visual complexity. We show that ECD consistently improves the performance of various MLLMs on a range of real-world and synthetic test sets. Code, data and models are available at: https://github.com/yuweiyang-anu/ECD.
authors: Yuwei Yang, Zeyu Zhang, Yunzhong Hou, Zhuowan Li, Gaowen Liu, Ali Payani, Yuan-Sen Ting, Liang Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2653-2663

title: 基于近似正交微调策略的预训练视觉变换器高效适配方法
title_en: Efficient Adaptation of Pre-trained Vision Transformer underpinned by Approximately Orthogonal Fine-Tuning Strategy
abstract: 参数高效微调(PEFT)中,预训练视觉变换器(ViT)的常见方法是冻结大部分主干参数,仅学习低秩适应权重矩阵以适配下游任务。这些低秩矩阵通常通过下投影和上投影矩阵的乘积结构生成,例如LoRA和Adapter方法。本研究观察到,主干参数任一权重矩阵中的任意两行或列向量之间存在近似正交性,但下/上投影矩阵的向量则不具备此性质。近似正交性意味着模型泛化误差的上界降低,表明模型具有更强的泛化能力。若微调后的下/上投影矩阵能具备与预训练主干矩阵相同的性质,是否能进一步增强微调ViT的泛化能力?为解决该问题,我们提出近似正交微调(AOFT)策略,用于表示低秩权重矩阵。该策略通过单个可学习向量生成一组近似正交向量,构成下/上投影矩阵,使这些矩阵的性质与主干参数一致。大量实验结果表明,我们的方法在多种下游图像分类任务中均取得竞争力的性能,验证了嵌入下/上投影矩阵中增强泛化能力的有效性。我们的代码可在链接中获取。
abstract_en: A prevalent approach in Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) of pre-trained Vision Transformers (ViT) involves freezing the majority of the backbone parameters and solely learning low-rank adaptation weight matrices to accommodate downstream tasks. These low-rank matrices are commonly derived through the multiplication structure of down-projection and up-projection matrices, exemplified by methods such as LoRA and Adapter. In this study, we observe an approximate orthogonality among any two row or column vectors within any weight matrix of the backbone parameters; however, this property is absent in the vectors of the down/up-projection matrices. Approximate orthogonality implies a reduction in the upper bound of the model's generalization error, signifying that the model possesses enhanced generalization capability. If the fine-tuned down/up-projection matrices were to exhibit this same property as the pre-trained backbone matrices, could the generalization capability of fine-tuned ViTs be further augmented? To address this question, we propose an Approximately Orthogonal Fine-Tuning (AOFT) strategy for representing the low-rank weight matrices. This strategy employs a single learnable vector to generate a set of approximately orthogonal vectors, which form the down/up-projection matrices, thereby aligning the properties of these matrices with those of the backbone. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance across a range of downstream image classification tasks, confirming the efficacy of the enhanced generalization capability embedded in the down/up-projection matrices. Our code is available at link.
authors: Yiting Yang, Hao Luo, Yuan Sun, Qingsen Yan, Haokui Zhang, Wei Dong, Guoqing Wang, Peng Wang, Yang Yang, Hengtao Shen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4878-4887

title: 基于八叉树的自适应标记化高效自回归形状生成
title_en: Efficient Autoregressive Shape Generation via Octree-Based Adaptive Tokenization
abstract: 许多三维生成模型依赖于变分自编码器(VAEs)来学习紧凑的形状表示。然而,现有方法将所有形状编码为固定大小的标记,忽视了三维数据中尺度和复杂性的固有变化。这导致了低效的潜在表示,可能影响下游生成效果。我们通过引入基于八叉树的自适应标记化框架来解决这一挑战,该框架根据形状复杂度调整潜在表示的维度。我们的方法构建了一个由二次误差驱动的细分准则引导的自适应八叉树结构,并使用基于查询的Transformer为每个八叉树单元分配形状潜在向量。在此标记化基础上,我们开发了一种基于八叉树的自回归生成模型,有效利用这些可变尺寸的表示进行形状生成。大量实验表明,与固定尺寸方法相比,我们的方法将标记数量减少了50%,同时保持了相当的视觉质量。当使用相似的标记长度时,我们的方法生成的形状质量显著更高。当与下游生成模型结合时,我们的方法能够生成比现有方法更详细和多样的三维内容。
abstract_en: Many 3D generative models rely on variational autoencoders (VAEs) to learn compact shape representations. However, existing methods encode all shapes into a fixed-size token, disregarding the inherent variations in scale and complexity across 3D data. This leads to inefficient latent representations that can compromise downstream generation. We address this challenge by introducing Octree-based Adaptive Tokenization, a novel framework that adjusts the dimension of latent representations according to shape complexity. Our approach constructs an adaptive octree structure guided by a quadric-error-based subdivision criterion and allocates a shape latent vector to each octree cell using a query-based transformer. Building upon this tokenization, we develop an octree-based autoregressive generative model that effectively leverages these variable-sized representations in shape generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach reduces token counts by 50% compared to fixed-size methods while maintaining comparable visual quality. When using a similar token length, our method produces significantly higher-quality shapes. When incorporated with our downstream generative model, our method creates more detailed and diverse 3D content than existing approaches.
authors: Kangle Deng, Hsueh-Ti Derek Liu, Yiheng Zhu, Xiaoxia Sun, Chong Shang, Kiran S. Bhat, Deva Ramanan, Jun-Yan Zhu, Maneesh Agrawala, Tinghui Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11685-11696

title: 高效Concertormer及其在图像去模糊等任务中的应用
title_en: Efficient Concertormer for Image Deblurring and Beyond
abstract: Transformer架构在自然语言处理和视觉任务中表现出色,但其自注意力复杂度与图像尺寸的平方成正比,导致高分辨率任务计算成本高昂。我们提出Concertormer,采用Concerto自注意力(CSA)机制用于图像去模糊。CSA将自注意力分为全局和局部组件,同时在额外维度中保留部分信息,实现线性复杂度。跨维度通信模块通过线性组合注意力图增强表达能力。此外,我们的门控深度可分离卷积MLP将两阶段Transformer设计合并为单阶段。大量实验表明,我们的方法在去模糊、去雨和JPEG伪影去除任务中均优于现有方法。
abstract_en: The Transformer architecture has excelled in NLP and vision tasks, but its self-attention complexity grows quadratically with image size, making high-resolution tasks computationally expensive. We introduce Concertormer, featuring Concerto Self-Attention (CSA) for image deblurring. CSA splits self-attention into global and local components while retaining partial information in additional dimensions, achieving linear complexity. A Cross-Dimensional Communication module enhances expressiveness by linearly combining attention maps. Additionally, our gated-dconv MLP merges the two-staged Transformer design into a single stage. Extensive evaluations show our method performs favorably against state-of-the-art works in deblurring, deraining, and JPEG artifact removal.
authors: Pin-Hung Kuo, Jinshan Pan, Shao-Yi Chien, Ming-Hsuan Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14665-14675

title: 基于自适应提示融合的高效事件相机数据预训练
title_en: Efficient Event Camera Data Pretraining with Adaptive Prompt Fusion
abstract: 将预训练-微调范式应用于事件相机面临显著挑战,这源于大规模事件数据集的稀缺性以及事件数据固有的稀疏性,这在广泛预训练过程中增加了过拟合风险。本文探索将预训练图像知识迁移至事件相机领域以解决这一挑战。我们的方法核心在于将事件数据表示适配至图像预训练模型,同时整合时空信息并缓解数据稀疏性。为此,我们提出一种轻量级时空信息融合提示(SpatioTemporal information fusion Prompting, STP)方法,通过具有多尺度时空感受野的动态感知模块逐步融合事件数据的时空特征,使其与图像预训练模型兼容。STP通过大感受野捕捉局部信息并在时间维度进行全局信息交换,有效减少事件数据的稀疏区域并细化细粒度细节,同时保留其固有时空结构。我们的方法在分类、语义分割和光流估计任务中显著超越现有最先进方法。例如,在仅使用1/10预训练参数和1/3训练轮次的情况下,其在N-ImageNet上达到68.87%(+4.04%)的Top-1准确率。
abstract_en: Applying pretraining-finetuning paradigm to event cameras presents significant challenges due to the scarcity of large-scale event datasets and the inherently sparse nature of event data, which increases the risk of overfitting during extensive pretraining.In this paper, we explore the transfer of pretrained image knowledge to the domain of event cameras to address this challenge. The key to our approach lies in adapting event data representations to align with image pretrained models while simultaneously integrating spatiotemporal information and mitigating data sparsity. To achieve this, we propose a lightweight SpatioTemporal information fusion Prompting (STP) method, which progressively fuses the spatiotemporal characteristics of event data through a dynamic perception module with multi-scale spatiotemporal receptive fields, enabling compatibility with image pretrained models.STP enhances event data representation by capturing local information within a large receptive field and performing global information exchange along the temporal dimension. This strategy effectively reduces sparse regions in event data while refining fine-grained details, all while preserving its inherent spatiotemporal structure. Our method significantly outperforms previous state-of-the-art approaches across classification, semantic segmentation, and optical flow estimation tasks. For instance, it achieves a top-1 accuracy of 68.87% (+4.04%) on N-ImageNet with only 1/10 of the pretraining parameters and 1/3 of the training epochs.
authors: Quanmin Liang, Qiang Li, Shuai Liu, Xinzi Cao, Jinyi Lu, Feidiao Yang, Wei Zhang, Kai Huang, Yonghong Tian ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8656-8667

title: 基于嵌套低秩适应的大模型高效微调
title_en: Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Models via Nested Low-Rank Adaptation
abstract: 低秩适应(LoRA)已成为大模型微调的流行范式,但仍需要大量训练参数。为解决这一问题,我们首先对参数高效的LoRA结构进行了全面实证研究。随后,我们建立了设计指南,强调串行结构、最优位置和嵌套LoRA的使用。基于这些见解,我们提出了NoRA,一种革新投影矩阵初始化和微调的嵌套参数高效LoRA结构。NoRA的创新方法包括冻结外层LoRA权重并采用串行内层设计,从而在保持紧凑训练参数的同时实现精确的任务特定适应。此外,我们提出了一种激活感知奇异值分解(AwSVD),根据激活分布调整权重矩阵以初始化外层LoRA权重。该方案提升了分解精度并缓解了计算误差。在多个大模型上的广泛评估表明,NoRA优于现有LoRA变体,在视觉少样本任务、视觉指令调优和主题驱动生成中实现了显著的性能效率权衡。代码可在https://github.com/lliai/LoRA-Zoo获取。
abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a popular paradigm for fine-tuning large models, but it still necessitates a substantial number of training parameters. To address this issue, we first conduct comprehensive empirical studies on parameter-efficient LoRA structure. Then, we establish design guidelines that emphasize the use of serial structures, optimal placements, and nested LoRA. Based on these insights, we present NoRA, a nested parameter-efficient LoRA structure that revolutionizes the initialization and fine-tuning of projection matrices. Our NoRA's innovative approach involves freezing outer layer LoRA weights and employing a serial inner layer design, enabling precise task-specific adaptations while maintaining compact training parameters. In addition, we propose an activation-aware Singular Value Decomposition (AwSVD) that adjusts the weight matrices based on activation distributions for initialization of outer layer LoRA weights. This schema enhances decomposition accuracy and mitigates computational errors. Extensive evaluations across multiple large models demonstrate that NoRA outperforms state-of-the-art LoRA variants, achieving significant improvements in performance-efficiency trade-off on visual few-shot tasks, visual instruction tuning and subject-driven generation. Codes are available at https://github.com/lliai/LoRA-Zoo.
authors: Lujun Li, Cheng Lin, Dezhi Li, You-Liang Huang, Wei Li, Tianyu Wu, Jie Zou, Wei Xue, Sirui Han, Yike Guo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22252-22262

title: 基于神经元激活变化的文本到图像合成输入级后门防御方法
title_en: Efficient Input-level Backdoor Defense on Text-to-Image Synthesis via Neuron Activation Variation
abstract: 近年来,文本到图像(T2I)扩散模型因其能够生成反映文本提示的高质量图像而受到广泛关注。然而,其日益流行也导致了后门威胁的出现,带来了重大风险。目前,由于T2I合成中后门目标的多样性,针对此类威胁的有效防御策略仍显不足。本文提出NaviT2I,一种高效的输入级后门防御框架,可应对多样化的T2I后门攻击。我们的方法基于新观察:触发标记倾向于在扩散生成过程的早期阶段引起显著的神经元激活变化,我们将这一现象称为早期步骤激活变化(Early-step Activation Variation)。利用这一洞察,NaviT2I通过分析输入标记引起的神经元激活变化,引导T2I模型阻止恶意输入。大量实验表明,NaviT2I在多样化数据集、各种T2I后门攻击以及包括UNet和DiT在内的不同模型架构中,均在有效性与效率上显著优于基线方法。此外,我们证明了该方法在潜在自适应攻击下仍保持有效性。
abstract_en: In recent years, text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models have gained significant attention for their ability to generate high-quality images reflecting text prompts. However, their growing popularity has also led to the emergence of backdoor threats, posing substantial risks. Currently, effective defense strategies against such threats are lacking due to the diversity of backdoor targets in T2I synthesis. In this paper, we propose NaviT2I, an efficient input-level backdoor defense framework against diverse T2I backdoors. Our approach is based on the new observation that trigger tokens tend to induce significant neuron activation variation in the early stage of the diffusion generation process, a phenomenon we term Early-step Activation Variation. Leveraging this insight, NaviT2I navigates T2I models to prevent malicious inputs by analyzing Neuron activation variations caused by input tokens. Extensive experiments show that NaviT2I significantly outperforms the baselines in both effectiveness and efficiency across diverse datasets, various T2I backdoors, and different model architectures including UNet and DiT. Furthermore, we show that our method remains effective under potential adaptive attacks.
authors: Shengfang Zhai, Jiajun Li, Yue Liu, Huanran Chen, Zhihua Tian, Wenjie Qu, Qingni Shen, Ruoxi Jia, Yinpeng Dong, Jiaheng Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15182-15193

title: 基于轻量级空间与时间交互的高效多人运动预测
title_en: Efficient Multi-Person Motion Prediction by Lightweight Spatial and Temporal Interactions
abstract: 三维多人运动预测是一项高度复杂的任务,主要由于其依赖于个体过去运动和智能体间交互。此外,有效建模这些交互通常会带来显著的计算成本。在本工作中,我们通过简化空间和时间交互提出了一种计算高效的多人运动预测模型。我们的方法首先设计了轻量级双分支结构,分别学习个体和多人的局部与全局表示。此外,我们引入了一种新颖的跨层级交互模块,以整合两个分支的空间和时间表示。为进一步增强交互建模,我们显式地纳入了空间人际距离嵌入。通过上述高效的时空设计,在CMU-Mocap、MuPoTS-3D和3DPW标准数据集的多个指标上实现了最先进的性能,同时显著降低了计算成本。
abstract_en: 3D multi-person motion prediction is a highly complex task, primarily due to the dependencies on both individual past movements and the interactions between agents. Moreover, effectively modeling these interactions often incurs substantial computational costs. In this work, we propose a computationally efficient model for multi-person motion prediction by simplifying spatial and temporal interactions. Our approach begins with the design of lightweight dual branches that learn local and global representations for individual and multiple persons separately. Additionally, we introduce a novel cross-level interaction block to integrate the spatial and temporal representations from both branches. To further enhance interaction modeling, we explicitly incorporate the spatial inter-person distance embedding. With above efficient temporal and spatial design, we achieve state-of-the-art performance for multiple metrics on standard datasets of CMU-Mocap, MuPoTS-3D, and 3DPW, while significantly reducing the computational cost.
authors: Yuanhong Zheng, Ruixuan Yu, Jian Sun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10844-10853

title: 面向点云分析的高效尖峰点Mamba模型
title_en: Efficient Spiking Point Mamba for Point Cloud Analysis
abstract: 生物启发的尖峰神经网络(SNNs)为提取3D时空特征提供了一种能效高的方法。然而,现有的3D SNNs在处理长程依赖方面一直存在困难,直到最近Mamba的出现,其提供了卓越的计算效率和序列建模能力。在本工作中,我们提出了尖峰点Mamba(SPM),这是首个基于Mamba的3D领域SNN。然而,直接将Mamba适配到3D SNNs时,会受到时序动态不匹配和尖峰引起的信损问题的阻碍。因此,我们首先引入了分层动态编码(HDE),这是一种改进的直接编码方法,能有效引入动态时序机制。随后,我们提出了尖峰Mamba块(SMB),其在Mamba基础上学习时序步间特征并最小化尖峰导致的信息损失。最后,为了进一步提升性能,我们采用非对称的SNN-ANN架构进行基于尖峰的预训练和微调。与之前最先进的SNN模型相比,SPM在ScanObjectNN的三个变体上整体准确率分别提升了+6.2%、+6.1%和+7.4%,并在ShapeNetPart上将实例mIOU提升了+1.9%。同时,其能耗最多仅为对应ANN模型的12.6倍。代码:https://github.com/PeppaWu/SPM。
abstract_en: Bio-inspired Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) provide an energy-efficient way to extract 3D spatio-temporal features. However, existing 3D SNNs have struggled with long-range dependencies until the recent emergence of Mamba, which offers superior computational efficiency and sequence modeling capability. In this work, we propose Spiking Point Mamba (SPM), the first Mamba-based SNN in the 3D domain. Naively adapting Mamba to 3D SNNs, though, is hindered by temporal dynamics mismatch and spike-induced information loss. Thus, we first introduce Hierarchical Dynamic Encoding (HDE), an improved direct encoding method that effectively introduces dynamic temporal mechanism. Then, we propose Spiking Mamba Block (SMB), which builds upon Mamba while learning inter-time-step features and minimizing information loss caused by spikes. Finally, to further boost performance, we adopt an asymmetric SNN-ANN architecture for spike-based pre-training and finetune. Compared with the previous state-of-the-art SNN models, SPM improves overall accuracy by +6.2%, +6.1%, and +7.4% on three variants of ScanObjectNN, and boosts instance mIOU by +1.9% on ShapeNetPart. Meanwhile, its energy consumption is at most 12.6x lower than that of its ANN counterpart. Code: https://github.com/PeppaWu/SPM.
authors: Peixi Wu, Bosong Chai, Menghua Zheng, Wei Li, Zhangchi Hu, Jie Chen, Zheyu Zhang, Hebei Li, Xiaoyan Sun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26393-26403

title: 高效追踪一切
title_en: Efficient Track Anything
abstract: 分割一切模型2(SAM 2)已成为视频对象分割和追踪一切的强大工具。驱动SAM 2出色视频对象分割性能的关键组件包括用于帧特征提取的大型多阶段图像编码器以及存储过去帧记忆上下文的记忆机制,以帮助当前帧分割。图像编码器和记忆模块的高计算复杂度限制了其在现实任务中的应用,例如移动设备上的视频对象分割。为了解决这一限制,我们提出了EfficientTAMs,轻量级端到端追踪一切模型,能够在低延迟和小模型尺寸下产生高质量结果。我们的方法基于采用轻量级视觉Transformer(ViT)作为视频对象分割的图像编码器,并引入高效记忆模块,降低帧特征提取和当前帧分割的记忆计算复杂度。我们使用原始轻量级ViT和高效记忆模块构建EfficientTAMs,并在SA-1B和SA-V数据集上训练模型进行视频对象分割和追踪一切任务。我们在多个视频分割基准测试中进行了评估,包括半监督VOS和可提示视频分割,发现我们的轻量级ViT的EfficientTAM在A100上比SAM 2-HieraB+快1.6倍,参数量减少2.4倍。在分割一切图像任务中,我们的EfficientTAM在A100上比原始SAM快20倍,参数量减少20倍。在iPhone 15 Pro Max等移动设备上,我们的EfficientTAM可实现28 FPS的近实时视频对象分割,质量合理,突显了小型模型在设备端视频对象分割应用中的能力。我们的EfficientTAM代码和模型可在https://github.com/yformer/EfficientTAM获取。
abstract_en: Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM 2) has emerged as a powerful tool for video object segmentation and tracking anything. Key components of SAM 2 that drive the impressive video object segmentation performance include a large multistage image encoder for frame feature extraction and a memory mechanism that stores memory contexts from past frames to help current frame segmentation. The high computation complexity of image encoder and memory module has limited its applications in real-world tasks, e.g., video object segmentation on mobile devices. To address this limitation, we propose EfficientTAMs, lightweight end-to-end track anything models that produce high-quality results with low latency and small model size. Our idea is based on adopting lightweight Vision Transformer (ViT) as an image encoder for video object segmentation, and introducing an efficient memory module, which reduces the complexity for both frame feature extraction and memory computation for current frame segmentation. We take vanilla lightweight ViTs and efficient memory module to build EfficientTAMs, and train the models on SA-1B and SA-V datasets for video object segmentation and track anything tasks. We evaluate on multiple video segmentation benchmarks including semi-supervised VOS and promptable video segmentation, and find that our proposed EfficientTAM with lightweight ViT performs comparably to SAM 2 model (SAM 2-HieraB+) with  1.6x speedup on A100 and  2.4x parameter reduction. On segment anything image tasks, our EfficientTAMs also perform favorably over original SAM with  20x speedup on A100 and  20x parameter reduction. On mobile devices such as iPhone 15 Pro Max, our EfficientTAM can run at  28 FPS for near real-time video object segmentation with reasonable quality, highlighting the capability of small models for on-device video object segmentation applications. Our EfficientTAM code and models are available at https://github.com/yformer/EfficientTAM.
authors: Yunyang Xiong, Chong Zhou, Xiaoyu Xiang, Lemeng Wu, Chenchen Zhu, Zechun Liu, Saksham Suri, Balakrishnan Varadarajan, Ramya Akula, Forrest Iandola, Raghuraman Krishnamoorthi, Bilge Soran, Vikas Chandra ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11513-11524

title: Transformer中高效无监督捷径学习检测与缓解方法
title_en: Efficient Unsupervised Shortcut Learning Detection and Mitigation in Transformers
abstract: 捷径学习,即模型依赖于与任务无直接关联的不相关特征,是限制机器学习算法应用的主要挑战,特别是在部署用于辅助敏感决策(如医学诊断)时。在本研究中,我们利用机器学习领域的最新进展,构建了一个能够同时检测和缓解Transformer中捷径学习的无监督框架。我们在多个数据集上验证了该方法。结果表明,我们的框架显著提升了最差群体准确率(因捷径导致误分类的样本)和平均准确率,同时最小化了人工标注工作量。此外,我们证明检测到的捷径对人类专家具有意义且信息丰富,且该框架计算效率高,可在消费级硬件上运行。
abstract_en: Shortcut learning, i.e., a model's reliance on undesired features not directly relevant to the task, is a major challenge that severely limits the applications of machine learning algorithms, particularly when deploying them to assist in making sensitive decisions, such as in medical diagnostics. In this work, we leverage recent advancements in machine learning to create an unsupervised framework that is capable of both detecting and mitigating shortcut learning in transformers. We validate our method on multiple datasets. Results demonstrate that our framework significantly improves both worst-group accuracy (samples misclassified due to shortcuts) and average accuracy, while minimizing human annotation effort. Moreover, we demonstrate that the detected shortcuts are meaningful and informative to human experts, and that our framework is computationally efficient, allowing it to be run on consumer hardware.
authors: Lukas Kuhn, Sari Sadiya, Jörg Schlötterer, Florian Buettner, Christin Seifert, Gemma Roig ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2217-2226

title: 通过多模态语义知识集成的高效视觉地点识别
title_en: Efficient Visual Place Recognition Through Multimodal Semantic Knowledge Integration
abstract: 视觉地点识别对于自主导航和机器人地图构建至关重要。当前方法在感知别名和计算效率方面存在不足。我们提出SemVPR,一种将多模态语义知识集成到视觉地点识别(VPR)中的新方法。通过在训练阶段利用预训练的视觉-语言模型作为教师,SemVPR同时学习局部视觉和语义描述符,通过语义感知的聚合有效缓解感知别名问题,且无需额外的推理成本。所提出的嵌套描述符学习策略以由粗到细的方式生成一系列超紧凑的全局描述符,其维度较现有方法降低约__ABS_MATH_1__,消除了对离线降维或训练多个模型的需求。在多个VPR基准数据集上的广泛实验表明,SemVPR在显著降低计算成本的情况下持续优于现有方法,使其在现实场景的延迟敏感应用中具有可行性。
abstract_en: Visual place recognition is crucial for autonomous navigation and robotic mapping. Current methods struggle with perceptual aliasing and computational inefficiency. We present SemVPR, a novel approach integrating multimodal semantic knowledge into VPR.
