By leveraging a pre-trained vision-language model as a teacher during the training phase, SemVPR learns local visual and semantic descriptors simultaneously, effectively mitigating perceptual aliasing through semantic-aware aggregation without extra inference cost. The proposed nested descriptor learning strategy generates a series of ultra-compact global descriptors, reduced by approximately compared to state-of-the-art methods, in a coarse-to-fine manner, eliminating the need for offline dimensionality reduction or training multiple models. Extensive experiments across various VPR benchmarks demonstrate that SemVPR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods with significantly lower computational costs, rendering its feasibility for latency-sensitive scenarios in real-world applications.
authors: Sitao Zhang, Hongda Mao, Qingshuang Chen, Yelin Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5601-5610

title: EfficientMT:文本到视频扩散模型中的高效时间自适应运动迁移
title_en: EfficientMT: Efficient Temporal Adaptation for Motion Transfer in Text-to-Video Diffusion Models
abstract: 生成模型的进展推动了文本到视频(T2V)生成技术的显著发展,但生成视频的运动可控性仍存在局限。现有运动迁移方法通过参考视频的运动表示来引导生成过程。然而,这些方法通常依赖样本特定优化框架,导致计算负担较高。本文提出EfficientMT,一种新颖高效的端到端视频运动迁移框架。通过利用少量合成配对运动迁移样本,EfficientMT能够有效将预训练的T2V模型适配为通用运动迁移框架,准确捕捉并复现多样化的运动模式。具体而言,我们重新利用T2V模型的骨干网络提取参考视频的时间信息,并进一步提出标量模块以蒸馏运动相关信息。随后,我们引入时间整合机制,无缝整合参考运动特征到视频生成过程中。在自收集的合成配对样本上训练后,EfficientMT无需测试时优化即可实现通用视频运动迁移。大量实验表明,我们的EfficientMT在保持灵活运动可控性的同时,相比现有方法在效率上具有显著优势。我们的代码将开源于https://github.com/PrototypeNx/EfficientMT。
abstract_en: The progress on generative models has led to significant advances on text-to-video (T2V) generation, yet the motion controllability of generated videos remains limited. Existing motion transfer approaches explored the motion representations of reference videos to guide generation. Nevertheless, these methods typically rely on sample-specific optimization frameworks, resulting in high computational burdens. In this paper, we propose EfficientMT, a novel and efficient end-to-end framework for video motion transfer. By leveraging a small set of synthetic paired motion transfer samples, EfficientMT effectively adapts a pretrained T2V model into a general motion transfer framework that can accurately capture and reproduce diverse motion patterns. Specifically, we repurpose the backbone of the T2V model to extract temporal information from reference videos, and further propose a scaler module to distill motion-related information. Subsequently, we introduce a temporal integration mechanism that seamlessly incorporates reference motion features into the video generation process. After training on our self-collected synthetic paired samples, EfficientMT enables general video motion transfer without requiring test-time optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our EfficientMT outperforms existing methods in efficiency while maintaining flexible motion controllability. Our code will be available at https://github.com/PrototypeNx/EfficientMT.
authors: Yufei Cai, Hu Han, Yuxiang Wei, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10592-10601

title: EgoAdapt:面向高效第一视角感知的自适应多模态蒸馏与策略学习
title_en: EgoAdapt: Adaptive Multisensory Distillation and Policy Learning for Efficient Egocentric Perception
abstract: 现代感知模型,特别是针对多模态第一视角任务设计的模型,虽取得了显著性能,但往往伴随着高昂的计算成本。这些高需求对实际部署构成挑战,尤其是在资源受限的环境中。本文提出EGOADAPT框架,通过自适应跨模态蒸馏与策略学习,实现不同第一视角感知任务(包括第一视角动作识别、主动说话人定位和行为预测)的高效推理。我们提出的策略模块可适配任务特定的动作空间,具有广泛适用性。在三个具有挑战性的第一视角数据集——EPIC-Kitchens、EasyCom和Aria Everyday Activities上的实验结果表明,我们的方法显著提升了效率,将GMACs降低最多89.09%,参数减少最多82.02%,能耗降低达9.6倍,同时在多数情况下与对应SOTA模型性能相当甚至更优。
abstract_en: Modern perception models, particularly those designed for multisensory egocentric tasks, have achieved remarkable performance but often come with substantial computational costs. These high demands pose challenges for real-world deployment, especially in resource-constrained environments. In this paper, we introduce EGOADAPT, a framework that adaptively performs cross-modal distillation and policy learning to enable efficient inference across different egocentric perception tasks, including egocentric action recognition, active speaker localization, and behavior anticipation. Our proposed policy module is adaptable to task-specific action spaces, making it broadly applicable. Experimental results on three challenging egocentric datasets - EPIC-Kitchens, EasyCom, and Aria Everyday Activities - demonstrate that our method significantly enhances efficiency, reducing GMACs by up to 89.09%, parameters up to 82.02%, and energy up to 9.6x, while still on-par and in many cases outperforming the performance of corresponding state-of-the-art models.
authors: Sanjoy Chowdhury, Subrata Biswas, Sayan Nag, Tushar Nagarajan, Calvin Murdock, Ishwarya Ananthabhotla, Yijun Qian, Vamsi Krishna Ithapu, Dinesh Manocha, Ruohan Gao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10741-10752

title: EgoAgent:一种以自我为中心世界中的联合预测智能体模型
title_en: EgoAgent: A Joint Predictive Agent Model in Egocentric Worlds
abstract: 学习一个能够像人类一样行为的智能体模型——具备联合感知环境、预测未来并以第一人称视角采取行动的能力——是计算机视觉中的基础性挑战。现有方法通常为这些能力单独训练模型,无法捕捉其内在关联性,也阻碍了它们之间的相互学习。受人类通过感知-行动循环学习机制的启发,我们提出EgoAgent,这是一种统一的智能体模型,能够在单一Transformer中同时学习表征、预测和行动。EgoAgent通过将任务建模为状态与动作的交错序列,显式建模这些能力间的因果关系和时间依赖性。进一步引入了联合嵌入-动作预测架构,包含时间不对称的预测器和观察器分支,实现了三类能力的协同优化。在图像分类、第一视角未来状态预测和三维人体运动预测等代表性任务上的全面评估表明,我们的方法具有优越性。代码和训练模型将在https://github.com/zju3dv/EgoAgent公开。
abstract_en: Learning an agent model that behaves like humans--capable of jointly perceiving the environment, predicting the future, and taking actions from a first-person perspective--is a fundamental challenge in computer vision. Existing methods typically train separate models for these abilities, which fail to capture their intrinsic relationships and prevent them from learning from each other. Inspired by how humans learn through the perception-action loop, we propose EgoAgent, a unified agent model that simultaneously learns to represent, predict, and act within a single transformer. EgoAgent explicitly models the causal and temporal dependencies among these abilities by formulating the task as an interleaved sequence of states and actions. It further introduces a joint embedding-action-prediction architecture with temporally asymmetric predictor and observer branches, enabling synergistic optimization across all three capabilities. Comprehensive evaluations of EgoAgent on representative tasks such as image classification, egocentric future state prediction, and 3D human motion prediction demonstrate the superiority of our method. The code and trained models will be publicly available at https://github.com/zju3dv/EgoAgent.
authors: Lu Chen, Yizhou Wang, Shixiang Tang, Qianhong Ma, Tong He, Wanli Ouyang, Xiaowei Zhou, Hujun Bao, Sida Peng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6970-6980

title: EgoM2P:第一视角多模态多任务预训练
title_en: EgoM2P: Egocentric Multimodal Multitask Pretraining
abstract: 理解第一视角视觉中的多模态信号(如RGB视频、深度、相机姿态和注视)对于增强现实、机器人和人机交互等应用至关重要,使系统能够更好地解读佩戴相机者的动作、意图及周围环境。然而,构建大规模第一视角多模态和多任务模型面临独特挑战。第一视角数据本质上具有异构性,不同设备和场景下的模态覆盖范围存在显著差异。生成缺失模态(如注视或头戴式相机轨迹)的伪标签往往不可行,使得标准监督学习方法难以扩展。此外,动态相机运动和第一视角视频复杂的时序与空间结构也给现有多模态基础模型的直接应用带来额外挑战。为应对这些挑战,我们提出一组高效的时间感知标记器,并引入EgoM2P,一种基于掩码建模的框架,通过时序感知的多模态标记进行训练,构建大规模通用模型以实现第一视角4D理解。该统一设计支持跨多样化的第一视角感知与合成任务的多任务学习,包括注视预测、第一视角相机跟踪和从第一视角视频中单目深度估计,同时还能作为条件第一视角视频生成的生成模型。在这些任务中,EgoM2P在性能上匹配或超越专业模型,且速度提升一个数量级。我们将完全开源EgoM2P以支持社区并推动第一视角视觉研究。
abstract_en: Understanding multimodal signals in egocentric vision, such as RGB video, depth, camera poses, and gaze, is essential for applications in augmented reality, robotics, and human-computer interaction, enabling systems to better interpret the camera wearer's actions, intentions, and surrounding environment. However, building large-scale egocentric multimodal and multitask models presents unique challenges. Egocentric data are inherently heterogeneous, with large variations in modality coverage across devices and settings. Generating pseudo-labels for missing modalities, such as gaze or head-mounted camera trajectories, is often infeasible, making standard supervised learning approaches difficult to scale. Furthermore, dynamic camera motion and the complex temporal and spatial structure of first-person video pose additional challenges for the direct application of existing multimodal foundation models. To address these challenges, we introduce a set of efficient temporal tokenizers and propose EgoM2P, a masked modeling framework that learns from temporally-aware multimodal tokens to train a large, general-purpose model for egocentric 4D understanding. This unified design supports multitasking across diverse egocentric perception and synthesis tasks, including gaze prediction, egocentric camera tracking, and monocular depth estimation from egocentric video, and also serves as a generative model for conditional egocentric video synthesis. Across these tasks, EgoM2P matches or outperforms specialist models while being an order of magnitude faster. We will fully open-source EgoM2P to support the community and advance egocentric vision research.
authors: Gen Li, Yutong Chen, Yiqian Wu, Kaifeng Zhao, Marc Pollefeys, Siyu Tang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10830-10843

title: 基于EgoMusic的人体舞蹈动作估计与Skeleton Mamba
title_en: EgoMusic-driven Human Dance Motion Estimation with Skeleton Mamba
abstract: 人体舞蹈动作估计是一项具有多种工业应用的挑战性任务。近期,许多研究致力于通过第一视角视频或音乐作为输入来预测人体舞蹈动作。然而,从第一视角视频和音乐联合估计人体动作的任务仍鲜有探索。本文旨在开发一种新方法,通过第一视角视频和音乐共同预测人体舞蹈动作。实践中,第一视角常遮挡大量身体部位,使得准确的全身姿态估计极具挑战性。此外,融合音乐要求生成的头部和身体运动需与视觉和音乐输入保持良好对齐。我们首先引入EgoAIST++,这是一个结合第一视角和音乐的新型大规模数据集,包含超过36小时的舞蹈动作。借鉴扩散模型和Mamba在序列建模中的成功经验,我们开发了EgoMusic Motion Network,其核心为显式捕捉人体骨架结构的Skeleton Mamba。我们证明该方法在理论上具有支撑性。大量实验表明,我们的方法显著优于现有先进方法,并能有效泛化到真实世界数据。
abstract_en: Estimating human dance motion is a challenging task with various industrial applications. Recently, many efforts have focused on predicting human dance motion using either egocentric video or music as input. However, the task of jointly estimating human motion from both egocentric video and music remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we aim to develop a new method that predicts human dance motion from both egocentric video and music. In practice, the egocentric view often obscures much of the body, making accurate full-pose estimation challenging. Additionally, incorporating music requires the generated head and body movements to align well with both visual and musical inputs. We first introduce EgoAIST++, a new large-scale dataset that combines both egocentric views and music with more than 36 hours of dancing motion. Drawing on the success of diffusion models and Mamba on modeling sequences, we develop an EgoMusic Motion Network with a core Skeleton Mamba that explicitly captures the skeleton structure of the human body. We illustrate that our approach is theoretically supportive. Intensive experiments show that our method clearly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches and generalizes effectively to real-world data.
authors: Quang Nguyen, Nhat Le, Baoru Huang, Minh Nhat Vu, Chengcheng Tang, Van Nguyen, Ngan Le, Thieu Vo, Anh Nguyen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12023-12033

title: 点云中基于视觉-语言引导的自我中心动作感知惯性定位
title_en: Egocentric Action-aware Inertial Localization in Point Clouds with Vision-Language Guidance
abstract: 本文提出了一种新型惯性定位框架,称为自我中心动作感知惯性定位(EAIL),该框架利用头戴式IMU信号中的自我中心动作线索,在三维点云中定位目标个体。由于IMU传感器噪声会导致轨迹随时间漂移,人类惯性定位具有挑战性。人类动作的多样性进一步通过引入多种运动模式复杂化了IMU信号处理。然而,我们观察到某些由头戴式IMU捕获的动作与空间环境结构(如弯腰查看烤箱内部、在水槽旁洗碗)相关,这些动作可作为空间锚点以补偿定位漂移。所提出的EAIL框架通过层次化多模态对齐与视觉-语言引导学习此类相关性。假设环境的三维点云可用,该框架通过对比学习模态编码器,将IMU信号中的短期自我中心动作线索与点云中的局部环境特征对齐。利用同时采集的视觉和语言信号增强学习过程以提升多模态对齐效果。学习得到的编码器随后用于随时间空间推理IMU数据和点云以执行惯性定位。有趣的是,这些编码器还可作为副产品用于识别对应的动作序列。大量实验验证了所提框架在现有惯性定位和惯性动作识别基线方法上的有效性。
abstract_en: This paper presents a novel inertial localization framework named Egocentric Action-aware Inertial Localization (EAIL), which leverages egocentric action cues from head-mounted IMU signals to localize the target individual within a 3D point cloud. Human inertial localization is challenging due to IMU sensor noise that causes trajectory drift over time. The diversity of human actions further complicates IMU signal processing by introducing various motion patterns. Nevertheless, we observe that some actions captured by the head-mounted IMU correlate with spatial environmental structures (e.g., bending down to look inside an oven, washing dishes next to a sink), thereby serving as spatial anchors to compensate for the localization drift. The proposed EAIL framework learns such correlations via hierarchical multi-modal alignment with vision-language guidance. By assuming that the 3D point cloud of the environment is available, it contrastively learns modality encoders that align short-term egocentric action cues in IMU signals with local environmental features in the point cloud. The learning process is enhanced using concurrently collected vision and language signals to improve multimodal alignment. The learned encoders are then used in reasoning the IMU data and the point cloud over time and space to perform inertial localization. Interestingly, these encoders can further be utilized to recognize the corresponding sequence of actions as a by-product. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework over state-of-the-art inertial localization and inertial action recognition baselines.
authors: Mingfang Zhang, Ryo Yonetani, Yifei Huang, Liangyang Ouyang, Ruicong Liu, Yoichi Sato ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27209-27219

title: 具身图像描述:用于空间一致图像描述的自监督学习代理
title_en: Embodied Image Captioning: Self-supervised Learning Agents for Spatially Coherent Image Descriptions
abstract: 我们提出了一种自监督方法,以提升代理在描述任意物体时的能力,同时主动探索通用环境。这是一个具有挑战性的问题,因为当前模型由于不同的摄像机视角和杂乱环境,难以获得连贯的图像描述。我们提出一个三阶段框架,用于微调现有的图像描述模型,通过共识机制提升描述的准确性与视角一致性。首先,代理探索环境,收集带有噪声的图像-描述对。然后,利用大规模语言模型通过共识机制提炼每个物体实例的一致伪描述。最后,这些伪描述用于微调现成的图像描述模型,并引入对比学习。我们分析了描述模型、探索策略、伪标签方法和微调策略的组合性能,在我们手动标注的测试集上进行评估。结果表明,可以训练出一种策略,挖掘出与经典基线相比具有更高分歧的样本。我们的伪描述方法与所有策略结合后,语义相似度高于其他现有方法,微调显著提升了描述的准确性与一致性。代码和测试集注释可在https://hsp-iit.github.io/embodied-captioning获取。
abstract_en: We present a self-supervised method to improve an agent's abilities in describing arbitrary objects while actively exploring a generic environment. This is a challenging problem, as current models struggle to obtain coherent image captions due to different camera viewpoints and clutter. We propose a three-phase framework to fine-tune existing captioning models that enhances caption accuracy and consistency across views via a consensus mechanism. First, an agent explores the environment, collecting noisy image-caption pairs. Then, a consistent pseudo-caption for each object instance is distilled via consensus using a large language model. Finally, these pseudo-captions are used to fine-tune an off-the-shelf captioning model, with the addition of contrastive learning. We analyse the performance of the combination of captioning models, exploration policies, pseudo-labeling methods, and fine-tuning strategies, on our manually labeled test set. Results show that a policy can be trained to mine samples with higher disagreement compared to classical baselines. Our pseudo-captioning method, in combination with all policies, has a higher semantic similarity compared to other existing methods, and fine-tuning improves caption accuracy and consistency by a significant margin. Code and test set annotations available at https://hsp-iit.github.io/embodied-captioning.
authors: Tommaso Galliena, Tommaso Apicella, Stefano Rosa, Pietro Morerio, Alessio Del Bue, Lorenzo Natale ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24370-24379

title: 基于动作描述预测的辅助任务的具身导航
title_en: Embodied Navigation with Auxiliary Task of Action Description Prediction
abstract: 近年来,多模态机器人在室内环境中的导航领域受到了广泛关注。然而,随着任务和方法的不断进步,动作决策系统趋于复杂化并成为黑箱模型。对于可靠系统而言,具备解释或描述其决策的能力至关重要;但通常存在权衡,即可解释系统在性能上难以超越不可解释系统。本文提出将动作描述任务作为语言生成的辅助任务融入导航的强化学习中。现有研究发现,由于缺乏真实数据,将动作描述融入强化学习存在困难。我们通过利用预训练描述生成模型(如视觉-语言模型)的知识蒸馏来解决这一问题。我们在多种导航任务中全面评估了所提出的方法,证明其能够在保持高导航性能的同时描述动作。此外,该方法在具有挑战性的语义音频-视觉导航多模态导航任务中达到了当前最佳性能。
abstract_en: The field of multimodal robot navigation in indoor environments has garnered significant attention in recent years. However, as tasks and methods become more advanced, the action decision systems tend to become more complex and operate as black-boxes. For a reliable system, the ability to explain or describe its decisions is crucial; however, there tends to be a trade-off in that explainable systems cannot outperform non-explainable systems in terms of performance. In this paper, we propose incorporating the task of describing actions in language into the reinforcement learning of navigation as an auxiliary task. Existing studies have found it difficult to incorporate describing actions into reinforcement learning due to the absence of ground-truth data. We address this issue by leveraging knowledge distillation from pre-trained description generation models, such as vision-language models. We comprehensively evaluate our approach across various navigation tasks, demonstrating that it can describe actions while attaining high navigation performance. Furthermore, it achieves state-of-the-art performance in the particularly challenging multimodal navigation task of semantic audio-visual navigation.
authors: Haru Kondoh, Asako Kanezaki ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7025-7036

title: 具身表征对齐与镜像神经元
title_en: Embodied Representation Alignment with Mirror Neurons
abstract: 镜像神经元是一类在个体观察动作和执行相同动作时都会激活的神经元。这种机制揭示了动作理解与具身执行之间存在根本性的相互作用,表明这两种能力本质上是相互关联的。然而,现有机器学习方法大多忽视了这种相互作用,将这两种能力视为独立任务。在本研究中,我们通过表征学习的视角提供了一个统一的建模框架。我们首先观察到它们的中间表征会自发对齐。受镜像神经元的启发,我们进一步提出了一种显式对齐观察动作与执行动作表征的方法。具体而言,我们采用两个线性层将表征映射到共享的潜在空间,其中对比学习强制对齐对应表征,有效最大化其互信息。实验表明,这种简单方法在两个任务间建立了相互协同效应,有效提升了表征质量与泛化能力。
abstract_en: Mirror neurons are a class of neurons that activate both when an individual observes an action and when they perform the same action. This mechanism reveals a fundamental interplay between action understanding and embodied execution, suggesting that these two abilities are inherently connected. Nonetheless, existing machine learning methods largely overlook this interplay, treating these abilities as separate tasks. In this study, we provide a unified perspective in modeling them through the lens of representation learning. We first observe that their intermediate representations spontaneously align. Inspired by mirror neurons, we further introduce an approach that explicitly aligns the representations of observed and executed actions. Specifically, we employ two linear layers to map the representations to a shared latent space, where contrastive learning enforces the alignment of corresponding representations, effectively maximizing their mutual information. Experiments demonstrate that this simple approach fosters mutual synergy between the two tasks, effectively improving representation quality and generalization.
authors: Wentao Zhu, Zhining Zhang, Yuwei Ren, Yin Huang, Hao Xu, Yizhou Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11948-11957

title: 具身视频代理:从第一视角视频和具身传感器获取的持久记忆实现动态场景理解
title_en: Embodied VideoAgent: Persistent Memory from Egocentric Videos and Embodied Sensors Enables Dynamic Scene Understanding
abstract: 本文研究了从第一视角观测理解动态三维场景的问题,这是机器人学和具身人工智能中的关键挑战。与以往将该问题视为长视频理解并仅利用第一视角视频的研究不同,我们提出了一种基于大语言模型的代理——具身视频代理(Embodied VideoAgent),该代理通过第一视角视频和具身感官输入(如深度和姿态感知)构建场景记忆。我们进一步引入了一种基于视觉语言模型的方法,用于在感知到动作或对象活动时自动更新记忆。具身视频代理在三维场景中的复杂推理和规划任务中显著优于其他方法,在Ego4D-VQ3D上提升6.5%,在OpenEQA上提升2.6%,在EnvQA上提升15.3%。我们还展示了其在生成具身交互和机器人操作感知等各类具身人工智能任务中的潜力。代码和演示将公开。
abstract_en: This paper investigates the problem of understanding dynamic 3D scenes from egocentric observations, a key challenge in robotics and embodied AI. Unlike prior studies that explored this as long-form video understanding and utilized egocentric video only, we instead propose an LLM-based agent, Embodied VideoAgent, which constructs scene memory from both egocentric video and embodied sensory inputs (e.g. depth and pose sensing). We further introduce a VLM-based approach to automatically update the memory when actions or activities over objects are perceived. Embodied VideoAgent attains significant advantages over counterparts in challenging reasoning and planning tasks in 3D scenes, achieving gains of 6.5% on Ego4D-VQ3D, 2.6% on OpenEQA, and 15.3% on EnvQA. We have also demonstrated its potential in various embodied AI tasks including generating embodied interactions and perception for robot manipulation. The code and demo will be made public.
authors: Yue Fan, Xiaojian Ma, Rongpeng Su, Jun Guo, Rujie Wu, Xi Chen, Qing Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6342-6352

title: EmbodiedOcc:基于视觉的在线场景理解的具身化三维占据预测
title_en: EmbodiedOcc: Embodied 3D Occupancy Prediction for Vision-based Online Scene Understanding
abstract: 三维占据预测能够全面描述周围场景,已成为三维感知的重要任务。现有方法多集中于从单个或少数视角进行离线感知,难以应用于需要通过渐进式具身探索逐步感知场景的具身智能体。本文提出了一种具身化三维占据预测任务以应对这一实际场景,并设计了一种基于高斯分布的EmbodiedOcc框架来实现该任务。我们通过均匀分布的三维语义高斯分布初始化全局场景,并逐步更新具身智能体观测到的局部区域。对于每次更新,我们从观测图像中提取语义和结构特征,并通过可变形交叉注意力机制高效融合以细化区域高斯分布。最终,我们采用高斯到体素的投影技术,从更新后的三维高斯分布中获得全局三维占据。我们的EmbodiedOcc假设环境未知(即均匀分布),并利用三维高斯分布显式维护其全局记忆。它通过区域高斯分布的局部细化逐步获取知识,这与人类通过具身探索理解新场景的方式一致。我们基于局部标注重新组织了一个EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet基准数据集,以促进具身三维占据预测任务的评估。我们的EmbodiedOcc在现有方法基础上取得了显著性能提升,并以高精度和高效率实现了具身占据预测。Code: https://github.com/YkiWu/EmbodiedOcc.
abstract_en: 3D occupancy prediction provides a comprehensive description of the surrounding scenes and has become an essential task for 3D perception. Most existing methods focus on offline perception from one or a few views and cannot be applied to embodied agents that demand to gradually perceive the scene through progressive embodied exploration. In this paper, we formulate an embodied 3D occupancy prediction task to target this practical scenario and propose a Gaussian-based EmbodiedOcc framework to accomplish it. We initialize the global scene with uniform 3D semantic Gaussians and progressively update local regions observed by the embodied agent. For each update, we extract semantic and structural features from the observed image and efficiently incorporate them via deformable cross-attention to refine the regional Gaussians. Finally, we employ Gaussian-to-voxel splatting to obtain the global 3D occupancy from the updated 3D Gaussians. Our EmbodiedOcc assumes an unknown (i.e., uniformly distributed) environment and maintains an explicit global memory of it with 3D Gaussians. It gradually gains knowledge through the local refinement of regional Gaussians, which is consistent with how humans understand new scenes through embodied exploration. We reorganize an EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet benchmark based on local annotations to facilitate the evaluation of the embodied 3D occupancy prediction task. Our EmbodiedOcc outperforms existing methods by a large margin and accomplishes the embodied occupancy prediction with high accuracy and efficiency. Code: https://github.com/YkiWu/EmbodiedOcc.
authors: Yuqi Wu, Wenzhao Zheng, Sicheng Zuo, Yuanhui Huang, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26360-26370

title: EmbodiedSplat: 基于移动设备高斯点云的个性化实-模-实导航
title_en: EmbodiedSplat: Personalized Real-to-Sim-to-Real Navigation with Gaussian Splats from a Mobile Device
abstract: 具身AI领域主要依赖模拟环境进行训练与评估,常采用缺乏真实感的完全合成环境或需昂贵硬件采集的高保真现实场景重建。因此,模拟到真实迁移仍是一个重大挑战。本文提出EmbodiedSplat,一种通过高效捕捉部署环境并在此重建场景中微调策略,实现个性化策略训练的新方法。我们的方法结合三维高斯点云(GS)技术与Habitat-Sim模拟器,弥合真实场景捕捉与有效训练环境之间的差距。利用iPhone采集的部署场景,通过GS重建网格,使训练环境更贴近现实条件。我们对训练策略、预训练数据集及网格重建技术进行了全面分析,评估其对现实场景中模拟到真实预测性的影响。实验结果表明,使用EmbodiedSplat微调的智能体在现实图像导航任务中,相较基于大规模现实数据集(HM3D)和合成数据集(HSSD)的零样本基线,成功率分别提升20%和40%。此外,我们的方法在重建网格中获得高模拟-现实相关性(0.87-0.97),凸显其以最小努力适应多样化环境的有效性。项目页面:https://gchhablani.github.io/embodied-splat
abstract_en: The field of Embodied AI predominantly relies on simulation for training and evaluation, often using either fully synthetic environments that lack photorealism or high-fidelity real-world reconstructions captured with expensive hardware. As a result, sim-to-real transfer remains a major challenge. In this paper, we introduce EmbodiedSplat, a novel approach that personalizes policy training by efficiently capturing the deployment environment and fine-tuning policies within the reconstructed scenes. Our method leverages 3D Gaussian Splatting (GS) and the Habitat-Sim simulator to bridge the gap between realistic scene capture and effective training environments. Using iPhone-captured deployment scenes, we reconstruct meshes via GS, enabling training in settings that closely approximate real-world conditions. We conduct a comprehensive analysis of training strategies, pre-training datasets, and mesh reconstruction techniques, evaluating their impact on sim-to-real predictivity in real-world scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that agents fine-tuned with EmbodiedSplat outperform both zero-shot baselines pre-trained on large-scale real-world datasets (HM3D) and synthetically generated datasets (HSSD), achieving absolute success rate improvements of 20% and 40% on real-world Image Navigation task. Moreover, our approach yields a high sim-vs-real correlation (0.87-0.97) for the reconstructed meshes, underscoring its effectiveness in adapting policies to diverse environments with minimal effort. Project page: https://gchhablani.github.io/embodied-splat.
authors: Gunjan Chhablani, Xiaomeng Ye, Muhammad Zubair Irshad, Zsolt Kira ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25431-25441

title: EmotiCrafter:基于效价-唤醒度模型的文本到情感图像生成
title_en: EmotiCrafter: Text-to-Emotional-Image Generation based on Valence-Arousal Model
abstract: 近期研究表明,情绪能够增强用户认知并影响信息传播。尽管视觉情感分析研究较为广泛,但针对帮助用户生成情感丰富图像内容的研究仍较为有限。现有情感图像生成方法依赖离散情感类别,难以准确捕捉复杂且微妙的情感细微差别。此外,这些方法在基于文本提示控制生成图像的具体内容方面也存在困难。本文引入连续情感图像内容生成(C-EICG)任务,并提出EmotiCrafter,这是一种通用的情感图像生成模型,能够根据自由文本提示和效价-唤醒度(V-A)值生成图像。该模型采用新颖的情感嵌入映射网络,将V-A值融合到文本特征中,从而实现与预期输入提示一致的情感捕捉。同时提出了一种新的损失函数以增强情感表达。实验结果表明,我们的方法能够有效生成具有特定情感和所需内容的图像,并优于现有技术。
abstract_en: Recent research shows that emotions can enhance users' cognition and influence information communication. While research on visual emotion analysis is extensive, limited work has been done on helping users generate emotionally rich image content. Existing work on emotional image generation relies on discrete emotion categories, making it challenging to capture complex and subtle emotional nuances accurately. Additionally, these methods struggle to control the specific content of generated images based on text prompts. In this paper, we introduce the task of continuous emotional image content generation (C-EICG) and present EmotiCrafter, a general emotional image generation model that generates images based on free text prompts and Valence-Arousal (V-A) values. It leverages a novel emotion-embedding mapping network to fuse V-A values into textual features, enabling the capture of emotions in alignment with intended input prompts. A novel loss function is also proposed to enhance emotion expression. The experimental results show that our method effectively generates images representing specific emotions with the desired content and outperforms existing techniques.
authors: Shengqi Dang, Yi He, Long Ling, Ziqing Qian, Nanxuan Zhao, Nan Cao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15218-15228

title: 基于卷积模拟自注意力的高效图像超分辨率方法
title_en: Emulating Self-attention with Convolution for Efficient Image Super-Resolution
abstract: 本文针对Transformer在高效图像超分辨率(SR)中高计算开销的问题展开研究。受自注意力层间重复现象的启发,我们提出一种卷积化的自注意力模块——卷积注意力(ConvAttn),通过单个共享的大卷积核和动态卷积核,模拟自注意力的长距离建模能力和实例依赖加权机制。通过引入ConvAttn模块,我们显著降低了对自注意力及其相关内存密集型操作的依赖,同时保持Transformer的表示能力。此外,我们克服了将Flash Attention集成到轻量级SR框架中的挑战,有效缓解了自注意力固有的内存瓶颈。相比设计复杂的自注意力模块,我们通过扩大窗口尺寸至32x32并采用Flash Attention,使Urban100x2数据集上的PSNR提升0.31dB,同时将延迟和内存使用量分别降低16倍和12.2倍。基于上述方法,我们提出的网络命名为基于卷积模拟自注意力(ESC),在Urban100x4数据集上相比HiT-SRF提升了0.27dB的PSNR,延迟和内存使用量分别降低3.7倍和6.2倍。大量实验表明,尽管大部分自注意力被ConvAttn模块替代,我们的ESC仍保持了长距离建模能力、数据可扩展性和Transformer的表示能力。
abstract_en: In this paper, we tackle the high computational overhead of Transformers for efficient image super-resolution (SR). Motivated by the observations of self-attention's inter-layer repetition, we introduce a convolutionized self-attention module named Convolutional Attention (ConvAttn) that emulates self-attention's long-range modeling capability and instance-dependent weighting with a single shared large kernel and dynamic kernels. By utilizing the ConvAttn module, we significantly reduce the reliance on self-attention and its involved memory-bound operations while maintaining the representational capability of Transformers. Furthermore, we overcome the challenge of integrating flash attention into the lightweight SR regime, effectively mitigating self-attention's inherent memory bottleneck. We scale up the window size to 32x32 with flash attention rather than proposing an intricate self-attention module, significantly improving PSNR by 0.31dB on Urban100x2 while reducing latency and memory usage by 16xand 12.2x. Building on these approaches, our proposed network, termed Emulating Self-attention with Convolution (ESC), notably improves PSNR by 0.27 dB on Urban100x4 compared to HiT-SRF, reducing the latency and memory usage by 3.7xand 6.2x, respectively. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our ESC maintains the ability for long-range modeling, data scalability, and the representational power of Transformers despite most self-attention being replaced by the ConvAttn module.
authors: Dongheon Lee, Seokju Yun, Youngmin Ro ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24467-24477

title: 基于BEV世界模型的端到端在线轨迹评估驾驶
title_en: End-to-End Driving with Online Trajectory Evaluation via BEV World Model
abstract: 端到端自动驾驶通过将感知、预测和规划整合到全可微框架中,取得了显著进展。然而,要充分发挥其潜力,必须依赖有效的在线轨迹评估以确保安全性。通过预测给定轨迹的未来结果,轨迹评估变得更为有效。这一目标可通过采用世界模型来捕捉环境动态并预测未来状态来实现。因此,我们提出了一种端到端驾驶框架**WoTE**,该框架利用BEV**Wo**rld模型预测未来BEV状态以进行**T**rajectory **E**valuation。所提出的BEV世界模型相比图像级世界模型具有更低的延迟,且可无缝利用现成的BEV空间交通模拟器进行监督。我们在NAVSIM基准测试和基于CARLA模拟器的闭合循环Bench2Drive基准测试上验证了该框架,取得了当前最优性能。代码已开源至https://github.com/liyingyanUCAS/WoTE。
abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving has achieved remarkable progress by integrating perception, prediction, and planning into a fully differentiable framework. Yet, to fully realize its potential, an effective online trajectory evaluation is indispensable to ensure safety. By forecasting the future outcomes of a given trajectory, trajectory evaluation becomes much more effective. This goal can be achieved by employing a world model to capture environmental dynamics and predict future states. Therefore, we propose an end-to-end driving framework **WoTE**, which leverages a BEV **Wo**rld model to predict future BEV states for **T**rajectory **E**valuation. The proposed BEV world model is latency-efficient compared to image-level world models and can be seamlessly supervised using off-the-shelf BEV-space traffic simulators. We validate our framework on both the NAVSIM benchmark and the closed-loop Bench2Drive benchmark based on the CARLA simulator, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Code is released at https://github.com/liyingyanUCAS/WoTE.
authors: Yingyan Li, Yuqi Wang, Yang Liu, Jiawei He, Lue Fan, Zhaoxiang Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27137-27146

title: 面向动态场景图生成的端到端实体-谓词关联推理
title_en: End-to-End Entity-Predicate Association Reasoning for Dynamic Scene Graph Generation
abstract: 动态场景图生成(DSGG)旨在通过将视频抽象为视觉三元组<主体,谓词,客体>来全面理解视频。现有方法多聚焦于捕捉时间依赖性,却忽视了实体与谓词之间以及谓词子类间的关键视觉关系依赖性。这些依赖性对于深入理解场景上下文至关重要。此外,当前方法不支持端到端训练,而是依赖两阶段流程,导致更高的计算成本。为解决这些问题,我们提出面向DSGG的端到端关联推理网络(ARN)。ARN利用CLIP的语义先验建模细粒度三元组线索以生成场景图。此外,我们设计了谓词关联解析(PAP)模块,采用条件权重映射机制对实体和谓词表示进行结构化。进一步引入层次化注意力(HA)机制,将时空上下文与实体、谓词表示进行融合,实现有效的关联推理。在Action Genome数据集上的大量实验表明,该方法显著优于现有方法。源代码可在\hyperref[URL] https://github.com/wlw951226/ARN 获取。
abstract_en: Dynamic Scene Graph Generation (DSGG) aims to comprehensively understand videos by abstracting them into visual triplets <subject, predicate, object>. Most existing methods focus on capturing temporal dependencies, but overlook crucial visual relationship dependencies between entities and predicates, as well as among predicate subclasses. These dependencies are essential for a deeper contextual understanding of scenarios. Additionally, current approaches do not support end-to-end training and instead rely on a two-stage pipeline, which incurs higher computational costs. To address these issues, we propose an end-to-end Association Reasoning Network (ARN) for DSGG. ARN leverages CLIP's semantic priors to model fine-grained triplet cues to generate scene graph. In addition, we design a Predicate Association Parsing (PAP) module that employs a conditional weight mapping mechanism to structure entity and predicate representations. We further introduce a Hierarchical Attention (HA) mechanism to integrate spatio-temporal context with entity and predicate representations, enabling effective associative reasoning. Extensive experiments on the Action Genome dataset demonstrate significant performance improvements over existing methods. The source code is available in \hyperref[URL] https://github.com/wlw951226/ARN .
authors: Liwei Wang, Yanduo Zhang, Tao Lu, Fang Liu, Huiqin Zhang, Jiayi Ma, Huabing Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17729-17738

title: 端到端多模态扩散Mamba
title_en: End-to-End Multi-Modal Diffusion Mamba
abstract: 当前端到端多模态模型使用不同的编码器和解码器处理输入和输出信息。这种分离阻碍了各模态的联合表征学习。为统一多模态处理,我们提出了一种名为MDM(多模态扩散Mamba)的新架构。MDM利用基于Mamba的多步选择扩散模型,通过统一的变分自编码器对编码和解码进行逐步生成和精炼模态特异性信息。这种创新方法使MDM在处理高维数据时能够实现优越性能,特别是在同时生成高分辨率图像和长文本序列方面。我们在图像生成、图像描述、视觉问答、文本理解及推理任务等领域的评估表明,MDM显著优于现有端到端模型(MonoFormer、LlamaGen和Chameleon等),并在与GPT-4V、Gemini Pro和Mistral等SOTA模型的竞争中表现出色。我们的结果验证了MDM在统一多模态处理过程中保持计算效率的有效性,为端到端多模态架构确立了新方向。
abstract_en: Current end-to-end multi-modal models utilize different encoders and decoders to process input and output information. This separation hinders the joint representation learning of various modalities. To unify multi-modal processing, we propose a novel architecture called MDM (Multi-modal Diffusion Mamba). MDM utilizes a Mamba-based multi-step selection diffusion model to progressively generate and refine modality-specific information through a unified variational autoencoder for both encoding and decoding. This innovative approach allows MDM to achieve superior performance when processing high-dimensional data, particularly in generating high-resolution images and extended text sequences simultaneously. Our evaluations in areas such as image generation, image captioning, visual question answering, text comprehension, and reasoning tasks demonstrate that MDM significantly outperforms existing end-to-end models (MonoFormer, LlamaGen, and Chameleon etc.) and competes effectively with SOTA models like GPT-4V, Gemini Pro, and Mistral. Our results validate MDM's effectiveness in unifying multi-modal processes while maintaining computational efficiency, establishing a new direction for end-to-end multi-modal architectures.
authors: Chunhao Lu, Qiang Lu, Meichen Dong, Jake Luo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20529-20540

title: 全民参与:让普通图像描述重新变得引人入胜!
title_en: Engage for All: Making Ordinary Image Descriptions Appealing Again!
abstract: 近年来,多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)已成功应用于生成互联网表情包的幽默且引人入胜的描述。然而,相同的方法难以应用于缺乏固有幽默或夸张内容的普通图像。因此,为普通图像创作吸引人的描述需要发挥想象力,发现或创造词语与图像内容之间引人入胜的联系。为解决这一问题,我们引入AppealImage,一个包含普通图像及其吸引人描述的大型数据集。AppealImage使我们能够定义四个具有量化指标的独立任务,以实现客观评估。随后,我们提出CharmNet,一个创新框架,专门用于生成普通图像的吸引人描述。CharmNet结合了指令调优与启发式主动学习,由裁判模型引导。实验结果表明,CharmNet在生成吸引人描述方面比现有最先进方法提升了11.4%。此外,CharmNet在多种创意应用中表现出色,包括视觉叙事和情境对话生成。这些结果凸显了CharmNet增强社交媒体参与度、在竞争市场中强化品牌存在的潜力。
abstract_en: In recent years, multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) have been successfully adopted to generate humorous and engaging descriptions for internet memes. While, it is challenging for the same approaches to apply to ordinary images which lack of inherent funny or exaggerated contents. Thus, crafting appealing descriptions for ordinary image demands imaginative efforts to discover or create intriguing connections between words to image contents. To address this gap, we introduce AppealImage, a large-scale dataset consisting of ordinary images paired with appealing descriptions. AppealImage allows us to define four distinct tasks with quantitative metrics to enable objective evaluation. Subsequently, we propose CharmNet, an innovative framework designed to generate appealing descriptions for ordinary images. CharmNet combines instruction tuning with heuristic active learning, guided by a referee model. Experimental results demonstrate that CharmNet outperforms the state-of-the-art method by 11.4% in generating appealing descriptions. Furthermore, CharmNet delivers impressive performance across various creative applications, including visual storytelling and situational dialogue generation. These results highlight CharmNet's potential to enhance social media engagement and to empower strong brand presence in competitive markets.
authors: Yuyan Chen, Yifan Jiang, Li Zhou, Jinghan Cao, Yu Guan, Ming Yang, Qingpei Guo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19342-19352

title: 基于跨传感器知识蒸馏的增强型事件稠密立体视觉
title_en: Enhanced Event-based Dense Stereo via Cross-Sensor Knowledge Distillation
abstract: 在快速运动和极端光照条件下实现准确的立体匹配是许多视觉应用面临的挑战。事件相机具有低延迟和高动态范围的优势,因此为解决这一挑战提供了可靠方案。然而,由于事件数据稀疏,仅依靠事件数据获取稠密视差成为一个不适定问题。本文提出了一种基于跨传感器知识蒸馏的事件稠密立体视觉新框架。具体而言,设计了多级强度图像到事件的蒸馏策略,以最大化强度图像的长距离信息、局部纹理细节及任务相关知识的潜力。同时,为强化跨视角一致性,提出了一种强度-事件联合左右一致性模块。通过我们的框架,强度图像中包含的大量稠密和结构化信息被蒸馏至事件分支。因此,在推理过程中仅保留事件数据即可预测稠密视差,保留事件的低延迟特性。在MVSEC和DSEC数据集上的充分实验表明,我们的方法在定量和定性指标上均优于基线方法。
abstract_en: Accurate stereo matching under fast motion and extreme lighting conditions is a challenge for many vision applications. Event cameras have the advantages of low latency and high dynamic range, thus providing a reliable solution to this challenge. However, since events are sparse, this makes it an ill-posed problem to obtain dense disparity using only events. In this work, we propose a novel framework for event-based dense stereo via cross-sensor knowledge distillation. Specifically, a multi-level intensity-to-event distillation strategy is designed to maximize the potential of long-range information, local texture details, and task-related knowledge of the intensity images. Simultaneously, to enforce the cross-view consistency, an intensity-event joint left-right consistency module is proposed. With our framework, extensive dense and structural information contained in intensity images is distilled to the event branch. Therefore, retaining only the events can predict dense disparities during inference, preserving the low latency characteristics of the events. Adequate experiments conducted on the MVSEC and DSEC datasets demonstrate that our method exhibits superior stereo matching performance than baselines, both quantitatively and qualitatively.
authors: Haihao Zhang, Yunjian Zhang, Jianing Li, Lin Zhu, Meng Lv, Yao Zhu, Yanwei Liu, Xiangyang Ji ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5437-5447

title: 基于四元数空间-光谱交互的增强全色锐化
title_en: Enhanced Pansharpening via Quaternion Spatial-Spectral Interactions
abstract: 全色锐化旨在通过融合全色(PAN)图像与对应的低分辨率多光谱(MS)图像,生成高分辨率多光谱(MS)图像。然而,许多现有方法难以充分捕捉空间与光谱交互,限制了其有效性。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种基于四元数的空间-光谱交互网络,通过利用四元数对高维数据的紧凑表示能力,增强全色锐化效果。我们的方法包含三个关键组件:四元数全局光谱交互分支、四元数局部空间结构感知分支以及四元数空间-光谱交互分支。第一分支通过四元数傅里叶变换将多通道特征整体转换到频域,实现全局信息交互同时保持通道间依赖关系,有助于光谱保真度。第二分支采用定制化的空间四元数表示,结合窗口移动策略,在保持局部空间依赖关系的同时促进空间交互,有助于注入空间细节。最后一分支在四元数框架内融合两个路径,丰富空间-光谱交互以获得更丰富的表示。通过利用四元数的多维表示和参数共享特性,我们的方法实现了更紧凑高效的跨分辨率、多波段信息集成,显著提升了融合图像的质量。大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性及其在当前SOTA技术上的优越性能。代码可在https://github.com/dongli8/QuatPanNet获取。
abstract_en: Pansharpening aims to generate high-resolution multispectral (MS) images by fusing panchromatic (PAN) images with corresponding low-resolution MS images. However, many existing methods struggle to fully capture spatial and spectral interactions, limiting their effectiveness. To address this, we propose a novel quaternion-based spatial-spectral interaction network that enhances pansharpening by leveraging the compact representation capabilities of quaternions for high-dimensional data. Our method consists of three key components: the quaternion global spectral interaction branch, the quaternion local spatial structure awareness branch, and the quaternion spatial-spectral interaction branch. The first applies the quaternion Fourier transform to convert multi-channel features into the frequency domain as a whole, enabling global information interaction while preserving inter-channel dependencies, which aids spectral fidelity. The second uses a customized spatial quaternion representation, combined with a window-shifting strategy, to maintain local spatial dependencies while promoting spatial interactions, which helps inject spatial details. The last integrates the two pathways within the quaternion framework to enrich spatial-spectral interactions for richer representations. By utilizing quaternion's multi-dimensional representation and parameter-sharing properties, our method achieves a more compact and efficient cross-resolution, multi-band information integration, significantly improving the quality of the fused image. Extensive experiments validate the proposed method's effectiveness and its superior performance over current SOTA techniques. The code is available at https://github.com/dongli8/QuatPanNet.
authors: Dong Li, Chunhui Luo, Yuanfei Bao, Gang Yang, Jie Xiao, Xueyang Fu, Zheng-Jun Zha ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10908-10918

title: 通过平衡探索与利用的梯度引导采样增强对抗迁移性
title_en: Enhancing Adversarial Transferability by Balancing Exploration and Exploitation with Gradient-Guided Sampling
abstract: 对抗攻击对深度神经网络的鲁棒性构成关键挑战,特别是在不同模型架构间的迁移场景中。然而,对抗攻击的迁移性面临探索(增强跨模型泛化能力)与利用(最大化攻击强度)之间的根本性矛盾。传统基于动量的方法过度优先考虑利用,即通过更高的损失极值提升攻击强度但削弱泛化能力(形成狭窄的损失曲面)。相反,近期采用内迭代采样的方法则过度优先考虑探索,即通过平坦的损失曲面增强跨模型泛化能力但削弱攻击强度(陷入次优局部极值)。为解决这一矛盾,我们提出了一种简单而有效的梯度引导采样(Gradient-Guided Sampling, GGS)方法,通过沿梯度上升方向引导采样,实现对采样效率与稳定性的双重提升。具体而言,基于MI-FGSM,GGS引入内迭代随机采样,并利用前一次内迭代的梯度引导采样方向(采样幅度由随机分布确定)。该机制促使对抗样本驻留在兼具平坦性(利于跨模型泛化)与更高局部极值(利于强攻击强度)的平衡区域。在多种深度神经网络架构和多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)上的综合实验验证了本方法相较于现有最先进的迁移攻击方法的优越性。代码已开源至https://github.com/anuin-cat/GGS。
abstract_en: Adversarial attacks present a critical challenge to deep neural networks' robustness, particularly in transfer scenarios across different model architectures. However, the transferability of adversarial attacks faces a fundamental dilemma between Exploitation (maximizing attack potency) and Exploration (enhancing cross-model generalization). Traditional momentum-based methods over-prioritize Exploitation, i.e., higher loss maxima for attack potency but weakened generalization (narrow loss surface). Conversely, recent methods with inner-iteration sampling over-prioritize Exploration, i.e., flatter loss surfaces for cross-model generalization but weakened attack potency (suboptimal local maxima). To resolve this dilemma, we propose a simple yet effective Gradient-Guided Sampling (GGS), which harmonizes both objectives through guiding sampling along the gradient ascent direction to improve both sampling efficiency and stability. Specifically, based on MI-FGSM, GGS introduces inner-iteration random sampling and guides the sampling direction using the gradient from the previous inner-iteration (the sampling's magnitude is determined by a random distribution). This mechanism encourages adversarial examples to reside in balanced regions with both flatness for cross-model generalization and higher local maxima for strong attack potency. Comprehensive experiments across multiple DNN architectures and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) demonstrate the superiority of our method over state-of-the-art transfer attacks. Code is made available at https://github.com/anuin-cat/GGS.
authors: Zenghao Niu, Weicheng Xie, Siyang Song, Zitong Yu, Feng Liu, Linlin Shen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3885-3894

title: 基于大型多模态模型特征的少样本视觉-语言分类增强
title_en: Enhancing Few-Shot Vision-Language Classification with Large Multimodal Model Features
abstract: 像LLaVA和Qwen-VL这样的生成式大型多模态模型(LMMs)在多种视觉-语言(VL)任务中表现出色。尽管性能优异,但LMMs的生成输出未针对视觉-语言分类任务(即具有视觉-语言输入和离散标签的任务)进行专门优化,如图像分类和多项选择视觉问答(VQA)。在利用LMMs处理这些任务时,一个关键挑战在于从生成式LMMs中提取有用的特征。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种方法,利用LMMs潜在空间中的多模态特征提取。为此,我们提出了稀疏注意力向量(SAVs)——一种无需微调的方法,通过利用LMMs中少于5%的稀疏注意力头激活作为强大的特征表示。仅使用少量样本,SAVs在一系列视觉-语言分类任务中展现出优于多种少样本和微调基线的最先进性能。我们的实验还表明,SAVs的性能可随额外样本数量增加而提升,并能泛化到相似任务,确立了SAVs作为有效且鲁棒的多模态特征表示。
abstract_en: Generative Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) like LLaVA and Qwen-VL excel at a wide variety of vision-language (VL) tasks. Despite strong performance, LMMs' generative outputs are not specialized for vision-language classification tasks (i.e., tasks with vision-language inputs and discrete labels) such as image classification and multiple-choice VQA. One key challenge in utilizing LMMs for these tasks is the extraction of useful features from generative LMMs. To overcome this, we propose an approach that leverages multimodal feature extraction from the LMM's latent space. Toward this end, we present Sparse Attention Vectors (SAVs)---a finetuning-free method that leverages sparse attention head activations (fewer than 5% of the heads) in LMMs as strong feature representations. With only few-shot examples, SAVs demonstrate state-of-the-art performance compared to a variety of few-shot and finetuned baselines on a collection of vision-language classification tasks. Our experiments also imply that SAVs can scale in performance with additional examples and generalize to similar tasks, establishing SAVs as both effective and robust multimodal feature representations.
authors: Chancharik Mitra, Brandon Huang, Tianning Chai, Zhiqiu Lin, Assaf Arbelle, Rogerio Feris, Leonid Karlinsky, Trevor Darrell, Deva Ramanan, Roei Herzig ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2760-2772

title: 基于自适应平移等变性的图像修复变换器增强
title_en: Enhancing Image Restoration Transformer via Adaptive Translation Equivariance
abstract: 平移等变性是图像修复中的基本归纳偏置,确保输入平移后输出也相应平移。现代修复变换器中的注意力机制会破坏这一性质,对训练收敛性和泛化能力产生不利影响。为缓解此问题,我们提出两种关键策略以融入平移等变性:滑动索引和组件堆叠。滑动索引通过固定位置维护运算响应,滑动窗口注意力是典型示例;组件堆叠则允许并行或序列排列平移等变运算符,从而构建复杂架构同时保持平移等变性。然而,这些策略仍面临模型设计中的两难:自注意力机制的高计算成本与滑动窗口注意力固有固定感受野之间的矛盾。为此,我们开发了自适应滑动索引机制,高效选择每个查询的关键-值对,随后与全局聚合的关键-值对并行拼接。设计的网络称为平移等变性自适应变换器(TEAFormer),在多种图像修复任务中进行了评估。结果突显其在有效性、训练收敛性和泛化能力方面的优越性。
abstract_en: Translation equivariance is a fundamental inductive bias in image restoration, ensuring that translated inputs produce translated outputs. Attention mechanisms in modern restoration transformers undermine this property, adversely impacting both training convergence and generalization. To alleviate this issue, we propose two key strategies for incorporating translation equivariance: slide indexing and component stacking. Slide indexing maintains operator responses at fixed positions, with sliding window attention being a notable example, while component stacking enables the arrangement of translation-equivariant operators in parallel or sequentially, thereby building complex architectures while preserving translation equivariance. However, these strategies still create a dilemma in model design between the high computational cost of self-attention and the fixed receptive field associated with sliding window attention. To address this, we develop an adaptive sliding indexing mechanism to efficiently select key-value pairs for each query, which are then concatenated in parallel with globally aggregated key-value pairs. The designed network, called the Translation Equivariance Adaptive Transformer (TEAFormer), is assessed across a variety of image restoration tasks. The results highlight its superiority in terms of effectiveness, training convergence, and generalization.
authors: JiaKui Hu, Zhengjian Yao, Lujia Jin, Hangzhou He, Yanye Lu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16047-16057

title: 基于双向交互的Mamba解码器增强方法在多任务密集预测中的应用
title_en: Enhancing Mamba Decoder with Bidirectional Interaction in Multi-Task Dense Prediction
abstract: 充分的跨任务交互对多任务密集预测的成功至关重要。然而,充分的交互往往导致高计算复杂度,迫使现有方法在交互完整性与计算效率之间进行权衡。为解决这一局限性,本文提出了一种双向交互Mamba(BIM),通过引入新颖的扫描机制,将Mamba建模方法适配于多任务密集预测。一方面,我们提出了一种新颖的双向交互扫描(BI-Scan)机制,该机制在交互过程中构建任务特定表示为双向序列。通过在统一的线性复杂度架构中集成任务优先和位置优先扫描模式,BI-Scan高效保留了关键的跨任务信息。另一方面,我们采用多尺度扫描(MS-Scan)机制实现多粒度场景建模。该设计不仅满足了各类任务的多样化粒度需求,还增强了细致的跨任务特征交互。在两个具有挑战性的基准数据集NYUD-V2和PASCAL-Context上的大量实验表明,我们的BIM方法优于其最先进的竞争方法。
abstract_en: Sufficient cross-task interaction is crucial for success in multi-task dense prediction. However, sufficient interaction often results in high computational complexity, forcing existing methods to face the trade-off between interaction completeness and computational efficiency. To address this limitation, this work proposes a Bidirectional Interaction Mamba (BIM), which incorporates novel scan mechanisms to adapt the Mamba modeling approach for multi-task dense prediction. On the one hand, we introduce a novel Bidirectional Interaction Scan (BI-Scan) mechanism, which constructs task-specific representations as bidirectional sequences during interaction. By integrating task-first and position-first scan modes within a unified linear complexity architecture, BI-Scan efficiently preserves critical cross-task information. On the other hand, we employ a Multi-Scale Scan (MS-Scan) mechanism to achieve multi-granularity scene modeling. This design not only meets the diverse granularity requirements of various tasks but also enhances nuanced cross-task feature interactions. Extensive experiments on two challenging benchmarks, i.e., NYUD-V2 and PASCAL-Context, show the superiority of our BIM vs its state-of-the-art competitors.
authors: Mang Cao, Sanping Zhou, Yizhe Li, Ye Deng, Wenli Huang, Le Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18815-18824

title: 基于软标签增强多模态大语言模型的数值预测
title_en: Enhancing Numerical Prediction of MLLMs with Soft Labeling
abstract: 在训练(多模态)大语言模型(LLMs/MLLMs)时,使用事实上的交叉熵损失与one-hot目标分布(硬标签)的最优性受到质疑。尽管对于语言标记预测(典型的离散空间多分类问题)是合理的,但对数值预测这类典型的连续空间回归问题则不够理想。然而,在LLMs/MLLMs中实现回归将复杂化训练和推理阶段的下一个标记预测范式。为此,我们提出了一种新颖的损失设计,称为软标签,通过平滑目标概率分布,使预测根据其与目标的距离进行惩罚。这类似于回归损失,对连续空间中距离更远的预测施加更大惩罚,但不会改变LLMs/MLLMs的模型架构和下一个标记预测范式。我们通过在视觉定位、物体计数和图表理解等任务上的大量实验验证了软标签的有效性,在多个基准测试中实现了最先进的性能,且无需复杂技巧。软标签可应用于任何LLM/MLLM。
abstract_en: The optimality of using the de facto cross-entropy loss with one-hot target distribution (hard labeling) is questioned when training (Multimodal) Large Language Models (LLMs/MLLMs). Although it is reasonable for language token prediction, which is a typical multi-class classification problem in discrete space, it is suboptimal for task like numerical prediction, which is a typical regression problem in continuous space. However, enabling regression in LLMs/MLLMs will complicate the training and next-token prediction paradigm at inference. Instead, to address this challenge, we propose a novel loss design, called soft labeling, which smooths the target probability distribution, enabling predictions to be penalized according to their distance to the target. This is similar to regression loss, which penalizes more on the further predictions in the continuous space, but will not change the model architecture and the next-token prediction paradigm of LLMs/MLLMs. We demonstrate the efficacy of soft labeling through extensive experiments on visual grounding, object counting, and chart understanding, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks without bells and whistles. Soft labeling can be applied in any LLM/MLLM.
authors: Pei Wang, Zhaowei Cai, Hao Yang, Davide Modolo, Ashwin Swaminathan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3424-3434

title: 基于双曲学习的部分相关视频检索增强
title_en: Enhancing Partially Relevant Video Retrieval with Hyperbolic Learning
abstract: 部分相关视频检索(PRVR)旨在解决将未剪辑视频与仅描述部分内容的文本查询进行匹配的关键挑战。现有方法在欧几里得空间中存在几何失真问题,有时无法准确反映视频的内在层次结构,并忽略某些层次语义,最终导致时序建模效果不佳。为解决这一问题,我们提出首个用于PRVR的双曲建模框架HLFormer,该框架利用双曲空间学习来弥补欧几里得空间在层次建模能力上的不足。具体而言,HLFormer通过混合空间编码视频嵌入,整合洛伦兹注意力块和欧几里得注意力块,并采用均值引导自适应交互模块动态融合特征。此外,我们引入部分顺序保持损失,通过洛伦兹锥约束强制执行"text \prec video"的层次关系。该方法进一步通过增强视频内容与文本查询之间的部分相关性,提升跨模态匹配效果。大量实验表明,HLFormer优于现有最先进的方法。代码已开源于__ABS_MATH_1__。
abstract_en: Partially Relevant Video Retrieval (PRVR) addresses the critical challenge of matching untrimmed videos with text queries describing only partial content. Existing methods suffer from geometric distortion in Euclidean space that sometimes misrepresents the intrinsic hierarchical structure of videos and overlooks certain hierarchical semantics, ultimately leading to suboptimal temporal modeling. To address this issue, we propose the first hyperbolic modeling framework for PRVR, namely HLFormer, which leverages hyperbolic space learning to compensate for the suboptimal hierarchical modeling capabilities of Euclidean space. Specifically, HLFormer integrates the Lorentz Attention Block and Euclidean Attention Block to encode video embeddings in hybrid spaces, using the Mean-Guided Adaptive Interaction Module to dynamically fuse features. Additionally, we introduce a Partial Order Preservation Loss to enforce "\text text  \prec \text video " hierarchy through Lorentzian cone constraints. This approach further enhances cross-modal matching by reinforcing partial relevance between video content and text queries. Extensive experiments show that HLFormer outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Code is released at \href https://github.com/lijun2005/ICCV25-HLFormer  https://github.com/lijun2005/ICCV25-HLFormer .
authors: Jun Li, Jinpeng Wang, Chaolei Tan, Niu Lian, Long Chen, Yaowei Wang, Min Zhang, Shu-Tao Xia, Bin Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23074-23084

title: 基于自适应细化的提示生成增强伪装目标检测
title_en: Enhancing Prompt Generation with Adaptive Refinement for Camouflaged Object Detection
abstract: 基础模型(如Segment Anything Model,SAM)在常规分割任务中表现出色,主要得益于其在大规模数据集上的训练。然而,在特定下游任务(如伪装目标检测,COD)中仍存在挑战。现有研究主要通过整合其他基础模型生成的多模态信息来提升性能。然而,直接利用这些模型生成的信息可能因领域偏移引入额外偏差。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种自适应细化模块(Adaptive Refinement Module,ARM),该模块高效处理多模态信息并同时优化掩码提示。此外,我们构建了辅助嵌入,有效利用ARM生成的中间信息,为SAM提供更丰富的特征表示。实验结果表明,所提出的架构在COD任务中超越了大多数最先进的(SOTA)模型,尤其在结构化目标分割方面表现突出。
abstract_en: Foundation models, such as Segment Anything Model (SAM), have exhibited remarkable performance in conventional segmentation tasks, primarily due to their training on large-scale datasets. Nonetheless, challenges remain in specific downstream tasks, such as Camouflaged Object Detection (COD). Existing research primarily aims to enhance performance by integrating additional multimodal information derived from other foundation models. However, directly leveraging the information generated by these models may introduce additional biases due to domain shifts. To address this issue, we propose an Adaptive Refinement Module (ARM), which efficiently processes multimodal information and simultaneously refining the mask prompt. Furthermore, we construct an auxiliary embedding that effectively exploits the intermediate information generated during ARM, providing SAM with richer feature representations. Experimental results indicate that our proposed architecture surpasses most state-of-the-art (SOTA) models in the COD task, particularly excelling in structured target segmentation.
authors: Xuehan Chen, Guangyu Ren, Tianhong Dai, Tania Stathaki, Hengyan Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20672-20682

title: 提升高质量图像生成的奖励模型:超越文本-图像对齐
title_en: Enhancing Reward Models for High-quality Image Generation: Beyond Text-Image Alignment
abstract: 当前的图像生成系统已超越基本的文本-图像对齐,实现了高保真度和卓越的审美质量。然而,现有的评估框架未能同步演进。本研究揭示了基于CLIP和BLIP架构微调的人类偏好奖励模型存在固有缺陷:它们不当地下降对细节丰富且审美价值高的图像的评分,与实际人类审美偏好产生显著偏差。为解决这一问题,我们设计了一种新型评估指标ICT(图像包含文本)分数,通过评估图像表征文本内容的程度,实现并超越文本-图像对齐的目标。在此基础上,我们进一步仅使用图像模态训练HP(高偏好)分数模型,旨在提升图像在美学和细节优化等方面的质量,同时保持已实现的文本-图像对齐。实验表明,所提出的评估模型相比现有方法提升评分准确率超过10%,并在优化前沿文本到图像模型方面取得显著成果。本研究为图像生成技术向更高阶人类审美偏好对齐的演进提供了理论基础和实证支持。
abstract_en: Contemporary image generation systems have achieved high fidelity and superior aesthetic quality beyond basic text-image alignment. However, existing evaluation frameworks have failed to evolve in parallel. This study reveals that human preference reward models fine-tuned based on CLIP and BLIP architectures have inherent flaws: they inappropriately assign low scores to images with rich details and high aesthetic value, creating a significant discrepancy with actual human aesthetic preferences. To address this issue, we design a novel evaluation score, ICT (Image-Contained-Text) score, that achieves and surpasses the objectives of text-image alignment by assessing the degree to which images represent textual content. Building upon this foundation, we further train a HP (High-Preference) score model using solely the image modality, aiming to enhance image quality in aspects such as aesthetics and detail refinement while maintaining achieved text-image alignment.Experiments demonstrate that the proposed evaluation model improves scoring accuracy by over 10% compared to existing methods, and achieves significant results in optimizing state-of-the-art text-to-image models. This research provides theoretical foundation and empirical support for the evolution of image generation technology toward better alignment with higher-order human aesthetic preferences.
authors: Ying Ba, Tianyu Zhang, Yalong Bai, Wenyi Mo, Tao Liang, Bing Su, Ji-Rong Wen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19022-19031

title: 通过基于推理的分割增强多模态大语言模型的空间推理能力
title_en: Enhancing Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models through Reasoning-based Segmentation
abstract: 近期在点云感知领域的进展表明,通过利用大语言模型(LLMs)实现的视觉-语言对齐,已在场景理解方面取得了显著进展。然而,现有方法在处理需要精确空间推理的复杂指令时仍可能面临挑战,即使三维点云数据提供了诸如尺寸和位置等详细空间线索以识别目标。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种基于推理的分割框架——相关推理分割(R^2S)。该框架通过将空间推理分解为两个连续阶段来模拟人类认知过程:首先识别相关元素,然后根据其关联的视觉先验处理指令。此外,鉴于现有数据集在复杂推理任务中的不足,我们引入了3D ReasonSeg数据集,该数据集包含25,185个训练样本和3,966个验证样本,并具有精确标注。定量和定性实验均表明,R^2S和3D ReasonSeg有效增强了三维点云感知的空间推理能力,我们希望它们能成为未来工作的新基准和参考。
abstract_en: Recent advances in point cloud perception have demonstrated remarkable progress in scene understanding through vision-language alignment leveraging large language models (LLMs). However, existing methods may still encounter challenges in handling complex instructions that require accurate spatial reasoning, even if the 3D point cloud data provides detailed spatial cues such as size and position for identifying the targets. To tackle this issue, we propose Relevant Reasoning Segmentation (R^2S), a reasoning-based segmentation framework. The framework emulates human cognitive processes by decomposing spatial reasoning into two sequential stages: first identifying relevant elements, then processing instructions guided by their associated visual priors. Furthermore, acknowledging the inadequacy of existing datasets in complex reasoning tasks, we introduce 3D ReasonSeg, a reasoning-based segmentation dataset comprising 25,185 training samples and 3,966 validation samples with precise annotations. Both quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that the R^2S and 3D ReasonSeg effectively endow 3D point cloud perception with stronger spatial reasoning capabilities, and we hope that they can serve as a new baseline and benchmark for future work.
authors: Zhenhua Ning, Zhuotao Tian, Shaoshuai Shi, Guangming Lu, Daojing He, Wenjie Pei, Li Jiang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7851-7860

title: 通过逆目标梯度竞争与空间距离拉伸增强定向对抗样本的可迁移性
title_en: Enhancing Transferability of Targeted Adversarial Examples via Inverse Target Gradient Competition and Spatial Distance Stretching
abstract: 在人工智能安全领域,深度神经网络(DNNs)对对抗样本(AEs)高度敏感,微小的输入扰动即可导致错误预测。尽管对抗样本在模型间具有可迁移性,但由于特征维度和决策边界差异,定向攻击成功率(TASRs)较低。为提升定向对抗样本的可迁移性,我们提出了一种新颖方法,在优化过程中引入逆目标梯度竞争(ITC)和空间距离拉伸(SDS)。具体而言,我们采用类似孪生网络的框架生成非定向和定向对抗样本。ITC机制通过每轮应用非定向对抗梯度抑制定向扰动的优化,从而提升模型鲁棒性。此外,采用top-k SDS策略引导对抗样本在潜在空间中穿透目标类别区域,同时远离非目标区域,实现最优可迁移性。与最先进的竞争型攻击方法相比,我们的方法在主流CNNs和ViTs上分别将可迁移TASRs提升了16.1%和21.4%,展现出更强的防御突破能力。
abstract_en: In the field of AI security, deep neural networks (DNNs) are highly sensitive to adversarial examples (AEs), which can cause incorrect predictions with minimal input perturbations. Although AEs exhibit transferability across models, targeted attack success rates (TASRs) are low due to differences in feature dimensions and decision boundaries. To enhance targeted AE transferability, we propose a novel approach using Inverse Target Gradient Competition (ITC) and Spatial Distance Stretching (SDS) in the optimization process. Specifically, we employ a siamese-network-like framework to generate both non-targeted and targeted AEs. The ITC mechanism applies non-targeted adversarial gradients each epoch to impede the optimization of targeted perturbations, thereby improving robustness. Additionally, a top-k SDS strategy guides AEs to penetrate target class regions in the latent space while distancing from non-targeted regions, achieving optimal transferability. Compared to state-of-the-art competition-based attacks, our method significantly improves transferable TASRs by 16.1% and 21.4% on mainstream CNNs and ViTs, respectively, and demonstrates superior defense-breaking capabilities.
authors: Zhankai Li, Weiping Wang, Jie Li, Shigeng Zhang, Yunan Hu, Song Guo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3716-3725

title: 通过条件嵌入标记增强Transformer模型
title_en: Enhancing Transformers Through Conditioned Embedded Tokens
abstract: Transformer模型已彻底改变了现代机器学习,推动了计算机视觉、自然语言处理和机器人学领域的突破。其成功的核心在于注意力机制,该机制能够建模输入标记之间的全局依赖关系。然而,我们发现Transformer中的注意力模块存在固有的病态条件,这会阻碍基于梯度的优化,导致训练效率低下。为解决这一问题,我们开发了一个理论框架,建立了注意力模块的条件与嵌入标记数据的条件之间的直接关系。基于这一见解,我们引入了条件嵌入标记,这是一种系统性修改嵌入标记以改善注意力机制条件的方法。我们的分析表明,这种方法显著缓解了病态条件,从而实现更稳定和高效的训练。我们在多种Transformer架构上验证了该方法,实现了图像分类、目标检测、实例分割和自然语言处理领域的持续改进,突显了其广泛适用性和有效性。
abstract_en: Transformers have transformed modern machine learning, driving breakthroughs in computer vision, natural language processing, and robotics. At the core of their success lies the attention mechanism, which enables the modeling of global dependencies among input tokens. However, we reveal that the attention block in transformers suffers from inherent ill-conditioning, which hampers gradient-based optimization and leads to inefficient training. To address this, we develop a theoretical framework that establishes a direct relationship between the conditioning of the attention block and that of the embedded tokenized data. Building on this insight, we introduce conditioned embedded tokens, a method that systematically modifies the embedded tokens to improve the conditioning of the attention mechanism. Our analysis demonstrates that this approach significantly mitigates ill-conditioning, leading to more stable and efficient training. We validate our methodology across various transformer architectures, achieving consistent improvements in image classification, object detection, instance segmentation, and natural language processing, highlighting its broad applicability and effectiveness.
authors: Hemanth Saratchandran, Simon Lucey ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4786-4795

title: 基于文本引导的局部排序与数字激发的全局注意力提升零样本物体计数
title_en: Enhancing Zero-shot Object Counting via Text-guided Local Ranking and Number-evoked Global Attention
abstract: 文本引导的零样本物体计数利用视觉-语言模型(VLMs)对任意类别的物体进行计数,其输入为文本提示。现有方法仅利用局部块级特征与文本特征进行融合,忽略了全局图像级特征的重要影响。本文提出一种通用策略,可同时利用局部块级特征和全局图像级特征。具体而言,为提升VLMs的定位能力,提出文本引导的局部排序方法。基于前景块与文本提示具有更高相似性的先验知识,设计新的局部-文本排序损失,以增大前景与背景块相似度得分的差异,从而将前景与背景块分开。为增强VLMs的计数能力,引入数字激发的全局注意力,首先将全局图像级特征与多个数字条件文本提示对齐,然后选择相似度最高的文本提示与全局图像级特征进行交叉注意力计算。通过在广泛使用的数据集和方法上进行大量实验,所提方法在性能、泛化能力和可扩展性方面均表现出显著优势。此外,为更好地评估文本引导的零样本物体计数方法,提出一个更大且更具挑战性的数据集ZSC-8K,以建立新的基准。代码和ZSC-8K数据集将公开。
abstract_en: Text-guided zero-shot object counting leverages vision-language models (VLMs) to count objects of an arbitrary class given by a text prompt. Existing approaches for this challenging task only utilize local patch-level features to fuse with text feature, ignoring the important influence of the global image-level feature. In this paper, we propose a universal strategy that can exploit both local patch-level features and global image-level feature simultaneously. Specifically, to improve the localization ability of VLMs, we propose Text-guided Local Ranking. Depending on the prior knowledge that foreground patches have higher similarity with the text prompt, a new local-text rank loss is designed to increase the differences between the similarity scores of foreground and background patches which push foreground and background patches apart. To enhance the counting ability of VLMs, Number-evoked Global Attention is introduced to first align global image-level feature with multiple number-conditioned text prompts. Then, the one with the highest similarity is selected to compute cross-attention with the global image-level feature. Through extensive experiments on widely used datasets and methods, the proposed approach has demonstrated superior advancements in performance, generalization, and scalability. Furthermore, to better evaluate text-guided zero-shot object counting methods, we propose a dataset named ZSC-8K, which is larger and more challenging, to establish a new benchmark. Codes and ZSC-8K dataset will be available.
authors: Shiwei Zhang, Qi Zhou, Wei Ke ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21097-21106

title: 赋能你的 pansharpening 模型的泛化能力:统一分布即你所需
title_en: Enpowering Your Pansharpening Models with Generalizability: Unified Distribution is All You Need
abstract: 现有基于深度学习的遥感 pansharpening 模型在训练数据集上表现出卓越性能。然而,由于传感器特定特性及成像条件的差异,这些模型在应用于未见过的卫星数据时会出现显著性能退化,缺乏泛化能力从而限制了其应用范围。我们认为性能下降主要源于不同来源的分布差异,解决这一挑战的关键在于弥合训练分布与测试分布之间的差距。为验证该理念并进一步实现"一次训练,永久部署"的能力,本文提出了一种新颖直观的方法,通过采用统一分布策略(UniPAN)赋能任何 pansharpening 模型的泛化能力。具体而言,我们构建了一个分布转换函数,将不同来源采样的像素归一化为相同分布。深度模型在转换后的域上进行训练,在测试新数据集时,新数据也转换为匹配训练分布。UniPAN旨在使模型在统一且一致的分布上进行训练和测试,从而增强其泛化能力。大量实验验证了 UniPAN 的有效性,证明其有望显著提升深度 pansharpening 模型在多种卫星传感器上的性能。Codes: https://github.com/yc-cui/UniPAN.
abstract_en: Existing deep learning-based models for remote sensing pansharpening exhibit exceptional performance on training datasets. However, due to sensor-specific characteristics and varying imaging conditions, these models suffer from substantial performance degradation when applied to unseen satellite data, lacking generalizability and thus limiting their applicability. We argue that the performance drops stem primarily from distributional discrepancies from different sources and the key to addressing this challenge lies in bridging the gap between training and testing distributions. To validate the idea and further achieve a "train once, deploy forever" capability, this paper introduces a novel and intuitive approach to enpower any pansharpening models with generalizability by employing a unified distribution strategy (UniPAN). Specifically, we construct a distribution transformation function that normalizes the pixels sampled from different sources to conform to an identical distribution. The deep models are trained on the transformed domain, and during testing on new datasets, the new data are also transformed to match the training distribution. UniPAN aims to train and test the model on a unified and consistent distribution, thereby enhancing its generalizability. Extensive experiments validate the efficacy of UniPAN, demonstrating its potential to significantly enhance the performance of deep pansharpening models across diverse satellite sensors. Codes: https://github.com/yc-cui/UniPAN.
authors: Yongchuan Cui, Peng Liu, Hui Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11850-11860

title: Enrich and Detect: 视频时间定位与多模态大语言模型
title_en: Enrich and Detect: Video Temporal Grounding with Multimodal LLMs
abstract: 我们提出ED-VTG方法,利用多模态大语言模型实现细粒度视频时间定位。我们的方法通过多模态大语言模型联合处理文本和视频,通过两阶段过程有效将自然语言查询定位到视频中。与直接进行定位不同,语言查询首先被转换为包含缺失细节和线索的丰富句子,以辅助定位。在第二阶段,这些丰富查询通过轻量级解码器进行定位,该解码器专门化于基于上下文表示的丰富查询预测准确边界。为减少噪声和降低幻觉影响,我们的模型采用多实例学习目标进行训练,动态选择每个训练样本的最佳查询版本。我们在各种时间视频定位和段落定位基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。实验表明,我们的方法显著优于所有先前提出的基于大语言模型的时间定位方法,在零样本评估场景中相较于专用模型具有明显优势,且在性能上优于或与专用模型相当。
abstract_en: We introduce ED-VTG, a method for fine-grained video temporal grounding utilizing multi-modal large language models. Our approach harnesses the capabilities of multimodal LLMs to jointly process text and video, in order to effectively localize natural language queries in videos through a two-stage process. Rather than being directly grounded, language queries are initially transformed into enriched sentences that incorporate missing details and cues to aid in grounding. In the second stage, these enriched queries are grounded, using a lightweight decoder, which specializes at predicting accurate boundaries conditioned on contextualized representations of the enriched queries. To mitigate noise and reduce the impact of hallucinations, our model is trained with a multiple-instance-learning objective that dynamically selects the optimal version of the query for each training sample. We demonstrate state-of-the-art results across various benchmarks in temporal video grounding and paragraph grounding settings. Experiments reveal that our method significantly outperforms all previously proposed LLM-based temporal grounding approaches and is either superior or comparable to specialized models, while maintaining a clear advantage against them in zero-shot evaluation scenarios.
authors: Shraman Pramanick, Effrosyni Mavroudi, Yale Song, Rama Chellappa, Lorenzo Torresani, Triantafyllos Afouras ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24297-24308

title: 集成前景管理用于无监督物体发现
title_en: Ensemble Foreground Management for Unsupervised Object Discovery
abstract: 无监督物体发现(UOD)旨在无需人工标注的情况下检测和分割2D图像中的物体。自监督表示学习的最新进展在UOD算法中取得了一定的成功。然而,缺乏真实标签为现有UOD方法带来了两个挑战:1)判断发现的区域是前景还是背景,2)知晓还有多少物体未被发现。为解决这两个问题,先前方法依赖于前景先验来判断发现的区域是否为前景,并进行一次或固定次数的发现迭代。然而,现有前景先验是启发式的且不总是鲁棒的,固定数量的发现会导致欠分割或过分割,因为图像中的物体数量变化较大。本文引入UnionCut,一种基于最小割和集成方法的鲁棒且有理论依据的前景先验,用于检测图像的前景区域联合,使UOD算法能够识别前景物体并在图像前景联合的大部分区域被分割后停止发现。此外,我们提出UnionSeg,一种UnionCut的蒸馏变压器,能够更高效准确地输出前景联合。实验表明,结合UnionCut或UnionSeg后,先前最先进的UOD方法在多个基准测试中单物体发现、显著性检测和自监督实例分割性能均有所提升。代码可在https://github.com/YFaris/UnionCut获取。
abstract_en: Unsupervised object discovery (UOD) aims to detect and segment objects in 2D images without handcrafted annotations. Recent progress in self-supervised representation learning has led to some success in UOD algorithms. However, the absence of ground truth provides existing UOD methods with two challenges: 1) determining if a discovered region is foreground or background, and 2) knowing how many objects remain undiscovered. To address these two problems, previous solutions rely on foreground priors to distinguish if the discovered region is foreground, and conduct one or fixed iterations of discovery. However, the existing foreground priors are heuristic and not always robust, and a fixed number of discoveries leads to under or over-segmentation, since the number of objects in images varies. This paper introduces UnionCut, a robust and well-grounded foreground prior based on min-cut and ensemble methods that detects the union of foreground areas of an image, allowing UOD algorithms to identify foreground objects and stop discovery once the majority of the foreground union in the image is segmented. In addition, we propose UnionSeg, a distilled transformer of UnionCut that outputs the foreground union more efficiently and accurately. Our experiments show that by combining with UnionCut or UnionSeg, previous state-of-the-art UOD methods witness an increase in the performance of single object discovery, saliency detection and self-supervised instance segmentation on various benchmarks. The code is available at https://github.com/YFaris/UnionCut.
authors: Ziling Wu, Armaghan Moemeni, Praminda Caleb-Solly ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20268-20279

title: 基于动态步长对齐的熵自适应扩散策略优化
title_en: Entropy-Adaptive Diffusion Policy Optimization with Dynamic Step Alignment
abstract: 尽管通过强化学习(RL)微调扩散模型在直接优化下游目标方面表现出有效性,但现有RL框架容易过拟合奖励,导致输出偏离真实数据分布并降低多样性。为解决这一问题,我们引入熵作为定量指标以增强扩散模型去噪策略的探索能力。我们提出一种自适应机制,根据中间噪声状态的实时质量估计动态调整熵和正则化的应用及强度。理论上,我们证明了熵增强策略优化的收敛性,并建立了两个关键性质:1)全局熵随训练增加,确保鲁棒探索能力;2)熵在去噪过程中系统性降低,实现从早期阶段多样性促进到后期阶段分布保真的相变。在此基础上,我们提出一个即插即用的RL模块,可自适应控制熵并优化去噪步骤。大量实验验证了方法的理论正确性和实证鲁棒性,在基准测试中实现了最先进的质量-多样性权衡。值得注意的是,我们的框架在训练中显著提升了奖励并减少了去噪步骤,最多可达40%。
abstract_en: While fine-tuning diffusion models with reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated effectiveness in directly optimizing downstream objectives, existing RL frameworks are prone to overfitting the rewards, leading to outputs that deviate from the true data distribution and exhibit reduced diversity. To address this issue, we introduce entropy as a quantitative measure to enhance the exploratory capacity of diffusion models' denoising policies. We propose an adaptive mechanism that dynamically adjusts the application and magnitude of entropy and regularization, guided by real-time quality estimation of intermediate noised states. Theoretically, we prove the convergence of our entropy-enhanced policy optimization and establish two critical properties: 1) global entropy increases through training, ensuring robust exploration capabilities, and 2) entropy systematically decreases during the denoising process, enabling a phase transition from early-stage diversity promotion to late-stage distributional fidelity. Building on this foundation, we propose a plug-and-play RL module that adaptively controls entropy and optimizes denoising steps. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the theoretical soundness and empirical robustness of our method, achieving state-of-the-art quality-diversity trade-offs across benchmarks. Notably, our framework significantly improves the rewards and reduces denoising steps in training by up to 40%.
authors: RenYe Yan, Jikang Cheng, Yaozhong Gan, Shikun Sun, You Wu, Yunfan Yang, Liang Ling, Jinlong Lin, Yeshuang Zhu, Jie Zhou, Jinchao Zhang, Junliang Xing, Yimao Cai, Ru Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1924-1934

title: 环境无关的姿态:生成环境无关的物体表示用于六自由度姿态估计
title_en: Environment-Agnostic Pose: Generating Environment-independent Object Representations for 6D Pose Estimation
abstract: 本文介绍了EA6D,一种新颖的基于扩散的六自由度姿态估计框架,可在任何环境中有效运行。传统姿态估计方法在现实世界场景的多样性和复杂性方面存在困难,常导致在受控数据集上过拟合,并在新场景中泛化能力差。为解决这些挑战,我们提出了一种生成式姿态估计范式,通过生成环境无关的物体表示来进行姿态估计,这些表示对光照、遮挡和背景杂乱等环境变化具有鲁棒性。具体而言,我们提出了新颖的环境解耦扩散模型(EDDM),该模型通过利用输入图像先验而非纯噪声初始化,将物体表示与环境因素分离,同时实现高效的少步采样。我们在四个标准基准测试和自定义数据集DiverseScenes上验证了我们的方法。结果表明,仅使用合成数据训练的EA6D在合成数据和真实数据上均能超越现有最先进方法。特别是,在与合成数据的公平比较中,我们在Linemod和Linemod-Occluded数据集上分别超过了之前的SOTA 18.1%和33.5%。项目页面:https://github.com/acmff22/EA6D
abstract_en: This paper introduces EA6D, a novel diffusion-based framework for 6D pose estimation that operates effectively in any environment. Traditional pose estimation methods struggle with the variability and complexity of real-world scenarios, often leading to overfitting on controlled datasets and poor generalization to new scenes. To address these challenges, we propose a generative pose estimation paradigm that generates environment-independent object representations for pose estimation, which are robust to environmental variations such as illumination, occlusion, and background clutter. Specifically, we propose the novel Environment Decoupling Diffusion Model (EDDM) which separates object representations from environmental factors while enabling efficient few-step sampling by leveraging input image priors instead of pure noise initialization. We validate our approach on four standard benchmarks and a self-made dataset DiverseScenes. The results demonstrate that EA6D, trained using only synthetic data, can outperform the state-of-the-art methods with both synthetic and realistic data. In particular, for fair comparisons with synthetic data, we can exceed the previous SOTA by 18.1% and 33.5% on Linemod and Linemod-Occluded datasets respectively. Project page: https://github.com/acmff22/EA6D
authors: Shaobo Zhang, Yuhang Huang, Wanqing Zhao, Wei Zhao, Ziyu Guan, Jinye Peng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8678-8687

title: 用于无监督光场视差估计的极线一致注意力聚合网络
title_en: Epipolar Consistent Attention Aggregation Network for Unsupervised Light Field Disparity Estimation
abstract: 视差估计是处理和分析光场(LF)图像的关键步骤。近期方法通过构建代价体来利用预设最大视差下的LF对应关系,限制了其处理大视差场景的能力。不同于构建代价体,自注意力机制通过计算极线间的视差注意力来寻找匹配点。然而,对于具有不同视角的LF,由于与中心视角的基线不同,视差注意力中的相关视差尺度存在差异。此外,若某一视角的匹配信息被遮挡,可通过其他视角探索视差信息。因此,将这些注意力映射到同一尺度并选择有效的匹配信息是视差估计的关键。本文探索了LF的视差注意力,设计了一种无监督方法,命名为极线一致注意力聚合网络(ECAAN)。我们首先引入极线一致尺度统一模块,通过考虑一致性关系来标准化视差注意力图的视差尺度。基于视差注意力的内部属性和相互关系,我们进一步提出了一致遮挡无关聚合模块,以整合遮挡区域的信息。此外,我们设计了改进的光度损失来约束模型。ECAAN在LF深度估计中实现了最先进的性能。值得注意的是,ECAAN在大视差LF数据集上取得了均方误差(MSE)为0.2的优异结果,相比次优方法实现了68%的误差降低。
abstract_en: Disparity estimation is an essential step in processing and analyzing Light Field (LF) images. Recent methods construct the cost volume to exploit the correspondence of the LFs over the preset maximum disparity, limiting them to process the large parallax scenes. Different from constructing cost volume, the self-attention mechanism calculates the parallax attention between epipolar lines to find the matching points. However, for LFs that have different views, the related disparity scales are different in parallax attention since the baselines with the central view are different. Moreover, if the matching information is occluded in one view, the disparity information can be explored through other views. Therefore, mapping these attentions to the same scale and selecting effective matching information are key points for disparity estimation from parallax attention. In this paper, we explore parallax attention for LF and design an unsupervised method, named Epipolar Consistent Attention Aggregation Network (ECAAN). We first introduce an epipolar consistent scale unification block by considering the consistency relationships to standardize disparity scales of the parallax attention maps. Based on the intra-properties and inter-relationships of parallax attention, we further propose a consistent occlusion-free aggregation block to integrate the information from the occlusion-free areas. Besides, we design an improved photometric loss to constrain the model. ECAAN achieves state-of-the-art performance in LF depth estimation.
