abstract_en: The incorporation of high-resolution visual input equips multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with enhanced visual perception capabilities for real-world tasks. However, most existing high-resolution MLLMs rely on a cropping-based approach to process images, which leads to fragmented visual encoding and a sharp increase in redundant tokens. To tackle these issues, we propose the FALCON model. FALCON introduces a novel visual register technique to simultaneously: 1) Eliminate redundant tokens at the stage of visual encoding. To directly address the visual redundancy present in the output of vision encoder, we propose a Register-based Representation Compacting (ReCompact) mechanism. This mechanism introduces a set of learnable visual registers designed to adaptively aggregate essential information while discarding redundancy. It enables the encoder to produce a more compact visual representation with a minimal number of output tokens, thus eliminating the need for an additional compression module. 2) Ensure continuity in visual encoding. To address the potential encoding errors caused by fragmented visual inputs, we develop a Register Interactive Attention (ReAtten) module. This module facilitates effective and efficient information exchange across sub-images by enabling interactions between visual registers. It ensures the continuity of visual semantics throughout the encoding. We conduct comprehensive experiments with FALCON on high-resolution benchmarks across a wide range of scenarios. FALCON demonstrates superior performance with a remarkable 9-fold reduction in visual tokens.
authors: Renshan Zhang, Rui Shao, Gongwei Chen, Miao Zhang, Kaiwen Zhou, Weili Guan, Liqiang Nie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23530-23540

title: FB-Diff:基于傅里叶基引导的四维医学影像时间插值方法
title_en: FB-Diff: Fourier Basis-guided Diffusion for Temporal Interpolation of 4D Medical Imaging
abstract: 四维医学影像的时间插值任务在呼吸运动建模的临床实践中起着关键作用。现有方法遵循简化的线性运动假设,采用基于光流的模型来插值中间帧。然而,真实的呼吸运动应是非线性和准周期性的,并具有特定频率。基于这一特性,我们从频率角度解决时间插值任务,并提出一种傅里叶基引导的扩散模型,称为FB-Diff。具体而言,由于呼吸运动具有规律的运动纪律,引入生理运动先验以描述时间数据分布的一般特征。随后,设计了一种傅里叶运动算子,在变分自编码器的特征空间中,通过结合生理运动先验和病例特异性频谱信息提取傅里叶基。良好学习的傅里叶基能够更好地模拟具有特定频率运动模式的呼吸运动。在起始帧和结束帧的条件下,扩散模型进一步通过基交互算子利用这些傅里叶基,以生成方式推进时间插值任务。大量实验结果表明,FB-Diff在保持良好重建指标的同时,实现了最先进的感知性能,并具有更好的时间一致性。代码可在https://github.com/AlexYouXin/FB-Diff获取。
abstract_en: The temporal interpolation task for 4D medical imaging, plays a crucial role in clinical practice of respiratory motion modeling. Following the simplified linear-motion hypothesis, existing approaches adopt optical flow-based models to interpolate intermediate frames. However, realistic respiratory motions should be nonlinear and quasi-periodic with specific frequencies. Intuited by this property, we resolve the temporal interpolation task from the frequency perspective, and propose a Fourier Basis-guided Diffusion model, termed FB-Diff. Specifically, due to the regular motion discipline of respiration, physiological motion priors are introduced to describe general characteristics of temporal data distributions. Then a Fourier motion operator is elaborately devised to extract Fourier bases by incorporating physiological motion priors and case-specific spectral information in the feature space of Variational Autoencoder. Well-learned Fourier bases can better simulate respiratory motions with motion patterns of specific frequencies. Conditioned on starting and ending frames, the diffusion model further leverages well-learned Fourier bases via the basis interaction operator, which promotes the temporal interpolation task in a generative manner. Extensive results demonstrate that FB-Diff achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) perceptual performance with better temporal consistency while maintaining promising reconstruction metrics. Codes are available at https://github.com/AlexYouXin/FB-Diff.
authors: Xin You, Runze Yang, Chuyan Zhang, Zhongliang Jiang, Jie Yang, Nassir Navab ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28010-28020

title: FDPT:面向黑盒视觉语言模型的联邦离散提示调优
title_en: FDPT: Federated Discrete Prompt Tuning for Black-Box Visual-Language Models
abstract: 通用型视觉语言模型(VLMs)推动了多模态人工智能的重大进展。通过任务特定数据对这些模型进行微调可以增强其对各种下游任务的适应性,但存在隐私风险。尽管联邦学习等潜在解决方案可以缓解用户数据隐私问题,但模型保护同样至关重要。其他依赖黑盒视觉语言模型API的方法通常需要访问预测logits,使其容易受到逆向攻击。此外,解决联邦视觉语言模型场景中的调优复杂性和数据传输效率挑战同样至关重要。为了解决这些挑战,我们提出了FDPT——一种利用黑盒视觉语言模型的联邦离散提示调优方法。在客户端优化阶段,FDPT采用代理驱动框架,利用具有增强推理能力的大语言模型(LLMs)系统地优化离散提示表示,同时利用反馈机制和思维链来提高预测准确性。重要的是,它通过依赖文本结果而非LLMs输出的预测逻辑向量进行优化,从而避免逆向攻击风险。在全局聚合阶段,我们通过在语义相似性计算基础上采用进化计算方法,模仿人类选举活动,实现增强的零阶优化以获取代表性全局标记,从而实现知识聚合。FDPT在图像分类和视觉问答任务中显著优于九种最先进的方法,在减少通信开销的同时生成高度可迁移的优化提示。此外,它还表现出对数据异质性的更强鲁棒性。
abstract_en: General-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have driven major advancements in multimodal AI. Fine-tuning these models with task-specific data enhances adaptability to various downstream tasks but suffers from privacy risks. While potential solutions like federated learning can address user data privacy concerns, model protection is also essential. Other methods that rely on black-box VLM APIs usually require the access of prediction logits, leaving them open to inversion attacks. Moreover, addressing the challenges of tuning complexity and data transmission efficiency in federated VLM scenarios is also crucial. To address these challenges, we propose FDPT--a federated discrete prompt tuning method utilizing black-box VLMs. During client optimization stage, FDPT employs an agent-driven framework leveraging large language models (LLMs) with enhanced reasoning capacities to systematically optimize discrete prompt representations, and also utilizes feedback mechanisms and chain of thought to enhance prediction accuracy. Importantly, it performs optimization by relying not on the predicted logic vectors output by LLMs but on textual results, avoiding reverse attack risks. During global aggregation stage, We mimic human electoral activities by employing evolutionary computation methods underpinned by semantic similarity computation to implement enhanced zero-order optimization for acquiring representative global tokens, thereby achieving knowledge aggregation. FDPT significantly outperforms nine state-of-the-art methods in image classification and visual question-answering, reducing communication overhead while generating highly transferable optimized prompts. Additionally, it exhibits improved robustness to data heterogeneity.
authors: Jiaqi Wu, Simin Chen, Jing Tang, Yuzhe Yang, Yiming Chen, Lixu Wang, Song Lin, Zehua Wang, Wei Chen, Zijian Tian ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2461-2470

title: FE-CLIP:面向零样本异常检测与分割的频率增强CLIP模型
title_en: FE-CLIP: Frequency Enhanced CLIP Model for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection and Segmentation
abstract: 零样本异常检测(ZSAD)要求使用辅助数据训练的检测模型能够在目标数据集中检测异常,而无需目标数据集的任何训练样本。由于模型需要跨领域泛化,这具有挑战性。近年来,基于CLIP的异常检测方法(如WinCLIP和AnomalyCLIP)在ZSAD任务中表现出色,得益于CLIP模型强大的零样本识别能力。然而,这些方法忽略了图像频率信息的利用。本文发现,频率信息可为ZSAD任务带来益处,因为异常区域的一些属性(如外观缺陷)也可通过其频率信息反映。为此,我们提出频率增强CLIP(FE-CLIP),在CLIP的视觉编码器中利用两种不同但互补的频率感知线索:(1)频率感知特征提取适配器,(2)局部频率统计适配器,以深度挖掘频率信息用于ZSAD任务。我们采用DCT作为频率域变换。通过综合实验,我们证明所提出的FE-CLIP在不同领域具有良好的泛化能力,并在来自各类缺陷检测和医学领域的10个高度多样化类别语义数据集上实现了优越的零样本异常检测与分割性能。此外,所提出的FE-CLIP在少样本正常情况下的异常检测设置中也表现出色。
abstract_en: Zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) requires detection models trained using auxiliary data to detect anomalies without any training sample in a target dataset. It is challenging since the models need to generalize to anomalies across different domains. Recently, CLIP-based anomaly detection methods, such as WinCLIP and AnomalyCLIP, have demonstrated superior performance in the ZSAD task, due to the strong zero-shot recognition of the CLIP model. However, they overlook the utilization of frequency information of images. In this paper, we find that frequency information could benefit the ZSAD task, since some properties of the anomaly area, such as appearance defects, can also be reflected based on its frequency information. To this end, We propose Frequency Enhanced CLIP (FE-CLIP), taking advantage of two different but complementary frequency-aware clues, (1) Frequency-aware Feature Extraction adapter, and (2) Local Frequency Statistics adapter, in the visual encoder of CLIP, to deeply mine frequency information for the ZSAD task. We apply DCT as the frequency-domain transformation. Through comprehensive experiments, we show that the proposed FE-CLIP has good generalization across different domains and achieves superior zero-shot performance of detecting and segmenting anomalies in 10 datasets of highly diverse class semantics from various defect inspections and medical domains. Besides, the proposed FE-CLIP also achieves superior performance under the few-normal-shot anomaly detection settings.
authors: Tao Gong, Qi Chu, Bin Liu, Wei Zhou, Nenghai Yu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21220-21230

title: FED-PsyAU: 基于心理动作单元协调与动态面部运动建模的隐私保护微表情识别
title_en: FED-PsyAU: Privacy-Preserving Micro-Expression Recognition via Psychological AU Coordination and Dynamic Facial Motion Modeling
abstract: 微表情(MEs)是短暂、低强度且局部化的面部表情,能够揭示个体试图隐藏的真实情感,在审讯和心理咨询等场景中具有重要价值。然而,微表情识别(MER)面临样本量小和特征细微等挑战,阻碍了高效建模。此外,实际应用中存在微表情数据隐私问题,导致在隐私约束下提升跨场景识别性能的研究仍属空白。为解决这些问题,我们提出FED-PsyAU研究框架。首先通过心理研究分析上下面部动作单元(AUs)的协调机制,为面部肌肉动态提供结构化先验知识。随后开发DPK-GAT网络,将心理先验与统计AU模式相结合,实现从局部到全局的分层面部运动特征学习,有效提升MER性能。此外,我们的联邦学习框架在不共享数据的前提下增强多客户端的MER能力,保障隐私并缓解单客户端样本量不足问题。在常用微表情数据库上的大量实验验证了方法的有效性,代码已开源至https://github.com/MELABIPCAS/FED-PsyAU.git。
abstract_en: Micro-expressions (MEs) are brief, low-intensity, often localized facial expressions. They could reveal genuine emotions individuals may attempt to conceal, valuable in contexts like criminal interrogation and psychological counseling. However, ME recognition (MER) faces challenges, such as small sample sizes and subtle features, which hinder efficient modeling. Additionally, real-world applications encounter ME data privacy issues, leaving the task of enhancing recognition across settings under privacy constraints largely unexplored. To address these issues, we propose a FED-PsyAU research framework. We begin with a psychological study on the coordination of upper and lower facial action units (AUs) to provide structured prior knowledge of facial muscle dynamics. We then develop a DPK-GAT network that combines these psychological priors with statistical AU patterns, enabling hierarchical learning of facial motion features from regional to global levels, effectively enhancing MER performance. Additionally, our federated learning framework advances MER capabilities across multiple clients without data sharing, preserving privacy and alleviating the limited-sample issue for each client. Extensive experiments on commonly-used ME databases demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/MELABIPCAS/FED-PsyAU.git.
authors: Jingting Li, Yu Qian, Lin Zhao, Su-Jing Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14453-14463

title: FEVER-OOD: 基于自由能脆弱性消除的鲁棒分布外检测
title_en: FEVER-OOD: Free Energy Vulnerability Elimination for Robust Out-of-Distribution Detection
abstract: 现代机器学习模型在图像分类和目标检测等计算机视觉任务中表现出色,但往往对分布外(OOD)样本的预测过于自信,导致在开放集环境中出现不可预测的行为。近期研究表明,自由能分数由于与数据分布的紧密关联,是分布外检测的有效不确定性度量方法。然而,尽管基于自由能的方法在分布外检测中取得了显著的实证进展,我们的理论分析揭示了自由能分数公式中尚未被探索且固有的脆弱性,即分布内样本和分布外样本可能具有不同的特征表示却拥有相同的自由能分数。这种现象发生在表示分布内样本与分布外样本特征空间差异的向量属于神经分类器最后一层的零空间时。为缓解这些问题,我们探索低维特征空间以减少零空间的影响,并引入新颖的正则化方法以最大化最终线性层的最小奇异值,从而增强样本间的自由能分离度。我们将这些技术称为基于自由能脆弱性消除的鲁棒分布外检测(FEVER-OOD)。大量实验表明,FEVER-OOD在CIFAR-10数据集上将分布外检测的FPR95从33.66%降至28.22%,AUROC从92.15提升至94.78;在CIFAR-100数据集上,FPR95从50.96%降至42.77%,AUROC从88.06提升至89.98;在ImageNet-100数据集上,与Dream-OOD模型结合时,平均分布外FPR95为36.50%,AUROC为92.74,相比未使用FEVER-OOD时的39.33%和91.84 AUROC,实现了最先进的分布外检测性能。
abstract_en: Modern machine learning models, that excel on computer vision tasks such as classification and object detection, are often overconfident in their predictions for Out-of-Distribution (OOD) examples, resulting in unpredictable behaviour for open-set environments. Recent works have demonstrated that the free energy score is an effective measure of uncertainty for OOD detection given its close relationship to the data distribution. However, despite that free energy-based methods representing a significant empirical advance in OOD detection, our theoretical analysis reveals previously unexplored and inherent vulnerabilities within the free energy score formulation such that in-distribution and OOD instances can have distinct feature representations yet identical free energy scores. This phenomenon occurs when the vector representing the feature space difference between the in-distribution and OOD sample belongs to the null space of the last layer of a neural-based classifier. To mitigate these issues, we explore lower-dimensional feature spaces to reduce the null space footprint and introduce novel regularisation to maximize the least singular value of the final linear layer, hence enhancing inter-sample free energy separation. We refer to these techniques as Free Energy Vulnerability Elimination for Robust Out-of-Distribution Detection (FEVER-OOD). Extensive experimentation shows that FEVER-OOD improves OOD detection in CIFAR-10 with 28.22% FPR95 and 94.78 AUROC vs 33.66% FPR95 and 92.15 AUROC of the baseline model, CIFAR-100 with 42.77% FPR95 and 89.98 AUROC vs 50.96% FPR95 and 88.06 AUROC of the baseline model, and achieves state of the art OOD detection in Imagenet-100, with average OOD FPR95 of 36.50% and an AUROC of 92.74 when used with the Dream-OOD model, compared with a 39.33% and 91.84 AUROC without FEVER-OOD.
authors: Brian K.S. Isaac-Medina, Mauricio Che, Yona Falinie A. Gaus, Samet Akcay, Toby P. Breckon ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4529-4538

title: FG-OrIU:通过特征-梯度正交性实现增量遗忘的更优方法
title_en: FG-OrIU: Towards Better Forgetting via Feature-Gradient Orthogonality for Incremental Unlearning
abstract: 增量遗忘(IU)对于预训练模型遵循按顺序的数据删除请求至关重要,但现有方法主要通过抑制参数或混淆知识,缺乏对特征和梯度层面的明确约束,导致表面性遗忘,残留信息仍可被恢复。这种不完全遗忘可能引发安全漏洞并破坏保留平衡,尤其是在增量遗忘场景中。我们提出FG-OrIU(面向增量遗忘的特征-梯度正交性框架),这是首个在特征和梯度层面统一施加正交约束的框架,以实现深度遗忘,其遗忘效果具有不可逆性。FG-OrIU通过奇异值分解(SVD)分解特征空间,将遗忘类与保留类特征分离至不同子空间。随后施加双重约束:对遗忘类和保留类特征进行正交投影,同时通过梯度正交投影防止遗忘知识的重新引入及对保留类的干扰。此外,动态子空间适应机制融合新遗忘子空间并收缩保留子空间,确保连续遗忘任务中删除与保留的稳定平衡。大量实验验证了本方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Incremental unlearning (IU) is critical for pre-trained models to comply with sequential data deletion requests, yet existing methods primarily suppress parameters or confuse knowledge without explicit constraints on both feature and gradient level, resulting in superficial forgetting where residual information remains recoverable. This incomplete forgetting risks security breaches and disrupts retention balance, especially in IU scenarios. We propose FG-OrIU (Feature-Gradient Orthogonality for Incremental Unlearning), the first framework unifying orthogonal constraints on both features and gradients level to achieve deep forgetting, where the forgetting effect is irreversible. FG-OrIU decomposes feature spaces via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), separating forgetting and remaining class features into distinct subspaces. It then enforces dual constraints: feature orthogonal projection on both forgetting and remaining classes, while gradient orthogonal projection prevents the reintroduction of forgotten knowledge and disruption to remaining classes during updates. Additionally, dynamic subspace adaptation merges newly forgetting subspaces and contracts remaining subspaces, ensuring a stable balance between removal and retention across sequential unlearning tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
authors: Qian Feng, JiaHang Tu, Mintong Kang, Hanbin Zhao, Chao Zhang, Hui Qian ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1957-1967

title: FICGen:基于频率启发的上下文解耦布局驱动退化图像生成
title_en: FICGen: Frequency-Inspired Contextual Disentanglement for Layout-driven Degraded Image Generation
abstract: 布局到图像(L2I)生成在自然领域展现出 promising 结果,但在退化场景(如低光、水下)中存在生成保真度有限及与用户提供的布局对齐弱的问题。我们主要归因于退化条件下存在的“上下文幻觉困境”,即前景实例被主导频率分布的上下文所淹没。受此启发,本文提出一种新的频率启发式上下文解耦生成范式(FICGen),旨在将退化图像的频率知识迁移至潜在扩散空间,从而通过上下文频率感知引导实现退化实例及其环境的渲染。具体而言,FICGen包含两个主要步骤。首先,我们引入可学习的双查询机制,每种查询均配以专用频率重采样器,从训练集中的预收集退化示例中提取上下文频率原型。其次,采用视觉频率增强注意力机制,将频率原型注入退化生成过程。为缓解上下文幻觉和属性泄露,开发了实例一致性图以调节个体实例与其环境在潜在空间中的解耦,同时结合自适应空间频率聚合模块重构空间频率混合的退化表征。在涵盖从严重低光到轻微模糊等多种退化场景的5个基准测试中,实验表明FICGen在生成保真度、对齐度及下游辅助可训练性方面均优于现有L2I方法。
abstract_en: Layout-to-image (L2I) generation has exhibited promising results in natural domains, but suffers from limited generative fidelity and weak alignment with user-provided layouts when applied to degraded scenes (i.e., low-light, underwater). We primarily attribute these limitations to the "contextual illusion dilemma" in degraded conditions, where foreground instances are overwhelmed by context-dominant frequency distributions. Motivated by this, our paper proposes a new Frequency-Inspired Contextual Disentanglement Generative (FICGen) paradigm, which seeks to transfer frequency knowledge of degraded images into the latent diffusion space, thereby facilitating the rendering of degraded instances and their surroundings via contextual frequency-aware guidance. To be specific, FICGen consists of two major steps. Firstly, we introduce a learnable dual-query mechanism, each paired with a dedicated frequency resampler, to extract contextual frequency prototypes from pre-collected degraded exemplars in the training set. Secondly, a visual-frequency enhanced attention is employed to inject frequency prototypes into the degraded generation process. To alleviate the contextual illusion and attribute leakage, an instance coherence map is developed to regulate latent-space disentanglement between individual instances and their surroundings, coupled with an adaptive spatial-frequency aggregation module to reconstruct spatial-frequency mixed degraded representations. Extensive experiments on 5 benchmarks involving a variety of degraded scenarios--from severe low-light to mild blur--demonstrate that FICGen consistently surpasses existing L2I methods in terms of generative fidelity, alignment and downstream auxiliary trainability.
authors: Wenzhuang Wang, Yifan Zhao, Mingcan Ma, Ming Liu, Zhonglin Jiang, Yong Chen, Jia Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19097-19107

title: FIND:基于仅正常数据的少样本异常检测多模态方法
title_en: FIND: Few-Shot Anomaly Inspection with Normal-Only Multi-Modal Data
abstract: 多模态异常检测(MAD)通过利用互补的2D和3D数据提升工业检测效果。然而,现有方法在少样本场景中因数据有限和模态差异而面临挑战。当前方法要么融合多模态特征,要么对齐跨模态表示,但往往存在高误报率,难以检测细微缺陷,尤其是在训练样本稀缺时。为解决这些问题,我们提出首个少样本MAD方法FIND,这是一种新颖的双学生框架,集成了模态内反向蒸馏和跨模态特征映射。FIND采用模态特定教师和两个协作学生:一个用于通过反向蒸馏实现细粒度异常定位的模态内学生,以及一个通过捕捉跨模态对应关系以检测跨模态不一致性的跨模态学生。在MVTec-3D-AD和Eyecandies数据集上的大量实验表明,FIND在全样本和少样本设置下均显著优于现有最先进的方法。消融实验验证了模态内与跨模态蒸馏的互补作用。我们的工作显著提升了数据稀缺工业应用中MAD的鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Multi-modal anomaly detection (MAD) improves industrial inspection by exploiting complementary 2D and 3D data. However, existing methods struggle in few-shot scenarios due to limited data and modality gaps. Current approaches either fuse multi-modal features or align cross-modal representations; however, they often suffer from high false-positive rates and fail to detect subtle defects, especially when training samples are scarce. To address these challenges, we propose the first few-shot MAD method FIND, a novel dual-student framework that integrates intra-modal reverse distillation and cross-modal feature mapping. FIND employs modality-specific teachers and two collaborative students: an intra-modal student for fine-grained anomaly localization via reverse distillation, and a cross-modal student that captures inter-modal correspondences to detect cross-modal inconsistencies. Extensive experiments on MVTec-3D-AD and Eyecandies show that FIND significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both full-shot and few-shot settings. Ablation studies validate the complementary roles of intra- and cross-modal distillation. Our work significantly advances MAD robustness in data-scarce industrial applications.
authors: Yiting Li, Fayao Liu, Jingyi Liao, Sichao Tian, Chuan-Sheng Foo, Xulei Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23290-23299

title: FLOAT: 基于生成运动潜在流匹配的音频驱动说话肖像视频生成
title_en: FLOAT: Generative Motion Latent Flow Matching for Audio-driven Talking Portrait
abstract: 随着基于扩散的生成模型的快速发展,肖像图像动画已取得显著成果。然而,由于其迭代采样的特性,仍面临时间一致视频生成和快速采样的挑战。本文提出FLOAT,一种基于流匹配生成模型的音频驱动说话肖像视频生成方法。不同于基于像素的潜在空间,我们采用学习到的正交运动潜在空间,实现时间一致运动的高效生成与编辑。为实现该目标,我们引入基于Transformer的向量场预测器,并设计有效的帧级条件机制。此外,我们的方法支持语音驱动的情绪增强,实现表达性运动的自然融合。大量实验表明,我们的方法在视觉质量、运动保真度和效率方面均优于现有音频驱动说话肖像方法。
abstract_en: With the rapid advancement of diffusion-based generative models, portrait image animation has achieved remarkable results. However, it still faces challenges in temporally consistent video generation and fast sampling due to its iterative sampling nature. This paper presents FLOAT, an audio-driven talking portrait video generation method based on flow matching generative model. Instead of a pixel-based latent space, we take advantage of a learned orthogonal motion latent space, enabling efficient generation and editing of temporally consistent motion. To achieve this, we introduce a transformer-based vector field predictor with an effective frame-wise conditioning mechanism. Additionally, our method supports speech-driven emotion enhancement, enabling a natural incorporation of expressive motions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art audio-driven talking portrait methods in terms of visual quality, motion fidelity, and efficiency.
authors: Taekyung Ki, Dongchan Min, Gyeongsu Chae ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14699-14710

title: FLOSS:开放词汇语义分割中的免费午餐
title_en: FLOSS: Free Lunch in Open-vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
abstract: 本文挑战了开放词汇语义分割(OVSS)领域常规的使用平均类别文本嵌入的实践,这些嵌入通常通过将每个类别名称与多个模板(例如,一张<class>的照片,一张<class>的草图)编码获得。我们研究了模板对OVSS的影响,发现对于每个类别,存在单模板分类器——我们称之为类别专家——其性能显著优于传统平均分类器。首先,为识别这些类别专家,我们提出了一种无需标注数据或训练的新方法。通过利用单模板分类器的类别预测熵,我们选择熵值最低的分类器作为最可靠的类别专家。其次,我们设计了一种新的融合过程来结合类别专家的输出。我们的即插即用方法FLOSS与现有OVSS方法正交且互补,在无需额外标注或训练的情况下实现性能提升。大量实验表明,FLOSS能够持续增强最先进的OVSS模型,在不同分布偏移的数据集上具有良好的泛化能力,并在仅有少量未标注图像的低数据场景中实现显著性能提升。我们的代码已开源至https://github.com/yasserben/FLOSS。
abstract_en: In this paper, we challenge the conventional practice in Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation (OVSS) of using averaged class-wise text embeddings, which are typically obtained by encoding each class name with multiple templates (e.g., a photo of <class>, a sketch of a <class>). We investigate the impact of templates for OVSS, and find that for each class, there exist single-template classifiers---which we refer to as class-experts--- that significantly outperform the conventional averaged classifier.First, to identify these class-experts, we introduce a novel approach that estimates them without any labeled data or training. By leveraging the class-wise prediction entropy of single-template classifiers, we select those yielding the lowest entropy as the most reliable class-experts. Second, we combine the outputs of class-experts in a new fusion process. Our plug-and-play method, coined FLOSS, is orthogonal and complementary to existing OVSS methods, offering an improvement without the need for additional labels or training. Extensive experiments show that FLOSS consistently enhances state-of-the-art OVSS models, generalizes well across datasets with different distribution shifts, and delivers substantial improvements in low-data scenarios where only a few unlabeled images are available. Our code is available at https://github.com/yasserben/FLOSS.
authors: Yasser Benigmim, Mohammad Fahes, Tuan-Hung Vu, Andrei Bursuc, Raoul de Charette ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21471-21481

title: FLSeg:通过模型分割增强联邦学习在异构数据下的隐私与鲁棒性
title_en: FLSeg: Enhancing Privacy and Robustness in Federated Learning under Heterogeneous Data via Model Segmentation
abstract: 联邦学习(FL)能够在不共享数据的前提下实现全局模型的协作训练,但面临隐私泄露和拜占庭攻击等关键挑战。现有隐私保护鲁棒联邦学习框架存在三大核心局限:高计算成本、鲁棒聚合规则(RAR)应用受限以及对数据异构性的处理不足。为解决这些问题,我们提出FLSeg框架,通过分段交换与分段聚合机制避免过多加密计算,同时实现对任意RAR的无限制使用。此外,本地训练中引入的正则化项在个性化与全局模型性能间取得平衡,有效适应异构数据。我们的理论与实验分析表明,FLSeg具备半诚实安全性和计算效率:其客户端和服务器时间复杂度分别为O(l)和O(nl),实证结果表明计算时间显著降低。大量实验进一步验证了FLSeg在多样化异构和对抗性场景下的鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of a global model without data sharing, yet it faces critical challenges from privacy leakage and Byzantine attacks. Existing privacy-preserving robust FL frameworks suffer from three key limitations: high computational costs, restricted application of Robust Aggregation Rules (RAR), and inadequate handling of data heterogeneity. To address these limitations, we propose the FLSeg framework, which leverages Segment Exchange and Segment Aggregation to avoid excessive encryption computations while enabling unrestricted use of any RAR. Additionally, a regularization term in local training balances personalization with global model performance, effectively adapting to heterogeneous data. Our theoretical and experimental analyses demonstrate FLSeg's semi-honest security and computational efficiency: it achieves client and server time complexities of O(l) and O(nl), with empirical results showing significantly reduced computational times. Extensive experiments further confirm FLSeg's robustness across diverse heterogeneous and adversarial scenarios.
authors: Zichun Su, Zhi Lu, Yutong Wu, Renfei Shen, Songfeng Lu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3916-3925

title: FOLDER: 通过增强性能加速多模态大语言模型
title_en: FOLDER: Accelerating Multi-Modal Large Language Models with Enhanced Performance
abstract: 近年来,多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)因其跨模态理解能力,在多模态任务中展现出显著的效果。然而,从视觉主干网络中提取的长序列视觉标记的处理对实时应用的部署提出了挑战。为解决这一问题,我们引入了FOLDER,一个简单而有效的即插即用模块,旨在缩短视觉标记序列长度,从而在训练和推理过程中降低计算和内存需求。通过对视觉编码器中标记缩减过程的全面分析,我们研究了不同缩减策略引入的信息损失,并开发了FOLDER以在去除视觉冗余的同时保留关键信息。我们通过将FOLDER集成到多种MLLMs的视觉主干中,验证了其有效性,显著加速了推理阶段。此外,我们评估了其作为训练加速器或性能增强器的效用。FOLDER在去除多达70%的视觉标记后,实现了与原始模型相当甚至更好的性能。我们的代码可在https://github.com/anakin-skywalker-Joseph/Folder获取。
abstract_en: Recently, Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown remarkable effectiveness for multi-modal tasks due to their ability of cross-modal understanding. However, processing long sequences of visual tokens extracted from visual backbones poses challenges for deployment in real-time applications. To address this issue, we introduce FOLDER, a simple yet effective plug-and-play module designed to reduce the length of the visual token sequence, mitigating computational and memory demands during both training and inference. Through a comprehensive analysis of the token reduction process in the vision encoder, we analyze the information loss introduced by different reduction strategies and develop FOLDER to preserve key information while removing visual redundancy. We show the effectiveness of FOLDER by integrating it into the visual backbone of various MLLMs, significantly accelerating the inference phase. Furthermore, we evaluate its utility as a training accelerator or even performance booster for MLLMs. FOLDER achieves comparable or even better performance than the original models, while dramatically reducing complexity by removing up to 70% of visual tokens. Our code is available at https://github.com/anakin-skywalker-Joseph/Folder.
authors: Haicheng Wang, Zhemeng Yu, Gabriele Spadaro, Chen Ju, Victor Quétu, Shuai Xiao, Enzo Tartaglione ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23614-23625

title: FPEM: 基于面部先验增强的直播视频面部吸引力预测方法
title_en: FPEM: Face Prior Enhanced Facial Attractiveness Prediction for Live Videos with Face Retouching
abstract: 面部吸引力预测(FAP)长期以来一直是重要的计算机视觉任务,可广泛应用于需要面部修饰的直播视频场景。然而,先前的FAP数据集要么规模较小,要么为闭源数据。此外,相应的FAP模型在泛化能力和适应性方面存在局限。为克服这些限制,我们引入了首个专为直播视频场景设计的大规模FAP数据集LiveBeauty,该数据集针对可能进行实时美学处理的人脸图像。直接从直播平台收集了10,000张人脸图像,并通过精心设计的主观实验获得200,000个对应的吸引力标注,使LiveBeauty成为目前最大的开放获取FAP数据集。基于构建的数据集,提出了一种新型FAP方法——面部先验增强多模态模型(FPEM),用于衡量人脸图像的吸引力。在LiveBeauty及其他开源FAP数据集上的大量实验表明,所提出的方法取得了最先进性能。该数据集将在https://github.com/Estella-LH/FPEM发布。
abstract_en: Facial attractiveness prediction (FAP) has long been an important computer vision task, which could be widely applied in live videos with facial retouching. However, previous FAP datasets are either small or closed-source. Moreover, the corresponding FAP models exhibit limited generalization and adaptation ability.To overcome these limitations, we introduce the first large-scale FAP dataset LiveBeauty specifically designed for live video scenarios wherein face images may be real-time processed for aesthetics purposes.10,000 face images are collected directly from a live streaming platform, with 200,000 corresponding attractiveness annotations obtained from a well-devised subjective experiment, making LiveBeauty the largest open-access FAP dataset. Based on the built dataset, a novel FAP method named Facial Prior Enhanced Multi-modal model (FPEM) is proposed to measure the attractiveness of facial images.Extensive experiments conducted on both LiveBeauty and other open-source FAP datasets demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance. The dataset will be released at https://github.com/Estella-LH/FPEM.
authors: Hui Li, Xiaoyu Ren, Hongjiu Yu, Ying Chen, Kai Li, L Wang, Xiongkuo Min, Huiyu Duan, Guangtao Zhai, Xu Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11458-11468

title: FREE-Merging:傅里叶变换在高效模型融合中的应用
title_en: FREE-Merging: Fourier Transform for Efficient Model Merging
abstract: 随着深度学习的快速发展,各类任务的开源模型逐渐变得丰富可用。然而,单一微调模型往往难以满足用户多样化的实际需求。模型融合因此成为一种高效方法,通过整合现有模型的能力形成统一模型。但现有模型融合方法在性能与部署成本之间面临严峻的权衡挑战,这主要源于任务干扰问题。首次揭示任务干扰现象在模型参数的频域中尤为显著,而当前研究仅关注空域解决方案,难以有效应对频域干扰。为缓解频域干扰的影响,我们提出**FR-Merging**,一种创新方法,通过最小计算开销有效过滤有害的频域干扰。由于无成本方法必然伴随性能损失,我们设计了轻量级任务特定专家模块,在融合过程中动态补偿信息损失。该框架**FREE-Merging**(FR-Merging与专家模块结合)在训练成本、推理延迟、存储需求与性能间实现了平衡。我们在计算机视觉、自然语言处理和多模态领域多个任务中验证了FR-Merging和FREE-Merging的有效性,证明其可灵活适配具体需求。
abstract_en: With the rapid growth of deep learning, there is an increasing availability of open-source models for various tasks. However, single fine-tuned models often fall short of meeting the diverse needs of users. Model merging has thus emerged as an efficient method to integrate the capabilities of existing models into a unified model. Nevertheless, existing model merging methods face challenging trade-offs between performance and deployment costs, primarily due to task interference. For the first time, we reveal that task interference is evident in the frequency domain of model parameters, yet current efforts only focus on spatial domain solutions, which are largely ineffective in addressing frequency domain interference. To mitigate the impact of frequency domain interference, we propose **FR-Merging**, an innovative method that effectively filters harmful frequency domain interference on the backbone with minimal computational overhead. Since performance loss is inevitable with cost-free methods, we propose a lightweight task-specific expert module that dynamically compensates for information loss during merging. This proposed framework, **FREE-Merging** (FR-Merging with experts), strikes a balanced trade-off between training cost, inference latency, storage requirements, and performance. We demonstrate the effectiveness of both FR-Merging and FREE-Merging on multiple tasks across CV, NLP, and Multi-Modal domains and show that they can be flexibly adapted to specific needs.
authors: Shenghe Zheng, Hongzhi Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3863-3873

title: FRET:用于测试时适应的特征冗余消除
title_en: FRET: Feature Redundancy Elimination for Test Time Adaptation
abstract: 测试时适应(TTA)旨在增强深度学习模型在面对与训练数据存在分布偏移的测试数据时的泛化能力。在此背景下,仅提供预训练模型和无标签测试数据,使其在隐私敏感的应用中尤为重要。在实践中,我们观察到在TTA中,随着领域偏移的加剧,嵌入特征的冗余性趋于增加。然而,现有TTA方法往往忽视这种冗余性,这可能会阻碍模型对新数据的适应能力。为了解决这一问题,我们引入了用于测试时适应的特征冗余消除(FRET),这是一种新颖的TTA视角。一种直接的方法(S-FRET)是将特征冗余得分作为优化目标进行最小化,以提高适应性。尽管其简单且有效,S-FRET在标签偏移情况下表现不佳,限制了其在现实场景中的鲁棒性。为缓解这一局限性,我们进一步提出基于图的FRET(G-FRET),该方法将图卷积网络(GCN)与对比学习相结合。这种设计不仅减少了特征冗余,还增强了表示层和预测层的特征可区分性。在多种模型架构、任务和数据集上的广泛实验验证了S-FRET的有效性,并表明G-FRET实现了最先进的性能。进一步分析表明,G-FRET使模型能够在推理过程中提取非冗余且高度可区分的特征,从而促进更稳健的测试时适应。
abstract_en: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) aims to enhance the generalization of deep learning models when faced with test data that exhibits distribution shifts from the training data. In this context, only a pre-trained model and unlabeled test data are available, making it particularly relevant for privacy-sensitive applications. In practice, we observe that feature redundancy in embeddings tends to increase as domain shifts intensify in TTA. However, existing TTA methods often overlook this redundancy, which can hinder the model's adaptability to new data. To address this issue, we introduce Feature Redundancy Elimination for Test-time Adaptation (FRET), a novel perspective for TTA. A straightforward approach (S-FRET) is to directly minimize the feature redundancy score as an optimization objective to improve adaptation. Despite its simplicity and effectiveness, S-FRET struggles with label shifts, limiting its robustness in real-world scenarios. To mitigate this limitation, we further propose Graph-based FRET (G-FRET), which integrates a Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) with contrastive learning. This design not only reduces feature redundancy but also enhances feature discriminability in both the representation and prediction layers. Extensive experiments across multiple model architectures, tasks, and datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of S-FRET and show that G-FRET achieves state-of-the-art performance. Further analysis reveals that G-FRET enables the model to extract non-redundant and highly discriminative features during inference, thereby facilitating more robust test-time adaptation.
authors: Linjing You, Jiabao Lu, Xiayuan Huang, Xiangli Nie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2120-2130

title: FROSS:基于RGB-D图像的实时以上在线三维语义场景图生成
title_en: FROSS: Faster-Than-Real-Time Online 3D Semantic Scene Graph Generation from RGB-D Images
abstract: 将复杂3D环境抽象为简化和结构化表示的能力在多个领域至关重要。三维语义场景图(3D SSG)通过将物体表示为节点、其相互关系表示为边,实现这一目标,从而促进高层次场景理解。然而,现有3D SSG生成方法面临显著挑战,包括高计算需求和非增量式处理,这限制了其在实时开放世界应用中的适用性。为解决这一问题,我们提出FROSS(实时以上在线三维语义场景图生成),一种创新的在线实时以上三维SSG生成方法,通过直接将2D场景图提升到3D空间,并将物体表示为三维高斯分布。该框架消除了对精确且计算密集型点云处理的依赖。此外,我们扩展了Replica数据集,添加物体间关系标注,创建ReplicaSSG数据集以全面评估FROSS。在ReplicaSSG和3DSSG数据集上的实验结果表明,FROSS在显著提升速度的同时实现了优于现有方法的性能。我们的实现和数据集已公开在https://github.com/Howardkhh/FROSS。
abstract_en: The ability to abstract complex 3D environments into simplified and structured representations is crucial across various domains. 3D semantic scene graphs (SSGs) achieve this by representing objects as nodes and their interrelationships as edges, facilitating high-level scene understanding. Existing methods for 3D SSG generation, however, face significant challenges, including high computational demands and non-incremental processing that hinder their suitability for real-time open-world applications. To address this issue, we propose FROSS (Faster-than-Real-Time Online 3D Semantic Scene Graph Generation), an innovative approach for online and faster-than-real-time 3D SSG generation that leverages the direct lifting of 2D scene graphs to 3D space and represents objects as 3D Gaussian distributions. This framework eliminates the dependency on precise and computationally-intensive point cloud processing. Furthermore, we extend the Replica dataset with inter-object relationship annotations, creating the ReplicaSSG dataset for comprehensive evaluation of FROSS. The experimental results from evaluations on ReplicaSSG and 3DSSG datasets show that FROSS can achieve superior performance while operating significantly faster than prior 3D SSG generation methods. Our implementation and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/Howardkhh/FROSS.
authors: Hao-Yu Hou, Chun-Yi Lee, Motoharu Sonogashira, Yasutomo Kawanishi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28818-28827

title: FVGen: 通过对抗性视频扩散蒸馏加速新视角合成
title_en: FVGen: Accelerating Novel-View Synthesis with Adversarial Video Diffusion Distillation
abstract: 近期在3D重建领域的进展使得从密集图像采集中生成逼真的3D模型成为可能,但稀疏视角仍存在挑战,常导致未见区域出现伪影。近期工作利用视频扩散模型(VDMs)生成密集观测值,在仅提供稀疏视角的3D重建任务中填补缺失信息。这些方法的显著局限在于使用VDMs时采样速度缓慢。本文提出FVGen框架,通过在仅需4次采样步骤内即可实现快速新视角合成,解决这一挑战。我们提出一种新颖的视频扩散模型蒸馏方法,利用生成对抗网络(GANs)和软化逆KL散度最小化,将多步去噪教师模型蒸馏为几步去噪学生模型。在现实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明,与先前方法相比,我们的框架在生成相同数量的新视角时,视觉质量相似(甚至更好),同时将采样时间减少了超过90%。FVGen显著提升了下游重建任务的时间效率,特别是在处理稀疏输入视角(超过2个)时,预训练VDMs需要多次运行才能获得更好的空间覆盖。我们的代码将在论文被接受后发布。
abstract_en: Recent progress in 3D reconstruction has enabled realistic 3D models from dense image captures, yet challenges persist with sparse views, often leading to artifacts in unseen areas. Recent works leverage Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) to generate dense observations, filling the gaps when only sparse views are available for 3D reconstruction tasks. A significant limitation of these methods is their slow sampling speed when using VDMs. In this paper, we present FVGen, a novel framework that addresses this challenge by enabling fast novel view synthesis using VDMs in as few as 4 sampling steps. We propose a novel video diffusion model distillation method that distills a multi-step denoising teacher model into a few-step denoising student model using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and softened reverse KL-divergence minimization. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets show that, compared to prior works, our framework generates the same number of novel views with similar (or even better) visual quality while reducing sampling time by more than 90%. FVGen significantly improves time efficiency for downstream reconstruction tasks, particularly when working with sparse input views (more than 2) where pre-trained VDMs need to be run multiple times to achieve better spatial coverage. Our code will be released upon acceptance of the paper.
authors: Wenbin Teng, Gonglin Chen, Haiwei Chen, Yajie Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26095-26105

title: FW-Merging: 通过Frank-Wolfe优化扩展模型合并
title_en: FW-Merging: Scaling Model Merging with Frank-Wolfe Optimization
abstract: 模型合并已成为大语言模型(LLMs)中多任务学习(MTL)的有前景方法,为传统微调提供了一种训练和数据效率更高的替代方案。然而,随着开源AI生态系统的快速发展和微调LLM的日益普及,现有模型合并方法面临两个关键限制:(i) 它们主要针对内部微调模型设计,难以适应具有部分未知模型和任务信息的多样化模型来源;(ii) 在合并大量模型检查点时难以有效扩展。为解决这些挑战,我们将模型合并形式化为约束优化问题,并提出一种新方法:Frank-Wolfe合并(FW-Merging)。受Frank-Wolfe优化启发,我们的方法通过预定义的合并函数,迭代选择最相关的模型参数以最小化目标函数的线性近似。目标函数设计用于捕捉目标合并模型的期望行为,而微调候选模型定义了约束集。更重要的是,FW-Merging作为现有合并方法的正交技术,可无缝集成以进一步提升性能。实验表明,FW-Merging在多样化模型来源中具有扩展性,即使在16个无关模型情况下仍保持稳定,在16个相关模型情况下于20个CV任务中提升15.3%,且内存开销恒定——不同于数据驱动方法的线性开销。与最先进方法相比,FW-Merging在合并20个ViT模型时超越数据无关合并方法32.8%,优于数据驱动Adamerging方法8.39%。我们的代码随本提交一并提供。
abstract_en: Model merging has emerged as a promising approach for multi-task learning (MTL) in large language models (LLMs), providing a training- and data-efficient alternative to conventional fine-tuning. However, with the rapid development of the open-source AI ecosystem and the increasing availability of fine-tuned LLMs, existing model merging methods face two key limitations: (i) they are primarily designed for in-house fine-tuned models, making them less adaptable to diverse model sources with partially unknown model and task information, (ii) they struggle to scale effectively when merging numerous model checkpoints.To address these challenges, we formulate model merging as a constrained optimization problem and introduce a novel approach: Frank-Wolfe Merging (FW-Merging). Inspired by the Frank-Wolfe optimization, our approach iteratively selects the most relevant model parameters to minimize a linear approximation of the objective function, merging them through a predefined merging function. The objective function is designed to capture the desired behavior of the target merged model, while the fine-tuned candidate models defines the constraint set.More importantly, FW-Merging serves as an orthogonal technique to existing merging methods, seamlessly integrating with them to further enhance performance.Our experiments show that FW-Merging scales across diverse model sources, remaining stable with 16 irrelevant models and improving by 15.3% with 16 relevant models on 20 CV tasks, all while maintaining constant memory overhead--unlike the linear overhead of data-informed methods.Compared with the state-of-the-art methods, FW-Merging surpasses the data-free merging method by 32.8% and outperforms the data-informed Adamerging by 8.39% when merging 20 ViT models. Our code is attached with this submission.
authors: Hao Mark Chen, Shell Xu Hu, Wayne Luk, Timothy Hospedales, Hongxiang Fan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3390-3400

title: 基于扩散数据生成与频谱修复的人脸美化
title_en: Face Retouching with Diffusion Data Generation and Spectral Restorement
abstract: 人脸美化在各种实际任务中取得了显著性能,主要得益于其广泛的应用场景。然而,大多数现有工作常常面临全局一致性与局部细节保留之间的矛盾,部分归因于缺乏大规模高质量的训练数据。我们从两个角度解决人脸美化挑战。首先,我们创建了一个大规模人脸美化基准数据集以缓解数据稀缺问题。该基准包含25,000对高质量面部图像(修图前与修图后),涵盖多种面部属性和瑕疵类型,如痤疮和痣。其次,我们设计了一个新颖框架,引入频率选择与修复(FSR)和多分辨率融合(MRF),通过频率感知动态聚合和空域-频域滤波实现全局一致性与局部细节保留的协同。受JPEG压缩原理启发,FSR通过空域投影引入频域量化以学习增强的特征表示。MRF通过拉普拉斯金字塔融合多分辨率特征,有效去除大面积瑕疵并保留局部细节。在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明,所提出的框架在定量和定性方面均优于现有最先进的方法。创建的基准数据集也为现有和未来人脸美化网络的训练与评估提供了宝贵的数据资源。
abstract_en: Face retouching has achieved impressive performance largely driven by its wide range of applications in various real-world tasks. However, most existing works often encounters a dilemma between global consistency and local detail preservation, partially due to the lack of large-scale and high-quality training data. We address the face retouching challenge from two perspectives. First, we create a large-scale face retouching benchmark to mitigate the data scarcity issue. The benchmark comprises 25,000 pairs of high-quality facial images (before and after face retouching) that contain a variety of facial attributes and blemish types such as acne and moles. Second, we design a novel framework that introduces frequency selection and restoration (FSR) and multi-resolution fusion (MRF) that leverages frequency-aware dynamic aggregation and spatial-frequency filtering to achieve global consistency and local detail preservation concurrently. Inspired by the principle of JPEG compression, FSR introduces frequency-domain quantization with spatial projections to learn enhanced feature representations. MRF fuses multi-resolution features via laplacian pyramid fusion, removing large-area blemishes and preserving local fine details effectively. Extensive experiments over multiple benchmarks show that the proposed framework outperforms the state-of-the-art quantitatively and qualitatively. The created benchmark also provides valuable data for training and evaluating both existing and future face retouching networks.
authors: Zhidan Xu, Xiaoqin Zhang, Shijian Lu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14722-14731

title: FaceCraft4D:从单张图像生成动态3D面部化身
title_en: FaceCraft4D: Animated 3D Facial Avatar Generation from a Single Image
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的框架,用于从单张图像生成高质量、可动画化的4D化身。尽管近期进展在4D化身创建中显示出有希望的结果,但现有方法要么需要大量多视角数据,要么在几何精度和身份一致性方面存在困难。为了解决这些限制,我们提出了一种全面的系统,利用几何、图像和视频先验知识来创建全视角、可动画化的化身。我们的方法首先通过3D-GAN反演获取初始的粗略几何结构。然后,借助图像扩散模型,利用深度引导的变形信号增强多视角纹理,以实现跨视角的一致性。为处理表情动画,我们引入了带有跨视角同步驱动信号的视频先验。我们进一步引入了一种一致-不一致训练方法,以有效处理4D重建过程中的数据不一致性。实验结果表明,我们的方法在保持不同视角和表情一致性的同时,相比现有技术实现了更优的质量。
abstract_en: We present a novel framework for generating high-quality, animatable 4D avatar from a single image. While recent advances have shown promising results in 4D avatar creation, existing methods either require extensive multiview data or struggle with geometry accuracy and identity consistency. To address these limitations, we propose a comprehensive system that leverages geometry, image, and video priors to create full-view, animatable avatars. Our approach first obtains initial coarse geometry through 3D-GAN inversion. Then, it enhances multiview textures using depth-guided warping signals for cross-view consistency with the help of the image diffusion model. To handle expression animation, we incorporate a video prior with synchronized driving signals across viewpoints. We further introduce a Consistent-Inconsistent training to effectively handle data inconsistencies during 4D reconstruction. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves superior quality compared to the prior art, while maintaining consistency across different viewpoints and expressions.
authors: Fei Yin, Mallikarjun B R, Chun-Han Yao, Rafal K. Mantiuk, Varun Jampani ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11612-11621

title: FaceLift:从合成头部学习可泛化的单图像三维人脸重建
title_en: FaceLift: Learning Generalizable Single Image 3D Face Reconstruction from Synthetic Heads
abstract: 我们提出FaceLift,一种新颖的前馈方法,用于从单张图像中实现可泛化的高质量360度三维头部重建。我们的流程首先采用多视角潜在扩散模型,从单张面部输入生成一致的侧面和背面视图,随后输入基于Transformer的重建器,生成全面的三维高斯点云表示。以往的单目三维人脸重建方法由于缺乏足够的多视角监督,往往在视图覆盖或视图一致性方面存在不足。我们通过创建一个高质量的合成头部数据集来解决这一问题,该数据集能够实现跨视角的一致监督。为弥合合成训练数据与真实世界图像之间的领域差距,我们提出了一种简单而有效的技术,通过在生成视图的同时学习重建输入图像,确保视图生成过程保持对输入的保真度。尽管仅在合成数据上进行训练,我们的方法在真实世界图像上表现出显著的泛化能力。通过广泛的定性和定量评估,我们证明FaceLift在身份保持、细节恢复和渲染质量方面优于最先进的三维人脸重建方法。
abstract_en: We present FaceLift, a novel feed-forward approach for generalizable high-quality 360-degree 3D head reconstruction from a single image. Our pipeline first employs a multi-view latent diffusion model to generate consistent side and back views from a single facial input, which then feed into a transformer-based reconstructor that produces a comprehensive 3D Gaussian splats representation. Previous methods for monocular 3D face reconstruction often lack full view coverage or view consistency due to insufficient multi-view supervision. We address this by creating a high-quality synthetic head dataset that enables consistent supervision across viewpoints. To bridge the domain gap between synthetic training data and real-world images, we propose a simple yet effective technique that ensures the view generation process maintains fidelity to the input by learning to reconstruct the input image alongside the view generation. Despite being trained exclusively on synthetic data, our method demonstrates remarkable generalization to real-world images. Through extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations, we show that FaceLift outperforms state-of-the-art 3D face reconstruction methods on identity preservation, detail recovery and rendering quality.
authors: Weijie Lyu, Yi Zhou, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Zhixin Shu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12691-12701

title: FaceShield: 面部图像防御深度伪造威胁
title_en: FaceShield: Defending Facial Image against Deepfake Threats
abstract: 深度伪造技术在犯罪活动中的广泛应用引发了广泛争议,成为重大问题。尽管已有大量研究针对该问题展开,但多数研究主要聚焦于深度伪造检测。这些反应性解决方案作为忽视真实性犯罪的根本性应对措施仍显不足。现有主动防御方法也存在局限性,因其仅对基于特定生成对抗网络(GANs)的深度伪造模型有效,难以应对近期扩散模型(DMs)的进展。本文提出一种主动防御方法FaceShield,通过引入针对扩散模型(DMs)生成的深度伪造的新型防御策略,并通过面部特征提取器操控实现对多种现有基于GANs的深度伪造模型的防御。我们的方法包含三个主要组成部分:(i) 操控扩散模型的注意力机制,在去噪过程中排除受保护的面部特征;(ii) 针对显著面部特征提取模型以增强对抗性扰动的鲁棒性;(iii) 采用高斯模糊和低通滤波技术提升不可感知性同时增强对JPEG压缩的鲁棒性。在CelebA-HQ和VGGFace2-HQ数据集上的实验结果表明,我们的方法在针对最新扩散模型的深度伪造模型上达到最先进水平,同时具备向GANs迁移的能力,并展现出更高的噪声不可感知性及增强的鲁棒性。
abstract_en: The rising use of deepfakes in criminal activities presents a significant issue, inciting widespread controversy. While numerous studies have tackled this problem, most primarily focus on deepfake detection. These reactive solutions are insufficient as a fundamental approach for crimes where authenticity is disregarded. Existing proactive defenses also have limitations, as they are effective only for deepfake models based on specific Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), making them less applicable in light of recent advancements in diffusion-based models. In this paper, we propose a proactive defense method named FaceShield, which introduces novel defense strategies targeting deepfakes generated by Diffusion Models (DMs) and facilitates defenses on various existing GAN-based deepfake models through facial feature extractor manipulations. Our approach consists of three main components: (i) manipulating the attention mechanism of DMs to exclude protected facial features during the denoising process, (ii) targeting prominent facial feature extraction models to enhance the robustness of our adversarial perturbation, and (iii) employing Gaussian blur and low-pass filtering techniques to improve imperceptibility while enhancing robustness against JPEG compression. Experimental results on the CelebA-HQ and VGGFace2-HQ datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance against the latest deepfake models based on DMs, while also exhibiting transferability to GANs and showcasing greater imperceptibility of noise along with enhanced robustness.
authors: Jaehwan Jeong, Sumin In, Sieun Kim, Hannie Shin, Jongheon Jeong, Sang Ho Yoon, Jaewook Chung, Sangpil Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10364-10374

title: FaceXFormer:一种用于面部分析的统一变换器
title_en: FaceXFormer: A Unified Transformer for Facial Analysis
abstract: 在本文中,我们引入了FaceXFormer,这是一种端到端的统一变换器模型,能够在单一框架内执行十种面部分析任务。这些任务包括面部分割、关键点检测、头部姿态估计、属性预测、年龄、性别和种族估计、表情识别、人脸识别以及面部可见性。传统的人脸分析方法依赖于任务特定的架构和预处理技术,限制了其可扩展性和集成性。相比之下,FaceXFormer采用基于变换器的编码器-解码器架构,其中每个任务都表示为可学习的标记,从而在统一模型中实现无缝的多任务处理。为提高效率,我们引入了FaceX,这是一种轻量级解码器,配备了一种新颖的双向交叉注意力机制,该机制联合处理面部和任务标记以学习鲁棒且通用的面部表示。我们在十个多样化的人脸感知数据集上训练FaceXFormer,并在多个基准测试中将其与专用和多任务模型进行比较,展示了最先进的或具有竞争力的性能。此外,我们分析了FaceXFormer各组件对性能的影响,评估了其在真实环境设置中的鲁棒性,并在不同主干网络下进行了性能比较。据我们所知,FaceXFormer是首个能够在保持33.21 FPS实时性能的同时处理十种面部分析任务的模型。
abstract_en: In this work, we introduce FaceXFormer, an end-to-end unified transformer model capable of performing ten facial analysis tasks within a single framework. These tasks include face parsing, landmark detection, head pose estimation, attribute prediction, age, gender, and race estimation, facial expression recognition, face recognition, and face visibility. Traditional face analysis approaches rely on task-specific architectures and pre-processing techniques, limiting scalability and integration. In contrast, FaceXFormer employs a transformer-based encoder-decoder architecture, where each task is represented as a learnable token, enabling seamless multi-task processing within a unified model. To enhance efficiency, we introduce FaceX, a lightweight decoder with a novel bi-directional cross-attention mechanism, which jointly processes face and task tokens to learn robust and generalized facial representations. We train FaceXFormer on ten diverse face perception datasets and evaluate it against both specialized and multi-task models across multiple benchmarks, demonstrating state-of-the-art or competitive performance. Additionally, we analyze the impact of various components of FaceXFormer on performance, assess real-world robustness in "in-the-wild" settings, and conduct a performance comparison under different backbones. To the best of our knowledge, FaceXFormer is the first model capable of handling ten facial analysis tasks while maintaining real-time performance at 33.21 FPS.
authors: Kartik Narayan, Vibashan VS, Rama Chellappa, Vishal M. Patel ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11369-11382

title: 面向时间锚定视频-语言模型的因子化学习
title_en: Factorized Learning for Temporally Grounded Video-Language Models
abstract: 近期视频-语言模型在视频理解领域展现出巨大潜力,但在事件级感知的时间锚定准确性方面仍存在挑战。我们观察到视频理解中的两个主要因素(即时间锚定与文本响应)形成逻辑层次结构:准确的时间证据锚定为可靠的文本响应奠定基础。然而现有研究通常以耦合方式处理这两个任务而缺乏明确的逻辑结构,导致次优目标。我们从因子化学习视角解决这一问题。我们首先提出D2VLM框架,该框架在解耦这两个任务学习的同时强调其内在依赖性。我们采用"先锚定后回答并引用证据"的范式,引入证据标记进行证据锚定,这超越了现有工作对时间戳表示的侧重,强调事件级视觉语义捕捉。为进一步促进这两个任务的学习,我们提出新颖的因子化偏好优化(FPO)算法。与标准偏好优化不同,FPO将概率时间锚定建模显式纳入优化目标,实现时间锚定与文本响应的偏好学习。我们还构建了一个合成数据集以解决因子化偏好学习在时间锚定方面的数据不足问题。在各类任务上的实验验证了我们方法的显著优势。源代码可在https://github.com/nusnlp/d2vlm获取。
abstract_en: Recent video-language models have shown great potential for video understanding, but still struggle with accurate temporal grounding for event-level perception. We observe that two main factors in video understanding (i.e., temporal grounding and textual response) form a logical hierarchy: accurate temporal evidence grounding lays the foundation for reliable textual response. However, existing works typically handle these two tasks in a coupled manner without a clear logical structure, leading to sub-optimal objectives. We address this from a factorized learning perspective. We first propose D2VLM, a framework that decouples the learning of these two tasks while also emphasizing their inherent dependency. We adopt a "grounding then answering with evidence referencing" paradigm and introduce evidence tokens for evidence grounding, which emphasize event-level visual semantic capture beyond the focus on timestamp representation in existing works. To further facilitate the learning of these two tasks, we introduce a novel factorized preference optimization (FPO) algorithm. Unlike standard preference optimization, FPO explicitly incorporates probabilistic temporal grounding modeling into the optimization objective, enabling preference learning for both temporal grounding and textual response. We also construct a synthetic dataset to address the lack of suitable datasets for factorized preference learning with explicit temporal grounding. Experiments on various tasks demonstrate the clear advantage of our approach. Our source code is available at https://github.com/nusnlp/d2vlm.
authors: Wenzheng Zeng, Difei Gao, Mike Zheng Shou, Hwee Tou Ng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20683-20693

title: 失败案例被更好地学习但边界表示歉意:促进对抗训练中准确率-鲁棒性权衡的平滑感知变化
title_en: Failure Cases Are Better Learned But Boundary Says Sorry: Facilitating Smooth Perception Change for Accuracy-Robustness Trade-Off in Adversarial Training
abstract: 对抗训练(AT)是训练鲁棒深度神经网络(DNN)最有效的方法之一。然而,AT在干净准确率与对抗鲁棒性之间存在固有权衡,这通常归因于对困难对抗样本学习不足导致的决策边界复杂化。本工作中,我们首次揭示了一个反直觉事实:**从感知一致性视角来看,经过AT后仍能攻击鲁棒模型的困难对抗样本实际上已被更好地学习,而非成功防御的样本**。因此,不同于以往观点,我们认为正是对困难对抗样本的过度充分学习导致了决策边界的退化,进而引发权衡问题。具体而言,对感知一致性的过度追求会迫使模型将扰动视为噪声并忽略其中信息,而这些信息本应被用于诱导向决策边界的平滑感知过渡,以支持其建立到合适位置。针对此,我们定义了一个新的AT目标**鲁棒感知**,鼓励模型感知随输入扰动平滑变化,基于此提出了一种新型**鲁棒感知对抗训练(RPAT)**方法,有效缓解当前的准确率-鲁棒性权衡问题。在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet数据集上,使用ResNet-18、PreActResNet-18和WideResNet-34-10进行的实验表明,我们的方法在超越四个常见基线和12项最先进(SOTA)工作的同时验证了有效性。代码已开源于https://github.com/FlaAI/RPAT。
abstract_en: Adversarial Training (AT) is one of the most effective methods to train robust Deep Neural Networks (DNNs). However, AT creates an inherent trade-off between clean accuracy and adversarial robustness, which is commonly attributed to the more complicated decision boundary caused by the insufficient learning of hard adversarial samples. In this work, we reveal a counterintuitive fact for the first time: **From the perspective of perception consistency, hard adversarial samples that can still attack the robust model after AT are already learned better than those successfully defended**. Thus, different from previous views, we argue that it is rather the over-sufficient learning of hard adversarial samples that degrades the decision boundary and contributes to the trade-off problem. Specifically, the excessive pursuit of perception consistency would force the model to view the perturbations as noise and ignore the information within them, which should have been utilized to induce a smoother perception transition towards the decision boundary to support its establishment to an appropriate location. In response, we define a new AT objective named **Robust Perception**, encouraging the model perception to change smoothly with input perturbations, based on which we propose a novel **R**obust **P**erception **A**dversarial **T**raining (**RPAT**) method, effectively mitigating the current accuracy-robustness trade-off. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny-ImageNet with ResNet-18, PreActResNet-18, and WideResNet-34-10 demonstrate the effectiveness of our method beyond four common baselines and 12 state-of-the-art (SOTA) works. The code is available at https://github.com/FlaAI/RPAT.
authors: Yanyun Wang, Li Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4691-4700

title: 公平生成无需不公平扭曲:基于无纠缠注意力的文本到图像生成去偏方法
title_en: Fair Generation without Unfair Distortions: Debiasing Text-to-Image Generation with Entanglement-Free Attention
abstract: 近期基于扩散的文本到图像(T2I)模型的发展使得从文本生成高质量且逼真的图像成为可能。然而,这些模型往往表现出与性别、种族和经济地位相关的社会偏见,从而可能强化有害刻板印象并以非预期方式塑造公众认知。尽管现有偏见缓解方法展现出有效性,但常遭遇属性纠缠问题,即对与偏见相关的属性(即目标属性)进行调整时,会无意改变与偏见无关的属性(即非目标属性),导致不期望的分布偏移。为解决这一挑战,我们提出无纠缠注意力(EFA)方法,在缓解偏见过程中准确融合目标属性(如白人、黑人和亚洲人)同时保留非目标属性(如背景)。推理阶段,EFA等概率随机采样目标属性,并在选定层调整交叉注意力以融合采样属性,实现目标属性的公平分布。大量实验表明,EFA在缓解偏见的同时优于现有方法,从而保持原始模型的输出分布和生成能力。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in diffusion-based text-to-image (T2I) models have enabled the generation of high-quality and photorealistic images from text. However, they often exhibit societal biases related to gender, race, and socioeconomic status, thereby potentially reinforcing harmful stereotypes and shaping public perception in unintended ways. While existing bias mitigation methods demonstrate effectiveness, they often encounter attribute entanglement, where adjustments to attributes relevant to the bias (i.e., target attributes) unintentionally alter attributes unassociated with the bias (i.e., non-target attributes), causing undesirable distribution shifts. To address this challenge, we introduce Entanglement-Free Attention (EFA), a method that accurately incorporates target attributes (e.g., White, Black, and Asian) while preserving non-target attributes (e.g., background) during bias mitigation. At inference time, EFA randomly samples a target attribute with equal probability and adjusts the cross-attention in selected layers to incorporate the sampled attribute, achieving a fair distribution of target attributes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EFA outperforms existing methods in mitigating bias while preserving non-target attributes, thereby maintaining the original model's output distribution and generative capacity.
authors: Jeonghoon Park, Juyoung Lee, Chaeyeon Chung, Jaeseong Lee, Jaegul Choo, Jindong Gu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17567-17576

title: FairGen:通过自发现潜在方向提升文本到图像扩散模型的公平性
title_en: FairGen: Enhancing Fairness in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Self-Discovering Latent Directions
abstract: 尽管扩散模型(DM)在各类图像生成任务中表现出卓越性能,但它们仍会反映训练集中的固有偏差。随着扩散模型在现实应用中的广泛使用,这些偏差可能强化扭曲的世界观并阻碍少数群体的机会。现有去偏方法通常需要借助人工构建的参考数据集或额外分类器进行模型再训练,这存在两大局限:(1)收集参考数据集导致高昂的标注成本;(2)去偏性能严重依赖参考数据集或额外分类器的质量。为解决上述问题,我们提出FairGen,一种即插即用方法,通过自发现方式学习属性潜在方向,从而消除对参考数据集的依赖。具体而言,FairGen包含两部分:一组属性适配器和一个分布指示器。每组适配器旨在学习属性潜在方向,并通过自发现过程中的噪声组合进行优化。随后,分布指示器与适配器组相乘,引导生成过程朝向指定分布。我们的方法能够同时对扩散模型中的多个属性进行去偏,同时保持轻量级并易于与其他扩散模型集成,无需进行再训练。在去偏性别、种族及其交叉性偏差的大量实验中,我们的方法显著超越了现有最先进方法。
abstract_en: While Diffusion Models (DM) exhibit remarkable performance across various image generative tasks, they nonetheless reflect the inherent bias presented in the training set.As DMs are now widely used in real-world applications, these biases could perpetuate a distorted worldview and hinder opportunities for minority groups. Existing methods on debiasing DMs usually requires model re-training with a human-crafted reference dataset or additional classifiers, which suffer from two major limitations: (1) collecting reference datasets causes expensive annotation cost; (2) the debiasing performance is heavily constrained by the quality of the reference dataset or the additional classifier. To address the above limitations, we propose FairGen, a plug-and-play method that learns attribute latent directions in a self-discovering manner, thus eliminating the reliance on such reference dataset. Specifically, FairGen consists of two parts: a set of attribute adapters and a distribution indicator. Each adapter in the set aims to learn an attribute latent direction, and is optimized via noise composition through a self-discovering process.Then, the distribution indicator is multiplied by the set of adapters to guide the generation process towards the prescribed distribution. Our method enables debiasing multiple attributes in DMs simultaneously, while remaining lightweight and easily integrable with other DMs, eliminating the need for re-training. Extensive experiments on debiasing gender, racial, and their intersectional biases show that our method outperforms previous SOTA by a large margin.
authors: Yilei Jiang, Wei-Hong Li, Yiyuan Zhang, Minghong Cai, Xiangyu Yue ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18411-18420

title: FairHuman:基于扩散模型中最小潜在延迟公平性的手与面部质量提升方法
title_en: FairHuman: Boosting Hand and Face Quality in Human Image Generation with Minimum Potential Delay Fairness in Diffusion Models
abstract: 随着大规模文本到图像模型的发展,图像生成技术取得了显著进展,尤其是基于扩散的模型。然而,由于训练过程中局部区域的监督不足,生成具有合理细节(如面部或手部)的人像图像仍面临挑战。为了解决这一问题,我们提出FairHuman,这是一种多目标微调方法,旨在公平地提升全局和局部生成质量。具体而言,我们首先构建了三个学习目标:一个来自默认扩散目标函数的全局目标,以及基于预标注位置先验的手部和面部两个局部目标。随后,在最小潜在延迟(MPD)准则的指导下,我们推导出最优的参数更新策略,从而实现对该多目标问题的公平性优化。基于此,我们的方法在保持整体质量的同时,能够显著提升生成具有挑战性的局部细节的能力。大量实验验证了该方法在不同场景下提升人类图像生成性能的有效性。
abstract_en: Image generation has achieved remarkable progress with the development of large-scale text-to-image models, especially diffusion-based models. However, generating human images with plausible details, such as faces or hands, remains challenging due to insufficient supervision of local regions during training. To address this issue, we propose FairHuman, a multi-objective fine-tuning approach designed to enhance both global and local generation quality fairly. Specifically, we first construct three learning objectives: a global objective derived from the default diffusion objective function and two local objectives for hands and faces based on pre-annotated positional priors. Subsequently, we derive the optimal parameter updating strategy under the guidance of the Minimum Potential Delay (MPD) criterion, thereby attaining fairness-ware optimization for this multi-objective problem. Based on this, our proposed method can achieve significant improvements in generating challenging local details while maintaining overall quality. Extensive experiments showcase the effectiveness of our method in improving the performance of human image generation under different scenarios.
authors: Yuxuan Wang, Tianwei Cao, Huayu Zhang, Zhongjiang He, Kongming Liang, Zhanyu Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17046-17055

title: FakeRadar:探测伪造异常以检测未知深度伪造视频
title_en: FakeRadar: Probing Forgery Outliers to Detect Unknown Deepfake Videos
abstract: 本文提出FakeRadar,一种新型深度伪造视频检测框架,旨在解决现实场景中跨域泛化面临的挑战。现有检测方法通常依赖于特定操作特征,在已知伪造类型上表现良好,但对新兴操作技术存在严重局限性。这种泛化能力不足源于其无法有效适应未知伪造模式。为克服这一问题,我们利用大规模预训练模型(如CLIP)主动探测特征空间,明确突出真实视频、已知伪造和未知操作之间的分布差异。具体而言,FakeRadar引入伪造异常探测技术,通过动态子簇建模和簇条件异常生成,在估计子簇边界附近合成异常样本,模拟超越已知操作类型的新型伪造特征。此外,我们设计异常引导的三阶段训练,通过提出的异常驱动对比学习和异常条件交叉熵损失,优化检测器以区分真实、伪造和异常样本。实验表明,FakeRadar在多个深度伪造视频检测基准数据集上均优于现有方法,特别是在跨域评估中,通过处理多样化的新兴操作技术展现出优势。
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose FakeRadar, a novel deepfake video detection framework designed to address the challenges of cross-domain generalization in real-world scenarios. Existing detection methods typically rely on manipulation-specific cues, performing well on known forgery types but exhibiting severe limitations against emerging manipulation techniques. This poor generalization stems from their inability to adapt effectively to unseen forgery patterns. To overcome this, we leverage large-scale pretrained models (e.g. CLIP) to proactively probe the feature space, explicitly highlighting distributional gaps between real videos, known forgeries, and unseen manipulations. Specifically, FakeRadar introduces Forgery Outlier Probing, which employs dynamic subcluster modeling and cluster-conditional outlier generation to synthesize outlier samples near boundaries of estimated subclusters, simulating novel forgery artifacts beyond known manipulation types. Additionally, we design Outlier-Guided Tri-Training, which optimizes the detector to distinguish real, fake, and outlier samples using proposed outlier-driven contrastive learning and outlier-conditioned cross-entropy losses. Experiments show that FakeRadar outperforms existing methods across various benchmark datasets for deepfake video detection, particularly in cross-domain evaluations, by handling the variety of emerging manipulation techniques.
authors: Zhaolun Li, Jichang Li, Yinqi Cai, Junye Chen, Xiaonan Luo, Guanbin Li, Rushi Lan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13382-13392

title: 快速全局最优且几何一致的三维形状匹配
title_en: Fast Globally Optimal and Geometrically Consistent 3D Shape Matching
abstract: 几何一致性,即邻域的保持,是三维形状匹配中自然且强的先验条件。几何一致的匹配对于许多下游应用至关重要,例如纹理迁移或统计形状建模。然而,在实践中,几何一致性往往被忽视,或仅在严重限制的假设下(例如良好的初始化)才能实现。在本文中,我们提出了一种新颖的形式化方法,用于计算在实践中可扩展的三维形状之间的全局最优且几何一致的匹配。我们的关键思想是将源形状的表面表示为一组循环图,然后将这些图一致地匹配到目标形状上。数学上,我们构建一个超积图(源形状和目标形状之间),然后将三维形状匹配问题转化为该超图中的最小费用循环流问题,从而得到两者之间的全局几何一致匹配。我们实证表明,我们的形式化方法是高效可解的,并且能够产生高质量的结果。我们的代码已公开发布。
abstract_en: Geometric consistency, i.e. the preservation of neighbourhoods, is a natural and strong prior in 3D shape matching. Geometrically consistent matchings are crucial for many downstream applications, such as texture transfer or statistical shape modelling. Yet, in practice, geometric consistency is often overlooked, or only achieved under severely limiting assumptions (e.g. a good initialisation). In this work, we propose a novel formalism for computing globally optimal and geometrically consistent matchings between 3D shapes which is scalable in practice. Our key idea is to represent the surface of the source shape as a collection of cyclic graphs, which are then consistently matched to the target shape. Mathematically, we construct a hyper product graph (between source and target shape), and then cast 3D shape matching as a minimum-cost circulation flow problem in this hyper graph, which yields global geometrically consistent matchings between both shapes. We empirically show that our formalism is efficiently solvable and that it leads to high-quality results. Our code is publicly available.
authors: Paul Roetzer, Florian Bernard ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 912-922

title: 基于一致性校正流的快速图像超分辨率
title_en: Fast Image Super-Resolution via Consistency Rectified Flow
abstract: 扩散模型(DMs)在现实场景图像超分辨率(SR)中展现出显著成效,但其依赖耗时的多步采样过程严重制约了实际应用。尽管近期研究引入了少量或单步解决方案,现有方法要么低效建模噪声输入过程,要么未能充分挖掘迭代生成先验,导致重建图像的保真度和质量受损。为解决此问题,我们提出FlowSR,一种将SR问题重新表述为从低分辨率(LR)到高分辨率(HR)图像的一致性校正流的新方法。我们的方法通过改进的一致性学习策略,实现单步高质量SR。具体而言,我们通过引入HR正则化优化原始一致性蒸馏过程,确保学习的SR流不仅强制自洽性,还能精确收敛至真实HR目标。此外,我们提出快慢调度策略,其中一致性学习的相邻时间步从两个不同调度器中采样:快速调度器采用较少时间步以提升效率,慢速调度器采用更多时间步以捕捉细粒度纹理细节。大量实验表明,FlowSR在效率和图像质量方面均取得卓越性能。
abstract_en: Diffusion models (DMs) have demonstrated remarkable success in real-world image super-resolution (SR), yet their reliance on time-consuming multi-step sampling largely hinders their practical applications. While recent efforts have introduced few- or single-step solutions, existing methods either inefficiently model the process from noisy input or fail to fully exploit iterative generative priors, compromising the fidelity and quality of the reconstructed images. To address this issue, we propose FlowSR, a novel approach that reformulates the SR problem as a rectified flow from low-resolution (LR) to high-resolution (HR) images. Our method leverages an improved consistency learning strategy to enable high-quality SR in a single step. Specifically, we refine the original consistency distillation process by incorporating HR regularization, ensuring that the learned SR flow not only enforces self-consistency but also converges precisely to the ground-truth HR target. Furthermore, we introduce a fast-slow scheduling strategy, where adjacent timesteps for consistency learning are sampled from two distinct schedulers: a fast scheduler with fewer timesteps to improve efficiency, and a slow scheduler with more timesteps to capture fine-grained texture details. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FlowSR achieves outstanding performance in both efficiency and image quality.
authors: Jiaqi Xu, Wenbo Li, Haoze Sun, Fan Li, Zhixin Wang, Long Peng, Jingjing Ren, Haoran Yang, Xiaowei Hu, Renjing Pei, Pheng-Ann Heng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11755-11765

title: FastJSMA: 通过梯度解耦加速基于雅可比矩阵的显著性图攻击
title_en: FastJSMA: Accelerating Jacobian-based Saliency Map Attacks through Gradient Decoupling
abstract: 对抗攻击在评估深度学习模型鲁棒性中起着关键作用。基于雅可比矩阵的显著性图攻击(JSMA)是一种可解释的对抗方法,能够提供优秀的像素级控制,并为模型脆弱性提供有价值的见解。然而,其二次计算复杂度 O(M2×N) 使其在大规模数据集上难以实际应用,尽管其固有价值仍受到限制。本文提出 FastJSMA,一种高效的攻击方法,解决了这些计算限制。我们的方法引入了梯度解耦机制,将雅可比矩阵计算分解为互补的类别抑制(g^-)和类别激发(g^+)梯度,将复杂度降低至 O(M√N)。此外,我们实现了类别探测机制和自适应显著性阈值以进一步优化流程。在多个数据集上的实验结果表明,FastJSMA 在保持相当攻击成功率的同时显著减少了计算时间——在 CIFAR-10 上仅需 JSMA 处理时间的 2.9%,在 CIFAR-100 上为 1.2%,并在传统 JSMA 因内存限制而无法运行的 ImageNet 上成功应用。这一进展使可解释的显著性图攻击在大规模数据集上的实际应用成为可能,实现了有效性与计算效率的平衡。
abstract_en: Adversarial attack plays a critical role in evaluating the robustness of deep learning models. Jacobian-based Saliency Map Attack (JSMA) is an interpretable adversarial method that offers excellent pixel-level control and provides valuable insights into model vulnerabilities. However, its quadratic computational complexity O(M^2 xN) renders it impractical for large-scale datasets, limiting its application despite its inherent value. This paper proposes FastJSMA, an efficient attack method that addresses these computational limitations. Our approach introduces a gradient decoupling mechanism that decomposes the Jacobian calculation into complementary class suppression (g^-) and class excitation (g^+) gradients, reducing complexity to O(M\sqrt N ). Additionally, we implement a class probing mechanism and an adaptive saliency threshold to further optimize the process. Experimental results across multiple datasets demonstrate that FastJSMA maintains comparable attack success rates while dramatically reducing computation time--requiring only 2.9% of JSMA's processing time on CIFAR-10 and 1.2% on CIFAR-100, and successfully operating on ImageNet where traditional JSMA fails due to memory constraints. This advancement enables the practical application of interpretable saliency map-based attacks on large-scale datasets, balancing effectiveness with computational efficiency.
authors: Zhenghao Gao, Shengjie Xu, Zijing Li, Meixi Chen, Chaojian Yu, Yuanjie Shao, Changxin Gao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1506-1515

title: FastPoint:通过采样点距离预测加速三维点云模型推理
title_en: FastPoint: Accelerating 3D Point Cloud Model Inference via Sample Point Distance Prediction
abstract: 深度神经网络已彻底改变了三维点云处理,但高效处理大规模且不规则的点云仍具挑战性。为解决这一问题,我们提出FastPoint,一种新颖的软件加速技术,该技术利用最远点采样过程中采样点之间的可预测距离趋势。通过预测距离曲线,我们可以在无需计算所有成对距离的情况下高效识别后续采样点。我们的方法显著加速了最远点采样和邻近搜索操作,同时保持采样质量与模型性能。将FastPoint集成到最先进的三维点云模型中,在NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU上实现了2.55倍的端到端加速,且不牺牲精度。
abstract_en: Deep neural networks have revolutionized 3D point cloud processing, yet efficiently handling large and irregular point clouds remains challenging. To tackle this problem, we introduce FastPoint, a novel software-based acceleration technique that leverages the predictable distance trend between sampled points during farthest point sampling. By predicting the distance curve, we can efficiently identify subsequent sample points without exhaustively computing all pairwise distances. Our proposal substantially accelerates farthest point sampling and neighbor search operations while preserving sampling quality and model performance. By integrating FastPoint into state-of-the-art 3D point cloud models, we achieve 2.55x end-to-end speedup on NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU without sacrificing accuracy.
authors: Donghyun Lee, Dawoon Jeong, Jae W. Lee, Hongil Yoon ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25114-25123

title: FastVAR:通过缓存标记修剪的线性视觉自回归建模
title_en: FastVAR: Linear Visual Autoregressive Modeling via Cached Token Pruning
abstract: 视觉自回归(VAR)建模因其转向下一尺度预测而受到关注。然而,现有VAR范式在每个尺度步骤均处理完整标记图,导致复杂度和运行时间随图像分辨率急剧增长。为解决这一挑战,我们提出FastVAR,一种针对VAR的后训练加速方法,实现高效分辨率缩放。我们的关键发现是,大部分延迟源自大规模步骤中已收敛的标记。基于此观察,我们开发了缓存标记修剪策略:仅转发关键标记进行尺度特定建模,同时利用前一尺度步骤的缓存标记恢复被修剪的槽位。这显著减少了转发标记数量,在更高分辨率下提升效率。实验表明,所提出的FastVAR可在性能下降不足1%的前提下,将FlashAttention加速的VAR速度提升2.7倍。我们进一步将该方法扩展至零样本生成更高分辨率图像。具体而言,FastVAR可在单块NVIDIA 3090 GPU上,以1.5秒生成15GB内存占用的2K图像。
abstract_en: Visual Autoregressive (VAR) modeling has gained popularity for its shift towards next-scale prediction. However, existing VAR paradigms process the entire token map at each scale step, leading to the complexity and runtime scaling dramatically with image resolution. To address this challenge, we propose FastVAR, a post-training acceleration method for efficient resolution scaling with VARs. Our key finding is that the majority of latency arises from the large-scale step where most tokens have already converged. Leveraging this observation, we develop the cached token pruning strategy that only forwards pivotal tokens for scale-specific modeling while using cached tokens from previous scale steps to restore the pruned slots. This significantly reduces the number of forwarded tokens and improves the efficiency at larger resolutions. Experiments show the proposed FastVAR can further speedup FlashAttention-accelerated VAR by 2.7x with negligible performance drop of <1%. We further extend \NAME to zero-shot generation of higher resolution images. In particular, FastVAR can generate one 2K image with 15GB memory footprints in 1.5s on a single NVIDIA 3090 GPU.
authors: Hang Guo, Yawei Li, Taolin Zhang, Jiangshan Wang, Tao Dai, Shu-Tao Xia, Luca Benini ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19011-19021

title: 通过分组训练实现更快更优的3D点云渲染
title_en: Faster and Better 3D Splatting via Group Training
abstract: 3D高斯点云渲染(3DGS)作为一种强大的新视角合成技术已崭露头角,其通过高斯基础体表示在高保真场景重建中展现出卓越能力。然而,由海量基础体带来的计算开销成为训练效率的显著瓶颈。为克服这一挑战,我们提出分组训练策略,该策略通过将高斯基础体组织为可管理的组,有效优化训练效率并提升渲染质量。该方法与现有3DGS框架具有通用兼容性,包括基础版3DGS和Mip-Splatting,在保持卓越合成质量的同时持续实现训练加速。大量实验表明,我们的简单分组训练策略在多种场景下实现了高达30%的收敛速度提升和渲染质量改善。项目网站:https://chengbo-wang.github.io/3DGS-with-Group-Training/
abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a powerful technique for novel view synthesis, demonstrating remarkable capability in high-fidelity scene reconstruction through its Gaussian primitive representations. However, the computational overhead induced by the massive number of primitives poses a significant bottleneck to training efficiency. To overcome this challenge, we propose Group Training, a simple yet effective strategy that organizes Gaussian primitives into manageable groups, optimizing training efficiency and improving rendering quality. This approach shows universal compatibility with existing 3DGS frameworks, including vanilla 3DGS and Mip-Splatting, consistently achieving accelerated training while maintaining superior synthesis quality. Extensive experiments reveal that our straightforward Group Training strategy achieves up to 30% faster convergence and improved rendering quality across diverse scenarios. Project Website: https://chengbo-wang.github.io/3DGS-with-Group-Training/.
authors: Chengbo Wang, Guozheng Ma, Yifei Xue, Yizhen Lao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27968-27977

title: 轻触油门:重新审视视觉标记剪枝以实现视觉-语言模型加速
title_en: Feather the Throttle: Revisiting Visual Token Pruning for Vision-Language Model Acceleration
abstract: 近期关于加速视觉-语言模型的研究在多种视觉-语言任务中均取得了优异表现,即使对视觉信息进行了高度压缩。本文重新审视了在语言模型中对视觉标记进行早期剪枝的流行加速方法。令人惊讶的是,尽管在多数任务中保持了强劲表现,但该方法在部分以视觉为中心的任务(如定位)中表现出显著差异。进一步研究发现,该加速方法存在核心问题:图像顶部的大部分标记被剪枝。然而,在许多旨在评估视觉导向能力的基准测试中,即使采用这种有缺陷的剪枝策略,仍能保持强表现,这凸显了这些基准测试在评估细粒度视觉能力方面的局限性。基于这些发现,我们提出FEATHER(快速且有效的加速方法,结合集成准则),这是一种简单有效的方法,解决了早期层剪枝问题,并通过多阶段剪枝结合早期均匀抽样,进一步增强相关标记的保留,确保图像广泛覆盖。在计算节省效果相当的前提下,我们在以视觉为中心的定位基准测试中发现,FEATHER相比原始加速方法实现了超过5倍的性能提升。
abstract_en: Recent works on accelerating Vision-Language Models achieve strong performance across a variety of vision-language tasks despite highly compressing visual information. In this work, we examine the popular acceleration approach of early pruning of visual tokens inside the language model. Surprisingly, we find that while strong performance is maintained across many tasks, it exhibits drastically different behavior for a subset of vision-centric tasks such as localization. Upon further investigation, we uncover a core issue with the acceleration approach where most tokens towards the top of the image are pruned away. Yet, on many benchmarks aiming to evaluate vision-centric capabilities, strong performance persists with the flawed pruning strategy, highlighting these benchmarks' limited ability to assess fine-grained visual capabilities. Based on these findings, we propose FEATHER (Fast and Effective Acceleration wiTH Ensemble cRiteria), a straightforward approach that resolves the discovered early-layer pruning issue and further enhances the preservation of relevant tokens via multistage pruning with early uniform sampling to ensure broad image coverage. With comparable computational savings, we find that FEATHER achieves more than 5x performance improvement on the vision-centric localization benchmarks compared to the original acceleration approach.
authors: Mark Endo, Xiaohan Wang, Serena Yeung-Levy ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22826-22835

title: 大模型时代的特征编码:数据集、测试条件与基准
title_en: Feature Coding in the Era of Large Models: Dataset, Test Conditions, and Benchmark
abstract: 大模型在各类任务中取得了显著性能,但在训练和推理过程中会产生显著的计算成本和隐私问题。分布式部署已成为一种潜在解决方案,但需要在模型各部分之间交换中间信息,而特征表示作为关键的信息载体。为优化信息交换,需要进行特征编码以减少传输和存储开销。尽管其重要性,大模型的特征编码仍是一个研究较少的领域。本文关注大模型特征编码,并做出三项基础贡献。首先,我们引入一个涵盖三种代表性大模型生成的多样化特征的综合数据集。其次,我们建立统一的测试条件,使未来特征编码研究能够实现标准化评估流程和公平比较。第三,我们从广泛使用的图像编码技术中衍生出两种基线方法,并在所提出的数据集上对它们的性能进行基准测试。这些贡献旨在为未来研究奠定基础,并激发该领域的更广泛参与。为支持长期研究,所有源代码和数据集均在https://github.com/chansongoal/LaMoFC公开。
abstract_en: Large models have achieved remarkable performance across various tasks, yet they incur significant computational costs and privacy concerns during both training and inference. Distributed deployment has emerged as a potential solution, but it necessitates the exchange of intermediate information between model segments, with feature representations serving as crucial information carriers. To optimize information exchange, feature coding is required to reduce transmission and storage overhead. Despite its importance, feature coding for large models remains an under-explored area. In this paper, we draw attention to large model feature coding and make three fundamental contributions. First, we introduce a comprehensive dataset encompassing diverse features generated by three representative types of large models.
