abstract: 本文提出FlexGen,一个灵活框架,旨在根据单视角图像、文本提示或两者生成可控且一致的多视角图像。FlexGen通过额外的三维感知文本注释条件化,解决可控多视角合成的挑战。我们利用GPT-4V的强大推理能力生成三维感知文本注释。通过分析以马赛克多视角图像形式排列的物体四个正交视角,GPT-4V可生成包含空间关系的三维感知信息文本注释。通过将控制信号与提出的自适应双控制模块集成,我们的模型可生成与指定文本对应的多视角图像。FlexGen支持多种可控能力,允许用户修改文本提示以生成合理且对应的未见部分。此外,用户可影响外观和材质属性,包括金属感和粗糙度。大量实验表明,我们的方法在多控方面具有显著提升,标志着对现有多视角扩散模型的重大进步。本工作对需要快速灵活3D内容创作的领域(如游戏开发、动画制作和虚拟现实)具有重要影响。
abstract_en: In this work, we introduce FlexGen, a flexible framework designed to generate controllable and consistent multi-view images, conditioned on a single-view image, or a text prompt, or both. FlexGen tackles the challenges of controllable multi-view synthesis through additional conditioning on 3D-aware text annotations. We utilize the strong reasoning capabilities of GPT-4V to generate 3D-aware text annotations. By analyzing four orthogonal views of an object arranged as tiled multi-view images, GPT-4V can produce text annotations that include 3D-aware information with spatial relationship. By integrating the control signal with proposed adaptive dual-control module, our model can generate multi-view images that correspond to the specified text. FlexGen supports multiple controllable capabilities, allowing users to modify text prompts to generate reasonable and corresponding unseen parts. Additionally, users can influence attributes such as appearance and material properties, including metallic and roughness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach offers enhanced multiple controllability, marking a significant advancement over existing multi-view diffusion models. This work has substantial implications for fields requiring rapid and flexible 3D content creation, including game development, animation, and virtual reality.
authors: Xinli Xu, Wenhang Ge, Jiantao Lin, Jiawei Feng, Lie Xu, Hanfeng Zhao, Shunsi Zhang, Ying-Cong Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18714-18724

title: Flexi-FSCIL: 自适应知识保留以突破少样本类增量学习中的稳定性-可塑性困境
title_en: Flexi-FSCIL: Adaptive Knowledge Retention for Breaking the Stability-Plasticity Dilemma in Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
abstract: 少样本类增量学习(FSCIL)面临数据量有限和类别空间扩展的挑战,导致过拟合和灾难性遗忘。现有方法通常冻结特征提取器并使用最近类均值分类器,以牺牲对新特征分布的适应性为代价。为解决这些问题,我们提出Flexi-FSCIL,一个半监督框架,集成了三种新颖策略:自适应门控残差融合(AGRF)、注意力引导动态混合蒸馏(ADHD)和原型偏移平衡(POE)。Flexi-FSCIL在FSCIL中有效平衡了稳定性与可塑性。AGRF通过整合冻结和可训练组件,解决冻结特征提取器的刚性问题,实现自适应特征学习同时保留旧类别知识。ADHD通过交叉注意力图和直接匹配动态对齐特征,解决旧新任务间的不平衡问题,在保留旧类别知识的同时促进新类别学习。POE通过选择高质量的无标签样本,解决半监督设置中的原型漂移问题,维持特征空间可分性并防止过拟合。在三个基准数据集上的评估表明,Flexi-FSCIL实现了最先进性能,仅在CUB200上出现12.97的性能下降,显著优于现有FSCIL方法。
abstract_en: Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL) is challenged by limited data and expanding class spaces, leading to overfitting and catastrophic forgetting. Existing methods, which often freeze feature extractors and use Nearest Class Mean classifiers, sacrifice adaptability to new feature distributions. To address these issues, we propose Flexi-FSCIL, a semi-supervised framework that integrates three novel strategies: Adaptive Gated Residual Fusion (AGRF), Attention-Guided Dynamic Hybrid Distillation (ADHD), and Prototype Offset Equilibrium (POE). Flexi-FSCIL effectively balances stability and plasticity in FSCIL. AGRF resolves the rigidity of frozen feature extractors by integrating both frozen and trainable components, enabling adaptive feature learning while retaining old-class knowledge. ADHD tackles the imbalance between old and new tasks by dynamically aligning features using cross-attention maps and direct matching, preserving old-class knowledge while facilitating new-class learning. POE addresses the issue of prototype drift in semi-supervised settings by selecting high-quality unlabeled samples, maintaining feature space separability and preventing overfitting. Evaluated on three benchmark datasets, Flexi-FSCIL achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming existing FSCIL methods with only 12.97 performance drop on CUB200.
authors: Wufei Xie, Yalin Wang, Chenliang Liu, Zhaohui Jiang, Xue Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2451-2460

title: 流概率分割网络
title_en: Flow Stochastic Segmentation Networks
abstract: 我们提出流概率分割网络(Flow-SSN),这是一种用于概率分割的生成模型,具有离散时间自回归和现代连续时间流参数化特征。我们证明了先前方法中低秩参数化的根本性局限性,并展示Flow-SSN能够在不假设秩或存储分布参数的情况下,估计任意高秩的像素级协方差。与标准基于扩散的分割模型相比,Flow-SSN在采样效率方面更具优势,因为模型容量主要分配给学习流的基本分布,这构成了一个表达力强的先验。我们将Flow-SSN应用于具有挑战性的医学影像基准测试,并取得了最先进的结果。
abstract_en: We propose the Flow Stochastic Segmentation Network (Flow-SSN), a generative model for probabilistic segmentation featuring discrete-time autoregressive and modern continuous-time flow parameterisations. We prove fundamental limitations of the low-rank parameterisation of previous methods and show that Flow-SSNs can estimate arbitrarily high-rank pixel-wise covariances without assuming the rank or storing the distributional parameters. Flow-SSNs are also more efficient to sample from than standard diffusion-based segmentation models, as most of the model capacity is allocated to learning the base distribution of the flow, which constitutes an expressive prior. We apply Flow-SSNs to challenging medical imaging benchmarks and achieve state-of-the-art results.
authors: Fabio De Sousa Ribeiro, Omar Todd, Charles Jones, Avinash Kori, Raghav Mehta, Ben Glocker ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14754-14765

title: 流向模式:用于最先进图像分词的模式寻求扩散自编码器
title_en: Flow to the Mode: Mode-Seeking Diffusion Autoencoders for State-of-the-Art Image Tokenization
abstract: 自VQGAN和潜在扩散模型等流行视觉生成框架问世以来,最先进的图像生成系统通常采用两阶段架构:首先将视觉数据压缩或分词至低维潜在空间,随后学习生成模型。分词器训练通常遵循标准流程,通过均方误差(MSE)、感知和对抗性损失的组合对图像进行压缩与重建。先前研究提出扩散自编码器作为端到端感知导向图像压缩的方法,但尚未在ImageNet-1K重建等竞争性任务中展现最先进性能。本文提出FlowMo,一种基于Transformer的扩散自编码器。FlowMo在多种比特率下实现了图像分词的最先进性能。我们无需使用卷积、对抗性损失、空间对齐的2D潜在代码或从其他分词器蒸馏即可达成此目标。我们的核心洞察是FlowMo训练应分为模式匹配预训练阶段和模式寻求后训练阶段。我们进行了广泛的分析与消融实验,并额外在FlowMo分词器基础上训练生成模型以验证性能。论文被接受后,我们将发布代码和模型检查点。
abstract_en: Since the advent of popular visual generation frameworks like VQGAN and Latent Diffusion Models, state-of-the-art image generation systems have generally been two-stage systems that first tokenize or compress visual data into a lower-dimensional latent space before learning a generative model. Tokenizer training typically follows a standard recipe in which images are compressed and reconstructed subject to a combination of MSE, perceptual, and adversarial losses. Diffusion autoencoders have been proposed in prior work as a way to learn end-to-end perceptually-oriented image compression, but have not yet shown state-of-the-art performance on the competitive task of ImageNet-1K reconstruction. In this work, we propose FlowMo, a transformer-based diffusion autoencoder. FlowMo achieves a new state-of-the-art for image tokenization at multiple bitrates. We achieve this without using convolutions, adversarial losses, spatially-aligned 2D latent codes, or distilling from other tokenizers. Our key insight is that FlowMo training should be broken into a mode-matching pre-training stage and a mode-seeking post-training stage. We conduct extensive analysis and ablations, and we additionally train generative models atop the FlowMo tokenizer and verify the performance. We will release our code and model checkpoints upon acceptance.
authors: Kyle Sargent, Kyle Hsu, Justin Johnson, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19471-19481

title: Flow-MIL:利用归一化流构建高表达潜在特征空间进行全切片图像分类
title_en: Flow-MIL: Constructing Highly-expressive Latent Feature Space For Whole Slide Image Classification Using Normalizing Flow
abstract: 全切片图像(WSI)分类在病理诊断和预后预测中被广泛应用,由于WSI的尺寸庞大且细粒度标注获取困难,通常被建模为弱监督多实例学习(MIL)问题。在MIL框架中,将WSI视为一个bag,从其裁剪的patches视为实例。现有方法大多先提取实例特征,再通过基于注意力的机制聚合为bag特征进行bag级预测。这些模型仅使用bag级标签进行训练,常缺乏实例级洞察力并丢失详细语义信息,限制了其bag级分类性能并损害了探索高表达信息的能力。本文提出Flow-MIL,利用基于归一化流的潜在语义嵌入空间(LSES)增强特征表示。通过将patches映射到简单且高表达的潜在空间LSES,Flow-MIL在实现有效slide级聚合的同时保留关键语义信息。我们还在LSES中引入基于高斯混合模型的潜在语义原型(LSP),捕捉每个类别的特异性病理分布并优化伪实例标签。在三个公开WSI数据集上的大量实验表明,Flow-MIL在bag级和实例级分类中均优于近期SOTA方法,并提供了改进的可解释性。
abstract_en: Whole Slide Image (WSI) classification has been widely used in pathological diagnosis and prognosis prediction, and it is commonly formulated as a weakly-supervised Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) problem because of the large size of WSIs and the difficulty of obtaining fine-grained annotations. In the MIL formulation, a WSI is treated as a bag and the patches cut from it are treated as its instances, and most existing methods first extract instance features and then aggregate them into bag feature using attention-based mechanism for bag-level prediction. These models are trained using only bag-level labels, so they often lack instance-level insights and lose detailed semantic information, which limits their bag-level classification performance and damages their ability to explore high-expressive information. In this paper, we propose Flow-MIL, which leverages normalizing flow-based Latent Semantic Embedding Space (LSES) to enhance feature representation. By mapping patches into the simple and highly-expressive latent space LSES, Flow-MIL achieves effective slide-level aggregation while preserving critical semantic information. We also introduce Gaussian Mixture Model-based Latent Semantic Prototypes (LSP) within the LSES to capture class-specific pathological distribution for each class and refine pseudo instance labels. Extensive experiments on three public WSI datasets show that Flow-MIL outperforms recent SOTA methods in both bag-level and instance-level classification and offers improved interpretability.
authors: Yingfan Ma, Bohan An, Ao Shen, Mingzhi Yuan, Minghong Duan, Manning Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23561-23570

title: Flow4Agent: 基于光流运动先验的长视频理解
title_en: Flow4Agent: Long-form Video Understanding via Motion Prior from Optical Flow
abstract: 长视频理解始终是一个具有挑战性的问题,由于时间和空间内容中存在显著的冗余性。这一挑战进一步因多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)的上下文长度有限而加剧。为解决这一问题,许多先前工作尝试提取关键视频信息,其中"关键"通常具有语义感知特性,并严重依赖CLIP模型作为先验。本文提出Flow4Agent,一种新颖框架,首次将光流运动先验纳入LLM-based长视频理解。Flow4Agent通过两个核心模块在时间和空间层面缓解长视频的冗余性:时间粒度优化(TGO)自适应地优化帧级层次结构,首先利用粗粒度光流先验对相似视觉内容进行分组,随后应用语义先验过滤高度不相关的场景信息;运动标记修剪(MTP)进一步优化帧内视觉表示,利用细粒度光流信息修剪高冗余视频标记。大量实验表明,我们的Flow4Agent在多种视频MLLM基准测试中均优于现有方法,特别是在小时级视频理解任务中,分别在Video-MME上达到64.7%、MLVU上达到71.4%、LongVideoBench上达到60.4%。
abstract_en: Long-form video understanding has always been a challenging problem due to the significant redundancy in both temporal and spatial contents. This challenge is further exacerbated by the limited context length of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). To address this issue, many previous works have attempted to extract key video information, where the "key" is typically semantic-aware and heavily dependent on the CLIP model as prior. In this paper, we propose Flow4Agent, a novel framework that pioneeringly incorporates motion priors from optical flow to facilitate LLM-based long video understanding. Flow4Agent mitigates the redundancy in long videos at both temporal and spatial levels through two core modules: Temporal Granularity Optimization (TGO) adaptively refines frame-level hierarchies, which first leverages coarse flow priors to group similar visual contents and then applies semantic priors to filter out highly irrelevant scene information. Motion Token Pruning (MTP) further refines the intra-frame visual representations, pruning high-redundancy video tokens using fine-grained optical flow information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our Flow4Agent outperforms existing methods across a wide range of video MLLM benchmarks, especially for hour-level video understanding tasks, achieving 64.7% on Video-MME, 71.4% on MLVU and 60.4% on LongVideoBench.
authors: Ruyang Liu, Shangkun Sun, Haoran Tang, Wei Gao, Ge Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23817-23827

title: FlowChef: 用于受控生成的修正流模型引导
title_en: FlowChef: Steering of Rectified Flow Models for Controlled Generations
abstract: 尽管修正流模型(RFMs)近期取得了进展,但解锁其在受控生成任务(如逆问题和图像编辑)中的全部潜力仍是一个重大挑战。虽然RFMs和扩散模型(DMs)代表了生成模型领域的最先进的方法,但它们对通过常微分方程求解器和逆向策略进行计算密集型反向传播的依赖,往往会影响效率和精度。在本文中,我们提出了FlowChef,这是一种针对RFMs的新型训练、逆向和无梯度推理时引导策略,能够确定性地引导去噪过程。我们首先从理论和实证角度理解RFMs的向量场动态,以高效引导去噪轨迹。具体而言,利用直线性和平滑雅可比矩阵特性,我们推导出修正流ODE梯度之间的数学关系。我们将理论发现扩展到解决线性逆问题、图像编辑、分类器引导等更多任务。我们进行了广泛的评估,结果表明FlowChef在性能、内存和时间需求方面显著优于基线方法,取得了新的最先进结果。值得注意的是,这是首次能够轻松扩展到十亿参数模型(如Flux)的方案。项目页面: https://flowchef.github.io/
abstract_en: Despite recent advances in Rectified Flow Models (RFMs), unlocking their full potential for controlled generation tasks--such as inverse problems and image editing--remains a significant hurdle. Although RFMs and Diffusion Models (DMs) represent state-of-the-art approaches in generative modeling, their reliance on computationally demanding backpropagation through ODE solvers and inversion strategies often undermines efficiency and precision. In this paper, we present FlowChef, a novel training, inversion, and gradient-free inference-time steering strategy for RFMs that deterministically guides the denoising process. We first develop a theoretical and empirical understanding of the vector-field dynamics of RFMs in efficiently guiding the denoising trajectory. Specifically, leveraging the straightness and smooth Jacobian properties, we derive the mathematical relationship between gradients of rectified flow ODEs. We extend our theoretical findings to solve linear-inverse problems, image editing, classifier guidance, and many more tasks. We perform extensive evaluations and show that FlowChef significantly exceeds baselines in terms of performance, memory, and time requirements, achieving new state-of-the-art results. Remarkably, for the first time, it scales effortlessly to billion-parameter models such as Flux. Project Page: https://flowchef.github.io/
authors: Maitreya Patel, Song Wen, Dimitris N. Metaxas, Yezhou Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15308-15318

title: FlowDPS:流驱动的后验采样方法用于逆问题
title_en: FlowDPS : Flow-Driven Posterior Sampling for Inverse Problems
abstract: 流匹配是一种基于常微分方程(ODE)的最新生成建模框架。尽管与扩散模型密切相关,但它为生成建模提供了更一般的视角。虽然逆问题求解已广泛采用扩散模型进行探索,但尚未在更广泛的流模型框架下进行严格检验。因此,本文将扩散逆求解器(DIS)——通过结合去噪扩散先验与似然梯度进行后验采样——扩展至流框架。具体而言,通过驱动流版本的Tweedie公式,我们将流ODE分解为两个组成部分:一个用于干净图像估计,另一个用于噪声估计。通过分别将似然梯度和随机噪声整合到每个组件中,我们证明了使用流可以有效实现逆问题求解的后验采样。所提出的求解器Flow-Driven Posterior Sampling(FlowDPS)还可无缝集成到具有Transformer架构的潜在流模型中。在四个线性逆问题上,我们验证了FlowDPS在无需额外训练的情况下优于现有最先进方法。
abstract_en: Flow matching is a recent state-of-the-art framework for generative modeling based on ordinary differential equations (ODEs). While closely related to diffusion models, it provides a more general perspective on generative modeling.Although inverse problem solving has been extensively explored using diffusion models, it has not been rigorously examined within the broader context of flow models. Therefore, here we extend the diffusion inverse solvers (DIS)-- which perform posterior sampling by combining a denoising diffusion prior with an likelihood gradient--into the flow framework. Specifically, by driving the flow-version of Tweedie's formula, we decompose the flow ODE into two components: one for clean image estimation and the other for noise estimation.By integrating the likelihood gradient and stochastic noise into each component, respectively, we demonstrate that posterior sampling for inverse problem solving can be effectively achieved using flows. Our proposed solver, Flow-Driven Posterior Sampling (FlowDPS), can also be seamlessly integrated into a latent flow model with a transformer architecture. Across four linear inverse problems, we confirm that FlowDPS outperforms state-of-the-art alternatives, all without requiring additional training.
authors: Jeongsol Kim, Bryan Sangwoo Kim, Jong Chul Ye ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12328-12337

title: FlowEdit:基于文本的无反演编辑方法,使用预训练流模型
title_en: FlowEdit: Inversion-Free Text-Based Editing Using Pre-Trained Flow Models
abstract: 使用预训练的文本到图像(T2I)扩散/流模型编辑真实图像时,通常需要将图像反演为对应的噪声图。然而,仅靠反演本身通常不足以获得令人满意的结果,因此许多方法还会干预采样过程。此类方法虽然取得了更优结果,但无法在不同模型架构间无缝迁移。本文提出FlowEdit,这是一种针对预训练T2I流模型的基于文本的编辑方法,具有无需反演、无需优化和模型无关的特性。我们的方法构建了一个常微分方程(ODE),直接映射源分布与目标分布(对应于源文本提示和目标文本提示),并实现比反演方法更低的传输成本。这使得我们取得了最先进的结果,如在Stable Diffusion 3和FLUX上的实验所示。
abstract_en: Editing real images using a pre-trained text-to-image (T2I) diffusion/flow model often involves inverting the image into its corresponding noise map. However, inversion by itself is typically insufficient for obtaining satisfactory results, and therefore many methods additionally intervene in the sampling process. Such methods achieve improved results but are not seamlessly transferable between model architectures. Here, we introduce FlowEdit, a text-based editing method for pre-trained T2I flow models, which is inversion-free, optimization-free and model agnostic. Our method constructs an ODE that directly maps between the source and target distributions (corresponding to the source and target text prompts) and achieves a lower transport cost than the inversion approach. This leads to state-of-the-art results, as we illustrate with Stable Diffusion 3 and FLUX.
authors: Vladimir Kulikov, Matan Kleiner, Inbar Huberman-Spiegelglas, Tomer Michaeli ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19721-19730

title: FlowR:从稀疏到密集的3D重建
title_en: FlowR: Flowing from Sparse to Dense 3D Reconstructions
abstract: 3D高斯光栅化技术能够在实时帧率下实现高质量的新视角合成(NVS)。然而,当偏离训练视角时,其质量会急剧下降。因此,需要密集采集来满足虚拟现实(VR)等应用对高质量的预期。然而,密集采集非常耗时且成本高昂。现有研究通过蒸馏或生成额外训练视角,尝试利用2D生成模型来缓解这一需求。这些模型通常仅依赖于少量参考输入视角的噪声到数据生成过程,导致幻觉、生成结果不一致以及后续重建伪影。相反,我们提出了一种多视角流匹配模型,该模型学习直接连接稀疏重建生成的新视角渲染与密集重建预期的渲染。这使得能够通过一致生成的视角增强场景采集,从而提升重建质量。我们的模型基于包含360万张图像对的新型数据集进行训练,并可在单个H100 GPU上通过一次前向传播处理最多45个540x960分辨率(9.1万tokens)的视角。我们的流程在稀疏和密集视角场景中均能持续提升NVS性能,在多个广泛使用的NVS基准测试中均优于现有方法。
abstract_en: 3D Gaussian splatting enables high-quality novel view synthesis (NVS) at real-time frame rates. However, its quality drops sharply as we depart from the training views. Thus, dense captures are needed to match the high-quality expectations of applications like Virtual Reality (VR). However, such dense captures are very laborious and expensive to obtain. Existing works have explored using 2D generative models to alleviate this requirement by distillation or generating additional training views. These models typically rely on a noise-to-data generative process conditioned only on a handful of reference input views, leading to hallucinations, inconsistent generation results, and subsequent reconstruction artifacts. Instead, we propose a multi-view, flow matching model that learns a flow to directly connect novel view renderings from possibly sparse reconstructions to renderings that we expect from dense reconstructions. This enables augmenting scene captures with consistent, generated views to improve reconstruction quality. Our model is trained on a novel dataset of 3.6M image pairs and can process up to 45 views at 540x960 resolution (91K tokens) on one H100 GPU in a single forward pass. Our pipeline consistently improves NVS in sparse- and dense-view scenarios, leading to higher-quality reconstructions than prior works across multiple, widely-used NVS benchmarks.
authors: Tobias Fischer, Samuel Rota Bulò, Yung-Hsu Yang, Nikhil Keetha, Lorenzo Porzi, Norman Müller, Katja Schwarz, Jonathon Luiten, Marc Pollefeys, Peter Kontschieder ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27702-27712

title: FlowSeek:基于深度基础模型与运动基元的光流简化方法
title_en: FlowSeek: Optical Flow Made Easier with Depth Foundation Models and Motion Bases
abstract: 我们提出FlowSeek,一种新型光流框架,其训练所需硬件资源极少。FlowSeek结合了光流网络设计空间的最新进展、前沿单图像深度基础模型以及经典低维运动参数化方法,实现了紧凑且精确的架构。FlowSeek仅需单块消费级GPU即可训练,硬件成本约为现有方法的8倍更低,同时在Sintel Final和KITTI数据集上仍实现超越先前最先进方法SEA-RAFT的相对提升10%和15%,并在Spring和LayeredFlow数据集上表现优异。
abstract_en: We present FlowSeek, a novel framework for optical flow requiring minimal hardware resources for training. FlowSeek marries the latest advances on the design space of optical flow networks with cutting-edge single-image depth foundation models and classical low-dimensional motion parametrization, implementing a compact, yet accurate architecture. FlowSeek is trained on a single consumer-grade GPU, a hardware budget about 8x lower compared to most recent methods, and still achieves superior cross-dataset generalization on Sintel Final and KITTI, with a relative improvement of 10 and 15% over the previous state-of-the-art SEA-RAFT, as well as on Spring and LayeredFlow datasets.
authors: Matteo Poggi, Fabio Tosi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5667-5679

title: FlowStyler: 基于变换场传输的艺术视频风格化
title_en: FlowStyler: Artistic Video Stylization via Transformation Fields Transports
abstract: 当前视频风格化方法在实现艺术风格化的同时难以保持时间一致性。基于生成器的方法虽然能产生视觉冲击力强的风格化结果,但在动态运动场景中易出现闪烁伪影,并需要耗费 prohibitive 计算资源。相反,非生成式技术常表现出时间不一致或风格保留不足的问题。我们通过将受物理启发的传输原理从基于传输的神经风格迁移(TNST)框架(最初用于体积流体风格化)引入视频风格化,以强制帧间一致性。我们的框架采用两个互补的变换场实现艺术风格化:一个几何风格化速度场控制形变,一个正交性正则化的颜色传输场管理颜色适应。我们进一步通过两项关键改进强化时间一致性:一种保持动量的策略以缓解振动伪影,以及一种感知遮挡的时间查找策略以解决运动拖影伪影。大量实验表明,FlowStyler在两个维度上均表现出优越性能:与基于生成器的方法相比,我们实现了4倍更低的短期变形误差,同时保持相近的风格保真度;与非生成式方法相比,FlowStyler在略微提升的时间稳定性下实现了22%更高的风格保真度。
abstract_en: Contemporary video stylization approaches struggle to achieve artistic stylization while preserving temporal consistency. While generator-based methods produce visually striking stylized results, they suffer from flickering artifacts in dynamic motion scenarios and require prohibitive computational resources. Conversely, non-generative techniques frequently show either temporal inconsistency or inadequate style preservation.We address these limitations by adapting the physics-inspired transport principles from the Transport-based Neural Style Transfer (TNST) framework (originally developed for volumetric fluid stylization) to enforce inter-frame consistency in video stylization.Our framework employs two complementary transformation fields for artistic stylization: a geometric stylization velocity field governing deformation and an orthogonality-regularized color transfer field managing color adaptations. We further strengthen temporal consistency through two key enhancements to our field architecture: a momentum-preserving strategy mitigating vibration artifacts, and an occlusion-aware temporal lookup strategy addressing motion trailing artifacts. Extensive experiments demonstrate FlowStyler's superior performance across dual dimensions: Compared to generator-based approaches, we achieve 4xlower short-term warping errors, while maintaining comparable style fidelity; Against non-generative methods, FlowStyler attains 22% higher style fidelity with slightly improved temporal stability.
authors: Yuning Gong, Jiaming Chen, Xiaohua Ren, Yuanjun Liao, Yanci Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10229-10238

title: FlowTok:在文本与图像标记间无缝流动
title_en: FlowTok: Flowing Seamlessly Across Text and Image Tokens
abstract: 跨模态生成的核心在于连接不同模态。尽管传统方法将文本模态视为逐步引导从高斯噪声到目标图像模态的条件信号,我们探索了一种更简单的范式——通过流匹配直接在文本与图像模态间演变。这需要将两种模态投影到共享的潜在空间中,但由于其本质不同的表示形式,这带来了显著挑战:文本具有高度语义且编码为1D标记,而图像则具有空间冗余并表示为2D潜在嵌入。为解决这一问题,我们引入了FlowTok,一个最小框架,通过将图像编码为紧凑的1D标记表示,实现文本与图像间的无缝流动。与先前方法相比,该设计在256分辨率下将潜在空间大小减少了3.3倍,消除了对复杂条件机制或噪声调度的需求。此外,FlowTok在相同公式下自然扩展到图像到文本生成。凭借以紧凑1D标记为中心的流线型架构,FlowTok具有高度内存效率,显著减少训练资源需求,并实现更快的采样速度——同时保持与最先进模型相当的性能。代码可在https://github.com/TACJu/FlowTok获取。
abstract_en: Bridging different modalities lies at the heart of cross-modality generation. While conventional approaches treat the text modality as a conditioning signal that gradually guides the denoising process from Gaussian noise to the target image modality, we explore a much simpler paradigm--directly evolving between text and image modalities through flow matching. This requires projecting both modalities into a shared latent space, which poses a significant challenge due to their inherently different representations: text is highly semantic and encoded as 1D tokens, whereas images are spatially redundant and represented as 2D latent embeddings. To address this, we introduce FlowTok, a minimal framework that seamlessly flows across text and images by encoding images into a compact 1D token representation. Compared to prior methods, this design reduces the latent space size by 3.3x at an image resolution of 256, eliminating the need for complex conditioning mechanisms or noise scheduling. Moreover, FlowTok naturally extends to image-to-text generation under the same formulation. With its streamlined architecture centered around compact 1D tokens, FlowTok is highly memory-efficient, requires significantly fewer training resources, and achieves much faster sampling speeds--all while delivering performance comparable to state-of-the-art models. Code is available at https://github.com/TACJu/FlowTok.
authors: Ju He, Qihang Yu, Qihao Liu, Liang-Chieh Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16629-16640

title: 焦平面像素处理器阵列上的视觉特征生成与匹配
title_en: Focal Plane Visual Feature Generation and Matching on a Pixel Processor Array
abstract: 像素处理器阵列(PPAs)是一种视觉传感器,将数据和处理嵌入每个像素单元。PPAs可在光捕获点直接执行视觉处理,仅输出稀疏的高层信息。这与传统视觉流水线形成鲜明对比,传统方式需将完整图像从传感器传输至处理器。这种稀疏数据读出提供了多项主要优势,如更高的帧率、更低的能耗和更小的带宽需求。本工作中,我们展示了基于PPA的二进制描述符生成、匹配和存储方法,无需输出图像至外部处理器,使我们的方法本质上具备隐私保护特性。该方法将描述符分布于多个像素处理器中,使得描述符规模显著大于以往任何像素处理工作。这些大型描述符可用于多种任务,如场景和物体识别。我们在多个数据集上验证了像素内特征匹配的准确性,达到约94.5%的准确率,帧率约为210fps,数据传输和带宽需求较传统相机降低超过100倍。
abstract_en: Pixel Processor Arrays (PPAs) are vision sensors that embed data and processing into every pixel element. PPAs can execute visual processing directly at the point of light capture, and output only sparse, high-level information. This is in sharp contrast with the conventional visual pipeline, where whole images must be transferred from sensor to processor. This sparse data readout also provides several major benefits such as higher frame rate, lower energy consumption and lower bandwidth requirements. In this work, we demonstrate generation, matching and storage of binary descriptors for visual keypoint features, entirely upon PPA with no need to output images to external processing, making our approach inherently privacy-aware.Our method spreads descriptors across multiple pixel-processors, which allows for significantly larger descriptors than any prior pixel-processing works. These large descriptors can be used for a range of tasks such as place and object recognition. We demonstrate the accuracy of our in-pixel feature matching up to  ~94.5%, at ~210fps, across a range of datasets, with a greater than 100xreduction in data transfer and bandwidth requirements over traditional cameras.
authors: Hongyi Zhang, Laurie Bose, Jianing Chen, Piotr Dudek, Walterio Mayol-Cuevas ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 29031-29039

title: FonTS: 基于排版与样式控制的文本渲染
title_en: FonTS: Text Rendering With Typography and Style Controls
abstract: 视觉文本渲染在各类现实应用场景中广泛应用,需要谨慎选择字体和排版方案。近期基于扩散Transformer(DiT)的文本到图像(T2I)模型在自动化这些流程方面展现出前景。然而,这些方法仍面临字体不一致、风格变化和有限的细粒度控制(尤其在单词级别)等挑战。本文提出一种两阶段的DiT基管道,通过增强文本渲染中的排版与样式控制来解决这些问题。我们引入了排版控制微调(TC-FT),一种参数高效的微调方法(仅针对5%关键参数),结合包围排版控制标记(ETC-tokens),实现精确的单词级排版特征应用。为进一步解决文本渲染中的风格不一致性,我们提出了一种文本无关的风格控制适配器(SCA),在防止内容泄露的同时提升风格一致性。为有效实施TC-FT和SCA,我们将HTML渲染整合至数据合成管道,并提出了首个单词级可控数据集。通过全面实验,我们验证了该方法在文本渲染任务中实现优越的单词级排版控制、字体一致性和风格一致性的有效性。项目页面详见此链接。
abstract_en: Visual text rendering are widespread in various real-world applications, requiring careful font selection and typographic choices. Recent progress in diffusion transformer (DiT)-based text-to-image (T2I) models show promise in automating these processes. However, these methods still encounter challenges like inconsistent fonts, style variation, and limited fine-grained control, particularly at the word-level. This paper proposes a two-stage DiT-based pipeline to address these problems by enhancing controllability over typography and style in text rendering. We introduce typography control fine-tuning (TC-FT), an parameter-efficient fine-tuning method (on 5% key parameters) with enclosing typography control tokens (ETC-tokens), which enables precise word-level application of typographic features. To further address style inconsistency in text rendering, we propose a text-agnostic style control adapter (SCA) that prevents content leakage while enhancing style consistency. To implement TC-FT and SCA effectively, we incorporated HTML-render into the data synthesis pipeline and proposed the first word-level controllable dataset. Through comprehensive experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in achieving superior word-level typographic control, font consistency, and style consistency in text rendering tasks. Our project page is available at this site.
authors: Wenda Shi, Yiren Song, Dengming Zhang, Jiaming Liu, Xingxing Zou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18463-18474

title: FontAnimate: 通过动画字体迁移过程实现高质量少样本字体生成
title_en: FontAnimate: High Quality Few-shot Font Generation via Animating Font Transfer Process
abstract: 少样本字体生成(FFG)旨在通过模仿有限参考图像的风格来创建新字体图像,同时保持源图像的内容。尽管该任务已取得显著进展,但大多数现有方法仍存在复杂字符结构和详细字体风格生成错误的问题。为解决上述问题,本文将字体生成视为从源字体到目标字体的迁移过程,并构建视频生成框架来建模这一过程。此外,进一步开发了测试时条件对齐机制,以增强生成样本与提供的条件样本之间的一致性。具体而言,我们首先构建了一个基于扩散的图像到图像字体生成框架,用于少样本字体生成任务。通过整合时间组件和帧索引信息,该框架扩展为图像到视频的字体生成框架,从而生成从源字体到目标字体的高质量字体视频。基于此框架,我们在生成过程中开发了噪声反转机制,以在生成样本与提供的条件样本之间进行内容和风格对齐,提升风格一致性和结构准确性。实验结果表明,我们的模型在FFG任务中表现出优越的性能,验证了方法的有效性。我们将在发表后发布代码。
abstract_en: Few-shot font generation (FFG) aims to create new font images by imitating the style from a limited set of reference images, while maintaining the content from the source images. Although this task has achieved significant progress, most existing methods still suffer from the incorrect generation of complicated character structure and detailed font style. To address the above issues, in this paper, we regard font generation as a font transfer process from the source font to the target font, and construct a video generation framework to model this process. Moreover, a test-time condition alignment mechanism is further developed to enhance the consistency between the generated samples and the provided condition samples. Specifically, we first construct a diffusion-based image-to-image font generation framework for the few-shot font generation task. This framework is expanded into an image-to-video font generation framework by integrating temporal components and frame-index information, enabling the production of high-quality font videos that transition from the source font to the target font. Based on this framework, we develop a noise inversion mechanism in the generative process to perform content and style alignment between the generated samples and the provided condition samples, enhancing style consistency and structural accuracy. The experimental results show that our model achieves superior performance on FFG tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of our method. We will release our code after publication.
authors: Bin Fu, Zixuan Wang, Kainan Yan, Shitian Zhao, Qi Qin, Jie Wen, Junjun He, Peng Gao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16015-16025

title: 面向前景的文档图像校正网络(ForCenNet)
title_en: ForCenNet: Foreground-Centric Network for Document Image Rectification
abstract: 文档图像校正旨在消除拍摄文档中的几何变形,以促进文本识别。然而,现有方法往往忽视前景元素的重要性,这些元素为文档图像校正提供了关键的几何参考和布局信息。在本文中,我们引入面向前景的网络(ForCenNet)以消除文档图像中的几何畸变。具体而言,我们首先提出一种面向前景的标签生成方法,从未畸变图像中提取详细的前景元素。随后,我们引入面向前景的掩码机制以增强可读区域与背景区域的区分度。此外,我们设计了一种曲率一致性损失,利用详细的前景标签帮助模型理解畸变的几何分布。大量实验表明,ForCenNet在四个现实世界基准数据集(如DocUNet、DIR300、WarpDoc和DocReal)上达到了新的最先进水平。定量分析表明,所提出的方法有效校正了布局元素,如文本行和表格边框。进一步比较的资源可在https://github.com/caipeng328/ForCenNet获取。
abstract_en: Document image rectification aims to eliminate geometric deformation in photographed documents to facilitate text recognition. However, existing methods often neglect the significance of foreground elements, which provide essential geometric references and layout information for document image correction. In this paper, we introduce Foreground-Centric Network(ForCenNet) to eliminate geometric distortions in document images. Specifically, we initially propose a foreground-centric label generation method, which extracts detailed foreground elements from an undistorted image. Then we introduce a foreground-centric mask mechanism to enhance the distinction between readable and background regions. Furthermore, we design a curvature consistency loss to leverage the detailed foreground labels to help the model understand the distorted geometric distribution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ForCenNet achieves new state-of-the-art on four real-world benchmarks, such as DocUNet, DIR300, WarpDoc, and DocReal. Quantitative analysis shows that the proposed method effectively undistorts layout elements, such as text lines and table borders. The resources for further comparison are provided at https://github.com/caipeng328/ForCenNet.
authors: Peng Cai, Qiang Li, Kaicheng Yang, Dong Guo, Jia Li, Nan Zhou, Xiang An, Ninghua Yang, Jiankang Deng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15137-15146

title: ForeSight:多视角流式联合目标检测与轨迹预测
title_en: ForeSight: Multi-View Streaming Joint Object Detection and Trajectory Forecasting
abstract: 我们介绍了ForeSight,一种用于自动驾驶车辆基于视觉的三维感知的新型联合检测与预测框架。传统方法将检测和预测视为独立的序列任务,限制了其利用时间线索的能力。ForeSight通过多任务流式和双向学习方法解决这一限制,使检测和预测能够共享查询内存并无缝传播信息。预测感知检测变换器通过整合多假设预测内存队列中的轨迹预测来增强空间推理,而流式预测变换器则利用过去的预测和优化的检测结果来提升时间一致性。与基于跟踪的方法不同,ForeSight消除了对显式目标关联的需求,通过无跟踪模型减少误差传播,并在多帧序列中高效扩展。在nuScenes数据集上的实验表明,ForeSight实现了最先进的性能,EPA达到54.9%,比之前的方法高出9.3%,同时在多视角检测和预测模型中取得了最佳的mAP和minADE。
abstract_en: We introduce ForeSight, a novel joint detection and forecasting framework for vision-based 3D perception in autonomous vehicles. Traditional approaches treat detection and forecasting as separate sequential tasks, limiting their ability to leverage temporal cues. ForeSight addresses this limitation with a multi-task streaming and bidirectional learning approach, allowing detection and forecasting to share query memory and propagate information seamlessly. The forecast-aware detection transformer enhances spatial reasoning by integrating trajectory predictions from a multiple hypothesis forecast memory queue, while the streaming forecast transformer improves temporal consistency using past forecasts and refined detections. Unlike tracking-based methods, ForeSight eliminates the need for explicit object association, reducing error propagation with a tracking-free model that efficiently scales across multi-frame sequences. Experiments on the nuScenes dataset show that ForeSight achieves state-of-the-art performance, achieving an EPA of 54.9%, surpassing previous methods by 9.3%, while also attaining the best mAP and minADE among multi-view detection and forecasting models.
authors: Sandro Papais, Letian Wang, Brian Cheong, Steven L. Waslander ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25474-25484

title: 在SO(3)中预测连续非保守动力系统
title_en: Forecasting Continuous Non-Conservative Dynamical Systems in SO(3)
abstract: 建模运动物体的旋转是计算机视觉中的基础任务,但SO(3)外推仍面临诸多挑战:(1) 未知量(如惯性矩)使动力学复杂化,(2) 外部力和力矩的存在可能导致非保守运动学,(3) 在稀疏、噪声观测下估计演化状态轨迹需要鲁棒性。我们提出通过神经控制微分方程引导的SO(3) Savitzky-Golay路径,在三维旋转流形上以物理和几何意义的方式建模噪声姿态估计的轨迹。现有外推方法常依赖能量守恒或恒定速度假设,限制了其在涉及非保守力的真实场景中的适用性。相比之下,我们的方法不依赖能量和动量守恒,同时对输入噪声具有鲁棒性,适用于复杂非惯性系统。该方法可轻松集成到现有流程中,并能良好泛化到具有未知物理参数的轨迹。通过训练从噪声状态中学习近似物体动力学,我们的模型在仿真和多种真实场景中实现了鲁棒的外推能力。
abstract_en: Modeling the rotation of moving objects is a fundamental task in computer vision, yet SO(3) extrapolation still presents numerous challenges: (1) unknown quantities such as the moment of inertia complicate dynamics, (2) the presence of external forces and torques can lead to non-conservative kinematics, and (3) estimating evolving state trajectories under sparse, noisy observations requires robustness. We propose modeling trajectories of noisy pose estimates on the manifold of 3D rotations in a physically and geometrically meaningful way by leveraging Neural Controlled Differential Equations guided with SO(3) Savitzky-Golay paths. Existing extrapolation methods often rely on energy conservation or constant velocity assumptions, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios involving non-conservative forces. In contrast, our approach is agnostic to energy and momentum conservation while being robust to input noise, making it applicable to complex, non-inertial systems. Our approach is easily integrated as a module in existing pipelines and generalizes well to trajectories with unknown physical parameters. By learning to approximate object dynamics from noisy states during training, our model attains robust extrapolation capabilities in simulation and various real-world settings.
authors: Lennart Bastian, Mohammad Rashed, Nassir Navab, Tolga Birdal ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14845-14855

title: Forensic-MoE: 探索基于专家混合的综合合成图像检测痕迹
title_en: Forensic-MoE: Exploring Comprehensive Synthetic Image Detection Traces with Mixture of Experts
abstract: 近年来,随着生成技术的发展,合成图像已发展出极其逼真的特性。为避免虚假信息的传播并识别合成内容,合成图像检测研究变得尤为迫切。然而,现有方法受限于单一的法医视角,难以充分探索多样化的合成技术所留下的痕迹。为此,我们认为不同合成图像包含多种检测痕迹,通过多个专家从不同视角探索这些痕迹将具有显著优势。因此,我们提出了一种新型检测器,名为Forensic-MoE,其核心是多专家混合架构。为整合多个专家并增强知识交互,Forensic-MoE采用适配器-主干架构。具体而言,多个在不同合成图像上训练的适配器作为痕迹探索专家,并统一集成到预训练主干模型中,以学习检测先验并促进专家交互。通过引导多个专家相互对齐与协作,Forensic-MoE能够从多视角整合全面且具有判别性的检测痕迹。此外,为提升每个专家的判别能力,提出了一种多阶段结构以实现高效的痕迹感知,并采用块解耦策略鼓励模型关注每个局部区域。代码将开源于https://github.com/fangmq77/Forensic-MoE
abstract_en: Recently, synthetic images have evolved incredibly realistic with the development of generative techniques. To avoid the spread of misinformation and identify synthetic content, research on synthetic image detection becomes urgent. Unfortunately, limited to the singular forensic perspective, existing methods struggle to explore sufficient traces encountered with diverse synthetic techniques. In response to this, we argue that different synthetic images encompass a variety of forensic traces, and utilizing multiple experts to explore traces from diverse perspectives will be beneficial. Accordingly, a novel detector with the Mixture of multiple forensic Experts is proposed, named Forensic-MoE. To integrate multiple experts and enhance the knowledge interaction, Forensic-MoE follows an adapter-backbone architecture. Specifically, multiple adapters trained on different synthetic images serve as the trace exploration experts, and they are uniformly integrated into a pretrained backbone model to learn the detection prior and encourage the expert interaction. By guiding multiple experts to align with each other and collaborate, Forensic-MoE can integrate comprehensive and discriminative detection traces from multiple perspectives. Moreover, for the discrimination improvement of each expert, a multi-stage structure is proposed for efficient trace perception, and a patch decentralization strategy is applied to encourage the model's attention on every local region. Code will be available in https://github.com/fangmq77/Forensic-MoE
authors: Mingqi Fang, Ziguang Li, Lingyun Yu, Quanwei Yang, Hongtao Xie, Yongdong Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17772-17782

title: 动态前瞻:通过奖励启发式方法强化轨迹预测
title_en: Foresight in Motion: Reinforcing Trajectory Prediction with Reward Heuristics
abstract: 道路交通代理的运动预测既是对自动驾驶系统安全性的重大挑战,也是关键需求。与大多数直接预测未来轨迹的数据驱动方法不同,我们从规划视角重新思考这一任务,倡导"先推理后预测"的策略,将行为意图作为轨迹预测的空间引导。为此,我们引入了一种可解释的、基于奖励的意图推理器,其建立在新颖的以查询为中心的逆强化学习(Inverse Reinforcement Learning, IRL)方案基础上。我们的方法首先将交通代理和场景元素编码为统一的向量表示,然后通过以查询为中心的范式聚合上下文特征。这使得能够通过IRL推导出奖励分布,即在给定场景上下文中目标代理行为的紧凑且信息丰富的表示。在奖励启发式的指导下,我们执行策略展开以推理多种可能的意图,为后续轨迹生成提供有价值的先验信息。最后,我们开发了一个集成双向选择状态空间模型的分层DETR-like解码器,以生成准确的未来轨迹及其关联概率。在大规模Argoverse和nuScenes运动预测数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法显著提升了轨迹预测置信度,在与最先进方法的对比中表现出高度竞争力。
abstract_en: Motion forecasting for on-road traffic agents presents both a significant challenge and a critical necessity for ensuring safety in autonomous driving systems. In contrast to most existing data-driven approaches that directly predict future trajectories, we rethink this task from a planning perspective, advocating a "First Reasoning, Then Forecasting" strategy that explicitly incorporates behavior intentions as spatial guidance for trajectory prediction. To achieve this, we introduce an interpretable, reward-driven intention reasoner grounded in a novel query-centric Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) scheme. Our method first encodes traffic agents and scene elements into a unified vectorized representation, then aggregates contextual features through a query-centric paradigm. This enables the derivation of a reward distribution, a compact yet informative representation of the target agent's behavior within the given scene context via IRL. Guided by this reward heuristic, we perform policy rollouts to reason about multiple plausible intentions, providing valuable priors for subsequent trajectory generation. Finally, we develop a hierarchical DETR-like decoder integrated with bidirectional selective state space models to produce accurate future trajectories along with their associated probabilities. Extensive experiments on the large-scale Argoverse and nuScenes motion forecasting datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances trajectory prediction confidence, achieving highly competitive performance relative to state-of-the-art methods.
authors: Muleilan Pei, Shaoshuai Shi, Xuesong Chen, Xu Liu, Shaojie Shen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28303-28312

title: ForestFormer3D:一种用于森林LiDAR三维点云端到端分割的统一框架
title_en: ForestFormer3D: A Unified Framework for End-to-End Segmentation of Forest LiDAR 3D Point Clouds
abstract: 森林LiDAR三维点云的分割,包括单株树木分割和语义分割,是推进森林管理和生态研究的基础。然而,现有方法往往难以应对自然森林环境的复杂性和多样性。我们提出ForestFormer3D,一种新的统一且端到端框架,旨在实现精确的单株树木和语义分割。ForestFormer3D结合了ISA引导的查询点选择、推理过程中的基于分数的块合并策略以及用于有效训练的一对多关联机制。通过结合这些新组件,我们的模型在新引入的涵盖多种森林类型和地区的FOR-instanceV2数据集上实现了单株树木分割的最先进性能。此外,ForestFormer3D在未见过的测试集(Wytham woods和LAUTx)上泛化能力良好,展示了其在不同森林条件和传感器模态下的鲁棒性。FOR-instanceV2数据集和ForestFormer3D代码已公开,可在https://bxiang233.github.io/FF3D/获取。
abstract_en: The segmentation of forest LiDAR 3D point clouds, including both individual tree and semantic segmentation, is fundamental for advancing forest management and ecological research. However, current approaches often struggle with the complexity and variability of natural forest environments. We present ForestFormer3D, a new unified and end-to-end framework designed for precise individual tree and semantic segmentation. ForestFormer3D incorporates ISA-guided query point selection, a score-based block merging strategy during inference, and a one-to-many association mechanism for effective training. By combining these new components, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance for individual tree segmentation on the newly introduced FOR-instanceV2 dataset, which spans diverse forest types and regions. Additionally, ForestFormer3D generalizes well to unseen test sets (Wytham woods and LAUTx), showcasing its robustness across different forest conditions and sensor modalities. The FOR-instanceV2 dataset and the ForestFormer3D code are publicly available at https://bxiang233.github.io/FF3D/.
authors: Binbin Xiang, Maciej Wielgosz, Stefano Puliti, Kamil Král, Martin Krůček, Azim Missarov, Rasmus Astrup ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24717-24727

title: ForgeLens:面向可泛化伪造图像检测的数据高效伪造聚焦
title_en: ForgeLens: Data-Efficient Forgery Focus for Generalizable Forgery Image Detection
abstract: 生成模型的兴起引发了对网络图像真实性的担忧,凸显了开发一种检测器的迫切需求,该检测器需满足(1)高度可泛化,能够处理未见过的伪造技术,以及(2)数据高效,以最小的训练数据实现最优性能,从而有效应对新兴的伪造技术。为实现这一目标,我们提出ForgeLens,一种数据高效的特征引导框架,通过两个轻量级设计使冻结网络能够聚焦于伪造特定特征。首先,我们引入权重共享引导模块(WSGM),在训练过程中引导提取伪造特定特征。其次,采用伪造感知特征集成器FAFormer,有效整合多阶段特征中的伪造信息。ForgeLens解决了先前基于冻结网络方法的关键局限性,即从大规模数据集中提取的通用特征往往包含过多与伪造无关的信息。因此,它在极小训练数据下实现了强大的泛化能力并达到最优性能。在包括GANs和扩散模型在内的19种生成模型上的实验结果表明,与基线模型相比,Avg.Acc和Avg.AP分别提升了13.61%和8.69%。值得注意的是,ForgeLens在仅使用1%训练数据的情况下超越了现有伪造检测方法,取得了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: The rise of generative models has raised concerns about image authenticity online, highlighting the urgent need for a detector that is (1) highly generalizable, capable of handling unseen forgery techniques, and (2) data-efficient, achieving optimal performance with minimal training data, enabling it to counter newly emerging forgery techniques effectively. To achieve this, we propose ForgeLens, a data-efficient, feature-guided framework that incorporates two lightweight designs to enable a frozen network to focus on forgery-specific features. First, we introduce the Weight-Shared Guidance Module (WSGM), which guides the extraction of forgery-specific features during training. Second, a forgery-aware feature integrator, FAFormer, is used to effectively integrate forgery information across multi-stage features. ForgeLens addresses a key limitation of previous frozen network-based methods, where general-purpose features extracted from large datasets often contain excessive forgery-irrelevant information. As a result, it achieves strong generalization and reaches optimal performance with minimal training data. Experimental results on 19 generative models, including both GANs and diffusion models, demonstrate improvements of 13.61% in Avg.Acc and 8.69% in Avg.AP over the base model. Notably, ForgeLens outperforms existing forgery detection methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance with just 1% of the training data.
authors: Yingjian Chen, Lei Zhang, Yakun Niu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16270-16280

title: 通过转换实现遗忘:基于类感知表示转换的联邦遗忘方法
title_en: Forgetting Through Transforming: Enabling Federated Unlearning via Class-Aware Representation Transformation
abstract: 联邦遗忘(FU)应满足三个关键要求:数据擦除保证、模型效用保持以及遗忘时间减少。近期研究主要聚焦于识别并修改与遗忘数据相关的原始模型参数。虽然这些方法能够实现更快的遗忘,但会降低模型在剩余数据上的性能,或因难以隔离遗忘数据的特定参数而无法彻底遗忘。通过重新审视最优遗忘模型(即重新训练模型)的表示分布,我们观察到遗忘数据倾向于在剩余数据的语义相关类别中聚集。这启发我们通过将遗忘数据的分布转换并与剩余数据中的相似类别融合,以实现有效的联邦遗忘。基于这一洞察,我们提出了一种名为FUCRT的新框架,通过类感知表示转换实现联邦遗忘。FUCRT包含两个关键组件:(1) 一种利用原始模型识别遗忘数据合适转换类别的转换类别识别策略(TCI),以及(2) 一种具有跨类融合机制的定向转换学习过程(TTL),以确保有效且一致的转换。在四个数据集上的大量实验表明,FUCRT不仅实现了100%的数据擦除,还在IID和Non-IID设置下,分别以平均2.96%和3.78%的效用保持优势超越现有最先进方法。此外,它将遗忘时间减少了19.13%~96.38%。代码库位于https://github.com/zhentian777/FUCRT。
abstract_en: Federated Unlearning (FU) should satisfy three key requirements: a guarantee of data erasure, preservation of model utility, and reduction of unlearning time. Recent studies focus on identifying and modifying original model parameters relevant to unlearning data. While they can achieve faster unlearning, they degrade the model performance on remaining data or fail to forget unlearning data due to the difficulty in isolating specific parameters of the unlearning data. By revisiting the representation distribution of the optimal unlearning models (i.e., the retrained models), we observe that unlearning data tends to cluster within semantically related categories of remaining data. This inspired us to transform the distribution of unlearning data to fuse with similar categories in the remaining data for effective FU. Based on this insight, we propose a novel framework, named FUCRT, to achieve Federated Unlearning via Class-aware Representation Transformation. FUCRT consists of two key components: (1) a transformation class identification strategy (TCI) that leverages the original model to identify appropriate transformation classes for unlearning data, and (2) a targeted transformation learning process (TTL) with cross-class fusion mechanism to ensure effective and consistent transformation. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate that FUCRT not only achieves 100% of data erasure but also outperforms state-of-the-art methods by an average of 2.96% and 3.78% in utility preservation under IID and Non-IID settings, respectively. Moreover, it reduces unlearning time by 19.13%~ 96.38%. Codes are at https://github.com/zhentian777/FUCRT.
authors: Qi Guo, Zhen Tian, Minghao Yao, Saiyu Qi, Yong Qi, Bingyi Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1474-1483

title: FoundIR:释放百万级训练数据以推进图像修复的基础模型
title_en: FoundIR: Unleashing Million-scale Training Data to Advance Foundation Models for Image Restoration
abstract: 尽管一体化模型在通用图像修复领域取得了显著进展,但现有方法在现实场景中仍面临泛化瓶颈,因为它们主要基于小规模合成数据集进行训练,且降质类型有限。因此,迫切需要大规模高质量的现实训练数据以推动图像修复基础模型的发展。为推进该领域,我们贡献了一个百万级数据集,其相较现有训练数据具有两个显著优势:更大规模的现实样本和更高多样性数据类型。通过调整内部相机参数和外部成像条件,我们利用精心设计的数据采集系统及数据对齐准则,在多轮采集中获取对齐图像对。此外,我们提出鲁棒模型FoundIR,以更好地应对现实场景中更广泛的修复任务,进一步向基础模型迈进。具体而言,我们首先利用基于扩散的通用模型,通过学习多样输入中的退化无关通用表示来去除退化,采用增量学习策略以更好地指导模型训练。为提升模型在复杂场景下的修复能力,我们引入退化感知的专用模型以实现最终高质量结果。大量实验验证了我们数据集的价值和方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Despite the significant progress made by all-in-one models in universal image restoration, existing methods suffer from a generalization bottleneck in real-world scenarios, as they are mostly trained on small-scale synthetic datasets with limited degradations. Therefore, large-scale high-quality real-world training data is urgently needed to facilitate the emergence of foundation models for image restoration. To advance this field, we spare no effort in contributing a million-scale dataset with two notable advantages over existing training data: larger-scale real-world samples, and higher-diversity data types. By adjusting internal camera settings and external imaging conditions, we can capture aligned image pairs using our well-designed data acquisition system over multiple rounds and our data alignment criterion. Moreover, we propose a robust model, FoundIR, to better address a broader range of restoration tasks in real-world scenarios, taking a further step toward foundation models. Specifically, we first utilize a diffusion-based generalist model to remove degradations by learning the degradation-agnostic common representations from diverse inputs, where incremental learning strategy is adopted to better guide model training. To refine the model's restoration capability in complex scenarios, we introduce degradation-aware specialist models for achieving final high-quality results. Extensive experiments show the value of our dataset and the effectiveness of our method.
authors: Hao Li, Xiang Chen, Jiangxin Dong, Jinhui Tang, Jinshan Pan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12626-12636

title: FrameFusion:结合相似性与重要性进行大视觉语言模型中的视频标记缩减
title_en: FrameFusion: Combining Similarity and Importance for Video Token Reduction on Large Vision Language Models
abstract: 随着对长时序和高分辨率视频处理需求的增加,大视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)因视觉标记数量庞大而面临显著负担。现有标记缩减方法主要基于重要性指标(如累积注意力分数)进行标记剪枝。然而,即使重要标记也可能因相邻视频帧间的相似性及重复视觉元素而产生高冗余。为解决这一局限,我们提出FrameFusion,一种融合基于相似性合并与基于重要性剪枝的新型标记缩减方法。我们对标记相似性特征进行深入研究,揭示三个关键发现:(1)相邻帧间空间对应的视觉标记具有比其他标记对更高的余弦相似度;(2)高标记相似度在模型深层显著降低;(3)标记相似度排名在不同层间高度一致。基于这些观察,FrameFusion仅计算相邻帧对应视觉标记间的相似度,先在初始连续层进行标记合并,随后在深层进行剪枝,并采用级联合并策略进一步提升效率。我们在涵盖视频检索、问答及时空理解任务的五个视频基准测试中,对参数范围从2B到72B的六个多样化LVLMs进行全面评估。实验表明,FrameFusion可将视觉标记减少70%,实现1.6-3.6倍端到端加速,平均性能损失低于3%。我们的代码已开源:https://github.com/thu-nics/FrameFusion
abstract_en: The increasing demand to process long and high-resolution videos significantly burdens Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) due to the enormous number of visual tokens. Existing token reduction methods primarily prune tokens based on importance metrics, such as cumulative attention scores. However, even important tokens may exhibit high redundancy caused by similarity among adjacent video frames and repetitive visual elements. To address this limitation, we propose FrameFusion, a novel token reduction approach integrating similarity-based merging with importance-based pruning. We conduct a thorough study on token similarity characteristics, revealing three key insights: (1) spatially corresponding visual tokens between adjacent frames have higher cosine similarities compared to other token pairs; (2) high token similarities prominently decrease in deeper model layers; and (3) token similarity rankings are highly consistent across different layers. Guided by these observations, FrameFusion computes token similarities exclusively between corresponding visual tokens from adjacent frames, applies token merging at initial successive layers followed by pruning in deeper layers, and adopts a cascaded merging strategy to further enhance efficiency. We evaluate FrameFusion comprehensively across six diverse LVLMs, ranging from 2B to 72B parameters, using five video benchmarks encompassing video retrieval, question-answering, and spatial-temporal understanding tasks. Experiments show that FrameFusion reduces visual tokens by 70%, achieving 1.6-3.6x end-to-end speedups, with an average performance impact of less than 3%. Our code is available at: https://github.com/thu-nics/FrameFusion.
authors: Tianyu Fu, Tengxuan Liu, Qinghao Han, Guohao Dai, Shengen Yan, Huazhong Yang, Xuefei Ning, Yu Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22654-22663

title: FramePainter: 为交互式图像编辑赋予视频扩散先验
title_en: FramePainter: Endowing Interactive Image Editing with Video Diffusion Priors
abstract: 交互式图像编辑允许用户通过绘制、点击和拖拽等视觉交互操作修改图像。现有方法从视频中构建此类监督信号,因为视频能够捕捉物体在不同物理交互下的变化过程。然而,这些模型通常基于文本到图像扩散模型,因此要么依赖缓慢的优化推理,要么需要(i)大量训练样本和(ii)额外的参考编码器以学习现实动态和视觉一致性。本文将该任务重新表述为图像到视频生成问题,从而继承强大的视频扩散先验以降低训练成本并确保时间一致性。具体而言,我们引入FramePainter作为该表述的高效实现。其以Stable Video Diffusion初始化,仅使用轻量级稀疏控制编码器注入编辑信号。考虑到时间注意力在处理两帧间大运动时的局限性,我们进一步提出匹配注意力机制,以扩大感受野并鼓励编辑图像与源图像标记之间的密集对应关系。我们展示了FramePainter在多种编辑信号下的有效性与效率:其在远少训练数据的情况下显著优于先前最先进方法,实现高度无缝且连贯的图像编辑,例如自动调整杯子的反光。此外,FramePainter在现实视频中未出现的场景中也展现出卓越的泛化能力,例如将小丑鱼转化为鲨鱼形态。我们的代码可在https://github.com/YBYBZhang/FramePainter获取。
abstract_en: Interactive image editing allows users to modify images through visual interaction operations such as drawing, clicking, and dragging. Existing methods construct such supervision signals from videos, as they capture how objects change with various physical interactions. However, these models are usually built upon text-to-image diffusion models, so they either rely on slow optimization-based inference, or necessitate (i) massive training samples and (ii) an additional reference encoder to learn real-world dynamics and visual consistency. In this paper, we reformulate this task as an image-to-video generation problem, so that inherit powerful video diffusion priors to reduce training costs and ensure temporal consistency. Specifically, we introduce FramePainter as an efficient instantiation of this formulation. Initialized with Stable Video Diffusion, it only uses a lightweight sparse control encoder to inject editing signals. Considering the limitations of temporal attention in handling large motion between two frames, we further propose matching attention to enlarge the receptive field while encouraging dense correspondence between edited and source image tokens. We highlight the effectiveness and efficiency of FramePainter across various of editing signals: it domainantly outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods with far less training data, achieving highly seamless and coherent editing of images, e.g., automatically adjust the reflection of the cup. Moreover, FramePainter also exhibits exceptional generalization in scenarios not present in real-world videos, e.g., transform the clownfish into shark-like shape. Our code is available at https://github.com/YBYBZhang/FramePainter.
authors: Yabo Zhang, Xinpeng Zhou, Yihan Zeng, Hang Xu, Hui Li, Wangmeng Zuo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18121-18131

title: 自由形式运动控制:在视频生成中控制相机和物体的六自由度位姿
title_en: Free-Form Motion Control: Controlling the 6D Poses of Camera and Objects in Video Generation
abstract: 在生成视频中控制动态物体和相机的运动是一项有意义但具有挑战性的任务。由于缺乏包含全面六自由度位姿标注的数据集,现有文本到视频方法无法以三维感知方式同时控制相机和物体的运动,导致生成内容的可控性受限。为解决这一问题并促进该领域研究,我们引入了一个用于自由形式运动控制的合成数据集(SynFMC)。所提出的SynFMC数据集包含多样化的物体和环境类别,根据特定规则覆盖各种运动模式,模拟常见且复杂的现实场景。完整的六自由度位姿信息有助于模型学习分离视频中物体和相机的运动效果。为进一步实现精确的三维感知运动控制,我们提出了一种在SynFMC上训练的方法——自由形式运动控制(FMC)。FMC可独立或同时控制物体和相机的六自由度位姿,生成高保真度视频。此外,它兼容多种个性化文本到图像(T2I)模型,适用于不同内容风格。大量实验表明,所提出的FMC在多个场景中均优于先前方法。
abstract_en: Controlling the movements of dynamic objects and the camera within generated videos is a meaningful yet challenging task. Due to the lack of datasets with comprehensive 6D pose annotations, existing text-to-video methods can not simultaneously control the motions of both camera and objects in 3D-aware manner, resulting in limited controllability over generated contents. To address this issue and facilitate the research in this field, we introduce a Synthetic Dataset for Free-Form Motion Control (SynFMC). The proposed SynFMC dataset includes diverse object and environment categories and covers various motion patterns according to specific rules, simulating common and complex real-world scenarios. The complete 6D pose information facilitates models learning to disentangle the motion effects from objects and the camera in a video. To provide precise 3D-aware motion control, we further propose a method trained on SynFMC, Free-Form Motion Control (FMC). FMC can control the 6D poses of objects and camera independently or simultaneously, producing high-fidelity videos. Moreover, it is compatible with various personalized text-to-image (T2I) models for different content styles. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed FMC outperforms previous methods across multiple scenarios.
authors: Xincheng Shuai, Henghui Ding, Zhenyuan Qin, Hao Luo, Xingjun Ma, Dacheng Tao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12449-12458

title: Free-MoRef:在单次推理中即时复用视频MLLM的上下文感知能力
title_en: Free-MoRef: Instantly Multiplexing Context Perception Capabilities of Video-MLLMs within Single Inference
abstract: 视频多模态大语言模型(Video-MLLM)在视频理解任务中取得了显著进展。然而,受限于底层大语言模型的上下文长度限制,现有Video-MLLM通常在长视频场景中表现出次优性能。为理解扩展输入帧,常见方案包括令牌压缩和流式推理技术,这些方法会牺牲特征粒度或推理效率。不同地,为高效实现对更长帧输入的全面理解,我们借鉴MoE思想,提出无需训练的Free-MoRef方法,该方法可在单次推理中即时复用视频MLLM的上下文感知能力。具体而言,Free-MoRef将视觉令牌重构为多个短序列作为多参考。随后,我们引入MoRef-attention,通过并行聚合多参考块中的线索,总结统一的查询激活。在LLM的阴影层之后,推导出参考融合步骤,将并行块中的关键令牌组合成最终的混合推理序列,补偿MoRef-attention中被忽略的跨参考视觉交互。通过分割和融合长视觉令牌序列,Free-MoRef在推理复用上下文长度时实现了显著的性能提升,且计算成本大幅降低,展现出强大的效率和效果。在VideoMME、MLVU、LongVideoBench上的实验表明,Free-MoRef在单块A100 GPU上无需压缩即可实现2x至8x更长输入帧的完整感知,同时保持即时响应,从而带来显著的性能增益,甚至超越专门训练的长视频MLLM。代码可在https://github.com/wkfdb/Free-MoRef获取
abstract_en: Video Multimodal Large Language Models (Video-MLLM) have achieved remarkable advancements in video understanding tasks. However, constrained by the context length limitation in the underlying LLMs, existing Video-MLLMs typically exhibit suboptimal performance on long video scenarios. To understand extended input frames, common solutions span token compression and streaming inference techniques, which sacrifice feature granularity or inference efficiency. Differently, to efficiently achieve comprehensive understanding of longer frame inputs, we draw ideas from MoE and propose a training-free approach Free-MoRef, which instantly multiplexes the context perception capabilities of Video-MLLMs within one inference pass. Specifically, Free-MoRef reconstructs the vision tokens into several short sequences as multi-references. Subsequently, we introduce MoRef-attention, which gathers clues from the multi-reference chunks in parallel to summarize unified query activations. After the shadow layers in LLMs, a reference fusion step is derived to compose a final mixed reasoning sequence with key tokens from parallel chunks, which compensates the cross-reference vision interactions that are neglected in MoRef-attention. By splitting and fusing the long vision token sequences, Free-MoRef achieves improved performance under much lower computing costs in reasoning multiplexed context length, demonstrating strong efficiency and effectiveness. Experiments on VideoMME, MLVU, LongVideoBench show that Free-MoRef achieves full perception of 2xto 8xlonger input frames without compression on a single A100 GPU while keeping instant responses, thereby bringing significant performance gains, even surpassing dedicatedly trained long-video-MLLMs. Codes are available at https://github.com/wkfdb/Free-MoRef
authors: Kuo Wang, Quanlong Zheng, Junlin Xie, Yanhao Zhang, Jinguo Luo, Haonan Lu, Liang Lin, Fan Zhou, Guanbin Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22499-22508

title: 自由运行与同步:高通量三维成像的单光子激光雷达
title_en: Free-running vs Synchronous: Single-Photon Lidar for High-flux 3D Imaging
abstract: 传统观点认为单光子激光雷达(SPL)应在低光条件下运行以最小化死时间效应。许多方法已开发用于缓解同步SPL系统中的这些效应。然而,尽管自由运行SPL能减少死时间引起的直方图失真,但相关解决方案仍有限。为提高自由运行SPL的准确性,我们提出了一种计算效率高的联合最大似然估计器,用于同时估计信号通量、背景通量和深度,并结合一个包含学习点云评分模型作为先验的互补正则化框架。仿真和实验表明,在相同条件下,自由运行SPL的估计误差低于其同步版本,而我们的正则化方法进一步提升了精度。
abstract_en: Conventional wisdom suggests that single-photon lidar (SPL) should operate in low-light conditions to minimize dead-time effects.Many methods have been developed to mitigate these effects in synchronous SPL systems. However, solutions for free-running SPL remain limited despite the advantage of reduced histogram distortion from dead times.To improve the accuracy of free-running SPL, we propose a computationally efficient joint maximum likelihood estimator of the signal flux, the background flux, and the depth, along with a complementary regularization framework that incorporates a learned point cloud score model as a prior.Simulations and experiments demonstrate that free-running SPL yields lower estimation errors than its synchronous counterpart under identical conditions, with our regularization further improving accuracy.
authors: Ruangrawee Kitichotkul, Shashwath Bharadwaj, Joshua Rapp, Yanting Ma, Alexander Mehta, Vivek K Goyal ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25972-25982

title: Free2Guide: 基于图像LVLM的无需训练文本到视频对齐
title_en: Free2Guide: Training-Free Text-to-Video Alignment using Image LVLM
abstract: 扩散模型在文本到视频(T2V)合成的生成任务中取得了显著成果。然而,由于帧间复杂的时序依赖关系,实现精确的文本对齐在T2V生成中仍面临挑战。现有基于强化学习(RL)的方法通常需要为视频专门训练可微奖励函数,这限制了其可扩展性和适用性。本文提出Free^2Guide,这是一种无需训练、无需梯度的新型框架,用于将生成视频与文本提示对齐。具体而言,借鉴路径积分控制原理,Free^2Guide利用不可微奖励函数近似扩散模型的引导,从而能够集成强大的黑箱大型视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)作为奖励模型。为使图像训练的LVLMs评估文本到视频对齐,我们利用视频帧间的拼接技术,并通过系统提示捕捉序列属性。我们的框架支持灵活集成多个奖励模型,协同增强对齐效果且无需显著计算开销。实验结果证实,使用图像训练的LVLMs的Free^2Guide显著提升了文本到视频对齐效果,从而提升整体视频质量。我们的结果与代码可在https://free2guide.github.io/获取。
abstract_en: Diffusion models have achieved impressive results in generative tasks for text-to-video (T2V) synthesis. However, achieving accurate text alignment in T2V generation remains challenging due to the complex temporal dependencies across frames. Existing reinforcement learning (RL)-based approaches to enhance text alignment often require differentiable reward functions trained for video, hindering their scalability and applicability. In this paper, we propose Free^2Guide, a novel gradient-free and training-free framework for aligning generated videos with text prompts. Specifically, leveraging principles from path integral control, Free^2Guide approximates guidance for diffusion models using non-differentiable reward functions, thereby enabling the integration of powerful black-box Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) as reward models. To enable image-trained LVLMs to assess text-to-video alignment, we leverage stitching between video frames and use system prompts to capture sequential attributions. Our framework supports the flexible ensembling of multiple reward models to synergistically enhance alignment without significant computational overhead. Experimental results confirm that Free^2Guide using image-trained LVLMs significantly improves text-to-video alignment, thereby enhancing the overall video quality. Our results and code are available at https://free2guide.github.io/
authors: Jaemin Kim, Bryan Sangwoo Kim, Jong Chul Ye ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17920-17929

title: Free4D:无需调参的4D场景生成与时空一致性
title_en: Free4D: Tuning-free 4D Scene Generation with Spatial-Temporal Consistency
abstract: 我们提出Free4D,一种新颖的无需调参框架,从单张图像生成4D场景。现有方法要么专注于物体级生成,导致场景级生成不可行,要么依赖大规模多视角视频数据集进行昂贵训练,由于4D场景数据稀缺,其泛化能力有限。相比之下,我们的关键洞察是通过蒸馏预训练基础模型以获得一致的4D场景表示,这提供了效率和可泛化性等优势。1)为实现这一目标,我们首先使用图像到视频扩散模型对输入图像进行动画化处理,随后进行4D几何结构初始化。2)为将该粗略结构转化为时空一致的多视角视频,我们设计了包含点引导去噪策略(空间一致性)和新颖潜在替换策略(时间一致性)的自适应引导机制。3)为将生成的观测提升为一致的4D表示,我们提出基于调制的细化方法以减少不一致性,同时充分利用生成信息。最终的4D表示支持实时可控渲染,标志着基于单图像的4D场景生成的重要进展。
abstract_en: We present Free4D, a novel tuning-free framework for 4D scene generation from a single image. Existing methods either focus on object-level generation, making scene-level generation infeasible, or rely on large-scale multi-view video datasets for expensive training, with limited generalization ability due to the scarcity of 4D scene data. In contrast, our key insight is to distill pre-trained foundation models for consistent 4D scene representation, which offers promising advantages such as efficiency and generalizability. 1) To achieve this, we first animate the input image using image-to-video diffusion models followed by 4D geometric structure initialization. 2) To turn this coarse structure into spatial-temporal consistent multi-view videos, we design an adaptive guidance mechanism with a point-guided denoising strategy for spatial consistency and a novel latent replacement strategy for temporal coherence. 3) To lift these generated observations into consistent 4D representation, we propose a modulation-based refinement to mitigate inconsistencies while fully leveraging the generated information. The resulting 4D representation enables real-time, controllable rendering, marking a significant advancement in single-image-based 4D scene generation.
authors: Tianqi Liu, Zihao Huang, Zhaoxi Chen, Guangcong Wang, Shoukang Hu, Liao Shen, Huiqiang Sun, Zhiguo Cao, Wei Li, Ziwei Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25571-25582

title: FreeCus: 无需额外训练的主体驱动定制化方法在扩散变换器中的应用
title_en: FreeCus: Free Lunch Subject-driven Customization in Diffusion Transformers
abstract: 鉴于文本到图像(T2I)生成领域近期的突破,特别是扩散变换器(DiT)的发展,主体驱动技术正被越来越多地用于高保真定制化生产,该技术能够从参考输入中保留主体身份,从而实现令人兴奋的设计流程和引人入胜的娱乐体验。现有方法通常需要通过可训练文本嵌入进行每主体优化,或在大规模数据集上训练专门的编码器以提取主体特征。这种对训练过程的依赖从根本上限制了其实际应用。更重要的是,当前方法未能充分挖掘现代扩散变换器(如Flux系列)固有的零样本潜力,以实现真实的主体驱动合成。为弥合这一差距,我们提出FreeCus,一个真正无需训练的框架,通过三项关键创新激活DiT的能力:1)我们引入了关键的注意力共享机制,在保留主体布局完整性的同时保持关键编辑灵活性。2)通过简单分析DiT的动态偏移特性,我们提出了一种改进变体,显著提升了细粒度特征提取能力。3)我们进一步整合了先进的多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)以丰富跨模态语义表示。大量实验表明,我们的方法成功解锁了DiT的零样本能力,在多样化的上下文中实现一致的主体合成,其效果达到或优于需要额外训练的方法。值得注意的是,我们的框架与现有修复管道和控制模块具有无缝兼容性,能够提供更引人入胜的体验。我们的代码已开源:https://github.com/Monalissaa/FreeCus
abstract_en: In light of recent breakthroughs in text-to-image (T2I) generation, particularly with diffusion transformers (DiT), subject-driven technologies are increasingly being employed for high-fidelity customized production that preserves subject identity from reference inputs, enabling thrilling design workflows and engaging entertainment. Existing alternatives typically require either per-subject optimization via trainable text embeddings or training specialized encoders for subject feature extraction on large-scale datasets. Such dependencies on training procedures fundamentally constrain their practical applications. More importantly, current methodologies fail to fully leverage the inherent zero-shot potential of modern diffusion transformers (e.g., the Flux series) for authentic subject-driven synthesis. To bridge this gap, we propose FreeCus, a genuinely training-free framework that activates DiT's capabilities through three key innovations: 1) We introduce a pivotal attention sharing mechanism that captures the subject's layout integrity while preserving crucial editing flexibility. 2) Through a straightforward analysis of DiT's dynamic shifting, we propose an upgraded variant that significantly improves fine-grained feature extraction. 3) We further integrate advanced Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to enrich cross-modal semantic representations. Extensive experiments reflect that our method successfully unlocks DiT's zero-shot ability for consistent subject synthesis across diverse contexts, achieving state-of-the-art or comparable results compared to approaches that require additional training. Notably, our framework demonstrates seamless compatibility with existing inpainting pipelines and control modules, facilitating more compelling experiences. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Monalissaa/FreeCus.
authors: Yanbing Zhang, Zhe Wang, Qin Zhou, Mengping Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15521-15531

title: FreeDNA: 为基于扩散的密集预测赋予无训练域噪声对齐的域适应能力
title_en: FreeDNA: Endowing Domain Adaptation of Diffusion-Based Dense Prediction with Training-Free Domain Noise Alignment
abstract: 域适应(DA)在密集预测任务中是一个重要课题,它能够提升密集预测模型在未见过的域上的性能。近年来,随着基于扩散的密集预测(DDP)模型的发展,探索针对该框架的定制化DA设计具有重要意义,因为扩散模型在建模包含域信息的分布变换方面表现出色。在本工作中,我们提出了一种无训练机制,使DDP框架具备域适应能力。我们的动机源于观察到扩散过程中的暴露偏差(如噪声统计偏差)会导致域偏移,并且在DDP模型的条件下,不同域也可以通过噪声预测统计有效捕捉。基于此,我们提出了一种无训练域噪声对齐(DNA)方法,通过在扩散采样过程中缓解噪声统计变化对域变化的影响,从而实现域适应。具体而言,当源域可用时,我们直接采用DNA方法通过将目标域的噪声统计与源域对齐来实现域适应。对于更具挑战性的源域无DA场景,受观察到靠近源域的区域在采样噪声变化中表现出更高置信度的启发,我们利用高置信度区域的统计信息逐步引导采样过程中噪声统计的调整。值得注意的是,我们的方法在四个常见的密集预测任务中验证了增强DDP模型域适应能力的有效性。代码可在\href https://github.com/xuhang07/FreeDNA https://github.com/xuhang07/FreeDNA 获取。
abstract_en: Domain Adaptation (DA) for dense prediction tasks is an important topic, which enhances the dense prediction model's performance when tested on its unseen domain. Recently, with the development of Diffusion-based Dense Prediction (DDP) models, the exploration of DA designs tailored to this framework is worth exploring, since the diffusion model is effective in modeling the distribution transformation that comprises domain information. In this work, we propose a training-free mechanism for DDP frameworks, endowing them with DA capabilities. Our motivation arises from the observation that the exposure bias (e.g., noise statistics bias) in diffusion brings domain shift, and different domains in conditions of DDP models can also be effectively captured by the noise prediction statistics. Based on this, we propose a training-free Domain Noise Alignment (DNA) approach, which alleviates the variations of noise statistics to domain changes during the diffusion sampling process, thereby achieving domain adaptation. Specifically, when the source domain is available, we directly adopt the DNA method to achieve domain adaptation by aligning the noise statistics of the target domain with those of the source domain. For the more challenging source-free DA, inspired by the observation that regions closer to the source domain exhibit higher confidence meeting variations of sampling noise, we utilize the statistics from the high-confidence regions progressively to guide the noise statistic adjustment during the sampling process. Notably, our method demonstrates the effectiveness of enhancing the DA capability of DDP models across four common dense prediction tasks. Code is available at \href https://github.com/xuhang07/FreeDNA  https://github.com/xuhang07/FreeDNA .
authors: Hang Xu, Jie Huang, Linjiang Huang, Dong Li, Yidi Liu, Feng Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3268-3279

title: FreeDance:基于统一框架的和谐自由人数群体舞蹈生成
title_en: FreeDance: Towards Harmonic Free-Number Group Dance Generation via a Unified Framework
abstract: 从音乐信号生成和谐且多样的人体运动,特别是针对群体舞者,是虚拟化身创建中的实际但具有挑战性的任务。现有方法仅建模固定数量的舞者,缺乏对任意个体的灵活性。为实现这一目标,我们提出了一种新颖的统一框架FreeDance。考虑到生成任意舞者的同时保持多个体动态的合理性,我们基于二维离散空间中的协作掩码标记建模构建框架。具体而言,我们设计了跨模态残差对齐模块(CRAM),以多样化每个个体的运动并增强其与音乐的对齐。CRAM利用残差学习捕捉每个舞者的空间运动形变,并将其与节奏表示集成以强化内在关联。此外,鉴于交互协调的需求,我们设计了时间交互模块(TIM)。得益于掩码二维运动标记,TIM有效建模当前个体与邻近舞者之间的时序相关性,作为交互指导以增强舞者间依赖关系。大量实验表明,我们的方法能够生成任意人数的和谐群体舞蹈,优于适应固定人数的最先进方法。代码可在https://github.com/Tsukasane/FreeDance获取。
abstract_en: Generating harmonic and diverse human motions from music signals, especially for a group of dancers, is a practical yet challenging task in virtual avatar creation. Existing methods merely model a fixed number of dancers, lacking the flexibility for arbitrary individuals. To fulfill this goal, we propose a novel unified framework, FreeDance. Considering the plausibility of generating arbitrary dancers while preserving the diverse dynamics of multiple individuals, we build the framework upon collaborative masked token modeling in a 2D discrete space. In particular, we devise a Cross-modality Residual Alignment Module (CRAM) to diversify the movement of each individual and intensify its alignment with music. CRAM captures the spatial motion deformation of each dancer using residual learning and integrates it with rhythmic representation to reinforce the intrinsic connection. Moreover, recognizing the requirement of interactive coordination, we design a Temporal Interaction Module (TIM). Benefiting from masked 2D motion tokens, TIM effectively models the temporal correlation between current individuals w.r.t. neighboring dancers as interaction guidance to foster stronger inter-dancer dependencies. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach generates harmonic group dance with any number of individuals, outperforming state-of-the-art methods adapting number-fixed counterparts. Code is available at https://github.com/Tsukasane/FreeDance.
authors: Yiwen Zhao, Yang Wang, Liting Wen, Hengyuan Zhang, Xingqun Qi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10560-10569

title: FreeFlux: 理解与利用基于RoPE的MMDiT中层特定角色以实现多功能图像编辑
title_en: FreeFlux: Understanding and Exploiting Layer-Specific Roles in RoPE-Based MMDiT for Versatile Image Editing
abstract: 旋转位置嵌入(RoPE)在多模态扩散Transformer(MMDiT)中的集成显著提升了文本到图像生成的质量。然而,自注意力层在生成过程中对位置嵌入与查询-键相似性的基本依赖关系仍是一个引人入胜的问题。我们首次对基于RoPE的MMDiT模型(如FLUX)进行了机制性分析,引入了一种自动化探针策略,通过在生成过程中战略性地操控RoPE,以解耦位置信息与内容依赖关系。我们的分析揭示了与深度无直接线性关联的依赖模式,为基于RoPE的MMDiT中层特定角色提供了新的见解。基于这些发现,我们提出了一种无需训练的任务特定图像编辑框架,将编辑任务分为三类:位置依赖型编辑(如物体添加)、内容相似性依赖型编辑(如非刚性编辑)和区域保留型编辑(如背景替换)。针对每种类型,我们根据编辑任务的特征设计了定制化的键值注入策略。大量定性与定量评估表明,我们的方法在保持原始语义内容和实现无缝修改方面优于现有最先进方法,特别是在复杂编辑场景中表现出显著优势。
abstract_en: The integration of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) in Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT) has significantly enhanced text-to-image generation quality. However, the fundamental reliance of self-attention layers on positional embedding versus query-key similarity during generation remains an intriguing question. We present the first mechanistic analysis of RoPE-based MMDiT models (e.g., FLUX), introducing an automated probing strategy that disentangles positional information versus content dependencies by strategically manipulating RoPE during generation. Our analysis reveals distinct dependency patterns that do not straightforwardly correlate with depth, offering new insights into the layer-specific roles in RoPE-based MMDiT. Based on these findings, we propose a training-free, task-specific image editing framework that categorizes editing tasks into three types: position-dependent editing (e.g., object addition), content similarity-dependent editing (e.g., non-rigid editing), and region-preserved editing (e.g., background replacement). For each type, we design tailored key-value injection strategies based on the characteristics of the editing task. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, particularly in preserving original semantic content and achieving seamless modifications.
authors: Tianyi Wei, Yifan Zhou, Dongdong Chen, Xingang Pan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16745-16754

title: FreeMorph:基于扩散模型的免调优通用图像变形方法
title_en: FreeMorph: Tuning-Free Generalized Image Morphing with Diffusion Model
abstract: 我们提出FreeMorph,这是首个无需调优的通用图像变形方法,可适应语义或布局各异的输入。与现有方法依赖微调预训练扩散模型且受限于时间约束和语义/布局差异不同,FreeMorph在无需大量训练的情况下实现高保真图像变形。尽管其效率和潜力显著,但免调优方法仍因多步去噪过程的非线性特性及预训练扩散模型继承的偏差,面临保持高质量图像变形的挑战。本文通过集成两项关键创新引入FreeMorph以解决这一问题:1)我们首先提出一种引导感知的球面插值设计,通过修改自注意力模块融入输入图像的显式引导,解决身份损失问题,并确保生成序列中的方向性过渡。2)我们进一步引入基于步骤的变异趋势,通过融合每张输入图像的自注意力模块实现受输入图像约束的可控且一致的过渡。大量实验表明,FreeMorph在训练速度提升10倍至50倍的情况下超越现有方法,建立了图像变形领域的新基准。
abstract_en: We present FreeMorph, the first tuning-free method for image morphing that accommodates inputs with varying semantics or layouts. Unlike existing methods, which rely on fine-tuning pre-trained diffusion models and are limited by time constraints and semantic/layout discrepancies, FreeMorph delivers high-fidelity image morphing without extensive training. Despite its efficiency and potential, tuning-free methods still face challenges in maintaining high-quality image morphing due to the non-linear nature of the multi-step denoising process and bias inherited from the pre-trained diffusion model. In this paper, we introduce FreeMorph to address this challenge by integrating two key innovations. 1) We first propose a guidance-aware spherical interpolation design that incorporates the explicit guidance from the input images by modifying the self-attention modules, addressing identity loss, and ensuring directional transitions throughout the generated sequences. 2) We further introduce a step-oriented variation trend that blends self-attention modules derived from each input image to achieve controlled and consistent transitions that respect both input images. Our extensive evaluations demonstrate that FreeMorph outperforms existing methods with training that is 10X   50X faster, establishing a new state-of-the-art for image morphing.
authors: Yukang Cao, Chenyang Si, Jinghao Wang, Ziwei Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18111-18120

title: FreeScale:通过免调参尺度融合释放扩散模型的分辨率潜力
title_en: FreeScale: Unleashing the Resolution of Diffusion Models via Tuning-Free Scale Fusion
abstract: 视觉扩散模型取得了显著进展,但通常受限于缺乏高分辨率数据和计算资源的约束,只能在有限分辨率下进行训练,这限制了其生成更高分辨率高保真图像或视频的能力。近期研究探索了免调参策略以展现预训练模型在高分辨率视觉生成方面的潜力。然而,这些方法仍容易产生低质量视觉内容并出现重复模式。关键障碍在于当模型生成超出训练分辨率的视觉内容时,高频信息的不可避免增加会导致由累积误差引发的不期望重复模式。为解决这一挑战,我们提出FreeScale,一种免调参推理范式,通过尺度融合实现更高分辨率的视觉生成。具体而言,FreeScale通过提取所需频率成分,对不同感受尺度的信息进行处理并融合。大量实验验证了我们的范式在扩展图像和视频模型高分辨率视觉生成能力方面的优越性。值得注意的是,与之前表现最佳的方法相比,FreeScale首次实现了8K分辨率的文本到图像生成。
abstract_en: Visual diffusion models achieve remarkable progress, yet they are typically trained at limited resolutions due to the lack of high-resolution data and constrained computation resources, hampering their ability to generate high-fidelity images or videos at higher resolutions. Recent efforts have explored tuning-free strategies to exhibit the untapped potential higher-resolution visual generation of pre-trained models. However, these methods are still prone to producing low-quality visual content with repetitive patterns. The key obstacle lies in the inevitable increase in high-frequency information when the model generates visual content exceeding its training resolution, leading to undesirable repetitive patterns deriving from the accumulated errors. To tackle this challenge, we propose FreeScale, a tuning-free inference paradigm to enable higher-resolution visual generation via scale fusion.
