Specifically, FreeScale processes information from different receptive scales and then fuses it by extracting desired frequency components. Extensive experiments validate the superiority of our paradigm in extending the capabilities of higher-resolution visual generation for both image and video models. Notably, compared with previous best-performing methods, FreeScale unlocks the 8k-resolution text-to-image generation for the first time.
authors: Haonan Qiu, Shiwei Zhang, Yujie Wei, Ruihang Chu, Hangjie Yuan, Xiang Wang, Yingya Zhang, Ziwei Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16893-16903

title: FreeSplatter:无需姿态的稀疏视角三维重建高斯点云方法
title_en: FreeSplatter: Pose-free Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-view 3D Reconstruction
abstract: 稀疏视角重建模型通常需要精确的相机姿态,但从稀疏视角图像中获取这些参数仍具挑战性。我们提出FreeSplatter,一种可扩展的前馈框架,能够从未校准的稀疏视角图像生成高质量的3D高斯点云,同时在数秒内估计相机参数。我们的方法采用精简的Transformer架构,其中自注意力块促进多视角图像标记之间的信息交互,并在统一参考系中解码为像素对齐的3D高斯基础元素。这种表示方式支持高保真度的3D建模,并通过现成求解器实现高效的相机参数估计。我们开发了两种专用变体——面向物体中心和场景级重建的版本,并在全面数据集上进行训练。值得注意的是,FreeSplatter在多个依赖姿态的大规模重建模型(LRMs)上表现出显著优势,同时在具有挑战性的基准测试中,其姿态估计精度与最先进的姿态无关重建方法MASt3R相当甚至更优。除技术基准外,FreeSplatter还简化了文本/图像到3D内容创作流程,消除了相机姿态管理的复杂性,同时实现卓越的视觉保真度。
abstract_en: Sparse-view reconstruction models typically require precise camera poses, yet obtaining these parameters from sparse-view images remains challenging. We introduce FreeSplatter, a scalable feed-forward framework that generates high-quality 3D Gaussians from uncalibrated sparse-view images while estimating camera parameters within seconds. Our approach employs a streamlined transformer architecture where self-attention blocks facilitate information exchange among multi-view image tokens, decoding them into pixel-aligned 3D Gaussian primitives within a unified reference frame. This representation enables both high-fidelity 3D modeling and efficient camera parameter estimation using off-the-shelf solvers. We develop two specialized variants--for object-centric and scene-level reconstruction--trained on comprehensive datasets. Remarkably, FreeSplatter outperforms several pose-dependent Large Reconstruction Models (LRMs) by a notable margin while achieving comparable or even better pose estimation accuracy compared to state-of-the-art pose-free reconstruction approach MASt3R in challenging benchmarks. Beyond technical benchmarks, FreeSplatter streamlines text/image-to-3D content creation pipelines, eliminating the complexity of camera pose management while delivering exceptional visual fidelity.
authors: Jiale Xu, Shenghua Gao, Ying Shan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25442-25452

title: FreqPDE:多视角三维目标检测变压器中位置深度嵌入的重新思考
title_en: FreqPDE: Rethinking Positional Depth Embedding for Multi-View 3D Object Detection Transformers
abstract: 从多视角二维图像中准确检测三维目标是自动驾驶领域具有挑战性却至关重要的任务。当前方法依赖深度预测来恢复目标查询解码所需的空间信息,这需要在训练阶段引入来自激光雷达点的显式监督。然而,预测的深度质量仍不理想,例如目标边界深度不连续和小目标区分度不足,这主要由投影点的稀疏监督和使用高层图像特征进行深度预测所致。此外,跨视角一致性与尺度不变性在先前方法中也被忽视。本文引入频率感知位置深度嵌入(FreqPDE),为三维检测变压器解码器赋予二维图像特征的空间信息,该信息可通过三个主要模块获得。具体而言,频率感知空间金字塔编码器(FSPE)通过结合不同层级的高频边缘线索和低频语义构建特征金字塔。随后,跨视角尺度不变深度预测器(CSDP)利用跨视角与高效通道注意力机制估计像素级深度分布。最后,位置深度编码器(PDE)将二维图像特征与三维位置嵌入结合,生成用于查询解码的三维深度感知特征。此外,采用混合深度监督从度量和分布两个方面进行互补的深度学习。在nuScenes数据集上的大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性与优越性。
abstract_en: Detecting 3D objects accurately from multi-view 2D images is a challenging yet essential task in the field of autonomous driving. Current methods resort to integrating depth prediction to recover the spatial information for object query decoding, which necessitates explicit supervision from LiDAR points during the training phase. However, the predicted depth quality is still unsatisfactory such as depth discontinuity of object boundaries and indistinction of small objects, which are mainly caused by the sparse supervision of projected points and the use of high-level image features for depth prediction. Besides, cross-view consistency and scale invariance are also overlooked in previous methods. In this paper, we introduce Frequency-aware Positional Depth Embedding (FreqPDE) to equip 2D image features with spatial information for 3D detection transformer decoder, which can be obtained through three main modules. Specifically, the Frequency-aware Spatial Pyramid Encoder (FSPE) constructs a feature pyramid by combining high-frequency edge clues and low-frequency semantics from different levels respectively. Then the Cross-view Scale-invariant Depth Predictor (CSDP) estimates the pixel-level depth distribution with cross-view and efficient channel attention mechanism. Finally, the Positional Depth Encoder (PDE) combines the 2D image features and 3D position embeddings to generate the 3D depth-aware features for query decoding. Additionally, hybrid depth supervision is adopted for complementary depth learning from both metric and distribution aspects. Extensive experiments conducted on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of our proposed method.
authors: Haisheng Su, Junjie Zhang, Feixiang Song, Sanping Zhou, Wei Wu, Junchi Yan, Nanning Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28145-28155

title: 基于频域的无配对图像去雾扩散模型
title_en: Frequency Domain-Based Diffusion Model for Unpaired Image Dehazing
abstract: 由于其在模型训练过程中灵活的数据需求,无配对图像去雾受到了越来越多的关注。基于对比学习的主流方法不仅引入了与雾霾无关的内容信息,还忽略了频域中与雾霾相关的特性(即,与雾霾相关的退化主要体现在幅值谱上)。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新型的基于频域的扩散模型FrDiff,以充分挖掘无配对清晰数据中的有益知识。特别是,受扩散模型(DMs)强大生成能力的启发,我们从频域重建的角度处理去雾任务,并通过DMs生成与清晰图像分布一致的幅值谱。为实现这一目标,我们提出了一种幅值残差编码器(ARE),用于提取幅值残差,有效补偿从雾霾到清晰域的幅值差距,并为DMs训练提供监督。此外,我们提出了一种相位校正模块(PCM),通过简单的注意力机制在去雾过程中进一步优化相位谱以消除伪影。实验结果表明,我们的FrDiff在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上均优于其他最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Unpaired image dehazing has attracted increasing attention due to its flexible data requirements during model training. Dominant methods based on contrastive learning not only introduce haze-unrelated content information, but also ignore haze-specific properties in the frequency domain (i.e., haze-related degradation is mainly manifested in the amplitude spectrum). To address these issues, we propose a novel frequency domain-based diffusion model, named FrDiff, for fully exploiting the beneficial knowledge in unpaired clear data. In particular, inspired by the strong generative ability shown by Diffusion Models (DMs), we tackle the dehazing task from the perspective of frequency domain reconstruction and perform the DMs to yield the amplitude spectrum consistent with the distribution of clear images. To implement it, we propose an Amplitude Residual Encoder (ARE) to extract the amplitude residuals, which effectively compensates for the amplitude gap from the hazy to clear domains, as well as provide supervision for the DMs training. In addition, we propose a Phase Correction Module (PCM) to eliminate artifacts by further refining the phase spectrum during dehazing with a simple attention mechanism. Experimental results demonstrate that our FrDiff outperforms other state-of-the-art methods on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
authors: Chengxu Liu, Lu Qi, Jinshan Pan, Xueming Qian, Ming-Hsuan Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7538-7547

title: 面向轻量化时空预测的频率对齐知识蒸馏方法
title_en: Frequency-Aligned Knowledge Distillation for Lightweight Spatiotemporal Forecasting
abstract: 时空预测任务(如交通流量、燃烧动力学和天气预测)通常需要复杂模型,但存在训练效率低和内存消耗高的问题。本文提出一种轻量框架——频谱解耦知识蒸馏,将复杂教师模型的多尺度时空表示迁移至更高效的轻量学生网络。教师模型采用编码器-潜在演进-解码器架构,其潜在演进模块通过卷积(局部高频提取器)和Transformer(全局低频建模器)分离高频细节(如瞬时交通波动)和低频趋势(如长期天气演变)。然而,多层卷积与反卷积结构导致训练缓慢和内存占用高。为此,我们提出频率对齐知识蒸馏策略,从教师模型潜在空间提取多尺度频谱特征(包括高低频成分),指导轻量学生模型(如ResNet、U-Net)同时捕捉局部细粒度变化和全局演变模式。实验表明,学生模型在仅使用教师模型20%-30%内存、训练速度提升超50%的情况下,预测精度超过教师模型95%。理论分析表明,频域解耦使学生模型无需复杂结构即可捕捉长程依赖。频率对齐蒸馏机制进一步缓解了轻量模型在跨尺度时空动态建模中的固有偏差。该框架为资源受限场景下的高精度时空预测提供了有效通用解决方案。
abstract_en: Spatiotemporal forecasting tasks, such as traffic flow, combustion dynamics, and weather forecasting, often require complex models that suffer from low training efficiency and high memory consumption. This paper proposes a lightweight framework, Spectral Decoupled Knowledge Distillation, which transfers the multi-scale spatiotemporal representations from a complex teacher model to a more efficient lightweight student network. The teacher model follows an encoder-latent evolution-decoder architecture, where its latent evolution module decouples high-frequency details (e.g., instant traffic fluctuations) and low-frequency trends (e.g. long-term weather evolution) using convolution (local high-frequency extractor) and Transformer (global low-frequency modeler). However, the multi-layer convolution and deconvolution structures result in slow training and high memory usage. To address these issues, we propose a frequency-aligned knowledge distillation strategy, which extracts multi-scale spectral features from the teacher's latent space, including high and low frequency components, to guide the lightweight student model (e.g., ResNet, U-Net) in capturing both local fine-grained variations and global evolution patterns. Experiments show that the student model achieves over 95% of the teacher's forecasting accuracy while using only 20%-30% of its memory, with training speed improved by more than 50%. Our theoretical analysis reveals that the frequency-domain decoupling enables the student model to capture long-range dependencies without the need for complex structures. The frequency-aligned distillation mechanism further mitigates the inherent bias of lightweight models in cross-scale spatiotemporal dynamics modeling. This framework offers an effective and general solution for high-accuracy spatiotemporal forecasting in resource-constrained scenarios.
authors: Yuqi Li, Chuanguang Yang, Hansheng Zeng, Zeyu Dong, Zhulin An, Yongjun Xu, Yingli Tian, Hao Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7262-7272

title: 面向高效高分辨率图像合成的频率感知自回归建模
title_en: Frequency-Aware Autoregressive Modeling for Efficient High-Resolution Image Synthesis
abstract: 基于下一尺度预测范式的视觉自回归建模在图像质量和模型扩展性方面相比传统自回归和扩散模型展现出显著优势。该方法通过多阶段逐步提升分辨率来生成图像。然而,由于高分辨率阶段涉及大量token,计算开销仍是一个关键挑战。本文提出SparseVAR,这是一种即插即用的加速框架,可在推理过程中动态排除低频token而无需额外训练。我们的方法基于以下观察:低频区域的token对高分辨率阶段的图像质量影响微乎其微,并且与邻近token具有强相似性。此外,我们发现下一尺度预测模型的不同块关注不同区域,部分块集中于高频区域。SparseVAR通过轻量级基于均方误差的指标识别低频token,并通过少量均匀采样的锚点token保持排除区域的保真度。该方法在显著降低计算成本的同时保持高质量图像生成,实现了HART和Infinity的显著加速。具体而言,SparseVAR在Infinity-2B中实现最高达2倍的速度提升,且质量损失极小。
abstract_en: Visual autoregressive modeling, based on the next-scale prediction paradigm, exhibits notable advantages in image quality and model scalability over traditional autoregressive and diffusion models. It generates images by progressively refining resolution across multiple stages. However, the computational overhead in high-resolution stages remains a critical challenge due to the substantial number of tokens involved. In this paper, we introduce SparseVAR, a plug-and-play acceleration framework for next-scale prediction that dynamically excludes low-frequency tokens during inference without requiring additional training. Our approach is motivated by the observation that tokens in low-frequency regions have a negligible impact on image quality in high-resolution stages and exhibit strong similarity with neighboring tokens. Additionally, we observe that different blocks in the next-scale prediction model focus on distinct regions, with some concentrating on high-frequency areas. SparseVAR leverages these insights by employing lightweight MSE-based metrics to identify low-frequency tokens while preserving the fidelity of excluded regions through a small set of uniformly sampled anchor tokens. By significantly reducing the computational cost while maintaining high image generation quality, SparseVAR achieves notable acceleration in both HART and Infinity. Specifically, SparseVAR achieves up to a 2x speedup with minimal quality degradation in Infinity-2B.
authors: Zhuokun Chen, Jugang Fan, Zhuowei Yu, Bohan Zhuang, Mingkui Tan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17140-17149

title: 频域动态注意力调制用于密集预测
title_en: Frequency-Dynamic Attention Modulation For Dense Prediction
abstract: 视觉Transformer(ViTs)显著推动了计算机视觉的发展,在各类任务中展现出强大的性能。然而,ViTs中的注意力机制使每一层都充当低通滤波器,现有Transformer的堆叠层架构存在频率消失问题,导致关键细节和纹理信息的丢失。我们提出了一种受电路理论启发的新型策略——频域动态注意力调制(FDAM),可轻松集成到ViTs中。FDAM直接调节ViTs的整体频率响应,包含两种技术:注意力反转(AttInv)和频率动态缩放(FreqScale)。由于电路理论以低通滤波器为基本元件,我们引入AttInv方法,通过反转注意力矩阵中的低通滤波器生成互补的高通滤波,并动态结合两者。我们进一步设计FreqScale对不同频率成分进行加权,实现对目标响应函数的精细调整。通过特征相似性分析和有效秩评估,我们证明该方法避免了表征坍缩,使SegFormer、DeiT和MaskDINO等各类模型均取得一致性能提升。这些改进在语义分割、目标检测和实例分割等任务中尤为明显。此外,我们将方法应用于遥感检测,在单尺度设置下取得SOTA结果。代码已开源至https://github.com/Linwei-Chen/FDAM
abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have significantly advanced computer vision, demonstrating strong performance across various tasks. However, the attention mechanism in ViTs makes each layer function as a low-pass filter, and the stacked-layer architecture in existing transformers suffers from frequency vanishing. This leads to the loss of critical details and textures.We propose a novel, circuit-theory-inspired strategy called Frequency-Dynamic Attention Modulation (FDAM), which can be easily plugged into ViTs. FDAM directly modulates the overall frequency response of ViTs and consists of two techniques: Attention Inversion (AttInv) and Frequency Dynamic Scaling (FreqScale).Since circuit theory uses low-pass filters as fundamental elements, we introduce AttInv, a method that generates complementary high-pass filtering by inverting the low-pass filter in the attention matrix, and dynamically combining the two. We further design FreqScale to weight different frequency components for fine-grained adjustments to the target response function.Through feature similarity analysis and effective rank evaluation, we demonstrate that our approach avoids representation collapse, leading to consistent performance improvements across various models, including SegFormer, DeiT, and MaskDINO. These improvements are evident in tasks such as semantic segmentation, object detection, and instance segmentation. Additionally, we apply our method to remote sensing detection, achieving state-of-the-art results in single-scale settings. The code is available at https://github.com/Linwei-Chen/FDAM
authors: Linwei Chen, Lin Gu, Ying Fu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22620-22632

title: 无需训练的文本驱动图像翻译的频率引导扩散
title_en: Frequency-Guided Diffusion for Training-Free Text-Driven Image Translation
abstract: 当前无需训练的文本驱动图像翻译主要利用预训练模型的扩散特征(卷积和注意力)作为指导,以在翻译图像中保留源图像的风格/结构。然而,特征层面的粗粒度指导在风格(如视觉模式)和结构(如边缘)与源图像的对齐上存在困难。基于低频/高频成分保留图像风格/结构信息的观察,本文提出无需训练的频率引导扩散(FGD),分别针对风格引导和结构引导的翻译进行低频/高频指导优化。对于低频指导(风格引导),我们通过替换采样过程中扩散潜变量的低频成分(来自源图像的反推)并利用复合频谱归一化获得的潜变量,以强化色彩对齐。对于高频指导(结构引导),我们提出高频对齐与高频注入机制,二者相互补偿。高频对齐通过调整预测噪声与指导函数,使采样与源图像间的高频区域对齐,从而保留边缘和轮廓;高频注入则通过将扩散卷积特征(来自反推)的高频成分注入采样过程,实现布局保留。定性与定量结果验证了我们的方法在风格与结构引导翻译任务中的优越性。
abstract_en: Current training-free text-driven image translation primarily uses diffusion features (convolution and attention) of pre-trained model as guidance to preserve the style/structure of source image in translated image. However, the coarse guidance at feature level struggles with style (e.g., visual patterns) and structure (e.g., edges) alignment with the source. Based on the observation that the low-/high-frequency components retain style/structure information of image, in this work, we propose training-free Frequency-Guided Diffusion (FGD), which tailors low-/high-frequency guidance for style- and structure-guided translation, respectively. For low-frequency guidance (style-guided), we substitute the low-frequency components of diffusion latents from sampling process with those from inversion of source and normalize the obtained latent with composited spectrum to enforce color alignment. For high-frequency guidance (structure-guided), we propose high-frequency alignment and high-frequency injection that compensate each other. High-frequency alignment preserves edges and contour by adjusting the predicted noise with guidance function that aligns high-frequency image regions between sampling and source image. High-frequency injection facilitates layout preservation by injecting high-frequency components of diffusion convolution features (from inversion) to sampling process. Qualitative and quantitative results verify the superiority of our method on style- and structure-guided translation tasks.
authors: Zheng Gao, Jifei Song, Zhensong Zhang, Jiankang Deng, Ioannis Patras ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19195-19205

title: 基于扩散的图像修复的频率引导后验采样
title_en: Frequency-Guided Posterior Sampling for Diffusion-Based Image Restoration
abstract: 图像修复旨在从退化观测中恢复高质量图像。当退化过程已知时,恢复问题可建模为逆问题,在贝叶斯框架下,目标是根据退化观测对干净图像进行采样。近年来,通过修改采样过程以考虑退化过程,现代预训练扩散模型已被用于图像修复。然而,这些方法通常依赖某些近似,可能导致显著误差和样本质量下降。在本文中,我们提出了一种对现有基于扩散的修复方法的简单修改,该方法利用了逆扩散过程的频率结构。具体而言,我们的方法称为频率引导后验采样(FGPS),在测量的频率域中引入了一个时变低通滤波器,在修复过程中逐步引入更高频率。我们在自然图像空间的分布假设下,首次对FGPS在线性逆问题中的近似误差进行了严格分析,展示了先前方法可能严重失效的情况。在真实数据上,我们根据底层数据分布开发了方法的频率调度自适应课程。FGPS在包括运动模糊和图像去雾在内的具有挑战性的图像修复任务中显著提升了性能。
abstract_en: Image restoration aims to recover high-quality images from degraded observations. When the degradation process is known, the recovery problem can be formulated as an inverse problem, and in a Bayesian context, the goal is to sample a clean reconstruction given the degraded observation. Recently, modern pretrained diffusion models have been used for image restoration by modifying their sampling procedure to account for the degradation process. However, these methods often rely on certain approximations that can lead to significant errors and compromised sample quality. In this paper, we propose a simple modification to existing diffusion-based restoration methods that exploits the frequency structure of the reverse diffusion process. Specifically, our approach, denoted as Frequency Guided Posterior Sampling (FGPS), introduces a time-varying low-pass filter in the frequency domain of the measurements, progressively incorporating higher frequencies during the restoration process. We provide the first rigorous analysis of the approximation error of FGPS for linear inverse problems under distributional assumptions on the space of natural images, demonstrating cases where previous works can fail dramatically. On real-world data, we develop an adaptive curriculum for our method's frequency schedule based on the underlying data distribution. FGPS significantly improves performance on challenging image restoration tasks including motion deblurring and image dehazing.
authors: Darshan Thaker, Abhishek Goyal, Rene Vidal ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12873-12882

title: 基于频率语义增强的变分自编码器零样本骨架动作识别
title_en: Frequency-Semantic Enhanced Variational Autoencoder for Zero-Shot Skeleton-based Action Recognition
abstract: 零样本骨架动作识别旨在开发能够识别训练过程中未遇到类别动作的模型。先前方法主要关注视觉与语义表示的对齐,但常忽视语义空间中细粒度动作模式(如饮水和刷牙的手部动作)的重要性。为解决这些局限性,我们提出频率语义增强变分自编码器(FS-VAE),通过频率分解探索骨架语义表示学习。FS-VAE包含三个关键组件:1)基于频率的增强模块,通过高低频调整丰富骨架语义学习并提升零样本动作识别的鲁棒性;2)基于语义的动作描述与多级对齐,捕捉局部细节与全局对应关系,有效弥合语义鸿沟并补偿骨架序列固有的信息损失;3)校准的跨对齐损失,使有效骨架-文本对平衡模糊对,缓解骨架与文本特征间的差异与歧义,确保稳健对齐。在基准测试中的评估验证了方法的有效性,证明频率增强的语义特征能够稳健区分视觉与语义相似的动作簇,从而提升零样本动作识别性能。
abstract_en: Zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition aims to develop models capable of identifying actions beyond the categories encountered during training. Previous approaches have primarily focused on aligning visual and semantic representations but often overlooked the importance of fine-grained action patterns in the semantic space (e.g., the hand movements in drinking water and brushing teeth). To address these limitations, we propose a Frequency-Semantic Enhanced Variational Autoencoder (FS-VAE) to explore the skeleton semantic representation learning with frequency decomposition. FS-VAE consists of three key components: 1) a frequency-based enhancement module with high- and low-frequency adjustments to enrich the skeletal semantics learning and improve the robustness of zero-shot action recognition; 2) a semantic-based action description with multilevel alignment to capture both local details and global correspondence, effectively bridging the semantic gap and compensating for the inherent loss of information in skeleton sequences; 3) a calibrated cross-alignment loss that enables valid skeleton-text pairs to counterbalance ambiguous ones, mitigating discrepancies and ambiguities in skeleton and text features, thereby ensuring robust alignment. Evaluations on the benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, validating that frequency-enhanced semantic features enable robust differentiation of visually and semantically similar action clusters, thereby improving zero-shot action recognition.
authors: Wenhan Wu, Zhishuai Guo, Chen Chen, Hongfei Xue, Aidong Lu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11122-11131

title: 从深渊黑暗到炫目强光:现实世界极端曝光校正的基准测试
title_en: From Abyssal Darkness to Blinding Glare: A Benchmark on Extreme Exposure Correction in Real World
abstract: 曝光校正旨在利用单个网络将过曝/欠曝图像恢复为正常曝光图像。然而,现有方法主要处理非极端曝光条件,在极端曝光导致的严重亮度和纹理损失场景中表现不佳。通过深入研究,我们发现高质量基准数据集的缺乏显著制约了极端曝光校正的发展。为解决这一问题,我们引入了首个现实世界极端曝光数据集REED。通过利用相机的连拍模式,我们捕捉到覆盖从极端黑暗到极端明亮亮度范围的图像序列。为防止因相机运动和场景变化导致的错位,我们采用裁剪和改进的SIFT算法确保精确对齐。我们还提出了一种新颖的上下文引导亮度归一化迭代曝光细化网络。我们采用对比损失和亮度归一化器以解耦过曝/欠曝图像的耦合分布。在某些情况下,仅亮度信息不足以判断过曝/欠曝,因此我们将语义引导集成到语义感知曝光扩散模型中以进一步增强亮度和纹理恢复。受迭代校正提升颜色和纹理效果的启发,我们引入了CLIP引导的迭代细化策略。大量实验验证了我们数据集和方法的优越性。我们的数据集可在https://github.com/juvenoia/REED获取。
abstract_en: Exposure correction aims to restore over/under-exposed images to well-exposed ones using a single network. However, existing methods mainly handle non-extreme exposure conditions and struggle with the severe luminance and texture loss caused by extreme exposure. Through a thorough investigation, we find that the lack of high-quality benchmark datasets significantly limits progress in extreme exposure correction.To address this issue, we introduce the first Real-world Extreme Exposure Dataset, REED. By leveraging the burst shooting mode of cameras, we capture image sequences covering a luminance range from extremely dark to extremely bright. To prevent misalignment caused by camera motion and scene changes, we apply cropping and an improved SIFT algorithm to ensure precise alignment.We also propose a novel Context-Guided Luminance-Normalized Iterative Exposure Refinement Network. We employ Contrastive Loss and Luminance Normalizer to disentangle the coupled distribution of over/under-exposed images. In certain cases, luminance alone is insufficient for determining over/under-exposure, so we integrate semantic guidance into the Semantic-aware Exposure Diffusion Model to further enhance luminance and texture restoration. Inspired by the effectiveness of iterative correction in improving color and texture, we introduce the CLIP-Guided Iterative Refinement Strategy. Extensive experiments validate the superiority of our dataset and method. Our dataset is available at https://github.com/juvenoia/REED.
authors: Bo Wang, Huiyuan Fu, Zhiye Huang, Siru Zhang, Xin Wang, Huadong Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7666-7675

title: 从易到难:面向单点监督红外小目标检测的渐进式主动学习框架
title_en: From Easy to Hard: Progressive Active Learning Framework for Infrared Small Target Detection with Single Point Supervision
abstract: 近期,单帧红外小目标(SIRST)检测在单点监督下的研究受到广泛关注。然而,最新的单点监督标签演化(LESPS)框架存在稳定性差、标签演化过度以及难以发挥嵌入网络性能等问题。受生物体逐步适应环境和持续积累知识的启发,我们构建了创新的渐进式主动学习(PAL)框架,推动现有SIRST检测网络逐步主动识别和学习更难样本。具体而言,为避免早期低性能模型导致硬样本选择错误,我们提出模型预启动概念,专注于自动选择部分易样本并帮助模型具备基础任务特定学习能力。同时,我们提出精细化双更新策略,可促进硬样本合理学习和伪标签持续优化。此外,为缓解标签演化过度风险,合理引入衰减因子,有助于实现目标标注扩展与收缩的动态平衡。大量实验表明,搭载PAL框架的现有SIRST检测网络在多个公开数据集上取得SOTA结果。此外,我们的PAL框架可构建全监督与单点监督任务间的高效稳定桥梁。代码已开源:https://github.com/YuChuang1205/PAL
abstract_en: Recently, single-frame infrared small target (SIRST) detection with single point supervision has drawn wide-spread attention. However, the latest label evolution with single point supervision (LESPS) framework suffers from instability, excessive label evolution, and difficulty in exerting embedded network performance. Inspired by organisms gradually adapting to their environment and continuously accumulating knowledge, we construct an innovative Progressive Active Learning (PAL) framework, which drives the existing SIRST detection networks progressively and actively recognizes and learns harder samples. Specifically, to avoid the early low-performance model leading to the wrong selection of hard samples, we propose a model pre-start concept, which focuses on automatically selecting a portion of easy samples and helping the model have basic task-specific learning capabilities. Meanwhile, we propose a refined dual-update strategy, which can promote reasonable learning of harder samples and continuous refinement of pseudo-labels. In addition, to alleviate the risk of excessive label evolution, a decay factor is reasonably introduced, which helps to achieve a dynamic balance between the expansion and contraction of target annotations. Extensive experiments show that existing SIRST detection networks equipped with our PAL framework have achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on multiple public datasets. Furthermore, our PAL framework can build an efficient and stable bridge between full supervision and single point supervision tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/YuChuang1205/PAL
authors: Chuang Yu, Jinmiao Zhao, Yunpeng Liu, Sicheng Zhao, Yimian Dai, Xiangyu Yue ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2588-2598

title: 从易到难:渐进式交错多图像推理的MIR基准
title_en: From Easy to Hard: The MIR Benchmark for Progressive Interleaved Multi-Image Reasoning
abstract: 多图像交错推理旨在提升多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)对多张图像及其关联文本上下文的联合理解和推理能力,其挑战超越了单图像或非交错多图像任务。当前多图像基准测试忽视了交错文本上下文,也未充分考虑单张图像与其关联文本之间的独特关系。使模型能够对多图像交错数据进行推理,可能显著增强其对复杂场景的理解能力,并更准确地捕捉跨模态关联。为弥合这一差距,我们提出了一种新型基准MIR,要求模型在多个图像及其交错文本上下文中进行联合推理,以准确关联图像区域与对应文本,并逻辑连接跨图像信息。为增强MLLMs对多图像交错数据的理解能力,我们在基准中为每个实例引入推理步骤,并提出分阶段课程学习策略。该策略遵循"从易到难"的渐进式方法,逐步引导模型从简单场景过渡到复杂场景,从而提升其处理挑战性任务的能力。大量实验评估表明,我们的方法在MIR及其他基准测试中显著提升了模型的推理性能,凸显了当前MLLMs在多图像交错推理中面临的挑战。我们相信MIR将推动多图像交错推理领域的进一步研究,促进MLLMs处理复杂跨模态任务能力的提升。
abstract_en: Multi-image Interleaved Reasoning aims to improve Multimodal Large Language Models' (MLLMs) ability to jointly comprehend and reason across multiple images and their associated textual contexts, introducing unique challenges beyond single-image or non-interleaved multi-image tasks.While current multi-image benchmarks overlook interleaved textual contexts and neglect distinct relationships between individual images and their associated texts, enabling models to reason over multi-image interleaved data may significantly enhance their comprehension of complex scenes and better capture cross-modal correlations.To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel benchmark MIR, requiring joint reasoning over multiple images accompanied by interleaved textual contexts to accurately associate image regions with corresponding texts and logically connect information across images.To enhance MLLMs' ability to comprehend multi-image interleaved data, we introduce reasoning steps for each instance within the benchmark and propose a stage-wise curriculum learning strategy. This strategy follows an "easy to hard" approach, progressively guiding models from simple to complex scenarios, thereby enhancing their ability to handle challenging tasks.Extensive experiments benchmarking multiple MLLMs demonstrate that our method significantly enhances models' reasoning performance on MIR and other established benchmarks, highlighting the challenges current MLLMs face with multi-image interleaved reasoning.We believe that MIR will encourage further research into multi-image interleaved reasoning, facilitating advancements in MLLMs' capability to handle complex inter-modal tasks.
authors: Hang Du, Jiayang Zhang, Guoshun Nan, Wendi Deng, Zhenyan Chen, Chenyang Zhang, Wang Xiao, Shan Huang, Yuqi Pan, Tao Qi, Sicong Leng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 859-869

title: 从增强到理解:通过语义一致的无监督微调构建低光照视觉的通用桥梁
title_en: From Enhancement to Understanding: Build a Generalized Bridge for Low-light Vision via Semantically Consistent Unsupervised Fine-tuning
abstract: 低光照视觉中的低层次增强与高层次视觉理解传统上被分别处理。低光照增强通过提升图像质量以支持下游任务,但现有方法依赖物理或几何先验,限制了泛化能力。评估主要聚焦于视觉质量而非下游性能。受限于稀缺的标注数据,低光照视觉理解主要采用任务特定的领域适应方法,缺乏可扩展性。为解决这些挑战,我们构建了连接低光照增强与低光照理解的通用桥梁,称为通用增强用于理解(Generalized Enhancement For Understanding, GEFU)。该范式同时提升了泛化能力与可扩展性。为应对低光照退化的多样化成因,我们利用预训练生成扩散模型优化图像,实现零样本泛化性能。在此基础上,我们提出语义一致的无监督微调(Semantically Consistent Unsupervised Fine-tuning, SCUF)。具体而言,为克服文本提示的局限性,我们引入光照感知图像提示以显式引导图像生成,并提出循环注意力适配器以最大化其语义潜力。为缓解无监督训练中的语义退化,我们提出标题与反射一致性以学习高层语义及图像级空间语义。大量实验表明,所提方法在传统图像质量及GEFU任务(包括分类、检测和语义分割)中均优于现有最先进方法。
abstract_en: Low-level enhancement and high-level visual understanding in low-light vision have traditionally been treated separately. Low-light enhancement improves image quality for downstream tasks, but existing methods rely on physical or geometric priors, limiting generalization. Evaluation mainly focuses on visual quality rather than downstream performance. Low-light visual understanding, constrained by scarce labeled data, primarily uses task-specific domain adaptation, which lacks scalability. To address these challenges, we build a generalized bridge between low-light enhancement and low-light understanding, which we term Generalized Enhancement For Understanding (GEFU). This paradigm improves both generalization and scalability. To address the diverse causes of low-light degradation, we leverage pretrained generative diffusion models to optimize images, achieving zero-shot generalization performance. Building on this, we propose Semantically Consistent Unsupervised Fine-tuning (SCUF). Specifically, to overcome text prompt limitations, we introduce an illumination-aware image prompt to explicitly guide image generation and propose a cycle-attention adapter to maximize its semantic potential. To mitigate semantic degradation in unsupervised training, we propose caption and reflectance consistency to learn high-level semantics and image-level spatial semantics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms current state-of-the-art methods in traditional image quality and GEFU tasks including classification, detection, and semantic segmentation.
authors: Sen Wang, Shao Zeng, Tianjun Gu, Zhizhong Zhang, Ruixin Zhang, Shouhong Ding, Jingyun Zhang, Jun Wang, Xin Tan, Yuan Xie, Lizhuang Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13804-13814

title: 从画廊到手腕:视频中的真实3D手镯插入
title_en: From Gallery to Wrist: Realistic 3D Bracelet Insertion in Videos
abstract: 将3D物体插入视频是计算机图形学中的长期挑战,应用领域包括增强现实、虚拟试穿和视频合成。实现时间一致性或逼真光照仍存在困难,尤其是在动态场景中,物体运动复杂、视角变化和光照条件多变的情况下。尽管2D扩散模型在生成逼真编辑方面展现出潜力,但往往难以在帧间保持时间一致性。相反,传统3D渲染方法在空间和时间一致性方面表现优异,但在实现逼真光照方面存在不足。在本工作中,我们提出了一种混合物体插入流程,结合了两种范式的优点。具体而言,我们专注于在动态手腕场景中插入手镯,利用3D高斯点云(3DGS)的高时间一致性进行初始渲染,并通过基于2D扩散的增强模型优化结果以确保逼真光照交互。我们的方法引入了基于光照的流程,分离物体的固有属性(漫反射、光照、反射率),并优化光照和sRGB图像以实现逼真效果。为保持时间一致性,我们通过多帧加权调整优化3DGS模型。这是首个将3D渲染与2D扩散相结合用于视频物体插入的方法,为真实且一致的视频编辑提供了稳健的解决方案。
abstract_en: Inserting 3D objects into videos is a longstanding challenge in computer graphics with applications in augmented reality, virtual try-on, and video composition. Achieving both temporal consistency, or realistic lighting remains difficult, particularly in dynamic scenarios with complex object motion, perspective changes, and varying illumination. While 2D diffusion models have shown promise for producing photorealistic edits, they often struggle with maintaining temporal coherence across frames. Conversely, traditional 3D rendering methods excel in spatial and temporal consistency but fall short in achieving photorealistic lighting. In this work, we propose a hybrid object insertion pipeline that combines the strengths of both paradigms. Specifically, we focus on inserting bracelets into dynamic wrist scenes, leveraging the high temporal consistency of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for initial rendering and refining the results using a 2D diffusion-based enhancement model to ensure realistic lighting interactions. Our method introduces a shading-driven pipeline that separates intrinsic object properties (albedo, shading, reflectance) and refines both shading and sRGB images for photorealism. To maintain temporal coherence, we optimize the 3DGS model with multi-frame weighted adjustments. This is the first approach to synergize 3D rendering and 2D diffusion for video object insertion, offering a robust solution for realistic and consistent video editing.
authors: Chenjian Gao, Lihe Ding, Rui Han, Zhanpeng Huang, Zibin Wang, Tianfan Xue ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25712-25721

title: 从注视到运动:基于程序化模仿学习的自动驾驶人机交互中视觉注意力预测
title_en: From Gaze to Movement: Predicting Visual Attention for Autonomous Driving Human-Machine Interaction based on Programmatic Imitation Learning
abstract: 人机交互技术不仅需要人类视觉注意力的分布,还需要预测注视点轨迹。我们提出了一种基于程序化模仿学习的PILOT方法,该方法通过一组基于规则的条件预测驾驶员的眼动。这些条件——来源于驾驶操作和交通流特征——定义了注视点如何转移。它们最初通过增量合成(一种启发式搜索方法)识别,随后通过L-BFGS(数值优化技术)进行优化。这些可读规则使我们能够理解驾驶员的眼动模式,并实现高效且可解释的预测。我们还提出了DATAD数据集,该数据集涵盖12种自动驾驶接管场景,收集自60名参与者,包含约60万帧注视点数据。与现有眼动追踪数据集相比,DATAD包含额外的驾驶指标和周围交通流特征,为建模注视行为提供了更丰富的上下文信息。在DATAD上对PILOT的实验评估表明,其准确性和预测速度均优于四个基线模型。具体而言,PILOT将预测轨迹的均方误差降低了38.59%至88.02%,并提高了注视目标预测的准确率6.90%至55.06%。此外,PILOT以约30%的预测时间降低实现了这些提升,提供了更准确且更高效的眼动预测。
abstract_en: Human-machine interaction technology requires not only the distribution of human visual attention but also the prediction of the gaze point trajectory. We introduce PILOT, a programmatic imitation learning approach that predicts a driver's eye movements based on a set of rule-based conditions. These conditions--derived from driving operations and traffic flow characteristics--define how gaze shifts occur. They are initially identified through incremental synthesis, a heuristic search method, and then refined via L-BFGS, a numerical optimization technique. These human-readable rules enable us to understand drivers' eye movement patterns and make efficient and explainable predictions. We also propose DATAD, a dataset that covers 12 types of autonomous driving takeover scenarios, collected from 60 participants and comprising approximately 600,000 frames of gaze point data. Compared to existing eye-tracking datasets, DATAD includes additional driving metrics and surrounding traffic flow characteristics, providing richer contextual information for modeling gaze behavior. Experimental evaluations of PILOT on DATAD demonstrate superior accuracy and faster prediction speeds compared to four baseline models. Specifically, PILOT reduces the MSE of predicted trajectories by 38.59% to 88.02% and improves the accuracy of gaze object predictions by 6.90% to 55.06%. Moreover, PILOT achieves these gains with approximately 30% lower prediction time, offering both more accurate and more efficient eye movement prediction.
authors: Yexin Huang, Yongbin Lin, Lishengsa Yue, Zhihong Yao, Jie Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26146-26155

title: 从整体到局部:用于高效视觉指令微调的局部增强适配器
title_en: From Holistic to Localized: Local Enhanced Adapters for Efficient Visual Instruction Fine-Tuning
abstract: 高效视觉指令微调(EVIT)旨在以最小的计算开销将多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)适配到下游任务。然而,随着任务多样性和复杂性的增加,EVIT在解决数据冲突方面面临显著挑战。为解决这一局限性,我们提出双低秩适配(Dual-LoRA),这是一种从整体到局部的框架,通过双结构优化增强适配器的容量以应对数据冲突。具体而言,我们利用两个子空间:一个用于稳定整体知识保留的技能空间,以及一个经过秩校正的任务空间,该空间局部激活整体知识。此外,我们引入了视觉线索增强(VCE),这是一种多级局部特征聚合模块,旨在通过局部细节丰富视觉-语言投影。我们的方法在内存和时间效率方面均表现优异,仅需标准LoRA方法(注入到查询和值投影层)的1.16倍推理时间,且仅需4专家LoRA-MoE的73%推理时间。在各种下游任务和通用MLLM基准测试上的大量实验验证了我们提出方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Efficient Visual Instruction Fine-Tuning (EVIT) seeks to adapt Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to downstream tasks with minimal computational overhead. However, as task diversity and complexity increase, EVIT faces significant challenges in resolving data conflicts. To address this limitation, we propose the Dual Low-Rank Adaptation (Dual-LoRA), a holistic-to-local framework that enhances the adapter's capacity to address data conflict through dual structural optimization. Specifically, we utilize two subspaces: a skill space for stable, holistic knowledge retention, and a rank-rectified task space that locally activates the holistic knowledge. Additionally, we introduce Visual Cue Enhancement (VCE), a multi-level local feature aggregation module designed to enrich the vision-language projection with local details. Our approach is both memory- and time-efficient, requiring only 1.16xthe inference time of the standard LoRA method (with injection into the query and value projection layers), and just 73% of the inference time of a 4-expert LoRA-MoE. Extensive experiments on various downstream tasks and general MLLM benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our proposed methods.
authors: Pengkun Jiao, Bin Zhu, Jingjing Chen, Chong-Wah Ngo, Yu-Gang Jiang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2728-2737

title: 从图像到视频:扩散表征的实证研究
title_en: From Image to Video: An Empirical Study of Diffusion Representations
abstract: 扩散模型彻底革新了生成建模领域,使图像和视频合成达到了前所未有的真实感。这一成功激发了利用其表示进行视觉理解任务的研究兴趣。尽管近期研究已探索了其在图像生成中的潜力,但视频扩散模型的视觉理解能力仍鲜有研究。为填补这一空白,我们分析了潜在图像和视频扩散表征在图像分类、动作识别、深度估计和跟踪等下游任务中的表现。为实现最具信息量的对比,我们在图像和视频生成目标中均采用相同的模型架构WALT。实验结果表明,视频生成预训练始终优于其图像对应模型,但我们在其优越程度的范围上发现了显著差异。我们进一步分析了不同层和不同噪声水平提取的特征,以及模型规模和训练预算对表征质量和生成效果的影响。本工作首次直接比较了视频与图像扩散目标在视觉理解中的表现,揭示了时序信息在表征学习中的作用。
abstract_en: Diffusion models have revolutionized generative modeling, enabling unprecedented realism in image and video synthesis.This success has sparked interest in leveraging their representations for visual understanding tasks. While recent works have explored this potential for image generation, the visual understanding capabilities of video diffusion models remain largely uncharted. To address this gap, we analyze the performance of latent image and video diffusion representations on various downstream tasks including image classification, action recognition, depth estimation, and tracking. For the most informative comparison, we utilize the same model architecture, WALT, across image and video generation objectives. Our results show that video generation pre-training consistently outperforms its image counterpart, though we find a striking range in the extent of this superiority. We further analyze features extracted from different layers and with varying noise levels, as well as the effect of model size and training budget on representation and generation quality. This work marks the first direct comparison of video and image diffusion objectives for visual understanding, offering insights into the role of temporal information in representation learning.
authors: Pedro Vélez, Luisa F. Polanía, Yi Yang, Chuhan Zhang, Rishabh Kabra, Anurag Arnab, Mehdi S. M. Sajjadi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16948-16958

title: 从模仿到创新:AI独特艺术风格的兴起与版权保护的挑战
title_en: From Imitation to Innovation: The Emergence of AI's Unique Artistic Styles and the Challenge of Copyright Protection
abstract: 现行法律框架认为,当AI生成作品满足原创性要求并包含实质性的人类智力投入时,可获得版权保护。然而,系统化的法律标准和可靠的AI艺术版权评估方法仍显不足。通过全面分析法律判例,我们确立了判定独特艺术风格的三大核心标准:风格一致性、创意独特性与表达准确性。为应对这些挑战,我们提出了ArtBulb,一个可解释且可量化的AI艺术版权判断框架,该框架结合了基于新型风格描述的多模态聚类方法与多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)。我们还发布了AICD,首个由艺术家与法律专家标注的AI艺术版权基准数据集。实验结果表明,ArtBulb在定量与定性评估中均优于现有模型。我们的工作旨在弥合法律与技术社区间的鸿沟,并引起对AI艺术版权社会议题的更多关注。
abstract_en: Current legal frameworks consider AI-generated works eligible for copyright protection when they meet originality requirements and involve substantial human intellectual input. However, systematic legal standards and reliable evaluation methods for AI art copyrights are lacking. Through comprehensive analysis of legal precedents, we establish three essential criteria for determining distinctive artistic style: stylistic consistency, creative uniqueness, and expressive accuracy. To address these challenges, we introduce ArtBulb, an interpretable and quantifiable framework for AI art copyright judgment that combines a novel style description-based multimodal clustering method with multimodal large language models (MLLMs). We also present AICD, the first benchmark dataset for AI art copyright annotated by artists and legal experts. Experimental results demonstrate that ArtBulb outperforms existing models in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations. Our work aims to bridge the gap between the legal and technological communities and bring greater attention to the societal issue of AI art copyrights.
authors: Zexi Jia, Chuanwei Huang, Yeshuang Zhu, Hongyan Fei, Ying Deng, Zhiqiang Yuan, Jiapei Zhang, Jinchao Zhang, Jie Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18980-18989

title: 从线性到非线性:掩码自编码器如何捕捉空间相关性
title_en: From Linearity to Non-Linearity: How Masked Autoencoders Capture Spatial Correlations
abstract: 掩码自编码器(MAEs)已成为视觉基础模型的强大预训练技术。尽管其效果显著,但在应用于新数据集时仍需对掩码比例、块大小、编码器/解码器层数等超参数进行大量调优。虽然先前的理论工作已从注意力模式和层次化潜在变量模型的角度分析了MAEs,但MAE超参数与下游任务性能之间的联系尚未被充分探索。本文研究了MAEs如何学习输入图像中的空间相关性。我们分析性地推导了线性MAE所学习的特征,并证明掩码比例和块大小可用于选择捕捉短程和长程空间相关性的特征。我们将这一分析扩展到非线性MAE,展示MAE表征能够超越二阶统计量地适应数据集中的空间相关性。最后,我们讨论了在实践中如何选择MAE超参数的一些见解。
abstract_en: Masked Autoencoders (MAEs) have emerged as a powerful pretraining technique for vision foundation models. Despite their effectiveness, they require extensive hyperparameter tuning (masking ratio, patch size, encoder/decoder layers) when applied to novel datasets. While prior theoretical works have analyzed MAEs in terms of their attention patterns and hierarchical latent variable models, the connection between MAE hyperparameters and performance on downstream tasks is relatively unexplored. This work investigates how MAEs learn spatial correlations in the input image. We analytically derive the features learned by a linear MAE and show that masking ratio and patch size can be used to select for features that capture short- and long-range spatial correlations. We extend this analysis to non-linear MAEs to show that MAE representations adapt to spatial correlations in the dataset, beyond second-order statistics. Finally, we discuss some insights on how to select MAE hyper-parameters in practice.
authors: Anthony Bisulco, Rahul Ramesh, Randall Balestriero, Pratik Chaudhari ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16441-16450

title: 从对象到事件:通过大语言模型引导的符号推理解锁目标检测器的复杂视觉理解
title_en: From Objects to Events: Unlocking Complex Visual Understanding in Object Detectors via LLM-guided Symbolic Reasoning
abstract: 当前目标检测器在实体定位和分类方面表现出色,但在事件识别能力上存在固有局限性。这种缺陷源于其架构更侧重于离散对象识别,而非建模组成推理、物体间相关性及上下文语义等对全面事件理解至关重要的要素。为解决这一挑战,我们提出了一种新颖框架,通过大语言模型引导的符号推理,将标准目标检测器的能力扩展至复杂事件理解。我们的关键创新在于无需昂贵的特定任务训练即可弥合目标检测与事件理解之间的语义鸿沟。所提出的即插即用框架可与任何开放词汇检测器兼容,同时扩展其固有能力至不同架构。其核心方法结合了(i)探索检测实体间关系模式的符号回归机制,以及(ii)由大语言模型引导的策略性搜索方向。这些发现的符号规则将低级视觉感知转化为可解释的事件理解,提供从对象到事件的透明推理路径,并在跨领域具有强迁移性。我们对比了训练无关框架与专用事件识别系统在多样化应用场景中的表现。实验表明,该框架可增强多种目标检测器架构以识别复杂事件,如非法捕鱼活动(75 %AUROC,+8.36 %提升)、施工安全违规(+15.77%)和异常人群行为(+23.16%)。
abstract_en: Current object detectors excel at entity localization and classification, yet exhibit inherent limitations in event recognition capabilities. This deficiency arises from their architecture's emphasis on discrete object identification rather than modeling the compositional reasoning, inter-object correlations, and contextual semantics essential for comprehensive event understanding. To address this challenge, we present a novel framework that expands the capability of standard object detectors beyond mere object recognition to complex event understanding through LLM-guided symbolic reasoning. Our key innovation lies in bridging the semantic gap between object detection and event understanding without requiring expensive task-specific training. The proposed plug-and-play framework interfaces with any open-vocabulary detector while extending their inherent capabilities across architectures. At its core, our approach combines (i) a symbolic regression mechanism exploring relationship patterns among detected entities and (ii) a LLM-guided strategically guiding the search toward meaningful expressions. These discovered symbolic rules transform low-level visual perception into interpretable event understanding, providing a transparent reasoning path from objects to events with strong transferability across domains.We compared our training-free framework against specialized event recognition systems across diverse application domains. Experiments demonstrate that our framework enhances multiple object detector architectures to recognize complex events such as illegal fishing activities (75 %AUROC, +8.36 %improvement), construction safety violations (+15.77%), and abnormal crowd behaviors (+23.16%).
authors: Yuhui Zeng, Haoxiang Wu, Wenjie Nie, Guangyao Chen, Xiawu Zheng, Yunhang Shen, Jun Peng, Yonghong Tian, Rongrong Ji ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24380-24391

title: 从单一到多样:面向3D生成的上下文部分潜在表示
title_en: From One to More: Contextual Part Latents for 3D Generation
abstract: 为生成3D物体,早期研究主要聚焦于依赖2D渲染的多视角驱动方法。近期,3D原生潜在扩散范式在3D生成中展现出优越性能,因其能充分利用真实3D数据提供的几何信息。尽管其发展迅速,3D扩散仍面临三大挑战。首先,多数方法以单一潜在表示3D物体,无论其复杂程度,这可能导致生成多部件复杂物体时出现细节丢失。其次,多数3D资产分部件设计,但当前整体潜在表示忽视了部件的独立性及其相互关系,限制了模型的生成能力。第三,现有方法依赖全局条件(如文本、图像、点云)控制生成过程,缺乏细节可控性。因此,受3D设计师创建物体方式启发,我们提出新的基于部件的3D生成框架CoPart,通过多个上下文部件潜在表示3D物体,并同步生成连贯的3D部件。该基于部件的框架具有以下优势:i)通过将复杂物体分解为简单部件降低编码负担;ii)促进部件学习与部件关系建模;iii)自然支持部件级控制。此外,为确保部件潜在表示的连贯性并利用基础模型的强大先验,我们提出新颖的相互指导策略,用于微调预训练扩散模型进行联合部件潜在去噪。得益于基于部件的表示,我们证明CoPart可支持部件编辑、可变形物体生成及微型场景生成等应用。此外,我们通过自动网格分割及后续人工标注,从Objaverse收集了新的大规模3D部件数据集Partverse。在该数据集上训练后,CoPart实现了具有高可控性的基于部件的3D生成。项目页面:https://hkdsc.github.io/project/copart.
abstract_en: To generate 3D objects, early research focused on multi-view-driven approaches relying solely on 2D renderings. Recently, the 3D native latent diffusion paradigm has demonstrated superior performance in 3D generation, because it fully leverages the geometric information provided in ground truth 3D data. Despite its fast development, 3D diffusion still faces three challenges. First, the majority of these methods represent a 3D object by one single latent, regardless of its complexity. This may lead to detail loss when generating 3D objects with multiple complicated parts. Second, most 3D assets are designed parts by parts, yet the current holistic latent representation overlooks the independence of these parts and their interrelationships, limiting the model's generative ability. Third, current methods rely on global conditions (e.g., text, image, point cloud) to control the generation process, lacking detailed controllability. Therefore, motivated by how 3D designers create a 3D object, we present a new part-based 3D generation framework, CoPart, which represents a 3D object with multiple contextual part latents and simultaneously generates coherent 3D parts. This part-based framework has several advantages, including: i) reduces the encoding burden of intricate objects by decomposing them into simpler parts, ii) facilitates part learning and part relationship modeling, and iii) naturally supports part-level control. Furthermore, to ensure the coherence of part latents and to harness the powerful priors from foundation models, we propose a novel mutual guidance strategy to fine-tune pre-trained diffusion models for joint part latent denoising. Benefiting from the part-based representation, we demonstrate that CoPart can support various applications including part-editing, articulated object generation, and mini-scene generation. Moreover, we collect a new large-scale 3D part dataset named Partverse from Objaverse through automatic mesh segmentation and subsequent human post-annotations. By training on the proposed dataset, CoPart achieves promising part-based 3D generation with high controllability. Project page: https://hkdsc.github.io/project/copart.
authors: Shaocong Dong, Lihe Ding, Xiao Chen, Yaokun Li, Yuxin Wang, Yucheng Wang, Qi Wang, Jaehyeok Kim, Chenjian Gao, Zhanpeng Huang, Zibin Wang, Tianfan Xue, Dan Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8230-8240

title: 从分镜到散文:从漫画生成文学叙事
title_en: From Panels to Prose: Generating Literary Narratives from Comics
abstract: 漫画长期以来一直是流行的故事叙述形式,提供视觉上引人入胜的叙事,吸引全球观众。然而,漫画的视觉特性对视觉障碍读者构成了重大障碍,限制了他们接触这些引人入胜故事的途径。在本工作中,我们通过开发一个自动化系统来解决这一可访问性挑战,该系统能够从漫画中生成基于文本的文学叙事。我们的方法旨在创造一种富有表现力和沉浸感的散文,不仅传达原始叙事,还能捕捉角色的深度和复杂性、他们的互动以及他们所处的生动场景。为此,我们做出以下贡献:(1) 我们提出了一种统一模型Magiv3,在漫画理解的各种功能任务中表现出色,如分镜定位、角色定位、文本识别、气泡尾部识别、OCR、角色定位等。(2) 我们发布了超过3300个日本漫画分镜的人工标注描述文本,以及角色定位标注,并基准测试大型视觉-语言模型对漫画图像的理解能力。(3) 最后,我们展示了如何通过将大型视觉-语言模型与Magiv3集成,生成无缝的文学叙事,使视觉障碍受众能够体验漫画叙事的深度和丰富性。我们的代码、训练模型和数据集标注已公开获取。
abstract_en: Comics have long been a popular form of storytelling, offering visually engaging narratives that captivate audiences worldwide. However, the visual nature of comics presents a significant barrier for visually impaired readers, limiting their access to these engaging stories. In this work, we provide a pragmatic solution to this accessibility challenge by developing an automated system that generates text-based literary narratives from manga comics. Our approach aims to create an evocative and immersive prose that not only conveys the original narrative but also captures the depth and complexity of characters, their interactions, and the vivid settings in which they reside.To this end we make the following contributions: (1) We present a unified model, Magiv3, that excels at various functional tasks pertaining to comic understanding, such as localising panels, characters, texts, and speech-bubble tails, performing OCR, grounding characters etc. (2) We release human-annotated captions for over 3300 Japanese comic panels, along with character grounding annotations, and benchmark large vision-language models in their ability to understand comic images. (3) Finally, we demonstrate how integrating large vision-language models with Magiv3, can generate seamless literary narratives that allows visually impaired audiences to engage with the depth and richness of comic storytelling. Our code, trained model and dataset annotations are publicly available.
authors: Ragav Sachdeva, Andrew Zisserman ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21864-21873

title: 从提示到演进:驯服视频扩散模型实现无缝属性过渡
title_en: From Prompt to Progression: Taming Video Diffusion Models for Seamless Attribute Transition
abstract: 现有模型在处理复杂时间变化时往往存在困难,特别是在生成具有渐进属性过渡的视频时。最常见的运动过渡提示插值方法在处理渐进属性过渡时往往失效,导致不一致性更加显著。相比之下,我们通过在去噪过程中引入帧级引导,将模型扩展为生成平滑且一致的属性过渡。我们的方法为每个噪声潜变量构建数据特定的过渡方向,引导属性从初始状态逐步过渡到最终状态,同时保持视频的运动动态。此外,我们提出了结合属性和运动动态的可控属性过渡基准测试集(CAT-Bench),以全面评估不同模型的性能。我们进一步提出两个指标,用于评估属性过渡的准确性和平滑度。实验结果表明,我们的方法在视觉保真度、文本提示对齐度以及无缝属性过渡方面均优于现有基线方法。
abstract_en: Existing models often struggle with complex temporal changes, particularly when generating videos with gradual attribute transitions.The most common prompt interpolation approach for motion transitions often fails to handle gradual attribute transitions, where inconsistencies tend to become more pronounced. In contrast, we extend the model to generate smooth and consistent attribute transitions by introducing frame-wise guidance for the video latent during the denoising process. Our approach constructs a data-specific transitional direction for each noisy latent, guiding the gradual shift from initial to final attributes frame by frame while preserving the motion dynamics of the video. Moreover, we present the Controlled-Attribute-Transition Benchmark (CAT-Bench), which integrates both attribute and motion dynamics, to comprehensively evaluate the performance of different models. We further propose two metrics to assess the accuracy and smoothness of attribute transitions. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach performs favorably against existing baselines, achieving visual fidelity, maintaining alignment with text prompts, and delivering seamless attribute transitions.
authors: Ling Lo, Kelvin C.K. Chan, Wen-Huang Cheng, Ming-Hsuan Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18651-18660

title: 从反思到完美:通过反思调优实现文本到图像扩散模型的推理时间优化扩展
title_en: From Reflection to Perfection: Scaling Inference-Time Optimization for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Reflection Tuning
abstract: 近期文本到图像扩散模型通过大量扩展训练数据和模型参数取得了令人印象深刻的视觉质量,但往往在处理复杂场景和细粒度细节时存在困难。受大语言模型中涌现的自我反思能力启发,我们提出ReflectionFlow,一个在推理时间框架下使扩散模型能够迭代反思并优化输出的框架。ReflectionFlow引入三个互补的推理时间扩展轴:(1) 噪声级扩展以优化潜在空间初始化;(2) 提示级扩展用于精确语义引导;最值得注意的是,(3) 反思级扩展,通过显式提供可操作的反思来迭代评估和修正先前生成。为促进反思级扩展,我们构建了GenRef,一个包含100万组三元组的大规模数据集,每组包含一个反思、一个有缺陷图像和一个增强图像。利用该数据集,我们通过统一框架内联合建模多模态输入,高效地对最先进的扩散Transformer模型FLUX.1-dev进行反思调优。实验结果表明,ReflectionFlow显著优于简单的噪声级扩展方法,为具有挑战性的任务提供了可扩展且计算高效的高质量图像合成解决方案。所有代码、检查点和数据集均可在https://diffusion-cot.github.io/reflection2perfection获取。
abstract_en: Recent text-to-image diffusion models achieve impressive visual quality through extensive scaling of training data and model parameters, yet they often struggle with complex scenes and fine-grained details. Inspired by the self-reflection capabilities emergent in large language models, we propose ReflectionFlow, an inference-time framework enabling diffusion models to iteratively reflect upon and refine their outputs. ReflectionFlow introduces three complementary inference-time scaling axes: (1) noise-level scaling to optimize latent initialization; (2) prompt-level scaling for precise semantic guidance; and most notably, (3) reflection-level scaling, which explicitly provides actionable reflections to iteratively assess and correct previous generations. To facilitate reflection-level scaling, we construct GenRef, a large-scale dataset comprising 1 million triplets, each containing a reflection, a flawed image, and an enhanced image. Leveraging this dataset, we efficiently perform reflection tuning on state-of-the-art diffusion transformer, FLUX.1-dev, by jointly modeling multimodal inputs within a unified framework. Experimental results show that ReflectionFlow significantly outperforms naive noise-level scaling methods, offering a scalable and compute-efficient solution toward higher-quality image synthesis on challenging tasks. All code, checkpoints, and datasets are available at https://diffusion-cot.github.io/reflection2perfection.
authors: Le Zhuo, Liangbing Zhao, Sayak Paul, Yue Liao, Renrui Zhang, Yi Xin, Peng Gao, Mohamed Elhoseiny, Hongsheng Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15329-15339

title: 从重用到预测:基于TaylorSeers加速扩散模型
title_en: From Reusing to Forecasting: Accelerating Diffusion Models with TaylorSeers
abstract: 扩散变换器(DiT)在高保真图像和视频合成领域取得了革命性进展,但其计算需求仍限制了实时应用的可行性。为解决这一问题,研究者提出了特征缓存方法,通过缓存前序时间步的特征并在后续时间步复用,以加速扩散模型。然而,在时间步间隔较大的情况下,扩散模型的特征相似性显著下降,导致特征缓存引入的误差大幅增加,严重损害生成质量。为解决该问题,我们提出TaylorSeer方法,首次证明扩散模型未来时间步的特征可基于前序时间步的特征值进行预测。基于特征在时间步间缓慢连续变化的特性,TaylorSeer采用微分方法近似特征的高阶导数,并通过泰勒级数展开预测未来时间步的特征。大量实验验证了其在图像和视频合成中的显著有效性,尤其在高加速比场景下表现突出。例如,在FLUX和HunyuanVideo上实现近无损加速4.99x和5.00x,无需额外训练。在DiT上,其4.53x加速下FID比先前SOTA低3.41。我们的代码已开源至Github:https://github.com/Shenyi-Z/TaylorSeer
abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiT) have revolutionized high-fidelity image and video synthesis, yet their computational demands remain prohibitive for real-time applications.To solve this problem, feature caching has been proposed to accelerate diffusion models by caching the features in the previous timesteps and then reusing them in the following timesteps.However, at timesteps with significant intervals, the feature similarity in diffusion models decreases substantially, leading to a pronounced increase in errors introduced by feature caching, significantly harming the generation quality.To solve this problem, we propose TaylorSeer, which firstly shows that features of diffusion models at future timesteps can be predicted based on their values at previous timesteps.Based on the fact that features change slowly and continuously across timesteps, TaylorSeer employs a differential method to approximate the higher-order derivatives of features and predict features in future timesteps with Taylor series expansion. Extensive experiments demonstrate its significant effectiveness in both image and video synthesis, especially in high acceleration ratios.For instance, it achieves an almost lossless acceleration of 4.99xon FLUX and 5.00xon HunyuanVideo without additional training. On DiT, it achieves 3.41 lower FID compared with previous SOTA at 4.53xacceleration. Our codes have been released in Github: https://github.com/Shenyi-Z/TaylorSeer
authors: Jiacheng Liu, Chang Zou, Yuanhuiyi Lyu, Junjie Chen, Linfeng Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15853-15863

title: 从清晰到模糊:基于事件相机的无监督域适应在极端运动模糊下的二维人体姿态估计
title_en: From Sharp to Blur: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for 2D Human Pose Estimation Under Extreme Motion Blur Using Event Cameras
abstract: 人体姿态估计对于康复、体育分析和增强现实/虚拟现实系统等应用至关重要。然而,快速运动和低光条件通常会引入运动模糊,由于清晰图像与模糊图像之间的域差距,显著降低姿态估计性能。大多数数据集假设稳定条件,导致在清晰图像上训练的模型在模糊环境中表现不佳。为解决这一问题,我们引入了一种新颖的域适应方法,利用事件相机,其能够捕捉高时间分辨率的运动数据并固有地鲁棒于运动模糊。通过基于事件的增强,我们生成运动感知的模糊图像,有效弥合清晰与模糊域之间的域差距,无需配对注释。此外,我们开发了一个学生-教师框架,通过迭代优化伪标签,利用相互不确定性掩码消除错误标签,实现更有效的学习。实验结果表明,我们的方法优于传统域自适应人体姿态估计方法,在运动模糊下无需目标域注释即可实现鲁棒姿态估计。我们的研究结果突显了事件相机作为可扩展且有效的域适应解决方案在现实运动模糊环境中的潜力。项目代码可在https://github.com/kmax2001/EvSharp2Blur获取。
abstract_en: Human pose estimation is critical for applications such as rehabilitation, sports analytics, and AR/VR systems. However, rapid motion and low-light conditions often introduce motion blur, significantly degrading pose estimation due to the domain gap between sharp and blurred images. Most datasets assume stable conditions, making models trained on sharp images struggle in blurred environments. To address this, we introduce a novel domain adaptation approach that leverages event cameras, which capture high temporal resolution motion data and are inherently robust to motion blur. Using event-based augmentation, we generate motion-aware blurred images, effectively bridging the domain gap between sharp and blurred domains without requiring paired annotations. Additionally, we develop a student-teacher framework that iteratively refines pseudo-labels, leveraging mutual uncertainty masking to eliminate incorrect labels and enable more effective learning. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms conventional domain-adaptive human pose estimation methods, achieving robust pose estimation under motion blur without requiring annotations in the target domain. Our findings highlight the potential of event cameras as a scalable and effective solution for domain adaptation in real-world motion blur environments. Our project codes are available at https://github.com/kmax2001/EvSharp2Blur.
authors: Youngho Kim, Hoonhee Cho, Kuk-Jin Yoon ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9406-9417

title: 从试错到成功:通过视觉上下文采样扩展与自奖励对齐推进长视频理解
title_en: From Trial to Triumph: Advancing Long Video Understanding via Visual Context Sample Scaling and Self-reward Alignment
abstract: 多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)在视频理解方面展现出显著能力。然而,理解长视频仍面临挑战,因为模型在单次推理中只能处理有限数量的帧,可能遗漏关键视觉信息。为解决这一挑战,我们提出通过视觉上下文采样生成多个预测,随后通过评分机制选择最终预测。具体而言,我们设计了一种分箱采样策略,使MLLMs能够基于不同关键帧组合生成多样化答案,从而丰富视觉上下文。为从采样答案中确定最终预测,我们采用自奖励机制,通过线性组合三个得分:(1) 频率得分,反映各选项的普遍性;(2) 边际置信度得分,体现MLLM预测的样本间-样本内确定性;(3) 推理得分,针对不同问题类型,包括全局问题的线索引导作答和局部问题的时序自聚焦。频率得分通过多数正确性确保鲁棒性,置信度对齐得分反映预测确定性,类型化推理得分则通过定制策略处理稀疏关键视觉信息的案例。实验表明,该方法在七组数据集上覆盖了长视频问题的正确答案,且在三个MLLMs的性能上均取得提升。
abstract_en: Multi-modal Large language models (MLLMs) show remarkable ability in video understanding. Nevertheless, understanding long videos remains challenging as the models can only process a finite number of frames in a single inference, potentially omitting crucial visual information. To address the challenge, we propose generating multiple predictions through visual context sampling, followed by a scoring mechanism to select the final prediction. Specifically, we devise a bin-wise sampling strategy that enables MLLMs to generate diverse answers based on various combinations of keyframes, thereby enriching the visual context. To determine the final prediction from the sampled answers, we employ a self-reward by linearly combining three scores: (1) a frequency score indicating the prevalence of each option, (2) a marginal confidence score reflecting the inter-intra sample certainty of MLLM predictions, and (3) a reasoning score for different question types, including clue-guided answering for global questions and temporal self-refocusing for local questions. The frequency score ensures robustness through majority correctness, the confidence-aligned score reflects prediction certainty, and the typed-reasoning score addresses cases with sparse key visual information using tailored strategies. Experiments show that this approach covers the correct answer for a high percentage of long video questions, on seven datasets show that our method improves the performance of three MLLMs.
authors: Yucheng Suo, Fan Ma, Linchao Zhu, Tianyi Wang, Fengyun Rao, Yi Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23243-23255

title: FuXi-RTM:一种基于物理引导的辐射传输建模预测框架
title_en: FuXi-RTM: A Physics-Guided Prediction Framework with Radiative Transfer Modeling
abstract: 与传统视频生成类似,当前基于深度学习的天气预测框架往往缺乏显式物理约束,导致产生非物理输出,限制了其在业务预报中的可靠性。在需要准确表征的各类物理过程中,辐射起着基础性作用,因为它驱动着地球的天气和气候系统。然而,由于其固有的复杂性和高计算成本,传统数值天气预报(NWP)模型在准确模拟辐射传输过程方面仍面临挑战。本文提出FuXi-RTM,这是一种混合物理引导的深度学习框架,旨在提升天气预报精度同时确保物理一致性。FuXi-RTM将主预测模型(FuXi)与固定深度学习辐射传输模型(DLRTM)替代模型相结合,高效替代传统辐射参数化方案。这是首个明确纳入物理过程建模的深度学习天气预测框架。在涵盖5年的综合数据集评估中,FuXi-RTM在3320个变量和预报时效组合中88.51%的情况下优于无约束版本,辐射通量预测性能得到提升。通过引入额外的物理过程,FuXi-RTM为下一代兼具高精度与物理一致性的天气预报系统奠定了基础。
abstract_en: Similar to conventional video generation, current deep learning-based weather prediction frameworks often lack explicit physical constraints, leading to unphysical outputs that limit their reliability for operational forecasting. Among various physical processes requiring proper representation, radiation plays a fundamental role as it drives Earth's weather and climate systems. However, accurate simulation of radiative transfer processes remains challenging for traditional numerical weather prediction (NWP) models due to their inherent complexity and high computational costs. Here, we propose FuXi-RTM, a hybrid physics-guided deep learning framework designed to enhance weather forecast accuracy while enforcing physical consistency. FuXi-RTM integrates a primary forecasting model (FuXi) with a fixed deep learning-based radiative transfer model (DLRTM) surrogate that efficiently replaces conventional radiation parameterization schemes. This represents the first deep learning-based weather forecasting framework to explicitly incorporate physical process modeling. Evaluated over a comprehensive 5-year dataset, FuXi-RTM outperforms its unconstrained counterpart in 88.51% of 3320 variable and lead time combinations, with improvements in radiative flux predictions. By incorporating additional physical processes, FuXi-RTM paves the way for next-generation weather forecasting systems that are both accurate and physically consistent.
authors: Qiusheng Huang, Xiaohui Zhong, Xu Fan, Hao Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8852-8862

title: FullDiT:基于全注意力的多模态控制视频生成基础模型
title_en: FullDiT: Video Generative Foundation Models with Multimodal Control via Full Attention
abstract: 当前视频生成基础模型主要聚焦于文本到视频任务,对细粒度视频内容创作的控制能力有限。尽管基于适配器的方法(如ControlNet)通过最小微调实现了额外的控制,但在整合多种条件时仍面临挑战,包括:独立训练适配器间的分支冲突、参数冗余导致计算成本增加,以及与全微调相比性能次优。为解决这些问题,我们提出FullDiT,这是一种通过统一全注意力机制无缝集成多种条件的视频生成统一基础模型。通过将多任务条件融合为统一序列表示,并利用全自注意力的长上下文学习能力捕捉条件动态,FullDiT降低了参数开销、避免条件冲突,并展现出可扩展性和涌现能力。我们进一步引入FullBench用于多任务视频生成评估。实验表明,FullDiT取得了最先进结果,突显了全注意力在复杂多任务视频生成中的有效性。
abstract_en: Current video generative foundation models primarily focus on text-to-video tasks, providing limited control for fine-grained video content creation. Although adapter-based approaches (e.g., ControlNet) enable additional controls with minimal fine-tuning, they encounter challenges when integrating multiple conditions, including: branch conflicts between independently trained adapters, parameter redundancy leading to increased computational cost, and suboptimal performance compared to full fine-tuning. To address these challenges, we introduce FullDiT, a unified foundation model for video generation that seamlessly integrates multiple conditions via unified full-attention mechanisms. By fusing multi-task conditions into a unified sequence representation and leveraging the long-context learning ability of full self-attention to capture condition dynamics, FullDiT reduces parameter overhead, avoids conditions conflict, and shows scalability and emergent ability. We further introduce FullBench for multi-task video generation evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that FullDiT achieves state-of-the-art results, highlighting the efficacy of full-attention in complex multi-task video generation.
authors: Xuan Ju, Weicai Ye, Quande Liu, Qiulin Wang, Xintao Wang, Pengfei Wan, Di Zhang, Kun Gai, Qiang Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15737-15747

title: 以功能为中心的贝叶斯网络用于零样本物体目标导航
title_en: Function-centric Bayesian Network for Zero-Shot Object Goal Navigation
abstract: 物体目标导航要求智能体在未见环境中无需显式地图即可导航至指定目标,这需要理解物体-场景上下文以基于部分观测推断目标位置。物体的功能在其分类和命名中起着至关重要的作用。分析物体在给定场景中的功能性角色可以增强对其上下文关系的理解,从而有助于目标推断。本文提出面向零样本物体导航任务的以功能为中心的贝叶斯网络(FBN)。FBN旨在揭示观测物体单独或与其他物体协作所赋予的功能,以及观测场景中包含的功能语义。FBN中的概率有向边描述物体-功能和场景-功能关系,这些关系通过提出的CounterfactCoT提示大型语言模型(LLMs)获得。利用贝叶斯推断结合FBN,可计算每个功能组的概率及目标出现的概率图。随后根据获得的概率图选择路标点。在MP3D和HM3D上的实验表明,FBN有效捕捉了物体-场景-功能关系,提升了零样本物体导航性能。
abstract_en: Object goal navigation requires an agent to navigate to a specified target in unseen environments without an explicit map, which demands an understanding of object-scene context to infer the target's location based on partial observations. The function of an object plays a crucial role in its categorization and naming. Analyzing an object's functional role within a given scene enhances the understanding of its contextual relationships, thereby aiding in goal inference. In this paper, we propose the Function-centric Bayesian Network (FBN) for the zero-shot ObjectNav task. FBN is designed to uncover the functions that observed objects afford individually or collaboratively with other objects, as well as the functional semantics contained within the observed scenes. The probabilistic directed edges in FBN describe the object-function and scene-function relationships, which are derived by prompting LLMs with the proposed CounterfactCoT. Leveraging FBN with Bayesian inference, the probability of each function group and probability map of goal occurrence are computed. Then the waypoint is selected based on obtained probability map. Experiments on MP3D and HM3D demonstrate that FBN effectively captures object-scene-function relationships and improves zero-shot ObjectNav performance.
authors: Sixian Zhang, Xinyao Yu, Xinhang Song, Yiyao Wang, Shuqiang Jiang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19535-19545

title: 先融合后迁移:异构知识蒸馏中的知识融合
title_en: Fuse Before Transfer: Knowledge Fusion for Heterogeneous Distillation
abstract: 大多数知识蒸馏(KD)方法聚焦于具有相似架构的教师-学生对,例如均为卷积神经网络(CNN)模型。通过将KD扩展到跨架构知识蒸馏(CAKD),可以显著提升其潜力和灵活性,其中可选择性地蒸馏同构和异构教师的知识。然而,异构模型(如ViT教师与CNN学生)之间显著的特征差异使CAKD极具挑战性,这源于固有归纳偏置和模块功能的差异。为此,我们提出在将知识从教师迁移至学生之前进行异构知识融合。该融合通过合并直接源自教师和学生模块功能的不同组合的卷积、注意力和MLP模块,结合跨架构归纳偏置和模块功能的优势。此外,异构特征表现出多样的空间分布,阻碍了传统逐像素均方误差(MSE)损失的有效性。因此,我们采用空间无关的InfoNCE损失替代。我们的方法在各类同构模型和任意异构组合(包括CNN、ViT和MLP)中进行了评估,在CIFAR-100上最大增益达到11.47%,在ImageNet-1K上达到3.67%。代码已开源至https://github.com/liguopeng0923/FBT。
abstract_en: Most knowledge distillation (KD) methods focus on teacher-student pairs with similar architectures, such as both being CNN models. The potential and flexibility of KD can be greatly improved by expanding it to Cross-Architecture KD (CAKD), where the knowledge of homogeneous and heterogeneous teachers can be distilled selectively. However, substantial feature gaps between heterogeneous models (e.g., ViT teacher v.s. CNN student) make CAKD extremely challenging, caused by the distinction of inherent inductive biases and module functions. To this end, we fuse heterogeneous knowledge before transferring it from teacher to student. This fusion combines the advantages of both cross-architecture inductive biases and module functions by merging different combinations of convolution, attention, and MLP modules derived directly from student and teacher module functions. Furthermore, heterogeneous features exhibit diverse spatial distributions, hindering the effectiveness of conventional pixel-wise MSE loss. Therefore, we replace it with a spatial-agnostic InfoNCE loss. Our method is evaluated across various homogeneous models and arbitrary heterogeneous combinations of CNNs, ViTs, and MLPs, yielding promising performance for distilled models with a maximum gain of 11.47% on CIFAR-100 and 3.67% on ImageNet-1K. Code is available at https://github.com/liguopeng0923/FBT.
authors: Guopeng Li, Qiang Wang, Ke Yan, Shouhong Ding, Yuan Gao, Gui-Song Xia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3445-3454

title: 融合应对多样条件:基于无人机的多模态目标检测高多样性基准与基线研究
title_en: Fusion Meets Diverse Conditions: A High-diversity Benchmark and Baseline for UAV-based Multimodal Object Detection with Condition Cues
abstract: 基于无人机(UAV)的可见光(RGB)与红外(IR)图像目标检测技术,借助深度学习技术的进步和高质量数据集的可用性,实现了全天候稳健检测。然而现有数据集难以充分覆盖有限成像条件下现实世界的复杂性。为此,我们引入了高多样性数据集ATR-UMOD,涵盖从80m到300m的多种场景高度,0度到75度的观测角度,以及丰富天气和光照条件下全天候、全年候的时间变化。此外,每组RGB-IR图像对均标注有6个条件属性,提供有价值的高层语境信息。为应对此类多样条件带来的挑战,我们提出了一种新型提示引导的条件感知动态融合(PCDF)方法,通过利用标注的条件提示,自适应地重新分配多模态贡献。通过将成像条件编码为文本提示,PCDF通过任务特定的软门控变换有效建模条件与多模态贡献之间的关系。提示引导的条件解耦模块进一步确保了实际应用中的可用性,无需条件标注。在ATR-UMOD数据集上的实验验证了PCDF的有效性。
abstract_en: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV)-based object detection with visible (RGB) and infrared (IR) images facilitates robust around-the-clock detection, driven by advancements in deep learning techniques and the availability of high-quality dataset. However, the existing dataset struggles to fully capture real-world complexity for limited imaging conditions. To this end, we introduce a high-diversity dataset ATR-UMOD covering varying scenarios, spanning altitudes from 80m to 300m, angles from 0deg to 75deg, and all-day, all-year time variations in rich weather and illumination conditions. Moreover, each RGB-IR image pair is annotated with 6 condition attributes, offering valuable high-level contextual information. To meet the challenge raised by such diverse conditions, we propose a novel prompt-guided condition-aware dynamic fusion (PCDF) to adaptively reassign multimodal contributions by leveraging annotated condition cues. By encoding imaging conditions as text prompts, PCDF effectively models the relationship between conditions and multimodal contributions through a task-specific soft-gating transformation. A prompt-guided condition-decoupling module further ensures the availability in practice without condition annotations. Experiments on ATR-UMOD dataset reveal the effectiveness of PCDF.
authors: Chen Chen, Kangcheng Bin, Ting Hu, Jiahao Qi, Xingyue Liu, Tianpeng Liu, Zhen Liu, Yongxiang Liu, Ping Zhong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27958-27967

title: FusionPhys:一种用于远程生理测量中融合互补传感模态的灵活框架
title_en: FusionPhys: A Flexible Framework for Fusing Complementary Sensing Modalities in Remote Physiological Measurement
abstract: 利用可见光相机进行远程生理测量已成为非接触式健康监测的强大工具,但其可靠性在低光环境或多样肤色等挑战性条件下会下降。这些局限性促使人们探索替代传感模态,如近红外传感器和雷达系统,它们通过不同的传感原理提供互补的生理信息。尽管这些模态提供了有价值的信息,现有方法未能全面整合这些异构数据。我们的核心洞察是:虽然可见光、近红外和雷达基于不同的物理原理运作,但它们均捕捉到时间动态的生理特征,这些特征可表示为反映潜在生理过程的时变信号。基于这一洞察,我们提出FusionPhys,一种新颖框架,通过自适应集成机制优化互补模态的生理信息。我们进一步引入子模态分解技术,将融合原理扩展到单模态视频。在五个数据集上的广泛实验表明,FusionPhys在多种传感配置中均表现出优越性能,代表了向更可靠、更通用的远程生理测量系统的重要进展。代码可在:https://github.com/chh-ying/fusionphys 获取。
abstract_en: Remote physiological measurement using visible light cameras has emerged as a powerful tool for non-contact health monitoring, yet its reliability degrades under challenging conditions such as low-light environments or diverse skin tones. These limitations have motivated the exploration of alternative sensing modalities, such as near-infrared sensors and radar systems, which offer complementary physiological information through distinct sensing principles. While these modalities provide valuable information, existing methods fail to holistically integrate these heterogeneous data. Our key insight is that while visible light, near-infrared, and radar operate on distinct physical principles, they all capture temporally dynamic physiological signatures that can be represented as time-varying signals reflecting underlying physiological processes. Based on this insight, we propose FusionPhys, a novel framework that implements an adaptive integration mechanism to refine physiological information across complementary modalities. We further introduce a sub-modality decomposition technique that extends fusion principles to single-modality videos. Extensive experiments across five datasets demonstrate that FusionPhys achieves superior performance in diverse sensing configurations, representing a significant advancement toward more reliable and versatile remote physiological measurement systems. The code is available at: https://github.com/chh-ying/fusionphys.
authors: Chenhang Ying, Huiyu Yang, Jieyi Ge, Zhaodong Sun, Xu Cheng, Kui Ren, Xiaobai Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9363-9373

title: 面向未来的交互网络用于运动预测
title_en: Future-Aware Interaction Network For Motion Forecasting
abstract: 运动预测是自动驾驶系统的关键组成部分,能够生成准确且平滑的未来轨迹以确保安全导航至目的地。在先前方法中,潜在的未来轨迹往往在场景编码阶段缺失,可能导致次优结果。此外,传统方法通常采用Transformer架构对轨迹和地图信息进行时空建模,但Transformer架构存在二次缩放复杂度的问题。在本工作中,我们提出了一种基于交互的方法,命名为面向未来的交互网络(Future-Aware Interaction Network),将潜在未来轨迹引入场景编码以实现全面的交通表示。此外,引入了状态空间模型(State Space Model, SSM),特别是Mamba,用于空间和时间建模。为适应Mamba进行空间交互建模,我们提出了一种自适应重排序策略,将无序数据转换为结构化序列。同时,Mamba被用于对生成的未来轨迹进行时间细化,确保预测更加一致。这些改进不仅提升了模型效率,还增强了预测的准确性和多样性。我们在广泛使用的Argoverse 1和Argoverse 2数据集上进行了全面实验,结果表明所提方法以更高效的方式相比先前方法实现了优越性能。代码已在此处提供。
abstract_en: Motion forecasting is a crucial component of autonomous driving systems, enabling the generation of accurate and smooth future trajectories to ensure safe navigation to the destination. In previous methods, potential future trajectories are often absent in the scene encoding stage, which may lead to suboptimal outcomes. Additionally, prior approaches typically employ transformer architectures for spatiotemporal modeling of trajectories and map information, which suffer from the quadratic scaling complexity of the transformer architecture. In this work, we propose an interaction-based method, named Future-Aware Interaction Network, that introduces potential future trajectories into scene encoding for a comprehensive traffic representation. Furthermore, a State Space Model (SSM), specifically Mamba, is introduced for both spatial and temporal modeling. To adapt Mamba for spatial interaction modeling, we propose an adaptive reordering strategy that transforms unordered data into a structured sequence. Additionally, Mamba is employed to refine generated future trajectories temporally, ensuring more consistent predictions. These enhancements not only improve model efficiency but also enhance the accuracy and diversity of predictions. We conduct comprehensive experiments on the widely used Argoverse 1 and Argoverse 2 datasets, demonstrating that the proposed method achieves superior performance compared to previous approaches in a more efficient way. The code is available here.
authors: Shijie Li, Chunyu Liu, Xun Xu, Si Yong Yeo, Xulei Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7505-7515

title: 基于模糊对比解码缓解大视觉-语言模型中的物体幻觉
title_en: Fuzzy Contrastive Decoding to Alleviate Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
abstract: 大视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)常常表现出物体幻觉,即模型在图像中生成不存在物体的描述的现象。先前方法通过调整模型logits以减少语言偏差来缓解这一问题,但它们往往缺乏对视觉不确定性的精确控制,有时反而加剧了幻觉而非缓解。为了解决这一局限性,我们提出了一种名为模糊对比解码(FuzzyCD)的新解码策略,该策略利用Takagi-Sugeno模糊推理来优化幻觉控制。FuzzyCD在减轻不必要的语言偏差的同时,自适应地为高幻觉logits分配权重。具体而言,它将标准和幻觉logits中top-1标记的对数概率转换为一个置信度语言模糊集。通过Takagi-Sugeno模糊推理,它动态调整幻觉logits以防止模型过度依赖虚假的语言模式。在物体幻觉数据集上的实验结果表明,与传统LVLMs相比,幻觉减少了11%。深入分析突显了FuzzyCD在提升视觉-语言模型可靠性方面的有效性。
abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) often exhibit object hallucination, a phenomenon where models generate descriptions of non-existent objects within images. Prior methods have sought to mitigate this issue by adjusting model logits to reduce linguistic bias, but they often lack precise control over visual uncertainty, sometimes exacerbating hallucinations instead of mitigating them. To address this limitation, we propose a novel decoding strategy called fuzzy contrastive decoding (FuzzyCD) that uses Takagi-Sugeno fuzzy inference to refine hallucination control. FuzzyCD adaptively assigns weights to high-hallucination logits while mitigating unnecessary linguistic bias. Specifically, it transforms the log-probabilities of top-1 tokens from both standard and hallucination logits into a confidence linguistic fuzzy set. Through Takagi-Sugeno fuzzy inference, it dynamically adjusts hallucination logits to prevent the model from over-relying on spurious linguistic patterns. Experimental results on object hallucination datasets demonstrate that hallucination is mitigated by 11%p compared to conventional LVLMs. In-depth analyses highlight the effectiveness of FuzzyCD in enhancing the reliability of vision-language models.
authors: Jieun Kim, Jinmyeong Kim, Yoonji Kim, Sung-Bae Cho ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20572-20581

title: G-DexGrasp:基于部件感知先验检索与先验辅助生成的可泛化灵巧抓取合成
title_en: G-DexGrasp: Generalizable Dexterous Grasping Synthesis Via Part-Aware Prior Retrieval and Prior-Assisted Generation
abstract: 近期在灵巧抓取合成领域取得了显著进展,能够为多种任务目的生成合理且可信的抓取方案。但将其泛化到未见过的对象类别和多样化任务指令仍具挑战性。本文提出G-DexGrasp,一种检索增强的生成方法,可为未见过的对象类别和基于语言的任务指令生成高质量的灵巧手配置。关键在于检索可泛化的抓取先验,包括相关抓取实例的细粒度接触部件和效用相关分布,用于后续合成流程。具体而言,细粒度接触部件和效用作为泛化指导,通过生成模型推断未见过对象的合理抓取配置;而相关抓取分布则作为正则化项,确保后续优化细化过程中合成抓取的可信度。我们的对比实验验证了关键设计在泛化方面的有效性,并展示了相较于现有方法的显著性能优势。
abstract_en: Recent advances in dexterous grasping synthesis have demonstrated significant progress in producing reasonable and plausible grasps for many task purposes. But it remains challenging to generalize to unseen object categories and diverse task instructions. In this paper, we propose G-DexGrasp, a retrieval-augmented generation approach that can produce high-quality dexterous hand configurations for unseen object categories and language-based task instructions. The key is to retrieve generalizable grasping priors, including the fine-grained contact part and the affordance-related distribution of relevant grasping instances, for the following synthesis pipeline.
