Specifically, the fine-grained contact part and affordance act as generalizable guidance to infer reasonable grasping configurations for unseen objects with a generative model, while the relevant grasping distribution plays as regularization to guarantee the plausibility of synthesized grasps during the subsequent refinement optimization. Our comparison experiments validate the effectiveness of our key designs for generalization and demonstrate the remarkable performance against the existing approaches.
authors: Juntao Jian, Xiuping Liu, Zixuan Chen, Manyi Li, Jian Liu, Ruizhen Hu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11447-11457

title: G2D: 通过梯度引导蒸馏提升多模态学习
title_en: G2D: Boosting Multimodal Learning with Gradient-Guided Distillation
abstract: 多模态学习旨在利用多样化的数据模态信息以实现更全面的性能表现。然而,传统多模态模型常面临模态不平衡问题,其中某一或某些模态主导模型优化过程,导致特征表示次优且弱模态未被充分挖掘。为解决这一挑战,我们提出梯度引导蒸馏(Gradient-Guided Distillation, G^2D),这是一种知识蒸馏框架,通过融合单模态与多模态目标的自定义损失函数优化多模态模型。G^2D进一步在学习过程中引入动态序列模态优先级(Dynamic Sequential Modality Prioritization, SMP)技术,确保每个模态主导学习过程,避免强模态压制弱模态的弊端。我们在多个真实世界数据集上验证了G^2D,结果表明其在训练过程中增强弱模态的重要性,并在分类与回归任务中超越现有最先进方法。我们的代码已开源,详见\href https://github.com/rAIson-Lab/G2D here。
abstract_en: Multimodal learning aims to leverage information from diverse data modalities to achieve more comprehensive performance. However, conventional multimodal models often suffer from modality imbalance, where one or a few modalities dominate model optimization, leading to suboptimal feature representation and underutilization of weak modalities. To address this challenge, we introduce Gradient-Guided Distillation (G^ 2 D), a knowledge distillation framework that optimizes the multimodal model with a custom-built loss function that fuses both unimodal and multimodal objectives. G^ 2 D further incorporates a dynamic sequential modality prioritization (SMP) technique in the learning process to ensure each modality leads the learning process, avoiding the pitfall of stronger modalities overshadowing weaker ones. We validate G^ 2 D on multiple real-world datasets and show that G^ 2 D amplifies the significance of weak modalities while training and outperforms state-of-the-art methods in classification and regression tasks. Our code is available \href https://github.com/rAIson-Lab/G2D  here .
authors: Mohammed Rakib, Arunkumar Bagavathi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4059-4068

title: G2PDiffusion: 通过进化扩散实现跨物种基因型到表型预测
title_en: G2PDiffusion: Cross-Species Genotype-to-Phenotype Prediction via Evolutionary Diffusion
abstract: 理解基因如何在不同物种间影响表型是遗传工程中的基础挑战,这将促进作物育种、保护生物学和个性化医学等领域的进展。然而,当前的表型预测模型局限于单一物种,并且昂贵的表型标注过程,使得基因型到表型预测成为一个高度依赖领域且数据稀缺的问题。为此,我们建议将图像作为形态学代理,通过大规模多模态预训练实现跨物种泛化。我们提出了首个基于DNA生成形态学图像的基因型到表型扩散模型(G2PDiffusion),该模型考虑了两个关键的进化信号,即多序列比对(MSA)和环境背景。该模型包含三个创新组件:1)MSA检索引擎,用于识别保守和共进化模式;2)环境感知的MSA条件编码器,有效建模复杂的基因型-环境交互;3)自适应表型对齐模块以提升基因型-表型一致性。大量实验表明,将进化信号与环境背景相结合能够增强模型对跨物种表型变异性的理解,从而为先进的AI辅助基因组分析提供了有价值的探索方向。
abstract_en: Understanding how genes influence phenotype across species is a fundamental challenge in genetic engineering, which will facilitate advances in various fields such as crop breeding, conservation biology, and personalized medicine. However, current phenotype prediction models are limited to individual species and expensive phenotype labeling process, making the genotype-to-phenotype prediction a highly domain-dependent and data-scarce problem. To this end, we suggest taking images as morphological proxies, facilitating cross-species generalization through large-scale multimodal pretraining. We propose the first genotype-to-phenotype diffusion model (G2PDiffusion) that generates morphological images from DNA considering two critical evolutionary signals, i.e., multiple sequence alignments (MSA) and environmental contexts. The model contains three novel components: 1) a MSA retrieval engine that identifies conserved and co-evolutionary patterns; 2) an environment-aware MSA conditional encoder that effectively models complex genotype-environment interactions; and 3) an adaptive phenomic alignment module to improve genotype-phenotype consistency. Extensive experiments show that integrating evolutionary signals with environmental context enriches the model's understanding of phenotype variability across species, thereby offering a valuable and promising exploration into advanced AI-assisted genomic analysis.
authors: Mengdi Liu, Zhangyang Gao, Hong Chang, Stan Z. Li, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20705-20714

title: G2SF:面向多模态工业异常检测的几何引导得分融合方法
title_en: G2SF: Geometry-Guided Score Fusion for Multimodal Industrial Anomaly Detection
abstract: 工业质量检测在现代制造中起着关键作用,通过在生产过程中识别缺陷产品。虽然基于3D点云或2D RGB图像的单模态方法存在信息不完整性问题,但通过跨模态数据的互补融合,多模态异常检测提供了新的可能性。然而,现有方法在有效整合单模态结果和提升判别能力方面仍面临挑战。为解决这些局限性,我们首先将单模态基于记忆库的异常得分重新诠释为局部特征空间中的各向同性欧几里得距离。动态演化自欧几里得度量,我们提出了一种新颖的几何引导得分融合(G2SF)框架,逐步学习各向异性局部距离度量作为融合任务的统一得分。通过几何编码算子,我们提出了一种新型局部尺度预测网络(LSPN),用于预测方向感知的缩放因子以表征一阶局部特征分布,从而增强正常与异常模式的区分能力。此外,我们从几何先验中开发专用损失函数和得分聚合策略,以确保度量泛化性和有效性。在MVTec-3D AD和Eyecandies数据集上的综合评估验证了本方法的最先进检测性能,详细消融分析验证了各组件的贡献。我们的代码已开源于https://github.com/ctaoaa/G2SF。
abstract_en: Industrial quality inspection plays a critical role in modern manufacturing by identifying defective products during production. While single-modality approaches using either 3D point clouds or 2D RGB images suffer from information incompleteness, multimodal anomaly detection offers promise through the complementary fusion of crossmodal data. However, existing methods face challenges in effectively integrating unimodal results and improving discriminative power. To address these limitations, we first reinterpret memory bank-based anomaly scores in single modalities as isotropic Euclidean distances in local feature spaces. Dynamically evolving from Euclidean metrics, we propose a novel \underline G eometry-\underline G uided \underline S core \underline F usion (G^ 2 SF) framework that progressively learns an anisotropic local distance metric as a unified score for the fusion task. Through a geometric encoding operator, a novel Local Scale Prediction Network (LSPN) is proposed to predict direction-aware scaling factors that characterize first-order local feature distributions, thereby enhancing discrimination between normal and anomalous patterns. Additionally, we develop specialized loss functions and score aggregation strategy from geometric priors to ensure both metric generalization and efficacy. Comprehensive evaluations on the MVTec-3D AD and Eyecandies datasets demonstrate the state-of-the-art detection performance of our method, and detailed ablation analysis validates each component's contribution. Our code is available at https://github.com/ctaoaa/G2SF.
authors: Chengyu Tao, Xuanming Cao, Juan Du ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20551-20560

title: GAP:通过文本引导将任意点云高斯化
title_en: GAP: Gaussianize Any Point Clouds with Text Guidance
abstract: 三维高斯点云渲染(3DGS)在实现快速高质量渲染方面展现出显著优势。由于点云作为广泛应用且易于获取的三维表示形式,弥合点云与高斯分布之间的差距变得愈发重要。近期研究已探索如何将彩色点转换为高斯分布,但直接从无色三维点云生成高斯分布仍是一个未解决的挑战。本文提出GAP,一种新颖方法,通过文本引导将原始点云转换为高保真三维高斯分布。我们的核心思想是设计一个多视角优化框架,利用深度感知图像扩散模型合成不同视角下的一致外观。为确保几何精度,我们引入表面锚定机制,在优化过程中有效约束高斯分布位于三维形状的表面。此外,GAP结合基于扩散的修复策略,专门针对难以观测区域进行补全。我们在点云到高斯生成任务中评估GAP,涵盖从合成点云到具有挑战性的现实世界扫描,甚至大规模场景的多种复杂度级别。项目页面:https://weiqi-zhang.github.io/GAP.
abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated its advantages in achieving fast and high-quality rendering. As point clouds serve as a widely-used and easily accessible form of 3D representation, bridging the gap between point clouds and Gaussians becomes increasingly important. Recent studies have explored how to convert the colored points into Gaussians, but directly generating Gaussians from colorless 3D point clouds remains an unsolved challenge. In this paper, we propose GAP, a novel approach that gaussianizes raw point clouds into high-fidelity 3D Gaussians with text guidance. Our key idea is to design a multi-view optimization framework that leverages a depth-aware image diffusion model to synthesize consistent appearances across different viewpoints. To ensure geometric accuracy, we introduce a surface-anchoring mechanism that effectively constrains Gaussians to lie on the surfaces of 3D shapes during optimization. Furthermore, GAP incorporates a diffuse-based inpainting strategy that specifically targets at completing hard-to-observe regions. We evaluate GAP on the Point-to-Gaussian generation task across varying complexity levels, from synthetic point clouds to challenging real-world scans, and even large-scale scenes. Project Page: https://weiqi-zhang.github.io/GAP.
authors: Weiqi Zhang, Junsheng Zhou, Haotian Geng, Wenyuan Zhang, Yu-Shen Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25627-25638

title: GARF:面向现实世界断裂的可泛化3D重组学习
title_en: GARF: Learning Generalizable 3D Reassembly for Real-World Fractures
abstract: 3D重组是一项具有广泛应用的挑战性空间智能任务,涉及多个科学领域。尽管大规模合成数据集推动了有前景的学习方法,但其在不同领域的泛化能力有限。关键问题在于,训练于合成数据集的模型是否能泛化到现实世界断裂场景,其中断裂模式更为复杂。为弥合这一差距,我们提出GARF,一种面向现实世界断裂的可泛化3D重组框架。GARF通过断裂感知预训练从单个碎片中学习断裂特征,同时利用流匹配实现精确的6自由度对齐。在推理阶段,我们引入单步预组装,提升对未知物体和不同断裂数量的鲁棒性。与考古学家、古人类学家和鸟类学家合作,我们整理了__DATASET__数据集,该数据集包含陶瓷、骨骼、蛋壳和石器等领域的现实世界断裂类型,为视觉与学习社区提供多样化资源。全面实验表明,我们的方法在合成和现实世界数据集上均优于现有最先进方法,实现82.87%的旋转误差降低和25.15%的部件准确率提升。本工作展示了基于合成数据训练在推进现实世界3D拼图求解中的潜力,展现了其在未知物体形状和多样化断裂类型上的强泛化能力。
abstract_en: 3D reassembly is a challenging spatial intelligence task with broad applications across scientific domains. While large-scale synthetic datasets have fueled promising learning-based approaches, their generalizability to different domains is limited. Critically, it remains uncertain whether models trained on synthetic datasets can generalize to real-world fractures where breakage patterns are more complex. To bridge this gap, we propose \acronym  , a generalizable 3D reassembly framework for real-world fractures. \acronym   leverages fracture-aware pretraining to learn fracture features from individual fragments, while flow matching enables precise 6-DoF alignments. At inference time, we introduce one-step preassembly, improving robustness to unseen objects and varying numbers of fractures. In collaboration with archaeologists, paleoanthropologists, and ornithologists, we curate \dataset  , a diverse dataset for vision and learning communities, featuring real-world fracture types across ceramics, bones, eggshells, and lithics. Comprehensive experiments have demonstrated our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both synthetic and real-world datasets, achieving 82.87% lower rotation error and 25.15% higher part accuracy. This work sheds light on training on synthetic data to advance real-world 3D puzzle solving, showcasing its strong generalization across unseen object shapes and diverse fracture types.
authors: Sihang Li, Zeyu Jiang, Grace Chen, Chenyang Xu, Siqi Tan, Xue Wang, Irving Fang, Kristof Zyskowski, Shannon P. McPherron, Radu Iovita, Chen Feng, Jing Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5711-5721

title: GAS: 基于单张图像的生成式虚拟形象合成
title_en: GAS: Generative Avatar Synthesis from a Single Image
abstract: 我们提出了一种统一且可推广的框架,用于从单张图像合成视角一致且时间连贯的虚拟形象,解决了单图像虚拟形象生成这一具有挑战性的问题。现有基于扩散模型的方法通常依赖稀疏的人体模板(例如深度图或法线图),由于这些信号与被摄对象的真实外观存在不匹配,导致多视角和时间不一致。我们的方法通过结合基于回归的3D人体重建的重建能力与扩散模型的生成能力,弥合了这一差距。首先,通过通用NeRF生成的初始3D重建人体提供全面的条件约束,确保高质量合成忠实于参考外观和结构。随后,从通用NeRF导出的几何结构和外观作为输入传递给基于视频的扩散模型。这种策略性整合对于在整个虚拟形象生成过程中强制执行多视角和时间一致性至关重要。实验结果突显了所提方法的卓越泛化能力,证明其在多样化的领域内数据集和领域外真实场景数据集上的有效性。
abstract_en: We present a unified and generalizable framework for synthesizing view-consistent and temporally coherent avatars from a single image, addressing the challenging task of single-image avatar generation. Existing diffusion-based methods often condition on sparse human templates (e.g., depth or normal maps), which leads to multi-view and temporal inconsistencies due to the mismatch between these signals and the true appearance of the subject. Our approach bridges this gap by combining the reconstruction power of regression-based 3D human reconstruction with the generative capabilities of a diffusion model. In a first step, an initial 3D reconstructed human through a generalized NeRF provides comprehensive conditioning, ensuring high-quality synthesis faithful to the reference appearance and structure. Subsequently, the derived geometry and appearance from the generalized NeRF serve as input to a video-based diffusion model. This strategic integration is pivotal for enforcing both multi-view and temporal consistency throughout the avatar's generation. Empirical results underscore the superior generalization ability of our proposed method, demonstrating its effectiveness across diverse in-domain and out-of-domain in-the-wild datasets.
authors: Yixing Lu, Junting Dong, Youngjoong Kwon, Qin Zhao, Bo Dai, Fernando De la Torre ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12883-12893

title: GCAV:一种用于可解释性中跨层一致性的全局概念激活向量框架
title_en: GCAV: A Global Concept Activation Vector Framework for Cross-Layer Consistency in Interpretability
abstract: 概念激活向量(CAVs)通过量化对人类定义概念的敏感性,为解释深度神经网络提供了一种强大方法。然而,当在不同层独立计算时,CAVs常表现出不一致性,导致跨层比较不可靠。为解决这一问题,我们提出全局概念激活向量(GCAV),一种将CAVs统一为单一语义一致表示的新框架。我们的方法利用对比学习对跨层概念表示进行对齐,并采用基于注意力的融合机制构建全局集成的CAV。通过这种方法,我们的方法在保持概念相关性的同时显著降低了TCAV分数的方差,确保概念归因更加稳定可靠。为评估GCAV的有效性,我们引入基于全局概念激活向量的测试方法(TGCAV)以应用于GCAV表示。我们在多个深度神经网络上进行了广泛实验,证明我们的方法有效缓解了跨层概念不一致性,增强了概念定位能力,并提升了对对抗性扰动的鲁棒性。通过将跨层信息整合到统一框架中,我们的方法为理解深度学习模型如何编码人类定义概念提供了更全面且可解释的视角。代码和模型可在https://github.com/Zhenghao-He/GCAV获取。
abstract_en: Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs) provide a powerful approach for interpreting deep neural networks by quantifying their sensitivity to human-defined concepts. However, when computed independently at different layers, CAVs often exhibit inconsistencies, making cross-layer comparisons unreliable. To address this issue, we propose the Global Concept Activation Vector (GCAV), a novel framework that unifies CAVs into a single, semantically consistent representation. Our method leverages contrastive learning to align concept representations across layers and employs an attention-based fusion mechanism to construct a globally integrated CAV. By doing so, our method significantly reduces the variance in TCAV scores while preserving concept relevance, ensuring more stable and reliable concept attributions. To evaluate the effectiveness of GCAV, we introduce Testing with Global Concept Activation Vectors (TGCAV) as a method to apply TCAV to GCAV-based representations. We conduct extensive experiments on multiple deep neural networks, demonstrating that our method effectively mitigates concept inconsistency across layers, enhances concept localization, and improves robustness against adversarial perturbations. By integrating cross-layer information into a coherent framework, our method offers a more comprehensive and interpretable understanding of how deep learning models encode human-defined concepts. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Zhenghao-He/GCAV.
authors: Zhenghao He, Sanchit Sinha, Guangzhi Xiong, Aidong Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 614-623

title: GCRayDiffusion: 无需姿态的表面重建通过几何一致的光线扩散
title_en: GCRayDiffusion: Pose-Free Surface Reconstruction via Geometric Consistent Ray Diffusion
abstract: 从无姿态图像中实现精确的表面重建对于高效创建3D物体或场景至关重要。然而,这仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题,尤其是在联合相机姿态估计方面。先前的方法在密集视角设置中实现了令人印象深刻的无需姿态表面重建结果,但在缺乏足够视觉重叠的稀疏视角场景中却容易失败。在本文中,我们提出了一种新的无需姿态表面重建技术,该技术基于三平面的符号距离场(SDF)学习,但通过从基于光线扩散的相机姿态估计中显式采样的点对学习进行正则化。我们的关键贡献是一种新颖的几何一致光线扩散模型(GCRayDiffusion),其中我们将相机姿态表示为神经束光线,并通过扩散模型回归噪声光线的分布。更重要的是,我们进一步利用整个场景的基于三平面的SDF对RGRayDiffusion的去噪过程进行条件约束,这为实现多视角一致的相机姿态估计提供了有效的3D一致性正则化。最后,我们通过引入神经束光线采样点的表面几何正则化,将RGRayDiffusion整合到基于三平面的SDF学习中,即使对于稀疏视角输入也能获得高度精确的无需姿态表面重建结果。在公开数据集上的广泛评估表明,我们的GCRayDiffusion在相机姿态估计方面比先前方法更加准确,尤其在稀疏视角输入下,其几何一致性更强的表面重建结果更加显著。
abstract_en: Accurate surface reconstruction from unposed images is crucial for efficient 3D object or scene creation. However, it remains challenging, particularly for the joint camera pose estimation. Previous approaches have achieved impressive pose-free surface reconstruction results in dense-view settings, but could easily fail for sparse-view scenarios without sufficient visual overlap. In this paper, we propose a new technique for pose-free surface reconstruction, which follows triplane-based signed distance field (SDF) learning but regularizes the learning by explicit points sampled from ray-based diffusion of camera pose estimation. Our key contribution is a novel Geometric Consistent Ray Diffusion model (GCRayDiffusion), where we represent camera poses as neural bundle rays and regress the distribution of noisy rays via a diffusion model. More importantly, we further condition the denoising process of RGRayDiffusion using the triplane-based SDF of the entire scene, which provides effective 3D consistent regularization to achieve multi-view consistent camera pose estimation. Finally, we incorporate RGRayDiffusion into the triplane-based SDF learning by introducing on-surface geometric regularization from the sampling points of the neural bundle rays, which leads to highly accurate pose-free surface reconstruction results even for sparse-view inputs. Extensive evaluations on public datasets show that our GCRayDiffusion achieves more accurate camera pose estimation than previous approaches, with geometrically more consistent surface reconstruction results, especially given sparse-view inputs.
authors: Li-Heng Chen, Zi-Xin Zou, Chang Liu, Tianjiao Jing, Yan-Pei Cao, Shi-Sheng Huang, Hongbo Fu, Hua Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25335-25345

title: GDKVM:基于门控Delta规则的时空键值记忆超声心动图视频分割
title_en: GDKVM: Echocardiography Video Segmentation via Spatiotemporal Key-Value Memory with Gated Delta Rule
abstract: 在超声心动图序列中准确分割心脏腔室对于心脏功能的定量分析至关重要,有助于临床诊断和治疗。成像噪声、伪影以及心脏的变形和运动对分割算法提出了挑战。尽管基于卷积神经网络、Transformer和时空记忆网络的方法已提高了分割精度,但它们往往在捕捉长程时空依赖关系与保持计算效率及细粒度特征表示之间存在权衡难题。本文提出了一种新型架构GDKVM用于超声心动图视频分割。该模型采用线性键值关联(LKVA)有效建模帧间相关性,并引入门控Delta规则(GDR)高效存储中间记忆状态。关键像素特征融合(KPFF)模块设计用于在多尺度上融合局部与全局特征,增强对边界模糊和噪声干扰的鲁棒性。我们在两个主流的超声心动图视频数据集(CAMUS和EchoNet-Dynamic)上验证了GDKVM,并与多种最先进的方法进行了比较。实验结果表明,GDKVM在分割精度和鲁棒性方面优于现有方法,同时确保实时性能。代码已开源至https://github.com/wangrui2025/GDKVM。
abstract_en: Accurate segmentation of cardiac chambers in echocardiography sequences is crucial for the quantitative analysis of cardiac function, aiding in clinical diagnosis and treatment. The imaging noise, artifacts, and the deformation and motion of the heart pose challenges to segmentation algorithms. While existing methods based on convolutional neural networks, Transformers and space-time memory networks, have improved segmentation accuracy, they often struggle with the trade-off between capturing long-range spatiotemporal dependencies and maintaining computational efficiency with fine-grained feature representation. In this paper, we introduce GDKVM, a novel architecture for echocardiography video segmentation. The model employs Linear Key-Value Association (LKVA) to effectively model inter-frame correlations, and introduces Gated Delta Rule (GDR) to efficiently store intermediate memory states. Key-Pixel Feature Fusion (KPFF) module is designed to integrate local and global features at multiple scales, enhancing robustness against boundary blurring and noise interference. We validated GDKVM on two mainstream echocardiography video datasets (CAMUS and EchoNet-Dynamic) and compared it with various state-of-the-art methods. Experimental results show that GDKVM outperforms existing approaches in terms of segmentation accuracy and robustness, while ensuring real-time performance. Codes are available at https://github.com/wangrui2025/GDKVM.
authors: Rui Wang, Yimu Sun, Jingxing Guo, Huisi Wu, Jing Qin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12191-12200

title: GECKO:组织病理学中的十亿像素视觉-概念对比预训练
title_en: GECKO: Gigapixel Vision-Concept Contrastive Pretraining in Histopathology
abstract: 对多实例学习(MIL)聚合器进行预训练,能够在无监督条件下从图像块级表示中推导出全切片图像(WSI)级嵌入。尽管近期利用辅助模态的多模态MIL预训练方法在单模态WSI预训练基础上实现了性能提升,但获取这些额外模态需要大量的临床特征分析。这一要求增加了成本并限制了现有缺乏此类配对模态的WSI数据集的可扩展性。为解决这一问题,我们提出Gigapixel Vision-Concept Knowledge Contrastive预训练(GECKO),该方法通过从可用WSI中导出的概念先验将WSI与之对齐。首先,我们通过计算每个WSI图像块与预定义病理学概念的文本描述之间的相似性,导出具有内在可解释性的概念先验。GECKO随后采用双分支MIL网络:一个分支将图像块嵌入聚合为WSI级深度嵌入,另一个分支将概念先验聚合为对应的WSI级概念嵌入。通过对比目标对两种聚合嵌入进行对齐,从而实现整个双分支MIL模型的预训练。此外,当存在转录组学等辅助模态数据时,GECKO可无缝集成。在五个多样化任务中,GECKO持续超越先前的单模态和多模态预训练方法,同时提供具有临床意义的可解释性,弥合计算模型与病理学专业知识之间的差距。代码已开源至github.com/bmi-imaginelab/GECKO
abstract_en: Pretraining a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) aggregator enables the derivation of Whole Slide Image (WSI)-level embeddings from patch-level representations without supervision. While recent multimodal MIL pretraining approaches leveraging auxiliary modalities have demonstrated performance gains over unimodal WSI pretraining, the acquisition of these additional modalities necessitates extensive clinical profiling. This requirement increases costs and limits scalability in existing WSI datasets lacking such paired modalities. To address this, we propose Gigapixel Vision-Concept Knowledge Contrastive pretraining (GECKO), which aligns WSIs with a Concept Prior derived from the available WSIs. First, we derive an inherently interpretable concept prior by computing the similarity between each WSI patch and textual descriptions of predefined pathology concepts. GECKO then employs a dual-branch MIL network: one branch aggregates patch embeddings into a WSI-level deep embedding, while the other aggregates the concept prior to a corresponding WSI-level concept embedding. Both aggregated embeddings are aligned using a contrastive objective, thereby pretraining the entire dual-branch MIL model. Moreover, when auxiliary modalities such as transcriptomics data are available, GECKO seamlessly integrates them. Across five diverse tasks, GECKO consistently outperforms prior unimodal and multimodal pretraining approaches while also delivering clinically meaningful interpretability that bridges the gap between computational models and pathology expertise. Code is made available at github.com/bmi-imaginelab/GECKO
authors: Saarthak Kapse, Pushpak Pati, Srikar Yellapragada, Srijan Das, Rajarsi R. Gupta, Joel Saltz, Dimitris Samaras, Prateek Prasanna ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20020-20030

title: GECO:基于几何一致嵌入与极速推理的特征学习方法
title_en: GECO: Geometrically Consistent Embedding with Lightspeed Inference
abstract: 近期特征计算领域的进展表明,自监督特征提取器能够识别语义对应关系。然而,这些特征通常缺乏对物体底层三维几何结构的理解。本文聚焦于学习能够通过几何属性语义表征区分部分的特征,例如左右眼或前后腿。我们提出GECO,一种基于最优传输的新型学习方法,可获取几何一致且能准确表征对称点的特征。GECO采用轻量级模型架构,实现快速推理,可达到30fps的图像处理速度。我们的方法具有可解释性,且在跨数据集泛化方面表现优异,在PFPascal、APK和CUB数据集上分别取得6.0%、6.2%和4.1%的性能提升。通过采用更小的主干网络和更高效的训练方案,相比先前方法实现98.2%的速度提升。最后,我们发现PCK指标不足以分析特征的几何属性。因此,我们扩展分析,提出新的度量标准和见解,这些将对开发更几何感知的方法起到关键作用。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in feature computation have revealed that self-supervised feature extractors can recognize semantic correspondences. However, these features often lack an understanding of objects' underlying 3D geometry. In this paper, we focus on learning features capable of semantically characterizing parts distinguished by their geometric properties, e.g., left/right eyes or front/back legs. We propose GECO, a novel, optimal-transport-based learning method that obtains features geometrically coherent, well-characterizing symmetric points. GECO uses a lightweight model architecture that results in a fast inference, capable of processing images at 30fps. Our method is interpretable and generalizes across datasets, achieving state-of-the-art performance on PFPascal, APK, and CUB datasets improving by 6.0%, 6.2%, and 4.1% respectively. We achieve a \final speed-up of 98.2% compared to previous methods by using a smaller backbone and a more efficient training scheme. Finally, we find PCK insufficient to analyze the geometrical properties of the features. Hence, we expand our analysis, proposing novel metrics and insights that will be instrumental in developing more geometrically-aware methods.
authors: Regine Hartwig, Dominik Muhle, Riccardo Marin, Daniel Cremers ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9309-9319

title: GEMeX:面向胸部X光诊断的大型、可验证且可解释的医学视觉问答基准数据集
title_en: GEMeX: A Large-Scale, Groundable, and Explainable Medical VQA Benchmark for Chest X-ray Diagnosis
abstract: 医学视觉问答(Med-VQA)结合计算机视觉和自然语言处理技术,自动回答关于医学图像的临床问题。然而,当前Med-VQA数据集存在两个显著局限性:(1)往往缺乏对答案的视觉和文本解释,阻碍患者和初级医生的理解;(2)通常提供狭窄的问题格式范围,无法充分反映实际场景中的多样化需求。这些局限性对开发可靠且用户友好的Med-VQA系统构成了重大挑战。为解决这些问题,我们引入了面向胸部X光诊断的大型、可验证且可解释的医学视觉问答基准数据集(GEMeX),包含以下创新组件:(1)多模态可解释性机制,为每个问答对提供详细的视觉和文本解释,从而提升答案的可理解性;(2)四种问题类型——开放式、封闭式、单选和多选——以更好地反映实际需求。GEMeX包含151,025张图像和1,605,575个问题,是目前最大的胸部X光视觉问答数据集。在GEMeX上对12个代表性大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)的评估表明其性能仍不理想,凸显了数据集的复杂性。同时,我们通过在GEMeX训练集上微调现有LVLM提出了一个强模型。显著的性能提升验证了数据集的有效性。该基准数据集可在www.med-vqa.com/GEMeX获取。
abstract_en: Medical Visual Question Answering (Med-VQA) combines computer vision and natural language processing to automatically answer clinical inquiries about medical images. However, current Med-VQA datasets exhibit two significant limitations: (1) they often lack visual and textual explanations for answers, hindering comprehension for patients and junior doctors; (2) they typically offer a narrow range of question formats, inadequately reflecting the diverse requirements in practical scenarios. These limitations pose significant challenges to the development of a reliable and user-friendly Med-VQA system. To address these challenges, we introduce a large-scale, Groundable, and Explainable Medical VQA benchmark for chest X-ray diagnosis (GEMeX), featuring several innovative components: (1) a multi-modal explainability mechanism that offers detailed visual and textual explanations for each question-answer pair, thereby enhancing answer comprehensibility; (2) four question types--open-ended, closed-ended, single-choice, and multiple-choice--to better reflect practical needs. With 151,025 images and 1,605,575 questions, GEMeX is the currently largest chest X-ray VQA dataset. Evaluation of 12 representative large vision language models (LVLMs) on GEMeX reveals suboptimal performance, underscoring the dataset's complexity. Meanwhile, we propose a strong model by fine-tuning an existing LVLM on the GEMeX training set. The substantial performance improvement showcases the dataset's effectiveness. The benchmark is available at www.med-vqa.com/GEMeX.
authors: Bo Liu, Ke Zou, Li-Ming Zhan, Zexin Lu, Xiaoyu Dong, Yidi Chen, Chengqiang Xie, Jiannong Cao, Xiao-Ming Wu, Huazhu Fu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21310-21320

title: GENMO:一种通用的人体运动模型
title_en: GENMO: A GENeralist Model for Human MOtion
abstract: 人体运动建模传统上将运动生成与估计作为独立任务,分别使用专门的模型。运动生成模型专注于从文本、音频或关键帧等输入中创建多样且逼真的运动,而运动估计模型旨在从视频等观测数据中重建精确的运动轨迹。尽管二者共享时间动态和运动学的底层表示,但这种分离限制了任务间的知识迁移,并需要维护独立的模型。我们提出GENMO,一种统一的通用人体运动模型,通过单一框架将运动估计与生成相结合。我们的核心洞察是将运动估计重新表述为受约束的运动生成,其中输出运动必须精确满足观测到的条件信号。通过回归与扩散的协同作用,GENMO实现了精确的全局运动估计,同时支持多样化的运动生成。我们还引入了基于估计的训练目标,利用野外视频数据及其2D标注和文本描述来增强生成多样性。此外,我们的新型架构可处理可变长度的运动以及不同时间间隔下的混合多模态条件(文本、音频、视频),提供灵活的控制能力。这种统一方法创造了协同优势:生成先验在遮挡等挑战性条件下提升估计运动质量,而多样化的视频数据则增强生成能力。大量实验验证了GENMO作为通用框架的有效性,其单模型成功处理了多种人体运动任务。
abstract_en: Human motion modeling traditionally separates motion generation and estimation into distinct tasks with specialized models. Motion generation models focus on creating diverse, realistic motions from inputs like text, audio, or keyframes, while motion estimation models aim to reconstruct accurate motion trajectories from observations like videos. Despite sharing underlying representations of temporal dynamics and kinematics, this separation limits knowledge transfer between tasks and requires maintaining separate models. We present GENMO, a unified Generalist Model for Human Motion that bridges motion estimation and generation in a single framework. Our key insight is to reformulate motion estimation as constrained motion generation, where the output motion must precisely satisfy observed conditioning signals. Leveraging the synergy between regression and diffusion, GENMO achieves accurate global motion estimation while enabling diverse motion generation. We also introduce an estimation-guided training objective that exploits in-the-wild videos with 2D annotations and text descriptions to enhance generative diversity. Furthermore, our novel architecture handles variable-length motions and mixed multimodal conditions (text, audio, video) at different time intervals, offering flexible control. This unified approach creates synergistic benefits: generative priors improve estimated motions under challenging conditions like occlusions, while diverse video data enhances generation capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate GENMO's effectiveness as a generalist framework that successfully handles multiple human motion tasks within a single model.
authors: Jiefeng Li, Jinkun Cao, Haotian Zhang, Davis Rempe, Jan Kautz, Umar Iqbal, Ye Yuan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11766-11776

title: GEOBench-VLM:地理空间任务中视觉-语言模型的基准测试
title_en: GEOBench-VLM: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Geospatial Tasks
abstract: 尽管近期众多基准测试聚焦于评估通用视觉-语言模型(VLMs),但它们未能有效应对地理空间应用的特定挑战。通用VLM基准测试未设计用于处理地理空间数据的复杂性,这是环境监测、城市规划和灾害管理等应用的关键组成部分。地理空间领域的主要挑战包括时间变化检测、大规模物体计数、微小物体检测以及遥感图像中实体间关系的理解。为弥合这一差距,我们提出了GEOBench-VLM,一个专门设计用于评估VLMs在地理空间任务中表现的综合性基准测试,涵盖场景理解、物体计数、定位、细粒度分类、分割和时间分析等任务。我们的基准测试包含超过10,000条人工验证的指令,覆盖多样的视觉条件、物体类型和尺度。我们评估了多个最先进的VLMs以评估其在地理空间特定挑战上的表现。结果表明,尽管现有VLMs展现出潜力,但在处理地理空间特定任务时仍面临挑战,凸显了进一步改进的空间。值得注意的是,表现最佳的LLaVa-OneVision在多项选择题(MCQs)上的准确率仅为41.7%,略高于GPT-4o,而后者约为随机猜测性能的两倍。我们的基准测试将公开发布。
abstract_en: While numerous recent benchmarks focus on evaluating generic Vision-Language Models (VLMs), they do not effectively address the specific challenges of geospatial applications.Generic VLM benchmarks are not designed to handle the complexities of geospatial data, an essential component for applications such as environmental monitoring, urban planning, and disaster management.Key challenges in the geospatial domain include temporal change detection, large-scale object counting, tiny object detection, and understanding relationships between entities in remote sensing imagery.To bridge this gap, we present GEOBench-VLM, a comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate VLMs on geospatial tasks, including scene understanding, object counting, localization, fine-grained categorization, segmentation, and temporal analysis. Our benchmark features over 10,000 manually verified instructions and spanning diverse visual conditions, object types, and scales.We evaluate several state-of-the-art VLMs to assess performance on geospatial-specific challenges. The results indicate that although existing VLMs demonstrate potential, they face challenges when dealing with geospatial-specific tasks, highlighting the room for further improvements. Notably, the best-performing LLaVa-OneVision achieves only 41.7% accuracy on MCQs, slightly more than GPT-4o, which is approximately double the random guess performance. Our benchmark will be publicly available.
authors: Muhammad Danish, Muhammad Akhtar Munir, Syed Roshaan Ali Shah, Kartik Kuckreja, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Paolo Fraccaro, Alexandre Lacoste, Salman Khan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7132-7142

title: GEOPARD:面向三维形状运动预测的几何预训练
title_en: GEOPARD: Geometric Pretraining for Articulation Prediction in 3D Shapes
abstract: 我们提出GEOPARD,这是一种基于Transformer的架构,可从三维形状的单个静态快照中预测运动。我们的方法核心思想是一种预训练策略,使Transformer能够基于几何驱动的搜索,无需手动标注运动信息,学习三维形状的合理运动候选方案。该搜索过程会自动发现不会导致与其他形状部件分离或碰撞的物理上有效的部件运动。实验表明,结合我们精心设计的Transformer架构选择,这种几何预训练策略在流行的形状Part-Mobility数据集上的运动推理任务中取得了最先进结果。
abstract_en: We present GEOPARD, a transformer-based architecture for predicting articulation from a single static snapshot of a 3D shape. The key idea of our method is a pretraining strategy that allows our transformer to learn plausible candidate articulations for 3D shapes based on a geometric-driven search without manual articulation annotation. The search automatically discovers physically valid part motions that do not cause detachments or collisions with other shape parts. Our experiments indicate that this geometric pretraining strategy, along with carefully designed choices in our transformer architecture, yields state-of-the-art results in articulation inference in the popular shape Part-Mobility dataset.
authors: Pradyumn Goyal, Dmitry Petrov, Sheldon Andrews, Yizhak Ben-Shabat, Hsueh-Ti Derek Liu, Evangelos Kalogerakis ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9332-9341

title: GFPack++:基于注意力驱动的梯度场用于优化二维不规则装箱
title_en: GFPack++: Attention-Driven Gradient Fields for Optimizing 2D Irregular Packing
abstract: 二维不规则装箱是一个具有广泛应用的经典组合优化问题,例如材料利用率和纹理图集生成。由于其NP难性质,传统数值方法通常面临收敛速度慢和高计算成本的问题。先前的研究GFPack引入了一种基于梯度的装箱生成方法,提供了其可行性的初步证据,但存在旋转支持不足、边界适应性差和高重叠率等局限性。在本文中,我们提出GFPack++,这是一个深入研究的框架,采用基于注意力的几何和关系编码,能够更全面地建模复杂装箱关系。我们进一步设计了约束梯度和加权函数,以提高生成解的可行性和学习效果。在多个数据集上的实验结果表明,GFPack++实现了更高的空间利用率,支持连续旋转,对任意边界具有良好的泛化能力,并且比以往的方法快几个数量级。本文的代码可在https://github.com/TimHsue/GFPack-pp获取。
abstract_en: 2D irregular packing is a classic combinatorial optimization problem with various applications, such as material utilization and texture atlas generation. Due to its NP-hard nature, conventional numerical approaches typically encounter slow convergence and high computational costs. Previous research GFPack introduced a generative method for gradient-based packing, providing early evidence of its feasibility but faced limitations such as insufficient rotation support, poor boundary adaptability, and high overlap ratios. In this paper, we propose GFPack++, a deeply investigated framework that adopts attention-based geometry and relation encoding, enabling more comprehensive modeling of complex packing relationships. We further design a constrained gradient and a weighting function to enhance both the feasibility of the produced solutions and the learning effectiveness. Experimental results on multiple datasets demonstrate that GFPack++ achieves higher space utilization, supports continuous rotation, generalizes well to arbitrary boundaries, and infers orders of magnitude faster than previous approaches. Codes for this paper are at https://github.com/TimHsue/GFPack-pp.
authors: Tianyang Xue, Lin Lu, Yang Liu, Mingdong Wu, Hao Dong, Yanbin Zhang, Renmin Han, Baoquan Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18014-18023

title: GGTalker: 基于可泛化高斯先验与身份特定自适应的说话头合成
title_en: GGTalker: Talking Head Systhesis with Generalizable Gaussian Priors and Identity-Specific Adaptation
abstract: 创建高质量、可泛化的语音驱动三维说话头仍是一个持续存在的挑战。先前方法在固定视角和小规模音频变化场景下取得了令人满意的结果,但在大头旋转和分布外(OOD)音频场景下表现不佳。此外,它们受限于耗时的身份特定训练需求。我们认为核心问题在于缺乏足够的三维先验,这限制了合成说话头的外推能力。为解决这一问题,我们提出GGTalker,通过结合可泛化先验与身份特定自适应方法合成说话头。我们引入两阶段的先验-自适应训练策略,学习高斯头部先验并适应个体特征。我们训练音频-表情与表情-视觉先验,捕捉唇部运动的通用模式和头部纹理的总体分布。在定制化自适应阶段,精确建模个体说话风格和纹理细节。此外,我们引入颜色MLP生成细粒度、运动对齐的纹理,并通过Body Inpainter将渲染结果与背景融合,生成难以区分的逼真视频帧。全面实验表明,GGTalker在渲染质量、三维一致性、唇同步准确性和训练效率方面均达到最先进的水平。
abstract_en: Creating high-quality, generalizable speech-driven 3D talking heads remains a persistent challenge. Previous methods achieve satisfactory results for fixed viewpoints and small-scale audio variations, but they struggle with large head rotations and out-of-distribution (OOD) audio. Moreover, they are constrained by the need for time-consuming, identity-specific training. We believe the core issue lies in the lack of sufficient 3D priors, which limits the extrapolation capabilities of synthesized talking heads. To address this, we propose GGTalker, which synthesizes talking heads through a combination of generalizable priors and identity-specific adaptation. We introduce a two-stage Prior-Adaptation training strategy to learn Gaussian head priors and adapt to individual characteristics. We train Audio-Expression and Expression-Visual priors to capture the universal patterns of lip movements and the general distribution of head textures. During the Customized Adaptation, individual speaking styles and texture details are precisely modeled. Additionally, we introduce a color MLP to generate fine-grained, motion-aligned textures and a Body Inpainter to blend rendered results with the background, producing indistinguishable, photorealistic video frames. Comprehensive experiments show that GGTalker achieves state-of-the-art performance in rendering quality, 3D consistency, lip-sync accuracy, and training efficiency.
authors: Wentao Hu, Shunkai Li, Ziqiao Peng, Haoxian Zhang, Fan Shi, Xiaoqiang Liu, Pengfei Wan, Di Zhang, Hui Tian ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10108-10117

title: GIViC:生成式隐式视频压缩
title_en: GIViC: Generative Implicit Video Compression
abstract: 尽管基于隐式神经表示(INRs)的视频压缩最近展现出巨大潜力,但现有的INR视频编解码器在相同编码配置下仍无法达到与传统或自编码器方法相比的最先进性能。在此背景下,我们提出了一种**生成式隐式视频压缩框架**(GIViC),旨在提升此类编码方法的性能极限。GIViC受到INRs与大语言模型和扩散模型在利用*长期依赖性*方面的共性启发。通过新设计的*隐式扩散*过程,GIViC在粗到细的时空分解上执行扩散采样,逐步从粗粒度的全序列扩散过渡到细粒度的逐token扩散。框架中还集成了新型**分层门控线性注意力变压器**(HGLA),该模块沿尺度和序列轴对全局依赖建模进行双因子分解。所提出的GIViC模型在随机访问(RA)配置(YUV 4:2:0,GOPSize=32)下与最先进传统和神经编解码器进行基准测试,分别比VVC VTM、DCVC-FM和NVRC实现15.94%、22.46%和8.52%的BD-rate节省。据我们所知,GIViC是**首个在RA编码配置下超越VTM的INR视频编解码器**。源代码将公开提供。
abstract_en: While video compression based on implicit neural representations (INRs) has recently demonstrated great potential, existing INR-based video codecs still cannot achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance compared to their conventional or autoencoder-based counterparts given the same coding configuration. In this context, we propose a **G**enerative **I**mplicit **Vi**deo **C**ompression framework, **GIViC**, aiming at advancing the performance limits of this type of coding methods. GIViC is inspired by the characteristics that INRs share with large language and diffusion models in exploiting *long-term dependencies*. Through the newly designed *implicit diffusion* process, GIViC performs diffusive sampling across coarse-to-fine spatiotemporal decompositions, gradually progressing from coarser-grained full-sequence diffusion to finer-grained per-token diffusion. A novel **Hierarchical Gated Linear Attention-based transformer** (HGLA), is also integrated into the framework, which dual-factorizes global dependency modeling along scale and sequential axes. The proposed GIViC model has been benchmarked against SOTA conventional and neural codecs using a Random Access (RA) configuration (YUV 4:2:0, GOPSize=32), and yields BD-rate savings of 15.94%, 22.46% and 8.52% over VVC VTM, DCVC-FM and NVRC, respectively. As far as we are aware, GIViC is the **first INR-based video codec that outperforms VTM based on the RA coding configuration**. The source code will be made available.
authors: Ge Gao, Siyue Teng, Tianhao Peng, Fan Zhang, David Bull ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17356-17367

title: GLEAM: 基于全局-局部变换的视觉-语言预训练模型增强可迁移对抗攻击
title_en: GLEAM: Enhanced Transferable Adversarial Attacks for Vision-Language Pre-training Models via Global-Local Transformations
abstract: 视觉-语言预训练(VLP)模型通过大规模跨模态预训练对齐视觉与文本模态,在图像-文本检索和视觉定位等任务中取得显著性能。然而这些模型对对抗攻击高度敏感,引发对其在安全关键应用中鲁棒性与可靠性的重大担忧。现有黑盒攻击方法受限于数据增强机制不足或全局语义结构的破坏,导致对抗样本迁移性较差。为解决这些挑战,我们提出全局-局部增强对抗多模态攻击(GLEAM),这是一个统一框架,用于生成视觉-语言任务中的可迁移对抗样本。GLEAM引入局部特征增强模块,在保持全局语义与几何完整性的同时实现多样化的局部变形。同时包含全局分布扩展模块,通过动态变换扩展特征空间覆盖范围。此外,跨模态特征对齐模块利用中间对抗状态引导文本扰动,增强跨模态一致性与对抗文本迁移性。在Flickr30K和MSCOCO数据集上的大量实验表明,GLEAM超越现有最先进方法,在图像-文本检索任务中攻击成功率高出10%-30%,在Claude 3.5 Sonnet和GPT-4o等大模型上迁移性提升超30%。GLEAM为暴露VLP模型脆弱性提供了可靠工具,并为设计更安全可靠的视觉-语言系统提供了宝贵见解。我们的代码已开源于https://github.com/LuckAlex/GLEAM。
abstract_en: Vision-language pre-training (VLP) models leverage large-scale cross-modal pre-training to align vision and text modalities, achieving impressive performance on tasks like image-text retrieval and visual grounding. However, these models are highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks, raising critical concerns about their robustness and reliability in safety-critical applications. Existing black-box attack methods are limited by insufficient data augmentation mechanisms or the disruption of global semantic structures, leading to poor adversarial transferability. To address these challenges, we propose the Global-Local Enhanced Adversarial Multimodal attack (GLEAM), a unified framework for generating transferable adversarial examples in vision-language tasks. GLEAM introduces a local feature enhancement module that achieves diverse local deformations while maintaining global semantic and geometric integrity. It also incorporates a global distribution expansion module, which expands feature space coverage through dynamic transformations. Additionally, a cross-modal feature alignment module leverages intermediate adversarial states to guide text perturbations. This enhances cross-modal consistency and adversarial text transferability. Extensive experiments on Flickr30K and MSCOCO datasets show that GLEAM outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with over 10%-30% higher attack success rates in image-text retrieval tasks and over 30% improved transferability on large models like Claude 3.5 Sonnet and GPT-4o. GLEAM provides a robust tool for exposing vulnerabilities in VLP models and offers valuable insights into designing more secure and reliable vision-language systems. Our code is available at https://github.com/LuckAlex/GLEAM.
authors: Yunqi Liu, Xue Ouyang, Xiaohui Cui ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1665-1674

title: GLEAM:学习复杂三维室内场景中可泛化的主动映射探索策略
title_en: GLEAM: Learning Generalizable Exploration Policy for Active Mapping in Complex 3D Indoor Scene
abstract: 在复杂未知环境中实现可泛化的主动映射仍然是移动机器人面临的关键挑战。现有方法受限于有限的训练数据和保守的探索策略,难以在具有多样化布局和复杂连通性的场景中进行泛化。为实现可扩展的训练和可靠的评估,我们提出了GLEAM-Bench,这是首个包含1,152个来自合成和真实数据集的多样化三维场景的大规模基准测试。在本工作中,我们提出了GLEAM,一种用于主动映射的可泛化探索策略。其卓越的泛化能力源于我们的语义表示、长期目标和随机化策略。它显著优于最先进的方法,在高效轨迹下实现了68.16%的覆盖率(+11.41%),并在128个未见过的复杂场景中提升了映射精度。
abstract_en: Generalizable active mapping in complex unknown environments remains a critical challenge for mobile robots. Existing methods, constrained by limited training data and conservative exploration strategies, struggle to generalize across scenes with diverse layouts and complex connectivity. To enable scalable training and reliable evaluation, we present GLEAM-Bench, the first large-scale benchmark with 1,152 diverse 3D scenes from synthetic and real datasets. In this work, we propose GLEAM, a generalizable exploration policy for active mapping. Its superior generalizability comes from our semantic representations, long-term goals, and randomized strategies. It significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving 68.16% coverage (+11.41%) with efficient trajectories, and improved mapping accuracy on 128 unseen complex scenes.
authors: Xiao Chen, Tai Wang, Quanyi Li, Tao Huang, Jiangmiao Pang, Tianfan Xue ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5558-5568

title: GM-MoE:基于门控机制专家混合的低光照增强
title_en: GM-MoE: Low-Light Enhancement with Gated-Mechanism Mixture-of-Experts
abstract: 低光照增强在自动驾驶、3D重建、遥感、监控等领域具有广泛应用,可显著提升信息利用率。然而,现有大多数方法缺乏泛化能力,仅局限于图像恢复等特定任务。为解决这些问题,我们提出\textbf{门控机制专家混合}(Gated-Mechanism Mixture-of-Experts, GM-MoE),这是首个将专家混合网络引入低光照图像增强的框架。GM-MoE包含一个动态门控权重调节网络和三个子专家网络,每个子网络专注于不同的增强任务。结合自设计的门控机制,动态调整子专家网络在不同数据域中的权重。此外,我们在子专家网络中整合局部与全局特征融合,通过捕捉多尺度特征提升图像质量。实验结果表明,GM-MoE相比超过20种现有方法展现出更优的泛化能力,在5个基准测试中达到PSNR最优性能,在4个基准测试中达到SSIM最优性能。代码已开源:https://github.com/Sameenok/gm-moe-lowlight-enhancement.git
abstract_en: Low-light enhancement has wide applications in autonomous driving, 3D reconstruction, remote sensing, surveillance, and so on, which can significantly improve information utilization. However, most existing methods lack generalization and are limited to specific tasks such as image recovery. To address these issues, we propose \textbf Gated-Mechanism Mixture-of-Experts (GM-MoE), the first framework to introduce a mixture-of-experts network for low-light image enhancement. GM-MoE comprises a dynamic gated weight conditioning network and three sub-expert networks, each specializing in a distinct enhancement task. Combining a self-designed gated mechanism that dynamically adjusts the weights of the sub-expert networks for different data domains. Additionally, we integrate local and global feature fusion within sub-expert networks to enhance image quality by capturing multi-scale features. Experimental results demonstrate that the GM-MoE achieves superior generalization compared to over 20 existing approaches, reaching state-of-the-art performance on PSNR on 5 benchmarks and SSIM on 4 benchmarks, respectively. Code is available at: https://github.com/Sameenok/gm-moe-lowlight-enhancement.git
authors: Minwen Liao, Haobo Dong, Xinyi Wang, Kurban Ubul, Yihua Shao, Ziyang Yan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8766-8776

title: GMMamba:面向全切片图像分类的分组掩码Mamba
title_en: GMMamba: Group Masking Mamba for Whole Slide Image Classification
abstract: 近年来,选择性状态空间模型(Mamba)在全切片图像(WSI)分类中展现出巨大潜力。尽管如此,WSI包含显式的局部冗余(相似块)和无关区域(无用实例),这对基于Mamba的多实例学习(MIL)方法捕捉全局表示构成显著挑战。此外,袋级方法难以从所有实例中提取关键特征,而组级方法未能充分考虑肿瘤分散性和组间内在相关性,导致次优的全局表示。为解决这些问题,我们提出分组掩码Mamba(GMMamba),一种结合两个精细模块的新型框架:(1) 组内掩码Mamba(IMM)用于组内选择性实例探索,(2) 跨组超特征采样(CSS)以改善长程关系学习。具体而言,IMM在双向Mamba建模过程中自适应预测稀疏掩码,过滤掉注意力分数较低的特征(即无用模式),从而去除实例冗余以获得紧凑的局部表示。为提升袋预测性能,CSS模块进一步将稀疏组表示聚合为判别性特征,有效捕捉大规模WSI中分散且稀疏肿瘤区域的固有依赖关系。在四个数据集上的大量实验表明,GMMamba在TCGA-BRCA和TCGA-ESCA数据集上分别以2.2%和6.4%的准确率超越最先进的ACMIL方法。
abstract_en: Recent advances in selective state space models (Mamba) have shown great promise in whole slide image (WSI) classification. Despite this, WSIs contain explicit local redundancy (similar patches) and irrelevant regions (uninformative instances), posing significant challenges for Mamba-based multi-instance learning (MIL) methods in capturing global representations. Furthermore, bag-level approaches struggle to extract critical features from all instances, while group-level methods fail to adequately account for tumor dispersion and intrinsic correlations across groups, leading to suboptimal global representations. To address these issues, we propose group masking Mamba (GMMamba), a novel framework that combines two elaborate modules: (1) intra-group masking Mamba (IMM) for selective instance exploration within groups, and (2) cross-group super-feature sampling (CSS) to ameliorate long-range relation learning. Specifically, IMM adaptively predicts sparse masks to filter out features with low attention scores (i.e., uninformative patterns) during bidirectional Mamba modeling, facilitating the removal of instance redundancies for compact local representation. For improved bag prediction, the CSS module further aggregates sparse group representations into discriminative features, effectively grasping comprehensive dependencies among dispersed and sparse tumor regions inherent in large-scale WSIs. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate that GMMamba outperforms the state-of-the-art ACMIL by 2.2% and 6.4% in accuracy on the TCGA-BRCA and TCGA-ESCA datasets, respectively.
authors: Tingting Zheng, Hongxun Yao, Kui Jiang, Yi Xiao, Sicheng Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9935-9944

title: GRAB:一种针对大规模多模态模型的具有挑战性的图分析基准测试
title_en: GRAB: A Challenging GRaph Analysis Benchmark for Large Multimodal Models
abstract: 大规模多模态模型(LMMs)在许多视觉任务中表现出色。尽管存在大量知名的基准测试用于评估模型性能,但它们的挑战性正逐渐不足。因此,迫切需要为下一代LMMs设计更具挑战性的新一代基准测试。LMMs展现出潜力的一个领域是图分析,具体包括分析师在解读图表时通常执行的任务,例如估计函数和数据序列的均值、截距或相关性。在本工作中,我们引入了GRAB,一个适用于当前和未来前沿LMMs的图分析基准测试。我们的基准测试主要为合成数据,确保高质量、无噪声的问题。GRAB包含3284个问题,涵盖五个任务和23种图属性。我们在GRAB上评估了20个LMMs,发现其具有挑战性,表现最佳的模型得分仅为21.0%。最后,我们进行了多种消融实验以探究模型的成功与不足之处。我们发布了GRAB和轻量级版本GRAB-Lite,以促进这一重要且快速增长领域的发展。
abstract_en: Large multimodal models (LMMs) have exhibited proficiencies across many visual tasks. Although numerous well-known benchmarks exist to evaluate model performance, they increasingly have insufficient headroom. As such, there is a pressing need for a new generation of benchmarks challenging enough for the next generation of LMMs. One area that LMMs show potential is graph analysis, specifically, the tasks an analyst might typically perform when interpreting figures such as estimating the mean, intercepts or correlations of functions and data series. In this work, we introduce GRAB, a graph analysis benchmark, fit for current and future frontier LMMs. Our benchmark is predominantly synthetic, ensuring high-quality, noise-free questions. GRAB is comprised of 3284 questions, covering five tasks and 23 graph properties. We evaluate 20 LMMs on GRAB, finding it to be a challenging benchmark, with the highest performing model attaining a score of just 21.0%. Finally, we conduct various ablations to investigate where the models succeed and struggle. We release GRAB and a lightweight GRAB-Lite to encourage progress in this important, growing domain.
authors: Jonathan Roberts, Kai Han, Samuel Albanie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1644-1654

title: GReg:面向手语视频生成的几何感知区域细化
title_en: GReg: Geometry-Aware Region Refinement for Sign Language Video Generation
abstract: 手语视频生成(SLVG)旨在将手语序列转换为自然流畅的手语视频。现有SLVG方法缺乏对人体解剖结构的几何建模,导致生成结果在解剖学上不合理且时间上不一致。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新的SLVG框架:几何感知区域细化(GReg)。GReg利用SMPL-X模型中的三维几何信息(如法线图和梯度图),以确保解剖学和时间上的连贯性。为了充分利用三维几何先验,我们提出了两种新方法:1)区域先验生成,利用区域专家网络生成目标结构区域作为生成先验;2)梯度增强细化,通过梯度特征引导关键区域中细节结构的细化。此外,我们通过在这些区域及其梯度图上进行对抗训练,增强关键区域的视觉真实感。实验结果表明,GReg在结构准确性和时间一致性方面均达到最先进水平。
abstract_en: Sign Language Video Generation (SLVG) aims to transform sign language sequences into natural and fluent sign language videos. Existing SLVG methods lack geometric modeling of human anatomical structures, leading to anatomically implausible and temporally inconsistent generation. To address these challenges, we propose a novel SLVG framework: Geometry-Aware Region Refinement (GReg). GReg uses 3D geometric information (such as normal maps and gradient maps) from the SMPL-X model to ensure anatomical and temporal consistency.To fully leverage the 3D geometric priors, we propose two novel methods: 1) Regional Prior Generation, which uses regional expert networks to generate target-structured regions as generation priors; 2) Gradient-Enhanced Refinement, which guides the refinement of detailed structures in key regions using gradient features.Furthermore, we enhance visual realism in key regions through adversarial training on both these regions and their gradient maps.Experimental results demonstrate that GReg achieves state-of-the-art performance with superior structural accuracy and temporal consistency.
authors: Tongkai Shi, Lianyu Hu, Fanhua Shang, Liqing Gao, Wei Feng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16472-16481

title: 基于自适应光照聚合与扩散引导材质先验的高斯泼溅光照分解方法
title_en: GS-ID: Illumination Decomposition on Gaussian Splatting via Adaptive Light Aggregation and Diffusion-Guided Material Priors
abstract: 高斯泼溅(GS)已成为逼真渲染的有效表示方法,但其底层几何、材质和光照仍存在纠缠,阻碍场景编辑。现有基于GS的方法在非朗伯条件下难以解耦这些成分,尤其在存在镜面反射和阴影时表现不佳。我们提出GS-ID,一种端到端的光照分解框架,整合自适应光照聚合与扩散引导的材质先验。除可学习的环境光映射外,我们通过各向异性球面高斯混合(SGMs)建模空间变化的局部光照,并与场景内容联合优化。为更好捕捉投影阴影,我们为每个泼溅关联一个可学习单位向量,编码多光源的阴影方向,进一步提升材质与光照估计。通过结合SGMs与扩散模型的内在先验,GS-ID显著降低光照-材质-几何交互的歧义性,在逆渲染和重光照基准测试中取得最先进性能。实验还验证了GS-ID在重光照和场景合成等下游应用中的有效性。
abstract_en: Gaussian Splatting (GS) has emerged as an effective representation for photorealistic rendering, but the underlying geometry, material, and lighting remain entangled, hindering scene editing. Existing GS-based methods struggle to disentangle these components under non-Lambertian conditions, especially in the presence of specularities and shadows. We propose GS-ID, an end-to-end framework for illumination decomposition that integrates adaptive light aggregation with diffusion-based material priors. In addition to a learnable environment map for ambient illumination, we model spatially-varying local lighting using anisotropic spherical Gaussian mixtures (SGMs) that are jointly optimized with scene content. To better capture cast shadows, we associate each splat with a learnable unit vector that encodes shadow directions from multiple light sources, further improving material and lighting estimation. By combining SGMs with intrinsic priors from diffusion models, GS-ID significantly reduces ambiguity in light-material-geometry interactions and achieves state-of-the-art performance on inverse rendering and relighting benchmarks. Experiments also demonstrate the effectiveness of GS-ID for downstream applications such as relighting and scene composition.
authors: Kang Du, Zhihao Liang, Yulin Shen, Zeyu Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26220-26229

title: GS-LIVM:基于高斯泼溅的实时逼真激光雷达-惯性-视觉映射
title_en: GS-LIVM: Real-Time Photo-Realistic LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Mapping with Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 本文提出GS-LIVM,一种面向户外场景的实时逼真激光雷达-惯性-视觉映射框架,采用高斯泼溅技术。与基于神经辐射场(NeRF)和三维高斯泼溅(3DGS)的现有方法相比,我们的方法在大规模无界户外环境中实现了实时逼真映射,同时保证高质量图像渲染。本工作中,采用高斯过程回归(GPR)来缓解稀疏且分布不均的激光雷达观测带来的问题。基于体素的三维高斯映射表示通过自定义CUDA内核加速,实现了大规模户外环境的实时密集映射。此外,整体框架以协方差为中心设计,利用估计的协方差初始化三维高斯的尺度和旋转,并更新GPR参数。我们在多个户外数据集上评估了该算法,结果表明我们的方法在映射效率和渲染质量方面均达到最先进水平。源代码已开源至GitHub。
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce GS-LIVM, a real-time photo-realistic LiDAR-Inertial-Visual mapping framework with Gaussian Splatting tailored for outdoor scenes. Compared to existing methods based on Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), our approach enables real-time photo-realistic mapping while ensuring high-quality image rendering in large-scale unbounded outdoor environments. In this work, Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) is employed to mitigate the issues resulting from sparse and unevenly distributed LiDAR observations. The voxel-based 3D Gaussians map representation facilitates real-time dense mapping in large outdoor environments with acceleration governed by custom CUDA kernels. Moreover, the overall framework is designed in a covariance-centered manner, where the estimated covariance is used to initialize the scale and rotation of 3D Gaussians, as well as update the parameters of the GPR. We evaluate our algorithm on several outdoor datasets, and the results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of mapping efficiency and rendering quality. The source code is available on GitHub.
authors: Yusen Xie, Zhenmin Huang, Jin Wu, Jun Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26869-26878

title: GS-Occ3D:基于高斯点云的视觉仅占用场重建扩展
title_en: GS-Occ3D: Scaling Vision-only Occupancy Reconstruction with Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 占据场对自动驾驶至关重要,为感知和规划提供关键的几何先验信息。然而,现有方法主要依赖基于激光雷达的占据场标注,这限制了可扩展性,并阻碍了利用大量潜在众包数据进行自动标注。为解决这一问题,我们提出GS-Occ3D,一个可扩展的纯视觉框架,直接重建占据场。纯视觉占据场重建面临显著挑战,包括稀疏视角、动态场景元素、严重遮挡和长时序运动。现有基于视觉的方法主要依赖网格表示,其存在几何不完整和额外后处理的问题,限制了可扩展性。为克服这些问题,GS-Occ3D采用基于八叉树的高斯点云表示优化显式占据场表示,确保效率和可扩展性。此外,我们将场景分解为静态背景、地面和动态物体,实现定制化建模策略:(1) 地面被显式重建为主导结构元素,显著提升大面积一致性;(2) 动态车辆被单独建模以更好捕捉与运动相关的占据场模式。在Waymo数据集上的大量实验表明,GS-Occ3D实现了最先进的几何重建结果。通过从多样化城市场景中整理纯视觉二值占据场标签,我们展示了其在Occ3D-Waymo上的下游占据场模型有效性以及在Occ3D-nuScenes上的优越零样本泛化能力。这突显了大规模基于视觉的占据场重建作为可扩展自动标注新范式的潜力。项目页面:https://gs-occ3d.github.io/
abstract_en: Occupancy is crucial for autonomous driving, providing essential geometric priors for perception and planning. However, existing methods predominantly rely on LiDAR-based occupancy annotations, which limits scalability and prevents leveraging vast amounts of potential crowdsourced data for auto-labeling. To address this, we propose GS-Occ3D, a scalable vision-only framework that directly reconstructs occupancy. Vision-only occupancy reconstruction poses significant challenges due to sparse viewpoints, dynamic scene elements, severe occlusions, and long-horizon motion. Existing vision-based methods primarily rely on mesh representation, which suffer from incomplete geometry and additional post-processing, limiting scalability. To overcome these issues, GS-Occ3D optimizes an explicit occupancy representation using an Octree-based Gaussian Surfel formulation, ensuring efficiency and scalability. Additionally, we decompose scenes into static background, ground, and dynamic objects, enabling tailored modeling strategies: (1) Ground is explicitly reconstructed as a dominant structural element, significantly improving large-area consistency; (2) Dynamic vehicles are separately modeled to better capture motion-related occupancy patterns. Extensive experiments on the Waymo dataset demonstrate that GS-Occ3D achieves state-of-the-art geometry reconstruction results. By curating vision-only binary occupancy labels from diverse urban scenes, we show their effectiveness for downstream occupancy models on Occ3D-Waymo and superior zero-shot generalization on Occ3D-nuScenes. It highlights the potential of large-scale vision-based occupancy reconstruction as a new paradigm for scalable auto-labeling. Project Page: https://gs-occ3d.github.io/
authors: Baijun Ye, Minghui Qin, Saining Zhang, Moonjun Gong, Shaoting Zhu, Hao Zhao, Hang Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25925-25937

title: GSOT3D:面向自然场景中通用三维单目标跟踪的基准
title_en: GSOT3D: Towards Generic 3D Single Object Tracking in the Wild
abstract: 本文提出了一种新型基准数据集GSOT3D,旨在促进自然场景中通用三维单目标跟踪(SOT)的发展。具体而言,GSOT3D包含620个序列,共计123K帧,覆盖54种物体类别。每个序列均提供多种模态数据,包括点云(PC)、RGB图像和深度信息。这使得GSOT3D能够支持多种三维跟踪任务,如基于点云的单模态三维SOT、基于RGB-PC或RGB-D的多模态三维SOT,从而大幅拓展三维目标跟踪的研究方向。为提供高质量的逐帧三维标注,所有序列均经过多轮细致的标注、检查与优化。据我们所知,GSOT3D是目前针对各类通用三维目标跟踪任务规模最大的基准数据集。为理解现有三维跟踪器的性能并为未来GSOT3D相关研究提供对比基准,我们评估了八种具有代表性的基于点云的跟踪模型。我们的评估结果表明,这些模型在GSOT3D上性能显著下降,表明需要更多努力来实现鲁棒且通用的三维目标跟踪。此外,为鼓励未来研究,我们提出了一种简单而有效的通用三维跟踪器PROT3D,该跟踪器通过渐进式时空网络定位目标物体,在各项指标上均显著超越现有解决方案。通过发布GSOT3D,我们期望推动未来三维跟踪在研究与应用中的进一步发展。我们的基准数据集、模型以及评估工具包和结果已公开在https://github.com/ailovejinx/GSOT3D。
abstract_en: In this paper, we present a novel benchmark, GSOT3D, that aims at facilitating development of generic 3D single object tracking (SOT) in the wild. Specifically, GSOT3D offers 620 sequences with 123K frames, and covers a wide selection of 54 object categories. Each sequence is offered with multiple modalities, including the point cloud (PC), RGB image, and depth. This allows GSOT3D to support various 3D tracking tasks, such as single-modal 3D SOT on PC and multi-modal 3D SOT on RGB-PC or RGB-D, and thus greatly broadens research directions for 3D object tracking. To provide high-quality per-frame 3D annotations, all sequences are labeled manually with multiple rounds of meticulous inspection and refinement. To our best knowledge, GSOT3D is the largest benchmark dedicated to various generic 3D object tracking tasks. To understand how existing 3D trackers perform and to provide comparisons for future research on GSOT3D, we assess eight representative point cloud-based tracking models. Our evaluation results exhibit that these models heavily degrade on GSOT3D, and more efforts are required for robust and generic 3D object tracking. Besides, to encourage future research, we present a simple yet effective generic 3D tracker, named PROT3D, that localizes the target object via a progressive spatial-temporal network and outperforms all current solutions by a large margin. By releasing GSOT3D, we expect to advance further 3D tracking in future research and applications. Our benchmark and model as well as the evaluation toolkit and results are publicly available at https://github.com/ailovejinx/GSOT3D.
authors: Yifan Jiao, Yunhao Li, Junhua Ding, Qing Yang, Song Fu, Heng Fan, Libo Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5469-5478

title: GSRecon:面向稀疏视角的高效可泛化高斯点云表面重建
title_en: GSRecon: Efficient Generalizable Gaussian Splatting for Surface Reconstruction from Sparse Views
abstract: 可泛化表面重建旨在以端到端方式从稀疏图像集合中恢复场景表面。现有基于体渲染的方法通过沿相机光线评估大量点来推断几何结构,导致重建效率低下。近期,3D高斯点云提供了一种替代的高效场景表示方法,并启发了一系列表面重建技术。然而,这些方法需要密集视角且无法泛化到新场景。本文提出了一种基于高斯点云的新型表面重建方法GSRecon,利用基于光栅化的渲染优势实现高效重建。为获得准确的几何表示,我们提出了一种几何感知的跨视角增强模块,通过融合其他视角的准确几何信息来提升当前视角中不可靠的几何估计。为生成细粒度高斯基元,我们提出了一种混合跨视角特征聚合模块,集成高效体素分支与细粒度点分支,联合捕捉跨视角几何信息。随后,利用这些高斯基元渲染生成每视角深度图并进行融合,最终获得3D表面。在DTU、BlendedMVS和Tanks and Temples数据集上的大量实验验证了GSRecon在效率上的最先进性能。代码已开源至https://github.com/hyangwinter/GSRecon。
abstract_en: Generalizable surface reconstruction aims to recover the surface the scene from a sparse set of images in a feed-forward manner. Existing volume rendering-based methods evaluate numerous points along camera rays to infer the geometry, resulting in inefficient reconstruction. Recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting offers an alternative efficient scene representation and has inspired a series of surface reconstruction methods. However, these methods require dense views and cannot be generalized to new scenes. In this paper, we propose a novel surface reconstruction method with Gaussian splatting, named GSRecon, which leverages the advantages of rasterization-based rendering to achieve efficient reconstruction. To obtain accurate geometry representation, we propose a geometry-aware cross-view enhancement module to improve the unreliable geometry estimation in the current view by incorporating accurate geometric information from other views. To generate the fine-grained Gaussian primitives, we propose a hybrid cross-view feature aggregation module that integrates an efficient voxel branch and a fine-grained point branch to jointly capture cross-view geometric information. Subsequently, per-view depth maps are rendered using these Gaussian primitives and fused to obtain the final 3D surface. Extensive experiments on the DTU, BlendedMVS, and Tanks and Temples datasets validate that GSRecon achieves state-of-the-art performance efficiently. Code is available at https://github.com/hyangwinter/GSRecon.
authors: Hang Yang, Le Hui, Jianjun Qian, Jin Xie, Jian Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25346-25356

title: GSV3D: 基于高斯点云几何蒸馏与稳定视频扩散的单图像三维物体生成
title_en: GSV3D: Gaussian Splatting-based Geometric Distillation with Stable Video Diffusion for Single-Image 3D Object Generation
abstract: 基于图像的三维生成在机器人和游戏领域有广泛的应用,其中高质量、多样化输出和一致的三维表示至关重要。然而,现有方法存在局限性:3D扩散模型受限于数据集稀缺性和缺乏强大的预训练先验,而基于2D扩散的方法则难以保证几何一致性。我们提出了一种方法,利用2D扩散模型的隐式三维推理能力,通过基于高斯点云的几何蒸馏确保三维一致性。具体而言,所提出的高斯点云解码器通过将SV3D潜在输出转换为显式的三维表示来强制执行三维一致性。与仅依赖隐式二维表示进行视频生成的SV3D不同,高斯点云显式编码空间和外观属性,通过几何约束实现多视角一致性。这些约束校正视角不一致性,确保稳健的几何一致性。因此,我们的方法同时生成高质量、多视角一致的图像和精确的三维模型,为基于单图像的三维生成提供可扩展的解决方案,并弥合二维扩散多样性与三维结构一致性的差距。实验结果表明,我们的方法在多视角一致性方面达到最先进水平,并在多样化数据集上展现出强大的泛化能力。我们的代码可在https://github.com/MOMOYATW/GSV3D获取。
abstract_en: Image-based 3D generation has vast applications in robotics and gaming, where high-quality, diverse outputs and consistent 3D representations are crucial. However, existing methods have limitations: 3D diffusion models are limited by dataset scarcity and the absence of strong pre-trained priors, while 2D diffusion-based approaches struggle with geometric consistency. We propose a method that leverages 2D diffusion models' implicit 3D reasoning ability while ensuring 3D consistency via Gaussian-splatting-based geometric distillation. Specifically, the proposed Gaussian Splatting Decoder enforces 3D consistency by transforming SV3D latent outputs into an explicit 3D representation. Unlike SV3D, which only relies on implicit 2D representations for video generation, Gaussian Splatting explicitly encodes spatial and appearance attributes, enabling multi-view consistency through geometric constraints. These constraints correct view inconsistencies, ensuring robust geometric consistency. As a result, our approach simultaneously generates high-quality, multi-view-consistent images and accurate 3D models, providing a scalable solution for single-image-based 3D generation and bridging the gap between 2D Diffusion diversity and 3D structural coherence. Experimental results demonstrate state-of-the-art multi-view consistency and strong generalization across diverse datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/MOMOYATW/GSV3D.
authors: Ye Tao, Jiawei Zhang, Yahao Shi, Dongqing Zou, Bin Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7751-7760

title: GT-Loc:通过联合嵌入空间统一图像中的时间与地点
title_en: GT-Loc: Unifying When and Where in Images Through a Joint Embedding Space
abstract: 时间戳预测旨在仅通过视觉信息确定图像的拍摄时间,支持元数据校正、检索和数字取证等应用。在户外场景中,小时估计依赖于亮度、色调和阴影位置等线索,而季节变化和天气信息用于日期估计。然而,这些视觉线索显著依赖于地理上下文,使时间戳预测与地理定位紧密关联。为解决这种相互依赖性,我们提出GT-Loc,一种基于检索的新方法,可联合预测图像的拍摄时间(小时和月份)及地理定位(GPS坐标)。我们的方法采用独立的图像、时间和位置编码器,在共享的高维特征空间中对齐其嵌入。考虑到时间的循环性,不同于传统基于硬正负样本的对比学习,我们提出一种时间度量学习目标,通过建模循环托尔多表面上的成对时间差异生成软目标。我们展示了新的基准测试结果,证明联合优化优于先前的时间预测方法,即使在推理时使用真实地理定位作为输入。此外,我们的方法在标准地理定位任务中取得竞争性结果,统一的嵌入空间还促进了组合和基于文本的图像检索。
abstract_en: Timestamp prediction aims to determine when an image was captured using only visual information, supporting applications such as metadata correction, retrieval, and digital forensics. In outdoor scenarios, hourly estimates rely on cues like brightness, hue, and shadow positioning, while seasonal changes and weather inform date estimation. However, these visual cues significantly depend on geographic context, closely linking timestamp prediction to geo-localization. To address this interdependence, we introduce GT-Loc, a novel retrieval-based method that jointly predicts the capture time (hour and month) and geo-location (GPS coordinates) of an image. Our approach employs separate encoders for images, time, and location, aligning their embeddings within a shared high-dimensional feature space. Recognizing the cyclical nature of time, instead of conventional contrastive learning with hard positives and negatives, we propose a temporal metric-learning objective providing soft targets by modeling pairwise time differences over a cyclical toroidal surface. We present new benchmarks demonstrating that our joint optimization surpasses previous time prediction methods, even those using the ground-truth geo-location as an input during inference. Additionally, our approach achieves competitive results on standard geo-localization tasks, and the unified embedding space facilitates compositional and text-based image retrieval.
authors: David G. Shatwell, Ishan Rajendrakumar Dave, Sirnam Swetha, Mubarak Shah ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1-11

title: GT-Mean Loss:一种解决低光照图像增强中亮度不匹配问题的简单而有效的解决方案
title_en: GT-Mean Loss: A Simple Yet Effective Solution for Brightness Mismatch in Low-Light Image Enhancement
abstract: 低光照图像增强(LLIE)旨在提升在光照条件较差环境下拍摄图像的视觉质量。在监督式LLIE任务中,增强图像的整体亮度与其真实标签对应图像之间存在显著却常被忽视的不一致性,这种现象在本研究中被称为亮度不匹配。亮度不匹配通过误导模型训练对监督式LLIE模型产生负面影响。然而,这一问题在当前研究中被严重忽视。在此背景下,我们提出GT-mean损失函数,这是一种从概率视角直接建模图像均值的简单而有效的损失函数。GT-mean损失具有灵活性,因为它可以以最小的额外计算成本将现有的监督式LLIE损失函数扩展为GT-mean形式。大量实验表明,引入GT-mean损失可使各类方法和数据集在性能上实现一致的提升。
abstract_en: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) aims to improve the visual quality of images captured under poor lighting conditions. In supervised LLIE tasks, there exists a significant yet often overlooked inconsistency between the overall brightness of an enhanced image and its ground truth counterpart, referred to as brightness mismatch in this study. Brightness mismatch negatively impact supervised LLIE models by misleading model training. However, this issue is largely neglected in current research. In this context, we propose the  GT-mean loss, a simple yet effective loss function directly modeling the mean values of images from a probabilistic perspective.The GT-mean loss is flexible, as it extends existing supervised LLIE loss functions into the GT-mean form with minimal additional computational costs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the incorporation of the GT-mean loss results in consistent performance improvements across various methods and datasets.
authors: Jingxi Liao, Shijie Hao, Richang Hong, Meng Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6112-6121

title: GTR:引导式思维强化防止基于强化学习的视觉-语言模型代理训练中的思维坍塌
title_en: GTR: Guided Thought Reinforcement Prevents Thought Collapse in RL-based VLM Agent Training
abstract: 可验证结果奖励的强化学习(RLVR)已有效扩展了大型语言模型(LLMs)中的思维链(CoT)推理能力。然而,其在视觉环境中训练目标导向动作推理的视觉-语言模型(VLM)代理的有效性尚未得到充分验证。本研究通过在24点等复杂卡牌游戏和ALFWorld具身任务上的大量实验探讨了这一问题。我们发现,当奖励仅基于动作结果时,强化学习(RL)无法激励VLM中的CoT推理,反而导致我们定义的“思维坍塌”现象:代理思维多样性快速丧失,出现与状态无关且不完整的推理,进而产生无效动作,最终导致负奖励。为应对思维坍塌,我们强调过程引导的必要性,并提出一种自动校正器,在每个RL步骤中评估和优化代理的推理过程。这种简单且可扩展的GTR(引导式思维强化)框架无需密集的每步人工标注即可同时训练推理和动作。实验表明,GTR显著提升了LLaVA-7B模型在多种视觉环境中的性能和泛化能力,任务成功率比现有最优模型高3-5倍,且模型规模显著更小。
abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable outcome rewards (RLVR) has effectively scaled up chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning in large language models (LLMs). Yet, its efficacy in training vision-language model (VLM) agents for goal-directed action reasoning in visual environments is less established. This work investigates this problem through extensive experiments on complex card games, such as 24 points, and embodied tasks from ALFWorld. We find that when rewards are based solely on action outcomes, RL fails to incentivize CoT reasoning in VLMs, instead leading to a phenomenon we termed thought collapse, characterized by a rapid loss of diversity in the agent's thoughts, state-irrelevant and incomplete reasoning, and subsequent invalid actions, resulting in negative rewards. To counteract thought collapse, we highlight the necessity of process guidance and propose an automated corrector that evaluates and refines the agent's reasoning at each RL step. This simple and scalable GTR (Guided Thought Reinforcement) framework trains reasoning and action simultaneously without the need for dense, per-step human labeling. Our experiments demonstrate that GTR significantly enhances the performance and generalization of the LLaVA-7B model across various visual environments, achieving 3-5 times higher task success rates compared to SoTA models with notably smaller model sizes.
authors: Tong Wei, Yijun Yang, Junliang Xing, Yuanchun Shi, Zongqing Lu, Deheng Ye ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18855-18865

title: GUAVA: 通用的上半身三维高斯人像
title_en: GUAVA: Generalizable Upper Body 3D Gaussian Avatar
abstract: 从单张图像重建高质量、可动画化的三维人体化身,因其广泛的应用潜力而受到广泛关注。三维人体化身重建通常需要多视角或单目视频,并针对个体ID进行训练,这既复杂又耗时。此外,受限于SMPLX的表达能力,现有方法往往侧重于身体运动,而难以处理面部表情。为解决这些问题,我们首先引入了一个具有表达能力的人体模型(EHM)以增强面部表情能力,并开发了精确的跟踪方法。基于该模板模型,我们提出GUAVA,这是首个用于快速可动画化上半身三维高斯人像重建的框架。我们利用逆纹理映射和投影采样技术,从单张图像中推断上半身高斯分布。渲染图像通过神经细化器进行优化。实验结果表明,GUAVA在渲染质量上显著优于先前方法,并实现了显著的速度提升,重建时间处于亚秒级(0.1秒),并支持实时动画与渲染。
abstract_en: Reconstructing a high-quality, animatable 3D human avatar with expressive facial and hand motions from a single image has gained significant attention due to its broad application potential. 3D human avatar reconstruction typically requires multi-view or monocular videos and training on individual IDs, which is both complex and time-consuming. Furthermore, limited by SMPLX's expressiveness, these methods often focus on body motion but struggle with facial expressions. To address these challenges, we first introduce an expressive human model (EHM) to enhance facial expression capabilities and develop an accurate tracking method. Based on this template model, we propose GUAVA, the first framework for fast animatable upper-body 3D Gaussian avatar reconstruction. We leverage inverse texture mapping and projection sampling techniques to infer Ubody (upper-body) Gaussians from a single image. The rendered images are refined through a neural refiner. Experimental results demonstrate that GUAVA significantly outperforms previous methods in rendering quality and offers significant speed improvements, with reconstruction times in the sub-second range ( 0.1s), and supports real-time animation and rendering.
authors: Dongbin Zhang, Yunfei Liu, Lijian Lin, Ye Zhu, Yang Li, Minghan Qin, Yu Li, Haoqian Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14205-14217

title: GUIOdyssey:面向移动设备跨应用图形用户界面导航的综合数据集
title_en: GUIOdyssey: A Comprehensive Dataset for Cross-App GUI Navigation on Mobile Devices
abstract: 自主图形用户界面(GUI)导航代理可通过优化工作流程并减少手动干预,提升通信、娱乐和生产力场景下的用户体验。然而,先前的GUI代理多基于单一应用内任务的数据集进行训练,导致跨应用导航性能欠佳。为解决该问题,我们提出GUIOdyssey,一个面向移动设备跨应用GUI导航的综合数据集。GUIOdyssey包含8,334个会话,平均每会话15.3步,覆盖6款移动设备、212个独立应用及1,357个应用组合。每个步骤均配备详细的语义推理注释,有助于模型构建认知过程并增强复杂跨应用任务的推理能力。基于GUIOdyssey,我们开发了OdysseyAgent,这是一个配备历史重采样模块的探索型多模态代理,可高效关注历史截图标记,在性能与推理速度间取得平衡。在领域内和领域外场景的大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性。此外,我们证明了数据集中包含的动作、截图和上下文的历史信息可显著提升OdysseyAgent在复杂跨应用任务中的表现。
abstract_en: Autonomous Graphical User Interface (GUI) navigation agents can enhance user experience in communication, entertainment, and productivity by streamlining workflows and reducing manual intervention. However, prior GUI agents often trained with datasets comprising tasks that can be completed within a single app, leading to poor performance in cross-app navigation. To address this problem, we present GUIOdyssey, a comprehensive dataset for cross-app mobile GUI navigation. GUIOdyssey comprises 8,334 episodes with an average of 15.3 steps per episode, covering 6 mobile devices, 212 distinct apps, and 1,357 app combinations. Each step is enriched with detailed semantic reasoning annotations, which aid the model in building cognitive processes and enhancing its reasoning abilities for complex cross-app tasks. Building on GUIOdyssey, we develop OdysseyAgent, an exploratory multimodal agent for long-step cross-app navigation equipped with a history resampler module that efficiently attends to historical screenshot tokens, balancing performance and inference speed. Extensive experiments conducted in both in-domain and out-of-domain scenarios validate the effectiveness of our approach. Moreover, we demonstrate that historial information involving actions, screenshots and context in our dataset can significantly enhances OdysseyAgent's performance on complex cross-app tasks.
authors: Quanfeng Lu, Wenqi Shao, Zitao Liu, Lingxiao Du, Fanqing Meng, Boxuan Li, Botong Chen, Siyuan Huang, Kaipeng Zhang, Ping Luo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22404-22414

title: GVDepth: 基于概率线索融合的地面车辆零样本单目深度估计方法
title_en: GVDepth: Zero-Shot Monocular Depth Estimation for Ground Vehicles based on Probabilistic Cue Fusion
abstract: 由于其病态性,度量单目深度估计的泛化面临重大挑战,而相机参数与深度的耦合关系进一步加剧了问题,阻碍了多数据集训练和零样本准确率。这一挑战在自动驾驶和移动机器人领域尤为明显,其中数据采集采用固定相机配置,限制了几何多样性。然而,这一背景也提供了机遇:相机与地面平面的固定关系施加了额外的透视几何约束,使得可通过物体在图像中的垂直位置进行深度回归。然而,该线索极易过拟合,因此我们提出了一种新的规范表示方法,在不同相机配置下保持一致性,有效解耦深度与特定参数,提升跨数据集的泛化能力。我们还提出了一种新颖的架构,通过物体尺寸和垂直图像位置线索的概率性融合进行自适应深度估计。全面评估表明,该方法在五个自动驾驶数据集上有效,实现了不同分辨率、宽高比和相机配置下的精确度量深度估计。值得注意的是,尽管仅在单一数据集和单相机配置上训练,我们仍实现了与现有零样本方法相当的精度。项目网站:https://unizgfer-lamor.github.io/gvdepth/
abstract_en: Generalizing metric monocular depth estimation presents a significant challenge due to its ill-posed nature, while the entanglement between camera parameters and depth amplifies issues further, hindering multi-dataset training and zero-shot accuracy. This challenge is particularly evident in autonomous vehicles and mobile robotics, where data is collected with fixed camera setups, limiting the geometric diversity. Yet, this context also presents an opportunity: the fixed relationship between the camera and the ground plane imposes additional perspective geometry constraints, enabling depth regression via vertical image positions of objects. However, this cue is highly susceptible to overfitting, thus we propose a novel canonical representation that maintains consistency across varied camera setups, effectively disentangling depth from specific parameters and enhancing generalization across datasets. We also propose a novel architecture that adaptively and probabilistically fuses depths estimated via object size and vertical image position cues. A comprehensive evaluation demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed approach on five autonomous driving datasets, achieving accurate metric depth estimation for varying resolutions, aspect ratios and camera setups. Notably, we achieve comparable accuracy to existing zero-shot methods, despite training on a single dataset with a single-camera setup. Project website: https://unizgfer-lamor.github.io/gvdepth/
authors: Karlo Koledić, Luka Petrović, Ivan Marković, Ivan Petrović ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26126-26135

title: GWM:面向可扩展高斯世界模型的机器人操作
title_en: GWM: Towards Scalable Gaussian World Models for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: 在学习到的世界模型中训练机器人策略正因现实世界交互的低效性而成为趋势。已有的基于图像的世界模型和策略在先前研究中展现出成功,但缺乏需要对三维世界进行一致空间和物理理解的稳健几何信息,即使在互联网规模视频数据上预训练。为此,我们提出了一种新型世界模型分支——高斯世界模型(GWM),用于机器人操作,该模型通过推断高斯基元在机器人动作作用下的传播来重建未来状态。其核心是一个潜在扩散变换器(DiT)与三维变分自编码器的结合,利用高斯点云实现细粒度场景级未来状态重建。GWM不仅能通过自监督未来预测训练增强模仿学习代理的视觉表征,还能作为神经模拟器支持基于模型的强化学习。模拟和真实世界实验均表明,GWM能够根据多样化的机器人动作精确预测未来场景,并可进一步用于训练超越现有技术水平的策略,展示了三维世界模型的初始数据扩展潜力。
abstract_en: Training robot policies within a learned world model is trending due to the inefficiency of real-world interactions. The established image-based world models and policies have shown prior success, but lack robust geometric information that requires consistent spatial and physical understanding of the three-dimensional world, even pre-trained on internet-scale video sources. To this end, we propose a novel branch of world model named Gaussian World Model (GWM) for robotic manipulation, which reconstructs the future state by inferring the propagation of Gaussian primitives under the effect of robot actions. At its core is a latent Diffusion Transformer (DiT) combined with a 3D variational autoencoder, enabling fine-grained scene-level future state reconstruction with Gaussian Splatting. GWM can not only enhance the visual representation for imitation learning agent by self-supervised future prediction training, but can serve as a neural simulator that supports model-based reinforcement learning. Both simulated and real-world experiments depict that GWM can precisely predict future scenes conditioned on diverse robot actions, and can be further utilized to train policies that outperform the state-of-the-art by impressive margins, showcasing the initial data scaling potential of 3D world model.
authors: Guanxing Lu, Baoxiong Jia, Puhao Li, Yixin Chen, Ziwei Wang, Yansong Tang, Siyuan Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9263-9274

title: GaRe:基于可重新照明的3D高斯点云渲染的户外场景从无约束照片集合
title_en: GaRe: Relightable 3D Gaussian Splatting for Outdoor Scenes from Unconstrained Photo Collections
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于3D高斯点云渲染的户外重新照明框架,该框架利用内在图像分解技术,从无约束照片集合中精确整合太阳光、天空辐射和间接光照。与先前将每张图像的全局光照压缩为单一潜在向量的方法不同,我们的方法能够同时实现多样化的光照效果操控和动态阴影效果生成。这通过三项关键创新实现:(1) 基于残差的太阳可见性提取方法,以准确分离直接阳光效果;(2) 基于区域的监督框架,结合结构一致性损失,实现物理可解释且一致的光照分解;(3) 基于光线追踪的技术,用于现实阴影模拟。大量实验表明,我们的框架在生成新颖视角时,其保真度与最先进的重新照明解决方案竞争,并产生更自然且多方面的光照和阴影效果。
abstract_en: We propose a 3D Gaussian splatting-based framework for outdoor relighting that leverages intrinsic image decomposition to precisely integrate sunlight, sky radiance, and indirect lighting from unconstrained photo collections.
