authors: Nupur Kumari, Xi Yin, Jun-Yan Zhu, Ishan Misra, Samaneh Azadi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16524-16534

title: 从文本生成物理稳定且可建造的砖结构
title_en: Generating Physically Stable and Buildable Brick Structures from Text
abstract: 我们介绍了BrickGPT,这是首个从文本提示生成物理稳定且相互连接的砖块组装模型的方法。为实现这一目标,我们构建了一个大规模的物理稳定砖结构数据集及其相关描述,并训练一个自回归大语言模型通过下一个标记预测来预测要添加的下一个砖块。为了提高生成设计的稳定性,我们在自回归推理过程中采用了一种高效的合法性检查和物理感知回滚机制,利用物理定律和装配约束修剪不可行的标记预测。我们的实验表明,BrickGPT生成的砖结构稳定、多样且具有审美价值,与输入文本提示高度一致。我们还开发了一种基于文本的砖块纹理生成方法,以创建彩色和纹理设计。我们展示了这些设计可以由人类手动组装,也可由机械臂自动完成。我们发布了新的数据集StableText2Brick,包含超过47,000个砖结构,涵盖超过28,000个独特的3D物体,并配有详细描述,同时在项目网站(https://avalovelace1.github.io/BrickGPT/)提供代码和模型。
abstract_en: We introduce BrickGPT, the first approach for generating physically stable interconnecting brick assembly models from text prompts. To achieve this, we construct a large-scale, physically stable dataset of brick structures, along with their associated captions, and train an autoregressive large language model to predict the next brick to add via next-token prediction. To improve the stability of the resulting designs, we employ an efficient validity check and physics-aware rollback during autoregressive inference, which prunes infeasible token predictions using physics laws and assembly constraints. Our experiments show that BrickGPT produces stable, diverse, and aesthetically pleasing brick structures that align closely with the input text prompts. We also develop a text-based brick texturing method to generate colored and textured designs. We show that our designs can be assembled manually by humans and automatically by robotic arms. We release our new dataset, StableText2Brick, containing over 47,000 brick structures of over 28,000 unique 3D objects accompanied by detailed captions, along with our code and models at the project website: https://avalovelace1.github.io/BrickGPT/.
authors: Ava Pun, Kangle Deng, Ruixuan Liu, Deva Ramanan, Changliu Liu, Jun-Yan Zhu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14798-14809

title: 生成、快与慢:可扩展的并行视频生成方法
title_en: Generating, Fast and Slow: Scalable Parallel Video Generation with Video Interface Networks
abstract: 扩散变换器(DiTs)可以生成短时逼真的视频,但直接通过全注意力机制对长视频进行训练和采样在计算上仍具有挑战性。替代方法将长视频分解为短视频片段的序列生成,需要多次采样链迭代和专门的一致性模块。为克服这些挑战,我们引入了一种新范式——视频接口网络(VINs),通过抽象模块增强DiTs,以实现视频片段的并行推理。在每个扩散步骤中,VINs从本地片段的噪声输入和编码表示中编码全局语义,从而指导DiTs并行去噪片段。VIN与DiT的耦合通过去噪目标进行端到端学习。此外,VIN架构保持固定大小的编码标记,通过单次交叉注意力步骤对输入进行编码。将编码标记与输入解耦,使VIN能够扩展到长视频并学习关键语义。在VBench上的实验表明,VINs在保持背景一致性和主体连贯性方面优于现有基于分块的方法。我们通过光流分析进一步表明,与全生成相比,我们的方法在使用25-40%更少FLOPs的情况下实现了最先进的运动平滑度。最后,在用户研究中,人类评估者对我们的方法在整体视频质量和时间一致性方面给予了积极评价。
abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) can generate short photorealistic videos, yet directly training and sampling longer videos with full attention across the video remains computationally challenging. Alternative methods break long videos down into sequential generation of short video segments, requiring multiple sampling chain iterations and specialized consistency modules. To overcome these challenges, we introduce a new paradigm called Video Interface Networks (VINs), which augment DiTs with an abstraction module to enable parallel inference of video chunks. At each diffusion step, VINs encode global semantics from the noisy input of local chunks and the encoded representations, in turn, guide DiTs in denoising chunks in parallel. The coupling of VIN and DiT is learned end-to-end on the denoising objective. Further, the VIN architecture maintains fixed-size encoding tokens that encode the input via a single cross-attention step. Disentangling the encoding tokens from the input thus enables VIN to scale to long videos and learn essential semantics. Experiments on VBench demonstrate that VINs surpass existing chunk-based methods in preserving background consistency and subject coherence. We then show via an optical flow analysis that our approach attains state-of-the-art motion smoothness while using 25-40% fewer FLOPs than full generation. Finally, human raters favorably assessed the overall video quality and temporal consistency of our method in a user study.
authors: Bhishma Dedhia, David Bourgin, Krishna Kumar Singh, Yuheng Li, Yan Kang, Zhan Xu, Niraj K. Jha, Yuchen Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15385-15394

title: 基于可控扩散模型的生成式主动学习长尾轨迹预测方法
title_en: Generative Active Learning for Long-tail Trajectory Prediction via Controllable Diffusion Model
abstract: 尽管数据驱动的轨迹预测提升了自动驾驶系统的可靠性,但仍难以处理罕见的长尾场景。先前研究通过修改模型架构(如使用超网络)来解决这一问题。相反,我们提出通过优化训练过程来释放每个模型的潜力,而无需改变其结构。我们提出轨迹预测生成式主动学习(GALTraj),这是首个成功将生成式主动学习应用于轨迹预测的方法。它在训练过程中主动识别模型失败的罕见尾部样本,并通过可控扩散模型对这些样本进行增强。在我们的框架中,生成多样化、真实且保留尾部场景特征的场景至关重要。因此,我们设计了一种尾部感知生成方法,通过定制的扩散引导生成既捕捉罕见行为又遵守交通规则的轨迹。与先前仅关注场景多样性的模拟方法不同,GALTraj首次展示了模拟器驱动增强对轨迹预测长尾学习的益处。在多个轨迹数据集(WOMD、Argoverse2)上使用流行主干网络(QCNet、MTR)的实验验证了我们的方法在尾部样本上显著提升性能,同时也在头部样本上提高了准确性。
abstract_en: While data-driven trajectory prediction has enhanced the reliability of autonomous driving systems, it still struggles with rarely observed long-tail scenarios. Prior works addressed this by modifying model architectures, such as using hypernetworks. In contrast, we propose refining the training process to unlock each model's potential without altering its structure. We introduce Generative Active Learning for Trajectory prediction (GALTraj), the first method to successfully deploy generative active learning into trajectory prediction. It actively identifies rare tail samples where the model fails and augments these samples with a controllable diffusion model during training. In our framework, generating scenarios that are diverse, realistic, and preserve tail-case characteristics is paramount. Accordingly, we design a tail-aware generation method that applies tailored diffusion guidance to generate trajectories that both capture rare behaviors and respect traffic rules. Unlike prior simulation methods focused solely on scenario diversity, GALTraj is the first to show how simulator-driven augmentation benefits long-tail learning in trajectory prediction. Experiments on multiple trajectory datasets (WOMD, Argoverse2) with popular backbones (QCNet, MTR) confirm that our method significantly boosts performance on tail samples and also enhances accuracy on head samples.
authors: Daehee Park, Monu Surana, Pranav Desai, Ashish Mehta, Reuben MV John, Kuk-Jin Yoon ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27839-27850

title: 生成对抗扩散
title_en: Generative Adversarial Diffusion
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的生成框架,通过统一对抗训练和扩散训练来克服传统模型的局限性。我们的方法称为生成对抗扩散(GAD),将对抗损失直接整合到潜在扩散模型的每个去噪步骤中。通过采用单一U-Net作为统一的生成器和判别器,我们的框架消除了对独立判别器的需求,从而降低内存开销并缓解常见的GAN问题,如模式崩溃和训练不稳定。这种集成的对抗正则化促进了时间步之间的语义信息交换,使模型即使在训练数据稀缺或存在偏差时也能更好地捕捉复杂的数据分布。在标准潜在扩散基准上的大量实验表明,GAD在文本到图像和图像到3D生成等任务中显著提升了图像质量和模式覆盖范围。我们的结果表明,在单一网络中统一对抗训练和扩散训练为高保真、稳定的图像合成提供了有前景的新方向。
abstract_en: We introduce a novel generative framework that unifies adversarial and diffusion-based training to overcome the limitations of conventional models. Our approach, termed Generative Adversarial Diffusion (GAD), integrates an adversarial loss directly into each denoising step of a latent diffusion model. By employing a single U-Net as a unified generator and discriminator, our framework eliminates the need for a separate discriminator, thereby reducing memory overhead and mitigating common GAN issues such as mode collapse and training instability. This integrated adversarial regularizer promotes semantic information exchange across timesteps, enabling the model to better capture complex data distributions even when training data is scarce or biased. Extensive experiments on standard latent diffusion benchmarks demonstrate that GAD significantly enhances image quality and mode coverage in tasks including text-to-image and image-to-3D generation. Our results suggest that unifying adversarial and diffusion-based training in a single network offers a promising new direction for high-fidelity, stable image synthesis.
authors: U-Chae Jun, Jaeeun Ko, Jiwoo Kang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16786-16796

title: 生成高斯点云:基于视频扩散先验的3D场景生成
title_en: Generative Gaussian Splatting: Generating 3D Scenes with Video Diffusion Priors
abstract: 合成一致且逼真的3D场景是计算机视觉领域的一个开放性问题。视频扩散模型能够生成令人印象深刻的视频,但无法直接合成3D表示,即生成序列中缺乏三维一致性。此外,由于缺乏大规模3D训练数据,直接训练生成3D模型具有挑战性。在本工作中,我们提出了生成高斯点云(GGS)——一种将3D表示与预训练潜在视频扩散模型相结合的新方法。具体而言,我们的模型通过三维高斯基元参数化合成特征场。该特征场随后要么被渲染为特征图并解码为多视角图像,要么直接上采样为三维辐射场。我们在两个常见的场景合成基准数据集RealEstate10K和ScanNet++上评估了我们的方法,发现所提出的GGS模型在生成多视角图像的三维一致性和生成3D场景的质量方面均显著优于所有相关基线。与没有3D表示的类似模型相比,GGS在RealEstate10K和ScanNet++生成的3D场景上将FID指标提升了20%。
abstract_en: Synthesizing consistent and photorealistic 3D scenes is an open problem in computer vision. Video diffusion models generate impressive videos but cannot directly synthesize 3D representations, i.e., lack 3D consistency in the generated sequences. In addition, directly training generative 3D models is challenging due to a lack of 3D training data at scale. In this work, we present Generative Gaussian Splatting (GGS) - a novel approach that integrates a 3D rep resentation with a pre-trained latent video diffusion model. Specifically, our model synthesizes a feature field parameterized via 3D Gaussian primitives. The feature field is then either rendered to feature maps and decoded into multi-view images, or directly upsampled into a 3D radiance field. We evaluate our approach on two common benchmark datasets for scene synthesis, RealEstate10K and ScanNet++, and find that our proposed GGS model significantly improves both the 3D consistency of the generated multi-view images, and the quality of the generated 3D scenes over all relevant baselines. Compared to a similar model without 3D representation, GGS improves FID on the generated 3D scenes by  20% on both RealEstate10K and ScanNet++.
authors: Katja Schwarz, Norman Müller, Peter Kontschieder ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27510-27520

title: 形状依赖的自接触人体姿态生成建模
title_en: Generative Modeling of Shape-Dependent Self-Contact Human Poses
abstract: 在不考虑基础身体形状的情况下,难以对人类姿态的自接触进行建模。例如,BMI较低的人摩擦腹部的姿势会导致BMI较高的人手部穿透腹部。尽管这一问题具有重要研究价值,但现有的自接触数据集缺乏多样化的自接触姿态和精确的身体形状数据,限制了对自接触姿态与形状之间关系的深入分析。为解决这一问题,我们首先引入了首个包含精确身体形状注册的广泛自接触数据集Goliath-SC,该数据集涵盖130名受试者的383,000个自接触姿态。基于此数据集,我们提出了一种基于身体部位级潜在扩散模型与自注意力机制的自接触先验生成建模方法,该方法以身体形状参数为条件。我们进一步将该先验模型整合到单视角人体姿态估计中,并优化估计姿态以实现自接触。实验结果表明,形状条件对自接触姿态分布的成功建模至关重要,从而提升了自接触场景下的单视角姿态估计性能。
abstract_en: One can hardly model self-contact of human poses without considering underlying body shapes. For example, the pose of rubbing a belly for a person with a low BMI leads to penetration of the hand into the belly for a person with a high BMI. Despite its relevance, existing self-contact datasets lack the variety of self-contact poses and precise body shapes, limiting conclusive analysis between self-contact poses and shapes. To address this, we begin by introducing the first extensive self-contact dataset with precise body shape registration, Goliath-SC, consisting of 383K self-contact poses across 130 subjects. Using this dataset, we propose generative modeling of self-contact prior conditioned by body shape parameters, based on a body-part-wise latent diffusion with self-attention. We further incorporate this prior into single-view human pose estimation while refining estimated poses to be in contact. Our experiments suggest that shape conditioning is vital to the successful modeling of self-contact pose distribution, hence improving single-view pose estimation in self-contact.
authors: Takehiko Ohkawa, Jihyun Lee, Shunsuke Saito, Jason Saragih, Fabian Prada, Yichen Xu, Shoou-I Yu, Ryosuke Furuta, Yoichi Sato, Takaaki Shiratori ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5426-5436

title: 生成视频双流模型
title_en: Generative Video Bi-flow
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的生成视频模型,通过神经常微分方程(ODE)流以双线性目标鲁棒地学习时间变化。该目标结合了两个方面:第一,直接从过去映射到未来视频帧。先前工作通过将噪声映射到新帧实现这一目标,但这是一个计算成本更高的过程。不幸的是,从上一帧而非噪声开始更容易产生漂移误差。因此,第二,我们在训练过程中通过添加噪声联合学习如何消除累积误差。我们以流式方式对多种视频数据集进行无条件视频生成,生成质量与条件扩散模型基线相当,但速度更快,即需要更少的ODE求解器步骤。
abstract_en: We propose a novel generative video model to robustly learn temporal change as a neural Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) flow with a bilinear objective which combines two aspects: The first is to map from the past into future video frames directly. Previous work has mapped the noise to new frames, a more computationally expensive process. Unfortunately, starting from the previous frame, instead of noise, is more prone to drifting errors. Hence, second, we additionally learn how to remove the accumulated errors as the joint objective by adding noise during training. We demonstrate unconditional video generation in a streaming manner for various video datasets, all at competitive quality compared to a conditional diffusion baseline but with higher speed, i.e., fewer ODE solver steps.
authors: Chen Liu, Tobias Ritschel ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19363-19372

title: 生成动物园
title_en: Generative Zoo
abstract: 基于模型的图像中三维动物姿态和形状估计能够实现动物行为的计算建模。为此训练模型需要大量带有精确姿态和形状标注的标记图像数据。然而,获取此类数据需要使用多视角或基于标记的运动捕捉系统,这些系统难以适应野外动物的实地环境,且无法扩展到涵盖广泛动物物种的全面数据集。一些研究者尝试通过手动2D标注对真实世界图像进行伪标签,随后对这些标签进行3D参数优化来解决训练数据获取的挑战。尽管这种方法可能生成轮廓对齐的样本,但由于单目拟合问题的病态性,获得的姿态和形状参数往往不合理。为规避现实世界的模糊性,其他研究者设计了利用游戏引擎和艺术家设计的3D资产集合的复杂合成数据生成流程。此类引擎可生成完美的真实标签,但往往缺乏视觉真实感,并且需要大量手动工作来适应新物种或环境。我们提出了一种替代的合成数据生成方法:使用条件图像生成模型进行渲染。我们引入了一种流程,为多种哺乳动物四足动物采样多样化的姿态和形状,并生成具有对应真实姿态和形状参数的逼真图像。为展示我们方法的可扩展性,我们引入了GenZoo,一个包含一百万张不同主体图像的合成数据集。我们在GenZoo上训练了一个三维姿态和形状回归器,尽管仅使用合成数据训练,却在现实世界多物种三维动物姿态和形状估计基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。我们将在https://genzoo.is.tue.mpg.de发布我们的数据和流程。
abstract_en: The model-based estimation of 3D animal pose and shape from images enables computational modeling of animal behavior. Training models for this purpose requires large amounts of labeled image data with precise pose and shape annotations. However, capturing such data requires the use of multi-view or marker-based motion-capture systems, which are impractical to adapt to wild animals in situ and impossible to scale across a comprehensive set of animal species. Some have attempted to address the challenge of procuring training data by pseudo-labeling individual real-world images through manual 2D annotation, followed by 3D-parameter optimization to those labels. While this approach may produce silhouette-aligned samples, the obtained pose and shape parameters are often implausible due to the ill-posed nature of the monocular fitting problem. Sidestepping real-world ambiguity, others have designed complex synthetic-data-generation pipelines leveraging game engines and collections of artist-designed 3D assets. Such engines yield perfect ground-truth labels but are often lacking in visual realism and require considerable manual effort to adapt to new species or environments. We propose an alternative approach to synthetic-data generation: rendering with a conditional image-generation model. We introduce a pipeline that samples a diverse set of poses and shapes for a variety of mammalian quadrupeds and generates realistic images with corresponding ground-truth pose and shape parameters. To demonstrate the scalability of our approach, we introduce GenZoo, a synthetic dataset containing one million images of distinct subjects. We train a 3D pose and shape regressor on GenZoo, which achieves state-of-the-art performance on a real-world multi-species 3D animal pose and shape estimation benchmark, despite being trained solely on synthetic data. We release our data and pipeline at https://genzoo.is.tue.mpg.de.
authors: Tomasz Niewiadomski, Anastasios Yiannakidis, Hanz Cuevas-Velasquez, Soubhik Sanyal, Michael J. Black, Silvia Zuffi, Peter Kulits ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8492-8502

title: 基于去噪扩散的通用事件边界检测
title_en: Generic Event Boundary Detection via Denoising Diffusion
abstract: 通用事件边界检测(GEBD)旨在识别视频中的自然边界,将其分割为具有区分性和意义的片段。尽管事件边界具有内在的主观性,但先前方法主要关注确定性预测,忽视了合理解的多样性。本文提出了一种基于扩散的边界检测模型,称为DiffGEBD,从生成视角解决GEBD问题。所提模型通过时间自相似性编码相邻帧间的相关变化,然后基于编码特征迭代地将随机噪声解码为合理的事件边界。无分类器引导机制允许在去噪扩散中控制多样性程度。此外,我们引入了一种新的评估指标,综合考虑多样性与保真度来评估预测质量。实验表明,我们的方法在Kinetics-GEBD和TAPOS两个标准基准上表现出色,生成了多样且合理的事件边界。
abstract_en: Generic event boundary detection (GEBD) aims to identify natural boundaries in a video, segmenting it into distinct and meaningful chunks. Despite the inherent subjectivity of event boundaries, previous methods have focused on deterministic predictions, overlooking the diversity of plausible solutions. In this paper, we introduce a novel diffusion-based boundary detection model, dubbed DiffGEBD, that tackles the problem of GEBD from a generative perspective. The proposed model encodes relevant changes across adjacent frames via temporal self-similarity and then iteratively decodes random noise into plausible event boundaries being conditioned on the encoded features. Classifier-free guidance allows the degree of diversity to be controlled in denoising diffusion. In addition, we introduce a new evaluation metric to assess the quality of predictions considering both diversity and fidelity. Experiments show that our method achieves strong performance on two standard benchmarks, Kinetics-GEBD and TAPOS, generating diverse and plausible event boundaries.
authors: Jaejun Hwang, Dayoung Gong, Manjin Kim, Minsu Cho ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14084-14094

title: GenieBlue:面向移动设备的大语言模型语言与多模态能力融合方法
title_en: GenieBlue: Integrating both Linguistic and Multimodal Capabilities for Large Language Models on Mobile Devices
abstract: 近期多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)的进展使其能够在移动设备上部署。然而,保持强语言能力与确保硬件兼容性仍面临挑战,这两者对用户体验和实际部署效率至关重要。在部署过程中,我们观察到现有MLLMs在纯语言任务中常出现性能下降,且当前智能手机上的NPU平台不支持常用于多模态训练中保留纯语言能力的MoE架构。为解决这些问题,我们系统分析了在MLLMs训练过程中维持纯语言能力的方法,重点关注训练数据与模型架构两个方面。基于上述分析,我们提出GenieBlue,一种高效的MLLM结构设计,旨在为移动设备上的大语言模型集成语言与多模态能力。GenieBlue在MLLM训练过程中冻结原始LLM参数以维持纯语言能力,通过复制特定Transformer块进行全量微调并集成轻量级LoRA模块来获取多模态能力。该方法在大量训练中保持语言能力的同时实现了可比的多模态性能。在智能手机NPU上部署的GenieBlue展现出良好的效率与实用性,适用于移动设备上的实际应用。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have enabled their deployment on mobile devices. However, challenges persist in maintaining strong language capabilities and ensuring hardware compatibility, both of which are crucial for user experience and practical deployment efficiency. In our deployment process, we observe that existing MLLMs often face performance degradation on pure language tasks, and the current NPU platforms on smartphones do not support the MoE architecture, which is commonly used to preserve pure language capabilities during multimodal training. To address these issues, we systematically analyze methods to maintain pure language capabilities during the training of MLLMs, focusing on both training data and model architecture aspects. Based on these analyses, we propose GenieBlue, an efficient MLLM structural design that integrates both linguistic and multimodal capabilities for LLMs on mobile devices. GenieBlue freezes the original LLM parameters during MLLM training to maintain pure language capabilities. It acquires multimodal capabilities by duplicating specific transformer blocks for full fine-tuning and integrating lightweight LoRA modules. This approach preserves language capabilities while achieving comparable multimodal performance through extensive training. Deployed on smartphone NPUs, GenieBlue demonstrates efficiency and practicality for applications on mobile devices.
authors: Xudong Lu, Yinghao Chen, Renshou Wu, Haohao Gao, Xi Chen, Xue Yang, Xiangyu Zhao, Aojun Zhou, Fangyuan Li, Yafei Wen, Xiaoxin Chen, Shuai Ren, Hongsheng Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4198-4210

title: Geo4D:利用视频生成器进行几何4D场景重建
title_en: Geo4D: Leveraging Video Generators for Geometric 4D Scene Reconstruction
abstract: 我们介绍了Geo4D,一种将视频扩散模型重新用于动态场景单目3D重建的方法。通过利用大规模预训练视频模型捕捉到的强大动态先验,Geo4D可以仅使用合成数据进行训练,同时在零样本方式下很好地泛化到真实数据。Geo4D预测几种互补的几何模态,包括点、视差和射线图。我们提出了一种新的多模态对齐算法,用于对齐和融合这些模态,以及在推理时采用滑动窗口方法,从而实现对长视频的稳健且精确的4D重建。在多个基准测试中进行的大量实验表明,Geo4D显著超越了最先进的视频深度估计方法。
abstract_en: We introduce Geo4D, a method to repurpose video diffusion models for monocular 3D reconstruction of dynamic scenes. By leveraging the strong dynamic priors captured by large-scale pre-trained video models, Geo4D can be trained using only synthetic data while generalizing well to real data in a zero-shot manner. Geo4D predicts several complementary geometric modalities, namely point, disparity, and ray maps. We propose a new multi-modal alignment algorithm to align and fuse these modalities, as well as a sliding window approach at inference time, thus enabling robust and accurate 4D reconstruction of long videos. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks show that Geo4D significantly surpasses state-of-the-art video depth estimation methods.
authors: Zeren Jiang, Chuanxia Zheng, Iro Laina, Diane Larlus, Andrea Vedaldi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20658-20671

title: GeoAvatar:面向三维头像的自适应几何高斯点云
title_en: GeoAvatar: Adaptive Geometrical Gaussian Splatting for 3D Head Avatar
abstract: 尽管在三维头像生成领域取得了近期进展,但平衡身份保持(即重建)与新颖姿态和表情(即动画)仍是一项挑战。现有方法难以适应面部区域间的几何偏差变化,导致质量欠佳。为解决这一问题,我们提出GeoAvatar,一种自适应几何高斯点云框架。GeoAvatar利用无监督的自适应预分配阶段(APS),将高斯点划分为刚性集与柔性集以实现自适应偏移正则化。随后,基于口部解剖结构与动态特性,我们引入新颖的口部结构和分部变形策略以提升口部动画保真度。最后,我们提出一种正则化损失函数,用于精确绑定高斯点与三维人脸模型(3DMM)。此外,我们发布了DynamicFace数据集,该数据集包含高度表达性的面部运动视频。大量实验表明,GeoAvatar在重建与新颖动画场景中均优于现有先进方法。
abstract_en: Despite recent progress in 3D head avatar generation, balancing identity preservation, i.e., reconstruction, with novel poses and expressions, i.e., animation, remains a challenge. Existing methods struggle to adapt Gaussians to varying geometrical deviations across facial regions, resulting in suboptimal quality. To address this, we propose GeoAvatar, a framework for adaptive geometrical Gaussian Splatting. GeoAvatar leverages Adaptive Pre-allocation Stage (APS), an unsupervised method that segments Gaussians into rigid and flexible sets for adaptive offset regularization. Then, based on mouth anatomy and dynamics, we introduce a novel mouth structure and the part-wise deformation strategy to enhance the animation fidelity of the mouth. Finally, we propose a regularization loss for precise rigging between Gaussians and 3DMM faces. Moreover, we release DynamicFace, a video dataset with highly expressive facial motions. Extensive experiments show the superiority of GeoAvatar compared to state-of-the-art methods in reconstruction and novel animation scenarios.
authors: SeungJun Moon, Hah Min Lew, Seungeun Lee, Ji-Su Kang, Gyeong-Moon Park ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12811-12821

title: GeoDiffusion:一种免训练的用于图像生成中精确三维几何条件化的框架
title_en: GeoDiffusion: A Training-Free Framework for Accurate 3D Geometric Conditioning in Image Generation
abstract: 在工程、产品设计和创意产业中,图像生成中的精确几何控制对于在二维图像空间中准确控制三维物体特征至关重要。传统三维编辑方法耗时且需要专业技能,而当前基于图像的生成方法在几何条件化方面缺乏准确性。为解决这些挑战,我们提出GeoDiffusion,一种免训练的框架,用于图像生成中三维特征的精确高效几何条件化。GeoDiffusion采用类别特定的三维物体作为几何先验,在三维空间中定义关键点和参数相关性。我们通过参考三维物体的渲染图像确保视角一致性,随后通过风格迁移满足用户定义的外观规格。我们的框架核心是GeoDrag,其在DragBench上改进了基于拖拽的图像编辑在几何引导任务和通用指令中的准确性和速度。实验结果表明,GeoDiffusion能够在各种迭代设计流程中实现精确的几何修改。
abstract_en: Precise geometric control in image generation is essential for fields like engineering & product design and creative industries to control 3D object features accurately in 2D image space. Traditional 3D editing approaches are time-consuming and demand specialized skills, while current image-based generative methods lack accuracy in geometric conditioning. To address these challenges, we propose GeoDiffusion, a training-free framework for accurate and efficient geometric conditioning of 3D features in image generation. GeoDiffusion employs a class-specific 3D object as a geometric prior to define keypoints and parametric correlations in 3D space. We ensure viewpoint consistency through a rendered image of a reference 3D object, followed by style transfer to meet user-defined appearance specifications. At the core of our framework is GeoDrag, improving accuracy and speed of drag-based image editing on geometry guidance tasks and general instructions on DragBench. Our results demonstrate that GeoDiffusion enables precise geometric modifications across various iterative design workflows.
authors: Phillip Mueller, Talip Uenlue, Sebastian Schmidt, Marcel Kollovieh, Jiajie Fan, Stephan Günnemann, Lars Mikelsons ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6374-6384

title: GeoDistill: 基于几何引导的弱监督跨视角定位自蒸馏方法
title_en: GeoDistill: Geometry-Guided Self-Distillation for Weakly Supervised Cross-View Localization
abstract: 跨视角定位任务旨在通过地面图像与航拍图像的对齐,估计相机的三自由度(3-DoF)位姿,对自动驾驶导航和增强现实等大规模户外应用至关重要。现有方法通常依赖全监督学习,需要成本高昂的真值位姿标注。本文提出GeoDistill,一种基于几何引导的弱监督自蒸馏框架,通过基于视场角(FoV)的掩码实现教师-学生学习,增强局部特征学习以实现鲁棒的跨视角定位。在GeoDistill中,教师模型对完整视角图像进行定位,而学生模型则从基于视场角掩码生成的有限视角图像中预测位置。通过将学生模型的预测与教师模型对齐,学生模型聚焦于关键特征(如车道线)并忽略无纹理区域(如道路)。这使得预测结果更加准确且不确定性降低。实验表明,GeoDistill在不同框架下显著提升了定位性能。此外,我们引入了一种新颖的方位估计网络,可在无需精确平面位置真值的情况下预测相对方位。GeoDistill为现实场景中的跨视角定位挑战提供了可扩展且高效的解决方案。代码和模型可访问https://github.com/tongshw/GeoDistill。
abstract_en: Cross-view localization, the task of estimating a camera's 3-degrees-of-freedom (3-DoF) pose by aligning ground-level images with aerial images, is crucial for large-scale outdoor applications like autonomous navigation and augmented reality. Existing methods often rely on fully supervised learning, which requires costly ground-truth pose annotations. In this work, we propose GeoDistill, a Geometry guided weakly supervised self Distillation framework that uses teacher-student learning with Field-of-View (FoV)-based masking to enhance local feature learning for robust cross-view localization. In GeoDistill, the teacher model localizes a full view image, while the student model predicts locations from a limited FoV counterpart created by FoV-based masking. By aligning the student's predictions with those of the teacher, the student focuses on key features like lane lines and ignores textureless regions, such as roads. This results in more accurate predictions and reduced uncertainty. Our experiments show that GeoDistill significantly improves localization performance across different frameworks. Additionally, we introduce a novel orientation estimation network that predicts relative orientation without requiring precise planar position ground truth. GeoDistill provides a scalable and efficient solution for real-world cross-view localization challenges. Code and model can be found at https://github.com/tongshw/GeoDistill.
authors: Shaowen Tong, Zimin Xia, Alexandre Alahi, Xuming He, Yujiao Shi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25357-25366

title: GeoExplorer: 基于好奇心驱动探索的主动地理定位
title_en: GeoExplorer: Active Geo-localization with Curiosity-Driven Exploration
abstract: 主动地理定位(AGL)是将目标(以多种模态表示,如航拍图像、地面图像或文本)在预定义搜索区域内进行定位的任务。现有方法将AGL视为基于距离奖励的到达目标强化学习(RL)问题。它们通过隐式学习最小化与目标的相对距离来实现定位。然而,当距离估计变得困难或遇到未见过的目标和环境时,由于训练过程中学习到的探索策略可靠性较低,智能体表现出较差的鲁棒性和泛化能力。本文提出GeoExplorer,这是一种结合好奇心驱动探索的AGL智能体,通过内在奖励机制实现。与基于距离的奖励不同,我们的基于好奇心的奖励是目标无关的,能够基于有效的环境建模实现稳健、多样且语境相关的探索。这些能力已在四个AGL基准测试中通过大量实验验证,证明了GeoExplorer在多样化场景中的有效性与泛化能力,特别是在定位陌生目标和环境方面表现出色。
abstract_en: Active Geo-localization (AGL) is the task of localizing a goal, represented in various modalities (e.g., aerial images, ground-level images, or text), within a predefined search area. Current methods approach AGL as a goal-reaching reinforcement learning (RL) problem with a distance-based reward. They localize the goal by implicitly learning to minimize the relative distance from it. However, when distance estimation becomes challenging or when encountering unseen targets and environments, the agent exhibits reduced robustness and generalization ability due to the less reliable exploration strategy learned during training. In this paper, we propose GeoExplorer, an AGL agent that incorporates curiosity-driven exploration through intrinsic rewards. Unlike distance-based rewards, our curiosity-driven reward is goal-agnostic, enabling robust, diverse, and contextually relevant exploration based on effective environment modeling. These capabilities have been proven through extensive experiments across four AGL benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness and generalization ability of GeoExplorer in diverse settings, particularly in localizing unfamiliar targets and environments.
authors: Li Mi, Manon Béchaz, Zeming Chen, Antoine Bosselut, Devis Tuia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6122-6131

title: GeoFormer: 基于图的Transformer几何点编码器用于3D目标检测
title_en: GeoFormer: Geometry Point Encoder for 3D Object Detection with Graph-based Transformer
abstract: 基于激光雷达的3D检测是自动驾驶领域最受欢迎的研究方向之一。3D检测器通常根据点云的空间分布模式检测场景中的特定目标。然而,现有体素方法通常采用MLP和全局池化(如PointNet、CenterPoint)作为体素特征编码器,这使得从原始点中提取详细空间结构信息的效果较差,导致信息丢失和性能下降。本文提出了一种新颖的基于图的Transformer,通过压缩完整的点几何信息来编码体素特征,称为GeoFormer。我们首先基于相对距离将体素内的点表示为图,以捕捉其空间几何结构。随后,我们引入了一种几何引导的Transformer架构来编码体素特征,其中相邻几何线索用于重新加权点特征相似性,从而更有效地提取不同距离点对之间的几何关系。我们强调GeoFormer是一个即插即用模块,可无缝集成以增强现有体素检测器的性能。在三个流行户外数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的GeoFormer在有效性与鲁棒性对比中均达到最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Lidar-based 3D detection is one of the most popular research fields in autonomous driving. 3D detectors typically detect specific targets in a scene according to the pattern formed by the spatial distribution of point clouds. However, existing voxel-based methods usually adopt MLP and global pooling (e.g., PointNet, CenterPoint) as voxel feature encoder, which makes it less effective to extract detailed spatial structure information from raw points, leading to information loss and inferior performance. In this paper, we propose a novel graph-based transformer to encode voxel features by condensing the full and detailed point's geometry, termed as GeoFormer. We first represent points within a voxel as a graph, based on relative distances to capture its spatial geometry. Then, We introduce a geometry-guided transformer architecture to encode voxel features, where the adjacent geometric clues are used to re-weight point feature similarities, enabling more effective extraction of geometric relationships between point pairs at varying distances. We highlight that GeoFormer is a plug-and-play module which can be seamlessly integrated to enhance the performance of existing voxel-based detectors. Extensive experiments conducted on three popular outdoor datasets demonstrate that our GeoFormer achieves the start-of-the-art performance on both effectiveness and robustness comparisons.
authors: Xin Jin, Haisheng Su, Cong Ma, Kai Liu, Wei Wu, Fei Hui, Junchi Yan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26879-26889

title: GeoMan: 基于图像到视频扩散的时间一致人体几何估计
title_en: GeoMan: Temporally Consistent Human Geometry Estimation using Image-to-Video Diffusion
abstract: 从视频中估计准确且时间一致的三维人体几何结构是计算机视觉中的挑战性问题。现有方法主要针对单张图像进行优化,常存在时间不一致性和无法捕捉细粒度动态细节的问题。为解决这些局限性,我们提出GeoMan,一种新型架构,可从单目人体视频中生成准确且时间一致的深度和法线估计。GeoMan解决两个关键挑战:高质量四维训练数据的稀缺性以及需要度量深度估计以准确建模人体尺寸。为克服第一个挑战,GeoMan采用基于图像的模型对视频首帧进行深度和法线估计,该估计结果作为条件引导视频扩散模型,将视频几何估计任务重构为图像到视频生成问题。此设计将几何估计的复杂计算转移至图像模型,简化视频模型的角色,使其专注于复杂细节,同时利用大规模视频数据集学习的先验知识。因此,GeoMan在需要极少四维训练数据的情况下提升了时间一致性与泛化能力。为解决人体尺寸精确估计的挑战,我们引入根相对深度表示,保留关键人体尺度细节,并更易于从单目输入中估计,克服了传统仿射不变和度量深度表示的局限性。GeoMan在定性与定量评估中均达到最先进性能,证明其在解决视频三维人体几何估计长期挑战中的有效性。
abstract_en: Estimating accurate and temporally consistent 3D human geometry from videos is a challenging problem in computer vision. Existing methods, primarily optimized for single images, often suffer from temporal inconsistencies and fail to capture fine-grained dynamic details. To address these limitations, we present GeoMan, a novel architecture designed to produce accurate and temporally consistent depth and normal estimations from monocular human videos. GeoMan addresses two key challenges: the scarcity of high-quality 4D training data and the need for metric depth estimation to accurately model human size. To overcome the first challenge, GeoMan employs an image-based model to estimate depth and normals for the first frame of a video, which then conditions a video diffusion model, reframing video geometry estimation task as an image-to-video generation problem. This design offloads the heavy lifting of geometric estimation to the image model and simplifies the video model's role to focus on intricate details while using priors learned from large-scale video datasets. Consequently, GeoMan improves temporal consistency and generalizability while requiring minimal 4D training data. To address the challenge of accurate human size estimation, we introduce a root-relative depth representation that retains critical human-scale details and is easier to be estimated from monocular inputs, overcoming the limitations of traditional affine-invariant and metric depth representations. GeoMan achieves state-of-the-art performance in both qualitative and quantitative evaluations, demonstrating its effectiveness in overcoming longstanding challenges in 3D human geometry estimation from videos.
authors: Gwanghyun Kim, Xueting Li, Ye Yuan, Koki Nagano, Tianye Li, Jan Kautz, Se Young Chun, Umar Iqbal ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7451-7461

title: GeoProg3D: 城市级三维语言场的组合式视觉推理
title_en: GeoProg3D: Compositional Visual Reasoning for City-Scale 3D Language Fields
abstract: 三维语言场技术的进步使得通过自然语言实现对三维场景的直观交互成为可能。然而,现有方法通常局限于小规模环境,缺乏处理大规模复杂城市场景所需的可扩展性和组合式推理能力。为克服这些局限性,我们提出GeoProg3D,一个支持自然语言驱动的城市级高保真三维场景交互的视觉编程框架。GeoProg3D包含两个核心组件:(i) 一种地理感知城市级三维语言场(GCLF),该模型采用内存高效的分层三维结构处理大规模数据,并结合地理信息通过方向提示、距离测量、高程数据和地标参考等要素高效过滤广阔的城市空间;(ii) 地理视觉API(GV-APIs),包括专门的地理视觉工具如区域分割和物体检测。我们的框架利用大语言模型(LLMs)作为推理引擎,动态组合GV-APIs并操作GCLF,有效支持多样化的地理视觉任务。为评估城市级推理性能,我们引入GeoEval3D,一个包含五个挑战性任务(定位、空间推理、比较、计数和测量)的952组问答对的综合基准数据集。实验表明,GeoProg3D在多项任务中显著优于现有三维语言场和视觉-语言模型。据我们所知,GeoProg3D是首个通过自然语言实现高保真城市级三维环境中组合式地理推理的框架。
abstract_en: The advancement of 3D language fields has enabled intuitive interactions with 3D scenes via natural language. However, existing approaches are typically limited to small-scale environments, lacking the scalability and compositional reasoning capabilities necessary for large, complex urban settings. To overcome these limitations, we propose GeoProg3D, a visual programming framework that enables natural language-driven interactions with city-scale high-fidelity 3D scenes. GeoProg3D consists of two key components: (i) a Geography-aware City-scale 3D Language Field (GCLF) that leverages a memory-efficient hierarchical 3D model to handle large-scale data, integrated with geographic information for efficiently filtering vast urban spaces using directional cues, distance measurements, elevation data, and landmark references; and (ii) Geographical Vision APIs (GV-APIs), specialized geographic vision tools such as area segmentation and object detection. Our framework employs large language models (LLMs) as reasoning engines to dynamically combine GV-APIs and operate GCLF, effectively supporting diverse geographic vision tasks. To assess performance in city-scale reasoning, we introduce GeoEval3D, a comprehensive benchmark dataset containing 952 query-answer pairs across five challenging tasks: grounding, spatial reasoning, comparison, counting, and measurement. Experiments demonstrate that GeoProg3D significantly outperforms existing 3D language fields and vision-language models across multiple tasks. To our knowledge, GeoProg3D is the first framework enabling compositional geographic reasoning in high-fidelity city-scale 3D environments via natural language.
authors: Shunsuke Yasuki, Taiki Miyanishi, Nakamasa Inoue, Shuhei Kurita, Koya Sakamoto, Daichi Azuma, Masato Taki, Yutaka Matsuo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9737-9748

title: GeoSplatting:面向基于物理的逆渲染的几何引导高斯点撒布
title_en: GeoSplatting: Towards Geometry Guided Gaussian Splatting for Physically-based Inverse Rendering
abstract: 近期的三维高斯点撒布(3DGS)表示方法在新视角合成任务中表现出显著性能;进一步地,对3DGS的材质-光照分离研究为重新照明能力及其在更广泛应用中的适应性提供了可能。尽管后者操作的通用方法是通过集成可微分物理渲染(PBR)技术,联合恢复BRDF材质和环境光照,但实现精确的分离仍是一个固有的困难任务,因为准确建模光传输具有挑战性。现有方法通常近似高斯点的法线,这些法线构成隐式几何约束。然而,它们通常在法线估计中存在不准确性,进而导致光传输退化,产生噪声材质分解和错误的重新照明结果。为解决这一问题,我们提出GeoSplatting,一种通过显式几何引导增强3DGS的新型方法,以实现精确的光传输建模。通过可微分地从可优化网格构建地表基础的3DGS,我们的方法利用明确定义的网格法线和不透明网格表面,同时支持基于网格的光线追踪技术,实现高效且具有遮挡感知的光传输计算。这一增强确保了精确的材质分解,同时保持3DGS的效率和高质量渲染能力。在多样化数据集上的全面评估验证了GeoSplatting的有效性,突显其卓越的效率和最先进的逆渲染性能。
abstract_en: Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) representations have demonstrated remarkable performance in novel view synthesis; further, material-lighting disentanglement on 3DGS warrants relighting capabilities and its adaptability to broader applications. While the general approach to the latter operation lies in integrating differentiable physically-based rendering (PBR) techniques to jointly recover BRDF materials and environment lighting, achieving a precise disentanglement remains an inherently difficult task due to the challenge of accurately modeling light transport. Existing approaches typically approximate Gaussian points' normals, which constitute an implicit geometric constraint. However, they usually suffer from inaccuracies in normal estimation that subsequently degrade light transport, resulting in noisy material decomposition and flawed relighting results. To address this, we propose GeoSplatting, a novel approach that augments 3DGS with explicit geometry guidance for precise light transport modeling. By differentiably constructing a surface-grounded 3DGS from an optimizable mesh, our approach leverages well-defined mesh normals and the opaque mesh surface, and additionally facilitates the use of mesh-based ray tracing techniques for efficient, occlusion-aware light transport calculations. This enhancement ensures precise material decomposition while preserving the efficiency and high-quality rendering capabilities of 3DGS. Comprehensive evaluations across diverse datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of GeoSplatting, highlighting its superior efficiency and state-of-the-art inverse rendering performance.
authors: Kai Ye, Chong Gao, Guanbin Li, Wenzheng Chen, Baoquan Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28991-29000

title: 面向未见过类别的视图引导点云补全的几何对齐与先验调制
title_en: Geometric Alignment and Prior Modulation for View-Guided Point Cloud Completion on Unseen Categories
abstract: 视图引导的点云补全(VG-PCC)旨在通过参考单视角图像,从部分输入中重建完整的点云。尽管现有VG-PCC模型在同类预测中表现良好,但将其泛化到未见过的类别时会出现显著性能下降。我们识别出该挑战的两个关键限制:(1) 当前编码器难以弥合图像与点云之间的显著模态差距,导致其学习的表示往往缺乏稳健的跨模态对齐,并过度依赖浅层的类别特异性模式。(2) 当前解码器整体优化全局结构,忽视了类无关且可跨类别迁移的局部几何模式。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种基于几何对齐与先验调制(GAPM)的新型可泛化VG-PCC框架用于未见过的类别。首先,我们引入了几何对齐编码器,通过深度图将参考图像提升至3D空间,实现与部分点云的自然对齐。这减少了对阻碍泛化至未见过类别的类别特异性RGB模式的依赖。其次,我们提出了先验调制解码器,通过融合类无关的局部先验,在区域基础上重建形状。这使得能够自适应复用促进泛化至未见过类别的学习几何模式。大量实验验证了GAPM在已见和,特别是未见过类别上均显著优于现有模型,建立了VG-PCC领域未见过类别泛化的新的基准。我们的代码可在补充材料中找到。
abstract_en: View-Guided Point Cloud Completion (VG-PCC) aims to reconstruct complete point clouds from partial inputs by referencing single-view images. While existing VG-PCC models perform well on in-class predictions, they exhibit significant performance drops when generalizing to unseen categories. We identify two key limitations underlying this challenge: (1) Current encoders struggle to bridge the substantial modality gap between images and point clouds. Consequently, their learned representations often lack robust cross-modal alignment and over-rely on superficial class-specific patterns. (2) Current decoders refine global structures holistically, overlooking local geometric patterns that are class-agnostic and transferable across categories. To address these issues, we present a novel generalizable VG-PCC framework for unseen categories based on Geometric Alignment and Prior Modulation (GAPM). First, we introduce a Geometry Aligned Encoder that lifts reference images into 3D space via depth maps for natural alignment with the partial point clouds. This reduces dependency on class-specific RGB patterns that hinder generalization to unseen classes. Second, we propose a Prior Modulated Decoder that incorporates class-agnostic local priors to reconstruct shapes on a regional basis. This allows the adaptive reuse of learned geometric patterns that promote generalization to unseen classes. Extensive experiments validate that GAPM consistently outperforms existing models on both seen and, notably, unseen categories, establishing a new benchmark for unseen-category generalization in VG-PCC. Our code can be found in the supplementary material.
authors: Jingqiao Xiu, Yicong Li, Na Zhao, Han Fang, Xiang Wang, Angela Yao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27435-27444

title: 几何分布
title_en: Geometry Distributions
abstract: 三维数据的神经表示已被广泛应用于各种领域,尤其是在近期利用基于坐标的网络建模标量或向量场的研究中。然而,这些方法面临固有的挑战,例如处理薄结构和非闭合几何体,这限制了其灵活性和准确性。相比之下,我们提出了一种新颖的几何数据表示方法,将几何体建模为分布——一种强大的表示方式,无需对曲面亏格、连通性或边界条件做出假设。我们的方法采用扩散模型结合新颖的网络架构,学习表面点分布,捕捉细粒度的几何细节。我们在多种物体类型上对表示方法进行了定性和定量评估,证明其在实现高几何保真度方面的有效性。此外,我们探索了该表示方法的应用,如纹理网格表示、神经表面压缩、动态物体建模和渲染,突显其在推进三维几何学习方面的潜力。
abstract_en: Neural representations of 3D data have been widely adopted across various applications, particularly in recent work leveraging coordinate-based networks to model scalar or vector fields. However, these approaches face inherent challenges, such as handling thin structures and non-watertight geometries, which limit their flexibility and accuracy. In contrast, we propose a novel geometric data representation that models geometry as distributions-a powerful representation that makes no assumptions about surface genus, connectivity, or boundary conditions. Our approach uses diffusion models with a novel network architecture to learn surface point distributions, capturing fine-grained geometric details. We evaluate our representation qualitatively and quantitatively across various object types, demonstrating its effectiveness in achieving high geometric fidelity. Additionally, we explore applications using our representation, such as textured mesh representation, neural surface compression, dynamic object modeling, and rendering, highlighting its potential to advance 3D geometric learning.
authors: Biao Zhang, Jing Ren, Peter Wonka ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1495-1505

title: GeometryCrafter:基于扩散先验的开放世界视频一致几何估计
title_en: GeometryCrafter: Consistent Geometry Estimation for Open-world Videos with Diffusion Priors
abstract: 尽管视频深度估计取得了显著进展,但现有方法由于其仿射不变预测,在几何保真度上存在不足,限制了其在重建及其他基于度量的下游任务中的适用性。我们提出了一种新颖的点图变分自编码器(VAE),用于编码和解码无界点图。值得注意的是,其潜在空间与视频扩散模型的视频潜在分布无关,使我们能够利用生成先验来建模基于输入视频的点图序列分布。因此,我们可以从开放世界视频中恢复具有时间一致性的高保真点图序列,从而实现准确的3D/4D重建、相机参数估计及其他基于深度的应用。在多种数据集上的广泛评估表明,我们的方法在3D精度、时间一致性和泛化能力方面均达到最先进的水平。
abstract_en: Despite remarkable advancements in video depth estimation, existing methods fall short in geometric fidelity due to their affine-invariant predictions, restricting their applicability in reconstruction and other metrically grounded downstream tasks. We propose a novel point map Variational Autoencoder (VAE) for encoding and decoding unbounded point maps. Notably, its latent space is agnostic to video latent distributions of video diffusion models, allowing us to leverage generation priors to model the distribution of point map sequences conditioned on the input videos. Thus, we can recover high-fidelity point map sequences with temporal coherence from open-world videos, facilitating accurate 3D/4D reconstruction, camera parameter estimation, and other depth-based applications. Extensive evaluations on diverse datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art 3D accuracy, temporal consistency, and generalization capability.
authors: Tian-Xing Xu, Xiangjun Gao, Wenbo Hu, Xiaoyu Li, Song-Hai Zhang, Ying Shan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6632-6644

title: GestureHYDRA: 基于混合模态扩散变换器与级联同步检索增强生成的语义共语音手势合成
title_en: GestureHYDRA: Semantic Co-speech Gesture Synthesis via Hybrid Modality Diffusion Transformer and Cascaded-Synchronized Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: 尽管共语音手势合成受到越来越多的关注,但大多数先前研究忽视了具有显式且本质语义的手部动作。本文重点研究具有特定手部动作激活的共语音手势生成,这种手势能够传递比常规身体运动更丰富的指导信息。为实现这一目标,我们首先构建了一个包含常用直播主播常用语义明确手部动作的高质量三维人体运动数据集。随后,我们提出了一种基于混合模态扩散变换器架构的混合模态手势生成系统GestureHYDRA,其创新性设计了运动风格注入变换器层,实现了先进的手势建模能力和多样的手势操作。为确保这些特定手部动作能够被激活,我们引入了基于语义手势仓库(每个受试者均标注)的级联检索增强生成策略和自适应音频-手势同步机制,显著提升了语义手势激活效率和生成效果。定量与定性实验表明,我们的方法在各项指标上均优于现有方法。
abstract_en: While increasing attention has been paid to co-speech gesture synthesis, most previous works neglect to investigate hand gestures with explicit and essential semantics. In this paper, we study co-speech gesture generation with an emphasis on specific hand gesture activation, which can deliver more instructional information than common body movements. To achieve this, we first build a high-quality dataset of 3D human body movements including a set of semantically explicit hand gestures that are commonly used by live streamers. Then we present a hybrid-modality gesture generation system GestureHYDRA built upon a hybrid-modality diffusion transformer architecture with novelly designed motion-style injective transformer layers, which enables advanced gesture modeling ability and versatile gesture operations. To guarantee these specific hand gestures can be activated, we introduce a cascaded retrieval-augmented generation strategy built upon a semantic gesture repository annotated for each subject and an adaptive audio-gesture synchronization mechanism, which substantially improves semantic gesture activation and production efficiency. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our proposed approach achieves superior performance over all the counterparts.
authors: Quanwei Yang, Luying Huang, Kaisiyuan Wang, Jiazhi Guan, Shengyi He, Fengguo Li, Hang Zhou, Lingyun Yu, Yingying Li, Haocheng Feng, Hongtao Xie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12615-12625

title: 基于潜在捷径的伴随语音手势生成与时空建模方法:GestureLSM
title_en: GestureLSM: Latent Shortcut based Co-Speech Gesture Generation with Spatial-Temporal Modeling
abstract: 基于语音信号生成全身人体手势在质量和速度方面仍面临挑战。现有方法分别对身体、腿部和手部等不同身体部位进行建模,无法捕捉它们之间的空间交互关系,导致生成动作不自然且断续。此外,其自回归/扩散基管道由于需要数十步推理步骤而生成速度缓慢。为解决这两个挑战,我们提出GestureLSM,一种基于流匹配的伴随语音手势生成方法,结合时空建模。我们的方法i) 通过空间和时间注意力机制显式建模标记化身体部位的交互,以生成连贯的全身手势;ii) 引入流匹配以通过显式建模潜在速度空间实现更高效的采样。为克服流匹配基线的次优性能,我们在训练过程中提出潜在捷径学习和Beta分布时间戳采样,以提升手势合成质量并加速推理。结合时空建模与改进的流匹配框架,GestureLSM在BEAT2数据集上达到最先进性能,同时相比现有方法显著减少推理时间,凸显其在增强数字人类和具身智能体现实应用中的潜力。
abstract_en: Generating full-body human gestures based on speech signals remains challenges on quality and speed. Existing approaches model different body regions such as body, legs and hands separately, which fail to capture the spatial interactions between them and result in unnatural and disjointed movements. Additionally, their autoregressive/diffusion-based pipelines show slow generation speed due to dozens of inference steps. To address these two challenges, we propose GestureLSM, a flow-matching-based approach for Co-Speech Gesture Generation with spatial-temporal modeling. Our method i) explicitly model the interaction of tokenized body regions through spatial and temporal attention, for generating coherent full-body gestures. ii) introduce the flow matching to enable more efficient sampling by explicitly modeling the latent velocity space. To overcome the suboptimal performance of flow matching baseline, we propose latent shortcut learning and beta distribution time stamp sampling during training to enhance gesture synthesis quality and accelerate inference. Combining the spatial-temporal modeling and improved flow matching-based framework, GestureLSM achieves state-of-the-art performance on BEAT2 while significantly reducing inference time compared to existing methods, highlighting its potential for enhancing digital humans and embodied agents in real-world applications.
authors: Pinxin Liu, Luchuan Song, Junhua Huang, Haiyang Liu, Chenliang Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10929-10939

title: GigaTok:将视觉分词器扩展至30亿参数以实现自回归图像生成
title_en: GigaTok: Scaling Visual Tokenizers to 3 Billion Parameters for Autoregressive Image Generation
abstract: 在自回归(AR)图像生成中,视觉分词器将图像压缩为紧凑的离散潜在标记,通过下一个标记预测实现对下游自回归模型的高效训练。尽管扩展视觉分词器可提升图像重建质量,但往往会导致下游生成质量下降——这一挑战在现有文献中尚未得到充分解决。为应对这一问题,我们提出GigaTok,这是首个在扩展视觉分词器时同时提升图像重建、生成和表示学习的方法。我们识别出潜在空间复杂度的增加是重建与生成矛盾的关键因素。为缓解这一问题,我们提出语义正则化方法,将分词器特征与预训练视觉编码器的语义一致特征对齐。该约束在扩展过程中防止潜在空间复杂度过度增长,从而在重建和下游自回归生成中实现一致的性能提升。基于语义正则化,我们探索了扩展分词器的三个关键实践:(1) 使用1D分词器以获得更好的可扩展性,(2) 在同时扩展编码器和解码器时优先扩展解码器,(3) 采用熵损失以稳定十亿级分词器的训练。通过扩展至30亿参数,GigaTok在重建、下游自回归生成和下游自回归表示质量方面均达到最先进水平。
abstract_en: In autoregressive (AR) image generation, visual tokenizers compress images into compact discrete latent tokens, enabling efficient training of downstream autoregressive models for visual generation via next-token prediction. While scaling visual tokenizers improves image reconstruction quality, it often degrades downstream generation quality--a challenge not adequately addressed in existing literature. To address this, we introduce GigaTok, the first approach to simultaneously improve image reconstruction, generation, and representation learning when scaling visual tokenizers. We identify the growing complexity of latent space as the key factor behind the reconstruction vs. generation dilemma. To mitigate this, we propose semantic regularization, which aligns tokenizer features with semantically consistent features from a pre-trained visual encoder. This constraint prevents excessive latent space complexity during scaling, yielding consistent improvements in both reconstruction and downstream autoregressive generation. Building on semantic regularization, we explore three key practices for scaling tokenizers: (1) using 1D tokenizers for better scalability, (2) prioritizing decoder scaling when expanding both encoder and decoder, and (3) employing entropy loss to stabilize training for billion-scale tokenizers. By scaling to 3 billion parameters, GigaTok achieves state-of-the-art performance in reconstruction, downstream AR generation, and downstream AR representation quality.
authors: Tianwei Xiong, Jun Hao Liew, Zilong Huang, Jiashi Feng, Xihui Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18770-18780

title: GlassWizard:基于扩散先验的玻璃表面检测
title_en: GlassWizard: Harvesting Diffusion Priors for Glass Surface Detection
abstract: 玻璃表面检测(GSD)是计算机视觉中的关键任务,能够实现与透明表面的精确交互,提升安全性和物体识别准确性。然而,当前研究在识别性能和泛化能力方面仍面临挑战。得益于近期基于扩散的生成模型的进展,GSD任务可以受益于预训练Stable Diffusion(SD)模型中封装的丰富先验知识。因此,本文提出GlassWizard,旨在从基于扩散的模型中提取先验知识,实现准确且泛化的GSD。首先,我们深入研究SD中的文本嵌入空间,构建基于文本的上下文先验,从而增强对玻璃隐含属性的理解,实现细粒度预测。其次,我们采用一步式公式化流程训练端到端扩散模型,实现有效的优化和快速推理。此外,为便于我们的自适应框架扩展到其他多模态GSD任务(如RGB-D/RGB-T GSD),我们提出一种模态定制化适配方法,可快速适配多模态GSD任务。实验结果表明,所提出的框架在多样化数据集上实现了最先进的性能,并展现出强大的泛化能力。此外,在多模态GSD任务中表现优异,验证了其跨模态的可扩展性。
abstract_en: Glass Surface Detection (GSD) is a critical task in computer vision, enabling precise interactions with transparent surfaces and enhancing both safety and object recognition accuracy. However, current research still faces challenges in both recognition performance and generalization capability. Thanks to the recent advanced diffusion-based generative models, GSD task can benefit from rich prior knowledge encapsulated in pre-trained Stable Diffusion (SD) model. Thus, in this paper, we present GlassWizard, aiming to harvest priors in diffusion-based model to achieve accurate and generalized GSD. Firstly, we delve into the text embedding space in SD to build an text-based context prior, thereby enhancing the understanding of implicit attribute of glass and achieving fine-grained predictions. Secondly, we train an end-to-end diffusion model with a one-step formulation pipeline, yielding effective optimization and fast inference. In addition, to facilitate our adapted framework scalable to other multi-modal GSD tasks (such as RGB-D/RGB-T GSD), we present a modality-customized adaptation, that can achieve rapid adaptation to multi-modal GSD tasks. Our experimental results demonstrate that our proposed framework achieves cutting-edge performance across diverse datasets, and it also shows strong generalization ability. Additionally, it excels in multi-modal GSD tasks, confirming its scalability across different modalities.
authors: Wenxue Li, Tian Ye, Xinyu Xiong, Jinbin Bai, Feilong Tang, Wenxuan Song, Zhaohu Xing, Lie Ju, Guanbin Li, Lei Zhu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17848-17858

title: GloPER:基于局部重建的无监督动物图案提取
title_en: GloPER: Unsupervised Animal Pattern Extraction from Local Reconstruction
abstract: 传统图像分割方法在细粒度图案提取方面存在困难,尤其是在无监督环境下缺乏标注数据。浅层和深度学习方法要么缺乏结构连贯性,要么侧重于对象级分割而非内部纹理。此外,现有方法由于图案复杂性差异和光照变化,往往难以在多样化动物物种间实现泛化。我们提出GloPER,一种无监督分割框架,可在无需标注监督的情况下提取细粒度动物图案。通过仅使用每个区域两种颜色强制局部图像重建,GloPER捕捉结构化图案并缓解阴影和光照不一致的影响。鉴于缺乏细粒度标注数据,我们构建了包含10个动物物种的数据集,每个物种至少包含100张良好标注的图像,从而实现直接分割评估。实验结果表明,GloPER在所有10个动物物种上的平均DICE分数比浅层和深度分割基线高出42.44%。我们还通过动物再识别(ReID)评估其有效性,其中GloPER提取的二值化图案在某些情况下超越了全图像ReID性能,突显了结构化分割的判别能力。
abstract_en: Traditional image segmentation methods struggle with fine-grained pattern extraction, especially in an unsupervised setting without labeled data. Shallow and deep learning approaches either lack structural coherence or focus on object-level segmentation rather than internal textures. Additionally, existing methods often fail to generalize across diverse animal species due to variations in pattern complexity and lighting variations. We introduce GloPER, an unsupervised segmentation framework that extracts fine-grained animal patterns without labeled supervision. By enforcing local image reconstruction with only two colors per region, GloPER captures structured patterns while mitigating the effects of shadows and lighting inconsistencies. Given the lack of fine-detailed labeled data, we construct a dataset of 10 animal species, each with at least 100 well labeled images, enabling direct segmentation assessment. Experimental results show that GloPER outperforms both shallow and deep segmentation baselines, with a 42.44% higher DICE score on average across all 10 animal species. We also assess its effectiveness through animal re-identification (ReID), where GloPER's extracted binary patterns achieve superior accuracy, in some cases exceeding full-image ReID performance, underscoring the discriminative power of structured segmentation.
authors: Bowen Chen, Yun Sing Koh, Gillian Dobbie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6519-6529

title: 基于大运动的三维点场景插值的全局运动对应器
title_en: Global Motion Corresponder for 3D Point-Based Scene Interpolation under Large Motion
abstract: 现有的动态场景插值方法通常假设连续时间步之间的运动足够小,可以局部近似为线性模型。在实践中,即使轻微偏离这一小运动假设,传统技术也会失效。本文提出了一种新的方法——全局运动对应器(GMC),该方法能够稳健处理大运动并实现平滑过渡。GMC学习一元势场以预测SE(3)映射到共享的规范空间,平衡对应关系、空间和语义平滑性以及局部刚性。我们证明了当两个状态经历大全局运动时,我们的方法在三维场景插值中显著优于现有基线方法。此外,我们的方法使外推能力成为可能,而其他基线方法无法实现。
abstract_en: Existing dynamic scene interpolation methods typically assume that the motion between consecutive timesteps is small enough so that displacements can be locally approximated by linear models. In practice, even slight deviations from this small-motion assumption can cause conventional techniques to fail. In this paper, we introduce Global Motion Corresponder (GMC), a novel approach that robustly handles large motion and achieves smooth transitions. GMC learns unary potential fields that predict SE(3) mappings into a shared canonical space, balancing correspondence, spatial and semantic smoothness, and local rigidity. We demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines on 3D scene interpolation when the two states undergo large global motions. Furthermore, our method enables extrapolation capabilities where other baseline methods cannot.
authors: Junru Lin, Chirag Vashist, Mikaela Angelina Uy, Colton Stearns, Xuan Luo, Leonidas Guibas, Ke Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7884-7893

title: 基于注意力调谐的全局调控与激励立体匹配
title_en: Global Regulation and Excitation via Attention Tuning for Stereo Matching
abstract: 立体匹配在迭代算法如RAFT-Stereo和IGEV-Stereo的推动下取得了显著进展。然而,这些方法在存在遮挡、无纹理或重复模式的不适定区域中表现不佳,原因在于缺乏有效的全局上下文和几何信息以支持迭代优化。为使现有迭代方法能够融合全局上下文,我们提出基于注意力调谐的全局调控与激励(GREAT)框架,包含三个注意力模块。具体而言,空间注意力(SA)在空间维度捕捉全局上下文,匹配注意力(MA)沿极线提取全局上下文,而体积注意力(VA)与SA和MA协同工作,通过全局上下文和几何细节构建更鲁棒的代价体。为验证该框架的通用性和有效性,我们将其集成到多个代表性迭代立体匹配方法中,并通过大量实验验证,统称为GREAT-Stereo。该框架在挑战性的不适定区域表现出卓越性能。应用于IGEV-Stereo时,我们的GREAT-IGEV在Scene Flow测试集、KITTI 2015和ETH3D排行榜中位列第一,在Middlebury基准测试中排名第二。代码已开源至https://github.com/JarvisLee0423/GREAT-Stereo。
abstract_en: Stereo matching achieves significant progress with iterative algorithms like RAFT-Stereo and IGEV-Stereo. However, these methods struggle in ill-posed regions with occlusions, textureless, or repetitive patterns, due to a lack of global context and geometric information for effective iterative refinement. To enable the existing iterative approaches to incorporate global context, we propose the Global Regulation and Excitation via Attention Tuning (GREAT) framework which encompasses three attention modules. Specifically, Spatial Attention (SA) captures the global context within the spatial dimension, Matching Attention (MA) extracts global context along epipolar lines, and Volume Attention (VA) works in conjunction with SA and MA to construct a more robust cost-volume excited by global context and geometric details. To verify the universality and effectiveness of this framework, we integrate it into several representative iterative stereo-matching methods and validate it through extensive experiments, collectively denoted as GREAT-Stereo. This framework demonstrates superior performance in challenging ill-posed regions. Applied to IGEV-Stereo, among all published methods, our GREAT-IGEV ranks first on the Scene Flow test set, KITTI 2015, and ETH3D leaderboards, and achieves second on the Middlebury benchmark. Code is available at https://github.com/JarvisLee0423/GREAT-Stereo.
authors: Jiahao Li, Xinhong Chen, Zhengmin Jiang, Qian Zhou, Yung-Hui Li, Jianping Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25539-25549

title: 自然世界图像的全局与局部蕴含学习
title_en: Global and Local Entailment Learning for Natural World Imagery
abstract: 在视觉-语言模型中学习数据的层次结构是一个重大挑战。先前的研究尝试通过采用蕴含学习来解决这一问题。然而,这些方法未能显式建模蕴含的传递性,而这种传递性在表示空间中建立了顺序与语义之间的关系。在本工作中,我们引入了径向跨模态嵌入(Radial Cross-Modal Embeddings, RCME),这是一种能够显式建模传递性约束蕴含的框架。我们提出的框架优化了视觉-语言模型中概念的偏序关系。通过利用我们的框架,我们开发出一个能够表示生命之树层次结构的分层视觉-语言基础模型。我们在分层物种分类和分层检索任务上的实验表明,与现有最先进的模型相比,我们的模型性能得到了提升。我们的代码和模型已开源,地址为 https://vishu26.github.io/RCME。
abstract_en: Learning the hierarchical structure of data in vision-language models is a significant challenge. Previous works have attempted to address this challenge by employing entailment learning. However, these approaches fail to model the transitive nature of entailment explicitly, which establishes the relationship between order and semantics within a representation space. In this work, we introduce Radial Cross-Modal Embeddings (RCME), a framework that enables the explicit modeling of transitivity-enforced entailment. Our proposed framework optimizes for the partial order of concepts within vision-language models. By leveraging our framework, we develop a hierarchical vision-language foundation model capable of representing the hierarchy in the Tree of Life. Our experiments on hierarchical species classification and hierarchical retrieval tasks demonstrate the enhanced performance of our models compared to the existing state-of-the-art models. Our code and models are open-sourced at https://vishu26.github.io/RCME.
authors: Srikumar Sastry, Aayush Dhakal, Eric Xing, Subash Khanal, Nathan Jacobs ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15770-15780

title: 基于状态空间模型的全局感知单目语义场景补全
title_en: Global-Aware Monocular Semantic Scene Completion with State Space Models
abstract: 单目语义场景补全(MonoSSC)从单张图像中重建并解释三维环境,使能多样化的现实世界应用。然而,现有方法常受限于卷积神经网络(CNNs)的局部感受野,难以处理投影点的非均匀分布(图__ABS_MATH_1__)以及由三维到二维投影导致的缺失信息的有效重建。在本工作中,我们提出GA-MonoSSC,一种用于MonoSSC的混合架构,能够有效捕捉二维图像域和三维空间中的全局上下文。具体而言,我们提出双头多模态编码器,利用Transformer架构捕捉二维图像域中所有特征的空间关系,实现更全面的二维特征提取。此外,我们引入基于状态空间模型(SSM)的Frustum Mamba解码器,以高效捕捉三维空间中的长程依赖关系。进一步地,我们在Frustum Mamba解码器中提出一种视锥体重排序策略,以缓解重排序体素序列中的特征不连续性,确保更好地与状态空间模型(SSM)的扫描机制对齐,提升三维表征学习效果。我们在广泛使用的Occ-ScanNet和NYUv2数据集上进行了大量实验,验证了所提方法达到最先进的性能,证明了其有效性。代码已在此处提供。
abstract_en: Monocular Semantic Scene Completion (MonoSSC) reconstructs and interprets 3D environments from a single image, enabling diverse real-world applications. However, existing methods are often constrained by the local receptive field of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), making it challenging to handle the non-uniform distribution of projected points (Fig. \ref fig:perspective ) and effectively reconstruct missing information caused by the 3D-to-2D projection. In this work, we introduce GA-MonoSSC, a hybrid architecture for MonoSSC that effectively captures global context in both the 2D image domain and 3D space. Specifically, we propose a Dual-Head Multi-Modality Encoder, which leverages a Transformer architecture to capture spatial relationships across all features in the 2D image domain, enabling more comprehensive 2D feature extraction. Additionally, we introduce the Frustum Mamba Decoder, built on the State Space Model (SSM), to efficiently capture long-range dependencies in 3D space. Furthermore, we propose a frustum reordering strategy within the Frustum Mamba Decoder to mitigate feature discontinuities in the reordered voxel sequence, ensuring better alignment with the scan mechanism of the State Space Model (SSM) for improved 3D representation learning. We conduct extensive experiments on the widely used Occ-ScanNet and NYUv2 datasets, demonstrating that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating its effectiveness. The code is available here.
authors: Shijie Li, Zhongyao Cheng, Rong Li, Shuai Li, Juergen Gall, Xun Xu, Xulei Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25550-25559

title: 迈向零样本:基于百万级数据的零样本运动生成
title_en: Go to Zero: Towards Zero-shot Motion Generation with Million-scale Data
abstract: 基于文本描述生成多样化且自然的人类运动序列,构成了计算机视觉、图形学和机器人学领域一个基础且具有挑战性的研究方向。尽管该领域取得了显著进展,但现有方法在零样本泛化能力方面仍面临诸多挑战,这主要归因于训练数据集规模的限制。此外,缺乏全面的评估框架也阻碍了该任务的发展,因为无法有效识别改进方向。在本工作中,我们旨在将文本到运动生成推向新纪元,即实现零样本泛化能力。为此,我们首先开发了一个高效的标注流程,并引入MotionMillion——迄今为止最大的人类运动数据集,包含超过2000小时和200万条高质量运动序列。此外,我们提出了MotionMillion-Eval,这是目前评估零样本运动生成最全面的基准。通过可扩展的架构,我们将模型规模扩展至70亿参数,并在MotionMillion-Eval上验证其性能。实验结果表明,我们的方法在跨域和复杂组合运动上展现出强大的泛化能力,标志着零样本人类运动生成的重要进展。
abstract_en: Generating diverse and natural human motion sequences based on textual descriptions constitutes a fundamental and challenging research area within the domains of computer vision, graphics, and robotics. Despite significant advancements in this field, current methodologies often face challenges regarding zero-shot generalization capabilities, largely attributable to the limited size of training datasets. Moreover, the lack of a comprehensive evaluation framework impedes the advancement of this task by failing to identify directions for improvement. In this work, we aim to push text-to-motion into a new era, that is, to achieve the generalization ability of zero-shot. To this end, firstly, we develop an efficient annotation pipeline and introduce MotionMillion--the largest human motion dataset to date, featuring over 2,000 hours and 2 million high-quality motion sequences. Additionally, we propose MotionMillion-Eval, the most comprehensive benchmark for evaluating zero-shot motion generation. Leveraging a scalable architecture, we scale our model to 7B parameters and validate its performance on MotionMillion-Eval. Our results demonstrate strong generalization to out-of-domain and complex compositional motions, marking a significant step toward zero-shot human motion generation.
authors: Ke Fan, Shunlin Lu, Minyue Dai, Runyi Yu, Lixing Xiao, Zhiyang Dou, Junting Dong, Lizhuang Ma, Jingbo Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13336-13348

title: 扩散模型的黄金噪声:一种学习框架
title_en: Golden Noise for Diffusion Models: A Learning Framework
abstract: 文本到图像扩散模型是一种流行的范式,通过提供文本提示和随机高斯噪声来合成个性化图像。尽管人们观察到某些噪声是"黄金噪声",能够实现更好的文本-图像对齐和更高的人类偏好,但我们仍缺乏一种机器学习框架来获取这些黄金噪声。为学习扩散采样中的黄金噪声,本文主要做出三项贡献。首先,我们识别出一个新概念,称为噪声提示,旨在通过添加源自文本提示的小规模理想扰动,将随机高斯噪声转化为黄金噪声。基于这一概念,我们首先构建了噪声提示学习框架,系统地学习与文本提示相关的"提示式"黄金噪声。其次,我们设计了噪声提示数据收集管道,收集了一个大规模的噪声提示数据集(NPD),包含10万对随机噪声与黄金噪声及其关联的文本提示。以准备好的NPD作为训练数据集,我们训练了一个小型噪声提示网络(NPNet),能够直接学习将随机噪声转化为黄金噪声。所学习的黄金噪声扰动可被视为一种噪声提示,因其富含语义信息且针对给定文本提示进行定制。第三,我们的大量实验验证了NPNet在提升各类扩散模型(包括SDXL、DreamShaper-xl-v2-turbo和Hunyuan-DiT)合成图像质量方面的显著有效性与泛化能力。此外,NPNet是一个小型高效的控制器,作为即插即用模块,其额外推理和计算成本非常有限,因为它仅提供黄金噪声而非随机噪声,无需访问原始流程。
abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion model is a popular paradigm that synthesizes personalized images by providing a text prompt and a random Gaussian noise. While people observe that some noises are "golden noises" that can achieve better text-image alignment and higher human preference than others, we still lack a machine learning framework to obtain those golden noises. To learn golden noises for diffusion sampling, we mainly make three contributions in this paper. First, we identify a new concept termed the noise prompt, which aims at turning a random Gaussian noise into a golden noise by adding a small desirable perturbation derived from the text prompt. Following the concept, we first formulate the noise prompt learning framework that systematically learns "prompted" golden noise associated with a text prompt for diffusion models. Second, we design a noise prompt data collection pipeline and collect a large-scale noise prompt dataset (NPD) that contains 100k pairs of random noises and golden noises with the associated text prompts. With the prepared NPD as the training dataset, we trained a small noise prompt network (NPNet) that can directly learn to transform a random noise into a golden noise. The learned golden noise perturbation can be considered as a kind of prompt for noise, as it is rich in semantic information and tailored to the given text prompt. Third, our extensive experiments demonstrate the impressive effectiveness and generalization of NPNet on improving the quality of synthesized images across various diffusion models, including SDXL, DreamShaper-xl-v2-turbo, and Hunyuan-DiT. Moreover, NPNet is a small and efficient controller that acts as a plug-and-play module with very limited additional inference and computational costs, as it just provides a golden noise instead of a random noise without accessing the original pipeline.
authors: Zikai Zhou, Shitong Shao, Lichen Bai, Shufei Zhang, Zhiqiang Xu, Bo Han, Zeke Xie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17688-17697

title: 梯度分解与对齐用于增量目标检测
title_en: Gradient Decomposition and Alignment for Incremental Object Detection
abstract: 增量目标检测(IOD)对于使AI系统能够随时间持续学习新物体类别同时保留先前学习类别的知识至关重要,使模型能够在不遗忘先前信息的情况下适应动态环境。现有IOD方法主要采用知识蒸馏来缓解灾难性遗忘问题,但这些方法往往忽视类别重叠问题,导致性能欠佳。本文提出了一种新颖的IOD框架,该框架在专门设计的伪标签策略基础上,采用解耦的梯度对齐技术。我们的方法利用高斯混合模型准确估计当前训练图像中先前学习物体的伪标签,有效作为知识回放机制。该策略强化了先前知识的保留,防止早期类别未标注前景物体被误分类为背景。此外,我们引入了一种自适应梯度分解与对齐方法,在维持模型稳定性的同时促进正向知识迁移。通过对旧类和新类梯度进行对齐,我们的方法在保留先前学习知识的同时增强了新任务的可塑性。在两个IOD基准数据集上的大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性,取得了优于最先进方法的性能。
abstract_en: Incremental object detection (IOD) is crucial for enabling AI systems to continuously learn new object classes over time while retaining knowledge of previously learned categories, allowing model to adapt to dynamic environments without forgetting prior information.Existing IOD methods primarily employ knowledge distillation to mitigate catastrophic forgetting, yet these approaches overlook class overlap issues, often resulting in suboptimal performance. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for IOD that leverages a decoupled gradient alignment technique on top of the specially proposed pseudo-labeling strategy. Our method employs a Gaussian Mixture Model to accurately estimate pseudo-labels of previously learned objects in current training images, effectively functioning as a knowledge-replay mechanism. This strategy reinforces prior knowledge retention and prevents the misclassification of unannotated foreground objects from earlier classes as background. Furthermore, we introduce an adaptive gradient decomposition and alignment method to maintain model stability while facilitating positive knowledge transfer. By aligning gradients from both old and new classes, our approach preserves previously learned knowledge while enhancing plasticity for new tasks. Extensive experiments on two IOD benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, achieving superior performances to state-of-the-art methods.
authors: Wenlong Luo, Shizhou Zhang, De Cheng, Yinghui Xing, Guoqiang Liang, Peng Wang, Yanning Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4486-4495

title: 用于去偏表征学习的梯度外推
title_en: Gradient Extrapolation for Debiased Representation Learning
abstract: 通过经验风险最小化(ERM)训练的机器学习分类模型往往无意中依赖于虚假相关性。当这些非目标属性与目标标签之间的意外关联在测试数据中缺失时,会导致泛化性能下降。本文从模型优化角度出发,提出了一种新颖方法——用于去偏表征学习的梯度外推(GERNE),旨在学习已知和未知属性训练场景下的去偏表征。GERNE使用两个具有不同虚假相关性程度的独立批次,将目标梯度定义为从每个批次损失计算得到的梯度的线性外推。我们的分析表明,当外推梯度指向虚假相关性较少的批次梯度时,能够有效引导训练学习去偏模型。GERNE作为去偏的通用框架,包含ERM和重采样方法作为特例。我们推导了GERNE所采用的外推因子的理论上下界。通过调节该因子,GERNE可以适应最大化组平衡准确率(GBA)或最差组准确率(WGA)。我们在五个视觉和一个NLP基准数据集上验证了GERNE,结果表明其性能与现有最先进方法相比具有竞争力,且在多数情况下更优。项目页面地址为:https://gerne-debias.github.io/
abstract_en: Machine learning classification models trained with empirical risk minimization (ERM) often inadvertently rely on spurious correlations. When absent in the test data, these unintended associations between non-target attributes and target labels lead to poor generalization. This paper addresses this problem from a model optimization perspective and proposes a novel method, Gradient Extrapolation for Debiased Representation Learning (GERNE), designed to learn debiased representations in both known and unknown attribute training cases. GERNE uses two distinct batches with different amounts of spurious correlations and defines the target gradient as a linear extrapolation of the gradients computed from each batch's loss. Our analysis shows that when the extrapolated gradient points toward the batch gradient with fewer spurious correlations, it effectively guides training toward learning a debiased model. GERNE serves as a general framework for debiasing, encompassing ERM and Resampling methods as special cases. We derive the theoretical upper and lower bounds of the extrapolation factor employed by GERNE. By tuning this factor, GERNE can adapt to maximize either Group-Balanced Accuracy (GBA) or Worst-Group Accuracy (WGA). We validate GERNE on five vision and one NLP benchmarks, demonstrating competitive and often superior performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines. The project page is available at: https://gerne-debias.github.io/.
authors: Ihab Asaad, Maha Shadaydeh, Joachim Denzler ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3819-3829

title: 梯度短路:通过特征干预实现高效的分布外检测
title_en: Gradient Short-Circuit: Efficient Out-of-Distribution Detection via Feature Intervention
abstract: 分布外(OOD)检测对于在开放世界环境中安全部署深度模型至关重要,其中输入可能超出训练分布。在仅使用分布内(ID)数据训练的模型进行推理时,我们观察到一个显著的梯度现象:在ID样本周围,增强该样本预测类别的局部梯度方向保持相对一致,而未在训练中见过的OOD样本在同一邻域内表现出无序或冲突的梯度方向。受此观察启发,我们提出了一种推理阶段技术,通过短路那些被虚假梯度利用以提升OOD置信度的特征坐标,同时保持ID分类基本不变。为避免梯度短路后重新计算logits的高昂成本,我们进一步引入了一种局部一阶近似方法,无需二次前向传播即可准确捕捉修改后的输出。在标准OOD基准测试中,我们的方法展现出显著提升。此外,该方法轻量级且对标准推理流程的改动极小,为现实应用中的鲁棒OOD检测提供了实用路径。
abstract_en: Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection is critical for safely deploying deep models in open-world environments, where inputs may lie outside the training distribution. During inference on a model trained exclusively with In-Distribution (ID) data, we observe a salient gradient phenomenon: around an ID sample, the local gradient directions for "enhancing" that sample's predicted class remain relatively consistent, whereas OOD samples--unseen in training--exhibit disorganized or conflicting gradient directions in the same neighborhood. Motivated by this observation, we propose an inference-stage technique to short-circuit those feature coordinates that spurious gradients exploit to inflate OOD confidence, while leaving ID classification largely intact. To circumvent the expense of recomputing the logits after this gradient short-circuit, we further introduce a local first-order approximation that accurately captures the post-modification outputs without a second forward pass. Experiments on standard OOD benchmarks show our approach yields substantial improvements. Moreover, the method is lightweight and requires minimal changes to the standard inference pipeline, offering a practical path toward robust OOD detection in real-world applications.
authors: Jiawei Gu, Ziyue Qiao, Zechao Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 457-466

title: 基于梯度重加权对抗性伪装的物理目标检测规避
title_en: Gradient-Reweighted Adversarial Camouflage for Physical Object Detection Evasion
abstract: 目标检测广泛应用于自动驾驶等现实场景,但对抗性伪装通过多视角欺骗检测器构成重大威胁。现有技术难以在不同视角下保持一致的攻击效果。为解决这一问题,我们提出GRAC,一种增强攻击效果的对抗性伪装框架,适用于不同视角和距离。首先,我们识别不同角度下的梯度更新冲突,并引入梯度重加权以解决冲突,实现协同优化。其次,我们建模光照交互以模拟光照变化,提升在不同光照条件下的鲁棒性。此外,针对渲染过程中采样密度不一致导致的非均匀纹理更新,我们应用基于池化的纹理正则化以提升平滑性。在模拟和物理环境的大量实验表明,GRAC在多样化条件下均优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Object detection is widely used in real-world applications such as autonomous driving, yet adversarial camouflage poses a significant threat by deceiving detectors from multiple viewpoints. Existing techniques struggle to maintain consistent attack efficacy across different viewpoints. To address this, we propose GRAC, an adversarial camouflage framework that enhances attack effectiveness across viewpoints and distances. First, we identify conflicts in gradient updates across angles and introduce gradient reweighting to resolve them, enabling coordinated optimization. Second, we model light interactions to simulate illumination changes, improving robustness under varying lighting conditions. Additionally, we address non-uniform texture updates arising from inconsistent sampling density during rendering by applying pooling-based texture regularization to improve smoothness. Extensive experiments in both simulated and physical environments demonstrate that GRAC outperforms existing methods across diverse conditions.
authors: Jiawei Liang, Siyuan Liang, Tianrui Lou, Ming Zhang, Wenjin Li, Dunqiu Fan, Xiaochun Cao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13880-13889

title: 细粒度概念电路:面向概念表示的细粒度电路发现
title_en: Granular Concept Circuits: Toward a Fine-Grained Circuit Discovery for Concept Representations
abstract: 深度视觉模型通过分层架构实现了卓越的分类性能,其中人类可解释的概念通过各层单个神经元的组合逐渐显现。鉴于表示的分布式特性,确定特定视觉概念在模型中的编码位置仍是一个关键且具有挑战性的任务。本文提出了一种有效的电路发现方法,称为细粒度概念电路(Granular Concept Circuit, GCC)(代码可在https://github.com/daheekwon/GCC获取)。该方法中,每个电路代表与给定查询相关的特定概念。为构建每个电路,我们的方法通过迭代评估神经元间的连接性,重点关注功能依赖与语义对齐。通过自动发现多个电路,每个电路捕捉特定查询中的具体概念,我们的方法为模型提供了深入的概念级解释,并首次在细粒度层面识别出与特定视觉概念相关的电路。我们在多种深度图像分类模型中验证了GCC的通用性与有效性。
abstract_en: Deep vision models have achieved remarkable classification performance by leveraging a hierarchical architecture in which human-interpretable concepts emerge through the composition of individual neurons across layers. Given the distributed nature of representations, pinpointing where specific visual concepts are encoded within a model remains a crucial yet challenging task. In this paper, we introduce an effective circuit discovery method, called Granular Concept Circuit (GCC)(Code is available at https://github.com/daheekwon/GCC)., in which each circuit represents a concept relevant to a given query. To construct each circuit, our method iteratively assesses inter-neuron connectivity, focusing on both functional dependencies and semantic alignment. By automatically discovering multiple circuits, each capturing specific concepts within that query, our approach offers a profound, concept-wise interpretation of models and is the first to identify circuits tied to specific visual concepts at a fine-grained level. We validate the versatility and effectiveness of GCCs across various deep image classification models.
authors: Dahee Kwon, Sehyun Lee, Jaesik Choi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2356-2365

title: 基于双分支编码器与两级对齐的图领域适应在全切片图像生存预测中的应用
title_en: Graph Domain Adaptation with Dual-branch Encoder and Two-level Alignment for Whole Slide Image-based Survival Prediction
abstract: 近年来,基于全切片图像(WSI)的生存分析受到了广泛关注。在实际应用中,WSI通常来自不同医院(或领域),可能存在显著差异。这些差异通常导致不同WSI领域之间的分布存在较大差距,因此在某一领域训练的生存分析模型可能难以迁移到另一领域。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种双分支编码器与两级对齐(DETA)框架,以探索不同WSI领域间的特征级和类别级对齐。具体而言,我们将所关注的问题建模为图领域适应(GDA),利用WSI的图表示进行分析。随后,我们构建了一个双分支图编码器,包括消息传递(MP)分支和最短路径(SP)分支,以显式和隐式地从图表示的WSI中提取语义信息。为实现GDA,我们提出了一种两级对齐方法:在类别级,我们利用双分支结构开发了耦合技术,从而减少两个领域类别分布的差异;在特征级,我们引入了对抗性扰动策略以更好地增强源领域特征,从而提升特征分布的对齐效果。大量实验验证了所提出的DETA框架在领域迁移场景下基于WSI的生存分析的有效性。
abstract_en: In recent years, whole slide image (WSI)-based survival analysis has attracted much attention. In practice, WSIs usually come from different hospitals (or domains) and may have significant differences. These differences generally result in large gaps in distribution between different WSI domains and thus, the survival analysis models trained on one domain may fail to transfer to another. To address this issue, we propose a Dual-branch Encoder and Two-level Alignment (DETA) framework to explore both feature and category-level alignment between different WSI domains. Specifically, we first formulate the concerned problem as graph domain adaptation (GDA) using the graph representation of WSIs. Then, we construct a dual-branch graph encoder, including the message passing (MP) and the shortest path (SP) branches, to explicitly and implicitly extract semantic information from the graph-represented WSIs. To realize GDA, we propose a two-level alignment approach: at the category level, we develop a coupling technique by virtue of the dual-branch structure, leading to reduced divergence between the category distributions of the two domains; at the feature level, we introduce an adversarial perturbation strategy to better augment source domain feature, resulting in improved alignment in feature distribution. Extensive experiments have demonstrated the effectiveness of our proposed DETA framework in WSI-based survival analysis under the domain shift scenario.
authors: Yuntao Shou, Xiangyong Cao, Peiqiang Yan, Qiao Hui, Qian Zhao, Deyu Meng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19925-19935

title: GraspCoT: 融合物理属性推理的灵活语言指令下的六自由度抓取
title_en: GraspCoT: Integrating Physical Property Reasoning for 6-DoF Grasping under Flexible Language Instructions
