abstract: 灵活指令引导的六自由度抓取是现实机器人系统中一项重要且具有挑战性的任务。现有方法利用大语言模型(LLMs)的上下文理解能力,建立表达式与目标之间的映射关系,使机器人能够理解用户指令中的意图。然而,尽管LLM对物体物理属性的知识与抓取任务密切相关,但其应用仍处于探索阶段。本文提出GraspCoT,一种融合面向物理属性的思维链(CoT)推理机制的六自由度抓取检测框架,该机制由辅助问答(QA)任务引导。具体而言,我们设计了一组QA模板,实现包含目标解析、物理属性分析和抓取动作选择三个阶段的分层推理。此外,GraspCoT提出了一种统一的多模态LLM架构,将3D场景的多视角观测编码为3D感知视觉标记,再通过LLM将这些视觉标记与CoT生成的文本标记联合嵌入,生成抓取位姿预测。进一步地,我们提出IntentGrasp,一个大规模基准数据集,填补了多物体抓取检测在多样且间接的口头指令下的公共数据集空白。在IntentGrasp上的大量实验验证了我们方法的优越性,实际机器人应用的额外验证也证实了其实用性。代码已开源于https://github.com/cxmomo/GraspCoT。
abstract_en: Flexible instruction-guided 6-DoF grasping is a significant yet challenging task for real-world robotic systems. Existing methods utilize the contextual understanding capabilities of the large language models (LLMs) to establish mappings between expressions and targets, allowing robots to comprehend users' intentions in the instructions. However, the LLM's knowledge about objects' physical properties remains underexplored despite its tight relevance to grasping. In this work, we propose GraspCoT, a 6-DoF grasp detection framework that integrates a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning mechanism oriented to physical properties, guided by auxiliary question-answering (QA) tasks. Particularly, we design a set of QA templates to enable hierarchical reasoning that includes three stages: target parsing, physical property analysis, and grasp action selection. Moreover, GraspCoT presents a unified multimodal LLM architecture, which encodes multi-view observations of 3D scenes into 3D-aware visual tokens, and then jointly embeds these visual tokens with CoT-derived textual tokens within LLMs to generate grasp pose predictions. Furthermore, we present IntentGrasp, a large-scale benchmark that fills the gap in public datasets for multi-object grasp detection under diverse and indirect verbal commands. Extensive experiments on IntentGrasp demonstrate the superiority of our method, with additional validation in real-world robotic applications confirming its practicality. The code is available at https://github.com/cxmomo/GraspCoT.
authors: Xiaomeng Chu, Jiajun Deng, Guoliang You, Wei Liu, Xingchen Li, Jianmin Ji, Yanyong Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10130-10140

title: Griffon v2: 通过高分辨率扩展与视觉-语言共指推进多模态感知
title_en: Griffon v2: Advancing Multimodal Perception with High-Resolution Scaling and Visual-Language Co-Referring
abstract: 大视觉语言模型已实现细粒度物体感知,但图像分辨率的限制仍是复杂密集场景中超越任务特定专家性能的重要障碍。此类限制进一步制约了模型在GUI代理、计数等领域的精细视觉与语言共指潜力。为解决该问题,我们引入统一的高分辨率通用模型Griffon v2,支持通过视觉与文本提示实现灵活物体指称。为高效扩展图像分辨率,我们设计了简单轻量的下采样投影器以克服大语言模型的输入token限制。该设计内在保留完整上下文与细节信息,显著提升多模态感知能力,尤其对小物体表现突出。在此基础上,我们通过插件式视觉分词器进一步赋予模型视觉-语言共指能力。该能力支持用户友好地与灵活目标图像、自由文本甚至坐标进行交互。实验表明,Griffon v2可实现视觉与文本指称的物体定位,在REC和短语定位任务中达到SOTA性能,并在物体检测、物体计数和REG任务中超越专家模型。数据与代码已开源于https://github.com/jefferyZhan/Griffon。
abstract_en: Large Vision Language Models have achieved fine-grained object perception, but the limitation of image resolution remains a significant obstacle to surpassing the performance of task-specific experts in complex and dense scenarios. Such limitation further restricts the model's potential to achieve nuanced visual and language referring in domains such as GUI Agents, counting, etc. To address this issue, we introduce a unified high-resolution generalist model, Griffon v2, enabling flexible object referring with visual and textual prompts. To efficiently scale up image resolution, we design a simple and lightweight down-sampling projector to overcome the input tokens constraint in Large Language Models. This design inherently preserves the complete contexts and fine details and significantly improves multimodal perception ability, especially for small objects. Building upon this, we further equip the model with visual-language co-referring capabilities through a plug-and-play visual tokenizer. It enables user-friendly interaction with flexible target images, free-form texts, and even coordinates. Experiments demonstrate that Griffon v2 can localize objects of interest with visual and textual referring, achieve state-of-the-art performance on REC and phrase grounding, and outperform expert models in object detection, object counting, and REG. Data and codes are released at https://github.com/jefferyZhan/Griffon.
authors: Yufei Zhan, Shurong Zheng, Yousong Zhu, Hongyin Zhao, Fan Yang, Ming Tang, Jinqiao Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22947-22957

title: GroundFlow:一种用于三维点云序列定位的时序推理插件模块
title_en: GroundFlow: A Plug-in Module for Temporal Reasoning on 3D Point Cloud Sequential Grounding
abstract: 三维点云序列定位(SG3D)指的是通过遵循包含详细步骤的日常活动的文本指令来定位物体序列。当前三维视觉定位(3DVG)方法将包含多步骤的文本指令视为整体,而未从每个步骤中提取有用的时序信息。然而,SG3D中的指令通常包含如“它”、“这里”和“同样的”等代词,以使语言表达更加简洁。这要求定位方法能够理解上下文,并从先前步骤中检索相关信息,以正确定位物体序列。由于缺乏有效的模块来收集相关历史信息,最先进的3DVG方法在适应SG3D任务时面临重大挑战。为了解决这一问题,我们提出GroundFlow——一种用于三维点云序列定位的时序推理插件模块。首先,我们证明在SG3D基准测试中,集成GroundFlow可显著提升3DVG基线方法的任务准确率(+7.5%和+10.2%),甚至超越了在多种数据集上预训练的三维大语言模型。此外,我们根据其与当前指令的相关性,选择性地提取短期和长期步骤信息,使GroundFlow能够全面审视历史信息,并在步骤数量增加时保持其时序理解优势。总体而言,我们的工作为现有的3DVG模型引入了时序推理能力,并在五个数据集上的SG3D基准测试中实现了最先进性能。
abstract_en: Sequential grounding in 3D point clouds (SG3D) refers to locating sequences of objects by following text instructions for a daily activity with detailed steps. Current 3D visual grounding (3DVG) methods treat text instructions with multiple steps as a whole, without extracting useful temporal information from each step. However, the instructions in SG3D often contain pronouns such as "it", "here" and "the same" to make language expressions concise. This requires grounding methods to understand the context and retrieve relevant information from previous steps to correctly locate object sequences. Due to the lack of an effective module for collecting related historical information, state-of-the-art 3DVG methods face significant challenges in adapting to the SG3D task. To fill this gap, we propose GroundFlow -- a plug-in module for temporal reasoning on 3D point cloud sequential grounding. Firstly, we demonstrate that integrating GroundFlow improves the task accuracy of 3DVG baseline methods by a large margin (+7.5% and +10.2%) in the SG3D benchmark, even outperforming a 3D large language model pre-trained on various datasets. Furthermore, we selectively extract both short-term and long-term step information based on its relevance to the current instruction, enabling GroundFlow to take a comprehensive view of historical information and maintain its temporal understanding advantage as step counts increase. Overall, our work introduces temporal reasoning capabilities to existing 3DVG models and achieves state-of-the-art performance in the SG3D benchmark across five datasets.
authors: Zijun Lin, Shuting He, Cheston Tan, Bihan Wen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28774-28784

title: GroundingSuite: 复杂多粒度像素级定位的度量
title_en: GroundingSuite: Measuring Complex Multi-Granular Pixel Grounding
abstract: 像素级定位任务,包括引用表达分割(RES)等,因其在连接视觉与语言模态方面的潜力而受到广泛关注。然而,该领域的发展目前受到现有数据集固有局限性的制约,包括对象类别有限、文本多样性不足以及高质量标注稀缺。为缓解这些限制,我们引入GroundingSuite,其包含:(1) 利用多个视觉-语言模型(VLM)代理的自动化数据标注框架;(2) 包含956万条多样化引用表达及其对应分割的大规模训练数据集;(3) 由3800张图像组成的精心策划评估基准。GroundingSuite数据集使模型性能达到最先进水平。具体而言,在gRefCOCO上实现68.9的cIoU,在RefCOCOm上实现55.3的gIoU。此外,GroundingSuite标注框架相比当前领先的标注方法展现出更高的效率,即比GLaMM快4.5倍。代码已开源:https://github.com/hustvl/GroundingSuite
abstract_en: Pixel grounding, encompassing tasks such as Referring Expression Segmentation (RES), has garnered considerable attention due to its potential for bridging the gap between vision and language modalities. However, advancements in this domain are currently constrained by limitations inherent in existing datasets, including limited object categories, insufficient textual diversity, and a scarcity of high-quality annotations. To mitigate these limitations, we introduce GroundingSuite, which comprises: (1) an automated data annotation framework leveraging multiple Vision-Language Model (VLM) agents; (2) a large-scale training dataset encompassing 9.56 million diverse referring expressions and their corresponding segmentations; and (3) a meticulously curated evaluation benchmark consisting of 3,800 images. The GroundingSuite dataset boosts model performance to state-of-the-art levels. Specifically, a cIoU of 68.9 on gRefCOCO and a gIoU of 55.3 on RefCOCOm. Moreover, the GroundingSuite annotation framework demonstrates superior efficiency compared to the current leading data annotation method, i.e., 4.5x faster than the GLaMM. Codes are available at: https://github.com/hustvl/GroundingSuite.
authors: Rui Hu, Lianghui Zhu, Yuxuan Zhang, Tianheng Cheng, Lei Liu, Heng Liu, Longjin Ran, Xiaoxin Chen, Wenyu Liu, Xinggang Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23105-23114

title: 群体惯性姿态估计器:基于稀疏惯性传感器和超宽带测距的多人姿态与全局位移
title_en: Group Inertial Poser: Multi-Person Pose and Global Translation from Sparse Inertial Sensors and Ultra-Wideband Ranging
abstract: 使用稀疏可穿戴惯性测量单元(IMUs)跟踪人体全身运动,克服了基于视觉方法中固有的遮挡和环境仪器限制。然而,仅依赖IMU的跟踪方法会损害位移估计和个体之间的准确相对定位,因为惯性信号本质上是自参考的,无法提供关于他人的直接空间参考。在本文中,我们提出了一种新颖的方法,通过利用稀疏可穿戴传感器之间的距离(包括每个个体内部和不同个体之间),稳健地估计多人的身体姿态和全局位移。我们的方法Group Inertial Poser从超宽带测距(UWB)中估计这些传感器对之间的绝对距离,并将它们与惯性观测融合作为输入到结构化状态空间模型中,以整合时间运动模式进行精确的3D姿态估计。我们的新颖两步优化进一步利用估计的距离,通过世界中的准确跟踪人们全球轨迹。我们还引入了GIP-DB,首个用于两人跟踪的IMU+UWB数据集,包含14名参与者200分钟的运动记录。在我们的评估中,Group Inertial Poser在合成和真实世界捕获中均优于先前最先进的方法,在准确性和鲁棒性方面展现出IMU+UWB多人体运动捕捉在野外应用的潜力。
abstract_en: Tracking human full-body motion using sparse wearable inertial measurement units (IMUs) overcomes the limitations of occlusion and instrumentation of the environment inherent in vision-based approaches. However, purely IMU-based tracking compromises translation estimates and accurate relative positioning between individual people, as inertial cues are inherently self-referential and provide no direct spatial reference about others. In this paper, we present a novel approach for robustly estimating body poses and global translation for multiple individuals by leveraging the distances between sparse wearable sensors - both on each individual and across different people. Our method Group Inertial Poser estimates these absolute distances between pairs of sensors from ultra-wideband ranging (UWB) and fuses them with inertial observations as input into structured state-space models to integrate temporal motion patterns for precise 3D pose estimation. Our novel two-step optimization further leverages the estimated distances for accurately tracking people's global trajectories through the world. We also introduce GIP-DB, the first IMU+UWB dataset for two-person tracking, which comprises 200 minutes of motion recordings from 14 participants. In our evaluation, Group Inertial Poser outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods in accuracy and robustness across synthetic and real-world captures, showing the promise of IMU+UWB-based multi-human motion capture in the wild.
authors: Ying Xue, Jiaxi Jiang, Rayan Armani, Dominik Hollidt, Yi-Chi Liao, Christian Holz ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24910-24921

title: 面向反欺骗的领域不变特征提取中的组级缩放与正交分解
title_en: Group-wise Scaling and Orthogonal Decomposition for Domain-Invariant Feature Extraction in Face Anti-Spoofing
abstract: 领域泛化人脸反欺骗(DG-FAS)方法通过对齐跨领域的局部决策边界方向(权重),有效捕捉领域不变特征。然而,这些边界相关的偏置项仍存在不对齐问题,导致分类阈值不一致,并在未见目标领域上性能下降。为解决该问题,我们提出了一种新颖的DG-FAS框架,通过特征正交分解(FOD)和组级缩放风险最小化(GS-RM)联合对齐权重和偏置。具体而言,GS-RM通过平衡多领域间的组级损失实现偏置对齐。FOD采用Gram-Schmidt正交化过程,显式地将特征空间分解为领域不变子空间和领域特异性子空间。通过在训练过程中利用领域标签强制领域特异性特征与领域不变特征正交,FOD确保跨领域权重对齐,而不会负面影响偏置对齐。此外,我们引入预期校准误差(ECE)作为新型评估指标,定量评估方法在跨领域偏置项对齐效果。在基准数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法实现了最先进性能,持续提升准确率、减少偏置错位,并增强对未见目标领域的泛化稳定性。
abstract_en: Domain Generalizable Face Anti-Spoofing (DG-FAS) methods effectively capture domain-invariant features by aligning the directions (weights) of local decision boundaries across domains. However, the bias terms associated with these boundaries remain misaligned, leading to inconsistent classification thresholds and degraded performance on unseen target domains.To address this issue, we propose a novel DG-FAS framework that jointly aligns weights and biases through Feature Orthogonal Decomposition (FOD) and Group-wise Scaling Risk Minimization (GS-RM).Specifically, GS-RM facilitates bias alignment by balancing group-wise losses across multiple domains. FOD employs the Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization process to decompose the feature space explicitly into domain-invariant and domain-specific subspaces. By enforcing orthogonality between domain-specific and domain-invariant features during training using domain labels, FOD ensures effective weight alignment across domains without negatively impacting bias alignment.Additionally, we introduce Expected Calibration Error (ECE) as a novel evaluation metric for quantitatively assessing the effectiveness of our method in aligning bias terms across domains. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently improving accuracy, reducing bias misalignment, and enhancing generalization stability on unseen target domains.
authors: Seungjin Jung, Kanghee Lee, Yonghyun Jeong, Haeun Noh, Jungmin Lee, Jongwon Choi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13372-13381

title: 用于自回归图像生成的分组推测解码
title_en: Grouped Speculative Decoding for Autoregressive Image Generation
abstract: 近期,自回归(AR)图像模型展现出显著的生成能力,作为扩散模型的有力替代方案。然而,其序列性导致推理时间较长,限制了实际应用的可扩展性。本文提出了一种名为分组推测解码(GSD)的新型无需额外训练的加速方法。尽管近期研究已探索推测解码(SD)以提升AR图像生成速度,但现有方法要么加速效果有限,要么需要额外训练。我们的深入分析揭示了语言标记与图像标记之间存在本质差异:图像标记具有固有的冗余性和多样性,意味着多个标记可传达有效语义。然而,传统SD方法仅接受最可能的单一标记,未能利用这一差异,导致过度的误拒。为此,我们提出了一种新的SD策略,通过评估视觉有效的标记簇而非依赖单一目标标记。此外,我们观察到基于嵌入距离的静态聚类效果不佳,这促使我们开发了动态GSD方法。大量实验表明,GSD在不需额外训练的情况下,平均将AR图像模型的生成速度提升了3.7倍,同时保持图像质量--所有操作均无需额外训练。
abstract_en: Recently, autoregressive (AR) image models have demonstrated remarkable generative capabilities, positioning themselves as a compelling alternative to diffusion models. However, their sequential nature leads to long inference times, limiting their practical scalability. In this work, we introduce Grouped Speculative Decoding (GSD), a novel, training-free acceleration method for AR image models. While recent studies have explored Speculative Decoding (SD) as a means to speed up AR image generation, existing approaches either provide only modest acceleration or require additional training. Our in-depth analysis reveals a fundamental difference between language and image tokens: image tokens exhibit inherent redundancy and diversity, meaning multiple tokens can convey valid semantics. However, traditional SD methods are designed to accept only a single most-likley token, which fails to leverage this difference, leading to excessive false-negative rejections. To address this, we propose a new SD strategy that evaluates clusters of visually valid tokens rather than relying on a single target token. Additionally, we observe that static clustering based on embedding distance is ineffective, which motivates our dynamic GSD approach. Extensive experiments show that GSD accelerates AR image models by an average of 3.7x while preserving image quality--all without requiring any additional training.
authors: Junhyuk So, Juncheol Shin, Hyunho Kook, Eunhyeok Park ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15375-15384

title: 通过生长枝条加速大型视觉-语言模型
title_en: Growing a Twig to Accelerate Large Vision-Language Models
abstract: 大型视觉-语言模型(VLMs)在开放世界多模态理解中展现出显著能力,但其高计算开销对实际部署提出了重大挑战。一些近期工作提出了通过早期层注意力图引导的冗余视觉令牌剪枝方法来加速VLMs。尽管这些令牌剪枝方法取得了一定成功,但仍存在两个主要缺陷:(i) 早期层不敏感的注意力信号导致显著准确率下降,(ii) 生成长响应(如30个令牌)时加速效果有限。为解决上述局限性,我们提出TwigVLM——一种通过在基础VLM的早期层上"生长"轻量级枝条的简单通用架构。与大多数基于视觉令牌剪枝的现有VLM加速方法相比,我们的TwigVLM不仅通过枝条引导的令牌剪枝(TTP)策略实现更好的准确率保留,还通过自投机解码(SSD)策略实现更高的生成速度。以LLaVA-1.5-7B为基准VLM,实验结果表明,剪枝88.9%的视觉令牌后,TwigVLM保留了96%的原始性能,并在生成长响应时实现154%的速度提升,相较于最先进的VLM加速方法,在准确率和速度方面均表现出显著优势。
abstract_en: Large vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in open-world multimodal understanding, yet their high computational overheads pose great challenges for practical deployment. Some recent works have proposed methods to accelerate VLMs by pruning redundant visual tokens guided by the attention maps of VLM's early layers. Despite the success of these token pruning methods, they still suffer from two major shortcomings: (i) considerable accuracy drop due to insensitive attention signals in early layers, and (ii) limited speedup when generating long responses (e.g., 30 tokens). To address the limitations above, we present TwigVLM---a simple and general architecture by "growing" a lightweight twig upon an early layer of the base VLM. Compared with most existing VLM acceleration methods purely based on visual token pruning, our TwigVLM not only achieves better accuracy retention by employing a twig-guided token pruning (TTP) strategy, but also yields higher generation speed by utilizing a self-speculative decoding (SSD) strategy. Taking LLaVA-1.5-7B as the base VLM, experimental results show that TwigVLM preserves 96% of the original performance after pruning 88.9% of visual tokens and achieves 154% speedup in generating long responses, delivering significantly better performance in terms of both accuracy and speed over the state-of-the-art VLM acceleration methods.
authors: Zhenwei Shao, Mingyang Wang, Zhou Yu, Wenwen Pan, Yan Yang, Tao Wei, Hongyuan Zhang, Ning Mao, Wei Chen, Jun Yu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20064-20074

title: 无需外部资源的自适应负采样引导扩散模型
title_en: Guiding Diffusion Models with Adaptive Negative Sampling Without External Resources
abstract: 扩散模型(DMs)已展现出从文本提示生成多样化且高保真图像的卓越能力。然而,它们在提示遵循性和生成质量方面存在显著差异。负提示被引入以通过指定图像不应包含的内容来提升提示遵循性。先前研究表明存在一个理想负提示,可最大化正提示的成功概率。本文探索负提示与无分类器引导(CFG)之间的关系,提出一种无需外部资源的采样方法——自适应负采样(ANSWER),该方法从单个提示中同时考虑正负条件。这利用扩散模型对否定的内部理解,提高生成符合提示图像的概率。ANSWER是一种无需训练的技术,适用于任何支持CFG的模型,允许在无显式负提示(通常存在信息损失和不完整性)的情况下实现图像概念的负约束。实验表明,将ANSWER添加到现有DMs中,在多个基准测试中表现优于基线方法,并且被人类更偏爱两倍于其他方法。
abstract_en: Diffusion models (DMs) have demonstrated an unparalleled ability to create diverse and high-fidelity images from text prompts. However, they are also well-known to vary substantially regarding both prompt adherence and quality. Negative prompting was introduced to improve prompt compliance by specifying what an image must not contain. Previous works have shown the existence of an ideal negative prompt that can maximize the odds of the positive prompt. In this work, we explore relations between negative prompting and classifier-free guidance (CFG) to develop a sampling procedure, Adaptive Negative Sampling Without External Resources (ANSWER), that accounts for both positive and negative conditions from a single prompt. This leverages the internal understanding of negation by the diffusion model to increase the odds of generating images faithful to the prompt. ANSWER is a training-free technique, applicable to any model that supports CFG, and allows for negative grounding of image concepts without an explicit negative prompts, which are lossy and incomplete. Experiments show that adding ANSWER to existing DMs outperforms the baselines on multiple benchmarks and is preferred by humans 2x more over the other methods
authors: Alakh Desai, Nuno Vasconcelos ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16122-16131

title: 基于部分点云对齐与物理合理性约束的扩散模型引导可动物体生成
title_en: Guiding Diffusion-Based Articulated Object Generation by Partial Point Cloud Alignment and Physical Plausibility Constraints
abstract: 可动物体是日常环境中重要的可交互物体类型。本文提出PhysNAP,一种基于扩散模型的新方法,用于生成可动物体,通过部分点云对齐提升其物理合理性。该模型使用符号距离函数(SDFs)表示物体部件形状。我们通过预测的SDFs计算点云对齐损失来引导逆扩散过程。此外,基于部件SDFs施加非穿透和运动约束,以引导模型生成更符合物理规律的物体。我们还使扩散方法具备类别感知能力,若可获取类别信息可进一步提升点云对齐效果。我们使用PartNet-Mobility数据集评估PhysNAP生成样本的生成能力和约束一致性,并与未引导的基线扩散模型进行对比实验,证明PhysNAP在约束一致性方面具有优势,同时在生成能力与约束一致性之间取得平衡。
abstract_en: Articulated objects are an important type of interactable objects in everyday environments. In this paper, we propose PhysNAP, a novel diffusion model-based approach for generating articulated objects that aligns them with partial point clouds and improves their physical plausibility. The model represents part shapes by signed distance functions (SDFs). We guide the reverse diffusion process using a point cloud alignment loss computed using the predicted SDFs. Additionally, we impose non-penetration and mobility constraints based on the part SDFs for guiding the model to generate more physically plausible objects. We also make our diffusion approach category-aware to further improve point cloud alignment if category information is available. We evaluate the generative ability and constraint consistency of samples generated with PhysNAP using the PartNet-Mobility dataset. We also compare it with an unguided baseline diffusion model and demonstrate that PhysNAP can improve constraint consistency and provides a tradeoff with generative ability.
authors: Jens U. Kreber, Joerg Stueckler ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3206-3214

title: 基于分数的判别器校正引导噪声标签条件扩散模型
title_en: Guiding Noisy Label Conditional Diffusion Models with Score-based Discriminator Correction
abstract: 扩散模型因其在图像和视频合成中的出色表现而受到关注,特别是在其能够有效扩展至大规模数据集的能力方面。近期研究表明,这些大规模数据集往往包含手动标注过程中的错误。然而,此类错误对扩散模型生成能力和可控性的具体影响尚未得到充分研究。本文提出基于分数的判别器校正(Score-based Discriminator Correction, SBDC),这是一种用于对齐噪声预训练条件扩散模型的引导技术。该引导方法基于对抗损失的判别器训练,借鉴先前的噪声检测技术来评估每个样本的真实性。我们进一步证明,将引导方法限制在生成过程的早期阶段可获得更好的性能。我们的方法计算效率高,仅略微增加推理时间,且无需重新训练扩散模型。在不同噪声设置下的实验表明,我们的方法优于先前的最先进方法。
abstract_en: Diffusion models have gained prominence as state-of-the-art techniques for synthesizing images and videos, particularly due to their ability to scale effectively with large datasets. Recent studies have uncovered that these extensive datasets often contain mistakes from manual labeling processes. However, the extent to which such errors compromise the generative capabilities and controllability of diffusion models is not well studied. This paper introduces Score-based Discriminator Correction (SBDC), a guidance technique for aligning noisy pre-trained conditional diffusion models. The guidance is built on discriminator training using adversarial loss, drawing on prior noise detection techniques to assess the authenticity of each sample.We further show that limiting the usage of our guidance to the early phase of the generation process leads to better performance.Our method is computationally efficient, only marginally increases inference time, and does not require retraining diffusion models.Experiments on different noise settings demonstrate the superiority of our method over previous state-of-the-art methods.
authors: Dat Nguyen Cong, Hieu Tran Bao, Tung Hoang-Thanh ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18531-18541

title: H3R:面向可泛化三维重建的混合多视角对应
title_en: H3R: Hybrid Multi-view Correspondence for Generalizable 3D Reconstruction
abstract: 尽管前馈三维高斯点云技术取得了进展,但可泛化三维重建仍面临挑战,尤其是在多视角对应建模方面。现有方法面临根本性权衡:显式方法在几何精度上表现优异但难以处理模糊区域,而隐式方法虽具鲁棒性却存在收敛速度慢的问题。我们提出H3R,一种混合框架通过融合体积潜在融合与基于注意力的特征聚合来解决这一局限。我们的框架包含两个互补组件:一个通过极线约束强制几何一致性的高效潜在体积,以及一个利用Plucker坐标进行自适应对应优化的相机感知Transformer。通过整合两种范式,我们的方法在提升泛化能力的同时,收敛速度比现有方法快2倍。此外,我们证明空间对齐的基础模型(如SD-VAE)显著优于语义对齐模型(如DINOv2),解决了语义表示与空间重建需求之间的不匹配问题。我们的方法支持可变数量和高分辨率输入视角,并展现出跨数据集的鲁棒泛化能力。大量实验表明,我们的方法在多个基准测试中达到最先进性能,在RealEstate10K、ACID和DTU数据集上分别实现了0.59 dB、1.06 dB和0.22 dB的PSNR提升。代码可在https://github.com/JiaHeng-DLUT/H3R获取。
abstract_en: Despite recent advances in feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting, generalizable 3D reconstruction remains challenging, particularly in multi-view correspondence modeling. Existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: explicit methods achieve geometric precision but struggle with ambiguous regions, while implicit methods provide robustness but suffer from slow convergence. We present H3R, a hybrid framework that addresses this limitation by integrating volumetric latent fusion with attention-based feature aggregation. Our framework consists of two complementary components: an efficient latent volume that enforces geometric consistency through epipolar constraints, and a camera-aware Transformer that leverages Plucker coordinates for adaptive correspondence refinement. By integrating both paradigms, our approach enhances generalization while converging 2xfaster than existing methods. Furthermore, we show that spatial-aligned foundation models (e.g., SD-VAE) substantially outperform semantic-aligned models (e.g., DINOv2), resolving the mismatch between semantic representations and spatial reconstruction requirements. Our method supports variable-number and high-resolution input views while demonstrating robust cross-dataset generalization. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks, with significant PSNR improvements of 0.59 dB, 1.06 dB, and 0.22 dB on the RealEstate10K, ACID, and DTU datasets, respectively. Code is available at https://github.com/JiaHeng-DLUT/H3R.
authors: Heng Jia, Linchao Zhu, Na Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7655-7665

title: HADES:具有动态显式发丝的人类虚拟形象
title_en: HADES: Human Avatar with Dynamic Explicit Hair Strands
abstract: 我们介绍了HADES,这是首个能够将动态发丝无缝集成到人类虚拟形象中的框架。HADES将头发表示为绑定到三维高斯分布的发丝,其根部连接头皮。通过建模惯性与速度感知运动,HADES能够模拟与身体运动自然协调的逼真发丝动态。为提升虚拟形象保真度,我们结合多尺度数据,并利用基于轻量级多层感知机的校正模块解决不同摄像机间的颜色不一致问题,该模块生成颜色校正矩阵以实现一致的颜色色调。此外,我们通过二维Mip滤波器和物理约束的发丝半径来解决渲染伪影,例如缩放时的发丝膨胀。同时,引入了一个时间融合模块,通过建模历史运动状态来确保时间一致性。实验结果表明,HADES实现了具有逼真发丝动态的高保真虚拟形象,在真实感和鲁棒性方面优于现有最先进的解决方案。
abstract_en: We introduce HADES, the first framework to seamlessly integrate dynamic hair into human avatars. HADES represents hair as strands bound to 3D Gaussians, with roots attached to the scalp. By modeling inertial and velocity-aware motion, HADES is able to simulate realistic hair dynamics that naturally align with body movements. To enhance avatar fidelity, we incorporate multi-scale data and address color inconsistencies across cameras using a lightweight MLP-based correction module, which generates color correction matrices for consistent color tones. Besides, we resolve rendering artifacts, such as hair dilation during zoom-out, through a 2D Mip filter and physically constrained hair radii. Furthermore, a temporal fusion module is introduced to ensure temporal coherence by modeling historical motion states. Experimental results demonstrate that HADES achieves high-fidelity avatars with realistic hair dynamics, outperforming existing state-of-the-art solutions in terms of realism and robustness.
authors: Zhanfeng Liao, Hanzhang Tu, Cheng Peng, Hongwen Zhang, Boyao Zhou, Yebin Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12318-12327

title: HAMSt3R:人感知的多视角立体三维重建
title_en: HAMSt3R: Human-Aware Multi-view Stereo 3D Reconstruction
abstract: 从稀疏的未校准图像中恢复场景的三维几何结构是计算机视觉领域长期存在的问题。尽管最近基于学习的方法如DUSt3R和MASt3R通过直接预测密集场景几何结构取得了令人印象深刻的结果,但它们主要在静态环境的户外场景上进行训练,难以处理以人为中心的场景。在本文中,我们引入HAMSt3R,这是MASt3R的扩展,用于从稀疏的未校准多视角图像中联合重建人体和场景的三维结构。首先,我们利用DUNE,一个通过蒸馏包括MASt3R编码器和最新人体网格恢复(HMR)模型multi-HMR在内的多个编码器获得的强大图像编码器,以更好地理解场景几何结构和人体。我们的方法随后引入了额外的网络头部,用于分割人体、通过DensePose估计密集对应关系,并预测以人为中心环境中的深度,从而实现更全面的三维重建。通过利用不同头部的输出,HAMSt3R生成了一个富含三维人体语义信息的密集点图。与依赖复杂优化流程的现有方法不同,我们的方法是完全前馈且高效的,使其适用于实际应用。我们在包含多样以人为中心场景的两个具有挑战性的基准EgoHumans和EgoExo4D上评估了我们的模型。此外,我们验证了其在传统多视角立体和多视角姿态回归任务中的泛化能力。实验结果表明,我们的方法能够有效重建人体,同时在一般的三维重建任务中保持强劲性能,弥合了三维视觉中人体与场景理解之间的差距。
abstract_en: Recovering the 3D geometry of a scene from a sparse set of uncalibrated images is a long-standing problem in computer vision. While recent learning-based approaches such as DUSt3R and MASt3R have demonstrated impressive results by directly predicting dense scene geometry, they are primarily trained on outdoor scenes with static environments and struggle to handle human-centric scenarios. In this work, we introduce HAMSt3R, an extension of MASt3R for joint human and scene 3D reconstruction from sparse, uncalibrated multi-view images. First, we exploit DUNE, a strong image encoder obtained by distilling, among others, the encoders from MASt3R and from a state-of-the-art Human Mesh Recovery (HMR) model, multi-HMR, for a better understanding of scene geometry and human bodies. Our method then incorporates additional network heads to segment people, estimate dense correspondences via DensePose, and predict depth in human-centric environments, enabling a more comprehensive 3D reconstruction. By leveraging the outputs of our different heads, HAMSt3R produces a dense point map enriched with human semantic information in 3D. Unlike existing methods that rely on complex optimization pipelines, our approach is fully feed-forward and efficient, making it suitable for real-world applications. We evaluate our model on EgoHumans and EgoExo4D, two challenging benchmarks containing diverse human-centric scenarios. Additionally, we validate its generalization to traditional multi-view stereo and multi-view pose regression tasks. Our results demonstrate that our method can reconstruct humans effectively while preserving strong performance in general 3D reconstruction tasks, bridging the gap between human and scene understanding in 3D vision.
authors: Sara Rojas, Matthieu Armando, Bernard Ghanem, Philippe Weinzaepfel, Vincent Leroy, Grégory Rogez ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5027-5037

title: HAMoBE:面向视频行人再识别的分层自适应生物特征专家混合框架
title_en: HAMoBE: Hierarchical and Adaptive Mixture of Biometric Experts for Video-based Person ReID
abstract: 近年来,行人再识别(ReID)研究兴趣日益聚焦于视频场景,这对于在多样且动态环境中实现稳健的监控与安全至关重要。然而,现有视频ReID方法往往忽视了从查询-图库对中的视频中识别并选择最具判别性的特征以实现有效匹配的必要性。为解决这一挑战,我们提出了一种新颖的分层自适应生物特征专家混合(HAMoBE)框架,该框架利用预训练大型模型(如CLIP)的多尺度特征,并通过独立建模关键生物特征——外观、静态身体形态和动态步态——来模拟人类感知机制,并自适应地融合这些特征。具体而言,HAMoBE包含两个层级:第一层级从冻结大型模型提供的多尺度表示中提取低级特征,而第二层级由专注于长期、短期和时序特征的专用专家组成。为确保稳健匹配,我们引入了一种新的双输入决策门控网络,该网络根据专家与输入场景的相关性动态调整各专家的贡献度。在MEVID等基准数据集上的广泛评估表明,我们的方法在Rank1指标上实现了显著性能提升(+11.0%)。
abstract_en: Recently, research interest in person re-identification (ReID) has increasingly focused on video-based scenarios, essential for robust surveillance and security in varied and dynamic environments. However, existing video-based ReID methods often overlook the necessity of identifying and selecting the most discriminative features from both videos in a query-gallery pair for effective matching. To address this challenge, we propose a novel Hierarchical and Adaptive Mixture of Biometric Experts (HAMoBE) framework, which leverages multi-scale features from a pre-trained large model (e.g., CLIP) and is designed to mimic human perceptual mechanisms by independently modeling key biometric features--appearance, Static body shape, and dynamic gait--and adaptively integrating them. Specifically, HAMoBE includes two levels: the first level extracts low-level features from multi-scale representations provided by the frozen large model, while the second level consists of specialized experts focusing on long-term, short-term, and temporal features. To ensure robust matching, we introduce a new dual-input decision gating network that dynamically adjusts the contributions of each expert based on their relevance to the input scenarios. Extensive evaluations on benchmarks like MEVID demonstrate that our approach yields significant performance improvements (+11.0% Rank1).
authors: Yiyang Su, Yunping Shi, Feng Liu, Xiaoming Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11525-11536

title: 基于增益图分解扩散的HDR图像生成
title_en: HDR Image Generation via Gain Map Decomposed Diffusion
abstract: 尽管扩散模型在标准动态范围(SDR)图像合成中表现出显著成效,但生成具有更高亮度和更广色域的高动态范围(HDR)图像仍面临挑战。这主要源于两个因素:(1)预训练的SDR图像自编码器与高比特深度HDR图像之间的不兼容性;(2)缺乏用于有效学习和监督的大规模HDR图像数据集。本文提出了一种新型HDR图像生成框架,包含两项关键创新:(1)分解式HDR图像生成:我们利用双层HDR图像格式,将HDR图像分解为两个低比特深度组件:一个SDR图像及其对应的增益图(GM)。该格式与预训练的SDR自编码器天然兼容,从而将HDR图像生成分解为SDR图像与GM预测任务。(2)无监督数据构建:我们开发了一种自动化流程,通过亮度感知压缩和色域约束降维,从大规模文本-图像数据集中构建"文本-SDR-GM"三元组,无需真实数据即可实现GM的无监督学习。基于这些创新,我们将Stable Diffusion模型适配为联合预测GM和SDR图像,从而实现高质量的分解式HDR图像生成。实验表明,我们的框架在HDR图像生成和SDR到HDR-TV的上采样转换中表现优异,能够良好地泛化到多样化的场景和条件下。
abstract_en: While diffusion models have demonstrated significant success in standard dynamic range (SDR) image synthesis, generating high dynamic range (HDR) images with higher luminance and broader color gamuts remains challenging. This arises primarily from two factors: (1) The incompatibility between pretrained SDR image auto-encoders and the high-bit-depth HDR images; (2) The lack of large-scale HDR image datasets for effective learning and supervision. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for HDR image generation with two key innovations: (1) Decomposed HDR Image Generation: We leverage a double-layer HDR image format to decompose the HDR image into two low-bit-depth components: an SDR image with a corresponding Gain Map (GM).This format is inherently compatible with pretrained SDR auto-encoders, motivating the decomposition of HDR image generation into SDR image and GM prediction. (2) Unsupervised Data Construction: We develop an automated pipeline to construct "Text-SDR-GM" triplets from large-scale text-image datasets by brightness-aware compression and gamut-constrained reduction, enabling unsupervised learning of GMs without ground-truth data. Building upon these innovations, we adapt the Stable Diffusion model to jointly predict GMs and SDR images, enabling high-quality decomposed HDR image generation. Experiments show that our framework excels in HDR image generation and SDR-to-HDRTV up-conversion, generalizing well across diverse scenes and conditions.
authors: Yuanshen Guan, Ruikang Xu, Yinuo Liao, Mingde Yao, Lizhi Wang, Zhiwei Xiong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17536-17545

title: HERMES:一种用于同时进行三维场景理解和生成的统一自动驾驶世界模型
title_en: HERMES: A Unified Self-Driving World Model for Simultaneous 3D Scene Understanding and Generation
abstract: 驾驶世界模型(DWMs)通过实现未来场景预测,已成为自动驾驶的关键技术。然而,现有DWMs仅限于场景生成,未能整合场景理解,后者涉及对驾驶环境的解释与推理。本文提出一种统一的驾驶世界模型HERMES。我们通过统一框架在驾驶场景中无缝整合三维场景理解和未来场景演变(生成)。具体而言,HERMES利用鸟瞰图(BEV)表示法整合多视角空间信息,同时保持几何关系与交互。我们还引入世界查询,通过大语言模型中的因果注意力将世界知识整合到BEV特征中,实现理解与生成任务的上下文丰富化。我们在nuScenes和OmniDrive-nuScenes数据集上开展全面研究以验证方法有效性。HERMES取得最先进性能,生成误差降低32.4%,理解指标如CIDEr提升8.0%。模型与代码将在https://github.com/LMD0311/HERMES公开发布。
abstract_en: Driving World Models (DWMs) have become essential for autonomous driving by enabling future scene prediction. However, existing DWMs are limited to scene generation and fail to incorporate scene understanding, which involves interpreting and reasoning about the driving environment. In this paper, we present a unified Driving World Model named HERMES. We seamlessly integrate 3D scene understanding and future scene evolution (generation) through a unified framework in driving scenarios. Specifically, HERMES leverages a Bird's-Eye View (BEV) representation to consolidate multi-view spatial information while preserving geometric relationships and interactions. We also introduce world queries, which incorporate world knowledge into BEV features via causal attention in the Large Language Model, enabling contextual enrichment for understanding and generation tasks. We conduct comprehensive studies on nuScenes and OmniDrive-nuScenes datasets to validate the effectiveness of our method. HERMES achieves state-of-the-art performance, reducing generation error by 32.4% and improving understanding metrics such as CIDEr by 8.0%. The model and code will be publicly released at https://github.com/LMD0311/HERMES.
authors: Xin Zhou, Dingkang Liang, Sifan Tu, Xiwu Chen, Yikang Ding, Dingyuan Zhang, Feiyang Tan, Hengshuang Zhao, Xiang Bai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27817-27827

title: HERMES:基于事件与语义的时间一致长格式理解
title_en: HERMES: temporal-coHERent long-forM understanding with Episodes and Semantics
abstract: 长格式视频理解面临独特的挑战,这些挑战超越了传统短视频分析方法,特别是在捕捉长距离依赖关系、高效处理冗余信息以及提取高阶语义概念方面。为解决这些挑战,我们提出了一种更准确反映人类认知的新方法。本文介绍了HERMES:基于事件与语义的时间一致长格式理解,该方法包含两个通用模块,可增强现有视频-语言模型或作为独立系统运行。我们的事件压缩器(Episodic COmpressor, ECO)通过从微观到半宏观层级高效聚合表征,在降低计算开销的同时保持时间依赖性。我们的语义检索器(Semantics ReTRiever, SeTR)通过关注更广泛上下文,利用语义信息丰富这些表征,显著降低特征维度同时保留相关宏观信息。我们证明这些模块可无缝集成到现有SOTA模型中,持续提升其性能,同时将推理延迟降低最多43%、内存使用降低46%。作为独立系统,HERMES在零样本和全监督设置下均在多个长视频理解基准测试中达到最先进水平。我们的项目页面和代码可访问https://joslefaure.github.io/assets/html/hermes.html。
abstract_en: Long-form video understanding presents unique challenges that extend beyond traditional short-video analysis approaches, particularly in capturing long-range dependencies, processing redundant information efficiently, and extracting high-level semantic concepts. To address these challenges, we propose a novel approach that more accurately reflects human cognition. This paper introduces HERMES: temporal-coHERent long-forM understanding with Episodes and Semantics, featuring two versatile modules that can enhance existing video-language models or operate as a standalone system. Our Episodic COmpressor (ECO) efficiently aggregates representations from micro to semi-macro levels, reducing computational overhead while preserving temporal dependencies. Our Semantics ReTRiever (SeTR) enriches these representations with semantic information by focusing on broader context, dramatically reducing feature dimensionality while preserving relevant macro-level information. We demonstrate that these modules can be seamlessly integrated into existing SOTA models, consistently improving their performance while reducing inference latency by up to 43% and memory usage by 46%. As a standalone system, HERMES achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple long-video understanding benchmarks in both zero-shot and fully-supervised settings. Our project page and code can be found at https://joslefaure.github.io/assets/html/hermes.html.
authors: Gueter Josmy Faure, Jia-Fong Yeh, Min-Hung Chen, Hung-Ting Su, Shang-Hong Lai, Winston H. Hsu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22911-22921

title: HERO: 从视频中生成人类反应
title_en: HERO: Human Reaction Generation from Videos
abstract: 人类反应生成是交互式人工智能领域的重要研究方向,因为人类持续与环境进行互动。先前的研究主要聚焦于给定人类运动序列时合成反应性运动。这种范式将交互类别限制在人与人之间的互动,并忽略了可能影响反应生成的情感因素。在本工作中,我们提出从RGB视频生成三维人类反应,该方法涉及更广泛的交互类别,并自然地提供了可能反映主体情感的表达信息。为应对这一任务,我们提出了HERO框架,这是一个简单而有效的从视频中生成人类反应的框架。HERO同时考虑视频的全局和帧级局部表示以提取交互意图,然后利用提取的交互意图指导反应的合成。此外,局部视觉表示持续注入模型以最大化利用视频中固有的动态特性。此外,我们收集了包含配对视频-运动数据的ViMo数据集以支持该任务。除人与人之间的互动外,这些视频-运动对还涵盖了动物与人、场景与人的互动。大量实验验证了我们方法的优越性。
abstract_en: Human reaction generation represents a significant research domain for interactive AI, as humans constantly interact with their surroundings. Previous works focus mainly on synthesizing the reactive motion given a human motion sequence. This paradigm limits interaction categories to human-human interactions and ignores emotions that may influence reaction generation. In this work, we propose to generate 3D human reactions from RGB videos, which involves a wider range of interaction categories and naturally provides information about expressions that may reflect the subject's emotions. To cope with this task, we present HERO, a simple yet effective framework for Human rEaction geneRation from videOs. HERO considers both global and frame-level local representations of the video to extract the interaction intention, and then uses the extracted interaction intention to guide the synthesis of the reaction. Besides, local visual representations are continuously injected into the model to maximize the exploitation of the dynamic properties inherent in videos. Furthermore, the ViMo dataset containing paired Video-Motion data is collected to support the task. In addition to human-human interactions, these video-motion pairs also cover animal-human interactions and scene-human interactions. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our method.
authors: Chengjun Yu, Wei Zhai, Yuhang Yang, Yang Cao, Zheng-Jun Zha ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10262-10274

title: HFD-Teacher: 从深度基础模型中进行高频深度蒸馏以增强深度补全
title_en: HFD-Teacher: High-Frequency Depth Distillation from Depth Foundation Models for Enhanced Depth Completion
abstract: 深度补全,即从稀疏深度图和RGB图像中重建密集深度图的任务,在三维场景理解中起关键作用。然而,现有方法在恢复高频细节(如细结构区域或弱信号区域)时往往存在困难,因为深度传感器可能无法在这些区域捕捉到准确的深度图,导致监督地面真实数据不完善。为克服这一局限性,有必要为模型引入替代的训练数据源。新兴的深度基础模型擅长从RGB图像中生成高频细节,但其深度图存在缩放不一致的问题。因此,我们提出了一种新颖的教师-学生框架,通过从深度基础模型中跨多尺度蒸馏高频知识来增强深度补全。我们的方法引入了两项关键创新:自适应局部小波分解,根据局部复杂度动态调整小波分解层级以实现高效特征提取;拓扑约束,通过持续同调强制结构一致性并抑制虚假深度边缘。实验结果表明,我们的方法优于现有最先进方法,在保留高频细节和整体深度保真度方面表现优异。
abstract_en: Depth completion, the task of reconstructing dense depth maps from sparse depth and RGB images, plays a critical role in 3D scene understanding. However, existing methods often struggle to recover high-frequency details, such as regions with fine structures or weak signals, since depth sensors may fail to capture accurate depth maps in those regions, leading to imperfect supervision ground truth. To overcome this limitation, it is essential to introduce an alternative training source for the models. Emerging depth foundation models excel at producing high-frequency details from RGB images, yet their depth maps suffer from inconsistent scaling. Therefore, we propose a novel teacher-student framework that enhances depth completion by distilling high-frequency knowledge from depth foundation models across multiple scales. Our approach introduces two key innovations: Adaptive Local Wavelet Decomposition, which dynamically adjusts wavelet decomposition level based on local complexity for efficient feature extraction, and Topological Constraints, which apply persistent homology to enforce structural coherence and suppress spurious depth edges. Experiment results demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods, preserving high-frequency details and overall depth fidelity.
authors: Zhiyuan Yang, Anqi Cheng, Haiyue Zhu, Tianjiao Li, Pey Yuen Tao, Kezhi Mao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8994-9003

title: HIS-GPT:面向三维场景中人与多模态理解的研究
title_en: HIS-GPT: Towards 3D Human-In-Scene Multimodal Understanding
abstract: 我们提出一个新的任务来评估具身智能体的场景中人理解能力:场景中人问答任务(HIS-QA)。给定一个三维场景中的人体运动,HIS-QA要求智能体理解人体状态与行为,推断其周围环境,并回答与场景中人相关的问题。为支持这一新任务,我们提出了HIS-Bench,一个多模态基准测试,系统性地评估从基础感知到常识推理和规划的广泛场景中人理解能力。我们在HIS-Bench上对多种视觉-语言模型的评估揭示了其处理HIS-QA任务的显著局限性。为此,我们提出了HIS-GPT,首个面向场景中人理解的基础模型。HIS-GPT将三维场景上下文和人体运动动态整合进大语言模型,同时引入专用机制以捕捉人与场景的交互。大量实验表明,HIS-GPT在HIS-QA任务中达到了新的最先进水平。我们希望这项工作能激发未来三维场景中人类行为分析的研究,推动具身AI和世界模型的发展。
abstract_en: We propose a new task to benchmark human-in-scene understanding for embodied agents: Human-In-Scene Question Answering (HIS-QA). Given a human motion within a 3D scene, HIS-QA requires the agent to comprehend human states and behaviors, reason about its surrounding environment, and answer human-related questions within the scene. To support this new task, we present HIS-Bench, a multimodal benchmark that systematically evaluates HIS understanding across a broad spectrum, from basic perception to commonsense reasoning and planning. Our evaluation of various vision-language models on HIS-Bench reveals significant limitations in their ability to handle HIS-QA tasks. To this end, we propose HIS-GPT, the first foundation model for HIS understanding. HIS-GPT integrates 3D scene context and human motion dynamics into large language models while incorporating specialized mechanisms to capture human-scene interactions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HIS-GPT sets a new state-of-the-art on HIS-QA tasks. We hope this work inspires future research of human behavior analysis in 3D scenes, advancing embodied AI and world models.
authors: Jiahe Zhao, Ruibing Hou, Zejie Tian, Hong Chang, Shiguang Shan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4317-4327

title: HOLa:基于低秩分解的视觉-语言模型特征适配的零样本人-物交互检测
title_en: HOLa: Zero-Shot HOI Detection with Low-Rank Decomposed VLM Feature Adaptation
abstract: 零样本人-物交互(HOI)检测仍是一项具有挑战性的任务,特别是在泛化到未见过的动作方面。现有方法通过利用视觉-语言模型(VLMs)获取超出训练数据的知识来应对这一挑战。然而,它们要么难以区分涉及相同物体的动作,要么对未见过的类别泛化能力有限。本文提出HOLa(基于低秩分解的视觉-语言模型特征适配的零样本人-物交互检测),一种新颖的方法,既增强了对未见过类别的泛化能力,又提升了动作区分能力。在训练过程中,HOLa通过低秩因子分解对给定HOI类别的VLM文本特征进行分解,生成类共享的基础特征和可适配的权重。这些特征和权重形成了一种紧凑的HOI表示,保留了跨类别的共享信息,从而增强对未见过类别的泛化能力。随后,我们通过为每个HOI类别适配权重并引入人-物标记来丰富视觉交互表示,以进一步区分未见过的动作。为了进一步区分未见过的动作,我们通过由大语言模型(LLM)导出的动作正则化引导权重适配。实验结果表明,我们的方法在HICO-DET数据集上的零样本HOI设置中达到了新的最先进水平,在未见过动词设置下实现了27.91的未见过类别mAP。我们的代码可在https://github.com/ChelsieLei/HOLa获取。
abstract_en: Zero-shot human-object interaction (HOI) detection remains a challenging task, particularly in generalizing to unseen actions. Existing methods address this challenge by tapping Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to access knowledge beyond the training data. However, they either struggle to distinguish actions involving the same object or demonstrate limited generalization to unseen classes. In this paper, we introduce HOLa (Zero-Shot HOI Detection with Low-Rank Decomposed VLM Feature Adaptation), a novel approach that both enhances generalization to unseen classes and improves action distinction. In training, HOLa decomposes VLM text features for given HOI classes via low-rank factorization, producing class-shared basis features and adaptable weights. These features and weights form a compact HOI representation that preserves shared information across classes, enhancing generalization to unseen classes. Subsequently, we refine action distinction by adapting weights for each HOI class and introducing human-object tokens to enrich visual interaction representations. To further distinguish unseen actions, we guide the weight adaptation with LLM-derived action regularization. Experimental results show that our method sets a new state-of-the-art across zero-shot HOI settings on HICO-DET, achieving an unseen-class mAP of 27.91 in the unseen-verb setting. Our code is available at https://github.com/ChelsieLei/HOLa.
authors: Qinqian Lei, Bo Wang, Robby T. Tan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1825-1835

title: HOMO-特征:基于有序主方向同构的跨任意模态图像匹配
title_en: HOMO-Feature: Cross-Arbitrary-Modal Image Matching with Homomorphism of Organized Major Orientation
abstract: 本文探索了跨任意模态图像不变特征提取与匹配方法,提出了一种纯手工设计的全链算法——有序主方向同构(HOMO)。不同于采用深度模型进行数据驱动的黑箱学习,我们引入主方向图(MOM),有效应对图像模态差异。考虑到跨模态图像中的旋转、尺度和纹理多样性,HOMO结合了新型通用极坐标描述符(GPolar)和多尺度策略(MsS),实现全面的特征匹配能力。HOMO在多个通用跨模态数据集的特征匹配中取得了最佳综合性能,超越了包括7种传统算法和10种深度网络模型在内的多种最先进方法。提出了一种名为通用跨模态区域(GCZ)的数据集,具有实际应用价值。代码与数据集可在https://github.com/MrPingQi/HOMO_Feature_ImgMatching获取。
abstract_en: An exploration of cross-arbitrary-modal image invariant feature extraction and matching is made, with a purely handcrafted full-chain algorithm, Homomorphism of Organized Major Orientation (HOMO), being proposed. Instead of using deep models to conduct data-driven black-box learning, we introduce a Major Orientation Map (MOM), effectively combating image modal differences. Considering rotation, scale, and texture diversities in cross-modal images, HOMO incorporates a novel, universally designed Generalized-Polar descriptor (GPolar) and a Multi-scale Strategy (MsS) to gain well-rounded capacities. HOMO achieves the best comprehensive performance in feature matching on several generally cross-modal datasets, challenging compared with a set of state-of-the-art methods including 7 traditional algorithms and 10 deep network models. A dataset named General Cross-modal Zone (GCZ) is proposed, which shows practical values. Codes with datasets are available at https://github.com/MrPingQi/HOMO_Feature_ImgMatching.
authors: Chenzhong Gao, Wei Li, Desheng Weng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10538-10548

title: HORT: 基于Transformer的单目手持物体重建
title_en: HORT: Monocular Hand-held Objects Reconstruction with Transformers
abstract: 从单目图像中重建手持物体的三维结构仍然是计算机视觉中的重大挑战。现有大多数方法依赖隐式三维表示,导致重建结果过于平滑且生成显式三维形状耗时。尽管近期方法直接使用扩散模型重建点云,但多步去噪过程使得高分辨率重建效率低下。为解决这些局限性,我们提出一种基于Transformer的模型,高效重建手持物体的密集三维点云。我们的方法采用粗到细策略,首先从图像生成稀疏点云,再利用像素对齐的图像特征逐步精化为密集表示。为提升重建精度,我们融合图像特征与三维手部几何信息,联合预测物体点云及其相对于手部的姿态。模型通过端到端训练实现最优性能。在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验结果表明,我们的方法在保持优异泛化能力的同时,实现了更优的重建精度和更快的推理速度。
abstract_en: Reconstructing hand-held objects in 3D from monocular images remains a significant challenge in computer vision. Most existing approaches rely on implicit 3D representations, which produce overly smooth reconstructions and are time-consuming to generate explicit 3D shapes. While more recent methods directly reconstruct point clouds with diffusion models, the multi-step denoising makes high-resolution reconstruction inefficient. To address these limitations, we propose a transformer-based model to efficiently reconstruct dense 3D point clouds of hand-held objects. Our method follows a coarse-to-fine strategy, first generating a sparse point cloud from the image and progressively refining it into a dense representation using pixel-aligned image features. To enhance reconstruction accuracy, we integrate image features with 3D hand geometry to jointly predict the object point cloud and its pose relative to the hand. Our model is trained end-to-end for optimal performance. Experimental results on both synthetic and real datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with much faster inference speed, while generalizing well to in-the-wild images.
authors: Zerui Chen, Rolandos Alexandros Potamias, Shizhe Chen, Cordelia Schmid ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6046-6057

title: HPSv3:面向广谱人类偏好分数
title_en: HPSv3: Towards Wide-Spectrum Human Preference Score
abstract: 评估文本到图像生成模型需要与人类感知对齐,但现有以人类为中心的指标受限于数据覆盖有限、特征提取不理想和低效损失函数。为解决这些挑战,我们引入了人类偏好分数v3(HPSv3)。(1) 我们发布了HPDv3,这是首个整合108万文本-图像对和117万标注成对比较的广谱人类偏好数据集,涵盖前沿生成模型和低至高质量真实世界图像。(2) 我们提出基于视觉语言模型的偏好模型,采用不确定性感知的排序损失进行细粒度排序。此外,我们提出人类偏好链(CoHP),一种迭代图像优化方法,通过HPSv3在每一步选择最佳图像以提升质量而无需额外数据。大量实验表明,HPSv3可作为广谱图像评估的稳健指标,CoHP提供了高效且与人类对齐的图像生成质量提升方法。代码和数据集可在https://mizzenai.github.io/HPSv3/获取
abstract_en: Evaluating text-to-image generation models requires alignment with human perception, yet existing human-centric metrics are constrained by limited data coverage, suboptimal feature extraction, and inefficient loss functions. To address these challenges, we introduce Human Preference Score v3 (HPSv3). (1) We release HPDv3, the first wide-spectrum human preference dataset integrating 1.08M text-image pairs and 1.17M annotated pairwise comparisons from state-of-the-art generative models and low to high-quality real-world images. (2) We introduce a VLM-based preference model trained using an uncertainty-aware ranking loss for fine-grained ranking. Besides, we propose Chain-of-Human-Preference (CoHP), an iterative image refinement method that enhances quality without extra data, using HPSv3 to select the best image at each step. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HPSv3 serves as a robust metric for wide-spectrum image evaluation, and CoHP offers an efficient and human-aligned approach to improve image generation quality. Code and dataset is available at https://mizzenai.github.io/HPSv3/
authors: Yuhang Ma, Xiaoshi Wu, Keqiang Sun, Hongsheng Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15086-15095

title: HQ-CLIP: 利用大规模视觉-语言模型创建高质量图像-文本数据集和CLIP模型
title_en: HQ-CLIP: Leveraging Large Vision-Language Models to Create High-Quality Image-Text Datasets and CLIP Models
abstract: 大规模但存在噪声的图像-文本对数据为对比语言-图像预训练(CLIP)的成功奠定了基础。作为基础视觉编码器,CLIP反过来成为大多数大规模视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)的核心支柱。这种相互依赖关系自然引发了一个有趣的问题:能否通过LVLMs反哺提升图像-文本对数据的质量,从而开启持续改进的自我强化循环?在本工作中,我们通过引入一个由LVLM驱动的数据精炼流程,迈出实现这一愿景的关键一步。我们的框架利用LVLMs处理图像及其原始替代文本,生成四种互补的文本公式:长正描述、长负描述、短正标签和短负标签。将该流程应用于精心整理的DFN-Large数据集,得到VLM-150M数据集,该数据集富含多粒度注释。基于此数据集,我们进一步提出一种训练范式,通过引入负描述和短标签作为额外的监督信号,扩展传统的对比学习。所得到的模型HQ-CLIP在各类基准测试中展现出显著提升。在相当的训练数据规模下,我们的方法在零样本分类、跨模态检索和细粒度视觉理解任务中均达到最先进水平。在检索基准测试中,HQ-CLIP甚至超越了基于包含10倍更多训练数据的DFN-2B数据集训练的标准CLIP模型。所有代码、数据和模型将公开发布以支持进一步研究。
abstract_en: Large-scale but noisy image-text pair data have paved the way for the success of Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP). As the foundation vision encoder, CLIP in turn serves as the cornerstone for most large vision-language models (LVLMs). This interdependence naturally raises an interesting question: Can we reciprocally leverage LVLMs to enhance the quality of image-text pair data, thereby opening the possibility of a self-reinforcing cycle for continuous improvement? In this work, we take a significant step toward this vision by introducing an LVLM-driven data refinement pipeline. Our framework leverages LVLMs to process images and their raw alt-text, generating four complementary textual formulas: long positive descriptions, long negative descriptions, short positive tags, and short negative tags. Applying this pipeline to the curated DFN-Large dataset yields VLM-150M, a refined dataset enriched with multi-grained annotations. Based on this dataset, we further propose a training paradigm that extends conventional contrastive learning by incorporating negative descriptions and short tags as additional supervised signals. The resulting model, namely HQ-CLIP, demonstrates remarkable improvements across diverse benchmarks. Within a comparable training data scale, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance in zero-shot classification, cross-modal retrieval, and fine-grained visual understanding tasks. In retrieval benchmarks, HQ-CLIP even surpasses standard CLIP models trained on the DFN-2B dataset, which contains 10xmore training data than ours. All code, data, and models will be made publicly available to support further research.
authors: Zhixiang Wei, Guangting Wang, Xiaoxiao Ma, Ke Mei, Huaian Chen, Yi Jin, Fengyun Rao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22447-22456

title: HRScene:视觉大语言模型在有效高分辨率图像理解方面还有多远?
title_en: HRScene: How Far Are VLMs from Effective High-Resolution Image Understanding?
abstract: 高分辨率图像(HRI)理解旨在处理像素数量庞大的图像,例如病理图像和农业航拍图像,这些图像均可超过100万像素。视觉大语言模型(VLMs)据称能够处理HRI,然而目前缺乏对VLMs进行HRI理解评估的综合性基准测试。为解决这一问题,我们引入了HRScene,一个包含丰富场景的新型统一HRI理解基准测试。HRScene整合了25个真实世界数据集和2个合成诊断数据集,分辨率范围从1,024×1,024到35,503×26,627。HRScene由10名研究生级别的标注员收集并重新标注,涵盖25种场景,从显微图像到放射影像、街景、长距离图像和望远镜图像。它包含真实世界物体、扫描文档和组合多图像的HRI。这两个诊断评估数据集通过将目标图像与黄金答案和干扰图像以不同顺序组合生成,评估模型在HRI中利用特定区域的能力。我们对28个VLMs(包括Gemini 2.0 Flash和GPT-4o)进行了广泛实验。在HRScene上的实验表明,当前VLMs在真实世界任务上的平均准确率约为50%,揭示了HRI理解存在显著差距。在合成数据集上的结果表明,VLMs难以有效利用HRI区域,表现出显著的区域分歧和中间丢失现象,为未来研究提供了启示。
abstract_en: High-resolution image (HRI) understanding aims to process images with a large number of pixels, such as pathological images and agricultural aerial images, both of which can exceed 1 million pixels. Vision Large Language Models (VLMs) can allegedly handle HRIs, however, there is a lack of a comprehensive benchmark for VLMs to evaluate HRI understanding. To address this gap, we introduce HRScene, a novel unified benchmark for HRI understanding with rich scenes. HRScene incorporates 25 real-world datasets and 2 synthetic diagnostic datasets with resolutions ranging from 1,024 times 1,024 to 35,503 times 26,627. HRScene is collected and re-annotated by 10 graduate-level annotators, covering 25 scenarios, ranging from microscopic to radiology images, street views, long-range pictures, and telescope images. It includes HRIs of real-world objects, scanned documents, and composite multi-image. The two diagnostic evaluation datasets are synthesized by combining the target image with the gold answer and distracting images in different orders, assessing how well models utilize regions in HRI. We conduct extensive experiments involving 28 VLMs, including Gemini 2.0 Flash and GPT-4o. Experiments on HRScene show that current VLMs achieve an average accuracy of around 50% on real-world tasks, revealing significant gaps in HRI understanding. Results on synthetic datasets reveal that VLMs struggle to effectively utilize HRI regions, showing significant Regional Divergence and lost-in-middle, shedding light on future research.
authors: Yusen Zhang, Wenliang Zheng, Aashrith Madasu, Peng Shi, Ryo Kamoi, Hao Zhou, Zhuoyang Zou, Shu Zhao, Sarkar Snigdha Sarathi Das, Vipul Gupta, Xiaoxin Lu, Nan Zhang, Ranran Haoran Zhang, Avitej Iyer, Renze Lou, Wenpeng Yin, Rui Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22922-22933

title: HUG:基于分块重建的分层城市高斯点云方法用于大范围航拍场景
title_en: HUG: Hierarchical Urban Gaussian Splatting with Block-Based Reconstruction for Large-Scale Aerial Scenes
abstract: 3DGS是新兴且日益流行的新视角合成领域技术。其高度逼真的渲染质量和实时渲染能力使其在多种应用中具有广阔前景。然而,当应用于大范围航拍城市场景时,3DGS方法会面临内存消耗过大、训练时间缓慢、分区过程耗时以及因数据量增加导致渲染质量显著下降等问题。为解决这些挑战,我们提出HUG方法,通过分层神经高斯表示增强数据分区和重建质量。我们首先提出一种基于可见性的数据分区方法,该方法简单高效,显著优于现有方法的速度。随后,我们引入一种新颖的分层加权训练方法,结合其他优化策略,大幅提高重建质量。我们的方法在一套合成数据集和四个真实场景数据集上取得了最先进水平的结果。
abstract_en: 3DGS is an emerging and increasingly popular technology in the field of novel view synthesis. Its highly realistic rendering quality and real-time rendering capabilities make it promising for various applications. However, when applied to large-scale aerial urban scenes, 3DGS methods suffer from issues such as excessive memory consumption, slow training times, prolonged partitioning processes, and significant degradation in rendering quality due to the increased data volume. To tackle these challenges, we introduce HUG, a novel approach that enhances data partitioning and reconstruction quality by leveraging a hierarchical neural Gaussian representation. We first propose a visibility-based data partitioning method that is simple yet highly efficient, significantly outperforming existing methods in speed. Then, we introduce a novel hierarchical weighted training approach, combined with other optimization strategies, to substantially improve reconstruction quality. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results on one synthetic dataset and four real-world datasets.
authors: Mai Su, Zhongtao Wang, Huishan Au, Yilong Li, Xizhe Cao, Chengwei Pan, Yisong Chen, Guoping Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28839-28848

title: HUMOTO:动作捕捉人机交互的四维数据集
title_en: HUMOTO: A 4D Dataset of Mocap Human Object Interactions
abstract: 我们提出了一种高保真的人机交互数据集Human Motions with Objects(HUMOTO),用于运动生成、计算机视觉和机器人应用。该数据集包含735个序列(30fps下共计7,875秒),记录了与63个精确建模物体和72个可动部件的交互。我们的创新包括基于场景的LLM脚本流程,可生成具有自然进展的完整任务,以及动作捕捉与相机录制设置以有效处理遮挡问题。涵盖烹饪到户外野餐等多样化活动,HUMOTO在保持物理准确性的同时确保任务流程逻辑性。专业艺术家严格清理并验证每个序列,最大限度减少脚部滑动和物体穿透。我们还提供了与其他数据集的基准对比。HUMOTO的全面全身运动和同时多物体交互解决了关键数据采集挑战,为动画、机器人和具身AI系统等研究领域提供推动真实人机交互建模的机会。项目页面:https://jiaxin-lu.github.io/humoto/
abstract_en: We present Human Motions with Objects (HUMOTO), a high-fidelity dataset of human-object interactions for motion generation, computer vision, and robotics applications. Featuring 735 sequences (7,875 seconds at 30 fps), HUMOTO captures interactions with 63 precisely modeled objects and 72 articulated parts. Our innovations include a scene-driven LLM scripting pipeline creating complete, purposeful tasks with natural progression, and a mocap-and-camera recording setup to effectively handle occlusions. Spanning diverse activities from cooking to outdoor picnics, HUMOTO preserves both physical accuracy and logical task flow. Professional artists rigorously clean and verify each sequence, minimizing foot sliding and object penetrations. We also provide benchmarks compared to other datasets. HUMOTO's comprehensive full-body motion and simultaneous multi-object interactions address key data-capturing challenges and provide opportunities to advance realistic human-object interaction modeling across research domains with practical applications in animation, robotics, and embodied AI systems. Project Page: https://jiaxin-lu.github.io/humoto/.
authors: Jiaxin Lu, Chun-Hao Paul Huang, Uttaran Bhattacharya, Qixing Huang, Yi Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10886-10897

title: HUST:基于纹理量化的高保真无偏肤色估计
title_en: HUST: High-Fidelity Unbiased Skin Tone Estimation via Texture Quantization
abstract: 近期的三维人脸重建方法在形状估计方面取得了显著进展,但高保真无偏面部漫反射率估计仍面临挑战。现有方法依赖于昂贵的光舞台采集数据,尽管在高保真重建或无偏肤色估计方面取得进展,但尚未有工作同时在两者方面达到最优效果。本文提出了一种新颖的高保真无偏面部漫反射率重建方法HUST,可直接从单张图像中恢复漫反射率图,无需采集数据。我们的核心洞察是漫反射率图是光照不变的纹理图,这使我们能够通过消除光照使用低成本纹理数据进行漫反射率估计。为实现这一目标,我们收集了大规模高分辨率人脸图像,并在图像空间中训练VQGAN模型。为适应预训练的VQGAN模型进行UV纹理生成,我们在图像和潜在空间中使用有限的UV纹理和我们的高分辨率人脸在对抗监督下微调编码器。最后,我们训练了一个交叉注意力模块,并利用组身份损失实现从纹理到漫反射率的领域适应。大量实验表明,HUST能够预测野外图像的高保真面部漫反射率。在FAIR基准测试中,HUST实现了最低的平均ITA误差(11.20)和偏差分数(1.58),证明了其在整个人类肤色光谱范围内的优越精度和鲁棒公平性。我们的代码、模型和训练数据将公开发布,以促进未来研究。
abstract_en: Recent 3D facial reconstruction methods have made significant progress in shape estimation, but high-fidelity unbiased facial albedo estimation remains challenging. Existing methods rely on expensive light-stage captured data, and while they have made progress in either high-fidelity reconstruction or unbiased skin tone estimation, no work has yet achieved optimal results in both aspects simultaneously. In this paper, we present a novel high-fidelity unbiased facial diffuse albedo reconstruction method, HUST, which recovers the diffuse albedo map directly from a single image without the need for captured data. Our key insight is that the albedo map is the illumination-invariant texture map, which enables us to use inexpensive texture data for diffuse albedo estimation by eliminating illumination. To achieve this, we collect large-scale high-resolution facial images and train a VQGAN model in the image space. To adapt the pre-trained VQGAN model for UV texture generation, we fine-tune the encoder by using limited UV textures and our high-resolution faces under adversarial supervision in both image and latent space. Finally, we train a cross-attention module and utilize group identity loss for the domain adaptation from texture to albedo. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HUST can predict high-fidelity facial albedos for in-the-wild images. On the FAIR benchmark, HUST achieves the lowest average ITA error (11.20) and bias score (1.58), demonstrating superior accuracy and robust fairness across the entire spectrum of human skin tones. Our code, models, and training data will be made publicly available to facilitate future research.
authors: Zimin Ran, Xingyu Ren, Xiang An, Kaicheng Yang, Ziyong Feng, Jing Yang, Rolandos Alexandros Potamias, Linchao Zhu, Jiankang Deng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13523-13532

title: HVPUNet:混合体素点云上采样网络
title_en: HVPUNet: Hybrid-Voxel Point-cloud Upsampling Network
abstract: 点云上采样旨在从稀疏或不完整的3D数据生成密集点集。现有大多数工作采用点对点框架。虽然该方法实现了高几何精度,但因处理无结构点数据时的不规则内存访问导致速度较慢。替代方案基于体素的方法通过使用规则网格实现计算效率,但因离散化难以保持精确点位置。为解决效率-精度的权衡,我们引入混合体素表示,该表示结合了体素占用和连续点偏移。随后提出混合体素点云上采样网络(HVPUNet),这是一种基于该表示的高效框架。HVPUNet集成了两个关键模块:(1)形状补全模块通过填充空体素恢复缺失几何结构,(2)超分辨率模块用于增强空间分辨率并捕捉更精细的表面细节。我们还采用了渐进细化、操作体素扩展和隐式几何学习。实验结果表明,HVPUNet在计算成本显著低于最先进方法的同时,模型精度相当。
abstract_en: Point-cloud upsampling aims to generate dense point sets from sparse or incomplete 3D data. Most existing work uses a point-to-point framework. While this method achieves high geometric precision, it is slow because of irregular memory accesses to process unstructured point data. Alternatively, voxel-based methods offer computational efficiency by using regular grids, but struggle to preserve precise point locations due to discretization. To resolve this efficiency-precision trade-off, we introduce Hybrid Voxels, a representation that combines both voxel occupancy and a continuous point offset. We then present the Hybrid-Voxel Point-cloud Upsampling Network (HVPUNet), an efficient framework built upon this representation. HVPUNet integrates two key modules: (1) Shape Completion to restore missing geometry by filling empty voxels, and (2) Super-Resolution to enhance spatial resolution and capture finer surface details. We also use progressive refinement, operational voxel expansion, and implicit geometric learning. Experimental results demonstrate that HVPUNet can upsample point clouds at significantly lower computational cost than the state-of-the-art, but with comparable model accuracy.
authors: Juhyung Ha, Vibhas Kumar Vats, Soon-heung Jung, Alimoor Reza, David J. Crandall ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 29153-29162

title: HairCUP:面向3D高斯头像的头发组合性通用先验模型
title_en: HairCUP: Hair Compositional Universal Prior for 3D Gaussian Avatars
abstract: 我们提出了一种面向3D头部头像的通用先验模型,具有显式的头发组合性。现有构建通用先验模型的方法通常采用整体建模方法,将面部和头发视为不可分割的整体。这种做法忽略了人类头部的固有组合性,导致模型难以自然解耦面部与头发的表示,尤其是在数据集有限的情况下。此外,此类整体模型在支持如3D面部与发型交换等应用时,难以实现灵活可控的性能。为解决这些挑战,我们引入了一种显式考虑面部与头发组合性的先验模型,分别学习其潜在空间。该方法的关键使能技术是我们的合成无发数据生成流水线,通过从扩散先验估计的无发几何和纹理,从工作室捕捉的数据集中移除头发。通过利用原始与合成无发捕捉的配对数据集,我们训练了面部与头发的解耦先验模型,将组合性作为归纳偏置纳入其中以促进有效分离。我们的模型固有的组合性使得在保持身份的前提下,能够无缝地在头像之间转移面部与头发组件。此外,我们证明该模型可通过单目捕捉以数据高效的方式进行微调,从而为未见过的主体生成高保真、具有头发组合性的3D头部头像。这些能力凸显了我们的方法在现实场景中的实用价值,为灵活且富有表现力的3D头像生成铺平了道路。
abstract_en: We present a universal prior model for 3D head avatars with explicit hair compositionality. Existing approaches to build generalizable priors for 3D head avatars often adopt a holistic modeling approach, treating the face and hair as an inseparable entity. This overlooks the inherent compositionality of the human head, making it difficult for the model to naturally disentangle face and hair representations, especially when the dataset is limited. Furthermore, such holistic models struggle to support applications like 3D face and hairstyle swapping in a flexible and controllable manner. To address these challenges, we introduce a prior model that explicitly accounts for the compositionality of face and hair, learning their latent spaces separately. A key enabler of this approach is our synthetic hairless data creation pipeline, which removes hair from studio-captured datasets using estimated hairless geometry and texture derived from a diffusion prior. By leveraging a paired dataset of original and synthetic hairless captures, we train disentangled prior models for face and hair, incorporating compositionality as an inductive bias to facilitate effective separation. Our model's inherent compositionality enables seamless transfer of face and hair components between avatars while preserving identity. Additionally, we demonstrate that our model can be fine-tuned in a data-efficient manner using monocular captures to create high-fidelity, hair-compositional 3D head avatars for unseen subjects. These capabilities highlight the practical applicability of our approach in real-world scenarios, paving the way for flexible and expressive 3D avatar generation.
authors: Byungjun Kim, Shunsuke Saito, Giljoo Nam, Tomas Simon, Jason Saragih, Hanbyul Joo, Junxuan Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9966-9976

title: 幻觉图像标记:一种无需训练的EAZY方法用于检测和缓解大型视觉语言模型中的物体幻觉
title_en: Hallucinatory Image Tokens: A Training-free EAZY Approach to Detecting and Mitigating Object Hallucinations in LVLMs
abstract: 尽管具有显著潜力,大型视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)仍面临物体幻觉的挑战,即其生成输出错误地包含实际不存在的物体。虽然大多数研究聚焦于语言模型主干中解决此问题,但我们的工作将重点转向图像输入源,探讨特定图像标记如何导致幻觉。分析表明,一小部分具有高注意力分数的图像标记是物体幻觉的主要驱动因素。通过移除这些幻觉图像标记(仅占所有图像标记的1.5%),可有效缓解该问题。这一发现适用于不同模型。基于此洞察,我们提出\eazy,一种新颖的无需训练方法,通过将幻觉图像标记置零,自动识别并消除幻觉。我们利用EAZY进行无监督物体幻觉检测,相较以往方法提升15%。此外,EAZY在缓解幻觉的同时保持模型实用性,并能无缝适配各类LVLM架构。
abstract_en: Despite their remarkable potential, Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) still face challenges with object hallucination, a problem where their generated outputs mistakenly incorporate objects that do not actually exist. Although most works focus on addressing this issue within the language-model backbone, our work shifts the focus to the image input source, investigating how specific image tokens contribute to hallucinations. Our analysis reveals that a small subset of image tokens with high attention scores are the main drivers of object hallucination. By removing these hallucinatory image tokens (only 1.5% of all image tokens), the issue can be effectively mitigated. This finding holds consistently across different models. Building on this insight, we introduce \eazy, a novel, training-free method that automatically identifies and Eliminates hAllucinations by Zeroing out hallucinator Y image tokens. We utilize EAZY for unsupervised object hallucination detection, achieving a 15% improvement compared to previous methods. Additionally, EAZY demonstrates remarkable effectiveness in mitigating hallucinations while preserving model utility and seamlessly adapting to various LVLM architectures.
authors: Liwei Che, Tony Qingze Liu, Jing Jia, Weiyi Qin, Ruixiang Tang, Vladimir Pavlovic ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21635-21644

title: 协调视觉表示以实现统一的多模态理解和生成
title_en: Harmonizing Visual Representations for Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
abstract: 在单一多模态框架中统一视觉理解和生成仍是一个重大挑战,因为这两个本质上异构的任务需要不同粒度层次的表示。当前采用向量量化(VQ)或变分自编码器(VAE)进行统一视觉表示的方法,优先考虑内在图像特征而非语义信息,从而损害了理解性能。受掩码图像建模(MIM)的启发,该方法通过掩码-重构预训练学习丰富语义,并成功扩展到掩码自回归(MAR)图像生成。对MAR编码器表示的初步研究揭示了其卓越的线性探测准确率和对视觉概念的精确特征响应,这表明MAR在超出其原始生成角色的视觉理解任务中具有潜力。基于这些洞察,我们提出Harmon,一个统一的自回归框架,通过共享的MAR编码器协调理解和生成任务。通过三阶段训练过程逐步优化理解和生成能力,Harmon在GenEval(指令对齐)和MJHQ30K(视觉质量)基准上实现了最先进的图像生成结果,同时在图像理解基准上与专用语义编码器(如Janus)的方法表现相当。我们的代码和模型将在https://github.com/wusize/Harmon上发布。
abstract_en: Unifying visual understanding and generation within a single multimodal framework remains a significant challenge, as the two inherently heterogeneous tasks require representations at different levels of granularity. Current approaches that utilize vector quantization (VQ) or variational autoencoders (VAE) for unified visual representation prioritize intrinsic imagery features over semantics, compromising understanding performance. In this work, we take inspiration from masked image modelling (MIM) that learns rich semantics via a mask-and-reconstruct pre-training and its successful extension to masked autoregressive (MAR) image generation. A preliminary study on the MAR encoder's representation reveals exceptional linear probing accuracy and precise feature response to visual concepts, which indicates MAR's potential for visual understanding tasks beyond its original generation role. Based on these insights, we present Harmon, a unified autoregressive framework that harmonizes understanding and generation tasks with a shared MAR encoder. Through a three-stage training procedure that progressively optimizes understanding and generation capabilities, Harmon achieves state-of-the-art image generation results on the GenEval (instruction alignment) and MJHQ30K (visual quality) benchmarks while matching the performance of methods with dedicated semantic encoders (e.g., Janus) on image understanding benchmarks. Our code and models will be available at https://github.com/wusize/Harmon.
authors: Size Wu, Wenwei Zhang, Lumin Xu, Sheng Jin, Zhonghua Wu, Qingyi Tao, Wentao Liu, Wei Li, Chen Change Loy ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17739-17750

title: HarmonySeg: 基于深浅特征融合与生长抑制平衡损失的管状结构分割
title_en: HarmonySeg: Tubular Structure Segmentation with Deep-Shallow Feature Fusion and Growth-Suppression Balanced Loss
abstract: 在医学图像中,如血管和支气管树等管状结构的精确分割对于计算机辅助诊断、放疗和手术规划至关重要。然而,当面对这些结构在尺寸多样、拓扑复杂以及(通常)标注数据不完整等挑战时,算法设计面临显著困难。我们通过提出一种新的管状结构分割框架HarmonySeg来解决这些问题。首先,我们设计了一个从深到浅的解码器网络,其包含具有可变感受野的灵活卷积块,使模型能够有效适应不同尺度的管状结构。其次,为突出潜在解剖区域并提升小管状结构的召回率,我们引入了血管性图作为辅助信息。这些图通过浅层-深层融合模块与图像特征对齐,同时消除不合理候选区域以保持高精度。最后,我们引入了一种拓扑保持损失函数,利用上下文和形状先验知识平衡管状结构的生长与抑制,使模型能够处理低质量及不完整标注。在四个公开数据集上进行了大量定量实验,结果表明我们的模型能够准确分割2D和3D管状结构,并优于现有最先进的方法。在私有数据集上的外部验证也展示了良好的泛化能力。代码将在机构批准后通过此链接发布。
abstract_en: Accurate segmentation of tubular structures in medical images, such as vessels and airway trees, is crucial for computer-aided diagnosis, radiotherapy, and surgical planning. However, significant challenges exist in algorithm design when faced with diverse sizes, complex topologies, and (often) incomplete data annotation of these structures. We address these difficulties by proposing a new tubular structure segmentation framework named HarmonySeg. First, we design a deep-to-shallow decoder network featuring flexible convolution blocks with varying receptive fields, which enables the model to effectively adapt to tubular structures of different scales. Second, to highlight potential anatomical regions and improve the recall of small tubular structures, we incorporate vesselness maps as auxiliary information. These maps are aligned with image features through a shallow-and-deep fusion module, which simultaneously eliminates unreasonable candidates to maintain high precision. Finally, we introduce a topology-preserving loss function that leverages contextual and shape priors to balance the growth and suppression of tubular structures, which also allows the model to handle low-quality and incomplete annotations. Extensive quantitative experiments are conducted on four public datasets. The results show that our model can accurately segment 2D and 3D tubular structures and outperform existing state-of-the-art methods. External validation on a private dataset also demonstrates good generalizability. Code will be released at this link upon institutional approval.
authors: Yi Huang, Ke Zhang, Wei Liu, Yuanyuan Wang, Vishal M. Patel, Le Lu, Xu Han, Dakai Jin, Ke Yan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23571-23581

title: 利用输入自适应推理提升视觉-语言导航效率
title_en: Harnessing Input-Adaptive Inference for Efficient VLN
abstract: 视觉-语言导航(VLN)领域新兴范式是采用具有历史感知能力的多模态Transformer模型。给定语言指令,这些模型通过处理观测数据和导航历史来预测智能体最合适的动作。尽管这些模型显著提升了性能,但其规模在计算资源有限的实际场景中可能成为瓶颈。本文提出了一种新颖的输入自适应导航方法以提升VLN模型效率。我们首先证明现有输入自适应机制在不显著降低性能的前提下无法减少计算量。为解决这一问题,我们引入了三种自适应算法,分别部署在不同层级:(1) 为提升空间效率,我们选择性地处理智能体每次观测的全景视图;(2) 为提升模型内部效率,我们提出基于重要性的自适应阈值机制用于提前退出方法;(3) 为提升时间效率,我们实现了一种缓存机制以避免重复处理智能体已观测过的视图。在七个VLN基准测试中,我们在标准和连续环境中对三种开箱即用的智能体均实现了超过2倍的计算量减少。
abstract_en: An emerging paradigm in vision-and-language navigation (VLN) is the use of history-aware multi-modal transformer models. Given a language instruction, these models process observation and navigation history to predict the most appropriate action for an agent. While they have significantly improved performance, the scale of these models can be a bottleneck in practical settings with limited computational resources. In this work, we propose a novel input adaptive navigation method to enhance VLN model efficiency. We first show that existing input-adaptive mechanisms fail to reduce computations without substantial performance degradation. To address this, we introduce three adaptive algorithms, each deployed at a different level: (1) To improve spatial efficiency, we selectively process panoramic views at each observation of an agent. (2) To improve intra-model efficiency, we propose importance-based adaptive thresholding for the early-exit methods. (3) To improve temporal efficiency, we implement a caching mechanism that prevents reprocessing of views previously seen by the agent. In evaluations on seven VLN benchmarks, we demonstrate over a 2x reduction in computation across three off-the-shelf agents in both standard and continuous environments.
authors: Dongwoo Kang, Akhil Perincherry, Zachary Coalson, Aiden Gabriel, Stefan Lee, Sanghyun Hong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8219-8229

title: 利用高效掩码图像建模处理海量卫星影像
title_en: Harnessing Massive Satellite Imagery with Efficient Masked Image Modeling
abstract: 掩码图像建模(MIM)已成为构建遥感(RS)基础视觉模型的关键方法。然而,现有RS数据集在规模和多样性方面的局限性限制了MIM方法学习可泛化表示的能力。此外,传统MIM技术需要重建所有标记,导致不必要的计算开销。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新的RS模型预训练流程,包含大规模RS数据集的构建和高效MIM方法。我们通过收集公开RS数据集并经过排除、切片和去重处理,构建了高质量数据集**OpticalRS-13M**。该数据集包含1300万张光学影像,涵盖目标检测、像素分割等各类RS任务。为提升效率,我们提出SelectiveMAE预训练方法,动态编码和重建语义丰富的补丁标记,从而减少传统MIM模型因遥感影像冗余背景像素导致的低效问题。大量实验表明,OpticalRS-13M显著提升了分类、检测和分割性能,而SelectiveMAE训练效率提升超过两倍。这凸显了我们流程在开发RS基础模型方面的有效性与可扩展性。
abstract_en: Masked Image Modeling (MIM) has become an essential method for building foundational visual models in remote sensing (RS). However, the limitations in size and diversity of existing RS datasets restrict the ability of MIM methods to learn generalizable representations. Additionally, conventional MIM techniques, which require reconstructing all tokens, introduce unnecessary computational overhead. To address these issues, we present a new pre-training pipeline for RS models, featuring the creation of a large-scale RS dataset and an efficient MIM approach. We curated a high-quality dataset named **OpticalRS-13M** by collecting publicly available RS datasets and processing them through exclusion, slicing, and deduplication. OpticalRS-13M comprises 13 million optical images covering various RS tasks, such as object detection and pixel segmentation. To enhance efficiency, we propose SelectiveMAE, a pre-training method that dynamically encodes and reconstructs semantically rich patch tokens, thereby reducing the inefficiencies of traditional MIM models caused by redundant background pixels in RS images. Extensive experiments show that OpticalRS-13M significantly improves classification, detection, and segmentation performance, while SelectiveMAE increases training efficiency over 2xtimes. This highlights the effectiveness and scalability of our pipeline in developing RS foundational models.
authors: Fengxiang Wang, Hongzhen Wang, Di Wang, Zonghao Guo, Zhenyu Zhong, Long Lan, Wenjing Yang, Jing Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6935-6947

title: 利用文本到图像扩散模型进行点云自监督学习
title_en: Harnessing Text-to-Image Diffusion Models for Point Cloud Self-Supervised Learning
abstract: 基于扩散的模型在文本到图像生成中广泛应用,已被证明在2D表示学习中有效。最近,该框架通过构建条件点生成器扩展到3D自监督学习,以增强3D表示。然而,其性能受限于训练在有限规模3D数据集上的3D扩散模型。我们假设,特别是基于大规模数据集训练的文本到图像扩散模型(如Stable Diffusion(SD)模型)的鲁棒性能力,可以帮助克服这些限制。为验证这一假设,我们提出PointSD框架,利用SD模型进行3D自监督学习。通过将SD模型的文本编码器替换为3D编码器,我们训练了一个点到图像扩散模型,使点云能够引导渲染噪声图像的去噪过程。利用训练好的点到图像扩散模型,我们以无噪声图像作为输入,点云作为条件提取SD特征。随后,通过将3D主干网络特征与这些SD特征对齐,从而促进直接语义学习。在下游点云任务上的综合实验和消融研究证明了SD模型可以增强点云自监督学习。代码已公开在https://github.com/wdttt/PointSD。
abstract_en: Diffusion-based models, widely used in text-to-image generation, have proven effective in 2D representation learning. Recently, this framework has been extended to 3D self-supervised learning by constructing a conditional point generator for enhancing 3D representations. However, its performance remains constrained by the 3D diffusion model, which is trained on the available 3D datasets with limited size. We hypothesize that the robust capabilities of text-to-image diffusion models, particularly Stable Diffusion (SD), which is trained on large-scale datasets, can help overcome these limitations. To investigate this hypothesis, we propose PointSD, a framework that leverages the SD model for 3D self-supervised learning. By replacing the SD model's text encoder with a 3D encoder, we train a point-to-image diffusion model that allows point clouds to guide the denoising of rendered noisy images. With the trained point-to-image diffusion model, we use noise-free images as the input and point clouds as the condition to extract SD features. Next, we train a 3D backbone by aligning its features with these SD features, thereby facilitating direct semantic learning.
