title_en: How Do Multimodal Large Language Models Handle Complex Multimodal Reasoning? Placing Them in An Extensible Escape Game
abstract: 多模态大语言模型(Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs)的快速发展激发了人们对现实世界和虚拟环境中复杂多模态推理任务的兴趣,这类任务需要协调多种能力,包括视觉感知、视觉推理、空间感知和目标推断。然而,现有评估主要关注最终任务完成情况,往往将评估简化为孤立的能力,如视觉定位和视觉问答。对多模态环境中推理过程的全面定量分析关注不足,这对于理解模型行为及超越单纯任务成功的底层推理机制至关重要。为解决这一问题,我们引入了MM-Escape,一个受现实世界逃脱游戏启发的可扩展基准测试,用于研究多模态推理。MM-Escape强调中间模型行为与最终任务完成的结合。为此,我们开发了EscapeCraft,一个可定制且开放的环境,使模型能够进行自由形式探索以评估多模态推理能力。大量实验表明,无论规模大小,MLLMs都能成功完成最简单的房间逃脱任务,部分模型甚至展现出类人探索策略。然而,随着任务难度增加,性能显著下降。此外,我们观察到模型容易出现偶然成功,且不同模型的性能瓶颈存在差异,揭示了其多模态推理能力的多样化失败模式和局限性,例如缺乏适应性探索的重复轨迹、因空间感知不足而卡在角落,以及对获取道具(如钥匙)的无效使用等。我们希望本研究能揭示多模态推理的新挑战,并发现MLLMs能力的潜在改进方向。
abstract_en: The rapid advancing of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has spurred interest in complex multimodal reasoning tasks in the real-world and virtual environment, which require coordinating multiple abilities, including visual perception, visual reasoning, spatial awareness, and target deduction. However, existing evaluations primarily assess the final task completion, often degrading assessments to isolated abilities such as visual grounding and visual question answering. Less attention is given to comprehensively and quantitatively analyzing reasoning process in multimodal environments, which is crucial for understanding model behaviors and underlying reasoning mechanisms beyond merely task success. To address this, we introduce MM-Escape, an extensible benchmark for investigating multimodal reasoning, inspired by real-world escape games. MM-Escape emphasizes intermediate model behaviors alongside final task completion. To achieve this, we develop EscapeCraft, a customizable and open environment that enables models to engage in free-form exploration for assessing multimodal reasoning. Extensive experiments show that MLLMs, regardless of scale, can successfully complete the simplest room escape tasks, with some exhibiting human-like exploration strategies. Yet, performance dramatically drops as task difficulty increases. Moreover, we observe that models severely suffer from accidental success, and that performance bottlenecks vary across models, revealing distinct failure modes and limitations in their multimodal reasoning abilities, such as repetitive trajectories without adaptive exploration, getting stuck in corners due to poor visual spatial awareness, and ineffective use of acquired props, such as the key. We hope our work sheds light on new challenges in multimodal reasoning, and uncovers potential improvements in MLLMs capabilities.
authors: Ziyue Wang, Yurui Dong, Fuwen Luo, Minyuan Ruan, Zhili Cheng, Chi Chen, Peng Li, Yang Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4807-4817

title: 光流与文本提示如何协作辅助音频视觉语义分割?
title_en: How Do Optical Flow and Textual Prompts Collaborate to Assist in Audio-Visual Semantic Segmentation?
abstract: 音频视觉语义分割(AVSS)是音频视觉分割(AVS)任务的扩展,要求在视觉像素层面识别发声物体的基础上,实现对音频视觉场景的语义理解。与先前方法不同,我们通过首先提供提示分割掩码以促进后续语义分析,将AVSS任务分解为两个离散子任务,创新性地改进了这一基础策略。我们提出了一种新型协作框架Stepping Stone Plus(SSP),整合光流与文本提示以辅助分割过程。在声源频繁与运动物体共存的场景中,我们的预掩码技术利用光流捕捉运动动态,为精确分割提供关键时间上下文。针对静态发声物体(如报警钟)带来的挑战,SSP引入两个特定文本提示:一个用于识别发声物体类别,另一个提供场景的广义描述。此外,我们实施了视觉-文本对齐模块(VTA),促进跨模态融合,实现更连贯且语境相关的语义解释。训练过程中采用后掩码技术,迫使模型学习光流图的结构。实验结果表明,SSP优于现有AVS方法,实现了高效且精确的分割结果。
abstract_en: Audio-visual semantic segmentation (AVSS) represents an extension of the audio-visual segmentation (AVS) task, necessitating a semantic understanding of audio-visual scenes beyond merely identifying sound-emitting objects at the visual pixel level. Contrary to a previous methodology, by decomposing the AVSS task into two discrete subtasks by initially providing a prompted segmentation mask to facilitate subsequent semantic analysis, our approach innovates on this foundational strategy. We introduce a novel collaborative framework, Stepping Stone Plus (SSP), which integrates optical flow and textual prompts to assist the segmentation process. In scenarios where sound sources frequently coexist with moving objects, our pre-mask technique leverages optical flow to capture motion dynamics, providing essential temporal context for precise segmentation. To address the challenge posed by stationary sound-emitting objects, such as alarm clocks, SSP incorporates two specific textual prompts: one identifies the category of the sound-emitting object, and the other provides a broader description of the scene. Additionally, we implement a visual-textual alignment module (VTA) to facilitate cross-modal integration, delivering more coherent and contextually relevant semantic interpretations. Our training regimen involves a post-mask technique aimed at compelling the model to learn the diagram of the optical flow. Experimental results demonstrate that SSP outperforms existing AVS methods, delivering efficient and precise segmentation results.
authors: Yujian Lee, Peng Gao, Yongqi Xu, Wentao Fan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23342-23352

title: AI生成视频距离模拟三维视觉世界有多远:一种学习型三维评估方法
title_en: How Far are AI-generated Videos from Simulating the 3D Visual World: A Learned 3D Evaluation Approach
abstract: 近年来视频扩散模型的进展使得生成具有令人印象深刻的三维一致性和时间连贯性的逼真视频成为可能。然而,这些AI生成视频在多大程度上模拟三维视觉世界仍缺乏深入研究。本文提出了一种客观、可量化且可解释的评估方法——学习型三维评估(L3DE),用于评估AI生成视频在三维视觉质量和一致性方面模拟现实世界的能力,无需依赖人工标注的缺陷或质量注释。与依赖易在野外视频中失效的三维重建不同,L3DE采用在单目三维线索(运动、深度和外观)上训练的三维卷积网络,以区分真实视频与合成视频。L3DE的置信度评分量化了真实视频与合成视频在三维视觉连贯性上的差距,而基于梯度的可视化则能定位不真实的区域,提升可解释性。我们通过大量实验验证了L3DE,证明其与三维重建质量及人类判断高度一致。对主流生成模型(如Sora、MiniMax和Kling)的评估揭示了持续存在的模拟差距和细微不一致性。除生成视频评估外,L3DE还可拓展至更广泛的应用:视频生成模型基准测试、深度伪造检测以及通过修复标记不一致区域增强视频合成。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in video diffusion models enable the generation of photorealistic videos with impressive 3D consistency and temporal coherence. However, the extent to which these AI-generated videos simulate the 3D visual world remains underexplored. In this paper, we introduce Learned 3D Evaluation (L3DE), an objective, quantifiable, and interpretable method for assessing AI-generated videos' ability to simulate the real world in terms of 3D visual qualities and consistencies, without requiring manually labeled defects or quality annotations. Instead of relying on 3D reconstruction, which is prone to failure with in-the-wild videos, L3DE employs a 3D convolutional network, trained on monocular 3D cues of motion, depth, and appearance, to distinguish real from synthetic videos. Confidence scores from L3DE quantify the gap between real and synthetic videos in terms of 3D visual coherence, while a gradient-based visualization pinpoints unrealistic regions, improving interpretability. We validate L3DE through extensive experiments, demonstrating strong alignment with 3D reconstruction quality and human judgments. Our evaluations on leading generative models (e.g., Sora, MiniMax, and Kling) reveal persistent simulation gaps and subtle inconsistencies. Beyond generative video assessment, L3DE extends to broader applications: benchmarking video generation models, serving as a deepfake detector, and enhancing video synthesis by inpainting flagged inconsistencies.
authors: Chirui Chang, Jiahui Liu, Zhengzhe Liu, Xiaoyang Lyu, Yi-Hua Huang, Xin Tao, Pengfei Wan, Di Zhang, Xiaojuan Qi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10307-10317

title: 如何让您的细胞追踪器说“我不知道”
title_en: How To Make Your Cell Tracker Say "I dunno!"
abstract: 细胞追踪是活细胞显微镜中的关键计算任务,但高通量成像的全自动分析需要可靠且具有不确定性感知的数据分析工具,因为单个实验记录的数据量已超出人类的观察能力。本文提出并评估了多种方法,用于在基于线性分配的细胞追踪算法中推理和量化不确定性。我们的方法从统计学和机器学习中汲取灵感,通过本研究中探讨的两种细胞追踪问题视角:将其视为贝叶斯推断问题和分类问题。我们的方法具有框架化特征,即为任何帧间追踪方法提供不确定性量化。我们通过将其应用于多种现有追踪算法(包括最近提出的基于Transformer的追踪器)来验证这一点。我们实证表明,我们的方法能够产生有用且校准良好的追踪不确定性。
abstract_en: Cell tracking is a key computational task in live-cell microscopy, but fully automated analysis of high-throughput imaging requires reliable and, thus, uncertainty-aware data analysis tools, as the amount of data recorded within a single experiment exceeds what humans are able to overlook. We here propose and benchmark various methods to reason about and quantify uncertainty in linear assignment-based cell tracking algorithms. Our methods take inspiration from statistics and machine learning, leveraging two perspectives on the cell tracking problem explored throughout this work: Considering it as a Bayesian inference problem and as a classification problem. Our methods admit a framework-like character in that they equip any frame-to-frame tracking method with uncertainty quantification. We demonstrate this by applying it to various existing tracking algorithms including the recently presented Transformer-based trackers. We demonstrate empirically that our methods yield useful and well-calibrated tracking uncertainties.
authors: Richard D. Paul, Johannes Seiffarth, David Rügamer, Katharina Nöh, Hanno Scharr ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6914-6923

title: 声音会如何变化?面向室内场景的材料控制多模态声学特征生成
title_en: How Would It Sound? Material-Controlled Multimodal Acoustic Profile Generation for Indoor Scenes
abstract: 在铺有地毯的地板和墙壁上有吸音板的情况下,工作室的声音会如何变化?我们引入了材料控制的声学特征生成任务,即在给定具有特定音频-视觉特性的室内场景时,目标是在推理过程中根据用户定义的材料配置生成目标声学特征。我们采用了一种新颖的编码器-解码器方法,该方法从音频-视觉观察中编码场景的关键属性,并根据用户提供的材料规格生成条件化的房间脉冲响应(RIR)。我们的模型能够基于推理过程中动态定义的各种材料配置生成多样化的RIR。为支持该任务,我们创建了一个新的基准数据集——声学奇幻数据集(Acoustic Wonderland Dataset),用于在多样且具有挑战性的环境下开发和评估材料感知的RIR预测方法。实验结果表明,所提出的模型能够有效编码材料信息并生成高保真度的RIR,优于多个基线和最先进的方法。项目地址:https://mahnoor-fatima-saad.github.io/m-capa.html
abstract_en: How would the sound in a studio change with a carpeted floor and acoustic tiles on the walls? We introduce the task of material-controlled acoustic profile generation, where, given an indoor scene with specific audio-visual characteristics, the goal is to generate a target acoustic profile based on a user-defined material configuration at inference time. We address this task with a novel encoder-decoder approach that encodes the scene's key properties from an audio-visual observation and generates the target Room Impulse Response (RIR) conditioned on the material specifications provided by the user. Our model enables the generation of diverse RIRs based on various material configurations defined dynamically at inference time. To support this task, we create a new benchmark, the Acoustic Wonderland Dataset, designed for developing and evaluating material-aware RIR prediction methods under diverse and challenging settings. Our results demonstrate that the proposed model effectively encodes material information and generates high-fidelity RIRs, outperforming several baselines and state-of-the-art methods. Project: https://mahnoor-fatima-saad.github.io/m-capa.html
authors: Mahnoor Fatima Saad, Ziad Al-Halah ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12232-12241

title: 基于人类级指令的人-物体交互
title_en: Human-Object Interaction from Human-Level Instructions
abstract: 智能体必须基于人类级指令,自主与环境交互以执行日常任务。它们需要对世界的基础理解以准确解释这些指令,并具备精确的低层次运动和交互技能以执行推导出的动作。在本工作中,我们提出了首个完整的系统,用于在情境环境中基于人类级指令合成物理上合理的长时序人-物体交互,以实现物体操作。我们利用大语言模型(LLMs)将输入指令解释为详细的执行计划。与先前工作不同,我们的系统能够生成详细的指尖-物体交互,并与全身运动无缝协调。我们还通过强化学习(RL)在物理仿真中训练策略,以跟踪生成的运动,确保其物理合理性。我们的实验表明,该系统在复杂环境中合成多样化物体的逼真交互方面有效,突显了其在现实应用中的巨大潜力。
abstract_en: Intelligent agents must autonomously interact with the environments to perform daily tasks based on human-level instructions. They need a foundational understanding of the world to accurately interpret these instructions, along with precise low-level movement and interaction skills to execute the derived actions. In this work, we propose the first complete system for synthesizing physically plausible, long-horizon human-object interactions for object manipulation in contextual environments, driven by human-level instructions. We leverage large language models (LLMs) to interpret the input instructions into detailed execution plans. Unlike prior work, our system is capable of generating detailed finger-object interactions, in seamless coordination with full-body movements. We also train a policy to track generated motions in physics simulation via reinforcement learning (RL) to ensure physical plausibility of the motion. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our system in synthesizing realistic interactions with diverse objects in complex environments, highlighting its significant potential for real-world applications.
authors: Zhen Wu, Jiaman Li, Pei Xu, C. Karen Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11176-11186

title: 通过填充实现的人参与的三维场景布局局部修正
title_en: Human-in-the-Loop Local Corrections of 3D Scene Layouts via Infilling
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的人类参与方法,用于从第一人称视角获取人类反馈来估计三维场景布局。我们通过引入一种新颖的局部修正任务来研究该方法,用户在此任务中识别局部错误并提示模型自动进行修正。基于SceneScript,一个利用结构化语言的最先进的三维场景布局估计框架,我们提出了一种将该问题结构化为“填充”任务的解决方案,该任务在自然语言处理领域已有研究。我们训练了一个SceneScript的多任务版本,在保持全局预测性能的同时显著提升了其局部修正能力。我们将这一方法整合到人类参与的系统中,使用户能够通过低摩擦的“一键修复”工作流程迭代优化场景布局估计。我们的系统使最终优化的布局能够偏离训练分布,从而更精确地建模复杂布局。
abstract_en: We present a novel human-in-the-loop approach to estimate 3D scene layout that uses human feedback from an egocentric standpoint. We study this approach through introduction of a novel local correction task, where users identify local errors and prompt a model to automatically correct them. Building on SceneScript, a state-of-the-art framework for 3D scene layout estimation that leverages structured language, we propose a solution that structures this problem as "infilling", a task studied in natural language processing. We train a multi-task version of SceneScript that maintains performance on global predictions while significantly improving its local correction ability. We integrate this into a human-in-the-loop system, enabling a user to iteratively refine scene layout estimates via a low-friction "one-click fix" workflow. Our system enables the final refined layout to diverge from the training distribution, allowing for more accurate modelling of complex layouts.
authors: Christopher Xie, Armen Avetisyan, Henry Howard-Jenkins, Yawar Siddiqui, Julian Straub, Richard Newcombe, Vasileios Balntas, Jakob Engel ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5657-5666

title: HumanOLAT:面向全身人体重光照与新视角合成的大规模数据集
title_en: HumanOLAT: A Large-Scale Dataset for Full-Body Human Relighting and Novel-View Synthesis
abstract: 数字人体表示的同步重光照与新视角渲染是一项重要且具有挑战性的任务,具有广泛的应用场景。然而,由于缺乏公开的高质量数据集,尤其是针对全身人体捕捉的数据集,该领域的进展受到显著限制。为解决这一关键缺口,我们引入了HumanOLAT数据集,这是首个公开可访问的大规模数据集,提供全身人体的多视角单光源(OLAT)捕捉。该数据集包含多种光照条件下的HDR RGB帧,如白光、环境贴图、颜色渐变和精细粒度的OLAT光照。我们在最先进的重光照和新视角合成方法上的评估结果突显了该数据集的价值,同时也指出了在准确建模复杂的人体中心外观与光照交互方面仍存在的重大挑战。我们相信,HumanOLAT将显著促进未来研究,使通用及人体特定的重光照与渲染技术的严格基准测试和进步成为可能。
abstract_en: Simultaneous relighting and novel-view rendering of digital human representations is an important yet challenging task with numerous applications. However, progress in this area has been significantly limited due to the lack of publicly available, high-quality datasets, especially for full-body human captures. To address this critical gap, we introduce the HumanOLAT dataset, the first publicly accessible large-scale dataset providing multi-view One-Light-at-a-Time (OLAT) captures of full-body humans. The dataset includes HDR RGB frames under various illumination conditions, such as white light, environment maps, color gradients and fine-grained OLAT illuminations. Our evaluations on state-of-the-art relighting and novel-view synthesis methods underscore both the dataset's value and the significant challenges still present in accurately modeling complex human-centric appearance and lighting interactions. We believe that HumanOLAT will significantly facilitate future research, enabling rigorous benchmarking and advancements in both general and human-specific relighting and rendering techniques.
authors: Timo Teufel, Pulkit Gera, Xilong Zhou, Umar Iqbal, Pramod Rao, Jan Kautz, Vladislav Golyanik, Christian Theobalt ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 29131-29141

title: HumanSAM: 以人为中心的伪造视频分类:空间、外观与运动异常检测
title_en: HumanSAM: Classifying Human-centric Forgery Videos in Human Spatial, Appearance, and Motion Anomaly
abstract: 大量由生成模型合成的视频,尤其是模拟真实人类行为的人为中心伪造视频,对人类信息安全和真实性构成了重大威胁。尽管二元伪造视频检测已取得进展,但对伪造类型缺乏细粒度理解仍引发可靠性与可解释性方面的担忧,这对实际应用至关重要。为解决这一局限性,我们提出HumanSAM,一个基于视频生成模型根本挑战的新框架。具体而言,HumanSAM旨在将以人为中心的伪造视频分类为生成内容中常见的三类异常:空间、外观和运动异常。为更好地捕捉几何、语义及时空一致性特征,我们通过融合视频理解与空间深度的两个分支来生成伪造人类表示。同时,在训练过程中采用基于排序的置信度增强策略,通过引入三个先验分数学习更鲁棒的表示。在训练与评估方面,我们构建了首个公开基准数据集——以人为中心的伪造视频(HFV)数据集,所有伪造类型均通过半自动标注进行精细标注。实验结果表明,HumanSAM在二元和多类伪造分类任务中均优于现有先进方法,展现出 promising 的性能。
abstract_en: Numerous synthesized videos from generative models, especially human-centric ones that simulate realistic human actions, pose significant threats to human information security and authenticity. While progress has been made in binary forgery video detection, the lack of fine-grained understanding of forgery types raises concerns regarding both reliability and interpretability, which are critical for real-world applications. To address this limitation, we propose HumanSAM, a new framework that builds upon the fundamental challenges of video generation models. Specifically, HumanSAM aims to classify human-centric forgeries into three distinct types of artifacts commonly observed in generated content: spatial, appearance, and motion anomaly.To better capture the features of geometry, semantics and spatiotemporal consistency, we propose to generate the human forgery representation by fusing two branches of video understanding and spatial depth. We also adopt a rank-based confidence enhancement strategy during the training process to learn more robust representation by introducing three prior scores. For training and evaluation, we construct the first public benchmark, the Human-centric Forgery Video (HFV) dataset, with all types of forgeries carefully annotated semi-automatically. In our experiments, HumanSAM yields promising results in comparison with state-of-the-art methods, both in binary and multi-class forgery classification.
authors: Chang Liu, Yunfan Ye, Fan Zhang, Qingyang Zhou, Yuchuan Luo, Zhiping Cai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14028-14038

title: 人类作为棋盘:世界坐标系人体网格恢复的相机运动尺度校准
title_en: Humans as Checkerboards: Calibrating Camera Motion Scale for World-Coordinate Human Mesh Recovery
abstract: 准确的相机运动估计对于从RGB视频输入中恢复世界坐标系下的全局人体运动至关重要。尽管SLAM(同步定位与建图)被广泛用于估计相机轨迹和点云,但单目SLAM仅能估计到未知尺度因子。先前方法通过优化估计尺度因子,但这种方法不可靠且耗时。本文提出了一种无需优化的尺度校准框架Human as Checkerboard(HAC)。HAC明确利用人体网格恢复模型预测的人体作为校准参考。具体而言,它创新性地使用人体-场景接触关节的绝对深度作为参考,校准来自SLAM的对应相对场景深度。HAC借助人体网格恢复模型中编码的几何先验来估计SLAM尺度,实现精确的全局人体运动估计。简单而强大的方法,我们的方法在全局人体网格估计任务中设立了新的SOTA性能。与先前的局部到全局方法相比,将运动误差降低了50%,同时比基于优化的方法减少了100倍的后SLAM推理时间。我们的代码可在https://martayang.github.io/HAC/获取。
abstract_en: Accurate camera motion estimation is essential for recovering global human motion in world coordinates from RGB video inputs. While SLAM is widely used for estimating camera trajectory and point cloud, monocular SLAM does so only up to an unknown scale factor. Previous works estimate the scale factor through optimization, but this is unreliable and time-consuming. This paper presents an optimization-free scale calibration framework, Human as Checkerboard (HAC). HAC explicitly leverages the human body predicted by human mesh recovery model as a calibration reference. Specifically, it innovatively uses the absolute depth of human-scene contact joints as references to calibrate the corresponding relative scene depth from SLAM. HAC benefits from geometric priors encoded in human mesh recovery models to estimate the SLAM scale and achieves precise global human motion estimation. Simple yet powerful, our method sets a new state-of-the-art performance for global human mesh estimation tasks. It reduces motion errors by 50% over prior local-to-global methods while using 100x less post-SLAM inference time than optimization-based methods. Our code is available at https://martayang.github.io/HAC/.
authors: Fengyuan Yang, Kerui Gu, Ha Linh Nguyen, Tze Ho Elden Tse, Angela Yao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6069-6079

title: 人类作为校准模式:从不同步且未校准视频中实现动态三维场景重建
title_en: Humans as a Calibration Pattern: Dynamic 3D Scene Reconstruction from Unsynchronized and Uncalibrated Videos
abstract: 近期关于动态三维神经场重建的研究假设输入为姿态已知的同步多视角视频。然而在实际场景中,这些输入约束往往难以满足,导致该方法难以应用。我们证明只要视频捕捉到人类运动,即使视频来自未知姿态且不同步,也能生成动态神经场。人类是视频中最常见的动态主体之一,其形状和姿态可通过最先进的库进行估计。尽管存在噪声,这些估计的人体形状和姿态参数仍能作为训练高度非凸且欠约束的动态神经表征问题的优良初始化点。基于单帧中人体的形状和姿态参数,我们提出计算视频间时间偏移的方法,随后通过分析三维关节位置进行相机姿态估计。接着,我们采用多分辨率网格训练动态神经场,同时优化时间偏移和相机姿态。该设置仍需优化大量参数,因此我们引入鲁棒的渐进式学习策略以稳定训练过程。实验表明,我们的方法在挑战性条件下实现了精确的时空校准和高质量场景重建。
abstract_en: Recent works on dynamic 3D neural field reconstruction assume the input from synchronized multi-view videos whose poses are known. The input constraints are often not satisfied in real-world setups, making the approach impractical. We show that unsynchronized videos from unknown poses can generate dynamic neural fields as long as the videos capture human motion. Humans are one of the most common dynamic subjects captured in videos, and their shapes and poses can be estimated using state-of-the-art libraries. While noisy, the estimated human shape and pose parameters provide a decent initialization point to start the highly non-convex and under-constrained problem of training a consistent dynamic neural representation. Given the shape and pose parameters of humans in individual frames, we formulate methods to calculate the time offsets between videos, followed by camera pose estimations that analyze the 3D joint positions. Then, we train the dynamic neural fields employing multiresolution grids while we concurrently refine both time offsets and camera poses. The setup still involves optimizing many parameters; therefore, we introduce a robust progressive learning strategy to stabilize the process. Experiments show that our approach achieves accurate spatio-temporal calibration and high-quality scene reconstruction in challenging conditions.
authors: Changwoon Choi, Jeongjun Kim, Geonho Cha, Minkwan Kim, Dongyoon Wee, Young Min Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6598-6608

title: HumorDB:AI能否理解图形幽默?
title_en: HumorDB: Can AI understand graphical humor?
abstract: 尽管在图像分割和目标检测领域取得了显著进展,但理解复杂场景仍是一个重大挑战。本文聚焦图形幽默,作为需要阐明不同场景元素在先验认知知识背景下的交互关系的图像解释范例。本文介绍了HumorDB,一个新颖、受控且精心整理的数据集,旨在评估和推动AI系统对视觉幽默的理解。该数据集包含照片、漫画、速写和AI生成内容等多样化图像,包含细微编辑差异的最小对比对,以区分幽默与非幽默版本。我们在三个任务上评估人类、最先进的视觉模型和大型视觉-语言模型:二元幽默分类、趣味性评分预测以及成对幽默比较。结果揭示了当前AI系统与人类水平幽默理解之间的差距。尽管预训练的视觉-语言模型表现优于仅视觉模型,但它们在抽象速写和微妙幽默线索上仍存在困难。注意力图分析表明,即使模型正确分类幽默图像,也常常无法聚焦于使图像有趣的精确区域。初步的机制可解释性研究和模型解释评估提供了不同架构处理幽默的初步见解。我们的结果识别了有前景的趋势和当前局限性,表明有效的视觉幽默理解需要能够检测微妙上下文特征并弥合视觉感知与抽象推理之间差距的复杂架构。所有代码和数据均可通过此处获取:https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HumorDB_-049A
abstract_en: Despite significant advancements in image segmentation and object detection, understanding complex scenes remains a significant challenge. Here, we focus on graphical humor as a paradigmatic example of image interpretation that requires elucidating the interaction of different scene elements in the context of prior cognitive knowledge. This paper introduces HumorDB, a novel, controlled, and carefully curated dataset designed to evaluate and advance visual humor understanding by AI systems. The dataset comprises diverse images spanning photos, cartoons, sketches, and AI-generated content, including minimally contrastive pairs where subtle edits differentiate between humorous and non-humorous versions. We evaluate humans, state-of-the-art vision models, and large vision-language models on three tasks: binary humor classification, funniness rating prediction, and pairwise humor comparison. The results reveal a gap between current AI systems and human-level humor understanding. While pretrained vision-language models perform better than vision-only models, they still struggle with abstract sketches and subtle humor cues. Analysis of attention maps shows that even when models correctly classify humorous images, they often fail to focus on the precise regions that make the image funny. Preliminary mechanistic interpretability studies and evaluation of model explanations provide initial insights into how different architectures process humor. Our results identify promising trends and current limitations, suggesting that an effective understanding of visual humor requires sophisticated architectures capable of detecting subtle contextual features and bridging the gap between visual perception and abstract reasoning.All the code and data are available here: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HumorDB_-049A
authors: Vedaant V Jain, Gabriel Kreiman, Felipe dos Santos Alves Feitosa ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 604-613

title: HyPiDecoder:面向高效分割与检测的混合像素解码器
title_en: HyPiDecoder: Hybrid Pixel Decoder for Efficient Segmentation and Detection
abstract: 近期,Mask2Former作为通用图像分割框架取得了显著成功,其多尺度可变形注意力(MSDeformAttn)像素解码器已成为当前分割模型中广泛采用的组件。然而,MSDeformAttn的低效性已成为分割器的性能瓶颈。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种改进的像素解码器设计——超像素解码器(HyPiDecoder),通过将部分MSDeformAttn层替换为基于卷积的FPN层,引入显式局部信息并显著提升推理速度。实验结果表明,HyPiDecoder可应用于通用分割模型和统一的分割与检测模型,在目标检测、语义分割、实例分割和全景分割任务中均实现了速度与精度的提升。集成HyPiDecoder的Mask DINO模型在COCO全景分割任务中,使用SwinL-scale主干网络且无需额外训练数据,取得了58.8 PQ的新SOTA结果,推理速度较原模型提升了127%。代码已开源于\href https://github.com/HyPiDecoder/HybridPixelDecoder https://github.com/HyPiDecoder/HybridPixelDecoder 。
abstract_en: Recently, Mask2Former has achieved significant success as a universal image segmentation framework, with its Multi-Scale Deformable Attention (MSDeformAttn) Pixel Decoder becoming a widely adopted component in current segmentation models. However, the inefficiency of MSDeformAttn has become a performance bottleneck for segmenters. To address this, we propose the Hyper Pixel Decoder (HyPiDecoder), an improved Pixel Decoder design that replaces parts of the MSDeformAttn layers with convolution-based FPN layers, introducing explicit locality information and significantly boosting inference speed. Experimental results show that HyPiDecoder can be applied to both universal segmentation models and unified segmentation and detection models, achieving improvements in both speed and accuracy across object detection, semantic, instance, and panoptic segmentation tasks. The Mask DINO model integrated with HyPiDecoder achieves a new SOTA of 58.8 PQ on COCO panoptic segmentation with SwinL-scale backbone and no extra training data, with a 127% increase in inference speed compared to the original model. Code is available at \href https://github.com/HyPiDecoder/HybridPixelDecoder  https://github.com/HyPiDecoder/HybridPixelDecoder .
authors: Fengzhe Zhou, Humphrey Shi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22100-22109

title: HyTIP:基于掩码条件残差的混合时序信息传播视频编码框架
title_en: HyTIP: Hybrid Temporal Information Propagation for Masked Conditional Residual Video Coding
abstract: 大多数基于帧的视频编解码器可解释为沿时间维度传播参考信息的循环神经网络(RNN)。本文从RNN视角重新审视当前方法的局限性。输出递归方法通过传播解码帧具有直观性,但会对输出解码帧施加双重约束,导致率失真性能次优。相比之下,通过RNN内部传播潜在特征的隐藏层到隐藏层连接方法具有更大灵活性,但需要较大的缓冲区尺寸。为解决这些问题,我们提出HyTIP,一种结合两种机制的视频编码框架。我们的混合缓冲策略通过显式解码帧和少量隐式潜在特征实现竞争力的编码性能。实验结果表明,HyTIP在单独使用输出递归或隐藏层到隐藏层方法时均表现更优。此外,其性能与最先进方法相当但缓冲区尺寸显著更小,并在PSNR-RGB和MS-SSIM-RGB指标上超越VTM 17.0(低延迟B)。HyTIP的源代码可在https://github.com/NYCU-MAPL/HyTIP获取。
abstract_en: Most frame-based learned video codecs can be interpreted as recurrent neural networks (RNNs) propagating reference information along the temporal dimension. This work revisits the limitations of the current approaches from an RNN perspective. The output-recurrence methods, which propagate decoded frames, are intuitive but impose dual constraints on the output decoded frames, leading to suboptimal rate-distortion performance. In contrast, the hidden-to-hidden connection approaches, which propagate latent features within the RNN, offer greater flexibility but require large buffer sizes. To address these issues, we propose HyTIP, a learned video coding framework that combines both mechanisms. Our hybrid buffering strategy uses explicit decoded frames and a small number of implicit latent features to achieve competitive coding performance. Experimental results show that our HyTIP outperforms the sole use of either output-recurrence or hidden-to-hidden approaches. Furthermore, it achieves comparable performance to state-of-the-art methods but with a much smaller buffer size, and outperforms VTM 17.0 (Low-delay B) in terms of PSNR-RGB and MS-SSIM-RGB. The source code of HyTIP is available at https://github.com/NYCU-MAPL/HyTIP.
authors: Yi-Hsin Chen, Yi-Chen Yao, Kuan-Wei Ho, Chun-Hung Wu, Huu-Tai Phung, Martin Benjak, Jörn Ostermann, Wen-Hsiao Peng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17889-17898

title: 扩散变换器的混合布局控制:更少注释,更优美学
title_en: Hybrid Layout Control for Diffusion Transformer: Fewer Annotations, Superior Aesthetics
abstract: 文本到图像生成模型通常难以有效解析具有空间感知的文本提示。为解决这一问题,现有方法通常需要数百万高质量的语义布局注释,包括边界框和区域提示。本文表明,对于最新扩散变换器(如SD3或FLUX)而言,大量区域提示并非必需。本文提出了一种高效的混合布局框架用于扩散变换器。我们的方法大幅减少了对广泛布局注释的需求,并最小化了对区域提示注释的依赖——仅在推理过程中产生极小的额外计算成本,同时保持高质量的布局遵循。我们的关键洞察是将布局控制任务分解为两个顺序阶段:首先,根据匿名布局生成目标对象于指定区域;其次,优化这些输出以确保严格遵循语义布局中的区域提示。基于这一洞察,我们提出了一种混合布局控制方案:首先微调DiT模型(如SD3)以遵循匿名布局,随后继续微调DiT模型以遵循语义布局,最后加入质量调优阶段以增强视觉美学。我们证明该混合设计具有高度的数据效率,发现仅使用少量语义布局注释即可实现,从而显著降低对区域提示的依赖。此外,我们提出了一种高效的区域扩散变换器,通过一组低分辨率区域标记而非精心设计的布局标记来编码空间布局信息。这些区域标记上的区域级扩散损失可引导扩散变换器隐式学习遵循给定布局。我们通过与SiamLayout最新版本的对比实证验证了方法的有效性,结果表明我们的方法在数据效率上超过10倍且确保更优的视觉美学。
abstract_en: Text-to-image generation models often struggle to interpret spatially aware text prompts effectively. To overcome this, existing approaches typically require millions of high-quality semantic layout annotations consisting of bounding boxes and regional prompts. This paper shows that the large amounts of regional prompts are non-necessary for the latest diffusion transformers like SD3 or FLUX.In this paper, we propose an efficient hybrid layout framework for diffusion transformers. Our approach drastically reduces need for extensive layout annotations and minimizes reliance on regional prompt annotations--incurring only minimal additional computational cost during inference--while maintaining high-quality layout adherence. Our key insight is to break the layout-control task into two sequential stages: first, generating the target objects within the designated regions specified by an anonymous layout, and second, refining these outputs to ensure they strictly adhere to the regional prompts in the semantic layout. Building on this insight, we propose a hybrid layout control scheme that first fine-tunes the DiTs (e.g., SD3) to follow an anonymous layout, then continues fine-tuning the DiTs to follow the semantic layout, and finally includes a quality-tuning stage to enhance visual aesthetics. We show that this hybrid design is highly data-efficient, as we find only using a small amount of semantic layout annotations is sufficient, thereby significantly reducing dependency on regional prompts. In addition, we propose an efficient regional diffusion transformer to encode the spatial layout information using just a set of lower-resolution regional tokens instead of various carefully designed layout tokens. The region-wise diffusion loss over these regional tokens can guide the diffusion transformer learn to follow the given layout implicitly. We empirically validate the effectiveness of our approach by comparing it with the latest version of SiamLayout and show that our method achieves better results while being more than 10 times more data efficient and ensuring superior aesthetics.
authors: Keming Wu, Junwen Chen, Zhanhao Liang, Yinuo Wang, Ji Li, Chao Zhang, Bin Wang, Yuhui Yuan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17930-17940

title: Hybrid-TTA:通过动态域偏移检测实现持续测试时适应
title_en: Hybrid-TTA: Continual Test-time Adaptation via Dynamic Domain Shift Detection
abstract: 持续测试时适应(CTTA)已成为弥合受控训练环境与现实场景之间领域差距的关键方法。由于需要在适应与稳定化之间取得平衡,许多研究尝试通过引入对完全可训练模型的调控或更新模型的有限部分来实现这一目标。本文提出Hybrid-TTA,这是一种综合方法,通过动态选择实例级调优方法以实现最优适应。我们的方法引入了动态域偏移检测(DDSD),通过利用输入序列中的时间相关性来识别领域偏移,并在不同领域偏移之间动态切换全量调优或高效调优以实现有效适应。为维持模型稳定性,掩码图像建模适应(MIMA)通过辅助重建任务实现增强的泛化能力和鲁棒性,且计算开销极小。Hybrid-TTA在Cityscapes-to-ACDC语义分割基准数据集上实现了0.6%的性能提升,超越了先前最先进的方法。与最近提出的最快方法相比,其帧率(FPS)提升了约20倍,为现实场景中的持续适应挑战提供了稳健的解决方案。
abstract_en: Continual Test Time Adaptation (CTTA) has emerged as a critical approach to bridge the domain gap between controlled training environments and real-world scenarios.Since it is important to balance the trade-off between adaptation and stabilization, many studies have tried to accomplish it by either introducing a regulation to fully trainable models or updating a limited portion of the models.This paper proposes Hybrid-TTA, a holistic approach that dynamically selects the instance-wise tuning method for optimal adaptation. Our approach introduces Dynamic Domain Shift Detection (DDSD), which identifies domain shifts by leveraging temporal correlations in input sequences, and dynamically switches between Full or Efficient Tuning for effective adaptation toward varying domain shifts. To maintain model stability, Masked Image Modeling Adaptation (MIMA) leverages auxiliary reconstruction task for enhanced generalization and robustness with minimal computational overhead.Hybrid-TTA achieves 0.6%p gain on the Cityscapes-to-ACDC benchmark dataset for semantic segmentation, surpassing previous state-of-the-art methods. It also delivers about 20-fold increase in FPS compared to the recently proposed fastest methods, offering a robust solution for real-world continual adaptation challenges.
authors: Hyewon Park, Hyejin Park, Jueun Ko, Dongbo Min ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2877-2886

title: 混合塔:文本到视频检索中的细粒度伪查询交互与生成
title_en: Hybrid-Tower: Fine-grained Pseudo-query Interaction and Generation for Text-to-Video Retrieval
abstract: 文本到视频检索(T2VR)任务旨在通过具有相同语义含义的文本查询检索未标注视频。近期基于CLIP的方法探索了两种框架:双塔框架与单塔框架,但前者效果较低,后者效率较低。本研究探索了一种新的混合塔框架,能够融合双塔与单塔框架的优势,同时实现高效果和高效率。我们提出了一种新颖的混合方法,即细粒度伪查询交互与生成用于T2VR,即\name,包含一个新设计的伪查询生成器,为每个视频生成伪查询。这使得视频特征与伪查询的文本特征能够以细粒度方式进行交互,类似于单塔方法在接收真实文本查询前即可实现高效果。同时,我们的方法在推理阶段相比双塔框架引入了无额外存储或计算开销,从而保持高效率。在五个常用文本-视频检索基准数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在R@1指标上相比基线提升了1.6%~3.9%。此外,我们的方法在保持双塔模型效率的同时实现了接近SOTA的性能,突显了混合塔框架的优势。
abstract_en: The Text-to-Video Retrieval (T2VR) task aims to retrieve unlabeled videos by textual queries with the same semantic meanings. Recent CLIP-based approaches have explored two frameworks: Two-Tower versus Single-Tower framework, yet the former suffers from low effectiveness, while the latter suffers from low efficiency. In this study, we explore a new Hybrid-Tower framework that can hybridize the advantages of the Two-Tower and Single-Tower framework, achieving high effectiveness and efficiency simultaneously. We propose a novel hybrid method, Fine-grained Pseudo-query Interaction and Generation for T2VR, i.e. \name  , which includes a new pseudo-query generator designed to generate a pseudo-query for each video. This enables the video feature and the textual features of pseudo-query to interact in a fine-grained manner, similar to the Single-Tower approaches to hold high effectiveness, even before the real textual query is received. Simultaneously, our method introduces no additional storage or computational overhead compared to the Two-Tower framework during the inference stage, thus maintaining high efficiency. Extensive experiments on five commonly used text-video retrieval benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves a significant improvement over the baseline, with an increase of 1.6% ~ 3.9% in R@1. Furthermore, our method matches the efficiency of Two-Tower models while achieving near state-of-the-art performance, highlighting the advantages of the Hybrid-Tower framework.
authors: Bangxiang Lan, Ruobing Xie, Ruixiang Zhao, Xingwu Sun, Zhanhui Kang, Gang Yang, Xirong Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24497-24506

title: 基于由粗到细语言引导的混合粒度特征聚合的自监督单目深度估计
title_en: Hybrid-grained Feature Aggregation with Coarse-to-fine Language Guidance for Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation
abstract: 当前自监督单目深度估计(MDE)方法由于语义-空间知识提取不足而面临性能瓶颈。为解决这一挑战,我们提出Hybrid-depth框架,系统整合基础模型(如CLIP和DINO)提取视觉先验并获取充分上下文信息用于MDE。我们的方法引入由粗到细的渐进式学习框架:1)首先,在对比语言引导下,从CLIP(全局语义)和DINO(局部空间细节)中聚合多粒度特征。设计了一个比较近景-远景图像块的代理任务,通过文本提示强制实现深度感知特征对齐;2)随后,在粗粒度特征基础上,融合相机位姿信息和像素级语言对齐以优化深度预测。该模块可无缝集成到现有自监督MDE流程(如Monodepth2、ManyDepth)中作为即插即用的深度编码器,提升连续深度估计性能。通过语言引导聚合CLIP的语义上下文和DINO的空间细节,我们的方法有效解决了特征粒度不匹配问题。在KITTI基准上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在所有评估指标上均显著超越现有SOTA方法,且对下游任务如BEV感知具有实际益处。
abstract_en: Current self-supervised monocular depth estimation (MDE) approaches encounter performance limitations due to insufficient semantic-spatial knowledge extraction. To address this challenge, we propose Hybrid-depth, a novel framework that systematically integrates foundation models (e.g., CLIP and DINO) to extract visual priors and acquire sufficient contextual information for MDE. Our approach introduces a coarse-to-fine progressive learning framework: 1) Firstly, we aggregate multi-grained features from CLIP (global semantics) and DINO (local spatial details) under contrastive language guidance. A proxy task comparing close-distant image patches is designed to enforce depth-aware feature alignment using text prompts; 2) Next, building on the coarse features, we integrate camera pose information and pixel-wise language alignment to refine depth predictions. This module seamlessly integrates with existing self-supervised MDE pipelines (e.g., Monodepth2, ManyDepth) as a plug-and-play depth encoder, enhancing continuous depth estimation. By aggregating CLIP's semantic context and DINO's spatial details through language guidance, our method effectively addresses feature granularity mismatches. Extensive experiments on the KITTI benchmark demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms SOTA methods across all metrics, which also indeed benefits downstream tasks like BEV perception.
authors: Wenyao Zhang, Hongsi Liu, Bohan Li, Jiawei He, Zekun Qi, Yunnan Wang, Shengyang Zhao, Xinqiang Yu, Wenjun Zeng, Xin Jin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6678-6692

title: Hydra-NeXt:基于开环训练的鲁棒闭环驾驶
title_en: Hydra-NeXt: Robust Closed-Loop Driving with Open-Loop Training
abstract: 端到端自动驾驶研究当前面临的关键挑战在于弥合开环训练与闭环部署之间的差距。现有方法在开环环境中训练以预测轨迹,这导致其在闭环环境中难以快速响应其他智能体,并因开环训练与闭环驾驶之间的差异而可能生成动力学不可行的计划。本文提出Hydra-NeXt,这是一种新颖的多分支规划框架,将轨迹预测、控制预测和轨迹优化网络统一于单一模型中。与仅处理一般情况规划的现有开环轨迹预测模型不同,Hydra-NeXt进一步采用控制解码器聚焦于短期动作,从而实现对动态场景和反应性代理的更快响应。此外,我们提出轨迹优化模块,通过有效遵循闭环环境中的运动学约束来增强和细化规划决策。这种统一方法弥合了开环训练与闭环驾驶之间的差距,在Bench2Drive数据集上无需依赖外部专家数据采集即取得65.89驾驶得分(DS)和48.20%成功率(SR)的优异表现。Hydra-NeXt超越了先前的最先进方法,DS提升22.98,SR提升17.49,标志着自动驾驶领域的重要进展。
abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving research currently faces a critical challenge in bridging the gap between open-loop training and closed-loop deployment. Current approaches are trained to predict trajectories in an open-loop environment, which struggle with quick reactions to other agents in closed-loop environments and risk generating kinematically infeasible plans due to the gap between open-loop training and closed-loop driving. In this paper, we introduce Hydra-NeXt, a novel multi-branch planning framework that unifies trajectory prediction, control prediction, and a trajectory refinement network in one model. Unlike current open-loop trajectory prediction models that only handle general-case planning, Hydra-NeXt further utilizes a control decoder to focus on short-term actions, which enables faster responses to dynamic situations and reactive agents. Moreover, we propose the Trajectory Refinement module to augment and refine the planning decisions by effectively adhering to kinematic constraints in closed-loop environments. This unified approach bridges the gap between open-loop training and closed-loop driving, demonstrating superior performance of 65.89 Driving Score (DS) and 48.20% Success Rate (SR) on the Bench2Drive dataset without relying on external experts for data collection. Hydra-NeXt surpasses the previous state-of-the-art by 22.98 DS and 17.49 SR, marking a significant advancement in autonomous driving.
authors: Zhenxin Li, Shihao Wang, Shiyi Lan, Zhiding Yu, Zuxuan Wu, Jose M. Alvarez ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27305-27314

title: HypDAE: 双曲扩散自编码器用于分层少样本图像生成
title_en: HypDAE: Hyperbolic Diffusion Autoencoders for Hierarchical Few-shot Image Generation
abstract: 少样本图像生成旨在基于仅有的少量示例,生成多样且高质量的未见过类别的图像。该任务中的关键挑战在于平衡类别一致性与图像多样性,二者往往相互竞争。此外,现有方法对新生成图像的属性控制有限。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新颖的方法Hyperbolic Diffusion Autoencoders(HypDAE),该方法在双曲空间中操作,以捕捉已见类别图像间的层次关系。通过利用预训练基础模型,HypDAE通过调整随机子码或语义码,能够以卓越的质量生成未见过类别的多样化新图像。最重要的是,双曲表示通过在双曲盘内调整半径,引入了对语义多样性的额外控制维度。大量实验和可视化结果表明,HypDAE在有限数据下通过更好地平衡保留类别相关特征与促进图像多样性,显著优于现有方法。此外,HypDAE提供了一个高度可控且可解释的生成过程。
abstract_en: Few-shot image generation aims to generate diverse and high-quality images for an unseen class given only a few examples in that class. A key challenge in this task is balancing category consistency and image diversity, which often compete with each other. Moreover, existing methods offer limited control over the attributes of newly generated images. In this work, we propose Hyperbolic Diffusion Autoencoders (HypDAE), a novel approach that operates in hyperbolic space to capture hierarchical relationships among images from seen categories. By leveraging pre-trained foundation models, HypDAE generates diverse new images for unseen categories with exceptional quality by varying stochastic subcodes or semantic codes. Most importantly, the hyperbolic representation introduces an additional degree of control over semantic diversity through the adjustment of radii within the hyperbolic disk. Extensive experiments and visualizations demonstrate that HypDAE significantly outperforms prior methods by achieving a better balance between preserving category-relevant features and promoting image diversity with limited data. Furthermore, HypDAE offers a highly controllable and interpretable generation process.
authors: Lingxiao Li, Kaixuan Fan, Boqing Gong, Xiangyu Yue ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17119-17128

title: Hyper-Depth:基于超图的多尺度表示融合单目深度估计
title_en: Hyper-Depth: Hypergraph-based Multi-Scale Representation Fusion for Monocular Depth Estimation
abstract: 单目深度估计(MDE)是计算机视觉中的基础问题,在多种下游任务中具有广泛应用。尽管多尺度特征对MDE具有感知上的重要性,但现有的基于Transformer的方法尚未显式地利用这些特征。为解决这一局限性,我们提出了一种基于超图的多尺度表示融合框架Hyper-Depth。所提出的Hyper-Depth包含两个关键组件:语义一致性增强(SCE)模块和几何一致性约束(GCC)模块。SCE模块基于超图卷积设计,聚合全局信息并增强多尺度块特征的表示。同时,GCC模块提供几何引导以减少因过度依赖局部特征导致的过拟合误差。此外,我们引入基于相关性的条件随机场(C-CRFs)模块作为解码器,以更有效地过滤相关块并计算注意力权重。大量实验表明,我们的方法在KITTI和NYU-Depth-v2数据集的所有评估指标上均显著优于现有最先进方法,分别在主指标RMSE上取得6.21%和3.32%的提升。此外,对nuScenes和SUN-RGBD数据集的零样本评估验证了本方法的泛化能力。
abstract_en: Monocular depth estimation (MDE) is a fundamental problem in computer vision with wide-ranging applications in various downstream tasks. While multi-scale features are perceptually critical for MDE, existing transformer-based methods have yet to leverage them explicitly. To address this limitation, we propose a hypergraph-based multi-scale representation fusion framework, Hyper-Depth.The proposed Hyper-Depth incorporates two key components: a Semantic Consistency Enhancement (SCE) module and a Geometric Consistency Constraint (GCC) module. The SCE module, designed based on hypergraph convolution, aggregates global information and enhances the representation of multi-scale patch features. Meanwhile, the GCC module provides geometric guidance to reduce over-fitting errors caused by excessive reliance on local features. In addition, we introduce a Correlation-based Conditional Random Fields (C-CRFs) module as the decoder to filter correlated patches and compute attention weights more effectively.Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across all evaluation metrics on the KITTI and NYU-Depth-v2 datasets, achieving improvements of 6.21% and 3.32% on the main metric RMSE, respectively. Furthermore, zero-shot evaluations on the nuScenes and SUN-RGBD datasets validate the generalizability of our approach.
authors: Lin Bie, Siqi Li, Yifan Feng, Yue Gao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5081-5090

title: HyperGCT:一种基于动态超图神经网络学习的三维配准几何约束
title_en: HyperGCT: A Dynamic Hyper-GNN-Learned Geometric Constraint for 3D Registration
abstract: 特征匹配之间的几何约束在三维点云配准问题中至关重要。现有方法通常将无序匹配建模为一致性图,并通过采样一致匹配来生成假设。然而,显式图构建会引入噪声,给手工设计的几何约束实现一致性带来巨大挑战。为了解决这一问题,我们提出HyperGCT,这是一种灵活的动态超图神经网络学习的几何约束方法,利用三维对应关系中的高阶一致性。据我们所知,HyperGCT是首个从动态超图中挖掘鲁棒几何约束用于三维配准的方法。通过动态优化超图(通过顶点和边特征聚合),HyperGCT有效捕捉对应关系之间的相关性,从而实现准确的假设生成。在3DMatch、3DLoMatch、KITTI-LC和ETH数据集上的广泛实验表明,HyperGCT实现了最先进的性能。此外,HyperGCT对图噪声具有鲁棒性,在泛化能力方面表现出显著优势。
abstract_en: Geometric constraints between feature matches are critical in 3D point cloud registration problems. Existing approaches typically model unordered matches as a consistency graph and sample consistent matches to generate hypotheses. However, explicit graph construction introduces noise, posing great challenges for handcrafted geometric constraints to render consistency. To overcome this, we propose HyperGCT, a flexible dynamic Hyper-GNN-learned geometric ConstrainT that leverages high-order consistency among 3D correspondences. To our knowledge, HyperGCT is the first method that mines robust geometric constraints from dynamic hypergraphs for 3D registration. By dynamically optimizing the hypergraph through vertex and edge feature aggregation, HyperGCT effectively captures the correlations among correspondences, leading to accurate hypothesis generation. Extensive experiments on 3DMatch, 3DLoMatch, KITTI-LC, and ETH show that HyperGCT achieves state-of-the-art performance. Furthermore, HyperGCT is robust to graph noise, demonstrating a significant advantage in terms of generalization.
authors: Xiyu Zhang, Jiayi Ma, Jianwei Guo, Wei Hu, Zhaoshuai Qi, Fei Hui, Jiaqi Yang, Yanning Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24750-24759

title: 带有部分属性填补的超图聚类网络
title_en: Hypergraph Clustering Network with Partial Attribute Imputation
abstract: 现有超图聚类方法通常假设节点属性是完全可用的。然而,在现实场景中,由于隐私保护或数据噪声,缺失节点属性是常见现象。尽管一些方法尝试处理传统图中的缺失属性,但它们并未针对超图设计,而超图编码高阶关系并引入了额外挑战。为弥合这一差距,我们提出带有部分属性填补的超图聚类网络(HCN-PAI)。具体而言,我们首先利用高阶邻域传播通过最小化狄利克雷能量来填补缺失节点属性,确保特征在超图上的平滑传播。随后,我们引入超图平滑预处理,高效捕捉结构信息,替代超图卷积操作,并显著降低计算成本。最后,我们设计双层级对比机制,通过两个独立的MLP将节点表示编码为两个不同视角,并在节点和超边层级上强制一致性。在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验验证了所提方法的有效性和优越性。
abstract_en: Existing hypergraph clustering methods typically assume that node attributes are fully available. However, in real-world scenarios, missing node attributes are common for the sake of privacy or due to data noise. While some approaches attempt to handle missing attributes in traditional graphs, they are not designed for hypergraphs, which encode higher-order relationships and introduce additional challenges. To bridge this gap, we propose Hypergraph Clustering Network with Partial Attribute Imputation (HCN-PAI). Specifically, we first leverage higher-order neighborhood propagation to impute missing node attributes by minimizing the Dirichlet energy, ensuring smooth feature propagation across the hypergraph. Next, we introduce a hypergraph smoothing preprocessing that efficiently captures structural information, replacing the hypergraph convolution operation, and significantly reducing computational costs. Finally, we design a dual-level contrastive mechanism, which employs two independent MLPs to encode node representations into two distinct views and enforces consistency at both node and hyperedge levels. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets validate the effectiveness and superiority of our proposed method.
authors: Qianqian Wang, Bowen Zhao, Zhengming Ding, Wei Feng, Quanxue Gao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2697-2706

title: 我大,你小;我正确,你错误
title_en: I Am Big, You Are Little; I Am Right, You Are Wrong
abstract: 图像分类的机器学习是一个活跃且迅速发展的领域。随着不同尺寸和架构的分类器数量激增,选择合适模型的问题变得愈发重要。虽然我们可以通过统计方法评估模型的分类准确率,但对这些模型工作原理的理解却相当有限。为了深入理解不同视觉模型的决策过程,我们提出使用最小充分像素集。这些像素通过模型的视角捕捉图像的本质。通过比较像素集的位置、重叠和大小,我们发现不同架构的模型在像素集的大小和位置上存在统计学差异。特别是ConvNext和EVA模型与其他模型差异显著。我们还发现,被误分类的图像与正确分类的图像相比,其关联的像素集统计上显著更大。
abstract_en: Machine learning for image classification is an active and rapidly developing field. With the proliferation of classifiers of different sizes and different architectures, the problem of choosing the right model becomes more and more important. While we can assess a model's classification accuracy statistically, our understanding of the way these models work is unfortunately quite limited. In order to gain insight into the decision-making process of different vision models, we propose using minimal sufficient pixels sets. These pixels capture the essence of an image through the lens of the model. By comparing position, overlap and size of sets of pixels, we identify that different architectures have statistically different minimal pixels sets, in both size and position. In particular, ConvNext and EVA models differ markedly from the others. We also identify that images which are misclassified are associated with statistically significant larger pixels sets than correct classifications.
authors: David A. Kelly, Akchunya Chanchal, Nathan Blake ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 817-826

title: i2-World:面向高效动态四维场景预测的内-外分词方法
title_en: I2-World: Intra-Inter Tokenization for Efficient Dynamic 4D Scene Forecasting
abstract: 通过基于占用的世界模型预测三维场景的演变并生成未见过的场景,为提升自动驾驶系统的安全性提供了巨大潜力。尽管分词技术已革新图像和视频生成领域,但高效分词复杂三维场景仍是三维世界模型的关键挑战。为解决这一问题,我们提出i2-World,一种高效的四维占用预测框架。我们的方法将场景分词解耦为内场景分词器和外场景分词器。内场景分词器采用多尺度残差量化策略,分层压缩三维场景同时保留空间细节。外场景分词器残差聚合跨时间步的时间依赖性。这种双设计在保持三维分词器紧凑性的同时,捕捉四维方法的动态表达性。与仅解码器的GPT风格自回归模型不同,i2-World采用编码器-解码器架构。编码器聚合当前场景的空间上下文并预测变换矩阵以指导未来场景生成。解码器在该矩阵和历史分词的条件下,确保生成过程中的时间一致性。实验表明,i2-World在四维占用预测中达到最先进性能,相较现有方法提升41.8%,且具有卓越效率——仅需2.9GB训练内存,实现94.8 FPS实时推理。
abstract_en: Forecasting the evolution of 3D scenes and generating unseen scenarios through occupancy-based world models offers substantial potential to enhance the safety of autonomous driving systems. While tokenization has revolutionized image and video generation, efficiently tokenizing complex 3D scenes remains a critical challenge for 3D world models. To address this, we propose I^ 2 -World, an efficient framework for 4D occupancy forecasting. Our method decouples scene tokenization into intra-scene and inter-scene tokenizers. The intra-scene tokenizer employs a multi-scale residual quantization strategy to hierarchically compress 3D scenes while preserving spatial details. The inter-scene tokenizer residually aggregates temporal dependencies across timesteps. This dual design retains the compactness of 3D tokenizers while capturing the dynamic expressiveness of 4D approaches. Unlike decoder-only GPT-style autoregressive models, I^ 2 -World adopts an encoder-decoder architecture. The encoder aggregates spatial context from the current scene and predicts a transformation matrix to guide future scene generation. The decoder, conditioned on this matrix and historical tokens, ensures temporal consistency during generation. Experiments demonstrate that I^ 2 -World achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing existing approaches by 41.8% in 4D occupancy forecasting with exceptional efficiency--requiring only 2.9 GB of training memory and achieving real-time inference at 94.8 FPS.
authors: Zhimin Liao, Ping Wei, Ruijie Zhang, Shuaijia Chen, Haoxuan Wang, Ziyang Ren ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25810-25819

title: I2V3D:基于3D指导的可控图像到视频生成
title_en: I2V3D: Controllable Image-to-video Generation with 3D Guidance
abstract: 我们提出I2V3D,一种新颖框架,通过精确的3D控制将静态图像动画化为动态视频,结合3D几何指导与先进生成模型的优势。我们的方法融合了计算机图形学管线的精确性,实现对相机运动、物体旋转和角色动画等元素的精准控制,同时借助生成AI的视觉保真度,从粗略渲染的输入生成高质量视频。为支持任意起始点和扩展序列的动画,我们采用基于3D几何的两阶段生成流程:1)3D指导关键帧生成,通过定制图像扩散模型优化渲染关键帧以确保一致性和质量;2)3D指导视频插值,一种无需训练的方法,利用双向引导在关键帧间生成平滑高质量视频帧。实验结果验证了该框架通过协调3D几何与生成模型,从单张输入图像生成可控的高质量动画的有效性。
abstract_en: We present I2V3D, a novel framework for animating static images into dynamic videos with precise 3D control, leveraging the strengths of both 3D geometry guidance and advanced generative models. Our approach combines the precision of a computer graphics pipeline, enabling accurate control over elements such as camera movement, object rotation, and character animation, with the visual fidelity of generative AI to produce high-quality videos from coarsely rendered inputs. To support animations with any initial start point and extended sequences, we adopt a two-stage generation process guided by 3D geometry: 1) 3D-Guided Keyframe Generation, where a customized image diffusion model refines rendered keyframes to ensure consistency and quality, and 2) 3D-Guided Video Interpolation, a training-free approach that generates smooth, high-quality video frames between keyframes using bidirectional guidance. Experimental results highlight the effectiveness of our framework in producing controllable, high-quality animations from single input images by harmonizing 3D geometry with generative models.
authors: Zhiyuan Zhang, Dongdong Chen, Jing Liao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13360-13371

title: I2VControl:解耦与统一的视频运动合成控制
title_en: I2VControl: Disentangled and Unified Video Motion Synthesis Control
abstract: 运动可控性在视频合成中至关重要。然而,大多数先前方法局限于单一控制类型,组合时往往导致逻辑冲突。本文提出了一种解耦且统一的框架I2VControl,以克服逻辑冲突。我们重新思考相机控制、物体拖拽和运动笔刷,将所有任务重新表述为基于点轨迹的一致表示,每个任务由专用公式管理。相应地,我们提出了一种空间划分策略,每个单元被分配到相应的控制类别,使多种控制类型能够在单一合成流程中动态协调而无冲突。此外,我们设计了一种适配器结构,作为预训练模型的插件,且与特定模型架构无关。我们进行了广泛的实验,在各种控制任务中取得了优异性能,我们的方法进一步促进了用户驱动的创意组合,提升创新性和创造性。项目页面:https://wanquanf.github.io/I2VControl
abstract_en: Motion controllability is crucial in video synthesis. However, most previous methods are limited to single control types, and combining them often results in logical conflicts. In this paper, we propose a disentangled and unified framework, namely I2VControl, to overcome the logical conflicts. We rethink camera control, object dragging, and motion brush, reformulating all tasks into a consistent representation based on point trajectories, each managed by a dedicated formulation. Accordingly, we propose a spatial partitioning strategy, where each unit is assigned to a concomitant control category, enabling diverse control types to be dynamically orchestrated within a single synthesis pipeline without conflicts. Furthermore, we design an adapter structure that functions as a plug-in for pre-trained models and is agnostic to specific model architectures. We conduct extensive experiments, achieving excellent performance on various control tasks, and our method further facilitates user-driven creative combinations, enhancing innovation and creativity. Project page: https://wanquanf.github.io/I2VControl.
authors: Wanquan Feng, Tianhao Qi, Jiawei Liu, Mingzhen Sun, Pengqi Tu, Tianxiang Ma, Fei Dai, Songtao Zhao, Siyu Zhou, Qian He ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14051-14060

title: IAP: 通过感知意识定位与扰动优化的不可见对抗补丁攻击
title_en: IAP: Invisible Adversarial Patch Attack through Perceptibility-Aware Localization and Perturbation Optimization
abstract: 尽管仅修改了很小的局部输入区域,对抗补丁却能显著改变计算机视觉模型的预测结果。然而,现有方法要么在目标攻击场景下表现不佳,要么生成的对抗补丁缺乏上下文一致性,导致容易被人类检测到且对自动补丁防御措施不够隐蔽。本文提出IAP,一种基于感知意识定位和扰动优化方案的新型攻击框架,能够生成高度隐蔽的对抗补丁。具体而言,IAP首先通过类别感知定位和敏感度图寻找合适的补丁位置,在平衡补丁位置对受害模型预测和人类视觉系统的影响方面进行优化,随后采用感知感知正则化对抗损失和优先考虑颜色恒常性的梯度更新规则来优化隐蔽扰动。在多种图像基准和模型架构上的综合实验表明,与现有基线方法相比,IAP在目标攻击场景下实现了显著提升的补丁隐蔽性,并保持了具有竞争力的攻击成功率。除了对人类高度不可察觉外,IAP还被证明能够使多个最先进的补丁防御措施失效。
abstract_en: Despite modifying only a small localized input region, adversarial patches can drastically change the prediction of computer vision models. However, prior methods either cannot perform satisfactorily under targeted attack scenarios or fail to produce contextually coherent adversarial patches, causing them to be easily noticeable by human examiners and insufficiently stealthy against automatic patch defenses. In this paper, we introduce IAP, a novel attack framework that generates highly invisible adversarial patches based on perceptibility-aware localization and perturbation optimization schemes. Specifically, IAP first searches for a proper location to place the patch by leveraging classwise localization and sensitivity maps, balancing the susceptibility of patch location to both victim model prediction and human visual system, then employs a perceptibility-regularized adversarial loss and a gradient update rule that prioritizes color constancy for optimizing invisible perturbations. Comprehensive experiments across various image benchmarks and model architectures demonstrate that IAP consistently achieves competitive attack success rates in targeted settings with significantly improved patch invisibility compared to existing baselines. In addition to being highly imperceptible to humans, IAP is shown to be stealthy enough to render several state-of-the-art patch defenses ineffective.
authors: Subrat Kishore Dutta, Xiao Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14766-14775

title: ICE-Bench:图像创建与编辑的统一且全面基准测试
title_en: ICE-Bench: A Unified and Comprehensive Benchmark for Image Creating and Editing
abstract: 近年来,图像生成技术取得了显著进展。然而,评估图像生成模型的性能仍是一个严峻的挑战。在本文中,我们提出ICE-Bench,一个统一且全面的基准测试,旨在严格评估图像生成模型。其全面性可概括为以下关键特征:(1) 由粗到细的任务划分:我们系统地将图像生成分解为四个任务类别:无参考/有参考图像创建/编辑,基于是否存在源图像和参考图像。进一步将其细分为涵盖广泛图像生成需求的31个细粒度任务,最终形成一个全面的基准测试。(2) 多维评估指标:评估框架从六个维度评估图像生成能力:美学质量、成像质量、遵循提示、源一致性、参考一致性和可控性。引入了11个指标以支持多维评估。值得注意的是,我们提出了VLLM-QA,一个创新性指标,通过大模型评估图像编辑的成功性。(3) 混合数据:数据来源于真实场景和虚拟生成,有效提升了数据多样性并缓解了模型评估中的偏差问题。通过ICE-Bench,我们对现有生成模型进行了深入分析,揭示了本基准测试的挑战性以及当前模型能力与实际生成需求之间的差距。为促进该领域进一步发展,我们将开源ICE-Bench,包括其数据集、评估代码和模型,从而为研究社区提供宝贵的资源。
abstract_en: Image generation has witnessed significant advancements in the past few years. However, evaluating the performance of image generation models remains a formidable challenge. In this paper, we propose ICE-Bench, a unified and comprehensive benchmark designed to rigorously assess image generation models. Its comprehensiveness could be summarized in the following key features: (1) Coarse-to-Fine Tasks: We systematically deconstruct image generation into four task categories: No-ref/Ref Image Creating/Editing, based on the presence or absence of source images and reference images. And further decompose them into 31 fine-grained tasks covering a broad spectrum of image generation requirements, culminating in a comprehensive benchmark. (2) Multi-dimensional Metrics: The evaluation framework assesses image generation capabilities across 6 dimensions: aesthetic quality, imaging quality, prompt following, source consistency, reference consistency, and controllability. 11 metrics are introduced to support the multi-dimensional evaluation. Notably, we introduce VLLM-QA, an innovative metric designed to assess the success of image editing by leveraging large models. (3) Hybrid Data: The data comes from real scenes and virtual generation, which effectively improves data diversity and alleviates the bias problem in model evaluation. Through ICE-Bench, we conduct a thorough analysis of existing generation models, revealing both the challenging nature of our benchmark and the gap between current model capabilities and real-world generation requirements. To foster further advancements in the field, we will open-source ICE-Bench, including its dataset, evaluation code, and models, thereby providing a valuable resource for the research community.
authors: Yulin Pan, Xiangteng He, Chaojie Mao, Zhen Han, Zeyinzi Jiang, Jingfeng Zhang, Yu Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16586-16596

title: IDEATOR:利用自身进行大型视觉-语言模型的越狱攻击与基准测试
title_en: IDEATOR: Jailbreaking and Benchmarking Large Vision-Language Models Using Themselves
abstract: 随着大型视觉-语言模型(VLMs)日益受到关注,确保其安全部署已成为关键。近期研究探索了VLMs对越狱攻击的鲁棒性——一种利用模型漏洞诱使有害输出的技术。然而,多模态数据的多样性有限,制约了当前方法过度依赖对抗性或手动制作的图像,这些图像源自有害文本数据集,往往在不同场景下缺乏有效性与多样性。本文提出IDEATOR,一种新颖的越狱方法,可自主生成恶意图像-文本对以实施黑盒越狱攻击。IDEATOR基于VLMs自身可作为强大红队模型的洞察,用于生成多模态越狱提示。具体而言,IDEATOR利用VLM生成针对性越狱文本,并与由先进扩散模型生成的越狱图像配对。大量实验验证了IDEATOR的高效性与可迁移性,其在仅平均5.34次查询下实现对MiniGPT-4的94%攻击成功率(ASR),并分别在LLaVA、InstructBLIP和Chameleon上实现82%、88%和75%的高ASR。基于IDEATOR的强可迁移性与自动化流程,我们引入VLJailbreakBench,一个包含3,654个多模态越狱样本的安全基准。对11个近期发布的VLMs的基准测试结果揭示了安全对齐的显著差距。例如,我们的挑战集在GPT-4o和Claude-3.5-Sonnet上分别实现46.31%和19.65%的ASR,凸显了对更强防御机制的迫切需求。
abstract_en: As large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) gain prominence, ensuring their safe deployment has become critical. Recent studies have explored VLM robustness against jailbreak attacks--techniques that exploit model vulnerabilities to elicit harmful outputs. However, the limited availability of diverse multimodal data has constrained current approaches to rely heavily on adversarial or manually crafted images derived from harmful text datasets, which often lack effectiveness and diversity across different contexts. In this paper, we propose IDEATOR, a novel jailbreak method that autonomously generates malicious image-text pairs for black-box jailbreak attacks. IDEATOR is grounded in the insight that VLMs themselves could serve as powerful red team models for generating multimodal jailbreak prompts. Specifically, IDEATOR leverages a VLM to create targeted jailbreak texts and pairs them with jailbreak images generated by a state-of-the-art diffusion model. Extensive experiments demonstrate IDEATOR's high effectiveness and transferability, achieving a 94% attack success rate (ASR) in jailbreaking MiniGPT-4 with an average of only 5.34 queries, and high ASRs of 82%, 88%, and 75% when transferred to LLaVA, InstructBLIP, and Chameleon, respectively. Building on IDEATOR's strong transferability and automated process, we introduce the VLJailbreakBench, a safety benchmark comprising 3,654 multimodal jailbreak samples. Our benchmark results on 11 recently released VLMs reveal significant gaps in safety alignment. For instance, our challenge set achieves ASRs of 46.31% on GPT-4o and 19.65% on Claude-3.5-Sonnet, underscoring the urgent need for stronger defenses.
authors: Ruofan Wang, Juncheng Li, Yixu Wang, Bo Wang, Xiaosen Wang, Yan Teng, Yingchun Wang, Xingjun Ma, Yu-Gang Jiang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8875-8884

title: IDF:面向可泛化图像去噪的迭代动态滤波网络
title_en: IDF: Iterative Dynamic Filtering Networks for Generalizable Image Denoising
abstract: 图像去噪是计算机视觉的基本挑战,在摄影和医学成像等领域具有广泛应用。尽管基于深度学习的方法取得了显著成功,但其对特定噪声分布的依赖性限制了对未见过的噪声类型和强度的泛化能力。现有方法通过大量训练数据和高计算资源试图解决这一问题,但仍存在过拟合现象。为应对这些挑战,我们通过高效操作动态生成内核进行图像去噪。该方法有助于防止过拟合并提升对未知噪声的鲁棒性。具体而言,我们的方法利用特征提取模块提取鲁棒的噪声不变特征,通过全局统计与局部相关性模块捕捉全面的噪声特性与结构相关性。内核预测模块随后利用这些特征生成像素级变化的内核,适配局部结构,并通过迭代应用进行去噪。这确保了方法的高效性与卓越的恢复质量。尽管模型仅在单级高斯噪声上训练,但其紧凑的结构(0.04 M)在多样化的噪声类型和强度下均表现出色,验证了迭代动态滤波在实际图像去噪中的应用潜力。
abstract_en: Image denoising is a fundamental challenge in computer vision, with applications in photography and medical imaging. While deep learning-based methods have shown remarkable success, their reliance on specific noise distributions limits generalization to unseen noise types and levels. Existing approaches attempt to address this with extensive training data and high computational resources but they still suffer from overfitting. To address these issues, we conduct image denoising by utilizing dynamically generated kernels via efficient operations. This approach helps prevent overfitting and improves resilience to unseen noise. Specifically, our method leverages a Feature Extraction Module for robust noise-invariant features, Global Statistics and Local Correlation Modules to capture comprehensive noise characteristics and structural correlations. The Kernel Prediction Module then employs these cues to produce pixel-wise varying kernels adapted to local structures, which are then applied iteratively for denoising. This ensures both efficiency and superior restoration quality. Despite being trained on single-level Gaussian noise, our compact model (  0.04 M) excels across diverse noise types and levels, demonstrating the promise of iterative dynamic filtering for practical image denoising.
authors: Dongjin Kim, Jaekyun Ko, Muhammad Kashif Ali, Tae Hyun Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12180-12190

title: IDFace:高效且安全的人脸模板保护识别
title_en: IDFace: Face Template Protection for Efficient and Secure Identification
abstract: 随着人脸识别系统(FRS)的广泛应用,用户隐私问题日益重要。FRS中的关键隐私问题在于保护用户的人脸模板,因为用户人脸图像的特征可以从模板中恢复。尽管近年来同态加密(HE)等密码学工具的进步为保护FRS提供了机会,但HE无法以高效即插即用的方式直接与FRS结合。特别是,虽然HE在功能上适用于任意程序,但它本质上是为预定形状的加密数据(如多项式环)的代数运算而设计的。因此,非定制化的HE与系统结合会导致非常低效的性能,许多先前基于HE的人脸模板保护方法速度比无保护的普通系统慢数百倍。在本研究中,我们提出\mathsf IDFace,一种基于HE的新型安全高效人脸识别方法,具有模板保护功能。\mathsf IDFace基于两种新型技术设计,用于在(同态加密的)生物特征数据库中以角度度量进行高效搜索。第一种技术是模板表示转换,显著降低匹配测试的单位成本。第二种是空间高效的编码,减少加密算法导致的浪费空间,从而减少对加密模板的操作次数。通过实验,我们表明\mathsf IDFace可在126ms内从包含1M加密模板的数据库中识别人脸模板,仅比明文识别多2倍开销。
abstract_en: As face recognition systems (FRS) become more widely used, user privacy becomes more important. A key privacy issue in FRS is protecting the user's face template, as the characteristics of the user's face image can be recovered from the template. Although recent advances in cryptographic tools such as homomorphic encryption (HE) have provided opportunities for securing the FRS, HE cannot be used directly with FRS in an efficient plug-and-play manner. In particular, although HE is functionally complete for arbitrary programs, it is basically designed for algebraic operations on encrypted data of predetermined shape, such as a polynomial ring. Thus, a non-tailored combination of HE and the system can yield very inefficient performance, and many previous HE-based face template protection methods are hundreds of times slower than plain systems without protection. In this study, we propose \mathsf IDFace , a new HE-based secure and efficient face identification method with template protection. \mathsf IDFace  is designed on the basis of two novel techniques for efficient searching on a (homomorphically encrypted) biometric database with an angular metric. The first technique is a template representation transformation that sharply reduces the unit cost for the matching test. The second is a space-efficient encoding that reduces wasted space from the encryption algorithm, thus saving the number of operations on encrypted templates. Through experiments, we show that \mathsf IDFace  can identify a face template from among a database of 1M encrypted templates in 126ms, showing only 2xoverhead compared to the identification over plaintexts.
authors: Sunpill Kim, Seunghun Paik, Chanwoo Hwang, Dongsoo Kim, Junbum Shin, Jae Hong Seo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13995-14005

title: IFAdapter: 基于实例的文本到图像生成中的特征控制
title_en: IFAdapter: Instance Feature Control for Grounded Text-to-Image Generation
abstract: 尽管文本到图像(T2I)扩散模型在生成单个实例的视觉吸引力图像方面表现出色,但它们在准确定位和控制多个实例的特征生成方面存在困难。为解决定位挑战,引入了布局到图像(L2I)任务,通过将边界框作为空间控制信号进行整合,但其在生成精确实例特征方面仍显不足。为应对这一实例特征生成(IFG)任务,我们提出实例特征适配器(IFAdapter)。IFAdapter通过引入额外的外观标记并利用实例语义图将实例级特征与空间位置对齐,从而增强特征描述。IFAdapter以即插即用模块的形式引导扩散过程,使其可适配于各类社区模型。在评估方面,我们贡献了一个IFG基准测试,并开发了验证流程以客观比较模型在生成具有准确定位和特征的实例方面的能力。实验结果表明,IFAdapter在定量和定性评估中均优于其他模型。
abstract_en: While Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion models excel at generating visually appealing images of individual instances, they struggle to accurately position and control the features generation of multiple instances. The Layout-to-Image (L2I) task was introduced to address the positioning challenges by incorporating bounding boxes as spatial control signals, but it still falls short in generating precise instance features. To address this Instance Feature Generation (IFG) task, we introduce the Instance Feature Adapter (IFAdapter). The IFAdapter enhances feature depiction by incorporating additional appearance tokens and utilizing an Instance Semantic Map to align instance-level features with spatial locations. The IFAdapter guides the diffusion process in a plug-and-play module, making it adaptable to various community models. For evaluation, we contribute an IFG benchmark and develop a verification pipeline to objectively compare models' abilities to generate instances with accurate positioning and features. Experimental results demonstrate that IFAdapter outperforms other models in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations.
authors: Yinwei Wu, Xianpan Zhou, Bing Ma, Xuefeng Su, Kai Ma, Xinchao Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15949-15959

title: IGD:基于多模态图层生成的指导性图形设计
title_en: IGD: Instructional Graphic Design with Multimodal Layer Generation
abstract: 图形设计通过创建和组合文本、图像和图形来视觉传达信息和数据。主要依赖布局生成的两阶段方法缺乏创造性和智能性,导致图形设计仍具有劳动密集型特征。现有基于扩散的方法在图像级别生成不可编辑的图形设计文件,且视觉文本渲染可读性差,难以实现令人满意的自动化图形设计。本文提出指令性图形设计师(IGD),仅通过自然语言指令即可快速生成具有可编辑灵活性的多模态图层。IGD采用新的范式,结合参数化渲染和图像资产生成。首先,我们开发设计平台并建立多场景设计文件的标准格式,为数据扩展奠定基础。其次,IGD利用MLLM的多模态理解和推理能力完成图层属性预测、排序和布局,并采用扩散模型生成图像资产内容。通过端到端训练,IGD在复杂图形设计任务中实现了架构上的可扩展性和可扩展性。优越的实验结果表明,IGD为图形设计提供了新的解决方案。
abstract_en: Graphic design visually conveys information and data by creating and combining text, images and graphics. Two-stage methods that rely primarily on layout generation lack creativity and intelligence, making graphic design still labor-intensive. Existing diffusion-based methods generate non-editable graphic design files at image level with poor legibility in visual text rendering, which prevents them from achieving satisfactory and practical automated graphic design. In this paper, we propose Instructional Graphic Designer (IGD) to swiftly generate multimodal layers with editable flexibility with only natural language instructions. IGD adopts a new paradigm that leverages parametric rendering and image asset generation. First, we develop a design platform and establish a standardized format for multi-scenario design files, thus laying the foundation for scaling up data. Second, IGD utilizes the multimodal understanding and reasoning capabilities of MLLM to accomplish attribute prediction, sequencing and layout of layers. It also employs a diffusion model to generate image content for assets. By enabling end-to-end training, IGD architecturally supports scalability and extensibility in complex graphic design tasks. The superior experimental results demonstrate that IGD offers a new solution for graphic design.
authors: Yadong Qu, Shancheng Fang, Yuxin Wang, Xiaorui Wang, Zhineng Chen, Hongtao Xie, Yongdong Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18218-18228

title: IGL-Nav:面向图像目标导航的增量三维高斯定位
title_en: IGL-Nav: Incremental 3D Gaussian Localization for Image-goal Navigation
abstract: 以图像为目标的视觉导航是一个基础且具有挑战性的问题。传统方法要么依赖端到端强化学习,要么采用基于模块的策略,以拓扑图或鸟瞰图地图作为记忆,无法充分建模探索的三维环境与目标图像之间的几何关系。为高效准确地在三维空间中定位目标图像,我们基于可渲染的三维高斯(3DGS)表示构建导航系统。然而,由于3DGS优化的计算强度和六自由度(6-DoF)相机姿态的庞大搜索空间,直接在智能体探索过程中利用3DGS进行图像定位效率极低。为此,我们提出IGL-Nav,一种面向高效且三维感知的图像目标导航的增量三维高斯定位框架。具体而言,我们通过前馈单目预测随新图像到达增量更新场景表示。随后,利用几何信息在离散空间中粗定位目标,该过程等价于高效的三维卷积。当智能体接近目标时,最终通过可微渲染优化求解精细目标姿态。所提出的IGL-Nav在多种实验配置中显著超越现有最先进方法,能够处理更具挑战性的自由视角图像目标设置,并可通过手机在任意姿态下捕获目标图像部署于真实世界机器人平台。项目页面:https://gwxuan.github.io/IGL-Nav/
abstract_en: Visual navigation with an image as goal is a fundamental and challenging problem. Conventional methods either rely on end-to-end RL learning or modular-based policy with topological graph or BEV map as memory, which cannot fully model the geometric relationship between the explored 3D environment and the goal image. In order to efficiently and accurately localize the goal image in 3D space, we build our navigation system upon the renderable 3D gaussian (3DGS) representation. However, due to the computational intensity of 3DGS optimization and the large search space of 6-DoF camera pose, directly leveraging 3DGS for image localization during agent exploration process is prohibitively inefficient. To this end, we propose IGL-Nav, an Incremental 3D Gaussian Localization framework for efficient and 3D-aware image-goal navigation. Specifically, we incrementally update the scene representation as new images arrive with feed-forward monocular prediction. Then we coarsely localize the goal by leveraging the geometric information for discrete space matching, which can be equivalent to efficient 3D convolution. When the agent is close to the goal, we finally solve the fine target pose with optimization via differentiable rendering. The proposed IGL-Nav outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods by a large margin across diverse experimental configurations. It can also handle the more challenging free-view image-goal setting and be deployed on real-world robotic platform using a cellphone to capture goal image at arbitrary pose. Project page: https://gwxuan.github.io/IGL-Nav/.
authors: Wenxuan Guo, Xiuwei Xu, Hang Yin, Ziwei Wang, Jianjiang Feng, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6808-6817

title: ILLUME:照亮你的LLMs以实现视觉理解、图像生成与自增强
title_en: ILLUME: Illuminating Your LLMs to See, Draw, and Self-Enhance
abstract: 本文介绍了ILLUME,一种统一的多模态大语言模型(MLLM),通过统一的下一个token预测框架,无缝整合多模态理解和生成能力。为应对图像-文本对齐通常需要的大规模数据集,我们通过设计融合语义信息的视觉分词器和渐进式多阶段训练流程提升数据效率。该方法将预训练所需数据集规模缩减至仅15M——比通常需求少四倍以上——同时在现有统一MLLM(如Janus)中表现出具有竞争力甚至更优的性能。此外,为促进理解与生成能力之间的协同增强(此前研究较少探索),我们引入了一种新颖的自增强多模态对齐方案。该方案通过监督MLLM自我评估文本描述与自生成图像的一致性,使模型更准确地解读图像并避免因生成对齐问题导致的不现实或错误预测。基于广泛实验,我们的ILLUME在多模态理解、生成和编辑的各类基准测试中表现突出,与最先进的统一MLLM和专用模型竞争。
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce ILLUME, a unified multimodal large language model (MLLM) that seamlessly integrates multimodal understanding and generation capabilities within a single large language model through a unified next-token prediction formulation.To address the large dataset size typically required for image-text alignment, we propose to enhance data efficiency through the design of a vision tokenizer that incorporates semantic information and a progressive multi-stage training procedure. This approach reduces the dataset size to just 15M for pretraining -- over four times fewer than what is typically needed -- while achieving competitive or even superior performance with existing unified MLLMs, such as Janus. Additionally, to promote synergistic enhancement between understanding and generation capabilities, which is under-explored in previous works, we introduce a novel self-enhancing multimodal alignment scheme. This scheme supervises the MLLM to self-assess the consistency between text descriptions and self-generated images, facilitating the model to interpret images more accurately and avoid unrealistic and incorrect predictions caused by misalignment in image generation. Based on our extensive experiments, our proposed ILLUME stands out and competes with state-of-the-art unified MLLMs and specialized models across various benchmarks for multimodal understanding, generation, and editing.
authors: Chunwei Wang, Guansong Lu, Junwei Yang, Runhui Huang, Jianhua Han, Lu Hou, Wei Zhang, Hang Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21612-21622

title: IM-LUT:用于图像超分辨率的插值混合查找表
title_en: IM-LUT: Interpolation Mixing Look-Up Tables for Image Super-Resolution
abstract: 超分辨率(SR)作为图像处理中的关键任务,旨在通过多种应用场景提升图像分辨率。近年来,基于查找表(LUT)的方法因其高效性和性能受到关注。然而,这些方法通常针对固定尺度因子设计,难以适用于任意尺度图像超分辨率(ASISR)。现有ASISR技术多采用隐式神经表示,但存在较高的计算成本和内存需求。为解决这些局限性,我们提出插值混合查找表(IM-LUT),一种新型框架通过学习融合多种插值函数以最大化其表示能力来实现ASISR。具体而言,我们引入IM-Net网络,该网络通过局部图像模式和目标尺度因子预测插值函数的混合权重。为提升插值方法的效率,IM-Net被转换为IM-LUT,其中通过查找表替代计算成本高昂的操作,实现轻量且快速的CPU推理同时保持重建质量。在多个基准数据集上的实验结果表明,IM-LUT在图像质量和效率之间实现了优于现有方法的优越平衡,凸显其在资源受限应用中的潜力。
abstract_en: Super-resolution (SR) has been a pivotal task in image processing, aimed at enhancing image resolution across various applications. Recently, look-up table (LUT)-based approaches have attracted interest due to their efficiency and performance. However, these methods are typically designed for fixed scale factors, making them unsuitable for arbitrary-scale image SR (ASISR). Existing ASISR techniques often employ implicit neural representations, which come with considerable computational cost and memory demands. To address these limitations, we propose Interpolation Mixing LUT (IM-LUT), a novel framework that operates ASISR by learning to blend multiple interpolation functions to maximize their representational capacity. Specifically, we introduce IM-Net, a network trained to predict mixing weights for interpolation functions based on local image patterns and the target scale factor. To enhance efficiency of interpolation-based methods, IM-Net is transformed into IM-LUT, where LUTs are employed to replace computationally expensive operations, enabling lightweight and fast inference on CPUs while preserving reconstruction quality. Experimental results on several benchmark datasets demonstrate that IM-LUT consistently achieves a superior balance between image quality and efficiency compared to existing methods, highlighting its potential as a promising solution for resource-constrained applications.
authors: Sejin Park, Sangmin Lee, Kyong Hwan Jin, Seung-Won Jung ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14317-14325

title: IM360:基于360度相机的大规模室内测绘
title_en: IM360: Large-scale Indoor Mapping with 360 Cameras
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的三维映射流程,用于大规模室内环境。为了解决大规模室内场景中的显著挑战,如普遍存在的遮挡和无纹理区域,我们提出了IM360,一种新颖的方法,利用全向图像的宽视场,并将球形相机模型整合到结构从运动(SfM)流程中。我们的SfM利用专门为360图像设计的密集匹配特征,在图像配准方面表现出卓越的能力。此外,借助基于网格的神经渲染技术,我们引入了一种纹理优化方法,通过结合漫反射和镜面反射成分,优化纹理映射并准确捕捉视图依赖属性。我们在大规模室内场景上评估了我们的流程,证明其在现实场景中的有效性。在实践中,IM360表现出卓越的性能,在纹理网格重建中实现了3.5 dB的PSNR提升。我们在Matterport3D和Stanford2D3D数据集上实现了相机定位和配准方面的最先进性能。
abstract_en: We present a novel 3D mapping pipeline for large-scale indoor environments. To address the significant challenges in large-scale indoor scenes, such as prevalent occlusions and textureless regions, we propose IM360, a novel approach that leverages the wide field of view of omnidirectional images and integrates the spherical camera model into the Structure-from-Motion (SfM) pipeline. Our SfM utilizes dense matching features specifically designed for 360 images, demonstrating superior capability in image registration. Furthermore, with the aid of mesh-based neural rendering techniques, we introduce a texture optimization method that refines texture maps and accurately captures view-dependent properties by combining diffuse and specular components. We evaluate our pipeline on large-scale indoor scenes, demonstrating its effectiveness in real-world scenarios. In practice, IM360 demonstrates superior performance, achieving a 3.5 PSNR increase in textured mesh reconstruction. We attain state-of-the-art performance in terms of camera localization and registration on Matterport3D and Stanford2D3D.
authors: Dongki Jung, Jaehoon Choi, Yonghan Lee, Dinesh Manocha ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 29040-29050

title: 基于隐式多模态引导的扩散模型校准方法:IMG
title_en: IMG: Calibrating Diffusion Models via Implicit Multimodal Guidance
