abstract: 在含噪声标签的情况下进行学习是训练准确深度神经网络的关键任务。为缓解标签噪声,先前的研究提出了各种鲁棒损失函数,特别是对称损失函数。然而,对称损失函数通常由于过于严格的约束而面临欠拟合问题。为解决这一问题,主动-被动损失(APL)联合优化主动损失和被动损失,以相互增强整体拟合能力。在APL中,对称损失函数已成功扩展,产生了先进的鲁棒损失函数。尽管取得了这些进展,新兴的理论分析表明,作为新型鲁棒损失函数的非对称损失函数相比对称损失函数具有更优的性质。然而,现有的非对称损失函数与先进的优化框架(如APL)不兼容,限制了其潜力和适用性。受这一理论差距及非对称损失函数前景的启发,我们将非对称损失函数扩展到更复杂的被动损失场景,并提出了一种新型非对称损失函数——非对称均方误差(AMSE)。我们严格建立了AMSE满足非对称条件的必要且充分条件。通过将APL中的传统对称被动损失替换为所提出的AMSE,我们引入了一种新的鲁棒损失框架,称为联合非对称损失(JAL)。大量实验验证了我们的方法在缓解标签噪声方面的有效性。代码地址:https://github.com/cswjl/joint-asymmetric-loss
abstract_en: Learning with noisy labels is a crucial task for training accurate deep neural networks. To mitigate label noise, prior studies have proposed various robust loss functions, particularly symmetric losses. Nevertheless, symmetric losses usually suffer from the underfitting issue due to the overly strict constraint. To address this problem, the Active Passive Loss (APL) jointly optimizes an active and a passive loss to mutually enhance the overall fitting ability. Within APL, symmetric losses have been successfully extended, yielding advanced robust loss functions. Despite these advancements, emerging theoretical analyses indicate that asymmetric losses, a new class of robust loss functions, possess superior properties compared to symmetric losses. However, existing asymmetric losses are not compatible with advanced optimization frameworks such as APL, limiting their potential and applicability. Motivated by this theoretical gap and the prospect of asymmetric losses, we extend the asymmetric loss to the more complex passive loss scenario and propose the Asymetric Mean Square Error (AMSE), a novel asymmetric loss. We rigorously establish the necessary and sufficient condition under which AMSE satisfies the asymmetric condition. By substituting the traditional symmetric passive loss in APL with our proposed AMSE, we introduce a novel robust loss framework termed Joint Asymmetric Loss (JAL). Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in mitigating label noise. Code available at: https://github.com/cswjl/joint-asymmetric-loss
authors: Jialiang Wang, Xianming Liu, Xiong Zhou, Gangfeng Hu, Deming Zhai, Junjun Jiang, Xiangyang Ji ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1947-1956

title: 持续学习中的联合扩散模型
title_en: Joint Diffusion Models in Continual Learning
abstract: 在本文中,我们引入了JDCL——一种基于联合扩散模型的生成重放持续学习新方法。神经网络在重新训练时会遭受灾难性遗忘问题,即当使用来自不同分布的额外数据时,模型性能会突然下降。基于生成重放的持续学习方法通过结合新数据和从生成模型中采样的重放数据来重新训练模型,以缓解这一问题。在本文中,我们提出通过将持续训练的分类器与基于扩散的生成模型结合到单一的联合优化神经网络中,扩展这一思路。我们证明,这种共享参数化结合知识蒸馏技术,能够在不出现灾难性遗忘的情况下实现对新任务的稳定适应。我们在多个基准测试中评估了我们的方法,结果优于近期最先进的生成重放技术。此外,我们将方法扩展到半监督持续学习设置中,在此设置下优于竞争的缓冲区重放技术,并以自监督方式评估了训练表示的质量。
abstract_en: In this work, we introduce JDCL - a new method for continual learning with generative rehearsal based on joint diffusion models. Neural networks suffer from catastrophic forgetting defined as abrupt loss in the model's performance when retrained with additional data coming from a different distribution. Generative-replay-based continual learning methods try to mitigate this issue by retraining a model with a combination of new and rehearsal data sampled from a generative model. In this work, we propose to extend this idea by combining a continually trained classifier with a diffusion-based generative model into a single - jointly optimized neural network. We show that such shared parametrization, combined with the knowledge distillation technique allows for stable adaptation to new tasks without catastrophic forgetting. We evaluate our approach on several benchmarks, where it outperforms recent state-of-the-art generative replay techniques. Additionally, we extend our method to the semi-supervised continual learning setup, where it outperforms competing buffer-based replay techniques, and evaluate, in a self-supervised manner, the quality of trained representations.
authors: Paweł Skierś, Kamil Deja ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4380-4390

title: 基于分数缩放采样的姿态回归与去噪扩散联合学习用于类别级6D姿态估计
title_en: Joint Learning of Pose Regression and Denoising Diffusion with Score Scaling Sampling for Category-level 6D Pose Estimation
abstract: 最新扩散模型通过深度图像输入建模条件姿态分布,在类别级6D物体姿态估计中展现出 promising results(有前景的结果)。然而现有方法在训练过程中收敛速度缓慢,以端到端方式学习其编码器与扩散去噪网络,并需要额外网络评估采样姿态假设以过滤低质量姿态候选。本文提出一种新型流程,通过两个关键组件解决这些局限性。首先,所提方法以直接姿态回归头预训练编码器,并通过回归头与去噪扩散头联合学习网络,显著加速训练收敛同时实现更高精度。其次,提出基于时间依赖分数缩放的采样引导,有效平衡探索-利用权衡,消除额外评估网络需求。该采样引导在早期去噪步骤保持对称物体的多模态特性,同时确保最终步骤生成高质量姿态。在包含REAL275、HouseCat6D和ROPE等多个基准的大量实验中,所提方法(简单而有效)即使在单姿态推理下也实现最先进精度,且在训练和推理效率上更具优势。
abstract_en: Latest diffusion models have shown promising results in category-level 6D object pose estimation by modeling the conditional pose distribution with depth image input. The existing methods, however, suffer from slow convergence during training, learning its encoder with the diffusion denoising network in end-to-end fashion, and require an additional network that evaluates sampled pose hypotheses to filter out low-quality pose candidates. In this paper, we propose a novel pipeline that tackles these limitations by two key components. First, the proposed method pre-trains the encoder with the direct pose regression head, and jointly learns the networks via the regression head and the denoising diffusion head, significantly accelerating training convergence while achieving higher accuracy. Second, sampling guidance via time-dependent score scaling is proposed s.t. the exploration-exploitation trade-off is effectively taken, eliminating the need for the additional evaluation network. The sampling guidance maintains multi-modal characteristics of symmetric objects at early denoising steps while ensuring high-quality pose generation at final steps. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks including REAL275, HouseCat6D, and ROPE, demonstrate that the proposed method, simple yet effective, achieves state-of-the-art accuracies even with single-pose inference, while being more efficient in both training and inference.
authors: Seunghyun Lee, Tae-Kyun Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5757-5768

title: 联合自监督视频对齐与动作分割
title_en: Joint Self-Supervised Video Alignment and Action Segmentation
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于统一最优传输框架的新型方法,用于同时进行自监督视频对齐和动作分割。具体而言,我们首先通过开发一种融合Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输公式并结合结构先验的方法来解决自监督视频对齐问题,该方法可在GPU上高效训练,仅需少量迭代即可求解最优传输问题。我们的单任务方法在多个视频对齐基准测试中达到了最先进的性能,并优于依赖传统Kantorovich最优传输公式与最优性先验的VAVA方法。此外,我们通过提出一个统一的最优传输框架扩展了该方法,用于联合自监督视频对齐和动作分割,该方法只需训练和存储单一模型,相比两个不同的单任务模型在时间和内存消耗上均有显著节省。在多个视频对齐和动作分割数据集上的广泛评估表明,我们的多任务方法在视频对齐方面与先前方法表现相当,而在动作分割方面取得了更优的结果。最后,据我们所知,这是首个将视频对齐与动作分割统一到单一模型中的工作。
abstract_en: We introduce a novel approach for simultaneous self-supervised video alignment and action segmentation based on a unified optimal transport framework. In particular, we first tackle self-supervised video alignment by developing a fused Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport formulation with a structural prior, which trains efficiently on GPUs and needs only a few iterations for solving the optimal transport problem. Our single-task method achieves the state-of-the-art performance on multiple video alignment benchmarks and outperforms VAVA, which relies on a traditional Kantorovich optimal transport formulation with an optimality prior. Furthermore, we extend our approach by proposing a unified optimal transport framework for joint self-supervised video alignment and action segmentation, which requires training and storing a single model and saves both time and memory consumption as compared to two different single-task models. Extensive evaluations on several video alignment and action segmentation datasets demonstrate that our multi-task method achieves comparable video alignment yet superior action segmentation results over previous methods in video alignment and action segmentation respectively. Finally, to the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to unify video alignment and action segmentation into a single model.
authors: Ali Shah Ali, Syed Ahmed Mahmood, Mubin Saeed, Andrey Konin, M. Zeeshan Zia, Quoc-Huy Tran ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10807-10818

title: 基于各向异性局部编码的三维高斯建模联合语义与渲染增强
title_en: Joint Semantic and Rendering Enhancements in 3D Gaussian Modeling with Anisotropic Local Encoding
abstract: 近期研究提出通过引入语义特征向量扩展三维高斯模型(3DGS),以实现语义分割与图像渲染的同步。然而,这些方法通常将语义与渲染分支独立处理,仅依赖二维监督信号而忽视三维高斯几何特性。此外,现有自适应策略仅依据渲染梯度调整高斯集,这在细节区域或无纹理区域可能表现不足。本文提出一种联合增强框架,用于三维语义高斯建模,协同优化语义与渲染分支。首先,不同于传统点云形状编码,我们引入基于拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米算子的各向异性三维高斯切比雪夫描述符,以捕捉细粒度三维形状细节,从而区分外观相似的对象并减少对潜在噪声二维引导的依赖。此外,不依赖于仅渲染梯度,我们通过局部语义与形状信号自适应调整高斯分配及球面调和函数(SH),通过选择性资源分配提升渲染效率。最后,我们采用跨场景知识迁移模块持续更新学习到的形状模式,实现无需从头学习场景信息即可加速收敛并获得鲁棒表示。在多个数据集上的实验表明,该方法在分割精度和渲染质量方面取得提升,同时保持高渲染帧率。
abstract_en: Recent works propose extending 3DGS with semantic feature vectors for simultaneous semantic segmentation and image rendering. However, these methods often treat the semantic and rendering branches separately, relying solely on 2D supervision while ignoring the 3D Gaussian geometry. Moreover, current adaptive strategies adapt the Gaussian set depending solely on rendering gradients, which can be insufficient in subtle or textureless regions. In this work, we propose a joint enhancement framework for 3D semantic Gaussian modeling that synergizes both semantic and rendering branches. Firstly, unlike conventional point cloud shape encoding, we introduce an anisotropic 3D Gaussian Chebyshev descriptor using the Laplace-Beltrami operator to capture fine-grained 3D shape details, thereby distinguishing objects with similar appearances and reducing reliance on potentially noisy 2D guidance. In addition, without relying solely on rendering gradient, we adaptively adjust Gaussian allocation and spherical harmonics (SH) with local semantic and shape signals, enhancing rendering efficiency through selective resource allocation. Finally, we employ a cross-scene knowledge transfer module to continuously update learned shape patterns, enabling faster convergence and robust representations without relearning shape information from scratch for each new scene. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate improvements in segmentation accuracy and rendering quality while maintaining high rendering frame rates.
authors: Jingming He, Chongyi Li, Shiqi Wang, Sam Kwong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28354-28363

title: JointDiT: 通过扩散变换器增强RGB-深度联合建模
title_en: JointDiT: Enhancing RGB-Depth Joint Modeling with Diffusion Transformers
abstract: 我们提出JointDiT,一种能够建模RGB和深度联合分布的扩散变换器。通过利用当前最先进的扩散变换器的架构优势和卓越的图像先验,JointDiT不仅能够生成高保真图像,还能生成几何上合理且精确的深度图。我们提出了两种简单而有效的技术,实现了坚实的联合分布建模,即:基于各模态噪声水平的自适应调度权重,以及不平衡时间步采样策略。通过这些技术,我们针对每个模态的所有噪声水平训练模型,使JointDiT能够自然处理各种组合生成任务,包括联合生成、深度估计和深度条件图像生成,只需简单控制各分支的时间步即可。JointDiT在联合生成任务中表现出色。此外,在深度估计和深度条件图像生成中也取得了可比的结果,表明联合分布建模可以作为条件生成的可替代方案。
abstract_en: We present JointDiT, a diffusion transformer that models the joint distribution of RGB and depth. By leveraging the architectural benefit and outstanding image prior of the state-of-the-art diffusion transformer, JointDiT not only generates high-fidelity images but also produces geometrically plausible and accurate depth maps. This solid joint distribution modeling is achieved through two simple yet effective techniques that we propose, i.e., adaptive scheduling weights, which depend on the noise levels of each modality, and the unbalanced timestep sampling strategy. With these techniques, we train our model across all noise levels for each modality, enabling JointDiT to naturally handle various combinatorial generation tasks, including joint generation, depth estimation, and depth-conditioned image generation by simply controlling the timesteps of each branch. JointDiT demonstrates outstanding joint generation performance. Furthermore, it achieves comparable results in depth estimation and depth-conditioned image generation, suggesting that joint distribution modeling can serve as a replaceable alternative to conditional generation.
authors: Kwon Byung-Ki, Qi Dai, Lee Hyoseok, Chong Luo, Tae-Hyun Oh ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25261-25271

title: KDA:基于增强上下文的知识扩散对齐视频时序定位
title_en: KDA: Knowledge Diffusion Alignment with Enhanced Context for Video Temporal Grounding
abstract: 视频时序定位(Video Temporal Grounding, VTG)面临弥合简洁文本查询与视频内容丰富复杂性之间语义鸿沟的挑战,这一问题进一步被缺乏显式目标线索时捕捉判别特征的困难所加剧。为解决这些挑战,我们提出知识扩散对齐(Knowledge Diffusion Alignment, KDA)框架,该框架利用扩散模型的生成能力。KDA引入多层视频知识提取模块与背景残差扩散模型,后者通过渐进式修剪全局视频特征中的无关背景信息,从而提炼出富含视觉上下文的查询相关时刻知识。通过结合标注时刻引导的三阶段训练方法,KDA确保提取的时刻知识包含实现精准定位所需的判别特征。知识提示推理模块促进时刻知识与多模态特征的全面交互与利用。此外,我们引入跨度增强解码器,该解码器选择性整合多模态特征中的跨度信息,利用内在对齐线索。在三个数据集上的综合实验表明,所提框架的性能超越了现有最先进方法,验证了其有效性。
abstract_en: Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) confronts the challenge of bridging the semantic gap between concise textual queries and the rich complexity of video content, further compounded by the difficulty of capturing discriminative features without explicit target cues. To address these challenges, we propose Knowledge Diffusion Alignment (KDA), a framework that leverages the generative prowess of diffusion models. KDA introduces a multi-layer video knowledge extraction module alongside a background residual diffusion model that progressively prunes irrelevant background information from global video features, thereby distilling query-relevant moment knowledge enriched with visual context. By a three-stage training approach that harnesses annotated moment guidance, KDA guarantees that the extracted moment knowledge incorporates the discriminative features necessary for accurate localization. A knowledge prompt reasoning module facilitates the comprehensive interaction and utilization of moment knowledge and multimodal features. Moreover, we introduce a spans-enhanced decoder that selectively integrates spans from multi-modal features, capitalizing on intrinsic alignment cues. Comprehensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate performance that surpasses state-of-the-art methods, attesting to the effectiveness of the proposed framework.
authors: Ran Ran, Jiwei Wei, Shiyuan He, Zeyu Ma, Chaoning Zhang, Ning Xie, Yang Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23311-23320

title: KOEnsAttack:通过知识正交化替代模型集成实现高效的无数据黑盒对抗攻击
title_en: KOEnsAttack: Towards Efficient Data-Free Black-Box Adversarial Attacks via Knowledge-Orthogonalized Substitute Ensembles
abstract: 无数据黑盒攻击旨在在不接触模型参数或训练数据的情况下攻击模型。现有方法使用生成器合成训练样本,然后训练替代模型以模仿目标模型。最终通过替代模型生成对抗样本(AEs)并迁移至目标模型。为此,如何为替代模型训练生成多样化训练样本以及提升替代模型到目标模型的对抗样本迁移性成为核心挑战。本文提出一种知识正交化集成攻击方法,称为KOEnsAttack,以实现这两个目标。我们首先使用双网络作为集成替代模型,然后提出样本硬度增强方法,将生成器生成的样本转化为存在于双模型争议区域的硬样本,以促进样本多样性。接下来,在替代模型训练过程中,我们设计知识正交化模块,引导双网络从黑盒中学习互补且有用的信息,从而增强最终集成模型生成的对抗样本的迁移性。在多个数据集上进行了大量实验以评估所提方法的有效性。实验结果表明,所提方法相比现有先进方法具有更优性能。
abstract_en: Data-free black-box attacks aim to attack a model without access to either the model parameters or training data. Existing methods use a generator to synthesize training samples and then train a substitute model to imitate the victim model. The adversarial examples (AEs) are finally generated using the substitute model to transfer to the victim model. To this end, how to generate diverse training samples for substitute model training and improve the transferability of AEs from the substitute model to victim model become the core challenges. In this paper, we propose a Knowledge-Orthogonalized Ensemble Attack, dubbed KOEnsAttack, to accomplish these two goals. We first use dual networks as the ensemble substitute model, and then propose a sample hardness enhancement to transform the samples from the generator into hard samples that exist in the controversial regions of the dual models for promoting the sample diversity. Next, during the substitute model training, we design a knowledge orthogonalization module to guide the dual networks in learning complementary and useful information from the black-box, thereby enhancing the transferability of adversarial samples generated on the final ensemble model. Extensive experiments on several datasets are conducted to evaluate the effectiveness of our method. The results show that the proposed method can achieve superior performance compared with the state-of-the-art competitors.
authors: Chaoyong Yang, Jia-Li Yin, Bin Chen, Zhaozhe Hu, Xiaolei Liu, Wei Lin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3101-3110

title: KV-Edit:无需训练的图像编辑方法,实现精确背景保持
title_en: KV-Edit: Training-Free Image Editing for Precise Background Preservation
abstract: 背景一致性仍是图像编辑任务中的重大挑战。尽管已有大量研究进展,现有方法仍需在保持与原图相似性与生成符合目标内容之间进行权衡。本文提出KV-Edit,一种无需训练的编辑方法,通过在DiT中使用键值缓存(KV cache)维持背景一致性,其中背景标记被保留而非重新生成,消除了对复杂机制或昂贵训练的需求,最终在用户指定区域内生成与背景无缝融合的新内容。我们进一步研究了编辑过程中键值缓存的内存消耗,并通过无需反向的方法将空间复杂度从O(N)优化至O(1)。我们的方法兼容任何基于DiT的生成模型,无需额外训练。实验表明,KV-Edit在背景质量和图像质量方面均显著优于现有方法,甚至超越了基于训练的方法。
abstract_en: Background consistency remains a significant challenge in image editing tasks. Despite extensive developments, existing works still face a trade-off between maintaining similarity to the original image and generating content that aligns with the target. Here, we propose KV-Edit, a training-free approach that uses KV cache in DiTs to maintain background consistency, where background tokens are preserved rather than regenerated, eliminating the need for complex mechanisms or expensive training, ultimately generating new content that seamlessly integrates with the background within user-provided regions. We further explore the memory consumption of KV cache during editing and optimize the space complexity from O(N) to O(1) using an inversion-free method. Our approach is compatible with any DiT-based generative model without additional training. Experiments demonstrate that KV-Edit significantly outperforms existing approaches in terms of both background and image quality, even surpassing training-based methods.
authors: Tianrui Zhu, Shiyi Zhang, Jiawei Shao, Yansong Tang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16607-16617

title: 多折径向对称纹理背景攻击:干扰姿态估计的新型方法
title_en: Kaleidoscopic Background Attack: Disrupting Pose Estimation with Multi-Fold Radial Symmetry Textures
abstract: 相机姿态估计是计算机视觉的基础任务,对于视觉定位和多视角立体重建等应用至关重要。在稀疏输入的物体中心场景中,背景纹理在不同视角下占据图像主要部分,对姿态估计的准确性产生显著影响。鉴于此,我们提出了一种名为Kaleidoscopic Background Attack(KBA)的新型攻击方法,通过相同片段形成具有多折径向对称性的圆盘。这些圆盘在不同视角下保持高度相似性,即使使用自然纹理片段也能有效攻击姿态估计模型。此外,我们提出了一种投影方向一致性损失函数来优化Kaleidoscopic片段,显著提升了攻击效果。实验结果表明,经过优化的对抗性Kaleidoscopic背景能够有效攻击各类相机姿态估计模型。
abstract_en: Camera pose estimation is a fundamental computer vision task that is essential for applications like visual localization and multi-view stereo reconstruction. In the object-centric scenarios with sparse inputs, the accuracy of pose estimation can be significantly influenced by background textures that occupy major portions of the images across different viewpoints. In light of this, we introduce the Kaleidoscopic Background Attack (KBA), which uses identical segments to form discs with multi-fold radial symmetry. These discs maintain high similarity across different viewpoints, enabling effective attacks on pose estimation models even with natural texture segments. Additionally, a projected orientation consistency loss is proposed to optimize the kaleidoscopic segments, leading to a significant enhancement in the attack effectiveness. Experimental results show that optimized adversarial kaleidoscopic backgrounds can effectively attack various camera pose estimation models.
authors: Xinlong Ding, Hongwei Yu, Jiawei Li, Feifan Li, Yu Shang, Bochao Zou, Huimin Ma, Jiansheng Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28483-28492

title: Kaputt:面向视觉缺陷检测的大规模数据集
title_en: Kaputt: A Large-Scale Dataset for Visual Defect Detection
abstract: 我们提出了一种新型的大规模数据集,用于物流场景中的缺陷检测。近期的工业异常检测研究主要聚焦于制造场景,这些场景具有高度控制的姿态和有限的物体类别。现有基准数据集如MVTec-AD(Bergmann等,2021)和VisA(Zou等,2022)已达到饱和,最先进的方法在AUROC评分上可达99.9%。与制造场景不同,零售物流中的异常检测面临新的挑战,特别是物体姿态和外观的多样性和变化性。当前领先的异常检测方法在该新场景下表现不佳。为弥合这一差距,我们引入了一个新的基准数据集,克服了现有数据集的局限性。该数据集包含超过23万张图像(超过2.9万个缺陷实例),规模是MVTec的40倍,包含超过4.8万个不同物体。为验证问题的难度,我们对多种最先进的异常检测方法进行了广泛评估,证明它们在我们的数据集上AUROC评分不超过56.96%。进一步的定性分析证实,现有方法在姿态和外观变化较大的情况下难以有效利用正常样本。借助我们的大规模数据集,我们设定了新的基准,并鼓励未来针对零售物流异常检测这一具有挑战性问题的研究。该数据集可在https://www.kaputt-dataset.com下载。
abstract_en: We present a novel large-scale dataset for defect detection in a logistics setting. Recent work on industrial anomaly detection has primarily focused on manufacturing scenarios with highly controlled poses and a limited number of object categories. Existing benchmarks like MVTec-AD (Bergmann et al., 2021) and VisA (Zou et al., 2022) have reached saturation, with state-of-the-art methods achieving up to 99.9% AUROC scores. In contrast to manufacturing, anomaly detection in retail logistics faces new challenges, particularly in the diversity and variability of object pose and appearance. Leading anomaly detection methods fall short when applied to this new setting. To bridge this gap, we introduce a new benchmark that overcomes the current limitations of existing datasets. With over 230,000 images (and more than 29,000 defective instances), it is 40 times larger than MVTec and contains more than 48,000 distinct objects. To validate the difficulty of the problem, we conduct an extensive evaluation of multiple state-of-the-art anomaly detection methods, demonstrating that they do not surpass 56.96% AUROC on our dataset. Further qualitative analysis confirms that existing methods struggle to leverage normal samples under heavy pose and appearance variation. With our large-scale dataset, we set a new benchmark and encourage future research towards solving this challenging problem in retail logistics anomaly detection. The dataset is available for download under https://www.kaputt-dataset.com.
authors: Sebastian Höfer, Dorian F. Henning, Artemij Amiranashvili, Douglas Morrison, Mariliza Tzes, Ingmar Posner, Marc Matvienko, Alessandro Rennola, Anton Milan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24224-24233

title: 保持朋友近在咫尺,敌人远在天涯:面向半监督多器官分割的距离感知体素级对比学习
title_en: Keep Your Friends Close, and Your Enemies Farther: Distance-aware Voxel-wise Contrastive Learning for Semi-supervised Multi-organ Segmentation
abstract: 基于伪标签,体素级对比学习(VCL)是一种突出的方法,旨在为半监督医学图像分割学习有效的特征表示。然而,在多器官分割(MoS)中,某些器官复杂的解剖结构常导致大量不可靠的伪标签。直接应用VCL可能引入确认偏误,导致分割性能下降。常见做法是将这些不可靠伪标签转换为互补标签,表示体素最不可能所属的类别,然后将体素远离生成的互补标签。但我们发现,这种方法可能无法让具有不可靠伪标签的体素(不可靠体素)充分受益于VCL的优势。本文提出DVCL,一种面向半监督MoS的新型距离感知VCL方法。DVCL基于观察:不可靠体素虽可能无法形成判别性特征边界,但仍形成清晰聚类。因此,特征空间中相近的体素("邻居")可能属于同一语义类别,而相距较远的体素("外来者")可能属于不同类别。在DVCL中,我们首先为所有不可靠体素识别邻居和外来者,然后将邻居拉近同一聚类,将外来者推远。这样,不可靠体素可学习更判别的特征,从而充分享受VCL的优势。然而,DVCL本身不可避免引入噪声邻居和异常值问题。为解决这些挑战,我们进一步提出邻居划分策略和查询异常值策略,为DVCL提供更稳定的特征表示。大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Based on pseudo-labels, voxel-wise contrastive learning (VCL) is a prominent approach designed to learn effective feature representations for semi-supervised medical image segmentation. However, in multi-organ segmentation (MoS), the complex anatomical structures of certain organs often lead to many unreliable pseudo-labels. Directly applying VCL can introduce confirmation bias, resulting in poor segmentation performance. A common practice is to first transform these unreliable pseudo-labels into complementary ones, which represent classes that voxels are least likely to belong to, and then push voxels away from the generated complementary labels. However, we find that this approach may fail to allow voxels with unreliable pseudo-labels (unreliable voxels) to fully benefit from the advantages of VCL. In this paper, we propose DVCL, a novel distance-aware VCL method for semi-supervised MoS. DVCL is based on the observation that unreliable voxels, which may not form discriminative feature boundaries, still form clear clusters. Hence, voxels close to each other in the feature space ('neighbors') likely belong to the same semantic class, while distant ones ('outsiders') likely belong to different classes. In DVCL, we first identify neighbors and outsiders for all unreliable voxels, and then pull their neighbors into the same clusters while pushing outsiders away. In this way, unreliable voxels can learn more discriminative features, thereby fully enjoying the advantages of VCL. However, DVCL itself will inevitably introduce the problem of noisy neighbors and outliers. To address these challenges, we further propose a neighbor partitioning strategy and a query outlier strategy to provide more stable feature representations for DVCL. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
authors: Haochen Zhao, Jianwei Niu, Xuefeng Liu, Xiaozheng Xie, Li Kuang, Haotian Yang, Bin Dai, Hui Meng, Yong Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21832-21842

title: Kestrel: 三维多模态大语言模型用于部件感知的定位描述
title_en: Kestrel: 3D Multimodal LLM for Part-Aware Grounded Description
abstract: 本文提出Part-Aware Point Grounded Description (PaPGD),这是一个旨在推动细粒度、部件感知分割定位与三维物体详细解释的具有挑战性的任务。现有三维数据集主要关注单一视觉部件分割或视觉-语言场景分割,缺乏机器人在现实环境中导航与交互所需的细粒度多模态分割。为解决这一问题,我们提出了3DCoMPaT Grounded Instructions (3DCoMPaT-GrIn)数据集,这是一个全面资源,将丰富的点云描述与对应的部件级分割掩码进行配对。该数据集包含大量样本,适用于PaPGD任务和细粒度单部件定位任务。为应对部件级定位与生成定位描述的固有挑战,我们提出Kestrel,一个部件感知的三维多模态大语言模型,通过集成先进的语言模型进行细腻的语言理解,结合多级点特征传播与查询优化机制,增强部件级空间推理能力。大量实验表明,Kestrel有效弥合了部件感知语言理解与三维分割定位之间的鸿沟,为满足现实机器人应用需求的更 robust 且可解释的三维物体理解奠定了基础。
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce Part-Aware Point Grounded Description (PaPGD), a challenging task aimed at advancing 3D multimodal learning for fine-grained, part-aware segmentation grounding and detailed explanation of 3D objects. Existing 3D datasets largely focus on either vision-only part segmentation or vision-language scene segmentation, lacking the fine-grained multimodal segmentation needed for robotic navigation and interaction in real-world environments. To address this gap, we present the 3DCoMPaT Grounded Instructions (3DCoMPaT-GrIn) Dataset, a comprehensive resource that pairs rich point cloud descriptions with corresponding part-level segmentation masks. This dataset encompasses extensive samples designed for both PaPGD and fine-grained single-part grounding tasks. To tackle the inherent challenges of grounding objects and generating grounded descriptions at the part level, we propose Kestrel, a part-aware 3D multimodal large language model that integrates an advanced language model for nuanced language comprehension with multi-level point feature propagation and query refinement mechanism to enhance spatial reasoning at the part level. The extensive experiments demonstrate that Kestrel effectively bridges the gap between part-aware language understanding and 3D segmentation grounding, paving the way for more robust and interpretable 3D object comprehension that meets the demands of real-world robotic applications.
authors: Mahmoud Ahmed, Junjie Fei, Jian Ding, Eslam Mohamed Bakr, Mohamed Elhoseiny ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8973-8983

title: 基于关键帧的视觉标记修剪:提升大视觉语言模型在长视频处理中的效率
title_en: Keyframe-oriented Vision Token Pruning: Enhancing Efficiency of Large Vision Language Models on Long-Form Video Processing
abstract: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在联合处理视觉和文本数据方面展现出强大能力。然而,由于冗余视觉信息,特别是在长视频场景中,它们往往会产生显著的计算开销。现有方法主要聚焦于视觉标记修剪(可能忽略时空依赖性)或关键帧选择(识别信息帧但丢弃其他帧,从而破坏上下文连续性)。在本工作中,我们提出KVTP(基于关键帧的视觉标记修剪),一种新型框架,克服了标记修剪和关键帧选择的缺陷。通过根据查询帧的相关性自适应分配修剪率,KVTP有效保留了关键上下文信息,同时显著减少冗余计算。为全面评估VLMs的长视频理解能力,我们将VideoMME、EgoSchema和NextQA的数据集子集整理为统一基准SparseKV-QA,突出真实场景中稀疏但关键的事件。我们的实验表明,KVTP可在不损害时空和上下文一致性的情况下,将标记使用量减少80%,显著降低计算成本同时保持性能。这些结果验证了我们的方法在高效长视频处理中的有效性,促进了更大规模VLM的部署。
abstract_en: Vision language models (VLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities in jointly processing visual and textual data. However, they often incur substantial computational overhead due to redundant visual information, particularly in long-form video scenarios. Existing approaches predominantly focus on either vision token pruning, which may overlook spatio-temporal dependencies, or keyframe selection, which identifies informative frames but discards others, thus disrupting contextual continuity. In this work, we propose KVTP (Keyframe-oriented Vision Token Pruning), a novel framework that overcomes the drawbacks of token pruning and keyframe selection. By adaptively assigning pruning rates based on frame relevance to the query, KVTP effectively retains essential contextual information while significantly reducing redundant computation. To thoroughly evaluate the long-form video understanding capacities of VLMs, we curated and reorganized subsets from VideoMME, EgoSchema, and NextQA into a unified benchmark named SparseKV-QA that highlights real-world scenarios with sparse but crucial events. Our experiments with VLMs of various scales show that KVTP can reduce token usage by 80% without compromising spatiotemporal and contextual consistency, significantly cutting computation while maintaining the performance. These results demonstrate our approach's effectiveness in efficient long-video processing, facilitating more scalable VLM deployment.
authors: Yudong Liu, Jingwei Sun, Yueqian Lin, Jianyi Zhang, Jingyang Zhang, Ming Yin, Qinsi Wang, Hai Li, Yiran Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20802-20811

title: KinMo:运动学感知的人类运动理解与生成
title_en: KinMo: Kinematic-aware Human Motion Understanding and Generation
abstract: 当前人类运动合成框架依赖于全局动作描述,造成模态间隙,限制了运动理解和生成能力。单一粗粒度描述(如"run")无法捕捉速度变化、肢体定位和运动学动态等关键细节,导致文本与运动模态间存在显著歧义。为解决这一挑战,我们提出KinMo,一个基于层次化可描述运动表示的统一框架,通过引入运动学群体运动及其交互,超越了传统全局动作描述。我们设计自动化标注流程生成高质量细粒度描述,构建KinMo数据集。为利用这些结构化描述,我们提出层次化文本-运动对齐方法,通过整合额外运动细节提升空间理解能力。此外,我们引入由粗到细的生成流程,展示增强空间理解对运动合成的促进作用。实验结果表明,KinMo显著提升了运动理解能力,体现在文本-运动检索性能的提升,并实现了更细粒度的运动生成与编辑能力。项目页面:https://andypinxinliu.github.io/KinMo
abstract_en: Current human motion synthesis frameworks rely on global action descriptions, creating a modality gap that limits both motion understanding and generation capabilities. A single coarse description, such as "run", fails to capture essential details like variations in speed, limb positioning, and kinematic dynamics, leading to significant ambiguities between text and motion modalities. To address this challenge, we introduce KinMo, a unified framework built on a hierarchical describable motion representation that extends beyond global action by incorporating kinematic group movements and their interactions.We design an automated annotation pipeline to generate high-quality, fine-grained descriptions for this decomposition, resulting in the KinMo dataset. To leverage these structured descriptions, we propose Hierarchical Text-Motion Alignment, improving spatial understanding by integrating additional motion details. Furthermore, we introduce a coarse-to-fine generation procedure to demonstrate how enhanced spatial understanding benefits motion synthesis. Experimental results show that KinMo significantly improves motion understanding, demonstrated by enhanced text-motion retrieval performance and enabling more fine-grained motion generation and editing capabilities. Project Page: https://andypinxinliu.github.io/KinMo
authors: Pengfei Zhang, Pinxin Liu, Pablo Garrido, Hyeongwoo Kim, Bindita Chaudhuri ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11187-11197

title: Know "No" Better: 一种提升CLIP否定意识的数据驱动方法
title_en: Know "No" Better: A Data-Driven Approach for Enhancing Negation Awareness in CLIP
abstract: 尽管CLIP通过连接视觉与语言显著推进了多模态理解,但其无法把握否定概念(如无法区分"parking"与"no parking")这一缺陷仍带来重大挑战。通过分析公开CLIP模型预训练所用数据,我们提出该局限源于缺乏包含否定信息的数据。为解决此问题,我们引入数据生成管道,利用大语言模型(LLM)和多模态大语言模型生成包含否定信息的描述。通过使用我们生成的数据对CLIP进行微调,我们开发了NegationCLIP,在增强否定意识的同时保持模型的通用性。此外,为实现对否定理解能力的全面评估,我们提出NegRefCOCOg基准测试,专门用于检验视觉语言模型对句子中不同表达形式和位置的否定理解能力。在多种CLIP架构上的实验验证了我们数据生成管道提升CLIP准确感知否定能力的有效性。此外,NegationCLIP增强的否定意识在各类多模态任务中具有实际应用价值,这在文本到图像生成和指称图像分割任务中得到了性能提升的验证。
abstract_en: While CLIP has significantly advanced multimodal understanding by bridging vision and language, the inability to grasp negation -- such as failing to differentiate concepts like "parking" from "no parking" -- poses substantial challenges.By analyzing the data used in the public CLIP model's pre-training, we posit this limitation stems from a lack of negation-inclusive data.To address this, we introduce data generation pipelines that employ a large language model (LLM) and a multimodal LLM to produce negation-inclusive captions.Fine-tuning CLIP with data generated from our pipelines, we develop NegationCLIP, which enhances negation awareness while preserving the generality.Moreover, to enable a comprehensive evaluation of negation understanding, we propose NegRefCOCOg--a benchmark tailored to test VLMs' ability to interpret negation across diverse expressions and positions within a sentence.Experiments on various CLIP architectures validate the effectiveness of our data generation pipelines in enhancing CLIP's ability to perceive negation accurately.Additionally, NegationCLIP's enhanced negation awareness has practical applications across various multimodal tasks, demonstrated by performance gains in text-to-image generation and referring image segmentation.
authors: Junsung Park, Jungbeom Lee, Jongyoon Song, Sangwon Yu, Dahuin Jung, Sungroh Yoon ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2825-2835

title: Know Your Attention Maps: 类特定标记掩码用于弱监督语义分割
title_en: Know Your Attention Maps: Class-specific Token Masking for Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation
abstract: 弱监督语义分割(WSSS)是一个具有挑战性的问题,近年来得到了广泛研究。传统方法通常依赖于外部模块(如类激活图)来突出感兴趣区域并生成伪分割掩码。在本文中,我们提出了一种端到端方法,直接利用视觉Transformer(ViT)学习的注意力图进行WSSS。我们提出训练一个稀疏ViT,使用多个[CLS]标记(每个类别对应一个),通过随机掩码策略促进[CLS]标记-类别分配。在推理阶段,我们通过聚合每个[CLS]标记对应预测标签的不同自注意力图来生成伪分割掩码。我们的方法增强了自注意力图的可解释性,并确保了准确的类别分配。在两个标准基准和三个专用数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法生成了准确的伪掩码,优于相关工作。这些伪掩码可用于训练分割模型,其结果与全监督模型相当,显著减少了对细粒度标注数据的需求。
abstract_en: Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation (WSSS) is a challenging problem that has been extensively studied in recent years. Traditional approaches often rely on external modules like Class Activation Maps to highlight regions of interest and generate pseudo segmentation masks. In this work, we propose an end-to-end method that directly utilizes the attention maps learned by a Vision Transformer (ViT) for WSSS. We propose training a sparse ViT with multiple [CLS] tokens (one for each class), using a random masking strategy to promote [CLS] token - class assignment. At inference time, we aggregate the different self-attention maps of each [CLS] token corresponding to the predicted labels to generate pseudo segmentation masks. Our proposed approach enhances the interpretability of self-attention maps and ensures accurate class assignments. Extensive experiments on two standard benchmarks and three specialized datasets demonstrate that our method generates accurate pseudo-masks, outperforming related works. Those pseudo-masks can be used to train a segmentation model which achieves results comparable to fully-supervised models, significantly reducing the need for fine-grained labeled data.
authors: Joëlle Hanna, Damian Borth ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23763-23772

title: 基于学习的图像压缩中的知识蒸馏
title_en: Knowledge Distillation for Learned Image Compression
abstract: 近年来,基于学习的图像压缩(LIC)模型在率失真(RD)性能方面取得了显著进展,但其高计算复杂度严重限制了实际部署。为克服这一挑战,我们提出了一种新颖的分阶段模块化蒸馏框架SMoDi,该框架在保持RD性能的同时高效压缩LIC模型。该框架将LIC模型的每个阶段视为独立的子任务,将教师模型的任务分解映射到学生模型,从而简化知识迁移。我们识别出两个决定知识蒸馏效果的关键因素:学生模型构建和损失函数设计。具体而言,我们首先提出教师引导的学生模型构建方法,这是一种类似剪枝的技术,确保教师模型与学生模型的架构一致性。随后,我们引入隐式端到端监督,促进自适应能量压缩和比特率正则化。基于这些见解,我们开发了KDIC,这是一种轻量级学生模型,源自最先进的S2CFormer模型。实验结果表明,KDIC在显著降低计算复杂度的同时实现了顶级的RD性能。据我们所知,这是知识蒸馏在基于学习的图像压缩中的首次成功应用之一。
abstract_en: Recently, learned image compression (LIC) models have achieved remarkable rate-distortion (RD) performance, yet their high computational complexity severely limits practical deployment. To overcome this challenge, we propose a novel Stage-wise Modular Distillation framework, SMoDi, which efficiently compresses LIC models while preserving RD performance. This framework treats each stage of LIC models as an independent sub-task, mirroring the teacher model's task decomposition to the student, thereby simplifying knowledge transfer. We identify two crucial factors determining the effectiveness of knowledge distillation: student model construction and loss function design. Specifically, we first propose Teacher-Guided Student Model Construction, a pruning-like method ensuring architectural consistency between teacher and student models. Next, we introduce Implicit End-to-end Supervision, facilitating adaptive energy compaction and bitrate regularization. Based on these insights, we develop KDIC, a lightweight student model derived from the state-of-the-art S2CFormer model. Experimental results demonstrate that KDIC achieves top-tier RD performance with significantly reduced computational complexity. To our knowledge, this work is among the first successful applications of knowledge distillation to learned image compression.
authors: Yunuo Chen, Zezheng Lyu, Bing He, Ning Cao, Gang Chen, Guo Lu, Wenjun Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4996-5006

title: 基于精细化logits的知识蒸馏
title_en: Knowledge Distillation with Refined Logits
abstract: 近期关于知识蒸馏的研究日益聚焦于logit蒸馏,因其在模型压缩中的简洁性、有效性及通用性。本文提出精细化logits蒸馏(RLD)以解决现有logit蒸馏方法的局限性。我们的方法源于以下观察:即使高性能教师模型也可能产生错误预测,导致标准蒸馏损失与交叉熵损失间的差异加剧,从而损害学生模型学习目标的一致性。先前尝试通过标签实证修正教师预测可能破坏类别相关性。相比之下,我们的RLD利用标签信息动态优化教师logits。通过这种方式,我们的方法可有效消除教师的误导信息,同时保留关键类别相关性,从而提升蒸馏知识的价值与效率。在CIFAR-100和ImageNet上的实验结果验证了其优越性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/zju-SWJ/RLD获取。
abstract_en: Recent research on knowledge distillation has increasingly focused on logit distillation because of its simplicity, effectiveness, and versatility in model compression. In this paper, we introduce Refined Logit Distillation (RLD) to address the limitations of current logit distillation methods. Our approach is motivated by the observation that even high-performing teacher models can make incorrect predictions, creating an exacerbated divergence between the standard distillation loss and the cross-entropy loss, which can undermine the consistency of the student model's learning objectives. Previous attempts to use labels to empirically correct teacher predictions may undermine the class correlations. In contrast, our RLD employs labeling information to dynamically refine teacher logits. In this way, our method can effectively eliminate misleading information from the teacher while preserving crucial class correlations, thus enhancing the value and efficiency of distilled knowledge. Experimental results on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet demonstrate its superiority over existing methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/zju-SWJ/RLD.
authors: Wujie Sun, Defang Chen, Siwei Lyu, Genlang Chen, Chun Chen, Can Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1110-1119

title: 基于交互学习的知识迁移
title_en: Knowledge Transfer from Interaction Learning
abstract: 当前视觉基础模型(VFMs)在从视觉语言模型(VLMs)迁移知识时面临根本性限制:尽管VLMs通过统一表征空间出色地建模了跨模态交互,但现有VFMs主要采用结果导向范式,忽视了底层交互过程。这种表征差异导致知识迁移效果欠佳且视觉任务泛化能力受限。我们提出Learning from Interactions框架,通过在视觉理解过程中显式建模交互来弥合这一差距。我们的核心洞察是:保留VLMs捕捉的交互动态(而非仅最终表征)可更有效地将知识迁移至下游VFMs。技术核心包含两项创新:(1) 交互查询(Interaction Queries)通过网络层间保持持久关系,(2) 基于预训练VLMs跨模态注意力模式的交互监督。综合实验在多个基准测试中均取得显著提升:在TinyImageNet分类任务中实现约3.3%的绝对增益,在COCO检测/分割任务中分别获得+1.6 mAP/+2.4 AP^ mask绝对提升,且参数开销最小、收敛速度更快(7倍加速)。该框架在跨域场景中表现尤为突出,在PACS和VLCS数据集上分别实现约2.4%和9.3%的零样本提升。人类评估验证了方法的认知对齐性,在语义一致性指标上超越结果导向方法2.7倍。
abstract_en: Current visual foundation models (VFMs) face a fundamental limitation in transferring knowledge from vision language models (VLMs): while VLMs excel at modeling cross-modal interactions through unified representation spaces, existing VFMs predominantly adopt result-oriented paradigms that neglect the underlying interaction processes. This representational discrepancy leads to suboptimal knowledge transfer and limited generalization capabilities across vision tasks.We propose Learning from Interactions, a cognitive-inspired framework that bridges this gap by explicitly modeling interactions during visual understanding. Our key insight is that preserving the interaction dynamics captured by VLMs -- rather than just their final representations -- enables more effective knowledge transfer to downstream VFMs. The technical core involves two innovations: (1) Interaction Queries that maintain persistent relationships across network layers, and (2) interaction-based supervision derived from pre-trained VLMs' cross-modal attention patterns.Comprehensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements across multiple benchmarks: achieving ~3.3% and +1.6 mAP/+2.4 AP^ mask  absolute gains on TinyImageNet classification and COCO detection/segmentation respectively, with minimal parameter overhead and faster convergence (7xspeedup). The framework particularly excels in cross-domain scenarios, delivering ~2.4% and ~9.3% zero-shot improvements on PACS and VLCS. Human evaluations confirm our approach's cognitive alignment, outperforming result-oriented methods by 2.7xin semantic consistency metrics.
authors: Yilin Gao, Kangyi Chen, Zhongxing Peng, Hengjie Lu, Shugong Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3585-3595

title: 知识引导的部件分割
title_en: Knowledge-Guided Part Segmentation
abstract: 在现实场景中,物体及其部件本质上同时具有粗粒度差异和复杂的细粒度结构关系。这些特性可以形式化为知识,用于细粒度部件理解。然而,现有部件分割模型始终无法捕捉这些复杂的部件间关系,将部件视为独立实体并忽略物体级差异。为解决这些局限性,我们提出了一种新颖的知识引导部件分割(KPS)框架。我们的方法利用大语言模型(LLM)自动提取部件间的结构关系,并将其整合到知识图谱中。随后,结构知识引导模块通过图卷积网络(GCN)建模这些关系。此外,粗粒度物体引导模块捕捉物体特定差异并将其作为视觉引导整合。部件结构与物体差异的综合洞察指导细粒度部件分割。我们的KPS在分割性能上取得显著提升,在PartImageNet上实现4.96%的mIoU增益,在Pascal-Part上实现3.73%的增益。此外,在Pascal-Part-116的开放词汇设置中,其hIoU提升3.25%,突显了知识引导在增强细粒度部件分割中的有效性。
abstract_en: In real-world scenarios, objects and their parts inherently possess both coarse-grained differences and intricate fine-grained structural relationships. These characteristics can be formalized as knowledge, leveraged for fine-grained part comprehension. However, existing part segmentation models consistently fail to capture these complex inter-part relationships, treating parts as independent entities and disregarding object-level distinctions. To address these limitations, we propose a novel Knowledge-Guided Part Segmentation (KPS) framework. Our approach automatically extracts structural relationships between parts using a large language model (LLM) and integrates them into a knowledge graph. Subsequently, a structural knowledge guidance module employs a graph convolutional network (GCN) to model these relationships. Furthermore, a coarse-grained object guidance module captures object-specific distinctions and integrates them as visual guidance. The integrated insights from the part structure and object differentiation guide the fine-grained part segmentation. Our KPS achieves notable improvements in segmentation performance, with a 4.96% mIoU gain on PartImageNet and a 3.73% gain on Pascal-Part. Moreover, in the open-vocabulary setting on Pascal-Part-116, it improves hIoU by 3.25%, highlighting the effectiveness of knowledge guidance in enhancing fine-grained part segmentation.
authors: Xuejian Gou, Fang Liu, Licheng Jiao, Shuo Li, Lingling Li, Hao Wang, Xu Liu, Puhua Chen, Wenping Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5490-5500

title: LA-MOTR:基于可学习关联的端到端多目标跟踪
title_en: LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Learnable Association
abstract: 本文提出LA-MOTR,一种新型的基于可学习关联的跟踪框架,用于解决端到端基于注意力(TbA)多目标跟踪中检测与关联任务之间的竞争性优化目标。当前TbA方法采用共享解码器同时进行目标检测与轨迹关联,常导致任务干扰和次优精度。相比之下,我们的端到端框架将这些任务解耦为两个专用模块:分离目标-轨迹检测(SOTD)和空间引导的可学习关联(SGLA)。这种解耦设计提供了灵活性和可解释性。具体而言,SOTD在每一帧中独立检测新目标和现有轨迹,而SGLA则通过相对空间线索引导的空间加权可学习注意力模块对它们进行关联。轨迹更新模块进一步维持时间一致性。可学习关联机制解决了解耦框架中固有的次优关联问题,避免了联合方法中常见的任务干扰。在DanceTrack、MOT17和SportMOT数据集上的评估表明该方法达到SOTA性能。广泛的消融实验验证了所设计模块的有效性。代码已开源至https://github.com/PenK1nG/LA-MOTR。
abstract_en: This paper proposes LA-MOTR, a novel Tracking-by-Learnable-Association framework that resolves the competing optimization objectives between detection and association in end-to-end Tracking-by-Attention (TbA) Multi-Object Tracking. Current TbA methods employ shared decoders for simultaneous object detection and tracklet association, often resulting in task interference and suboptimal accuracy. By contrast, our end-to-end framework decouples these tasks into two specialized modules: Separated Object-Tracklet Detection (SOTD) and Spatial-Guided Learnable Association (SGLA). This decoupled design offers flexibility and explainability. In particular, SOTD independently detects new objects and existing tracklets in each frame, while SGLA associates them via Spatial-Weighted Learnable Attention module guided by relative spatial cues. Temporal coherence is further maintained through Tracklet Updates Module. The learnable association mechanism resolves the inherent suboptimal association issues in decoupled frameworks, avoiding the task interference commonly observed in joint approaches. Evaluations on DanceTrack, MOT17, and SportMOT datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance. Extensive ablation studies validate the effectiveness of the designed modules. Code is available at https://github.com/PenK1nG/LA-MOTR.
authors: Peng Wang, Yongcai Wang, Hualong Cao, Wang Chen, Deying Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12438-12448

title: LACONIC: 一种用于可控图像生成的三维布局适配器
title_en: LACONIC: A 3D Layout Adapter for Controllable Image Creation
abstract: 现有针对多物体场景引导图像合成的生成方法通常依赖于图像或文本空间中的二维控制。因此,这些方法在保持和尊重场景底层一致的三维几何结构方面存在困难。本文提出了一种新颖的条件控制方法、训练方法和适配器网络,可嵌入到预训练的文本到图像扩散模型中。我们的方法为这类模型赋予三维感知能力,同时利用其丰富的先验知识。我们的方法支持相机控制、基于显式三维几何的条件控制,并首次考虑了场景的完整上下文(即画面内外的物体),以合成合理且语义丰富的图像。尽管具有多模态特性,我们的模型轻量且需要合理的监督学习数据量,展现出显著的泛化能力。我们还引入了直观且一致的图像编辑与重风格化方法,例如通过定位、旋转或调整场景中单个物体的大小。我们的方法能良好融入各种图像创作流程,相较于以往方法支持更丰富的应用场景。
abstract_en: Existing generative approaches for guided image synthesis of multi-object scenes typically rely on 2D controls in the image or text space. As a result, these methods struggle to maintain and respect consistent three-dimensional geometric structure, underlying the scene. In this paper, we propose a novel conditioning approach, training method and adapter network that can be plugged into pretrained text-to-image diffusion models. Our approach provides a way to endow such models with 3D-awareness, while leveraging their rich prior knowledge. Our method supports camera control, conditioning on explicit 3D geometries and, for the first time, accounts for the entire context of a scene, i.e., both on and off-screen items, to synthesize plausible and semantically rich images. Despite its multi-modal nature, our model is lightweight, requires a reasonable number of data for supervised learning and shows remarkable generalization power. We also introduce methods for intuitive and consistent image editing and restyling, e.g., by positioning, rotating or resizing individual objects in a scene. Our method integrates well within various image creation workflows and enables a richer set of applications compared to previous approaches.
authors: Léopold Maillard, Tom Durand, Adrien Ramanana Rahary, Maks Ovsjanikov ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18046-18057

title: LANGTRAJ:用于语言条件轨迹模拟的扩散模型与数据集
title_en: LANGTRAJ: Diffusion Model and Dataset for Language-Conditioned Trajectory Simulation
abstract: 通过可控性评估自动驾驶汽车,能够在反事实或结构化环境中实现可扩展的测试,从而提高效率和安全性。我们引入LangTraj,这是一种语言条件化的场景扩散模型,能够模拟交通场景中所有代理的联合行为。通过基于自然语言输入的条件化,LangTraj能够对交互行为提供灵活且直观的控制,生成细致且真实的场景。与依赖领域特定引导函数的先前方法不同,LangTraj在训练过程中引入语言条件化,从而实现更直观的交通模拟控制。我们提出了一种新颖的扩散模型闭环训练策略,专门设计用于在闭环模拟中增强稳定性和真实性。为支持语言条件模拟,我们开发了Inter-Drive,这是一个用于训练语言条件扩散模型的大规模数据集,包含多样且交互的标签。我们的数据集基于一个可扩展的流程,用于标注代理间交互和单代理行为,确保丰富且多样的监督。在Waymo Motion数据集上验证后,LangTraj在真实感、语言可控性和语言条件安全关键模拟方面表现出色,为灵活且可扩展的自动驾驶测试建立了新范式。项目网站:https://langtraj.github.io/
abstract_en: Evaluating autonomous vehicles with controllability enables scalable testing in counterfactual or structured settings, enhancing both efficiency and safety. We introduce LangTraj, a language-conditioned scene-diffusion model that simulates the joint behavior of all agents in traffic scenarios. By conditioning on natural language inputs, LangTraj provides flexible and intuitive control over interactive behaviors, generating nuanced and realistic scenarios. Unlike prior approaches that depend on domain-specific guidance functions, LangTraj incorporates language conditioning during training, facilitating more intuitive traffic simulation control. We propose a novel closed-loop training strategy for diffusion models, explicitly tailored to enhance stability and realism during closed-loop simulation. To support language-conditioned simulation, we develop Inter-Drive, a large-scale dataset with diverse and interactive labels for training language-conditioned diffusion models. Our dataset is built upon a scalable pipeline for annotating agent-agent interactions and single-agent behaviors, ensuring rich and varied supervision. Validated on the Waymo Motion Dataset, LangTraj demonstrates strong performance in realism, language controllability, and language-conditioned safety-critical simulation, establishing a new paradigm for flexible and scalable autonomous vehicle testing. Project website: https://langtraj.github.io/.
authors: Wei-Jer Chang, Wei Zhan, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Manmohan Chandraker, Francesco Pittaluga ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26622-26631

title: LATINO-PRO: 基于潜在一致性逆求解器与提示优化的即插即用框架
title_en: LATINO-PRO: LAtent consisTency INverse sOlver with PRompt Optimization
abstract: 文本到图像的潜在扩散模型(LDMs)近期作为强大的生成模型崭露头角,在图像逆问题求解中展现出巨大潜力。然而,以即插即用(PnP)零样本方式利用此类模型仍面临挑战,因为需要为未知图像识别合适的文本提示。此外,现有文本到图像的PnP方法计算成本极高。本文通过提出一种新型PnP推理范式解决这些挑战,该范式专门设计用于将生成模型嵌入随机逆求解器,特别关注潜在一致性模型(LCMs),该模型将LDMs蒸馏为快速生成器。我们基于此框架提出LAtent consisTency INverse sOlver(LATINO),这是首个利用LCMs编码先验知识解决逆问题的零样本PnP框架。我们的条件机制避免自动微分,在仅需8次神经函数评估即可达到SOTA质量。因此,LATINO提供了显著准确的解决方案,并在内存和计算效率方面远超以往方法。随后,我们将LATINO嵌入经验贝叶斯框架,通过边缘最大似然估计自动校准文本提示。大量实验表明,提示自校准显著提升了估计效果,使LATINO结合提示优化在图像重建质量和计算效率方面定义了新的SOTA。代码可在latino-pro.github.io获取。
abstract_en: Text-to-image latent diffusion models (LDMs) have recently emerged as powerful generative models with great potential for solving inverse problems in imaging. However, leveraging such models in a Plug & Play (PnP), zero-shot manner remains challenging because it requires identifying a suitable text prompt for the unknown image of interest. Also, existing text-to-image PnP approaches are highly computationally expensive. We herein address these challenges by proposing a novel PnP inference paradigm specifically designed for embedding generative models within stochastic inverse solvers, with special attention to Latent Consistency Models (LCMs), which distill LDMs into fast generators. We leverage our framework to propose LAtent consisTency INverse sOlver (LATINO), the first zero-shot PnP framework to solve inverse problems with priors encoded by LCMs. Our conditioning mechanism avoids automatic differentiation and reaches SOTA quality in as little as 8 neural function evaluations. As a result, LATINO delivers remarkably accurate solutions and is significantly more memory and computationally efficient than previous approaches. We then embed LATINO within an empirical Bayesian framework that automatically calibrates the text prompt from the observed measurements by marginal maximum likelihood estimation. Extensive experiments show that prompt self-calibration greatly improves estimation, allowing LATINO with PRompt Optimization to define new SOTAs in image reconstruction quality and computational efficiency. The code is available at latino-pro.github.io
authors: Alessio Spagnoletti, Jean Prost, Andrés Almansa, Nicolas Papadakis, Marcelo Pereyra ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19597-19607

title: LBM:潜在桥梁匹配用于快速图像到图像翻译
title_en: LBM: Latent Bridge Matching for Fast Image-to-Image Translation
abstract: 本文提出了一种新的、通用且可扩展的潜在桥梁匹配(LBM)方法,该方法通过在潜在空间中进行桥梁匹配实现快速图像到图像翻译。我们证明该方法仅需单次推理步骤即可在多种图像到图像任务中达到最先进水平的结果。除了高效性外,我们还展示了该方法在不同图像翻译任务(如物体移除、正常与深度估计以及物体重照明)中的通用性。我们还推导了LBM的条件框架,并通过解决可控图像重照明和阴影生成任务验证了其有效性。
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce Latent Bridge Matching (LBM), a new, versatile and scalable method that relies on Bridge Matching in a latent space to achieve fast image-to-image translation. We show that the method can reach state-of-the-art results for various image-to-image tasks using only a single inference step. In addition to its efficiency, we also demonstrate the versatility of the method across different image translation tasks such as object removal, normal and depth estimation, and object relighting. We also derive a conditional framework of LBM and demonstrate its effectiveness by tackling the tasks of controllable image relighting and shadow generation.
authors: Clément Chadebec, Onur Tasar, Sanjeev Sreetharan, Benjamin Aubin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 29086-29098

title: LD-RPS:基于潜在扩散递归后验采样的零样本统一图像修复
title_en: LD-RPS: Zero-Shot Unified Image Restoration via Latent Diffusion Recurrent Posterior Sampling
abstract: 统一图像修复是低级视觉中的极具挑战性任务。现有方法要么针对特定任务进行定制化设计,限制了其在多种退化类型中的泛化能力,要么依赖成对数据集训练,从而受到封闭集约束。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种无需数据集的统一方法,通过预训练潜在扩散模型进行递归后验采样。我们的方法结合多模态理解模型,在任务盲条件下为生成模型提供语义先验。此外,它利用轻量模块对退化输入与扩散模型的生成偏好进行对齐,并采用递归精炼进行后验采样。大量实验表明,我们的方法超越了最先进方法,验证了其有效性与鲁棒性。我们的代码和数据将在https://github.com/AMAP-ML/LD-RPS公开。
abstract_en: Unified image restoration is a significantly challenging task in low-level vision. Existing methods either make tailored designs for specific tasks, limiting their generalizability across various types of degradation, or rely on training with paired datasets, thereby suffering from closed-set constraints. To address these issues, we propose a novel, dataset-free, and unified approach through recurrent posterior sampling utilizing a pretrained latent diffusion model. Our method incorporates the multimodal understanding model to provide sematic priors for the generative model under a task-blind condition. Furthermore, it utilizes a lightweight module to align the degraded input with the generated preference of the diffusion model, and employs recurrent refinement for posterior sampling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods, validating its effectiveness and robustness. Our code and data will be available at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/LD-RPS.
authors: Huaqiu Li, Yong Wang, Tongwen Huang, Hailang Huang, Haoqian Wang, Xiangxiang Chu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13684-13694

title: LDIP:面向视频超分辨率的长距离信息传播
title_en: LDIP: Long Distance Information Propagation for Video Super-Resolution
abstract: 视频超分辨率(VSR)方法通常通过多帧信息融合实现高质量放大,近期方法在性能上表现出色。然而,仍存在挑战,特别是在长距离信息的有效利用方面。为解决VSR中的这一局限性,我们提出了一种长距离信息传播策略,该策略包含一个灵活的融合模块,可选地整合来自额外高分辨率参考图像的信息。我们设计整体方法以利用现有的预训练VSR主干网络,并调整特征放大模块以支持任意缩放因子。实验表明,我们在感知指标上达到最先进水平,并相较于现有方案提供了更优的视觉效果。
abstract_en: Video super-resolution (VSR) methods typically exploit information across multiple frames to achieve high quality upscaling, with recent approaches demonstrating impressive performance. Nevertheless, challenges remain, particularly in effectively leveraging information over long distances. To address this limitation in VSR, we propose a strategy for long distance information propagation with a flexible fusion module that can optionally also assimilate information from additional high resolution reference images. We design our overall approach such that it can leverage existing pre-trained VSR backbones and adapt the feature upscaling module to support arbitrary scaling factors. Our experiments demonstrate that we can achieve state-of-theart results on perceptual metrics and deliver more visually pleasing results compared to existing solutions.
authors: Michael Bernasconi, Abdelaziz Djelouah, Yang Zhang, Markus Gross, Christopher Schroers ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11558-11567

title: LDPose: 朝向肢体缺失者在真实场景中包容性人体姿态估计的研究
title_en: LDPose: Towards Inclusive Human Pose Estimation for Limb-Deficient Individuals in the Wild
abstract: 人体姿态估计旨在预测身体关键点位置并实现多种实际应用。然而,现有研究仅关注完整躯体个体,忽视了肢体缺失者群体。因此,当前姿态估计方法无法推广至肢体缺失者。本文引入了肢体缺失者姿态估计任务,该任务不仅预测标准人体关键点位置,还估计缺失肢体的末端位置。为支持该任务,我们提出了首个针对肢体缺失者的姿态估计数据集Limb-Deficient Pose (LDPose)。LDPose包含超过28,000张图像,涵盖约73,000名不同肢体缺失类型和民族背景的个体。标注过程由国际认证的残疾人田径分类器指导以确保高精度。此外,我们提出了一种肢体缺失损失(LDLoss),通过对比残肢关键点与完整肢体关键点更好地区分残肢关键点。进一步地,我们设计了肢体缺失度量(LD Metrics)以定量评估残肢和完整肢体关键点预测结果,并采用最先进的姿态估计方法对数据集进行基准测试。实验结果表明LDPose是一个具有挑战性的数据集,我们相信它将促进进一步研究,最终支持全球肢体缺失者群体。
abstract_en: Human pose estimation aims to predict the location of body keypoints and enable various practical applications. However, existing research focuses solely on individuals with full physical bodies and overlooks those with limb deficiencies. As a result, current pose estimation methods cannot be generalized to individuals with limb deficiencies. In this paper, we introduce the Limb-Deficient Pose Estimation task, which not only predicts the locations of standard human body keypoints, but also estimates the endpoints of missing limbs. To support this task, we present Limb-Deficient Pose (LDPose), the first-ever human pose estimation dataset for individuals with limb deficiencies. LDPose comprises over 28k images for approximately 73k individuals across diverse limb deficiency types and ethnic backgrounds. The annotation process is guided by internationally accredited para-athletics classifiers to ensure high precision. In addition, we propose a Limb-Deficient Loss (LDLoss) to better distinguish residual limb keypoints by contrasting residual limb keypoints and intact limb keypoints. Furthermore, we design Limb-Deficient Metrics (LD Metrics) to quantitatively measure the keypoint predictions of both residual and intact limbs and benchmark our dataset using state-of-the-art human pose estimation methods. Experiment results indicate that LDPose is a challenging dataset, and we believe that it will foster further research and ultimately support individuals with limb deficiencies worldwide.
authors: Jiaying Ying, Heming Du, Kaihao Zhang, Lincheng Li, Xin Yu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9865-9875

title: LEGION:面向合成图像检测的定位与解释学习
title_en: LEGION: Learning to Ground and Explain for Synthetic Image Detection
abstract: 生成技术的快速发展已成为一把双刃剑。虽然提供了增强便利性的强大工具,但也带来了显著的社会担忧。作为防御者,当前的合成图像检测方法往往缺乏针对人工制品的文本可解释性,并过度关注图像篡改检测,而现有数据集通常面临生成器过时和细粒度标注缺失的问题。本文我们引入SynthScars,一个高质量且多样化的数据集,包含12,236张全合成图像及人类专家标注。该数据集包含4种不同的图像内容类型、3类人工制品以及覆盖像素级分割、详细文本解释和人工制品类别标签的细粒度标注。此外,我们提出LEGION(LEarning to Ground and explain for Synthetic Image detectiON),一个基于多模态大语言模型(MLLM)的图像伪造分析框架,集成了人工制品检测、分割和解释功能。在此基础上,我们进一步探索LEGION作为控制器的应用,将其集成到图像优化流程中,以指导生成更高质量和更逼真的图像。大量实验表明,LEGION在多个基准测试中均优于现有方法,特别是在SynthScars数据集上,其mIoU和F1分数分别超越次优传统专家3.31%和7.75%。此外,在其指导下生成的优化图像与人类偏好表现出更强的契合度。更多关于LEGION的信息可访问 https://opendatalab.github.io/LEGION。
abstract_en: The rapid advancements in generative technology have emerged as a double-edged sword. While offering powerful tools that enhance convenience, they also pose significant social concerns. As defenders, current synthetic image detection methods often lack artifact-level textual interpretability and are overly focused on image manipulation detection, and current datasets usually suffer from outdated generators and a lack of fine-grained annotations. In this paper, we introduce SynthScars, a high-quality and diverse dataset consisting of 12,236 fully synthetic images with human-expert annotations. It features 4 distinct image content types, 3 categories of artifacts, and fine-grained annotations covering pixel-level segmentation, detailed textual explanations, and artifact category labels. Furthermore, we propose LEGION (LEarning to Ground and explain for Synthetic Image detectiON), a multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based image forgery analysis framework that integrates artifact detection, segmentation, and explanation. Building upon this capability, we further explore LEGION as a controller, integrating it into image refinement pipelines to guide the generation of higher-quality and more realistic images. Extensive experiments show that LEGION outperforms existing methods across multiple benchmarks, particularly surpassing the second-best traditional expert on SynthScars by 3.31% in mIoU and 7.75% in F1 score. Moreover, the refined images generated under its guidance exhibit stronger alignment with human preferences. More information about LEGION can be found at https://opendatalab.github.io/LEGION.
authors: Hengrui Kang, Siwei Wen, Zichen Wen, Junyan Ye, Weijia Li, Peilin Feng, Baichuan Zhou, Bin Wang, Dahua Lin, Linfeng Zhang, Conghui He ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18937-18947

title: LEGO-Maker:一种语义驱动的文本到3D生成算法
title_en: LEGO-Maker: A Semantic-Driven Algorithm for Text-to-3D Generation
abstract: 在大规模模型迭代的推动下,3D模型生成的推理速度和泛化能力得到了显著提升。然而,现有方法的质量仍难以直接应用而无需后处理。常见问题包括纹理清晰度不足、语义信息丢失、细节不够精细以及生成冗余伪影。此外,当前方法仅关注静态结构的生成,其中单个组件保持不可移动,未在生成过程中考虑功能性应用。为解决这些局限性,我们从类似乐高积木的模块化构建中获得启发,将复杂模型分解为语义功能组件。我们提出LEGO-Maker,一种新颖框架,将文本到3D任务重新表述为三阶段过程:目标图像生成、功能语义分解以及带有结构融合的多任务3D生成。通过重新组织高质量3D数据集,我们训练了针对3D生成任务的扩散模型和语义分割模型。此外,我们设计了运动驱动机制,在模型融合后引入动作序列以实现功能交互模块。实验结果表明,与现有方法相比,我们的方法在语义理解、模型细节质量和文本一致性方面显著提升,同时展现出在多种场景下的直接适用性。
abstract_en: Driven by large-scale model iterations, the inference speed and generalization ability of 3D model generation have improved significantly. However, the quality of existing methods still falls short of enabling direct use without post-processing. Common issues include insufficient texture clarity, loss of semantic information, lack of fine-grained detail, and the generation of redundant artifacts. Moreover, current approaches focus solely on producing static structures, where individual components remain non-movable, without considering functional applications in the generation process. To address these limitations, we draw inspiration from LEGO-like modular construction and decompose complex models into semantically functional components. We propose LEGO-Maker, a novel framework that reformulates the text-to-3D task into a three-stage process: target image generation, functional semantic decomposition, and multi-task 3D generation with structured fusion. Leveraging a reorganized high-quality 3D dataset, we train a Diffusion model and a semantic segmentation model tailored for 3D generation tasks. Additionally, we design a motion-driven mechanism to introduce action sequences for functionally interactive modules after model fusion. Experimental results demonstrate that, compared to existing methods, our approach significantly enhances semantic understanding, model detail quality, and text consistency while showcasing direct applicability across various scenarios.
authors: Yifei Zhang, Lei Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15127-15136

title: LGA-Net: 学习局部与全局亲和力用于基于稀疏涂鸦的图像着色
title_en: LGA-Net: Learning Local and Global Affinities for Sparse Scribble based Image Colorization
abstract: 图像着色是一个典型的不适定问题。在各种着色方法中,基于涂鸦的方法具有独特优势,允许用户准确解决歧义并修改任何物体的颜色以符合其特定偏好。然而,由于涂鸦绘制过程耗时,用户倾向于绘制稀疏涂鸦而非密集详细涂鸦,这使得现有方法,尤其是无直接涂鸦区域的处理变得具有挑战性。针对上述问题,本文提出了一种新型着色算法,名为局部与全局亲和力网络(LGA-Net),将基于涂鸦的着色任务表述为局部和全局层面的亲和力传播过程。与直接预测颜色值不同,我们的神经网络学习预测给定灰度输入下像素间的局部与全局亲和力关系,描述颜色应如何传播,且独立于涂鸦。在可靠亲和力关系的基础上,颜色传播过程被表述为最大后验概率问题。局部与全局亲和力均通过加权图表示,并通过图拉普拉斯正则化器确保准确的颜色传播。大量实验表明,当使用稀疏涂鸦时,LGA-Net能够产生最先进的着色结果。
abstract_en: Image colorization is a typical ill-posed problem. Among various colorization methods, scribble-based methods have a unique advantage that allows users to accurately resolve ambiguities and modify the colors of any objects to suit their specific tastes. However, due to the time-consuming scribble drawing process, users tend to draw sparse scribbles instead of dense and detailed scribbles, which makes it challenging for existing methods, especially for regions with no immediate scribbles. Facing the above problems, this paper proposes a novel colorization algorithm named Local and Global Affinity Net (LGA-Net) that formulates the scribble-based colorization task as an affinity propagation process at both local and global levels. Instead of predicting color values directly, our neural network learns to predict local and global affinity relationships between pixels for a given grayscale input, describing how colors should be propagated, which are independent of the scribbles. Given reliable affinity relationships, the color propagation process is formulated as a maximum a posteriori problem. Both local and global affinities are represented using a weighted graph and enabled by a graph Laplacian regularizer to ensure accurate color propagation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LGA-Net produces state-of-the-art colorization results when using sparse scribbles.
authors: Hongjin Lyu, Bo Li, Paul L. Rosin, Yu-Kun Lai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8144-8153

title: LHM: 大规模可动画化人体重建模型:单图像到3D的快速重建
title_en: LHM: Large Animatable Human Reconstruction Model for Single Image to 3D in Seconds
abstract: 从单张图像进行可动画化3D人体重建是一个具有挑战性的问题,由于几何结构、外观和形变的解耦存在歧义。近年来,3D人体重建的主要进展集中在静态人体建模上,依赖合成3D扫描数据进行训练限制了其泛化能力。相反,基于优化的视频方法虽然能获得更高的保真度,但需要受控的采集条件和计算密集型的优化过程。受大规模重建模型在高效静态重建领域的发展启发,我们提出LHM(大规模可动画化人体重建模型),通过前向传播即可推断出以3D高斯点云表示的高保真度虚拟形象。我们的模型采用多模态Transformer架构,通过注意力机制有效编码人体姿态特征与图像特征,实现服装几何结构和纹理的细节保持。为进一步提升面部身份保持和精细细节恢复能力,我们提出头部特征金字塔编码方案,聚合头部区域的多尺度特征。大量实验表明,我们的LHM无需后期处理即可在数秒内生成合理的可动画化人体,其重建精度和泛化能力均优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Animatable 3D human reconstruction from a single image is a challenging problem due to the ambiguity in decoupling geometry, appearance, and deformation. Recent advances in 3D human reconstruction mainly focus on static human modeling, and the reliance of using synthetic 3D scans for training limits their generalization ability. Conversely, optimization-based video methods achieve higher fidelity but demand controlled capture conditions and computationally intensive refinement processes. Motivated by the emergence of large reconstruction models for efficient static reconstruction, we propose LHM (Large Animatable Human Reconstruction Model) to infer high-fidelity avatars represented as 3D Gaussian splatting in a feed-forward pass. Our model leverages a multimodal transformer architecture to effectively encode the human body positional features and image features with attention mechanism, enabling detailed preservation of clothing geometry and texture. To further boost the face identity preservation and fine detail recovery, we propose a head feature pyramid encoding scheme to aggregate multi-scale features of the head regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our LHM generates plausible animatable human in seconds without post-processing for face and hands, outperforming existing methods in both reconstruction accuracy and generalization ability.
authors: Lingteng Qiu, Xiaodong Gu, Peihao Li, Qi Zuo, Weichao Shen, Junfei Zhang, Kejie Qiu, Weihao Yuan, Guanying Chen, Zilong Dong, Liefeng Bo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14184-14194

title: LIFT: 基于潜在隐式函数的任务与数据无关编码
title_en: LIFT: Latent Implicit Functions for Task- and Data-Agnostic Encoding
abstract: 隐式神经表示(INRs)在统一多领域数据任务建模中展现出强大范式,具有内存效率高和分辨率独立性等关键优势。传统深度学习模型通常依赖特定模态,常需为不同信号类型定制架构和目标。然而现有INR框架常依赖全局潜在向量或存在计算效率不足问题,限制其广泛应用。我们提出**LIFT**,一种新型高性能框架,通过元学习捕捉多尺度信息解决上述挑战。LIFT结合多组并行局部隐式函数与层次化潜在生成器,生成涵盖局部、中间和全局特征的统一潜在表示。该架构实现局部区域间平滑过渡,提升表达能力同时保持推理效率。此外,我们引入增强型变体ReLIFT,集成残差连接和表达性频率编码。该简洁方法有效解决同类方法中收敛-容量差距问题,提供高效且强大的解决方案以提升容量并加速收敛。实验证明,LIFT在生成建模和分类任务中达到最先进(SOTA)性能,计算成本显著降低。此外,在单任务场景中,精简的ReLIFT架构在信号表示和逆问题任务中表现出色。
abstract_en: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) are proving to be a powerful paradigm in unifying task modeling across diverse data domains, offering key advantages such as memory efficiency and resolution independence. Conventional deep learning models are typically modality-dependent, often requiring custom architectures and objectives for different types of signals. However, existing INR frameworks frequently rely on global latent vectors or exhibit computational inefficiencies that limit their broader applicability. We introduce **LIFT**, a novel, high-performance framework that addresses these challenges by capturing multiscale information through meta-learning. LIFT leverages multiple parallel localized implicit functions alongside a hierarchical latent generator to produce unified latent representations that span local, intermediate, and global features. This architecture facilitates smooth transitions across local regions, enhancing expressivity while maintaining inference efficiency. Additionally, we introduce ReLIFT, an enhanced variant of LIFT that incorporates residual connections and expressive frequency encodings. With this straightforward approach, ReLIFT effectively addresses the convergence-capacity gap found in comparable methods, providing an efficient yet powerful solution to improve capacity and speed up convergence. Empirical results show that LIFT achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in generative modeling and classification tasks, with notable reductions in computational costs. Moreover, in single-task settings, the streamlined ReLIFT architecture proves effective in signal representations and inverse problem tasks.
authors: Amirhossein Kazerouni, Soroush Mehraban, Michael Brudno, Babak Taati ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4828-4837

title: LINR-PCGC: 无损隐式神经表示用于点云几何压缩
title_en: LINR-PCGC: Lossless Implicit Neural Representations for Point Cloud Geometry Compression
abstract: 现有的基于人工智能的点云压缩方法在依赖特定训练数据分布方面存在困难,这限制了其在实际场景中的部署。隐式神经表示(INR)方法通过将过拟合的网络参数编码到比特流中,解决了上述问题,从而获得更与分布无关的结果。然而,由于编码时间和解码器规模的限制,当前基于INR的方法仅考虑有损几何压缩。本文提出了一种首个无损点云几何压缩方法,称为Lossless Implicit Neural Representations for Point Cloud Geometry Compression(LINR-PCGC)。为加速编码速度,我们设计了一组点云层级编码框架,结合有效的网络初始化策略,可将编码时间减少约60%。提出了一种基于多尺度SparseConv的轻量级编码网络,包含尺度上下文提取、子节点预测和模型压缩模块,以实现快速推理和紧凑的解码器规模。实验结果表明,我们的方法在传统方法和基于AI的方法中均表现优异:例如,在MVUB数据集的收敛时间内,与G-PCC TMC13v23相比,我们的方法将比特流减少了约21.21%,与SparsePCGC相比减少了约21.95%。
abstract_en: Existing AI-based point cloud compression methods struggle with dependence on specific training data distributions, which limits their real-world deployment. Implicit Neural Representation (INR) methods solve the above problem by encoding overfitted network parameters to the bitstream, resulting in more distribution-agnostic results. However, due to the limitation of encoding time and decoder size, current INR based methods only consider lossy geometry compression. In this paper, we propose the first lossless point cloud geometry compression method called Lossless Implicit Neural Representations for Point Cloud Geometry Compression (LINR-PCGC). To accelerate encoding speed, we design a group of point clouds level coding framework with an effective network initialization strategy, which can reduce around 60% encoding time. A lightweight coding network based on multiscale SparseConv, consisting of scale context extraction, child node prediction, and model compression modules, is proposed to realize fast inference and compact decoder size. Experimental results show that our method consistently outperforms traditional and AI-based methods: for example, with the convergence time in the MVUB dataset, our method reduces the bitstream by approximately 21.21% compared to G-PCC TMC13v23 and 21.95% compared to SparsePCGC.
authors: Wenjie Huang, Qi Yang, Shuting Xia, He Huang, Yiling Xu, Zhu Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28577-28586

title: LIRA:借助局部交错区域辅助的大型多模态模型分割推理
title_en: LIRA: Inferring Segmentation in Large Multi-modal Models with Local Interleaved Region Assistance
abstract: 尽管大型多模态模型(LMMs)在分割与理解任务中展现出 promising 能力,但仍面临两个主要局限:分割不准确和幻觉式理解。这些挑战主要源于弱视觉理解能力的约束以及缺乏细粒度感知。为缓解这些问题,我们提出 LIRA 框架,通过两个关键组件利用视觉理解与分割之间的互补关系:(1) 语义增强特征提取器(SEFE)通过融合语义与像素级特征提升物体属性推理能力,实现更精确的分割;(2) 交错局部视觉耦合(ILVC)基于分割掩码提取局部特征后,自回归生成局部描述,提供细粒度监督以缓解幻觉。此外,我们发现物体分割精度与 <seg> token 的潜在相关语义呈正相关。为量化这种关系及模型的潜在语义推理能力,我们引入属性评估(AttrEval)数据集。实验表明,LIRA 在分割与理解任务中均达到最先进性能。代码将开源于 https://github.com/echo840/LIRA。
abstract_en: While large multi-modal models (LMMs) demonstrate promising capabilities in segmentation and comprehension, they still struggle with two limitations: inaccurate segmentation and hallucinated comprehension. These challenges stem primarily from constraints in weak visual comprehension and a lack of fine-grained perception. To alleviate these limitations, we propose LIRA, a framework that capitalizes on the complementary relationship between visual comprehension and segmentation via two key components: (1) Semantic-Enhanced Feature Extractor (SEFE) improves object attribute inference by fusing semantic and pixel-level features, leading to more accurate segmentation; (2) Interleaved Local Visual Coupling (ILVC) autoregressively generates local descriptions after extracting local features based on segmentation masks, offering fine-grained supervision to mitigate hallucinations. Furthermore, we find that the precision of object segmentation is positively correlated with the latent related semantics of the <seg> token. To quantify this relationship and the model's potential semantic inferring ability, we introduce the Attributes Evaluation (AttrEval) dataset. Our experiments show that LIRA achieves state-of-the-art performance in both segmentation and comprehension tasks. Code will be available at https://github.com/echo840/LIRA.
authors: Zhang Li, Biao Yang, Qiang Liu, Shuo Zhang, Zhiyin Ma, Liang Yin, Linger Deng, Yabo Sun, Yuliang Liu, Xiang Bai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24056-24067

title: LIRA:通过多模态大语言模型实现的推理重建
title_en: LIRA: Reasoning Reconstruction via Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: 现有基于语言指令引导的在线三维重建系统主要依赖显式指令或可查询地图,表现出处理隐式和复杂指令能力不足的局限性。本文首先引入了一个推理重建任务。该任务输入包含复杂推理的隐式指令和RGB-D序列,输出符合指令的增量式三维重建实例。为处理该任务,我们提出LIRA:语言引导的重建助手。该方法利用多模态大语言模型主动对隐式指令进行推理,获取与指令相关的2D候选实例及其属性。随后,候选实例被回投影到增量重建的三维几何图中,经过实例融合和目标实例推理。在LIRA中,为实现更高质量的实例融合,我们提出TIFF模块,该模块在碎片包围体积内运行,基于学习方法同时融合多个关键帧。由于该任务的评估系统尚未完善,我们提出包含最大场景-指令数据样本集合的基准数据集ReasonRecon,涵盖隐式推理。实验表明,LIRA在推理重建任务中优于现有方法,并具备实时运行能力。代码和基准数据集可在https://github.com/zhen6618/LIRA获取。
abstract_en: Existing language instruction-guided online 3D reconstruction systems mainly rely on explicit instructions or queryable maps, showing inadequate capability to handle implicit and complex instructions. In this paper, we first introduce a reasoning reconstruction task. This task inputs an implicit instruction involving complex reasoning and an RGB-D sequence, and outputs incremental 3D reconstruction of instances that conform to the instruction. To handle this task, we propose LIRA: Language Instructed Reconstruction Assistant. It leverages a multimodal large language model to actively reason about the implicit instruction and obtain instruction-relevant 2D candidate instances and their attributes. Then, candidate instances are back-projected into the incrementally reconstructed 3D geometric map, followed by instance fusion and target instance inference. In LIRA, to achieve higher instance fusion quality, we propose TIFF, a Text-enhanced Instance Fusion module operating within Fragment bounding volume, which is learning-based and fuses multiple keyframes simultaneously. Since the evaluation system for this task is not well established, we propose a benchmark ReasonRecon comprising the largest collection of scene-instruction data samples involving implicit reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that LIRA outperforms existing methods in the reasoning reconstruction task and is capable of running in real time. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/zhen6618/LIRA.
authors: Zhen Zhou, Tong Wang, Yunkai Ma, Xiao Tan, Fengshui Jing ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1762-1772

title: 基于对话的图像生成控制中的大语言模型思维发散与收敛
title_en: LLM Thought Divergence and Convergence for Dialogue-Based Image Generation Control
abstract: 生成式AI(GenAI)革新了计算机视觉和自然语言处理领域,近期持续引发关注。随着大语言模型(LLMs)的发展,图像生成任务从基于提示的模式演进为基于对话的模式,该模式通过对话表达真实世界的人类意图。当将该任务分解为多个步骤时,分析对话的最佳路径尚未确定,例如在对话分析的第一步应优先关注对象还是提示模板。因此,需要采用多链推理方法,将该应用分解为纯链式思维结构之外的模式。在发散过程完成后,问题转化为如何收敛至最佳匹配图像的思维链,这需要新的评估方法引导思维过程。为解决这些挑战,我们提出大语言模型思维发散与收敛(LTDC)框架,通过三个阶段模拟人类认知过程:(1)分步思维过程利用LLMs将基于对话的图像生成任务分解为顺序思维链;(2)图像生成过程根据这些思维指令创建图像提示并生成对应图像;(3)评估过程通过多模态LLM对生成图像与对话的连贯性进行对齐,指导最优思维链的选择。在VisDial数据集上的评估显示,我们的LTE框架在CLIP相似度上提升了4.87%,证明了在生成语义保真度更高的图像方面的有效性。
abstract_en: Generative AI (GenAI), which revolutionized both computer vision and natural language processing, has drawn continuous attention recently. Benefits from GenAI with the evolution of large language models (LLMs), the image generation task evolved from prompt-based to dialogue-based, which takes the real-world human intent expressed through conversations. When breaking this task into multiple steps, the best pathway of analyzing the dialogues is not determined, such as whether the objects or prompted template should be focused on the first step of dialogues analyzing. Thus, a multi-chain reasoning is requested to decompose this application beyond a pure chain-of-thought structure. After the divergent process, the question comes to how to converge the thinking chain that leads to the best matched image, which requires a new evaluation method to lead the thinking process. To address these challenges, we propose the LLM Thought Divergence and Convergence (LTDC) framework, which simulates human cognitive processes through three phases: (1) The Step-by-Step Thought process decomposes dialogue-based image generation tasks into sequential thinking chains using LLMs; (2) The Image Generation process creates image prompts following these thought instructions and produces corresponding images; (3) The Evaluation process aligns the coherence between generated images and dialogues through a multi-modal LLM, guiding the selection of optimal thinking chains. Evaluated on VisDial, our LTE framework achieves a 4.87% improvement in CLIP similarity, demonstrating the effectiveness in generating images with higher semantic fidelity.
authors: Hui Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18101-18110

title: LLM辅助的语义引导稀疏标注遥感目标检测
title_en: LLM-Assisted Semantic Guidance for Sparsely Annotated Remote Sensing Object Detection
abstract: 由于密集目标分布和类别不平衡,遥感目标检测中的稀疏标注带来了显著挑战。尽管现有的密集伪标签方法在伪标签任务中展现出显著潜力,但仍受限于选择歧义和置信度估计不一致性。本文提出一种针对稀疏标注遥感目标检测的LLM辅助语义引导框架,利用大语言模型(LLMs)的先进语义推理能力提炼高置信度伪标签。通过集成LLM生成的语义先验,我们提出了一种类感知密集伪标签分配机制,自适应地为无标签和稀疏标注数据分配伪标签,确保在不同数据分布下的稳健监督。此外,我们开发了一种自适应难负样本重加权模块,通过削弱混杂背景信息的影响来稳定监督学习分支。在DOTA和HRSC2016上的大量实验表明,所提方法优于现有基于单阶段检测器的框架,在稀疏标注下显著提升了检测性能。
abstract_en: Sparse annotation in remote sensing object detection poses significant challenges due to dense object distributions and category imbalances.
