abstract_en: Visual grounding tasks, such as referring image segmentation (RIS) and referring expression comprehension (REC), aim to localize a target object based on a given textual description. The target object in an image can be described in multiple ways, reflecting diverse attributes such as color, position, and more. However, most existing methods rely on a single textual input, which captures only a fraction of the rich information available in the visual domain. This mismatch between rich visual details and sparse textual cues can lead to the misidentification of similar objects. To address this, we propose a novel visual grounding framework that leverages multiple latent expressions generated from a single textual input by incorporating complementary visual details absent from the original description. Specifically, we introduce subject distributor and visual concept injector modules to embed both shared-subject and distinct-attributes concepts into the latent representations, thereby capturing unique and target-specific visual cues. We also propose a positive-margin contrastive learning strategy to align all latent expressions with the original text while preserving subtle variations. Experimental results show that our method not only outperforms state-of-the-art RIS and REC approaches on multiple benchmarks but also achieves outstanding performance on the generalized referring expression segmentation (GRES) benchmark.
authors: Seonghoon Yu, Joonbeom Hong, Joonseok Lee, Jeany Son ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21374-21383

title: 二维长格式潜在生成的潜在交换联合扩散
title_en: Latent Swap Joint Diffusion for 2D Long-Form Latent Generation
abstract: 本文提出Swap Forward (SaFa),一种模态无关且高效的生成方法,通过多视角下的潜在交换联合扩散过程,实现无缝且连贯的长频谱和全景图生成。我们首先研究了现有联合扩散方法在基于频谱的音频生成中导致频谱混叠问题的原因。通过对比分析频谱与RGB图像的VAE潜表示,我们发现频谱混叠问题源于分步平均算子对高频成分的过度抑制。为解决这一问题,我们提出自环潜在交换(Self-Loop Latent Swap),一种基于帧级双向交换算子,应用于相邻视角的重叠区域。利用分步差异化轨迹,该交换算子可避免频谱失真并自适应增强高频成分。此外,为提升非重叠区域的全局跨视角一致性,我们引入参考引导潜在交换(Reference-Guided Latent Swap),一种单向潜在交换算子,通过集中参考轨迹同步子视角扩散。通过优化交换时机与间隔,我们以前馈方式实现跨视角相似性与多样性的平衡。定量与定性实验表明,SaFa在使用U-Net和DiT模型进行音频生成时显著优于现有联合扩散方法及基于训练的方法,且在全景图生成中表现优异,速度提升达2至20倍。项目网站地址为https://swapforward.github.io。
abstract_en: This paper introduces Swap Forward (SaFa), a modality-agnostic and efficient method to generate seamless and coherent long spectrum and panorama using a latent swap joint diffusion process across multi-views. We first investigate spectrum aliasing problem in spectrum-based audio generation caused by existing joint diffusion methods. Through a comparative analysis of the VAE latent representation of spectra and RGB images, we identify that the failure arises from excessive suppression of high-frequency components due to the step-wise averaging operator. To address this issue, we propose Self-Loop Latent Swap, a frame-level bidirectional swap operator, applied to the overlapping region of adjacent views. Leveraging step-wise differentiated trajectories, this swap operator avoids spectrum distortion and adaptively enhances high-frequency components. Furthermore, to improve global cross-view consistency in non-overlapping regions, we introduce Reference-Guided Latent Swap, a unidirectional latent swap operator that provides a centralized reference trajectory to synchronize subview diffusions. By refining swap timing and intervals, we canachieve a balance between cross-view similarity and diversity in a feed-forward manner. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that SaFa significantly outperforms existing joint diffusion methods and even training-based methods in audio generation using both U-Net and DiT models. It also adapts well to panorama generation, achieving comparable performance with a 2 xto 20 xspeedup. The project website is available at https://swapforward.github.io.
authors: Yusheng Dai, Chenxi Wang, Chang Li, Chen Wang, Kewei Li, Jun Du, Lei Sun, Jianqing Gao, Ruoyu Wang, Jiefeng Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11006-11015

title: Latent-Reframe: 无需训练的视频扩散模型相机控制方法
title_en: Latent-Reframe: Enabling Camera Control for Video Diffusion Models without Training
abstract: 精确的相机姿态控制对视频生成至关重要。现有方法需要使用包含配对视频和相机姿态标注的额外数据集进行微调,这些方法既数据密集又计算成本高昂,且可能破坏模型从训练数据中学到的分布。我们提出Latent-Reframe,可在无需微调的预训练视频扩散模型中实现相机控制。与现有方法不同,Latent-Reframe在采样阶段进行操作,保持效率的同时保留预训练阶段学到的分布。我们的方法通过时间感知点云对齐视频帧的潜码,随后通过潜码修复与调和优化模型的潜码空间,确保高质量视频生成。Latent-Reframe可应用于基于DiT和UNet的视频扩散模型。实验结果表明,Latent-Reframe在无需额外数据集微调的情况下,可实现与训练方法相当或更优的相机控制精度和视频质量。
abstract_en: Precise camera pose control is crucial for video generation with diffusion models. Existing methods require fine-tuning with additional datasets containing paired videos and camera pose annotations, which are both data-intensive and computationally costly, and may disrupt the model's distribution learned from the training data. We introduce Latent-Reframe, which enables camera control in a pre-trained video diffusion model without fine-tuning. Unlike existing methods, Latent-Reframe operates during the sampling stage, maintaining efficiency while preserving the distribution learned during pretraining. Our approach reframes the latent code of video frames to align with the input camera trajectory through time-aware point clouds. Latent code inpainting and harmonization then refine the model's latent space, ensuring high-quality video generation. Latent-Reframe can be applied to both DiT- and UNet-based video diffusion models. Experimental results demonstrate that Latent-Reframe can achieve comparable or superior camera control precision and video quality to training-based methods, without the need for fine-tuning on additional datasets.
authors: Zhenghong Zhou, Jie An, Jiebo Luo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12779-12789

title: Latte:联邦学习中视觉-语言模型的协作测试时适应
title_en: Latte: Collaborative Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models in Federated Learning
abstract: 使用预训练视觉-语言模型进行测试时适应,因其在解决测试期间的分布偏移问题上受到越来越多的关注。在这些方法中,基于记忆的算法因其无需训练的特性以及能够利用历史测试数据的能力而脱颖而出。然而,现有的测试时适应方法通常针对单个数据量丰富的领域进行设计。在联邦学习等去中心化场景中,将这些方法单独应用于每个客户端会因测试数据有限而受限,而通过服务器直接共享单一全局记忆则无法对每个客户端的独特分布进行有效个性化。为了解决这一问题,我们提出Latte,一个新颖的框架,其中每个客户端维护一个本地记忆以存储其自身历史测试数据的嵌入,以及一个外部记忆以存储其他相关客户端的类别原型。在通信过程中,每个客户端在服务器的协调下从相似客户端检索原型以扩展其记忆。在本地适应中,Latte同时利用嵌入相似性和不确定性来提升模型性能。我们的理论分析表明,Latte能够有效利用分布内客户端,同时对分布外客户端保持鲁棒性。在领域适应和损坏基准上的大量实验验证了Latte在去中心化场景中表现出优越的性能,同时仅引入微乎其微的通信和计算成本。我们的代码可在https://github.com/baowenxuan/Latte获取。
abstract_en: Test-time adaptation with pre-trained vision-language models has gained increasing attention for addressing distribution shifts during testing. Among these approaches, memory-based algorithms stand out due to their training-free nature and ability to leverage historical test data. However, existing test-time adaptation methods are typically designed for a single domain with abundant data. In decentralized settings such as federated learning, applying these methods individually to each client suffers from limited test data, while directly sharing a single global memory via the server prevents proper personalization to each client's unique distribution. To address this, we propose Latte, a novel framework where each client maintains a local memory to store embeddings from its own historical test data and an external memory to store class prototypes from other relevant clients. During communication, each client retrieves prototypes from similar clients under the server's coordination to expand its memory. For local adaptation, Latte utilizes both embedding similarity and uncertainty to enhance model performance. Our theoretical analysis shows that Latte effectively leverages in-distribution clients while remaining robust to out-of-distribution clients. Extensive experiments on domain adaptation and corruption benchmarks validate that Latte achieves superior performance in decentralized settings, while introducing only negligible communication and computation costs. Our code is available at https://github.com/baowenxuan/Latte.
authors: Wenxuan Bao, Ruxi Deng, Ruizhong Qiu, Tianxin Wei, Hanghang Tong, Jingrui He ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 133-143

title: LawDIS: 基于语言和窗口的可控二值图像分割框架
title_en: LawDIS: Language-Window-based Controllable Dichotomous Image Segmentation
abstract: 我们提出LawDIS,一种基于语言-窗口的可控二值图像分割(DIS)框架,能够生成高质量的目标掩码。我们的框架将DIS重新定义为潜在扩散模型中的图像条件掩码生成任务,从而实现用户控制的无缝集成。LawDIS引入了宏观到微观的控制模式。具体而言,在宏观模式中,我们引入了语言控制的分割策略(LS),根据用户提供的语言提示生成初始掩码;在微观模式中,窗口控制的细化策略(WR)允许在初始掩码中灵活细化用户定义的区域(即可调整大小的窗口)。通过模式切换器的协调,这些模式可独立或联合运行,使框架适用于高精度、个性化的应用。在DIS5K基准数据集上的广泛实验表明,我们的LawDIS在所有指标上均显著优于11种最先进的方法。值得注意的是,与表现第二好的模型MVANet相比,在DIS-TE数据集上,采用LS和WR策略时,我们的加权F度量值分别提升4.6%,仅采用LS策略时提升3.6%。代码将开源于https://github.com/XinyuYanTJU/LawDIS。
abstract_en: We present LawDIS, a language-window-based controllable dichotomous image segmentation (DIS) framework that produces high-quality object masks. Our framework recasts DIS as an image-conditioned mask generation task within a latent diffusion model, enabling seamless integration of user controls. LawDIS is enhanced with macro-to-micro control modes. Specifically, in macro mode, we introduce a language-controlled segmentation strategy (LS) to generate an initial mask based on user-provided language prompts. In micro mode, a window-controlled refinement strategy (WR) allows flexible refinement of user-defined regions (i.e., size-adjustable windows) within the initial mask. Coordinated by a mode switcher, these modes can operate independently or jointly, making the framework well-suited for high-accuracy, personalised applications. Extensive experiments on the DIS5K benchmark reveal that our LawDIS significantly outperforms 11 cutting-edge methods across all metrics. Notably, compared to the second-best model MVANet, we achieve weighted F-measure gains of 4.6% with both the LS and WR strategies and 3.6% gains with only the LS strategy on DIS-TE. Codes will be made available at https://github.com/XinyuYanTJU/LawDIS.
authors: Xinyu Yan, Meijun Sun, Ge-Peng Ji, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Salman Khan, Deng-Ping Fan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23902-23911

title: Lay-Your-Scene: 基于扩散变换器的自然场景布局生成
title_en: Lay-Your-Scene: Natural Scene Layout Generation with Diffusion Transformers
abstract: 我们提出Lay-Your-Scene(简称LayouSyn),一种新型的文本到自然场景布局生成管道。现有场景布局生成方法要么采用封闭词汇,要么依赖专有大语言模型进行开放词汇生成,这限制了其建模能力和在可控图像生成中的广泛应用。在本工作中,我们提出使用轻量级开源语言模型从文本提示中获取场景元素,并采用一种新型面向长宽比的扩散变换器架构,在开放词汇方式下进行条件布局生成。大量实验表明,LayouSyn优于现有方法,并在具有挑战性的空间与数值推理基准测试中达到最先进水平。此外,我们展示了LayouSyn的两个应用:首先,我们证明了从大型语言模型获得的粗略初始化可以无缝结合我们的方法以获得更优结果;其次,我们提出了一种向图像中添加物体的管道,展示了LayouSyn在图像编辑应用中的潜力。
abstract_en: We present Lay-Your-Scene (shorthand LayouSyn), a novel text-to-layout generation pipeline for natural scenes. Prior scene layout generation methods are either closed-vocabulary or use proprietary large language models for open-vocabulary generation, limiting their modeling capabilities and broader applicability in controllable image generation. In this work, we propose to use lightweight open-source language models to obtain scene elements from text prompts and a novel aspect-aware diffusion Transformer architecture trained in an open-vocabulary manner for conditional layout generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LayouSyn outperforms existing methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance on challenging spatial and numerical reasoning benchmarks. Additionally, we present two applications of LayouSyn: First, we show that coarse initialization from large language models can be seamlessly combined with our method to achieve better results. Second, we present a pipeline for adding objects to images, demonstrating the potential of LayouSyn in image editing applications.
authors: Divyansh Srivastava, Xiang Zhang, He Wen, Chenru Wen, Zhuowen Tu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17909-17919

title: Lay2Story:基于扩散变换器的布局可切换故事生成方法
title_en: Lay2Story: Extending Diffusion Transformers for Layout-Togglable Story Generation
abstract: 涉及生成一致主体的故事创作任务近期受到广泛关注。然而,现有方法无论是无需训练还是基于训练的,都因缺乏细粒度指导和帧间交互而持续面临主体一致性维护的挑战。此外,该领域高质量数据的稀缺性使得对故事创作任务的精确控制变得困难,包括主体的位置、外观、服装、表情和姿态等关键细节,从而阻碍了进一步发展。本文证明,布局条件(如主体位置和详细属性)能有效促进帧间的细粒度交互。这不仅增强了生成帧序列的一致性,还允许对主体位置、外观等关键细节进行精确控制。在此基础上,我们引入了一项先进的故事创作任务:布局可切换故事创作,通过整合布局条件实现对主体的精确控制。为解决该任务缺乏带布局标注的高质量数据集的问题,我们开发了Lay2Story-1M数据集,包含超过100万张720p及以上分辨率的图像,这些图像源自约11300小时的动画视频。基于Lay2Story-1M,我们构建了Lay2Story-Bench基准测试集,包含3000个提示,用于评估不同方法在该任务上的性能。此外,我们提出了Lay2Story框架,该框架基于扩散变换器(DiTs)架构,专门用于布局可切换故事创作任务。通过定性和定量实验,我们发现所提方法优于先前最先进的技术,在一致性、语义相关性和审美质量方面均取得最佳结果。
abstract_en: Storytelling tasks involving generating consistent subjects have gained significant attention recently. However, existing methods, whether training-free or training-based, continue to face challenges in maintaining subject consistency due to the lack of fine-grained guidance and inter-frame interaction. Additionally, the scarcity of high-quality data in this field makes it difficult to precisely control storytelling tasks, including the subject's position, appearance, clothing, expression, and posture, thereby hindering further advancements. In this paper, we demonstrate that layout conditions, such as the subject's position and detailed attributes, effectively facilitate fine-grained interactions between frames. This not only strengthens the consistency of the generated frame sequence but also allows for precise control over the subject's position, appearance, and other key details. Building on this, we introduce an advanced storytelling task: Layout-Toggable Storytelling, which enables precise subject control by incorporating layout conditions. To address the lack of high-quality datasets with layout annotations for this task, we develop Lay2Story-1M, which contains over 1 million 720p and higher-resolution images, processed from approximately 11,300 hours of cartoon videos. Building on Lay2Story-1M, we create Lay2Story-Bench, a benchmark with 3,000 prompts designed to evaluate the performance of different methods on this task. Furthermore, we propose Lay2Story, a robust framework based on the Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) architecture for Layout-Togglable Storytelling tasks. Through both qualitative and quantitative experiments, we find that our method outperforms the previous state-of-the-art (SOTA) techniques, achieving the best results in terms of consistency, semantic correlation, and aesthetic quality.
authors: Ao Ma, Jiasong Feng, Ke Cao, Jing Wang, Yun Wang, Quanwei Zhang, Zhanjie Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16102-16111

title: 基于解耦注意力的逐层视觉注入高效大视觉-语言模型
title_en: Layer-wise Vision Injection with Disentangled Attention for Efficient LVLMs
abstract: 受益于近期在大语言模型和模态对齐技术方面的进展,现有大视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)已在广泛场景中取得了显著性能。然而,过高的计算复杂度限制了这些模型在实际应用中的普及。我们认为计算复杂度的主要瓶颈源于语言解码器中冗余视觉序列的参与。这源于对LVLMs语言解码器中视觉与语言信息传输效率的重新评估。随后,我们提出了一种新颖的视觉-语言交互机制,称为逐层视觉注入与解耦注意力(LVIDA)。在LVIDA中,仅语言序列经历完整的前向传播,而视觉序列在每个语言解码器层的特定阶段与语言进行交互。令人惊讶的是,我们的方法在几乎不损失性能的情况下显著降低了计算复杂度。具体而言,LVIDA在多个LVLM模型中实现了语言解码器计算成本约10倍的降低,同时保持了相当的性能。项目页面:https://xuange923.github.io/LVIDA/
abstract_en: Benefiting from recent advancements in large language models and modality alignment techniques, existing Large Vision-Language Models(LVLMs) have achieved prominent performance across a wide range of scenarios. However, the excessive computational complexity limits the widespread use of these models in practical applications. We argue that one main bottleneck in computational complexity is caused by the involvement of redundant vision sequences in model computation. This is inspired by a reassessment of the efficiency of vision and language information transmission in the language decoder of LVLMs. Then, we propose a novel vision-language interaction mechanism called Layer-wise Vision Injection with Disentangled Attention (LVIDA). In LVIDA, only the language sequence undergoes full forward propagation, while the vision sequence interacts with the language at specific stages within each language decoder layer. It is striking that our approach significantly reduces computational complexity with minimal performance loss. Specifically, LVIDA achieves approximately a 10x reduction in the computational cost of the language decoder across multiple LVLM models while maintaining comparable performance. Project Page: https://xuange923.github.io/LVIDA/
authors: Xuange Zhang, Dengjie Li, Bo Liu, Zenghao Bao, Yao Zhou, Baisong Yang, Zhongying Liu, Yujie Zhong, Tongtong Yuan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7004-7013

title: LayerAnimate:动画的层级控制
title_en: LayerAnimate: Layer-level Control for Animation
abstract: 传统动画制作将视觉元素分解为离散层,以便对草图、细化、着色和中间帧进行独立处理。现有动漫生成视频方法通常将动画视为与现实视频不同的独立数据域,缺乏对单个图层的精细控制。为弥合这一差距,我们引入LayerAnimate,这是一种具有层感知架构的新型视频扩散框架,通过层级控制实现对图层的操作。由于专业动画资产的商业敏感性,开发层感知框架面临显著的数据稀缺挑战。为解决这一限制,我们提出包含自动化元素分割和基于运动的分层合并的数据整理流程。通过定量和定性比较及用户研究,我们证明LayerAnimate在动画质量、控制精度和可用性方面均优于现有方法,使其成为专业动画师和业余爱好者的有效工具。该框架为层级动画应用和创作灵活性开辟了新可能。我们的代码可在https://layeranimate.github.io获取。
abstract_en: Traditional animation production decomposes visual elements into discrete layers to enable independent processing for sketching, refining, coloring, and in-betweening. Existing anime generation video methods typically treat animation as a distinct data domain different from real-world videos, lacking fine-grained control at the layer level. To bridge this gap, we introduce LayerAnimate, a novel video diffusion framework with layer-aware architecture that empowers the manipulation of layers through layer-level controls. The development of a layer-aware framework faces a significant data scarcity challenge due to the commercial sensitivity of professional animation assets. To address the limitation, we propose a data curation pipeline featuring Automated Element Segmentation and Motion-based Hierarchical Merging. Through quantitative and qualitative comparisons and user study, we demonstrate that LayerAnimate outperforms current methods in terms of animation quality, control precision, and usability, making it an effective tool for both professional animators and amateur enthusiasts. This framework opens up new possibilities for layer-level animation applications and creative flexibility. Our code is available at https://layeranimate.github.io.
authors: Yuxue Yang, Lue Fan, Zuzeng Lin, Feng Wang, Zhaoxiang Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10865-10874

title: LayerD:将栅格图形设计分解为图层
title_en: LayerD: Decomposing Raster Graphic Designs into Layers
abstract: 设计师在图层表示中创作和编辑图形设计,但一旦合成栅格图像,基于图层的编辑将变得不可能。在本工作中,我们提出LayerD,一种将栅格图形设计分解为图层以实现可重新编辑的创意工作流的方法。LayerD通过迭代提取未被遮挡的前景图层来解决分解任务。我们提出了一种简单而有效的优化方法,利用图形设计中图层通常表现出统一外观的假设。由于分解任务具有歧义性且真实图层结构可能不可靠,我们开发了一种质量度量方法以应对这一挑战。实验表明,LayerD成功实现了高质量的分解并优于基线方法。我们还展示了LayerD与最先进的图像生成器和基于图层的编辑工具的结合应用。代码和模型已公开获取。
abstract_en: Designers craft and edit graphic designs in a layer representation, but layer-based editing becomes impossible once composited into a raster image. In this work, we propose LayerD, a method to decompose raster graphic designs into layers for re-editable creative workflow. LayerD addresses the decomposition task by iteratively extracting unoccluded foreground layers. We propose a simple yet effective refinement approach taking advantage of the assumption that layers often exhibit uniform appearance in graphic designs. As decomposition is ill-posed and the ground-truth layer structure may not be reliable, we develop a quality metric that addresses the difficulty. In experiments, we show that LayerD successfully achieves high-quality decomposition and outperforms baselines. We also demonstrate the use of LayerD with state-of-the-art image generators and layer-based editing. Code and models are publicly available.
authors: Tomoyuki Suzuki, Kang-Jun Liu, Naoto Inoue, Kota Yamaguchi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17783-17792

title: LayerLock:基于渐进冻结的非坍缩表征学习
title_en: LayerLock: Non-collapsing Representation Learning with Progressive Freezing
abstract: 我们提出LayerLock,这是一种简单而有效的自监督视觉表征学习方法,通过渐进层冻结策略,在训练过程中逐步从预测浅层特征过渡到深层特征。首先,我们观察到在视频掩码自编码器(MAE)模型训练中,ViT层按深度顺序收敛:浅层特征收敛较早,深层特征收敛较晚。随后,我们证明这一观察结果可通过在训练过程中根据显式调度逐步冻结模型来加速标准MAE。此外,相同的调度策略还可用于一种简单且可扩展的潜在预测方法,该方法不会出现"表征坍缩"问题。我们将所提出的LayerLock方法应用于像素和潜在预测方法,使用高达4B参数的大模型,并在语义(动作分类)和低级(深度估计)视觉任务上均取得性能提升。
abstract_en: We introduce LayerLock, a simple yet effective approach for self-supervised visual representation learning, that gradually transitions throughout training from predicting shallow features to deeper ones through progressive layer freezing. First, we make the observation that during training of video masked-autoencoding (MAE) models, ViT layers converge in the order of their depth: shallower layers converge early, deeper layers converge late. We then show that this observation can be exploited to accelerate standard MAE by progressively freezing the model according to an explicit schedule, throughout training. Furthermore, this same schedule can be used in a simple and scalable approach to latent prediction that does not suffer from "representation collapse". We apply our proposed approach, LayerLock, to both pixel and latent prediction approaches with large models of up to 4B parameters and show improvements on both semantic (action classification) and low level (depth estimation) vision tasks.
authors: Goker Erdogan, Nikhil Parthasarathy, Catalin Ionescu, Drew A. Hudson, Alexander Lerchner, Andrew Zisserman, Mehdi S. M. Sajjadi, Joao Carreira ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19461-19470

title: LayerTracer:基于扩散变换器的认知对齐分层SVG合成
title_en: LayerTracer: Cognitive-Aligned Layered SVG Synthesis via Diffusion Transformer
abstract: 由于现有方法倾向于产生过度简化的单层输出或优化导致的形状冗余,生成认知对齐的分层SVG仍具挑战性。我们提出LayerTracer,一个基于DiT的框架,通过从新型序贯设计操作数据集中学习设计师的分层SVG创作过程,弥合这一差距。我们的方法包含两个阶段:首先,文本条件化的DiT生成多阶段栅格化构造蓝图,模拟人类设计工作流;其次,逐层向量化与路径去重生成整洁可编辑的SVG。针对图像向量化,我们引入条件扩散机制,将参考图像编码为潜在标记,指导分层重建同时保持结构完整性。大量实验表明,LayerTracer在生成质量与可编辑性方面超越了基于优化和神经网络的基线方法。
abstract_en: Generating cognitive-aligned layered SVGs remains challenging due to existing methods' tendencies toward either oversimplified single-layer outputs or optimization-induced shape redundancies. We propose LayerTracer, a DiT based framework that bridges this gap by learning designers' layered SVG creation processes from a novel dataset of sequential design operations. Our approach operates in two phases: First, a text-conditioned DiT generates multi-phase rasterized construction blueprints that simulate human design workflows. Second, layer-wise vectorization with path deduplication produces clean, editable SVGs. For image vectorization, we introduce a conditional diffusion mechanism that encodes reference images into latent tokens, guiding hierarchical reconstruction while preserving structural integrity. Extensive experiments show that LayerTracer surpasses optimization-based and neural baselines in generation quality and editability.
authors: Yiren Song, Danze Chen, Mike Zheng Shou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19731-19741

title: LazyMAR:通过特征缓存加速掩码自回归模型
title_en: LazyMAR: Accelerating Masked Autoregressive Models via Feature Caching
abstract: 掩码自回归(MAR)模型已成为图像生成领域的一种有前景的方法,通过利用并行解码能力,有望在计算效率上超越传统自回归模型。然而,其对双向自注意力机制的依赖本质上与常规的键值缓存机制存在冲突,导致意想不到的计算瓶颈,削弱了其预期的效率。为解决这一问题,本文通过利用两种类型的冗余研究MAR的缓存机制:令牌冗余表明在相邻解码步骤中,大量令牌具有非常相似的表示,这使我们能够先在前一步骤缓存它们,再在后续步骤中复用;条件冗余表明在分类器自由引导中,条件输出与无条件输出之间的差异在相邻步骤中表现出非常相似的值。基于这两种冗余,我们提出LazyMAR,其引入两种缓存机制分别处理它们。LazyMAR对所有MAR模型均无需训练且即插即用。实验结果表明,我们的方法实现了2.83倍的加速,且生成质量几乎无下降。我们的代码将在https://github.com/feihongyan1/LazyMAR发布。
abstract_en: Masked Autoregressive (MAR) models have emerged as a promising approach in image generation, expected to surpass traditional autoregressive models in computational efficiency by leveraging the capability of parallel decoding. However, their dependence on bidirectional self-attention inherently conflicts with conventional KV caching mechanisms, creating unexpected computational bottlenecks that undermine their expected efficiency. To address this problem, this paper studies the caching mechanism for MAR by leveraging two types of redundancy: Token Redundancy indicates that a large portion of tokens have very similar representations in the adjacent decoding steps, which allows us to first cache them in previous steps and then reuse them in the later steps. Condition Redundancy indicates that the difference between conditional and unconditional output in classifier-free guidance exhibits very similar values in adjacent steps. Based on these two redundancies, we propose LazyMAR, which introduces two caching mechanisms to handle them one by one. LazyMAR is training-free and plug-and-play for all MAR models. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves 2.83 times acceleration with almost no drop in generation quality. Our codes will be released in https://github.com/feihongyan1/LazyMAR.
authors: Feihong Yan, Qingyan Wei, Jiayi Tang, Jiajun Li, Yulin Wang, Xuming Hu, Huiqi Li, Linfeng Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15552-15561

title: LeGrad: 一种基于特征形成敏感性的视觉变换器可解释性方法
title_en: LeGrad: An Explainability Method for Vision Transformers via Feature Formation Sensitivity
abstract: 视觉变换器(ViTs)已成为计算机视觉的标准架构。然而,由于其通过自注意力机制建模长程依赖关系,这些模型的可解释性仍面临挑战。为解决这一问题,我们提出LeGrad,一种专门针对ViTs的可解释性方法。LeGrad计算相对于单个ViT层注意力图的梯度,将梯度本身作为可解释性信号。我们对所有层的信号进行聚合,结合最后以及中间token的激活,生成合并的可解释性图。这使LeGrad成为一种概念简单且易于实现的方法,以增强ViTs的透明度。我们在多种设置中评估LeGrad,包括分割、扰动和开放词汇设置,展示了其相比其他SotA可解释性方法在空间保真度上的提升和多功能性。演示和代码可在https://walidbousselham.com/LeGrad获取
abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have become a standard architecture in computer vision. However, because of their modeling of long-range dependencies through self-attention mechanisms, the explainability of these models remains a challenge. To address this, we propose LeGrad, an explainability method specifically designed for ViTs. LeGrad computes the gradient with respect to the attention maps of single ViT layers, considering the gradient itself as the explainability signal. We aggregate the signal over all layers, combining the activations of the last as well as intermediate tokens to produce the merged explainability map. This makes LeGrad a conceptually simple and an easy-to-implement method to enhance the transparency of ViTs. We evaluate LeGrad in various setups, including segmentation, perturbation, and open-vocabulary settings, showcasing its improved spatial fidelity and its versatility compared to other SotA explainability methods. A demo and the code is available at https://walidbousselham.com/LeGrad
authors: Walid Bousselham, Angie Boggust, Sofian Chaybouti, Hendrik Strobelt, Hilde Kuehne ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20336-20345

title: LeanVAE:一种用于视频扩散模型的超高效重建变分自编码器
title_en: LeanVAE: An Ultra-Efficient Reconstruction VAE for Video Diffusion Models
abstract: 近期潜在视频扩散模型(LVDMs)的进展通过利用视频变分自编码器(Video VAEs)将复杂视频数据压缩到紧凑的潜在空间,彻底革新了视频生成。然而,随着LVDM训练规模扩大,视频变分自编码器的计算开销成为关键瓶颈,尤其在编码高分辨率视频时。为解决这一问题,我们提出LeanVAE,一种新颖且超高效的视频变分自编码器框架,包含两项关键创新:(1) 基于邻域感知前馈(NAF)模块和非重叠块操作的轻量架构,显著降低计算成本;(2) 融合小波变换与压缩感知技术以提升重建质量。大量实验验证了LeanVAE在视频重建与生成中的优越性,特别是在提升效率方面超越现有视频变分自编码器。我们的模型在保持竞争力重建质量的同时,提供高达50倍的FLOPs减少和44倍的推理速度提升,为可扩展、高效的视频生成提供了见解。我们的模型和代码可在https://github.com/westlake-repl/LeanVAE获取。
abstract_en: Recent advances in Latent Video Diffusion Models (LVDMs) have revolutionized video generation by leveraging Video Variational Autoencoders (Video VAEs) to compress intricate video data into a compact latent space. However, as LVDM training scales, the computational overhead of Video VAEs becomes a critical bottleneck, particularly for encoding high-resolution videos. To address this, we propose LeanVAE, a novel and ultra-efficient Video VAE framework that introduce two key innovations: (1) a lightweight architecture based on a Neighborhood-Aware Feedforward (NAF) module and non-overlapping patch operations, drastically reducing computational cost, and (2) the integration of wavelet transforms and compressed sensing techniques to enhance reconstruction quality. Extensive experiments validate LeanVAE's superiority in video reconstruction and generation, particularly in enhancing efficiency over existing Video VAEs. Our model offers up to 50x fewer FLOPs and 44x faster inference speed while maintaining competitive reconstruction quality, providing insights for scalable, efficient video generation. Our models and code are available at https://github.com/westlake-repl/LeanVAE.
authors: Yu Cheng, Fajie Yuan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15692-15702

title: 飞跃与界限:一种改进的点云缠绕数公式用于快速法线估计和曲面重建
title_en: Leaps and Bounds: An Improved Point Cloud Winding Number Formulation for Fast Normal Estimation and Surface Reconstruction
abstract: 近期的点云曲面法线估计方法主要采用由法线诱导的广义缠绕数场。通过优化该场以满足输入点位于该场定义的曲面上等属性,提供了一种获得全局一致曲面法线的原理性方法。然而,我们证明现有的点云缠绕数公式在输入表面点附近是较差的近似,当查询点接近表面点时会出现发散现象。这对依赖该近似准确性和稳定性的方法提出了挑战,需要启发式方法进行补偿。相反,我们推导出一种更精确的近似方法,该方法具有正确的有界性并收敛到正确值。随后,我们考察了两种不同的方法,通过点云缠绕数优化全局一致的法线。我们展示了原始无界公式对两种方法关键设计选择的影响,并证明替换我们的公式在法线估计和曲面重建准确性方面取得了实质性改进。
abstract_en: Recent methods for point cloud surface normal estimation predominantly use the generalized winding number field induced by the normals. Optimizing the field towards satisfying desired properties, such as the input points being on the surface defined by the field, provides a principled way to obtain globally consistent surface normals. However, we show that the existing winding number formulation for point clouds is a poor approximation near the input surface points, diverging as the query point approaches a surface point. This is problematic for methods that rely on the accuracy and stability of this approximation, requiring heuristics to compensate. Instead, we derive a more accurate approximation that is properly bounded and converges to the correct value. We then examine two distinct approaches that optimize for globally consistent normals using point cloud winding numbers. We show how the original unbounded formulation influences key design choices in both methods and demonstrate that substituting our formulation yields substantive improvements with respect to normal estimation and surface reconstruction accuracy.
authors: Chamin Hewa Koneputugodage, Dylan Campbell, Stephen Gould ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26116-26125

title: Learn2Synth:利用超梯度进行脑图像分割的最优数据合成学习
title_en: Learn2Synth: Learning Optimal Data Synthesis Using Hypergradients for Brain Image Segmentation
abstract: 通过合成实现的领域随机化是一种强大的策略,用于训练对输入图像领域无偏的网络。随机化使网络在训练过程中能够接触到几乎无限的强度和伪影范围,从而最小化对表观特征的过拟合并最大化对未见数据的泛化能力。尽管该方法强大,但其依赖于准确调整一组控制合成图像概率分布的大量超参数。为了避免手动调整这些参数,我们引入了Learn2Synth,这是一种新颖的流程,通过少量真实标注数据学习合成参数。与通过约束对齐合成数据与真实数据的方法(如对比或对抗技术)不同,这些方法可能风险导致图像与其标签图错位,我们则调整增强引擎,使得在真实数据上训练的分割网络在应用于真实数据时具有最优精度。该方法使训练过程能够受益于真实标注示例,而从未使用这些真实示例训练分割网络,从而避免网络偏向训练集的特性。具体而言,我们开发了参数化和非参数化策略,以增强合成图像的方式提升分割网络的性能。我们在合成和真实世界脑扫描数据上验证了该学习策略的有效性。代码可在:https://github.com/HuXiaoling/Learn2Synth 获取。
abstract_en: Domain randomization through synthesis is a powerful strategy to train networks that are unbiased with respect to the domain of the input images. Randomization allows networks to see a virtually infinite range of intensities and artifacts during training, thereby minimizing overfitting to appearance and maximizing generalization to unseen data. Although powerful, this approach relies on the accurate tuning of a large set of hyperparameters that govern the probabilistic distribution of the synthesized images. Instead of manually tuning these parameters, we introduce Learn2Synth, a novel procedure in which synthesis parameters are learned using a small set of real labeled data. Unlike methods that impose constraints to align synthetic data with real data (e.g., contrastive or adversarial techniques), which risk misaligning the image and its label map, we tune an augmentation engine such that a segmentation network trained on synthetic data has optimal accuracy when applied to real data. This approach allows the training procedure to benefit from real labeled examples, without ever using these real examples to train the segmentation network, which avoids biasing the network towards the properties of the training set. Specifically, we develop parametric and nonparametric strategies to enhance synthetic images in a way that improves the performance of the segmentation network. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this learning strategy on synthetic and real-world brain scans. Code is available at: https://github.com/HuXiaoling/Learn2Synth.
authors: Xiaoling Hu, Xiangrui Zeng, Oula Puonti, Juan Eugenio Iglesias, Bruce Fischl, Yaël Balbastre ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20368-20378

title: 可学习特征块与向量提升无需外部知识的低光照图像增强
title_en: Learnable Feature Patches and Vectors for Boosting Low-light Image Enhancement without External Knowledge
abstract: 低光照图像增强(LLIE)面临的主要挑战是其病态性:低光照图像通常缺乏足够的信息与正常光照图像对齐(例如,并非所有训练数据都能完全拟合真实值)。大量研究尝试通过引入有效的附加信息来弥合低光照与正常光照数据之间的差距,本文将此类信息称为“参考”。然而,现有方法忽略了训练数据集内部蕴含的宝贵参考信息。本文提出了一种新颖的LLIE策略,通过神经网络同时学习图像特定特征,并从训练数据中提取有效的公共特征作为参考。这些公共特征与LLIE网络自身无法完全拟合的样本相关联,并在隐式特征空间中表示为可学习特征块和向量(LFPVs)。LFPVs通过两种机制更新:样本更新器从训练样本中提取有用特征以优化LFPVs,以及互更新器在LFPVs之间传播信息以相互更新。通过我们设计的查询与融合过程,LFPVs可自适应地与图像特定特征对齐,从而提升LLIE性能。所提方法可集成至任意LLIE框架中,同时提升增强质量与下游任务性能。在多个基准数据集上的大量实验验证了该方法的有效性。
abstract_en: A major challenge in Low-Light Image Enhancement (LLIE) is its ill-posed nature: low-light images often lack sufficient information to align with normal-light ones (e.g., not all training data can be fully fitted to the ground truth). Numerous studies have attempted to bridge the gap between low- and normal-light data by introducing effective additional information, which is called "references" in this paper. However, existing methods overlook the valuable references hidden within the training dataset itself. In this work, we propose a novel LLIE strategy that simultaneously learns image-specific features by neural networks while formulating effective common features from the training data as the reference. These common features are correlated with the samples that are not fully fitted by the LLIE network itself, and they are represented as a set of Learnable Feature Patches and Vectors (LFPVs) in the hidden feature space. LFPVs are updated through two mechanisms: the sample-updater, which extracts useful features from training samples to refine LFPVs, and the mutual-updater, which propagates information across LFPVs to mutually update them. LFPVs can be adaptively aligned with image-specific features via our designed query-and-fusion procedure, boosting the LLIE performance. Our proposed method can be integrated into any LLIE framework, improving both enhancement quality and downstream task performance. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
authors: Xiaogang Xu, Jiafei Wu, Qingsen Yan, Jiequan Cui, Richang Hong, Bei Yu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7761-7770

title: 面向屏下光飞行时间成像及其应用的可学习分数阶反应扩散动力学
title_en: Learnable Fractional Reaction-Diffusion Dynamics for Under-Display ToF Imaging and Beyond
abstract: 屏下光飞行时间(ToF)成像旨在通过置于屏幕面板下方的ToF相机实现精确的深度感知。然而,透明有机发光二极管(TOLED)层会引入严重的退化现象——如信号衰减、多路径干扰(MPI)和时间噪声——显著降低深度质量。为缓解这一缺陷,我们提出可学习分数阶反应扩散动力学(LFRD2),一种结合神经网络表达能力与物理建模可解释性的混合框架。具体而言,我们实现了一个时间分数阶反应扩散模块,通过动态生成的微分阶数实现迭代深度优化,捕捉长期依赖关系。此外,我们通过系数预测和重复微分引入高效的连续卷积算子,进一步提升恢复质量。在四个基准数据集上的实验验证了本方法的有效性。代码已公开在https://github.com/wudiqx106/LFRD2。
abstract_en: Under-display ToF imaging aims to achieve accurate depth sensing through a ToF camera placed beneath a screen panel. However, transparent OLED (TOLED) layers introduce severe degradations--such as signal attenuation, multi-path interference (MPI), and temporal noise--that significantly compromise depth quality. To alleviate this drawback, we propose Learnable Fractional Reaction-Diffusion Dynamics (LFRD^2), a hybrid framework that combines the expressive power of neural networks with the interpretability of physical modeling. Specifically, we implement a time-fractional reaction-diffusion module that enables iterative depth refinement with dynamically generated differential orders, capturing long-term dependencies. In addition, we introduce an efficient continuous convolution operator via coefficient prediction and repeated differentiation to further improve restoration quality. Experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/wudiqx106/LFRD2.
authors: Xin Qiao, Matteo Poggi, Xing Wei, Pengchao Deng, Yanhui Zhou, Stefano Mattoccia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6080-6090

title: 面向类别分布不匹配的可学习logit调整半监督学习
title_en: Learnable Logit Adjustment for Imbalanced Semi-Supervised Learning under Class Distribution Mismatch
abstract: 在类别不平衡学习(CIL)中,后处理logit调整(LA)通过根据标签频率调整偏差logit有效缓解类别不平衡问题。鉴于LA在CIL中的成功应用,近期类别不平衡半监督学习(CISSL)算法引入了LA,当标记与未标记数据集具有相同类别分布时可提升性能。然而,现实场景中未标记数据集的类别分布常未知,可能与标记数据集存在不匹配。此时LA可能产生不适当的logit调整程度,由于无法融合未标记数据集的未知分布,可能因过度调整而降低分类性能。为解决该问题,我们提出一种新型CISSL算法——可学习logit调整(LLA)。与原始LA不同,LLA通过最小化标记与未标记数据集的类别平均损失来学习适当的logit调整程度。基于学习到的调整程度,LLA优化基础半监督学习算法的偏差伪标签,并通过调整logit修正测试集上的偏差类别预测。在基准数据集上的实验结果表明,LLA在CISSL任务中达到SOTA性能。
abstract_en: In class-imbalanced learning (CIL), post-hoc logit adjustment (LA) effectively mitigates class imbalance by adjusting biased logits according to label frequencies. Given the success of LA in CIL, recent class-imbalanced semi-supervised learning (CISSL) algorithms incorporated LA, leading to improved performance when labeled and unlabeled datasets share the same class distribution. However, a common real-world scenario involves the unknown class distribution of the unlabeled set, which may mismatch that of the labeled set. In this case, LA may result in an inappropriate degree of logit adjustments, potentially degrading classification performance due to its inability to incorporate the unknown class distribution of the unlabeled set. To address this problem, we propose a novel CISSL algorithm named learnable logit adjustment (LLA). Unlike the original LA, LLA learns the appropriate degree of logit adjustment by minimizing the class-averaged loss computed for both the labeled and unlabeled sets. Based on the learned degree, LLA refines the biased pseudo-labels of base semi-supervised learning algorithms and adjusts the biased class predictions on the test set by adjusting the logits. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that LLA achieves state-of-the-art performance in CISSL.
authors: Hyuck Lee, Taemin Park, Heeyoung Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2664-2674

title: 可学习检索增强的视觉-文本对齐与融合在放射科报告生成中的应用
title_en: Learnable Retrieval Enhanced Visual-Text Alignment and Fusion for Radiology Report Generation
abstract: 自动化放射科报告生成对于提升诊断效率和减轻医疗专业人员的工作负担至关重要。然而,现有方法面临诸如疾病类别不平衡和跨模态融合不足等显著挑战。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种可学习的检索增强视觉-文本对齐与融合(REVTAF)框架,该框架在报告生成中有效应对类别不平衡和视觉-文本融合问题。REVTAF包含两个核心组件:(1) 一个利用双曲空间语义层次结构和基于排序的度量的批次内上下文的可学习检索增强器(LRE),LRE能够自适应检索最相关的参考报告,增强图像表示,特别是对代表性不足(尾部)类输入;(2) 一种细粒度的视觉-文本对齐与融合策略,确保多源跨注意力图之间的一致性以实现精确对齐。该组件进一步采用基于最优传输的跨注意力机制,动态整合任务相关的文本知识以提升报告生成效果。通过结合自适应检索与多源对齐和融合,REVTAF在弱图像-报告级监督下实现细粒度的视觉-文本集成,同时有效缓解数据不平衡问题。实验表明,REVTAF优于现有最先进方法,在MIMIC-CXR数据集上平均提升7.4%,在IU X-Ray数据集上平均提升2.9%。与主流多模态大语言模型(如GPT系列模型)的对比进一步凸显了其在放射科报告生成中的优越性。
abstract_en: Automated radiology report generation is essential for improving diagnostic efficiency and reducing the workload of medical professionals. However, existing methods face significant challenges, such as disease class imbalance and insufficient cross-modal fusion. To address these issues, we propose the learnable Retrieval Enhanced Visual-Text Alignment and Fusion (REVTAF) framework, which effectively tackles both class imbalance and visual-text fusion in report generation. REVTAF incorporates two core components: (1) a Learnable Retrieval Enhancer (LRE) that utilizes semantic hierarchies from hyperbolic space and intra-batch context through a ranking-based metric. LRE adaptively retrieves the most relevant reference reports, enhancing image representations, particularly for underrepresented (tail) class inputs; and (2) a fine-grained visual-text alignment and fusion strategy that ensures consistency across multi-source cross-attention maps for precise alignment. This component further employs an optimal transport-based cross-attention mechanism to dynamically integrate task-relevant textual knowledge for improved report generation. By combining adaptive retrieval with multi-source alignment and fusion, REVTAF achieves fine-grained visual-text integration under weak image-report level supervision while effectively mitigating data imbalance issues. The experiments demonstrate that REVTAF outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving an average improvement of 7.4% on the MIMIC-CXR dataset and 2.9% on the IU X-Ray dataset. Comparisons with mainstream multimodal LLMs (e.g., GPT-series models), further highlight its superiority in radiology report generation.
authors: Qin Zhou, Guoyan Liang, Xindi Li, Jingyuan Chen, Zhe Wang, Chang Yao, Sai Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22529-22538

title: 基于分层渐进上下文建模的学习图像压缩
title_en: Learned Image Compression with Hierarchical Progressive Context Modeling
abstract: 上下文建模在学习图像压缩中对于准确估计潜变量分布至关重要。尽管近期先进方法已扩展了上下文建模能力,但仍难以高效利用不同编码步骤中的长程依赖关系和多样化上下文信息。本文提出了一种新颖的分层渐进上下文模型(HPCM),以更高效地获取上下文信息。具体而言,HPCM采用分层编码调度机制,按顺序建模多尺度潜变量间的上下文依赖关系,从而实现更高效的长程上下文建模。此外,我们提出了一种渐进式上下文融合机制,将前序编码步骤的上下文信息融入当前步骤,有效利用多样化上下文信息。实验结果表明,我们的方法在率失真性能上达到最先进水平,并在压缩性能与计算复杂度之间取得了更好的平衡。代码可在 https://github.com/lyq133/LIC-HPCM 获取。
abstract_en: Context modeling is essential in learned image compression for accurately estimating the distribution of latents. While recent advanced methods have expanded context modeling capacity, they still struggle to efficiently exploit long-range dependency and diverse context information across different coding steps. In this paper, we introduce a novel Hierarchical Progressive Context Model (HPCM) for more efficient context information acquisition. Specifically, HPCM employs a hierarchical coding schedule to sequentially model the contextual dependencies among latents at multiple scales, which enables more efficient long-range context modeling. Furthermore, we propose a progressive context fusion mechanism that incorporates contextual information from previous coding steps into the current step, effectively exploiting diverse contextual information. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art rate-distortion performance and strikes a better balance between compression performance and computational complexity. The code is available at https://github.com/lyq133/LIC-HPCM.
authors: Yuqi Li, Haotian Zhang, Li Li, Dong Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18834-18843

title: 从预训练2D扩散模型中学习3D物体空间关系
title_en: Learning 3D Object Spatial Relationships from Pre-trained 2D Diffusion Models
abstract: 我们提出了一种方法,通过利用预训练2D扩散模型生成的合成3D样本,学习物体对之间的3D空间关系,称为物体-物体空间关系(OOR)。我们假设由2D扩散模型合成的图像固有地捕捉到真实的OOR线索,从而能够高效地收集3D数据集,以学习各种无界物体类别的OOR。我们的方法合成多样化图像,捕捉合理的OOR线索,然后将其提升为3D样本。利用我们针对物体对的多样化3D样本集合,我们训练一个基于分数的OOR扩散模型,以学习它们相对空间关系的分布。此外,我们通过强制各对关系之间的一致性并防止物体碰撞,将我们的成对OOR扩展到多物体OOR。大量实验表明,我们的方法在各种物体间空间关系上具有鲁棒性,并且其在使用我们的OOR扩散模型进行3D场景布置任务和人体运动合成方面具有适用性。
abstract_en: We present a method for learning 3D spatial relationships between object pairs, referred to as object-object spatial relationships (OOR), by leveraging synthetically generated 3D samples from pre-trained 2D diffusion models. We hypothesize that images synthesized by 2D diffusion models inherently capture realistic OOR cues, enabling efficient collection of a 3D dataset to learn OOR for various unbounded object categories. Our approach synthesizes diverse images that capture plausible OOR cues, which we then uplift into 3D samples. Leveraging our diverse collection of 3D samples for the object pairs, we train a score-based OOR diffusion model to learn the distribution of their relative spatial relationships. Additionally, we extend our pairwise OORtomulti-object OOR by enforcing consistency across pairwise relations and preventing object collisions. Extensive experiments demonstrate the robustness of our method across various object-object spatial relationships, along with its applicability to 3D scene arrangement tasks and human motion synthesis using our OOR diffusion model.
authors: Sangwon Baik, Hyeonwoo Kim, Hanbyul Joo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8418-8428

title: 基于神经上下文场景图学习三维场景类比
title_en: Learning 3D Scene Analogies with Neural Contextual Scene Maps
abstract: 理解场景上下文对于机器在未见过或嘈杂的三维环境中执行任务并适应先验知识至关重要。由于数据驱动的学习难以全面涵盖多样化的布局和开放空间,我们提出教机器识别三维空间中的关系共性。与专注于点级或物体级表示不同,我们引入三维场景类比,即对齐空间关系的三维场景区域平滑映射。与已研究较多的单实例级映射不同,这些场景级映射可平滑连接大范围场景区域,潜在地支持AR/VR中的轨迹迁移、模仿学习中的长示范迁移以及上下文感知物体重排等独特应用。为发现三维场景类比,我们提出神经上下文场景图,该方法提取总结语义和几何上下文的描述符场,并以粗到细的方式整体对齐以估计映射。这种方法减少了对单个特征点的依赖,使其对输入噪声或形状变化具有鲁棒性。实验表明,我们的方法在识别场景类比和迁移轨迹或物体摆放位置方面在多样化室内场景中均有效,表明其在机器人技术和AR/VR应用中的潜力。项目页面(包含代码)可通过此链接访问:https://82magnolia.github.io/3d_scene_analogies/
abstract_en: Understanding scene contexts is crucial for machines to perform tasks and adapt prior knowledge in unseen or noisy 3D environments. As data-driven learning is intractable to comprehensively encapsulate diverse ranges of layouts and open spaces, we propose teaching machines to identify relational commonalities in 3D spaces. Instead of focusing on point-wise or object-wise representations, we introduce 3D scene analogies, which are smooth maps between 3D scene regions that align spatial relationships. Unlike well-studied single instance-level maps, these scene-level maps smoothly link large scene regions, potentially enabling unique applications in trajectory transfer in AR/VR, long demonstration transfer for imitation learning, and context-aware object rearrangement. To find 3D scene analogies, we propose neural contextual scene maps, which extract descriptor fields summarizing semantic and geometric contexts, and holistically align them in a coarse-to-fine manner for map estimation. This approach reduces reliance on individual feature points, making it robust to input noise or shape variations. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in identifying scene analogies and transferring trajectories or object placements in diverse indoor scenes, indicating its potential for robotics and AR/VR applications. Project page including the code is available through this link: https://82magnolia.github.io/3d_scene_analogies/.
authors: Junho Kim, Gwangtak Bae, Eun Sun Lee, Young Min Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7828-7840

title: 学习四维具身世界模型
title_en: Learning 4D Embodied World Models
abstract: 本文提出了一种有效的学习新型四维具身世界模型的方法,该模型能够预测三维场景随时间推移在具身智能体行动响应下的动态演化过程,提供空间与时间一致性。我们通过在RGB-DN(RGB、深度和法线)视频数据集上进行训练,提出学习四维世界模型的方法。这不仅通过将详细的形状、配置和时间变化纳入预测中超越了传统二维模型,还使我们能够有效学习具身智能体的准确逆动力学模型。具体而言,我们首先利用现成模型扩展现有机器人操作视频数据集,加入深度和法线信息。随后,我们在该标注数据集上微调视频生成模型,联合预测每帧的RGB-DN(RGB、深度和法线)。接着,我们提出一种算法,将生成的RGB、深度和法线视频直接转换为高质量的四维世界场景。我们的方法确保了具身场景中四维场景预测的时间与空间一致性,实现了具身环境的新视角合成,并促进了显著优于传统视频基世界模型的策略学习。
abstract_en: This paper presents an effective approach for learning novel 4D embodied world models, which predict the dynamic evolution of 3D scenes over time in response to an embodied agent's actions, providing both spatial and temporal consistency. We propose to learn a 4D world model by training on RGB-DN (RGB, Depth, and Normal) videos.This not only surpasses traditional 2D models by incorporating detailed shape, configuration, and temporal changes into their predictions, but also allows us to effectively learn accurate inverse dynamic models for an embodied agent. Specifically, we first extend existing robotic manipulation video datasets with depth and normal information leveraging off-the-shelf models. Next, we fine-tune a video generation model on this annotated dataset, which jointly predicts RGB-DN (RGB, Depth, and Normal) for each frame. We then present an algorithm to directly convert generated RGB, Depth, and Normal videos into a high-quality 4D scene of the world. Our method ensures temporal and spatial coherence in 4D scene predictions from embodied scenarios, enables novel view synthesis for embodied environments, and facilitates policy learning that significantly outperforms those derived from prior video-based world models.
authors: Haoyu Zhen, Qiao Sun, Hongxin Zhang, Junyan Li, Siyuan Zhou, Yilun Du, Chuang Gan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5337-5347

title: 基于统一模板的步态识别学习
title_en: Learning A Unified Template for Gait Recognition
abstract: "我无法创造的,我也不理解。" 人类智慧揭示了创造是学习的最高形式之一。例如,扩散模型在图像生成、去噪和修复中展现出卓越的语义结构和记忆能力,这直观地促进了表征学习。然而,当前步态网络很少采用这一视角,主要依赖于在复杂变化条件下通过对比步态样本进行学习,导致语义不一致和统一性问题。为解决这些问题,我们提出Origins方法,其核心理念是不同实体由统一模板生成,从而在一致且多样的语义空间中内在地规范步态表征,以准确捕捉差异。诚然,学习这一统一模板极具挑战性,因为模板需涵盖各种条件下的步态表征。受扩散模型启发,Origins将统一模板扩散为时间步模板进行步态生成建模,同时将统一模板用于步态表征学习。特别地,步态生成建模与表征学习作为统一框架实现端到端联合训练。在CASIA-B、CCPG、SUSTech1K、Gait3D、GREW和CCGR-MINI数据集上的大量实验表明,Origins在统一模板内实现表征学习,取得优越性能。
abstract_en: "What I cannot create, I do not understand." Human wisdom reveals that creation is one of the highest forms of learning. For example, Diffusion Models have demonstrated remarkable semantic structural and memory capabilities in image generation, denoising, and restoration, which intuitively benefits representation learning. However, current gait networks rarely embrace this perspective, relying primarily on learning by contrasting gait samples under varying complex conditions, leading to semantic inconsistency and uniformity issues. To address these issues, we propose Origins with generative capabilities whose underlying philosophy is that different entities are generated from a unified template, inherently regularizing gait representations within a consistent and diverse semantic space to capture differences accurately. Admittedly, learning this unified template is exceedingly challenging, as it requires the comprehensiveness of the template to encompass gait representations with various conditions. Inspired by Diffusion Models, Origins diffuses the unified template into timestep templates for gait generative modeling, and meanwhile transfers the unified template for gait representation learning. Especially, gait generative modeling and representation learning serve as a unified framework to end-to-end joint training. Extensive experiments on CASIA-B, CCPG, SUSTech1K, Gait3D, GREW and CCGR-MINI demonstrate that Origins performs representation learning within a unified template, achieving superior performance.
authors: Panjian Huang, Saihui Hou, Junzhou Huang, Yongzhen Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12459-12469

title: 超越静态帧的学习:通过视频扩展视觉-语言模型
title_en: Learning Beyond Still Frames: Scaling Vision-Language Models with Video
abstract: 高质量的图像-文本数据对增强视觉-语言模型(VLMs)至关重要,但传统的基于图像的预训练方法存在局限性。这些方法资源密集型,依赖于精心整理的高质量交错数据,而这类数据在大规模收集时成本高昂且具有挑战性。此外,尽管此类数据集能提升静态图像-文本理解能力,却无法培养视频理解所需的时间性和运动性理解。为解决这些不足,我们提出将视频预训练纳入VLMs,以提升模型捕捉时间动态和一般视觉感知的能力,这需要在空间冗余与严格时间因果性之间取得平衡。因此,我们提出因果层次化聚合方法,将计算密集型的空间编码与轻量级的时间传播分离,并构建不同粒度的层次化感受野。随着视频上下文扩展至超过1000亿个标记,我们的方法在图像和视频理解任务中展现出高吞吐量和最先进性能,如图1所示,为增强动态场景下的多模态学习提供了可扩展的解决方案。
abstract_en: High-quality image-text data is critical in enhancing Vision-Language Models (VLMs), but traditional image-based pretraining approaches face limitations. These methods are resource-intensive, relying on curated, high-quality interleaved data that is costly and challenging to collect at scale. Additionally, while such datasets improve static image-text understanding, they fail to develop the temporal and motion comprehension needed for video understanding. To address these gaps, we propose incorporating video pretraining into VLMs to improve the model's ability to capture temporal dynamics and general visual perception, which requires reconciling spatial redundancy with strict temporal causality. Therefore, we propose Causal Hierarchical Aggregation to separate computation-heavy spatial encoding from lightweight temporal propagation and construct hierarchical receptive fields at varying granularities. As we scale video context to more than 100 billion tokens, our method excels in high throughput and state-of-the-art performances on both Image and Video understanding, as shown in Figure 1, providing a scalable solution to enhance multimodal learning in dynamic contexts.
authors: Yiyuan Zhang, Handong Li, Jing Liu, Xiangyu Yue ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22425-22435

title: 面向开放世界模型归因的反事实解耦注意力学习方法
title_en: Learning Counterfactually Decoupled Attention for Open-World Model Attribution
abstract: 本文提出了一种面向开放世界模型归因的反事实解耦注意力学习(CDAL)方法。现有方法依赖于手工设计的区域划分或特征空间,可能受到虚假统计相关性的干扰,并在开放世界场景中难以应对新型攻击。为解决这一问题,CDAL显式建模注意力视觉痕迹与源模型归因之间的因果关系,并通过反事实解耦方式将判别模型特定的伪影与混淆源偏差分离以进行比较。这样得到的因果效应可对学习到的注意力图质量进行量化,从而鼓励网络通过最大化效应来捕捉可推广到未见源模型的生成模式。在现有开放世界模型归因基准数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在计算开销最小的情况下,显著提升了最先进的模型性能,特别是在应对未见新型攻击时表现突出。
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a Counterfactually Decoupled Attention Learning (CDAL) method for open-world model attribution. Existing methods rely on handcrafted design of region partitioning or feature space, which could be confounded by the spurious statistical correlations and struggle with novel attacks in open-world scenarios. To address this, CDAL explicitly models the causal relationships between the attentional visual traces and source model attribution, and counterfactually decouples the discriminative model-specific artifacts from confounding source biases for comparison. In this way, the resulting causal effect provides a quantification on the quality of learned attention maps, thus encouraging the network to capture essential generation patterns that generalize to unseen source models by maximizing the effect. Extensive experiments on existing open-world model attribution benchmarks show that with minimal computational overhead, our method consistently improves state-of-the-art models by large margins, particularly for unseen novel attacks.
authors: Yu Zheng, Boyang Gong, Fanye Kong, Yueqi Duan, Bingyao Yu, Wenzhao Zheng, Lei Chen, Jiwen Lu, Jie Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 122-132

title: 从无配对数据中利用扩散模型学习去模糊纹理先验
title_en: Learning Deblurring Texture Prior from Unpaired Data with Diffusion Model
abstract: 由于获取大量真实的模糊-清晰图像对既困难又昂贵,从无配对数据中学习盲图像去模糊成为更实用且有前景的解决方案。不幸的是,大多数现有方法仅使用对抗学习来弥合模糊域到清晰域的差距,忽视了现实世界模糊模式的复杂性和不可预测性。本文提出了一种基于扩散模型(DM)的新型框架TP-Diff,通过从无配对清晰数据中学习空间变化的纹理先验来实现图像去模糊。具体而言,TP-Diff通过DM生成用于恢复模糊图像纹理的先验知识。为实现该目标,我们提出了一种纹理先验编码器(TPE),引入记忆机制以编码纹理先验,从而为DM训练提供监督。为进一步充分利用生成的纹理先验,我们进一步提出了纹理传输变换器层(TTformer),其中一种新颖的滤波调制多头自注意力(FM-MSA)通过自适应滤波高效去除空间变化的模糊。此外,采用基于小波的对抗损失以保留高频纹理细节。广泛评估表明,TP-Diff提供了一种有前景的无监督去模糊方案,并在六个广泛使用的基准测试中超越了SOTA方法。
abstract_en: Since acquiring large amounts of realistic blurry-sharp image pairs is difficult and expensive, learning blind image deblurring from unpaired data is a more practical and promising solution. Unfortunately, most existing approaches only use adversarial learning to bridge the gap from blurry domains to sharp domains, ignoring the complex and unpredictable nature of real-world blurry patterns. In this paper, we propose a novel diffusion model (DM)-based framework, dubbed TP-Diff, for image deblurring by learning spatially varying texture prior from unpaired sharp data. In particular, TP-Diff performs DM to generate the prior knowledge used to recover the texture of blurry images. To implement it, we propose a Texture Prior Encoder (TPE) that introduces a memory mechanism to encode the texture prior and thereby provide supervision for the DM training. To fully exploit the generated texture priors, we further present the Texture Transfer Transformer layer (TTformer), in which a novel Filter-Modulated Multi-head Self-Attention (FM-MSA) efficiently removes spatially varying blurring through adaptive filtering. In addition, a wavelet-based adversarial loss is used to preserve high-frequency texture details. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that TP-Diff provides a promising unsupervised deblurring solution and outperforms SOTA methods in six widely-used benchmarks.
authors: Chengxu Liu, Lu Qi, Jinshan Pan, Xueming Qian, Ming-Hsuan Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14195-14204

title: 通过将单张二维图像提升至三维空间实现稠密特征匹配的学习
title_en: Learning Dense Feature Matching via Lifting Single 2D Image to 3D Space
abstract: 特征匹配在许多计算机视觉任务中发挥着基础性作用,但现有方法依赖于稀缺且干净的多视角图像集合,这限制了其在多样且具有挑战性的场景中的泛化能力。此外,传统特征编码器通常基于单视角二维图像进行训练,限制了其捕捉三维感知对应关系的能力。本文提出了一种新颖的两阶段框架,名为Lift to Match (L2M),通过将单视角二维图像提升至三维空间,充分利用大规模且多样的单视角图像。具体而言,在第一阶段,我们结合多视角图像合成与三维特征高斯表示,学习一种三维感知特征编码器,将三维几何知识注入编码器。在第二阶段,采用新视角渲染策略,结合从单视角图像生成的大规模合成数据,学习特征解码器以实现鲁棒特征匹配,从而在多样领域中实现泛化。大量实验表明,我们的方法在零样本评估基准上实现了优越的泛化能力,突显了所提框架在鲁棒特征匹配中的有效性。
abstract_en: Feature matching plays a fundamental role in many computer vision tasks, yet existing methods rely on scarce and clean multi-view image collections, which constrains their generalization to diverse and challenging scenarios. Moreover, conventional feature encoders are typically trained on single-view 2D images, limiting their capacity to capture 3D-aware correspondences. In this paper, we propose a novel two-stage framework that lifts 2D images to 3D space, named as Lift to Match (L2M), taking full advantage of large-scale and diverse single-view images. To be specific, in the first stage, we learn a 3D-aware feature encoder using a combination of multi-view image synthesis and 3D feature Gaussian representation, which injects 3D geometry knowledge into the encoder. In the second stage, a novel-view rendering strategy, combined with large-scale synthetic data generation from single-view images, is employed to learn a feature decoder for robust feature matching, thus achieving generalization across diverse domains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior generalization across zero-shot evaluation benchmarks, highlighting the effectiveness of the proposed framework for robust feature matching.
authors: Yingping Liang, Yutao Hu, Wenqi Shao, Ying Fu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6621-6631

title: 基于人类高斯模型的高效可泛化人类表征学习
title_en: Learning Efficient and Generalizable Human Representation with Human Gaussian Model
abstract: 从视频中建模可动画的人类化身是一个长期存在且具有挑战性的问题。尽管传统方法需要针对每个实例进行优化,但近期提出的前馈方法通过可学习网络生成3D高斯。然而,这些方法为每个帧预测独立高斯,未能充分捕捉不同帧高斯之间的关系,导致难以通过新姿势进行动画。为解决这一问题,我们提出人类高斯图(Human Gaussian Graph, HGG),以生成可泛化且可动画的高斯表征。具体而言,我们构建双层图来建模多帧预测高斯与SMPL网格之间的关系。我们设计节点内操作以聚合不同时间步的高斯信息,从而利用视频输入的优势。此外,我们提出节点间操作以支持SMPL顶点之间的消息传递。通过这种方式,我们利用人体结构先验知识恢复可泛化且可动画的高斯表征。实验结果在新视角合成和新姿势动画任务中验证了本方法的效率与泛化能力。
abstract_en: Modeling animatable human avatars from videos is a long-standing and challenging problem. While conventional methods require per-instance optimization, recent feed-forward methods have been proposed to generate 3D Gaussians with a learnable network.However, these methods predict independent Gaussians for each frame prediction without fully capturing the relations of Gaussians from different frames, which are hard to be animated by novel poses. To address this, we propose Human Gaussian Graph (HGG) to generate generalizable and animatable Gaussian representations. Specifically, we construct a dual-layer graph to model the relations between predicted Gaussians from multiple frames and SMPL mesh. We design an intra-node operation to aggregate various Gaussian information at different timesteps to benefit from video inputs. Furthermore, we propose an inter-node operation to support message passing between SMPL vertices. In this manner, we leverage the human structure prior to recover generalizable and animatable Gaussian representations.Experimental results on novel view synthesis and novel pose animation demonstrate the efficiency and generalization of our method.
authors: Yifan Liu, Shengjun Zhang, Chensheng Dai, Yang Chen, Hao Liu, Chen Li, Yueqi Duan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11797-11806

title: 基于轨迹分布匹配的少步扩散模型学习
title_en: Learning Few-Step Diffusion Models by Trajectory Distribution Matching
abstract: 加速扩散模型采样对高效AIGC部署至关重要。尽管基于分布匹配和轨迹匹配的扩散蒸馏方法可将采样步骤减少至最少一步,但在复杂任务如文本到图像生成中仍存在不足。少步生成在速度与质量之间提供了更好的平衡,但现有方法面临持续的权衡:分布匹配在多步采样中缺乏灵活性,而轨迹匹配常导致图像质量次优。为弥合这一差距,我们提出通过轨迹分布匹配(Trajectory Distribution Matching, TDM)学习少步扩散模型,这是一种结合分布匹配与轨迹匹配优势的统一蒸馏范式。我们的方法引入了无数据分数蒸馏目标,在分布层面对齐学生模型与教师模型的轨迹。进一步地,我们开发了采样步数感知目标,解耦不同步数的学习目标,实现更灵活的采样。该方法支持高质量图像的确定性采样和灵活的多步适应,以显著的效率实现了最先进性能。我们的模型TDM在多种主干网络(如SDXL和PixArt-α)上均优于现有方法,提供了更优的质量并显著降低了训练成本。特别地,我们的方法将PixArt-α蒸馏为一个4步生成器,在1024分辨率下于真实用户偏好测试中超越其教师模型,仅需500次迭代和2个A800小时的训练成本(约为先前最先进蒸馏方法的1%)。此外,我们提出的TDM可扩展加速文本到视频扩散。值得注意的是,TDM在VBench上仅使用4个NFE即可超越其教师模型(CogVideoX-2B),将总得分从80.91提升至81.65。
abstract_en: Accelerating diffusion model sampling is crucial for efficient AIGC deployment. While diffusion distillation methods -- based on distribution matching and trajectory matching -- reduce sampling to as few as one step, they fall short on complex tasks like text-to-image generation. Few-step generation offers a better balance between speed and quality, but existing approaches face a persistent trade-off: distribution matching lacks flexibility for multi-step sampling, while trajectory matching often yields suboptimal image quality.To bridge this gap, we propose learning few-step diffusion models by Trajectory Distribution Matching (TDM), a unified distillation paradigm that combines the strengths of distribution and trajectory matching. Our method introduces a data-free score distillation objective, aligning the student's trajectory with the teacher's at the distribution level. Further, we develop a sampling-steps-aware objective that decouples learning targets across different steps, enabling more adjustable sampling.This approach supports both deterministic sampling for superior image quality and flexible multi-step adaptation, achieving state-of-the-art performance with remarkable efficiency. Our model, TDM, outperforms existing methods on various backbones, such as SDXL and PixArt-\alpha, delivering superior quality and significantly reduced training costs.In particular, our method distills PixArt-\alpha into a 4-step generator that outperforms its teacher on real user preference at 1024 resolution. This is accomplished with 500 iterations and 2 A800 hours -- a training cost of approximately 1% of the previous state-of-the-art distillation method. In addition, our proposed TDM can be extended to accelerate text-to-video diffusion. Notably, TDM can outperform its teacher model (CogVideoX-2B) by using only 4 NFE on VBench, improving the total score from 80.91 to 81.65.
authors: Yihong Luo, Tianyang Hu, Jiacheng Sun, Yujun Cai, Jing Tang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17719-17728

title: 面向图像处理的层次化行缓冲器学习
title_en: Learning Hierarchical Line Buffer for Image Processing
abstract: 近年来,神经网络在离线图像处理领域取得了显著进展。然而,在在线场景,特别是芯片级实现中,由于集成图像处理器的内存资源有限,内存使用量成为关键瓶颈。本研究聚焦于通过优化网络设计以提高内存利用效率,减少神经网络在芯片图像处理中的内存占用。具体而言,我们考虑一种典型场景:图像传感器输出的图像以逐行方式通过行缓冲器进行顺序处理。该设置要求同时建模行内与行间相关性——分别捕捉单一行组内像素间的依赖关系以及不同行组间的关联。为建模行内相关性,我们提出渐进式特征增强策略,其中行像素通过多阶段扩展条形卷积进行处理。对于行间相关性建模,我们引入层次化行缓冲器结构,其中从先前行提取的特征在多个层次结构中逐步复用与压缩。在包括RAW去噪、高斯去噪和超分辨率等各类图像处理任务上的综合实验表明,所提方法在性能与内存效率之间实现了优于先前方案的平衡,例如在峰值内存占用五分之一的情况下实现RAW去噪1dB的PSNR增益。
abstract_en: In recent years, neural networks have achieved significant progress in offline image processing. However, in online scenarios, particularly in on-chip implementations, memory usage emerges as a critical bottleneck due to the limited memory resources of integrated image processors. In this study, we focus on reducing the memory footprint of neural networks for on-chip image processing by optimizing network design for efficient memory utilization. Specifically, we consider a typical scenario in which images outputted from an image sensor are processed sequentially using line buffers in a line-by-line manner. This setting necessitates the modeling of both intra-line and inter-line correlations--capturing dependencies among pixels within a single line group and across different line groups, respectively.To model intra-line correlations, we propose a progressive feature enhancement strategy, where line pixels are processed with expanding strip convolutions in multiple stages.For inter-line correlation modeling, we introduce a hierarchical line buffer formulation, where features extracted from previous lines are incrementally reused and compressed across multiple hierarchical levels.Comprehensive experiments on various image processing tasks, including RAW denoising, Gaussian denoising, and super-resolution, demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a superior trade-off between performance and memory efficiency than previous solutions, e.g., up to 1dB PSNR gain in RAW denoising at one-fifth of peak memory usage.
authors: Jiacheng Li, Feiran Li, Daisuke Iso ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11132-11141

title: 基于融合流变换学习隐式特征的逼真虚拟试穿
title_en: Learning Implicit Features with Flow-Infused Transformations for Realistic Virtual Try-On
abstract: 基于扩散的虚拟试穿旨在合成一张将特定服装无缝融合到目标模型中的逼真图像。主要挑战在于有效引导潜在扩散模型的变形过程。然而,现有方法要么缺乏直接引导,要么显式地对服装图像进行变形,这高度依赖于变形模块的性能。本文提出FIA-VTON,通过在虚拟试穿中采用流注入注意力模块,利用隐式流特征作为引导。密集变形流图被投影为间接引导,以在生成过程中隐式增强特征图变形,其对变形估计精度的敏感度低于显式服装图像变形。为进一步增强隐式变形引导,我们引入高级空间注意力以补充密集变形。在VTON-HD和DressCode数据集上的实验结果显著优于现有最先进方法,证明FIA-VTON在虚拟试穿中具有有效性与鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Diffusion-based virtual try-on aims to synthesize a realistic image that seamlessly integrating the specific garment into a target model. The primary challenge lies in effectively guiding the warping process of the latent diffusion model. However, previous methods either lack direct guidance or explicitly warp the garment image, which highly depends on the performance of the warping module. In this paper, we propose FIA-VTON, which leverages the implicit flow feature as guidance by adopting a Flow Infused Attention module on virtual try-on. The dense warp flow map is projected as indirect guidance to enhance the feature map warping in the generation process implicitly, which is less sensitive to the warping estimation accuracy than an explicit warp of the garment image. To further enhance implicit warp guidance, we incorporate high-level spatial attention to complement the dense warp. Experimental results on the VTON-HD and DressCode dataset significantly outperform state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating that FIA-VTON is effective and robust for virtual try-on.
authors: Delong Zhang, Qiwei Huang, Yang Sun, Yuanliu Liu, Wei-Shi Zheng, Pengfei Xiong, Wei Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18736-18745

title: 基于信息追求的可解释查询学习用于可解释图像分类
title_en: Learning Interpretable Queries for Explainable Image Classification with Information Pursuit
abstract: 信息追求(IP)是一种近期提出的机器学习框架,旨在构建设计上可解释的分类器。给定一组任务相关且可解释的数据查询,IP会选择最具信息量的少量查询,并基于收集到的查询-答案对进行预测。然而,IP的关键局限性在于其依赖于任务相关且可解释的查询,这通常需要大量数据标注和整理工作。尽管先前方法已探索利用通用的大规模语言模型生成这些查询集,但它们依赖于提示工程启发式方法,往往产生次优的查询集,导致IP与非可解释的黑盒预测器之间存在性能差距。在本文中,我们提出将IP查询参数化为在视觉-语言模型(如CLIP)的潜在空间中定义的可学习字典。我们制定了学习IP查询的优化目标,并提出了一种交替优化算法,该算法与经典稀疏字典学习算法具有引人注目的联系。我们的学习字典在多个图像分类基准测试中优于基于手工设计或提示字典的基线方法。
abstract_en: Information Pursuit (IP) is a recently introduced learning framework to construct classifiers that are interpretable-by-design. Given a set of task-relevant and interpretable data queries, IP selects a small subset of the most informative queries and makes predictions based on the gathered query-answer pairs. However, a key limitation of IP is its dependency on task-relevant interpretable queries, which typically require considerable data annotation and curation efforts. While previous approaches have explored using general-purpose large language models to generate these query sets, they rely on prompt engineering heuristics and often yield suboptimal query sets, resulting in a performance gap between IP and non-interpretable black-box predictors. In this work, we propose parameterizing IP queries as a learnable dictionary defined in the latent space of vision-language models such as CLIP. We formulate an optimization objective to learn IP queries and propose an alternating optimization algorithm that shares appealing connections with classic sparse dictionary learning algorithms. Our learned dictionary outperforms baseline methods based on handcrafted or prompted dictionaries across several image classification benchmarks.
authors: Stefan Kolek, Aditya Chattopadhyay, Kwan Ho Ryan Chan, Hector Andrade-Loarca, Gitta Kutyniok, René Vidal ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3947-3956

title: 基于高分辨率光流数据集的长程动态运动大范围运动估计中间表示学习
title_en: Learning Large Motion Estimation from Intermediate Representations with a High-Resolution Optical Flow Dataset Featuring Long-Range Dynamic Motion
abstract: 随着传感器和显示技术的进步,高分辨率图像在多样化应用中变得越来越普遍。因此,光流估计需要适应更大的图像分辨率,其中即使中等运动也会导致显著的像素位移,使得长程运动估计比以往任何时候都更加关键。然而,现有数据集主要关注低分辨率设置下的短程光流,限制了模型在高分辨率大位移场景中的泛化能力。此外,缺乏适合评估长程运动估计模型容量的合适数据集,进一步阻碍了该领域的发展。为了解决这一问题,我们引入了RelayFlow-4K,一个高分辨率4K光流数据集,旨在捕捉包括长程中间帧光流在内的多样化运动模式。尽管此类数据集提供了宝贵的训练资源,但由于匹配模糊度增加,长程估计仍面临挑战。简单地引入这些数据集并不必然提升性能。为此,我们提出了一种新颖的训练框架,结合匹配代价蒸馏和增量时间步学习,以优化代价体估计并稳定训练。此外,我们利用距离图,该图测量未匹配区域与其最近匹配像素之间的距离,从而改进遮挡处理。我们的方法显著提升了高分辨率场景下的长程光流估计性能。我们的数据集和代码可在https://github.com/Chohoonhee/RelayFlow-4K获取。
abstract_en: With advancements in sensor and display technologies, high-resolution imagery is becoming increasingly prevalent in diverse applications. As a result, optical flow estimation needs to adapt to larger image resolutions, where even moderate movements lead to substantial pixel displacements, making long-range motion estimation more critical than ever. However, existing datasets primarily focus on short-range flow in low-resolution settings, limiting the generalization of models to high-resolution scenarios with large displacements. Additionally, there is a lack of suitable datasets for evaluating model capacity in long-range motion estimation, further hindering progress in this area. To address this, we introduce RelayFlow-4K, high-resolution 4K optical flow dataset designed to capture diverse motion patterns, including long-range intermediate frame flows. While such datasets provide valuable training resources, long-range estimation remains challenging due to increased matching ambiguity. Simply incorporating these datasets does not inherently improve performance. To this end, we propose a novel training framework that integrates matching cost distillation and incremental time-step learning to refine cost volume estimation and stabilize training. Additionally, we leverage the distance map, which measures the distance from unmatched regions to their nearest matched pixels, improving occlusion handling. Our approach significantly enhances long-range optical flow estimation in high-resolution settings. Our datasets and code are available at https://github.com/Chohoonhee/RelayFlow-4K.
authors: Hoonhee Cho, Yuhwan Jeong, Kuk-Jin Yoon ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6176-6187

title: 从iToF成像中学习神经场景表示
title_en: Learning Neural Scene Representation from iToF Imaging
abstract: 间接飞行时间(iToF)相机因其成本效益高且易于部署而广泛用于3D感知。它们发射调制的红外信号以照亮场景,并处理接收到的信号以生成振幅和相位图像。深度值通过调制频率从相位计算得出。然而,获得的深度常受多路径干扰、低信噪比(SNR)和深度环绕效应引起的噪声影响。基于近期在神经场景表示方面的进展,这些方法在从多视角RGB图像进行3D建模方面展现出巨大潜力,我们提出利用该方法从噪声iToF数据中重建3D表示。我们的方法利用振幅和相位图的多视角一致性,融合所有输入视角的信息以生成精确的场景表示。考虑到红外照明的影响,我们提出了一种基于有符号距离函数(SDF)的新振幅图渲染方案,并引入神经光照函数以建模主动照明引起的外观变化。我们还结合了相位引导的采样策略和感知深度环绕的相位到深度损失,以利用原始相位信息并缓解深度环绕问题。此外,我们添加了噪声加权损失以防止在噪声多视角测量中过度平滑信息。在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上的实验表明,所提出的方法优于现有最先进的技术。
abstract_en: Indirect Time-of-Flight (iToF) cameras are popular for 3D perception because they are cost-effective and easy to deploy. They emit modulated infrared signals to illuminate the scene and process the received signals to generate amplitude and phase images. The depth is calculated from the phase using the modulation frequency. However, the obtained depth often suffers from noise caused by multi-path interference, low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and depth wrapping. Building on recent advancements in neural scene representations, which have shown great potential in 3D modeling from multi-view RGB images, we propose leveraging this approach to reconstruct 3D representations from noisy iToF data. Our method utilizes the multi-view consistency of amplitude and phase maps, fusing information from all input views to generate an accurate scene representation. Considering the impact of infrared illumination, we propose a new rendering scheme for amplitude maps based on signed distance function (SDF) and introduce a neural lighting function to model the appearance variations caused by active illumination. We also incorporate a phase-guided sampling strategy and a wrapping-aware phase-to-depth loss to utilize raw phase information and mitigate depth wrapping. Additionally, we add a noise-weight loss to prevent excessive smoothing information across noisy multi-view measurements. Experiments conducted on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art techniques.
authors: Wenjie Chang, Hanzhi Chang, Yueyi Zhang, Wenfei Yang, Tianzhu Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27937-27946

title: 直接从事件中学习法线流
title_en: Learning Normal Flow Directly From Events
abstract: 基于事件的运动场估计是一项重要任务。然而,当前光流方法面临挑战:基于学习的方法通常以帧为单位且依赖卷积神经网络(CNNs),缺乏跨域迁移能力;而基于模型的方法虽然更鲁棒,但精度较低。为解决光流估计的局限性,近期研究聚焦于法线流,因其在纹理有限或强边缘区域可更可靠地测量。然而,现有法线流估计器主要基于模型,存在高误差问题。本文提出一种新颖的监督点基方法用于法线流估计,克服现有事件学习方法的局限性。通过局部点云编码器,我们的方法直接从原始事件中估计每个事件的法线流,具有多项独特优势:1)生成时序和空间上锐利的预测;2)支持更多样化的数据增强(如随机旋转),提升跨域鲁棒性;3)通过集成推理自然支持不确定性量化,有利于下游任务;4)可在归一化相机坐标系下使用无畸变数据进行训练和推理,提升跨相机迁移能力。大量实验表明,我们的方法在跨数据集迁移时比现有最先进方法表现更优且更一致。利用该迁移能力,我们在数据集联合集上训练模型并公开发布。最后,我们引入基于最大边距问题的自运动求解器,利用法线流和IMU在复杂场景中实现强性能。代码可在https://github.com/dhyuan99/VecKM_flow获取。
abstract_en: Event-based motion field estimation is an important task. However, current optical flow methods face challenges: learning-based approaches, often frame-based and relying on CNNs, lack cross-domain transferability, while model-based methods, though more robust, are less accurate. To address the limitations of optical flow estimation, recent works have focused on normal flow, which can be more reliably measured in regions with limited texture or strong edges. However, existing normal flow estimators are predominantly model-based and suffer from high errors. In this paper, we propose a novel supervised point-based method for normal flow estimation that overcomes the limitations of existing event learning-based approaches. Using a local point cloud encoder, our method directly estimates per-event normal flow from raw events, offering multiple unique advantages: 1) It produces temporally and spatially sharp predictions. 2) It supports more diverse data augmentation, such as random rotation, to improve robustness across various domains. 3) It naturally supports uncertainty quantification via ensemble inference, which benefits downstream tasks. 4) It enables training and inference on undistorted data in normalized camera coordinates, improving transferability across cameras. Extensive experiments demonstrate our method achieves better and more consistent performance than state-of-the-art methods when transferred across different datasets. Leveraging this transferability, we train our model on the union of datasets and release it for public use. Finally, we introduce an egomotion solver based on a maximum-margin problem that uses normal flow and IMU to achieve strong performance in challenging scenarios. Codes are available at https://github.com/dhyuan99/VecKM_flow.
authors: Dehao Yuan, Levi Burner, Jiayi Wu, Minghui Liu, Jingxi Chen, Yiannis Aloimonos, Cornelia Fermüller ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7969-7979

title: 通过局部梯度感知曲面滤波学习噪声点的法线
title_en: Learning Normals of Noisy Points by Local Gradient-Aware Surface Filtering
abstract: 对噪声点云进行法线估计是三维几何处理中的持续性挑战,特别是在面向端到端的法线估计方向。现有方法通常针对相对干净的数据,并依赖监督先验在特定邻域内拟合局部曲面。本文提出了一种新颖的方法,通过局部梯度感知曲面滤波从噪声点云中学习法线。我们的方法利用受局部梯度约束的隐式函数导出的法线和距离,将噪声点投影到基础曲面上。我们首先引入一种距离测量算子,用于在噪声数据上进行全局曲面拟合,该算子整合了沿法线方向的投影距离。随后,我们开发了一种基于隐式场的滤波方法用于曲面点构建,在滤波过程中对这些点添加投影约束。为了解决过度平滑和梯度退化问题,我们进一步引入了局部梯度一致性约束,以及局部梯度方向和聚合。在法线估计、曲面重建和点云去噪的综合实验中,我们的方法展现了最先进的性能。源代码和训练模型可在https://github.com/LeoQLi/LGSF获取。
abstract_en: Estimating normals for noisy point clouds is a persistent challenge in 3D geometry processing, particularly for end-to-end oriented normal estimation. Existing methods generally address relatively clean data and rely on supervised priors to fit local surfaces within specific neighborhoods. In this paper, we propose a novel approach for learning normals from noisy point clouds through local gradient-aware surface filtering. Our method projects noisy points onto the underlying surface by utilizing normals and distances derived from an implicit function constrained by local gradients. We start by introducing a distance measurement operator for global surface fitting on noisy data, which integrates projected distances along normals. Following this, we develop an implicit field-based filtering approach for surface point construction, adding projection constraints on these points during filtering. To address issues of over-smoothing and gradient degradation, we further incorporate local gradient consistency constraints, as well as local gradient orientation and aggregation. Comprehensive experiments on normal estimation, surface reconstruction, and point cloud denoising demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of our method. The source code and trained models are available at https://github.com/LeoQLi/LGSF.
authors: Qing Li, Huifang Feng, Xun Gong, Yu-Shen Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28828-28838

title: 在广义相对论中学习零测地线以实现引力透镜渲染
title_en: Learning Null Geodesics for Gravitational Lensing Rendering in General Relativity
abstract: 我们提出了GravlensX,这是一种利用神经网络实现黑洞引力透镜效应渲染的创新方法。该方法论涉及训练神经网络以拟合黑洞周围的时空,并利用这些训练好的模型生成受引力透镜影响的光子路径。这使得黑洞的高效且可扩展的模拟成为可能,与传统方法相比,显著减少了渲染所需的时间。我们通过广泛渲染叠加克尔度规的多个黑洞系统来验证我们的方法,展示了其在计算时间减少15倍的情况下生成精确可视化的能力。我们的研究结果表明,神经网络为渲染复杂的天体物理现象提供了一种有前景的替代方案,可能为天文学可视化开辟新的途径。
abstract_en: We present GravlensX, an innovative method for rendering black holes with gravitational lensing effects using neural networks. The methodology involves training neural networks to fit the spacetime around black holes and then employing these trained models to generate the path of light rays affected by gravitational lensing. This enables efficient and scalable simulations of black holes, significantly decreasing the time required for rendering compared to traditional methods.
