abstract: 视频大语言模型(Video-LLMs)在理解视频方面取得了显著进展。然而,处理多帧会导致冗长的视觉标记序列,带来诸如上下文长度限制无法容纳完整视频、无关帧干扰视觉感知等挑战。因此,有效的帧选择至关重要。本文强调帧选择应遵循三个关键原则:查询相关性、列表式多样性与时序性。现有方法如均匀帧采样和查询-帧匹配未能全面满足这些原则。为此,我们提出基于动态规划的马尔可夫决策确定性点过程(MDP^3),这是一种无需训练且模型无关的方法,可无缝集成到现有Video-LLMs中。我们的方法首先在再生核希尔伯特空间(RKHS)中利用条件高斯核,基于查询估计帧相似性。随后将确定性点过程(DPP)应用于相似性矩阵,以同时捕捉查询相关性与列表式多样性。为融入时序性,我们将视频分割并在每个片段内应用DPP,基于前一片段的选择进行条件建模,作为马尔可夫决策过程(MDP)分配各片段的选取规模。理论上,MDP^3为NP难的列表式帧选择问题提供了(1-1/e)近似解,具有伪多项式时间复杂度,证明其高效性。实验表明,MDP显著优于现有方法,验证其有效性与鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Video large language models (Video-LLMs) have made significant progress in understanding videos. However, processing multiple frames leads to lengthy visual token sequences, presenting challenges such as the limited context length cannot accommodate the entire video, and the inclusion of irrelevant frames hinders visual perception. Hence, effective frame selection is crucial. This paper emphasizes that frame selection should follow three key principles: query relevance, list-wise diversity, and sequentiality. Existing methods, such as uniform frame sampling and query-frame matching, do not capture all of these principles. Thus, we propose Markov decision determinantal point process with dynamic programming (MDP^3) for frame selection, a training-free and model-agnostic method that can be seamlessly integrated into existing Video-LLMs. Our method first estimates frame similarities conditioned on the query using a conditional Gaussian kernel within the reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). We then apply the determinantal point process (DPP) to the similarity matrix to capture both query relevance and list-wise diversity. To incorporate sequentiality, we segment the video and apply DPP within each segment, conditioned on the preceding segment selection, modeled as a Markov decision process (MDP) for allocating selection sizes across segments. Theoretically, MDP^3 provides a (1-1/e)-approximate solution to the NP-hard list-wise frame selection problem with pseudo-polynomial time complexity, demonstrating its efficiency. Empirically, MDP significantly outperforms existing methods, verifying its effectiveness and robustness.
authors: Hui Sun, Shiyin Lu, Huanyu Wang, Qing-Guo Chen, Zhao Xu, Weihua Luo, Kaifu Zhang, Ming Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24090-24101

title: MEGA: 内存高效的动态场景四维高斯点云
title_en: MEGA: Memory-Efficient 4D Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Scenes
abstract: 四维高斯点云(4DGS)作为一种高保真捕捉复杂动态三维场景的新兴技术,近年来展现出巨大潜力。该技术采用四维高斯表示和GPU友好的光栅化器,实现了快速渲染速度。尽管具有诸多优势,4DGS仍面临显著挑战,尤其是需要数百万个四维高斯,每个高斯均包含大量属性信息,导致内存和存储成本高昂。本文提出了一种内存高效的4DGS框架。我们通过将颜色属性分解为每个高斯的3参数直接颜色分量和共享的轻量级交流颜色预测器,简化了颜色属性。该方法消除了对球面调和系数的需求,而经典4DGS中球面调和系数通常涉及多达144个参数,从而创建了内存高效的四维高斯表示。此外,我们引入了熵约束的高斯变形技术,利用变形场扩展每个高斯的作用范围,并结合基于不透明度的熵损失来限制高斯数量,迫使模型尽可能少地使用高斯来良好拟合动态场景。通过简单的半精度存储和zip压缩,我们的框架在Technicolor和Neural 3D Video数据集上分别实现了约190倍和125倍的存储缩减,同时保持与原始4DGS相当的渲染速度和场景表示质量,为该领域设立了新标准。代码可在https://github.com/Xinjie-Q/MEGA获取。
abstract_en: 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) has recently emerged as a promising technique for capturing complex dynamic 3D scenes with high fidelity. It utilizes a 4D Gaussian representation and a GPU-friendly rasterizer, enabling rapid rendering speeds. Despite its advantages, 4DGS faces significant challenges, notably the requirement of millions of 4D Gaussians, each with extensive associated attributes, leading to substantial memory and storage cost. This paper introduces a memory-efficient framework for 4DGS. We streamline the color attribute by decomposing it into a per-Gaussian direct color component with only 3 parameters and a shared lightweight alternating current color predictor. This approach eliminates the need for spherical harmonics coefficients, which typically involve up to 144 parameters in classic 4DGS, thereby creating a memory-efficient 4D Gaussian representation. Furthermore, we introduce an entropy-constrained Gaussian deformation technique that uses a deformation field to expand the action range of each Gaussian and integrates an opacity-based entropy loss to limit the number of Gaussians, thus forcing our model to use as few Gaussians as possible to fit a dynamic scene well. With simple half-precision storage and zip compression, our framework achieves a storage reduction by approximately 190xand 125xon the Technicolor and Neural 3D Video datasets, respectively, compared to the original 4DGS. Meanwhile, it maintains comparable rendering speeds and scene representation quality, setting a new standard in the field. Code is available at https://github.com/Xinjie-Q/MEGA.
authors: Xinjie Zhang, Zhening Liu, Yifan Zhang, Xingtong Ge, Dailan He, Tongda Xu, Yan Wang, Zehong Lin, Shuicheng Yan, Jun Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27828-27838

title: MEH:推进埃及象形文字识别的多风格数据集与工具包
title_en: MEH: A Multi-Style Dataset and Toolkit for Advancing Egyptian Hieroglyph Recognition
abstract: 由于标注数据有限和风格变化广泛,古埃及象形文字的识别始终面临持续性挑战。我们引入了多源埃及象形文字(MEH)数据集,这是一个新基准数据集,通过专家整理的来源获取详细句级和光学字符识别(OCR)标注,涵盖多样化的书写风格。为应对训练数据稀缺问题,我们提出一种生成合成象形文字序列的方法,结合真实语言材料、分层布局建模和基于扩散的渲染技术。我们在MEH数据集上评估了多阶段和端到端OCR系统,研究了合成预训练、模型规模和跨风格迁移的效果。为支持未来扩展,我们发布了pyThoth工具,内置模型辅助功能以实现人机协作标注的流程优化。我们认为这些贡献为构建埃及学领域的AI研究助手奠定了基础。
abstract_en: The recognition of Ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs poses persistent challenges due to limited annotated data and wide stylistic variation. We introduce the Multisource Egyptian Hieroglyphs (MEH) dataset, a new benchmark that captures a diverse range of writing styles with detailed clause-level and OCR annotations derived from expert-curated sources. To address the scarcity of training data, we propose a method for generating synthetic hieroglyphic sequences by combining real linguistic material, hierarchical layout modeling, and diffusion-based rendering. We evaluate both multi-stage and end-to-end OCR systems on MEH, studying the effects of synthetic pretraining, model scale, and cross-style transfer. To enable future expansion, we release pyThoth, an annotation tool with built-in model assistance for streamlined human-in-the-loop labeling. We believe that these contributions lay the groundwork for building an AI-powered research assistant for Egyptology.
authors: Maksim Golyadkin, Valeria Rubanova, Aleksandr Utkov, Dmitry Nikolotov, Ilya Makarov ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24488-24496

title: MEMFOF:面向内存高效多帧光流估计的高分辨率训练
title_en: MEMFOF: High-Resolution Training for Memory-Efficient Multi-Frame Optical Flow Estimation
abstract: 近期光流估计技术在追求精度的同时,导致GPU内存消耗持续增长,尤其在处理高分辨率(FullHD)输入时更为显著。我们提出MEMFOF,一种内存高效的多帧光流方法,能够在多帧估计与GPU内存使用之间取得理想平衡。值得注意的是,MEMFOF在1080p输入运行时仅需2.09GB GPU内存,训练时为28.5GB,这一特性使其能够以原生1080p分辨率进行训练,无需裁剪或下采样。我们系统性地回顾了类似RAFT架构的设计选择,结合降低相关体积和高分辨率训练协议,与多帧估计相结合,从而在多个基准测试中实现最先进性能,同时显著降低内存开销。我们的方法在准确性和运行时效率上均优于资源消耗更大的替代方案,验证了其在高分辨率光流估计中的鲁棒性。投稿时,我们的方法在Spring基准测试中以1像素(1px)异常率3.289位列第一,在Sintel(clean)基准测试中以端点误差(EPE)0.963领先,并在KITTI-2015的Fl-all误差上达到2.94%的最佳成绩。代码已开源:https://github.com/msu-video-group/memfof。
abstract_en: Recent advances in optical flow estimation have prioritized accuracy at the cost of growing GPU memory consumption, particularly for high-resolution (FullHD) inputs. We introduce MEMFOF, a memory-efficient multi-frame optical flow method that identifies a favorable trade-off between multi-frame estimation and GPU memory usage. Notably, MEMFOF requires only 2.09 GB of GPU memory at runtime for 1080p inputs, and 28.5 GB during training, which uniquely positions our method to be trained at native 1080p without the need for cropping or downsampling. We systematically revisit design choices from RAFT-like architectures, integrating reduced correlation volumes and high-resolution training protocols alongside multi-frame estimation, to achieve state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks while substantially reducing memory overhead. Our method outperforms more resource-intensive alternatives in both accuracy and runtime efficiency, validating its robustness for flow estimation at high resolutions. At the time of submission, our method ranks first on the Spring benchmark with a 1-pixel (1px) outlier rate of 3.289, leads Sintel (clean) with an endpoint error (EPE) of 0.963, and achieves the best Fl-all error on KITTI-2015 at 2.94%. The code is available at: https://github.com/msu-video-group/memfof.
authors: Vladislav Bargatin, Egor Chistov, Alexander Yakovenko, Dmitriy Vatolin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8187-8196

title: METEOR: 多编码器协作标记剪枝用于高效视觉语言模型
title_en: METEOR: Multi-Encoder Collaborative Token Pruning for Efficient Vision Language Models
abstract: 视觉编码器是多模态理解的基石。单编码器架构如CLIP在跨多样多模态任务的泛化能力上存在固有局限,而近期多编码器融合方法通过使用多个视觉编码器的互补视觉表征来实现优越性能,却引入了 prohibitive 计算开销。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种渐进式剪枝框架,即多编码器协作标记剪枝(METEOR),通过在多编码器大语言模型的编码、融合和解码阶段消除冗余视觉标记。对于多视觉编码,我们通过秩引导的协作标记分配策略在每个编码器内丢弃冗余标记。随后,在多视觉融合阶段,我们结合不同编码器的视觉特征,同时通过协作剪枝减少跨编码器冗余。最后,在大语言模型解码阶段,我们提出了一种自适应标记剪枝方法,根据文本提示动态调整剪枝比例以进一步丢弃无关标记,满足特定任务需求。据我们所知,这是首个成功实现多阶段剪枝策略的高效多编码器视觉语言模型。在11个基准测试上的大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性。与典型多编码器大语言模型EAGLE相比,METEOR在平均性能仅下降0.3%的情况下,将视觉标记数量减少了76%。代码已开源至https://github.com/YuchenLiu98/METEOR。
abstract_en: Vision encoders serve as the cornerstone of multimodal understanding. Single-encoder architectures like CLIP exhibit inherent constraints in generalizing across diverse multimodal tasks, while recent multi-encoder fusion methods introduce prohibitive computational overhead to achieve superior performance using complementary visual representations from multiple vision encoders. To address this, we propose a progressive pruning framework, namely Multi-Encoder collaboraTivE tOken pRuning (METEOR), that eliminates redundant visual tokens across the encoding, fusion, and decoding stages for multi-encoder MLLMs. For multi-vision encoding, we discard redundant tokens within each encoder via a rank guided collaborative token assignment strategy. Subsequently, for multi-vision fusion, we combine the visual features from different encoders while reducing cross-encoder redundancy with cooperative pruning. Finally, we propose an adaptive token pruning method in the LLM decoding stage to further discard irrelevant tokens based on the text prompts with dynamically adjusting pruning ratios for specific task demands. To our best knowledge, this is the first successful attempt that achieves an efficient multi-encoder based vision language model with multi-stage pruning strategies. Extensive experiments on 11 benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach. Compared with EAGLE, a typical multi-encoder MLLMs, METEOR reduces 76% visual tokens with only 0.3% performance drop in average. The code is available at https://github.com/YuchenLiu98/METEOR.
authors: Yuchen Liu, Yaoming Wang, Bowen Shi, Xiaopeng Zhang, Wenrui Dai, Chenglin Li, Hongkai Xiong, Qi Tian ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21492-21504

title: MGSR:面向多种光照条件的2D/3D互增强高斯点云高保真表面重建
title_en: MGSR: 2D/3D Mutual-boosted Gaussian Splatting for High-fidelity Surface Reconstruction under Various Light Conditions
abstract: 新视角合成(NVS)和表面重建(SR)是三维高斯点云(3DGS)中的关键任务。尽管近期取得了进展,但这些任务通常被独立处理,基于GS的渲染方法在多样光照条件下表现不佳且难以生成精确表面,而基于GS的重建方法则常牺牲渲染质量。这引发了一个核心问题:渲染与重建是否必须始终存在权衡?为解决这一问题,我们提出MGSR,一种面向表面重建的2D/3D互增强高斯点云方法,同时提升渲染质量与三维重建精度。MGSR引入两个分支——一个基于2DGS,另一个基于3DGS。2DGS分支在表面重建方面表现优异,为3DGS分支提供精确的几何信息。利用该几何信息,3DGS分支采用几何引导的光照分解模块,捕捉反射与透射成分,从而在多样光照条件下实现逼真渲染。通过透射成分进行监督,2DGS分支也实现了高保真表面重建。在整个优化过程中,2DGS与3DGS分支交替优化,提供相互监督。在此之前,每个分支完成独立的预热阶段,并采用早期停止策略以降低计算成本。我们在多样化的合成与真实数据集上评估MGSR,涵盖物体与场景级别,展示了其在渲染与表面重建方面的优异性能。代码已开源:https://github.com/TsingyuanChou/MGSR
abstract_en: Novel view synthesis (NVS) and surface reconstruction (SR) are essential tasks in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). Despite recent progress, these tasks are often addressed independently, with GS-based rendering methods struggling under diverse light conditions and failing to produce accurate surfaces, while GS-based reconstruction methods frequently compromise rendering quality. This raises a central question: must rendering and reconstruction always involve a trade-off? To address this, we propose MGSR, a 2D/3D Mutual-boosted Gaussian Splatting for Surface Reconstruction that enhances both rendering quality and 3D reconstruction accuracy. MGSR introduces two branches--one based on 2DGS and the other on 3DGS. The 2DGS branch excels in surface reconstruction, providing precise geometry information to the 3DGS branch. Leveraging this geometry, the 3DGS branch employs a geometry-guided illumination decomposition module that captures reflected and transmitted components, enabling realistic rendering under varied light conditions. Using the transmitted component as supervision, the 2DGS branch also achieves high-fidelity surface reconstruction. Throughout the optimization process, the 2DGS and 3DGS branches undergo alternating optimization, providing mutual supervision. Prior to this, each branch completes an independent warm-up phase, with an early stopping strategy implemented to reduce computational costs. We evaluate MGSR on a diverse set of synthetic and real-world datasets, at both object and scene levels, demonstrating strong performance in rendering and surface reconstruction. Code is available at https://github.com/TsingyuanChou/MGSR.
authors: Qingyuan Zhou, Yuehu Gong, Weidong Yang, Jiaze Li, Yeqi Luo, Baixin Xu, Shuhao Li, Ben Fei, Ying He ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27295-27304

title: MGSfM: 多摄像机几何驱动全局结构从运动
title_en: MGSfM: Multi-Camera Geometry Driven Global Structure-from-Motion
abstract: 多摄像机系统在自动驾驶汽车和机器人环境感知中日益关键。其物理配置提供了固有的固定相对位姿约束,这对结构从运动(SfM)具有优势。然而,传统全局SfM系统由于优化框架的局限性在鲁棒性方面存在困难。我们提出了一种针对多摄像机系统的新型全局运动平均框架,包含两个核心组件:解耦旋转平均模块和混合平移平均模块。我们的旋转平均采用分层策略,首先估计刚性摄像机单元内的相对旋转,然后计算全局刚性单元旋转。为增强平移平均的鲁棒性,我们结合摄像机间和摄像机-点约束,通过凸距离目标函数初始化摄像机位置和3D点,并通过无偏非双线性角度目标函数进行优化。在大规模数据集上的实验表明,我们的系统在匹配或超越增量SfM精度的同时显著提升效率。我们的框架优于现有全局SfM方法,成为现实世界多摄像机SfM应用的稳健解决方案。我们将开源分享该系统实现。
abstract_en: Multi-camera systems are increasingly vital in the environmental perception of autonomous vehicles and robotics. Their physical configuration offers inherent fixed relative pose constraints that benefit Structure-from-Motion (SfM). However, traditional global SfM systems struggle with robustness due to their optimization framework.We propose a novel global motion averaging framework for multi-camera systems, featuring two core components: a decoupled rotation averaging module and a hybrid translation averaging module.Our rotation averaging employs a hierarchical strategy by first estimating relative rotations within rigid camera units and then computing global rigid unit rotations.To enhance the robustness of translation averaging, we incorporate both camera-to-camera and camera-to-point constraints to initialize camera positions and 3D points with a convex distance-based objective function and refine them with an unbiased non-bilinear angle-based objective function.Experiments on large-scale datasets show that our system matches or exceeds incremental SfM accuracy while significantly improving efficiency.Our framework outperforms existing global SfM methods, establishing itself as a robust solution for real-world multi-camera SfM applications. We will share our system as an open-source implementation.
authors: Peilin Tao, Hainan Cui, Diantao Tu, Shuhan Shen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5232-5241

title: MH-LVC:面向学习条件残差视频编码的多假设时域预测
title_en: MH-LVC: Multi-Hypothesis Temporal Prediction for Learned Conditional Residual Video Coding
abstract: 本工作提出的MH-LVC方法,在条件残差视频编码框架中引入多假设时域预测方案,通过结合长期和短期参考帧进行预测。近期针对条件视频编码的时域上下文挖掘方法在编码性能上表现优异。然而,在解码视频帧时需要存储和访问大量从过去解码帧中提取的隐式上下文信息,由于内存访问量过大而面临挑战。MH-LVC通过存储多个长期和短期参考帧,但限制时域预测过程中每次仅使用两个参考帧,从而解决该问题。我们的解码帧缓冲管理机制使编码器能够灵活利用长期关键帧以缓解时域级联误差,并通过短期参考帧最小化预测误差。此外,我们的缓冲方案使时域预测结构能够适配不同输入视频。尽管这种灵活性在传统视频编码器中较为常见,但尚未被充分应用于学习视频编码器。大量实验表明,所提方法在常用测试数据集上,相较于VTM-17.0在低延迟B配置下的PSNR-RGB指标表现更优,且与最先进的学习视频编码器(如DCVC-FM)性能相当,同时需要更少的解码帧缓冲和相似的解码时间。
abstract_en: This work, termed MH-LVC, presents a multi-hypothesis temporal prediction scheme that employs long- and short-term reference frames in a conditional residual video coding framework. Recent temporal context mining approaches to conditional video coding offer superior coding performance. However, the need to store and access a large amount of implicit contextual information extracted from past decoded frames in decoding a video frame poses a challenge due to excessive memory access. Our MH-LVC overcomes this issue by storing multiple long- and short-term reference frames but limiting the number of reference frames used at a time for temporal prediction to two. Our decoded frame buffer management allows the encoder to flexibly utilize the long-term key frames to mitigate temporal cascading errors and the short-term reference frames to minimize prediction errors. Moreover, our buffering scheme enables the temporal prediction structure to be adapted to individual input videos. While this flexibility is common in traditional video codecs, it has not been fully explored for learned video codecs. Extensive experiments show that the proposed method outperforms VTM-17.0 under the low-delay B configuration in terms of PSNR-RGB across commonly used test datasets, and performs comparably to the state-of-the-art learned codecs (e.g. DCVC-FM) while requiring less decoded frame buffer and similar decoding time.
authors: Huu-Tai Phung, Zong-Lin Gao, Yi-Chen Yao, Kuan-Wei Ho, Yi-Hsin Chen, Yu-Hsiang Lin, Alessandro Gnutti, Wen-Hsiao Peng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19649-19658

title: MIEB:大规模图像嵌入基准
title_en: MIEB: Massive Image Embedding Benchmark
abstract: 图像表示通常通过分散的、任务特定的协议进行评估,导致对模型能力的理解碎片化。例如,尚不清楚图像嵌入模型在图像聚类表现优异时,是否在给定文本时能同样有效地检索相关图像。我们引入大规模图像嵌入基准(MIEB),以评估图像和图像-文本嵌入模型在迄今为止最广泛的任务谱系中的性能。MIEB涵盖38种语言、130个独立任务,我们将其归类为8个高层类别。我们在基准测试中对50个模型进行了评估,发现没有单一方法能在所有任务类别中占据主导地位。我们揭示了先进视觉模型的潜在能力,例如其对文本的精确视觉表征,以及在存在混杂因素时交错编码和匹配图像与文本能力的局限性。我们还表明,视觉编码器在MIEB中的表现与其在多模态大语言模型中的表现高度相关。我们的代码、数据集和排行榜已公开在https://github.com/embeddings-benchmark/mteb。
abstract_en: Image representations are often evaluated through disjointed, task-specific protocols, leading to a fragmented understanding of model capabilities. For instance, it is unclear whether an image embedding model adept at clustering images is equally good at retrieving relevant images given a piece of text. We introduce the Massive Image Embedding Benchmark (MIEB) to evaluate the performance of image and image-text embedding models across the broadest spectrum to date. MIEB spans 38 languages across 130 individual tasks, which we group into 8 high-level categories. We benchmark 50 models across our benchmark, finding that no single method dominates across all task categories. We reveal hidden capabilities in advanced vision models such as their accurate visual representation of texts, and their yet limited capabilities in interleaved encodings and matching images and texts in the presence of confounders. We also show that the performance of vision encoders on MIEB correlates highly with their performance when used in multimodal large language models. Our code, dataset, and leaderboard are publicly available at https://github.com/embeddings-benchmark/mteb.
authors: Chenghao Xiao, Isaac Chung, Imene Kerboua, Jamie Stirling, Xin Zhang, Márton Kardos, Roman Solomatin, Noura Al Moubayed, Kenneth Enevoldsen, Niklas Muennighoff ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22187-22198

title: MINERVA: 复杂视频推理评估
title_en: MINERVA: Evaluating Complex Video Reasoning
abstract: 多模态大语言模型正将研究重点转向视频基准测试,然而大多数视频基准测试仅提供结果监督,缺乏中间或可解释的推理步骤。这使得评估模型是否真正能够结合感知信息和时序信息进行视频推理变得困难,还是仅仅通过偶然性或利用语言偏差获得正确答案。为了解决这一问题,我们为现代多模态模型提供了一个新的视频推理数据集MINERVA。该数据集中的每个问题均包含5个答案选项以及详细的、手工构建的推理轨迹。我们的数据集是多模态的,在视频领域和时长方面具有多样性,包含复杂的多步骤问题。广泛的基准测试表明,我们的数据集对前沿开源和专有模型提出了挑战。我们进行了细粒度错误分析,以识别各种模型的常见失败模式,并创建了推理错误的分类体系。我们利用这一分类体系探索了人类和LLM作为评分者的方法对视频推理轨迹的评分,发现失败模式主要与时间定位相关,其次是视觉感知错误,而非逻辑或完整性错误。该数据集,包括问题、答案候选和推理轨迹,可在https://github.com/google-deepmind/neptune?tab=readme-ov-file#minerva https://github.com/google-deepmind/neptune?tab=readme-ov-file\#minerva公开获取。
abstract_en: Multimodal LLMs are turning their focus to video benchmarks, however most video benchmarks only provide outcome supervision, with no intermediate or interpretable reasoning steps. This makes it challenging to assess if models are truly able to combine perceptual and temporal information to reason about videos, or simply get the correct answer by chance or by exploiting linguistic biases. To remedy this, we provide a new video reasoning dataset called MINERVA for modern multimodal models. Each question in the dataset comes with 5 answer choices, as well as detailed, hand-crafted reasoning traces. Our dataset is multimodal, diverse in terms of video domain and length, and consists of complex multi-step questions. Extensive benchmarking shows that our dataset provides a challenge for frontier open-source and proprietary models. We perform fine-grained error analysis to identify common failure modes across various models, and create a taxonomy of reasoning errors. We use this to explore both human and LLM-as-a-judge methods for scoring video reasoning traces, and find that failure modes are primarily related to temporal localization, followed by visual perception errors, as opposed to logical or completeness errors. The dataset, along with questions, answer candidates and reasoning traces is publicly available under https://github.com/google-deepmind/neptune?tab=readme-ov-file#minerva  https://github.com/google-deepmind/neptune?tab=readme-ov-file\#minerva.
authors: Arsha Nagrani, Sachit Menon, Ahmet Iscen, Shyamal Buch, Ramin Mehran, Nilpa Jha, Anja Hauth, Yukun Zhu, Carl Vondrick , Mikhail Sirotenko, Cordelia Schmid, Tobias Weyand ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23968-23978

title: MIORe & VAR-MIORe: 推动修复领域边界的基准数据集
title_en: MIORe & VAR-MIORe: Benchmarks to Push the Boundaries of Restoration
abstract: 我们引入了MIORe和VAR-MIORe两个新颖的多任务数据集,旨在解决当前运动修复基准数据集的关键局限性。该数据集采用高帧率(1000 FPS)采集和专业级光学设备设计,涵盖了复杂自拍相机运动、动态多主体交互以及深度依赖的模糊效应等广泛运动场景。通过基于计算的光流指标自适应平均帧,MIORe生成一致的运动模糊效果,并保留锐利输入以用于视频帧插值和光流估计。VAR-MIORe进一步扩展,涵盖从最小到极端的可变运动幅度范围,建立了首个可显式控制运动幅度的基准数据集。我们提供了高分辨率、可扩展的地面真实数据,在可控和恶劣条件下挑战现有算法,为各种图像和视频修复任务的下一代研究铺平道路。
abstract_en: We introduce MIORe and VAR-MIORe, two novel multi-task datasets that address critical limitations in current motion restoration benchmarks. Designed with high-frame-rate (1000 FPS) acquisition and professional-grade optics, our datasets capture a broad spectrum of motion scenarios, which include complex ego-camera movements, dynamic multi-subject interactions, and depth-dependent blur effects. By adaptively averaging frames based on computed optical flow metrics, MIORe generates consistent motion blur, and preserves sharp inputs for video frame interpolation and optical flow estimation. VAR-MIORe further extends by spanning a variable range of motion magnitudes, from minimal to extreme, establishing the first benchmark to offer explicit control over motion amplitude. We provide high-resolution, scalable ground truths that challenge existing algorithms under both controlled and adverse conditions, paving the way for next-generation research of various image and video restoration tasks.
authors: George Ciubotariu, Zhuyun Zhou, Zongwei Wu, Radu Timofte ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19784-19793

title: MM-IFEngine: 向多模态指令跟随迈进
title_en: MM-IFEngine: Towards Multimodal Instruction Following
abstract: 指令跟随(IF)能力衡量多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)理解用户指令并准确执行的能力。现有多模态指令跟随训练数据稀缺,基准测试简单且仅包含原子指令,对需要精确输出约束的任务评估策略不精确。为解决这一问题,我们提出MM-IFEngine,一种有效生成高质量图像-指令对的流程。我们的MM-IFEngine流程生成大规模、多样且高质量的训练数据集MM-IFInstruct-23k,适用于监督微调(SFT),并扩展为用于直接偏好优化(DPO)的MM-IFDPO-23k。我们进一步引入MM-IFEval,一个具有挑战性且多样的多模态指令跟随基准测试,包含(1)输出响应的文本约束与输入图像的视觉约束,以及(2)结合基于规则评估与大语言模型作为裁判的综合评估流程。我们进行了SFT和DPO实验,证明在MM-IFInstruct-23k和MM-IFDPO-23k上微调MLLMs在各类IF基准测试中取得显著提升,如MM-IFEval(+11.8%)、MIA(+7.7%)和IFEval(+10.5%)。
abstract_en: The Instruction Following (IF) ability measures how well Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) understand exactly what users are telling them and doing it right.Existing multimodal instruction following training data is scarce, the benchmarks are simple with atomic instructions, and the evaluation strategies are imprecise for tasks demanding exact output constraints.To address this, we present MM-IFEngine, an effective pipeline to generate high-quality image-instruction pairs.Our MM-IFEngine pipeline yields large-scale, diverse, and high-quality training data MM-IFInstruct-23k, which is suitable for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and extended as MM-IFDPO-23k for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).We further introduce MM-IFEval, a challenging and diverse multi-modal instruction-following benchmark that includes (1) both textual constraints for output responses and visual constraints tied to the input images, and (2) a comprehensive evaluation pipeline incorporating rule-based assessment and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation.We conduct SFT and DPO experiments and demonstrate that fine-tuning MLLMs on MM-IFInstruct-23k and MM-IFDPO-23k achieve notable gains on various IF benchmarks, such as MM-IFEval (+11.8%), MIA (+7.7%), and IFEval (+10.5%).
authors: Shengyuan Ding, Shenxi Wu, Xiangyu Zhao, Yuhang Zang, Haodong Duan, Xiaoyi Dong, Pan Zhang, Yuhang Cao, Dahua Lin, Jiaqi Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1099-1109

title: MM-Spatial:探索多模态大语言模型中的三维空间理解
title_en: MM-Spatial: Exploring 3D Spatial Understanding in Multimodal LLMs
abstract: 多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)在二维视觉理解方面表现出色,但在三维空间推理能力上仍存在局限。本工作中,我们利用大规模高质量的三维场景数据及开放集注释,提出1)一个新颖的监督微调数据集和2)针对室内场景的新评价基准。我们的Cubify Anything VQA(CA-VQA)数据集涵盖空间关系预测、度量尺寸和距离估计、三维定位等多样化空间任务。我们证明CA-VQA使我们能够训练MM-Spatial,这是一种在三维空间理解基准测试中表现优异的通用型MLLM,包括我们自建的基准。我们展示了如何通过结合度量深度和多视角输入(由CA-VQA提供)进一步提升三维理解能力,并证明仅凭数据即可使我们的模型实现与专用单目深度估计模型相当的深度感知能力。
abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel at 2D visual understanding but remain limited in their ability to reason about 3D space. In this work, we leverage large-scale high-quality 3D scene data with open-set annotations to introduce 1) a novel supervised fine-tuning dataset and 2) a new evaluation benchmark, focused on indoor scenes. Our Cubify Anything VQA (CA-VQA) data covers diverse spatial tasks including spatial relationship prediction, metric size and distance estimation, and 3D grounding. We show that CA-VQA enables us to train MM-Spatial, a strong generalist MLLM that also achieves state-of-the-art performance on 3D spatial understanding benchmarks, including our own. We show how incorporating metric depth and multi-view inputs (provided in CA-VQA) can further improve 3D understanding, and demonstrate that data alone allows our model to achieve depth perception capabilities comparable to dedicated monocular depth estimation models.
authors: Erik Daxberger, Nina Wenzel, David Griffiths, Haiming Gang, Justin Lazarow, Gefen Kohavi, Kai Kang, Marcin Eichner, Yinfei Yang, Afshin Dehghan, Peter Grasch ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7395-7408

title: MMAD:视频中的多标签微动作检测
title_en: MMAD: Multi-label Micro-Action Detection in Videos
abstract: 人体动作是社会互动中重要的非语言交流形式。本文特别关注一种被称为微动作的身体动作子集,这些微动作是细微且低强度的身体运动,在人类情感分析中具有广阔的应用前景。在现实场景中,人类微动作往往在时间上共现,多个微动作在时间上重叠,例如同时发生的头部和手部运动。然而,当前研究主要关注识别单个微动作,而忽视了它们的共现特性。为解决这一问题,我们提出一个新的任务,称为多标签微动作检测(MMAD),其目标是识别给定短视频中的所有微动作,确定其起始和结束时间,并进行分类。实现这一目标需要一种能够准确捕捉长期和短期动作关系的模型,以检测多个重叠的微动作。为促进MMAD任务,我们引入了一个新的数据集,命名为多标签微动作-52(MMA-52),并提出了一种基于双路径时空适配器的基线方法,以应对MMAD中细微视觉变化的挑战。我们希望MMA-52能够激发视频中微动作分析的研究,并推动以人类为中心的视频理解中的时空建模发展。所提出的MMA-52数据集可在以下链接获取:https://github.com/VUT-HFUT/Micro-Action
abstract_en: Human body actions are an important form of non-verbal communication in social interactions. This paper specifically focuses on a subset of body actions known as micro-actions, which are subtle, low-intensity body movements with promising applications in human emotion analysis. In real-world scenarios, human micro-actions often temporally co-occur, with multiple micro-actions overlapping in time, such as concurrent head and hand movements. However, current research primarily focuses on recognizing individual micro-actions while overlooking their co-occurring nature. To address this gap, we propose a new task named Multi-label Micro-Action Detection (MMAD), which involves identifying all micro-actions in a given short video, determining their start and end times, and categorizing them. Accomplishing this requires a model capable of accurately capturing both long-term and short-term action relationships to detect multiple overlapping micro-actions. To facilitate the MMAD task, we introduce a new dataset named Multi-label Micro-Action-52 (MMA-52) and propose a baseline method equipped with a dual-path spatial-temporal adapter to address the challenges of subtle visual change in MMAD. We hope that MMA-52 can stimulate research on micro-action analysis in videos and prompt the development of spatio-temporal modeling in human-centric video understanding. The proposed MMA-52 dataset is available at: https://github.com/VUT-HFUT/Micro-Action
authors: Kun Li, Pengyu Liu, Dan Guo, Fei Wang, Zhiliang Wu, Hehe Fan, Meng Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13225-13236

title: MMAIF:基于语言引导的多任务多退化一体化图像融合方法
title_en: MMAIF: Multi-task and Multi-degradation All-in-One for Image Fusion with Language Guidance
abstract: 图像融合是一项基础的低级视觉任务,旨在将多个图像序列整合为单个输出,同时尽可能保留输入中的信息。然而,现有方法面临以下显著局限:1)需要针对特定任务或数据集的模型;2)忽略现实世界中的图像退化(如噪声),导致处理退化输入时失效;3)在像素空间中操作,其中注意力机制计算成本高昂;4)缺乏用户交互能力。为解决这些挑战,我们提出了一体化框架,用于多任务、多退化和语言引导的图像融合。我们的框架包含两个关键组件:1)一个实用的退化流程,模拟现实世界图像退化并生成交互式提示以引导模型;2)一个在潜在空间中操作的全集成扩散变换器(DiT),该变换器基于退化输入和生成的提示进行条件化融合。此外,我们对原始DiT架构进行了系统性改进,以更好地适应融合任务。基于此框架,我们开发了两种模型版本:基于回归的变体和基于流匹配的变体。广泛的定性和定量实验表明,我们的方法有效解决了上述局限性,并优于以往的修复+融合和全集成流程。
abstract_en: Image fusion, a fundamental low-level vision task, aims to integrate multiple image sequences into a single output while preserving as much information as possible from the input. However, existing methods face several significant limitations: 1) requiring task- or dataset-specific models; 2) neglecting real-world image degradations (e.g., noise), which causes failure when processing degraded inputs; 3) operating in pixel space, where attention mechanisms are computationally expensive; and 4) lacking user interaction capabilities.To address these challenges, we propose a unified framework for multi-task, multi-degradation, and language-guided image fusion. Our framework includes two key components: 1) a practical degradation pipeline that simulates real-world image degradations and generates interactive prompts to guide the model; 2) an all-in-one Diffusion Transformer (DiT) operating in latent space, which fuses a clean image conditioned on both the degraded inputs and the generated prompts. Furthermore, we introduce principled modifications to the original DiT architecture to better suit the fusion task. Based on this framework, we develop two versions of the model: Regression-based and Flow Matching-based variants.Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that our approach effectively addresses the aforementioned limitations and outperforms previous restoration+fusion and all-in-one pipelines.
authors: Zihan Cao, Yu Zhong, Ziqi Wang, Liang-Jian Deng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11744-11754

title: MMAT-1M:多模态代理调优的大规模推理数据集
title_en: MMAT-1M: A Large Reasoning Dataset for Multimodal Agent Tuning
abstract: 通过代理调优增强的大语言模型(LLMs)在思维链(CoT)和工具利用方面展现出卓越能力,显著超越了独立模型的性能。然而,多模态领域仍缺乏大规模、高质量的代理调优数据集以充分释放多模态大语言模型的潜力。为弥合这一差距,我们引入了MMAT-1M,这是首个百万级多模态代理调优数据集,旨在支持思维链、反思和动态工具使用。我们的数据集通过创新的四阶段数据引擎构建:1)首先筛选包含问答对的公开多模态数据集;2)随后利用GPT-4o为原始问答对生成推理过程,并通过多轮范式动态整合API调用和检索增强生成(RAG)信息;3)进一步通过反思优化推理过程,确保逻辑一致性和准确性,构建包含推理与反思(RR)的多轮对话数据集;4)最后,为提升效率,可选地将多轮对话压缩为单轮推理与反思(ORR)格式。在MMAT-1M上微调开源多模态模型可观察到显著性能提升。例如,InternVL2.5-8B-RR模型在八个公开基准测试中平均提升2.7%,在RAG基准测试Dyn-VQA中提升8.8%,证明了该数据集在增强多模态推理和工具化能力方面的有效性。该数据集可在https://github.com/VIS-MPU-Agent/MMAT-1M获取。
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs), enhanced through agent tuning, have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and tool utilization, significantly surpassing the performance of standalone models. However, the multimodal domain still lacks a large-scale, high-quality agent tuning dataset to unlock the full potential of multimodal large language models. To bridge this gap, we introduce MMAT-1M, the first million-scale multimodal agent tuning dataset designed to support CoT, reflection, and dynamic tool usage. Our dataset is constructed through a novel four-stage data engine: 1) We first curate publicly available multimodal datasets containing question-answer pairs; 2) Then, leveraging GPT-4o, we generate rationales for the original question-answer pairs and dynamically integrate API calls and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) information through a multi-turn paradigm; 3) Furthermore, we refine the rationales through reflection to ensure logical consistency and accuracy, creating a multi-turn dialogue dataset with both Rationale and Reflection (RR); 4) Finally, to enhance efficiency, we optionally compress multi-turn dialogues into a One-turn Rationale and Reflection (ORR) format. By fine-tuning open-source multimodal models on the MMAT-1M, we observe significant performance gains. For instance, the InternVL2.5-8B-RR model achieves an average improvement of 2.7% across eight public benchmarks and 8.8% on the RAG benchmark Dyn-VQA, demonstrating the dataset's effectiveness in enhancing multimodal reasoning and tool-based capabilities. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/VIS-MPU-Agent/MMAT-1M.
authors: Tianhong Gao, Yannian Fu, Weiqun Wu, Haixiao Yue, Shanshan Liu, Gang Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1484-1494

title: MMCR:科学论文中跨源推理的基准测试
title_en: MMCR: Benchmarking Cross-Source Reasoning in Scientific Papers
abstract: 机器全面理解科学论文反映了人工通用智能的高水平,要求具备在碎片化和异构信息源之间进行推理的能力,提出了一个复杂且具有实际意义的挑战。尽管视觉-语言模型(VLMs)在各类任务中取得了显著进展,特别是在基于单张图像或文本页面的证据源推理任务中,但其利用跨源信息进行推理的能力仍是一个开放性问题。本文提出MMCR,一个高难度基准测试,用于评估VLMs在科学论文跨源信息推理中的能力。该基准包含7个学科领域、10种任务类型的276个高质量问题,由人类精心标注。对18个VLMs的实验表明,跨源推理对现有模型提出了重大挑战。值得注意的是,表现最佳的模型GPT-4o整体准确率仅为48.55%,在多表格理解任务中准确率仅为20%,而次优模型Qwen2.5-VL-72B的整体准确率为39.86%。这些结果凸显了开发能够有效利用跨源信息进行推理的VLMs的迫切需求。
abstract_en: Fully comprehending scientific papers by machines reflects a high level of Artificial General Intelligence, requiring the ability to reason across fragmented and heterogeneous sources of information, presenting a complex and practically significant challenge. While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have made remarkable strides in various tasks, particularly those involving reasoning with evidence source from single image or text page, their ability to use cross-source information for reasoning remains an open problem. This work presents MMCR, a high-difficulty benchmark designed to evaluate VLMs' capacity for reasoning with cross-source information from scientific papers. The benchmark comprises 276 high-quality questions, meticulously annotated by humans across 7 subjects and 10 task types. Experiments with 18 VLMs demonstrate that cross-source reasoning presents a substantial challenge for existing models. Notably, even the top-performing model, GPT-4o, achieved only 48.55% overall accuracy, with just 20% accuracy in multi-table comprehension tasks, while the second-best model, Qwen2.5-VL-72B, reached 39.86% overall accuracy. These results highlight the pressing need to develop VLMs capable of effectively utilizing cross-source information for reasoning.
authors: Yang Tian, Zheng Lu, Mingqi Gao, Zheng Liu, Bo Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 488-497

title: MMGeo:面向无人机的多模态组合地理定位
title_en: MMGeo: Multimodal Compositional Geo-Localization for UAVs
abstract: 多模态地理定位方法能够通过利用不同模态间的互补信息,本质上克服单一传感器系统的局限性。然而,现有基于检索的方法依赖于全面的多模态数据库,这在实际应用中往往难以满足。本文提出一个更实际的问题,通过在卫星视角参考地图中协作多模态数据,实现无人机视角图像的定位,该方法整合多模态信息而无需依赖庞大的多模态数据库。我们提出MMGeo,通过统一框架学习将多模态表征的组合推向目标参考地图。通过利用全面的多模态查询(图像、点云/深度/文本),我们能够实现更鲁棒和精确的地理定位,特别是在未知且复杂的环境中。此外,我们将两个视觉地理定位数据集GTA-UAV和UAV-VisLoc扩展为多模态,建立了首个结合图像、点云、深度和文本数据的无人机地理定位数据集。实验验证了MMGeo在无人机多模态组合地理定位的有效性,以及其在现实场景中的泛化能力。代码和数据集见https://github.com/Yux1angJi/MMGeo。
abstract_en: Multimodal geo-localization methods can inherently overcome the limitations of unimodal sensor systems by leveraging complementary information from different modalities. However, existing retrieval-based methods rely on a comprehensive multimodal database, which is often challenging to fulfill in practice. In this paper, we introduce a more practical problem for localizing drone-view images by collaborating multimodal data within a satellite-view reference map, which integrates multimodal information while avoiding the need for an extensive multimodal database. We present MMGeo that learns to push the composition of multimodal representations to the target reference map through a unified framework. By utilizing a comprehensive multimodal query (image, point cloud/depth/text), we can achieve more robust and accurate geo-localization, especially in unknown and complex environments. Additionally, we extend two visual geo-localization datasets GTA-UAV and UAV-VisLoc to multi-modality, establishing the first UAV geo-localization datasets that combine image, point cloud, depth and text data. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of MMGeo for UAV multimodal compositional geo-localization, as well as the generalization capabilities to real-world scenarios. The code and dataset are at https://github.com/Yux1angJi/MMGeo.
authors: Yuxiang Ji, Boyong He, Zhuoyue Tan, Liaoni Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25165-25175

title: MMOne: 在单一场景中表示多种模态
title_en: MMOne: Representing Multiple Modalities in One Scene
abstract: 人类通过多模态线索感知世界以理解并交互环境。学习多模态场景表示可增强对物理世界的理解。然而,源于不同模态固有差异的模态冲突带来两个关键挑战:属性差异与粒度差异。为解决这些问题,我们提出通用框架MMOne,用于在单一场景中表示多种模态,该框架可便捷扩展至更多模态。具体而言,我们设计了一个包含新型模态指示器的模态建模模块,以捕捉各模态的独特属性。此外,我们设计了多模态分解机制,基于模态差异将多模态高斯分布分解为单模态高斯分布。通过将多模态信息解耦为共享成分与模态特异性成分,我们有效处理模态间本质差异,从而获得更紧凑高效的多模态场景表示。大量实验表明,我们的方法持续增强各模态的表示能力,并可扩展至更多模态。代码已开源至https://github.com/Neal2020GitHub/MMOne。
abstract_en: Humans perceive the world through multimodal cues to understand and interact with the environment. Learning a scene representation for multiple modalities enhances comprehension of the physical world. However, modality conflicts, arising from inherent distinctions among different modalities, present two critical challenges: property disparity and granularity disparity. To address these challenges, we propose a general framework, MMOne, to represent multiple modalities in one scene, which can be readily extended to additional modalities. Specifically, a modality modeling module with a novel modality indicator is proposed to capture the unique properties of each modality. Additionally, we design a multimodal decomposition mechanism to separate multi-modal Gaussians into single-modal Gaussians based on modality differences. We address the essential distinctions among modalities by disentangling multimodal information into shared and modality-specific components, resulting in a more compact and efficient multimodal scene representation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently enhances the representation capability for each modality and is scalable to additional modalities. The code is available at https://github.com/Neal2020GitHub/MMOne.
authors: Zhifeng Gu, Bing Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1088-1098

title: MMReason:面向通用人工智能的多模态多步骤开放推理基准测试
title_en: MMReason: An Open-Ended Multi-Modal Multi-Step Reasoning Benchmark for MLLMs Toward AGI
abstract: 推理在推动多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)向通用人工智能(AGI)发展过程中发挥着关键作用。然而,现有MLLM基准测试往往在三个关键方面难以精准且全面地评估长链推理能力:(1)缺乏难度与多样性,(2)易受猜测性与记忆性干扰,(3)对中间推理步骤的评估不足。为填补这一空白,我们提出**MMReason**,一个旨在精准且全面评估MLLM长链推理能力的新型基准测试,其包含多样、开放性、具有挑战性的题目。首先,我们从六个学科领域及多个难度层级(即从中学至大学,从基础到竞赛级别)精选需要多步骤推理的挑战性问题。其次,这些问题被改写为开放性格式,并通过多模型投票技术筛选,以消除与猜测和记忆相关的捷径案例,确保推理评估的鲁棒性。第三,我们为问题标注详细的分步解答,并设计基于参考的三元评分机制,以可靠评估中间推理步骤。通过MMReason,我们对主流MLLM进行了基准测试,并深入分析其推理能力。我们希望MMReason能成为推进MLLM推理研究的宝贵资源。
abstract_en: Reasoning plays a crucial role in advancing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) toward Artificial General Intelligence.However, existing MLLM benchmarks often fall short in precisely and comprehensively evaluating long-chain reasoning abilities from three key aspects: (1) lack of difficulty and diversity, (2) susceptibility to guessability and memorization, (3) inadequate assessment of intermediate reasoning steps.To fill this gap, we introduce **MMReason**, a new benchmark designed to precisely and comprehensively evaluate MLLM long-chain reasoning capability with diverse, open-ended, challenging questions.First, we curate challenging questions requiring multi-step reasoning from various fields (i.e., 6 disciplines) and multiple difficulty levels (i.e., from pre-university to university, and from foundational to competition tiers).Second, these questions are reformulated into an open-ended format and filtered using a multi-model voting technique to eliminate shortcut cases related to guessing and memorization, ensuring robust reasoning evaluations.Third, we annotate the questions with detailed step-by-step solutions, and design a reference-based ternary scoring mechanism to reliably assess intermediate reasoning steps.With MMReason, we benchmark popular leading MLLMs and provide an in-depth analysis of their reasoning capabilities.We hope MMReason will serve as a valuable resource for advancing MLLM reasoning research.
authors: Huanjin Yao, Jiaxing Huang, Yawen Qiu, Michael K. Chen, Wenzheng Liu, Wei Zhang, Wenjie Zeng, Xikun Zhang, Jingyi Zhang, YuXin Song, Wenhao Wu, Dacheng Tao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 273-283

title: MOBIUS:通过多模态瓶颈融合与校准解码器剪枝实现从大型到移动的通用实例分割
title_en: MOBIUS: Big-to-Mobile Universal Instance Segmentation via Multi-modal Bottleneck Fusion and Calibrated Decoder Pruning
abstract: 扩大模型规模和训练数据量已推动基础模型在实例级感知领域的发展,实现了目标检测和分割任务中领域内及零样本性能的最先进水平。然而,其高昂的计算成本限制了其在资源受限平台上的应用。我们首先分析现有架构在实现高效边缘部署时的局限性,同时保持性能不下降。随后,我们引入MOBIUS,这是一类用于通用实例分割的基础模型,旨在实现帕累托最优的模型压缩,以支持从高端加速器到移动硬件的多设备部署。为降低训练和推理需求,我们提出:(i) 一种用于高效多尺度和多模态融合的瓶颈像素解码器,(ii) 一种语言引导的不确定性校准损失以实现自适应解码器剪枝,以及(iii) 一种简化且统一的训练策略。与那些以降低复杂度为代价牺牲准确率的高效基线不同,MOBIUS分别将像素和Transformer解码器的FLOPs降低了最多55%和75%,同时仅用三分之一的训练迭代次数即可保持最先进性能。MOBIUS在高性能计算平台和移动设备上建立了新的高效分割基准。
abstract_en: Scaling up model size and training data has advanced foundation models for instance-level perception, achieving state-of-the-art in-domain and zero-shot performance across object detection and segmentation. However, their high computational cost limits adoption on resource-constrained platforms. We first examine the limitations of existing architectures in enabling efficient edge deployment without compromising performance. We then introduce MOBIUS, a family of foundation models for universal instance segmentation, designed for Pareto-optimal downscaling to support deployment across devices ranging from high-end accelerators to mobile hardware. To reduce training and inference demands, we propose: (i) a bottleneck pixel decoder for efficient multi-scale and multi-modal fusion, (ii) a language-guided uncertainty calibration loss for adaptive decoder pruning, and (iii) a streamlined, unified training strategy. Unlike efficient baselines that trade accuracy for reduced complexity, MOBIUS reduces pixel and transformer decoder FLOPs by up to 55% and 75%, respectively, while maintaining state-of-the-art performance in just a third of the training iterations. MOBIUS establishes a new benchmark for efficient segmentation on both high-performance computing platforms and mobile devices.
authors: Mattia Segu, Marta Tintore Gazulla, Yongqin Xian, Luc Van Gool, Federico Tombari ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20726-20736

title: MOERL:当专家混合模型与强化学习相遇用于恶劣天气图像修复
title_en: MOERL: When Mixture-of-Experts Meet Reinforcement Learning for Adverse Weather Image Restoration
abstract: 恶劣天气条件(如雨、雪、霾)引入复杂的退化现象,对图像修复任务构成重大挑战。现有的一体化模型通常依赖固定网络结构,限制了其对不同天气特征的适应能力。此外,这些模型通常缺乏人类专家用于渐进式图像修复的迭代优化过程。在本工作中,我们提出MOERL,一种通过强化学习(RL)优化的专家混合模型(MoE),以提升在多样化天气条件下的图像修复效果。我们的方法包含两种核心类型的专家,即通道调制专家和空间调制专家,以应对任务特定的退化特征并最小化任务干扰。此外,受人类专家启发,我们将优化过程建模为序列渐进问题,使网络能够逐步优化参数并适应特定天气条件。大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性和优越性。代码和预训练模型将公开提供。
abstract_en: Adverse weather conditions, such as rain, snow, and haze, introduce complex degradations that present substantial challenges for effective image restoration. Existing all-in-one models often rely on fixed network structures, limiting their ability to adapt to the varying characteristics of different weather conditions. Moreover, these models typically lack the iterative refinement process that human experts use for progressive image restoration. In this work, we propose MOERL, a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model optimized with reinforcement learning (RL) to enhance image restoration across diverse weather conditions. Our method incorporates two core types of experts, i.e., channel-wise modulation and spatial modulation experts, to address task-specific degradation characteristics while minimizing task interference. In addition, inspired by human expertise, we frame the optimization process as a sequential, progressive problem, allowing the network to refine its parameters progressively and adapt to specific weather conditions. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy and superiority of our proposed method. The code and pre-trained models will be available.
authors: Tao Wang, Peiwen Xia, Bo Li, Peng-Tao Jiang, Zhe Kong, Kaihao Zhang, Tong Lu, Wenhan Luo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13673-13683

title: MOSAIC: 从多视角深度图像生成多房间环境的一致性隐私保护场景
title_en: MOSAIC: Generating Consistent, Privacy-Preserving Scenes from Multiple Depth Views in Multi-Room Environments
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于扩散模型的方法,仅通过深度图像生成多房间室内环境的隐私保护数字孪生。该方法的核心是一种新型的多视角重叠场景对齐与隐式一致性(Multi-view Overlapped Scene Alignment with Implicit Consistency, MOSAIC)模型,该模型在概率意义上显式考虑同一场景内跨视角的依赖关系。MOSAIC通过多通道推理时间优化进行操作,避免了基于全景图方法中序贯或单房间约束常见的误差累积问题。MOSAIC无需额外训练即可扩展到复杂场景,并在增加更多重叠视角时可证明地降低去噪过程中的方差,从而提升生成质量。实验表明,MOSAIC在重建复杂多房间环境的图像保真度指标上优于最先进的基线方法。
abstract_en: We introduce a diffusion-based approach for generating privacy-preserving digital twins of multi-room indoor environments from depth images only. Central to our approach is a novel Multi-view Overlapped Scene Alignment with Implicit Consistency (MOSAIC) model that explicitly considers cross-view dependencies within the same scene in the probabilistic sense. MOSAIC operates through a multi-channel inference-time optimization that avoids error accumulation common in sequential or single-room constraints in panorama-based approaches. MOSAIC scales to complex scenes with zero extra training and provably reduces the variance during denoising process when more overlapping views are added, leading to improved generation quality. Experiments show that MOSAIC outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on image fidelity metrics in reconstructing complex multi-room environments.
authors: Zhixuan Liu, Haokun Zhu, Rui Chen, Jonathan Francis, Soonmin Hwang, Ji Zhang, Jean Oh ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27456-27465

title: MOSCATO: 通过动作预测多物体状态变化
title_en: MOSCATO: Predicting Multiple Object State Change Through Actions
abstract: 我们引入MOSCATO:一个用于通过长时序程序化视频中多个动作预测多物体状态演变的新基准。尽管先前的物体状态预测研究通常聚焦于单个物体经历一到几次状态变化,但现实任务需要跟踪多个物体,其状态在多个动作中持续演变。鉴于收集多视频帧级物体状态标签的高成本,我们开发了一个弱监督多物体状态预测框架,仅在训练中使用动作标签。具体而言,我们提出了一种新颖的伪标签获取(PLA)流程,整合大型语言模型、视觉-语言模型和动作片段标注,生成用于训练多物体状态预测(MOSP)网络的细粒度、每帧物体状态伪标签。我们进一步设计了状态-动作交互(SAI)模块,显式建模动作与物体状态之间的关联,从而提升MOSP性能。为促进全面评估,我们通过添加帧级物体状态标注,构建了MOSCATO基准数据集。实验表明,我们的多阶段伪标签方法和SAI模块显著优于零样本VLM基线和现有方法的简单扩展,突显了对细粒度程序化视频理解进行整体动作-状态建模的重要性。
abstract_en: We introduce MOSCATO: a new benchmark for predicting the evolving states of multiple objects through long procedural videos with multiple actions. While prior work in object state prediction has typically focused on a single object undergoing one or a few state changes, real-world tasks require tracking many objects whose states evolve over multiple actions. Given the high cost of gathering framewise object-state labels for many videos, we develop a weakly-supervised multiple object state prediction framework, which only uses action labels during training. Specifically, we propose a novel Pseudo-Label Acquisition (PLA) pipeline that integrates large language models, vision-language models, and action segment annotations to generate fine-grained, per-frame object-state pseudo-labels for training a Multiple Object State Prediction (MOSP) network. We further devise a State-Action Interaction (SAI) module that explicitly models the correlations between actions and object states, thereby improving MOSP. To facilitate comprehensive evaluation, we create the MOSCATO benchmark by augmenting three egocentric video datasets with framewise object-state annotations. Experiments show that our multi-stage pseudo-labeling approach and SAI module significantly boost performance over zero-shot VLM baselines and naive extensions of existing methods, underscoring the importance of holistic action-state modeling for fine-grained procedural video understanding.
authors: Parnian Zameni, Yuhan Shen, Ehsan Elhamifar ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11600-11611

title: MOVE:运动引导的少样本视频对象分割
title_en: MOVE: Motion-Guided Few-Shot Video Object Segmentation
abstract: 本工作针对运动引导的少样本视频对象分割(FSVOS)问题,旨在基于少量具有相同运动模式的标注示例,对视频中的动态对象进行分割。现有FSVOS数据集和方法通常关注对象类别,这些静态属性忽略了视频中的丰富时间动态,限制了其在需要运动理解场景中的应用。为填补这一空白,我们引入了MOVE,这是一个专门为运动引导的FSVOS设计的大规模数据集。基于MOVE,我们在两种实验设置下,全面评估了来自三个不同相关任务的六种最先进的方法。我们的结果表明,现有方法难以应对运动引导的FSVOS问题,促使我们分析相关挑战并提出一种基准方法——解耦运动外观网络(DMA)。实验表明,我们的方法在少样本运动理解中表现出优越的性能,为未来该方向的研究奠定了坚实基础。
abstract_en: This work addresses motion-guided few-shot video object segmentation (FSVOS), which aims to segment dynamic objects in videos based on a few annotated examples with the same motion patterns. Existing FSVOS datasets and methods typically focus on object categories, which are static attributes that ignore the rich temporal dynamics in videos, limiting their application in scenarios requiring motion understanding. To fill this gap, we introduce MOVE, a large-scale dataset specifically designed for motion-guided FSVOS. Based on MOVE, we comprehensively evaluate 6 state-of-the-art methods from 3 different related tasks across 2 experimental settings. Our results reveal that current methods struggle to address motion-guided FSVOS, prompting us to analyze the associated challenges and propose a baseline method, Decoupled Motion Appearance Network (DMA). Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance in few shot motion understanding, establishing a solid foundation for future research in this direction.
authors: Kaining Ying, Hengrui Hu, Henghui Ding ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11632-11642

title: MP-HSIR:一种通用高光谱图像恢复的多提示框架
title_en: MP-HSIR: A Multi-Prompt Framework for Universal Hyperspectral Image Restoration
abstract: 高光谱图像(HSIs)在成像过程中常遭受多样且未知的退化现象,导致严重的光谱和空间失真。现有高光谱图像恢复方法通常依赖特定的退化假设,限制了其在复杂场景中的有效性。本文提出MP-HSIR,一种新颖的多提示框架,通过有效融合光谱、文本和视觉提示,实现对多种退化类型和强度的通用高光谱图像恢复。具体而言,我们开发了提示引导的空谱变换器,其包含空间自注意力机制和提示引导的双分支光谱自注意力模块。由于退化对光谱特征的影响存在差异,我们在局部光谱分支中引入光谱提示,提供通用低秩光谱模式作为先验知识以增强光谱重建。此外,文本-视觉协同提示通过融合高层语义表示与细粒度视觉特征,编码退化信息,从而指导恢复过程。在9个高光谱图像恢复任务(包括一体化场景、泛化测试和现实案例)上的广泛实验表明,MP-HSIR不仅在一体化方法中持续优于现有方法,而且在多个任务中超越了最先进的任务特定方法。代码和模型可在https://github.com/ZhehuiWu/MP-HSIR获取。
abstract_en: Hyperspectral images (HSIs) often suffer from diverse and unknown degradations during imaging, leading to severe spectral and spatial distortions. Existing HSI restoration methods typically rely on specific degradation assumptions, limiting their effectiveness in complex scenarios. In this paper, we propose MP-HSIR, a novel multi-prompt framework that effectively integrates spectral, textual, and visual prompts to achieve universal HSI restoration across diverse degradation types and intensities. Specifically, we develop a prompt-guided spatial-spectral transformer, which incorporates spatial self-attention and a prompt-guided dual-branch spectral self-attention. Since degradations affect spectral features differently, we introduce spectral prompts in the local spectral branch to provide universal low-rank spectral patterns as prior knowledge for enhancing spectral reconstruction. Furthermore, the text-visual synergistic prompt fuses high-level semantic representations with fine-grained visual features to encode degradation information, thereby guiding the restoration process. Extensive experiments on 9 HSI restoration tasks, including all-in-one scenarios, generalization tests, and real-world cases, demonstrate that MP-HSIR not only consistently outperforms existing all-in-one methods but also surpasses state-of-the-art task-specific approaches across multiple tasks. The code and models are available at https://github.com/ZhehuiWu/MP-HSIR.
authors: Zhehui Wu, Yong Chen, Naoto Yokoya, Wei He ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13009-13020

title: MPBR:面向开放集细粒度识别的多模态渐进双向推理
title_en: MPBR: Multimodal Progressive Bidirectional Reasoning for Open-Set Fine-Grained Recognition
abstract: 开放集细粒度识别(OSFGR)是构建开放世界智能系统的核心探索方向。其挑战在于从粗粒度类别向细粒度类别过渡过程中出现的渐进语义漂移。然而,尽管现有方法利用层次化表示辅助渐进推理,却忽视了跨层次的语义一致性。为解决这一问题,我们提出一种多模态渐进双向推理框架:(1) 在前向推理中,模型逐步优化视觉特征以捕捉层次化结构表示;(2) 在反向推理中,变分推断整合多模态信息以约束类别感知潜在空间中的一致性。该机制通过双向信息流和跨层次特征一致性约束缓解语义漂移。在iNat2021-OSR数据集上的大量实验表明,所提方法取得了优越的性能。
abstract_en: Open-set fine-grained recognition (OSFGR) is the core exploration of building open-world intelligent systems. The challenge lies in the gradual semantic drift during the transition from coarse-grained to fine-grained categories. However, although existing methods leverage hierarchical representations to assist progressive reasoning, they neglect semantic consistency across hierarchies. To address this, we propose a multimodal progressive bidirectional reasoning framework: (1) In forward reasoning, the model progressively refines visual features to capture hierarchical structural representations, while (2) in backward reasoning, variational inference integrates multimodal information to constrain consistency in category-aware latent spaces. This mechanism mitigates semantic drift through bidirectional information flow and cross-hierarchical feature consistency constraints. Extensive experiments on the iNat2021-OSR dataset demonstrate that our proposed method achieves superior performance.
authors: Junfu Tan, Peiguang Jing, Yu Zhu, Yu Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1282-1291

title: MPG-SAM 2:结合掩码先验与全局上下文的SAM 2适配方法用于视频对象引用分割
title_en: MPG-SAM 2: Adapting SAM 2 with Mask Priors and Global Context for Referring Video Object Segmentation
abstract: 引用视频对象分割(RVOS)旨在根据文本描述对视频中的对象进行分割,这需要多模态信息的融合与时序动态感知。Segment Anything Model 2(SAM 2)在多种视频分割任务中表现出色。然而,其在离线RVOS中的应用面临文本到有效提示的转换以及缺乏全局上下文感知的挑战。本文提出了一种新型RVOS框架,称为MPG-SAM 2,以解决这些挑战。具体而言,MPG-SAM 2采用多模态编码器联合编码视频和文本特征,生成语义对齐的视频-文本嵌入以及多模态类别标记。设计了掩码先验生成器,利用视频嵌入和类别标记生成目标对象和全局上下文的伪掩码。这些掩码作为密集提示输入提示编码器,同时结合多模态类别标记作为稀疏提示,生成准确的SAM 2提示。为使在线SAM 2获得全局视角,提出分层全局-历史聚合器,使SAM 2能够在像素和对象层面聚合目标对象的全局与历史信息,增强目标表示与时间一致性。在多个RVOS基准数据集上的大量实验验证了MPG-SAM 2的优越性及所提模块的有效性。代码已开源于https://github.com/rongfu-dsb/MPG-SAM2。
abstract_en: Referring video object segmentation (RVOS) aims to segment objects in a video according to textual descriptions, which requires the integration of multimodal information and temporal dynamics perception. The Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM 2) has shown great effectiveness across various video segmentation tasks. However, its application to offline RVOS is challenged by the translation of the text into effective prompts and a lack of global context awareness. In this paper, we propose a novel RVOS framework, termed MPG-SAM 2, to address these challenges. Specifically, MPG-SAM 2 employs a multimodal encoder to jointly encode video and textual features, generating semantically aligned video and text embeddings along with multimodal class tokens. A mask prior generator is devised to utilize the video embeddings and class tokens to create pseudo masks of target objects and global context. These masks are fed into the prompt encoder as dense prompts, along with multimodal class tokens as sparse prompts to generate accurate prompts for SAM 2. To provide the online SAM 2 with a global view, we propose a hierarchical global-historical aggregator, which allows SAM 2 to aggregate global and historical information of target objects at both pixel and object levels, enhancing the target representation and temporal consistency. Extensive experiments on several RVOS benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of MPG-SAM 2 and the effectiveness of the proposed modules. The code is available at https://github.com/rongfu-dsb/MPG-SAM2.
authors: Fu Rong, Meng Lan, Qian Zhang, Lefei Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23979-23989

title: MR-FIQA:基于合成数据生成的多参考表示人脸图像质量评估
title_en: MR-FIQA: Face Image Quality Assessment with Multi-Reference Representations from Synthetic Data Generation
abstract: 近期在真实大规模人脸数据集上训练的人脸图像质量评估(FIQA)模型在无约束场景中保障精确人脸识别方面具有关键作用。然而,隐私问题导致真实数据集的终止,凸显了为FIQA任务定制合成数据集的迫切需求。然而,创建令人满意的FIQA合成数据集具有挑战性。这不仅需要控制伪身份生成中不同质量因素(如姿态、模糊、遮挡)的类内退化,还需要设计优化的质量表征方法用于质量标注。本文首次提出基于假设建立面向FIQA的合成数据集(SynFIQA):通过在质量可控生成涉及的多样化领域中利用质量先验,可实现准确的质量标注。为验证该假设,我们通过对齐稳定扩散潜在空间中的伪身份图像特征、编辑3D面部参数以及定制双文本提示和后处理,专门生成参考和退化样本。此外,我们提出了一种新颖的质量表征方法,全面分析识别嵌入、空间和视觉-语言领域中多参考表示的关系,以获取适用于拟合FIQA模型的标注(MR-FIQA)。大量实验验证了我们的假设,并展示了SynFIQA数据和MR-FIQA方法的优势。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in Face Image Quality Assessment (FIQA) models trained on real large-scale face datasets are pivotal in guaranteeing precise face recognition in unrestricted scenarios. Regrettably, privacy concerns lead to the discontinuation of real datasets, underscoring the pressing need for a tailored synthetic dataset dedicated to the FIQA task. However, creating satisfactory synthetic datasets for FIQA is challenging. It requires not only controlling the intra-class degradation of different quality factors (e.g., pose, blur, occlusion) for the pseudo-identity generation but also designing an optimized quality characterization method for quality annotations. This paper undertakes the pioneering initiative to establish a Synthetic dataset for FIQA (SynFIQA) based on a hypothesis: accurate quality labelling can be achieved through the utilization of quality priors across the diverse domains involved in quality-controllable generation. To validate this, we tailor the generation of reference and degraded samples by aligning pseudo-identity image features in stable diffusion latent space, editing 3D facial parameters, and customizing dual text prompts and post-processing. Furthermore, we propose a novel quality characterization method that thoroughly examines the relationship of Multiple Reference representations among recognition embedding, spatial, and visual-language domains to acquire annotations essential for fitting FIQA models (MR-FIQA). Extensive experiments confirm the validity of our hypothesis and demonstrate the advantages of our SynFIQA data and MR-FIQA method.
authors: Fu-Zhao Ou, Chongyi Li, Shiqi Wang, Sam Kwong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12915-12925

title: MRGen:面向少数MRI模态的分割数据引擎
title_en: MRGen: Segmentation Data Engine For Underrepresented MRI Modalities
abstract: 由于标注数据稀缺,训练罕见但具有临床重要性的医学影像分割模型具有挑战性,而手动掩码标注的获取成本高且劳动密集。本文研究利用生成模型合成数据,以训练少数模态的分割模型,特别是在标注稀缺的MRI领域。具体而言,我们的贡献有三方面:(i) 我们引入MRGen-DB,一个包含大量样本和丰富元数据的大规模放射影像-文本数据集,包括模态标签、属性、区域和器官信息,其中一部分样本包含像素级掩码标注;(ii) 我们提出MRGen,一种基于扩散的数据引擎,可受文本提示和分割掩码控制,用于医学影像合成。MRGen能够生成缺乏掩码标注的多样化MRI模态的逼真影像,促进低源域的分割训练;(iii) 跨多模态的大量实验表明,MRGen通过提供高质量的合成数据,显著提升了未标注模态的分割性能。我们认为该方法填补了医学影像分析中的关键空白,将分割能力扩展到难以获取手动标注的场景。代码、模型和数据将在:https://haoningwu3639.github.io/MRGen/ 公开。
abstract_en: Training medical image segmentation models for rare yet clinically important imaging modalities is challenging due to the scarcity of annotated data, and manual mask annotations can be costly and labor-intensive to acquire. This paper investigates leveraging generative models to synthesize data, for training segmentation models for underrepresented modalities, particularly on annotation-scarce MRI. Concretely, our contributions are threefold: (i) we introduce MRGen-DB, a large-scale radiology image-text dataset comprising extensive samples with rich metadata, including modality labels, attributes, regions, and organs information, with a subset featuring pixel-wise mask annotations; (ii) we present MRGen, a diffusion-based data engine for controllable medical image synthesis, conditioned on text prompts and segmentation masks. MRGen can generate realistic images for diverse MRI modalities lacking mask annotations, facilitating segmentation training in low-source domains; (iii) extensive experiments across multiple modalities demonstrate that MRGen significantly improves segmentation performance on unannotated modalities by providing high-quality synthetic data. We believe that our method bridges a critical gap in medical image analysis, extending segmentation capabilities to scenarios that are challenging to acquire manual annotations. The codes, models, and data will be publicly available at: https://haoningwu3639.github.io/MRGen/
authors: Haoning Wu, Ziheng Zhao, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang, Weidi Xie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19903-19913

title: MS3D:基于多尺度表示建模的高质量三维生成
title_en: MS3D: High-Quality 3D Generation via Multi-Scale Representation Modeling
abstract: 从稀疏视角图像中实现高质量纹理网格重建仍是计算机图形学和计算机视觉中的基础性挑战。传统的大规模重建模型采用单尺度方式运作,迫使模型同时捕捉全局结构与局部细节,往往导致重建形状质量受损。本文提出MS3D,一种新颖的多尺度三维重建框架。其核心方法引入分层结构化潜在表示进行多尺度建模,并结合多尺度特征提取与融合机制。这使得重建过程可逐步推进,有效将复杂细节几何重建任务分解为一系列更易处理的步骤。该粗到精的策略能够有效捕捉多频率细节,学习复杂几何模式,并在多样化物体上保持良好的泛化能力,同时保留细粒度细节。大量实验表明,MS3D优于现有最先进的方法,且广泛适用于图像-文本到三维生成场景。整个流程可在五秒内完成高质量纹理网格的重建。
abstract_en: High-quality textured mesh reconstruction from sparse-view images remains a fundamental challenge in computer graphics and computer vision. Traditional large reconstruction models operate in a single-scale manner, forcing the models to simultaneously capture global structure and local details, often resulting in compromised reconstructed shapes. In this work, we propose MS3D, a novel multi-scale 3D reconstruction framework. At its core, our method introduces a hierarchical structured latent representation for multi-scale modeling, coupled with a multi-scale feature extraction and integration mechanism. This enables progressive reconstruction, effectively decomposing the complex task of detailed geometry reconstruction into a sequence of easier steps. This coarse-to-fine approach effectively captures multi-frequency details, learns complex geometric patterns, and generalizes well across diverse objects while preserving fine-grained details. Extensive experiments demonstrate MS3D outperforms state-of-the-art methods and is broadly applicable to both image- and text-to-3D generation. The entire pipeline reconstructs high-quality textured meshes in under five seconds.
authors: Guan Luo, Jianfeng Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26336-26348

title: MSA2:面向开放集中文文本识别的结构感知与风格自适应多任务框架
title_en: MSA2: Multi-task Framework with Structure-aware and Style-adaptive Character Representation for Open-set Chinese Text Recognition
abstract: 现有方法大多将开放集中文文本识别(CTR)视为单任务问题,主要聚焦于语言成分或字形的原型学习以识别未见过的字符。相比之下,人类通过整合语言和视觉线索等多视角来识别字符。受此启发,我们提出一种名为MSA2的多任务框架,该框架针对开放集CTR考虑多视角字符表示。在MSA2中,我们引入两种新颖的字符表示策略:结构感知组件编码(SACE)和风格自适应字形嵌入(SAGE)。SACE利用具有动态表示空间的二叉树强调主要语言成分,从而为每个字符生成结构感知且具有判别性的语言表示。同时,SAGE采用以字形为中心的对比学习,聚合多样化形式的特征,为CTR模型生成鲁棒的字形表示以适应不同字体间的风格变化。大量实验表明,所提出的MSA2优于现有最先进的CTR方法,在BCTR数据集的闭集和开集设置下分别实现了1.3%和6.0%的平均准确率提升。代码将很快发布。
abstract_en: Most existing methods regard open-set Chinese text recognition (CTR) as a single-task problem, primarily focusing on prototype learning of linguistic components or glyphs to identify unseen characters. In contrast, humans identify characters by integrating multiple perspectives, including linguistic and visual cues. Inspired by this, we propose a multi-task framework termed MSA^2, which considers multi-view character representations for open-set CTR. Within MSA^2, we introduce two novel strategies for character representation: structure-aware component encoding (SACE) and style-adaptive glyph embedding (SAGE). SACE utilizes a binary tree with dynamic representation space to emphasize the primary linguistic components, thereby generating structure-aware and discriminative linguistic representations for each character. Meanwhile, SAGE employs a glyph-centric contrastive learning to aggregate features from diverse forms, yielding robust glyph representations for the CTR model to adapt to the style variations among various fonts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed MSA^2 outperforms state-of-the-art CTR methods, achieving an average improvement of 1.3% and 6.0% in accuracy under closed-set and open-set settings on the BCTR dataset, respectively. The code will be available soon.
authors: Yangfu Li, Hongjian Zhan, Qi Liu, Li Sun, Yu-Jie Xiong, Yue Lu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23095-23104

title: MSQ: 内存高效的位稀疏化量化
title_en: MSQ: Memory-Efficient Bit Sparsification Quantization
abstract: 随着深度神经网络(DNNs)在移动设备和边缘设备上的部署日益增加,优化模型效率变得至关重要。相比均匀量化,混合精度量化因其在效率和准确性之间取得更优平衡而广受青睐。然而,为每一层寻找最佳精度仍具挑战性。近期利用位级稀疏性的研究展现出前景,但往往引入显著的训练复杂度和高GPU内存需求。本文提出内存高效的位稀疏化量化(MSQ)方法,以解决这些限制。MSQ采用舍入钳位量化器,实现对模型权重最低有效位(LSBs)的可微计算。进一步通过正则化诱导这些LSBs的稀疏性,从而在无需显式位级参数分割的情况下实现有效的精度降低。此外,MSQ结合Hessian信息,允许同时剪枝多个LSBs以进一步提升训练效率。实验结果表明,与先前的位级量化方法相比,MSQ在可训练参数上实现最高8.00倍的减少,训练时间减少最高86%,同时保持竞争力的准确率和压缩率。这使其成为在资源受限设备上训练高效DNNs的实用解决方案。
abstract_en: As deep neural networks (DNNs) see increased deployment on mobile and edge devices, optimizing model efficiency has become crucial. Mixed-precision quantization is widely favored, as it offers a superior balance between efficiency and accuracy compared to uniform quantization. However, finding the optimal precision for each layer is challenging. Recent studies utilizing bit-level sparsity have shown promise, yet they often introduce substantial training complexity and high GPU memory requirements. In this paper, we propose Memory-Efficient Bit Sparsification Quantization (MSQ), a novel approach that addresses these limitations. MSQ applies a round-clamp quantizer to enable differentiable computation of the least significant bits (LSBs) from model weights. It further employs regularization to induce sparsity in these LSBs, enabling effective precision reduction without explicit bit-level parameter splitting. Additionally, MSQ incorporates Hessian information, allowing the simultaneous pruning of multiple LSBs to further enhance training efficiency. Experimental results show that MSQ achieves up to 8.00x reduction in trainable parameters and up to 86% reduction in training time compared to previous bit-level quantization, while maintaining competitive accuracy and compression rates. This makes it a practical solution for training efficient DNNs on resource-constrained devices.
authors: Seokho Han, Seoyeon Yoon, Jinhee Kim, Dongwei Wang, Kang Eun Jeon, Huanrui Yang, Jong Hwan Ko ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21885-21894

title: MUG:基于伪标签增强的音频-视觉Mamba网络用于音频-视觉视频解析
title_en: MUG: Pseudo Labeling Augmented Audio-Visual Mamba Network for Audio-Visual Video Parsing
abstract: 弱监督音频-视觉视频解析(AVVP)旨在预测所有模态特异性事件并定位其时间边界。尽管取得了显著进展,但由于弱监督的局限性和模型架构的缺陷,现有方法在同时提升段级预测和事件级预测方面仍存在不足。本文提出了一种基于伪标签增强的音频-视觉Mamba网络(MUG),以强调每个段的唯一性并排除来自交替模态的噪声干扰。具体而言,我们基于先前工作对部分伪标签进行标注。利用单模态伪标签,我们进行跨模态随机组合以生成新数据,这可以增强模型对各种段级事件组合的解析能力。在特征处理与交互方面,我们采用音频-视觉Mamba网络。AV-Mamba增强了对不同段的感知能力,在共享相似模态信息的同时排除额外模态噪声。我们的大量实验表明,MUG在LLP数据集上所有指标(例如视觉段级指标和音频段级指标分别提升了2.1%和1.2%)均优于现有方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/WangLY136/MUG获取。
abstract_en: The weakly-supervised audio-visual video parsing (AVVP) aims to predict all modality-specific events and locate their temporal boundaries. Despite significant progress, due to the limitations of the weakly-supervised and the deficiencies of the model architecture, existing methods are lacking in simultaneously improving both the segment-level prediction and the event-level prediction. In this work, we propose an audio-visual Mamba network with pseudo labeling aUGmentation (MUG) for emphasising the uniqueness of each segment and excluding the noise interference from the alternate modalities. Specifically, we annotate some of the pseudo-labels based on previous work. Using unimodal pseudo-labels, we perform cross-modal random combinations to generate new data, which can enhance the model's ability to parse various segment-level event combinations. For feature processing and interaction, we employ a audio-visual mamba network. The AV-Mamba enhances the ability to perceive different segments and excludes additional modal noise while sharing similar modal information. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that MUG improves state-of-the-art results on LLP dataset in all metrics ( e.g., gains of 2.1% and 1.2% in terms of visual Segment-level and audio Segment-level metrics). Our code is available at https://github.com/WangLY136/MUG.
authors: Langyu Wang, Bingke Zhu, Yingying Chen, Yiyuan Zhang, Ming Tang, Jinqiao Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20637-20646

title: MUNBa: 基于纳什谈判的机器遗忘方法
title_en: MUNBa: Machine Unlearning via Nash Bargaining
abstract: 机器遗忘(MU)旨在选择性地消除模型中的有害行为,同时保留模型的整体效用。作为多任务学习问题,MU需要在遗忘特定概念/数据与保持通用性能之间进行平衡。简单地将这些遗忘与保留目标整合在一起会导致梯度冲突和主导问题,阻碍MU算法达到最优解。为解决梯度冲突和主导问题,我们将MU重新表述为一个双人合作博弈问题,其中遗忘玩家和保留玩家通过梯度提案贡献,以最大化整体收益并平衡贡献。为此,受纳什谈判理论启发,我们推导出闭式解以引导模型向帕累托平稳点收敛。我们的MU表述保证了均衡解,其中任何偏离最终状态的行为都会导致双方目标函数的下降,确保每个目标的最优性。我们在图像分类和图像生成任务的多样化数据集上评估了算法的有效性。使用ResNet、视觉-语言模型CLIP和文本到图像扩散模型的大量实验表明,我们的方法优于现有最先进的MU算法,在遗忘与保留之间实现了更优的平衡。实验结果还突显了遗忘精度的提升、通用性能的保留以及对对抗攻击的鲁棒性增强。
abstract_en: Machine Unlearning (MU) aims to selectively erase harmful behaviors from models while retaining the overall utility of the model. As a multi-task learning problem, MU involves balancing objectives related to forgetting specific concepts/data and preserving general performance. A naive integration of these forgetting and preserving objectives can lead to gradient conflicts and dominance, impeding MU algorithms from reaching optimal solutions.To address the gradient conflict and dominance issue, we reformulate MU as a two-player cooperative game, where the two players, namely, the forgetting player and the preservation player, contribute via their gradient proposals to maximize their overall gain and balance their contributions.To this end, inspired by the Nash bargaining theory, we derive a closed-form solution to guide the model toward the Pareto stationary point.Our formulation of MU guarantees an equilibrium solution, where any deviation from the final state would lead to a reduction in the overall objectives for both players, ensuring optimality in each objective.We evaluate our algorithm's effectiveness on a diverse set of tasks across image classification and image generation.Extensive experiments with ResNet, vision-language model CLIP, and text-to-image diffusion models demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art MU algorithms, achieving a better trade-off between forgetting and preserving.Our results also highlight improvements in forgetting precision, preservation of generalization, and robustness against adversarial attacks.
authors: Jing Wu, Mehrtash Harandi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4754-4765

title: MUSE-VL:通过语义离散编码建模统一视觉语言模型
title_en: MUSE-VL: Modeling Unified VLM through Semantic Discrete Encoding
abstract: 我们提出MUSE-VL,一种通过语义离散编码实现的统一视觉-语言模型,用于多模态理解和生成。近期,研究社区开始探索统一模型用于视觉生成与理解。然而,现有视觉分词器(如VQGAN)仅考虑低层次信息,导致难以与语言分词器对齐,这使得训练复杂度高且需要大量训练数据才能达到最优性能。此外,其性能仍远逊于专用理解模型。本文提出语义离散编码(SDE),通过向视觉分词器添加语义约束,有效对齐视觉分词器与语言分词器的信息。这大幅减少了训练数据量并提升了统一模型的性能。在相同LLM规模下,我们的方法相比先前SOTA模型Emu3理解性能提升4.8%,超越专用理解模型LLaVA-NeXT 34B 3.7%。在视觉生成方面,我们的模型在MJHQ-30k数据集上取得7.73的FID得分,超越现有统一模型。
abstract_en: We introduce MUSE-VL, a Unified Vision-Language Model through Semantic discrete Encoding for multimodal understanding and generation. Recently, the research community has begun exploring unified models for visual generation and understanding. However, existing vision tokenizers (e.g., VQGAN) only consider low-level information, which makes it difficult to align with language tokens. This results in high training complexity and necessitates a large amount of training data to achieve optimal performance.Additionally, their performance is still far from dedicated understanding models. This paper proposes Semantic Discrete Encoding (SDE), which effectively aligns the information of visual tokens and language tokens by adding semantic constraints to the visual tokenizer. This greatly reduces the amount of training data and improves the performance of the unified model. With the same LLM size, our method improved the understanding performance by 4.8% compared to the previous SOTA Emu3 and surpassed the dedicated understanding model LLaVA-NeXT 34B by 3.7%. For visual generation, our model achieves a FID score of 7.73 on MJHQ-30k, surpassing the existing unified models.
authors: Rongchang Xie, Chen Du, Ping Song, Chang Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24135-24146

title: MUSE: 基于显式布局语义扩展的多主体统一合成
title_en: MUSE: Multi-Subject Unified Synthesis via Explicit Layout Semantic Expansion
abstract: 现有文本到图像扩散模型在基于文本提示生成高质量图像方面展现出显著能力。然而,实现具有精确空间控制的多主体组合合成仍是一个重大挑战。本文针对布局可控的多主体合成(LMS)任务,要求在统一图像中对参考主体进行忠实重建并准确放置在指定区域。尽管近期进展已分别改进布局控制和主体合成,现有方法难以同时满足该复合任务中空间精度与身份保持的双重需求。为弥合这一差距,我们提出MUSE,一个通过显式语义空间扩展将布局规范与文本引导无缝集成的统一合成框架。所提出的串联交叉注意力(CCA)机制实现了空间约束与文本描述之间的双向模态对齐,且无相互干扰。此外,我们设计了渐进式两阶段训练策略,将LMS任务分解为可学习的子目标以实现有效优化。大量实验表明,与现有方案相比,MUSE在零样本端到端生成中实现了更优的空间精度和身份一致性,推动了可控图像合成的前沿发展。我们的代码和模型可在https://github.com/pf0607/MUSE获取。
abstract_en: Existing text-to-image diffusion models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in generating high-quality images guided by textual prompts. However, achieving multi-subject compositional synthesis with precise spatial control remains a significant challenge. In this work, we address the task of layout-controllable multi-subject synthesis (LMS), which requires both faithful reconstruction of reference subjects and their accurate placement in specified regions within a unified image. While recent advancements have separately improved layout control and subject synthesis, existing approaches struggle to simultaneously satisfy the dual requirements of spatial precision and identity preservation in this composite task. To bridge this gap, we propose MUSE, a unified synthesis framework that employs concatenated cross-attention (CCA) to seamlessly integrate layout specifications with textual guidance through explicit semantic space expansion. The proposed CCA mechanism enables bidirectional modality alignment between spatial constraints and textual descriptions without interference. Furthermore, we design a progressive two-stage training strategy that decomposes the LMS task into learnable sub-objectives for effective optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MUSE achieves zero-shot end-to-end generation with superior spatial accuracy and identity consistency compared to existing solutions, advancing the frontier of controllable image synthesis. Our code and model are available at https://github.com/pf0607/MUSE.
authors: Fei Peng, Junqiang Wu, Yan Li, Tingting Gao, Di Zhang, Huiyuan Fu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15885-15895

title: MV-Adapter:简化多视角一致图像生成
title_en: MV-Adapter: Multi-View Consistent Image Generation Made Easy
abstract: 现有多视角图像生成方法常对预训练文本到图像(T2I)模型进行侵入性修改并要求全量微调,导致计算成本高且因高质量3D数据稀缺而出现图像质量下降。本文提出MV-Adapter,一种高效且多功能的适配器,可在不改变原始网络结构或特征空间的前提下增强T2I模型及其衍生模型。为在适配器中高效建模3D几何知识,我们引入创新设计,包括重复的自注意力层和并行注意力架构,使适配器能够继承预训练模型的强大先验知识以建模新颖的3D知识。此外,我们提出统一的条件编码器,无缝整合相机参数与几何信息,支持基于文本和图像的3D生成与纹理处理。MV-Adapter在Stable Diffusion XL(SDXL)上实现768分辨率的多视角生成,展现出卓越的适应性与多功能性,还可扩展至任意视角生成,拓展应用范围。实验证明,MV-Adapter为多视角图像生成设立了新的质量标准,并因其高效性、适应性与多功能性开辟了新的可能性。
abstract_en: Existing multi-view image generation methods often make invasive modifications to pre-trained text-to-image (T2I) models and require full fine-tuning, leading to high computational costs and degradation in image quality due to scarce high-quality 3D data. This paper introduces MV-Adapter, an efficient and versatile adapter that enhances T2I models and their derivatives without altering the original network structure or feature space. To efficiently model the 3D geometric knowledge within the adapter, we introduce innovative designs that include duplicated self-attention layers and parallel attention architecture, enabling the adapter to inherit the powerful priors of the pre-trained models to model the novel 3D knowledge. Moreover, we present a unified condition encoder that seamlessly integrates camera parameters and geometric information, facilitating applications such as text- and image-based 3D generation and texturing. MV-Adapter achieves multi-view generation at 768 resolution on Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL), and demonstrates adaptability and versatility. It can also be extended to arbitrary view generation, enabling broader applications. We demonstrate that MV-Adapter sets a new quality standard for multi-view image generation, and opens up new possibilities due to its efficiency, adaptability and versatility.
authors: Zehuan Huang, Yuan-Chen Guo, Haoran Wang, Ran Yi, Lizhuang Ma, Yan-Pei Cao, Lu Sheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16377-16387

title: MVGBench:多视角生成模型的全面基准
title_en: MVGBench: a Comprehensive Benchmark for Multi-view Generation Models
abstract: 我们提出MVGBench,这是一个针对多视角图像生成模型(MVGs)的全面基准,用于评估几何和纹理的3D一致性、图像质量以及语义(使用视觉语言模型)。近年来,MVGs已成为3D物体创建的主要驱动力。然而,现有指标将生成图像与真实目标视角进行比较,这不适合存在多种解决方案且与真实数据不同的生成任务。此外,不同的MVGs在不同视角、合成数据和特定光照条件下进行训练,对这些因素的鲁棒性以及对真实数据的泛化能力很少被彻底评估。在缺乏严格评估协议的情况下,也难以明确哪些设计选择促进了MVGs的进步。MVGBench评估三个方面:最佳设置性能、对真实数据的泛化和鲁棒性。我们引入了一种新颖的3D自一致性度量,该度量不与真实数据进行比较,而是比较不相交生成多视角的3D重建。我们系统地在4个不同整理的真实和合成数据集上比较了12种现有MVGs。通过我们的分析,我们识别出现有方法的重要局限,特别是在鲁棒性和泛化方面,并找到了最关键的设计选择。利用发现的最佳实践,我们提出了ViFiGen方法,在3D一致性上超越了所有评估的MVGs。我们的基准套件和预训练模型已发布。
abstract_en: We propose MVGBench, a comprehensive benchmark for multi-view image generation models (MVGs) that evaluates 3D consistency in geometry and texture, image quality, and semantics (using vision language models). Recently, MVGs have been the main driving force in 3D object creation.
