authors: Jie Shao, Hanxiao Zhang, Hao Yu, Jianxin Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16871-16881

title: MemoryTalker:通过音频引导风格化实现的个性化语音驱动三维面部动画
title_en: MemoryTalker: Personalized Speech-Driven 3D Facial Animation via Audio-Guided Stylization
abstract: 语音驱动的三维面部动画旨在从给定音频中合成与说话者说话风格匹配的逼真面部运动序列。然而,先前的研究通常需要说话者的类别标签或额外的三维面部网格等先验信息,这使得它们无法准确反映说话风格并限制了实际应用。为解决这些问题,我们提出MemoryTalker,通过仅使用音频输入反映说话者风格,实现真实且精确的三维面部运动合成,以最大化在应用中的实用性。我们的框架包含两个训练阶段:<1阶段>是存储和检索通用运动(即记忆化),<2阶段>是通过音频驱动的说话风格特征对运动记忆进行风格化后,执行个性化面部运动合成(即动画化)。在第二阶段,我们的模型学习针对特定音频应强调哪些面部运动类型。因此,MemoryTalker能够在无需额外先验信息的情况下生成可靠的个性化面部动画。通过定量和定性评估以及用户研究,我们展示了模型的有效性及其在个性化面部动画方面相比现有方法的性能提升。我们的源代码将开源以促进进一步研究。
abstract_en: Speech-driven 3D facial animation aims to synthesize realistic facial motion sequences from given audio, matching the speaker's speaking style. However, previous works often require priors such as class labels of a speaker or additional 3D facial meshes at inference, which makes them fail to reflect the speaking style and limits their practical use. To address these issues, we propose MemoryTalker which enables realistic and accurate 3D facial motion synthesis by reflecting speaker style only with audio input to maximize usability in applications. Our framework consists of two training stages: <1-stage> is storing and retrieving general motion (i.e., Memorizing), and <2-stage> is to perform the personalized facial motion synthesis (i.e., Animating) with the motion memory stylized by the audio-driven speaking style feature. In this second stage, our model learns about which facial motion types should be emphasized for a particular piece of audio. As a result, our MemoryTalker can generate a reliable personalized facial animation without additional prior information. With quantitative and qualitative evaluations, as well as user study, we show the effectiveness of our model and its performance enhancement for personalized facial animation over state-of-the-art methods. Our source code will be released to facilitate further research.
authors: Hyung Kyu Kim, Sangmin Lee, Hak Gu Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11241-11251

title: MergeOcc: 弥合不同激光雷达间的领域差距以实现鲁棒的占用预测
title_en: MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between Different LiDARs for Robust Occupancy Prediction
abstract: 基于激光雷达的3D占用预测算法随着大规模数据集的出现迅速发展。然而,现有多样化数据集的全部潜力仍被低估,因为它们通常被孤立使用。在单一数据集上训练的模型在部署到现实场景或涉及不同激光雷达的数据集时往往性能显著下降。为解决这一局限性,我们引入MergeOcc,一个通用的处理不同激光雷达的流程,通过并行利用多个数据集。激光雷达数据集间的差距主要体现在几何差异和语义不一致上,这对应于数据集的基本组成部分:数据和标签。为此,MergeOcc采用了一种新颖的模型架构,包含几何对齐和语义标签映射,以支持多数据集训练(MDT)。通过在自动驾驶领域两个著名数据集OpenOccupancy-nuScenes和SemanticKITTI上的大量实验验证了MergeOcc的有效性。结果表明,该方法在两种激光雷达上均展现出增强的鲁棒性和性能提升,超越了多个SOTA方法。此外,尽管使用相同的模型架构和超参数集,MergeOcc凭借从多样化数据集学习的能力显著超越了基线方法。据我们所知,本工作提出了首个有效弥合领域差距的跨数据集3D占用预测流程,实现了在异构平台上的无缝部署。
abstract_en: LiDAR-based 3D occupancy prediction algorithms evolved rapidly with the advent of large-scale datasets. However, the full potential of the existing diverse datasets remains underutilized, as they are typically employed in isolation. Models trained on a single dataset often suffer considerable performance degradation when deployed to real-world scenarios or datasets involving disparate LiDARs.To address this limitation, we introduce MergeOcc, a generalized pipeline designed to handle different LiDARs by leveraging multiple datasets concurrently.The gaps among LiDAR datasets primarily manifest in geometric disparities and semantic inconsistencies, which correspond to the fundamental components of datasets: data and labels. In response, MergeOcc incorporates a novel model architecture that features a geometric realignment and a semantic label mapping to facilitate multiple datasets training (MDT). The effectiveness of MergeOcc is validated through extensive experiments on two prominent datasets for autonomous vehicles: OpenOccupancy-nuScenes and SemanticKITTI.The results demonstrate its enhanced robustness and performance improvements across both types of LiDARs, outperforming several SOTA methods. Additionally, despite using an identical model architecture and hyper-parameter set, MergeOcc can significantly surpass the baselines thanks to its ability to learn from diverse datasets. To the best of our knowledge, this work presents the first cross-dataset 3D occupancy prediction pipeline that effectively bridges the domain gap for seamless deployment across heterogeneous platforms.
authors: Zikun Xu, Shaobing Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26539-26548

title: MeshAnything V2: 基于邻近网格标记化的艺术家创建网格生成
title_en: MeshAnything V2: Artist-Created Mesh Generation with Adjacent Mesh Tokenization
abstract: 网格是工业界事实上的三维表示形式,但其生产过程耗时耗力。近期研究聚焦于自回归生成网格的方法。该方法将网格转化为由顶点组成的序列,逐个顶点生成,类似于语言模型生成文本的方式。这些方法已取得一定成功,但仍难以生成复杂网格。这一局限性的主要原因是其低效的标记化方法。为解决此问题,我们提出MeshAnything V2,这是一种先进的网格生成模型,能够精确生成与指定形状一致的艺术家创建网格。MeshAnything V2的核心创新在于我们提出的邻近网格标记化(AMT)方法。与传统方法使用三个顶点表示每个面不同,AMT在可行时采用单个顶点,平均将标记序列长度减少约一半。这不仅优化了标记化过程,还生成了更紧凑、结构更清晰的序列,提升了网格生成效率。借助这些改进,MeshAnything V2的面数上限较前代模型有效翻倍,在保持计算成本不变的前提下实现了更优性能。我们在多种网格标记化方法上的广泛实验表明,AMT在效率与性能的优化中起着关键作用。
abstract_en: Meshes are the de facto 3D representation in the industry but are labor-intensive to produce. Recently, a line of research has focused on autoregressively generating meshes. This approach processes meshes into a sequence composed of vertices and then generates them vertex by vertex, similar to how a language model generates text. These methods have achieved some success but still struggle to generate complex meshes. One primary reason for this limitation is their inefficient tokenization methods. To address this issue, we introduce MeshAnything V2, an advanced mesh generation model designed to create Artist-Created Meshes that align precisely with specified shapes. A key innovation behind MeshAnything V2 is our novel Adjacent Mesh Tokenization (AMT) method. Unlike traditional approaches that represent each face using three vertices, AMT optimizes this by employing a single vertex wherever feasible, effectively reducing the token sequence length by about half on average. This not only streamlines the tokenization process but also results in more compact and well-structured sequences, enhancing the efficiency of mesh generation. With these improvements, MeshAnything V2 effectively doubles the face limit compared to previous models, delivering superior performance without increasing computational costs. Our extensive experiments across various mesh tokenization methods demonstrate that AMT is pivotal in achieving optimal results in both efficiency and performance.
authors: Yiwen Chen, Yikai Wang, Yihao Luo, Zhengyi Wang, Zilong Chen, Jun Zhu, Chi Zhang, Guosheng Lin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13922-13931

title: MeshLLM: 为大语言模型赋能逐步理解与生成三维网格
title_en: MeshLLM: Empowering Large Language Models to Progressively Understand and Generate 3D Mesh
abstract: 我们提出MeshLLM,一种新型框架,利用大语言模型(LLMs)理解并生成文本序列化的三维网格。我们的方法解决了现有方法中的关键局限性,包括针对LLMs token长度时数据集规模受限以及网格序列化过程中3D结构信息的丢失。我们引入了Primitive-Mesh分解策略,将三维网格划分为具有结构意义的子单元。这使得创建了一个包含150万+样本的大规模数据集,规模几乎是之前方法的50倍,更符合LLM扩展定律原则。此外,我们提出从顶点推断面连接以及局部网格组装训练策略,显著增强了LLMs对网格拓扑和空间结构的捕捉能力。实验表明,MeshLLM在网格生成质量与形状理解方面均优于最先进的LLaMA-Mesh,凸显了其在处理文本序列化三维网格方面的巨大潜力。
abstract_en: We present MeshLLM, a novel framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to understand and generate text-serialized 3D meshes. Our approach addresses key limitations in existing methods, including the limited dataset scale when catering to LLMs' token length and the loss of 3D structural information during mesh serialization. We introduce a Primitive-Mesh decomposition strategy, which divides 3D meshes into structurally meaningful subunits. This enables the creation of a large-scale dataset with 1500k+ samples, almost 50x larger than previous methods, which aligns better with the LLM scaling law principles. Furthermore, we propose inferring face connectivity from vertices and local mesh assembly training strategies, significantly enhancing the LLMs' ability to capture mesh topology and spatial structures. Experiments show that MeshLLM outperforms the state-of-the-art LLaMA-Mesh in both mesh generation quality and shape understanding, highlighting its great potential in processing text-serialized 3D meshes.
authors: Shuangkang Fang, I-Chao Shen, Yufeng Wang, Yi-Hsuan Tsai, Yi Yang, Shuchang Zhou, Wenrui Ding, Takeo Igarashi, Ming-Hsuan Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14061-14072

title: MeshMamba:基于状态空间模型的关节式三维网格生成与重建
title_en: MeshMamba: State Space Models for Articulated 3D Mesh Generation and Reconstruction
abstract: 本文提出MeshMamba,一种利用近期提出的Mamba状态空间模型(Mamba-SSMs)学习三维关节式网格模型的神经网络模型。MeshMamba在处理大量输入标记时具有高效性和可扩展性,能够生成和重建顶点数超过10,000的体表网格模型,捕捉服装和手部几何结构。有效学习MeshMamba的关键在于将网格顶点序列化为易于Mamba处理的顺序。这通过根据身体部位标注或模板网格的三维顶点位置对顶点进行排序实现,使得顺序尊重关节式形状的结构。基于MeshMamba,我们设计了1)MambaDiff3D,一种用于生成三维关节式网格的去噪扩散模型,以及2)Mamba-HMR,一种从单张图像中重建人体形状和姿态的三维人体网格恢复模型。实验结果表明,MambaDiff3D能够生成带有抓握手部等细节的密集三维人体网格,在三维人体形状生成任务中优于先前方法。此外,Mamba-HMR扩展了先前非参数人体网格恢复方法的能力,这些方法受限于仅能处理约500个顶点标记的身体姿态,现可处理包含面部和手部的全身设置,同时在(近)实时场景中实现竞争力的性能。
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce MeshMamba, a neural network model for learning 3D articulated mesh models by employing the recently proposed Mamba State Space Models (Mamba-SSMs). MeshMamba is efficient and scalable in handling a large number of input tokens, enabling the generation and reconstruction of body mesh models with more than 10,000 vertices, capturing clothing and hand geometries. The key to effectively learning MeshMamba is the serialization technique of mesh vertices into orderings that are easily processed by Mamba. This is achieved by sorting the vertices based on body part annotations or the 3D vertex locations of a template mesh, such that the ordering respects the structure of articulated shapes. Based on MeshMamba, we design 1) MambaDiff3D, a denoising diffusion model for generating 3D articulated meshes and 2) Mamba-HMR, a 3D human mesh recovery model that reconstructs a human body shape and pose from a single image. Experimental results showed that MambaDiff3D can generate dense 3D human meshes in clothes, with grasping hands, etc., and outperforms previous approaches in the 3D human shape generation task. Additionally, Mamba-HMR extends the capabilities of previous non-parametric human mesh recovery approaches, which were limited to handling body-only poses using around 500 vertex tokens, to the whole-body setting with face and hands, while achieving competitive performance in (near) real-time.
authors: Yusuke Yoshiyasu, Leyuan Sun, Ryusuke Sagawa ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6563-6574

title: MeshPad: 基于草图的交互式艺术家风格网格生成与编辑
title_en: MeshPad: Interactive Sketch-Conditioned Artist-Reminiscent Mesh Generation and Editing
abstract: 我们提出MeshPad,一种从草图输入生成三维网格的生成方法。基于近期在艺术家风格三角网格生成领域的进展,我们的方法解决了交互式网格创建的需求。为此,我们专注于通过将编辑分解为"删除"网格区域,随后进行"添加"新网格几何体,从而实现一致的编辑操作。这两种操作均通过用户对草图图像的简单编辑触发,促进了迭代内容创作流程,并使复杂三维网格的构建成为可能。我们的方法基于三角序列的网格表示,利用大型Transformer模型进行网格三角形的添加和删除。为实现交互式编辑,我们在加法网格生成器上引入了顶点对齐的推测预测策略。该推测器预测与每个顶点对应的多个输出标记,从而显著降低推理的计算成本并加速编辑过程,使每个编辑步骤仅需数秒即可完成。全面的实验表明,MeshPad在Chamfer距离指标上实现了超过22%的网格质量提升,并在感知评估中被90%的参与者所偏好。
abstract_en: We introduce MeshPad, a generative approach that creates 3D meshes from sketch inputs. Building on recent advances in artist-reminiscent triangle mesh generation, our approach addresses the need for interactive mesh creation. To this end, we focus on enabling consistent edits by decomposing editing into 'deletion' of regions of a mesh, followed by 'addition' of new mesh geometry. Both operations are invoked by simple user edits of a sketch image, facilitating an iterative content creation process and enabling the construction of complex 3D meshes. Our approach is based on a triangle sequence-based mesh representation, exploiting a large Transformer model for mesh triangle addition and deletion. In order to perform edits interactively, we introduce a vertex-aligned speculative prediction strategy on top of our additive mesh generator. This speculator predicts multiple output tokens corresponding to a vertex, thus significantly reducing the computational cost of inference and accelerating the editing process, making it possible to execute each editing step in only a few seconds. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that MeshPad outperforms state-of-the-art sketch-conditioned mesh generation methods, achieving more than 22% mesh quality improvement in Chamfer distance, and being preferred by 90% of participants in perceptual evaluations.
authors: Haoxuan Li, Ziya Erkoç, Lei Li, Daniele Sirigatti, Vladislav Rosov, Angela Dai, Matthias Nießner ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16227-16237

title: Met2Net:一种针对复杂气象系统的解耦双阶段时空预测模型
title_en: Met2Net: A Decoupled Two-Stage Spatio-Temporal Forecasting Model for Complex Meteorological Systems
abstract: 由于全球气候变化导致极端天气事件频发,对准确的天气预测提出了更高要求。尽管端到端方法借助深度学习技术取得了显著进展,但在多变量集成中仍面临表示不一致性问题,且难以有效捕捉变量间的依赖关系,这在复杂天气系统中尤为关键。将不同变量视为独立模态,并采用多模态模型的双阶段训练方法可部分缓解该问题,但由于两个阶段训练任务存在不一致性,结果往往不理想。为解决这些挑战,我们提出了一种隐式双阶段训练方法,为每个变量配置独立的编码器和解码器。具体而言,在第一阶段冻结Translator模块,编码器和解码器学习共享潜在空间;在第二阶段冻结编码器和解码器,由Translator模块捕捉变量间交互关系以进行预测。此外,通过在潜在空间中引入自注意力机制实现多变量融合,进一步提升了模型性能。实验表明,我们的方法在多个指标上达到当前最优水平。具体而言,近地面气温和相对湿度预测的均方误差(MSE)分别降低了28.82%和23.39%。
abstract_en: The increasing frequency of extreme weather events due to global climate change urges accurate weather prediction. Recently, great advances are made by the end-to-end methods, thanks to deep learning techniques, but they face limitations of representation inconsistency in multivariable integration and struggle to effectively capture the dependency between variables, which is required in complex weather systems. Treating different variables as distinct modalities and applying a two-stage training approach from multimodal models can partially alleviate this issue, but due to the inconformity in training tasks between the two stages, the results are often suboptimal. To address these challenges, we propose an implicit two-stage training method, configuring separate encoders and decoders for each variable. In detailed, in the first stage, the Translator is frozen while the Encoders and Decoders learn a shared latent space, in the second stage, the Encoders and Decoders are frozen, and the Translator captures inter-variable interactions for prediction. Besides, by introducing a self-attention mechanism for multivariable fusion in the latent space, the performance achieves further improvements. Empirically, extensive experiments shows state-of-the-art performance of our method. In specific, it reduces the MSE for near-surface air temperature and relative humidity predictions by 28.82% and 23.39%, respectively.
authors: Shaohan Li, Hao Yang, Min Chen, Xiaolin Qin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5458-5468

title: 元学习动态中心距离:噪声标签学习中的困难样本挖掘
title_en: Meta-Learning Dynamic Center Distance: Hard Sample Mining for Learning with Noisy Labels
abstract: 样本选择方法是处理噪声标签学习的常用策略,其中损失值较低的样本在训练过程中被有效视为干净样本。然而,这种干净集合往往被简单样本主导,限制了模型对更具挑战性案例的有意义接触,降低了其表达能力。为克服这一局限,我们引入了一种名为动态中心距离(DCD)的新颖度量方法,该方法可量化样本难度并提供关键补充损失值的信息。与依赖预测的方法不同,DCD在特征空间中计算样本特征与动态更新中心之间的距离,该中心通过提出的元学习框架建立。基于初步半监督训练捕捉基础数据模式,我们结合DCD进一步优化分类损失,降低分类良好的样本权重,并战略性地在稀疏的困难实例集上聚焦训练。该策略防止简单样本主导分类器,实现更鲁棒的学习。在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验,包括合成和现实噪声场景以及自然和医学图像,一致验证了我们方法的有效性。
abstract_en: The sample selection approach is a widely adopted strategy for learning with noisy labels, where examples with lower losses are effectively treated as clean during training. However, this clean set often becomes dominated by easy examples, limiting the model's meaningful exposure to more challenging cases and reducing its expressive power. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a novel metric called Dynamic Center Distance (DCD), which can quantify sample difficulty and provide information that critically complements loss values. Unlike approaches that rely on predictions, DCD is computed in feature space as the distance between sample features and a dynamically updated center, established through a proposed meta-learning framework. Building on preliminary semi-supervised training that captures fundamental data patterns, we incorporate DCD to further refine the classification loss, down-weighting well-classified examples and strategically focusing training on a sparse set of hard instances. This strategy prevents easy examples from dominating the classifier, leading to more robust learning. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmark datasets, including synthetic and real-world noise settings, as well as natural and medical images, consistently demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
authors: Chenyu Mu, Yijun Qu, Jiexi Yan, Erkun Yang, Cheng Deng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 415-425

title: 扩散模型上的元反学习:防止重新学习已反学习的概念
title_en: Meta-Unlearning on Diffusion Models: Preventing Relearning Unlearned Concepts
abstract: 随着扩散模型(DMs)的快速发展,人们正在付出巨大努力从预训练的DMs中去除有害或受版权保护的概念,以防止潜在的模型滥用。然而,观察到即使DMs在发布前被正确反学习,恶意微调仍可能破坏这一过程,导致DMs重新学习已反学习的概念。这在一定程度上是因为DMs中保留的某些良性概念(例如“皮肤”)与已反学习的概念(例如“露骨”)相关,从而通过微调重新学习这些概念。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了扩散模型的元反学习方法。直观而言,一个元反学习的DM在正常使用时应表现得如同一个已反学习的DM;此外,如果元反学习的DM在已反学习的概念上经历恶意微调,其内部保留的相关良性概念将被触发自我销毁,从而阻碍已反学习概念的重新学习。我们的元反学习框架与大多数现有反学习方法兼容,只需添加一个易于实现的元目标即可。我们通过在Stable Diffusion模型(SD-v1-4和SDXL)上进行元反学习概念的实证实验验证了我们的方法,并通过广泛的消融实验加以支持。
abstract_en: With the rapid progress of diffusion models (DMs), significant efforts are being made to unlearn harmful or copyrighted concepts from pretrained DMs to prevent potential model misuse. However, it is observed that even when DMs are properly unlearned before release, malicious finetuning can compromise this process, causing DMs to relearn the unlearned concepts. This occurs partly because certain benign concepts (e.g., "skin") retained in DMs are related to the unlearned ones (e.g., "nudity"), facilitating their relearning via finetuning. To address this, we propose meta-unlearning on DMs. Intuitively, a meta-unlearned DM should behave like an unlearned DM when used as is; moreover, if the meta-unlearned DM undergoes malicious finetuning on unlearned concepts, the related benign concepts retained within it will be triggered to self-destruct, hindering the relearning of unlearned concepts. Our meta-unlearning framework is compatible with most existing unlearning methods, requiring only the addition of an easy-to-implement meta objective. We validate our approach through empirical experiments on meta-unlearning concepts from Stable Diffusion models (SD-v1-4 and SDXL), supported by extensive ablation studies.
authors: Hongcheng Gao, Tianyu Pang, Chao Du, Taihang Hu, Zhijie Deng, Min Lin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2131-2141

title: MetaMorph:通过指令调优实现的多模态理解与生成
title_en: MetaMorph: Multimodal Understanding and Generation via Instruction Tuning
abstract: 本文提出了一种名为视觉预测指令调优(Visual-Predictive Instruction Tuning, VPiT)的方法——这是对视觉指令调优的简单而有效的扩展,能够使预训练的大型语言模型(LLM)快速转变为统一的自回归模型,该模型能够同时生成文本和视觉标记。VPiT 教授 LLM 从按照指令跟随格式整理的图像和文本数据输入序列中,预测离散文本标记和连续视觉标记。我们的实证研究表明 VPiT 具有以下特性:(1) 视觉生成能力作为视觉理解能力提升的自然产物出现,且可通过少量生成数据高效解锁;(2) 虽然我们发现理解与生成能力相互促进,但理解数据相较于生成数据更有效地提升两者能力。基于这些发现,我们训练了 MetaMorph 模型,并在视觉理解和生成任务中均取得了具有竞争力的性能。在视觉生成方面,MetaMorph 可利用 LLM 预训练获得的世界知识和推理能力,克服其他生成模型常见的失败模式。我们的结果表明,LLM 可能具备强大的"先验"视觉能力,可通过相对简单的指令调优过程高效适应于视觉理解和生成任务。
abstract_en: In this work, we propose Visual-Predictive Instruction Tuning (VPiT) - a simple and effective extension to visual instruction tuning that enables a pretrained LLM to quickly morph into an unified autoregressive model capable of generating both text and visual tokens. VPiT teaches an LLM to predict discrete text tokens and continuous visual tokens from any input sequence of image and text data curated in an instruction-following format. Our empirical investigation reveals several intriguing properties of VPiT: (1) visual generation ability emerges as a natural byproduct of improved visual understanding, and can be unlocked efficiently with a small amount of generation data; (2) while we find understanding and generation to be mutually beneficial, understanding data contributes to both capabilities more effectively than generation data. Building upon these findings, we train our MetaMorph model and achieve competitive performance on both visual understanding and generation. In visual generation, MetaMorph can leverage the world knowledge and reasoning abilities gained from LLM pretraining, and overcome common failure modes exhibited by other generation models. Our results suggest that LLMs may have strong "prior" vision capabilities that can be efficiently adapted to both visual understanding and generation with a relatively simple instruction tuning process.
authors: Shengbang Tong, David Fan, Jiachen Li, Yunyang Xiong, Xinlei Chen, Koustuv Sinha, Michael Rabbat, Yann LeCun, Saining Xie, Zhuang Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17001-17012

title: MetaScope:面向超微型金属透镜内窥镜的光学驱动神经网络
title_en: MetaScope: Optics-Driven Neural Network for Ultra-Micro Metalens Endoscopy
abstract: 微型化内窥镜技术已推动了人体内精确视觉感知的发展。现有研究多局限于采用凸透镜的传统相机,其中毫米级厚度的物理限制对微尺度临床应用造成了严重阻碍。近年来,随着超构光学的出现,基于金属透镜(微米级)的超微型成像技术受到广泛关注,成为一种有前景的解决方案。然而,由于金属透镜的物理特性差异,数据采集与算法研究之间存在显著差距。针对这一问题,我们旨在填补这一未被探索的空白,推动新型金属透镜内窥镜技术的发展。首先,我们构建金属透镜内窥镜数据集并开展初步光学仿真,识别出两个符合强光学先验的物理光学问题。其次,我们提出MetaScope,一种面向金属透镜内窥镜的新型光学驱动神经网络,其设计基于物理光学原理。MetaScope包含两项创新设计:光学引导强度调整(OIA),通过学习光学嵌入来校正强度衰减;光学引导色差校正(OCC),通过学习由所学点扩散函数(PSF)分布引导的空间形变来缓解色差。为进一步增强联合学习,我们还部署了梯度引导的知识蒸馏方法,以自适应地迁移基础模型的知识。大量实验表明,MetaScope不仅在金属透镜分割与复原任务中优于现有最先进方法,还在真实生物医学场景中展现出显著的泛化能力。
abstract_en: Miniaturized endoscopy has advanced accurate visual perception within the human body. Prevailing research remains limited to conventional cameras employing convex lenses, where the physical constraints with millimetre-scale thickness impose serious impediments on the micro-level clinical. Recently, with the emergence of meta-optics, ultra-micro imaging based on metalenses (micron-scale) has garnered great attention, serving as a promising solution. However, due to the physical difference of metalens, there is a large gap in data acquisition and algorithm research. In light of this, we aim to bridge this unexplored gap, advancing the novel metalens endoscopy. First, we establish datasets for metalens endoscopy and conduct preliminary optical simulation, identifying two derived optical issues that physically adhere to strong optical priors. Second, we propose MetaScope, a novel optics-driven neural network tailored for metalens endoscopy driven by physical optics. MetaScope comprises two novel designs: Optics-informed Intensity Adjustment (OIA), rectifying intensity decay by learning optical embeddings, and Optics-informed Chromatic Correction (OCC), mitigating chromatic aberration by learning spatial deformations informed by learned Point Spread Function (PSF) distributions. To enhance joint learning, we further deploy a gradient-guided distillation to transfer knowledge from the foundational model adaptively. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MetaScope not only outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both metalens segmentation and restoration but also achieves impressive generalized ability in real biomedical scenes.
authors: Wuyang Li, Wentao Pan, Xiaoyuan Liu, Zhendong Luo, Chenxin Li, Hengyu Liu, Din Ping Tsai, Mu Ku Chen, Yixuan Yuan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25938-25950

title: 度量卷积:自适应图像卷积的统一理论
title_en: Metric Convolutions: A Unifying Theory to Adaptive Image Convolutions
abstract: 标准卷积在图像处理和深度学习中被广泛使用,但其固定核限制了适应性。已提出多种参考核网格的变形策略。然而,这些方法缺乏统一的理论框架。通过回归到图像的度量视角,即将图像视为配备局部和测地距离概念的二维流形(对称的Riemannian或非对称的Finsler),我们提出一个统一原则:核的位置是隐式度量单位球的样本。基于这一新视角,我们还提出度量卷积,这是一种新颖的方法,从显式的信号依赖度量中采样子单位球,提供具有几何正则化的可解释算子。该框架与基于梯度的优化兼容,可直接替代应用于输入图像或神经网络深层特征的现有卷积。度量卷积通常需要更少的参数并提供更好的泛化能力。我们的方法在标准去噪和分类任务中表现出竞争力。
abstract_en: Standard convolutions are prevalent in image processing and deep learning, but their fixed kernels limits adaptability. Several deformation strategies of the reference kernel grid have been proposed. Yet, they lack a unified theoretical framework. By returning to a metric perspective for images, now seen as two-dimensional manifolds equipped with notions of local and geodesic distances, either symmetric (Riemannian) or not (Finsler), we provide a unifying principle: the kernel positions are samples of unit balls of implicit metrics. With this new perspective, we also propose metric convolutions, a novel approach that samples unit balls from explicit signal-dependent metrics, providing interpretable operators with geometric regularisation. This framework, compatible with gradient-based optimisation, can directly replace existing convolutions applied to either input images or deep features of neural networks. Metric convolutions typically require fewer parameters and provide better generalisation. Our approach shows competitive performance in standard denoising and classification tasks.
authors: Thomas Dagès, Michael Lindenbaum, Alfred M. Bruckstein ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13974-13984

title: MiDSummer:用于可控零样本沉浸式高斯泼溅场景生成的多引导扩散
title_en: MiDSummer: Multi-Guidance Diffusion for Controllable Zero-Shot Immersive Gaussian Splatting Scene Generation
abstract: 我们提出MiDSummer,一种两阶段框架,用于生成沉浸式高斯泼溅场景,通过多扩散引导信号实现结构化布局控制、增强物理真实感和提升视觉质量。尽管3D场景生成近年来取得了显著进展,当前方法仍需改进:(1) 实现精确可靠的布局控制,同时保持开放世界泛化能力和物理合理性;(2) 平衡高层语义推理与底层可直接控制的几何约束;(3) 有效利用布局知识进行视觉优化。我们的工作通过结构化的两阶段规划-组装框架解决这些挑战。在规划阶段,我们引入双布局扩散引导方法,以连接语义推理与几何可控性。我们的方法通过在场景图结构和布局边界框参数上引入多级自一致性分数,独特地融合了LLMs的开放词汇推理与图扩散模型(GDM)的几何精度。这种融合实现了对场景构成的细粒度控制,同时确保物理合理性和忠实的提示解释。在组装阶段,我们提出一种布局引导的优化技术用于场景优化。我们有效将规划阶段获得的布局先验纳入基于Stable Diffusion(SD)的优化过程,联合优化相机轨迹和场景泼溅点。这种受多视角一致性约束的布局感知联合优化,生成了结构连贯且可控的视觉引人入胜的沉浸式场景。
abstract_en: We present MiDSummer, a two-stage framework for generating immersive Gaussian Splatting scenes that leverages multiple diffusion guidance signals to enable structured layout control, enhanced physical realism, and improved visual quality.While 3D scene generation has seen significant recent advances, current approaches could benefit from: (1) achieving precise, reliable layout control while preserving open-world generalization and physical plausibility, (2) balancing high-level semantic reasoning with low-level, directly controllable geometric constraints, and (3) effectively utilizing layout knowledge for visual refinement. Our work addresses these challenges through a structured two-stage planning-assembly framework. For planning, we introduce a dual layout diffusion guidance approach to bridge semantic reasoning and geometric controllability. Our approach uniquely integrates LLMs' open-vocabulary reasoning with Graph Diffusion Models' (GDM) geometric precision by incorporating multi-level self-consistency scores over scene graph structures and layout bounding box parameters. This fusion enables fine-grained control over scene composition while ensuring physical plausibility and faithful prompt interpretation. For assembly, we propose a layout-guided optimization technique for scene refinement. We effectively incorporate layout priors obtained during the planning stage into a Stable Diffusion (SD)-based refinement process that jointly optimizes camera trajectories and scene splats. This layout-aware joint optimization, constrained by multi-view consistency, produces visually compelling immersive scenes that are structurally coherent and controllable.
authors: Anjun Hu, Richard Tomsett, Valentin Gourmet, Massimo Camplani, Jas Kandola, Hanting Xie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26793-26805

title: MikuDance: 基于混合运动动力学的字符艺术动画
title_en: MikuDance: Animating Character Art with Mixed Motion Dynamics
abstract: 我们提出MikuDance,一种基于扩散的流程,通过融合混合运动动力学来实现风格化字符艺术的动画。MikuDance包含两项关键技术:混合运动建模与混合控制扩散,以解决字符艺术动画中的高动态运动和参考引导不匹配问题。具体而言,提出了一种场景运动跟踪策略,以像素级空间显式建模动态摄像机,实现统一的字符-场景运动建模。在此基础上,混合控制扩散隐式对齐多样字符的尺度与身体形态与运动引导,实现局部字符运动的灵活控制。随后,引入运动自适应归一化模块,有效注入全局场景运动,为全面的字符艺术动画奠定基础。通过大量实验,我们验证了MikuDance在各类字符艺术与运动引导下的有效性与通用性,持续生成具有显著运动动力学的高质量动画。
abstract_en: We propose MikuDance, a diffusion-based pipeline incorporating mixed motion dynamics to animate stylized character art. MikuDance consists of two key techniques: Mixed Motion Modeling and Mixed-Control Diffusion, to address the challenges of high-dynamic motion and reference-guidance misalignment in character art animation. Specifically, a Scene Motion Tracking strategy is presented to explicitly model the dynamic camera in pixel-wise space, enabling unified character-scene motion modeling. Building on this, the Mixed-Control Diffusion implicitly aligns the scale and body shape of diverse characters with motion guidance, allowing flexible control of local character motion. Subsequently, a Motion-Adaptive Normalization module is incorporated to effectively inject global scene motion, paving the way for comprehensive character art animation. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of MikuDance across various character art and motion guidance, consistently producing high-quality animations with remarkable motion dynamics.
authors: Jiaxu Zhang, Xianfang Zeng, Xin Chen, Wei Zuo, Gang Yu, Zhigang Tu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19689-19699

title: MinCD-PnP:基于近似盲PnP的2D-3D对应学习
title_en: MinCD-PnP: Learning 2D-3D Correspondences with Approximate Blind PnP
abstract: 图像到点云(I2P)配准是计算机视觉中的基础问题,旨在建立图像与点云之间的2D-3D对应关系。近年来,可微视角-n点(PnP)被广泛用于监督I2P配准网络,通过在2D-3D对应关系上施加投影约束。然而,可微PnP对预测对应关系中的噪声和异常值高度敏感,这阻碍了对应关系学习的有效性。受盲PnP对对应关系中噪声和异常值鲁棒性的启发,我们提出了一种基于近似盲PnP的对应关系学习方法。为降低盲PnP的高计算成本,我们将其重新表述为更易处理的问题:最小化学习得到的2D与3D关键点之间的Chamfer距离,称为MinCD-PnP。为有效求解MinCD-PnP,我们引入了一个轻量级多任务学习模块MinCD-Net,可轻松集成到现有的I2P配准架构中。在7-Scenes、RGBD-V2、ScanNet、自采集和KITTI数据集上的广泛实验表明,MinCD-Net优于现有最先进方法,在跨场景和跨数据集设置中均实现了更高的内点比例和配准召回率。源代码:https://github.com/anpei96/mincd-pnp-demo
abstract_en: Image-to-point-cloud (I2P) registration is a fundamental problem in computer vision, focusing on establishing 2D-3D correspondences between an image and a point cloud. Recently, the differentiable perspective-n-point (PnP) has been widely used to supervise I2P registration networks by enforcing projective constraints on 2D-3D correspondences. However, differentiable PnP is highly sensitive to noise and outliers in the predicted correspondences, which hinders the effectiveness of correspondence learning. Inspired by the robustness of blind PnP to noise and outliers in correspondences, we propose an approximate blind PnP-based correspondence learning approach. To mitigate the high computational cost of blind PnP, we reformulate it as a more tractable problem: minimizing the Chamfer distance between learned 2D and 3D keypoints, referred to as MinCD-PnP. To effectively solve MinCD-PnP, we introduce a lightweight multi-task learning module, MinCD-Net, which can be easily integrated into the existing I2P registration architectures. Extensive experiments on 7-Scenes, RGBD-V2, ScanNet, self-collected, and KITTI datasets demonstrate that MinCD-Net outperforms state-of-the-art methods and achieves higher inlier ratio and registration recall in both cross-scene and cross-dataset settings. The source code: https://github.com/anpei96/mincd-pnp-demo.
authors: Pei An, Jiaqi Yang, Muyao Peng, You Yang, Qiong Liu, Xiaolin Wu, Liangliang Nan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26519-26528

title: 警惕Scaffold的代价!良性客户端甚至可能成为后门攻击的共犯
title_en: Mind the Cost of Scaffold! Benign Clients May Even Become Accomplices of Backdoor Attack
abstract: 通过使用控制变量校准每个客户端的局部梯度,Scaffold被广泛认为是缓解联邦学习中数据异质性影响的有力解决方案。尽管Scaffold实现了显著的性能提升,我们证明这种优越性是以增加安全漏洞为代价的。具体而言,本文提出了BadSFL,这是首个针对Scaffold的后门攻击方法,能够将良性客户端转化为共犯以放大攻击效果。BadSFL的核心思想是独特地篡改控制变量,微妙地引导良性客户端的局部梯度更新方向朝向攻击者污染的方向,有效将其转化为不知情的共犯,显著增强后门的持久性。此外,BadSFL采用GAN增强的中毒策略丰富攻击者的数据集,在保持良性样本和后门样本高准确率的同时保持隐蔽性。大量实验表明,BadSFL实现了卓越的攻击持久性,其有效性可维持超过60轮全局训练——即使在停止恶意模型注入后,其持续时间是现有基线方法的三倍以上。
abstract_en: By using a control variate to calibrate the local gradient of each client, Scaffold has been widely known as a powerful solution to mitigate the impact of data heterogeneity in Federated Learning. Although Scaffold achieves significant performance improvements, we show that this superiority is at the cost of increased security vulnerabilities. Specifically, this paper presents BadSFL, the first backdoor attack targeting Scaffold, which turns benign clients into accomplices to amplify the attack effect. The core idea of BadSFL is to uniquely tamper with the control variate to subtly steer benign clients' local gradient updates towards the attacker's poisoned direction, effectively turning them into unwitting accomplices, significantly enhancing the backdoor persistence. Additionally, BadSFL leverages a GAN-enhanced poisoning strategy to enrich the attacker's dataset, maintaining high accuracy on both benign and backdoored samples while remaining stealthy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BadSFL achieves superior attack durability, maintaining effectiveness for over 60 global rounds--lasting up to three times longer than existing baselines even after ceasing malicious model injections.
authors: Xingshuo Han, Xuanye Zhang, Xiang Lan, Haozhao Wang, Shengmin Xu, Shen Ren, Jason Zeng, Ming Wu, Michael Heinrich, Tianwei Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1580-1589

title: 弥合差距:对齐视觉基础模型与图像特征匹配
title_en: Mind the Gap: Aligning Vision Foundation Models to Image Feature Matching
abstract: 利用视觉基础模型已成为提升图像特征匹配性能的主流范式。然而,先前研究在引入基础模型时忽略了其与特征匹配之间的不匹配问题。这种不匹配源于基础模型侧重单图像理解与特征匹配所需的跨图像理解之间的差异。具体而言:1)常用基础模型生成的嵌入与特征匹配所需的最优嵌入存在差异;2)缺乏有效机制将单图像理解能力转化为跨图像理解。这种不匹配的显著后果是,它们在处理多实例特征匹配问题时表现不佳。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种简单但有效的框架IMD(基于预训练扩散模型的图像特征匹配),包含两部分:1)不同于主流基于对比学习的基础模型强调全局语义,我们整合基于生成的扩散模型以有效捕捉实例级细节;2)我们利用生成模型中的提示机制作为自然通道,提出新型跨图像交互提示模块以促进图像对之间的双向信息交互。为更准确衡量不匹配程度,我们提出新基准IMIM,聚焦多实例场景。我们的IMD方法在常用评估基准上建立了新最先进水平,且在IMIM上显著提升12%,表明我们的方法高效缓解了不匹配问题。
abstract_en: Leveraging the vision foundation models has emerged as a mainstream paradigm that improves the performance of image feature matching. However, previous works have ignored the misalignment when introducing the foundation models into feature matching. The misalignment arises from the discrepancy between the foundation models focusing on single-image understanding and the cross-image understanding requirement of feature matching. Specifically, 1) the embeddings derived from commonly used foundation models exhibit discrepancies with the optimal embeddings required for feature matching; 2) lacking an effective mechanism to leverage the single-image understanding ability into cross-image understanding. A significant consequence of the misalignment is they struggle when addressing multi-instance feature matching problems. To address this, we introduce a simple but effective framework, called IMD (Image feature Matching with a pre-trained Diffusion model) with two parts: 1) Unlike the dominant solutions employing contrastive-learning based foundation models that emphasize global semantics, we integrate the generative-based diffusion models to effectively capture instance-level details. 2) We leverage the prompt mechanism in generative model as a natural tunnel, propose a novel cross-image interaction prompting module to facilitate bidirectional information interaction between image pairs. To more accurately measure the misalignment, we propose a new benchmark called IMIM, which focuses on multi-instance scenarios. Our proposed IMD establishes a new state-of-the-art in commonly evaluated benchmarks, and the superior improvement 12% in IMIM indicates our method efficiently mitigates the misalignment.
authors: Yuhan Liu, Jingwen Fu, Yang Wu, Kangyi Wu, Pengna Li, Jiayi Wu, Sanping Zhou, Jingmin Xin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20313-20323

title: 注意差距:基于CLIP的持续学习中模态间隙的保持与补偿
title_en: Mind the Gap: Preserving and Compensating for the Modality Gap in CLIP-Based Continual Learning
abstract: 持续学习旨在使模型能够从持续流入的数据中按顺序学习,同时保持对先前学习任务的性能。鉴于对比语言-图像预训练模型(CLIP)在各种下游任务中展现出强大的能力,人们对其在持续学习场景中的应用兴趣日益增长。现有大多数研究忽视了CLIP中的固有模态间隙,这是其泛化能力和适应性的重要因素。本文分析了在视觉-语言预训练模型微调过程中模态间隙的变化。我们的观察结果表明,模态间隙有效地反映了预训练知识的保留程度。基于这些见解,我们提出了一种简单而有效的方法MG-CLIP,以提升CLIP在类别增量学习中的性能。我们的方法利用模态间隙保持来减轻遗忘,并通过模态间隙补偿来增强对新数据的处理能力,引入了一种基于模态间隙的持续学习新视角。在多个基准测试上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在无需额外重放数据的情况下优于现有方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/linlany/MindtheGap获取。
abstract_en: Continual learning aims to enable models to learn sequentially from continuously incoming data while retaining performance on previously learned tasks. With the Contrastive Language-Image Pre-trained model (CLIP) exhibiting strong capabilities across various downstream tasks, there has been growing interest in leveraging CLIP for continual learning in such scenarios. Most existing works overlook the inherent modality gap in CLIP, a key factor in its generalization and adaptability. In this paper, we analyze the variations in the modality gap during the fine-tuning of vision-language pre-trained models. Our observations reveal that the modality gap effectively reflects the extent to which pre-trained knowledge is preserved. Based on these insights, we propose a simple yet effective method, MG-CLIP, that improves CLIP's performance in class-incremental learning. Our approach leverages modality gap preservation to mitigate forgetting and modality gap compensation to enhance the capacity for new data, introducing a novel modality-gap-based perspective for continual learning. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches without requiring additional replay data. Our code is available at https://github.com/linlany/MindtheGap.
authors: Linlan Huang, Xusheng Cao, Haori Lu, Yifan Meng, Fei Yang, Xialei Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3777-3786

title: MissRAG:解决多模态大语言模型中的缺失模态挑战
title_en: MissRAG: Addressing the Missing Modality Challenge in Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: 近年来,多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)已成为增强大语言模型(LLMs)处理非语言模态能力的领先框架。尽管其表现出色,但MLLMs在部分或全部模态缺失条件下的鲁棒性仍鲜有研究。本文探讨了MLLMs在面对缺失模态输入时维持性能的能力范围。此外,我们提出了一种名为检索增强生成用于缺失模态(MissRAG)的新框架,该框架包含一种新颖的多模态RAG技术及定制的提示工程策略,旨在通过减轻缺失模态的影响来增强模型鲁棒性,同时避免额外指令调优带来的负担。为验证技术有效性,我们在五个多样化数据集上进行全面评估,涵盖音频-视觉问答、音频-视觉描述生成及多模态情感分析等任务。我们的源代码可在https://github.com/aimagelab/MissRAG获取。
abstract_en: Recently, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have emerged as a leading framework for enhancing the ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to interpret non-linguistic modalities. Despite their impressive capabilities, the robustness of MLLMs under conditions where one or more modalities are missing remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we investigate the extent to which MLLMs can maintain performance when faced with missing modality inputs. Moreover, we propose a novel framework to mitigate the aforementioned issue called retrieval-augmented generation for missing modalities (MissRAG). It consists of a novel multimodal RAG technique alongside a tailored prompt engineering strategy designed to enhance model robustness by mitigating the impact of absent modalities while preventing the burden of additional instruction tuning. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our techniques, we conduct comprehensive evaluations across five diverse datasets, covering tasks such as audio-visual question answering, audio-visual captioning, and multimodal sentiment analysis. Our source code is available at https://github.com/aimagelab/MissRAG.
authors: Vittorio Pipoli, Alessia Saporita, Federico Bolelli, Marcella Cornia, Lorenzo Baraldi, Costantino Grana, Rita Cucchiara, Elisa Ficarra ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3215-3224

title: MistSense: 多样化的在线程序错误与执行错误检测
title_en: MistSense: Versatile Online Detection of Procedural and Execution Mistakes
abstract: 在线错误检测在工业自动化、教育应用等多个领域至关重要,因为人类操作员可以在检测到错误后通过持续视频流推理进行纠正。尽管先前研究主要针对程序错误(通常涉及时间与顺序信息),但识别更广泛的错误类型对于实际应用至关重要。本文提出MistSense,一种在线错误识别方法,通过同时考虑程序错误(涉及错误动作序列)和执行错误(如运动不准确或设备使用不当)来实现多样性。我们的方法整合RGB和手部姿态特征,以捕捉细粒度的上下文线索从而检测错误。通过联合建模人类动作的空间和顺序特性,我们的框架能够在动态环境中实现稳健且自适应的错误检测。一旦检测到错误,我们利用大型语言模型(LLM)提供错误解释,使用户更深入地理解为何某动作被判定为错误。在常见错误检测基准上的评估验证了我们方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Online mistake detection is crucial across various domains, ranging from industrial automation to educational applications, as mistakes can be corrected by the human operator after their detection due to the continuous inference on a video stream. While prior research mainly addresses procedural errors that often relate to temporal and ordering information, identifying a broader range of error types is essential for real-world implementation. In this work, we present MistSense, an approach for online mistake identification that includes this versatility by considering both procedural errors, which involve incorrect action sequences, and execution errors, such as motor inaccuracies or improper equipment use. Our method integrates RGB and hand pose features to capture fine-grained contextual cues in order to detect a mistake. By jointly modeling spatial and sequential aspects of human actions, our framework enables robust and adaptive error detection in dynamic environments. Once a mistake has been detected, we leverage a large language model (LLM) which provides an error explanation that gives the user further insights into why an action has been identified as a mistake. The evaluation on common mistake detection benchmarks shows the effectiveness of our approach.
authors: Constantin Patsch, Yuankai Wu, Marsil Zakour, Driton Salihu, Eckehard Steinbach ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14528-14537

title: 通过标签信息消除缓解快速对抗训练中的灾难性过拟合
title_en: Mitigating Catastrophic Overfitting in Fast Adversarial Training via Label Information Elimination
abstract: 快速对抗训练(FAT)采用单步快速梯度符号法(FGSM)生成对抗样本,降低了传统对抗训练的计算成本。然而,FAT存在灾难性过拟合(CO)问题,模型在训练过程中对多步攻击的鲁棒准确率会骤降至零。近期研究表明,CO发生的原因是单步对抗扰动包含模型用于预测的标签信息,导致过拟合并削弱对复杂攻击的鲁棒性。本文发现,CO发生后,某些样本的标签信息会跨样本传递,显著增加修改后的图像被分类为预期标签的可能性。这一发现为不同对抗初始化策略的有效性提供了新视角。为解决该问题,我们提出了一种创新的FAT策略,利用特殊样本捕捉可迁移的标签信息,并在训练过程中主动移除潜在标签信息,辅以非均匀标签平滑技术进一步消除标签信息。在三个数据集上的实验结果表明,与其它FAT方法相比,我们的方法在多种攻击下的鲁棒性具有竞争力,消融实验验证了方法的有效性。代码已开源至https://github.com/fzjcdt/LIET。
abstract_en: Fast Adversarial Training (FAT) employs the single-step Fast Gradient Sign Method (FGSM) to generate adversarial examples, reducing the computational costs of traditional adversarial training. However, FAT suffers from Catastrophic Overfitting (CO), where models' robust accuracy against multi-step attacks plummets to zero during training. Recent studies indicate that CO occurs because single-step adversarial perturbations contain label information that models exploit for prediction, leading to overfitting and diminished robustness against more complex attacks. In this paper, we discover that after CO occurs, the label information of certain samples can transfer across different samples, significantly increasing the likelihood of modified images being classified as the intended label. This discovery offers a new perspective on why various adversarial initialization strategies are effective. To address this issue, we introduce an innovative FAT strategy that leverages special samples to capture transferable label information and proactively removes potential label information during training, complemented by a non-uniform label smoothing technique to further eliminate label information. Experimental results across three datasets demonstrate that our method maintains competitive robustness against several attacks compared to other FAT approaches, with ablation studies confirming the effectiveness of our methodology. The code is available at https://github.com/fzjcdt/LIET.
authors: Chao Pan, Ke Tang, Qing Li, Xin Yao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2991-3000

title: 通过FastAdapter减轻点云分割中快速下采样导致的几何退化
title_en: Mitigating Geometric Degradation in Fast DownSampling via FastAdapter for Point Cloud Segmentation
abstract: 最远点采样(FPS)因其在下采样过程中能有效保持结构完整性而被广泛应用于现有点基模型中。然而,其计算开销较大,严重制约了模型的推理效率。随机采样或网格采样被视为更快的下采样方法;然而,这些快速下采样方法由于规则过于简单且固定,可能导致下采样过程中几何信息的丢失,从而负面影响模型性能。为解决这一问题,我们提出FastAdapter,通过少量锚点聚合局部上下文信息,并促进空间与层维度的交互,最终将该信息反馈至下采样点云中,以缓解快速下采样方法导致的信息退化。除用于增强已采用快速下采样的方法的模型性能外,我们还旨在探索更具挑战性但更具价值的应用场景。具体而言,我们聚焦于采用FPS的预训练模型,嵌入FastAdapter并替换FPS为随机采样进行轻量化微调。该方法旨在显著提升推理速度,同时保持性能基本不变。在ScanNet、S3DIS和SemanticKITTI上的实验结果表明,我们的方法有效缓解了快速下采样导致的几何信息退化问题。
abstract_en: Farthest Point Sampling (FPS) is widely used in existing point-based models because it effectively preserves structural integrity during downsampling. However, it incurs significant computational overhead, severely impacting the model's inference efficiency. Random sampling or grid sampling is considered faster downsampling methods; however, these fast downsampling methods may lead to the loss of geometric information during the downsampling process due to their overly simplistic and fixed rules, which can negatively affect model performance. To address this issue, we propose FastAdapter, which aggregates local contextual information through a small number of anchor points and facilitates interactions across spatial and layer dimensions, ultimately feeding this information back into the downsampled point cloud to mitigate the information degradation caused by fast downsampling methods. In addition to using FastAdapter to enhance model performance in methods that already employ fast downsampling, we aim to explore a more challenging yet valuable application scenario. Specifically, we focus on pre-trained models that utilize FPS, embedding FastAdapter and replacing FPS with random sampling for lightweight fine-tuning. This approach aims to significantly improve inference speed while maintaining relatively unchanged performance. Experimental results on ScanNet, S3DIS, and SemanticKITTI demonstrate that our method effectively mitigates the geometric information degradation issues caused by fast downSampling.
authors: Shuofeng Sun, Haibin Yan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25983-25992

title: 基于句子级早期干预缓解物体幻觉
title_en: Mitigating Object Hallucinations via Sentence-Level Early Intervention
abstract: 多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)在跨模态理解领域取得革命性进展,但仍在处理幻觉问题上存在困难——生成内容与视觉输入相矛盾的虚构内容。现有幻觉缓解方法要么导致计算成本过高,要么造成训练数据与模型输出之间的分布不匹配。我们发现关键洞察:幻觉主要在文本生成的早期阶段产生,并通过后续输出传播。为此,我们提出SENTINEL(Sentence-level Early iNtervention Through IN-domain prEference Learning)框架,该框架无需依赖人工标注。具体而言,我们首先通过迭代采样模型输出、利用两个开放词汇检测器进行交叉验证以验证物体存在性,并将句子分类为幻觉/非幻觉类别,从而构建高质量的领域内偏好对。随后,我们使用语境一致的正样本和幻觉负样本迭代构建语境感知偏好数据。最后,我们采用语境感知偏好损失(C-DPO)训练模型,该损失函数在幻觉最初显现的句子级进行判别性学习。实验结果表明,SENTINEL在原始模型基础上将幻觉减少90%,并在幻觉基准测试和通用能力基准测试中均超越先前最先进方法,展现出其优越性和泛化能力。模型、数据集和代码已开源至https://github.com/pspdada/SENTINEL。
abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have revolutionized cross-modal understanding but continue to struggle with hallucinations - fabricated content contradicting visual inputs. Existing hallucination mitigation methods either incur prohibitive computational costs or introduce distribution mismatches between training data and model outputs. We identify a critical insight: hallucinations predominantly emerge at the early stages of text generation and propagate through subsequent outputs. To address this, we propose SENTINEL (Sentence-level Early iNtervention Through IN-domain prEference Learning), a framework that eliminates dependency on human annotations. Specifically, we first bootstrap high-quality in-domain preference pairs by iteratively sampling model outputs, validating object existence through cross-checking with two open-vocabulary detectors, and classifying sentences into hallucinated/non-hallucinated categories. Subsequently, we use context-coherent positive samples and hallucinated negative samples to iteratively build context-aware preference data. Finally, we train models using a context-aware preference loss (C-DPO) that emphasizes discriminative learning at the sentence level where hallucinations initially manifest. Experimental results show that SENTINEL can reduce hallucinations by 90% over the original model and outperforms the previous state-of-the-art method on both the hallucination benchmarks and general capabilities benchmarks, manifesting its superiority and generalization ability. The models, datasets, and code are available at https://github.com/pspdada/SENTINEL.
authors: Shangpin Peng, Senqiao Yang, Li Jiang, Zhuotao Tian ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 635-646

title: MixA-Q:从混合精度量化视角重新审视视觉Transformer的激活稀疏性
title_en: MixA-Q: Revisiting Activation Sparsity for Vision Transformers from a Mixed-Precision Quantization Perspective
abstract: 本文提出MixA-Q,一种混合精度激活量化框架,利用层内激活稀疏性(这一概念在激活剪枝方法中被广泛探索)以实现基于窗口的量化视觉Transformer的高效推理。对于给定的均匀位量化配置,MixA-Q将Swin块内的批量窗口计算分离,并为重要性较低的窗口激活分配较低的位宽,从而改善模型性能与效率之间的权衡。我们引入双分支Swin块,分别以高/低精度处理激活,使我们的方法能够无缝集成到大多数量化感知训练(QAT)和后训练量化(PTQ)方法中,或通过简单修改实现。在COCO数据集上的实验评估表明,MixA-Q在PTQ配置下实现无需训练的1.35倍计算加速且无精度损失。通过结合激活剪枝,MixA-Q在QAT中实现无损1.25倍加速,并在仅1% mAP下降的情况下实现1.53倍加速。值得注意的是,通过减少重要区域的量化误差,我们的稀疏性感知量化适配将量化W4A4模型(权重和激活均为4位精度)的mAP提升0.7%,量化退化减少24%。
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose MixA-Q, a mixed-precision activation quantization framework that leverages intra-layer activation sparsity (a concept widely explored in activation pruning methods) for efficient inference of quantized window-based vision transformers. For a given uniform-bit quantization configuration, MixA-Q separates the batched window computations within Swin blocks and assigns a lower bit width to the activations of less important windows, improving the trade-off between model performance and efficiency. We introduce a Two-Branch Swin Block that processes activations separately in high- and low-bit precision, enabling seamless integration of our method with most quantization-aware training (QAT) and post-training quantization (PTQ) methods, or with simple modifications. Our experimental evaluations over the COCO dataset demonstrate that MixA-Q achieves a training-free 1.35x computational speedup without accuracy loss in PTQ configuration. With QAT, MixA-Q achieves a lossless 1.25x speedup and a 1.53x speedup with only a 1% mAP drop by incorporating activation pruning. Notably, by reducing the quantization error in important regions, our sparsity-aware quantization adaptation improves the mAP of the quantized W4A4 model (with both weights and activations in 4-bit precision) by 0.7%, reducing quantization degradation by 24%.
authors: Weitian Wang, Rai Shubham, Cecilia De La Parra, Akash Kumar ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22143-22152

title: MixA:一种结合稳定轻量线性注意力的混合注意力方法,以提升边缘设备上视觉Transformer的效率
title_en: MixA: A Mixed Attention approach with Stable Lightweight Linear Attention to enhance Efficiency of Vision Transformers at the Edge
abstract: 视觉Transformer(ViTs)因其在各类计算机视觉任务中的强大性能而广受欢迎。然而,由于自注意力层的二次复杂度过度使用以及资源密集型softmax操作,将ViTs部署在边缘设备上仍是一个持续存在的挑战。为解决这一问题,线性自注意力方法作为一种高效替代方案应运而生。然而,当前线性注意力方法相比基于softmax的二次注意力在性能上存在显著下降。因此,我们提出MixA,一种新颖的混合注意力方法,在保持与基于softmax的二次注意力相当性能的同时提升ViT模型的效率。MixA采用预训练的ViT模型,分析每个注意力层的重要性,并在关键层选择性地应用基于ReLU的二次注意力以确保模型高性能。为提升效率,MixA选择较不关键的层并替换为我们的新型基于ReLU的线性注意力模块SteLLA(SteLLA:一种基于ReLU的线性注意力模块)。SteLLA利用理论驱动的归一化项,改进了先前基于ReLU的线性注意力的稳定性,从而在相比基于softmax的二次注意力实现显著加速的同时获得更好的性能。在三个基准视觉任务上的实验表明,MixA能够显著提升ViT模型的效率且保持竞争力。值得注意的是,MixA在Apple M1芯片上将DeiT-T模型的推理速度提升22%,仅损失0.1%的准确率。
abstract_en: Vision transformers (ViTs) have become widely popular due to their strong performance across various computer vision tasks. However, deploying ViTs on edge devices remains a persistent challenge due to their high computational demands primarily caused by the over use of self-attention layers with quadratic complexity together with the resource-intensive softmax operation. To resolve this challenge, linear self-attention approach has emerged as an efficient alternative. Nonetheless, current linear attention methods experience considerable performance degradation compared to the softmax-based quadratic attention. Hence, we propose MixA, a novel mixed attention approach that enhances efficiency of ViT models while maintaining comparable performance to softmax-based quadratic attention. MixA takes a pretrained ViT model and analyzes the significance of each attention layer, and selectively apply ReLU-based quadratic attention in the critical layers to ensure high model performance. To enhance efficiency, MixA selects the less critical layers and replaces them with our novel ReLU-based linear attention module called SteLLA. SteLLA utilizes theoretically motivated normalization terms that improve stability of prior ReLU-based linear attention, resulting in better performance while achieving significant speedup compared to softmax based quadratic attention. Experiments conducted on three benchmark vision tasks show that MixA can significantly improve efficiency of ViT models with competitive performance. Notably, MixA can improve inference speed of DeiT-T model by 22% on Apple M1 chip with only  0.1% accuracy loss.
authors: Sabbir Ahmed, Jingtao Li, Weiming Zhuang, Chen Chen, Lingjuan Lyu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21187-21196

title: MixANT: 基于观测依赖的记忆传播机制用于随机密集动作预判
title_en: MixANT: Observation-dependent Memory Propagation for Stochastic Dense Action Anticipation
abstract: 我们提出MixANT,一种用于人类活动随机长期密集预判的新架构。尽管近期的状态空间模型(SSMs)如Mamba通过在三个关键参数上实现输入依赖的选择性展现出前景,但控制时间记忆的关键遗忘门(A矩阵)仍保持静态。我们通过引入专家混合方法来解决这一局限性,该方法根据输入特征动态选择上下文相关的A矩阵,从而在不牺牲计算效率的前提下增强表征能力。在50Salads、Breakfast和Assembly101数据集上的大量实验表明,MixANT在所有评估设置中均优于现有最先进方法。我们的结果突显了输入依赖遗忘门机制对于在多样化现实场景中可靠预测人类行为的重要性。项目页面可访问https://talalwasim.github.io/MixANT/。
abstract_en: We present MixANT, a novel architecture for stochastic long-term dense anticipation of human activities. While recent State Space Models (SSMs) like Mamba have shown promise through input-dependent selectivity on three key parameters, the critical forget-gate (A matrix) controlling temporal memory remains static. We address this limitation by introducing a mixture of experts approach that dynamically selects contextually relevant A matrices based on input features, enhancing representational capacity without sacrificing computational efficiency. Extensive experiments on the 50Salads, Breakfast, and Assembly101 datasets demonstrate that MixANT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across all evaluation settings. Our results highlight the importance of input-dependent forget-gate mechanisms for reliable prediction of human behavior in diverse real-world scenarios. The project page is available at https://talalwasim.github.io/MixANT/.
authors: Syed Talal Wasim, Hamid Suleman, Olga Zatsarynna, Muzammal Naseer, Juergen Gall ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14613-14622

title: MixRI:融合参考图像特征的新型物体姿态估计
title_en: MixRI: Mixing Features of Reference Images for Novel Object Pose Estimation
abstract: 我们提出MixRI,一种轻量级网络,用于解决基于CAD的新型物体姿态估计问题。该网络可在测试时无需微调即可即时应用于新型物体。我们设计网络以满足实际应用场景需求,强调降低内存需求和提升推理速度。与现有工作不同,后者需要大量参考图像和大网络参数,我们通过轻量级网络直接基于查询图像与参考图像间的多视角信息进行点匹配。得益于我们的参考图像融合策略,显著减少了参考图像数量,从而降低处理这些图像所需时间及存储所需内存。此外,通过轻量级网络,我们的方法推理时间更短。尽管使用更少的参考图像,实验表明在BOP挑战的七个核心数据集上,我们的方法与需要更多参考图像和更大网络参数的方法相比,取得了相当的结果。
abstract_en: We present MixRI, a lightweight network that solves the CAD-based novel object pose estimation problem in RGB images. It can be instantly applied to a novel object at test time without finetuning. We design our network to meet the demands of real-world applications, emphasizing reduced memory requirements and fast inference time. Unlike existing works that utilize many reference images and have large network parameters, we directly match points based on the multi-view information between the query and reference images with a lightweight network. Thanks to our reference image fusion strategy, we significantly decrease the number of reference images, thus decreasing the time needed to process these images and the memory required to store them. Furthermore, with our lightweight network, our method requires less inference time. Though with fewer reference images, experiments on seven core datasets in the BOP challenge show that our method achieves comparable results with other methods that require more reference images and larger network parameters.
authors: Xinhang Liu, Jiawei Shi, Zheng Dang, Yuchao Dai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9024-9035

title: 混合信号:用于异构激光雷达V2X协作的多样化点云数据集
title_en: Mixed Signals: A Diverse Point Cloud Dataset for Heterogeneous LiDAR V2X Collaboration
abstract: 车对外一切(V2X)协同感知已成为解决单车感知系统局限性的一种有前景的解决方案。然而,现有V2X数据集在范围、多样性和质量方面存在局限。为弥补这些不足,我们提出了Mixed Signals,一个包含45.1万个点云和240.6万个边界框的全面V2X数据集,数据来源于三辆配备两种不同激光雷达配置的联网自动驾驶车辆(CAVs),以及配备双激光雷达的路侧单元。我们的数据集提供了10类点云和边界框标注,确保感知训练的可靠数据。我们对数据集质量进行了详细统计分析,并在该数据集上广泛基准测试现有V2X方法。Mixed Signals具备即开即用特性,具有时间与视角一致的精确对齐和标注。我们希望本工作能推动V2X感知这一新兴且具有影响力的领域研究。
abstract_en: Vehicle-to-everything (V2X) collaborative perception has emerged as a promising solution to address the limitations of single-vehicle perception systems. However, existing V2X datasets are limited in scope, diversity, and quality. To address these gaps, we present Mixed Signals, a comprehensive V2X dataset featuring 45.1k point clouds and 240.6k bounding boxes collected from three connected autonomous vehicles (CAVs) equipped with two different configurations of LiDAR sensors, plus a roadside unit with dual LiDARs. Our dataset provides point clouds and bounding box annotations across 10 classes, ensuring reliable data for perception training. We provide detailed statistical analysis on the quality of our dataset and extensively benchmark existing V2X methods on it. Mixed Signals is ready-to-use, with precise alignment and consistent annotations across time and viewpoints. We hope our work advances research in the emerging, impactful field of V2X perception.
authors: Katie Z Luo, Minh-Quan Dao, Zhenzhen Liu, Mark Campbell, Wei-Lun Chao, Kilian Q Weinberger, Ezio Malis, Vincent Fremont, Bharath Hariharan, Mao Shan, Stewart Worrall, Julie Stephany Berrio Perez ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28763-28773

title: 高斯散射引导的专家混合模型的重要性:一种弱监督视频异常检测的新方法
title_en: Mixture of Experts Guided by Gaussian Splatters Matters: A new Approach to Weakly-Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
abstract: 视频异常检测(VAD)是一项具有挑战性的任务,由于异常事件的多样性以及标注数据的有限性。在弱监督视频异常检测(WSVAD)范式下,训练时仅提供视频级别的标签,而预测在帧级别进行。尽管最先进的模型在简单异常(如爆炸)上表现良好,但在复杂的真实世界事件(如商店行窃)上却存在困难。这种困难源于两个关键问题:(1)当前模型无法处理异常类型的多样性,因为它们使用共享模型处理所有类别,忽略了类别特定特征;(2)弱监督信号缺乏精确的时间信息,限制了对与正常事件混合的细微异常模式的捕捉能力。为了解决这些挑战,我们提出了一种基于高斯散射引导的专家混合模型(GS-MoE),这是一种新颖的框架,采用一组专家模型,每个模型专门捕捉特定类型的异常。这些专家由时间高斯散射损失引导,使模型能够利用时间一致性并增强弱监督。高斯散射方法通过关注最可能包含异常事件的时间段,鼓励对异常进行更精确和全面的表示。这些专门专家的预测通过专家混合机制整合,以建模多样化异常模式之间的复杂关系。我们的方法在UCF-Crime数据集上实现了91.58%的AUC,同时在XD-Violence和MSAD数据集上展示了优越的结果。通过利用类别特定的专业知识和时间指导,GS-MoE为弱监督下的VAD设定了新基准。
abstract_en: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) is a challenging task due to the variability of anomalous events and the limited availability of labeled data. Under the Weakly-Supervised VAD (WSVAD) paradigm, only video-level labels are provided during training, while predictions are made at the frame level. Although state-of-the-art models perform well on simple anomalies (e.g., explosions), they struggle with complex real-world events (e.g., shoplifting). This difficulty stems from two key issues: (1) the inability of current models to address the diversity of anomaly types, as they process all categories with a shared model, overlooking category-specific features; and (2) the weak supervision signal, which lacks precise temporal information, limiting the ability to capture nuanced anomalous patterns blended with normal events. To address these challenges, we propose Gaussian Splatting-guided Mixture of Experts (GS-MoE), a novel framework that employs a set of expert models, each specialized in capturing specific anomaly types. These experts are guided by a temporal Gaussian splatting loss, enabling the model to leverage temporal consistency and enhance weak supervision. The Gaussian splatting approach encourages a more precise and comprehensive representation of anomalies by focusing on temporal segments most likely to contain abnormal events. The predictions from these specialized experts are integrated through a mixture-of-experts mechanism to model complex relationships across diverse anomaly patterns. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, with a 91.58% AUC on the UCF-Crime dataset, and demonstrates superior results on XD-Violence and MSAD datasets. By leveraging category-specific expertise and temporal guidance, GS-MoE sets a new benchmark for VAD under weak supervision.
authors: Giacomo D' Amicantonio, Snehashis Majhi, Quan Kong, Lorenzo Garattoni, Gianpiero Francesca, Francois Bremond, Egor Bondarev ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10275-10285

title: 混合评分:通过三行代码实现稳健的图像-文本数据评估
title_en: Mixture-of-Scores: Robust Image-Text Data Valuation via Three Lines of Code
abstract: 评估图像-文本对的质量对于视觉-语言预训练中的数据处理至关重要。目前大多数指标使用现成模型(如CLIP-Score)基于特征相似性对对进行评分。然而,我们发现不同的评分模型对同一数据通常会产生不一致的质量评分。这种差异影响了数据处理结果,导致数据集的差异,进而影响在这些数据集上训练的模型性能。值得注意的是,没有单一的质量评分能在所有任务中表现最佳,因为每个评分都对特定概念存在偏倚,从而对模型性能产生互补效应。这使得评分模型的选择变得复杂。在本文中,我们分析了这些差异,并提出了一种名为混合评分(MoS)的方法。该方法将多种质量评分集成到一个稳健的集成评分中,有效缓解了偏倚问题。它仅需三行代码即可实现。我们的大量实验表明,MoS在多个视觉-语言任务和基准测试中均优于现有的单一质量评分。我们旨在提供新的见解和实用工具,帮助社区应对评分模型选择的挑战。
abstract_en: Evaluating the quality of image-text pairs is essential for data processing in vision-language pre-training. Most metrics currently use off-the-shelf models, like CLIP-Score, to score pairs based on feature similarity. However, we find that different scoring models often produce inconsistent quality scores for the same data. This disparity impacts data processing results, leading to variations in datasets and, consequently, in model performance when trained on these datasets. Notably, no single quality score excels across all tasks, as each has biases toward specific concepts, resulting in complementary effects on model performance. This complicates the selection of scoring models. In this paper, we analyze these disparities and propose a method called Mixture-of-Scores (MoS). This approach integrates various quality scores into a robust ensemble score, effectively mitigating biases. It can be implemented easily in just three lines of code. Our extensive experiments show that MoS outperforms existing single quality scores across multiple vision-language tasks and benchmarks. We aim to offer new insights and practical tools to help the community navigate the challenges of scoring model selection.
authors: Sitong Wu, Haoru Tan, Yukang Chen, Shaofeng Zhang, Jingyao Li, Bei Yu, Xiaojuan Qi, Jiaya Jia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24603-24614

title: MoFRR:用于人脸修图复原的扩散模型混合方法
title_en: MoFRR: Mixture of Diffusion Models for Face Retouching Restoration
abstract: 社交媒体平台上广泛使用的人脸修图技术引发了对人脸图像真实性的担忧。尽管现有方法主要聚焦于人脸修图检测,但如何准确从修图后的图像恢复原始人脸仍是一个未解难题。本文提出了一种新颖的计算机视觉任务——人脸修图复原(FRR),旨在从修图后的图像中恢复原始人脸。与传统图像修复任务不同,FRR更关注处理多种类型和程度的复杂修图操作,重点在于恢复人脸的低频信息。为解决这一挑战,我们提出了MoFRR(用于FRR的扩散模型混合方法)。受DeepSeek专家隔离策略启发,MoFRR通过稀疏激活处理不同修图类型的专用专家,以及参与通用修图痕迹处理的共享专家。每个专用专家采用双分支结构:基于DDIM的低频分支由迭代失真评估模块(IDEM)引导,以及基于交叉注意力的高频分支(HFCAM)用于细节优化。在新构建的修图人脸数据集RetouchingFFHQ++上的大量实验验证了MoFRR在FRR任务中的有效性。
abstract_en: The widespread use of face retouching on social media platforms raises concerns about the authenticity of face images. While existing methods focus on detecting face retouching, how to accurately recover the original faces from the retouched ones has yet to be answered. This paper introduces Face Retouching Restoration (FRR), a novel computer vision task aimed at restoring original faces from their retouched counterparts. FRR differs from traditional image restoration tasks by addressing the complex retouching operations with various types and degrees, which focuses more on the restoration of the low-frequency information of the faces. To tackle this challenge, we propose MoFRR, Mixture of Diffusion Models for FRR. Inspired by DeepSeek's expert isolation strategy, the MoFRR uses sparse activation of specialized experts handling distinct retouching types and the engagement of a shared expert dealing with universal retouching traces. Each specialized expert follows a dual-branch structure with a DDIM-based low-frequency branch guided by an Iterative Distortion Evaluation Module (IDEM) and a Cross-Attention-based High-Frequency branch (HFCAM) for detail refinement. Extensive experiments on a newly constructed face retouching dataset, RetouchingFFHQ++, demonstrate the effectiveness of MoFRR for FRR.
authors: Jiaxin Liu, Qichao Ying, Zhenxing Qian, Sheng Li, Runqi Zhang, Jian Liu, Xinpeng Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12842-12851

title: MoGA:单目高斯化身重建的三维生成化身先验
title_en: MoGA: 3D Generative Avatar Prior for Monocular Gaussian Avatar Reconstruction
abstract: 我们提出MoGA,一种新颖的方法,可从单视角图像重建高保真度的三维高斯化身。主要挑战在于推断未见过的外观和几何细节,同时确保三维一致性和真实感。大多数先前方法依赖于二维扩散模型合成未见过的视角;然而,这些生成的视角稀疏且不一致,导致不真实的三维伪影和模糊外观。为了解决这些限制,我们利用生成化身模型,通过从学习到的先验分布中采样变形高斯,生成多样化的三维化身。由于三维训练数据有限,此类三维模型单独无法捕捉未见过身份的所有图像细节。因此,我们将其作为先验,通过将输入图像投影到其潜在空间并施加额外的三维外观和几何约束,确保三维一致性。我们的新方法通过将生成化身拟合到二维扩散模型合成的视角,将高斯化身创建公式化为模型逆过程。生成化身为模型拟合提供初始化,强制三维正则化,并有助于优化姿态。实验表明,我们的方法超越了最先进的技术,并在现实场景中具有良好的泛化能力。我们的高斯化身本质上是可动画化的。代码见https:// zj-dong.github.io/ MoGA/
abstract_en: We present MoGA, a novel method to reconstruct high-fidelity 3D Gaussian avatars from a single-view image. The main challenge lies in inferring unseen appearance and geometric details while ensuring 3D consistency and realism. Most previous methods rely on 2D diffusion models to synthesize unseen views; however, these generated views are sparse and inconsistent, resulting in unrealistic 3D artifacts and blurred appearance. To address these limitations, we leverage a generative avatar model, that can generate diverse 3D avatars by sampling deformed Gaussians from a learned prior distribution. Due to limited 3D training data, such a 3D model alone cannot capture all image details of unseen identities. Consequently, we integrate it as a prior, ensuring 3D consistency by projecting input images into its latent space and enforcing additional 3D appearance and geometric constraints. Our novel approach formulates Gaussian avatar creation as model inversion by fitting the generative avatar to synthetic views from 2D diffusion models. The generative avatar provides an initialization for model fitting, enforces 3D regularization, and helps in refining pose. Experiments show that our method surpasses state-of-the-art techniques and generalizes well to real-world scenarios. Our Gaussian avatars are also inherently animatable. For code, see https:// zj-dong.github.io/ MoGA/
authors: Zijian Dong, Longteng Duan, Jie Song, Michael J. Black, Andreas Geiger ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13304-13314

title: MoMa-Kitchen:面向移动操作中基于可操作性的最后一公里导航的10万+基准数据集
title_en: MoMa-Kitchen: A 100K+ Benchmark for Affordance-Grounded Last-Mile Navigation in Mobile Manipulation
abstract: 在移动操作中,导航与操作通常被视为独立的问题,导致仅仅接近目标物体与有效交互之间存在显著差距。许多导航方法主要通过接近目标的距离定义成功,往往忽视了为后续操作提供最佳定位的必要性。为解决这一问题,我们引入\ours,一个包含超过10万样本的基准数据集,为模型提供训练数据以学习实现无缝操作过渡的最优最终导航位置。我们的数据集包含基于可操作性的地板标签,这些标签从多样化的厨房环境中收集,其中不同型号的机器人移动操作器尝试在杂乱环境中抓取目标物体。通过完全自动化的流水线,我们模拟多样化的现实场景并生成最优操作位置的可操作性标签。视觉数据通过安装在机械臂上的第一视角摄像头捕获的RGB-D输入收集,确保数据采集过程中视角的一致性。我们还开发了一个轻量级基线模型\ourmodel,用于导航可操作性定位,在\ours基准上展现出有前景的性能。我们的方法使模型能够学习基于可操作性的最终定位,适应不同臂型和平台高度,从而为具身AI中导航与操作的更鲁棒、更通用的集成铺平道路。
abstract_en: In mobile manipulation, navigation and manipulation are often treated as separate problems, resulting in a significant gap between merely approaching an object and engaging with it effectively. Many navigation approaches primarily define success by proximity to the target, often overlooking the necessity for optimal positioning that facilitates subsequent manipulation. To address this, we introduce \ours, a benchmark dataset comprising over 100k samples that provide training data for models to learn optimal final navigation positions for seamless transition to manipulation. Our dataset includes affordance-grounded floor labels collected from diverse kitchen environments, in which robotic mobile manipulators of different models attempt to grasp target objects amidst clutter. Using a fully automated pipeline, we simulate diverse real-world scenarios and generate affordance labels for optimal manipulation positions. Visual data are collected from RGB-D inputs captured by a first-person view camera mounted on the robotic arm, ensuring consistency in viewpoint during data collection. We also develop a lightweight baseline model, \ourmodel, for navigation affordance grounding that demonstrates promising performance on the \ours benchmark. Our approach enables models to learn affordance-based final positioning that accommodates different arm types and platform heights, thereby paving the way for more robust and generalizable integration of navigation and manipulation in embodied AI.
authors: Pingrui Zhang, Xianqiang Gao, Yuhan Wu, Kehui Liu, Dong Wang, Zhigang Wang, Bin Zhao, Yan Ding, Xuelong Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6315-6326

title: MoMaps: 基于运动图的语义感知场景运动生成
title_en: MoMaps: Semantics-Aware Scene Motion Generation with Motion Maps
abstract: 本文旨在解决从真实世界视频中学习具有语义和功能意义的三维运动先验知识的挑战,以实现从单张输入图像预测未来三维场景运动。我们提出了一种新颖的像素对齐运动图(MoMap)表示方法,该方法可从现有生成式图像模型中生成,以促进高效且有效的运动预测。为学习具有意义的运动分布,我们从超过50,000个真实视频中构建了大规模MoMap数据库,并在这些表示上训练扩散模型。我们的运动生成不仅能够合成三维轨迹,还提出了一种新的二维视频合成流程:首先生成MoMap,然后根据该运动图进行图像变形并完成变形后的点渲染。实验结果表明,我们的方法能够生成合理且语义一致的三维场景运动。
abstract_en: This paper addresses the challenge of learning semantically and functionally meaningful 3D motion priors from real-world videos, in order to enable prediction of future 3D scene motion from a single input image. We propose a novel pixel-aligned Motion Map (MoMap) representation for 3D scene motion, which can be generated from existing generative image models to facilitate efficient and effective motion prediction. To learn meaningful distributions over motion, we create a large-scale database of MoMaps from over 50,000 real videos and train a diffusion model on these representations. Our motion generation not only synthesizes trajectories in 3D but also suggests a new pipeline for 2D video synthesis: first generate a MoMap, then warp an image accordingly and complete the warped point-based renderings. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach generates plausible and semantically consistent 3D scene motion.
authors: Jiahui Lei, Kyle Genova, George Kopanas, Noah Snavely, Leonidas Guibas ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10022-10031

title: MoSiC:基于最优传输的密集自监督学习运动轨迹
title_en: MoSiC: Optimal-Transport Motion Trajectory for Dense Self-Supervised Learning
abstract: 密集自监督学习在学习像素级和补丁级表征方面展现出巨大潜力,但将其扩展到视频领域仍面临挑战,这主要是由于运动动态的复杂性。现有方法存在局限,因为它们依赖静态增强,在物体形变、遮挡和相机运动情况下失效,导致特征学习随时间不一致。我们提出了一种运动引导的自监督学习框架,通过聚类密集点轨迹来学习时空一致的表征。借助现成的点跟踪器,我们提取长程运动轨迹,并通过基于动量编码器的最优传输机制优化特征聚类。为确保时间一致性,我们沿跟踪点传播聚类分配,即使在视角变化情况下也强制特征在不同视图间保持一致。将运动作为隐式监督信号进行整合,我们的方法学习到能够跨帧泛化的表征,在动态场景和复杂遮挡场景中提升鲁棒性。通过从强图像预训练模型初始化并利用视频数据进行训练,我们在六个图像和视频数据集及四个评估基准上将最先进方法提升了1%至6%。实现代码已开源至我们的GitHub仓库:github.com/SMSD75/MoSiC
abstract_en: Dense self-supervised learning has shown great promise for learning pixel- and patch-level representations, but extending it to videos remains challenging due to the complexity of motion dynamics. Existing approaches struggle as they rely on static augmentations that fail under object deformations, occlusions, and camera movement, leading to inconsistent feature learning over time. We propose a motion-guided self-supervised learning framework that clus- ters dense point tracks to learn spatiotemporally consistent representations. By leveraging an off-the-shelf point tracker, we extract long-range motion trajectories and optimize feature clustering through a momentum-encoder-based optimal transport mechanism. To ensure temporal coherence, we propagate cluster assignments along tracked points, enforcing feature consistency across views despite viewpoint changes. Integrating motion as an implicit supervisory signal, our method learns representations that generalize across frames, improving robustness in dynamic scenes and challenging occlusion scenarios. By initializing from strong image-pretrained models and leveraging video data for training, we improve state-of-the-art by 1% to 6% on six image and video datasets and four evaluation benchmarks. The implementation is publicly available at our GitHub repository: github.com/SMSD75/MoSiC
authors: Mohammadreza Salehi, Shashanka Venkataramanan, Ioana Simion, Efstratios Gavves, Cees G. M. Snoek, Yuki M Asano ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6541-6551

title: 移动视频扩散
title_en: Mobile Video Diffusion
abstract: 视频扩散模型在逼真度和可控性方面取得了令人印象深刻的成果,但受限于高计算需求,难以在移动设备上应用。本文介绍了首个移动优化的图像到视频扩散模型。我们从Stable Video Diffusion(SVD)的时空UNet出发,通过降低帧分辨率、引入多尺度时间表示以及提出两种新颖的剪枝方案来减少通道数和时间块数量,从而降低计算成本。此外,我们采用对抗性微调将去噪过程简化为单步操作。我们的模型MobileVD可在Xiaomi-14 Pro上以1.7秒生成14x512x256像素片段的潜在表示,且质量损失可忽略不计。我们的结果可在https://qualcomm-ai-research.github.io/mobile-video-diffusion获取。
abstract_en: Video diffusion models have achieved impressive realism and controllability but are limited by high computational demands, restricting their use on mobile devices. This paper introduces the first mobile-optimized image-to-video diffusion model. Starting from a spatio-temporal UNet from Stable Video Diffusion (SVD), we reduce the computational cost by reducing the frame resolution, incorporating multi-scale temporal representations, and introducing two novel pruning schemas to reduce the number of channels and temporal blocks. Furthermore, we employ adversarial finetuning to reduce the denoising to a single step. Our model, coined as MobileVD, can generate latents for a 14x512x256 px clip in 1.7 seconds on a Xiaomi-14 Pro, with negligible quality loss. Our results are available at https://qualcomm-ai-research.github.io/mobile-video-diffusion
authors: Haitam Ben Yahia, Denis Korzhenkov, Ioannis Lelekas, Amir Ghodrati, Amirhossein Habibian ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19450-19460

title: MobileIE: 一种极轻量级且高效的卷积神经网络用于移动设备上的实时图像增强
title_en: MobileIE: An Extremely Lightweight and Effective ConvNet for Real-Time Image Enhancement on Mobile Devices
abstract: 近年来,深度神经网络的进展显著推动了图像增强(IE)领域的发展。然而,由于高计算和内存需求,将深度学习模型部署到资源受限平台(如移动设备)仍面临挑战。为解决这些挑战并实现移动设备上的实时图像增强,我们提出了一种约4000参数的极轻量级卷积神经网络(CNN)框架。我们的方法结合了重参数化与增量权重优化策略以确保效率。此外,我们通过特征自变换模块和分层双路径注意力机制提升性能,采用局部方差加权损失进行优化。借助该高效框架,我们首次实现了高达1100帧每秒(FPS)的实时图像增强推理,同时保持了竞争力的图像质量,在多项图像增强任务中实现了速度与性能的最佳平衡。代码将开源于https://github.com/AVC2-UESTC/MobileIE.git。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in deep neural networks have driven significant progress in image enhancement (IE). However, deploying deep learning models on resource-constrained platforms, such as mobile devices, remains challenging due to high computation and memory demands. To address these challenges and facilitate real-time IE on mobile, we introduce an extremely lightweight Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) framework with around 4K parameters. Our approach integrates re-parameterization with an Incremental Weight Optimization strategy to ensure efficiency. Additionally, we enhance performance with a Feature Self-Transform module and a Hierarchical Dual-Path Attention mechanism, optimized with a Local Variance-Weighted loss. With this efficient framework, we are the first to achieve real-time IE inference at up to 1,100 frames per second (FPS) while delivering competitive image quality, achieving the best trade-off between speed and performance across multiple IE tasks. The code will be available at https://github.com/AVC2-UESTC/MobileIE.git.
authors: Hailong Yan, Ao Li, Xiangtao Zhang, Zhe Liu, Zenglin Shi, Ce Zhu, Le Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21949-21960

title: MobileViCLIP:面向移动设备的高效视频-文本模型
title_en: MobileViCLIP: An Efficient Video-Text Model for Mobile Devices
abstract: 由于轻量级神经网络在推理速度和移动设备上的部署方面具有优势,其受到了越来越多的关注。然而,现有的视频模型仍主要关注较大的ViT架构,鲜有研究尝试构建高效的架构。鉴于许多高效的对比语言-图像预训练(CLIP)模型展现出强大的零样本分类和检索能力,我们尝试填补视频-文本理解模型的空白,提出一种快速且高效的视频-文本模型MobileViCLIP,该模型具备强大的零样本推理能力,可部署于移动设备。特别是,我们的MobileViCLIP-Small在文本到视频数据集MSR-VTT上实现了与InternVideo2-L14相似的零样本检索性能,而在移动设备上的部署速度则快46.7倍。此外,MobileViCLIP-Small可泛化至零样本动作识别任务,在移动设备上的运行速度比InternVideo2-S14快5.6倍,并且Top-1准确率高出1.0%。代码已开源,地址为https://github.com/MCG-NJU/MobileViCLIP。
abstract_en: Efficient lightweight neural networks have received increasing attention due to their faster reasoning speed and easier deployment on mobile devices. However, existing video models still focus on the larger ViT architecture, and few works attempt to build efficient architecture. Since many efficient contrastive language-image pre-training (CLIP) models have shown strong zero-shot classification and retrieval capability, we attempt to fill the gap in video-text understanding models and propose a fast and efficient video-text model MobileViCLIP with strong zero-shot reasoning capability that can be deployed on mobile devices. In particular, our MobileViCLIP-Small obtains similar zero-shot retrieval performance as InternVideo2-L14 on text-to-video dataset MSR-VTT while being 46.7x faster when deployed on the mobile device. Furthermore, MobileViCLIP-Small can generalize to zero-shot action recognition task and obtains 1.0% better Top-1 accuracy than InternVideo2-S14 while being 5.6x faster on the mobile device. The code is available at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/MobileViCLIP.
authors: Min Yang, Zihan Jia, Zhilin Dai, Sheng Guo, Limin Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20824-20835

title: ModSkill: 物理角色技能模块化
title_en: ModSkill: Physical Character Skill Modularization
abstract: 人类运动具有高度多样性和动态性,这对旨在泛化运动技能以控制模拟角色的模仿学习算法提出了挑战。现有方法通常依赖于通用全身控制器来跟踪参考运动(基于跟踪的模型)或统一的全身技能嵌入空间(技能嵌入)。然而,这些方法在泛化和扩展到更大运动数据集时往往存在困难。在本工作中,我们引入了一种新颖的技能学习框架ModSkill,通过解耦复杂的全身技能为可组合、模块化的独立身体部位技能,利用受身体结构启发的归纳偏置来提升技能学习性能。我们的框架包含一个技能模块化注意力机制,将策略观测转换为模块化技能嵌入,以指导每个身体部位的低级控制器。我们进一步提出生成式自适应采样用于主动技能学习,利用大型运动生成模型在具有挑战性的跟踪场景中自适应增强策略学习。结果表明,这种通过生成式采样增强的模块化技能学习框架在精确全身运动跟踪方面优于现有方法,并能够为多样化的目标驱动任务提供可复用的技能嵌入。
abstract_en: Human motion is highly diverse and dynamic, posing challenges for imitation learning algorithms that aim to generalize motor skills for controlling simulated characters. Prior methods typically rely on a universal full-body controller for tracking reference motion (tracking-based model) or a unified full-body skill embedding space (skill embedding). However, these approaches often struggle to generalize and scale to larger motion datasets.
