abstract: 我们介绍了首个数据驱动的多视角三维点跟踪器,旨在利用多摄像机视角对动态场景中的任意点进行跟踪。与现有单目跟踪器难以处理深度歧义和遮挡问题,或需要超过20个摄像机且需繁琐逐序列优化的早期多摄像机方法不同,我们的前馈模型通过实用数量的摄像机(例如四个)直接预测三维对应关系,实现了鲁棒且精确的在线跟踪。在已知摄像机姿态及基于传感器或估计的多视角深度条件下,我们的跟踪器将多视角特征融合为统一的点云,并结合k近邻相关性与基于Transformer的更新机制,可靠地估计长程三维对应关系,即使在遮挡情况下也能保持稳定性。我们在5000个合成多视角Kubric序列上进行训练,并在两个真实场景基准数据集——Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上进行评估,分别取得3.1厘米和2.0厘米的中位轨迹误差。我们的方法可良好泛化至1-8视角的多样化摄像机配置,适用于不同视角和24-150帧长度的视频序列。通过发布跟踪器及训练与评估数据集,我们旨在为多视角三维跟踪研究树立新标准,并为实际应用提供实用工具。项目页面:https://ethz-vlg.github.io/mvtracker
abstract_en: We introduce the first data-driven multi-view 3D point tracker, designed to track arbitrary points in dynamic scenes using multiple camera views. Unlike existing monocular trackers, which struggle with depth ambiguities and occlusion, or prior multi-camera methods that require over 20 cameras and tedious per-sequence optimization, our feed-forward model directly predicts 3D correspondences using a practical number of cameras (e.g., four), enabling robust and accurate online tracking. Given known camera poses and either sensor-based or estimated multi-view depth, our tracker fuses multi-view features into a unified point cloud and applies k-nearest-neighbors correlation alongside a transformer-based update to reliably estimate long-range 3D correspondences, even under occlusion. We train on 5K synthetic multi-view Kubric sequences and evaluate on two real-world benchmarks--Panoptic Studio and DexYCB--achieving median trajectory errors of 3.1 cm and 2.0cm, respectively. Our method generalizes well to diverse camera setups of 1-8 views with varying vantage points and video lengths of 24-150 frames. By releasing our tracker alongside training and evaluation datasets, we aim to set a new standard for multi-view 3D tracking research and provide a practical tool for real-world applications. Project page: https://ethz-vlg.github.io/mvtracker.
authors: Frano Rajič, Haofei Xu, Marko Mihajlovic, Siyuan Li, Irem Demir, Emircan Gündoğdu, Lei Ke, Sergey Prokudin, Marc Pollefeys, Siyu Tang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 59-68

title: 基于改写文本的多视角槽注意力用于人脸反欺骗
title_en: Multi-View Slot Attention Using Paraphrased Texts for Face Anti-Spoofing
abstract: 近期基于视觉-语言模型(如CLIP)的人脸反欺骗(FAS)方法在跨域性能方面表现出色。然而,现有的CLIP-based FAS模型未能充分挖掘CLIP的补丁嵌入标记,导致无法检测关键欺骗线索。此外,这些模型依赖于每个类别单一的文本提示(例如“活体”或“伪造”),限制了其泛化能力。为解决这些问题,我们提出MVP-FAS框架,该框架包含两个关键模块:多视角槽注意力(MVS)和多文本补丁对齐(MTPA)。两个模块均利用多种改写文本生成泛化特征,减少对领域特定文本的依赖。MVS通过多视角的多样化文本提取补丁嵌入中的局部详细空间特征和全局上下文。MTPA将补丁与多种文本表示对齐以提升语义鲁棒性。大量实验表明,MVP-FAS在跨域数据集上实现了优越的泛化性能,超越了先前最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Recent face anti-spoofing (FAS) methods have shown remarkable cross-domain performance by employing vision-language models like CLIP. However, existing CLIP-based FAS models do not fully exploit CLIP's patch embedding tokens, failing to detect critical spoofing clues. Moreover, these models rely on a single text prompt per class (e.g, 'live' or 'fake'), which limits generalization. To address these issues, we propose MVP-FAS, a novel framework incorporating two key modules: Multi-View Slot attention (MVS) and Multi-Text Patch Alignment (MTPA). Both modules utilize multiple paraphrased texts to generate generalized features and reduce dependence on domain-specific text. MVS extracts local detailed spatial features and global context from patch embeddings by leveraging diverse texts with multiple perspectives. MTPA aligns patches with multiple text representations to improve semantic robustness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MVP-FAS achieves superior generalization performance, outperforming previous state-of-the-art methods on cross-domain datasets.
authors: Jeongmin Yu, Susang Kim, Kisu Lee, Taekyoung Kwon, Won-Yong Shin, Ha Young Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21117-21128

title: 基于结构化视频扩散的多身份人体图像动画
title_en: Multi-identity Human Image Animation with Structural Video Diffusion
abstract: 从单张图像生成人体视频并确保高视觉质量和精确控制是一项具有挑战性的任务,尤其是在涉及多人物和与物体交互的复杂场景中。现有方法虽然在单人案例中有效,但往往难以处理多身份交互的复杂性,因为它们难以正确关联人物外观与姿态条件的配对,并建模三维感知动态的分布。为解决这些局限性,我们提出了结构化视频扩散(Structural Video Diffusion),这是一种专门用于生成真实感多人体视频的新框架。我们的方法引入了两项核心创新:身份特定嵌入以保持人物间的一致外观,以及结合深度和表面法线线索的结构化学习机制以建模人物-物体交互。此外,我们扩展了现有的人体视频数据集,新增了25000个包含多样多人体和物体交互场景的视频,为训练提供了坚实的基础。实验结果表明,结构化视频扩散在生成具有动态丰富交互的多主体逼真、连贯视频方面表现出色,推动了以人体为中心的视频生成技术的发展。代码可在https://github.com/zhenzhiwang/Multi-HumanVid获取
abstract_en: Generating human videos from a single image while ensuring high visual quality and precise control is a challenging task, especially in complex scenarios involving multiple individuals and interactions with objects. Existing methods, while effective for single-human cases, often fail to handle the intricacies of multi-identity interactions because they struggle to associate the correct pairs of human appearance and pose condition and model the distribution of 3D-aware dynamics. To address these limitations, we present Structural Video Diffusion, a novel framework designed for generating realistic multi-human videos. Our approach introduces two core innovations: identity-specific embeddings to maintain consistent appearances across individuals and a structural learning mechanism that incorporates depth and surface-normal cues to model human-object interactions. Additionally, we expand existing human video dataset with 25K new videos featuring diverse multi-human and object interaction scenarios, providing a robust foundation for training. Experimental results demonstrate that Structural Video Diffusion achieves superior performance in generating lifelike, coherent videos for multiple subjects with dynamic and rich interactions, advancing the state of human-centric video generation. Code is available at https://github.com/zhenzhiwang/Multi-HumanVid
authors: Zhenzhi Wang, Yixuan Li, Yanhong Zeng, Yuwei Guo, Dahua Lin, Tianfan Xue, Bo Dai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11937-11947

title: 多模态身份提取
title_en: Multi-modal Identity Extraction
abstract: 多模态基础模型的成功在很大程度上归功于其多样化、数十亿规模的训练数据。本质上,网络数据包含人类面部图像和个体描述信息,因此这些模型可能引发广泛隐私隐患。近期针对CLIP模型的身份成员推理攻击(IMIA)表明,个体姓名与图像是否存在于训练数据中可被可靠推断。本工作形式化了身份提取问题,即攻击者仅凭图像即可可靠提取个体姓名。我们提出以下贡献:(i)将先前IMIA方法适配至从大规模候选集中选择正确姓名的问题,并证明该方法可扩展至百万级姓名;(ii)设计出超越适配基线的攻击方法;(iii)展示攻击者可通过优化方法单独提取姓名。为验证框架价值,我们说明身份提取可用于审计模型隐私。事实上,一类声称训练前模糊人脸以保护隐私的知名模型仍高度易受攻击。
abstract_en: The success of multi-modal foundational models can be partly attributed to their diverse, billions scale training data. By nature, web data contains human faces and descriptions of individuals. Thus, these models pose potentially widespread privacy issues. Recently, identity membership inference attacks (IMIAs) against the CLIP model showed that membership of an individual's name and image within training data can be reliably inferred. This work formalizes the problem of identity extraction, wherein an attacker can reliably extract the names of individuals given their images only. We provide the following contributions (i) we adapt a previous IMIA to the problem of selecting the correct name among a large set and show that the method scales to millions of names (ii) we design an attack that outperforms the adapted baseline (iii) we show that an attacker can extract names via optimization only. To demonstrate the interest of our framework, we show how identity extraction can be used to audit model privacy. Indeed, a family of prominent models that advertise blurring faces before training to protect privacy is still highly vulnerable to attack.
authors: Ryan Webster, Teddy Furon ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10797-10806

title: 多模态多平台行人重识别:基准与方法
title_en: Multi-modal Multi-platform Person Re-Identification: Benchmark and Method
abstract: 传统行人重识别(ReID)研究往往局限于静态摄像头的单模态传感器数据,难以应对现实场景中多模态信号日益普遍的复杂性。例如,考虑一个整合静态RGB摄像头、夜间红外传感器以及配备动态跟踪功能的无人机的城市ReID系统。此类系统由于摄像头视角、光照条件和传感器模态的变化,面临显著挑战,阻碍了有效的行人重识别。为解决这些问题,我们引入了MP-ReID基准,这是一个专为多模态和多平台ReID设计的新数据集。该基准独特地整合了来自1930个身份的多样化模态数据,包括RGB、红外和热成像,这些数据由无人机和地面摄像头在室内外环境中采集。基于此基准,我们提出了Uni-Prompt ReID框架,该框架专门设计了提示,适用于跨模态和跨平台场景。我们的方法持续超越现有最先进方法,为复杂动态ReID环境中的未来研究奠定了坚实基础。此外,我们的数据集将公开以支持进一步发展。
abstract_en: Conventional person re-identification (ReID) research is often limited to single-modality sensor data from static cameras, which fails to address the complexities of real-world scenarios where multi-modal signals are increasingly prevalent. For instance, consider an urban ReID system integrating stationary RGB cameras, nighttime infrared sensors, and UAVs equipped with dynamic tracking capabilities. Such systems face significant challenges due to variations in camera perspectives, lighting conditions, and sensor modalities, hindering effective person ReID.To address these challenges, we introduce the MP-ReID benchmark, a novel dataset designed specifically for multi-modality and multi-platform ReID. This benchmark uniquely compiles data from 1,930 identities across diverse modalities, including RGB, infrared, and thermal imaging, captured by both UAVs and ground-based cameras in indoor and outdoor environments.Building on this benchmark, we introduce Uni-Prompt ReID, a framework with specific-designed prompts, tailored for cross-modality and cross-platform scenarios. Our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, establishing a robust foundation for future research in complex and dynamic ReID environments. Additionally, our dataset will be made publicly available to support further advancements.
authors: Ruiyang Ha, Songyi Jiang, Bin Li, Bikang Pan, Yihang Zhu, Junjie Zhang, Xiatian Zhu, Shaogang Gong, Jingya Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10251-10261

title: 多模态SAM模型用于伪装场景分割
title_en: Multi-modal Segment Anything Model for Camouflaged Scene Segmentation
abstract: 伪装场景中,物体与环境无缝融合,对人类观察者和计算机视觉系统都提出了重大挑战。这些物体在颜色、纹理和形状上与背景匹配,使其难以检测。为此,我们提出利用分割任何模型(SAM)有效解决这一具有挑战性的任务。具体而言,我们提出无需任何手动提示即可利用SAM的若干思路。我们方法的核心在于通过多模态提示提取的丰富信息。首先,我们使用BLIP模型生成图像描述,并通过文本编码器获得其文本嵌入。随后,我们通过BLIP模型的视觉编码器生成视觉嵌入,并将两者作为输入传递给SAM,以提供关于图像的额外语义信息。最后,我们提出两项架构创新:a)通过多级适配器有效整合SAM中的多模态信息;b)将SAM的密集嵌入替换为其图像编码器的图像嵌入。我们的方法在三个伪装检测基准数据集的12项指标中取得了11项新最先进的性能。此外,我们的方法可成功适配于其他任务(如医学图像分割),在性能上与当前最佳方法相当甚至更优。我们的代码可在https://github.com/ic-qialanqian/Vision-Language-SAM获取。
abstract_en: Camouflaged scenes, where objects blend seamlessly into their environments, pose significant challenges to both human observers and computer vision systems. These objects match the background in color, texture, and shape, making them difficult to detect. To this end, we propose leveraging the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to tackle this challenging task effectively. Specifically, we propose how to exploit SAM without requiring any manual prompts by proposing several ideas. At the core of our method lies the rich information extracted through multi-modal prompts. At first, we generate an image caption using the BLIP model and obtain its text embedding through the use of a text encoder. We then generate a visual embedding through the vision encoder of the BLIP model and use both as inputs to SAM to provide additional semantic information about the image. Finally, we propose a couple of architectural novelties, a) we effectively integrate the multi-modal information in SAM through a multi-level adapter and b) we replace the dense embedding of SAM with the image embedding of its image encoder. Our method achieves new state-of-the-art performance in 11 out of 12 metrics in three benchmark datasets for camouflaged detection. Additionally, our method can be successfully adapted to other tasks such as medical image segmentation performing on par or even outperforming the state-of-the-art methods. Our code is available in https://github.com/ic-qialanqian/Vision-Language-SAM.
authors: Guangyu Ren, Hengyan Liu, Michalis Lazarou, Tania Stathaki ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19882-19892

title: 基于深度感知的多场景重叠文本分割
title_en: Multi-scenario Overlapping Text Segmentation with Depth Awareness
abstract: 重叠文本对文本相关感知任务构成重大挑战,尤其是在字体和视觉效果多样的开放场景中。尽管现有研究主要针对文档中的重叠问题进行了探索,但其在其他场景中的适用性仍受到限制。为弥合这一差距,我们提出了一种新的多场景重叠文本分割任务,并引入了一个涵盖英文和中文的真实数据集,该数据集覆盖印刷文本、票据、艺术设计和门牌号等多种场景。为进一步提升重叠文本分割模型的泛化能力,我们提出了一种分层训练数据合成策略,模拟不同场景下的多样化重叠模式。此外,我们发现深度图能够提供三维空间中清晰的相对位置关系,有助于模型捕捉文本实例之间的复杂重叠关系。基于这一洞察,我们提出了一种深度引导解码器,无缝融合图像和深度特征以捕捉重叠交互。与现有SOTA方法相比,我们的模型在基准数据集和SignaTR6k数据集上分别实现了文本mIoU 5.3%和整体mIoU 6.4%的提升。
abstract_en: Overlapping text poses significant challenges for text-related perception tasks, particularly in open scenes characterized by diverse fonts and visual effects. While existing research has primarily addressed the overlapping problem in documents, its applicability to other scenes remains limited. To bridge this gap, we propose a new task of multi-scenario overlapping text segmentation and introduce a corresponding real dataset in both English and Chinese, spanning various contexts such as printed text, bills, artistic designs, and house numbers. To further enhance the generalization of overlapping text segmentation models, we propose a hierarchical training data synthesis strategy that simulates diverse overlapping patterns across different scenarios. Furthermore, we found that depth maps can provide clear relative position relationships in three-dimensional space, assisting the model in capturing complex overlapping relationships between text instances. Building on this insight, we present a depth-guided decoder that seamlessly integrates image and depth features to capture overlapping interactions. Our proposed model achieves a 5.3% improvement in text mIoU and a 6.4% improvement in overall mIoU compared to existing SOTA methods on our benchmark and SignaTR6k datasets, respectively.
authors: Yang Liu, Xudong Xie, Yuliang Liu, Xiang Bai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17454-17463

title: 多轮连贯图像编辑
title_en: Multi-turn Consistent Image Editing
abstract: 许多现实应用场景,如交互式照片修图、艺术内容创作和产品设计,需要灵活且可迭代的图像编辑。然而,现有图像编辑方法主要关注于单步实现所需修改,常难以处理用户意图模糊、复杂变换或需要渐进式优化等场景,导致结果不一致或无法满足用户期望。为解决这些问题,我们提出一种多轮图像编辑框架,使用户能够迭代优化编辑内容,逐步获得更满意的结果。我们的方法通过流匹配实现精确的图像反演,并采用双目标线性二次调节器(LQR)进行稳定采样,有效缓解误差累积问题。此外,通过分析Transformer的层间作用,我们引入自适应注意力突出方法,在提升编辑性的同时保持多轮连贯性。大量实验表明,与现有方法相比,我们的框架显著提升了编辑成功率和视觉保真度。代码已开源:https://zhouzj-dl.github.io/Multi-turn_Consistent_Image_Editing/
abstract_en: Many real-world applications, such as interactive photo retouching, artistic content creation, and product design, require flexible and iterative image editing. However, existing image editing methods primarily focus on achieving the desired modifications in a single step, which often struggles with ambiguous user intent, complex transformations, or the need for progressive refinements. As a result, these methods frequently produce inconsistent outcomes or fail to meet user expectations. To address these challenges, we propose a multi-turn image editing framework that enables users to iteratively refine their edits, progressively achieving more satisfactory results. Our approach leverages flow matching for accurate image inversion and a dual-objective Linear Quadratic Regulators (LQR) for stable sampling, effectively mitigating error accumulation. Additionally, by analyzing the layer-wise roles of transformers, we introduce a adaptive attention highlighting method that enhances editability while preserving multi-turn coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly improves edit success rates and visual fidelity compared to existing methods. The code is available at: https://zhouzj-dl.github.io/Multi-turn_Consistent_Image_Editing/.
authors: Zijun Zhou, Yingying Deng, Xiangyu He, Weiming Dong, Fan Tang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15792-15801

title: 多视角注视目标估计
title_en: Multi-view Gaze Target Estimation
abstract: 本文提出了一种利用多视角摄像头进行注视目标估计(GTE)任务的方法。该方法通过整合不同摄像头视角的信息,提升估计精度并拓展适用性,解决了现有单视角方法在面临面部遮挡、目标歧义和超出视野目标等挑战时的局限性。我们的方法以一对摄像头视角作为输入,结合头部信息聚合(HIA)模块,利用双视角的头部信息实现更精确的注视估计,引入基于不确定性的注视选择(UGS)以识别最可靠的注视输出,并采用基于极线的场景注意力(ESA)模块实现跨视角背景信息共享。该方法在单视角基线方法上表现显著优于,尤其是在第二视角能清晰捕捉到人脸时。此外,我们的方法能够仅通过第二视角的人脸图像估计第一视角的注视目标,这是单视角GTE方法所不具备的能力。此外,本文还引入了一个多视角数据集用于开发和评估多视角GTE方法。数据和代码已公开。
abstract_en: This paper presents a method that utilizes multiple camera views for the gaze target estimation (GTE) task. The approach integrates information from different camera views to improve accuracy and expand applicability, addressing limitations in existing single-view methods that face challenges such as face occlusion, target ambiguity, and out-of-view targets. Our method processes a pair of camera views as input, incorporating a Head Information Aggregation (HIA) module for leveraging head information from both views for more accurate gaze estimation, an Uncertainty-based Gaze Selection (UGS) for identifying the most reliable gaze output, and an Epipolar-based Scene Attention (ESA) module for cross-view background information sharing. This approach significantly outperforms single-view baselines, especially when the second camera provides a clear view of the person's face. Additionally, our method can estimate the gaze target in the first view using the image of the person in the second view only, a capability not possessed by single-view GTE methods. Furthermore, the paper introduces a multi-view dataset for developing and evaluating multi-view GTE methods. Data and code are available.
authors: Qiaomu Miao, Vivek Raju Golani, Jingyi Xu, Progga Paromita Dutta, Minh Hoai, Dimitris Samaras ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5371-5381

title: MultiADS: 面向零样本学习的多类型异常检测与分割的缺陷感知监督
title_en: MultiADS: Defect-aware Supervision for Multi-type Anomaly Detection and Segmentation in Zero-Shot Learning
abstract: 在工业应用中,精确的光学检测对于降低废品率和减少相关成本至关重要。除了判断产品是否异常外,还需要明确识别不同类型的缺陷,如弯曲、切割或划痕。能够识别“确切”的缺陷类型,可使现代生产线实现异常的自动化处理。现有方法仅限于判断产品是否缺陷,而无法提供任何关于缺陷类型的见解,但仍然能够检测和识别多种缺陷。我们提出MultiADS,一种零样本学习方法,能够执行多类型异常检测与分割。MultiADS的架构包含CLIP和额外的线性层,以在联合特征空间中对齐视觉和文本表示。据我们所知,我们的方法是首个在零样本学习中执行多类型异常分割任务的方案。与其它基线方法不同,我们的方法i)为每种不同缺陷类型生成特定的异常掩码,ii)学习区分缺陷类型,iii)同时识别异常产品中存在的多种缺陷类型。此外,我们的方法在五个常用数据集(MVTec-AD、Visa、MPDD、MAD和Real-IAD)的图像级和像素级异常检测与分割任务中,优于零样本/少样本学习的最先进方法。
abstract_en: Precise optical inspection in industrial applications is crucial for minimizing scrap rates and reducing the associated costs. Besides merely detecting if a product is anomalous or not, it is crucial to know the distinct types of defects, such as a bent, cut, or scratch. The ability to recognize the "exact" defect type enables automated treatments of the anomalies in modern production lines. Current methods are limited to solely detecting whether a product is defective or not, without providing any insights into the defect type, but nevertheless detecting and identifying multiple defects. We propose MultiADS, a zero-shot learning approach, able to perform Multi-type Anomaly Detection and Segmentation. The architecture of MultiADS comprises CLIP and extra linear layers to align the visual and textual representation in a joint feature space. To the best of our knowledge, our proposal is the first approach to perform a multitype anomaly segmentation task in zero-shot learning. Contrary to the other baselines, our approach i) generates specific anomaly masks for each distinct defect type, ii) learns to distinguish defect types, and iii) simultaneously identifies multiple defect types present in an anomalous product. Additionally, our approach outperforms zero/few-shot learning SoTA methods on image-level and pixel-level anomaly detection and segmentation tasks on five commonly used datasets: MVTec-AD, Visa, MPDD, MAD, and Real-IAD.
authors: Ylli Sadikaj, Hongkuan Zhou, Lavdim Halilaj, Stefan Schmid, Steffen Staab, Claudia Plant ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22978-22988

title: 多模态动作条件化视频模拟
title_en: MultiModal Action Conditioned Video Simulation
abstract: 当前视频模型作为世界模型存在不足,因其缺乏细粒度控制能力。通用家用机器人需要实时细粒度运动控制以处理精细任务和紧急情况。在本工作中,我们引入细粒度多模态动作以捕捉此类精确控制。我们考虑本体感觉、动觉、力触觉和肌肉激活等感知模态。此类多模态感知自然地使细粒度交互成为可能,而文本条件生成模型难以模拟此类交互。为有效模拟细粒度多模态感官动作,我们开发了一种特征学习范式,在对齐这些模态的同时保留各模态提供的独特信息。我们进一步提出一种正则化方案,以增强动作轨迹特征在表示复杂交互动态中的因果性。实验表明,引入多模态感知可提升模拟精度并减少时间漂移。广泛的消融实验和下游应用验证了本工作的有效性与实用性。
abstract_en: Current video models fail as world model as they lack fine-graiend control. General-purpose household robots require real-time fine motor control to handle delicate tasks and urgent situations. In this work, we introduce fine-grained multimodal actions to capture such precise control. We consider senses of proprioception, kinesthesia, force haptics, and muscle activation. Such multimodal senses naturally enables fine-grained interactions that are difficult to simulate with text-conditioned generative models. To effectively simulate fine-grained multisensory actions, we develop a feature learning paradigm that aligns these modalities while preserving the unique information each modality provides. We further propose a regularization scheme to enhance causality of the action trajectory features in representing intricate interaction dynamics. Experiments show that incorporating multimodal senses improves simulation accuracy and reduces temporal drift. Extensive ablation studies and downstream applications demonstrate the effectiveness and practicality of our work.
authors: Yichen Li, Antonio Torralba ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14173-14183

title: MultiVerse:一个用于评估大视觉语言模型的多轮对话基准
title_en: MultiVerse: A Multi-Turn Conversation Benchmark for Evaluating Large Vision and Language Models
abstract: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)在单轮基准测试中展现出令人印象深刻的能力,但现实应用场景往往需要更复杂的多轮对话。现有多轮对话数据集(如MMDU、ConvBench)仅部分覆盖了用户实际遇到的对话场景的广度和深度。在本工作中,我们引入了MultiVerse,一个新型多轮对话基准,包含647个对话(每个平均四轮),源自12个流行VLM评估基准的多样化集合。该基准涵盖484项任务和484个交互目标,涉及从事实性知识和感知到数学和编程等高级推理任务的广泛主题。为实现稳健评估,我们提出基于清单的评估方法,利用GPT-4o作为自动化评估器,从感知准确性、语言清晰度和事实正确性等37个关键方面衡量性能。我们在MultiVerse上评估了18个VLMs,发现即使最强的模型(如GPT-4o)在复杂多轮对话中也仅达到50%的成功率,突显了该数据集的挑战性。值得注意的是,我们发现为较小或较弱模型提供完整对话上下文可显著提升其性能,强调了上下文学习的重要性。我们认为MultiVerse是评估VLMs多轮交互能力的基准。
abstract_en: Vision-and-Language Models (VLMs) have shown impressive capabilities on single-turn benchmarks, yet real-world applications often demand more intricate multi-turn dialogues. Existing multi-turn datasets (e.g, MMDU, ConvBench) only partially capture the breadth and depth of conversational scenarios encountered by users. In this work, we introduce MultiVerse, a novel multi-turn conversation benchmark featuring 647 dialogues--each averaging four turns--derived from a diverse set of 12 popular VLM evaluation benchmarks. With 484 tasks and 484 interaction goals, MultiVerse covers a wide range of topics, from factual knowledge and perception to advanced reasoning tasks such as mathematics and coding. To facilitate robust assessment, we propose a checklist-based evaluation method that leverages GPT-4o as the automated evaluator, measuring performance across 37 key aspects, including perceptual accuracy, linguistic clarity, and factual correctness. We evaluate 18 VLMs on MultiVerse, revealing that even the strongest models (e.g., GPT-4o) achieve only a 50% success rate in complex multi-turn conversations, highlighting the dataset's challenging nature. Notably, we find that providing full dialogue context significantly enhances performance for smaller or weaker models, emphasizing the importance of in-context learning. We believe MultiVerse is a landscape of evaluating multi-turn interaction abilities for VLMs.
authors: Young-Jun Lee, Byung-Kwan Lee, Jianshu Zhang, Yechan Hwang, Byungsoo Ko, Han-Gyu Kim, Dongyu Yao, Xuankun Rong, Eojin Joo, Seung-Ho Han, Bowon Ko, Ho-Jin Choi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 708-719

title: 多维字节对编码:缩短序列以提升视觉数据生成效果
title_en: Multidimensional Byte Pair Encoding: Shortened Sequences for Improved Visual Data Generation
abstract: 在语言处理中,变压器模型通过将字符压缩为词片段,从更大词汇量的更大单元构建输出,这通常通过字节对编码实现。在图像领域,视觉数据的分词通常局限于由量化方法获得的规则网格,未采用此类区域进一步抽象的方法。我们的工作通过将字节对编码从一维扩展到多维,作为现有压缩的补充模块,改进了视觉数据的分词。我们通过统计标记对的组合,并用新引入的标记替换最频繁的标记对来实现这一目标。该方法仅使图像处理时间增加2倍,即使在消费级硬件上也能在几分钟内处理大型数据集如ImageNet。这是一个无损预处理步骤。我们进一步提出网络如何消化不再处于规则网格中的新标记。评估结果表明,通过压缩频繁标记组合生成的视觉数据,变压器模型在训练和推理性能上均有提升:生成的序列信息内容分布更均匀,例如通过将图像中的空区域压缩为单个标记。如实验所示,这些压缩序列更易于处理。
abstract_en: In language processing, transformers benefit greatly from characters being condensed into word fragments, building outputs from a larger vocabulary of bigger pieces. This is often done with Byte Pair Encoding. In the context of images, tokenisation of visual data is usually limited to regular grids obtained from quantisation methods, not using such further abstraction of regions.Our work improves tokenisation of visual data by bringing Byte Pair Encoding from 1D to multiple dimensions, as a complementary add-on to existing compression. We achieve this through counting constellations of token pairs and replacing the most frequent token pair with a newly introduced token. Our approach only increases computation time by a factor of 2 for images, making it applicable even to large datasets like ImageNet within minutes on consumer hardware. This is a lossless preprocessing step. We further propose how networks can digest the new tokens that are no longer in a regular grid. Our evaluation shows improved training and inference performance of transformers on visual data achieved by compressing frequent constellations of tokens: The resulting sequences have more uniformly distributed information content, e.g. by condensing empty regions in an image into single tokens. As our experiments show, these condensed sequences are easier to process.
authors: Tim Elsner, Paula Usinger, Julius Nehring-Wirxel, Gregor Kobsik, Victor Czech, Yanjiang He, Isaak Lim, Leif Kobbelt ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21331-21341

title: 多模态大语言模型引导的探索与主动映射方法研究
title_en: Multimodal LLM Guided Exploration and Active Mapping using Fisher Information
abstract: 我们提出了一种主动映射系统,能够基于三维高斯泼溅(3DGS)表示规划长视距探索目标和短时动作。现有方法要么未充分利用多模态大语言模型(LLM)的最新进展,要么未考虑定位不确定性这一具身智能体的关键挑战。我们提出将多模态LLM与基于信息的算法相结合,用于长视距规划和详细运动规划。通过利用我们3DGS表示的高质量视图合成,我们的方法将多模态LLM作为零样本规划器,从语义视角实现长视距探索目标。我们还引入了一种不确定性感知的路径提案与选择算法,在最大化环境信息增益的同时最小化定位误差成本。在Gibson和Habitat-Matterport 3D数据集上的实验验证了所提方法达到最先进水平。
abstract_en: We present an active mapping system that could plan for long-horizon exploration goals and short-term actions with a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) representation. Existing methods either did not take advantage of recent developments in multimodal Large Language Models (LLM) or did not consider challenges in localization uncertainty which is critical in embodied agents. We propose employing multimodal LLMs for long-horizon planning in conjunction with detailed motion planning using our information-based algorithm. By leveraging high-quality view synthesis from our 3DGS representation, our method employs a multimodal LLM as a zero-shot planner for long-horizon exploration goals from the semantic perspective. We also introduce an uncertainty-aware path proposal and selection algorithm that balances the dual objectives of maximizing the information gain for the environment while minimizing the cost of localization errors. Experiments conducted on the Gibson and Habitat-Matterport 3D datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art results of the proposed method.
authors: Wen Jiang, Boshu Lei, Katrina Ashton, Kostas Daniilidis ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5392-5404

title: 多模态大语言模型作为文本到图像生成的定制化奖励模型
title_en: Multimodal LLMs as Customized Reward Models for Text-to-Image Generation
abstract: 我们引入LLaVA-Reward,这是一种高效的奖励模型,旨在从多个视角自动评估文本到图像(T2I)生成结果,利用预训练多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)。现有基于MLLM的方法需要指令跟随数据进行监督微调,并通过分析文本响应评估生成质量,这过程耗时且难以训练。为解决此问题,我们提出LLaVA-Reward,直接利用给定文本-图像对的MLLM隐藏状态。为进一步增强解码器-only MLLM中视觉与文本表征的双向交互,我们提出添加跳连交叉注意力(SkipCA)模块。该设计通过将早期层视觉特征与后期层隐藏表征连接,提升文本-图像相关性推理。此外,LLaVA-Reward支持不同类型偏好数据的高效微调,包括配对偏好数据和非配对数据。我们在四个评估视角上训练LLaVA-Reward:文本-图像对齐、保真度/伪影、安全性及整体排名。实证结果表明,LLaVA-Reward在生成与人类对齐的自动评估分数及文本到图像生成的推理时扩展方面,均优于传统方法和基于MLLM的方法。
abstract_en: We introduce LLaVA-Reward, an efficient reward model designed to automatically evaluate text-to-image (T2I) generations across multiple perspectives, leveraging pretrained multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing MLLM-based approaches require instruction-following data for supervised fine-tuning and evaluate generation quality on analyzing text response, which is time-consuming and difficult to train. To address this problem, we propose LLaVA-Reward, which directly utilizes the hidden states of MLLMs given text-image pairs. To enhance the bidirectional interaction between visual and textual representations in decoder-only MLLMs, we further propose adding a Skip-connection Cross Attention (SkipCA) module. This design enhances text-image correlation reasoning by connecting early-layer visual features with later-layer hidden representations. In addition, LLaVA-Reward supports different types of preference data for efficient fine-tuning, including paired preference data and unpaired data. We train LLaVA-Reward on four evaluation perspectives: text-image alignment, fidelity/artifact, safety, and overall ranking. Empirical results demonstrate that LLaVA-Reward outperforms conventional and MLLM-based methods in generating human-aligned scores for automatic evaluations and inference-time scaling in text-to-image generations.
authors: Shijie Zhou, Ruiyi Zhang, Huaisheng Zhu, Branislav Kveton, Yufan Zhou, Jiuxiang Gu, Jian Chen, Changyou Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19638-19648

title: 多模态大语言模型引导的ISP超参数优化与动态偏好学习
title_en: Multimodal Large Language Model-Guided ISP Hyperparameter Optimization with Dynamic Preference Learning
abstract: 图像信号处理(ISP)流程负责将传感器采集的原始图像转换为高质量的RGB图像。该流程包含一系列图像处理模块及对应的ISP超参数。近期基于学习的方法旨在通过仅使用图像数据自动优化ISP超参数。然而,其单模态特性限制了对更丰富上下文信息的捕捉,降低了在多样化应用场景中的鲁棒性和适应性。为解决这一局限性,我们提出了一种多模态大语言模型(MLLM)引导的ISP超参数优化框架,将MLLM生成的文本洞察整合到优化过程中。通过结合高层语义线索和低层图像质量描述符,我们的方法增强了上下文理解与任务适应性。此外,我们引入了一种基于直接偏好优化(DPO)的动态配对生成(DPG)精炼策略,实现了无需大量人工标注数据的高效偏好对齐。该两阶段框架不仅提升了优化方向的一致性,还显著降低了计算和数据准备的开销。我们在高阶和低阶视觉任务上验证了所提方法,结果表明其性能优于现有方法。
abstract_en: The image signal processing (ISP) pipeline is responsible for converting the RAW images collected from the sensor into high-quality RGB images. It contains a series of image processing modules and associated ISP hyperparameters. Recent learning-based approaches aim to automate ISP hyperparameter optimization using solely image data. However, their unimodal nature limits their ability to capture richer contextual information, reducing robustness and adaptability across diverse application scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-guided ISP hyperparameter optimization framework, which integrates textual insights generated by MLLMs into the optimization process. By incorporating both high-level semantic cues and low-level image quality descriptors, our method enhances contextual understanding and task adaptability. Additionally, we introduce a Dynamic Pair Generation (DPG) refinement strategy based on Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), facilitating efficient preference alignment without the need for extensive human-labeled data. This two-stage framework not only improves the directional consistency of optimization but also significantly reduces the computational and data preparation overhead. We validate our proposed methods on both high-level and low-level vision tasks, demonstrating superior performance compared to existing methods.
authors: Xinyu Sun, Zhikun Zhao, Congyan Lang, Bing Li, Juan Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 437-446

title: 多模态潜在扩散模型在复杂缝纫图案生成中的应用
title_en: Multimodal Latent Diffusion Model for Complex Sewing Pattern Generation
abstract: 在服装设计中生成缝纫图案正因其CG友好和灵活编辑的特性而受到越来越多的关注。先前的缝纫图案生成方法能够生成精致的服装,但难以实现对复杂服装的详细控制设计。为了解决这些问题,我们提出**SewingLDM**,这是一种多模态生成模型,能够通过文本提示、人体形状和服装草图来控制缝纫图案的生成。首先,我们将原始缝纫图案向量扩展为更全面的表示,以涵盖更多复杂细节,然后将其压缩到一个紧凑的潜在空间中。为了在潜在空间中学习缝纫图案分布,我们设计了一种两步训练策略,将多模态条件(即人体形状、文本提示和服装草图)注入扩散模型,确保生成的服装适合人体且细节可控。全面的定性和定量实验表明,我们提出的方法有效性显著,其在复杂服装设计和多种人体适应性方面均超越了以往的方法。
abstract_en: Generating sewing patterns in garment design is receiving increasing attention due to its CG-friendly and flexible-editing nature. Previous sewing pattern generation methods have been able to produce exquisite clothing, but struggle to design complex garments with detailed control. To address these issues, we propose **SewingLDM**, a multi-modal generative model that generates sewing patterns controlled by text prompts, body shapes, and garment sketches. Initially, we extend the original vector of sewing patterns into a more comprehensive representation to cover more intricate details and then compress them into a compact latent space. To learn the sewing pattern distribution in the latent space, we design a two-step training strategy to inject the multi-modal conditions, i.e., body shapes, text prompts, and garment sketches, into a diffusion model, ensuring the generated garments are body-suited and detail-controlled. Comprehensive qualitative and quantitative experiments show the effectiveness of our proposed method, significantly surpassing previous approaches in terms of complex garment design and various body adaptability.
authors: Shengqi Liu, Yuhao Cheng, Zhuo Chen, Xingyu Ren, Wenhan Zhu, Lincheng Li, Mengxiao Bi, Xiaokang Yang, Yichao Yan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17640-17650

title: 面向面部表情识别的多模态提示对齐方法
title_en: Multimodal Prompt Alignment for Facial Expression Recognition
abstract: 提示学习已被广泛采用,以高效适配如CLIP等视觉-语言模型(VLMs)到各种下游任务。尽管取得了成功,当前基于VLM的面部表情识别(FER)方法在捕捉细粒度的文本-视觉关系方面存在困难,而这种关系对于区分面部表情的细微差异至关重要。为解决这一挑战,我们提出了一种用于FER的多模态提示对齐框架,称为MPA-FER,该框架为提示的视觉特征学习过程提供细粒度语义指导,从而生成更精确且可解释的表示。具体而言,我们引入了一种多粒度硬提示生成策略,利用如ChatGPT等大语言模型(LLM)为每种面部表情生成详细描述。通过最小化软提示与硬提示之间的特征差异,将基于LLM的外部知识注入到软提示中。为保持预训练CLIP模型的泛化能力,我们的方法结合了原型引导的视觉特征对齐,确保冻结图像编码器生成的提示视觉特征与类别特定原型紧密对齐。此外,我们提出了一种跨模态全局-局部对齐模块,聚焦于与表情相关的面部特征,进一步提升文本与视觉特征之间的对齐效果。大量实验表明,我们的框架在三个FER基准数据集上优于现有最先进的方法,同时保留了预训练模型的优势并降低了计算成本。
abstract_en: Prompt learning has been widely adopted to efficiently adapt vision-language models (VLMs) like CLIP for various downstream tasks. Despite their success, current VLM-based facial expression recognition (FER) methods struggle to capture fine-grained textual-visual relationships, which are essential for distinguishing subtle differences between facial expressions. To address this challenge, we propose a multimodal prompt alignment framework for FER, called MPA-FER, that provides fine-grained semantic guidance to the learning process of prompted visual features, resulting in more precise and interpretable representations. Specifically, we introduce a multi-granularity hard prompt generation strategy that utilizes a large language model (LLM) like ChatGPT to generate detailed descriptions for each facial expression. The LLM-based external knowledge is injected into the soft prompts by minimizing the feature discrepancy between the soft prompts and the hard prompts. To preserve the generalization abilities of the pretrained CLIP model, our approach incorporates prototype-guided visual feature alignment, ensuring that the prompted visual features from the frozen image encoder align closely with class-specific prototypes. Additionally, we propose a cross-modal global-local alignment module that focuses on expression-relevant facial features, further improving the alignment between textual and visual features. Extensive experiments demonstrate our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods on three FER benchmark datasets, while retaining the benefits of the pretrained model and minimizing computational costs.
authors: Fuyan Ma, Yiran He, Bin Sun, Shutao Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12581-12591

title: 基于双相机的多光谱解马赛克
title_en: Multispectral Demosaicing via Dual Cameras
abstract: 多光谱(MS)图像能够捕捉广泛光谱波段下的详细场景信息,使其在需要丰富光谱数据的应用中具有不可替代的价值。将多光谱成像集成到多摄像头设备(如智能手机)中,有望同时提升光谱应用和RGB图像质量。处理多光谱数据的关键步骤是解马赛克,即从相机捕获的马赛克多光谱图像中重建颜色信息。本文提出了一种专门针对双摄像头配置的多光谱图像解马赛克方法,其中RGB和多光谱摄像头均捕捉同一场景。我们的方法利用通常具有更高空间保真度的协同捕捉RGB图像,来指导低保真度多光谱图像的解马赛克过程。我们引入了双摄像头RGB-MS数据集——一个包含配对RGB和多光谱马赛克图像及其真实值解马赛克输出的大规模数据集,用于训练和评估我们的方法。实验结果表明,与现有技术相比,我们的方法在精度上达到了最先进水平。
abstract_en: Multispectral (MS) images capture detailed scene information across a wide range of spectral bands, making them invaluable for applications requiring rich spectral data. Integrating MS imaging into multi-camera devices, such as smartphones, has the potential to enhance both spectral applications and RGB image quality. A critical step in processing MS data is demosaicing, which reconstructs color information from the mosaic MS images captured by the camera. This paper proposes a method for MS image demosaicing specifically designed for dual-camera setups where both RGB and MS cameras capture the same scene. Our approach leverages co-captured RGB images, which typically have higher spatial fidelity, to guide the demosaicing of lower-fidelity MS images. We introduce the Dual-camera RGB-MS Dataset - a large collection of paired RGB and MS mosaiced images with ground-truth demosaiced outputs - that enables training and evaluation of our method. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy compared to existing techniques.
authors: SaiKiran Tedla, Junyong Lee, Beixuan Yang, Mahmoud Afifi, Michael S. Brown ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5405-5414

title: MultiverSeg: 可扩展的生物医学图像数据集交互分割方法与上下文引导
title_en: MultiverSeg: Scalable Interactive Segmentation of Biomedical Imaging Datasets with In-Context Guidance
abstract: 医疗研究人员和临床医生经常需要在一组相关图像上执行新的分割任务。现有方法对于分割新数据集要么是交互式的,需要为每张图像投入大量人力,要么需要依赖已有的先前标注图像集。我们引入了一个系统MultiverSeg,使从业者能够在无需访问任何现有标注数据或领域数据的情况下,快速分割整个新数据集。模型在接收待分割图像的同时,接受用户交互(如点击、边界框或涂鸦)作为输入,并预测分割结果。随着用户对更多图像进行分割,这些图像及其分割结果会成为模型的额外输入,提供上下文信息。随着标注图像的上下文集规模扩大,每个新图像所需的交互次数逐渐减少。我们证明MultiverSeg能够通过摊薄每张图像的交互次数,实现高效的新数据集交互分割,达到90% Dice系数。与使用最先进的交互分割方法相比,MultiverSeg在未见过的任务图像集上将点击次数减少了36%,涂鸦步骤减少了25%。我们将在https://multiverseg.csail.mit.edu/发布代码和模型权重。
abstract_en: Medical researchers and clinicians often need to perform novel segmentation tasks on a set of related images. Existing methods for segmenting a new dataset are either interactive, requiring substantial human effort for each image, or require an existing set of previously labeled images. We introduce a system, MultiverSeg, that enables practitioners to rapidly segment an entire new dataset without requiring access to any existing labeled data from that task or domain. Along with the image to segment, the model takes user interactions such as clicks, bounding boxes or scribbles as input, and predicts a segmentation. As the user segments more images, those images and segmentations become additional inputs to the model, providing context. As the context set of labeled images grows, the number of interactions required to segment each new image decreases. We demonstrate that MultiverSeg enables users to interactively segment new datasets efficiently, by amortizing the number of interactions per image to achieve an accurate segmentation. Compared to using a state-of-the-art interactive segmentation method, MultiverSeg reduced the total number of clicks by 36% and scribble steps by 25% to achieve 90% Dice on sets of images from unseen tasks. We release code and model weights at https://multiverseg.csail.mit.edu/.
authors: Hallee E. Wong, Jose Javier Gonzalez Ortiz, John Guttag, Adrian V. Dalca ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20966-20980

title: 基于短视频的音乐定位
title_en: Music Grounding by Short Video
abstract: 为短视频添加合适的背景音乐有助于完成视频内容以供分享。先前的工作通过视频到音乐检索(V2MR)来处理该任务,旨在从音乐库中找到最匹配给定查询视频内容的音乐片段。然而在实际应用中,音乐片段通常比查询视频长得多,需要(手动)对检索到的音乐进行裁剪,以匹配视频时长。为弥合音乐时刻定位的实际需求与V2MR之间的差距,我们提出了一项新任务,称为基于短视频的音乐定位(MGSV)。为解决该新任务,我们引入了一个新的基准数据集MGSV-EC,包含53000个多样化的短视频,关联着来自4000个独特音乐片段的35000个不同音乐时刻。此外,我们开发了一种新的基线方法MaDe,在统一的端到端深度网络中同时执行视频到音乐匹配和音乐时刻检测。在MGSV-EC上的大量实验不仅突显了MGSV任务的挑战性,也确立了MaDe作为强有力的基线方法。
abstract_en: Adding proper background music helps complete a short video to be shared. Previous work tackles the task by video-to-music retrieval (V2MR), aiming to find the most suitable music track from a collection to match the content of a given query video. In practice, however, music tracks are typically much longer than the query video, necessitating (manual) trimming of the retrieved music to a shorter segment that matches the video duration. In order to bridge the gap between the practical need for music moment localization and V2MR, we propose a new task termed Music Grounding by Short Video (MGSV). To tackle the new task, we introduce a new benchmark, MGSV-EC, which comprises a diverse set of 53k short videos associated with 35k different music moments from 4k unique music tracks. Furthermore, we develop a new baseline method, MaDe, which performs both video-to-music matching and music moment detection within a unified end-to-end deep network. Extensive experiments on MGSV-EC not only highlight the challenging nature of MGSV but also set MaDe as a strong baseline.
authors: Zijie Xin, Minquan Wang, Jingyu Liu, Quan Chen, Ye Ma, Peng Jiang, Xirong Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22285-22293

title: 基于分层运动建模的音乐对齐整体三维舞蹈生成
title_en: Music-Aligned Holistic 3D Dance Generation via Hierarchical Motion Modeling
abstract: 协调一致且音乐对齐的整体舞蹈能够增强情感表达力和观众参与度。然而,由于整体三维舞蹈数据集稀缺、音乐与舞蹈跨模态对齐难度大以及身体、手部和面部运动间依赖关系建模复杂,生成此类舞蹈仍面临挑战。为解决这些问题,我们引入SoulDance,一个通过专业动作捕捉系统采集的高精度音乐-舞蹈配对数据集,包含精心标注的整体舞蹈动作。基于此数据集,我们提出SoulNet框架,旨在生成音乐对齐、运动协调的整体三维舞蹈序列。SoulNet包含三个核心组件:(1) 分层残差向量量化,用于建模身体、手部和面部间的复杂细粒度运动依赖关系;(2) 音乐对齐生成模型,将这些分层运动单元组合为富有表现力且协调的整体舞蹈;(3) 音乐-运动检索模块,作为预训练的跨模态模型,充当音乐-舞蹈对齐先验,确保生成舞蹈与输入音乐在生成过程中的时间同步和语义一致性。大量实验表明,SoulNet在生成高质量、音乐协调且对齐的整体三维舞蹈序列方面显著超越现有方法。更多资源请访问我们的项目页面:https://xjli360.github.io/SoulDance
abstract_en: Well-coordinated, music-aligned holistic dance enhances emotional expressiveness and audience engagement. However, generating such dances remains challenging due to the scarcity of holistic 3D dance datasets, the difficulty of achieving cross-modal alignment between music and dance, and the complexity of modeling interdependent motion across the body, hands, and face. To address these challenges, we introduce SoulDance, a high-precision music-dance paired dataset captured via professional motion capture systems, featuring meticulously annotated holistic dance movements. Building on this dataset, we propose SoulNet, a framework designed to generate music-aligned, kinematically coordinated holistic dance sequences. SoulNet consists of three principal components: (1) Hierarchical Residual Vector Quantization, which models complex, fine-grained motion dependencies across the body, hands, and face; (2) Music-Aligned Generative Model, which composes these hierarchical motion units into expressive and coordinated holistic dance; (3) Music-Motion Retrieval Module, a pre-trained cross-modal model that functions as a music-dance alignment prior, ensuring temporal synchronization and semantic coherence between generated dance and input music throughout the generation process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SoulNet significantly surpasses existing approaches in generating high-quality, music-coordinated, and well-aligned holistic 3D dance sequences. Additional resources are available on our project: https://xjli360.github.io/SoulDance
authors: Xiaojie Li, Ronghui Li, Shukai Fang, Shuzhao Xie, Xiaoyang Guo, Jiaqing Zhou, Junkun Peng, Zhi Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14420-14430

title: NAPPure: 非加性扰动下鲁棒图像分类的对抗净化方法
title_en: NAPPure: Adversarial Purification for Robust Image Classification under Non-Additive Perturbations
abstract: 对抗净化在对抗图像扰动的防御中取得了显著成效,这类扰动通常被假设为加性扰动。然而,模糊、遮挡和失真等非加性对抗扰动在现实世界中同样常见。在这些扰动下,现有对抗净化方法效果大打折扣,因为它们的设计基于加性扰动特性。本文提出了一种扩展的对抗净化框架NAPPure,可进一步处理非加性扰动。具体而言,我们首先建立对抗图像的生成过程,然后通过似然最大化分离底层干净图像与扰动参数。在GTSRB和CIFAR-10数据集上的实验表明,NAPPure显著提升了图像分类模型对非加性扰动的鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Adversarial purification has achieved great success in combating adversarial image perturbations, which are usually assumed to be additive. However, non-additive adversarial perturbations such as blur, occlusion, and distortion are also common in the real world. Under such perturbations, existing adversarial purification methods are much less effective since they are designed to fit the additive nature. In this paper, we propose an extended adversarial purification framework named NAPPure, which can further handle non-additive perturbations. Specifically, we first establish the generation process of an adversarial image, and then disentangle the underlying clean image and perturbation parameters through likelihood maximization. Experiments on GTSRB and CIFAR-10 datasets show that NAPPure significantly boosts the robustness of image classification models against non-additive perturbations.
authors: Junjie Nan, Jianing Li, Wei Chen, Mingkun Zhang, Xueqi Cheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2260-2269

title: NATRA:一种噪声无关的轨迹预测框架,适用于噪声观测
title_en: NATRA: Noise-Agnostic Framework for Trajectory Prediction with Noisy Observations
abstract: 轨迹预测旨在基于主体的历史观测轨迹预测其未来轨迹,这对于自动驾驶、机器人和监控系统等应用至关重要。大多数现有轨迹预测方法假设用于预测的观测轨迹是干净的。然而,在现实场景中,噪声不可避免地引入到观测中,导致现有方法失效。因此,基于噪声观测进行鲁棒轨迹预测是更实际的场景。本文提出**NATRA**,一种**N**oise-**A**gnostic框架,能够处理任意类型的噪声观测下的**TRA**jectory预测问题。具体而言,我们提出了一种基于互信息的机制来去噪原始噪声观测。它优化生成的轨迹,使其呈现出与干净轨迹模式高度相似的模式,同时远离噪声模式。考虑到仅通过互信息优化可能破坏轨迹结构,我们引入额外的重建损失以保留生成观测轨迹的结构信息。此外,我们进一步提出排序损失以进一步提升性能。由于NATRA不依赖于针对特定噪声分布设计的特定模块,因此原则上可以处理任意类型的噪声。此外,我们提出的NATRA可以轻松集成到现有轨迹预测模型中。在合成和真实世界噪声数据集上的大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Trajectory prediction aims to forecast an agent's future trajectories based on its historical observed trajectories, which is a critical task for various applications such as autonomous driving, robotics, and surveillance systems. Most existing trajectory prediction methods assume that the observed trajectories collected for forecasting are clean. However, in real-world scenarios, noise is inevitably introduced into the observations, resulting in the collapse of the existing approaches. Therefore, it is essential to perform robust trajectory prediction based on noisy observations, which is a more practical scenario. In this paper, we propose **NATRA**, a **N**oise-**A**gnostic framework capable of tackling the problem of **TRA**jectory prediction with arbitrary types of noisy observations. Specifically, we put forward a mutual information-based mechanism to denoise the original noisy observations. It optimizes the produced trajectories to exhibit a pattern that closely resembles the clean trajectory pattern while deviating from the noisy one.Considering that the trajectory structure may be destroyed through the only optimization of mutual information, we introduce an additional reconstruction loss to preserve the structure information of the produced observed trajectories. Moreover, we further propose a ranking loss to further enhance the performance. Because NATRA does not rely on any specific module tailored to particular noise distributions, it can handle arbitrary types of noise in principle. Additionally, our proposed NATRA can be easily integrated into existing trajectory prediction models. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world noisy datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
authors: Rongqing Li, Changsheng Li, Ruilin Lv, Yuhang Li, Yang Gao, Xiaolu Zhang, Jun Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27872-27884

title: NAVER: 一种具有显式逻辑推理的神经符号组合自动机用于视觉定位
title_en: NAVER: A Neuro-Symbolic Compositional Automaton for Visual Grounding with Explicit Logic Reasoning
abstract: 视觉定位(VG)任务,如指称表达检测和分割任务,对于将视觉实体与上下文联系起来至关重要,尤其是在需要详细查询解释的复杂推理任务中。本文探讨了超越基础感知的视觉定位(VG)任务,强调了需要推理的方法(如人类认知)所面临的挑战。近年来,大语言模型方法(LLMs)和视觉-语言方法(VLMs)的进步提高了视觉理解、上下文理解和推理能力。这些方法主要分为端到端方法和组合方法,后者提供了更大的灵活性。整合LLMs和基础模型的组合方法表现出有前景的性能,但仍难以处理基于语言的逻辑表示的复杂推理。为了解决这些局限性,我们提出了NAVER,一种整合显式概率逻辑推理的组合视觉定位方法,其内置有限状态自动机并配备自纠正机制。这种设计通过显式逻辑推理提高了推理的鲁棒性和可解释性。我们的结果表明,NAVER在与近期端到端和组合基线方法的比较中实现了最先进的性能。代码可在https://github.com/ControlNet/NAVER获取。
abstract_en: Visual Grounding (VG) tasks, such as referring expression detection and segmentation tasks are important for linking visual entities to context, especially in complex reasoning tasks that require detailed query interpretation. This paper explores VG beyond basic perception, highlighting challenges for methods that require reasoning like human cognition. Recent advances in large language methods (LLMs) and Vision-Language methods (VLMs) have improved abilities for visual comprehension, contextual understanding, and reasoning. These methods are mainly split into end-to-end and compositional methods, with the latter offering more flexibility. Compositional approaches that integrate LLMs and foundation models show promising performance but still struggle with complex reasoning with language-based logical representations. To address these limitations, we propose NAVER, a compositional visual grounding method that integrates explicit probabilistic logic reasoning within a finite-state automaton, equipped with a self-correcting mechanism. This design improves robustness and interpretability in inference through explicit logic reasoning. Our results show that NAVER achieves SoTA performance comparing to recent end-to-end and compositional baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/ControlNet/NAVER.
authors: Zhixi Cai, Fucai Ke, Simindokht Jahangard, Maria Garcia de la Banda, Reza Haffari, Peter J. Stuckey, Hamid Rezatofighi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24078-24089

title: NETracer:一种拓扑感知的迭代追踪方法用于管状结构提取
title_en: NETracer: A Topology-Aware Iterative Tracing Approach for Tubular Structure Extraction
abstract: 从图像中提取管状结构是计算机视觉中广泛且具有挑战性的任务。为了探索这些连续结构,迭代追踪方法提供了一种有前景的方向。然而,在密集且模糊的分支场景中,现有追踪方法在追踪过程中容易跳转到相邻分支,导致显著的拓扑错误。这一缺陷的原因在于,追踪模型仅关注离散节点的估计,而忽略了它们的连接属性。为了解决这一问题,我们引入了NETracer,一种拓扑感知的迭代追踪方法,以提高连续性和拓扑准确性。在我们的方法中,一个带有局部连接损失的节点-边估计网络被训练以生成未来的节点及其连接边。随后,借助预测的边线索,采用基于测地距离的搜索策略,以更准确地追踪未来的分支。此外,为了全面评估追踪模型的效果,提出了一种新的追踪度量标准,用于评估追踪分支的局部准确性、连续性和拓扑正确性。我们证明了所提出的方法在五个2D道路、血管和3D神经元数据集上优于现有的分割和追踪方法。
abstract_en: Extracting tubular structures from images is a widespread and challenging task in computer vision. To explore these continuous structures, iterative tracing methods offer a promising direction. However, in scenes with dense and blurred branches, existing tracing methods tend to jump to adjacent branches during tracing process, leading a significant topological mistake. The reason of this shortcoming is that the tracing model only focuses on the estimation of discrete nodes and ignores their connection attribution. To solve this problem, we introduce NETracer, a topology-aware iterative tracing method to improve the continuity and topological accuracy. In our approach, a node-edge estimation network with local connectivity loss is trained to produce the future nodes and their connective edges. Then, a geodesic distance-based search strategy is employed with the help of predicted edge cues to trace the future branches more accurately. Additionally, to comprehensively assess the effect of the tracing model, an new tracing metric is proposed to evaluate the local accuracy, continuity, and topological correctness of the traced branches. We demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms existing segmentation and tracing methods on five 2D road, vessel and 3D neuron datasets.
authors: Chao Liu, Yangbo Jiang, Nenggan Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20593-20602

title: NGD:基于神经梯度的单目服装重建方法
title_en: NGD: Neural Gradient Based Deformation for Monocular Garment Reconstruction
abstract: 从单目视频中进行动态服装重建是一项重要但具有挑战性的任务,由于服装的复杂动态和无约束特性。近年来,神经渲染领域的进展使得在图像/视频监督下实现高质量的几何重建成为可能。然而,使用体积渲染的隐式表示方法通常能提供平滑的几何结构,但无法建模高频细节。尽管模板重建方法建模显式几何,但它们使用顶点位移进行变形,导致伪影的产生。针对上述局限性,我们提出NGD,一种基于神经梯度的变形方法,用于从单目视频中重建动态演变的纹理服装。此外,我们提出了一种新颖的自适应重网格化策略,用于建模如裙摆褶皱和褶裥等动态演变的表面,从而实现高质量的重建。最后,我们学习动态纹理图以捕捉每帧的光照和阴影效果。我们提供了广泛的定性和定量评估,以证明与现有最先进的方法相比有显著改进,并实现高质量的服装重建。
abstract_en: Dynamic garment reconstruction from monocular video is an important yet challenging task due to the complex dynamics and unconstrained nature of the garments. Recent advancements in neural rendering have enabled high-quality geometric reconstruction with image/video supervision. However, implicit representation methods that use volume rendering often provide smooth geometry and fail to model high-frequency details. While template reconstruction methods model explicit geometry, they use vertex displacement for deformation which results in artifacts. Addressing these limitations, we propose NGD, a Neural Gradient-based Deformation method to reconstruct dynamically evolving textured garments from monocular videos. Additionally, we propose a novel adaptive remeshing strategy for modeling dynamically evolving surfaces like wrinkles and pleats of the skirt, leading to high-quality reconstruction. Finally, we learn dynamic texture maps to capture per-frame lighting and shadow effects. We provide extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations to demonstrate significant improvements over existing SOTA methods and provide high-quality garment reconstructions.
authors: Soham Dasgupta, Shanthika Naik, Preet Savalia, Sujay Kumar Ingle, Avinash Sharma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25485-25495

title: Nautilus:面向可扩展网格生成的局部感知自编码器
title_en: Nautilus: Locality-aware Autoencoder for Scalable Mesh Generation
abstract: 三角网格是三维应用的基础。当前自动网格生成方法通常依赖于缺乏网格固有连续表面质量的中间表示。将这些表示转换为网格会产生密集但次优的输出。尽管近期自回归方法在直接建模网格顶点和面方面展现出前景,但受限于面数量、可扩展性和结构保真度的不足。为解决这些挑战,我们提出Nautilus,一种面向艺术家风格网格生成的局部感知自编码器,通过利用流形网格的局部特性实现结构保真度和高效表示。我们的方法引入了一种新颖的标记化算法,通过局部共享顶点和边压缩序列长度,保留面邻近关系,从而生成高达5000个面的前所未有的大规模网格。此外,我们开发了双流点条件器,捕捉细粒度几何信息,确保全局一致性和局部结构保真度。实验表明,Nautilus在生成质量上显著优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Triangle meshes are fundamental to 3D applications. Current automatic mesh generation methods typically rely on intermediate representations that lack the continuous surface quality inherent to meshes. Converting these representations into meshes produces dense, suboptimal outputs. Although recent autoregressive approaches demonstrate promise in directly modeling mesh vertices and faces, they are constrained by the limitation in face count, scalability, and structural fidelity.To address these challenges, we propose Nautilus, a locality-aware autoencoder for artist-like mesh generation that leverages the local properties of manifold meshes to achieve structural fidelity and efficient representation. Our approach introduces a novel tokenization algorithm that preserves face proximity relationships and compresses sequence length through locally shared vertices and edges, enabling the generation of meshes with an unprecedented scale of up to 5,000 faces. Furthermore, we develop a Dual-stream Point Conditioner that captures fine-grained geometry, ensuring global consistency and local structural fidelity. Our experiments demonstrate that Nautilus significantly outperforms existing methods in generation quality.
authors: Yuxuan Wang, Xuanyu Yi, Haohan Weng, Qingshan Xu, Xiaokang Wei, Xianghui Yang, Chunchao Guo, Long Chen, Hanwang Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10961-10970

title: NavMorph:一种用于连续环境中的视觉-语言导航的自进化世界模型
title_en: NavMorph: A Self-Evolving World Model for Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
abstract: 在连续环境中的视觉-语言导航(VLN-CE)要求智能体在自然语言指令引导的复杂环境中执行序列化导航动作。当前方法在泛化到新环境和适应导航过程中的持续变化方面存在困难。受人类认知启发,我们提出了NavMorph,一种用于提升VLN-CE任务中环境理解和决策能力的自进化世界模型框架。NavMorph采用紧凑的潜在表示建模环境动态,使智能体具备前瞻性以实现自适应规划和策略优化。通过集成一种新颖的上下文演化记忆模块,NavMorph利用场景上下文信息支持高效导航,同时保持在线适应性。大量实验表明,我们的方法在主流的VLN-CE基准测试中实现了显著的性能提升。代码可在补充材料中找到。
abstract_en: Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires agents to execute sequential navigation actions in complex environments guided by natural language instructions. Current approaches often struggle with generalizing to novel environments and adapting to ongoing changes during navigation. Inspired by human cognition, we present NavMorph, a self-evolving world model framework that enhances environmental understanding and decision-making in VLN-CE tasks. NavMorph employs compact latent representations to model environmental dynamics, equipping agents with foresight for adaptive planning and policy refinement. By integrating a novel Contextual Evolution Memory, NavMorph leverages scene-contextual information to support effective navigation while maintaining online adaptability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves notable performance improvements on popular VLN-CE benchmarks. Code is available in the Supplementary Material.
authors: Xuan Yao, Junyu Gao, Changsheng Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5536-5546

title: NavQ:面向前瞻性视觉-语言导航的Q模型学习
title_en: NavQ: Learning a Q-Model for Foresighted Vision-and-Language Navigation
abstract: 本文专注于目标导向的视觉-语言导航(VLN)任务。现有方法通常基于历史信息进行决策,忽视了行动的未来影响和长期结果。相反,我们旨在开发一个具有前瞻性的智能体。具体而言,我们借鉴Q学习,利用大规模未标记的轨迹数据训练Q模型,以学习室内场景中布局和物体关系的通用知识。该模型可以为每个候选动作生成一个Q特征,类似于传统Q网络中的Q值,该特征描述了执行特定动作后可能观察到的潜在未来信息。随后,跨模态未来编码器将任务无关的Q特征与导航指令结合,生成一组反映未来前景的动作得分。这些得分与基于历史的原始得分结合后,有助于采用A*风格的搜索策略,有效探索更可能通往目标的区域。在广泛使用的面向目标的VLN数据集上进行的大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性。
abstract_en: In this work we concentrate on the task of goal-oriented Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN). Existing methods often make decisions based on historical information, overlooking the future implications and long-term outcomes of the actions. In contrast, we aim to develop a foresighted agent. Specifically, we draw upon Q-learning to train a Q-model using large-scale unlabeled trajectory data, in order to learn the general knowledge regarding the layout and object relations within indoor scenes. This model can generate a Q-feature, analogous to the Q-value in traditional Q-network, for each candidate action, which describes the potential future information that may be observed after taking the specific action. Subsequently, a cross-modal future encoder integrates the task-agnostic Q-feature with navigation instructions to produce a set of action scores reflecting future prospects. These scores, when combined with the original scores based on history, facilitate an A*-style searching strategy to effectively explore the regions that are more likely to lead to the destination. Extensive experiments conducted on widely used goal-oriented VLN datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
authors: Peiran Xu, Xicheng Gong, Yadong Mu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6327-6341

title: NeRF是三维高斯点云的有价值的辅助工具
title_en: NeRF Is a Valuable Assistant for 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 我们提出NeRF-GS,一种联合优化神经辐射场(NeRF)和三维高斯点云(3DGS)的新型框架。该框架利用NeRF固有的连续空间表示,缓解3DGS的多个局限性,包括对高斯初始化的敏感性、空间感知能力有限以及高斯点间相关性弱等问题,从而提升其性能。在NeRF-GS中,我们重新审视3DGS的设计,并逐步将其空间特征与NeRF对齐,使两种表示方式通过共享的三维空间信息在同一场景中进行联合优化。我们进一步通过优化隐式特征和高斯点位置的残差向量,解决两种方法的正式差异,以增强3DGS的个性化能力。在基准数据集上的实验结果表明,NeRF-GS超越了现有方法,取得了最先进的性能。这一结果证实了NeRF和3DGS是互补而非竞争的关系,为结合3DGS和NeRF的混合方法提供了新的思路,以实现高效的三维场景表示。
abstract_en: We introduce NeRF-GS, a novel framework that jointly optimizes Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). This framework leverages the inherent continuous spatial representation of NeRF to mitigate several limitations of 3DGS, including sensitivity to Gaussian initialization, limited spatial awareness, and weak inter-Gaussian correlations, thereby enhancing its performance. In NeRF-GS, we revisit the design of 3DGS and progressively align its spatial features with NeRF, enabling both representations to be optimized within the same scene through shared 3D spatial information. We further address the formal distinctions between the two approaches by optimizing residual vectors for both implicit features and Gaussian positions to enhance the personalized capabilities of 3DGS. Experimental results on benchmark datasets show that NeRF-GS surpasses existing methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance. This outcome confirms that NeRF and 3DGS are complementary rather than competing, offering new insights into hybrid approaches that combine 3DGS and NeRF for efficient 3D scene representation.
authors: Shuangkang Fang, I-Chao Shen, Takeo Igarashi, Yufeng Wang, ZeSheng Wang, Yi Yang, Wenrui Ding, Shuchang Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26230-26240

title: NegRefine:基于负标签的零样本OOD检测优化方法
title_en: NegRefine: Refining Negative Label-Based Zero-Shot OOD Detection
abstract: 近年来,视觉-语言模型(如CLIP)的进步使得通过结合图像和文本标签信息实现零样本OOD检测成为可能。其中,基于负标签的方法(如NegLabel和CSP)通过利用词汇表定义负标签以区分OOD样本,展现出 promising results。然而,这些方法由于负标签可能为分布内标签的子类别或专有名词,导致误将分布内样本识别为OOD;同时在处理同时匹配多个分布内和负标签的图像时也存在局限性。我们提出NegRefine,一种针对零样本OOD检测的新型负标签优化框架。通过引入过滤机制排除负标签集中的子类别标签和专有名词,并结合多匹配感知评分函数动态调整图像匹配多个标签的贡献,NegRefine实现了分布内样本与OOD样本更 robust 的分离。我们在ImageNet-1K等大规模基准上进行评估,代码已开源:https://github.com/ah-ansari/NegRefine
abstract_en: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models like CLIP have enabled zero-shot OOD detection by leveraging both image and textual label information. Among these, negative label-based methods such as NegLabel and CSP have shown promising results by utilizing a lexicon of words to define negative labels for distinguishing OOD samples. However, these methods suffer from detecting in-distribution samples as OOD due to negative labels that are subcategories of in-distribution labels or proper nouns. They also face limitations in handling images that match multiple in-distribution and negative labels. We propose NegRefine, a novel negative label refinement framework for zero-shot OOD detection. By introducing a filtering mechanism to exclude subcategory labels and proper nouns from the negative label set and incorporating a multi-matching-aware scoring function that dynamically adjusts the contributions of multiple labels matching an image, NegRefine ensures a more robust separation between in-distribution and OOD samples. We evaluate NegRefine on large-scale benchmarks, including ImageNet-1K. The code is available at https://github.com/ah-ansari/NegRefine.
authors: Amirhossein Ansari, Ke Wang, Pulei Xiong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 573-582

title: 邻近自回归建模:高效视觉生成的方法
title_en: Neighboring Autoregressive Modeling for Efficient Visual Generation
abstract: 视觉自回归模型通常遵循栅格顺序的"下一个标记预测"范式,忽略了视觉内容中固有的空间和时间局部性。具体而言,视觉标记与其空间或时间邻近标记的相关性显著强于远距离标记。本文提出邻近自回归建模(NAR),一种新颖范式,将自回归视觉生成建模为渐进式外扩过程,遵循近到远的"下一个邻近标记预测"机制。从初始标记出发,剩余标记按其在时空空间中与初始标记的曼哈顿距离升序解码,逐步扩展解码区域边界。为实现时空空间中多个邻近标记的并行预测,我们引入一组维度导向的解码头,每个解码头沿相互正交的维度预测下一个标记。推理过程中,所有与已解码标记相邻的标记均可并行处理,显著减少生成所需的模型前向步骤。在ImageNet 256x256和UCF101数据集上的实验表明,NAR分别实现2.4倍和8.6倍的吞吐量提升,同时在图像和视频生成任务中,其FID/FVD分数均优于PAR-4X方法。在文本到图像生成基准GenEval评估中,参数量为0.8B的NAR模型在仅使用PAR-4X训练数据的0.4%时,性能超越Chameleon-7B。
abstract_en: Visual autoregressive models typically adhere to a raster-order "next-token prediction" paradigm, which overlooks the spatial and temporal locality inherent in visual content. Specifically, visual tokens exhibit significantly stronger correlations with their spatially or temporally adjacent tokens compared to those that are distant. In this paper, we propose Neighboring Autoregressive Modeling (NAR), a novel paradigm that formulates autoregressive visual generation as a progressive outpainting procedure, following a near-to-far "next-neighbor prediction" mechanism. Starting from an initial token, the remaining tokens are decoded in ascending order of their Manhattan distance from the initial token in the spatial-temporal space, progressively expanding the boundary of the decoded region. To enable parallel prediction of multiple adjacent tokens in the spatial-temporal space, we introduce a set of dimension-oriented decoding heads, each predicting the next token along a mutually orthogonal dimension. During inference, all tokens adjacent to the decoded tokens are processed in parallel, substantially reducing the model forward steps for generation. Experiments on ImageNet 256x256 and UCF101 demonstrate that NAR achieves 2.4x and 8.6x higher throughput respectively, while obtaining superior FID/FVD scores for both image and video generation tasks compared to the PAR-4X approach. When evaluating on text-to-image generation benchmark GenEval, NAR with 0.8B parameters outperforms Chameleon-7B while using merely 0.4% of the training data.
authors: Yefei He, Yuanyu He, Shaoxuan He, Feng Chen, Hong Zhou, Kaipeng Zhang, Bohan Zhuang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19000-19010

title: NeuFrameQ:基于神经框架场的可扩展且可泛化的各向异性四边形化方法
title_en: NeuFrameQ: Neural Frame Fields for Scalable and Generalizable Anisotropic Quadrangulation
abstract: 四边形网格在计算机图形学应用中起着关键作用,但自动生成高质量四边形网格仍面临挑战。传统四边形化方法依赖局部几何特征和手动约束,常产生次优的网格布局,难以捕捉全局形状语义。我们提出NeuFrameQ,一种基于学习的框架,通过框架场预测实现可扩展且可泛化的网格四边形化。我们首先构建包含多种形状的高质量四边形网格大规模数据集,作为领域知识的先验。借助该数据集,我们采用不依赖连通性的学习方法,在带有法线的点云上进行操作,实现对复杂几何的鲁棒处理。通过将框架场预测分解为方向回归和幅度估计任务,我们有效处理框架场估计中的病态问题。同时在两项任务中采用多向量表示和注意力机制,以应对框架场表示的固有歧义。大量实验表明,NeuFrameQ生成的四边形网格在语义对齐方面表现优异,尤其适用于源自神经场的几何结构。我们的方法显著推动了自动四边形网格生成的技术发展,弥合了神经内容创作与生产就绪几何资产之间的差距。
abstract_en: Quad meshes play a crucial role in computer graphics applications, yet automatically generating high-quality quad meshes remains challenging. Traditional quadrangulation approaches rely on local geometric features and manual constraints, often producing suboptimal mesh layouts that fail to capture global shape semantics. We introduce NeuFrameQ, a novel learning-based framework for scalable and generalizable mesh quadrangulation via frame field prediction. We first create a large-scale dataset of high-quality quad meshes with various shapes to serve as priors of domain knowledge. Empowered by this dataset, we employ a connectivity-agnostic learning approach that operates on point clouds with normals, enabling robust processing of complex geometries. By decomposing frame field prediction into direction regression and magnitude estimation tasks, we effectively handle the ill-posed nature in frame field estimation. We also employ the polyvector representation and attention mechanism in both tasks to handle the inherent ambiguities in frame field representation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NeuFrameQ produces high-quality quad meshes with superior semantic alignment, also for geometries derived from neural fields. Our method significantly advances the state of the art in automatic quad mesh generation, bridging the gap between neural content creation and production-ready geometric assets.
authors: Ying-Tian Liu, Jiajun Li, Yu-Tao Liu, Xin Yu, Yuan-Chen Guo, Yan-Pei Cao, Ding Liang, Ariel Shamir, Song-Hai Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28000-28009

title: NeurOp-Diff: 通过神经算子扩散实现连续遥感图像超分辨率
title_en: NeurOp-Diff: Continuous Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution via Neural Operator Diffusion
abstract: 大多数公开获取的遥感数据存在分辨率低的问题,限制了其实际应用。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种由神经算子(NO)引导的扩散模型(NeurOp-Diff),用于连续遥感图像超分辨率。神经算子用于学习任意尺度的分辨率表征,将低分辨率(LR)图像编码为高维特征,这些特征作为先验条件引导扩散模型进行去噪。这有效解决了现有超分辨率(SR)方法中存在的伪影和过度平滑问题,能够生成高质量的连续超分辨率图像。具体而言,我们通过缩放因子(s)调整超分辨率尺度,使模型能够适应不同的超分辨率倍率。此外,多个数据集上的实验验证了NeurOp-Diff的有效性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/zerono000/NeurOp-Diff获取。
abstract_en: Most publicly accessible remote sensing data suffer from low resolution, limiting their practical applications. To address this, we propose a diffusion model guided by neural operators (NO) for continuous remote sensing image super-resolution (NeurOp-Diff). Neural operators are used to learn resolution representations at arbitrary scales, encoding low-resolution (LR) images into high-dimensional features, which are then used as prior conditions to guide the diffusion model for denoising. This effectively addresses the artifacts and excessive smoothing issues present in existing super-resolution (SR) methods, enabling the generation of high-quality, continuous super-resolution images. Specifically, we adjust the super-resolution scale by a scaling factor (s), allowing the model to adapt to different super-resolution magnifications. Furthermore, experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of NeurOp-Diff. Our code is available at https://github.com/zerono000/NeurOp-Diff.
authors: Zihao Xu, Yuzhi Tang, Bowen Xu, Qingquan Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12491-12501

title: NeuraLeaf: 基于形状与形变解耦的神经参数化叶片模型
title_en: NeuraLeaf: Neural Parametric Leaf Models with Shape and Deformation Disentanglement
abstract: 我们开发了一种神经参数化模型,用于3D植物叶片的建模与重建,这对于农业和计算机图形学中的植物建模至关重要。尽管参数化建模在人体和动物形状建模中已得到广泛研究,但植物叶片由于其形状多样性及柔性形变特性,使得常规方法难以适用。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种基于学习的参数化模型NeuraLeaf,将叶片的几何形状解耦为2D基础形状与3D形变。由于基础形状代表扁平化的2D叶片,这使得可以从丰富的2D叶片图像数据集中进行学习,同时具备与几何形状对齐的纹理学习优势。为建模3D形变,我们提出了一种新颖的无骨骼皮肤模型,并引入了一个名为DeformLeaf的新采集3D叶片数据集。我们通过将样本级的皮肤参数转换为紧凑的潜在表示,建立了参数化形变空间,从而实现叶片形变的灵活高效建模。实验表明,NeuraLeaf能够成功生成多种具有形变的叶片形状,实现对深度图和点云等3D观测数据的精确模型拟合。我们的实现与数据集将在论文被接受后发布。
abstract_en: We develop a neural parametric model for 3D plant leaves for modeling and reconstruction of plants that are essential for agriculture and computer graphics. While parametric modeling has been actively studied for human and animal shapes, plant leaves present unique challenges due to their diverse shapes and flexible deformation, making common approaches inapplicable. To this problem, we introduce a learning-based parametric model, NeuraLeaf, disentangling the leaves' geometry into their 2D base shapes and 3D deformations. Since the base shapes represent flattened 2D leaves, it allows learning from rich sources of 2D leaf image datasets, and also has the advantage of simultaneously learning texture aligned with the geometry. To model the 3D deformation, we propose a novel skeleton-free skinning model and a newly captured 3D leaf dataset called DeformLeaf. We establish a parametric deformation space by converting the sample-wise skinning parameters into a compact latent representation, allowing for flexible and efficient modeling of leaf deformations. We show that NeuraLeaf successfully generates a wide range of leaf shapes with deformation, resulting in accurate model fitting to 3D observations like depth maps and point clouds. Our implementation and datasets will be released upon acceptance.
authors: Yang Yang, Dongni Mao, Hiroaki Santo, Yasuyuki Matsushita, Fumio Okura ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28167-28176

title: 基于局部引导扩散的神经网络架构搜索驱动个性化联邦学习
title_en: Neural Architecture Search Driven by Locally Guided Diffusion for Personalized Federated Learning
abstract: 神经网络架构搜索(NAS)因其能够自动为每个客户端设计定制模型,在个性化联邦学习(PFL)中受到广泛关注。尽管现有大多数PFL NAS方法在服务器端进行架构搜索,但客户端侧NAS--通过在客户端本地优化架构--通过消除传输敏感模型信息的需要,提供了更强的隐私保护。然而,这一范式仍处于探索阶段,通常面临平均客户端性能次优的问题,主要由于两个限制:(1) 由于数据隔离和客户端间局部架构访问受限导致的客户端侧搜索策略低效;(2) 由于服务器聚合和本地超网训练导致的超网收敛缓慢。为解决这些挑战,我们提出了一种基于个性化联邦随机微分方程的NAS方法(PerFedSDE-NAS)。为实现有效的本地搜索,每个客户端采用引导扩散模型生成适应本地数据特征的有前景个性化架构,同时基于径向基函数的性能预测器用于仅评估最有前景的架构子集。为加速超网收敛,每个客户端维护一个具有档案驱动训练机制的超网,并提出了一种新颖的模型聚合策略以进一步增强FL轮次中的权重收敛。我们在包括卷积神经网络和变换器在内的三个NAS搜索空间中验证了PerFedSDE-NAS,证明了其广泛适用性。与传统固定模型和基于NAS的PFL方法相比,我们的方法实现了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has gained significant attention in personalized federated learning (PFL) due to its ability to automatically design tailored models for individual clients. While most existing NAS approaches for PFL perform architecture search on the server side, client-side NAS--where architectures are optimized locally on clients--offers stronger privacy protection by eliminating the need to transmit sensitive model information. However, this paradigm remains underexplored and often suffers from suboptimal average client performance, primarily due to two limitations: (1) Inefficient client-side search strategies caused by data isolation and restricted access to local architectures across clients, and (2) slow supernet convergence arising from server aggregation and local supernet training. To address these challenges, we propose a Personalized Federated Stochastic Differential Equation-based NAS (PerFedSDE-NAS). To achieve effective local search, each client employs a guided diffusion model to generate promising personalized architectures tailored to local data characteristics, while a performance predictor based on radial basis functions is used to select only the most promising subset of architectures for evaluation. To accelerate supernet convergence, each client maintains a supernet with an archive-driven training mechanism, and a novel model aggregation strategy is proposed to further enhance weight convergence during FL rounds. We validate PerFedSDE-NAS across three NAS search spaces, including convolutional neural networks and transformers, demonstrating its broad applicability. Compared to traditional fixed-model and NAS-based PFL approaches, our method achieves the state-of-the-art performance.
authors: Peng Liao, Xilu Wang, Yaochu Jin, Wenli Du, Han Hu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4222-4231

title: 三维几何集的神经压缩
title_en: Neural Compression for 3D Geometry Sets
abstract: 我们提出NeCGS,这是首个神经压缩范式,能够以高达900倍的压缩率,高精度地保留详细几何结构,压缩包含数千个详细且多样的三维网格模型的几何集。具体而言,我们首先提出TSDF-Def,一种新的隐式表示方法,能够将具有各种结构的不规则三维网格模型准确表示为统一且紧凑的规则4D张量,其中可通过可变形Marching Cubes算法提取三维表面。随后,我们构建了量化感知的自解码器网络架构,将这些4D张量回归以探索每个形状内部及不同形状间的局部几何相似性,从而去除冗余,得到更紧凑的表示,包括与每个三维模型相关联的更小尺寸嵌入特征以及所有模型共享的网络参数。最后,我们通过熵编码将得到的特征和网络参数编码为比特流。此外,我们的NeCGS能够良好处理动态场景,其中新的三维模型不断被添加到压缩集。大量实验和消融研究验证了我们的NeCGS在定量和定性方面均显著优于现有最先进方法。源代码可在https://github.com/rsy6318/NeCGS公开获取。
abstract_en: We present NeCGS, the first neural compression paradigm, which can compress a geometry set encompassing thousands of detailed and diverse 3D mesh models by up to 900 times with high accuracy and preservation of detailed geometric structures. Specifically, we first propose TSDF-Def, a new implicit representation that is capable of accurately representing irregular 3D mesh models with various structures into regular 4D tensors of uniform and compact size, where 3D surfaces can be extracted through the deformable marching cubes. Then we construct a quantization-aware auto-decoder network architecture to regress these 4D tensors to explore the local geometric similarity within each shape and across different shapes for redundancy removal, resulting in more compact representations, including an embedded feature of a smaller size associated with each 3D model and a network parameter shared by all models. We finally encode the resulting features and network parameters into bitstreams through entropy coding. Besides, our NeCGS can handle the dynamic scenario well, where new 3D models are constantly added to a compressed set. Extensive experiments and ablation studies demonstrate the significant advantages of our NeCGS over state-of-the-art methods both quantitatively and qualitatively. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/rsy6318/NeCGS.
authors: Siyu Ren, Junhui Hou, Weiyao Lin, Wenping Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25294-25304

title: 基于神经逆渲染的高精度运动物体三维测量方法及少相位移模式应用
title_en: Neural Inverse Rendering for High-Accuracy 3D Measurement of Moving Objects with Fewer Phase-Shifting Patterns
abstract: 在结构光方法中,相位移方法能够通过最少三个模式实现高分辨率和高精度测量。然而,当测量动态且形状复杂的物体时,其性能会受到显著影响,因运动伪影和相位不一致性会降低测量精度。本研究提出了一种增强型相位移方法,通过引入神经逆渲染技术实现运动物体的三维测量。为有效捕捉物体运动,我们在渲染模型中引入位移场,该模型能够准确表示位置变化并减轻运动引起的畸变。此外,为实现更少相位移模式下的高精度重建,我们设计了多视角渲染框架,该框架结合多个相机与单个投影仪协同工作。与现有先进方法的对比实验及多种消融研究验证表明,即使仅使用少量模式,我们的方法也能通过简单的已知相位移模式准确重建运动物体的形状。
abstract_en: Among structured-light methods, the phase-shifting approach enables high-resolution and high-accuracy measurements using a minimum of three patterns. However, its performance is significantly affected when dynamic and complex-shaped objects are measured, as motion artifacts and phase inconsistencies can degrade accuracy. In this study, we propose an enhanced phase-shifting method that incorporates neural inverse rendering to enable the 3D measurement of moving objects. To effectively capture object motion, we introduce a displacement field into the rendering model, which accurately represents positional changes and mitigates motion-induced distortions. Additionally, to achieve high-precision reconstruction with fewer phase-shifting patterns, we design a multiview-rendering framework that utilizes multiple cameras in conjunction with a single projector. Comparisons with state-of-the-art methods and various ablation studies demonstrated that our method accurately reconstructs the shapes of moving objects, even with a small number of patterns, using only simple, well-known phase-shifting patterns.
authors: Yuki Urakawa, Yoshihiro Watanabe ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27692-27701

title: 无需光度立体法提示的神经多视角自校准光度立体法
title_en: Neural Multi-View Self-Calibrated Photometric Stereo without Photometric Stereo Cues
abstract: 我们提出了一种神经逆渲染方法,通过多视角图像联合重建几何结构、空间变化反射率和光照条件,这些图像是在变化方向光照下捕获的。与需要光照校准或中间提示(如每视角法线图)的先前多视角光度立体方法不同,我们的方法在一个阶段内从原始图像中联合优化所有场景参数。我们将几何结构和反射率表示为神经隐式场,并应用阴影感知的体积渲染。一个空间网络首先预测每个场景点的符号距离和反射率潜在编码。随后,反射率网络根据潜在编码、角度编码的表面法线、视角和光照方向估计反射率值。所提出的方法在形状和光照估计精度上优于最先进的法线引导方法,能够泛化到视角不一致的多光源图像,并处理具有挑战性几何结构和反射率的对象。
abstract_en: We propose a neural inverse rendering approach that jointly reconstructs geometry, spatially varying reflectance, and lighting conditions from multi-view images captured under varying directional lighting. Unlike prior multi-view photometric stereo methods that require light calibration or intermediate cues such as per-view normal maps, our method jointly optimizes all scene parameters from raw images in a single stage. We represent both geometry and reflectance as neural implicit fields and apply shadow-aware volume rendering. A spatial network first predicts the signed distance and a reflectance latent code for each scene point. A reflectance network then estimates reflectance values conditioned on the latent code and angularly encoded surface normal, view, and light directions. The proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art normal-guided approaches in shape and lighting estimation accuracy, generalizes to view-unaligned multi-light images, and handles objects with challenging geometry and reflectance.
authors: Xu Cao, Takafumi Taketomi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27552-27562

title: 神经壳纹理点涂:更多细节与更少基础元素
title_en: Neural Shell Texture Splatting: More Details and Fewer Primitives
abstract: 高斯点涂技术在新视角合成中展现出有前景的结果,实现了高保真度和高效性。然而,其高质量重建以需要大量基础元素为代价。我们识别出这一问题源于高斯点涂中几何与外观的纠缠。为解决这一问题,我们引入了一种神经壳纹理,这是一种全局表示,用于编码表面周围的纹理信息。我们使用高斯基础元素作为几何表示和纹理场采样器,高效地将纹理特征溅射到图像空间。我们的评估表明,这种解耦能够实现高参数效率、精细纹理细节重建以及易于提取的纹理网格,同时使用显著更少的基础元素。
abstract_en: Gaussian splatting techniques have shown promising results in novel view synthesis, achieving high fidelity and efficiency. However, their high reconstruction quality comes at the cost of requiring a large number of primitives.
