We identify this issue as stemming from the entanglement of geometry and appearance in Gaussian Splatting. To address this, we introduce a neural shell texture, a global representation that encodes texture information around the surface. We use Gaussian primitives as both a geometric representation and texture field samplers, efficiently splatting texture features into image space. Our evaluation demonstrates that this disentanglement enables high parameter efficiency, fine texture detail reconstruction, and easy textured mesh extraction, all while using significantly fewer primitives.
authors: Xin Zhang, Anpei Chen, Jincheng Xiong, Pinxuan Dai, Yujun Shen, Weiwei Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25229-25238

title: 基于二色反射模型的神经求解器用于镜面高光去除
title_en: Neural Solver of Dichromatic Reflection Model for Specular Highlight Removal
abstract: 二色反射模型(DRM)作为一种广泛使用的物理图像形成模型,已被广泛应用于镜面高光去除任务。然而,传统DRM求解器难以有效恢复镜面高光下的缺失内容,并容易产生视觉伪影。此外,现有基于深度学习的方法未能充分挖掘DRM变量的完整集合。相反,它们通常学习将输入图像转换为漫反射图像(及镜面残差图像)。因此,其性能仍存在一定局限性。为克服这些限制,我们提出了一种用于镜面高光去除的神经DRM求解器。我们的流程包含三个网络:高光检测网络(HDNet)、Alpha-色估计网络(ACENet)和精炼网络(RNet)。具体而言,首先使用HDNet检测镜面高光。同时,在HDNet提供的多级上下文对比特征指导下,ACENet估计DRM变量。这些估计变量随后被用于重建模型生成无高光图像和镜面残差图像。最后,我们引入了一个无模型依赖的RNet对结果进行进一步优化。在现有数据集和我们收集的图像上的大量实验表明,我们的神经求解器优于先前方法。
abstract_en: The Dichromatic Reflection Model (DRM), a widely used physical image formation model, has been extensively applied to specular highlight removal. However, traditional DRM solvers fail to effectively recover the missing content underneath specular highlights and are prone to producing visual artifacts. Additionally, existing deep learning-based methods do not fully exploit the full set of the DRM variables. Instead, they typically learn to translate an input image into its diffuse image (and specular residue image). As a result, their performance remains somewhat limited. To overcome these limitations, we propose a neural DRM solver for specular highlight removal. Our pipeline consists of three networks: Highlight Detection Network (HDNet), Alpha-Chrom Estimation Network (ACENet), and Refinement Network (RNet). Specifically, HDNet is first used to detect specular highlights. Meanwhile, guided by multi-level contextual contrasted features from HDNet, ACENet estimates the DRM variables. These estimated variables are then used by our reconstruction models to generate the specular-free and specular residue images. Finally, we introduce RNet, a model-free network, to further refine the results. Extensive experiments on existing datasets and our collected images demonstrate that our neural solver is superior to previous methods.
authors: Gang Fu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7241-7250

title: NeuralSVG: 一种用于文本到向量生成的隐式表示方法
title_en: NeuralSVG: An Implicit Representation for Text-to-Vector Generation
abstract: 矢量图形在设计领域至关重要,为艺术家提供了创建独立于分辨率且高度可编辑的视觉内容的多功能媒介。近年来,视觉-语言模型和扩散模型的进展激发了对文本到矢量图形生成的兴趣。然而,现有方法常面临输出参数过多或将矢量图形的核心特征——分层结构视为次要目标的问题,削弱了其实际应用价值。鉴于分层SVG表示的重要性,我们提出NeuralSVG,一种用于从文本提示生成矢量图形的隐式神经表示方法。受神经辐射场(NeRFs)的启发,NeuralSVG将整个场景编码到一个小型MLP网络的权重中,并通过分数蒸馏采样(Score Distillation Sampling, SDS)进行优化。为鼓励生成SVG的分层结构,我们引入了一种基于丢弃的正则化技术,强化每个形状的独立意义。此外,我们还证明利用神经表示提供了推理阶段的控制优势,使用户能够根据提供的输入动态调整生成的SVG,所有操作均基于单一学习表示。通过广泛的定性与定量评估,我们证明NeuralSVG在生成结构化且灵活的SVG方面优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Vector graphics are essential in design, providing artists with a versatile medium for creating resolution-independent and highly editable visual content. Recent advancements in vision-language and diffusion models have fueled interest in text-to-vector graphics generation. However, existing approaches often suffer from over-parameterized outputs or treat the layered structure -- a core feature of vector graphics -- as a secondary goal, diminishing their practical use. Recognizing the importance of layered SVG representations, we propose NeuralSVG, an implicit neural representation for generating vector graphics from text prompts. Inspired by Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs), NeuralSVG encodes the entire scene into the weights of a small MLP network, optimized using Score Distillation Sampling (SDS). To encourage a layered structure in the generated SVG, we introduce a dropout-based regularization technique that strengthens the standalone meaning of each shape. We additionally demonstrate that utilizing a neural representation provides an added benefit of inference-time control, enabling users to dynamically adapt the generated SVG based on user-provided inputs, all with a single learned representation. Through extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations, we demonstrate that NeuralSVG outperforms existing methods in generating structured and flexible SVG.
authors: Sagi Polaczek, Yuval Alaluf, Elad Richardson, Yael Vinker, Daniel Cohen-Or ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15458-15468

title: 面向形状公平特征表示的神经流形正则化KANs
title_en: Neuromanifold-Regularized KANs for Shape-fair Feature Representations
abstract: 传统深度网络由于高表达性难以获得形状公平的表示。Kolmogorov-Arnold网络(KANs)作为候选因其直接学习非线性特性,使其更具适应性。然而,由于非约束非线性,KANs在形状公平性方面表现欠佳,这一局限性我们首次予以证明。另一方面,形状公平网络位于低阶神经流形上。受此启发,我们研究了KANs的神经流形正则化以实现形状公平特征表示。所提方法NeuroManifold Regularized-KANs是一种新型正则化方法,通过约束两个联合训练特征提取器的神经流形阶数,分别解决局部和全局形状线索获取过程中的失效模式。此外,我们提出了一种新型风格去相关损失,促进中间表示的去相关。实验表明,NMR-KAN在形状偏差上比基线卷积KANs提升14.8%,同时在图像损坏和对抗攻击下具有鲁棒性。代码可访问:http://www.github.com/kaptres/NMR-KAN
abstract_en: Traditional deep networks struggle to acquire shape-fair representations due to their high expressivity. Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) are promising candidates as they learn nonlinearities directly, a property that makes them more adaptive. However, KANs perform suboptimally in terms of shape-fairness because of unconstrained nonlinearities, a limitation we demonstrate for the first time. On the other hand, shape-fair networks reside on a neuromanifold of low-degree. Motivated by this, we investigate neuromanifold regularization of KANs to enable learning of shape-fair feature representations. The proposed method, NeuroManifold Regularized-KANs, is a novel regularization that addresses failure modes during the acquisition of local and global shape cues, separately. This is done by constraining the degree of the neuromanifolds of two jointly trained feature extractors. Additionally, we propose a novel Style Decorrelation Loss that promotes decorrelation of intermediate representations. Our experiments demonstrate that NMR-KAN improves shape bias over baseline convolutional KANs by 14.8% while also providing robustness under image corruptions and adversarial attacks. Code is avaliable at: http://www.github.com/kaptres/NMR-KAN
authors: Mazlum Ferhat Arslan, Weihong Guo, Shuo Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12790-12799

title: Neurons: 模拟人类视觉皮层提升fMRI到视频重建的保真度和可解释性
title_en: Neurons: Emulating the Human Visual Cortex Improves Fidelity and Interpretability in fMRI-to-Video Reconstruction
abstract: 从神经活动解码视觉刺激对于理解人脑至关重要。尽管fMRI方法已成功重建静态图像,但fMRI到视频重建面临挑战,因为需要捕捉运动和场景转换等时空动态。近期方法在语义和感知对齐方面有所改进,但难以将粗粒度fMRI数据与详细视觉特征整合。受视觉系统分层组织结构启发,我们提出NEURONS框架,将学习解耦为四个相关子任务:关键物体分割、概念识别、场景描述和模糊视频重建。该方法模拟视觉皮层的功能专业化,使模型能够捕捉多样化的视频内容。在推理阶段,NEURONS为预训练的文本到视频扩散模型生成鲁棒的条件信号以重建视频。大量实验表明,NEURONS优于现有最先进基线,在视频一致性(26.6%)和语义层面准确性(19.1%)方面取得显著提升。值得注意的是,NEURONS与视觉皮层表现出强功能相关性,凸显其在脑机接口和临床应用的潜力。代码和模型权重可在:https://github.com/xmed-lab/NEURONS 获取。
abstract_en: Decoding visual stimuli from neural activity is essential for understanding the human brain. While fMRI methods have successfully reconstructed static images, fMRI-tovideo reconstruction faces challenges due to the need for capturing spatiotemporal dynamics like motion and scene transitions. Recent approaches have improved semantic and perceptual alignment but struggle to integrate coarse fMRI data with detailed visual features. Inspired by the hierarchical organization of the visual system, we propose NEURONS, a novel framework that decouples learning into four correlated sub-tasks: key object segmentation, concept recognition, scene description, and blurry video reconstruction. This approach simulates the visual cortex's functional specialization, allowing the model to capture diverse video content. In the inference stage, NEURONS generates robust conditioning signals for a pre-trained textto-video diffusion model to reconstruct the videos. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NEURONS outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving solid improvements in video consistency (26.6%) and semantic-level accuracy (19.1%). Notably, NEURONS shows a strong functional correlation with the visual cortex, highlighting its potential for brain-computer interfaces and clinical applications. Code and model weights are available at: https://github.com/xmed-lab/NEURONS.
authors: Haonan Wang, Qixiang Zhang, Lehan Wang, Xuanqi Huang, Xiaomeng Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18367-18376

title: Neuroverse3D:面向三维神经影像学的上下文学习通用模型开发
title_en: Neuroverse3D: Developing In-Context Learning Universal Model for Neuroimaging in 3D
abstract: 上下文学习(ICL)作为一种通用模型,通过利用上下文中的任务特定指导,无需重新训练即可在广泛任务中表现出卓越的泛化能力,使其特别适用于神经影像学的复杂需求。然而,当前受限于2D输入的ICL模型因高内存需求而难以扩展至3D输入,导致性能欠佳。针对此问题,我们提出Neuroverse3D,一种能够处理三维神经影像任务(如分割、去噪、补全)的ICL模型。Neuroverse3D通过自适应并行-顺序上下文处理和U型融合策略,克服了三维输入带来的高内存消耗,可处理无限数量的上下文图像。此外,我们提出优化的损失函数以平衡多任务训练并增强对解剖边界的关注。本研究整合了19个神经影像学数据集的43,674个三维多模态扫描数据,并在14个多样化任务上使用保留测试集评估Neuroverse3D。结果表明,Neuroverse3D显著优于现有ICL模型,且接近任务特定模型,无需重新训练即可灵活适应医疗中心差异。代码和模型权重将公开发布。
abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL), a type of universal model, demonstrates exceptional generalization across a wide range of tasks without retraining by leveraging task-specific guidance from context, making it particularly effective for the intricate demands of neuroimaging. However, current ICL models, limited to 2D inputs and thus exhibiting suboptimal performance, struggle to extend to 3D inputs due to the high memory demands of ICL. In this regard, we introduce Neuroverse3D, an ICL model capable of performing multiple neuroimaging tasks in 3D (e.g., segmentation, denoising, inpainting). Neuroverse3D overcomes the large memory consumption associated with 3D inputs through adaptive parallel-sequential context processing and a U-shaped fusion strategy, allowing it to handle an unlimited number of context images. Additionally, we propose an optimized loss function to balance multi-task training and enhance focus on anatomical boundaries. Our study incorporates 43,674 3D multi-modal scans from 19 neuroimaging datasets and evaluates Neuroverse3D on 14 diverse tasks using held-out test sets. The results demonstrate that Neuroverse3D significantly outperforms existing ICL models and closely matches task-specific models, enabling flexible adaptation to medical center variations without retraining. The code and model weights will be made publicly available.
authors: Jiesi Hu, Hanyang Peng, Yanwu Yang, Xutao Guo, Yang Shang, Pengcheng Shi, Chenfei Ye, Ting Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21721-21731

title: 消除兄弟竞争:去偏见的人-物交互检测
title_en: No More Sibling Rivalry: Debiasing Human-Object Interaction Detection
abstract: 检测变压器已被应用于人-物交互(HOI)检测,提升了图像中人-动作-物体三元组的定位与识别能力。尽管取得了显著进展,本研究发现了一个关键问题——"有毒兄弟"偏见,该偏见阻碍了交互解码器的学习过程。由于大量相似但不同的HOI三元组在输入端和输出端均对交互解码器产生干扰甚至相互竞争,导致高混淆的兄弟三元组/类别间出现悖论性精度下降,即一方的提升以另一方的下降为代价。为解决这一问题,我们提出两个新颖的去偏见学习目标——"对比后校准"和"合并后分割",分别从输入和输出视角进行优化。前者通过强位置先验引导,采样类似但错误的HOI三元组并重构为正确三元组;后者首先学习兄弟类别间的共享特征以区分其他组别,随后显式优化组内差异以保持独特性。实验表明,我们在多种设置下均显著超越基线(在HICO-Det上提升9.18% mAP)和当前最优方法(提升3.59% mAP)。源代码将公开。
abstract_en: Detection transformers have been applied to human-object interaction (HOI) detection, enhancing the localization and recognition of human-action-object triplets in images. Despite remarkable progress, this study identifies a critical issue--"Toxic Siblings" bias--which hinders the interaction decoder's learning, as numerous similar yet distinct HOI triplets interfere with and even compete against each other both input side and output side to the interaction decoder. This bias arises from high confusion among sibling triplets/categories, where increased similarity paradoxically reduces precision, as one's gain comes at the expense of its toxic sibling's decline. To address this, we propose two novel debiasing learning objectives--"contrastive-then-calibration" and "merge-then-split"--targeting the input and output perspectives, respectively. The former samples sibling-like incorrect HOI triplets and reconstructs them into correct ones, guided by strong positional priors. The latter first learns shared features among sibling categories to distinguish them from other groups, then explicitly refines intra-group differentiation to preserve uniqueness. Experiments show that we significantly outperform both the baseline (+9.18% mAP on HICO-Det) and the state-of-the-art (+3.59% mAP) across various settings. The source code will be made public.
authors: Bin Yang, Yulin Zhang, Hong-Yu Zhou, Sibei Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22707-22717

title: 无需姿态的自监督稀疏视角3D高斯点云生成
title_en: No Pose at All: Self-Supervised Pose-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Views
abstract: 我们提出SPFSplat,一种高效的稀疏多视角图像3D高斯点云生成框架,训练和推理过程中均无需真实姿态信息。该框架采用共享特征提取主干网络,在单次前向传播步骤中,从无姿态输入中同时预测3D高斯基元和相机姿态的规范空间表示。除基于估计新视角姿态的渲染损失外,还集成重投影损失以强制学习像素对齐的高斯基元,增强几何约束。这种无姿态训练范式和高效的单步前向传播设计使SPFSplat适用于实际应用。值得注意的是,即使在缺乏姿态监督的情况下,SPFSplat在显著视角变化和有限图像重叠度下仍实现了新视角合成的最先进水平。它在相对姿态估计任务中也超越了近期基于几何先验训练的方法。代码和训练模型可在我们的项目页面获取:https://ranrhuang.github.io/spfsplat/
abstract_en: We introduce SPFSplat, an efficient framework for 3D Gaussian splatting from sparse multi-view images, requiring no ground-truth poses during training or inference. It employs a shared feature extraction backbone, enabling simultaneous prediction of 3D Gaussian primitives and camera poses in a canonical space from unposed inputs within a single feed-forward step. Alongside the rendering loss based on estimated novel-view poses, a reprojection loss is integrated to enforce the learning of pixel-aligned Gaussian primitives for enhanced geometric constraints. This pose-free training paradigm and efficient one-step feed-forward design make SPFSplat well-suited for practical applications. Remarkably, despite the absence of pose supervision, SPFSplat achieves state-of-the-art performance in novel view synthesis even under significant viewpoint changes and limited image overlap. It also surpasses recent methods trained with geometry priors in relative pose estimation. Code and trained models are available on our project page: https://ranrhuang.github.io/spfsplat/.
authors: Ranran Huang, Krystian Mikolajczyk ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27947-27957

title: 低光照尖峰图像恢复的噪声建模扩散模型
title_en: Noise-Modeled Diffusion Models for Low-Light Spike Image Restoration
abstract: 受人类视觉系统启发的基于尖峰的成像技术具有高时间分辨率和低功耗等优势,但在低光照条件下由于噪声干扰会导致显著的图像退化。在如此条件下恢复尖峰图像是一项重大挑战,因为传统基于帧或基于尖峰的技术难以处理严重噪声和独特的噪声特性。本文提出了一种基于噪声建模扩散模型的低光照尖峰图像恢复新方法。通过建立低光照下的噪声嵌入尖峰成像模型,我们将前向扩散过程建模为尖峰图像退化的比例项和残差项,并通过反向位移融合确定性和非确定性成分,使模型能够捕捉尖峰噪声结构的特征。此外,我们利用区域掩码图像、暗电流图和尖峰密度值作为条件,分别通过提供退化区域提示、确定性参数和噪声强度来进一步引导恢复过程。实验结果表明,我们的方法在定量性能和视觉质量上均显著优于现有的基于尖峰的重建方法和基于扩散的图像修复方法。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/BIT-Vision/SpikeDiffusion获取。
abstract_en: Spike-based imaging, inspired by the human visual system, offers several advantages, including high temporal resolution and low power consumption, but suffers from significant image degradation in low-light conditions due to noise interference. Restoring spike images under such conditions poses a significant challenge, as traditional frame-based or spike-based techniques are ill-suited to handle such severe noise and unique noise characteristics. This paper proposes a novel approach for restoring low-light spike images using noise-modeled diffusion models. By establishing a noise-embedded spike imaging model under low light, we model the forward diffusion process as the degradation of spike images with proportional and residual terms and incorporate deterministic and non-deterministic components with reverse shifting, enabling the model to capture the distinctive spike noise structure. Additionally, we utilize region mask image, dark current map and spike density value as conditions to further guide the restoration process by providing prompts for degradation regions, deterministic parameters and noise intensity, respectively. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing spike-based reconstruction and diffusion-based image restoration methods in both quantitative performance and visual quality. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/BIT-Vision/SpikeDiffusion.
authors: Ruonan Liu, Lin Zhu, Xijie Xiang, Lizhi Wang, Hua Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4080-4089

title: Noise2Score3D: Tweedie方法在无监督点云去噪中的应用
title_en: Noise2Score3D: Tweedie's Approach for Unsupervised Point Cloud Denoising
abstract: 基于贝叶斯统计学和图像去噪领域的最新进展,我们提出Noise2Score3D,这是一种全无监督的点云去噪框架。Noise2Score3D直接从噪声数据中学习底层点云分布的得分函数,无需在训练过程中使用干净数据。通过Tweedie公式,我们的方法能够在单步完成去噪,避免了现有无监督方法中使用的迭代过程,从而提高了准确性和效率。此外,我们引入点云的总变差作为去噪质量度量,允许估计未知噪声参数。实验结果表明,Noise2Score3D在Chamfer距离和点到网格指标上,相较于其他无监督学习方法达到了最先进水平。Noise2Score3D还展现出超越训练数据集的强大泛化能力。通过解决基于学习方法中的泛化问题和缺乏干净数据的挑战,我们的方法为现实场景中的基于学习的点云去噪方法奠定了基础。
abstract_en: Building on recent advances in Bayesian statistics and image denoising, we propose Noise2Score3D, a fully unsupervised framework for point cloud denoising. Noise2Score3D learns the score function of the underlying point cloud distribution directly from noisy data, eliminating the need for clean data during training. Using Tweedie's formula, our method performs denoising in a single step, avoiding the iterative processes used in existing unsupervised methods, thus improving both accuracy and efficiency. Additionally, we introduce Total Variation for Point Clouds as a denoising quality metric, which allows for the estimation of unknown noise parameters. Experimental results demonstrate that Noise2Score3D achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks among unsupervised learning methods in Chamfer distance and point-to-mesh metrics. Noise2Score3D also demonstrates strong generalization ability beyond training datasets. Our method, by addressing the generalization issue and challenge of the absence of clean data in learning-based methods, paves the way for learning-based point cloud denoising methods in real-world applications.
authors: Xiangbin Wei, Yuanfeng Wang, Ao Xu, Lingyu Zhu, Dongyong Sun, Keren Li, Yang Li, Qi Qin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25993-26003

title: NoiseController: 通过噪声分解与协作实现多视角视频生成的一致性
title_en: NoiseController: Towards Consistent Multi-view Video Generation via Noise Decomposition and Collaboration
abstract: 高质量视频生成在许多领域(如电影行业和自动驾驶)中至关重要。然而,生成具有时空一致性的视频仍面临挑战。现有方法通常利用注意力机制或修改噪声以实现一致的视频,忽视了有助于确保视频生成过程中空间和时间一致性的全局时空信息。本文提出***NoiseController***,包含**多级噪声分解**、**多帧噪声协作**和**联合去噪**,以增强视频生成的时空一致性。在多级噪声分解中,我们首先将初始噪声分解为场景级的前景/背景噪声,捕捉不同的运动特性以建模多视角前景/背景变化。此外,每个场景级噪声进一步分解为个体级的共享和残余成分。共享噪声保持一致性,而残余成分维持多样性。在多帧噪声协作中,我们引入了跨视角时空协作矩阵和跨帧影响协作矩阵,以捕捉互跨视角效应和历史跨帧影响,提升视频质量。联合去噪包含两个并行的去噪U-Net,分别去除每个场景级噪声,相互增强视频生成。我们在专注于视频生成及下游任务的公开数据集上评估***NoiseController***,展示了其最先进的性能。
abstract_en: High-quality video generation is crucial for many fields, including the film industry and autonomous driving. However, generating videos with spatiotemporal consistencies remains challenging. Current methods typically utilize attention mechanisms or modify noise to achieve consistent videos, neglecting global spatiotemporal information that could help ensure spatial and temporal consistency during video generation. In this paper, we propose the ***NoiseController***, consisting of **Multi-Level Noise Decomposition**, **Multi-Frame Noise Collaboration**, and **Joint Denoising**, to enhance spatiotemporal consistencies in video generation. In multi-level noise decomposition, we first decompose initial noises into scene-level foreground/background noises, capturing distinct motion properties to model multi-view foreground/background variations. Furthermore, each scene-level noise is further decomposed into individual-level shared and residual components. The shared noise preserves consistency, while the residual component maintains diversity. In multi-frame noise collaboration, we introduce an inter-view spatiotemporal collaboration matrix and an intra-view impact collaboration matrix, which captures mutual cross-view effects and historical cross-frame impacts to enhance video quality. The joint denoising contains two parallel denoising U-Nets to remove each scene-level noise, mutually enhancing video generation. We evaluate our ***NoiseController*** on public datasets focusing on video generation and downstream tasks, demonstrating its state-of-the-art performance.
authors: Haotian Dong, Xin Wang, Di Lin, Yipeng Wu, Qin Chen, Ruonan Liu, Kairui Yang, Ping Li, Qing Guo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14443-14452

title: 基于正常与异常病理知识增强的视觉-语言模型用于病理图像异常检测
title_en: Normal and Abnormal Pathology Knowledge-Augmented Vision-Language Model for Anomaly Detection in Pathology Images
abstract: 计算病理学中的异常检测旨在识别罕见且稀缺的异常病变,其中疾病相关数据往往有限或缺失。现有异常检测方法主要针对工业场景设计,在病理学中因计算约束、组织结构多样性及缺乏可解释性而面临局限。为解决这些挑战,我们提出Ano-NAViLa,一种基于正常与异常病理知识增强的视觉-语言模型,用于病理图像的异常检测。Ano-NAViLa基于预训练的视觉-语言模型构建,采用轻量级可训练MLP。通过融合正常与异常病理知识,Ano-NAViLa提升了病理图像的检测准确性与对变异性的鲁棒性,并通过图像-文本关联提供可解释性。在两个不同器官的淋巴结数据集上评估,Ano-NAViLa在异常检测与定位任务中达到最先进的性能,优于竞争模型。
abstract_en: Anomaly detection in computational pathology aims to identify rare and scarce anomalies where disease-related data are often limited or missing. Existing anomaly detection methods, primarily designed for industrial settings, face limitations in pathology due to computational constraints, diverse tissue structures, and lack of interpretability. To address these challenges, we propose Ano-NAViLa, a Normal and Abnormal pathology knowledge-augmented Vision-Language model for Anomaly detection in pathology images. Ano-NAViLa is built on a pre-trained vision-language model with a lightweight trainable MLP. By incorporating both normal and abnormal pathology knowledge, Ano-NAViLa enhances accuracy and robustness to variability in pathology images and provides interpretability through image-text associations. Evaluated on two lymph node datasets from different organs, Ano-NAViLa achieves the state-of-the-art performance in anomaly detection and localization, outperforming competing models.
authors: Jinsol Song, Jiamu Wang, Anh Tien Nguyen, Keunho Byeon, Sangjeong Ahn, Sung Hak Lee, Jin Tae Kwak ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22066-22076

title: NormalCrafter:从视频扩散先验学习时间一致的法线
title_en: NormalCrafter: Learning Temporally Consistent Normals from Video Diffusion Priors
abstract: 表面法线估计是诸多计算机视觉应用的基础。尽管已有大量研究聚焦于静态图像场景,但基于视频的法线估计确保时间一致性仍是一个重大挑战。我们提出NormalCrafter,通过利用视频扩散模型(VDMs)的固有时间先验,而非简单地在现有方法中添加时间组件。我们识别出直接应用VDMs时预测模糊的原因,并引入语义特征正则化(SFR),通过将扩散特征与细粒度语义线索对齐,促使模型关注几何细节。此外,我们提出了一种两阶段训练协议,结合潜在空间和像素空间学习,在保持空间精度的同时维持长期时间上下文。广泛评估表明了我们方法的有效性,展示了从多样化视频中生成具有复杂细节的时间一致法线序列的优越性能。代码和模型可在https://normalcrafter.github.io/获取。
abstract_en: Surface normal estimation serves as a cornerstone for a spectrum of computer vision applications. While numerous efforts have been devoted to static image scenarios, ensuring temporal coherence in video-based normal estimation remains a formidable challenge. Instead of merely augmenting existing methods with temporal components, we present NormalCrafter to leverage the inherent temporal priors of Video Diffusion Models (VDMs). We identify the reason for blurry predictions when directly applying VDMs and introduce Semantic Feature Regularization (SFR) to encourage the model to concentrate on geometric details by aligning diffusion features with fine-grained semantic cues. Moreover, we introduce a two-stage training protocol that leverages both latent and pixel space learning to preserve spatial accuracy while maintaining long temporal context. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the efficacy of our method, showcasing a superior performance in generating temporally consistent normal sequences with intricate details from diverse videos. Code and models are publicly available at https://normalcrafter.github.io/.
authors: Yanrui Bin, Wenbo Hu, Haoyuan Wang, Xinya Chen, Bing Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8330-8339

title: NormalLoc:基于表面法线的无纹理3D模型视觉定位
title_en: NormalLoc: Visual Localization on Textureless 3D Models using Surface Normals
abstract: 我们提出NormalLoc,一种新颖的视觉定位方法,用于利用无纹理3D模型估计相机的六自由度姿态。现有方法通常依赖于颜色或纹理信息,这限制了其在缺乏此类信息场景中的适用性。NormalLoc通过使用从3D模型表面法线生成的渲染法线图像,建立用于全局描述符计算和匹配的训练方案,从而解决这一局限性。该方法即使在几何细节有限的情况下也能实现稳健的视觉定位。实验结果表明,NormalLoc在无纹理3D模型的视觉定位中达到了最先进的性能,尤其是在几何细节有限的场景中。
abstract_en: We propose NormalLoc, a novel visual localization method for estimating the 6-DoF pose of a camera using textureless 3D models. Existing methods often rely on color or texture information, limiting their applicability in scenarios where such information is unavailable. NormalLoc addresses this limitation by using rendered normal images generated from surface normals of 3D models to establish a training scheme for both global descriptor computation and matching. This approach enables robust visual localization even when geometric details are limited. Experimental results demonstrate that NormalLoc achieves state-of-the-art performance for visual localization on textureless 3D models, especially in scenarios with limited geometric detail.
authors: Jiro Abe, Gaku Nakano, Kazumine Ogura ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25421-25430

title: 并非所有退化都相同:一种面向可泛化图像超分辨率的针对性特征去噪框架
title_en: Not All Degradations Are Equal: A Targeted Feature Denoising Framework for Generalizable Image Super-Resolution
abstract: 可泛化图像超分辨率旨在提升模型在未知退化下的泛化能力。为实现此目标,模型应仅关注与图像内容相关的特征而非退化细节(即过拟合退化)。近年来,诸如dropout和特征对齐等方法被提出以抑制模型对退化的自然过拟合倾向,取得了 promising 的结果。然而,这些方法均假设模型会过拟合所有退化类型(如模糊、噪声),而通过本文的深入研究发现,模型主要过拟合噪声,这主要归因于噪声与其他退化类型在退化模式上的显著差异。本文提出一种针对性特征去噪框架,包含噪声检测与去噪模块。我们的方法是一种通用解决方案,可无缝集成到现有超分辨率模型中,无需修改网络结构。在五个传统基准数据集和包含合成与真实场景的测试集上,我们的框架相较基于正则化的方法展现出更优性能。
abstract_en: Generalizable Image Super-Resolution aims to enhance model generalization capabilities under unknown degradations. To achieve such goal, the models are expected to focus only on image content-related features instead of degradation details (i.e., overfitting degradations).Recently, numerous approaches such as dropout and feature alignment have been proposed to suppress models' natural tendency to overfitting degradations and yields promising results. Nevertheless, these works have assumed that models overfit to all degradation types (e.g., blur, noise), while through careful investigations in this paper, we discover that models predominantly overfit to noise, largely attributable to the distinct degradation pattern in noise compared to other degradation types. In this paper, we propose a targeted feature denoising framework, comprising noise detection and denoising modules. Our approach represents a general solution that can be seamlessly integrated with existing super-resolution models without requiring architectural modifications. Our framework demonstrates superior performance compared to previous regularization-based methods across five traditional benchmark and datasets, encompassing both synthetic and real-world scenarios.
authors: Hongjun Wang, Jiyuan Chen, Zhengwei Yin, Xuan Song, Yinqiang Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14152-14161

title: 并非所有帧特征都同等重要:通过解耦动态-静态特征实现视频到四维生成
title_en: Not All Frame Features Are Equal: Video-to-4D Generation via Decoupling Dynamic-Static Features
abstract: 近期,从视频生成动态三维物体取得了令人印象深刻的结果。现有方法直接利用帧中全部信息优化高斯分布。然而,当动态区域与静态区域在帧内交织,特别是静态区域占比较大时,现有方法常忽略动态区域信息,并容易在静态区域过拟合,导致生成结果出现模糊纹理。我们认为通过解耦动态-静态特征以增强动态表征可缓解此问题。因此,我们提出动态-静态特征解耦模块(DSFD)。沿时间轴,该模块将当前帧特征与参考帧特征差异显著的区域视为动态特征,其余部分为静态特征。随后,我们获取由动态特征和当前帧特征驱动的解耦特征。此外,为进一步增强不同视角下解耦特征的动态表征并确保精确运动预测,我们设计时序-空间相似性融合模块(TSSF)。沿空间轴,该模块自适应选择动态区域的相似信息。基于上述方法,我们构建了新型方法DS4D。实验结果验证了我们的方法在视频到四维生成中达到最先进(SOTA)水平。此外,在现实场景数据集上的实验验证了其在四维场景中的有效性。项目页面:https://github.com/LiyingCV/DS4D
abstract_en: Recently, the generation of dynamic 3D objects from a video has shown impressive results. Existing methods directly optimize Gaussians using whole information in frames. However, when dynamic regions are interwoven with static regions within frames, particularly if the static regions account for a large proportion, existing methods often overlook information in dynamic regions and are prone to overfitting on static regions. This leads to producing results with blurry textures. We consider that decoupling dynamic-static features to enhance dynamic representations can alleviate this issue. Thus, we propose a dynamic-static feature decoupling module (DSFD). Along temporal axes, it regards the regions of current frame features that possess significant differences relative to reference frame features as dynamic features. Conversely, the remaining parts are the static features. Then, we acquire decoupled features driven by dynamic features and current frame features. Moreover, to further enhance the dynamic representation of decoupled features from different viewpoints and ensure accurate motion prediction, we design a temporal-spatial similarity fusion module (TSSF). Along spatial axes, it adaptively selects similar information of dynamic regions. Hinging on the above, we construct a novel approach, DS4D. Experimental results verify our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results in video-to-4D. In addition, the experiments on a real-world scenario dataset demonstrate its effectiveness on the 4D scene. Project page: https://github.com/LiyingCV/DS4D.
authors: Liying Yang, Chen Liu, Zhenwei Zhu, Ajian Liu, Hui Ma, Jian Nong, Yanyan Liang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7494-7504

title: 不仅依靠视觉:通过外围信息进化视觉语音识别
title_en: Not Only Vision: Evolve Visual Speech Recognition via Peripheral Information
abstract: 视觉信息单独是否足以应对挑战性的现实场景中的视觉语音识别(VSR)?人类在唇读时不仅依赖视觉信息,还会结合其他线索,如与语音相关的上下文和任务先验知识。然而,现有方法在自动VSR系统中很大程度上忽略了此类外部信息。为系统探索此类信息在VSR中的作用,我们引入了外围信息的概念。根据与语音内容的相关性,将其分为三类:(1)上下文引导(如语音主题或描述),(2)任务专长(如人类唇读的先验经验),(3)语言扰动(与有意义信息并行处理的无关信号)。考虑到外围信息提供具有不同重要性的额外线索,而视觉输入是VSR最直接的信息源,我们提出一个框架,通过分层处理策略处理不同模态。结合视觉特定适配和多模态信息的动态路由机制,我们的方法有效减少了模态冲突的影响,并实现了对不同相关性外围信息的选择性利用。利用易获取的外围信息,我们的模型在LRS3上达到22.03%的词错误率(WER)。进一步在AVSpeech上的实验验证了其在现实场景中的泛化能力。
abstract_en: Is visual information alone sufficient for visual speech recognition (VSR) in challenging real-world scenarios? Humans do not rely solely on visual information for lip-reading but also incorporate additional cues, such as speech-related context and prior knowledge about the task. However, existing methods have largely overlooked such external information in automatic VSR systems. To systematically explore the role of such information for VSR, we introduce the concept of Peripheral Information. We categorize it into three types based on the relevance to the spoken content: (1) Contextual Guidance (e.g., topic or description of speech), (2) Task Expertise (e.g., human prior experience in lip-reading), and (3) Linguistic Perturbation (irrelevant signals processed alongside meaningful information). Considering the disparity that peripheral information provides additional clues with varying significance while visual input serves as the most direct source for VSR, we propose a framework that introduces a hierarchical processing strategy to handle different modalities. With visual-specific adaptation and a dynamic routing mechanism for multi-modal information, our approach reduces the impact of modality conflicts effectively and enables selective utilization of peripheral information with varying relevance. Leveraging readily available peripheral information, our model achieves a WER of 22.03% on LRS3. Further experiments on AVSpeech demonstrate its generalization in real-world scenarios.
authors: Zhaoxin Yuan, Shuang Yang, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3091-3100

title: 并非所有视角都平等:分析视觉基础模型中的视角不稳定性
title_en: Not all Views are Created Equal: Analyzing Viewpoint Instabilities in Vision Foundation Models
abstract: 本文分析了基础模型的视角稳定性——具体而言,其对视角变化的敏感性,并将不稳定性定义为因微小视角变化导致显著特征变化,从而在3D推理任务中产生泛化差距。我们研究了九个基础模型,重点关注其对视角变化的响应,包括常被忽视的意外视角,其中特定相机方向会遮挡物体的真实3D结构。我们的方法通过特征表示单独识别和分类意外视角、稳定视角及其他视角,无需访问实际图像。研究结果表明,尽管基础模型一致编码意外视角,但因固有偏差,在解释其他视角时存在差异,有时会导致基于几何相似性的物体误分类。通过在三个下游任务——分类、视觉问答(VQA)和3D重建上的定量与定性评估,我们展示了视角不稳定性的影响,并强调了在多样化视角条件下特征鲁棒性的重要性。
abstract_en: In this paper, we analyze the viewpoint stability of foundational models - specifically, their sensitivity to changes in viewpoint- and define instability as significant feature variations resulting from minor changes in viewing angle, leading to generalization gaps in 3D reasoning tasks. We investigate nine foundational models, focusing on their responses to viewpoint changes, including the often-overlooked accidental viewpoints where specific camera orientations obscure an object's true 3D structure. Our methodology enables recognizing and classifying accidental, stable and other viewpoints using feature representations alone, without accessing the actual images. Our findings indicate that while foundation models consistently encode accidental viewpoints, they vary in their interpretation of other viewpoints due to inherent biases, at times leading to object misclassifications based on geometric resemblance. Through quantitative and qualitative evaluations on three downstream tasks - classification, VQA, and 3D reconstruction - we illustrate the impact of viewpoint instability and underscore the importance of feature robustness across diverse viewing conditions.
authors: Mateusz Michalkiewicz, Sheena Bai, Mahsa Baktashmotlagh, Varun Jampani, Guha Balakrishnan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9113-9123

title: NuPlanQA: 一个面向多模态大语言模型的多视角驾驶场景理解大规模数据集与基准
title_en: NuPlanQA: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Multi-View Driving Scene Understanding in Multi-Modal Large Language Models
abstract: 近年来,多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)在多个领域展现出强大的性能;然而,其对驾驶场景的理解能力仍缺乏充分验证。驾驶场景的复杂性,包括多视角信息,对现有MLLMs提出了显著挑战。本文提出NuPlanQA-Eval,一个用于驾驶场景理解的多视角、多模态评估基准。为进一步支持多视角驾驶场景的泛化能力,我们还提出了NuPlanQA-1M,一个包含100万组真实世界视觉问答(VQA)对的大规模数据集。为实现交通场景的上下文感知分析,我们将数据集划分为三个核心技能的九个子任务:道路环境感知、空间关系识别和以自我为中心的推理。此外,我们提出了BEV-LLM,将多视角图像中的鸟眼视角(BEV)特征集成到MLLMs中。评估结果揭示了现有MLLMs在驾驶场景特定感知和以自我为中心的空间推理中面临的关键挑战。相比之下,BEV-LLM在九个子任务中的六个中表现优于其他模型,显示出对该领域的显著适应性。这些发现表明BEV集成如何增强多视角MLLMs,同时也指出了需要进一步优化的关键领域,以实现对驾驶场景的有效适应。NuPlanQA可在https://github.com/sungyeonparkk/NuPlanQA获取。
abstract_en: Recent advances in multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across various domains; however, their ability to comprehend driving scenes remains less proven. The complexity of driving scenarios, which includes multi-view information, poses significant challenges for existing MLLMs. In this paper, we introduce NuPlanQA-Eval, a multi-view, multi-modal evaluation benchmark for driving scene understanding. To further support generalization to multi-view driving scenarios, we also propose NuPlanQA-1M, a large-scale dataset comprising 1M real-world visual question-answering (VQA) pairs. For context-aware analysis of traffic scenes, we categorize our dataset into nine subtasks across three core skills: Road Environment Perception, Spatial Relations Recognition, and Ego-Centric Reasoning. Furthermore, we present BEV-LLM, integrating Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) features from multi-view images into MLLMs. Our evaluation results reveal key challenges that existing MLLMs face in driving scene-specific perception and spatial reasoning from ego-centric perspectives. In contrast, BEV-LLM demonstrates remarkable adaptability to this domain, outperforming other models in six of the nine subtasks. These findings highlight how BEV integration enhances multi-view MLLMs while also identifying key areas that require further refinement for effective adaptation to driving scenes. NuPlanQA is available at https://github.com/sungyeonparkk/NuPlanQA.
authors: Sung-Yeon Park, Can Cui, Yunsheng Ma, Ahmadreza Moradipari, Rohit Gupta, Kyungtae Han, Ziran Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8066-8076

title: NuiScene:探索无界户外场景的高效生成
title_en: NuiScene: Exploring Efficient Generation of Unbounded Outdoor Scenes
abstract: 本文探讨了生成广阔户外场景的任务,涵盖从城堡到摩天大楼的多种场景。与以往主要聚焦于室内场景生成的研究不同,户外场景生成面临独特挑战,包括场景高度的广泛变化以及需要快速生成大规模景观的方法。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种高效方法,将场景块编码为统一向量集,在压缩率和性能方面均优于以往方法中使用的空间结构化潜在变量。此外,我们训练了一个显式的外扩模型用于无界生成,该模型在保持连贯性方面优于以往基于重采样的修复方案,同时通过消除额外的扩散步骤加快了生成速度。为促进该任务,我们整理了NuiScene43数据集,这是一个小但高质量的场景集合,已预处理用于联合训练。值得注意的是,当模型在风格各异的场景上训练时,能够将不同环境(如乡村房屋和城市摩天大楼)融合在同一场景中,突显了我们的筛选流程利用异构场景进行联合训练的潜力。
abstract_en: In this paper, we explore the task of generating expansive outdoor scenes, ranging from castles to high-rises. Unlike indoor scene generation, which has been a primary focus of prior work, outdoor scene generation presents unique challenges, including wide variations in scene heights and the need for a method capable of rapidly producing large landscapes. To address this, we propose an efficient approach that encodes scene chunks as uniform vector sets, offering better compression and performance than the spatially structured latents used in prior methods. Furthermore, we train an explicit outpainting model for unbounded generation, which improves coherence compared to prior resampling-based inpainting schemes while also speeding up generation by eliminating extra diffusion steps. To facilitate this task, we curate NuiScene43, a small but high-quality set of scenes, preprocessed for joint training. Notably, when trained on scenes of varying styles, our model can blend different environments, such as rural houses and city skyscrapers, within the same scene, highlighting the potential of our curation process to leverage heterogeneous scenes for joint training.
authors: Han-Hung Lee, Qinghong Han, Angel X. Chang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26509-26518

title: NullSwap:主动身份伪装对抗深度伪造面部替换
title_en: NullSwap: Proactive Identity Cloaking Against Deepfake Face Swapping
abstract: 由于生成模型的发展,被动检测高质量深度伪造图像存在性能瓶颈,主动扰动通过在良性图像中插入信号来禁用深度伪造操作,提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而,现有主动扰动方法在多个方面仍不令人满意:1)由于直接逐元素相加导致的视觉退化;2)对面部替换操作的抑制效果有限;3)不可避免地依赖白盒和灰盒设置以在训练期间引入生成模型。本研究分析了深度伪造面部替换的本质,论证了保护源身份而非目标图像的必要性,提出了一种新型主动防御方法NullSwap,在纯黑盒场景下实现源图像身份伪装并消除面部替换。我们设计了身份提取模块以从源图像中获取面部身份特征,随后设计扰动模块生成身份引导的扰动。同时,特征模块提取浅层图像特征,这些特征在伪装模块中与扰动融合以实现图像重建。为进一步确保在面部替换算法中不同身份提取器的适应性,我们提出动态损失加权以自适应平衡身份损失。实验表明,我们的方法能够有效欺骗各类身份识别模型,在防止面部替换模型生成具有正确源身份的图像方面优于现有最先进的主动扰动方法。
abstract_en: Suffering from performance bottlenecks in passively detecting high-quality Deepfake images due to the advancement of generative models, proactive perturbations offer a promising approach to disabling Deepfake manipulations by inserting signals into benign images. However, existing proactive perturbation approaches remain unsatisfactory in several aspects: 1) visual degradation due to direct element-wise addition; 2) limited effectiveness against face swapping manipulation; 3) unavoidable reliance on white- and grey-box settings to involve generative models during training. In this study, we analyze the essence of Deepfake face swapping and argue the necessity of protecting source identities rather than target images, and we propose NullSwap, a novel proactive defense approach that cloaks source image identities and nullifies face swapping under a pure black-box scenario. We design an Identity Extraction module to obtain facial identity features from the source image, while a Perturbation Block is then devised to generate identity-guided perturbations accordingly. Meanwhile, a Feature Block extracts shallow-level image features, which are then fused with the perturbation in the Cloaking Block for image reconstruction. Furthermore, to ensure adaptability across different identity extractors in face swapping algorithms, we propose Dynamic Loss Weighting to adaptively balance identity losses. Experiments demonstrate the outstanding ability of our approach to fool various identity recognition models, outperforming state-of-the-art proactive perturbations in preventing face swapping models from generating images with correct source identities.
authors: Tianyi Wang, Shuaicheng Niu, Harry Cheng, Xiao Zhang, Yinglong Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9945-9954

title: O-MaMa: 学习自摄与他摄视角间的物体掩码匹配
title_en: O-MaMa: Learning Object Mask Matching between Egocentric and Exocentric Views
abstract: 从多视角理解世界对协同工作的智能系统至关重要,其中跨不同视角分割常见物体仍是一个开放性问题。我们提出了一种新方法,通过将跨图像分割重新定义为掩码匹配任务来解决该问题。我们的方法包含:(1) 一个掩码上下文编码器,通过池化密集的DINOv2语义特征,从FastSAM掩码候选中获取具有判别性的物体级表示;(2) 一个自摄-他摄交叉注意力模块,融合多视角观测;(3) 一个掩码匹配对比损失,使跨视角特征在共享潜在空间中对齐;(4) 一个硬负样本相邻挖掘策略,鼓励模型更好地区分相邻物体。O-MaMa在Ego-Exo4D对应性基准测试中达到最先进水平,相较官方挑战基线在Ego2Exo和Exo2Ego IoU上分别取得+22%和+76%的相对提升,与参数量仅为1%的SOTA方法相比,分别提升+13%和+6%。
abstract_en: Understanding the world from multiple perspectives is essential for intelligent systems operating together, where segmenting common objects across different views remains an open problem. We introduce a new approach that re-defines cross-image segmentation by treating it as a mask matching task. Our method consists of: (1) A Mask-Context Encoder that pools dense DINOv2 semantic features to obtain discriminative object-level representations from FastSAM mask candidates, (2) an Ego-Exo Cross-Attention that fuses multi-perspective observations, (3) a Mask Matching contrastive loss that aligns cross-view features in a shared latent space, and (4) a Hard Negative Adjacent Mining strategy to encourage the model to better differentiate between nearby objects. O-MaMa achieves the state of the art in the Ego-Exo4D Correspondences benchmark, obtaining relative gains of +22 % and +76 % in the Ego2Exo and Exo2Ego IoU against the official challenge baselines, and a +13 % and +6 % compared with the SOTA with 1 % of the training parameters.
authors: Lorenzo Mur-Labadia, Maria Santos-Villafranca, Jesus Bermudez-Cameo, Alejandro Perez-Yus, Ruben Martinez-Cantin, Jose J. Guerrero ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6892-6903

title: OCK: 基于物体中心运动学的无监督动态视频预测
title_en: OCK: Unsupervised Dynamic Video Prediction with Object-Centric Kinematics
abstract: 人类感知涉及将复杂的多物体场景分解为时间静态的物体外观(即尺寸、形状、颜色)和时间变化的物体运动(即位置、速度、加速度)。为了使机器在现实交互中实现类人智能,理解这些物体的物理属性至关重要,这是动态视频预测的基础。尽管近期基于物体中心的Transformer模型在视频预测中展现出潜力,但它们主要关注物体外观,往往忽视运动动力学,而运动动力学对于建模动态交互和保持复杂环境中的时间一致性至关重要。为解决这些局限性,我们提出OCK模型,该模型利用物体中心运动学和物体槽机制进行动态视频预测。我们引入了一个名为物体运动学的新组件,包含显式的物体运动信息,作为传统外观特征之外的附加属性以建模动态场景。物体运动学被整合到OCK的多种机制中,从而实现对长视频序列中复杂物体交互的时空预测。我们的模型在处理具有复杂物体属性和运动的场景时表现出优越性能,凸显了其在视觉相关动态学习任务中的应用潜力。
abstract_en: Human perception involves decomposing complex multi-object scenes into time-static object appearance (i.e., size, shape, color) and time-varying object motion (i.e., position, velocity, acceleration). For machines to achieve human-like intelligence in real-world interactions, understanding these physical properties of objects is essential, forming the foundation for dynamic video prediction. While recent advancements in object-centric transformers have demonstrated potential in video prediction, they primarily focus on object appearance, often overlooking motion dynamics, which is crucial for modeling dynamic interactions and maintaining temporal consistency in complex environments. To address these limitations, we propose OCK, a dynamic video prediction model leveraging object-centric kinematics and object slots. We introduce a novel component named Object Kinematics that comprises explicit object motions, serving as an additional attribute beyond conventional appearance features to model dynamic scenes. The Object Kinematics are integrated into various OCK mechanisms, enabling spatiotemporal prediction of complex object interactions over long video sequences. Our model demonstrates superior performance in handling complex scenes with intricate object attributes and motions, highlighting its potential for applicability in vision-related dynamics learning tasks.
authors: Yeon-Ji Song, Jaein Kim, Suhyung Choi, Jin-Hwa Kim, Byoung-Tak Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11359-11368

title: OCR阻碍RAG:评估OCR对检索增强生成系统的级联影响
title_en: OCR Hinders RAG: Evaluating the Cascading Impact of OCR on Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: 检索增强生成(RAG)通过整合外部知识提升大语言模型(LLMs)性能,可减少幻觉并引入最新信息而无需重新训练。作为RAG的关键组成部分,外部知识库通常通过光学字符识别(OCR)从非结构化PDF文档中提取结构化数据构建。然而,由于OCR预测的不完美性及结构化数据固有的非均匀表示,知识库不可避免地包含各类OCR噪声。本文提出OHRBench,首个用于理解OCR对RAG系统级联影响的基准测试。OHRBench包含来自七个真实应用场景的8,561个精心挑选的非结构化文档图像,以及8,498个源自文档多模态元素的问答对,挑战现有用于RAG的OCR解决方案。为更深入理解OCR对RAG系统的影响,我们识别出两类主要OCR噪声:语义噪声和格式噪声,并通过扰动生成包含不同程度噪声的结构化数据集。利用OHRBench,我们首先对现有OCR方案进行全面评估,发现无一能胜任构建高质量RAG知识库。随后系统评估这两类噪声的影响,揭示OCR噪声程度与RAG性能之间的趋势关系。我们的OHRBench包含PDF文档、问答对及真实结构化数据,已开源:https://github.com/opendatalab/OHR-Bench
abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented Generation (RAG) enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) by integrating external knowledge to reduce hallucinations and incorporate up-to-date information without retraining. As an essential part of RAG, external knowledge bases are commonly built by extracting structured data from unstructured PDF documents using Optical Character Recognition (OCR). However, given the imperfect prediction of OCR and the inherent non-uniform representation of structured data, knowledge bases inevitably contain various OCR noises. In this paper, we introduce OHRBench, the first benchmark for understanding the cascading impact of OCR on RAG systems. OHRBench includes 8,561 carefully selected unstructured document images from seven real-world RAG application domains, along with 8,498 Q&A pairs derived from multimodal elements in documents, challenging existing OCR solutions used for RAG. To better understand OCR's impact on RAG systems, we identify two primary types of OCR noise: Semantic Noise and Formatting Noise and apply perturbation to generate a set of structured data with varying degrees of each OCR noise. Using OHRBench, we first conduct a comprehensive evaluation of current OCR solutions and reveal that none is competent for constructing high-quality knowledge bases for RAG systems. We then systematically evaluate the impact of these two noise types and demonstrate the trend relationship between the degree of OCR noise and RAG performance. Our OHRBench, including PDF documents, Q&As, and the ground truth structured data are released at: https://github.com/opendatalab/OHR-Bench
authors: Junyuan Zhang, Qintong Zhang, Bin Wang, Linke Ouyang, Zichen Wen, Ying Li, Ka-Ho Chow, Conghui He, Wentao Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17443-17453

title: OCSplats:3DGS中的观测完整性量化与标签噪声分离
title_en: OCSplats: Observation Completeness Quantification and Label Noise Separation in 3DGS
abstract: 3D高斯泼溅(3DGS)已成为最具前景的3D重建技术之一。然而,现实场景中的标签噪声——如移动物体、非朗伯表面和阴影——常常导致重建误差。现有基于3DGS的抗噪声重建方法要么无法有效分离噪声,要么需要针对特定场景进行超参数微调,导致其在实际应用中难以推广。本文从知识不确定性角度重新审视抗噪声重建问题,提出了一种新颖框架OCSplats。通过融合混合噪声评估和基于观测的认知校正等关键技术,显著提升了认知差异区域的噪声分类准确率。此外,为解决不同场景中噪声比例变化的问题,我们设计了基于动态锚点的标签噪声分类管道。该管道使OCSplats能够同时应用于噪声比例差异巨大的场景而无需调整参数。大量实验表明,OCSplats在不同复杂度场景中始终实现领先的重建性能和精确的标签噪声分类。代码已公开。
abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become one of the most promising 3D reconstruction technologies. However, label noise in real-world scenarios--such as moving objects, non-Lambertian surfaces, and shadows--often leads to reconstruction errors. Existing 3DGS-Bsed anti-noise reconstruction methods either fail to separate noise effectively or require scene-specific fine-tuning of hyperparameters, making them difficult to apply in practice. This paper re-examines the problem of anti-noise reconstruction from the perspective of epistemic uncertainty, proposing a novel framework, OCSplats. By combining key technologies such as hybrid noise assessment and observation-based cognitive correction, the accuracy of noise classification in areas with cognitive differences has been significantly improved. Moreover, to address the issue of varying noise proportions in different scenarios, we have designed a label noise classification pipeline based on dynamic anchor points. This pipeline enables OCSplats to be applied simultaneously to scenarios with vastly different noise proportions without adjusting parameters. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OCSplats always achieve leading reconstruction performance and precise label noise classification in scenes of different complexity levels. Code is available.
authors: Han Ling, Xian Xu, Yinghui Sun, Quansen Sun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25680-25689

title: OD-RASE:面向自动驾驶的本体驱动风险评估与安全增强
title_en: OD-RASE: Ontology-Driven Risk Assessment and Safety Enhancement for Autonomous Driving
abstract: 尽管自动驾驶系统表现出卓越的感知性能,但在处理罕见场景或复杂道路结构时仍面临局限。由于现有道路基础设施是为人类驾驶员设计的,安全改进通常仅在事故发生后才被引入。这种事后应对方式对需要主动风险缓解的自动驾驶系统构成了重大挑战。为解决这一问题,我们提出OD-RASE框架,通过检测导致交通事故的道路结构并将其与基础设施开发相连接,提升自动驾驶系统的安全性。首先,我们基于道路交通系统的专业领域知识构建本体。同时,我们利用大规模视觉语言模型(LVLM)生成基础设施改进方案,并通过本体驱动的数据过滤提升其可靠性。该过程自动标注事故前道路图像的改进方案,构建新的数据集。此外,我们引入基线方法(OD-RASE模型),该方法结合LVLM和扩散模型,生成基础设施改进方案及改进后的道路环境生成图像。实验表明,本体驱动的数据过滤可实现对事故致因道路结构及对应改进方案的高精度预测。我们认为,本工作有助于提升交通环境的整体安全性,并标志着自动驾驶系统更广泛应用的重要一步。
abstract_en: Although autonomous driving systems demonstrate high perception performance, they still face limitations when handling rare situations or complex road structures. Since existing road infrastructures are designed for human drivers, safety improvements are typically introduced only after accidents occur. This reactive approach poses a significant challenge for autonomous systems, which require proactive risk mitigation. To address this issue, we propose OD-RASE, a framework for enhancing the safety of autonomous driving systems by detecting road structures that cause traffic accidents and connecting these findings to infrastructure development. First, we formalize an ontology based on specialized domain knowledge of road traffic systems. In parallel, we generate infrastructure improvement proposals using a large-scale visual language model (LVLM) and use ontology-driven data filtering to enhance their reliability. This process automatically annotates improvement proposals on pre-accident road images, leading to the construction of a new dataset. Furthermore, we introduce the Baseline approach (OD-RASE model), which leverages LVLM and a diffusion model to produce both infrastructure improvement proposals and generated images of the improved road environment. Our experiments demonstrate that ontology-driven data filtering enables highly accurate prediction of accident-causing road structures and the corresponding improvement plans. We believe that this work contributes to the overall safety of traffic environments and marks an important step toward the broader adoption of autonomous driving systems.
authors: Kota Shimomura, Masaki Nambata, Atsuya Ishikawa, Ryota Mimura, Koki Inoue, Takayoshi Yamashita, Takayuki Kawabuchi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26167-26177

title: 基于离群点检测与降维的对抗性补丁防御方法(ODDR)
title_en: ODDR: Outlier Detection & Dimension Reduction Based Defense Against Adversarial Patches
abstract: 对抗性攻击对机器学习模型的可靠部署构成重大挑战,其中基于补丁的攻击尤为有效。这些攻击在图像的局部区域引入对抗性扰动,即使是对训练良好的模型也能产生欺骗效果。本文提出了一种综合防御策略——离群点检测与降维(ODDR),通过先进的统计方法对抗基于补丁的对抗性攻击。我们的方法基于以下观察:与对抗性补丁(无论是自然还是合成的)相关的输入特征会偏离剩余图像数据的内在分布,因此可以被识别为离群点。ODDR通过一个稳健的三阶段流程运行:碎片化、分离和中和。该模型无关框架具有通用性,可为包括图像分类、目标检测和深度估计在内的多种任务提供保护,并在基于CNN和Transformer的架构中均被证明有效。在碎片化阶段,图像样本被分割为更小的片段,为分离阶段做准备,该阶段利用先进的离群点检测技术隔离与对抗性扰动相关的异常特征。中和阶段则对这些离群点应用降维技术,有效中和对抗性影响,同时保留机器学习任务的关键信息。在基准数据集上对最新对抗性补丁的广泛评估突显了ODDR的有效性。例如,我们的方法在GoogleAp攻击下将模型准确率从39.26%提升至79.1%,优于LGS(53.86%)、Jujutsu(60%)和Jedi(64.34%)等领先防御方法。
abstract_en: Adversarial attacks present a significant challenge to the dependable deployment of machine learning models, with patch-based attacks being particularly potent. These attacks introduce adversarial perturbations in localized regions of an image, deceiving even well-trained models. In this paper, we propose Outlier Detection and Dimension Reduction (ODDR), a comprehensive defense strategy engineered to counteract patch-based adversarial attacks through advanced statistical methodologies.Our approach is based on the observation that input features corresponding to adversarial patches--whether naturalistic or synthetic--deviate from the intrinsic distribution of the remaining image data and can thus be identified as outliers. ODDR operates through a robust three-stage pipeline: Fragmentation, Segregation, and Neutralization. This model-agnostic framework is versatile, offering protection across various tasks, including image classification, object detection, and depth estimation, and is proved effective in both CNN-based and Transformer-based architectures.In the Fragmentation stage, image samples are divided into smaller segments, preparing them for the Segregation stage, where advanced outlier detection techniques isolate anomalous features linked to adversarial perturbations. The Neutralization stage then applies dimension reduction techniques to these outliers, effectively neutralizing the adversarial impact while preserving critical information for the machine learning task.Extensive evaluation on benchmark datasets against state-of-the-art adversarial patches underscores the efficacy of ODDR. For example, our proposed method enhances model accuracy from 39.26% to 79.1% under the GoogleAp attack, outperforming leading defenses such as LGS (53.86%), Jujutsu (60%), and Jedi (64.34%).
authors: Nandish Chattopadhyay, Amira Guesmi, Muhammad Abdullah Hanif, Bassem Ouni, Muhammad Shafique ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22999-23008

title: ODP-Bench:分布外性能预测基准测试
title_en: ODP-Bench: Benchmarking Out-of-Distribution Performance Prediction
abstract: 近年来,分布外(OOD)性能预测逐渐受到更多关注,其目标是预测训练模型在未标记的分布外测试数据集上的性能,从而在风险敏感场景中更好地利用和部署现成模型。尽管该领域已取得进展,但先前文献中的评估协议存在不一致性,且多数工作仅覆盖有限数量的现实世界分布外数据集和分布转移类型。为方便各类算法进行公平比较,我们提出分布外性能预测基准(ODP-Bench),该基准包含最常用的分布外数据集和现有实用性能预测算法。我们提供训练好的模型作为未来研究者的测试平台,确保比较的一致性并避免重复模型训练过程的负担。此外,我们还进行了深入的实验分析,以更好地理解其能力边界。
abstract_en: Recently, there has been gradually more attention paid to Out-of-Distribution (OOD) performance prediction, whose goal is to predict the performance of trained models on unlabeled OOD test datasets, so that we could better leverage and deploy off-the-shelf trained models in risk-sensitive scenarios. Although progress has been made in this area, evaluation protocols in previous literature are inconsistent, and most works cover only a limited number of real-world OOD datasets and types of distribution shifts. To provide convenient and fair comparisons for various algorithms, we propose Out-of-Distribution Performance Prediction Benchmark (ODP-Bench), a comprehensive benchmark that includes most commonly used OOD datasets and existing practical performance prediction algorithms. We provide our trained models as a testbench for future researchers, thus guaranteeing the consistency of comparison and avoiding the burden of repeating the model training process. Furthermore, we also conduct in-depth experimental analyses to better understand their capability boundary.
authors: Han Yu, Kehan Li, Dongbai Li, Yue He, Xingxuan Zhang, Peng Cui ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1846-1858

title: OMNI-DC:基于多分辨率深度集成的高鲁棒性深度补全
title_en: OMNI-DC: Highly Robust Depth Completion with Multiresolution Depth Integration
abstract: 深度补全(DC)旨在从RGB图像和稀疏深度图中预测出密集深度图。现有DC方法在面对新数据集或未见过的稀疏深度模式时泛化能力较差,限制了其在实际应用中的效果。我们提出OMNI-DC,这是一种具有强鲁棒性的DC模型,能够零样本泛化到各种数据集。其关键设计是一种新颖的多分辨率深度集成器,使我们的模型能够处理非常稀疏的深度输入。我们还引入了一种新颖的拉普拉斯损失函数,以建模训练过程中的不确定性。此外,我们使用尺度归一化技术和合成深度模式,在高质量数据集的混合数据上训练OMNI-DC。在7个数据集上的大量实验表明,与基线方法相比有持续改进,将误差减少了高达43%。代码和检查点可在https://github.com/princeton-vl/OMNI-DC获取。
abstract_en: Depth completion (DC) aims to predict a dense depth map from an RGB image and a sparse depth map. Existing DC methods generalize poorly to new datasets or unseen sparse depth patterns, limiting their real-world applications. We propose OMNI-DC, a highly robust DC model that generalizes well zero-shot to various datasets. The key design is a novel Multi-Resolution Depth Integrator, allowing our model to deal with very sparse depth inputs. We also introduce a novel Laplacian loss to model the ambiguity in the training process. Moreover, we train OMNI-DC on a mixture of high-quality datasets with a scale normalization technique and synthetic depth patterns. Extensive experiments on 7 datasets show consistent improvements over baselines, reducing errors by as much as 43%. Codes and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/princeton-vl/OMNI-DC.
authors: Yiming Zuo, Willow Yang, Zeyu Ma, Jia Deng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9287-9297

title: ONLY: 单层干预充分缓解大视觉-语言模型的幻觉
title_en: ONLY: One-Layer Intervention Sufficiently Mitigates Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models
abstract: 近期的大视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)通过文本响应引入了理解与推理图像输入的新范式。尽管它们在多种多模态任务中取得了显著性能,但仍面临幻觉的持续挑战,这会引入实际缺陷并引发其在现实应用中可靠部署的担忧。现有工作探索了对比解码方法来缓解这一问题,其中原始LVLM的输出与扰动版本的输出进行对比。然而,这些方法需要两个或更多查询,会减缓LVLM响应生成速度,使其不太适合实时应用。为克服这一局限,我们提出ONLY,一种无需训练的解码方法,仅需单次查询和解码过程中的单层干预,即可实现高效实时部署。具体而言,我们通过每个token的文本到视觉熵比值选择性放大关键文本信息以增强文本输出。大量实验结果表明,我们的ONLY方法在各类基准测试中持续优于最先进方法,同时所需的实现工作量和计算成本极低。代码可在https://github.com/zifuwan/ONLY获取。
abstract_en: Recent Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have introduced a new paradigm for understanding and reasoning about image input through textual responses. Although they have achieved remarkable performance across a range of multi-modal tasks, they face the persistent challenge of hallucination, which introduces practical weaknesses and raises concerns about their reliable deployment in real-world applications. Existing work has explored contrastive decoding approaches to mitigate this issue, where the output of the original LVLM is compared and contrasted with that of a perturbed version. However, these methods require two or more queries that slow down LVLM response generation, making them less suitable for real-time applications. To overcome this limitation, we propose ONLY, a training-free decoding approach that requires only a single query and a one-layer intervention during decoding, enabling efficient real-time deployment. Specifically, we enhance textual outputs by selectively amplifying crucial textual information using a text-to-visual entropy ratio for each token. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our ONLY approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across various benchmarks while requiring minimal implementation effort and computational cost. Code is available at https://github.com/zifuwan/ONLY.
authors: Zifu Wan, Ce Zhang, Silong Yong, Martin Q. Ma, Simon Stepputtis, Louis-Philippe Morency, Deva Ramanan, Katia Sycara, Yaqi Xie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3225-3234

title: ORION: 一种基于视觉-语言引导动作生成的全面端到端自动驾驶框架
title_en: ORION: A Holistic End-to-End Autonomous Driving Framework by Vision-Language Instructed Action Generation
abstract: 端到端(E2E)自动驾驶方法在交互式闭环评估中仍因因果推理能力有限而难以做出正确决策。当前方法尝试利用视觉-语言模型(VLMs)强大的理解和推理能力来解决这一困境。然而,由于语义推理空间与动作空间中纯数值轨迹输出之间的差距,现有少数VLMs在闭环评估中表现仍不理想。为解决这一问题,我们提出ORION,一种基于视觉-语言引导动作生成的全面端到端自动驾驶框架。ORION独特地结合了QT-Former以聚合长期历史上下文、大型语言模型(LLM)用于驾驶场景推理以及生成式规划器用于精确轨迹预测。ORION进一步对齐推理空间与动作空间,实现视觉问答(VQA)和规划任务的统一端到端优化。我们的方法在挑战性Bench2Drive数据集上取得了令人印象深刻的闭环性能:77.47驾驶得分(DS)和54.62%成功率(SR),相较最先进(SOTA)方法分别高出14.28 DS和28.08% SR。
abstract_en: End-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving methods still struggle to make correct decisions in interactive closed-loop evaluation due to limited causal reasoning capability. Current methods attempt to leverage the powerful understanding and reasoning abilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to resolve this dilemma. However, the problem is still open that few VLMs for E2E methods perform well in the closed-loop evaluation due to the gap between the semantic reasoning space and the purely numerical trajectory output in the action space. To tackle this issue, we propose ORION, a holistic E2E autonomous driving framework by vision-language instructed action generation.ORION uniquely combines a QT-Former to aggregate long-term history context, a Large Language Model (LLM) for driving scenario reasoning, and a generative planner for precision trajectory prediction. ORION further aligns the reasoning space and the action space to implement a unified E2E optimization for both visual question-answering (VQA) and planning tasks. Our method achieves an impressive closed-loop performance of 77.47 Driving Score (DS) and 54.62% Success Rate (SR) on the challenge Bench2Drive datasets, which outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods by a large margin of 14.28 DS and 28.08% SR.
authors: Haoyu Fu, Diankun Zhang, Zongchuang Zhao, Jianfeng Cui, Dingkang Liang, Chong Zhang, Dingyuan Zhang, Hongwei Xie, Bing Wang, Xiang Bai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24823-24834

title: OURO:一种增强多模态场景理解的自引导框架
title_en: OURO: A Self-Bootstrapped Framework for Enhancing Multimodal Scene Understanding
abstract: 多模态大模型取得了显著进展,但对复杂场景的细粒度理解仍面临挑战。高质量、大规模的视觉-语言数据集对于解决这一问题至关重要。然而,现有方法往往依赖劳动密集型手动标注或闭源模型的最优性能,导致大规模数据收集成本高昂。为克服这些局限性,我们提出了一种自引导训练流程,利用模型自身的多模态能力递归优化其理解能力。通过将现有多模态数据分解为局部子区域,并生成分层场景描述和多维度问答对,我们构建了一个基于140万张图像-任务实例的数据集。我们进一步利用该数据集训练基础模型,显著提升了其对复杂视觉场景的理解能力及各类视觉相关任务的执行能力。我们的OURO模型在Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct上使用LoRA进行微调,在多个多模态基准测试中均显著优于基础模型及同规模模型。我们的自引导训练流程为多模态模型的持续优化提供了全新范式。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/tinnel123666888/OURO.git获取。
abstract_en: Multimodal large models have made significant progress, yet fine-grained understanding of complex scenes remains a challenge. High-quality, large-scale vision-language datasets are essential for addressing this issue. However, existing methods often rely on labor-intensive manual annotations or closed-source models with optimal performance, making large-scale data collection costly. To overcome these limitations, we propose a self-bootstrapped training pipeline that leverages the model's own multimodal capabilities to recursively refine its understanding. By decomposing existing multimodal data into localized sub-regions and generating hierarchical scene descriptions and multi-faceted question-answer pairs, we construct a dataset based on 1.4M image-task instances. We further utilize this dataset to train the base model, significantly enhancing its ability to interpret complex visual scenes and perform various vision-related tasks. Our OURO model, fine-tuned on Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct using LoRA, achieves substantial improvements over both the base model and similarly-sized counterparts across multiple multimodal benchmarks. Our self-bootstrapped training pipeline offers a novel paradigm for the continuous improvement of multimodal models. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/tinnel123666888/OURO.git.
authors: Tianrun Xu, Guanyu Chen, Ye Li, Yuxin Xi, Zeyu Mu, Ruichen Wang, Tianren Zhang, Haichuan Gao, Feng Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18240-18251

title: OV-SCAN:开放词汇三维目标检测中的新颖物体发现语义一致对齐
title_en: OV-SCAN: Semantically Consistent Alignment for Novel Object Discovery in Open-Vocabulary 3D Object Detection
abstract: 自动驾驶的开放词汇三维目标检测旨在检测点云场景中超出预定义训练标签集的新物体。现有方法通过将传统三维目标检测器与视觉-语言模型(VLMs)连接,利用三维与二维特征间的跨模态对齐,回归新物体的三维边界框并执行开放词汇分类。然而,由于生成对应三维和二维特征对时存在语义不一致,实现稳健的跨模态对齐仍是一个挑战。为克服这一挑战,我们提出OV-SCAN,一个强制执行新颖物体发现语义一致对齐的开放词汇三维框架。OV-SCAN采用两项核心策略:发现精确的三维标注并过滤掉低质量或损坏的对齐对(由三维标注、遮挡或分辨率引起的噪声)。在nuScenes数据集上的大量实验表明,OV-SCAN实现了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D object detection for autonomous driving aims to detect novel objects beyond the predefined training label sets in point cloud scenes. Existing approaches achieve this by connecting traditional 3D object detectors with vision-language models (VLMs) to regress 3D bounding boxes for novel objects and perform open-vocabulary classification through cross-modal alignment between 3D and 2D features. However, achieving robust cross-modal alignment remains a challenge due to semantic inconsistencies when generating corresponding 3D and 2D feature pairs. To overcome this challenge, we present OV-SCAN, an Open-Vocabulary 3D framework that enforces Semantically Consistent Alignment for Novel object discovery. OV-SCAN employs two core strategies: discovering precise 3D annotations and filtering out low-quality or corrupted alignment pairs (arising from 3D annotation, occlusion-induced, or resolution-induced noise). Extensive experiments on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate that OV-SCAN achieves state-of-the-art performance.
authors: Adrian Chow, Evelien Riddell, Yimu Wang, Sean Sedwards, Krzysztof Czarnecki ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7990-8000

title: OV3D-CG:基于上下文引导的开放词汇三维实例分割
title_en: OV3D-CG: Open-vocabulary 3D Instance Segmentation with Contextual Guidance
abstract: 开放词汇三维实例分割(OV-3DIS)旨在对超出预定义类别的物体进行分割和分类,是具身智能应用的关键能力。现有方法依赖预训练的2D基础模型,聚焦实例级特征而忽视上下文关系,限制了其对罕见或模糊物体的泛化能力。为解决这些局限性,我们提出一种基于上下文信息引导的OV-3DIS框架。首先,我们采用无类别偏置的提议模块,将预训练的3D分割模型与SAM引导的分割器结合,提取鲁棒的3D实例掩码。随后,我们设计语义推理模块,为每个实例选择最佳视角并构建三个2D上下文感知表示。这些表示通过链式推理提示的多模态大语言模型进行处理,以增强语义推理能力。值得注意的是,我们的方法在ScanNet200和Replica数据集上超越了现有最先进方法,展示了卓越的开放词汇分割能力。此外,初步的现实场景实现验证了方法的鲁棒性和准确性,突显了其在物体驱动导航等具身智能任务中的潜力。我们的项目页面为:https://vipl-vsu.github.io/OV3D-CG/
abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation (OV-3DIS), which aims to segment and classify objects beyond predefined categories, is a critical capability for embodied AI applications. Existing methods rely on pre-trained 2D foundation models, focusing on instance-level features while overlooking contextual relationships, limiting their ability to generalize to rare or ambiguous objects. To address these limitations, we propose an OV-3DIS framework guided by contextual information. First, we employ a Class-agnostic Proposal Module, integrating a pre-trained 3D segmentation model with a SAM-guided segmenter to extract robust 3D instance masks. Subsequently, we design a Semantic Reasoning Module, which selects the best viewpoint for each instance and constructs three 2D context-aware representations. The representations are processed using Multimodal Large Language Models with Chain-of-Thought prompting to enhance semantic inference. Notably, our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods on the ScanNet200 and Replica datasets, demonstrating superior open-vocabulary segmentation capabilities. Moreover, preliminary implementation in real-world scenarios verifies our method's robustness and accuracy, highlighting its potential for embodied AI tasks such as object-driven navigation. Our project page is at: https://vipl-vsu.github.io/OV3D-CG/.
authors: Mingquan Zhou, Chen He, Ruiping Wang, Xilin Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5305-5314

title: OVA-Fields:面向机器人操作部件检测的弱监督开放词汇可操作性场
title_en: OVA-Fields: Weakly Supervised Open-Vocabulary Affordance Fields for Robot Operational Part Detection
abstract: 近年来,可操作性检测已成为机器人在现实场景中执行操作的关键技术,其中机器人必须自主理解指令并执行动作。现有方法多聚焦于单个点云对象或简单语义查询,限制了其在复杂场景和复杂指令中的有效性。为解决这一问题,我们提出OVA-Fields框架,用于复杂语义三维场景中的可操作性检测。通过融合多级几何编码与增强语义可操作性嵌入,OVA-Fields可将用户指令直接映射到操作部件,将丰富的可操作性信息嵌入三维场景。实验结果表明,OVA-Fields在复杂语义现实场景中达到52.4%的mIoU,在现实机器人操作任务(如"从冰箱中取出一些食物")中实现90%的成功率(使用RGB-D感知)。我们的方法实现了操作部件的精确识别,将自然语言查询转化为现实环境中的定向操作。
abstract_en: In recent years, affordance detection has become essential for robotic manipulation in real-world scenes, where robots must autonomously interpret commands and perform actions. Current methods often focus on individual point cloud objects or simple semantic queries, limiting their effectiveness in diverse scenes and complex instructions. To address this, we introduce OVA-Fields, a framework for affordance detection in 3D scenes with complex semantics. By integrating multilevel geometric encoding and enhanced semantic affordance embeddings, OVA-Fields maps user commands directly to operational parts, embedding enriched affordance information into the 3D scene. Experimental results demonstrate that OVA-Fields achieves 52.4% mIoU on complex semantic real-world scenes and 90% success rate in real-world robot manipulation tasks (e.g., "take out some food from the refrigerator") using RGB-D sensing. Our approach enables the precise identification of operational parts, transforming natural language queries into targeted manipulations in real-world environments.
authors: Heng Su, Mengying Xie, Nieqing Cao, Yan Ding, Beichen Shao, Xianlei Long, Fuqiang Gu, Chao Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6385-6395

title: OVG-HQ:基于混合模态查询的在线视频定位
title_en: OVG-HQ: Online Video Grounding with Hybrid-modal Queries
abstract: 视频定位(VG)任务旨在根据查询定位视频中的特定时刻,通常以文本形式给出。然而,传统视频定位方法在处理流媒体视频或使用视觉线索的查询等场景时存在困难。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种名为在线视频定位与混合模态查询(OVG-HQ)的新任务,该任务能够通过文本、图像、视频片段及其组合实现在线片段定位。该任务带来了两个新挑战:在线环境下上下文有限,以及训练过程中模态不平衡问题,其中主导模态会掩盖较弱模态。为了解决这些问题,我们提出了OVG-HQ-Unify,这是一个统一框架,包含一个使用神经网络参数动态保留过去上下文的参数化记忆块(PMB)以及一种指导非主导模态学习的跨模态蒸馏策略。由于缺乏合适的数据集,我们构建了QVHighlights-Unify数据集,该数据集包含多模态查询。此外,由于离线指标忽略了预测的及时性,我们将它们适配到在线环境中,引入了oR@n、IoU=m和在线平均精度(omAP)来评估准确性和效率。实验表明,我们的OVG-HQ-Unify在现有模型上表现更优,为在线混合模态视频定位提供了稳健的解决方案。我们将发布源代码和数据集。
abstract_en: Video grounding (VG) task focuses on locating specific moments in a video based on a query, usually in text form. However, traditional VG struggles with some scenarios like streaming video or queries using visual cues. To fill this gap, we present a new task named Online Video Grounding with Hybrid-modal Queries (OVG-HQ), which enables online segment localization using text, images, video segments, and their combinations. This task poses two new challenges: limited context in online settings and modality imbalance during training, where dominant modalities overshadow weaker ones. To address these, we propose OVG-HQ-Unify, a unified framework featuring a Parametric Memory Block (PMB) that uses neural network parameters to dynamically retain past context and a cross-modal distillation strategy that guides the learning of non-dominant modalities. This design enables a single model to effectively handle hybrid-modal queries. Due to the lack of suitable datasets, we construct QVHighlights-Unify, an expanded dataset with multi-modal queries. Besides, since offline metrics overlook prediction timeliness, we adapt them to the online setting, introducing oR@n, IoU=m, and online mean Average Precision (omAP) to evaluate both accuracy and efficiency. Experiments show that our OVG-HQ-Unify outperforms existing models, offering a robust solution for online, hybrid-modal video grounding. We will release our source code and dataset.
authors: Runhao Zeng, Jiaqi Mao, Minghao Lai, Minh Hieu Phan, Yanjie Dong, Wei Wang, Qi Chen, Xiping Hu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21085-21096

title: Oasis:仅需一张图像即可实现多模态指令数据合成
title_en: Oasis: One Image is All You Need for Multimodal Instruction Data Synthesis
abstract: 多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)的成功在很大程度上归功于大规模训练数据。然而,由于隐私问题,许多MLLMs的训练数据不可用。多模态数据收集过程昂贵且耗时耗力,进一步加剧了这一问题。是否可以在不损害多样性和质量的前提下自动合成多模态训练数据?本文提出了一种新方法Oasis,仅通过图像即可合成高质量的多模态数据。Oasis通过仅向MLLMs提示图像突破传统方法,从而大幅扩展数据多样性。我们的方法具有精细的质量控制机制以确保数据质量。我们收集了超过50万条数据并在LLaVA-NeXT上进行了增量实验。大量实验表明,我们的方法能显著提升MLLMs的性能。基于图像的合成还使我们能够专注于MLLMs的特定领域能力。代码和数据将公开可用。
abstract_en: The success of multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) has been largely attributed to the large-scale training data. However, the training data of many MLLMs is unavailable due to privacy concerns. The expensive and labor-intensive process of collecting multi-modal data further exacerbates the problem. Is it possible to synthesize multi-modal training data automatically without compromising diversity and quality? In this paper, we propose a new method, Oasis, to synthesize high-quality multi-modal data with only images. Oasis breaks through traditional methods by prompting only images to the MLLMs, thus extending the data diversity by a large margin. Our method features a delicate quality control method which ensures the data quality. We collected over 500k data and conducted incremental experiments on LLaVA-NeXT. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method can significantly improve the performance of MLLMs. The image-based synthesis also allows us to focus on the specific-domain ability of MLLMs. Code and data will be publicly available.
authors: Letian Zhang, Quan Cui, Bingchen Zhao, Cheng Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3542-3551

title: 以对象为中心的视频问答:结合视觉定位与指代
title_en: Object-centric Video Question Answering with Visual Grounding and Referring
abstract: 视频大语言模型(VideoLLMs)近期在通用视频理解方面取得了显著进展。然而,现有模型主要聚焦于高层理解,且仅限于文本响应,限制了其在以对象为中心的多轮交互中的灵活性。本文的贡献包括:(i) 我们通过引入一种名为**RGA3**的VideoLLM来解决这些限制,该模型能够以多轮对话方式执行视频推理任务中的对象指代与定位,即允许用户通过文本和视觉查询迭代地与视频进行交互;(ii) 我们提出**STOM**(时空叠加模块),一种新颖方法,可对视频中任意时间戳的任意视觉提示进行处理;(iii) 我们展示了**VideoInfer**,一个手动构建的以对象为中心的视频指令数据集,包含需要推理的问答对。我们在VideoInfer及其他现有基准数据集上进行了全面实验,涵盖视频问答和指代视频对象分割任务。在涵盖6个任务的12个基准测试中,RGA3在视频问答和分割任务中均优于基线模型,突显了其在多模态、以对象为中心的视频和图像理解中的鲁棒性。代码、数据集和网页演示将公开发布。
abstract_en: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) have recently demonstrated remarkable progress in general video understanding. However, existing models primarily focus on high-level comprehension and are limited to text-only responses, restricting the flexibility for object-centric, multi-round interactions. In this paper, we make three contributions:(i) we address these limitations by introducing a VideoLLM, termed as **RGA3**, capable of performing both object referring and grounding for video reasoning tasks in a multi-round conversational manner, i.e., allowing users to iteratively interact with videos using both textual and visual queries; (ii) we propose **STOM** (Spatial-Temporal Overlay Module), a novel approach that allows arbitrary visual prompts to be processed at any timestamp within a video;(iii) we present **VideoInfer**, a manually curated object-centric video instruction dataset featuring question-answering pairs that require reasoning. We conduct comprehensive experiments on VideoInfer and other existing benchmarks across video question answering and referring video object segmentation. The results on 12 benchmarks spanning 6 tasks show that RGA3 consistently outperforms baseline models in both video question answering and segmentation, underscoring its robustness in multimodal, object-centric video and image understanding. The code, dataset, and web demo will be publicly released.
authors: Haochen Wang, Qirui Chen, Cilin Yan, Jiayin Cai, Xiaolong Jiang, Yao Hu, Weidi Xie, Stratis Gavves ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22274-22284

title: 面向少样本分割的对象级相关性
title_en: Object-level Correlation for Few-Shot Segmentation
abstract: 少样本语义分割(FSS)旨在仅利用少量标注的支持样本,对查询图像中的新类别对象进行分割。现有方法主要建立支持目标对象与整个查询图像之间的图像级相关性。然而,这种相关性包含难以追踪和抑制的硬像素噪声,即无关背景对象,导致背景过拟合。为解决这一相关性的局限性,我们模仿生物视觉过程,在对象级信息中识别新对象。在通用对象中的目标识别比在整个图像中更为有效,尤其是在低数据量场景下。受此启发,我们通过建立支持目标对象与查询通用对象之间的对象级相关性,设计了对象级相关网络(OCNet),其主要由通用对象挖掘模块(GOMM)和相关性构建模块(CCM)组成。具体而言,GOMM通过学习显著性和高层相似性线索,构建查询通用对象特征,其中通用对象包括无关背景对象和目标前景对象。随后,CCM通过将目标原型分配到匹配通用对象特征,建立对象级相关性。生成的对象级相关性可挖掘查询目标特征,并抑制硬像素噪声以实现最终预测。在PASCAL-5i和COCO-20i上的大量实验表明,我们的模型达到了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Few-shot semantic segmentation (FSS) aims to segment objects of novel categories in the query images given only a few annotated support samples. Existing methods primarily build the image-level correlation between the support target object and the entire query image. However, this correlation contains the hard pixel noise, i.e., irrelevant background objects, that is intractable to trace and suppress, leading to the overfitting of the background. To address the limitation of this correlation, we imitate the biological vision process to identify novel objects in the object-level information. Target identification in the general objects is more valid than in the entire image, especially in the low-data regime. Inspired by this, we design an Object-level Correlation Network (OCNet) by establishing the object-level correlation between the support target object and query general objects, which is mainly composed of the General Object Mining Module (GOMM) and Correlation Construction Module (CCM). Specifically, GOMM constructs the query general object feature by learning saliency and high-level similarity cues, where the general objects include the irrelevant background objects and the target foreground object. Then, CCM establishes the object-level correlation by allocating the target prototypes to match the general object feature. The generated object-level correlation can mine the query target feature and suppress the hard pixel noise for the final prediction. Extensive experiments on PASCAL-5i and COCO-20i show that our model achieves the state-of-the-art performance.
authors: Chunlin Wen, Yu Zhang, Jie Fan, Hongyuan Zhu, Xiu-Shen Wei, Yijun Wang, Zhiqiang Kou, Shuzhou Sun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23689-23699

title: ObjectGS: 基于高斯点云的物体感知场景重建与语义理解
title_en: ObjectGS: Object-aware Scene Reconstruction and Scene Understanding via Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 3D高斯点云技术以其高保真重建能力和实时新视角合成能力而闻名,但其缺乏语义理解能力限制了物体级感知。在本工作中,我们提出ObjectGS,一个将3D场景重建与语义理解统一的物体感知框架。与将场景视为统一整体不同,ObjectGS将单个物体建模为局部锚点,生成神经高斯分布并共享物体ID,从而实现精确的物体级重建。在训练过程中,我们动态扩展或修剪这些锚点并优化其特征,同时通过one-hot ID编码与分类损失施加明确的语义约束。我们通过大量实验表明,ObjectGS不仅在开放词汇和全景分割任务上超越了现有最先进方法,还能无缝集成到网格提取和场景编辑等应用中。
abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting is renowned for its high-fidelity reconstructions and real-time novel view synthesis, yet its lack of semantic understanding limits object-level perception. In this work, we propose ObjectGS, an object-aware framework that unifies 3D scene reconstruction with semantic understanding. Instead of treating the scene as a unified whole, ObjectGS models individual objects as local anchors that generate neural Gaussians and share object IDs, enabling precise object-level reconstruction. During training, we dynamically grow or prune these anchors and optimize their features, while a one-hot ID encoding with a classification loss enforces clear semantic constraints. We show through extensive experiments that ObjectGS not only outperforms state-of-the-art methods on open-vocabulary and panoptic segmentation tasks, but also integrates seamlessly with applications like mesh extraction and scene editing.
authors: Ruijie Zhu, Mulin Yu, Linning Xu, Lihan Jiang, Yixuan Li, Tianzhu Zhang, Jiangmiao Pang, Bo Dai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8350-8360

title: ObjectMate: 一种用于物体插入与主题驱动生成的递归先验
title_en: ObjectMate: A Recurrence Prior for Object Insertion and Subject-Driven Generation
