abstract: 本文提出了一种无需调参的方法,用于物体插入与主题驱动生成。该任务涉及根据多个视角将物体组合到由图像或文本指定的场景中。现有方法难以充分满足任务的挑战性目标:(i) 以逼真姿态与光照无缝融合物体到场景中,(ii) 保持物体的身份特征。我们假设实现这些目标需要大规模监督,但手动收集足够数据成本过高。本文的关键观察是:在大规模未标注数据集中,许多批量生产物体会在不同场景、姿态与光照条件下多次出现。我们通过检索相同物体的多样化视角集合,创建了大量监督数据。这一强大配对数据集使我们能够训练一个简单的文本到图像扩散架构,将物体与场景描述映射到合成图像。我们通过单个或多个参考对比了ObjectMate与现有物体插入和主题驱动生成方法。实验证明,ObjectMate在身份保持和逼真融合方面表现更优。与许多多参考方法不同,ObjectMate无需慢速测试时调参。
abstract_en: This paper introduces a tuning-free method for both object insertion and subject-driven generation. The task involves composing an object, given multiple views, into a scene specified by either an image or text. Existing methods struggle to fully meet the task's challenging objectives: (i) seamlessly composing the object into the scene with photorealistic pose and lighting, and (ii) preserving the object's identity. We hypothesize that achieving these goals requires large-scale supervision, but manually collecting sufficient data is simply too expensive. The key observation in this paper is that many mass-produced objects recur across multiple images of large unlabeled datasets, in different scenes, poses, and lighting conditions. We use this observation to create massive supervision by retrieving sets of diverse views of the same object. This powerful paired dataset enables us to train a straightforward text-to-image diffusion architecture to map the object and scene descriptions to the composite image. We compare our method, ObjectMate, with state-of-the-art methods for object insertion and subject-driven generation, using a single or multiple references. Empirically, ObjectMate achieves superior identity preservation and more photorealistic composition. Differently from many other multi-reference methods, ObjectMate does not require slow test-time tuning.
authors: Daniel Winter, Asaf Shul, Matan Cohen, Dana Berman, Yael Pritch, Alex Rav-Acha, Yedid Hoshen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16281-16291

title: ObjectRelator:实现以自我为中心与非自我中心视角下的跨视角物体关系理解
title_en: ObjectRelator: Enabling Cross-View Object Relation Understanding Across Ego-Centric and Exo-Centric Perspectives
abstract: 弥合以自我为中心视角与非自我中心视角之间的差距一直是计算机视觉领域的长期问题。本文聚焦于新兴的Ego-Exo物体对应任务,旨在通过分割理解不同视角下的物体关系。尽管已提出众多分割模型,但大多数仅适用于单张图像(视角),难以应用于跨视角场景。PSALM作为一种最近提出的分割方法,因其在该任务中展现出的零样本能力而成为显著例外。然而,由于以自我为中心视角与非自我中心视角之间存在剧烈的视角变化,PSALM在复杂背景或物体外观显著变化时,无法准确定位和分割物体。为解决这些问题,我们提出ObjectRelator,一种包含两个关键模块的新型方法:多模态条件融合(MCFuse)和基于自监督学习的跨视角物体对齐(XObjAlign)。MCFuse引入语言作为额外线索,整合视觉掩码与文本描述以提升物体定位并防止错误关联。XObjAlign通过自监督对齐强制跨视角一致性,增强对物体外观变化的鲁棒性。大量实验表明,ObjectRelator在大规模Ego-Exo4D基准和HANDAL-X(用于跨视角分割的改编数据集)上均表现出最先进的性能。代码可访问:http://yuqianfu.com/ObjectRelator
abstract_en: Bridging the gap between ego-centric and exo-centric views has been a long-standing question in computer vision. In this paper, we focus on the emerging Ego-Exo object correspondence task, which aims to understand object relations across ego-exo perspectives through segmentation. While numerous segmentation models have been proposed, most operate on a single image (view), making them impractical for cross-view scenarios. PSALM, a recently proposed segmentation method, stands out as a notable exception with its demonstrated zero-shot ability on this task. However, due to the drastic viewpoint change between ego and exo, PSALM fails to accurately locate and segment objects, especially in complex backgrounds or when object appearances change significantly. To address these issues, we propose ObjectRelator, a novel approach featuring two key modules: Multimodal Condition Fusion (MCFuse) and SSL-based Cross-View Object Alignment (XObjAlign). MCFuse introduces language as an additional cue, integrating both visual masks and textual descriptions to improve object localization and prevent incorrect associations. XObjAlign enforces cross-view consistency through self-supervised alignment, enhancing robustness to object appearance variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate ObjectRelator's effectiveness on the large-scale Ego-Exo4D benchmark and HANDAL-X (an adapted dataset for cross-view segmentation) with state-of-the-art performance. Code is available at: http://yuqianfu.com/ObjectRelator.
authors: Yuqian Fu, Runze Wang, Bin Ren, Guolei Sun, Biao Gong, Yanwei Fu, Danda Pani Paudel, Xuanjing Huang, Luc Van Gool ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6530-6540

title: OcRFDet: 以物体为中心的辐射场用于自动驾驶中的多视角三维目标检测
title_en: OcRFDet: Object-Centric Radiance Fields for Multi-View 3D Object Detection in Autonomous Driving
abstract: 当前多视角三维目标检测方法通常通过深度估计或三维位置编码将二维特征转换到三维空间,但这种完全数据驱动且隐式的方式限制了检测性能。受辐射场在三维重建中的成功启发,我们假设其可用于增强检测器对三维几何的估计能力。然而,当我们直接将其用于三维渲染作为辅助任务时,检测性能出现下降。通过分析,我们发现性能下降是由于渲染整个场景时背景区域的强响应所致。为解决此问题,我们提出以物体为中心的辐射场,专注于建模前景物体并丢弃背景噪声。具体而言,我们通过渲染前景物体的辅助任务,利用以物体为中心的辐射场(OcRF)增强三维体素特征。进一步地,我们利用渲染过程中产生的不透明度作为副产品,通过高度感知的基于不透明度的注意力机制(HOA)增强二维前景鸟瞰图(BEV)特征,其中不同高度层级的注意力图由多个并行网络分别生成。在nuScenes验证集和测试集上的大量实验表明,我们的OcRFDet在nuScenes测试基准上取得了优越性能,以57.2%的mAP和64.8%的NDS超越了先前的最先进方法。
abstract_en: Current multi-view 3D object detection methods typically transfer 2D features into 3D space using depth estimation or 3D position encoder, but in a fully data-driven and implicit manner, which limits the detection performance. Inspired by the success of radiance fields on 3D reconstruction, we assume they can be used to enhance the detector's ability of 3D geometry estimation. However, we observe a decline in detection performance, when we directly use them for 3D rendering as an auxiliary task. From our analysis, we find the performance drop is caused by the strong responses on the background when rendering the whole scene. To address this problem, we propose object-centric radiance fields, focusing on modeling foreground objects while discarding background noises. Specifically, we employ object-centric radiance fields (OcRF) to enhance 3D voxel features via an auxiliary task of rendering foreground objects. We further use opacity - the side-product of rendering- to enhance the 2D foreground BEV features via height-aware opacity-based attention (HOA), where attention maps at different height levels are generated separately via multiple networks in parallel. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes validation and test datasets demonstrate that our OcRFDet achieves superior performance, outperforming previous state-of-the-art methods with 57.2% mAP and 64.8% NDS on the nuScenes test benchmark.
authors: Mingqian Ji, Shanshan Zhang, Jian Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24933-24942

title: OccluGaussian:面向大场景重建与渲染的遮挡感知高斯泼溅
title_en: OccluGaussian: Occlusion-Aware Gaussian Splatting for Large Scene Reconstruction and Rendering
abstract: 在使用三维高斯泼溅进行大规模场景重建时,通常将场景划分为多个较小区域并分别进行重建。然而,现有划分方法缺乏遮挡感知,意味着每个区域可能包含严重遮挡的区域。因此,这些区域内的相机之间相关性较低,导致对整体重建的平均贡献较低。本文提出了一种遮挡感知的场景划分策略,基于相机的位置和共视性对训练相机进行聚类,以获取多个区域。此类区域内的相机表现出更强的相关性及更高的平均贡献,从而实现高质量的场景重建。我们进一步提出一种基于区域的渲染技术以加速大规模场景渲染,该技术会剔除在当前视点所在区域不可见的高斯点。这种技术显著提升了渲染速度而不会牺牲质量。在多个大规模场景上的大量实验表明,与现有最先进的方法相比,我们的方法在重建效果和渲染速度方面均具有优势。项目页面:https://occlugaussian.github.io.
abstract_en: In large-scale scene reconstruction using 3D Gaussian splatting, it is common to partition the scene into multiple smaller regions and reconstruct them individually. However, existing division methods are occlusion-agnostic, meaning that each region may contain areas with severe occlusions. As a result, the cameras within those regions are less correlated, leading to a low average contribution to the overall reconstruction. In this paper, we propose an occlusion-aware scene division strategy that clusters training cameras based on their positions and co-visibilities to acquire multiple regions. Cameras in such regions exhibit stronger correlations and a higher average contribution, facilitating high-quality scene reconstruction. We further propose a region-based rendering technique to accelerate large scene rendering, which culls Gaussians invisible to the region where the viewpoint is located. Such a technique significantly speeds up the rendering without compromising quality. Extensive experiments on multiple large scenes show that our method achieves superior reconstruction results with faster rendering speeds compared to existing state-of-the-art approaches. Project page: https://occlugaussian.github.io.
authors: Shiyong Liu, Xiao Tang, Zhihao Li, Yingfan He, Chongjie Ye, Jianzhuang Liu, Binxiao Huang, Shunbo Zhou, Xiaofei Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26643-26652

title: 基于手绘的3D动画的抗遮挡风格化
title_en: Occlusion-robust Stylization for Drawing-based 3D Animation
abstract: 3D动画旨在从输入图像和目标3D运动序列生成3D动画视频。近期图像到3D模型的进展使得可以直接从用户手绘图生成动画。与传统3D动画不同,基于手绘的3D动画需要保留艺术家独特的风格属性,如粗糙轮廓和独特的笔触模式。然而,现有方法在遮挡情况下仍会出现风格属性质量下降,尤其是由重叠身体部位引起的遮挡导致轮廓闪烁和笔触模糊。这源于风格化网络在训练和推理阶段存在的`风格化姿态差距',即用于训练风格化网络的目标姿态始终为无遮挡姿态,而推理阶段遇到的目标姿态包含动态运动下的多样化遮挡。为此,我们提出基于手绘的3D动画的抗遮挡风格化框架(OSF)。我们发现,虽然使用物体边缘作为输入先验可有效引导风格化,但在推理阶段出现遮挡时会显著不准确。因此,我们提出的OSF利用光流为风格化网络提供抗遮挡边缘引导,确保在遮挡下仍能保持一致的风格化。此外,OSF采用单次运行方式而非之前的两阶段方法,实现2.4倍更快的推理速度和2.1倍更低的内存占用。项目地址:github.io/Drawing-based-3D-Animation-page.
abstract_en: 3D animation aims to generate a 3D animated video from an input image and a target 3D motion sequence. Recent advances in image-to-3D models enable the creation of animations directly from user-hand drawings. Distinguished from conventional 3D animation, drawing-based 3D animation is crucial to preserve artist's unique style properties, such as rough contours and distinct stroke patterns. However, recent methods still exhibit quality deterioration in style properties, especially under occlusions caused by overlapping body parts, leading to contour flickering and stroke blurring. This occurs due to a `stylization pose gap' between training and inference in stylization networks designed to preserve drawing styles in drawing-based 3D animation systems. The stylization pose gap denotes that input target poses used to train the stylization network are always in occlusion-free poses, while target poses encountered in an inference include diverse occlusions under dynamic motions. To this end, we propose Occlusion-robust Stylization Framework (OSF) for drawing-based 3D animation. We found that while employing object's edge can be effective input prior for guiding stylization, it becomes notably inaccurate when occlusions occur at inference. Thus, our proposed OSF provides occlusion-robust edge guidance for stylization network using optical flow, ensuring a consistent stylization even under occlusions. Furthermore, OSF operates in a single run instead of the previous two-stage method, achieving 2.4x faster inference and 2.1x less memory. Project is available at: github.io/Drawing-based-3D-Animation-page.
authors: Sunjae Yoon, Gwanhyeong Koo, Younghwan Lee, Ji Woo Hong, Chang D. Yoo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12263-12273

title: 基于时空记忆的空间占用学习
title_en: Occupancy Learning with Spatiotemporal Memory
abstract: 三维空间占用成为自动驾驶领域一种有前景的感知表示方法,用于以细粒度尺度建模周围环境。然而,由于高处理成本以及体素的不确定性和动态性,跨多个输入帧高效地随时间聚合三维空间占用仍具挑战性。为了解决这一问题,我们提出ST-Occ,这是一个场景级的空间占用表示学习框架,能够有效学习具有时间一致性的时空特征。ST-Occ包含两个核心设计:一个时空记忆模块,通过场景级表示高效捕获并存储全面的历史信息;以及一个记忆注意力机制,通过不确定性与动态感知模型将当前空间占用表示条件化于时空记忆。我们的方法通过利用多帧输入之间的时间依赖性,显著增强了用于三维空间占用预测任务的学习到的时空表示。实验表明,我们的方法在平均交并比(mIoU)上比现有最佳方法高出3个点,并将时间不一致性降低了29%。代码和模型可在https://github.com/matthew-leng/ST-Occ获取。
abstract_en: 3D occupancy becomes a promising perception representation for autonomous driving to model the surrounding environment at a fine-grained scale. However, it remains challenging to efficiently aggregate 3D occupancy over time across multiple input frames due to the high processing cost and the uncertainty and dynamics of voxels. To address this issue, we propose ST-Occ, a scene-level occupancy representation learning framework that effectively learns the spatiotemporal feature with temporal consistency. ST-Occ consists of two core designs: a spatiotemporal memory that captures comprehensive historical information and stores it efficiently through a scene-level representation, and a memory attention that conditions the current occupancy representation on the spatiotemporal memory with a model of uncertainty and dynamic awareness. Our method significantly enhances the spatiotemporal representation learned for 3D occupancy prediction tasks by exploiting the temporal dependency between multi-frame inputs. Experiments show that our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by a margin of 3 mIoU and reduces the temporal inconsistency by 29%. The code and model are available at https://github.com/matthew-leng/ST-Occ.
authors: Ziyang Leng, Jiawei Yang, Wenlong Yi, Bolei Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26569-26578

title: Omegance:一种用于扩散合成中多种粒度的单一参数
title_en: Omegance: A Single Parameter for Various Granularities in Diffusion-Based Synthesis
abstract: 本文展示了一种仅需单一参数ω即可有效控制扩散合成中粒度的方法。该参数在扩散模型逆过程的去噪步骤中被引入。这种简单方法无需模型重新训练或架构修改,计算开销可忽略不计,却能实现对生成输出细节水平的精确控制。此外,通过应用具有不同ω值的空间掩码或去噪时间表,可实现区域特定或时间步特定的粒度控制。外部控制信号或参考图像可引导创建精确的ω掩码,从而实现针对性的粒度调整。尽管方法简单,其在各类图像和视频合成任务中均展现出卓越性能,并可适配先进的扩散模型。代码已开源至https://github.com/itsmag11/Omegance。
abstract_en: In this work, we show that we only need a single parameter \omega to effectively control granularity in diffusion-based synthesis. This parameter is incorporated during the denoising steps of the diffusion model's reverse process. This simple approach does not require model retraining or architectural modifications and incurs negligible computational overhead, yet enables precise control over the level of details in the generated outputs. Moreover, spatial masks or denoising schedules with varying \omega values can be applied to achieve region-specific or timestep-specific granularity control. External control signals or reference images can guide the creation of precise \omega masks, allowing targeted granularity adjustments. Despite its simplicity, the method demonstrates impressive performance across various image and video synthesis tasks and is adaptable to advanced diffusion models. The code is available at https://github.com/itsmag11/Omegance.
authors: Xinyu Hou, Zongsheng Yue, Xiaoming Li, Chen Change Loy ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19353-19362

title: OminiControl:扩散Transformer的最小化与通用控制方法
title_en: OminiControl: Minimal and Universal Control for Diffusion Transformer
abstract: 我们提出OminiControl,一种重新思考图像条件如何整合到扩散Transformer(DiT)架构中的新方法。当前图像条件方法要么引入大量参数开销,要么仅能有效处理特定控制任务,限制了其实际应用的通用性。OminiControl通过三项关键创新解决这些局限:(1) 一种最小化的架构设计,利用DiT自身的VAE编码器和Transformer块,仅需额外0.1%的参数;(2) 一种统一的序列处理策略,将条件标记与图像标记结合以实现灵活的标记交互;(3) 一种动态位置编码机制,可适配空间对齐与非对齐的控制任务。我们的广泛实验表明,这种精简方法不仅在多种条件任务中达到甚至超越了专用方法的性能。为克服主题驱动生成的数据限制,我们还引入了Subjects200K数据集,该数据集通过DiT模型自身合成身份一致的图像对。本工作证明无需架构复杂性即可实现有效的图像控制,为高效且通用的图像生成系统开辟了新可能。
abstract_en: We present OminiControl, a novel approach that rethinks how image conditions are integrated into Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architectures. Current image conditioning methods either introduce substantial parameter overhead or handle only specific control tasks effectively, limiting their practical versatility. OminiControl addresses these limitations through three key innovations: (1) a minimal architectural design that leverages the DiT's own VAE encoder and transformer blocks, requiring just 0.1% additional parameters; (2) a unified sequence processing strategy that combines condition tokens with image tokens for flexible token interactions; and (3) a dynamic position encoding mechanism that adapts to both spatially-aligned and non-aligned control tasks. Our extensive experiments show that this streamlined approach not only matches but surpasses the performance of specialized methods across multiple conditioning tasks. To overcome data limitations in subject-driven generation, we also introduce Subjects200K, a large-scale dataset of identity-consistent image pairs synthesized using DiT models themselves. This work demonstrates that effective image control can be achieved without architectural complexity, opening new possibilities for efficient and versatile image generation systems.
authors: Zhenxiong Tan, Songhua Liu, Xingyi Yang, Qiaochu Xue, Xinchao Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14940-14950

title: 面向全景感知的点云几何增强方法用于坐标量化
title_en: Omni-scene Perception-oriented Point Cloud Geometry Enhancement for Coordinate Quantization
abstract: 信息量化已被广泛应用于多媒体内容,如图像、视频和点云。信息量化的目的是通过降低数据精度或冗余度实现高效存储和传输。然而,量化导致的信息失真会降低信号保真度和下游任务的性能。本文聚焦于点云的几何量化失真,提出了一种面向全景点云的统一学习基质量增强框架。基于几何量化失真的特性,我们分析并发现现有上采样方法在同时处理坐标量化引起的点减少和几何位移时并不具有竞争力。因此,我们设计了一种通用的根部生长-修剪范式,以高效感知量化点云的几何特征并显著提升质量。此外,提出了一种与量化步长参数相关的新型损失约束项,进一步提升质量并加速模型收敛。据我们所知,这是首个针对具有坐标量化的物体和场景点云的统一质量增强框架。大量实验验证了所提方法在不同量化失真程度的多尺度点云上的优越性,包括物体(ModelNet40, 8iVFB)和场景(KITTI)。特别是,增强后的点云提升了下游分析任务(包括分类和3D目标检测)的性能。
abstract_en: Information quantization has been widely adopted in multimedia content, such as images, videos, and point clouds. The goal of information quantization is to achieve efficient storage and transmission by reducing data precision or redundancy. However, the information distortion caused by quantization will lead to the degradation of signal fidelity and the performance of downstream tasks. This paper focuses on the geometry quantization distortion of point clouds and proposes a unified learning-based quality enhancement framework for omni-scene point clouds. Based on the characteristics of geometry quantization distortion, we analyze and find that existing upsampling methods are not competitive in dealing with point reduction and geometry displacement simultaneously caused by coordinate quantization. Therefore, we design a general rooting-growing-pruning paradigm to efficiently perceive the geometry feature of quantized point clouds and improve the quality significantly. In addition, a novel loss constraint term related to the quantization step parameter is proposed to further improve quality and accelerate model convergence. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first unified quality enhancement framework for object and scene point clouds with coordinate quantization. Extensive experiments verify the superiority of the proposed method on multi-scale point clouds with different levels of quantization distortion, including object (ModelNet40, 8iVFB) and scene (KITTI). In particular, the enhanced point clouds improve the performance of downstream analysis tasks, including classification and 3D object detection.
authors: Wang Liu, Wei Gao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26055-26064

title: OmniCache:一种面向轨迹的全局视角无训练缓存重用方法用于扩散Transformer模型
title_en: OmniCache: A Trajectory-Oriented Global Perspective on Training-Free Cache Reuse for Diffusion Transformer Models
abstract: 扩散模型已成为图像合成和视频生成等生成任务的强大范式,Transformer架构进一步提升了性能。然而,扩散Transformer模型的高计算成本——源于大量采样步骤和复杂的每步计算——对实时部署提出了显著挑战。本文提出OmniCache,一种无需训练的加速方法,利用去噪过程中固有的全局冗余。与现有基于步间相似性确定缓存策略的方法不同,我们的方法源自DIT模型的采样视角。我们系统分析模型的采样轨迹,并战略性地在整个采样过程中分配缓存重用。这种全局视角使缓存计算在整个扩散轨迹中更有效利用,而非局限于采样过程的有限段落。此外,在缓存重用过程中,我们动态估计相应噪声并过滤以减少其对采样方向的影响。大量实验表明,我们的方法在加速采样过程的同时保持了具有竞争力的生成质量,为基于扩散的生成模型的高效部署提供了有前景且实用的解决方案。
abstract_en: Diffusion models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for generative tasks such as image synthesis and video generation, with Transformer architectures further enhancing performance. However, the high computational cost of diffusion Transformers--stemming from a large number of sampling steps and complex per-step computations--presents significant challenges for real-time deployment. In this paper, we introduce OmniCache, a training-free acceleration method that exploits the global redundancy inherent in the denoising process. Unlike existing methods that determine caching strategies based on inter-step similarities and tend to prioritize reusing later sampling steps, our approach originates from the sampling perspective of DIT models. We systematically analyze the model's sampling trajectories and strategically distribute cache reuse across the entire sampling process. This global perspective enables more effective utilization of cached computations throughout the diffusion trajectory, rather than concentrating reuse within limited segments of the sampling procedure. In addition, during cache reuse, we dynamically estimate the corresponding noise and filter it out to reduce its impact on the sampling direction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach accelerates the sampling process while maintaining competitive generative quality, offering a promising and practical solution for efficient deployment of diffusion-based generative models.
authors: Huanpeng Chu, Wei Wu, Guanyu Feng, Yutao Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16302-16312

title: OmniDiff:细粒度图像差异描述的全面基准
title_en: OmniDiff: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Fine-grained Image Difference Captioning
abstract: 图像差异描述(IDC)旨在生成图像对之间细微差异的自然语言描述,需要同时实现精确的视觉变化定位和连贯的语义表达。尽管近期取得进展,现有数据集往往在广度和深度上存在不足,限制了其在复杂动态环境中的适用性:(1)从广度角度看,当前数据集局限于特定场景中物体的有限变化;(2)从深度角度看,先前基准常提供过于简化的描述。为解决这些挑战,我们引入OmniDiff,一个包含324个多样化场景的全面数据集——涵盖现实复杂环境和三维合成设置,包含平均长度为60词的细粒度人工标注,覆盖12种不同的变化类型。基于此基础,我们提出M3Diff,一种通过即插即用多尺度差异感知(MDP)模块增强的多模态大语言模型。该模块在保持基础模型泛化能力的同时,提升了模型准确识别和描述图像间差异的能力。借助OmniDiff数据集,M3Diff在多个基准测试中取得最先进性能,包括Spot-the-Diff、IEdit、CLEVR-Change、CLEVR-DC和OmniDiff,相较于现有方法在跨场景差异识别准确率上实现显著提升。数据集、代码和模型将公开发布以支持进一步研究。
abstract_en: Image Difference Captioning (IDC) aims to generate natural language descriptions of subtle differences between image pairs, requiring both precise visual change localization and coherent semantic expression. Despite recent advancements, existing datasets often lack breadth and depth, limiting their applicability in complex and dynamic environments: (1) from a breadth perspective, current datasets are constrained to limited variations of objects in specific scenes, and (2) from a depth perspective, prior benchmarks often provide overly simplistic descriptions. To address these challenges, we introduce OmniDiff, a comprehensive dataset comprising 324 diverse scenarios--spanning real-world complex environments and 3D synthetic settings--with fine-grained human annotations averaging 60 words in length and covering 12 distinct change types. Building on this foundation, we propose M3Diff, a Multi Modal large language model enhanced by a plug-and-play Multi-scale Differential Perception (MDP) module. This module improves the model's ability to accurately identify and describe inter-image differences while maintaining the foundational model's generalization capabilities. With the addition of the OmniDiff dataset, M3Diff achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks, including Spot-the-Diff, IEdit, CLEVR-Change, CLEVR-DC, and OmniDiff, demonstrating significant improvements in cross-scenario difference recognition accuracy compared to existing methods. The dataset, code, and models will be made publicly available to support further research.
authors: Yuan Liu, Saihui Hou, Saijie Hou, Jiabao Du, Shibei Meng, Yongzhen Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21440-21449

title: OmniHuman-1:重新思考单阶段条件化人动画模型的扩展
title_en: OmniHuman-1: Rethinking the Scaling-Up of One-Stage Conditioned Human Animation Models
abstract: 端到端的人体动画,如音频驱动的说话人生成,在近年来取得了显著进展。然而,现有方法仍难以像大型通用视频生成模型那样进行扩展,限制了其在实际应用中的潜力。本文提出OmniHuman,这是一个基于扩散变换器的框架,通过将与运动相关的条件融入训练阶段来实现数据扩展。为此,我们引入了两种针对混合条件的训练原则,以及相应的模型架构和推理策略。这些设计使OmniHuman能够充分利用数据驱动的运动生成,最终实现高度逼真的人体视频生成。更重要的是,OmniHuman支持多种人像内容(特写、人像、半身、全身),支持说话和唱歌,处理人与物体的交互以及具有挑战性的身体姿态,并适应不同的图像风格。与现有的端到端音频驱动方法相比,OmniHuman不仅生成更逼真的视频,还提供了更大的输入灵活性。它还支持多种驱动模态(音频驱动、视频驱动和组合驱动信号)。
abstract_en: End-to-end human animation, such as audio-driven talking human generation, has undergone notable advancements in the recent few years. However, existing methods still struggle to scale up as large general video generation models, limiting their potential in real applications. In this paper, we propose OmniHuman, a Diffusion Transformer-based framework that scales up data by mixing motion-related conditions into the training phase. To this end, we introduce two training principles for these mixed conditions, along with the corresponding model architecture and inference strategy. These designs enable OmniHuman to fully leverage data-driven motion generation, ultimately achieving highly realistic human video generation. More importantly, OmniHuman supports various portrait contents (face close-up, portrait, half-body, full-body), supports both talking and singing, handles human-object interactions and challenging body poses, and accommodates different image styles. Compared to existing end-to-end audio-driven methods, OmniHuman not only produces more realistic videos, but also offers greater flexibility in inputs. It also supports multiple driving modalities (audio-driven, video-driven and combined driving signals).
authors: Gaojie Lin, Jianwen Jiang, Jiaqi Yang, Zerong Zheng, Chao Liang, Yuan Zhang, Jingtuo Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13847-13858

title: OmniPaint: 通过解耦的插入-移除修复实现面向对象的编辑
title_en: OmniPaint: Mastering Object-Oriented Editing via Disentangled Insertion-Removal Inpainting
abstract: 基于扩散的生成模型已革新了面向对象的图像编辑,但其在现实场景中的物体移除与插入应用仍受限于物理效应的复杂交互及配对训练数据不足等挑战。本文提出OmniPaint,一个统一框架,将物体移除与插入重新定义为相互关联的过程而非独立任务。通过结合预训练的扩散先验模型与包含初始配对样本优化及后续大规模非配对精修的渐进式训练流程(CycleFlow),OmniPaint实现了精确的前景消除与无缝的物体插入,同时忠实保持场景几何结构与内在属性。此外,我们提出的CFD度量指标提供了一种无需参考的上下文一致性与物体幻觉评估方法,建立了高保真图像编辑的新基准。
abstract_en: Diffusion-based generative models have revolutionized object-oriented image editing, yet their deployment in realistic object removal and insertion remains hampered by challenges such as the intricate interplay of physical effects and insufficient paired training data. In this work, we introduce OmniPaint, a unified framework that re-conceptualizes object removal and insertion as interdependent processes rather than isolated tasks. Leveraging a pre-trained diffusion prior along with a progressive training pipeline comprising initial paired sample optimization and subsequent large-scale unpaired refinement via CycleFlow, OmniPaint achieves precise foreground elimination and seamless object insertion while faithfully preserving scene geometry and intrinsic properties. Furthermore, our novel CFD metric offers a robust, reference-free evaluation of context consistency and object hallucination, establishing a new benchmark for high-fidelity image editing.
authors: Yongsheng Yu, Ziyun Zeng, Haitian Zheng, Jiebo Luo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17324-17334

title: OmniSAM:面向全景语义分割的全向Segment Anything模型用于无监督域适应
title_en: OmniSAM: Omnidirectional Segment Anything Model for UDA in Panoramic Semantic Segmentation
abstract: Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) 已成为多种针孔成像分割任务中的强大基础模型。然而,当将其应用于360°域时,针孔成像(70°×70°)与全景图像(180°×360°)之间显著的视场角(FoV)差距带来了独特挑战。该应用的两大主要问题包括:1)域间大FoV差异导致的不可避免的失真和物体形变;2)原始SAM2无法提供的像素级语义理解能力。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新颖的OmniSAM框架,首次尝试将SAM2应用于全景语义分割。具体而言,为弥合第一类差距,OmniSAM首先将全景图像分割为一系列补丁,随后以类似视频分割任务的方式将这些补丁视为图像序列。我们随后利用SAM2的记忆机制提取跨补丁对应关系,嵌入跨FoV依赖性,提升特征连续性及掩码边界处的预测一致性。针对第二类差距,OmniSAM对预训练图像编码器进行微调,并重新利用掩码解码器进行语义预测。同时引入基于FoV的原型适应模块与动态伪标签更新机制,以促进记忆与主干特征的对齐,从而提升模型在不同规模源模型间的泛化能力。大量实验结果表明,我们的方法在多个数据集上显著超越了最先进方法,例如在SPin8-to-SPan8上达到79.06%(↑10.22%),在CS13-to-DP13上达到62.46%(↑6.58%)。
abstract_en: Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) has emerged as a strong base model in various pinhole imaging segmentation tasks. However, when applying it to 360^\circ domain, the significant field-of-view (FoV) gap between pinhole (70^\circ x70^\circ) and panoramic images (180^\circ x360^\circ) poses unique challenges. Two major concerns for this application includes 1) inevitable distortion and object deformation brought by the large FoV disparity between domains; 2) the lack of pixel-level semantic understanding that the original SAM2 cannot provide. To address these issues, we propose a novel OmniSAM framework, which makes the first attempt to apply SAM2 for panoramic semantic segmentation. Specifically, to bridge the first gap, OmniSAM first divides the panorama into sequences of patches. These patches are then treated as image sequences in similar manners as in video segmentation tasks. We then leverage the SAM2's memory mechanism to extract cross-patch correspondences that embeds the cross-FoV dependencies, improving feature continuity and the prediction consistency along mask boundaries. For the second gap, OmniSAM fine-tunes the pretrained image encoder and reutilize the mask decoder for semantic prediction. An FoV-based prototypical adaptation module with dynamic pseudo label update mechanism is also introduced to facilitate the alignment of memory and backbone features, thereby improving model generalization ability across different sizes of source models. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by large margins, e.g., 79.06% (10.22%\uparrow) on SPin8-to-SPan8, 62.46% (6.58%\uparrow) on CS13-to-DP13.
authors: Ding Zhong, Xu Zheng, Chenfei Liao, Yuanhuiyi Lyu, Jialei Chen, Shengyang Wu, Linfeng Zhang, Xuming Hu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23892-23901

title: OmniVTON:无需训练的通用虚拟试穿
title_en: OmniVTON: Training-Free Universal Virtual Try-On
abstract: 基于图像的虚拟试穿(VTON)技术依赖于监督式店内方法,虽然能保证高保真度但难以实现跨域泛化,或无监督野外方法,虽然提升了适应性但受限于数据偏差和有限的通用性。一种统一的无需训练的解决方案在两种场景中均有效仍是一个开放性挑战。我们提出OmniVTON,这是首个无需训练的通用VTON框架,通过解耦服装与姿态条件,实现多样场景下的纹理保真度与姿态一致性。为保留服装细节,我们引入服装先验生成机制,使服装与人体对齐,随后采用连续边界缝合技术实现细粒度纹理保留。为实现精确姿态对齐,我们利用DDIM反演捕捉结构特征同时抑制纹理干扰,确保与原图纹理无关的准确人体对齐。通过解耦服装与姿态约束,OmniVTON消除了扩散模型在处理多条件时固有的偏差。实验结果表明,OmniVTON在多样化数据集、服装类型和应用场景中均表现出优越性能。值得注意的是,这是首个支持多人体VTON的框架,能够在单场景中实现多人的逼真服装迁移。代码可在https://github.com/Jerome-Young/OmniVTON获取。
abstract_en: Image-based Virtual Try-On (VTON) techniques rely on either supervised in-shop approaches, which ensure high fidelity but struggle with cross-domain generalization, or unsupervised in-the-wild methods, which improve adaptability but remain constrained by data biases and limited universality. A unified, training-free solution that works across both scenarios remains an open challenge. We propose OmniVTON, the first training-free universal VTON framework that decouples garment and pose conditioning to achieve both texture fidelity and pose consistency across diverse settings. To preserve garment details, we introduce a garment prior generation mechanism that aligns clothing with the body, followed by continuous boundary stitching technique to achieve fine-grained texture retention. For precise pose alignment, we utilize DDIM inversion to capture structural cues while suppressing texture interference, ensuring accurate body alignment independent of the original image textures. By disentangling garment and pose constraints, OmniVTON eliminates the bias inherent in diffusion models when handling multiple conditions simultaneously. Experimental results demonstrate that OmniVTON achieves superior performance across diverse datasets, garment types, and application scenarios. Notably, it is the first framework capable of multi-human VTON, enabling realistic garment transfer across multiple individuals in a single scene. Code is available at https://github.com/Jerome-Young/OmniVTON.
authors: Zhaotong Yang, Yuhui Li, Shengfeng He, Xinzhe Li, Yangyang Xu, Junyu Dong, Yong Du ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16702-16711

title: 大规模多模态模型作为开放世界图像分类器的研究
title_en: On Large Multimodal Models as Open-World Image Classifiers
abstract: 传统图像分类需要预定义的语义类别列表。相比之下,大规模多模态模型(LMMs)可以通过直接使用自然语言对图像进行分类,从而绕过这一要求(例如,回答“图像中的主要物体是什么?”的提示)。尽管具备这一显著能力,现有大多数关于LMM分类性能的研究在范围上却出人意料地有限,通常假设在预定义类别的封闭世界设定中。在本工作中,我们通过在真正开放世界环境中全面评估LMM分类性能来填补这一研究空白。我们首先形式化该任务并引入评估协议,定义多种指标以衡量预测类别与真实类别之间的对齐程度。随后,我们在10个基准数据集上评估了13个模型,涵盖原型类、非原型类、细粒度类和超细粒度类,展示了LMM在此任务中面临的挑战。基于所提出指标的进一步分析揭示了LMM所犯的错误类型,突显了与粒度和细粒度能力相关的挑战,并展示了如何通过定制提示和推理来缓解这些问题。
abstract_en: Traditional image classification requires a predefined list of semantic categories. In contrast, Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) can sidestep this requirement by classifying images directly using natural language (e.g., answering the prompt "What is the main object in the image?"). Despite this remarkable capability, most existing studies on LMM classification performance are surprisingly limited in scope, often assuming a closed-world setting with a predefined set of categories. In this work, we address this gap by thoroughly evaluating LMM classification performance in a truly open-world setting. We first formalize the task and introduce an evaluation protocol, defining various metrics to assess the alignment between predicted and ground truth classes. We then evaluate 13 models across 10 benchmarks, encompassing prototypical, non-prototypical, fine-grained, and very fine-grained classes, demonstrating the challenges LMMs face in this task. Further analyses based on the proposed metrics reveal the types of errors LMMs make, highlighting challenges related to granularity and fine-grained capabilities, showing how tailored prompting and reasoning can alleviate them.
authors: Alessandro Conti, Massimiliano Mancini, Enrico Fini, Yiming Wang, Paolo Rota, Elisa Ricci ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16388-16398

title: 基于梯度的解释中的复杂性-忠实性权衡
title_en: On the Complexity-Faithfulness Trade-off of Gradient-Based Explanations
abstract: 尽管ReLU网络在视觉数据处理中广泛使用,但其具有尖锐的过渡特性,有时会依赖单个像素进行预测,导致原始梯度解释存在噪声且难以解释。现有方法(如GradCAM)通过生成替代模型来平滑这些解释,但以牺牲忠实性为代价。我们引入一个统一的谱框架,系统地分析和量化解释中的平滑性、忠实性及其权衡关系。利用该框架,我们量化并规范ReLU网络对高频信息的贡献,提供了一种识别该权衡关系的原则性方法。我们的分析揭示了基于替代模型的平滑如何扭曲解释,导致所谓的"解释差距",我们对此进行了形式化定义并针对不同事后方法进行了测量。最后,我们在不同的设计选择、数据集和消融实验中验证了我们的理论发现。
abstract_en: ReLU networks, while prevalent for visual data, have sharp transitions, sometimes relying on individual pixels for predictions, making vanilla gradient-based explanations noisy and difficult to interpret. Existing methods, such as GradCAM, smooth these explanations by producing surrogate models at the cost of faithfulness. We introduce a unifying spectral framework to systematically analyze and quantify smoothness, faithfulness, and their trade-off in explanations.Using this framework, we quantify and regularize the contribution of ReLU networks to high-frequency information, providing a principled approach to identifying this trade-off. Our analysis characterizes how surrogate-based smoothing distorts explanations, leading to an "explanation gap" that we formally define and measure for different post-hoc methods.Finally, we validate our theoretical findings across different design choices, datasets, and ablations.
authors: Amir Mehrpanah, Matteo Gamba, Kevin Smith, Hossein Azizpour ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3531-3541

title: 地球观测中表征不确定性的泛化研究
title_en: On the Generalization of Representation Uncertainty in Earth Observation
abstract: 近年来计算机视觉领域的进展引入了预训练表示不确定性概念,实现了零样本不确定性估计。这一技术对地球观测(EO)具有重要潜在价值,因为在EO领域可信度至关重要,但EO数据的复杂性给不确定性感知方法带来了挑战。本研究探讨了EO领域中表示不确定性的泛化能力,考虑了该领域独特的语义特征。我们基于大型EO数据集预训练不确定性,并提出评估框架以评估其在多标签分类和分割EO任务中的零样本性能。研究发现,与自然图像预训练的不确定性不同,EO预训练在未见EO领域、地理区域和目标粒度上展现出强大的泛化能力,同时保持对地面采样距离变化的敏感性。我们展示了预训练不确定性的实用价值,证明其在下游任务中与任务特定不确定性的一致性,对现实EO图像噪声的敏感性,以及能够直接生成空间不确定性估计的能力。本研究开启了关于EO中表示不确定性的讨论,提供了其优势与局限性的见解,为该领域的未来研究铺平道路。代码和权重可在:https://github.com/Orion-AI-Lab/EOUncertaintyGeneralization 获取。
abstract_en: Recent advances in Computer Vision have introduced the concept of pretrained representation uncertainty, enabling zero-shot uncertainty estimation. This holds significant potential for Earth Observation (EO), where trustworthiness is critical, yet the complexity of EO data poses challenges to uncertainty-aware methods. In this work, we investigate the generalization of representation uncertainty in EO, considering the domain's unique semantic characteristics. We pretrain uncertainties on large EO datasets and propose an evaluation framework to assess their zero-shot performance in multi-label classification and segmentation EO tasks. Our findings reveal that, unlike uncertainties pretrained on natural images, EO-pretraining exhibits strong generalization across unseen EO domains, geographic locations, and target granularities, while maintaining sensitivity to variations in ground sampling distance. We demonstrate the practical utility of pretrained uncertainties showcasing their alignment with task-specific uncertainties in downstream tasks, their sensitivity to real-world EO image noise, and their ability to generate spatial uncertainty estimates out-of-the-box. Initiating the discussion on representation uncertainty in EO, our study provides insights into its strengths and limitations, paving the way for future research in the field. Code and weights are available at: https://github.com/Orion-AI-Lab/EOUncertaintyGeneralization.
authors: Spyros Kondylatos, Nikolaos Ioannis Bountos, Dimitrios Michail, Xiao Xiang Zhu, Gustau Camps-Valls, Ioannis Papoutsis ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6552-6562

title: 梯度在自主语言辅助图像聚类中的可证明重要性
title_en: On the Provable Importance of Gradients for Autonomous Language-Assisted Image Clustering
abstract: 本文研究了近期出现的语言辅助图像聚类(LaIC)问题,其中通过文本语义提升视觉表示的可区分性以促进图像聚类。由于缺乏真实的类别名称,LaIC的核心挑战之一在于如何从无标签的野生语料库数据中过滤出与目标图像语义相近的正向名词。现有过滤策略主要基于CLIP学习的现成特征空间,尽管直观,但缺乏严格的理论基础。为填补这一空白,我们提出了一种新型基于梯度的框架GradNorm,该框架具有理论保证且表现出色。具体而言,我们通过交叉熵损失与softmax输出之间的梯度反向传播的梯度幅度来衡量每个名词的正性。理论上,我们提供了严格的误差界以量化GradNorm对正向名词的可分性,并证明GradNorm自然包含现有过滤策略作为其极端特殊情形。实验上,大量实验证明GradNorm在多个基准数据集上实现了最先进的聚类性能。
abstract_en: This paper investigates the recently emerged problem of Language-assisted Image Clustering (LaIC), where textual semantics are leveraged to improve the discriminability of visual representations to facilitate image clustering. Due to the unavailability of true class names, one of core challenges of LaIC lies in how to filter positive nouns, i.e., those semantically close to the images of interest, from unlabeled wild corpus data. Existing filtering strategies are predominantly based on the off-the-shelf feature space learned by CLIP; however, despite being intuitive, these strategies lack a rigorous theoretical foundation. To fill this gap, we propose a novel gradient-based framework, termed as GradNorm, which is theoretically guaranteed and shows strong empirical performance. In particular, we measure the positiveness of each noun based on the magnitude of gradients back-propagated from the cross-entropy between the predicted target distribution and the softmax output. Theoretically, we provide a rigorous error bound to quantify the separability of positive nouns by GradNorm and prove that GradNorm naturally subsumes existing filtering strategies as extremely special cases of itself. Empirically, extensive experiments show that GradNorm achieves the state-of-the-art clustering performance on various benchmarks.
authors: Bo Peng, Jie Lu, Guangquan Zhang, Zhen Fang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19805-19815

title: 从基础矩阵中恢复相机的方法研究
title_en: On the Recovery of Cameras from Fundamental Matrices
abstract: 视图图是一种紧凑的工具,用于编码多视角的几何信息:节点表示未校准相机,边表示基础矩阵(当存在时)。大多数研究集中在理论分析上,探讨在何种视图图下可以从基础矩阵中恢复相机,即该问题在无噪声数据下具有唯一解。然而,从噪声基础矩阵中恢复相机的实际任务仍属开放性问题,现有方法仅限于特殊视图图(如由三元组覆盖的图)。本文提出了一种通用视图图下从噪声基础矩阵中恢复相机的首个方法。实验结果在多种合成与真实场景中验证了所提方法的潜力。
abstract_en: The viewing graph is a compact tool to encode the geometry of multiple views: nodes represent uncalibrated cameras and edges represent fundamental matrices (when available). Most research focuses on theoretical analyses, exploring for which viewing graphs it is possible (in principle) to retrieve cameras from fundamental matrices, in the sense that the problem admits a unique solution for noiseless data. However, the practical task of recovering cameras from noisy fundamental matrices is still open, as available methods are limited to special graphs (such as those covered by triplets). In this paper, we develop the first method that can deal with the recovery of cameras from noisy fundamental matrices in a general viewing graph. Experimental results demonstrate the promise of the proposed approach on a variety of synthetic and real scenarios.
authors: Rakshith Madhavan, Federica Arrigoni ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20934-20943

title: 微调中的鲁棒性权衡关系研究
title_en: On the Robustness Tradeoff in Fine-Tuning
abstract: 微调已成为适应预训练模型到下游任务的标准实践。然而,其对模型鲁棒性的影响尚未被充分理解。本文研究了微调中的鲁棒性-准确率权衡关系。我们在6个基准数据集和7种不同的微调策略上评估了微调模型的鲁棒性与准确率。观察到对抗鲁棒性与准确率之间存在一致的权衡关系。如BitFit等外围更新方法在简单任务中表现更优——在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上,其帕累托前沿下的面积平均值超过75%。相比之下,通过Compacter对信息密集型层(如注意力层)进行微调,在更复杂的任务中实现了更好的帕累托前沿——在Caltech-256和CUB-200上分别超过平均值57.5%和34.6%。最后,我们观察到微调对分布外数据的鲁棒性与准确率紧密相关。这些发现强调了需要鲁棒性感知的微调方法以确保可靠的实际部署。
abstract_en: Fine-tuning has become the standard practice for adapting pre-trained models to downstream tasks. However, the impact on model robustness is not well understood. In this work, we characterize the robustness-accuracy trade-off in fine-tuning. We evaluate the robustness and accuracy of fine-tuned models over 6 benchmark datasets and 7 different fine-tuning strategies. We observe a consistent trade-off between adversarial robustness and accuracy. Peripheral updates such as BitFit are more effective for simple tasks---over 75% above the average measured by the area under the Pareto frontiers on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100. In contrast, fine-tuning information-heavy layers, such as attention layers via Compacter, achieves a better Pareto frontier on more complex tasks---57.5% and 34.6% above the average on Caltech-256 and CUB-200, respectively. Lastly, we observe that the robustness of fine-tuning against out-of-distribution data closely tracks accuracy. These insights emphasize the need for robustness-aware fine-tuning to ensure reliable real-world deployments.
authors: Kunyang Li, Jean-Charles Noirot Ferrand, Ryan Sheatsley, Blaine Hoak, Yohan Beugin, Eric Pauley, Patrick McDaniel ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4898-4907

title: 面向高效机器人操作的设备端扩散变换器策略
title_en: On-Device Diffusion Transformer Policy for Efficient Robot Manipulation
abstract: 扩散策略通过模仿学习显著提升了机器人操作任务,但其在资源受限的移动平台上的应用仍面临计算效率低下和庞大内存占用的挑战。本文提出LightDP,一种专门设计用于加速扩散策略以实现实时部署在移动设备上的新型框架。LightDP通过两项核心策略解决计算瓶颈:去噪模块的网络压缩和所需采样步骤的减少。我们首先对现有扩散策略架构进行广泛计算分析,识别出去噪网络是导致延迟的主要因素。为克服传统剪枝方法通常伴随的性能退化,我们引入统一的剪枝与再训练流程,显式优化模型剪枝后的恢复能力。此外,我们将剪枝技术与一致性蒸馏结合,有效减少采样步骤同时保持动作预测精度。在标准数据集(即PushT、Robomimic、CALVIN和LIBERO)上的实验评估表明,LightDP在移动设备上实现了具有竞争力性能的实时动作预测,标志着扩散策略在资源受限环境中的实用部署迈出重要一步。大量现实世界实验也表明,所提出的LightDP可达到与最先进扩散策略相当的性能。
abstract_en: Diffusion Policies have significantly advanced robotic manipulation tasks via imitation learning, but their application on resource-constrained mobile platforms remains challenging due to computational inefficiency and extensive memory footprint. In this paper, we propose LightDP, a novel framework specifically designed to accelerate Diffusion Policies for real-time deployment on mobile devices. LightDP addresses the computational bottleneck through two core strategies: network compression of the denoising modules and reduction of the required sampling steps. We first conduct an extensive computational analysis on existing Diffusion Policy architectures, identifying the denoising network as the primary contributor to latency. To overcome performance degradation typically associated with conventional pruning methods, we introduce a unified pruning and retraining pipeline, optimizing the model's post-pruning recoverability explicitly. Furthermore, we combine pruning techniques with consistency distillation to effectively reduce sampling steps while maintaining action prediction accuracy. Experimental evaluations on the standard datasets, i.e., PushT, Robomimic, CALVIN, and LIBERO, demonstrate that LightDP achieves real-time action prediction on mobile devices with competitive performance, marking an important step toward practical deployment of diffusion-based policies in resource-limited environments. Extensive real-world experiments also show the proposed LightDP can achieve performance comparable to state-of-the-art Diffusion Policies.
authors: Yiming Wu, Huan Wang, Zhenghao Chen, Jianxin Pang, Dong Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14073-14083

title: 一个编码器统御一切:基于傅里叶神经算子的无模型视觉强化学习表征学习
title_en: One Encoder to Rule them All: Representation Learning for Model-free Visual Reinforcement Learning using Fourier Neural Operators
abstract: 表征学习是深度强化学习的核心。尽管卷积神经网络(CNN)传统上作为图像观测的编码模型,但修改编码器架构会带来挑战,尤其是需要确定新的超参数集。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种强大的表征学习技术,利用傅里叶神经算子(FNO)进行视觉强化学习。我们的研究发现,所提出的FNO编码器能够在线无模型强化学习框架中,从图像中学习到包含环境动态微分方程(PDEs)的表征。我们通过将PPO、A2C和Rainbow(分别对应策略梯度、Actor-Critic和Q学习强化学习算法)中的CNN图像编码器替换为所提出的架构,验证了该方法的适用性。在CARLA自动驾驶(基于图像观测)基准和Atari 100k基准的无模型强化学习设置中,我们取得了最先进的得分。所提出的FNO编码器兼容所有无模型强化学习算法,通过隐式学习环境底层动态提升奖励和样本效率,并消除了额外超参数调优的需要。
abstract_en: Representation learning lies at the core of deep reinforcement learning. Although CNNs have traditionally served as the primary models for encoding image observations, modifying the encoder architecture introduces challenges, especially due to the necessity of determining a new set of hyperparameters. To address this problem, we propose a powerful representation learning technique for visual reinforcement learning utilizing Fourier Neural Operators (FNO). Our findings demonstrate that the proposed FNO encoder effectively learns representations from images that encapsulate the underlying differential equations (PDEs) governing the dynamics of the environment in an online model-free RL framework. We demonstrate the applicability of our proposed architecture by replacing the CNN image encoder in PPO, A2C, and Rainbow (a Policy Gradient, Actor-Critic, and Q-Learning RL algorithm, respectively). We achieve state-of-the-art scores (in the model-free RL setting) at both the CARLA Autonomous Driving (from image observations) benchmark and the Atari 100k benchmark. Our proposed FNO encoder is compatible with all model-free reinforcement learning algorithms, enhances both rewards and sample efficiency by implicitly learning the underlying dynamics of the environment, and eliminates the need for additional hyperparameter tuning.
authors: Parag Dutta, Mohd Ayyoob, Shalabh Bhatnagar, Ambedkar Dukkipati ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4818-4827

title: One Last Attention for Your Vision-Language Model
title_en: One Last Attention for Your Vision-Language Model
abstract: 预训练视觉-语言模型(VLMs),如CLIP,在零样本任务中表现出色,但其下游应用潜力依赖于有效的微调。大多数适应方法通常专注于优化单独模态(文本或视觉)的表示,却忽视了其融合表示在决策过程中的关键作用,即驱动最终预测的理性矩阵。为弥合这一差距,我们提出了一种简单而有效的理性适应(RAda)方法,在微调过程中显式利用最终融合表示。RAda通过在VLM末端附加的轻量级注意力层获得的可学习掩码,动态校准理性矩阵中每个元素的贡献,从而在不修改中间特征的情况下实现针对最终跨模态交互的精准调整。在不同设置(即更新或冻结预训练编码器,以及仅能访问无标签测试数据的测试时训练)的实验表明,RAda是一种通用的微调技术,以最小的代码量提升基线性能,并在大多数设置中与当前最佳方法表现相当。
abstract_en: Pretrained vision-language models (VLMs), such as CLIP, achieve remarkable zero-shot performance, yet their downstream potential hinges on effective fine-tuning. Most adaptation methods typically focus on refining representation from separate modalities (text or vision) but neglect the critical role of their fused representations in the decision-making process, i.e., rational matrix that drives the final prediction. To bridge the gap, we propose a simple yet effective Rational Adaptaion (RAda) to explicitly exploit the final fused representation during fine-tuning. RAda employs a learned mask, obtained from a lightweight attention layer attached at the end of a VLM, to dynamically calibrate the contribution of each element in the rational matrix, enabling targeted adjustments to the final cross-modal interactions without incurring costly modifications to intermediate features. Experiments in different settings (i.e., updating, or freezing pretrained encoders in adaptation, and test-time training that can only access the unlabeled test data) show that RAda serves as a versatile fine-tuning technique, improving the baseline with minimal code and performing comparably against current arts in most settings.
authors: Liang Chen, Ghazi Shazan Ahmad, Tianjun Yao, Lingqiao Liu, Zhiqiang Shen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1464-1473

title: 一瞥即足:高分辨率图像零样本单目深度估计的无缝分块细化
title_en: One Look is Enough: Seamless Patchwise Refinement for Zero-Shot Monocular Depth Estimation on High-Resolution Images
abstract: 零样本深度估计(DE)模型因其在大规模数据集上的训练展现出强大的泛化性能。然而,现有模型在处理高分辨率图像时面临挑战,这是由于训练时采用较小分辨率而推理时需处理高分辨率导致的图像分辨率差异。在全分辨率下处理会导致深度估计精度下降且内存消耗巨大,而下采样至训练分辨率则会使估计的深度图像边缘模糊。主流的高分辨率深度估计方法采用分块处理方式,但在重新拼接估计的深度块时会引入深度不连续问题,导致推理时效率低下。此外,为了获取细粒度深度细节,这些方法依赖合成数据集,因为现实世界中深度真值稀疏,从而导致泛化能力差。为解决这些局限性,我们提出了一种高效且通用的基于瓦片的框架Patch Refine Once(PRO)。我们的PRO包含两个关键组件:(i) 分组补丁一致性训练,通过联合处理四个重叠补丁并在单次反向传播步骤中对其重叠区域施加一致性损失,从而提升推理效率并缓解深度不连续问题;(ii) 无偏掩码,防止深度估计模型过度拟合数据集特定偏差,即使在合成数据上训练后也能更好地泛化到现实世界数据集。在Booster、ETH3D、Middlebury 2014和NuScenes数据集上的零样本评估表明,我们的PRO可无缝集成到现有深度估计模型中。它在高分辨率图像的网格推理下仍能保持原始深度估计模型的性能,表现出最小的补丁边界深度不连续性。此外,与先前的分块方法相比,我们的PRO实现了显著更快的推理速度。
abstract_en: Zero-shot depth estimation (DE) models exhibit strong generalization performance as they are trained on large-scale datasets. However, existing models struggle with high-resolution images due to the discrepancy in image resolutions of training (with smaller resolutions) and inference (for high resolutions). Processing them at full resolution leads to decreased estimation accuracy on depth with tremendous memory consumption, while downsampling to the training resolution results in blurred edges in the estimated depth images. Prevailing high-resolution depth estimation methods adopt a patch-based approach, which introduces depth discontinuity issues when reassembling the estimated depth patches, resulting in test-time inefficiency. Additionally, to obtain fine-grained depth details, these methods rely on synthetic datasets due to the real-world sparse ground truth depth, leading to poor generalizability. To tackle these limitations, we propose Patch Refine Once (PRO), an efficient and generalizable tile-based framework. Our PRO consists of two key components: (i) Grouped Patch Consistency Training that enhances test-time efficiency while mitigating the depth discontinuity problem by jointly processing four overlapping patches and enforcing a consistency loss on their overlapping regions within a single backpropagation step, and (ii) Bias Free Masking that prevents the DE models from overfitting to dataset-specific biases, enabling better generalization to real-world datasets even after training on synthetic data. Zero-shot evaluations on Booster, ETH3D, Middlebury 2014, and NuScenes demonstrate that our PRO can be seamlessly integrated into existing depth estimation models. It preserves the performance of original depth estimation models even under grid-based inference on high-resolution images, exhibiting minimal depth discontinuities along patch boundaries. Moreover, our PRO achieves significantly faster inference speed compared to prior patch-based methods.
authors: Byeongjun Kwon, Munchurl Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8077-8087

title: 单一对象,多重欺骗:统一视觉-语言模型跨任务对抗攻击的基准数据集
title_en: One Object, Multiple Lies: A Benchmark for Cross-task Adversarial Attack on Unified Vision-Language Models
abstract: 统一视觉-语言模型(VLMs)近期取得了显著进展,通过共享计算架构中的不同指令,使单一模型能够灵活应对多样任务。这种基于指令的控制机制带来了独特的安全挑战,因为对抗输入必须在多个可能被不可预测应用的任务指令下保持有效性。本文提出CrossVLAD,一个从MSCOCO精心构建的基准数据集,通过GPT-4辅助标注系统性评估统一VLMs的跨任务对抗攻击。CrossVLAD聚焦于对象变化目标——在四个下游任务中一致操控目标对象的分类,并提出新的成功率度量指标,衡量同时在所有任务中误分类的情况,为对抗迁移性提供严格评估。为应对这一挑战,我们提出CRAFT(基于区域的跨任务攻击框架,带令牌对齐),一种高效的区域中心攻击方法。在Florence-2及其他流行统一VLMs上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在整体跨任务攻击性能和目标对象变化成功率方面均优于现有方法,突显其在多样化任务中对抗性影响统一VLMs的有效性。
abstract_en: Unified vision-language models (VLMs) have recently shown remarkable progress, enabling a single model to flexibly address diverse tasks through different instructions within a shared computational architecture. This instruction-based control mechanism creates unique security challenges, as adversarial inputs must remain effective across multiple task instructions that may be unpredictably applied to process the same malicious content. In this paper, we introduce CrossVLAD, a new benchmark dataset carefully curated from MSCOCO with GPT-4-assisted annotations for systematically evaluating cross-task adversarial attacks on unified VLMs. CrossVLAD centers on the object-change objective--consistently manipulating a target object's classification across four downstream tasks--and proposes a novel success rate metric that measures simultaneous misclassification across all tasks, providing a rigorous evaluation of adversarial transferability. To tackle this challenge, we present CRAFT (Cross-task Region-based Attack Framework with Token-alignment), an efficient region-centric attack method. Extensive experiments on Florence-2 and other popular unified VLMs demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both overall cross-task attack performance and targeted object-change success rates, highlighting its effectiveness in adversarially influencing unified VLMs across diverse tasks.
authors: Jiale Zhao, Xinyang Jiang, Junyao Gao, Yuhao Xue, Cairong Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 187-196

title: 一个扰动就足够:针对视觉-语言预训练模型生成通用对抗扰动的研究
title_en: One Perturbation is Enough: On Generating Universal Adversarial Perturbations against Vision-Language Pre-training Models
abstract: 视觉-语言预训练(VLP)模型通过充分利用学习到的多模态对齐,在许多应用中展现出前所未有的能力。然而,先前研究表明它们对恶意构造的对抗样本存在脆弱性。尽管近期取得成功,这些攻击通常具有实例相关性,需要为每个输入样本生成扰动。本文揭示了VLP模型同样易受实例无关的通用对抗扰动(UAP)影响。具体而言,我们设计了一种结合跨模态条件的对比训练扰动生成器(C-PGC)。鉴于VLP模型中的关键多模态对齐是通过对比学习实现的,我们旨在将这一强大工具转而用于对抗VLP模型本身。即,我们采用恶意版本的对比学习,利用精心构造的正负图像-文本对训练所提出的生成器。训练完成后,生成器能够产生破坏VLP模型已建立对齐关系的通用扰动。此外,C-PGC通过融合单模态和跨模态信息作为有效指导,充分挖掘了视觉-语言(V+L)场景的特性。大量实验表明,C-PGC成功地使对抗样本在VLP模型的特征空间中远离原始区域,从而在各类受害模型和V+L任务中根本性地提升攻击性能。
abstract_en: Vision-Language Pre-training (VLP) models have exhibited unprecedented capability in many applications by taking full advantage of the learned multimodal alignment. However, previous studies have shown they are vulnerable to maliciously crafted adversarial samples. Despite recent success, these attacks are generally instance-specific and require generating perturbations for each input sample. In this paper, we reveal that VLP models are also susceptible to the instance-agnostic universal adversarial perturbation (UAP). Specifically, we design a novel Contrastive-training Perturbation Generator with Cross-modal conditions (C-PGC). In light that the pivotal multimodal alignment in VLP models is achieved via contrastive learning, we devise to turn this powerful weapon against VLP models themselves. I.e., we employ a malicious version of contrastive learning to train the proposed generator using our carefully crafted positive and negative image-text pairs. Once training is complete, the generator is able to produce universal perturbations that can essentially destroy the established alignment relationship in VLP models. Besides, C-PGC fully utilizes the characteristics of Vision-and-Language (V+L) scenarios by incorporating both unimodal and cross-modal information as effective guidance. Extensive experiments show that C-PGC successfully forces adversarial samples to move away from their original area in the VLP model's feature space, thus fundamentally enhancing attack performance across various victim models and V+L tasks.
authors: Hao Fang, Jiawei Kong, Wenbo Yu, Bin Chen, Jiawei Li, Hao Wu, Shu-Tao Xia, Ke Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4090-4100

title: 一个息肉识别全部:基于级联先验和迭代提示演化的SAM单次息肉分割
title_en: One Polyp Identifies All: One-Shot Polyp Segmentation with SAM via Cascaded Priors and Iterative Prompt Evolution
abstract: 息肉分割对于早期结直肠癌检测至关重要,但传统全监督方法在形态学变化和领域迁移方面存在困难,需要频繁重新训练。此外,由于息肉边界标注耗时且易出错,依赖大规模标注是主要瓶颈。近期,视觉基础模型如Segment Anything Model (SAM) 通过稀疏提示展现出强大的泛化能力和细粒度边界检测能力,有效解决了息肉分割的关键挑战。然而,SAM的提示依赖性限制了其在医疗应用中的自动化程度,因为为每张图像手动输入提示需要大量人力和时间。我们提出OP-SAM,一种基于SAM的单次息肉分割框架,可从单张标注图像自动生成提示,确保无需额外标注负担即可实现准确且可泛化的分割。我们的方法引入基于相关性的先验生成(CPG)实现语义标签迁移,并通过尺度级联先验融合(SPF)适应息肉尺寸变化及过滤噪声迁移。不同于一次性输出所有提示,我们设计欧几里得提示演化(EPE)进行迭代提示优化,逐步提升分割质量。在五个数据集上的广泛评估验证了OP-SAM的有效性。值得注意的是,在Kvasir数据集上,其IoU达到76.93%,超越当前最优方法11.44%。
abstract_en: Polyp segmentation is vital for early colorectal cancer detection, yet traditional fully supervised methods struggle with morphological variability and domain shifts, requiring frequent retraining. Additionally, reliance on large-scale annotations is a major bottleneck due to the time-consuming and error-prone nature of polyp boundary labeling. Recently, vision foundation models like Segment Anything Model (SAM) have demonstrated strong generalizability and fine-grained boundary detection with sparse prompts, effectively addressing key polyp segmentation challenges. However, SAM's prompt-dependent nature limits automation in medical applications, since manually inputting prompts for each image is labor-intensive and time-consuming. We propose OP-SAM, a One-shot Polyp segmentation framework based on SAM that automatically generates prompts from a single annotated image, ensuring accurate and generalizable segmentation without additional annotation burdens. Our method introduces Correlation-based Prior Generation (CPG) for semantic label transfer and Scale-cascaded Prior Fusion (SPF) to adapt to polyp size variations as well as filter out noisy transfers. Instead of dumping all prompts at once, we devise Euclidean Prompt Evolution (EPE) for iterative prompt refinement, progressively enhancing segmentation quality. Extensive evaluations across five datasets validate OP-SAM's effectiveness. Notably, on Kvasir, it achieves 76.93% IoU, surpassing the state-of-the-art by 11.44%.
authors: Xinyu Mao, Xiaohan Xing, Fei Meng, Jianbang Liu, Fan Bai, Qiang Nie, Max Meng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24182-24191

title: 一条轨迹,一个标记:基于全景子对象轨迹的具身视频标记化
title_en: One Trajectory, One Token: Grounded Video Tokenization via Panoptic Sub-object Trajectory
abstract: 有效的视频标记化对于扩展Transformer模型处理长视频至关重要。当前方法使用时空块进行视频标记化,导致标记数量过多和计算效率低下。最佳的标记减少策略在相机移动时性能下降且标记数量减少有限。我们提出具身视频标记化范式,通过全景子对象轨迹组织标记而非固定块。我们的方法符合基本的感知原理,确保标记化反映场景复杂度而非视频时长。我们提出TrajViT视频编码器,提取对象轨迹并将其转换为语义上有意义的标记,在显著减少冗余的同时保持时间连贯性。通过对比学习训练的TrajViT在多个视频理解基准测试中显著优于时空ViT(ViT3D),例如在视频-文本检索任务中,TrajViT在减少10倍标记的情况下,平均top-5召回率比ViT3D高出6%。我们还表明,TrajViT作为现代VideoLLM的视频编码器比ViT3D更强,在6个视频问答基准测试中平均性能提升5.2%,同时训练时间快4倍,推理FLOPs减少20倍。TrajViT是首个在多样化视频分析任务中持续超越ViT3D的高效编码器,使其成为稳健且可扩展的解决方案。
abstract_en: Effective video tokenization is critical for scaling transformer models for long videos. Current approaches tokenize videos using space-time patches, leading to excessive tokens and computational inefficiencies. The best token reduction strategies degrade performance and barely reduce the number of tokens when the camera moves. We introduce grounded video tokenization, a paradigm that organizes tokens based on panoptic sub-object trajectories rather than fixed patches. Our method aligns with fundamental perceptual principles, ensuring that tokenization reflects scene complexity rather than video duration. We propose TrajViT, a video encoder that extracts object trajectories and converts them into semantically meaningful tokens, significantly reducing redundancy while maintaining temporal coherence. Trained with contrastive learning, TrajViT significantly outperforms space-time ViT (ViT3D) across multiple video understanding benchmarks, e.g., TrajViT outperforms ViT3D by a large margin of 6% top-5 recall in average at video-text retrieval task with 10x token deduction. We also show TrajViT as a stronger model than ViT3D for being the video encoder for modern VideoLLM, obtaining an average of 5.2% performance improvement across 6 VideoQA benchmarks while having 4x faster training time and 20x less inference FLOPs. TrajViT is the first efficient encoder to consistently outperform ViT3D across diverse video analysis tasks, making it a robust and scalable solution.
authors: Chenhao Zheng, Jieyu Zhang, Mohammadreza Salehi, Ziqi Gao, Vishnu Iyengar, Norimasa Kobori, Quan Kong, Ranjay Krishna ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23156-23166

title: 面向可扩展人重新识别的单次知识迁移方法
title_en: One-Shot Knowledge Transfer for Scalable Person Re-Identification
abstract: 在人重新识别(ReID)中,边缘计算对于减轻中心云服务器负载并保障用户隐私至关重要。传统压缩方法获取紧凑模型需要为每个个体学生模型进行计算。当需要适应不同资源条件的多种尺寸模型时,这会导致重复且繁琐的计算过程。为解决这一挑战,我们提出了一种新型知识继承方法,名为OSKT(单次知识迁移,One-Shot Knowledge Transfer),该方法将教师模型的知识整合至名为权重链的中间载体中。当下游场景需要满足特定资源约束的模型时,该权重链可扩展至目标模型尺寸而无需额外计算。OSKT显著优于最先进的压缩方法,其单次知识迁移优势可消除对每个目标模型频繁计算的需求。
abstract_en: Edge computing in person re-identification (ReID) is crucial for reducing the load on central cloud servers and ensuring user privacy. Conventional compression methods for obtaining compact models require computations for each individual student model. When multiple models of varying sizes are needed to accommodate different resource conditions, this leads to repetitive and cumbersome computations. To address this challenge, we propose a novel knowledge inheritance approach named OSKT (One-Shot Knowledge Transfer), which consolidates the knowledge of the teacher model into an intermediate carrier called a weight chain. When a downstream scenario demands a model that meets specific resource constraints, this weight chain can be expanded to the target model size without additional computation. OSKT significantly outperforms state-of-the-art compression methods, with the added advantage of one-time knowledge transfer that eliminates the need for frequent computations for each target model.
authors: Longhua Li, Lei Qi, Xin Geng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 668-677

title: 基于自适应扩散模型的一步式镜面高光去除方法
title_en: One-Step Specular Highlight Removal with Adapted Diffusion Models
abstract: 镜面高光虽对人类感知具有价值,但在计算机视觉和图形任务中常被视为干扰因素,因其可能遮蔽表面细节并影响分析。现有方法依赖多阶段流程或多标签数据集,导致训练困难。本研究提出一种基于扩散模型的一步式镜面高光去除方法,通过预训练的扩散图像生成模型结合自适应机制提升效率与适应性。为进一步优化适应过程,我们引入ProbLoRA,这是低秩适应(LoRA)的新改进方法,旨在有效适配扩散模型进行高光去除。我们的方法超越现有技术,在定量指标和视觉质量上均达到最先进水平。在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上的大量实验验证了方法的有效性,突显其鲁棒性和泛化能力。
abstract_en: Specular highlights, though valuable for human perception, are often undesirable in computer vision and graphics tasks as they can obscure surface details and affect analysis. Existing methods rely on multi-stage pipelines or multi-label datasets, making training difficult. In this study, we propose a one-step diffusion-based model for specular highlight removal, leveraging a pre-trained diffusion-based image generation model with an adaptation mechanism to enhance efficiency and adaptability. To further improve the adaptation process, we introduce ProbLoRA, a novel modification of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), designed to adapt the diffusion model for highlight removal effectively. Our approach surpasses existing methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance in both quantitative metrics and visual quality. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, highlighting its robustness and generalization capabilities.
authors: Mahir Atmis, Levent Karacan, Mehmet Sarıgül ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16313-16322

title: OneGT:面向头像的单次几何-纹理神经渲染
title_en: OneGT: One-Shot Geometry-Texture Neural Rendering for Head Avatars
abstract: 现有解决方案在创建高保真数字头像时面临诸多障碍。传统渲染工具可生成逼真结果,但需依赖专家技能。神经渲染方法虽更高效,却常在生成保真度与灵活性之间妥协。本文提出OneGT,其框架遵循传统渲染工具,通过神经网络重构渲染管线的各阶段。OneGT保持高系统可解释性,继承神经渲染方法的优越性能。具体而言,OneGT包含骨架锚定阶段与纹理渲染阶段,其中精心设计的Transformer学习几何变换,而提出的参考感知DiT分别渲染纹理。我们的框架通过创新性引入的合成数据学习几何一致性,从而在仅需竞争方法通常使用的10%-30%真实数据的情况下实现卓越性能。实验结果表明,OneGT在生成肖像头像时达到高保真度,同时保持编辑的灵活性。
abstract_en: Existing solutions for creating high-fidelity digital head avatars encounter various obstacles. Traditional rendering tools offer realistic results, while heavily requiring expert skills. Neural rendering methods are more efficient but often compromise between the generated fidelity and flexibility. We present OneGT that adheres to the frameworks of the rendering tools, while restructuring individual stages of the rendering pipeline through neural networks. OneGT maintains high systemic interpretability, inheriting the superior performances of neural rendering approaches. Specifically, OneGT contains a skeleton-anchoring stage and a texture-rendering stage, in which well-designed Transformers learn the geometric transformations and the proposed reference-perceptible DiT renders the textures respectively. Our framework learns geometric consistency from the innovatively introduced synthetic data, thus achieving superior performance while requiring only 10%-30% of the real-world data typically used by competitive methods. Experimental results demonstrate that OneGT achieves high fidelity in producing portrait avatars, meanwhile maintaining the flexibility of editing.
authors: Jinshu Chen, Bingchuan Li, Fan Zhang, Songtao Zhao, Qian He ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11294-11304

title: 基于流式内存的在线密集点跟踪
title_en: Online Dense Point Tracking with Streaming Memory
abstract: 密集点跟踪是一项具有挑战性的任务,要求在视频的大部分时间段内持续跟踪初始帧中的每一个点,即使存在遮挡情况。传统方法使用光流模型直接估计长距离运动,但往往因未考虑时间一致性而出现外观漂移问题。近期的点跟踪算法通常依赖滑动窗口进行从第一帧到当前帧的间接信息传播,这种方法在长距离跟踪中速度较慢且效果不佳。为兼顾时间一致性并实现高效的信息传播,我们提出了一种轻量且快速的模型,结合流式内存用于密集点跟踪和在线视频处理。SPOT框架包含三个核心组件:用于特征增强的定制化内存读取模块、用于短期运动动态建模的感官记忆模块,以及用于精确信息传播的可见性引导的点扩散模块。这种组合使SPOT在CVO基准测试中实现了最先进的密集点跟踪精度,并在稀疏跟踪基准如TAP-Vid和RoboTAP上表现出与离线模型相当或更优的性能。值得注意的是,参数数量仅为先前最先进模型1/10的SPOT,在保持CVO最佳性能的同时,运行速度至少快2倍。我们将发布模型和代码:https://dqiaole.github.io/SPOT/
abstract_en: Dense point tracking is a challenging task requiring the continuous tracking of every point in the initial frame throughout a substantial portion of a video, even in the presence of occlusions. Traditional methods use optical flow models to directly estimate long-range motion, but they often suffer from appearance drifting without considering temporal consistency. Recent point tracking algorithms usually depend on sliding windows for indirect information propagation from the first frame to the current one, which is slow and less effective for long-range tracking. To account for temporal consistency and enable efficient information propagation, we present a lightweight and fast model with Streaming memory for dense POint Tracking and online video processing. The SPOT framework features three core components: a customized memory reading module for feature enhancement, a sensory memory for short-term motion dynamics modeling, and a visibility-guided splatting module for accurate information propagation. This combination enables SPOT to perform dense point tracking with state-of-the-art accuracy on the CVO benchmark, as well as comparable or superior performance to offline models on sparse tracking benchmarks such as TAP-Vid and RoboTAP. Notably, SPOT with 10x smaller parameter numbers operates at least 2x faster than previous state-of-the-art models while maintaining the best performance on CVO. We will release the models and codes at: https://dqiaole.github.io/SPOT/.
authors: Qiaole Dong, Yanwei Fu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8710-8720

title: 在线通用事件边界检测
title_en: Online Generic Event Boundary Detection
abstract: 通用事件边界检测(GEBD)旨在通过人类感知的视角来解释长视频。然而,当前GEBD方法需要处理完整视频帧以进行预测,不同于人类在线实时处理数据的方式。为弥合这一差距,我们引入了一个新任务——在线通用事件边界检测(On-GEBD),旨在实时流媒体视频中即时检测通用事件边界。该任务面临独特挑战:需在无未来帧访问权限的情况下,实时识别无需分类体系的细微事件变化。为应对这些挑战,我们提出了一种受事件分割理论(EST)启发的新型On-GEBD框架ESTimator,该理论解释了人类如何通过预测信息与实际信息的差异,将持续活动分割为事件。我们的框架包含两个关键组件:一致事件预测器(CEA)和在线边界判别器(OBD)。具体而言,CEA仅基于先前帧生成反映当前事件动态的未来帧预测。随后,OBD通过统计检验对历史误差进行分析,测量预测误差并自适应调整阈值,以捕捉多样化的细微事件过渡。实验结果表明,ESTimator在Kinetics-GEBD和TAPOS数据集上超越了所有基于近期在线视频理解模型的基线方法,并在性能上与先前离线GEBD方法相当。
abstract_en: Generic Event Boundary Detection (GEBD) aims to interpret long-form videos through the lens of human perception. However, current GEBD methods require processing complete video frames to make predictions, unlike humans processing data online and in real-time. To bridge this gap, we introduce a new task, Online Generic Event Boundary Detection (On-GEBD), aiming to detect boundaries of generic events immediately in streaming videos. This task faces unique challenges of identifying subtle, taxonomy-free event changes in real-time, without the access to future frames. To tackle these challenges, we propose a novel On-GEBD framework, ESTimator, inspired by Event Segmentation Theory (EST) which explains how humans segment ongoing activity into events by leveraging the discrepancies between predicted and actual information. Our framework consists of two key components: the Consistent Event Anticipator (CEA), and the Online Boundary Discriminator (OBD). Specifically, the CEA generates a prediction of the future frame reflecting current event dynamics based solely on prior frames. Then, the OBD measures the prediction error and adaptively adjusts the threshold using statistical tests on past errors to capture diverse, subtle event transitions. Experimental results demonstrate that ESTimator outperforms all baselines adapted from recent online video understanding models and achieves performance comparable to prior offline-GEBD methods on the Kinetics-GEBD and TAPOS datasets.
authors: Hyungrok Jung, Daneul Kim, Seunggyun Lim, Jeany Son, Jonghyun Choi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13741-13750

title: 在线语言溅射
title_en: Online Language Splatting
abstract: 为使AI代理能够无缝与人类和三维环境交互,它们不仅需要准确感知三维世界,还需将人类语言与三维空间表示对齐。尽管先前工作通过将语言特征整合到几何细节丰富的三维场景表示中,利用三维高斯溅射(GS)取得了显著进展,但这些方法依赖于对每个输入图像进行计算密集型的离线语言特征预处理,限制了其对新环境的适应性。在本工作中,我们引入了在线语言溅射(Online Language Splatting),这是首个在无需预生成语言特征的三维GS-SLAM系统中实现在线、近实时、开放词汇语言映射的框架。关键挑战在于高效地将高维语言特征融合到三维表示中,同时平衡计算速度、内存使用、渲染质量和开放词汇能力。为此,我们创新性地设计了:(1) 一个高分辨率CLIP嵌入模块,可在每帧18ms内生成详细的语言特征图;(2) 一个两阶段在线自动编码器,将768维CLIP特征压缩至15维同时保留开放词汇能力;(3) 一种颜色-语言解耦优化方法以提升渲染质量。实验结果表明,我们的在线方法不仅在准确性上超越了最先进的离线方法,还实现了超过40倍的效率提升,展示了其在动态交互AI应用中的潜力。
abstract_en: To enable AI agents to interact seamlessly with both humans and 3D environments, they must not only perceive the 3D world accurately but also align human language with 3D spatial representations. While prior work has made significant progress by integrating language features into geometrically detailed 3D scene representations using 3D Gaussian Splatting (GS), these approaches rely on computationally intensive offline preprocessing of language features for each input image, limiting adaptability to new environments. In this work, we introduce Online Language Splatting, the first framework to achieve online, near real-time, open-vocabulary language mapping within a 3DGS-SLAM system without requiring pre-generated language features. The key challenge lies in efficiently fusing high-dimensional language features into 3D representations while balancing the computation speed, memory usage, rendering quality and open-vocabulary capability. To this end, we innovatively design: (1) a high-resolution CLIP embedding module capable of generating detailed language feature maps in 18ms per frame, (2) a two-stage online auto-encoder that compresses 768-dimensional CLIP features to 15 dimensions while preserving open-vocabulary capabilities, and (3) a color-language disentangled optimization approach to improve rendering quality. Experimental results show that our online method not only surpasses the state-of-the-art offline methods in accuracy but also achieves more than 40x efficiency boost, demonstrating the potential for dynamic and interactive AI applications.
authors: Saimouli Katragadda, Cho-Ying Wu, Yuliang Guo, Xinyu Huang, Guoquan Huang, Liu Ren ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25882-25892

title: 基于即时数字孪生的在线推理视频分割
title_en: Online Reasoning Video Segmentation with Just-in-Time Digital Twins
abstract: 推理分割(RS)旨在基于隐式文本查询识别和分割感兴趣的对象。因此,RS是具身AI代理的催化剂,使它们能够在无需显式逐步指导的情况下解释高级指令。然而,当前RS方法严重依赖多模态大语言模型(LLMs)的视觉感知能力,导致若干主要局限性。首先,它们难以处理需要多步推理或涉及复杂空间/时间关系的查询。其次,它们需要LLMs微调,这可能需要频繁更新以保持与当代LLMs的兼容性,并可能在微调过程中增加灾难性遗忘的风险。最后,由于主要设计用于静态图像或离线视频处理,它们在在线视频数据上的扩展性较差。为解决这些局限性,我们提出了一种代理框架,无需LLMs微调即可实现在线视频RS的感知与推理解耦。我们的创新在于引入了即时数字孪生概念——给定隐式查询,LLM将利用专用视觉模型从高阶视频中规划构建低阶场景表示。我们将这种创建数字孪生的方法称为“即时”,因为LLM规划器将预判特定信息需求,仅请求该有限子集而非始终评估所有专用模型。随后,LLM在该数字孪生表示上进行推理以识别目标对象。为评估我们的方法,我们引入了一个新的综合视频推理分割基准,包含200个视频和895个隐式文本查询。该基准涵盖三个推理类别(语义、空间和时间)及三种不同的推理链复杂度。实验结果表明,我们的方法在所有推理类别中表现最佳,表明我们的即时数字孪生能够弥合具身AI中高层推理与低层感知之间的差距。基准数据集可在https://github.com/yiqings/jitbench/获取。
abstract_en: Reasoning segmentation (RS) aims to identify and segment objects of interest based on implicit text queries. As such, RS is a catalyst for embodied AI agents, enabling them to interpret high-level commands without requiring explicit step-by-step guidance. However, current RS approaches rely heavily on the visual perception capabilities of multimodal large language models (LLMs), leading to several major limitations. First, they struggle with queries that require multiple steps of reasoning or those that involve complex spatial/temporal relationships. Second, they necessitate LLM fine-tuning, which may require frequent updates to maintain compatibility with contemporary LLMs and may increase risks of catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning. Finally, being primarily designed for static images or offline video processing, they scale poorly to online video data. To address these limitations, we propose an agent framework that disentangles perception and reasoning for online video RS without LLM fine-tuning. Our innovation is the introduction of a just-in-time digital twin concept, where -- given an implicit query -- an LLM plans the construction of a low-level scene representation from high-level video using specialist vision models. We refer to this approach to creating a digital twin as "just-in-time" because the LLM planner will anticipate the need for specific information and only request this limited subset instead of always evaluating every specialist model. The LLM then performs reasoning on this digital twin representation to identify target objects. To evaluate our approach, we introduce a new comprehensive video reasoning segmentation benchmark comprising 200 videos with 895 implicit text queries. The benchmark spans three reasoning categories (semantic, spatial, and temporal) with three different reasoning chain complexity. Experimental results demonstrate that our method performs best across all reasoning categories, suggesting that our just-in-time digital twin can bridge the gap between high-level reasoning and low-level perception in embodied AI. Benchmark is available at https://github.com/yiqings/jitbench/.
authors: Yiqing Shen, Bohan Liu, Chenjia Li, Lalithkumar Seenivasan, Mathias Unberath ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24698-24706

title: 面向通用深度伪造检测的开放不公平对抗缓解方法
title_en: Open-Unfairness Adversarial Mitigation for Generalized Deepfake Detection
abstract: 深度伪造检测方法在身份安全领域日益重要,并已被用于支持法律程序。然而,这些方法由于逻辑推理缺陷常表现出不公平性,削弱了预测的可靠性,并引发其在法律场景中适用性的担忧。为缓解此类偏见,现有方法通常依赖预定义的人口统计属性(如种族和性别)。然而,这些假设本质上存在局限性,因为不同深度伪造检测器在公平性表现上存在显著差异,常揭示出复杂且未预见的偏见模式。为此,我们提出对抗性开放不公平发现与缓解网络(AdvOU),一种旨在缓解深度伪造检测中不可预测不公平性的新框架。我们的方法通过为通用深度伪造检测器配备轻量级不公平调节器(UR),增强其公平性,该调节器可动态识别并缓解偏见。此外,我们提出一种对抗学习范式,交替训练开放不公平发现(OUD)模块与不公平对抗缓解(UAM)模块。前者通过增强UR中的不公平性以揭示潜在偏见模式,后者则通过对抗性鲁棒性强化检测器的公平性。在广泛使用的深度伪造数据集上的大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性,在跨域深度伪造检测的公平性与泛化评估中均优于现有最先进方法。代码已开源至https://github.com/liacaaa/AdvOU。
abstract_en: Deepfake detection methods are becoming increasingly crucial for identity security and have recently been employed to support legal proceedings. However, these methods often exhibit unfairness due to flawed logical reasoning, undermining the reliability of their predictions and raising concerns about their applicability in legal contexts. To mitigate this bias, existing approaches typically rely on predefined demographic attributes, such as race and gender. However, these assumptions are inherently limited, as different deepfake detectors exhibit substantial variations in fairness performance, often uncovering intricate and unforeseen bias patterns. To this end, we propose the Adversarial Open-Unfairness Discovery and Mitigation Network (AdvOU), a novel framework designed to mitigate unpredictable unfairness in deepfake detection. Our approach strengthens general deepfake detectors by equipping them with a lightweight Unfairness Regulator (UR), which dynamically identifies and mitigates bias. Furthermore, we propose an adversarial learning paradigm that alternates between the training of the Open-Unfairness Discovery (OUD) module and the Unfairness Adversarial Mitigation (UAM) module. The former intensifies unfairness within UR to reveal underlying bias patterns, while the latter leverages fairness in the detector by enforcing adversarial robustness against unfairness. Extensive experiments on widely used deepfake datasets validate the effectiveness of our approach, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in both fairness and generalization evaluations for cross-domain deepfake detection. The code is available at https://github.com/liacaaa/AdvOU.
authors: Zhaoyang Li, Zhu Teng, Baopeng Zhang, Jianping Fan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 698-707

title: 基于交互感知提示与概念校准的开放词汇人-物交互检测
title_en: Open-Vocabulary HOI Detection with Interaction-aware Prompt and Concept Calibration
abstract: 开放词汇人-物交互(HOI)检测旨在检测人类与物体之间的交互关系,同时泛化到训练集之外的新交互类别。当前方法通常依赖视觉语言模型(VLMs),但受限于次优的图像编码器,因图像级预训练难以与细粒度区域级交互检测需求对齐。此外,有效编码视觉外观的文本描述仍具挑战性,限制了模型对详细HOI关系的捕捉能力。为解决这些问题,我们提出基于交互感知提示与概念校准的INP-CC方法,这是一种端到端的开放词汇HOI检测器,整合了交互感知提示和概念校准。具体而言,我们提出交互感知提示生成器,根据输入场景动态生成紧凑的提示集,实现相似交互间的选择性共享。该方法引导模型关注关键交互模式而非通用图像级语义,提升HOI检测效果。此外,通过语言模型引导的校准优化HOI概念表示,通过跨类别视觉相似性分析区分多样HOI概念。同时采用负采样策略提升跨模态相似性建模,使模型更好区分视觉相似但语义不同的动作。大量实验结果表明,INP-CC在SWIG-HOI和HICO-DET数据集上显著优于现有SOTA模型。代码已开源于https://github.com/ltttpku/INP-CC。
abstract_en: Open Vocabulary Human-Object Interaction (HOI) detection aims to detect interactions between humans and objects while generalizing to novel interaction classes beyond the training set. Current methods often rely on Vision and Language Models (VLMs) but face challenges due to suboptimal image encoders, as image-level pre-training does not align well with the fine-grained region-level interaction detection required for HOI. Additionally, effectively encoding textual descriptions of visual appearances remains difficult, limiting the model's ability to capture detailed HOI relationships. To address these issues, we propose INteraction-aware Prompting with Concept Calibration (INP-CC), an end-to-end open-vocabulary HOI detector that integrates interaction-aware prompts and concept calibration. Specifically, we propose an interaction-aware prompt generator that dynamically generates a compact set of prompts based on the input scene, enabling selective sharing among similar interactions. This approach directs the model's attention to key interaction patterns rather than generic image-level semantics, enhancing HOI detection.
