Enhanced by frequency-domain regularization, PRE-Mamba achieves superior performance (0.95 SR, 0.91 NR, and 0.4s/M events) with only 0.26M parameters on EventRain-27K, a comprehensive dataset with labeled synthetic and real-world sequences. Moreover, our method generalizes well across varying rain intensities, viewpoints, and even snowy conditions. Code and dataset: https://github.com/softword-tt/PRE-Mamba.
authors: Ciyu Ruan, Ruishan Guo, Zihang Gong, Jingao Xu, Wenhan Yang, Xinlei Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9169-9180

title: PRIMAL: 用于角色学习的物理反应与交互运动模型
title_en: PRIMAL: Physically Reactive and Interactive Motor Model for Avatar Learning
abstract: 我们将交互式角色的运动系统建模为一种生成式运动模型,该模型能够以持续、真实、可控且响应式的方式驱动身体在三维空间中运动。尽管人类运动生成已得到广泛研究,但许多现有方法缺乏真实人类运动的响应性与真实感。受基础模型最新进展的启发,我们提出PRIMAL,该模型采用两阶段范式进行学习。在预训练阶段,模型从大量亚秒级运动片段中学习身体运动,为构建更复杂的运动提供生成基础。该训练过程完全无监督且无需标注。在推理阶段,给定单帧初始状态,预训练模型不仅能生成无边界、真实且可控的运动,还能使角色实时响应诱导的冲击力。在适配阶段,我们采用新颖的ControlNet类适配器高效微调基础模型,使其适应少样本个性化动作生成、空间目标到达等新任务。评估结果表明,我们的方法优于现有最先进基线。我们利用该模型在Unreal Engine中构建了一个实时角色动画系统,其表现高度响应且自然。
abstract_en: We formulate the motor system of an interactive avatar as a generative motion model that can drive the body to move through 3D space in a perpetual, realistic, controllable, and responsive manner. Although human motion generation has been extensively studied, many existing methods lack the responsiveness and realism of real human movements. Inspired by recent advances in foundation models, we propose PRIMAL, which is learned with a two-stage paradigm. In the pretraining stage, the model learns body movements from a large number of sub-second motion segments, providing a generative foundation from which more complex motions are built. This training is fully unsupervised without annotations. Given a single-frame initial state during inference, the pretrained model not only generates unbounded, realistic, and controllable motion, but also enables the avatar to be responsive to induced impulses in real time. In the adaptation phase, we employ a novel ControlNet-like adaptor to fine-tune the base model efficiently, adapting it to new tasks such as few-shot personalized action generation and spatial target reaching. Evaluations show that our proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. We leverage the model to create a real-time character animation system in Unreal Engine that feels highly responsive and natural.
authors: Yan Zhang, Yao Feng, Alpár Cseke, Nitin Saini, Nathan Bajandas, Nicolas Heron, Michael J. Black ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12725-12736

title: PRISM:通过大语言模型引导的嵌入投影减少视觉-语言模型中的虚假隐式偏见
title_en: PRISM: Reducing Spurious Implicit Biases in Vision-Language Models with LLM-Guided Embedding Projection
abstract: 我们引入了基于投影的隐式虚假偏见减少方法(PRISM),这是一种针对如CLIP等视觉-语言模型(VLMs)的无数据、任务无关的偏见缓解新方案。VLMs通常会继承并放大训练数据中的偏见,导致预测结果出现偏差。PRISM设计用于在不依赖预定义偏见类别或额外外部数据的情况下对VLMs进行去偏。其操作分为两个阶段:首先,通过简单的类别提示引导大语言模型(LLM)生成包含虚假相关性的场景描述;随后,PRISM利用我们提出的对比式去偏损失,学习一种将嵌入映射到潜在空间的投影,该潜在空间在最小化虚假相关性的同时保持图像和文本嵌入之间的对齐。大量实验表明,PRISM在常用的数据集Waterbirds和CelebA上优于当前的去偏方法。我们的代码已公开:https://github.com/MahdiyarMM/PRISM
abstract_en: We introduce Projection-based Reduction of Implicit Spurious bias in vision-language Models (PRISM), a new data-free and task-agnostic solution for bias mitigation in VLMs like CLIP. VLMs often inherit and amplify biases in their training data, leading to skewed predictions.PRISM is designed to debias VLMs without relying on predefined bias categories or additional external data. It operates in two stages: first, an LLM is prompted with simple class prompts to generate scene descriptions that contain spurious correlations. Next, PRISM uses our novel contrastive-style debiasing loss to learn a projection that maps the embeddings onto a latent space that minimizes spurious correlations while preserving the alignment between image and text embeddings. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PRISM outperforms current debiasing methods on the commonly used Waterbirds and CelebA datasets We make our code public at: https://github.com/MahdiyarMM/PRISM.
authors: Mahdiyar Molahasani, Azadeh Motamedi, Michael Greenspan, Il-Min Kim, Ali Etemad ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 688-697

title: PRM:基于光度立体法的大规模重建模型
title_en: PRM: Photometric Stereo based Large Reconstruction Model
abstract: 我们提出PRM,一种新颖的基于光度立体法的大规模重建模型,用于重建具有细粒度细节的高质量网格。以往的大规模重建模型通常在固定且简单的光照条件下准备训练图像,为精确重建提供有限的光度线索。此外,包含镜面表面的图像被当作分布外样本处理,导致重建质量下降。为应对这些挑战,PRM通过改变材质和光照来生成图像,这不仅通过提供丰富的光度线索提升局部细节,还增强了模型对输入图像外观变化的鲁棒性。为了提供更强的灵活性,我们结合了实时基于物理的渲染(PBR)方法和网格光栅化技术,用于真实感渲染。通过将显式网格作为3D表示,PRM确保了可微分PBR在预测渲染中的应用。这种方法比以往的神经渲染方法更准确地建模了材质和光照变化图像的镜面颜色,并支持几何优化的多监督。大量实验表明,PRM显著优于其他模型。
abstract_en: We propose PRM, a novel photometric stereo based large reconstruction model to reconstruct high-quality meshes with fine-grained details. Previous large reconstruction models typically prepare training images under fixed and simple lighting, offering minimal photometric cues for precise reconstruction. Furthermore, images containing specular surfaces are treated as out-of-distribution samples, resulting in degraded reconstruction quality. To handle these challenges, PRM renders images by varying materials and lighting, which not only improves the local details by providing rich photometric cues but also increases the model's robustness to variations in the appearance of input images. To offer enhanced flexibility, we incorporate a real-time physically-based rendering (PBR) method and mesh rasterization for ground-truth rendering. By using an explicit mesh as 3D representation, PRM ensures the application of differentiable PBR for predicted rendering. This approach models specular color more accurately for images with varying materials and illumination than previous neural rendering methods and supports multiple supervisions for geometry optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PRM significantly outperforms other models.
authors: Wenhang Ge, Jiantao Lin, Guibao Shen, Jiawei Feng, Tao Hu, Xinli Xu, Ying-Cong Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25009-25018

title: PRO-VPT: 基于提示迁移的分布自适应视觉提示调优
title_en: PRO-VPT: Distribution-Adaptive Visual Prompt Tuning via Prompt Relocation
abstract: 视觉提示调优(VPT),即对轻量级提示标记进行微调,为预训练模型适应各类下游任务提供了一种高效且有效的方法。然而,大多数现有方法在不同任务中 indiscriminately 使用固定提示分布,忽视了每个块的重要性会根据任务而变化。本文通过解决两个关键问题引入自适应分布优化(ADO):(1)如何适当且形式化地定义 ADO?(2)如何设计基于该定义的自适应分布策略?通过实证分析,我们首先确认适当调整分布可显著提升 VPT 性能,并进一步揭示 ADO 与 VPT 之间存在嵌套关系的关键洞察。基于这些发现,我们提出新的 VPT 框架,称为 PRO-VPT(基于迭代提示迁移的 VPT),其通过嵌套优化公式自适应调整分布。具体而言,我们开发了源自该公式的提示迁移策略,包含两个步骤:从提示饱和块中剪枝闲置提示,随后将这些提示分配给最需要提示的块。通过迭代执行提示迁移和 VPT,我们的方法可在嵌套优化框架下自适应学习最优提示分布,从而释放 VPT 的全部潜力。大量实验表明,我们的方法显著优于先进 VPT 方法,例如 PRO-VPT 在准确率上超越 VPT 1.6 个百分点和 2.0 个百分点,使基于提示的方法在 VTAB-1k 和 FGVC 基准上达到最先进性能。代码可在 https://github.com/ckshang/PRO-VPT 获取。
abstract_en: Visual prompt tuning (VPT), i.e., fine-tuning some lightweight prompt tokens, provides an efficient and effective approach for adapting pre-trained models to various downstream tasks. However, most prior art indiscriminately uses a fixed prompt distribution across different tasks, neglecting the importance of each block varying depending on the task. In this paper, we introduce adaptive distribution optimization (ADO) by tackling two key questions: (1) How to appropriately and formally define ADO, and (2) How to design an adaptive distribution strategy guided by this definition? Through empirical analysis, we first confirm that properly adjusting the distribution significantly improves VPT performance, and further uncover a key insight that a nested relationship exists between ADO and VPT. Based on these findings, we propose a new VPT framework, termed PRO-VPT (iterative Prompt RelOcation-based VPT), which adaptively adjusts the distribution built upon a nested optimization formulation. Specifically, we develop a prompt relocation strategy derived from this formulation, comprising two steps: pruning idle prompts from prompt-saturated blocks, followed by allocating these prompts to the most prompt-needed blocks. By iteratively performing prompt relocation and VPT, our proposal can adaptively learn the optimal prompt distribution in a nested optimization-based manner, thereby unlocking the full potential of VPT. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposal significantly outperforms advanced VPT methods, e.g., PRO-VPT surpasses VPT by 1.6 pp and 2.0 pp average accuracy, leading prompt-based methods to state-of-the-art performance on VTAB-1k and FGVC benchmarks. The code is available at https://github.com/ckshang/PRO-VPT.
authors: Chikai Shang, Mengke Li, Yiqun Zhang, Zhen Chen, Jinlin Wu, Fangqing Gu, Yang Lu, Yiu-Ming Cheung ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1558-1568

title: PROGRESSOR:一种基于感知引导的自监督在线优化奖励估计器
title_en: PROGRESSOR: A Perceptually Guided Reward Estimator with Self-Supervised Online Refinement
abstract: 我们提出PROGRESSOR,一种新颖框架,能够从视频中学习任务无关的奖励函数,通过目标条件强化学习(RL)实现策略训练,无需人工监督。该奖励函数的核心是通过当前、初始和目标观测值估计任务进展的分布,该分布以自监督方式学习。关键在于,PROGRESSOR在在线RL训练过程中通过对抗性优化来精炼奖励,通过推回分布外观测值的预测以缓解非专家观测固有的分布偏移。利用这种进展预测作为密集奖励,并结合对抗性推回,我们证明PROGRESSOR使机器人能够在无外部监督的情况下学习复杂行为。在EPIC-KITCHENS大规模第一视角人类视频上预训练后,PROGRESSOR无需在领域内任务特定数据上微调即可实现对噪声演示下的真实机器人离线RL的泛化,其性能优于提供密集视觉奖励的当代方法。我们的发现凸显了PROGRESSOR在可扩展机器人应用中的潜力,特别是在直接动作标签和任务特定奖励不易获得的场景中。
abstract_en: We present PROGRESSOR, a novel framework that learns a task-agnostic reward function from videos, enabling policy training through goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (RL) without manual supervision. Underlying this reward is an estimate of the distribution over task progress as a function of the current, initial, and goal observations that is learned in a self-supervised fashion. Crucially, PROGRESSOR refines rewards adversarially during online RL training by pushing back predictions for out-of-distribution observations in order to mitigate distribution shift inherent in non-expert observations. Utilizing this progress prediction as a dense reward together with an adversarial push-back, we show that PROGRESSOR enables robots to learn complex behaviors without any external supervision. Pretrained on large-scale egocentric human video from EPIC-KITCHENS, PROGRESSOR requires no fine-tuning on in-domain task-specific data for generalization to real-robot offline RL under noisy demonstrations, outperforming contemporary methods that provide dense visual reward for robotic learning. Our findings highlight the potential of PROGRESSOR for scalable robotic applications where direct action labels and task-specific rewards are not readily available.
authors: Tewodros W. Ayalew, Xiao Zhang, Kevin Yuanbo Wu, Tianchong Jiang, Michael Maire, Matthew R. Walter ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10297-10306

title: PROL:基于提示的流数据持续学习无需重放方法
title_en: PROL : Rehearsal Free Continual Learning in Streaming Data via Prompt Online Learning
abstract: 在线持续学习(OCL)中的数据隐私约束,即数据只能被查看一次,使流数据中的灾难性遗忘问题更加复杂。当前SOTA方法常采用记忆节省的示例或先前类别的特征进行重放。另一方面,基于提示的方法在持续学习中表现出色,但代价是可训练参数数量的持续增长。第一种方法可能因数据开放政策而无法实际应用,而第二种方法则面临流数据相关的吞吐量问题。本研究提出了一种新颖的基于提示的在线持续学习方法,包含4个主要组件:(1) 单个轻量级提示生成器作为通用知识,(2) 可训练的缩放-位移器作为特定知识,(3) 预训练模型(PTM)泛化保持,(4) 硬-软更新机制。我们的方法在CIFAR100、ImageNet-R、ImageNet-A和CUB数据集上显著优于当前SOTA方法。复杂度分析表明,我们的方法需要相对较少的参数,且实现中等的训练时间、推理时间和吞吐量。源代码已开源于https://github.com/anwarmaxsum/PROL。
abstract_en: The data privacy constraint in online continual learning (OCL), where the data can be seen only once, complicates the catastrophic forgetting problem in streaming data. A common approach applied by the current SOTAs in OCL is the use of memory-saving exemplars or features from previous classes to be replayed in the current task. On the other hand, the prompt-based approach performs excellently in continual learning, but at the cost of a growing number of trainable parameters. The first approach may not be applicable in practice due to the data openness policy, while the second approach has the issue of throughput associated with the streaming data. In this study, we propose a novel prompt-based method for online continual learning that includes 4 main components: (1) single light-weight prompt generator as a general knowledge, (2) trainable scaler-and-shifter as specific knowledge, (3) pre-trained model (PTM) generalization preserving, and (4) hard-soft updates mechanism. Our proposed method achieves significantly higher performance than the current SOTAs in CIFAR100, ImageNet-R, ImageNet-A, and CUB dataset. Our complexity analysis shows that our method requires a relatively smaller number of parameters and achieves moderate training time, inference time, and throughput. For further study, the source code of our method is available at https://github.com/anwarmaxsum/PROL.
authors: M. Anwar Ma'sum, Mahardhika Pratama, Savitha Ramasamy, Lin Liu, Habibullah Habibullah, Ryszard Kowalczyk ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2471-2481

title: PRVQL: 渐进式知识引导优化用于鲁棒的第一视角视觉查询定位
title_en: PRVQL: Progressive Knowledge-guided Refinement for Robust Egocentric Visual Query Localization
abstract: 第一视角视觉查询定位(EgoVQL)旨在从第一人称视频中,根据视觉查询在时空维度定位目标。尽管近期出现了渐进式方法,现有方法常因缺乏足够的目标线索而难以处理视频中严重的物体外观变化和背景杂乱问题,导致性能退化。为解决这一问题,我们提出PRVQL,一种新颖的渐进式知识引导优化框架用于EgoVQL。其核心是持续从视频中直接挖掘与目标相关知识,并利用其指导查询和视频特征的优化,以提升目标定位效果。PRVQL包含多个处理阶段。前一阶段提取的包含外观和空间知识的目标知识,通过两个专门设计的知识学习模块获取,作为指导用于优化下一阶段的查询和视频特征,进而生成更精确的知识以进一步优化特征。通过这种渐进式流程,PRVQL中的目标知识可逐步提升,从而在最终阶段实现更优的查询和视频特征优化。与先前方法相比,PRVQL除给定物体线索外,还利用视频中额外的关键目标信息作为指导优化特征,因此在复杂场景中增强了EgoVQL性能。在具有挑战性的Ego4D数据集上的实验表明,PRVQL取得了最先进结果并显著超越其他方法,验证了其有效性。我们的代码、模型和结果将在https://github.com/fb-reps/PRVQL发布。
abstract_en: Egocentric visual query localization (EgoVQL) focuses on localizing the target of interest in space and time from first-person videos, given a visual query. Despite recent progressive, existing methods often struggle to handle severe object appearance changes and cluttering background in the video due to lacking sufficient target cues, leading to degradation. Addressing this, we introduce PRVQL, a novel Progressive knowledge-guided Refinement framework for EgoVQL. The core is to continuously exploit target-relevant knowledge directly from videos and utilize it as guidance to refine both query and video features for improving target localization. Our PRVQL contains multiple processing stages. The target knowledge from one stage, comprising appearance and spatial knowledge extracted via two specially designed knowledge learning modules, are utilized as guidance to refine the query and videos features for the next stage, which are used to generate more accurate knowledge for further feature refinement. With such a progressive process, target knowledge in PRVQL can be gradually improved, which, in turn, leads to better refined query and video features for localization in the final stage. Compared to previous methods, our PRVQL, besides the given object cues, enjoys additional crucial target information from a video as guidance to refine features, and hence enhances EgoVQL in complicated scenes. In our experiments on challenging Ego4D, PRVQL achieves state-of-the-art result and largely surpasses other methods, showing its efficacy. Our code, model, and results will be released at https://github.com/fb-reps/PRVQL.
authors: Bing Fan, Yunhe Feng, Yapeng Tian, James Chenhao Liang, Yuewei Lin, Yan Huang, Heng Fan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5156-5165

title: PS-Mamba: 基于时空图Mamba的人体姿态序列优化
title_en: PS-Mamba: Spatial-Temporal Graph Mamba for Pose Sequence Refinement
abstract: 人体姿态序列优化在提升帧序列中姿态估计的时间一致性方面发挥着关键作用。尽管其在实际应用中具有重要价值,但相较于人体姿态估计,人体姿态序列优化的研究仍显不足。本文提出PS-Mamba框架,通过融合时空图学习与状态空间建模技术,实现对人体姿态序列的优化。具体而言,我们引入时空图状态空间(ST-GSS)模块,该模块通过捕捉关节间的时空依赖关系,在平滑姿态序列的同时保持结构完整性。时空图学习复杂关节交互关系,而状态空间组件有效管理时间动态,降低短时与长时姿态不稳定性。此外,我们引入动态图权重矩阵,自适应建模关节交互的相对影响,进一步缓解姿态歧义。在具有挑战性的基准测试中,我们的PS-Mamba超越现有最优方法(SOTAs),在AIST++数据集上相比SynSP取得-14.21 mm MPJPE (+18.5%\uparrow)、-13.59 mm PA-MPJPE (+22.1%\uparrow)和-0.42 mm/s2 ACCEL (+9.7%\uparrow)的显著提升,有效减少抖动并增强姿态稳定性。
abstract_en: Human pose sequence refinement plays a crucial role in improving the temporal coherence of pose estimation across the sequence of frames. Despite its importance in real-world applications, human pose sequence refinement has received less attention than human pose estimation. In this paper, we propose PS-Mamba, a novel framework that refines human pose sequences by integrating spatial-temporal graph learning with state space modeling. Specifically, we introduce the Spatial-Temporal Graph State Space (ST-GSS) block, which captures spatial and temporal dependencies across joints to smooth pose sequences while preserving structural integrity. The spatial-temporal graph learns intricate joint interactions, while the state space component effectively manages temporal dynamics, reducing both short- and long-term pose instability. Besides, we incorporate a dynamic graph weight matrix to adaptively model the relative influence of joint interactions, further mitigating pose ambiguity. Experiments on challenging benchmarks show that our PS-Mamba outperforms SOTAs, achieving -14.21 mm MPJPE (+18.5%\uparrow), -13.59 mm PA-MPJPE (+22.1%\uparrow), and -0.42 mm/s2 ACCEL (+9.7%\uparrow) compared to SynSP on AIST++, significantly reducing jitters and enhancing pose stability.
authors: Haoye Dong, Gim Hee Lee ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8568-8578

title: PS3:一种整合病理报告、组织学图像和生物通路的多模态Transformer模型用于癌症生存预测
title_en: PS3: A Multimodal Transformer Integrating Pathology Reports with Histology Images and Biological Pathways for Cancer Survival Prediction
abstract: 当前计算肿瘤学中的多模态融合方法主要集中在将多吉像素的组织学全切片图像(WSIs)与基因组或转录组数据整合,显示出改善的生存预测效果。我们假设整合病理报告可以进一步提升预后性能。作为临床工作流程的重要组成部分,病理报告通过总结组织病理学发现并整合专家解读和临床背景,提供了可直接获取的互补信息。然而,由于这些模态的异质性,融合它们存在挑战。WSIs是高维数据,每个包含数十亿像素,而病理报告则是不同长度的简洁文本摘要,导致潜在的模态不平衡。为解决这一问题,我们提出一种基于原型的方法生成平衡表示,随后通过基于Transformer的融合模型进行整合,用于生存预测,我们称之为PS3(从三种模态预测生存)。具体而言,我们提出:(1) 从病理报告中提取诊断原型,利用自注意力机制提取诊断相关部分并标准化文本表示;(2) 组织学原型用于紧凑表示WSIs中的关键形态学模式;(3) 生物通路原型用于编码转录组表达,准确捕捉细胞功能。PS3这一三模态Transformer模型处理由此产生的基于原型的多模态标记,并建模病理报告、WSIs和转录组数据之间的模态内及跨模态交互。在癌症基因组图谱(TCGA)的六个数据集上,与临床、单模态和多模态基线方法相比,所提模型表现优于现有最先进方法。代码将在发表后发布。
abstract_en: Current multimodal fusion approaches in computational oncology primarily focus on integrating multi-gigapixel histology whole slide images (WSIs) with genomic or transcriptomic data, demonstrating improved survival prediction. We hypothesize that incorporating pathology reports can further enhance prognostic performance. Pathology reports, as essential components of clinical workflows, offer readily available complementary information by summarizing histopathological findings and integrating expert interpretations and clinical context. However, fusing these modalities poses challenges due to their heterogeneous nature. WSIs are high-dimensional, each containing several billion pixels, whereas pathology reports consist of concise text summaries of varying lengths, leading to potential modality imbalance. To address this, we propose a prototype-based approach to generate balanced representations, which are then integrated using a Transformer-based fusion model for survival prediction that we term PS3 (Predicting Survival from Three Modalities). Specifically, we present: (1) Diagnostic prototypes from pathology reports, leveraging self-attention to extract diagnostically relevant sections and standardize text representation; (2) Histological prototypes to compactly represent key morphological patterns in WSIs; and (3) Biological pathway prototypes to encode transcriptomic expressions, accurately capturing cellular functions. PS3, the three-modal transformer model, processes the resulting prototype-based multimodal tokens and models intra-modal and cross-modal interactions across pathology reports, WSIs and transcriptomic data. The proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art methods when evaluated against clinical, unimodal and multimodal baselines on six datasets from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA). The code will be released upon publication.
authors: Manahil Raza, Ayesha Azam, Talha Qaiser, Nasir Rajpoot ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22175-22186

title: PUMA: 以多粒度视觉生成赋能统一多模态大语言模型
title_en: PUMA: Empowering Unified MLLM with Multi-granular Visual Generation
abstract: 多模态基础模型的最新进展在视觉-语言理解领域取得了显著突破。初步尝试也探索了多模态大语言模型在视觉内容生成中的潜力。然而,现有方法在生成多样性与可控性之间存在权衡,难以在统一的多模态大语言模型框架内满足不同图像生成任务的多样化粒度需求。本文提出PUMA(Powering Unified MLLM with Multi-grAnular visual generation),一种新型范式,旨在解决多样性-可控性权衡问题。PUMA通过将多粒度视觉特征统一为多模态大语言模型的输入和输出,从而在单一框架内有效满足多样化生成和精确操控的差异化粒度需求。经过多模态预训练和指令调优后,PUMA在包括图像理解、多样化文本到图像生成、编辑、修复、上色和条件生成等广泛多模态任务中展现出卓越能力。本工作标志着实现真正统一多模态大语言模型的重要进展,该模型能够无缝适应各类视觉任务中固有的多样化粒度需求和任务要求。代码和模型将在接受后发布。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in multimodal foundation models have yielded significant progress in vision-language understanding. Initial attempts have also explored the potential of multimodal large language models for visual content generation. However, existing approaches face a trade-off between generation diversity and controllability, struggling to meet the varying granularity demands of different image generation tasks within a unified MLLM framework. In this work, we propose PUMA, emPowering Unified MLLM with Multi-grAnular visual generation, a novel paradigm that tackles the diversity-controllability trade-off. PUMA achieves this by unifying multi-granular visual features as both inputs and outputs of MLLMs, thus effectively meeting the distinct granularity needs for diverse generation and precise manipulation within a single framework. Following multimodal pretraining and instruction tuning, PUMA demonstrates remarkable capabilities in a wide range of multimodal tasks, including image understanding, diverse text-to-image generation, editing, inpainting, colorization, and conditional generation. This work marks a significant stride towards realizing truly unified MLLMs capable of seamlessly adapting to the diverse granularity demands and task requirements inherent in various visual tasks. The code and model will be released upon acceptance.
authors: Rongyao Fang, Chengqi Duan, Kun Wang, Hao Li, Linjiang Huang, Hao Tian, Xingyu Zeng, Rui Zhao, Jifeng Dai, Hongsheng Li, Xihui Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15447-15457

title: PUMPS:面向人类运动任务的骨骼无关点基通用运动预训练
title_en: PUMPS: Skeleton-Agnostic Point-based Universal Motion Pre-Training for Synthesis in Human Motion Tasks
abstract: 运动骨骼通过转换骨骼层次驱动3D角色动画,但比例或结构差异导致运动数据难以跨骨骼迁移,给数据驱动的运动合成带来挑战。时间点云(TPCs)提供了一种无结构、跨兼容的运动表示。尽管TPCs可与骨骼互逆,但其主要服务于兼容性而非直接运动任务学习。实现这一目标需要TPC格式的数据合成能力,这涉及其独特的时间一致性和点可识别性所带来的未探索挑战。因此,我们提出PUMPS,这是TPC数据的原始自编码器架构。PUMPS独立地将帧级点云降维为可采样的特征向量,解码器通过潜在高斯噪声向量作为采样标识符提取独特的时序点。我们引入基于线性分配的点配对优化TPC重建过程,并在架构中摒弃昂贵的点级注意力机制。利用这些潜在特征,我们预训练出能够执行运动预测、过渡生成和关键帧插值的运动合成模型。在无需原生数据集监督的预训练任务中,PUMPS表现优异,匹配最先进的性能。当微调用于运动去噪或估计时,PUMPS在不偏离其通用架构的情况下优于许多相应方法。
abstract_en: Motion skeletons drive 3D character animation by transforming bone hierarchies, but differences in proportions or structure make motion data hard to transfer across skeletons, posing challenges for data-driven motion synthesis. Temporal Point Clouds (TPCs) offer an unstructured, cross-compatible motion representation. Though reversible with skeletons, TPCs mainly serve for compatibility, not for direct motion task learning. Doing so would require data synthesis capabilities for the TPC format, which presents unexplored challenges regarding its unique temporal consistency and point identifiability. Therefore, we propose PUMPS, the primordial autoencoder architecture for TPC data. PUMPS independently reduces frame-wise point clouds into sampleable feature vectors, from which a decoder extracts distinct temporal points using latent Gaussian noise vectors as sampling identifiers. We introduce linear assignment-based point pairing to optimise the TPC reconstruction process, and negate the use of expensive point-wise attention mechanisms in the architecture. Using these latent features, we pre-train a motion synthesis model capable of performing motion prediction, transition generation, and keyframe interpolation. For these pre-training tasks, PUMPS performs remarkably well even without native dataset supervision, matching state-of-the-art performance. When fine-tuned for motion denoising or estimation, PUMPS outperforms many respective methods without deviating from its generalist architecture.
authors: Clinton Ansun Mo, Kun Hu, Chengjiang Long, Dong Yuan, Wan-Chi Siu, Zhiyong Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14496-14506

title: PVChat:基于单次学习的个性化视频聊天
title_en: PVChat: Personalized Video Chat with One-Shot Learning
abstract: 视频大语言模型(ViLLMs)在通用视频理解方面表现出色,例如识别谈话和进食等行为,但在身份感知理解方面存在局限,如"Wilson正在接受化疗"或"Tom正在与Sarah讨论",这限制了其在智能医疗和智能家居环境中的适用性。为解决这一局限,我们提出了一种单次学习框架PVChat,这是首个能够从单个视频中实现主体感知问答(QA)的个性化ViLLM。我们的方法在合成增强的视频问答数据集上优化了头部混合(MoH)增强的ViLLM,采用渐进式图像到视频学习策略。具体而言,我们引入了自动化增强管道,合成身份保持的正样本并从现有视频语料库中检索困难负样本,生成包含存在性、外观、动作和位置四种问答类型的多样化训练数据集。为增强主体特定学习,我们提出了一种ReLU路由MoH注意力机制,以及两个新目标:(1) 通过指数距离缩放实现渐进学习的平滑邻近正则化,(2) 头部激活增强以实现注意力路由的平衡。最后,我们采用两阶段训练策略,从图像预训练过渡到视频微调,使模型能够从静态属性逐步学习到动态表征。我们在涵盖医疗场景、电视剧、动漫和现实世界视频的多样化数据集上评估PVChat,证明其在单视频学习后个性化特征理解方面优于现有最先进的ViLLM。
abstract_en: Video large language models (ViLLMs) excel in general video understanding, e.g., recognizing activities like talking and eating, but struggle with identity-aware comprehension, such as "Wilson is receiving chemotherapy" or "Tom is discussing with Sarah", limiting their applicability in smart healthcare and smart home environments. To address this limitation, we propose a one-shot learning framework PVChat, the first personalized ViLLM that enables subject-aware question answering (QA) from a single video for each subject. Our approach optimizes a Mixture-of-Heads (MoH) enhanced ViLLM on a synthetically augmented video-QA dataset, leveraging a progressive image-to-video learning strategy. Specifically, we introduce an automated augmentation pipeline that synthesizes identity-preserving positive samples and retrieves hard negatives from existing video corpora, generating a diverse training dataset with four QA types: existence, appearance, action, and location inquiries. To enhance subject-specific learning, we propose a ReLU Routing MoH attention mechanism, alongside two novel objectives: (1) Smooth Proximity Regularization for progressive learning through exponential distance scaling and (2) Head Activation Enhancement for balanced attention routing. Finally, we adopt a two-stage training strategy, transitioning from image pre-training to video fine-tuning, enabling a gradual learning process from static attributes to dynamic representations. We evaluate PVChat on diverse datasets covering medical scenarios, TV series, anime, and real-world footage, demonstrating its superiority in personalized feature understanding after learning from a single video, compared to state-of-the-art ViLLMs.
authors: Yufei Shi, Weilong Yan, Gang Xu, Yumeng Li, Yucheng Chen, Zhenxi Li, Fei Yu, Ming Li, Si Yong Yeo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23321-23331

title: PVMamba: 通过动态状态聚合并行化视觉Mamba
title_en: PVMamba: Parallelizing Vision Mamba via Dynamic State Aggregation
abstract: Mamba是一种具有类似RNN序列建模能力的状态空间模型(SSM)架构,在长距离建模中展现出高效且有前景的能力。然而,Mamba模型在处理结构化的二维视觉数据时,由于依赖顺序计算,其性能落后于基于注意力机制的对应模型。本文提出了一种并行视觉Mamba(PVMamba),这是一种专为视觉数据设计的新颖SSM架构。PVMamba包含两个关键设计:1)基于视觉信号的稀疏性和邻近性,我们通过三个核心步骤实现顺序计算的并行化,称为动态状态聚合(DSA),即并行化、对齐和聚合。DSA通过可行的空间聚合生成SSM的隐藏状态,从而克服了固有的顺序约束。2)在保持线性计算复杂度的同时,我们应用动态算子学习每个隐藏状态的空间采样。为进一步提升局部建模能力,我们在浅层网络中限制动态算子仅作用于邻近像素。我们还设计了一种层复用技术以稳定训练并减少学习冗余。PVMamba是一种适用于多种视觉任务(如图像分类和密集预测)的通用骨干网络,其包含动态算子。大量实验表明,PVMamba在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Mamba, an architecture with RNN-like sequence modeling of State Space Model (SSM), has demonstrated promising capabilities in long-range modeling with high efficiency. However, Mamba models struggle with structured 2D visual data using sequential computing, thereby lagging behind their attention-based counterparts. In this paper, we propose a Parallel Vision Mamba (PVMamba), a novel SSM architecture tailored for visual data. PVMamba encompasses two key designs: 1) Based on the sparsity and adjacency of visual signals, we parallelize the sequential computing through three core steps, termed Dynamic State Aggregation (DSA), i.e., parallelization, alignment, and aggregation. DSA generates the hidden state in SSM by a feasible spatial aggregation, thereby overcoming the inherent sequential constraints. 2) Along with maintaining linear computational complexity, we apply a dynamic operator to learn the spatial samplings for each hidden state. To further boost the local modeling capability, we restrict the dynamic operator to the neighboring pixels in shallow layers. We also devise a layer multiplexing technique to stabilize the training and reduce the learning redundancy. PVMamba is a versatile backbone network with dynamic operators for various vision tasks, such as image classification and dense prediction. Extensive experiments show that PVMamba achieves state-of-the-art performance on a range of benchmarks.
authors: Fei Xie, Zhongdao Wang, Weijia Zhang, Chao Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10218-10228

title: PacGDC:基于投影歧义与一致性的标签高效可泛化深度补全
title_en: PacGDC: Label-Efficient Generalizable Depth Completion with Projection Ambiguity and Consistency
abstract: 可泛化深度补全能够为未见过的环境获取密集度量深度图,为各种下游任务提供强大的感知能力。然而,训练此类模型通常需要大规模带有度量深度标签的数据集,而这些数据集的收集往往耗时费力。本文提出PacGDC,一种标签高效的技巧,通过最小的标注努力增强可泛化深度补全的数据多样性。PacGDC基于对物体形状和位置在2D到3D投影中固有歧义和一致性的新见解,允许合成同一视觉场景的大量伪几何结构。这一过程通过操纵对应深度图的场景尺度,大大扩展了可用的几何结构。为了利用这一特性,我们提出了一种新的数据合成流程,使用多个深度基础模型作为尺度操纵器。这些模型能够稳健地提供具有不同场景尺度的伪深度标签,影响局部物体和全局布局,同时确保投影一致性以支持泛化。为进一步多样化几何结构,我们结合插值和重定位策略,以及未标记图像,扩展数据覆盖范围,超越单一基础模型的使用。大量实验表明,PacGDC在多个基准测试中表现出色,零样本和少样本设置下在多样场景语义/尺度和深度稀疏性/模式下具有显著的泛化能力。Code: https://github.com/Wang-xjtu/PacGDC.
abstract_en: Generalizable depth completion enables the acquisition of dense metric depth maps for unseen environments, offering robust perception capabilities for various downstream tasks. However, training such models typically requires large-scale datasets with metric depth labels, which are often labor-intensive to collect. This paper presents PacGDC, a label-efficient technique that enhances data diversity with minimal annotation effort for generalizable depth completion. PacGDC builds on novel insights into inherent ambiguities and consistencies in object shapes and positions during 2D-to-3D projection, allowing the synthesis of numerous pseudo geometries for the same visual scene. This process greatly broadens available geometries by manipulating scene scales of the corresponding depth maps. To leverage this property, we propose a new data synthesis pipeline that uses multiple depth foundation models as scale manipulators. These models robustly provide pseudo depth labels with varied scene scales, affecting both local objects and global layouts, while ensuring projection consistency that supports generalization. To further diversify geometries, we incorporate interpolation and relocation strategies, as well as unlabeled images, extending the data coverage beyond the individual use of foundation models. Extensive experiments show that PacGDC achieves remarkable generalizability across multiple benchmarks, excelling in diverse scene semantics/scales and depth sparsity/patterns under both zero-shot and few-shot settings. Code: https://github.com/Wang-xjtu/PacGDC.
authors: Haotian Wang, Aoran Xiao, Xiaoqin Zhang, Meng Yang, Shijian Lu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7709-7720

title: PanSt3R:多视角一致的全景分割
title_en: PanSt3R: Multi-view Consistent Panoptic Segmentation
abstract: 三维全景分割是场景理解中的基础问题。现有方法通常依赖于成本高昂的测试时优化(通常基于NeRF)来整合现成全景分割方法的2D预测结果到三维空间。相反,本文提出了一种统一且集成的方法PanSt3R,通过单次前向传播联合预测三维几何结构和多视角一致的全景分割,从而消除了测试时优化的需求。我们的方法利用了MUSt3R(DUSt3R的可扩展多视角版本)的三维表示和DINOv2的二维表示,通过掩码Transformer架构进行联合多视角全景预测。我们还重新审视了标准的后处理掩码合并流程,并引入了一种更为严谨的多视角分割方法。此外,我们还提出了一种基于PanSt3R和基础3DGS预测结果生成新视角预测的简单方法。总体而言,所提出的PanSt3R在概念上简单且高效可扩展,在多个基准测试中实现了最先进性能,同时速度提升了几个数量级。
abstract_en: Panoptic segmentation in 3D is a fundamental problem in scene understanding. Existing approaches typically rely on costly test-time optimizations (often based on NeRF) to consolidate 2D predictions of off-the-shelf panoptic segmentation methods into 3D. Instead, in this work, we propose a unified and integrated approach PanSt3R, which eliminates the need for test-time optimization by jointly predicting 3D geometry and multi-view-consistent panoptic segmentation in a single forward pass. Our approach harnesses the 3D representations of MUSt3R, a recent scalable multi-view version of DUSt3R, and 2D representations of DINOv2, then performs joint multi-view panoptic prediction via a mask transformer architecture. We additionally revisit the standard post-processing mask merging procedure and introduce a more principled approach for multi-view segmentation. We also introduce a simple method for generating novel-view predictions based on the predictions of PanSt3R and vanilla 3DGS. Overall, the proposed PanSt3R is conceptually simple yet fast and scalable, and achieves state-of-the-art performance on several benchmarks, while being orders of magnitude faster.
authors: Lojze Zust, Yohann Cabon, Juliette Marrie, Leonid Antsfeld, Boris Chidlovskii, Jerome Revaud, Gabriela Csurka ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5856-5866

title: PanoLlama: 基于下一个标记预测的大型语言模型生成无尽且连贯的全景图
title_en: PanoLlama: Generating Endless and Coherent Panoramas with Next-Token-Prediction LLMs
abstract: 全景图像生成(PIG)旨在创建任意长度的连贯图像。现有方法大多采用联合扩散范式,但其复杂且启发式的裁剪连接设计常限制多层级连贯性的实现。通过将该挑战分解为核心组件,我们发现其自然契合下一个标记预测,从而采用自回归(AR)范式进行PIG建模。然而,现有视觉自回归(VAR)模型局限于固定尺寸生成,缺乏生成全景图像的能力。本文提出PanoLlama,一种新型框架,通过自回归范式实现无尽且连贯的全景图生成。我们的方法开发了无需训练的策略,利用标记重定向突破现有VAR模型的尺寸限制,实现水平和垂直方向的下一次裁剪预测。该方法刷新了PIG流程,同时在连贯性(47.50%)、保真度(28.16%)和美学(15%)方面达到SOTA性能。此外,PanoLlama支持其他PIG方法无法实现的应用,包括无需掩码的布局控制、多尺度和多引导合成。为促进标准化评估,我们还构建了一个包含1,000个提示、涵盖100+主题的数据集,为PIG研究提供新的测试基准。
abstract_en: Panoramic Image Generation (PIG) aims to create coherent images of arbitrary lengths. Most existing methods fall in the joint diffusion paradigm, but their complex and heuristic crop connection designs often limit their ability to achieve multilevel coherence. By deconstructing this challenge into its core components, we find it naturally aligns with next-token prediction, leading us to adopt an autoregressive (AR) paradigm for PIG modeling. However, existing visual AR (VAR) models are limited to fixed-size generation, lacking the capability to produce panoramic images. In this paper, we propose PanoLlama, a novel framework that achieves endless and coherent panorama generation with the autoregressive paradigm. Our approach develops a training-free strategy that utilizes token redirection to overcome the size limitations of existing VAR models, enabling next-crop prediction in both horizontal and vertical directions. This refreshes the PIG pipeline while achieving SOTA performance in coherence (47.50%), fidelity(28.16%), and aesthetics (15%). Additionally, PanoLlama supports applications other PIG methods cannot achieve, including mask-free layout control, multi-scale and multi-guidance synthesis. To facilitate standardized evaluation, we also establish a dataset with 1,000 prompts spanning 100+ themes, providing a new testing benchmark for PIG research.
authors: Teng Zhou, Xiaoyu Zhang, Yongchuan Tang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15340-15349

title: PanoSplatt3R: 利用视角预训练实现通用无姿态宽基线全景重建
title_en: PanoSplatt3R: Leveraging Perspective Pretraining for Generalized Unposed Wide-Baseline Panorama Reconstruction
abstract: 宽基线全景重建已成为实现周围三维环境几何重建以及生成高度真实且沉浸式新视角的高效关键方法。尽管现有方法在各类基准测试中表现出色,但它们主要依赖于精确的姿态信息。在实际现实场景中,获取精确姿态往往需要额外的计算资源,并且极易受到噪声干扰。这些限制阻碍了此类方法的广泛应用和实用性。本文提出PanoSplatt3R,一种无需姿态信息的宽基线全景重建方法。我们扩展并适配了视角领域的基础重建预训练模型至全景领域,从而实现强大的泛化能力。为确保无缝高效的领域迁移过程,我们引入RoPE滚动机制,通过在不同注意力头间的旋转位置嵌入中跨越卷积坐标,保持对RoPE机制的最小修改,同时建模全景图像的水平周期性。综合实验表明,即使在缺乏姿态信息的情况下,PanoSplatt3R仍显著优于当前最先进的方法。其优越性在高质量新视角生成和深度估计准确性方面均有体现,展示了其在实际应用中的巨大潜力。
abstract_en: Wide-baseline panorama reconstruction has emerged as a highly effective and pivotal approach for not only achieving geometric reconstruction of the surrounding 3D environment, but also generating highly realistic and immersive novel views. Although existing methods have shown remarkable performance across various benchmarks, they are predominantly reliant on accurate pose information. In practical real-world scenarios, the acquisition of precise pose often requires additional computational resources and is highly susceptible to noise. These limitations hinder the broad applicability and practicality of such methods. In this paper, we present PanoSplatt3R, an unposed wide-baseline panorama reconstruction method. We extend and adapt the foundational reconstruction pretrainings from the perspective domain to the panoramic domain, thus enabling powerful generalization capabilities. To ensure a seamless and efficient domain-transfer process, we introduce RoPE rolling that spans rolled coordinates in rotary positional embeddings across different attention heads, maintaining a minimal modification to RoPE's mechanism, while modeling the horizontal periodicity of panorama images.Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that PanoSplatt3R, even in the absence of pose information, significantly outperforms current state-of-the-art methods. This superiority is evident in both the generation of high-quality novel views and the accuracy of depth estimation, thereby showcasing its great potential for practical applications.
authors: Jiahui Ren, Mochu Xiang, Jiajun Zhu, Yuchao Dai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28959-28969

title: 通过嵌入偏转实现地理空间基础模型的参数高效适配
title_en: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Geospatial Foundation Models through Embedding Deflection
abstract: 随着大规模异构数据集的日益丰富,以低成本适配基础模型已成为关键问题。自然语言处理领域的开创性工作,例如低秩适配(LoRA),利用了适配过程中参数更新的低"固有秩"特性。本文我们认为,通过在数据和模型中引入更强的归纳偏置,可以提升基于RGB卫星图像预训练的地理空间基础模型(GFMs)对其他类型光学卫星数据的适配能力。具体而言,GFMs的预训练参数为多光谱图像的空间结构提供了强先验。基于此,我们提出DEFLECT(用于地球与气候任务的嵌入偏转微调策略),一种通过极少额外参数即可适配多光谱卫星图像的创新方法。DEFLECT提升了提取特征的表征能力,特别是增强了光谱信息,这对于地球科学和环境相关任务至关重要。我们在三个不同的GFMs和五个多样化的数据集上验证了方法的有效性,涵盖森林监测到海洋环境分割等多个领域。与竞争方法相比,DEFLECT在分类和分割任务中以5-10倍更少的参数实现了相当或更高的精度。代码已开源至https://github.com/VMarsocci/DEFLECT。
abstract_en: As large-scale heterogeneous data sets become increasingly available, adapting foundation models at low cost has become a key issue. Seminal works in natural language processing, e.g. Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), leverage the low "intrinsic rank" of parameter updates during adaptation. In this paper, we argue that incorporating stronger inductive biases on both the data and the models can enhance the adaptation of Geospatial Foundation Models (GFMs), pretrained on RGB satellite images, to other types of optical satellite data. Specifically, the pretrained parameters of GFMs serve as a strong prior for the spatial structure of multispectral images. For this reason, we introduce DEFLECT (Deflecting Embeddings for Finetuning Latent representations for Earth and Climate Tasks), a novel strategy for adapting GFMs to multispectral satellite imagery with very few additional parameters. DEFLECT improves the representation capabilities of the extracted features, particularly enhancing spectral information, which is essential for geoscience and environmental-related tasks. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method across three different GFMs and five diverse datasets, ranging from forest monitoring to marine environment segmentation. Compared to competing methods, DEFLECT achieves on-par or higher accuracy with 5-10x fewer parameters for classification and segmentation tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/VMarsocci/DEFLECT.
authors: Romain Thoreau, Valerio Marsocci, Dawa Derksen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9594-9604

title: 文本到图像扩散模型中肖像生成的参数化阴影控制
title_en: Parametric Shadow Control for Portrait Generation in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
abstract: 文本到图像扩散模型在生成多样化肖像方面表现出色,但缺乏直观的阴影控制能力。现有编辑方法作为后处理步骤,在跨多样风格的有效操控上存在困难。此外,这些方法要么依赖昂贵的现实世界光舞台数据收集,要么需要大量计算资源进行训练。为解决这些局限性,我们引入了Shadow Director,一种从训练良好的扩散模型中提取和操控隐藏阴影属性的方法。我们的方法使用一个小规模估计网络,仅需几千张合成图像和数小时训练——无需昂贵的现实世界光舞台数据。Shadow Director在肖像生成过程中实现了对阴影形状、位置和强度的参数化和直观控制,同时在多种风格中保持艺术完整性和身份认同。尽管仅在基于现实身份的合成数据上进行训练,它仍能有效泛化到具有多样风格的生成肖像,使其成为一种更易获取且资源友好的解决方案。
abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models excel at generating diverse portraits, but lack intuitive shadow control. Existing editing approaches, as post-processing, struggle to offer effective manipulation across diverse styles. Additionally, these methods either rely on expensive real-world light-stage data collection or require extensive computational resources for training. To address these limitations, we introduce Shadow Director, a method that extracts and manipulates hidden shadow attributes within well-trained diffusion models. Our approach uses a small estimation network that requires only a few thousand synthetic images and hours of training--no costly real-world light-stage data needed. Shadow Director enables parametric and intuitive control over shadow shape, placement, and intensity during portrait generation while preserving artistic integrity and identity across diverse styles. Despite training only on synthetic data built on real-world identities, it generalizes effectively to generated portraits with diverse styles, making it a more accessible and resource-friendly solution.
authors: Haoming Cai, Tsung-Wei Huang, Shiv Gehlot, Brandon Y. Feng, Sachin Shah, Guan-Ming Su, Christopher Metzler ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18207-18217

title: PartField:用于部件分割及更广泛应用的三维特征场学习
title_en: PartField: Learning 3D Feature Fields for Part Segmentation and Beyond
abstract: 我们提出PartField,一种用于学习基于部件的三维特征的前馈方法,该方法无需依赖预定义模板或基于文本的名称,即可捕捉部件的一般概念及其层次结构,并可应用于跨多种模态的开放世界三维形状。PartField仅需在推理时进行一次三维前馈传递,显著提升了运行效率和鲁棒性,相比先前方法具有明显优势。我们的模型通过对比学习框架,从混合标注数据集和大规模无监督数据集上的图像分割中蒸馏出2D和3D部件提案进行训练。它生成一个连续特征场,可通过聚类得到层次化部件分解。实验表明,PartField的准确率比其他近期无类别依赖的部件分割方法高至20%,且通常快几个数量级。超越单个形状的部件分解,所学特征场在不同形状间表现出一致性,使共分割和对应等任务成为可能,我们在多个应用中展示了这些通用、层次化且一致的三维特征场的潜力。访问我们的网页!https://research.nvidia.com/labs/toronto-ai/partfield-release/
abstract_en: We propose PartField, a feedforward approach for learning part-based 3D features, which captures the general concept of parts and their hierarchy without relying on predefined templates or text-based names, and can be applied to open-world 3D shapes across various modalities. PartField requires only a 3D feedforward pass at inference time, significantly improving runtime and robustness compared to prior approaches. Our model is trained by distilling 2D and 3D part proposals from a mix of labeled datasets and image segmentations on large unsupervised datasets, via a contrastive learning formulation. It produces a continuous feature field which can be clustered to yield a hierarchical part decomposition. Comparisons show that PartField is up to 20% more accurate and often orders of magnitude faster than other recent class-agnostic part-segmentation methods. Beyond single-shape part decomposition, consistency in the learned field emerges across shapes, enabling tasks such as co-segmentation and correspondence, which we demonstrate in several applications of these general-purpose, hierarchical, and consistent 3D feature fields. Check our Webpage! https://research.nvidia.com/labs/toronto-ai/partfield-release/
authors: Minghua Liu, Mikaela Angelina Uy, Donglai Xiang, Hao Su, Sanja Fidler, Nicholas Sharp, Jun Gao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9704-9715

title: Partial Forward Blocking: 一种新型无损训练加速数据剪枝范式
title_en: Partial Forward Blocking: A Novel Data Pruning Paradigm for Lossless Training Acceleration
abstract: 训练数据集规模的持续增长增强了机器学习模型的泛化能力,但也带来了巨大的计算成本。现有数据剪枝方法通过移除不重要的样本以加速训练,但往往依赖梯度或代理模型,导致梯度反向传播和代理模型训练的额外成本过高。本文提出Partial Forward Blocking(PFB),一种新型无损训练加速框架。PFB的效率源于其独特的自适应剪枝流程:通过目标模型浅层特征提取评估样本重要性,随后剪除不重要样本,仅保留样本进行后续前向传播和损失反向传播。该机制显著降低了剪枝样本深层前向传播和反向传播的计算开销,同时消除了辅助反向计算和代理模型训练的需求。此外,PFB引入概率密度作为样本重要性指标。结合自适应分布估计模块,我们的方法动态优先处理相对稀有的样本,与不断演化的训练状态保持一致。大量实验验证了PFB在性能和速度上的显著优势。在ImageNet数据集上,PFB在剪枝40%数据的情况下实现0.5%准确率提升和33%训练时间减少。
abstract_en: The ever-growing size of training datasets enhances the generalization capability of machine learning models but also incurs exorbitant computational costs. Existing data pruning approaches aim to accelerate training by removing those less important samples. However, they often rely on gradients or proxy models, leading to prohibitive additional costs of gradient back-propagation and proxy model training. In this paper, we propose Partial Forward Blocking (PFB), a novel framework for lossless training acceleration. The efficiency of PFB stems from its unique adaptive pruning pipeline: sample importance is assessed based on features extracted from the shallow layers of the target model. Less important samples are then pruned, allowing only the retained ones to proceed with the subsequent forward pass and loss back-propagation. This mechanism significantly reduces the computational overhead of deep-layer forward passes and back-propagation for pruned samples, while also eliminating the need for auxiliary backward computations and proxy model training. Moreover, PFB introduces probability density as an indicator of sample importance. Combined with an adaptive distribution estimation module, our method dynamically prioritizes relatively rare samples, aligning with the constantly evolving training state. Extensive experiments demonstrate the significant superiority of PFB in performance and speed. On ImageNet, PFB achieves a 0.5% accuracy improvement and 33% training time reduction with 40% data pruned.
authors: Dongyue Wu, Zilin Guo, Jialong Zuo, Nong Sang, Changxin Gao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 319-328

title: 部分匹配子图助力:文本到点云定位中的不确定性建模与传播
title_en: Partially Matching Submap Helps: Uncertainty Modeling and Propagation for Text to Point Cloud Localization
abstract: 文本到点云跨模态定位是未来人机协作的关键视觉-语言任务。现有由粗到细框架假设每个查询文本精确对应子图中心区域,限制了其在现实场景中的适用性。本工作在更现实的假设下重新定义任务,通过允许部分匹配的查询文本与子图对,放松一对一检索约束。为解决该挑战,我们通过增强部分匹配子图数据集并引入不确定性感知框架。具体而言,我们通过集成表示为二维高斯分布的不确定性分数,在细粒度位置回归中建模跨模态歧义,以缓解困难样本的影响。此外,我们提出一种不确定性感知相似度度量,通过将不确定性传播至粗粒度场景识别中,提升查询文本与子图间的相似度评估,使模型能够学习判别性特征,有效处理部分匹配样本并提升任务协同性。在KITTI360Pose和CityRefer上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在两个阶段均达到最先进性能。代码已开源至https://github.com/Afoolbird/PMSH
abstract_en: Text to point cloud cross-modal localization is a crucial vision-language task for future human-robot collaboration. Existing coarse-to-fine frameworks assume that each query text precisely corresponds to the center area of a submap, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios. This work redefines the task under a more realistic assumption, relaxing the one-to-one retrieval constraint by allowing partially matching query text and submap pairs. To address this challenge, we augment datasets with partially matching submaps and introduce an uncertainty-aware framework. Specifically, we model cross-modal ambiguity in fine-grained location regression by integrating uncertainty scores, represented as 2D Gaussian distributions, to mitigate the impact of challenging samples. Additionally, we propose an uncertainty-aware similarity metric that enhances similarity assessment between query text and submaps by propagating uncertainty into coarse place recognition, enabling the model to learn discriminative features, effectively handle partially matching samples and improve task synergy. Extensive experiments on KITTI360Pose and CityRefer demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across both stages. Our code is available at https://github.com/Afoolbird/PMSH
authors: Mingtao Feng, Longlong Mei, Zijie Wu, Jianqiao Luo, Fenghao Tian, Jie Feng, Weisheng Dong, Yaonan Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8296-8305

title: 通过驾驶知识测试
title_en: Passing the Driving Knowledge Test
abstract: 如果大语言模型(LLM)今天参加驾驶知识测试,是否能够通过?除了当前自动驾驶基准测试中的标准空间和视觉问答(QA)任务,驾驶知识测试要求对所有交通规则、标志和优先权原则有全面理解。要通过这项测试,人类驾驶员必须识别各种在现实数据集中罕见的边缘案例。在本工作中,我们提出了DriveQA,一个涵盖交通法规和场景的广泛开源文本和视觉基准测试。通过使用DriveQA进行的实验,我们展示了(1)最先进的LLMs和多模态LLMs(MLLMs)在基本交通规则上表现良好,但在数值推理、复杂优先权场景、交通标志变化和空间布局方面存在显著弱点;(2)在DriveQA上微调可提升多个类别的准确性,特别是在法规标志识别和交叉口决策方面;(3)DriveQA-V的受控变化为模型对光照、视角、距离和天气等环境因素的敏感性提供了见解;(4)在DriveQA上预训练可提升下游驾驶任务性能,在nuScenes和BDD等现实数据集上取得改进结果,同时表明模型能够内化文本和合成交通知识,有效泛化到下游QA任务。
abstract_en: If a Large Language Model (LLM) were to take a driving knowledge test today, would it pass? Beyond standard spatial and visual question-answering (QA) tasks on current autonomous driving benchmarks, driving knowledge tests require a complete understanding of all traffic rules, signage, and right-of-way principles. To pass this test, human drivers must discern various edge cases that rarely appear in real-world datasets. In this work, we present DriveQA, an extensive open-source text and vision-based benchmark that exhaustively covers traffic regulations and scenarios. Through our experiments using DriveQA, we show that (1) state-of-the-art LLMs and Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) perform well on basic traffic rules but exhibit significant weaknesses in numerical reasoning and complex right-of-way scenarios, traffic sign variations, and spatial layouts, (2) fine-tuning on DriveQA improves accuracy across multiple categories, particularly in regulatory sign recognition and intersection decision-making, (3) controlled variations in DriveQA-V provide insights into model sensitivity to environmental factors such as lighting, perspective, distance, and weather conditions, and (4) pretraining on DriveQA enhances downstream driving task performance, leading to improved results on real-world datasets such as nuScenes and BDD, while also demonstrating that models can internalize text and synthetic traffic knowledge to generalize effectively across downstream QA tasks.
authors: Maolin Wei, Wanzhou Liu, Eshed Ohn-Bar ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8395-8406

title: PatchScaler:一种高效的无块依赖图像超分辨率扩散模型
title_en: PatchScaler: An Efficient Patch-Independent Diffusion Model for Image Super-Resolution
abstract: 尽管扩散模型显著提升了超分辨率图像的感知质量,但通常需要大量采样步骤,导致计算成本高且推理时间长。近期研究通过减少采样步骤探索了合理的加速方案。然而,这些方法将图像所有区域同等对待,忽视了不同重建难度区域需要不同采样步骤的事实。为解决这一局限,我们提出PatchScaler,一种高效的无块依赖扩散流程用于单图像超分辨率。具体而言,PatchScaler引入基于块自适应分组采样(PGS)策略,通过量化重建难度对特征块进行分组,并为每个组建立不同采样配置的快捷路径。为进一步优化PGS的块级重建过程,我们提出纹理提示,为扩散模型提供丰富的纹理条件信息。该纹理提示自适应地从公共参考纹理记忆库中检索目标块的纹理先验。大量实验表明,我们的PatchScaler在定量和定性评估中均表现出色,同时显著加速推理。项目页面:https://github.com/yongliuy/PatchScaler.
abstract_en: While diffusion models significantly improve the perceptual quality of super-resolved images, they usually require a large number of sampling steps, resulting in high computational costs and long inference times. Recent efforts have explored reasonable acceleration schemes by reducing the number of sampling steps. However, these approaches treat all regions of the image equally, overlooking the fact that regions with varying levels of reconstruction difficulty require different sampling steps. To address this limitation, we propose PatchScaler, an efficient patch-independent diffusion pipeline for single image super-resolution. Specifically, PatchScaler introduces a Patch-adaptive Group Sampling (PGS) strategy that groups feature patches by quantifying their reconstruction difficulty and establishes shortcut paths with different sampling configurations for each group. To further optimize the patch-level reconstruction process of PGS, we propose a texture prompt that provides rich texture conditional information to the diffusion model. The texture prompt adaptively retrieves texture priors for the target patch from a common reference texture memory. Extensive experiments show that our PatchScaler achieves favorable performance in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations, while significantly speeding up inference. Project page: https://github.com/yongliuy/PatchScaler.
authors: Yong Liu, Hang Dong, Jinshan Pan, Qingji Dong, Kai Chen, Rongxiang Zhang, Lean Fu, Fei Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11283-11293

title: PathDiff:基于无配对文本和掩码条件的组织病理图像合成
title_en: PathDiff: Histopathology Image Synthesis with Unpaired Text and Mask Conditions
abstract: 基于扩散的生成模型在合成组织病理图像方面展现出潜力,以应对因隐私限制导致的数据稀缺问题。诊断文本报告提供高层次的语义描述,而掩码则提供表示不同形态学区域所必需的细粒度空间结构。然而,公共数据集缺乏相同组织病理图像的配对文本和掩码数据,限制了它们在图像生成中的联合应用。这一限制阻碍了充分利用结合两种模态以增强对语义和空间细节的控制的益处。为了解决这一问题,我们提出PathDiff,这是一种扩散框架,通过将两种模态整合到统一的条件空间中,有效学习无配对的掩码-文本数据。PathDiff允许对结构和上下文特征进行精确控制,生成高质量且语义准确的图像。PathDiff还提高了图像保真度、文本-图像对齐和忠实度,增强了用于细胞核分割和分类等下游任务的数据增强效果。大量实验验证了其在现有方法中的优越性。我们的代码在https://github.com/bhosalems/PathDiff上公开可用。
abstract_en: Diffusion-based generative models have shown promise in synthesizing histopathology images to address data scarcity caused by privacy constraints. Diagnostic text reports provide high-level semantic descriptions, and masks offer fine-grained spatial structures essential for representing distinct morphological regions. However, public datasets lack paired text and mask data for the same histopathological images, limiting their joint use in image generation. This constraint restricts the ability to fully exploit the benefits of combining both modalities for enhanced control over semantics and spatial details. To overcome this, we propose PathDiff, a diffusion framework that effectively learns from unpaired mask-text data by integrating both modalities into a unified conditioning space. PathDiff allows precise control over structural and contextual features, generating high-quality, semantically accurate images. PathDiff also improves image fidelity, text-image alignment, and faithfulness, enhancing data augmentation for downstream tasks like nuclei segmentation and classification. Extensive experiments demonstrate its superiority over existing methods. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/bhosalems/PathDiff.
authors: Mahesh Bhosale, Abdul Wasi, Yuanhao Zhai, Yunjie Tian, Samuel Border, Nan Xi, Pinaki Sarder, Junsong Yuan, David Doermann, Xuan Gong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22415-22424

title: PathFinder:一种用于组织病理学的多模态多智能体医学诊断决策系统
title_en: PathFinder: A Multi-Modal Multi-Agent System for Medical Diagnostic Decision-Making Applied to Histopathology
abstract: 通过组织病理学全切片图像(WSIs)诊断疾病是现代病理学的基础,但WSIs的吉像素级和复杂性带来了挑战。训练有素的病理学家通过导航WSI、寻找相关区域、做笔记并综合分析来克服这一挑战,最终形成整体诊断。传统的AI方法,如多实例学习和基于Transformer的模型,未能实现这种整体、迭代、多尺度的诊断流程,限制了其在实际中的应用。我们提出PathFinder,一种多模态多智能体框架,模拟专家病理学家的决策过程。PathFinder整合了四个AI代理:分诊代理、导航代理、描述代理和诊断代理,协同导航WSI、收集证据并提供包含自然语言解释的全面诊断。分诊代理将WSI分类为良性或风险性;若为风险性,导航代理和描述代理将迭代聚焦于关键区域,生成重要性图谱和采样区域的描述性见解。最终,诊断代理综合分析结果以确定患者的诊断分类。实验表明,PathFinder在皮肤黑色素瘤诊断中优于现有最佳方法8%,并通过自然语言描述诊断相关区域实现内在可解释性。病理学家的定性分析显示,描述代理的输出质量高,与GPT-4o相当。PathFinder也是首个在该挑战性黑色素瘤分类任务中超越病理学家平均表现9%的AI系统,为病理学领域树立了高效、准确且可解释的AI辅助诊断新标杆。我们的数据、代码和模型将公开。
abstract_en: Diagnosing diseases through histopathology whole slide images (WSIs) is fundamental in modern pathology but is challenged by the gigapixel scale and complexity of WSIs. Trained histopathologists overcome this challenge by navigating the WSI, looking for relevant patches, taking notes, and compiling them to produce a final holistic diagnostic. Traditional AI approaches, such as multiple instance learning and transformer-based models, fail short of such a holistic, iterative, multi-scale diagnostic procedure, limiting their adoption in the real-world. We introduce PathFinder, a multi-modal, multi-agent framework that emulates the decision-making process of expert pathologists. PathFinder integrates four AI agents, the Triage Agent, Navigation Agent, Description Agent, and Diagnosis Agent, that collaboratively navigate WSIs, gather evidence, and provide comprehensive diagnoses with natural language explanations. The Triage Agent classifies the WSI as benign or risky; if risky, the Navigation and Description Agents iteratively focus on significant regions, generating importance maps and descriptive insights of sampled patches. Finally, the Diagnosis Agent synthesizes the findings to determine the patient's diagnostic classification. Our Experiments show that PathFinder outperforms state-of-the-art methods in skin melanoma diagnosis by 8% while offering inherent explainability through natural language descriptions of diagnostically relevant patches. Qualitative analysis by pathologists shows that the Description Agent's outputs are of high quality and comparable to GPT-4o. PathFinder is also the first AI-based system to surpass the average performance of pathologists in this challenging melanoma classification task by 9%, setting a new record for efficient, accurate, and interpretable AI-assisted diagnostics in pathology. Our Data, code and models will be made available.
authors: Fatemeh Ghezloo, Mehmet Saygin Seyfioglu, Rustin Soraki, Wisdom O. Ikezogwo, Beibin Li, Tejoram Vivekanandan, Joann G. Elmore, Ranjay Krishna, Linda Shapiro ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23431-23441

title: 对扩散模型中物体完整性进行边界激活惩罚
title_en: Penalizing Boundary Activation for Object Completeness in Diffusion Models
abstract: 扩散模型已成为文本到图像(T2I)生成的强大技术,能够创建高质量、多样化的图像,涵盖多个领域。然而,这些模型的一个常见局限是物体显示不完整,碎片或缺失部分会损害模型在需要视觉准确性的下游应用(如基于2D先验模型的数据集合成和视频生成)中的性能。在本研究中,我们深入分析了这一问题,并揭示了物体生成不完整的主要原因是随机裁剪(RandomCrop)。尽管这一数据增强方法广泛用于扩散模型中,能够增强模型的泛化能力,但在训练过程中会破坏物体的连续性。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种无需训练的解决方案,通过在早期去噪步骤中惩罚图像边界处的激活值。我们的方法可轻松应用于预训练的Stable Diffusion模型,仅需极少修改且计算开销可忽略不计。大量实验验证了该方法的有效性,展示了物体完整性与图像质量的显著提升。
abstract_en: Diffusion models have emerged as a powerful technique for text-to-image (T2I) generation, creating high-quality, diverse images across various domains. However, a common limitation in these models is the incomplete display of objects, where fragments or missing parts can undermine the model's performance in downstream applications such as dataset synthesis and video generation using 2D prior-based models. % that demand visual accuracy, such as e-commerce product imaging and realistic digital content creation.In this study, we conduct the in-depth analysis of this issue and reveal that the primary culprit behind incomplete object generation is RandomCrop. This data augmentation method, widely used in diffusion models, though enhances model generalization ability, disrupts object continuity during training. To address this, we propose a training-free solution that penalizes activation values occurring at image boundaries during the early denoising steps. Our method is easily applicable to pre-trained Stable Diffusion models with minimal modifications and negligible computational overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, showing substantial improvements in object integrity and image quality.
authors: Haoyang Xu, Tianhao Zhao, Sibei Yang, Yutian Lin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14962-14972

title: PerLDiff: 基于透视-布局扩散模型的可控街景合成
title_en: PerLDiff: Controllable Street View Synthesis Using Perspective-Layout Diffusion Model
abstract: 可控生成被视为解决三维数据标注挑战的潜在关键方法,其精度在自动驾驶数据生产场景中尤为重要。现有方法主要通过GLIGEN或ControlNet等框架整合多样化的生成信息至控制输入,实现了可控生成的优异效果。然而,此类方法本质上受限于预定义网络架构的学习能力。本文探索了控制信息与生成过程的创新融合,提出PerLDiff(透视-布局扩散模型),一种有效生成街景图像的新方法,充分融合了透视三维几何信息。我们的PerLDiff通过三维几何先验引导网络学习过程中的对象级控制,实现更稳健且可控的输出。此外,与替代布局控制方法相比,其可控性表现更优。实验结果验证了PerLDiff在NuScenes和KITTI数据集上显著提升了可控生成的精度。
abstract_en: Controllable generation is considered a potentially vital approach to address the challenge of annotating 3D data, and the precision of such controllable generation becomes particularly imperative in the context of data production for autonomous driving. Existing methods focus on the integration of diverse generative information into controlling inputs, utilizing frameworks such as GLIGEN or ControlNet, to produce commendable outcomes in controllable generation. However, such approaches intrinsically restrict generation performance to the learning capacities of predefined network architectures. In this paper, we explore the innovative integration of controlling information and introduce PerLDiff (Perspective-Layout Diffusion Models), a novel method for effective street view image generation that fully leverages perspective 3D geometric information. Our PerLDiff employs 3D geometric priors to guide the generation of street view images with precise object-level control within the network learning process, resulting in a more robust and controllable output. Moreover, it demonstrates superior controllability compared to alternative layout control methods. Empirical results justify that our PerLDiff markedly enhances the precision of controllable generation on the NuScenes and KITTI datasets.
authors: Jinhua Zhang, Hualian Sheng, Sijia Cai, Bing Deng, Qiao Liang, Wen Li, Ying Fu, Jieping Ye, Shuhang Gu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26306-26315

title: 感知、理解与重建:基于自回归多模态生成模型的现实世界图像超分辨率
title_en: Perceive, Understand and Restore: Real-World Image Super-Resolution with Autoregressive Multimodal Generative Models
abstract: 通过利用预训练文本到图像扩散模型的生成先验,现实世界图像超分辨率(Real-ISR)取得了显著进展。然而,这些方法在复杂和/或严重退化场景中往往生成不准确且不自然的重建结果,主要由于其对输入低质量图像的感知和理解能力有限。为解决这些局限性,我们首次将预训练的自回归多模态模型(如Lumina-mGPT)适配为鲁棒的Real-ISR模型,即PURE,该模型通过感知和理解输入低质量图像,最终重建其高质量版本。具体而言,我们对Lumina-mGPT实施指令调优,以感知退化程度和token间依赖关系,通过语义描述生成理解内容,并最终利用收集的信息自回归生成高质量图像token进行重建。此外,我们揭示了图像token熵反映了图像结构,并提出基于熵的Top-k采样策略以优化推理过程中图像的局部结构。实验结果表明,PURE在保留图像内容的同时生成逼真细节,尤其在包含多个物体的复杂场景中表现出色,展示了自回归多模态生成模型在鲁棒Real-ISR中的潜力。模型和代码可在https://github.com/nonwhy/PURE获取。
abstract_en: By leveraging the generative priors from pre-trained text-to-image diffusion models, significant progress has been made in real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR). However, these methods tend to generate inaccurate and unnatural reconstructions in complex and/or heavily degraded scenes, primarily due to their limited perception and understanding capability of the input low-quality image. To address these limitations, we propose, for the first time to our knowledge, to adapt the pre-trained autoregressive multimodal model such as Lumina-mGPT into a robust Real-ISR model, namely PURE, which Perceives and Understands the input low-quality image, then REstores its high-quality counterpart. Specifically, we implement instruction tuning on Lumina-mGPT to perceive degradation levels and inter-token dependencies, understand content via semantic description generation, and ultimately restore the image by generating high-quality image tokens autoregressively with the collected information. In addition, we reveal that the image token entropy reflects the image structure and present a entropy-based Top-k sampling strategy to optimize the local structure of the image during inference. Experimental results demonstrate that PURE preserves image content while generating realistic details, especially in complex scenes with multiple objects, showcasing the potential of autoregressive multimodal generative models for robust Real-ISR. The model and code are available at https://github.com/nonwhy/PURE.
authors: Hongyang Wei, Shuaizheng Liu, Chun Yuan, Lei Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18640-18650

title: 第一视角下的感知与行动:面向以自我为中心的人-物-人交互的数据集与基准
title_en: Perceiving and Acting in First-Person: A Dataset and Benchmark for Egocentric Human-Object-Human Interactions
abstract: 从真实世界的人本交互数据集中学习动作模型,对于构建高效通用智能助手至关重要。然而,现有数据集大多仅提供专业交互类别,忽视了AI助手基于第一视角采集进行感知与行动的特性。我们强调通用交互知识与第一视角模态的双重重要性。本文将人工辅助任务嵌入视觉-语言-动作框架中,其中助手根据第一视角视觉信息和指令为指导者提供服务。通过我们的混合RGB-运动捕捉系统,助手与指导者按照由GPT生成的脚本与多个物体及场景进行交互。在此设置下,我们构建了InterVLA数据集,这是首个包含11.4小时、120万帧多模态数据的面向人-物-人交互的大规模数据集,涵盖2个第一视角和5个外部视角视频,精确的人/物体运动及语音指令。此外,我们建立了针对第一视角人体运动估计、交互合成与交互预测的新基准,并进行了全面分析。我们相信,InterVLA测试平台与基准将促进未来在物理世界中构建AI代理的研究工作。
abstract_en: Learning action models from real-world human-centric interaction datasets is important towards building general-purpose intelligent assistants with efficiency. However, most existing datasets only offer specialist interaction category and ignore that AI assistants perceive and act based on first-person acquisition. We urge that both the generalist interaction knowledge and egocentric modality are indispensable. In this paper, we embed the manual-assisted task into a vision-language-action framework, where the assistant provides services to the instructor following egocentric vision and commands. With our hybrid RGB-MoCap system, pairs of assistants and instructors engage with multiple objects and the scene following GPT-generated scripts. Under this setting, we accomplish InterVLA, the first large-scale human-object-human interaction dataset with 11.4 hours and 1.2M frames of multimodal data, spanning 2 egocentric and 5 exocentric videos, accurate human/object motions and verbal commands. Furthermore, we establish novel benchmarks on egocentric human motion estimation, interaction synthesis, and interaction prediction with comprehensive analysis. We believe that our InterVLA testbed and the benchmarks will foster future works on building AI agents in the physical world.
authors: Liang Xu, Chengqun Yang, Zili Lin, Fei Xu, Yifan Liu, Congsheng Xu, Yiyi Zhang, Jie Qin, Xingdong Sheng, Yunhui Liu, Xin Jin, Yichao Yan, Wenjun Zeng, Xiaokang Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12535-12548

title: 感知即控制:基于三维感知运动表示的细粒度可控图像动画
title_en: Perception-as-Control: Fine-grained Controllable Image Animation with 3D-aware Motion Representation
abstract: 运动可控的图像动画是一项具有广泛应用前景的基础性任务。尽管近期的研究在通过多种运动表示方法控制相机或物体运动方面取得了一定进展,但它们在支持具有自适应控制粒度的协同相机与物体运动控制方面仍面临挑战。为此,我们引入了三维感知运动表示,并提出了一种名为Perception-as-Control的图像动画框架,以实现细粒度的协同运动控制。具体而言,我们从参考图像中构建三维感知运动表示,根据解析后的用户指令对其进行操控,并从不同视角进行感知。通过这种方式,相机和物体的运动被转化为直观且一致的视觉变化。随后,我们的框架将感知结果作为运动控制信号,使其能够以统一且灵活的方式支持各种与运动相关的视频合成任务。实验结果验证了所提出方法的优越性。
abstract_en: Motion-controllable image animation is a fundamental task with a wide range of potential applications. Recent works have made progress in controlling camera or object motion via various motion representations, while they still struggle to support collaborative camera and object motion control with adaptive control granularity. To this end, we introduce 3D-aware motion representation and propose an image animation framework, called Perception-as-Control, to achieve fine-grained collaborative motion control. Specifically, we construct 3D-aware motion representation from a reference image, manipulate it based on interpreted user instructions, and perceive it from different viewpoints. In this way, camera and object motions are transformed into intuitive and consistent visual changes. Then, our framework leverages the perception results as motion control signals, enabling it to support various motion-related video synthesis tasks in a unified and flexible way. Experiments demonstrate the superiority of the proposed approach.
authors: Yingjie Chen, Yifang Men, Yuan Yao, Miaomiao Cui, Liefeng Bo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14380-14389

title: 通过建模其形成过程进行散焦去模糊
title_en: Performing Defocus Deblurring by Modeling its Formation Process
abstract: 单图像散焦去模糊(SIDD)是一项具有挑战性的任务,旨在从散焦图像中恢复全焦图像。本文观察到,基于基本成像原理,散焦图像可被视为由照明 blobs 混合而成,而散焦模糊是由于大照明 blobs 相互交织造成的。因此,从新视角出发,我们通过调整组成散焦图像的照明 blobs 的形状和不透明度来执行 SIDD。为此,我们采用了一种新颖的 2D 高斯 blobs 表示方法和可微光栅化方法,以获取组成散焦图像的 2D 高斯 blobs 参数。此外,我们提出了一种 blobs 去模糊器,用于调整对应散焦图像的 2D 高斯 blobs 参数,从而获得锐利图像。我们还通过基于深度的正则化损失函数结合先验深度信息,对高斯 blobs 的尺寸进行正则化,进一步提升方法性能。在五个广泛使用的数据集上的大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Single image defocus deblurring (SIDD) is a challenging task that aims to recover an all-in-focus image from a defocused one. In this paper, we make the observation that a defocused image can be viewed as a blend of illuminated blobs based on fundamental imaging principles, and the defocus blur in the defocused image is caused by large illuminated blobs intermingling with each other. Thus, from a novel perspective, we perform SIDD by adjusting the shape and opacity of the illuminated blobs that compose the defocused image. With this aim, we adopt a novel 2D Gaussian blob representation for illuminated blobs and a differentiable rasterization method to obtain the parameters of the 2D Gaussian blobs that compose the defocused image. Additionally, we propose a blob deblurrer to adjust the parameters of the 2D Gaussian blobs corresponding to the defocused image, thereby obtaining a sharp image. We also explore incorporating prior depth information via our depth-based regularization loss to regularize the size of Gaussian blobs, further improving the performance of our method. Extensive experiments on five widely-used datasets validate the effectiveness of our proposed method.
authors: Zhengbo Zhang, Lin Geng Foo, Hossein Rahmani, Jun Liu, De Wen Soh ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5791-5801

title: PersPose:基于视角编码与视角旋转的三维人体姿态估计
title_en: PersPose: 3D Human Pose Estimation with Perspective Encoding and Perspective Rotation
abstract: 单目三维人体姿态估计(HPE)方法从单张图像中估计关节的三维位置。现有三维HPE方法通常将裁剪后的图像单独作为模型输入。然而,缺乏对应相机内参的裁剪图像无法准确估计关节的相对深度,而相机内参决定了三维物体与裁剪图像之间的透视关系。在本工作中,我们引入视角编码(PE)来编码裁剪图像的相机内参。此外,由于人体主体可能出现在原始图像的任意位置,三维场景与裁剪图像之间的透视关系存在显著差异,这增加了模型拟合的难度。同时,人体主体越偏离图像中心,裁剪图像中的透视失真越严重。为解决这些问题,我们提出视角旋转(PR),通过对原始图像进行变换以居中人体主体,从而减少透视失真并缓解模型拟合难度。通过结合PE和PR,我们提出了一种新颖的三维HPE框架PersPose。实验结果表明,PersPose在3DPW、MPI-INF-3DHP和Human3.6M数据集上达到了最先进的(SOTA)性能。例如,在野外数据集3DPW上,PersPose实现了60.1 mm的MPJPE,比之前的SOTA方法降低了7.54%。代码已开源:https://github.com/KenAdamsJoseph/PersPose
abstract_en: Monocular 3D human pose estimation (HPE) methods estimate the 3D positions of joints from individual images. Existing 3D HPE approaches often use the cropped image alone as input for their models. However, the relative depths of joints cannot be accurately estimated from cropped images without the corresponding camera intrinsics, which determine the perspective relationship between 3D objects and the cropped images. In this work, we introduce Perspective Encoding (PE) to encode the camera intrinsics of the cropped images. Moreover, since the human subject can appear anywhere within the original image, the perspective relationship between the 3D scene and the cropped image differs significantly, which complicates model fitting. Additionally, the further the human subject deviates from the image center, the greater the perspective distortions in the cropped image. To address these issues, we propose Perspective Rotation (PR), a transformation applied to the original image that centers the human subject, thereby reducing perspective distortions and alleviating the difficulty of model fitting. By incorporating PE and PR, we propose a novel 3D HPE framework, PersPose. Experimental results demonstrate that PersPose achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on the 3DPW, MPI-INF-3DHP, and Human3.6M datasets. For example, on the in-the-wild dataset 3DPW, PersPose achieves an MPJPE of 60.1 mm, 7.54% lower than the previous SOTA approach. Code is available at: https://github.com/KenAdamsJoseph/PersPose.
authors: Xiaoyang Hao, Han Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8110-8119

title: PersonaCraft: 基于遮挡感知的3D条件扩散的个性化且可控的全身多人体场景生成
title_en: PersonaCraft: Personalized and Controllable Full-Body Multi-Human Scene Generation Using Occlusion-Aware 3D-Conditioned Diffusion
abstract: 我们提出PersonaCraft,一种用于复杂场景中多个体全身个性化图像合成的可控且遮挡鲁棒的框架。现有方法在遮挡密集场景和完整身体个性化方面存在困难,因为2D姿态条件缺乏3D几何信息,常导致模糊遮挡和解剖学扭曲,且多数方法仅关注面部身份。相比之下,我们的PersonaCraft将扩散模型与3D人体建模相结合,采用SMPLx-ControlNet,利用深度图和法线图等3D几何信息实现鲁棒的3D感知姿态条件化和增强的解剖学一致性。为处理细粒度遮挡,我们提出遮挡边界增强网络,通过遮挡聚焦训练利用深度边缘信号,并提出遮挡感知的分类器自由引导策略,选择性地强化遮挡区域的条件化而不影响未遮挡区域。PersonaCraft可无缝结合面部身份控制网络,实现全身多人体个性化,从而超越了仅关注面部身份的先前方法。我们的基于SMPLx的双通道身体形状表示与文本细化方法,实现了精确的全身个性化和灵活的用户自定义身体形状调整。大量定量实验和用户研究证明,PersonaCraft在生成高质量的多人物图像方面显著优于现有方法,具有准确的个性化和鲁棒的遮挡处理能力。
abstract_en: We present PersonaCraft, a framework for controllable and occlusion-robust full-body personalized image synthesis of multiple individuals in complex scenes. Current methods struggle with occlusion-heavy scenarios and complete body personalization, as 2D pose conditioning lacks 3D geometry, often leading to ambiguous occlusions and anatomical distortions, and many approaches focus solely on facial identity. In contrast, our PersonaCraft integrates diffusion models with 3D human modeling, employing SMPLx-ControlNet, to utilize 3D geometry like depth and normal maps for robust 3D-aware pose conditioning and enhanced anatomical coherence. To handle fine-grained occlusions, we propose Occlusion Boundary Enhancer Network that exploits depth edge signals with occlusion-focused training, and Occlusion-Aware Classifier-Free Guidance strategy that selectively reinforces conditioning in occluded regions without affecting unoccluded areas. PersonaCraft can seamlessly be combined with Face Identity ControlNet, achieving full-body multi-human personalization and thus marking a significant advancement beyond prior approaches that concentrate only on facial identity. Our dual-pathway body shape representation with SMPLx-based shape parameters and textual refinement, enables precise full-body personalization and flexible user-defined body shape adjustments. Extensive quantitative experiments and user studies demonstrate that PersonaCraft significantly outperforms existing methods in generating high-quality, multi-person images with accurate personalization and robust occlusion handling.
authors: Gwanghyun Kim, Suh Yoon Jeon, Seunggyu Lee, Se Young Chun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12034-12044

title: PersonalVideo:无需动态和语义退化的高身份保真度视频定制
title_en: PersonalVideo: High ID-Fidelity Video Customization without Dynamic and Semantic Degradation
abstract: 当前文本到视频(T2V)生成技术在合成逼真通用视频方面取得了显著进展,但在基于定制ID图像的特定身份人类视频生成领域仍存在较大探索空间。关键挑战在于在身份注入后保持高身份保真度,同时保留原始运动动态和语义延续性。现有视频身份定制方法主要依赖于在文本到图像模型上重建给定身份图像,但这类模型与T2V模型存在分布差异。该过程引入了调优-推理间隙,导致动态和语义退化。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新型框架PersonalVideo,通过在合成视频上应用奖励监督混合策略,而非简单的图像重建目标。具体而言,我们首先引入身份一致性奖励,有效注入参考身份且避免调优-推理间隙。随后提出新颖的语义一致性奖励,使生成视频的语义分布与原始T2V模型对齐,从而在身份注入过程中保持其动态和语义延续能力。通过非重建奖励训练,我们进一步采用模拟提示增强技术,通过在更多语义场景中监督生成结果降低过拟合,即使仅使用单张参考图像也能获得良好的鲁棒性。大量实验验证了我们的方法在保持原始T2V模型固有视频生成特性的同时,实现高身份保真度的优势,超越了现有方法。
abstract_en: The current text-to-video (T2V) generation has made significant progress in synthesizing realistic general videos, but it is still under-explored in identity-specific human video generation with customized ID images. The key challenge lies in maintaining high ID fidelity consistently while preserving the original motion dynamic and semantic following after the identity injection. Current video identity customization methods mainly rely on reconstructing given identity images on text-to-image models, which have a divergent distribution with the T2V model. This process introduces a tuning-inference gap, leading to dynamic and semantic degradation. To tackle this problem, we propose a novel framework, dubbed PersonalVideo, that applies a mixture of reward supervision on synthesized videos instead of the simple reconstruction objective on images. Specifically, we first incorporate identity consistency reward to effectively inject the reference's identity without the tuning-inference gap. Then we propose a novel semantic consistency reward to align the semantic distribution of the generated videos with the original T2V model, which preserves its dynamic and semantic following capability during the identity injection. With the non-reconstructive reward training, we further employ simulated prompt augmentation to reduce overfitting by supervising generated results in more semantic scenarios, gaining good robustness even with only a single reference image.Extensive experiments demonstrate our method's superiority in delivering high identity faithfulness while preserving the inherent video generation qualities of the original T2V model, outshining prior methods.
authors: Hengjia Li, Haonan Qiu, Shiwei Zhang, Xiang Wang, Yujie Wei, Zekun Li, Yingya Zhang, Boxi Wu, Deng Cai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19406-19416

title: 基于本地监督的个性化联邦学习
title_en: Personalized Federated Learning under Local Supervision
abstract: 联邦学习中的一个关键问题是在客户端间的数据异质性,这可能导致模型发散,最终损害模型性能。个性化联邦学习(pFL)已被证明是解决联邦学习中数据异质性的一种有效方法。然而,许多现有的pFL研究直接使用全局模型进行本地训练,而未充分评估其对本地模型性能的影响,导致个性化与泛化能力之间可能存在潜在冲突。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种本地监督器与交互学习模型的并行结构,引入了一种新的pFL方法,称为通过本地监督器辅助的客户端间数据相似性联邦学习(FedSimSup)。具体而言,FedSimSup为每个客户端维护一个交互学习模型,并利用本地监督器对交互学习模型进行优化。本地监督器监控聚合的全局信息,确保交互学习模型与本地异质数据对齐,以提升本地模型性能。此外,客户端间的相似性基于本地数据分布的差异进行测量,并利用该相似性调整交互学习模型的权重。实验结果表明,FedSimSup在处理异质数据方面优于八种最先进的联邦学习方法。此外,它支持客户端间不同的模型架构,在计算资源差异时提供了更大的灵活性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/jqLi1626/FedSimSup获取。
abstract_en: A crucial issue in federated learning is the heterogeneity of data across clients, which may lead to model divergence, eventually deteriorating the model performance. Personalized federated learning (pFL) has been shown to be an effective approach to addressing data heterogeneity in federated learning. However, many existing pFL studies rely on directly using the global model for local training without fully assessing its impact on the performance of the local model, resulting in a potential conflict between personalization and generalization. To address this issue, we propose a parallel structure of a local supervisor and an inter-learning model for the local model and introduce a novel pFL method called federated learning by considering data similarity across clients assisted by a local supervisor (FedSimSup). Specifically, FedSimSup maintains an inter-learning model for each client and refines the inter-learning model using a local supervisor for each client. The local supervisor monitors the aggregated global information and ensures that the inter-learning model aligns with the local heterogeneous data to enhance local model performance. Additionally, the similarity between clients is measured based on differences in local data distributions, and this similarity is used to adjust the weights of the inter-learning models.Experimental results show that FedSimSup outperforms eight state-of-the-art federated learning methods in handling heterogeneous data. Additionally, it supports different model architectures across clients, providing greater flexibility when computational resources vary among them. Our code can be found at https://github.com/jqLi1626/FedSimSup.
authors: Qiqi Liu, Jiaqiang Li, Yuchen Liu, Yaochu Jin, Lingjuan Lyu, Xiaohu Wu, Han Yu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4069-4079

title: 通过心理意象模拟的视觉-语言模型视角感知推理
title_en: Perspective-Aware Reasoning in Vision-Language Models via Mental Imagery Simulation
