title_en: Pretrained Reversible Generation as Unsupervised Visual Representation Learning
abstract: 基于分数匹配和流匹配的近期生成模型在生成任务中取得了显著进展,但其在判别任务中的潜力仍待探索。先前方法如生成分类器由于复杂的设计,未能充分挖掘这些模型在判别任务中的能力。我们提出预训练可逆生成(PRG),通过逆转预训练连续生成模型的生成过程来提取无监督表示。PRG有效复用无监督生成模型,利用其高容量作为鲁棒且可泛化的特征提取器,服务于下游任务。该框架支持根据特定下游任务灵活选择特征层次结构。我们的方法在多个基准测试中均优于先前方法,包括在64x64分辨率下达到78%的ImageNet top-1准确率,是基于生成模型方法中的最先进性能。广泛的消融实验,包括分布外评估,进一步验证了我们的方法有效性。PRG可在https://opendilab.github.io/PRG获取。
abstract_en: Recent generative models based on score matching and flow matching have significantly advanced generation tasks, but their potential in discriminative tasks remains underexplored. Previous approaches, such as generative classifiers, have not fully leveraged the capabilities of these models for discriminative tasks due to their intricate designs. We propose Pretrained Reversible Generation (PRG), which extracts unsupervised representations by reversing the generative process of a pretrained continuous generation model. PRG effectively reuses unsupervised generative models, leveraging their high capacity to serve as robust and generalizable feature extractors for downstream tasks. This framework enables the flexible selection of feature hierarchies tailored to specific downstream tasks. Our method consistently outperforms prior approaches across multiple benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art performance among generative model based methods, including 78% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet at a resolution of 64x64. Extensive ablation studies, including out-of-distribution evaluations, further validate the effectiveness of our approach. PRG is available at https://opendilab.github.io/PRG.
authors: Rongkun Xue, Jinouwen Zhang, Yazhe Niu, Dazhong Shen, Bingqi Ma, Yu Liu, Jing Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19216-19226

title: PriOr-Flow:通过正交视角增强原始全景光流
title_en: PriOr-Flow: Enhancing Primitive Panoramic Optical Flow with Orthogonal View
abstract: 全景光流能够全面理解宽视场下的时间动态。然而,由球面到平面投影(如等距圆柱投影ERP)引起的严重失真显著降低了传统基于透视的光流方法的性能,尤其是在极地区域。为解决这一挑战,我们提出PriOr-Flow,一种新颖的双分支框架,利用正交视角的低失真特性来增强这些区域的光流估计。具体而言,我们引入了双成本协作查找(DCCL)算子,该算子联合从原始和正交成本体积中检索相关性信息,有效抑制了成本体积构建过程中的失真噪声。此外,我们的正交驱动失真补偿(ODDC)模块迭代优化原始分支的运动特征,进一步抑制极地失真。大量实验表明,PriOr-Flow与各种基于透视的迭代光流方法兼容,并在公开的全景光流数据集上持续取得最先进性能,为宽视场运动估计设立了新基准。
abstract_en: Panoramic optical flow enables a comprehensive understanding of temporal dynamics across wide fields of view. However, severe distortions caused by sphere-to-plane projections, such as the equirectangular projection (ERP), significantly degrade the performance of conventional perspective-based optical flow methods, especially in polar regions. To address this challenge, we propose PriOr-Flow, a novel dual-branch framework that leverages the low-distortion nature of the orthogonal view to enhance optical flow estimation in these regions. Specifically, we introduce the Dual-Cost Collaborative Lookup (DCCL) operator, which jointly retrieves correlation information from both the primitive and orthogonal cost volumes, effectively mitigating distortion noise during cost volume construction. Furthermore, our Ortho-Driven Distortion Compensation (ODDC) module iteratively refines motion features of the primitive branch, further suppressing polar distortions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PriOr-Flow is compatible with various perspective-based iterative optical flow methods and consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance on publicly available panoramic optical flow datasets, setting a new benchmark for wide-field motion estimation.
authors: Longliang Liu, Miaojie Feng, Junda Cheng, Jijun Xiang, Xuan Zhu, Xin Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5326-5336

title: PrimHOI:通过可重用基元实现的组合式人-物交互
title_en: PrimHOI: Compositional Human-Object Interaction via Reusable Primitives
abstract: 合成逼真的人-物交互(HOI)动作对于创建可信的数字角色和智能机器人至关重要。现有方法依赖数据密集型学习模型,难以处理日常人-物交互动作的组合结构,尤其在复杂多物操作任务中表现不足。交互场景的指数级增长使得全面数据收集成本高昂。核心挑战在于无需大量任务特定训练数据即可合成未见过的复杂HOI序列。本文展示PrimHOI通过相对几何定义的通用交互基元的空间与时间组合生成复杂HOI动作。我们的方法表明,重复的局部接触模式——抓取、夹持和支持——可作为多样化交互序列的可重用构建模块。与需要针对每个任务变体进行端到端训练的先前数据驱动方法不同,PrimHOI通过分层基元规划实现对未见过场景的零样本迁移。实验验证表明,与现有方法相比,PrimHOI在适应性、多样性及运动质量方面均取得显著提升。
abstract_en: Synthesizing realistic Human-Object Interaction (HOI) motions is essential for creating believable digital characters and intelligent robots. Existing approaches rely on data-intensive learning models that struggle with the compositional structure of daily HOI motions, particularly for complex multi-object manipulation tasks. The exponential growth of possible interaction scenarios makes comprehensive data collection prohibitively expensive. The fundamental challenge is synthesizing unseen, complex HOI sequences without extensive task-specific training data. Here we show that PrimHOI generates complex HOI motions through spatial and temporal composition of generalizable interaction primitives defined by relative geometry. Our approach demonstrates that repetitive local contact patterns -- grasping, clamping, and supporting -- serve as reusable building blocks for diverse interaction sequences. Unlike previous data-driven methods requiring end-to-end training for each task variant, PrimHOI achieves zero-shot transfer to unseen scenarios through hierarchical primitive planning. Experimental validation demonstrates substantial improvements in adaptability, diversity, and motion quality compared to existing approaches.
authors: Kai Jia, Tengyu Liu, Mingtao Pei, Yixin Zhu, Siyuan Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11491-11501

title: Princeton365:一个具有精确相机姿态的多样化数据集
title_en: Princeton365: A Diverse Dataset with Accurate Camera Pose
abstract: 我们介绍了Princeton365,这是一个包含365个视频的大型多样化数据集,具有精确的相机姿态。我们的数据集通过引入一种新颖的真实数据收集框架,弥合了当前SLAM基准测试中精度与数据多样性之间的差距,该框架利用校准板和360度相机。我们收集了室内、室外和物体扫描视频,同步输出单目和双目RGB视频以及IMU数据。我们进一步提出了一种基于由相机姿态估计误差引起的光流的新型场景尺度感知SLAM评估指标。与现有指标不同,我们的新指标允许研究人员比较不同场景下SLAM方法的性能,而非现有指标如平均轨迹误差(ATE),从而能够分析其方法的失效模式。我们还提出了一种具有挑战性的新型视图合成基准测试,覆盖了当前NVS基准测试未涵盖的案例,例如包含360度相机轨迹的完全非朗伯反射场景。请访问https://princeton365.cs.princeton.edu获取数据集、代码、视频和提交信息。
abstract_en: We introduce Princeton365, a large-scale diverse dataset of 365 videos with accurate camera pose. Our dataset bridges the gap between accuracy and data diversity in current SLAM benchmarks by introducing a novel ground truth collection framework that leverages calibration boards and a 360 camera. We collect indoor, outdoor, and object scanning videos with synchronized monocular and stereo RGB video outputs as well as IMU. We further propose a new scene scale-aware evaluation metric for SLAM based on the the optical flow induced by the camera pose estimation error. In contrast to the current metrics, our new metric allows for comparison between the performance of SLAM methods across scenes as opposed to existing metrics such as Average Trajectory Error (ATE), allowing researchers to analyze the failure modes of their methods. We also propose a challenging Novel View Synthesis benchmark that covers cases not covered by current NVS benchmarks, such as fully non-Lambertian scenes with 360 camera trajectories. Please visit https://princeton365.cs.princeton.edu for the dataset, code, videos, and submission.
authors: Karhan Kayan, Stamatis Alexandropoulos, Rishabh Jain, Yiming Zuo, Erich Liang, Jia Deng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7645-7654

title: 视觉标记的原理:高效视频理解
title_en: Principles of Visual Tokens for Efficient Video Understanding
abstract: 近年来视频理解取得了巨大进展,主要依赖于Transformer架构的强大能力。然而由于该架构成本高昂且视频数据高度冗余,提升效率的研究变得尤为重要。一些创新性解决方案包括标记选择与合并。尽管大多数方法在降低模型成本并保持准确性方面取得成功,但一个有趣的现象浮现:这些方法大多无法超越随机丢弃标记的基线表现。本文深入探讨这一现象,观察到视觉标记的五个本质规律。例如,我们发现标记值遵循清晰的帕累托分布,其中大部分标记价值极低,仅有少数携带主要的感知信息。基于这些发现及进一步洞察,我们提出轻量级视频模型LITE,该模型能有效选择少量标记,在Kinetics-400和Something-Something-V2数据集上,在计算量(GFLOPs)与准确率的挑战性权衡中超越现有方法。实验还表明,LITE无需重新训练即可在不同数据集和其他任务中实现泛化。代码已开源于https://github.com/maggieHao/Efficient-LITE。
abstract_en: Video understanding has made huge strides in recent years, relying largely on the power of transformers. As this architecture is notoriously expensive and video data is highly redundant, research into improving efficiency has become particularly relevant. Some creative solutions include token selection and merging. While most methods succeed in reducing the cost of the model and maintaining accuracy, an interesting pattern arises: most methods do not outperform the baseline of randomly discarding tokens. In this paper we take a closer look at this phenomenon and observe 5 principles of the nature of visual tokens. For example, we observe that the value of tokens follows a clear Pareto-distribution where most tokens have remarkably low value, and just a few carry most of the perceptual information. We build on these and further insights to propose a lightweight video model, LITE, that can select a small number of tokens effectively, outperforming state-of-the-art and existing baselines across datasets (Kinetics-400 and Something-Something-V2) in the challenging trade-off of computation (GFLOPs) vs accuracy. Experiments also show that LITE generalizes across datasets and even other tasks without the need for retraining. The code is released at https://github.com/maggieHao/Efficient-LITE.
authors: Xinyue Hao, Gen Li, Shreyank N Gowda, Robert B. Fisher, Jonathan Huang, Anurag Arnab, Laura Sevilla-Lara ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21254-21264

title: 基于先验感知的动态时间建模框架用于序列三维手部姿态估计
title_en: Prior-aware Dynamic Temporal Modeling Framework for Sequential 3D Hand Pose Estimation
abstract: 三维手部姿态估计在各类人机交互任务中发挥关键作用。单帧三维手部姿态估计方法存在时间平滑性差且易受自遮挡影响的问题,严重制约其实际应用效果。传统基于关节的序列姿态估计方法主要聚焦于人体结构,难以处理手部结构复杂、运动自由度高及运动趋势快速变化等挑战。为解决上述问题,我们提出一种基于先验感知的动态时间建模框架用于序列三维手部姿态估计。我们引入灵活的记忆机制以建模手部先验信息,有效缓解单帧手部姿态估计中的尺度和深度模糊问题。此外,我们提出动态时间卷积模块,根据各时刻的运动信息动态调整感受野大小和特征聚合权重,有效捕捉快速运动趋势。通过在关节级和手部级解耦动态时间建模,我们的方法同时捕捉细微的短时变化和长期运动趋势,显著提升手部姿态估计的平滑度和精度。在四个公开数据集上的实验表明,我们的方法在手部姿态估计精度和时间平滑性方面均达到当前最优水平。
abstract_en: 3D hand pose estimation plays a critical role in various human-computer interaction tasks. Single-frame 3D hand pose estimation methods have poor temporal smoothness and are easily affected by self-occlusion, which severely impacts their practical applicability. Traditional joint-based sequential pose estimation methods primarily focus on the human body and struggle to handle the complex hand structure, high degrees of freedom in hand motion, and rapidly changing hand motion trends. To address these challenges, we propose a prior-aware dynamic temporal modeling framework for sequential 3D hand pose estimation. We introduce a flexible memory mechanism to model hand prior information, which alleviates the scale and depth ambiguity in single-frame hand pose estimation. Additionally, we propose a dynamic temporal convolution module that adjusts the receptive field size and feature aggregation weights based on the motion information at each moment, effectively capturing rapid motion trends. By decoupling dynamic temporal modeling at the joint and hand levels, our method captures both subtle short-term variations and long-term motion trends, significantly improving the smoothness and accuracy of hand pose estimation. Experiments on four public datasets demonstrate that our method achieves the state-of-the-art results in terms of hand pose estimation accuracy and temporal smoothness.
authors: Pengfei Ren, Jingyu Wang, Haifeng Sun, Qi Qi, Xingyu Liu, Menghao Zhang, Lei Zhang, Jing Wang, Jianxin Liao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6476-6487

title: Prior2Former - 基于证据建模的掩码变换器用于无需假设的开放世界全景分割
title_en: Prior2Former - Evidential Modeling of Mask Transformers for Assumption-Free Open-World Panoptic Segmentation
abstract: 在全景分割中,需在语义类别内分离个体实例。由于最先进的方法依赖于预定义的类别集合,其在新类别和分布外(OOD)数据上表现不佳。这在安全关键型应用(如自动驾驶)中尤为突出,因为在未见过的场景中可靠性至关重要。我们通过提出Prior2Former(P2F),填补了卓越基准性能与可靠性之间的差距。P2F是首个基于证据学习的分割视觉变换器方法。P2F通过引入贝塔先验扩展了掩码视觉变换器架构,用于计算像素级二值掩码分配中的模型不确定性。该设计实现了高质量的不确定性估计,有效检测新类别和分布外对象,从而实现最先进的异常实例分割和开放世界全景分割。与大多数处理未知类别的分割模型不同,P2F无需访问分布外数据样本或在空(即未标记)类别上进行对比训练,使其在缺乏此类先验信息的现实场景中具有高度适用性。此外,P2F可灵活应用于异常实例分割和全景分割。通过在Cityscapes、COCO、SegmentMeIfYouCan和OoDIS数据集上的全面实验,P2F展现出最先进的性能。特别是在OoDIS数据集上,P2F在该类别中排名第一。
abstract_en: In panoptic segmentation, individual instances must be separated within semantic classes. As state-of-the-art methods rely on a pre-defined set of classes, they struggle with novel categories and out-of-distribution (OOD) data. This is particularly problematic in safety-critical applications, such as autonomous driving, where reliability in unseen scenarios is essential. We address the gap between outstanding benchmark performance and reliability by proposing Prior2Former (P2F), the first approach for segmentation vision transformers rooted in evidential learning. P2F extends the mask vision transformer architecture by incorporating a Beta prior for computing model uncertainty in pixel-wise binary mask assignments. This design enables high-quality uncertainty estimation that effectively detects novel and OOD objects, enabling state-of-the-art anomaly instance segmentation and open-world panoptic segmentation. Unlike most segmentation models addressing unknown classes, P2F operates without access to OOD data samples or contrastive training on void (i.e., unlabeled) classes, making it highly applicable in real-world scenarios where such prior information is unavailable. Additionally, P2F can be flexibly applied to anomaly instance and panoptic segmentation. Through comprehensive experiments on the Cityscapes, COCO, SegmentMeIfYouCan, and OoDIS datasets, P2F demonstrates state-of-the-art performance. Especially in OoDIS, P2F ranks first in its category.
authors: Sebastian Schmidt, Julius Koerner, Dominik Fuchsgruber, Stefano Gasperini, Federico Tombari, Stephan Günnemann ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23646-23656

title: PriorMotion: 基于栅格-矢量运动场先验的生成式无类别依赖运动预测
title_en: PriorMotion: Generative Class-Agnostic Motion Prediction with Raster-Vector Motion Field Priors
abstract: 可靠的时空与运动感知对于安全的自动驾驶导航至关重要。近期,基于激光雷达点云生成的俯视图(BEV)网格单元上的无类别依赖运动预测受到广泛关注。然而,现有框架通常基于像素级进行单元分类和运动预测,忽视了刚性约束、时间一致性及代理间未来交互等重要的运动场先验知识。这些局限性导致在稀疏和远距离区域性能下降。为解决这些挑战,我们提出PriorMotion,一种创新的生成式框架,通过在结构化潜在空间中建模运动先验分布,实现无类别依赖运动预测。具体而言,我们的方法利用栅格-矢量表示捕捉结构化运动先验,并采用具有动态与静态组件的变分自编码器,在潜在空间中学习未来运动分布。在nuScenes数据集上的实验表明,PriorMotion在传统指标和我们提出的新型评估标准上均优于现有最先进方法。值得注意的是,在快速移动物体的准确率上提高了约15.24%,泛化能力提升3.59%,运动稳定性降低0.0163,远距离区域预测误差减少31.52%。进一步在FMCW激光雷达传感器上的验证证实了我们方法的鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Reliable spatial and motion perception is essential for safe autonomous navigation. Recently, class-agnostic motion prediction on bird's-eye view (BEV) cell grids derived from LiDAR point clouds has gained significant attention. However, existing frameworks typically perform cell classification and motion prediction on a per-pixel basis, neglecting important motion field priors such as rigidity constraints, temporal consistency, and future interactions between agents. These limitations lead to degraded performance, particularly in sparse and distant regions. To address these challenges, we introduce PriorMotion, an innovative generative framework designed for class-agnostic motion prediction that integrates essential motion priors by modeling them as distributions within a structured latent space. Specifically, our method captures structured motion priors using raster-vector representations and employs a variational autoencoder with distinct dynamic and static components to learn future motion distributions in the latent space. Experiments on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate that PriorMotion outperforms state-of-the-art methods across both traditional metrics and our newly proposed evaluation criteria. Notably, we achieve improvements of approximately 15.24% in accuracy for fast-moving objects, an 3.59% increase in generalization, a reduction of 0.0163 in motion stability, and a 31.52% reduction in prediction errors in distant regions. Further validation on FMCW LiDAR sensors confirms the robustness of our approach.
authors: Kangan Qian, Jinyu Miao, Xinyu Jiao, Ziang Luo, Zheng Fu, Yining Shi, Yunlong Wang, Kun Jiang, Diange Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27284-27294

title: 面向骨架运动可视化匿名化的隐私优先深度运动重定向
title_en: Privacy-centric Deep Motion Retargeting for Anonymization of Skeleton-Based Motion Visualization
abstract: 基于骨架的运动捕捉与可视化是计算机视觉的关键领域,尤其在虚拟现实(VR)场景中具有重要地位。其流行度因获取骨架数据的简便性及虚拟交互需求的增长而显著提升。尽管骨架数据看似不可识别,但可能被用于推导个人可识别信息(PII),从而导致无意的隐私泄露。本文探讨了运动重定向技术的应用及其缓解隐私泄露的能力。运动重定向可有效将初始用户的运动转移到虚拟骨架上,以隐藏PII。我们提出了一种以隐私为中心的深度运动重定向模型(PMR),通过对抗学习降低PII风险。在评估中,所提模型的运动重定向性能与当前最先进的方法相当。更重要的是,该模型能有效阻止攻击者识别初始用户。
abstract_en: Capturing and visualizing motion using skeleton-based techniques is a key aspect of computer vision, particularly in virtual reality (VR) settings. Its popularity has surged, driven by the simplicity of obtaining skeleton data and the growing appetite for virtual interaction. Although this skeleton data appears to be non-identifiable, it can be exploited to derive personally identifiable information (PII), posing a risk of inadvertent privacy breaches. In this paper, we explore the application of motion retargeting and its ability to mitigate privacy leakages. Motion retargeting can effectively transfer the motion from an initial user onto a dummy skeleton with the purpose of hiding PII. We propose a Privacy-centric Deep Motion Retargeting model (PMR), which mitigates the PII through adversarial learning. In our evaluation, our proposed model achieves motion retargeting performance on par with the current state-of-the-art models. More importantly, it effectively prevents the attackers from identifying the initial user.
authors: Thomas Carr, Depeng Xu, Shuhan Yuan, Aidong Lu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13162-13170

title: ProGait:面向膝上假肢用户的多功能视频数据集与基准
title_en: ProGait: A Multi-Purpose Video Dataset and Benchmark for Transfemoral Prosthesis Users
abstract: 假肢在临床康复中起着关键作用,使下肢截肢者能够恢复行动能力并提高生活质量。步态分析是优化假肢设计和对齐的基础,直接影响下肢截肢者的行动能力和生活质量。基于视觉的机器学习(ML)方法为步态分析提供了可扩展且无创的解决方案,但面临正确检测和分析假肢的挑战,由于假肢具有独特的外观和新的运动模式。本文旨在通过引入一个多功能数据集ProGait来弥合这一差距,以支持视频对象分割、2D人体姿态估计和步态分析(GA)等多任务视觉任务。ProGait提供了412个视频片段,来自四位膝上截肢者在通过行走试验测试多种新安装假肢时的记录,描绘了使用膝上假肢的人体受试者的存在、轮廓、姿态和步态模式。除了数据集本身,我们还提出了基准任务和微调的基线模型,以展示ProGait数据集的实际应用和性能。我们将基线模型与预训练视觉模型进行比较,证明在假肢特定任务中应用ProGait数据集可提高泛化能力。ProGait数据集可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/ericyxy98/ProGait获取,基准任务的源代码可在https://github.com/pittisl/ProGait获取。
abstract_en: Prosthetic legs play a pivotal role in clinical rehabilitation, allowing individuals with lower-limb amputations the ability to regain mobility and improve their quality of life. Gait analysis is fundamental for optimizing prosthesis design and alignment, directly impacting the mobility and life quality of individuals with lower-limb amputations. Vision-based machine learning (ML) methods offer a scalable and non-invasive solution to gait analysis, but face challenges in correctly detecting and analyzing prosthesis, due to their unique appearances and new movement patterns. In this paper, we aim to bridge this gap by introducing a multi-purpose dataset, namely ProGait, to support multiple vision tasks including Video Object Segmentation, 2D Human Pose Estimation, and Gait Analysis (GA). ProGait provides 412 video clips from four above-knee amputees when testing multiple newly-fitted prosthetic legs through walking trials, and depicts the presence, contours, poses, and gait patterns of human subjects with transfemoral prosthetic legs. Alongside the dataset itself, we also present benchmark tasks and fine-tuned baseline models to illustrate the practical application and performance of the ProGait dataset. We compared our baseline models against pre-trained vision models, demonstrating improved generalizability when applying the ProGait dataset for prosthesis-specific tasks. The ProGait dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ericyxy98/ProGait, and the source codes of our benchmark tasks are available at https://github.com/pittisl/ProGait.
authors: Xiangyu Yin, Boyuan Yang, Weichen Liu, Qiyao Xue, Abrar Alamri, Goeran Fiedler, Wei Gao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8984-8993

title: ProJudge:面向基于多模态大语言模型的流程裁判的多模态多学科基准及指令调优数据集
title_en: ProJudge: A Multi-Modal Multi-Discipline Benchmark and Instruction-Tuning Dataset for MLLM-based Process Judges
abstract: 随着多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)在解决科学问题时常出现错误,评估其推理过程的有效性对于确保可靠性并揭示模型细粒度缺陷至关重要。由于人工评估耗时耗力,通过提示词让MLLMs充当自动化流程裁判已成为常见做法。然而,基于模型的裁判可靠性仍存疑。为解决这一问题,我们引入ProJudgeBench,这是首个专门用于评估基于MLLMs流程裁判能力的全面基准。ProJudgeBench包含2,400个测试用例和50,118个步骤级标注,涵盖四个科学领域,具有多样化难度等级和多模态内容。在ProJudgeBench中,每个步骤均由人类专家标注正确性、错误类型和解释,从而实现对裁判检测、分类和诊断错误能力的系统性评估。在ProJudgeBench上的评估揭示了开源模型与专有模型之间存在显著性能差距。为弥合这一差距,我们进一步提出大规模指令调优数据集ProJudge-173k,以及鼓励模型在评估解决方案前明确进行问题解决推理的动态双阶段微调策略。这两项贡献显著提升了开源模型的流程评估能力。本项目地址:https://projudge.github.io。
abstract_en: As multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) frequently exhibit errors when solving scientific problems, evaluating the validity of their reasoning processes is critical for ensuring reliability and uncovering fine-grained model weaknesses. Since human evaluation is laborious and costly, prompting MLLMs as automated process judges has become a common practice. However, the reliability of these model-based judges remains uncertain. To address this, we introduce ProJudgeBench, the first comprehensive benchmark specifically designed for evaluating abilities of MLLM-based process judges. ProJudgeBench comprises 2,400 test cases and 50,118 step-level labels, spanning four scientific disciplines with diverse difficulty levels and multi-modal content. In ProJudgeBench, each step is meticulously annotated by human experts for correctness, error type, and explanation, enabling a systematic evaluation of judges' capabilities to detect, classify and diagnose errors. Evaluation on ProJudgeBench reveals a significant performance gap between open-source and proprietary models. To bridge this gap, we further propose ProJudge-173k, a large-scale instruction-tuning dataset, and a Dynamic Dual-Phase fine-tuning strategy that encourages models to explicitly reason through problem-solving before assessing solutions. Both contributions significantly enhance the process evaluation capabilities of open-source models. This project is available at: https://projudge.github.io.
authors: Jiaxin Ai, Pengfei Zhou, Zhaopan Xu, Ming Li, Fanrui Zhang, Zizhen Li, Jianwen Sun, Yukang Feng, Baojin Huang, Zhongyuan Wang, Kaipeng Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4681-4690

title: ProSAM: 通过概率提示增强基于SAM的视觉参考分割的鲁棒性
title_en: ProSAM: Enhancing the Robustness of SAM-based Visual Reference Segmentation with Probabilistic Prompts
abstract: 近期大基础模型的进展推动了开放集图像分割的成功,该任务专注于分割预定义类别之外的对象。在多种提示类型(如点、框、文本和视觉参考)中,视觉参考分割因其独特的灵活性和强大的零样本能力而脱颖而出。最近,几种基于SAM的方法通过自动生成提示来引导SAM,在该任务中取得了显著进展。然而,这些方法由于提示编码器存在次优设计,常在目标区域边界生成提示,导致结果不稳定且鲁棒性降低。本文提出ProSAM,一种简单但有效的解决方案,旨在解决现有基于SAM的视觉参考分割方法中存在的稳定性问题。通过学习变分提示编码器以预测多变量提示分布,ProSAM避免生成位于不稳定区域的提示,克服了由鲁棒性较差提示导致的不稳定性。我们的方法在Pascal-5和COCO-20数据集上持续超越最先进的方法,为视觉参考分割提供了更鲁棒的解决方案。
abstract_en: The recent advancements in large foundation models have driven the success of open-set image segmentation, a task focused on segmenting objects beyond predefined categories. Among various prompt types (such as points, boxes, texts, and visual references), visual reference segmentation stands out for its unique flexibility and strong zero-shot capabilities. Recently, several SAM-based methods have made notable progress in this task by automatically generating prompts to guide SAM. However, these methods often generate prompts at boundaries of target regions due to a suboptimal prompt encoder, which results in instability and reduced robustness. In this work, we introduce ProSAM, a simple but effective method to address the stability challenges we identified in existing SAM-based visual reference segmentation approaches. By learning a variational prompt encoder to predict multivariate prompt distributions, ProSAM avoids generating prompts that lie in unstable regions, overcoming the instability caused by less robust prompts. Our approach consistently surpasses state-of-the-art methods on the Pascal-5 and COCO-20 datasets, providing a more robust solution for visual reference segmentation.
authors: Xiaoqi Wang, Clint Sebastian, Wenbin He, Liu Ren ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20487-20496

title: 前瞻性场景分解与重建
title_en: Proactive Scene Decomposition and Reconstruction
abstract: 人类行为是场景动态变化的主要诱因,本质上包含丰富的动态线索。本文提出一种新型任务——前瞻性场景分解与重建,这是一种基于人机交互的在线方法,通过迭代分解与重建环境实现动态场景建模。通过观察这些有意行为,可动态优化分解与重建过程,解决静态物体级重建中的固有歧义。所提系统有效整合了动态环境中的多任务处理,包括精确的相机与物体姿态估计、实例分解及在线地图更新,利用第一视角直播流中的人机交互线索,为传统物体级重建方法提供灵活渐进的替代方案。借助高斯泼溅技术,实现了逼真且高效的动态场景建模与一致渲染。该方法在多个现实场景中验证了有效性,展现出显著优势。
abstract_en: Human behaviors are the major causes of scene dynamics and inherently contain rich cues regarding the dynamics. This paper formalizes a new task of proactive scene decomposition and reconstruction, an online approach that leverages human-object interactions to iteratively disassemble and reconstruct the environment. By observing these intentional interactions, we can dynamically refine the decomposition and reconstruction process, addressing inherent ambiguities in static object-level reconstruction. The proposed system effectively integrates multiple tasks in dynamic environments such as accurate camera and object pose estimation, instance decomposition, and online map updating, capitalizing on cues from human-object interactions in egocentric live streams for a flexible, progressive alternative to conventional object-level reconstruction methods. Aided by the Gaussian splatting technique, accurate and consistent dynamic scene modeling is achieved with photorealistic and efficient rendering. The efficacy is validated in multiple real-world scenarios with promising advantages.
authors: Baicheng Li, Zike Yan, Dong Wu, Hongbin Zha ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9780-9789

title: ProbMED:面向医疗多模态绑定的概率框架
title_en: ProbMED: A Probabilistic Framework for Medical Multimodal Binding
abstract: 医疗决策需要整合来自影像到临床文本的多样化医学信息。这些医学模态通常以多对多的方式获取。然而,当前的医学视觉-语言预训练模型(Med-VLPMs)在模型训练和嵌入表示中未能直接考虑这种多对多映射。为解决这一问题,我们提出概率模态增强诊断(ProbMED),这是一种采用概率对比学习的多模态Med-VLPM,通过建模嵌入分布而非确定性估计来表征数据。ProbMED将胸部X光、心电图、超声心动图和临床文本四种不同模态对齐到统一的概率嵌入空间。我们采用结合Hellinger距离的InfoNCE损失函数来整合跨模态分布。我们引入概率合成采样损失,捕捉模态特异性的均值和方差以提升同模态绑定效果。在13个医疗数据集上的广泛实验表明,我们的模型在跨模态检索、零样本和少样本分类任务中均优于现有Med-VLPMs。我们还展示了多模态在预后分析中的稳健整合,证明了同模态和跨模态绑定的显著提升。
abstract_en: Medical decision-making requires integrating diverse medical information, from imaging to clinical narratives. These medical modalities are often acquired in a many-to-many manner. However, current medical vision-language pretraining models (Med-VLPMs) fail to directly account for this many-to-many mapping in their model training and embeddings. To address this, we present Probabilistic Modality-Enhanced Diagnosis (ProbMED), a multimodal Med-VLPM that employs probabilistic contrastive learning to model distributions over embeddings rather than deterministic estimates. ProbMED aligns four distinct modalities--chest X-rays, electrocardiograms, echocardiograms, and clinical text--into a unified probabilistic embedding space. We use InfoNCE loss with Hellinger distance to integrate inter-modality distributions. We introduce a probabilistic synthetic sampling loss that captures modality-specific mean and variance to improve intra-modality binding. Extensive experiments across 13 medical datasets demonstrate that our model outperforms current Med-VLPMs in cross-modality retrieval, zero-shot, and few-shot classification. We also demonstrate the robust integration of multiple modalities for prognostication, showing improved intra- and inter-medical modality binding.
authors: Yuan Gao, Sangwook Kim, Jianzhong You, Chris McIntosh ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20157-20167

title: ProbRes:面向开放世界第一人称活动识别的贝叶斯跳跃扩散方法
title_en: ProbRes: Probabilistic Jump Diffusion for Open-World Egocentric Activity Recognition
abstract: 由于其无约束特性,开放世界第一人称活动识别面临根本性挑战,要求模型从广阔且部分可观测的搜索空间中推断未见过的活动。我们提出ProbRes,一种基于跳跃扩散的贝叶斯残差搜索框架,通过平衡先验引导的探索与似然驱动的利用,高效导航该搜索空间。我们的方法整合结构化常识先验构建语义连贯的搜索空间,利用视觉-语言模型(VLMs)自适应优化预测,并采用随机搜索机制在降低穷举枚举效率的同时定位高似然活动标签。我们系统评估ProbRes在多个开放程度等级(L0-L3)上的表现,验证其对搜索空间复杂度提升的适应性。除在基准数据集(GTEA Gaze、GTEA Gaze+、EPIC-Kitchens和Charades-Ego)上取得最先进性能外,我们还建立开放世界识别的清晰分类体系,明确第一人称活动理解的挑战与方法论进展。实验结果凸显结构化搜索策略的重要性,为可扩展高效的开放世界活动识别奠定基础。
abstract_en: Open-world egocentric activity recognition poses a fundamental challenge due to its unconstrained nature, requiring models to infer unseen activities from an expansive, partially observed search space. We introduce ProbRes, a Probabilistic Residual search framework based on jump-diffusion that efficiently navigates this space by balancing prior-guided exploration with likelihood-driven exploitation. Our approach integrates structured commonsense priors to construct a semantically coherent search space, adaptively refines predictions using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and employs a stochastic search mechanism to locate high-likelihood activity labels while minimizing exhaustive enumeration efficiently. We systematically evaluate ProbRes across multiple openness levels (L0-L3), demonstrating its adaptability to increasing search space complexity. In addition to achieving state-of-the-art performance on benchmark datasets (GTEA Gaze, GTEA Gaze+, EPIC-Kitchens, and Charades-Ego), we establish a clear taxonomy for open-world recognition, delineating the challenges and methodological advancements necessary for egocentric activity understanding. Our results highlight the importance of structured search strategies, paving the way for scalable and efficient open-world activity recognition.
authors: Sanjoy Kundu, Shanmukha Vellamcheti, Sathyanarayanan N. Aakur ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14128-14140

title: 概率惯性姿态器(ProbIP):基于稀疏惯性传感器的不确定性感知人体运动建模
title_en: Probabilistic Inertial Poser (ProbIP): Uncertainty-aware Human Motion Modeling from Sparse Inertial Sensors
abstract: 可穿戴惯性测量单元(IMUs)能够实现非侵入式运动追踪,但受限的传感器布置可能引入对详细全身运动捕捉的不确定性。现有方法通过选择更符合物理规律的运动模式来缓解这一问题,但并未直接解决数据中的固有不确定性。我们提出概率惯性姿态器(ProbIP),这是一种新颖的概率模型,可将稀疏IMU数据转换为人体运动预测,无需物理约束。ProbIP利用RU-Mamba模块预测旋转的矩阵Fisher分布,有效估计旋转矩阵及其相关不确定性。为通过多层细化运动分布,我们的渐进分布窄化(PDN)技术实现了在多样化运动范围内的稳定学习。实验结果表明,ProbIP在多个公开数据集上使用六种及更少IMU传感器时均达到最先进性能。我们的贡献包括:开发基于RU-Mamba模块的ProbIP用于概率运动估计,应用渐进分布窄化(PDN)进行不确定性降低,以及六种及减少传感器配置下的优越结果证据。
abstract_en: Wearable Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) allow non-intrusive motion tracking, but limited sensor placements can introduce uncertainty in capturing detailed full-body movements. Existing methods mitigate this issue by selecting more physically plausible motion patterns but do not directly address inherent uncertainties in the data. We introduce the Probabilistic Inertial Poser (ProbIP), a novel probabilistic model that transforms sparse IMU data into human motion predictions without physical constraints. ProbIP utilizes RU-Mamba blocks to predict a matrix Fisher distribution over rotations, effectively estimating both rotation matrices and associated uncertainties. To refine motion distribution through layers, our Progressive Distribution Narrowing (PDN) technique enables stable learning across a diverse range of motions. Experimental results demonstrate that ProbIP achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple public datasets with six and fewer IMU sensors. Our contributions include the development of ProbIP with RU-Mamba blocks for probabilistic motion estimation, applying Progressive Distribution Narrowing (PDN) for uncertainty reduction, and evidence of superior results with six and reduced sensor configurations.
authors: Min Kim, Younho Jeon, Sungho Jo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25893-25902

title: 基于视觉-语言模型的概率原型校准用于广义少样本语义分割
title_en: Probabilistic Prototype Calibration of Vision-language Models for Generalized Few-shot Semantic Segmentation
abstract: 广义少样本语义分割(GFSS)旨在通过仅使用少量标注示例将分割模型扩展到新类别,同时保持对基础类别的性能。近期,预训练的视觉-语言模型(VLMs)如CLIP已被用于GFSS,通过多模态原型学习提升对新类别的泛化能力。然而,现有基于原型的方法本质上是确定性的,限制了所学原型对多样样本的适应性,特别是对于标注数据稀缺的新类别。为解决这一问题,我们的工作提出了一种概率原型校准网络(PPCN)——一种基于预训练CLIP多模态原型的概率建模框架,从而为GFSS提供更自适应的原型学习。具体而言,PPCN首先引入了原型校准机制,通过可学习的视觉校准原型优化冻结的文本原型,从而获得更具判别性和适应性的表示。此外,不同于确定性原型学习技术,PPCN在这些校准原型上引入了分布正则化。这种概率建模确保了结构化且具有不确定感知的原型学习,有效缓解了对有限新类别数据的过拟合,同时增强泛化能力。在PASCAL-5^i和COCO-20^i数据集上的大量实验结果表明,我们提出的PPCN在GFSS和类别增量设置中均显著优于最先进的方法。源代码将公开发布。
abstract_en: Generalized Few-Shot Semantic Segmentation (GFSS) aims to extend a segmentation model to novel classes with only a few annotated examples while maintaining performance on base classes. Recently, pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP have been leveraged in GFSS to improve generalization on novel classes through multi-modal prototypes learning. However, existing prototype-based methods are inherently deterministic, limiting the adaptability of learned prototypes to diverse samples, particularly for novel classes with scarce annotations. To address this, our work propose Probabilistic Prototype Calibration Network (PPCN) - a probabilistic modeling framework over multi-modal prototypes from the pretrained CLIP, thus providing more adaptive prototype learning for GFSS. Specifically, PPCN first introduces a prototype calibration mechanism, which refines frozen textual prototypes with learnable visual calibration prototypes, leading to a more discriminative and adaptive representation. Furthermore, unlike deterministic prototype learning techniques, PPCN introduces distribution regularization over these calibration prototypes. This probabilistic formulation ensures structured and uncertainty-aware prototype learning, effectively mitigating overfitting to limited novel class data while enhancing generalization. Extensive experimental results on PASCAL-5^i and COCO-20^i datasets demonstrate that our proposed PPCN significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across both GFSS and class-incremental setting. The source code will be released publicly.
authors: Jie Liu, Jiayi Shen, Pan Zhou, Jan-Jakob Sonke, Efstratios Gavves ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21155-21165

title: 视觉编码器中的处理与采集痕迹:CLIP知道你的相机什么?
title_en: Processing and acquisition traces in visual encoders: What does CLIP know about your camera?
abstract: 先前研究分析了视觉编码器对图像变换和损坏的鲁棒性,特别是在训练时未见过的改变导致分布偏移的情况下,往往引发性能下降。研究重点主要集中在严重损坏上,当这些损坏被激进应用时,会扭曲对准确语义预测至关重要的信号。我们采取了不同的视角,分析图像采集过程的参数及可能微妙甚至难以察觉于人眼的变换。我们发现这些参数在学习到的视觉表示中被系统性编码,并且可以轻易恢复。更引人注目的是,这些参数的存在会对语义预测产生深远影响,无论是正面还是负面。这种影响取决于语义标签与基于采集或处理的标签之间是否存在强正相关或负相关。我们的代码和数据可在:https://github.com/ryan-caesar-ramos/visual-encoder-traces 获取。
abstract_en: Prior work has analyzed the robustness of visual encoders to image transformations and corruptions, particularly in cases where such alterations are not seen during training. When this occurs, they introduce a form of distribution shift at test time, often leading to performance degradation. The primary focus has been on severe corruptions that, when applied aggressively, distort useful signals necessary for accurate semantic predictions. We take a different perspective by analyzing parameters of the image acquisition process and transformations that may be subtle or even imperceptible to the human eye. We find that such parameters are systematically encoded in the learned visual representations and can be easily recovered. More strikingly, their presence can have a profound impact, either positively or negatively, on semantic predictions. This effect depends on whether there is a strong correlation or anti-correlation between semantic labels and these acquisition-based or processing-based labels. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/ryan-caesar-ramos/visual-encoder-traces
authors: Ryan Ramos, Vladan Stojnić, Giorgos Kordopatis-Zilos, Yuta Nakashima, Giorgos Tolias, Noa Garcia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17056-17066

title: 基于潜在扩散模型的渐进式艺术作品外扩
title_en: Progressive Artwork Outpainting via Latent Diffusion Models
abstract: 潜在扩散模型在生成高细节且具有审美价值的图像方面表现出优于传统方法的性能,这使其被广泛应用于各种图像生成与编辑任务,包括外扩。然而,大多数基于潜在扩散模型的外扩方法对分辨率和宽高比施加了限制,常常导致局部细节丢失和模糊。解决这些问题的一种方法是渐进式外扩,即逐步扩展图像。然而,朴素的渐进式外扩面临两个关键挑战:(1) 难以有效捕捉全局上下文,导致原始上下文难以保持;(2) 倾向于生成不自然的图案。这些挑战在艺术领域尤为突出,因为艺术家通常在绘画前预先设计构图。因此,现有方法常引入视觉不一致,分散观众注意力并削弱预期的艺术强调。为解决这些局限性,我们提出两种类型的构图规划模块,通过利用全局结构指导来增强渐进式外扩。这些模块引导预训练的稳定扩散模型考虑整体构图,实现无需繁琐用户提示的现实且符合上下文的艺术作品完成。通过在多样化艺术作品图像上的实验,我们展示了所提方法在定量和定性上的有效性。
abstract_en: Latent diffusion models have demonstrated superior performance over traditional methods in generating highly detailed and aesthetically pleasing images, which makes them widely used for various image generation and editing tasks, including outpainting. However, most LDM-based outpainting methods impose constraints on resolution and aspect ratio, often leading to the loss of local details and blurring. One way to address these issues is progressive outpainting, where the image is extended outward incrementally. However, naive progressive outpainting suffers from two key challenges: (1) difficulty in effectively capturing global context, making it hard to maintain the original context, and (2) a tendency to generate unnatural patterns. These challenges are particularly pronounced in art, where artists pre-design the composition before painting. As a result, existing methods often introduce visual inconsistencies that distract the viewer and diminish the intended artistic emphasis. To address these limitations, we propose two types of composition planning modules that enhance progressive outpainting by leveraging global structural guidance. These modules guide a pre-trained stable diffusion model to consider the overall composition, enabling realistic and contextually appropriate artwork completion without labor-intensive user prompts. Through experiments on diverse artwork images, we show the effectiveness of our proposed method both quantitatively and qualitatively.
authors: Dae-Young Song, Jung-Jae Yu, Donghyeon Cho ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15405-15415

title: 渐进式分布桥接:通过自适应辅助数据实现大规模预训练模型的无监督适应
title_en: Progressive Distribution Bridging: Unsupervised Adaptation for Large-scale Pre-trained Models via Adaptive Auxiliary Data
abstract: 大规模预训练视觉-语言模型(VLMs)如CLIP在下游任务中展现出有前景的零样本迁移能力。然而,当面临显著领域迁移时,其性能会下降。本文聚焦于大规模预训练VLMs向无标签目标领域的低成本适应。在此背景下,两种主流范式存在固有局限:无监督微调(UFT)受初始模型性能较差的困扰,而无监督领域适应(UDA)可能因不恰当的辅助源域产生负面影响。为缓解这些局限,我们提出通过大规模图像-文本对自适应构建更合适的辅助数据,以实现无需人工标注的无监督适应。具体而言,我们引入渐进式分布桥接(PDB),通过构建辅助数据将具有挑战性的适应任务分解为多个简单步骤。为获取此类数据,我们设计了一种高效可控的检索算法,结合级联语义过滤器和风格控制器,分别调节检索数据的语义类别和领域风格。在三个标准UDA基准的11个不同领域上的实验结果验证了我们辅助数据的有效性。值得注意的是,在Office-Home数据集上,我们的方法超越了依赖标注源域的最先进UDA方法。所提方法为VLMs适应无标签下游任务提供了更通用且成本效益更高的解决方案。
abstract_en: Large-scale pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) like CLIP have demonstrated promising zero-shot transfer capabilities to downstream tasks. However, their performance deteriorates when facing significant domain shifts. In this paper, we focus on cost-effective adaptation of large-scale pre-trained VLMs to unlabeled target domains. In this context, two prevalent paradigms show inherent limitations: Unsupervised Fine-Tuning (UFT) struggles with poor initial model performance, while Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) may suffer from adverse effects of inappropriate auxiliary source domain. To alleviate these limitations, we propose to adaptively construct more suitable auxiliary data from large-scale image-text pairs to facilitate unsupervised adaptation without any human annotations. Specifically, we introduce Progressive Distribution Bridging (PDB), which decomposes the challenging adaptation task into multiple simple steps through the construction of auxiliary data. To obtain such data, we design an efficient and controllable retrieval algorithm incorporating cascaded semantic filters and style controller to regulate the semantic category and domain style of retrieved data, respectively. Experimental results across 11 different domains from three standard UDA benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our auxiliary data. Notably, on Office-Home, our method outperforms state-of-the-art UDA methods that rely on labeled source domains. The proposed method offers a more universal and cost-effective solution for adapting VLMs to unlabeled downstream tasks.
authors: Weinan He, Yixin Zhang, Zilei Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3280-3292

title: 视频分词器的逐步增长以实现时间紧凑的潜在空间
title_en: Progressive Growing of Video Tokenizers for Temporally Compact Latent Spaces
abstract: 视频分词器对于潜在视频扩散模型至关重要,其将原始视频数据转换为时空压缩的潜在空间以实现高效训练。然而,将最先进的视频分词器扩展至在不增加通道容量的情况下实现超过4倍的时间压缩比面临显著挑战。在本工作中,我们提出了一种替代方法以增强时间压缩。我们发现,从低压缩编码器对时间下采样的视频进行重建的质量,优于对原始视频应用高压缩编码器的结果。这表明高压缩模型可以利用低压缩模型的表示。基于这一发现,我们开发了一种逐步训练的高时间压缩模型,其在已训练良好的低压缩模型基础上逐步训练高压缩模块。我们的方法包含一个跨层级特征混合模块,以保留预训练低压缩模型的信息,并引导高压缩模块捕捉完整视频序列中剩余的细节。对视频基准的评估表明,与直接训练完整模型相比,我们的方法在提高重建质量的同时显著增加了时间压缩比。此外,所得到的紧凑潜在空间能够以显著减少的token预算有效训练视频扩散模型,实现高质量视频生成。
abstract_en: Video tokenizers are essential for latent video diffusion models, converting raw video data into spatiotemporally compressed latent spaces for efficient training. However, extending state-of-the-art video tokenizers to achieve a temporal compression ratio beyond 4x without increasing channel capacity poses significant challenges. In this work, we propose an alternative approach to enhance temporal compression. We find that the reconstruction quality of temporally subsampled videos from a low-compression encoder surpasses that of high-compression encoders applied to original videos. This indicates that high-compression models can leverage representations from lower-compression models. Building on this insight, we develop a bootstrapped high-temporal-compression model that progressively trains high-compression blocks atop well-trained lower-compression models. Our method includes a cross-level feature-mixing module to retain information from the pretrained low-compression model and guide higher-compression blocks to capture the remaining details from the full video sequence. Evaluation of video benchmarks shows that our method significantly improves reconstruction quality while increasing temporal compression compared to directly training the full model. Furthermore, the resulting compact latent space effectively trains a video diffusion model for high-quality video generation with a significantly reduced token budget.
authors: Aniruddha Mahapatra, Long Mai, David Bourgin, Yitian Zhang, Feng Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17629-17639

title: 面向音频-视觉多任务增量学习的渐进式稳态与可塑性提示调优
title_en: Progressive Homeostatic and Plastic Prompt Tuning for Audio-Visual Multi-Task Incremental Learning
abstract: 音频-视觉多任务增量学习旨在无需对所有任务进行联合训练的情况下,持续从多个音频-视觉任务中学习。该问题的挑战在于如何在保留旧任务知识的同时,利用先前经验促进新任务的学习。为解决这些挑战,我们提出了一种三阶段渐进式稳态与可塑性音频-视觉提示(PHP)方法。在浅层阶段,设计任务共享模态聚合适配器,促进跨任务和跨模态的音频-视觉表征学习,以增强任务间的共享理解。在中层阶段,提出任务特定模态共享动态生成适配器,构建针对个体任务定制的提示,同时保持跨模态通用性,平衡模型的知识保留能力与遗忘风险,以及其多任务迁移的通用性。在深层阶段,引入任务特定模态无关提示,通过针对每个任务和模态的特定信息进一步精炼理解能力。通过融合这三个阶段,PHP在保留任务特定提示的同时,为新任务调整共享参数,有效平衡知识共享与特异性。我们的方法在四种任务(AVE、AVVP、AVS和AVQA)的不同顺序中均达到最先进性能。代码已开源至https://github.com/ENJOY-Yin-jiong/PHP。
abstract_en: Audio-visual multi-task incremental learning aims to continuously learn from multiple audio-visual tasks without the need for joint training on all tasks. The challenge of the problem is how to preserve the old task knowledge while facilitating the learning of new task with previous experiences. To address these challenges, we introduce a three-stage Progressive Homeostatic and Plastic audio-visual prompt (PHP) method. In the shallow phase, we design the task-shared modality aggregating adapter to foster cross-task and cross-modal audio-visual representation learning to enhance shared understanding between tasks. In the middle phase, we propose the task-specific modality-shared dynamic generating adapter, which constructs prompts that are tailored to individual tasks while remaining general across modalities, which balances the model's ability to retain knowledge against forgetting with its potential for versatile multi-task transferability. In the deep phase, we introduce the task-specific modality-independent prompts to further refine the understand ability by targeting individual information for each task and modality. By incorporating these three phases, PHP retains task-specific prompts while adapting shared parameters for new tasks to effectively balance knowledge sharing and specificity. Our method achieves SOTA performance in different orders of four tasks (AVE, AVVP, AVS and AVQA). Our code can be available at https://github.com/ENJOY-Yin-jiong/PHP.
authors: Jiong Yin, Liang Li, Jiehua Zhang, Yuhan Gao, Chenggang Yan, Xichun Sheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2022-2033

title: 面向医学图像分割的渐进式测试时能量自适应方法
title_en: Progressive Test Time Energy Adaptation for Medical Image Segmentation
abstract: 我们提出了一种模型无关的、渐进式测试时能量自适应方法,用于医学图像分割。在多样化医学数据集上保持模型性能具有挑战性,因为分布偏移源于不一致的成像协议和患者差异。与需要多次遍历目标数据的领域自适应方法不同(在临床环境中不切实际),我们的方法在处理测试数据时逐步自适应预训练模型。我们的方法利用在源数据上训练的形状能量模型,为分割图分配像素级能量得分:低能量表示分布内(准确)形状,高能量则指示分布外(错误)预测。通过在测试时最小化该能量得分,我们优化分割模型以匹配目标分布。为验证有效性与适应性,我们在八个公开的MRI(bSSFP、T1-和T2加权)和X光数据集上评估框架,涵盖心脏、脊髓和肺部分割任务。我们在定量和定性方面均优于基线方法。项目页面详见:\href https://voldemort108x.github.io/pttea_seg/ https://voldemort108x.github.io/pttea_seg/
abstract_en: We propose a model-agnostic, progressive test-time energy adaptation approach for medical image segmentation. Maintaining model performance across diverse medical datasets is challenging, as distribution shifts arise from inconsistent imaging protocols and patient variations. Unlike domain adaptation methods that require multiple passes through target data--impractical in clinical settings--our approach adapts pretrained models progressively as they process test data. Our method leverages a shape energy model trained on source data, which assigns an energy score at the patch level to segmentation maps: low energy represents in-distribution (accurate) shapes, while high energy signals out-of-distribution (erroneous) predictions. By minimizing this energy score at test time, we refine the segmentation model to align with the target distribution. To validate effectiveness and adaptability, we evaluated our framework on eight public MRI (bSSFP, T1- and T2-weighted) and X-ray datasets spanning cardiac, spinal cord, and lung segmentation. We consistently outperform baselines both quantitatively and qualitatively. Project page is available at: \href https://voldemort108x.github.io/pttea_seg/  https://voldemort108x.github.io/pttea_seg/
authors: Xiaoran Zhang, Byung-Woo Hong, Hyoungseob Park, Daniel H. Pak, Anne-Marie Rickmann, Lawrence H. Staib, James S. Duncan, Alex Wong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22338-22348

title: Prompt引导与人类近距感知的HOT预测区域联合损失方法
title_en: Prompt Guidance and Human Proximal Perception for HOT Prediction with Regional Joint Loss
abstract: 人类-物体接触(HOT)检测任务涉及识别人体与物体接触的具体区域。然而现有模型受限于单一类型的图像,常导致交互较少区域出现过度分割,并难以保持特定区域内的类别一致性。为解决该问题,提出了一种名为P3HOT的HOT框架,融合了提示引导与人类近距感知机制。首先,通过语义驱动的提示机制,基于图像与文本间的相关性引导网络关注相关区域;随后采用人类近距感知机制,利用可学习参数动态感知人体周围关键深度范围,有效消除非预期交互区域。深度计算解决了二维视角下人与物体重叠的不确定性,提供准三维视角。此外,设计了区域联合损失(RJLoss)作为新型损失函数,抑制同一区域内的异常类别。引入新的评估指标AD-Acc.以弥补现有方法在处理负样本方面的不足。综合实验结果表明,本方法在两个基准数据集的四个指标上均达到最先进水平。具体而言,在HOT-Annotated数据集上,模型在SC-Acc.、mIoU、wIoU和AD-Acc.指标上分别提升了0.7、2.0、1.6和11.0。源代码已开源至https://github.com/YuxiaoWang-AI/P3HOT。
abstract_en: The task of Human-Object conTact (HOT) detection involves identifying the specific areas of the human body that are touching objects. Nevertheless, current models are restricted to just one type of image, often leading to too much segmentation in areas with little interaction, and struggling to maintain category consistency within specific regions. To tackle this issue, a HOT framework, termed P3HOT, is proposed, which blends Prompt guidance and human Proximal Perception. To begin with, we utilize a semantic-driven prompt mechanism to direct the network's attention towards the relevant regions based on the correlation between image and text. Then a human proximal perception mechanism is employed to dynamically perceive key depth range around the human, using learnable parameters to effectively eliminate regions where interactions are not expected. Calculating depth resolves the uncertainty of the overlap between humans and objects in a 2D perspective, providing a quasi-3D viewpoint. Moreover, a Regional Joint Loss (RJLoss) has been created as a new loss to inhibit abnormal categories in the same area. A new evaluation metric called AD-Acc. is introduced to address the shortcomings of existing methods in addressing negative samples. Comprehensive experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance in four metrics across two benchmark datasets. Specifically, our model achieves an improvement of 0.7, 2.0, 1.6, and 11.0 in SC-Acc., mIoU, wIoU, and AD-Acc. metrics, respectively, on the HOT-Annotated dataset. The sources code are available at https://github.com/YuxiaoWang-AI/P3HOT.
authors: Yuxiao Wang, Yu Lei, Zhenao Wei, Weiying Xue, Xinyu Jiang, Nan Zhuang, Qi Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23636-23645

title: Prompt-A-Video: 通过偏好对齐大语言模型提示你的视频扩散模型
title_en: Prompt-A-Video: Prompt Your Video Diffusion Model via Preference-Aligned LLM
abstract: 文本到视频模型通过在高质量文本-视频对上的优化取得了显著进展,其中文本提示在决定输出视频质量中起着关键作用。然而,实现期望的输出通常需要多次修订和迭代推理以优化用户提供的提示。当前自动优化提示的方法在应用于文本到视频扩散模型时面临模态不一致性、成本差异和模型不敏感等挑战。为解决这些问题,我们引入了一种基于大语言模型的提示适配框架,称为Prompt-A-Video,该框架擅长创建以视频为中心、无需人工干预且与偏好对齐的提示,以适配特定的视频扩散模型。我们的方法涉及精心设计的两阶段优化和对齐系统。首先,我们通过奖励引导的提示演化流程自动创建最优提示池,并利用它们对大语言模型进行监督微调(SFT)。随后,通过多维奖励生成成对数据用于SFT模型,再结合直接偏好优化(DPO)算法进一步促进偏好对齐。通过广泛的实验和对比分析,我们验证了Prompt-A-Video在多种生成模型上的有效性,突显其推动视频生成边界潜力。
abstract_en: Text-to-video models have made remarkable advancements through optimization on high-quality text-video pairs, where the textual prompts play a pivotal role in determining quality of output videos. However, achieving the desired output often entails multiple revisions and iterative inference to refine user-provided prompts. Current automatic methods for refining prompts encounter challenges such as Modality-Inconsistency, Cost-Discrepancy, and Model-Unaware when applied to text-to-video diffusion models. To address these problem, we introduce an LLM-based prompt adaptation framework, termed as Prompt-A-Video, which excels in crafting Video-Centric, Labor-Free and Preference-Aligned prompts tailored to specific video diffusion model. Our approach involves a meticulously crafted two-stage optimization and alignment system. Initially, we conduct a reward-guided prompt evolution pipeline to automatically create optimal prompts pool and leverage them for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of the LLM. Then multi-dimensional rewards are employed to generate pairwise data for the SFT model, followed by the direct preference optimization (DPO) algorithm to further facilitate preference alignment. Through extensive experimentation and comparative analyses, we validate the effectiveness of Prompt-A-Video across diverse generation models, highlighting its potential to push the boundaries of video generation.
authors: Yatai Ji, Jiacheng Zhang, Jie Wu, Shilong Zhang, Shoufa Chen, Chongjian Ge, Peize Sun, Weifeng Chen, Wenqi Shao, Xuefeng Xiao, Weilin Huang, Ping Luo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18725-18735

title: 基于属性感知文本反转的提示驱动可迁移行人重识别对抗攻击
title_en: Prompt-driven Transferable Adversarial Attack on Person Re-Identification with Attribute-aware Textual Inversion
abstract: 行人重识别(re-id)模型在安全监控系统中至关重要,需要可迁移对抗攻击来探索其漏洞。近期基于视觉-语言模型(VLM)的攻击方法通过攻击VLM的通用图像和文本特征表现出卓越的可迁移性,但因过度强调整体表征中的判别语义而缺乏全面的特征破坏。本文提出属性感知提示攻击(AP-Attack)方法,利用VLM的图像-文本对齐能力,通过破坏属性特定的文本嵌入显式干扰行人图像的细粒度语义特征。为获取个体属性的个性化文本描述,设计文本反转网络将行人图像映射到表示语义嵌入的伪标记,通过对比学习方式以图像和预定义的提示模板进行训练,该模板明确描述行人属性。反转的良性与对抗性细粒度文本语义有助于攻击者有效实施全面干扰,提升对抗样本的可迁移性。大量实验表明,AP-Attack在跨模型&数据集攻击场景中实现最先进的可迁移性,平均Drop Rate较先前方法提升22.9%。
abstract_en: Person re-identification (re-id) models are vital in security surveillance systems, requiring transferable adversarial attacks to explore the vulnerabilities of them. Recently, vision-language models (VLM) based attacks have shown superior transferability by attacking generalized image and textual features of VLM, but they lack comprehensive feature disruption due to the overemphasis on discriminative semantics in integral representation. In this paper, we introduce the Attribute-aware Prompt Attack (AP-Attack), a novel method that leverages VLM's image-text alignment capability to explicitly disrupt fine-grained semantic features of pedestrian images by destroying attribute-specific textual embeddings. To obtain personalized textual descriptions for individual attributes, textual inversion networks are designed to map pedestrian images to pseudo tokens that represent semantic embeddings, trained in the contrastive learning manner with images and a predefined prompt template that explicitly describes the pedestrian attributes. Inverted benign and adversarial fine-grained textual semantics facilitate attacker in effectively conducting thorough disruptions, enhancing the transferability of adversarial examples. Extensive experiments show that AP-Attack achieves state-of-the-art transferability, significantly outperforming previous methods by 22.9% on mean Drop Rate in cross-model&dataset attack scenarios.
authors: Yuan Bian, Min Liu, Yunqi Yi, Xueping Wang, Shuai Jiang, Yaonan Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22599-22609

title: PromptDresser: 通过生成式文本提示与提示感知掩码提升虚拟试穿的质量与可控性
title_en: PromptDresser: Improving the Quality and Controllability of Virtual Try-On via Generative Textual Prompt and Prompt-aware Mask
abstract: 近期的虚拟试穿方法通过微调预训练的文本到图像扩散模型来利用其强大的生成能力而取得进展;然而,文本提示在虚拟试穿中的应用仍处于初步探索阶段。本文提出了一种文本可编辑的虚拟试穿任务,该任务基于提供的服装图像修改服装,并根据文本描述调整穿着风格(如收腰方式、合身程度)。在文本可编辑的虚拟试穿中存在三个关键方面:(i) 为配对的人体-服装数据设计丰富的文本描述以训练模型,(ii) 解决现有服装文本信息干扰新服装生成的冲突问题,(iii) 根据文本描述自适应调整修复掩码,确保编辑区域的准确性同时保留与新服装无关的原始人体外观。为解决这些问题,我们提出了PromptDresser,一种基于生成式文本提示的文本可编辑虚拟试穿模型,利用大模态模型(LMM)辅助实现高质量且多样的操作。我们的方法通过上下文学习利用LMM生成人体和服装图像的详细文本描述,包括姿态细节和编辑属性,且仅需极少的人力成本。此外,为确保编辑区域,我们根据文本提示自适应调整修复掩码。该方法在提升文本可编辑性的同时,有效传达图像难以捕捉的服装细节,从而提高图像质量。实验表明,PromptDresser显著优于基线方法,展示了卓越的文本驱动控制能力和多样化的服装操作能力。
abstract_en: Recent virtual try-on approaches have advanced by finetuning pre-trained text-to-image diffusion models to leverage their powerful generative ability; however, the use of text prompts in virtual try-on remains underexplored. This paper tackles a text-editable virtual try-on task that modifies the clothing based on the provided clothing image while editing the wearing style (e.g., tucking style, fit) according to the text descriptions. In the text-editable virtual try-on, three key aspects exist: (i) designing rich text descriptions for paired person-clothing data to train the model, (ii) addressing the conflicts where textual information of the existing person's clothing interferes the generation of the new clothing, and (iii) adaptively adjust the inpainting mask aligned with the text descriptions, ensuring proper editing areas while preserving the original person's appearance irrelevant to the new clothing. To address these aspects, we propose PromptDresser, a text-editable virtual try-on model that leverages large multimodal model (LMM) assistance to enable high-quality and versatile manipulation based on generative text prompts. Our approach utilizes LMMs via in-context learning to generate detailed text descriptions for person and clothing images independently, including pose details and editing attributes using minimal human cost. Moreover, to ensure the editing areas, we adjust the inpainting mask depending on the text prompts adaptively. Our approach enhances text editability while effectively conveying clothing details that are difficult to capture through images alone, leading to improved image quality. Experiments show that PromptDressersignificantly outperforms baselines, demonstrating superior text-driven control and versatile clothing manipulation.
authors: Jeongho Kim, Hoiyeong Jin, Sunghyun Park, Jaegul Choo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16026-16036

title: PropVG:端到端基于提议的视觉定位与多粒度判别
title_en: PropVG: End-to-End Proposal-Driven Visual Grounding with Multi-Granularity Discrimination
abstract: 近期视觉定位领域的进展已大幅偏离传统基于提议的两阶段框架,因其效率低下和高计算复杂度,转而采用端到端直接参考范式。然而,这些方法仅依赖于所指目标进行监督,忽视了显著前景目标的潜在优势。此外,现有方法往往未能融合多粒度判别,这对于复杂场景中鲁棒的目标识别至关重要。为解决这些局限性,我们提出PropVG,一种端到端基于提议的框架,据我们所知,这是首个无缝集成前景目标提议生成与参考目标理解的框架,无需额外检测器。此外,我们引入了基于对比的参考评分(CRS)模块,通过句子和单词级别的对比学习增强模型对参考目标的理解与区分能力。同时,我们设计了多粒度目标判别(MTD)模块,融合目标级和语义级信息以提升对缺失目标的识别能力。在gRefCOCO (GREC/GRES)、Ref-ZOM、R-RefCOCO/+/g和RefCOCO/+/g (REC/RES)基准上的大量实验验证了PropVG的有效性。
abstract_en: Recent advances in visual grounding have largely shifted away from traditional proposal-based two-stage frameworks due to their inefficiency and high computational complexity, favoring end-to-end direct reference paradigms. However, these methods rely exclusively on the referred target for supervision, overlooking the potential benefits of prominent prospective targets. Moreover, existing approaches often fail to incorporate multi-granularity discrimination, which is crucial for robust object identification in complex scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose PropVG, an end-to-end proposal-based framework that, to the best of our knowledge, is the first to seamlessly integrate foreground object proposal generation with referential object comprehension without requiring additional detectors. Furthermore, we introduce a Contrastive-based Refer Scoring (CRS) module, which employs contrastive learning at both sentence and word levels to enhance the model's capability in understanding and distinguishing referred objects. Additionally, we design a Multi-granularity Target Discrimination (MTD) module that fuses object- and semantic-level information to improve the recognition of absent targets. Extensive experiments on gRefCOCO (GREC/GRES), Ref-ZOM, R-RefCOCO/+/g, and RefCOCO/+/g (REC/RES) benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of PropVG.
authors: Ming Dai, Wenxuan Cheng, Jiedong Zhuang, Jiang-jiang Liu, Hongshen Zhao, Zhenhua Feng, Wankou Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7058-7068

title: 通过激活空间操控的原型引导后门防御
title_en: Prototype Guided Backdoor Defense via Activation Space Manipulation
abstract: 深度学习模型容易受到涉及恶意扰动部分训练数据的后门攻击,通过触发器强制将样本分类到目标类别。已使用各种触发器,包括易于实现的语义触发器。我们提出了一种原型引导后门防御(PGBD),这是一种稳健的后处理防御方法,可扩展到不同类型的触发器,包括之前未解决的语义触发器。PPGBD利用激活空间几何空间中的位移来惩罚向触发器方向的移动。这是通过事后微调步骤中的一种新颖净化损失实现的。这种方法适用于所有类型的攻击和触发器,并在不同设置下表现更优。我们还提出了针对名人面部图像数据集上语义攻击的第一种防御方法。激活空间可以以多种方式为增强深度学习模型提供丰富的线索。
abstract_en: Deep learning models are susceptible to   backdoor attacks  involving malicious perturbation of some training data with a   trigger  to force misclassification to a target class. Various triggers have been used including semantic triggers that are easily realizable. We present Prototype Guided Backdoor Defense (PGBD), a robust post-hoc defense that scales across different trigger types, including previously unsolved semantic triggers. PPGBD exploits displacements in the geometric spaces of activations to penalize movements towards the trigger. This is done using a novel   sanitization loss  of a post-hoc fine-tuning step. This approach scales to all types of attacks and triggers, and achieves better performance across settings. We also present the first defense against semantic attacks on a new celebrity face images dataset. Activation spaces can provide rich clues to enhance DL models in different ways.
authors: Venkat Adithya Amula, Sunayana Samavedam, Saurabh Saini, Avani Gupta, P J Narayanan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2195-2205

title: 基于原型的对比学习与分阶段渐进增强自监督细粒度学习
title_en: Prototype-based Contrastive Learning with Stage-wise Progressive Augmentation for Self-Supervised Fine-Grained Learning
abstract: 本文旨在缓解自监督学习(SSL)在细粒度表征学习中的问题,目标是区分高度相似子类中的细微差异。我们的初步分析表明,SSL,特别是多阶段对齐策略,在通用类别上表现良好,但在细粒度区分上存在困难。为克服这一局限性,我们提出了一种基于原型的对比学习模块与分阶段渐进增强策略。与以往方法不同,我们的分阶段渐进增强策略在各阶段自适应调整数据增强,更好地适配细粒度数据集的自监督学习。基于原型的对比学习模块同时捕捉整体与局部模式,提取全局与局部图像表征以增强特征可区分性。在流行的细粒度分类与检索基准数据集上的实验验证了方法的有效性,广泛消融研究进一步证实了我们方案的优越性。代码已开源于https://github.com/SEU-VIPGroup/PAPN
abstract_en: In this paper, we mitigate the problem of Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) for fine-grained representation learning, aimed at distinguishing subtle differences within highly similar subordinate categories. Our preliminary analysis shows that SSL, especially the multi-stage alignment strategy, performs well on generic categories but struggles with fine-grained distinctions. To overcome this limitation, we propose a prototype-based contrastive learning module with stage-wise progressive augmentation. Unlike previous methods, our stage-wise progressive augmentation adapts data augmentation across stages to better suit SSL on fine-grained datasets. The prototype-based contrastive learning module captures both holistic and partial patterns, extracting global and local image representations to enhance feature discriminability. Experiments on popular fine-grained benchmarks for classification and retrieval tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, and extensive ablation studies confirm the superiority of our proposals. Codes are available at https://github.com/SEU-VIPGroup/PAPN
authors: Baofeng Tan, Xiu-Shen Wei, Lin Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4125-4134

title: 原型是高效且有效的部分相关视频检索的平衡单元
title_en: Prototypes are Balanced Units for Efficient and Effective Partially Relevant Video Retrieval
abstract: 在检索系统中,同时实现搜索准确性和效率具有内在挑战性。这一挑战在部分相关视频检索(PRVR)中尤为突出,其中为每个视频在不同时间尺度上引入更多样化的上下文表示可提升准确性,但会增加计算和内存成本。为解决这一矛盾,我们提出了一种原型化的PRVR框架,将视频中的多样化上下文编码为固定数量的原型。随后,我们引入了多种策略以增强原型中的文本关联性和视频理解,并采用正交目标确保原型能够捕捉多样化的内容。为在保持原型可通过文本查询检索的同时准确编码视频上下文,我们实施了跨模态和单模态重建任务。跨模态重建任务在共享空间中对齐原型与文本特征,而单模态重建任务则在编码过程中保留所有视频上下文。此外,我们采用视频混合技术提供弱引导,进一步对齐原型与相关文本表示。在TVR、ActivityNet-Captions和QVHighlights上的广泛评估验证了我们的方法在不牺牲效率的前提下具有有效性。
abstract_en: In a retrieval system, simultaneously achieving search accuracy and efficiency is inherently challenging. This challenge is particularly pronounced in partially relevant video retrieval (PRVR), where incorporating more diverse context representations at varying temporal scales for each video enhances accuracy but increases computational and memory costs. To address this dichotomy, we propose a prototypical PRVR framework that encodes diverse contexts within a video into a fixed number of prototypes. We then introduce several strategies to enhance text association and video understanding within the prototypes, along with an orthogonal objective to ensure that the prototypes capture a diverse range of content. To keep the prototypes searchable via text queries while accurately encoding video contexts, we implement cross- and uni-modal reconstruction tasks. The cross-modal reconstruction task aligns the prototypes with textual features within a shared space, while the uni-modal reconstruction task preserves all video contexts during encoding. Additionally, we employ a video mixing technique to provide weak guidance to further align prototypes and associated textual representations. Extensive evaluations on TVR, ActivityNet-Captions, and QVHighlights validate the effectiveness of our approach without sacrificing efficiency.
authors: WonJun Moon, Cheol-Ho Cho, Woojin Jun, Taeoh Kim, Inwoong Lee, Dongyoon Wee, Minho Shim, Jae-Pil Heo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21789-21799

title: 用于交互式极端运动预测的代理桥接游戏变换器
title_en: Proxy-Bridged Game Transformer for Interactive Extreme Motion Prediction
abstract: 在处理涉及极端运动的高度交互场景时,多人运动预测变得尤为具有挑战性。以往的研究更多关注于“中等”运动(例如,一起行走)的情况,其中独立预测每个姿态通常能获得合理的结果。然而,这些方法在建模如林迪跳舞等极端运动时存在不足,因为它们需要更全面地理解跨人物依赖关系。为弥合这一差距,我们引入了代理桥接游戏变换器(PGformer),这是一种基于Transformer的基础模型,能够捕捉驱动极端多人运动的交互作用。PGformer集成了一个新颖的交叉查询注意力模块,以学习姿态序列之间的双向依赖关系,并通过一个微妙控制双向空间信息流的代理单元。我们在具有大规模协作运动的具有挑战性的ExPI数据集上评估了PGformer。定量和定性结果均表明,PGformer在短期和长期预测中均表现出优越性。我们还在中等运动数据集CMU-Mocap和MuPoTS-3D上测试了所提出的方法,将PGformer推广到超过两个人的场景,取得了有希望的结果。PGformer的代码可在https://github.com/joyfang1106/pgformer获取。
abstract_en: Multi-person motion prediction becomes particularly challenging when handling highly interactive scenarios involving extreme motions. Previous works focused more on the case of `moderate' motions (e.g., walking together), where predicting each pose in isolation often yields reasonable results. However, these approaches fall short in modeling extreme motions like lindy-hop dances, as they require a more comprehensive understanding of cross-person dependencies. To bridge this gap, we introduce Proxy-bridged Game Transformer (PGformer), a Transformer-based foundation model that captures the interactions driving extreme multi-person motions. PGformer incorporates a novel cross-query attention module to learn bidirectional dependencies between pose sequences and a proxy unit that subtly controls bidirectional spatial information flow. We evaluated PGformer on the challenging ExPI dataset, which involves large collaborative movements. Both quantitative and qualitative results demonstrate the superiority of PGformer in both short- and long-term predictions. We also test the proposed method on moderate movement datasets CMU-Mocap and MuPoTS-3D, generalizing PGformer to scenarios with more than two individuals with promising results. Code of PGformer is available at https://github.com/joyfang1106/pgformer.
authors: Yanwen Fang, Wenqi Jia, Xu Cao, Peng-Tao Jiang, Guodong Li, Jintai Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13912-13921

title: 全面剪枝:重新思考和提升大视觉语言模型的推理效率
title_en: Pruning All-Rounder: Rethinking and Improving Inference Efficiency for Large Vision Language Models
abstract: 尽管大视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)取得了令人瞩目的成果,但其高昂的计算成本成为广泛应用的重要障碍。为了提升推理效率,现有大多数方法可归类为参数依赖或token依赖策略以降低计算需求。然而,参数依赖方法需要重新训练LVLMs以恢复性能,而token依赖策略则难以持续选择最相关的token。在本文中,我们系统分析了上述挑战,并为推理加速提供了有价值的见解。基于这些发现,我们提出了一种新颖框架——全面剪枝(PAR)。与以往工作不同,PAR开发了一个元路由器,以自适应地组织跨token和层的剪枝流程。通过自监督学习方式,我们的方法在性能与效率之间实现了优越的平衡。值得注意的是,PAR具有高度灵活性,提供了多种剪枝版本以应对各类加速场景。本工作的代码已公开在https://github.com/ASGO-MM/Pruning-All-Rounder。
abstract_en: Although Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved impressive results, their high computational costs pose a significant barrier to wide application. To enhance inference efficiency, most existing approaches can be categorized as parameter-dependent or token-dependent strategies to reduce computational demands. However, parameter-dependent methods require retraining LVLMs to recover performance while token-dependent strategies struggle to consistently select the most relevant tokens. In this paper, we systematically analyze the above challenges and provide a series of valuable insights for inference acceleration. Based on these findings, we propose a novel framework, the Pruning All-Rounder (PAR). Different from previous works, PAR develops a meta-router to adaptively organize pruning flows across both tokens and layers. With a self-supervised learning manner, our method achieves a superior balance between performance and efficiency. Notably, PAR is highly flexible, offering multiple pruning versions to address a range of acceleration scenarios. The code for this work is publicly available at https://github.com/ASGO-MM/Pruning-All-Rounder.
authors: Wei Suo, Ji Ma, Mengyang Sun, Lin Yuanbo Wu, Peng Wang, Yanning Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20247-20256

title: 伪控制的稳定扩散:用于半监督和跨域语义分割的伪标签框架
title_en: Pseudo-SD: Pseudo Controlled Stable Diffusion for Semi-Supervised and Cross-Domain Semantic Segmentation
abstract: 伪标签技术是半监督和跨域语义分割的关键技术,但其效果常受伪标签固有噪声的制约。本研究提出Pseudo-SD框架,通过稳定扩散(Stable Diffusion, SD)重新定义伪标签知识的利用方式。我们的Pseudo-SD创新性地将伪标签与其文本提示结合,对SD模型进行微调,从而生成高质量、多样化的合成图像,使其紧密模拟目标数据特征。在该框架中,提出两种新型机制,即部分注意力操控和结构化伪标签,分别用于在SD微调过程中有效传播文本到图像的对应关系,并确保可控的高质量图像合成。大量实验结果表明,Pseudo-SD在半监督和跨域分割场景中显著提升了性能。通过将我们的Pseudo-SD注入现有方法,我们在不同数据集上建立了新的SOTA,为有效利用伪标签的探索提供了新途径。源代码可在\href https://github.com/DZhaoXd/Pseudo-SD https://github.com/DZhaoXd/Pseudo-SD 获取。
abstract_en: Pseudo-labeling is a key technique of semi-supervised and cross-domian semantic segmentation, yet its efficacy is often hampered by the intrinsic noise of pseudo-labels. This study introduces Pseudo-SD, a novel framework that redefines the utilization of pseudo-label knowledge through Stable Diffusion (SD). Our Pseudo-SD innovatively combines pseudo-labels and its text prompts to fine-tune SD models, facilitating the generation of high-quality, diverse synthetic images that closely mimic target data characteristics. Within this framework, two novel mechanisms, i.e., partial attention manipulation, and structured pseudo-labeling, are proposed to effectively spread text-to-image corresponding during SD fine-tuning process and to ensure controllable high-quality image synthesis respectively. Extensive results demonstrate that Pseudo-SD significantly improves the performance on semi-supervised and cross-domain segmentation scenarios. By injecting our Pseudo-SD into current methods, we establish new state-of-the-arts in different datasets, offering a new way for the exploration of effective pseudo-label utilization. The source code is available at \href https://github.com/DZhaoXd/Pseudo-SD  https://github.com/DZhaoXd/Pseudo-SD .
authors: Dong Zhao, Qi Zang, Shuang Wang, Nicu Sebe, Zhun Zhong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22393-22403

title: PseudoMapTrainer: 在无需高精度地图的情况下进行在线映射学习
title_en: PseudoMapTrainer: Learning Online Mapping without HD Maps
abstract: 在线映射模型仅通过多视角相机图像即可在预测向量地图方面展现出显著成果。然而,所有现有方法在训练过程中仍依赖于真实高精度地图,而获取这些地图成本高昂且地理多样性不足,难以实现可靠的泛化能力。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新颖的在线映射方法PseudoMapTrainer,该方法利用从未标记传感器数据生成的伪标签。我们通过使用高斯点云技术结合预训练2D分割网络的语义信息,从多摄像头图像中重建路面以生成这些伪标签。此外,我们引入了一种掩码感知的分配算法和损失函数,以处理部分掩码的伪标签,首次实现了无需任何真实地图即可训练在线映射模型。进一步地,我们的伪标签可有效用于以半监督方式预训练在线模型,从而利用大规模未标记的众包数据。代码已开源至github.com/boschresearch/PseudoMapTrainer。
abstract_en: Online mapping models show remarkable results in predicting vectorized maps from multi-view camera images only. However, all existing approaches still rely on ground-truth high-definition maps during training, which are expensive to obtain and often not geographically diverse enough for reliable generalization. In this work, we propose PseudoMapTrainer, a novel approach to online mapping that uses pseudo-labels generated from unlabeled sensor data. We derive those pseudo-labels by reconstructing the road surface from multi-camera imagery using Gaussian splatting and semantics of a pre-trained 2D segmentation network. In addition, we introduce a mask-aware assignment algorithm and loss function to handle partially masked pseudo-labels, allowing for the first time the training of online mapping models without any ground-truth maps. Furthermore, our pseudo-labels can be effectively used to pre-train an online model in a semi-supervised manner to leverage large-scale unlabeled crowdsourced data. The code is available at github.com/boschresearch/PseudoMapTrainer.
authors: Christian Löwens, Thorben Funke, Jingchao Xie, Alexandru Paul Condurache ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5263-5272

title: 沙袋与击打人体:视频中的运动迁移性
title_en: Punching Bag vs. Punching Person: Motion Transferability in Videos
abstract: 动作识别模型表现出强大的泛化能力,但它们能否在多样化场景中,甚至在相似分布下,有效迁移高层运动概念?例如,当面对未见过的变体如"击打人体"时,模型能否识别广义动作"击打"?为探索这一问题,我们引入了一个运动迁移性框架,包含三个数据集:(1) Syn-TA,一个包含3D物体运动的合成数据集;(2) Kinetics400-TA;以及(3) Something-Something-v2-TA,均源自自然视频数据集。我们在这些基准数据集上评估了13种最先进的模型,观察到在新场景中识别高层动作时性能显著下降。我们的分析揭示:1) 多模态模型在细粒度未知动作上表现更差,而非粗粒度动作;2) 无偏的Syn-TA数据集与真实世界数据集同样具有挑战性,模型在受控环境下表现出更大的性能下降;3) 当空间线索占主导时,更大模型能提升迁移性,但在密集时序推理上表现不佳,而依赖物体和背景线索则会阻碍泛化。我们进一步探讨了如何解耦粗粒度与细粒度运动以提升在时序挑战性数据集中的识别性能。我们认为本研究建立了评估动作识别中运动迁移性的关键基准。数据集和相关代码:https://github.com/raiyaan-abdullah/Motion-Transfer
abstract_en: Action recognition models demonstrate strong generalization, but can they effectively transfer high-level motion concepts across diverse contexts, even within similar distributions? For example, can a model recognize the broad action "punching" when presented with an unseen variation such as "punching person"? To explore this, we introduce a motion transferability framework with three datasets: (1) Syn-TA, a synthetic dataset with 3D object motions; (2) Kinetics400-TA; and (3) Something-Something-v2-TA, both adapted from natural video datasets. We evaluate 13 state-of-the-art models on these benchmarks and observe a significant drop in performance when recognizing high-level actions in novel contexts. Our analysis reveals: 1) Multimodal models struggle more with fine-grained unknown actions than with coarse ones; 2) The bias-free Syn-TA proves as challenging as real-world datasets, with models showing greater performance drops in controlled settings; 3) Larger models improve transferability when spatial cues dominate but struggle with intensive temporal reasoning, while reliance on object and background cues hinders generalization. We further explore how disentangling coarse and fine motions can improve recognition in temporally challenging datasets. We believe this study establishes a crucial benchmark for assessing motion transferability in action recognition. Datasets and relevant code: https://github.com/raiyaan-abdullah/Motion-Transfer.
authors: Raiyaan Abdullah, Jared Claypoole, Michael Cogswell, Ajay Divakaran, Yogesh Rawat ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11348-11358

title: Puppet-Master: 以部分级动态运动先验实现交互式视频生成的扩展
title_en: Puppet-Master: Scaling Interactive Video Generation as a Motion Prior for Part-Level Dynamics
abstract: 我们引入了Puppet-Master,这是一种交互式视频生成器,能够捕捉物体的内部部分级运动,作为建模物体动态的通用代理。给定一个物体的图像和一组指定物体上若干点轨迹的"拖拽"操作,该模型会合成一段视频,使物体的部件按相应轨迹运动。为构建Puppet-Master,我们将预训练的图像到视频生成器扩展以编码输入拖拽操作。我们还提出了一种替代传统空间注意力机制的all-to-first注意力机制,以缓解在域外数据上微调视频生成器时产生的伪影问题。该模型在Objaverse-Animation-HQ数据集上进行微调,这是一个通过渲染合成3D动画获得的精心整理的部分级运动片段数据集。与真实视频不同,这些合成片段避免了将部分级运动与整体物体和相机运动混淆。我们广泛过滤次优动画,并通过强调物体内部动态的有意义拖拽操作增强合成渲染。我们证明Puppet-Master能够学习生成部分级运动,这与其它主要移动物体整体的运动条件视频生成器不同。此外,Puppet-Master在域外真实图像上具有良好的泛化能力,在零样本方式下优于现有方法在现实世界基准测试中的表现。
abstract_en: We introduce Puppet-Master, an interactive video generator that captures the internal, part-level motion of objects, serving as a proxy for modeling object dynamics universally. Given an image of an object and a set of "drags" specifying the trajectory of a few points on the object, the model synthesizes a video where the object's parts move accordingly. To build Puppet-Master, we extend a pre-trained image-to-video generator to encode the input drags. We also propose all-to-first attention, an alternative to conventional spatial attention that mitigates artifacts caused by fine-tuning a video generator on out-of-domain data. The model is fine-tuned on Objaverse-Animation-HQ, a new dataset of curated part-level motion clips obtained by rendering synthetic 3D animations. Unlike real videos, these synthetic clips avoid confounding part-level motion with overall object and camera motion. We extensively filter sub-optimal animations and augment the synthetic renderings with meaningful drags that emphasize the internal dynamics of objects. We demonstrate that Puppet-Master learns to generate part-level motions, unlike other motion-conditioned video generators that primarily move the object as a whole. Moreover, Puppet-Master generalizes well to out-of-domain real images, outperforming existing methods on real-world benchmarks in a zero-shot manner.
authors: Ruining Li, Chuanxia Zheng, Christian Rupprecht, Andrea Vedaldi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13405-13415

title: Purge-Gate:通过令牌清除实现无需反向传播的点云分类测试时适应
title_en: Purge-Gate: Backpropagation-Free Test-Time Adaptation for Point Clouds Classification via Token purging
abstract: 测试时适应(TTA)对于缓解3D点云分类中由分布偏移导致的性能退化至关重要。在本工作中,我们引入了令牌清除(PG),一种无需反向传播的新方法,该方法在注意力层之前移除受领域偏移影响较大的令牌。与现有TTA方法不同,PG在令牌级别操作,确保稳健适应而无需迭代更新。我们提出了两种变体:PG-SP利用源统计信息,PG-SF是完全源无关的版本,依赖CLS-token驱动的适应。在ModelNet40-C、ShapeNet-C和ScanObjectNN-C上的广泛评估表明,PG-SP比最先进的无需反向传播方法平均准确率高出+10.3%,而PG-SF为源无关适应设定了新基准。此外,PG比我们的基线快12.4倍且内存效率高5.5倍,使其适合实际部署。
abstract_en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) is crucial for mitigating performance degradation caused by distribution shifts in 3D point cloud classification. In this work, we introduce Token Purging (PG), a novel backpropagation-free approach that removes tokens highly affected by domain shifts before they reach attention layers. Unlike existing TTA methods, PG operates at the token level, ensuring robust adaptation without iterative updates. We propose two variants: PG-SP, which leverages source statistics, and PG-SF, a fully source-free version relying on CLS-token-driven adaptation. Extensive evaluations on ModelNet40-C, ShapeNet-C, and ScanObjectNN-C demonstrate that PG-SP achieves an average of +10.3% higher accuracy than state-of-the-art backpropagation-free methods, while PG-SF sets new benchmarks for source-free adaptation. Moreover, PG is 12.4x faster and 5.5x more memory efficient than our baseline, making it suitable for real-world deployment.
authors: Moslem Yazdanpanah, Ali Bahri, Mehrdad Noori, Sahar Dastani, Gustavo Adolfo Vargas Hakim, David Osowiechi, Ismail Ben Ayed, Christian Desrosiers ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27640-27649

title: 拼图相似性:一种基于感知的跨参考度量用于三维场景重建中的瑕疵检测
title_en: Puzzle Similarity: A Perceptually-guided Cross-Reference Metric for Artifact Detection in 3D Scene Reconstructions
abstract: 现代重建技术能够从稀疏的二维视角有效建模复杂的三维场景。然而,由于缺乏真实图像和无参考图像度量在预测可靠瑕疵图方面的局限性,自动评估新视角质量并识别瑕疵具有挑战性。此类度量的缺失阻碍了新视角质量的评估,并限制了诸如修复等后处理技术在提升重建质量中的应用。为解决这一问题,近期研究建立了一类新的度量方法(跨参考度量),仅通过利用其他视角捕获的上下文信息来预测图像质量。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新的跨参考度量——拼图相似性,旨在定位新视角中的瑕疵。我们的方法利用训练视角的图像块统计信息建立场景特定分布,随后用于识别新视角中重建质量较差的区域。鉴于在三维重建背景下缺乏评估跨参考方法的良好度量,我们收集了一个新颖的人工标注数据集,包含未见重建视角中的瑕疵和失真图。通过该数据集,我们证明了我们的方法在新视角中实现了最先进的瑕疵定位,即使没有对齐的参考,也能与人工评估相关联。我们可以利用这一新度量来增强自动图像修复、引导采集或从稀疏输入进行三维重建等应用。项目页面请访问 https://nihermann.github.io/puzzlesim/
abstract_en: Modern reconstruction techniques can effectively model complex 3D scenes from sparse 2D views. However, automatically assessing the quality of novel views and identifying artifacts is challenging due to the lack of ground truth images and the limitations of no-reference image metrics in predicting reliable artifact maps. The absence of such metrics hinders assessment of the quality of novel views and limits the adoption of post-processing techniques, such as inpainting, to enhance reconstruction quality.
