To tackle this, recent work has established a new category of metrics (cross-reference), predicting image quality solely by leveraging context from alternate viewpoint captures. In this work, we propose a new cross-reference metric, Puzzle Similarity, which is designed to localize artifacts in novel views. Our approach utilizes image patch statistics from the training views to establish a scene-specific distribution, later used to identify poorly reconstructed regions in the novel views. Given the lack of good measures to evaluate cross-reference methods in the context of 3D reconstruction, we collected a novel human-labeled dataset of artifact and distortion maps in unseen reconstructed views. Through this dataset, we demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art localization of artifacts in novel views, correlating with human assessment, even without aligned references. We can leverage our new metric to enhance applications like automatic image restoration, guided acquisition, or 3D reconstruction from sparse inputs. Find the project page at https://nihermann.github.io/puzzlesim/.
authors: Nicolai Hermann, Jorge Condor, Piotr Didyk ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28881-28891

title: Q-Frame:面向视频大语言模型的查询感知帧选择与多分辨率自适应
title_en: Q-Frame: Query-aware Frame Selection and Multi-Resolution Adaptation for Video-LLMs
abstract: 多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)在视觉理解任务中展现出显著成果。然而,由于数据量庞大和时间复杂性,将这些模型适配到视频理解任务中仍面临挑战。现有采用均匀帧采样的视频大语言模型(Video-LLMs)往往难以有效捕捉与查询相关的关键时空线索。本文提出Q-Frame,一种针对视频内容和特定查询的自适应帧选择与多分辨率缩放新方法。Q-Frame采用无需训练、即插即用策略,通过类似CLIP的文本-图像匹配网络生成,利用Gumbel-Max技巧实现高效帧选择。Q-Frame使视频大语言模型能够在不超出计算限制的前提下处理更多帧,从而保留关键的时序和空间信息。我们在MLVU、LongVideoBench和Video-MME等基准数据集上进行了大量实验,验证了Q-Frame的有效性,展示了其优于现有方法的优越性及其在各类视频理解任务中的适用性。
abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant success in visual understanding tasks. However, challenges persist in adapting these models for video comprehension due to the large volume of data and temporal complexity. Existing Video-LLMs using uniform frame sampling often struggle to capture the query-related crucial spatiotemporal clues of videos effectively. In this paper, we introduce Q-Frame, a novel approach for adaptive frame selection and multi-resolution scaling tailored to the video's content and the specific query. Q-Frame employs a training-free, plug-and-play strategy generated by a text-image matching network like CLIP, utilizing the Gumbel-Max trick for efficient frame selection. Q-Frame allows Video-LLMs to process more frames without exceeding computational limits, thereby preserving critical temporal and spatial information. We demonstrate Q-Frame's effectiveness through extensive experiments on benchmark datasets, including MLVU, LongVideoBench, and Video-MME, illustrating its superiority over existing methods and its applicability across various video understanding tasks.
authors: Shaojie Zhang, Jiahui Yang, Jianqin Yin, Zhenbo Luo, Jian Luan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22056-22065

title: Q-Norm:基于质量自适应归一化的鲁棒表示学习
title_en: Q-Norm: Robust Representation Learning via Quality-Adaptive Normalization
abstract: 尽管深度神经网络在各类计算机视觉任务中取得了显著成功,但其在退化图像理解中仍面临由于质量变化引起的领域转移带来的重大挑战。受人类视觉系统(HVS)的生物启发,该系统通过对比增益控制和对显著区域的选择性注意动态调整感知策略,我们提出质量自适应归一化(Q-Norm)——一种通过图像质量特征引导学习自适应参数的新型归一化方法。我们的方法解决了传统归一化技术的两个关键局限性:1)领域协方差转移:现有方法无法对齐不同质量领域的特征分布。Q-Norm通过质量感知的参数适应隐式实现跨域对齐,无需显式损失函数。2)生物合理性:通过模仿HVS的对比归一化机制和基于注意力的特征选择,Q-Norm利用预训练的质量评估模型动态调整均值和方差参数,确保对图像退化的鲁棒性。在多个任务(图像分类、语义分割、目标检测)上的大量实验表明,Q-Norm在低质量图像上始终优于基线方法。代码已发布于https://github.com/IIP-Lab-XDU/Q-Norm。
abstract_en: Although deep neural networks have achieved remarkable success in various computer vision tasks, they face significant challenges in degraded image understanding due to domain shifts caused by quality variations. Drawing biological inspiration from the human visual system (HVS), which dynamically adjusts perception strategies through contrast gain control and selective attention to salient regions, we propose Quality-Adaptive Normalization (Q-Norm) - a novel normalization method that learns adaptive parameters guided by image quality features. Our approach addresses two critical limitations of conventional normalization techniques: 1) Domain Covariance Shift: Existing methods fail to align feature distributions across different quality domains. Q-Norm implicitly achieves cross-domain alignment through quality-aware parameter adaptation without explicit loss functions. 2) Biological Plausibility: By mimicking HVS's contrast normalization mechanisms and attention-based feature selection, Q-Norm dynamically adjusts the mean and variance parameters using a pre-trained quality assessment model, ensuring robustness to image degradation. Extensive experiments across multiple tasks (image classification, semantic segmentation, object detection) demonstrate that Q-Norm consistently outperforms baseline methods on low-quality images. Code has been released at https://github.com/IIP-Lab-XDU/Q-Norm.
authors: Lanning Zhang, Ying Zhou, Fei Gao, Ziyun Li, Maoying Qiao, Jinlan Xu, Nannan Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13901-13911

title: QK-Edit:重新审视MM-DiT中基于注意力的注入用于图像和视频编辑
title_en: QK-Edit: Revisiting Attention-based Injection in MM-DiT for Image and Video Editing
abstract: 多模态扩散Transformer(MM-DiTs)近期作为统一文本-视觉合成的有力框架崭露头角,在生成任务中超越了传统U-Net架构。其关键创新在于多模态自注意力(MM-SA)交互机制,其中图像和文本标记被拼接并通过自注意力处理。然而,这种机制在编辑任务中面临显著挑战,使传统基于U-Net的注意力操控方法失效。为解决这一局限,我们提出QK-Edit,一种无需训练的框架,利用MM-DiTs独特的注意力动态实现精确的文本引导图像和视频编辑。通过引入新颖的查询-键操控策略,我们的方法隔离并调整关键注意力组件,在提示保真度与结构一致性之间实现最优平衡。这使得在对象添加、对象移除、对象替换、背景更改、材质更改、颜色更改及风格转换等多任务中实现无缝编辑。值得注意的是,其可通过推理阶段的特征替换轻松实现。QK-Edit在FLUX和HunyuanVideo等最先进模型上展现出卓越的编辑性能,有效弥合了MM-DiTs中生成能力与可编辑灵活性之间的差距,为可扩展的多模态内容创作铺平道路。
abstract_en: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) have recently emerged as a powerful framework for unified text-vision synthesis, surpassing traditional U-Net architectures in generative tasks. One key innovation lies in its Multimodal Self-Attention (MM-SA) interaction where image and text tokens are concatenated and processed via self-attention.However, this mechanism poses significant challenges for editing, rendering conventional U-Net-based attention manipulation methods ineffective. To address this limitation, we propose QK-Edit, a training-free framework that exploits the unique attention dynamics of MM-DiTs for precise text-guided image and video editing. By introducing a novel query-key manipulation strategy, our method isolates and adjusts critical attention components to achieve an optimal balance between prompt fidelity and structural consistency. This enables seamless edits across various tasks, including object addition, object removal, object replacement, changing background, changing material, changing color, and style transformation. Notably, it can be easily implemented with feature replacement in inference.QK-Edit demonstrates superior editing performance on state-of-the-art models, such as FLUX and HunyuanVideo, effectively bridging the gap between generative power and editable flexibility in MM-DiTs, and paving the way for scalable multimodal content creation.
authors: Tiancheng Shen, Zilong Huang, Xiangtai Li, Zhijie Lin, Jiyang Liu, Yitong Wang, Jiashi Feng, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jun Hao Liew ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19043-19053

title: QR-LoRA:基于QR分解的高效解耦微调方法用于定制化生成
title_en: QR-LoRA: Efficient and Disentangled Fine-tuning via QR Decomposition for Customized Generation
abstract: 现有文本到图像模型常依赖于参数微调技术如低秩适应(LoRA)来定制视觉属性。然而,当组合多个LoRA模型进行内容-风格融合任务时,权重矩阵的无结构修改往往导致内容与风格属性间的不期望特征纠缠。我们提出QR-LoRA,一种利用QR分解实现结构化参数更新的新型微调框架,可有效分离视觉属性。我们的核心洞察是正交Q矩阵自然最小化不同视觉特征间的干扰,而上三角R矩阵高效编码属性特定的变换。我们的方法固定Q和R矩阵,仅训练额外的任务特定R矩阵。这种结构化设计将可训练参数减少至传统LoRA方法的一半,并通过R矩阵间的强解耦特性支持多适应融合而无交叉污染。实验表明,QR-LoRA在内容-风格融合任务中实现更优的解耦效果,为生成模型的参数高效解耦微调建立了新范式。项目页面:https://luna-ai-lab.github.io/QR-LoRA/
abstract_en: Existing text-to-image models often rely on parame- ter fine-tuning techniques such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to customize visual attributes. However, when com- bining multiple LoRA models for content-style fusion tasks, unstructured modifications of weight matrices often lead to undesired feature entanglement between content and style attributes. We propose QR-LoRA, a novel fine-tuning frame- work leveraging QR decomposition for structured parame- ter updates that effectively separate visual attributes. Our key insight is that the orthogonal Q matrix naturally min- imizes interference between different visual features, while the upper triangular R matrix efficiently encodes attribute- specific transformations. Our approach fixes both Q and R matrices while only training an additional task-specific R matrix. This structured design reduces trainable param- eters to half of conventional LoRA methods and supports effective merging of multiple adaptations without cross- contamination due to the strong disentanglement properties between R matrices. Experiments demonstrate that QR- LoRA achieves superior disentanglement in content-style fusion tasks, establishing a new paradigm for parameter- efficient, disentangled fine-tuning in generative models. The project page is available at: https://luna-ai-lab. github.io/QR-LoRA/
authors: Jiahui Yang, Yongjia Ma, Donglin Di, Jianxun Cui, Hao Li, Wei Chen, Yan Xie, Xun Yang, Wangmeng Zuo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17587-17597

title: QuEST: 通过高效选择性微调实现低比特扩散模型量化
title_en: QuEST: Low-bit Diffusion Model Quantization via Efficient Selective Finetuning
abstract: 扩散模型的实际部署仍受高内存和计算开销的制约。尽管量化为模型压缩和加速提供了可能,但现有方法在高效实现低比特量化方面面临挑战。本文识别出不平衡的激活分布是量化困难的主要根源,并提出通过权重微调调整这些分布,使其更适应量化。我们提供了理论和实证证据,证明微调作为实用且可靠的解决方案的有效性。在此基础上,我们进一步区分了两种关键类型的量化层:负责保留关键时序信息的层和对位宽缩减特别敏感的层。通过在局部和全局监督下对这些层进行选择性微调,我们缓解了性能退化同时提升了量化效率。我们的方法在三个高分辨率图像生成任务中展现出有效性,在多种位宽设置下均取得了最先进性能。
abstract_en: The practical deployment of diffusion models is still hindered by the high memory and computational overhead. Although quantization paves a way for model compression and acceleration, existing methods face challenges in achieving low-bit quantization efficiently. In this paper, we identify imbalanced activation distributions as a primary source of quantization difficulty, and propose to adjust these distributions through weight finetuning to be more quantization-friendly. We provide both theoretical and empirical evidence supporting finetuning as a practical and reliable solution. Building on this approach, we further distinguish two critical types of quantized layers: those responsible for retaining essential temporal information and those particularly sensitive to bit-width reduction. By selectively finetuning these layers under both local and global supervision, we mitigate performance degradation while enhancing quantization efficiency. Our method demonstrates its efficacy across three high-resolution image generation tasks, obtaining state-of-the-art performance across multiple bit-width settings.
authors: Haoxuan Wang, Yuzhang Shang, Zhihang Yuan, Junyi Wu, Junchi Yan, Yan Yan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15542-15551

title: 二次高斯点云:基于二阶几何原语的高质量表面重建
title_en: Quadratic Gaussian Splatting: High Quality Surface Reconstruction with Second-order Geometric Primitives
abstract: 我们提出了一种名为二次高斯点云(QGS)的新表示方法,通过用可变形二次曲面(如椭圆、抛物面)替代静态原语,以捕捉复杂几何结构。与依赖欧几里得距离进行原语密度建模的先前方法不同——该度量在变形下与表面几何不匹配——QGS引入了基于测地距离的密度分布。这一创新确保密度权重能够内在适应原语曲率,在形状变化(如从平面圆盘到曲面抛物面)过程中保持一致性。通过在二次曲面上闭式求解测地距离,QGS实现了表面感知点云,其中单个原语可表示复杂曲率,这在之前需要数十个平面表面元(surfels),从而在保持高效渲染(通过快速射线-二次曲面相交)的同时,潜在降低内存使用。在DTU、Tanks and Temples和MipNeRF360数据集上的实验表明,QGS实现了最先进的表面重建,其在DTU数据集上将几何误差(Chamfer距离)分别比2DGS减少33%、比GOF减少27%。关键的是,QGS保持了具有竞争力的外观质量,弥合了几何精度与视觉保真度之间的差距,适用于机器人和沉浸式现实等应用。
abstract_en: We propose Quadratic Gaussian Splatting (QGS), a novel representation that replaces static primitives with deformable quadric surfaces (e.g., ellipse, paraboloids) to capture intricate geometry. Unlike prior works that rely on Euclidean distance for primitive density modeling--a metric misaligned with surface geometry under deformation--QGS introduces geodesic distance-based density distributions. This innovation ensures that density weights adapt intrinsically to the primitive curvature, preserving consistency during shape changes (e.g., from planar disks to curved paraboloids). By solving geodesic distances in closed form on quadric surfaces, QGS enables surface-aware splatting, where a single primitive can represent complex curvature that previously required dozens of planar surfels, potentially reducing memory usage while maintaining efficient rendering via fast ray-quadric intersection. Experiments on DTU, Tanks and Temples, and MipNeRF360 datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art surface reconstruction, with QGS reducing geometric error (chamfer distance) by 33% over 2DGS and 27% over GOF on the DTU dataset. Crucially, QGS retains competitive appearance quality, bridging the gap between geometric precision and visual fidelity for applications like robotics and immersive reality.
authors: Ziyu Zhang, Binbin Huang, Hanqing Jiang, Liyang Zhou, Xiaojun Xiang, Shuhan Shen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28260-28270

title: QuantCache: 基于分层潜在空间与层缓存的自适应重要性引导量化视频生成
title_en: QuantCache: Adaptive Importance-Guided Quantization with Hierarchical Latent and Layer Caching for Video Generation
abstract: 近年来,扩散Transformer(DiTs)已成为视频生成领域的主导架构,其性能超越了基于U-Net的模型。然而,DiTs增强的能力伴随着显著的缺点,包括计算和内存成本的增加,这阻碍了其在资源受限设备上的部署。当前的加速技术,如量化和缓存机制,提供的加速效果有限,且通常孤立应用,无法充分解决DiT架构的复杂性。在本文中,我们提出QuantCache,一种无需训练的推理加速框架,联合优化分层潜在空间缓存、自适应重要性引导量化和结构冗余感知剪枝。QuantCache在Open-Sora上实现了6.72倍的端到端延迟加速,仅在生成质量上损失极小。在多个视频生成基准测试中进行的广泛评估证明了我们方法的有效性,为高效DiT推理设立了新标准。我们将发布所有代码和模型以促进进一步研究。
abstract_en: Recently, Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have emerged as a dominant architecture in video generation, surpassing U-Net-based models in terms of performance. However, the enhanced capabilities of DiTs come with significant drawbacks, including increased computational and memory costs, which hinder their deployment on resource-constrained devices. Current acceleration techniques, such as quantization and cache mechanism, offer limited speedup and are often applied in isolation, failing to fully address the complexities of DiT architectures. In this paper, we propose QuantCache, a novel training-free inference acceleration framework that jointly optimizes hierarchical latent caching, adaptive importance-guided quantization, and structural redundancy-aware pruning. QuantCache achieves an end-to-end latency speedup of 6.72x on Open-Sora with minimal loss in generation quality. Extensive evaluations across multiple video generation benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, setting a new standard for efficient DiT inference. We will release all code and models to facilitate further research.
authors: Junyi Wu, Zhiteng Li, Zheng Hui, Yulun Zhang, Linghe Kong, Xiaokang Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15035-15044

title: 量子神经网络:从光子到感知
title_en: Quanta Neural Networks: From Photons to Perception
abstract: 量子图像传感器可记录单个光子,从而实现接近完全黑暗环境下的成像和超高速视频拍摄等能力。然而,大多数关于量子传感器的研究仅限于恢复图像强度。我们能否超越单纯的成像,开发能够从量子传感器中提取高层场景信息的算法?这将为视觉系统开辟新的可能性,使其在极端条件下也能可靠运行。挑战在于,量子传感器捕获的原始光子流与传统图像具有本质上的不同特性,导致其与视觉模型不兼容。一种方法是首先将原始光子流转换为类似传统图像的图像,但这种方法在计算、内存和延迟方面成本过高。我们提出量子神经网络(QNNs),可直接从原始光子流生成下游任务目标。我们的核心提案是一种可训练的QNN层,能够无缝集成到现有的基于图像和视频的神经网络中,生成量子对应物。通过避免图像重建并基于场景自适应分配计算资源,QNNs在计算、延迟和读出带宽等所有效率指标上相比基于重建的量子视觉技术实现了1-2个数量级的提升,同时在低光和快速运动等广泛挑战性场景中保持高任务准确性。
abstract_en: Quanta image sensors record individual photons, enabling capabilities like imaging in near-complete darkness and ultra-high-speed videography. Yet, most research on quanta sensors is limited to recovering image intensities. Can we go beyond just imaging, and develop algorithms that can extract high-level scene information from quanta sensors? This could unlock new possibilities in vision systems, offering reliable operation in extreme conditions. The challenge: raw photon streams captured by quanta sensors have fundamentally different characteristics than conventional images, making them incompatible with vision models. One approach is to first transform raw photon streams to conventional-like images, but this is prohibitively expensive in terms of compute, memory, and latency. We propose quanta neural networks (QNNs) that directly produce downstream task objectives from raw photon streams. Our core proposal is a trainable QNN layer that can seamlessly integrate with existing image- and video-based neural networks, producing quanta counterparts. By avoiding image reconstruction and allocating computational resources on a scene-adaptive basis, QNNs achieve 1--2 orders of magnitude improvements across all efficiency metrics (compute, latency, readout bandwidth) as compared to reconstruction-based quanta vision, while maintaining high task accuracy across a wide gamut of challenging scenarios including low light and rapid motion.
authors: Varun Sundar, Tianyi Zhang, Sacha Jungerman, Mohit Gupta ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5091-5101

title: 量化与缩小未知领域:通过不确定性最小化的交互式文本到视频检索
title_en: Quantifying and Narrowing the Unknown: Interactive Text-to-Video Retrieval via Uncertainty Minimization
abstract: 尽管近期取得进展,文本到视频检索(TVR)仍受多种固有不确定性的制约,如模糊的文本查询、不明确的文本-视频映射以及低质量视频帧。虽然交互系统已出现通过澄清问题来细化用户意图以应对这些挑战,但现有方法通常依赖启发式或即兴策略,未明确量化这些不确定性,限制了其有效性。受此差距的启发,我们提出UMIVR,一种基于不确定性最小化的交互式文本到视频检索框架,通过原理性、无需训练的指标明确量化三种关键不确定性——文本模糊度、映射不确定性以及帧不确定性:基于语义熵的文本模糊度评分(TAS)、基于Jensen-Shannon散度的映射不确定性评分(MUS)以及基于时间质量的帧采样器(TQFS)。通过基于这些不确定性度量自适应生成针对性澄清问题,UMIVR迭代细化用户查询,显著降低检索模糊性。在多个基准数据集上的大量实验验证了UMIVR的有效性,在MSR-VTT-1k数据集上实现Recall@1(10轮交互后达69.2%)的显著提升,从而为交互式TVR建立了不确定性最小化基础。
abstract_en: Despite recent advances, Text-to-video retrieval (TVR) is still hindered by multiple inherent uncertainties, such as ambiguous textual queries, indistinct text-video mappings, and low-quality video frames. Although interactive systems have emerged to address these challenges by refining user intent through clarifying questions, current methods typically rely on heuristic or ad-hoc strategies without explicitly quantifying these uncertainties, limiting their effectiveness. Motivated by this gap, we propose UMIVR, an Uncertainty-Minimizing Interactive Text-to-Video Retrieval framework that explicitly quantifies three critical uncertainties-text ambiguity, mapping uncertainty, and frame uncertainty-via principled, training-free metrics: semantic entropy-based Text Ambiguity Score (TAS), Jensen-Shannon divergence-based Mapping Uncertainty Score (MUS), and a Temporal Quality-based Frame Sampler (TQFS). By adaptively generating targeted clarifying questions guided by these uncertainty measures, UMIVR iteratively refines user queries, significantly reducing retrieval ambiguity. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks validate UMIVR's effectiveness, achieving notable gains in Recall@1 (69.2% after 10 interactive rounds) on the MSR-VTT-1k dataset, thereby establishing an uncertainty-minimizing foundation for interactive TVR.
authors: Bingqing Zhang, Zhuo Cao, Heming Du, Yang Li, Xue Li, Jiajun Liu, Sen Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22120-22130

title: QuickSplat:通过学习高斯初始化实现快速三维表面重建
title_en: QuickSplat: Fast 3D Surface Reconstruction via Learned Gaussian Initialization
abstract: 表面重建是计算机视觉和图形学的基础,使三维建模、混合现实、机器人技术等应用成为可能。现有基于体积渲染的方法取得了有希望的结果,但基于每场景进行优化,导致优化过程缓慢,难以建模未观测或无纹理区域。我们引入QuickSplat,该方法通过学习数据驱动的先验,为大规模室内场景的二维高斯散射优化生成密集初始化。这为重建提供了强大的起点,加速了优化的收敛并改善了平面墙结构的几何形状。我们进一步学习在每次迭代中联合估计场景参数的密集化和更新;所提出的密集化网络基于现有高斯的渲染梯度预测新高斯,消除了对密集化启发式方法的需求。在大规模室内场景重建的广泛实验中,我们的数据驱动优化方法表现出优越性。具体而言,我们将运行时间加速了8倍,同时与最先进方法相比,深度误差减少了48%。
abstract_en: Surface reconstruction is fundamental to computer vision and graphics, enabling applications in 3D modeling, mixed reality, robotics, and more. Existing approaches based on volumetric rendering obtain promising results, but optimize on a per-scene basis, resulting in a slow optimization that can struggle to model under-observed or textureless regions. We introduce QuickSplat, which learns data-driven priors to generate dense initializations for 2D gaussian splatting optimization of large-scale indoor scenes. This provides a strong starting point for the reconstruction, which accelerates the convergence of the optimization and improves the geometry of flat wall structures. We further learn to jointly estimate the densification and update of the scene parameters during each iteration; our proposed densifier network predicts new Gaussians based on the rendering gradients of existing ones, removing the needs of heuristics for densification. Extensive experiments on large-scale indoor scene reconstruction demonstrate the superiority of our data-driven optimization. Concretely, we accelerate runtime by 8x, while decreasing depth errors by 48% in comparison to state of the art methods.
authors: Yueh-Cheng Liu, Lukas Höllein, Matthias Nießner, Angela Dai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27851-27861

title: R-LiViT: 一种面向弱势道路使用者的激光雷达-视觉-热成像路边感知数据集
title_en: R-LiViT: A LiDAR-Visual-Thermal Dataset Enabling Vulnerable Road User Focused Roadside Perception
abstract: 在自动驾驶领域,整合路边感知系统对于克服遮挡挑战和提升弱势道路使用者(VRUs)的安全性至关重要。尽管激光雷达和视觉(RGB)传感器被广泛使用,但热成像在数据集中仍处于代表性不足的状态,尽管其在极端光照条件下对VRU检测具有公认的优越性。本文提出R-LiViT,这是首个从路边视角融合激光雷达、RGB和热成像的数据集,重点关注弱势道路使用者。R-LiViT在白天和夜间分别记录了三个交叉路口,确保数据集的多样性。该数据集包含150种交通场景下的10,000帧激光雷达数据和2,400组在时间和空间上对齐的RGB与热成像图像,分别包含7和8个标注类别,为目标检测与跟踪等任务提供了全面的资源。数据集及复现评估结果的代码已公开获取。
abstract_en: In autonomous driving, the integration of roadside perception systems is essential for overcoming occlusion challenges and enhancing the safety of vulnerable road users (VRUs). While LiDAR and visual (RGB) sensors are commonly used, thermal imaging remains underrepresented in datasets, despite its acknowledged advantages for VRU detection in extreme lighting conditions. In this paper, we present R-LiViT, the first dataset to combine LiDAR, RGB, and thermal imaging from a roadside perspective, with a strong focus on VRUs. R-LiViT captures three intersections during both day and night, ensuring a diverse dataset.It includes 10,000 LiDAR frames and 2,400 temporally and spatially aligned RGB and thermal images across 150 traffic scenarios, with 7 and 8 annotated classes respectively, providing a comprehensive resource for tasks such as object detection and tracking.The dataset and the code for reproducing our evaluation results are made publicly available.
authors: Jonas Mirlach, Lei Wan, Andreas Wiedholz, Hannan Ejaz Keen, Andreas Eich ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28375-28384

title: R1-Onevision:通过跨模态形式化推进通用多模态推理
title_en: R1-Onevision: Advancing Generalized Multimodal Reasoning through Cross-Modal Formalization
abstract: 大语言模型在复杂文本任务中展现出显著的推理能力。然而,需要整合视觉与文本信息的多模态推理仍是一个重大挑战。现有视觉-语言模型在有效分析和推理视觉内容方面存在困难,导致在复杂推理任务中表现欠佳。此外,缺乏全面的基准测试阻碍了对多模态推理能力的准确评估。本文提出R1-Onevision,一种旨在弥合视觉感知与深度推理之间鸿沟的多模态推理模型。为此,我们提出了一种跨模态推理流程,将图像转化为形式化的文本表示,从而实现精确的语言推理。借助该流程,我们构建了R1-Onevision数据集,该数据集在多个领域提供了详细的分步多模态推理标注。我们进一步通过监督微调和强化学习开发R1-Onevision模型,以培养高级推理能力和稳健的泛化能力。为全面评估不同层次的多模态推理性能,我们引入了R1-Onevision-Bench基准测试,该基准与人类教育阶段对齐,涵盖从小学到大学及更高层次的考试。实验结果表明,R1-Onevision在多个具有挑战性的多模态推理基准测试中均优于GPT-4o和Qwen2.5-VL等模型。代码、数据集和基准测试可在https://github.com/Fancy-MLLM/R1-Onevision获取
abstract_en: Large Language Models have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capability in complex textual tasks. However, multimodal reasoning, which requires integrating visual and textual information, remains a significant challenge. Existing visual-language models often struggle to effectively analyze and reason visual content, resulting in suboptimal performance on complex reasoning tasks. Moreover, the absence of comprehensive benchmarks hinders the accurate assessment of multimodal reasoning capabilities. In this paper, we introduce R1-Onevision, a multimodal reasoning model designed to bridge the gap between visual perception and deep reasoning. To achieve this, we propose a cross-modal reasoning pipeline that transforms images into formal textual representations, enabling precise language-based reasoning. Leveraging this pipeline, we construct the R1-Onevision dataset which provides detailed, step-by-step multimodal reasoning annotations across diverse domains. We further develop the R1-Onevision model through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to cultivate advanced reasoning and robust generalization abilities. To comprehensively evaluate multimodal reasoning performance across different grades, we introduce R1-Onevision-Bench, a benchmark aligned with human educational stages, covering exams from junior high school to university and beyond. Experimental results show that R1-Onevision achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming models such as GPT-4o and Qwen2.5-VL on multiple challenging multimodal reasoning benchmarks. Code, dataset and benchmark are available at https://github.com/Fancy-MLLM/R1-Onevision
authors: Yi Yang, Xiaoxuan He, Hongkun Pan, Xiyan Jiang, Yan Deng, Xingtao Yang, Haoyu Lu, Dacheng Yin, Fengyun Rao, Minfeng Zhu, Bo Zhang, Wei Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2376-2385

title: R1-VL:通过分步组相对策略优化实现多模态大语言模型的推理学习
title_en: R1-VL: Learning to Reason with Multimodal Large Language Models via Step-wise Group Relative Policy Optimization
abstract: 近期研究通常通过在高质量思维链推理数据上进行监督微调来增强多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)的推理能力,这往往使模型仅模仿成功的推理路径,而无法理解错误推理路径的性质。在本工作中,我们旨在超越被动模仿正向推理路径,增强MLLMs的推理能力。为此,我们设计了分步组相对策略优化(StepGRPO),这是一种新的在线强化学习框架,通过简单、有效且密集的分步奖励机制,使MLLMs能够自我提升推理能力。具体而言,StepGRPO引入了两种新颖的基于规则的推理奖励:分步推理准确率奖励(StepRAR)和分步推理有效性奖励(StepRVR)。StepRAR通过软键步匹配技术奖励包含必要中间推理步骤的推理路径,而StepRVR则通过推理完整性与逻辑评估策略奖励遵循结构良好且逻辑一致推理过程的路径。通过提出的分步奖励机制,我们引入了R1-VL,这是一系列在逐步推理方面具有卓越能力的MLLMs。在8个基准测试上的大量实验验证了所提出StepGRPO的优越性。
abstract_en: Recent studies generally enhance MLLMs' reasoning capabilities via supervised fine-tuning on high-quality chain-of-thought reasoning data, which often leads models to merely imitate successful reasoning paths without understanding what the wrong reasoning paths are.In this work, we aim to enhance the MLLMs' reasoning ability beyond passively imitating positive reasoning paths. To this end, we design Step-wise Group Relative Policy Optimization (StepGRPO), a new online reinforcement learning framework that enables MLLMs to self-improve reasoning ability via simple, effective and dense step-wise rewarding. Specifically, StepGRPO introduces two novel rule-based reasoning rewards: Step-wise Reasoning Accuracy Reward (StepRAR) and Step-wise Reasoning Validity Reward (StepRVR). StepRAR rewards the reasoning paths that contain necessary intermediate reasoning steps via a soft key-step matching technique, while StepRAR rewards reasoning paths that follow a well-structured and logically consistent reasoning process through a reasoning completeness and logic evaluation strategy. With the proposed step-wise reward mechanisms, we introduce R1-VL, a series of of MLLMs with outstanding capabilities in step-by-step reasoning. Extensive experiments over 8 benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of the proposed StepGRPO.
authors: Jingyi Zhang, Jiaxing Huang, Huanjin Yao, Shunyu Liu, Xikun Zhang, Shijian Lu, Dacheng Tao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1859-1869

title: RA-BUSSeg:基于相邻传播与跨层对齐的关系感知半监督乳腺超声图像分割
title_en: RA-BUSSeg: Relation-aware Semi-supervised Breast Ultrasound Image Segmentation via Adjacent Propagation and Cross-layer Alignment
abstract: 准确的乳腺超声(BUS)图像分割对于诊断和手术规划至关重要,但受限于标注图像数量较少而面临挑战。半监督方法通过利用伪标签缓解对大规模标注的依赖展现出潜力。然而,其性能高度依赖伪标签质量,而由于BUS图像固有的复杂性(如低对比度、杂波噪声和伪影)难以保证伪标签质量。先前研究主要聚焦于单方面优化伪标签或引入辅助监督,却忽视了利用图像中固有像素关系提升半监督分割鲁棒性的潜力。本文提出一种新型关系感知半监督模型用于BUS图像分割,包含两个创新模块:相邻关系传播(ARP)模块和跨层关系对齐(CRA)模块,全面探索像素关系以提升分割性能。ARP通过传播相邻像素关系强化相关像素的协同预测,增强模型对局部语义一致性的感知。CRA对齐跨层像素关系,利用深层引导修正浅层错误关联实现噪声抑制,同时融合多尺度上下文以实现不同尺寸病灶的鲁棒分割。在两个代表性BUS数据集上进行的大量实验表明,我们的方法在多种标注条件下均优于现有SOTA方法。代码已开源至https://github.com/dodooo1/RA-BUSSeg。
abstract_en: Accurate breast ultrasound (BUS) image segmentation is critical for diagnosis and surgical planning, but faces challenges due to limited labeled images. Semi-supervised methods show promise by leveraging pseudo-labels to mitigate reliance on large-scale annotations. However, their performance is highly dependent on the quality of pseudo-labels, which is difficult to guarantee in BUS images due to inherent complexities such as low contrast, speckle noise, and artifacts. Previous studies primarily focus on refining pseudo-labels in one way or the other, or introducing auxiliary supervision; yet they overlook the potential of harnessing intrinsic and inherent pixel relations to enhance the robustness of semi-supervised segmentation. In this paper, we present a novel relation-aware semi-supervised model for BUS image segmentation, which is composed of two innovative components: an adjacent relation propagation (ARP) module and a cross-layer relation alignment (CRA) module, for comprehensively explore pixel relations to improve segmentation performance. The ARP propagates relations among adjacent pixels to reinforce the collaborative prediction of correlated pixels and enhance the model's awareness of local semantic consistency. The CRA aligns cross-layer pixel relations, employing deep-layer guidance to rectify erroneous correlations in shallow layers for noise suppression, while integrating multi-scale contexts to enable robust segmentation of lesions with varying sizes. Extensive experiments on two representative BUS datasets under various labeling conditions demonstrate the superiority of our method to the SOTAs. Codes are available at https://github.com/dodooo1/RA-BUSSeg.
authors: Wanting Zhang, Zhenhui Ding, Guilian Chen, Huisi Wu, Jing Qin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21689-21698

title: RAGD:面向文本到图像生成的区域感知扩散模型
title_en: RAGD: Regional-Aware Diffusion Model for Text-to-Image Generation
abstract: 区域提示(或组合生成),通过实现细粒度的空间控制,因其在现实应用中的实用性而受到越来越多的关注。然而,先前方法要么引入额外的可训练模块,因而仅适用于特定模型,要么通过注意力掩码在注意力层内操作得分图,导致区域数量增加时控制力度受限。为解决这些局限性,我们提出RAGD,一种基于区域描述的区域感知文本到图像生成方法,用于精确布局组合。RAGD将多区域生成解耦为两个子任务:确保区域提示正确执行的个体区域构建(区域硬绑定),以及在区域间消除视觉边界并增强相邻交互的整体细节细化(区域软细化)。此外,RAGD创新性地实现了重绘功能,用户可在最后生成阶段修改特定不满意区域,而无需依赖额外的修复模型,同时保持其他区域不变。我们的方法无需微调,可作为提示后属性增强应用于其他框架。定量和定性实验表明,RAGD在属性绑定和物体关系方面均优于先前方法。
abstract_en: Regional prompting, or compositional generation, which enables fine-grained spatial control, has gained increasing attention for its practicality in real-world applications. However, previous methods either introduce additional trainable modules, thus only applicable to specific models, or manipulate on score maps within attention layers using attention masks, resulting in limited control strength when the number of regions increases. To handle these limitations, we present RAGD, a Regional-Aware text-to-image Generation method conditioned on regional descriptions for precise layout composition. RAGD decouples the multi-region generation into two sub-tasks, the construction of individual region (Regional Hard Binding) that ensures the regional prompt is properly executed, and the overall detail refinement (Regional Soft Refinement) over regions that dismiss the visual boundaries and enhance adjacent interactions. Furthermore, RAGD novelly makes repainting feasible, where users can modify specific unsatisfied regions in the last generation while keeping all other regions unchanged, without relying on additional inpainting models. Our approach is tuning-free and applicable to other frameworks as an enhancement to the prompt following property. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that RAGD achieves superior performance over attribute binding and object relationship than previous methods.
authors: Zhennan Chen, Yajie Li, Haofan Wang, Zhibo Chen, Zhengkai Jiang, Jun Li, Qian Wang, Jian Yang, Ying Tai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19331-19341

title: RAGDiffusion:通过外部知识融合实现忠实布料生成
title_en: RAGDiffusion: Faithful Cloth Generation via External Knowledge Assimilation
abstract: 标准服装资产生成涉及从多样化现实场景中提取服装信息,以恢复正面平铺式服装图像(背景清晰),但该任务面临显著挑战,因高度标准化的结构采样分布及复杂场景中服装语义的缺失。现有模型空间感知能力有限,常在高规格生成任务中出现结构幻觉和纹理扭曲。为解决此问题,我们提出一种新型检索增强生成(RAG)框架,命名为RAGDiffusion,通过融合语言模型和外部数据库的知识,提升结构确定性并缓解幻觉。RAGDiffusion包含两个过程:(1) 基于检索的结构聚合,采用对比学习和结构局部线性嵌入(SLLE)获取全局结构与空间地标,提供软硬双重引导以对抗结构歧义;(2) 全层级忠实服装生成,引入由粗到细的纹理对齐机制,确保扩散过程中图案与细节组件的保真度。在具有挑战性的现实数据集上的大量实验表明,RAGDiffusion能够生成结构与纹理均忠实的服装资产,性能显著提升,代表了利用RAG进行高规格忠实生成的开创性尝试,有效应对内在幻觉并提升保真度。
abstract_en: Standard clothing asset generation involves restoring forward-facing flat-lay garment images displayed on a clear background by extracting clothing information from diverse real-world contexts, which presents significant challenges due to highly standardized structure sampling distributions and clothing semantic absence in complex scenarios. Existing models have limited spatial perception, often exhibiting structural hallucinations and texture distortion in this high-specification generative task. To address this issue, we propose a novel Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework, termed RAGDiffusion, to enhance structure determinacy and mitigate hallucinations by assimilating knowledge from language models and external databases. RAGDiffusion consists of two processes: (1) Retrieval-based structure aggregation, which employs contrastive learning and a Structure Locally Linear Embedding (SLLE) to derive global structure and spatial landmarks, providing both soft and hard guidance to counteract structural ambiguities; and (2) Omni-level faithful garment generation, which introduces a coarse-to-fine texture alignment that ensures fidelity in pattern and detail components within the diffusing. Extensive experiments on challenging real-world datasets demonstrate that RAGDiffusion synthesizes structurally and texture-faithful clothing assets with significant performance improvements, representing a pioneering effort in high-specification faithful generation with RAG to confront intrinsic hallucinations and enhance fidelity.
authors: Yuhan Li, Xianfeng Tan, Wenxiang Shang, Yubo Wu, Jian Wang, Xuanhong Chen, Yi Zhang, Hangcheng Zhu, Bingbing Ni ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17485-17495

title: RAGNet:面向通用抓取的大规模基于推理的可操作性分割基准
title_en: RAGNet: Large-scale Reasoning-based Affordance Segmentation Benchmark towards General Grasping
abstract: 通用机器人抓取系统需要在遵循人类指令的多样化开放世界场景中准确感知物体可操作性。然而,当前研究面临缺乏基于推理的大规模可操作性预测数据的问题,这引发了对开放世界效果的严重担忧。为解决这一局限性,我们构建了一个面向抓取的大型可操作性分割基准RAGNet,其包含27.3万张图像、180类和2.6万个推理指令。图像覆盖野生、机器人、以自我为中心以及仿真等多样化具身数据域。这些图像经过精心标注包含可操作性图,同时通过移除类别名称仅提供功能描述来大幅增加语言指令的难度。此外,我们提出了一种全面的基于可操作性的抓取框架AffordanceNet,该框架由在大规模可操作性数据上预训练的视觉语言模型(VLM)和一个将可操作性图条件化以抓取目标的抓取网络组成。在可操作性分割基准和真实机器人操作任务上的大量实验表明,我们的模型具有强大的开放世界泛化能力。我们的数据和代码可通过此链接获取。
abstract_en: General robotic grasping systems require accurate object affordance perception in diverse open-world scenarios following human instructions. However, current studies suffer from the problem of lacking reasoning-based large-scale affordance prediction data, leading to considerable concern about open-world effectiveness. To address this limitation, we build a large-scale grasping-oriented affordance segmentation benchmark with human-like instructions, named RAGNet. It contains 273k images, 180 categories, and 26k reasoning instructions. The images cover diverse embodied data domains, such as wild, robot, ego-centric, and even simulation data. They are carefully annotated with an affordance map, while the difficulty of language instructions is largely increased by removing their category name and only providing functional descriptions. Furthermore, we propose a comprehensive affordance-based grasping framework, named AffordanceNet, which consists of a VLM pre-trained on our massive affordance data and a grasping network that conditions an affordance map to grasp the target. Extensive experiments on affordance segmentation benchmarks and real-robot manipulation tasks show that our model has a powerful open-world generalization ability. Our data and code is available at this link.
authors: Dongming Wu, Yanping Fu, Saike Huang, Yingfei Liu, Fan Jia, Nian Liu, Feng Dai, Tiancai Wang, Rao Muhammad Anwer, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Jianbing Shen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11980-11990

title: RALoc:通过旋转感知提升户外激光雷达定位
title_en: RALoc: Enhancing Outdoor LiDAR Localization via Rotation Awareness
abstract: 激光雷达定位是自动驾驶和机器人领域的基础任务。场景坐标回归(SCR)在基于学习的定位方法中展现出领先的姿态精度,取得了令人印象深刻的成果。我们观察到,从不同视角捕获的真实世界激光雷达扫描通常会导致SCR的灾难性崩溃。然而,现有的激光雷达定位方法在很大程度上忽视了SCR的旋转敏感性问题。在本文中,我们提出了RALoc,一种具有旋转感知的户外激光雷达定位方法,以实现精确的定位。我们的方法关键在于设计了一个点云规范化的模块,该模块利用强大的等变关键特征聚合,将输入激光雷达扫描转换为一致的方向,有效消除旋转的不利影响。该模块具有良好的可扩展性,可以无缝集成到现有的激光雷达定位网络中。此外,我们提出了双向激光雷达定位(BiLiLo)数据集作为基准,用于评估各种方法在具有显著旋转变化的大型户外场景中的性能。大量实验表明,RALoc在存在大旋转变化的场景中显著提升了定位性能,并在牛津雷达机器人汽车数据集中也取得了具有竞争力的性能。我们的代码和数据集将在接受后发布。
abstract_en: LiDAR localization is a fundamental task in autonomous driving and robotics. Scene Coordinate Regression (SCR) exhibits leading pose accuracy, achieving impressive results in learning-based localization. We observe that the real-world LiDAR scans captured from different viewpoints usually result in the catastrophic collapse of SCR. However, existing LiDAR localization methods have largely overlooked the issue of rotation sensitivity in SCR. In this paper, we present RALoc, an outdoor LiDAR localization method with rotation awareness to achieve accurate localization. The key to our approach is to design a Point Cloud Canonicalization module, which leverages a powerful equivariant key feature aggregation to transform the input LiDAR scan towards a consistent orientation, effectively eliminating the adverse effects of rotation. This proposed module has promising scalability and can be seamlessly integrated with the existing LiDAR localization network. Moreover, we propose the Bidirectional LiDAR Localization (BiLiLo) dataset as a benchmark to evaluate the performance of various methods in large outdoor scenes with significant rotation changes. Extensive experiments show that RALoc significantly improves localization performance in scenarios with large rotation changes, and also achieves competitive performance in the Oxford Radar RobotCar dataset. Our code and dataset will be released upon acceptance.
authors: Yuyang Yang, Wen Li, Sheng Ao, Qingshan Xu, Shangshu Yu, Yu Guo, Yin Zhou, Siqi Shen, Cheng Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3304-3313

title: RANKCLIP:排序一致的语言-图像预训练方法
title_en: RANKCLIP: Ranking-Consistent Language-Image Pretraining
abstract: 自监督对比学习模型(如CLIP)在许多下游任务中为视觉-语言模型设定了新的基准。然而,它们对刚性一对一映射的依赖忽视了文本与图像之间及内部复杂且常常多方面的关系。为此,我们引入了RankCLIP,一种新颖的预训练方法,超越了CLIP及其变体的刚性一对一匹配框架。通过将传统成对损失扩展为列表级,并利用模态内和跨模态的排序一致性,RankCLIP改进了对齐过程,使其能够捕捉各模态之间及内部的细微多对多关系。通过全面的实验,我们证明了RankCLIP在各种下游任务中的有效性,特别是在零样本分类任务中显著超越了最先进方法,突显了这种增强学习过程的重要性。
abstract_en: Self-supervised contrastive learning models, such as CLIP, have set new benchmarks for vision-language models in many downstream tasks. However, their dependency on rigid one-to-one mappings overlooks the complex and often multifaceted relationships between and within texts and images. To this end, we introduce RankCLIP, a novel pretraining method that extends beyond the rigid one-to-one matching framework of CLIP and its variants. By extending the traditional pair-wise loss to list-wise, and leveraging both in-modal and cross-modal ranking consistency, RankCLIP improves the alignment process, enabling it to capture the nuanced many-to-many relationships between and within each modality. Through comprehensive experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of RankCLIP in various downstream tasks, notably achieving significant gains in zero-shot classifications over state-of-the-art methods, underscoring the importance of this enhanced learning process.
authors: Yiming Zhang, Zhuokai Zhao, Zhaorun Chen, Zhili Feng, Zenghui Ding, Yining Sun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3874-3884

title: RARE: 通过零样本学习优化任意点云配准
title_en: RARE: Refine Any Registration of Pairwise Point Clouds via Zero-Shot Learning
abstract: 近期研究利用大规模预训练扩散模型,展示了利用扩散特征在图像中建立语义对应关系的潜力。受扩散技术进展启发,我们提出了一种新颖的零样本方法来优化点云配准算法。我们的方法通过深度图像中的对应关系增强点特征表示,无需专用训练数据集。具体而言,我们首先从多视角将点云投影到深度图中,并从预训练扩散网络中提取隐式知识作为深度扩散特征。这些特征随后与现有方法获得的几何特征结合,建立更精确的点云对应关系。通过利用这些优化的对应关系,我们的方法显著提升了配准精度。大量实验表明,我们的方法不仅提升了现有点云配准技术的性能,还在多样化数据集上展现出强大的泛化能力。代码可在 https://github.com/zhengcy-lambo/RARE.git 获取。
abstract_en: Recent research leveraging large-scale pretrained diffusion models has demonstrated the potential of using diffusion features to establish semantic correspondences in images. Inspired by advancements in diffusion-based techniques, we propose a novel zero-shot method for refining point cloud registration algorithms. Our approach leverages correspondences derived from depth images to enhance point feature representations, eliminating the need for a dedicated training dataset. Specifically, we first project the point cloud into depth maps from multiple perspectives and extract implicit knowledge from a pretrained diffusion network as depth diffusion features. These features are then integrated with geometric features obtained from existing methods to establish more accurate correspondences between point clouds. By leveraging these refined correspondences, our approach achieves significantly improved registration accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method not only enhances the performance of existing point cloud registration techniques but also exhibits robust generalization capabilities across diverse datasets. Codes are available a https://github.com/zhengcy-lambo/RARE.git.
authors: Chengyu Zheng, Jin Huang, Honghua Chen, Mingqiang Wei ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26549-26558

title: RCTDistill:基于时序融合的雷达-摄像头三维目标检测跨模态知识蒸馏框架
title_en: RCTDistill: Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation Framework for Radar-Camera 3D Object Detection with Temporal Fusion
abstract: 雷达-摄像头融合方法作为经济高效的三维目标检测方案已崭露头角,但其性能仍不及基于LiDAR的方法。近期研究主要聚焦于通过时序融合与知识蒸馏(KD)策略突破性能瓶颈。然而现有方法尚未充分考虑物体运动或雷达/摄像头模态固有误差带来的不确定性。本文提出RCTDistill,一种基于时序融合的新型跨模态知识蒸馏方法,包含三个核心模块:距离-方位知识蒸馏(RAKD)、时序知识蒸馏(TKD)和区域解耦知识蒸馏(RDKD)。RAKD通过考虑距离和方位方向的固有误差,实现从LiDAR特征到优化不准确BEV表示的有效知识迁移。TKD通过将历史雷达-摄像头BEV特征与LiDAR表示对齐,缓解动态物体导致的时序错位问题。RDKD通过蒸馏教师模型的关联知识增强特征判别能力,使学生模型更准确地区分前景与背景特征。RCTDistill在nuScenes和view-of-delft(VoD)数据集上均取得SOTA雷达-摄像头融合性能,推理速度达到26.2 FPS,为当前最快。
abstract_en: Radar-camera fusion methods have emerged as a cost-effective approach for 3D object detection but still lag behind LiDAR-based methods in performance. Recent works have focused on employing temporal fusion and Knowledge Distillation (KD) strategies to overcome these limitations. However, existing approaches have not sufficiently accounted for uncertainties arising from object motion or sensor-specific errors inherent in radar and camera modalities. In this work, we propose RCTDistill, a novel cross-modal KD method based on temporal fusion, comprising three key modules: Range-Azimuth Knowledge Distillation (RAKD), Temporal Knowledge Distillation (TKD), and Region-Decoupled Knowledge Distillation (RDKD). RAKD is designed to consider the inherent errors in the range and azimuth directions, enabling effective knowledge transfer from LiDAR features to refine inaccurate BEV representations. TKD mitigates temporal misalignment caused by dynamic objects by aligning historical radar-camera BEV features with LiDAR representations. RDKD enhances feature discrimination by distilling relational knowledge from the teacher model, allowing the student to understand better and differentiate foreground and background features. RCTDistill achieves state-of-the-art radar-camera fusion performance on both the nuScenes and view-of-delft (VoD) datasets, with the fastest inference speed of 26.2 FPS.
authors: Geonho Bang, Minjae Seong, Jisong Kim, Geunju Baek, Daye Oh, Junhyung Kim, Junho Koh, Jun Won Choi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25315-25324

title: REDUCIO! 基于极压缩运动潜变量的1K视频16秒生成
title_en: REDUCIO! Generating 1K Video within 16 Seconds using Extremely Compressed Motion Latents
abstract: 商业视频生成模型已展现出真实、高保真的结果,但仍受限于有限的访问权限。大规模应用的关键障碍之一是高昂的训练和推理成本。本文认为视频包含比图像显著更多的冗余信息,使其能够通过极少数运动潜变量进行编码。为此,我们设计了一种图像条件变分自编码器(VAE),将视频投影到极压缩的潜在空间,并基于内容图像进行解码。这种魔法Reducio咒语相比常规2D VAE实现了64倍的潜变量缩减,而不会牺牲质量。基于Reducio-VAE,我们可以高效训练高分辨率视频生成的扩散模型。具体而言,我们采用两阶段生成范式,首先通过文本到图像生成获得条件图像,随后利用所提出的Reducio-DiT进行文本-图像到视频的生成。大量实验表明,我们的模型在评估中表现出色。更重要的是,我们的方法显著提升了视频LDMs的训练和推理效率。Reducio-DiT总训练时间为3.2K A100 GPU小时,单个A100 GPU可在15.5秒内生成16帧1024x1024的视频片段。代码已开源:https://github.com/microsoft/Reducio-VAE
abstract_en: Commercial video generation models have exhibited realistic, high-fidelity results but are still restricted to limited access.One crucial obstacle for large-scale applications is the expensive training and inference cost.In this paper, we argue that videos contain significantly more redundant information than images, allowing them to be encoded with very few motion latents.Towards this goal, we design an image-conditioned VAE that projects videos into extremely compressed latent space and decode them based on content images. This magic Reducio charm enables 64xreduction of latents compared to a common 2D VAE, without sacrificing the quality.Building upon Reducio-VAE, we can train diffusion models for high-resolution video generation efficiently. Specifically, we adopt a two-stage generation paradigm, first generating a condition image via text-to-image generation, followed by text-image-to-video generation with the proposed Reducio-DiT. Extensive experiments show that our model achieves strong performance in evaluation.More importantly, our method significantly boosts the training and inference efficiency of video LDMs. Reducio-DiT is trained in just 3.2K A100 GPU hours in total and can generate a 16-frame 1024x1024 video clip within 15.5 seconds on a single A100 GPU. Code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/Reducio-VAE.
authors: Rui Tian, Qi Dai, Jianmin Bao, Kai Qiu, Yifan Yang, Chong Luo, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19237-19247

title: REGEN: 基于(再)生成解码器的紧凑视频嵌入学习
title_en: REGEN: Learning Compact Video Embedding with (Re-)Generative Decoder
abstract: 我们提出了一种学习视频嵌入器的新视角用于生成建模:与其要求精确复现输入视频,有效的嵌入器应专注于合成视觉上合理的重建。这一放宽的标准在不损害下游生成模型质量的前提下,显著提升了压缩比。具体而言,我们提出用编码器-生成器框架替代传统编码器-解码器视频嵌入器,该框架采用扩散变换器(DiT)从紧凑的潜在空间合成缺失细节。在此过程中,我们开发了专用的潜在条件模块,以对编码视频潜在嵌入进行条件化。实验表明,我们的方法在编码-解码性能上优于现有最先进方法,尤其在压缩比增加时表现更优。为验证方法有效性,我们报告了视频嵌入器实现高达32倍的时间压缩比(比领先视频嵌入器高8倍)的结果,并验证了该超紧凑潜在空间在文本到视频生成中的鲁棒性,为潜在扩散模型的训练和推理提供了显著的效率提升。
abstract_en: We present a novel perspective on learning video embedders for generative modeling: rather than requiring an exact reproduction of an input video, an effective embedder should focus on synthesizing visually plausible reconstructions. This relaxed criterion enables substantial improvements in compression ratios without compromising the quality of downstream generative models. Specifically, we propose replacing the conventional encoder-decoder video embedder with an encoder-generator framework that employs a diffusion transformer (DiT) to synthesize missing details from a compact latent space. Therein, we develop a dedicated latent conditioning module to condition the DiT decoder on the encoded video latent embedding. Our experiments demonstrate that our approach enables superior encoding-decoding performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, particularly as the compression ratio increases. To demonstrate the efficacy of our approach, we report results from our video embedders achieving a temporal compression ratio of up to 32x (8x higher than leading video emebbders) and validate the robustness of this ultra-compact latent space for text-to-video generation, providing a significant efficiency boost in latent diffusion model training and inference.
authors: Yitian Zhang, Long Mai, Aniruddha Mahapatra, David Bourgin, Yicong Hong, Jonah Casebeer, Feng Liu, Yun Fu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18453-18462

title: REPA-E:解锁VAE用于潜在扩散变换器的端到端调优
title_en: REPA-E: Unlocking VAE for End-to-End Tuning of Latent Diffusion Transformers
abstract: 本文探讨了一个基本问题:"我们能否以端到端的方式同时训练潜在扩散模型和变分自编码器(VAE)分词器?" 传统深度学习智慧认为,当可能时,端到端训练通常更可取。然而,对于潜在扩散变换器,观察到使用标准扩散损失对VAE和扩散模型进行端到端训练是无效的,甚至导致最终性能下降。我们证明,尽管扩散损失无效,但通过表示对齐(REPA)损失可以解锁端到端训练——允许在训练过程中同时调优VAE和扩散模型。尽管其简单性,所提出的训练方法(REPA-E)表现出色;相比REPA和传统训练方法,分别将扩散模型训练速度提升了17倍和45倍。有趣的是,我们观察到使用REPA-E进行端到端调优还能提升VAE本身;从而改善潜在空间结构和下游生成性能。在最终性能方面,我们的方法设定了新的最先进水平;在ImageNet 256x256上,使用和不使用无分类器引导时分别实现了1.26和1.83的FID分数。代码可在https://end2end-diffusion.github.io获取。
abstract_en: In this paper we tackle a fundamental question: "Can we train latent diffusion models together with the variational auto-encoder (VAE) tokenizer in an end-to-end manner?" Traditional deep-learning wisdom dictates that end-to-end training is often preferable when possible. However, for latent diffusion transformers, it is observed that end-to-end training both VAE and diffusion-model using standard diffusion-loss is ineffective, even causing a degradation in final performance. We show that while diffusion loss is ineffective, end-to-end training can be unlocked through the representation-alignment (REPA) loss -- allowing both VAE and diffusion model to be jointly tuned during the training process. Despite its simplicity, the proposed training recipe (REPA-E) shows remarkable performance; speeding up diffusion model training by over 17x and 45x over REPA and vanilla training recipes, respectively. Interestingly, we observe that end-to-end tuning with REPA-E also improves the VAE itself; leading to improved latent space structure and downstream generation performance. In terms of final performance, our approach sets a new state-of-the-art; achieving FID of 1.26 and 1.83 with and without classifier-free guidance on ImageNet 256x256. Code is available at https://end2end-diffusion.github.io.
authors: Xingjian Leng, Jaskirat Singh, Yunzhong Hou, Zhenchang Xing, Saining Xie, Liang Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18262-18272

title: REPARO:基于可微3D布局对齐的组合式3D资产生成
title_en: REPARO: Compositional 3D Assets Generation with Differentiable 3D Layout Alignment
abstract: 传统图像到3D模型在处理包含多个物体的场景时,常因偏见和遮挡复杂性而面临挑战。为解决这一问题,我们提出REPARO,一种从单张图像生成组合式3D资产的新方法。REPARO采用两步流程:首先,通过现成的图像到3D模型从场景中提取单个物体并重建其3D网格;随后,利用可微渲染技术优化这些网格的布局,确保场景组合的连贯性。通过在可微渲染中集成基于最优传输的长程外观损失项和高层语义损失项,REPARO能够有效恢复3D资产的布局。所提方法显著提升了物体独立性、细节精度和整体场景连贯性。对多物体场景的广泛评估表明,我们的REPARO为从单张图像生成多物体3D场景提供了全面的解决方案。
abstract_en: Traditional image-to-3D models often struggle with scenes containing multipleobjects due to biases and occlusion complexities. To address this challenge, wepresent REPARO, a novel approach for compositional 3D asset generation fromsingle images. REPARO employs a two-step process: first, it extracts individualobjects from the scene and reconstructs their 3D meshes using off-the-shelf imageto-3D models; then, it optimizes the layout of these meshes through differentiablerendering techniques, ensuring coherent scene composition. By integrating optimaltransport-based long-range appearance loss term and high-level semantic loss termin the differentiable rendering, REPARO can effectively recover the layout of 3Dassets. The proposed method can significantly enhance object independence, detailaccuracy, and overall scene coherence. Extensive evaluation of multi-object scenesdemonstrates that our REPARO offers a comprehensive approach to address thecomplexities of multi-object 3D scene generation from single images.
authors: Haonan Han, Rui Yang, Huan Liao, Jiankai Xing, Zunnan Xu, Xiaoming Yu, Junwei Zha, Xiu Li, Wanhua Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25367-25377

title: RESCUE: 基于SDM联合角色的群体疏散模拟
title_en: RESCUE: Crowd Evacuation Simulation via Controlling SDM-United Characters
abstract: 群体疏散模拟对于提升公共安全至关重要,并被要求用于构建逼真的虚拟环境。当前主流的疏散模型忽视了疏散过程中复杂的行人行为,如行人碰撞、人际互动以及受地形类型或个体体型影响的行为差异。这导致无法准确模拟现实世界中人群的疏散过程。本文遵循人类大脑的感知-决策-运动(SDM)流程,提出一种实时三维群体疏散模拟框架,集成了三维自适应社会力模型(SFM)决策机制和个性化步态控制模块。该框架支持多智能体并行运动,适用于多种场景,具备动态群体感知能力。此外,我们引入了部件级力可视化技术以辅助疏散分析。实验结果表明,该框架支持疏散过程中每个智能体的动态轨迹规划和个性化行为,且兼容不规则地形。从视觉效果上看,我们的方法生成的疏散结果更加真实可信,为群体模拟提供了增强的洞察力。代码已开源,地址为http://cic.tju.edu.cn/faculty/likun/projects/RESCUE。
abstract_en: Crowd evacuation simulation is critical for enhancing public safety, and demanded for realistic virtual environments. Current mainstream evacuation models overlook the complex human behaviors that occur during evacuation, such as pedestrian collisions, interpersonal interactions, and variations in behavior influenced by terrain types or individual body shapes. This results in the failure to accurately simulate the escape of people in the real world. In this paper, aligned with the sensory-decision-motor (SDM) flow of the human brain, we propose a real-time 3D crowd evacuation simulation framework that integrates a 3D-adaptive SFM (Social Force Model) Decision Mechanism and a Personalized Gait Control Motor. This framework allows multiple agents to move in parallel and is suitable for various scenarios, with dynamic crowd awareness. Additionally, we introduce Part-level Force Visualization to assist in evacuation analysis. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework supports dynamic trajectory planning and personalized behavior for each agent throughout the evacuation process, and is compatible with uneven terrain. Visually, our method generates evacuation results that are more realistic and plausible, providing enhanced insights for crowd simulation. The code is available at http://cic.tju.edu.cn/faculty/likun/projects/RESCUE.
authors: Xiaolin Liu, Tianyi Zhou, Hongbo Kang, Jian Ma, Ziwen Wang, Jing Huang, Wenguo Weng, Yu-Kun Lai, Kun Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24955-24964

title: RGE-GS:基于扩散先验的奖励引导式扩展驾驶场景重建
title_en: RGE-GS: Reward-Guided Expansive Driving Scene Reconstruction via Diffusion Priors
abstract: 单次通过驾驶片段常导致道路结构扫描不完整,使场景扩展成为传感器模拟器有效回归驾驶动作的关键需求。尽管当代三维高斯点云(3DGS)技术已实现卓越的重建质量,但通过整合扩散先验的直接扩展常引入累积物理不一致性并降低训练效率。为解决这些局限性,我们提出RGE-GS,一种新型扩展重建框架,将基于扩散的生成与奖励引导的高斯集成相结合。RGE-GS框架包含两项关键创新:首先,我们提出奖励网络,通过学习在重建阶段前识别并优先处理一致生成模式,从而实现扩散输出的空间稳定性选择性保留;其次,在重建过程中,我们设计差异化训练策略,根据场景收敛指标自动调整高斯优化进度,相较基线方法实现更优收敛效果。对公开数据集的广泛评估表明,RGE-GS在重建质量上达到最先进水平。
abstract_en: A single-pass driving clip frequently results in incomplete scanning of the road structure, making reconstructed scene expanding a critical requirement for sensor simulators to effectively regress driving actions. Although contemporary 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) techniques achieve remarkable reconstruction quality, their direct extension through the integration of diffusion priors often introduces cumulative physical inconsistencies and compromises training efficiency. To address these limitations, we present RGE-GS, a novel expansive reconstruction framework that synergizes diffusion-based generation with reward-guided Gaussian integration. The RGE-GS framework incorporates two key innovations: First, we propose a reward network that learns to identify and prioritize consistently generated patterns prior to reconstruction phases, thereby enabling selective retention of diffusion outputs for spatial stability. Second, during the reconstruction process, we devise a differentiated training strategy that automatically adjust Gaussian optimization progress according to scene converge metrics, which achieving better convergence than baseline methods. Extensive evaluations of publicly available datasets demonstrate that RGE-GS achieves state-of-the-art performance in reconstruction quality.
authors: Sicong Du, Jiarun Liu, Qifeng Chen, Hao-Xiang Chen, Tai-Jiang Mu, Sheng Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25756-25764

title: RI3D: 基于修复与填充扩散先验的少样本高斯点云重建
title_en: RI3D: Few-Shot Gaussian Splatting With Repair and Inpainting Diffusion Priors
abstract: 本文提出RI3D,一种基于3DGS的新方法,利用扩散模型的力量,在稀疏输入图像集下重建高质量的新型视图。我们的核心贡献在于将视图合成过程分解为两个任务:重建可见区域和生成缺失区域,并引入两个个性化扩散模型,分别针对这两个任务。具体而言,一个模型("修复")以渲染图像为输入,预测对应的高质量图像,该图像作为伪真实图像约束优化过程。另一个模型("填充")主要关注生成未观测区域的细节。为有效整合这些模型,我们引入两阶段优化策略:第一阶段使用修复模型重建可见区域,第二阶段通过进一步优化确保连贯性,使用填充模型重建缺失区域。此外,我们通过结合3D一致性和平滑深度与高细节相对深度,提出一种新颖的高斯初始化方法来增强优化过程。实验表明,通过将过程分解为两个任务并分别使用修复和填充模型处理,我们在极端稀疏输入的多样化场景中,生成可见和缺失区域均具有详细纹理的结果,优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose RI3D, a novel 3DGS-based approach that harnesses the power of diffusion models to reconstruct high-quality novel views given a sparse set of input images. Our key contribution is separating the view synthesis process into two tasks of reconstructing visible regions and hallucinating missing regions, and introducing two personalized diffusion models, each tailored to one of these tasks. Specifically, one model ('repair') takes a rendered image as input and predicts the corresponding high-quality image, which in turn is used as a pseudo ground truth image to constrain the optimization. The other model ('inpainting') primarily focuses on hallucinating details in unobserved areas. To integrate these models effectively, we introduce a two-stage optimization strategy: the first stage reconstructs visible areas using the repair model, and the second stage reconstructs missing regions with the inpainting model while ensuring coherence through further optimization. Moreover, we augment the optimization with a novel Gaussian initialization method that obtains per-image depth by combining 3D-consistent and smooth depth with highly detailed relative depth. We demonstrate that by separating the process into two tasks and addressing them with the repair and inpainting models, we produce results with detailed textures in both visible and missing regions that outperform state-of-the-art approaches on a diverse set of scenes with extremely sparse inputs.
authors: Avinash Paliwal, Xilong Zhou, Wei Ye, Jinhui Xiong, Rakesh Ranjan, Nima Khademi Kalantari ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25094-25103

title: RIOcc:一种用于三维语义占用预测的高效跨模态融合变压器协同特征优化方法
title_en: RIOcc: Efficient Cross-Modal Fusion Transformer with Collaborative Feature Refinement for 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction
abstract: 多模态三维语义占用任务为场景理解提供了全面视角,在自动驾驶领域受到广泛关注。然而现有方法主要聚焦于处理大规模体素,导致高计算成本并丢失细节信息。此外,它们难以准确捕捉被遮挡目标和远距离信息。本文提出了一种新型LiDAR-相机三维语义占用预测框架RIOcc,采用协同特征优化与多尺度跨模态融合变压器。具体而言,RIOcc将多模态数据编码至统一的鸟瞰图(BEV)空间,降低计算复杂度并提升特征对齐效率。随后,多尺度特征处理显著扩展了感受野。同时,在LiDAR分支中设计双分支池化(DBP)模块,自适应增强通道与网格维度的几何特征。在相机分支中开发小波与语义编码器,提取富含边缘与结构信息的高层语义特征。最后,为促进有效跨模态互补性,设计可变形双注意力(DDA)模块。大量实验表明,RIOcc在Occ3D-nuScenes和nuScenes-Occupancy数据集上分别取得54.2 mIoU和25.9 mIoU的SOTA性能。
abstract_en: The multi-modal 3D semantic occupancy task provides a comprehensive understanding of the scene and has received considerable attention in the field of autonomous driving. However, existing methods mainly focus on processing large-scale voxels, which bring high computational costs and degrade details. Additionally, they struggle to accurately capture occluded targets and distant information. In this paper, we propose a novel LiDAR-Camera 3D semantic occupancy prediction framework called RIOcc, with collaborative feature refinement and multi-scale cross-modal fusion transformer. Specifically, RIOcc encodes multi-modal data into a unified Bird's Eye View (BEV) space, which reduces computational complexity and enhances the efficiency of feature alignment. Then, multi-scale feature processing substantially expands the receptive fields. Meanwhile, in the LiDAR branch, we design the Dual-branch Pooling (DBP) to adaptively enhance geometric features across both the Channel and Grid dimensions. In the camera branch, the Wavelet and Semantic Encoders are developed to extract high-level semantic features with abundant edge and structural information. Finally, to facilitate effective cross-modal complementarity, we develop the Deformable Dual-Attention (DDA) module. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RIOcc achieves state-of-the-art performance, with 54.2 mIoU and 25.9 mIoU on the Occ3D-nuScenes and nuScenes-Occupancy datasets, respectively.
authors: Baojie Fan, Xiaotian Li, Yuhan Zhou, Yuyu Jiang, Jiandong Tian, Huijie Fan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25851-25861

title: RIPE: 基于无标签图像对的强化学习在鲁棒关键点提取中的应用
title_en: RIPE: Reinforcement Learning on Unlabeled Image Pairs for Robust Keypoint Extraction
abstract: 我们提出RIPE,一种创新的基于强化学习的框架,用于弱监督训练关键点提取器,该提取器在检测和描述任务中均表现出色。与传统依赖人工变换、预生成模型或3D数据的训练范式不同,RIPE仅需一个二元标签指示配对图像是否表示同一场景。这种最小监督显著扩展了训练数据池,使创建高度通用且鲁棒的关键点提取器成为可能。RIPE利用编码器的中间层,通过超列方法整合不同尺度的信息以描述关键点。此外,我们提出辅助损失函数以增强所学描述符的判别能力。在标准基准上的全面评估表明,RIPE简化了数据准备流程,同时在性能上与最先进方法竞争,标志着鲁棒关键点提取与描述领域的重要进展。代码和数据将用于研究目的。
abstract_en: We introduce RIPE, an innovative reinforcement learning-based framework for weakly-supervised training of a keypoint extractor that excels in both detection and description tasks. In contrast to conventional training regimes that depend heavily on artificial transformations, pre-generated models, or 3D data, RIPE requires only a binary label indicating whether paired images represent the same scene.This minimal supervision significantly expands the pool of training data, enabling the creation of a highly generalized and robust keypoint extractor. RIPE utilizes the encoder's intermediate layers for the description of the keypoints with a hyper-column approach to integrate information from different scales. Additionally, we propose a auxiliary loss to enhance the discriminative capability of the learned descriptors.Comprehensive evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate that RIPE simplifies data preparation while achieving competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art techniques, marking a significant advancement in robust keypoint extraction and description.Code and data will be made available for research purposes.
authors: Johannes Künzel, Anna Hilsmann, Peter Eisert ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4868-4877

title: RMultiplex200K:面向电信领域视觉语言模型的可靠多模态过程监督
title_en: RMultiplex200K: Toward Reliable Multimodal Process Supervision for Visual Language Models on Telecommunications
abstract: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)因其能够进行逐步推理的能力,在多个领域取得了显著成果。然而,电信(Telecom)领域的发展仍受到高质量数据集缺乏和领域特定见解不足的限制。本文提出RMultiplex200K,这是一个多模态数据集,旨在为现实世界电信问题提供逐步推理理由和正确性评分。这使VLMs能够利用多模态信息进行逐级推理和验证,从而实现可靠的问题解决。RMultiplex200K具有高度可扩展性,其构建无需人工标注,而是依赖于我们提出的基于自动计划的标注(ApPA)方法,该方法可自动合成带有奖励评分的推理步骤。借助该数据集,我们引入了TC-NAVIGATOR,这是一种新的机制,用于训练多模态过程奖励模型,作为VLMs的可靠推理验证器。例如,初始在实践电信问题上仅达到21.3%和19.8%准确率的Qwen-2-VL-72B和Llama-3.2-90B模型,在使用RMultiplex200K训练并经TC-NAVIGATOR验证后,准确率分别提升至48.5%和46.1%。
abstract_en: Visual Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable success in many domains due to their ability to perform step-by-step reasoning. However, progress in the telecommunication (Telecom) domain remains limited, primarily due to the lack of high-quality datasets and domain-specific insights. In this paper, we introduce RMultiplex200K, a multimodal dataset designed to present step-wise reasoning rationales and correctness scores for real-world Telecom questions. This enables VLMs to engage in step-level reasoning and verification using multimodal information, thereby facilitating reliable problem-solving. RMultiplex200K is highly scalable as it is constructed without human annotations, relying instead on our automatic plan-based annotation (ApPA) method, which automatically synthesizes reasoning steps labeled with reward scores. With this dataset, we introduce TC-NAVIGATOR, a new mechanism for training multimodal process reward models to serve as reliable reasoning verifiers for VLMs. For instance, the Qwen-2-VL-72B and Llama-3.2-90B models, which initially achieve only 21.3% and 19.8% respectively on practice Telecom questions, reached 48.5% and 46.1% accuracy, respectively, after training with RMultiplex200K and verifying with TC-NAVIGATOR.
authors: Sijia Chen, Bin Song ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1686-1696

title: ROADWork:面向工作区识别、观察、分析与驾驶的学习数据集与基准
title_en: ROADWork: A Dataset and Benchmark for Learning to Recognize, Observe, Analyze and Drive Through Work Zones
abstract: 感知并自主导航通过工作区是一项具有挑战性且研究不足的问题。针对这一长尾场景的公开数据集稀缺。我们提出ROADWork数据集,用于学习识别、观察、分析并驾驶通过工作区。最先进的基础模型在应用于工作区时表现不佳。在我们的数据集上微调模型显著提升了工作区的感知与导航能力。借助ROADWork,我们以更高的精度(+32.5%)和更高的效率(12.8倍)全球范围内发现更多工作区图像。开放词汇方法同样失效,而微调检测器性能提升(+32.2 AP)。视觉-语言模型(VLMs)难以描述工作区,但微调显著提升性能(+36.7 SPICE)。除微调外,我们展示了简单技术的价值。视频标签传播为实例分割带来额外增益(+2.6 AP)。在阅读工作区标志时,通过裁剪缩放组合检测器和文本定位器可提升性能(+14.2% 1-NED)。将工作区检测结果组合以提供上下文进一步减少VLMs的幻觉(+3.9 SPICE)。我们预测导航目标并从工作区视频中计算可行驶路径。融入道路施工语义确保53.6%的目标具有角度误差(AE)<0.5(+9.9%),75.3%的路径具有AE<0.5(+8.1%)。
abstract_en: Perceiving and autonomously navigating through work zones is a challenging and under-explored problem. Open datasets for this long-tailed scenario are scarce. We propose the ROADWork dataset to learn to recognize, observe, analyze, and drive through work zones. State-of-the-art foundation models fail when applied to work zones. Fine-tuning models on our dataset significantly improves perception and navigation in work zones. With ROADWork, we discover new work zone images with higher precision (+32.5%) at a much higher rate (12.8x) around the world. Open-vocabulary methods fail too, whereas fine-tuned detectors improve performance (+32.2 AP).Vision-Language Models (VLMs) struggle to describe work zones, but fine-tuning substantially improves performance (+36.7 SPICE). Beyond fine-tuning, we show the value of simple techniques. Video label propagation provides additional gains (+2.6 AP) for instance segmentation. While reading work zone signs, composing a detector and text spotter via crop-scaling improves performance (+14.2% 1-NED). Composing work zone detections to provide context further reduces hallucinations (+3.9 SPICE) in VLMs. We predict navigational goals and compute drivable paths from work zone videos. Incorporating road work semantics ensures 53.6% goals have angular error (AE) < 0.5 (+9.9%) and 75.3% pathways have AE < 0.5 (+8.1%).
authors: Anurag Ghosh, Shen Zheng, Robert Tamburo, Khiem Vuong, Juan Alvarez-Padilla, Hailiang Zhu, Michael Cardei, Nicholas Dunn, Christoph Mertz, Srinivasa G. Narasimhan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6132-6142

title: ROAR:减少生成图像水印中的反演误差
title_en: ROAR: Reducing Inversion Error in Generative Image Watermarking
abstract: 生成图像水印技术能够实现生成图像的主动检测和可追溯性。在现有方法中,基于反演的框架通过在扩散过程之前将水印注入潜在表示中,实现了高度隐蔽的水印嵌入。该方法的鲁棒性取决于嵌入机制和反演精度。然而,先前的研究主要集中在优化嵌入过程,而忽视了反演误差,这显著影响了提取保真度。在本文中,我们针对反演误差的挑战,提出ROAR,一种双域优化框架,旨在缓解来自两个关键来源的误差:1)潜在域误差,由于固有的近似假设,这些误差在反演步骤中累积;2)像素域误差,由JPEG压缩等信道失真引起。为解决这些问题,我们引入了两个新组件:基于再生的优化(RO)机制,通过可优化的起始潜在表示最小化潜在域误差;基于专家混合(MoE)的失真自适应恢复(AR)网络,有效从像素级失真中恢复水印分布。大量实验表明,ROAR显著减少了反演误差并增强了水印提取的鲁棒性,从而提高了生成图像水印的可靠性。
abstract_en: Generative image watermarking enables the proactive detection and traceability of generated images. Among existing methods, inversion-based frameworks achieve highly conceal ed watermark embedding by injecting watermarks into the latent representation before the diffusion process. The robustness of this approach hinges on both the embedding mechanism and inversion accuracy. However, prior works have predominantly focused on optimizing the embedding process while overlooking inversion errors, which significantly affect extraction fidelity. In this paper, we address the challenge of inversion errors and propose ROAR, a dual-domain optimization-based framework designed to mitigate errors arising from two key sources: 1) Latent-domain errors, which accumulate across inversion steps due to inherent approximation assumptions. 2) Pixel-domain errors, which result from channel distortions such as JPEG compression. To tackle these issues, we introduce two novel components: A Regeneration-based Optimization (RO) mechanism, which incorporates an optimizable starting latent to minimize latent-domain errors; A Mixture of Experts (MoE)-based distortion-adaptive restoration (AR) network, which effectively recovers watermarked distributions from pixel-level distortions.Extensive experiments demonstrate that ROAR significantly reduces inversion errors and enhances watermark extraction robustness, thereby improving the reliability of generative image watermarking.
authors: Hanyi Wang, Han Fang, Shi-Lin Wang, Ee-Chien Chang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19742-19751

title: ROVI:一种用于开放词汇实例关联文本到图像生成的VLM-LLM重描述数据集
title_en: ROVI: A VLM-LLM Re-Captioned Dataset for Open-Vocabulary Instance-Grounded Text-to-Image Generation
abstract: 我们提出了ROVI,一个高质量的合成数据集,用于实例关联的文本到图像生成,该数据集通过标注100万张精选网络图像创建。我们的关键创新是一种称为重描述的策略,专注于预检测阶段,其中VLM(视觉语言模型)生成全面的视觉描述,然后由LLM(大语言模型)处理,以提取开放词汇检测器(OVDs)可检测的平列表示的潜在类别。这种方法生成的全局提示固有地关联于实例注释,同时捕捉人类通常忽视的次要视觉元素。评估表明,ROVI在图像质量和分辨率方面超越了现有检测数据集,同时包含两个数量级更多的类别,具有开放词汇特性。为了示范目的,基于ROVI训练的文本到图像模型GLIGEN在实例定位准确性、提示保真度和美学质量方面显著优于最先进的替代方案。我们的数据集和可复现的流程可在https://github.com/CihangPeng/ROVI获取。
abstract_en: We present ROVI, a high-quality synthetic dataset for instance-grounded text-to-image generation, created by labeling 1M curated web images. Our key innovation is a strategy called re-captioning, focusing on the pre-detection stage, where a VLM (Vision-Language Model) generates comprehensive visual descriptions that are then processed by an LLM (Large Language Model) to extract a flat list of potential categories for OVDs (Open-Vocabulary Detectors) to detect. This approach yields a global prompt inherently linked to instance annotations while capturing secondary visual elements humans typically overlook. Evaluations show that ROVI exceeds existing detection datasets in image quality and resolution while containing two orders of magnitude more categories with an open-vocabulary nature. For demonstrative purposes, a text-to-image model GLIGEN trained on ROVI significantly outperforms state-of-the-art alternatives in instance grounding accuracy, prompt fidelity, and aesthetic quality. Our dataset and reproducible pipeline are available at https://github.com/CihangPeng/ROVI.
authors: Cihang Peng, Qiming Hou, Zhong Ren, Kun Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20204-20214

title: RS-vHeat:基于热传导的高效遥感基础模型
title_en: RS-vHeat: Heat Conduction Guided Efficient Remote Sensing Foundation Model
abstract: 遥感基础模型 largely break away from the traditional paradigm of designing task-specific models, offering greater scalability across multiple tasks. However, they face challenges such as low computational efficiency and limited interpretability, especially when dealing with large-scale remote sensing images. To overcome these, we draw inspiration from heat conduction, a physical process modeling local heat diffusion. Building on this idea, we are the first to explore the potential of using the parallel computing model of heat conduction to simulate the local region correlations in high-resolution remote sensing images, and introduce RS-vHeat, an efficient multi-modal remote sensing foundation model. Specifically, RS-vHeat 1) applies the Heat Conduction Operator (HCO) with a complexity of O(N^ 1.5 ) and a global receptive field, reducing computational overhead while capturing remote sensing object structure information to guide heat diffusion; 2) learns the frequency distribution representations of various scenes through a self-supervised strategy based on frequency domain hierarchical masking and multi-domain reconstruction; 3) significantly improves efficiency and performance over state-of-the-art techniques across 4 tasks and 10 datasets. Compared to attention-based remote sensing foundation models, we reduce memory usage by 84%, FLOPs by 24% and improves throughput by 2.7 times. The code will be made publicly available.
abstract_en: Remote sensing foundation models largely break away from the traditional paradigm of designing task-specific models, offering greater scalability across multiple tasks. However, they face challenges such as low computational efficiency and limited interpretability, especially when dealing with large-scale remote sensing images. To overcome these, we draw inspiration from heat conduction, a physical process modeling local heat diffusion. Building on this idea, we are the first to explore the potential of using the parallel computing model of heat conduction to simulate the local region correlations in high-resolution remote sensing images, and introduce RS-vHeat, an efficient multi-modal remote sensing foundation model. Specifically, RS-vHeat 1) applies the Heat Conduction Operator (HCO) with a complexity of O(N^ 1.5 ) and a global receptive field, reducing computational overhead while capturing remote sensing object structure information to guide heat diffusion; 2) learns the frequency distribution representations of various scenes through a self-supervised strategy based on frequency domain hierarchical masking and multi-domain reconstruction; 3) significantly improves efficiency and performance over state-of-the-art techniques across 4 tasks and 10 datasets. Compared to attention-based remote sensing foundation models, we reduce memory usage by 84%, FLOPs by 24% and improves throughput by 2.7 times. The code will be made publicly available.
authors: Huiyang Hu, Peijin Wang, Hanbo Bi, Boyuan Tong, Zhaozhi Wang, Wenhui Diao, Hao Chang, Yingchao Feng, Ziqi Zhang, Yaowei Wang, Qixiang Ye, Kun Fu, Xian Sun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9876-9887

title: RTMap:实时递归地图构建与变化检测及定位
title_en: RTMap: Real-Time Recursive Mapping with Change Detection and Localization
abstract: 尽管近期在线高精度地图构建方法缓解了离线管线的负担并解决了地图时效性问题,但仍受限于感知误差、密集交通中的遮挡问题以及无法融合多智能体观测数据。我们提出RTMap,通过持续众包多遍高精度地图作为自进化记忆,增强这些单次遍历方法。在车载智能体上,RTMap以端到端方式同时解决三个核心挑战:(1) 不确定性感知的高精度地图元素位置建模,(2) 基于众包先验地图的概率感知定位,(3) 可能道路结构变化的实时检测。在多个公开自动驾驶数据集上的实验验证了我们在先验辅助地图质量与定位精度方面的优异性能,证明了我们能够有效服务于下游预测与规划模块,同时异步逐步提升众包先验地图的准确性和时效性。我们的源代码将在https://github.com/CN-ADLab/RTMap公开。
abstract_en: While recent online HD mapping methods relieve burdened offline pipelines and solve map freshness, they remain limited by perceptual inaccuracies, occlusion in dense traffic, and an inability to fuse multi-agent observations. We propose RTMap to enhance these single-traversal methods by persistently crowdsourcing a multi-traversal HD map as a self-evolutional memory. On onboard agents, RTMap simultaneously addresses three core challenges in an end-to-end fashion: (1) Uncertainty-aware positional modeling for HD map elements, (2) probabilistic-aware localization w.r.t. the crowdsourced prior-map, and (3) real-time detection for possible road structural changes. Experiments on several public autonomous driving datasets demonstrate our solid performance on both the prior-aided map quality and the localization accuracy, demonstrating our effectiveness of robustly serving downstream prediction and planning modules while gradually improving the accuracy and freshness of the crowdsourced prior-map asynchronously. Our source-code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/CN-ADLab/RTMap.
authors: Yuheng Du, Sheng Yang, Lingxuan Wang, Zhenghua Hou, Chengying Cai, Zhitao Tan, Mingxia Chen, Shi-Sheng Huang, Qiang Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28021-28030

title: RadGPT:构建三维图像-文本肿瘤数据集
title_en: RadGPT: Constructing 3D Image-Text Tumor Datasets
abstract: CT扫描中识别出的癌症通常伴随详细的放射学报告,但公开可用的CT数据集往往缺乏这些关键报告。这种缺失限制了其在开发准确报告生成AI中的实用性。为解决这一差距,我们提出了AbdomenAtlas 3.0,这是首个公开的高质量腹部CT数据集,包含详细的专家审核放射学报告。所有报告均与逐体素掩码配对,描述肝脏、肾脏和胰腺肿瘤。AbdomenAtlas 3.0包含9,262组CT、掩码和报告--其中3,955组包含肿瘤。这些CT扫描来自17个公开数据集。除了为这些数据集创建报告外,我们还将肿瘤掩码数量扩展了4.2倍,识别出3,011个新肿瘤病例。值得注意的是,AbdomenAtlas 3.0中的报告更加标准化,生成速度也快于传统人工报告。这些报告提供了肿瘤大小、位置、衰减程度和手术切除性等细节。这些报告由12名认证放射科医生使用我们提出的RadGPT框架生成,该框架将放射科医生修订的肿瘤分割掩码转换为结构化和叙述性报告。除了作为数据集创建工具,RadGPT还可以成为完全自动化的分割辅助报告生成方法。我们对这种方法和5个最先进的报告生成视觉-语言模型进行了基准测试。我们的结果表明,分割显著提高了AI生成报告中的肿瘤检测性能。
abstract_en: Cancers identified in CT scans are usually accompanied by detailed radiology reports, but publicly available CT datasets often lack these essential reports. This absence limits their usefulness for developing accurate report generation AI. To address this gap, we present AbdomenAtlas 3.0, the first public, high-quality abdominal CT dataset with detailed, expert-reviewed radiology reports. All reports are paired with per-voxel masks and they describe liver, kidney and pancreatic tumors. AbdomenAtlas 3.0 has 9,262 triplets of CT, mask and report--3,955 with tumors. These CT scans come from 17 public datasets. Besides creating the reports for these datasets, we expanded their number of tumor masks by 4.2x, identifying 3,011 new tumor cases. Notably, the reports in AbdomenAtlas 3.0 are more standardized, and generated faster than traditional human-made reports. They provide details like tumor size, location, attenuation and surgical resectability. These reports were created by 12 board-certified radiologists using our proposed RadGPT, a novel framework that converted radiologist-revised tumor segmentation masks into structured and narrative reports. Besides being a dataset creation tool, RadGPT can also become a fully-automatic, segmentation-assisted report generation method. We benchmarked this method and 5 state-of-the-art report generation vision-language models. Our results show that segmentation strongly improves tumor detection in AI-made reports.
authors: Pedro R.A.S. Bassi, Mehmet Can Yavuz, Ibrahim Ethem Hamamci, Sezgin Er, Xiaoxi Chen, Wenxuan Li, Bjoern Menze, Sergio Decherchi, Andrea Cavalli, Kang Wang, Yang Yang, Alan Yuille, Zongwei Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23720-23730

title: RadarSplat:面向自动驾驶场景的高保真数据合成与三维重建的雷达高斯点云技术
title_en: RadarSplat: Radar Gaussian Splatting for High-Fidelity Data Synthesis and 3D Reconstruction of Autonomous Driving Scenes
abstract: 高保真三维场景重建在自动驾驶中起着关键作用,它能够从现有数据集中生成新颖的数据。这使得可以模拟安全关键场景并增强训练数据集,而无需进一步的数据采集成本。尽管近期在辐射场方面的进展在使用相机和激光雷达进行三维重建和传感器数据合成方面显示出有希望的结果,但其在雷达领域的潜力仍 largely unexplored。雷达因其在雨、雾和雪等恶劣天气条件下的鲁棒性,在自动驾驶中至关重要,而光学传感器往往难以应对这些情况。尽管最先进的基于雷达的神经表示方法在三维驾驶场景重建中显示出前景,但在存在显著雷达噪声(包括接收器饱和和多路径反射)的场景中表现不佳。此外,它仅限于合成预处理、排除噪声的雷达图像,无法解决现实雷达数据合成的问题。为了解决这些局限性,本文提出RadarSplat,它将高斯点云与新颖的雷达噪声建模相结合,以实现现实雷达数据合成和增强的三维重建。与最先进的方法相比,RadarSplat在雷达图像合成(+3.4 PSNR / 2.6x SSIM)和几何重建(-40% RMSE / 1.5x Accuracy)方面均取得显著提升,证明了其在生成高保真雷达数据和场景重建方面的有效性。
abstract_en: High-fidelity 3D scene reconstruction plays a crucial role in autonomous driving by enabling novel data generation from existing datasets. This allows simulating safety-critical scenarios and augmenting training datasets without incurring further data collection costs. While recent advances in radiance fields have demonstrated promising results in 3D reconstruction and sensor data synthesis using cameras and LiDAR, their potential for radar remains largely unexplored.
