title_en: SAFER: Sharpness Aware layer-selective Finetuning for Enhanced Robustness in vision transformers
abstract: 视觉Transformer(ViTs)已成为先进计算机视觉应用和多模态基础模型的核心骨干网络。尽管具有诸多优势,ViTs仍对对抗性扰动高度敏感,其脆弱性与卷积神经网络(CNNs)相当甚至更甚。此外,ViTs庞大的参数量和复杂架构使其特别容易出现对抗性过拟合,往往同时损害干净数据和对抗样本的准确率。本文通过一种新颖的分层选择性微调方法SAFER缓解ViTs的对抗性过拟合问题。与优化整个模型不同,我们识别并选择性微调最易发生过拟合的小部分层,对这些层应用锐度感知最小化,同时冻结其余模型层。我们的方法在各类ViT架构和数据集上均显著提升干净数据和对抗样本的准确率。典型提升幅度约为5%,某些案例甚至可达20%。
abstract_en: Vision transformers (ViTs) have become essential backbones in advanced computer vision applications and multi-modal foundation models. Despite their strengths, ViTs remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, comparable to or even exceeding the vulnerability of convolutional neural networks (CNNs). Furthermore, the large parameter count and complex architecture of ViTs make them particularly prone to adversarial overfitting, often compromising both clean and adversarial accuracy. This paper mitigates adversarial overfitting in ViTs through a novel, layer-selective fine-tuning approach: SAFER. Instead of optimizing the entire model, we identify and selectively fine-tune a small subset of layers most susceptible to overfitting, applying sharpness-aware minimization to these layers while freezing the rest of the model. Our method consistently enhances both clean and adversarial accuracy over baseline approaches. Typical improvements are around 5%, with some cases achieving gains as high as 20% across various ViT architectures and datasets.
authors: Bhavna Gopal, Huanrui Yang, Mark Horton, Yiran Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3999-4008

title: SAFT: 从单目视频通过可微物理模拟从模板重建织物的形状与外观
title_en: SAFT: Shape and Appearance of Fabrics from Template via Differentiable Physical Simulations from Monocular Video
abstract: 三维动态场景的重建是计算机视觉领域中一项成熟但具有挑战性的任务。本文提出了一种新颖的方法,结合了三维几何重建与外观估计领域,用于基于物理的渲染,并展示了一个系统,该系统仅需单目RGB视频序列作为输入,即可同时完成织物的两项任务。为获得真实且高质量的变形与渲染效果,采用了织物几何的物理模拟与可微渲染技术。本文引入了两种新的正则化项,用于三维重建任务,通过解决单目视频中的深度歧义问题,提高了重建的合理性。与领域内最新方法相比,我们在三维重建中将误差降低了2.64倍,同时每场景的中等运行时间为30分钟。此外,优化的运动效果足够高质量,能够进行变形物体的外观估计,从该单目RGB视频中恢复出锐利的细节。
abstract_en: The reconstruction of three-dimensional dynamic scenes is a well-established yet challenging task within the domain of computer vision. In this paper, we propose a novel approach that combines the domains of 3D geometry reconstruction and appearance estimation for physically based rendering and present a system that is able to perform both tasks for fabrics, utilizing only a single monocular RGB video sequence as input. In order to obtain realistic and high-quality deformations and renderings, a physical simulation of the cloth geometry and differentiable rendering are employed. In this paper, we introduce two novel regularization terms for the 3D reconstruction task that improve the plausibility of the reconstruction by addressing the depth ambiguity problem in monocular video. In comparison with the most recent methods in the field, we have reduced the error in the 3D reconstruction by a factor of 2.64 while requiring a medium runtime of 30 min per scene. Furthermore, the optimized motion achieves sufficient quality to perform an appearance estimation of the deforming object, recovering sharp details from this single monocular RGB video.
authors: David Stotko, Reinhard Klein ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27660-27670

title: SAGI:语义对齐与不确定性引导的人工智能图像修复
title_en: SAGI: Semantically Aligned and Uncertainty Guided AI Image Inpainting
abstract: 生成式AI的最新进展使文本引导的图像修复——通过文本提示添加、移除或修改图像区域——变得广泛可用。然而,生成语义正确且逼真的图像通常需要精心设计的提示和通过评估生成内容的现实性进行迭代优化——这些任务通常由人类完成。为自动化生成过程,我们提出语义对齐与不确定性引导的人工智能图像修复(SAGI),这是一个模型无关的流程,从与人类感知紧密对齐的分布中采样提示,并评估生成内容,丢弃偏离该分布的实例。我们使用预训练的大语言模型和视觉-语言模型近似该分布。通过将此流程应用于多个最先进的图像修复模型,我们创建了SAGI数据集(SAGI-D),目前这是最大的、最多样化的AI生成图像修复数据集,包含超过95,000张修复图像及人工评估子集。实验表明,语义对齐显著提升了图像质量和美学效果,而不确定性引导有效识别了真实操作——在应用我们的流程后,人类区分修复图像与真实图像的准确率从74%降至35%。此外,使用SAGI-D训练多种图像取证方法,领域内检测性能平均提升37.4%,领域外泛化能力提升26.1%(按交并比计算),也证明了其在对抗生成式AI恶意利用方面的实用性。代码和数据集可在https://mever-team.github.io/SAGI/获取。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in generative AI have made text-guided image inpainting--adding, removing, or altering image regions using textual prompts--widely accessible. However, generating semantically correct photorealistic imagery, typically requires carefully-crafted prompts and iterative refinement by evaluating the realism of the generated content - tasks commonly performed by humans. To automate the generative process, we propose Semantically Aligned and Uncertainty Guided AI Image Inpainting (SAGI), a model-agnostic pipeline, to sample prompts from a distribution that closely aligns with human perception and to evaluate the generated content and discard instances that deviate from such a distribution, which we approximate using pretrained large language models and vision-language models. By applying this pipeline on multiple state-of-the-art inpainting models, we create the SAGI Dataset SAGI-D, currently the largest and most diverse dataset of AI-generated inpaintings, comprising over 95k inpainted images and a human-evaluated subset. Our experiments show that semantic alignment significantly improves image quality and aesthetics, while uncertainty guidance effectively identifies realistic manipulations -- human ability to distinguish inpainted images from real ones drops from 74% to 35% in terms of accuracy, after applying our pipeline. Moreover, using SAGI-D for training several image forensic approaches increases in-domain detection performance on average by 37.4% and out-of-domain generalization by 26.1% in terms of IoU, also demonstrating its utility in countering malicious exploitation of generative AI. Code and dataset are available at https://mever-team.github.io/SAGI/
authors: Paschalis Giakoumoglou, Dimitrios Karageorgiou, Symeon Papadopoulos, Panagiotis C. Petrantonakis ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16090-16101

title: SALAD——语义感知的逻辑异常检测
title_en: SALAD -- Semantics-Aware Logical Anomaly Detection
abstract: 近期表面异常检测方法在识别结构异常(如凹陷和划痕)方面表现出色,但在逻辑异常(如不规则或缺失的物体组件)检测上存在困难。当前性能最佳的逻辑异常检测方法依赖于聚合的预训练特征或手工制作的描述符(通常源自组合图),这些方法丢弃了空间和语义信息,导致性能欠佳。我们提出SALAD,一种语义感知的判别性逻辑异常检测方法,通过引入新提出的组合分支显式建模物体组合图的分布,从而学习重要的语义关系。此外,我们引入了一种无需手工标注标签或类别特定信息的新程序来提取组合图,与以往方法形成对比。通过有效建模组合图分布,SALAD在逻辑异常检测标准基准MVTec LOCO上显著超越现有方法,达到令人印象深刻的图像级AUROC为96.1%。代码:https://github.com/MaticFuc/SALAD
abstract_en: Recent surface anomaly detection methods excel at identifying structural anomalies, such as dents and scratches, but struggle with logical anomalies, such as irregular or missing object components. The best-performing logical anomaly detection approaches rely on aggregated pretrained features or handcrafted descriptors (most often derived from composition maps), which discard spatial and semantic information, leading to suboptimal performance. We propose SALAD, a semantics-aware discriminative logical anomaly detection method that incorporates a newly proposed composition branch to explicitly model the distribution of object composition maps, consequently learning important semantic relationships. Additionally, we introduce a novel procedure for extracting composition maps that requires no hand-made labels or category-specific information, in contrast to previous methods. By effectively modelling the composition map distribution, SALAD significantly improves upon state-of-the-art methods on the standard benchmark for logical anomaly detection, MVTec LOCO, achieving an impressive image-level AUROC of 96.1%. Code: https://github.com/MaticFuc/SALAD
authors: Matic Fučka, Vitjan Zavrtanik, Danijel Skočaj ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21843-21852

title: 对抗性单纯形复形引发的SAM编码器漏洞导致下游模型失效
title_en: SAM Encoder Breach by Adversarial Simplicial Complex Triggers Downstream Model Failures
abstract: 尽管Segment Anything Model(SAM)通过零样本能力革新了交互分割技术,其固有漏洞却构成单点风险,可能引发下游应用失效。因此,主动评估这些可迁移的漏洞至关重要。此前针对SAM的对抗攻击因跨域共性弱点探索不足,导致迁移性有限。为解决此问题,我们提出一种新型方法Vertex-Refining Simplicial Complex Attack(VeSCA),通过参数化单纯形复形显式表征SAM与下游模型间的共享脆弱区域,从而在对抗性强区域迭代顶点细化以识别此类复形。引入轻量级领域再适应策略,以最少参考数据桥接领域差异。值得注意的是,VeSCA仅利用SAM编码器,缓解过拟合问题,并通过随机单纯形复形采样生成一致的可迁移对抗样本。大量实验表明,VeSCA在五个领域特定数据集的三个下游模型类别中,性能较现有方法提升12.7%。我们的研究进一步揭示了SAM漏洞对下游模型的风险。
abstract_en: While the Segment Anything Model (SAM) transforms interactive segmentation with zero-shot abilities, its inherent vulnerabilities present a single-point risk, potentially leading to the failure of downstream applications. Proactively evaluating these transferable vulnerabilities is thus imperative. Prior adversarial attacks on SAM often present limited transferability due to insufficient exploration of common weakness across domains. To address this, we propose a novel method, Vertex-Refining Simplicial Complex Attack (VeSCA), generating transferable adversarial examples by explicitly characterizing the shared vulnerable regions between SAM and downstream models through a parametric simplicial complex. Our goal is to identify such complexes within adversarially potent regions by iterative vertex-wise refinement.A lightweight domain re-adaptation strategy is introduced to bridge domain divergence using minimal reference data. Notably, VeSCA leverages only the encoder of SAM, which mitigates overfitting issue, and generates consistently transferable adversarial examples by random simplicial complex sampling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VeSCA achieves performance improved by 12.7% compared to state-of-the-art methods across three downstream model categories across five domain-specific datasets. Our findings further highlight the downstream model risks posed by SAM's vulnerabilities.
authors: Yi Qin, Rui Wang, Tao Huang, Tong Xiao, Liping Jing ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10624-10634

title: SAM2Long: 无需训练的记忆树增强SAM 2用于长视频分割
title_en: SAM2Long: Enhancing SAM 2 for Long Video Segmentation with a Training-Free Memory Tree
abstract: 分割任何模型2(SAM 2)已成为图像和视频中对象分割的强大基础模型。SAM 2在视频分割中的关键设计是其记忆模块,该模块通过先前帧提示对象感知记忆以进行当前帧预测。然而,其贪心选择记忆设计存在"误差累积"问题,其中错误或遗漏的掩膜会级联影响后续帧的分割,限制了SAM 2在复杂长时视频中的性能。为此,我们引入SAM2Long,一种改进的无需训练视频对象分割策略,该策略考虑每帧的分割不确定性,并通过受限树搜索方式从多个分割路径中选择视频级最优结果。在实践中,我们在整个视频中保持固定数量的分割路径。对于每个帧,基于现有路径生成多个掩膜,创建多种候选分支。然后选择具有更高累计得分的相同固定数量分支作为下一帧的新路径。处理完最后一帧后,选择累计得分最高的路径作为最终分割结果。得益于其启发式搜索设计,SAM2Long对遮挡和对象重现具有鲁棒性,能够有效分割和跟踪复杂长时视频中的对象。无需进一步训练,SAM2Long在九个VOS基准和三个VOT基准上显著且一致地超越SAM 2。值得注意的是,SAM2Long在所有12次直接比较中平均提升3.7分,在SA-V和LVOS等长时视频对象分割基准上,J&F指标最高提升5.3分。代码已发布于https://github.com/Mark12Ding/SAM2Long。
abstract_en: The Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM 2) has emerged as a powerful foundation model for object segmentation in both images and videos. The crucial design of SAM 2 for video segmentation is its memory module, which prompts object-aware memories from previous frames for current frame prediction. However, its greedy-selection memory design suffers from the "error accumulation" problem, where an errored or missed mask will cascade and influence the segmentation of the subsequent frames, which limits the performance of SAM 2 toward complex long-term videos. To this end, we introduce SAM2Long, an improved training-free video object segmentation strategy, which considers the segmentation uncertainty within each frame and chooses the video-level optimal results from multiple segmentation pathways in a constrained tree search manner. In practice, we maintain a fixed number of segmentation pathways throughout the video. For each frame, multiple masks are proposed based on the existing pathways, creating various candidate branches. We then select the same fixed number of branches with higher cumulative scores as the new pathways for the next frame. After processing the final frame, the pathway with the highest cumulative score is chosen as the final segmentation result. Benefiting from its heuristic search design, SAM2Long is robust toward occlusions and object reappearances, and can effectively segment and track objects for complex long-term videos. Without further training, SAM2Long significantly and consistently outperforms SAM 2 on nine VOS benchmarks and three VOT benchmarks. Notably, SAM2Long achieves an average improvement of 3.7 points across all 12 direct comparisons, with gains of up to 5.3 points in J&F on long-term video object segmentation benchmarks such as SA-V and LVOS. The code is released at https://github.com/Mark12Ding/SAM2Long.
authors: Shuangrui Ding, Rui Qian, Xiaoyi Dong, Pan Zhang, Yuhang Zang, Yuhang Cao, Yuwei Guo, Dahua Lin, Jiaqi Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13614-13624

title: SAM4D:摄像头与激光雷达流中的任意分割
title_en: SAM4D: Segment Anything in Camera and LiDAR Streams
abstract: 我们提出SAM4D,一种用于摄像头与激光雷达流中可提示分割的多模态和时序基础模型。引入统一多模态位置编码(UMPE),在共享的三维空间中对齐摄像头与激光雷达特征,实现无缝的跨模态提示与交互。此外,我们提出运动感知的跨模态记忆注意力(MCMA),利用自运动补偿增强时间一致性与长时序特征检索,确保在动态变化的自动驾驶场景中实现稳健的分割。为避免标注瓶颈,我们开发了多模态自动化数据引擎,协同视频特征模型驱动的视频掩膜、时空四维重建和跨模态掩膜融合。该框架在构建的Waymo-4DSeg数据集上进行大量实验,生成的摄像头-激光雷达对齐伪标签速度比人工标注快多个数量级,同时保持点云表示中视频特征模型推导的语义保真度。实验结果验证了SAM4D强大的跨模态分割能力及其在数据标注中的巨大潜力。
abstract_en: We present SAM4D, a multi-modal and temporal foundation model designed for promptable segmentation across camera and LiDAR streams. Unified Multi-modal Positional Encoding (UMPE) is introduced to align camera and LiDAR features in a shared 3D space, enabling seamless cross-modal prompting and interaction. Additionally, we propose Motion-aware Cross-modal Memory Attention (MCMA), which leverages ego-motion compensation to enhance temporal consistency and long-horizon feature retrieval, ensuring robust segmentation across dynamically changing autonomous driving scenes. To avoid annotation bottlenecks, we develop a multi-modal automated data engine that synergizes VFM-driven video masklets, spatiotemporal 4D reconstruction, and cross-modal masklet fusion. This framework generates camera-LiDAR aligned pseudo-labels at a speed orders of magnitude faster than human annotation while preserving VFM-derived semantic fidelity in point cloud representations. We conduct extensive experiments on the constructed Waymo-4DSeg, which demonstrate the powerful cross-modal segmentation ability and great potential in data annotation of proposed SAM4D.
authors: Jianyun Xu, Song Wang, Ziqian Ni, Chunyong Hu, Sheng Yang, Jianke Zhu, Qiang Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28535-28545

title: SAME: 基于状态自适应专家混合模型的通用语言引导视觉导航学习
title_en: SAME: Learning Generic Language-Guided Visual Navigation with State-Adaptive Mixture of Experts
abstract: 学习指令引导的视觉导航学术领域可根据语言指令的粒度划分为高阶类别特定搜索与低阶语言引导导航,前者侧重于探索过程,而后者则专注于遵循详细的文本指令。尽管这些任务的侧重点不同,但其底层需求保持一致,包括指令解释、环境理解以及行动决策的推断。本文将多样化的导航任务整合至统一的通用框架——我们探讨了学习导航过程中共享通用知识与利用任务特定能力的核心难点,并提出了一种新型的状态自适应专家混合模型(SAME),该模型有效使代理能够基于不同粒度的语言指令和动态观测推断决策。借助SAME,我们展示了能够同时处理七项导航任务的多功能代理,其性能高度可比于专用任务代理。
abstract_en: The academic field of learning instruction-guided visual navigation can be generally categorized into high-level category-specific search and low-level language-guided navigation, depending on the granularity of language instruction, in which the former emphasizes the exploration process, while the latter concentrates on following detailed textual commands. Despite the differing focuses of these tasks, the underlying requirements of interpreting instructions, comprehending the surroundings, and inferring action decisions remain consistent. This paper consolidates diverse navigation tasks into a unified and generic framework -- we investigate the core difficulties of sharing general knowledge and exploiting task-specific capabilities in learning navigation and propose a novel State-Adaptive Mixture of Experts (SAME) model that effectively enables an agent to infer decisions based on different-granularity language and dynamic observations. Powered by SAME, we present a versatile agent capable of addressing seven navigation tasks simultaneously, achieving highly comparable performance to task-specific agents.
authors: Gengze Zhou, Yicong Hong, Zun Wang, Chongyang Zhao, Mohit Bansal, Qi Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7794-7807

title: SAMO:一种轻量级的锐度感知多任务优化方法,结合联合全局-局部扰动
title_en: SAMO: A Lightweight Sharpness-Aware Approach for Multi-Task Optimization with Joint Global-Local Perturbation
abstract: 多任务学习(MTL)使联合模型能够捕捉多个任务之间的共性,降低计算成本并提高数据效率。然而,MTL优化中的主要挑战是任务冲突,即任务梯度在方向或幅度上存在差异,限制了模型性能相较于单任务方法的表现。锐度感知最小化(SAM)在最小化任务损失的同时,还减少损失景观的锐度。我们的实证观察表明,SAM能有效缓解MTL中的任务冲突。受此启发,我们探索将SAM集成到MTL中,但面临两个关键挑战。一方面,平均损失梯度和个体任务梯度(称为全局和局部信息)均对SAM有贡献,但如何结合它们仍不明确。另一方面,直接计算每个任务梯度会引入显著的计算和内存开销。为解决这些挑战,我们提出SAMO,一种轻量级的**S**harpness-**A**ware **M**ulti-task **O**ptimization方法,利用联合全局-局部扰动。局部扰动仅通过前向传播近似计算,并通过逐层归一化以提高效率。在一系列多任务基准测试中,大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性和效率。
abstract_en: Multi-task learning (MTL) enables a joint model to capture commonalities across multiple tasks, reducing computation costs and improving data efficiency. However, a major challenge in MTL optimization is task conflicts, where the task gradients differ in direction or magnitude, limiting model performance compared to single-task counterparts. Sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) minimizes task loss while simultaneously reducing the sharpness of the loss landscape. Our empirical observations show that SAM effectively mitigates task conflicts in MTL. Motivated by these findings, we explore integrating SAM into MTL but face two key challenges. On one hand, both the average loss gradient and individual task gradients--referred to as global and local information--contribute to SAM, but how to combine them remains unclear. On the other hand, directly computing each task gradient introduces significant computational and memory overheads. To address these challenges, we propose SAMO, a lightweight **S**harpness-**A**ware **M**ulti-task **O**ptimization approach, that leverages a joint global-local perturbation. The local perturbations are approximated using only forward passes and are layerwise normalized to improve efficiency. Extensive experiments on a suite of multi-task benchmarks demonstrate both the effectiveness and efficiency of our method.
authors: Hao Ban, Gokul Ram Subramani, Kaiyi Ji ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 785-795

title: SAMPLE: 基于时序自适应多模态提示学习的语义对齐事件驱动开放词汇动作识别
title_en: SAMPLE: Semantic Alignment through Temporal-Adaptive Multimodal Prompt Learning for Event-Based Open-Vocabulary Action Recognition
abstract: 开放词汇动作识别(OVAR)将识别系统扩展至识别未见过的动作类别。尽管大规模视觉-语言模型(VLMs)如CLIP已在图像领域实现了OVAR,但其对事件数据的适应仍处于探索阶段。事件相机具有高时间分辨率和固有的隐私保护特性,适合捕捉细粒度运动动态。然而,利用事件数据进行OVAR面临挑战:1)弥合基于静态图像模型与事件流之间的领域差距;2)在开放词汇设置中保持预训练VLMs的泛化能力。本文提出SAMPLE,一种轻量级VLMs适配方法用于事件驱动动作识别,在监督学习与开放词汇性能间取得平衡。我们引入时序自适应多模态提示学习策略,包含:1)事件与文本分支的单模态提示以学习数据分布;2)事件-文本跨模态提示以实现表征空间对齐;3)时序自适应提示以建模事件数据中的时间依赖关系。大量实验表明,SAMPLE在全监督、少样本、基类到新类及零样本设置中均优于先前方法。值得注意的是,在零样本场景中,SAMPLE在SeAct、DVS128Gesture和PAF数据集上分别取得+15.46%、+29.76%和+23.79%的性能提升,且计算成本更低。我们的代码已开源于https://github.com/JingWang-self/SAMPLE。
abstract_en: Open-vocabulary action recognition (OVAR) extends recognition systems to identify unseen action categories. While large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) like CLIP have enabled OVAR in image domains, their adaptation to event data remains underexplored. Event cameras offer high temporal resolution and inherent privacy preservation, making them suitable for capturing fine-grained motion dynamics. However, leveraging event data for OVAR presents challenges: 1) bridging the domain gap between static image-based models and event streams, and 2) preserving the generalization capabilities of pretrained VLMs in open-vocabulary settings. In this paper, we propose SAMPLE, a lightweight adaptation of VLMs for event-based action recognition, balancing supervised and open-vocabulary performance. We introduce a Temporal-Adaptive Multimodal Prompt Learning strategy that can be divided into: 1) Unimodal prompt on both the event and text branches to learn the data distribution 2) Event-Text cross-modal prompt for representation space alignment 3) Temporal-Adaptive prompt to model temporal dependencies across event data. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that SAMPLE outperforms prior methods across fully supervised, few-shot, base-to-novel and zero-shot settings. Notably, in zero-shot scenarios, SAMPLE achieves gains of +15.46%, +29.76%, and +23.79% on SeAct, DVS128Gesture, and PAF respectively with less commute cost. Our codes are released at https://github.com/JingWang-self/SAMPLE.
authors: Jing Wang, Rui Zhao, Ruiqin Xiong, Xingtao Wang, Xiaopeng Fan, Tiejun Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14409-14419

title: SAMora: 通过层次化自监督预训练增强SAM用于医学图像
title_en: SAMora: Enhancing SAM through Hierarchical Self-Supervised Pre-Training for Medical Images
abstract: Segment Anything Model (SAM) 在医学图像分割中展现出巨大潜力,但其性能在仅有少量标注数据时受到限制,而医学数据中蕴含着大量被忽视的层次化信息。为解决这一局限,我们借鉴自监督学习方法,提出SAMora框架,通过在图像、图像块和像素层级应用互补的自监督学习目标,捕捉层次化的医学知识。为充分挖掘LoRAs中层次化知识的互补性,我们引入HL-Attn模块,该模块在融合多尺度特征的同时保持其独特特性。SAMora兼容多种SAM变体,包括SAM2、SAMed和H-SAM。在Synapse、LA和PROMISE12数据集上的实验结果表明,SAMora优于现有SAM变体,在少样本和全监督设置中均取得最先进性能,同时将微调轮数减少了90%。
abstract_en: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) has demonstrated significant potential in medical image segmentation, yet its performance is limited when only a small amount of labeled data is available, while there are abundance of valuable yet often overlooked hierarchical information inherent in medical data. To address this limitation, we draw inspiration from self-supervised learning and propose SAMora, an innovative framework that captures hierarchical medical knowledge by applying complementary self-supervised learning objectives at the image, patch, and pixel levels. To fully exploit the complementarity of hierarchical knowledge within LoRAs, we introduce HL-Attn, a hierarchical fusion module that integrates multi-scale features while maintaining their distinct characteristics. SAMora is compatible with various SAM variants, including SAM2, SAMed and H-SAM. Experimental results on the Synapse, LA, and PROMISE12 datasets demonstrate that SAMora outperforms existing SAM variants, achieving state-of-the-art performance in both few-shot and fully-supervised settings, while reducing fine-tuning epochs by 90%.
authors: Shuhang Chen, Hangjie Yuan, Pengwei Liu, Hanxue Gu, Tao Feng, Dong Ni ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21209-21219

title: SANA-Sprint:基于连续时间一致性蒸馏的一步扩散模型
title_en: SANA-Sprint: One-Step Diffusion with Continuous-Time Consistency Distillation
abstract: 本文提出SANA-Sprint,一种高效的扩散模型,用于超快速文本到图像(T2I)生成。SANA-Sprint基于预训练基础模型,并通过混合蒸馏技术,将推理步骤从20次大幅减少至1-4次。我们引入三项关键创新:(1) 提出一种无需训练的方法,将预训练流匹配模型转换为连续时间一致性蒸馏(sCM),消除从头训练的高昂成本,实现高训练效率。我们的混合蒸馏策略结合sCM与潜在对抗蒸馏(LADD):sCM确保与教师模型的对齐,而LADD提升单步生成保真度。(2) SANA-Sprint是统一的步长自适应模型,可在1-4步内实现高质量生成,消除步长特定训练,提升效率。(3) 我们将ControlNet集成到SANA-Sprint中,实现实时交互式图像生成,为用户交互提供即时视觉反馈。SANA-Sprint在速度-质量权衡中建立新的帕累托前沿,在仅1步时即达到7.59 FID和0.74 GenEval的最先进性能——优于FLUX-schnell(7.94 FID / 0.71 GenEval),且速度提升10倍(0.1s vs 1.1s on H100)。它在H100上实现1024x1024图像的0.1s(T2I)和0.25s(ControlNet)延迟,在RTX 4090上实现0.31s(T2I)的延迟,展现出卓越的效率和AI驱动消费级应用(AIPC)潜力。代码和预训练模型将开源。
abstract_en: This paper presents SANA-Sprint, an efficient diffusion model for ultra-fast text-to-image (T2I) generation. SANA-Sprint is built on a pre-trained foundation model and augmented with hybrid distillation, dramatically reducing inference steps from 20 to 1-4.We introduce three key innovations: (1) We propose a training-free approach that transforms a pre-trained flow-matching model for continuous-time consistency distillation (sCM), eliminating costly training from scratch and achieving high training efficiency. Our hybrid distillation strategy combines sCM with latent adversarial distillation (LADD): sCM ensures alignment with the teacher model, while LADD enhances single-step generation fidelity. (2) SANA-Sprint is a unified step-adaptive model that achieves high-quality generation in 1-4 steps, eliminating step-specific training and improving efficiency. (3) We integrate ControlNet with SANA-Sprint for real-time interactive image generation, enabling instant visual feedback for user interaction. SANA-Sprint establishes a new Pareto frontier in speed-quality tradeoffs, achieving state-of-the-art performance with 7.59 FID and 0.74 GenEval in just 1 step -- outperforming FLUX-schnell (7.94 FID / 0.71 GenEval) while being 10x faster (0.1s vs 1.1s on H100). It also achieves 0.1s (T2I) and 0.25s (ControlNet) latency for 1024x1024 images on H100, and 0.31s (T2I) on an RTX 4090, showcasing its exceptional efficiency and potential for AI-powered consumer applications (AIPC). Code and pre-trained models will be open-sourced.
authors: Junsong Chen, Shuchen Xue, Yuyang Zhao, Jincheng Yu, Sayak Paul, Junyu Chen, Han Cai, Song Han, Enze Xie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16185-16195

title: SAS:集成二维先验知识的任意三维场景分割
title_en: SAS: Segment Any 3D Scene with Integrated 2D Priors
abstract: 三维模型的开放词汇能力日益受到重视,因为传统方法在固定类别训练的模型无法识别复杂动态三维场景中的未见物体。本文提出了一种简单而有效的SAS方法,用于整合多个二维模型的开放词汇能力并迁移至三维领域。具体而言,我们首先提出基于文本的模型对齐方法,通过文本作为桥梁将不同二维模型映射到同一嵌入空间。随后,我们提出无标注的模型能力构建方法,利用扩散模型显式量化二维模型对不同类别的识别能力。在此基础上,根据构建的模型能力指导不同二维模型的点云特征融合。最后,通过特征蒸馏将集成的二维开放词汇能力迁移至三维领域。SAS在多个数据集(包括ScanNet v2、Matterport3D和nuScenes)上显著优于先前方法,其泛化能力在下游任务(如高斯分割和实例分割)中进一步得到验证。
abstract_en: The open vocabulary capability of 3D models is increasingly valued, as traditional methods with models trained with fixed categories fail to recognize unseen objects in complex dynamic 3D scenes. In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective approach, SAS, to integrate the open vocabulary capability of multiple 2D models and migrate it to 3D domain. Specifically, we first propose Model Alignment via Text to map different 2D models into the same embedding space using text as a bridge. Then, we propose Annotation-Free Model Capability Construction to explicitly quantify the 2D model's capability of recognizing different categories using diffusion models. Following this, point cloud features from different 2D models are fused with the guide of constructed model capabilities. Finally, the integrated 2D open vocabulary capability is transferred to 3D domain through feature distillation. SAS outperforms previous methods by a large margin across multiple datasets, including ScanNet v2, Matterport3D, and nuScenes, while its generalizability is further validated on downstream tasks, e.g., gaussian segmentation and instance segmentation.
authors: Zhuoyuan Li, Jiahao Lu, Jiacheng Deng, Hanzhi Chang, Lifan Wu, Yanzhe Liang, Tianzhu Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8306-8318

title: SAUCE:基于稀疏自编码器的视觉-语言模型选择性概念遗忘
title_en: SAUCE: Selective Concept Unlearning in Vision-Language Models with Sparse Autoencoders
abstract: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)的遗忘方法主要借鉴了大语言模型(LLMs)的技术,依赖于需要大量标注遗忘集的权重更新。此外,这些方法在粗粒度层面进行遗忘,往往导致过度遗忘并降低模型效用。为解决这一问题,我们引入了SAUCE,一种利用稀疏自编码器(SAEs)实现视觉-语言模型中细粒度和选择性概念遗忘的新方法。简要而言,SAUCE首先训练SAEs以捕捉高维、语义丰富的稀疏特征。随后,它识别与目标概念遗忘最相关的特征。在推理过程中,它选择性地修改这些特征以抑制特定概念,同时保留无关信息。我们在两个不同的VLMs(LLaVA-v1.5-7B和LLaMA-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct)上评估SAUCE,涵盖两类任务:具体概念遗忘(物体和运动场景)与抽象概念遗忘(情感、颜色和材料),共计60个概念。大量实验表明,SAUCE在遗忘质量上比最先进方法提升18.04%,同时保持相当的模型效用。此外,我们研究了SAUCE对常用对抗性攻击的鲁棒性、其在不同模型间的可迁移性以及其处理多个同时遗忘请求的可扩展性。我们的发现确立了SAUCE作为视觉-语言模型选择性概念遗忘的有效且可扩展解决方案。
abstract_en: Unlearning methods for vision-language models (VLMs) have primarily adapted techniques from large language models (LLMs), relying on weight updates that demand extensive annotated forget sets. Moreover, these methods perform unlearning at a coarse granularity, often leading to excessive forgetting and reduced model utility. To address this issue, we introduce SAUCE, a novel method that leverages sparse autoencoders (SAEs) for fine-grained and selective concept unlearning in VLMs. Briefly, SAUCE first trains SAEs to capture high-dimensional, semantically rich sparse features. It then identifies the features most relevant to the target concept for unlearning. During inference, it selectively modifies these features to suppress specific concepts while preserving unrelated information. We evaluate SAUCE on two distinct VLMs, LLaVA-v1.5-7B and LLaMA-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct, across two types of tasks: concrete concept unlearning (objects and sports scenes) and abstract concept unlearning (emotions, colors, and materials), encompassing a total of 60 concepts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAUCE outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 18.04% in unlearning quality while maintaining comparable model utility. Furthermore, we investigate SAUCE's robustness against widely used adversarial attacks, its transferability across models, and its scalability in handling multiple simultaneous unlearning requests. Our findings establish SAUCE as an effective and scalable solution for selective concept unlearning in VLMs.
authors: Jiahui Geng, Qing Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3023-3033

title: SC-Captioner:通过强化学习实现图像描述的自纠正改进
title_en: SC-Captioner: Improving Image Captioning with Self-Correction by Reinforcement Learning
abstract: 我们提出SC-Captioner,这是一种强化学习框架,能够使图像描述模型具备自纠正能力。我们的关键技术在于奖励函数的设计,以激励准确的描述修正。具体而言,通过场景图解析算法将预测描述和参考描述分解为对象、属性和关系集合。我们计算初始描述与自纠正描述集合的集合差,以识别新增和移除的元素。这些元素与参考集合进行匹配,计算准确修正的正确性奖励和错误添加/移除的惩罚,从而形成最终奖励。针对图像描述质量评估,我们提出一套从CAPTURE优化而来的指标,解决了其不完全精度评估和低效关系匹配的问题。此外,我们收集了一个细粒度标注的图像描述数据集RefinedCaps,包含来自COCO数据集的6.5K张多样化图像。实验表明,将SC-Captioner应用于大型视觉-语言模型可生成更优质的图像描述,显著优于直接偏好优化训练策略。
abstract_en: We propose SC-Captioner, a reinforcement learning framework that enables the self-correcting capability of image caption models. Our crucial technique lies in the design of the reward function to incentivize accurate caption corrections. Specifically, the predicted and reference captions are decomposed into object, attribute, and relation sets using scene-graph parsing algorithms. We calculate the set difference between sets of initial and self-corrected captions to identify added and removed elements. These elements are matched against the reference sets to calculate correctness bonuses for accurate refinements and mistake punishments for wrong additions and removals, thereby forming the final reward. For image caption quality assessment, we propose a set of metrics refined from CAPTURE that alleviate its incomplete precision evaluation and inefficient relation matching problems. Furthermore, we collect a fine-grained annotated image caption dataset, RefinedCaps, consisting of 6.5K diverse images from COCO dataset. Experiments show that applying SC-Captioner on large visual-language models can generate better image captions across various scenarios, significantly outperforming the direct preference optimization training strategy.
authors: Lin Zhang, Xianfang Zeng, Kangcong Li, Gang Yu, Tao Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23145-23155

title: SC-Lane:面向三维车道检测的坡度感知与一致的道路高度估计框架
title_en: SC-Lane: Slope-aware and Consistent Road Height Estimation Framework for 3D Lane Detection
abstract: 本文提出SC-Lane,一种面向三维车道检测的新型坡度感知与时序一致的高度图估计框架。与依赖固定坡度锚点的先前方法不同,SC-Lane自适应地融合坡度特异性高度特征,提升对多样道路几何结构的鲁棒性。为实现这一目标,我们提出坡度感知自适应特征模块,该模块从图像线索动态预测适当权重,将多坡度表示整合为统一的高度图。此外,高度一致性模块强制时序一致性,确保连续帧间稳定且准确的高度估计,这对于现实驾驶场景至关重要。为评估SC-Lane的有效性,我们采用三种标准化指标——平均绝对误差(MAE)、均方根误差(RMSE)和基于阈值的准确率,尽管这些指标在表面和深度估计中常见,但尚未被广泛用于道路高度评估。使用先前工作中引入的基于激光雷达的高度图数据集,我们在这些指标下对方法进行基准测试,从而建立未来比较的严格标准。在OpenLane基准上的大量实验表明,SC-Lane显著提升了高度估计和三维车道检测性能,以64.3%的F值达到最先进水平,明显优于现有方法。详细结果和演示视频请参见我们的项目页面:https://parkchaesong.github.io/sclane/
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce SC-Lane, a novel slope-aware and temporally consistent heightmap estimation framework for 3D lane detection. Unlike previous approaches that rely on fixed slope anchors, SC-Lane adaptively determines the fusion of slope-specific height features, improving robustness to diverse road geometries. To achieve this, we propose a Slope-Aware Adaptive Feature module that dynamically predicts the appropriate weights from image cues for integrating multi-slope representations into a unified heightmap. Additionally, a Height Consistency Module enforces temporal coherence, ensuring stable and accurate height estimation across consecutive frames, which is crucial for real-world driving scenarios. To evaluate the effectiveness of SC-Lane, we employ three standardized metrics-Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), and threshold-based accuracy-which, although common in surface and depth estimation, have been underutilized for road height assessment. Using the LiDAR-derived heightmap dataset introduced in prior work, we benchmark our method under these metrics, thereby establishing a rigorous standard for future comparisons. Extensive experiments on the OpenLane benchmark demonstrate that SC-Lane significantly improves both height estimation and 3D lane detection, achieving state-of-the-art performance with an F-score of 64.3%, outperforming existing methods by a notable margin. For detailed results and a demonstration video, please refer to our project page: https://parkchaesong.github.io/sclane/
authors: Chaesong Park, Eunbin Seo, Jihyeon Hwang, Jongwoo Lim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28407-28416

title: SCAN:面向数据效率的对比预训练自举方法
title_en: SCAN: Bootstrapping Contrastive Pre-training for Data Efficiency
abstract: 尽管对比预训练已被广泛应用,但其数据效率问题仍相对缺乏深入研究。现有方法通常依赖静态子集选择算法预先识别重要训练数据。然而,这种静态特性使其无法在预训练过程中动态跟踪数据效用,导致预训练模型效果欠佳。为解决这一挑战,本文提出了一种新颖的动态自举数据集修剪方法。该方法包含数据准备阶段的修剪操作和数据集突变操作,二者均经历迭代和动态更新。我们将该方法应用于两种主流对比预训练框架:CLIP和MoCo,分别代表视觉-语言领域和视觉中心领域。具体而言,我们在两个大规模图像-文本对数据集上分别预训练七种CLIP模型,在ImageNet数据集上预训练两种MoCo模型,共计获得16个预训练模型。在所有16个模型中,数据修剪率均为30-35%,与在完整数据集上训练的对应模型相比,其在各类下游数据集上的性能仅出现轻微下降(平均低于1%),且在多个基线模型上表现出显著优势。此外,该方法产生的副产品——预训练后原始数据集的子集——在下游任务表现上也显著优于其他静态子集选择方法。代码已开源至https://github.com/guoyang9/SCAN。
abstract_en: While contrastive pre-training is widely employed, its data efficiency problem has remained relatively under-explored thus far. Existing methods often rely on static coreset selection algorithms to pre-identify important data for training. However, this static nature renders them unable to dynamically track the data utility throughout pre-training, leading to subpar pre-trained models. To address this challenge, our paper introduces a novel dynamic bootstrapping dataset pruning method. It involves pruning data preparation followed by dataset mutation operations, both of which undergo iterative and dynamic updates. We apply this method to two prevalent contrastive pre-training frameworks: CLIP and MoCo, representing vision-language and vision-centric domains, respectively. In particular, we individually pre-train seven CLIP models on two large-scale image-text pair datasets, and two MoCo models on the ImageNet dataset, resulting in a total of 16 pre-trained models. With a data pruning rate of 30-35% across all 16 models, our method exhibits only marginal performance degradation (less than 1% on average) compared to corresponding models trained on the full dataset counterparts across various downstream datasets, and also surpasses several baselines with a large performance margin. Additionally, the byproduct from our method, i.e., coresets derived from the original datasets after pre-training, also demonstrates significant superiority in terms of downstream performance over other static coreset selection approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/guoyang9/SCAN.
authors: Yangyang Guo, Mohan Kankanhalli ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3662-3672

title: SCFlow:通过流模型隐式学习风格与内容解耦
title_en: SCFlow: Implicitly Learning Style and Content Disentanglement with Flow Models
abstract: 在视觉模型中显式解耦风格与内容仍具有挑战性,这是由于其语义重叠以及人类感知的主观性。现有方法通过生成或判别目标提出分离策略,但它们仍面临解耦交织概念的固有模糊性。相反,我们提出疑问:是否可以通过学习可逆地合并风格与内容,从而绕过显式解耦,使分离自然浮现?我们提出SCFlow,一种流匹配框架,学习交织与解耦表示之间的双向映射。我们的方法基于三个关键洞察:1)仅训练合并风格与内容,这一明确定义的任务,能够在无显式监督下实现可逆解耦;2)流匹配在任意分布上进行桥接,避免了扩散模型和归一化流的限制性高斯先验;3)整理了一个包含510,000个样本的合成数据集,通过系统化的风格-内容配对来模拟解耦。在可控生成任务之外,我们证明SCFlow在零样本设置下可泛化至ImageNet-1k和WikiArt,并取得具有竞争力的性能,表明解耦自然源自可逆合并过程。代码和数据集:https://github.com/CompVis/SCFlow
abstract_en: Explicitly disentangling style and content in vision models remains challenging due to their semantic overlap and the subjectivity of human perception. Existing methods propose separation through generative or discriminative objectives, but they still face the inherent ambiguity of disentangling intertwined concepts. Instead, we ask: Can we bypass explicit disentanglement by learning to merge style and content invertibly, allowing separation to emerge naturally? We propose SCFlow, a flow-matching framework that learns bidirectional mappings between entangled and disentangled representations. Our approach is built upon three key insights: 1) Training solely to merge style and content, a well-defined task, enables invertible disentanglement without explicit supervision; 2) flow matching bridges on arbitrary distributions, avoiding the restrictive Gaussian priors of diffusion models and normalizing flows; and 3) a synthetic dataset of 510,000 samples was curated to simulate disentanglement through systematic style-content pairing. Beyond controllable generation tasks, we demonstrate that SCFlow generalizes to ImageNet-1k and WikiArt in zero-shot settings and achieves competitive performance, highlighting that disentanglement naturally emerges from the invertible merging process. Code and dataset: https://github.com/CompVis/SCFlow
authors: Pingchuan Ma, Xiaopei Yang, Yusong Li, Ming Gui, Felix Krause, Johannes Schusterbauer, Björn Ommer ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14919-14929

title: SCORE:开放词汇遥感实例分割中的场景上下文重要性
title_en: SCORE: Scene Context Matters in Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Instance Segmentation
abstract: 现有大多数遥感实例分割方法均针对封闭词汇预测设计,限制了其识别新类别或跨数据集泛化的能力。这制约了其在多样化的地球观测场景中的适用性。为解决这一问题,我们引入开放词汇(OV)学习用于遥感实例分割。尽管当前OV分割模型在自然图像数据集上表现良好,但直接应用于遥感面临诸如多样化的地表景观、季节性变化以及航拍图像中存在小尺寸或模糊对象等挑战。为克服这些挑战,我们提出SCORE(Scene Context matters in Open-vocabulary REmote sensing instance segmentation),一个融合多粒度场景上下文(即区域上下文和全局上下文)的框架,以增强视觉和文本表征。具体而言,我们引入区域感知集成,通过区域上下文优化类别嵌入以提升目标可区分性。此外,我们提出全局上下文适应,通过遥感全局上下文丰富原始文本嵌入,构建更适应且表达力更强的分类器语言潜在空间。我们在多样化的数据集上建立了新的开放词汇遥感实例分割基准。实验结果表明,我们的方法实现了最先进的性能,为大规模、真实场景的地理空间分析提供了稳健的解决方案。我们的代码可在https://github.com/HuangShiqi128/SCORE获取。
abstract_en: Most existing remote sensing instance segmentation approaches are designed for close-vocabulary prediction, limiting their ability to recognize novel categories or generalize across datasets. This restricts their applicability in diverse Earth observation scenarios. To address this, we introduce open-vocabulary (OV) learning for remote sensing instance segmentation. While current OV segmentation models perform well on natural image datasets, their direct application to remote sensing faces challenges such as diverse landscapes, seasonal variations, and the presence of small or ambiguous objects in aerial imagery. To overcome these challenges, we propose SCORE (Scene Context matters in Open-vocabulary REmote sensing instance segmentation), a framework that integrates multi-granularity scene context, i.e., regional context and global context, to enhance both visual and textual representations. Specifically, we introduce Region-Aware Integration, which refines class embeddings with regional context to improve object distinguishability. Additionally, we propose Global Context Adaptation, which enriches naive text embeddings with remote sensing global context, creating a more adaptable and expressive linguistic latent space for the classifier. We establish new benchmarks for OV remote sensing instance segmentation across diverse datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that, our proposed method achieves SOTA performance, which provides a robust solution for large-scale, real-world geospatial analysis. Our code is available at https://github.com/HuangShiqi128/SCORE.
authors: Shiqi Huang, Shuting He, Huaiyuan Qin, Bihan Wen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12559-12569

title: SD2Actor:基于扩散嵌入的连续状态分解用于机器人操作
title_en: SD2Actor: Continuous State Decomposition via Diffusion Embeddings for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: 在连续状态空间中,基于语言条件的机器人操作仍面临挑战,主要困难在于将状态映射到目标动作。先前方法在有效建模物体状态方面存在局限,主要由于其依赖于执行模糊指令且缺乏显式状态信息。为此,我们提出SD^2Actor,一种零样本机器人操作框架,能够生成连续状态下的精确动作。具体而言,针对新颖指令,我们旨在生成遵循指令且精确的机器人操作动作。与耗时的优化和微调不同,我们的零样本方法可通过广泛平移和多变旋转的任意物体状态进行泛化。其核心在于量化训练集中的多个基础状态,并利用其组合优化扩散模型生成的目标动作。为获取新颖状态表示,我们首先利用大语言模型(LLMs)从指令中提取新颖状态,并将其分解为多个学习到的基础状态。随后,通过基础状态嵌入的线性组合生成新颖状态特征。此外,我们引入正交化损失约束状态嵌入空间,确保线性插值的有效性。实验表明,SD^2Actor在ARNOLD基准测试的多样化操作任务中优于现有最先进方法。此外,SD^2Actor可从有限的人类示范中有效学习可泛化的策略,在多种现实世界操作任务中实现 promising 准确性。
abstract_en: Language-conditioned robot manipulation in the continuous spectrum presents a persistent challenge due to the difficult of mapping states to target actions. Previous methods face limitations in effectively modeling object states, primarily due to their reliance on executing ambiguous instructions devoid of explicit state information. In response, we present SD^2Actor, a zero-shot robotic manipulation framework that possesses the capability to generate precise actions in continuous states. Specifically, given the novel instructions, we aim to generate instruction-following and accurate robot manipulation actions. Instead of time-consuming optimization and finetuning, our zero-shot method generalizes to any object state with a wide range of translations and versatile rotations. At its core, we quantify multiple base states in the training set and utilize their combination to refine the target action generated by the diffusion model. To obtain novel state representations, we initially employ LLMs to extract the novel state from the instruction and decompose it into multiple learned base states. We then employ the linear combination of base state embeddings to produce novel state features. Moreover, we introduce the orthogonalization loss to constrain the state embedding space, which ensures the validity of linear interpolation. Experiments demonstrate that SD^2Actor outperforms state-of-the-art methods across a diverse range of manipulation tasks in ARNOLD Benchmark. Moreover, SD^2Actor can effectively learn generalizable policies from a limited number of human demonstrations, achieving promising accuracy in a variety of real-world manipulation tasks.
authors: Jiayi Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13751-13760

title: SDFit: 通过单张图像拟合可变形有符号距离函数实现3D物体姿态与形状
title_en: SDFit: 3D Object Pose and Shape by Fitting a Morphable SDF to a Single Image
abstract: 从单张图像中恢复3D物体姿态与形状是一个具有挑战性且病态的问题。这主要是由于强(自)遮挡、深度歧义、类别内和类别间形状的巨大差异,以及自然图像缺乏3D真实标注。现有深度网络方法通常在合成数据集上训练以预测3D形状,因此在真实图像上往往难以泛化。此外,它们缺乏对噪声估计的显式反馈循环,并主要关注几何结构而未直接考虑像素对齐。为解决这些局限性,我们开发了一种新型的渲染与比较优化框架,称为SDFit。该框架有三个关键创新:首先,它使用一个学习得到的类别特定且可变形的有符号距离函数(mSDF)模型,通过迭代优化同时精炼3D姿态与形状。mSDF通过在有效形状流形上约束搜索空间来增强推理鲁棒性,同时允许任意形状拓扑。其次,SDFit通过利用基础模型对3D形状数据库进行高效检索,获取一个可能匹配图像的初始3D形状。第三,SDFit通过基础特征在图像与mSDF之间建立丰富的2D-3D对应关系来初始化姿态。我们在Pix3D、Pascal3D+和COMIC三个图像数据集上评估SDFit。SDFit在无遮挡图像和常见姿态上与SotA前馈网络表现相当,但对遮挡和罕见姿态具有独特鲁棒性。此外,它无需重新训练即可处理未见过的图像。因此,SDFit为在自然场景中泛化提供了新见解。代码可在https://anticdimi.github.io/sdfit获取。
abstract_en: Recovering 3D object pose and shape from a single image is a challenging and ill-posed problem. This is due to strong (self-)occlusions, depth ambiguities, the vast intra- and inter-class shape variance, and the lack of 3D ground truth for natural images. Existing deep-network methods are trained on synthetic datasets to predict 3D shapes, so they often struggle generalizing to real-world images. Moreover, they lack an explicit feedback loop for refining noisy estimates, and primarily focus on geometry without directly considering pixel alignment. To tackle these limitations, we develop a novel render-and-compare optimization framework, called SDFit. This has three key innovations: First, it uses a learned category-specific and morphable signed-distance-function (mSDF) model, and fits this to an image by iteratively refining both 3D pose and shape. The mSDF robustifies inference by constraining the search on the manifold of valid shapes, while allowing for arbitrary shape topologies. Second, SDFit retrieves an initial 3D shape that likely matches the image, by exploiting foundational models for efficient look-up into 3D shape databases. Third, SDFit initializes pose by establishing rich 2D-3D correspondences between the image and the mSDF through foundational features. We evaluate SDFit on three image datasets, i.e., Pix3D, Pascal3D+, and COMIC. SDFit performs on par with SotA feed-forward networks for unoccluded images and common poses, but is uniquely robust to occlusions and uncommon poses. Moreover, it requires no retraining for unseen images. Thus, SDFit contributes new insights for generalizing in the wild. Code is available at https://anticdimi.github.io/sdfit.
authors: Dimitrije Antić, Georgios Paschalidis, Shashank Tripathi, Theo Gevers, Sai Kumar Dwivedi, Dimitrios Tzionas ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9616-9626

title: SDFormer:基于视觉的三维语义场景补全:通过SAM辅助的双通道体素变换器
title_en: SDFormer: Vision-based 3D Semantic Scene Completion via SAM-assisted Dual-channel Voxel Transformer
abstract: 基于视觉的语义场景补全(SSC)能够从有限的2D图像中预测复杂的场景信息,这一技术已引起广泛关注。目前,SSC方法通常构建包含几何和语义信息的统一体素特征,导致被遮挡区域的不同深度位置共享相同的2D语义信息,从而产生模糊的语义分割。为解决这一问题,我们提出SDFormer,一种新型的SAM辅助双通道体素变换器框架用于SSC。我们基于任务的多目标性质进行任务解耦,并构建两个并行子网络:语义构建器(SC)和几何细化器(GR)。SC利用分割任何模型(SAM)从图像中可靠的可见语义信息构建密集的语义体素特征。GR准确预测深度位置,并通过SAM进一步调整语义输出。此外,我们设计了语义校准亲和力以增强SC中的语义感知变换。在GR中,形状段交互与可学习的掩码生成模块用于强调语义的空间位置,以获取细粒度的体素信息。在SemanticKITTI和SSCBench-KITTI-360数据集上的大量定性和定量实验结果表明,我们的方法优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Vision-based semantic scene completion (SSC) is able to predict complex scene information from limited 2D images, which has attracted widespread attention. Currently, SSC methods typically construct unified voxel features containing both geometry and semantics, which lead to different depth positions in occluded regions sharing the same 2D semantic information, resulting in ambiguous semantic segmentation. To address this problem, we propose SDFormer, a novel SAM-assisted Dual-channel Voxel Transformer framework for SSC. We uncouple the task based on its multi-objective nature and construct two parallel sub-networks: a semantic constructor (SC) and a geometric refiner (GR). The SC utilizes the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to construct dense semantic voxel features from reliable visible semantic information in the image. The GR accurately predicts depth positions and then further adjusts the semantic output by SAM. Additionally, we design a Semantic Calibration Affinity to enhance semantic-aware transformations in SC. Within the GR, Shape Segments Interactive and Learnable mask generation module to emphasize the spatial location of semantics to obtain fine-grained voxel information. Extensive qualitative and quantitative results on the SemanticKITTI and SSCBench-KITTI-360 datasets show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches.
authors: Yujie Xue, Huilong Pi, Jiapeng Zhang, Yunchuan Qin, Zhuo Tang, Kenli Li, Ruihui Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26837-26847

title: SDMatte:用于交互式抠图的扩散模型嫁接方法
title_en: SDMatte: Grafting Diffusion Models for Interactive Matting
abstract: 近期交互式抠图方法在捕捉物体主要区域方面表现出色,但在边缘区域提取细粒度细节方面仍存在不足。在数十亿张图像-文本对上训练的扩散模型展现出卓越的复杂数据分布建模能力和真实纹理细节合成能力,同时具备强大的文本驱动交互能力,使其成为交互式抠图的有吸引力解决方案。为此,我们提出SDMatte,一种基于扩散模型的交互式抠图方法,具有三个关键贡献。首先,我们利用扩散模型中预训练U-Net的强大先验知识,将文本驱动交互机制转化为视觉提示驱动交互机制,实现交互式抠图。其次,我们将视觉提示的坐标嵌入与物体的透明度嵌入集成到U-Net中,增强SDMatte对空间位置信息和透明度信息的敏感性。第三,我们提出一种掩码自注意力机制和视觉提示驱动交互机制,使模型能够聚焦于视觉提示指定的区域,从而获得更优性能。在多个数据集上的大量实验验证了我们方法的优越性能,证明其在交互式抠图中的有效性。代码将公开发布。
abstract_en: Recent interactive matting methods have demonstrated satisfactory performance in capturing the primary regions of objects, but they fall short in extracting fine-grained details in edge regions. Diffusion models trained on billions of image-text pairs, demonstrate exceptional capability in modeling highly complex data distributions and synthesizing realistic texture details, while exhibiting robust text-driven interaction capabilities, making them an attractive solution for interactive matting. To this end, we propose SDMatte, a diffusion-driven interactive matting model, with three key contributions. First, we exploit the powerful priors of the pre-trained U-Net within diffusion models and transform the text-driven interaction mechanism into a visual prompt-driven interaction mechanism to enable interactive matting. Second, we integrate coordinate embeddings of visual prompts and opacity embeddings of objects into U-Net, enhancing SDMatte's sensitivity to spatial position information and opacity information. Third, we propose a masked self-attention mechanism and a visual prompt-driven interaction mechanism that enable the model to focus on areas specified by visual prompts, leading to better performance. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate the superior performance of our method, validating its effectiveness in interactive matting. Code will be made publicly available.
authors: Longfei Huang, Yu Liang, Hao Zhang, Jinwei Chen, Wei Dong, Lunde Chen, Wanyu Liu, Bo Li, Peng-Tao Jiang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15229-15239

title: SEAL: 语义感知图像水印
title_en: SEAL: Semantic Aware Image Watermarking
abstract: 生成模型迅速发展,能够生成逼真的输出内容。然而,其合成输出日益挑战自然内容与AI生成内容之间的清晰区分,需要鲁棒的水印技术来标记合成图像。水印通常被期望保持目标图像的完整性,抵御移除尝试,并防止未经授权将水印模式插入无关图像。为应对这一需求,近期方法通过扩散过程的初始噪声将持久水印嵌入扩散模型生成的图像中。然而,为此,它们要么会扭曲生成图像的分布,要么需要搜索大型候选噪声模式字典进行检测。在本文中,我们提出了一种新颖的水印方法,将生成图像的语义信息嵌入噪声模式中,从而实现无失真水印,且无需依赖关键模式数据库即可验证。相反,可以通过局部敏感哈希从图像的语义嵌入中推断出关键模式。此外,将水印检测条件化于原始图像内容可提高其对伪造攻击的鲁棒性。为验证这一点,我们考虑了两种长期被忽视的攻击策略:(i) 攻击者提取初始噪声并生成具有相同模式的新图像;(ii) 攻击者在水印图像中插入无关(潜在有害)对象,同时保留水印。我们通过实证验证了方法对这些攻击的增强鲁棒性。总体而言,我们的结果表明,内容感知水印可以缓解图像生成模型带来的风险。
abstract_en: Generative models have rapidly evolved to generate realistic outputs. However, their synthetic outputs increasingly challenge the clear distinction between natural and AI-generated content, necessitating robust watermarking techniques to mark synthetic images. Watermarks are typically expected to preserve the integrity of the target image, withstand removal attempts, and prevent unauthorized insertion of the watermark pattern onto unrelated images. To address this need, recent methods embed persistent watermarks into images produced by diffusion models using the initial noise of the diffusion process. Yet, to do so, they either distort the distribution of generated images or require searching a large dictionary of candidate noise patterns for detection. In this paper, we propose a novel watermarking method that embeds semantic information about the generated image into the noise pattern, enabling a distortion-free watermark that can be verified without requiring a database of key patterns. Instead, the key pattern can be inferred from the semantic embedding of the image using locality-sensitive hashing. Furthermore, conditioning the watermark detection on the original image content improves its robustness against forgery attacks. To demonstrate that, we consider two largely overlooked attack strategies: (i) an attacker extracting the initial noise and generating a novel image with the same pattern; (ii) an attacker inserting an unrelated (potentially harmful) object into a watermarked image, while preserving the watermark. We empirically validate our method's increased robustness to these attacks. Taken together, our results suggest that content-aware watermarks can mitigate risks arising from image-generative models.
authors: Kasra Arabi, R. Teal Witter, Chinmay Hegde, Niv Cohen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16196-16205

title: SEGA:一种面向内容感知布局生成的设计先验分步演化范式
title_en: SEGA: A Stepwise Evolution Paradigm for Content-Aware Layout Generation with Design Prior
abstract: 本文研究内容感知布局生成问题,旨在自动生成与给定背景图像和谐的布局。现有方法通常采用单步推理框架处理该任务,缺乏基于反馈的自校正机制,导致在复杂元素布局规划场景下失败率显著增加。为解决这一挑战,我们提出SEGA,一种新型内容感知布局生成的分步演化范式。受人类系统化思维模式启发,SEGA采用分层推理框架与由粗到细策略:首先,粗粒度模块粗略估计布局规划结果;随后,精炼模块对粗粒度规划结果进行细粒度推理。此外,我们将布局设计原则作为先验知识融入模型以增强其布局规划能力。同时,我们提出GenPoster-100K,这是一个包含丰富元信息标注的新大型海报数据集。实验结果验证了我们方法的有效性,在多个基准数据集上取得了最先进结果。项目页面地址:https://brucew91.github.io/SEGA.github.io
abstract_en: In this paper, we study the content-aware layout generation problem, which aims to automatically generate layouts that are harmonious with a given background image. Existing methods usually deal with this task with a single-step reasoning framework. The lack of a feedback-based self-correction mechanism leads to their failure rates significantly increasing when faced with complex element layout planning. To address this challenge, we introduce SEGA, a novel Stepwise Evolution Paradigm for Content-Aware Layout Generation. Inspired by the systematic mode of human thinking, SEGA employs a hierarchical reasoning framework with a coarse-to-fine strategy: first, a coarse-level module roughly estimates the layout planning results; then, another refining module performs fine-level reasoning regarding the coarse planning results. Furthermore, we incorporate layout design principles as prior knowledge into the model to enhance its layout planning ability. Besides, we present GenPoster-100K that is a new large-scale poster dataset with rich meta-information annotation. The experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach by achieving the state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmark datasets. Our project page is at: https://brucew91.github.io/SEGA.github.io
authors: Haoran Wang, Bo Zhao, Jinghui Wang, Hanzhang Wang, Huan Yang, Wei Ji, Hao Liu, Xinyan Xiao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19321-19330

title: SEGS-SLAM:基于外观嵌入的结构增强三维高斯点云SLAM
title_en: SEGS-SLAM: Structure-enhanced 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM with Appearance Embedding
abstract: 三维高斯点云(3D-GS)最近在同时定位与建图(SLAM)问题中的新视角合成领域取得了革命性进展。然而,大多数现有算法未能充分捕捉底层结构,导致结构不一致。此外,它们在面对突变外观变化时表现不佳,造成视觉质量不一致。为解决这些问题,我们提出SEGS-SLAM,一种结构增强的三维高斯点云SLAM方法,实现高质量的逼真映射。我们的主要贡献包含两方面:首先,我们提出结构增强的逼真映射(SEPM)框架,首次利用高度结构化的点云初始化结构化三维高斯分布,显著提升渲染质量;其次,我们提出运动外观嵌入(AfME),使三维高斯分布能够更好地建模不同相机姿态下的图像外观变化。在单目、双目和RGB-D数据集上的大量实验表明,SEGS-SLAM在逼真映射质量上显著优于现有最先进(SOTA)方法,例如在TUM RGB-D数据集上,单目相机的PSNR比MonoGS提升19.86%。项目页面可访问https://segs-slam.github.io/。
abstract_en: 3D Gaussian splatting (3D-GS) has recently revolutionized novel view synthesis in the simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) problem. However, most existing algorithms fail to fully capture the underlying structure, resulting in structural inconsistency. Additionally, they struggle with abrupt appearance variations, leading to inconsistent visual quality. To address these problems, we propose SEGS-SLAM, a structure-enhanced 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM, which achieves high-quality photorealistic mapping. Our main contributions are two-fold. First, we propose a structure-enhanced photorealistic mapping (SEPM) framework that, for the first time, leverages highly structured point cloud to initialize structured 3D Gaussians, leading to significant improvements in rendering quality. Second, we propose Appearance-from-Motion embedding (AfME), enabling 3D Gaussians to better model image appearance variations across different camera poses. Extensive experiments on monocular, stereo, and RGB-D datasets demonstrate that SEGS-SLAM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods in photorealistic mapping quality, e.g., an improvement of 19.86% in PSNR over MonoGS on the TUM RGB-D dataset for monocular cameras. The project page is available at https://segs-slam.github.io/.
authors: Tianci Wen, Zhiang Liu, Yongchun Fang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28103-28113

title: SEHDR: 基于三维高斯括号的单次曝光高动态范围新视角合成
title_en: SEHDR: Single-Exposure HDR Novel View Synthesis via 3D Gaussian Bracketing
abstract: 本文提出SeHDR,一种新颖的高动态范围三维高斯点云(HDR-3DGS)方法,可基于多视角低动态范围(LDR)图像生成高动态范围(HDR)新视角。与现有方法通常需要从不同曝光条件下捕获多视角LDR输入图像(这既繁琐又更易出现错误,如物体运动模糊和校准/对齐不准确)不同,我们的方法从单次曝光的多视角LDR图像中学习HDR场景表示。我们针对该病态问题的关键洞察是:首先从单次曝光多视角LDR图像中估计**括号式三维高斯**(即具有不同曝光值),随后可将这些括号式三维高斯合并为HDR场景表示。具体而言,SeHDR首先从单次曝光LDR输入中学习基础三维高斯,其中球面调和函数参数化线性色彩空间中的颜色。接着,我们根据曝光操作估计多个几何相同但线性色彩不同的三维高斯。最后,我们提出可微神经曝光融合(NeEF)方法,将基础三维高斯与估计的三维高斯融合为HDR高斯,用于新视角渲染。大量实验表明,SeHDR在性能上优于现有方法及精心设计的基线方法。
abstract_en: This paper presents SeHDR, a novel high dynamic range 3D Gaussian Splatting (HDR-3DGS) approach for generating HDR novel views given multi-view LDR images. Unlike existing methods that typically require the multi-view LDR input images to be captured from different exposures, which are tedious to capture and more likely to suffer from errors (e.g., object motion blurs and calibration/alignment inaccuracies), our approach learns the HDR scene representation from multi-view LDR images of a single exposure. Our key insight to this ill-posed problem is that by first estimating **Bracketed 3D Gaussians** (i.e., with different exposures) from single-exposure multi-view LDR images, we may then be able to merge these bracketed 3D Gaussians into an HDR scene representation. Specifically, SeHDR first learns base 3D Gaussians from single-exposure LDR inputs, where the spherical harmonics parameterize colors in a linear color space. We then estimate multiple 3D Gaussians with identical geometry but varying linear colors conditioned on exposure manipulations. Finally, we propose the Differentiable Neural Exposure Fusion (NeEF) to integrate the base and estimated 3D Gaussians into HDR Gaussians for novel view rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SeHDR outperforms existing methods as well as carefully designed baselines.
authors: Yiyu Li, Haoyuan Wang, Ke Xu, Gerhard Petrus Hancke, Rynson W.H. Lau ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26045-26054

title: SEREP: 语义面部表情表示用于鲁棒的野外环境捕捉与重定向
title_en: SEREP: Semantic Facial Expression Representation for Robust In-the-Wild Capture and Retargeting
abstract: 由于多样的捕捉条件、面部形状和表情,野外环境下的单目面部性能捕捉具有挑战性。当前大多数方法依赖于线性三维可变形模型,该模型在顶点位移层面独立表示面部表情与身份特征。我们提出SEREP(语义表情表示),该模型在语义层面分离表情与身份特征。我们首先从无配对高质量三维数据中学习表情表示,然后训练模型通过新颖的半监督方案,利用低质量合成数据从单目图像预测表情。此外,我们引入MultiREX基准,解决表情捕捉任务评估资源不足的问题。实验表明,SEREP优于现有最先进方法,能够捕捉具有挑战性的表情并将其迁移至新身份。
abstract_en: Monocular facial performance capture in-the-wild is challenging due to varied capture conditions, face shapes, and expressions. Most current methods rely on linear 3D Morphable Models, which represent facial expressions independently of identity at the vertex displacement level. We propose SEREP (Semantic Expression Representation), a model that disentangles expression from identity at the semantic level. We start by learning an expression representation from high-quality 3D data of unpaired facial expressions. Then, we train a model to predict expression from monocular images relying on a novel semi-supervised scheme using low quality synthetic data. In addition, we introduce MultiREX, a benchmark addressing the lack of evaluation resources for the expression capture task. Our experiments show that SEREP outperforms state-of-the-art methods, capturing challenging expressions and transferring them to new identities.
authors: Arthur Josi, Luiz Gustavo Hafemann, Abdallah Dib, Emeline Got, Rafael M. O. Cruz, Marc-André Carbonneau ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14538-14548

title: SFUOD: 无源未知目标检测
title_en: SFUOD: Source-Free Unknown Object Detection
abstract: 无源目标检测将预训练于源域的检测器适配到无标签的目标域,且无需访问带标签的源数据。尽管该设定在实践中具有可行性,因为它消除了领域适应过程中对源数据集的需求,但其操作基于一个限制性假设:即目标域中仅存在源域中预定义的对象。这种封闭集设定会阻止检测器识别未定义的对象。为缓解这一假设,我们提出无源未知目标检测(SFUOD),这是一种新颖的场景,使检测器不仅能识别已知对象,还能将未定义对象识别为未知对象。为此,我们提出CollaPAUL(协作调优与基于主轴的未知标签分配),一种用于SFUOD的新框架。协作调优通过跨域注意力机制,将辅助编码器提供的目标相关知识与预训练检测器提供的源相关知识相结合,从而增强知识适应。此外,基于主轴的未知标签分配通过估计对象性(通过主轴投影)和模型预测的置信度得分,为未知对象分配伪标签。所提出的CollaPAUL在SFUOD基准测试中实现了最先进的性能,大量实验验证了其有效性。代码将在审稿后发布。
abstract_en: Source-free object detection adapts a detector pre-trained on a source domain to an unlabeled target domain without requiring access to labeled source data. While this setting is practical as it eliminates the need for the source dataset during domain adaptation, it operates under the restrictive assumption that only pre-defined objects from the source domain exist in the target domain. This closed-set setting prevents the detector from detecting undefined objects. To ease this assumption, we propose Source-Free Unknown Object Detection (SFUOD), a novel scenario which enables the detector to not only recognize known objects but also detect undefined objects as unknown objects. To this end, we propose CollaPAUL (Collaborative tuning and Principal Axis-based Unknown Labeling), a novel framework for SFUOD. Collaborative tuning enhances knowledge adaptation by integrating target-dependent knowledge from the auxiliary encoder with source-dependent knowledge from the pre-trained detector through a cross-domain attention mechanism. Additionally, principal axis-based unknown labeling assigns pseudo-labels to unknown objects by estimating objectness via principal axes projection and confidence scores from model predictions. The proposed CollaPAUL achieves state-of-the-art performances on SFUOD benchmarks, and extensive experiments validate its effectiveness. The code will be released after the review.
authors: Keon-Hee Park, Seun-An Choe, Gyeong-Moon Park ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3499-3508

title: SG-LDM: 基于潜在对齐扩散的语义引导激光雷达生成
title_en: SG-LDM: Semantic-Guided LiDAR Generation via Latent-Aligned Diffusion
abstract: 基于生成模型的激光雷达点云合成为增强深度学习流程提供了有前景的解决方案,特别是在真实世界数据稀缺或缺乏多样性时。通过实现灵活的物体操控,该合成方法能够显著丰富训练数据集并提升判别模型性能。然而,现有方法聚焦于无条件激光雷达点云生成,忽视了其在实际应用中的潜力。本文提出SG-LDM,一种基于潜在对齐的语义引导激光雷达扩散模型,通过直接在原生激光雷达空间操作并利用显式语义条件,实现了由语义标签引导的高保真激光雷达点云生成的最先进水平。此外,我们提出首个基于SG-LDM的扩散型激光雷达翻译框架,作为领域自适应策略实现跨域翻译,以提升下游感知性能。系统实验表明,SG-LDM显著优于现有激光雷达扩散模型,所提出的激光雷达翻译框架进一步提升了下游激光雷达分割任务中的数据增强性能。
abstract_en: Lidar point cloud synthesis based on generative models offers a promising solution to augment deep learning pipelines, particularly when real-world data is scarce or lacks diversity. By enabling flexible object manipulation, this synthesis approach can significantly enrich training datasets and enhance discriminative models. However, existing methods focus on unconditional lidar point cloud generation, overlooking their potential for real-world applications. In this paper, we propose SG-LDM, a Semantic-Guided Lidar Diffusion Model that employs latent alignment to enable robust semantic-to-lidar synthesis. By directly operating in the native lidar space and leveraging explicit semantic conditioning, SG-LDM achieves state-of-the-art performance in generating high-fidelity lidar point clouds guided by semantic labels. Moreover, we propose the first diffusion-based lidar translation framework based on SG-LDM, which enables cross-domain translation as a domain adaptation strategy to enhance downstream perception performance. Systematic experiments demonstrate that SG-LDM significantly outperforms existing lidar diffusion models and the proposed lidar translation framework further improves data augmentation performance in the downstream lidar segmentation task.
authors: Zhengkang Xiang, Zizhao Li, Amir Khodabandeh, Kourosh Khoshelham ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24965-24976

title: SGAD:面向局部特征匹配的语义与几何感知描述符
title_en: SGAD: Semantic and Geometric-aware Descriptor for Local Feature Matching
abstract: 局部特征匹配仍是计算机视觉中的基础性挑战。近期的点对区域匹配(A2PM)方法已提升了匹配精度。然而,基于该框架的现有研究依赖低效的像素级比较和复杂的图匹配,限制了可扩展性。本文提出语义与几何感知描述符网络(SGAD),通过生成高度可区分的区域描述符,从根本上重新思考基于区域的匹配方法,实现无需复杂图优化的直接匹配。该方法显著提升了区域匹配的准确性和效率。我们进一步通过新颖的监督策略提升区域匹配性能,将区域匹配任务分解为分类与排序子任务。最后,引入层次化包含冗余过滤器(HCRF),通过分析包含图消除重叠区域。SGAD展现出显著性能提升,相比MESA将运行时间减少60倍(0.82s vs. 60.23s)。广泛评估表明,在多种点匹配器中均实现持续改进:SGAD+LoFTR相比DKM降低运行时间(0.82s vs. 1.51s),同时实现更高精度(65.98 vs. 61.11);SGAD+ROMA在室内位姿估计中实现+7.39%的AUC@5^\circ,建立新SOTA。
abstract_en: Local feature matching remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision. Recent Area to Point Matching (A2PM) methods have improved matching accuracy. However, existing research based on this framework relies on inefficient pixel-level comparisons and complex graph matching that limit scalability. In this work, we introduce the Semantic and Geometric-aware Descriptor Network (SGAD), which fundamentally rethinks area-based matching by generating highly discriminative area descriptors that enable direct matching without complex graph optimization. This approach significantly improves both accuracy and efficiency of area matching. We further improve the performance of area matching through a novel supervision strategy that decomposes the area matching task into classification and ranking subtasks. Finally, we introduce the Hierarchical Containment Redundancy Filter (HCRF) to eliminate overlapping areas by analyzing containment graphs. SGAD demonstrates remarkable performance gains, reducing runtime by 60x(0.82s vs. 60.23s) compared to MESA. Extensive evaluations show consistent improvements across multiple point matchers: SGAD+LoFTR reduces runtime compared to DKM, while achieving higher accuracy (0.82s vs. 1.51s, 65.98 vs. 61.11) in outdoor pose estimation, and SGAD+ROMA delivers +7.39% AUC@5^\circ in indoor pose estimation, establishing a new state-of-the-art.
authors: Xiangzeng Liu, Chi Wang, Guanglu Shi, Xiaodong Zhang, Qiguang Miao, Miao Fan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27095-27104

title: SHIFT:通过信息流调优平滑幻觉的多模态大语言模型
title_en: SHIFT: Smoothing Hallucinations by Information Flow Tuning for Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: 大语言模型(LLMs)容易产生幻觉,这在实际应用中可能带来重大风险。现有大多数幻觉检测方法依赖于内部概率或外部知识,并且仅限于在句子或段落层面识别幻觉。在本文中,我们引入了首个基于令牌级别的零资源幻觉检测框架,该框架借鉴了受填空游戏启发的创新方法。该方法通过评估游戏前后信息的一致性来评估输入文本的可靠性。在此框架基础上,我们还提出了一种创新的自动化幻觉生成技术,并引入了一个高质量的幻觉数据集HalluWiki。大量实验表明,我们的方法在不同层级上实现了超过90%的检测准确率,为LLMs的幻觉检测开辟了新的前沿。
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are prone to hallucinations, which pose significant risks in their applications. Most existing hallucination detection methods rely on internal probabilities or external knowledge, and they are limited to identifying hallucinations at the sentence or passage level. In this paper, we introduce the first token-level, zero-resource hallucination detection framework, leveraging a novel approach inspired by the Mad Libs game. This method assesses the reliability of the input text by evaluating the consistency of information before and after the game. Building on this framework, we also propose an innovative automated hallucination generation technique and introduce a high-quality hallucination dataset, HalluWiki. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves over 90% detection accuracy across different levels, establishing a new frontier in hallucination detection for LLMs.
authors: Sudong Wang, Yunjian Zhang, Yao Zhu, Enci Liu, Jianing Li, Yanwei Liu, Xiangyang Ji ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3639-3649

title: SHeaP:基于二维高斯的自监督头部几何预测器
title_en: SHeaP: Self-Supervised Head Geometry Predictor Learned via 2D Gaussians
abstract: 从单目图像和视频中实现准确且实时的三维人脸重建是众多视觉应用的基础。由于大规模三维真实数据难以获取,先前方法尝试通过自监督学习从丰富的二维视频中获取知识。通常,这涉及可微分网格渲染技术,该技术虽有效但存在局限性。为改进这一方法,我们提出SHeaP(基于二维高斯的自监督头部几何预测器)。给定一个源图像,我们预测一个3DMM网格及一组与该网格绑定的高斯分布。随后,我们将该绑定头部虚拟形象重新动画化以匹配目标帧,并将光度损失反向传播至3DMM和高斯预测网络。我们发现,使用高斯进行渲染显著提升了该自监督方法的效果。仅基于二维数据训练,我们的方法在NoW基准测试中中性面部几何评估及非中性表情的新基准测试中均超越现有自监督方法。此外,我们的方法生成高度表达性的网格,在情感分类任务中优于现有最先进方法。
abstract_en: Accurate, real-time 3D reconstruction of human heads from monocular images and videos underlies numerous visual applications. As 3D ground truth data is hard to come by at scale, previous methods have sought to learn from abundant 2D videos in a self-supervised manner. Typically, this involves the use of differentiable mesh rendering, which is effective but faces limitations. To improve on this, we propose SHeaP (Self-supervised Head Geometry Predictor Learned via 2D Gaussians).Given a source image, we predict a 3DMM mesh and a set of Gaussians that are rigged to this mesh. We then reanimate this rigged head avatar to match a target frame, and backpropagate photometric losses to both the 3DMM and Gaussian prediction networks. We find that using Gaussians for rendering substantially improves the effectiveness of this self-supervised approach.Training solely on 2D data, our method surpasses existing self-supervised approaches in geometric evaluations on the NoW benchmark for neutral faces and a new benchmark for non-neutral expressions. Our method also produces highly expressive meshes, outperforming state-of-the-art in emotion classification.
authors: Liam Schoneveld, Zhe Chen, Davide Davoli, Jiapeng Tang, Saimon Terazawa, Ko Nishino, Matthias Nießner ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14162-14172

title: SIC:基于相似度的可解释图像分类神经网络
title_en: SIC: Similarity-Based Interpretable Image Classification with Neural Networks
abstract: 在关键领域部署深度学习模型需要在高精度与可解释性之间取得平衡。我们提出SIC,一种本质上可解释的神经网络,能够提供决策过程的局部和全局解释。通过利用基于案例的推理概念,SIC从训练图像中提取具有类代表性的支持向量,确保其捕捉相关特征同时抑制无关特征。分类决策通过计算并聚合这些支持向量与输入潜在特征向量之间的相似度得分来实现。我们采用B-Cos变换,将模型权重与输入对齐,从而在提供基于案例推理的全局解释的同时,生成连贯的像素级解释。我们在三个任务上评估SIC:在Stanford Dogs和FunnyBirds数据集上的细粒度分类、在Pascal VOC数据集上的多标签分类,以及在RSNA数据集上的病理检测。结果表明,SIC不仅在准确率上与最先进的黑盒模型和本质可解释模型具有竞争力,而且通过在FunnyBirds基准上的实际评估验证了其解释的洞察力。我们的理论分析证明,这些解释满足已建立的解释公理。我们的发现强调了SIC在模型决策理解与决策本身同样关键的应用场景中的潜力。
abstract_en: The deployment of deep learning models in critical domains necessitates a balance between high accuracy and interpretability.We introduce SIC, an inherently interpretable neural network that provides local and global explanations of its decision-making process.Leveraging the concept of case-based reasoning, SIC extracts class-representative support vectors from training images, ensuring they capture relevant features while suppressing irrelevant ones.Classification decisions are made by calculating and aggregating similarity scores between these support vectors and the input's latent feature vector. We employ B-Cos transformations, which align model weights with inputs, to yield coherent pixel-level explanations in addition to global explanations of case-based reasoning.We evaluate SIC on three tasks: fine-grained classification on Stanford Dogs and FunnyBirds, multi-label classification on Pascal VOC, and pathology detection on the RSNA dataset.Results indicate that SIC not only achieves competitive accuracy compared to state-of-the-art black-box and inherently interpretable models but also offers insightful explanations verified through practical evaluation on the FunnyBirds benchmark.Our theoretical analysis proves that these explanations fulfill established axioms for explanations. Our findings underscore SIC's potential for applications where understanding model decisions is as critical as the decisions themselves.
authors: Tom Nuno Wolf, Emre Kavak, Fabian Bongratz, Christian Wachinger ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24276-24285

title: SIGMAN: 扩展数百万资产的三维人体高斯生成
title_en: SIGMAN: Scaling 3D Human Gaussian Generation with Millions of Assets
abstract: 三维人体数字化长期以来一直是备受追求却极具挑战性的任务。现有方法旨在从单视角或多视角生成高质量的三维数字人,但主要受限于当前范式和三维人体资产的稀缺性。具体而言,近期方法主要分为几种范式:基于优化和前馈(包括单视角回归与多视角生成与重建)。然而,它们分别因遮挡和不可见性导致低维平面到高维空间映射的模糊性而存在速度慢、质量低、级联推理和映射不明确等问题。此外,现有三维人体资产仍处于小规模,难以支持大规模训练。为解决这些挑战,我们提出了一种用于三维人体数字化的潜在空间生成范式,该范式通过UV结构化变分自编码器将多视角图像压缩为高斯分布,并结合DiT条件生成,将病态的低维到高维映射问题转化为可学习的分布偏移,同时支持端到端推理。此外,我们采用多视角优化方法结合合成数据构建了HGS-1M数据集,该数据集包含100万三维高斯资产以支持大规模训练。实验结果表明,我们的范式通过大规模训练生成了具有复杂纹理、面部细节和宽松服装变形的高质量三维人体高斯。所有训练代码、模型和数据集将开源。
abstract_en: 3D human digitization has long been a highly pursued yet challenging task. Existing methods aim to generate high-quality 3D digital humans from single or multiple views, but remain primarily constrained by current paradigms and the scarcity of 3D human assets. Specifically, recent approaches fall into several paradigms: optimization-based and feed-forward (both single-view regression and multi-view generation with reconstruction). However, they are limited by slow speed, low quality, cascade reasoning, and ambiguity in mapping low-dimensional planes to high-dimensional space due to occlusion and invisibility, respectively. Furthermore, existing 3D human assets remain small-scale, insufficient for large-scale training. To address these challenges, we propose a latent space generation paradigm for 3D human digitization, which involves compressing multi-view images into Gaussians via a UV-structured VAE, along with DiT-based conditional generation, we transform the ill-posed low-to-high-dimensional mapping problem into a learnable distribution shift, which also supports end-to-end inference. In addition, we employ the multi-view optimization approach combined with synthetic data to construct the HGS-1M dataset, which contains 1 million 3D Gaussian assets to support the large-scale training. Experimental results demonstrate that our paradigm, powered by large-scale training, produces high-quality 3D human Gaussians with intricate textures, facial details, and loose clothing deformation. All training code, models, and the dataset will be open-sourced.
authors: Yuhang Yang, Fengqi Liu, Yixing Lu, Qin Zhao, Pingyu Wu, Wei Zhai, Ran Yi, Yang Cao, Lizhuang Ma, Zheng-Jun Zha, Junting Dong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5122-5133

title: SILO: 使用潜在算子解决逆问题
title_en: SILO: Solving Inverse Problems with Latent Operators
abstract: 近年来,通过整合更先进的图像先验,即插即用方法在解决逆问题方面持续取得进展。潜在扩散模型是其中最强大的先验之一,使其成为解决逆问题的自然选择。然而,现有方法在恢复过程中需要多次应用自动编码器以在像素空间和潜在空间之间转换,导致计算成本高且恢复质量下降。在本工作中,我们引入了一种全新的即插即用范式,该范式完全在扩散模型的潜在空间中运行。通过一个简短的学习阶段直接在潜在空间中模拟像素空间的退化,我们消除了恢复过程中对自动编码器的需求,从而实现更快的推理速度和更高的恢复保真度。我们在各种图像恢复任务和数据集上验证了该方法,实现了显著优于先前方法的感知质量,同时推理速度提高了2.6-10倍,当计入潜在算子学习阶段时,速度提高了1.7-7倍。
abstract_en: Plug-and-play methods for solving inverse problems have continuously improved over the years by incorporating more advanced image priors.Latent diffusion models are among the most powerful priors, making them a natural choice for solving inverse problems. However, existing approaches require multiple applications of an Autoencoder to transition between pixel and latent spaces during restoration, leading to high computational costs and degraded restoration quality. In this work, we introduce a new plug-and-play paradigm that operates entirely in the latent space of diffusion models. By emulating pixel-space degradations directly in the latent space through a short learning phase, we eliminate the need for the Autoencoder during restoration, enabling faster inference and improved restoration fidelity. We validate our method across various image restoration tasks and datasets, achieving significantly higher perceptual quality than previous methods while being 2.6-10x faster in inference and 1.7-7x faster when accounting for the learning phase of the latent operator.
authors: Ron Raphaeli, Sean Man, Michael Elad ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10570-10580

title: SIMS: 基于检索增强的脚本生成模拟风格化的人-场景交互
title_en: SIMS: Simulating Stylized Human-Scene Interactions with Retrieval-Augmented Script Generation
abstract: 在物理环境中模拟风格化的人-场景交互(HSI)是一项具有挑战性却引人入胜的任务。先前的研究强调长期执行,但在实现多样化风格与物理合理性方面仍存在不足。为应对这一挑战,我们提出了一种新颖的分层框架SIMS,无缝连接高层脚本驱动意图与低层控制策略,从而实现更具表现力和多样性的交互。具体而言,我们采用结合检索增强生成(RAG)的大型语言模型生成连贯且多样的长文本脚本,为运动规划提供丰富基础。同时开发了一种通用的多条件物理控制策略,利用生成脚本的文本嵌入编码风格提示,同时感知环境几何结构并完成任务目标。通过将检索增强脚本生成与多条件控制器集成,我们的方法为生成风格化HSI运动提供了统一解决方案。我们进一步引入了由RAG生成的综合规划数据集和包含多样化运动与交互的风格化运动数据集。大量实验验证了SIMS在执行多种任务和跨不同场景泛化方面的有效性,显著优于先前方法。
abstract_en: Simulating stylized human-scene interactions (HSI) in physical environments is a challenging yet fascinating task. Prior works emphasize long-term execution but fall short in achieving both diverse style and physical plausibility. To tackle this challenge, we introduce a novel hierarchical framework named SIMS that seamlessly bridges high-level script-driven intent with a low-level control policy, enabling more expressive and diverse human-scene interactions. Specifically, we employ Large Language Models with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to generate coherent and diverse long-form scripts, providing a rich foundation for motion planning. A versatile multi-condition physics-based control policy is also developed, which leverages text embeddings from the generated scripts to encode stylistic cues, simultaneously perceiving environmental geometries and accomplishing task goals. By integrating the retrieval-augmented script generation with the multi-condition controller, our approach provides a unified solution for generating stylized HSI motions. We further introduce a comprehensive planning dataset produced by RAG and a stylized motion dataset featuring diverse locomotions and interactions. Extensive experiments demonstrate SIMS's effectiveness in executing various tasks and generalizing across different scenarios, significantly outperforming previous methods.
authors: Wenjia Wang, Liang Pan, Zhiyang Dou, Jidong Mei, Zhouyingcheng Liao, Yuke Lou, Yifan Wu, Lei Yang, Jingbo Wang, Taku Komura ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14117-14127

title: SITE: 面向空间智能全面评估的基准
title_en: SITE: towards Spatial Intelligence Thorough Evaluation
abstract: 空间智能(SI)代表一种涵盖空间关系的可视化、操作和推理的认知能力,是涵盖从神经科学到机器人学等多个学科的基础能力。我们引入SITE,一个面向空间智能全面评估的基准数据集,采用多选视觉问答的标准化格式,旨在评估大视觉-语言模型在多种视觉模态(单图像、多图像和视频)及SI因素(从图形到环境尺度、空间可视化与定向、内在与外在、静态与动态)下的空间智能表现。我们构建基准的方法结合了现有数据集的自下而上调查和基于认知科学三个分类系统的自上而下策略,这促使我们设计了两种新型任务:视点获取和动态场景。大量实验表明,领先模型在空间定向这一基本SI因素上仍落后于人类专家。此外,我们展示了模型的空间推理能力与其在具身AI任务上的表现存在正相关。
abstract_en: Spatial intelligence (SI) represents a cognitive ability encompassing the visualization, manipulation, and reasoning about spatial relationships, underpinning disciplines from neuroscience to robotics. We introduce SITE, a benchmark dataset towards SI Thorough Evaluation in a standardized format of multi-choice visual question-answering, designed to assess large vision-language models' spatial intelligence across diverse visual modalities (single-image, multi-image, and video) and SI factors (figural to environmental scales, spatial visualization and orientation, intrinsic and extrinsic, static and dynamic). Our approach to curating the benchmark combines a bottom-up survey of existing datasets and a top-down strategy drawing upon three classification systems in cognitive science, which prompt us to design two novel types of tasks about view-taking and dynamic scenes. Extensive experiments reveal that leading models fall behind human experts, especially in spatial orientation, a fundamental SI factor. Moreover, we demonstrate a positive correlation between a model's spatial reasoning proficiency and its performance on an embodied AI task.
authors: Wenqi Wang, Reuben Tan, Pengyue Zhu, Jianwei Yang, Zhengyuan Yang, Lijuan Wang, Andrey Kolobov, Jianfeng Gao, Boqing Gong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9058-9069

title: SKALD:基于学习的连贯多镜头视频创作镜头拼接方法
title_en: SKALD: Learning-Based Shot Assembly for Coherent Multi-Shot Video Creation
