abstract: 我们提出SKALD,一种多镜头视频拼接方法,该方法通过最小依赖文本从候选镜头中构建连贯的视频序列。我们的方法核心是学习剪辑拼接(LCA)得分,这是一种基于学习的度量指标,用于衡量镜头间的时序和语义关系,以量化叙事连贯性。我们通过一种由LCA得分引导的高效束搜索算法,解决多镜头组合的指数级复杂度问题。为在有限的人工标注条件下有效训练模型,我们为LCA编码器提出两个任务:镜头连贯性学习,利用对比学习区分连贯与不连贯序列;特征回归,将这些学习到的表示转换为实值连贯性得分。我们开发了两个变体:仅依赖视觉连贯性的基础SKALD模型,以及在可用时整合辅助文本信息的SKALD-text模型。在VSPD和我们整理的MSV3C数据集上的实验表明,SKALD在IoU指标上比现有方法提升最高达48.6%,且速度提升43%。用户研究进一步验证了我们的方法,45%的参与者更倾向于SKALD拼接的视频,而仅22%的参与者偏好基于文本的拼接方法。
abstract_en: We present SKALD, a multi-shot video assembly method that constructs coherent video sequences from candidate shots with minimal reliance on text. Central to our approach is the Learned Clip Assembly (LCA) score, a learning-based metric that measures temporal and semantic relationships between shots to quantify narrative coherence. We tackle the exponential complexity of combining multiple shots with an efficient beam-search algorithm guided by the LCA score. To train our model effectively with limited human annotations, we propose two tasks for the LCA encoder: Shot Coherence Learning, which uses contrastive learning to distinguish coherent and incoherent sequences, and Feature Regression, which converts these learned representations into a real-valued coherence score. We develop two variants: a base SKALD model that relies solely on visual coherence and SKALD-text, which integrates auxiliary text information when available. Experiments on the VSPD and our curated MSV3C datasets show that SKALD achieves an improvement of up to 48.6% in IoU and a 43% speedup over the state-of-the-art methods. A user study further validates our approach, with 45% of participants favoring SKALD-assembled videos, compared to 22% preferring text-based assembly methods.
authors: Chen-Yi Lu, Md Mehrab Tanjim, Ishita Dasgupta, Somdeb Sarkhel, Gang Wu, Saayan Mitra, Somali Chaterji ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17859-17868

title: SL2A-INR: 针对隐式神经表示的单层可学习激活函数
title_en: SL2A-INR: Single-Layer Learnable Activation for Implicit Neural Representation
abstract: 隐式神经表示(INR)通过神经网络将坐标输入转换为对应属性,近年来在多个视觉相关领域推动了显著进展。然而,INR的性能严重依赖于其多层感知机(MLP)架构中所采用的非线性激活函数的选择。迄今为止,已研究了多种非线性激活函数,但当前的INR仍面临捕捉高频成分和多样化信号类型的局限性。我们证明,通过在INR架构中引入一种新方法可以缓解这些挑战。具体而言,我们提出SL^2A-INR,这是一种混合网络,结合了单层可学习激活函数与采用传统ReLU激活的MLP。我们的方法在包括图像表示、3D形状重建和新视角合成在内的多样化任务中均表现出色。通过全面实验,SL^2A-INR在INR的准确性、质量及鲁棒性方面设立了新基准。
abstract_en: Implicit Neural Representation (INR), leveraging a neural network to transform coordinate input into corresponding attributes, has recently driven significant advances in several vision-related domains. However, the performance of INR is heavily influenced by the choice of the nonlinear activation function used in its multilayer perceptron (MLP) architecture. To date, multiple nonlinearities have been investigated, but current INRs still face limitations in capturing high-frequency components and diverse signal types. We show that these challenges can be alleviated by introducing a novel approach in INR architecture. Specifically, we propose SL^ 2 A-INR, a hybrid network that combines a single-layer learnable activation function with an MLP that uses traditional ReLU activations. Our method performs superior across diverse tasks, including image representation, 3D shape reconstruction, and novel view synthesis. Through comprehensive experiments, SL^ 2 A-INR sets new benchmarks in accuracy, quality, and robustness for INR.
authors: Reza Rezaeian, Moein Heidari, Reza Azad, Dorit Merhof, Hamid Soltanian-Zadeh, Ilker Hacihaliloglu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26065-26074

title: SMARTIES:面向遥感图像的光谱感知多传感器自编码器
title_en: SMARTIES: Spectrum-Aware Multi-Sensor Auto-Encoder for Remote Sensing Images
abstract: 从光学传感器到微波雷达,利用遥感(RS)传感器的互补优势对于实现密集时空监测至关重要。相反,近期的深度学习模型,无论是任务特定还是基础模型,通常都局限于单个传感器或固定组合:适应不同传感器输入需要架构调整和重新训练,限制了在多种遥感传感器上的可扩展性和泛化能力。相反,一个能够调节其特征表示以接受多样传感器输入的单一模型将为敏捷灵活的多传感器遥感数据处理铺平道路。为此,我们引入SMARTIES,一个通用且多功能的基础模型,消除了传感器特定/依赖的努力,使模型能够扩展并泛化到多样遥感传感器:SMARTIES将异构传感器数据投影到共享的光谱感知空间,使训练和推理中均可使用任意波段组合。为获得与传感器无关的表示,我们训练了一个统一的Transformer模型,通过跨传感器标记混合重构掩码多传感器数据。在跨多样传感器的单模态和多模态任务中,SMARTIES优于依赖传感器特定预训练的先前模型。我们的代码和预训练模型可在https://gsumbul.github.io/SMARTIES获取。
abstract_en: From optical sensors to microwave radars, leveraging the complementary strengths of remote sensing (RS) sensors is crucial for achieving dense spatio-temporal monitoring of our planet. In contrast, recent deep learning models, whether task-specific or foundational, are often specific to single sensors or to fixed combinations: adapting such models to different sensory inputs requires both architectural changes and re-training, limiting scalability and generalization across multiple RS sensors. On the contrary, a single model able to modulate its feature representations to accept diverse sensors as input would pave the way to agile and flexible multi-sensor RS data processing. To address this, we introduce SMARTIES, a generic and versatile foundation model lifting sensor-specific/dependent efforts and enabling scalability and generalization to diverse RS sensors: SMARTIES projects data from heterogeneous sensors into a shared spectrum-aware space, enabling the use of arbitrary combinations of bands both for training and inference. To obtain sensor-agnostic representations, we train a single, unified transformer model reconstructing masked multi-sensor data with cross-sensor token mixup. On both single- and multi-modal tasks across diverse sensors, SMARTIES outperforms previous models that rely on sensor-specific pretraining. Our code and pretrained models are available at https://gsumbul.github.io/SMARTIES.
authors: Gencer Sumbul, Chang Xu, Emanuele Dalsasso, Devis Tuia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5569-5578

title: SMGDiff:基于扩散概率模型的足球运动生成
title_en: SMGDiff: Soccer Motion Generation using Diffusion Probabilistic Models
abstract: 足球是一项全球知名的运动,在视频游戏和VR/AR领域具有重要应用。然而,由于球员与球之间复杂的交互关系,生成逼真的足球运动仍面临挑战。本文提出SMGDiff,一种新颖的两阶段框架,用于生成实时且用户可控的足球运动。我们的核心思想是将实时角色动画与强大的扩散生成模型相结合。具体而言,我们首先将粗粒度用户控制映射为复杂的角色轨迹。随后,我们采用基于Transformer的自回归扩散模型,根据轨迹条件生成足球运动。为进一步提升物理真实性,我们在推理过程中集成接触引导模块以优化精确的球-脚交互。此外,我们贡献了一个大规模足球运动数据集,包含超过108万帧的多样化足球运动。大量实验表明,我们的SMGDiff在运动质量与条件对齐方面显著优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Soccer is a globally renowned sport with significant applications in video games and VR/AR. However, generating realistic soccer motions remains challenging due to the intricate interactions between the player and the ball. In this paper, we introduce SMGDiff, a novel two-stage framework for generating real-time and user-controllable soccer motions. Our key idea is to integrate real-time character animation with a powerful diffusion-based generative model. Specifically, we first map coarse user control to intricate character trajectories. Then, we employ a transformer-based autoregressive diffusion model to generate soccer motions based on trajectory conditioning. For further physical realism, we integrate a contact guidance module during inference to refine precise ball-foot interactions.Additionally, we contribute a large-scale soccer motion dataset consisting of over 1.08 million frames of diverse soccer motions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our SMGDiff significantly outperforms existing methods in terms of motion quality and condition alignment.
authors: Hongdi Yang, Chengyang Li, Zhenxuan Wu, Gaozheng Li, Jingya Wang, Jingyi Yu, Zhuo Su, Lan Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11807-11817

title: SMP-Attack: 通过语义感知的多粒度补丁移除提升基于特征重要性的对抗攻击的迁移性
title_en: SMP-Attack: Boosting the Transferability of Feature Importance-based Adversarial Attack with Semantics-aware Multi-granularity Patchout
abstract: 基于迁移的攻击对深度神经网络(DNNs)构成了重大安全威胁,因其在现实黑盒场景中对未见过的模型表现出强大的攻击效果。在此基础上,基于特征重要性的攻击通过有效抑制模型特定特征模式,进一步提升了对抗样本的迁移性。然而,现有方法主要聚焦于单粒度补丁和单阶段训练,导致解决方案不够理想。为解决这些局限性,我们提出了一种基于语义感知的多粒度补丁移除的通用多阶段优化框架,命名为SMP-Attack。与非变形/常规补丁定义相比,我们在变形/不规则补丁的生成过程中引入多粒度特性,从而提升计算聚合梯度的质量。与传统多层损失联合优化方法不同,我们引入了一种有效的多阶段训练策略,系统地从浅层到中间层探索显著的模型无关特征。在ImageNet数据集上,我们在未防御/已防御的CNN和ViTs模型上进行了大量实验,结果明确表明我们的SMP-Attack在黑盒场景中显著优于现有最先进的方法。此外,我们评估了多阶段优化的兼容性,该方法超越了现有基于特征的方法中采用的单阶段训练,最终实现了显著的性能提升。代码已开源至https://github.com/AdvML-Group/SMP-Attack。
abstract_en: Transfer-based attacks pose a significant security threat to deep neural networks (DNNs), due to their strong performance on unseen models in real-world black-box scenarios. Building on this, feature importance-based attacks further improve the transferability of adversarial examples by effectively suppressing model-specific feature patterns. However, existing methods primarily focus on single-granularity patch and single-stage training, leading to suboptimal solutions. To address these limitations, we propose a general multi-stage optimization framework based on Semantics-aware Multi-granularity Patchout, dubbed as SMP-Attack. Compared to the non-deformable/regular patch definition, we incorporate multi-granularity into the generation process of deformable/irregular patches, thereby enhancing the quality of the computed aggregate gradient. In contrast to conventional joint optimization of multi-layer losses, we introduce an effective multi-stage training strategy that systematically explores significant model-agnostic features from shallow to intermediate layers. Employing the ImageNet dataset, we conduct extensive experiments on undefended/defended CNNs and ViTs, which unequivocally demonstrate the superior performance of our proposed SMP-Attack over current state-of-the-art methods in black-box scenarios. Furthermore, we assess the compatibility of our multi-stage optimization, which supersedes single-stage training employed in existing feature-based methods, culminating in substantial performance improvement. Code is available at https://github.com/AdvML-Group/SMP-Attack.
authors: Wen Yang, Guodong Liu, Di Ming ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4444-4454

title: SMSTracker:三路径得分掩码与sigma融合的多模态跟踪
title_en: SMSTracker: Tri-path Score Mask Sigma Fusion for Multi-Modal Tracking
abstract: 多模态目标跟踪因在复杂环境(如曝光变化、模糊和遮挡)中表现出的鲁棒性,已成为计算机视觉的重要研究方向。尽管现有研究通过视觉提示机制将补充模态信息整合至预训练RGB跟踪器,但该方法存在关键局限:其本质优先级RGB信息作为主导模态,导致其他模态的互补信息被低估。为解决这一根本性局限,我们提出SMSTracker,一种创新的三路径得分掩码sigma融合框架用于多模态跟踪,包含三个核心模块。首先,设计三路径得分掩码融合(SMF)模块,用于评估和量化各模态的可靠性,实现模态间互补特征的最优利用。其次,引入开创性的sigma交互(SGI)模块,促进三分支间模态特征的复杂融合。进一步,提出关键丢弃微调(DKF)策略,以应对多模态学习场景中数据贡献不均的固有挑战,从而增强模型对全面多模态信息处理的能力。最终,在RGB+热红外、RGB+深度和RGB+事件数据集上的大量实验验证了SMSTracker相较于现有SOTA方法的显著性能提升。代码和模型可访问https://github.com/Leezed525/SMSTracker。
abstract_en: Multi-modal object tracking has emerged as a significant research focus in computer vision due to its robustness in complex environments, such as exposure variations, blur, and occlusions. Despite existing studies integrating supplementary modal information into pre-trained RGB trackers through visual prompt mechanisms, this approach exhibits a critical limitation: it inherently prioritizes RGB information as the dominant modality, thereby underutilizing the complementary information of alternative modalities. To address this fundamental limitation, we present SMSTracker, an innovative tri-path score mask sigma fusion framework for multi-modal tracking, including three key modules. Firstly, we design a tri-path Score Mask Fusion (SMF) module to evaluate and quantify the reliability of each modality, allowing optimal exploitation of complementary features between modalities. Secondly, we introduce a pioneering Sigma Interaction (SGI) module to facilitate a sophisticated fusion of modal features across tri-branches. Furthermore, we advance a Drop Key Fine-tuning (DKF) strategy to address the inherent challenge of unequal data contribution in multi-modal learning scenarios, thereby enhancing the model's capacity for comprehensive multi-modal information processing. Finally, extensive experiments on RGB+Thermal, RGB+Depth, and RGB+Event datasets demonstrate the significant performance improvements achieved by SMSTracker over existing state-of-the-art methods. Code and model are available at https://github.com/Leezed525/SMSTracker.
authors: Sixian Chan, Zedong Li, Wenhao Li, Shijian Lu, Chunhua Shen, Xiaoqin Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4766-4775

title: SMoLoRA:探索与对抗持续视觉指令调优中的双重灾难性遗忘
title_en: SMoLoRA: Exploring and Defying Dual Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Visual Instruction Tuning
abstract: 视觉指令调优(VIT)通过将视觉任务框架化为基于语言的指令,使多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)能够有效处理广泛视觉任务。在此基础上,持续视觉指令调优(CVIT)进一步拓展了MLLMs的能力,使其能够增量学习新任务以适应功能演进。尽管已有研究通过构建新基准和方法缓解灾难性遗忘推动了CVIT的发展,但这些努力大多遵循传统持续学习范式,忽视了CVIT特有的挑战。我们识别出CVIT中存在双重灾难性遗忘现象,即MLLMs不仅会遗忘先前学习的视觉理解能力,同时在学习新任务时还会出现遵循指令能力的下降。为解决这一问题,我们提出可分离的低秩适配混合框架(SMoLoRA),通过两个独立模块实现分离路由——一个用于视觉理解,另一个用于指令遵循。这种双路由设计使两个领域能够实现专业化适配,在防止遗忘的同时提升性能。此外,我们提出一个新的CVIT基准,该基准超越现有基准,额外评估模型对未见任务的泛化能力以及跨任务处理多样化指令的能力。大量实验表明,SMoLoRA在缓解双重遗忘、提升对未见任务的泛化能力以及确保多样化指令遵循的鲁棒性方面均优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Visual instruction tuning (VIT) enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to effectively handle a wide range of vision tasks by framing them as language-based instructions. Building on this, continual visual instruction tuning (CVIT) extends the capability of MLLMs to incrementally learn new tasks, accommodating evolving functionalities. While prior work has advanced CVIT through the development of new benchmarks and approaches to mitigate catastrophic forgetting, these efforts largely follow traditional continual learning paradigms, neglecting the unique challenges specific to CVIT. We identify a dual form of catastrophic forgetting in CVIT, where MLLMs not only forget previously learned visual understanding but also experience a decline in instruction following abilities as they acquire new tasks. To address this, we introduce the Separable Mixture of Low-Rank Adaptation (SMoLoRA) framework, which employs separable routing through two distinct modules--one for visual understanding and another for instruction following. This dual-routing design enables specialized adaptation in both domains, preventing forgetting while improving performance. Furthermore, we propose a new CVIT benchmark that goes beyond existing benchmarks by additionally evaluating a model's ability to generalize to unseen tasks and handle diverse instructions across various tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SMoLoRA outperforms existing methods in mitigating dual forgetting, improving generalization to unseen tasks, and ensuring robustness in following diverse instructions.
authors: Ziqi Wang, Chang Che, Qi Wang, Yangyang Li, Zenglin Shi, Meng Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 177-186

title: SP2T: 基于稀疏代理注意力的双流点变换器
title_en: SP2T: Sparse Proxy Attention for Dual-stream Point Transformer
abstract: 点变换器通过扩展感受野(RF)在3D理解中取得了显著进展,但进一步扩展会导致分组注意力稀释和细节特征提取能力下降。代理作为简化特征图的抽象表示可实现全局感受野。然而现有基于代理的方法存在关键局限:全局代理在大规模点云中导致二次复杂度并存在位置模糊,而局部代理则面临1)几何多样性点云的采样不可靠、2)代理交互计算效率低、3)局部-全局信息融合不平衡等问题。为解决这些挑战,我们提出稀疏代理点变换器(SP2T)——一种基于局部代理的双流点变换器,包含三项创新:首先,通过基于顶点关联的空间感知代理采样实现几何多样性点云的可靠采样;其次,采用基于表格的相对偏置稀疏代理注意力,通过高效的映射-归约计算实现代理交互;第三,通过并行分支结构在双流架构中保持局部-全局信息平衡。综合实验表明,SP2T在室内和室外3D理解基准测试中取得SOTA结果且延迟可接受,相比其他基于代理的点云方法表现出显著提升(+3.8% mIoU vs. SPoTr@S3DIS,+22.9% mIoU vs. PointASNL@Sem.KITTI)。
abstract_en: Point transformers have demonstrated remarkable progress in 3D understanding through expanded receptive fields (RF), but further expanding the RF leads to dilution in group attention and decreases detailed feature extraction capability. Proxy, which serves as abstract representations for simplifying feature maps, enables global RF. However, existing proxy-based approaches face critical limitations: Global proxies incur quadratic complexity for large-scale point clouds and suffer positional ambiguity, while local proxy alternatives struggle with 1) Unreliable sampling from the geometrically diverse point cloud, 2) Inefficient proxy interaction computation, and 3) Imbalanced local-global information fusion; To address these challenges, we propose Sparse Proxy Point Transformer (SP^ 2 T) -- a local proxy-based dual-stream point transformer with three key innovations: First, for reliable sampling, spatial-wise proxy sampling with vertex-based associations enables robust sampling on geometrically diverse point clouds. Second, for efficient proxy interaction, sparse proxy attention with a table-based relative bias effectively achieves the interaction with efficient map-reduce computation. Third, for local-global information fusion, our dual-stream architecture maintains local-global balance through parallel branches. Comprehensive experiments reveal that SP^ 2 T sets state-of-the-art results with acceptable latency on indoor and outdoor 3D comprehension benchmarks, demonstrating marked improvement (+3.8% mIoU vs. SPoTr@S3DIS, +22.9% mIoU vs. PointASNL@Sem.KITTI) compared to other proxy-based point cloud methods.
authors: Jiaxu Wan, Hong Zhang, Ziqi He, Yangyan Deng, Qishu Wang, Ding Yuan, Yifan Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27885-27895

title: SPA:面向医学图像分割中不确定性的高效用户偏好对齐
title_en: SPA: Efficient User-Preference Alignment against Uncertainty in Medical Image Segmentation
abstract: 医学图像分割数据本质上包含不确定性。这种不确定性可能源于图像质量不完善以及对模糊像素标注偏好的变异性,这种变异性取决于标注者的专业水平和注释的临床背景。例如,边界像素可能在诊断中被标记为肿瘤以避免低估严重程度,而在放疗中则被标记为正常组织以防止对敏感结构造成损伤。由于分割偏好在下游应用中存在差异,通常希望图像分割模型能够提供可适应用户需求的预测结果,而非固定输出。尽管先前的不确定性感知和交互方法提供了适应性,但它们在测试阶段效率较低:不确定性感知模型要求用户从众多相似输出中进行选择,而交互模型则需要通过点击或框选提示进行大量用户输入以优化分割。为解决这些挑战,我们提出SPA(Segmentation Preference Alignment),一种新的分割偏好对齐框架,能够以最小的人机交互高效适应多样化的测试阶段偏好。通过向用户展示少量、具有代表性的分割候选方案以最佳体现不确定性,该方法可显著降低用户工作量以达到所需分割结果。为适应用户偏好,我们引入一种概率机制,利用用户反馈调整模型的分割偏好。所提出的框架在多个医学图像分割任务中进行了评估:包括彩色视网膜图像、肺部病变和肾脏CT扫描、脑部和前列腺的MRI扫描。实验结果表明,SPA在以下方面表现突出:1)相比现有交互分割方法显著减少用户时间和精力投入;2)基于人类反馈展现出强大的适应性;3)在不同成像模式和语义标签下均达到最先进的图像分割性能。我们的代码已公开在https://github.com/SuperMedIntel/SPA。
abstract_en: Medical image segmentation data inherently contain uncertainty. This can stem from both imperfect image quality and variability in labeling preferences on ambiguous pixels, which depend on annotator expertise and the clinical context of the annotations. For instance, a boundary pixel might be labeled as tumor in diagnosis to avoid under-estimation of severity, but as normal tissue in radiotherapy to prevent damage to sensitive structures. As segmentation preferences vary across downstream applications, it is often desirable for an image segmentation model to offer user-adaptable predictions rather than a fixed output. While prior uncertainty-aware and interactive methods offer adaptability, they are inefficient at test time: uncertainty-aware models require users to choose from numerous similar outputs, while interactive models demand significant user input through click or box prompts to refine segmentation. To address these challenges, we propose SPA, a new Segmentation Preference Alignment framework that efficiently adapts to diverse test-time preferences with minimal human interaction. By presenting users with a select few, distinct segmentation candidates that best capture uncertainties, it reduces the user workload to reach the preferred segmentation. To accommodate user preference, we introduce a probabilistic mechanism that leverages user feedback to adapt a model's segmentation preference. The proposed framework is evaluated on several medical image segmentation tasks: color fundus images, lung lesion and kidney CT scans, MRI scans of brain and prostate. SPA shows 1) a significant reduction in user time and effort compared to existing interactive segmentation approaches, 2) strong adaptability based on human feedback, and 3) state-of-the-art image segmentation performance across different imaging modalities and semantic labels. Our code is publicly available here: https://github.com/SuperMedIntel/SPA.
authors: Jiayuan Zhu, Junde Wu, Cheng Ouyang, Konstantinos Kamnitsas, J. Alison Noble ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23731-23740

title: SPADE: 基于空间感知去噪网络的开放词汇全景场景图生成方法与长程-局部上下文推理
title_en: SPADE: Spatial-Aware Denoising Network for Open-vocabulary Panoptic Scene Graph Generation with Long- and Local-range Context Reasoning
abstract: 全景场景图生成(PSG)将实例分割与关系理解相结合,以捕捉复杂场景中像素级的结构关系。尽管近期利用预训练视觉-语言模型(VLMs)的方法在开放词汇设置中显著提升了性能,但它们通常忽视了VLMs在空间关系推理中的固有局限性,例如难以区分物体相对位置,导致关系预测效果欠佳。受去噪扩散模型保留输入图像空间结构的逆过程启发,我们提出SPADE(SPatial-Aware Denoising-nEtwork)框架——一种新型开放词汇PSG方法。SPADE包含两个关键步骤:(1)基于逆过程引导的UNet适配校准,(2)空间感知上下文推理。在第一步中,我们通过轻量级LoRA微调策略,将通用预训练教师扩散模型校准为PSG专用的去噪网络,利用逆过程生成的交叉注意力图进行适配。在第二步中,我们开发了空间感知关系图变换器,捕捉局部与长程上下文信息,促进高质量关系查询的生成。在基准PSG和Visual Genome数据集上的大量实验表明,SPADE在闭集和开集场景中均优于现有最先进方法,尤其在空间关系预测方面表现突出。代码已开源:https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SPADE-105F
abstract_en: Panoptic Scene Graph Generation (PSG) integrates instance segmentation with relation understanding to capture pixel-level structural relationships in complex scenes. Although recent approaches leveraging pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) have significantly improved performance in the open-vocabulary setting, they commonly ignore the inherent limitations of VLMs in spatial relation reasoning, such as difficulty in distinguishing object relative positions, which results in suboptimal relation prediction.Motivated by the denoising diffusion model's inversion process in preserving the spatial structure of input images, we propose SPADE (SPatial-Aware Denoising-nEtwork) framework---a novel approach for open-vocabulary PSG. SPADE consists of two key steps: (1) inversion-guided calibration for the UNet adaption, and (2) spatial-aware context reasoning. In the first step, we calibrate a general pre-trained teacher diffusion model into a PSG-specific denoising network with cross-attention maps derived during inversion through a lightweight LoRA-based fine-tuning strategy. In the second step, we develop a spatial-aware relation graph transformer that captures both local and long-range contextual information, facilitating the generation of high-quality relation queries. Extensive experiments on benchmark PSG and Visual Genome datasets demonstrate that SPADE outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both closed-set and open-set scenarios, particularly excelling in spatial relationship prediction. The code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SPADE-105F.
authors: Xin Hu, Ke Qin, Guiduo Duan, Ming Li, Yuan-Fang Li, Tao He ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15562-15572

title: SPD: 浅层后门保护深层后门免受后门检测
title_en: SPD: Shallow Backdoor Protecting Deep Backdoor Against Backdoor Detection
abstract: 后门攻击揭示了深度神经网络(DNNs)的脆弱性,这推动了安全深度学习系统的发展。然而,现有后门攻击常无法绕过后门检测和人工视觉检查,导致植入DNNs中的后门暴露,随后可通过在良性数据上进行修剪或微调显著缓解。为解决这一问题,本文提出了一种新型后门攻击方法SPD(Shallow Protecting Deep),其包含频率域中的深层后门和像素域中的浅层后门,其中浅层后门充当防火墙以保护深层后门免受检测。具体而言,SPD中的深层后门从特定高斯分布中采样,并通过自编码器将采样结果编码为图像幅值分量的强度,作为后门触发器,从而确保后门攻击的隐蔽性。浅层后门利用传统基于补丁的触发器,覆盖所有类别并吸引防御者的注意力,从而保持深层后门对现有后门检测技术的抵抗能力。实验结果表明,SPD不仅能够抵抗现有后门检测技术,而且由于后门触发器对良性样本造成的最小扰动,仍保持隐蔽性,使后门样本通过人工视觉检查。SPD的源代码可在GitHub获取:https://github.com/YuanShunJie1/SPD
abstract_en: Backdoor attacks have revealed the vulnerability of deep neural networks (DNNs), which motivates the development of secure deep learning systems. However, existing backdoor attacks often fail to bypass backdoor detection and human visual inspection, resulting in the exposure of the backdoor implanted in DNNs, which can subsequently be significantly mitigated through pruning or fine-tuning on benign data. To address this issue, in this paper, we propose a novel backdoor attack called SPD (Shallow Protecting Deep), which consists of a deep backdoor in the frequency domain and a shallow backdoor in the pixel domain, where the shallow backdoor acts as a firewall to protect the deep backdoor from being detected. Specifically, the deep backdoor in SPD samples from a specific Gaussian distribution, and encodes the sampled results into the intensity of the image's amplitude component in the frequency domain using an autoencoder, which serves as the backdoor trigger, thereby ensuring the invisibility of the backdoor attack. The shallow backdoor leverages traditional patch-based triggers, which covers all classes and attracts the defender's attention, thereby preserving the deep backdoor's resistance to existing backdoor detection techniques. Experimental results demonstrate that SPD not only can resist existing backdoor detection techniques, but also, due to the minimal disturbance caused by the backdoor trigger on benign samples, remains invisible, allowing the backdoor samples to pass through the human visual inspection. The source code of SPD is available at GitHub https://github.com/YuanShunJie1/SPD.
authors: Shunjie Yuan, Xinghua Li, Xuelin Cao, Haiyan Zhang, Mengyao Zhu, Robert H. Deng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4029-4038

title: SRefiner:基于软辫注意力的多智能体轨迹优化
title_en: SRefiner: Soft-Braid Attention for Multi-Agent Trajectory Refinement
abstract: 多智能体未来轨迹的准确预测对自动驾驶系统做出安全高效的决策至关重要。轨迹优化已成为提升预测精度的关键策略。然而,现有优化方法往往忽视轨迹间的拓扑关系,而这种关系对于提高预测精度至关重要。受辫论启发,我们提出了一种新型轨迹优化方法——软辫优化器(SRefiner),该方法通过轨迹的软辫拓扑结构引导软辫注意力机制。软辫注意力机制通过考虑"软交点"处的空间邻近性和车辆运动状态,捕捉轨迹间的时空拓扑关系。此外,我们将该方法扩展至建模轨迹与车道间的交互,进一步提升预测精度。SRefiner是一个多迭代、多智能体框架,通过迭代优化轨迹,融合拓扑信息以增强交通场景中的交互效果。SRefiner在两个数据集上超越了四种基线方法,建立了轨迹优化领域的新标杆。
abstract_en: Accurate prediction of multi-agent future trajectories is crucial for autonomous driving systems to make safe and efficient decisions. Trajectory refinement has emerged as a key strategy to enhance prediction accuracy. However, existing refinement methods often overlook the topological relationships between trajectories, which are vital for improving prediction precision. Inspired by braid theory, we propose a novel trajectory refinement approach, Soft-Braid Refiner (SRefiner), guided by the soft-braid topological structure of trajectories using Soft-Braid Attention. Soft-Braid Attention captures spatio-temporal topological relationships between trajectories by considering both spatial proximity and vehicle motion states at "soft intersection points". Additionally, we extend this approach to model interactions between trajectories and lanes, further improving the prediction accuracy. SRefiner is a multi-iteration, multi-agent framework that iteratively refines trajectories, incorporating topological information to enhance interactions within traffic scenarios. SRefiner achieves significant performance improvements over four baseline methods across two datasets, establishing a new state-of-the-art in trajectory refinement.
authors: Liwen Xiao, Zhiyu Pan, Zhicheng Wang, Zhiguo Cao, Wei Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 960-969

title: SSVQ:通过符号分割释放向量量化的潜力
title_en: SSVQ: Unleashing the Potential of Vector Quantization with Sign-Splitting
abstract: 向量量化(VQ)作为一种显著的权重压缩技术,已在多种模型中展现出比均匀量化更低的量化误差,特别是在极端压缩场景中。然而,其在微调过程中的效果受到压缩格式的限制,同一码字分配的权重向量只能进行同方向更新,导致许多量化权重被迫与局部梯度信息相反的方向移动。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新颖的VQ范式——符号分割VQ(SSVQ),将权重的符号位与码本分离。我们的方法包括提取未压缩权重的符号位,并对所有正权重进行聚类和压缩。随后,我们引入隐变量用于符号位,并联合优化符号和码本。此外,我们实施了可学习符号的渐进冻结策略以确保训练稳定性。在多种现代模型和任务上的大量实验表明,SSVQ在压缩-精度权衡上显著优于传统VQ。进一步地,我们在硬件加速器上验证了该算法,结果显示SSVQ通过减少内存访问,相比8位压缩模型实现了3倍的速度提升。我们的代码可在https://github.com/list0830/SSVQ获取。
abstract_en: Vector Quantization (VQ) has emerged as a prominent weight compression technique, showcasing substantially lower quantization errors than uniform quantization across diverse models, particularly in extreme compression scenarios. However, its efficacy during fine-tuning is limited by the constraint of the compression format, where weight vectors assigned to the same codeword are restricted to updates in the same direction. Consequently, many quantized weights are compelled to move in directions contrary to their local gradient information. To mitigate this issue, we introduce a novel VQ paradigm, Sign-Splitting VQ (SSVQ), which decouples the sign bit of weights from the codebook. Our approach involves extracting the sign bits of uncompressed weights and performing clustering and compression on all-positive weights. We then introduce latent variables for the sign bit and jointly optimize both the signs and the codebook. Additionally, we implement a progressive freezing strategy for the learnable sign to ensure training stability. Extensive experiments on various modern models and tasks demonstrate that SSVQ achieves a significantly superior compression-accuracy trade-off compared to conventional VQ. Furthermore, we validate our algorithm on a hardware accelerator, showing that SSVQ achieves a 3x speedup over the 8-bit compressed model by reducing memory access. Our code is available at https://github.com/list0830/SSVQ.
authors: Shuaiting Li, Juncan Deng, Chengxuan Wang, Kedong Xu, Rongtao Deng, Hong Gu, Haibin Shen, Kejie Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23710-23719

title: STAR: 基于文本到视频模型的时空增强现实世界视频超分辨率
title_en: STAR: Spatial-Temporal Augmentation with Text-to-Video Models for Real-World Video Super-Resolution
abstract: 图像扩散模型已被应用于现实世界视频超分辨率以解决基于生成对抗网络方法中的过平滑问题。然而,这些模型在保持时间一致性方面存在困难,因为它们是基于静态图像进行训练的,限制了其有效捕捉时间动态的能力。将文本到视频(T2V)模型集成到视频超分辨率中以改进时间建模是直接的。然而,两个关键挑战依然存在:现实场景中复杂退化引入的伪影,以及强大T2V模型(如CogVideoX-5B)的强生成能力导致的保真度下降。为提升恢复视频的时空质量,我们提出STAR(基于T2V模型的时空增强现实世界视频超分辨率),一种新颖方法,利用T2V模型进行现实世界视频超分辨率,实现逼真的空间细节和稳健的时间一致性。具体而言,我们在全局注意力块前引入局部信息增强模块(LIEM)以丰富局部细节并缓解退化伪影。此外,我们提出动态频率(DF)损失以强化保真度,引导模型在扩散步骤中关注不同频率成分。大量实验表明,STAR在合成数据集和现实世界数据集上均优于最先进的方法。
abstract_en: Image diffusion models have been adapted for real-world video super-resolution to tackle over-smoothing issues in GAN-based methods. However, these models struggle to maintain temporal consistency, as they are trained on static images, limiting their ability to capture temporal dynamics effectively. Integrating text-to-video (T2V) models into video super-resolution for improved temporal modeling is straightforward. However, two key challenges remain: artifacts introduced by complex degradations in real-world scenarios, and compromised fidelity due to the strong generative capacity of powerful T2V models (e.g., CogVideoX-5B). To enhance the spatio-temporal quality of restored videos, we introduce STAR (Spatial-Temporal Augmentation with T2V models for Real-world video super-resolution), a novel approach that leverages T2V models for real-world video super-resolution, achieving realistic spatial details and robust temporal consistency. Specifically, we introduce a Local Information Enhancement Module (LIEM) before the global attention block to enrich local details and mitigate degradation artifacts. Moreover, we propose a Dynamic Frequency (DF) Loss to reinforce fidelity, guiding the modelto focus on different frequency components across diffusion steps. Extensive experiments demonstrate STAR outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
authors: Rui Xie, Yinhong Liu, Penghao Zhou, Chen Zhao, Jun Zhou, Kai Zhang, Zhenyu Zhang, Jian Yang, Zhenheng Yang, Ying Tai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17108-17118

title: STD-GS:探索帧-事件交互的时空解耦高斯点云以重建高动态场景
title_en: STD-GS: Exploring Frame-Event Interaction for SpatioTemporal-Disentangled Gaussian Splatting to Reconstruct High-Dynamic Scene
abstract: 高动态场景重建旨在通过刚性空间特征表示静态背景,通过变形的连续时空特征表示动态物体。通常,现有方法采用统一表示模型(如高斯)直接匹配动态场景的时空特征。然而,这种统一范式由于帧成像导致的潜在时间特征不连续性以及背景与物体之间的异质空间特征,难以有效处理。在本工作中,我们引入事件相机以补偿帧相机,并提出一种时空解耦的高斯点云框架用于高动态场景重建。针对动态场景,我们发现基于帧的空间特征中背景与物体存在外观差异,基于事件的时间特征中存在运动差异,这促使我们通过聚类区分背景与物体的时空特征。针对动态物体,我们发现高斯表示与事件数据共享一致的时空特性,可作为先验引导物体高斯的时空解耦。在高斯点云框架中,累积的场景-物体解耦可提升背景与物体的时空区分度,从而渲染时间连续的动态场景。大量实验验证了我们方法的优越性。
abstract_en: High-dynamic scene reconstruction aims to represent static background with rigid spatial features and dynamic objects with deformed continuous spatiotemporal features. Typically, existing methods adopt unified representation model (e.g., Gaussian) to directly match the spatiotemporal features of dynamic scene from frame camera. However, this unified paradigm fails in the potential discontinuous temporal features of objects due to frame imaging and the heterogeneous spatial features between background and objects. In this work, we introduce event camera to compensate for frame camera, and propose a spatiotemporal-disentangled Gaussian splatting framework for high-dynamic scene reconstruction. As for dynamic scene, we figure out that background and objects have appearance discrepancy in frame-based spatial features and motion discrepancy in event-based temporal features, which motivates us to distinguish the spatiotemporal features between background and objects via clustering. As for dynamic object, we discover that Gaussian representations and event data share the consistent spatiotemporal characteristic, which could serve as a prior to guide the spatiotemporal disentanglement of object Gaussians. Within Gaussian splatting framework, the cumulative scene-object disentanglement can improve the spatiotemporal discrimination between background and objects to render the time-continuous dynamic scene. Extensive experiments are performed to verify the superiority of our method.
authors: Hanyu Zhou, Haonan Wang, Haoyue Liu, Yuxing Duan, Luxin Yan, Gim Hee Lee ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24801-24810

title: STDDNet: 基于空间对齐时间建模与判别性动态表示学习的Mamba视频息肉分割
title_en: STDDNet: Harnessing Mamba for Video Polyp Segmentation via Spatial-aligned Temporal Modeling and Discriminative Dynamic Representation Learning
abstract: 结肠镜视频中息肉的自动化分割对临床具有重要意义,可辅助临床医生进行准确诊断和精准干预。然而,视频息肉分割(VPS)面临息肉边界模糊、连续帧间息肉尺度、对比度和位置变化等挑战。此外,为满足临床需求,推理必须实时运行以实现术中跟踪与指导。本文提出一种新颖高效的分割网络STDDNet,通过整合空间对齐时间建模策略和判别性动态表示学习机制,结合Mamba的优势全面解决上述挑战。具体而言,设计了空间对齐时间依赖传播(STDP)模块,基于双向扫描Mamba块建模连续帧的时间一致性。进一步,设计了判别性动态特征提取(DDFE)模块,从Mamba块生成的结构特征中探索帧级动态信息。此类动态特征可有效应对结肠镜帧间的差异,为精细化分割提供更丰富的细节。我们在两个基准数据集SUN-SEG和CVC-ClinicDB上对STDDNet进行了广泛评估,结果表明其分割性能优于现有先进方法,同时保持实时推理能力。代码已开源至https://github.com/C-GLGLGL/STDDNet。
abstract_en: Automated segmentation of polyps from colonoscopy videos is of great clinical significance as it can assist clinicians in making accurate diagnoses and precise interventions. However, video polyp segmentation (VPS) is challenging due to ambiguous polyp boundaries, as well as variations in polyp scale, contrast, and position across consecutive frames. Moreover, to meet clinical requirements, the inference must operate in real-time to enable intraoperative tracking and guidance. In this paper, we propose a novel and efficient segmentation network, STDDNet, which integrates a spatial-aligned temporal modeling strategy and a discriminative dynamic representation learning mechanism, to comprehensively address these challenges by harnessing the advantages of Mamba. Specifically, a spatial-aligned temporal dependency propagation (STDP) module is developed to model temporal consistency from the consecutive frames based on a bidirectional scanning Mamba block. Furthermore, we design a discriminative dynamic feature extraction (DDFE) module to explore frame-wise dynamic information from the structural feature generated by the Mamba block. Such dynamic features can effectively deal with the variations across colonoscopy frames, providing more details for refined segmentation. We extensively evaluate STDDNet on two benchmark datasets, SUN-SEG and CVC-ClinicDB, demonstrating superior segmentation performance compared to state-of-the-art methods while maintaining real-time inference. Codes are available at https://github.com/C-GLGLGL/STDDNet.
authors: Guilian Chen, Huisi Wu, Jing Qin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21364-21373

title: STEP-DETR:基于DETR的半监督目标检测方法:结合超级教师与伪标签引导的文本查询提升
title_en: STEP-DETR: Advancing DETR-based Semi-Supervised Object Detection with Super Teacher and Pseudo-Label Guided Text Queries
abstract: 本文针对当前半监督目标检测(SSOD)框架中的关键局限性,重点解决伪标签质量、置信度偏差和低效查询生成等问题。传统方法,包括基于CNN和基于DETR的架构,常面临噪声伪标签、对常见物体类别的过拟合,从而导致稀有物体检测困难。具体而言,近期基于DETR的SSOD方法在一对一到多对一的分配策略中表现不佳,产生噪声伪标签和重叠预测,导致性能欠佳。为解决这些挑战,我们提出STEP-DETR,一种基于Transformer的SSOD框架。STEP-DETR引入超级教师生成高质量伪标签并优化学生的学习过程。此外,STEP-DETR提出伪标签文本查询,通过整合超级教师的文本嵌入,平衡学生对常见和稀有类别的置信度,从而缓解置信度偏差并提升泛化能力。同时,去噪文本引导的目标查询利用对比学习合成前景和背景的查询-标签对,使模型更有效地区分物体与背景噪声。为进一步提升性能和训练效率,引入查询精炼模块以过滤冗余的去噪查询。在MS-COCO和Pascal VOC基准测试中,STEP-DETR超越了现有最先进方法,证明了其在提升半监督目标检测的有效性。值得注意的是,仅使用10%的标注数据时,其mAP达到45.4,超越基线Semi-DETR 1.9 mAP。
abstract_en: This paper addresses key limitations in current Semi-Supervised Object Detection (SSOD) frameworks, focusing on issues related to pseudo-label quality, confidence bias, and inefficient query generation. Traditional methods, including CNN-based and DETR-based architectures, often face challenges such as noisy pseudo-labels, overfitting to common object categories, and consequently face difficulty detecting rare objects. Specifically, recent DETR-based SSOD approaches struggle with the one-to-many assignment strategy, which produces noisy pseudo-labels and overlapping predictions, resulting in suboptimal performance. To address these challenges, we propose STEP-DETR, a transformer-based SSOD framework. STEP-DETR introduces Super Teacher to generate higher-quality pseudo-labels and improve the student's learning process. Furthermore, STEP-DETR proposes Pseudo-Label Text Queries, which incorporate text embeddings from Super Teacher, balancing the student's confidence across common and rare categories, thereby mitigating confidence bias and enhancing generalization. Moreover, Denoising Text Guided Object Queries synthesizes query-label pairs for foreground and background using contrastive learning, enabling the model to better distinguish objects from background noise. To further boost performance and training efficiency, a Query Refinement Module is incorporated to filter out redundant denoising queries. On MS-COCO and Pascal VOC benchmarks, STEP-DETR outperforms state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in improving semi-supervised object detection. Notably, with just 10% labeled data, it achieves 45.4 mAP, surpassing the baseline Semi-DETR by 1.9 mAP.
authors: Tahira Shehzadi, Khurram Azeem Hashmi, Shalini Sarode, Didier Stricker, Muhammad Zeshan Afzal ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3069-3079

title: STI-Bench:多模态大语言模型是否已准备好进行精确的时空世界理解?
title_en: STI-Bench: Are MLLMs Ready for Precise Spatial-Temporal World Understanding?
abstract: 将多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)作为具身智能和自动驾驶的端到端解决方案已成为主流趋势。尽管MLLMs在视觉语义理解任务上已得到广泛研究,但其在现实应用中进行精确且定量的时空理解的能力仍 largely unexamined,导致前景不明。为了解决这一问题,我们引入了ST-Bench,这是一个基准测试,通过诸如估计和预测物体的外观、姿态、位移和运动等具有挑战性的任务来评估MLLMs的时空理解能力。我们的基准测试涵盖了桌面、室内和室外场景中的广泛机器人和车辆操作。大量实验表明,最先进的MLLMs在现实世界的时空理解上仍存在困难,尤其是在需要精确距离估计和运动分析的任务中。
abstract_en: The use of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) as an end-to-end solution for Embodied AI and Autonomous Driving has become a prevailing trend. While MLLMs have been extensively studied for visual semantic understanding tasks, their ability to perform precise and quantitative spatial-temporal understanding in real-world applications remains largely unexamined, leading to uncertain prospects. To address this gap, we introduce ST-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate MLLMs' spatial-temporal understanding through challenging tasks such as estimating and predicting the appearance, pose, displacement, and motion of objects. Our benchmark encompasses a wide range of robot and vehicle operations across desktop, indoor, and outdoor scenarios. The extensive experiments reveals that the state-of-the-art MLLMs still struggle in real-world spatial-temporal understanding, especially in tasks requiring precise distance estimation and motion analysis.
authors: Yun Li, Yiming Zhang, Tao Lin, Xiangrui Liu, Wenxiao Cai, Zheng Liu, Bo Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5622-5632

title: STIV:可扩展的文本和图像条件视频生成
title_en: STIV: Scalable Text and Image Conditioned Video Generation
abstract: 我们提出了一种简单且可扩展的文本和图像条件视频生成方法。我们的方法STIV通过帧替换将可变数量的图像条件集成到扩散变换器(DiT)中。这种设计使STIV能够同时执行文本到视频(T2V)和文本-图像到视频(TI2V)任务,并通过自回归展开实现长视频生成。此外,STIV可以轻松扩展到视频预测、帧插值和多视角生成等各类应用。通过对T2I、T2V、TI2V和长视频生成进行全面的消融研究,STIV在简单设计下展现出强大的性能。一个分辨率为(512^2)的8.7B模型在VBench T2V任务中取得83.1的得分,超越了包括CogVideoX-5B、Pika、Kling和Gen-3在内的领先开源和闭源模型。相同规模的模型在VBench I2V任务中(512^2分辨率)也取得了90.1的最先进结果。综合所有这些成果,我们将模型扩展至540p分辨率并包含超过200帧。通过提供构建前沿视频生成模型的透明方案,我们旨在赋能未来研究并加速视频生成领域的发展。
abstract_en: We present a simple and scalable text and image conditioned video generation method. Our approach, named STIV, integrates a variable number of image conditions into a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) through frame replacement. This design enables STIV to perform both text-to-video (T2V) and text-image-to-video (TI2V) tasks simultaneously, as well as long video generation through autoregressive rollouts.Additionally, STIV can be easily extended to various applications, such as video prediction, frame interpolation, and multi-view generation, etc.With comprehensive ablation studies on T2I, T2V, TI2V, and long video generation, STIV demonstrate strong performance, despite its simple design. An 8.7B model with (512^2) resolution achieves 83.1 on VBench T2V, surpassing both leading open and closed-source models like CogVideoX-5B, Pika, Kling, and Gen-3. The same-sized model also achieves a state-of-the-art result of 90.1 on VBench I2V task at (512^2) resolution. Combine all of these, we finally scale up our model to 540p with over 200 frames. By providing a transparent recipe for building cutting-edge video generation models, we aim to empower future research and accelerate progress for video generation.
authors: Zongyu Lin, Wei Liu, Chen Chen, Jiasen Lu, Wenze Hu, Tsu-Jui Fu, Jesse Allardice, Zhengfeng Lai, Liangchen Song, Bowen Zhang, Cha Chen, Yiran Fei, Lezhi Li, Yinfei Yang, Yizhou Sun, Kai-Wei Chang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16249-16259

title: STaR:基于穿透与一致性约束的无缝时空感知运动重定向
title_en: STaR: Seamless Spatial-Temporal Aware Motion Retargeting with Penetration and Consistency Constraints
abstract: 运动重定向旨在将源角色的时空运动特征忠实地映射到具有不同身体形状的目标角色上。除了运动语义的保持,确保几何合理性与维持时间一致性对于有效的运动重定向同样关键。然而,许多现有方法更侧重于几何合理性或时间一致性。忽略几何合理性会导致相互穿透,而忽略时间一致性则会产生运动抖动。本文提出了一种新颖的序列到序列模型,用于无缝时空感知运动重定向(STaR),并引入了穿透与一致性约束。STaR包含两个模块:(1)空间模块,结合密集形状表示和新颖的肢体穿透约束,以确保几何合理性同时保持运动语义;(2)时间模块,利用时间变压器和新颖的时间一致性约束,一次性预测完整运动序列并强制多级轨迹平滑。两个模块的无缝结合使我们能够在语义、几何和时间目标之间取得良好平衡。在Mixamo和ScanRet数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在保持运动合理性和连贯性的同时,相比其他方法显著降低了相互穿透率。Code page: https://github.com/XiaohangYang829/STaR.
abstract_en: Motion retargeting seeks to faithfully replicate the spatio-temporal motion characteristics of a source character onto a target character with a different body shape. Apart from motion semantics preservation, ensuring geometric plausibility and maintaining temporal consistency are also crucial for effective motion retargeting. However, many existing methods prioritize either geometric plausibility or temporal consistency. Neglecting geometric plausibility results in interpenetration, while neglecting temporal consistency leads to motion jitter. In this paper, we propose a novel sequence-to-sequence model for seamless Spatial-Temporal aware motion Retargeting (STaR), with penetration and consistency constraints. STaR consists of two modules: (1) a spatial module that incorporates dense shape representation and a novel limb penetration constraint to ensure geometric plausibility while preserving motion semantics, and (2) a temporal module that utilizes a temporal transformer and a novel temporal consistency constraint to predict the entire motion sequence at once while enforcing multi-level trajectory smoothness. The seamless combination of the two modules helps us achieve a good balance between the semantic, geometric, and temporal targets. Extensive experiments on the Mixamo and ScanRet datasets demonstrate that our method produces plausible and coherent motions while significantly reducing interpenetration rates compared with other approaches. Code page: https://github.com/XiaohangYang829/STaR.
authors: Xiaohang Yang, Qing Wang, Jiahao Yang, Gregory Slabaugh, Shanxin Yuan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12947-12955

title: SU-RGS:无约束光照条件下基于稀疏视角的可重光照三维高斯点云
title_en: SU-RGS: Relightable 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Views under Unconstrained Illuminations
abstract: 当前场景重光照技术的最新进展主要依赖于基于三维高斯点云(3DGS)的逆渲染方法。然而,现有方法仍过度依赖静态光照条件下的密集采样图像,这在现实场景中成本过高且不切实际。本文提出了一种新颖的无约束光照条件下基于稀疏视角的可重光照三维高斯点云方法(称为SU-RGS),通过仅使用稀疏输入视角联合优化3DGS表示、表面材质和环境光照(即训练中的未知且多样化的光照条件)来解决这一挑战。首先,SU-RGS提出了一种变化的外观渲染策略,使每个三维高斯点云能在不同光照条件下呈现不一致的颜色。其次,SU-RGS通过构建跨视角的层次化语义伪标签,建立多视角语义一致性,以补偿额外监督并促进应对无约束光照条件的稀疏逆渲染。此外,我们引入了一种自适应瞬态物体感知组件,以细粒度方式融合场景几何与语义信息,量化并消除前景的不确定性。在合成和真实世界挑战性数据集上的大量实验验证了SU-RGS的有效性,通过仅从无约束光照条件下的稀疏视角学习3DGS,实现了场景逆渲染的最先进性能。
abstract_en: The latest advancements in scene relighting have been predominantly driven by inverse rendering with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). However, existing methods remain overly reliant on densely sampled images under static illumination conditions, which is prohibitively expensive and even impractical in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel learning from Sparse views under Unconstrained illuminations Relightable 3D Gaussian Splatting (dubbed SU-RGS), to address this challenge by jointly optimizing 3DGS representations, surface materials, and environment illuminations (i.e., unknown and various lighting conditions in training) using only sparse input views. Firstly, SU-RGS presents a varying appearance rendering strategy, enabling each 3D Gaussian can perform inconsistent color under various lightings. Next, SU-RGS establishes the multi-view semantic consistency by constructing hierarchical semantics pseudo-labels across inter-views, to compensate for extra supervisions and facilitate sparse inverse rendering for confronting unconstrained illuminations. Additionally, we introduce an adaptive transient object perception component that integrates the scene geometry and semantics in a fine-grained manner, to quantify and eliminate the uncertainty of the foreground. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world challenging datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of SU-RGS, achieving the state-of-the-art performance for scene inverse rendering by learning 3DGS from only sparse views under unconstrained illuminations.
authors: Qi Zhang, Chi Huang, Qian Zhang, Nan Li, Wei Feng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26859-26868

title: SUB: 通过合成属性替换对概念瓶颈模型泛化能力的基准测试
title_en: SUB: Benchmarking CBM Generalization via Synthetic Attribute Substitutions
abstract: 概念瓶颈模型(CBMs)及其他基于概念的可解释模型在提升人工智能应用透明度方面展现出巨大潜力,这对于医学等关键领域至关重要。尽管取得了成功,我们证明CBMs在分布偏移下难以可靠地识别正确概念。为评估CBMs对概念变化的鲁棒性,我们引入SUB:一个包含38,400张基于CUB数据集的合成图像的细粒度图像与概念基准。为构建SUB,我们从CUB数据集中选取33个鸟类类别和45个概念,生成替换特定概念(如翅膀颜色或腹部图案)的图像。我们提出了一种新颖的联合扩散引导(Tied Diffusion Guidance, TDG)方法,通过两个并行去噪过程的噪声共享,精确控制生成图像,确保正确生成鸟类类别和属性。该新颖基准使CBMs及类似可解释模型的严格评估成为可能,有助于开发更鲁棒的方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/ExplainableML/sub获取,数据集可在http://huggingface.co/datasets/Jessica-bader/SUB获取。
abstract_en: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) and other concept-based interpretable models show great promise for making AI applications more transparent, which is essential in fields like medicine. Despite their success, we demonstrate that CBMs struggle to reliably identify the correct concepts under distribution shifts. To assess the robustness of CBMs to concept variations, we introduce SUB: a fine-grained image and concept benchmark containing 38,400 synthetic images based on the CUB dataset. To create SUB, we select a CUB subset of 33 bird classes and 45 concepts to generate images which substitute a specific concept, such as wing color or belly pattern. We introduce a novel Tied Diffusion Guidance (TDG) method to precisely control generated images, where noise sharing for two parallel denoising processes ensures that both the correct bird class and the correct attribute are generated. This novel benchmark enables rigorous evaluation of CBMs and similar interpretable models, contributing to the development of more robust methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/ExplainableML/sub and the dataset at http://huggingface.co/datasets/Jessica-bader/SUB.
authors: Jessica Bader, Leander Girrbach, Stephan Alaniz, Zeynep Akata ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23188-23198

title: 基于文本嵌入的语义调制视频内容抑制方法(SUV)
title_en: SUV: Suppressing Undesired Video Content via Semantic Modulation Based on Text Embeddings
abstract: 近年来,文本驱动的扩散模型显著推动了视频编辑的发展。然而,仍存在两个实际挑战:(1)现有文本到视频编辑方法难以理解负面文本提示,导致编辑视频中不期望内容的抑制效果不佳;(2)这些方法难以保持编辑视频的时间一致性,导致帧间闪烁。为解决上述挑战,我们提出SUV,一种基于文本嵌入的新型语义调制方法,用于抑制编辑视频中的不期望内容。具体而言,一方面,我们发现端嵌入(EE)包含大量耦合的正负嵌入,这是编辑视频中出现不期望内容的主要原因。基于这一发现,我们通过奇异值分解将负嵌入从EE中解耦,并提出指数抑制算子以降低负嵌入的奇异值,从而抑制负嵌入对编辑视频内容的影响。随后,设计了两种约束,通过推动负嵌入远离和拉近正嵌入以进一步抑制负内容,同时保持正内容不变。另一方面,为提升编辑视频的时间一致性,我们设计了一种模糊特征选择策略,融合不同帧中的相似特征以避免帧间闪烁。得益于上述精心设计,我们的方法不仅有效抑制了视频中的不期望内容,还保持了帧间一致性。大量实验表明,与现有方法相比,我们的SUV显著提升了编辑视频的编辑准确性和时间一致性。
abstract_en: Recently, text-driven diffusion models have significantly promoted the development of video editing. However, there still remain two practical challenges: (1) existing text-to-video editing methods struggle to understand negative text prompt, resulting in ineffective suppression of undesirable content in edited video; (2) these methods are difficult to maintain the temporal consistency of the edited video, leading to inter-frame flickering. To address the above challenges, we propose SUV, a novel semantic modulation method based on text embeddings to suppress undesired content in the edited video. Specifically, on the one hand, we discover that the end embeddings (EE) contain substantial coupled positive and negative embeddings, which is the primary reason for the appearance of undesirable content in the edited video. Based on this discovery, we advocate decoupling the negative embeddings from the EE by employing singular value decomposition and propose an exponential suppression operator to decrease the singular values of negative embeddings, thereby restraining the effect of negative embeddings on the edited video content. Subsequently, two constraints are designed to further suppress negative content while keep positive content unchanged via pushing negative embeddings apart and pulling positive embeddings closer. On the other hand, to boost the temporal consistency of edited video, we devise a fuzzy feature selection strategy to fuse similar features in different frame for avoiding inter-frame flickering. Benefiting from the above elaborate designs, our method not only effectively suppresses undesired content of video, but also maintains inter-frame consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our SUV significantly improves edit accuracy and temporal consistency of edited videos compared to existing methods.
authors: Xiang Lv, Mingwen Shao, Lingzhuang Meng, Chang Liu, Yecong Wan, Xinyuan Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18357-18366

title: SV4D 2.0:增强多视角视频扩散中时空一致性以实现高质量4D生成
title_en: SV4D 2.0: Enhancing Spatio-Temporal Consistency in Multi-View Video Diffusion for High-Quality 4D Generation
abstract: 我们提出Stable Video 4D 2.0(SV4D 2.0),一种用于动态3D资产生成的多视角视频扩散模型。与前代SV4D相比,SV4D 2.0对遮挡和大范围运动更具鲁棒性,对真实世界视频的泛化能力更强,在细节锐度和时空一致性方面生成更高质量的输出。我们通过在多个方面引入关键改进实现了这一目标:1)网络架构:消除对参考多视角的依赖,设计3D与帧注意力的混合机制;2)数据:提升训练数据的质量和数量;3)训练策略:采用渐进式3D-4D训练以获得更好的泛化能力;4)4D优化:通过两阶段细化和渐进式帧采样处理3D不一致性和大范围运动。大量实验表明,SV4D 2.0在视觉和定量指标上均取得显著性能提升,在新视角视频合成和4D优化中分别实现更好的细节(-14% LPIPS)和4D一致性(-44% FV4D),相比SV4D分别提升-12% LPIPS和-24% FV4D。
abstract_en: We present Stable Video 4D 2.0 (SV4D 2.0), a multi-view video diffusion model for dynamic 3D asset generation. Compared to its predecessor SV4D, SV4D 2.0 is more robust to occlusions and large motion, generalizes better to real-world videos, and produces higher-quality outputs in terms of detail sharpness and spatio-temporal consistency. We achieve this by introducing key improvements in multiple aspects: 1) network architecture: eliminating the dependency of reference multi-views and designing blending mechanism for 3D and frame attention, 2) data: enhancing quality and quantity of training data, 3) training strategy: adopting progressive 3D-4D training for better generalization, and 4) 4D optimization: handling 3D inconsistency and large motion via 2-stage refinement and progressive frame sampling. Extensive experiments demonstrate significant performance gain by SV4D 2.0 both visually and quantitatively, achieving better detail (-14% LPIPS) and 4D consistency (-44% FV4D) in novel-view video synthesis and 4D optimization (-12% LPIPS and -24% FV4D) compared to SV4D.
authors: Chun-Han Yao, Yiming Xie, Vikram Voleti, Huaizu Jiang, Varun Jampani ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13248-13258

title: SVG-Head:面向高保真头部重建与实时编辑的混合表面-体积高斯分布
title_en: SVG-Head: Hybrid Surface-Volumetric Gaussians for High-Fidelity Head Reconstruction and Real-Time Editing
abstract: 在计算机视觉和图形学中,创建高保真且可编辑的头部虚拟形象是一项关键挑战,促进了众多AR/VR应用的发展。尽管近期进展已实现了逼真的渲染效果和合理的动画效果,但头部编辑,尤其是实时外观编辑,仍因几何形状与全局外观的隐式表示和纠缠建模而具有挑战性。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新的混合表示方法——表面-体积高斯头像(SVG-Head),该方法通过绑定在FLAME网格上的3D高斯分布显式建模几何形状,并利用解耦的纹理图像来捕捉全局外观。技术上,该方法包含两种类型的高斯分布:表面高斯分布通过可学习的纹理图像显式建模头像的外观,从而实现实时纹理编辑;而体积高斯分布则提升了非朗伯区域(如嘴唇和头发)的重建质量。为了建模3D世界与纹理空间之间的对应关系,我们提供了一种网格感知的高斯UV映射方法,该方法利用FLAME网格提供的UV坐标获取锐利的纹理图像并实现实时渲染速度。进一步设计了一种分层优化策略,以在重建质量和编辑灵活性方面追求最佳性能。在NeRSemble数据集上的实验表明,SVG-Head不仅生成高保真渲染结果,而且是首个能够获取高斯头像的显式纹理图像并支持实时外观编辑的方法。
abstract_en: Creating high-fidelity and editable head avatars is a pivotal challenge in computer vision and graphics, boosting many AR/VR applications. While recent advancements have achieved photorealistic renderings and plausible animation, head editing, especially real-time appearance editing, remains challenging due to the implicit representation and entangled modeling of the geometry and global appearance. To address this, we propose Surface-Volumetric Gaussian Head Avatar (SVG-Head), a novel hybrid representation that explicitly models the geometry with 3D Gaussians bound on a FLAME mesh and leverages disentangled texture images to capture the global appearance. Technically, it contains two types of Gaussians, in which surface Gaussians explicitly model the appearance of head avatars using learnable texture images, facilitating real-time texture editing, while volumetric Gaussians enhance the reconstruction quality of non-Lambertian regions (e.g., lips and hair). To model the correspondence between 3D world and texture space, we provide a mesh-aware Gaussian UV mapping method, which leverages UV coordinates given by the FLAME mesh to obtain sharp texture images and real-time rendering speed. A hierarchical optimization strategy is further designed to pursue the optimal performance in both reconstruction quality and editing flexibility. Experiments on the NeRSemble dataset show that SVG-Head not only generates high-fidelity rendering results, but also is the first method to obtain explicit texture images for Gaussian head avatars and support real-time appearance editing.
authors: Heyi Sun, Cong Wang, Tian-Xing Xu, Jingwei Huang, Di Kang, Chunchao Guo, Song-Hai Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13326-13335

title: SVIP: 语义上下文感知的视觉补丁用于零样本学习
title_en: SVIP: Semantically Contextualized Visual Patches for Zero-Shot Learning
abstract: 零样本学习(ZSL)旨在通过利用类级语义描述符(如属性)来识别没有标注训练示例的未见类别。ZSL中的一个根本性挑战是语义错位,其中视觉特征中包含的语义无关信息会引入视觉-语义交互的歧义。与现有方法在特征空间或模型空间中事后抑制语义无关信息不同,我们提出在输入阶段解决这一问题,防止语义无关补丁通过网络传播。为此,我们为ZSL引入了语义上下文化的视觉补丁(SVIP),这是一种基于Transformer的框架,旨在增强视觉-语义对齐。具体而言,我们提出了一种自监督补丁选择机制,该机制预先学习在输入空间中识别语义无关补丁。该机制通过所有Transformer层的聚合注意力分数进行监督训练,以估计每个补丁的语义得分。由于从输入序列中移除语义无关补丁可能会破坏物体结构,我们将其替换为可学习的补丁嵌入。通过以词嵌入进行初始化,我们可以确保这些嵌入在整个特征提取过程中保持语义意义。在ZSL基准上的大量实验表明,SVIP在实现最先进性能的同时,提供了更具解释性和语义丰富的特征表示。代码可在https://github.com/uqzhichen/SVIP获取。
abstract_en: Zero-shot learning (ZSL) aims to recognize unseen classes without labeled training examples by leveraging class-level semantic descriptors such as attributes. A fundamental challenge in ZSL is semantic misalignment, where semantic-unrelated information involved in visual features introduce ambiguity to visual-semantic interaction. Unlike existing methods that suppress semantic-unrelated information post hoc either in the feature space or the model space, we propose addressing this issue at the input stage, preventing semantic-unrelated patches from propagating through the network. To this end, we introduce Semantically contextualized VIsual Patches (SVIP) for ZSL, a transformer-based framework designed to enhance visual-semantic alignment. Specifcally, we propose a self-supervised patch selection mechanism that preemptively learns to identify semantic-unrelated patches in the input space. This is trained with the supervision from aggregated attention scores across all transformer layers, which estimate each patch's semantic score. As removing semantic-unrelated patches from the input sequence may disrupt object structure, we replace them with learnable patch embeddings. With initialization from word embeddings, we can ensure they remain semantically meaningful throughout feature extraction. Extensive experiments on ZSL benchmarks demonstrate that SVIP achieves state-of-the-art performance results while providing more interpretable and semantically rich feature representations. Code is available at https://github.com/uqzhichen/SVIP.
authors: Zhi Chen, Zecheng Zhao, Jingcai Guo, Jingjing Li, Zi Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3346-3356

title: SVTRv2: CTC在场景文本识别中超越编码器-解码器模型
title_en: SVTRv2: CTC Beats Encoder-Decoder Models in Scene Text Recognition
abstract: 基于连接主义时序分类(CTC)的场景文本识别(STR)方法,例如SVTR,由于其仅包含视觉模型和CTC对齐线性分类器的简单架构以及快速推理能力,被广泛应用于OCR应用。然而,它们通常在文本不规则性和语言缺失方面表现较差,导致准确率低于基于编码器-解码器的方法(EDTRs)。为解决这些挑战,我们提出SVTRv2,这是一种具备处理文本不规则性并建模语言上下文能力的CTC模型。首先,提出多尺寸重缩放策略,将文本实例重缩放至预定义的适当尺寸,有效避免严重文本失真。同时,引入特征重排模块,确保视觉特征满足CTC需求,从而缓解对齐难题。其次,提出语义引导模块,将语言上下文整合至视觉特征中,使CTC模型能够利用语言信息提升准确率。该模块可在推理阶段省略,且不会增加时间成本。我们在标准和近期具有挑战性的基准数据集上广泛评估SVTRv2,其中SVTRv2在多种场景中与流行STR模型进行公平比较,包括不同类型文本不规则性、语言、长文本以及是否使用预训练。SVTRv2在准确率和推理速度方面超越了大多数EDTRs。Code: https://github.com/Topdu/OpenOCR.
abstract_en: Connectionist temporal classification (CTC)-based scene text recognition (STR) methods, e.g., SVTR, are widely employed in OCR applications, mainly due to their simple architecture, which only contains a visual model and a CTC-aligned linear classifier, and therefore fast inference. However, they generally exhibit worse accuracy than encoder-decoder-based methods (EDTRs) due to struggling with text irregularity and linguistic missing. To address these challenges, we propose SVTRv2, a CTC model endowed with the ability to handle text irregularities and model linguistic context. First, a multi-size resizing strategy is proposed to resize text instances to appropriate predefined sizes, effectively avoiding severe text distortion. Meanwhile, we introduce a feature rearrangement module to ensure that visual features accommodate the requirement of CTC, thus alleviating the alignment puzzle. Second, we propose a semantic guidance module. It integrates linguistic context into the visual features, allowing CTC model to leverage language information for accuracy improvement. This module can be omitted at the inference stage and would not increase the time cost. We extensively evaluate SVTRv2 in both standard and recent challenging benchmarks, where SVTRv2 is fairly compared to popular STR models across multiple scenarios, including different types of text irregularity, languages, long text, and whether employing pretraining. SVTRv2 surpasses most EDTRs across the scenarios in terms of accuracy and inference speed. Code: https://github.com/Topdu/OpenOCR.
authors: Yongkun Du, Zhineng Chen, Hongtao Xie, Caiyan Jia, Yu-Gang Jiang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20147-20156

title: SViM3D:单图像三维生成的稳定视频材质扩散
title_en: SViM3D: Stable Video Material Diffusion for Single Image 3D Generation
abstract: 我们提出Stable Video Materials 3D(SViM3D),一种框架,可根据单张图像预测多视角一致的基于物理的渲染(PBR)材质。近期,视频扩散模型已被成功用于高效地从单张图像重建3D物体。然而,反射率仍通过简单材质模型表示,或需要在额外的流程步骤中估计,以实现重光照和可控外观编辑。我们将潜在视频扩散模型扩展为输出空间变化的PBR参数和表面法线,这些参数与每个生成的RGB视角基于显式相机控制联合生成。这种独特的设置允许在2.5D环境中直接进行重光照,并利用我们的模型作为神经先验生成3D资产。我们向该流程引入了多种机制,以提升该欠定设置下的质量。我们在多个以物体为中心的数据集上展示了最先进的重光照和新视角合成性能。我们的方法可泛化到多样化的图像输入,从而生成可用于AR/VR、电影、游戏和其他视觉媒体的可重光照3D资产。
abstract_en: We present Stable Video Materials 3D (SViM3D), a framework to predict multi-view consistent physically based rendering (PBR) materials, given a single image. Recently, video diffusion models have been successfully used to reconstruct 3D objects from a single image efficiently. However, reflectance is still represented by simple material models or needs to be estimated in additional pipeline steps to enable relighting and controlled appearance edits. We extend a latent video diffusion model to output spatially-varying PBR parameters and surface normals jointly with each generated RGB view based on explicit camera control. This unique setup allows for direct relighting in a 2.5D setting, and for generating a 3D asset using our model as neural prior. We introduce various mechanisms to this pipeline that improve quality in this ill-posed setting. We show state-of-the-art relighting and novel view synthesis performance on multiple object-centric datasets. Our method generalizes to diverse image inputs, enabling the generation of relightable 3D assets useful in AR/VR, movies, games and other visual media.
authors: Andreas Engelhardt, Mark Boss, Vikram Voleti, Chun-Han Yao, Hendrik P. A. Lensch, Varun Jampani ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28428-28439

title: 视觉-语言模型的安全防护:缓解基于扰动攻击的高斯噪声脆弱性
title_en: Safeguarding Vision-Language Models: Mitigating Vulnerabilities to Gaussian Noise in Perturbation-based Attacks
abstract: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)通过融合视觉信息扩展了大语言模型(LLMs)的能力,但其仍易受越狱攻击,尤其是在处理噪声或损坏图像时。尽管现有VLMs在训练过程中采用安全措施以缓解此类攻击,但与噪声增强视觉输入相关的脆弱性被忽视。本工作中我们发现,缺乏噪声增强训练导致关键安全漏洞:许多VLMs对简单的扰动(如高斯噪声)都高度敏感。为解决这一挑战,我们提出Robust-VLGuard,一个包含对齐/错位图像-文本对的多模态安全数据集,并结合噪声增强微调,在保持VLM功能的同时降低攻击成功率。针对更强的基于优化的视觉扰动攻击,我们提出DiffPure-VLM,利用扩散模型将对抗性扰动转换为高斯噪声,此类噪声可通过噪声增强安全微调的VLM进行防御。实验结果表明,扩散模型的分布迁移特性与我们的微调VLMs高度契合,显著缓解了不同强度的对抗性扰动。数据集和代码可在https://github.com/JarvisUSTC/DiffPure-RobustVLM获取。
abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) extend the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating visual information, yet they remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, especially when processing noisy or corrupted images. Although existing VLMs adopt security measures during training to mitigate such attacks, vulnerabilities associated with noise-augmented visual inputs are overlooked. In this work, we identify that missing noise-augmented training causes critical security gaps: many VLMs are susceptible to even simple perturbations such as Gaussian noise. To address this challenge, we propose Robust-VLGuard, a multimodal safety dataset with aligned / misaligned image-text pairs, combined with noise-augmented fine-tuning that reduces attack success rates while preserving functionality of VLM. For stronger optimization-based visual perturbation attacks, we propose DiffPure-VLM, leveraging diffusion models to convert adversarial perturbations into Gaussian-like noise, which can be defended by VLMs with noise-augmented safety fine-tuning. Experimental results demonstrate that the distribution-shifting property of diffusion model aligns well with our fine-tuned VLMs, significantly mitigating adversarial perturbations across varying intensities. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/JarvisUSTC/DiffPure-RobustVLM.
authors: Jiawei Wang, Yushen Zuo, Yuanjun Chai, Zhendong Liu, Yicheng Fu, Yichun Feng, Kin-Man Lam ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2773-2782

title: 面向高效机器人控制的显著性感知量化模仿学习方法
title_en: Saliency-Aware Quantized Imitation Learning for Efficient Robotic Control
abstract: 基于深度神经网络(DNN)的策略模型,如视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型,在从多模态输入中自动化复杂决策方面表现出色。然而,模型规模的扩大显著增加了计算开销,给资源受限场景(如机器人操作和自动驾驶)的部署带来挑战。为解决这一问题,我们提出显著性感知量化模仿学习(\method),该方法结合量化感知训练与针对关键任务状态的选择性损失加权策略。通过显著性评分识别关键状态并在训练损失中强调这些状态,\method在低位精度下保持决策保真度。我们在大量模拟基准测试中验证了\method的泛化能力,包括环境变化、现实任务和跨域任务(自动驾驶、物理仿真),始终恢复全精度性能。值得注意的是,用于机器人操作的4位权重量化VLA模型在边缘GPU上实现最高2.5倍加速和2.5倍能耗节省,且仅损失少量精度。这些结果凸显了\method在资源受限设备上高效部署大型基于模仿学习(IL)策略模型的潜力。
abstract_en: Deep neural network (DNN)-based policy models, such as vision-language-action (VLA) models, excel at automating complex decision-making from multi-modal inputs. However, scaling these models greatly increases computational overhead, complicating deployment in resource-constrained settings like robot manipulation and autonomous driving. To address this, we propose Saliency-Aware Quantized Imitation Learning (\method), which combines quantization-aware training with a selective loss-weighting strategy for mission-critical states. By identifying these states via saliency scores and emphasizing them in the training loss, \method preserves decision fidelity under low-bit precision. We validate \method's generalization capability across extensive simulation benchmarks with environment variations, real-world tasks, and cross-domain tasks (self-driving, physics simulation), consistently recovering full-precision performance. Notably, a 4-bit weight-quantized VLA model for robotic manipulation achieves up to 2.5xspeedup and 2.5xenergy savings on an edge GPU with minimal accuracy loss. These results underline \method's potential for efficiently deploying large IL-based policy models on resource-limited devices.
authors: Seongmin Park, Hyungmin Kim, Sangwoo Kim, Wonseok Jeon, Juyoung Yang, Byeongwook Jeon, Yoonseon Oh, Jungwook Choi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13140-13150

title: 拯救被忽视的:利用类感知对比学习进行多类异常检测
title_en: Salvaging the Overlooked: Leveraging Class-Aware Contrastive Learning for Multi-Class Anomaly Detection
abstract: 在异常检测(AD)领域,早期方法通常为每个类别单独训练模型,虽然能获得高性能,但存在可扩展性和资源管理方面的挑战。近期研究转向训练单一模型以处理多类任务。然而,直接将早期AD方法扩展到多类设置时往往导致性能下降。本文研究了基于重构的方法中观察到的性能退化现象,识别出关键问题:类间混淆。这种混淆出现在多类场景中训练的模型错误地将某一类样本重构为另一类样本时,从而加剧重构误差。为此,我们提出了一种简单而有效的改进方法,称为类感知对比学习(CCL)。通过显式利用原始对象类别信息(如地毯或木材)作为监督信号,我们引入局部CL以优化多尺度密集特征,全局CL以获取更紧凑的正常模式特征表示,从而有效适应多类设置。在五个数据集上的实验验证了我们方法的有效性,展示了显著的性能提升和优于现有方法的优越表现。值得注意的是,消融研究表明伪类标签可实现相当的性能。
abstract_en: For anomaly detection (AD), early approaches often train separate models for individual classes, yielding high performance but posing challenges in scalability and resource management. Recent efforts have shifted toward training a single model capable of handling multiple classes. However, directly extending early AD methods to multi-class settings often results in degraded performance. In this paper, we investigate this performance degradation observed in reconstruction-based methods, identifying the key issue: inter-class confusion. This confusion emerges when a model trained in multi-class scenarios incorrectly reconstructs samples from one class as those of another, thereby exacerbating reconstruction errors. To this end, we propose a simple yet effective modification, called class-aware contrastive learning (CCL). By explicitly leveraging raw object category information (e.g., carpet or wood) as supervised signals, we introduce local CL to refine multiscale dense features, and global CL to obtain more compact feature representations of normal patterns, thereby effectively adapting the models to multi-class settings. Experiments across five datasets validate the effectiveness of our approach, demonstrating significant improvements and superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods. Notably, ablation studies indicate that pseudo-class labels can achieve comparable performance.
authors: Lei Fan, Junjie Huang, Donglin Di, Anyang Su, Tianyou Song, Maurice Pagnucco, Yang Song ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21419-21428

title: Sat2City:基于单张卫星图像的三维城市生成与级联潜在扩散模型
title_en: Sat2City: 3D City Generation from A Single Satellite Image with Cascaded Latent Diffusion
abstract: 近年来,生成模型的进展使得从卫星图像生成三维城市场景成为可能,为游戏、数字孪生等领域打开了新的应用前景。然而,大多数现有方法严重依赖神经渲染技术,这限制了其在更大规模上生成详细三维结构的能力,主要由于有限的二维观测带来了固有的结构歧义。为解决这一挑战,我们提出Sat2City,一种新型框架,将稀疏体素网格的表示能力与潜在扩散模型相结合,专门针对我们新构建的三维城市数据集。我们的方法由三个关键组件构成:(1) 一种级联潜在扩散框架,可从卫星图像逐步恢复三维城市结构;(2) 在变分自编码器(VAE)瓶颈处的Re-Hash操作,用于计算多尺度特征网格以实现稳定的外观优化;(3) 一种反向采样策略,实现隐式监督以平滑外观过渡。为克服收集具有高质量几何和外观的真实城市尺度三维模型的挑战,我们引入了一个合成大规模三维城市数据集,并配以卫星视角高度图。在该数据集上验证,我们的框架可从单张卫星图像生成详细三维结构,其保真度优于现有城市生成模型。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in generative models have enabled 3D urban scene generation from satellite imagery, unlocking promising applications in gaming, digital twins, and beyond. However, most existing methods rely heavily on neural rendering techniques, which hinder their ability to produce detailed 3D structures on a broader scale, largely due to the inherent structural ambiguity derived from relatively limited 2D observations. To address this challenge, we propose Sat2City, a novel framework that synergizes the representational capacity of sparse voxel grids with latent diffusion models, tailored specifically for our novel 3D city dataset. Our approach is enabled by three key components: (1) A cascaded latent diffusion framework that progressively recovers 3D city structures from satellite imagery, (2) a Re-Hash operation at its Variational Autoencoder (VAE) bottleneck to compute multi-scale feature grids for stable appearance optimization, and (3) an inverse sampling strategy enabling implicit supervision for smooth appearance transitioning. To overcome the challenge of collecting real-world city-scale 3D models with high-quality geometry and appearance, we introduce a dataset of synthesized large-scale 3D cities paired with satellite-view height maps. Validated on this dataset, our framework generates detailed 3D structures from a single satellite image, achieving superior fidelity compared to existing city generation models.
authors: Tongyan Hua, Lutao Jiang, Ying-Cong Chen, Wufan Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27978-27988

title: 面向文本到图像模型分层归因的可扩展双指纹技术
title_en: Scalable Dual Fingerprinting for Hierarchical Attribution of Text-to-Image Models
abstract: 生成式人工智能(GenAI)的商业化已形成涉及模型开发者、服务提供商和消费者的多级生态系统。因此,确保可追溯性至关重要,因为服务提供商可能侵犯知识产权(IPR),而消费者可能生成有害内容。然而,现有方法仅适用于单级归因场景,无法同时跨多级进行追溯。为此,我们提出一种面向文本到图像(T2I)模型的可扩展双指纹方法,以实现服务提供商和消费者的可追溯性。具体而言,我们提出双头指纹引导的低秩自适应(FI-LoRA),其中每个头由二进制指纹控制,并能够将指纹引入生成的图像。在实践中,一个FI-LoRA头由开发者用于为每个服务提供商分配唯一指纹,而另一个头则提供给服务提供商,在图像生成过程中嵌入消费者特定指纹。我们的方法不仅在生成图像中嵌入两个指纹,还允许在开发者层级和业务层级对指纹进行独立控制,从而实现业务和消费者的同步追溯。实验表明,我们的方法适用于多种T2I模型的图像生成与编辑任务,且可实现两个指纹超过99.9%的提取准确率。我们的方法在图像级攻击和白盒模型级攻击下也表现出良好的鲁棒性。我们希望本工作为开发者提供统一的解决方案,以实现其模型的多级可追溯性及对模型分发和内容生成的层级控制。
abstract_en: The commercialization of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) has led to a multi-level ecosystem involving model developers, service providers, and consumers. Thus, ensuring traceability is crucial, as service providers may violate intellectual property rights (IPR), and consumers may generate harmful content. However, existing methods are limited to single-level attribution scenarios and cannot simultaneously trace across multiple levels. To this end, we introduce a scalable dual fingerprinting method for text-to-image (T2I) models, to achieve traceability of both service providers and consumers. Specifically, we propose 2-headed Fingerprint-Informed Low-Rank Adaptation (FI-LoRA), where each head is controlled by a binary fingerprint and capable of introducing the fingerprints into generated images. In practice, one FI-LoRA head is used by the developer to assign a unique fingerprint to each service provider, while the other is made available to service providers for embedding consumer-specific fingerprints during image generation. Our method does not merely embed two fingerprints within the generated image but instead allows independent control over them at developer level and business level, enabling simultaneous traceability of businesses and consumers. Experiments show that our method applies to various image generation and editing tasks of multiple T2I models, and can achieve over 99.9% extraction accuracy for both fingerprints. Our method also demonstrates good robustness against both image-level attacks and white-box model-level attacks. We hope our work provides a unified solution for developers to implement multi-tiered traceability of their models and hierarchical control over model distribution and content generation.
authors: Jianwei Fei, Yunshu Dai, Peipeng Yu, Zhe Kong, Jiantao Zhou, Zhihua Xia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15025-15034

title: 基于索引反向传播量化的可扩展图像标记化
title_en: Scalable Image Tokenization with Index Backpropagation Quantization
abstract: 现有向量量化(VQ)方法在可扩展性方面存在局限,主要归因于代码本在训练过程中进行部分更新时的不稳定性。随着利用率降低,非激活码与视觉特征之间的分布差距逐渐扩大,导致代码本容易崩溃。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新的向量量化方法——索引反向传播量化(IBQ),用于联合优化所有代码本嵌入和视觉编码器。通过对编码特征与代码本之间的一热类别分布应用直通估计器,所有码均可微分并保持与视觉编码器一致的潜在空间。IBQ实现了视觉标记化的可扩展训练,并首次实现了大规模代码本(2^18)的高维度(256)和高利用率。在标准ImageNet基准上的实验验证了IBQ的可扩展性和优越性,在重建任务和自回归视觉生成应用中取得了具有竞争力的结果。
abstract_en: Existing vector quantization (VQ) methods struggle with scalability, largely attributed to the instability of the codebook that undergoes partial updates during training. The codebook is prone to collapse as utilization decreases, due to the progressively widening distribution gap between non-activated codes and visual features. To solve the problem, we propose Index Backpropagation Quantization (IBQ), a new VQ method for the joint optimization of all codebook embeddings and the visual encoder. Applying a straight-through estimator on the one-hot categorical distribution between the encoded feature and codebook, all codes are differentiable and maintain a consistent latent space with the visual encoder. IBQ enables scalable training of visual tokenizers and, for the first time, achieves a large-scale codebook (2^ 18 ) with high dimension (256) and high utilization. Experiments on the standard ImageNet benchmark demonstrate the scalability and superiority of IBQ, achieving competitive results on reconstruction and the application of autoregressive visual generation.
authors: Fengyuan Shi, Zhuoyan Luo, Yixiao Ge, Yujiu Yang, Ying Shan, Limin Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16037-16046

title: 面向文本到图像生成的可扩展排序偏好优化
title_en: Scalable Ranked Preference Optimization for Text-to-Image Generation
abstract: 直接偏好优化(DPO)已成为将文本到图像(T2I)模型与人类反馈对齐的强大方法。不幸的是,成功将DPO应用于T2I模型需要大量资源来收集和标注大规模数据集,例如数百万对生成图像及其人类偏好标注。此外,随着T2I模型的快速改进,这些人类偏好数据集会迅速过时,导致生成图像质量提升。在本工作中,我们研究了一种可扩展的方法,用于收集大规模且完全合成的数据集以进行DPO训练。具体而言,使用预训练的奖励函数生成配对图像的偏好,消除了人类参与标注过程的需要,大大提高了数据集收集效率。此外,我们证明此类数据集允许在多个模型间平均预测,并收集排序偏好而非成对偏好。进一步地,我们引入RankDPO,利用排序反馈增强基于DPO的方法。将RankDPO应用于我们的合成生成偏好数据集"Syn-Pic"的SDXL和SD3-Medium模型,提升了提示遵循性(在T2I-Compbench、GenEval和DPG-Bench等基准测试中)和视觉质量(通过用户研究验证)。该流程提供了一种实用且可扩展的解决方案,以开发更优的偏好数据集,从而增强文本到图像模型的性能。
abstract_en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has emerged as a powerful approach to align text-to-image (T2I) models with human feedback. Unfortunately, successful application of DPO to T2I models requires a huge amount of resources to collect and label large-scale datasets, e.g., millions of generated paired images annotated with human preferences. In addition, these human preference datasets can get outdated quickly as the rapid improvements of T2I models lead to higher quality images. In this work, we investigate a scalable approach for collecting large-scale and fully synthetic datasets for DPO training. Specifically, the preferences for paired images are generated using a pre-trained reward function, eliminating the need for involving humans in the annotation process, greatly improving the dataset collection efficiency. Moreover, we demonstrate that such datasets allow averaging predictions across multiple models and collecting ranked preferences as opposed to pairwise preferences. Furthermore, we introduce RankDPO to enhance DPO-based methods using the ranking feedback. Applying RankDPO on SDXL and SD3-Medium models with our synthetically generated preference dataset "Syn-Pic" improves both prompt-following (on benchmarks like T2I-Compbench, GenEval, and DPG-Bench) and visual quality (through user studies). This pipeline presents a practical and scalable solution to develop better preference datasets to enhance the performance of text-to-image models.
authors: Shyamgopal Karthik, Huseyin Coskun, Zeynep Akata, Sergey Tulyakov, Jian Ren, Anil Kag ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18399-18410

title: 指令扩展:通过自适应注意力缩放提升统一图像生成模型的指令遵循保真度
title_en: Scale Your Instructions: Enhance the Instruction-Following Fidelity of Unified Image Generation Model by Self-Adaptive Attention Scaling
abstract: 近期统一图像生成模型(如OmniGen)的进展使得在单一框架内处理多样化的图像生成与编辑任务成为可能,能够接受自由形式的多模态、交错文本与图像输入。这种统一架构消除了对文本编码器的需求,大幅降低模型复杂度并标准化各类图像生成与编辑任务,使其更易于用户使用。然而,我们发现该模型存在文本指令忽视问题,尤其当文本指令包含多个子指令时表现更为明显。为探究这一问题,我们对输入进行了扰动分析以识别关键步骤和层。通过分析这些关键步骤的交叉注意力图,我们观察到被忽视的子指令与输入图像激活之间存在显著冲突。为此,我们提出自适应注意力缩放(SaaS)方法,该方法利用相邻时间步之间的交叉注意力一致性,动态调整每个子指令的注意力激活。我们的SaaS在无需额外训练或测试时优化的情况下提升了指令遵循保真度。在基于指令的图像编辑和视觉条件图像生成实验中验证了SaaS的有效性,结果表明其在指令遵循保真度上优于现有方法。代码已开源至https://github.com/zhouchao-ops/SaaS。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in unified image generation models, such as OmniGen, have enabled the handling of diverse image generation and editing tasks within a single framework, accepting multimodal, interleaved texts and images in free form. This unified architecture eliminates the need for text encoders, greatly reducing model complexity and standardizing various image generation and editing tasks, making it more user-friendly. However, we found that it suffers from text instruction neglect, especially when the text instruction contains multiple sub-instructions. To explore this issue, we performed a perturbation analysis on the input to identify critical steps and layers. By examining the cross-attention maps of these key steps, we observed significant conflicts between neglected sub-instructions and the activations of the input image. In response, we propose Self-Adaptive Attention Scaling (SaaS), a method that leverages the consistency of cross-attention between adjacent timesteps to dynamically scale the attention activation for each sub-instruction. Our SaaS enhances instruction-following fidelity without requiring additional training or test-time optimization. Experimental results on instruction-based image editing and visual conditional image generation validate the effectiveness of our SaaS, showing superior instruction-following fidelity over existing methods. The code is available at https://github.com/zhouchao-ops/SaaS.
authors: Chao Zhou, Tianyi Wei, Nenghai Yu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15171-15181

title: 扩展3D组合模型以实现鲁棒分类与姿态估计
title_en: Scaling 3D Compositional Models for Robust Classification and Pose Estimation
