abstract: 用于物体分类和3D物体姿态估计的深度学习算法缺乏对分布外因素(如合成刺激、天气变化和部分遮挡)的鲁棒性。最近,一类神经网格模型被开发出来,其中物体通过具有顶点学习特征的3D网格进行表示。这些模型在小规模设置中表现出鲁棒性,涉及10个物体类别,但尚不清楚它们能否扩展到数百个物体类别。主要问题是其训练涉及所有类别顶点间的对比学习,其复杂度随类别数量呈二次方增长。我们提出了一种策略,利用物体的组合性,即顶点特征向量的独立性,这大大减少了训练时间并提高了算法性能。我们首先将每顶点对比学习重构为类内对比和类间对比。然后提出一种动态解耦对比过程,对极少混淆的类别间对比进行分离,增强最易混淆类别顶点间的对比。我们的大规模3D组合模型不仅在同时预测分类和姿态估计任务中达到最先进水平,超越了神经网格模型和标准DNNs,而且对分布外测试(包括遮挡、天气条件、合成数据和未知类别泛化)也更具鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Deep learning algorithms for object classification and 3D object pose estimation lack robustness to out-of-distribution factors such as synthetic stimuli, changes in weather conditions, and partial occlusion. Recently, a class of Neural Mesh Models have been developed where objects are represented in terms of 3D meshes with learned features at the vertices. These models have shown robustness in small-scale settings, involving 10 objects, but it is unclear that they can be scaled up to 100s of object classes. The main problem is that their training involves contrastive learning among the vertices of all object classes, which scales quadratically with the number of classes. We present a strategy which exploits the compositionality of the objects, i.e. the independence of the feature vectors of the vertices, which greatly reduces the training time while also improving the performance of the algorithms. We first restructure the per-vertex contrastive learning into contrasting within class and between classes. Then we propose a process that dynamically decouples the contrast between classes which are rarely confused, and enhances the contrast between the vertices of classes that are most confused. Our large-scale 3D compositional model not only achieves state-of-the-art performance on the task of predicting classification and pose estimation simultaneously, surpassing the Neural Mesh Models and standard DNNs, but is also more robust to out-of-distribution testing including occlusion, weather conditions, synthetic data, and generalization to unknown classes.
authors: Xiaoding Yuan, Guofeng Zhang, Prakhar Kaushik, Artur Jesslen, Adam Kortylewski, Alan Yuille ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6406-6415

title: 基于Transformer的时空自适应扩展动作检测:AdaTAD++
title_en: Scaling Action Detection: AdaTAD++ with Transformer-Enhanced Temporal-Spatial Adaptation
abstract: 时序动作检测(TAD)对于通过识别和分割未剪辑序列中的动作来分析长视频至关重要。尽管时序信息适配器(TIA)等近期创新提高了分辨率,但内存限制仍制约着大视频的处理。为解决这一问题,我们引入了AdaTAD++增强框架,通过在适配器内解耦时序和空间处理,将其组织为可独立训练的模块。我们的创新两阶段训练策略首先优化高时序低空间分辨率,随后反之,使模型在推理时可同时利用高空间和时序分辨率,同时保持训练效率。此外,我们引入了更复杂的时序模块,能比以往方法更有效地捕捉长程依赖关系。在ActivityNet-1.3、THUMOS14和EPIC-Kitchens 100等基准数据集上的实验表明,AdaTAD++实现了最先进的性能。我们还探讨了多种适配器配置,讨论其在资源约束与性能间的权衡,为最佳应用提供了有价值的见解。
abstract_en: Temporal Action Detection (TAD) is essential for analyzing long-form videos by identifying and segmenting actions within untrimmed sequences. While recent innovations like Temporal Informative Adapters (TIA) have improved resolution, memory constraints still limit large video processing. To address this, we introduce AdaTAD++, an enhanced framework that decouples temporal and spatial processing within adapters, organizing them into independently trainable modules. Our novel two-step training strategy first optimizes for high temporal and low spatial resolution, then vice versa, allowing the model to utilize both high spatial and temporal resolutions during inference, while maintaining training efficiency. Additionally, we incorporate a more sophisticated temporal module capable of capturing long-range dependencies more effectively than previous methods. Experiments on benchmark datasets, including ActivityNet-1.3, THUMOS14, and EPIC-Kitchens 100, demonstrate that AdaTAD++ achieves state-of-the-art performance. We also explore various adapter configurations, discussing their trade-offs regarding resource constraints and performance, providing valuable insights into their optimal application.
authors: Tanay Agrawal, Abid Ali, Antitza Dantcheva, Francois Bremond ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12222-12231

title: 基于视觉价值模型的推理时间搜索扩展以提升视觉理解能力
title_en: Scaling Inference-Time Search with Vision Value Model for Improved Visual Comprehension
abstract: 尽管视觉语言模型(VLMs)取得了显著进展,但缺乏有效方法通过扩展推理时间计算来提升响应质量。这种能力被认为是近期大语言模型研究中实现自我改进模型的核心步骤。本文提出视觉价值模型(VisVM),该模型可引导VLM推理时间搜索生成更具视觉理解能力的响应。具体而言,VisVM不仅评估当前搜索步骤中生成句子的质量,还预判当前步骤可能产生的后续句子质量,从而提供长期价值。通过这种方式,VisVM使VLM远离生成易出现幻觉或细节不足的句子,从而生成更高质量的响应。实验结果表明,VisVM引导的搜索显著提升了VLM生成富含视觉细节且较少幻觉的描述性标题的能力,相比贪婪解码和其他视觉奖励信号的搜索方法。此外,我们发现通过VisVM引导的标题进行自训练可提升VLM在多种多模态基准测试中的表现,表明开发自我改进VLM的潜力。
abstract_en: Despite significant advancements in vision-language models (VLMs), there lacks effective approaches to enhance response quality by scaling inference-time computation. This capability is known to be a core step towards the self-improving models in recent large language model studies. In this paper, we present Vision Value Model (VisVM) that can guide VLM inference-time search to generate responses with better visual comprehension. Specifically, VisVM not only evaluates the generated sentence quality in the current search step, but also anticipates the quality of subsequent sentences that may result from the current step, thus providing a long-term value. In this way, VisVM steers VLMs away from generating sentences prone to hallucinations or insufficient detail, thereby producing higher quality responses. Experimental results demonstrate that VisVM-guided search significantly enhances VLMs' ability to generate descriptive captions with richer visual details and fewer hallucinations, compared with greedy decoding and search methods with other visual reward signals. Furthermore, we find that self-training the model with the VisVM-guided captions improve VLM's performance across a wide range of multimodal benchmarks, indicating the potential for developing self-improving VLMs.
authors: Xiyao Wang, Zhengyuan Yang, Linjie Li, Hongjin Lu, Yuancheng Xu, Chung-Ching Lin, Kevin Lin, Furong Huang, Lijuan Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1173-1184

title: 无语言监督视觉表征学习的扩展
title_en: Scaling Language-Free Visual Representation Learning
abstract: 视觉自监督学习(SSL)在多模态场景(如视觉问答)中目前仍弱于对比语言-图像预训练(CLIP)。这种多模态差距通常归因于语言监督引入的语义,尽管视觉SSL和CLIP模型常在不同数据集上训练。本研究探讨了以下问题:"视觉自监督方法的落后是由于缺乏语言监督,还是训练数据的差异?" 我们通过在相同MetaCLIP数据集上训练视觉SSL和CLIP模型,并利用视觉问答(VQA)作为视觉编码器的多样化测试平台,来研究这一问题。在受控实验设置中,视觉SSL模型在数据量和模型容量方面均优于CLIP模型,且即使扩展至7B参数规模,其性能仍不饱和。因此,我们观察到视觉SSL方法在广泛的VQA和经典视觉基准测试中均达到CLIP水平。这些发现表明,纯视觉SSL可在大规模场景下匹配语言监督的视觉预训练效果,为以视觉为中心的表征学习开辟了新机遇。代码和模型见https://github.com/facebookresearch/webssl。
abstract_en: Visual Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) currently underperforms Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) in multimodal settings such as Visual Question Answering (VQA). This multimodal gap is often attributed to the semantics introduced by language supervision, even though visual SSL and CLIP models are often trained on different data. In this work, we ask the question: "Do visual self-supervised approaches lag behind CLIP due to the lack of language supervision, or differences in the training data?" We study this question by training both visual SSL and CLIP models on the same MetaCLIP data, and leveraging VQA as a diverse testbed for vision encoders. In this controlled setup, visual SSL models scale better than CLIP models in terms of data and model capacity, and visual SSL performance does not saturate even after scaling up to 7B parameters. Consequently, we observe visual SSL methods achieve CLIP-level performance on a wide range of VQA and classic vision benchmarks. These findings demonstrate that pure visual SSL can match language-supervised visual pretraining at scale, opening new opportunities for vision-centric representation learning. Code and models are at https://github.com/facebookresearch/webssl.
authors: David Fan, Shengbang Tong, Jiachen Zhu, Koustuv Sinha, Zhuang Liu, Xinlei Chen, Michael Rabbat, Nicolas Ballas, Yann LeCun, Amir Bar, Saining Xie ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 370-382

title: 原生多模态模型的扩展定律
title_en: Scaling Laws for Native Multimodal Models
abstract: 构建能够通过多模态信号有效感知世界的通用模型一直是长期目标。当前方法涉及集成单独预训练的组件,例如将视觉编码器连接到大语言模型(LLMs)并继续进行多模态训练。尽管这些方法表现出显著的样本效率,但其后期融合架构是否本质上优于其他方法仍是一个开放问题。在本工作中,我们重新审视了原生多模态模型(NMMs)的架构设计——这些模型从头开始在所有模态上进行训练,并进行了广泛的扩展定律研究,涵盖457个不同架构和训练混合的模型。我们的研究发现,后期融合架构相对于不依赖图像编码器或分词器的早期融合架构并无固有优势。相反,早期融合在参数量较低时表现出更强的性能,训练更高效,部署也更简单。受早期融合架构优异性能的启发,我们证明引入专家混合(MoEs)可使模型学习模态特定权重,显著提升性能。
abstract_en: Building general-purpose models that can effectively perceive the world through multimodal signals has been a long-standing goal. Current approaches involve integrating separately pre-trained components, such as connecting vision encoders to LLMs and continuing multimodal training. While such approaches exhibit remarkable sample efficiency, it remains an open question whether such late-fusion architectures are inherently superior. In this work, we revisit the architectural design of native multimodal models (NMMs)--those trained from the ground up on all modalities--and conduct an extensive scaling laws study, spanning 457 trained models with different architectures and training mixtures. Our investigation reveals no inherent advantage to late-fusion architectures over early-fusion ones, which do not rely on image encoders or tokenizers. On the contrary, early fusion exhibits stronger performance at lower parameter counts, is more efficient to train, and is easier to deploy. Motivated by the strong performance of the early-fusion architectures, we show that incorporating Mixture of Experts (MoEs) allows models to learn modality-specific weights, significantly benefiting performance.
authors: Mustafa Shukor, Enrico Fini, Victor Guilherme Turrisi da Costa, Matthieu Cord, Joshua Susskind, Alaaeldin El-Nouby ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12-23

title: 基于多模态上下文的全模态预训练:跨模态通用表征学习的推进
title_en: Scaling Omni-modal Pretraining with Multimodal Context: Advancing Universal Representation Learning Across Modalities
abstract: 本文提出多模态上下文(MiCo),一种可扩展的预训练框架,旨在推进全模态智能——一种能够理解并从多种模态中学习以实现通用表征学习的AI系统。MiCo允许在预训练阶段高效扩展模态数量、数据量及模型参数。我们在涵盖10种不同模态的单模态感知基准测试、跨模态任务(包括检索、问答和描述生成)以及18项大规模多模态语言模型基准测试中评估预训练模型。MiCo在这些任务中持续取得最先进结果,创下37项新基准。预训练模型、收集的数据集及代码库将公开发布,以支持全模态智能的发展及多模态学习的更广泛研究。
abstract_en: This work introduces Multimodal Context (MiCo), a scalable pretraining framework designed to advance omni-modal intelligence--an AI system capable of understanding and learning from multiple modalities to achieve universal representation learning. MiCo allows for efficient scaling of both the number of modalities and the volume of data, along with model parameters, during the pretraining phase. We evaluate the pretrained models across a diverse set of tasks, including: (i) single-modality perception benchmarks covering 10 distinct modalities, (ii) 25 cross-modal tasks spanning retrieval, question-answering, and captioning, and (iii) 18 large-scale multimodal language model benchmarks. MiCo consistently delivers state-of-the-art results, setting 37 new benchmarks across these tasks. The pretrained models, along with the collected datasets and codebase, will be made publicly available to support the development of omni-modal intelligence and broader research in multimodal learning.
authors: Yiyuan Zhang, Handong Li, Jing Liu, Xiangyu Yue ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1336-1348

title: 基于Transformer的新型视图合成扩展:通过模型令牌解耦与合成数据
title_en: Scaling Transformer-Based Novel View Synthesis with Models Token Disentanglement and Synthetic Data
abstract: 基于大型Transformer的模型在从稀疏输入视图中实现可泛化的新型视图合成(NVS)方面取得了显著进展,能够在无需测试时优化的情况下生成新颖视角。然而,这些模型受限于公开场景数据集的多样性不足,导致大多数真实世界(in-the-wild)场景处于分布外。为克服这一问题,我们引入由扩散模型生成的合成训练数据,从而提升对未见领域的泛化能力。尽管合成数据具有可扩展性,但我们发现数据生成过程中引入的伪影是影响重建质量的关键瓶颈。为此,我们提出在Transformer架构中引入令牌解耦过程,增强特征分离并确保更有效的学习。这种改进不仅提升了标准Transformer的重建质量,还实现了基于合成数据的可扩展训练。因此,我们的方法在数据集内和跨数据集评估中均优于现有模型,在多个基准测试中取得最先进水平,同时显著降低了计算成本。
abstract_en: Large transformer-based models have made significant progress in generalizable novel view synthesis (NVS) from sparse input views, generating novel viewpoints without the need for test-time optimization. However, these models are constrained by the limited diversity of publicly available scene datasets, making most real-world (in-the-wild) scenes out-of-distribution. To overcome this, we incorporate synthetic training data generated from diffusion models, which improves generalization across unseen domains. While synthetic data offers scalability, we identify artifacts introduced during data generation as a key bottleneck affecting reconstruction quality. To address this, we propose a token disentanglement process within the transformer architecture, enhancing feature separation and ensuring more effective learning. This refinement not only improves reconstruction quality over standard transformers but also enables scalable training with synthetic data. As a result, our method outperforms existing models on both in-dataset and cross-dataset evaluations, achieving state-of-the-art results across multiple benchmarks while significantly reducing computational costs.
authors: Nithin Gopalakrishnan Nair, Srinivas Kaza, Xuan Luo, Vishal M. Patel, Stephen Lombardi, Jungyeon Park ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28567-28576

title: 肿瘤分割的扩展:真实与合成数据的最佳经验
title_en: Scaling Tumor Segmentation: Best Lessons from Real and Synthetic Data
abstract: AI在肿瘤分割中的应用受限于缺乏大规模体素级标注数据集,这类数据集难以创建且需要医学专家参与。在我们自主构建的包含3,000个标注胰腺肿瘤扫描的JHH数据集中,我们发现AI性能在1,500个扫描后停止提升。通过合成数据,仅使用500个真实扫描即可达到相同性能。这一发现表明合成数据可以加快数据扩展的规模效应,使模型训练比仅使用真实数据更高效。受此启发,我们创建了AbdomenAtlas 2.0---包含10,134个CT扫描的数据集,其中六个器官(胰腺、肝脏、肾脏、结肠、食管和子宫)的每个体素均手动标注了13,223个肿瘤实例,另有6,511个对照扫描。由23位放射科专家标注,该数据集规模比现有公开肿瘤数据集大几个数量级。尽管我们仍在扩展该数据集,但当前版本的AbdomenAtlas 2.0已基于JHH数据集的经验,为训练六器官肿瘤分割AI提供了坚实基础。它在分布内测试中实现+7%的DSC增益,在分布外测试中实现+16%的DSC增益,显著优于公开数据集。
abstract_en: AI for tumor segmentation is limited by the lack of large, voxel-wise annotated datasets, which are hard to create and require medical experts. In our proprietary JHH dataset of 3,000 annotated pancreatic tumor scans, we found that AI performance stopped improving after 1,500 scans. With synthetic data, we reached the same performance using only 500 real scans. This finding suggests that synthetic data can steepen data scaling laws, enabling more efficient model training than real data alone. Motivated by these lessons, we created AbdomenAtlas 2.0---a dataset of 10,134 CT scans with a total of 13,223 tumor instances per-voxel manually annotated in six organs (pancreas, liver, kidney, colon, esophagus, and uterus) and 6,511 control scans. Annotated by 23 expert radiologists, it is several orders of magnitude larger than existing public tumor datasets. While we continue expanding the dataset, the current version of AbdomenAtlas 2.0 already provides a strong foundation---based on lessons from the JHH dataset---for training AI to segment tumors in six organs. It achieves notable improvements over public datasets, with a +7% DSC gain on in-distribution tests and +16% on out-of-distribution tests.
authors: Qi Chen, Xinze Zhou, Chen Liu, Hao Chen, Wenxuan Li, Zekun Jiang, Ziyan Huang, Yuxuan Zhao, Dexin Yu, Junjun He, Yefeng Zheng, Ling Shao, Alan Yuille, Zongwei Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24001-24013

title: 利用合成数据扩展与控制对抗训练
title_en: Scaling and Taming Adversarial Training with Synthetic Data
abstract: 尽管对抗训练在小数据集上取得了成功,但将其应用于大规模数据集(如ImageNet)仍面临挑战。此前使用合成数据的尝试仅显示出有限的改进。本文研究了合成数据扩展、模型扩展和训练策略对ImageNet对抗训练的影响,深入探讨了大规模鲁棒性问题。在研究过程中,我们观察到损失震荡这一显著现象,导致对抗过拟合,并提出了缓解策略。实验结果表明,在ImageNet-1K上使用AutoAttack时,我们的方法实现了71.54%的鲁棒准确率。我们的发现突显了合成数据和模型扩展在提升大规模基准上对抗鲁棒性中的关键作用,并为大规模训练鲁棒视觉表征提供了新方向。
abstract_en: Despite the success of adversarial training on small datasets, applying it to large-scale datasets like ImageNet remains challenging. Previous attempts using synthetic data show limited improvements. This work investigates the impact of synthetic data scaling, model scaling, and training strategies on adversarial training with ImageNet, providing deeper insights into large-scale robustness. During the process, we observe a notable phenomenon of loss oscillation, leading to adversarial overfitting, and propose strategies to mitigate it. Experimental results show that, under AutoAttack on ImageNet-1K, our method achieves a robust accuracy of 71.54%. Our findings highlight the crucial role of synthetic data and model scaling in enhancing adversarial robustness on large-scale benchmarks and provide a new direction for training robust visual representations at scale.
authors: Juntao Wu, Xianting Huang, Yu Chen, Shuai Pang, Ke Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2951-2960

title: ScanEdit:层次化引导的功能性三维扫描编辑
title_en: ScanEdit: Hierarchically-Guided Functional 3D Scan Editing
abstract: 随着现实世界三维场景捕获的便捷性不断提升,有效的编辑对于将捕获的三维扫描数据应用于各类图形应用变得至关重要。我们提出了ScanEdit,该方法能够通过自然语言文本提示对复杂的现实世界三维扫描数据进行功能性编辑。通过利用大语言模型(LLMs)的高级推理能力,我们基于输入三维扫描的实例分解构建了层次化场景图表示。我们开发了一种层次化引导的多阶段提示方法,利用LLMs将通用语言指令(可能模糊且不涉及具体对象)分解为具体的、可操作的约束条件,并应用于我们的场景图。我们的场景优化整合了LLM引导的约束条件与基于三维的物理合理性目标,使生成的编辑场景能够符合从抽象的功能性目标到更详细的特定指令的各种输入提示。这为现实世界场景中的直观、文本驱动的三维场景编辑奠定了基础。
abstract_en: With the growing ease of capture of real-world 3D scenes, effective editing becomes essential for the use of captured 3D scan data in various graphics applications.We present ScanEdit, which enables functional editing of complex, real-world 3D scans from natural language text prompts.By leveraging the high-level reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), we construct a hierarchical scene graph representation for an input 3D scan given its instance decomposition. We develop a hierarchically-guided, multi-stage prompting approach using LLMs to decompose general language instructions (that can be vague, without referencing specific objects) into specific, actionable constraints that are applied to our scene graph. Our scene optimization integrates LLM-guided constraints along with 3D-based physical plausibility objectives, enabling the generation of edited scenes that align with a variety of input prompts, from abstract, functional-based goals to more detailed, specific instructions. This establishes a foundation for intuitive, text-driven 3D scene editing in real-world scenes.
authors: Mohamed El Amine Boudjoghra, Ivan Laptev, Angela Dai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27105-27115

title: Scendi Score: 基于CLIP嵌入舒尔余子式的提示感知多样性评估
title_en: Scendi Score: Prompt-Aware Diversity Evaluation via Schur Complement of CLIP Embeddings
abstract: 基于CLIP嵌入评估文本到图像生成模型样本保真度的研究在文献中已被广泛探讨。尽管广泛采用的CLIPScore通过文本和图像嵌入的余弦相似度有效衡量生成图像的对齐程度,但它无法量化文本到图像模型生成图像的多样性。在本工作中,我们将CLIP嵌入的应用扩展到量化和解释文本到图像模型的内在多样性,这些模型能够从相似文本提示生成多样化图像,我们称之为提示感知多样性。为实现这一目标,我们提出将基于CLIP的图像数据核协方差矩阵分解为文本相关和非文本相关成分。通过联合图像-文本核协方差矩阵的舒尔余子式,我们进行该分解,并将分解后的成分的基于矩阵的熵定义为舒尔余子式熵多样性(Scendi)得分,作为对提示引导生成模型的提示感知多样性的度量。此外,我们讨论了基于舒尔余子式分解的应用,以消除给定提示对图像CLIP嵌入的影响,从而实现嵌入向量对特定对象的聚焦或模糊。我们展示了将所提出的Scendi得分应用于评估文本到图像和LLM(文本到文本)模型的若干数值结果。我们的数值结果表明,Scendi得分在捕捉提示引导生成模型的内在多样性方面具有成功性。代码库可在https://github.com/aziksh-ospanov/scendi-score获取。
abstract_en: The use of CLIP embeddings to assess the fidelity of samples produced by text-to-image generative models has been extensively explored in the literature. While the widely adopted CLIPScore, derived from the cosine similarity of text and image embeddings, effectively measures the alignment of a generated image, it does not quantify the diversity of images generated by a text-to-image model. In this work, we extend the application of CLIP embeddings to quantify and interpret the intrinsic diversity of text-to-image models, which are responsible for generating diverse images from similar text prompts, which we refer to as prompt-aware diversity. To achieve this, we propose a decomposition of the CLIP-based kernel covariance matrix of image data into text-based and non-text-based components. Using the Schur complement of the joint image-text kernel covariance matrix, we perform this decomposition and define the matrix-based entropy of the decomposed component as the Schur Complement ENtopy DIversity (Scendi) score, as a measure of the prompt-aware diversity for prompt-guided generative models. Additionally, we discuss the application of the Schur complement-based decomposition to nullify the influence of a given prompt on the CLIP embedding of an image, enabling focus or defocus of the embedded vectors on specific objects. We present several numerical results that apply our proposed Scendi score to evaluate text-to-image and LLM (text-to-text) models. Our numerical results indicate the success of the Scendi score in capturing the intrinsic diversity of prompt-guided generative models. The codebase is available at https://github.com/aziksh-ospanov/scendi-score.
authors: Azim Ospanov, Mohammad Jalali, Farzan Farnia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16927-16937

title: 场景坐标重建先验
title_en: Scene Coordinate Reconstruction Priors
abstract: 场景坐标回归(SCR)模型已被证明是3D视觉中强大的隐式场景表示方法,能够实现视觉重定位和运动恢复结构。SCR模型专门针对单个场景进行训练。如果训练图像提供的多视角约束不足,无法恢复场景几何结构,SCR模型将退化。我们提出对训练SCR模型的概率性重新诠释,从而能够注入高层重建先验知识。我们研究了多种此类先验知识,从重建深度值分布的简单先验到学习得到的合理场景坐标配置先验。对于后者,我们在大量室内扫描数据集上训练了一个三维点云扩散模型。我们的先验知识在每个训练步骤中将预测的三维场景点推向更合理的几何结构,以提高其似然性。在三个室内数据集上,我们的先验知识有助于学习更优的场景表示,从而生成更连贯的场景点云,提高配准率和相机姿态精度,对下游任务如新视角合成和相机重定位产生积极影响。
abstract_en: Scene coordinate regression (SCR) models have proven to be powerful implicit scene representations for 3D vision, enabling visual relocalization and structure-from-motion. SCR models are trained specifically for one scene. If training images imply insufficient multi-view constraints to recover the scene geometry, SCR models degenerate. We present a probabilistic reinterpretation of training SCR models, which allows us to infuse high-level reconstruction priors. We investigate multiple such priors, ranging from simple priors over the distribution of reconstructed depth values to learned priors over plausible scene coordinate configurations. For the latter, we train a 3D point cloud diffusion model on a large corpus of indoor scans. Our priors push predicted 3D scene points towards a more plausible geometry at each training step to increase their likelihood. On three indoor datasets our priors help learning better scene representations, resulting in more coherent scene point clouds, higher registration rates and better camera poses, with a positive effect on down-stream tasks such as novel view synthesis and camera relocalization.
authors: Wenjing Bian, Axel Barroso-Laguna, Tommaso Cavallari, Victor Adrian Prisacariu, Eric Brachmann ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25765-25776

title: 场景图引导生成:通过纹理校正实现文本到图像模型中准确关系生成
title_en: Scene Graph Guided Generation: Enable Accurate Relations Generation in Text-to-Image Models via Textural Rectification
abstract: 近年来,文本到图像生成技术的进步得益于扩散模型和多模态学习的发展。然而,由于这些模型通常以序列形式表示文本,往往难以提供准确的上下文化和结构控制,导致生成的图像与人类预期不一致,尤其是在涉及多个对象和关系的复杂场景中。本文提出场景图适配器(SG-Adapter),利用场景图的结构化表示校正原始文本嵌入中的不准确之处。SG-Adapter的显式且非全连接图表示显著提升了全连接的基于Transformer的文本表示。这种改进在维护多关系场景中精确对应关系方面尤为突出。为应对如Visual Genome等低质量标注数据集的挑战,我们手动整理了一个高度纯净的多关系场景图-图像配对数据集MultiRels。此外,我们设计了三个基于GPT-4V的指标,以有效且全面地测量图像与场景图之间的对应关系。定性与定量结果验证了我们的方法在控制多关系对应关系方面的有效性。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in text-to-image generation have been propelled by the development of diffusion models and multi-modality learning. However, since text is typically represented sequentially in these models, it often falls short in providing accurate contextualization and structural control. So the generated images do not consistently align with human expectations, especially in complex scenarios involving multiple objects and relationships. In this paper, we introduce the Scene Graph Adapter(SG-Adapter), leveraging the structured representation of scene graphs to rectify inaccuracies in the original text embeddings. The SG-Adapter's explicit and non-fully connected graph representation greatly improves the fully connected, transformer-based text representations. This enhancement is particularly notable in maintaining precise correspondence in scenarios involving multiple relationships. To address the challenges posed by low-quality annotated datasets like Visual Genome, we have manually curated a highly clean, multi-relational scene graph-image paired dataset MultiRels. Furthermore, we design three metrics derived from GPT-4V to effectively and thoroughly measure the correspondence between images and scene graphs. Both qualitative and quantitative results validate the efficacy of our approach in controlling the correspondence in multiple relationships.
authors: Guibao Shen, Luozhou Wang, Jiantao Lin, Wenhang Ge, Chaozhe Zhang, Xin Tao, Di Zhang, Pengfei Wan, Guangyong Chen, Yijun Li, Ying-cong Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15437-15446

title: SceneMI:面向人-场景交互建模的运动中间帧生成
title_en: SceneMI: Motion In-betweening for Modeling Human-Scene Interaction
abstract: 建模人-场景交互(HSI)对于理解和模拟日常人类行为至关重要。近年来,利用生成建模的方法在该领域取得了一定进展;然而,这些方法在现实应用中的可控性和灵活性仍存在局限。为解决这些挑战,我们将HSI建模问题重新表述为场景感知的运动中间帧生成——一个更具可操作性和实用性的任务。我们提出SceneMI框架,支持关键帧引导的三维场景角色动画生成以及提升不完美HSI数据的运动质量。SceneMI采用双场景描述符对全局和局部场景上下文进行全面编码。此外,我们的框架利用扩散模型固有的去噪特性,实现对噪声关键帧的泛化。实验结果表明,SceneMI在场景感知关键帧中间帧生成和现实世界GIMO数据集(通过噪声IMU传感器和智能手机采集运动与场景)的泛化方面均表现出色。我们进一步展示了SceneMI在从单目视频中重建HSI的适用性。
abstract_en: Modeling human-scene interactions (HSI) is essential for understanding and simulating everyday human behaviors. Recent approaches utilizing generative modeling have made progress in this domain; however, they are limited in controllability and flexibility for real-world applications. To address these challenges, we propose reformulating the HSI modeling problem as Scene-aware Motion In-betweening---a more tractable and practical task. We introduce SceneMI, a framework that supports several practical applications, including keyframe-guided character animation in 3D scenes and enhancing the motion quality of imperfect HSI data. SceneMI employs dual scene descriptors to comprehensively encode global and local scene context. Furthermore, our framework leverages the inherent denoising nature of diffusion models to generalize on noisy keyframes. Experimental results demonstrate SceneMI's effectiveness in scene-aware keyframe in-betweening and generalization to the real-world GIMO dataset, where motions and scenes are acquired by noisy IMU sensors and smartphones. We further showcase SceneMI's applicability in HSI reconstruction from monocular videos.
authors: Inwoo Hwang, Bing Zhou, Young Min Kim, Jian Wang, Chuan Guo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6034-6045

title: ScenePainter: 基于概念关系对齐的语义一致持续3D场景生成
title_en: ScenePainter: Semantically Consistent Perpetual 3D Scene Generation with Concept Relation Alignment
abstract: 持续3D场景生成旨在生成长序列且连贯的3D视角序列,适用于长期视频合成与3D场景重建。现有方法采用"导航-想象"模式,依赖外扩模块进行连续视角扩展。然而,生成的视角序列存在由外扩模块累积偏差导致的语义漂移问题。为解决这一挑战,我们提出ScenePainter框架,通过将外扩模块的场景特定先验与当前场景理解进行对齐,实现语义一致的3D场景生成。具体而言,我们引入层次图结构SceneConceptGraph,构建多级场景概念间的关联关系,指导外扩模块生成一致的新视角,并可通过动态优化增强多样性。大量实验表明,我们的框架有效克服了语义漂移问题,生成更连贯且沉浸的3D视角序列。
abstract_en: Perpetual 3D scene generation aims to produce long-range and coherent 3D view sequences, which is applicable for long-term video synthesis and 3D scene reconstruction. Existing methods follow a "navigate-and-imagine" fashion and rely on outpainting for successive view expansion. However, the generated view sequences suffer from semantic drift issue derived from the accumulated deviation of the outpainting module. To tackle this challenge, we propose ScenePainter, a new framework for semantically consistent 3D scene generation, which aligns the outpainter's scene-specific prior with the comprehension of the current scene. To be specific, we introduce a hierarchical graph structure dubbed SceneConceptGraph to construct relations among multi-level scene concepts, which directs the outpainter for consistent novel views and can be dynamically refined to enhance diversity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework overcomes the semantic drift issue and generates more consistent and immersive 3D view sequences.
authors: Chong Xia, Shengjun Zhang, Fangfu Liu, Chang Liu, Khodchaphun Hirunyaratsameewong, Yueqi Duan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28808-28817

title: SceneSplat: 基于高斯泼溅的场景理解与视觉-语言预训练
title_en: SceneSplat: Gaussian Splatting-based Scene Understanding with Vision-Language Pretraining
abstract: 识别任意或先前未见过的类别对于全面理解现实世界三维场景至关重要。目前所有现有方法在训练过程中均依赖于2D或文本模态,或在推理时共同使用。这凸显了缺乏能够单独处理三维数据以实现端到端语义学习的模型,以及训练此类模型所需的数据。同时,三维高斯泼溅(3DGS)已成为各种视觉任务中三维场景表示的行业标准。然而,如何以可推广的方式将语义推理有效整合到3DGS中仍是一个开放性挑战。为解决这些局限性,我们引入了SceneSplat,据我们所知这是首个大规模的三维室内场景理解方法,可原生运行于3DGS上。此外,我们提出了一种自监督学习方案,可从无标签场景中解锁丰富的三维特征学习。为支持所提出的方法,我们引入了SceneSplat-7K,这是首个用于室内场景的大型3DGS数据集,包含从ScanNet、Matterport3D等7个基准数据集中衍生的6868个场景。生成SceneSplat-7K需要相当于119个L4 GPU日的计算资源,使三维高斯泼溅基于的室内场景推理标准化基准测试成为可能。我们在SceneSplat-7K上的全面实验验证了所提方法相较于现有基线的显著优势。我们的代码、模型和数据集将开放以促进进一步研究。
abstract_en: Recognizing arbitrary or previously unseen categories is essential for comprehensive real-world 3D scene understanding. Currently, all existing methods rely on 2D or textual modalities during training, or together at inference. This highlights a clear absence of a model capable of processing 3D data alone for learning semantics end-to-end, along with the necessary data to train such a model. Meanwhile, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as the de facto standard for 3D scene representation across various vision tasks. However, effectively integrating semantic reasoning into 3DGS in a generalizable fashion remains an open challenge.To address these limitations we introduce SceneSplat, to our knowledge the first large-scale 3D indoor scene understanding approach that operates natively on 3DGS. Furthermore, we propose a self-supervised learning scheme that unlocks rich 3D feature learning from unlabeled scenes. In order to power the proposed methods, we introduce SceneSplat-7K, the first large-scale 3DGS dataset for indoor scenes, comprising of 6868 scenes derived from 7 established datasets like ScanNet, Matterport3D, etc. Generating SceneSplat-7K required computational resources equivalent to 119 GPU-days on an L4 GPU, enabling standardized benchmarking for 3DGS-based reasoning for indoor scenes.Our exhaustive experiments on SceneSplat-7K demonstrate the significant benefit of the proposed methods over the established baselines. Our code, model, and datasets will be released to facilitate further research.
authors: Yue Li, Qi Ma, Runyi Yang, Huapeng Li, Mengjiao Ma, Bin Ren, Nikola Popovic, Nicu Sebe, Ender Konukoglu, Theo Gevers, Luc Van Gool, Martin R. Oswald, Danda Pani Paudel ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4961-4972

title: 量化感知训练中的权重转换调度
title_en: Scheduling Weight Transitions for Quantization-Aware Training
abstract: 量化感知训练(QAT)在训练过程中模拟量化过程,以降低权重/激活值的位精度。它通过使用基于梯度的优化器更新潜在权重(即量化器的全精度输入)来间接学习量化权重。我们认为,将用户定义的学习率(LR)与这些优化器结合对于QAT来说是次优的。量化权重仅在对应的潜在权重通过转换点时,在量化器的离散层级间转换,此时量化器改变其离散状态。这表明量化权重的变化受潜在权重的学习率及其分布的共同影响。因此,手动调度学习率难以控制量化权重的变化程度。我们推测,QAT中参数的变化程度与量化权重在离散层级间转换的数量有关。基于此,我们引入了一种转换率(TR)调度技术,以显式控制量化权重的转换次数。我们不调度潜在权重的学习率,而是调度量化权重的目标TR,并使用一种新颖的转换自适应学习率(TALR)更新潜在权重,从而在QAT过程中考虑量化权重的变化程度。实验结果验证了我们方法在标准基准上的有效性。
abstract_en: Quantization-aware training (QAT) simulates a quantization process during training to lower bit-precision of weights/activations. It learns quantized weights indirectly by updating latent weights, i.e., full-precision inputs to a quantizer, using gradient-based optimizers. We claim that coupling a user-defined learning rate (LR) with these optimizers is sub-optimal for QAT. Quantized weights transit discrete levels of a quantizer, only if corresponding latent weights pass transition points, where the quantizer changes discrete states. This suggests that the changes of quantized weights are affected by both the LR for latent weights and their distributions. It is thus difficult to control the degree of changes for quantized weights by scheduling the LR manually. We conjecture that the degree of parameter changes in QAT is related to the number of quantized weights transiting discrete levels. Based on this, we introduce a transition rate (TR) scheduling technique that controls the number of transitions of quantized weights explicitly. Instead of scheduling a LR for latent weights, we schedule a target TR of quantized weights, and update the latent weights with a novel transition-adaptive LR (TALR), enabling considering the degree of changes for the quantized weights during QAT. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on standard benchmarks.
authors: Junghyup Lee, Jeimin Jeon, Dohyung Kim, Bumsub Ham ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23466-23475

title: SciVid:科学应用中视频模型的跨领域评估
title_en: SciVid: Cross-Domain Evaluation of Video Models in Scientific Applications
abstract: 近年来,不同科学领域涌现出大量时空基础模型。尽管这些模型前景广阔,但它们往往具有领域特定性,仅在设计用途的特定应用中进行评估。鉴于许多任务可以表示为视频建模问题,视频基础模型(ViFMs)作为通用的领域无关方法展现出巨大潜力。然而,尚不清楚在大规模但可能超出领域范围的数据上获得的知识是否能有效迁移至多样化的科学领域,以及单一预训练的ViFM是否能与领域特定基线相竞争。为解决这一问题,我们引入SciVid,这是一个包含五个*Sci*entific *Vid*eo任务的综合性基准,涵盖医学计算机视觉、动物行为和天气预报等领域。我们通过简单的可训练读出模块将六个领先的ViFMs适配到SciVid,建立了强大的基线并展示了有效迁移学习的潜力。具体而言,我们证明了通过利用ViFM主干的通用表示,可以在多个应用中获得最先进的结果。此外,我们的结果揭示了现有ViFMs的局限性,并突出了开发可泛化模型以应对高影响力科学应用的机会。我们将在github.com/google-deepmind/scivid发布代码,以促进ViFM开发的进一步研究。
abstract_en: In recent years, there has been a proliferation of spatiotemporal foundation models in different scientific disciplines. While promising, these models are often domain-specific and are only assessed within the particular applications for which they are designed. Given that many tasks can be represented as video modeling problems, video foundation models (ViFMs) hold considerable promise as general-purpose domain-agnostic approaches. However, it is not known whether the knowledge acquired on large-scale but potentially out-of-domain data can be effectively transferred across diverse scientific disciplines, and if a single, pretrained ViFM can be competitive with domain-specific baselines. To address this, we introduce SciVid, a comprehensive benchmark comprising five *Sci*entific *Vid*eo tasks, across medical computer vision, animal behavior, and weather forecasting. We adapt six leading ViFMs to SciVid using simple trainable readout modules, establishing strong baselines and demonstrating the potential for effective transfer learning. Specifically, we show that state-of-the-art results can be obtained in several applications by leveraging the general-purpose representations from ViFM backbones. Furthermore, our results reveal the limitations of existing ViFMs, and highlight opportunities for the development of generalizable models for high-impact scientific applications. We release our code at github.com/google-deepmind/scivid to facilitate further research in the development of ViFMs.
authors: Yana Hasson, Pauline Luc, Liliane Momeni, Maks Ovsjanikov, Guillaume Le Moing, Alina Kuznetsova, Ira Ktena, Jennifer J. Sun, Skanda Koppula, Dilara Gokay, Joseph Heyward, Etienne Pot, Andrew Zisserman ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21800-21811

title: ScoreHOI: 基于分数引导扩散的物理合理人类-物体交互重建
title_en: ScoreHOI: Physically Plausible Reconstruction of Human-Object Interaction via Score-Guided Diffusion
abstract: 人类-物体交互的联合重建标志着理解人类与其周围环境复杂关系的重要里程碑。然而,先前的优化方法由于缺乏人类-物体交互的先验知识,往往难以实现物理上合理的重建结果。本文提出ScoreHOI,一种有效的基于扩散的优化器,通过引入扩散先验实现人类-物体交互的精确恢复。利用分数引导采样中的可控性,扩散模型可基于图像观测和物体特征重建人类与物体姿态的条件分布。在推理阶段,ScoreHOI通过特定物理约束引导去噪过程有效提升重建结果。此外,我们提出一种接触驱动的迭代优化方法,以增强接触合理性并提高重建精度。在标准基准数据集上的大量评估表明,ScoreHOI在联合人类-物体交互重建任务中显著优于现有最先进方法,凸显其在实现精确且鲁棒提升方面的优势。
abstract_en: Joint reconstruction of human-object interaction marks a significant milestone in comprehending the intricate interrelations between humans and their surrounding environment. Nevertheless, previous optimization methods often struggle to achieve physically plausible reconstruction results due to the lack of prior knowledge about human-object interactions. In this paper, we introduce ScoreHOI, an effective diffusion-based optimizer that introduces diffusion priors for the precise recovery of human-object interactions. By harnessing the controllability within score-guided sampling, the diffusion model can reconstruct a conditional distribution of human and object pose given the image observation and object feature. During inference, the ScoreHOI effectively improves the reconstruction results by guiding the denoising process with specific physical constraints. Furthermore, we propose a contact-driven iterative refinement approach to enhance the contact plausibility and improve the reconstruction accuracy. Extensive evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate ScoreHOI's superior performance over state-of-the-art methods, highlighting its ability to achieve a precise and robust improvement in joint human-object interaction reconstruction.
authors: Ao Li, Jinpeng Liu, Yixuan Zhu, Yansong Tang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7592-7602

title: 评分、记忆与参考:视频中伪装物体的捕捉
title_en: Scoring, Remember, and Reference: Catching Camouflaged Objects in Videos
abstract: 视频伪装物体检测(VCOD)旨在分割外观与周围环境高度相似的物体,是一项具有挑战性且新兴的任务。现有视觉模型在这些场景中往往表现不佳,主要由于伪装物体外观难以区分以及视频中动态信息的利用不足。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种受人类记忆-识别启发的端到端VCOD框架,通过整合记忆参考帧来利用历史视频信息进行伪装序列处理。具体而言,我们设计了一个具有双重功能的解码器,同时生成预测掩码和评分,基于评分实现参考帧选择,并引入辅助监督以增强特征提取。此外,本研究引入了一种新颖的参考引导多级非对称注意力机制,有效整合长期参考信息与短期运动线索,实现全面的特征提取。通过结合这些模块,我们开发了评分、记忆与参考(SRR)框架,该框架高效提取信息以定位目标,并利用记忆引导提升后续处理。凭借优化的模块设计和对视频数据的有效利用,我们的模型在基准数据集上实现了显著性能提升,在参数量(54M)更少且仅需单次视频遍历的情况下,超越现有方法约10%。代码将公开发布。
abstract_en: Video Camouflaged Object Detection (VCOD) aims to segment objects whose appearances closely resemble their surroundings, posing a challenging and emerging task. Existing vision models often struggle in such scenarios due to the indistinguishable appearance of camouflaged objects and the insufficient exploitation of dynamic information in videos. To address these challenges, we propose an end-to-end VCOD framework inspired by human memory-recognition, which leverages historical video information by integrating memory reference frames for camouflaged sequence processing. Specifically, we design a dual-purpose decoder that simultaneously generates predicted masks and scores, enabling reference frame selection based on scores while introducing auxiliary supervision to enhance feature extraction. Furthermore, this study introduces a novel reference-guided multilevel asymmetric attention mechanism, effectively integrating long-term reference information with short-term motion cues for comprehensive feature extraction. By combining these modules, we develop the Scoring, Remember, and Reference (SRR) framework, which efficiently extracts information to locate targets and employs memory guidance to improve subsequent processing. With its optimized module design and effective utilization of video data, our model achieves significant performance improvements, surpassing existing approaches by approximately 10% on benchmark datasets while requiring fewer parameters (54M) and only a single pass through the video. The code will be made publicly available.
authors: Yu'ang Feng, Shuyong Gao, Fuzhen Yan, Yicheng Song, Lingyi Hong, Junjie Hu, Wenqiang Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13043-13052

title: 雕刻记忆:通过动态掩码与概念感知优化实现扩散模型的多概念遗忘
title_en: Sculpting Memory: Multi-Concept Forgetting in Diffusion Models via Dynamic Mask and Concept-Aware Optimization
abstract: 文本到图像(T2I)扩散模型在从文本提示生成高质量图像方面取得了显著成功。然而,其存储大量知识的能力在需要选择性遗忘的场景(如移除版权内容、减少偏见或消除有害概念)中引发了担忧。尽管现有去学习方法可以移除特定概念,但因稳定性不足、残留知识持续存在和生成质量下降等问题,难以处理多概念遗忘。为解决这些挑战,我们提出**动态掩码与概念感知损失结合**的新型去学习框架,专门用于扩散模型的多概念遗忘。我们的**动态掩码**机制根据当前优化状态自适应更新梯度掩码,允许选择性权重修改,防止对无关知识的干扰。此外,我们的**概念感知损失**通过超类对齐强制执行语义一致性,明确引导去学习过程,同时基于知识蒸馏的正则化损失确保在顺序去学习过程中已遗忘的概念不会重新出现。我们进行了大量实验评估该方法。结果表明,我们的方法在遗忘效果、输出保真度和语义一致性方面均优于现有去学习技术,特别是在多概念场景中。本研究为生成模型的稳定、高保真去学习提供了原理性且灵活的框架。代码见https://github.com/coulsonlee/Sculpting-Memory-ICCV-2025
abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generating high-quality images from textual prompts. However, their ability to store vast amounts of knowledge raises concerns in scenarios where selective forgetting is necessary, such as removing copyrighted content, reducing biases, or eliminating harmful concepts. While existing unlearning methods can remove certain concepts, they struggle with multi-concept forgetting due to instability, residual knowledge persistence, and generation quality degradation. To address these challenges, we propose **Dynamic Mask coupled with Concept-Aware Loss**, a novel unlearning framework designed for multi-concept forgetting in diffusion models. Our **Dynamic Mask** mechanism adaptively updates gradient masks based on current optimization states, allowing selective weight modifications that prevent interference with unrelated knowledge. Additionally, our **Concept-Aware Loss** explicitly guides the unlearning process by enforcing semantic consistency through superclass alignment, while a regularization loss based on knowledge distillation ensures that previously unlearned concepts remain forgotten during sequential unlearning. We conduct extensive experiments to evaluate our approach. Results demonstrate that our method outperforms existing unlearning techniques in forgetting effectiveness, output fidelity, and semantic coherence, particularly in multi-concept scenarios. Our work provides a principled and flexible framework for stable and high-fidelity unlearning in generative models. Code available in https://github.com/coulsonlee/Sculpting-Memory-ICCV-2025
authors: Gen Li, Yang Xiao, Jie Ji, Kaiyuan Deng, Bo Hui, Linke Guo, Xiaolong Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19659-19668

title: SeaS: 基于分离与共享微调的少样本工业异常图像生成
title_en: SeaS: Few-shot Industrial Anomaly Image Generation with Separation and Sharing Fine-tuning
abstract: 我们提出SeaS,一种统一的工业生成模型,可自动创建多样化的异常、真实的正常产品和精确的异常掩码。尽管已有大量研究,但多数工作要么仅专注于特定任务(即仅异常或正常产品),要么需要为每种异常类型单独构建模型。因此,现有方法要么生成能力有限,要么依赖大量异常特定模型。我们证明U-Net的差异化学习能力能够捕捉略微变化的正常产品和多样化异常的视觉特征,使我们能够构建适用于所有任务的统一模型。具体而言,我们首先引入不平衡异常(UA)文本提示,包含一个正常标记和多个异常标记。更重要的是,我们的解耦异常对齐(DA)损失将异常属性解耦并绑定到UA的特定异常标记,使SeaS能够通过重新组合这些属性生成未见过的异常。此外,我们的正常图像对齐(NA)损失将正常标记对齐到正常模式,使生成的正常产品在全局保持一致且局部具有多样性。最后,SeaS通过融合判别性U-Net特征与高分辨率VAE特征,生成精确的异常掩码。SeaS在工业生成领域设立了新基准,显著提升了下游应用性能,合成型异常检测方法在像素级AP值上平均提升+8.66%,无监督异常检测方法在图像级AP值上平均提升+1.10%,监督分割模型在IoU上平均提升+12.79%。代码已开源至https://github.com/HUST-SLOW/SeaS。
abstract_en: We introduce SeaS, a unified industrial generative model for automatically creating diverse anomalies, authentic normal products, and precise anomaly masks. While extensive research exists, most efforts either focus on specific tasks, i.e., anomalies or normal products only, or require separate models for each anomaly type. Consequently, prior methods either offer limited generative capability or depend on a vast array of anomaly-specific models. We demonstrate that U-Net's differentiated learning ability captures the distinct visual traits of slightly-varied normal products and diverse anomalies, enabling us to construct a unified model for all tasks. Specifically, we first introduce an Unbalanced Abnormal (UA) Text Prompt, comprising one normal token and multiple anomaly tokens. More importantly, our Decoupled Anomaly Alignment (DA) loss decouples anomaly attributes and binds them to distinct anomaly tokens of UA, enabling SeaS to create unseen anomalies by recombining these attributes. Furthermore, our Normal-image Alignment (NA) loss aligns the normal token to normal patterns, making generated normal products globally consistent and locally varied. Finally, SeaS produces accurate anomaly masks by fusing discriminative U-Net features with high-resolution VAE features. SeaS sets a new benchmark for industrial generation, significantly enhancing downstream applications, with average improvements of +8.66% pixel-level AP for synthesis-based AD approaches, +1.10% image-level AP for unsupervised AD methods, and +12.79% IoU for supervised segmentation models. The code is available at https://github.com/HUST-SLOW/SeaS.
authors: Zhewei Dai, Shilei Zeng, Haotian Liu, Xurui Li, Feng Xue, Yu Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23135-23144

title: 使用变分防御封堵后门
title_en: Seal Your Backdoor with Variational Defense
abstract: 我们提出VIBE,一种模型无关的框架,用于训练对后门攻击具有鲁棒性的分类器。我们的方法核心思想是将训练数据集中恶意输入和被污染标签视为观测随机变量,而真实的干净标签则为潜在变量。VIBE通过变分推断恢复相应的潜在干净标签后验分布。最终的训练过程遵循期望最大化(EM)算法。E步通过求解熵正则化的最优传输问题推断干净伪标签,而M步则通过梯度下降更新分类器参数。由于其模块化特性,VIBE可以无缝集成到近期自监督表示学习的进展中,从而增强其抵御后门攻击的能力。我们在标准数据集、包含1000类的大规模设置以及被多种攻击污染的数据集上实验验证了该方法的有效性。VIBE在所有测试场景中均优于之前的防御方法。
abstract_en: We propose VIBE, a model-agnostic framework that trains classifiers resilient to backdoor attacks. The key concept behind our approach is to treat malicious inputs and corrupted labels from the training dataset as observed random variables, while the actual clean labels are latent. VIBE then recovers the corresponding latent clean label posterior through variational inference. The resulting training procedure follows the expectation-maximization (EM) algorithm. The E-step infers the clean pseudolabels by solving an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem, while the M-step updates the classifier parameters via gradient descent. Being modular, VIBE can seamlessly integrate with recent advancements in self-supervised representation learning, which enhance its ability to resist backdoor attacks. We experimentally validate the method effectiveness against contemporary backdoor attacks on standard datasets, a large-scale setup with 1k classes, and a dataset poisoned with multiple attacks. VIBE consistently outperforms previous defenses across all tested scenarios.
authors: Ivan Sabolić, Matej Grcić, Siniša Šegvić ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 752-764

title: Seam360GS:从现实世界全景图像中生成无缝360度高斯点云
title_en: Seam360GS: Seamless 360deg Gaussian Splatting from Real-World Omnidirectional Images
abstract: 360度视觉内容在YouTube等平台上广泛传播,并在虚拟现实、机器人技术和自主导航中发挥着核心作用。然而,由于固有的镜头分离和角度失真,消费级双鱼眼系统始终会产生不完美的全景图。在本文中,我们引入了一种新颖的校准框架,将双鱼眼相机模型整合到3D高斯点云生成流程中。我们的方法不仅模拟了双鱼眼相机产生的真实视觉伪影,还实现了无缝渲染的360度图像的合成。通过联合优化3D高斯参数和模拟镜头间隙及角度失真的校准变量,我们的框架将不完美的全景输入转化为完美的新视角合成。在现实世界数据集上的广泛评估证实,我们的方法能够生成无缝渲染结果——即使从不完美的图像中也能实现,并且优于现有的360度渲染模型。
abstract_en: 360deg visual content is widely shared on platforms such as YouTube and plays a central role in virtual reality, robotics, and autonomous navigation. However, consumer-grade dual-fisheye systems consistently yield imperfect panoramas due to inherent lens separation and angular distortions. In this work, we introduce a novel calibration framework that incorporates a dual-fisheye camera model into the 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline. Our approach not only simulates the realistic visual artifacts produced by dual-fisheye cameras but also enables the synthesis of seamlessly rendered 360deg images. By jointly optimizing 3D Gaussian parameters alongside calibration variables that emulate lens gaps and angular distortions, our framework transforms imperfect omnidirectional inputs into flawless novel view synthesis. Extensive evaluations on real-world datasets confirm that our method produces seamless renderings--even from imperfect images--and outperforms existing 360deg rendering models.
authors: Changha Shin, Woong Oh Cho, Seon Joo Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28970-28979

title: 无需反向传播的安全设备端视频分布外检测
title_en: Secure On-Device Video OOD Detection Without Backpropagation
abstract: 分布外检测(OOD)对于确保机器学习模型在自动驾驶和医疗诊断等安全关键应用中的可靠性至关重要。尽管将个性化OOD检测直接部署在边缘设备上是理想选择,但受限于模型体积庞大和设备端训练的计算不可行性,仍面临挑战。联邦学习在一定程度上缓解了这一问题,但仍需要梯度计算和反向传播,超出了许多边缘设备的能力。为克服这些挑战,我们提出SecDOOD,一种无需设备端反向传播的高效设备端OOD检测安全云-设备协作框架。SecDOOD利用云资源进行模型训练,同时通过保留敏感信息在设备端确保用户数据隐私。SecDOOD的核心是基于超网络的个性化参数生成模块,该模块通过动态生成本地权重调整,将云训练模型适配到设备特定分布,有效结合中心与本地信息而无需本地微调。此外,我们的动态特征采样和加密策略仅对最具信息量的特征通道进行选择性加密,大幅降低加密开销而不会影响检测性能。在多个数据集和OOD场景的广泛实验表明,SecDOOD的性能与完全微调模型相当,使资源受限的边缘设备实现安全、高效且个性化的OOD检测。为增强可访问性和可复现性,我们的代码已公开在https://github.com/Dystopians/SecDOOD。
abstract_en: Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection is critical for ensuring the reliability of machine learning models in safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving and medical diagnosis. While deploying personalized OOD detection directly on edge devices is desirable, it remains challenging due to large model sizes and the computational infeasibility of on-device training. Federated learning partially addresses this but still requires gradient computation and backpropagation, exceeding the capabilities of many edge devices.To overcome these challenges, we propose SecDOOD, a secure cloud-device collaboration framework for efficient on-device OOD detection without requiring device-side backpropagation.SecDOOD utilizes cloud resources for model training while ensuring user data privacy by retaining sensitive information on-device. Central to SecDOOD is a HyperNetwork-based personalized parameter generation module, which adapts cloud-trained models to device-specific distributions by dynamically generating local weight adjustments, effectively combining central and local information without local fine-tuning. Additionally, our dynamic feature sampling and encryption strategy selectively encrypts only the most informative feature channels, largely reducing encryption overhead without compromising detection performance.Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and OOD scenarios demonstrate that SecDOOD achieves performance comparable to fully fine-tuned models, enabling secure, efficient, and personalized OOD detection on resource-limited edge devices. To enhance accessibility and reproducibility, our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Dystopians/SecDOOD.
authors: Shawn Li, Peilin Cai, Yuxiao Zhou, Zhiyu Ni, Renjie Liang, You Qin, Yi Nian, Zhengzhong Tu, Xiyang Hu, Yue Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 112-121

title: 通过二维透镜观察三维:基于跨模态几何校正的三维少样本类增量学习
title_en: Seeing 3D Through 2D Lenses: 3D Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning via Cross-Modal Geometric Rectification
abstract: 三维数字内容的快速增长需要可扩展的开放世界场景识别系统。然而,现有三维类增量学习方法在极端数据稀缺情况下因几何错位和纹理偏差而表现不佳。尽管近期方法将三维数据与二维基础模型(如CLIP)结合,但因纹理偏差投影和几何-纹理特征的无差别融合导致语义模糊,进而引发决策原型不稳定和灾难性遗忘。为解决这些问题,我们提出跨模态几何校正(CMGR)框架,通过利用CLIP的层次化空间语义提升三维几何保真度。具体而言,我们引入结构感知几何校正模块,通过注意力驱动的几何融合,分层对齐三维部件结构与CLIP的中间空间先验。此外,纹理增强模块合成最小但具有判别性的纹理以抑制噪声并强化跨模态一致性。为进一步稳定增量原型,我们采用基类-新类判别器以隔离几何变化。大量实验表明,我们的方法显著提升了三维少样本类增量学习性能,在跨域和同域设置中均展现出更优的几何一致性及对纹理偏差的鲁棒性。
abstract_en: The rapid growth of 3D digital content necessitates expandable recognition systems for open-world scenarios. However, existing 3D class-incremental learning methods struggle under extreme data scarcity due to geometric misalignment and texture bias. While recent approaches integrate 3D data with 2D foundation models (e.g., CLIP), they suffer from semantic blurring caused by texture-biased projections and indiscriminate fusion of geometric-textural cues, leading to unstable decision prototypes and catastrophic forgetting. To address these issues, we propose Cross-Modal Geometric Rectification (CMGR), a framework that enhances 3D geometric fidelity by leveraging CLIP's hierarchical spatial semantics. Specifically, we introduce a Structure-Aware Geometric Rectification module that hierarchically aligns 3D part structures with CLIP's intermediate spatial priors through attention-driven geometric fusion. Additionally, a Texture Amplification Module synthesizes minimal yet discriminative textures to suppress noise and reinforce cross-modal consistency. To further stabilize incremental prototypes, we employ a Base-Novel Discriminator that isolates geometric variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly improves 3D few-shot class-incremental learning, achieving superior geometric coherence and robustness to texture bias across cross-domain and within-domain settings.
authors: Tuo Xiang, Xuemiao Xu, Bangzhen Liu, Jinyi Li, Yong Li, Shengfeng He ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6761-6771

title: 基于人类认知的多面孔检测框架
title_en: Seeing Through Deepfakes: A Human-Inspired Framework for Multi-Face Detection
abstract: 多面孔深度伪造视频正变得越来越普遍,常出现在自然社交场景中,这给现有检测方法带来了挑战。目前大多数方法在单面孔检测上表现优异,但在多面孔场景中却存在困难,主要由于缺乏对关键上下文线索的感知。在本工作中,我们开发了一种新颖方法,通过借鉴人类认知来分析和防御多面孔深度伪造视频。通过一系列人类研究,我们系统地考察了人们在社交场景中如何检测深度伪造面孔。定量分析揭示了人类依赖的四个关键线索:场景运动一致性、面孔外观兼容性、人际视线对齐以及面孔与身体的一致性。基于这些发现,我们提出了\textsf HICOM,一个专门用于检测多面孔场景中所有伪造面孔的新框架。在基准数据集上的大量实验表明,\textsf HICOM在数据集内检测中平均准确率提升了3.3%,在真实世界扰动下提升了2.8%。此外,它在未见过的数据集上超越现有方法5.8%,证明了人类启发线索的泛化能力。\textsf HICOM进一步通过引入大语言模型(LLM)提供可读的解释,增强了可解释性,使检测结果更加透明和有说服力。我们的工作为引入人类因素以增强对抗深度伪造的防御提供了新思路。
abstract_en: Multi-face deepfake videos are becoming increasingly prevalent, often appearing in natural social settings that challenge existing detection methods. Most current approaches excel at single-face detection but struggle in multi-face scenarios, due to a lack of awareness of crucial contextual cues. In this work, we develop a novel approach that leverages human cognition to analyze and defend against multi-face deepfake videos. Through a series of human studies, we systematically examine how people detect deepfake faces in social settings. Our quantitative analysis reveals four key cues humans rely on: scene-motion coherence, inter-face appearance compatibility, interpersonal gaze alignment, and face-body consistency. Guided by these insights, we introduce \textsf HICOM , a novel framework designed to detect every fake face in multi-face scenarios. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets show that \textsf HICOM  improves average accuracy by 3.3% in in-dataset detection and 2.8% under real-world perturbations. Moreover, it outperforms existing methods by 5.8% on unseen datasets, demonstrating the generalization of human-inspired cues. \textsf HICOM  further enhances interpretability by incorporating an LLM to provide human-readable explanations, making detection results more transparent and convincing. Our work sheds light on involving human factors to enhance defense against deepfakes.
authors: Juan Hu, Shaojing Fan, Terence Sim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14517-14527

title: 看见与透过玻璃看见:用于多层深度估计的真实与合成数据
title_en: Seeing and Seeing Through the Glass: Real and Synthetic Data for Multi-Layer Depth Estimation
abstract: 透明物体在日常生活中普遍存在,理解其多层深度信息——同时感知透明表面与背后的物体——对于涉及透明材料的实际应用至关重要。本文我们引入LayeredDepth数据集,这是首个包含多层深度标注的数据集,包括一个真实场景基准数据集和一个合成数据生成器,以支持多层深度估计任务。我们的真实场景基准数据集包含1500张来自多样化场景的图像,评估最先进的深度估计方法时发现,它们在处理透明物体时表现不佳。该合成数据生成器是完全程序化的,能够提供无限种类物体和场景组合的训练数据。利用该生成器,我们创建了一个包含15300张图像的合成数据集。仅基于该合成数据集训练的基线模型能够产生良好的跨域多层深度估计。在该数据集上对最先进的单层深度模型进行微调,显著提升了其在透明物体上的性能,我们的基准测试中四元组准确率从55.59%提升至75.16%。
abstract_en: Transparent objects are common in daily life, and understanding their multi-layer depth information--perceiving both the transparent surface and the objects behind it--is crucial for real-world applications that interact with transparent materials.In this paper, we introduce LayeredDepth, the first dataset with multi-layer depth annotations, including a real-world benchmark and a synthetic data generator, to support the task of multi-layer depth estimation. Our real-world benchmark consists of 1,500 images from diverse scenes, and evaluating state-of-the-art depth estimation methods on it reveals that they struggle with transparent objects. The synthetic data generator is fully procedural and capable of providing training data for this task with an unlimited variety of objects and scene compositions. Using this generator, we create a synthetic dataset with 15,300 images. Baseline models training solely on this synthetic dataset produce good cross-domain multi-layer depth estimation. Fine-tuning state-of-the-art single-layer depth models on it substantially improves their performance on transparent objects, with quadruplet accuracy on our benchmark increased from 55.59% to 75.16%.
authors: Hongyu Wen, Yiming Zuo, Venkat Subramanian, Patrick Chen, Jia Deng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6715-6725

title: 见林不见树:重新思考弱监督医学视觉定位
title_en: Seeing the Trees for the Forest: Rethinking Weakly-Supervised Medical Visual Grounding
abstract: 视觉定位(VG)是指识别图像中与特定文本描述相关联的具体区域。在医学影像中,VG通过突出与文本描述对应的病理特征,提升模型的可解释性,从而增强模型透明度和可信度,推动深度学习模型在临床实践中的广泛应用。当前模型由于注意力机制效率低下和缺乏细粒度标记表示,难以将文本描述与疾病区域关联。本文通过实证研究得出两个关键观察结果。首先,当前视觉语言模型(VLMs)赋予背景标记较高的范数,导致模型注意力偏离疾病区域。其次,用于跨模态学习的全局标记无法代表局部疾病标记。这阻碍了文本与疾病标记之间相关性的识别。为解决这一问题,我们引入了一种简单而有效的疾病感知提示(DAP)流程,该流程利用VLM的可解释性图谱来识别合适的图像特征。这一简单策略增强了与疾病相关的区域,同时抑制背景干扰。在无需任何像素级标注的情况下,DAP在三个主要胸部X光数据集上,相比现有最先进方法将视觉定位准确率提升了20.74%。
abstract_en: Visual grounding (VG) is the capability to identify the specific regions in an image associated with a particular text description. In medical imaging, VG enhances interpretability by highlighting relevant pathological features corresponding to textual descriptions, improving model transparency and trustworthiness for wider adoption of deep learning models in clinical practice. Current models struggle to associate textual descriptions with disease regions due to inefficient attention mechanisms and a lack of fine-grained token representations. In this paper, we empirically demonstrate two key observations. First, current VLMs assign high norms to background tokens, diverting the model's attention from regions of disease. Second, the global tokens used for cross-modal learning are not representative of local disease tokens. This hampers identifying correlations between the text and disease tokens. To address this, we introduce simple, yet effective Disease-Aware Prompting (DAP) process, which uses the explainability map of a VLM to identify the appropriate image features. This simple strategy amplifies disease-relevant regions while suppressing background interference. Without any additional pixel-level annotations, DAP improves visual grounding accuracy by 20.74% compared to state-of-the-art methods across three major chest X-ray datasets.
authors: Ta Duc Huy, Duy Anh Huynh, Yutong Xie, Yuankai Qi, Qi Chen, Phi Le Nguyen, Sen Kim Tran, Son Lam Phung, Anton van den Hengel, Zhibin Liao, Minh-Son To, Johan W. Verjans, Vu Minh Hieu Phan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24445-24455

title: Seeing the Unseen: 一种面向开放词汇伪装目标分割的语义对齐与上下文感知提示框架
title_en: Seeing the Unseen: A Semantic Alignment and Context-Aware Prompt Framework for Open-Vocabulary Camouflaged Object Segmentation
abstract: 开放词汇伪装目标分割(OVCOS)旨在基于文本描述对任意类别的伪装目标进行分割。尽管现有开放词汇方法展现出强大的分割能力,但在伪装场景中仍存在主要局限:语义混淆,这会导致分割不完整和模型类别偏移。为缓解上述问题,我们提出面向OVCOS的框架SuCLIP。具体而言,我们设计了一种上下文感知提示方案,利用CLIP视觉编码器的内部知识丰富文本提示,并将其与局部视觉特征对齐,从而增强文本提示。为更好地对齐视觉语义空间与文本语义空间,我们设计了类感知特征选择模块,动态调整文本与视觉嵌入,使其更匹配伪装目标。同时,我们引入语义一致性损失以缓解文本提示与视觉特征间的语义偏差,确保分割结果与文本提示的语义一致性。最后,我们设计了文本查询解码器,精确映射文本语义到像素级分割结果,从而实现语义-空间一致的解码。实验结果表明,SuCLIP在OVCamo数据集上显著优于先进方法OVCoser。
abstract_en: Open-Vocabulary Camouflaged Object Segmentation (OVCOS) aims to segment camouflaged objects of any category based on text descriptions. Despite existing open-vocabulary methods exhibit strong segmentation capabilities, they still have a major limitation in camouflaged scenarios: semantic confusion, which leads to incomplete segmentation and class shift in the model. To mitigate the above limitation, we propose a framework for OVCOS, named SuCLIP. Specifically, we design a context-aware prompt scheme that leverages the internal knowledge of the CLIP visual encoder to enrich the text prompt and align it with local visual features, thereby enhancing the text prompt. To better align the visual semantic space and the text semantic space, we design a class-aware feature selection module to dynamically adjust text and visual embeddings, making them more matched with camouflaged object. Meanwhile, we introduce a semantic consistency loss to mitigate the semantic deviation between the text prompt and visual features, ensuring semantic consistency between the segmentation results and the text prompt. Finally, we design a text query decoder that precisely maps textual semantics to pixel-level segmentation results, thereby achieving semantic-spatial consistent decoding. Experimental results show that SuCLIP significantly outperforms the advanced method OVCoser on the OVCamo dataset.
authors: Peng Ren, Tian Bai, Jing Sun, Fuming Sun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23657-23666

title: SegAnyPET: 从正电子发射断层扫描图像实现通用可提示分割
title_en: SegAnyPET: Universal Promptable Segmentation from Positron Emission Tomography Images
abstract: 正电子发射断层扫描(PET)是一种强大的分子成像工具,在现代医学诊断中通过可视化放射性示踪剂分布揭示生理过程,发挥着关键作用。从PET图像中准确分割器官对于全面分析不同器官和病理之间的多系统相互作用至关重要。现有分割方法受限于标注数据不足和标注质量参差不齐,导致泛化能力弱且难以临床应用。尽管分割基础模型在多样化分割任务中展现出卓越的通用性,但医学领域适配工作主要聚焦于包含详细生理结构信息的结构化医学图像,在分子PET成像中泛化性能有限。本文收集构建了迄今为止最大的PET分割数据集PETS-5k,包含5,731例三维全身PET图像及超过1.3M张二维图像。基于该数据集,我们开发了SegAnyPET,这是首个针对PET图像的三维专用基础模型,支持通用可提示分割。为应对标注质量差异的挑战,我们采用跨提示置信学习(CPCL)策略,结合不确定性引导的自校正过程,从高质量标注数据和低质量噪声标注数据中鲁棒地学习分割,实现可提示分割。实验结果表明,SegAnyPET仅需单个或少量提示点即可分割已见和未见目标器官,在准确率和泛化能力方面均优于现有最先进的基础模型和任务专用全监督模型。作为首个PET图像基础模型,我们相信SegAnyPET将推动分子成像在多种下游任务中的应用。
abstract_en: Positron Emission Tomography (PET) is a powerful molecular imaging tool that plays a crucial role in modern medical diagnostics by visualizing radio-tracer distribution to reveal physiological processes. Accurate organ segmentation from PET images is essential for comprehensive multi-systemic analysis of interactions between different organs and pathologies.Existing segmentation methods are limited by insufficient annotation data and varying levels of annotation, resulting in weak generalization ability and difficulty in clinical application. Recent developments in segmentation foundation models have shown superior versatility across diverse segmentation tasks. Despite the efforts of medical adaptations, these works primarily focus on structural medical images with detailed physiological structural information and exhibit limited generalization performance on molecular PET imaging. In this paper, we collect and construct PETS-5k, the largest PET segmentation dataset to date, comprising 5,731 three-dimensional whole-body PET images and encompassing over 1.3M 2D images. Based on the established dataset, we develop SegAnyPET, a modality-specific 3D foundation model for universal promptable segmentation from PET images. To issue the challenge of discrepant annotation quality, we adopt a cross prompting confident learning (CPCL) strategy with an uncertainty-guided self-rectification process to robustly learn segmentation from high-quality labeled data and low-quality noisy labeled data for promptable segmentation. Experimental results demonstrate that SegAnyPET can segment seen and unseen target organs using only one or a few prompt points, outperforming state-of-the-art foundation models and task-specific fully supervised models with higher accuracy and strong generalization ability for universal segmentation. As the first foundation model for PET images, we believe that SegAnyPET will advance the applications to various downstream tasks for molecular imaging.
authors: Yichi Zhang, Le Xue, Wenbo Zhang, Lanlan Li, Yuchen Liu, Chen Jiang, Yuan Cheng, Yuan Qi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21107-21116

title: SegmentDreamer: 面向高保真文本到3D合成的分段一致性轨迹蒸馏
title_en: SegmentDreamer: Towards High-fidelity Text-to-3D Synthesis with Segmented Consistency Trajectory Distillation
abstract: 近期文本到3D生成技术的进步通过直接连接一致性蒸馏(CD)与分数蒸馏采样(SDS)及其变体,提升了SDS的视觉质量。然而,由于自一致性与跨一致性之间的不平衡,这些基于CD的方法本质上存在不当的条件引导问题,导致生成结果次优。为解决这一问题,我们提出SegmentDreamer,一种旨在充分发挥一致性模型潜力的新型框架,用于高保真文本到3D生成。具体而言,我们通过提出的分段一致性轨迹蒸馏(SCTD)重新表述SDS,通过显式定义自一致性与跨一致性之间的关系,有效缓解了不平衡问题。此外,SCTD将概率流常微分方程(PF-ODE)轨迹划分为多个子轨迹,并确保每个子轨迹内的自洽性,理论上可提供显著更紧的蒸馏误差上界。同时,我们提出了一种蒸馏流程以实现更快速且稳定的生成。大量实验表明,我们的SegmentDreamer在视觉质量上超越了现有最先进方法,通过3D高斯点云(3DGS)技术实现了高保真3D资产创建。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in text-to-3D generation improve the visual quality of Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) and its variants by directly connecting Consistency Distillation (CD) to score distillation.However, due to the imbalance between self-consistency and cross-consistency, these CD-based methods inherently suffer from improper conditional guidance, leading to sub-optimal generation results.To address this issue, we present SegmentDreamer, a novel framework designed to fully unleash the potential of consistency models for high-fidelity text-to-3D generation.Specifically, we reformulate SDS through the proposed Segmented Consistency Trajectory Distillation (SCTD), effectively mitigating the imbalance issues by explicitly defining the relationship between self- and cross-consistency.Moreover, SCTD partitions the Probability Flow Ordinary Differential Equation (PF-ODE) trajectory into multiple sub-trajectories and ensures consistency within each segment, which can theoretically provide a significantly tighter upper bound on distillation error.Additionally, we propose a distillation pipeline for a more swift and stable generation.Extensive experiments demonstrate that our SegmentDreamer outperforms state-of-the-art methods in visual quality, enabling high-fidelity 3D asset creation through 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS).
authors: Jiahao Zhu, Zixuan Chen, Guangcong Wang, Xiaohua Xie, Yi Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15864-15874

title: 弱监督可用性定位中的选择性对比学习
title_en: Selective Contrastive Learning for Weakly Supervised Affordance Grounding
abstract: 促进实体与物体的交互需要准确识别赋予特定动作的功能部分。弱监督可用性定位(WSAG)旨在模仿人类从第三人称示范中学习的过程,其中人类无需像素级标注即可直观把握功能部分。为实现这一目标,通常通过跨不同视角图像的共享分类器进行定位学习,并结合包含部分发现过程的蒸馏策略。然而,由于可用性相关部分往往难以区分,模型主要依赖分类,常聚焦于常见但不可用的特征。为解决这一局限,我们超越孤立的部分级学习,引入选择性原型和像素对比目标,根据可用信息的粒度自适应学习部分和物体级的可用性相关线索。首先,我们利用CLIP在第一人称(物体聚焦)和第三人称(示例视角)图像中发现与动作相关的物体。随后,通过交叉参照互补视角的发现物体,我们挖掘每个视角中的精确部分级可用性线索。通过持续学习区分可用性相关区域与无关背景上下文,我们的方法有效将激活从无关区域转移至有意义的可用性线索。实验结果验证了所提方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Facilitating an entity's interaction with objects requires accurately identifying parts that afford specific actions. Weakly supervised affordance grounding (WSAG) seeks to imitate human learning from third-person demonstrations, where humans intuitively grasp functional parts without needing pixel-level annotations. To achieve this, grounding is typically learned using a shared classifier across images from different perspectives, along with distillation strategies incorporating part discovery process. However, since affordance-relevant parts are not always easily distinguishable, models primarily rely on classification, often focusing on common but unaffordable features. To address this limitation, we move beyond isolated part-level learning by introducing selective prototypical and pixel contrastive objectives that adaptively learn affordance-relevant cues at both the part and object levels, depending on the granularity of the available information. Initially, we find the action-associated objects in both egocentric (object-focused) and exocentric (third-person example) images by leveraging CLIP. Then, cross-referencing the discovered objects of complementary views, we excavate the precise part-level affordance clues in each perspective. By consistently learning to distinguish affordance-relevant regions from affordance-irrelevant background context, our approach effectively shifts activation from irrelevant areas toward meaningful affordance cues. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
authors: WonJun Moon, Hyun Seok Seong, Jae-Pil Heo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5210-5220

title: 面向现实世界图像去噪的自校准方差稳定变换
title_en: Self-Calibrated Variance-Stabilizing Transformations for Real-World Image Denoising
abstract: 监督深度学习已成为图像去噪的首选方法。该方法涉及在由噪声图像与干净图像对组成的大规模数据集上训练神经网络。然而,针对特定应用场景的训练数据需求限制了去噪网络的广泛应用。近期,已有方法通过人工生成真实清洁/噪声图像对,或仅在噪声图像上训练来克服这一困难。本文表明,与普遍看法相反,专门用于去除高斯噪声的去噪网络即使无需额外训练,也可高效应用于现实世界图像去噪。为此,需事先应用适当的方差稳定变换(VST)。我们提出了一种名为Noise2VST的算法,用于学习此类无模型VST。我们的方法仅需输入噪声图像和现成的高斯去噪器。通过大量实验验证,Noise2VST在无需特定清洁/噪声对训练的情况下,相较于现有方法展现出更高的效率和优越性。
abstract_en: Supervised deep learning has become the method of choice for image denoising. It involves the training of neural networks on large datasets composed of pairs of noisy and clean images. However, the necessity of training data that are specific to the targeted application constrains the widespread use of denoising networks. Recently, several approaches have been developed to overcome this difficulty by whether artificially generating realistic clean/noisy image pairs, or training exclusively on noisy images. In this paper, we show that, contrary to popular belief, denoising networks specialized in the removal of Gaussian noise can be efficiently leveraged in favor of real-world image denoising, even without additional training. For this to happen, an appropriate variance-stabilizing transform (VST) has to be applied beforehand. We propose an algorithm termed Noise2VST for the learning of such a model-free VST. Our approach requires only the input noisy image and an off-the-shelf Gaussian denoiser. We demonstrate through extensive experiments the efficiency and superiority of Noise2VST in comparison to existing methods trained in the absence of specific clean/noisy pairs.
authors: Sébastien Herbreteau, Michael Unser ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10496-10506

title: 面向大视场重建的自校准高斯点云方法
title_en: Self-Calibrating Gaussian Splatting for Large Field-of-View Reconstruction
abstract: 大视场(FOV)相机可以通过更少的视角提供完整覆盖,从而简化并加速场景捕获过程。然而,现有重建流程未能充分利用大视场输入数据,因为它们将输入视角转换为透视图像,导致图像拉伸而无法使用完整图像。此外,它们使用无法准确拟合真实鱼眼镜头的模型进行镜头校准。我们提出了一种基于高斯点云的新重建流程,采用灵活的镜头模型,支持接近180度的视场。我们通过基于可逆ResNet的混合神经场表示镜头畸变,并使用立方体贴图渲染宽视场图像,同时保持高斯点云流程的效率。我们的系统通过直接对比原始输入像素的损失函数,联合优化镜头畸变、相机内参、相机姿态和场景表示。我们在合成和真实场景上进行了大量实验,证明我们的模型能够准确拟合真实鱼眼镜头,且端到端自校准方法相比现有方法提供了更高质量的重建。更多细节和视频请访问项目页面:https://denghilbert.github.io/self-cali/
abstract_en: Large field-of-view (FOV) cameras can simplify and accelerate scene capture because they provide complete coverage with fewer views. However, existing reconstruction pipelines fail to take full advantage of large-FOV input data because they convert input views to perspective images, resulting in stretching that prevents the use of the full image. Additionally, they calibrate lenses using models that do not accurately fit real fisheye lenses in the periphery. We present a new reconstruction pipeline based on Gaussian Splatting that uses a flexible lens model and supports fields of view approaching 180 degrees. We represent lens distortion with a hybrid neural field based on an Invertible ResNet and use a cubemap to render wide-FOV images while retaining the efficiency of the Gaussian Splatting pipeline. Our system jointly optimizes lens distortion, camera intrinsics, camera poses, and scene representations using a loss measured directly against the original input pixels. We present extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world scenes, demonstrating that our model accurately fits real-world fisheye lenses and that our end-to-end self-calibration approach provides higher-quality reconstructions than existing methods. More details and videos can be found at the project page: https://denghilbert.github.io/self-cali/.
authors: Youming Deng, Wenqi Xian, Guandao Yang, Leonidas Guibas, Gordon Wetzstein, Steve Marschner, Paul Debevec ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25124-25133

title: 用于少样本新视角合成的自集成高斯点云
title_en: Self-Ensembling Gaussian Splatting for Few-Shot Novel View Synthesis
abstract: 三维高斯点云(3DGS)在新视角合成(NVS)中表现出显著的有效性。然而,当使用稀疏视角进行训练时,3DGS容易出现过拟合,限制了其对新视角的泛化能力。本文通过引入自集成高斯点云(SE-GS)来解决这一过拟合问题。我们通过在训练过程中引入不确定性感知的扰动策略实现自集成。Δ模型和Σ模型在可用图像上联合训练。Δ模型基于渲染不确定性在训练步骤中动态扰动,生成多样化的扰动模型,且计算开销可忽略不计。在训练过程中,通过最小化Σ模型与这些扰动模型之间的差异,形成鲁棒的3DGS模型集成。该集成由Σ模型表示,并在推理阶段用于生成新视角图像。在LLFF、Mip-NeRF360、DTU和MVImgNet数据集上的实验结果表明,我们的方法在少样本训练条件下提升了NVS质量,优于现有最先进的方法。代码已发布于:https://sailor-z.github.io/projects/SEGS.html。
abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated remarkable effectiveness in novel view synthesis (NVS). However, 3DGS tends to overfit when trained with sparse views, limiting its generalization to novel viewpoints. In this paper, we address this overfitting issue by introducing Self-Ensembling Gaussian Splatting (SE-GS). We achieve self-ensembling by incorporating an uncertainty-aware perturbation strategy during training. A \Delta-model and a \Sigma-model are jointly trained on the available images. The \Delta-model is dynamically perturbed based on rendering uncertainty across training steps, generating diverse perturbed models with negligible computational overhead. Discrepancies between the \Sigma-model and these perturbed models are minimized throughout training, forming a robust ensemble of 3DGS models. This ensemble, represented by the \Sigma-model, is then used to generate novel-view images during inference. Experimental results on the LLFF, Mip-NeRF360, DTU, and MVImgNet datasets demonstrate that our approach enhances NVS quality under few-shot training conditions, outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods. The code is released at: https://sailor-z.github.io/projects/SEGS.html.
authors: Chen Zhao, Xuan Wang, Tong Zhang, Saqib Javed, Mathieu Salzmann ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4940-4950

title: 基于双知识协作的自增强原型演化半监督终身行人重识别
title_en: Self-Reinforcing Prototype Evolution with Dual-Knowledge Cooperation for Semi-Supervised Lifelong Person Re-Identification
abstract: 当前终身行人重识别(LReID)方法主要依赖于全标注数据流。然而,在标注资源有限的现实场景中,大量未标注数据与稀缺标注样本共存,导致半监督终身行人重识别(Semi-LReID)问题,使得LReID方法性能严重退化。现有LReID方法,即使结合半监督策略,仍因难以处理未标注数据利用过程中产生的噪声知识而面临长期适应性能受限的问题。本文首次系统研究Semi-LReID问题,提出一种新颖的基于双知识协作的自增强原型演化框架(SPRED)。我们的核心创新在于建立动态原型引导的伪标签生成与新旧知识协同净化之间的自增强循环,以提升未标注数据的利用效率。具体而言,引入可学习的身份原型动态捕捉身份分布并生成高质量伪标签。随后,双知识协作方案整合当前模型专业化与历史模型泛化能力,优化噪声伪标签。通过该循环设计,逐步挖掘可靠伪标签以提升当前阶段学习,并确保长期学习中的正向知识传播。在建立的Semi-LReID基准测试中,我们的SPRED方法取得了最先进性能。源代码已开源至https://github.com/zhoujiahuan1991/ICCV2025-SPRED
abstract_en: Current lifelong person re-identification (LReID) methods predominantly rely on fully labeled data streams. However, in real-world scenarios where annotation resources are limited, a vast amount of unlabeled data coexists with scarce labeled samples, leading to the Semi-Supervised LReID (Semi-LReID) problem where LReID methods suffer severe performance degradation. Existing LReID methods, even when combined with semi-supervised strategies, suffer from limited long-term adaptation performance due to struggling with the noisy knowledge occurring during unlabeled data utilization. In this paper, we pioneer the investigation of Semi-LReID, introducing a novel Self-Reinforcing PRototype Evolution with Dual-Knowledge Cooperation framework (SPRED). Our key innovation lies in establishing a self-reinforcing cycle between dynamic prototype-guided pseudo-label generation and new-old knowledge collaborative purification to enhance the utilization of unlabeled data. Specifically, learnable identity prototypes are introduced to dynamically capture the identity distributions and generate high-quality pseudo-labels. Then, the dual-knowledge cooperation scheme integrates current model specialization and historical model generalization, refining noisy pseudo-labels. Through this cyclic design, reliable pseudo-labels are progressively mined to improve current-stage learning and ensure positive knowledge propagation over long-term learning. Experiments on the established Semi-LReID benchmarks show that our SPRED achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our source code is available at https://github.com/zhoujiahuan1991/ICCV2025-SPRED
authors: Kunlun Xu, Fan Zhuo, Jiangmeng Li, Xu Zou, Jiahuan Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3564-3574

title: 面向第一视角视频的自监督单目四维场景重建
title_en: Self-Supervised Monocular 4D Scene Reconstruction for Egocentric Videos
abstract: 第一视角视频为人类与物理世界的互动提供了宝贵的见解,这在计算机视觉和机器人学领域引发了广泛关注。要完全理解第一视角视频的几何结构和动态特性,密集场景重建是一个关键挑战。然而,该领域缺乏高质量标注数据集,限制了当前监督学习方法的有效性。本文旨在通过探索自监督动态场景重建方法来解决这一问题。我们提出**EgoMono4D**,一种新型模型,统一了*Ego*centric *Mono*cular *4D*重建所需多变量的估计,包括相机内参、相机位姿和视频深度,所有计算均在快速前馈框架内完成。基于预训练的单帧深度和内参估计模型,我们扩展了相机位姿估计功能,并在大规模未标注的第一视角视频上对多帧结果进行对齐。我们在领域内和零样本泛化设置下评估EgoMono4D,在密集点云序列重建任务中优于所有基线方法。EgoMono4D是首个将自监督学习应用于点云序列重建的尝试,适用于标注稀缺的第一视角领域,实现了快速、密集且可泛化的重建。交互式可视化、代码和训练模型已发布于https://egomono4d.github.io/。
abstract_en: Egocentric videos provide valuable insights into human interactions with the physical world, which has sparked growing interest in the computer vision and robotics communities. A critical challenge in fully understanding the geometry and dynamics of egocentric videos is dense scene reconstruction. However, the lack of high-quality labeled datasets in this field has hindered the effectiveness of current supervised learning methods. In this work, we aim to address this issue by exploring an self-supervised dynamic scene reconstruction approach. We introduce **EgoMono4D**, a novel model that unifies the estimation of multiple variables necessary for *Ego*centric *Mono*cular *4D* reconstruction, including camera intrinsic, camera poses, and video depth, all within a fast feed-forward framework. Starting from pretrained single-frame depth and intrinsic estimation model, we extend it with camera poses estimation and align multi-frame results on large-scale unlabeled egocentric videos. We evaluate EgoMono4D in both in-domain and zero-shot generalization settings, achieving superior performance in dense pointclouds sequence reconstruction compared to all baselines. EgoMono4D represents the first attempt to apply self-supervised learning for pointclouds sequence reconstruction to the label-scarce egocentric field, enabling fast, dense, and generalizable reconstruction. The interactable visualization, code and trained models are released https://egomono4d.github.io/.
authors: Chengbo Yuan, Geng Chen, Li Yi, Yang Gao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8863-8874

title: 面向长距离感知的自监督稀疏传感器融合
title_en: Self-Supervised Sparse Sensor Fusion for Long Range Perception
abstract: 在城市中心以外的区域,自动驾驶汽车和卡车必须掌握城际高速公路的驾驶技能。以超过100 km/h的速度进行安全长途高速公路行驶,需要至少250米的感知距离,这大约是城市驾驶中通常处理的50-100米的五倍,以确保足够的规划和制动余量。增加感知范围还允许将自动驾驶能力从轻型两吨级乘用车扩展到大型四十吨级卡车,后者由于惯性较大需要更长的规划时间范围。然而,大多数现有感知方法侧重于较短范围,并依赖于鸟眼视图(BEV)表示,随着距离增加,其内存和计算成本呈二次增长。为克服这一局限性,我们基于稀疏表示构建框架,引入了高效的三维多模态时序特征编码,并提出了一种新颖的自监督预训练方案,使系统能够从未标记的相机-激光雷达数据中进行大规模学习。我们的方法将感知距离扩展至250米,在目标检测中实现26.6%的mAP提升,在激光雷达预测中将切比雪夫距离降低30.5%,相比现有方法达到250米的感知距离。
abstract_en: Outside of urban hubs, autonomous cars and trucks have to master driving on intercity highways.
