We propose to solve the problem locally on individual objects and leverage the capabilities of instance segmentation methods to scale our solution to full 3D scenes. In doing that, we design a new architecture which efficiently decompose point clouds of arbitrary objects in a compact set of superquadrics. We train our architecture on ShapeNet and we prove its generalization capabilities on object instances extracted from the ScanNet++ dataset as well as on full Replica scenes. Finally, we show how a compact representation based on superquadrics can be useful for a diverse range of downstream applications, including robotic tasks and controllable visual content generation and editing.
authors: Elisabetta Fedele, Boyang Sun, Leonidas Guibas, Marc Pollefeys, Francis Engelmann ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24625-24635

title: SuperEdit:基于指令的图像编辑中监督的修正与增强
title_en: SuperEdit: Rectifying and Facilitating Supervision for Instruction-Based Image Editing
abstract: 由于手动收集准确编辑数据的挑战,现有数据集通常通过各种自动化方法构建,导致编辑指令与原始编辑图像对之间的不匹配产生噪声监督信号。近期研究尝试通过生成高质量编辑图像、在识别任务上进行预训练或引入视觉-语言模型(VLMs)来改进编辑模型,但未能解决这一根本问题。本文通过为给定图像对构建更有效的编辑指令提供新解决方案。这包括修正编辑指令以更好地与原始编辑图像对对齐,并使用对比编辑指令进一步增强其有效性。具体而言,我们发现编辑模型在不同推理步骤中表现出特定的生成属性,且与文本无关。基于这些先验属性,我们定义了统一的指南用于VLMs修正编辑指令。然而,存在一些难以仅通过修正指令解决的挑战性编辑场景。为此,我们进一步构建包含正负指令的对比监督信号,并通过三元组损失将其引入模型训练,从而进一步增强监督效果。我们的方法无需使用先前工作中的VLM模块或预训练任务,提供了一种更直接高效的监督信号提供方式,为基于指令的图像编辑提供了新颖、简单且有效的解决方案。在多个基准测试中的结果表明,我们的方法显著优于现有方法。与先前SOTA SmartEdit相比,在Real-Edit基准测试中,我们仅使用30倍更少的训练数据和13倍更小的模型规模就实现了9.19%的性能提升。所有数据和模型均开源于\href https://github.com/bytedance/SuperEdit Github供未来研究使用。
abstract_en: Due to the challenges of manually collecting accurate editing data, existing datasets are typically constructed using various automated methods, leading to noisy supervision signals caused by the mismatch between editing instructions and original-edited image pairs. Recent efforts attempt to improve editing models through generating higher-quality edited images, pre-training on recognition tasks, or introducing vision-language models (VLMs) but fail to resolve this fundamental issue. In this paper, we offer a novel solution by constructing more effective editing instructions for given image pairs. This includes rectifying the editing instructions to better align with the original-edited image pairs and using contrastive editing instructions to further enhance their effectiveness. Specifically, we find that editing models exhibit specific generation attributes at different inference steps, independent of the text. Based on these prior attributes, we define a unified guide for VLMs to rectify editing instructions. However, there are some challenging editing scenarios that cannot be resolved solely with rectified instructions. To this end, we further construct contrastive supervision signals with positive and negative instructions and introduce them into the model training using triplet loss, thereby further facilitating supervision effectiveness. Our method does not require the VLM modules or pre-training tasks used in previous work, offering a more direct and efficient way to provide better supervision signals, and providing a novel, simple, and effective solution for instruction-based image editing. Results on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing approaches. Compared with previous SOTA SmartEdit, we achieve 9.19% improvements on the Real-Edit benchmark with 30xless training data and 13xsmaller model size. All data and models are open-sourced on \href https://github.com/bytedance/SuperEdit  Github  for future research.
authors: Ming Li, Xin Gu, Fan Chen, Xiaoying Xing, Longyin Wen, Chen Chen, Sijie Zhu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19206-19215

title: SuperEvent:基于事件的特征点检测跨模态学习用于SLAM
title_en: SuperEvent: Cross-Modal Learning of Event-based Keypoint Detection for SLAM
abstract: 基于事件的特征点检测与匹配具有巨大潜力,能够将事件传感器集成到高度优化的视觉SLAM系统中,该系统经过数十年帧相机研究开发。不幸的是,现有方法在处理与运动相关的特征点外观以及事件流中普遍存在的复杂噪声时存在困难,导致特征匹配能力严重受限且下游任务性能不佳。为缓解这一问题,我们提出SuperEvent,一种数据驱动的方法,用于预测具有表达性描述符的稳定特征点。由于缺乏带有真实标签的事件数据集,我们利用现有基于帧的特征点检测器,在可获取的事件对齐和同步灰度帧上进行自监督:我们生成时间稀疏的特征点伪标签,考虑到事件是场景外观和相机运动的产物。结合我们新颖的信息丰富事件表示,SuperEvent能够有效学习事件流中的鲁棒特征点检测与描述。最后,我们通过将SuperEvent集成到现代稀疏特征点和描述符基于的SLAM框架中(该框架最初为传统相机开发),证明其有效性,其性能在事件SLAM领域远超现有最先进方法。源代码可在https://ethz-mrl.github.io/SuperEvent/获取。
abstract_en: Event-based keypoint detection and matching holds significant potential, enabling the integration of event sensors into highly optimized Visual SLAM systems developed for frame cameras over decades of research. Unfortunately, existing approaches struggle with the motion-dependent appearance of keypoints and the complex noise prevalent in event streams, resulting in severely limited feature matching capabilities and poor performance on downstream tasks. To mitigate this problem, we propose SuperEvent, a data-driven approach to predict stable keypoints with expressive descriptors. Due to the absence of event datasets with ground truth keypoint labels, we leverage existing frame-based keypoint detectors on readily available event-aligned and synchronized gray-scale frames for self-supervision: we generate temporally sparse keypoint pseudo-labels considering that events are a product of both scene appearance and camera motion. Combined with our novel, information-rich event representation, we enable SuperEvent to effectively learn robust keypoint detection and description in event streams. Finally, we demonstrate the usefulness of SuperEvent by its integration into a modern sparse keypoint and descriptor-based SLAM framework originally developed for traditional cameras, surpassing the state-of-the-art in event-based SLAM by a wide margin. Source code is available at https://ethz-mrl.github.io/SuperEvent/.
authors: Yannick Burkhardt, Simon Schaefer, Stefan Leutenegger ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8918-8928

title: SuperMat:实时交互速率下的物理一致PBR材质估计
title_en: SuperMat: Physically Consistent PBR Material Estimation at Interactive Rates
abstract: 从图像中分解基于物理的材质到其组成属性仍具有挑战性,特别是在保持计算效率和物理一致性方面。尽管最近的扩散模型方法显示出前景,但由于多步去噪和针对不同材质属性的独立模型,其计算开销显著。我们提出SuperMat,一个单步框架,通过一步推理实现高质量的材质分解。这使得能够使用感知损失和重渲染损失进行端到端训练,同时以毫秒级速度分解漫反射、金属度和粗糙度图。我们进一步通过UV优化网络扩展框架至3D物体,实现跨视角的一致材质估计并保持效率。实验表明,SuperMat在PBR材质分解质量上达到最先进水平,将推理时间从秒级缩短至毫秒级每图像,并在约3秒内完成3D物体的PBR材质估计。项目页面位于https://hyj542682306.github.io/SuperMat/。
abstract_en: Decomposing physically-based materials from images into their constituent properties remains challenging, particularly when maintaining both computational efficiency and physical consistency. While recent diffusion-based approaches have shown promise, they face substantial computational overhead due to multiple denoising steps and separate models for different material properties. We present SuperMat, a single-step framework that achieves high-quality material decomposition with one-step inference. This enables end-to-end training with perceptual and re-render losses while decomposing albedo, metallic, and roughness maps at millisecond-scale speeds. We further extend our framework to 3D objects through a UV refinement network, enabling consistent material estimation across viewpoints while maintaining efficiency. Experiments demonstrate that SuperMat achieves state-of-the-art PBR material decomposition quality while reducing inference time from seconds to milliseconds per image, and completes PBR material estimation for 3D objects in approximately 3 seconds. The project page is at https://hyj542682306.github.io/SuperMat/.
authors: Yijia Hong, Yuan-Chen Guo, Ran Yi, Yulong Chen, Yan-Pei Cao, Lizhuang Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25083-25093

title: 增强型一步式文本到图像扩散模型与负提示
title_en: Supercharged One-step Text-to-Image Diffusion Models with Negative Prompts
abstract: 实时图像合成需求的激增推动了一步式扩散模型的显著进展,这类模型相比传统多步方法本征地提供了更快的生成速度。然而,这种增强的效率通常伴随着图像属性可控性的妥协。尽管无分类器引导(CFG)实现的负提示在多步模型中已被证明对细粒度控制有效,但其在一步式生成器中的应用仍鲜有研究。由于缺乏多步扩散中的迭代优化,直接将CFG应用于一步式生成会导致混叠伪影和输出质量下降。为填补这一空白,我们提出Negative-Away Steer Attention(NASA),一种高效方法,将负提示集成到一步式扩散模型中。NASA通过交叉注意力机制在中间表示空间内操作,抑制不需要的视觉属性。该策略避免了输出空间引导固有的混叠伪影,同时实现高效率,仅比CFG计算量翻倍带来1.89%的FLOPs增量。此外,NASA可无缝集成到现有时间步蒸馏框架中,提升学生模型的输出质量。实验结果表明,NASA显著提升了可控性与输出质量,达到HPSv2评分31.21,为一步式扩散模型设立了新的SOTA基准。
abstract_en: The escalating demand for real-time image synthesis has driven significant advancements in one-step diffusion models, which inherently offer expedited generation speeds compared to traditional multi-step methods. However, this enhanced efficiency is frequently accompanied by a compromise in the controllability of image attributes. While negative prompting, typically implemented via classifier-free guidance (CFG), has proven effective for fine-grained control in multi-step models, its application to one-step generators remains largely unaddressed. Due to the lack of iterative refinement, as in multi-step diffusion, directly applying CFG to one-step generation leads to blending artifacts and diminished output quality. To fill this gap, we introduce Negative-Away Steer Attention (NASA), an efficient method that integrates negative prompts into one-step diffusion models. NASA operates within the intermediate representation space by leveraging cross-attention mechanisms to suppress undesired visual attributes. This strategy avoids the blending artifacts inherent in output-space guidance and achieves high efficiency, incurring only a minimal 1.89% increase in FLOPs compared to the computational doubling of CFG. Furthermore, NASA can be seamlessly integrated into existing timestep distillation frameworks, enhancing the student's output quality. Experimental results demonstrate that NASA substantially improves controllability and output quality, achieving an HPSv2 score of 31.21, setting a new state-of-the-art benchmark for one-step diffusion models.
authors: Viet Nguyen, Anh Nguyen, Trung Dao, Khoi Nguyen, Cuong Pham, Toan Tran, Anh Tran ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18004-18013

title: 基于语义射线增强的平面图定位
title_en: Supercharging Floorplan Localization with Semantic Rays
abstract: 平面图提供了建筑物结构的紧凑表示,不仅揭示了布局信息,还包含窗户和门等详细语义信息的位置。然而,当前平面图定位技术主要关注基于深度的结构线索匹配,忽略了平面图中蕴含的丰富语义信息。本文提出了一种语义感知的定位框架,联合估计深度和语义射线,并通过两者融合预测结构-语义概率体积。我们的概率体积采用由粗到细的方式构建:首先采样少量射线获得低分辨率初始概率体积,随后仅在高概率区域进行密集采样以优化概率值,并处理优化后的值以预测二维位置和方向角度。我们在两个标准平面图定位基准数据集上进行了评估。实验表明,我们的方法显著优于现有最先进方法,在召回率指标上相比先前工作取得了显著提升。此外,我们展示了该框架可轻松集成房间标签等附加元数据,从而在准确性和效率方面实现进一步提升。
abstract_en: Floorplans provide a compact representation of the building's structure, revealing not only layout information but also detailed semantics such as the locations of windows and doors. However, contemporary floorplan localization techniques mostly focus on matching depth-based structural cues, ignoring the rich semantics communicated within floorplans. In this work, we introduce a semantic-aware localization framework that jointly estimates depth and semantic rays, consolidating over both for predicting a structural-semantic probability volume. Our probability volume is constructed in a coarse-to-fine manner: We first sample a small set of rays to obtain an initial low-resolution probability volume. We then refine these probabilities by performing a denser sampling only in high-probability regions and process the refined values for predicting a 2D location and orientation angle. We conduct an evaluation on two standard floorplan localization benchmarks. Our experiments demonstrate that our approach substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving significant improvements in recall metrics compared to prior works. Moreover, we show that our framework can easily incorporate additional metadata such as room labels, enabling additional gains in both accuracy and efficiency.
authors: Yuval Grader, Hadar Averbuch-Elor ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27116-27125

title: 增强开放词汇目标检测器的X光视觉能力
title_en: Superpowering Open-Vocabulary Object Detectors for X-ray Vision
abstract: 开放词汇目标检测(OvOD)旨在通过使系统能够识别X光扫描中的任何物品来革新安全检查流程。然而,由于数据稀缺性和模态差距导致无法直接采用RGB基解决方案,开发有效的X光成像OvOD模型面临独特挑战。为克服这些限制,我们提出RAXO,一个无需训练的框架,通过重新利用现成的RGB OvOD检测器实现稳健的X光检测。RAXO采用双源检索策略构建高质量X光类别描述符。它从网络中收集相关RGB图像,并通过新颖的X光材料迁移机制进行丰富,无需依赖标注数据库。这些视觉描述符替代了OvOD中的文本分类,利用同模态特征距离实现稳健检测。大量实验表明,RAXO持续提升OvOD性能,相比基础检测器平均mAP提升最高达17.0个百分点。为进一步支持该新兴领域研究,我们还引入了DET-COMPASS新基准测试,包含超过300个物品类别的边界框注释,支持大规模OvOD在X光场景下的评估。代码和数据集可访问:https://pagf188.github.io/RAXO/
abstract_en: Open-vocabulary object detection (OvOD) is set to revolutionize security screening by enabling systems to recognize any item in X-ray scans. However, developing effective OvOD models for X-ray imaging presents unique challenges due to data scarcity and the modality gap that prevents direct adoption of RGB-based solutions. To overcome these limitations, we propose RAXO, a training-free framework that repurposes off-the-shelf RGB OvOD detectors for robust X-ray detection. RAXO builds high-quality X-ray class descriptors using a dual-source retrieval strategy. It gathers relevant RGB images from the web and enriches them via a novel X-ray material transfer mechanism, eliminating the need for labeled databases. These visual descriptors replace text-based classification in OvOD, leveraging intra-modal feature distances for robust detection. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RAXO consistently improves OvOD performance, providing an average mAP increase of up to 17.0 points over base detectors. To further support research in this emerging field, we also introduce DET-COMPASS, a new benchmark featuring bounding box annotations for over 300 object categories, enabling large-scale evaluation of OvOD in X-ray. Code and dataset available at: https://pagf188.github.io/RAXO/.
authors: Pablo Garcia-Fernandez, Lorenzo Vaquero, Mingxuan Liu, Feng Xue, Daniel Cores, Nicu Sebe, Manuel Mucientes, Elisa Ricci ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20770-20779

title: 长尾视觉识别的监督探索学习
title_en: Supervised Exploratory Learning for Long-Tailed Visual Recognition
abstract: 长尾数据对深度学习模型提出了显著挑战,这些模型往往优先准确分类头部类别而忽视尾部类别。现有技术如类重平衡、logit调整和数据增强旨在扩大尾类的决策区域或实现清晰的决策边界,但对决策区域的鲁棒性考虑不足。本文提出了一种简单而有效的监督探索学习(SEL)框架,从空间探索视角同时实现上述目标。SEL采用自适应最优觅食算法(OFA)生成多样化的探索示例,结合类偏倚互补(CbC)实现均衡的类别分布和适应度加权采样(FwS)进行空间探索。理论分析和实证结果均表明,SEL增强了类别平衡,锐化了决策边界并强化了决策区域。SEL是一种即插即用的训练框架,可无缝集成到模型训练或分类器调整阶段,具有高度适应性和兼容性,能够与现有方法兼容并进一步提升性能。在多个长尾基准数据集上的广泛实验验证了SEL的优越性。
abstract_en: Long-tailed data poses a significant challenge for deep learning models, which tend to prioritize accurate classification of head classes while largely neglecting tail classes. Existing techniques, such as class re-balancing, logit adjustment, and data augmentation, aim to enlarge decision regions of tail classes or achieve clear decision boundaries, leaving the robustness of decision regions under-considered. This paper proposes a simple yet effective Supervised Exploratory Learning (SEL) framework to achieve these goals simultaneously from space exploration perspectives. SEL employs the adaptive Optimal Foraging Algorithm (OFA) to generate diverse exploratory examples, integrating Class-biased Complement (CbC) for balanced class distribution and Fitness-weighted Sampling (FwS) for space exploration. Both theoretical analysis and empirical results demonstrate that SEL enhances class balance, sharpens decision boundaries, and strengthens decision regions. SEL is a plug-and-play training framework that can be seamlessly integrated into model training or classifier adjustment stages, making it highly adaptable and compatible with existing methods and facilitating further performance improvements. Extensive experiments on various long-tailed benchmarks demonstrate SEL's superiority.
authors: Zhongquan Jian, Yanhao Chen, Yancheng Wang, Junfeng Yao, Meihong Wang, Qingqiang Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1870-1880

title: SurfaceSplat:连接表面重建与高斯点云
title_en: SurfaceSplat: Connecting Surface Reconstruction and Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 从稀疏视角图像进行表面重建和新视角渲染具有挑战性。基于符号距离函数(SDF)的方法难以处理精细细节,而基于三维高斯点云(3DGS)的方法缺乏全局几何一致性。我们提出了一种新颖的混合方法,结合两者的优势:SDF捕捉粗尺度几何以增强基于3DGS的渲染,而由3DGS新生成的图像则用于细化SDF细节,从而实现精确的表面重建。实验结果表明,我们的方法在DTU和MobileBrick数据集上的表面重建和新视角合成任务中超越了现有最先进的方法。代码将发布于https://github.com/aim-uofa/SurfaceSplat。
abstract_en: Surface reconstruction and novel view rendering from sparse-view images are challenging. Signed Distance Function (SDF)-based methods struggle with fine details, while 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based approaches lack global geometry coherence. We propose a novel hybrid method that combines both strengths: SDF captures coarse geometry to enhance 3DGS-based rendering, while newly rendered images from 3DGS refine SDF details for accurate surface reconstruction. As a result, our method surpasses state-of-the-art approaches in surface reconstruction and novel view synthesis on DTU and MobileBrick datasets. Code will be released at https://github.com/aim-uofa/SurfaceSplat.
authors: Zihui Gao, Jia-Wang Bian, Guosheng Lin, Hao Chen, Chunhua Shen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28525-28534

title: SweetTok: 语义感知的时空分词器用于紧凑视频离散化
title_en: SweetTok: Semantic-Aware Spatial-Temporal Tokenizer for Compact Video Discretization
abstract: 本文提出了一种新型视频分词器——语义感知时空分词器(SweetTok),旨在克服当前视频分词方法在紧凑且有效离散化方面的局限性。与以往通过直接离散化或自适应查询分词处理扁平化局部视觉块的方法不同,SweetTok提出了一种解耦框架,通过解耦查询自编码器(DQAE)利用不同的空间和时间查询对视觉输入进行压缩。该设计使SweetTok能够在压缩视频分词数量的同时,通过捕捉空间和时间维度上的关键信息,实现更好的保真度。此外,我们设计了专门用于空间和时间压缩的运动增强语言码本(MLC),以解决外观信息与运动信息在语义表示上的差异。SweetTok在UCF-101数据集上,相对于rFVD指标显著提升了42.8%的视频重建效果。凭借更优的分词压缩策略,它还相对于gFVD指标提升了15.1%的下游视频生成效果。此外,压缩后的解耦分词蕴含语义信息,使下游应用中基于大语言模型(LLM)的少样本识别成为可能。
abstract_en: This paper presents the Semantic-aWarE spatial-tEmporal Tokenizer (SweetTok), a novel video tokenizer to overcome the limitations in current video tokenization methods for compacted yet effective discretization. Unlike previous approaches that process flattened local visual patches via direct discretization or adaptive query tokenization, SweetTok proposes a decoupling framework, compressing visual inputs through distinct spatial and temporal queries via Decoupled Query AutoEncoder (DQAE). This design allows SweetTok to efficiently compress video token count while achieving better fidelity by capturing essential information across spatial and temporal dimensions. Furthermore, we design a Motion-enhanced Language Codebook (MLC) tailored for spatial and temporal compression to address the differences in semantic representation between appearance and motion information.SweetTok significantly improves video reconstruction results by 42.8% w.r.t rFVD on UCF-101 dataset.With a better token compression strategy, it also boost downstream video generation results by 15.1% w.r.t gFVD.Additionally, the compressed decoupled tokens are imbued with semantic information, enabling few-shot recognition capabilities powered by LLMs in downstream applications.
authors: Zhentao Tan, Ben Xue, Jian Jia, Junhao Wang, Wencai Ye, Shaoyun Shi, Mingjie Sun, Wenjin Wu, Quan Chen, Peng Jiang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23541-23550

title: Switch-a-View:从无标签野外视频中学习视角选择
title_en: Switch-a-View: View Selection Learned from Unlabeled In-the-wild Videos
abstract: 我们介绍了Switch-a-View模型,该模型学习在创建教学视频时自动选择每个时间点显示的视角。我们的方法核心在于如何从无标签但由人类编辑的视频样本中训练此类模型。我们设计了一个预训练任务,为训练视频中的片段进行伪标签(确定其主要视角,如第一人称或第三人称),并在此基础上发现教学视频的视觉与语音内容与视角切换时刻之间的模式。借助这一预测器,我们的模型可应用于新的多视角视频,以协调何时显示哪个视角。我们在HowTo100M和Ego-Exo4D等真实世界视频数据集上验证了该方法,并严格验证了其优势。
abstract_en: We introduce Switch-a-View, a model that learns to automatically select the viewpoint to display at each timepoint when creating a how-to video. The key insight of our approach is how to train such a model from unlabeled--but human-edited--video samples. We pose a pretext task that pseudo-labels segments in the training videos for their primary viewpoint (egocentric or exocentric), and then discovers the patterns between the visual and spoken content in a how-to video on the one hand and its view-switch moments on the other hand. Armed with this predictor, our model can be applied to new multi-view videos to orchestrate which viewpoint should be displayed when. We demonstrate our idea on a variety of real-world videos from HowTo100M and Ego-Exo4D, and rigorously validate its advantages.
authors: Sagnik Majumder, Tushar Nagarajan, Ziad Al-Halah, Kristen Grauman ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11969-11979

title: SynAD:通过合成数据集成增强现实世界端到端自动驾驶模型
title_en: SynAD: Enhancing Real-World End-to-End Autonomous Driving Models through Synthetic Data Integration
abstract: 近年来,深度学习的进展以及高质量的现实世界驾驶数据集的可用性推动了端到端自动驾驶的发展。尽管取得了这一进展,仅依赖现实世界数据仍会限制训练中驾驶场景的多样性。合成场景生成已作为丰富训练数据多样性的有前景解决方案出现;然而,其在端到端自动驾驶(E2E AD)模型中的应用仍 largely unexplored。这主要是由于现实世界场景中通常提供的指定自身车辆(ego vehicle)及其相关传感器输入(如摄像头或激光雷达)的缺失。为解决这一差距,我们引入了SynAD,这是首个旨在通过合成数据增强现实世界端到端自动驾驶模型的框架。我们的方法在多智能体合成场景中将拥有最全面驾驶信息的代理指定为自身车辆。我们进一步将路径级场景投影到地图上,并采用新开发的Map-to-BEV网络以无需依赖传感器输入的方式提取俯视图特征。最后,我们设计了一种有效的训练策略,将这些基于地图的合成数据与真实驾驶数据进行融合。实验结果表明,SynAD有效整合了所有组件,并显著提升了安全性表现。通过连接合成场景生成与端到端自动驾驶,SynAD为更全面且稳健的自动驾驶模型铺平了道路。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in deep learning and the availability of high-quality real-world driving datasets have propelled end-to-end autonomous driving. Despite this progress, relying solely on real-world data limits the variety of driving scenarios for training. Synthetic scenario generation has emerged as a promising solution to enrich the diversity of training data; however, its application within E2E AD models remains largely unexplored. This is primarily due to the absence of a designated ego vehicle and the associated sensor inputs, such as camera or LiDAR, typically provided in real-world scenarios. To address this gap, we introduce SynAD, the first framework designed to enhance real-world E2E AD models using synthetic data. Our method designates the agent with the most comprehensive driving information as the ego vehicle in a multi-agent synthetic scenario. We further project path-level scenarios onto maps and employ a newly developed Map-to-BEV Network to derive bird's-eye-view features without relying on sensor inputs. Finally, we devise a training strategy that effectively integrates these map-based synthetic data with real driving data. Experimental results demonstrate that SynAD effectively integrates all components and notably enhances safety performance. By bridging synthetic scenario generation and E2E AD, SynAD paves the way for more comprehensive and robust autonomous driving models.
authors: Jongsuk Kim, Jaeyoung Lee, Gyojin Han, Dong-Jae Lee, Minki Jeong, Junmo Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25197-25206

title: SynCity:无需训练的3D世界生成
title_en: SynCity: Training-Free Generation of 3D Worlds
abstract: 我们提出SynCity,一种从文本描述生成可探索3D世界的方法。我们的方法利用预训练的文本、图像和3D生成器,无需进行微调或推理时优化。尽管大多数3D生成器以对象为中心且无法创建大规模世界,我们展示了如何通过结合2D和3D生成器生成不断扩展的场景。世界以瓷砖形式逐块生成,每个新瓷砖在其上下文中创建并无缝整合到场景中。SynCity使生成世界的外观和布局实现细粒度控制,生成的世界既详细又多样化。
abstract_en: We propose SynCity, a method for generating explorable 3D worlds from textual descriptions. Our approach leverages pre-trained textual, image, and 3D generators without requiring fine-tuning or inference-time optimization. While most 3D generators are object-centric and unable to create large-scale worlds, we demonstrate how 2D and 3D generators can be combined to produce ever-expanding scenes. The world is generated tile by tile, with each new tile created within its context and seamlessly integrated into the scene. SynCity enables fine-grained control over the appearance and layout of the generated worlds, which are both detailed and diverse.
authors: Paul Engstler, Aleksandar Shtedritski, Iro Laina, Christian Rupprecht, Andrea Vedaldi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27585-27595

title: SynFER:面向合成数据提升面部表情识别的框架
title_en: SynFER: Towards Boosting Facial Expression Recognition with Synthetic Data
abstract: 由于隐私问题、标注的主观性以及数据收集的劳动密集型特性,面部表情数据集在规模上仍受到限制。这一限制对依赖大规模数据实现最佳性能的现代深度学习面部表情分析模型,特别是基础模型,构成了重大挑战。为应对这一全面而复杂的挑战,我们提出SynFER(基于精细控制的面部表情合成),这是一种基于高层文本描述以及更细粒度和精确的面部动作单元控制的面部表情图像数据合成框架。为确保合成数据的质量和可靠性,我们提出语义引导技术以指导生成过程,并设计伪标签生成器来帮助校正合成图像的面部表情标签。为验证SynFER生成数据的保真度和有效性,我们在合成数据和真实数据上进行了广泛的表示学习实验。结果验证了我们方法的有效性及合成数据的可靠性。值得注意的是,当仅使用与AffectNet训练集规模相当的合成数据进行训练时,我们的方法在AffectNet上实现了67.23%的分类准确率,当数据规模扩大到原始大小五倍时,准确率提升至69.84%。
abstract_en: Facial expression datasets remain limited in scale due to privacy concerns, the subjectivity of annotations, and the labor-intensive nature of data collection. This limitation poses a significant challenge for developing modern deep learning-based facial expression analysis models, particularly foundation models, that rely on large-scale data for optimal performance. To tackle the overarching and complex challenge, we introduce SynFER (Synthesis of Facial Expressions with Refined Control), a novel framework for synthesizing facial expression image data based on high-level textual descriptions as well as more fine-grained and precise control through facial action units. To ensure the quality and reliability of the synthetic data, we propose a semantic guidance technique to steer the generation process and a pseudo-label generator to help rectify the facial expression labels for the synthetic images. To demonstrate the generation fidelity and the effectiveness of the synthetic data from SynFER, we conduct extensive experiments on representation learning using both synthetic data and real-world data. Results validate the efficacy of our approach and the synthetic data. Notably, our approach achieves a 67.23% classification accuracy on AffectNet when training solely with synthetic data equivalent to the AffectNet training set size, which increases to 69.84% when scaling up to five times the original size.
authors: Xilin He, Cheng Luo, Xiaole Xian, Bing Li, Muhammad Haris Khan, Zongyuan Ge, Weicheng Xie, Siyang Song, Linlin Shen, Bernard Ghanem, Xiangyu Yue ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10184-10195

title: SynTag:增强基于逆向的生成图像水印的几何鲁棒性
title_en: SynTag: Enhancing the Geometric Robustness of Inversion-based Generative Image Watermarking
abstract: 鲁棒性对于生成图像水印至关重要,通常通过注入失真不变的水印特征来实现。主流范式,即基于逆向的框架,在对抗非几何失真方面表现出色,但在几何失真方面存在困难。为了解决这一问题,我们提出SynTag,一种基于同步标签注入的方法,用于增强基于逆向方案的几何鲁棒性。由于几何失真的复杂性,寻找普遍几何不变的特征具有挑战性,且尚不清楚是否存在这样的不变表示。因此,我们并未寻求不变表示,而是将敏感模板特征与水印特征一同嵌入。该模板会随几何失真演变,使我们能够在提取前重构失真轨迹进行校正。聚焦于潜在扩散模型,我们微调VAE解码器以注入不可见的SynTag特征,并与预测网络配对实现提取和校正。此外,我们引入抖动补偿机制以进一步提升校正精度。SynTag高度兼容现有基于逆向的方法。大量实验表明,在保持对非几何失真抗性的同时,显著提升了几何失真鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Robustness is significant for generative image watermarking, typically achieved by injecting distortion-invariant watermark features. The leading paradigm, i.e., inversion-based framework, excels against non-geometric distortions but struggles with geometric ones. To address this, we propose SynTag, a synchronization tag injection-based method that enhances geometric robustness in inversion-based schemes. Due to the complexity of geometric distortions, finding universally geometric-invariant features is challenging, and it is not clear whether such an invariant representation exists. Therefore, instead of seeking invariant representations, we embed a sensitive template feature alongside the watermarking features. This template evolves with geometric distortions, allowing us to reconstruct the distortion trajectory for correction before extraction. Focusing on latent diffusion models, we fine-tune the VAE decoder to inject the invisible SynTag feature, pairing it with a prediction network for extraction and correction. Additionally, we introduce a dither compensation mechanism to further improve correction accuracy. SynTag is highly compatible with existing inversion-based methods. Extensive experiments demonstrate a significant boost in geometric distortion robustness while maintaining resilience against non-geometric distortions.
authors: Han Fang, Kejiang Chen, Zehua Ma, Jiajun Deng, Yicong Li, Weiming Zhang, Ee-Chien Chang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15416-15425

title: SyncDiff:多体人机交互合成的同步运动扩散
title_en: SyncDiff: Synchronized Motion Diffusion for Multi-Body Human-Object Interaction Synthesis
abstract: 合成逼真的人机交互运动是VR/AR和人动画中的关键问题。不同于通常研究的单人或手与单个物体交互的场景,我们解决了一个更通用的多体设置,包含任意数量的人、手和物体。身体间的高相关性及相互影响导致两个主要挑战,对此我们提出了解决方案。首先,为满足不同身体运动的高同步需求,我们在训练过程中数学推导出新的对齐分数,并在动态图模型上使用最大似然采样进行显式同步。其次,物体间的高频交互常被大范围低频运动所掩盖。为此,我们引入频率分解并在频域显式表示高频成分。在包含五种不同多体配置数据集的大量实验中,SyncDiff在现有最先进的运动合成方法上展现出优越性。
abstract_en: Synthesizing realistic human-object interaction motions is a critical problem in VR/AR and human animation. Unlike the commonly studied scenarios involving a single human or hand interacting with one object, we address a more generic multi-body setting with arbitrary numbers of humans, hands, and objects. The high correlations and mutual influences among bodies leads to two major challenges, for which we propose solutions. First, to satisfy the high demands for synchronization of different body motions, we mathematically derive a new set of alignment scores during the training process, and use maximum likelihood sampling on a dynamic graphical model for explicit synchronization during inference. Second, the high-frequency interactions between objects are often overshadowed by the large-scale low-frequency movements. To address this, we introduce frequency decomposition and explicitly represent high-frequency components in the frequency domain. Extensive experiments across five datasets with various multi-body configurations demonstrate the superiority of SyncDiff over existing state-of-the-art motion synthesis methods.
authors: Wenkun He, Yun Liu, Ruitao Liu, Li Yi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11731-11743

title: 多视频同步
title_en: Synchronization of Multiple Videos
abstract: 在同一场景中从多个摄像头同时捕获的视频同步通常较为简单,通常只需简单的时间偏移即可完成。然而,不同场景或近期生成式AI视频的同步则面临更为复杂的挑战,由于存在多样化的主体、背景以及非线性时间错位。我们提出了一种基于原型的框架——时间原型学习(TPL),该框架通过任意预训练模型提取的高维嵌入构建共享且紧凑的1D表示。TPL通过学习统一的原型序列来锚定关键动作阶段,从而实现视频的鲁棒对齐,避免了穷举的成对匹配。实验表明,TPL在包括细粒度帧检索和阶段分类任务在内的多样化数据集上,显著提升了同步的准确性、效率和鲁棒性。尤为重要的是,TPL是首个缓解多生成式AI视频同步问题的方法,这些视频描绘着相同动作。我们的代码和一个新的多视频同步数据集可在https://bgu-cs-vil.github.io/TPL/获取。
abstract_en: Synchronizing videos captured simultaneously from multiple cameras in the same scene is often easy and typically requires only simple time shifts. However, synchronizing videos from different scenes or, more recently, generative AI videos, poses a far more complex challenge due to diverse subjects, backgrounds, and nonlinear temporal misalignment. We propose Temporal Prototype Learning (TPL), a prototype-based framework that constructs a shared, compact 1D representation from high-dimensional embeddings extracted by any of various pretrained models. TPL robustly aligns videos by learning a unified prototype sequence that anchors key action phases, thereby avoiding exhaustive pairwise matching. Our experiments show that TPL improves synchronization accuracy, efficiency, and robustness across diverse datasets, including fine-grained frame retrieval and phase classification tasks. Importantly, TPL is the first approach to mitigate synchronization issues in multiple generative AI videos depicting the same action. Our code and a new multiple video synchronization dataset are available at https://bgu-cs-vil.github.io/TPL/
authors: Avihai Naaman, Ron Shapira Weber, Oren Freifeld ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12514-12523

title: 同步任务行为:测试时训练中多任务的对齐
title_en: Synchronizing Task Behavior: Aligning Multiple Tasks during Test-Time Training
abstract: 将神经网络泛化到未见过的目标域是现实部署中的重大挑战。测试时训练(TTT)通过引入辅助的自监督任务来缓解源域与目标域分布偏移导致的领域差距。然而我们发现,当模型需要在领域偏移下执行多个任务时,传统TTT方法会面临任务行为不同步的问题,即优化某一任务所需的适应步骤可能与其它任务的需求不一致。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新型TTT方法,称为测试时训练任务同步(Synchronizing Tasks for Test-time Training,S4T),该方法能够同时处理多个任务。S4T的核心思想是:预测跨领域偏移的任务关系是实现测试时任务同步的关键。为验证我们的方法,我们将S4T应用于传统多任务基准测试,结合传统TTT协议进行集成。实验结果表明,S4T在各类基准测试中均优于现有最先进的TTT方法。
abstract_en: Generalizing neural networks to unseen target domains is a significant challenge in real-world deployments. Test-time training (TTT) addresses this by using an auxiliary self-supervised task to reduce the domain gap caused by distribution shifts between the source and target. However, we find that when models are required to perform multiple tasks under domain shifts, conventional TTT methods suffer from unsynchronized task behavior, where the adaptation steps needed for optimal performance in one task may not align with the requirements of other tasks. To address this, we propose a novel TTT approach called Synchronizing Tasks for Test-time Training (S4T), which enables the concurrent handling of multiple tasks. The core idea behind S4T is that predicting task relations across domain shifts is key to synchronizing tasks during test time. To validate our approach, we apply S4T to conventional multi-task benchmarks, integrating it with traditional TTT protocols. Our empirical results show that S4T outperforms state-of-the-art TTT methods across various benchmarks.
authors: Wooseong Jeong, Jegyeong Cho, Youngho Yoon, Kuk-Jin Yoon ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24340-24350

title: 面向缺失模态的鲁棒视觉识别协同提示方法
title_en: Synergistic Prompting for Robust Visual Recognition with Missing Modalities
abstract: 大规模多模态模型通过利用大量配对多模态训练数据,在各类视觉识别任务中展现出卓越性能。然而,在实际应用中,缺失或不完整的模态输入常导致性能显著下降。近期研究聚焦于基于提示的策略以解决该问题;然而,现有方法存在两大主要局限:(1) 静态提示缺乏适应不同缺失数据条件的灵活性,(2) 基础提示调整方法在关键模态缺失时难以确保可靠性能。为应对这些挑战,我们提出了一种面向缺失模态的鲁棒视觉识别新型协同提示(SyP)框架。所提出的SyP引入两项关键创新:(I) 动态适配器,通过计算自适应缩放因子动态生成提示,替代静态参数实现灵活多模态适配;(II) 协同提示策略,结合静态与动态提示平衡模态间信息,确保关键模态缺失时仍能进行鲁棒推理。实验表明,SyP在三个广泛使用的视觉识别数据集上显著超越现有方法,验证了其在多样缺失率和条件下的鲁棒性。大量实验与消融研究证实了其处理缺失模态的有效性,突显了其卓越的适应性与可靠性。源代码将公开发布。
abstract_en: Large-scale multi-modal models have demonstrated remarkable performance across various visual recognition tasks by leveraging extensive paired multi-modal training data. However, in real-world applications, the presence of missing or incomplete modality inputs often leads to significant performance degradation. Recent research has focused on prompt-based strategies to tackle this issue; however, existing methods are hindered by two major limitations: (1) static prompts lack the flexibility to adapt to varying missing-data conditions, and (2) basic prompt-tuning methods struggle to ensure reliable performance when critical modalities are missing. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Synergistic Prompting (SyP) framework for robust visual recognition with missing modalities. The proposed SyP introduces two key innovations: (I) a Dynamic Adapter, which computes adaptive scaling factors to dynamically generate prompts, replacing static parameters for flexible multi-modal adaptation, and (II) a Synergistic Prompting Strategy, which combines static and dynamic prompts to balance information across modalities, ensuring robust reasoning even when key modalities are missing. The proposed SyP achieves significant performance improvements over existing approaches across three widely-used visual recognition datasets, demonstrating robustness under diverse missing rates and conditions. Extensive experiments and ablation studies validate its effectiveness in handling missing modalities, highlighting its superior adaptability and reliability. The source code will be released.
authors: Zhihui Zhang, Luanyuan Dai, Qika Lin, Yunfeng Diao, Guangyin Jin, Yufei Guo, Jing Zhang, Xiaoshuai Hao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1881-1890

title: 近边界分布外样本的合成用于分布外检测
title_en: Synthesizing Near-Boundary OOD Samples for Out-of-Distribution Detection
abstract: 预训练的视觉-语言模型在检测分布外(OOD)样本方面展现出显著能力。然而,一些位于图像特征空间中分布内(InD)数据附近的挑战性OOD样本仍可能导致误分类。扩散模型和多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)等基础模型的出现为解决这一问题提供了潜在方案。本文提出SynOOD,一种新颖方法,利用基础模型生成合成的、具有挑战性的OOD数据以微调CLIP模型,从而增强InD与OOD样本的边界级区分能力。我们的方法通过MLLMs的上下文提示引导的迭代图像修复过程生成细致的边界对齐OOD样本。这些样本通过基于能量分数等OOD分数梯度的噪声调整进行优化,有效采样自InD/OOD边界。借助这些精心合成的图像,我们微调CLIP图像编码器和从文本编码器提取的负标签特征,强化近边界OOD样本与一组负标签之间的关联。最终,SynOOD在大规模ImageNet基准测试中达到最先进性能,参数和运行时间仅略有增加。我们的方法显著超越现有方法,AUROC提升2.80%,FPR95降低11.13%。代码可在https://github.com/Jarvisgivemeasuit/SynOOD获取。
abstract_en: Pre-trained vision-language models have exhibited remarkable abilities in detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) samples. However, some challenging OOD samples, which lie close to in-distribution (InD) data in image feature space, can still lead to misclassification. The emergence of foundation models like diffusion models and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offers a potential solution to this issue. In this work, we propose SynOOD, a novel approach that harnesses foundation models to generate synthetic, challenging OOD data for fine-tuning CLIP models, thereby enhancing boundary-level discrimination between InD and OOD samples. Our method uses an iterative in-painting process guided by contextual prompts from MLLMs to produce nuanced, boundary-aligned OOD samples. These samples are refined through noise adjustments based on gradients from OOD scores like the energy score, effectively sampling from the InD/OOD boundary. With these carefully synthesized images, we fine-tune the CLIP image encoder and negative label features derived from the text encoder to strengthen connections between near-boundary OOD samples and a set of negative labels. Finally, SynOOD achieves state-of-the-art performance on the large-scale ImageNet benchmark, with minimal increases in parameters and runtime. Our approach significantly surpasses existing methods, improving AUROC by 2.80% and reducing FPR95 by 11.13%. Codes are available in https://github.com/Jarvisgivemeasuit/SynOOD.
authors: Jinglun Li, Kaixun Jiang, Zhaoyu Chen, Bo Lin, Yao Tang, Weifeng Ge, Wenqiang Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4496-4506

title: 合成视频增强视频生成的物理保真度
title_en: Synthetic Video Enhances Physical Fidelity in Video Synthesis
abstract: 我们研究如何通过利用标准计算机图形技术生成的合成视频来提升视频生成模型的物理保真度。这些渲染视频遵循现实世界的物理规律——例如保持三维一致性——从而成为一种有价值的资源,可能有助于提升视频生成模型。为充分发挥这一潜力,我们提出了一种解决方案,通过整理和整合合成数据,并引入一种将物理真实感转移到模型的方法,以减少不必要的伪影。通过在三个强调物理一致性的代表性任务上的实验,我们证明了其在增强物理保真度方面的有效性。尽管我们的模型仍缺乏对物理的深入理解,但我们的工作提供了首个实证演示,表明合成视频能够增强视频生成中的物理保真度。
abstract_en: We investigate how to enhance the physical fidelity of video generation models by leveraging synthetic videos generated via standard computer graphics techniques. These rendered videos respect real-world physics -- such as maintaining 3D consistency -- thereby serving as a valuable resource that can potentially improve video generation models. To harness this potential, we propose a solution that curates and integrates synthetic data while introducing a method to transfer its physical realism to the model, minimizing unwanted artifacts. Through experiments on three representative tasks emphasizing physical consistency, we demonstrate its effectiveness in enhancing physical fidelity. While our model still lacks a deep understanding of physics, our work offers one of the first empirical demonstrations that synthetic video enhances physical fidelity in video synthesis.
authors: Qi Zhao, Xingyu Ni, Ziyu Wang, Feng Cheng, Ziyan Yang, Lu Jiang, Bohan Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12135-12146

title: T2Bs: 通过视频生成实现文本到角色的融合形态
title_en: T2Bs: Text-to-Character Blendshapes via Video Generation
abstract: 我们提出T2Bs框架,通过结合静态文本到3D生成与视频扩散技术,从文本生成高质量、可动画的角色头部可变形模型。文本到3D模型生成详细的静态几何结构但缺乏运动合成,而视频扩散模型则会产生时间与多视角几何不一致。T2Bs通过可变形3D高斯点云技术对齐静态3D资产与视频输出。通过约束运动与静态几何结构,并采用视角依赖变形MLP,T2Bs(i)在准确性和表达性上超越现有4D生成方法,减少视频伪影和视角不一致;(ii)重建光滑、连贯、完全注册的3D几何结构,可扩展构建具有多样、真实面部运动的可变形模型。这使得合成具有表现力、可动画的角色头部成为可能,超越当前4D生成技术。
abstract_en: We present T2Bs, a framework for generating high-quality, animatable character head morphable models from text by combining static text-to-3D generation with video diffusion. Text-to-3D models produce detailed static geometry but lack motion synthesis, while video diffusion models generate motion with temporal and multi-view geometric inconsistencies. T2Bs bridges this gap by leveraging deformable 3D Gaussian splatting to align static 3D assets with video outputs. By constraining motion with static geometry and employing a view-dependent deformation MLP, T2Bs (i) outperforms existing 4D generation methods in accuracy and expressiveness while reducing video artifacts and view inconsistencies, and (ii) reconstructs smooth, coherent, fully registered 3D geometries designed to scale for building morphable models with diverse, realistic facial motions. This enables synthesizing expressive, animatable character heads that surpass current 4D generation techniques.
authors: Jiahao Luo, Chaoyang Wang, Michael Vasilkovsky, Vladislav Shakhrai, Di Liu, Peiye Zhuang, Sergey Tulyakov, Peter Wonka, Hsin-Ying Lee, James Davis, Jian Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13625-13637

title: T2I-Copilot:一种无需训练的多智能体文本到图像系统,用于增强提示解释与交互生成
title_en: T2I-Copilot: A Training-Free Multi-Agent Text-to-Image System for Enhanced Prompt Interpretation and Interactive Generation
abstract: 文本到图像(T2I)生成模型革新了内容创作,但对提示措辞高度敏感,通常需要用户反复多次调整提示词而缺乏明确反馈。尽管自动提示工程、受控文本嵌入、去噪和多轮生成等技术在一定程度上缓解了这些问题,但它们要么提供有限的可控性,要么需要额外训练,限制了模型的泛化能力。因此,我们引入了T2I-Copilot,这是一种无需训练的多智能体系统,通过(多模态)大语言模型之间的协作,实现提示措辞自动化、模型选择和迭代优化。该方法显著简化了提示工程,同时相比直接生成,提升了生成质量与文本-图像对齐度。具体而言,T2I-Copilot包含三个智能体:(1) 输入解释器,解析输入提示,解决歧义并生成标准化报告;(2) 生成引擎,从不同类型的T2I模型中选择合适模型,并组织视觉与文本提示以启动生成;(3) 质量评估器,评估美学质量与文本-图像对齐度,提供评分和反馈以支持潜在的重生成。T2I-Copilot可完全自主运行,同时也支持人类在环干预以实现精细控制。在GenAI-Bench上,使用开源生成模型,T2I-Copilot取得的VQA得分与商业模型ReCraftV3和Imagen 3相当,仅以16.59%的成本超越FLUX1.1-pro 6.17%,并优于FLUX.1-dev和SD 3.5 Large分别达9.11%和6.36%。代码已开源:https://github.com/SHI-Labs/T2I-Copilot
abstract_en: Text-to-Image (T2I) generative models have revolutionized content creation but remain highly sensitive to prompt phrasing, often requiring users to repeatedly refine prompts multiple times without clear feedback. While techniques such as automatic prompt engineering, controlled text embeddings, denoising, and multi-turn generation mitigate these issues, they offer limited controllability, or often necessitate additional training, restricting the generalization abilities. Thus, we introduce T2I-Copilot, a training-free multi-agent system that leverages collaboration between (Multimodal) Large Language Models to automate prompt phrasing, model selection, and iterative refinement. This approach significantly simplifies prompt engineering while enhancing generation quality and text-image alignment compared to direct generation. Specifically, T2I-Copilot consists of three agents: (1) Input Interpreter, which parses the input prompt, resolves ambiguities, and generates a standardized report; (2) Generation Engine, which selects the appropriate model from different types of T2I models and organizes visual and textual prompts to initiate generation; and (3) Quality Evaluator, which assesses aesthetic quality and text-image alignment, providing scores and feedback for potential regeneration. T2I-Copilot can operate fully autonomously while also supporting human-in-the-loop intervention for fine-grained control. On GenAI-Bench, using open-source generation models, T2I-Copilot achieves a VQA score comparable to commercial models RecraftV3 and Imagen 3, surpasses FLUX1.1-pro by 6.17% at only 16.59% of its cost, and outperforms FLUX.1-dev and SD 3.5 Large by 9.11% and 6.36%. Code is released at: https://github.com/SHI-Labs/T2I-Copilot.
authors: Chieh-Yun Chen, Min Shi, Gong Zhang, Humphrey Shi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19396-19405

title: TAB: Transformer 注意力瓶颈实现视觉-语言模型中的用户干预与调试
title_en: TAB: Transformer Attention Bottlenecks enable User Intervention and Debugging in Vision-Language Models
abstract: 多头自注意力(MHSA)是Transformer架构的核心组件,该架构在语言和视觉领域均广泛应用。多个注意力头直观地支持对同一输入的不同并行处理过程。然而,它们也掩盖了每个输入片段对模型输出的贡献关系。我们提出了一种新颖的单头Transformer注意力瓶颈(TAB)层,插入在传统MHSA架构之后,作为可解释性与干预的注意力瓶颈。与标准自注意力不同,TAB将所有片段的总注意力约束在∈[0, 1]范围内。即当总注意力为0时,视觉信息将不再进一步传播至网络,视觉-语言模型(VLM)将默认输出通用的、与图像无关的响应。为验证TAB的优势,我们训练带有TAB的VLM执行图像差异描述任务。在三个数据集上,我们的模型在描述任务中的表现与基线VLM相似,但瓶颈机制在定位变化和识别无变化发生时表现更优。TAB是首个允许用户通过编辑注意力进行调试的架构,这种调试方式通常能产生VLM预期的输出。
abstract_en: Multi-head self-attention (MHSA) is a key component of Transformers, a widely popular architecture in both language and vision. Multiple heads intuitively enable different parallel processes over the same input. Yet, they also obscure the attribution of each input patch to the output of a model. We propose a novel 1-head Transformer Attention Bottleneck (TAB) layer, inserted after the traditional MHSA architecture, to serve as an attention bottleneck for interpretability and intervention. Unlike standard self-attention, TAB constrains the total attention over all patches to \in [0, 1]. That is, when the total attention is 0, no visual information is propagated further into the network, and the vision-language model (VLM) would default to a generic, image-independent response. To demonstrate the advantages of TAB, we train VLMs with TAB to perform image-difference captioning. Over three datasets, our models perform similarly to baseline VLMs in captioning but the bottleneck is superior in localizing changes and in identifying when no changes occur. TAB is the first architecture to enable users to debug by editing attention, which often produces expected outputs by VLMs.
authors: Pooyan Rahmanzadehgervi, Hung Huy Nguyen, Rosanne Liu, Long Mai, Anh Totti Nguyen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22551-22562

title: TACO:控制扩散模型实现真实场景视频无模态补全
title_en: TACO: Taming Diffusion for in-the-wild Video Amodal Completion
abstract: 人类能够通过有限的视觉线索推断出物体的完整形状和外观,依赖于对物理世界的广泛先验知识。然而,现有模型在确保视频帧间一致性的同时完成部分可观察物体的补全仍面临挑战,尤其是在非结构化的真实场景视频中。本文针对视频无模态补全(Video Amodal Completion, VAC)任务,旨在根据指定目标物体的视觉提示生成视频中一致的完整物体。我们利用预训练视频扩散模型学习到的丰富且一致的流形结构,提出一个条件扩散模型TACO,重新利用这些流形结构进行VAC。为使TACO在具有挑战性的真实场景场景中实现有效且鲁棒的泛化,我们通过系统性地施加遮挡到无遮挡视频上,构建了一个包含多个难度级别的大规模合成数据集。在此基础上,我们设计了一种渐进式微调范式,从更简单的恢复任务逐步过渡到更复杂的任务。我们在来自互联网的广泛真实场景视频以及自动驾驶、机器人操作和场景理解中常用的多样化未见过数据集上展示了TACO的通用性。此外,我们证明TACO可有效应用于物体重建和姿态估计等下游任务,突显其在促进物理世界理解和推理方面的潜力。
abstract_en: Humans can infer complete shapes and appearances of objects from limited visual cues, relying on extensive prior knowledge of the physical world. However, completing partially observable objects while ensuring consistency across video frames remains challenging for existing models, especially for unstructured, in-the-wild videos. This paper tackles the task of Video Amodal Completion (VAC), which aims to generate the complete object consistently throughout the video given a visual prompt specifying the object of interest. Leveraging the rich, consistent manifolds learned by pre-trained video diffusion models, we propose a conditional diffusion model, TACO, that repurposes these manifolds for VAC. To enable its effective and robust generalization to challenging in-the-wild scenarios, we curate a large-scale synthetic dataset with multiple difficulty levels by systematically imposing occlusions onto un-occluded videos. Building on this, we devise a progressive fine-tuning paradigm that starts with simpler recovery tasks and gradually advances to more complex ones. We demonstrate TACO's versatility on a wide range of in-the-wild videos from Internet, as well as on diverse, unseen datasets commonly used in autonomous driving, robotic manipulation, and scene understanding. Moreover, we show that TACO can be effectively applied to various downstream tasks like object reconstruction and pose estimation, highlighting its potential to facilitate physical world understanding and reasoning.
authors: Ruijie Lu, Yixin Chen, Yu Liu, Jiaxiang Tang, Junfeng Ni, Diwen Wan, Gang Zeng, Siyuan Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13638-13650

title: TAD-E2E:一个大规模端到端自动驾驶数据集
title_en: TAD-E2E: A Large-scale End-to-end Autonomous Driving Dataset
abstract: 端到端自动驾驶技术近期已成为自动驾驶领域研究与应用的焦点。最先进的方法(SOTA)通常在NuScenes数据集上进行训练与评估。然而,自2019年推出用于三维感知任务的NuScenes数据集以来,其存在诸如规模不足、场景简单和驾驶行为同质化等局限性,制约了端到端自动驾驶算法的上限发展。针对这些问题,我们提出了一种专门用于端到端自动驾驶任务的新颖大规模真实世界数据集,命名为TAD-E2E,其规模是NuScenes的25倍,场景复杂度为NuScenes的1.7倍,并具有高度多样化的驾驶行为。我们在TAD-E2E数据集上复现了最先进的方法,观察到这些方法的表现不再如预期般良好。此外,针对TAD-E2E数据集中提出的挑战性场景,我们设计了一种多模态稀疏端到端方法,显著超越了最先进的方法。消融研究验证了我们方法的有效性,并分析了各模块的贡献。该数据集将在近期发布。
abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving technology has recently become a focal point of research and application in autonomous driving. State-of-the-art (SOTA) methods are often trained and evaluated on the NuScenes dataset. However, the NuScenes dataset, introduced in 2019 for 3D perception tasks, faces several limitations--such as insufficient scale, simple scenes, and homogeneous driving behaviors--that restrict the upper-bound development of end-to-end autonomous driving algorithms. In light of these issues, we propose a novel, large-scale real-world dataset specifically designed for end-to-end autonomous driving tasks, named TAD-E2E, which is 25x larger, 1.7x scene complexity over NuScenes, and features a highly diverse range of driving behaviors. We replicated SOTA methods on the TAD-E2E dataset and observed that these methods no longer performed well, as expected. Additionally, in response to the challenging scenarios presented in the TAD-E2E dataset, we devised a multimodal sparse end-to-end method that significantly outperforms SOTA methods. Ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, and we analyze the contributions of each module. The dataset will be released in the near future.
authors: Chang Liu, Mingxu Zhu, Zheyuan Zhang, Linna Song, Xiao Zhao, Qingliang Luo, Qi Wang, Chufan Guo, Kuifeng Su ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26600-26609

title: TAG-WM:基于扩散逆过程敏感性的防篡改生成图像水印方法
title_en: TAG-WM: Tamper-Aware Generative Image Watermarking via Diffusion Inversion Sensitivity
abstract: AI生成内容(AIGC)虽能高效实现视觉创作,但带来了版权和真实性风险。作为完整性验证和溯源的常见技术,数字图像水印被视为解决上述问题的潜在方案。然而,生成图像编辑工具的广泛应用和能力提升加剧了恶意篡改风险,同时对被动篡改检测和水印鲁棒性提出了新挑战。为应对这些挑战,本文提出一种名为TAG-WM的防篡改生成图像水印方法。该方法包含四个关键模块:双标记联合采样(DMJS)算法用于在保持生成质量的同时将版权水印和定位水印嵌入潜在空间,利用逆向DMJS实现的水印潜在重建(WLR),基于扩散逆过程敏感性的密集变化区域检测器(DVRD)通过统计偏差分析识别篡改区域,以及由定位结果引导的防篡改解码(TAD)。实验结果表明,TAG-WM在存在失真情况下仍实现了篡改鲁棒性和定位能力的最先进性能,同时保持无损生成质量,并维持256位的水印容量。
abstract_en: AI-generated content (AIGC) enables efficient visual creation but raises copyright and authenticity risks. As a common technique for integrity verification and source tracing, digital image watermarking is regarded as a potential solution to above issues. However, the widespread adoption and advancing capabilities of generative image editing tools have amplified malicious tampering risks, while simultaneously posing new challenges to passive tampering detection and watermark robustness. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a Tamper-Aware Generative image WaterMarking method named TAG-WM. The proposed method comprises four key modules: a dual-mark joint sampling (DMJS) algorithm for embedding copyright and localization watermarks into the latent space while preserving generative quality, the watermark latent reconstruction (WLR) utilizing reversed DMJS, a dense variation region detector (DVRD) leveraging diffusion inversion sensitivity to identify tampered areas via statistical deviation analysis, and the tamper-aware decoding (TAD) guided by localization results. The experimental results demonstrate that TAG-WM achieves state-of-the-art performance in both tampering robustness and localization capability even under distortion, while preserving lossless generation quality and maintaining a watermark capacity of 256 bits.
authors: Yuzhuo Chen, Zehua Ma, Han Fang, Weiming Zhang, Nenghai Yu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16723-16732

title: TAPNext: 将任意点跟踪(TAP)视为下一个标记预测
title_en: TAPNext: Tracking Any Point (TAP) as Next Token Prediction
abstract: 在视频中进行任意点跟踪(TAP)是一项具有诸多已验证应用(如机器人技术、视频编辑和三维重建)的具有挑战性的计算机视觉问题。现有TAP方法严重依赖复杂的跟踪特定归纳偏置和启发式策略,限制了其通用性和扩展潜力。为解决这些挑战,我们提出TAPNext,一种将TAP视为序列掩码标记解码的新方法。我们的模型具有因果性,以纯在线方式跟踪,并消除了跟踪特定的归纳偏置。这使得TAPNext能够以最小延迟运行,并消除了许多现有最先进跟踪器所需的时序窗口。尽管其设计简单,TAPNext在在线和离线跟踪器中均实现了新的最先进跟踪性能。最后,我们提供了证据表明,许多广泛使用的跟踪启发式策略通过端到端训练自然涌现于TAPNext中。
abstract_en: Tracking Any Point (TAP) in a video is a challenging computer vision problem with many demonstrated applications in robotics, video editing, and 3D reconstruction. Existing methods for TAP rely heavily on complex tracking-specific inductive biases and heuristics, limiting their generality and potential for scaling. To address these challenges, we present TAPNext, a new approach that casts TAP as sequential masked token decoding. Our model is causal, tracks in a purely online fashion, and removes tracking-specific inductive biases. This enables TAPNext to run with minimal latency, and removes the temporal windowing required by many existing state of art trackers. Despite its simplicity, TAPNext achieves a new state-of-the-art tracking performance among both online and offline trackers. Finally, we present evidence that many widely used tracking heuristics emerge naturally in TAPNext through end-to-end training.
authors: Artem Zholus, Carl Doersch, Yi Yang, Skanda Koppula, Viorica Patraucean, Xu Owen He, Ignacio Rocco, Mehdi S. M. Sajjadi, Sarath Chandar, Ross Goroshin ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9693-9703

title: TAR3D: 通过下一步预测创建高质量3D资产
title_en: TAR3D: Creating High-Quality 3D Assets via Next-Part Prediction
abstract: 我们提出TAR3D,一种新颖的框架,包含3D感知的向量量化变分自编码器(VQVAE)和生成式预训练变换器(GPT),用于生成高质量的3D资产。本工作的核心洞察是将下一步预测范式的多模态统一和卓越学习能力迁移至条件3D对象生成。为实现这一目标,3D VQ-VAE首先将广泛的3D形状编码到紧凑的三平面潜在空间,并利用可训练代码本中的离散表示在查询点占据监督下重建细粒度几何结构。随后,配备自定义三平面位置嵌入(TriPE)的3D GPT以自回归方式通过预填充提示标记预测代码本索引序列,从而逐部分建模3D几何结构的组合。在ShapeNet和Objaverse上的大量实验表明,TAR3D在文本到3D和图像到3D任务中相比现有方法实现了更优的生成质量。
abstract_en: We present TAR3D, a novel framework that consists of a 3D-aware Vector Quantized-Variational AutoEncoder (VQVAE) and a Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT) to generate high-quality 3D assets. The core insight of this work is to migrate the multimodal unification and promising learning capabilities of the next-token prediction paradigm to conditional 3D object generation. To achieve this, the3D VQ-VAE first encodes a wide range of 3D shapes into a compact triplane latent space and utilizes a set of discrete representations from a trainable codebook to reconstruct fine-grained geometries under the supervision of query point occupancy. Then, the 3D GPT, equipped with a custom triplane position embedding called TriPE, predicts the codebook index sequence with prefilling prompt tokensin an autoregressive manner so that the composition of 3D geometries can be modeled part by part. Extensive experiments on ShapeNet and Objaverse demonstrate that TAR3D can achieve superior generation quality over existing methods in text-to-3D and image-to-3D tasks.
authors: Xuying Zhang, Yutong Liu, Yangguang Li, Renrui Zhang, Yufei Liu, Kai Wang, Wanli Ouyang, Zhiwei Xiong, Peng Gao, Qibin Hou, Ming-Ming Cheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5134-5145

title: TARO:基于时间步自适应表示对齐与起始感知条件的同步视频到音频合成框架
title_en: TARO: Timestep-Adaptive Representation Alignment with Onset-Aware Conditioning for Synchronized Video-to-Audio Synthesis
abstract: 本文提出了一种基于流式Transformer的新型框架——时间步自适应表示对齐与起始感知条件(TARO),用于实现高保真且时间一致的视频到音频合成。该框架通过两个关键创新提升性能:(1) 时间步自适应表示对齐(TRA),通过根据噪声调度动态调整对齐强度,实现潜在表示的平滑演化与保真度提升;(2) 起始感知条件(OAC),通过整合作为音频相关视觉时刻的尖锐事件驱动标记的起始提示,增强与动态视觉事件的同步性。在VGGSound和Landscape数据集上的大量实验表明,TARO相较现有方法表现更优,实现了Frechet距离(FD)降低53%、Frechet音频距离(FAD)降低29%以及97.19%的对齐准确率,凸显其卓越的音频质量与同步精度。
abstract_en: This paper introduces Timestep-Adaptive Representation Alignment with Onset-Aware Conditioning (TARO), a novel framework for high-fidelity and temporally coherent video-to-audio synthesis. Built upon flow-based transformers, which offer stable training and continuous transformations for enhanced synchronization and audio quality, TARO introduces two key innovations: (1) Timestep-Adaptive Representation Alignment (TRA), which dynamically aligns latent representations by adjusting alignment strength based on the noise schedule, ensuring smooth evolution and improved fidelity, and (2) Onset-Aware Conditioning (OAC), which integrates onset cues that serve as sharp event-driven markers of audio-relevant visual moments to enhance synchronization with dynamic visual events. Extensive experiments on the VGGSound and Landscape datasets demonstrate that TARO outperforms prior methods, achieving relatively 53% lower Frechet Distance (FD), 29% lower Frechet Audio Distance (FAD), and a 97.19% Alignment Accuracy, highlighting its superior audio quality and synchronization precision.
authors: Tri Ton, Ji Woo Hong, Chang D. Yoo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14228-14237

title: TARS:交通感知雷达场景流估计
title_en: TARS: Traffic-Aware Radar Scene Flow Estimation
abstract: 场景流为自动驾驶提供了关键的运动信息。近期的激光雷达场景流模型在实例级别采用刚体运动假设,认为物体为刚体。然而,这些实例级方法不适用于稀疏的雷达点云。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新颖的交通感知雷达场景流(TARS)估计方法,其在交通级别利用运动刚性。为应对雷达场景流的挑战,我们联合进行目标检测与场景流估计并提升后者的性能。我们引入由检测损失训练的目标检测器的特征图,使雷达场景流感知环境和道路使用者。由此,我们在特征空间中构建交通向量场(TVF),在场景流分支中实现整体交通级别的场景理解。在估计场景流时,我们同时考虑点级运动线索(来自点邻域)和空间中刚体运动的交通级别一致性。TARS在专有数据集和View-of-Delft数据集上均超越了现有方法,分别将基准提升23%和15%。
abstract_en: Scene flow provides crucial motion information for autonomous driving. Recent LiDAR scene flow models utilize the rigid-motion assumption at the instance level, assuming objects are rigid bodies. However, these instance-level methods are not suitable for sparse radar point clouds. In this work, we present a novel Traffic-Aware Radar Scene-Flow (TARS) estimation method, which utilizes motion rigidity at the traffic level. To address the challenges in radar scene flow, we perform object detection and scene flow jointly and boost the latter. We incorporate the feature map from the object detector, trained with detection losses, to make radar scene flow aware of the environment and road users. From this, we construct a Traffic Vector Field (TVF) in the feature space to achieve holistic traffic-level scene understanding in our scene flow branch. When estimating the scene flow, we consider both point-level motion cues from point neighbors and traffic-level consistency of rigid motion within the space. TARS outperforms the state of the art on a proprietary dataset and the View-of-Delft dataset, improving the benchmarks by 23% and 15%, respectively.
authors: Jialong Wu, Marco Braun, Dominic Spata, Matthias Rottmann ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26075-26084

title: TAViS: 基于文本桥接的音频-视觉分割方法与基础模型
title_en: TAViS: Text-bridged Audio-Visual Segmentation with Foundation Models
abstract: 音频-视觉分割(AVS)面临有效对齐音频与视觉模态的基本挑战。尽管近期方法利用基础模型应对数据稀缺问题,但往往依赖单模态知识或简单组合基础模型,未能解决跨模态对齐挑战。本文提出TAViS框架,结合多模态基础模型(ImageBind)实现跨模态对齐,以及分割基础模型(SAM2)实现精确分割。然而,有效整合这些模型面临两大关键挑战:SAM2与ImageBind因特征空间差异导致的知识迁移困难,以及仅使用分割损失进行监督的不足。为解决这些问题,我们引入文本桥接设计,包含两个核心组件:(1) 文本桥接混合提示机制,其中伪文本提供类别原型信息,同时保留音频与视觉输入的模态特异性细节;(2) 基于文本的对齐监督策略,利用文本作为桥梁对音频-视觉模态中的共享语义概念进行对齐。我们的方法在单源、多源及语义数据集上均取得优越性能,并在零样本设置中表现突出。
abstract_en: Audio-Visual Segmentation (AVS) faces a fundamental challenge of effectively aligning audio and visual modalities. While recent approaches leverage foundation models to address data scarcity, they often rely on single-modality knowledge or combine foundation models in an off-the-shelf manner, failing to address the cross-modal alignment challenge. In this paper, we present TAViS, a novel framework that couples the knowledge of multimodal foundation models (ImageBind) for cross-modal alignment and a segmentation foundation model (SAM2) for precise segmentation. However, effectively combining these models poses two key challenges: the difficulty in transferring the knowledge between SAM2 and ImageBind due to their different feature spaces, and the insufficiency of using only segmentation loss for supervision. To address these challenges, we introduce a text-bridged design with two key components: (1) a text-bridged hybrid prompting mechanism where pseudo text provides class prototype information while retaining modality-specific details from both audio and visual inputs, and (2) an alignment supervision strategy that leverages text as a bridge to align shared semantic concepts within audio-visual modalities. Our approach achieves superior performance on single-source, multi-source, semantic datasets, and excels in zero-shot settings.
authors: Ziyang Luo, Nian Liu, Xuguang Yang, Salman Khan, Rao Muhammad Anwer, Hisham Cholakkal, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Junwei Han ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24014-24023

title: TCFG:一种高效可扩展的文本到图像加速方法——截断式无分类器引导
title_en: TCFG: Truncated Classifier-Free Guidance for Efficient and Scalable Text-to-Image Acceleration
abstract: 扩散模型由于其强大的生成能力,在图像和视频生成领域取得了显著成功。然而,它们存在推理速度慢和高计算成本的问题。现有扩散模型加速方法可能损害模型性能,并难以在多样化的扩散模型架构和下游任务中泛化。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种模型无关且高度可扩展的文本控制图像生成加速策略。具体而言,我们在去噪过程中动态调节文本引导系数,并截断冗余的文本相关计算。实验结果表明,我们的方法在保持精确的文本-图像对齐的同时显著加速模型,展示了其在广泛扩散模型和下游应用中的潜力。
abstract_en: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in image and video generation due to their powerful generative capabilities. However, they suffer from slow inference speed and high computational costs. Existing acceleration methods for diffusion models may compromise model performance and struggle to generalize across diverse diffusion model architectures and downstream tasks. To address these issues, we propose a model-agnostic and highly scalable acceleration strategy for text-controlled image generation. Specifically, we dynamically modulate the text guidance coefficience and truncate redundant text-related computations during the denoising process. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves significant model acceleration while preserving precise text-image alignment, showcasing the potential for a wide range of diffusion models and downstream applications.
authors: Xiaomeng Fu, Jia Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18552-18562

title: TESPEC:面向事件相机的时序增强自监督预训练方法
title_en: TESPEC: Temporally-Enhanced Self-Supervised Pretraining for Event Cameras
abstract: 长期时间信息对基于事件的感知任务至关重要,因为原始事件仅编码像素亮度变化。近期研究表明,当从头训练时,循环模型在这些任务中比前馈模型表现更好。然而,当利用自监督预训练权重时,前馈模型可以超越其循环对应模型。当前基于事件的自监督学习(SSL)方法大多模仿基于RGB图像的方法。它们在短时间内对原始事件进行前馈模型的预训练,忽略了事件的时间信息。在本工作中,我们引入TESPEC,一种专门用于学习时空信息的自监督预训练框架。TESPEC非常适合循环模型,因为它首次在预训练过程中利用长事件序列。TESPEC采用带有新重建目标的掩码图像建模范式。我们设计了一种新颖方法,将事件累积为包含底层场景高阶语义信息的伪灰度视频,该视频对传感器噪声具有鲁棒性并减少运动模糊。重建此目标因此要求模型推理事件的长期历史。大量实验验证了我们在下游任务中的最先进结果,包括目标检测、语义分割和单目深度估计。项目网页:https://mhdmohammadi.github.io/TESPEC_webpage
abstract_en: Long-term temporal information is crucial for event-based perception tasks, as raw events only encode pixel brightness changes. Recent works show that when trained from scratch, recurrent models achieve better results than feedforward models in these tasks. However, when leveraging self-supervised pre-trained weights, feedforward models can outperform their recurrent counterparts. Current self-supervised learning (SSL) methods for event-based pre-training largely mimic RGB image-based approaches. They pre-train feedforward models on raw events within a short time interval, ignoring the temporal information of events. In this work, we introduce TESPEC, a self-supervised pre-training framework tailored for learning spatio-temporal information. TESPEC is well-suited for recurrent models, as it is the first framework to leverage long event sequences during pre-training. TESPEC employs the masked image modeling paradigm with a new reconstruction target. We design a novel method to accumulate events into pseudo grayscale videos containing high-level semantic information about the underlying scene, which is robust to sensor noise and reduces motion blur. Reconstructing this target thus requires the model to reason about long-term history of events. Extensive experiments demonstrate our state-of-the-art results in downstream tasks, including object detection, semantic segmentation, and monocular depth estimation. Project webpage: https://mhdmohammadi.github.io/TESPEC_webpage.
authors: Mohammad Mohammadi, Ziyi Wu, Igor Gilitschenski ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7782-7793

title: TF-TI2I:基于多模态隐式上下文学习的免训练文本-图像到图像生成方法
title_en: TF-TI2I: Training-Free Text-and-Image-to-Image Generation via Multi-Modal Implicit-Context Learning In Text-to-Image Models
abstract: 文本-图像到图像(TI2I)作为文本到图像(T2I)的扩展,通过整合图像输入与文本指令来增强图像生成能力。现有方法往往仅部分利用图像输入,聚焦于特定元素如物体或风格,或在处理复杂多图像指令时生成质量下降。为解决这些问题,我们提出免训练文本-图像到图像生成方法(TF-TI2I),可直接适配SD3等先进T2I模型。我们的方法基于MM-DiT架构,指出文本标记可从视觉标记中隐式学习视觉信息。通过从参考图像中提取压缩的视觉表示,结合参考上下文掩码技术实现选择性信息共享——该技术将上下文标记的使用限制在与指令相关的视觉信息范围内。此外,我们的Winner-Takes-All模块通过为每个视觉标记优先选择最相关参考图像来缓解分布偏移。针对TI2I评估体系的不足,我们还提出FG-TI2I Bench,这是一个专为TI2I设计的综合性基准,兼容现有T2I方法。实验表明,我们的方法在各类基准测试中均表现出色,验证了其在复杂图像生成任务中的有效性。
abstract_en: Text-and-Image-To-Image (TI2I), an extension of Text-To-Image (T2I), integrates image inputs with textual instructions to enhance image generation. Existing methods often partially utilize image inputs, focusing on specific elements like objects or styles, or they experience a decline in generation quality with complex, multi-image instructions. To overcome these challenges, we introduce Training-Free Text-and-Image-to-Image (TF-TI2I), which adapts cutting-edge T2I models such as SD3 without the need for additional training. Our method capitalizes on the MM-DiT architecture, in which we point out that textual tokens can implicitly learn visual information from vision tokens. We enhance this interaction by extracting a condensed visual representation from reference images, facilitating selective information sharing through Reference Contextual Masking--this technique confines the usage of contextual tokens to instruction-relevant visual information. Additionally, our Winner-Takes-All module mitigates distribution shifts by prioritizing the most pertinent references for each vision token. Addressing the gap in TI2I evaluation, we also introduce the FG-TI2I Bench, a comprehensive benchmark tailored for TI2I and compatible with existing T2I methods. Our approach shows robust performance across various benchmarks, confirming its effectiveness in handling complex image-generation tasks.
authors: Teng-Fang Hsiao, Bo-Kai Ruan, Yi-Lun Wu, Tzu-Ling Lin, Hong-Han Shuai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18377-18387

title: TIP-I2V:面向图像到视频生成的百万量级真实文本与图像提示数据集
title_en: TIP-I2V: A Million-Scale Real Text and Image Prompt Dataset for Image-to-Video Generation
abstract: 视频生成模型正在革新内容创作,图像到视频模型因其增强的可控性、视觉一致性和实际应用而受到越来越多的关注。然而,尽管这些模型广受欢迎,它们仍依赖于用户提供的文本和图像提示,目前尚无专门用于研究这些提示的数据集。本文介绍了TIP-I2V,这是首个包含超过170万独特用户提供的文本与图像提示的图像到视频生成专用大规模数据集。此外,我们还提供了由五个最先进的图像到视频模型生成的相应视频。我们首先概述了创建这一大规模数据集的耗时且成本高昂的过程。接下来,我们将TIP-I2V与两个流行的提示数据集VidProM(文本到视频)和DiffusionDB(文本到图像)进行比较,突出其在基础信息和语义信息上的差异。该数据集推动了图像到视频研究的发展。例如,研究人员可以利用TIP-I2V中的提示分析用户偏好,评估训练模型的多维性能;也可通过解决图像到视频模型引发的虚假信息问题来增强模型安全性。TIP-I2V激发的新研究以及与现有数据集的差异强调了专用图像到视频提示数据集的重要性。项目地址为:https://tip-i2v.github.io/
abstract_en: Video generation models are revolutionizing content creation, with image-to-video models drawing increasing attention due to their enhanced controllability, visual consistency, and practical applications. However, despite their popularity, these models rely on user-provided text and image prompts, and there is currently no dedicated dataset for studying these prompts. In this paper, we introduce TIP-I2V, the first large-scale dataset of over 1.70 million unique user-provided Text and Image Prompts specifically for Image-to-Video generation. Additionally, we provide the corresponding generated videos from five state-of-the-art image-to-video models. We begin by outlining the time-consuming and costly process of curating this large-scale dataset. Next, we compare TIP-I2V to two popular prompt datasets, VidProM (text-to-video) and DiffusionDB (text-to-image), highlighting differences in both basic and semantic information. This dataset enables advancements in image-to-video research. For instance, to develop better models, researchers can use the prompts in TIP-I2V to analyze user preferences and evaluate the multi-dimensional performance of trained models; and to enhance model safety, they may focus on addressing the misinformation issue caused by image-to-video models. The new research inspired by TIP-I2V and the differences with existing datasets emphasize the importance of a specialized image-to-video prompt dataset. The project is available at https://tip-i2v.github.io/.
authors: Wenhao Wang, Yi Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14898-14908

title: TITAN-Guide:控制推理时间对齐的引导式文本到视频扩散模型
title_en: TITAN-Guide: Taming Inference-Time Alignment for Guided Text-to-Video Diffusion Models
abstract: 在条件扩散模型的最新发展中,仍需要大量的监督微调才能在一类任务上进行控制。通过使用现成模型进行引导的无需训练的条件控制是一种避免对基础模型进行进一步微调的有利替代方案。然而,现有的无需训练的引导框架要么存在高内存需求,要么由于粗略估计而提供次优控制。这些缺点限制了其在需要高计算资源的扩散模型(如文本到视频(T2V)扩散模型)中的适用性。在本工作中,我们提出了用于引导式文本到视频扩散模型的推理时间对齐控制方法,即TITAN-Guide,该方法克服了内存空间问题,并在引导过程中相比现有方法提供了更优的控制。特别是,我们开发了一种无需从判别式引导模型进行反向传播即可优化扩散潜变量的高效方法。特别是,我们研究了在方向指令的各种选项下用于引导扩散任务的前向梯度下降方法。在我们的实验中,我们展示了我们的方法在潜变量优化过程中高效管理内存的有效性,而之前的方法则表现不足。我们的方法不仅最小化了内存需求,还显著提升了在多种扩散引导基准上的文本到视频性能。代码、模型和演示可在https://titanguide.github.io获取。
abstract_en: In the recent development of conditional diffusion models still require heavy supervised fine-tuning for performing control on a category of tasks. Training-free conditioning via guidance with off-the-shelf models is a favorable alternative to avoid further fine-tuning on the base model. However, the existing training-free guidance frameworks either have heavy memory requirements or offer sub-optimal control due to rough estimation. These shortcomings limit the applicability to control diffusion models that require intense computation, such as Text-to-Video (T2V) diffusion models. In this work, we propose Taming Inference Time Alignment for Guided Text-to-Video Diffusion Model, so-called TITAN-Guide, which overcomes memory space issues, and provides more optimal control in the guidance process compared to the counterparts. In particular, we develop an efficient method for optimizing diffusion latents without backpropagation from a discriminative guiding model. In particular, we study forward gradient descents for guided diffusion tasks with various options on directional directives. In our experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in efficiently managing memory during latent optimization, while previous methods fall short. Our proposed approach not only minimizes memory requirements but also significantly enhances T2V performance across a range of diffusion guidance benchmarks. Code, models, and demo are available at https://titanguide.github.io.
authors: Christian Simon, Masato Ishii, Akio Hayakawa, Zhi Zhong, Shusuke Takahashi, Takashi Shibuya, Yuki Mitsufuji ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16662-16671

title: TITAN: 基于查询标记的领域自适应对抗学习
title_en: TITAN: Query-Token based Domain Adaptive Adversarial Learning
abstract: 我们聚焦于源域无数据的领域自适应目标检测(SFDAOD)问题,当适应过程中无法获取源数据时,模型必须适应无标签的目标域。现有方法大多采用基于师生框架(ST框架)的自监督策略,通过源预训练模型生成伪标签进行进一步微调。我们观察到,由于伪标签中高噪声(主要由领域偏差、差异及显著的领域迁移引起)导致教师模型崩溃,学生模型的性能往往急剧下降。为获得可靠的伪标签,我们提出基于目标的迭代查询标记对抗网络(TITAN),将目标图像划分为与源域相似(易)和不相似(难)的两个子集。我们提出通过估计方差来划分目标域的策略,该方法利用高检测方差对应高召回率和源域相似性的洞察。同时,我们将基于查询标记的对抗模块整合到师生框架中,以减少两个特征表示间的领域差距。在四个自然图像数据集和两个具有挑战性的医学数据集上的实验验证了TITAN优于现有最先进(SOTA)方法的性能。我们在C2F、C2B、S2C和K2C基准上分别实现了比当前SOTA方法高22.7%、22.2%、21.1%和3.7%的mAP提升。代码已开源于https://github.com/Tajamul21/TITAN
abstract_en: We focus on the source-free domain adaptive object detection (SFDAOD) problem when source data is unavailable during adaptation and the model must adapt to the unlabeled target domain. The majority of approaches for the problem employ a self-supervised approach using a student-teacher (ST) framework where pseudo-labels are generated via a source-pretrained model for further fine-tuning. We observe that the performance of a student model often degrades drastically, due to the collapse of the teacher model, primarily caused by high noise in pseudo-labels, resulting from domain bias, discrepancies, and a significant domain shift across domains. To obtain reliable pseudo-labels, we propose a Target-based Iterative Query-Token Adversarial Network (TITAN) which separates the target images into two subsets that are similar to the source (easy) and those that are dissimilar (hard). We propose a strategy to estimate variance to partition the target domain. This approach leverages the insight that higher detection variances correspond to higher recall and greater similarity to the source domain. Also, we incorporate query-token based adversarial modules into a student-teacher baseline framework to reduce the domain gaps between two feature representations. Experiments conducted on four natural imaging datasets and two challenging medical datasets have substantiated the superior performance of TITAN compared to existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) methodologies. We report a map improvement of +22.7, +22.2, +21.1, and +3.7 percent over the current SOTA on C2F, C2B, S2C, and K2C benchmarks, respectively. Code is available at https://github.com/Tajamul21/TITAN
authors: Tajamul Ashraf, Janibul Bashir ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 250-262

title: TLB-VFI:时序感知的潜在布朗桥扩散视频帧插值方法
title_en: TLB-VFI: Temporal-Aware Latent Brownian Bridge Diffusion for Video Frame Interpolation
abstract: 视频帧插值(VFI)旨在基于两个连续相邻帧I_0和I_1预测中间帧I_n(我们使用n表示视频中的时间以避免与扩散模型中的时间步t产生符号冗余)。近期方法在该任务中应用扩散模型(包括基于图像和基于视频的模型)并取得了优异性能。然而,基于图像的扩散模型无法提取时序信息且相比非扩散方法效率较低。基于视频的扩散模型虽能提取时序信息,但其训练规模、模型尺寸和推理时间均过大。为缓解上述问题,我们提出时序感知的潜在布朗桥扩散视频帧插值方法(TLB-VFI),这是一种高效的基于视频的扩散模型。通过我们提出的3D小波门控机制和时序感知自编码器从视频输入中提取丰富时序信息,我们的方法在最具挑战性的数据集上相比近期基于图像的扩散模型SOTA表现提升了20%的FID指标。同时,由于存在丰富的时序信息,我们的方法在参数量减少3倍的情况下仍表现出色。这种参数量减少带来了2.3倍的推理速度提升。通过引入光流引导机制,我们的方法仅需9000倍更少的训练数据,并且参数量比基于视频的扩散模型减少超过20倍。
abstract_en: Video Frame Interpolation (VFI) aims to predict the intermediate frame I_n (we use n to denote time in videos to avoid notation overload with the timestep t in diffusion models) based on two consecutive neighboring frames I_0 and I_1. Recent approaches apply diffusion models (both image-based and video-based) in this task and achieve strong performance. However, image-based diffusion models are unable to extract temporal information and are relatively inefficient compared to non-diffusion methods. Video-based diffusion models can extract temporal information, but they are too large in terms of training scale, model size, and inference time. To mitigate the above issues, we propose Temporal-Aware Latent Brownian Bridge Diffusion for Video Frame Interpolation (TLB-VFI), an efficient video-based diffusion model. By extracting rich temporal information from video inputs through our proposed 3D-wavelet gating and temporal-aware autoencoder, our method achieves 20% improvement in FID on the most challenging datasets over recent SOTA of image-based diffusion models. Meanwhile, due to the existence of rich temporal information, our method achieves strong performance while having 3xfewer parameters. Such a parameter reduction results in 2.3xspeed up. By incorporating optical flow guidance, our method requires 9000xless training data and achieves over 20xfewer parameters than video-based diffusion models.
authors: Zonglin Lyu, Chen Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16260-16269

title: TOGA:基于弱监督的时间锚定开放性视频问答
title_en: TOGA: Temporally Grounded Open-Ended Video QA with Weak Supervision
abstract: 我们研究了在弱监督设置下具有时间锚定的视频问答(视频QA)问题,无需任何时间标注。给定一个视频和一个问题,我们生成一个以起始和结束时间锚定的开放性答案。为此任务,我们提出TOGA:一个用于弱监督时间锚定开放性视频问答的视觉-语言模型。我们通过联合生成答案和时间锚定对TOGA进行指令微调。我们在弱监督设置下操作,其中时间锚定标注不可用。我们为时间锚定生成伪标签,并通过在接地响应的问题与同一时间段的问答响应之间施加一致性约束来确保这些标签的有效性。我们注意到,联合生成答案与锚定可提高问答性能以及锚定效果。我们在基于锚定的QA和开放性QA任务上评估TOGA。对于基于锚定的QA,我们考虑NExT-GQA基准,该基准旨在评估弱监督基于锚定的开放性问答。对于开放性QA,我们考虑MSVD-QA和ActivityNet-QA基准。我们在这些基准上实现了两项任务的最先进性能。
abstract_en: We address the problem of video question answering (video QA) with temporal grounding in a weakly supervised setup, without any temporal annotations. Given a video and a question, we generate an open-ended answer grounded with the start and end time. For this task, we propose TOGA: a vision-language model for Temporally Grounded Open-Ended Video QA with Weak Supervision. We instruct-tune TOGA to jointly generate the answer and the temporal grounding. We operate in a weakly supervised setup where the temporal grounding annotations are not available.We generate pseudo labels for temporal grounding and ensure the validity of these labels by imposing a consistency constraint between the question of a grounding response and the response generated by a question referring to the same temporal segment. We notice that jointly generating the answers with the grounding improves performance on question answering as well as grounding.We evaluate TOGA on grounded QA and open-ended QA tasks. For grounded QA, we consider the NExT-GQA benchmark which is designed to evaluate weakly supervised grounded open-ended question answering.For open-ended QA, we consider the MSVD-QA and ActivityNet-QA benchmarks. We achieve state-of-the-art performance for both tasks on these benchmarks.
authors: Ayush Gupta, Anirban Roy, Rama Chellappa, Nathaniel D. Bastian, Alvaro Velasquez, Susmit Jha ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23593-23603

title: TOTP: 基于时序自适应Mamba潜在扩散的可迁移在线行人轨迹预测
title_en: TOTP: Transferable Online Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction with Temporal-Adaptive Mamba Latent Diffusion
abstract: 行人轨迹预测对于许多智能任务至关重要。尽管现有方法从固定帧历史观测中预测未来轨迹,但受限于观测视角和对大量历史信息的需求,导致实时系统中出现预测延迟和泛化能力不足的问题。本文提出了一种新型任务——可迁移在线行人轨迹预测(TOTP),该任务可同步预测具有可变观测的未来轨迹,并在不同观测约束下实现有效任务迁移。为推进TOTP建模,我们提出时序自适应Mamba潜在扩散(TAMLD)模型。该模型利用社会隐式Mamba合成器提取包含社会交互的运动状态,并通过时序感知蒸馏优化时序表示。趋势条件Mamba分解器生成未来运动趋势的运动潜在分布,并通过采样分解预测未来运动轨迹。我们采用运动潜在Mamba扩散重构受不平衡时序噪声干扰的潜在空间。我们的方法在多个数据集和任务上取得了最先进结果,展示了其时序适应性和泛化能力。
abstract_en: Pedestrian trajectory prediction is crucial for many intelligent tasks. While existing methods predict future trajectories from fixed-frame historical observations, they are limited by the observational perspective and the need for extensive historical information, resulting in prediction delays and inflexible generalization in real-time systems. In this paper, we propose a novel task called Transferable Online Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction (TOTP), which synchronously predicts future trajectories with variable observations and enables effective task transfer under different observation constraints. To advance TOTP modeling, we propose a Temporal-Adaptive Mamba Latent Diffusion (TAMLD) model. It utilizes the Social-Implicit Mamba Synthesizer to extract motion states with social interaction and refine temporal representations through Temporal-Aware Distillation.
