A Trend-Conditional Mamba Decomposer generates the motion latent distribution of the future motion trends and predicts future motion trajectories through sampling decomposition. We utilize Motion-Latent Mamba Diffusion to reconstruct the latent space disturbed by imbalanced temporal noise. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple datasets and tasks, showcasing temporal adaptability and generalization ability.
authors: Ziyang Ren, Ping Wei, Shangqi Deng, Haowen Tang, Jiapeng Li, Huan Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26263-26272

title: TPG-INR:基于目标先验引导的隐式三维CT重建方法用于增强稀疏视图成像
title_en: TPG-INR: Target Prior-Guided Implicit 3D CT Reconstruction for Enhanced Sparse-view Imaging
abstract: 基于穿透原理的X射线成像技术能够实现对内部结构的详细可视化。现有隐式三维重建方法在CT重建中借鉴了NeRF模型及其变体,但往往忽视了物体解剖先验对隐式学习的重要性,导致重建精度和学习效率受限,特别是在超稀疏视图场景下。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新型三维CT重建框架,通过从物体投影数据中提取的"目标先验"来增强隐式学习。该方法融合位置编码与结构编码,实现体素级隐式重建,利用目标先验指导体素采样并丰富结构编码。这种双策略显著提升了学习效率和重建质量。此外,我们引入了基于CUDA的算法,可快速从稀疏视图投影中估计高质量三维目标先验。实验利用复杂腹部数据集的投影数据表明,所提模型显著提升了学习效率,在超稀疏视图下比当前领先模型NAF提升十倍;在重建质量方面,其PSNR分别比最精确模型NeRP提升3.57 dB、5.42 dB和5.70 dB(对应10、20、30次投影)。代码可应要求获取。
abstract_en: X-ray imaging, based on penetration, enables detailed visualization of internal structures. Building on this capability, existing implicit 3D reconstruction methods have adapted the NeRF model and its variants for internal CT reconstruction. However, these approaches often neglect the significance of objects' anatomical priors for implicit learning, limiting both reconstruction precision and learning efficiency, particularly in ultra-sparse view scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose a novel 3D CT reconstruction framework that employs a 'target prior' derived from the object's projection data to enhance implicit learning. Our approach integrates positional and structural encoding to facilitate voxel-wise implicit reconstruction, utilizing the target prior to guide voxel sampling and enrich structural encoding. This dual strategy significantly boosts both learning efficiency and reconstruction quality. Additionally, we introduce a CUDA-based algorithm for rapid estimation of high-quality 3D target priors from sparse-view projections. Experiments utilizing projection data from a complex abdominal dataset demonstrate that the proposed model substantially enhances learning efficiency, outperforming the current leading model, NAF, by a factor of ten. In terms of reconstruction quality, it also exceeds the most accurate model, NeRP, achieving PSNR improvements of 3.57 dB, 5.42 dB, and 5.70 dB with 10, 20, and 30 projections, respectively. The code is available upon request.
authors: Qinglei Cao, Ziyao Tang, Xiaoqin Tang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28239-28248

title: TR-PTS:面向任务的参数与标记选择用于高效调优
title_en: TR-PTS: Task-Relevant Parameter and Token Selection for Efficient Tuning
abstract: 大型预训练模型在视觉任务中表现出色,但由于计算和存储成本高昂,难以进行微调。参数高效微调(PEFT)方法通过仅更新部分参数缓解这一问题;然而,现有大多数方法均为任务无关型,未能充分挖掘任务特定适配性,导致效率和性能欠佳。为解决这一局限,我们提出任务相关参数与标记选择(TR-PTS),一种任务驱动框架,可同时提升计算效率与准确性。具体而言,我们引入任务相关参数选择,利用费舍尔信息矩阵(FIM)逐层识别并微调最具信息量的参数,其余参数保持冻结。同时,任务相关标记选择动态保留最具信息量的标记并合并冗余标记,降低计算开销。通过联合优化参数与标记,TR-PTS使模型聚焦于任务判别性信息。我们在基准测试(包括FGVC和VTAB-1k)中评估TR-PTS,分别超越全量微调3.40%和10.35%,达到最先进的性能。代码已开源至https://github.com/synbol/TR-PTS。
abstract_en: Large pre-trained models achieve remarkable performance in vision tasks but are impractical for fine-tuning due to high computational and storage costs. Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods mitigate this issue by updating only a subset of parameters; however, most existing approaches are task-agnostic, failing to fully exploit task-specific adaptations, which leads to suboptimal efficiency and performance. To address this limitation, we propose Task-Relevant Parameter and Token Selection (TR-PTS), a task-driven framework that enhances both computational efficiency and accuracy. Specifically, we introduce Task-Relevant Parameter Selection, which utilizes the Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) to identify and fine-tune only the most informative parameters in a layer-wise manner, while keeping the remaining parameters frozen. Simultaneously, Task-Relevant Token Selection dynamically preserves the most informative tokens and merges redundant ones, reducing computational overhead. By jointly optimizing parameters and tokens, TR-PTS enables the model to concentrate on task-discriminative information. We evaluate TR-PTS on benchmark, including FGVC and VTAB-1k, where it achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing full fine-tuning by 3.40% and 10.35%, respectively. The code are available at https://github.com/synbol/TR-PTS.
authors: Siqi Luo, Haoran Yang, Yi Xin, Mingyang Yi, Guangyang Wu, Guangtao Zhai, Xiaohong Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4360-4369

title: TRACE: 从多视角视频中学习三维高斯物理动力学
title_en: TRACE: Learning 3D Gaussian Physical Dynamics from Multi-view Videos
abstract: 本文旨在通过动态多视角视频,在无任何人工标签的情况下建模三维场景几何、外观和物理信息。现有方法通过将物理信息损失作为软约束或集成简单物理模型到神经网络中,往往难以学习复杂运动物理,或需要额外标签如物体类型或掩码。本文提出一种名为**TRACE**的新框架,用于建模复杂动态三维场景的运动物理。我们的方法关键创新在于:将每个三维点建模为空间中具有尺寸和方向的刚体粒子,直接学习每个粒子的平移旋转动力学系统,显式估计一组完整的物理参数以控制粒子随时间的运动。在三个现有动态数据集和一个新创建的具有挑战性的合成数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的方法在未来帧外推任务中显著优于基线方法。我们的框架具有良好的性质,即通过聚类学习到的物理参数即可轻松分割多个物体或部件。我们的数据集和代码将在https://github.com/发布。
abstract_en: In this paper, we aim to model 3D scene geometry, appearance, and physical information just from dynamic multi-view videos in the absence of any human labels. By leveraging physics-informed losses as soft constraints or integrating simple physics models into neural networks, existing works often fail to learn complex motion physics, or doing so requires additional labels such as object types or masks. In this paper, we propose a new framework named **TRACE** to model the motion physics of complex dynamic 3D scenes. The key novelty of our approach is that, by formulating each 3D point as a rigid particle with size and orientation in space, we choose to directly learn a translation rotation dynamics system for each particle, explicitly estimating a complete set of physical parameters to govern the particle's motion over time. Extensive experiments on three existing dynamic datasets and one newly created challenging synthetic datasets demonstrate the extraordinary performance of our method over baselines in the task of future frame extrapolation. A nice property of our framework is that multiple objects or parts can be easily segmented just by clustering the learned physical parameters. Our datasets and code will be released at https://github.com/.
authors: Jinxi Li, Ziyang Song, Bo Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8820-8829

title: TRCE:面向文本到图像扩散模型中可靠恶意概念擦除的研究
title_en: TRCE: Towards Reliable Malicious Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
abstract: 近年来,文本到图像扩散模型在逼真图像生成方面取得了显著进展,但同时也可能生成恶意内容,如不适宜内容图像。为降低风险,研究者探索了概念擦除方法以帮助模型遗忘特定概念。然而,现有研究在消除隐含于提示中的恶意概念(如隐喻表达或对抗性提示)时仍面临挑战,同时难以保持模型的正常生成能力。为解决这一问题,本研究提出TRCE,采用两阶段概念擦除策略,在可靠擦除与知识保留之间实现有效平衡。首先,TRCE通过识别关键映射目标(即[EoT]嵌入),优化交叉注意力层,将恶意提示映射为语境相似但包含安全概念的提示,从而防止模型在去噪过程中过度受恶意语义影响。随后,考虑到扩散模型采样轨迹的确定性特性,TRCE通过对比学习引导早期去噪预测向安全方向发展,远离不安全方向,进一步避免生成恶意内容。最后,我们在多个恶意概念擦除基准数据集上对TRCE进行全面评估,结果表明其在消除恶意概念的同时,更有效地保留了模型的原始生成能力。
abstract_en: Recent advances in text-to-image diffusion models enable photorealistic image generation, but they also risk producing malicious content, such as NSFW images. To mitigate risk, concept erasure methods are studied to facilitate the model to unlearn specific concepts. However, current studies struggle to fully erase malicious concepts implicitly embedded in prompts (e.g., metaphorical expressions or adversarial prompts) while preserving the model's normal generation capability. To address this challenge, our study proposes TRCE, using a two-stage concept erasure strategy to achieve an effective trade-off between reliable erasure and knowledge preservation. Firstly, TRCE starts by erasing the malicious semantics implicitly embedded in textual prompts. By identifying a critical mapping objective(i.e., the [EoT] embedding), we optimize the cross-attention layers to map malicious prompts to contextually similar prompts but with safe concepts. This step prevents the model from being overly influenced by malicious semantics during the denoising process. Following this, considering the deterministic properties of the sampling trajectory of the diffusion model, TRCE further steers the early denoising prediction toward the safe direction and away from the unsafe one through contrastive learning, thus further avoiding the generation of malicious content. Finally, we conduct comprehensive evaluations of TRCE on multiple malicious concept erasure benchmarks, and the results demonstrate its effectiveness in erasing malicious concepts while better preserving the model's original generation ability.
authors: Ruidong Chen, Honglin Guo, Lanjun Wang, Chenyu Zhang, Weizhi Nie, An-An Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18927-18936

title: TREAD:用于高效架构无关扩散训练的令牌路由
title_en: TREAD: Token Routing for Efficient Architecture-agnostic Diffusion Training
abstract: 扩散模型已成为视觉生成的主流方法。然而,这些模型通常存在样本效率低下和高训练成本的问题。因此,社区迅速采用了用于高效微调、推理和个性化的方法。然而,最初训练这些模型仍然非常昂贵。尽管近年来提出了包括掩码、蒸馏和架构修改在内的多种方法来提升训练效率,但每种方法都有其自身的权衡:一些方法以增加计算成本为代价提升了性能。相比之下,本文旨在通过充当从早期层随机选择的令牌向模型更深层传输的机制,同时提升训练效率和生成性能。我们的方法不仅适用于常见的基于Transformer的模型,还可应用于状态空间模型,并且无需架构修改或额外参数即可实现这一目标。最后,我们证明TREAD在标准基准ImageNet-256的类别条件合成任务中,同时降低了计算成本并提升了模型性能。在400K训练迭代中,与DiT相比,训练速度提升了14倍;在7M训练迭代中,与DiT的最佳基准性能相比,训练速度提升了37倍。此外,在引导式设置下我们实现了2.09的FID,在非引导式设置下实现了3.93的FID,这一表现优于DiT,且无需架构修改。我们将发布我们的代码。
abstract_en: Diffusion models have emerged as the mainstream approach for visual generation. However, these models typically suffer from sample inefficiency and high training costs. Consequently, methods for efficient finetuning, inference and personalization were quickly adopted by the community. However, training these models in the first place still remains very costly. While several recent approaches--including masking, distillation, and architectural modifications--have been proposed to improve training efficiency, each of these methods comes with its own tradeoffs: some achieve enhanced performance at the expense of increased computational cost. In contrast, this work aims to improve training efficiency as well as generative performance at the same time through routes that act as transport mechanism for randomly selected tokens from early layers to deeper layers of the model. Our method is not limited to the common transformer-based model - it can also be applied to state-space models and achieves this without architectural modifications or additional parameters. Finally, we show that TREAD reduces the computational cost and simultaneously boosts model performance on the standard benchmark ImageNet-256 in class-conditional synthesis. Both of these benefits multiply to a convergence speedup of 14x at 400K training iterations compared to DiT and 37x compared to the best benchmark performance of DiT at 7M training iterations. Further, we achieve a competitive FID of 2.09 in a guided and 3.93 in an unguided setting which improves upon the DiT, without architectural changes. We will release our code.
authors: Felix Krause, Timy Phan, Ming Gui, Stefan Andreas Baumann, Vincent Tao Hu, Björn Ommer ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15703-15713

title: TRKT: 基于时序增强的关系感知知识迁移的弱监督动态场景图生成
title_en: TRKT: Weakly Supervised Dynamic Scene Graph Generation with Temporal-enhanced Relation-aware Knowledge Transferring
abstract: 动态场景图生成(DSGG)旨在通过检测物体并预测其关系为每个视频帧生成场景图。弱监督动态场景图生成(WS-DSGG)通过使用视频中单帧的非定位场景图进行训练,从而减少标注工作量。现有WS-DSGG方法依赖于现成的外部物体检测器生成伪标签用于后续DSGG训练。然而,基于静态、以物体为中心图像训练的检测器在动态、关系感知的DSGG场景中表现不佳,导致定位不准确和低置信度的候选框。为解决外部检测器在WS-DSGG中的挑战,我们提出了一种时序增强的关系感知知识迁移(TRKT)方法,该方法利用知识增强关系感知动态场景中的检测能力。TRKT由两个关键组件构成:(1) 关系感知知识挖掘:我们首先采用物体和关系类别解码器生成类别特定的注意力图以突出物体区域和交互区域。随后提出帧间注意力增强策略,利用光流信息增强注意力图,使其具备运动感知能力并鲁棒于运动模糊。该步骤实现了关系和运动感知的知识挖掘用于WS-DSGG。(2) 我们引入双流融合模块,将类别特定注意力图整合到外部检测结果中,以优化物体定位并提升物体候选框的置信度得分。大量实验表明,TRKT在Action Genome数据集上达到了最先进的性能。我们的代码可在https://github.com/XZPKU/TRKT.git获取。
abstract_en: Dynamic Scene Graph Generation (DSGG) aims to create a scene graph for each video frame by detecting objects and predicting their relationships. Weakly Supervised DSGG (WS-DSGG) reduces annotation workload by using an un- localized scene graph from a single frame per video for training. Existing WS-DSGG methods depend on an off-the- shelf external object detector to generate pseudo labels for subsequent DSGG training. However, detectors trained on static, object-centric images struggle in dynamic, relation- aware scenarios required for DSGG, leading to inaccurate localization and low-confidence proposals. To address the challenges posed by external object detectors in WS-DSGG, we propose a Temporal-enhanced Relation-aware Knowl- edge Transferring (TRKT) method, which leverages knowl- edge to enhance detection in relation-aware dynamic sce- narios. TRKT is built on two key components: (1) Relation-aware knowledge mining: we first employ object and re- lation class decoders that generate category-specific atten- tion maps to highlight both object regions and interactive areas. Then we propose an Inter-frame Attention Augmen- tation strategy that exploits optical flow for neighboring frames to enhance the attention maps, making them motion- aware and robust to motion blur. This step yields relation- and motion-aware knowledge mining for WS-DSGG. (2) we introduce a Dual-stream Fusion Module that integrates category-specific attention maps into external detections to refine object localization and boost confidence scores for object proposals. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TRKT achieves state-of-the-art performance on Ac- tion Genome dataset. Our code is avaliable at https: //github.com/XZPKU/TRKT.git.
authors: Zhu Xu, Ting Lei, Zhimin Li, Guan Wang, Qingchao Chen, Yuxin Peng, Yang Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15812-15821

title: TRNAS:一种无需训练的鲁棒神经架构搜索方法
title_en: TRNAS: A Training-Free Robust Neural Architecture Search
abstract: 深度神经网络(DNNs)已成功应用于各种计算机任务。然而,它们仍易受对抗攻击的影响,可能导致严重的安全风险。近年来,鲁棒神经架构搜索(NAS)逐渐成为设计对抗鲁棒架构的新兴方向。然而,现有鲁棒NAS方法依赖于反复训练大量DNN来评估鲁棒性,这使得搜索过程成本极高。在本文中,我们提出了一种无需训练的鲁棒NAS方法(TRNAS),显著降低了搜索成本。首先,我们设计了一个零成本代理模型(R-Score),通过探索DNN的线性激活能力和特征一致性理论,形式化对抗鲁棒性评估。该代理模型仅需初始化权重即可进行评估,从而避免昂贵的对抗训练成本。其次,我们引入多目标选择(MOS)策略,以保留具有鲁棒性和紧凑性的候选架构。实验结果表明,TRNAS仅需0.02个GPU天即可在包含约10^20个网络的广阔搜索空间中找到一种有前景的鲁棒架构。TRNAS在白盒和黑盒攻击下均超越了其他最先进的鲁棒NAS方法。最后,我们总结了若干对设计鲁棒架构和推动鲁棒NAS领域发展的有意义结论。
abstract_en: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have been successfully applied in various computer tasks. However, they remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks, which could lead to severe security risks. In recent years, robust neural architecture search (NAS) has gradually become an emerging direction for designing adversarially robust architectures. However, existing robust NAS methods rely on repeatedly training numerous DNNs to evaluate robustness, which makes the search process extremely expensive. In this paper, we propose a training-free robust NAS method (TRNAS) that significantly reduces search costs. First, we design a zero-cost proxy model (R-Score) that formalizes adversarial robustness evaluation by exploring the theory of DNN's linear activation capability and feature consistency. This proxy only requires initialized weights for evaluation, thereby avoiding expensive adversarial training costs. Secondly, we introduce a multi-objective selection (MOS) strategy to save candidate architectures with robustness and compactness. Experimental results show that TRNAS only requires 0.02 GPU days to find a promising robust architecture in a vast search space including approximately 10^ 20  networks. TRNAS surpasses other state-of-the-art robust NAS methods under both white-box and black-box attacks. Finally, we summarize a few meaningful conclusions for designing the robust architecture and promoting the development of robust NAS field.
authors: Yeming Yang, Qingling Zhu, Jianping Luo, Ka-Chun Wong, Qiuzhen Lin, Jianqiang Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2336-2345

title: TWIST & SCOUT:通过无遗忘调优实现多模态LLM专家的视觉定位
title_en: TWIST & SCOUT: Grounding Multimodal LLM-Experts by Forget-Free Tuning
abstract: 空间感知是实现具身多模态AI系统的关键。然而,在缺乏大量空间监督的情况下,当前多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)难以完成该任务。本文提出TWIST & SCOUT框架,通过无遗忘调优赋予预训练MLLMs视觉定位能力,同时保留其原有的图像和语言理解技能。为此,我们提出TWIST双专家分步调优模块,通过一个在图像理解任务上预训练的冻结模块和一个用于视觉定位任务的可学习模块,修改语言模型的解码器。这使MLLM既能保留已学习的知识和技能,又能获取缺失的能力。为有效微调模型,我们生成高质量合成数据集SCOUT,其模仿人类在视觉定位中的推理过程。该数据集提供丰富的监督信号,描述分步的多模态推理过程,从而简化视觉定位任务。我们在多个标准基准数据集上评估方法,涵盖基于图像的描述生成、零样本定位和视觉定位任务。我们的方法在所有任务中均表现出色,同时保留预训练的图像理解能力。
abstract_en: Spatial awareness is key to enable embodied multimodal AI systems. Yet, without vast amounts of spatial supervision, current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle at this task. In this paper, we introduce TWIST & SCOUT, a framework that equips pre-trained MLLMs with visual grounding ability without forgetting their existing image and language understanding skills. To this end, we propose TWIST, a twin-expert stepwise tuning module that modifies the decoder of the language model using one frozen module pre-trained on image understanding tasks and another learnable one for visual grounding tasks. This allows the MLLM to retain previously learned knowledge and skills, while acquiring what is missing. To fine-tune the model effectively, we generate a high-quality synthetic dataset we call SCOUT, which mimics human reasoning in visual grounding. This dataset provides rich supervision signals, describing a step-by-step multimodal reasoning process, thereby simplifying the task of visual grounding. We evaluate our approach on several standard benchmark datasets, encompassing grounded image captioning, zero-shot localization, and visual grounding tasks. Our method consistently delivers strong performance across all tasks, while retaining the pre-trained image understanding capabilities.
authors: Aritra Bhowmik, Mohammad Mahdi Derakhshani, Dennis Koelma, Yuki M. Asano, Martin R. Oswald, Cees G. M. Snoek ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1359-1368

title: Talking to DINO: 将自监督视觉主干与语言结合实现开放词汇分割
title_en: Talking to DINO: Bridging Self-Supervised Vision Backbones with Language for Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
abstract: 开放词汇分割(OVS)旨在无需预定义训练类别的前提下,对图像进行自由形式文本概念的分割。尽管现有视觉-语言模型如CLIP可通过利用Vision Transformer的粗略空间信息生成分割掩码,但其因图像与文本特征的全局对齐而面临空间定位挑战。相反,自监督视觉模型如DINO在细粒度视觉编码方面表现出色,但缺乏与语言的整合。为弥合这一差距,我们提出Talk2DINO,一种新颖的混合方法,结合了DINOv2的空间精度与CLIP的语言理解能力。我们的方法通过学习到的映射函数,将CLIP的文本嵌入对齐到DINOv2的像素级特征,无需对底层主干进行微调。在训练过程中,我们利用DINOv2的注意力图,选择性地将局部视觉块与文本嵌入对齐。我们证明Talk2DINO强大的语义和定位能力可提升分割过程,实现更自然且噪声更少的分割结果,并且我们的方法能有效区分前景对象与背景。实验结果表明,Talk2DINO在多个无监督OVS基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。
abstract_en: Open-Vocabulary Segmentation (OVS) aims at segmenting images from free-form textual concepts without predefined training classes. While existing vision-language models such as CLIP can generate segmentation masks by leveraging coarse spatial information from Vision Transformers, they face challenges in spatial localization due to their global alignment of image and text features. Conversely, self-supervised visual models like DINO excel in fine-grained visual encoding but lack integration with language. To bridge this gap, we present Talk2DINO, a novel hybrid approach that combines the spatial accuracy of DINOv2 with the language understanding of CLIP. Our approach aligns the textual embeddings of CLIP to the patch-level features of DINOv2 through a learned mapping function without the need to fine-tune the underlying backbones. At training time, we exploit the attention maps of DINOv2 to selectively align local visual patches with textual embeddings. We show that the powerful semantic and localization abilities of Talk2DINO can enhance the segmentation process, resulting in more natural and less noisy segmentations, and that our approach can also effectively distinguish foreground objects from the background. Experimental results demonstrate that Talk2DINO achieves state-of-the-art performance across several unsupervised OVS benchmarks.
authors: Luca Barsellotti, Lorenzo Bianchi, Nicola Messina, Fabio Carrara, Marcella Cornia, Lorenzo Baraldi, Fabrizio Falchi, Rita Cucchiara ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22025-22035

title: 通过不平衡最优传输控制流匹配实现快速全色锐化
title_en: Taming Flow Matching with Unbalanced Optimal Transport into Fast Pansharpening
abstract: 全色锐化是遥感中的关键任务,用于融合高分辨率全色和多光谱图像,近年来基于随机微分方程(SDEs)的扩散模型在该任务中表现出最先进的性能。然而,SDEs固有的多步采样过程带来了显著的计算开销,阻碍了实际部署。尽管现有方法采用高效采样器、知识蒸馏或重新训练来减少采样步数(例如从1,000步减少到更少),但此类方法往往牺牲融合质量。本文提出最优传输流匹配(OTFM)框架,通过整合不平衡最优传输(UOT)的双重形式实现一步高质量全色锐化。与传统OT形式强制严格分布对齐不同,UOT放松边缘约束以增强建模灵活性,适应遥感数据固有的光谱和空间差异。此外,我们将任务特定正则化纳入UOT目标函数,提升流模型的鲁棒性。OTFM框架实现了无模拟训练和单步推理,同时严格遵循全色锐化约束。在多个数据集上的实验评估表明,OTFM在仅需单步采样的情况下,性能可匹配或超越先前基于回归的模型和领先的扩散方法。
abstract_en: Pansharpening, a pivotal task in remote sensing for fusing high-resolution panchromatic and multispectral imagery, has garnered significant research interest. Recent advancements employing diffusion models based on stochastic differential equations (SDEs) have demonstrated state-of-the-art performance. However, the inherent multi-step sampling process of SDEs imposes substantial computational overhead, hindering practical deployment. While existing methods adopt efficient samplers, knowledge distillation, or retraining to reduce sampling steps (e.g., from 1,000 to fewer steps), such approaches often compromise fusion quality.In this work, we propose the Optimal Transport Flow Matching (OTFM) framework, which integrates the dual formulation of unbalanced optimal transport (UOT) to achieve one-step, high-quality pansharpening. Unlike conventional OT formulations that enforce rigid distribution alignment, UOT relaxes marginal constraints to enhance modeling flexibility, accommodating the intrinsic spectral and spatial disparities in remote sensing data. Furthermore, we incorporate task-specific regularization into the UOT objective, enhancing the robustness of the flow model.The OTFM framework enables simulation-free training and single-step inference while maintaining strict adherence to pansharpening constraints. Experimental evaluations across multiple datasets demonstrate that OTFM matches or exceeds the performance of previous regression-based models and leading diffusion-based methods while only needing one sampling step.
authors: Zihan Cao, Yu Zhong, Liang-Jian Deng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2803-2813

title: 基于图的知识检索与推理:让MLLMs驾驭未知
title_en: Taming the Untamed: Graph-Based Knowledge Retrieval and Reasoning for MLLMs to Conquer the Unknown
abstract: 知识的真正价值不仅在于其积累,更在于其有效利用以征服未知的潜力。尽管近期多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)展现出显著的多模态能力,但其在罕见领域特定任务中常因相关知识有限而表现不佳。为探索这一问题,我们采用视觉游戏认知作为测试平台,以《怪物猎人:世界》为目标构建多模态知识图谱(MH-MMKG),该图谱融合了多模态信息与复杂实体关系。我们还基于MH-MMKG设计了一系列具有挑战性的查询,以评估模型在复杂知识检索与推理方面的能力。此外,我们提出了一种多智能体检索器,使模型无需额外训练即可自主搜索相关知识。实验结果表明,我们的方法显著提升了MLLMs的性能,为多模态知识增强推理提供了新视角,并为未来研究奠定了坚实基础。
abstract_en: The real value of knowledge lies not just in its accumulation, but in its potential to be harnessed effectively to conquer the unknown. Although recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibit impressing multimodal capabilities, they often fail in rarely encountered domain-specific tasks due to limited relevant knowledge. To explore this, we adopt visual game cognition as a testbed and select "Monster Hunter: World" as the target to construct a multimodal knowledge graph (MH-MMKG), which incorporates multi-modalities and intricate entity relations. We also design a series of challenging queries based on MH-MMKG to evaluate the models' ability for complex knowledge retrieval and reasoning. Furthermore, we propose a multi-agent retriever that enables a model to autonomously search relevant knowledge without additional training. Experimental results show that our approach significantly enhances the performance of MLLMs, providing a new perspective on multimodal knowledge-augmented reasoning and laying a solid foundation for future research.
authors: Bowen Wang, Zhouqiang Jiang, Yasuaki Susumu, Shotaro Miwa, Tianwei Chen, Yuta Nakashima ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4732-4742

title: 目标偏见即所需:基于偏见语料库的视觉-语言模型零样本去偏
title_en: Target Bias Is All You Need: Zero-Shot Debiasing of Vision-Language Models with Bias Corpus
abstract: 像CLIP这样的视觉-语言模型(VLMs)通过在嵌入空间对齐不同模态,展现出显著的零样本性能,使图像编辑到视觉问答(VQA)等多样化应用成为可能。然而,这些模型常继承训练数据中的偏见,导致特定子群体间性能差异。传统VLMs去偏方法主要依赖标注数据集针对特定下游任务,我们认为这不足以满足VLMs的广泛适用性。具体而言,这些方法因过拟合、任务适用性有限及敏感数据使用监管限制,导致泛化性、可迁移性和可行性不足,难以在实际场景中应用。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种任务无关的新型方法,用于学习VLMs中的去偏图像嵌入。我们的方法无需昂贵的标注数据集或定制提示,仍能保留模型的固有零样本能力。相反,我们利用易获取的信息:1)由大语言模型生成的偏见文本语料库,2)通用的无监督视觉数据集。通过在文本-视觉表征相似性上应用中心核对齐(CKA)正则化,利用偏见文本语料库对通用视觉数据集进行分解,将图像嵌入分离为偏见与中性成分。实验结果验证了该方法在多个任务中的有效性,为VLMs去偏提供了实用且灵活的解决方案。
abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) like CLIP have shown remarkable zero-shot performance by aligning different modalities in the embedding space, enabling diverse applications from image editing to visual question answering (VQA). However, these models often inherit biases from their training data, resulting in performance disparities across specific subpopulations. Traditional debiasing methods for VLMs primarily focus on specific downstream tasks using labeled datasets, which we argue is insufficient given the broad applicability of VLMs. Specifically, these methods struggle with generalizability, transferability, and feasibility due to overfitting, limited task applicability, and regulatory constraints on the use of sensitive data, making them less practical in real-world scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose a novel task-agnostic method for learning debiased image embeddings in VLMs. Our approach does not require expensive annotated datasets or curated prompts for downstream tasks, while still preserving the inherent zero-shot capabilities of these models. Instead, we leverage easily accessible information: 1) a bias text corpus generated by a large language model, and 2) a generic unsupervised vision dataset. Our method disentangles the image embedding into bias and neutral components by applying centered kernel alignment (CKA) regularization to the text-vision representational similarity, using the bias text corpus over the generic vision dataset. Experimental results validate the effectiveness of our approach across multiple tasks, offering a practical and versatile solution to debiasing VLMs.
authors: Taeuk Jang, Hoin Jung, Xiaoqian Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1935-1946

title: 面向内存高效模型融合的任务向量量化
title_en: Task Vector Quantization for Memory-Efficient Model Merging
abstract: 模型融合通过结合任务特定的微调检查点实现高效多任务模型。然而,存储多个任务特定检查点需要大量内存,限制了扩展性并限制了模型融合仅适用于大型模型和多样任务。本文提出对任务向量(即预训练与微调检查点之间的差异)进行量化,而非对微调检查点进行量化。我们观察到任务向量具有狭窄的权重范围,可在现有任务向量融合框架中实现低精度量化(<=4位)。为进一步缓解超低精度量化(如2位)中的量化误差,我们引入残差任务向量量化,将任务向量分解为基向量和偏移分量。我们根据量化敏感度分配位数,在内存预算内确保精度同时最小化误差。在图像分类和密集预测任务上的实验表明,我们的方法在仅使用全精度检查点所需内存的8%时,保持或提升了模型融合性能。我们的代码可在https://aim-skku.github.io/TVQ/获取。
abstract_en: Model merging enables efficient multi-task models by combining task-specific fine-tuned checkpoints. However, storing multiple task-specific checkpoints requires significant memory, limiting scalability and restricting model merging to larger models and diverse tasks. In this paper, we propose quantizing task vectors (i.e., the difference between pre-trained and fine-tuned checkpoints) instead of quantizing fine-tuned checkpoints. We observe that task vectors exhibit a narrow weight range, enabling low-precision quantization (<= 4 bit) within existing task vector merging frameworks. To further mitigate quantization errors within ultra-low bit precision (e.g., 2 bit), we introduce Residual Task Vector Quantization, which decomposes the task vector into a base vector and offset component. We allocate bits based on quantization sensitivity, ensuring precision while minimizing error within a memory budget. Experiments on image classification and dense prediction show our method maintains or improves model merging performance while using only 8% of the memory required for full-precision checkpoints. Our code is available at https://aim-skku.github.io/TVQ/.
authors: Youngeun Kim, Seunghwan Lee, Aecheon Jung, Bogon Ryu, Sungeun Hong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20105-20115

title: 面向任务的提示梯度投影参数高效调优联邦类增量学习
title_en: Task-Aware Prompt Gradient Projection for Parameter-Efficient Tuning Federated Class-Incremental Learning
abstract: 联邦持续学习(FCL)因其在持续学习新任务的同时保护用户隐私的能力而受到广泛关注。然而,现有无数据知识迁移(DFKT)方法需要训练整个模型,导致高昂的训练和通信成本,而基于提示池的方法若能访问池中其他任务特定提示则可能带来隐私泄露风险。为解决这些挑战,我们提出了一种新方法:任务感知提示梯度投影与回放(TPPR),利用视觉提示构建参数高效调优架构。具体而言,我们提出任务感知提示梯度投影(TAPGP)机制以平衡任务无关与任务特定知识的学习。在实践中,我们将深度提示的梯度正交于先前任务的虚拟数据和提示,从而防止旧任务知识的侵蚀同时允许模型学习新信息。此外,我们基于指数移动平均引入双级提示回放(DLPR),在任务间和任务内层面促进知识复习,有效继承已学习知识。大量实验结果表明,我们的方法有效降低了模型通信开销并缓解遗忘问题,同时充分保护隐私。仅使用1%的训练参数,我们在所有设置中均比相同主干网络的SOTA方法取得超过5%的准确率提升。
abstract_en: Federated Continual Learning (FCL) has recently garnered significant attention due to its ability to continuously learn new tasks while protecting user privacy. However, existing Data-Free Knowledge Transfer (DFKT) methods require training the entire model, leading to high training and communication costs, while prompt pool-based methods with access to other task-specific prompts in the pool may pose a privacy leakage risk. To address these challenges, we propose a novel method: Task-aware Prompt gradient Projection and Replay (TPPR), which leverages visual prompts to build a parameter-efficient tuning architecture. Specifically, we propose the Task-Aware Prompt Gradient Projection (TAPGP) mechanism to balance the learning of task-agnostic and task-specific knowledge. In practice, we make the gradient of the deep prompts orthogonal to the virtual data and prompts of preceding tasks, which prevents the erosion of old task knowledge while allowing the model to learn new information. Additionally, we introduce Dual-Level Prompt Replay (DLPR) based on the exponential moving average to facilitate knowledge review at both inter-task and intra-task levels, effectively inheriting learned knowledge. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method effectively reduces model communication overhead and alleviates forgetting while fully protecting privacy. With only 1% of the training parameters, we achieve more than 5% accuracy improvements in all settings than SOTA with the same backbone.
authors: Hualong Ke, Jiangming Shi, Yachao Zhang, Fangyong Wang, Yuan Xie, Yanyun Qu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2631-2641

title: 任务解耦的贝塞尔曲面约束用于非均匀低光照图像增强
title_en: Task-Decoupled Bezier Surface Constraint for Uneven Low-Light Image Enhancement
abstract: 低光照图像增强(LLIE)是计算机视觉中的基础任务。其目标是从暗区域中提取更多有用信息。许多现有方法在提升图像亮度和增强纹理细节方面取得了显著进展。然而,这些方法在处理非均匀光照图像时,常导致某些区域过曝,造成图像中原有信息的丢失。为解决这一问题,我们提出一种基于任务解耦的贝塞尔曲面约束(BSCNet)方法,用于增强非均匀亮度的低光照图像。具体而言,我们设计了一个具有分支结构的扩散模型,将增强过程分为亮度调整和色彩恢复,实现对亮度均匀性的独立控制。此外,我们以贝塞尔曲面作为学习目标,对图像施加平滑约束,从而解决增强图像中亮度不均的问题。为应对贝塞尔曲面可能引入的细节损失,我们引入基于傅里叶变换的空间频率重建模块,以增强细粒度纹理信息。对六个通用LLIE数据集的实验对比表明,所提方法展现出卓越的有效性。
abstract_en: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) is a fundamental task in computer vision. Its goal is to extract more useful information from dark regions. Many existing methods have made excellent strides in improving image brightness and enhancing texture details. However, these approaches often lead to overexposure in certain regions when dealing with unevenly illuminated images, resulting in the loss of original information within the images. To address this issue, we propose a Bezier surface constraint (BSCNet) method based on task decoupling to enhance low-light images with uneven brightness. Specifically, we design a diffusion model with a branch structure that separates the enhancement process into brightness adjustment and color restoration, enabling independent control over brightness uniformity. Additionally, we use Bezier surfaces as a learning target to impose smoothness constraints on the image, thereby addressing the issue of uneven brightness in the enhanced image. To counteract potential detail loss introduced by Bezier surfaces, we introduce a spatial-frequency reconstruction module based on the Fourier transform to enhance fine-grained texture information. Experimental comparisons of six generalized LLIE datasets show that our proposed method has demonstrated outstanding effectiveness.
authors: Xingxiang Zhou, Xiangdong Su, Haoran Zhang, Wei Chen, Guanglai Gao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6859-6868

title: 基于上下文和任务感知扩散模型的任务导向人体抓取合成
title_en: Task-Oriented Human Grasp Synthesis via Context- and Task-Aware Diffusers
abstract: 本文研究任务导向的人体抓取合成,这是一个需要同时具备任务和上下文感知的新抓取合成任务。我们方法的核心是任务感知接触图。与仅考虑被操作物体及其与手部关系的传统接触图不同,我们的增强接触图同时考虑场景和任务信息。这种全面的接触图对于手-物体交互至关重要,能够生成与任务一致的精确抓取姿态。我们提出一个两阶段流程:首先基于场景和任务构建任务感知接触图;随后利用该接触图合成任务导向的人体抓取。我们引入了针对该任务的新数据集和评估指标来验证我们的方法。实验结果验证了同时建模场景和任务的重要性,在抓取质量和任务性能方面均显著优于现有方法。
abstract_en: In this paper, we study task-oriented human grasp synthesis, a new grasp synthesis task that demands both task and context awareness. At the core of our method is the task-aware contact maps. Unlike traditional contact maps that only reason about the manipulated object and its relation with the hand, our enhanced maps take into account scene and task information. This comprehensive map is critical for hand-object interaction, enabling accurate grasping poses that align with the task. We propose a two-stage pipeline that first constructs a task-aware contact map informed by the scene and task. In the subsequent stage, we use this contact map to synthesize task-oriented human grasps. We introduce a new dataset and metric for the proposed task to evaluate our approach. Our experiments validate the importance of modeling both scene and task, demonstrating significant improvements over existing methods in both grasp quality and task performance.
authors: An-Lun Liu, Yu-Wei Chao, Yi-Ting Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10375-10385

title: 面向任务的零样本量化感知训练用于目标检测
title_en: Task-Specific Zero-shot Quantization-Aware Training for Object Detection
abstract: 量化是通过以较低精度表示网络参数来减少网络规模和计算复杂度的关键技术。传统量化方法依赖于原始训练数据的访问,但常因隐私或安全问题受到限制。零样本量化(ZSQ)通过使用预训练模型生成的合成数据解决这一问题,无需真实训练数据。最近,ZSQ已扩展至目标检测领域。然而,现有方法使用无标签的任务无关合成图像,缺乏目标检测所需的具体信息,导致性能欠佳。本文提出了一种面向任务的ZSQ框架用于目标检测网络,包含两个主要阶段。首先,我们引入边界框和类别采样策略,从预训练网络中合成任务特定的校准集,无需先验知识即可重建目标位置、尺寸和类别分布。其次,我们将任务特定训练整合到知识蒸馏过程中以恢复量化检测网络的性能。在MS-COCO和Pascal VOC数据集上的大量实验验证了本文方法的效率和先进性。
abstract_en: Quantization is a key technique to reduce network size and computational complexity by representing the network parameters with a lower precision. Traditional quantization methods rely on access to original training data, which is often restricted due to privacy concerns or security challenges. Zero-shot Quantization (ZSQ) addresses this by using synthetic data generated from pre-trained models, eliminating the need for real training data.Recently, ZSQ has been extended to object detection. However, existing methods use unlabeled task-agnostic synthetic images that lack the specific information required for object detection, leading to suboptimal performance. In this paper, we propose a novel task-specific ZSQ framework for object detection networks, which consists of two main stages. First, we introduce a bounding box and category sampling strategy to synthesize a task-specific calibration set from the pre-trained network, reconstructing object locations, sizes, and category distributions without any prior knowledge. Second, we integrate task-specific training into the knowledge distillation process to restore the performance of quantized detection networks.Extensive experiments conducted on the MS-COCO and Pascal VOC datasets demonstrate the efficiency and state-of-the-art performance of our method.
authors: Changhao Li, Xinrui Chen, Ji Wang, Kang Zhao, Jianfei Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22868-22878

title: TaxaDiffusion:渐进式训练的细粒度物种生成扩散模型
title_en: TaxaDiffusion: Progressively Trained Diffusion Model for Fine-Grained Species Generation
abstract: 我们提出TaxaDiffusion,这是一种基于分类学的扩散模型训练框架,用于生成具有高形态学和身份准确性的细粒度动物图像。不同于将每个物种视为独立类别的标准方法,TaxaDiffusion整合了领域知识,即许多物种表现出强烈的视觉相似性,而差异往往体现在形状、图案和颜色的细微变化中。为利用这些关系,TaxaDiffusion在不同分类层级上渐进式训练条件扩散模型——从较宽泛的分类(如纲和目)开始,逐步细化至科和属,最终在物种层级进行区分。这种分层学习策略首先捕捉具有共同祖先的物种共有的粗粒度形态特征,促进知识迁移,随后细化物种级的细微差异。因此,TaxaDiffusion即使在每个物种仅有少量训练样本的情况下也能实现准确生成。在三个细粒度动物数据集上的大量实验表明,TaxaDiffusion优于现有方法,在细粒度动物图像生成中实现了更高的保真度。我们的模型和代码将公开发布。
abstract_en: We propose TaxaDiffusion, a taxonomy-informed training framework for diffusion models to generate fine-grained animal images with high morphological and identity accuracy. Unlike standard approaches that treat each species as an independent category, TaxaDiffusion incorporates domain knowledge that many species exhibit strong visual similarities, with distinctions often residing in subtle variations of shape, pattern, and color. To exploit these relationships, TaxaDiffusion progressively trains conditioned diffusion models across different taxonomic levels --- starting from broad classifications such as Class and Order, refining through Family and Genus, and ultimately distinguishing at the Species level. This hierarchical learning strategy first captures coarse-grained morphological traits shared by species with common ancestors, facilitating knowledge transfer, before refining fine-grained differences for species-level distinction. As a result, TaxaDiffusion enables accurate generation even with limited training samples per species. Extensive experiments on three fine-grained animal datasets demonstrate that TaxaDiffusion outperforms existing approaches, achieving superior fidelity in fine-grained animal image generation. Our model and code will be publicly available.
authors: Amin Karimi Monsefi, Mridul Khurana, Rajiv Ramnath, Anuj Karpatne, Wei-Lun Chao, Cheng Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8579-8589

title: TeEFusion:融合文本嵌入以蒸馏无分类器引导
title_en: TeEFusion: Blending Text Embeddings to Distill Classifier-Free Guidance
abstract: 近期文本到图像合成技术的进展主要得益于复杂的采样策略和无分类器引导(CFG)技术,以确保高质量生成。然而,CFG依赖两次前向传递,尤其是在结合复杂采样算法时,会导致极高的推理成本。为解决这一问题,我们提出TeEFusion(文本嵌入融合),一种新颖高效的蒸馏方法,通过将引导幅度直接融入文本嵌入,并蒸馏教师模型的复杂采样策略。通过简单的线性操作融合条件与无条件文本嵌入,TeEFusion在不增加额外参数的情况下重建所需引导,同时使学生模型能够从教师模型通过其复杂采样方法生成的输出中学习。在SD3等先进模型上的广泛实验表明,我们的方法使学生模型能够以更简单高效的采样策略接近教师模型的性能。因此,学生模型的推理速度最高可达教师模型的6倍,同时保持与教师复杂采样方法相当的图像质量。代码已开源至github.com/AIDC-AI/TeEFusion。
abstract_en: Recent advances in text-to-image synthesis largely benefit from sophisticated sampling strategies and classifier-free guidance (CFG) to ensure high-quality generation. However, CFG's reliance on two forward passes, especially when combined with intricate sampling algorithms, results in prohibitively high inference costs. To address this, we introduce TeEFusion (Text Embeddings Fusion), a novel and efficient distillation method that directly incorporates the guidance magnitude into the text embeddings and distills the teacher model's complex sampling strategy. By simply fusing conditional and unconditional text embeddings using linear operations, TeEFusion reconstructs the desired guidance without adding extra parameters, simultaneously enabling the student model to learn from the teacher's output produced via its sophisticated sampling approach. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art models such as SD3 demonstrate that our method allows the student to closely mimic the teacher's performance with a far simpler and more efficient sampling strategy. Consequently, the student model achieves inference speeds up to 6xfaster than the teacher model, while maintaining image quality at levels comparable to those obtained through the teacher's complex sampling approach. The code is publicly available at github.com/AIDC-AI/TeEFusion.
authors: Minghao Fu, Guo-Hua Wang, Xiaohao Chen, Qing-Guo Chen, Zhao Xu, Weihua Luo, Kaifu Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16652-16661

title: TeRA:重新思考文本引导的逼真三维虚拟形象生成
title_en: TeRA: Rethinking Text-guided Realistic 3D Avatar Generation
abstract: 高效三维虚拟形象创建在元宇宙、影视游戏、AR/VR等领域具有重要需求。本文通过提出TeRA框架,重新思考文本到虚拟形象的生成模型,该框架相比基于SDS的模型和通用大尺寸三维生成模型更具效率和效果。我们的方法采用两阶段训练策略学习原生三维虚拟形象生成模型。首先,通过蒸馏解码器从大型人体重建模型中提取结构化潜在空间;随后在该潜在空间中训练文本控制的潜在扩散模型,生成逼真三维人体虚拟形象。TeRA通过消除缓慢迭代优化提升模型性能,并通过结构化的三维人体表示实现基于文本的部分定制化。实验验证了我们的方法在主观和客观评估中均优于先前的文本到虚拟形象生成模型。
abstract_en: Efficient 3D avatar creation is a significant demand in the metaverse, film/game, AR/VR, etc. In this paper, we rethink text-to-avatar generative models by proposing TeRA, a more efficient and effective framework than the previous SDS-based models and general large 3D generative models. Our approach employs a two-stage training strategy for learning a native 3D avatar generative model. Initially, we distill a decoder to derive a structured latent space from a large human reconstruction model. Subsequently, a text-controlled latent diffusion model is trained to generate photorealistic 3D human avatars within this latent space. TeRA enhances the model performance by eliminating slow iterative optimization and enables text-based partial customization through a structured 3D human representation. Experiments have proven our approach's superiority over previous text-to-avatar generative models in subjective and objective evaluation.
authors: Yanwen Wang, Yiyu Zhuang, Jiawei Zhang, Li Wang, Yifei Zeng, Xun Cao, Xinxin Zuo, Hao Zhu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10686-10697

title: 教会AI扫描背后的解剖学:利用可学习先验解决医学图像分割中的解剖学缺陷
title_en: Teaching AI the Anatomy Behind the Scan: Addressing Anatomical Flaws in Medical Image Segmentation with Learnable Prior
abstract: 在构建稳健的多器官分割模型时,施加关键解剖特征(如器官数量、形状及其相对位置)至关重要。当前尝试整合解剖特征的方法包括通过数据密集型模块扩大有效感受野(ERF)尺寸,或引入扩展性较差的解剖约束。我们提出了一种名为解剖信息引导级联分割网络(AIC-Net)的新架构。AIC-Net整合了一种可学习输入——"解剖先验",该先验可通过可微空间变形适配患者特异性解剖结构。变形后的先验随后引导解码器层进行更符合解剖学的预测。我们在局部图像块层面重复此过程以增强复杂物体的表征,形成级联网络结构。AIC-Net是一种通用方法,可增强任何现有分割模型的解剖学感知能力。我们在三个多器官分割任务(腹部器官、椎体和肋骨)中验证了AIC-Net的性能,使用不同主干网络。针对每个任务,我们的基准测试均显示出Dice分数和Hausdorff距离的提升。
abstract_en: Imposing key anatomical features, such as the number of organs, their shapes and relative positions, is crucial for building a robust multi-organ segmentation model. Current attempts to incorporate anatomical features include broadening the effective receptive field (ERF) size with data-intensive modules, or introducing anatomical constraints that scales poorly to multi-organ segmentation. We introduce a novel architecture called the Anatomy-Informed Cascaded Segmentation Network (AIC-Net). AIC-Net incorporates a learnable input termed "Anatomical Prior", which can be adapted to patient-specific anatomy using a differentiable spatial deformation. The deformed prior later guides decoder layers towards more anatomy-informed predictions. We repeat this process at a local patch level to enhance the representation of intricate objects, resulting in a cascaded network structure. AIC-Net is a general method that enhances any existing segmentation models to be more anatomy-aware. We have validated the performance of AIC-Net, with various backbones, on three multi-organ segmentation tasks: abdominal organs, vertebrae, and ribs. For each respective task, our benchmarks demonstrate improved dice score and Hausdorff distance.
authors: Young Seok Jeon, Hongfei Yang, Huazhu Fu, Mengling Feng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24024-24033

title: 通过上下文示例教授视觉-语言模型定位特定对象
title_en: Teaching VLMs to Localize Specific Objects from In-context Examples
abstract: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)在多种视觉任务中展现出显著的能力,包括图像识别、视频理解以及视觉问答(VQA),当这些任务被显式训练时。尽管取得了这些进展,我们发现当前的VLMs(包括专有模型GPT-4o)缺乏一种基本的认知能力:通过考虑上下文来定位场景中的特定对象。在本工作中,我们专注于少样本个性化定位任务,其中模型被提供一组标注图像(上下文示例)——每张图像都有类别标签和边界框——并被要求在查询图像中定位相同类型的对象。个性化定位在存在多个相关对象的歧义情况下尤为重要,这些对象可能对文本或难以用语言描述的对象作出响应。为了激发模型的个性化定位能力,我们提出了一种以数据为中心的解决方案,通过精心挑选的视频目标跟踪数据集对模型进行微调。通过利用跨多个镜头跟踪同一对象的帧序列,我们模拟了指令微调对话,以促进上下文感知。为加强这一效果,我们引入了一种新颖的正则化技术,将对象标签替换为伪名称,确保模型依赖于视觉上下文而非先验知识。我们的方法显著提升了从7B到72B规模的最新VLMs的少样本定位性能,而不会牺牲泛化能力,如在多个专门评估个性化定位能力的基准测试中所展示的。本工作首次探索并基准测试了VLMs的少样本个性化定位,揭示了当前VLMs的关键弱点,并为未来基于上下文驱动的视觉-语言应用研究奠定了基础。
abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across diverse visual tasks, including image recognition, video understanding, and Visual Question Answering (VQA) when explicitly trained for these tasks. Despite these advances, we find that present-day VLMs (including the proprietary GPT-4o) lack a fundamental cognitive ability: learning to localize specific objects in a scene by taking into account the context.In this work, we focus on the task of few-shot personalized localization, where a model is given a small set of annotated images (in-context examples) -- each with a category label and bounding box -- and is tasked with localizing the same object type in a query image. Personalized localization can be particularly important in cases of ambiguity of several related objects that can respond to a text or an object that is hard to describe with words.To provoke personalized localization abilities in models, we present a data-centric solution that fine-tunes them using carefully curated data from video object tracking datasets. By leveraging sequences of frames tracking the same object across multiple shots, we simulate instruction-tuning dialogues that promote context awareness. To reinforce this, we introduce a novel regularization technique that replaces object labels with pseudo-names, ensuring the model relies on visual context rather than prior knowledge. Our method significantly enhances few-shot localization performance of recent VLMs ranging from 7B to 72B in size, without sacrificing generalization, as demonstrated on several benchmarks tailored towards evaluating personalized localization abilities. This work is the first to explore and benchmark personalized few-shot localization for VLMs -- exposing critical weaknesses in present-day VLMs, and lays a foundation for future research in context-driven vision-language applications.
authors: Sivan Doveh, Nimrod Shabtay, Eli Schwartz, Hilde Kuehne, Raja Giryes, Rogerio Feris, Leonid Karlinsky, James Glass, Assaf Arbelle, Shimon Ullman, M. Jehanzeb Mirza ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9572-9582

title: 基于手机摄像头的牙齿重建与表情捕捉方法
title_en: Teeth Reconstruction and Performance Capture Using a Phone Camera
abstract: 我们提出了一种仅使用单部手机摄像头实现个性化牙齿形状重建和包含牙齿的面部表情捕捉的首个方法。我们的方法通过非侵入式、低成本的设置,利用分析-合成方法解决单目捕捉的不适定问题,从而普及高质量的面部虚拟形象。我们引入了一种表示自适应技术,同时维护牙齿的网格和SDF表示,实现高效的可微渲染并防止牙齿与嘴唇的穿透。为克服相似外观的牙科组件对齐挑战,我们利用基础模型进行语义牙齿分割,并设计专门的优化目标。我们的方法通过利用面部结构先验的优化策略解决面部表情中牙齿的遮挡问题,而基于最优传输的语义掩码渲染损失确保了即使初始定位存在显著差异时的收敛性。
abstract_en: We present the first method for personalized dental shape reconstruction and teeth-inclusive facial performance capture using only a single phone camera. Our approach democratizes high-quality facial avatars through a non-invasive, low-cost setup by addressing the ill-posed monocular capture problem with an analysis-by-synthesis approach. We introduce a representation adaptation technique that maintains both mesh and SDF representations of teeth, enabling efficient differentiable rendering while preventing teeth-lip interpenetration. To overcome alignment challenges with similar-appearing dental components, we leverage foundation models for semantic teeth segmentation and design specialized optimization objectives. Our method addresses the challenging occlusions of teeth during facial performance through optimization strategies that leverage facial structural priors, while our semantic mask rendering loss with optimal transport-based matching ensures convergence despite significant variations in initial positioning.
authors: Weixi Zheng, Jingwang Ling, Zhibo Wang, Quan Wang, Feng Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9998-10008

title: TeethGenerator:一种用于生成配对正畸前/后三维牙科数据的两阶段框架
title_en: TeethGenerator: A two-stage framework for paired pre- and post-orthodontic 3D dental data generation
abstract: 数字正畸学是计算机视觉技术在医疗领域的重要且关键应用。迄今为止,临床数据收集过程,特别是获取配对的三维正畸牙齿模型,构成了开发牙齿排列神经网络的关键瓶颈。尽管已提出众多通用的3D形状生成方法,但大多数方法侧重于单对象生成,难以生成由24-32个分割牙齿组成的解剖结构化牙齿模型。本文提出TeethGenerator,一种新型两阶段框架,旨在合成正畸前/后的配对三维牙齿模型,以促进下游牙齿排列网络的训练。具体而言,我们的方法包含两个关键模块:(1) 利用扩散模型学习牙齿形态特征分布的牙齿形状生成模块,能够生成多样化的正畸后牙齿模型;(2) 通过将期望风格作为条件输入合成对应正畸前牙齿模型的牙齿风格生成模块。大量定性与定量实验表明,我们的合成数据集与真实正畸数据分布高度一致,当与真实数据结合训练时,可显著提升牙齿排列性能。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/lcshhh/teeth generator获取。
abstract_en: Digital orthodontics represents a prominent and critical application of computer vision technology in the medical field. So far, the labor-intensive process of collecting clinical data, particularly in acquiring paired 3D orthodontic teeth models, constitutes a crucial bottleneck for developing tooth arrangement neural networks. Although numerous general 3D shape generation methods have been proposed, most of them focus on single-object generation and are insufficient for generating anatomically structured teeth models, each comprising 24-32 segmented teeth. In this paper, we propose TeethGenerator, a novel two-stage framework designed to synthesize paired 3D teeth models pre- and post-orthodontic, aiming to facilitate the training of downstream tooth arrangement networks. Specifically, our approach consists of two key modules: (1) a teeth shape generation module that leverages a diffusion model to learn the distribution of morphological characteristics of teeth, enabling the generation of diverse post-orthodontic teeth models; and (2) a teeth style generation module that synthesizes corresponding pre-orthodontic teeth models by incorporating desired styles as conditional inputs. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that our synthetic dataset aligns closely with the distribution of real orthodontic data, and promotes tooth alignment performance significantly when combined with real data for training. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/lcshhh/teeth generator.
authors: Changsong Lei, Yaqian Liang, Shaofeng Wang, Jiajia Dai, Yong-Jin Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25872-25881

title: Teleportraits: 无需训练的人物任意场景插入
title_en: Teleportraits: Training-Free People Insertion into Any Scene
abstract: 从参考图像中真实地将人物插入到背景场景中的任务极具挑战性,要求模型能够(1)确定人物的正确位置和姿态,(2)基于背景进行高质量个性化处理。现有方法通常将这两个问题视为独立任务,忽视了它们的内在关联性,并通常依赖训练来实现高性能。在本工作中,我们引入了一个统一的无需训练流程,利用预训练的文本到图像扩散模型。我们证明扩散模型本质上具备在复杂场景中放置人物的知识,无需特定任务的训练。通过结合反演技术与无分类器引导,我们的方法实现了具备可用性感知的全局编辑,无缝地将人物插入场景。此外,我们提出的掩码引导的自注意力机制确保了高质量个性化,仅通过单张参考图像即可保留主体的身份、服装和身体特征。据我们所知,我们是首个实现无需训练的现实人物场景插入的研究,并在多样化的合成场景图像中取得了最先进的结果,背景和主体均保持了出色的身份一致性。
abstract_en: The task of realistically inserting a human from a reference image into a background scene is highly challenging, requiring the model to (1) determine the correct location and poses of the person and (2) perform high-quality personalization conditioned on the background. Previous approaches often treat them as separate problems, overlooking their interconnections, and typically rely on training to achieve high performance. In this work, we introduce a unified training-free pipeline that leverages pre-trained text-to-image diffusion models. We show that diffusion models inherently possess the knowledge to place people in complex scenes without requiring task-specific training. By combining inversion techniques with classifier-free guidance, our method achieves affordance-aware global editing, seamlessly inserting people into scenes. Furthermore, our proposed mask-guided self-attention mechanism ensures high-quality personalization, preserving the subject's identity, clothing, and body features from just a single reference image. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to perform realistic human insertions into scenes in a training-free manner and achieve state-of-the-art results in diverse composite scene images with excellent identity preservation in backgrounds and subjects.
authors: Jialu Gao, K J Joseph, Fernando De La Torre ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 18866-18875

title: TemCoCo:基于视觉语义协同的时间一致多模态视频融合
title_en: TemCoCo: Temporally Consistent Multi-modal Video Fusion with Visual-Semantic Collaboration
abstract: 现有多模态融合方法通常直接将基于静态帧的图像融合技术应用于视频融合任务,忽视了内在的时间依赖性,导致帧间结果不一致。为解决这一局限性,我们提出了首个显式融合时间建模与视觉语义协同的视频融合框架,同时确保视觉保真度、语义准确性和时间一致性。首先,我们引入包含语义分支和视觉分支的视觉语义交互模块,采用Dinov2和VGG19进行定向蒸馏,实现视觉与语义表示的同步增强。其次,我们首次将视频退化增强任务整合至视频融合流程,构建时间协作模块,通过时间依赖性促进弱信息恢复。第三,为确保时间一致性,我们嵌入时间增强机制并设计时间损失函数指导优化过程。最后,我们提出两个针对视频融合的创新性评估指标,旨在评估生成融合视频的时间一致性。在公开视频数据集上的大量实验结果验证了本方法的优越性。我们的代码已发布于https://github.com/Meiqi-Gong/TemCoCo。
abstract_en: Existing multi-modal fusion methods typically apply static frame-based image fusion techniques directly to video fusion tasks, neglecting inherent temporal dependencies and leading to inconsistent results across frames. To address this limitation, we propose the first video fusion framework that explicitly incorporates temporal modeling with visual-semantic collaboration to simultaneously ensure visual fidelity, semantic accuracy, and temporal consistency. First, we introduce a visual-semantic interaction module consisting of a semantic branch and a visual branch, with Dinov2 and VGG19 employed for targeted distillation, allowing simultaneous enhancement of both the visual and semantic representations. Second, we pioneer integrate the video degradation enhancement task into the video fusion pipeline by constructing a temporal cooperative module, which leverages temporal dependencies to facilitate weak information recovery. Third, to ensure temporal consistency, we embed a temporal-enhanced mechanism into the network and devise a temporal loss to guide the optimization process. Finally, we introduce two innovative evaluation metrics tailored for video fusion, aimed at assessing the temporal consistency of the generated fused videos. Extensive experimental results on public video datasets demonstrate the superiority of our method. Our code is released at https://github.com/Meiqi-Gong/TemCoCo.
authors: Meiqi Gong, Hao Zhang, Xunpeng Yi, Linfeng Tang, Jiayi Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14326-14335

title: 基于余弦的Softmax损失中的温度
title_en: Temperature in Cosine-based Softmax Loss
abstract: 尽管深度模型通常基于Softmax交叉熵损失进行有效训练,但基于余弦的Softmax损失同样适用于生成有利的特征嵌入。在基于余弦的Softmax中,温度参数在适当缩放余弦相似度的logits方面起着关键作用,但由于对温度的先验知识有限,通常需要以非结构化方式手动调整。本文针对在监督图像分类框架下自适应估计基于余弦的Softmax温度这一具有挑战性的问题进行了研究。通过从特征和分类器的几何视角分析基于余弦的Softmax表示,我们构建了一种最小二乘准则,使得可以通过简单的贪心搜索在每个样本上优化温度参数。此外,我们对温度的深入分析表明,基于余弦的Softmax损失生成的特征嵌入具有多样的特性,这些特性可通过温度以可解释的方式进行控制。实验结果表明,我们优化的温度参数有助于确定控制特征特性的可行温度范围,并在各种图像分类任务中实现了优越的性能。
abstract_en: While deep models are effectively trained based on a softmax cross-entropy loss, a cosine-based softmax loss also works for producing favorable feature embedding.In the cosine-based softmax, temperature plays a crucial role in properly scaling the logits of cosine similarities, though being manually tuned in ad-hoc ways as there is less prior knowledge about the temperature.In this paper, we address the challenging problem to adaptively estimate the temperature of cosine-based softmax in the framework of supervised image classification.By analyzing the cosine-based softmax representation from a geometrical viewpoint regarding features and classifiers, we construct a criterion in a least-square fashion which enables us to optimize the temperature at each sample via simple greedy search.Besides, our thorough analysis about temperature clarifies that feature embedding by the cosine-based softmax loss is endowed with diverse characteristics which are controllable by the temperature in an explainable way.The experimental results demonstrate that our optimized temperature contributes to determine a feasible range of temperature to control the feature characteristics and produces favorable performance on various image classification tasks.
authors: Takumi Kobayashi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22199-22208

title: 时序重叠预测:一种用于激光雷达移动物体分割的自监督预训练方法
title_en: Temporal Overlapping Prediction: A Self-supervised Pre-training Method for LiDAR Moving Object Segmentation
abstract: 激光雷达点云上的移动物体分割(MOS)对自动驾驶车辆等自主系统至关重要。尽管先前的监督方法依赖昂贵的手动标注,但激光雷达序列自然捕捉到时序运动线索,可用于自监督学习。本文提出时序重叠预测(TOP),一种旨在减轻标注负担的自监督预训练方法。TOP通过预测当前扫描及相邻扫描中常见的时间重叠点的占用状态,学习强大的时空表征。为进一步将这些表征与当前场景的几何结构关联,我们引入了重建当前扫描占用状态的辅助预训练目标。在nuScenes和SemanticKITTI数据集上的大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性。TOP在点级交并比(IoU)和物体级召回率指标上均优于现有监督和自监督预训练基线。值得注意的是,它在从零训练基线上的相对提升高达28.77%,并在不同激光雷达配置间展现出强大的迁移能力。我们的代码已公开在https://github.com/ZiliangMiao/TOP。
abstract_en: Moving object segmentation (MOS) on LiDAR point clouds is crucial for autonomous systems such as self-driving vehicles. While previous supervised approaches rely on costly manual annotations, LiDAR sequences naturally capture temporal motion cues that can be leveraged for self-supervised learning. In this paper, we propose Temporal Overlapping Prediction (TOP), a self-supervised pre-training method designed to alleviate this annotation burden. TOP learns powerful spatiotemporal representations by predicting the occupancy states of temporal overlapping points that are commonly observed in current and adjacent scans. To further ground these representations in the current scene's geometry, we introduce an auxiliary pre-training objective of reconstructing the occupancy of the current scan. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes and SemanticKITTI datasets validate our method's effectiveness. TOP consistently outperforms existing supervised and self-supervised pre-training baselines across both point-level Intersection-over-Union (IoU) and object-level Recall metrics. Notably, it achieves a relative improvement of up to 28.77% over a training-from-scratch baseline and demonstrates strong transferability across LiDAR setups. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ZiliangMiao/TOP.
authors: Ziliang Miao, Runjian Chen, Yixi Cai, Buwei He, Wenquan Zhao, Wenqi Shao, Bo Zhang, Fu Zhang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26653-26663

title: 人体运动分割的时序速率降低聚类
title_en: Temporal Rate Reduction Clustering for Human Motion Segmentation
abstract: 人体运动分割(HMS)旨在将视频分割为非重叠的人体运动,近年来吸引了越来越多的研究关注。现有HMS方法主要基于子空间聚类方法,其假设高维时序数据符合联合子空间(UoS)分布。然而,视频中捕捉复杂人体运动时,包含杂乱背景的帧可能难以与UoS分布良好对齐。本文提出了一种新型HMS方法,命名为时序速率降低聚类(\text TR ^2\text C),该方法联合学习结构化表示和亲和力以分割视频中的帧序列。具体而言,\text TR ^2\text C学习的结构化表示在时序上保持一致性,并与UoS结构良好对齐,这有利于解决HMS任务。我们在五个基准HMS数据集上进行了大量实验,使用不同特征提取器均取得了最先进的性能。代码已开源:https://github.com/mengxianghan123/TR2C
abstract_en: Human Motion Segmentation (HMS), which aims to partition videos into non-overlapping human motions, has attracted increasing research attention recently. Existing approaches for HMS are mainly dominated by subspace clustering methods, which are grounded on the assumption that high-dimensional temporal data align with a Union-of-Subspaces (UoS) distribution. However, the frames in video capturing complex human motions with cluttered backgrounds may not align well with the UoS distribution. In this paper, we propose a novel approach for HMS, named Temporal Rate Reduction Clustering (\text TR ^2\text C ), which jointly learns structured representations and affinity to segment the sequences of frames in video. Specifically, the structured representations learned by \text TR ^2\text C  enjoy temporally consistency and are aligned well with a UoS structure, which is favorable for addressing the HMS task. We conduct extensive experiments on five benchmark HMS datasets and achieve state-of-the-art performances with different feature extractors. The code is available at: https://github.com/mengxianghan123/TR2C.
authors: Xianghan Meng, Zhengyu Tong, Zhiyuan Huang, Chun-Guang Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14644-14654

title: 时间不可学习示例:通过目标跟踪防止个人视频数据的未经授权利用
title_en: Temporal Unlearnable Examples: Preventing Personal Video Data from Unauthorized Exploitation by Object Tracking
abstract: 随着社交媒体的兴起,大量用户上传的视频(如YouTube)被用作视觉目标跟踪(VOT)的训练数据。然而,VOT社区普遍忽视了视频数据隐私问题,许多私人视频在未获得授权的情况下被收集并用于训练商业模型。为缓解这些问题,本文首次探讨了通过深度跟踪器防止个人视频数据被未经授权利用的方法。现有防止未经授权数据使用的方案主要集中在基于图像的任务(如图像分类),直接将其应用于视频时存在效率低下、效果有限和泛化能力差等局限性。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种新颖的生成框架,用于生成时间不可学习示例(TUEs),其高效的计算能力使其可扩展至大规模视频数据集。使用TUEs训练的跟踪器严重依赖不可学习噪声进行时序匹配,忽略原始数据结构,从而确保训练视频数据的隐私性。为增强TUEs的有效性,我们引入了时序对比损失,进一步在使用我们的TUEs进行训练时破坏现有跟踪器的学习过程。大量实验表明,我们的方法在视频数据隐私保护方面达到了最先进的性能,在VOT模型、数据集和时序匹配任务中展现出强大的迁移能力。
abstract_en: With the rise of social media, vast amounts of user-uploaded videos (e.g., YouTube) are utilized as training data for Visual Object Tracking (VOT). However, the VOT community has largely overlooked video data-privacy issues, as many private videos have been collected and used for training commercial models without authorization. To alleviate these issues, this paper presents the first investigation on preventing personal video data from unauthorized exploitation by deep trackers. Existing methods for preventing unauthorized data use primarily focus on image-based tasks (e.g., image classification), directly applying them to videos reveals several limitations, including inefficiency, limited effectiveness, and poor generalizability. To address these issues, we propose a novel generative framework for generating Temporal Unlearnable Examples (TUEs), and whose efficient computation makes it scalable for usage on large-scale video datasets. The trackers trained w/ TUEs heavily rely on unlearnable noises for temporal matching, ignoring the original data structure and thus ensuring training video data-privacy. To enhance the effectiveness of TUEs, we introduce a temporal contrastive loss, which further corrupts the learning of existing trackers when using our TUEs for training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance in video data-privacy protection, with strong transferability across VOT models, datasets, and temporal matching tasks.
authors: Qiangqiang Wu, Yi Yu, Chenqi Kong, Ziquan Liu, Jia Wan, Haoliang Li, Alex C. Kot, Antoni B. Chan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11110-11121

title: 时序感知的查询路由在实时视频实例分割中的应用
title_en: Temporal-aware Query Routing for Real-time Video Instance Segmentation
abstract: 随着具身智能等应用的兴起,开发高实时性在线视频实例分割(VIS)技术变得愈发重要。然而,通过对先进在线VIS架构(即基于Transformer的架构)中各组件的时间性能分析,我们发现Transformer解码器显著阻碍了推理速度。进一步分析每个Transformer解码器层中相邻帧输出之间的相似性,揭示了Transformer解码器内部存在显著的冗余计算。为解决这一问题,我们引入了时序感知查询路由(TAR)机制。我们将TAR机制嵌入到每个Transformer解码器层之前,通过融合前一帧的最优查询、前一解码器层输出的查询及其差异信息,TAR预测二分类得分,并通过argmax操作决定当前层是否需要跳过。实验结果表明,将TAR集成到基线模型中可实现显著的效率提升(MinVIS为24.7-34.6 FPS,DVIS++为22.4-32.8 FPS),同时提升性能(例如在YoutubeVIS 2019数据集上,MinVIS达到47.4-48.4 AP,DVIS++达到55.5-55.7 AP)。此外,我们对TAR机制的分析表明,随着相邻视频帧差异的减小,跳过的层数随之增加,这表明我们的方法有效利用了帧间差异以减少Transformer解码器中的冗余计算。
abstract_en: With the rise of applications such as embodied intelligence, developing high real-time online video instance segmentation (VIS) has become increasingly important. However, through time profiling of the components in advanced online VIS architecture (i.e., transformer-based architecture), we find that the transformer decoder significantly hampers the inference speed. Further analysis of the similarities between the outputs from adjacent frames at each transformer decoder layer reveals significant redundant computations within the transformer decoder. To address this issue, we introduce Temporal-Aware query Routing (TAR) mechanism. We embed it before each transformer decoder layer. By fusing the optimal queries from the previous frame, the queries output by the preceding decoder layer, and their differential information, TAR predicts a binary classification score and then uses an argmax operation to determine whether the current layer should be skipped. Experimental results demonstrate that integrating TAR into the baselines achieves significant efficiency gains (24.7 - 34.6 FPS for MinVIS, 22.4 - 32.8 FPS for DVIS++) while also improving performance (e.g., on YoutubeVIS 2019, 47.4 - 48.4 AP for MinVIS, 55.5 - 55.7 AP for DVIS++). Furthermore, our analysis of the TAR mechanism shows that the number of skipped layers increases as the differences between adjacent video frames decrease, which suggests that our method effectively utilizes inter-frame differences to reduce redundant computations in the transformer decoder.
authors: Zesen Cheng, Kehan Li, Yian Zhao, Hang Zhang, Chang Liu, Jie Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22467-22476

title: 联邦微调中的张量聚合LoRA
title_en: Tensor-aggregated LoRA in Federated Fine-tuning
abstract: 将大语言模型(LLMs)与联邦学习(FL)结合以利用隐私保护数据,已成为进一步增强LLMs参数高效微调(PEFT)能力的有前景方法。在现实联邦学习场景中,由于资源异构性,低秩适应(LoRA)作为代表性PEFT方法的训练过程仍面临两大挑战:聚合噪声和聚合错位。本文提出一种基于非交替冻结训练策略的新型张量聚合LoRA(Te-LoRA),在避免额外服务端计算成本的同时消除聚合噪声,并缓解因异构LoRA参数错位导致的聚合次优问题。特别是在解决聚合次优问题方面,我们设计了预聚合对齐策略(PAA策略)和张量到矩阵策略(T2M策略),用于对齐异构LoRA并将其聚合为统一张量,随后将其分解为适配客户端下载的矩阵。大量实验验证了Te-LoRA在同构和异构场景下的有效性与鲁棒性。
abstract_en: The combination of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Federated Learning (FL) to leverage privacy-preserving data has emerged as a promising approach to further enhance the Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) capabilities of LLMs. In real-world FL settings with resource heterogeneity, the training process of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), the representative PEFT method, still faces two major challenges: aggregation noise and aggregation misalignment. In this paper, we propose a novel Tensor-aggregated LoRA (Te-LoRA) in Federated Fine-tuning based on an alternating-freeze training strategy to avoid aggregating noise without additional server-side computational costs, while mitigating aggregation suboptimality caused by parameter misalignment between heterogeneous LoRAs. Especially in addressing the aggregation suboptimality issue, we design the Pre-Aggregation Alignment strategy (PAA-strategy) and Tensor-to-Matrix strategy (T2M-strategy) for aligning heterogeneous LoRAs and aggregating them into an united tensor, which is then decomposed into matrices adapted for client download. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of Te-LoRA in both homogeneous and heterogeneous settings.
authors: Zhixuan Li, Binqian Xu, Xiangbo Shu, Jiachao Zhang, Yazhou Yao, Guo-Sen Xie, Jinhui Tang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1058-1067

title: TerraMind:面向地球观测的大型生成式多模态模型
title_en: TerraMind: Large-Scale Generative Multimodality for Earth Observation
abstract: 我们提出TerraMind,这是首个支持任意到任意生成式、多模态的基础模型,用于地球观测(EO)。与其它多模态模型不同,TerraMind在融合了跨模态的token级和像素级数据的双尺度表示上进行预训练。在token级别,TerraMind编码高层语境信息以学习跨模态关系;而在像素级别,TerraMind利用细粒度表示捕捉关键空间细节。我们基于一个全球范围的大型地理空间数据集,对TerraMind进行了九种地理空间模态的预训练。本文展示:(i) TerraMind的双尺度早期融合方法解锁了地球观测领域多种零样本和少样本应用;(ii) TerraMind引入了"模态思考"(TiM)——在微调和推理过程中生成额外人工数据以提升模型输出的能力;(iii) TerraMind在PANGAEA等地球观测社区标准基准测试中实现了超越当前最先进水平的性能。所有模型和代码已通过宽松许可协议开源,地址为https://huggingface.co/ibm-esa-geospatial和https://github.com/ibm/terramind。
abstract_en: We present TerraMind, the first any-to-any generative, multi-modal foundation model for Earth observation (EO). Unlike other multimodal models, TerraMind is pretrained on dual-scale representations combining both token-level and pixel-level data across modalities. On a token level, TerraMind encodes high-level contextual information to learn cross-modal relationships, while on a pixel level, TerraMind leverages fine-grained representations to capture critical spatial nuances. We pretrained TerraMind on nine geospatial modalities of a global, large-scale dataset. In this paper, we demonstrate that (i) TerraMind's dual-scale early fusion approach unlocks a range of zero-shot and few-shot applications for Earth observation, (ii) TerraMind introduces "thinking in modalities" (TiM)--the capability of generating additional artificial data during finetuning and inference to improve the model output--and (iii) TerraMind achieves beyond state-of-the-art performance in community-standard benchmarks for EO like PANGAEA. All models and code have been open-sourced under a permissive license at https://huggingface.co/ibm-esa-geospatial and https://github.com/ibm/terramind.
authors: Johannes Jakubik, Felix Yang, Benedikt Blumenstiel, Erik Scheurer, Rocco Sedona, Stefano Maurogiovanni, Jente Bosmans, Nikolaos Dionelis, Valerio Marsocci, Niklas Kopp, Rahul Ramachandran, Paolo Fraccaro, Thomas Brunschwiler, Gabriele Cavallaro, Juan Bernabe-Moreno, Nicolas Longépé ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7383-7394

title: 测试时提示调优用于零样本深度补全
title_en: Test-Time Prompt Tuning for Zero-Shot Depth Completion
abstract: 在具有度量尺度的零样本深度补全任务中存在显著挑战,主要由于领域特异性及传感器特性等性能限制。近期出现的一种新兴解决方案是将单目深度基础模型集成到深度补全框架中,但这些方法仍面临次优性能问题,且通常需要进一步适配目标任务。令人惊讶的是,我们发现一种简单的测试时训练方法,即在传感器提供的稀疏深度测量数据上微调单目深度基础模型,即可获得合理结果。然而,这种测试时训练显然会带来高昂的计算成本,并引入对特定条件的偏差,使其难以应用于实际场景。本文提出了一种新的参数高效零样本深度补全方法。我们的核心思想是利用视觉提示调优,在不遗忘基础知识的前提下实现传感器特定的深度尺度适配。在多个数据集上的实验结果表明,我们的方法优于相关最先进的方法,展现出更优的泛化能力和效率。我们的源代码已包含在补充材料中。
abstract_en: Zero-shot depth completion with metric scales poses significant challenges, primarily due to performance limitations such as domain specificity and sensor characteristics. One recent emerging solution is to integrate monocular depth foundation models into depth completion frameworks, yet these efforts still face issues with suboptimal performance and often require further adaptation to the target task. Surprisingly, we find that a simple test-time training, which fine-tunes monocular depth foundation models on sparse depth measurements from sensors just as it is, yields reasonable results. However, this test-time training obviously incurs high computational costs and introduces biases towards specific conditions, making it impractical for real-world scenarios. In this paper, we introduce a new approach toward parameter-efficient zero-shot depth completion. Our key idea of this work is to leverage visual prompt tuning, achieving sensor-specific depth scale adaptation without forgetting foundational knowledge. Experimental results on diverse datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms relevant state-of-the-art methods, showing superior generalization and efficiency. Our source code is available in the supplementary materials.
authors: Chanhwi Jeong, Inhwan Bae, Jin-Hwi Park, Hae-Gon Jeon ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9443-9454

title: 测试时检索增强适应方法:视觉-语言模型的适应性提升
title_en: Test-Time Retrieval-Augmented Adaptation for Vision-Language Models
abstract: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)因其在通过自然语言描述理解与推理视觉内容方面的卓越能力,在测试时适应任务中展现出巨大潜力。然而,训练VLMs通常需要大量计算资源,且它们往往难以高效适应新领域或任务。此外,从流式数据中动态估计测试分布仍然是一个重大挑战。在本工作中,我们提出了一种新颖的测试时检索增强适应(TT-RAA)方法,使VLMs能够在无需任务特定训练或大规模计算开销的情况下,在多样化的视觉识别任务中保持高性能。在推理过程中,TT-RAA采用流式高斯混合数据库(SMGD)持续估计测试分布,仅需最小存储空间。随后,TT-RAA从SMGD中检索最相关的信息,增强原始VLM输出。基于CLIP的VLMs的关键局限性在于其跨模态视觉-语言优化,未优化视觉空间相似性,导致同模态方差增大。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种多模态检索增强模块,将SMGD转换为统一的多模态空间,实现视觉与语言模态的对齐检索。在包含14个数据集的跨域和分布外基准测试中,TT-RAA的优越性能得到了充分验证。消融实验和超参数分析进一步验证了所提模块的有效性。本工作的源代码可在https://github.com/xinqi-fan/TT-RAA获取。
abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promise in test-time adaptation tasks due to their remarkable capabilities in understanding and reasoning about visual content through natural language descriptions. However, training VLMs typically demands substantial computational resources, and they often struggle to adapt efficiently to new domains or tasks. Additionally, dynamically estimating the test distribution from streaming data at test time remains a significant challenge. In this work, we propose a novel test-time retrieval-augmented adaptation (TT-RAA) method that enables VLMs to maintain high performance across diverse visual recognition tasks without the need for task-specific training or large computational overhead. During inference, TT-RAA employs a streaming mixture of Gaussian database (SMGD) to continuously estimate test distributions, requiring minimal storage. Then, TT-RAA retrieves the most relevant information from the SMGD, enhancing the original VLM outputs. A key limitation of CLIP-based VLMs is their inter-modal vision-language optimization, which does not optimize vision-space similarity, leading to larger intra-modal variance. To address this, we propose a multimodal retrieval augmentation module that transforms the SMGD into a unified multimodal space, enabling retrieval that aligns both vision and language modalities. Extensive experiments across both cross-domain and out-of-distribution benchmarks comprising fourteen datasets demonstrate TT-RAA's superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods. Ablation studies and hyperparameter analyses further validate the effectiveness of the proposed modules. The source code of our work is available at https://github.com/xinqi-fan/TT-RAA.
authors: Xinqi Fan, Xueli Chen, Luoxiao Yang, Chuin Hong Yap, Rizwan Qureshi, Qi Dou, Moi Hoon Yap, Mubarak Shah ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8810-8819

title: 无需参数更新的基础医学分割模型测试时适应
title_en: Test-time Adaptation for Foundation Medical Segmentation Model Without Parametric Updates
abstract: 以MedSAM为代表的基医学分割模型在器官和病灶分割任务中表现出色。然而,MedSAM在结构复杂且外观多样的特定病灶上仍存在性能下降问题,并受边界框提示引发的扰动影响。尽管现有医学图像分割测试时适应(TTA)方法可缓解该问题,但部分(如批量归一化)或整体参数更新受限于更新信号不足或大模型中的灾难性遗忘现象。同时,这些方法忽视了适应过程中的计算复杂性,这对现代基础模型尤为重要。为此,我们的理论分析表明,在MedSAM架构下直接优化图像嵌入可实现与参数更新相同的优化目标,从而在避免灾难性遗忘的同时实现高计算效率和分割性能。基于此框架,我们提出通过结合分布近似潜在条件随机场损失与熵最小化损失,鼓励最大化后验预测概率的因子化条件概率。实验表明,我们在三个数据集上实现了约3%的Dice分数提升,同时将计算复杂度降低了7倍以上。
abstract_en: Foundation medical segmentation models, with MedSAM being the most popular, have achieved promising performance across organs and lesions. However, MedSAM still suffers from compromised performance on specific lesions with intricate structures and appearance, as well as bounding box prompt-induced perturbations. Although current test-time adaptation (TTA) methods for medical image segmentation may tackle this issue, partial (e.g., batch normalization) or whole parametric updates restrict their effectiveness due to limited update signals or catastrophic forgetting in large models. Meanwhile, these approaches ignore the computational complexity during adaptation, which is particularly significant for modern foundation models. To this end, our theoretical analyses reveal that directly refining image embeddings is feasible to approach the same goal as parametric updates under the MedSAM architecture, which enables us to realize high computational efficiency and segmentation performance without the risk of catastrophic forgetting. Under this framework, we propose to encourage maximizing factorized conditional probabilities of the posterior prediction probability using a proposed distribution-approximated latent conditional random field loss combined with an entropy minimization loss. Experiments show that we achieve about 3% Dice score improvements across three datasets while reducing computational complexity by over 7 times.
authors: Kecheng Chen, Xinyu Luo, Tiexin Qin, Jie Liu, Hui Liu, Victor Ho Fun Lee, Hong Yan, Haoliang Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20075-20084

title: 文本嵌入知道如何量化文本引导的扩散模型
title_en: Text Embedding Knows How to Quantize Text-Guided Diffusion Models
abstract: 尽管扩散模型在文本到图像等图像生成任务中取得了成功,但扩散模型的巨大计算复杂度限制了其在资源受限环境中的应用。为了解决这一问题,网络量化已成为设计高效扩散模型的有前景的解决方案。然而,现有的扩散模型量化方法并未将输入条件(如文本提示)视为量化过程中不可或缺的信息来源。在本文中,我们提出了一种新颖的量化方法,称为利用文本提示的文本到图像扩散模型量化(QLIP)。QLIP利用文本提示来指导每个时间步每层的位精度选择。此外,QLIP可以无缝集成到现有量化方法中以提升量化效率。我们的广泛实验表明,QLIP在降低计算复杂度并提高各类数据集生成图像质量方面具有显著效果。
abstract_en: Despite the success of diffusion models in image generation tasks such as text-to-image, the enormous computational complexity of diffusion models limits their use in resource-constrained environments. To address this, network quantization has emerged as a promising solution for designing efficient diffusion models. However, existing diffusion model quantization methods do not consider input conditions, such as text prompts, as an essential source of information for quantization. In this paper, we propose a novel quantization method dubbed Quantization of Language-to-Image diffusion models using text Prompts (QLIP). QLIP leverages text prompts to guide the selection of bit precision for every layer at each time step. In addition, QLIP can be seamlessly integrated into existing quantization methods to enhance quantization efficiency. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of QLIP in reducing computational complexity and improving the quality of the generated images across various datasets.
authors: Hongjae Lee, Myungjun Son, Dongjea Kang, Seung-Won Jung ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15426-15436

title: Text-IRSTD:利用语义文本提升复杂场景下的红外小目标检测
title_en: Text-IRSTD: Leveraging Semantic Text to Promote Infrared Small Target Detection in Complex Scenes
abstract: 红外小目标检测是当前计算机视觉领域的热点和挑战性任务。现有方法通常聚焦于挖掘目标的视觉特征,难以应对复杂多样的检测场景。主要原因在于红外小目标自身图像信息有限,仅依赖视觉特征无法有效区分目标与干扰源,导致检测性能较低。为解决这一问题,我们提出一种利用语义文本引导的红外小目标检测新方法,称为Text-IRSTD。该方法创新性地将经典IRSTD扩展为文本引导的IRSTD,提供了新的研究思路。一方面,我们设计了一种新颖的模糊语义文本提示以适应模糊目标类别;另一方面,提出渐进式跨模态语义交互解码器(PCSID)以促进文本与图像信息的融合。此外,我们构建了一个包含2,755张不同场景红外图像及模糊语义文本注释的新基准数据集,称为FZDT。大量实验结果表明,我们的方法在检测性能和目标轮廓恢复方面均优于现有先进方法。此外,提出的Text-IRSTD在未见检测场景中展现出强泛化能力和广泛的应用前景。数据集和代码将在论文被接受后公开发布。数据集和代码可在https://github.com/Zhengsy0407/Text-IRSTD获取。
abstract_en: Infrared small target detection is currently a hot and challenging task in computer vision. Existing methods usually focus on mining visual features of targets, which struggles to cope with complex and diverse detection scenarios. The main reason is that infrared small targets have limited image information on their own, thus relying only on visual features fails to discriminate targets and interferences, leading to lower detection performance. To address this issue, we introduce a novel approach leveraging semantic text to guide infrared small target detection, called Text-IRSTD. It innovatively expands classical IRSTD to text-guided IRSTD, providing a new research idea. On the one hand, we devise a novel fuzzy semantic text prompt to accommodate ambiguous target categories. On the other hand, we propose a progressive cross-modal semantic interaction decoder (PCSID) to facilitate information fusion between texts and images. In addition, we construct a new benchmark consisting of 2,755 infrared images of different scenarios with fuzzy semantic textual annotations, called FZDT. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves better detection performance and target contour recovery than the state-of-the-art methods.
