Rather than relying on external feedback or reward, VCA leverages VLM's self-generated intrinsic reward to guide its exploration, enabling it to capture the most crucial information for reasoning. Experimental results on multiple long video benchmarks demonstrate our approach's superior effectiveness and efficiency.
authors: Zeyuan Yang, Delin Chen, Xueyang Yu, Maohao Shen, Chuang Gan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20168-20179

title: VEGGIE: 基于指令编辑与推理的视频概念锚定生成
title_en: VEGGIE: Instructional Editing and Reasoning Video Concepts with Grounded Generation
abstract: 尽管近期视频扩散模型能够实现视频编辑,但将多样化的指令编辑任务(如添加、删除、修改)统一到单一框架下仍是一个重大挑战。本文提出VEGGIE,一种基于指令的视频编辑器,通过锚定生成实现视频概念编辑、锚定与推理的统一。具体而言,给定视频和文本查询,VEGGIE首先利用大语言模型(MLLM)解析指令中的用户意图,并将其锚定到视频上下文中,生成针对每一帧的锚定任务查询以获取像素空间响应。随后,扩散模型根据这些计划生成符合用户意图的编辑视频。为支持多样任务和复杂指令,我们采用课程学习策略:首先利用大规模指令图像编辑数据对MLLM和视频扩散模型进行对齐,随后在高质量多任务视频数据上进行端到端微调。此外,我们引入了一种新颖的数据合成流水线,生成用于模型训练的配对指令视频编辑数据。该流水线通过利用图像到视频模型注入动态,将静态图像数据转化为多样且高质量的视频编辑样本。VEGGIE在不同编辑技能的指令视频编辑中表现出色,作为通用模型超越了最佳指令基线,而其他模型在多任务处理上表现不佳。VEGGIE在视频对象锚定和推理分割任务中也表现出色,其他基线方法均无法完成。我们进一步揭示了多任务间的协同效应,并突出了零样本多模态指令和上下文视频编辑等有前景的应用。
abstract_en: While recent video diffusion models enable video editing, unifying diverse instructional editing tasks (e.g., add, remove, modify) under a single framework remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we introduce VEGGIE, a Video Editor with Grounded Generation from Instructions, a simple end-to-end framework that unifies video concept editing, grounding, and reasoning based on diverse user instructions. Specifically, given a video and text query, VEGGIE first utilises an MLLM to interpret user intentions in instructions and ground them to the video contexts, generating frame-specific grounded task queries for pixel-space responses. A diffusion model then renders these plans and generates edited videos that align with user intent. To support diverse tasks and complex instructions, we employ a curriculum learning strategy: first aligning the MLLM and video diffu- sion model with large-scale instructional image editing data, followed by end-to-end fine-tuning on high-quality multitask video data. Additionally, we introduce a novel data synthe- sis pipeline to generate paired instructional video editing data for model training. It transforms static image data into diverse, high-quality video editing samples by leveraging Image-to-Video models to inject dynamics. VEGGIE shows strong performance in instructional video editing with different editing skills, outperforming the best instructional baseline as a versatile model, while other models struggle with multi-tasking. VEGGIE also excels in video object grounding and reasoning segmentation, where other baselines fail. We further reveal how the multiple tasks help each other and highlight promising applications like zero-shot multimodal instructional and in-context video editing.
authors: Shoubin Yu, Difan Liu, Ziqiao Ma, Yicong Hong, Yang Zhou, Hao Tan, Joyce Chai, Mohit Bansal ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15147-15158

title: VFlowOpt:一种基于视觉信息流引导优化的LMMs令牌修剪框架
title_en: VFlowOpt: A Token Pruning Framework for LMMs with Visual Information Flow-Guided Optimization
abstract: 大型多模态模型(LMMs)通过利用大量视觉标记进行细粒度视觉信息处理,在视觉-语言任务中表现出色,但这种标记冗余导致了显著的计算成本。先前的研究通常通过从视觉标记或视觉-语言标记的注意力分数中提取重要性图,在推理过程中减少视觉标记,这些方法通常涉及一个或多个修剪阶段。尽管取得了进展,修剪框架和策略仍较为简单且研究不足,往往导致显著的性能下降。本文提出VFlowOpt,一种令牌修剪框架,引入了重要性图生成过程和具有回收机制的渐进式修剪模块。其修剪策略的超参数进一步通过视觉信息流引导的方法进行优化。具体而言,我们基于注意力衍生的上下文相关性和块级信息熵计算图像标记的重要性图。随后决定保留或修剪哪些标记,并将修剪的标记聚合为回收标记以避免潜在的信息损失。最后,我们应用一种将LMMs中最后一个标记视为文本-视觉交互最具代表性的信号的视觉信息流引导方法。该方法最小化了修剪前后LMMs中标记表示之间的差异,从而实现针对不同LMMs的优化修剪策略。实验表明,VFlowOpt可在保持相当性能的同时修剪90%的视觉标记,实现KV-Cache内存减少89%和推理速度提升3.8倍。
abstract_en: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) excel in visual-language tasks by leveraging numerous visual tokens for fine-grained visual information, but this token redundancy results in significant computational costs. Previous research aimed at reducing visual tokens during inference typically leverages importance maps derived from attention scores among vision-only tokens or vision-language tokens to prune tokens across one or multiple pruning stages. Despite this progress, pruning frameworks and strategies remain simplistic and insufficiently explored, often resulting in substantial performance degradation. In this paper, we propose VFlowOpt, a token pruning framework that introduces an importance map derivation process and a progressive pruning module with a recycling mechanism. The hyperparameters of its pruning strategy are further optimized by a visual information flow-guided method. Specifically, we compute an importance map for image tokens based on their attention-derived context relevance and patch-level information entropy. We then decide which tokens to retain or prune and aggregate the pruned ones as recycled tokens to avoid potential information loss. Finally, we apply a visual information flow-guided method that regards the last token in the LMM as the most representative signal of text-visual interactions. This method minimizes the discrepancy between token representations in LMMs with and without pruning, thereby enabling superior pruning strategies tailored to different LMMs. Experiments demonstrate that VFlowOpt can prune 90% of visual tokens while maintaining comparable performance, leading to an 89% reduction in KV-Cache memory and 3.8xfaster inference.
authors: Sihan Yang, Runsen Xu, Chenhang Cui, Tai Wang, Dahua Lin, Jiangmiao Pang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23924-23934

title: VGGSounder:基础模型的视听评估
title_en: VGGSounder: Audio-Visual Evaluations for Foundation Models
abstract: 设计有效的基础模型需要高质量的评估数据集。随着视听基础模型的出现,对其多模态理解能力的可靠评估至关重要。目前评估视听理解能力的黄金标准是流行的分类数据集VGGSound。然而,我们的分析发现VGGSound存在若干关键问题,包括标签不完整、类别部分重叠以及模态不匹配。这些缺陷导致模型真实听觉和视觉能力的评估出现偏差。为解决这些局限性,我们引入了VGGSounder,这是一个全面重新标注的多标签测试集,扩展自VGGSound,专门设计用于准确评估视听基础模型。VGGSounder具有详细的模态标注,能够精确分析模态特定性能,并揭示此前未被注意到的模型局限性。我们相信VGGSounder提供了一个稳健可靠的基准,支持视听基础模型的未来发展。
abstract_en: Designing effective foundation models requires high-quality evaluation datasets. With the emergence of audio-visual foundation models, reliable assessment of their multi-modal understanding is essential. The current gold standard for evaluating audio-visual understanding is the popular classification dataset VGGSound. However, our analysis identifies several critical issues in VGGSound, including incomplete labelling, partially overlapping classes, and misaligned modalities. These flaws lead to distorted evaluations of models' true auditory and visual capabilities. To address these limitations, we introduce VGGSounder, a comprehensively re-annotated, multi-label test set extending VGGSound that is explicitly designed to accurately evaluate audio-visual foundation models. VGGSounder features detailed modality annotations, enabling precise analyses of modality-specific performance and revealing previously unnoticed model limitations. We believe VGGSounder offers a robust and reliable benchmark supporting the future development of audio-visual foundation models.
authors: Daniil Zverev, Thaddäus Wiedemer, Ameya Prabhu, Matthias Bethge, Wieland Brendel, A. Sophia Koepke ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1027-1037

title: VGMamba:面向数量无关的3D视觉定位的属性-位置线索推理
title_en: VGMamba: Attribute-to-Location Clue Reasoning for Quantity-Agnostic 3D Visual Grounding
abstract: 作为具身智能的重要方向,三维视觉定位受到广泛关注,旨在识别与给定语言描述匹配的三维物体。现有方法通常遵循两阶段流程,即首先检测候选物体,再基于与给定查询的相关性识别正确物体。然而,当查询复杂时,难以利用抽象语言表示精准锁定对应物体,影响定位性能。通常情况下,人类在完成对应定位时会遵循两个线索,即属性线索和位置线索。为此,我们探索了一种新的机制——属性到位置线索推理,以实现精准定位。具体而言,我们提出了一种VGMamba网络,包含基于SVD的属性Mamba、位置Mamba和多模态融合Mamba。输入为三维点云场景和语言查询,首先通过SVD对提取特征进行分解,随后进行滑动窗口操作以捕捉属性特征,接着通过位置Mamba获取对应位置信息。最后,通过多模态Mamba融合,模型能够有效定位与给定查询匹配的物体。在实验中,我们的方法在四个数据集上进行了验证。大量实验结果证明了本方法的优越性。
abstract_en: As an important direction of embodied intelligence, 3D Visual Grounding has attracted much attention, aiming to identify 3D objects matching the given language description. Most existing methods often follow a two-stage process, i.e., first detecting proposal objects and identifying the right objects based on the relevance to the given query. However, when the query is complex, it is difficult to leverage an abstract language representation to lock the corresponding objects accurately, affecting the grounding performance. In general, given a specific object, humans usually follow two clues to finish the corresponding grounding, i.e., attribute and location clues. To this end, we explore a new mechanism, attribute-to-location clue reasoning, to conduct accurate grounding. Particularly, we propose a VGMamba network that consists of an SVD-based attribute mamba, location mamba, and multi-modal fusion mamba. Taking a 3D point cloud scene and language query as the input, we first exploit SVD to make a decomposition of the extracted features. Then, a slidingwindow operation is conducted to capture attribute characteristics. Next, a location mamba is presented to obtain the corresponding location information. Finally, by means of multi-modal mamba fusion, the model could effectively localize the object that matches the given query. In the experiment, our method is verified on four datasets. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our method.
authors: Yihang Zhu, Jinhao Zhang, Yuxuan Wang, Aming Wu, Cheng Deng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5295-5304

title: VIGFace:面向隐私无忧的人脸识别数据集的虚拟身份生成
title_en: VIGFace: Virtual Identity Generation for Privacy-Free Face Recognition Dataset
abstract: 基于深度学习的人脸识别技术仍面临挑战,因其依赖于通过网络爬取获得的庞大数据集,这些数据集的收集成本高昂且引发显著的现实隐私问题。为解决这一问题,我们提出VIGFace,一种能够生成合成面部图像的创新框架。我们的方法源于在特征空间中预先分配虚拟身份。首先,我们使用真实人脸数据集训练人脸识别模型,并构建包含真实身份和虚拟身份的特征空间,其中虚拟原型与其他原型正交。随后,基于已建立的特征空间训练扩散模型,使其能够从真实原型生成真实人脸图像,并从虚拟原型合成虚拟人脸图像。我们的框架提供了两项显著优势。首先,它实现了现有个体与虚拟人脸图像的清晰区分,使用户能够自信地生成合成图像而无需担心隐私和肖像权问题。其次,通过引入真实现有图像进行数据增强,有效提升了模型性能。大量实验表明,我们的虚拟人脸数据集和框架在各类人脸识别基准测试中均优于先前的最先进方法。
abstract_en: Deep learning-based face recognition continues to face challenges due to its reliance on huge datasets obtained from web crawling, which can be costly to gather and raise significant real-world privacy concerns. To address this issue, we propose VIGFace, a novel framework capable of generating synthetic facial images. Our idea originates from pre-assigning virtual identities in the feature space. Initially, we train the face recognition model using a real face dataset and create a feature space for both real and virtual identities, where virtual prototypes are orthogonal to other prototypes. Subsequently, we train the diffusion model based on the established feature space, enabling it to generate authentic human face images from real prototypes and synthesize virtual face images from virtual prototypes.Our proposed framework provides two significant benefits. Firstly, it shows clear separability between existing individuals and virtual face images, allowing one to create synthetic images with confidence and without concerns about privacy and portrait rights. Secondly, it ensures improved performance through data augmentation by incorporating real existing images. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our virtual face dataset and framework, outperforming the previous state-of-the-art on various face recognition benchmarks.
authors: Minsoo Kim, Min-Cheol Sagong, Gi Pyo Nam, Junghyun Cho, Ig-Jae Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10043-10053

title: VIPerson:面向行人重识别的灵活虚拟身份生成
title_en: VIPerson: Flexibly Generating Virtual Identity for Person Re-Identification
abstract: 行人重识别(ReID)旨在匹配不同摄像头视角下的行人图像。训练ReID模型需要大量标注的现实数据,导致高昂的标注成本和隐私问题。尽管已有多种ReID数据合成方法被提出以解决这些问题,但它们无法生成具有新身份或真实世界摄像头风格的图像。本文提出了一种新型行人生成管道VIPerson,用于生成具有灵活虚拟身份的摄像头真实感行人图像以完成行人重识别任务。VIPerson聚焦于数据合成的三个关键因素:(I) 虚拟身份多样性:通过我们提出的丢弃文本嵌入增强潜在扩散模型,灵活生成随机且困难的身份;(II) 可扩展的跨摄像头变化:VIPerson在每个身份内引入可扩展的场景和姿态变化;(III) 摄像头真实风格:采用与身份无关的方法进行真实风格迁移,避免真实身份的隐私暴露。在广泛下游ReID任务上的大量实验结果验证了我们生成数据集相较于现有方法的优越性。此外,VIPerson可扩展至身份扩展场景,拓宽了我们管道的应用范围。VIPerson的数据集和代码可在https://isee-laboratory.github.io/VIPerson/获取。
abstract_en: Person re-identification (ReID) is to match the person images under different camera views. Training ReID models necessitates a substantial amount of labeled real-world data, leading to high labeling costs and privacy issues. Although several ReID data synthetic methods are proposed to address these issues, they fail to generate images with new identities or real-world camera styles. In this paper, we propose a novel pedestrian generation pipeline, VIPerson, to generate camera-realistic pedestrian images with flexible Virtual Identities for the Person ReID task. VIPerson focuses on three key factors in data synthesis: (I) Virtual identity diversity: Enhancing the latent diffusion model with our proposed dropout text embedding, we flexibly generate random and hard identities. (II) Scalable cross-camera variations: VIPerson introduces scalable variations of scenes and poses within each identity. (III) Camera-realistic style: Adopting an identity-agnostic approach to transfer realistic styles, we avoid privacy exposure of real identities. Extensive experimental results across a broad range of downstream ReID tasks demonstrate the superiority of our generated dataset over existing methods. In addition, VIPerson can be adapted to the identity expansion scenario, which widens the application of our pipeline. The dataset and code of VIPerson are available at https://isee-laboratory.github.io/VIPerson/.
authors: Xiao-Wen Zhang, Delong Zhang, Yi-Xing Peng, Zhi Ouyang, Jingke Meng, Wei-Shi Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23374-23384

title: VISION-XL: 基于潜在图像扩散模型的高清晰度视频逆问题求解器
title_en: VISION-XL: High Definition Video Inverse Problem Solver using Latent Image Diffusion Models
abstract: 本文提出了一种基于潜在图像扩散模型解决高清晰度视频逆问题的新框架。在视频逆问题中利用图像扩散模型进行时空优化的最新进展基础上,我们的方法通过潜在空间扩散模型实现了视频质量与分辨率的提升。为应对高分辨率帧处理的高计算需求,我们引入了伪批量一致性采样策略,使单个GPU能够高效运行。此外,为增强时间一致性,我们提出了伪批量逆变换,这是一种结合测量信息潜在特征的初始化技术。通过与SDXL集成,我们的框架在包括复杂帧平均与多种空间退化(如去模糊、超分辨率和图像修复)在内的广泛时空逆问题中实现了最先进的视频重建。与以往方法不同,我们的方法支持多种宽高比(横屏、竖屏和方形),并在单个NVIDIA 4090 GPU上每帧可在6秒内完成超过1280x720的高清分辨率重建。项目页面: https://vision-xl.github.io/
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a novel framework for solving high-definition video inverse problems using latent image diffusion models. Building on recent advancements in spatio-temporal optimization for video inverse problems using image diffusion models, our approach leverages latent-space diffusion models to achieve enhanced video quality and resolution. To address the high computational demands of processing high-resolution frames, we introduce a pseudo-batch consistent sampling strategy, allowing efficient operation on a single GPU. Additionally, to improve temporal consistency, we present pseudo-batch inversion, an initialization technique that incorporates informative latents from the measurement. By integrating with SDXL, our framework achieves state-of-the-art video reconstruction across a wide range of spatio-temporal inverse problems, including complex combinations of frame averaging and various spatial degradations, such as deblurring, super-resolution, and inpainting. Unlike previous methods, our approach supports multiple aspect ratios (landscape, vertical, and square) and delivers HD-resolution reconstructions (exceeding 1280x720) in under 6 seconds per frame on a single NVIDIA 4090 GPU. Project page: https://vision-xl.github.io/.
authors: Taesung Kwon, Jong Chul Ye ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10465-10474

title: VISO:基于语言引导掩码学习与稀疏推理的在轨目标检测加速方法
title_en: VISO: Accelerating In-orbit Object Detection with Language-Guided Mask Learning and Sparse Inference
abstract: 在轨目标检测对于配备GPU的卫星地球观测任务至关重要。一种有前景的方法是利用预训练的视觉-语言建模(VLM)来增强其开放词汇能力。然而,在卫星上采用该方法面临两个挑战:(1)卫星图像与自然图像存在显著差异;(2)卫星嵌入式GPU的算力不足以支持复杂模型的推理。我们发现其缺乏一个关键先验:在轨检测涉及在杂乱但单调的背景下识别一组已知目标。受此启发,我们提出VISo,一种基于视觉-语言指令的卫星目标检测模型,该模型专注于目标特定特征,通过语言引导的掩码学习抑制无关区域。在包含340万区域-文本对的大型卫星数据集上预训练后,VISo增强目标-文本对齐度和以目标为中心的特征以提升检测精度。同时,VISo通过抑制无关区域实现高度稀疏推理,从而加速卫星上的处理速度。大量实验表明,不采用稀疏性的VISo在零样本检测中比最先进(SOTA)的VLMs提升34.1%的AP并减少27xFLOPs,且在监督目标检测和目标指称任务中超越专用模型2.3%的AP。当将VISo稀疏化至相当的AP时,FLOPs可减少高达8.5倍。实际测试表明,VISo在卫星嵌入式GPU上实现2.8-4.8倍的FPS加速。
abstract_en: In-orbit object detection is essential for Earth observation missions on satellites equipped with GPUs. A promising approach is to use pre-trained vision-language modeling (VLM) to enhance its open-vocabulary capability. However, adopting it on satellites poses two challenges: (1) satellite imagery differs substantially from natural images, and (2) satellites' embedded GPUs are insufficient for complex models' inference. We reveal their lack of a crucial prior: in-orbit detection involves identifying a set of known objects within a cluttered yet monotonous background. Motivated by this observation, we propose VISO, a Vision-language Instructed Satellite Object detection model that focuses on object-specific features while suppressing irrelevant regions through language-guided mask learning. After pre-training on a large-scale satellite dataset with 3.4M region-text pairs, VISO enhances object-text alignment and object-centric features to improve detection accuracy. Also, VISO suppresses irrelevant regions, enabling highly sparse inference to accelerate speed on satellites. Extensive experiments show that VISO without sparsity outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) VLMs in zero-shot detection by increasing 34.1% AP and reducing 27xFLOPs, and surpasses specialist models in supervised object detection and object referring by improving 2.3% AP. When sparsifying VISO to a comparable AP, FLOPs can be greatly reduced by up to 8.5x. Real-world tests reveal that VISO achieves a 2.8-4.8xFPS speed-up on satellites' embedded GPUs.
authors: Meiqi Wang, Han Qiu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23300-23310

title: VITAL:通过分布对齐和相关信息流实现更易理解的特征可视化
title_en: VITAL: More Understandable Feature Visualization through Distribution Alignment and Relevant Information Flow
abstract: 神经网络被广泛用于解决复杂且具有挑战性的任务。特别是在高风险决策场景中,理解其推理过程至关重要,但现代深度网络却难以实现。特征可视化(FV)是一种强大的工具,能够解码神经元响应的信息,从而更好地理解此类网络的推理机制。具体而言,在FV中,我们生成反映感兴趣神经元检测信息的人类可理解图像。然而,当前方法常产生难以辨识的可视化结果,呈现出重复模式和视觉伪影,这些对于人类而言难以理解。为解决这些问题,我们提出通过**真实图像特征的统计信息**结合**相关网络流的度量**来指导FV生成原型图像。我们的方法在多种架构上均优于现有最先进的FV方法,从定性和定量两个层面均取得显著提升。因此,该方法可用于解码**哪些**信息被网络使用,补充识别**何处**编码的机制电路。
abstract_en: Neural networks are widely adopted to solve complex and challenging tasks. Especially in high-stakes decision-making, understanding their reasoning process is crucial, yet proves challenging for modern deep networks. Feature visualization (FV) is a powerful tool to decode what information neurons are responding to and hence to better understand the reasoning behind such networks. In particular, in FV we generate human-understandable images that reflect the information detected by neurons of interest. However, current methods often yield unrecognizable visualizations, exhibiting repetitive patterns and visual artifacts that are hard to understand for a human. To address these problems, we propose to guide FV through **statistics of real image features** combined with measures of **relevant network flow** to generate prototypical images. Our approach yields human-understandable visualizations that both qualitatively and quantitatively improve over state-of-the-art FVs across various architectures. As such, it can be used to decode **which** information the network uses, complementing mechanistic circuits that identify **where** it is encoded.
authors: Ada Görgün, Bernt Schiele, Jonas Fischer ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4403-4412

title: VLABench: 一个面向长时域推理任务的语言引导机器人操作大规模基准测试
title_en: VLABench: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Language-Conditioned Robotics Manipulation with Long-Horizon Reasoning Tasks
abstract: 通用具身智能体旨在理解用户的自然指令或意图,并精确执行通用任务。近期基于基础模型特别是视觉-语言-动作模型(VLAs)的方法在解决语言引导操作(LCM)任务方面展现出显著潜力。然而现有基准测试未能充分满足VLA及相关算法的需求。为更好定义LLM语境下的通用任务并推动VLA研究,我们提出VLABench,一个开源的通用LCM任务学习评估基准。VLABench提供100个精心设计的任务类别,每个类别具有强随机化特性,包含2000+个物体。该基准在四个方面区别于先前基准:1)需要世界知识和常识迁移的任务;2)包含隐含人类意图而非模板的自然语言指令;3)需要多步推理的长时域任务;4)同时评估动作策略和语言模型能力。该基准评估包括网格/纹理理解、空间关系、语义指令、物理定律、知识迁移和推理等多维度能力。为支持下游微调,我们提供通过结合启发式技能和先验信息的自动化框架收集的高质量训练数据。实验结果表明,当前最先进的预训练VLA模型和基于VLM的流程在本任务中均面临挑战。
abstract_en: General-purposed embodied agents are designed to understand the users' natural instructions or intentions and act precisely to complete universal tasks. Recently, methods based on foundation models especially Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have shown a substantial potential to solve language-conditioned manipulation (LCM) tasks well. However, existing benchmarks do not adequately meet the needs of VLAs and relative algorithms. To better define such general-purpose tasks in the context of LLMs and advance the research in VLAs, we present VLABench, an open-source benchmark for evaluating universal LCM task learning. VLABench provides 100 carefully designed categories of tasks, with strong randomization in each category of task and a total of 2000+ objects. VLABench stands out from previous benchmarks in four key aspects: 1) tasks requiring world knowledge and common sense transfer, 2) natural language instructions with implicit human intentions rather than templates, 3) long-horizon tasks demanding multi-step reasoning, and 4) evaluation of both action policies and language model capabilities. The benchmark assesses multiple competencies including understanding of mesh&texture, spatial relationship, semantic instruction, physical laws, knowledge transfer and reasoning, etc. To support the downstream finetuning, we provide high-quality training data collected via an automated framework incorporating heuristic skills and prior information. The experimental results indicate that both the current state-of-the-art pretrained VLAs and the workflow based on VLMs face challenges in our tasks.
authors: Shiduo Zhang, Zhe Xu, Peiju Liu, Xiaopeng Yu, Yuan Li, Qinghui Gao, Zhaoye Fei, Zhangyue Yin, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang, Xipeng Qiu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11142-11152

title: VLDrive:面向高效语言引导自动驾驶的视觉增强轻量级多模态大语言模型
title_en: VLDrive: Vision-Augmented Lightweight MLLMs for Efficient Language-grounded Autonomous Driving
abstract: 近期语言引导的自动驾驶技术进展显著得益于大语言模型(LLMs)复杂的认知和推理能力。然而,当前基于LLM的方法面临关键挑战:(1) 故障分析表明,源于视觉表征局限性的频繁碰撞和障碍物仍是对鲁棒驾驶性能的主要障碍。(2) LLMs庞大的参数量导致部署面临重大挑战。为解决这些局限性,我们提出VLDrive,一种新型方法,其特征是轻量级MLLM架构与增强的视觉组件。VLDrive通过创新策略实现紧凑的视觉标记,包括循环一致的动态视觉剪枝和记忆增强的特征聚合。此外,我们提出距离解耦的指令注意力机制以提升联合视觉-语言特征学习,尤其针对长距离视觉标记。在CARLA模拟器中进行的大量实验验证了VLDrive的有效性。值得注意的是,VLDrive在减少参数量81%(从7B降至1.3B)的同时实现最先进的驾驶性能,在闭环评估中分别在极短、短和长距离场景下取得15.4%、16.8%和7.6%的显著驾驶得分提升。代码可在https://github.com/ReaFly/VLDrive获取。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in language-grounded autonomous driving have been significantly promoted by the sophisticated cognition and reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, current LLM-based approaches encounter critical challenges: (1) Failure analysis reveals that frequent collisions and obstructions, stemming from limitations in visual representations, remain primary obstacles to robust driving performance. (2) The substantial parameters of LLMs pose considerable deployment hurdles. To address these limitations, we introduce VLDrive, a novel approach featuring a lightweight MLLM architecture with enhanced vision components. VLDrive achieves compact visual tokens through innovative strategies, including cycle-consistent dynamic visual pruning and memory-enhanced feature aggregation. Furthermore, we propose a distance-decoupled instruction attention mechanism to improve joint visual-linguistic feature learning, particularly for long-range visual tokens. Extensive experiments conducted in the CARLA simulator demonstrate VLDrive's effectiveness. Notably, VLDrive achieves state-of-the-art driving performance while reducing parameters by 81% (from 7B to 1.3B), yielding substantial driving score improvements of 15.4%, 16.8%, and 7.6% at tiny, short, and long distances, respectively, in closed-loop evaluations. Code is available at https://github.com/ReaFly/VLDrive.
authors: Ruifei Zhang, Wei Zhang, Xiao Tan, Sibei Yang, Xiang Wan, Xiaonan Luo, Guanbin Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5923-5933

title: VLIPP: 基于视觉与语言引导的物理先验实现物理合理视频生成
title_en: VLIPP: Towards Physically Plausible Video Generation with Vision and Language Informed Physical Prior
abstract: 近年来,视频扩散模型(VDMs)取得了显著进展,能够生成高度逼真的视频,并因其作为世界模拟器的潜力而受到社区关注。然而,尽管具备强大能力,VDMs往往因缺乏对物理规律的理解而难以生成物理合理视频,导致运动动态和事件序列错误。为解决这一局限,我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段图像到视频生成框架,显式融合视觉与语言引导的物理先验。第一阶段采用视觉语言模型(VLM)作为粗粒度运动规划器,通过思维链与物理感知推理预测近似真实物理动态的粗略运动轨迹/变化,同时确保帧间一致性。第二阶段利用预测的运动轨迹/变化引导VDM视频生成。由于预测轨迹/变化较为粗糙,推理过程中添加噪声以赋予VDM生成更精细运动细节的自由度。大量实验结果表明,我们的框架能够生成物理合理运动,对比评估凸显了方法相较于现有技术的显著优势。更多视频结果与代码请访问项目页面:https://madaoer.github.io/projects/physically_plausible_video_generation/
abstract_en: Video diffusion models (VDMs) have advanced significantly in recent years, enabling the generation of highly realistic videos and drawing the attention of the community in their potential as world simulators. However, despite their capabilities, VDMs often fail to produce physically plausible videos due to an inherent lack of understanding of physics, resulting in incorrect dynamics and event sequences. To address this limitation, we propose a novel two-stage image-to-video generation framework that explicitly incorporates physics with vision and language informed physical prior. In the first stage, we employ a Vision Language Model (VLM) as a coarse-grained motion planner, integrating chain-of-thought and physics-aware reasoning to predict a rough motion trajectories/changes that approximate real-world physical dynamics while ensuring the inter-frame consistency. In the second stage, we use the predicted motion trajectories/changes to guide the video generation of a VDM. As the predicted motion trajectories/changes are rough, noise is added during inference to provide freedom to the VDM in generating motion with more fine details. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our framework can produce physically plausible motion, and comparative evaluations highlight the notable superiority of our approach over existing methods. More video results and code are available on our Project Page: https://madaoer.github.io/projects/physically_plausible_video_generation/.
authors: Xindi Yang, Baolu Li, Yiming Zhang, Zhenfei Yin, Lei Bai, Liqian Ma, Zhiyong Wang, Jianfei Cai, Tien-Tsin Wong, Huchuan Lu, Xu Jia ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12360-12370

title: VLM4D:迈向视觉语言模型的时空感知
title_en: VLM4D: Towards Spatiotemporal Awareness in Vision Language Models
abstract: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在整合语言和视觉推理方面展现出显著能力,但在理解动态时空交互方面仍存在根本性局限。人类能够毫不费力地追踪和推理物体的运动、旋转和视角变化——这些能力对于稳健的动态现实理解至关重要,但当前VLMs却明显缺乏。本文我们引入VLM4D,这是首个专门用于评估VLMs时空推理能力的基准测试。我们的基准测试包含多样化的现实世界和合成视频,配套精心策划的问题-答案对,重点强调平移和旋转运动、视角感知以及运动连续性。通过对当前最先进的开源和闭源VLMs进行全面评估,我们发现其性能与人类基线存在显著差距,凸显了现有模型的根本性缺陷。深入分析表明,VLMs在整合多视觉线索和保持时间连贯性方面尤其困难。我们进一步探索有前景的方向,如利用四维特征场重建和有针对性的时空监督微调,证明这些方法在增强时空理解方面的有效性。我们的工作旨在鼓励更深入地探索提升VLMs空间和时间基础的改进方法,为动态环境中的更强大可靠的视觉智能铺平道路。
abstract_en: Vision language models (VLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in integrating linguistic and visual reasoning but remain fundamentally limited in understanding dynamic spatiotemporal interactions. Humans effortlessly track and reason about object movements, rotations, and perspective shifts--abilities essential for robust dynamic real-world understanding yet notably lacking in current VLMs. In this paper, we introduce VLM4D, the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the spatiotemporal reasoning capabilities of VLMs. Our benchmark comprises diverse real-world and synthetic videos accompanied by carefully curated question-answer pairs emphasizing translational and rotational motions, perspective awareness, and motion continuity. Through comprehensive evaluations of state-of-the-art open and closed-source VLMs, we identify significant performance gaps compared to human baselines, highlighting fundamental deficiencies in existing models. Extensive analysis reveals that VLMs struggle particularly with integrating multiple visual cues and maintaining temporal coherence. We further explore promising directions, such as leveraging 4D feature field reconstruction and targeted spatiotemporal supervised fine-tuning, demonstrating their effectiveness in enhancing spatiotemporal comprehension. Our work aims to encourage deeper exploration into improving VLMs' spatial and temporal grounding, paving the way towards more capable and reliable visual intelligence for dynamic environments.
authors: Shijie Zhou, Alexander Vilesov, Xuehai He, Ziyu Wan, Shuwang Zhang, Aditya Nagachandra, Di Chang, Dongdong Chen, Xin Eric Wang, Achuta Kadambi ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8600-8612

title: VLR-Driver:用于具身自动驾驶的大规模视觉-语言-推理模型
title_en: VLR-Driver: Large Vision-Language-Reasoning Models for Embodied Autonomous Driving
abstract: 具身智能与多模态大语言模型的兴起,推动了自动驾驶领域取得令人振奋的进展,使其成为学术界和工业界的重要研究方向。然而,当面对复杂且模糊的交通场景时,缺乏逻辑推理和认知决策能力仍然是制约具身自动驾驶实现的主要挑战。尽管视觉语言模型(VLMs)增强了自动驾驶系统的深度语义理解,但在处理罕见和长尾交通场景时,其决策可解释性仍存在显著局限。本文提出VLR-Driver,这是一种基于思维链(CoT)的新型多模态视觉-语言-推理(VLR)框架,专门用于具身自动驾驶。该框架采用时空思维链推理方法,递归分析其他智能体的潜在安全风险和驾驶意图,从而实现高效且透明的决策过程。此外,我们构建了一个多模态推理决策数据集,以支持自动驾驶中VLMs的层次化推理发展。在CARLA平台进行的闭环实验表明,VLR-Driver显著优于最先进的端到端方法。值得注意的是,驾驶得分关键指标提升了17.5%,成功率提升了22.2%,为自动驾驶系统提供了更透明、可靠且安全的解决方案。
abstract_en: The rise of embodied intelligence and multi-modal large language models has led to exciting advancements in the field of autonomous driving, establishing it as a prominent research focus in both academia and industry. However, when confronted with intricate and ambiguous traffic scenarios, the lack of logical reasoning and cognitive decision-making capabilities remains the primary challenge impeding the realization of embodied autonomous driving. Although Vision Language Models (VLMs) have enhanced the deep semantic understanding of autonomous driving systems, they exhibit notable limitations in decision explainability when handling rare and long-tail traffic scenarios. In this paper, we propose VLR-Driver, a novel multi-modal Vision-Language-Reasoning (VLR) framework based on Chain of Thought (CoT) for embodied autonomous driving. The framework employs a spatiotemporal CoT reasoning approach to recursively analyze potential safety risks and driving intentions of other agents, thereby delivering an efficient and transparent decision-making process. Furthermore, we construct a multi-modal reasoning-decision dataset to support the advancement of hierarchical reasoning of VLMs in autonomous driving. Closed-loop experiments conducted in CARLA demonstrate that the VLR-Driver significantly outperforms state-of-the-art end-to-end methods. Notably, key metrics such as driving score improved by 17.5%, while the success rate improved by 22.2%, offering a more transparent, reliable, and secure solution for autonomous driving systems.
authors: Fanjie Kong, Yitong Li, Weihuang Chen, Chen Min, Yizhe Li, Zhiqiang Gao, Haoyang Li, Zhongyu Guo, Hongbin Sun ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 26966-26976

title: VLRMBench:一个全面且具有挑战性的视觉-语言奖励模型基准测试
title_en: VLRMBench: A Comprehensive and Challenging Benchmark for Vision-Language Reward Models
abstract: 尽管大型视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)在多模态任务中表现出色,但推理过程中可能因偏差导致错误偶尔发生。近年来,奖励模型(RMs)在推理过程中变得越来越关键。具体而言,过程RMs评估每个推理步骤,结果RMs关注推理结果的评估,而批判性RMs则对整个推理过程进行错误分析并随后进行修正。然而,现有的视觉-语言奖励模型(VLRMs)基准测试通常仅评估其能力的单一方面(例如区分两个答案),从而限制了全面评估并制约了视觉-语言领域RMs的发展。为解决这一问题,我们提出一个全面且具有挑战性的基准测试,命名为VLRMBench,包含12,634个问题。VLRMBench基于三种类型的数据集构建,涵盖数学推理、幻觉理解和多图像理解。我们设计了涵盖三个主要类别的12项任务,重点评估VLRMs在过程理解、结果判断和批判性生成方面的表现。在21个开源模型和5个先进闭源模型上进行了大量实验,突显了VLRMBench带来的挑战。例如,在“预测未来”二分类任务中,先进的GPT-4o仅达到76.0%的准确率。代码可在https://github.com/JCruan519/VLRMBench获取。
abstract_en: Although large visual-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in multimodal tasks, errors may occasionally arise due to biases during the reasoning process. Recently, reward models (RMs) have become increasingly pivotal in the reasoning process. Specifically, process RMs evaluate each reasoning step, outcome RMs focus on the assessment of reasoning results, and critique RMs perform error analysis on the entire reasoning process, followed by corrections. However, existing benchmarks for vision-language RMs (VLRMs) typically assess only a single aspect of their capabilities (e.g., distinguishing between two answers), thus limiting the all-round evaluation and restricting the development of RMs in the visual-language domain. To address this gap, we propose a comprehensive and challenging benchmark, dubbed as VLRMBench, encompassing 12,634 questions. VLRMBench is constructed based on three distinct types of datasets, covering mathematical reasoning, hallucination understanding, and multi-image understanding. We design 12 tasks across three major categories, focusing on evaluating VLRMs in the aspects of process understanding, outcome judgment, and critique generation. Extensive experiments are conducted on 21 open-source models and 5 advanced closed-source models, highlighting the challenges posed by VLRMBench. For instance, in the `Forecasting Future', a binary classification task, the advanced GPT-4o achieves only a 76.0% accuracy. The code is available at https://github.com/JCruan519/VLRMBench.
authors: Jiacheng Ruan, Wenzhen Yuan, Xian Gao, Ye Guo, Daoxin Zhang, Zhe Xu, Yao Hu, Ting Liu, Yuzhuo Fu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3163-3173

title: VMBench:面向感知对齐的视频运动生成基准
title_en: VMBench: A Benchmark for Perception-Aligned Video Motion Generation
abstract: 视频生成技术已取得显著进展,评估方法不断完善,但对视频运动的评估仍面临重大挑战。具体而言,存在两个关键问题:1)现有运动指标未能充分与人类感知对齐;2)现有运动提示存在局限性。基于上述发现,我们提出VMBench——一个全面的视频运动基准,其运动指标与人类感知对齐,并包含最多样化的运动类型。VMBench具有以下优势:(1)感知驱动的运动评估指标,我们基于人类对运动视频的感知识别五个维度,开发细粒度评估指标,为模型运动质量的优劣提供更深入洞察。(2)元引导的运动提示生成,通过提取元信息,利用大语言模型生成多样化的运动提示,并通过人机验证进行优化,构建涵盖六个关键动态场景维度的多级提示库。(3)人类对齐的验证机制,我们提供人类偏好标注以验证基准,所提指标在斯皮尔曼相关系数上较基线方法平均提升35.3%。这是首次从人类感知对齐视角评估视频运动质量。此外,我们已在https://github.com/AMAP-ML/VMBench发布VMBench,为运动生成模型的评估与进步设立了新标准。
abstract_en: Video generation has advanced rapidly, improving evaluation methods, yet assessing video's motion remains a major challenge. Specifically, there are two key issues: 1) current motion metrics do not fully align with human perceptions; 2) the existing motion prompts are limited. Based these findings, we introduce VMBench--a comprehensive Video Motion Benchmark that has perception-aligned motion metrics and features the most diverse types of motion. VMBench has several appealing properties: (1) Perception-Driven Motion Evaluation Metrics, we identify five dimensions based on human perception in motion video assessment and develop fine-grained evaluation metrics, providing deeper insights into models' strengths and weaknesses in motion quality. (2) Meta-Guided Motion Prompt Generation, a structured method that extracts meta-information, generates diverse motion prompts with LLMs, and refines them through human-AI validation, resulting in a multi-level prompt library covering six key dynamic scene dimensions. (3) Human-Aligned Validation Mechanism, we provide human preference annotations to validate our benchmarks, with our metrics achieving an average 35.3% improvement in Spearman's correlation over baseline methods. This is the first time that the quality of motion in videos has been evaluated from the perspective of human perception alignment. Additionally, we release VMBench at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/VMBench, setting a new standard for evaluating and advancing motion generation models.
authors: Xinran Ling, Chen Zhu, Meiqi Wu, Hangyu Li, Xiaokun Feng, Cundian Yang, Aiming Hao, Jiashu Zhu, Jiahong Wu, Xiangxiang Chu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13087-13098

title: VMem:基于表面元素索引视图记忆的交互式视频场景生成
title_en: VMem: Consistent Interactive Video Scene Generation with Surfel-Indexed View Memory
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的记忆模块,用于构建能够交互式探索环境的视频生成器。先前方法要么通过外扩绘制场景的2D视图同时逐步重建其3D几何结构(这会迅速积累误差),要么使用上下文窗口较短的视频生成器,难以在长时序中保持场景连贯性。为解决这些局限性,我们引入了基于表面元素(surfels)几何索引的视图记忆(Surfel-Indexed View Memory,VMem),该记忆模块通过基于观测到的3D表面元素对过往视图进行几何索引以记录历史视图。VMem在生成新视图时能够高效检索最相关的过往视图。通过仅关注这些相关视图,我们的方法以远低于使用所有过往视图作为上下文所需的计算成本,实现了对想象环境的一致探索。我们在具有挑战性的长期场景合成基准测试中评估了我们的方法,并在保持场景连贯性和摄像机控制方面展现出优于现有方法的性能。
abstract_en: We propose a novel memory module for building video generators capable of interactively exploring environments. Previous approaches have achieved similar results either by out-painting 2D views of a scene while incrementally reconstructing its 3D geometry--which quickly accumulates errors--or by using video generators with a short context window, which struggle to maintain scene coherence over the long term. To address these limitations, we introduce Surfel-Indexed View Memory (VMem), a memory module that remembers past views by indexing them geometrically based on the 3D surface elements (surfels) they have observed. VMem enables efficient retrieval of the most relevant past views when generating new ones. By focusing only on these relevant views, our method produces consistent explorations of imagined environments at a fraction of the computational cost required to use all past views as context. We evaluate our approach on challenging long-term scene synthesis benchmarks and demonstrate superior performance compared to existing methods in maintaining scene coherence and camera control.
authors: Runjia Li, Philip Torr, Andrea Vedaldi, Tomas Jakab ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 25690-25699

title: VOVTrack:探索原始视频在开放词汇多目标跟踪中的潜力
title_en: VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in Raw Videos for Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking
abstract: 开放词汇多目标跟踪(OVMOT)代表了一个关键的新挑战,涉及在视频中检测和跟踪多样化的物体类别,包括已知类别(基础类别)和未知类别(新类别)。该问题融合了开放词汇目标检测(OVD)和多目标跟踪(MOT)的复杂性。现有OVMOT方法通常将OVD和MOT方法作为独立模块进行融合,未能充分挖掘视频信息。本文提出VOVTrack,一种新颖方法,通过整合与MOT相关的物体状态和以视频为中心的训练,从视频分析视角解决这一挑战。首先,我们在跟踪过程中考虑物体的跟踪相关状态,提出新的提示引导注意力机制以实现时变物体更精确的检测(定位与分类)。随后,我们通过构建自监督目标相似性学习技术,利用未标注的原始视频数据进行训练,以促进时序物体跟踪(关联)。实验结果表明,VOVTrack在开放词汇跟踪任务中建立了最先进的解决方案。
abstract_en: Open-vocabulary multi-object tracking (OVMOT) represents a critical new challenge involving the detection and tracking of diverse object categories in videos, encompassing both seen categories (base classes) and unseen categories (novel classes). This issue amalgamates the complexities of open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) and multi-object tracking (MOT). Existing approaches to OVMOT often merge OVD and MOT methodologies as separate modules, not fully leveraging the video information. In this work, we propose VOVTrack, a novel method that integrates object states relevant to MOT and video-centric training to address this challenge from a video analysis standpoint. First, we consider the tracking-related state of the objects during tracking and propose a new prompt-guided attention mechanism for more accurate detection (localization and classification) of time-varying objects. Subsequently, we leverage raw video data without annotations for training by formulating a self-supervised object similarity learning technique to facilitate temporal object tracking (association). Experimental results underscore that VOVTrack establishes itself as a state-of-the-art solution for the open-vocabulary tracking task.
authors: Zekun Qian, Ruize Han, Junhui Hou, Linqi Song, Wei Feng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7472-7482

title: VOccl3D: 一种用于真实遮挡下三维人体姿态和形状估计的视频基准数据集
title_en: VOccl3D: A Video Benchmark Dataset for 3D Human Pose and Shape Estimation under real Occlusions
abstract: 人体姿态和形状(HPS)估计方法已得到广泛研究,许多方法在野外图像和视频上展现出高零样本性能。然而,这些方法在涉及复杂人体姿态或显著遮挡的挑战性场景中往往表现不佳。尽管一些研究针对遮挡下的三维人体姿态估计进行了探索,但它们通常在缺乏真实或显著遮挡的基准数据集上进行评估,例如,大多数现有数据集通过在人体上随机覆盖补丁或使用剪贴画风格叠加物引入遮挡,这可能无法反映现实世界中的挑战。为弥合真实遮挡数据集的不足,我们引入了一个新颖的基准数据集VOccl3D,这是一个基于视频的人体遮挡数据集,包含三维人体姿态和形状标注。受AGORA和BEDLAM等工作的启发,我们采用先进的计算机图形渲染技术构建了该数据集,融合了多样化的现实遮挡场景、服装纹理和人体动作。此外,我们在该数据集上微调了近期的HPS方法CLIFF和BEDLAM-CLIFF,展示了在多个公开数据集以及我们数据集测试分割上的显著定性和定量改进,同时与其它最先进方法进行性能对比。此外,我们利用该数据集通过微调现有目标检测器YOLO11来提升遮挡下的目标检测性能,从而构建了一个鲁棒的端到端HPS估计系统。总体而言,该数据集为未来旨在评估遮挡处理方法的研究提供了宝贵的资源,提供了比现有遮挡数据集更现实的替代方案。
abstract_en: Human pose and shape (HPS) estimation methods have been extensively studied, with many demonstrating high zero-shot performance on in-the-wild images and videos. However, these methods often struggle in challenging scenarios involving complex human poses or significant occlusions. Although some studies address 3D human pose estimation under occlusion, they typically evaluate performance on datasets that lack realistic or substantial occlusions, e.g., most existing datasets introduce occlusions with random patches over the human or clipart-style overlays, which may not reflect real-world challenges. To bridge this gap in realistic occlusion datasets, we introduce a novel benchmark dataset, VOccl3D, a Video-based human Occlusion dataset with 3D body pose and shape annotations. Inspired by works such as AGORA and BEDLAM, we constructed this dataset using advanced computer graphics rendering techniques, incorporating diverse real-world occlusion scenarios, clothing textures, and human motions. Additionally, we fine-tuned recent HPS methods, CLIFF and BEDLAM-CLIFF, on our dataset, demonstrating significant qualitative and quantitative improvements across multiple public datasets, as well as on the test split of our dataset, while comparing its performance with other state-of-the-art methods. Furthermore, we leveraged our dataset to enhance human detection performance under occlusion by fine-tuning an existing object detector, YOLO11, thus leading to a robust end-to-end HPS estimation system under occlusions. Overall, this dataset serves as a valuable resource for future research aimed at benchmarking methods designed to handle occlusions, offering a more realistic alternative to existing occlusion datasets.
authors: Yash Garg, Saketh Bachu, Arindam Dutta, Rohit Lal, Sarosij Bose, Calvin-Khang Ta, M. Salman Asif, Amit Roy-Chowdhury ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7350-7360

title: VPO:基于提示优化的文本到视频生成模型对齐
title_en: VPO: Aligning Text-to-Video Generation Models with Prompt Optimization
abstract: 视频生成模型在文本到视频任务中取得了显著进展。这些模型通常在高度详细且精心设计的文本-视频配对数据上进行训练,而推理过程中真实用户的输入往往简短、模糊或结构松散。这种差距使得提示优化对于生成高质量视频至关重要。当前方法通常依赖大语言模型(LLMs)通过上下文学习优化提示,但存在诸多局限:可能扭曲用户意图、遗漏关键细节或引入安全风险。此外,这些方法在优化提示时未考虑对最终视频质量的影响,可能导致次优结果。为解决这些问题,我们提出VPO,一个基于三个核心原则(无害性、准确性和有用性)的框架。生成的提示忠实保留用户意图,更重要的是提升了生成视频的安全性与质量。为实现这一目标,VPO采用两阶段优化方法。首先,我们基于安全性和对齐原则构建并优化监督微调(SFT)数据集。其次,引入文本级和视频级反馈,通过偏好学习进一步优化SFT模型。大量实验表明,VPO在安全、对齐和视频质量方面显著优于基线方法。此外,VPO在不同视频生成模型上展现出强泛化能力。进一步研究表明,VPO可超越并结合RLHF方法,凸显其在对齐视频生成模型中的有效性。我们的代码和数据已开源,详见https://github.com/thu-coai/VPO。
abstract_en: Video generation models have achieved remarkable progress in text-to-video tasks. These models are typically trained on text-video pairs with highly detailed and carefully crafted descriptions, while real-world user inputs during inference are often concise, vague, or poorly structured. This gap makes prompt optimization crucial for generating high-quality videos. Current methods often rely on large language models (LLMs) to refine prompts through in-context learning, but suffer from several limitations: they may distort user intent, omit critical details, or introduce safety risks. Moreover, they optimize prompts without considering the impact on the final video quality, which can lead to suboptimal results. To address these issues, we introduce VPO, a principled framework that optimizes prompts based on three core principles: harmlessness, accuracy, and helpfulness. The generated prompts faithfully preserve user intents and, more importantly, enhance the safety and quality of generated videos. To achieve this, VPO employs a two-stage optimization approach. First, we construct and refine a supervised fine-tuning (SFT) dataset based on principles of safety and alignment. Second, we introduce both text-level and video-level feedback to further optimize the SFT model with preference learning. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that VPO significantly improves safety, alignment, and video quality compared to baseline methods. Moreover, VPO shows strong generalization across video generation models. Furthermore, we demonstrate that VPO could outperform and be combined with RLHF methods on video generation models, underscoring the effectiveness of VPO in aligning video generation models. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/thu-coai/VPO.
authors: Jiale Cheng, Ruiliang Lyu, Xiaotao Gu, Xiao Liu, Jiazheng Xu, Yida Lu, Jiayan Teng, Zhuoyi Yang, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang, Hongning Wang, Minlie Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15636-15645

title: VPR-Cloak:首次探讨视觉地点识别中的隐私遮蔽技术
title_en: VPR-Cloak: A First Look at Privacy Cloak Against Visual Place Recognition
abstract: 随着视觉地点识别(VPR)系统的快速发展,其在社交媒体图像中的未经授权使用使得监控个人日常活动成为可能,带来了严重的隐私风险。然而,针对VPR系统中这些风险的隐私保护仍是一个研究不足的领域。尽管对抗性扰动已被广泛用于视觉隐私保护,现有方法仍难以同时满足现实VPR隐私保护场景中所需的黑盒约束、不可察觉性和实时性能要求。本文首次探讨VPR系统的隐私保护方法,提出VPR-Cloak,一种高效的隐私保护网络。我们引入显著性感知先验以识别对地点识别至关重要的区域,并提出显著性感知先验引导的扰动优化(SAP-PO)方法,选择性地优化这些区域的扰动生成。为进一步增强不可察觉性,我们在频域中进一步优化扰动,细致调整扰动的高频成分,同时保留对人类感知至关重要的低频结构。大量实验验证了我们的方法优于现有最先进的方法(SOTA)。此外,我们的方法在运行时间上比SOTA方法快15倍。我们在Google和Microsoft Bing上进行了验证,证明了其在现实场景中的实用性。代码已开源至https://github.com/Dilemma-CMZ/VPR-Cloak。
abstract_en: With the rapid advancement of Visual Place Recognition (VPR) systems, their unauthorized use on social media images enables monitoring of individuals' daily movements, posing serious privacy risks. However, privacy protection for addressing these risks in VPR systems remains an underexplored area. While adversarial perturbations have been widely explored for visual privacy protection, existing methods still fail to simultaneously satisfy the black-box constraint, imperceptibility, and real-time performance required in realistic VPR privacy protection scenarios. In this paper, we present the first look at privacy protection in VPR systems and introduce VPR-Cloak, an efficient privacy-preserving network. We introduce a saliency-aware prior to identify decisive regions for place recognition and propose Saliency-Aware Prior Guided Perturbation Optimization (SAP-PO) to selectively optimize perturbation generation in these areas. To enhance imperceptibility, we further optimize perturbations in the frequency domain, meticulously refining high-frequency components of perturbations while preserving low-frequency structures essential for human perception. Extensive experiments verify that our method outperforms existing SOTA methods. Additionally, our method achieves a 15x speedup in runtime compared to SOTA methods. We also validate on Google and Microsoft Bing, demonstrating the practical applicability in real-world scenarios. The code is released at https://github.com/Dilemma-CMZ/VPR-Cloak.
authors: Shuting Dong, Mingzhi Chen, Feng Lu, Hao Yu, Guanghao Li, Zhe Wu, Ming Tang, Chun Yuan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 7197-7208

title: VQ-SGen:一种用于创意草图生成的向量量化笔画表示法
title_en: VQ-SGen: A Vector Quantized Stroke Representation for Creative Sketch Generation
abstract: 本文提出VQ-SGen,一种用于高质量创意草图生成的新算法。近期方法将该任务框架为基于像素的生成,要么整体生成,要么分部分生成,忽视了单个笔画之间的内在和上下文关系,例如邻近和远处笔画的形状与空间定位。为克服这些局限性,我们提出将每个草图中的笔画视为实体,并引入向量量化(VQ)笔画表示法以实现细粒度草图生成。我们的方法采用两阶段框架——第一阶段,我们将每个笔画的形状和位置信息解耦,确保VQ表示优先学习笔画形状。第二阶段,我们将精确且紧凑的表示输入自解码Transformer,将笔画语义、位置和形状融入生成过程。通过利用标记化的笔画表示,我们的方法生成高保真度的笔画,并支持新颖应用,如文本或类别标签条件生成和草图补全。全面实验表明,我们的方法在CreativeSketch数据集上超越现有最先进技术,凸显其有效性。
abstract_en: This paper presents VQ-SGen, a novel algorithm for high-quality creative sketch generation. Recent approaches have framed the task as pixel-based generation either as a whole or part-by-part, neglecting the intrinsic and contextual relationships among individual strokes, such as the shape and spatial positioning of both proximal and distant strokes. To overcome these limitations, we propose treating each stroke within a sketch as an entity and introducing a vector-quantized (VQ) stroke representation for fine-grained sketch generation. Our method follows a two-stage framework - in stage one, we decouple each stroke's shape and location information to ensure the VQ representation prioritizes stroke shape learning. In stage two, we feed the precise and compact representation into an auto-decoding Transformer to incorporate stroke semantics, positions, and shapes into the generation process. By utilizing tokenized stroke representation, our approach generates strokes with high fidelity and facilitates novel applications, such as text or class label conditioned generation and sketch completion. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate our method surpasses existing state-of-the-art techniques on the CreativeSketch dataset, underscoring its effectiveness.
authors: Jiawei Wang, Zhiming Cui, Changjian Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19311-19320

title: VQ-VLA: 通过扩展向量量化动作标记器提升视觉-语言-动作模型
title_en: VQ-VLA: Improving Vision-Language-Action Models via Scaling Vector-Quantized Action Tokenizers
abstract: 本文提出了一种基于向量量化的创新动作标记器,该标记器建立在迄今为止最大规模的动作轨迹数据集之上,其数据量超过以往方法的100倍以上。这一广泛的数据集使我们的标记器能够捕捉丰富的时空动态,从而构建出不仅加速推理过程,还能生成更平滑、更连贯动作输出的模型。训练完成后,该标记器可无缝适配于多种下游任务,以零样本方式从短时域反应行为到长时域规划均能有效应用。我们的关键发现是,合成与真实动作轨迹之间的领域差距较小,这使得我们能够在训练过程中有效利用大量合成数据,而不会影响现实世界性能。为验证我们的方法,我们在模拟环境和真实机器人平台上进行了大量实验。结果表明,随着合成轨迹数据量的增加,我们的标记器在下游任务中的性能显著提升——特别是在长时域场景下,两个现实任务的成功率最高可提升30%。这些发现凸显了我们的动作标记器作为实时具身智能系统稳健且可扩展解决方案的潜力,为在多样化应用领域实现更高效可靠的机器人控制铺平了道路。
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce an innovative vector quantization based action tokenizer built upon the largest-scale action trajectory dataset to date, leveraging over 100 times more data than previous approaches. This extensive dataset enables our tokenizer to capture rich spatiotemporal dynamics, resulting in a model that not only accelerates inference but also generates smoother and more coherent action outputs. Once trained, the tokenizer can be seamlessly adapted to a wide range of downstream tasks in a zero-shot manner, from short-horizon reactive behaviors to long-horizon planning. A key finding of our work is that the domain gap between synthetic and real action trajectories is marginal, allowing us to effectively utilize a vast amount of synthetic data during training without compromising real-world performance. To validate our approach, we conducted extensive experiments in both simulated environments and on real robotic platforms. The results demonstrate that as the volume of synthetic trajectory data increases, the performance of our tokenizer on downstream tasks improves significantly-most notably, achieving up to a 30% higher success rate on two real-world tasks in long-horizon scenarios. These findings highlight the potential of our action tokenizer as a robust and scalable solution for real-time embodied intelligence systems, paving the way for more efficient and reliable robotic control in diverse application domains.
authors: Yating Wang, Haoyi Zhu, Mingyu Liu, Jiange Yang, Hao-Shu Fang, Tong He ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 11089-11099

title: VRBench:长叙事视频中的多步骤推理基准
title_en: VRBench: A Benchmark for Multi-Step Reasoning in Long Narrative Videos
abstract: 我们提出VRBench,这是首个针对长叙事视频设计的多步骤推理基准,旨在评估大模型的多步骤推理能力,解决现有评估方法忽视时间推理和程序有效性的局限性。该基准包含960个长视频(平均时长1.6小时),以及8,243个人标注的多步骤问答对和25,106个带时间戳的推理步骤。这些视频通过多阶段筛选流程进行精选,包括专家间评分审查以确保情节连贯性。我们开发了一个人机协作框架,生成需要多个时间锚定步骤的连贯推理链,涵盖七种类型(如事件归因、隐含推断)。VRBench设计了多阶段评估流程,从结果和过程两个层面评估模型。除最终结果的多项选择题外,我们提出了一种进度级LLM引导评分指标,从多维度全面评估推理链的质量。通过对12个LLMs和19个VLMs在VRBench上的广泛评估,我们进行了深入分析,提供了有价值的见解,推动了多步骤推理领域的发展。
abstract_en: We present VRBench, the first long narrative video benchmark crafted for evaluating large models' multi-step reasoning capabilities, addressing limitations in existing evaluations that overlook temporal reasoning and procedural validity. It comprises 960 long videos (with an average duration of 1.6 hours), along with 8,243 human-labeled multi-step question-answering pairs and 25,106 reasoning steps with timestamps. These videos are curated via a multi-stage filtering process including expert inter-rater reviewing to prioritize plot coherence. We develop a human-AI collaborative framework that generates coherent reasoning chains, each requiring multiple temporally grounded steps, spanning seven types (e.g., event attribution, implicit inference). VRBench designs a multi-phase evaluation pipeline that assesses models at both the outcome and process levels. Apart from the MCQs for the final results, we propose a progress-level LLM-guided scoring metric to evaluate the quality of the reasoning chain from multiple dimensions comprehensively. Through extensive evaluations of 12 LLMs and 19 VLMs on VRBench, we undertake a thorough analysis and provide valuable insights that advance the field of multi-step reasoning.
authors: Jiashuo Yu, Yue Wu, Meng Chu, Zhifei Ren, Zizheng Huang, Pei Chu, Ruijie Zhang, Yinan He, Qirui Li, Songze Li, Zhenxiang Li, Zhongying Tu, Conghui He, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Yi Wang, Limin Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21655-21666

title: VRM: 通过虚拟关系匹配的知识蒸馏
title_en: VRM: Knowledge Distillation via Virtual Relation Matching
abstract: 知识蒸馏(KD)旨在将更强大但复杂的教师模型知识转移到轻量级的学生模型中。近年来,基于关系的KD方法逐渐落后,因为其实例匹配的对应方法在性能上占据主导地位。在本文中,我们通过识别并解决基于关系方法中的几个关键问题来复兴关系知识蒸馏,包括其对过拟合和虚假响应的易感性。具体而言,我们通过利用虚拟视图和关系,将新颖构建的亲和力图作为新型知识,这些亲和力图紧凑地封装了大量有益的样本间、类别间和视图间相关性。因此,学生在蒸馏过程中能够获得更丰富的指导信号和更强的正则化。为进一步减轻虚假响应的不利影响,我们通过动态断开冗余和不可靠的边来修剪亲和力图。在CIFAR-100、ImageNet和MS-COCO数据集上的大量实验表明,所提出的虚拟关系匹配(VRM)方法具有优越性能,在多种模型、架构、任务和设置中持续刷新最佳记录。例如,VRM在ImageNet上首次达到ResNet50到MobileNetV2蒸馏的74.0%准确率,并在ResNet56教师模型下将DeiT-T在CIFAR-100上的性能提升14.44%。
abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) aims to transfer the knowledge of a more capable yet cumbersome teacher model to a lightweight student model. In recent years, relation-based KD methods have fallen behind, as their instance-matching counterparts dominate in performance. In this paper, we revive relational KD by identifying and tackling several key issues in relation-based methods, including their susceptibility to overfitting and spurious responses. Specifically, we transfer novelly constructed affinity graphs that compactly encapsulate a wealth of beneficial inter-sample, inter-class, and inter-view correlations by exploiting virtual views and relations as a new kind of knowledge. As a result, the student has access to richer guidance signals and stronger regularisation throughout the distillation process. To further mitigate the adverse impact of spurious responses, we prune the affinity graphs by dynamically detaching redundant and unreliable edges. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-100, ImageNet, and MS-COCO datasets demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed virtual relation matching (VRM) method, where it consistently sets new state-of-the-art records over a range of models, architectures, tasks, and set-ups. For instance, VRM for the first time hits 74.0% accuracy for ResNet50-to-MobileNetV2 distillation on ImageNet, and improves DeiT-T by 14.44% on CIFAR-100 with a ResNet56 teacher.
authors: Weijia Zhang, Fei Xie, Weidong Cai, Chao Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2707-2717

title: VSC:基于视觉搜索的组合式文本到图像扩散模型
title_en: VSC: Visual Search Compositional Text-to-Image Diffusion Model
abstract: 文本到图像扩散模型在从自然语言提示生成逼真视觉效果方面展现出显著能力,但往往难以准确绑定属性与对应对象,尤其是在包含多个属性-对象对的提示中。这一挑战主要源于常用文本编码器(如CLIP)的局限性,这些编码器难以有效编码复杂的语言关系和修饰语。现有方法通过推理过程中的注意力图控制、布局信息或训练阶段的微调来缓解这些问题,但在提示复杂度增加时仍面临性能下降。本文提出了一种新颖的组合生成方法,利用成对图像嵌入提升属性-对象绑定效果。我们的方法将复杂提示分解为子提示,生成相应图像并计算视觉原型,通过与文本嵌入融合以增强表示。通过基于分割的定位训练,我们解决了跨注意力错位问题,实现了多属性与对象绑定的准确率提升。我们的方法在基准测试T2I CompBench上超越现有组合式文本到图像扩散模型,实现更优的人类评估图像质量,并在提示中绑定对数量扩展时展现出更强的鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models have shown impressive capabilities in generating realistic visuals from natural-language prompts, yet they often struggle with accurately binding attributes to corresponding objects, especially in prompts containing multiple attribute-object pairs. This challenge primarily arises from the limitations of commonly used text encoders, such as CLIP, which can fail to encode complex linguistic relationships and modifiers effectively. Existing approaches have attempted to mitigate these issues through attention map control during inference and the use of layout information or fine-tuning during training, yet they face performance drops with increased prompt complexity. In this work, we introduce a novel compositional generation method that leverages pairwise image embeddings to improve attribute-object binding. Our approach decomposes complex prompts into sub-prompts, generates corresponding images, and computes visual prototypes that fuse with text embeddings to enhance representation. By applying segmentation-based localization training, we address cross-attention misalignment, achieving improved accuracy in binding multiple attributes to objects. Our approaches outperform existing compositional text-to-image diffusion models on the benchmark T2I CompBench, achieving better image quality, evaluated by humans, and emerging robustness under scaling the number of binding pairs in the prompt.
authors: Do Huu Dat, Nam Hyeon-Woo, Po-Yuan Mao, Tae-Hyun Oh ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19153-19162

title: VSP:诊断多模态大语言模型在空间规划任务中的感知与推理双重挑战
title_en: VSP: Diagnosing the Dual Challenges of Perception and Reasoning in Spatial Planning Tasks for MLLMs
abstract: 多模态大语言模型是新兴的语言模型(LM)类别,其将经典LM能力与图像处理系统能力相结合。然而,这些能力如何整合往往并不直观,需要直接研究。多模态大语言模型中一个未被充分研究的能力是视觉空间规划——理解物体的空间排列并制定行动计划以实现视觉场景中的目标结果。鉴于其在其他多样化场景中的成功表现,为何在这些通常被认为是人类易处理的任务上表现不足仍不清楚。为此,我们引入VSP基准测试,1)评估多模态大语言模型在空间规划任务中的通用能力,2)通过更细粒度的子任务(包括感知与推理)诊断该能力,并通过这些子任务衡量模型能力。我们的评估证实,开源和私有多模态大语言模型甚至在简单空间规划任务中也难以生成有效计划。在细粒度分析任务上的评估进一步揭示了模型在视觉感知中的根本缺陷和推理能力的瓶颈,解释了其在通用空间规划任务中表现不佳的原因。我们的工作为提升多模态大语言模型的空间规划能力指明了未来方向。我们的基准测试已公开可用。
abstract_en: Multimodal large language models are an exciting emerging class of language models (LMs) that have merged classic LM capabilities with those of image processing systems. However, how these capabilities integrate is often not intuitive and warrants direct investigation. One understudied capability in MLLMs is visual spatial planning---the ability to comprehend the spatial arrangements of objects and devise action plans to achieve desired outcomes in visual scenes. It is unclear why MLLMs fall short on these tasks generally considered easy for humans, given their successes across other diverse scenarios. To this end, we introduce VSP, a benchmark that 1) evaluates the spatial planning capability in MLLMs in general, and 2) diagnoses this capability via finer-grained sub-tasks, including perception and reasoning, and measure the capabilities of models through these sub-tasks. Our evaluation confirms that both open-source and private MLLMs fail to generate effective plans for even simple spatial planning tasks. Evaluations on the fine-grained analytical tasks further reveal fundamental deficiencies in the models' visual perception and bottlenecks in reasoning abilities, explaining their worse performance in the general spatial planning tasks. Our work illuminates future directions for improving MLLMs' abilities in spatial planning. Our benchmark is publicly available.
authors: Qiucheng Wu, Handong Zhao, Michael Saxon, Trung Bui, William Yang Wang, Yang Zhang, Shiyu Chang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2270-2280

title: VSRM:一种基于Mamba的鲁棒视频超分辨率框架
title_en: VSRM: A Robust Mamba-Based Framework for Video Super-Resolution
abstract: 视频超分辨率仍是低层次视觉任务中的重大挑战。迄今为止,基于卷积神经网络(CNN)和Transformer的方法已取得显著成果。然而,CNN受限于局部感受野,而Transformer则面临二次复杂度问题,这给视频超分辨率(VSR)中长序列处理带来了挑战。近期,Mamba因其长序列建模能力、线性复杂度和大感受野受到关注。在本工作中,我们提出VSRM,一种新型视频超分辨率框架,利用Mamba的强大能力。VSRM引入了空间到时间Mamba模块和时间到空间Mamba模块,以高效提取长程时空特征并增强感受野。为更好地对齐相邻帧,我们提出可变形跨Mamba对齐模块。该模块采用可变形跨Mamba机制,使补偿阶段更加动态灵活,防止特征失真。最后,我们通过提出一种简单而有效的频率域Charbonnier类损失函数,最小化重建帧与真实帧之间的频率域差异,更好地保留高频内容并提升视觉质量。通过大量实验,VSRM在多个基准数据集上取得了最先进的结果,为未来研究奠定了坚实基础。
abstract_en: Video super-resolution remains a significant challenge in low-level vision tasks. To date, CNN- and Transformer-based methods have delivered impressive results. However, CNNs are limited by local receptive fields, while Transformers struggle with quadratic complexity, posing challenges for processing long sequences in VSR. Recently, Mamba has drawn attention for its long-sequence modeling, linear complexity, and large receptive fields. In this work, we propose VSRM, a novel Video Super-Resolution framework that leverages the power of Mamba. VSRM introduces Spatial-to-Temporal Mamba and Temporal-to-Spatial Mamba blocks to extract long-range spatio-temporal features and enhance receptive fields efficiently. To better align adjacent frames, we propose Deformable Cross-Mamba Alignment module. This module utilizes a deformable cross-mamba mechanism to make the compensation stage more dynamic and flexible, preventing feature distortions. Finally, we minimize the frequency domain gaps between reconstructed and ground-truth frames by proposing a simple yet effective Frequency Charbonnier-like loss that better preserves high-frequency content and enhances visual quality. Through extensive experiments, VSRM achieves state-of-the-art results on diverse benchmarks, establishing itself as a solid foundation for future research.
authors: Dinh Phu Tran, Dao Duy Hung, Daeyoung Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 14711-14721

title: VSSD:基于非因果状态空间对偶性的视觉Mamba
title_en: VSSD: Vision Mamba with Non-Causal State Space Duality
abstract: 视觉Transformer在计算机视觉领域取得了显著进展,提供了强大的建模能力和全局感受野。然而,其高计算需求限制了其在处理长序列时的应用。为解决这一问题,状态空间模型(SSMs)在视觉任务中受到重视,因其具有线性计算复杂度。最近,状态空间对偶性(SSD)作为SSMs的改进变体被引入Mamba2以提升模型性能和效率。然而,SSD/SSMs的固有因果性限制了其在非因果视觉任务中的应用。为解决这一局限性,我们提出视觉状态空间对偶性(VSSD)模型,其采用非因果格式的SSD。具体而言,我们提出在保留隐藏状态与token相对权重的同时丢弃二者交互的绝对值,从而缓解token贡献对先前token的依赖。结合多扫描策略的参与,我们证明扫描结果可被整合以实现非因果性,这不仅提升了SSD在视觉任务中的性能,也增强了其效率。我们在包括图像分类、检测和分割在内的多个基准数据集上进行了大量实验,结果表明VSSD超越了现有的基于SSM的最先进模型。代码已开源至https://github.com/YuHengsss/VSSD。
abstract_en: Vision transformers have significantly advanced the field of computer vision, offering robust modeling capabilities and global receptive field. However, their high computational demands limit their applicability in processing long sequences. To tackle this issue, State Space Models (SSMs) have gained prominence in vision tasks as they offer linear computational complexity. Recently, State Space Duality (SSD), an improved variant of SSMs, was introduced in Mamba2 to enhance model performance and efficiency. However, the inherent causal nature of SSD/SSMs restricts their applications in non-causal vision tasks. To address this limitation, we introduce Visual State Space Duality (VSSD) model, which has a non-causal format of SSD. Specifically, we propose to discard the magnitude of interactions between the hidden state and tokens while preserving their relative weights, which relieves the dependencies of token contribution on previous tokens. Together with the involvement of multi-scan strategies, we show that the scanning results can be integrated to achieve non-causality, which not only improves the performance of SSD in vision tasks but also enhances its efficiency. We conduct extensive experiments on various benchmarks including image classification, detection, and segmentation, where VSSD surpasses existing state-of-the-art SSM-based models. Code is available at https://github.com/YuHengsss/VSSD.
authors: Yuheng Shi, Mingjia Li, Minjing Dong, Chang Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10819-10829

title: VTimeCoT: 通过绘图进行视频时序定位与推理
title_en: VTimeCoT: Thinking by Drawing for Video Temporal Grounding and Reasoning
abstract: 近年来,基于多模态大语言模型(MLLM)的视频问答技术因其在大语言模型(LLM)领域取得的显著进展而受到广泛关注。然而,这些模型在视频时序定位与推理领域存在明显不足,制约了高效现实视频理解系统的开发。受人类通过视频播放器与进度条交互以理解视频的启发,我们提出VTimeCoT,一个简单而有效的无训练框架,专为高性能视频定位与推理设计。该框架引入了两种新颖的视觉工具:插件式进度条集成工具和高效高亮工具。此外,为解决传统基于文本的思维链(CoT)方法的局限性,我们提出了一种融合视频与文本跨模态推理的视觉时序CoT过程。我们的方法在Qwen2VL-7B和GPT4o基线模型上,于视频时序定位与基于推理的问答任务中表现出显著性能提升。最后,我们展示了该框架实现了可组合且可解释的推理过程。项目页面:\href https://vtimecot.github.io https://vtimecot.github.io .
abstract_en: In recent years, video question answering based on multimodal large language models (MLLM) has garnered considerable attention, due to the benefits from the substantial advancements in LLMs. However, these models have a notable deficiency in the domains of video temporal grounding and reasoning, posing challenges to the development of effective real-world video understanding systems. Inspired by how humans use video players to interact with the progress bar for video comprehension, we introduce VTimeCoT, a simple yet effective training-free framework, designed for high-performance video grounding and reasoning. The proposed framework incorporates two novel visual tools of the progress bar: a plug-and-play progress bar integration tool and a high-efficiency highlighting tool. In addition, to address the limitations of conventional text-based chain-of-thought (CoT) approaches, we introduce a visuotemporal CoT process that integrates cross-modality reasoning across both video and text. Our approach demonstrates significant performance improvements on both Qwen2VL-7B and GPT4o baselines in tasks of video temporal grounding and reasoning-based question answering. Finally, we showcase that the proposed framework achieves a compositional and interpretable reasoning process. Project page: \href https://vtimecot.github.io  https://vtimecot.github.io .
authors: Jinglei Zhang, Yuanfan Guo, Rolandos Alexandros Potamias, Jiankang Deng, Hang Xu, Chao Ma ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24203-24213

title: VAMBA:基于混合Mamba-Transformer模型理解一小时长视频
title_en: Vamba: Understanding Hour-Long Videos with Hybrid Mamba-Transformers
abstract: 基于Transformer的最先进大型多模态模型(LMMs)由于因果自注意力操作的二次复杂度,难以处理一小时长视频输入,导致训练和推理过程中的高计算成本。现有基于令牌压缩的方法虽能减少视频令牌数量,但常伴随信息损失且对超长序列仍不够高效。本文探索了另一条正交路径,构建了混合Mamba-Transformer模型(VAMBA),采用Mamba-2块以线性复杂度编码视频令牌。无需任何令牌减少,VAMBA可在单个GPU上编码超过1024帧(640x360)视频,而基于Transformer的模型仅能编码256帧。在长视频输入场景下,VAMBA在训练和推理过程中GPU内存使用量减少至少50%,且每个训练步骤的速度较基于Transformer的LMMs提升近一倍。实验结果表明,VAMBA在具有挑战性的小时长视频理解基准LVBench上,相比先前高效的视频LMMs准确率提升了4.3%,并在广泛长短视频理解任务中保持了强劲性能。
abstract_en: State-of-the-art transformer-based large multimodal models (LMMs) struggle to handle hour-long video inputs due to the quadratic complexity of the causal self-attention operations, leading to high computational costs during training and inference. Existing token compression-based methods reduce the number of video tokens but often incur information loss and remain inefficient for extremely long sequences. In this paper, we explore an orthogonal direction to build a hybrid Mamba-Transformer model (VAMBA) that employs Mamba-2 blocks to encode video tokens with linear complexity. Without any token reduction, VAMBA can encode more than 1024 frames (640x360) on a single GPU, while transformer-based models can only encode 256 frames. On long video input, VAMBA achieves at least 50% reduction in GPU memory usage during training and inference, and nearly doubles the speed per training step compared to transformer-based LMMs. Our experimental results demonstrate that VAMBA improves accuracy by 4.3% on the challenging hour-long video understanding benchmark LVBench over prior efficient video LMMs, and maintains strong performance on a broad spectrum of long and short video understanding tasks.
authors: Weiming Ren, Wentao Ma, Huan Yang, Cong Wei, Ge Zhang, Wenhu Chen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21197-21208

title: 基于方差的剪枝:加速与压缩训练网络的方法
title_en: Variance-Based Pruning for Accelerating and Compressing Trained Networks
abstract: 随着视觉Transformer等更大模型的训练成本不断增加,复用已训练的大量先进网络库成为必要。然而,其延迟、高计算成本和内存需求对部署构成显著挑战,尤其是在资源受限的硬件上。虽然结构化剪枝方法可以降低这些因素,但通常需要代价高昂的重新训练,有时甚至需数百个epoch或从头开始训练以恢复因结构修改而损失的精度。保持结构化剪枝后已训练模型的性能并避免大量重新训练仍是一个挑战。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种简单且结构化的单次剪枝技术——基于方差的剪枝,可高效压缩网络并仅需少量微调。我们的方法首先收集激活统计信息,随后利用这些统计信息选择剪枝神经元。同时,将均值激活重新整合回模型中以保持高性能。在ImageNet-1k识别任务中,我们证明直接剪枝后DeiT-Base仍保留超过70%的原始性能,仅需10个epoch的微调即可恢复99%的原始精度,同时将MACs减少35%、模型尺寸减少36%,从而将模型速度提升1.44倍。
abstract_en: Increasingly expensive training of ever larger models such as Vision Transfomers motivate reusing the vast library of already trained state-of-the-art networks. However, their latency, high computational costs and memory demands pose significant challenges for deployment, especially on resource-constrained hardware. While structured pruning methods can reduce these factors, they often require costly retraining, sometimes for up to hundreds of epochs, or even training from scratch to recover the lost accuracy resulting from the structural modifications. Maintaining the provided performance of trained models after structured pruning and thereby avoiding extensive retraining remains a challenge. To solve this, we introduce Variance-Based Pruning, a simple and structured one-shot pruning technique for efficiently compressing networks, with minimal finetuning. Our approach first gathers activation statistics, which are then used to select neurons for pruning. Simultaneously the mean activations are integrated back into the model to preserve a high degree of performance. On ImageNet-1k recognition tasks, we demonstrate that directly after pruning DeiT-Base retains over 70% of its original performance and requires only 10 epochs of fine-tuning to regain 99% of the original accuracy while simultaneously reducing MACs by 35% and model size by 36%, thus speeding up the model by 1.44 times.
authors: Uranik Berisha, Jens Mehnert, Alexandru Paul Condurache ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4973-4982

title: 面向医学视觉的像素级预训练向量对比学习
title_en: Vector Contrastive Learning For Pixel-Wise Pretraining In Medical Vision
abstract: 对比学习(CL)已成为基础模型中自监督预训练(SSP)的核心方法;然而,将CL扩展到像素级表示——这对医学视觉至关重要——仍是一个开放性问题。标准CL将SSP表述为二元优化问题(二元CL),其中对特征分散的过度追求导致了"过度分散"问题,破坏了像素级特征相关性,从而扰乱了类内分布。我们的向量CL将CL重新表述为向量回归问题,通过建模回归位移向量中的特征距离,实现了像素级预训练中的分散量化。为实现这一新型范式,我们提出了对比在向量回归(COVER)框架。COVER建立了一个可扩展的基于向量的自学习机制,从向量回归到距离建模保持一致的优化流程,并利用向量金字塔架构实现粒度自适应,从而在SSP中保持像素级特征相关性。在涵盖2个维度和4种模态的8个任务上的广泛实验表明,COVER显著提升了像素级SSP,推动了可泛化的医学视觉基础模型发展。代码将在https://github.com/YutingHe-list/COVER公开。
abstract_en: Contrastive learning (CL) has become a cornerstone of self-supervised pretraining (SSP) in foundation models; however, extending CL to pixel-wise representation--crucial for medical vision--remains an open problem. Standard CL formulates SSP as a binary optimization problem (binary CL) where the excessive pursuit of feature dispersion leads to an "over-dispersion" problem, breaking pixel-wise feature correlation thus disrupting the intra-class distribution. Our vector CL reformulates CL as a vector regression problem, enabling dispersion quantification in pixel-wise pretraining via modeling feature distances in regressing displacement vectors. To implement this novel paradigm, we propose the COntrast in VEctor Regression (COVER) framework. COVER establishes an extendable vector-based self-learning, enforces a consistent optimization flow from vector regression to distance modeling, and leverages a vector pyramid architecture for granularity adaptation, thus preserving pixel-wise feature correlations in SSP. Extensive experiments across 8 tasks, spanning 2 dimensions and 4 modalities, show that COVER significantly improves pixel-wise SSP, advancing generalizable medical visual foundation models. Codes will be publicly available at https://github.com/YutingHe-list/COVER.
authors: Yuting He, Shuo Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19827-19837

title: VehicleMAE: 通过掩码自编码器进行车辆重识别预训练的视图不对称互学习
title_en: VehicleMAE: View-asymmetry Mutual Learning for Vehicle Re-identification Pre-training via Masked AutoEncoders
abstract: 大规模预训练技术已在多样化目标重识别(Re-ID)下游任务中取得了显著性能。然而,据我们所知,专门针对车辆重识别的预训练模型,其重点在于解决多视角变化的挑战,尚未被充分研究。本文首先利用扩散模型构建了一个大规模车辆重识别基准数据集,命名为"DiffVERI",包含超过170万张来自丰富多视角标注的图像。基于此数据集,我们进一步提出VehicleMAE,一种新颖的掩码图像建模预训练范式,通过自监督方式执行互蒸馏,学习视角不变的表示。具体而言,VehicleMAE的流程包含两个核心模块,即视图不对称掩码图像建模(VMIM)和过去到现在的互蒸馏(PPMD)。技术上,VMIM由两个同构的掩码自编码器(MAE)组成,通过配对的不对称掩码采样策略,同时重建特定车辆区域的RGB像素和多视角语义信息。为逐步蒸馏模型自身的知识,PPMD将当前周期和前一周期的两个MAE分别视为学生模型和教师模型,利用当前学生学习的知识和历史教师的知识进行互特征级蒸馏。大量实验结果验证了所提出的预训练范式在DiffVERI上获得的车辆重识别下游任务的卓越性能。
abstract_en: Large-scale pre-training technology has achieved remarkable performance in diversified object re-identification (Re-ID) downstream tasks. Nevertheless, to our best knowledge, the pre-training model specifically for vehicle Re-ID, which focuses on tackling the challenge of multi-view variations, has not been fully investigated. In this paper, we first leverage a diffusion model to build a large-scale vehicle Re-ID benchmark dataset, dubbed "DiffVERI", containing over 1700K images from abundant multi-view annotations. In terms of this dataset, we further present VehicleMAE, a novel masked image modeling pre-training paradigm that learns view-invariant representations by performing mutual-distillation in a self-supervised manner. To be specific, the pipeline of VehicleMAE unfolds two core modules, i.e., view-asymmetry masked image modeling (VMIM) and past-to-present mutual-distillation (PPMD). Technically, VMIM consists of two homogeneous masked autoencoders (MAE) that simultaneously reconstruct the RGB pixels and multi-view semantic information of the specific vehicle body region via paired asymmetric mask sampling strategies. To progressively distill the knowledge of the model itself, PPMD considers the two MAEs in the current epoch and the previous one as the student models and the teacher models, respectively, which leverages the knowledge learned by the current student and the historical teacher for mutual feature-level distillation. Extensive experimental results have verified that the proposed pre-training paradigm on DiffVERI gains compelling downstream task performance for vehicle Re-ID.
authors: Qi Wang, Zeyu Zhang, Dong Wang, Di Gai, Xin Xiong, Jiyang Xu, Ruihua Zhou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4701-4711

title: 面向可解释少样本泛化的语言化表征学习
title_en: Verbalized Representation Learning for Interpretable Few-Shot Generalization
abstract: 人类仅通过观察少量示例即可识别物体,这种显著能力源于其对现实环境的固有语言理解。构建语言化且可解释的表征能够显著提升模型在低数据量场景下的泛化能力。本文提出一种新型方法——语言化表征学习(Verbalized Representation Learning, VRL),通过少样本数据自动提取人类可解释的特征用于物体识别。我们的方法通过采用视觉-语言模型(Vision-Language Model, VLM)识别不同类之间的关键判别特征及同一类内的共有特性,以自然语言形式独特地捕捉类间差异和类内共性。这些语言化特征随后通过VLM映射为数值向量。生成的特征向量可进一步用于训练和推理下游分类器。实验结果表明,在相同模型规模下,VRL相较先前最先进方法实现24%的绝对性能提升,同时使用95%更少的数据和更小的模型。此外,与人工标注的属性相比,VRL学习的特征在下游分类任务中表现出20%的绝对增益。
abstract_en: Humans recognize objects after observing only a few examples, a remarkable capability enabled by their inherent language understanding of the real-world environment. Developing verbalized and interpretable representation can significantly improve model generalization in low-data settings. In this work, we propose Verbalized Representation Learning (VRL), a novel approach for automatically extracting human-interpretable features for object recognition using few-shot data. Our method uniquely captures inter-class differences and intra-class commonalities in the form of natural language by employing a Vision-Language Model (VLM) to identify key discriminative features between different classes and shared characteristics within the same class. These verbalized features are then mapped to numeric vectors through the VLM. The resulting feature vectors can be further utilized to train and infer with downstream classifiers. Experimental results show that, at the same model scale, VRL achieves a 24% absolute improvement over prior state-of-the-art methods while using 95% less data and a smaller model. Furthermore, compared to human-labeled attributes, the features learned by VRL exhibit a 20% absolute gain when used for downstream classification tasks.
authors: Cheng-Fu Yang, Da Yin, Wenbo Hu, Heng Ji, Nanyun Peng, Bolei Zhou, Kai-Wei Chang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 1602-1612

title: 基于图像到视频扩散的多功能过渡生成
title_en: Versatile Transition Generation with Image-to-Video Diffusion
abstract: 利用文本、图像、结构图或运动轨迹作为条件引导,扩散模型在自动化和高质量视频生成领域取得了显著成果。然而,基于首尾视频帧及描述性文本提示生成平滑且合理的过渡视频仍远未充分探索。我们提出VTG,一种多功能过渡视频生成框架,能够生成平滑、高保真且语义一致的视频过渡。VTG引入基于插值的初始化方法,有助于保持物体身份并有效处理突变内容变化。此外,它结合双向运动微调和表示对齐正则化,分别缓解预训练图像到视频扩散模型在运动平滑性和生成保真度方面的局限性。为评估VTG并促进统一过渡生成的未来研究,我们收集了TransitBench,一个涵盖概念融合和场景过渡两个代表性任务的综合性基准测试集。大量实验表明,VTG在所有四个任务中均展现出卓越的过渡性能。
abstract_en: Leveraging text, images, structure maps, or motion trajectories as conditional guidance, diffusion models have achieved great success in automated and high-quality video generation. However, generating smooth and rational transition videos given the first and last video frames as well as descriptive text prompts is far underexplored. We present VTG, a Versatile Transition video Generation framework that can generate smooth, high-fidelity, and semantic-coherent video transitions. VTG introduces interpolation-based initialization that helps preserve object identity and handle abrupt content changes effectively. In addition, it incorporates dual-directional motion fine-tuning and representation alignment regularization to mitigate the limitations of pre-trained image-to-video diffusion models in motion smoothness and generation fidelity, respectively. To evaluate VTG and facilitate future studies on unified transition generation, we collected TransitBench, a comprehensive benchmark for transition generation covering two representative transition tasks: concept blending and scene transition. Extensive experiments show that VTG achieves superior transition performance consistently across all four tasks.
authors: Zuhao Yang, Jiahui Zhang, Yingchen Yu, Shijian Lu, Song Bai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16981-16990

title: VertexRegen: 连续细节层次的网格生成
title_en: VertexRegen: Mesh Generation with Continuous Level of Detail
abstract: 我们引入VertexRegen,一种新型网格生成框架,能够实现连续细节层次的生成。现有自回归方法以部分到完整的方式生成网格,因此生成过程的中间步骤往往代表不完整的结构。VertexRegen受渐进网格启发,将生成过程重新表述为边折叠的逆过程,即顶点分裂,该过程通过生成模型学习。实验结果表明,VertexRegen生成的网格质量与现有方法相当,同时独特地支持随时生成,可在任意步骤停止以获得不同细节层次的有效网格。
abstract_en: We introduce VertexRegen, a novel mesh generation framework that enables generation at a continuous level of detail. Existing autoregressive methods generate meshes in a partial-to-complete manner and thus intermediate steps of generation represent incomplete structures. VertexRegen takes inspiration from progressive meshes and reformulates the process as the reversal of edge collapse, i.e. vertex split, learned through a generative model.
