Additionally, CSL introduces random masking of reliable pixels to guide the network in learning contextual relationships from low-reliability regions, thereby mitigating the adverse effects of discarding uncertain predictions. Extensive experimental results on the Pascal, Cityscapes, and COCO benchmarks show that CSL performs favorably against state-of-the-art methods. Code and model weights are available at: https://github.com/PanLiuCSU/CSL.
authors: Pan Liu, Jinshi Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 21874-21884

title: 大视觉-语言模型与大遥感图像的结合:由粗到细的文本引导标记修剪
title_en: When Large Vision-Language Model Meets Large Remote Sensing Imagery: Coarse-to-Fine Text-Guided Token Pruning
abstract: 对大遥感图像(RSIs)进行高效的视觉-语言理解具有重要意义但充满挑战。当前的大视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)通常采用有限的预定义网格处理图像,导致在处理吉像素RSI时出现信息丢失。相反,使用无限网格会显著增加计算成本。为在减少计算复杂度的同时保留图像细节,我们提出了一种结合动态图像金字塔(DIP)的文本引导标记修剪方法。我们的方法包含:(i) 利用文本感知区域定位能力识别关键视觉标记的区域聚焦模块(RFM),以及 (ii) 基于DIP的由粗到细图像瓦片选择和视觉标记修剪策略,该策略由RFM输出引导,避免直接处理整个大遥感图像。此外,现有评估LVLMs在大RSI上感知能力的基准测试存在问题多样性不足和图像尺寸受限的问题。我们构建了一个新的基准测试LRS-VQA,包含8个类别共7,333个问答对,图像长度可达27,328像素。在相同数据集上,我们的方法在四个数据集上优于现有高分辨率策略。此外,与现有标记缩减方法相比,我们的方法在高分辨率设置下表现出更高的效率。
abstract_en: Efficient vision-language understanding of large Remote Sensing Images (RSIs) is meaningful but challenging. Current Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) typically employ limited pre-defined grids to process images, leading to information loss when handling gigapixel RSIs. Conversely, using unlimited grids significantly increases computational costs. To preserve image details while reducing computational complexity, we propose a text-guided token pruning method with Dynamic Image Pyramid (DIP) integration. Our method introduces: (i) a Region Focus Module (RFM) that leverages text-aware region localization capability to identify critical vision tokens, and (ii) a coarse-to-fine image tile selection and vision token pruning strategy based on DIP, which is guided by RFM outputs and avoids directly processing the entire large imagery. Additionally, existing benchmarks for evaluating LVLMs' perception ability on large RSI suffer from limited question diversity and constrained image sizes. We construct a new benchmark named LRS-VQA, which contains 7,333 QA pairs across 8 categories, with image length up to 27,328 pixels. Our method outperforms existing high-resolution strategies on four datasets using the same data. Moreover, compared to existing token reduction methods, our approach demonstrates higher efficiency under high-resolution settings.
authors: Junwei Luo, Yingying Zhang, Xue Yang, Kang Wu, Qi Zhu, Lei Liang, Jingdong Chen, Yansheng Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9206-9217

title: 当光照欺骗时:通过光照变换攻击揭示视觉-语言模型的光照脆弱性
title_en: When Lighting Deceives: Exposing Vision-Language Models' Illumination Vulnerability Through Illumination Transformation Attack
abstract: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)在各类任务中取得了显著成功,但其对现实世界光照变化的鲁棒性仍缺乏系统研究。为填补这一空白,我们提出光照变换攻击(ITA),这是首个系统评估VLMs对光照变化鲁棒性的框架。然而,仍存在两个关键挑战:(1) 如何建模具有细粒度控制的全局光照以实现多样化的光照条件,(2) 如何在保持自然性的同时确保对抗有效性。针对第一个挑战,我们创新性地基于光照渲染方程将全局光照分解为多个参数化点光源。该设计使我们能够建模此前方法无法捕捉的更丰富的光照变化。随后,通过将这些参数化光照变化与基于物理的光照重建技术相结合,我们能够精确还原原始场景中的光交互,最终实现细粒度光照控制。针对第二个挑战,我们通过控制光照重建模型的潜在空间而非直接像素操作,内在保留了物理光照先验。此外,为防止潜在的重建伪影,我们设计了额外的感知约束以保持与原始图像的视觉一致性,并设计多样性约束以避免光源收敛。大量实验表明,我们的ITA能够显著降低先进VLMs(如LLaVA-1.6)的性能,同时具备竞争力的自然性,揭示了VLMs的关键光照脆弱性。
abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable success in various tasks, yet their robustness to real-world illumination variations remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose Illumination Transformation Attack (ITA), the first framework to systematically assess VLMs' robustness against illumination changes. However, there still exist two key challenges: (1) how to model global illumination with fine-grained control to achieve diverse lighting conditions and (2) how to ensure adversarial effectiveness while maintaining naturalness. To address the first challenge, we innovatively decompose global illumination into multiple parameterized point light sources based on the illumination rendering equation. This design enables us to model more diverse lighting variations that previous methods could not capture. Then, by integrating these parameterized lighting variations with physics-based lighting reconstruction techniques, we could precisely render such light interactions in the original scenes, finally meeting the goal of fine-grained lighting control. For the second challenge, by controlling illumination through the lighting reconstrution model's latent space rather than direct pixel manipulation, we inherently preserve physical lighting priors. Furthermore, to prevent potential reconstruction artifacts, we design additional perceptual constraints for maintaining visual consistency with original images and diversity constraints for avoiding light source convergence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our ITA could significantly reduce the performance of advanced VLMs, e.g., LLaVA-1.6, while possessing competitive naturalness, exposing VLMS' critical illuminiation vulnerabilities.
authors: Hanqing Liu, Shouwei Ruan, Yao Huang, Shiji Zhao, Xingxing Wei ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10485-10495

title: 当像素差异模式遇见ViT:面向少样本目标检测的PiDiViT
title_en: When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT: PiDiViT for Few-Shot Object Detection
abstract: 少样本目标检测旨在通过有限样本检测新类别。近期方法利用预训练视觉Transformer(ViT)丰富的语义表示来克服模型微调的局限性,从而提升新类别上的性能。然而现有预训练ViT方案仅在特征维度进行Transformer编码,忽略了对低级特征像素级差异及多尺度变化的探索。当前挑战在于:(i) 提取的特征存在边界特征模糊和中心到边界的平滑过渡问题,导致物体与背景区分不足;(ii) 如何在多尺度场景下平衡局部细节与全局轮廓特征的提取。为此提出像素差异视觉Transformer(PiDiViT)。创新点包括:(i) 差分卷积融合模块(DCFM),通过注意力机制融合像素级中心差分特征与原始特征,增强物体中心到边界的特征差异并有效保留全局信息;(ii) 多尺度特征融合模块(MFFM),利用尺度注意力机制自适应融合五种不同尺度卷积核提取的特征生成注意力权重,实现局部细节与全局语义信息提取的最优平衡。PiDiViT在COCO基准上达到SOTA:在10-shot场景下超越少样本检测SOTA 2.7 nAP50,在30-shot场景下超越4.0 nAP50;超越单样本检测SOTA 4.4 nAP50,超越开放词汇检测SOTA 3.7 nAP50。代码已开源于https://github.com/Seaz9/PiDiViT。
abstract_en: Few-shot object detection aims to detect novel classes with limited samples. Recent methods have leveraged the rich semantic representations of pretrained vision transformer (ViT) to overcome the limitations of model fine-tuning, thereby improving the performance on novel classes. However, existing pretrained ViT schemes only perform transformer encoding in the feature dimension, ignoring the exploration of pixel-wise differences in low-level features and multiscale variations. The current challenges lie in: (i) the extracted features suffer from blurred boundary features and smooth transition from center to boundary, leading to insufficient distinction between objects and backgrounds, and (ii) how to balance the extraction of local details and global contour features under multiscale scenarios. So Pixel Difference Vision Transformer (PiDiViT) is proposed. Innovations include: (i) difference convolution fusion module (DCFM), which enhances the feature differences from object centers to boundaries and effectively preserves global information by fusing pixel-wise central difference features with original features through an attention mechanism, and (ii) multiscale feature fusion module (MFFM), which adaptively fuses features extracted by five different scale convolutional kernels using a scale attention mechanism to generate attention weights, achieving an optimal balance between local detail and global semantic information extraction. PiDiViT achieves SOTA on COCO benchmark: surpassing few-shot detection SOTA by 2.7 nAP50 (10-shot) and 4.0 nAP50 (30-shot) for novel classes, exceeding one-shot detection SOTA by 4.4 nAP50 and open-vocabulary detection SOTA by 3.7 nAP50. The code is available at https://github.com/Seaz9/PiDiViT.
authors: Hongliang Zhou, Yongxiang Liu, Canyu Mo, Weijie Li, Bowen Peng, Li Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24309-24318

title: 薛定谔桥与无配对训练在现实世界图像去雾中的结合
title_en: When Schrodinger Bridge Meets Real-World Image Dehazing with Unpaired Training
abstract: 近期无配对去雾技术,特别是基于生成对抗网络(GANs)的方法,在处理现实世界模糊图像方面展现出显著性能。然而,这些方法常因生成器的运输映射能力受限,导致在无配对训练范式中难以充分发挥其效果。为解决这一问题,我们提出DehazeSB,一种基于薛定谔桥的新型无配对去雾框架。通过利用最优传输(OT)理论,DehazeSB直接桥接模糊与清晰图像的分布,从而在更少步骤内实现从模糊到清晰的最优传输映射,生成高质量结果。为确保恢复图像的结构信息与细节一致性,我们引入细节保留正则化,强制模糊输入与去雾输出在像素级对齐。此外,我们提出新型提示学习方法,通过学习雾感知的视觉-语言对齐,利用预训练CLIP模型区分模糊图像与清晰图像。在多个现实世界数据集上的大量实验验证了本方法的优越性。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in unpaired dehazing, particularly those using GANs, show promising performance in processing real-world hazy images. However, these methods tend to face limitations due to the generator's limited transport mapping capability, which hinders the full exploitation of their effectiveness in unpaired training paradigms. To address these challenges, we propose DehazeSB, a novel unpaired dehazing framework based on the Schrodinger Bridge. By leveraging optimal transport (OT) theory, DehazeSB directly bridges the distributions between hazy and clear images. This enables optimal transport mappings from hazy to clear images in fewer steps, thereby generating high-quality results. To ensure the consistency of structural information and details in the restored images, we introduce detail-preserving regularization, which enforces pixel-level alignment between hazy inputs and dehazed outputs. Furthermore, we propose a novel prompt learning to leverage pre-trained CLIP models in distinguishing hazy images and clear ones, by learning a haze-aware vision-language alignment. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate our method's superiority.
authors: Yunwei Lan, Zhigao Cui, Xin Luo, Chang Liu, Nian Wang, Menglin Zhang, Yanzhao Su, Dong Liu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 8756-8765

title: 数据毒药何时何地攻击文本反转?
title_en: When and Where do Data Poisons Attack Textual Inversion?
abstract: 数据污染攻击对扩散模型(DMs)的鲁棒性提出了重大挑战。本文系统分析了数据污染攻击在文本反转(TI)中的攻击时机和位置,文本反转是扩散模型(DMs)中广泛使用的个性化技术。我们首先引入语义敏感度图,一种用于可视化污染对文本嵌入影响的新方法。其次,我们识别并实验证实扩散模型在时间步长上表现出非均匀的学习行为,尤其关注低噪声样本。数据污染攻击继承了这种偏差,在较低时间步长上主要注入对抗信号。最后,我们观察到对抗信号会将学习过程偏离训练数据中的相关概念区域,从而破坏文本反转过程。基于这些见解,我们提出安全区域训练(SZT),一种由三个关键组件组成的新型防御机制:(1)JPEG压缩以削弱高频污染信号,(2)在文本反转训练期间限制到高时间步长以避免低时间步长的对抗信号,(3)损失掩码以约束学习到相关区域。在多种污染方法上的广泛实验表明,SZT显著增强了文本反转对所有污染攻击的鲁棒性,其生成质量超越了先前发表的防御方法。代码:www.github.com/JStyborski/Diff_Lab 数据:www.github.com/JStyborski/NC10
abstract_en: Poisoning attacks pose significant challenges to the robustness of diffusion models (DMs). In this paper, we systematically analyze when and where poisoning attacks textual inversion (TI), a widely used personalization technique for DMs. We first introduce Semantic Sensitivity Maps, a novel method for visualizing the influence of poisoning on text embeddings. Second, we identify and experimentally verify that DMs exhibit non-uniform learning behavior across timesteps, focusing on lower-noise samples. Poisoning attacks inherit this bias and inject adversarial signals predominantly at lower timesteps. Lastly, we observe that adversarial signals distract learning away from relevant concept regions within training data, corrupting the TI process. Based on these insights, we propose Safe-Zone Training (SZT), a novel defense mechanism comprised of 3 key components: (1) JPEG compression to weaken high-frequency poison signals, (2) restriction to high timesteps during TI training to avoid adversarial signals at lower timesteps, and (3) loss masking to constrain learning to relevant regions. Extensive experiments across multiple poisoning methods demonstrate that SZT greatly enhances the robustness of TI against all poisoning attacks, improving generative quality beyond prior published defenses. Code: www.github.com/JStyborski/Diff_Lab Data: www.github.com/JStyborski/NC10
authors: Jeremy Styborski, Mingzhi Lyu, Jiayou Lu, Nupur Kapur, Adams Wai-Kin Kong ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 19439-19449

title: 我在哪里?基于自然语言描述的跨视图地理定位
title_en: Where am I? Cross-View Geo-localization with Natural Language Descriptions
abstract: 跨视图地理定位通过匹配带有地理标签的卫星图像或OSM识别街景图像的位置。然而,现有研究多聚焦于图像到图像的检索,较少涉及文本引导的检索,而该任务对行人导航和应急响应等应用至关重要。本文提出基于自然语言描述的跨视图地理定位新任务,旨在根据场景文本描述检索对应的卫星图像或OSM数据库。为支持该任务,我们构建CVG-Text数据集,通过多城市跨视图数据收集,并采用场景文本生成方法,利用大型多模态模型的标注能力生成包含定位细节的高质量场景文本描述。此外,我们提出新型文本引导检索定位方法CrossText2Loc,在召回率上提升10%,并展现优秀的长文本检索能力。在可解释性方面,该方法不仅提供相似度分数,还给出检索原因。更多信息请访问https://github.com/yejy53/CVG-Text
abstract_en: Cross-view geo-localization identifies the locations of street-view images by matching them with geo-tagged satellite images or OSM. However, most existing studies focus on image-to-image retrieval, with fewer addressing text-guided retrieval, a task vital for applications like pedestrian navigation and emergency response.In this work, we introduce a novel task for cross-view geo-localization with natural language descriptions, which aims to retrieve corresponding satellite images or OSM database based on scene text descriptions. To support this task, we construct the CVG-Text dataset by collecting cross-view data from multiple cities and employing a scene text generation approach that leverages the annotation capabilities of Large Multimodal Models to produce high-quality scene text descriptions with localization details. Additionally, we propose a novel text-based retrieval localization method, CrossText2Loc, which improves recall by 10% and demonstrates excellent long-text retrieval capabilities. In terms of explainability, it not only provides similarity scores but also offers retrieval reasons. More information can be found at https://github.com/yejy53/CVG-Text
authors: Junyan Ye, Honglin Lin, Leyan Ou, Dairong Chen, Zihao Wang, Qi Zhu, Conghui He, Weijia Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5890-5900

title: Where, What, Why: 迈向可解释的驾驶员注意力预测
title_en: Where, What, Why: Towards Explainable Driver Attention Prediction
abstract: 在自动驾驶和认知科学中,建模任务驱动的注意力是一个根本性挑战。现有方法主要通过生成空间热图预测驾驶员注视点,但未能捕捉特定情境下注意力分配的认知动机,这限制了对注意力机制的深入理解。为弥合这一差距,我们引入可解释的驾驶员注意力预测,这是一种新型任务范式,可联合预测空间注意力区域(where)、解析关注语义(what),并提供注意力分配的认知推理(why)。为此,我们提出W3DA,首个大规模可解释驾驶员注意力数据集。该数据集在多样化驾驶场景(包括正常条件、安全关键情境和交通事故)中,通过详细语义和因果注释丰富了现有基准。我们进一步提出LLada,一种基于大语言模型的驾驶员注意力预测框架,其端到端架构统一了像素建模、语义解析和认知推理。大量实验验证了LLada的有效性,展示了其在不同数据集和驾驶条件下的鲁棒泛化能力。本工作为深入理解驾驶员注意力机制提供了关键步骤,对自动驾驶、智能驾驶员培训和人机交互具有重要意义。
abstract_en: Modeling task-driven attention in driving is a fundamental challenge for both autonomous vehicles and cognitive science. Existing methods primarily predict where drivers look by generating spatial heatmaps, but fail to capture the cognitive motivations behind attention allocation in specific contexts, which limits deeper understanding of attention mechanisms. To bridge this gap, we introduce Explainable Driver Attention Prediction, a novel task paradigm that jointly predicts spatial attention regions (where), parses attended semantics (what), and provides cognitive reasoning for attention allocation (why). To support this, we present W3DA, the first large-scale explainable driver attention dataset. It enriches existing benchmarks with detailed semantic and causal annotations across diverse driving scenarios, including normal conditions, safety-critical situations, and traffic accidents. We further propose LLada, a Large Language model-driven framework for driver attention prediction, which unifies pixel modeling, semantic parsing, and cognitive reasoning within an end-to-end architecture. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of LLada, exhibiting robust generalization across datasets and driving conditions. This work serves as a key step toward a deeper understanding of driver attention mechanisms, with significant implications for autonomous driving, intelligent driver training, and human-computer interaction.
authors: Yuchen Zhou, Jiayu Tang, Xiaoyan Xiao, Yueyao Lin, Linkai Liu, Zipeng Guo, Hao Fei, Xiaobo Xia, Chao Gou ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2675-2685

title: 谁掌控授权?可逆网络在文本到图像合成中的版权保护应用
title_en: Who Controls the Authorization? Invertible Networks for Copyright Protection in Text-to-Image Synthesis
abstract: 为应对更具隐蔽性和破坏性的个性化生成新形式侵权,现有版权保护方法通过在图像中添加对抗扰动来防御。然而这些方法仅专注于对抗非法个性化,忽视了合法个性化的需求。此外,现有方法均无法直接从对抗样本中验证和追溯版权。针对这些局限性,我们提出一种可追溯且可授权的版权追溯方法,通过一系列可逆复合耦合模块将版权水印嵌入图像。我们为可逆神经网络设计了新颖的信息交换机制,并提出基于对比学习的优化策略以解决个性化侵权问题。该方法通过引入水印类伪影和模糊生成图像中的隐私细节,有效抑制未经授权的个性化生成模型的恶意使用。同时支持版权追溯和合法个性化,从而具备更广泛的实际应用价值。实验结果表明,该方法可几乎无损还原原始图像并提取版权水印,实现FID超过300,并在未经授权的个性化图像中造成显著视觉伪影。此外,其在对抗净化和文本提示修改方面表现出一致的鲁棒性。
abstract_en: To defend against personalized generation, a new form of infringement that is more concealed and destructive, the existing copyright protection methods is to add adversarial perturbations in images. However, these methods focus solely on countering illegal personalization, neglecting the requirement for legitimate personalization. Moreover, none of these methods are capable of directly verifying and tracing the copyright from adversarial examples. In response to these limitations, we propose a traceable and authorizable copyright traceability method that embeds the copyright watermark into images through a series of invertible compound coupling modules. We introduce a novel information exchange mechanism for invertible neural network and design a contrastive learning-based optimization strategy tailored to address personalized infringement issues. Our method effectively mitigates the malicious use of unauthorized personalized generation models by inducing watermark-like artifacts and obscuring privacy details in generated images. Additionally, it facilitates copyright traceability and supports authorized legitimate personalization, thereby offering broader practical applicability. Experimental results demonstrate that our method can almost losslessly restore original image and extract copyright watermark, achieving FID exceeding 300 and causing visually noticeable artifacts in unauthorized personalized images. Furthermore, it exhibits consistent robustness against adversarial purification and text prompt modifications.
authors: Baoyue Hu, Yang Wei, Junhao Xiao, Wendong Huang, Xiuli Bi, Bin Xiao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15832-15841

title: 谁是更好的说话者:AI生成说话头部的主观与客观质量评估
title_en: Who is a Better Talker: Subjective and Objective Quality Assessment for AI-Generated Talking Heads
abstract: 语音驱动的肖像生成方法被称为"Talkers",因其能够合成说话时的嘴形和面部动作。特别是随着文本到图像(Text-to-Image, T2I)模型的快速发展,AI生成说话头部(AI-Generated Talking Heads, AGTHs)逐渐成为新兴的数字人类媒体。然而,关于这些Talkers及其生成的AGTHs质量仍存在诸多挑战,相关综合研究仍显不足。为解决这一问题,本文提出了迄今为止最大的AGTH质量评估数据集THQA-10K,该数据集选取了12个主流T2I模型和14个先进Talkers,针对14个提示生成AGTHs。在排除AGTH生成失败的实例后,THQA-10K数据集包含10,457个AGTHs,为AGTH质量评估提供了丰富的素材。随后,招募志愿者对AGTHs进行主观评分并给出相应的失真类别。在主观实验结果分析中,我们从泛化能力和质量两个维度评估Talkers的性能,同时揭示现有AGTHs的失真问题。最后,提出基于首帧、Y-T切片和音唇一致性指标的客观质量评估方法。实验结果表明,该方法在AGTH质量评估中达到最先进(SOTA)性能。相关工作发布于https://github.com/zyj-2000/Talker。
abstract_en: Speech-driven methods for portraits are figuratively known as "Talkers" because of their capability to synthesize speaking mouth shapes and facial movements. Especially with the rapid development of the Text-to-Image (T2I) models, AI-Generated Talking Heads (AGTHs) have gradually become an emerging digital human media. However, challenges persist regarding the quality of these talkers and AGTHs they generate, and comprehensive studies addressing these issues remain limited. To address this gap, this paper presents the largest AGTH quality assessment dataset THQA-10K to date, which selects 12 prominent T2I models and 14 advanced talkers to generate AGTHs for 14 prompts. After excluding instances where AGTH generation is unsuccessful, the THQA-10K dataset contains 10,457 AGTHs, which provides rich material for AGTH quality assessment. Then, volunteers are recruited to subjectively rate the AGTHs and give the corresponding distortion categories. In our analysis for subjective experimental results, we evaluate the performance of talkers in terms of generalizability and quality, and also expose the distortions of existing AGTHs. Finally, an objective quality assessment method based on the first frame, Y-T slice and tone-lip consistency is proposed. Experimental results show that this method can achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in AGTH quality assessment. The work is released at https://github.com/zyj-2000/Talker.
authors: Yingjie Zhou, Jiezhang Cao, Zicheng Zhang, Farong Wen, Yanwei Jiang, Jun Jia, Xiaohong Liu, Xiongkuo Min, Guangtao Zhai ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12201-12211

title: 为何大型视觉语言模型在更长回复中更容易出现幻觉:上下文的作用
title_en: Why LVLMs Are More Prone to Hallucinations in Longer Responses: The Role of Context
abstract: 大型视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)近年来取得了显著进展,但也容易出现幻觉问题。它们在更长、自由形式的回复中表现出更多幻觉,通常归因于累积的不确定性。本文提出问题:增加的幻觉是否仅由长度引发的错误导致,还是存在更深层次的机制?在一系列初步实验和发现之后,我们建议幻觉风险并非由长度本身引起,而是由更长回复中对上下文依赖性增强所致,以确保回复的连贯性和完整性。基于这些见解,我们提出了一种新颖的"诱导-检测-抑制"框架,通过精心设计的上下文主动诱导幻觉,利用诱导实例进行高风险案例的早期检测,并在实际解码过程中最终抑制潜在的物体级幻觉。我们的方法在所有基准测试中均实现了稳定且显著的改进,验证了其有效性。强大的检测能力和改进的幻觉缓解不仅验证了我们的框架,更重要的是重新验证了我们关于上下文的假设。本研究不仅旨在追求性能提升,还旨在提供新见解,并作为深入探索LVLMs更长回复中幻觉问题的第一步。
abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have made significant progress in recent years but are also prone to hallucination issues. They exhibit more hallucinations in longer, free-form responses, often attributed to accumulated uncertainties. In this paper, we ask: Does increased hallucination result solely from length-induced errors, or is there a deeper underlying mechanism? After a series of preliminary experiments and findings, we suggest that the risk of hallucinations is not caused by length itself but by the increased reliance on context for coherence and completeness in longer responses. Building on these insights, we propose a novel "induce-detect-suppress" framework that actively induces hallucinations through deliberately designed contexts, leverages induced instances for early detection of high-risk cases, and ultimately suppresses potential object-level hallucinations during actual decoding. Our approach achieves consistent, significant improvements across all benchmarks, demonstrating its efficacy. The strong detection and improved hallucination mitigation not only validate our framework but, more importantly, re-validate our hypothesis on context. Rather than solely pursuing performance gains, this study aims to provide new insights and serves as a first step toward a deeper exploration of hallucinations in LVLMs' longer responses.
authors: Ge Zheng, Jiaye Qian, Jiajin Tang, Sibei Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4101-4113

title: Wide2Long:学习广角到长焦的镜头压缩与视角调整
title_en: Wide2Long: Learning Lens Compression and Perspective Adjustment for Wide-Angle to Telephoto Translation
abstract: 一种从广角镜头拍摄的图像生成似长焦镜头拍摄图像的翻译框架,将有助于减少智能手机上复杂、昂贵且笨重的镜头的必要性。为此,我们提出了一种图像到图像的翻译管道,以模拟与此重建相关的镜头压缩和视角调整,其中图像中主体的尺寸保持不变。我们精心设计了基于深度的图像分层、逐层修复、冗余减少和分层缩放模块,以构建所需的长焦图像,其中管道参数由卷积网络估计。我们的方法与相关的光学变换兼容,因此主体后方的内容被放大,主体前方的内容被缩小,实现了适当的视角调整下的镜头压缩。我们的管道在我们专门为本任务拍摄的多个源-目标图像对上,以及在真实场景图像上均表现出良好的定性和定量性能。我们展示了它能够模拟针对目标2倍、4倍、8倍焦距变化的镜头压缩不同量级的效果。此外,该管道被证明对镜头压缩问题的一个子类——人像视角畸变校正也有效。我们还提供了消融研究,以展示管道中各个组件的重要性。
abstract_en: A translation framework that produces images as if they were captured with a telephoto lens, from images captured with a wide-angle lens, will help in reducing the necessity of complex, expensive and bulky lenses on smartphones. To this end, we propose an image-to-image translation pipeline to simulate the lens compression and perspective adjustment associated with this reconstruction, where the size of the main subject in the images remains the same. We judiciously design depth-based image layering, layer-wise in-painting, redundancy reduction and layer scaling modules to construct the desired tele-photo image, where the pipeline parameters are estimated by a convolutional network. Our approach is compatible with the related optical transformation, and hence, contents behind the main subject are enlarged and that before are diminished, achieving lens compression with appropriate perspective adjustment. Our pipeline performs well qualitatively and quantitatively on several source-target image pairs we have captured solely for this task, and also on images in-the-wild. We show that it can simulate the different amounts of lens compression associated with targeted 2x, 4x, 8xchanges in the focal length. Further, the pipeline is demonstrated to be effective for a sub-class of the lens-compression problem - portrait perspective distortion correction. We also provide an ablation study to show the significance of the various components in the pipeline.
authors: Soumyadipta Banerjee, Jiaul H. Paik, Debashis Sen ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 29001-29009

title: WikiAutoGen: 向多模态维基百科式文章生成迈进
title_en: WikiAutoGen: Towards Multi-Modal Wikipedia-Style Article Generation
abstract: 知识发现与收集是智力密集型任务,传统上需要大量人力投入以确保高质量输出。近期研究已探索多智能体框架,通过从互联网检索和综合信息来自动化生成维基百科式文章。然而,这些方法主要关注纯文本生成,忽视了多模态内容在增强信息量和吸引力方面的重要性。在本工作中,我们引入WikiAutoGen,一个用于自动化多模态维基百科式文章生成的新系统。与以往方法不同,WikiAutoGen不仅检索文本,还整合相关图像,从而丰富生成内容的深度和视觉吸引力。为进一步提高事实准确性和全面性,我们提出了一种多视角自我反思机制,从多样化视角批判性评估检索内容,以增强可靠性、广度和连贯性等。此外,我们引入WikiSeek基准,包含与文本和图像表示配对的维基百科文章主题,旨在更复杂主题上评估多模态知识生成。实验结果表明,WikiAutoGen在我们的WikiSeek基准上优于先前方法8%-29%,生成更准确、连贯且视觉丰富的维基百科式文章。我们部分生成示例展示于https://anonymous.4open.science/r/WikiAutoGen-C3C4
abstract_en: Knowledge discovery and collection are intelligence-intensive tasks that traditionally require significant human effort to ensure high-quality outputs. Recent research has explored multi-agent frameworks for automating Wikipedia-style article generation by retrieving and synthesizing information from the internet. However, these methods primarily focus on text-only generation, overlooking the importance of multimodal content in enhancing informativeness and engagement. In this work, we introduce WikiAutoGen, a novel system for automated multimodal Wikipedia-style article generation. Unlike prior approaches, WikiAutoGen retrieves and integrates relevant images alongside text, enriching both the depth and visual appeal of generated content. To further improve factual accuracy and comprehensiveness, we propose a multi-perspective self-reflection mechanism, which critically assesses retrieved content from diverse viewpoints to enhance reliability, breadth, and coherence, etc. Additionally, we introduce WikiSeek, a benchmark comprising Wikipedia articles with topics paired with both textual and image-based representations, designed to evaluate multimodal knowledge generation on more challenging topics. Experimental results show that WikiAutoGen outperforms previous methods by 8%-29% on our WikiSeek benchmark, producing more accurate, coherent, and visually enriched Wikipedia-style articles. We show some of our generated examples in https://anonymous.4open.science/r/WikiAutoGen-C3C4
authors: Zhongyu Yang, Jun Chen, Dannong Xu, Junjie Fei, Xiaoqian Shen, Liangbing Zhao, Chun-Mei Feng, Mohamed Elhoseiny ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15532-15541

title: WildSAT:从野生动物观测中学习卫星图像表示
title_en: WildSAT: Learning Satellite Image Representations from Wildlife Observations
abstract: 物种分布编码了有价值的生态和环境信息,但其在遥感中指导表示学习的潜力尚未被充分探索。我们介绍了WildSAT,该方法将卫星图像与公民科学平台上可轻松获取的数百万条地理标记的野生动物观测数据相结合。WildSAT采用对比学习方法,联合利用卫星图像、物种分布图和文本栖息地描述来训练或微调模型。这种方法在多种卫星图像识别任务中显著提升了性能,优于ImageNet预训练模型和卫星专用基线模型。此外,通过__ABS_MATH_1__对齐视觉和文本信息,WildSAT实现了零样本检索,使用户能够基于文本描述搜索地理位置。WildSAT超越了近期的跨模态学习方法,包括将卫星图像与地面图像或野生动物照片对齐的方法,展示了我们方法的优势。最后,我们分析了关键设计选择的影响,并强调了WildSAT在遥感和生物多样性监测中的广泛适用性。
abstract_en: Species distributions encode valuable ecological and environmental information, yet their potential for guiding representation learning in remote sensing remains underexplored. We introduce WildSAT, which pairs satellite images with millions of geo-tagged wildlife observations readily-available on citizen science platforms. WildSAT employs a contrastive learning approach that jointly leverages satellite images, species occurrence maps, and textual habitat descriptions to train or fine-tune models. This approach significantly improves performance on diverse satellite image recognition tasks, outperforming both ImageNet-pretrained models and satellite-specific baselines. Additionally, by aligning visual and textual information, WildSAT enables zero-shot retrieval, allowing users to search geographic locations based on textual descriptions. WildSAT surpasses recent cross-modal learning methods, including approaches that align satellite images with ground imagery or wildlife photos, demonstrating the advantages of our approach. Finally, we analyze the impact of key design choices and highlight the broad applicability of WildSAT to remote sensing and biodiversity monitoring.
authors: Rangel Daroya, Elijah Cole, Oisin Mac Aodha, Grant Van Horn, Subhransu Maji ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6143-6154

title: WildSeg3D:从2D图像中在野外分割任意3D物体
title_en: WildSeg3D: Segment Any 3D Objects in the Wild from 2D Images
abstract: 近期在从2D图像进行直观3D分割领域的进展已展现出显著性能。然而,现有模型通常需要大量场景特定训练才能准确重建和分割物体,这限制了其在实时场景中的适用性。本文提出WildSeg3D,一种高效的前馈机制方法,可在多样化的环境中对任意3D物体进行分割。该前馈方法的关键挑战在于多视角2D图像中3D对齐误差的累积,可能导致不准确的3D分割结果。为解决此问题,我们提出动态全局对齐(DGA)技术,通过聚焦跨图像难以匹配的3D点,利用动态调整函数提升全局多视角对齐的准确性。此外,为实现实时直观分割,我们引入多视角组映射(MGM)方法,利用物体掩码缓存整合多视角分割结果,并快速响应用户提示。WildSeg3D在任意场景中展现出强大的泛化能力,从而消除了对场景特定训练的需求。具体而言,WildSeg3D不仅达到现有最先进(SOTA)方法的精度,相比现有SOTA模型速度提升40倍。代码将发布于__ABS_MATH_1__。
abstract_en: Recent advances in intuitive 3D segmentation from 2D images have demonstrated impressive performance. However, current models typically require extensive scene-specific training to accurately reconstruct and segment objects, which limits their applicability in real-time scenarios. In this paper, we introduce WildSeg3D, an efficient approach that enables the segmentation of arbitrary 3D objects across diverse environments using a feed-forward mechanism. A key challenge of this feed-forward approach lies in the accumulation of 3D alignment errors across multiple 2D views, which can lead to inaccurate 3D segmentation results. To address this issue, we propose Dynamic Global Aligning (DGA), a technique that improves the accuracy of global multi-view alignment by focusing on difficult-to-match 3D points across images, using a dynamic adjustment function. Additionally, for real-time intuitive segmentation, we introduce Multi-view Group Mapping (MGM), a method that utilizes an object mask cache to integrate multi-view segmentations and respond rapidly to user prompts. WildSeg3D demonstrates robust generalization across arbitrary scenes, thereby eliminating the need for scene-specific training. Specifically, WildSeg3D not only attains the accuracy of state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods but also achieves a 40xspeedup compared to existing SOTA models. Code will be released at \href https://github.com/Ethan16162/WildSeg3D  https://github.com/Ethan16162/WildSeg3D .
authors: Yansong Guo, Jie Hu, Yansong Qu, Liujuan Cao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5166-5176

title: WonderPlay: 从单张图像和动作生成动态三维场景
title_en: WonderPlay: Dynamic 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image and Actions
abstract: WonderPlay 是一种新型框架,将物理模拟与视频生成相结合,用于从单张图像生成基于动作的动态三维场景。我们的混合生成模拟器首先使用物理求解器模拟粗粒度的三维动态,随后将该动态作为条件引导视频生成器产生更精细、更逼真的运动视频。生成的视频随后用于更新模拟的动态三维场景,从而在物理求解器与视频生成器之间形成闭环。这种方法使直观的用户控制能够结合基于物理模拟器的精确动态特性与基于扩散模型的视频生成器的表达能力。实验结果表明,WonderPlay 使用户能够通过单张图像输入与包含布料、沙子、雪、液体、烟雾、弹性和刚体等多样化内容的各类场景进行交互。代码将公开发布。
abstract_en: WonderPlay is a novel framework integrating physics simulation with video generation for generating action-conditioned dynamic 3D scenes from a single image. Our hybrid generative simulator first uses a physics solver to simulate coarse 3D dynamics, which subsequently conditions a video generator to produce a video with finer, more realistic motion. The generated video is then used to update the simulated dynamic 3D scene, closing the loop between the physics solver and the video generator. This approach enables intuitive user control to be combined with the accurate dynamics of physics-based simulators and the expressivity of diffusion-based video generators. Experimental results demonstrate that WonderPlay enables users to interact with various scenes of diverse content, including cloth, sand, snow, liquid, smoke, elasticity, and rigid bodies -- all using a single image input. Code will be made public.
authors: Zizhang Li, Hong-Xing Yu, Wei Liu, Yin Yang, Charles Herrmann, Gordon Wetzstein, Jiajun Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9080-9090

title: WonderTurbo: 在0.72秒内生成交互式3D世界
title_en: WonderTurbo: Generating Interactive 3D World in 0.72 Seconds
abstract: 交互式3D生成正迅速发展并引起广泛关注,因其潜在能力可创造沉浸式虚拟体验。然而,当前3D生成技术面临的关键挑战在于实现实时交互性。为解决这一问题,我们引入WonderTurbo,这是首个能够实现实时交互式3D场景生成的框架,可在0.72秒内生成新颖视角的3D场景。具体而言,WonderTurbo加速了3D场景生成中的几何与外观建模。在几何建模方面,我们提出StepSplat,一种通过动态更新构建高效3D几何表示的创新方法,每次更新仅需0.26秒。此外,我们设计了QuickDepth,一个轻量级深度补全模块,为StepSplat提供一致的深度输入,进一步提升几何精度。在外观建模方面,我们开发了FastPaint,一个针对即时修复优化的两阶段扩散模型,专注于保持空间外观一致性。实验结果表明,WonderTurbo相比基线方法实现了15倍的速度提升,同时保持了出色的空问一致性并生成高质量输出。
abstract_en: Interactive 3D generation is gaining momentum and capturing extensive attention for its potential to create immersive virtual experiences. However, a critical challenge in current 3D generation technologies lies in achieving real-time interactivity. To address this issue, we introduce WonderTurbo, the first real-time interactive 3D scene generation framework capable of generating novel perspectives of 3D scenes within 0.72 seconds. Specifically, WonderTurbo accelerates both geometric and appearance modeling in 3D scene generation. In terms of geometry, we propose StepSplat, an innovative method that constructs efficient 3D geometric representations through dynamic updates, each taking only 0.26 seconds. Additionally, we design QuickDepth, a lightweight depth completion module that provides consistent depth input for StepSplat, further enhancing geometric accuracy. For appearance modeling, we develop FastPaint, a 2-steps diffusion model tailored for instant inpainting, which focuses on maintaining spatial appearance consistency. Experimental results demonstrate that WonderTurbo achieves a remarkable 15xspeedup compared to baseline methods, while preserving excellent spatial consistency and delivering high-quality output.
authors: Chaojun Ni, Xiaofeng Wang, Zheng Zhu, Weijie Wang, Haoyun Li, Guosheng Zhao, Jie Li, Wenkang Qin, Guan Huang, Wenjun Mei ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27423-27434

title: World4Drive: 基于意图感知物理潜在世界模型的端到端自动驾驶
title_en: World4Drive: End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Intention-aware Physical Latent World Model
abstract: 端到端自动驾驶直接从原始传感器数据生成规划轨迹,但通常依赖昂贵的感知监督来提取场景信息。一个关键研究挑战在于:构建一个信息丰富的驾驶世界模型,以实现无需人工感知标注的端到端规划,通过自监督学习完成。本文提出World4Drive,一个端到端自动驾驶框架,利用视觉基础模型构建潜在世界模型,生成并评估多模态规划轨迹。具体而言,World4Drive首先提取场景特征,包括通过视觉基础模型提供的空间语义先验增强的驾驶意图和世界潜在表示。随后基于当前场景特征和驾驶意图生成多模态规划轨迹,并在潜在空间中预测多个意图驱动的未来状态。最后引入世界模型选择模块评估并选择最佳轨迹。我们通过实际未来观测与从潜在空间重构的预测观测之间的自监督对齐,实现无需人工感知标注的端到端规划。World4Drive在开放循环nuScenes和闭合循环NavSim基准测试中均无需人工感知标注即达到最先进性能,实现了L2误差相对减少18.0%、碰撞率降低46.7%以及训练收敛速度提升3.75倍。代码将开放访问于https://github.com/ucaszyp/World4Drive。
abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving directly generates planning trajectories from raw sensor data, yet it typically relies on costly perception supervision to extract scene information. A critical research challenge arises: constructing an informative driving world model to enable perception annotation-free, end-to-end planning via self-supervised learning. In this paper, we present World4Drive, an end-to-end autonomous driving framework that employs vision foundation models to build latent world models for generating and evaluating multi-modal planning trajectories. Specifically, World4Drive first extracts scene features, including driving intention and world latent representations enriched with spatial-semantic priors provided by vision foundation models. It then generates multi-modal planning trajectories based on current scene features and driving intentions and predicts multiple intention-driven future states within the latent space. Finally, it introduces a world model selector module to evaluate and select the best trajectory. We achieve perception annotation-free, end-to-end planning through self-supervised alignment between actual future observations and predicted observations reconstructed from the latent space. World4Drive achieves state-of-the-art performance without manual perception annotations on both the open-loop nuScenes and closed-loop NavSim benchmarks, demonstrating an 18.0% relative reduction in L2 error, 46.7% lower collision rate, and 3.75 faster training convergence. Codes will be accessed at https://github.com/ucaszyp/World4Drive.
authors: Yupeng Zheng, Pengxuan Yang, Zebin Xing, Qichao Zhang, Yuhang Zheng, Yinfeng Gao, Pengfei Li, Teng Zhang, Zhongpu Xia, Peng Jia, XianPeng Lang, Dongbin Zhao ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28632-28642

title: WorldScore:世界生成的统一评估基准
title_en: WorldScore: A Unified Evaluation Benchmark for World Generation
abstract: 我们引入了WorldScore基准,这是首个用于世界生成的统一评估基准。我们将世界生成分解为一系列基于显式相机轨迹布局规范的下一场景生成任务,从而能够统一评估从三维和四维场景生成到视频生成模型等多样化方法。WorldScore基准包含一个精心策划的3,000个测试示例数据集,涵盖静态与动态、室内外、写实与风格化等多种世界类型。WorldScore度量标准通过可控性、质量与动态性三个关键方面评估生成的世界。通过对20个代表性模型(包括开源和闭源模型)的广泛评估,我们揭示了各类模型的关键洞察与挑战。我们的数据集、评估代码和排行榜可在https://haoyi-duan.github.io/WorldScore/获取。
abstract_en: We introduce the WorldScore benchmark, the first unified benchmark for world generation. We decompose world generation into a sequence of next-scene generation tasks with explicit camera trajectory-based layout specifications, enabling unified evaluation of diverse approaches from 3D and 4D scene generation to video generation models. The WorldScore benchmark encompasses a curated dataset of 3,000 test examples that span diverse worlds: static and dynamic, indoor and outdoor, photorealistic and stylized. The WorldScore metric evaluates generated worlds through three key aspects: controllability, quality, and dynamics. Through extensive evaluation of 20 representative models, including both open-source and closed-source ones, we reveal key insights and challenges for each category of models. Our dataset, evaluation code, and leaderboard can be found at https://haoyi-duan.github.io/WorldScore/.
authors: Haoyi Duan, Hong-Xing Yu, Sirui Chen, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27713-27724

title: X-Capture:一种开源便携式多感官学习设备
title_en: X-Capture: An Open-Source Portable Device for Multi-Sensory Learning
abstract: 通过多种感官模态理解物体是人类感知的基础,能够实现跨感官整合和更丰富的理解。对于AI和机器人系统要复制这种能力,获取多样且高质量的多感官数据至关重要。现有数据集往往受限于其对受控环境、模拟物体或受限模态配对的侧重。我们引入X-Capture,这是一种开源、便携且成本效益高的设备,用于现实世界多感官数据采集,能够捕捉相关RGBD图像、触觉读数和冲击音频。凭借低于1,000美元的构建成本,X-Capture使多感官数据集的创建民主化,仅需消费级工具即可组装。使用X-Capture,我们整理了一个包含600个日常物品的样本数据集,总计3,600个点,涵盖多样化的现实环境,兼具丰富性和多样性。我们的实验验证了数据量和感官广度对多模态表示预训练和微调的价值,特别是在以物体为中心的任务如跨感官检索和重建中。X-Capture为推进AI中类人感官表示奠定了基础,强调可扩展性、可访问性和现实应用场景。
abstract_en: Understanding objects through multiple sensory modalities is fundamental to human perception, enabling cross-sensory integration and richer comprehension. For AI and robotic systems to replicate this ability, access to diverse, high-quality multi-sensory data is critical. Existing datasets are often limited by their focus on controlled environments, simulated objects, or restricted modality pairings. We introduce X-Capture, an open-source, portable, and cost-effective device for real-world multi-sensory data collection, capable of capturing correlated RGBD images, tactile readings, and impact audio. With a build cost under 1,000, X-Capture democratizes the creation of multi-sensory datasets, requiring only consumer-grade tools for assembly. Using X-Capture, we curate a sample dataset of 3,600 total points on 600 everyday objects from diverse, real-world environments, offering both richness and variety. Our experiments demonstrate the value of both the quantity and the sensory breadth of our data for both pretraining and fine-tuning multi-modal representations for object-centric tasks such as cross-sensory retrieval and reconstruction. X-Capture lays the groundwork for advancing human-like sensory representations in AI, emphasizing scalability, accessibility, and real-world applicability.
authors: Samuel Clarke, Suzannah Wistreich, Yanjie Ze, Jiajun Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6436-6446

title: X-Dancer: 从音乐到人类舞蹈视频的表达生成
title_en: X-Dancer: Expressive Music to Human Dance Video Generation
abstract: 我们提出X-Dancer,一种新颖的零样本音乐驱动图像动画管道,能够从单张静态图像生成多样化且长时序的逼真人类舞蹈视频。其核心是一个统一的Transformer-扩散框架,包含一个自回归Transformer模型,用于合成扩展的、与音乐同步的token序列,用于2D身体、头部和手部姿态,这些序列随后引导扩散模型生成连贯且真实的舞蹈视频帧。与传统主要在3D空间生成人类运动的方法不同,X-Dancer通过建模广泛范围的2D舞蹈动作,解决了数据限制并增强了可扩展性,利用易于获取的单目视频捕捉其与音乐节拍的细微对齐。为此,我们首先从与关键点置信度相关的2D人体姿态标签中构建空间组合的token表示,编码大范围的关节运动(如上身和下身)和细粒度动作(如头部和手部)。随后设计了一个音乐到运动的Transformer模型,自回归地生成与音乐对齐的舞蹈姿态token序列,结合全局注意力机制关注音乐风格和先验运动上下文。最后,我们利用扩散主干通过AdaIN将这些合成的姿态token动画化参考图像,形成一个完全可微的端到端框架。实验结果表明,X-Dancer能够生成多样化且具特征的舞蹈视频,在多样性、表达性和真实感方面显著优于现有最先进方法。详见我们的项目页面获取更多结果:https://zeyuan-chen.com/X-Dancer/
abstract_en: We present X-Dancer, a novel zero-shot music-driven image animation pipeline that creates diverse and long-range lifelike human dance videos from a single static image. As its core, we introduce a unified transformer-diffusion framework, featuring an autoregressive transformer model that synthesize extended and music-synchronized token sequences for 2D body, head and hands poses, which then guide a diffusion model to produce coherent and realistic dance video frames. Unlike traditional methods that primarily generate human motion in 3D, X-Dancer addresses data limitations and enhances scalability by modeling a wide spectrum of 2D dance motions, capturing their nuanced alignment with musical beats through readily available monocular videos. To achieve this, we first build a spatially compositional token representation from 2D human pose labels associated with keypoint confidences, encoding both large articulated body movements (e.g., upper and lower body) and fine-grained motions (e.g., head and hands). We then design a music-to-motion transformer model that autoregressively generates music-aligned dance pose token sequences, incorporating global attention to both musical style and prior motion context. Finally we leverage a diffusion backbone to animate the reference image with these synthesized pose tokens through AdaIN, forming a fully differentiable end-to-end framework. Experimental results demonstrate that X-Dancer is able to produce both diverse and characterized dance videos, substantially outperforming state-of-the-art methods in term of diversity, expressiveness and realism. See our project page for more results: https://zeyuan-chen.com/X-Dancer/.
authors: Zeyuan Chen, Hongyi Xu, Guoxian Song, You Xie, Chenxu Zhang, Xin Chen, Chao Wang, Di Chang, Linjie Luo ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 10602-10611

title: X-Fusion:向冻结的大型语言模型引入新模态
title_en: X-Fusion: Introducing New Modality to Frozen Large Language Models
abstract: 我们提出X-Fusion框架,该框架在保持大型语言模型(LLMs)语言能力的同时,扩展预训练的LLMs以处理多模态任务。X-Fusion采用双塔设计,结合模态特定权重,在保持LLM参数冻结的同时,整合视觉特定信息以实现理解和生成。我们发现,引入以理解为导向的数据可提升生成质量,减少图像数据噪声可增强整体性能,而特征对齐可加速小型模型的收敛,但对大型模型影响较小。我们的研究结果为构建高效统一的多模态模型提供了宝贵见解。
abstract_en: We propose X-Fusion, a framework that extends pretrained Large Language Models (LLMs) for multimodal tasks while preserving their language capabilities. X-Fusion employs a dual-tower design with modality-specific weights, keeping the LLM's parameters frozen while integrating vision-specific information for both understanding and generation. We find that incorporating understanding-focused data improves generation quality, reducing image data noise enhances overall performance, and feature alignment accelerates convergence for smaller models but has minimal impact on larger ones. Our findings provide valuable insights into building efficient unified multimodal models.
authors: Sicheng Mo, Thao Nguyen, Xun Huang, Siddharth Srinivasan Iyer, Yijun Li, Yuchen Liu, Abhishek Tandon, Eli Shechtman, Krishna Kumar Singh, Yong Jae Lee, Bolei Zhou, Yuheng Li ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 228-238

title: X-Prompt:基于上下文提示的可泛化自回归视觉学习
title_en: X-Prompt: Generalizable Auto-Regressive Visual Learning with In-Context Prompting
abstract: 近期大语言模型的进展使得开放式文本生成任务提示成为可能。在视觉领域,长期目标是开发能够实现通用视觉学习的模型,涵盖图像生成、编辑、低级处理和密集感知等任务。尽管近期研究致力于构建支持提示的视觉基础模型,但仍有显著挑战,尤其是在准确理解视觉提示和解决文本提示固有的歧义性方面。为解决这一问题,我们引入了X-Prompt,这是一种纯粹的自回归式大规模视觉-语言模型,通过上下文提示实现通用视觉学习。X-Prompt可将视觉和文本提示作为上下文进行处理,实现精确的任务理解和准确执行。一种新颖的提示-标记融合机制有效提取复杂提示中的相关任务信息,同时显著减少标记长度。此外,统一的文本和图像预测训练策略增强了任务意识,实现了对开放式提示的无缝适应。大量实验表明,X-Prompt能够有效理解上下文提示,并在领域内和领域外的视觉任务中表现出泛化能力,为通用视觉学习的未来发展铺平道路。
abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models have enabled task prompting for open-ended text generation. In the vision domain, a longstanding goal is developing models capable of general visual learning, encompassing tasks such as image generation, editing, low-level processing, and dense perception. Although recent efforts have aimed at building vision foundation models that support prompting, significant challenges remain, particularly in accurately comprehending visual prompts and addressing the ambiguity inherent in textual prompts. To address this, we introduce X-Prompt, a purely auto-regressive large vision-language model designed for generalizable visual learning via in-context prompting. X-Prompt can process visual and textual prompts as context, enabling precise task interpretation and accurate execution. A novel prompt-token fusion mechanism effectively extracts relevant task information from complex prompts while significantly reducing the token length. Additionally, a unified training strategy for text and image prediction enhances task awareness, enabling seamless adaptation to open-ended prompts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that X-Prompt effectively interprets in-context prompts and exhibits generalization across both in-domain and out-of-domain visual tasks, paving the way for future advancements in general visual learning.
authors: Zeyi Sun, Ziyang Chu, Pan Zhang, Tong Wu, Yuhang Zang, Xiaoyi Dong, Yuanjun Xiong, Dahua Lin, Jiaqi Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 17268-17280

title: X2-Gaussian: 4D辐射高斯散射用于连续时间断层重建
title_en: X2-Gaussian: 4D Radiative Gaussian Splatting for Continuous-time Tomographic Reconstruction
abstract: 四维计算机断层扫描(4D CT)重建对于捕捉动态解剖结构变化至关重要,但传统相位分组流程存在固有局限性。现有方法通过呼吸门控设备将时间分辨率离散化为固定相位,导致运动错位并限制临床实用性。本文提出X2-Gaussian框架,通过整合动态辐射高斯散射与自监督呼吸运动学习,实现连续时间4D-CT重建。我们的方法通过时空编码器-解码器架构建模解剖动态,预测时变高斯变形,消除相位离散化。为摆脱对外部门控设备的依赖,我们引入生理驱动的周期一致性损失,通过可微优化直接从投影中学习患者特异性呼吸周期。大量实验验证了该方法的先进性能,在传统方法基础上实现9.93 dB PSNR增益,相较先前高斯散射技术提升2.25 dB。通过统一连续运动建模与无硬件周期学习,X2-Gaussian推动了高保真4D CT重建在动态临床成像中的应用。代码将公开在https://github.com/CUHK-AIM-Group/X2-Gaussian。
abstract_en: Four-dimensional computed tomography (4D CT) reconstruction is crucial for capturing dynamic anatomical changes but faces inherent limitations from conventional phase-binning workflows. Current methods discretize temporal resolution into fixed phases with respiratory gating devices, introducing motion misalignment and restricting clinical practicality. In this paper, We propose X^2-Gaussian, a novel framework that enables continuous-time 4D-CT reconstruction by integrating dynamic radiative Gaussian splatting with self-supervised respiratory motion learning. Our approach models anatomical dynamics through a spatiotemporal encoder-decoder architecture that predicts time-varying Gaussian deformations, eliminating phase discretization. To remove dependency on external gating devices, we introduce a physiology-driven periodic consistency loss that learns patient-specific breathing cycles directly from projections via differentiable optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, achieving a 9.93 dB PSNR gain over traditional methods and 2.25 dB improvement against prior Gaussian splatting techniques. By unifying continuous motion modeling with hardware-free period learning, X^2-Gaussian advances high-fidelity 4D CT reconstruction for dynamic clinical imaging. Code will be publicly available at https://github.com/CUHK-AIM-Group/X2-Gaussian.
authors: Weihao Yu, Yuanhao Cai, Ruyi Zha, Zhiwen Fan, Chenxin Li, Yixuan Yuan ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24728-24738

title: X2I:通过注意力蒸馏将多模态理解无缝集成至扩散Transformer
title_en: X2I: Seamless Integration of Multimodal Understanding into Diffusion Transformer via Attention Distillation
abstract: 文本到图像(T2I)模型以其生成高度逼真图像的能力而闻名,而多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)则因其在理解和整合多种模态方面的专长而著称。然而,目前尚无直接且高效的框架能够将MLLMs的多模态理解能力迁移至T2I模型,以使其具备处理多模态输入的能力。本文提出X2I框架,该框架使扩散Transformer(DiT)模型具备理解多语言文本、截图文档、图像、视频和音频等多种模态的能力。X2I仅使用10万英文语料库和160个GPU小时进行训练。基于DiT教师模型,我们采用创新的蒸馏方法提取教师模型的推理能力,并设计轻量级AlignNet结构作为中间桥梁。与教师模型相比,X2I在性能退化方面下降不到1%,同时获得了多种多模态理解能力。此外,它适用于图像-文本到图像生成的LoRA训练,在该领域填补了行业空白。我们进一步设计了简单的LightControl以提升指令图像编辑的保真度。最后,大量实验验证了X2I在有效性、效率、多功能性和可迁移性方面的优势。
abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) models are well known for their ability to produce highly realistic images, while multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are renowned for their proficiency in understanding and integrating multiple modalities. However, currently there is no straightforward and efficient framework to transfer the multimodal comprehension abilities of MLLMs to T2I models to enable them to understand multimodal inputs. In this paper, we propose the X2I framework, which endows Diffusion Transformer (DiT) models with the capability to comprehend various modalities, including multilingual text, screenshot documents, images, videos, and audio. X2I is trained using merely 100K English corpus with 160 GPU hours. Building on the DiT teacher model, we adopt an innovative distillation method to extract the inference capabilities of the teacher model and design a lightweight AlignNet structure to serve as an intermediate bridge. Compared to the teacher model, X2I shows a decrease in performance degradation of less than 1% while gaining various multimodal understanding abilities. Furthermore, it is applicable for LoRA training in the context of image-text to image generation, filling a void in the industry in this area. We further design a simple LightControl to enhance the fidelity of instructional image editing. Finally, extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness, efficiency, multifunctionality, and transferability of our X2I.
authors: Jian Ma, Qirong Peng, Xu Guo, Chen Chen, Haonan Lu, Zhenyu Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16733-16744

title: XTrack:多模态训练提升RGB-X视频目标跟踪器
title_en: XTrack: Multimodal Training Boosts RGB-X Video Object Trackers
abstract: 多模态感知已被证明对视觉跟踪具有重要价值,因为不同传感器类型在处理目标外观变化的特定挑战性场景时具有独特优势。虽然能够利用所有模态的通用模型是理想选择,但数据稀疏性阻碍了其开发,通常实践中仅能获取单一模态数据。因此,确保并实现多模态感知获得的知识(如识别相关特征和区域)在推理时某些模态不可用时的有效共享至关重要。我们基于一个简单假设:不同模态中的相似样本具有更多可共享的知识。为实现这一目标,我们采用一个弱损失分类器,任务是区分不同模态。更具体地,若分类器"未能"准确识别给定样本的模态,这表明存在跨模态知识共享的机会。直观而言,当某一模态的样本与另一模态的样本足够接近且对齐时,知识迁移将被促进。技术上,我们通过在面向多模态视频目标跟踪的混合专家框架中,将某一模态的样本路由至其他模态的专家来实现这一目标。在推理时选择相应模态的专家,我们证明了所提方法得益于训练期间的多模态知识,从而提升性能。通过仅使用配对RGB-E、RGB-D和RGB-T进行的详尽实验,我们展示了所提方法在推理时对RGB-X跟踪器的提升效果,平均精度较当前SOTA提升+3%。源代码已公开在https://github.com/supertyd/XTrack。
abstract_en: Multimodal sensing has proven valuable for visual tracking, as different sensor types offer unique strengths in handling one specific challenging scene where object appearance varies. While a generalist model capable of leveraging all modalities would be ideal, development is hindered by data sparsity, typically in practice, only one modality is available at a time. Therefore, it is crucial to ensure and achieve that knowledge gained from multimodal sensing -- such as identifying relevant features and regions -- is effectively shared, even when certain modalities are unavailable at inference. We venture with a simple assumption: similar samples across different modalities have more knowledge to share than otherwise. To implement this, we employ a classifier with weak loss tasked with distinguishing between modalities. More specifically, if the classifier "fails" to accurately identify the modality of the given sample, this signals an opportunity for cross-modal knowledge sharing. Intuitively, knowledge transfer is facilitated whenever a sample from one modality is sufficiently close and aligned with another. Technically, we achieve this by routing samples from one modality to the expert of the others, within a mixture-of-experts framework designed for multimodal video object tracking. During the inference, the expert of the respective modality is chosen, which we show to benefit from the multimodal knowledge available during training, thanks to the proposed method. Through the exhaustive experiments that use only paired RGB-E, RGB-D, and RGB-T during training, we showcase the benefit of the proposed method for RGB-X tracker during inference, with an average +3% precision improvement over the current SOTA. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/supertyd/XTrack.
authors: Yuedong Tan, Zongwei Wu, Yuqian Fu, Zhuyun Zhou, Guolei Sun, Eduard Zamfir, Chao Ma, Danda Paudel, Luc Van Gool, Radu Timofte ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5734-5744

title: YOLO-Count:面向文本到图像生成的可微对象计数
title_en: YOLO-Count: Differentiable Object Counting for Text-to-Image Generation
abstract: 我们提出YOLO-Count,一种可微开放词汇对象计数模型,同时解决通用计数挑战并实现文本到图像(T2I)生成中的精确数量控制。核心贡献是"基数"图,一种新颖的回归目标,能够考虑物体尺寸和空间分布的变化。通过表征对齐和混合强弱监督方案,YOLO-Count弥合了开放词汇计数与T2I生成控制之间的差距。其完全可微架构支持基于梯度的优化,实现了准确的对象数量估计和生成模型的细粒度引导。大量实验表明,YOLO-Count在计数精度上达到最先进水平,同时为T2I系统提供稳健有效的数量控制。
abstract_en: We propose YOLO-Count, a differentiable open-vocabulary object counting model that tackles both general counting challenges and enables precise quantity control for text-to-image (T2I) generation. A core contribution is the 'cardinality' map, a novel regression target that accounts for variations in object size and spatial distribution. Leveraging representation alignment and a hybrid strong-weak supervision scheme, YOLO-Count bridges the gap between open-vocabulary counting and T2I generation control. Its fully differentiable architecture facilitates gradient-based optimization, enabling accurate object count estimation and fine-grained guidance for generative models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that YOLO-Count achieves state-of-the-art counting accuracy while providing robust and effective quantity control for T2I systems.
authors: Guanning Zeng, Xiang Zhang, Zirui Wang, Haiyang Xu, Zeyuan Chen, Bingnan Li, Zhuowen Tu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16765-16775

title: YOLOE: 实时任意目标检测
title_en: YOLOE: Real-Time Seeing Anything
abstract: 目标检测与分割广泛应用于计算机视觉领域,但传统模型如YOLO系列虽高效准确,却受限于预定义类别,难以适应开放场景。近年来,开放集方法通过文本提示、视觉线索或无提示范式来突破这一限制,但往往因计算需求高或部署复杂而牺牲性能与效率。本文提出YOLOE,该模型在单一高效架构中整合多种开放提示机制,实现实时任意目标检测。针对文本提示,我们提出可重参数化区域-文本对齐(RepRTA)策略,通过轻量级辅助网络优化预训练文本嵌入,并在零推理与迁移开销下增强视觉-文本对齐。针对视觉提示,我们设计语义激活视觉提示编码器(SAVPE),通过解耦语义与激活分支实现更优视觉嵌入与精度,且复杂度极低。针对无提示场景,我们引入懒惰区域-提示对比(LRPC)策略,利用内置大词汇量与专用嵌入识别所有目标,避免依赖语言模型。大量实验表明,YOLOE在零样本性能与迁移能力上表现卓越,具备高推理效率与低训练成本。值得注意的是,在LVIS数据集上,YOLOE-v8-S以训练成本减少3倍、推理速度提升1.4倍的代价,超越YOLO-Worldv2-S 3.5 AP。迁移至COCO数据集时,YOLOE-v8-L相较闭集YOLOv8-L在AP^b和AP^m上分别提升0.6和0.4,且训练时间减少近4倍。代码与模型可访问__ABS_MATH_1__。
abstract_en: Object detection and segmentation are widely employed in computer vision applications, yet conventional models like YOLO series, while efficient and accurate, are limited by predefined categories, hindering adaptability in open scenarios. Recent open-set methods leverage text prompts, visual cues, or prompt-free paradigm to overcome this, but often compromise between performance and efficiency due to high computational demands or deployment complexity. In this work, we introduce YOLOE, which integrates detection and segmentation across diverse open prompt mechanisms within a single highly efficient model, achieving real-time seeing anything. For text prompts, we propose Re-parameterizable Region-Text Alignment (RepRTA) strategy. It refines pretrained textual embeddings via a re-parameterizable lightweight auxiliary network and enhances visual-textual alignment with zero inference and transferring overhead. For visual prompts, we present Semantic-Activated Visual Prompt Encoder (SAVPE). It employs decoupled semantic and activation branches to bring improved visual embedding and accuracy with minimal complexity. For prompt-free scenario, we introduce Lazy Region-Prompt Contrast (LRPC) strategy. It utilizes a built-in large vocabulary and specialized embedding to identify all objects, avoiding costly language model dependency. Extensive experiments show YOLOE's exceptional zero-shot performance and transferability with high inference efficiency and low training cost. Notably, on LVIS, with 3xless training cost and 1.4xinference speedup, YOLOE-v8-S surpasses YOLO-Worldv2-S by 3.5 AP. When transferring to COCO, YOLOE-v8-L achieves 0.6 AP^b and 0.4 AP^m gains over closed-set YOLOv8-L with nearly 4xless training time. Code and models are available at \href https://github.com/THU-MIG/yoloe  here .
authors: Ao Wang, Lihao Liu, Hui Chen, Zijia Lin, Jungong Han, Guiguang Ding ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 24591-24602

title: 你就是你自己的最佳老师:在异构且长尾数据下实现联邦学习的集中式水平性能
title_en: You Are Your Own Best Teacher: Achieving Centralized-level Performance in Federated Learning under Heterogeneous and Long-tailed Data
abstract: 数据异构性源于本地非独立同分布数据和全局长尾分布,是联邦学习(FL)中的主要挑战,导致与集中式学习相比出现显著性能差距。先前研究发现,表示能力差和分类器偏差是主要问题,并提出了受神经坍缩启发的合成单纯形ETF来帮助表示更接近神经坍缩最优解。然而,我们发现受神经坍缩启发的方法不足以达到神经坍缩,与集中式训练仍存在巨大差距。本文从自蒸馏视角重新审视该问题,提出FedYoYo(你就是你自己的最佳老师),引入增强自引导蒸馏(ASD)通过弱增强和强增强本地样本间的知识蒸馏提升表示学习,无需额外数据集或模型。我们进一步引入分布感知对数调整(DLA)以平衡自蒸馏过程并校正偏差特征表示。FedYoYo几乎消除了性能差距,在混合异构性下实现集中式水平性能。它增强了本地表示学习,减少模型漂移并提升收敛性,特征原型更接近神经坍缩最优解。大量实验表明FedYoYo取得最先进结果,甚至在全局长尾设置下超越集中式对数调整方法5.4%。代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FedYoYo-1F01获取。
abstract_en: Data heterogeneity, stemming from local non-IID data and global long-tailed distributions, is a major challenge in federated learning (FL), leading to significant performance gaps compared to centralized learning. Previous research found that poor representations and biased classifiers are the main problems and proposed neural-collapse-inspired synthetic simplex ETF to help representations be closer to neural collapse optima. However, we find that the neural-collapse-inspired methods are not strong enough to reach neural collapse and still have huge gaps to centralized training. In this paper, we rethink this issue from a self-distillation perspective and propose FedYoYo (You Are Your Own Best Teacher), introducing Augmented Self-bootstrap Distillation (ASD) to improve representation learning by distilling knowledge between weakly and strongly augmented local samples, without needing extra datasets or models. We further introduce Distribution-aware Logit Adjustment (DLA) to balance the self-distillation process and correct biased feature representations. FedYoYo nearly eliminates the performance gap, achieving centralized-level performance even under mixed heterogeneity. It enhances local representation learning, reducing model drift and improving convergence, with feature prototypes closer to neural collapse optimality. Extensive experiments show FedYoYo achieves state-of-the-art results, even surpassing centralized logit adjustment methods by 5.4% under global long-tailed settings. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FedYoYo-1F01.
authors: Shanshan Yan, Zexi Li, Chao Wu, Meng Pang, Yang Lu, Yan Yan, Hanzi Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 2750-2759

title: 你共享信念,我适应:渐进式异构协同感知
title_en: You Share Beliefs, I Adapt: Progressive Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception
abstract: 协同感知通过信息共享使车辆能够克服个体感知局限,从而实现更远距离的观测和穿透遮挡。在现实场景中,不同车辆上的模型往往因制造商差异而异构。现有异构协同感知方法通过微调适配器或整个网络来弥合域差距。然而,这些方法在实际应用中不切实际,因为每个新协作方需在推理前与本车在数据集上进行联合训练,或本车需提前存储所有潜在协作方的模型。因此,我们提出新问题:能否在推理过程中直接解决这一挑战,无需联合训练?为回答这一问题,我们提出渐进式异构协同感知(PHCP),一种将问题建模为少样本无监督域适应的新框架。与以往方法不同,PHCP通过推理过程中自训练适配器动态对齐特征,无需标注数据和联合训练。在OPV2V数据集上的大量实验表明,PHCP在多样化的异构场景中表现出色。值得注意的是,PHCP仅使用少量无标签数据即可达到与在完整数据集上训练的SOTA方法相当的性能。
abstract_en: Collaborative perception enables vehicles to overcome individual perception limitations by sharing information, allowing them to see further and through occlusions. In real-world scenarios, models on different vehicles are often heterogeneous due to manufacturer variations. Existing methods for heterogeneous collaborative perception address this challenge by fine-tuning adapters or the entire network to bridge the domain gap. However, these methods are impractical in real-world applications, as each new collaborator must undergo joint training with the ego vehicle on a dataset before inference, or the ego vehicle stores models for all potential collaborators in advance. Therefore, we pose a new question: Can we tackle this challenge directly during inference, eliminating the need for joint training? To answer this, we introduce Progressive Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception (PHCP), a novel framework that formulates the problem as few-shot unsupervised domain adaptation. Unlike previous work, PHCP dynamically aligns features by self-training an adapter during inference, eliminating the need for labeled data and joint training. Extensive experiments on the OPV2V dataset demonstrate that PHCP achieves strong performance across diverse heterogeneous scenarios. Notably, PHCP achieves performance comparable to SOTA methods trained on the entire dataset while using only a small amount of unlabeled data.
authors: Hao Si, Ehsan Javanmardi, Manabu Tsukada ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 27521-27530

title: 你思考,你行动:任意文本到运动生成的新任务
title_en: You Think, You ACT: The New Task of Arbitrary Text to Motion Generation
abstract: 文本到运动旨在从文本生成人类动作。现有方法依赖于包含动作标签(如"行走、弯曲")的有限动作文本,这限制了在难以直接描述的场景中灵活应用和实际可行性。本文将有限动作文本扩展为任意文本。不包含显式动作标签的场景文本可提升模型在虚拟人类交互、机器人行为生成和影视制作等复杂多样的行业中的实用性,同时支持潜在隐含行为模式的探索。然而,新引入的场景文本可能产生多种合理输出结果,给现有数据、框架和评估方法带来显著挑战。为解决这一实际问题,我们首先通过扩展现有最大数据集HumanML3D的文本创建了新数据集HumanML3D++。其次,我们提出了一种简单有效的框架,从任意文本中提取动作指令并生成运动。此外,我们还通过多解度指标对这一新设定进行基准测试,以弥补现有单解度指标的不足。大量实验表明,在这种现实设定下文本到运动具有挑战性,推动了该实用方向的新研究。更多细节请参见https://github.com/RunqiWang77/TAAT.github.io。
abstract_en: Text to Motion aims to generate human motions from texts. Existing settings rely on limited Action Texts that include action labels (e.g., "walk, bend"), which limits flexibility and practicability in scenarios difficult to describe directly. This paper extends limited Action Texts to arbitrary ones. Scene texts without explicit action labels can enhance the practicality of models in complex and diverse industries such as virtual human interaction, robot behavior generation, and film production, while also supporting the exploration of potential implicit behavior patterns. However, newly introduced Scene Texts may yield multiple reasonable output results, causing significant challenges in existing data, framework, and evaluation.To address this practical issue, we first create a new dataset, HumanML3D++, by extending texts of the largest existing dataset, HumanML3D. Secondly, we propose a simple yet effective framework that extracts action instructions from arbitrary texts and subsequently generates motions. Furthermore, we also benchmark this new setting with multi-solution metrics to address the inadequacies of existing single-solution metrics. Extensive experiments indicate that Text to Motion in this realistic setting is challenging, fostering new research in this practical direction. More details are available in https://github.com/RunqiWang77/TAAT.github.io.
authors: Runqi Wang, Caoyuan Ma, Guopeng Li, Hanrui Xu, Yuke Li, Zheng Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12012-12022

title: Your Text Encoder Can Be An Object-Level Watermarking Controller
title_en: Your Text Encoder Can Be An Object-Level Watermarking Controller
abstract: AI生成图像的不可见水印技术可助力版权保护,实现对AI生成媒体的检测与识别。本文提出一种针对文本到图像(T2I)潜扩散模型(LDMs)图像水印的新方法。通过仅微调文本标记嵌入__ABS_MATH_1__,我们能够在选定对象或图像部分实现水印嵌入,相较于传统全图水印方案具有更高的灵活性。本方法利用文本编码器在各类LDMs中的兼容性,支持不同LDMs的即插即用集成。此外,在编码阶段早期引入水印可提升后续流程中对抗扰动的鲁棒性。实验表明,该方法在48位水印下达到99%的比特准确率,同时将模型参数量减少10^5倍,实现了高效的水印嵌入。
abstract_en: Invisible watermarking of AI-generated images can help with copyright protection, enabling detection and identification of AI-generated media. In this work, we present a novel approach to watermark images of T2I Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs). By only fine-tuning text token embeddings \mathcal W _*, we enable watermarking in selected objects or parts of the image, offering greater flexibility compared to traditional full-image watermarking. Our method leverages the text encoder's compatibility across various LDMs, allowing plug-and-play integration for different LDMs. Moreover, introducing the watermark early in the encoding stage improves robustness to adversarial perturbations in later stages of the pipeline. Our approach achieves 99% bit accuracy (48 bits) with a 10^5 xreduction in model parameters, enabling efficient watermarking.
authors: Naresh Kumar Devulapally, Mingzhen Huang, Vishal Asnani, Shruti Agarwal, Siwei Lyu, Vishnu Suresh Lokhande ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 16576-16585

title: ZFusion: 面向盲图像超分辨率的高效深度组合零样本学习方法与生成扩散先验
title_en: ZFusion: Efficient Deep Compositional Zero-shot Learning for Blind Image Super-Resolution with Generative Diffusion Prior
abstract: 深度盲图像超分辨率(Blind SR)方案致力于在各种图像退化过程中提供高性能。尽管盲图像超分辨率领域取得了显著进展,但这些方法在现实退化操作下的性能仍可能不尽如人意。本文提出了一种基于扩散的盲图像超分辨率方法,通过利用组合零样本学习,能够为合成与现实未知退化过程提供优越性能。具体而言,我们首先以组合零样本学习方式从输入视觉信号中提取合成与现实退化嵌入。随后,我们将此类退化嵌入高效地嵌入到基于扩散的方案架构中,以指导扩散特征生成过程。大量实验结果验证了所提盲图像超分辨率方法的有效性,其性能优于现有最先进的算法。我们的源代码和预训练模型将公开提供。
abstract_en: Deep blind image super resolution (Blind SR) schemes strive to provide high performances under various image degradation processes. Despite the significant advancement in the area of Blind SR, the performances of these methods still may not be as high as one would desire in the case of real-world degradation operations. In this paper, we develop a novel diffusion-based Blind SR method, which, by leveraging compositional zero-shot learning, is able to provide superior performances for both synthetic and real-world unknown degradation processes. Specifically, we first extract both synthetic and real-world degradation embeddings from the input visual signal in a compositional zero-shot fashion. Next, we have efficiently embedded such degradation embeddings in the architecture of our diffusion-based scheme for guiding the diffusion feature generation process. The results of extensive experiments have demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed Blind SR method over the state-of-the-art algorithms. Our source code and pre-trained models will be publicly available.
authors: Alireza Esmaeilzehi, Hossein Zaredar, Yapeng Tian, Laleh Seyyed-Kalantari ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 12338-12348

title: ZIM:面向任意对象的零样本图像抠图
title_en: ZIM: Zero-Shot Image Matting for Anything
abstract: 近期的分割基础模型分割任何模型(Segment Anything Model, SAM)展现出强大的零样本分割能力,但在生成细粒度精确遮罩方面存在不足。为解决这一局限性,我们提出了一种新型零样本图像抠图模型ZIM,具有两项关键贡献:首先,我们开发了标签转换器,将分割标签转换为详细遮罩标签,构建了无需昂贵人工标注的新SA1B-Matte数据集。使用该数据集训练SAM,使其在保持零样本能力的同时生成精确的遮罩。其次,我们设计了配备层次化像素解码器的零样本抠图模型,以增强遮罩表示,同时结合提示感知的遮罩注意力机制,通过使模型聚焦于视觉提示指定的区域来提升性能。我们使用新引入的MicroMat-3K测试集评估ZIM,该测试集包含高质量的微粒级遮罩标签。实验结果表明,ZIM在细粒度遮罩生成和零样本泛化方面均优于现有方法。此外,我们展示了ZIM在需要精确遮罩的多种下游任务中的通用性,如图像修复和3D分割。我们的贡献为推进零样本抠图及其在广泛计算机视觉任务中的下游应用提供了坚实基础。代码可在https://naver-ai.github.io/ZIM获取。
abstract_en: The recent segmentation foundation model, Segment Anything Model (SAM), exhibits strong zero-shot segmentation capabilities, but it falls short in generating fine-grained precise masks. To address this limitation, we propose a novel zero-shot image matting model, called ZIM, with two key contributions: First, we develop a label converter that transforms segmentation labels into detailed matte labels, constructing the new SA1B-Matte dataset without costly manual annotations. Training SAM with this dataset enables it to generate precise matte masks while maintaining its zero-shot capability. Second, we design the zero-shot matting model equipped with a hierarchical pixel decoder to enhance mask representation, along with a prompt-aware masked attention mechanism to improve performance by enabling the model to focus on regions specified by visual prompts. We evaluate ZIM using the newly introduced MicroMat-3K test set, which contains high-quality micro-level matte labels. Experimental results show that ZIM outperforms existing methods in fine-grained mask generation and zero-shot generalization. Furthermore, we demonstrate the versatility of ZIM in various downstream tasks requiring precise masks, such as image inpainting and 3D segmentation. Our contributions provide a robust foundation for advancing zero-shot matting and its downstream applications across a wide range of computer vision tasks. The code is available at https://naver-ai.github.io/ZIM.
authors: Beomyoung Kim, Chanyong Shin, Joonhyun Jeong, Hyungsik Jung, Se-Yun Lee, Sewhan Chun, Dong-Hyun Hwang, Joonsang Yu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 23828-23838

title: ZIUM: 零样本意图感知对抗攻击在已遗忘模型中的应用
title_en: ZIUM: Zero-Shot Intent-Aware Adversarial Attack on Unlearned Models
abstract: 机器遗忘(MU)通过移除深度学习模型中的特定数据点或概念,以增强隐私并防止敏感内容生成。对抗性提示可以利用已遗忘的模型生成包含被移除概念的内容,构成重大安全风险。然而,现有对抗攻击方法在生成符合攻击者意图的内容时仍面临挑战,同时需要高昂的计算成本来识别成功提示。为解决这些问题,我们提出ZIUM,一种针对已遗忘模型的零样本意图感知对抗攻击方法,能够灵活定制目标攻击图像以反映攻击者的意图。此外,ZIUM支持无需对先前攻击过的已遗忘概念进行进一步优化的零样本对抗攻击。在多种MU场景的评估中,ZIUM证明了其在基于用户意图提示成功定制内容方面的有效性,同时相比现有方法实现了更高的攻击成功率。此外,其零样本对抗攻击显著减少了对先前攻击过的已遗忘概念的攻击时间。
abstract_en: Machine unlearning (MU) removes specific data points or concepts from deep learning models to enhance privacy and prevent sensitive content generation. Adversarial prompts can exploit unlearned models to generate content containing removed concepts, posing a significant security risk. However, existing adversarial attack methods still face challenges in generating content that aligns with an attacker's intent while incurring high computational costs to identify successful prompts. To address these challenges, we propose ZIUM, a Zero-shot Intent-aware adversarial attack on Unlearned Models, which enables the flexible customization of target attack images to reflect an attacker's intent. Additionally, ZIUM supports zero-shot adversarial attacks without requiring further optimization for previously attacked unlearned concepts. The evaluation across various MU scenarios demonstrated ZIUM's effectiveness in successfully customizing content based on user-intent prompts while achieving a superior attack success rate compared to existing methods. Moreover, its zero-shot adversarial attack significantly reduces the attack time for previously attacked unlearned concepts.
authors: Hyun Jun Yook, Ga San Jhun, Jae Hyun Cho, Min Jeon, Donghyun Kim, Tae Hyung Kim, Youn Kyu Lee ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3926-3935

title: Zero-AVSR: 基于学习语言无关语音表示的零样本音频-视觉语音识别与大语言模型
title_en: Zero-AVSR: Zero-Shot Audio-Visual Speech Recognition with LLMs by Learning Language-Agnostic Speech Representations
abstract: 我们探索了一种新颖的零样本音频-视觉语音识别(AVSR)框架,称为Zero-AVSR,该框架能够在无需目标语言音频-视觉语音数据的情况下实现语音识别。具体而言,我们引入了音频-视觉语音罗马化器(AV-Romanizer),通过预测罗马字文本来学习语言无关的语音表示。随后,借助大语言模型(LLMs)强大的多语言建模能力,我们提出将预测的罗马字文本转换为语言特定字符,形成所提出的级联零样本AVSR。进一步地,我们探索了一种统一的零样本AVSR方法,通过直接将AV-Romanizer编码的音频-视觉语音表示集成到LLM中实现。这通过我们提出的多任务学习方案对适配器和LLM进行微调来完成。为捕捉广泛的语音和语言多样性,我们还引入了一个多语言音频-视觉罗马化语料库(MARC),包含82种语言共计2,916小时的音频-视觉语音数据,以及语言特定字符和罗马字文本的转录。大量分析和实验验证了所提出的Zero-AVSR框架具有扩展语言支持的潜力,超越AV-Romanizer训练时所见的语言范围。代码可在https://bit.ly/zero-avsr获取。
abstract_en: We explore a novel zero-shot Audio-Visual Speech Recognition (AVSR) framework, dubbed Zero-AVSR, which enables speech recognition in target languages without requiring any audio-visual speech data in those languages. Specifically, we introduce the Audio-Visual Speech Romanizer (AV-Romanizer), which learns language-agnostic speech representations by predicting Roman text. Then, by leveraging the strong multilingual modeling capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), we propose converting the predicted Roman text into language-specific graphemes, forming the proposed Cascaded Zero-AVSR. Taking it a step further, we explore a unified Zero-AVSR approach by directly integrating the audio-visual speech representations encoded by the AV-Romanizer into the LLM. This is achieved through finetuning the adapter and the LLM using our proposed multi-task learning scheme. To capture the wide spectrum of phonetic and linguistic diversity, we also introduce a Multilingual Audio-Visual Romanized Corpus (MARC) consisting of 2,916 hours of audio-visual speech data across 82 languages, along with transcriptions in both language-specific graphemes and Roman text. Extensive analysis and experiments confirm that the proposed Zero-AVSR framework has the potential to expand language support beyond the languages seen during the training of the AV-Romanizer. Code is available at https://bit.ly/zero-avsr.
authors: Jeong Hun Yeo, Minsu Kim, Chae Won Kim, Stavros Petridis, Yong Man Ro ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6693-6703

title: 基于双流指令感知蒸馏的零样本组合图像检索
title_en: Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval via Dual-Stream Instruction-Aware Distillation
abstract: 组合图像检索(CIR)旨在根据参考图像和文本修改条件检索图像,但构建标注三元组(参考图像、文本修改、目标图像)本质上具有挑战性。现有的零样本组合图像检索(ZS-CIR)方法通常依赖于对齐良好的视觉-语言模型(VLMs)来结合视觉和文本输入,或使用大语言模型(LLMs)以获得更丰富的修改理解。尽管基于LLM的方法在捕捉文本细节方面表现出色,但其计算成本高、推理速度慢且常受专有约束限制。在本文中,我们认为基于LLM的ZS-CIR方法的优越性能主要源于其遵循指令的能力,而这一特性在基于VLMs构建的更高效的投影模型中普遍存在缺失。为弥合这一差距,我们引入DistillCIR,这是一种双流蒸馏框架,将LLM的指令遵循能力转移到紧凑的投影架构中。通过使用LLM合成三元组数据并结合新颖的推理过程,DistillCIR同时学习组合检索和指令感知能力。此外,我们在生成的数据上训练了一个开源的多模态LLM,并进一步将该模型的指令感知嵌入蒸馏到投影架构中。在推理过程中无需依赖LLM,DistillCIR在性能和效率上均显著超越现有最先进的ZS-CIR方法,为具有指令感知能力的轻量级CIR提供了有前景的方向。
abstract_en: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) targets the retrieval of images conditioned on a reference image and a textual modification, but constructing labeled triplets (reference image, textual modification, target image) is inherently challenging. Existing Zero-Shot CIR (ZS-CIR) approaches often rely on well-aligned vision-language models (VLMs) to combine visual and textual inputs, or use large language models (LLMs) for richer modification understanding. While LLM-based methods excel in capturing textual details, they are computationally costly, slow to infer, and often restricted by proprietary constraints. In this paper, we argue that the superior performance of LLM-based ZS-CIR methods primarily stems from their capacity to follow instructions, an aspect largely missing in more efficient projection-based models built upon VLMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce DistillCIR, a dual-stream distillation framework that transfers LLMs' instruction-following capability into compact, projection-based architectures. By synthesizing triplet data with an LLM and incorporating a novel reasoning process, DistillCIR learns both composed retrieval and instruction awareness. In addition, we train an open-source multimodal LLM on the generated data, and further distill its instruction-aware embeddings into the projection-based model. Without any reliance on LLMs at inference, DistillCIR significantly surpasses state-of-the-art ZS-CIR methods in both performance and efficiency, offering a promising direction for instruction-aware, lightweight CIR.
authors: Wenliang Zhong, Rob Barton, Weizhi An, Feng Jiang, Hehuan Ma, Yuzhi Guo, Abhishek Dan, Shioulin Sam, Karim Bouyarmane, Junzhou Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22221-22231

title: 零样本组合视频学习与编码率降低
title_en: Zero-Shot Compositional Video Learning with Coding Rate Reduction
abstract: 本文提出了一种受儿童高效学习新概念并灵活扩展现有知识框架启发的新型零样本组合视频理解方法。尽管近期大规模视觉语言模型(VLMs)在各类任务中取得了显著进展并展现出 impressive 性能提升,但它们需要大量数据和计算资源。然而,尽管在基准测试中表现强劲,这些模型往往无法解决简单的零样本组合任务。此外,针对视频数据设计的 VLMs 需要更庞大的计算资源。我们引入了一种受人类组合学习启发的新视频表征学习方法以应对这些挑战。具体而言,我们证明实现零样本组合学习需要有效的表征学习,将给定数据解耦为有意义的语义单元。我们提出了一种基于信息论度量的新方法,通过优化编码率降低,成功从视频中学习到时空解耦的特征,这是最具挑战性的数据之一。我们的方法显著增强了组合泛化能力,在零样本学习场景中展现出有效性。
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a novel zero-shot compositional video understanding method inspired by how young children efficiently learn new concepts and flexibly expand their existing knowledge framework. While recent large-scale visual language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable advancements and demonstrated impressive performance improvements across various tasks, they require massive amounts of data and computational resources. However, despite their strong benchmark performance, they often fail to solve simple zero-shot composition tasks. Moreover, VLMs designed for video data demand even greater computational resources. We introduce a new video representation learning method inspired by human compositional learning to address these challenges. Specifically, we demonstrate that achieving zero-shot compositional learning requires effective representation learning that disentangles given data into meaningful semantic units. We propose a novel method that learns such disentangled representations based on an information-theoretic measure. By optimizing coding rate reduction, we successfully learn spatio-temporally disentangled features from videos, one of the most challenging data. Our approach significantly enhances compositional generalizability, demonstrating its effectiveness in zero-shot learning scenarios.
authors: Heeseok Jung, Jun-Hyeon Bak, Yujin Jeong, Gyugeun Lee, Jinwoo Ahn, Eun-Sol Kim ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20508-20518

title: 基于扩散模型的零样本深度感知图像编辑
title_en: Zero-Shot Depth Aware Image Editing with Diffusion Models
abstract: 扩散模型已改变了图像编辑领域,但在精确的深度感知控制方面仍存在困难,例如将物体放置在指定深度。分层表示通过将图像分解为可编辑的独立层,实现了细粒度控制。然而,现有方法简单地通过背景和透明前景层集合表示场景,而忽略了场景几何信息,限制了其在深度感知编辑中的有效性。我们提出深度引导的分层分解方法,该方法根据用户指定的深度值将图像分解为前景和背景层,从而实现精确的深度感知编辑。我们进一步提出特征引导的分层合成方法,这是一种零样本的现实分层合成方法,通过利用预训练扩散模型的生成先验知识。具体而言,我们指导内部U-Net特征在每个去噪步骤中逐步融合单个层到复合潜变量。这种方法在保持各层结构的同时,无需后处理调和模型即可生成具有适当颜色和光照调整的现实输出。我们在两个关键的深度感知编辑任务上验证了我们的方法:1)通过在指定深度将一个场景的前景与另一个场景的背景融合实现场景合成;2)在用户定义的深度位置插入物体。我们的零样本方法实现了精确的深度排序和高质量的编辑效果,超越了专门的场景合成和物体放置基线,经过基准测试和用户研究验证。
abstract_en: Diffusion models have transformed image editing but struggle with precise depth-aware control, such as placing objects at a specified depth. Layered representations offer fine-grained control by decomposing an image into separate editable layers. However, existing methods simplistically represent a scene via a set of background and transparent foreground layers while ignoring the scene geometry - limiting their effectiveness for depth-aware editing.
