We propose Depth-Guided Layer Decomposition - a layering method that decomposes an image into foreground and background layers based on a user-specified depth value, enabling precise depth-aware edits. We further propose Feature Guided Layer Compositing - a zero-shot approach for realistic layer compositing by leveraging generative priors from pretrained diffusion models. Specifically, we guide the internal U-Net features to progressively fuse individual layers into a composite latent at each denoising step. This preserves the structure of individual layers while generating realistic outputs with appropriate color and lighting adjustments without a need for post-hoc harmonization models. We demonstrate our method on two key depth-aware editing tasks: 1) scene compositing by blending the foreground of one scene with the background of another at a specified depth, and; 2) object insertion at a user-defined depth. Our zero-shot approach achieves precise depth ordering and high-quality edits, surpassing specialized scene compositing and object placement baselines, as validated across benchmarks and user studies.
authors: Rishubh Parihar, Sachidanand VS, R. Venkatesh Babu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 15748-15759

title: 通过大语言模型代理模型实现的零样本视觉编码器移植
title_en: Zero-Shot Vision Encoder Grafting via LLM Surrogates
abstract: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)通常将一个中等规模的视觉编码器与一个大语言模型(LLM),例如Llama-70B进行配对,使得解码器在训练期间成为主要的计算负担。为降低计算成本,一种有前景的策略是先使用小型语言模型训练视觉编码器,再将其迁移到大型模型上。我们构建了小型"代理模型",通过直接继承其浅层结构,使其共享与大型目标LLM相同的嵌入空间和表示语言。在代理模型上训练的视觉编码器可以直接迁移到更大的模型上,我们称之为零样本移植——当直接插入完整尺寸的目标LLM时,移植后的编码器-目标LLM对的表现超越编码器-代理模型对,并在某些基准测试中甚至与使用目标LLM的完整解码器训练表现相当。此外,我们的代理训练方法在使用Llama-70B作为解码器时,将总体VLM训练成本降低了45%。
abstract_en: Vision language models (VLMs) typically pair a modestly sized vision encoder with a large language model (LLM), e.g., Llama-70B, making the decoder the primary computational burden during training.To reduce costs, a promising strategy is to first train the vision encoder using a small language model before transferring it to the large one.We construct small "surrogate models" that share the same embedding space and representation language as the large target LLM by directly inheriting its shallow layers.Vision encoders trained on the surrogate can then be directly transferred to the larger model, a process we call zero-shot grafting -- when plugged directly into the full-size target LLM, the grafted pair surpasses the encoder-surrogate pair and, on some benchmarks, even performs on par with full decoder training with the target LLM.Furthermore, our surrogate training approach reduces overall VLM training costs by  45% when using Llama-70B as the decoder.
authors: Kaiyu Yue, Vasu Singla, Menglin Jia, John Kirchenbauer, Rifaa Qadri, Zikui Cai, Abhinav Bhatele, Furong Huang, Tom Goldstein ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4275-4284

title: 基于单张图像的零样本不精确CAD模型对齐
title_en: Zero-shot Inexact CAD Model Alignment from a Single Image
abstract: 一种从单张图像推断3D场景结构的实用方法是:从数据库中检索高度匹配的3D模型,并将其与图像中的物体进行对齐。现有方法依赖于带有图像和姿态标注的监督训练,这限制了其只能处理有限的物体类别。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种弱监督的九自由度对齐方法,用于不精确的3D模型,该方法无需场景级姿态标注,并能泛化到未见过的类别。我们的方法基于基础特征构建了新颖的特征空间,通过自监督三元组损失确保多视角一致性,并克服基础特征固有的对称性歧义。此外,我们引入了一种纹理不变的姿态优化技术,通过增强的特征空间估计的归一化物体坐标进行密集对齐。我们在现实世界的ScanNet25k数据集上进行了广泛评估,结果表明我们的方法在均值对齐精度上优于当前最优弱监督基线4.3%,且是唯一超越监督ROCA的弱监督方法,优势达2.7%。为评估泛化能力,我们引入了SUN2CAD,这是一个包含20个新颖物体类别的现实世界测试集,我们的方法在未经这些类别训练的情况下取得了SOTA结果。
abstract_en: One practical approach to infer 3D scene structure from a single image is to retrieve a closely matching 3D model from a database and align it with the object in the image. Existing methods rely on supervised training with images and pose annotations, which limits them to a narrow set of object categories. To address this, we propose a weakly supervised 9-DoF alignment method for inexact 3D models that requires no scene-level pose annotations and generalizes to unseen categories. Our approach derives a novel feature space based on foundation features that ensure multi-view consistency and overcome symmetry ambiguities inherent in foundation features using a self-supervised triplet loss. Additionally, we introduce a texture-invariant pose refinement technique that performs dense alignment in normalized object coordinates, estimated through the enhanced feature space. We conduct extensive evaluations on the real-world ScanNet25k dataset, where our method outperforms SOTA weakly supervised baselines by +4.3% mean alignment accuracy and is the only weakly supervised approach to surpass the supervised ROCA by +2.7%. To assess generalization, we introduce SUN2CAD, a real-world test set with 20 novel object categories, where our method achieves SOTA results without prior training on them.
authors: Pattaramanee Arsomngern, Sasikarn Khwanmuang, Matthias Nießner, Supasorn Suwajanakorn ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 6231-6241

title: ZeroKey:基于大语言模型的点级推理与零样本三维关键点检测
title_en: ZeroKey: Point-Level Reasoning and Zero-Shot 3D Keypoint Detection from Large Language Models
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的零样本方法用于三维形状的关键点检测。在视觉数据上进行点级推理具有挑战性,因为需要精确的定位能力,即使是像DINO或CLIP这样强大的模型也会面临困难。传统三维关键点检测方法高度依赖标注的三维数据集和大量的监督训练,限制了其在新类别或领域中的可扩展性和适用性。相比之下,我们的方法利用了多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)中嵌入的丰富知识。具体而言,我们首次证明,用于训练近期MLLMs的像素级标注可以用于在三维模型上提取和命名显著关键点,而无需任何真实标签或监督。实验评估表明,尽管训练过程中不需要任何三维关键点标注,我们的方法在标准基准测试中仍能与监督方法取得具有竞争力的性能。我们的结果突显了将语言模型整合到局部三维形状理解中的潜力。本工作为跨模态学习开辟了新途径,并强调了MLLMs在解决三维计算机视觉挑战中的有效性。
abstract_en: We propose a novel zero-shot approach for keypoint detection on 3D shapes. Point-level reasoning on visual data is challenging as it requires precise localization capability, posing problems even for powerful models like DINO or CLIP. Traditional methods for 3D keypoint detection rely heavily on annotated 3D datasets and extensive supervised training, limiting their scalability and applicability to new categories or domains. In contrast, our method utilizes the rich knowledge embedded within Multi-Modal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Specifically, we demonstrate, for the first time, that pixel-level annotations used to train recent MLLMs can be exploited for both extracting and naming salient keypoints on 3D models without any ground truth labels or supervision. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that our approach achieves competitive performance on standard benchmarks compared to supervised methods, despite not requiring any 3D keypoint annotations during training. Our results highlight the potential of integrating language models for localized 3D shape understanding. This work opens new avenues for cross-modal learning and underscores the effectiveness of MLLMs in contributing to 3D computer vision challenges.
authors: Bingchen Gong, Diego Gomez, Abdullah Hamdi, Abdelrahman Eldesokey, Ahmed Abdelreheem, Peter Wonka, Maks Ovsjanikov ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 22089-22099

title: ZeroStereo:基于单张图像的零样本立体匹配
title_en: ZeroStereo: Zero-shot Stereo Matching from Single Images
abstract: 当前最先进的监督立体匹配方法在各类基准测试中表现出色。然而,由于真实世界立体数据标注的稀缺性,其在现实场景中的泛化能力仍面临挑战。本文提出ZeroStereo,一种新型的零样本立体匹配图像生成流程。我们的方法通过单目深度估计模型生成的伪视差,从任意单张图像中合成高质量的右图像。与先前通过邻近像素或随机背景填充缺失区域的方法不同,我们微调扩散修复模型以恢复缺失细节同时保持语义结构。此外,我们提出无需训练的置信度生成方法,可缓解不可靠伪标签的影响;并提出自适应视差选择机制,确保多样且真实的视差分布,同时避免过度遮挡和前景失真。实验表明,使用我们流程训练的模型在多个数据集上仅需与Scene Flow相当的数据量即可达到最先进的零样本泛化能力。代码:https://github.com/Windsrain/ZeroStereo
abstract_en: State-of-the-art supervised stereo matching methods have achieved remarkable performance on various benchmarks. However, their generalization to real-world scenarios remains challenging due to the scarcity of annotated real-world stereo data. In this paper, we propose ZeroStereo, a novel stereo image generation pipeline for zero-shot stereo matching. Our approach synthesizes high-quality right images from arbitrary single images by leveraging pseudo disparities generated by a monocular depth estimation model. Unlike previous methods that address occluded regions by filling missing areas with neighboring pixels or random backgrounds, we fine-tune a diffusion inpainting model to recover missing details while preserving semantic structure. Additionally, we propose Training-Free Confidence Generation, which mitigates the impact of unreliable pseudo labels without additional training, and Adaptive Disparity Selection, which ensures a diverse and realistic disparity distribution while preventing excessive occlusion and foreground distortion. Experiments demonstrate that models trained with our pipeline achieve state-of-the-art zero-shot generalization across multiple datasets with only a dataset volume comparable to Scene Flow. Code: https://github.com/Windsrain/ZeroStereo.
authors: Xianqi Wang, Hao Yang, Gangwei Xu, Junda Cheng, Min Lin, Yong Deng, Jinliang Zang, Yurui Chen, Xin Yang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28177-28187

title: 大语言模型在随机子空间中的零阶微调
title_en: Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of LLMs in Random Subspaces
abstract: 大语言模型(LLMs)的微调已被证明在多种下游任务中有效。然而,随着LLMs规模的增大,反向传播的内存需求变得愈发不可行。零阶(ZO)优化方法通过前向传播估计梯度,提供了一种内存高效的替代方案,但梯度估计的方差通常随模型参数维度线性增长——这对LLMs而言是一个重大问题。本文提出随机子空间零阶(SubZero)优化方法,以应对LLMs高维度带来的挑战。我们引入一种针对LLMs设计的低秩扰动方法,在显著降低内存消耗的同时提升性能。此外,我们证明了所提出的梯度估计方法能够紧密逼近反向传播梯度,其方差低于传统ZO方法,并且与SGD结合时可确保收敛性。实验结果表明,SubZero在多种语言建模任务中相比标准ZO方法(如MeZO)提升了微调性能并实现了更快的收敛速度。代码已开源至https://github.com/zimingyy/SubZero。
abstract_en: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) has proven effective for a variety of downstream tasks. However, as LLMs grow in size, the memory demands for backpropagation become increasingly prohibitive. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization methods offer a memory-efficient alternative by using forward passes to estimate gradients, but the variance of gradient estimates typically scales linearly with the model's parameter dimension--a significant issue for LLMs. In this paper, we propose the random Subspace Zeroth-order (SubZero) optimization to address the challenges posed by LLMs' high dimensionality. We introduce a low-rank perturbation tailored for LLMs that significantly reduces memory consumption while improving performance. Additionally, we prove that our gradient estimation closely approximates the backpropagation gradient, exhibits lower variance than traditional ZO methods, and ensures convergence when combined with SGD. Experimental results show that SubZero enhances fine-tuning performance and achieves faster convergence compared to standard ZO approaches like MeZO across various language modeling tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/zimingyy/SubZero.
authors: Ziming Yu, Pan Zhou, Sike Wang, Jia Li, Mi Tian, Hua Huang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 4475-4485

title: ZipVL: 通过动态令牌稀疏性加速视觉语言模型
title_en: ZipVL: Accelerating Vision-Language Models through Dynamic Token Sparsity
abstract: 大规模视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)的效率受到预填充阶段注意力机制计算瓶颈和解码阶段键值(KV)缓存获取内存瓶颈的制约,特别是在处理高分辨率图像或视频时。视觉内容往往存在大量冗余,导致LVLMs中注意力图谱高度稀疏。这种稀疏性可通过多种方法用于加速注意力计算或压缩KV缓存。然而,大多数研究仅针对上述瓶颈中的一个进行优化,未能充分支持针对不同层或任务动态调整稀疏性的需求。本文提出ZipVL,一种通过重要令牌动态比例分配策略设计的高效推理框架。该比例基于层特定的注意力分数分布自适应确定,而非固定超参数,从而在保持对复杂任务高性能的同时,提升对简单任务的效率。随后我们根据归一化注意力分数选择重要令牌,并仅在这些重要令牌上执行稀疏注意力机制,降低预填充阶段延迟。被判定为不重要的令牌将被丢弃以减小KV缓存规模,缓解解码阶段的内存瓶颈。我们的实验表明,ZipVL在VQAv2基准测试中仅损失0.5%准确率的情况下,相比LLaVA-Next-13B模型可将预填充阶段加速2.3倍,解码吞吐量提升2.8倍,有效提升LVLMs的生成效率。
abstract_en: The efficiency of large vision-language models (LVLMs) is constrained by the computational bottleneck of the attention mechanism during the prefill phase and the memory bottleneck of fetching the key-value (KV) cache in the decoding phase, particularly in scenarios involving high-resolution images or videos. Visual content often exhibits substantial redundancy, resulting in highly sparse attention maps within LVLMs. This sparsity can be leveraged to accelerate attention computation or compress the KV cache through various approaches. However, most studies focus on addressing only one of these bottlenecks and do not adequately support dynamic adjustment of sparsity concerning distinct layers or tasks. In this paper, we present ZipVL, an efficient inference framework designed for LVLMs through a dynamic ratio allocation strategy of important tokens. This ratio is adaptively determined based on the layer-specific distribution of attention scores, rather than fixed hyper-parameters, thereby improving efficiency for less complex tasks while maintaining high performance for more challenging ones. Then we select important tokens based on their normalized attention scores and perform sparse attention mechanism solely on those important tokens, reducing the latency in the prefill phase. Tokens deemed less important will be discarded to reduce KV cache size, alleviating the memory bottleneck in the decoding phase. Our experiments demonstrate that ZipVL can accelerate the prefill phase by 2.3x and improve decoding throughput by 2.8x, with a minimal accuracy reduction of only 0.5% on VQAv2 benchmark over LLaVA-Next-13B model, effectively enhancing the generation efficiency of LVLMs.
authors: Yefei He, Feng Chen, Jing Liu, Wenqi Shao, Hong Zhou, Kaipeng Zhang, Bohan Zhuang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 20477-20486

title: egoPPG:基于眼动追踪摄像头的以自我为中心系统心率估计以提升下游视觉任务
title_en: egoPPG: Heart Rate Estimation from Eye-Tracking Cameras in Egocentric Systems to Benefit Downstream Vision Tasks
abstract: 以自我为中心的视觉系统旨在理解空间环境及佩戴者在其中的行为,包括运动、活动和互动。我们认为,以自我为中心的系统还必须检测生理状态,以捕捉个体的注意力和情境反应,这对于情境感知行为建模至关重要。本文提出egoPPG,一种新型的以自我为中心视觉系统的视觉任务,用于恢复个体的心脏活动以辅助下游视觉任务。我们引入PulseFormer,一种从未经修改的以自我为中心视觉系统的眼动追踪摄像头中提取心率作为生理状态关键指标的方法。PulseFormer持续从眼周区域估计光电容积描记图(PPG),并融合头戴设备惯性测量单元的运动线索以跟踪心率值。我们在EgoExo4D数据集上展示了egoPPG的下游效益,该数据集是现有以自我为中心数据集,我们发现PulseFormer的心率估计使熟练度估计提升了14%。为了训练和验证PulseFormer,我们收集了来自Project Aria的13小时以上眼动追踪视频数据集、接触式PPG信号以及心电图(ECG)作为真实心率值的基准。与EgoExo4D类似,25名参与者执行了办公、烹饪、跳舞和锻炼等多样化日常活动,这些活动引发了显著的自然运动和心率变化(44-164次/分钟)。我们的模型稳健地估计心率(MAE=7.67次/分钟)并捕捉模式(r=0.85)。我们的结果表明,以自我为中心的系统如何统一环境和生理状态追踪以更好地理解用户,并且egoPPG作为补充任务为现有数据集和任务提供了有意义的增强。我们发布了代码、数据集和针对EgoExo4D的心率增强数据以激励生理感知以自我为中心任务的研究。
abstract_en: Egocentric vision systems aim to understand the spatial surroundings and the wearer's behavior inside it, including motions, activities, and interactions. We argue that egocentric systems must additionally detect physiological states to capture a person's attention and situational responses, which are critical for context-aware behavior modeling. In this paper, we propose egoPPG, a novel vision task for egocentric systems to recover a person's cardiac activity to aid downstream vision tasks. We introduce PulseFormer, a method to extract heart rate as a key indicator of physiological state from the eye tracking cameras on unmodified egocentric vision systems. PulseFormer continuously estimates the photoplethysmogram (PPG) from areas around the eyes and fuses motion cues from the headset's inertial measurement unit to track HR values. We demonstrate egoPPG's downstream benefit for a key task on EgoExo4D, an existing egocentric dataset for which we find PulseFormer's estimates of HR to improve proficiency estimation by 14%. To train and validate PulseFormer, we collected a dataset of 13+ hours of eye tracking videos from Project Aria and contact-based PPG signals as well as an electrocardiogram (ECG) for ground-truth HR values. Similar to EgoExo4D, 25 participants performed diverse everyday activities such as office work, cooking, dancing, and exercising, which induced significant natural motion and HR variation (44-164 bpm). Our model robustly estimates HR (MAE=7.67 bpm) and captures patterns (r=0.85). Our results show how egocentric systems may unify environmental and physiological tracking to better understand users and that egoPPG as a complementary task provides meaningful augmentations for existing datasets and tasks. We release our code, dataset, and HR augmentations for EgoExo4D to inspire research on physiology-aware egocentric tasks.
authors: Björn Braun, Rayan Armani, Manuel Meier, Max Moebus, Christian Holz ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 5579-5590

title: iManip:面向机器人操作的技能增量学习
title_en: iManip: Skill-Incremental Learning for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: 在机器人学界,开发具备自适应多操作技能的通用智能体一直是长期目标。本文探讨了机器人操作中的关键任务——技能增量学习,即在不重新训练的前提下,使机器人能够基于先前学习的知识学习新操作技能。首先,我们基于RLBench基准构建了技能增量环境,并探索传统增量方法在此场景下的表现。我们发现,由于先前分类方法忽视了机器人操作任务中时间性和动作复杂性的特征,导致严重的灾难性遗忘问题。为此,我们提出了一种增量操作框架,称为iManip,以缓解上述问题。我们首先设计了时间回放策略,以在学习新技能时保持旧技能的完整性。此外,我们提出了可扩展的PerceiverIO架构,包含可适应新技能中新型动作原语的可扩展权重动作提示。大量实验表明,我们的框架在技能增量学习中表现优异。
abstract_en: The development of a generalist agent with adaptive multiple manipulation skills has been a long-standing goal in the robotics community.In this paper, we explore a crucial task, skill-incremental learning, in robotic manipulation, which is to endow the robots with the ability to learn new manipulation skills based on the previous learned knowledge without re-training. First, we build a skill-incremental environment based on the RLBench benchmark, and explore how traditional incremental methods perform in this setting. We find that they suffer from severe catastrophic forgetting due to the previous methods on classification overlooking the characteristics of temporality and action complexity in robotic manipulation tasks. Towards this end, we propose an incremental Manipulation framework, termed iManip, to mitigate the above issues. We firstly design a temporal replay strategy to maintain the integrity of old skills when learning new skill. Moreover, we propose the Extendable PerceiverIO, consisting of an action prompt with extendable weight to adapt to new action primitives in new skill. Extensive experiments show that our framework performs well in Skill-Incremental Learning.
authors: Zexin Zheng, Jia-Feng Cai, Xiao-Ming Wu, Yi-Lin Wei, Yu-Ming Tang, Ancong Wu, Wei-Shi Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13890-13900

title: kh: 通过手性解缠实现三维形状的对称性理解
title_en: kh: Symmetry Understanding of 3D Shapes via Chirality Disentanglement
abstract: 手性信息(即能够区分左右的信息)在计算机视觉的各种数据模式中普遍存在,包括图像、视频、点云和网格。尽管手性在图像领域已得到广泛研究,但在形状分析(如点云和网格)中的探索仍显不足。尽管许多形状顶点描述符表现出吸引人的特性(例如对刚体变换的鲁棒性),但它们往往无法区分左右对称部分。考虑到手性信息在不同形状分析问题中的普遍性以及当前形状描述符中缺乏手性感知特征,开发手性特征提取器变得必要且紧迫。基于最近的Diff3F框架,我们提出了一种无监督的手性特征提取流程,通过从2D基础模型中提取的手性感知信息来装饰形状顶点。我们通过在多样化数据集上的定量和定性实验评估了提取的手性特征。在包括左右解缠、形状匹配和部分分割等下游任务中的结果证明了其有效性与实用价值。项目页面: https://wei-kang-wang.github.io/chirality/
abstract_en: Chirality information (i.e. information that allows distinguishing left from right) is ubiquitous for various data modes in computer vision, including images, videos, point clouds, and meshes. While chirality has been extensively studied in the image domain, its exploration in shape analysis (such as point clouds and meshes) remains underdeveloped. Although many shape vertex descriptors have shown appealing properties (e.g. robustness to rigid-body transformations), they are often not able to disambiguate between left and right symmetric parts. Considering the ubiquity of chirality information in different shape analysis problems and the lack of chirality-aware features within current shape descriptors, developing a chirality feature extractor becomes necessary and urgent. Based on the recent Diff3F framework, we propose an unsupervised chirality feature extraction pipeline to decorate shape vertices with chirality-aware information, extracted from 2D foundation models. We evaluated the extracted chirality features through quantitative and qualitative experiments across diverse datasets. Results from downstream tasks including left-right disentanglement, shape matching, and part segmentation demonstrate their effectiveness and practical utility. Project page: https://wei-kang-wang.github.io/chirality/
authors: Weikang Wang, Tobias Weißberg, Nafie El Amrani, Florian Bernard ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28292-28302

title: mmCooper:一种多智能体多阶段通信高效且协作鲁棒的协同感知框架
title_en: mmCooper: A Multi-agent Multi-stage Communication-efficient and Collaboration-robust Cooperative Perception Framework
abstract: 协同感知通过智能体间的感知信息交换显著提升了单车辆的感知性能。然而,实际部署面临由于信息交换过程中的带宽限制和不可避免的校准误差带来的挑战。为解决这些问题,我们提出mmCooper,一种新颖的多智能体、多阶段、通信高效且协作鲁棒的协同感知框架。我们的框架采用多阶段协作策略,动态且自适应地平衡中间阶段和后期阶段的信息,以便在智能体间共享,从而在保持通信效率的同时提升感知性能。为支持在潜在对齐误差和校准误差下的鲁棒协作,我们的框架防止低置信度的感知信息传输,并优化来自协作伙伴的检测结果以提高准确性。在真实世界和模拟数据集上的广泛评估结果证明了mmCooper框架及其组件的有效性。
abstract_en: Collaborative perception significantly enhances individual vehicle perception performance through the exchange of sensory information among agents. However, real-world deployment faces challenges due to bandwidth constraints and inevitable calibration errors during information exchange. To address these issues, we propose mmCooper, a novel multi-agent, multi-stage, communication-efficient, and collaboration-robust cooperative perception framework. Our framework leverages a multi-stage collaboration strategy that dynamically and adaptively balances intermediate- and late-stage information to share among agents, enhancing perceptual performance while maintaining communication efficiency. To support robust collaboration despite potential misalignments and calibration errors, our framework prevents misleading low-confidence sensing information from transmission and refines the received detection results from collaborators to improve accuracy. The extensive evaluation results on both real-world and simulated datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the mmCooper framework and its components.
authors: Bingyi Liu, Jian Teng, Hongfei Xue, Enshu Wang, Chuanhui Zhu, Pu Wang, Libing Wu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 28396-28406

title: monoVLN:弥合单目与全景视觉语言导航之间的观测差距
title_en: monoVLN: Bridging the Observation Gap between Monocular and Panoramic Vision and Language Navigation
abstract: 视觉语言导航(VLN)要求智能体通过遵循自然语言指令在三维环境中进行导航。尽管现有方法主要假设能够获取全景观测,但许多实际机器人配备的是单目RGBD相机,导致显著的配置差异。在本工作中,我们通过开发一种基于3DGS的新型单目VLN智能体框架来解决这一关键差距,重点在于内在信息不完整挑战。我们的方法包含两项关键创新:(1)用于推断不完全渲染全景特征图中缺失区域表示的隐式部分补全模块;(2)一种不确定性感知的主动感知策略,使智能体在决策不确定时能够主动获取视觉观测。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的monoVLN在R2R-CE数据集上相比现有单目方法将成功率提升了8%,显著优于所有现有单目方法。我们还在现实环境中验证了我们的monoVLN,为现实世界VLN提供了实用解决方案。
abstract_en: Vision and Language Navigation(VLN) requires agents to navigate 3D environments by following natural language instructions. While existing methods predominantly assume access to panoramic observations, many practical robotics are equipped with monocular RGBD cameras, creating a significant configuration disparity. In this work, we address this critical gap by developing a novel 3DGS-based framework for monocular VLN agents, focusing on the intrinsic information incompleteness challenge. Our approach incorporates two key innovations: (1) implicit partial completion module for inferring representations of missing regions in incompletely rendered panoramic feature maps, and (2) an uncertainty-aware active perception strategy that enables the agent to actively acquire visual observation when uncertain about its decision. Extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE datasets demonstrate that our monoVLN outperforms all existing monocular methods, significantly improve 8% success rate on R2R-CE compared to previous monocular methods. We also validate our monoVLN in real-world environments, providing a practical solution for real-world VLN.
authors: Renjie Lu, Yu Zhou, Hao Cheng, Jingke Meng, Wei-Shi Zheng ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 9477-9486

title: p-AVAS:物理融合的音频-视觉建模能否提升神经声学合成?
title_en: p-AVAS: Can Physics-Integrated Audio-Visual Modeling Boost Neural Acoustic Synthesis?
abstract: 音频-视觉声学合成(AVAS)任务旨在建模特定视觉场景中的真实音频传播行为。现有方法通常依赖稀疏图像表示来指导音频合成。然而,我们认为这种方法不足以捕捉环境的复杂物理特性,且可能在多样化场景中面临泛化能力不足的问题。本工作中,我们回顾了现有流程的局限性,并探讨研究问题:能否通过物理音频-视觉关联来增强神经声学合成?我们提出了一种新型框架——物理融合音频-视觉声学合成(PI-AVAS或\pi-AVAS),其设计包含两个核心目标。i)泛化能力:我们开发了一种视觉引导的音频模拟框架,利用基于物理的声波传播模型。通过显式建模视觉关联的几何结构和声波路径,我们的方法在多样化视觉环境中实现了稳健性能。ii)真实感:虽然基于模拟的方法具有良好的泛化能力,但往往牺牲真实感。为缓解这一问题,我们引入了第二阶段的数据驱动细化流程,提出基于流匹配的音频细化模型,以缩小模拟与真实音频-视觉场景之间的差距。大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性和鲁棒性。我们在RWAVS-Gen、RWAVS和RAF数据集上取得了最先进的性能。此外,我们证明该方法可无缝集成于现有方法中,显著提升其性能。
abstract_en: The Audio-Visual Acoustic Synthesis (AVAS) task aims to model realistic audio propagation behavior within a specific visual scene. Prior works often rely on sparse image representations to guide acoustic synthesis. However, we argue that this approach is insufficient to capture the intricate physical properties of the environment and may struggle with generalization across diverse scenes. In this work, we review the limitations of existing pipelines and address the research question: Can we leverage physical audio-visual associations to enhance neural acoustic synthesis? We introduce Physics-Integrated Audio-Visual Acoustic Synthesis (PI-AVAS or \pi-AVAS), a novel framework designed with two key objectives. i) Generalization: We develop a vision-guided audio simulation framework that leverages physics-based sound propagation. By explicitly modeling vision-grounded geometry and sound rays, our approach achieves robust performance across diverse visual environments. ii) Realism: While simulation-based approaches offer generalizability, they often compromise on realism. To mitigate this, we incorporate a second stage for data-centric refinement, where we propose a flow matching-based audio refinement model to narrow the gap between simulation and real-world audio-visual scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our method. We achieve state-of-the-art performance on the RWAVS-Gen, RWAVS, and RAF datasets. Additionally, we show that our approach can be seamlessly integrated with existing methods to significantly improve their performance.
authors: Susan Liang, Chao Huang, Yunlong Tang, Zeliang Zhang, Chenliang Xu ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 13942-13951

title: p-MoD: 通过渐进比率衰减构建混合深度多模态大语言模型
title_en: p-MoD: Building Mixture-of-Depths MLLMs via Progressive Ratio Decay
abstract: 尽管多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)在各类任务中表现出卓越性能,但其高昂的训练和推理成本限制了其发展。本文提出p-MoD,一种高效的MLLM架构,显著降低训练和推理成本同时保持模型性能。多数MLLMs的计算量源于基于Transformer的LLM处理的海量视觉token。为此,我们采用混合深度(MoD)机制,其中每个LLM层选择关键视觉token进行处理并跳过冗余token。然而,将MoD集成到MLLMs中具有挑战性。为解决训练和推理稳定性及训练数据有限的问题,我们对MoD模块进行了两项创新设计:tanh门控权重归一化(TanhNorm)和对称token重加权(STRing)。此外,我们观察到深层网络中视觉token冗余性更高,因此设计了渐进比率衰减(PRD)策略,通过移位余弦调度逐层降低token保留比率。这一关键设计充分释放了MoD的潜力,显著提升了模型的效率和性能。在15个基准测试中基于两个基线模型的大量实验表明,我们的模型在性能上与基线相当甚至超越,推理时仅需55.6%的TFLOPs和53.7%的KV缓存存储,训练时仅需77.7%的GPU小时。
abstract_en: Despite the remarkable performance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) across diverse tasks, the substantial training and inference costs impede their advancement. In this paper, we propose p-MoD, an efficient MLLM architecture that significantly reduces training and inference costs while maintaining model performance. The majority of computation in MLLMs stems from the overwhelming volume of vision tokens processed by the transformer-based LLM. Accordingly, we leverage the Mixture-of-Depths (MoD) mechanism, where each LLM layer selects essential vision tokens to process while skipping redundant ones. However, integrating MoD into MLLMs is non-trivial. To address the challenges of training and inference stability as well as limited training data, we adapt the MoD module with two novel designs: tanh-gated weight normalization (TanhNorm) and symmetric token reweighting (STRing). Moreover, we observe that vision tokens exhibit higher redundancy in deeper layers and thus design a progressive ratio decay (PRD) strategy, which gradually reduces the token retention ratio layer by layer, employing a shifted cosine schedule. This crucial design fully unleashes the potential of MoD, significantly boosting the efficiency and performance of our models. Extensive experiments on two baseline models across 15 benchmarks show that our model matches or even surpasses the performance of corresponding baselines, while requiring only 55.6% TFLOPs and 53.7% KV cache storage during inference, and 77.7% GPU hours during training.
authors: Jun Zhang, Desen Meng, Zhengming Zhang, Zhenpeng Huang, Tao Wu, Limin Wang ; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2025, pp. 3705-3715

title: 3D-Layers:将基于图层的颜色编辑引入VR绘画
title_en: 3D-Layers: Bringing Layer-Based Color Editing to VR Painting.
abstract: 将艺术作品表示为图层堆栈的能力是现代图形设计的基础,因为它使艺术家能够轻松分离视觉元素、独立编辑并混合它们以实现丰富的视觉效果。尽管图层在2D绘画软件中普遍存在,但它们尚未被引入VR绘画领域,用户通过6自由度控制器在三维空间中直接绘制笔触。然而,二维图层堆栈的概念灵感来源于细胞动画中的现实图层,那么三维图层应该是什么样的呢?我们提出将3D-Layers定义为三维笔触的集合,并区分表示三维几何体的图层与表示几何体颜色修改的图层。前者称为基底图层,后者称为外观图层。外观图层中的笔触会修改与其相交的基底笔触的颜色。得益于这种区分,艺术家可以将颜色修改序列定义为外观图层的堆栈,并独立编辑每个图层以精细控制基底的最终颜色。我们已将3D-Layers集成到VR绘画应用中,并通过与经验丰富的VR艺术家进行可用性研究来评估其灵活性和表现力。
abstract_en: The ability to represent artworks as stacks of layers is fundamental to modern graphics design, as it allows artists to easily separate visual elements, edit them in isolation, and blend them to achieve rich visual effects. Despite their ubiquity in 2D painting software, layers have not yet made their way to VR painting, where users paint strokes directly in 3D space by gesturing a 6-degrees-of-freedom controller. But while the concept of a stack of 2D layers was inspired by real-world layers in cell animation, what should 3D layers be? We propose to define 3D-Layers as groups of 3D strokes, and we distinguish the ones that represent 3D geometry from the ones that represent color modifications of the geometry. We call the former substrate layers and the latter appearance layers. Strokes in appearance layers modify the color of the substrate strokes they intersect. Thanks to this distinction, artists can define sequences of color modifications as stacks of appearance layers, and edit each layer independently to finely control the final color of the substrate. We have integrated 3D-Layers into a VR painting application and we evaluate its flexibility and expressiveness by conducting a usability study with experienced VR artists.
authors: Emilie Yu, Fanny Chevalier, Karan Singh 0004, Adrien Bousseau

title: 3Doodle:基于三维笔触的物体紧凑抽象
title_en: 3Doodle: Compact Abstraction of Objects with 3D Strokes.
abstract: 尽管自由手绘草图长期以来作为高效表达物体特征的表示方式,但它们往往具有主观性,与现实表示存在显著差异。此外,草图在任意视角下不一致,难以捕捉3D形状。我们提出3Doodle,根据目标物体的多视角图像生成描述性且视角一致的草图图像。我们的方法基于三维笔触集可高效表示3D结构信息并渲染视角一致的2D草图的理念。我们将2D草图表达为视角无关和视角相关组件的联合。三维立方贝塞尔曲线表示视角无关的3D特征线,而超二次曲面的轮廓表达不同视角下体积的平滑轮廓。我们的流程直接优化三维笔触原语的参数,以全可微方式最小化感知损失。生成的稀疏三维笔触集可渲染为包含各种物体本质3D特征形状的抽象草图。我们证明与近期草图生成方法相比,3Doodle能忠实表达原始图像的概念。
abstract_en: While free-hand sketching has long served as an efficient representation to convey characteristics of an object, they are often subjective, deviating significantly from realistic representations. Moreover, sketches are not consistent for arbitrary viewpoints, making it hard to catch 3D shapes. We propose 3Dooole, generating descriptive and view-consistent sketch images given multi-view images of the target object. Our method is based on the idea that a set of 3D strokes can efficiently represent 3D structural information and render view-consistent 2D sketches. We express 2D sketches as a union of view-independent and view-dependent components. 3D cubic Bézier curves indicate view-independent 3D feature lines, while contours of superquadrics express a smooth outline of the volume of varying viewpoints. Our pipeline directly optimizes the parameters of 3D stroke primitives to minimize perceptual losses in a fully differentiable manner. The resulting sparse set of 3D strokes can be rendered as abstract sketches containing essential 3D characteristic shapes of various objects. We demonstrate that 3Doodle can faithfully express concepts of the original images compared with recent sketch generation approaches.1
authors: Changwoon Choi, Jaeah Lee, Jaesik Park, Young Min Kim 0001

title: 自由空间衍射双向散射分布函数
title_en: A Free-Space Diffraction BSDF.
abstract: 自由空间衍射是一种光学现象,其中光线似乎会"绕过"场景物体的几何边缘和角落。本文提出了一种高效模拟此类效应的方法。我们推导出一种基于边的夫琅禾费衍射公式化方法,该方法非常适合计算机图形学中常用的(三角形)几何网格。我们的方法通过考虑光线与物体交点周围的几何结构动态构建自由空间衍射双向散射分布函数,并为这些双向散射分布函数提出了一种重要性采样策略。我们的方法独特之处在于仅需光线追踪即可生成自由空间衍射,适用于通用网格,无需几何预处理,并设计为与具有线性渲染方程的路径追踪器兼容。我们展示了能够准确再现衍射瓣,并且与现有任何方法不同,能够处理复杂的真实世界几何结构。本工作将自由空间衍射与计算机图形学中的高效路径追踪工具相连接。
abstract_en: Free-space diffractions are an optical phenomenon where light appears to "bend" around the geometric edges and corners of scene objects. In this paper we present an efficient method to simulate such effects. We derive an edge-based formulation of Fraunhofer diffraction, which is well suited to the common (triangular) geometric meshes used in computer graphics. Our method dynamically constructs a free-space diffraction BSDF by considering the geometry around the intersection point of a ray of light with an object, and we present an importance sampling strategy for these BSDFs. Our method is unique in requiring only ray tracing to produce free-space diffractions, works with general meshes, requires no geometry preprocessing, and is designed to work with path tracers with a linear rendering equation. We show that we are able to reproduce accurate diffraction lobes, and, in contrast to any existing method, are able to handle complex, real-world geometry. This work serves to connect free-space diffractions to the efficient path tracing tools from computer graphics.
authors: Shlomi Steinberg, Ravi Ramamoorthi, Benedikt Bitterli, Arshiya Mollazainali, Eugene d'Eon, Matt Pharr

title: 一种完全相关的各向异性微粒BSDF模型
title_en: A Fully-correlated Anisotropic Micrograin BSDF Model.
abstract: 我们引入了Lucas等人[2023]提出的微粒BSDF模型的改进版本,用于各向异性多孔层的渲染。我们的方法利用微粒的特性,考虑其高度与法线之间的相关性,以及光照方向与观察方向之间的相关性。这使我们能够推导出几何衰减因子(GAF)的精确解析表达式,总结多孔层内部的阴影和遮挡效应。随后,该完全相关的GAF被用于定义适当的混合权重,以融合多孔层与基底层的BSDF。此外,通过将微粒形状推广为各向异性,并结合其完全相关的GAF,我们的改进BSDF模型能够产生多孔层特有的效果,如在掠射角下可见于尘埃层的逆反射效应,或在锈蚀材料上可观察到的高度与颜色相关性。最后,我们通过与显式微粒实例的光传输模拟进行对比,验证了该BSDF模型的准确性。
abstract_en: We introduce an improved version of the micrograin BSDF model [Lucas et al. 2023] for the rendering of anisotropic porous layers. Our approach leverages the properties of micrograins to take into account the correlation between their height and normal, as well as the correlation between the light and view directions. This allows us to derive an exact analytical expression for the Geometrical Attenuation Factor (GAF), summarizing shadowing and masking inside the porous layer. This fully-correlated GAF is then used to define appropriate mixing weights to blend the BSDFs of the porous and base layers. Furthermore, by generalizing the micrograins shape to anisotropy, combined with their fully-correlated GAF, our improved BSDF model produces effects specific to porous layers such as retro-reflection visible on dust layers at grazing angles or height and color correlation that can be found on rusty materials. Finally, we demonstrate very close matches between our BSDF model and light transport simulations realized with explicit instances of micrograins, thus validating our model.
authors: Simon Lucas 0002, Mickaël Ribardière, Romain Pacanowski, Pascal Barla

title: 一种用于广义符号距离函数的热方法
title_en: A Heat Method for Generalized Signed Distance.
abstract: 我们提出了一种方法,用于近似存在孔洞、噪声或自相交的几何体的符号距离函数(SDF)。该方法隐式地定义了形状的完整版本,而非显式修复输入数据。我们的起点是测地距离的热方法的修改版本,该方法扩散法向量而非标量分布。这种表述提供了类似于广义绕数(GWN)的鲁棒性,但提供的是距离函数而非仅内外分类。我们的表述还提供了经典距离算法中不常见的几个特性,例如同时拟合多个水平集的能力、对不拓扑包围任何区域的几何体的距离概念,以及混合使用符号距离和非符号距离的能力。该方法可应用于任意维度和任意空间离散化,包括三角网格、四面体网格、点云、多边形网格、体素化表面和规则网格。我们在多个具有挑战性的示例上评估了该方法,直接在不完美的曲线和曲面数据上实现法向量偏移和其他形态学操作。在许多情况下,我们还获得了比GWN提供的内外分类更鲁棒的结果。
abstract_en: We introduce a method for approximating the signed distance function (SDF) of geometry corrupted by holes, noise, or self-intersections. The method implicitly defines a completed version of the shape, rather than explicitly repairing the given input. Our starting point is a modified version of the heat method for geodesic distance, which diffuses normal vectors rather than a scalar distribution. This formulation provides robustness akin to generalized winding numbers (GWN), but provides distance function rather than just an inside/outside classification. Our formulation also offers several features not common to classic distance algorithms, such as the ability to simultaneously fit multiple level sets, a notion of distance for geometry that does not topologically bound any region, and the ability to mix and match signed and unsigned distance. The method can be applied in any dimension and to any spatial discretization, including triangle meshes, tet meshes, point clouds, polygonal meshes, voxelized surfaces, and regular grids. We evaluate the method on several challenging examples, implementing normal offsets and other morphological operations directly on imperfect curve and surface data. In many cases we also obtain an inside/outside classification dramatically more robust than the one obtained provided by GWN.
authors: Nicole Feng, Keenan Crane

title: 一种用于超大规模数据集实时渲染的层次化三维高斯表示方法
title_en: A Hierarchical 3D Gaussian Representation for Real-Time Rendering of Very Large Datasets.
abstract: 近年来,新视角合成技术取得了显著进展,三维高斯点云在视觉质量、快速训练和实时渲染方面表现出色。然而,训练和渲染所需的资源不可避免地限制了可高质量表示的场景规模。我们引入一种层次化的三维高斯表示方法,在保持视觉质量的同时,为远距离内容的高效渲染提供了一种高效的细节层次(LOD)解决方案,并通过有效的层次选择和平滑的层次过渡实现。我们提出一种分而治之的方法,允许我们独立分块训练超大规模场景。我们将这些分块整合为一个层次结构,可进一步优化以提升合并到中间节点的高斯体的视觉质量。超大规模捕获通常对场景覆盖稀疏,给原始三维高斯点云训练方法带来诸多挑战;我们通过调整和正则化训练来应对这些问题。我们提出了一种完整解决方案,借助我们的LOD方法,能够实时渲染超大规模场景并适应可用资源。我们展示了使用简单且经济的设备捕获的场景结果,这些场景包含多达数万张图像,覆盖长达数公里的轨迹,持续时间长达一小时。
abstract_en: Novel view synthesis has seen major advances in recent years, with 3D Gaussian splatting offering an excellent level of visual quality, fast training and real-time rendering. However, the resources needed for training and rendering inevitably limit the size of the captured scenes that can be represented with good visual quality. We introduce a hierarchy of 3D Gaussians that preserves visual quality for very large scenes, while offering an efficient Level-of-Detail (LOD) solution for efficient rendering of distant content with effective level selection and smooth transitions between levels. We introduce a divide-and-conquer approach that allows us to train very large scenes in independent chunks. We consolidate the chunks into a hierarchy that can be optimized to further improve visual quality of Gaussians merged into intermediate nodes. Very large captures typically have sparse coverage of the scene, presenting many challenges to the original 3D Gaussian splatting training method; we adapt and regularize training to account for these issues. We present a complete solution, that enables real-time rendering of very large scenes and can adapt to available resources thanks to our LOD method. We show results for captured scenes with up to tens of thousands of images with a simple and affordable rig, covering trajectories of up to several kilometers and lasting up to one hour.
authors: Bernhard Kerbl, Andreas Meuleman, Georgios Kopanas, Michael Wimmer 0001, Alexandre Lanvin, George Drettakis

title: 一种高效的肌骨驱动皮肤变形神经网络模型
title_en: A Neural Network Model for Efficient Musculoskeletal-Driven Skin Deformation.
abstract: 我们提出了一种全面的神经网络模型,用于模拟人体软组织(包括肌肉、肌腱、脂肪和皮肤)的变形。我们的方法通过运动学和主动校正来改进线性混合皮肤绑定[Magennat-Thalmann等,1989],在较低的计算成本下提升软组织变形的逼真度。我们的网络考虑了骨骼关节状态变化以及相关肌肉主动收缩状态引起的变形。训练过程通过物理模拟超弹性软组织在紧密接触下的准静态平衡进行近似。我们采用分层方法生成平衡数据,首先计算肌肉变形,随后是内层皮肤/筋膜层,最后是位于筋膜与外层皮肤之间的脂肪层。我们证明,一个能够解耦骨骼运动学与肌肉激活状态依赖关系的简单网络模型,即使在有限的训练数据负担下也能产生令人信服的行为。肌肉的主动收缩通过逆动力学进行估计,其中神经网络准确预测肌肉力臂以建模运动学肌腱几何关系。实验结果表明,该模型能够准确复现代表性运动范围内的肌骨和皮肤变形行为,包括健美动作中附加重量的影响。
abstract_en: We present a comprehensive neural network to model the deformation of human soft tissues including muscle, tendon, fat and skin. Our approach provides kinematic and active correctives to linear blend skinning [Magnenat-Thalmann et al. 1989] that enhance the realism of soft tissue deformation at modest computational cost. Our network accounts for deformations induced by changes in the underlying skeletal joint state as well as the active contractile state of relevant muscles. Training is done to approximate quasistatic equilibria produced from physics-based simulation of hyperelastic soft tissues in close contact. We use a layered approach to equilibrium data generation where deformation of muscle is computed first, followed by an inner skin/fascia layer, and lastly a fat layer between the fascia and outer skin. We show that a simple network model which decouples the dependence on skeletal kinematics and muscle activation state can produce compelling behaviors with modest training data burden. Active contraction of muscles is estimated using inverse dynamics where muscle moment arms are accurately predicted using the neural network to model kinematic musculotendon geometry. Results demonstrate the ability to accurately replicate compelling musculoskeletal and skin deformation behaviors over a representative range of motions, including the effects of added weights in body building motions.
authors: Yushan Han, Yizhou Chen, Carmichael F. Ong, Jingyu Chen 0002, Jennifer L. Hicks, Joseph Teran

title: 一种用于肥皂膜模拟的涡旋粒子网格方法
title_en: A Vortex Particle-on-Mesh Method for Soap Film Simulation.
abstract: 本文介绍了一种新颖的基于物理的涡旋流体模型,专门用于准确模拟变形薄膜上的级联涡旋结构。我们的方法核心在于一种新型机制,将薄膜的切向速度分解为环流和膨胀分量。这些分量随后通过混合粒子网格方法进行演化,从而有效重建三维切向速度,并将表面活性剂和厚度动力学无缝整合到统一框架中。通过与法向分量和表面张力模型耦合,我们的方法特别擅长描绘平面涡旋与垂直物理现象(如重力、表面活性剂动力学和固体边界)之间的复杂相互作用,从而实现高度逼真的复杂薄膜动力学模拟,达到前所未有的涡旋细节水平和物理真实感。
abstract_en: This paper introduces a novel physically-based vortex fluid model for films, aimed at accurately simulating cascading vortical structures on deforming thin films. Central to our approach is a novel mechanism decomposing the film's tangential velocity into circulation and dilatation components. These components are then evolved using a hybrid particle-mesh method, enabling the effective reconstruction of three-dimensional tangential velocities and seamlessly integrating surfactant and thickness dynamics into a unified framework. By coupling with its normal component and surface-tension model, our method is particularly adept at depicting complex interactions between in-plane vortices and out-of-plane physical phenomena, such as gravity, surfactant dynamics, and solid boundary, leading to highly realistic simulations of complex thin-film dynamics, achieving an unprecedented level of vortical details and physical realism.
authors: Ningxiao Tao, Liangwang Ruan, Yitong Deng, Bo Zhu 0002, Bin Wang 0069, Baoquan Chen

title: 隐式复形的自适应网格生成
title_en: Adaptive grid generation for discretizing implicit complexes.
abstract: 我们提出了一种生成单纯形网格(例如三角形或四面体网格)的方法,以实现对由向量函数定义的隐式形状的自适应离散化。这类形状,我们称之为隐式复形,是隐式曲面的推广,适用于表示非光滑和非流形结构。尽管自适应网格生成已广泛用于隐式曲面的多边形化,但针对隐式复形的算法却很少。我们的方法可以为多种隐式复形生成自适应网格,包括隐式曲面的排列、构造实体几何形状、材料界面和曲线网络。重要的是,我们的方法不仅适应隐式曲面的几何形状,还适应其低维交集的几何特征。我们展示了该方法如何实现对复杂隐式形状的高效且细节保留的离散化。
abstract_en: We present a method for generating a simplicial (e.g., triangular or tetrahedral) grid to enable adaptive discretization of implicit shapes defined by a vector function. Such shapes, which we call implicit complexes, are generalizations of implicit surfaces and useful for representing non-smooth and non-manifold structures. While adaptive grid generation has been extensively studied for polygonizing implicit surfaces, few methods are designed for implicit complexes. Our method can generate adaptive grids for several implicit complexes, including arrangements of implicit surfaces, CSG shapes, material interfaces, and curve networks. Importantly, our method adapts the grid to the geometry of not only the implicit surfaces but also their lower-dimensional intersections. We demonstrate how our method enables efficient and detail-preserving discretization of non-trivial implicit shapes.
authors: Yiwen Ju, Xingyi Du, Qingnan Zhou, Nathan Carr 0001, Tao Ju 0001

title: 基于NURBS的混合拉压网格壳设计的对齐条件
title_en: Alignment conditions for NURBS-based design of mixed tension-compression grid shells.
abstract: 在建筑领域,能够承受重力且无弯矩作用的曲面形态被视为壳结构的理想形式。这类壳体通过特殊几何形态实现重力沿表面切向应力传递至地面,具有高度效率。寻找此类特殊形态的过程称为形态生成。近期,[Miki和Mitchell 2022]提出了一种可靠方法,用于生成混合拉压连续壳体,这类壳体因形态生成困难而著称。该方法的关键在于利用Airy应力函数概念,通过迭代壳体形态与Airy应力函数,将原本过度约束的问题转化为具有多重解的问题。在[Miki和Mitchell 2022]中,该方法被提出可用于设计网格壳体,通过在连续壳体上追踪曲线,使生成的网格具有无弯矩且形成平面面板的特性,这对玻璃和钢材构成的实体网格壳体施工具有实用价值。然而,这种特殊网格在混合拉压壳体上并非普遍存在,即使壳体处于无弯矩平衡状态[Miki和Mitchell 2023]。需对壳体形态施加额外条件以确保同时存在无弯矩与共轭网格方向。本研究通过引入对齐条件解决存在性问题。我们考虑了多种实用曲线对齐条件:与壳体曲率线对齐、近似对齐用户指定的双向引导曲线集、精确对齐用户指定的单向引导曲线。报告指出,最初用于解决[Miki和Mitchell 2022]形态生成问题的变量投影方法可成功扩展至解决新引入的对齐条件,并以多个实用设计示例的结果作结。据我们所知,这是首个能接受用户输入网格并找到"邻近"的平面面板且处于无弯矩平衡的混合拉压网格壳体的方法。
abstract_en: In architecture, shapes of surfaces that can withstand gravity with no bending action are considered ideal for shell structures. Those shells have special geometries through which they can stream gravitational force toward the ground via stresses strictly tangent to the surface, making them highly efficient. The process of finding these special forms is called form-finding. Recently, [Miki and Mitchell 2022] presented a method to reliably produce mixed tension-compression continuum shells, a type of shells known to be especially difficult to form-find. The key to this method was to use the concept of the Airy stress function to derive a valid bending-free shell shape by iterating on both the shell shape and the Airy stress function; this turns a problem that is over-constrained in general into a problem with many solutions. In [Miki and Mitchell 2022], it was proposed that the method could also be used to design grid shells by tracing curves on a continuum shell such that the resulting grid has bars that are both bending-free and form flat panels, a property useful for construction of real grid shells made of glass and steel. However, this special type of grid is not guaranteed to exist in general on a mixed-tension compression shell, even when the shell is in bending-free equilibrium [Miki and Mitchell 2023]. Additional conditions must be imposed on the shell shape to guarantee the existence of simultaneously bending-free and conjugate grid directions. The current study resolves the existence issue by adding alignment conditions. We consider several practical curve alignment conditions: alignment with the lines of curvature of the shell, approximate alignment with a bidirectional set of user-prescribed guide curves, and exact alignment with a single direction of user-prescribed guide curves. We report that the variable projection method originally used to solve the form-finding problem in the work of [Miki and Mitchell 2022] can be successfully extended to solve the newly introduced alignment conditions, and conclude with results for several practical design examples. To our knowledge, this is the first method that can take a user-input grid and find a "nearby" grid that is both flat-panelled and in bending-free equilibrium for the general case of mixed tension-compression grid shells.
authors: Masaaki Miki, Toby Mitchell

title: 基于网格的铁磁流体边界诱导静磁求解器
title_en: An Induce-on-Boundary Magnetostatic Solver for Grid-Based Ferrofluids.
abstract: 本文介绍了一种新型的边界诱导(IoB)求解器,旨在解决铁磁流体的静磁控制方程。该IoB求解器基于单层位势,仅利用物体的表面点云,提供了一种轻量、快速且精确的磁场所计算方案。与现有方法相比,它消除了对复杂线性系统求解器的需求,并保持了最小的计算复杂度。此外,它可无缝集成到传统流体模拟器中,而不会影响边界条件。通过广泛的理论分析和实验,我们验证了IoB求解器的收敛性与可扩展性,实现了最先进的性能。此外,提出并执行了一种直接的耦合方法,以展示该求解器在网格流体模拟流程中的有效性,从而实现代表性铁磁流体不稳定性的真实模拟。
abstract_en: This paper introduces a novel Induce-on-Boundary (IoB) solver designed to address the magnetostatic governing equations of ferrofluids. The IoB solver is based on a single-layer potential and utilizes only the surface point cloud of the object, offering a lightweight, fast, and accurate solution for calculating magnetic fields. Compared to existing methods, it eliminates the need for complex linear system solvers and maintains minimal computational complexities. Moreover, it can be seamlessly integrated into conventional fluid simulators without compromising boundary conditions. Through extensive theoretical analysis and experiments, we validate both the convergence and scalability of the IoB solver, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Additionally, a straightforward coupling approach is proposed and executed to showcase the solver's effectiveness when integrated into a grid-based fluid simulation pipeline, allowing for realistic simulations of representative ferrofluid instabilities.
authors: Xingyu Ni, Ruicheng Wang, Bin Wang 0069, Baoquan Chen

title: Analogist:基于图像扩散模型的开箱即用视觉上下文学习
title_en: Analogist: Out-of-the-box Visual In-Context Learning with Image Diffusion Model.
abstract: 视觉上下文学习(ICL)因其通过类比推理以有限的示例对完成多种任务的能力,已成为一个有前景的研究领域。然而,基于训练的视觉ICL在泛化到未见过的任务方面存在局限性,并需要收集多样化的任务数据集。另一方面,现有基于推理的视觉ICL方法仅依赖文本提示,无法捕捉给定示例中的细粒度上下文信息,且在将图像转换为文本提示时耗时。为解决这些挑战,我们提出Analogist,一种新颖的基于推理的视觉ICL方法,利用文本到图像扩散模型(用于图像修复的预训练模型)结合视觉和文本提示技术。对于视觉提示,我们提出自注意力克隆(SAC)方法,以引导图像示例间的细粒度结构级类比。对于文本提示,我们借助GPT-4V的视觉推理能力高效生成文本提示,并引入交叉注意力掩码(CAM)操作以提升文本提示引导的语义级类比准确性。我们的方法开箱即用,无需微调或优化,具有通用性和灵活性,可支持多种视觉任务的上下文式处理。大量实验验证了我们的方法在定性和定量上的优越性。项目网页详见https://analogist2d.github.io。
abstract_en: Visual In-Context Learning (ICL) has emerged as a promising research area due to its capability to accomplish various tasks with limited example pairs through analogical reasoning. However, training-based visual ICL has limitations in its ability to generalize to unseen tasks and requires the collection of a diverse task dataset. On the other hand, existing methods in the inference-based visual ICL category solely rely on textual prompts, which fail to capture fine-grained contextual information from given examples and can be time-consuming when converting from images to text prompts. To address these challenges, we propose Analogist, a novel inference-based visual ICL approach that exploits both visual and textual prompting techniques using a text-to-image diffusion model pretrained for image inpainting. For visual prompting, we propose a self-attention cloning (SAC) method to guide the fine-grained structural-level analogy between image examples. For textual prompting, we leverage GPT-4V's visual reasoning capability to efficiently generate text prompts and introduce a cross-attention masking (CAM) operation to enhance the accuracy of semantic-level analogy guided by text prompts. Our method is out-of-the-box and does not require fine-tuning or optimization. It is also generic and flexible, enabling a wide range of visual tasks to be performed in an in-context manner. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our method over existing approaches, both qualitatively and quantitatively. Our project webpage is available at https://analogist2d.github.io.
authors: Zheng Gu 0001, Shiyuan Yang, Jing Liao 0001, Jing Huo, Yang Gao 0001

title: 区域ReSTIR:实时景深与抗锯齿的重采样
title_en: Area ReSTIR: Resampling for Real-Time Defocus and Antialiasing.
abstract: 近期在时空蓄水池重采样(ReSTIR)领域的进展通过利用邻域样本重用,高效评估路径积分。与光栅化类似,ReSTIR方法隐式假设针孔相机,并通过单个预定义的子像素位置(例如像素中心)逐次评估到达像素的光。这阻碍了在高频细节像素及其邻域内高效路径重用。我们引入区域ReSTIR,将ReSTIR蓄水池扩展至整合每个像素的四维射线空间,包括胶片和镜头上的二维区域。我们设计了新颖的子像素跟踪时间重用与位移映射,以在这些区域最大化重采样质量。这增强了ReSTIR对高频内容的鲁棒性,使我们能够重要性采样子像素和镜头坐标,并高效渲染抗锯齿与景深。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in spatiotemporal reservoir resampling (ReSTIR) leverage sample reuse from neighbors to efficiently evaluate the path integral. Like rasterization, ReSTIR methods implicitly assume a pinhole camera and evaluate the light arriving at a pixel through a single predetermined subpixel location at a time (e.g., the pixel center). This prevents efficient path reuse in and near pixels with high-frequency details. We introduce Area ReSTIR, extending ReSTIR reservoirs to also integrate each pixel's 4D ray space, including 2D areas on the film and lens. We design novel subpixel-tracking temporal reuse and shift mappings that maximize resampling quality in such regions. This robustifies ReSTIR against high-frequency content, letting us importance sample subpixel and lens coordinates and efficiently render antialiasing and depth of field.
authors: Song Zhang 0007, Daqi Lin, Markus Kettunen 0001, Cem Yuksel, Chris Wyman

title: 音频同样重要!利用音频信号增强无标记运动捕捉的弦乐表演捕捉
title_en: Audio Matters Too! Enhancing Markerless Motion Capture with Audio Signals for String Performance Capture.
abstract: 本文探讨了无标记多模态人体运动捕捉问题,特别是针对涉及固有微妙手弦接触和复杂动作的弦乐表演捕捉。为实现此目标,我们首先收集了一个名为弦乐表演数据集(String Performance Dataset, SPD)的数据集,包含大提琴和小提琴演奏表演。该数据集包括最多23个不同视角的视频、音频信号以及身体、手部、乐器和琴弓的详细三维运动注释。此外,为获取详细的运动注释,我们提出了一种音频引导的多模态运动捕捉框架,该框架明确融合了从音频信号中检测到的手弦接触信息,以解决详细手部姿态问题。该框架作为无标记弦乐表演捕捉的基准方法,无需在表演者身上安装任何外部设备,消除了在如此精细动作中引入失真的潜在可能。我们认为,表演者的动作,特别是发声手势,包含常被视觉方法忽略的细微信息,但可通过音频线索推断和检索。因此,我们通过创新的音频引导方法优化基于视觉的运动捕捉结果,同时通过音频推导出的接触关系澄清表演者与乐器之间的接触关系。我们验证了所提出的框架并进行了消融研究以证明其有效性。我们的结果优于当前最先进的基于视觉的算法,突显了通过音频模态增强视觉运动捕捉的可行性。据我们所知,SPD是首个用于音乐乐器表演的多模态、大规模数据集,涵盖了细粒度手部运动细节。它对弦乐器教学、动画、虚拟音乐会以及音乐表演分析与生成具有重要意义和指导价值。我们的代码和SPD数据集可在https://github.com/Yitongishere/string_performance获取。
abstract_en: In this paper, we touch on the problem of markerless multi-modal human motion capture especially for string performance capture which involves inherently subtle hand-string contacts and intricate movements. To fulfill this goal, we first collect a dataset, named String Performance Dataset (SPD), featuring cello and violin performances. The dataset includes videos captured from up to 23 different views, audio signals, and detailed 3D motion annotations of the body, hands, instrument, and bow. Moreover, to acquire the detailed motion annotations, we propose an audio-guided multi-modal motion capture framework that explicitly incorporates hand-string contacts detected from the audio signals for solving detailed hand poses. This framework serves as a baseline for string performance capture in a completely markerless manner without imposing any external devices on performers, eliminating the potential of introducing distortion in such delicate movements. We argue that the movements of performers, particularly the sound-producing gestures, contain subtle information often elusive to visual methods but can be inferred and retrieved from audio cues. Consequently, we refine the vision-based motion capture results through our innovative audio-guided approach, simultaneously clarifying the contact relationship between the performer and the instrument, as deduced from the audio. We validate the proposed framework and conduct ablation studies to demonstrate its efficacy. Our results outperform current state-of-the-art vision-based algorithms, underscoring the feasibility of augmenting visual motion capture with audio modality. To the best of our knowledge, SPD is the first dataset for musical instrument performance, covering fine-grained hand motion details in a multi-modal, large-scale collection. It holds significant implications and guidance for string instrument pedagogy, animation, and virtual concerts, as well as for both musical performance analysis and generation. Our code and SPD dataset are available at https://github.com/Yitongishere/string_performance.
authors: Yitong Jin, Zhiping Qiu, Yi Shi 0009, Shuangpeng Sun, Chongwu Wang, Donghao Pan, Jiachen Zhao, Zhenghao Liang, Yuan Wang 0052, Xiaobing Li, Feng Yu, Tao Yu 0007, Qionghai Dai

title: 基于裁剪图样的数字服装自动初始化
title_en: Automatic Digital Garment Initialization from Sewing Patterns.
abstract: 数字时尚和生成式AI技术的快速发展需要一种自动化方法,将数字裁剪图样转换为适合人体虚拟形象的贴合服装。当给定带有相关缝制关系的裁剪图样时,主要挑战是建立无折叠和交叉的缝制部件初始排列。该设置使基于物理的模拟器能够无缝地将它们缝合成数字服装,避免陷入不理想的局部极小值。为实现这一目标,我们结合了AI分类、启发式算法和数值优化方法。这促使我们开发了一种创新的混合系统,显著减少服装部件初始化过程中对用户干预的需求。该系统的播种过程包括训练分类网络以选择种子部件,随后求解优化问题以确定其位置和形状。随后,通过迭代选择-排列过程自动化选择图样部件,并采用分阶段初始化方法以缓解数值优化相关的局部极小值问题。我们的实验验证了该系统在处理多层、多部件的复杂服装时的可靠性、效率和可扩展性。根据研究结果,68%的服装可实现零用户干预的初始化,其余服装可通过用户操作轻松修正。
abstract_en: The rapid advancement of digital fashion and generative AI technology calls for an automated approach to transform digital sewing patterns into well-fitted garments on human avatars. When given a sewing pattern with its associated sewing relationships, the primary challenge is to establish an initial arrangement of sewing pieces that is free from folding and intersections. This setup enables a physics-based simulator to seamlessly stitch them into a digital garment, avoiding undesirable local minima. To achieve this, we harness AI classification, heuristics, and numerical optimization. This has led to the development of an innovative hybrid system that minimizes the need for user intervention in the initialization of garment pieces. The seeding process of our system involves the training of a classification network for selecting seed pieces, followed by solving an optimization problem to determine their positions and shapes. Subsequently, an iterative selection-arrangement procedure automates the selection of pattern pieces and employs a phased initialization approach to mitigate local minima associated with numerical optimization. Our experiments confirm the reliability, efficiency, and scalability of our system when handling intricate garments with multiple layers and numerous pieces. According to our findings, 68 percent of garments can be initialized with zero user intervention, while the remaining garments can be easily corrected through user operations.
authors: Chen Liu 0012, Weiwei Xu 0003, Yin Yang 0002, Huamin Wang 0001

title: 三维三角笼的双调和坐标及其导数
title_en: Biharmonic Coordinates and their Derivatives for Triangular 3D Cages.
abstract: 作为调和坐标的自然延伸,双调和坐标在平面形状和图像处理中展现出更丰富的形变空间,从而在形状操作中表现出优越性。然而,三维双调和坐标及其导数的研究仍属空白。本文推导了三维三角笼的双调和坐标及其导数的闭式表达式。我们的推导核心在于计算三角形上欧几里得距离积分及其导数的闭式表达式。所推导的三维双调和坐标不仅填补了广义重心坐标方法中的缺失组件,还为实际应用开辟了多种可能性,包括生成双调和形变族、求解变分形状形变,甚至解锁近期引入的Somigliana坐标的闭式表达式,以实现快速且精确的评估。
abstract_en: As a natural extension to the harmonic coordinates, the biharmonic coordinates have been found superior for planar shape and image manipulation with an enriched deformation space. However, the 3D biharmonic coordinates and their derivatives have remained unexplored. In this work, we derive closed-form expressions for biharmonic coordinates and their derivatives for 3D triangular cages. The core of our derivation lies in computing the closed-form expressions for the integral of the Euclidean distance over a triangle and its derivatives. The derived 3D biharmonic coordinates not only fill a missing component in methods of generalized barycentric coordinates but also pave the way for various interesting applications in practice, including producing a family of biharmonic deformations, solving variational shape deformations, and even unlocking the closed-form expressions for recently-introduced Somigliana coordinates for both fast and accurate evaluations.
authors: Jean-Marc Thiery, Élie Michel, Jiong Chen 0001

title: 双侧引导的辐射场处理
title_en: Bilateral Guided Radiance Field Processing.
abstract: 神经辐射场(NeRF)通过多视角一致性实现了前所未有的新视角合成性能。当捕获多视角输入时,现代相机的图像信号处理(ISP)会独立增强这些输入,包括曝光调整、色彩校正、局部色调映射等。虽然这些处理显著提升了图像质量,但常常破坏多视角一致性假设,导致重建的辐射场中出现"漂浮物"。为在不损害视觉美学的前提下解决这一问题,我们旨在首先在NeRF训练阶段分离ISP增强效果,并在后期阶段重新应用用户期望的增强至重建的辐射场。为进一步使重新应用的增强在新视角间保持一致,我们需要在三维空间中进行图像信号处理(即"3D ISP")。为此,我们采用双侧网格(bilateral grid),一种局部仿射模型,作为ISP处理的通用表示。具体而言,我们通过辐射场优化每视角的三维双侧网格,以近似每个输入视角的相机管线效果。为实现用户可调节的三维后期处理,我们提出从给定单视角编辑中学习低秩4D双侧网格,将照片增强提升至整个三维场景。我们证明该方法能通过有效去除漂浮物并执行用户修图增强,提升新视角合成的视觉质量。源代码和数据可在https://bilarfpro.github.io获取。
abstract_en: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) achieves unprecedented performance in synthesizing novel view synthesis, utilizing multi-view consistency. When capturing multiple inputs, image signal processing (ISP) in modern cameras will independently enhance them, including exposure adjustment, color correction, local tone mapping, etc. While these processings greatly improve image quality, they often break the multi-view consistency assumption, leading to "floaters" in the reconstructed radiance fields. To address this concern without compromising visual aesthetics, we aim to first disentangle the enhancement by ISP at the NeRF training stage and re-apply user-desired enhancements to the reconstructed radiance fields at the finishing stage. Furthermore, to make the re-applied enhancements consistent between novel views, we need to perform imaging signal processing in 3D space (i.e. "3D ISP"). For this goal, we adopt the bilateral grid, a locally-affine model, as a generalized representation of ISP processing. Specifically, we optimize per-view 3D bilateral grids with radiance fields to approximate the effects of camera pipelines for each input view. To achieve user-adjustable 3D finishing, we propose to learn a low-rank 4D bilateral grid from a given single view edit, lifting photo enhancements to the whole 3D scene. We demonstrate our approach can boost the visual quality of novel view synthesis by effectively removing floaters and performing enhancements from user retouching. The source code and our data are available at: https://bilarfpro.github.io.
authors: Yuehao Wang, Chaoyi Wang, Bingchen Gong, Tianfan Xue

title: 二值不透明网格:基于网格的视图合成中精细几何细节的捕捉
title_en: Binary Opacity Grids: Capturing Fine Geometric Detail for Mesh-Based View Synthesis.
abstract: 尽管基于表面的视图合成算法因其计算需求较低而具有吸引力,但它们往往难以再现细长结构。相比之下,更昂贵的方法通过将场景几何建模为体积密度场(例如NeRF)在重建精细几何细节方面表现出色。然而,密度场通常以“模糊”的方式表示几何,这阻碍了表面的精确定位。在本工作中,我们修改密度场以鼓励其向表面收敛,同时不损害其重建细长结构的能力。首先,我们采用离散不透明网格表示替代连续密度场,这使得不透明值能够在表面处不连续地从零过渡到一。其次,我们通过每像素投射多条射线进行抗锯齿处理,这使得无需使用半透明体素即可建模遮挡边界和亚像素结构。第三,我们最小化不透明值的二进制熵,这通过鼓励不透明值在训练后期二值化,从而促进表面几何的提取。最后,我们开发了一种基于融合的网格生成策略,随后进行网格简化和外观模型拟合。我们模型生成的紧凑网格可在移动设备上实时渲染,并在视图合成质量方面显著优于现有基于网格的方法。我们的交互式网络演示可访问https://binary-opacity-grid.github.io。
abstract_en: While surface-based view synthesis algorithms are appealing due to their low computational requirements, they often struggle to reproduce thin structures. In contrast, more expensive methods that model the scene's geometry as a volumetric density field (e.g. NeRF) excel at reconstructing fine geometric detail. However, density fields often represent geometry in a "fuzzy" manner, which hinders exact localization of the surface. In this work, we modify density fields to encourage them to converge towards surfaces, without compromising their ability to reconstruct thin structures. First, we employ a discrete opacity grid representation instead of a continuous density field, which allows opacity values to discontinuously transition from zero to one at the surface. Second, we anti-alias by casting multiple rays per pixel, which allows occlusion boundaries and subpixel structures to be modelled without using semi-transparent voxels. Third, we minimize the binary entropy of the opacity values, which facilitates the extraction of surface geometry by encouraging opacity values to binarize towards the end of training. Lastly, we develop a fusion-based meshing strategy followed by mesh simplification and appearance model fitting. The compact meshes produced by our model can be rendered in real-time on mobile devices and achieve significantly higher view synthesis quality compared to existing mesh-based approaches. Our interactive webdemo is available at https://binary-opacity-grid.github.io.
authors: Christian Reiser, Stephan J. Garbin, Pratul P. Srinivasan, Dor Verbin, Richard Szeliski, Ben Mildenhall, Jonathan T. Barron, Peter Hedman, Andreas Geiger 0001

title: BlockFusion: 基于隐式三平面外推的可扩展三维场景生成
title_en: BlockFusion: Expandable 3D Scene Generation using Latent Tri-plane Extrapolation.
abstract: 我们提出BlockFusion,这是一种基于扩散的模型,能够以单元块形式生成三维场景,并无缝整合新块以扩展场景。BlockFusion通过从完整三维场景网格中随机裁剪得到的三维块数据集进行训练。通过逐块拟合,所有训练块被转换为混合神经场:包含几何特征的三平面,随后通过多层感知机(MLP)解码符号距离值。采用变分自编码器将三平面压缩到潜在三平面空间,在该空间上执行去噪扩散过程。对潜在表示的扩散应用使得能够生成高质量且多样化的三维场景。在生成过程中扩展场景时,只需在当前场景上附加空块并外推现有潜在三平面以填充新块。外推过程通过在去噪迭代中使用重叠三平面的特征样本对生成过程进行条件约束。潜在三平面外推产生语义和几何上有意义的过渡,与现有场景和谐融合。采用二维布局条件机制控制场景元素的放置和排列。实验结果表明,BlockFusion能够生成多样、几何一致且无边界的大规模三维场景,在室内外场景中均能实现前所未有的高质量形状生成。
abstract_en: We present BlockFusion, a diffusion-based model that generates 3D scenes as unit blocks and seamlessly incorporates new blocks to extend the scene. BlockFusion is trained using datasets of 3D blocks that are randomly cropped from complete 3D scene meshes. Through per-block fitting, all training blocks are converted into the hybrid neural fields: with a tri-plane containing the geometry features, followed by a Multi-layer Perceptron (MLP) for decoding the signed distance values. A variational auto-encoder is employed to compress the tri-planes into the latent tri-plane space, on which the denoising diffusion process is performed. Diffusion applied to the latent representations allows for high-quality and diverse 3D scene generation. To expand a scene during generation, one needs only to append empty blocks to overlap with the current scene and extrapolate existing latent tri-planes to populate new blocks. The extrapolation is done by conditioning the generation process with the feature samples from the overlapping tri-planes during the denoising iterations. Latent tri-plane extrapolation produces semantically and geometrically meaningful transitions that harmoniously blend with the existing scene. A 2D layout conditioning mechanism is used to control the placement and arrangement of scene elements. Experimental results indicate that BlockFusion is capable of generating diverse, geometrically consistent and unbounded large 3D scenes with unprecedented high-quality shapes in both indoor and outdoor scenarios.
authors: Zhennan Wu, Yang Li 0193, Han Yan, Taizhang Shang, Weixuan Sun, Senbo Wang, Ruikai Cui, Weizhe Liu, Hiroyuki Sato 0002, Hongdong Li, Pan Ji

title: BrepGen:一种具有结构化潜在几何的B-rep生成扩散模型
title_en: BrepGen: A B-rep Generative Diffusion Model with Structured Latent Geometry.
abstract: 本文提出BrepGen,一种基于扩散的生成方法,可直接输出边界表示(B-rep)计算机辅助设计(CAD)模型。BrepGen将B-rep模型表示为一种新颖的结构化潜在几何,以分层树结构进行组织。以CAD实体作为根节点,B-rep模型的每个元素(即面、边或顶点)自顶向下逐步转化为子节点。B-rep几何信息以每个基本体的全局包围盒和描述局部几何形状的潜在编码形式输入节点。B-rep拓扑信息通过节点复制隐式表示。当两个面共享一条边时,该边曲线在树中会出现两次;具有三个入射边的T型连接顶点在树中会出现六次,且节点特征完全相同。从根节点向叶节点推进时,BrepGen采用基于Transformer的扩散模型依次去噪节点特征,同时检测并合并重复节点,恢复B-Rep拓扑信息。大量实验表明,BrepGen在CAD B-rep生成任务中取得进展,在多个基准测试中超越现有方法。在我们新收集的家具数据集上的实验结果进一步展示了其在生成复杂几何形状方面的卓越能力。与以往仅能生成简单棱柱形结构的方法不同,BrepGen首次引入了自由曲面和双曲面。BrepGen的其他应用包括CAD自动补全和设计插值。代码、预训练模型和数据集可在https://github.com/samxuxiang/BrepGen获取。
abstract_en: This paper presents BrepGen, a diffusion-based generative approach that directly outputs a Boundary representation (B-rep) Computer-Aided Design (CAD) model. BrepGen represents a B-rep model as a novel structured latent geometry in a hierarchical tree. With the root node representing a whole CAD solid, each element of a B-rep model (i.e., a face, an edge, or a vertex) progressively turns into a child-node from top to bottom. B-rep geometry information goes into the nodes as the global bounding box of each primitive along with a latent code describing the local geometric shape. The B-rep topology information is implicitly represented by node duplication. When two faces share an edge, the edge curve will appear twice in the tree, and a T-junction vertex with three incident edges appears six times in the tree with identical node features. Starting from the root and progressing to the leaf, BrepGen employs Transformer-based diffusion models to sequentially denoise node features while duplicated nodes are detected and merged, recovering the B-Rep topology information. Extensive experiments show that BrepGen advances the task of CAD B-rep generation, surpassing existing methods on various benchmarks. Results on our newly collected furniture dataset further showcase its exceptional capability in generating complicated geometry. While previous methods were limited to generating simple prismatic shapes, BrepGen incorporates free-form and doubly-curved surfaces for the first time. Additional applications of BrepGen include CAD autocomplete and design interpolation. The code, pretrained models, and dataset are available at https://github.com/samxuxiang/BrepGen.
authors: Xiang Xu 0008, Joseph G. Lambourne, Pradeep Kumar Jayaraman, Zhengqing Wang, Karl D. D. Willis, Yasutaka Furukawa

title: CLAY:一种用于创建高质量3D资产的可控大规模生成模型
title_en: CLAY: A Controllable Large-scale Generative Model for Creating High-quality 3D Assets.
abstract: 在数字创意领域,我们从想象中构建复杂3D世界的潜力往往受到现有数字工具的限制,这些工具需要大量专业知识和努力。为缩小这一差距,我们引入CLAY,一种3D几何与材质生成器,旨在轻松将人类想象力转化为复杂的3D数字结构。CLAY支持经典文本或图像输入,以及来自多种基础元素(多视角图像、体素、边界框、点云、隐式表示等)的3D感知控制。其核心是一个由多分辨率变分自编码器(VAE)和极简主义潜在扩散变换器(DiT)组成的大规模生成模型,可直接从多样化的3D几何体中提取丰富的3D先验知识。具体而言,它采用神经场表示连续且完整的表面,并在潜在空间中使用纯变换器块的几何生成模块。我们提出了一种渐进式训练方案,通过精心设计的处理流程获取超大规模3D模型数据集来训练CLAY,最终得到一个具有15亿参数的3D原生几何生成器。对于外观生成,CLAY通过采用多视角材质扩散模型,旨在生成基于物理的渲染(PBR)纹理,可生成包含漫反射、粗糙度和金属材质模态的2K分辨率纹理。我们展示了CLAY在可控3D资产创作中的多种应用,从草图概念设计到具备复杂细节的生产就绪资产。即使是初次使用的用户也能轻松利用CLAY将生动的3D想象变为现实,释放无限创造力。
abstract_en: In the realm of digital creativity, our potential to craft intricate 3D worlds from imagination is often hampered by the limitations of existing digital tools, which demand extensive expertise and efforts. To narrow this disparity, we introduce CLAY, a 3D geometry and material generator designed to effortlessly transform human imagination into intricate 3D digital structures. CLAY supports classic text or image inputs as well as 3D-aware controls from diverse primitives (multi-view images, voxels, bounding boxes, point clouds, implicit representations, etc). At its core is a large-scale generative model composed of a multi-resolution Variational Autoencoder (VAE) and a minimalistic latent Diffusion Transformer (DiT), to extract rich 3D priors directly from a diverse range of 3D geometries. Specifically, it adopts neural fields to represent continuous and complete surfaces and uses a geometry generative module with pure transformer blocks in latent space. We present a progressive training scheme to train CLAY on an ultra large 3D model dataset obtained through a carefully designed processing pipeline, resulting in a 3D native geometry generator with 1.5 billion parameters. For appearance generation, CLAY sets out to produce physically-based rendering (PBR) textures by employing a multi-view material diffusion model that can generate 2K resolution textures with diffuse, roughness, and metallic modalities. We demonstrate using CLAY for a range of controllable 3D asset creations, from sketchy conceptual designs to production ready assets with intricate details. Even first time users can easily use CLAY to bring their vivid 3D imaginations to life, unleashing unlimited creativity.
authors: Longwen Zhang, Ziyu Wang, Qixuan Zhang, Qiwei Qiu, Anqi Pang, Haoran Jiang, Wei Yang 0034, Lan Xu 0003, Jingyi Yu 0001

title: CWF:在高质量网格简化中整合弱特征
title_en: CWF: Consolidating Weak Features in High-quality Mesh Simplification.
abstract: 在网格简化中,精度、三角形质量与特征对齐等常见需求往往被视为权衡关系。现有算法通常仅关注这些需求中的一个或几个方面。例如,著名的二次误差度量(QEM)方法[Garland and Heckbert 1997]优先考虑精度,能够保留强特征线/点,但在确保高质量三角形和弱特征保护方面存在不足,可能削弱不如强特征显著的弱特征。本文提出一种平滑函数,同时考虑所有这些需求。该函数包含法向各向异性项和中心Voronoi镶嵌(CVT)[Du et al. 1999]能量项,变量为位于表面的可移动点集。前者继承QEM的精神但以连续方式运作,后者鼓励均匀点分布,允许多种表面度量。我们进一步引入衰减权重以自动平衡两项。我们选取了ABC数据集[Koch et al. 2019]中的100个CAD模型和21个有机模型,与现有网格简化算法进行对比。实验结果揭示一个重要发现:引入衰减权重有效减少了两项之间的冲突,实现了弱特征对齐。这一特性使我们的方法区别于大多数现有网格简化方法,并在形状理解中展现出显著潜力。请参见引言图示。
abstract_en: In mesh simplification, common requirements like accuracy, triangle quality, and feature alignment are often considered as a trade-off. Existing algorithms concentrate on just one or a few specific aspects of these requirements. For example, the well-known Quadric Error Metrics (QEM) approach [Garland and Heckbert 1997] prioritizes accuracy and can preserve strong feature lines/points as well, but falls short in ensuring high triangle quality and may degrade weak features that are not as distinctive as strong ones. In this paper, we propose a smooth functional that simultaneously considers all of these requirements. The functional comprises a normal anisotropy term and a Centroidal Voronoi Tessellation (CVT) [Du et al. 1999] energy term, with the variables being a set of movable points lying on the surface. The former inherits the spirit of QEM but operates in a continuous setting, while the latter encourages even point distribution, allowing various surface metrics. We further introduce a decaying weight to automatically balance the two terms. We selected 100 CAD models from the ABC dataset [Koch et al. 2019], along with 21 organic models, to compare the existing mesh simplification algorithms with ours. Experimental results reveal an important observation: the introduction of a decaying weight effectively reduces the conflict between the two terms and enables the alignment of weak features. This distinctive feature sets our approach apart from most existing mesh simplification methods and demonstrates significant potential in shape understanding. Please refer to the teaser figure for illustration.
authors: Rui Xu 0016, Longdu Liu, Ningna Wang, Shuang-Min Chen, Shiqing Xin, Xiaohu Guo, Zichun Zhong, Taku Komura, Wenping Wang 0001, Changhe Tu

title: 通用三维表面的电容式触摸感应
title_en: Capacitive Touch Sensing on General 3D Surfaces.
abstract: 互电容式感应是检测多点触摸最常用的技术,尤其适用于平面和简单曲率表面。将其扩展到更复杂的形状仍具有挑战性,因为需要在表面上均匀分布感应电极以确保一致的触摸灵敏度。为解决此问题,我们提出了一种方法,将常见电容式多点触摸传感器的传感器布局适应于更复杂的三维表面,确保高分辨率、稳健的多点触摸检测。该方法自动计算一个在通用三维形状上尽可能规则分布的发射器和接收器电极网格。它首先通过四边形网格划分计算代理几何,用于通过双边图放置电极。然后在表面上安排电极,以最小化电容感应所需的触摸控制器数量以及连接电极与控制器的输入/输出引脚数量。我们使用新的简化与聚类算法实现这一目标,用于规则四边形贴片布局。减少的贴片布局用于优化所有结构(表面沟槽和内部管道)的布线,以容纳所有电极在表面和物体体积内,同时考虑三维形状的几何约束。最后,我们打印出准备安装电极的三维对象原型。我们使用不同的四边形网格划分分析所提出的四边形布局简化与聚类算法的性能,并表征电容式触摸传感器在不同非平面几何形状下的信号质量和精度。测试的原型展示了精确且稳健的多点触摸检测,具有良好的信噪比和约1mm的空间精度。
abstract_en: Mutual-capacitive sensing is the most common technology for detecting multi-touch, especially on flat and simple curvature surfaces. Its extension to a more complex shape is still challenging, as a uniform distribution of sensing electrodes is required for consistent touch sensitivity across the surface. To overcome this problem, we propose a method to adapt the sensor layout of common capacitive multi-touch sensors to more complex 3D surfaces, ensuring high-resolution, robust multi-touch detection. The method automatically computes a grid of transmitter and receiver electrodes with as regular distribution as possible over a general 3D shape. It starts with the computation of a proxy geometry by quad meshing used to place the electrodes through the dual-edge graph. It then arranges electrodes on the surface to minimize the number of touch controllers required for capacitive sensing and the number of input/output pins to connect the electrodes with the controllers. We reach these objectives using a new simplification and clustering algorithm for a regular quad-patch layout. The reduced patch layout is used to optimize the routing of all the structures (surface grooves and internal pipes) needed to host all electrodes on the surface and inside the object's volume, considering the geometric constraints of the 3D shape. Finally, we print the 3D object prototype ready to be equipped with the electrodes. We analyze the performance of the proposed quad layout simplification and clustering algorithm using different quad meshing and characterize the signal quality and accuracy of the capacitive touch sensor for different non-planar geometries. The tested prototypes show precise and robust multi-touch detection with good Signal-to-Noise Ratio and spatial accuracy of about 1mm.
authors: Gianpaolo Palma, Narges Pourjafarian, Jürgen Steimle, Paolo Cignoni

title: 具身角色控制器的类别码本匹配
title_en: Categorical Codebook Matching for Embodied Character Controllers.
abstract: 将真实用户动作转换到虚拟具身化身是元宇宙角色动画的关键挑战。本文提出了一种新颖的生成框架,能够实时将稀疏传感器信号映射为全身化身动作,同时忠实保留用户动作上下文。与现有需要分别训练动作先验及其控制到动作映射的技术不同,我们的框架可端到端地同时学习动作流形及其采样方法。为实现该目标,我们引入了一种称为码本匹配的技术,通过匹配输入输出两个类别码本的概率分布来合成角色动作。我们证明该技术可成功处理动作生成中的歧义,并从非结构化动作捕捉数据生成高质量角色控制器。该方法特别适用于需要高精度和响应性的交互应用,如虚拟现实或视频游戏。
abstract_en: Translating motions from a real user onto a virtual embodied avatar is a key challenge for character animation in the metaverse. In this work, we present a novel generative framework that enables mapping from a set of sparse sensor signals to a full body avatar motion in real-time while faithfully preserving the motion context of the user. In contrast to existing techniques that require training a motion prior and its mapping from control to motion separately, our framework is able to learn the motion manifold as well as how to sample from it at the same time in an end-to-end manner. To achieve that, we introduce a technique called codebook matching which matches the probability distribution between two categorical codebooks for the inputs and outputs for synthesizing the character motions. We demonstrate this technique can successfully handle ambiguity in motion generation and produce high quality character controllers from unstructured motion capture data. Our method is especially useful for interactive applications like virtual reality or video games where high accuracy and responsiveness are needed.
authors: Sebastian Starke, Paul Starke, Nicky He, Taku Komura, Yuting Ye

title: CharacterGen: 从单张图像高效生成3D角色的多视角姿态规范化方法
title_en: CharacterGen: Efficient 3D Character Generation from Single Images with Multi-View Pose Canonicalization.
abstract: BNRist, 清华大学计算机科学与技术系, 中国 在数字内容创作领域, 从单张图像生成高质量3D角色具有挑战性, 尤其是面对各种身体姿态的复杂性以及自遮挡和姿态歧义等问题。本文提出CharacterGen框架, 旨在高效生成3D角色。CharacterGen引入了简化生成流程和图像条件多视角扩散模型。该模型能有效校准输入姿态至规范形式, 同时保留输入图像的关键属性, 从而解决多样姿态带来的挑战。我们方法的另一个核心组件是基于Transformer的通用稀疏视角重建模型, 有助于从多视角图像创建详细3D模型。我们还采用纹理反投影策略生成高质量纹理图。此外, 我们构建了一个包含多种姿势和视角的动漫角色数据集, 用于训练和评估模型。通过定量和定性实验全面验证了我们的方法, 显示其在生成高质量形状和纹理的3D角色方面具有高效性, 可直接用于绑定和动画等下游应用。
abstract_en: BNRist, Department of Computer Science and Technology, Tsinghua University, China In the field of digital content creation, generating high-quality 3D characters from single images is challenging, especially given the complexities of various body poses and the issues of self-occlusion and pose ambiguity. In this paper, we present CharacterGen, a framework developed to efficiently generate 3D characters. CharacterGen introduces a streamlined generation pipeline along with an image-conditioned multi-view diffusion model. This model effectively calibrates input poses to a canonical form while retaining key attributes of the input image, thereby addressing the challenges posed by diverse poses. A transformer-based, generalizable sparse-view reconstruction model is the other core component of our approach, facilitating the creation of detailed 3D models from multi-view images. We also adopt a texture-back-projection strategy to produce high-quality texture maps. Additionally, we have curated a dataset of anime characters, rendered in multiple poses and views, to train and evaluate our model. Our approach has been thoroughly evaluated through quantitative and qualitative experiments, showing its proficiency in generating 3D characters with high-quality shapes and textures, ready for downstream applications such as rigging and animation.
authors: Hao-Yang Peng, Jia-Peng Zhang, Meng-Hao Guo, Yan-Pei Cao, Shi-Min Hu 0001

title: ColorVideoVDP: 一种用于图像、视频和显示失真的视觉差异预测器
title_en: ColorVideoVDP: A visual difference predictor for image, video and display distortions.
abstract: ColorVideoVDP是一种视频和图像质量度量方法,该方法同时建模了亮度和色度的空域与时域视觉特性。该度量方法基于新颖的色度空时对比敏感度和跨通道对比掩蔽的生理心理模型。它考虑了显示设备的观看条件、几何特性和光度特性。该方法被训练以预测常见的视频流失真(如视频压缩、缩放和传输错误),同时也预测了与AR/VR显示相关的8种新失真类型(如光源和波导非均匀性)。为应对后者应用,我们收集了新型XR-Display-Artifact-Video质量数据集(XR-DAVID),包含336个失真视频。在XR-DAVID以及多个文献数据集上的广泛测试表明,与现有度量方法相比,预测性能有显著提升。ColorVideoVDP为许多需要联合自动空时评估亮度和色度失真的新应用打开了大门,包括视频流、显示规格与设计、结果可视化比较以及感知引导的质量优化。该度量方法的代码可在https://github.com/gfxdisp/ColorVideoVDP获取。
abstract_en: ColorVideoVDP is a video and image quality metric that models spatial and temporal aspects of vision for both luminance and color. The metric is built on novel psychophysical models of chromatic spatiotemporal contrast sensitivity and cross-channel contrast masking. It accounts for the viewing conditions, geometric, and photometric characteristics of the display.
