It was trained to predict common video-streaming distortions (e.g., video compression, rescaling, and transmission errors) and also 8 new distortion types related to AR/VR displays (e.g., light source and waveguide non-uniformities). To address the latter application, we collected our novel XR-Display-Artifact-Video quality dataset (XR-DAVID), comprised of 336 distorted videos. Extensive testing on XR-DAVID, as well as several datasets from the literature, indicate a significant gain in prediction performance compared to existing metrics. ColorVideoVDP opens the doors to many novel applications that require the joint automated spatiotemporal assessment of luminance and color distortions, including video streaming, display specification, and design, visual comparison of results, and perceptually-guided quality optimization. The code for the metric can be found at https://github.com/gfxdisp/ColorVideoVDP.
authors: Rafal K. Mantiuk, Param Hanji, Maliha Ashraf, Yuta Asano, Alexandre Chapiro

title: 基于表面的可充气结构逆向设计的计算均质化方法
title_en: Computational Homogenization for Inverse Design of Surface-based Inflatables.
abstract: 基于表面的可充气结构由两层几乎不可伸长的片状材料沿精心选择的熔接曲线连接而成。充气过程中,压力作用力将两层材料分离以最大化封闭体积。熔接曲线限制了这种扩张,导致平面内空间变化的收缩,从而产生度量矛盾。充气结构最终达到平衡压力与材料内部弹性力的三维平衡状态。本文提出了一种分析和设计任意熔接模式的基于表面的可充气结构的计算框架。我们的方法采用数值均质化技术,表征参数化周期性可充气单元几何形状族的行为,这些形状可组合成具有平滑变化图案的片状结构。我们提出了一种新颖的变形空间参数化方法,允许对具有潜在开放边界条件的充气单元的拉伸和弯曲行为进行准确、高效且系统的分析。我们将均质化算法应用于创建涵盖广泛材料属性和变形特性的几何多样的熔接模式数据库。该数据库用于逆向设计算法中,求解熔接曲线以最佳逼近给定的目标曲面。通过几何展平算法选择并融合局部单元,形成基于全局曲线网络的结构。这些熔接曲线进一步优化以最小化展开结构与目标曲面的距离。我们证明,与之前的工作相比,该方法在逼近给定目标几何形状方面提供了更大的灵活性,同时显著提升了结构性能。
abstract_en: Surface-based inflatables are composed of two thin layers of nearly inextensible sheet material joined together along carefully selected fusing curves. During inflation, pressure forces separate the two sheets to maximize the enclosed volume. The fusing curves restrict this expansion, leading to a spatially varying in-plane contraction and hence metric frustration. The inflated structure settles into a 3D equilibrium that balances pressure forces with the internal elastic forces of the sheets. We present a computational framework for analyzing and designing surface-based inflatable structures with arbitrary fusing patterns. Our approach employs numerical homogenization to characterize the behavior of parametric families of periodic inflatable patch geometries, which can then be combined to tessellate the sheet with smoothly varying patterns. We propose a novel parametrization of the underlying deformation space that allows accurate, efficient, and systematical analysis of the stretching and bending behavior of inflated patches with potentially open boundaries. We apply our homogenization algorithm to create a database of geometrically diverse fusing patterns spanning a wide range of material properties and deformation characteristics. This database is employed in an inverse design algorithm that solves for fusing curves to best approximate a given input target surface. Local patches are selected and blended to form a global network of curves based on a geometric flattening algorithm. These fusing curves are then further optimized to minimize the distance of the deployed structure to target surface. We show that this approach offers greater flexibility to approximate given target geometries compared to previous work while significantly improving structural performance.
authors: Yingying Ren 0001, Julian Panetta, Seiichi Suzuki, Uday Kusupati, Florin Isvoranu, Mark Pauly

title: 计算错视编织
title_en: Computational Illusion Knitting.
abstract: 错视编织面料根据观察角度会呈现出不同的图案或图像。艺术家通过利用“微几何”,即针脚高度的小差异,手动实现了这一效果。然而,以往的计算3D编织研究并未对基于针脚高度变化的设计进行建模或利用。本文在计算设计与制造的背景下,为探索错视编织奠定了基础。我们观察到设计空间高度受限,阐明了这些约束,并提出了开发有效且可机织的错视图案的策略。我们在新的交互式设计工具中部分自动化了这些策略,将复杂的图案设计任务转化为熟悉的图像编辑任务。错视图案还揭示了关于混合色彩和纹理的新制造挑战;我们描述了新的算法,以减轻制造失败并确保高质量的编织结果。
abstract_en: Illusion-knit fabrics reveal distinct patterns or images depending on the viewing angle. Artists have manually achieved this effect by exploiting "microgeometry," i.e., small differences in stitch heights. However, past work in computational 3D knitting does not model or exploit designs based on stitch height variation. This paper establishes a foundation for exploring illusion knitting in the context of computational design and fabrication. We observe that the design space is highly constrained, elucidate these constraints, and derive strategies for developing effective, machine-knittable illusion patterns. We partially automate these strategies in a new interactive design tool that reduces difficult patterning tasks to familiar image editing tasks. Illusion patterns also uncover new fabrication challenges regarding mixed colorwork and texture; we describe new algorithms for mitigating fabrication failures and ensuring high-quality knit results.
authors: Amy Zhu, Yuxuan Mei, Benjamin T. Jones, Zachary Tatlock, Adriana Schulz

title: 条件混合路径引导用于可微渲染
title_en: Conditional Mixture Path Guiding for Differentiable Rendering.
abstract: 基于物理的可微渲染中逆优化的效率在很大程度上依赖于蒙特卡洛估计的方差。尽管近期研究强调了定制化差异采样策略的必要性,但通用方法仍未被探索。本文研究了局部采样决策与光路导数估计之间的相互作用。考虑到现代可微渲染算法在估计微分辐射度和普通辐射度时共享相同的路径,我们证明仅基于最后一个顶点的常规引导方法无法达到所需密度。相反,需要混合不同的采样分布,其中权重基于路径中所有先前采样的顶点进行条件。为体现我们的理论,我们实现了一种条件混合路径引导方法,该方法在运行时显式计算最优权重。此外,我们展示了如何进行正则化以消除符号方差,并扩展到包含数百万参数的场景。据我们所知,这是首个通用框架,用于将路径引导应用于可微渲染。大量实验表明,我们的方法在梯度估计方差降低和逆优化误差方面相比现有方法提升了近一个数量级。我们提出的方法实现可在https://github.com/mollnn/conditional-mixture获取。
abstract_en: The efficiency of inverse optimization in physically based differentiable rendering heavily depends on the variance of Monte Carlo estimation. Despite recent advancements emphasizing the necessity of tailored differential sampling strategies, the general approaches remain unexplored. In this paper, we investigate the interplay between local sampling decisions and the estimation of light path derivatives. Considering that modern differentiable rendering algorithms share the same path for estimating differential radiance and ordinary radiance, we demonstrate that conventional guiding approaches, conditioned solely on the last vertex, cannot attain this density. Instead, a mixture of different sampling distributions is required, where the weights are conditioned on all the previously sampled vertices in the path. To embody our theory, we implement a conditional mixture path guiding that explicitly computes optimal weights on the fly. Furthermore, we show how to perform positivization to eliminate sign variance and extend to scenes with millions of parameters. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first generic framework for applying path guiding to differentiable rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves nearly one order of magnitude improvements over state-of-the-art methods in terms of variance reduction in gradient estimation and errors of inverse optimization. The implementation of our proposed method is available at https://github.com/mollnn/conditional-mixture.
authors: Zhimin Fan 0001, Pengcheng Shi, Mufan Guo, Ruoyu Fu, Yanwen Guo 0001, Jie Guo 0001

title: 曲线纤维间的接触检测:高阶方法带来差异
title_en: Contact detection between curved fibres: high order makes a difference.
abstract: 计算机图形学在设计处理固体物体间接触与摩擦的有效算法方面有着悠久的历史。为了简化和通用性,大多数方法依赖于低阶基础元素(如线段或三角形),既用于接触检测也用于响应阶段。本文针对纤维系统,仔细分析了此类选择对获取接触力的影响。我们强调了在接触力响应中出现的伪影现象,这些现象与用于接触检测的低阶几何结构密切相关。我们的分析通过高阶超螺旋模型与低阶离散弹性杆模型的全面比较得出。这些比较揭示了当与基于线段的低阶检测方案耦合时,两种模型均会导致接触力曲线出现虚假跳跃。此外,这些伪影在纤维接触几何呈曲线时尤为明显。为消除此类伪影,我们开发了一种高阶曲线间的精确检测方案,该方案依赖于高效的自适应剪枝策略。我们使用该算法在超螺旋间实现高精度接触检测,从而在波浪状至高度卷曲的纤维范围内,获得比传统线段策略更平滑的滑动运动接触力曲线。此外,我们证明了与基于线段的方法相比,我们的方法在效率与精度的权衡方面具有更好的可扩展性,使其在需要准确可靠力的场景中更具吸引力。最后,我们在具有挑战性的头发梳理场景中验证了全高阶方法的鲁棒性与准确性。
abstract_en: Computer Graphics has a long history in the design of effective algorithms for handling contact and friction between solid objects. For the sake of simplicity and versatility, most methods rely on low-order primitives such as line segments or triangles, both for the detection and the response stages. In this paper we carefully analyse, in the case of fibre systems, the impact of such choices on the retrieved contact forces. We highlight the presence of artifacts in the force response that are tightly related to the low-order geometry used for contact detection. Our analysis draws upon thorough comparisons between the high-order super-helix model and the low-order discrete elastic rod model. These reveal that when coupled to a low-order, segment-based detection scheme, both models yield spurious jumps in the contact force profile. Moreover, these artifacts are shown to be all the more visible as the geometry of fibres at contact is curved. In order to remove such artifacts we develop an accurate high-order detection scheme between two smooth curves, which relies on an efficient adaptive pruning strategy. We use this algorithm to detect contact between super-helices at high precision, allowing us to recover, in the range of wavy to highly curly fibres, much smoother force profiles during sliding motion than with a classical segment-based strategy. Furthermore, we show that our approach offers better scaling properties in terms of efficiency vs. precision compared to segment-based approaches, making it attractive for applications where accurate and reliable forces are desired. Finally, we demonstrate the robustness and accuracy of our fully high-order approach on a challenging hair combing scenario.
authors: Octave Crespel, Emile Hohnadel, Thibaut Metivet, Florence Bertails-Descoubes

title: 从单张图像创建乐高人偶
title_en: Creating LEGO Figurines from Single Images.
abstract: 本文提出了一种计算流程,用于从用户输入的肖像照片生成个性化的实体乐高®1人偶。生成的人偶由连贯连接的乐高®积木组成,表面印有UV印刷贴纸,能够捕捉到显著特征如发型、服装风格和衣物颜色,以及复杂细节如标志、文字和图案。该任务具有挑战性,因为用户照片与风格一致的乐高®人偶模型之间存在显著的领域差距。为确保通过乐高®积木可组装性的同时捕捉显著特征和复杂细节,我们设计了一个三阶段流程:(i) 我们设计了一种CLIP引导的检索方法,连接用户照片与乐高®人偶的领域,然后输出不含贴纸的可物理组装的乐高®人偶;(ii) 接着通过基于用户照片提取外观特征的对称U-Net架构,在人偶上合成贴纸;(iii) 最后将贴纸重新投影并UV印刷到相关乐高®积木上,用于物理模型生产。我们通过八百个专家设计的人偶,使用包含新颖的GPT-4V评估指标的综合指标集评估方法的有效性,证明了我们的方法在视觉质量和与输入照片的相似度方面具有优越性能。此外,我们通过从多样化输入生成乐高®人偶,并物理制造和组装其中一些人偶,展示了方法的鲁棒性。
abstract_en: This paper presents a computational pipeline for creating personalized, physical LEGO®1 figurines from user-input portrait photos. The generated figurine is an assembly of coherently-connected LEGO® bricks detailed with uv-printed decals, capturing prominent features such as hairstyle, clothing style, and garment color, and also intricate details such as logos, text, and patterns. This task is non-trivial, due to the substantial domain gap between unconstrained user photos and the stylistically-consistent LEGO® figurine models. To ensure assemble-ability by LEGO® bricks while capturing prominent features and intricate details, we design a three-stage pipeline: (i) we formulate a CLIP-guided retrieval approach to connect the domains of user photos and LEGO® figurines, then output physically-assemble-able LEGO® figurines with decals excluded; (ii) we then synthesize decals on the figurines via a symmetric U-Nets architecture conditioned on appearance features extracted from user photos; and (iii) we next reproject and uv-print the decals on associated LEGO® bricks for physical model production. We evaluate the effectiveness of our method against eight hundred expert-designed figurines, using a comprehensive set of metrics, which include a novel GPT-4V-based evaluation metric, demonstrating superior performance of our method in visual quality and resemblance to input photos. Also, we show our method's robustness by generating LEGO® figurines from diverse inputs and physically fabricating and assembling several of them.
authors: Jiahao Ge, Mingjun Zhou, Wenrui Bao, Hao Xu 0034, Chi-Wing Fu

title: 蟋蟀:一种自供电鸣叫像素
title_en: Cricket: A Self-Powered Chirping Pixel.
abstract: 我们提出了一种传感器,能够测量光并无线传输测量结果,无需外部电源或电池。我们的传感器称为蟋蟀,通过入射光获取能量。它大部分时间处于休眠状态,当收集到的能量达到特定水平时,会发出短而强的射频鸣叫。每个蟋蟀的载波频率固定并揭示其身份,连续鸣叫之间的间隔时间是入射光强度的度量。我们表征了蟋蟀的辐射响应函数、信噪比和动态范围。我们通过实验验证了蟋蟀可以微型化,但会增加连续鸣叫间隔时间。我们展示了在立方体每个面上安装蟋蟀可用来估计任意复杂光照的质心,这对太阳能追踪等应用具有价值。我们还演示了蟋蟀在创建无缆传感器阵列中的应用,这些阵列可生成视频并控制照明以实现节能。最后,我们修改了蟋蟀的电路,开发出无需电池的电子墨镜,可即时适应环境光照。
abstract_en: We present a sensor that can measure light and wirelessly communicate the measurement, without the need for an external power source or a battery. Our sensor, called cricket, harvests energy from incident light. It is asleep for most of the time and transmits a short and strong radio frequency chirp when its harvested energy reaches a specific level. The carrier frequency of each cricket is fixed and reveals its identity, and the duration between consecutive chirps is a measure of the incident light level. We have characterized the radiometric response function, signal-to-noise ratio and dynamic range of cricket. We have experimentally verified that cricket can be miniaturized at the expense of increasing the duration between chirps. We show that a cube with a cricket on each of its sides can be used to estimate the centroid of any complex illumination, which has value in applications such as solar tracking. We also demonstrate the use of crickets for creating untethered sensor arrays that can produce video and control lighting for energy conservation. Finally, we modified cricket's circuit to develop battery-free electronic sunglasses that can instantly adapt to environmental illumination.
authors: Shree K. Nayar, Jeremy Klotz, Nikhil Nanda, Mikhail Fridberg

title: 曲率驱动的共形变形
title_en: Curvature-Driven Conformal Deformations.
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法,用于在R3中计算共形变形,同时最小化基于曲率的能量。基于曲率的能量是几何处理中的基本工具,对于表面平滑、变形以及使用可展或圆锥度量曲面进行逼近等任务至关重要。然而,准确计算几何嵌入,尤其是后者,一直是一个具有挑战性的任务。复杂性源于曲率估计中的固有数值不稳定性以及这些能量的微分性质的复杂性。为了解决这些挑战,我们专注于共形变形,将曲率张量作为模型中的主要变量。这一策略选择使基于曲率的能量易于应用,缓解了先前的操作困难。我们的主要贡献在于识别出一个先前未知的可积性条件,该条件建立了共形变形与曲率变化之间的联系。我们利用这一见解对任意亏格的表面进行变形,旨在最小化弯曲能量或指定高斯曲率,同时遵守位置约束。
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce a novel approach for computing conformal deformations in R3 while minimizing curvature-based energies. Curvature-based energies serve as fundamental tools in geometry processing, essential for tasks such as surface fairing, deformation, and approximation using developable or cone metric surfaces. However, accurately computing the geometric embedding, especially for the latter, has been a challenging endeavor. The complexity arises from inherent numerical instabilities in curvature estimation and the intricate nature of differentiating these energies. To address these challenges, we concentrate on conformal deformations, leveraging the curvature tensor as the primary variable in our model. This strategic choice renders curvature-based energies easily applicable, mitigating previous manipulation difficulties. Our key contribution lies in identifying a previously unknown integrability condition that establishes a connection between conformal deformations and changes in curvature. We use this insight to deform surfaces of arbitrary genus, aiming to minimize bending energies or prescribe Gaussian curvature while sticking to positional constraints.
authors: Etienne Corman

title: 通过眼动依赖图像变形减轻网络病
title_en: Cybersickness Reduction via Gaze-Contingent Image Deformation.
abstract: 虚拟现实技术 ushered in 一个沉浸式内容感知的革命性时代。然而,在动态环境中持续存在的挑战是由于视觉线索与前庭线索冲突导致的网络病发生。先前技术表明,通过模糊图像的周边部分、引入隧道视野或改变摄像机路径来限制错觉自运动(即视动效应)可有效缓解该问题。不幸的是,这些方法往往通过内容的可见变化影响用户体验。本文提出了一种新方法,通过微妙降低用户周边视野中物体的屏幕空间速度来减少视动效应并对抗网络病。该方法基于我们的假设:对周边物体速度的微小修改以及周边视野中的几何畸变可在不被察觉的情况下降低视动效应。本文描述了支持该假设的实验及其局限性。此外,我们提出了一种方法,通过在动画帧中引入微妙的屏幕空间几何畸变来抵消导致视动效应的运动。我们将该方法实现为一个实时后处理步骤,可集成到现有渲染框架中。技术的最终验证与对比替代方法的比较证实了其在减轻网络病方面的有效性。
abstract_en: Virtual reality has ushered in a revolutionary era of immersive content perception. However, a persistent challenge in dynamic environments is the occurrence of cybersickness arising from a conflict between visual and vestibular cues. Prior techniques have demonstrated that limiting illusory self-motion, so-called vection, by blurring the peripheral part of images, introducing tunnel vision, or altering the camera path can effectively reduce the problem. Unfortunately, these methods often alter the user's experience with visible changes to the content. In this paper, we propose a new technique for reducing vection and combating cybersickness by subtly lowering the screen-space speed of objects in the user's peripheral vision. The method is motivated by our hypothesis that small modifications to the objects' velocity in the periphery and geometrical distortions in the peripheral vision can remain unnoticeable yet lead to reduced vection. This paper describes the experiments supporting this hypothesis and derives its limits. Furthermore, we present a method that exploits these findings by introducing subtle, screen-space geometrical distortions to animation frames to counteract the motion contributing to vection. We implement the method as a realtime post-processing step that can be integrated into existing rendering frameworks. The final validation of the technique and comparison to an alternative approach confirms its effectiveness in reducing cybersickness.
authors: Colin Groth, Marcus A. Magnor, Steve Grogorick, Martin Eisemann, Piotr Didyk

title: 气旋生成:模拟飓风和龙卷风
title_en: Cyclogenesis: Simulating Hurricanes and Tornadoes.
abstract: 气旋是大气中由复杂的热力和水汽传输过程,以及多种水成物(即水和冰粒子)之间的相互作用所形成的大尺度现象。当气旋登陆时,被视为自然灾害,引发恐惧与敬畏。我们提出了一种基于物理的方法,以逼真且符合物理规律的方式描述气旋的三维发展过程。该方法使我们能够捕捉大尺度的热力和水汽连续性、水成物的湍流微物理动力学,以及行星边界层内的中尺度气旋过程。对这些过程的建模使我们能够模拟多种飓风和龙卷风现象。我们通过与风暴探测数据和气候学研究中飓风登陆观测数据的定量比较来评估模拟结果。此外,还通过与先前方法的定性比较来验证我们方案的不同部分。总之,我们的模型以全面的方式模拟气旋生成过程,使我们能够交互式地渲染一些最复杂天气事件的动画。
abstract_en: Cyclones are large-scale phenomena that result from complex heat and water transfer processes in the atmosphere, as well as from the interaction of multiple hydrometeors, i.e., water and ice particles. When cyclones make landfall, they are considered natural disasters and spawn dread and awe alike. We propose a physically-based approach to describe the 3D development of cyclones in a visually convincing and physically plausible manner. Our approach allows us to capture large-scale heat and water continuity, turbulent microphysical dynamics of hydrometeors, and mesoscale cyclonic processes within the planetary boundary layer. Modeling these processes enables us to simulate multiple hurricane and tornado phenomena. We evaluate our simulations quantitatively by comparing to real data from storm soundings and observations of hurricane landfall from climatology research. Additionally, qualitative comparisons to previous methods are performed to validate the different parts of our scheme. In summary, our model simulates cyclogenesis in a comprehensive way that allows us to interactively render animations of some of the most complex weather events.
authors: Jorge Alejandro Amador Herrera, Jonathan Klein, Daoming Liu, Wojtek Palubicki, Sören Pirk, Dominik L. Michels

title: 通过隐式曲面提取的深度草图矢量化
title_en: Deep Sketch Vectorization via Implicit Surface Extraction.
abstract: 我们提出了一种具有最先进精度的草图矢量化算法,能够处理复杂草图。我们将草图矢量化视为从无符号距离场中进行曲面提取的任务,该任务通过两阶段神经网络和双轮廓域后处理算法实现。第一阶段从输入栅格图像中提取无符号距离场。第二阶段采用改进的神经双轮廓网络,该网络对噪声输入更具鲁棒性,并且对线条几何结构更敏感。为了解决基于网格的曲面提取方法中固有的欠采样问题,我们显式预测欠采样和关键点图。这些图用于我们的后处理算法以解决尖锐特征和多路交汇点。关键点和欠采样图具有自然可控性,我们在交互式拓扑优化界面中进行了演示。我们的方法在复杂输入上生成的矢量化结果比以往方法更准确,且运行时间高效。
abstract_en: We introduce an algorithm for sketch vectorization with state-of-the-art accuracy and capable of handling complex sketches. We approach sketch vectorization as a surface extraction task from an unsigned distance field, which is implemented using a two-stage neural network and a dual contouring domain post processing algorithm. The first stage consists of extracting unsigned distance fields from an input raster image. The second stage consists of an improved neural dual contouring network more robust to noisy input and more sensitive to line geometry. To address the issue of under-sampling inherent in grid-based surface extraction approaches, we explicitly predict undersampling and keypoint maps. These are used in our post-processing algorithm to resolve sharp features and multi-way junctions. The keypoint and undersampling maps are naturally controllable, which we demonstrate in an interactive topology refinement interface. Our proposed approach produces far more accurate vectorizations on complex input than previous approaches with efficient running time.
authors: Chuan Yan, Yong Li, Deepali Aneja, Matthew Fisher, Edgar Simo-Serra, Yotam I. Gingold

title: DiffCAD:基于RGB图像的弱监督概率CAD模型检索与对齐
title_en: DiffCAD: Weakly-Supervised Probabilistic CAD Model Retrieval and Alignment from an RGB Image.
abstract: 基于CAD模型基本元素从RGB图像中感知3D结构,可以实现对场景的有效、高效的基于3D物体的表示。然而,现有方法依赖于与真实图像关联的CAD模型昂贵且不完美的标注监督,并面临任务固有歧义带来的挑战——包括单目感知中的深度-尺度歧义,以及CAD数据库模型与真实观测之间的不精确匹配。因此,我们提出DiffCAD,这是首个基于RGB图像的弱监督概率CAD模型检索与对齐方法。我们通过扩散学习概率模型,建模图像中CAD物体的形状、姿态和尺度的可能分布。这使得能够生成多种合理的CAD重建假设,仅需少量假设即可表征深度/尺度的歧义和形状不精确匹配的问题。我们的方法仅在合成数据上进行训练,利用单目深度和掩码估计以实现对各种真实目标领域的鲁棒零样本适应。尽管仅在合成数据上进行训练,我们的多假设方法在Scan2CAD数据集上甚至以8个假设超越了监督最先进水平5.9%。
abstract_en: Perceiving 3D structures from RGB images based on CAD model primitives can enable an effective, efficient 3D object-based representation of scenes. However, current approaches rely on supervision from expensive yet imperfect annotations of CAD models associated with real images, and encounter challenges due to the inherent ambiguities in the task - both in depth-scale ambiguity in monocular perception, as well as inexact matches of CAD database models to real observations. We thus propose DiffCAD, the first weakly-supervised probabilistic approach to CAD retrieval and alignment from an RGB image. We learn a probabilistic model through diffusion, modeling likely distributions of shape, pose, and scale of CAD objects in an image. This enables multi-hypothesis generation of different plausible CAD reconstructions, requiring only a few hypotheses to characterize ambiguities in depth/scale and inexact shape matches. Our approach is trained only on synthetic data, leveraging monocular depth and mask estimates to enable robust zero-shot adaptation to various real target domains. Despite being trained solely on synthetic data, our multi-hypothesis approach can even surpass the supervised state-of-the-art on the Scan2CAD dataset by 5.9% with 8 hypotheses.
authors: Daoyi Gao, Dávid Rozenberszki, Stefan Leutenegger, Angela Dai

title: DiffPoseTalk: 基于扩散模型的语音驱动风格化三维面部动画与头部姿态生成
title_en: DiffPoseTalk: Speech-Driven Stylistic 3D Facial Animation and Head Pose Generation via Diffusion Models.
abstract: 语音驱动的风格化三维面部动画生成面临显著挑战,因其需要学习语音、风格与对应自然面部运动之间的多对多映射关系。然而现有方法要么采用确定性模型进行语音到运动的映射,要么使用独热编码方案编码风格。值得注意的是,独热编码方法无法捕捉风格的复杂性,从而限制了泛化能力。本文提出DiffPoseTalk,一种基于扩散模型的生成框架,结合风格编码器从短参考视频中提取风格嵌入。推理阶段采用分类器自由引导,根据语音和风格指导生成过程。特别地,我们的风格包含头部姿态生成,从而增强用户感知。此外,我们通过在高质量野外音频-视觉数据集重建的3DMM参数上训练模型,解决了扫描三维说话人脸数据不足的问题。大量实验和用户研究验证了我们的方法优于现有技术。代码和数据集见https://diffposetalk.github.io。
abstract_en: The generation of stylistic 3D facial animations driven by speech presents a significant challenge as it requires learning a many-to-many mapping between speech, style, and the corresponding natural facial motion. However, existing methods either employ a deterministic model for speech-to-motion mapping or encode the style using a one-hot encoding scheme. Notably, the one-hot encoding approach fails to capture the complexity of the style and thus limits generalization ability. In this paper, we propose DiffPoseTalk, a generative framework based on the diffusion model combined with a style encoder that extracts style embeddings from short reference videos. During inference, we employ classifier-free guidance to guide the generation process based on the speech and style. In particular, our style includes the generation of head poses, thereby enhancing user perception. Additionally, we address the shortage of scanned 3D talking face data by training our model on reconstructed 3DMM parameters from a high-quality, in-the-wild audio-visual dataset. Extensive experiments and user study demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The code and dataset are at https://diffposetalk.github.io.
authors: Zhiyao Sun, Tian Lv, Sheng Ye, Matthieu Gaetan Lin, Jenny Sheng, Yu-Hui Wen, Minjing Yu, Yong-Jin Liu 0001

title: 三角网格上的可微测地线距离用于内在最小化
title_en: Differentiable Geodesic Distance for Intrinsic Minimization on Triangle Meshes.
abstract: 在几何处理及其他领域中,计算离散曲面上的内在距离是许多最小化问题的核心。解决这些问题极具挑战性,因为它需要计算曲面上的距离及其导数。我们提出了一种新颖的方法,用于三角网格上基于距离的目标函数的内在最小化。通过最短路径测地线的变分公式,我们基于隐函数定理计算了第一和第二阶距离导数,从而为高效的牛顿型最小化求解器打开了大门。我们在一系列示例中展示了我们的可微测地线距离框架,包括任意亏格曲面上的测地线网络和膜、宿主曲面与嵌入系统的双向耦合、可微测地线Voronoi图以及复杂形状上Karcher均值的高效计算。我们的分析表明,基于可微测地线的二阶下降方法在现有的一阶和拟牛顿方法上表现出显著优势。
abstract_en: Computing intrinsic distances on discrete surfaces is at the heart of many minimization problems in geometry processing and beyond. Solving these problems is extremely challenging as it demands the computation of on-surface distances along with their derivatives. We present a novel approach for intrinsic minimization of distance-based objectives defined on triangle meshes. Using a variational formulation of shortest-path geodesics, we compute first and second-order distance derivatives based on the implicit function theorem, thus opening the door to efficient Newton-type minimization solvers. We demonstrate our differentiable geodesic distance framework on a wide range of examples, including geodesic networks and membranes on surfaces of arbitrary genus, two-way coupling between hosting surface and embedded system, differentiable geodesic Voronoi diagrams, and efficient computation of Karcher means on complex shapes. Our analysis shows that second-order descent methods based on our differentiable geodesics outperform existing first-order and quasi-Newton methods by large margins.
authors: Yue Li 0049, Logan Numerow, Bernhard Thomaszewski, Stelian Coros

title: 基于细胞的机械系统模拟的可微分Voronoi图
title_en: Differentiable Voronoi Diagrams for Simulation of Cell-Based Mechanical Systems.
abstract: 在细胞机械系统中导航拓扑转换是现有模拟方法的重大挑战。尽管抽象模型在细胞层面缺乏预测能力,显式网络表示难以处理拓扑变化,而单细胞表示在大规模模拟中计算成本过高。为解决这些挑战,我们提出了一种基于可微分Voronoi图的新型以细胞为中心的方法。通过将每个细胞表示为Voronoi点,我们的方法隐式定义了界面网络的形状和拓扑结构。这样,我们显著减少了问题变量数量,消除了对显式接触处理的需求,并确保在拓扑转换过程中几何形状的连续变化。网络位置的闭式导数使得能够使用牛顿型方法模拟广泛范围的单细胞能量。最后,我们将可微分Voronoi图扩展以实现与任意刚性及可变形边界的耦合。我们通过一系列多样化示例应用我们的方法,突出细胞的分裂与合并以及邻域变化。我们通过将泡沫模拟与真实图像匹配来展示逆问题的应用。与显式细胞模型的比较分析表明,我们的方法在显著更快的计算时间内实现了定性相当的结果。
abstract_en: Navigating topological transitions in cellular mechanical systems is a significant challenge for existing simulation methods. While abstract models lack predictive capabilities at the cellular level, explicit network representations struggle with topology changes, and per-cell representations are computationally too demanding for large-scale simulations. To address these challenges, we propose a novel cell-centered approach based on differentiable Voronoi diagrams. Representing each cell with a Voronoi site, our method defines shape and topology of the interface network implicitly. In this way, we substantially reduce the number of problem variables, eliminate the need for explicit contact handling, and ensure continuous geometry changes during topological transitions. Closed-form derivatives of network positions facilitate simulation with Newton-type methods for a wide range of per-cell energies. Finally, we extend our differentiable Voronoi diagrams to enable coupling with arbitrary rigid and deformable boundaries. We apply our approach to a diverse set of examples, highlighting splitting and merging of cells as well as neighborhood changes. We illustrate applications to inverse problems by matching soap foam simulations to real-world images. Comparative analysis with explicit cell models reveals that our method achieves qualitatively comparable results at significantly faster computation times.
authors: Logan Numerow, Yue Li 0049, Stelian Coros, Bernhard Thomaszewski

title: DreamMat:基于几何和光照感知的扩散模型高质量基于物理的渲染材质生成
title_en: DreamMat: High-quality PBR Material Generation with Geometry- and Light-aware Diffusion Models.
abstract: 近年来,二维扩散模型在未贴图的原始网格上实现了外观生成。这些方法通过蒸馏二维扩散模型生成RGB贴图,但往往包含不必要的烘焙入的阴影效果,导致下游应用中出现不真实的渲染效果。生成基于物理的渲染(PBR)材质而非单纯的RGB贴图将是一个有前景的解决方案。然而,直接从二维扩散模型蒸馏PBR材质参数仍存在材料分解错误的问题,例如漫反射率中的烘焙入阴影效果。我们提出DreamMat,一种创新方法以解决上述问题,从文本描述中生成高质量的PBR材质。我们发现,材料蒸馏错误的主要原因是大规模二维扩散模型仅训练生成最终的着色颜色,导致蒸馏过程中对材料分解的约束不足。为解决此问题,我们首先微调一个新的光照感知二维扩散模型,使其能够根据给定的光照环境生成特定光照条件下的着色结果。随后,通过在材质蒸馏过程中应用相同的环境光照,DreamMat能够生成不仅与给定几何结构一致且漫反射率中无任何烘焙入阴影效果的高质量PBR材质。大量实验表明,通过我们的方法生成的材质在视觉吸引力和渲染质量上均显著优于基线方法,更适用于游戏和影视制作等下游任务。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in 2D diffusion models allow appearance generation on untextured raw meshes. These methods create RGB textures by distilling a 2D diffusion model, which often contains unwanted baked-in shading effects and results in unrealistic rendering effects in the downstream applications. Generating Physically Based Rendering (PBR) materials instead of just RGB textures would be a promising solution. However, directly distilling the PBR material parameters from 2D diffusion models still suffers from incorrect material decomposition, such as baked-in shading effects in albedo. We introduce DreamMat, an innovative approach to resolve the aforementioned problem, to generate high-quality PBR materials from text descriptions. We find out that the main reason for the incorrect material distillation is that large-scale 2D diffusion models are only trained to generate final shading colors, resulting in insufficient constraints on material decomposition during distillation. To tackle this problem, we first finetune a new light-aware 2D diffusion model to condition on a given lighting environment and generate the shading results on this specific lighting condition. Then, by applying the same environment lights in the material distillation, DreamMat can generate high-quality PBR materials that are not only consistent with the given geometry but also free from any baked-in shading effects in albedo. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the materials produced through our methods exhibit greater visual appeal to users and achieve significantly superior rendering quality compared to baseline methods, which are preferable for downstream tasks such as game and film production.
authors: Yuqing Zhang 0005, Yuan Liu 0025, Zhiyu Xie 0004, Lei Yang 0048, Zhongyuan Liu, Mengzhou Yang, Runze Zhang, Qilong Kou, Cheng Lin 0001, Wenping Wang 0001, Xiaogang Jin 0001

title: DressCode:基于文本引导的自回归式缝制与生成服装
title_en: DressCode: Autoregressively Sewing and Generating Garments from Text Guidance.
abstract: 服装在人类外貌中的重要性凸显了服装数字化在数字人创建中的关键作用。近期3D内容创作的进展对数字人创建至关重要。然而,基于文本引导的服装生成仍处于初级阶段。我们提出了一种文本驱动的3D服装生成框架DressCode,旨在使初学者也能参与设计,并在时尚设计、虚拟试穿和数字人创建领域展现巨大潜力。我们首先引入SewingGPT,这是一种基于GPT的架构,通过结合交叉注意力机制与文本条件嵌入,以文本引导生成缝制图案。随后,我们调整预训练的Stable Diffusion模型,生成基于瓷砖的基于物理的渲染(PBR)纹理。通过利用大型语言模型,我们的框架通过自然语言交互生成适合计算机图形学的服装。该框架还支持图案补全和纹理编辑,通过用户友好的交互简化设计流程。该框架通过允许创作者自由实验设计并融入独特元素,促进创新。通过全面的评估与与其他最先进方法的比较,我们的方法在质量与输入提示的匹配度方面表现卓越。用户研究进一步验证了我们高质量的渲染结果,突显其在生产环境中的实用价值和潜力。我们的项目页面是https://IHe-KaiI.github.io/DressCode/。
abstract_en: Apparel's significant role in human appearance underscores the importance of garment digitalization for digital human creation. Recent advances in 3D content creation are pivotal for digital human creation. Nonetheless, garment generation from text guidance is still nascent. We introduce a text-driven 3D garment generation framework, DressCode, which aims to democratize design for novices and offer immense potential in fashion design, virtual try-on, and digital human creation. We first introduce SewingGPT, a GPT-based architecture integrating cross-attention with text-conditioned embedding to generate sewing patterns with text guidance. We then tailor a pre-trained Stable Diffusion to generate tile-based Physically-based Rendering (PBR) textures for the garments. By leveraging a large language model, our framework generates CG-friendly garments through natural language interaction. It also facilitates pattern completion and texture editing, streamlining the design process through user-friendly interaction. This framework fosters innovation by allowing creators to freely experiment with designs and incorporate unique elements into their work. With comprehensive evaluations and comparisons with other state-of-the-art methods, our method showcases superior quality and alignment with input prompts. User studies further validate our high-quality rendering results, highlighting its practical utility and potential in production settings. Our project page is https://IHe-KaiI.github.io/DressCode/.
authors: Kai He, Kaixin Yao, Qixuan Zhang, Jingyi Yu 0001, Lingjie Liu, Lan Xu 0003

title: EASI-Tex:基于单图像的边缘感知网格纹理化
title_en: EASI-Tex: Edge-Aware Mesh Texturing from Single Image.
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的单图像网格纹理化方法,该方法采用具有精心设计条件控制的扩散模型,无缝地将物体的纹理从单张RGB图像转移到给定的3D网格物体上。我们不假设这两个物体属于同一类别,即使它们属于同一类别,其几何形状和部分比例也可能存在显著差异。我们的方法通过ControlNet将描述网格的边缘信息作为条件,对预训练的Stable Diffusion生成器进行条件化,并利用IP-Adapter从输入图像中提取特征,无需任何优化或训练即可生成符合网格几何结构和输入纹理的纹理。我们还引入了Image Inversion技术,这是一种新颖的方法,通过单张图像快速个性化扩散模型,用于预训练IP-Adapter无法准确捕捉输入图像细节的情况。实验结果验证了我们提出的边缘感知单图像网格纹理化方法EASI-Tex在保持输入纹理细节方面的效率和有效性,同时尊重不同3D物体的几何结构。代码:https://github.com/sairajk/easi-tex
abstract_en: We present a novel approach for single-image mesh texturing, which employs a diffusion model with judicious conditioning to seamlessly transfer an object's texture from a single RGB image to a given 3D mesh object. We do not assume that the two objects belong to the same category, and even if they do, there can be significant discrepancies in their geometry and part proportions. Our method aims to rectify the discrepancies by conditioning a pre-trained Stable Diffusion generator with edges describing the mesh through ControlNet, and features extracted from the input image using IP-Adapter to generate textures that respect the underlying geometry of the mesh and the input texture without any optimization or training. We also introduce Image Inversion, a novel technique to quickly personalize the diffusion model for a single concept using a single image, for cases where the pre-trained IP-Adapter falls short in capturing all the details from the input image faithfully. Experimental results demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of our edge-aware single-image mesh texturing approach, coined EASI-Tex, in preserving the details of the input texture on diverse 3D objects, while respecting their geometry. Code: https://github.com/sairajk/easi-tex
authors: Sai Raj Kishore Perla, Yizhi Wang, Ali Mahdavi-Amiri, Hao Zhang 0002

title: 陡峭地形侵蚀的高效泥石流模拟
title_en: Efficient Debris-flow Simulation for Steep Terrain Erosion.
abstract: 侵蚀模拟是生成和塑造山地地形的常用方法。尽管水被视为主要的侵蚀因素,但其模拟无法准确捕捉山脊附近的陡峭坡面。在这些排水能力较低的区域,侵蚀通常被近似为减坡侵蚀,导致坡度分布不自然地均匀。然而,地貌学观察到另一种过程主导了低排水区域:由强烈气候事件触发的泥石流侵蚀,即泥沙与岩石的混合物。我们提出了一种新方法,通过源自地貌学的新数学公式描述泥石流侵蚀,并结合统一的GPU算法实现侵蚀与沉积的模拟。特别是,我们观察到沉积物和碎屑的沉积往往与河流路径相交,这促使我们设计了一种新的近似流路由算法,用于GPU上估算这些新形成洼地的水流路径。我们证明了泥石流在陡峭坡面形成独特的侵蚀痕迹,并与下游河流侵蚀竞争形成沉积锥体。
abstract_en: Erosion simulation is a common approach used for generating and authoring mountainous terrains. While water is considered the primary erosion factor, its simulation fails to capture steep slopes near the ridges. In these low-drainage areas, erosion is often approximated with slope-reducing erosion, which yields unrealistically uniform slopes. However, geomorphology observed that another process dominates the low-drainage areas: erosion by debris flow, which is a mixture of mud and rocks triggered by strong climatic events. We propose a new method to capture the interactions between debris flow and fluvial erosion thanks to a new mathematical formulation for debris flow erosion derived from geomorphology and a unified GPU algorithm for erosion and deposition. In particular, we observe that sediment and debris deposition tend to intersect river paths, which motivates the design of a new, approximate flow routing algorithm on the GPU to estimate the water path out of these newly formed depressions. We demonstrate that debris flow carves distinct patterns in the form of erosive scars on steep slopes and cones of deposited debris competing with fluvial erosion downstream.
authors: Aryamaan Jain, Bedrich Benes, Guillaume Cordonnier

title: 基于粒子流映射的欧拉-拉格朗日流体模拟
title_en: Eulerian-Lagrangian Fluid Simulation on Particle Flow Maps.
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的粒子流映射(PFM)方法,以实现不可压缩流体模拟中的精确长程输运。该方法的基础是观察到正向模拟中生成的粒子轨迹自然包含完美的流映射。基于这一概念,我们开发了一个欧拉-拉格朗日框架,包含四个核心组件:用于自然且精确表示双向流映射的拉格朗日粒子;双尺度映射表示法以适应多种流场量的映射;用于粒子到网格节点精确量传递的粒子-网格插值方案;以及用于在网格上强制不可压缩性的混合冲量求解器。通过多种模拟场景验证了PFM的有效性,突显了复杂涡旋结构的演化和湍流细节。值得注意的是,与NFM相比,PFM在计算时间上减少了高达49倍,在内存消耗上减少了高达41%,同时如跳跃蛙、涡管和湍流等测试所示,显著提升了涡量保持能力。
abstract_en: We propose a novel Particle Flow Map (PFM) method to enable accurate long-range advection for incompressible fluid simulation. The foundation of our method is the observation that a particle trajectory generated in a forward simulation naturally embodies a perfect flow map. Centered on this concept, we have developed an Eulerian-Lagrangian framework comprising four essential components: Lagrangian particles for a natural and precise representation of bidirectional flow maps; a dual-scale map representation to accommodate the mapping of various flow quantities; a particle-to-grid interpolation scheme for accurate quantity transfer from particles to grid nodes; and a hybrid impulse-based solver to enforce incompressibility on the grid. The efficacy of PFM has been demonstrated through various simulation scenarios, highlighting the evolution of complex vortical structures and the details of turbulent flows. Notably, compared to NFM, PFM reduces computing time by up to 49 times and memory consumption by up to 41%, while enhancing vorticity preservation as evidenced in various tests like leapfrog, vortex tube, and turbulent flow.
authors: Junwei Zhou 0001, Duowen Chen 0003, Molin Deng, Yitong Deng, Yuchen Sun 0002, Sinan Wang, Shiying Xiong, Bo Zhu 0002

title: 织物镶嵌:通过荷叶边缝纫实现自由曲面
title_en: Fabric Tessellation: Realizing Freeform Surfaces by Smocking.
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法,利用平面织物片实现自由曲面,通过荷叶边缝纫技术将织物上的点缝合以形成曲率。荷叶边缝纫以其能产生复杂几何纹理和蓬松褶皱而闻名。然而,它主要用于实现平面形状或手动设计的有限类曲面。我们的方法结合了方向场的计算与平面Tangram图的连续优化,从而能够通过具有多样对称性的荷叶边缝纫图案实现任意拓扑结构和曲率的表面。给定目标表面和期望的荷叶边缝纫图案,我们的方法输出对应的二维缝纫图案,可通过缝合指定点进行制作。所得纺织品制作近似目标形状,并呈现出视觉愉悦的褶皱。我们通过物理制作各种荷叶边缝纫示例验证了该方法。
abstract_en: We present a novel method for realizing freeform surfaces with pieces of flat fabric, where curvature is created by stitching together points on the fabric using a technique known as smocking. Smocking is renowned for producing intricate geometric textures with voluminous pleats. However, it has been mostly used to realize flat shapes or manually designed, limited classes of curved surfaces. Our method combines the computation of directional fields with continuous optimization of a Tangram graph in the plane, which together allow us to realize surfaces of arbitrary topology and curvature with smocking patterns of diverse symmetries. Given a target surface and the desired smocking pattern, our method outputs a corresponding 2D smocking pattern that can be fabricated by sewing specified points together. The resulting textile fabrication approximates the target shape and exhibits visually pleasing pleats. We validate our method through physical fabrication of various smocked examples.
authors: Aviv Segall, Jing Ren 0004, Amir Vaxman, Olga Sorkine-Hornung

title: FlexScale:柔性缩放片材的建模与表征
title_en: FlexScale: Modeling and Characterization of Flexible Scaled Sheets.
abstract: 我们提出了一种计算方法,用于建模柔性缩放片材材料的机械行为——即嵌入软质基底中的3D打印硬质鳞片。在强度与柔韧性之间取得平衡,这类结构材料被应用于防护装备、软体机器人和3D打印时尚领域。然而要充分发挥其潜力,必须解析鳞片图案与机械性能之间的复杂关系。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种接触感知的均质化方法,将原始级仿真数据提炼为新颖的宏观力学模型。该宏观模型结合分段二次单轴拟合与圆谐波极坐标插值,可高效模拟大规模图案。我们将该方法应用于探索等面鳞片图案空间,揭示了多样化的各向异性与非线性材料行为。通过大量实验验证,我们的模型能够再现多种鳞片级效应,并在宏观尺度上与物理原型表现出良好的定性一致性。
abstract_en: We present a computational approach for modeling the mechanical behavior of flexible scaled sheet materials---3D-printed hard scales embedded in a soft substrate. Balancing strength and flexibility, these structured materials find applications in protective gear, soft robotics, and 3D-printed fashion. To unlock their full potential, however, we must unravel the complex relation between scale pattern and mechanical properties. To address this problem, we propose a contact-aware homogenization approach that distills native-level simulation data into a novel macromechanical model. This macro-model combines piecewise-quadratic uniaxial fits with polar interpolation using circular harmonics, allowing for efficient simulation of large-scale patterns. We apply our approach to explore the space of isohedral scale patterns, revealing a diverse range of anisotropic and nonlinear material behaviors. Through an extensive set of experiments, we show that our models reproduce various scale-level effects while offering good qualitative agreement with physical prototypes on the macro-level.
authors: Juan Montes Maestre 0001, Yinwei Du, Ronan Hinchet, Stelian Coros, Bernhard Thomaszewski

title: 从微表面到参与介质:基于随机几何的光传输统一理论
title_en: From microfacets to participating media: A unified theory of light transport with stochastic geometry.
abstract: 随机几何模型在图形学中成功地用于建模光与复杂现象(如参与介质、粗糙表面、纤维等)的相互作用。尽管这些模型均基于将复杂几何替换为随机过程并推导所有实例的平均光传输的相同原理,但它们各自针对特定应用进行了定制,本质上存在根本差异。场景中每种随机几何类型均被封装在独立的外观模型中,具有各自的统计特性与光传输平均值,不同模型或确定性几何与随机几何之间无法进行交互。本文提出了一种基于随机隐式曲面的光传输理论,该几何模型能够表达确定性几何、微表面、参与介质以及介于二者之间的一个令人兴奋的新连续体,包含聚集外观、非经典介质等。我们的模型自然支持空间相关性,这是大多数现有随机模型所缺失的。该理论为所有几何均通过相同随机模型描述的场景的可计算渲染奠定了基础,同时为开发高效的采样与渲染算法留下了充分的研究空间。
abstract_en: Stochastic geometry models have enjoyed immense success in graphics for modeling interactions of light with complex phenomena such as participating media, rough surfaces, fibers, and more. Although each of these models operates on the same principle of replacing intricate geometry by a random process and deriving the average light transport across all instances thereof, they are each tailored to one specific application and are fundamentally distinct. Each type of stochastic geometry present in the scene is firmly encapsulated in its own appearance model, with its own statistics and light transport average, and no cross-talk between different models or deterministic and stochastic geometry is possible. In this paper, we derive a theory of light transport on stochastic implicit surfaces, a geometry model capable of expressing deterministic geometry, microfacet surfaces, participating media, and an exciting new continuum in between containing aggregate appearance, non-classical media, and more. Our model naturally supports spatial correlations, missing from most existing stochastic models. Our theory paves the way for tractable rendering of scenes in which all geometry is described by the same stochastic model, while leaving ample future work for developing efficient sampling and rendering algorithms.
authors: Dario Seyb, Eugene d'Eon, Benedikt Bitterli, Wojciech Jarosz

title: 顺应流体动力学
title_en: Going with the Flow.
abstract: 给定一个物体的姿势序列,我们研究当该物体浸入(可能运动的)不可压缩介质中时产生的运动。在给定姿势(例如由动画师提供)的情况下,支配的二阶常微分方程是受多种力作用的具有时间依赖惯性的刚体方程。其中一些力,如升力和阻力,依赖于物体在周围介质中的运动。此外,惯性必须通过附加质量编码介质的影响。我们推导出相应的动力学方程,这些方程推广了标准刚体动力学方程。所有力均基于仅使用质量密度等物理参数的局部计算。值得注意的是,我们通过局部计算近似介质对物体的影响,避免了对介质的全局模拟。因此,我们需要在时间上积分的方程组仅为6维(旋转和平移)。我们提出的算法具有线性复杂度,能够捕捉依赖于物体-流体相互作用的复杂自然现象。
abstract_en:
Given a sequence of poses of a body we study the motion resulting when the body is immersed in a (possibly) moving, incompressible medium. With the poses given, say, by an animator, the governing second-order ordinary differential equations are those of a rigid body with time-dependent inertia acted upon by various forces. Some of these forces, like lift and drag, depend on the motion of the body in the surrounding medium. Additionally, the inertia must encode the effect of the medium through its
 added mass.
 We derive the corresponding dynamics equations which generalize the standard rigid body dynamics equations. All forces are based on local computations using only physical parameters such as mass density. Notably, we approximate the effect of the medium on the body through local computations avoiding any global simulation of the medium. Consequently, the system of equations we must integrate in time is only 6 dimensional (rotation and translation). Our proposed algorithm displays linear complexity and captures intricate natural phenomena that depend on body-fluid interactions.
authors: Yousuf Soliman, Marcel Padilla, Oliver Gross 0001, Felix Knöppel, Ulrich Pinkall, Peter Schröder

title: 全息视差提升三维感知真实感
title_en: Holographic Parallax Improves 3D Perceptual Realism.
abstract: 全息近眼显示技术是解决虚拟现实和增强现实显示系统长期挑战的有前景方案。近年来,许多不同类型的计算机生成全息图(CGH)算法被提出,这些算法由不同类型的目标内容监督,例如2.5D RGB-深度图、3D焦深堆栈和4D光场。然而,目前尚不清楚算法选择和目标内容类型对感知效果的具体影响。在本研究中,我们构建了一个全彩色、高质量的全息近眼显示感知测试平台。在自然观看条件下,我们考察了不同CGH监督格式的影响,并通过用户研究评估其对三维真实感的感知影响。研究结果表明,针对特定视角设计的CGH算法在实现三维真实感方面存在明显不足。相比之下,包含视差线索的全息图在不同观看条件下(包括视场中心区域)均优于其他格式。这一发现尤其引人注目,表明在CGH渲染中包含视差线索对提升全息体验的整体质量起着关键作用。本研究代表了向通过全息近眼显示实现感知真实三维体验迈出的初步步伐。
abstract_en: Holographic near-eye displays are a promising technology to solve long-standing challenges in virtual and augmented reality display systems. Over the last few years, many different computer-generated holography (CGH) algorithms have been proposed that are supervised by different types of target content, such as 2.5D RGB-depth maps, 3D focal stacks, and 4D light fields. It is unclear, however, what the perceptual implications are of the choice of algorithm and target content type. In this work, we build a perceptual testbed of a full-color, high-quality holographic near-eye display. Under natural viewing conditions, we examine the effects of various CGH supervision formats and conduct user studies to assess their perceptual impacts on 3D realism. Our results indicate that CGH algorithms designed for specific viewpoints exhibit noticeable deficiencies in achieving 3D realism. In contrast, holograms incorporating parallax cues consistently outperform other formats across different viewing conditions, including the center of the eyebox. This finding is particularly interesting and suggests that the inclusion of parallax cues in CGH rendering plays a crucial role in enhancing the overall quality of the holographic experience. This work represents an initial stride towards delivering a perceptually realistic 3D experience with holographic near-eye displays.
authors: Dongyeon Kim, Seung-Woo Nam 0002, Suyeon Choi, Jong-Mo Seo, Gordon Wetzstein, Yoonchan Jeong

title: 隐式扫过的体积符号距离场:使任意形状的连续无碰撞轨迹生成成为可能
title_en: Implicit Swept Volume SDF: Enabling Continuous Collision-Free Trajectory Generation for Arbitrary Shapes.
abstract: 在物体轨迹生成领域,确保连续无碰撞运动仍然是一个巨大挑战,尤其是在非凸几何体和复杂环境中。先前方法要么过度简化物体形状,导致可行空间的牺牲,要么依赖离散采样,从而遭受"隧道效应"的困扰。为解决这些局限性,我们提出了一种新颖的分层轨迹生成管道,利用扫过的体积符号距离场(SVSDF)指导连续无碰撞避障(CCA)的轨迹优化。我们的跨学科方法融合了图形学与机器人学技术,在解决该问题上展现出卓越的有效性。我们将SVSDF的计算形式化为广义半无限规划模型,并通过隐式方式在查询点求解数值解,从而无需显式重建表面。我们的算法已在多种复杂场景中得到验证,适用于各种动力学的机器人,包括刚性和可变形形状。与典型算法相比,它展现出卓越的普适性和优越的CCA性能。代码将发布于https://github.com/ZJU-FAST-Lab/Implicit-SVSDF-Planner以造福社区。
abstract_en: In the field of trajectory generation for objects, ensuring continuous collision-free motion remains a huge challenge, especially for non-convex geometries and complex environments. Previous methods either oversimplify object shapes, which results in a sacrifice of feasible space or rely on discrete sampling, which suffers from the "tunnel effect". To address these limitations, we propose a novel hierarchical trajectory generation pipeline, which utilizes the Swept Volume Signed Distance Field (SVSDF) to guide trajectory optimization for Continuous Collision Avoidance (CCA). Our interdisciplinary approach, blending techniques from graphics and robotics, exhibits outstanding effectiveness in solving this problem. We formulate the computation of the SVSDF as a Generalized Semi-Infinite Programming model, and we solve for the numerical solutions at query points implicitly, thereby eliminating the need for explicit reconstruction of the surface. Our algorithm has been validated in a variety of complex scenarios and applies to robots of various dynamics, including both rigid and deformable shapes. It demonstrates exceptional universality and superior CCA performance compared to typical algorithms. The code will be released at https://github.com/ZJU-FAST-Lab/Implicit-SVSDF-Planner for the benefit of the community.
authors: Jingping Wang, Tingrui Zhang, Qixuan Zhang, Chuxiao Zeng, Jingyi Yu 0001, Chao Xu 0001, Lan Xu 0003, Fei Gao 0011

title: 基于自回归运动扩散模型的交互式角色控制
title_en: Interactive Character Control with Auto-Regressive Motion Diffusion Models.
abstract: 实时角色控制是交互体验的关键组成部分,具有广泛的应用领域,包括物理模拟、视频游戏和虚拟现实。扩散模型在图像合成领域的成功应用促使这些模型被用于运动合成。然而,大多数运动扩散模型主要设计用于离线应用,其中时空模型用于同时合成预设长度的完整帧序列。为实现允许时变控制的实时运动合成,我们提出A-MDM(自回归运动扩散模型)。我们的条件扩散模型以初始姿态为输入,并基于前一帧自回归地生成连续运动帧。尽管其网络架构采用简单的MLP,我们的框架仍能生成多样、长时序且高保真的运动序列。此外,我们引入了一系列技术将交互控制整合到A-MDM中,如任务导向采样、图像修复和分层强化学习(见图1)。这些技术使预训练的A-MDM能够高效适配多种新的下游任务。我们进行了全面的实验以验证A-MDM的有效性,并将其性能与最先进的自回归方法进行比较。
abstract_en: Real-time character control is an essential component for interactive experiences, with a broad range of applications, including physics simulations, video games, and virtual reality. The success of diffusion models for image synthesis has led to the use of these models for motion synthesis. However, the majority of these motion diffusion models are primarily designed for offline applications, where space-time models are used to synthesize an entire sequence of frames simultaneously with a pre-specified length. To enable real-time motion synthesis with diffusion model that allows time-varying controls, we propose A-MDM (Auto-regressive Motion Diffusion Model). Our conditional diffusion model takes an initial pose as input, and auto-regressively generates successive motion frames conditioned on the previous frame. Despite its streamlined network architecture, which uses simple MLPs, our framework is capable of generating diverse, long-horizon, and high-fidelity motion sequences. Furthermore, we introduce a suite of techniques for incorporating interactive controls into A-MDM, such as task-oriented sampling, in-painting, and hierarchical reinforcement learning (See Figure 1). These techniques enable a pre-trained A-MDM to be efficiently adapted for a variety of new downstream tasks. We conduct a comprehensive suite of experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of A-MDM, and compare its performance against state-of-the-art auto-regressive methods.
authors: Yi Shi 0008, Jingbo Wang 0003, Xuekun Jiang, Bingkun Lin, Bo Dai 0002, Xue Bin Peng

title: 机器人角色的风格化行走步态交互式设计
title_en: Interactive Design of Stylized Walking Gaits for Robotic Characters.
abstract: 程序化动画在虚拟角色的表达性行走步态设计中得到了广泛应用。尽管类似工具可以为机器人角色赋予生命,但现有技术大多未考虑物理机器人所受的运动学和动力学约束。本文提出了一种面向艺术家的风格化双足行走步态创作系统,专为在机器人角色上执行而设计。艺术家通过交互式编辑工具实时生成所需角色运动,该工具基于模型控制堆栈在物理或模拟机器人上运行。每种行走风格均编码为一组样本参数,通过提出的程序化动画技术转换为全身参考轨迹。为在连续输入速度范围内泛化风格化步态,我们采用相空间混合策略,插值动画师创作的示例行走周期集合,同时保持接触约束。为验证方法的有效性,我们为定制的自由行走机器人角色制作了步态动画,并通过两个额外的模拟示例展示了程序化动画技术如何泛化到具有不同自由度、比例和质量分布的双足机器人。
abstract_en: Procedural animation has seen widespread use in the design of expressive walking gaits for virtual characters. While similar tools could breathe life into robotic characters, existing techniques are largely unaware of the kinematic and dynamic constraints imposed by physical robots. In this paper, we propose a system for the artist-directed authoring of stylized bipedal walking gaits, tailored for execution on robotic characters. The artist interfaces with an interactive editing tool that generates the desired character motion in realtime, either on the physical or simulated robot, using a model-based control stack. Each walking style is encoded as a set of sample parameters which are translated into whole-body reference trajectories using the proposed procedural animation technique. In order to generalize the stylized gait over a continuous range of input velocities, we employ a phase-space blending strategy that interpolates a set of example walk cycles authored by the animator while preserving contact constraints. To demonstrate the utility of our approach, we animate gaits for a custom, free-walking robotic character, and show, with two additional in-simulation examples, how our procedural animation technique generalizes to bipeds with different degrees of freedom, proportions, and mass distributions.
authors: Michael A. Hopkins, Georg Wiedebach, Kyle Cesare, Jared Bishop, Espen Knoop, Moritz Bächer

title: 交互式增强:基于丝状结构的树木体积建模
title_en: Interactive Invigoration: Volumetric Modeling of Trees with Strands.
abstract: 生成真实树木和植物模型是一个复杂问题,因为树木可以形成极其多样的形状。程序化建模算法因其在定义分支结构方面的应用而广受欢迎,并通过考虑更多生物发现持续提升其表达能力。现有大多数方法聚焦于基于骨骼图定义树木的分支结构,而枝干的表面网格最常被简单地定义为圆柱体。一个关键性开放问题是如何定义和控制真实树木中观察到的复杂细节。本文旨在通过提出一种基于丝状结构的体积表示方法来推进树木建模。丝状结构是固定尺寸的体积管道,用于定义分支结构。通过利用丝状结构,我们的方法能够捕捉树木的横向发展。我们结合丝状结构与一种新颖的分支发展公式,使我们能够局部注入活力并重塑树木模型。此外,我们定义了一组针对树木主干和侧枝发育的编辑操作,使用户能够以极低的交互成本生成具有前所未有的细节复杂度的树木模型。
abstract_en: Generating realistic models of trees and plants is a complex problem because of the vast variety of shapes trees can form. Procedural modeling algorithms are popular for defining branching structures and steadily increasing their expressive power by considering more biological findings. Most existing methods focus on defining the branching structure of trees based on skeletal graphs, while the surface mesh of branches is most commonly defined as simple cylinders. One critical open problem is defining and controlling the complex details observed in real trees. This paper aims to advance tree modeling by proposing a strand-based volumetric representation for tree models. Strands are fixed-size volumetric pipes that define the branching structure. By leveraging strands, our approach captures the lateral development of trees. We combine the strands with a novel branch development formulation that allows us to locally inject vigor and reshape the tree model. Moreover, we define a set of editing operators for tree primary and lateral development that enables users to interactively generate complex tree models with unprecedented detail with minimal effort.
authors: Bosheng Li, Nikolas Alexander Schwarz, Wojtek Palubicki, Sören Pirk, Bedrich Benes

title: 湍流多流体流动的动力学模拟
title_en: Kinetic Simulation of Turbulent Multifluid Flows.
abstract: 尽管具有视觉吸引力,分离多相流(即通过界面分隔的流体流)的模拟在准确再现复杂行为(如喷溅、润湿或气泡)方面仍面临诸多挑战。这些困难在高雷诺数和流体间大密度变化的情况下尤为显著,这可能解释了为什么在计算机图形学领域,与单相或两相流相比,此类问题的关注度相对较低。本文提出了一种完整的LBM求解器用于多流体模拟。我们推导出一种保守相场模型,通过编码每种流体或相的空间存在,以实现可混溶、不可混溶甚至部分可混溶流体的模拟,同时利用D3Q7格子-玻尔兹曼离散化进行相的时演化。通过近期高阶矩编码LBM(HOME-LBM)框架处理速度场以最小化内存占用,速度场通过基于速度的分布存储在D3Q27或D3Q19离散化中,以在湍流场景中提供高密度比下的准确性和稳定性。通过压力、粘度和界面力与相的耦合,利用界面的扩散编码实现。所得到的求解器解决了计算流体力学和计算机图形学中动力学方法的多个局限性:它提供了一种快速、准确且低内存的流体求解器,能够高效进行湍流多相流模拟,避免了边界附近典型的振荡压力行为。我们展示了多个数值基准测试、示例和多相流的比较,以证明求解器的视觉复杂性、准确性和真实感。
abstract_en: Despite its visual appeal, the simulation of separated multiphase flows (i.e., streams of fluids separated by interfaces) faces numerous challenges in accurately reproducing complex behaviors such as guggling, wetting, or bubbling. These difficulties are especially pronounced for high Reynolds numbers and large density variations between fluids, most likely explaining why they have received comparatively little attention in Computer Graphics compared to single- or two-phase flows. In this paper, we present a full LBM solver for multifluid simulation. We derive a conservative phase field model with which the spatial presence of each fluid or phase is encoded to allow for the simulation of miscible, immiscible and even partially-miscible fluids, while the temporal evolution of the phases is performed using a D3Q7 lattice-Boltzmann discretization. The velocity field, handled through the recent high-order moment-encoded LBM (HOME-LBM) framework to minimize its memory footprint, is simulated via a velocity-based distribution stored on a D3Q27 or D3Q19 discretization to offer accuracy and stability to large density ratios even in turbulent scenarios, while coupling with the phases through pressure, viscosity, and interfacial forces is achieved by leveraging the diffuse encoding of interfaces. The resulting solver addresses a number of limitations of kinetic methods in both computational fluid dynamics and computer graphics: it offers a fast, accurate, and low-memory fluid solver enabling efficient turbulent multiphase simulations free of the typical oscillatory pressure behavior near boundaries. We present several numerical benchmarks, examples and comparisons of multiphase flows to demonstrate our solver's visual complexity, accuracy, and realism.
authors: Wei Li 0112, Kui Wu 0003, Mathieu Desbrun

title: 使用对抗训练跨尺度学习图像
title_en: Learning Images Across Scales Using Adversarial Training.
abstract: 现实世界在多尺度观测中展现出丰富的结构和细节。然而,使用普通图像难以捕捉和表示广泛的尺度范围。我们提出了一种新颖的范式,用于学习能够捕捉数量级差异尺度范围的表示方法,该方法基于无结构普通图像集合。我们将该集合视为需通过对抗训练学习的尺度空间切片分布,并额外强制切片间的连贯性。我们的方法依赖于多尺度生成器,其精心注入的程序化频率内容使用户能够交互式探索新兴的连续尺度空间。在跨巨大尺度范围的训练中,稳定性面临挑战,我们通过精心采样的尺度监督方案加以解决。我们证明该生成器可作为多尺度生成模型,用于从无结构补丁重建尺度空间。在高质量和尺度一致性方面,我们的方法显著优于现有技术,实现了最高256倍的放大倍率。
abstract_en: The real world exhibits rich structure and detail across many scales of observation. It is difficult, however, to capture and represent a broad spectrum of scales using ordinary images. We devise a novel paradigm for learning a representation that captures an orders-of-magnitude variety of scales from an unstructured collection of ordinary images. We treat this collection as a distribution of scale-space slices to be learned using adversarial training, and additionally enforce coherency across slices. Our approach relies on a multiscale generator with carefully injected procedural frequency content, which allows to interactively explore the emerging continuous scale space. Training across vastly different scales poses challenges regarding stability, which we tackle using a supervision scheme that involves careful sampling of scales. We show that our generator can be used as a multiscale generative model, and for reconstructions of scale spaces from unstructured patches. Significantly outperforming the state of the art, we demonstrate zoom-in factors of up to 256x at high quality and scale consistency.
authors: Krzysztof Wolski, Adarsh Djeacoumar, Alireza Javanmardi, Hans-Peter Seidel, Christian Theobalt, Guillaume Cordonnier, Karol Myszkowski, George Drettakis, Xingang Pan, Thomas Leimkühler

title: 基于数据的通用物理人脸模型学习
title_en: Learning a Generalized Physical Face Model From Data.
abstract: 基于物理的模拟是3D面部动画的强大方法,因为其产生的形变由物理约束控制,从而可以轻松解决自碰撞、响应外部力并执行逼真的解剖学编辑。当前的方法是数据驱动的,其中有限元的驱动行为是从捕获的皮肤几何形状中推断得出的。然而,由于初始化材料空间和为每个角色单独学习变形模型的复杂性,这些方法尚未被广泛采用,通常需要专业艺术家进行后续的长时间网络训练。在本文中,我们旨在通过提出一个从大型3D人脸数据集中学习得到的通用物理人脸模型,使基于物理的面部动画更加易用。一旦训练完成,我们的模型可以快速拟合到任何未见过的身份,并自动产生可动画化的物理人脸模型。拟合过程简单至提供单个3D人脸扫描,甚至单张人脸图像即可。拟合完成后,我们提供直观的动画控制,以及在角色间重定向动画的能力。同时,生成的动画支持碰撞避免、重力、瘫痪、骨骼重塑等物理效果。
abstract_en: Physically-based simulation is a powerful approach for 3D facial animation as the resulting deformations are governed by physical constraints, allowing to easily resolve self-collisions, respond to external forces and perform realistic anatomy edits. Today's methods are data-driven, where the actuations for finite elements are inferred from captured skin geometry. Unfortunately, these approaches have not been widely adopted due to the complexity of initializing the material space and learning the deformation model for each character separately, which often requires a skilled artist followed by lengthy network training. In this work, we aim to make physics-based facial animation more accessible by proposing a generalized physical face model that we learn from a large 3D face dataset. Once trained, our model can be quickly fit to any unseen identity and produce a ready-to-animate physical face model automatically. Fitting is as easy as providing a single 3D face scan, or even a single face image. After fitting, we offer intuitive animation controls, as well as the ability to retarget animations across characters. All the while, the resulting animations allow for physical effects like collision avoidance, gravity, paralysis, bone reshaping and more.
authors: Lingchen Yang, Gaspard Zoss, Prashanth Chandran, Markus Gross 0001, Barbara Solenthaler, Eftychios Sifakis, Derek Bradley

title: 方向场到极小截面的提升
title_en: Lifting Directional Fields to Minimal Sections.
abstract: 方向场,包括单位向量场、线场和交叉场,是几何处理工具箱中的重要工具。方向场的拓扑结构由其奇点决定。尽管奇点在下游应用(如网格生成)中起着重要作用,但现有方向场计算方法要么需要预先指定奇点,要么完全忽略奇点,要么将奇点视为松弛场的零点。尽管场在奇点处未定义,但具有奇点的方向场图像是圆丛中的良好定义曲面。通过将场的优化提升到其图像上的优化,我们可以利用自然的凸松弛,将问题转化为丛中电流空间上的极小截面问题。这种松弛将奇点视为首要元素,将场与奇点之间的关系明确表达为边界条件。由于曲率阻碍了丛的有限元离散化,我们设计了一种混合谱方法来表示和优化极小截面。我们的方法支持在平面和曲面域上进行场优化,并能更精确地控制奇点位置。
abstract_en: Directional fields, including unit vector, line, and cross fields, are essential tools in the geometry processing toolkit. The topology of directional fields is characterized by their singularities. While singularities play an important role in downstream applications such as meshing, existing methods for computing directional fields either require them to be specified in advance, ignore them altogether, or treat them as zeros of a relaxed field. While fields are ill-defined at their singularities, the graphs of directional fields with singularities are well-defined surfaces in a circle bundle. By lifting optimization of fields to optimization over their graphs, we can exploit a natural convex relaxation to a minimal section problem over the space of currents in the bundle. This relaxation treats singularities as first-class citizens, expressing the relationship between fields and singularities as an explicit boundary condition. As curvature frustrates finite element discretization of the bundle, we devise a hybrid spectral method for representing and optimizing minimal sections. Our method supports field optimization on both flat and curved domains and enables more precise control over singularity placement.
authors: David R. Palmer 0001, Albert Chern, Justin Solomon 0001

title: LightFormer:面向光源的动态场景全局神经渲染
title_en: LightFormer: Light-Oriented Global Neural Rendering in Dynamic Scene.
abstract: 实时生成全局光照一直是图形学领域长期存在的挑战,特别是在具有复杂光照的动态场景中。近期的神经渲染技术通过利用神经网络表示场景的光照并解码最终辐射度,展现出巨大潜力。然而,将物体参数纳入表示可能限制其在完全动态场景中的有效性。本文提出了一种神经渲染方法,称为LightFormer,可在实时性能下生成完全动态场景的逼真全局光照,包括动态光照、材质、摄像机和动画物体。受经典多光源方法启发,该方法聚焦于场景中光源的神经表示而非整个场景,从而实现整体更好的泛化能力。通过利用每个光源的虚拟点光源和着色线索实现神经预测。具体而言,探索了两个阶段。在光源编码阶段,每个光源在场景中生成一组虚拟点光源,随后编码为隐式神经光源表示,同时结合屏幕空间着色线索(如可见性)。在光源汇聚阶段,像素-光源注意力机制将所有光源表示组合到每个着色点。结合几何和材质表示,以及所有光源的组合表示,轻量级神经网络预测最终辐射度。实验结果表明,所提出的LightFormer可在完全动态场景中实现合理且逼真的全局光照,并具备实时性能。
abstract_en: The generation of global illumination in real time has been a long-standing challenge in the graphics community, particularly in dynamic scenes with complex illumination. Recent neural rendering techniques have shown great promise by utilizing neural networks to represent the illumination of scenes and then decoding the final radiance. However, incorporating object parameters into the representation may limit their effectiveness in handling fully dynamic scenes. This work presents a neural rendering approach, dubbed LightFormer, that can generate realistic global illumination for fully dynamic scenes, including dynamic lighting, materials, cameras, and animated objects, in real time. Inspired by classic many-lights methods, the proposed approach focuses on the neural representation of light sources in the scene rather than the entire scene, leading to the overall better generalizability. The neural prediction is achieved by leveraging the virtual point lights and shading clues for each light. Specifically, two stages are explored. In the light encoding stage, each light generates a set of virtual point lights in the scene, which are then encoded into an implicit neural light representation, along with screen-space shading clues like visibility. In the light gathering stage, a pixel-light attention mechanism composites all light representations for each shading point. Given the geometry and material representation, in tandem with the composed light representations of all lights, a lightweight neural network predicts the final radiance. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed LightFormer can yield reasonable and realistic global illumination in fully dynamic scenes with real-time performance.
authors: Haocheng Ren, Yuchi Huo, Yifan Peng 0001, Hongtao Sheng, Weidong Xue, Hongxiang Huang, Jingzhen Lan, Rui Wang 0004, Hujun Bao

title: 极快的基本解方法
title_en: Lightning-fast Method of Fundamental Solutions.
abstract: 基本解方法(MFS)及其相关边界元方法(BEM)由于其提供的维度降低特性,在计算机图形学中受到欢迎:对于三维线性问题,它们仅需域边界上的变量即可求解并评估整个空间中的解,使其成为广泛应用中的宝贵工具。然而,MFS和BEM在大规模问题中存在较差的计算可扩展性和巨大的内存需求,限制了其在实际中的适用性和效率。通过利用与高斯过程的联系并利用边界积分矩阵逆的稀疏结构,我们引入了一种变分预条件子,该预条件子可通过稀疏逆Cholesky分解在大规模并行方式下计算。我们展示将该预条件子应用于预置共轭梯度算法可显著提升MFS或BEM求解的效率,在我们的测试系列中可达四个数量级。
abstract_en: The method of fundamental solutions (MFS) and its associated boundary element method (BEM) have gained popularity in computer graphics due to the reduced dimensionality they offer: for three-dimensional linear problems, they only require variables on the domain boundary to solve and evaluate the solution throughout space, making them a valuable tool in a wide variety of applications. However, MFS and BEM have poor computational scalability and huge memory requirements for large-scale problems, limiting their applicability and efficiency in practice. By leveraging connections with Gaussian Processes and exploiting the sparse structure of the inverses of boundary integral matrices, we introduce a variational preconditioner that can be computed via a sparse inverse-Cholesky factorization in a massively parallel manner. We show that applying our preconditioner to the Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient algorithm greatly improves the efficiency of MFS or BEM solves, up to four orders of magnitude in our series of tests.
authors: Jiong Chen 0001, Florian Schäfer 0001, Mathieu Desbrun

title: 网格神经细胞自动机
title_en: Mesh Neural Cellular Automata.
abstract: 纹理建模与合成对于提升虚拟环境的真实性至关重要。直接在三维空间中合成纹理的方法相较于基于UV映射的方法具有独特优势,因为它们能够生成无缝纹理,并更贴近自然界中纹理的形成方式。我们提出了一种名为Mesh Neural Cellular Automata(MeshNCA)的方法,该方法无需任何UV映射即可直接在三维网格上合成动态纹理。MeshNCA是一种通用的细胞自动机类型,能够在非网格结构(如三维网格的顶点)上对一组排列的单元进行操作。MeshNCA支持多模态监督,可以通过图像、文本提示和运动矢量场等多种目标进行训练。仅在Icosphere网格上训练的MeshNCA展现出显著的测试时泛化能力,能够在未见过的网格上实时合成纹理。我们通过定性和定量比较证明,MeshNCA在泛化能力和生成高质量纹理方面优于其他三维纹理合成方法。此外,我们引入了一种对训练好的MeshNCA实例进行嫁接的方法,从而实现纹理插值。MeshNCA支持多种用户交互,包括纹理密度/方向控制、嫁接/重生成画笔以及运动速度/方向控制。最后,我们使用WebGL着色语言实现了MeshNCA模型的前向传播,并在在线交互演示中展示了训练好的模型,该演示可在个人电脑和智能手机上访问,网址为https://meshnca.github.io/。
abstract_en: Texture modeling and synthesis are essential for enhancing the realism of virtual environments. Methods that directly synthesize textures in 3D offer distinct advantages to the UV-mapping-based methods as they can create seamless textures and align more closely with the ways textures form in nature. We propose Mesh Neural Cellular Automata (MeshNCA), a method that directly synthesizes dynamic textures on 3D meshes without requiring any UV maps. MeshNCA is a generalized type of cellular automata that can operate on a set of cells arranged on non-grid structures such as the vertices of a 3D mesh. MeshNCA accommodates multi-modal supervision and can be trained using different targets such as images, text prompts, and motion vector fields. Only trained on an Icosphere mesh, MeshNCA shows remarkable test-time generalization and can synthesize textures on unseen meshes in real time. We conduct qualitative and quantitative comparisons to demonstrate that MeshNCA outperforms other 3D texture synthesis methods in terms of generalization and producing high-quality textures. Moreover, we introduce a way of grafting trained MeshNCA instances, enabling interpolation between textures. MeshNCA allows several user interactions including texture density/orientation controls, grafting/regenerate brushes, and motion speed/direction controls. Finally, we implement the forward pass of our MeshNCA model using the WebGL shading language and showcase our trained models in an online interactive demo, which is accessible on personal computers and smartphones and is available at https://meshnca.github.io/.
authors: Ehsan Pajouheshgar, Yitao Xu 0002, Alexander Mordvintsev, Eyvind Niklasson, Tong Zhang 0023, Sabine Süsstrunk

title: MoConVQ: 基于物理的运动控制统一框架通过可扩展离散表示
title_en: MoConVQ: Unified Physics-Based Motion Control via Scalable Discrete Representations.
abstract: 本文提出MoConVQ,一种基于物理的运动控制新统一框架,利用可扩展离散表示。基于向量量化变分自编码器(VQ-VAE)和基于模型的强化学习,我们的方法有效从包含数十小时运动示例的大规模无结构数据集中学习运动嵌入。所得运动表示不仅捕捉多样化的运动技能,还为各种应用提供稳健且直观的接口。我们通过多个应用展示MoConVQ的通用性:从多种运动源实现通用跟踪控制,使用监督学习通过潜在运动表示实现交互式角色控制,基于GPT框架从自然语言描述生成基于物理的运动,以及最有趣的是,通过上下文学习与大型语言模型(LLMs)无缝集成以解决复杂和抽象任务。
abstract_en: In this work, we present MoConVQ, a novel unified framework for physics-based motion control leveraging scalable discrete representations. Building upon vector quantized variational autoencoders (VQ-VAE) and model-based reinforcement learning, our approach effectively learns motion embeddings from a large, unstructured dataset spanning tens of hours of motion examples. The resultant motion representation not only captures diverse motion skills but also offers a robust and intuitive interface for various applications. We demonstrate the versatility of MoConVQ through several applications: universal tracking control from various motion sources, interactive character control with latent motion representations using supervised learning, physics-based motion generation from natural language descriptions using the GPT framework, and, most interestingly, seamless integration with large language models (LLMs) with in-context learning to tackle complex and abstract tasks.
authors: Heyuan Yao, Zhenhua Song, Yuyang Zhou, Tenglong Ao, Baoquan Chen, Libin Liu 0002

title: 基于多材料网格的隐式拓扑变化表面追踪方法
title_en: Multi-Material Mesh-Based Surface Tracking with Implicit Topology Changes.
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于多材料非流形网格的表面追踪算法,该算法将自相交转换为拓扑变化。我们的算法扩展了之前关于流形表面追踪与拓扑变化的工作:它保留了类似网格方法的表面特征,并且像水平集方法一样稳健地处理拓扑变化。我们的方法在效率和鲁棒性方面也优于现有技术。我们在一系列示例中验证了该方法的有效性,包括包含数千个相互作用气泡的复杂肥皂膜模拟,以及由数百万三角形组成的非流形网格的布尔并集操作。
abstract_en: We introduce a multi-material non-manifold mesh-based surface tracking algorithm that converts self-intersections into topological changes. Our algorithm generalizes prior work on manifold surface tracking with topological changes: it preserves surface features like mesh-based methods, and it robustly handles topological changes like level set methods. Our method also offers improved efficiency and robustness over the state of the art. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach on a range of examples, including complex soap film simulations with thousands of interacting bubbles, and boolean unions of non-manifold meshes consisting of millions of triangles.
authors: Peter Heiss-Synak, Aleksei Kalinov, Malina Strugaru, Arian Etemadi, Huidong Yang, Chris Wojtan

title: NICER:一种新的改进型消耗耐力与恢复指标,用于量化空中交互中的肌肉疲劳
title_en: NICER: A New and Improved Consumed Endurance and Recovery Metric to Quantify Muscle Fatigue of Mid-Air Interactions.
abstract: 自然手势对于空中交互至关重要,但预测和管理肌肉疲劳具有挑战性。现有基于扭矩的模型在建模肩部以上交互及考虑疲劳恢复方面存在局限性。我们引入了一种新的混合模型NICER,该模型结合了基于扭矩的方法、从肌肉收缩经验测量中衍生的新项以及恢复因子,以反映休息期间疲劳的降低。我们在一项空中选择任务中评估了NICER,使用两种不同感知疲劳程度的交互方法。结果表明,NICER能够准确建模肩部以上交互,并在休息期间反映疲劳恢复。此外,两种交互方法与主观疲劳测量的相关性(ρ = 0.978/0.976)均强于先前模型累积疲劳(ρ = 0.966/0.923),证实了NICER作为预测多种基于手势交互应用中疲劳的强大分析工具的有效性。
abstract_en: Natural gestures are crucial for mid-air interaction, but predicting and managing muscle fatigue is challenging. Existing torque-based models are limited in their ability to model above-shoulder interactions and to account for fatigue recovery. We introduce a new hybrid model, NICER, which combines a torque-based approach with a new term derived from the empirical measurement of muscle contraction and a recovery factor to account for decreasing fatigue during rest. We evaluated NICER in a mid-air selection task using two interaction methods with different degrees of perceived fatigue. Results show that NICER can accurately model above-shoulder interactions as well as reflect fatigue recovery during rest periods. Moreover, both interaction methods show a stronger correlation with subjective fatigue measurement (ρ = 0.978/0.976) than a previous model, Cumulative Fatigue (ρ = 0.966/0.923), confirming that NICER is a powerful analytical tool to predict fatigue across a variety of gesture-based interactive applications.
authors: Yi Li 0058, Benjamin Tag, Shaozhang Dai, Robert George Crowther, Tim Dwyer, Pourang Irani, Barrett Ens

title: NeurCADRecon: 基于强制零高斯曲率的神经表示重建CAD曲面
title_en: NeurCADRecon: Neural Representation for Reconstructing CAD Surfaces by Enforcing Zero Gaussian Curvature.
abstract: 尽管在使用神经符号距离函数(SDF)重建有机模型方面取得了近期进展,但直接从低质量无方向点云中高保真重建CAD模型仍是一个重大挑战。本文基于先前观察到的CAD模型表面通常由分段曲面片组成,每个曲面片即使在特征线附近也近似可展这一特性,来解决该挑战。我们提出的方法NeurCADRecon是自监督的,其损失函数包含一个可展性项,以鼓励高斯曲率趋近于零同时保持对输入点的保真度(参见预告图)。注意到高斯曲率在尖点处非零,我们引入双凹曲线来容忍这些尖点的存在。此外,我们开发了一种动态采样策略以应对给定点不完整或过于稀疏的情况。由于我们的神经SDF能够清晰表现尖锐特征点/线,因此可以从SDF中轻松提取特征对齐的三角网格,再将其分解为光滑曲面片,大大降低了恢复参数化CAD设计的难度。与现有最先进的方法的全面比较表明,我们的方法在重建忠实CAD形状方面具有显著优势。
abstract_en: Despite recent advances in reconstructing an organic model with the neural signed distance function (SDF), the high-fidelity reconstruction of a CAD model directly from low-quality unoriented point clouds remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we address this challenge based on the prior observation that the surface of a CAD model is generally composed of piecewise surface patches, each approximately developable even around the feature line. Our approach, named NeurCADRecon, is self-supervised, and its loss includes a developability term to encourage the Gaussian curvature toward 0 while ensuring fidelity to the input points (see the teaser figure). Noticing that the Gaussian curvature is non-zero at tip points, we introduce a double-trough curve to tolerate the existence of these tip points. Furthermore, we develop a dynamic sampling strategy to deal with situations where the given points are incomplete or too sparse. Since our resulting neural SDFs can clearly manifest sharp feature points/lines, one can easily extract the feature-aligned triangle mesh from the SDF and then decompose it into smooth surface patches, greatly reducing the difficulty of recovering the parametric CAD design. A comprehensive comparison with existing state-of-the-art methods shows the significant advantage of our approach in reconstructing faithful CAD shapes.
authors: Qiujie Dong, Rui Xu 0016, Pengfei Wang, Shuang-Min Chen, Shiqing Xin, Xiaohong Jia 0001, Wenping Wang 0001, Changhe Tu

title: 神经高斯尺度空间场
title_en: Neural Gaussian Scale-Space Fields.
abstract: 高斯尺度空间是信号表示与处理的核心方法,广泛应用于滤波、多尺度分析、抗混叠等领域。然而,对于连续表示(如神经场)而言,构建此类尺度空间成本高昂且繁琐。本文提出一种高效轻量的方法,用于学习任意信号的全连续各向异性高斯尺度空间。基于傅里叶特征调制与利普希茨界限,我们的方法采用自监督训练,即训练过程无需任何手动滤波。神经高斯尺度空间场能够忠实捕捉多种模态下的多尺度表示,并支持广泛的应用场景,包括图像、几何数据、光舞台数据、纹理抗混叠以及多尺度优化。
abstract_en: Gaussian scale spaces are a cornerstone of signal representation and processing, with applications in filtering, multiscale analysis, anti-aliasing, and many more. However, obtaining such a scale space is costly and cumbersome, in particular for continuous representations such as neural fields. We present an efficient and lightweight method to learn the fully continuous, anisotropic Gaussian scale space of an arbitrary signal. Based on Fourier feature modulation and Lipschitz bounding, our approach is trained self-supervised, i.e., training does not require any manual filtering. Our neural Gaussian scale-space fields faithfully capture multiscale representations across a broad range of modalities, and support a diverse set of applications. These include images, geometry, light-stage data, texture anti-aliasing, and multiscale optimization.
authors: Felix Mujkanovic, Ntumba Elie Nsampi, Christian Theobalt, Hans-Peter Seidel, Thomas Leimkühler

title: 多轴3D打印的神经切片器
title_en: Neural Slicer for Multi-Axis 3D Printing.
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于神经网络的计算管道,作为表示无关的多轴3D打印切片器。该先进切片器能够处理具有多样化表示和复杂拓扑结构的模型。该方法通过利用神经网络建立变形映射,在输入模型周围的空域中定义标量场。随后从该场中提取等值面,以生成用于3D打印的曲面层。构建可微分的管道使我们能够通过直接在场梯度上定义的损失函数优化映射,作为局部打印方向。引入了新的损失函数以满足无需支撑结构和强度增强的制造目标。我们的新计算管道对场的初始值依赖较少,能够生成性能显著提升的切片结果。
abstract_en: We introduce a novel neural network-based computational pipeline as a representation-agnostic slicer for multi-axis 3D printing. This advanced slicer can work on models with diverse representations and intricate topology. The approach involves employing neural networks to establish a deformation mapping, defining a scalar field in the space surrounding an input model. Isosurfaces are subsequently extracted from this field to generate curved layers for 3D printing. Creating a differentiable pipeline enables us to optimize the mapping through loss functions directly defined on the field gradients as the local printing directions. New loss functions have been introduced to meet the manufacturing objectives of support-free and strength reinforcement. Our new computation pipeline relies less on the initial values of the field and can generate slicing results with significantly improved performance.
authors: Tao Liu 0059, Tianyu Zhang 0007, Yongxue Chen, Yuming Huang 0003, Charlie C. L. Wang

title: NeuralTO:透明物体的神经重建与视图合成
title_en: NeuralTO: Neural Reconstruction and View Synthesis of Translucent Objects.
abstract: 利用神经隐式符号距离函数从多视角图像中学习,已在不透明物体的三维重建中展现出 impressive performance。然而,现有方法在应用于透明物体时,由于其渲染函数中不可忽略的偏差,难以重建准确的几何结构。为解决现有模型的不准确性,我们通过引入估计的常数消光系数,对神经辐射场的密度函数进行了重新参数化。这一改进构成了我们创新框架的基础,该框架旨在实现高保真表面重建及透明物体的新型视图合成。我们的框架包含两个阶段。在重建阶段,我们引入了一种新颖的权重函数以实现精确的表面几何重建。在几何结构恢复后,第二阶段涉及学习参与介质的特殊散射特性以增强渲染效果。我们构建了一个包含合成与真实透明物体的综合数据集,用于进行广泛实验。实验结果表明,我们的方法在重建与新型视图合成方面均优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Learning from multi-view images using neural implicit signed distance functions shows impressive performance on 3D Reconstruction of opaque objects. However, existing methods struggle to reconstruct accurate geometry when applied to translucent objects due to the non-negligible bias in their rendering function. To address the inaccuracies in the existing model, we have reparameterized the density function of the neural radiance field by incorporating an estimated constant extinction coefficient. This modification forms the basis of our innovative framework, which is geared towards highfidelity surface reconstruction and the novel-view synthesis of translucent objects. Our framework contains two stages. In the reconstruction stage, we introduce a novel weight function to achieve accurate surface geometry reconstruction. Following the recovery of geometry, the second phase involves learning the distinct scattering properties of the participating media to enhance rendering. A comprehensive dataset, comprising both synthetic and real translucent objects, has been built for conducting extensive experiments. Experiments reveal that our method outperforms existing approaches in terms of reconstruction and novel-view synthesis.
authors: Yuxiang Cai, Jiaxiong Qiu, Zhong Li, Bo Ren 0003

title: 一统程序性噪声:学习空间变化噪声模式的统一模型
title_en: One Noise to Rule Them All: Learning a Unified Model of Spatially-Varying Noise Patterns.
abstract: 程序性噪声是计算机图形学管线的基本组成部分,提供了一种灵活生成具有"自然"随机变化纹理的方法。存在多种不同类型的噪声,每种均由独立算法生成。本文提出了一种单一生成模型,能够学习生成多种类型的噪声并在其之间进行混合。此外,该模型即使在没有空间变化噪声数据的情况下,也能生成空间变化的噪声混合效果。这些特性通过结合新颖的数据增强和网络条件化技术训练去噪扩散模型实现。与程序性噪声生成器类似,该模型的行为可通过可解释参数和随机源进行控制。我们使用该模型生成了多种视觉吸引人的噪声纹理。同时,我们展示了该模型在改进逆程序材料设计中的应用;在程序材料图中用该模型替代固定类型噪声节点,可在无需预先知道噪声类型的情况下实现更高保真度的材料重建。开源材料可访问 https://armanmaesumi.github.io/onenoise/
abstract_en: Procedural noise is a fundamental component of computer graphics pipelines, offering a flexible way to generate textures that exhibit "natural" random variation. Many different types of noise exist, each produced by a separate algorithm. In this paper, we present a single generative model which can learn to generate multiple types of noise as well as blend between them. In addition, it is capable of producing spatially-varying noise blends despite not having access to such data for training. These features are enabled by training a denoising diffusion model using a novel combination of data augmentation and network conditioning techniques. Like procedural noise generators, the model's behavior is controllable via interpretable parameters plus a source of randomness.
