We use our model to produce a variety of visually compelling noise textures. We also present an application of our model to improving inverse procedural material design; using our model in place of fixed-type noise nodes in a procedural material graph results in higher-fidelity material reconstructions without needing to know the type of noise in advance. Open-sourced materials can be found at https://armanmaesumi.github.io/onenoise/
authors: Arman Maesumi, Dylan Hu, Krishi Saripalli, Vladimir G. Kim, Matthew Fisher, Sören Pirk, Daniel Ritchie

title: PEA-PODs:扩展现实显示电源优化算法的感知评估
title_en: PEA-PODs: Perceptual Evaluation of Algorithms for Power Optimization in XR Displays.
abstract: 显示功耗是无缆设备日益关注的问题。对于目标为高刷新率和高分辨率同时符合人体工学轻量化形态的增强现实与虚拟扩展现实(XR)显示而言,这一问题更为突出。已有多种图像映射技术被提出以延长电池使用时间。然而目前尚缺乏对这些方法所提供的节电效果与其对视觉质量影响的综合量化理解。我们旨在回答这一问题。为此,我们提出了扩展现实显示电源优化算法的感知评估(PEA)方法。整合六种电源节约显示映射方案,我们首先通过大规模感知研究理解每种方法在实际场景中对感知质量的影响。这为每种技术生成了统一的质量评分,以刚察觉差异(JOD)单位进行量化。同时,每种技术均通过硬件精确的功耗模型进行分析。由此得到的JOD到毫瓦转换函数首次揭示了显示映射技术的权衡关系,可直接用于扩展现实显示的功耗预算架构决策。最后,我们利用研究数据和功耗模型解决显示功耗应用中的重要问题,如显示主色选择、眼动追踪的功耗影响等。
abstract_en: Display power consumption is an emerging concern for untethered devices. This goes double for augmented and virtual extended reality (XR) displays, which target high refresh rates and high resolutions while conforming to an ergonomically light form factor. A number of image mapping techniques have been proposed to extend battery usage. However, there is currently no comprehensive quantitative understanding of how the power savings provided by these methods compare to their impact on visual quality. We set out to answer this question. To this end, we present a perceptual evaluation of algorithms (PEA) for power optimization in XR displays (PODs). Consolidating a portfolio of six power-saving display mapping approaches, we begin by performing a large-scale perceptual study to understand the impact of each method on perceived quality in the wild. This results in a unified quality score for each technique, scaled in just-objectionable-difference (JOD) units. In parallel, each technique is analyzed using hardware-accurate power models. The resulting JOD-to-Milliwatt transfer function provides a first-of-its-kind look into tradeoffs offered by display mapping techniques, and can be directly employed to make architectural decisions for power budgets on XR displays. Finally, we leverage our study data and power models to address important display power applications like the choice of display primary, power implications of eye tracking, and more1.
authors: Kenneth Chen, Thomas Wan, Nathan Matsuda, Ajit Ninan, Alexandre Chapiro, Qi Sun 0003

title: Portrait3D: 基于金字塔表示与GAN先验的文本引导高质量三维肖像生成
title_en: Portrait3D: Text-Guided High-Quality 3D Portrait Generation Using Pyramid Representation and GANs Prior.
abstract: 现有基于神经渲染的文本到三维肖像生成方法通常利用人体几何先验和扩散模型进行引导。然而,仅依赖几何信息会导致诸如Janus问题、过饱和和过平滑等缺陷。我们提出Portrait3D,一种新型神经渲染框架,通过创新的几何-外观联合先验实现文本到三维肖像生成,有效克服上述问题。为此,我们训练了一个3D肖像生成器3DPortraitGAN作为鲁棒先验。该生成器能够生成360°标准三维肖像,作为后续基于扩散的生成过程的起点。为缓解大多数三维感知GAN常用基于特征图的三维表示中高频信息导致的"网格状"伪影,我们将新颖的金字塔三网格三维表示集成到3DPortraitGAN中。为从文本生成三维肖像,我们首先将与给定提示对齐的随机生成图像投影到预训练的3DPortraitGAN潜在空间。得到的潜在编码随后用于合成金字塔三网格。以获得的金字塔三网格为起点,我们采用分数蒸馏采样将扩散模型的知识蒸馏到金字塔三网格中。随后利用扩散模型优化三维肖像的渲染图像,并将优化后的图像作为训练数据进一步优化金字塔三网格,有效消除不真实色彩和非自然伪影。实验结果表明,Portrait3D能够生成符合提示的逼真、高质量且标准的三维肖像。
abstract_en: Existing neural rendering-based text-to-3D-portrait generation methods typically make use of human geometry prior and diffusion models to obtain guidance. However, relying solely on geometry information introduces issues such as the Janus problem, over-saturation, and over-smoothing. We present Portrait3D, a novel neural rendering-based framework with a novel joint geometry-appearance prior to achieve text-to-3D-portrait generation that overcomes the aforementioned issues. To accomplish this, we train a 3D portrait generator, 3DPortraitGAN, as a robust prior. This generator is capable of producing 360° canonical 3D portraits, serving as a starting point for the subsequent diffusion-based generation process. To mitigate the "grid-like" artifact caused by the high-frequency information in the feature-map-based 3D representation commonly used by most 3D-aware GANs, we integrate a novel pyramid tri-grid 3D representation into 3DPortraitGAN. To generate 3D portraits from text, we first project a randomly generated image aligned with the given prompt into the pre-trained 3DPortraitGAN's latent space. The resulting latent code is then used to synthesize a pyramid tri-grid. Beginning with the obtained pyramid tri-grid, we use score distillation sampling to distill the diffusion model's knowledge into the pyramid tri-grid. Following that, we utilize the diffusion model to refine the rendered images of the 3D portrait and then use these refined images as training data to further optimize the pyramid tri-grid, effectively eliminating issues with unrealistic color and unnatural artifacts. Our experimental results show that Portrait3D can produce realistic, high-quality, and canonical 3D portraits that align with the prompt.
authors: Yiqian Wu, Hao Xu 0049, Xiangjun Tang, Xien Chen, Siyu Tang 0001, Zhebin Zhang, Chen Li 0062, Xiaogang Jin 0001

title: 基于位置的非线性高斯-赛德尔方法在准静态超弹性中的应用
title_en: Position-Based Nonlinear Gauss-Seidel for Quasistatic Hyperelasticity.
abstract: 基于位置的动力学[__TITLE_MATH_1__]是一种强大的技术,可用于模拟多种材料。其主要优势在于在计算预算有限的情况下运行时的鲁棒性。尽管基于位置的动力学(PBD)基于静态约束的投影,但它在准静态问题中表现不佳。这尤其相关,因为随着准静态神经网络[__ABS_MATH_1__]的出现,高效生成大量合理但不一定精确的弹性平衡数据集变得越来越重要[__ABS_MATH_2__]。近期研究[__TITLE_MATH_2__]表明,PBD可以与后向欧拉时间步长的拉格朗日乘数形式的高斯-赛德尔近似相关联,其中每个约束以迭代方式独立求解/投影。我们展示了一种基于位置而非约束的非线性高斯-赛德尔方法,能够解决PBD在准静态设置中的多个问题。我们的方法保留了PBD在受限计算预算下稳定行为的核心特性,但也允许在扩展预算下实现收敛行为。我们在多种代表性超弹性问题上验证了该方法的有效性,并表明连续过松弛(SOR)、Chebyshev和基于多分辨率的加速方法可以轻松应用。
abstract_en: Position based dynamics [Müller et al. 2007] is a powerful technique for simulating a variety of materials. Its primary strength is its robustness when run with limited computational budget. Even though PBD is based on the projection of static constraints, it does not work well for quasistatic problems. This is particularly relevant since the efficient creation of large data sets of plausible, but not necessarily accurate elastic equilibria is of increasing importance with the emergence of quasistatic neural networks [Bailey et al. 2018; Chentanez et al. 2020; Jin et al. 2022; Luo et al. 2020]. Recent work [Macklin et al. 2016] has shown that PBD can be related to the Gauss-Seidel approximation of a Lagrange multiplier formulation of backward Euler time stepping, where each constraint is solved/projected independently of the others in an iterative fashion. We show that a position-based, rather than constraint-based nonlinear Gauss-Seidel approach resolves a number of issues with PBD, particularly in the quasistatic setting. Our approach retains the essential PBD feature of stable behavior with constrained computational budgets, but also allows for convergent behavior with expanded budgets. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method on a variety of representative hyperelastic problems and show that both successive over relaxation (SOR), Chebyshev and multiresolution-based acceleration can be easily applied.
authors: Yizhou Chen, Yushan Han, Jingyu Chen 0002, Zhan Zhang 0009, Alex Mcadams, Joseph Teran

title: 渐进动力学:布料与壳体动画
title_en: Progressive Dynamics for Cloth and Shell Animation.
abstract: 我们提出渐进动力学,一种由粗到细、层次细节的物理基础模拟方法,用于复杂摩擦接触薄壳和布料动力学的动画。渐进动力学在各层次间提供紧密匹配的一致性与渐进改进,其在最细分辨率下的质量与真实感可与基于IPC的高保真壳体模拟 [Li et al. 2021] 相媲美。这些特性共同构建了一个高效的动画设计流程,通过预测性粗分辨率预览实现快速设计迭代,最终生成高分辨率动画。相比之下,以往设计此类场景需通过重复在高分辨率网格上进行直接模拟来实现可比的动力学效果,这会导致难以接受的缓慢设计迭代。我们对渐进动力学的特性进行了广泛评估与演示,涵盖多种具有挑战性的压力测试、基准测试和动画设计任务。在此过程中,渐进动力学以与最粗层次直接模拟相当的成本高效计算出一致的预览。其在各层次间的匹配渐进细化则生成丰富、高分辨率的动画,包含高速动力学、冲击以及摩擦接触薄壳和织物动态褶皱、折叠和滑动的复杂细节。
abstract_en: We propose Progressive Dynamics, a coarse-to-fine, level-of-detail simulation method for the physics-based animation of complex frictionally contacting thin shell and cloth dynamics. Progressive Dynamics provides tight-matching consistency and progressive improvement across levels, with comparable quality and realism to high-fidelity, IPC-based shell simulations [Li et al. 2021] at finest resolutions. Together these features enable an efficient animation-design pipeline with predictive coarse-resolution previews providing rapid design iterations for a final, to-be-generated, high-resolution animation. In contrast, previously, to design such scenes with comparable dynamics would require prohibitively slow design iterations via repeated direct simulations on high-resolution meshes. We evaluate and demonstrate Progressive Dynamics's features over a wide range of challenging stress-tests, benchmarks, and animation design tasks. Here Progressive Dynamics efficiently computes consistent previews at costs comparable to coarsest-level direct simulations. Its matching progressive refinements across levels then generate rich, high-resolution animations with high-speed dynamics, impacts, and the complex detailing of the dynamic wrinkling, folding, and sliding of frictionally contacting thin shells and fabrics.
authors: Jiayi Eris Zhang, Doug L. James, Danny M. Kaufman

title: 游戏中的布料模拟代理资产生成
title_en: Proxy Asset Generation for Cloth Simulation in Games.
abstract: 在实时应用中,高分辨率布料的模拟面临计算挑战。在游戏产业中,代理网格技术提供了一种替代方案,通过模拟简化后的低分辨率布料几何体(代理网格),利用线性混合皮肤(LBS)驱动详细的高分辨率几何体(视觉网格)。然而,从给定的视觉网格生成具有适当皮肤权重的合适代理网格并不容易,通常需要熟练的艺术家花费数天时间进行精细调整。本文提出了一种自动流程,将不适合模拟的高分辨率视觉网格转换为单层低多边形代理网格。鉴于输入的视觉网格可能不具备模拟条件,我们的方法基于特定使用场景模拟代理网格,并优化皮肤权重,依赖于差分皮肤技术与多个精心设计的损失函数,以确保最终模拟中皮肤网格的视觉合理性。我们在各种具有挑战性的布料模型上测试了该方法,证明了其鲁棒性和有效性。
abstract_en: Simulating high-resolution cloth poses computational challenges in real-time applications. In the gaming industry, the proxy mesh technique offers an alternative, simulating a simplified low-resolution cloth geometry, proxy mesh. This proxy mesh's dynamics drive the detailed high-resolution geometry, visual mesh, through Linear Blended Skinning (LBS). However, generating a suitable proxy mesh with appropriate skinning weights from a given visual mesh is non-trivial, often requiring skilled artists several days for fine-tuning. This paper presents an automatic pipeline to convert an ill-conditioned highresolution visual mesh into a single-layer low-poly proxy mesh. Given that the input visual mesh may not be simulation-ready, our approach then simulates the proxy mesh based on specific use scenarios and optimizes the skinning weights, relying on differential skinning with several well-designed loss functions to ensure the skinned visual mesh appears plausible in the final simulation. We have tested our method on various challenging cloth models, demonstrating its robustness and effectiveness.
authors: Zhongtian Zheng, Tongtong Wang, Qijia Feng, Zherong Pan, Xifeng Gao, Kui Wu 0003

title: 代理追踪:用于双向路径追踪中优化采样的无偏互易估计
title_en: Proxy Tracing: Unbiased Reciprocal Estimation for Optimized Sampling in BDPT.
abstract: 鲁棒的光传输算法,特别是双向路径追踪(BDPT),在处理涉及镜面或高光泽路径时面临显著挑战。BDPT通过连接从光源和相机单独追踪的子路径来构建完整路径。然而,由于镜面或光泽表面的窄lobe双向散射分布函数(BSDF)对可行方向的采样施加了严重限制,连接这些表面上的顶点仍存在困难。为解决此问题,我们提出了一种名为代理采样的新方法,可高效连接这些具有挑战性的路径。当发生低贡献的镜面/光泽连接时,我们从原始路径中移除该镜面/光泽顶点附近的有问题的邻近顶点,然后重新追踪替代子路径作为代理,以补充该不完整路径。新构建的完整路径确保连接符合镜面/光泽表面BSDF中窄lobe的约束条件。无偏互易估计是本方法的关键,用于获得与无偏渲染相匹配的概率密度函数(PDF)互易性。我们推导了互易估计方法,并提供了效率优化的设置以实现高效采样和连接。我们的方法为用有利替代路径替换问题路径提供了稳健工具,同时确保无偏性。我们在概率连接的BDPT中验证了该方法,以解决涉及镜面的困难路径。实验结果证明了该方法的有效性和效率,展示了在多样化场景下的高性能渲染能力。
abstract_en: Robust light transport algorithms, particularly bidirectional path tracing (BDPT), face significant challenges when dealing with specular or highly glossy involved paths. BDPT constructs the full path by connecting sub-paths traced individually from the light source and camera. However, it remains difficult to sample by connecting vertices on specular and glossy surfaces with narrow-lobed BSDF, as it poses severe constraints on sampling in the feasible direction. To address this issue, we propose a novel approach, called proxy sampling, that enables efficient sub-path connection of these challenging paths. When a low-contribution specular/glossy connection occurs, we drop out the problematic neighboring vertex next to this specular/glossy vertex from the original path, then retrace an alternative sub-path as a proxy to complement this incomplete path. This newly constructed complete path ensures that the connection adheres to the constraint of the narrow lobe within the BSDF of the specular/glossy surface. Unbiased reciprocal estimation is the key to our method to obtain a probability density function (PDF) reciprocal to ensure unbiased rendering. We derive the reciprocal estimation method and provide an efficiency-optimized setting for efficient sampling and connection. Our method provides a robust tool for substituting problematic paths with favorable alternatives while ensuring unbiasedness. We validate this approach in the probabilistic connections BDPT for addressing specular-involved difficult paths. Experimental results have proved the effectiveness and efficiency of our approach, showcasing high-performance rendering capabilities across diverse settings.
authors: Fujia Su, Bingxuan Li, Qingyang Yin, Yanchen Zhang, Sheng Li 0008

title: 光线追踪调和函数
title_en: Ray Tracing Harmonic Functions.
abstract: 球面追踪是一种快速且高质量的可视化符号距离函数(SDF)编码表面的方法。我们引入了一种类似的方法,用于完全不同的由调和函数编码的表面类别,为视觉计算开辟了丰富的可能性。我们的起点与球面追踪精神相似:利用调和函数增长的保守哈纳克界,我们开发了一种哈纳克追踪算法,用于可视化调和函数的水平集,包括角度值的和具有奇点的水平集。该方法比朴素的光线步进采取更大的步长,避免了通用根查找方法常见的数值问题,并且像球面追踪一样,只需在每一步对函数进行点值评估。对于许多应用场景,该方法足够快速,可以在着色器程序中实现实时运行。我们利用它直接从点云(通过泊松曲面重建)或网格碎片(通过广义绕数)可视化光滑表面,而无需线性求解或网格提取。我们还利用它可视化非平面多边形(可能有孔洞)、建筑几何表面、网格“外骨骼”以及关键数学对象,包括纽结、链、球面调和函数和黎曼曲面。最后,我们证明,至少在理论上,哈纳克追踪为可视化任意隐式曲面提供了一种替代机制。
abstract_en: Sphere tracing is a fast and high-quality method for visualizing surfaces encoded by signed distance functions (SDFs). We introduce a similar method for a completely different class of surfaces encoded by harmonic functions, opening up rich new possibilities for visual computing. Our starting point is similar in spirit to sphere tracing: using conservative Harnack bounds on the growth of harmonic functions, we develop a Harnack tracing algorithm for visualizing level sets of harmonic functions, including those that are angle-valued and exhibit singularities. The method takes much larger steps than naïve ray marching, avoids numerical issues common to generic root finding methods and, like sphere tracing, needs only perform pointwise evaluation of the function at each step. For many use cases, the method is fast enough to run real time in a shader program. We use it to visualize smooth surfaces directly from point clouds (via Poisson surface reconstruction) or polygon soup (via generalized winding numbers) without linear solves or mesh extraction. We also use it to visualize nonplanar polygons (possibly with holes), surfaces from architectural geometry, mesh "exoskeletons", and key mathematical objects including knots, links, spherical harmonics, and Riemann surfaces. Finally we show that, at least in theory, Harnack tracing provides an alternative mechanism for visualizing arbitrary implicit surfaces.
authors: Mark Gillespie, Denise Yang, Mario Botsch, Keenan Crane

title: 基于包围体素采样的实时路径引导
title_en: Real-Time Path Guiding Using Bounding Voxel Sampling.
abstract: 我们提出了一种实时路径引导方法Voxel Path Guiding (VXPG),在有限采样预算下显著提升了拟合效率。我们的核心思想是利用空间辐射度体素数据结构,通过所有着色点的可见性信息来指导路径顶点的位置。对于每一帧,我们首先将辐射度和几何信息填充到体素数据结构中。为了从数据结构中对某个着色点进行采样,需要选择对该点贡献较大的体素。为在考虑可见性的情况下进行重要性采样,我们借鉴离线多光源渲染技术,通过聚类着色点与体素的配对来实现。最后,在选定的体素内考虑内部几何信息进行无偏采样。实验表明,在等时间比较下,VXPG相比其他实时路径引导和虚拟点光源方法具有显著更低的感知误差。此外,我们的方法不依赖时间信息,但可以与ReSTIR等其他时间复用采样技术结合使用,进一步提升采样效率。
abstract_en: We propose a real-time path guiding method, Voxel Path Guiding (VXPG), that significantly improves fitting efficiency under limited sampling budget. Our key idea is to use a spatial irradiance voxel data structure across all shading points to guide the location of path vertices. For each frame, we first populate the voxel data structure with irradiance and geometry information. To sample from the data structure for a shading point, we need to select a voxel with high contribution to that point. To importance sample the voxels while taking visibility into consideration, we adapt techniques from offline many-lights rendering by clustering pairs of shading points and voxels. Finally, we unbiasedly sample within the selected voxel while taking the geometry inside into consideration. Our experiments show that VXPG achieves significantly lower perceptual error compared to other real-time path guiding and virtual point light methods under equal-time comparison. Furthermore, our method does not rely on temporal information, but can be used together with other temporal reuse sampling techniques such as ReSTIR to further improve sampling efficiency.
authors: Haolin Lu, Wesley Chang, Trevor Hedstrom, Tzu-Mao Li

title: 实时物理驱动发丝插值
title_en: Real-time Physically Guided Hair Interpolation.
abstract: 基于发丝的头发模拟近年来在多种实时应用中日益流行。然而,准确模拟全部发丝数量仍具挑战性。常用技术是模拟子集引导发丝以捕捉整体发型行为,随后通过线性皮肤绑定进行细节增强。发丝插值可实现快速实时模拟,但运行时常导致各种艺术效果。由于皮肤权重通常预计算,初始与变形形状间显著差异会导致细发几何严重偏离。直发可能产生褶皱,卷发可能呈现锯齿状。本文提出一种新颖的物理驱动发丝插值方案,利用现有模拟引导发丝数据。不同于直接操作位置,我们先从引导发丝插值内部力,再基于其材料模型高效重建渲染发丝。我们将问题建模为约束满足问题并提出高效解法。进一步通过正则化项处理实际考虑,调节穿透避免与漂移校正。我们测试了多种发型,结果表明仅需少量引导发丝即可生成视觉合理的渲染发丝,且计算开销仅为传统线性发丝插值的约20%。该效率凸显了方法在实时应用中的实用价值。
abstract_en: Strand-based hair simulations have recently become increasingly popular for a range of real-time applications. However, accurately simulating the full number of hair strands remains challenging. A commonly employed technique involves simulating a subset of guide hairs to capture the overall behavior of the hairstyle. Details are then enriched by interpolation using linear skinning. Hair interpolation enables fast real-time simulations but frequently leads to various artifacts during runtime. As the skinning weights are often pre-computed, substantial variations between the initial and deformed shapes of the hair can cause severe deviations in fine hair geometry. Straight hairs may become kinked, and curly hairs may become zigzags. This work introduces a novel physical-driven hair interpolation scheme that utilizes existing simulated guide hair data. Instead of directly operating on positions, we interpolate the internal forces from the guide hairs before efficiently reconstructing the rendered hairs based on their material model. We formulate our problem as a constraint satisfaction problem for which we present an efficient solution. Further practical considerations are addressed using regularization terms that regulate penetration avoidance and drift correction. We have tested various hairstyles to illustrate that our approach can generate visually plausible rendered hairs with only a few guide hairs and minimal computational overhead, amounting to only about 20% of conventional linear hair interpolation. This efficiency underscores the practical viability of our method for real-time applications.
authors: Jerry Hsu, Tongtong Wang, Zherong Pan, Xifeng Gao, Cem Yuksel, Kui Wu 0003

title: RealFill:基于参考驱动的真实图像补全方法
title_en: RealFill: Reference-Driven Generation for Authentic Image Completion.
abstract: 近年来生成图像技术的进展催生了外补和内补模型,这些模型能够在未知区域生成高质量且合理的图像内容。然而,这些模型生成的内容必然缺乏真实性,因为它们无法感知真实场景。本文提出RealFill,一种新颖的图像补全生成方法,能够以应有内容填充图像缺失区域。RealFill是一种生成式内补模型,仅需少量场景参考图像即可进行个性化定制。这些参考图像无需与目标图像对齐,可包含大幅变化的视角、光照条件、相机光圈或图像风格。个性化完成后,RealFill能够生成视觉吸引且忠实于原始场景的目标图像内容。我们在新的图像补全基准数据集上评估RealFill,该数据集涵盖多样且具有挑战性的场景,结果表明其在现有方法中表现显著优于。项目页面:https://realfill.github.io
abstract_en: Recent advances in generative imagery have brought forth outpainting and inpainting models that can produce high-quality, plausible image content in unknown regions. However, the content these models hallucinate is necessarily inauthentic, since they are unaware of the true scene. In this work, we propose RealFill, a novel generative approach for image completion that fills in missing regions of an image with the content that should have been there. RealFill is a generative inpainting model that is personalized using only a few reference images of a scene. These reference images do not have to be aligned with the target image, and can be taken with drastically varying viewpoints, lighting conditions, camera apertures, or image styles. Once personalized, RealFill is able to complete a target image with visually compelling contents that are faithful to the original scene. We evaluate RealFill on a new image completion benchmark that covers a set of diverse and challenging scenarios, and find that it outperforms existing approaches by a large margin. Project page: https://realfill.github.io.
authors: Luming Tang, Nataniel Ruiz, Qinghao Chu, Yuanzhen Li, Aleksander Holynski, David E. Jacobs, Bharath Hariharan, Yael Pritch, Neal Wadhwa, Kfir Aberman, Michael Rubinstein

title: 排斥壳体
title_en: Repulsive Shells.
abstract: 本文开发了一种用于碰撞感知几何建模的形状空间框架,其中基本几何操作能够自动避免相互穿透。形状空间是表面建模、形状分析、非刚性运动规划和动画的强大工具,但以往的公式允许非物理的相交。我们的框架通过引入排斥能量来增强现有形状空间,使得碰撞避免成为首要属性,该属性直接编码在黎曼度量中。因此,诸如无相交形状插值或运动外推等任务,只需通过标准数值算法计算测地线路径即可完成。为使优化实用,我们开发了一种自适应碰撞惩罚机制,可防止网格自相交,并在细化过程中收敛到有意义的极限能量。最终算法适用于任何形状类别,且无需示例数据集、训练、绑定或任何其他先验信息。例如,要插值两个形状,只需一对具有相同连接性的网格即可。我们在建模和动画领域的一系列具有挑战性的示例上评估了该方法。
abstract_en: This paper develops a shape space framework for collision-aware geometric modeling, where basic geometric operations automatically avoid inter-penetration. Shape spaces are a powerful tool for surface modeling, shape analysis, nonrigid motion planning, and animation, but past formulations permit nonphysical intersections. Our framework augments an existing shape space using a repulsive energy such that collision avoidance becomes a first-class property, encoded in the Riemannian metric itself. In turn, tasks like intersection-free shape interpolation or motion extrapolation amount to simply computing geodesic paths via standard numerical algorithms. To make optimization practical, we develop an adaptive collision penalty that prevents mesh self-intersection, and converges to a meaningful limit energy under refinement. The final algorithms apply to any category of shape, and do not require a dataset of examples, training, rigging, nor any other prior information. For instance, to interpolate between two shapes we need only a single pair of meshes with the same connectivity. We evaluate our method on a variety of challenging examples from modeling and animation.
authors: Josua Sassen, Henrik Schumacher, Martin Rumpf, Keenan Crane

title: 基于广义绕数的有理参数曲线集合鲁棒包含查询
title_en: Robust Containment Queries over Collections of Rational Parametric Curves via Generalized Winding Numbers.
abstract: 对于由无渗漏几何表面(即封闭且无自相交)界定的区域,点包含查询可通过若干成熟算法直接求解。当该几何域假设不成立时,此类方法要么不可用,要么易产生误分类,进而导致下游应用的级联错误。已有研究提出基于广义绕数的更鲁棒点分类方案,因其对几何缺陷不敏感。然而现有算法仅适用于点云和线性元素集合。本文将该方法扩展至更一般的曲面形状,提出一种算法,通过在无结构有理参数曲线集合上计算绕数标量场。具体而言,我们独立计算每条曲线的绕数,使推导出的包含查询对曲线排列方式具有鲁棒性。我们通过将每条曲线视为等效于自适应构造的折线,确保查询的几何保真度,该折线在感兴趣点处的广义绕数可证与原曲线相同。我们的算法对任意接近模型的点均保持数值稳定,并显式处理与曲线重合的点。我们展示了该方法相较于传统技术在计算性能上的改进,以及其应用带来的鲁棒性提升。
abstract_en: Point containment queries for regions bound by watertight geometric surfaces, i.e., closed and without self-intersections, can be evaluated straightforwardly with a number of well-studied algorithms. When this assumption on domain geometry is not met, such methods are either unusable, or prone to misclassifications that can lead to cascading errors in downstream applications. More robust point classification schemes based on generalized winding numbers have been proposed, as they are indifferent to these imperfections. However, existing algorithms are limited to point clouds and collections of linear elements. We extend this methodology to encompass more general curved shapes with an algorithm that evaluates the winding number scalar field over unstructured collections of rational parametric curves. In particular, we evaluate the winding number for each curve independently, making the derived containment query robust to how the curves are arranged. We ensure geometric fidelity in our queries by treating each curve as equivalent to an adaptively constructed polyline that provably has the same generalized winding number at the point of interest. Our algorithm is numerically stable for points that are arbitrarily close to the model, and explicitly treats points that are coincident with curves. We demonstrate the improvements in computational performance granted by this method over conventional techniques as well as the robustness induced by its application.
authors: Jacob Spainhour, David Gunderman, Kenneth Weiss 0001

title: S3:语音、脚本与场景驱动的头部与眼部动画
title_en: S3: Speech, Script and Scene driven Head and Eye Animation.
abstract: 我们提出S3,一种生成对话场景中角色具有表现力的、面向动画师的3D头部与眼部动画的新方法。给定语音音频、导演脚本和电影化3D场景作为输入,我们自动输出每个角色头部与眼部的动画3D旋转。S3将动画与心理语言学见解提炼为一种新颖的模块化框架,用于对话注视捕捉:语音驱动的节奏性头部运动;叙事脚本驱动的标志性头部与眼部手势;以及由语音驱动的注视聚焦/回避和三维视觉场景显著性计算得出的注视轨迹。我们的评估包含四个部分:我们定量验证算法与真实数据及基线方法的对比;我们进行感知研究,显示结果优于现有技术;我们展示动画师控制示例与S3输出的批评;并呈现大量引人入胜且多样的对话注视动画。
abstract_en: We present S3, a novel approach to generating expressive, animator-centric 3D head and eye animation of characters in conversation. Given speech audio, a Directorial script and a cinematographic 3D scene as input, we automatically output the animated 3D rotation of each character's head and eyes. S3 distills animation and psycho-linguistic insights into a novel modular framework for conversational gaze capturing: audio-driven rhythmic head motion; narrative script-driven emblematic head and eye gestures; and gaze trajectories computed from audio-driven gaze focus/aversion and 3D visual scene salience. Our evaluation is four-fold: we quantitatively validate our algorithm against ground truth data and baseline alternatives; we conduct a perceptual study showing our results to compare favourably to prior art; we present examples of animator control and critique of S3 output; and present a large number of compelling and varied animations of conversational gaze.
authors: Yifang Pan, Rishabh Agrawal, Karan Singh 0004

title: SMERF:面向实时大场景探索的流式内存高效辐射场
title_en: SMERF: Streamable Memory Efficient Radiance Fields for Real-Time Large-Scene Exploration.
abstract: 近年来,实时视图合成技术在保真度和速度方面取得了快速进展,现代方法能够在交互式帧率下渲染接近照片级真实的场景。同时,显式场景表示(适用于光栅化)与基于光线行进的神经场之间出现了张力,后者最先进的实例在质量上超越前者,但对实时应用而言成本过高。我们引入SMERF,一种视图合成方法,在体积分辨率为3.5立方毫米、场景面积达300平方米的大场景中,实现了实时方法中最先进的精度。我们的方法基于两个主要贡献:一种分层模型分区方案,通过增加模型容量同时限制计算和内存消耗;以及一种蒸馏训练策略,可同时实现高保真度和内部一致性。我们的方法支持在网页浏览器中实现完整的六自由度导航,并能在普通智能手机和笔记本电脑上实时渲染。大量实验表明,我们的方法在标准基准测试中比最先进方法在实时新视图合成中高出0.78 dB,在大场景中高出1.78 dB,帧渲染速度比最先进辐射场模型快三个数量级,并在包括智能手机在内的多种普通设备上实现实时性能。我们鼓励读者通过项目网站(https://smerf-3d.github.io)交互式探索这些模型。
abstract_en: Recent techniques for real-time view synthesis have rapidly advanced in fidelity and speed, and modern methods are capable of rendering near-photorealistic scenes at interactive frame rates. At the same time, a tension has arisen between explicit scene representations amenable to rasterization and neural fields built on ray marching, with state-of-the-art instances of the latter surpassing the former in quality while being prohibitively expensive for real-time applications. We introduce SMERF, a view synthesis approach that achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among real-time methods on large scenes with footprints up to 300 m2 at a volumetric resolution of 3.5 mm3. Our method is built upon two primary contributions: a hierarchical model partitioning scheme, which increases model capacity while constraining compute and memory consumption, and a distillation training strategy that simultaneously yields high fidelity and internal consistency. Our method enables full six degrees of freedom navigation in a web browser and renders in real-time on commodity smartphones and laptops. Extensive experiments show that our method exceeds the state-of-the-art in real-time novel view synthesis by 0.78 dB on standard benchmarks and 1.78 dB on large scenes, renders frames three orders of magnitude faster than state-of-the-art radiance field models, and achieves real-time performance across a wide variety of commodity devices, including smartphones. We encourage readers to explore these models interactively at our project website: https://smerf-3d.github.io.
authors: Daniel Duckworth, Peter Hedman, Christian Reiser, Peter Zhizhin, Jean-François Thibert, Mario Lucic, Richard Szeliski, Jonathan T. Barron

title: Scintilla:模拟可燃植被的野火
title_en: Scintilla: Simulating Combustible Vegetation for Wildfires.
abstract: 野火是一种复杂的物理现象,涉及从落叶和干枯枝条到分解有机物和活体植被等多种可燃材料的燃烧。所有这些材料都可能作为具有不同特性的燃料,决定野火的进程和严重程度。本文提出了一种新颖的方法,用于模拟野火中不同成分之间的动态相互作用,包括植被、土壤和大气之间的对流、燃烧和热传递过程。我们提出了一种新的植被表示方法,包含详细的枝干几何结构、燃料含水量以及草类、细燃料和腐殖质的分布。此外,我们建模了火种和火星的点火、生成和传输过程。这使得能够模拟和渲染逼真的虚拟三维野火,真实呈现该过程的关键方面,如从地面到树冠的火灾进展、风携带火星的影响以及火障等其他人为干预方法的效果。我们通过大量实验评估了该方法,并基于与真实野火数据的对比进行验证。
abstract_en: Wildfires are a complex physical phenomenon that involves the combustion of a variety of flammable materials ranging from fallen leaves and dried twigs to decomposing organic material and living flora. All these materials can potentially act as fuel with different properties that determine the progress and severity of a wildfire. In this paper, we propose a novel approach for simulating the dynamic interaction between the varying components of a wildfire, including processes of convection, combustion and heat transfer between vegetation, soil and atmosphere. We propose a novel representation of vegetation that includes detailed branch geometry, fuel moisture, and distribution of grass, fine fuel, and duff. Furthermore, we model the ignition, generation, and transport of fire by firebrands and embers. This allows simulating and rendering virtual 3D wildfires that realistically capture key aspects of the process, such as progressions from ground to crown fires, the impact of embers carried by wind, and the effects of fire barriers and other human intervention methods. We evaluate our approach through numerous experiments and based on comparisons to real-world wildfire data.
authors: Andrzej Kokosza, Helge Wrede, Daniel Gonzalez Esparza, Milosz Makowski, Daoming Liu, Dominik L. Michels, Sören Pirk, Wojtek Palubicki

title: Penner坐标中的无缝参数化
title_en: Seamless Parametrization in Penner Coordinates.
abstract: 我们提出了一种概念上简单且高效的无缝参数化算法,这是构建曲面上四边形布局和纹理图表的关键要素。更具体地说,我们考虑构造具有预设霍罗尼签名的参数化,即在奇点处的一组角度以及沿同调环的旋转,保持这些特性对于根据输入场构造参数化以及用户对参数化结构的控制至关重要。我们的算法在基于Thingi10k [Zhou和Jacobson 2016](16156个网格)的大规模数据集上表现优异,以及在[Myles等2014]提出的具有挑战性的较小数据集上也表现良好,平均收敛于9次迭代。尽管该算法缺乏正式的数学保证,但呈现的实证证据以及凸优化与相关算法之间的联系表明,未来可以为该算法找到类似的表述形式。
abstract_en: We introduce a conceptually simple and efficient algorithm for seamless parametrization, a key element in constructing quad layouts and texture charts on surfaces. More specifically, we consider the construction of parametrizations with prescribed holonomy signatures i.e., a set of angles at singularities, and rotations along homology loops, preserving which is essential for constructing parametrizations following an input field, as well as for user control of the parametrization structure. Our algorithm performs exceptionally well on a large dataset based on Thingi10k [Zhou and Jacobson 2016], (16156 meshes) as well as on a challenging smaller dataset of [Myles et al. 2014], converging, on average, in 9 iterations. Although the algorithm lacks a formal mathematical guarantee, presented empirical evidence and the connections between convex optimization and closely related algorithms, suggest that a similar formulation can be found for this algorithm in the future.
authors: Ryan Capouellez, Denis Zorin

title: 语义手势生成器:语义感知的伴随语音手势合成
title_en: Semantic Gesticulator: Semantics-Aware Co-Speech Gesture Synthesis.
abstract: 本文提出语义手势生成器(Semantic Gesticulator),一种新型框架,旨在合成与语音具有强语义对应关系的逼真手势。具有语义意义的手势对于有效的非语言交流至关重要,但此类手势往往位于自然人类运动分布的长尾部分。这些运动的稀疏性使得基于深度学习的系统在中等规模数据集上难以捕捉运动与对应语音语义之间的关系。为解决这一挑战,我们开发了一个基于大语言模型的生成检索框架。该框架能根据输入语音高效检索运动库中的合适语义手势候选。为构建该运动库,我们基于语言学研究总结了常用语义手势的综合列表,并收集了一个包含身体和手部运动的高质量运动数据集。我们还设计了一种具有强音频泛化能力的新型基于GPT的模型,能够生成与语音节奏匹配的高质量手势。此外,我们提出了一种语义对齐机制,以高效地将检索到的语义手势与GPT的输出对齐,确保最终动画的自然性。我们的系统在生成节奏协调且语义明确的手势方面表现出鲁棒性,这通过大量示例集得到验证。用户研究确认了我们结果的质量和拟人化程度,并表明我们的系统在语义恰当性方面显著优于现有最先进的系统。我们将发布代码和数据集供学术研究使用。
abstract_en: In this work, we present Semantic Gesticulator, a novel framework designed to synthesize realistic gestures accompanying speech with strong semantic correspondence. Semantically meaningful gestures are crucial for effective non-verbal communication, but such gestures often fall within the long tail of the distribution of natural human motion. The sparsity of these movements makes it challenging for deep learning-based systems, trained on moderately sized datasets, to capture the relationship between the movements and the corresponding speech semantics. To address this challenge, we develop a generative retrieval framework based on a large language model. This framework efficiently retrieves suitable semantic gesture candidates from a motion library in response to the input speech. To construct this motion library, we summarize a comprehensive list of commonly used semantic gestures based on findings in linguistics, and we collect a high-quality motion dataset encompassing both body and hand movements. We also design a novel GPT-based model with strong generalization capabilities to audio, capable of generating high-quality gestures that match the rhythm of speech. Furthermore, we propose a semantic alignment mechanism to efficiently align the retrieved semantic gestures with the GPT's output, ensuring the naturalness of the final animation. Our system demonstrates robustness in generating gestures that are rhythmically coherent and semantically explicit, as evidenced by a comprehensive collection of examples. User studies confirm the quality and human-likeness of our results, and show that our system outperforms state-of-the-art systems in terms of semantic appropriateness by a clear margin. We will release the code and dataset for academic research.
authors: Zeyi Zhang, Tenglong Ao, Yuyao Zhang, Qingzhe Gao, Chuan Lin, Baoquan Chen, Libin Liu 0002

title: Simplicits: 无网格、几何无关的弹性模拟
title_en: Simplicits: Mesh-Free, Geometry-Agnostic Elastic Simulation.
abstract: 从显式网格到隐式神经场等3D表示形式的普及,推动了对表示形式无关模拟器的需求。我们提出了一种无需数据、网格和网格的弹性模拟方案,适用于任何几何表示形式下经历大变形的物体。我们注意到,任何标准几何表示均可归约为一个在空间任意点均可查询的占据函数,并在此通用接口上定义了模拟器。对于每个物体,我们拟合一个小型隐式神经网络,该网络编码空间变化的权重,作为降维变形基。这些权重通过随机扰动训练以学习物体的物理显著运动。我们的损失函数确保通过蒙特卡洛采样对变形体积进行弹性能量的随机评估,从而找到最佳最小化变形能量的权重空间基。运行时,我们在降维基中进行模拟,并将变形采样回原始域。实验结果展示了该方法在包括有符号距离函数、点云、神经原素、断层扫描、辐射场、高斯点云、表面网格和体积网格等数据上的通用性、准确性和速度,同时展示了多种材料能量、接触模型和时间积分方案。
abstract_en: The proliferation of 3D representations, from explicit meshes to implicit neural fields and more, motivates the need for simulators agnostic to representation. We present a data-, mesh-, and grid-free solution for elastic simulation for any object in any geometric representation undergoing large, nonlinear deformations. We note that every standard geometric representation can be reduced to an occupancy function queried at any point in space, and we define a simulator atop this common interface. For each object, we fit a small implicit neural network encoding spatially varying weights that act as a reduced deformation basis. These weights are trained to learn physically significant motions in the object via random perturbations. Our loss ensures we find a weight-space basis that best minimizes deformation energy by stochastically evaluating elastic energies through Monte Carlo sampling of the deformation volume. At runtime, we simulate in the reduced basis and sample the deformations back to the original domain. Our experiments demonstrate the versatility, accuracy, and speed of this approach on data including signed distance functions, point clouds, neural primitives, tomography scans, radiance fields, Gaussian splats, surface meshes, and volume meshes, as well as showing a variety of material energies, contact models, and time integration schemes.
authors: Vismay Modi, Nicholas Sharp, Or Perel, Shinjiro Sueda, David I. W. Levin

title: SketchDream: 基于草图的文本到3D生成与编辑
title_en: SketchDream: Sketch-based Text-To-3D Generation and Editing.
abstract: 现有基于文本的3D生成方法能够生成吸引人的结果,但缺乏对几何细节的精细控制。草图因其简洁性和表现力,在直观3D建模中有所贡献,但受限于只能在预定义类别中生成无纹理的网格模型。同时整合草图与文本进行3D生成有望增强对几何形状和外观的控制,但面临2D到3D转换歧义性和多模态条件整合的挑战。此外,对任意视角下的3D模型进行进一步编辑将赋予用户更多自定义模型的自由度。然而,实现高质量生成、保持未编辑区域以及管理形状组件间的适当交互仍具难度。为解决上述问题,我们提出一种文本驱动的3D内容生成与编辑方法SketchDream,支持从给定手绘草图生成NeRF,并实现自由视角的草图局部编辑。为应对2D到3D歧义性挑战,我们引入一种基于草图的多视角图像生成扩散模型,利用深度引导建立空间对应关系。采用包含3D注意力模块的3D ControlNet来控制多视角图像并确保其三维一致性。为支持局部编辑,我们进一步提出粗到细的编辑方法:粗阶段分析组件交互关系并生成3D掩码以标记编辑区域,细阶段通过局部增强生成具有精细细节的逼真结果。大量实验验证了我们的方法在生成质量上优于结合2D ControlNet与图像到3D生成技术的组合,并在细节控制方面优于现有基于扩散的3D编辑方法。
abstract_en: Existing text-based 3D generation methods generate attractive results but lack detailed geometry control. Sketches, known for their conciseness and expressiveness, have contributed to intuitive 3D modeling but are confined to producing texture-less mesh models within predefined categories. Integrating sketch and text simultaneously for 3D generation promises enhanced control over geometry and appearance but faces challenges from 2D-to-3D translation ambiguity and multi-modal condition integration. Moreover, further editing of 3D models in arbitrary views will give users more freedom to customize their models. However, it is difficult to achieve high generation quality, preserve unedited regions, and manage proper interactions between shape components. To solve the above issues, we propose a text-driven 3D content generation and editing method, SketchDream, which supports NeRF generation from given hand-drawn sketches and achieves free-view sketch-based local editing. To tackle the 2D-to-3D ambiguity challenge, we introduce a sketch-based multi-view image generation diffusion model, which leverages depth guidance to establish spatial correspondence. A 3D ControlNet with a 3D attention module is utilized to control multi-view images and ensure their 3D consistency. To support local editing, we further propose a coarse-to-fine editing approach: the coarse phase analyzes component interactions and provides 3D masks to label edited regions, while the fine stage generates realistic results with refined details by local enhancement. Extensive experiments validate that our method generates higher-quality results compared with a combination of 2D ControlNet and image-to-3D generation techniques and achieves detailed control compared with existing diffusion-based 3D editing approaches.
authors: Feng-Lin Liu, Hongbo Fu 0001, Yu-Kun Lai, Lin Gao 0004

title: 高阶壳中的光滑双射投影
title_en: Smooth Bijective Projection in a High-order Shell.
abstract: 我们提出了一种称为高阶壳的新结构,其由一组三角棱柱组成。每个三角棱柱被三个贝塞尔三角形(顶部、中部和底部)以及三个侧表面所包围,每个侧表面均从双线性曲面中裁剪得到。此外,我们定义了一个连续向量场,以在壳内部的两个表面上实现光滑且双射的属性传递。由于高阶壳具有多个严格的构造约束条件,我们采用内点策略来稳健且自动地构建输入网格的高阶壳。具体而言,该策略从一个具有小厚度的有效线性壳开始,然后通过优化直到达到指定厚度,其中显式检查确保约束条件始终得到满足。我们在超过8300个模型上广泛测试了该方法,验证了其鲁棒性和性能。与最先进的方法相比,我们的双射投影更光滑,壳与输入网格之间的空间分布更加均匀。
abstract_en: We propose a new structure called a higher-order shell, which is composed of a set of triangular prisms. Each triangular prism is enveloped by three Bézier triangles (top, middle, and bottom) and three side surfaces, each of which is trimmed from a bilinear surface. Moreover, we define a continuous vector field to smoothly and bijectively transfer attributes between two surfaces inside the shell. Since the higher-order shell has several hard construction constraints, we apply an interior-point strategy to robustly and automatically construct a high-order shell for an input mesh. Specifically, the strategy starts from a valid linear shell with a small thickness. Then, the shell is optimized until the specified thickness is reached, where explicit checks ensure that the constraints are always satisfied. We extensively test our method on more than 8300 models, demonstrating its robustness and performance. Compared to state-of-the-art methods, our bijective projection is smoother, and the space between the shell and input mesh is more uniform.
authors: Shibo Liu 0001, Yang Ji, Jia-Peng Guo, Ligang Liu 0001, Xiao-Ming Fu 0001

title: 实体编织
title_en: Solid Knitting.
abstract: 我们引入了一种名为实体编织的新制造技术,该技术结合了3D打印的分层体积方法与编织的拓扑纠缠针结构,以生产实体三维物体。我们定义了实体编织的基本构建单元,并展示了一个由低级指令语言控制的实体编织机原型,以及用于创建可编织图案的体积设计工具。实体编织采用道纹层结构,其中每个实体编织物体中的针脚均穿过前一层和前一道的针脚。我们的机器使用两组钩针床来生成针脚,如同传统的V型床编织机,但通过一对旋转钩组为物体单层的所有针脚提供存储位置。该机器能够自主生产任意长度的实体编织棱柱,尽管需要手动干预以编织第一层并收尾最后一行。我们的设计工具允许用户通过连接基本针脚来创建实体编织图案;在通过基本拓扑检查和约束传播后,通过界面设计的物体可导出为在实体编织机上进行制造的指令序列。我们通过棱柱示例验证了实体编织的硬件和软件,详细说明了遇到的机械误差,并讨论了实体编织机能力的潜在扩展。
abstract_en: We introduce solid knitting, a new fabrication technique that combines the layer-by-layer volumetric approach of 3D printing with the topologically-entwined stitch structure of knitting to produce solid 3D objects. We define the basic building blocks of solid knitting and demonstrate a working prototype of a solid knitting machine controlled by a low-level instruction language, along with a volumetric design tool for creating machine-knittable patterns. Solid knitting uses a course-wale-layer structure, where every loop in a solid-knit object passes through both a loop from the previous layer and a loop from the previous course. Our machine uses two beds of latch needles to create stitches like a conventional V-bed knitting machine, but augments these needles with a pair of rotating hook arrays to provide storage locations for all of the loops in one layer of the object. It can autonomously produce solid-knit prisms of arbitrary length, although it requires manual intervention to cast on the first layer and bind off the final row. Our design tool allows users to create solid knitting patterns by connecting elementary stitches; objects designed in our interface can---after basic topological checks and constraint propagation---be exported as a sequence of instructions for fabrication on the solid knitting machine. We validate our solid knitting hardware and software on prism examples, detail the mechanical errors which we have encountered, and discuss potential extensions to the capability of our solid knitting machine.
authors: Yuichi Hirose, Mark Gillespie, Angelica M. Bonilla Fominaya, James McCann

title: 用于交互迁移的空间与表面对应场
title_en: Spatial and Surface Correspondence Field for Interaction Transfer.
abstract: 本文提出了一种用于交互迁移任务的新方法。给定源物体与代理物体之间的示例交互,我们的方法能够自动推断同一类别中代理物体与目标物体的表面与空间关系,实现更准确有效的迁移。具体而言,我们的方法通过结合空间与表面表示来表征示例交互。我们利用学习得到的空间与表面对应场,将与该表示相关的代理点和物体点对应到目标物体空间,该对应场将物体表示为变形和旋转的带符号距离场。在满足空间与表面交互表示约束及额外正则化条件下,基于对应点进行优化。在人体-椅子和手-杯子交互迁移任务上的实验表明,我们的方法能够处理源物体与目标物体之间更大的几何与拓扑变化,显著优于现有最先进的方法。
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce a new method for the task of interaction transfer. Given an example interaction between a source object and an agent, our method can automatically infer both surface and spatial relationships for the agent and target objects within the same category, yielding more accurate and valid transfers. Specifically, our method characterizes the example interaction using a combined spatial and surface representation. We correspond the agent points and object points related to the representation to the target object space using a learned spatial and surface correspondence field, which represents objects as deformed and rotated signed distance fields. With the corresponded points, an optimization is performed under the constraints of our spatial and surface interaction representation and additional regularization. Experiments conducted on human-chair and hand-mug interaction transfer tasks show that our approach can handle larger geometry and topology variations between source and target shapes, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods.
authors: Zeyu Huang, Honghao Xu, Haibin Huang, Chongyang Ma, Hui Huang 0004, Ruizhen Hu

title: 镜面多项式
title_en: Specular Polynomials.
abstract: 在蒙特卡洛渲染中寻找涉及镜面顶点的有效光路需要求解高维空间中的大量非线性、超越方程。现有方法严重依赖路径空间中的牛顿迭代,每次最多只能获得一个解,且当使用不当的初始种子时容易发散。我们提出镜面多项式,这是一种无需牛顿迭代的方法,用于寻找连接场景中任意两个端点的完整可接受镜面光路集合。核心是将镜面约束重新表述为多项式系统,从而将任务转化为单变量根查找问题。我们首先利用连续顶点坐标间的有理坐标映射推导出二元系统。随后采用隐变量结果方法进行变量消元,将问题转化为求解单变量矩阵多项式行列式零点。这可通过拉普拉斯展开法处理单次反射,或通过二分法求解器处理更多反射。我们的方法具有通用性、完全确定性,单次反射情形下精度高,并且适合GPU处理。我们开发了高效的CPU和GPU实现,并将其应用于具有挑战性的镜面高光和焦散渲染。在多种场景的实验中,基于镜面多项式的解决方案相比基于牛顿迭代的方案展现出优越性。我们的实现可在https://github.com/mollnn/spoly获取。
abstract_en: Finding valid light paths that involve specular vertices in Monte Carlo rendering requires solving many non-linear, transcendental equations in high-dimensional space. Existing approaches heavily rely on Newton iterations in path space, which are limited to obtaining at most a single solution each time and easily diverge when initialized with improper seeds. We propose specular polynomials, a Newton iteration-free methodology for finding a complete set of admissible specular paths connecting two arbitrary endpoints in a scene. The core is a reformulation of specular constraints into polynomial systems, which makes it possible to reduce the task to a univariate root-finding problem. We first derive bivariate systems utilizing rational coordinate mapping between the coordinates of consecutive vertices. Subsequently, we adopt the hidden variable resultant method for variable elimination, converting the problem into finding zeros of the determinant of univariate matrix polynomials. This can be effectively solved through Laplacian expansion for one bounce and a bisection solver for more bounces. Our solution is generic, completely deterministic, accurate for the case of one bounce, and GPU-friendly. We develop efficient CPU and GPU implementations and apply them to challenging glints and caustic rendering. Experiments on various scenarios demonstrate the superiority of specular polynomial-based solutions compared to Newton iteration-based counterparts. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/mollnn/spoly.
authors: Zhimin Fan 0001, Jie Guo 0001, Yiming Wang, Tianyu Xiao, Hao Zhang, Chenxi Zhou, Zhenyu Chen 0001, Pengpei Hong, Yanwen Guo 0001, Lingqi Yan 0001

title: Spin-It Faster: 二次曲面解决所有仅依赖质量矩的拓扑优化问题
title_en: Spin-It Faster: Quadrics Solve All Topology Optimization Problems That Depend Only On Mass Moments.
abstract: 刚体的行为主要取决于其质量矩,这包括质量、质心和惯性矩。通过在物体内部引入空腔,可以在不改变其几何外观的情况下操控这些量。能够找到合适形状和尺寸空腔的算法已实现了陀螺仪、悠悠球、轮子、浮标和静态平衡物体的计算设计。先前的工作例如基于体素网格的拓扑优化,会引入大量优化变量和盒约束,或基于偏移曲面计算,无法保证可行问题的解总能被找到。本文对仅依赖质量矩的约束拓扑优化问题进行了数学分析。此类问题涵盖上述所有应用。我们的主要结果是证明,无论待优化刚体的外形如何,或考虑的优化目标和约束条件如何,最优解始终在材料与空腔之间呈现二次曲面形状。这证明了最优界面始终为椭球面、双曲面、抛物面或少数退化情况(如平面)。这一洞察使我们能够将困难的拓扑优化问题替换为可证明等价的小规模(<10个变量)非线性方程组,这些变量代表二次曲面的系数。该系统可在数秒内求解,为许多具体应用的几何结构提供见解,并描述其解的特性。最后,我们的方法无缝集成到现代制造流程中,因为我们的解是分析曲面,天然属于CAD领域。
abstract_en: The behavior of a rigid body primarily depends on its mass moments, which consist of the mass, center of mass, and moments of inertia. It is possible to manipulate these quantities without altering the geometric appearance of an object by introducing cavities in its interior. Algorithms that find cavities of suitable shapes and sizes have enabled the computational design of spinning tops, yo-yos, wheels, buoys, and statically balanced objects. Previous work is based, for example, on topology optimization on voxel grids, which introduces a large number of optimization variables and box constraints, or offset surface computation, which cannot guarantee that solutions to a feasible problem will always be found. In this work, we provide a mathematical analysis of constrained topology optimization problems that depend only on mass moments. This class of problems covers, among others, all applications mentioned above. Our main result is to show that no matter the outer shape of the rigid body to be optimized or the optimization objective and constraints considered, the optimal solution always features a quadric-shaped interface between material and cavities. This proves that optimal interfaces are always ellipsoids, hyperboloids, paraboloids, or one of a few degenerate cases, such as planes. This insight lets us replace a difficult topology optimization problem with a provably equivalent non-linear equation system in a small number (<10) of variables, which represent the coefficients of the quadric. This system can be solved in a few seconds for most examples, provides insights into the geometric structure of many specific applications, and lets us describe their solution properties. Finally, our method integrates seamlessly into modern fabrication workflows because our solutions are analytical surfaces that are native to the CAD domain.
authors: Christian Hafner 0002, Mickaël Ly, Chris Wojtan

title: 自旋加权球面调和函数在偏振光传输中的应用
title_en: Spin-Weighted Spherical Harmonics for Polarized Light Transport.
abstract: 偏振渲染的目标是模拟光与表现出偏振依赖行为的材料之间的相互作用。然而,将偏振纳入渲染过程具有挑战性,并显著增加计算成本。主要困难在于高效建模和计算与偏振光相关的复杂反射现象。具体而言,频域分析对于高效环境照明和复杂光相互作用的存储至关重要,但目前尚缺乏。为高效模拟和再现偏振光相互作用,我们通过频域技术解决偏振光传输在角域中由斯托克斯矢量表示的连续性问题。传统球面调和函数方法无法有效处理斯托克斯矢量的连续性和旋转不变性。为克服这一问题,我们基于自旋加权球面调和函数理论开发了一种新方法,称为偏振球面调和函数(PSH)。我们的方法提供了斯托克斯矢量场的旋转不变表示。此外,我们引入了基于PSH的偏振渲染方程频域公式和球面卷积。我们首先在角域中定义斯托克斯矢量场的球面卷积,该方法还提供了高效的偏振光传输计算,几乎在频域中以逐元素乘积形式实现。我们的频域公式,包括球面卷积,促成了首个实时偏振渲染技术的开发,该技术在偏振环境照明下命名为预计算偏振辐射传输。结果表明,我们的方法能够有效且精确地模拟和再现复杂反射现象中的偏振光相互作用,包括偏振环境照明和软阴影。
abstract_en: The objective of polarization rendering is to simulate the interaction of light with materials exhibiting polarization-dependent behavior. However, integrating polarization into rendering is challenging and increases computational costs significantly. The primary difficulty lies in efficiently modeling and computing the complex reflection phenomena associated with polarized light. Specifically, frequency-domain analysis, essential for efficient environment lighting and storage of complex light interactions, is lacking. To efficiently simulate and reproduce polarized light interactions using frequency-domain techniques, we address the challenge of maintaining continuity in polarized light transport represented by Stokes vectors within angular domains. The conventional spherical harmonics method cannot effectively handle continuity and rotation invariance for Stokes vectors. To overcome this, we develop a new method called polarized spherical harmonics (PSH) based on the spin-weighted spherical harmonics theory. Our method provides a rotation-invariant representation of Stokes vector fields. Furthermore, we introduce frequency domain formulations of polarized rendering equations and spherical convolution based on PSH. We first define spherical convolution on Stokes vector fields in the angular domain, and it also provides efficient computation of polarized light transport, nearly on an entry-wise product in the frequency domain. Our frequency domain formulation, including spherical convolution, led to the development of the first real-time polarization rendering technique under polarized environmental illumination, named precomputed polarized radiance transfer, using our polarized spherical harmonics. Results demonstrate that our method can effectively and accurately simulate and reproduce polarized light interactions in complex reflection phenomena, including polarized environmental illumination and soft shadows.
authors: Shinyoung Yi 0001, Donggun Kim 0002, Jiwoong Na, Xin Tong 0001, Min H. Kim 0001

title: 分孔二合一计算摄像机
title_en: Split-Aperture 2-in-1 Computational Cameras.
abstract: 尽管传统摄像机在从业余摄影到自动驾驶等应用中展现出良好的通用性,计算摄像机则允许针对特定领域进行适应性优化。采用协同设计的光学系统与图像处理算法的摄像机,能够通过光学编码场景信息实现高动态范围图像恢复、深度估计和超光谱成像,而这些信息传统摄像机无法检测到。然而,这种光学编码为传统图像恢复带来了具有挑战性的逆重建问题,并往往降低整体成像质量。因此,具有领域特定光学系统的计算摄像机仅在少数专用场景中被采用,这些场景下的信息无法通过其他方式获取。在本工作中,我们研究了一种方法,通过将传统摄像机的光圈分为两半,结合两种光学系统以应对这一挑战。其中一半光圈通过衍射光学元件对入射光施加应用特定调制,生成编码图像捕获;另一半则不施加调制,生成传统图像捕获。通过将分孔的相位调制与双像素传感器协同设计,我们能够在不增加物理或计算开销的前提下同时捕获这些编码与未编码图像。在手握未编码的传统图像和光学编码图像后,我们研究了基于传统图像的图像重建方法,使得消除现有方法难以处理的伪影和计算成本成为可能。我们使用二合一摄像机对光学高动态范围重建、单目深度估计和超光谱成像进行了评估,结果在所有应用中均优于所有测试方法。
abstract_en: While conventional cameras offer versatility for applications ranging from amateur photography to autonomous driving, computational cameras allow for domain-specific adaption. Cameras with co-designed optics and image processing algorithms enable high-dynamic-range image recovery, depth estimation, and hyperspectral imaging through optically encoding scene information that is otherwise undetected by conventional cameras. However, this optical encoding creates a challenging inverse reconstruction problem for conventional image recovery, and often lowers the overall photographic quality. Thus computational cameras with domain-specific optics have only been adopted in a few specialized applications where the captured information cannot be acquired in other ways. In this work, we investigate a method that combines two optical systems into one to tackle this challenge. We split the aperture of a conventional camera into two halves: one which applies an application-specific modulation to the incident light via a diffractive optical element to produce a coded image capture, and one which applies no modulation to produce a conventional image capture. Co-designing the phase modulation of the split aperture with a dual-pixel sensor allows us to simultaneously capture these coded and uncoded images without increasing physical or computational footprint. With an uncoded conventional image alongside the optically coded image in hand, we investigate image reconstruction methods that are conditioned on the conventional image, making it possible to eliminate artifacts and compute costs that existing methods struggle with. We assess the proposed method with 2-in-1 cameras for optical high-dynamic-range reconstruction, monocular depth estimation, and hyperspectral imaging, comparing favorably to all tested methods in all applications.
authors: Zheng Shi 0003, Ilya Chugunov, Mario Bijelic, Geoffroi Côté, Jiwoon Yeom, Qiang Fu 0002, Hadi Amata, Wolfgang Heidrich, Felix Heide

title: Split-and-Fit: 通过结构感知的Voronoi划分学习边界表示
title_en: Split-and-Fit: Learning B-Reps via Structure-Aware Voronoi Partitioning.
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法,用于获取3D CAD模型的边界表示(B-Reps),该方法包含两个步骤:首先进行空间划分(称为"分割"),随后通过"拟合"操作在每个划分区域中推导出一个基本几何体。具体而言,我们的划分旨在生成真实边界表示(GT B-Rep)基本几何体集合的经典Voronoi图。与先前自下而上的B-Rep构造方法(通过直接基本几何体拟合或点聚类)不同,我们的Split-and-Fit方法是自上而下且结构感知的,因为Voronoi划分明确揭示了基本几何体的数量及其连接关系。我们设计了一个神经网络,通过二分类任务从输入点云或距离场预测Voronoi图。我们证明,这种称为NVD-Net(神经Voronoi图网络)的网络能够有效学习CAD模型的Voronoi划分,并在训练数据上展现出卓越的泛化能力。大量实验和评估表明,所生成的由参数曲面、曲线和顶点组成的B-Reps比现有方法获得的更合理,重建质量有显著提升。代码将发布在https://github.com/yilinliu77/NVDNet。
abstract_en: We introduce a novel method for acquiring boundary representations (B-Reps) of 3D CAD models which involves a two-step process: it first applies a spatial partitioning, referred to as the "split", followed by a "fit" operation to derive a single primitive within each partition. Specifically, our partitioning aims to produce the classical Voronoi diagram of the set of ground-truth (GT) B-Rep primitives. In contrast to prior B-Rep constructions which were bottom-up, either via direct primitive fitting or point clustering, our Split-and-Fit approach is top-down and structure-aware, since a Voronoi partition explicitly reveals both the number of and the connections between the primitives. We design a neural network to predict the Voronoi diagram from an input point cloud or distance field via a binary classification. We show that our network, coined NVD-Net for neural Voronoi diagrams, can effectively learn Voronoi partitions for CAD models from training data and exhibits superior generalization capabilities. Extensive experiments and evaluation demonstrate that the resulting B-Reps, consisting of parametric surfaces, curves, and vertices, are more plausible than those obtained by existing alternatives, with significant improvements in reconstruction quality. Code will be released on https://github.com/yilinliu77/NVDNet.
authors: Yilin Liu, Jiale Chen, Shanshan Pan, Daniel Cohen-Or, Hao Zhang 0002, Hui Huang 0004

title: 重心坐标的随机计算
title_en: Stochastic Computation of Barycentric Coordinates.
abstract: 本文提出了一种实用且通用的方法,通过随机采样计算重心坐标。我们的关键见解是将定义重心坐标的核积分重新表述为加权最小二乘法最小化,从而实现蒙特卡洛积分而不牺牲线性精度。因此,我们的方法可以直接在感兴趣点(包括笼体内外)计算重心坐标,仅需使用与笼体的邻近查询(如最近点和射线相交)。结果,我们能够无缝评估各种笼体表示(从四面体网格到参数曲线)的重心坐标,无需任何体积离散化或定制求解。为解决基于样本估计的典型噪声,我们还引入了针对重心坐标的去噪方案。通过实现随机生成调和坐标、均值坐标和正均值坐标,我们展示了该方法的效率和灵活性。
abstract_en: This paper presents a practical and general approach for computing barycentric coordinates through stochastic sampling. Our key insight is a reformulation of the kernel integral defining barycentric coordinates into a weighted least-squares minimization that enables Monte Carlo integration without sacrificing linear precision. Our method can thus compute barycentric coordinates directly at the points of interest, both inside and outside the cage, using just proximity queries to the cage such as closest points and ray intersections. As a result, we can evaluate barycentric coordinates for a large variety of cage representations (from quadrangulated surface meshes to parametric curves) seamlessly, bypassing any volumetric discretization or custom solves. To address the archetypal noise induced by sample-based estimates, we also introduce a denoising scheme tailored to barycentric coordinates. We demonstrate the efficiency and flexibility of our formulation by implementing a stochastic generation of harmonic coordinates, mean-value coordinates, and positive mean-value coordinates.
authors: Fernando de Goes, Mathieu Desbrun
