title: 基于期望的风格化渲染
title_en: Stylized Rendering as a Function of Expectation.
abstract: 我们提出了一种渲染方程的推广形式,该形式以原理性方式同时捕捉基于物理的渲染(PBR)的现实光传输和非真实感渲染(NPR)风格化的一类子集。所提出的公式基于一个关键观察:经典传输和某些NPR风格化均可建模为期望函数。基于这一观察,我们将渲染方程的递归积分推广为期望函数的递归形式。由于估计期望函数(尤其是递归形式)具有挑战性,我们提供了一个包含先前工作、通用策略以及一种新颖的自定义策略的工具包,用于构建更复杂的无偏估计器。随后,我们利用该工具包构建了所提出递归形式的完整估计器,并实现了一个概念简单且利用普通路径追踪器多个组件的采样算法。为展示所提方法的实用性,我们展示了其如何捕捉现有风格化效果(如颜色映射、细胞着色和交叉排线),融合NPR与PBR视觉效果,并允许探索在现有公式下难以实现的视觉效果。
abstract_en: We propose a generalization of the rendering equation that captures both the realistic light transport of physically-based rendering (PBR) and a subset of non-photorealistic rendering (NPR) stylizations in a principled manner. The proposed formulation is based on the key observation that both classical transport and certain NPR stylizations can be modeled as a function of expectation. Given this observation, we generalize the recursive integrals of the rendering equation to recursive functions of expectation. As estimating functions of expectation can be challenging, especially recursive ones, we provide a toolkit for unbiased and biased estimation comprising prior work, general strategies, and a novel build-your-own strategy for constructing more complex unbiased estimators from simpler unbiased estimators. We then use this toolkit to construct a complete estimator for the proposed recursive formulation, and implement a sampling algorithm that is both conceptually simple and leverages many of the components of an ordinary path tracer. To demonstrate the practicality of the proposed method we showcase how it captures several existing stylizations like color mapping, cel shading, and cross-hatching, fuses NPR and PBR visuals, and allows us to explore visuals that were previously challenging under existing formulations.
authors: Rex West, Sayan Mukherjee 0006

title: 具有空间与时间一致性的超分辨率布料动画
title_en: Super-Resolution Cloth Animation with Spatial and Temporal Coherence.
abstract: 创建超分辨率布料动画,通过精细的褶皱细节细化粗糙的布料网格,面临在帧间保持空间一致性与时间一致性的挑战。本文提出一个通用框架来解决这些问题,利用两个核心模块。第一个模块交替运行模拟器与校正器。模拟器处理布料动态,而校正器校正不同分辨率下低频特征的差异。这种交替机制确保了从粗粒度模拟中快速校正空间误差,有效防止其时间传播。第二个模块执行基于网格的超分辨率以增强细节褶皱。我们将服装网格分解为重叠补丁,以适应不同风格和几何连续性。我们的方法实现了8倍的分辨率提升。通过多样化的动画示例,包括简单布料和复杂服装,展示了方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Creating super-resolution cloth animations, which refine coarse cloth meshes with fine wrinkle details, faces challenges in preserving spatial consistency and temporal coherence across frames. In this paper, we introduce a general framework to address these issues, leveraging two core modules. The first module interleaves a simulator and a corrector. The simulator handles cloth dynamics, while the corrector rectifies differences in low-frequency features across various resolutions. This interleaving ensures prompt correction of spatial errors from the coarse simulation, effectively preventing their temporal propagation. The second module performs mesh-based super-resolution for detailed wrinkle enhancements. We decompose garment meshes into overlapping patches for adaptability to various styles and geometric continuity. Our method achieves an 8× improvement in resolution for cloth animations. We showcase the effectiveness of our method through diverse animation examples, including simple cloth pieces and intricate garments.
authors: Jiawang Yu, Zhendong Wang 0001

title: 基于隐式中轴线的曲面填充曲线流
title_en: Surface-Filling Curve Flows via Implicit Medial Axes.
abstract: 我们提出了一种快速、稳健且用户可控的算法,用于生成曲面填充曲线。我们通过简单稀疏能量的梯度流计算这些曲线,使我们的方法比以往的工作快几个数量级。我们的算法对输入曲面的拓扑结构和分辨率做出最小化假设,从而提高了鲁棒性。我们的框架提供了可调节参数以引导输出曲线的形状,使其非常适合交互式设计应用。
abstract_en: We introduce a fast, robust, and user-controllable algorithm to generate surface-filling curves. We compute these curves through the gradient flow of a simple sparse energy, making our method several orders of magnitude faster than previous works. Our algorithm makes minimal assumptions on the topology and resolution of the input surface, achieving improved robustness. Our framework provides tuneable parameters that guide the shape of the output curve, making it ideal for interactive design applications.
authors: Yuta Noma, Silvia Sellán, Nicholas Sharp, Karan Singh 0004, Alec Jacobson

title: TIP-Editor:一种同时遵循文本提示和图像提示的精确三维编辑器
title_en: TIP-Editor: An Accurate 3D Editor Following Both Text-Prompts And Image-Prompts.
abstract: 基于文本的三维场景编辑因其便捷性和用户友好性受到了广泛关注。然而,现有方法仍因文本描述的固有局限性而缺乏对编辑结果指定外观和位置的精确控制。为此,我们提出了一种三维场景编辑框架TIP-Editor,该框架可接受文本提示、图像提示和三维边界框以指定编辑区域。通过图像提示,用户可以便捷地补充文本描述,指定目标内容的详细外观/风格,从而实现对外观的精确控制。具体而言,TIP-Editor采用分步的二维个性化策略,更好地学习现有场景和参考图像的表示,在此过程中提出定位损失以鼓励符合边界框指定的正确物体放置。此外,TIP-Editor采用显式且灵活的三维高斯点云(GS)作为三维表示,便于局部编辑同时保持背景不变。大量实验结果表明,TIP-Editor在指定边界框区域内能够根据文本和图像提示进行精确编辑,在编辑质量与提示对齐度方面均优于基线方法,且定性与定量结果均表现出色。
abstract_en: Text-driven 3D scene editing has gained significant attention owing to its convenience and user-friendliness. However, existing methods still lack accurate control of the specified appearance and location of the editing result due to the inherent limitations of the text description. To this end, we propose a 3D scene editing framework, TIP-Editor, that accepts both text and image prompts and a 3D bounding box to specify the editing region. With the image prompt, users can conveniently specify the detailed appearance/style of the target content in complement to the text description, enabling accurate control of the appearance. Specifically, TIP-Editor employs a stepwise 2D personalization strategy to better learn the representation of the existing scene and the reference image, in which a localization loss is proposed to encourage correct object placement as specified by the bounding box. Additionally, TIP-Editor utilizes explicit and flexible 3D Gaussian splatting (GS) as the 3D representation to facilitate local editing while keeping the background unchanged. Extensive experiments have demonstrated that TIP-Editor conducts accurate editing following the text and image prompts in the specified bounding box region, consistently outperforming the baselines in editing quality, and the alignment to the prompts, qualitatively and quantitatively.
authors: Jingyu Zhuang, Di Kang, Yan-Pei Cao, Guanbin Li, Liang Lin, Ying Shan

title: 面向目标的逆蒙特卡洛渲染图像去噪
title_en: Target-Aware Image Denoising for Inverse Monte Carlo Rendering.
abstract: 基于物理的可微渲染技术允许对渲染输入(即场景参数)进行精确的光传输模拟求导,从而通过迭代优化推断场景参数,例如照片或合成图像。然而,这种逆蒙特卡洛渲染继承了蒙特卡洛积分的基本问题,即噪声,导致优化收敛缓慢。解决此类噪声的一种有吸引力的方法是利用图像去噪器提升优化收敛性。不幸的是,直接采用为普通渲染场景设计的现有图像去噪器可能因去噪偏差导致优化陷入非期望的局部极小值。这促使我们重新构建一种专门用于逆渲染的新型图像去噪器。与现有图像去噪器不同,我们通过考虑目标图像(即逆渲染中的特定信息)进行去噪。对于我们的目标感知去噪方法,我们利用目标通过线性回归技术确定去噪权重。我们证明,我们的去噪器能够通过多样化的测试集,使逆渲染优化鲁棒地推断场景参数。
abstract_en: Physically based differentiable rendering allows an accurate light transport simulation to be differentiated with respect to the rendering input, i.e., scene parameters, and it enables inferring scene parameters from target images, e.g., photos or synthetic images, via an iterative optimization. However, this inverse Monte Carlo rendering inherits the fundamental problem of the Monte Carlo integration, i.e., noise, resulting in a slow optimization convergence. An appealing approach to addressing such noise is exploiting an image denoiser to improve optimization convergence. Unfortunately, the direct adoption of existing image denoisers designed for ordinary rendering scenarios can drive the optimization into undesirable local minima due to denoising bias. It motivates us to reformulate a new image denoiser specialized for inverse rendering. Unlike existing image denoisers, we conduct our denoising by considering the target images, i.e., specific information in inverse rendering. For our target-aware denoising, we determine our denoising weights via a linear regression technique using the target. We demonstrate that our denoiser enables inverse rendering optimization to infer scene parameters robustly through a diverse set of tests.
authors: Jeongmin Gu, Jonghee Back, Sung-Eui Yoon, Bochang Moon

title: 基于循环Transformer模块的时序稳定Metropolis光传输去噪方法
title_en: Temporally Stable Metropolis Light Transport Denoising using Recurrent Transformer Blocks.
abstract: Metropolis光传输(MLT)是一种全球光照算法,以其在渲染复杂场景和复杂光路方面的卓越表现而闻名。然而,MLT方法在图像中倾向于产生不可预测的相关性伪影,这会引入动画渲染中的视觉不一致性。这一缺陷也使得在保持时间稳定性的同时对MLT渲染结果进行去噪变得具有挑战性。我们采用现代学习方法解决这一问题,构建了一个结合循环连接与前沿视觉Transformer架构的序列去噪器。我们证明,我们的复杂去噪器能够持续提升具有复杂光路的MLT渲染结果的质量和时间稳定性。我们的方法在需要高采样数的复杂场景渲染中具有高效性和可扩展性。
abstract_en: Metropolis Light Transport (MLT) is a global illumination algorithm that is well-known for rendering challenging scenes with intricate light paths. However, MLT methods tend to produce unpredictable correlation artifacts in images, which can introduce visual inconsistencies for animation rendering. This drawback also makes it challenging to denoise MLT renderings while maintaining temporal stability. We tackle this issue with modern learning-based methods and build a sequence denoiser combining the recurrent connections with the cutting-edge vision transformer architecture. We demonstrate that our sophisticated denoiser can consistently improve the quality and temporal stability of MLT renderings with difficult light paths. Our method is efficient and scalable for complex scene renderings that require high sample counts.
authors: Chuhao Chen 0003, Yuze He, Tzu-Mao Li

title: TensoSDF:面向粗糙度感知的张量表示的鲁棒几何与材质重建
title_en: TensoSDF: Roughness-aware Tensorial Representation for Robust Geometry and Material Reconstruction.
abstract: 从多视角图像中重建具有真实材质的物体极具挑战性,因为该问题高度病态。尽管神经重建方法展现出卓越的重建能力,但它们通常针对特定材质(如漫反射或镜面材质)设计。为此,我们提出了一种新的框架用于鲁棒的几何与材质重建,其中几何结构通过张量表示编码的隐式符号距离场(SDF)进行表达,即TensoSDF。我们方法的核心在于粗糙度感知的辐射度与反射场融合,这使得能够鲁棒地重建任意反射材质的物体。此外,张量表示增强了重建表面的几何细节并减少了训练时间。最后,我们通过显式网格进行材料估计以实现高效的相交计算,并通过隐式SDF进行精确表示。因此,我们的方法能够实现更鲁棒的几何重建,在重光照质量方面超越先前工作,并将训练时间减少50%、推理时间减少70%。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/Riga2/TensoSDF获取。
abstract_en: Reconstructing objects with realistic materials from multi-view images is problematic, since it is highly ill-posed. Although the neural reconstruction approaches have exhibited impressive reconstruction ability, they are designed for objects with specific materials (e.g., diffuse or specular materials). To this end, we propose a novel framework for robust geometry and material reconstruction, where the geometry is expressed with the implicit signed distance field (SDF) encoded by a tensorial representation, namely TensoSDF. At the core of our method is the roughness-aware incorporation of the radiance and reflectance fields, which enables a robust reconstruction of objects with arbitrary reflective materials. Furthermore, the tensorial representation enhances geometry details in the reconstructed surface and reduces the training time. Finally, we estimate the materials using an explicit mesh for efficient intersection computation and an implicit SDF for accurate representation. Consequently, our method can achieve more robust geometry reconstruction, outperform the previous works in terms of relighting quality, and reduce 50% training times and 70% inference time. Codes and datasets are available at https://github.com/Riga2/TensoSDF.
authors: Jia Li, Lu Wang 0007, Lei Zhang 0006, Beibei Wang 0002

title: 基于多尺度侵蚀的地形增强
title_en: Terrain Amplification using Multi Scale Erosion.
abstract: 高分辨率地形建模是虚拟世界创建中的长期挑战。本文聚焦于通过多尺度方法将低分辨率输入地形放大为具有复杂模式的高分辨率、水文一致地形。我们的框架结合了物理启发的侵蚀模型与不同尺度的控制,既保证了侵蚀地标的一致性,又实现了物理基础侵蚀模拟与多尺度程序化建模之间的桥梁。该方法采用快速准确的多尺度模拟近似,包括热侵蚀、流功率侵蚀和沉积等不同尺度的模拟,以获得多种效果。我们的方法为景观设计师提供了放大山脉和山谷并保持细节一致的工具。
abstract_en: Modeling high-resolution terrains is a perennial challenge in the creation of virtual worlds. In this paper, we focus on the amplification of a low-resolution input terrain into a high-resolution, hydrologically consistent terrain featuring complex patterns by a multi-scale approach. Our framework combines the best of both worlds, relying on physics-inspired erosion models producing consistent erosion landmarks and introducing control at different scales, thus bridging the gap between physics-based erosion simulations and multi-scale procedural modeling. The method uses a fast and accurate approximation of different simulations, including thermal, stream power erosion and deposition performed at different scales to obtain a range of effects. Our approach provides landscape designers with tools for amplifying mountain ranges and valleys with consistent details.
authors: Hugo Schott, Eric Galin, Eric Guérin, Axel Paris, Adrien Peytavie

title: 基于神经路径表示的文本到向量生成
title_en: Text-to-Vector Generation with Neural Path Representation.
abstract: 矢量图形因其可缩放性和分层特性在数字艺术领域广泛应用,深受设计师青睐。然而,矢量图形的创建与编辑需要创造力和设计专业知识,是一项耗时的任务。近年来,文本到矢量(T2V)生成技术的进步旨在使这一过程更加便捷。然而,现有T2V方法直接优化矢量图形路径的控制点,常因缺乏几何约束导致路径交叉或锯齿化。为克服这些局限性,我们提出了一种新颖的神经路径表示方法,通过设计双分支变分自编码器(VAE),从序列和图像模态中学习路径潜在空间。通过优化神经路径的组合,我们能够在生成SVG中融入几何约束同时保持表达能力。此外,我们引入了两阶段路径优化方法以提升生成SVG的视觉和拓扑质量。第一阶段利用预训练的文本到图像扩散模型,通过变分得分蒸馏(VSD)过程引导复杂矢量图形的初始生成。第二阶段采用分层图像矢量化策略优化图形,以实现更清晰的元素和结构。我们通过大量实验验证了方法的有效性,并展示了多种应用场景。项目页面为https://intchous.github.io/T2V-NPR。
abstract_en: Vector graphics are widely used in digital art and highly favored by designers due to their scalability and layer-wise properties. However, the process of creating and editing vector graphics requires creativity and design expertise, making it a time-consuming task. Recent advancements in text-to-vector (T2V) generation have aimed to make this process more accessible. However, existing T2V methods directly optimize control points of vector graphics paths, often resulting in intersecting or jagged paths due to the lack of geometry constraints. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel neural path representation by designing a dual-branch Variational Autoencoder (VAE) that learns the path latent space from both sequence and image modalities. By optimizing the combination of neural paths, we can incorporate geometric constraints while preserving expressivity in generated SVGs. Furthermore, we introduce a two-stage path optimization method to improve the visual and topological quality of generated SVGs. In the first stage, a pre-trained text-to-image diffusion model guides the initial generation of complex vector graphics through the Variational Score Distillation (VSD) process. In the second stage, we refine the graphics using a layer-wise image vectorization strategy to achieve clearer elements and structure. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method through extensive experiments and showcase various applications. The project page is https://intchous.github.io/T2V-NPR.
authors: Peiying Zhang 0002, Nanxuan Zhao, Jing Liao 0001

title: 人类四色视觉色彩体验与印刷理论
title_en: Theory of Human Tetrachromatic Color Experience and Printing.
abstract: 遗传学研究显示,超过50%的女性具有四色视觉基因特征,在视网膜中表达四种不同的色彩感光细胞(锥细胞)。实验室测试已确认至少存在一名功能性四色视觉者。我们假设人群中存在大量潜在的四色视觉群体,但由于视觉环境中缺乏四色视觉色彩,我们尚未意识到这一群体。本文发展了四色视觉色彩的理论与工程实践,旨在实现四色视觉色彩的制备并潜在识别野外的四色视觉。首先,我们应用d维色彩理论首次推导并计算了人类四色视觉的关键色彩结构,包括其四维物体色彩空间、三维色度空间,并预测出一个二维四色视觉色相球体。我们将该预测色相球体与熟悉的三色视觉色相圆环进行比较,拓展理论以预测高维拓扑结构如何为四色视觉者提供更丰富的色彩体验。其次,我们推导了理想四色视觉墨水集合的四反射率函数,类似于三色视觉中广为人知的CMY印刷基础。第三,我们开发了一种利用墨水笔墨水库和多通道喷墨打印平台原型化四色视觉打印机的方法。第四,我们将现有的色彩测试——敏感色相排序测试和快速等色板筛选测试——推广至高维视觉,并为野外识别和表征四色视觉开发了这些测试的变体。
abstract_en: Genetic studies indicate that more than 50% of women are genetically tetrachromatic, expressing four distinct types of color photoreceptors (cone cells) in the retina. At least one functional tetrachromat has been identified in laboratory tests. We hypothesize that there is a large latent group in the population capable of fundamentally richer color experience, but we are not yet aware of this group because of a lack of tetrachromatic colors in the visual environment. This paper develops theory and engineering practice for fabricating tetrachromatic colors and potentially identifying tetrachromatic color vision in the wild. First, we apply general d-dimensional color theory to derive and compute all the key color structures of human tetrachromacy for the first time, including its 4D space of possible object colors, 3D space of chromaticities, and yielding a predicted 2D sphere of tetrachromatic hues. We compare this predicted hue sphere to the familiar hue circle of trichromatic color, extending the theory to predict how the higher dimensional topology produces an expanded color experience for tetrachromats. Second, we derive the four reflectance functions for the ideal tetrachromatic inkset, analogous to the well-known CMY printing basis for trichromacy. Third, we develop a method for prototyping tetrachromatic printers using a library of fountain pen inks and a multi-pass inkjet printing platform. Fourth, we generalize existing color tests - sensitive hue ordering tests and rapid isochromatic plate screening tests - to higher-dimensional vision, and prototype variants of these tests for identifying and characterizing tetrachromacy in the wild.
authors: Jessica Lee, Nicholas Jennings, Varun Srivastava, Ren Ng

title: 面向视网膜渲染的运动等价物研究
title_en: Towards Motion Metamers for Foveated Rendering.
abstract: 视网膜渲染利用周边视觉空间敏感性降低的特性,在不显著降低空间质量的前提下大幅降低渲染成本。由于其优势,它已成为实时高质量虚拟现实和增强现实的关键使能技术。有趣的是,大量研究表明周边视觉的一个关键作用可能是运动检测,而视网膜渲染会降低这些区域的图像质量,这可能影响我们对运动的检测和量化能力。这一问题在沉浸式模拟中尤为关键,因为运动的检测和量化能力驱动着行动和决策。在本工作中,我们偏离当前方法,针对视网膜图形的目标进行研究,证明周边区域高频空间细节的丢失会抑制运动感知,导致速度等运动线索的低估。进一步地,受一种有趣视觉错觉的启发,我们设计了一种感知驱动的实时技术,合成可控的时空运动能量以补偿运动感知的损失。最后,我们通过用户实验验证了该方法在恢复运动线索方面有效性,且未引入明显的质量退化。
abstract_en: Foveated rendering takes advantage of the reduced spatial sensitivity in peripheral vision to greatly reduce rendering cost without noticeable spatial quality degradation. Due to its benefits, it has emerged as a key enabler for real-time high-quality virtual and augmented realities. Interestingly though, a large body of work advocates that a key role of peripheral vision may be motion detection, yet foveated rendering lowers the image quality in these regions, which may impact our ability to detect and quantify motion. The problem is critical for immersive simulations where the ability to detect and quantify movement drives actions and decisions. In this work, we diverge from the contemporary approach towards the goal of foveated graphics, and demonstrate that a loss of high-frequency spatial details in the periphery inhibits motion perception, leading to underestimating motion cues such as velocity. Furthermore, inspired by an interesting visual illusion, we design a perceptually motivated real-time technique that synthesizes controlled spatio-temporal motion energy to offset the loss in motion perception. Finally, we perform user experiments demonstrating our method's effectiveness in recovering motion cues without introducing objectionable quality degradation.
authors: Taimoor Tariq, Piotr Didyk

title: 无需训练的一致文本到图像生成
title_en: Training-Free Consistent Text-to-Image Generation.
abstract: 文本到图像模型通过允许用户通过自然语言引导图像生成过程,提供了新的创作灵活性。然而,使用这些模型在多样化的提示下一致地描绘同一主题仍面临挑战。现有方法通过微调模型来教授其描述特定用户提供的主题的新词汇,或向模型添加图像条件。这些方法需要针对每个主题进行长时间优化或大规模预训练。此外,它们在将生成图像与文本提示对齐方面存在困难,并且在描绘多个主题时面临挑战。本文提出ConsiStory,一种无需训练的方法,通过共享预训练模型的内部激活来实现一致的主题生成。我们引入了主题驱动的共享注意力模块和基于对应关系的特征注入,以促进图像间主题的一致性。此外,我们开发了在保持主题一致性的同时鼓励布局多样性的策略。我们与多种基线方法进行了比较,并在无需单次优化步骤的情况下,展示了在主题一致性和文本对齐方面的最先进性能。最后,ConsiStory可以自然扩展到多主题场景,甚至能够实现常见物体的无需训练个性化。
abstract_en: Text-to-image models offer a new level of creative flexibility by allowing users to guide the image generation process through natural language. However, using these models to consistently portray the same subject across diverse prompts remains challenging. Existing approaches fine-tune the model to teach it new words that describe specific user-provided subjects or add image conditioning to the model. These methods require lengthy persubject optimization or large-scale pre-training. Moreover, they struggle to align generated images with text prompts and face difficulties in portraying multiple subjects. Here, we present ConsiStory, a training-free approach that enables consistent subject generation by sharing the internal activations of the pretrained model. We introduce a subject-driven shared attention block and correspondence-based feature injection to promote subject consistency between images. Additionally, we develop strategies to encourage layout diversity while maintaining subject consistency. We compare ConsiStory to a range of baselines, and demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on subject consistency and text alignment, without requiring a single optimization step. Finally, ConsiStory can naturally extend to multi-subject scenarios, and even enable training-free personalization for common objects.
authors: Yoad Tewel, Omri Kaduri, Rinon Gal, Yoni Kasten, Lior Wolf, Gal Chechik, Yuval Atzmon

title: 基于潜在透明度的透明图像层扩散方法
title_en: Transparent Image Layer Diffusion using Latent Transparency.
abstract: 我们提出了一种方法,使大规模预训练的潜在扩散模型能够生成透明图像。该方法支持单个透明图像或多个透明层的生成。该方法学习一种"潜在透明度",将alpha通道透明度编码到预训练潜在扩散模型的潜在流形中。通过将添加的透明度作为潜在偏移量进行调节,在对预训练模型原始潜在分布进行最小改动的前提下,保持大规模扩散模型的可投入生产质量。因此,通过使用调整后的潜在空间对任何潜在扩散模型进行微调,即可将其转换为透明图像生成器。我们采用人机协作收集方案收集了100万组透明图像层配对数据进行模型训练。实验表明,潜在透明度可应用于不同的开源图像生成器,或适应各种条件控制系统,实现前景/背景条件下的层生成、联合层生成、层内容结构控制等应用。用户研究发现,在大多数情况下(97%)用户更倾向于我们的原生生成透明内容,而非以往的临时解决方案(如先生成再进行遮罩)。用户还报告我们的生成透明图像质量与Adobe Stock等商业透明素材相当。
abstract_en: We present an approach enabling large-scale pretrained latent diffusion models to generate transparent images. The method allows generation of single transparent images or of multiple transparent layers. The method learns a "latent transparency" that encodes alpha channel transparency into the latent manifold of a pretrained latent diffusion model. It preserves the production-ready quality of the large diffusion model by regulating the added transparency as a latent offset with minimal changes to the original latent distribution of the pretrained model. In this way, any latent diffusion model can be converted into a transparent image generator by finetuning it with the adjusted latent space. We train the model with 1M transparent image layer pairs collected using a human-in-the-loop collection scheme. We show that latent transparency can be applied to different open source image generators, or be adapted to various conditional control systems to achieve applications like foreground/background-conditioned layer generation, joint layer generation, structural control of layer contents, etc. A user study finds that in most cases (97%) users prefer our natively generated transparent content over previous ad-hoc solutions such as generating and then matting. Users also report the quality of our generated transparent images is comparable to real commercial transparent assets like Adobe Stock.
authors: Lvmin Zhang, Maneesh Agrawala

title: 从VR头显中通用面部编码的编解码头像
title_en: Universal Facial Encoding of Codec Avatars from VR Headsets.
abstract: 在虚拟现实(VR)中,忠实的实时面部动画对于化身介导的远程存在感至关重要。为模拟真实的交流,化身动画需要具备高效性和准确性:能够在数毫秒内捕捉极端和微妙的表情,以维持自然对话的节奏。面部的斜视和不完整视角、头显佩戴的差异性以及环境引起的光照变化是泛化到未见过的面部的特殊挑战。本文提出了一种方法,可从消费级VR头显上的头戴式摄像头(HMCs)实时生成逼真头像的动画。我们提出了一种基于跨视角重建目标的自监督学习方法,实现了对未见过用户的泛化。我们提出了一种轻量级表情校准机制,在几乎不增加运行效率成本的前提下提升准确性。我们还提出了一种改进的参数化方法,用于精确生成地面真实数据,增强了对环境变化的鲁棒性。所得到的系统能够实时生成未见过用户佩戴VR头显时的准确面部动画。我们将该方法与先前的面部编码方法进行比较,结果在定量指标和定性结果方面均实现了显著改进。
abstract_en: Faithful real-time facial animation is essential for avatar-mediated telepresence in Virtual Reality (VR). To emulate authentic communication, avatar animation needs to be efficient and accurate: able to capture both extreme and subtle expressions within a few milliseconds to sustain the rhythm of natural conversations. The oblique and incomplete views of the face, variability in the donning of headsets, and illumination variation due to the environment are some of the unique challenges in generalization to unseen faces. In this paper, we present a method that can animate a photorealistic avatar in realtime from head-mounted cameras (HMCs) on a consumer VR headset. We present a self-supervised learning approach, based on a cross-view reconstruction objective, that enables generalization to unseen users. We present a lightweight expression calibration mechanism that increases accuracy with minimal additional cost to run-time efficiency. We present an improved parameterization for precise ground-truth generation that provides robustness to environmental variation. The resulting system produces accurate facial animation for unseen users wearing VR headsets in realtime. We compare our approach to prior face-encoding methods demonstrating significant improvements in both quantitative metrics and qualitative results.
authors: Shaojie Bai, Te-Li Wang, Chenghui Li, Akshay Venkatesh, Tomas Simon, Chen Cao 0001, Gabriel Schwartz, Jason M. Saragih, Yaser Sheikh, Shih-En Wei

title: 科学可视化中的变分特征提取
title_en: Variational Feature Extraction in Scientific Visualization.
abstract: 在许多科学领域,对更高网格分辨率的追求导致了严重的可扩展性问题。特征提取是一种常用的手段,用于将密集场中的信息量减少到几何原语,从而进一步实现定量分析。常见的特征示例包括等线、极值线或涡旋核心线。由于观测现象的复杂性增加,或在数据离散化问题的情况下,教科书特征定义的直接应用往往不足。因此,从空间数据中提取特征通常需要大量的预处理或后处理,以清理结果或包含关于所关注特征的额外领域知识。这种特征的单独预处理或后处理不仅导致次优且不可比较的解决方案,还导致不同应用领域中出现许多专门的特征提取算法。在本文中,我们建立了一种数学语言,不仅涵盖常用的特征定义,还提供可在不同应用领域之间应用的一组正则化项。通过使用变分法的语言,我们将特征视为变分极小化器,可以根据需要进行组合和正则化。我们的公式不仅将现有特征定义作为特例涵盖,还为新的特征定义开辟了路径。本工作为许多新的研究方向奠定了基础,涉及形式定义、数据表示和数值提取算法。
abstract_en: Across many scientific disciplines, the pursuit of even higher grid resolutions leads to a severe scalability problem in scientific computing. Feature extraction is a commonly chosen approach to reduce the amount of information from dense fields down to geometric primitives that further enable a quantitative analysis. Examples of common features are isolines, extremal lines, or vortex corelines. Due to the rising complexity of the observed phenomena, or in the event of discretization issues with the data, a straightforward application of textbook feature definitions is unfortunately insufficient. Thus, feature extraction from spatial data often requires substantial pre- or post-processing to either clean up the results or to include additional domain knowledge about the feature in question. Such a separate pre- or post-processing of features not only leads to suboptimal and incomparable solutions, it also results in many specialized feature extraction algorithms arising in the different application domains. In this paper, we establish a mathematical language that not only encompasses commonly used feature definitions, it also provides a set of regularizers that can be applied across the bounds of individual application domains. By using the language of variational calculus, we treat features as variational minimizers, which can be combined and regularized as needed. Our formulation not only encompasses existing feature definitions as special case, it also opens the path to novel feature definitions. This work lays the foundations for many new research directions regarding formal definitions, data representations, and numerical extraction algorithms.
authors: Nico Daßler, Tobias Günther

title: 顶点块下降法
title_en: Vertex Block Descent.
abstract: 我们提出了一种顶点块下降法,该方法通过顶点级高斯-赛德尔迭代,为隐式欧拉的变分形式提供了一种块坐标下降解法。该方法通过局部顶点位置更新,在最大化并行性的前提下实现全局变分能量的减少。这形成了一种物理求解器,能够在无条件稳定性和卓越计算性能下实现数值收敛。通过简单限制迭代次数,该方法还能在保持稳定性及优越收敛速率的同时适应给定的计算预算。我们在弹性体动力学的背景下展示并评估了该方法,详细介绍了所有关键组件,并证明其优于其他技术。此外,我们还讨论并展示了该方法在其他模拟系统(包括基于粒子的模拟和刚体)中的应用示例。
abstract_en: We introduce vertex block descent, a block coordinate descent solution for the variational form of implicit Euler through vertex-level Gauss-Seidel iterations. It operates with local vertex position updates that achieve reductions in global variational energy with maximized parallelism. This forms a physics solver that can achieve numerical convergence with unconditional stability and exceptional computation performance. It can also fit in a given computation budget by simply limiting the iteration count while maintaining its stability and superior convergence rate. We present and evaluate our method in the context of elastic body dynamics, providing details of all essential components and showing that it outperforms alternative techniques. In addition, we discuss and show examples of how our method can be used for other simulation systems, including particle-based simulations and rigid bodies.
authors: Anka He Chen, Ziheng Liu, Yin Yang 0002, Cem Yuksel

title: 沃金·罗宾:基于罗宾边界条件的星形行走方法
title_en: Walkin' Robin: Walk on Stars with Robin Boundary Conditions.
abstract: 大量科学与工程应用需要求解涉及椭圆型偏微分方程(如拉普拉斯方程或泊松方程)的边值问题(BVPs),这些方程定义在几何复杂域上。我们开发了一种蒙特卡洛方法,用于求解具有任意一阶线性边界条件(狄利克雷、诺伊曼和罗宾边界条件)的此类BVPs。该方法通过对星形行走(WoSt)算法进行少量修改,直接推广了此前仅能处理前两种边界条件的算法。与传统数值方法不同,WoSt无需有限元网格划分或全局求解。类似蒙特卡洛渲染,它通过在BVP域内模拟随机行走于星形区域的光线交集和距离查询,计算点wise解估计。为确保在罗宾边界条件下WoSt产生有界方差估计,我们证明只需修改星形区域尺寸的选择方式即可。与替代的网格自由方法(如边界行走算法)相比,我们的推广WoSt算法将估计误差降低了多个数量级。我们还开发了双向和边界值缓存策略以进一步降低估计误差。该算法易于并行化,几何细节增加时具有次线性扩展性,并支持渐进式和视角依赖的评估。
abstract_en: Numerous scientific and engineering applications require solutions to boundary value problems (BVPs) involving elliptic partial differential equations, such as the Laplace or Poisson equations, on geometrically intricate domains. We develop a Monte Carlo method for solving such BVPs with arbitrary first-order linear boundary conditions---Dirichlet, Neumann, and Robin. Our method directly generalizes the walk on stars (WoSt) algorithm, which previously tackled only the first two types of boundary conditions, with a few simple modifications. Unlike conventional numerical methods, WoSt does not need finite element meshing or global solves. Similar to Monte Carlo rendering, it instead computes pointwise solution estimates by simulating random walks along star-shaped regions inside the BVP domain, using efficient ray-intersection and distance queries. To ensure WoSt produces bounded-variance estimates in the presence of Robin boundary conditions, we show that it is sufficient to modify how WoSt selects the size of these star-shaped regions. Our generalized WoSt algorithm reduces estimation error by orders of magnitude relative to alternative grid-free methods such as the walk on boundary algorithm. We also develop bidirectional and boundary value caching strategies to further reduce estimation error. Our algorithm is trivial to parallelize, scales sublinearly with increasing geometric detail, and enables progressive and view-dependent evaluation.
authors: Bailey Miller, Rohan Sawhney, Keenan Crane, Ioannis Gkioulekas

title: X-SLAM: 基于复步有限差分法的可扩展稠密SLAM任务感知优化
title_en: X-SLAM: Scalable Dense SLAM for Task-aware Optimization using CSFD.
abstract: 我们提出X-SLAM,一种实时稠密可微分SLAM系统,利用复步有限差分法(CSFD)高效计算数值导数,无需构建大规模计算图。我们的方法核心是将SLAM过程视为可微函数,通过复数域内的泰勒级数展开计算关键SLAM参数的导数。该系统不仅支持实时梯度计算,还可进行高阶导数计算,从而利用高阶优化器实现更高精度和更快收敛。基于X-SLAM,我们实现了两个重要任务的端到端优化框架:广域室外场景的相机重定位和复杂室内环境的主动机器人扫描。在公开基准和复杂真实场景的综合评估表明,通过任务感知优化显著提升了相机重定位精度和机器人导航效率。代码和数据可在https://gapszju.github.io/X-SLAM获取。
abstract_en: We present X-SLAM, a real-time dense differentiable SLAM system that leverages the complex-step finite difference (CSFD) method for efficient calculation of numerical derivatives, bypassing the need for a large-scale computational graph. The key to our approach is treating the SLAM process as a differentiable function, enabling the calculation of the derivatives of important SLAM parameters through Taylor series expansion within the complex domain. Our system allows for the real-time calculation of not just the gradient, but also higher-order differentiation. This facilitates the use of high-order optimizers to achieve better accuracy and faster convergence. Building on X-SLAM, we implemented end-to-end optimization frameworks for two important tasks: camera relocalization in wide outdoor scenes and active robotic scanning in complex indoor environments. Comprehensive evaluations on public benchmarks and intricate real scenes underscore the improvements in the accuracy of camera relocalization and the efficiency of robotic navigation achieved through our task-aware optimization. The code and data are available at https://gapszju.github.io/X-SLAM.
authors: Zhexi Peng, Yin Yang 0002, Tianjia Shao, Chenfanfu Jiang, Kun Zhou 0001

title: ZeroGrads:为非可微图形学习局部代理模型
title_en: ZeroGrads: Learning Local Surrogates for Non-Differentiable Graphics.
abstract: 基于梯度的优化方法在图形学中已广泛应用,但不幸的是无法应用于存在未定义或零梯度的问题。为解决此问题,可通过手动替换损失函数为具有相似极小值但可微的"替代函数"。我们提出的框架ZeroGrads通过学习目标函数的神经网络近似来自动化这一过程,从而能够对任意黑盒图形管线进行微分。我们采用目标函数的主动平滑版本进行替代函数训练,并通过鼓励局部性,将替代函数的容量集中在当前训练回合的关键部分。拟合过程在线进行,与参数优化同步完成,且为自监督学习,无需预计算数据或预训练模型。由于采样目标函数成本高昂(需完整渲染或模拟器运行),我们设计了一种高效采样方案,实现可管理的运行时间并保持竞争力的性能,且几乎无额外开销。我们展示了在图形学中优化多种非凸、非可微黑盒问题的能力,例如渲染中的可见性、程序建模中的离散参数空间或物理驱动动画中的最优控制。与其它无导数算法相比,我们的方法在更高维度问题上具有良好的扩展性,我们在包含高达35k相互关联变量的问题上进行了验证。
abstract_en: Gradient-based optimization is now ubiquitous across graphics, but unfortunately can not be applied to problems with undefined or zero gradients. To circumvent this issue, the loss function can be manually replaced by a "surrogate" that has similar minima but is differentiable. Our proposed framework, ZeroGrads, automates this process by learning a neural approximation of the objective function, which in turn can be used to differentiate through arbitrary black-box graphics pipelines. We train the surrogate on an actively smoothed version of the objective and encourage locality, focusing the surrogate's capacity on what matters at the current training episode. The fitting is performed online, alongside the parameter optimization, and self-supervised, without pre-computed data or pre-trained models. As sampling the objective is expensive (it requires a full rendering or simulator run), we devise an efficient sampling scheme that allows for tractable run-times and competitive performance at little overhead. We demonstrate optimizing diverse non-convex, non-differentiable black-box problems in graphics, such as visibility in rendering, discrete parameter spaces in procedural modelling or optimal control in physics-driven animation. In contrast to other derivative-free algorithms, our approach scales well to higher dimensions, which we demonstrate on problems with up to 35k interlinked variables.
authors: Michael Fischer 0011, Tobias Ritschel 0001

title: fVDB:面向稀疏、大规模和高性能空间智能的深度学习框架
title_en: fVDB : A Deep-Learning Framework for Sparse, Large Scale, and High Performance Spatial Intelligence.
abstract: 我们提出了fVDB,这是一个面向大规模三维数据的新型GPU优化深度学习框架。fVDB提供了一套完整的可微分原语,用于构建三维学习中常见任务(如卷积、池化、注意力、光线追踪、网格生成等)的深度学习架构。fVDB在不损失效率的前提下,提供了比现有框架更丰富的功能集(原语和运算符):我们的运算符在性能上与其它功能范围较窄的框架相比具有竞争力。此外,fVDB能够处理比以往工作更大规模和空间分辨率的数据集,同时在小输入情况下提供具有竞争力的内存占用。为了实现这种多功能性与性能的结合,fVDB依赖于单一的新型VDB索引网格加速结构,并结合了多项关键技术创新,包括GPU加速的稀疏网格构建、使用TensorCores的卷积、基于分层数字微分分析算法(HDDA)的快速光线追踪内核,以及锯齿张量。我们的框架完全集成于PyTorch,实现了与现有流程的互操作性,并在大规模点云分割、高分辨率三维生成建模、无界尺度神经辐射场以及大规模点云重建等代表性任务中验证了其有效性。
abstract_en: We present fVDB, a novel GPU-optimized framework for deep learning on large-scale 3D data. fVDB provides a complete set of differentiable primitives to build deep learning architectures for common tasks in 3D learning such as convolution, pooling, attention, ray-tracing, meshing, etc. fVDB simultaneously provides a much larger feature set (primitives and operators) than established frameworks with no loss in efficiency: our operators match or exceed the performance of other frameworks with narrower scope. Furthermore, fVDB can process datasets with much larger footprint and spatial resolution than prior works, while providing a competitive memory footprint on small inputs. To achieve this combination of versatility and performance, fVDB relies on a single novel VDB index grid acceleration structure paired with several key innovations including GPU accelerated sparse grid construction, convolution using tensorcores, fast ray tracing kernels using a Hierarchical Digital Differential Analyzer algorithm (HDDA), and jagged tensors. Our framework is fully integrated with PyTorch enabling interoperability with existing pipelines, and we demonstrate its effectiveness on a number of representative tasks such as large-scale point-cloud segmentation, high resolution 3D generative modeling, unbounded scale Neural Radiance Fields, and large-scale point cloud reconstruction.
authors: Francis Williams, Jiahui Huang, Jonathan Swartz, Gergely Klár, Vijay Thakkar, Matthew Cong, Xuanchi Ren, Ruilong Li, Clement Fuji-Tsang, Sanja Fidler, Eftychios Sifakis, Ken Museth

title: 3DGH: 基于可组合头发与面部的三维头生成
title_en: 3DGH: 3D Head Generation with Composable Hair and Face.
abstract: 我们提出3DGH,这是一种用于生成具有可组合头发和面部组件的三维人头的无条件生成模型。与以往将头发和面部建模纠缠在一起的工作不同,我们提出通过一种基于模板的三维高斯点云新型数据表示方法将二者分离,其中引入可变形头发几何结构以捕捉不同发型间的几何变化。基于这种数据表示,我们设计了一种基于三维生成对抗网络(3D GAN)的架构,包含双生成器并采用交叉注意力机制建模头发与面部的固有相关性。模型通过精心设计的目标函数在合成渲染图像上进行训练,以稳定训练过程并促进头发-面部分离。我们进行了大量实验验证3DGH的设计选择,并通过与多个先进3D GAN方法的对比,从定性和定量两个方面评估其性能,证明了其在无条件全头图像生成和可组合三维发型编辑方面的有效性。更多细节请访问我们的项目页面:https://c-he.github.io/projects/3dgh/
abstract_en: We present 3DGH, an unconditional generative model for 3D human heads with composable hair and face components. Unlike previous work that entangles the modeling of hair and face, we propose to separate them using a novel data representation with template-based 3D Gaussian Splatting, in which deformable hair geometry is introduced to capture the geometric variations across different hairstyles. Based on this data representation, we design a 3D GAN-based architecture with dual generators and employ a cross-attention mechanism to model the inherent correlation between hair and face. The model is trained on synthetic renderings using carefully designed objectives to stabilize training and facilitate hair-face separation. We conduct extensive experiments to validate the design choice of 3DGH, and evaluate it both qualitatively and quantitatively by comparing with several state-of-the-art 3D GAN methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in unconditional full-head image synthesis and composable 3D hairstyle editing. More details will be available on our project page: https://c-he.github.io/projects/3dgh/.
authors: Chengan He, Junxuan Li, Tobias Kirschstein, Artem Sevastopolsky, Shunsuke Saito, Qingyang Tan, Javier Romero 0002, Chen Cao 0001, Holly E. Rushmeier, Giljoo Nam

title: 用于湍流边界层流动动力学模拟的混合近壁模型
title_en: A Hybrid Near-wall Model for Kinetic Simulation of Turbulent Boundary Layer Flows.
abstract: 湍流边界层代表流体流动中最复杂但引人入胜的现象之一。尽管边界附近各种相互作用尺度的剪切涡旋生成与演变具有视觉吸引力,但通过模拟正确再现此类现象尤其在高雷诺数条件下极具挑战性。实用方法通常结合经验壁面建模以显著降低计算成本同时保持物理一致性。然而,这些方法主要适用于稳态流求解器。涉及动态流固交互的复杂场景及其在生成时变流动现象中的应用必然需要非稳态流求解器,但底层壁面建模技术存在不精确性,导致近壁涡旋形成方式不同,尤其对于基于笛卡尔网格的高效格子玻尔兹曼求解器而言。本文提出一种新型混合近壁模型,用于格子玻尔兹曼求解器,该模型受边界层分离程度测量启发,可以简单高效的方式处理湍流边界层流动。我们的模型包含宏观与介观代数模型,协同作用使低耗散格子玻尔兹曼求解器自然形成适当的湍流边界层。通过利用多分辨率技术,可获得精确的模拟结果。我们的模型参数化以近似可能影响边界层分布的固体表面不同物理属性,并可在不同网格分辨率下模拟可比的边界层流动行为。通过与实验数据和可视化结果对比,进行了严格的基准测试以验证模型在不同网格分辨率下的有效性。我们展示了新模型在促进计算设计和生成视觉动画中的应用,辅以具体实例与实际实验装置及摄影图像的对比。所有演示均证实了我们的求解器在使用相对较粗的网格分辨率进行模拟时仍能保持物理一致性。
abstract_en: Turbulent boundary layer represents one of the most complex but interesting phenomena in fluid flows. While the generation and alteration of sheared vortices in various interacting scales near the boundary are visually appealing, it is difficult to correctly replicate such phenomena by simulation, especially at high Reynolds numbers. Practical methodologies typically incorporate empirical wall modeling to substantially curtail the computational expenses while retaining physical consistency. Nevertheless, these are predominantly applicable to steady-state flow solvers. While complex scenarios involving dynamic fluid-solid interaction and its application to create time-dependent flow phenomena invariably necessitate unsteady flow solvers, the underlying wall modeling techniques are imprecise, leading to a different formation of near-wall vortices, especially for the highly efficient lattice Boltzmann solver operating on Cartesian grids. In this paper, we propose a novel hybrid near-wall model for the lattice Boltzmann solver, which can handle turbulent boundary layer flows in a simple and efficient manner, inspired by measuring the degree of boundary layer separation. Our model comprises both macroscopic and mesoscopic algebraic models, which collaborate to let the low dissipation lattice Boltzmann solver naturally form the turbulent boundary layer appropriately. By leveraging the multi-resolution technique, accurate simulation outcomes can be obtained. Our model is parameterized to approximate different physical attributes of the solid surface that can potentially influence the boundary layer distribution, and comparable boundary layer flow behaviors can be simulated at various grid resolutions. Rigorous benchmark tests are carried out to validate our model at different grid resolutions by comparing with experimental data and visualizations. We showcase the applications of our new model in both facilitating computational design and generating visual animations, accompanied by specific examples and comparisons with actual experimental setups and photographic images. All demonstrations affirm the physical consistency of our solver even when simulated with a relatively coarse grid resolution.
authors: Mengyun Liu, Kai Bai, Xiaopei Liu

title: 一种用于模拟光学外差检测的蒙特卡洛渲染框架
title_en: A Monte Carlo Rendering Framework for Simulating Optical Heterodyne Detection.
abstract: 光学外差检测(OHD)利用相干光和光学干涉技术(图1-(A))提取物理参数,如速度或距离,这些参数编码在光的频率调制中。与非相干检测方法(如飞行时间激光雷达)相比,OHD具有更高的信噪比,已成为需要高灵敏度的应用(如自主导航、大气传感和生物医学速度测量)的关键技术。然而,当前的OHD模拟工具局限于特定应用,依赖领域特定的设置,如受限的反射函数、场景配置或单次反射假设,这限制了其适用性。在本工作中,我们引入了一种灵活且通用的频域OHD模拟框架。我们证明经典基于辐射度的路径积分公式可以适应并扩展到频域模拟OHD测量。这使我们能够利用现有蒙特卡洛路径追踪技术丰富的建模和采样能力。我们的公式在结构上与瞬态渲染相似,但操作于频域并考虑多普勒效应(图1-(B))。尽管存在用于非相干(强度)检测方法多普勒效应的模拟器,但它们大多不适用于模拟OHD。我们通过微表面解释表明,这两种多普勒成像技术捕捉不同的物理量,因此需要不同的模拟框架。我们通过将模拟结果与真实世界捕获数据进行定性比较,验证了模拟框架的正确性和预测能力,涵盖三种不同的OHD应用——调频连续波激光雷达(FMCW lidar)、血流速度测量和风多普勒激光雷达(图1-(C))。
abstract_en: Optical heterodyne detection (OHD) employs coherent light and optical interference techniques (Fig. 1-(A)) to extract physical parameters, such as velocity or distance, which are encoded in the frequency modulation of the light. With its superior signal-to-noise ratio compared to incoherent detection methods, such as time-of-flight lidar, OHD has become integral to applications requiring high sensitivity, including autonomous navigation, atmospheric sensing, and biomedical velocimetry. However, current simulation tools for OHD focus narrowly on specific applications, relying on domain-specific settings like restricted reflection functions, scene configurations, or single-bounce assumptions, which limit their applicability. In this work, we introduce a flexible and general framework for spectral-domain simulation of OHD. We demonstrate that classical radiometry-based path integral formulation can be adapted and extended to simulate the OHD measurements in the spectral domain. This enables us to leverage the rich modeling and sampling capabilities of existing Monte Carlo path tracing techniques. Our formulation shares structural similarities with transient rendering but operates in the spectral domain and accounts for the Doppler effect (Fig. 1-(B)). While simulators for the Doppler effect in incoherent (intensity) detection methods exist, they are largely not suitable to simulate OHD. We use a microsurface interpretation to show that these two Doppler imaging techniques capture different physical quantities and thus need different simulation frameworks. We validate the correctness and predictive power of our simulation framework by qualitatively comparing the simulations with real-world captured data for three different OHD applications—FMCW lidar, blood flow velocimetry, and wind Doppler lidar (Fig. 1-(C)).
authors: Juhyeon Kim, Craig Benko, Magnus Wrenninge, Ryusuke Villemin, Zeb W. Barber, Wojciech Jarosz, Adithya Pediredla

title: Adaptive Algebraic Reuse of Reordering in Cholesky Factorizations with Dynamic Sparsity Patterns.
title_en: Adaptive Algebraic Reuse of Reordering in Cholesky Factorizations with Dynamic Sparsity Patterns.
abstract: 我们引入了Parth,一种针对具有动态稀疏模式(例如物理模拟中的接触或几何处理中的局部重网格化)的稀疏Cholesky求解器的填充减少排序方法。Parth通过在稀疏模式表现出时间一致性时选择性地重用填充减少排序,避免通过局部化动态稀疏变化对排序向量的影响来执行完整的符号分析。我们在来自物理模拟和几何处理应用的超过175,000个线性系统上评估了Parth,结果显示,在某些最具挑战性的物理模拟中,它实现了高达14倍的重排序运行时加速,即使在Apple Accelerate和Intel MKL等高度优化的求解器上,也使Cholesky求解时间加速了2倍。
abstract_en: We introduce Parth, a fill-reducing ordering method for sparse Cholesky solvers with dynamic sparsity patterns (e.g., in physics simulations with contact or geometry processing with local remeshing). Parth facilitates the selective reuse of fill-reducing orderings when sparsity patterns exhibit temporal coherence, avoiding full symbolic analysis by localizing the effect of dynamic sparsity changes on the ordering vector. We evaluated Parth on over 175,000 linear systems collected from both physics simulations and geometry processing applications, and show that for some of the most challenging physics simulations, it achieves up to 14x reordering runtime speedup, resulting in a 2x speedup in Cholesky solve time—even on top of well-optimized solvers such as Apple Accelerate and Intel MKL.

title: 线弹性壳格子超材料的渐近分析与设计
title_en: Asymptotic analysis and design of linear elastic shell lattice metamaterials.
abstract: 我们基于Ciarlet壳体理论,对壳格子超材料进行渐近分析,引入一种新指标——渐近方向刚度(ADS)——以量化中面几何形状如何控制有效刚度。我们证明了一个收敛定理,严格刻画ADS并建立其上界,以及实现该上界的必要且充分条件。作为关键结果,我们的理论为基于三重周期极小曲面(TPMS)的壳格子中观察到的高体模量提供了首个严格解释。为在一般周期表面上优化ADS,我们提出了一种基于三角网格的离散化与形状优化框架。数值实验验证了理论发现,并展示了在多种设计目标下优化的有效性。我们的实现可在https://github.com/lavenklau/minisurf获取。
abstract_en: We present an asymptotic analysis of shell lattice metamaterials based on Ciarlet's shell theory, introducing a new metric—asymptotic directional stiffness (ADS)—to quantify how the geometry of the middle surface governs the effective stiffness. We prove a convergence theorem that rigorously characterizes ADS and establishes its upper bound, along with necessary and sufficient condition for achieving it. As a key result, our theory provides the first rigorous explanation for the high bulk modulus observed in Triply Periodic Minimal Surfaces (TPMS)-based shell lattices. To optimize ADS on general periodic surfaces, we propose a triangular-mesh-based discretization and shape optimization framework. Numerical experiments validate the theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of the optimization under various design objectives. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/lavenklau/minisurf.

title: BANG:通过生成式爆炸动力学分割三维资产
title_en: BANG: Dividing 3D Assets via Generative Exploded Dynamics.
abstract: 三维创作始终是人类的独特优势,源于我们通过眼、脑和手解构并重组物体的能力。然而,当前三维设计工具难以复现这一自然过程,需要大量艺术专业知识和手动劳动。本文提出BANG,一种新颖的生成方法,连接三维生成与推理,实现对三维物体的直观灵活的部件级分解。BANG的核心是"生成式爆炸动力学",该技术为输入几何体创建平滑的爆炸状态序列,在逐步分离部件的同时保持其几何和语义一致性。BANG利用预训练的大型潜在扩散模型,通过轻量级爆炸视图适配器进行微调,实现对分解过程的精确控制。它还结合时间注意力模块,确保时间上的平滑过渡和一致性。BANG通过空间提示(如边界框和表面区域)增强控制能力,使用户能够指定分解哪些部件及如何分解。这种交互可扩展至多模态模型(如GPT-4),实现更直观创造性的2D到3D操作。BANG的能力延伸至生成详细部件级几何结构、将部件与功能描述关联,以及支持组件感知的三维创作与制造流程。此外,BANG在3D打印领域也具有应用价值,可生成可分离部件以实现便捷打印与重组。本质上,BANG实现了从创意概念到详细三维资产的无缝转换,为创作提供了与人类直觉共鸣的新视角。
abstract_en: 3D creation has always been a unique human strength, driven by our ability to deconstruct and reassemble objects using our eyes, mind and hand. However, current 3D design tools struggle to replicate this natural process, requiring considerable artistic expertise and manual labor. This paper introduces BANG, a novel generative approach that bridges 3D generation and reasoning, allowing for intuitive and flexible part-level decomposition of 3D objects. At the heart of BANG is "Generative Exploded Dynamics", which creates a smooth sequence of exploded states for an input geometry, progressively separating parts while preserving their geometric and semantic coherence. BANG utilizes a pre-trained large-scale latent diffusion model, fine-tuned for exploded dynamics with a lightweight exploded view adapter, allowing precise control over the decomposition process. It also incorporates a temporal attention module to ensure smooth transitions and consistency across time. BANG enhances control with spatial prompts, such as bounding boxes and surface regions, enabling users to specify which parts to decompose and how. This interaction can be extended with multimodal models like GPT-4, enabling 2D-to-3D manipulations for more intuitive and creative workflows. The capabilities of BANG extend to generating detailed part-level geometry, associating parts with functional descriptions, and facilitating component-aware 3D creation and manufacturing workflows. Additionally, BANG offers applications in 3D printing, where separable parts are generated for easy printing and reassembly. In essence, BANG enables seamless transformation from imaginative concepts to detailed 3D assets, offering a new perspective on creation that resonates with human intuition.
authors: Longwen Zhang, Qixuan Zhang, Haoran Jiang, Yinuo Bai, Wei Yang 0034, Lan Xu 0003, Jingyi Yu 0001

title: 焦散的伯恩斯坦界限
title_en: Bernstein Bounds for Caustics.
abstract: 系统模拟镜面光传输需要对包含可行路径的三角形三元组进行穷举搜索。鉴于枚举所有组合的极端低效性,我们通过随机采样此类三元组来显著缩小搜索域。挑战在于设计合理的采样概率以保持噪声水平可控。我们的核心洞察是:通过为每个三角形三元组在给定位置的辐照度贡献设定界限,可以采样出可能具有高贡献的三元组子集。尽管低贡献三元组被赋予极小概率,但整体方差仍保持较低。因此,我们推导出每个三角形三元组投射的焦散的位置和辐照度界限,引入有理函数在伯恩斯坦基上的界限性质。当将位置和辐照度表达式转化为有理函数时,通过余数变量处理非有理部分以维持界限有效性。最后,我们通过优化仅使用位置和辐照度界限表达的方差上界,精心设计采样概率。基于界限的三角形三元组采样即使在无需防御性采样的情况下也具有内在无偏性。该方法可与局部三角形域内的各种无偏和有偏根查找技术结合使用。广泛评估表明,我们的方法能够快速可靠地渲染复杂焦散效果。然而,该方法在不超过两个镜面顶点的情况下效率较高,其中复杂度随三角形数量呈亚线性增长,随光源数量呈线性增长,并未考虑菲涅尔项和可见性项。我们还依赖参数来控制细分。
abstract_en: Systematically simulating specular light transport requires an exhaustive search for triangle tuples containing admissible paths. Given the extreme inefficiency of enumerating all combinations, we significantly reduce the search domain by stochastically sampling such tuples. The challenge is to design proper sampling probabilities that keep the noise level controllable. Our key insight is that by bounding the irradiance contributed by each triangle tuple at a given position, we can sample a subset of triangle tuples with potentially high contributions. Although low-contribution tuples are assigned a negligible probability, the overall variance remains low. Therefore, we derive position and irradiance bounds for caustics casted by each triangle tuple, introducing a bounding property of rational functions on a Bernstein basis. When formulating position and irradiance expressions into rational functions, we handle non-rational parts through remainder variables to maintain bounding validity. Finally, we carefully design the sampling probabilities by optimizing the upper bound of the variance, expressed only using the position and irradiance bounds. The bound-driven sampling of triangle tuples is intrinsically unbiased even without defensive sampling. It can be combined with various unbiased and biased root-finding techniques within a local triangle domain. Extensive evaluations show that our method enables the fast and reliable rendering of complex caustics effects. Yet, our method is efficient for no more than two specular vertices, where complexity grows sublinearly to the number of triangles and linearly to that of emitters, and does not consider the Fresnel and visibility terms. We also rely on parameters to control subdivisions.

title: CAST:从单张RGB图像进行组件对齐的三维场景重建
title_en: CAST: Component-Aligned 3D Scene Reconstruction from an RGB Image.
abstract: 从单张RGB图像恢复高质量三维场景是计算机图形学中的具有挑战性的任务。现有方法往往面临领域特定限制或低质量物体生成的问题。为解决这些问题,我们提出CAST(Component-Aligned 3D Scene Reconstruction from a Single RGB Image),一种新颖的三维场景重建方法。CAST首先从输入图像中提取物体级二维分割和相对深度信息,随后利用基于GPT的模型分析物体间空间关系。这使得能够理解物体在场景中的相互关系,确保更连贯的重建。CAST接着采用遮挡感知的大规模三维生成模型,利用掩码自编码器(MAE)和点云条件化独立生成每个物体的完整几何结构,以减轻遮挡和部分物体信息的影响,确保与源图像几何和纹理的准确对齐。为将每个物体与场景对齐,对齐生成模型计算必要的变换,使生成的网格能够准确放置并整合到场景点云中。最后,CAST应用物理感知校正机制,利用细粒度关系图生成约束图。该图指导物体姿态的优化,确保物理一致性和空间连贯性。通过使用有符号距离场(SDF),模型有效解决了遮挡、物体穿透和漂浮物体等问题,确保生成的场景准确反映现实物理交互。实验结果表明,CAST显著提升了单图像三维场景重建的质量,在场景理解和重建任务中提供了增强的现实感和准确性。CAST在虚拟内容创作领域具有实际应用,如沉浸式游戏环境和影视制作,可无缝集成现实场景到虚拟景观中。此外,CAST还可用于机器人领域,实现高效的现实到仿真工作流,并为机器人系统提供逼真、可扩展的仿真环境。
abstract_en: Recovering high-quality 3D scenes from a single RGB image is a challenging task in computer graphics. Current methods often struggle with domain-specific limitations or low-quality object generation. To address these, we propose CAST (Component-Aligned 3D Scene Reconstruction from a Single RGB Image), a novel method for 3D scene reconstruction. CAST starts by extracting object-level 2D segmentation and relative depth information from the input image, followed by using a GPT-based model to analyze inter-object spatial relations. This enables understanding of how objects relate to each other within the scene, ensuring more coherent reconstruction. CAST then employs an occlusion-aware large-scale 3D generation model to independently generate each object's full geometry, using Masked Auto Encoder (MAE) and point cloud conditioning to mitigate the effects of occlusions and partial object information, ensuring accurate alignment with the source image's geometry and texture. To align each object with the scene, the alignment generation model computes the necessary transformations, allowing the generated meshes to be accurately placed and integrated into the scene's point cloud. Finally, CAST applies a physics-aware correction mechanism, which leverages a fine-grained relation graph to generate a constraint graph. This graph guides the optimization of object poses, ensuring physical consistency and spatial coherence. By utilizing Signed Distance Fields (SDF), the model effectively addresses issues such as occlusions, object penetration, and floating objects, ensuring that the generated scene accurately reflects real-world physical interactions. Experimental results demonstrate that CAST significantly improves the quality of single-image 3D scene reconstruction, offering enhanced realism and accuracy in scene understanding and reconstruction tasks. CAST has practical applications in virtual content creation, such as immersive game environments and film production, where real-world setups can be seamlessly integrated into virtual landscapes. Additionally, CAST can be leveraged in robotics, enabling efficient real-to-simulation workflows and providing realistic, scalable simulation environments for robotic systems.
authors: Kaixin Yao, Longwen Zhang, Xinhao Yan, Yan Zeng, Qixuan Zhang, Lan Xu 0003, Wei Yang 0034, Jiayuan Gu, Jingyi Yu 0001

title: CK-MPM:一种紧凑核物质点法
title_en: CK-MPM: A Compact-Kernel Material Point Method.
abstract: 物质点法(MPM)已成为基于物理的模拟基石,在地质力学和计算机图形学中被广泛用于模拟颗粒流、粘弹性、断裂力学等现象。尽管其具有通用性,原始MPM由于粒子-网格传递核的不连续性会导致跨单元不稳定性。现有解决方案主要通过采用更平滑的形状函数来缓解这些问题,但会因更大的核支持范围导致数值扩散增加和计算开销上升。本文提出了一种新型C2连续紧凑核用于MPM,在稳定性、精度和计算效率之间实现了独特平衡。我们的方法可无缝集成于仿射粒子-单元法(APIC)和移动最小二乘法(MLS)MPM,相比线性核仅需将每个粒子关联的网格节点数量翻倍。其核心是一种创新的双网格框架,通过两个交错网格中粒子仅与所占单元内的网格节点关联,确保力计算的一致性和稳定性。我们证明该方法可方便地通过领域特定语言Taichi或基于开源GPU MPM框架实现,相比二次B样条MPM具有更快的运行时和更少的数值扩散。通过单元测试、对比研究和压力测试的全面验证,展示了该方法在保持线动量和角动量守恒、处理刚性材料以及大规模模拟高效扩展方面的有效性。我们的结果突显了紧凑高阶核在提升MPM稳定、精确和高性能模拟能力方面的变革潜力。
abstract_en: The Material Point Method (MPM) has become a cornerstone of physics-based simulation, widely used in geomechanics and computer graphics for modeling phenomena such as granular flows, viscoelasticity, fracture mechanics, etc. Despite its versatility, the original MPM suffers from cell-crossing instabilities caused by discontinuities in particle-grid transfer kernels. Existing solutions mostly mitigate these issues by adopting smoother shape functions, but at the cost of increased numerical diffusion and computational overhead due to larger kernel support. In this paper, we propose a novel C2-continuous compact kernel for MPM that achieves a unique balance in terms of stability, accuracy, and computational efficiency. Our method integrates seamlessly with Affine Particle-In-Cell (APIC) and Moving Least Squares (MLS) MPM, while only doubling the number of grid nodes associated with each particle compared to linear kernels. At its core is an innovative dual-grid framework, which associates particles with grid nodes exclusively within the cells they occupy on two staggered grids, ensuring consistent and stable force computations. We demonstrate that our method can be conveniently implemented using a domain-specific language, Taichi, or based on open-source GPU MPM frameworks, achieving faster runtime and less numerical diffusion compared to quadratic B-spline MPM. Comprehensive validation through unit tests, comparative studies, and stress tests demonstrates the efficacy of our approach in conserving both linear and angular momentum, handling stiff materials, and scaling efficiently for large-scale simulations. Our results highlight the transformative potential of compact, high-order kernels in advancing MPM's capabilities for stable, accurate, and high-performance simulations.
authors: Michael Liu, Xinlei Wang, Minchen Li

title: Claycode:可样式化与可变形的二维可扫描码
title_en: Claycode: Stylable and Deformable 2D Scannable Codes.
abstract: 本文介绍了一种新颖的二维可扫描码Claycode,专为广泛样式化和变形而设计。与传统的基于矩阵的编码(例如QR码)不同,Claycode通过树状结构编码其信息。在编码过程中,位被映射到拓扑树中,随后以目标多边形形状边界内的颜色区域嵌套形式进行描绘。在解码过程中,Claycode实时从摄像头流中提取并解析。我们详细介绍了端到端流程,并展示了Claycode能够在不损害其功能的前提下实现广泛的样式化。随后,我们通过实证演示了Claycode对严重变形的高容忍度,在传统二维可扫描码通常失效的场景中表现优于传统编码。
abstract_en: This paper introduces Claycode, a novel 2D scannable code designed for extensive stylization and deformation. Unlike traditional matrix-based codes (e.g., QR codes), Claycodes encode their message in a tree structure. During the encoding process, bits are mapped into a topology tree, which is then depicted as a nesting of color regions drawn within the boundaries of a target polygon shape. When decoding, Claycodes are extracted and interpreted in real-time from a camera stream. We detail the end-to-end pipeline and show that Claycodes allow for extensive stylization without compromising their functionality. We then empirically demonstrate Claycode's high tolerance to heavy deformations, outperforming traditional 2D scannable codes in scenarios where they typically fail.

title: 传感器上的协作阵列相机
title_en: Collaborative On-Sensor Array Cameras.
abstract: 现代纳米制造技术使我们能够利用亚波长尺度结构操控光波前,为用超薄超材料表面替代传统光学中的 bulky 折射表面提供了潜力。理论上,纳米柱阵列在纳米尺度上对波前的相位、偏振和振幅具有前所未有的控制能力。一系列近期研究成功探索了平面计算相机,通过在传感器几毫米处使用单个金属透镜或超材料表面阵列替代复合透镜。然而,由于金属透镜的固有波长依赖性,这些相机在宽带成像中图像质量无法与折射型相机匹配,甚至可能在依赖生成式重建方法时出现幻影现象。本工作中,我们研究了一种协作式超材料元件阵列,这些元件联合学习以实现宽带成像。为此,我们学习了一个包含1亿个纳米柱的纳米光子学阵列,该阵列在整个可见光谱范围内进行端到端联合优化——这一设计任务由于内存和计算限制,现有逆向设计方法或学习方法无法支持。我们引入了一种分布式超光学学习方法来解决这一挑战。这使我们能够优化大型参数阵列,同时结合学习到的超原子代理和视差感知、噪声感知的非生成式重建方法。所提出的相机在模拟和所有实验测试中均表现出色,无论场景照明光谱如何。
abstract_en: Modern nanofabrication techniques have enabled us to manipulate the wave-front of light with sub-wavelength-scale structures, offering the potential to replace bulky refractive surfaces in conventional optics with ultrathin metasurfaces. In theory, arrays of nanoposts provide unprecedented control over manipulating the wavefront in terms of phase, polarization, and amplitude at the nanometer resolution. A line of recent work successfully investigates flat computational cameras that replace compound lenses with a single metalens or an array of metasurfaces a few millimeters from the sensor. However, due to the inherent wavelength dependence of metalenses, in practice, these cameras do not match their refractive counterparts in image quality for broadband imaging, and may even suffer from hallucinations when relying on generative reconstruction methods. In this work, we investigate a collaborative array of metasurface elements that are jointly learned to perform broadband imaging. To this end, we learn a nanophotonics array with 100-million nanoposts that is end-to-end jointly optimized over the full visible spectrum—a design task that existing inverse design methods or learning approaches cannot support due to memory and compute limitations. We introduce a distributed meta-optics learning method to tackle this challenge. This allows us to optimize a large parameter array along with a learned metaatom proxy and a non-generative reconstruction method that is parallax-aware and noise-aware. The proposed camera performs favorably in simulation and in all experimental tests irrespective of the scene illumination spectrum.

title: 基于Odeco张量的三维各向异性框架场设计
title_en: Designing 3D Anisotropic Frame Fields with Odeco Tensors.
abstract: 本文介绍了一种在以四面体网格表示的受限几何域内合成三维张量场的方法。与以往优化各向同性场的技术不同,我们专注于平滑且与域边界或用户引导对齐的各向异性张量场。我们方法的关键成分是一种基于对称正交分解(Odeco)张量表示的新计算设计框架,用于优化域内每个张量的拉伸比和方向。与以往仅针对各向同性张量设计的技术不同,我们展示了该方法在生成高各向异性且形状一致的平滑体张量场方面的有效性,尤其是在复杂形状域中。我们将这些各向异性张量场应用于各种应用,如各向异性网格、结构力学和制造。
abstract_en: This paper introduces a method to synthesize a 3D tensor field within a constrained geometric domain represented as a tetrahedral mesh. Whereas previous techniques optimize for isotropic fields, we focus on anisotropic tensor fields that are smooth and aligned with the domain boundary or user guidance. The key ingredient of our method is a novel computational design framework, built on top of the symmetric orthogonally decomposable (odeco) tensor representation, to optimize the stretching ratios and orientations for each tensor in the domain. In contrast to past techniques designed only for isotropic tensors, we demonstrate the efficacy of our approach in generating smooth volumetric tensor fields with high anisotropy and shape conformity, especially for the domain with complex shapes. We apply these anisotropic tensor fields to various applications, such as anisotropic meshing, structural mechanics, and fabrication.
authors: Haikuan Zhu, Hongbo Li, Hsueh-Ti Derek Liu, Wenping Wang 0001, Jing Hua 0001, Zichun Zhong

title: 针压夹爪设计及其在线手部调整的灵巧抓取学习
title_en: Designing Pin-pression Gripper and Learning its Dexterous Grasping with Online In-hand Adjustment.
abstract: 我们提出了一种受针压玩具启发的新型平行夹爪设计。所提出的针压夹爪具有独特的机制,每个手指集成二维针阵列,能够实现独立伸缩。这种独特设计使夹爪可通过动态调整针的伸缩状态,即时自定义手指形状以适配被抓取物体。此外,夹爪通过动态调整针的伸缩状态实现物体手部重定向,从而增强抓取稳定性。为学习针压夹爪的动态抓取技能,我们设计了专用强化学习算法,包含精心设计的状态表示和奖励塑造机制。为实现更高效的抓取-提升模式,我们提出课程学习方案。大量实验表明,我们的设计结合学习技能,在抓取灵活性、鲁棒性和对未见过物体的泛化能力方面均优于现有方案。我们还展示了物理制造的针压夹爪在仿真到现实转移中的积极实验结果,验证了该新型夹爪设计与抓取技能的实用价值。本文演示视频可访问 https://github.com/siggraph-pin-pression-gripper/pin-pression-gripper-video
abstract_en: We introduce a novel design of parallel-jaw grippers drawing inspiration from pin-pression toys. The proposed pin-pression gripper features a distinctive mechanism in which each finger integrates a 2D array of pins capable of independent extension and retraction. This unique design allows the gripper to instantaneously customize its finger's shape to conform to the object being grasped by dynamically adjusting the extension/retraction of the pins. In addition, the gripper excels in in-hand re-orientation of objects for enhanced grasping stability again via dynamically adjusting the pins. To learn the dynamic grasping skills of pin-pression grippers, we devise a dedicated reinforcement learning algorithm with careful designs of state representation and reward shaping. To achieve a more efficient grasp-while-lift grasping mode, we propose a curriculum learning scheme. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our design, together with the learned skills, leads to highly flexible and robust grasping with much stronger generality to unseen objects than alternatives. We also highlight encouraging physical results of sim-to-real transfer on a physically manufactured pin-pression gripper, demonstrating the practical significance of our novel gripper design and grasping skill. Demonstration videos for this paper are available at https://github.com/siggraph-pin-pression-gripper/pin-pression-gripper-video.
authors: Hewen Xiao, Xiuping Liu, Hang Zhao 0018, Jian Liu, Kai Xu 0004

title: 基于时间分辨路径回放反向传播的可微几何声学路径追踪
title_en: Differentiable Geometric Acoustic Path Tracing using Time-Resolved Path Replay Backpropagation.
abstract: 可微渲染已成为解决计算机图形学和视觉领域复杂逆问题的关键技术。现有系统能够模拟并区分光的空间传播过程。我们利用光传输模拟与几何声学的对偶性,将可微渲染技术应用于已有的声学模拟方法。所构建的系统能够根据几何声学模型模拟声音,并计算输出能量频谱图相对于场景任意参数(包括材料、声源、麦克风和场景几何)的导数。与当前可微瞬态渲染方法不同,我们通过提出路径回放反向传播的时间扩展版本[Vicini et al. 2021],能够处理任意模拟深度并实现常量内存和线性执行时间。我们通过与现有模拟软件的对比验证了模型的准确性,并在逆声学示例和房间参数优化案例中展示了梯度优化的能力。这为声学优化开辟了新的研究领域,其影响力可能如同可微渲染对图形学领域的影响一样深远。
abstract_en: Differentiable rendering has become a key ingredient in solving challenging inverse problems in computer graphics and vision. Existing systems can simulate and differentiate the spatial propagation of light. We exploit the duality of light transport simulations and geometric acoustics to apply differential rendering techniques to established acoustic simulation methods. The resulting system is capable of simulating sound according to the geometrical acoustics model and computing derivatives of the output energy spectrograms with respect to arbitrary parameters of the scene, including materials, emitters, microphones, and scene geometry. Contrary to current differentiable transient rendering, we can handle arbitrary simulation depths and achieve constant memory and linear execution times by presenting a temporal extension of Path Replay Backpropagation [Vicini et al. 2021]. We verify our model against established simulation software, and demonstrate the capabilities of optimization with gradients at examples of inverse acoustics and optimizing room parameters. This opens up a new field of research for acoustic optimization that could be as impactful for the acoustic community as differentiable rendering was for the graphics community.
authors: Ugo Paavo Finnendahl, Markus Worchel, Tobias Jüterbock, Daniel Wujecki, Fabian Brinkmann, Stefan Weinzierl, Marc Alexa

title: Diffuse-CLoC: 基于物理的角色前瞻控制引导扩散模型
title_en: Diffuse-CLoC: Guided Diffusion for Physics-based Character Look-ahead Control.
abstract: 我们提出Diffuse-CLoC,这是一种基于物理的前瞻控制引导扩散框架,能够实现直观、可操控且符合物理现实的运动生成。尽管现有的基于扩散模型的运动学运动生成方法在推理时通过条件控制提供了直观的操控能力,但往往难以生成符合物理可行性的运动。相反,近期基于扩散的控制策略在生成物理可实现的运动序列方面展现出潜力,但缺乏运动学预测限制了其操控性。Diffuse-CLoC通过一个关键洞察解决了这些挑战:在单一扩散模型中建模状态与动作的联合分布,使动作生成可通过条件控制预测的状态实现操控。这种方法使我们能够利用已有的运动学运动生成条件控制技术,同时生成符合物理现实的运动。因此,我们实现了无需高层规划器的规划能力。我们的方法通过单一预训练模型处理多样化的未见过的长时域下游任务,包括静态和动态障碍物避障、运动插值以及任务空间控制。实验结果表明,我们的方法在传统高层运动扩散与低层跟踪的分层框架上显著优于后者。
abstract_en: We present Diffuse-CLoC, a guided diffusion framework for physics-based look-ahead control that enables intuitive, steerable, and physically realistic motion generation. While existing kinematics motion generation with diffusion models offer intuitive steering capabilities with inference-time conditioning, they often fail to produce physically viable motions. In contrast, recent diffusion-based control policies have shown promise in generating physically realizable motion sequences, but the lack of kinematics prediction limits their steerability. Diffuse-CLoC addresses these challenges through a key insight: modeling the joint distribution of states and actions within a single diffusion model makes action generation steerable by conditioning it on the predicted states. This approach allows us to leverage established conditioning techniques from kinematic motion generation while producing physically realistic motions. As a result, we achieve planning capabilities without the need for a high-level planner. Our method handles a diverse set of unseen long-horizon downstream tasks through a single pre-trained model, including static and dynamic obstacle avoidance, motion in-betweening, and task-space control. Experimental results show that our method significantly outperforms the traditional hierarchical framework of high-level motion diffusion and low-level tracking.
authors: Xiaoyu Huang, Takara Truong, Yunbo Zhang, Fangzhou Yu, Jean-Pierre Sleiman, Jessica K. Hodgins, Koushil Sreenath, Farbod Farshidian

title: 粉雪雪崩的数字动画
title_en: Digital Animation of Powder-Snow Avalanches.
abstract: 粉雪雪崩是山地雪被不稳定性的自然现象。它始于密集的雪崩核心以高速沿山体下滑。在演化过程中,雪崩前端的雪颗粒与空气混合,形成环绕密集雪崩的悬浮湍流雪尘云。本文介绍了一种基于物理的框架,采用有限体积法模拟复杂地形下的粉雪雪崩。具体而言,主要目标是以视觉逼真的方式模拟雪崩内部的湍流雪云动力学。我们的方法依赖于多层模型,将雪崩分为两个主要层:密集雪层和粉雪层。密集雪层流动通过求解适用于复杂基底表面的浅水方程(Savage-Hutter模型)进行模拟。粉雪层流动被建模为可混溶流体的两相混合物,并使用纳维-斯托克斯方程进行模拟。此外,我们提出了一种新型过渡层模型,负责耦合雪崩主层,包括由雪卷入过程注入粉雪云的雪质量及其注入速度。简而言之,我们的框架全面模拟粉雪雪崩,使我们能够渲染最具挑战性的重力驱动流之一的逼真动画。
abstract_en: Powder-snow avalanches are natural phenomena that result from an instability in the snow cover on a mountain relief. It begins with a dense avalanche core moving fast down the mountain. During its evolution, the snow particles in the avalanche front mix with the air, forming a suspended turbulent cloud of snow dust surrounding the dense snow avalanche. This paper introduces a physically-based framework using the Finite Volume Method to simulate powder-snow avalanches under complex terrains. Specifically, the primary goal is to simulate the turbulent snow cloud dynamics within the avalanche in a visually realistic manner. Our approach relies on a multi-layer model that splits the avalanche into two main layers: dense and powder-snow. The dense-snow layer flow is simulated by solving a type of Shallow Water Equations suited for intricate basal surfaces, known as the Savage-Hutter model. The powder-snow layer flow is modeled as a two-phase mixture of miscible fluids and simulated using Navier-Stokes equations. Moreover, we propose a novel model for the transition layer, which is responsible for coupling the avalanche main layers, including the snow mass injected into the powder-snow cloud from the snow entrainment processes and its injection velocity. In brief, our framework comprehensively simulates powder-snow avalanches, allowing us to render convincing animations of one of the most complex gravity-driven flows.

title: Dress-1-to-3: 从单图像生成可模拟的3D服装:结合扩散先验与可微物理
title_en: Dress-1-to-3: Single Image to Simulation-Ready 3D Outfit with Diffusion Prior and Differentiable Physics.
abstract: 大规模模型的最新进展显著推动了图像到3D重建技术的发展。然而,生成的模型常被融合为单一整体,限制了其在下游任务中的应用。本文聚焦于3D服装生成,这是虚拟试衣等需要动态服装动画的应用关键领域,要求服装具备可分离性和可模拟性。我们提出Dress-1-to-3,一种新颖的流程,可从野外图像中重建物理合理、可模拟的分离服装与人体。该方法以图像为起点,结合预训练的图像到裁片生成模型创建粗略裁片,与预训练的多视角扩散模型生成多视角图像。进一步利用基于生成多视角图像的可微服装模拟器优化裁片。多样化的实验表明,我们的优化方法显著提升了重建3D服装与人体的几何对齐度。此外,通过集成纹理生成模块和人体运动生成模块,我们实现了定制化的物理合理且逼真的动态服装演示。项目页面为https://dress-1-to-3.github.io/。
abstract_en: Recent advances in large models have significantly advanced image-to-3D reconstruction. However, the generated models are often fused into a single piece, limiting their applicability in downstream tasks. This paper focuses on 3D garment generation, a key area for applications like virtual try-on with dynamic garment animations, which require garments to be separable and simulation-ready. We introduce Dress-1-to-3, a novel pipeline that reconstructs physics-plausible, simulation-ready separated garments with sewing patterns and humans from an in-the-wild image. Starting with the image, our approach combines a pre-trained image-to-sewing pattern generation model for creating coarse sewing patterns with a pre-trained multi-view diffusion model to produce multi-view images. The sewing pattern is further refined using a differentiable garment simulator based on the generated multi-view images. Versatile experiments demonstrate that our optimization approach substantially enhances the geometric alignment of the reconstructed 3D garments and humans with the input image. Furthermore, by integrating a texture generation module and a human motion generation module, we produce customized physics-plausible and realistic dynamic garment demonstrations. Our project page is https://dress-1-to-3.github.io/.
authors: Xuan Li 0015, Chang Yu 0005, Wenxin Du, Ying Jiang, Tianyi Xie, Yunuo Chen 0001, Yin Yang 0002, Chenfanfu Jiang

title: FLoD:将灵活细节层次集成到三维高斯泼溅技术中以实现可定制渲染
title_en: FLoD: Integrating Flexible Level of Detail into 3D Gaussian Splatting for Customizable Rendering.
abstract: 三维高斯泼溅(3DGS)通过实现高质量的三维重建和快速渲染速度,显著推动了计算机图形学的发展,激发了大量后续研究。然而,3DGS及其后续工作受限于特定的硬件配置,要么仅适用于低成本设备,要么仅适用于高端设备。旨在降低3DGS内存占用的方法虽可在低成本GPU上实现渲染,但会牺牲渲染质量,无法在高端GPU场景中充分发挥硬件性能。相反,提升渲染质量的方法需要配备大显存的高端GPU,使得此类方法在内存容量有限的低端设备上难以应用。因此,基于3DGS的工作通常假设单一硬件配置,缺乏适应不同硬件约束的灵活性。为克服这一局限,我们提出面向3DGS的灵活细节层次(FLoD)。FLoD通过针对不同层次的3D尺度约束构建多级3DGS表示,其中每一层次独立地以不同细节程度和GPU内存占用重建整个场景。引入逐级训练策略以确保各层次间的结构一致性。此外,FLoD的多级结构支持在不同细节层次上选择性渲染图像区域,提供额外的内存高效渲染选项。据我们所知,在将细节层次(LoD)概念与3DGS结合的先前工作中,FLoD是首个遵循LoD核心原则的方法,通过为广泛GPU配置提供可调节选项实现这一目标。实验表明,FLoD提供了多种渲染选项,在质量与内存占用之间进行权衡,能够在多样化的内存约束下实现实时渲染。此外,我们证明FLoD可扩展至不同的3DGS框架,表明其潜在的集成到未来前沿发展中的可能性。
abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has significantly advanced computer graphics by enabling high-quality 3D reconstruction and fast rendering speeds, inspiring numerous follow-up studies. However, 3DGS and its subsequent works are restricted to specific hardware setups, either on only low-cost or on only high-end configurations. Approaches aimed at reducing 3DGS memory usage enable rendering on low-cost GPU but compromise rendering quality, which fails to leverage the hardware capabilities in the case of higher-end GPU. Conversely, methods that enhance rendering quality require high-end GPU with large VRAM, making such methods impractical for lower-end devices with limited memory capacity. Consequently, 3DGS-based works generally assume a single hardware setup and lack the flexibility to adapt to varying hardware constraints. To overcome this limitation, we propose Flexible Level of Detail (FLoD) for 3DGS. FLoD constructs a multi-level 3DGS representation through level-specific 3D scale constraints, where each level independently reconstructs the entire scene with varying detail and GPU memory usage. A level-by-level training strategy is introduced to ensure structural consistency across levels. Furthermore, the multi-level structure of FLoD allows selective rendering of image regions at different detail levels, providing additional memory-efficient rendering options. To our knowledge, among prior works which incorporate the concept of Level of Detail (LoD) with 3DGS, FLoD is the first to follow the core principle of LoD by offering adjustable options for a broad range of GPU settings. Experiments demonstrate that FLoD provides various rendering options with trade-offs between quality and memory usage, enabling real-time rendering under diverse memory constraints. Furthermore, we show that FLoD generalizes to different 3DGS frameworks, indicating its potential for integration into future state-of-the-art developments.
authors: Yunji Seo, Young Sun Choi, Hyun Seung Son, Youngjung Uh

title: 居家环境下基于块级反射先验的面部外观捕捉
title_en: Facial Appearance Capture at Home with Patch-Level Reflectance Prior.
abstract: 现有面部外观捕捉方法能够从智能手机录制的视频中重建合理的面部反射特性。然而,重建质量仍远逊于基于专业工作室录制的方案。本文通过开发一种新型日常使用方案填补这一空白,该方案在昏暗房间中采用共置智能手机与闪光灯的视频采集设置。为提升重建质量,我们的核心观察是:在专业工作室扫描数据的分布范围内求解面部反射图。具体而言,我们首先在Light Stage扫描数据上学习扩散先验,然后引导其生成与采集图像最匹配的反射图。我们提出在块级进行扩散先验训练以提升泛化能力与训练稳定性,因当前Light Stage数据集虽分辨率超高但数据量有限。针对该先验,我们提出块级后验采样技术,从该块级扩散模型中采样无缝全分辨率反射图。实验表明,我们的方法在低成本录制与专业工作室录制之间显著缩小了质量差距,为普通用户实现数字世界中的自我克隆打开了大门。
abstract_en: Existing facial appearance capture methods can reconstruct plausible facial reflectance from smartphone-recorded videos. However, the reconstruction quality is still far behind the ones based on studio recordings. This paper fills the gap by developing a novel daily-used solution with a co-located smartphone and flashlight video capture setting in a dim room. To enhance the quality, our key observation is to solve facial reflectance maps within the data distribution of studio-scanned ones. Specifically, we first learn a diffusion prior over the Light Stage scans and then steer it to produce the reflectance map that best matches the captured images. We propose to train the diffusion prior at the patch level to improve generalization ability and training stability, as current Light Stage datasets are in ultra-high resolution but limited in data size. Tailored to this prior, we propose a patch-level posterior sampling technique to sample seamless full-resolution reflectance maps from this patch-level diffusion model. Experiments demonstrate our method closes the quality gap between low-cost and studio recordings by a large margin, opening the door for everyday users to clone themselves to the digital world.
authors: Yuxuan Han, Junfeng Lyu, Kuan Sheng, Minghao Que, Qixuan Zhang, Lan Xu 0003, Feng Xu 0005
