title: 当高斯遇见表面元:超高速高保真辐射场渲染
title_en: When Gaussian Meets Surfel: Ultra-fast High-fidelity Radiance Field Rendering.
abstract: 我们提出了一种高斯增强表面元(GESs)双尺度表示方法,用于辐射场渲染。该方法通过一组具有视角依赖颜色的2D不透明表面元表示场景的粗尺度几何与外观,少量围绕表面元的3D高斯分布则补充细尺度外观细节。GESs的渲染过程包含两个步骤:首先通过标准图形管线对表面元进行光栅化,生成深度图与颜色图;随后在每个像素顺序上独立进行高斯分布的深度测试与颜色累积。从多视角图像中优化GESs采用精细的由粗到细优化流程,能够忠实捕捉丰富的场景外观。GESs完全无需排序的渲染方式不仅实现了极高的渲染速度,还生成视角一致的图像,成功避免了视角变化时的闪烁伪影。基础的GES表示可便捷扩展实现抗锯齿(Mip-GES)、加速渲染(Speedy-GES)和紧凑存储(Compact-GES),并通过用2D高斯分布替代3D高斯分布(2D-GES)重建更精确的场景几何。实验结果表明,GESs作为超高速高保真辐射场渲染的表示方法,已超越现有技术。
abstract_en: We introduce Gaussian-enhanced Surfels (GESs), a bi-scale representation for radiance field rendering, wherein a set of 2D opaque surfels with view-dependent colors represent the coarse-scale geometry and appearance of scenes, and a few 3D Gaussians surrounding the surfels supplement fine-scale appearance details. The rendering with GESs consists of two passes - surfels are first rasterized through a standard graphics pipeline to produce depth and color maps, and then Gaussians are splatted with depth testing and color accumulation on each pixel order independently. The optimization of GESs from multi-view images is performed through an elaborate coarse-to-fine procedure, faithfully capturing rich scene appearance. The entirely sorting-free rendering of GESs not only achieves very fast rates, but also produces view-consistent images, successfully avoiding popping artifacts under view changes. The basic GES representation can be easily extended to achieve antialiasing in rendering (Mip-GES), boosted rendering speeds (Speedy-GES) and compact storage (Compact-GES), and reconstruct better scene geometries by replacing 3D Gaussians with 2D Gaussians (2D-GES). Experimental results show that GESs advance the state-of-the-arts as a compelling representation for ultra-fast high-fidelity radiance field rendering.
authors: Keyang Ye, Tianjia Shao, Kun Zhou 0001

title: WishGI:基于球面调和函数拟合的轻量级静态全局光照烘焙
title_en: WishGI: Lightweight Static Global Illumination Baking via Spherical Harmonics Fitting.
abstract: 全局光照通过结合直接光照和间接光照生成逼真的光照效果,使虚拟场景更接近现实。静态全局光照是虚拟场景渲染的关键组成部分,通过预计算和烘焙技术显著降低运行时计算成本。不幸的是,许多现有工作通过依赖大量纹理存储和像素级纹理采样来优先保证视觉质量,导致较大的性能开销。本文提出了一种光照重建方法,有效减少片段着色器中的采样并避免额外的渲染通道,使其特别适合低端平台。为在降低内存使用的同时实现高质量全局光照,我们采用球面调和函数拟合方法进行烘焙以获取有效的光照信息,并提出一种逆探针分布方法,为每个网格生成独特的探针关联。这种关联可在本地空间离线生成,确保同一网格所有实例的光照质量一致。因此,我们的方法在仅使用主流行业技术约5%内存的情况下,实现了具有高度竞争力的光照效果。
abstract_en: Global illumination combines direct and indirect lighting to create realistic lighting effects, bringing virtual scenes closer to reality. Static global illumination is a crucial component of virtual scene rendering, leveraging precomputation and baking techniques to significantly reduce runtime computational costs. Unfortunately, many existing works prioritize visual quality by relying on extensive texture storage and massive pixel-level texture sampling, leading to large performance overhead. In this paper, we introduce an illumination reconstruction method that effectively reduces sampling in fragment shader and avoids additional render passes, making it well-suited for low-end platforms. To achieve high-quality global illumination with reduced memory usage, we adopt a spherical harmonics fitting approach for baking effective illumination information and propose an inverse probe distribution method that generates unique probe associations for each mesh. This association, which can be generated offline in the local space, ensures consistent lighting quality across all instances of the same mesh. As a consequence, our method delivers highly competitive lighting effects while using only approximately 5% of the memory required by mainstream industry techniques.
authors: Junke Zhu, Zehan Wu, Qixing Zhang, Cheng Liao, Zhangjin Huang

title: α函数分段线性逼近:从噪声和赫尔米特数据中提取
title_en: '-Functions Piecewise-linear Approximation from Noisy and Hermite Data.
abstract: 我们引入α函数,通过两个凸函数之差对给定数据进行分段线性逼近。参数α控制用于探测数据的抛物面形状,可用于滤除数据中的噪声。利用凸函数的特性,可以高效地对数据进行逼近,增强对外部异常值的鲁棒性,并处理梯度信息。该方法还允许在高维空间中应用。我们展示了α函数可以高效计算,并通过从噪声表面样本中重建曲面的例子展示了其通用性。
abstract_en: We introduce α-functions, providing piecewise linear approximation to given data as the difference of two convex functions. The parameter α controls the shape of a paraboloid that is probing the data and may be used to filter out noise in the data. The use of convex functions enables tools for efficient approximation to the data, adding robustness to outliers, and dealing with gradient information. It also allows using the approach in higher dimension. We show that α-functions can be efficiently computed and demonstrate their versatility at the example of surface reconstruction from noisy surface samples.
authors: Marc Alexa

title: 基于运动匹配的可控手势合成框架
title_en: A Motion Matching-based Framework for Controllable Gesture Synthesis from Speech.
abstract: 近年来,基于深度学习的方法在从语音输入合成合理的3D人体手势方面取得了有希望的结果。然而,这些方法通常提供有限的用户控制自由度。此外,以监督方式训练此类模型往往无法捕捉数据的多模态特性,特别是相同音频输入可能产生不同的手势输出。为解决这些问题,我们提出了一种结合数据库匹配和深度生成建模优势的方法,用于生成可控的3D手势。我们的方法通过k近邻(k-NN)算法,依次从数据库中搜索最合理的音频-手势片段,该算法考虑输入音频与先前身体姿态信息的相似性,预测3D身体运动。为进一步提升合成质量,我们提出条件生成对抗网络(cGAN)模型,通过将k-NN结果与真实音频-手势对的合理性进行比较,提供数据驱动的优化。我们的新方法实现了先前基于学习的方法无法实现的直接且更丰富的控制操作。实验表明,我们的方法在使用高层信号(如运动统计信息)的控制合成任务中优于近期模型,同时支持灵活有效的低层信号用户控制。__ABS_MATH_1__
abstract_en: Recent deep learning-based approaches have shown promising results for synthesizing plausible 3D human gestures from speech input. However, these approaches typically offer limited freedom to incorporate user control. Furthermore, training such models in a supervised manner often does not capture the multi-modal nature of the data, particularly because the same audio input can produce different gesture outputs. To address these problems, we present an approach for generating controllable 3D gestures that combines the advantage of database matching and deep generative modeling. Our method predicts 3D body motion by sequentially searching for the most plausible audio-gesture clips from a database using a k-Nearest Neighbors (k-NN) algorithm that considers the similarity to both the input audio and the previous body pose information. To further improve the synthesis quality, we propose a conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) model to provide a data-driven refinement to the k-NN result by comparing its plausibility against the ground truth audio-gesture pairs. Our novel approach enables direct and more varied control manipulation that is not possible with prior learning-based counterparts. Our experiments show that our proposed approach outperforms recent models on control-based synthesis tasks using high-level signals such as motion statistics while enabling flexible and effective user control for lower-level signals. 1
authors: Ikhsanul Habibie, Mohamed Elgharib, Kripasindhu Sarkar, Ahsan Abdullah 0001, Simbarashe Nyatsanga, Michael Neff, Christian Theobalt

title: 光传输算子紧致性的理论分析
title_en: A Theoretical Analysis of Compactness of the Light Transport Operator.
abstract: 渲染虚拟场景的逼真视觉效果需要可处理的光照模拟模型。渲染方程通过积分方程描述了一种此类模型,其核心是一个连续积分算子。大多数渲染算法旨在通过离散化(使用光线、粒子、贴片等)近似该光传输算子的效果。四十年的研究揭示了该算子的有趣性质和直观理解。本文分析了紧致性,这是与离散化无关的关键性质,它表征了算子能否被有限秩算子序列一致逼近。我们最终证明了该算子非紧致的长期猜测,因此任何依赖有限秩或非自适应有限基的离散化方法在任意光照分布下都可能产生无界误差。我们的结果证明了对渲染算法使用多种场景和光照条件进行评估的必要性。我们还发现其低维对应物(仅在纯漫反射场景中)在特殊情况下才非紧致,并揭示了其非可逆性和低通滤波特性之间的联系。我们解释了我们的结果在先前研究中的相关性。我们相信这些理论结果将为未来渲染算法的实用选择提供指导。
abstract_en: Rendering photorealistic visuals of virtual scenes requires tractable models for the simulation of light. The rendering equation describes one such model using an integral equation, the crux of which is a continuous integral operator. A majority of rendering algorithms aim to approximate the effect of this light transport operator via discretization (using rays, particles, patches, etc.). Research spanning four decades has uncovered interesting properties and intuition surrounding this operator. In this paper we analyze compactness, a key property that is independent of its discretization and which characterizes the ability to approximate the operator uniformly by a sequence of finite rank operators. We conclusively prove lingering suspicions that this operator is not compact and therefore that any discretization that relies on a finite-rank or nonadaptive finite-bases is susceptible to unbounded error over arbitrary light distributions. Our result justifies the expectation for rendering algorithms to be evaluated using a variety of scenes and illumination conditions. We also discover that its lower dimensional counterpart (over purely diffuse scenes) is not compact except in special cases, and uncover connections with it being noninvertible and acting as a low-pass filter. We explain the relevance of our results in the context of previous work. We believe that our theoretical results will inform future rendering algorithms regarding practical choices.
authors: Cyril Soler, Ronak Molazem, Kartic Subr

title: 可解析积分的零静止长度弹簧模型用于捕捉准静态神经网络未表示的动态模态
title_en: Analytically Integratable Zero-restlength Springs for Capturing Dynamic Modes unrepresented by Quasistatic Neural Networks.
abstract: 我们提出了一种新型范式,利用神经网络在实时环境中建模某些类型的动态模拟。为显著降低对数据(尤其是时间依赖数据)的要求以及减少泛化误差,我们的方法仅使用数据驱动的神经网络捕捉准静态信息(而非动态或时间依赖信息)。随后,我们通过(实时)动态模拟层增强准静态神经网络(QNN)的推理过程。我们的核心洞察是:当使用QNN近似时丢失的动态模态,可以通过一个相当简单(且解耦的)零静止长度弹簧模型进行捕捉,该模型可解析积分(而非数值积分),因此没有时间步长稳定性限制。此外,我们证明了弹簧本构参数可以从令人惊讶少量的动态模拟数据中稳健地学习。尽管我们通过考虑动画人体上的软组织动态来展示方法的有效性,但该范式可扩展到许多不同的模拟框架。
abstract_en: We present a novel paradigm for modeling certain types of dynamic simulation in real-time with the aid of neural networks. In order to significantly reduce the requirements on data (especially time-dependent data), as well as decrease generalization error, our approach utilizes a data-driven neural network only to capture quasistatic information (instead of dynamic or time-dependent information). Subsequently, we augment our quasistatic neural network (QNN) inference with a (real-time) dynamic simulation layer. Our key insight is that the dynamic modes lost when using a QNN approximation can be captured with a quite simple (and decoupled) zero-restlength spring model, which can be integrated analytically (as opposed to numerically) and thus has no time-step stability restrictions. Additionally, we demonstrate that the spring constitutive parameters can be robustly learned from a surprisingly small amount of dynamic simulation data. Although we illustrate the efficacy of our approach by considering soft-tissue dynamics on animated human bodies, the paradigm is extensible to many different simulation frameworks.
authors: Yongxu Jin, Yushan Han, Zhenglin Geng, Joseph Teran, Ronald Fedkiw

title: 基于单张人脸照片和语音信号的肖像线稿动画生成
title_en: Animating Portrait Line Drawings from a Single Face Photo and a Speech Signal.
abstract: 单张人脸照片的动画生成是计算机视觉和图形学领域的重要研究课题,已受到广泛关注。然而,作为历史悠久且广受欢迎的艺术形式,人脸肖像的线稿动画尚未在该领域得到充分探索。简单地将生成真实说话人脸视频的模型与照片到绘画风格迁移模块进行拼接,会面临严重的帧间不连续问题。为应对这一新挑战,我们提出了一种新颖的框架,基于单张人脸照片和语音信号生成艺术风格的说话肖像线稿动画视频。在从输入语音信号预测面部地标运动后,我们提出了一种新型生成对抗网络模型,同时处理照片到线稿的域迁移(domain transfer)和根据预测面部地标进行的面部几何变化。为解决帧间不连续问题,我们提出两种新型时间一致性损失函数:一种基于变形(warping-based),另一种基于时间一致性判别器(temporal coherence discriminator)。实验表明,我们的模型能够生成高质量的艺术风格说话肖像线稿动画视频,并优于基线方法。我们还展示了该方法可轻松扩展到其他艺术风格并生成良好结果。源代码可在https://github.com/AnimatePortrait/AnimatePortrait获取。
abstract_en: Animating a single face photo is an important research topic which receives considerable attention in computer vision and graphics. Yet line drawings for face portraits, which is a longstanding and popular art form, have not been explored much in this area. Simply concatenating a realistic talking face video generation model with a photo-to-drawing style transfer module suffers from severe inter-frame discontinuity issues. To address this new challenge, we propose a novel framework to generate artistic talking portrait-line-drawing video, given a single face photo and a speech signal. After predicting facial landmark movements from the input speech signal, we propose a novel GAN model to simultaneously handle domain transfer (from photo to drawing) and facial geometry change (according to the predicted facial landmarks). To address the inter-frame discontinuity issues, we propose two novel temporal coherence losses: one based on warping and the other based on a temporal coherence discriminator. Experiments show that our model produces high quality artistic talking portrait-line-drawing videos and outperforms baseline methods. We also show our method can be easily extended to other artistic styles and generate good results. The source code is available at https://github.com/AnimatePortrait/AnimatePortrait .
authors: Ran Yi 0002, Zipeng Ye, Ruoyu Fan, Yezhi Shu, Yong-Jin Liu 0001, Yu-Kun Lai, Paul L. Rosin

title: CCP: 可配置人群配置文件
title_en: CCP: Configurable Crowd Profiles.
abstract: 代理行为的多样性以及虚拟人群的异质性是群体模拟的重要方面,因为这对模拟结果的感知真实性和可信度至关重要。异质性人群是创建诸如博物馆展览等现实场景的基础,这些场景需要从基本的避障到与环境特征的复杂交互等多种代理行为。现有系统大多针对特定行为(如目标导向)进行优化,而忽视了其他行为及其相互作用如何形成多样化的代理配置文件。本文提出了一种基于强化学习的框架,用于同时学习多种代理行为。我们在训练过程中通过调整所选行为(目标导向、避障、与环境交互和群体形成)的重要性来优化代理策略;本质上,我们拥有一个在训练过程中动态变化的奖励函数。每个子行为的重要性作为输入添加到策略中,从而开发出一个能够捕捉并实现代理配置文件动态运行时操控的单一模型;因此实现了可配置的配置文件。通过一系列实验,我们验证了该系统使用户能够设计虚拟场景,控制和混合代理行为以创建个性配置文件,并为代理群体分配不同的配置文件。此外,我们展示了所提出的模型能够泛化到训练数据中未出现的情况,例如a) 高密度人群,b) 行为权重超出训练区间,以及c) 环境布局更复杂的场景。本文的代码、数据和训练策略可在https://github.com/veupnea/CCP获取。
abstract_en: Diversity among agents’ behaviors and heterogeneity in virtual crowds in general, is an important aspect of crowd simulation as it is crucial to the perceived realism and plausibility of the resulting simulations. Heterogeneous crowds constitute the pillar in creating numerous real-life scenarios such as museum exhibitions, which require variety in agent behaviors, from basic collision avoidance to more complex interactions both among agents and with environmental features. Most of the existing systems optimize for specific behaviors such as goal seeking, and neglect to take into account other behaviors and how these interact together to form diverse agent profiles. In this paper, we present a RL-based framework for learning multiple agent behaviors concurrently. We optimize the agent policy by varying the importance of the selected behaviors (goal seeking, collision avoidance, interaction with environment, and grouping) while training; essentially we have a reward function that changes dynamically during training. The importance of each separate sub-behavior is added as input to the policy, resulting in the development of a single model capable of capturing as well as enabling dynamic run-time manipulation of agent profiles; thus allowing configurable profiles. Through a series of experiments, we verify that our system provides users with the ability to design virtual scenes; control and mix agent behaviors thus creating personality profiles, and assign different profiles to groups of agents. Moreover, we demonstrate that interestingly the proposed model generalizes to situations not seen in the training data such as a) crowds with higher density, b) behavior weights that are outside the training intervals and c) to scenes with more intricate environment layouts. Code, data and trained policies for this paper are at https://github.com/veupnea/CCP.
authors: Andreas Panayiotou, Theodoros Kyriakou, Marilena Lemonari, Yiorgos Chrysanthou, Panayiotis Charalambous

title: 用于快速流体模拟的紧凑型泊松滤波器
title_en: Compact Poisson Filters for Fast Fluid Simulation.
abstract: 泊松方程出现在许多图形学场景中,包括但不限于基于物理的流体模拟。针对此类问题的数值求解器在特定上下文中需要在内存、性能、稳定性和准确性之间进行权衡。我们提出了一种新的基于泊松滤波器的求解器,平衡了谱方法和迭代方法的优势。我们推导了通用泊松核,用于正向和逆向泊松问题,通过精心设计的自适应滤波截断技术来局部化其范围,同时保持稳定性和准确性。我们紧凑滤波器的迭代组合相比优化的线性方法将求解器迭代时间提高了数量级。虽然受谱公式启发,我们克服了谱方法的重要局限性,同时保留了许多其 desirable 属性。我们专注于将该方法应用于高性能和高保真流体模拟,但也展示了其更广泛的应用性。我们发布源代码于 https://github.com/Ubisoft-LaForge/CompactPoissonFilters 。
abstract_en: Poisson equations appear in many graphics settings including, but not limited to, physics-based fluid simulation. Numerical solvers for such problems strike context-specific memory, performance, stability and accuracy trade-offs. We propose a new Poisson filter-based solver that balances between the strengths of spectral and iterative methods. We derive universal Poisson kernels for forward and inverse Poisson problems, leveraging careful adaptive filter truncation to localize their extent, all while maintaining stability and accuracy. Iterative composition of our compact filters improves solver iteration time by orders-of-magnitude compared to optimized linear methods. While motivated by spectral formulations, we overcome important limitations of spectral methods while retaining many of their desirable properties. We focus on the application of our method to high-performance and high-fidelity fluid simulation, but we also demonstrate its broader applicability. We release our source code at https://github.com/Ubisoft-LaForge/CompactPoissonFilters .
authors: Amir Hossein Rabbani, Jean-Philippe Guertin, Damien Rioux-Lavoie, Arnaud Schoentgen, Kaitai Tong, Alexandre Sirois-Vigneux, Derek Nowrouzezahrai

title: 单图像HDR重建方法比较——质量评估的注意事项
title_en: Comparison of single image HDR reconstruction methods - the caveats of quality assessment.
abstract: 随着从单次曝光重建高动态范围(HDR)图像的问题受到广泛关注,提供稳健的评估协议和清晰的比较指南变得至关重要。本工作中,我们在HDR显示器上进行主观图像质量实验,比较了六种近期的单图像HDR重建(SI-HDR)方法。我们发现,仅有两种方法在平均意义上优于未处理的单次曝光图像。当使用图像质量指标(如论文中通常所做的)评估相同方法时,指标预测与主观质量评分的相关性较差。主要原因在于参考图像与重建HDR图像之间存在显著的色调和颜色差异。为提高图像质量指标的预测准确性,我们提出在计算质量值前修正估计相机响应曲线的不准确性。我们进一步分析了评估SI-HDR方法时预测噪声的来源,并证明现有指标只能可靠预测较大的质量差异。
abstract_en: As the problem of reconstructing high dynamic range (HDR) images from a single exposure has attracted much research effort, it is essential to provide a robust protocol and clear guidelines on how to evaluate and compare new methods. In this work, we compared six recent single image HDR reconstruction (SI-HDR) methods in a subjective image quality experiment on an HDR display. We found that only two methods produced results that are, on average, more preferred than the unprocessed single exposure images. When the same methods are evaluated using image quality metrics, as typically done in papers, the metric predictions correlate poorly with subjective quality scores. The main reason is a significant tone and color difference between the reference and reconstructed HDR images. To improve the predictions of image quality metrics, we propose correcting for the inaccuracies of the estimated camera response curve before computing quality values. We further analyze the sources of prediction noise when evaluating SI-HDR methods and demonstrate that existing metrics can reliably predict only large quality differences.
authors: Param Hanji, Rafal Mantiuk, Gabriel Eilertsen, Saghi Hajisharif, Jonas Unger

title: 深度顺应控制
title_en: Deep Compliant Control.
abstract: 在许多物理交互场景中,如开门和进行体育运动,人类会以顺应的方式行动,以多种方式移动以避免大的冲击或操控物体。本文旨在构建一个框架,用于人形机器人的模拟与控制,以创建与环境的物理顺应交互。我们可以生成从被动反应外部物理扰动到具有明确意图的主动操控的广泛运动范围。技术挑战包括定义顺应性、再现物理可靠的运动以及在欠驱动动力系统下实现鲁棒控制。关键技术贡献是一种基于深度强化学习的两级控制架构,该架构在模仿人类运动的同时调整身体以适应外部扰动。控制器通过最小化交互力和模仿控制力矩来实现,我们通过包括开门、平衡球体和手拉手跑步等多种运动技能展示了控制器的有效性。
abstract_en: In many physical interactions such as opening doors and playing sports, humans act compliantly to move in various ways to avoid large impacts or to manipulate objects. This paper aims to build a framework for simulation and control of humanoids that creates physically compliant interactions with surroundings. We can generate a broad spectrum of movements ranging from passive reactions to external physical perturbations, to active manipulations with clear intentions. Technical challenges include defining compliance, reproducing physically reliable movements, and robustly controlling under-actuated dynamical systems. The key technical contribution is a two-level control architecture based on deep reinforcement learning that imitates human movements while adjusting their bodies to external perturbations. The controller minimizes the interaction forces and the control torques for imitation, and we demonstrate the effectiveness of the controller with various motor skills including opening doors, balancing a ball, and running hand in hand.
authors: Seunghwan Lee, Phil Sik Chang, Jehee Lee

title: 具有学习形状控制的深度可变形3D漫画
title_en: Deep Deformable 3D Caricatures with Learned Shape Control.
abstract: 3D漫画是对人类面部的夸张三维描绘。本文的目标是建立一个紧凑的参数空间来建模3D漫画的变体,从而提供一个有用的数据驱动工具包来处理3D漫画变形。为实现该目标,我们提出了一种基于MLP的框架来构建可变形表面模型,该模型输入一个潜在代码并生成3D表面。在该框架中,SIREN MLP建模一个函数,该函数输入固定模板表面的3D位置并返回输入位置的3D位移向量。我们通过学习一个超网络来创建3D表面变体,该超网络输入潜在代码并生成MLP的参数。一旦学习完成,我们的可变形模型为3D漫画提供了良好的编辑空间,支持基于标签的语义编辑和基于点控制的变形,这两种方法都能生成高度夸张且自然的3D漫画形状。我们还展示了该可变形模型的其他应用,如自动3D漫画创建。我们的代码和补充材料可在https://github.com/ycjungSubhuman/DeepDeformable3DCaricatures获取。
abstract_en: A 3D caricature is an exaggerated 3D depiction of a human face. The goal of this paper is to model the variations of 3D caricatures in a compact parameter space so that we can provide a useful data-driven toolkit for handling 3D caricature deformations. To achieve the goal, we propose an MLP-based framework for building a deformable surface model, which takes a latent code and produces a 3D surface. In the framework, a SIREN MLP models a function that takes a 3D position on a fixed template surface and returns a 3D displacement vector for the input position. We create variations of 3D surfaces by learning a hypernetwork that takes a latent code and produces the parameters of the MLP. Once learned, our deformable model provides a nice editing space for 3D caricatures, supporting label-based semantic editing and point-handle-based deformation, both of which produce highly exaggerated and natural 3D caricature shapes. We also demonstrate other applications of our deformable model, such as automatic 3D caricature creation. Our code and supplementary materials are available at https://github.com/ycjungSubhuman/DeepDeformable3DCaricatures.
authors: Yucheol Jung, Wonjong Jang, Soongjin Kim, Jiaolong Yang, Xin Tong 0001, Seungyong Lee 0001

title: 通过区分概率程序设计感知难题
title_en: Designing Perceptual Puzzles by Differentiating Probabilistic Programs.
abstract: 我们通过寻找人类感知原理模型的“对抗样本”来设计新的视觉错觉——具体而言,针对将视觉视为贝叶斯推断的概率模型。为高效执行此搜索,我们设计了一种可微概率编程语言,其API将MCMC推断作为一阶可微函数暴露出来。我们通过自动创建三种人类视觉特征的错觉来演示该方法:颜色恒常性、大小恒常性以及面孔感知。
abstract_en: We design new visual illusions by finding “adversarial examples” for principled models of human perception — specifically, for probabilistic models, which treat vision as Bayesian inference. To perform this search efficiently, we design a differentiable probabilistic programming language, whose API exposes MCMC inference as a first-class differentiable function. We demonstrate our method by automatically creating illusions for three features of human vision: color constancy, size constancy, and face perception.
authors: Kartik Chandra, Tzu-Mao Li, Joshua B. Tenenbaum, Jonathan Ragan-Kelley

title: 三维与反射率获取的微分同胚神经表面参数化
title_en: Diffeomorphic Neural Surface Parameterization for 3D and Reflectance Acquisition.
abstract: 本文提出了一种简单方法,解决了由自由移动相机拍摄且由自由移动点光源照明的未知通用表面材料物体的多视角三维重建问题。该物体可具有任意(漫反射或镜面)且空间变化的表面反射率。我们的解决方案由两个小型神经网络(称为“Shape-Net”和“BRDF-Net”)组成,用于将未知形状和材质图参数化为标准表面(例如单位球面)上的函数。我们的方法关键在于一种速度场形状表示,通过时间驱动标准表面向目标形状演化。我们证明该参数化可实现为一个递归残差网络,该网络被保证为微分同胚且方向保持。我们的方法提供了异常清晰的公式,无需初始化即可通过标准梯度下降进行优化,并适用于近场和远场光源。合成与真实实验验证了重建的可靠性与准确性,扩展应用包括新视角合成、重照明和材质修复,且操作简便。我们的源代码可在https://github.com/za-cheng/DNS获取。
abstract_en: This paper proposes a simple method which solves the problem of multi-view 3D reconstruction for objects with unknown and generic surface materials, imaged by a freely moving camera and lit by a freely moving point light source. The object can have arbitrary (diffuse or specular) and spatially-varying surface reflectances. Our solution consists of two small-sized neural networks (dubbed the ‘Shape-Net’ and ‘BRDF-Net’), used to parameterize the unknown shape and material map as functions on a canonical surface (e.g. unit sphere). Key to our method is a velocity field shape representation that drives the canonical surface to target shape through time. We show this parameterization can be implemented as a recurrent residual network that is guaranteed to be diffeomorphic and orientation-preserving. Our method yields an exceptionally clean formulation that can be optimized by standard gradient descent without initialization, and works with both near-field and distant light source. Synthetic and real experiments demonstrate the reliability and accuracy of our reconstructions, with extensions including novel-view-synthesis, relighting and material retouching done with ease. Our source codes are available at https://github.com/za-cheng/DNS.
authors: Ziang Cheng, Hongdong Li, Richard Hartley 0001, Yinqiang Zheng, Imari Sato

title: 基于对比学习的领域增强任意图像风格迁移
title_en: Domain Enhanced Arbitrary Image Style Transfer via Contrastive Learning.
abstract: 本文通过一种新颖的风格特征表示学习方法,解决任意图像风格迁移这一具有挑战性的问题。作为图像风格化任务的关键组成部分,合适的风格表示对于获得令人满意的结果至关重要。现有的基于深度神经网络的方法在内容特征的Gram矩阵等二阶统计量指导下取得了合理效果。然而,它们未能充分利用风格信息,导致局部失真和风格不一致等伪影。为解决这些问题,我们提出直接从图像特征而非其二阶统计量学习风格表示,通过分析多种风格之间的相似性与差异性,并考虑风格分布。具体而言,我们提出了对比任意风格迁移(CAST),这是一种通过对比学习实现的新型风格表示学习与风格迁移方法。我们的框架包含三个关键组件:用于风格编码的多层风格投影器、用于有效学习风格分布的领域增强模块,以及用于图像风格迁移的生成网络。我们进行了全面的定性和定量评估,证明我们的方法相比现有最先进方法取得了显著更好的效果。代码和模型可在https://github.com/zyxElsa/CAST_pytorch获取。
abstract_en: In this work, we tackle the challenging problem of arbitrary image style transfer using a novel style feature representation learning method. A suitable style representation, as a key component in image stylization tasks, is essential to achieve satisfactory results. Existing deep neural network based approaches achieve reasonable results with the guidance from second-order statistics such as Gram matrix of content features. However, they do not leverage sufficient style information, which results in artifacts such as local distortions and style inconsistency. To address these issues, we propose to learn style representation directly from image features instead of their second-order statistics, by analyzing the similarities and differences between multiple styles and considering the style distribution. Specifically, we present Contrastive Arbitrary Style Transfer (CAST), which is a new style representation learning and style transfer method via contrastive learning. Our framework consists of three key components, i.e., a multi-layer style projector for style code encoding, a domain enhancement module for effective learning of style distribution, and a generative network for image style transfer. We conduct qualitative and quantitative evaluations comprehensively to demonstrate that our approach achieves significantly better results compared to those obtained via state-of-the-art methods. Code and models are available at https://github.com/zyxElsa/CAST_pytorch.
authors: Yuxin Zhang, Fan Tang, Weiming Dong, Haibin Huang, Chongyang Ma, Tong-Yee Lee, Changsheng Xu

title: 基于贴图元对齐特征的可驱动体素化身
title_en: Drivable Volumetric Avatars using Texel-Aligned Features.
abstract: 逼真的远程临场感需要高保真身体建模和精确的驱动,以实现与现实无异的动态合成外观。本文提出一个端到端框架,解决真实人物全身化身建模与驱动的两个核心挑战。第一个挑战是保持细节与动态特征的忠实性,这些特征无法通过全局低维参数化(如身体姿态)捕捉。我们的方法支持驱动具有褶皱和超出训练数据集的运动表现的着装化身。不同于现有全局状态表示或非参数屏幕空间方法,我们引入贴图元对齐特征——一种局部化表示,可同时利用基于骨骼的参数化模型的结构先验和观测到的稀疏图像信号。第二个挑战是建模时间一致的着装化身,通常需要精确的表面跟踪。为解决此问题,我们提出一种新颖的体积化身表示方法,通过扩展体积素原语混合到可变形物体。通过显式引入运动学特性,我们的方法自然泛化到未见过的姿态。我们还引入局部视角条件化,显著提升了视角依赖外观的泛化能力。所提出的体积表示无需高质量网格跟踪作为前提条件,相比基于网格的方法在质量上取得显著提升。在实验中,我们仔细验证设计选择并展示了方法的有效性,在具有挑战性的驱动场景中超越了现有最先进方法。
abstract_en: Photorealistic telepresence requires both high-fidelity body modeling and faithful driving to enable dynamically synthesized appearance that is indistinguishable from reality. In this work, we propose an end-to-end framework that addresses two core challenges in modeling and driving full-body avatars of real people. One challenge is driving an avatar while staying faithful to details and dynamics that cannot be captured by a global low-dimensional parameterization such as body pose. Our approach supports driving of clothed avatars with wrinkles and motion that a real driving performer exhibits beyond the training corpus. Unlike existing global state representations or non-parametric screen-space approaches, we introduce texel-aligned features—a localised representation which can leverage both the structural prior of a skeleton-based parametric model and observed sparse image signals at the same time. Another challenge is modeling a temporally coherent clothed avatar, which typically requires precise surface tracking. To circumvent this, we propose a novel volumetric avatar representation by extending mixtures of volumetric primitives to articulated objects. By explicitly incorporating articulation, our approach naturally generalizes to unseen poses. We also introduce a localized viewpoint conditioning, which leads to a large improvement in generalization of view-dependent appearance. The proposed volumetric representation does not require high-quality mesh tracking as a prerequisite and brings significant quality improvements compared to mesh-based counterparts. In our experiments, we carefully examine our design choices and demonstrate the efficacy of our approach, outperforming the state-of-the-art methods on challenging driving scenarios.
authors: Edoardo Remelli, Timur M. Bagautdinov, Shunsuke Saito, Chenglei Wu, Tomas Simon, Shih-En Wei, Kaiwen Guo, Zhe Cao, Fabian Prada, Jason M. Saragih, Yaser Sheikh

title: EAMM:基于音频驱动的情绪感知运动模型的单次情绪说话人脸生成
title_en: EAMM: One-Shot Emotional Talking Face via Audio-Based Emotion-Aware Motion Model.
abstract: 尽管在音频驱动的说话人脸生成领域已取得显著进展,现有方法要么忽略面部情绪,要么无法应用于任意主体。本文提出情绪感知运动模型(EAMM),通过引入情绪源视频生成单次情绪说话人脸。具体而言,我们首先提出Audio2Facial-Dynamics模块,该模块从音频驱动的无监督零阶和一阶关键点运动中生成说话人脸。随后通过探索运动模型的特性,进一步提出隐式情绪位移学习器,将与情绪相关的面部动态表示为对先前获取运动表示的线性可加位移。综合实验表明,通过结合两个模块的结果,我们的方法能够在任意主体上生成具有真实情绪模式的满意说话人脸结果。
abstract_en: Although significant progress has been made to audio-driven talking face generation, existing methods either neglect facial emotion or cannot be applied to arbitrary subjects. In this paper, we propose the Emotion-Aware Motion Model (EAMM) to generate one-shot emotional talking faces by involving an emotion source video. Specifically, we first propose an Audio2Facial-Dynamics module, which renders talking faces from audio-driven unsupervised zero- and first-order key-points motion. Then through exploring the motion model’s properties, we further propose an Implicit Emotion Displacement Learner to represent emotion-related facial dynamics as linearly additive displacements to the previously acquired motion representations. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that by incorporating the results from both modules, our method can generate satisfactory talking face results on arbitrary subjects with realistic emotion patterns.
authors: Xinya Ji, Hang Zhou 0009, Kaisiyuan Wang, Qianyi Wu, Wayne Wu, Feng Xu 0005, Xun Cao

title: 用于折射新视角合成的射线场
title_en: Eikonal Fields for Refractive Novel-View Synthesis.
abstract: 我们解决从展示折射和反射物体的2D图像集合中生成新视角图像的问题。当前解决方案假设光沿直线传播,遵循发射-吸收模型。相反,我们优化一个3D变化的折射率(IoR)场,并追踪光线穿过该场,光线根据射线光传输定律弯曲至所述折射率的空间梯度。
abstract_en: We tackle the problem of generating novel-view images from collections of 2D images showing refractive and reflective objects. Current solutions assume opaque or transparent light transport along straight paths following the emission-absorption model. Instead, we optimize for a field of 3D-varying index of refraction (IoR) and trace light through it that bends toward the spatial gradients of said IoR according to the laws of eikonal light transport.
authors: Mojtaba Bemana, Karol Myszkowski, Jeppe Revall Frisvad, Hans-Peter Seidel, Tobias Ritschel 0001

title: 面挤出四边形网格
title_en: Face Extrusion Quad Meshes.
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于面循环建模操作的3D对象构建方法。我们的面挤出四边形(FEQ)网格具有类似艺术家手工制作3D模型的精心设计的面循环结构。此外,我们定义了一个构造图,该图编码了一系列作用于可接受面循环的基本挤出/塌缩和桥接/分离操作序列。我们展示了FEQ具有由面循环诱导的有意义形状骨架、部件分割、合理的构建历史,并具备基于挤出的3D建模的诸多优势。我们的评估包含三个方面:我们展示了一组转换为FEQ的具有引人注目的面循环结构的挑战性3D模型;我们通过基于FEQ的剪切粘贴和逆向建模应用,展示了内在构造图的潜力;我们还演示了各种算法和参数相关选择对FEQ建模与应用的影响。
abstract_en: We propose a 3D object construction methodology built on face-loop modeling operations. Our Face Extrusion Quad (FEQ) meshes, have a well designed face-loop structure similar to artist crafted 3D models. Furthermore, we define a construction graph which encodes a sequence of primitive extrude/collapse and bridge/separate operations that operate on admissible face-loops. We show that FEQs are imbued with a meaningful face-loop induced shape skeleton, part segmentation, plausible construction history, and possess the many advantages of extrusion-based 3D modeling. Our evaluation is threefold: we show a gallery of challenging 3D models transformed to FEQs with compelling face-loop structure; we showcase the potential of an inherent construction graph, using FEQ-based cut-paste and inverse modeling applications; and we demonstrate the impact of various algorithmic and parameter related choices for FEQ modeling and application.
authors: Karran Pandey, Jakob Andreas Bærentzen, Karan Singh 0004

title: 生成步态网
title_en: Generative GaitNet.
abstract: 理解解剖学与步态之间的关系是实现成功预测步态模拟的关键。本文提出生成步态网(Generative GaitNet),这是一种基于深度强化学习的新型网络架构,用于控制包含304个Hill型肌腱-肌肉结构的全面全身肌肉骨骼模型。生成步态网是一个预训练的集成系统,其人工神经网络在618维连续域中学习解剖条件(如质量分布、身体比例、骨骼畸形和肌肉缺陷)与步态条件(如步幅和步频)的综合数据。预训练的步态网以解剖和步态条件为输入,通过基于物理的模拟生成适配条件的步态周期序列。我们将展示生成步态网在实时基于物理的模拟中生成多种健康和病理人类步态的有效性与表达能力。
abstract_en: Understanding the relation between anatomy and gait is key to successful predictive gait simulation. In this paper, we present Generative GaitNet, which is a novel network architecture based on deep reinforcement learning for controlling a comprehensive, full-body, musculoskeletal model with 304 Hill-type musculotendons. The Generative GaitNet is a pre-trained, integrated system of artificial neural networks learned in a 618-dimensional continuous domain of anatomy conditions (e.g., mass distribution, body proportion, bone deformity, and muscle deficits) and gait conditions (e.g., stride and cadence). The pre-trained GaitNet takes anatomy and gait conditions as input and generates a series of gait cycles appropriate to the conditions through physics-based simulation. We will demonstrate the efficacy and expressive power of Generative GaitNet to generate a variety of healthy and pathological human gaits in real-time physics-based simulation.
authors: Jungnam Park, Sehee Min, Phil Sik Chang, Jaedong Lee, Moon Seok Park, Jehee Lee

title: Go Green: 一般正则化格林函数在弹性力学中的应用
title_en: Go Green: General Regularized Green's Functions for Elasticity.
abstract: 线弹性力学中无限大且各向同性介质的基本解(格林函数)在交互式图形应用中广泛存在,这些应用无法承担体积网格划分和有限元模拟的计算成本。例如,de Goes和James [2017] 的近期工作利用这些格林函数构建了实时捕捉广泛且物理上合理的变形的雕刻工具,比传统编辑笔刷更直观和真实。在本文中,我们通过利用一般线弹性材料的各向异性行为扩展这一类格林函数,其中材料的应力与应变关系取决于其取向。尽管这种更通用的框架会阻止其基本解的解析表达式存在,我们证明可以通过有限个球面调和函数的求和来分解格林函数,进一步将其分解为方向性、径向和材料相关项。从这种解耦中,我们展示了如何数值推导雕刻笔刷以生成各向异性变形,并实时精细控制其衰减轮廓。
abstract_en: The fundamental solutions (Green’s functions) of linear elasticity for an infinite and isotropic media are ubiquitous in interactive graphics applications that cannot afford the computational costs of volumetric meshing and finite-element simulation. For instance, the recent work of de Goes and James [2017] leveraged these Green’s functions to formulate sculpting tools capturing in real-time broad and physically-plausible deformations more intuitively and realistically than traditional editing brushes. In this paper, we extend this family of Green’s functions by exploiting the anisotropic behavior of general linear elastic materials, where the relationship between stress and strain in the material depends on its orientation. While this more general framework prevents the existence of analytical expressions for its fundamental solutions, we show that a finite sum of spherical harmonics can be used to decompose a Green’s function, which can be further factorized into directional, radial, and material-dependent terms. From such a decoupling, we show how to numerically derive sculpting brushes to generate anisotropic deformation and finely control their falloff profiles in real-time.
authors: Jiong Chen 0001, Mathieu Desbrun

title: 全息眼镜用于虚拟现实
title_en: Holographic Glasses for Virtual Reality.
abstract: 我们提出了全息眼镜,这是一种具有眼镜造型的全息近眼显示系统,用于虚拟现实。全息眼镜由瞳孔复制波导、空间光调制器和几何相位透镜组成,可在轻便且纤薄的形态下生成全息图像。所提出的方案通过2.5 mm厚度的光学堆叠即可实现全彩色3D全息图像。我们提出了一种新颖的瞳孔高阶梯度下降算法,用于在用户瞳孔尺寸变化时正确计算相位。我们实现了桌面和可穿戴原型进行测试。我们的双目可穿戴原型支持3D聚焦提示,提供22.8°的对角视野,静态眼盒尺寸为2.3 mm,并具备通过光束转向实现动态眼盒的额外功能,且不含驱动板仅重60 g。
abstract_en: We present Holographic Glasses, a holographic near-eye display system with an eyeglasses-like form factor for virtual reality. Holographic Glasses are composed of a pupil-replicating waveguide, a spatial light modulator, and a geometric phase lens to create holographic images in a lightweight and thin form factor. The proposed design can deliver full-color 3D holographic images using an optical stack of 2.5 mm thickness. A novel pupil-high-order gradient descent algorithm is presented for the correct phase calculation with the user’s varying pupil size. We implement benchtop and wearable prototypes for testing. Our binocular wearable prototype supports 3D focus cues and provides a diagonal field of view of 22.8° with a 2.3 mm static eye box and additional capabilities of dynamic eye box with beam steering, while weighing only 60 g excluding the driving board.
authors: Jonghyun Kim, Manu Gopakumar, Suyeon Choi, Yifan Peng 0001, Ward Lopes, Gordon Wetzstein

title: ImLoveNet: 基于错位图像支持的低重叠点云配准网络
title_en: ImLoveNet: Misaligned Image-supported Registration Network for Low-overlap Point Cloud Pairs.
abstract: 配对点云之间的低重叠区域导致捕获的特征置信度极低,使得前沿模型在点云配准中产生质量较差的结果。超越传统智慧,我们提出一个引人深思的问题:是否可以利用两个低重叠点云之间的中间错位图像来提升先进配准模型的性能?为回答这一问题,我们提出了一种针对低重叠点云对的基于错位图像支持的配准网络,命名为ImLoveNet。ImLoveNet首先在不同模态间学习三重深度特征,随后将这些特征输入两阶段分类器,逐步获取两个点云间的高置信度重叠区域。因此,在预测的重叠区域上建立了良好的软对应关系,从而实现精确的刚性变换配准。ImLoveNet简单易实现且效果显著,原因在于:1)错位图像为两个低重叠点云提供了更清晰的重叠信息,有助于更准确地定位重叠部分;2)其包含一定的几何知识,可提取更优的深度特征;3)无需依赖相对于三维点云参考系的成像设备外参参数。在多种基准数据集上的广泛定性和定量评估验证了ImLoveNet的有效性与优越性,优于现有先进方法。
abstract_en: Low-overlap regions between paired point clouds make the captured features very low-confidence, leading cutting edge models to point cloud registration with poor quality. Beyond the traditional wisdom, we raise an intriguing question: Is it possible to exploit an intermediate yet misaligned image between two low-overlap point clouds to enhance the performance of cutting-edge registration models? To answer it, we propose a misaligned image supported registration network for low-overlap point cloud pairs, dubbed ImLoveNet. ImLoveNet first learns triple deep features across different modalities and then exports these features to a two-stage classifier, for progressively obtaining the high-confidence overlap region between the two point clouds. Therefore, soft correspondences are well established on the predicted overlap region, resulting in accurate rigid transformations for registration. ImLoveNet is simple to implement yet effective, since 1) the misaligned image provides clearer overlap information for the two low-overlap point clouds to better locate overlap parts; 2) it contains certain geometry knowledge to extract better deep features; and 3) it does not require the extrinsic parameters of the imaging device with respect to the reference frame of the 3D point cloud. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations on different kinds of benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of our ImLoveNet over state-of-the-art approaches.
authors: Honghua Chen, Zeyong Wei, Yabin Xu, Mingqiang Wei, Jun Wang 0039

title: 从野外文档中学习以改进文档去扭曲
title_en: Learning From Documents in the Wild to Improve Document Unwarping.
abstract: 文档图像去扭曲对于文档数字化和分析至关重要。最先进的方法依赖于纯合成数据来训练用于去扭曲的深度网络。因此,当在真实世界图像上进行测试时,训练后的网络存在泛化限制,通常会产生令人不满意的结果。在本工作中,我们通过在训练中引入真实世界图像来改进文档去扭曲性能。我们收集了包含5000张捕获文档图像的Document-in-the-Wild (DIW)数据集,这些图像在内容、形状和捕获环境方面具有高度多样性。我们标注了所有DIW图像的边界,并用于弱监督学习。我们提出了一种新颖的网络架构PaperEdge,结合合成和真实文档图像进行训练。此外,我们识别并分析了文档去扭曲中流行评估指标(如MS-SSIM和Local Distortion (LD))的缺陷,并提出了一种更稳健可靠的误差度量方法Aligned Distortion (AD)。通过结合合成和真实世界文档图像进行训练,我们在流行基准上展示了最先进的性能,并通过全面的定量评估和消融研究验证了结果。代码和数据可在https://github.com/cvlab-stonybrook/PaperEdge获取。
abstract_en: Document image unwarping is important for document digitization and analysis. The state-of-the-art approach relies on purely synthetic data to train deep networks for unwarping. As a result, the trained networks have generalization limitations when testing on real-world images, often yielding unsatisfying results. In this work, we propose to improve document unwarping performance by incorporating real-world images in training. We collected Document-in-the-Wild (DIW) dataset contains 5000 captured document images with large diversities in content, shape, and capturing environment. We annotate the boundaries of all DIW images and use them for weakly supervised learning. We propose a novel network architecture, PaperEdge, to train with a hybrid of synthetic and real document images. Additionally, we identify and analyze the flaws of popular evaluation metrics, e.g., MS-SSIM and Local Distortion (LD), for document unwarping and propose a more robust and reliable error metric called Aligned Distortion (AD). Training with a combination of synthetic and real-world document images, we demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on popular benchmarks with comprehensive quantitative evaluations and ablation studies. Code and data are available at https://github.com/cvlab-stonybrook/PaperEdge.
authors: Ke Ma 0005, Sagnik Das, Zhixin Shu, Dimitris Samaras

title: 基于利普希茨正则化的平滑神经函数学习
title_en: Learning Smooth Neural Functions via Lipschitz Regularization.
abstract: 神经隐式场近年来作为一种有用的三维形状表示方法崭露头角。这些场通常表示为神经网络,将潜在描述符和三维坐标映射到隐式函数值。神经场的潜在描述符作为其表示的三维形状的变形控制柄。因此,相对于该描述符的平滑性对于执行形状编辑操作至关重要。在本文中,我们引入了一种新颖的正则化方法,通过惩罚场的利普希茨常数的上界来鼓励神经场中平滑的潜在空间。与之前的利普希茨正则化网络相比,我们的方法计算速度快,仅需四行代码即可实现,且对几何应用的超参数调优需求极低。我们在形状插值与外推以及从三维点云中进行部分形状重建任务中验证了所提方法的有效性,结果在定性和定量指标上均优于现有最先进的方法和非正则化基线。
abstract_en: Neural implicit fields have recently emerged as a useful representation for 3D shapes. These fields are commonly represented as neural networks which map latent descriptors and 3D coordinates to implicit function values. The latent descriptor of a neural field acts as a deformation handle for the 3D shape it represents. Thus, smoothness with respect to this descriptor is paramount for performing shape-editing operations. In this work, we introduce a novel regularization designed to encourage smooth latent spaces in neural fields by penalizing the upper bound on the field’s Lipschitz constant. Compared with prior Lipschitz regularized networks, ours is computationally fast, can be implemented in four lines of code, and requires minimal hyperparameter tuning for geometric applications. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on shape interpolation and extrapolation as well as partial shape reconstruction from 3D point clouds, showing both qualitative and quantitative improvements over existing state-of-the-art and non-regularized baselines.
authors: Hsueh-Ti Derek Liu, Francis Williams, Alec Jacobson, Sanja Fidler, Or Litany

title: 基于分层混合专家模型的足球顶球技能学习
title_en: Learning Soccer Juggling Skills with Layer-wise Mixture-of-Experts.
abstract: 基于物理的字符控制器在整合多样化运动技能方面仍面临挑战,这需要单一策略实现成功。我们提出了一种系统,基于深度强化学习学习多种足球顶球技能的控制策略。我们引入了任务描述框架,便于指定个体足球顶球任务及其过渡。期望的运动可以通过粗糙参考姿态的插值或基于动作捕捉数据进行构建。我们证明分层混合专家架构具有显著优势。训练过程中,通过自适应随机游走选择过渡,以支持高效学习。我们展示了脚、头、膝和胸部顶球、脚停、具有挑战性的环球技巧以及鲁棒的过渡。我们的工作为实现具备人类运动员精确运动技能的基于物理的字符提供了重要进展。代码可在https://github.com/ZhaomingXie/soccer_juggle_release获取。
abstract_en: Learning physics-based character controllers that can successfully integrate diverse motor skills using a single policy remains a challenging problem. We present a system to learn control policies for multiple soccer juggling skills, based on deep reinforcement learning. We introduce a task-description framework for these skills which facilitates the specification of individual soccer juggling tasks and the transitions between them. Desired motions can be authored using interpolation of crude reference poses or based on motion capture data. We show that a layer-wise mixture-of-experts architecture offers significant benefits. During training, transitions are chosen with the help of an adaptive random walk, in support of efficient learning. We demonstrate foot, head, knee, and chest juggles, foot stalls, the challenging around-the-world trick, as well as robust transitions. Our work provides a significant step towards realizing physics-based characters capable of the precision-based motor skills of human athletes. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhaomingXie/soccer_juggle_release.
authors: Zhaoming Xie, Sebastian Starke, Hung Yu Ling, Michiel van de Panne

title: 通过简化模型模仿学习臂行
title_en: Learning to Brachiate via Simplified Model Imitation.
abstract: 臂行是长臂猿和猩猩的主要运动方式,这些灵长类动物仅依靠手臂在树梢间摆动。由于控制权限有限、需要提前规划以及抓握精度要求高,控制臂行具有挑战性。我们提出了一种基于强化学习的新方法,并在无手指的14连杆平面模型上进行了验证,该模型能够学习在复杂抓握序列中完成臂行。我们的方法关键在于使用简化模型——带有虚拟手臂的质点模型,首先学习能够在指定抓握顺序下完成臂行的策略。这为完整模型策略的学习提供了指导,通过模仿整体质心轨迹以及抓握时机。最后,简化模型还可用于规划特定环境中的抓握序列。实验结果展示了飞行阶段和抓握阶段具有多种时长的臂行动作,以及在需要时涌现的额外来回摆动。系统通过多种消融实验进行评估。该方法为未来更通用的三维臂行研究奠定了基础,同时也为其他场景中的简化模型模仿应用提供了思路。视频、补充材料和代码请访问:https://brachiation-rl.github.io/brachiation
abstract_en: Brachiation is the primary form of locomotion for gibbons and siamangs, in which these primates swing from tree limb to tree limb using only their arms. It is challenging to control because of the limited control authority, the required advance planning, and the precision of the required grasps. We present a novel approach to this problem using reinforcement learning, and as demonstrated on a finger-less 14-link planar model that learns to brachiate across challenging handhold sequences. Key to our method is the use of a simplified model, a point mass with a virtual arm, for which we first learn a policy that can brachiate across handhold sequences with a prescribed order. This facilitates the learning of the policy for the full model, for which it provides guidance by providing an overall center-of-mass trajectory to imitate, as well as for the timing of the holds. Lastly, the simplified model can also readily be used for planning suitable sequences of handholds in a given environment. Our results demonstrate brachiation motions with a variety of durations for the flight and hold phases, as well as emergent extra back-and-forth swings when this proves useful. The system is evaluated with a variety of ablations. The method enables future work towards more general 3D brachiation, as well as using simplified model imitation in other settings. For videos, supplementary material and code, visit: https://brachiation-rl.github.io/brachiation.
authors: Daniele Reda, Hung Yu Ling, Michiel van de Panne

title: 习得起身技能
title_en: Learning to Get Up.
abstract: 从任意倒地状态起身是一项基本的人类技能。现有方法学习该技能时往往生成高度动态且不规则的起身动作,这些动作与人类起身策略不相符,或基于跟踪记录的人类起身动作。本文提出了一种分阶段方法,利用强化学习,无需依赖运动捕捉数据。该方法首先利用强大的角色模型,便于发现解决方案模式。第二阶段则学习适应控制策略,使其与逐渐弱化的角色版本协同工作。最后,第三阶段学习能够以更慢速度重现较弱起身动作的控制策略。我们证明,该方法在多次运行中能够发现多种多样的起身策略,并以不同速度执行这些策略。结果通常产生使用最终站立策略的政策,该策略在所有初始状态下恢复动作中均可见。然而,我们也发现针对俯卧和仰卧初始倒地状态,存在不同策略的政策。学习到的起身控制策略通常具有显著的静态稳定性,即可以在起身动作的多个阶段暂停。我们进一步在新颖的约束场景中测试了该方法,例如腿部和手臂被石膏固定的场景。
abstract_en: Getting up from an arbitrary fallen state is a basic human skill. Existing methods for learning this skill often generate highly dynamic and erratic get-up motions, which do not resemble human get-up strategies, or are based on tracking recorded human get-up motions. In this paper, we present a staged approach using reinforcement learning, without recourse to motion capture data. The method first takes advantage of a strong character model, which facilitates the discovery of solution modes. A second stage then learns to adapt the control policy to work with progressively weaker versions of the character. Finally, a third stage learns control policies that can reproduce the weaker get-up motions at much slower speeds. We show that across multiple runs, the method can discover a diverse variety of get-up strategies, and execute them at a variety of speeds. The results usually produce policies that use a final stand-up strategy that is common to the recovery motions seen from all initial states. However, we also find policies for which different strategies are seen for prone and supine initial fallen states. The learned get-up control strategies often have significant static stability, i.e., they can be paused at a variety of points during the get-up motion. We further test our method on novel constrained scenarios, such as having a leg and an arm in a cast.
authors: Tianxin Tao, Matthew Wilson, Ruiyu Gou, Michiel van de Panne

title: LeviPrint: 无接触制造中的细长部件全声学捕获
title_en: LeviPrint: Contactless Fabrication using Full Acoustic Trapping of Elongated Parts.
abstract: LeviPrint 是一种利用声学悬浮实现无接触物体组装的系统。我们探索了一组最优声学场,以实现细长物体(如棒状物)在位置和方向上的全捕获。随后评估了不同超声悬浮装置对动态操控这些细长物体的能力。新型优化算法与悬浮装置的结合,使棒状物、珠子和液滴的操控成为可能,从而制造复杂物体。由机械臂和悬浮装置组成的系统原型被用于不同制造工艺的测试。我们强调了交叉污染的减少,以及从不同角度和封闭空间内构建物体的能力。希望这项技术能启发新型制造方法,并应用于机电元件微制造或体内增材制造等领域。
abstract_en: LeviPrint is a system for assembling objects in a contactless manner using acoustic levitation. We explore a set of optimum acoustic fields that enables full trapping in position and orientation of elongated objects such as sticks. We then evaluate the capabilities of different ultrasonic levitators to dynamically manipulate these elongated objects. The combination of novel optimization algorithms and levitators enable the manipulation of sticks, beads and droplets to fabricate complex objects. A system prototype composed of a robot arm and a levitator is tested for different fabrication processes. We highlight the reduction of cross-contamination and the capability of building on top of objects from different angles as well as inside closed spaces. We hope that this technique inspires novel fabrication techniques and that reaches fields such as microfabrication of electromechanical components or even in-vivo additive manufacturing.
authors: Iñigo Fermín Ezcurdia, Rafael Morales 0003, Marco A. B. Andrade, Asier Marzo

title: 建筑模型的低多边形网格生成
title_en: Low-poly Mesh Generation for Building Models.
abstract: 作为一种常见做法,游戏建模师手动创建给定三维建筑模型的低多边形网格,以在元素数量较少和视觉相似性之间实现理想平衡。这一过程可能耗时数小时,并涉及繁琐的试错。我们提出了一种新颖且简单的算法,通过将高多边形三维建筑模型转换为既简单又保持视觉相似性的低多边形网格,以自动化这一过程。我们的算法包含三个阶段:首先,通过输入轮廓的布尔相交三维挤出操作生成一个无泄漏、无自碰撞的视觉体;随后,通过从输入部分导出的三维基本体进行布尔减法操作,从视觉体中雕刻出显著但冗余的结构;最后,我们从雕刻后的网格生成一个逐步简化的低多边形网格序列,并提取帕累托前沿,供用户选择所需的输出。我们方法的每个阶段均通过视觉指标引导,旨在保持与输入的视觉相似性。我们在包含100个不同风格建筑模型的数据集上测试了我们的方法,其中大部分用于流行数字游戏。通过与最先进的竞争技术进行比较,我们突出了方法的卓越鲁棒性和质量。本文的可执行程序可在 lowpoly-modeling.github.io 获取。
abstract_en: As a common practice, game modelers manually craft low-poly meshes for given 3D building models in order to achieve the ideal balance between the small element count and the visual similarity. This can take hours and involve tedious trial and error. We propose a novel and simple algorithm to automate this process by converting high-poly 3D building models into both simple and visually preserving low-poly meshes. Our algorithm has three stages: First, a watertight, self-collision-free visual hull is generated via Boolean intersecting 3D extrusions of input’s silhouettes; We then carve out notable but redundant structures from the visual hull via Boolean subtracting 3D primitives derived from parts of the input; Finally, we generate a progressively simplified low-poly mesh sequence from the carved mesh and extract the Pareto front for users to select the desired output. Each stage of our approach is guided by visual metrics, aiming to preserve the visual similarity to the input. We have tested our method on a dataset containing 100 building models with different styles, most of which are used in popular digital games. We highlight the superior robustness and quality by comparing with state-of-the-art competing techniques. Executable program for this paper is at lowpoly-modeling.github.io.
authors: Xifeng Gao, Kui Wu 0003, Zherong Pan

title: MoRF:可变形辐射场用于多视角神经头建模
title_en: MoRF: Morphable Radiance Fields for Multiview Neural Head Modeling.
abstract: 近年来的研究工作开发了强大的生成模型(例如StyleGAN2),这些模型能够合成具有令人印象深刻的逼真度的完整人脸图像,从而实现诸如逼真编辑真实照片等应用。虽然这些模型可以基于大量未摆姿势图像进行训练,但其缺乏显式的3D知识,使得在不无意改变身份特征的前提下实现基本的3D视角控制变得困难。另一方面,近期的神经辐射场(NeRF)方法已经实现了多视角一致的逼真渲染,但目前仍局限于单一面部身份。在本文中,我们提出了一种新的可变形辐射场(MoRF)方法,将NeRF扩展为一种生成神经模型,能够真实合成多视角一致的完整人脸图像,并支持可变且可控的身份特征。MoRF支持在特定身份之间进行变形、合成任意新身份,或从少量新主体图像快速生成NeRF,同时在新颖视角下提供真实且一致的渲染。我们通过利用高质量的多视角人像图像数据库对MoRF进行监督训练,该数据库包含多人在摄影棚中拍摄的图像,采用基于偏振的漫反射和镜面反射分离技术进行采集。本文展示了MoRF如何成为向3D神经头建模生成NeRF方法的重要进展。
abstract_en: Recent research work has developed powerful generative models (e.g., StyleGAN2) that can synthesize complete human head images with impressive photorealism, enabling applications such as photorealistically editing real photographs. While these models can be trained on large collections of unposed images, their lack of explicit 3D knowledge makes it difficult to achieve even basic control over 3D viewpoint without unintentionally altering identity. On the other hand, recent Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) methods have already achieved multiview-consistent, photorealistic renderings but they are so far limited to a single facial identity. In this paper, we propose a new Morphable Radiance Field (MoRF) method that extends a NeRF into a generative neural model that can realistically synthesize multiview-consistent images of complete human heads, with variable and controllable identity. MoRF allows for morphing between particular identities, synthesizing arbitrary new identities, or quickly generating a NeRF from few images of a new subject, all while providing realistic and consistent rendering under novel viewpoints. We train MoRF in a supervised fashion by leveraging a high-quality database of multiview portrait images of several people, captured in studio with polarization-based separation of diffuse and specular reflection. Here, we demonstrate how MoRF is a strong new step forwards towards generative NeRFs for 3D neural head modeling.
authors: Daoye Wang, Prashanth Chandran, Gaspard Zoss, Derek Bradley, Paulo F. U. Gotardo

title: Möbius变换在球面卷积神经网络中的应用
title_en: Möbius Convolutions for Spherical CNNs.
abstract: Möbius变换在几何学和球面图像处理中扮演着重要角色——它们是二维曲面的共形自同构群,也是球面空间中的仿射变换等价物。本文提出了一种新颖的Möbius等变球面卷积算子,我们称之为Möbius卷积;基于此,我们构建了Möbius等变球面卷积神经网络的基础框架。我们的方法基于以下观察:为了实现等变性,只需考虑将点的位置在邻居坐标系中变换的低维子群。为高效计算大规模Möbius卷积,我们推导了变换对球面滤波器作用的近似方法,从而能够在快速球面谐波变换的频域中计算卷积。所提出的框架具有灵活性和描述性,我们通过在形状分类和图像分割任务中取得有希望的结果验证了其有效性。
abstract_en: Möbius transformations play an important role in both geometry and spherical image processing – they are the group of conformal automorphisms of 2D surfaces and the spherical equivalent of homographies. Here we present a novel, Möbius-equivariant spherical convolution operator which we call Möbius convolution; with it, we develop the foundations for Möbius-equivariant spherical CNNs. Our approach is based on the following observation: to achieve equivariance, we only need to consider the lower-dimensional subgroup which transforms the positions of points as seen in the frames of their neighbors. To efficiently compute Möbius convolutions at scale we derive an approximation of the action of the transformations on spherical filters, allowing us to compute our convolutions in the spectral domain with the fast Spherical Harmonic Transform. The resulting framework is flexible and descriptive, and we demonstrate its utility by achieving promising results in both shape classification and image segmentation tasks.
authors: Thomas W. Mitchel, Noam Aigerman, Vladimir G. Kim, Michael Kazhdan

title: 神经三维野外重建
title_en: Neural 3D Reconstruction in the Wild.
abstract: 我们正在见证计算机视觉和图形学领域神经隐式表示的爆发式增长。其适用性已从形状生成和基于图像的渲染等任务扩展到基于图像的三维重建这一基本问题。然而,现有方法通常假设由少量近似均匀分布的相机捕捉的受约束三维环境中的恒定光照条件。我们提出了一种新方法,能够在存在变化光照条件下,从互联网照片集合中高效准确地进行表面重建。为实现这一目标,我们提出了一种混合体素和表面引导的采样技术,该技术可更高效地在表面周围进行光线采样,从而显著提升重建质量。此外,我们还提出了一种新的基准和评估协议,用于评估此类野外场景的重建性能。我们进行了大量实验,证明我们的方法在多种指标上均超越了经典和神经重建方法。代码和数据将在https://zju3dv.github.io/neuralrecon-w上公开。
abstract_en: We are witnessing an explosion of neural implicit representations in computer vision and graphics. Their applicability has recently expanded beyond tasks such as shape generation and image-based rendering to the fundamental problem of image-based 3D reconstruction. However, existing methods typically assume constrained 3D environments with constant illumination captured by a small set of roughly uniformly distributed cameras. We introduce a new method that enables efficient and accurate surface reconstruction from Internet photo collections in the presence of varying illumination. To achieve this, we propose a hybrid voxel- and surface-guided sampling technique that allows for more efficient ray sampling around surfaces and leads to significant improvements in reconstruction quality. Further, we present a new benchmark and protocol for evaluating reconstruction performance on such in-the-wild scenes. We perform extensive experiments, demonstrating that our approach surpasses both classical and neural reconstruction methods on a wide variety of metrics. Code and data will be made available at https://zju3dv.github.io/neuralrecon-w.
authors: Jiaming Sun 0002, Xi Chen 0079, Qianqian Wang 0002, Zhengqi Li, Hadar Averbuch-Elor, Xiaowei Zhou 0001, Noah Snavely

title: 神经网络分层双向反射分布函数
title_en: Neural Layered BRDFs.
abstract: 双向反射分布函数(BRDFs)被广泛应用于计算机图形学中,以生成逼真的基于物理的外观。许多现实世界中的常见材料具有多层结构,如木材、皮肤、汽车漆和多种装饰材料。然而,精确模拟分层材料的光学特性并不容易。最精确的方法依赖于蒙特卡洛随机游走来模拟层内的光传输,导致高方差和计算成本。其他方法虽然高效,但精度较低。在本文中,我们提出在神经网络空间中进行分层处理,通过提出的一种表示神经网络将BRDF压缩为潜在代码,并通过分层网络对这些潜在向量执行学习到的分层操作。与最先进的方法相比,我们的BRDF评估无噪声且计算效率高,这也是向在潜在空间中对BRDF进行“神经代数”操作迈出的第一步。
abstract_en: Bidirectional reflectance distribution functions (BRDFs) are pervasively used in computer graphics to produce realistic physically-based appearance. Many common materials in the real world have more than one layer, like wood, skin, car paint, and many decorative materials. However, precise simulation of layered material optics is non-trivial. The most accurate approaches rely on Monte Carlo random walks to simulate the light transport within the layers, leading to high variance and cost. Other approaches are efficient, but less accurate. In this paper, we propose to perform layering in the neural space, by compressing BRDFs into latent codes via a proposed representation neural network, and performing a learned layering operation on these latent vectors via a layering network. Our BRDF evaluation is noise-free and computationally efficient, compared to the state-of-the-art approach; it is also a first step towards a “neural algebra” of operations on BRDFs in a latent space.
authors: Jiahui Fan, Beibei Wang 0002, Milos Hasan, Jian Yang 0003, Ling-Qi Yan 0001

title: 神经阴影映射
title_en: Neural Shadow Mapping.
abstract: 我们提出了一种基础阴影映射的神经扩展方法,用于生成快速且高质量的硬阴影和软阴影。我们的方法在保持与光线追踪硬阴影和软阴影视觉效果相当的同时,相比快速预滤波阴影映射具有显著优势。我们证明通过结合内存带宽感知的架构专业化设计和细致的时序窗口训练,可以实现一种快速、紧凑且易于训练的神经阴影方法。该技术具有内存带宽意识特性,消除了后处理时序抗锯齿或降噪的需求,同时支持动态视角、光源和几何体场景,并对未见物体具有鲁棒性。
abstract_en: We present a neural extension of basic shadow mapping for fast, high quality hard and soft shadows. We compare favorably to fast pre-filtering shadow mapping, all while producing visual results on par with ray traced hard and soft shadows. We show that combining memory bandwidth-aware architecture specialization and careful temporal-window training leads to a fast, compact and easy-to-train neural shadowing method. Our technique is memory bandwidth conscious, eliminates the need for post-process temporal anti-aliasing or denoising, and supports scenes with dynamic view, emitters and geometry while remaining robust to unseen objects.
authors: Sayantan Datta, Derek Nowrouzezahrai, Christoph Schied, Zhao Dong 0001

title: NeuralPassthrough:面向VR的基于学习的实时视图合成方法
title_en: NeuralPassthrough: Learned Real-Time View Synthesis for VR.
abstract: 虚拟现实(VR)头显设备能够提供沉浸式的立体视觉体验,但代价是用户无法直接观察其物理环境。透传技术旨在通过外向摄像头重建用户未佩戴头显时所见的图像,以解决这一局限性。这本质上是一个实时视图合成挑战,因为透传摄像头无法与用户眼睛物理共置。现有透传技术存在令人分心的重建伪影,主要由于缺乏准确的深度信息(尤其是近场和遮挡恢复物体),同时图像质量也有限(例如低分辨率和单色)。本文提出首个基于学习的透传方法,并使用包含双目RGB摄像头的定制VR头显评估其性能。通过仿真和实验,我们证明所提出的基于学习的透传方法在图像质量上优于现有最先进的方法,同时满足桌面连接头显在宽视场角下实时、透视校正的立体视图合成的严格VR要求。
abstract_en: Virtual reality (VR) headsets provide an immersive, stereoscopic visual experience, but at the cost of blocking users from directly observing their physical environment. Passthrough techniques are intended to address this limitation by leveraging outward-facing cameras to reconstruct the images that would otherwise be seen by the user without the headset. This is inherently a real-time view synthesis challenge, since passthrough cameras cannot be physically co-located with the user’s eyes. Existing passthrough techniques suffer from distracting reconstruction artifacts, largely due to the lack of accurate depth information (especially for near-field and disoccluded objects), and also exhibit limited image quality (e.g., being low resolution and monochromatic). In this paper, we propose the first learned passthrough method and assess its performance using a custom VR headset that contains a stereo pair of RGB cameras. Through both simulations and experiments, we demonstrate that our learned passthrough method delivers superior image quality compared to state-of-the-art methods, while meeting strict VR requirements for real-time, perspective-correct stereoscopic view synthesis over a wide field of view for desktop-connected headsets.
authors: Lei Xiao, Salah Nouri, Joel Hegland, Alberto Garcia Garcia, Douglas Lanman

title: 基于可微代理的节点图优化
title_en: Node Graph Optimization Using Differentiable Proxies.
abstract: 基于图的程序化材质在内容生产行业中普遍存在。程序化模型允许通过参数控制创建逼真的材质,实现外观的灵活编辑。然而,设计特定材质在构建模型和精细调整参数方面是一个耗时的过程。先前的工作[Hu et al. 2022; Shi et al. 2020]引入了材质图优化框架以匹配目标材质样本。然而,这些方法受限于仅能优化图中的可微函数。本文提出了一种完全可微框架,即使图中某些函数不可微,也能实现材质图的端到端基于梯度的优化。我们利用可微代理(Differentiable Proxy),即对不可微黑盒函数的可微近似器。通过多阶段可微优化,我们使用该框架将输出材质的结构和外观与目标材质进行匹配。与先前工作相比,可微代理为材质外观匹配提供了更通用的优化方案。
abstract_en: Graph-based procedural materials are ubiquitous in content production industries. Procedural models allow the creation of photo-realistic materials with parametric control for flexible editing of appearance. However, designing a specific material is a time-consuming process in terms of building a model and fine-tuning parameters. Previous work [Hu et al. 2022; Shi et al. 2020] introduced material graph optimization frameworks for matching target material samples. However, these previous methods were limited to optimizing differentiable functions in the graphs. In this paper, we propose a fully differentiable framework which enables end-to-end gradient-based optimization of material graphs, even if some functions of the graph are non-differentiable. We leverage the Differentiable Proxy, a differentiable approximator of a non-differentiable black-box function. We use our framework to match structure and appearance of an output material to a target material, through a multi-stage differentiable optimization. Differentiable Proxies offer a more general optimization solution to material appearance matching than previous work.
authors: Yiwei Hu, Paul Guerrero 0001, Milos Hasan, Holly E. Rushmeier, Valentin Deschaintre

title: 从稀疏多视角视频中合成多人互动的新视角
title_en: Novel View Synthesis of Human Interactions from Sparse Multi-view Videos.
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的系统,可从非常稀疏的RGB摄像头中生成多人体表演者的自由视角视频。该系统从多视角视频中重建动态多人体场景的分层神经表示,每一层代表一个运动实例或静态背景。与需要实例分割作为输入的先前工作不同,本文提出了一种新颖的方法,通过弱监督方式将多人体场景分解为分层并重建每一层的神经表示,从而实现高质量的新视角渲染和精确的实例掩码。所提方法还解决了相机同步误差问题。实验结果表明,与先前方法相比,该系统在视角合成质量上具有优势,并且能够利用几个异步GoPro摄像头生成可编辑的真实足球比赛自由视角视频。数据集和代码可在https://github.com/zju3dv/EasyMocap 获取。
abstract_en: This paper presents a novel system for generating free-viewpoint videos of multiple human performers from very sparse RGB cameras. The system reconstructs a layered neural representation of the dynamic multi-person scene from multi-view videos with each layer representing a moving instance or static background. Unlike previous work that requires instance segmentation as input, a novel approach is proposed to decompose the multi-person scene into layers and reconstruct neural representations for each layer in a weakly-supervised manner, yielding both high-quality novel view rendering and accurate instance masks. Camera synchronization error is also addressed in the proposed approach. The experiments demonstrate the better view synthesis quality of the proposed system compared to previous ones and the capability of producing an editable free-viewpoint video of a real soccer game using several asynchronous GoPro cameras. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/zju3dv/EasyMocap .
authors: Qing Shuai, Chen Geng 0001, Qi Fang, Sida Peng, Wenhao Shen, Xiaowei Zhou 0001, Hujun Bao

title: Palette: 图像到图像扩散模型
title_en: Palette: Image-to-Image Diffusion Models.
abstract: 本文基于条件扩散模型开发了一个统一的图像到图像翻译框架,并在四个具有挑战性的图像到图像翻译任务(即上色、图像修复、裁剪恢复和JPEG修复)上评估了该框架。我们的图像到图像扩散模型简单实现超越了所有任务的强GAN和回归基线,无需任务特定的超参数调整、架构定制或任何辅助损失或复杂的新技术。我们揭示了去噪扩散目标中L2与L1损失对样本多样性的影响,并通过实证研究证明了自注意力在神经架构中的重要性。重要的是,我们倡导基于ImageNet的统一评估协议,包含人类评估和样本质量评分(FID、Inception分数、预训练ResNet-50的分类准确率以及与原始图像的感知距离)。我们期望这种标准化的评估协议能推动图像到图像翻译研究的发展。最后,我们展示了通用型、多任务扩散模型的表现与任务特定的专家型模型相当或更优。访问https://diffusion-palette.github.io/查看结果概览和代码。
abstract_en: This paper develops a unified framework for image-to-image translation based on conditional diffusion models and evaluates this framework on four challenging image-to-image translation tasks, namely colorization, inpainting, uncropping, and JPEG restoration. Our simple implementation of image-to-image diffusion models outperforms strong GAN and regression baselines on all tasks, without task-specific hyper-parameter tuning, architecture customization, or any auxiliary loss or sophisticated new techniques needed. We uncover the impact of an L2 vs. L1 loss in the denoising diffusion objective on sample diversity, and demonstrate the importance of self-attention in the neural architecture through empirical studies. Importantly, we advocate a unified evaluation protocol based on ImageNet, with human evaluation and sample quality scores (FID, Inception Score, Classification Accuracy of a pre-trained ResNet-50, and Perceptual Distance against original images). We expect this standardized evaluation protocol to play a role in advancing image-to-image translation research. Finally, we show that a generalist, multi-task diffusion model performs as well or better than task-specific specialist counterparts. Check out https://diffusion-palette.github.io/ for an overview of the results and code.
authors: Chitwan Saharia, William Chan, Huiwen Chang, Chris A. Lee, Jonathan Ho, Tim Salimans, David J. Fleet, Mohammad Norouzi 0002

title: 虚拟现实中眼动追踪失真校正的感知需求
title_en: Perceptual Requirements for Eye-Tracked Distortion Correction in VR.
abstract: 我们提出了一种虚拟现实显示系统模拟器,能够准确再现由任何观看光学系统产生的注视依赖失真。该模拟器硬件通过在高速电视上呈现立体失真并配合快门眼镜,支持快速原型设计,无需制造物理光学元件。我们进一步引入光场门户作为VR光学的高效通用表示方法,利用该模拟器实现实时仿真。该平台用于开展首次眼动追踪光学失真校正的感知需求用户研究。由于我们的硬件平台可促进一致的头部和眼动,使得这些需求在观察者、光学设计和场景内容之间可进行直接比较。我们最后介绍了一种基于光场门户的简单双眼失真度量,其与用户研究中识别的关键趋势一致,并为基于感知的失真度量和校正方案设计奠定了基础。
abstract_en: We present a virtual reality display system simulator that accurately reproduces gaze-contingent distortions created by any viewing optic. The simulator hardware supports rapid prototyping by presenting stereoscopic distortions on a high-speed television paired with shutter glasses, eliminating the need to fabricate physical optics. We further introduce light field portals as an efficient and general-purpose representation for VR optics, enabling real-time emulation using our simulator. This platform is used to conduct the first user study of perceptual requirements for eye-tracked optical distortion correction. Because our hardware platform facilitates consistent head and eye movements, it enables direct comparison of these requirements across observers, optical designs, and scene content. We conclude by introducing a simple binocular distortion metric, built using light field portals, which agrees with key trends identified in the user study and lays a foundation for the design of perceptually-based distortion metrics and correction schemes.
authors: Phillip Guan, Olivier Mercier, Michael Shvartsman, Douglas Lanman

title: 基于骨骼驱动运动网络的宽松服装变形预测
title_en: Predicting Loose-Fitting Garment Deformations Using Bone-Driven Motion Networks.
abstract: 我们提出了一种学习算法,利用骨骼驱动运动网络以交互速率预测宽松服装网格的变形。给定一件服装,我们生成模拟数据库,并通过皮肤分解从模拟网格序列中提取虚拟骨骼。在运行时,我们按顺序分别计算低频和高频变形。低频变形通过将身体运动转移到虚拟骨骼运动进行预测,高频变形则利用虚拟骨骼运动的全局信息和从低频网格中提取的局部信息进行估计。此外,我们的方法还可通过针对不同模拟参数集训练的RBF核集成网络,估计由模拟参数变化(如织物弯曲刚度)引起的服装变形。通过大量对比实验,我们证明了该方法在网格变形预测精度方面优于现有最先进的方法,其RMSE误差降低约20%,Hausdorff距离和STED降低约10%。代码和数据可在https://github.com/non-void/VirtualBones获取。
abstract_en: We present a learning algorithm that uses bone-driven motion networks to predict the deformation of loose-fitting garment meshes at interactive rates. Given a garment, we generate a simulation database and extract virtual bones from simulated mesh sequences using skin decomposition. At runtime, we separately compute low- and high-frequency deformations in a sequential manner. The low-frequency deformations are predicted by transferring body motions to virtual bones’ motions, and the high-frequency deformations are estimated leveraging the global information of virtual bones’ motions and local information extracted from low-frequency meshes. In addition, our method can estimate garment deformations caused by variations of the simulation parameters (e.g., fabric’s bending stiffness) using an RBF kernel ensembling trained networks for different sets of simulation parameters. Through extensive comparisons, we show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of prediction accuracy of mesh deformations by about 20% in RMSE and 10% in Hausdorff distance and STED. The code and data are available at https://github.com/non-void/VirtualBones.
authors: Xiaoyu Pan, Jiaming Mai, Xinwei Jiang, Dongxue Tang, Jingxiang Li, Tianjia Shao, Kun Zhou 0001, Xiaogang Jin 0001, Dinesh Manocha

title: QuickPose:密集场景中实时多视角多人姿态估计
title_en: QuickPose: Real-time Multi-view Multi-person Pose Estimation in Crowded Scenes.
abstract: 本文提出了一种实时算法,用于从多个校准视角重建密集场景中三维人体姿态。该问题的关键挑战在于高效匹配多个视角间的二维观测。先前方法在全身级别进行多视角匹配,易受二维姿态估计误差影响;或在部件级别进行匹配,忽略了同一视角中不同类型躯干部件之间的二维约束。相反,我们的方法在多视角匹配过程中考虑所有可能的骨架提案,其中每个骨架可能由任意数量的部件组成,而非仅限于全身或单个部件。为此,我们将多视角匹配问题建模为骨架提案空间中的模式搜索,并开发了一种名为QuickPose的高效算法以解决问题,从而实现密集场景中的实时动作捕捉。实验表明,所提出的算法在公开数据集上实现了速度和精度方面的最先进性能。
abstract_en: This work proposes a real-time algorithm for reconstructing 3D human poses in crowded scenes from multiple calibrated views. The key challenge of this problem is to efficiently match 2D observations across multiple views. Previous methods perform multi-view matching either at the full-body level, which is sensitive to 2D pose estimation error, or at the part level, which ignores 2D constraints between different types of body parts in the same view. Instead, our approach reasons about all plausible skeleton proposals during multi-view matching, where each skeleton may consist of an arbitrary number of parts instead of being a whole body or a single part. To this end, we formulate the multi-view matching problem as mode seeking in the space of skeleton proposals and develop an efficient algorithm named QuickPose to solve the problem, which enables real-time motion capture in crowded scenes. Experiments show that the proposed algorithm achieves the state-of-the-art performance in terms of both speed and accuracy on public datasets.
authors: Zhize Zhou, Qing Shuai, Yize Wang, Qi Fang, Xiaopeng Ji, Fashuai Li, Hujun Bao, Xiaowei Zhou 0001

title: ReLU Fields: 微小的非线性却能带来突破
title_en: ReLU Fields: The Little Non-linearity That Could.
abstract: 在许多近期研究中,多层感知机(MLPs)已被证明适合建模包括图像和3D场景在内的复杂空间变化函数。尽管MLPs能够以前所未有的质量与内存占用表示复杂场景,但这种表达能力以较长的训练和推理时间作为代价。另一方面,基于规则网格表示的双线性/三线性插值可提供快速的训练和推理时间,但若不显著增加额外内存则无法达到MLPs的质量水平。因此,本文研究了对网格表示进行何种最小改动,以在保持MLPs高保真结果的同时实现快速重建与渲染。我们引入了一个令人惊讶的简单改动——仅允许在插值网格值上使用固定非线性(ReLU)。当与由粗到细优化结合时,这种方案展现出与最先进方法相竞争的性能。我们在辐射场和占据场上报告了实验结果,并与多种现有方法进行了对比。论文代码和数据可访问 https://geometry.cs.ucl.ac.uk/projects/2022/relu_fields。
abstract_en: In many recent works, multi-layer perceptions (MLPs) have been shown to be suitable for modeling complex spatially-varying functions including images and 3D scenes. Although the MLPs are able to represent complex scenes with unprecedented quality and memory footprint, this expressive power of the MLPs, however, comes at the cost of long training and inference times. On the other hand, bilinear/trilinear interpolation on regular grid-based representations can give fast training and inference times, but cannot match the quality of MLPs without requiring significant additional memory. Hence, in this work, we investigate what is the smallest change to grid-based representations that allows for retaining the high fidelity result of MLPs while enabling fast reconstruction and rendering times. We introduce a surprisingly simple change that achieves this task – simply allowing a fixed non-linearity (ReLU) on interpolated grid values. When combined with coarse-to-fine optimization, we show that such an approach becomes competitive with the state-of-the-art. We report results on radiance fields, and occupancy fields, and compare against multiple existing alternatives. Code and data for the paper are available at https://geometry.cs.ucl.ac.uk/projects/2022/relu_fields.
authors: Animesh Karnewar, Tobias Ritschel 0001, Oliver Wang, Niloy J. Mitra

title: 使用可微渲染重建半透明物体
title_en: Reconstructing Translucent Objects using Differentiable Rendering.
abstract: 逆渲染是一种强大的方法,用于从照片中建模物体,我们扩展了先前技术以处理表现出次表面散射的半透明材料。通过使用异构双向散射-表面反射分布函数(BSSRDF)表示半透明性,我们将路径空间可微渲染框架扩展到同时处理表面和次表面反射。这引入了需要新方法的新类型路径,用于采样材料空间中由于可见性与移动几何体产生的移动不连续性。我们使用这种可微渲染方法,在一个粗到细的框架中,结合拉普拉斯预处理,从稀疏的测量2D图像中联合恢复异构半透明材料(由BSSRDF表示)和物体的详细几何结构(由网格表示)。为了在BSSRDF积分引入的蒙特卡洛噪声存在的情况下高效优化模型,我们引入了一种双缓冲方法来评估L2图像损失。这有效避免了由于图像像素及其导数估计之间的相关性导致的梯度估计潜在偏差,并即使在渲染器中使用低样本数时也能实现优化器的正确收敛。我们通过与有限差分进行比较来验证我们的导数,并通过与先前方法的逆渲染性能比较展示了我们技术的有效性。我们展示了在合成和真实世界半透明物体集上,与仅建模表面反射的先前方法相比,重建质量的优越性。
abstract_en: Inverse rendering is a powerful approach to modeling objects from photographs, and we extend previous techniques to handle translucent materials that exhibit subsurface scattering. Representing translucency using a heterogeneous bidirectional scattering-surface reflectance distribution function (BSSRDF), we extend the framework of path-space differentiable rendering to accommodate both surface and subsurface reflection. This introduces new types of paths requiring new methods for sampling moving discontinuities in material space that arise from visibility and moving geometry. We use this differentiable rendering method in an end-to-end approach that jointly recovers heterogeneous translucent materials (represented by a BSSRDF) and detailed geometry of an object (represented by a mesh) from a sparse set of measured 2D images in a coarse-to-fine framework incorporating Laplacian preconditioning for the geometry. To efficiently optimize our models in the presence of the Monte Carlo noise introduced by the BSSRDF integral, we introduce a dual-buffer method for evaluating the L2 image loss. This efficiently avoids potential bias in gradient estimation due to the correlation of estimates for image pixels and their derivatives and enables correct convergence of the optimizer even when using low sample counts in the renderer. We validate our derivatives by comparing against finite differences and demonstrate the effectiveness of our technique by comparing inverse-rendering performance with previous methods. We show superior reconstruction quality on a set of synthetic and real-world translucent objects as compared to previous methods that model only surface reflection.
authors: Xi Deng, Fujun Luan, Bruce Walter, Kavita Bala, Steve Marschner

title: 虹彩岩鸽颈部羽毛的渲染
title_en: Rendering Iridescent Rock Dove Neck Feathers.
abstract: 鸟类羽毛展现出迷人的反射特性,这由纤维状结构所主导。与毛发和毛皮不同,羽毛的几何结构遵循跨越多个数量级尺度的复杂层次化模式。在最小尺度上,纤维元件具有强烈非圆柱形的横截面,并常与规则的纳米结构相辅相成,从而产生丰富的结构色。因此,以往基于纤维或纹理的外观模型在渲染羽毛时遗漏了视觉特性中的关键方面。我们提出了一种新的羽毛建模与渲染框架,将微观几何结构和反射率抽象为类似微表面的双向反射分布函数(BSDF)。R、TRT和T光束,也见于毛发和毛皮中,分别对应于皮质层的镜面反射、髓质层的漫反射以及由于羽枝间距导致的透射。我们的BSDF无需预计算或存储,可高效进行重要性采样,并可便捷地集成到渲染管线中,该管线可将羽毛几何结构细化至羽枝层级。我们通过针对小型生物结构的BSDF捕捉装置,以及与校准照片对比的方式验证了该方法。
abstract_en: Bird feathers exhibit fascinating reflectance, which is governed by fiber-like structures. Unlike hair and fur, the feather geometric structures follow intricate hierarchical patterns that span many orders of magnitude in scale. At the smallest scales, fiber elements have strongly non-cylindrical cross-sections and are often complemented by regular nanostructures, causing rich structural color. Therefore, past attempts to render feathers using fiber- or texture-based appearance models missed characteristic aspects of the visual appearance. We introduce a new feather modeling and rendering framework, which abstracts the microscopic geometry and reflectance into a microfacet-like BSDF. The R, TRT and T lobes, also known from hair and fur, here account for specular reflection off the cortex, diffuse reflection off the medulla, and transmission due to barbule spacing, respectively. Our BSDF, which does not require precomputation or storage, can be efficiently importance-sampled and readily integrated into rendering pipelines that represent feather geometry down to the barb level. We verify our approach using a BSDF-capturing setup for small biological structures, as well as against calibrated photographs of rock dove neck feathers.
authors: Weizhen Huang, Sebastian Merzbach, Clara Callenberg, Doekele Stavenga, Matthias B. Hullin

title: 在曲面上渲染神经材质
title_en: Rendering Neural Materials on Curved Surfaces.
abstract: 神经材质反射率表示方法通过参数纹理解决了一些传统分析BRDF的局限性;它们理论上可以表示任何材质数据,无论是包含位移、阴影和相互反射的复杂合成微几何结构,还是真实测量的反射率。然而,它们仍然在无限平面上近似材质,这导致无法正确处理接近掠射方向的视图方向的轮廓和视差效应。本文的目标是设计一种能够正确处理此类轮廓效应的神经材质表示方法。我们扩展了神经网络查询,使其输入包含曲面曲率信息,同时将查询输出扩展为返回透明度值以及反射率。我们在包含多种曲面曲率查询的合成数据上训练了新的神经表示方法。我们展示了其准确表示传统上需要更昂贵且不灵活的技术(如实时几何位移或光线行进)才能实现的复杂轮廓行为的能力。
abstract_en: Neural material reflectance representations address some limitations of traditional analytic BRDFs with parameter textures; they can theoretically represent any material data, whether a complex synthetic microgeometry with displacements, shadows and inter-reflections, or real measured reflectance. However, they still approximate the material on an infinite plane, which prevents them from correctly handling silhouette and parallax effects for viewing directions close to grazing. The goal of this paper is to design a neural material representation capable of correctly handling such silhouette effects. We extend the neural network query to take surface curvature information as input, while the query output is extended to return a transparency value in addition to reflectance. We train the new neural representation on synthetic data that contains queries spanning a variety of surface curvatures. We show an ability to accurately represent complex silhouette behavior that would traditionally require more expensive and less flexible techniques, such as on-the-fly geometry displacement or ray marching.
authors: Alexandr Kuznetsov, Xuezheng Wang, Krishna Mullia, Fujun Luan, Zexiang Xu, Milos Hasan, Ravi Ramamoorthi
