title: 自蒸馏StyleGAN:面向从互联网照片生成
title_en: Self-Distilled StyleGAN: Towards Generation from Internet Photos.
abstract: StyleGAN以其生成高保真图像的能力而闻名,同时还能提供前所未有的语义编辑功能。然而,这些引人注目的能力仅在有限的数据集上得到验证,这些数据集通常结构对齐且精心整理。本文展示了如何将StyleGAN适应于从互联网上收集的原始未整理图像。此类图像集合对StyleGAN提出了两个主要挑战:它们包含大量异常图像,并呈现出多模态分布特征。在这样的原始图像集合上训练StyleGAN会导致图像合成质量下降。为应对这些挑战,我们提出了一种基于StyleGAN的自蒸馏方法,包含两个主要组件:(i) 基于生成的自过滤机制,用于消除异常图像以生成合适的训练集;(ii) 对生成图像进行感知聚类以检测固有的数据模态,进而改进StyleGAN在图像合成过程中的“截断技巧”。所提出的技术能够在保持数据多样性的同时生成高质量图像。通过定性与定量评估,我们验证了该方法在互联网新挑战性与多样性领域中的有效性。项目网站(https://self-distilled-stylegan.github.io/)提供了新数据集和预训练模型。
abstract_en: StyleGAN is known to produce high-fidelity images, while also offering unprecedented semantic editing. However, these fascinating abilities have been demonstrated only on a limited set of datasets, which are usually structurally aligned and well curated. In this paper, we show how StyleGAN can be adapted to work on raw uncurated images collected from the Internet. Such image collections impose two main challenges to StyleGAN: they contain many outlier images, and are characterized by a multi-modal distribution. Training StyleGAN on such raw image collections results in degraded image synthesis quality. To meet these challenges, we proposed a StyleGAN-based self-distillation approach, which consists of two main components: (i) A generative-based self-filtering of the dataset to eliminate outlier images, in order to generate an adequate training set, and (ii) Perceptual clustering of the generated images to detect the inherent data modalities, which are then employed to improve StyleGAN’s “truncation trick” in the image synthesis process. The presented technique enables the generation of high-quality images, while minimizing the loss in diversity of the data. Through qualitative and quantitative evaluation, we demonstrate the power of our approach to new challenging and diverse domains collected from the Internet. New datasets and pre-trained models are provided in our project website https://self-distilled-stylegan.github.io/.
authors: Ron Mokady, Omer Tov, Michal Yarom, Oran Lang, Inbar Mosseri, Tali Dekel, Daniel Cohen-Or, Michal Irani

title: 基于自监督后校正的蒙特卡洛去噪
title_en: Self-Supervised Post-Correction for Monte Carlo Denoising.
abstract: 使用由大量数据集训练的网络进行蒙特卡洛渲染的去噪正变得越来越流行。这种基于监督学习的去噪方法在质量方面目前被认为是最佳方案。然而,当待渲染图像(即测试数据)与训练数据集中的图像具有非常不同的特性时,这种方法可能会失效。从监督学习的角度来看,预训练网络可能无法正确去噪此类未见过的数据。为了解决这一根本性问题,我们引入了一个后处理网络来提升监督学习去噪器的性能。我们的方法核心思想是通过自监督学习训练该后处理网络。与监督学习不同,我们的自监督模型在训练过程中不需要参考图像。因此,我们可以使用带有噪声的测试图像,并实时自校正模型以提升去噪性能。我们的主要贡献是一种自监督损失函数,该函数可以在不依赖参考图像的情况下指导后校正网络优化其参数。我们的工作首次将自监督学习概念应用于蒙特卡洛渲染估计的去噪。我们证明了通过我们的自监督优化,后校正框架可以提升监督去噪性能。我们的实现可在 https://github.com/CGLab-GIST/self-supervised-post-corr 获取。
abstract_en: Using a network trained by a large dataset is becoming popular for denoising Monte Carlo rendering. Such a denoising approach based on supervised learning is currently considered the best approach in terms of quality. Nevertheless, this approach may fail when the image to be rendered (i.e., the test data) has very different characteristics than the images included in the training dataset. A pre-trained network may not properly denoise such an image since it is unseen data from a supervised learning perspective. To address this fundamental issue, we introduce a post-processing network that improves the performance of supervised learning denoisers. The key idea behind our approach is to train this post-processing network with self-supervised learning. In contrast to supervised learning, our self-supervised model does not need a reference image in its training process. We can thus use a noisy test image and self-correct the model on the fly to improve denoising performance. Our main contribution is a self-supervised loss that can guide the post-correction network to optimize its parameters without relying on the reference. Our work is the first to apply this self-supervised learning concept in denoising Monte Carlo rendered estimates. We demonstrate that our post-correction framework can boost supervised denoising via our self-supervised optimization. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/CGLab-GIST/self-supervised-post-corr.
authors: Jonghee Back, Binh-Son Hua, Toshiya Hachisuka, Bochang Moon

title: ShaderTransformer:通过单次嵌入预测着色器质量以实现快速简化
title_en: ShaderTransformer: Predicting Shader Quality via One-shot Embedding for Fast Simplification.
abstract: 在特定场景配置和目标函数下,自动着色器简化需从包含大量候选方案的优化空间中寻找最佳简化着色器变体。尽管已提出多种加速方法,但获取变体性能与质量的渲染与评估过程仍存在较高成本,尤其在场景变化时。本文提出一种基于深度学习的框架,用于预测着色器的简化空间,其中着色器变体可一次性嵌入到度量空间中以实现高效质量评估。该新颖框架支持对整个空间而非单个实例进行单次嵌入。此外,通过着色器片段间的相互注意力可解释简化误差,提出一种具有信息量的聚焦感知简化框架,可辅助专家优化代码。实验结果表明,新框架相比现有搜索方法实现了显著加速。聚焦感知简化框架揭示了着色器在多种应用中可解释性的新可能性。
abstract_en: Given specific scene configurations and target functions, automatic shader simplification searches for the best simplified shader variant from an optimization space with many candidates. Although various speedup methods have been proposed, there is still a costly render-and-evaluate process to obtain variant’s performance and quality, especially when the scene changes. In this paper, we present a deep learning-based framework for predicting a shader’s simplification space, where the shader’s variants can be embedded into a metric space all at once for efficient quality evaluation. The novel framework allows the one-shot embedding of a space rather than a single instance. In addition, the simplification errors can be interpreted by mutual attention between shader fragments, presenting an informative focus-aware simplification framework that can assist experts in optimizing the codes. The results show that the new framework achieves significant speedup compared with existing search approaches. The focus-aware simplification framework reveals a new possibility of interpreting shaders for various applications.
authors: Yuchi Huo, Shi Li, Yazhen Yuan, Xu Chen, Rui Wang 0004, Wenting Zheng, Hai Lin 0003, Hujun Bao

title: Shoot360: 从城市全景影像中生成正常视角视频
title_en: Shoot360: Normal View Video Creation from City Panorama Footage.
abstract: 我们提出Shoot360系统,该系统能够基于不同环境下的360度视频记录集,高效生成具有用户指定内容呈现方式和多种电影风格的多镜头正常视角视频。系统核心包含三步决策流程:1) 首先基于镜头单元对每个全景环境中的感兴趣内容进行语义分析,根据用户对内容呈现和电影风格的指定,生成指导信息以确定输出镜头的语义焦点和运动类型;2) 在获得指导信息后,依据拍摄规则生成每个镜头的视频候选方案,并通过镜头级控制参数实现视图投影;3) 系统进一步通过局部和全局约束条件对投影后的正常视角镜头进行聚合,该过程融合了从示例视频中学习到的外部知识及专业拍摄规则。大量实验验证了系统设计的有效性,我们最后探讨了其在更广泛场景中的应用前景。
abstract_en: We present Shoot360, a system that efficiently generates multi-shot normal view videos with desired content presentation and various cinematic styles, given a collection of 360 video recordings on different environments. The core of our system is a three-step decision process: 1) It firstly semantically analyzes the contents of interest from each panorama environment based on shot units, and produces a guidance that specifies the semantic focus and movement type of its output shot according to the user specification on content presentation and cinematic styles. 2) Based on the obtained guidance, it generates video candidates for each shot with shot-level control parameters for view projections following the filming rules. 3) The system further aggregates the projected normal view shots with the imposed local and global constraints, which incorporates the external knowledge learned from exemplar videos and professional filming rules. Extensive experiments verify the effectiveness of our system design, and we conclude with promising extensions for applying it to more generalized scenarios.
authors: Anyi Rao, Linning Xu, Dahua Lin

title: 野外单视角视图合成中的学习自适应多平面图像
title_en: Single-View View Synthesis in the Wild with Learned Adaptive Multiplane Images.
abstract: 本文研究了在真实场景中合成新视图的具有挑战性的任务。现有方法通过利用单目深度估计和分层深度表示的颜色修复技术取得了 promising 结果。然而,这些方法在处理具有复杂 3D 几何结构的场景时仍存在局限性。我们提出了一种基于多平面图像(MPI)表示的新方法。为适应野外场景的多样布局并解决生成高维 MPI 内容的困难,我们设计了一个包含两个新模块的网络结构:一个用于平面深度调整,另一个用于深度感知的颜色预测。前者通过 RGBD 上下文特征和注意力机制调整初始平面位置。在调整后的深度值基础上,后者通过特征掩码策略实现层间交互,分别预测每层的颜色和密度。为训练我们的方法,我们通过简单而有效的 warp-back 策略,仅使用无约束单视角图像集合构建大规模立体训练数据。在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明,我们的训练模型表现卓越,取得了 state-of-the-art 结果。
abstract_en: This paper deals with the challenging task of synthesizing novel views for in-the-wild photographs. Existing methods have shown promising results leveraging monocular depth estimation and color inpainting with layered depth representations. However, these methods still have limited capability to handle scenes with complex 3D geometry. We propose a new method based on the multiplane image (MPI) representation. To accommodate diverse scene layouts in the wild and tackle the difficulty in producing high-dimensional MPI contents, we design a network structure that consists of two novel modules, one for plane depth adjustment and another for depth-aware color prediction. The former adjusts the initial plane positions using the RGBD context feature and an attention mechanism. Given adjusted depth values, the latter predicts the color and density for each plane separately with proper inter-plane interactions achieved via a feature masking strategy. To train our method, we construct large-scale stereo training data using only unconstrained single-view image collections by a simple yet effective warp-back strategy. The experiments on both synthetic and real datasets demonstrate that our trained model works remarkably well and achieves state-of-the-art results.
authors: Yuxuan Han, Ruicheng Wang, Jiaolong Yang

title: 曲线网络的稳定性感知简化
title_en: Stability-Aware Simplification of Curve Networks.
abstract: 设计用于制造的曲线网络需要同时考虑结构稳定性、成本效益和视觉吸引力——这些复杂且相互关联的目标使得手动设计变得困难且繁琐。我们提出了一种新颖的制造感知曲线网络简化方法,通过算法选择给定3D曲线的稳定子集。传统上稳定性通过预定义负载引起的变形量进行衡量,但预测日常物体的施加力具有挑战性。相反,我们直接优化最坏情况负载下的最小变形。我们的技术贡献是提出了一种用于最坏情况稳定性的3D曲线网络简化新公式,导致混合整数半定规划问题(MI-SDP)。我们证明虽然直接求解MI-SDP不可行,但物理洞察力提示了一种高效的贪心近似算法。我们在多种曲线网络设计中展示了该方法的潜力,并通过数值实验验证其有效性,与更简单的替代方案相比。
abstract_en: Designing curve networks for fabrication requires simultaneous consideration of structural stability, cost effectiveness, and visual appeal—complex, interrelated objectives that make manual design a difficult and tedious task. We present a novel method for fabrication-aware simplification of curve networks, algorithmically selecting a stable subset of given 3D curves. While traditionally stability is measured as magnitude of deformation induced by a set of pre-defined loads, predicting applied forces for common day objects can be challenging. Instead, we directly optimize for minimal deformation under the worst-case load. Our technical contribution is a novel formulation of 3D curve network simplification for worst-case stability, leading to a mixed-integer semi-definite programming problem (MI-SDP). We show that while solving MI-SDP directly is infeasible, a physical insight suggests an efficient greedy approximation algorithm. We demonstrate the potential of our approach on a variety of curve network designs and validate its effectiveness compared to simpler alternatives using numerical experiments.
authors: William Neveu, Ivan Puhachov, Bernhard Thomaszewski, Mikhail Bessmeltsev

title: 笔触迁移:可动画化笔触风格的基于示例的合成
title_en: Stroke Transfer: Example-based Synthesis of Animatable Stroke Styles.
abstract: 我们提出了一种笔触迁移方法,用于在视角、光照条件和物体形状变化的动画场景中进行笔触的基于示例的合成。我们引入笔触场来指导笔触的生成,该笔触场由笔触的空间变化属性组成,包括其方向、长度、宽度和颜色。笔触被合成为空间场的积分曲线。本质上,我们将构成艺术笔触的元素分为风格特定的可迁移元素和实例固有属性。为生成笔触场,我们首先计算一组反映实例固有属性的向量场,然后通过从示例中学习到的风格特定权重函数将它们组合起来,这些权重在多种物体共享的代理特征空间中计算。使用我们方法渲染的动画捕捉了时变的视角、光照条件和物体形状,以及以示例形式提供的艺术风格。
abstract_en: We present stroke transfer, an example-based synthesis method of brushstrokes for animated scenes under changes in viewpoint, lighting conditions, and object shapes. We introduce stroke field for guiding the generation of strokes, consisting of spatially varying attributes of strokes, namely, their orientations, lengths, widths, and colors. Strokes are synthesized as the integral curves of the stroke field. In essence, we separate elements that constitute the artistic stroke into style-specific transferable elements and instance-intrinsic ones. To generate the stroke field, we first compute a set of vector fields that reflect the instance-intrinsic elements and then combine them using style-specific weight functions learned from exemplars, with the weights computed in a proxy feature space shared among a variety of objects. The rendered animation using our method captures time-varying viewpoint, lighting conditions, and object shapes, as well as the artistic style given in the form of exemplars.
authors: Hideki Todo, Kunihiko Kobayashi, Jin Katsuragi, Haruna Shimotahira, Shizuo Kaji, Yonghao Yue

title: StyleGAN-XL:将StyleGAN扩展到大规模多样化数据集
title_en: StyleGAN-XL: Scaling StyleGAN to Large Diverse Datasets.
abstract: 计算机图形学领域近期涌现出大量以数据为中心的方法,用于实现逼真且可控的内容生成。特别是StyleGAN在图像质量和可控性方面为生成建模树立了新标准。然而,StyleGAN在ImageNet等大规模无结构数据集上的性能显著下降。StyleGAN的设计初衷是可控性,因此先前研究认为其限制性设计不适合多样化数据集。相反,我们发现当前的训练策略是主要限制因素。遵循近期提出的投影GAN范式,我们利用强大的神经网络先验和渐进增长策略,成功在ImageNet上训练最新的StyleGAN3生成器。我们的最终模型StyleGAN-XL在大规模图像合成任务中达到新标杆,并首次在10242分辨率下实现此类数据规模的图像生成。我们证明该模型能够超越肖像或特定物体类别的狭窄领域进行图像反演与编辑。代码、模型和补充视频可在https://sites.google.com/view/stylegan-xl/获取。
abstract_en: Computer graphics has experienced a recent surge of data-centric approaches for photorealistic and controllable content creation. StyleGAN in particular sets new standards for generative modeling regarding image quality and controllability. However, StyleGAN’s performance severely degrades on large unstructured datasets such as ImageNet. StyleGAN was designed for controllability; hence, prior works suspect its restrictive design to be unsuitable for diverse datasets. In contrast, we find the main limiting factor to be the current training strategy. Following the recently introduced Projected GAN paradigm, we leverage powerful neural network priors and a progressive growing strategy to successfully train the latest StyleGAN3 generator on ImageNet. Our final model, StyleGAN-XL, sets a new state-of-the-art on large-scale image synthesis and is the first to generate images at a resolution of 10242 at such a dataset scale. We demonstrate that this model can invert and edit images beyond the narrow domain of portraits or specific object classes. Code, models, and supplementary videos can be found at https://sites.google.com/view/stylegan-xl/ .
authors: Axel Sauer, Katja Schwarz, Andreas Geiger 0001

title: 基于对称的3D重建:从概念草图中恢复设计意图
title_en: Symmetry-driven 3D Reconstruction from Concept Sketches.
abstract: 概念草图在工业设计中被广泛使用,本质上不精确,但能高度有效地向人类观察者传达三维形状。我们提出了一种新的对称驱动算法,用于从概念草图中恢复设计者意图的三维几何形状。我们观察到,大多数人工形状的概念草图都围绕局部对称构建块进行结构化,这些构建块由三组正交对称平面定义。我们通过结合二维对称性和绘图顺序来识别潜在的构建块。我们利用感知线索和对设计师绘图选择的观察来重建每个构建块。我们将此重建过程建模为一个整数规划问题,旨在从由近似笔触形成的大量候选对称对应关系中,识别出产生最对称且连接良好的形状的子集。我们通过重建82幅草图来验证方法的鲁棒性,这些草图表现出显著的过度草图、不准确的透视、部分对称性及其他缺陷。在比较研究中,参与者以2:1的比例认为我们的结果优于现有技术。
abstract_en: Concept sketches, ubiquitously used in industrial design, are inherently imprecise yet highly effective at communicating 3D shape to human observers. We present a new symmetry-driven algorithm for recovering designer-intended 3D geometry from concept sketches. We observe that most concept sketches of human-made shapes are structured around locally symmetric building blocks, defined by triplets of orthogonal symmetry planes. We identify potential building blocks using a combination of 2D symmetries and drawing order. We reconstruct each such building block by leveraging a combination of perceptual cues and observations about designer drawing choices. We cast this reconstruction as an integer programming problem where we seek to identify, among the large set of candidate symmetry correspondences formed by approximate pen strokes, the subset that results in the most symmetric and well-connected shape. We demonstrate the robustness of our approach by reconstructing 82 sketches, which exhibit significant over-sketching, inaccurate perspective, partial symmetry, and other imperfections. In a comparative study, participants judged our results as superior to the state-of-the-art by a ratio of 2:1.
authors: Felix Hähnlein, Yulia Gryaditskaya, Alla Sheffer, Adrien Bousseau

title: 时分复用神经全息:一种灵活框架用于具有快速高度量化空间光调制器的全息近眼显示
title_en: Time-multiplexed Neural Holography: A Flexible Framework for Holographic Near-eye Displays with Fast Heavily-quantized Spatial Light Modulators.
abstract: 全息近眼显示为虚拟现实和增强现实系统提供了前所未有的能力,包括感知上重要的焦点提示。尽管基于人工智能的计算机生成全息(CGH)算法近年来在提升全息图像质量与合成效率方面取得了显著进展,但这些算法无法直接应用于新兴的仅相位控制空间光调制器(SLM),这类SLM具有极高的速度但相位控制精度有限。这些SLM的速度提供了时分复用能力,本质上使部分相干全息显示模式成为可能。本文报告了针对此类全息近眼显示的校准波传播模型的进展,并开发了一种CGH框架,该框架能够稳健地优化快速SLM的高度量化相位图案。我们的框架灵活支持多种内容的运行时监督,包括2D和2.5D RGBD图像、3D焦堆栈以及4D光场。使用我们的框架,在仿真和实验中我们展示了所有这些场景的最先进结果。
abstract_en: Holographic near-eye displays offer unprecedented capabilities for virtual and augmented reality systems, including perceptually important focus cues. Although artificial intelligence–driven algorithms for computer-generated holography (CGH) have recently made much progress in improving the image quality and synthesis efficiency of holograms, these algorithms are not directly applicable to emerging phase-only spatial light modulators (SLM) that are extremely fast but offer phase control with very limited precision. The speed of these SLMs offers time multiplexing capabilities, essentially enabling partially-coherent holographic display modes. Here we report advances in camera-calibrated wave propagation models for these types of holographic near-eye displays and we develop a CGH framework that robustly optimizes the heavily quantized phase patterns of fast SLMs. Our framework is flexible in supporting runtime supervision with different types of content, including 2D and 2.5D RGBD images, 3D focal stacks, and 4D light fields. Using our framework, we demonstrate state-of-the-art results for all of these scenarios in simulation and experiment.
authors: Suyeon Choi, Manu Gopakumar, Yifan Peng 0001, Jonghyun Kim, Matthew O'Toole, Gordon Wetzstein

title: 无监督分部件3D形状集合的运动检测
title_en: Unsupervised Kinematic Motion Detection for Part-segmented 3D Shape Collections.
abstract: 制造对象的3D模型对于构建虚拟世界以及视觉和机器人领域的合成数据生成至关重要。为了最大程度地发挥作用,这些对象应具备可活动性:其部件在被交互时应能够运动。尽管存在可活动对象数据集,但创建这些数据集需要大量人力。基于学习的部件运动预测方法可以有所帮助,但所有现有方法都需要标注的训练数据。在本文中,我们提出了一种无监督方法,用于在分部件的3D形状集合中发现可活动运动。我们的方法基于一个我们称之为类别闭合的概念:任何有效的部件运动应保持物体在相同的语义类别中(例如,椅子仍然是椅子)。我们通过一种算法来具体化这一概念,该算法优化形状的部件运动参数,使其能够转换为集合中的其他形状。我们通过使用该方法重新发现PartNet-Mobility数据集中的部件运动来评估我们的方法。对于几乎所有形状类别,我们的方法预测的运动参数与真实标注的误差较低,优于两种监督运动预测方法。
abstract_en: 3D models of manufactured objects are important for populating virtual worlds and for synthetic data generation for vision and robotics. To be most useful, such objects should be articulated: their parts should move when interacted with. While articulated object datasets exist, creating them is labor-intensive. Learning-based prediction of part motions can help, but all existing methods require annotated training data. In this paper, we present an unsupervised approach for discovering articulated motions in a part-segmented 3D shape collection. Our approach is based on a concept we call category closure: any valid articulation of an object’s parts should keep the object in the same semantic category (e.g. a chair stays a chair). We operationalize this concept with an algorithm that optimizes a shape’s part motion parameters such that it can transform into other shapes in the collection. We evaluate our approach by using it to re-discover part motions from the PartNet-Mobility dataset. For almost all shape categories, our method’s predicted motion parameters have low error with respect to ground truth annotations, outperforming two supervised motion prediction methods.
authors: Xianghao Xu, Yifan Ruan, Srinath Sridhar 0002, Daniel Ritchie

title: 可变比特率神经场
title_en: Variable Bitrate Neural Fields.
abstract: 标量场和矢量场(如符号距离函数和辐射场)的神经近似方法已发展为准确且高质量的表示方式。通过将神经近似与可训练特征网格的查找表相结合,可以取得最先进的结果[ Liu et al. 2020; Martel et al. 2021; Müller et al. 2022; Takikawa et al. 2021 ],这些特征网格承担了部分学习任务,使得神经网络更小且更高效。不幸的是,这些特征网格通常相比独立神经网络模型会显著增加内存消耗。我们提出了一种字典方法来压缩此类特征网格,可将内存消耗减少高达100倍,并允许多分辨率表示,这对离线流式处理可能有用。我们将字典优化公式化为向量量化自解码器问题,从而在无直接监督且具有动态拓扑和结构的空间中学习端到端离散神经表示。我们的源代码可在https://github.com/nv-tlabs/vqad获取。
abstract_en: Neural approximations of scalar- and vector fields, such as signed distance functions and radiance fields, have emerged as accurate, high-quality representations. State-of-the-art results are obtained by conditioning a neural approximation with a lookup from trainable feature grids [Liu et al. 2020; Martel et al. 2021; Müller et al. 2022; Takikawa et al. 2021] that take on part of the learning task and allow for smaller, more efficient neural networks. Unfortunately, these feature grids usually come at the cost of significantly increased memory consumption compared to stand-alone neural network models. We present a dictionary method for compressing such feature grids, reducing their memory consumption by up to 100 × and permitting a multiresolution representation which can be useful for out-of-core streaming. We formulate the dictionary optimization as a vector-quantized auto-decoder problem which lets us learn end-to-end discrete neural representations in a space where no direct supervision is available and with dynamic topology and structure. Our source code is available at https://github.com/nv-tlabs/vqad.
authors: Towaki Takikawa, Alex Evans, Jonathan Tremblay, Thomas Müller 0013, Morgan McGuire, Alec Jacobson, Sanja Fidler

title: VoLux-GAN:一种用于三维人脸合成的生成模型,支持HDRI重照明
title_en: VoLux-GAN: A Generative Model for 3D Face Synthesis with HDRI Relighting.
abstract: 我们提出VoLux-GAN,一种生成框架,用于合成具有可信重照明效果的三维人脸。我们的主要贡献是一种体素HDRI重照明方法,能够高效地沿每个三维射线累积任意所需HDR环境图的漫反射和镜面光照贡献。此外,我们展示了使用多个判别器监督图像分解过程的重要性。特别是,我们提出了一种数据增强技术,利用近期单图像人像重照明领域的进展,强制保持几何形状、漫反射、镜面等组件的一致性。多项实验和与其他生成框架的比较表明,我们的模型在实现逼真可重照明的三维生成模型方面迈出了重要一步。代码和预训练模型可在:https://github.com/google/volux-gan 获取。
abstract_en: We propose VoLux-GAN, a generative framework to synthesize 3D-aware faces with convincing relighting. Our main contribution is a volumetric HDRI relighting method that can efficiently accumulate albedo, diffuse and specular lighting contributions along each 3D ray for any desired HDR environmental map. Additionally, we show the importance of supervising the image decomposition process using multiple discriminators. In particular, we propose a data augmentation technique that leverages recent advances in single image portrait relighting to enforce consistent geometry, albedo, diffuse and specular components. Multiple experiments and comparisons with other generative frameworks show how our model is a step forward towards photorealistic relightable 3D generative models. Code and pre-trained models are available at: https://github.com/google/volux-gan.

title: 面向几何精确辐射场的二维高斯点云
title_en: 2D Gaussian Splatting for Geometrically Accurate Radiance Fields.
abstract: 3D高斯点云(3DGS)最近革新了辐射场重建,实现了高质量的新视角合成和快速渲染速度。然而,由于3D高斯的多视角不一致性,3DGS无法准确表示表面。我们提出了一种新的方法——二维高斯点云(2DGS),用于从多视角图像中建模和重建几何精确的辐射场。我们的核心思想是将3D体积压缩为一组二维定向平面高斯圆盘。与3D高斯不同,2D高斯在内在建模表面的同时,提供了视角一致的几何。为了准确恢复薄表面并实现稳定优化,我们引入了一种利用光线-点云相交和光栅化的透视准确的2D点云生成过程。此外,我们结合了深度失真和法线一致性项,以进一步提升重建质量。我们证明,我们的可微分渲染器能够在保持具有竞争力的外观质量、快速训练速度和实时渲染的同时,实现无噪声且详细的几何重建。项目页面:https://surfsplatting.github.io.
abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has recently revolutionized radiance field reconstruction, achieving high quality novel view synthesis and fast rendering speed. However, 3DGS fails to accurately represent surfaces due to the multi-view inconsistent nature of 3D Gaussians. We present 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS), a novel approach to model and reconstruct geometrically accurate radiance fields from multi-view images. Our key idea is to collapse the 3D volume into a set of 2D oriented planar Gaussian disks. Unlike 3D Gaussians, 2D Gaussians provide view-consistent geometry while modeling surfaces intrinsically. To accurately recover thin surfaces and achieve stable optimization, we introduce a perspective-accurate 2D splatting process utilizing ray-splat intersection and rasterization. Additionally, we incorporate depth distortion and normal consistency terms to further enhance the quality of the reconstructions. We demonstrate that our differentiable renderer allows for noise-free and detailed geometry reconstruction while maintaining competitive appearance quality, fast training speed, and real-time rendering. Project page at https://surfsplatting.github.io.
authors: Binbin Huang, Zehao Yu 0002, Anpei Chen, Andreas Geiger 0001, Shenghua Gao

title: 用于头部虚拟形象动画的3D高斯混合形状
title_en: 3D Gaussian Blendshapes for Head Avatar Animation.
abstract: 我们引入3D高斯混合形状用于建模逼真头部虚拟形象。以单目视频作为输入,我们学习一个中性表情的基础头部模型,以及一组表情混合形状,每个形状对应经典参数化面部模型中的基础表情。中性模型和表情混合形状均表示为3D高斯,包含若干属性以描述虚拟形象外观。通过高斯线性混合与表情系数,可有效生成任意表情的虚拟形象模型。利用高斯点云渲染技术,可实时合成高保真头部虚拟形象动画。与最先进的方法相比,我们的高斯混合形状表示更好地捕捉输入视频中展现的高频细节,并实现了更优的渲染性能。
abstract_en: We introduce 3D Gaussian blendshapes for modeling photorealistic head avatars. Taking a monocular video as input, we learn a base head model of neutral expression, along with a group of expression blendshapes, each of which corresponds to a basis expression in classical parametric face models. Both the neutral model and expression blendshapes are represented as 3D Gaussians, which contain a few properties to depict the avatar appearance. The avatar model of an arbitrary expression can be effectively generated by combining the neutral model and expression blendshapes through linear blending of Gaussians with the expression coefficients. High-fidelity head avatar animations can be synthesized in real time using Gaussian splatting. Compared to state-of-the-art methods, our Gaussian blendshape representation better captures high-frequency details exhibited in input video, and achieves superior rendering performance.
authors: Shengjie Ma, Yanlin Weng, Tianjia Shao, Kun Zhou 0001

title: 基于延迟反射的三维高斯点云渲染
title_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting with Deferred Reflection.
abstract: 基于神经网络和高斯的辐射场方法在新视角合成领域取得了显著成功。然而,镜面反射仍具有挑战性,因为高频率辐射场因其难以稳定且准确地拟合而著称。我们提出了一种延迟着色方法,以有效渲染高斯点云中的镜面反射。关键挑战来自于环境贴图反射模型,该模型需要精确的表面法线,同时又因不连续梯度而限制了法线估计。我们利用延迟着色生成的每个像素反射梯度,连接相邻高斯的优化过程,使近似正确的法线估计能够逐步传播并最终覆盖所有反射物体。我们的方法在合成高质量镜面反射效果方面显著优于现有技术及同期工作,展示了在合成场景和真实场景中峰值信噪比(PSNR)的持续提升,同时运行帧率几乎与原始高斯点云渲染相同。
abstract_en: The advent of neural and Gaussian-based radiance field methods have achieved great success in the field of novel view synthesis. However, specular reflection remains non-trivial, as the high frequency radiance field is notoriously difficult to fit stably and accurately. We present a deferred shading method to effectively render specular reflection with Gaussian splatting. The key challenge comes from the environment map reflection model, which requires accurate surface normal while simultaneously bottlenecks normal estimation with discontinuous gradients. We leverage the per-pixel reflection gradients generated by deferred shading to bridge the optimization process of neighboring Gaussians, allowing nearly correct normal estimations to gradually propagate and eventually spread over all reflective objects. Our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art techniques and concurrent work in synthesizing high-quality specular reflection effects, demonstrating a consistent improvement of peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) for both synthetic and real-world scenes, while running at a frame rate almost identical to vanilla Gaussian splatting.
authors: Keyang Ye, Qiming Hou, Kun Zhou 0001

title: 4D-Rotor高斯点云:面向动态场景高效新视角合成的方法
title_en: 4D-Rotor Gaussian Splatting: Towards Efficient Novel View Synthesis for Dynamic Scenes.
abstract: 我们考虑动态场景的新视角合成(NVS)问题。近年来的神经方法已在静态三维场景中实现了卓越的NVS结果,但将其扩展到四维时变场景仍面临非平凡的挑战。先前的方法通常通过学习规范空间加隐式或显式形变场来编码动态信息,这在突然运动或生成高保真渲染等复杂场景中表现不佳。本文提出4D高斯点云(4DRotorGS),这是一种受静态场景中3D高斯点云方法[2023年Kerbl等]成功启发的新方法,通过各向异性四维XYZT高斯来表示动态场景。我们通过时间切片四维高斯在每个时间戳建模动态,自然组合动态三维高斯并可无缝投影到图像。作为显式的时空表示,4DRotorGS展现出强大的复杂动态建模和细节捕捉能力,尤其适用于存在突变运动的场景。我们进一步在高度优化的CUDA加速框架中实现时间切片和点云生成技术,在RTX 3090 GPU上实现最高277 FPS实时推理渲染速度,在RTX 4090 GPU上达到583 FPS。在包含多样运动的场景上的严格评估表明,4DRotorGS在效率和效果上均优于现有方法,定量和定性结果均保持领先。
abstract_en: We consider the problem of novel-view synthesis (NVS) for dynamic scenes. Recent neural approaches have accomplished exceptional NVS results for static 3D scenes, but extensions to 4D time-varying scenes remain non-trivial. Prior efforts often encode dynamics by learning a canonical space plus implicit or explicit deformation fields, which struggle in challenging scenarios like sudden movements or generating high-fidelity renderings. In this paper, we introduce 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DRotorGS), a novel method that represents dynamic scenes with anisotropic 4D XYZT Gaussians, inspired by the success of 3D Gaussian Splatting in static scenes [Kerbl et al. 2023]. We model dynamics at each timestamp by temporally slicing the 4D Gaussians, which naturally compose dynamic 3D Gaussians and can be seamlessly projected into images. As an explicit spatial-temporal representation, 4DRotorGS demonstrates powerful capabilities for modeling complicated dynamics and fine details—especially for scenes with abrupt motions. We further implement our temporal slicing and splatting techniques in a highly optimized CUDA acceleration framework, achieving real-time inference rendering speeds of up to 277 FPS on an RTX 3090 GPU and 583 FPS on an RTX 4090 GPU. Rigorous evaluations on scenes with diverse motions showcase the superior efficiency and effectiveness of 4DRotorGS, which consistently outperforms existing methods both quantitatively and qualitatively.
authors: Yuanxing Duan, Fangyin Wei, Qiyu Dai, Yuhang He, Wenzheng Chen, Baoquan Chen

title: 无需相机姿态的稀疏视角合成构建-优化方法
title_en: A Construct-Optimize Approach to Sparse View Synthesis without Camera Pose.
abstract: 从稀疏输入图像集合成新视角是一个具有重大实际意义的挑战性问题,尤其是在相机姿态缺失或不准确的情况下。直接优化相机姿态并使用神经辐射场算法估计的深度通常无法获得良好结果,这是由于姿态与深度之间的耦合关系以及单目深度估计的不准确性所致。本文利用近期的3D高斯点云方法,开发了一种无需相机姿态的稀疏视角合成构建-优化方法。具体而言,我们通过使用单目深度将像素投影回三维世界,逐步构建解决方案。在构建过程中,我们通过检测训练视角与相应渲染图像之间的二维对应关系来优化解决方案。我们开发了一个统一的可微分流程,用于相机配准和相机姿态与深度的调整,随后进行反投影。我们还引入了高斯点云中的新概念——预期表面,这对我们的优化至关重要。这些步骤使我们能够获得一个粗略的解决方案,然后通过标准优化方法进行低通滤波和细化。我们在Tanks and Temples和Static Hikes数据集上展示了结果,仅需三个广泛分布的视角即可获得显著优于竞争方法的质量,包括那些具有近似相机姿态信息的方法。此外,我们的结果随着视角数量的增加而提升,并且即使使用数据集的一半,也优于之前的InstantNGP和高斯点云算法。
abstract_en: Novel view synthesis from a sparse set of input images is a challenging problem of great practical interest, especially when camera poses are absent or inaccurate. Direct optimization of camera poses and usage of estimated depths in neural radiance field algorithms usually do not produce good results because of the coupling between poses and depths, and inaccuracies in monocular depth estimation. In this paper, we leverage the recent 3D Gaussian splatting method to develop a novel construct-and-optimize method for sparse view synthesis without camera poses. Specifically, we construct a solution progressively by using monocular depth and projecting pixels back into the 3D world. During construction, we optimize the solution by detecting 2D correspondences between training views and the corresponding rendered images. We develop a unified differentiable pipeline for camera registration and adjustment of both camera poses and depths, followed by back-projection. We also introduce a novel notion of an expected surface in Gaussian splatting, which is critical to our optimization. These steps enable a coarse solution, which can then be low-pass filtered and refined using standard optimization methods. We demonstrate results on the Tanks and Temples and Static Hikes datasets with as few as three widely-spaced views, showing significantly better quality than competing methods, including those with approximate camera pose information. Moreover, our results improve with more views and outperform previous InstantNGP and Gaussian Splatting algorithms even when using half the dataset.
authors: Kaiwen Jiang, Yang Fu, Mukund Varma T., Yash Belhe, Xiaolong Wang 0004, Hao Su 0001, Ravi Ramamoorthi

title: 用于泊松方程的微分蒙特卡洛求解器
title_en: A Differential Monte Carlo Solver For the Poisson Equation.
abstract: 泊松方程是具有广泛物理、工程和计算机图形学应用的重要偏微分方程(PDE)。传统方法求解泊松方程需要对域或其边界进行离散化,这对于具有复杂几何结构的域而言计算成本极高。为克服这一挑战,近期开发了一系列无网格蒙特卡洛求解方法。通过利用球面行走(WoS)过程,这些技术能够高效地在复杂域上求解泊松方程。本文提出了一种通用技术,用于对具有狄利克雷边界条件的泊松方程解进行微分。具体而言,我们设计了一种新的边界积分公式,用于计算任意参数(包括域形状)的导数。进一步,我们基于新公式开发了一种高效的球面行走技术——包括一种新的解场法向导数估计方法。我们通过多个合成示例验证了所提技术相较于基线方法的有效性。
abstract_en: The Poisson equation is an important partial differential equation (PDE) with numerous applications in physics, engineering, and computer graphics. Conventional solutions to the Poisson equation require discretizing the domain or its boundary, which can be very expensive for domains with detailed geometries. To overcome this challenge, a family of grid-free Monte Carlo solutions has recently been developed. By utilizing walk-on-sphere (WoS) processes, these techniques are capable of efficiently solving the Poisson equation over complex domains. In this paper, we introduce a general technique that differentiates solutions to the Poisson equation with Dirichlet boundary conditions. Specifically, we devise a new boundary-integral formulation for the derivatives with respect to arbitrary parameters including shapes of the domain. Further, we develop an efficient walk-on-spheres technique based on our new formulation—including a new approach to estimate normal derivatives of the solution field. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our technique over baseline methods using several synthetic examples.
authors: Zihan Yu, Lifan Wu, Zhiqian Zhou, Shuang Zhao

title: 有限元与材料点方法的动态组合
title_en: A Dynamic Duo of Finite Elements and Material Points.
abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法,将有限元方法(FEM)与材料点方法(MPM)进行耦合。有限元方法通常用于建模拉格朗日固体(如肉体、布料、头发和刚体),而材料点方法则适用于模拟经历显著变形和拓扑变化的材料,包括牛顿/非牛顿流体、颗粒材料和断裂材料。这两种方法的耦合挑战源于其截然不同的计算需求:隐式有限元积分通常更受青睐以获得稳定性与大时间步长,而显式材料点积分则因其允许高效的GPU优化和不同塑性模型的灵活应用,仅允许中等时间步长。为弥合这一差距,提出了一种混合隐式-显式时间积分(IMEX)方法,利用偏微分方程的时间分裂原理和基于优化的时间积分器。该方法采用增量势接触(IPC)定义两种材料间的变分摩擦接触模型,作为主要的耦合机制。我们的方法使隐式有限元和显式材料点方法能够在显著不同的时间步长下共存,同时保持双向耦合。实验结果展示了该方法在多材料模拟领域作为未来探索和增强的坚实基础的潜力。
abstract_en: This paper presents a novel method to couple Finite Element Methods (FEM), typically employed for modeling Lagrangian solids such as flesh, cloth, hair, and rigid bodies, with Material Point Methods (MPM), which are well-suited for simulating materials undergoing substantial deformation and topology change, including Newtonian/non-Newtonian fluid, granular materials, and fracturing materials. The challenge of coupling these diverse methods arises from their contrasting computational needs: implicit FEM integration is often favored to enjoy stability and large timesteps, while explicit MPM integration benefits from its allowance for efficient GPU optimization and flexibility of applying different plasticity models, which only allows for moderate timesteps. To bridge this gap, a mixed implicit-explicit time integration (IMEX) approach is proposed, utilizing principles from time splitting for partial differential equations and optimization-based time integrators. This method adopts incremental potential contact (IPC) to define a variational frictional contact model between the two materials, serving as the primary coupling mechanism. Our method enables implicit FEM and explicit MPM to coexist with significantly different timestep sizes while preserving two-way coupling. Experimental results demonstrate the potential of our method as a strong foundation for future exploration and enhancement in the field of multi-material simulation.
authors: Xuan Li 0015, Minchen Li, Xuchen Han, Huamin Wang 0001, Yin Yang 0002, Chenfanfu Jiang

title: 一种用于一致定向三维点云法线的线性方法
title_en: A Linear Method to Consistently Orient Normals of a 3D Point Cloud.
abstract: 正确且一致地对三维点云采样表面的法向量集合进行定向是进一步处理采样三维几何体(如表面重建和配准)所必需的困难过程。其困难在于,无法通过不考虑整个点云全局信息的方式来实现正确的定向。我们提出了一种算法,用于对大小为N的三维点云法线集合进行定向,其主要计算组件是基于经典斯托克斯定理推导出的O(N)线性系统的最小二乘解,该系统主要为稀疏矩阵。实验表明,我们的方法能够在远低于现有先进方法所需时间的情况下,成功地对包含中等噪声量的点云局部计算的法线集合进行定向,同时也能处理具有非光滑特征(如角落和边缘)的三维表面。
abstract_en: Correctly and consistently orienting a set of normal vectors associated with a point cloud sampled from a surface in 3D is a difficult procedure necessary for further downstream processing of sampled 3D geometry, such as surface reconstruction and registration. It is difficult because correct orientation cannot be achieved without global considerations of the entire point cloud. We present an algorithm to orient a given set of normals of a 3D point cloud of size N, whose main computational component is the least-squares solution of an O(N) linear system, mostly sparse, derived from the classical Stokes’ theorem. We show experimentally that our method can successfully orient sets of normals computed locally from point clouds containing a moderate amount of noise, representing also 3D surfaces with non-smooth features (such as corners and edges), in a fraction of the time required by state-of-the-art methods.
authors: Craig Gotsman, Kai Hormann

title: 一种逼真多尺度基于表面的织物外观模型

title: 一种基于模糊逻辑的统一可微布尔运算符
title_en: A Unified Differentiable Boolean Operator with Fuzzy Logic.
abstract: 本文提出了一种用于构造实体几何(CSG)隐式实体建模的统一可微布尔运算符。传统CSG依赖于min、max运算符对隐式形状进行布尔运算。但由于这些布尔运算符在操作选择上具有不连续性和离散性,这使得对CSG表示的优化变得具有挑战性。受模糊逻辑启发,我们提出了一种统一的布尔运算符,该运算符输出连续函数且对运算类型可微。这使得能够使用连续优化技术(如梯度下降)同时优化CSG中使用的原始形状和布尔运算。我们进一步证明,这种连续布尔运算符能够在同一框架下建模尖锐机械物体和光滑有机形状。所提出的布尔运算符为未来实现完全连续CSG优化的研究开辟了新可能性。
abstract_en: This paper presents a unified differentiable boolean operator for implicit solid shape modeling using Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG). Traditional CSG relies on min, max operators to perform boolean operations on implicit shapes. But because these boolean operators are discontinuous and discrete in the choice of operations, this makes optimization over the CSG representation challenging. Drawing inspiration from fuzzy logic, we present a unified boolean operator that outputs a continuous function and is differentiable with respect to operator types. This enables optimization of both the primitives and the boolean operations employed in CSG with continuous optimization techniques, such as gradient descent. We further demonstrate that such a continuous boolean operator allows the modeling of both sharp mechanical objects and smooth organic shapes with the same framework. Our proposed boolean operator opens up new possibilities for future research toward fully continuous CSG optimization.
authors: Hsueh-Ti Derek Liu, Maneesh Agrawala, Cem Yuksel, Tim Omernick, Vinith Misra, Stefano Corazza, Morgan McGuire, Victor B. Zordan

title: AONeuS:一种用于声光传感器融合的神经渲染框架
title_en: AONeuS: A Neural Rendering Framework for Acoustic-Optical Sensor Fusion.
abstract: 水下感知和3D表面重建是具有广泛应用的挑战性问题,在建筑、安全、海洋考古和环境监测等领域均有重要应用。恶劣的操作条件、脆弱的环境以及有限的导航控制往往迫使潜水器限制其运动范围,从而导致其可采集测量数据的基线范围受限。在3D场景重建领域,已知较小的基线会使重建工作更具挑战性。我们的工作开发了一种基于物理的多模态声光神经表面重建框架(AONeuS),能够有效融合高分辨率RGB测量数据与低分辨率深度分辨成像声呐测量数据。通过融合这些互补的模态,我们的框架可以从在高度受限基线条件下采集的测量数据中重建出高精度的高分辨率3D表面。通过大量模拟和实验室实验,我们证明AONeuS显著优于近期基于逆可微渲染的仅RGB和仅声呐表面重建方法。
abstract_en: Underwater perception and 3D surface reconstruction are challenging problems with broad applications in construction, security, marine archaeology, and environmental monitoring. Treacherous operating conditions, fragile surroundings, and limited navigation control often dictate that submersibles restrict their range of motion and, thus, the baseline over which they can capture measurements. In the context of 3D scene reconstruction, it is well-known that smaller baselines make reconstruction more challenging. Our work develops a physics-based multimodal acoustic-optical neural surface reconstruction framework (AONeuS) capable of effectively integrating high-resolution RGB measurements with low-resolution depth-resolved imaging sonar measurements. By fusing these complementary modalities, our framework can reconstruct accurate high-resolution 3D surfaces from measurements captured over heavily-restricted baselines. Through extensive simulations and in-lab experiments, we demonstrate that AONeuS dramatically outperforms recent RGB-only and sonar-only inverse-differentiable-rendering–based surface reconstruction methods.
authors: Mohamad Qadri, Kevin Zhang 0003, Akshay Hinduja, Michael Kaess, Adithya Pediredla, Christopher A. Metzler

title: 通过空间与时间跨模态错位加速扫视反应
title_en: Accelerating Saccadic Response through Spatial and Temporal Cross-Modal Misalignments.
abstract: 人类的感知与认知是我们探索外部世界的重要机制。在此背景下,视觉扫视——快速且协调的眼动——是感知周围环境的主要工具。通常,我们的感知不仅限于视觉刺激,还通过跨模态交互得到丰富,例如视觉与听觉的结合。本研究探讨了这些交互的时间与空间关系,重点分析了先于视觉刺激的听觉线索如何影响扫视潜伏期——即眼睛对视觉目标做出反应并开始移动所需的时间。我们的研究在虚拟现实环境中进行,揭示了先于视觉信息的听觉线索可显著加速扫视反应,但该效应在特定时间阈值后趋于平稳。此外,尽管视觉刺激的空间位置会影响这些眼动的速度(如先前研究所示),但我们发现听觉线索相对于其对应视觉刺激的位置并无类似影响。为验证我们的发现,我们实施了两个实际应用:首先,在更真实的环境中设置包含复杂视听信号的篮球训练任务;其次,开发了一款互动农场游戏,探索我们关键因素尚未测试的值。最后,我们讨论了本模型在多种潜在应用中的价值。
abstract_en: Human senses and perception are our mechanisms to explore the external world. In this context, visual saccades –rapid and coordinated eye movements– serve as a primary tool for awareness of our surroundings. Typically, our perception is not limited to visual stimuli alone but is enriched by cross-modal interactions, such as the combination of sight and hearing. In this work, we investigate the temporal and spatial relationship of these interactions, focusing on how auditory cues that precede visual stimuli influence saccadic latency –the time that it takes for the eyes to react and start moving towards a visual target. Our research, conducted within a virtual reality environment, reveals that auditory cues preceding visual information can significantly accelerate saccadic responses, but this effect plateaus beyond certain temporal thresholds. Additionally, while the spatial positioning of visual stimuli influences the speed of these eye movements, as reported in previous research, we find that the location of auditory cues with respect to their corresponding visual stimulus does not have a comparable effect. To validate our findings, we implement two practical applications: first, a basketball training task set in a more realistic environment with complex audiovisual signals, and second, an interactive farm game that explores previously untested values of our key factors. Lastly, we discuss various potential applications where our model could be beneficial.
authors: Daniel Jiménez Navarro, Xi Peng, Yunxiang Zhang, Karol Myszkowski, Hans-Peter Seidel, Qi Sun 0003, Ana Serrano

title: 光圈感知的镜头设计
title_en: Aperture-Aware Lens Design.
abstract: 光学设计师使用仿真工具来辅助设计适用于各种应用的镜头。商业工具依赖有限差分和采样方法对镜头设计目标进行基于梯度的优化。近年来,可微渲染技术使这些目标的梯度计算更加高效。然而,这些技术通常无法优化光通量,而光通量往往是许多应用中的重要指标。我们开发了一种计算光学系统相对于焦点和光通量梯度的方法。我们将镜头性能表述为动态域上的积分损失,这使得可以利用可微渲染技术计算所需的梯度。我们还专门设计了一种适用于折射镜头的光线追踪器,并推导出同时优化焦点和光通量的梯度计算公式。显式优化光通量产生的镜头在性能上优于传统优化镜头,后者往往仅优先考虑焦点。为了评估我们的镜头设计,我们模拟了各种应用场景,其中我们的镜头:
abstract_en: Optics designers use simulation tools to assist them in designing lenses for various applications. Commercial tools rely on finite differencing and sampling methods to perform gradient-based optimization of lens design objectives. Recently, differentiable rendering techniques have enabled more efficient gradient calculation of these objectives. However, these techniques are unable to optimize for light throughput, often an important metric for many applications. We develop a method for calculating the gradients of optical systems with respect to both focus and light throughput. We formulate lens performance as an integral loss over a dynamic domain, which allows for the use of differentiable rendering techniques to calculate the required gradients. We also develop a ray tracer specifically designed for refractive lenses and derive formulas for calculating gradients that simultaneously optimize for focus and light throughput. Explicitly optimizing for light throughput produces lenses that outperform traditional optimized lenses that tend to prioritize for only focus.
