title: Minkowski惩罚项:矢量图形的鲁棒可微约束强制
title_en: Minkowski Penalties: Robust Differentiable Constraint Enforcement for Vector Graphics.
abstract: 本文描述了一种基于优化的框架,用于在成对约束条件下寻找二维形状的排列。此类排列自然出现在矢量插图和图表生成等任务中,但鲁棒地执行这些标准却出人意料地具有挑战性。我们通过最小化源自相互作用形状Minkowski差的符号距离函数的新型能量惩罚项来解决这一问题。该公式即使从高度不可行的状态初始化也能提供有用的梯度,且与许多常见的碰撞惩罚项不同,能够处理没有明确定义内外区域的开放曲线。此外,它还支持超越基本无重叠条件的丰富特性,如切线性、包含关系和精确填充,这些特性在矢量插图场景中尤为宝贵。我们为标准矢量图形原语开发了惩罚项的闭式表达式和高效近似方法,从而实现了高效的评估和在现有自动微分流程中的便捷实现。该方法已作为公开源软件组件经过实际验证;我们通过来自插图、数据可视化、图表生成和几何处理的示例展示了该框架的实用性。
abstract_en: This paper describes an optimization-based framework for finding arrangements of 2D shapes subject to pairwise constraints. Such arrangements naturally arise in tasks such as vector illustration and diagram generation, but enforcing these criteria robustly is surprisingly challenging. We approach this problem through the minimization of novel energetic penalties, derived from the signed distance function of the Minkowski difference between interacting shapes. This formulation provides useful gradients even when initialized from a wildly infeasible state, and, unlike many common collision penalties, can handle open curves that do not have a well-defined inside and outside. Moreover, it supports rich features beyond the basic no-overlap condition, such as tangency, containment, and precise padding, which are especially valuable in the vector illustration context. We develop closed-form expressions and efficient approximations of our penalty for standard vector graphics primitives, yielding efficient evaluation and easy implementation within existing automatic differentiation pipelines. The method has already been “battle-tested” as a component of public-facing open source software; we demonstrate the utility of the framework via examples from illustration, data visualization, diagram generation, and geometry processing.
authors: Jirí Minarcík, Sam Estep, Wode Ni, Keenan Crane

title: Mob-FGSR:面向移动实时渲染的帧生成与超分辨率
title_en: Mob-FGSR: Frame Generation and Super Resolution for Mobile Real-Time Rendering.
abstract: 近期在帧生成和超分辨率采样技术上的进展显著提升了实时渲染性能。然而,由于这些方法高度依赖高端GPU的最新特征,因此在受GPU性能限制且缺乏专用光流估计硬件的移动平台上难以应用。我们提出Mob-FGSR,这是一种专为移动设备设计的轻量级超采样框架,将帧生成与超分辨率技术相结合,有效提升实时渲染性能。我们的方法引入了基于点扩散的运动向量重建方法,可在无需高端GPU或生成帧的渲染数据的情况下,实现精确的像素级运动估计,支持插值与外推的时序需求。随后设计了快速图像生成模型,用于构建插值或外推帧并提升分辨率,为用户提供丰富的选择。我们的运行时模型无需使用神经网络,确保其适用于移动设备。大量测试表明,我们的框架在性能上优于其他轻量级方案,并可与专为高端GPU设计的算法相媲美。通过设备端测试验证了模型的最低运行时,证明其在广泛移动实时渲染应用中的潜力。更多信息及Android演示可访问:https://mob-fgsr.github.io/
abstract_en: Recent advances in supersampling for frame generation and super-resolution improve real-time rendering performance significantly. However, because these methods rely heavily on the most recent features of high-end GPUs, they are impractical for mobile platforms, which are limited by lower GPU capabilities and a lack of dedicated optical flow estimation hardware. We propose Mob-FGSR, a novel lightweight supersampling framework tailored for mobile devices that integrates frame generation with super resolution to effectively improve real-time rendering performance. Our method introduces a splat-based motion vectors reconstruction method, which allows for accurate pixel-level motion estimation for both interpolation and extrapolation at desired times without the need for high-end GPUs or rendering data from generated frames. Subsequently, fast image generation models are designed to construct interpolated or extrapolated frames and improve resolution, providing users with a plethora of options. Our runtime models operate without the use of neural networks, ensuring their applicability to mobile devices. Extensive testing shows that our framework outperforms other lightweight solutions and rivals the performance of algorithms designed specifically for high-end GPUs. Our model’s minimal runtime is confirmed by on-device testing, demonstrating its potential to benefit a wide range of mobile real-time rendering applications. More information and an Android demo can be found at: https://mob-fgsr.github.io/.
authors: Sipeng Yang, Qingchuan Zhu, Junhao Zhuge, Qiang Qiu, Chen Li 0062, Yuzhong Yan, Huihui Xu, Ling-Qi Yan 0001, Xiaogang Jin 0001

title: 模态折叠:利用应变空间模态发现薄板材料的平滑折叠模式
title_en: Modal Folding: Discovering Smooth Folding Patterns for Sheet Materials using Strain-Space Modes.
abstract: 折叠可以将餐巾等普通物品转化为令人惊叹的艺术作品。然而,为薄板材料发现新的折叠变换是一个具有挑战性的问题,需要专业知识和实际实验。本文提出模态折叠——一种自动发现能量最优折叠变换的方法,即需要较少机械功的大变形。对于小变形,固定位移幅度下最小化内部能量会得到众所周知的弹性本征模态。虽然线性模态为弯曲提供了有希望的方向,但无法捕捉折叠所需的旋转运动。为克服这一局限,我们引入应变空间模态——弹性本征模态的非线性类比,其作用于单元曲率而非顶点。通过使用应变空间模态确定弯曲单元的目标曲率,我们只需最小化薄板的内部能量即可生成复杂的非线性折叠运动。我们的模态折叠方法提供了一种系统且自动的复杂设计创建方式。我们通过多种形状和材料的模拟结果验证了方法的有效性,并通过物理原型验证了设计。
abstract_en: Folding can transform mundane objects such as napkins into stunning works of art. However, finding new folding transformations for sheet materials is a challenging problem that requires expertise and real-world experimentation. In this paper, we present Modal Folding—an automated approach for discovering energetically optimal folding transformations, i.e., large deformations that require little mechanical work. For small deformations, minimizing internal energy for fixed displacement magnitudes leads to the well-known elastic eigenmodes. While linear modes provide promising directions for bending, they cannot capture the rotational motion required for folding. To overcome this limitation, we introduce strain-space modes—nonlinear analogues of elastic eigenmodes that operate on per-element curvatures instead of vertices. Using strain-space modes to determine target curvatures for bending elements, we can generate complex nonlinear folding motions by simply minimizing the sheet’s internal energy. Our modal folding approach offers a systematic and automated way to create complex designs. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method with simulation results for a range of shapes and materials, and validate our designs with physical prototypes.
authors: Pengbin Tang, Ronan Hinchet, Roi Poranne, Bernhard Thomaszewski, Stelian Coros

title: 环境场景动态建模用于自由视角合成
title_en: Modeling Ambient Scene Dynamics for Free-view Synthesis.
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法,通过单目捕获实现环境场景的动态自由视角合成,为观看体验带来沉浸式质量。我们的方法基于近期在三维高斯点云(3DGS)技术上的进展,该技术能够忠实重建复杂静态场景。此前尝试将3DGS扩展到表示动态场景的尝试多局限于有限场景或需要多摄像头捕获,且往往无法泛化到未见过的运动,限制了其实际应用。我们的方法通过利用环境运动的周期性来学习运动轨迹模型,并结合细致的正则化策略,克服了这些限制。我们还提出了重要的实用策略,以提升基线3DGS静态重建的视觉质量,并提高对GPU内存密集型学习至关重要的内存效率。我们展示了对多个具有复杂纹理和精细结构元素的环境自然场景的高质量逼真新视角合成。实验表明,我们的方法在定性和定量上均显著优于先前方法。项目页面:https://ambientgaussian.github.io/
abstract_en: We introduce a novel method for dynamic free-view synthesis of an ambient scenes from a monocular capture bringing a immersive quality to the viewing experience. Our method builds upon the recent advancements in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) that can faithfully reconstruct complex static scenes. Previous attempts to extend 3DGS to represent dynamics have been confined to bounded scenes or require multi-camera captures, and often fail to generalize to unseen motions, limiting their practical application. Our approach overcomes these constraints by leveraging the periodicity of ambient motions to learn the motion trajectory model, coupled with careful regularization. We also propose important practical strategies to improve the visual quality of the baseline 3DGS static reconstructions and to improve memory efficiency critical for GPU-memory intensive learning. We demonstrate high-quality photorealistic novel view synthesis of several ambient natural scenes with intricate textures and fine structural elements. We show that our method significantly outperforms prior methods both qualitatively and quantitatively. Project page: https://ambientgaussian.github.io/
authors: Meng-Li Shih, Jia-Bin Huang 0001, Changil Kim 0001, Rajvi Shah, Johannes Kopf 0001, Chen Gao 0003

title: 使用移动胶囊体建模发丝
title_en: Modeling Hair Strands with Roving Capsules.
abstract: 发丝可以通过沿贝塞尔曲线扫掠、半径变化的球体进行建模。我们通过在运行时动态定义的一组胶囊体与给定射线的相交点来追踪此类形状。通过系统地消除那些确定不会与给定射线相交的形状部分,实现了显著的性能提升。新的相交检测器比之前领先的幻影算法[Reshetov和Luebke 2018]快两倍以上。这一改进带来了整体性能30%的提升,包括遍历、着色以及渲染系统的开销。此外,我们推导出了扫掠球体形状的参数形式。这比通过沿给定曲线正交扫掠的圆获得的偏移曲面提供了对这类物体属性更深入的理解。我们的算法完整WebGL实现可在https://www.shadertoy.com/view/4ffXWs获取。
abstract_en: Hair strands can be modeled by sweeping spheres with varying radii along Bézier curves. We ray-trace such shapes by finding intersections of a given ray with a set of capsules dynamically defined at runtime. A substantial performance boost is achieved by systematically eliminating parts of the shape that are guaranteed not to intersect with the given ray. The new intersector is more than twice faster than the previously leading phantom algorithm [Reshetov and Luebke 2018]. This improvement results in a 30% overall performance increase, which includes traversal, shading, and the rendering system overhead. In addition, we derive a parametric form of the swept sphere shapes. This provides a deeper understanding of the properties of such objects compared to the offset surfaces obtained by sweeping circles orthogonal to a given curve. The complete WebGL implementation of our algorithm is available at https://www.shadertoy.com/view/4ffXWs.
authors: Alexander Reshetov, David Hart

title: 将羽毛建模为强各向异性弹性壳
title_en: Modelling a Feather as a Strongly Anisotropic Elastic Shell.
abstract: 羽毛表现出高度各向异性行为,其复杂分层微观结构由固定在羽轴(rachis)上的单根毛发(barbs)以及通过微小钩状结构(barbules)相互连接的特性决定。以往计算机图形学方法将羽毛近似为布料条带,未能捕捉羽毛表面(羽片)特有的宏观非线性行为。为研究羽毛羽片的各向异性特性,我们设计了针对真实羽毛样本的精确测量协议。实验结果表明,羽毛膜具有与取向相关的线性应变-应力关系,且在barb与barbule方向存在高达104量级的刚度比。基于这些发现,我们构建了一个简单的连续体模型,将羽片表示为三参数各向异性弹性壳。然而,数值实现该模型时暴露出严重的锁死和病态问题,这是由于barb与barbule方向间极端的刚度比导致。为解决这些问题,我们沿barb方向对网格进行对齐,并用不可伸缩约束替代最刚性的模式。通过使用中介微尺度模型,我们广泛验证了该膜模型与现实实验室测量的一致性,从而限制了所需实验数量。最后,我们在膜模型中引入各向异性弯曲特性,并展示了其在类似图形场景中的实用性,如完整羽毛和更大尺度的鸟类。本文代码和数据可访问https://gitlab.inria.fr/elan-public-code/feather-shell/。
abstract_en: Feathers exhibit a highly anisotropic behaviour, governed by their complex hierarchical microstructure composed of individual hairs (barbs) clamped onto a spine (rachis) and attached to each other through tiny hooks (barbules). Previous methods in computer graphics have approximated feathers as strips of cloth, thus failing to capture the particular macroscopic nonlinear behaviour of the feather surface (vane). To investigate the anisotropic properties of a feather vane, we design precise measurement protocols on real feather samples. Our experimental results suggest a linear strain-stress relationship of the feather membrane with orientation-dependent coefficients, as well as an extreme ratio of stiffnesses in the barb and barbule direction, of the order of 104. From these findings we build a simple continuum model for the feather vane, where the vane is represented as a three-parameter anisotropic elastic shell. However, implementing the model numerically reveals severe locking and ill-conditioning issues, due to the extreme stiffness ratio between the barb and the barbule directions. To resolve these issues, we align the mesh along the barb directions and replace the stiffest modes with an inextensibility constraint. We extensively validate our membrane model against real-world laboratory measurements, by using an intermediary microscale model that allows us to limit the number of required lab experiments. Finally, we enrich our membrane model with anisotropic bending, and show its practicality in graphics-like scenarios like a full feather and a larger-scale bird. Code and data for this paper are available at https://gitlab.inria.fr/elan-public-code/feather-shell/.
authors: Jean Jouve, Victor Romero, Rahul Narain, Laurence Boissieux, Theodore Kim, Florence Bertails-Descoubes

title: MonoGaussianAvatar:单目高斯点头像
title_en: MonoGaussianAvatar: Monocular Gaussian Point-based Head Avatar.
abstract: 从单目人像视频序列中重建并动画化照片级真实感头部头像的能力,是弥合虚拟与现实世界之间鸿沟的关键步骤。近期头部头像技术的进展,包括显式的三维可变形网格(3DMM)、点云和神经隐式表示已被用于这一持续的研究。然而,基于3DMM的方法受限于固定拓扑结构,点云方法因涉及大量点而面临沉重的训练负担,而神经隐式表示方法则在变形灵活性和渲染效率方面存在局限。为应对这些挑战,我们提出MonoGaussianAvatar(单目高斯点头部头像),一种新颖方法,通过结合三维高斯点表示与高斯变形场,从单目人像视频中学习显式头部头像。我们以具有可调形状的高斯点定义头部头像,实现灵活拓扑结构。这些点通过高斯变形场与目标姿态和表情对齐,实现高效变形。此外,高斯点结合高斯点绘制技术,具有可控的形状、大小、颜色和不透明度,从而实现高效训练和渲染。实验表明,我们的方法在性能上优于先前方法,达到最先进水平。代码和数据可在https://github.com/aipixel/MonoGaussianAvatar获取。
abstract_en: The ability to animate photo-realistic head avatars reconstructed from monocular portrait video sequences represents a crucial step in bridging the gap between the virtual and real worlds. Recent advancements in head avatar techniques, including explicit 3D morphable meshes (3DMM), point clouds, and neural implicit representation have been exploited for this ongoing research. However, 3DMM-based methods are constrained by their fixed topologies, point-based approaches suffer from a heavy training burden due to the extensive quantity of points involved, and the last ones suffer from limitations in deformation flexibility and rendering efficiency. In response to these challenges, we propose MonoGaussianAvatar (Monocular Gaussian Point-based Head Avatar), a novel approach that harnesses 3D Gaussian point representation coupled with a Gaussian deformation field to learn explicit head avatars from monocular portrait videos. We define our head avatars with Gaussian points characterized by adaptable shapes, enabling flexible topology. These points exhibit movement with a Gaussian deformation field in alignment with the target pose and expression of a person, facilitating efficient deformation. Additionally, the Gaussian points have controllable shape, size, color, and opacity combined with Gaussian splatting, allowing for efficient training and rendering. Experiments demonstrate the superior performance of our method, which achieves state-of-the-art results among previous methods. Code and data can be found at https://github.com/aipixel/MonoGaussianAvatar.
authors: Yufan Chen, Lizhen Wang 0002, Qijing Li, Hongjiang Xiao, Shengping Zhang, Hongxun Yao, Yebin Liu

title: Motion-I2V:基于显式运动建模的一致且可控图像到视频生成
title_en: Motion-I2V: Consistent and Controllable Image-to-Video Generation with Explicit Motion Modeling.
abstract: 我们提出Motion-I2V,一种新颖的框架用于一致且可控的文本引导图像到视频生成(I2V)。与先前直接学习复杂图像到视频映射的方法不同,Motion-I2V将I2V分解为两个阶段并引入显式运动建模。在第一阶段,我们提出基于扩散的运动场预测器,专注于推导参考图像像素的轨迹。在第二阶段,我们提出运动增强的时间注意力,以增强视频潜在扩散模型中有限的1-D时间注意力。该模块能有效将参考图像特征传播到合成帧中,并通过第一阶段预测的轨迹进行引导。与现有方法相比,Motion-I2V即使在存在大运动和视角变化的情况下也能生成更一致的视频。通过训练第一阶段的稀疏轨迹ControlNet,Motion-I2V支持用户通过稀疏轨迹和区域精确控制运动轨迹和运动区域。这比仅依赖文本指令提供了更强大的I2V过程可控性。此外,Motion-I2V的第二阶段自然支持零样本视频到视频翻译。定性和定量比较均证明了Motion-I2V在一致且可控图像到视频生成方面相比先前方法的优势。请访问我们的项目页面:https://xiaoyushi97.github.io/Motion-I2V/
abstract_en: We introduce Motion-I2V, a novel framework for consistent and controllable text-guided image-to-video generation (I2V). In contrast to previous methods that directly learn the complicated image-to-video mapping, Motion-I2V factorizes I2V into two stages with explicit motion modeling. For the first stage, we propose a diffusion-based motion field predictor, which focuses on deducing the trajectories of the reference image’s pixels. For the second stage, we propose motion-augmented temporal attention to enhance the limited 1-D temporal attention in video latent diffusion models. This module can effectively propagate reference image features to synthesized frames with the guidance of predicted trajectories from the first stage. Compared with existing methods, Motion-I2V can generate more consistent videos even in the presence of large motion and viewpoint variation. By training a sparse trajectory ControlNet for the first stage, Motion-I2V can support users to precisely control motion trajectories and motion regions with sparse trajectory and region. This offers more controllability of the I2V process than solely relying on textual instructions. Additionally, Motion-I2V’s second stage naturally supports zero-shot video-to-video translation. Both qualitative and quantitative comparisons demonstrate the advantages of Motion-I2V over prior approaches in consistent and controllable image-to-video generation. Please see our project page at https://xiaoyushi97.github.io/Motion-I2V/.
authors: Xiaoyu Shi 0002, Zhaoyang Huang, Fu-Yun Wang, Weikang Bian, Dasong Li, Yi Zhang 0108, Manyuan Zhang, Ka Chun Cheung, Simon See, Hongwei Qin, Jifeng Dai, Hongsheng Li 0001

title: MotionCtrl:一种用于视频生成的统一且灵活的运动控制器
title_en: MotionCtrl: A Unified and Flexible Motion Controller for Video Generation.
abstract: 视频中的运动主要由相机运动(由相机移动引起)和物体运动(由物体移动引起)组成。对相机运动和物体运动的精确控制对于视频生成至关重要。然而,现有方法要么主要关注一种类型的运动,要么未能明确区分两者,限制了其控制能力和多样性。因此,本文提出MotionCtrl,一种用于视频生成的统一且灵活的运动控制器,旨在有效且独立地控制相机运动和物体运动。MotionCtrl的架构和训练策略经过精心设计,考虑了相机运动、物体运动的固有属性以及不完美的训练数据。与现有方法相比,MotionCtrl具有以下三个主要优势:1)它能够有效且独立地控制相机运动和物体运动,实现更精细的运动控制,并促进两种类型运动的灵活多样的组合。2)其运动条件由相机姿态和轨迹决定,与外观无关,且对生成视频中物体的外观或形状影响极小。3)它是一个具有较好泛化能力的模型,一旦训练完成,即可适应各种相机姿态和轨迹。已进行了大量定性和定量实验,以证明MotionCtrl相较于现有方法的优越性。项目页面:https://wzhouxiff.github.io/projects/MotionCtrl/ .
abstract_en: Motions in a video primarily consist of camera motion, induced by camera movement, and object motion, resulting from object movement. Accurate control of both camera and object motion is essential for video generation. However, existing works either mainly focus on one type of motion or do not clearly distinguish between the two, limiting their control capabilities and diversity. Therefore, this paper presents MotionCtrl, a unified and flexible motion controller for video generation designed to effectively and independently control camera and object motion. The architecture and training strategy of MotionCtrl are carefully devised, taking into account the inherent properties of camera motion, object motion, and imperfect training data. Compared to previous methods, MotionCtrl offers three main advantages: 1) It effectively and independently controls camera motion and object motion, enabling more fine-grained motion control and facilitating flexible and diverse combinations of both types of motion. 2) Its motion conditions are determined by camera poses and trajectories, which are appearance-free and minimally impact the appearance or shape of objects in generated videos. 3) It is a relatively generalizable model that can adapt to a wide array of camera poses and trajectories once trained. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments have been conducted to demonstrate the superiority of MotionCtrl over existing methods. Project page: https://wzhouxiff.github.io/projects/MotionCtrl/ .
authors: Zhouxia Wang, Ziyang Yuan, Xintao Wang 0002, Yaowei Li 0001, Tianshui Chen, Menghan Xia, Ping Luo 0002, Ying Shan

title: N-BVH:基于包围体积层次结构的神经光线查询
title_en: N-BVH: Neural ray queries with bounding volume hierarchies.
abstract: 神经表示展现出将复杂信号压缩为原始数据量分数的惊人能力。在三维计算机图形学中,场景内存的大部分消耗来自于多边形和纹理,这使它们成为神经压缩的理想候选对象。在此背景下,主要挑战在于在减少训练时间的同时,找到高效压缩与低成本推理之间的良好平衡。在渲染领域,我们采用以光线为中心的方法解决该问题,设计了<Formula format="inline"><TexMath><?TeX $\mathcal {N}$?></TexMath><AltText>Math 1</AltText><File name="siggraphconferencepapers24-70-inline1" type="svg"/></Formula>-BVH,这是一种能够回答任意光线查询的神经压缩架构。我们的紧凑模型从输入几何体学习得到,并在路径追踪引擎查询光线相交时替代原始几何体。虽然先前的神经压缩方法主要关注点查询,但我们的方法提出神经光线查询,可无缝集成到标准光线追踪管线中。在方法核心,我们采用自适应的BVH驱动探测方案,优化多分辨率哈希网格参数,将神经容量集中在原始表面扫过的稀疏三维占据区域。因此,我们的<Formula format="inline"><TexMath><?TeX $\mathcal {N}$?></TexMath><AltText>Math 2</AltText><File name="siggraphconferencepapers24-70-inline2" type="svg"/></Formula>-BVH能够从比原始表示紧凑一个数量级的表示中提供精确的光线查询,提供可见性、深度和外观属性的忠实近似。该方法的灵活性使我们能够在同一三维场景中结合和重叠神经与非神经实体,并扩展到外观细节层次。
abstract_en: Neural representations have shown spectacular ability to compress complex signals in a fraction of the raw data size. In 3D computer graphics, the bulk of a scene’s memory usage is due to polygons and textures, making them ideal candidates for neural compression. Here, the main challenge lies in finding good trade-offs between efficient compression and cheap inference while minimizing training time. In the context of rendering, we adopt a ray-centric approach to this problem and devise <Formula format="inline"><TexMath><?TeX $\mathcal {N}$?></TexMath><AltText>Math 1</AltText><File name="siggraphconferencepapers24-70-inline1" type="svg"/></Formula>-BVH, a neural compression architecture designed to answer arbitrary ray queries in 3D. Our compact model is learned from the input geometry and substituted for it whenever a ray intersection is queried by a path-tracing engine. While prior neural compression methods have focused on point queries, ours proposes neural ray queries that integrate seamlessly into standard ray-tracing pipelines. At the core of our method, we employ an adaptive BVH-driven probing scheme to optimize the parameters of a multi-resolution hash grid, focusing its neural capacity on the sparse 3D occupancy swept by the original surfaces. As a result, our <Formula format="inline"><TexMath><?TeX $\mathcal {N}$?></TexMath><AltText>Math 2</AltText><File name="siggraphconferencepapers24-70-inline2" type="svg"/></Formula>-BVH can serve accurate ray queries from a representation that is more than an order of magnitude more compact, providing faithful approximations of visibility, depth, and appearance attributes. The flexibility of our method allows us to combine and overlap neural and non-neural entities within the same 3D scene and extends to appearance level of detail.
authors: Philippe Weier, Alexander Rath, Élie Michel, Iliyan Georgiev, Philipp Slusallek, Tamy Boubekeur

title: 用于高维函数拟合的N维高斯分布
title_en: N-Dimensional Gaussians for Fitting of High Dimensional Functions.
abstract: 在众多新的机器学习启发方法用于重建和表示高质量3D内容之后,最近的混合和显式学习表示展现出有前景的性能和质量特性。然而,它们扩展到更高维度具有挑战性,例如在考虑材料属性、光照或时间等额外参数的动态内容时。在本文中,我们针对基于高斯混合模型的显式表示解决这些挑战。通过我们的解决方案,我们实现了紧凑N维高斯混合的高效拟合,并在渲染时实现高效评估:为了快速拟合和评估,我们引入了一种高维剔除方案,该方案受局部敏感哈希启发,高效限制N维高斯分布。为了自适应细化同时保持紧凑表示,我们引入了一种损失自适应密度控制方案,该方案逐步引导额外容量用于缺失细节。借助这些工具,我们首次能够在紧凑、显式表示中表示依赖于位置或视角以外的许多输入维度的复杂外观,并且该表示可在几分钟内优化并在毫秒内渲染。
abstract_en: In the wake of many new ML-inspired approaches for reconstructing and representing high-quality 3D content, recent hybrid and explicitly learned representations exhibit promising performance and quality characteristics. However, their scaling to higher dimensions is challenging, e.g. when accounting for dynamic content with respect to additional parameters such as material properties, illumination, or time. In this paper, we tackle these challenges for an explicit representations based on Gaussian mixture models. With our solutions, we arrive at efficient fitting of compact N-dimensional Gaussian mixtures and enable efficient evaluation at render time: For fast fitting and evaluation, we introduce a high-dimensional culling scheme that efficiently bounds N-D Gaussians, inspired by Locality Sensitive Hashing. For adaptive refinement yet compact representation, we introduce a loss-adaptive density control scheme that incrementally guides the use of additional capacity towards missing details. With these tools we can for the first time represent complex appearance that depends on many input dimensions beyond position or viewing angle within a compact, explicit representation optimized in minutes and rendered in milliseconds.
authors: Stavros Diolatzis, Tobias Zirr, Alexander Kuznetsov, Georgios Kopanas, Anton Kaplanyan

title: 导航驱动的近似凸分解
title_en: Navigation-Driven Approximate Convex Decomposition.
abstract: 近似凸分解——通过一组凸包来近似形状——是创建游戏和模拟中高效碰撞表示的流行方法。现有算法通常基于通用的表面或体积误差度量标准来构建此类分解,但无法忽略不可达的内部表面,也无法对结果进行局部控制。我们引入了可导航近似凸分解问题:首先为输入形状定义一个可导航空间,该空间必须允许游戏或模拟中的其他物体通过,然后寻找不与该空间重叠的分解方案。我们展示了如何自动找到此类可导航空间,如何对其进行定制,并引入了一种保护该空间的近似凸分解算法。实验结果表明,该方法能够比以往方法更快地生成满足应用需求的分解方案,并且使用更少的凸包,同时在定义需求方面提供了新的灵活性。
abstract_en: Approximate convex decomposition – approximating a shape by a set of convex hulls – is a popular approach to creating efficient collision representations for games and simulations. Existing algorithms to construct such decompositions are typically driven by general surface- or volume-based error metrics that can’t ignore unreachable internal surfaces nor provide local control over the results. We introduce the problem of navigable approximate convex decomposition: First, define a navigable space for the input shape which other objects in the game or simulation must be able to move through, then find a decomposition which does not overlap that space. We show how to automatically find such navigable space, how to customize it, and we introduce an approximate convex decomposition algorithm that protects it. Our results demonstrate that this approach can generate decompositions that meet application requirements faster and with fewer convex hulls than previous methods, while providing a new level of flexibility in defining what those requirements are.
authors: James Andrews

title: NeRF作为基于物理的逆渲染中的非远距离环境发射器
title_en: NeRF as a Non-Distant Environment Emitter in Physics-based Inverse Rendering.
abstract: 基于物理的逆渲染能够基于捕获的2D图像对形状、材质和光照进行联合优化。为确保准确重建,使用与捕获环境高度相似的光照模型至关重要。尽管广泛采用的远距离环境光照模型在许多情况下是足够的,但我们证明其无法捕捉空间变化的光照,可能导致许多现实世界逆渲染场景中重建不准确。为解决这一限制,我们将NeRF作为非远距离环境发射器纳入逆渲染流程。此外,我们引入了一种针对NeRF的发射器重要性采样技术以减少渲染方差。通过在真实和合成数据集上的对比实验,我们的结果表明,基于NeRF的发射器能够更精确地表示场景光照,从而提高逆渲染的准确性。
abstract_en: Physics-based inverse rendering enables joint optimization of shape, material, and lighting based on captured 2D images. To ensure accurate reconstruction, using a light model that closely resembles the captured environment is essential. Although the widely adopted distant environmental lighting model is adequate in many cases, we demonstrate that its inability to capture spatially varying illumination can lead to inaccurate reconstructions in many real-world inverse rendering scenarios. To address this limitation, we incorporate NeRF as a non-distant environment emitter into the inverse rendering pipeline. Additionally, we introduce an emitter importance sampling technique for NeRF to reduce the rendering variance. Through comparisons on both real and synthetic datasets, our results demonstrate that our NeRF-based emitter offers a more precise representation of scene lighting, thereby improving the accuracy of inverse rendering.
authors: Jingwang Ling, Ruihan Yu, Feng Xu 0005, Chun Du, Shuang Zhao

title: 神经包围体
title_en: Neural Bounding.
abstract: 包围体是计算机图形学和视觉任务中已确立的概念,但自其早期提出以来变化甚微。在本工作中,我们研究将神经网络作为包围体的应用。我们的关键观察是,包围(此前主要被视为计算几何问题)可以重新定义为学习将空间划分为自由或占用的问题。这种基于学习的方法在高维空间(如包含复杂查询的动画场景)中具有显著优势,因为神经网络在此类场景中表现优异。然而,实现神经包围体需要一个关键转折:允许但同时限制误报,同时确保漏报数量严格为零。我们通过动态加权非对称损失函数实现这种严格且保守的结果。实验结果表明,我们的神经包围体相比传统方法可减少一个数量级的误报。此外,我们提出了一种基于早期退出机制的包围体方法扩展,使查询速度提升25%。我们还证明该方法适用于可在数秒内训练完成的非深度学习模型。项目页面地址为:https://wenxin-liu.github.io/neural_bounding/
abstract_en: Bounding volumes are an established concept in computer graphics and vision tasks but have seen little change since their early inception. In this work, we study the use of neural networks as bounding volumes. Our key observation is that bounding, which so far has primarily been considered a problem of computational geometry, can be redefined as a problem of learning to classify space into free or occupied. This learning-based approach is particularly advantageous in high-dimensional spaces, such as animated scenes with complex queries, where neural networks are known to excel. However, unlocking neural bounding requires a twist: allowing – but also limiting – false positives, while ensuring that the number of false negatives is strictly zero. We enable such tight and conservative results using a dynamically-weighted asymmetric loss function. Our results show that our neural bounding produces up to an order of magnitude fewer false positives than traditional methods. In addition, we propose an extension of our bounding method using early exits that accelerates query speeds by 25 %. We also demonstrate that our approach is applicable to non-deep learning models that train within seconds. Our project page is at https://wenxin-liu.github.io/neural_bounding/.
authors: Stephanie Wenxin Liu, Michael Fischer 0011, Paul D. Yoo, Tobias Ritschel 0001

title: 基于自动积分的神经控制变量
title_en: Neural Control Variates with Automatic Integration.
abstract: 本文提出了一种利用任意神经网络架构构建控制变量的方法。控制变量在降低蒙特卡洛积分的方差中起着关键作用,但其依赖于找到一个既与被积函数相关又具有已知解析积分的函数。传统方法依赖启发式选择该函数,这可能导致表达能力不足而难以与被积函数良好相关。近期研究通过建模可学习的参数化模型(如神经网络)来缓解这一问题。然而,如何构建具有已知解析积分的表达性参数化模型仍是挑战。本文提出了一种新颖方法,从任意神经网络架构中构建可学习参数化控制变量函数。不同于直接用网络逼近被积函数,我们利用网络逼近被积函数的反导数。这使得我们能够通过自动微分创建一个积分可通过反导数网络构造的函数。我们将该方法应用于Walk-on-sphere算法[ SAWHNEY和CRANE 2020]求解偏微分方程。实验结果表明,该方法在多种网络架构下无偏,并且比其他控制变量方法具有更低的方差。
abstract_en: This paper presents a method to leverage arbitrary neural network architecture for control variates. Control variates are crucial in reducing the variance of Monte Carlo integration, but they hinge on finding a function that both correlates with the integrand and has a known analytical integral. Traditional approaches rely on heuristics to choose this function, which might not be expressive enough to correlate well with the integrand. Recent research alleviates this issue by modeling the integrands with a learnable parametric model, such as a neural network. However, the challenge remains in creating an expressive parametric model with a known analytical integral. This paper proposes a novel approach to construct learnable parametric control variates functions from arbitrary neural network architectures. Instead of using a network to approximate the integrand directly, we employ the network to approximate the anti-derivative of the integrand. This allows us to use automatic differentiation to create a function whose integration can be constructed by the antiderivative network. We apply our method to solve partial differential equations using the Walk-on-sphere algorithm [Sawhney and Crane 2020]. Our results indicate that this approach is unbiased using various network architectures and achieves lower variance than other control variate methods.
authors: Zilu Li, Guandao Yang, Qingqing Zhao, Xi Deng, Leonidas J. Guibas, Bharath Hariharan, Gordon Wetzstein

title: 面向网格的神经几何场
title_en: Neural Geometry Fields For Meshes.
abstract: 近期利用神经场表示表面的研究在表示能力与计算效率方面取得了显著进展。然而,据我们所知,现有大多数工作集中于隐式表示方法,如符号距离场或体积,而针对离散表面几何(即三维网格)的应用研究较少,限制了神经表面表示的适用性。我们提出神经几何场,这是一种用于三角形网格表示的离散表面几何神经表示方法。我们的方法是通过一组粗略的四边形块表示目标表面,并利用坐标神经网络通过位移块来添加表面细节。随后,我们通过采样位移从神经几何场实例中提取传统三角形网格。我们证明该表示在网格压缩方面表现优异,显著减少网格的内存占用而不影响表面细节。
abstract_en: Recent work on using neural fields to represent surfaces has resulted in significant improvements in representational capability and computational efficiency. However, to our knowledge, most existing work has focused on implicit representations such as signed distance fields or volumes, and little work has explored their application to discrete surface geometry, i.e., 3D meshes, limiting the applicability of neural surface representations. We present Neural Geometry Fields, a neural representation for discrete surface geometry represented by triangle meshes. Our idea is to represent the target surface using a coarse set of quadrangular patches, and add surface details using coordinate neural networks by displacing the patches. We then extract a traditional triangular mesh from a neural geometry field instance by sampling the displacement. We show that our representation excels in mesh compression, where it significantly reduces the memory footprint of meshes without compromising on surface details.
authors: Venkataram Edavamadathil Sivaram, Tzu-Mao Li, Ravi Ramamoorthi

title: 神经蒙特卡洛流体模拟
title_en: Neural Monte Carlo Fluid Simulation.
abstract: 利用神经网络表示连续向量场(即神经场)以求解物理模拟中出现的偏微分方程(PDEs)的思路已逐渐流行。在此方法中,传统PDE求解器的空间离散化(如有限差分法)被替换为能够建模可微函数的神经网络,从而通过自动微分即可便捷地计算PDE的空间梯度。然而,当应用于流体模拟时,神经场却无法捕捉诸如卡门涡街实验中经历的涡旋脱落等重要现象。我们提出了一种新的神经网络表示方法用于流体模拟,该方法在神经场中显式强制边界条件,并引入蒙特卡洛压力求解器以消除所有弱强制边界条件。我们的方法,即神经蒙特卡洛方法(NMC),完全无网格,即不依赖任何基于网格的离散化。虽然NMC在最先进精度上不如已建立的基于网格的方法,但它在涉及复杂边界和湍流状态的流体流动中显著优于先前的无网格神经流体方法。
abstract_en: The idea of using a neural network to represent continuous vector fields (i.e., neural fields) has become popular for solving PDEs arising from physics simulations. Here, the classical spatial discretization (e.g., finite difference) of PDE solvers is replaced with a neural network that models a differentiable function, so the spatial gradients of the PDEs can be readily computed via autodifferentiation. When used in fluid simulation, however, neural fields fail to capture many important phenomena, such as the vortex shedding experienced in the von Kármán vortex street experiment. We present a novel neural network representation for fluid simulation that augments neural fields with explicitly enforced boundary conditions as well as a Monte Carlo pressure solver to get rid of all weakly enforced boundary conditions. Our method, the Neural Monte Carlo method (NMC), is completely mesh-free, i.e., it doesn’t depend on any grid-based discretization. While NMC does not achieve the state-of-the-art accuracy of the well-established grid-based methods, it significantly outperforms previous mesh-free neural fluid methods on fluid flows involving intricate boundaries and turbulence regimes.
authors: Pranav Jain, Ziyin Qu, Peter Yichen Chen, Oded Stein

title: 基于神经网络的纱线级布料均质化方法
title_en: Neural-Assisted Homogenization of Yarn-Level Cloth.
abstract: 现实中的织物由纱线和纤维组成,通常表现出复杂的应力-应变关系,这使得其均质化成为基于连续体模型的快速模拟的挑战性任务。因此,现有的均质化纱线级模型在大时间步长下常因数值稳定性问题而需要线搜索,迫使在模型精度与稳定性之间进行权衡。本文提出一种神经辅助的均质化本构模型,用于模拟纱线级布料。与解析模型不同,神经网络模型在适应复杂动态行为方面具有优势,其固有的平滑性可自然缓解稳定性问题。我们还引入了基于扇区的预热策略以加速均质化过程中的数据收集。该模型通过收集的应变能数据集进行训练,并通过定性和定量实验验证其准确性。得益于模型的稳定性,我们的模拟器相比之前的方法在大时间步长下实现了两个数量级的速度提升。
abstract_en: Real-world fabrics, composed of threads and yarns, often display complex stress-strain relationships, making their homogenization a challenging task for fast simulation by continuum-based models. Consequently, existing homogenized yarn-level models frequently struggle with numerical stability without line search at large time steps, forcing a trade-off between model accuracy and stability. In this paper, we propose a neural-assisted homogenized constitutive model for simulating yarn-level cloth. Unlike analytic models, a neural model is advantageous in adapting to complex dynamic behaviors, and its inherent smoothness naturally mitigates stability issues. We also introduce a sector-based warm-start strategy to accelerate the data collection process in homogenization. This model is trained using collected strain energy datasets and its accuracy is validated through both qualitative and quantitative experiments. Thanks to our model’s stability, our simulator can now achieve two-orders-of-magnitude speedups with large time steps compared to previous models.
authors: Xudong Feng, Huamin Wang 0001, Yin Yang 0002, Weiwei Xu 0003

title: 对象级场景解遮挡
title_en: Object-level Scene Deocclusion.
abstract: 对场景中被遮挡物体部分进行解遮挡是一项具有挑战性的任务,尤其是在处理现实场景时。本文提出了一种新的自监督并行可见到完整扩散框架,命名为PACO,作为对象级场景解遮挡的基础模型。通过利用预训练模型的丰富先验知识,我们首先设计了并行变分自编码器,该编码器生成全视角特征图,同时编码多个完整物体;并设计了可见到完整潜在生成器,该生成器学习从部分视角特征图和从输入图像中不完整物体提取的文本提示中隐式预测全视角特征图。为训练PACO,我们构建了一个包含500k样本的大规模数据集,以实现自监督学习,避免对无模态掩码和遮挡区域进行繁琐的标注。在推理阶段,我们设计了一种逐层解遮挡策略,以提高效率同时保持解遮挡质量。在COCOA和各种现实场景上的大量实验表明,PACO在场景解遮挡方面具有优越性能,显著超越了现有技术。我们的方法还可扩展到训练集未覆盖的跨域场景和新类别。此外,我们展示了PACO在单视角三维场景重建和物体重组中的解遮挡适用性。项目页面:https://liuzhengzhe.github.io/Deocclude-Any-Object.github.io/
abstract_en: Deoccluding the hidden portions of objects in a scene is a formidable task, particularly when addressing real-world scenes. In this paper, we present a new self-supervised PArallel visible-to-COmplete diffusion framework, named PACO, a foundation model for object-level scene deocclusion. Leveraging the rich prior of pre-trained models, we first design the parallel variational autoencoder, which produces a full-view feature map that simultaneously encodes multiple complete objects, and the visible-to-complete latent generator, which learns to implicitly predict the full-view feature map from partial-view feature map and text prompts extracted from the incomplete objects in the input image. To train PACO, we create a large-scale dataset with 500k samples to enable self-supervised learning, avoiding tedious annotations of the amodal masks and occluded regions. At inference, we devise a layer-wise deocclusion strategy to improve efficiency while maintaining the deocclusion quality. Extensive experiments on COCOA and various real-world scenes demonstrate the superior capability of PACO for scene deocclusion, surpassing the state of the arts by a large margin. Our method can also be extended to cross-domain scenes and novel categories that are not covered by the training set. Further, we demonstrate the deocclusion applicability of PACO in single-view 3D scene reconstruction and object recomposition. Project page: https://liuzhengzhe.github.io/Deocclude-Any-Object.github.io/.
authors: Zhengzhe Liu, Qing Liu 0017, Chirui Chang, Jianming Zhang 0001, Daniil Pakhomov, Haitian Zheng, Zhe Lin 0001, Daniel Cohen-Or, Chi-Wing Fu

title: Part123:单视角图像的部件感知三维重建
title_en: Part123: Part-aware 3D Reconstruction from a Single-view Image.
abstract: 近年来,扩散模型的出现为单视角重建开辟了新的机遇。然而,现有方法均将目标物体表示为缺乏任何结构信息的闭合网格,从而忽视了对许多下游应用至关重要的重建形状的部件结构。此外,生成的网格通常存在大量噪声、不平滑表面和模糊纹理,使得使用3D分割技术获得满意的部件分割变得困难。本文提出Part123,一种新颖的单视角图像部件感知三维重建框架。我们首先利用扩散模型从给定图像生成多视角一致的图像,然后借助具有强大泛化能力的分割任意模型(Segment Anything Model, SAM)生成多视角分割掩码。为有效融合2D部件信息到3D重建并处理不一致性,我们引入对比学习到神经渲染框架中,基于多视角分割掩码学习部件感知特征空间。同时开发了基于聚类的算法,从重建模型中自动推导3D部件分割结果。实验表明,我们的方法能在各类物体上生成具有高质量分割部件的3D模型。与现有无结构重建方法相比,我们的部件感知3D模型对特征保持重建、原始体拟合和3D形状编辑等重要应用具有显著优势。
abstract_en: Recently, the emergence of diffusion models has opened up new opportunities for single-view reconstruction. However, all the existing methods represent the target object as a closed mesh devoid of any structural information, thus neglecting the part-based structure, which is crucial for many downstream applications, of the reconstructed shape. Moreover, the generated meshes usually suffer from large noises, unsmooth surfaces, and blurry textures, making it challenging to obtain satisfactory part segments using 3D segmentation techniques. In this paper, we present Part123, a novel framework for part-aware 3D reconstruction from a single-view image. We first use diffusion models to generate multiview-consistent images from a given image, and then leverage Segment Anything Model (SAM), which demonstrates powerful generalization ability on arbitrary objects, to generate multiview segmentation masks. To effectively incorporate 2D part-based information into 3D reconstruction and handle inconsistency, we introduce contrastive learning into a neural rendering framework to learn a part-aware feature space based on the multiview segmentation masks. A clustering-based algorithm is also developed to automatically derive 3D part segmentation results from the reconstructed models. Experiments show that our method can generate 3D models with high-quality segmented parts on various objects. Compared to existing unstructured reconstruction methods, the part-aware 3D models from our method benefit some important applications, including feature-preserving reconstruction, primitive fitting, and 3D shape editing.
authors: Anran Liu, Cheng Lin 0001, Yuan Liu 0025, Xiaoxiao Long, Zhiyang Dou, Hao-Xiang Guo, Ping Luo 0002, Wenping Wang 0001

title: 引导式视网膜投影的感知评估
title_en: Perceptual Evaluation of Steered Retinal Projection.
abstract: 引导式视网膜投影(SRP)是一种新兴的显示技术,通过结合视网膜投影与瞳孔引导技术,实现卓越的光效和一致的观看体验。视网膜投影使显示投影器的大部分光子能够到达视网膜,而瞳孔引导技术则动态地将视网膜投影的窄观看窗口与眼睛对齐。尽管SRP具有巨大潜力,但其发展停滞不前,主要由于缺乏对人类视觉系统如何响应观看窗口动态引导运动的理解。为深入研究这些领域,本研究引入了首个专门用于瞳孔引导观看体验感知研究的SRP系统测试平台。该测试平台能够复现SRP的观看体验,并提供调整包括引导分辨率、精度和延迟在内的多个参数的灵活性。我们利用该测试平台开展了两项感知研究。第一项研究探讨了扫视抑制现象(在快速眼动期间降低视觉敏感度)对SRP观看体验的影响。第二项研究探索了眼动追踪与瞳孔引导性能之间的权衡空间,提供了这些因素之间最佳平衡的见解。此外,我们引入了一个数值模型,考虑全球亮度的时间特性和人类视觉系统,预测SRP伪影的检测概率。该模型能够更全面地解释用户研究结果,并为SRP系统提供初步的硬件需求。本研究的发现为确定SRP开发的组件级里程碑提供了宝贵的研宄方向,为该有前景技术的实用化实施铺平了道路。
abstract_en: Steered retinal projection (SRP) is an emerging display technology that combines retinal projection and pupil steering to achieve exceptional light efficiency and a consistent viewing experience. Retinal projection enables most photons from a display projector to reach the retina, and pupil steering dynamically aligns the narrow viewing window of the retinal projection with the eye. While SRP holds considerable promise, its development has been stagnant due to a lack of understanding how human vision reacts to the dynamic steering movement of the viewing window. To delve into these areas, this study introduces the first SRP system testbed specifically designed for perceptual studies on the viewing experience of pupil steering. The testbed replicates the SRP viewing experience and offers the flexibility in adjusting several parameters including steering resolution, accuracy, and latency. We conducted two perceptual studies utilizing the testbed. The first study investigates the impact of saccadic suppression, a phenomenon that reduces visual sensitivity during rapid eye movements, on the SRP viewing experience. The second study explores the trade space between eye-tracking and pupil steering performance, providing insights into the optimal balance between these factors. Additionally, we introduce a numerical model to predict the detection probability for SRP artifacts considering the temporal characteristics of global luminance and the human vision system. This model enables a more comprehensive interpretation of user study and provides preliminary hardware requirements for SRP systems. The findings from this study offer invaluable research directions that may help determine component-level development milestones for SRP development, paving the way for the practical implementation of this promising technology.
authors: Seungjae Lee 0004, Seung-Woo Nam 0002, Kevin Rio, Renate Landig, Hsien-Hui Cheng, Lu Lu, Barry Silverstein

title: 物理非惯性姿态捕捉器(PNP):稀疏惯性人体运动捕捉中的非惯性效应建模
title_en: Physical Non-inertial Poser (PNP): Modeling Non-inertial Effects in Sparse-inertial Human Motion Capture.
abstract: 现有惯性运动捕捉技术使用人体根坐标系估计局部姿态,并默认将其视为惯性系。我们认为当根具有线性加速度或旋转时,根坐标系理论上应被视为非惯性系。本文通过遵循物理规律精心设计的自回归估计器,建模非惯性系中不可忽略的虚拟力。借助这些虚拟力,与力相关的IMU测量(加速度)可在非惯性系中正确补偿,从而满足牛顿运动定律。在此情况下,加速度与身体运动之间的关系具有确定性和可学习性,我们训练神经网络以建模该关系以提升运动捕捉效果。此外,为使用合成数据训练神经网络,我们开发了基于仿真的IMU合成策略,以更精确建模IMU硬件的噪声模型并允许参数调优以适配不同硬件。该策略不仅实现了基于合成数据的网络训练,还支持校准误差建模以处理不良运动捕捉校准,提升系统鲁棒性。代码可在https://xinyu-yi.github.io/PNP/获取。
abstract_en: Existing inertial motion capture techniques use the human root coordinate frame to estimate local poses and treat it as an inertial frame by default. We argue that when the root has linear acceleration or rotation, the root frame should be considered non-inertial theoretically. In this paper, we model the fictitious forces that are non-neglectable in a non-inertial frame by an auto-regressive estimator delicately designed following physics. With the fictitious forces, the force-related IMU measurement (accelerations) can be correctly compensated in the non-inertial frame and thus Newton’s laws of motion are satisfied. In this case, the relationship between the accelerations and body motions is deterministic and learnable, and we train a neural network to model it for better motion capture. Furthermore, to train the neural network with synthetic data, we develop an IMU synthesis by simulation strategy to better model the noise model of IMU hardware and allow parameter tuning to fit different hardware. This strategy not only establishes the network training with synthetic data but also enables calibration error modeling to handle bad motion capture calibration, increasing the robustness of the system. Code is available at https://xinyu-yi.github.io/PNP/.
authors: Xinyu Yi, Yuxiao Zhou 0001, Feng Xu 0005

title: 基于物理的特征轨迹学习用于烟雾重建
title_en: Physics-Informed Learning of Characteristic Trajectories for Smoke Reconstruction.
abstract: 我们深入研究了通过稀疏视角RGB视频进行物理信息引导的烟雾和障碍物神经重建,解决复杂动态中有限观测带来的挑战。现有物理信息引导神经网络往往强调短期物理约束,而对长期守恒的合理保持研究较少。我们引入了神经特征轨迹场,这是一种利用欧拉神经场隐式建模拉格朗日流体轨迹的新表示方法。该无拓扑结构、可自动微分的表示方法支持任意帧间的高效流映射计算以及通过自动微分的高效速度提取。因此,它能够实现涵盖长期守恒和短期物理先验的端到端监督。基于该表示方法,我们提出了物理信息引导的轨迹学习及其在基于NeRF的场景重建中的集成。我们通过自监督场景分解实现高级障碍物处理,并通过无缝集成边界约束进行平滑融合。实验结果展示了克服遮挡不确定性、密度-颜色歧义以及静态-动态纠缠等挑战的能力。代码和样本测试见https://github.com/19reborn/PICT_smoke。
abstract_en: We delve into the physics-informed neural reconstruction of smoke and obstacles through sparse-view RGB videos, tackling challenges arising from limited observation of complex dynamics. Existing physics-informed neural networks often emphasize short-term physics constraints, leaving the proper preservation of long-term conservation less explored. We introduce Neural Characteristic Trajectory Fields, a novel representation utilizing Eulerian neural fields to implicitly model Lagrangian fluid trajectories. This topology-free, auto-differentiable representation facilitates efficient flow map calculations between arbitrary frames as well as efficient velocity extraction via auto-differentiation. Consequently, it enables end-to-end supervision covering long-term conservation and short-term physics priors. Building on the representation, we propose physics-informed trajectory learning and integration into NeRF-based scene reconstruction. We enable advanced obstacle handling through self-supervised scene decomposition and seamless integrated boundary constraints. Our results showcase the ability to overcome challenges like occlusion uncertainty, density-color ambiguity, and static-dynamic entanglements. Code and sample tests are at https://github.com/19reborn/PICT_smoke.
authors: Yiming Wang 0009, Siyu Tang 0001, Mengyu Chu

title: 基于物理的人类运动场景布局生成
title_en: Physics-based Scene Layout Generation from Human Motion.
abstract: 为捕捉到的运动创建实现逼真人与场景交互的场景,对于电影或视频游戏中的三维动画至关重要。由于角色运动通常在没有真实家具或物体的蓝幕工作室中捕捉,计划运动与捕捉运动之间可能存在差异。这催生了自动场景布局生成的需求,以减轻选择和定位家具及物体的负担。由于缺乏物理约束,以往的方法无法避免穿透和漂浮等伪影。此外,一些方法严重依赖特定数据来学习接触可能性,限制了其对不同运动的泛化能力。在本工作中,我们提出了一种基于物理的方法,该方法同时优化场景布局生成器,并在物理模拟器中模拟移动的人。为了实现合理且逼真的交互运动,我们的方法明确引入了物理约束。为了自动恢复和生成场景布局,我们最小化运动跟踪误差以识别能够提供交互的物体。我们使用强化学习对角色运动模仿控制器和场景布局生成器进行双优化。为了促进优化,我们重塑跟踪奖励,并设计来自我们估计的伪接触标签的姿态先验引导。我们使用SAMP和PROX中的运动来评估我们的方法,并与之前的基于运动学的方法相比,展示了物理上合理的场景布局重建。
abstract_en: Creating scenes for captured motions that achieve realistic human-scene interaction is crucial for 3D animation in movies or video games. As character motion is often captured in a blue-screened studio without real furniture or objects in place, there may be a discrepancy between the planned motion and the captured one. This gives rise to the need for automatic scene layout generation to relieve the burdens of selecting and positioning furniture and objects. Previous approaches cannot avoid artifacts like penetration and floating due to the lack of physical constraints. Furthermore, some heavily rely on specific data to learn the contact affordances, restricting the generalization ability to different motions. In this work, we present a physics-based approach that simultaneously optimizes a scene layout generator and simulates a moving human in a physics simulator. To attain plausible and realistic interaction motions, our method explicitly introduces physical constraints. To automatically recover and generate the scene layout, we minimize the motion tracking errors to identify the objects that can afford interaction. We use reinforcement learning to perform a dual-optimization of both the character motion imitation controller and the scene layout generator. To facilitate the optimization, we reshape the tracking rewards and devise pose prior guidance obtained from our estimated pseudo-contact labels. We evaluate our method using motions from SAMP and PROX, and demonstrate physically plausible scene layout reconstruction compared with the previous kinematics-based method.
authors: Jianan Li 0006, Tao Huang, Qingxu Zhu 0001, Tien-Tsin Wong

title: 去噪蒙特卡洛图像合成的实用误差估计
title_en: Practical Error Estimation for Denoised Monte Carlo Image Synthesis.
abstract: 我们提出了一种结合基于深度学习的去噪技术的实用全局误差估计方法,用于蒙特卡洛光线追踪。我们的方法通过聚合偏差和方差的估计值,确定像素的平方误差分布。与经典蒙特卡洛光线追踪的无偏估计不同,该分布遵循非中心卡方分布(在合理假设下)。基于此,我们开发了一种去噪蒙特卡洛图像合成的停止准则,当达到用户指定的误差阈值时终止渲染过程。实验结果表明,我们的误差估计方法和停止准则在多种场景中均表现良好,并且能够在无需用户指定所需采样数的情况下达到指定的误差阈值。
abstract_en: We present a practical global error estimation technique for Monte Carlo ray tracing combined with deep learning based denoising. Our method uses aggregated estimates of bias and variance to determine the squared error distribution of the pixels. Unlike unbiased estimates for classical Monte Carlo ray tracing, this distribution follows a noncentral chi-squared distribution, under reasonable assumptions. Based on this, we develop a stopping criterion for denoised Monte Carlo image synthesis that terminates rendering once a user specified error threshold has been achieved. Our results demonstrate that our error estimate and stopping criterion work well on a variety of scenes, and that we are able to achieve a given error threshold without the user specifying the number of samples needed.
authors: Arthur Firmino, Ravi Ramamoorthi, Jeppe Revall Frisvad, Henrik Wann Jensen

title: 用于实时内点超弹性的预处理非线性共轭梯度法
title_en: Preconditioned Nonlinear Conjugate Gradient Method for Real-time Interior-point Hyperelasticity.
abstract: 线性共轭梯度法广泛应用于物理模拟,特别是用于求解由牛顿法导出的大规模线性系统。非线性共轭梯度法将共轭梯度法推广至非线性优化领域,被广泛应用于解决实际的大规模无约束优化问题。然而,由于需要多次向量-向量点积,其在物理模拟中鲜有讨论。幸运的是,随着GPU并行加速技术的发展,这一限制已不再成为瓶颈。本文提出了一种基于雅可比预处理的非线性共轭梯度法,用于弹性变形的内点法求解。该方法具有简单、可GPU并行化、收敛速度快且对大时间步长具有鲁棒性。内点法中障碍函数的使用要求每次迭代进行连续碰撞检测以获得无穿透步长,这在计算上成本高昂且难以在GPU上并行化。为解决此问题,我们引入了一种线搜索策略,通过单次通过推导出合适的步长,从而无需额外的碰撞检测。此外,我们简化并加速了超弹性与障碍函数的雅可比预处理及Hessian-向量乘积计算。该方法可实时模拟包含超过10万个四面体的复杂自碰撞场景中的物体。
abstract_en: The linear conjugate gradient method is widely used in physical simulation, particularly for solving large-scale linear systems derived from Newton’s method. The nonlinear conjugate gradient method generalizes the conjugate gradient method to nonlinear optimization, which is extensively utilized in solving practical large-scale unconstrained optimization problems. However, it is rarely discussed in physical simulation due to the requirement of multiple vector-vector dot products. Fortunately, with the advancement of GPU-parallel acceleration techniques, it is no longer a bottleneck. In this paper, we propose a Jacobi preconditioned nonlinear conjugate gradient method for elastic deformation using interior-point methods. Our method is straightforward, GPU-parallelizable, and exhibits fast convergence and robustness against large time steps. The employment of the barrier function in interior-point methods necessitates continuous collision detection per iteration to obtain a penetration-free step size, which is computationally expensive and challenging to parallelize on GPUs. To address this issue, we introduce a line search strategy that deduces an appropriate step size in a single pass, eliminating the need for additional collision detection. Furthermore, we simplify and accelerate the computations of Jacobi preconditioning and Hessian-vector product for hyperelasticity and barrier function. Our method can accurately simulate objects comprising over 100,000 tetrahedra in complex self-collision scenarios at real-time speeds.
authors: Xing Shen, Runyuan Cai, Mengxiao Bi, Tangjie Lv

title: 原始-对偶非光滑摩擦在刚体动画中的应用
title_en: Primal-Dual Non-Smooth Friction for Rigid Body Animation.
abstract: 当前用于模拟摩擦的数值算法主要分为两类:光滑求解器以牺牲静态摩擦的稳定处理来换取快速收敛,而非光滑求解器则在收敛速度上往往难以满足大规模图形应用的需求。我们提出了一种新颖的桥梁方法,能够在稳定性和效率之间取得平衡,准确计算静态摩擦与动态摩擦。我们的核心思想是通过引入对数障碍函数,将高度约束的非光滑问题转化为无约束光滑问题,随着精度的提升,该方法能够收敛到精确解。我们将问题表述为一个内点原始-对偶问题,可通过牛顿迭代高效求解。尽管原始问题具有非光滑性,我们观察到其仍具有二次收敛特性。该方法特别适用于紧密堆积的大型物体系统,具有大量接触点。我们通过稳定的颗粒堆叠、物体堆叠、复杂颗粒流以及刚体的鲁棒互锁装配等实验,验证了该方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Current numerical algorithms for simulating friction fall in one of two camps: smooth solvers sacrifice the stable treatment of static friction in exchange for fast convergence, and non-smooth solvers accurately compute friction at convergence rates that are often prohibitive for large graphics applications. We introduce a novel bridge between these two ideas that computes static and dynamic friction stably and efficiently. Our key idea is to convert the highly constrained non-smooth problem into an unconstrained smooth problem using logarithmic barriers that converges to the exact solution as accuracy increases. We phrase the problem as an interior point primal-dual problem that can be solved efficiently with Newton iteration. We observe quadratic convergence despite the non-smooth nature of the original problem, and our method is well-suited for large systems of tightly packed objects with many contact points. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method with stable piles of grains and stacks of objects, complex granular flows, and robust interlocking assemblies of rigid bodies.
authors: Yi-Lu Chen, Mickaël Ly, Chris Wojtan

title: QT-Font:基于四叉树的扩散模型实现高效字体合成
title_en: QT-Font: High-efficiency Font Synthesis via Quadtree-based Diffusion Models.
abstract: 少样本字体生成(FFG)旨在简化字体设计过程中的手动环节。现有模型能够生成与少量输入参考字形相同风格的字形图像。然而,主要由于其低效的字形表示,现有FFG方法仅限于生成低分辨率的字形图像。为了解决这一问题,我们引入了QT-Font,这是一种专门用于FFG的高效四叉树扩散模型。更具体地说,我们设计了一种稀疏四叉树字形表示,以降低表示空间的复杂度,展现出线性复杂度和唯一性。同时,为了降低计算复杂度,我们提出了一种基于双四叉树图网络和离散扩散模型的U-net模型。此外,还采用了内容感知池化模块以降低扩散过程的计算需求。定性和定量实验表明,与现有方法相比,我们的QT-Font能够生成具有更高质量和更具视觉吸引力细节的高分辨率字形图像,同时显著降低参数规模和计算成本。
abstract_en: Few-shot font generation (FFG) aims to streamline the manual aspects of the font design process. Existing models are capable of generating glyph images in the same style of a few input reference glyphs. However, mainly due to their inefficient glyph representations, these existing FFG methods are limited to generating low-resolution glyph images. To address this problem, we introduce QT-Font, an efficient quadtree-based diffusion model specifically designed for FFG. More specifically, we design a sparse quadtree-based glyph representation to reduce the complexity of the representation space, exhibiting linear complexity and uniqueness. Concurrently, to reduce computational complexity, we propose a U-net model based on the dual quadtree graph network and the discrete diffusion model. Furthermore, a content-aware pooling module is also adopted to lessen the computational demands of the diffusion process. Qualitative and quantitative experiments have been conducted to demonstrate that our QT-Font, compared to existing approaches, can generate high-resolution glyph images with superior quality and more visually pleasing details, meanwhile significantly reducing both parameter sizes and computational costs.
authors: Yitian Liu, Zhouhui Lian

title: 四维优化低差异序列
title_en: Quad-Optimized Low-Discrepancy Sequences.
abstract: 蒙特卡洛积分的收敛性取决于样本的均匀性以及被积函数的正则性。尽管已有大量工作致力于生成优秀的、高度均匀的采样模式,但Sobol采样器在生产渲染系统中仍占据主导地位。这不仅因其合理的质量,还因为它能够支持(几乎)任意维度、任意样本数量的积分,实际生成序列从而实现渐进式渲染,具有快速样本生成和小内存占用的优势。我们在连续二维和四维投影的样本均匀性方面改进了Sobol序列,同时保持了类似的实用优势——序列、高维性、速度和紧凑性。我们的贡献基于一种以3为基数的Sobol构造方法,涉及不可约多项式和生成矩阵的搜索,可生成所有连续四维维度的(1,4)-序列或(2,4)-序列,以及所有连续二维维度的(0,2)-序列。我们提供了这些多项式和矩阵,可作为Joe & Kuo广泛使用的替代方案,对于中等维度问题具有可接受的计算开销。
abstract_en: The convergence of Monte Carlo integration is given by the uniformity of samples as well as the regularity of the integrand. Despite much effort dedicated to producing excellent, extremely uniform, sampling patterns, the Sobol’ sampler remains unchallenged in production rendering systems. This is not only due to its reasonable quality, but also because it allows for integration in (almost) arbitrary dimension, with arbitrary sample count, while actually producing sequences thus allowing for progressive rendering, with fast sample generation and small memory footprint. We improve over Sobol’ sequences in terms of sample uniformity in consecutive 2-d and 4-d projections, while providing similar practical benefits – sequences, high dimensionality, speed and compactness. We base our contribution on a base-3 Sobol’ construction, involving a search over irreducible polynomials and generator matrices, that produce (1, 4)-sequences or (2,4)-sequences in all consecutive quadruplets of dimensions, and (0, 2)-sequence in all consecutive pairs of dimensions. We provide these polynomials and matrices that may be used as a replacement of Joe & Kuo’s widely used ones, with computational overhead, for moderate-dimensional problems.
authors: Victor Ostromoukhov, Nicolas Bonneel, David Coeurjolly, Jean-Claude Iehl

title: RGB↔X:基于材质和光照感知扩散模型的图像分解与合成
title_en: RGB↔X: Image decomposition and synthesis using material- and lighting-aware diffusion models.
abstract: 现实感正向渲染、逐像素逆渲染和生成图像合成这三个领域看似是图形学与视觉领域的独立子领域。然而,近期研究表明,基于扩散架构可以改进逐像素内在通道(漫反射率、粗糙度、金属度)的估计,我们称之为RGB → X问题。我们进一步证明,给定内在通道合成现实图像的逆问题(X → RGB)也可以在扩散框架中解决。聚焦于室内场景的图像域,我们引入了改进的RGB → X扩散模型,该模型同时估计光照,并提出了首个能够从(完整或部分)内在通道合成现实图像的X → RGB扩散模型。我们的X → RGB模型在传统渲染与生成模型之间探索了中间地带:我们只需指定应遵循的特定外观属性,而模型则可自由生成其余部分的合理版本。这种灵活性使得可以混合使用在可用通道上存在差异的异构训练数据集。我们使用多个现有数据集,并扩展了自有的合成与真实数据,从而得到一个能够优于先前工作的场景属性提取模型,并能生成高度逼真的室内场景图像。
abstract_en: The three areas of realistic forward rendering, per-pixel inverse rendering, and generative image synthesis may seem like separate and unrelated sub-fields of graphics and vision. However, recent work has demonstrated improved estimation of per-pixel intrinsic channels (albedo, roughness, metallicity) based on a diffusion architecture; we call this the RGB → X problem. We further show that the reverse problem of synthesizing realistic images given intrinsic channels, X → RGB, can also be addressed in a diffusion framework. Focusing on the image domain of interior scenes, we introduce an improved diffusion model for RGB → X, which also estimates lighting, as well as the first diffusion X → RGB model capable of synthesizing realistic images from (full or partial) intrinsic channels. Our X → RGB model explores a middle ground between traditional rendering and generative models: We can specify only certain appearance properties that should be followed, and give freedom to the model to hallucinate a plausible version of the rest. This flexibility allows using a mix of heterogeneous training datasets that differ in the available channels. We use multiple existing datasets and extend them with our own synthetic and real data, resulting in a model capable of extracting scene properties better than previous work and of generating highly realistic images of interior scenes.
authors: Zheng Zeng 0005, Valentin Deschaintre, Iliyan Georgiev, Yannick Hold-Geoffroy, Yiwei Hu, Fujun Luan, Ling-Qi Yan 0001, Milos Hasan
