title: 雷达场:用于调频连续波雷达的频率-空间神经场景表示
title_en: Radar Fields: Frequency-Space Neural Scene Representations for FMCW Radar.
abstract: 神经场已被广泛研究作为场景表示方法,用于再现与新颖生成多样化的户外场景,包括自动驾驶车辆和机器人必须处理的场景。尽管RGB和LiDAR数据的成功方法已存在,但作为感知模态的雷达神经重建方法仍被广泛忽视。工作在毫米波长的雷达传感器对雾和雨中的散射具有鲁棒性,因此为主动和被动光学感知技术提供了互补的感知模态。此外,现有雷达传感器具有高性价比,广泛部署在户外操作的机器人和车辆中。我们引入了雷达场——一种专为主动雷达成像器设计的神经场景重建方法。我们的方法将显式的、物理感知的传感器模型与隐式的神经几何和反射模型相结合,直接合成原始雷达测量数据并提取场景占用信息。所提方法不依赖于体积渲染。相反,我们以原始雷达数据为监督,在傅里叶频率空间中学习场。我们在多种户外场景中验证了方法的有效性,包括密集车辆和基础设施的城市场景,以及毫米波长感知表现优异的恶劣天气场景。
abstract_en: Neural fields have been broadly investigated as scene representations for the reproduction and novel generation of diverse outdoor scenes, including those autonomous vehicles and robots must handle. While successful approaches for RGB and LiDAR data exist, neural reconstruction methods for radar as a sensing modality have been largely unexplored. Operating at millimeter wavelengths, radar sensors are robust to scattering in fog and rain, and, as such, offer a complementary modality to active and passive optical sensing techniques. Moreover, existing radar sensors are highly cost-effective and deployed broadly in robots and vehicles that operate outdoors. We introduce Radar Fields –- a neural scene reconstruction method designed for active radar imagers. Our approach unites an explicit, physics-informed sensor model with an implicit neural geometry and reflectance model to directly synthesize raw radar measurements and extract scene occupancy. The proposed method does not rely on volume rendering. Instead, we learn fields in Fourier frequency space, supervised with raw radar data. We validate our method’s effectiveness across diverse outdoor scenarios, including urban scenes with dense vehicles and infrastructure, and harsh weather scenarios, where mm-wavelength sensing is favorable.
authors: David Borts, Erich Liang, Tim Broedermann, Andrea Ramazzina, Stefanie Walz, Edoardo Palladin, Jipeng Sun, David Brüggemann, Christos Sakaridis, Luc Van Gool, Mario Bijelic, Felix Heide

title: ReFiNe: 递归场网络用于跨模态多场景表示
title_en: ReFiNe: Recursive Field Networks for Cross-Modal Multi-Scene Representation.
abstract: 当前最先进的多形状表示方法(单个模型"打包"多个物体)在建模精度与内存存储之间存在常见权衡。我们展示了如何以比之前可能更高的精度对表示为连续神经场的多个形状进行编码,并且内存使用量较低。我们的方法关键在于一种递归层次化公式,该公式利用物体自相似性,从而实现高度压缩且高效的形状潜在空间。得益于递归公式,我们的方法无需初始化和维护辅助数据结构即可支持空间和全局到局部潜在特征融合,同时仍允许连续场查询以实现诸如光线追踪等应用。在一组多样化数据集上的实验中,我们提供了令人信服的定性结果,并展示了单个网络每数据集的最先进多场景重建和压缩结果。
abstract_en: The common trade-offs of state-of-the-art methods for multi-shape representation (a single model "packing" multiple objects) involve trading modeling accuracy against memory and storage. We show how to encode multiple shapes represented as continuous neural fields with a higher degree of precision than previously possible and with low memory usage. Key to our approach is a recursive hierarchical formulation that exploits object self-similarity, leading to a highly compressed and efficient shape latent space. Thanks to the recursive formulation, our method supports spatial and global-to-local latent feature fusion without needing to initialize and maintain auxiliary data structures, while still allowing for continuous field queries to enable applications such as raytracing. In experiments on a set of diverse datasets, we provide compelling qualitative results and demonstrate state-of-the-art multi-scene reconstruction and compression results with a single network per dataset.
authors: Sergey Zakharov, Katherine Liu, Adrien Gaidon, Rares Ambrus

title: 追寻弧线:通过切点从符号距离函数重建曲面
title_en: Reach for the Arcs: Reconstructing Surfaces from SDFs via Tangent Points.
abstract: 我们提出了一种算法,从形状的符号距离函数(SDF)的离散样本中重建网格。对SDF的简单几何重新诠释使我们能够通过点云来表述问题,并利用现有技术从中提取曲面。我们从SDF数据中提取所有可能的信息,超越了常用算法,并且不施加拓扑或几何限制。
abstract_en: We introduce an algorithm to reconstruct a mesh from discrete samples of a shape’s Signed Distance Function (SDF). A simple geometric reinterpretation of the SDF lets us formulate the problem through a point cloud, from which a surface can be extracted with existing techniques. We extract all possible information from the SDF data, outperforming commonly used algorithms and imposing no topological or geometric restrictions.
authors: Silvia Sellán, Yingying Ren 0001, Christopher Batty, Oded Stein

title: 基于发丝网格的实时发丝渲染
title_en: Real-Time Hair Rendering with Hair Meshes.
abstract: 发丝网格在计算机图形学中被证明是建模和动画化发丝的有效方法。我们展示了如何利用发丝网格结构,在GPU上通过实时几何生成高效渲染基于发丝的模型,实现存储空间和内存带宽数量级的减少。我们使用网格着色器精心分配计算任务,并采用自定义纹理布局将部分计算卸载到硬件纹理单元。此外,我们还提出了一组程序化造型操作,以实现广泛发型的发丝变化,并采用一致的坐标系生成方法将这些变化附加到动画/变形的发丝网格上。最后,我们描述了细节层次技术以提升远距离发丝模型渲染的性能。我们的实验结果展示了基于发丝的渲染前所未有的性能水平,在消费级GPU上实现了数百个完整发丝模型的实时帧率动画与渲染。
abstract_en: Hair meshes are known to be effective for modeling and animating hair in computer graphics. We present how the hair mesh structure can be used for efficiently rendering strand-based hair models on the GPU with on-the-fly geometry generation that provides orders of magnitude reduction in storage and memory bandwidth. We use mesh shaders to carefully distribute the computation and a custom texture layout for offloading a part of the computation to the hardware texture units. We also present a set of procedural styling operations to achieve hair strand variations for a wide range of hairstyles and a consistent coordinate-frame generation approach to attach these variations to an animating/deforming hair mesh. Finally, we describe level-of-detail techniques for improving the performance of rendering distant hair models. Our results show an unprecedented level of performance with strand-based hair rendering, achieving hundreds of full hair models animated and rendered at real-time frame rates on a consumer GPU.
authors: Gaurav Bhokare, Eisen Montalvo, Elie Diaz, Cem Yuksel

title: 实时神经编织面料渲染
title_en: Real-time Neural Woven Fabric Rendering.
abstract: 编织面料广泛应用于真实感渲染领域,其中实时性同样至关重要。然而,由于其复杂的结构和光学特性,实时渲染真实感编织面料具有挑战性,这会导致在缺乏大量采样时出现走样和噪声。该问题的核心在于织物着色模型的多尺度表示,这使得能够实现快速范围查询。一些先前的神经方法通过在每种材质上单独训练来处理该问题,这限制了其实际应用。在本文中,我们提出了一种轻量级神经网络,用于在不同尺度上表示不同类型的编织面料。得益于编织面料图案的规律性和重复性,我们的网络可以将面料图案和参数编码为一个小型潜在向量,随后由小型解码器进行解释,从而实现不同类型的面料表示。通过将像素的足迹作为输入,我们的网络实现了多尺度表示。此外,由于其轻量结构,我们的网络运行速度快且占用存储空间小。因此,我们的方法在RTX 3090上实现了接近60帧每秒的编织面料渲染和编辑,其质量接近真实情况,并且无明显走样和噪声。
abstract_en: Woven fabrics are widely used in applications of realistic rendering, where real-time capability is also essential. However, rendering realistic woven fabrics in real time is challenging due to their complex structure and optical appearance, which cause aliasing and noise without many samples. The core of this issue is a multi-scale representation of the fabric shading model, which allows for a fast range query. Some previous neural methods deal with the issue at the cost of training on each material, which limits their practicality. In this paper, we propose a lightweight neural network to represent different types of woven fabrics at different scales. Thanks to the regularity and repetitiveness of woven fabric patterns, our network can encode fabric patterns and parameters as a small latent vector, which is later interpreted by a small decoder, enabling the representation of different types of fabrics. By applying the pixel’s footprint as input, our network achieves multi-scale representation. Moreover, our network is fast and occupies little storage because of its lightweight structure. As a result, our method achieves rendering and editing woven fabrics at nearly 60 frames per second on an RTX 3090, showing a quality close to the ground truth and being free from visible aliasing and noise.
authors: Xiang Chen, Lu Wang 0007, Beibei Wang 0002

title: 飞行昆虫实时翼变形模拟
title_en: Real-time Wing Deformation Simulations for Flying Insects.
abstract: 对飞行昆虫复杂翼变形的逼真模拟不仅加深了我们对昆虫飞行力学的理解,还为计算机动画和虚拟现实等领域开辟了众多应用前景。尽管该研究领域具有重要价值,但由于昆虫翅膀结构复杂多样以及变形模式复杂,相关研究仍相对较少。本文提出了一种高效的骨骼驱动模型,专门用于实时模拟各类飞行昆虫的逼真翼变形。我们的方法首先构建能够准确反映不同昆虫物种独特形态学特征的虚拟骨骼,该骨骼作为模拟翼变形中常见复杂变形波传播的基础。为真实再现这些变形中的弯曲效应,我们引入作用于翼关节的内部与外部力,结合周期性振翅运动和简化的空气动力学模型。此外,我们采用质量弹簧算法模拟翅膀的固有弹性,以防止过度扭曲。通过多种模拟实验、对比分析和用户研究,我们验证了该模型的有效性、鲁棒性和适应性。
abstract_en: Realistic simulation of the intricate wing deformations seen in flying insects not only deepens our comprehension of insect flight mechanics but also opens up numerous applications in fields such as computer animation and virtual reality. Despite its importance, this research area has been relatively underexplored due to the complex and diverse wing structures and the intricate patterns of deformation. This paper presents an efficient skeleton-driven model specifically designed to real-time simulate realistic wing deformations across a wide range of flying insects. Our approach begins with the construction of a virtual skeleton that accurately reflects the distinct morphological characteristics of individual insect species. This skeleton serves as the foundation for the simulation of the intricate deformation wave propagation often observed in wing deformations. To faithfully reproduce the bending effect seen in these deformations, we introduce both internal and external forces that act on the wing joints, drawing on periodic wing-beat motion and a simplified aerodynamics model. Additionally, we utilize mass-spring algorithms to simulate the inherent elasticity of the wings, helping to prevent excessive twisting. Through various simulation experiments, comparisons, and user studies, we demonstrate the effectiveness, robustness, and adaptability of our model.
authors: Qiang Chen, Zhigang Deng 0001, Feng Li, Yuming Fang, Tingsong Lu, Yang Tong, Yifan Zuo

title: 用于程序化建筑的重构语法
title_en: Recompose Grammars for Procedural Architecture.
abstract: 我们提出了用于建筑程序化建模的新型语法语言Recomp。在基于语法的方法中,程序化细化过程基于形状细分。这一分解过程导致了分离的子部件,这不仅限制了几何表达能力,还限制了对适当形状粒度的控制,从而影响设计决策的协调。Recomp通过扩展语法语言以具备重构能力来克服这些限制。核心概念是规则内联,允许通过将形状子树折叠为单个形状来实现编辑子部件的拓扑重构,从而继续推导过程。这一过程结合了多功能的几何标记系统,使作者能够在任意细节层次编译和传输上下文信息,并独立于形状树的结构完全控制几何形状。通过多个示例,我们展示了Recomp在程序化布局和体量建模中的强大功能,以及其在支持上下文敏感设计方面的能力。
abstract_en: We present the novel grammar language Recomp for the procedural modeling of architecture. In grammar-based approaches, the procedural refinement process is based on shape subdivisions. This process of decomposition results in disconnected subparts, which not only restricts the geometric expressiveness but also limits the control over an appropriate shape granularity needed to coordinate design decisions. Recomp overcomes these limitations by extending grammar languages with the recomposition ability. Fundamental is the concept of rule inlining, allowing for the topological recomposition of edited subparts by collapsing a shape subtree into one single shape on which derivation can continue. This is completed with a versatile geometry tagging system, allowing authors to compile and transport context information at any level of detail and gain full control over the geometry independent of the structure of the shape tree. Through various examples, we demonstrate the power of Recomp in procedural layout and mass modeling, as well as its capabilities in facilitating context-sensitive design.
authors: Niklaus Houska, Cheryl Lau, Matthias Specht

title: Rip-NeRF:基于Ripmap编码的柏拉图立体体的抗锯齿辐射场
title_en: Rip-NeRF: Anti-aliasing Radiance Fields with Ripmap-Encoded Platonic Solids.
abstract: 尽管神经辐射场(NeRFs)取得了显著进展,但渲染结果仍可能因锥体投射过程导致的各向异性区域表征问题而出现锯齿和模糊伪影。本文提出了一种基于Ripmap编码的柏拉图立体体表示方法,以精确且高效地特征化3D各向异性区域,实现高保真抗锯齿渲染。我们的方法核心包含两个关键组件:柏拉图立体体投影与Ripmap编码。柏拉图立体体投影将3D空间分解到特定柏拉图立体体的不重叠面,使各向异性3D区域可投影到具有可区分特征的平面上。同时,每个柏拉图立体体面通过Ripmap编码进行表示,该编码由各向异性预滤波可学习特征网格构建,从而通过各向异性区域采样实现对投影各向异性区域的精确高效特征化。在经典合成数据集和新采集的真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明,我们的Rip-NeRF在重复结构和纹理的细节表现上显著优于现有方法,同时保持相对快速的训练速度,如图1所示。本文的源代码和数据可在https://github.com/JunchenLiu77/Rip-NeRF获取。
abstract_en: Despite significant advancements in Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs), the renderings may still suffer from aliasing and blurring artifacts, since it remains a fundamental challenge to effectively and efficiently characterize anisotropic areas induced by the cone-casting procedure. This paper introduces a Ripmap-Encoded Platonic Solid representation to precisely and efficiently featurize 3D anisotropic areas, achieving high-fidelity anti-aliased renderings. Central to our approach are two key components: Platonic Solid Projection and Ripmap encoding. The Platonic Solid Projection factorizes the 3D space onto the unparalleled faces of a certain Platonic solid, such that the anisotropic 3D areas can be projected onto planes with distinguishable characterization. Meanwhile, each face of the Platonic solid is encoded by the Ripmap encoding, which is constructed by anisotropically pre-filtering a learnable feature grid, to enable featurzing the projected anisotropic areas both precisely and efficiently by the anisotropic area-sampling. Extensive experiments on both well-established synthetic datasets and a newly captured real-world dataset demonstrate that our Rip-NeRF attains state-of-the-art rendering quality, particularly excelling in the fine details of repetitive structures and textures, while maintaining relatively swift training times, as shown in Fig. 1. The source code and data for this paper are at https://github.com/JunchenLiu77/Rip-NeRF.
authors: Junchen Liu, Wenbo Hu 0002, Zhuo Yang, Jianteng Chen, Guoliang Wang 0002, Xiaoxue Chen, Yantong Cai, Huan-ang Gao, Hao Zhao 0002

title: SMEAR:带有艺术指导的风格化运动夸张
title_en: SMEAR: Stylized Motion Exaggeration with ARt-direction.
abstract: 艺术家通常使用拖影帧来在动画中表现运动的表达性。本文提出了一种自动且可艺术指导的3D拖影帧生成方法,重点在于物体沿轨迹拉伸的延长中间帧。该方法输入一个3D网格的关键帧动画,输出动画每一帧的变形版本,同时在动画结束前提供艺术调整功能,以便在渲染前进行精细修饰。我们的方法分为两个步骤。首先,我们计算空间和时间一致的运动偏移量,描述输入网格的哪些部分应领先或滞后。然后,我们提出一个框架来对这些运动偏移量进行风格化处理,以在交互速率下生成延长中间帧,并扩展到另外两种常见的拖影帧效果:多重中间帧和运动线。新手用户可以依赖预设的风格化函数进行快速原型设计,而经验丰富的艺术家则可以通过Blender中的几何节点实现自定义复杂的风格化函数。
abstract_en: Smear frames are routinely used by artists for the expressive depiction of motion in animations. In this paper, we present an automatic, yet art-directable method for the generation of smear frames in 3D, with a focus on elongated in-betweens where an object is stretched along its trajectory. It takes as input a key-framed animation of a 3D mesh, and outputs a deformed version of this mesh for each frame of the animation, while providing for artistic refinement at the end of the animation process and prior to rendering. Our approach works in two steps. We first compute spatially and temporally coherent motion offsets that describe to which extent parts of the input mesh should be leading in front or trailing behind. We then describe a framework to stylize these motion offsets in order to produce elongated in-betweens at interactive rates, which we extend to the other two common smear frame effects: multiple in-betweens and motion lines. Novice users may rely on preset stylization functions for fast and easy prototyping, while more complex custom-made stylization functions may be designed by experienced artists through our geometry node implementation in Blender.
authors: Jean Basset, Pierre Bénard, Pascal Barla

title: ST-4DGS:面向高效动态场景渲染的时空持续四维高斯点云
title_en: ST-4DGS: Spatial-Temporally Consistent 4D Gaussian Splatting for Efficient Dynamic Scene Rendering.
abstract: 在任意新视角下进行动态场景渲染仍然是一个具有挑战性但重要的任务,尤其是在追求高保真渲染质量与高效渲染速度的场景中。近期的三维高斯点云(3DGS)技术在静态场景渲染中展现出显著成果,其在极高的渲染效率下实现了令人印象深刻的渲染质量。然而,将3DGS从静态场景扩展到动态四维高斯点云(4DGS)仍面临挑战,即使在前景物体运动量适中的场景(如人类移动物体)中也是如此。本文提出了一种新颖的时空持续四维高斯点云方法(ST-4DGS),旨在实现时空持续的动态渲染质量并保持实时渲染效率。ST-4DGS的核心思想包含两个创新机制:(1) 一种结合运动感知形状正则化的时空四维高斯点云方法,(2) 时空联合密度控制机制。所提出的机制有效防止了动态场景学习过程中四维高斯表示的紧致性退化,从而实现时空一致的动态渲染质量。在公开数据集上的广泛评估表明,我们的ST-4DGS在动态渲染质量上显著优于先前方法(如4DGS、HexPlane、K-Plane、4K4D等),并在持续动态渲染中实现了更高的渲染效率。据我们所知,ST-4DGS是目前高保真动态渲染领域的新一代四维高斯点云方法,特别是在运动量适中的场景中确保了时空一致的渲染质量。代码已开源至https://github.com/wanglids/ST-4DGS。
abstract_en: Dynamic scene rendering at any novel view continues to be a difficult but important task, especially for high-fidelity rendering quality with efficient rendering speed. The recent 3D Gaussian Splatting, i.e., 3DGS, shows great success for static scene rendering with impressive quality at a very efficient speed. However, the extension of 3DGS from static scene to dynamic 4DGS is still challenging, even for scenes with modest amounts of foreground object movement (such as a human moving an object). This paper proposes a novel spatial-temporally 4D Gaussian Splatting, i.e., ST-4DGS, which aims at the spatial-temporally persistent dynamic rendering quality and maintains real-time rendering efficiency. The key ideas of ST-4DGS are two novel mechanisms: (1) a novel spatial-temporal 4D Gaussian Splatting with a motion-aware shape regularization, and (2) a spatial-temporal joint density control mechanism. The proposed mechanisms efficiently prevent the compactness degeneration of the 4D Gaussian representation during dynamic scene learning, thus leading to spatial-temporally consistent dynamic rendering quality. With extensive evaluation on public datasets, our ST-4DGS can achieve much better dynamic rendering quality than previous approaches, such as 4DGS, HexPlane, K-Plane, 4K4D, etc, and in a more efficient rendering speed for persistent dynamic rendering. To our best knowledge, ST-4DGS is a new state-of-the-art 4D Gaussian Splatting for high-fidelity dynamic rendering, especially ensuring the spatial-temporally consistent rendering quality in scenes with modest movement. The code is available at https://github.com/wanglids/ST-4DGS.
authors: Deqi Li, Shi-Sheng Huang, Zhiyuan Lu, Xinran Duan, Hua Huang 0001

title: 扫视依赖渲染
title_en: Saccade-Contingent Rendering.
abstract: 电池供电限制下的功耗、计算限制以及头戴式显示设备的高帧率需求,在虚拟现实领域呈现越来越沉浸式和舒适的图像时带来了独特挑战。然而,人类对视觉场域各区域的敏感度并不相同,感知优化的渲染技术正被越来越多地用于解决这些瓶颈问题。许多此类技术依赖注视追踪,通常在用户注视点外渲染较低细节。这些技术依赖时空准确的注视追踪,当眼动追踪不准确时会导致明显的视觉伪影。在本研究中,我们提出了一种仅需扫视检测的注视依赖渲染技术,无需高精度眼动追踪。在第一个实验中,我们展示了扫视后数百毫秒内视觉敏锐度降低的现象。在第二个实验中,我们利用这些结果,在受控的感知实验设置中,在扫视后降低渲染图像分辨率,发现观察者在实验1确定的某些条件下无法区分扫视依赖的低分辨率渲染与全分辨率渲染。最后,在第三个实验中,我们引入了90像素/度的头戴设备,并在典型VR观看条件下验证了我们的扫视依赖渲染方法。
abstract_en: Battery-constrained power consumption, compute limitations, and high frame rate requirements in head-mounted displays present unique challenges in the drive to present increasingly immersive and comfortable imagery in virtual reality. However, humans are not equally sensitive to all regions of the visual field, and perceptually-optimized rendering techniques are increasingly utilized to address these bottlenecks. Many of these techniques are gaze-contingent and often render reduced detail away from a user’s fixation. Such techniques are dependent on spatio-temporally-accurate gaze tracking and can result in obvious visual artifacts when eye tracking is inaccurate. In this work we present a gaze-contingent rendering technique which only requires saccade detection, bypassing the need for highly-accurate eye tracking. In our first experiment, we show that visual acuity is reduced for several hundred milliseconds after a saccade. In our second experiment, we use these results to reduce the rendered image resolution after saccades in a controlled psychophysical setup, and find that observers cannot discriminate between saccade-contingent, reduced-resolution rendering and full-resolution rendering under certain conditions identified in Experiment 1. Finally, in our third experiment, we introduce a 90 pixels per degree headset and validate our saccade-contingent rendering method under typical VR viewing conditions.
authors: Yuna Kwak, Eric Penner, Xuan Wang, Mohammad R. Saeedpour-Parizi, Olivier Mercier, Xiuyun Wu, T. Scott Murdison, Phillip Guan

title: 基于SSI深度的尺度不变单目深度估计
title_en: Scale-Invariant Monocular Depth Estimation via SSI Depth.
abstract: 现有尺度不变单目深度估计(SI MDE)方法常因任务复杂性及数据集有限且缺乏多样性而面临挑战,阻碍了实际场景中的泛化能力。而移位和尺度不变(SSI)深度估计通过简化任务并利用丰富的立体数据集进行训练,实现了高性能。我们提出了一种新方法,利用SSI输入增强SI深度估计,简化网络功能,并仅使用合成数据集进行训练,实现SI深度估计的野外泛化。强调高分辨率细节生成,我们引入了一种新颖的稀疏序数损失,显著提升了SSI MDE中的细节生成能力,解决了现有方法的关键局限。通过野外定性示例和零样本评估,我们验证了该方法在计算摄影应用中的实用价值,展示了其生成高细节SI深度图并实现多样化场景泛化的能力。
abstract_en: Existing methods for scale-invariant monocular depth estimation (SI MDE) often struggle due to the complexity of the task, and limited and non-diverse datasets, hindering generalizability in real-world scenarios. This is while shift-and-scale-invariant (SSI) depth estimation, simplifying the task and enabling training with abundant stereo datasets achieves high performance. We present a novel approach that leverages SSI inputs to enhance SI depth estimation, streamlining the network’s role and facilitating in-the-wild generalization for SI depth estimation while only using a synthetic dataset for training. Emphasizing the generation of high-resolution details, we introduce a novel sparse ordinal loss that substantially improves detail generation in SSI MDE, addressing critical limitations in existing approaches. Through in-the-wild qualitative examples and zero-shot evaluation we substantiate the practical utility of our approach in computational photography applications, showcasing its ability to generate highly detailed SI depth maps and achieve generalization in diverse scenarios.
authors: S. Mahdi H. Miangoleh, Mahesh Kumar Krishna Reddy, Yagiz Aksoy

title: 基于图谱学习的自监督视频失焦去模糊
title_en: Self-Supervised Video Defocus Deblurring with Atlas Learning.
abstract: 失焦现象在几乎所有视频制作中普遍存在,会降低视频质量并常导致昂贵的延迟和重拍。当前的自动对焦(AF)系统容易受到现实场景和拍摄现场中常见的主体运动或光线变化等突发干扰的影响。当将单图像失焦去模糊方法应用于视频时,其时间稳定性较差,无法恢复因时间变化的失焦模糊而被遮蔽的细节。本文提出了一种端到端的解决方案,允许用户在后期处理过程中校正失焦。我们的方法将失焦视频生成并参数化为锐利的分层神经图谱,并将一致的焦点跟踪传播回视频帧。我们引入了一种新颖的可微分圆盘模糊层,用于更精确的点扩散函数(PSF)模拟,并结合了从当前单图像失焦去模糊(SIDD)网络迁移学习得到的弥散圆(COC)图估计模块。我们的流程在生成的图谱上直接提供一致、锐利的视频重建和有效的主体焦点校正与跟踪。此外,通过采用我们的方法,我们在失焦视频中实现了与最先进的光流估计方法相当的成果。
abstract_en: Misfocus is ubiquitous for almost all video producers, degrading video quality and often causing expensive delays and reshoots. Current autofocus (AF) systems are vulnerable to sudden disturbances such as subject movement or lighting changes commonly present in real-world and on-set conditions. Single image defocus deblurring methods are temporally unstable when applied to videos and cannot recover details obscured by temporally varying defocus blur. In this paper, we present an end-to-end solution that allows users to correct misfocus during post-processing. Our method generates and parameterizes defocused videos into sharp layered neural atlases and propagates consistent focus tracking back to the video frames. We introduce a novel differentiable disk blur layer for more accurate point spread function (PSF) simulation, coupled with a circle of confusion (COC) map estimation module with knowledge transferred from the current single image defocus deblurring (SIDD) networks. Our pipeline offers consistent, sharp video reconstruction and effective subject-focus correction and tracking directly on the generated atlases. Furthermore, by adopting our approach, we achieve comparable results to the state-of-the-art optical flow estimation approach from defocus videos.
authors: Lingyan Ruan, Martin Bálint, Mojtaba Bemana, Krzysztof Wolski, Hans-Peter Seidel, Karol Myszkowski, Bin Chen 0019

title: 基于参数隐式模板的语义形状编辑
title_en: Semantic Shape Editing with Parametric Implicit Templates.
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于参数隐式曲面模板的语义形状编辑方法,用于编辑三维三角网格。该方法得益于分析隐式表示所提供的诸多优势,如无限分辨率和布尔或混合操作。我们首先提出一种模板拟合方法,通过优化参数以最佳捕捉输入网格。对于后续的模板编辑,我们的新型网格变形方法能够在存在各向异性拉伸和/或局部体积变化时跟踪模板的零集。我们对模板隐式场仅做较少假设,仅严格要求连续性。我们展示了该方法在交互式语义形状编辑和语义网格重定向中的应用。
abstract_en: We propose a semantic shape editing method to edit 3D triangle meshes using parametric implicit surface templates, benefiting from the many advantages offered by analytical implicit representations, such as infinite resolution and boolean or blending operations. We propose first a template fitting method to optimize its parameters to best capture the input mesh. For subsequent template edits, our novel mesh deformation method allows tracking the template’s 0-set even when featuring anisotropic stretch and/or local volume change. We make few assumptions on the template implicit fields and only strictly require continuity. We demonstrate applications to interactive semantic shape editing and semantic mesh retargeting.
authors: Uday Kusupati, Mathieu Gaillard, Jean-Marc Thiery, Adrien Kaiser

title: Separate-and-Enhance: 组合微调用于文本到图像扩散模型
title_en: Separate-and-Enhance: Compositional Finetuning for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models.
abstract: 尽管基于扩散的文本到图像(T2I)模型近期取得了显著进展,但当前系统在确保与文本提示对齐的合理组合生成方面仍存在不足,尤其是在多对象生成场景中。在本工作中,我们首先通过识别与低注意力激活和掩码重叠相关的问题,揭示了这种错位的根本原因。随后,我们提出了一种组合微调框架,包含两个新颖的目标函数:分离损失(Separate loss)和增强损失(Enhance loss),分别用于减少对象掩码重叠并最大化注意力得分。与传统的测试时适应方法不同,我们的模型在关键参数微调后,能够直接根据任意多对象提示进行推理,从而提升了可扩展性和泛化能力。通过全面评估,我们的模型在图像真实感、文本-图像对齐度和适应性方面均表现出卓越性能,显著超越了现有基线模型。此外,我们证明了通过多样化概念进行训练可以使模型有效泛化到新概念,相较于仅基于单一概念对训练的模型,其性能得到显著提升。
abstract_en: Despite recent significant strides achieved by diffusion-based Text-to-Image (T2I) models, current systems are still less capable of ensuring decent compositional generation aligned with text prompts, particularly for the multi-object generation. In this work, we first show the fundamental reasons for such misalignment by identifying issues related to low attention activation and mask overlaps. Then we propose a compositional finetuning framework with two novel objectives, the Separate loss and the Enhance loss, that reduce object mask overlaps and maximize attention scores, respectively. Unlike conventional test-time adaptation methods, our model, once finetuned on critical parameters, is able to directly perform inference given an arbitrary multi-object prompt, which enhances the scalability and generalizability. Through comprehensive evaluations, our model demonstrates superior performance in image realism, text-image alignment, and adaptability, significantly surpassing established baselines. Furthermore, we show that training our model with a diverse range of concepts enables it to generalize effectively to novel concepts, exhibiting enhanced performance compared to models trained on individual concept pairs.
authors: Zhipeng Bao, Yijun Li 0001, Krishna Kumar Singh, Yu-Xiong Wang, Martial Hebert

title: 针织图设计中的奇异叶状结构
title_en: Singular Foliations for Knit Graph Design.
abstract: 我们基于[Mitra et al. 2023]提出的基于条纹的针织规划框架,从奇异叶状结构的视角审视生成的条纹模式。该视角将条纹(进而候选的经行或罗列)视为[Knöppel et al. 2015]纺纱形式定义的向量场的积分曲线。我们展示了如何通过线性水平集约束紧密控制该向量场的拓扑结构,防止任何积分曲线产生螺旋。实际上,这消除了[Mitra et al. 2023]的条纹放置约束,允许在不引入额外螺旋的情况下调整条纹频率和位移。在此过程中,我们首次对奇异三角形内纺纱形式水平集结构进行了显式代数表征,并用"有效"插值替代标准插值,提升针织图生成的鲁棒性。我们还通过基于莫尔斯理论的圆柱分解,将[Mitra et al. 2023]的模型扩展到具有亏格的曲面,并在生成的组件上实现了自动奇点配对。
abstract_en: We build upon the stripes-based knit planning framework of [Mitra et al. 2023], and view the resultant stripe pattern through the lens of singular foliations. This perspective views the stripes, and thus the candidate course rows or wale columns, as integral curves of a vector field specified by the spinning form of [Knöppel et al. 2015]. We show how to tightly control the topological structure of this vector field with linear level set constraints, preventing helicing of any integral curve. Practically speaking, this obviates the stripe placement constraints of [Mitra et al. 2023] and allows for shifting and variation of the stripe frequency without introducing additional helices. En route, we make the first explicit algebraic characterization of spinning form level set structure within singular triangles, and replace the standard interpolant with an “effective” one that improves the robustness of knit graph generation. We also extend the model of [Mitra et al. 2023] to surfaces with genus, via a Morse-based cylindrical decomposition, and implement automatic singularity pairing on the resulting components.
authors: Rahul Mitra, Erick Jimenez Berumen, Megan Hofmann, Edward Chien

title: 基于可微分仿真的柔性气动执行器设计
title_en: Soft Pneumatic Actuator Design using Differentiable Simulation.
abstract: 我们提出了一种用于通过接触与环境交互的气动柔性机器人的计算设计流程。我们采用形状优化方法优化机器人的形状,使用物理准确的高阶有限元模型进行正向仿真。我们的方法通过优化内部腔体的形状,实现了对变形和接触力的精细控制,从而设计出能够实现用户指定姿态或施加用户控制力的气动柔性机器人。我们在两个艺术类和两个功能类示例中验证了该方法的有效性。
abstract_en: We propose a computational design pipeline for pneumatically-actuated soft robots interacting with their environment through contact. We optimize the shape of the robot with a shape optimization approach, using a physically-accurate high-order finite element model for the forward simulation. Our approach enables fine-grained control over both deformation and contact forces by optimizing the shape of internal cavities, which we exploit to design pneumatically-actuated robots that can assume user-prescribed poses, or apply user-controlled forces. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method on two artistic and two functional examples.
authors: Arvi Gjoka, Espen Knoop, Moritz Bächer, Denis Zorin, Daniele Panozzo

title: Spice·E:基于跨实体注意力的3D扩散中的结构先验
title_en: Spice·E: Structural Priors in 3D Diffusion using Cross-Entity Attention.
abstract: 随着预训练的文本到图像扩散模型的出现,我们正在见证自动生成和操作3D资产的快速进展。然而,合成每个样本都需要耗时的优化过程,阻碍了其在民主化3D内容创作中的潜力。相反,3D扩散模型现在在百万级3D数据集上进行训练,能够在数秒内生成高质量的文本条件3D样本。在本工作中,我们提出了Spice · E——一种为3D扩散模型添加结构指导的神经网络,将它们的应用扩展到文本条件生成之外。我们的框架核心引入了一种跨实体注意力机制,允许多个实体——特别是配对的输入和指导3D形状——通过去噪网络中的内部表示进行交互。我们利用这一机制,从辅助指导形状中学习3D扩散模型的任务特定结构先验。我们展示了我们的方法支持多种应用,包括3D风格化、语义形状编辑和文本条件抽象到3D,该技术将基于基本体的抽象转换为高度表达的形状。大量实验表明,Spice · E在这些任务上实现了SOTA性能,同时通常比替代方法快得多。重要的是,这是在不针对任何特定任务进行定制的情况下实现的。我们将发布我们的代码和训练模型。
abstract_en: We are witnessing rapid progress in automatically generating and manipulating 3D assets due to the availability of pretrained text-to-image diffusion models. However, time-consuming optimization procedures are required for synthesizing each sample, hindering their potential for democratizing 3D content creation. Conversely, 3D diffusion models now train on million-scale 3D datasets, yielding high-quality text-conditional 3D samples within seconds. In this work, we present Spice · E – a neural network that adds structural guidance to 3D diffusion models, extending their usage beyond text-conditional generation. At its core, our framework introduces a cross-entity attention mechanism that allows for multiple entities—in particular, paired input and guidance 3D shapes—to interact via their internal representations within the denoising network. We utilize this mechanism for learning task-specific structural priors in 3D diffusion models from auxiliary guidance shapes. We show that our approach supports a variety of applications, including 3D stylization, semantic shape editing and text-conditional abstraction-to-3D, which transforms primitive-based abstractions into highly-expressive shapes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Spice · E achieves SOTA performance over these tasks while often being considerably faster than alternative methods. Importantly, this is accomplished without tailoring our approach for any specific task. We will release our code and trained models.
authors: Etai Sella, Gal Fiebelman, Noam Atia, Hadar Averbuch-Elor

title: Stabler Neo-Hookean 模拟:投影牛顿法中的绝对特征值滤波
title_en: Stabler Neo-Hookean Simulation: Absolute Eigenvalue Filtering for Projected Newton.
abstract: 体积保持的超弹性材料广泛用于建模近不可压缩材料,如橡胶和软组织。然而,由于能量函数的非凸性,体积保持超弹性材料的数值模拟在该领域内极具挑战性。在本工作中,我们识别了流行特征值钳制策略在投影牛顿法中将Hessian矩阵投影到正半定性的弊端。我们提出了一种新颖的特征值滤波策略,用于投影牛顿法以稳定Neo-Hookean能量及其他体积保持变体在高泊松比(接近0.5)和大初始体积变化下的优化过程。我们的方法仅需在现有投影牛顿框架中进行一行代码修改,即可在稳定性和收敛速度方面实现显著提升。我们在多种具有挑战性的示例和大规模数据集上的不同变形中验证了所提出特征值投影方案的有效性和效率。
abstract_en: Volume-preserving hyperelastic materials are widely used to model near-incompressible materials such as rubber and soft tissues. However, the numerical simulation of volume-preserving hyperelastic materials is notoriously challenging within this regime due to the non-convexity of the energy function. In this work, we identify the pitfalls of the popular eigenvalue clamping strategy for projecting Hessian matrices to positive semi-definiteness during Newton’s method. We introduce a novel eigenvalue filtering strategy for projected Newton’s method to stabilize the optimization of Neo-Hookean energy and other volume-preserving variants under high Poisson’s ratio (near 0.5) and large initial volume change. Our method only requires a single line of code change in the existing projected Newton framework, while achieving significant improvement in both stability and convergence speed. We demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our eigenvalue projection scheme on a variety of challenging examples and over different deformations on a large dataset.
authors: Honglin Chen, Hsueh-Ti Derek Liu, David I. W. Levin, Changxi Zheng, Alec Jacobson

title: 基于物理的乒乓球动画中的策略与技能学习
title_en: Strategy and Skill Learning for Physics-based Table Tennis Animation.
abstract: 近期基于物理的动画角色运动研究利用深度学习生成敏捷且自然的运动,使角色能够执行后空翻、拳击和网球等动作。然而,再现人类在动态环境中选择和使用多样化运动技能以解决复杂任务的能力,仍然是一个挑战。我们提出了一种基于物理的乒乓球动画中的策略与技能学习方法。我们的方法解决了模式崩溃问题,即角色在执行复杂任务时未能充分利用所需的运动技能。更具体地说,我们展示了一个用于多样化技能学习的分层控制系统和一个用于有效决策的策略学习框架。我们通过与最先进的方法进行比较分析,展示了我们方法的有效性,证明其在执行乒乓球各种技能方面的能力。我们的策略学习框架通过虚拟现实中的智能体-智能体交互和人-智能体交互进行了验证,能够处理竞争性和合作性任务。
abstract_en: Recent advancements in physics-based character animation leverage deep learning to generate agile and natural motion, enabling characters to execute movements such as backflips, boxing, and tennis. However, reproducing the selection and use of diverse motor skills in dynamic environments to solve complex tasks, as humans do, still remains a challenge. We present a strategy and skill learning approach for physics-based table tennis animation. Our method addresses the issue of mode collapse, where the characters do not fully utilize the motor skills they need to perform to execute complex tasks. More specifically, we demonstrate a hierarchical control system for diversified skill learning and a strategy learning framework for effective decision-making. We showcase the efficacy of our method through comparative analysis with state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating its capabilities in executing various skills for table tennis. Our strategy learning framework is validated through both agent-agent interaction and human-agent interaction in Virtual Reality, handling both competitive and cooperative tasks.
authors: Jiashun Wang, Jessica K. Hodgins, Jungdam Won

title: 街景:基于自回归视频扩散的大规模一致街景生成
title_en: Streetscapes: Large-scale Consistent Street View Generation Using Autoregressive Video Diffusion.
abstract: 我们提出了一种生成街景的方法——通过实时合成的城市级场景生成长序列视图。我们的生成过程以语言输入(如城市名称、天气)以及承载所需轨迹的底层地图/布局为条件。与近期的视频生成或三维视图合成模型相比,我们的方法能够扩展到更长范围的相机轨迹,跨越多个城市街区,同时保持视觉质量和一致性。为实现这一目标,我们基于近期的视频扩散研究,在自回归框架内进行构建,该框架可轻松扩展到长序列。特别是,我们引入了一种新的时间插补方法,防止自回归方法偏离真实城市图像的分布。我们使用Google街景提供的姿态图像以及上下文地图数据对街景系统进行训练,这使用户能够根据任何所需的城市布局生成城市视图,并控制相机姿态。
abstract_en: We present a method for generating Streetscapes—long sequences of views through an on-the-fly synthesized city-scale scene. Our generation is conditioned by language input (e.g., city name, weather), as well as an underlying map/layout hosting the desired trajectory. Compared to recent models for video generation or 3D view synthesis, our method can scale to much longer-range camera trajectories, spanning several city blocks, while maintaining visual quality and consistency. To achieve this goal, we build on recent work on video diffusion, used within an autoregressive framework that can easily scale to long sequences. In particular, we introduce a new temporal imputation method that prevents our autoregressive approach from drifting from the distribution of realistic city imagery. We train our Streetscapes system on a compelling source of data—posed imagery from Google Street View, along with contextual map data—which allows users to generate city views conditioned on any desired city layout, with controllable camera pose.
authors: Boyang Deng, Richard Tucker 0001, Zhengqi Li, Leonidas J. Guibas, Noah Snavely, Gordon Wetzstein

title: Subject-Diffusion: 开放域个性化文本到图像生成无需测试时微调
title_en: Subject-Diffusion: Open Domain Personalized Text-to-Image Generation without Test-time Fine-tuning.
abstract: 近期扩散模型在个性化图像生成领域取得了显著进展。然而,开放域和无需测试时微调的个性化图像生成研究进展相对缓慢。本文提出Subject-Diffusion,一种新型开放域个性化图像生成模型,除无需测试时微调外,仅需单张参考图像即可支持任意域中单主体或双主体的个性化生成。首先,我们构建了自动数据标注工具,并利用LAION-Aesthetics数据集构建了包含7600万张图像及其对应主体检测边界框、分割掩码和文本描述的大规模数据集。其次,我们设计了新的统一框架,通过结合粗粒度位置信息和细粒度参考图像控制,最大化主体保真度和泛化能力。此外,我们还采用注意力控制机制支持双主体生成。大量定性和定量实验结果表明,我们的方法在单主体、多主体及人类定制图像生成任务中均优于其他框架。
abstract_en: Recent progress in personalized image generation using diffusion models has been significant. However, development in the area of open-domain and test-time fine-tuning-free personalized image generation is proceeding rather slowly. In this paper, we propose Subject-Diffusion, a novel open-domain personalized image generation model that, in addition to not requiring test-time fine-tuning, also only requires a single reference image to support personalized generation of single- or two-subjects in any domain. Firstly, we construct an automatic data labeling tool and use the LAION-Aesthetics dataset to construct a large-scale dataset consisting of 76M images and their corresponding subject detection bounding boxes, segmentation masks, and text descriptions. Secondly, we design a new unified framework that combines text and image semantics by incorporating coarse location and fine-grained reference image control to maximize subject fidelity and generalization. Furthermore, we also adopt an attention control mechanism to support two-subject generation. Extensive qualitative and quantitative results demonstrate that our method have certain advantages over other frameworks in single, multiple, and human-customized image generation.
authors: Jian Ma 0010, Junhao Liang, Chen Chen 0015, Haonan Lu

title: SuperPADL:基于渐进式监督蒸馏的语言引导型物理控制扩展框架
title_en: SuperPADL: Scaling Language-Directed Physics-Based Control with Progressive Supervised Distillation.
abstract: 用于人体运动的物理模拟模型可以生成高质量的响应式角色动画,通常在实时环境中进行。自然语言作为控制这些模型的灵活接口,使专家和非专家用户能够快速创建和编辑其动画。许多近期基于物理的动画方法,包括使用文本接口的方法,均采用强化学习(RL)训练控制策略。然而,将这些方法扩展到数百种以上动作仍面临挑战。同时,运动学动画模型能够通过利用监督学习方法,从数千种多样的动作中成功学习。受这些成功启发,本文提出SuperPADL,这是一个可扩展的基于物理的文本到动作框架,结合强化学习和监督学习,在数千种多样的动作片段上训练控制器。SuperPADL通过渐进式蒸馏分阶段训练,首先使用强化学习训练大量专门的专家。随后,这些专家通过结合强化学习和监督学习的方法,被迭代蒸馏为更大、更稳健的策略。最终的SuperPADL控制器基于包含超过5000种技能的数据集进行训练,并可在消费级GPU上实时运行。此外,我们的策略能够自然地在技能之间切换,使用户能够交互式地创作多阶段动画。我们实验性地证明,SuperPADL在大规模数据集上显著优于基于强化学习的基线方法。
abstract_en: Physically-simulated models for human motion can generate high-quality responsive character animations, often in real-time. Natural language serves as a flexible interface for controlling these models, allowing expert and non-expert users to quickly create and edit their animations. Many recent physics-based animation methods, including those that use text interfaces, train control policies using reinforcement learning (RL). However, scaling these methods beyond several hundred motions has remained challenging. Meanwhile, kinematic animation models are able to successfully learn from thousands of diverse motions by leveraging supervised learning methods. Inspired by these successes, in this work we introduce SuperPADL, a scalable framework for physics-based text-to-motion that leverages both RL and supervised learning to train controllers on thousands of diverse motion clips. SuperPADL is trained in stages using progressive distillation, starting with a large number of specialized experts using RL. These experts are then iteratively distilled into larger, more robust policies using a combination of reinforcement learning and supervised learning. Our final SuperPADL controller is trained on a dataset containing over 5000 skills and runs in real time on a consumer GPU. Moreover, our policy can naturally transition between skills, allowing for users to interactively craft multi-stage animations. We experimentally demonstrate that SuperPADL significantly outperforms RL-based baselines at this large data scale.
authors: Jordan Juravsky, Yunrong Guo, Sanja Fidler, Xue Bin Peng

title: 驯化扩散概率模型用于角色控制
title_en: Taming Diffusion Probabilistic Models for Character Control.
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的角色控制框架,有效利用运动扩散概率模型生成高质量且多样的角色动画,并实时响应多种动态用户输入的控制信号。我们的方法核心是一种基于Transformer的条件自回归运动扩散模型(Conditional Autoregressive Motion Diffusion Model, CAMDM),该模型以角色的历史运动作为输入,能够根据高层级的粗粒度用户控制生成多种潜在的未来运动。为满足实时控制器对多样性、可控性和计算效率的需求,我们引入了若干关键算法设计。这些包括独立的条件标记化、对历史运动的无分类引导(classifier-free guidance)以及启发式未来轨迹扩展,旨在解决运动扩散概率模型在角色控制中的挑战。因此,我们的工作是首个基于用户交互控制实现高质量、多样化角色动画实时生成的模型,支持通过单一统一模型以多种风格动画化角色。我们在多种运动技能数据集上评估了该方法,验证了其相较于现有角色控制器的优势。代码和模型可在https://aiganimation.github.io/CAMDM/获取。
abstract_en: We present a novel character control framework that effectively utilizes motion diffusion probabilistic models to generate high-quality and diverse character animations, responding in real-time to a variety of dynamic user-supplied control signals. At the heart of our method lies a transformer-based Conditional Autoregressive Motion Diffusion Model (CAMDM), which takes as input the character’s historical motion and can generate a range of diverse potential future motions conditioned on high-level, coarse user control. To meet the demands for diversity, controllability, and computational efficiency required by a real-time controller, we incorporate several key algorithmic designs. These include separate condition tokenization, classifier-free guidance on past motion, and heuristic future trajectory extension, all designed to address the challenges associated with taming motion diffusion probabilistic models for character control. As a result, our work represents the first model that enables real-time generation of high-quality, diverse character animations based on user interactive control, supporting animating the character in multiple styles with a single unified model. We evaluate our method on a diverse set of locomotion skills, demonstrating the merits of our method over existing character controllers. The code and model are available at https://aiganimation.github.io/CAMDM/.
authors: Rui Chen, Mingyi Shi, Shaoli Huang, Ping Tan 0002, Taku Komura, Xuelin Chen

title: Tele-Aloha:一种基于稀疏RGB摄像头的低成本高真实感远程临场系统
title_en: Tele-Aloha: A Telepresence System with Low-budget and High-authenticity Using Sparse RGB Cameras.
abstract: 本文提出了一种低成本且高真实感的双向远程临场系统Tele-Aloha,面向点对点通信场景。与以往系统相比,Tele-Aloha仅使用四台稀疏RGB摄像头、一块消费级GPU和一块自立体屏幕,实现了高分辨率(2048x2048)、实时(30 fps)、低延迟(小于150ms)且稳健的远程通信。作为Tele-Aloha的核心,我们提出了一种针对上半身的高效新视角合成算法。首先,我们设计了一个级联视差估计器以获取稳健的几何线索。此外,通过高斯泼溅引入神经光栅化器,将潜在特征投影到目标视角并解码为降低分辨率的图像。进一步地,基于高质量的捕获数据,我们利用加权混合机制将解码图像精修至最终的2K分辨率。借助世界领先的自立体显示技术和低延迟虹膜追踪,用户即使不佩戴任何头戴式显示设备,也能体验到强烈的三维感。总体而言,我们的远程临场系统在现实实验中展现了共在感,启发了下一代通信技术的发展。
abstract_en: In this paper, we present a low-budget and high-authenticity bidirectional telepresence system, Tele-Aloha, targeting peer-to-peer communication scenarios. Compared to previous systems, Tele-Aloha utilizes only four sparse RGB cameras, one consumer-grade GPU, and one autostereoscopic screen to achieve high-resolution (2048x2048), real-time (30 fps), low-latency (less than 150ms) and robust distant communication. As the core of Tele-Aloha, we propose an efficient novel view synthesis algorithm for upper-body. Firstly, we design a cascaded disparity estimator for obtaining a robust geometry cue. Additionally a neural rasterizer via Gaussian Splatting is introduced to project latent features onto target view and to decode them into a reduced resolution. Further, given the high-quality captured data, we leverage weighted blending mechanism to refine the decoded image into the final resolution of 2K. Exploiting world-leading autostereoscopic display and low-latency iris tracking, users are able to experience a strong three-dimensional sense even without any wearable head-mounted display device. Altogether, our telepresence system demonstrates the sense of co-presence in real-life experiments, inspiring the next generation of communication.
authors: Hanzhang Tu, Ruizhi Shao, Xue Dong, Shunyuan Zheng, Hao Zhang, Lili Chen, Meili Wang, Wenyu Li, Siyan Ma, Shengping Zhang, Boyao Zhou, Yebin Liu

title: 时域声学点全息术
title_en: Temporal acoustic point holography.
abstract: 利用换能器相位阵列的全息声学悬浮技术已实现了创新的空中粒子显示。然而,当前用于计算声学全息图的时间不变方法往往导致高相位变化,从而引发换能器振幅波动,严重限制了动态显示的可能性。在本工作中,我们开发了一系列时域相位检索算法,以抑制相位变化并权衡计算时间与解的最优性。我们的硬件实现基于Gerchberg-Saxton (GS)算法,我们将其识别为通过最大化聚焦振幅从而提升声学陷阱质量的梯度下降方法。随后,我们将GS算法扩展以额外约束换能器(及点)的相位变化,使其与前一时间帧保持一致,并在无需预先知道粒子轨迹和相互作用的情况下实现多粒子动画。我们通过实验展示了一系列悬浮字符动画,描绘了人类运动,我们认为本工作为自然动态多粒子显示及其他模态(如触觉和音频)的无约束三维传输铺平了道路。
abstract_en: Holographic acoustic levitation using phased arrays of transducers has facilitated innovative mid-air particle displays. However, current time-invariant methods for computing acoustic holograms often induce high phase changes and thus transducer amplitude fluctuations, severely limiting possible dynamic displays. In this work, we develop a wide range of temporal phase retrieval algorithms that suppress phase change and trade off computational time and solution optimality. We base our hardware implementation on Gerchberg-Saxton (GS), which we identify as gradient descent for maximizing focal amplitudes and thus acoustic trap quality. Following this, we adapt GS to additionally constrain transducers’ (and points’) phase changes from the previous time frame, and enable multiparticle animations without prior knowledge of particles’ paths and interactions. We experimentally showcase a series of levitated character animations depicting human motion and believe our work paves the way for natural dynamic multi-particle displays and unencumbered 3D delivery of other modalities such as haptics and audio.
authors: Giorgos Christopoulos, Lei Gao 0007, Diego Martínez Plasencia, Marta Betcke, Ryuji Hirayama, Sriram Subramanian

title: TexSliders: 基于扩散的CLIP空间纹理编辑
title_en: TexSliders: Diffusion-Based Texture Editing in CLIP Space.
abstract: 生成模型使人们能够通过自然语言直观地进行图像创建和操作。特别是,扩散模型最近在自然图像编辑方面取得了显著成果。在本工作中,我们提出将扩散技术应用于编辑纹理,这是一种3D内容创作流程中的重要组成部分的特定类型图像。我们分析了现有的编辑方法,并表明它们不能直接应用于纹理,因为它们的共同基础方法——操作注意力图——不适用于纹理领域。为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一种新方法,即通过操作CLIP图像嵌入来引导扩散生成。我们使用简单的文本提示(例如,“老木头”到“新木头”)定义编辑方向,并通过一种基于采样的方法,利用纹理先验将这些方向映射到CLIP图像嵌入空间,从而在CLIP空间中获得保持身份的方向。为了进一步提高身份保持性,我们将这些方向投影到一个CLIP子空间,该子空间通过最小化由纠缠的纹理属性导致的身份变化。我们的编辑流程仅需使用自然语言提示即可创建任意滑块,无需真实标注数据。
abstract_en: Generative models have enabled intuitive image creation and manipulation using natural language. In particular, diffusion models have recently shown remarkable results for natural image editing. In this work, we propose to apply diffusion techniques to edit textures, a specific class of images that are an essential part of 3D content creation pipelines. We analyze existing editing methods and show that they are not directly applicable to textures, since their common underlying approach, manipulating attention maps, is unsuitable for the texture domain. To address this, we propose a novel approach that instead manipulates CLIP image embeddings to condition the diffusion generation. We define editing directions using simple text prompts (e.g., “aged wood” to “new wood”) and map these to CLIP image embedding space using a texture prior, with a sampling-based approach that gives us identity-preserving directions in CLIP space. To further improve identity preservation, we project these directions to a CLIP subspace that minimizes identity variations resulting from entangled texture attributes. Our editing pipeline facilitates the creation of arbitrary sliders using natural language prompts only, with no ground-truth annotated data necessary.
authors: Julia Guerrero-Viu, Milos Hasan, Arthur Roullier, Midhun Harikumar, Yiwei Hu, Paul Guerrero 0001, Diego Gutierrez, Belén Masiá, Valentin Deschaintre

title: 基于文本引导的群体动画合成
title_en: Text-Guided Synthesis of Crowd Animation.
abstract: 创建生动的群体动画是数字游戏中沉浸式虚拟环境的核心。本工作聚焦于解决群体行为生成问题的挑战。现有方法依赖从业者手动构建复杂行为系统,存在劳动密集型的缺陷。我们提出一种机器学习方法,基于文本描述输入,为给定环境合成多样化动态群体动画场景。我们首先训练两个条件扩散模型,生成文本引导的智能体分布场和速度场。在局部导航算法的辅助下,这些场被用于控制多个群体的智能体。我们进一步采用大型语言模型(LLM)将通用脚本规范化为结构化句子,以实现更稳定的训练和更好的可扩展性。为训练我们的扩散模型,我们设计了一种构造性方法生成随机环境和群体动画。我们证明所训练的扩散模型能够生成未见过的环境和新颖场景描述的群体动画。我们的方法为虚拟环境的群体行为自动生成开辟了新途径。本文代码和数据可在https://github.com/MLZG/Text-Crowd.git获取。
abstract_en: Creating vivid crowd animations is core to immersive virtual environments in digital games. This work focuses on tackling the challenges of the crowd behavior generation problem. Existing approaches are labor-intensive, relying on practitioners to manually craft the complex behavior systems. We propose a machine learning approach to synthesize diversified dynamic crowd animation scenarios for a given environment based on a text description input. We first train two conditional diffusion models that generate text-guided agent distribution fields and velocity fields. Assisted by local navigation algorithms, the fields are then used to control multiple groups of agents. We further employ Large-Language Model (LLM) to canonicalize the general script into a structured sentence for more stable training and better scalability. To train our diffusion models, we devise a constructive method to generate random environments and crowd animations. We show that our trained diffusion models can generate crowd animations for both unseen environments and novel scenario descriptions. Our method paves the way towards automatic generating of crowd behaviors for virtual environments. Code and data for this paper are available at: https://github.com/MLZG/Text-Crowd.git.
authors: Xuebo Ji, Zherong Pan, Xifeng Gao, Jia Pan 0001

title: 选定者:文本到图像扩散模型中的连贯角色
title_en: The Chosen One: Consistent Characters in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models.
abstract: 近期文本到图像生成模型的进展释放了视觉创作的巨大潜力。然而,使用这些模型的用户在生成连贯角色方面面临挑战,这对于故事可视化、游戏开发、资产设计、广告等众多实际应用场景至关重要。现有方法通常依赖于目标角色的多个预存图像或涉及繁琐的手动流程。在本工作中,我们提出了一种完全自动化的连贯角色生成方案,其唯一输入为文本提示。我们引入了一种迭代过程,在每一步骤中识别一组具有相似身份的连贯图像,并从该组中提取更一致的身份。定量分析表明,与基线方法相比,我们的方法在提示对齐与身份一致性之间取得了更好的平衡,这一结论得到了用户研究的验证。最后,我们展示了该方法的若干实际应用。
abstract_en: Recent advances in text-to-image generation models have unlocked vast potential for visual creativity. However, the users that use these models struggle with the generation of consistent characters, a crucial aspect for numerous real-world applications such as story visualization, game development, asset design, advertising, and more. Current methods typically rely on multiple pre-existing images of the target character or involve labor-intensive manual processes. In this work, we propose a fully automated solution for consistent character generation, with the sole input being a text prompt. We introduce an iterative procedure that, at each stage, identifies a coherent set of images sharing a similar identity and extracts a more consistent identity from this set. Our quantitative analysis demonstrates that our method strikes a better balance between prompt alignment and identity consistency compared to the baseline methods, and these findings are reinforced by a user study. To conclude, we showcase several practical applications of our approach.
authors: Omri Avrahami, Amir Hertz, Yael Vinker, Moab Arar, Shlomi Fruchter, Ohad Fried, Daniel Cohen-Or, Dani Lischinski

title: ThemeStation:从少量示例生成主题感知的3D资产
title_en: ThemeStation: Generating Theme-Aware 3D Assets from Few Exemplars.
abstract: 现实应用中常常需要大量共享一致主题的3D资产库。尽管在从文本或图像生成通用3D内容方面取得了显著进展,但根据输入3D示例的共享主题合成定制化3D资产仍是一个开放且具有挑战性的问题。在本文中,我们提出了ThemeStation,一种新颖的主题感知3D到3D生成方法。ThemeStation基于给定的少量示例合成定制化3D资产,目标包括:1)统一性,即生成与给定示例在主题上一致的3D资产;2)多样性,即生成高度变化的3D资产。为此,我们设计了一个两阶段框架,首先生成概念图像,随后进行参考引导的3D建模阶段。我们提出了一种新颖的双分数蒸馏(DSD)损失函数,联合利用输入示例和合成概念图像的先验信息。大量实验和用户研究证实,ThemeStation在生成多样化且高质量的主题感知3D模型方面超越了先前工作。ThemeStation还支持可控的3D到3D生成等多种应用。
abstract_en: Real-world applications often require a large gallery of 3D assets that share a consistent theme. While remarkable advances have been made in general 3D content creation from text or image, synthesizing customized 3D assets following the shared theme of input 3D exemplars remains an open and challenging problem. In this work, we present ThemeStation, a novel approach for theme-aware 3D-to-3D generation. ThemeStation synthesizes customized 3D assets based on given few exemplars with two goals: 1) unity for generating 3D assets that thematically align with the given exemplars and 2) diversity for generating 3D assets with a high degree of variations. To this end, we design a two-stage framework that draws a concept image first, followed by a reference-informed 3D modeling stage. We propose a novel dual score distillation (DSD) loss to jointly leverage priors from both the input exemplars and the synthesized concept image. Extensive experiments and a user study confirm that ThemeStation surpasses prior works in producing diverse theme-aware 3D models with impressive quality. ThemeStation also enables various applications such as controllable 3D-to-3D generation.
authors: Zhenwei Wang 0003, Tengfei Wang 0002, Gerhard P. Hancke 0002, Ziwei Liu 0002, Rynson W. H. Lau

title: Toonify3D:基于StyleGAN的三维风格化人脸生成器
title_en: Toonify3D: StyleGAN-based 3D Stylized Face Generator.
abstract: 近年来,生成模型的进展使得高质量的人脸图像风格化成为可能。Toonify是一个基于StyleGAN的流行框架,已被广泛用于人脸图像风格化。我们的目标是通过将Toonify转化为三维风格化人脸生成器,来创建富有表现力的三维人脸。Toonify通过从用于标准人脸的StyleGAN模型进行少量梯度下降步骤的微调,其特征将承载与原始StyleGAN模型特征对齐的语义和视觉信息。基于这一观察,我们设计了一种通用的三维提升方法StyleNormal,该方法利用StyleGAN特征回归StyleGAN生成人脸的表面法线图。由于Toonify与StyleGAN的特征对齐,尽管StyleNormal是为常规人脸训练的,但无需额外微调即可应用于各种风格化人脸。为了学习在各种光照条件下人脸的局部几何结构,我们引入了一种新的正则化项,即基于GAN潜在空间中光照操控的法线一致性损失。最后,我们提出了Toonify3D,一个基于StyleNormal的全自动框架,能够生成全头三维风格化虚拟形象,并支持基于GAN的三维面部表情编辑。
abstract_en: Recent advances in generative models enable high-quality facial image stylization. Toonify is a popular StyleGAN-based framework that has been widely used for facial image stylization. Our goal is to create expressive 3D faces by turning Toonify into a 3D stylized face generator. Toonify is fine-tuned with a few gradient descent steps from StyleGAN trained for standard faces, and its features would carry semantic and visual information aligned with the features of the original StyleGAN model. Based on this observation, we design a versatile 3D-lifting method for StyleGAN, StyleNormal, that regresses a surface normal map of a StyleGAN-generated face using StyleGAN features. Due to the feature alignment between Toonify and StyleGAN, although StyleNormal is trained for regular faces, it can be applied for various stylized faces without additional fine-tuning. To learn local geometry of faces under various illuminations, we introduce a novel regularization term, the normal consistency loss, based on lighting manipulation in the GAN latent space. Finally, we present Toonify3D, a fully automated framework based on StyleNormal, that can generate full-head 3D stylized avatars and support GAN-based 3D facial expression editing.
authors: Wonjong Jang, Yucheol Jung, Hyomin Kim, Gwangjin Ju, Chaewon Son, Jooeun Son, Seungyong Lee 0001

title: 无结构无标签光学动作捕捉:视频助力!
title_en: Towards Unstructured Unlabeled Optical Mocap: A Video Helps!
abstract: 光学动作捕捉(mocap)需要从反光标记点准确重建人体姿态和形状。在典型mocap设置中,标记点标注是重要但繁琐且容易出错的步骤。先前研究表明,可通过结构化模板定义特定标记点布局实现自动化标注,但该方法增加了额外的录制约束。我们提出放松这些约束,解决无结构无标签光学(UUO)动作捕捉问题。与典型mocap设置相比(要么标注标记点要么按结构化布局放置),UUO动作捕捉中的标记点可放置在身体任意位置,甚至特定肢体(如生物力学研究中的右腿),因此更具实际意义。同时更具挑战性。为解决UUO动作捕捉,我们利用单目RGB相机捕获的视频(无需相机标定)。在该视频上运行现成方法进行人体重建与跟踪,提供强人体姿态和形状的视觉先验。结合视频与UUO标记点,我们提出面向标记点识别、标记点标注、人体姿态估计和人体重建的优化流程。技术新颖性包括多假设测试优化全局方向,以及标记点定位与标记点-身体部分匹配以更好优化体表。我们开展大量实验定量比较方法与现有技术(包括仅标记点mocap和仅视频人体/形状重建),实验表明方法在三个基准数据集上显著优于现有方法,适用于全身和局部人体重建。
abstract_en: Optical motion capture (mocap) requires accurately reconstructing the human body from retroreflective markers, including pose and shape. In a typical mocap setting, marker labeling is an important but tedious and error-prone step. Previous work has shown that marker labeling can be automated by using a structured template defining specific marker placements, but this places additional recording constraints. We propose to relax these constraints and solve for Unstructured Unlabeled Optical (UUO) mocap. Compared to the typical mocap setting that either labels markers or places them w.r.t a structured layout, markers in UUO mocap can be placed anywhere on the body and even on one specific limb (e.g., right leg for biomechanics research), hence it is of more practical significance. It is also more challenging. To solve UUO mocap, we exploit a monocular video captured by a single RGB camera, which does not require camera calibration. On this video, we run an off-the-shelf method to reconstruct and track a human individual, giving strong visual priors of human body pose and shape. With both the video and UUO markers, we propose an optimization pipeline towards marker identification, marker labeling, human pose estimation, and human body reconstruction. Our technical novelties include multiple hypothesis testing to optimize global orientation, and marker localization and marker-part matching to better optimize for body surface. We conduct extensive experiments to quantitatively compare our method against state-of-the-art approaches, including marker-only mocap and video-only human body/shape reconstruction. Experiments demonstrate that our method resoundingly outperforms existing methods on three established benchmark datasets for both full-body and partial-body reconstruction.
authors: Nicholas Milef, John Keyser, Shu Kong

title: 超惯性姿态估计器:基于稀疏惯性传感器和超宽带测距的可扩展动作捕捉与跟踪
title_en: Ultra Inertial Poser: Scalable Motion Capture and Tracking from Sparse Inertial Sensors and Ultra-Wideband Ranging.
abstract: 尽管基于摄像头的捕捉系统仍是记录人体运动的黄金标准,但基于稀疏可穿戴传感器的学习型跟踪系统正逐渐流行。最常见的是使用惯性传感器,其漂移和抖动特性迄今为止限制了跟踪精度。在本文中,我们提出了一种名为Ultra Inertial Poser的新颖三维全身姿态估计方法,通过传感器间距离约束惯性跟踪的漂移和抖动。我们使用一种轻量级嵌入式跟踪器,在低成本的6D惯性测量单元上动态地增强基于超宽带无线电的测距功能,无需固定参考锚点即可实现。我们的方法随后将这些传感器间距离与每个传感器估计的三维状态进行融合。基于图的机器学习模型处理三维状态和距离,以估计人体的三维全身姿态和位移。为了训练我们的模型,我们从运动捕捉数据库AMASS中合成惯性测量和距离估计。在评估方面,我们贡献了一个包含10名参与者执行25种运动类型的新型运动数据集,由6个可穿戴IMU+UWB跟踪器和光学运动捕捉系统同步采集,总计200分钟的传感器数据(UIP-DB)。我们的广泛实验表明,与PIP和TIP相比,我们的方法在位置误差上从13.62厘米降低至10.65厘米(提升22%),抖动从1.56降至0.055 km/s3(降低97%)。UIP代码、UIP-DB数据集和硬件设计:https://github.com/eth-siplab/UltraInertialPoser
abstract_en: While camera-based capture systems remain the gold standard for recording human motion, learning-based tracking systems based on sparse wearable sensors are gaining popularity. Most commonly, they use inertial sensors, whose propensity for drift and jitter have so far limited tracking accuracy. In this paper, we propose Ultra Inertial Poser, a novel 3D full body pose estimation method that constrains drift and jitter in inertial tracking via inter-sensor distances. We estimate these distances across sparse sensor setups using a lightweight embedded tracker that augments inexpensive off-the-shelf 6D inertial measurement units with ultra-wideband radio-based ranging—dynamically and without the need for stationary reference anchors. Our method then fuses these inter-sensor distances with the 3D states estimated from each sensor. Our graph-based machine learning model processes the 3D states and distances to estimate a person’s 3D full body pose and translation. To train our model, we synthesize inertial measurements and distance estimates from the motion capture database AMASS. For evaluation, we contribute a novel motion dataset of 10 participants who performed 25 motion types, captured by 6 wearable IMU+UWB trackers and an optical motion capture system, totaling 200 minutes of synchronized sensor data (UIP-DB). Our extensive experiments show state-of-the-art performance for our method over PIP and TIP, reducing position error from 13.62 to 10.65 cm (22% better) and lowering jitter from 1.56 to 0.055 km/s3 (a reduction of 97%). UIP code, UIP-DB dataset, and hardware design: https://github.com/eth-siplab/UltraInertialPoser
authors: Rayan Armani, Changlin Qian, Jiaxi Jiang, Christian Holz 0001

title: VR-GS:一种面向物理动力学的虚拟现实交互高斯泼溅系统
title_en: VR-GS: A Physical Dynamics-Aware Interactive Gaussian Splatting System in Virtual Reality.
abstract: 随着三维内容日益普及,人们对于三维虚拟内容的互动方式正日益关注。然而,传统创建、编辑和交互三维内容的技术存在诸多困难。这些技术不仅工程复杂度高,还要求专业知识,导致虚拟物体操作中出现挫败感和低效性。我们提出的VR-GS系统在以人为中心的三维内容交互领域实现了突破,提供无缝且直观的用户体验。通过在虚拟现实环境中开发物理动力学感知的交互高斯泼溅(GS)技术,并构建高效的双级嵌入策略与可变形体模拟,VR-GS确保实时执行并产生高度逼真的动态响应。系统组件设计注重高效性与有效性,从详细场景重建与物体分割开始,经过多视角图像修复,延伸至基于物理的交互编辑。系统还集成了实时变形嵌入与动态阴影投射,确保全面且沉浸的虚拟体验。
abstract_en: As 3D content becomes increasingly prevalent, there’s a growing focus on the development of engagements with 3D virtual content. Unfortunately, traditional techniques for creating, editing, and interacting with this content are fraught with difficulties. They tend to be not only engineering-intensive but also require extensive expertise, which adds to the frustration and inefficiency in virtual object manipulation. Our proposed VR-GS system represents a leap forward in human-centered 3D content interaction, offering a seamless and intuitive user experience. By developing a physical dynamics-aware interactive Gaussian Splatting (GS) in a Virtual Reality (VR) setting, and constructing a highly efficient two-level embedding strategy alongside deformable body simulations, VR-GS ensures real-time execution with highly realistic dynamic responses. The components of our system are designed for high efficiency and effectiveness, starting from detailed scene reconstruction and object segmentation, advancing through multi-view image in-painting, and extending to interactive physics-based editing. The system also incorporates real-time deformation embedding and dynamic shadow casting, ensuring a comprehensive and engaging virtual experience.
authors: Ying Jiang, Chang Yu 0005, Tianyi Xie, Xuan Li 0015, Yutao Feng, Huamin Wang 0001, Minchen Li, Henry Y. K. Lau, Feng Gao 0013, Yin Yang 0002, Chenfanfu Jiang

title: VRMM:一种体积可重新照明的可变形头部模型
title_en: VRMM: A Volumetric Relightable Morphable Head Model.
abstract: 本文介绍了体积可重新照明可变形模型(VRMM),这是一种新颖的体积化和参数化的三维面部先验模型。尽管近期的体积先验模型在传统方法如三维可变形模型(3DMMs)的基础上有所改进,但在模型学习和个性化重建方面仍面临挑战。我们的VRMM通过采用一种新颖的训练框架,高效地将身份、表情和光照的潜在空间解耦并编码为低维表示,从而克服了这些挑战。该框架采用自监督学习设计,显著减少了训练数据的约束条件,使其在实践中更加可行。所学习的VRMM具备重新照明能力,并涵盖了广泛的表情范围。我们通过诸如虚拟形象生成、面部重建和动画制作等应用,展示了VRMM的多功能性和有效性。此外,我们针对生成体积模型中常见的过拟合问题,提出了一种基于VRMM的先验保持个性化框架。此类方法能够从甚至单张肖像输入中实现高质量的三维面部重建。我们的实验展示了VRMM在提升三维面部建模领域潜力的显著优势。
abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce the Volumetric Relightable Morphable Model (VRMM), a novel volumetric and parametric facial prior for 3D face modeling. While recent volumetric prior models offer improvements over traditional methods like 3D Morphable Models (3DMMs), they face challenges in model learning and personalized reconstructions. Our VRMM overcomes these by employing a novel training framework that efficiently disentangles and encodes latent spaces of identity, expression, and lighting into low-dimensional representations. This framework, designed with self-supervised learning, significantly reduces the constraints for training data, making it more feasible in practice. The learned VRMM offers relighting capabilities and encompasses a comprehensive range of expressions. We demonstrate the versatility and effectiveness of VRMM through various applications like avatar generation, facial reconstruction, and animation. Additionally, we address the common issue of overfitting in generative volumetric models with a novel prior-preserving personalization framework based on VRMM. Such an approach enables high-quality 3D face reconstruction from even a single portrait input. Our experiments showcase the potential of VRMM to significantly enhance the field of 3D face modeling.
authors: Haotian Yang, Mingwu Zheng, Chongyang Ma, Yu-Kun Lai, Pengfei Wan 0001, Haibin Huang

title: 基于速度的蒙特卡洛流体方法
title_en: Velocity-Based Monte Carlo Fluids.
abstract: 我们提出了一种基于速度的蒙特卡洛流体求解器,该方法克服了现有涡度基方法的局限性。由于基于速度的公式在图形学中更为常见,我们的蒙特卡洛求解器可以方便地结合流体模拟文献中的各种技术。我们通过算子分裂法求解纳维-斯托克斯方程,并为每个子步骤设计逐点蒙特卡洛估计器来推导该方法。我们基于最近引入的walk-on-boundary技术[__ABS_MATH_1__],将投影和扩散步骤重新表述为积分问题。我们将压力泊松方程源项的体积积分转换为更便于实际数值计算的形式。我们的基于速度的公式能够正确模拟先前涡度基蒙特卡洛方法[__ABS_MATH_2__]无法正确模拟或不支持的场景。我们证明了该方法可以轻松整合传统非蒙特卡洛方法的进展,例如如何直接添加浮力效应、发散控制能力以及数值耗散减少方法(如对流反射和PIC/FLIP方法)。
abstract_en: We present a velocity-based Monte Carlo fluid solver that overcomes the limitations of its existing vorticity-based counterpart. Because the velocity-based formulation is more commonly used in graphics, our Monte Carlo solver can be readily extended with various techniques from the fluid simulation literature. We derive our method by solving the Navier-Stokes equations via operator splitting and designing a pointwise Monte Carlo estimator for each substep. We reformulate the projection and diffusion steps as integration problems based on the recently introduced walk-on-boundary technique [Sugimoto et al. 2023]. We transform the volume integral arising from the source term of the pressure Poisson equation into a form more amenable to practical numerical evaluation. Our resulting velocity-based formulation allows for the proper simulation of scenes that the prior vorticity-based Monte Carlo method [Rioux-Lavoie et al. 2022] either simulates incorrectly or cannot support. We demonstrate that our method can easily incorporate advancements drawn from conventional non-Monte Carlo methods by showing how one can straightforwardly add buoyancy effects, divergence control capabilities, and numerical dissipation reduction methods, such as advection-reflection and PIC/FLIP methods.
authors: Ryusuke Sugimoto, Christopher Batty, Toshiya Hachisuka

title: 面向图像和视频着色的多功能视觉基础模型
title_en: Versatile Vision Foundation Model for Image and Video Colorization.
abstract: 图像和视频着色是图像修复中最常见的问题之一。这是一个不适定问题,已有大量方法被提出,从传统的计算机视觉策略到基于Transformer或生成神经网络模型的最新发展。在本工作中,我们展示了如何通过在文本到图像合成任务上预训练的潜在扩散模型进行微调,实现图像着色,并提供一种适用于多种场景的灵活解决方案:高质量直接着色、通过颜色提示、文本提示或参考图像进行用户引导着色,以及视频着色。尽管已有研究探索使用扩散模型进行着色,但提出的解决方案往往更为复杂,需要训练一个引导去噪过程的辅助模型(如ControlNet)。不仅这种方法增加了参数数量和计算时间,还导致着色效果次优,如我们所展示的。我们的评估表明,我们的模型是唯一一种在保持灵活性的同时,能够匹配或超越现有针对每个子任务专门优化的方法的方案,通过提出一组通用的、架构无关的机制,这些机制可应用于任何预训练的扩散模型。
abstract_en: Image and video colorization are among the most common problems in image restoration. This is an ill-posed problem and a wide variety of methods have been proposed, ranging from more traditional computer vision strategies to most recent development with transformer-based or generative neural network models. In this work we show how a latent diffusion model, pre-trained on text-to-image synthesis, can be finetuned for image colorization and provide a flexible solution for a wide variety of scenarios: high quality direct colorization with diverse results, user guided colorization through colors hints, text prompts or reference image and finally video colorization. Some works already investigated using diffusion models for colorization, however the proposed solutions are often more complex and require training a side model guiding the denoising process (à la ControlNet). Not only is this approach increasing the number of parameters and compute time, it also results in sub optimal colorization as we show. Our evaluation demonstrates that our model is the only approach that offers a wide flexibility while either matching or outperforming existing methods specialized in each sub-task, by proposing a group of universal, architecture-agnostic mechanisms which could be applied to any pre-trained diffusion model.
authors: Vukasin Bozic, Abdelaziz Djelouah, Yang Zhang 0003, Radu Timofte, Markus Gross 0001, Christopher Schroers

title: WalkTheDog:通过相位流形实现跨形态运动对齐
title_en: WalkTheDog: Cross-Morphology Motion Alignment via Phase Manifolds.
abstract: 我们提出了一种新的方法,用于理解运动数据集的周期性结构和语义,而无需依赖于角色的形态和骨骼结构。与现有方法使用过于稀疏的高维潜在空间不同,我们提出了一种由多个闭合曲线组成的相位流形,每条曲线对应一个潜在振幅。通过我们提出的向量量化周期自编码器,我们无需监督学习,为多个角色(如人类和狗)学习共享的相位流形。这是通过利用离散结构和浅层网络作为瓶颈实现的,使得语义相似的运动被聚类到流形的同一曲线中,且同一组件内的运动通过相位变量进行时间对齐。结合改进的运动匹配框架,我们在运动检索、迁移和风格化等多个应用中展示了该流形在时间对齐和语义对齐方面的能力。本文的代码和预训练模型可在peizhuoli.github.io/walkthedog获取。
abstract_en: We present a new approach for understanding the periodicity structure and semantics of motion datasets, independently of the morphology and skeletal structure of characters. Unlike existing methods using an overly sparse high-dimensional latent, we propose a phase manifold consisting of multiple closed curves, each corresponding to a latent amplitude. With our proposed vector quantized periodic autoencoder, we learn a shared phase manifold for multiple characters, such as a human and a dog, without any supervision. This is achieved by exploiting the discrete structure and a shallow network as bottlenecks, such that semantically similar motions are clustered into the same curve of the manifold, and the motions within the same component are aligned temporally by the phase variable. In combination with an improved motion matching framework, we demonstrate the manifold’s capability of timing and semantics alignment in several applications, including motion retrieval, transfer and stylization. Code and pre-trained models for this paper are available at peizhuoli.github.io/walkthedog.
authors: Peizhuo Li, Sebastian Starke, Yuting Ye, Olga Sorkine-Hornung

title: 基于反射-透射照片对的织物捕捉
title_en: Woven Fabric Capture with a Reflection-Transmission Photo Pair.
abstract: 对织物进行数字化处理对于数字人、室内设计等众多应用具有重要价值。先前工作通过捕捉单张反射图像并结合可微几何和光照模型估计织物参数,提出了一种轻量级的织物采集方法。估计参数的渲染结果可与照片高度匹配;然而,所捕捉的反射图像不足以完全表征织物样本的反射特性。例如,不同厚度的织物可能具有相似的反射图像,但会导致显著不同的透射效果。我们提出通过捕捉反射与透射图像对来恢复织物参数。该方法的核心是一个可微双向散射分布函数(BSDF)模型,能够处理反射与透射,包括单次散射和多次散射。我们提出双层模型,其中单次散射采用与先前工作相同的SGGX相函数,而多次散射采用新的方位角不变微片定义(ASGGX)。该新型织物BSDF模型在反射与透射方面均能紧密匹配真实织物。我们使用手机相机和两个点光源的简单设置捕捉反射与透射照片,并通过轻量级网络结合可微优化估计织物参数。同时,我们通过简单方案显式建模失焦效应,以更好地匹配薄透镜相机。结果表明,估计参数的渲染结果首次在反射与透射方面均能与输入图像一致。本文代码见https://github.com/lxtyin/FabricBTDF-Recovery。
abstract_en: Digitizing woven fabrics would be valuable for many applications, from digital humans to interior design. Previous work introduces a lightweight woven fabric acquisition approach by capturing a single reflection image and estimating the fabric parameters with a differentiable geometric and shading model. The renderings of the estimated fabric parameters can closely match the photo; however, the captured reflection image is insufficient to fully characterize the fabric sample reflectance. For instance, fabrics with different thicknesses might have similar reflection images but lead to significantly different transmission. We propose to recover the woven fabric parameters from two captured images: reflection and transmission. At the core of our method is a differentiable bidirectional scattering distribution function (BSDF) model, handling reflection and transmission, including single and multiple scattering. We propose a two-layer model, where the single scattering uses an SGGX phase function as in previous work, and multiple scattering uses a new azimuthally-invariant microflake definition, which we term ASGGX. This new fabric BSDF model closely matches real woven fabrics in both reflection and transmission. We use a simple setup for capturing reflection and transmission photos with a cell phone camera and two point lights, and estimate the fabric parameters via a lightweight network, together with a differentiable optimization. We also model the out-of-focus effects explicitly with a simple solution to match the thin-lens camera better. As a result, the renderings of the estimated parameters can agree with the input images on both reflection and transmission for the first time. The code for this paper is at https://github.com/lxtyin/FabricBTDF-Recovery.
authors: Yingjie Tang, Zixuan Li, Milos Hasan, Jian Yang 0003, Beibei Wang 0002

title: X-Portrait:基于层次化运动注意力的表达性肖像动画
title_en: X-Portrait: Expressive Portrait Animation with Hierarchical Motion Attention.
abstract: 我们提出X-Portrait,一种创新的条件扩散模型,专门用于生成具有时间连贯性的表达性肖像动画。具体而言,给定单张肖像作为外观参考,我们旨在通过驱动视频提取的运动来对其进行动画化,捕捉高度动态和微妙的面部表情以及大范围的头部运动。其核心在于利用预训练扩散模型的生成先验作为渲染骨干网络,同时在ControlNet框架内通过新颖的控制信号实现精细的头部姿态和表情控制。与传统的粗粒度显式控制(如面部关键点)不同,我们的运动控制模块学习直接从原始驱动RGB输入中解析动态信息。通过基于补丁的局部控制模块进一步提升运动精度,有效增强对眼球位置等微小细节的运动注意力。值得注意的是,为缓解驱动信号的身份泄露问题,我们采用缩放增强的跨身份图像对运动控制模块进行训练,确保与外观参考模块实现最大化的解耦。实验结果证明了X-Portrait在多种面部肖像和富有表现力的驱动序列上的广泛有效性,并展示了其生成具有持续身份特征的引人入胜的肖像动画的能力。
abstract_en: We propose X-Portrait, an innovative conditional diffusion model tailored for generating expressive and temporally coherent portrait animation. Specifically, given a single portrait as appearance reference, we aim to animate it with motion derived from a driving video, capturing both highly dynamic and subtle facial expressions along with wide-range head movements. As its core, we leverage the generative prior of a pre-trained diffusion model as the rendering backbone, while achieve fine-grained head pose and expression control with novel controlling signals within the framework of ControlNet. In contrast to conventional coarse explicit controls such as facial landmarks, our motion control module is learned to interpret the dynamics directly from the original driving RGB inputs. The motion accuracy is further enhanced with a patch-based local control module that effectively enhance the motion attention to small-scale nuances like eyeball positions. Notably, to mitigate the identity leakage from the driving signals, we train our motion control modules with scaling-augmented cross-identity images, ensuring maximized disentanglement from the appearance reference modules. Experimental results demonstrate the universal effectiveness of X-Portrait across a diverse range of facial portraits and expressive driving sequences, and showcase its proficiency in generating captivating portrait animations with consistently maintained identity characteristics.
authors: You Xie, Hongyi Xu, Guoxian Song, Chao Wang 0088, Yichun Shi, Linjie Luo

title: 乐高®草图艺术的计算设计
title_en: Computational Design of LEGO® Sketch Art.
abstract: 本文提出计算方法,以帮助从简单的输入图像创建乐高®草图模型。超越传统的乐高®马赛克,我们旨在通过利用具有斜边和圆角的乐高®积木,以及矩形积木,来再现输入中的平滑曲线和尖锐特征。这一任务具有挑战性,因为可用的积木形状有限,放置空间也有限。此外,搜索空间庞大且具有组合性质。我们将乐高®构建过程分解为两个步骤:首先用乐高®可构建的轮廓近似形状,然后用乐高®积木填充轮廓多边形。进一步,我们将这一轮廓近似转化为图优化问题,包含我们的目标和约束条件,并有效求解出最佳近似输入形状的轮廓多边形。进一步,我们将优化模型扩展以处理多色和多层区域,并制定网格对齐过程及各种感知约束以优化结果。我们采用该方法创建了大量乐高®模型,并与人类和基线方法进行比较,以展示其卓越的质量和速度。
abstract_en: This paper presents computational methods to aid the creation of LEGO®1 sketch models from simple input images. Beyond conventional LEGO® mosaics, we aim to improve the expressiveness of LEGO® models by utilizing LEGO® tiles with sloping and rounding edges, together with rectangular bricks, to reproduce smooth curves and sharp features in the input. This is a challenging task, as we have limited brick shapes to use and limited space to place bricks. Also, the search space is immense and combinatorial in nature. We approach the task by decoupling the LEGO® construction into two steps: first approximate the shape with a LEGO®-buildable contour then filling the contour polygon with LEGO® bricks. Further, we formulate this contour approximation into a graph optimization with our objective and constraints and effectively solve for the contour polygon that best approximates the input shape. Further, we extend our optimization model to handle multi-color and multi-layer regions, and formulate a grid alignment process and various perceptual constraints to refine the results. We employ our method to create a large variety of LEGO® models and compare it with humans and baseline methods to manifest its compelling quality and speed.

title: 通过运动矢量化与变换编辑运动图形视频
title_en: Editing Motion Graphics Video via Motion Vectorization and Transformation.
abstract: 运动图形视频广泛应用于网页设计、数字广告、动画标志和电影标题序列中,以吸引观众的注意力。但编辑此类视频具有挑战性,因为视频提供的是低层次的像素和帧序列,而非视频中物体及其对应运动和遮挡的高层次结构。我们提出了一种运动矢量化管道,将运动图形视频转换为提供此类结构的SVG运动程序。生成的SVG程序可以使用任何SVG渲染器(例如大多数网络浏览器)进行渲染,并使用任何SVG编辑器进行编辑。我们还引入了一个程序变换API,便于对SVG运动程序进行编辑,以创建调整物体时间、运动和/或外观变化的变体。我们展示了该API如何用于创建多种效果,包括调整物体运动以匹配音乐节拍、向物体添加运动纹理以及保持碰撞时外观变化。
abstract_en: Motion graphics videos are widely used in Web design, digital advertising, animated logos and film title sequences, to capture a viewer's attention. But editing such video is challenging because the video provides a low-level sequence of pixels and frames rather than higher-level structure such as the objects in the video with their corresponding motions and occlusions. We present a motion vectorization pipeline for converting motion graphics video into an SVG motion program that provides such structure. The resulting SVG program can be rendered using any SVG renderer (e.g. most Web browsers) and edited using any SVG editor. We also introduce a program transformation API that facilitates editing of a SVG motion program to create variations that adjust the timing, motions and/or appearances of objects. We show how the API can be used to create a variety of effects including retiming object motion to match a music beat, adding motion textures to objects, and collision preserving appearance changes.

title: GroomGen:基于层次化潜在表示的高质量生成发丝模型
title_en: GroomGen: A High-Quality Generative Hair Model Using Hierarchical Latent Representations.
abstract: 尽管近期在拟合高维发丝模型到特定输入主体的发丝采集技术上取得成功,但建立通用嵌入空间以编码、编辑和采样多样化发丝造型的生成发丝模型仍鲜有探索。本文提出GroomGen,这是首个针对由高度细节化密集发丝组成的发丝几何结构设计的生成模型。我们的方法基于两个关键思想。首先,我们构建覆盖单根发丝和发丝造型的潜在空间。这些潜在空间具有紧凑性、表达力和良好的约束性,能够实现高质量且多样化的采样。其次,我们采用层次化发丝表示方法,将完整发丝模型参数化为三个层级:单根发丝、稀疏引导发丝和完整密集发丝。这种表示方法对于潜在空间的紧凑性、训练的鲁棒性以及推理的效率至关重要。基于这种层次化潜在表示,我们提出的流程包括一个发丝-VAE和一个发丝造型-VAE,分别将单根发丝和一组引导发丝编码到各自的潜在空间,以及一个混合密集化步骤,将稀疏引导发丝填充到完整发丝模型中。GroomGen不仅支持新颖的发丝造型采样和合理的发丝造型插值,还支持复杂发丝造型的交互式编辑,或可作为强大的数据驱动先验用于从图像中重建发丝造型。我们通过多样化的采样发丝造型定性示例和针对每个组件及整个流程的生成质量定量评估,验证了方法的优越性。
abstract_en: Despite recent successes in hair acquisition that fits a high-dimensional hair model to a specific input subject, generative hair models, which establish general embedding spaces for encoding, editing, and sampling diverse hairstyles, are way less explored. In this paper, we present GroomGen, the first generative model designed for hair geometry composed of highly-detailed dense strands. Our approach is motivated by two key ideas. First, we construct hair latent spaces covering both individual strands and hairstyles. The latent spaces are compact, expressive, and well-constrained for high-quality and diverse sampling. Second, we adopt a hierarchical hair representation that parameterizes a complete hair model to three levels: single strands, sparse guide hairs, and complete dense hairs. This representation is critical to the compactness of latent spaces, the robustness of training, and the efficiency of inference. Based on this hierarchical latent representation, our proposed pipeline consists of a strand-VAE and a hairstyle-VAE that encode an individual strand and a set of guide hairs to their respective latent spaces, and a hybrid densification step that populates sparse guide hairs to a dense hair model. GroomGen not only enables novel hairstyle sampling and plausible hairstyle interpolation, but also supports interactive editing of complex hairstyles, or can serve as strong data-driven prior for hairstyle reconstruction from images. We demonstrate the superiority of our approach with qualitative examples of diverse sampled hairstyles and quantitative evaluation of generation quality regarding every single component and the entire pipeline.
