abstract: 近年来,学习可复用的运动先验的研究取得了进展,证明了其在生成自然行为方面的有效性。本文提出了一种新的学习框架,该框架在这一范式下,用于控制基于物理的字符,其运动质量和多样性优于现有方法。所提出的方法使用强化学习(RL)通过离散信息瓶颈,从无结构运动片段中跟踪和模仿类人运动,如Vector Quantized Variational AutoEncoder(VQ-VAE)所采用的。该结构将运动片段中最相关的信息压缩到一个紧凑且信息丰富的潜在空间中,即一个基于向量量化码的离散空间。通过从训练好的类别先验分布中采样空间中的码,可以生成高质量的类人行为,类似于VQ-VAE在计算机视觉中的应用。尽管该先验分布可以通过编码器输出的监督进行训练,但它遵循数据集中原始运动片段的分布,可能导致我们在设置中的行为失衡。为了解决这一问题,我们进一步提出了一种名为先验偏移的技术,利用好奇心驱动的强化学习调整先验分布。结果分布被证明能够提供充足的行为多样性,并显著促进下游任务的高层策略学习。我们在两个具有挑战性的下游任务——盾剑击打和双人拳击游戏中,使用人形角色进行了全面实验。结果表明,所提出的框架能够控制角色在行为策略、多样性和真实感方面表现出显著高质量的运动。视频、代码和数据可在https://tencent-roboticsx.github.io/NCP/获取。
abstract_en: Recent advances in learning reusable motion priors have demonstrated their effectiveness in generating naturalistic behaviors. In this paper, we propose a new learning framework in this paradigm for controlling physics-based characters with improved motion quality and diversity over existing methods. The proposed method uses reinforcement learning (RL) to initially track and imitate life-like movements from unstructured motion clips using the discrete information bottleneck, as adopted in the Vector Quantized Variational AutoEncoder (VQ-VAE). This structure compresses the most relevant information from the motion clips into a compact yet informative latent space, i.e., a discrete space over vector quantized codes. By sampling codes in the space from a trained categorical prior distribution, high-quality life-like behaviors can be generated, similar to the usage of VQ-VAE in computer vision. Although this prior distribution can be trained with the supervision of the encoder's output, it follows the original motion clip distribution in the dataset and could lead to imbalanced behaviors in our setting. To address the issue, we further propose a technique named prior shifting to adjust the prior distribution using curiosity-driven RL. The outcome distribution is demonstrated to offer sufficient behavioral diversity and significantly facilitates upper-level policy learning for downstream tasks. We conduct comprehensive experiments using humanoid characters on two challenging downstream tasks, sword-shield striking and two-player boxing game. Our results demonstrate that the proposed framework is capable of controlling the character to perform considerably high-quality movements in terms of behavioral strategies, diversity, and realism. Videos, codes, and data are available at https://tencent-roboticsx.github.io/NCP/.

title: 几何可微渲染的投影采样方法
title_en: Projective Sampling for Differentiable Rendering of Geometry.
abstract: 物体边界处的不连续可见性变化仍然是可微渲染领域持续存在的难题。若未加以处理,这些变化会严重偏倚计算梯度,甚至导致基本的优化任务失败。先前的路径空间方法通过将边界与内部解耦,采用专门的蒙特卡洛采样策略分别处理各部分来解决这一偏倚问题。尽管这一思路在概念上具有强大优势,但其全部潜力尚未被充分实现,因为现有方法往往未能按其贡献比例充分采样边界。本文提出理论与算法上的贡献。在理论方面,我们将边界导数转换为一个 remarkably simple 的局部积分,为后续发展提供了新的方向。基于这一结果,我们提出了一种新策略,将正向渲染过程中生成的普通样本投影到邻近边界上。所得投影建立了方差减少的引导分布,加速了后续微分相位的收敛。我们在多种形状表示(包括三角网格、隐式定义曲面以及基于贝塞尔曲线的圆柱纤维)中验证了方法的卓越效率和通用性。
abstract_en: Discontinuous visibility changes at object boundaries remain a persistent source of difficulty in the area of differentiable rendering. Left untreated, they bias computed gradients so severely that even basic optimization tasks fail. Prior path-space methods addressed this bias by decoupling boundaries from the interior, allowing each part to be handled using specialized Monte Carlo sampling strategies. While conceptually powerful, the full potential of this idea remains unrealized since existing methods often fail to adequately sample the boundary proportional to its contribution. This paper presents theoretical and algorithmic contributions. On the theoretical side, we transform the boundary derivative into a remarkably simple local integral that invites present and future developments. Building on this result, we propose a new strategy that projects ordinary samples produced during forward rendering onto nearby boundaries. The resulting projections establish a variance-reducing guiding distribution that accelerates convergence of the subsequent differential phase. We demonstrate the superior efficiency and versatility of our method across a variety of shape representations, including triangle meshes, implicitly defined surfaces, and cylindrical fibers based on Bézier curves.
authors: Ziyi Zhang, Nicolas Roussel, Wenzel Jakob

title: VASCO:面向混合制造的体积与表面协同分解
title_en: VASCO: Volume and Surface Co-Decomposition for Hybrid Manufacturing.
abstract: 增材与减材混合制造(ASHM)涉及增材和减材制造技术的交替使用,这为制造具有否则无法访问表面的复杂几何形状提供了独特优势。然而,一个重大挑战在于确保在制造过程中工具的可访问性,因为物体形状可能发生显著变化,且形状的不同部分相互依赖。在本研究中,我们提出了一种计算框架,以优化增材和减材工序的规划,同时确保工具可访问性。我们的目标是通过减少增材与减材工艺之间的切换次数,实现高效制造并保持产品质量。我们通过将问题建模为体积与表面协同分解(VASCO)问题来解决该问题。首先,我们将体积切片为层,并构建动态有向图以编码制造约束,每个节点代表一层,方向反映操作顺序。我们引入了一种新的几何属性——混合可制造性,用于评估增材和减材工艺对。随后,我们提出了一种基于光束引导的自上而下块分解算法来解决VASCO问题。我们将解决方案应用于五轴混合制造平台,并评估了多种3D形状。最后,我们通过物理和模拟制造评估来验证所提方法的性能。
abstract_en: Additive and subtractive hybrid manufacturing (ASHM) involves the alternating use of additive and subtractive manufacturing techniques, which provides unique advantages for fabricating complex geometries with otherwise inaccessible surfaces. However, a significant challenge lies in ensuring tool accessibility during both fabrication procedures, as the object shape may change dramatically, and different parts of the shape are interdependent. In this study, we propose a computational framework to optimize the planning of additive and subtractive sequences while ensuring tool accessibility. Our goal is to minimize the switching between additive and subtractive processes to achieve efficient fabrication while maintaining product quality. We approach the problem by formulating it as a Volume-And-Surface-CO-decomposition (VASCO) problem. First, we slice volumes into slabs and build a dynamic-directed graph to encode manufacturing constraints, with each node representing a slab and direction reflecting operation order. We introduce a novel geometry property called hybrid-fabricability for a pair of additive and subtractive procedures. Then, we propose a beam-guided top-down block decomposition algorithm to solve the VASCO problem. We apply our solution to a 5-axis hybrid manufacturing platform and evaluate various 3D shapes. Finally, we assess the performance of our approach through both physical and simulated manufacturing evaluations.

title: AniPortraitGAN:基于2D图像集合的可动画化3D肖像生成
title_en: AniPortraitGAN: Animatable 3D Portrait Generation from 2D Image Collections.
abstract: 先前用于人体生成的可动画化3D感知生成对抗网络(GAN)主要聚焦于人体头部或全身。然而,仅头部的视频在现实生活中相对少见,全身生成通常不处理面部表情控制,且在生成高质量结果方面仍面临挑战。为实现应用型视频头像,我们提出一种可动画化3D感知GAN,能够生成具有可控面部表情、头部姿态和肩部运动的肖像图像。该生成模型基于非结构化的2D图像集合进行训练,无需使用3D或视频数据。针对新任务,我们基于生成辐射流形表示,并为其配备可学习的面部和头肩变形模块。提出双摄像头渲染与对抗学习方案以提升生成面部质量,这对肖像图像至关重要。开发了姿态变形处理网络,用于生成长发等挑战区域的合理变形。实验表明,基于非结构化2D图像训练的本方法可生成多样且高质量的3D肖像,并实现对不同属性的精确控制。
abstract_en: Previous animatable 3D-aware GANs for human generation have primarily focused on either the human head or full body. However, head-only videos are relatively uncommon in real life, and full body generation typically does not deal with facial expression control and still has challenges in generating high-quality results. Towards applicable video avatars, we present an animatable 3D-aware GAN that generates portrait images with controllable facial expression, head pose, and shoulder movements. It is a generative model trained on unstructured 2D image collections without using 3D or video data. For the new task, we base our method on the generative radiance manifold representation and equip it with learnable facial and head-shoulder deformations. A dual-camera rendering and adversarial learning scheme is proposed to improve the quality of the generated faces, which is critical for portrait images. A pose deformation processing network is developed to generate plausible deformations for challenging regions such as long hair. Experiments show that our method, trained on unstructured 2D images, can generate diverse and high-quality 3D portraits with desired control over different properties.

title: 万物皆可字形:基于文本到图像扩散模型的艺术字体合成
title_en: Anything to Glyph: Artistic Font Synthesis via Text-to-Image Diffusion Model.
abstract: 艺术字体的自动生成是一项具有挑战性的任务,吸引了众多研究兴趣。先前的方法主要专注于字形或纹理风格迁移。然而,我们经常在海报或标志中遇到由物体组成的创意字体。这些字体对现有方法构成了挑战,因为它们难以生成类似设计。本文提出了一种新颖的方法,利用预训练的文本到图像扩散模型生成创意艺术字体。我们的模型以形状图像和描述物体的提示作为输入,生成由此类物体组成的艺术字形图像。具体而言,我们引入了一种基于热图的弱位置约束方法,以指导生成图像中物体的定位,并提出了潜在空间语义增强模块,在约束物体位置的同时提升其他信息。我们的方法独特之处在于能够在约束物体位置的同时保留其原始形状。此外,我们的训练方法仅需少量生成数据,使其成为一种高效的无监督学习方法。实验结果表明,我们的方法可以使用不同物体生成包括汉字、英文、日文和符号在内的多种字形。我们还与各种扩散模型的位置控制方法进行了定性和定量比较。结果表明,我们的方法在视觉质量、创新性和用户评价方面均优于其他方法。
abstract_en: The automatic generation of artistic fonts is a challenging task that attracts many research interests. Previous methods specifically focus on glyph or texture style transfer. However, we often come across creative fonts composed of objects in posters or logos. These fonts have proven to be a challenge for existing methods as they struggle to generate similar designs. This paper proposes a novel method for generating creative artistic fonts using a pre-trained text-to-image diffusion model. Our model takes a shape image and a prompt describing an object as input and generates an artistic glyph image consisting of such objects. Specifically, we introduce a novel heatmap-based weak position constraint method to guide the positioning of objects in the generated image, and we also propose the Latent Space Semantic Augmentation Module that improves other information while constraining object position. Our approach is unique in that it can preserve the object’s original shape while constraining its position. And our training method requires only a small quantity of generated data, making it an efficient unsupervised learning approach. Experimental results demonstrate that our method can generate various glyphs, including Chinese, English, Japanese, and symbols, using different objects. We also conducted qualitative and quantitative comparisons with various position control methods for the diffusion model. The results indicate that our approach outperforms other methods in terms of visual quality, innovation, and user evaluation.
authors: Changshuo Wang 0003, Lei Wu 0002, Xiaole Liu, Xiang Li 0177, Lei Meng 0001, Xiangxu Meng

title: Break-A-Scene:从单张图像中提取多个概念
title_en: Break-A-Scene: Extracting Multiple Concepts from a Single Image.
abstract: 文本到图像模型个性化旨在将用户提供的概念引入模型,使其能够在多样化的场景中进行合成。然而,现有方法主要关注从多张包含背景和姿态变化的图像中学习单一概念的场景,当应用于不同场景时表现不佳。在本工作中,我们引入了文本场景分解任务:给定一张可能包含多个概念的场景图像,我们旨在为每个概念提取一个独立的文本标记,从而实现对生成场景的精细控制。为此,我们提出通过添加指示目标概念存在的掩码来增强输入图像。这些掩码可以由用户提供,也可以由预训练的分割模型自动生成。随后,我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段定制流程,优化一组专用的文本嵌入(句柄)以及模型权重,在准确捕捉概念与避免过拟合之间取得微妙平衡。我们采用掩码扩散损失使句柄能够生成其分配的概念,并辅以针对交叉注意力图的新型损失函数以防止概念纠缠。我们还引入了联合采样(union-sampling),这是一种旨在提升生成图像中多概念组合能力的训练策略。我们使用多种自动指标对方法进行定量比较,并通过用户研究进一步验证结果。最后,我们展示了该方法的多种应用场景。
abstract_en: Text-to-image model personalization aims to introduce a user-provided concept to the model, allowing its synthesis in diverse contexts. However, current methods primarily focus on the case of learning a single concept from multiple images with variations in backgrounds and poses, and struggle when adapted to a different scenario. In this work, we introduce the task of textual scene decomposition: given a single image of a scene that may contain several concepts, we aim to extract a distinct text token for each concept, enabling fine-grained control over the generated scenes. To this end, we propose augmenting the input image with masks that indicate the presence of target concepts. These masks can be provided by the user or generated automatically by a pre-trained segmentation model. We then present a novel two-phase customization process that optimizes a set of dedicated textual embeddings (handles), as well as the model weights, striking a delicate balance between accurately capturing the concepts and avoiding overfitting. We employ a masked diffusion loss to enable handles to generate their assigned concepts, complemented by a novel loss on cross-attention maps to prevent entanglement. We also introduce union-sampling, a training strategy aimed to improve the ability of combining multiple concepts in generated images. We use several automatic metrics to quantitatively compare our method against several baselines, and further affirm the results using a user study. Finally, we showcase several applications of our method.
authors: Omri Avrahami, Kfir Aberman, Ohad Fried, Daniel Cohen-Or, Dani Lischinski

abstract: 我们提出了一种隐式生成蓝噪声点集的方法。我们的方法基于以下观察:旋度噪声向量场具有体积保持特性,并且抖动可以被理解为沿向量场流线移动点。我们证明了体积保持特性在使用旋度噪声向量场进行抖动时能够保持点集的良好分离性。同时,这种抖动显著降低了来自规则网格的各向异性。综合来看,这些特性意味着通过旋度噪声抖动能够有效地将规则网格转换为具有蓝噪声特性的点集。我们的隐式方法无需预先计算点集,这使得该技术在需要任意大量蓝噪声点集时具有重要价值。我们与其他基于抖动的方法以及蓝噪声点集生成的其他方法进行了比较。最后,我们展示了旋度噪声抖动在二维和三维中的多个应用。
abstract_en: We propose a method for implicitly generating blue noise point sets. Our method is based on the observations that curl noise vector fields are volume-preserving and that jittering can be construed as moving points along the streamlines of a vector field. We demonstrate that the volume preservation keeps the points well separated when jittered using a curl noise vector field. At the same time, the anisotropy that stems from regular lattices is significantly reduced by such jittering. In combination, these properties entail that jittering by curl noise effectively transforms a regular lattice into a point set with blue noise properties. Our implicit method does not require computing the point set in advance. This makes our technique valuable when an arbitrarily large set of points with blue noise properties is needed. We compare our method to several other methods based on jittering as well as other methods for blue noise point set generation. Finally, we show several applications of curl noise jittering in two and three dimensions.
authors: Jakob Andreas Bærentzen, Jeppe Revall Frisvad, Jonàs Martínez

title: C·ASE:基于物理角色的条件对抗技能嵌入学习
title_en: C·ASE: Learning Conditional Adversarial Skill Embeddings for Physics-based Characters.
abstract: 我们提出C·ASE,一个高效且有效的框架,用于学习基于物理角色的条件对抗技能嵌入。C·ASE使物理模拟角色能够学习多样化的技能集,同时通过直接操控待执行的技能来提供可控性。这是通过将异构技能动作划分为包含同质样本的子集,以训练低级条件模型来学习条件行为分布。技能条件化的模仿学习在训练后自然提供了对角色技能的显式控制。训练过程结合了焦点技能采样、骨骼残差力和逐元素特征掩码,以平衡不同复杂度的多样化技能,缓解动力学不匹配以掌握敏捷动作,并捕捉更普遍的行为特征。训练完成后,条件模型能够生成高度多样化且逼真的技能,优于现有最先进的模型,并可重新用于各种下游任务。特别是,显式的技能控制接口允许高层策略或用户根据所需技能规范引导角色,我们证明这对于交互式角色动画是有利的。
abstract_en: We present C · ASE, an efficient and effective framework that learns Conditional Adversarial Skill Embeddings for physics-based characters. C · ASE enables the physically simulated character to learn a diverse repertoire of skills while providing controllability in the form of direct manipulation of the skills to be performed. This is achieved by dividing the heterogeneous skill motions into distinct subsets containing homogeneous samples for training a low-level conditional model to learn the conditional behavior distribution. The skill-conditioned imitation learning naturally offers explicit control over the character’s skills after training. The training course incorporates the focal skill sampling, skeletal residual forces, and element-wise feature masking to balance diverse skills of varying complexities, mitigate dynamics mismatch to master agile motions and capture more general behavior characteristics, respectively. Once trained, the conditional model can produce highly diverse and realistic skills, outperforming state-of-the-art models, and can be repurposed in various downstream tasks. In particular, the explicit skill control handle allows a high-level policy or a user to direct the character with desired skill specifications, which we demonstrate is advantageous for interactive character animation.
authors: Zhiyang Dou, Xuelin Chen, Qingnan Fan, Taku Komura, Wenping Wang 0001

title: DROP: 从人体运动先验与投影动力学中获取动态响应
title_en: DROP: Dynamics Responses from Human Motion Prior and Projective Dynamics.
abstract: 合成具有环境动态响应能力的逼真人体运动,是角色动画领域长期追求的目标,其应用涵盖计算机视觉、体育和医疗领域,用于运动预测和数据增强。近期基于运动学的生成运动模型在建模大量运动数据方面展现出显著的可扩展性,但缺乏与物理推理和交互的接口。虽然嵌入模拟器的学习方法能够实现高度物理真实的运动行为,但训练过程中面临的挑战往往影响其可扩展性和应用推广。我们提出DROP,一种新颖的框架,利用生成运动先验和投影动力学建模人体动态响应。DROP可视为一种高度稳定、极简的基于物理的人体模拟器,与基于运动学的生成运动先验接口。通过利用投影动力学,DROP允许将学习到的运动先验灵活且简单地整合为一种投影能量,无缝融合运动先验提供的控制与牛顿动力学。作为模型无关的插件,DROP使我们能够充分利用近期生成运动模型的进展,实现基于物理的运动合成。我们在不同运动任务和多种物理扰动场景下对模型进行了广泛评估,验证了其响应的可扩展性和多样性。
abstract_en: Synthesizing realistic human movements, dynamically responsive to the environment, is a long-standing objective in character animation, with applications in computer vision, sports, and healthcare, for motion prediction and data augmentation. Recent kinematics-based generative motion models offer impressive scalability in modeling extensive motion data, albeit without an interface to reason about and interact with physics. While simulator-in-the-loop learning approaches enable highly physically realistic behaviors, the challenges in training often affect scalability and adoption. We introduce DROP, a novel framework for modeling Dynamics Responses of humans using generative mOtion prior and Projective dynamics. DROP can be viewed as a highly stable, minimalist physics-based human simulator that interfaces with a kinematics-based generative motion prior. Utilizing projective dynamics, DROP allows flexible and simple integration of the learned motion prior as one of the projective energies, seamlessly incorporating control provided by the motion prior with Newtonian dynamics. Serving as a model-agnostic plug-in, DROP enables us to fully leverage recent advances in generative motion models for physics-based motion synthesis. We conduct extensive evaluations of our model across different motion tasks and various physical perturbations, demonstrating the scalability and diversity of responses.
authors: Yifeng Jiang 0002, Jungdam Won, Yuting Ye, C. Karen Liu

title: 虚拟角色动画中的疲劳运动发现
title_en: Discovering Fatigued Movements for Virtual Character Animation.
abstract: 近年来,虚拟角色动画和运动合成技术取得了快速发展,尤其是在结合了大量动作捕捉数据集和机器学习方法后。一个尚未解决的挑战是交互式模拟在长时间运动中会疲劳的角色,这对生成动画的真实感至关重要。然而,捕捉此类运动存在困难,因为像后空翻等带有疲劳变化的动作在极限状态下会增加捕捉成本和受伤风险。令人惊讶的是,关于忠实疲劳建模的研究仍十分有限。为解决这一问题,我们提出了一种基于深度强化学习的方法,这是文献中首次生成全身体物理模拟代理的控制策略,这些代理能够感知累积疲劳。为此,我们首先利用生成对抗模仿学习(GAIL)学习技能的专家策略;其次,通过限制生成的恒定扭矩界限,基于耐力时间在关节驱动空间中非线性、状态和时间依赖的限制,使用三室控制器(3CC)模型学习疲劳策略。实验结果表明,代理能够适应不同的疲劳和恢复率,并在无需任何疲劳运动捕捉数据的情况下发现现实的恢复策略。
abstract_en: Virtual character animation and movement synthesis have advanced rapidly during recent years, especially through a combination of extensive motion capture datasets and machine learning. A remaining challenge is interactively simulating characters that fatigue when performing extended motions, which is indispensable for the realism of generated animations. However, capturing such movements is problematic, as performing movements like backflips with fatigued variations up to exhaustion raises capture cost and risk of injury. Surprisingly, little research has been done on faithful fatigue modeling. To address this, we propose a deep reinforcement learning-based approach, which—for the first time in literature—generates control policies for full-body physically simulated agents aware of cumulative fatigue. For this, we first leverage Generative Adversarial Imitation Learning (GAIL) to learn an expert policy for the skill; Second, we learn a fatigue policy by limiting the generated constant torque bounds based on endurance time to non-linear, state- and time-dependent limits in the joint-actuation space using a Three-Compartment Controller (3CC) model. Our results demonstrate that agents can adapt to different fatigue and rest rates interactively, and discover realistic recovery strategies without the need for any captured data of fatigued movement.
authors: Noshaba Cheema, Rui Xu, Nam Hee Kim, Perttu Hämäläinen, Vladislav Golyanik, Marc Habermann, Christian Theobalt, Philipp Slusallek

title: 领域无关的调优编码器:用于文本到图像模型的快速个性化
title_en: Domain-Agnostic Tuning-Encoder for Fast Personalization of Text-To-Image Models.
abstract: 文本到图像(T2I)个性化允许用户通过在自然语言提示中结合自身的视觉概念来引导创意图像生成过程。近年来,基于编码器的技术已成为T2I个性化的一种新有效方法,减少了对多张图像和长时间训练的需求。然而,大多数现有编码器仅限于单一类别领域,这限制了它们处理多样化概念的能力。在本工作中,我们提出了一种领域无关的方法,无需任何专用数据集或个性化概念的先验信息。我们引入了一种新颖的基于对比的正则化技术,通过将预测的标记推向其最近的现有CLIP标记,以保持对目标概念特征的高保真度,同时使预测的嵌入保持在潜在空间的可编辑区域附近。我们的实验结果证明了我们方法的有效性,并展示了学习到的标记比未正则化模型预测的标记更具语义性。这导致了更优的表示,实现了最先进的性能,同时比以往方法更具灵活性。
abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) personalization allows users to guide the creative image generation process by combining their own visual concepts in natural language prompts. Recently, encoder-based techniques have emerged as a new effective approach for T2I personalization, reducing the need for multiple images and long training times. However, most existing encoders are limited to a single-class domain, which hinders their ability to handle diverse concepts. In this work, we propose a domain-agnostic method that does not require any specialized dataset or prior information about the personalized concepts. We introduce a novel contrastive-based regularization technique to maintain high fidelity to the target concept characteristics while keeping the predicted embeddings close to editable regions of the latent space, by pushing the predicted tokens toward their nearest existing CLIP tokens. Our experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach and show how the learned tokens are more semantic than tokens predicted by unregularized models. This leads to a better representation that achieves state-of-the-art performance while being more flexible than previous methods.
authors: Moab Arar, Rinon Gal, Yuval Atzmon, Gal Chechik, Daniel Cohen-Or, Ariel Shamir, Amit H. Bermano

title: 基于可微分间接操作的高效图形表示
title_en: Efficient Graphics Representation with Differentiable Indirection.
abstract: 我们引入了可微分间接操作——一种新颖的学习原语,它利用可微分多尺度查找表作为传统计算和数据操作在图形流水线中的有效替代方案。我们在多个图形任务中展示了其灵活性,例如几何和图像表示、纹理映射、着色以及辐射场表示。在所有情况下,可微分间接操作都能无缝集成到现有架构中,快速训练,并产生既多功能又高效的结果。
abstract_en: We introduce differentiable indirection – a novel learned primitive that employs differentiable multi-scale lookup tables as an effective substitute for traditional compute and data operations across the graphics pipeline. We demonstrate its flexibility on a number of graphics tasks, i.e., geometric and image representation, texture mapping, shading, and radiance field representation. In all cases, differentiable indirection seamlessly integrates into existing architectures, trains rapidly, and yields both versatile and efficient results.
authors: Sayantan Datta, Carl S. Marshall, Zhao Dong 0001, Zhengqin Li, Derek Nowrouzezahrai

title: 基于单目视频的高效人体运动重建与物理一致性损失
title_en: Efficient Human Motion Reconstruction from Monocular Videos with Physical Consistency Loss.
abstract: 仅视觉的运动重建通常会产生如脚部滑动和抖动等伪影。现有基于物理的方法通常要么简化问题仅关注脚部与地面的接触,要么在物理模拟器中重建全身接触,需要求解耗时的双层优化问题。为克服这些局限性,我们提出了一种高效的梯度方法,用于在物理约束下重建复杂的人体运动(包括高度动态和特技动作)。我们的方法通过可微分的物理一致性损失,在考虑接触和相机对齐的增强搜索空间中重新表述人体运动动力学。这使我们能够将运动重建任务转化为单层轨迹优化问题。实验结果表明,我们的方法可在数分钟内从真实世界视频中重建复杂的人体运动,速度显著快于先前方法。此外,重建结果相比现有方法展现出增强的物理真实感。
abstract_en: Vision-only motion reconstruction from monocular videos often produces artifacts such as foot sliding and jittering. Existing physics-based methods typically either simplify the problem to focus solely on foot-ground contacts, or they reconstruct full-body contacts within a physics simulator, necessitating the solution of a time-consuming bilevel optimization problem. To overcome these limitations, we present an efficient gradient-based method for reconstructing complex human motions (including highly dynamic and acrobatic movements) with physical constraints. Our approach reformulates human motion dynamics through a differentiable physical consistency loss within an augmented search space that accounts both for contacts and camera alignment. This enables us to transform the motion reconstruction task into a single-level trajectory optimization problem. Experimental results demonstrate that our method can reconstruct complex human motions from real-world videos in minutes, which is substantially faster than previous approaches. Additionally, the reconstructed results show enhanced physical realism compared to existing methods.
authors: Lin Cong, Philipp Ruppel, Yizhou Wang 0001, Xiang Pan, Norman Hendrich, Jianwei Zhang 0001

title: 基于内容-情感解耦的情感语音驱动动画
title_en: Emotional Speech-Driven Animation with Content-Emotion Disentanglement.
abstract: 为了被广泛采用,3D面部化身必须能够轻松、真实且直接地从语音信号中进行动画生成。尽管最新方法生成的3D动画能够与输入音频同步,但大多忽视了情感对面部表情的影响。真实的面部动画需要唇同步与自然情感表达相结合。为此,我们提出EMOTE(用于带情感表达的说话模型),该模型生成的3D说话头化身能够在保持语音驱动的唇同步的同时,实现对情感表达的显式控制。为实现这一目标,我们通过解耦的损失函数监督EMOTE,分别对应语音(即唇同步)和情感。这些损失函数基于两个关键观察:(1) 语音引起的面部变形在空间上集中在口部区域且具有高时间频率,而(2) 面部表情可能变形整个面部且持续更长时间。因此,我们通过每帧唇读损失训练EMOTE以保留语音依赖的内容,同时在序列级别监督情感。此外,我们采用内容-情感交换机制,以便在同一音频上监督不同情感,同时保持唇部运动与语音同步。为在避免产生不期望的伪影的情况下使用深度感知损失,我们设计了一种时间变分自编码器(VAE)作为运动先验。由于缺乏高质量的语音对齐情感3D人脸数据集,EMOTE使用从情感视频数据集(即MEAD)提取的3D伪真实值进行训练。广泛的定性与感知评估表明,EMOTE在相同数据集上训练的最先进方法相比,生成的语音驱动面部动画具有更优的唇同步效果,同时提供额外的高质量情感控制。
abstract_en: To be widely adopted, 3D facial avatars must be animated easily, realistically, and directly from speech signals. While the best recent methods generate 3D animations that are synchronized with the input audio, they largely ignore the impact of emotions on facial expressions. Realistic facial animation requires lip-sync together with the natural expression of emotion. To that end, we propose EMOTE (Expressive Model Optimized for Talking with Emotion), which generates 3D talking-head avatars that maintain lip-sync from speech while enabling explicit control over the expression of emotion. To achieve this, we supervise EMOTE with decoupled losses for speech (i.e., lip-sync) and emotion. These losses are based on two key observations: (1) deformations of the face due to speech are spatially localized around the mouth and have high temporal frequency, whereas (2) facial expressions may deform the whole face and occur over longer intervals. Thus we train EMOTE with a per-frame lip-reading loss to preserve the speech-dependent content, while supervising emotion at the sequence level. Furthermore, we employ a content-emotion exchange mechanism in order to supervise different emotions on the same audio, while maintaining the lip motion synchronized with the speech. To employ deep perceptual losses without getting undesirable artifacts, we devise a motion prior in the form of a temporal VAE. Due to the absence of high-quality aligned emotional 3D face datasets with speech, EMOTE is trained with 3D pseudo-ground-truth extracted from an emotional video dataset (i.e., MEAD). Extensive qualitative and perceptual evaluations demonstrate that EMOTE produces speech-driven facial animations with better lip-sync than state-of-the-art methods trained on the same data, while offering additional, high-quality emotional control.
authors: Radek Danecek, Kiran Chhatre, Shashank Tripathi, Yandong Wen, Michael J. Black, Timo Bolkart

title: 基于示例的扩散模型采样
title_en: Example-Based Sampling with Diffusion Models.
abstract: 大量研究致力于开发具有特定性质的采样器,例如生成蓝噪声、低差异、格点或泊松圆盘采样。这些采样器如果依赖优化过程可能会较慢,可能需要广泛数值方法,且不总是可微的。近期扩散模型在图像生成中的成功表明,这些模型可能适合学习如何从示例生成点集。然而,其卷积特性使得这些方法难以处理散点集等非结构化数据。我们提出一种通用方法,利用扩散模型从观测到的点集模仿现有采样器生成二维点集。我们通过最优传输匹配到均匀网格的邻域信息来解决卷积层的问题,这使我们能够受益于网格上的快速卷积,并支持非均匀采样模式的基于示例的学习。我们展示了如何利用方法的可微性优化点集以强制执行特定性质。
abstract_en: Much effort has been put into developing samplers with specific properties, such as producing blue noise, low-discrepancy, lattice or Poisson disk samples. These samplers can be slow if they rely on optimization processes, may rely on a wide range of numerical methods, are not always differentiable. The success of recent diffusion models for image generation suggests that these models could be appropriate for learning how to generate point sets from examples. However, their convolutional nature makes these methods impractical for dealing with scattered data such as point sets. We propose a generic way to produce 2-d point sets imitating existing samplers from observed point sets using a diffusion model. We address the problem of convolutional layers by leveraging neighborhood information from an optimal transport matching to a uniform grid, that allows us to benefit from fast convolutions on grids, and to support the example-based learning of non-uniform sampling patterns. We demonstrate how the differentiability of our approach can be used to optimize point sets to enforce properties.
authors: Bastien Doignies, Nicolas Bonneel, David Coeurjolly, Julie Digne, Loïs Paulin, Jean-Claude Iehl, Victor Ostromoukhov

title: 输入相关非相关加权蒙特卡洛去噪
title_en: Input-Dependent Uncorrelated Weighting for Monte Carlo Denoising.
abstract: 图像空间去噪技术在蒙特卡洛渲染中被广泛应用,通常通过去噪核融合邻近像素估计值。普遍认为,为了确保对多样图像特征和噪声量的鲁棒性,核应适应输入像素估计值的特性。然而,使用这种输入相关核进行去噪可能会引入偏差,使去噪估计值甚至不如原始噪声输入估计值准确。因此,平衡去噪引入的偏差与噪声减少成为关键。我们提出了一种新框架来定义输入相关核,该框架不同于基于误差估计或监督学习的现有方法。与现有方法寻求最优偏差-噪声平衡不同,我们提出通过约束去噪引入的偏差量来实现。这种约束通过非相关统计量的概念实现,该概念此前从未应用于去噪。通过设计针对输入像素估计值的非相关加权输入相关核,我们的去噪核在大多数情况下可显著减少数据相关噪声,且引入的偏差极小。我们在多种场景中验证了该方法的有效性。
abstract_en: Image-space denoising techniques have been widely employed in Monte Carlo rendering, typically blending neighboring pixel estimates using a denoising kernel. It is widely recognized that a kernel should be adapted to characteristics of the input pixel estimates in order to ensure robustness to diverse image features and amount of noise. Denoising with such an input-dependent kernel, however, can introduce a bias that makes the denoised estimate even less accurate than the noisy input estimate. Consequently, it has been considered essential to balance the bias introduced by denoising and the reduction of noise. We propose a new framework to define an input-dependent kernel that departs from the existing approaches based on error estimation or supervised learning. Rather than seeking an optimal bias-noise balance as in those existing approaches, we propose to constrain the amount of bias introduced by denoising. Such a constraint is made possible by the concept of uncorrelated statistics, which has never been applied for denoising. By designing an input-dependent kernel with uncorrelated weights against the input pixel estimates, our denoising kernel can reduce data-dependent noise with a negligible amount of bias in most cases. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method for various scenes.
authors: Jonghee Back, Binh-Son Hua, Toshiya Hachisuka, Bochang Moon

title: 面向光照感知的图像合成内在和谐化方法
title_en: Intrinsic Harmonization for Illumination-Aware Image Compositing.
abstract: 尽管基于网络的图像和谐化技术取得了显著进展,但在推理过程中仍存在典型训练对与现实世界合成图像之间的领域差异。大多数现有方法训练用于逆转对分割图像区域进行的全局编辑,无法准确捕捉合成图像中前景与背景之间的光照不一致性。在本工作中,我们引入了一种自监督的光照和谐化方法,其建模于内在图像域。首先,我们从中级视觉表示中估计一个简单的全局光照模型,以生成前景区域的粗略阴影。随后,网络细化该推断出的阴影,生成与背景场景一致的和谐重新着色。为了匹配前景与背景的颜色外观,我们借鉴先前和谐化方法的思想,在反照率域执行参数化图像编辑。为验证所提方法的有效性,我们展示了具有挑战性的现实世界合成结果,并通过用户研究客观衡量与当前最佳和谐化方法相比所获得的增强现实感。
abstract_en: Despite significant advancements in network-based image harmonization techniques, there still exists a domain disparity between typical training pairs and real-world composites encountered during inference. Most existing methods are trained to reverse global edits made on segmented image regions, which fail to accurately capture the lighting inconsistencies between the foreground and background found in composited images. In this work, we introduce a self-supervised illumination harmonization approach formulated in the intrinsic image domain. First, we estimate a simple global lighting model from mid-level vision representations to generate a rough shading for the foreground region. A network then refines this inferred shading to generate a harmonious re-shading that aligns with the background scene. In order to match the color appearance of the foreground and background, we utilize ideas from prior harmonization approaches to perform parameterized image edits in the albedo domain. To validate the effectiveness of our approach, we present results from challenging real-world composites and conduct a user study to objectively measure the enhanced realism achieved compared to state-of-the-art harmonization methods.
authors: Chris Careaga, S. Mahdi H. Miangoleh, Yagiz Aksoy

title: 逆渲染中的联合采样与优化
title_en: Joint Sampling and Optimisation for Inverse Rendering.
abstract: 在处理如逆渲染等困难的逆问题时,使用蒙特卡洛估计梯度来优化参数可能导致收敛速度变慢,这是由于方差的存在。在每次迭代中平均许多梯度样本可以简单地减少这种方差。然而,对于需要数千次优化迭代的问题,这种方法的计算成本会迅速上升。我们推导了一个将采样与优化交织的理论框架。我们使用低方差的有限差分估计器更新并重用过去的样本,这些估计器描述了每次迭代之间估计梯度的变化。通过结合比例样本和有限差分样本,我们在优化过程中持续降低我们新颖的梯度元估计器的方差。我们研究了我们的估计器与Adam优化器的关联,并推导出一种稳定的组合方式。我们实现了该方法用于逆路径追踪,并展示了我们的估计器如何在困难的优化任务中加速收敛。
abstract_en: When dealing with difficult inverse problems such as inverse rendering, using Monte Carlo estimated gradients to optimise parameters can slow down convergence due to variance. Averaging many gradient samples in each iteration reduces this variance trivially. However, for problems that require thousands of optimisation iterations, the computational cost of this approach rises quickly. We derive a theoretical framework for interleaving sampling and optimisation. We update and reuse past samples with low-variance finite-difference estimators that describe the change in the estimated gradients between each iteration. By combining proportional and finite-difference samples, we continuously reduce the variance of our novel gradient meta-estimators throughout the optimisation process. We investigate how our estimator interlinks with Adam and derive a stable combination. We implement our method for inverse path tracing and demonstrate how our estimator speeds up convergence on difficult optimisation tasks.
authors: Martin Bálint, Karol Myszkowski, Hans-Peter Seidel, Gurprit Singh

title: LiCROM:基于神经场的线性子空间连续降阶建模
title_en: LiCROM: Linear-Subspace Continuous Reduced Order Modeling with Neural Fields.
abstract: 线性降阶建模(ROM)通过使用简化的运动表示近似系统行为,简化复杂模拟。通常,ROM在特定空间离散化生成的输入模拟上进行训练,随后用于加速相同离散化的模拟。这种离散化依赖性具有局限性。摆脱对特定离散化的依赖可提供灵活性,使训练数据能够混合不同网格分辨率、连接性及类型(四面体、六面体);可加速训练期间未见的新离散化模拟;还可加速在时间或参数上动态改变离散化的自适应模拟。我们提出了一种灵活且与离散化无关的降阶建模方法。与传统ROM类似,我们将配置表示为位移场的线性组合。与传统ROM不同,我们的位移场是连续映射,从参考域上的每个点映射到对应的位移向量;这些映射通过隐式神经场表示。借助线性连续ROM(LiCROM),我们的训练集可包含多个经历多种载荷条件的几何体,且与它们的离散化无关。这为降阶建模开辟了新应用。我们现在可加速运行时修改几何体的模拟,例如通过切割、打孔甚至整个网格替换。我们还可加速训练期间未见的几何体模拟。我们展示了单次训练泛化能力,即在单一几何体上训练后,可模拟各种未见几何体。
abstract_en: Linear reduced-order modeling (ROM) simplifies complex simulations by approximating the behavior of a system using a simplified kinematic representation. Typically, ROM is trained on input simulations created with a specific spatial discretization, and then serves to accelerate simulations with the same discretization. This discretization-dependence is restrictive. Becoming independent of a specific discretization would provide flexibility to mix and match mesh resolutions, connectivity, and type (tetrahedral, hexahedral) in training data; to accelerate simulations with novel discretizations unseen during training; and to accelerate adaptive simulations that temporally or parametrically change the discretization. We present a flexible, discretization-independent approach to reduced-order modeling. Like traditional ROM, we represent the configuration as a linear combination of displacement fields. Unlike traditional ROM, our displacement fields are continuous maps from every point on the reference domain to a corresponding displacement vector; these maps are represented as implicit neural fields. With linear continuous ROM (LiCROM), our training set can include multiple geometries undergoing multiple loading conditions, independent of their discretization. This opens the door to novel applications of reduced order modeling. We can now accelerate simulations that modify the geometry at runtime, for instance via cutting, hole punching, and even swapping the entire mesh. We can also accelerate simulations of geometries unseen during training. We demonstrate one-shot generalization, training on a single geometry and subsequently simulating various unseen geometries.
authors: Yue Chang, Peter Yichen Chen, Zhecheng Wang 0001, Maurizio M. Chiaramonte, Kevin Carlberg, Eitan Grinspun

title: 高效全息照明在连续波飞行时间成像中的应用
title_en: Light-Efficient Holographic Illumination for Continuous-Wave Time-of-Flight Imaging.
abstract: 飞行时间(TOF)相机近年来在各类消费级设备中得到广泛应用。然而,这些设备本质上受到动态范围的限制,难以处理近距离明亮物体导致的过饱和以及远距离暗物体产生的噪声深度。在本文中,我们探讨了通过使用能够根据任意模式重新分配光的全息光源,在连续波飞行时间(CWTOF)设备中克服这些限制的方法。具体而言,我们提出利用此类系统将场景中过曝区域的光转移到欠曝区域,从而使整个场景得到良好曝光。此类方法可以轻松集成到现有的TOF照明方案中。我们的概念验证原型由现成光学组件构建,并在多个实验室场景中进行了演示。
abstract_en: Time-of-flight (TOF) cameras have seen widespread adoption in recent years across the entire spectrum of commodity devices. However, these devices are fundamentally limited by their dynamic range, struggling with saturation from nearby, brighter objects and noisy depth from farther, darker objects. In this work, we explore overcoming these limitations in the context of continuous-wave time-of-flight (CWTOF) devices, by using a holographic light source capable of redistributing light according to arbitrary patterns. In particular, we propose using such a system to move light from overexposed to underexposed regions of a scene, such that the entire scene is well exposed. Such a methodology can be easily integrated with existing illumination schemes for TOF. Our proof-of-concept prototype is constructed from off-the-shelf optical components, and demonstrated on a number of lab scenes.
authors: Dorian Chan, Matthew O'Toole

title: LiveNVS: 神经视图合成在实时RGB-D流上的应用
title_en: LiveNVS: Neural View Synthesis on Live RGB-D Streams.
abstract: 现有实时RGB-D重建方法,如Kinect Fusion,缺乏实时逼真可视化。这归因于由不完美深度图和相机姿态融合产生的噪声、过度平滑或不完整的几何结构以及模糊的纹理。近期神经渲染方法虽能克服诸多此类伪影,但多针对离线使用进行优化,阻碍了其在实时重建管道中的集成。本文提出LiveNVS系统,可在实时RGB-D输入流上实现极低延迟和实时渲染的神经新视图合成。基于RGB-D输入流,通过密集融合的深度图将神经特征投影至目标视图,并在图像空间中聚合特征生成目标特征图。通用神经网络随后将目标特征图转换为高质量RGB图像。LiveNVS在捕获过程中实现未知场景的最先进神经渲染质量,使用户可实时虚拟探索场景并评估重建质量。
abstract_en: Existing real-time RGB-D reconstruction approaches, like Kinect Fusion, lack real-time photo-realistic visualization. This is due to noisy, oversmoothed or incomplete geometry and blurry textures which are fused from imperfect depth maps and camera poses. Recent neural rendering methods can overcome many of such artifacts but are mostly optimized for offline usage, hindering the integration into a live reconstruction pipeline. In this paper, we present LiveNVS, a system that allows for neural novel view synthesis on a live RGB-D input stream with very low latency and real-time rendering. Based on the RGB-D input stream, novel views are rendered by projecting neural features into the target view via a densely fused depth map and aggregating the features in image-space to a target feature map. A generalizable neural network then translates the target feature map into a high-quality RGB image. LiveNVS achieves state-of-the-art neural rendering quality of unknown scenes during capturing, allowing users to virtually explore the scene and assess reconstruction quality in real-time.
authors: Laura Fink, Darius Rückert, Linus Franke, Joachim Keinert, Marc Stamminger

title: 面向多核网格缩减的无锁顶点聚类
title_en: Lock-free Vertex Clustering for Multicore Mesh Reduction.
abstract: 现代数据采集方法能够以远高于图像离散渲染分辨率的精度捕捉三维物体的表示。为了提高由此类数据构建的三维模型在存储、传输、渲染和编辑方面的效率,首先采用网格缩减技术以减小网格规模是有益的。顶点聚类技术通过合并邻近顶点具有广泛适用性,因为它仅作用于顶点及其空间邻近性。然而,由于其包含大量算法依赖关系,以确定性方式加速该技术非常困难。先前工作将这一过程中的非平凡聚类步骤串行处理以保持顶点优先级,这从根本上限制了整体加速率最多达到个位数。本文引入了一种新颖的无锁并行算法P-Weld,通过图论视角迭代剥离网格中无剩余依赖的层以暴露并行性。共享数据的并发更新通过线性化原子指令序列进行管理,精确复现串行聚类过程。结果的并行性与改进的空间局部性在标准1400万顶点网格上实现3.86倍加速,在覆盖加拿大温哥华市的4亿顶点LiDaR点云上实现2.93倍加速,相对于流行开源库。
abstract_en: Modern data collection methods can capture representations of 3D objects at resolutions much greater than they can be discretely rendered as an image. To improve the efficiency of storage, transmission, rendering, and editing of 3D models constructed from such data, it is beneficial to first employ a mesh reduction technique to reduce the size of a mesh. Vertex clustering, a technique that merges close vertices together, has particularly wide applicability, because it operates only on vertices and their spatial proximity. However, it is also very difficult to accelerate with parallelisation in a deterministic manner because it contains extensive algorithmic dependencies. Prior work treats the non-trivial clustering step of this process serially to preserve vertex priorities, which fundamentally limits to mid-single digits the acceleration rates that are possible for the process overall. This paper introduces a novel lock-free parallel algorithm, P-Weld, that exposes parallelism with a graph-theoretic lens that iteratively peels away layers of a mesh that have no remaining dependencies. Concurrent updates to shared data are managed with a linearisable sequence of atomic instructions that exactly reproduces the serial clustering. The resulting parallelism and improved spatial locality yield a 3.86 × speedup on a standard 14-million vertex mesh and a 2.93 × speedup on a 400-million vertex LiDaR point cloud covering the city of Vancouver, Canada, relative to a popular open source library.
authors: Nima Fathollahi, Sean Chester

title: 基于不变性原理的多反射Smith微面元BRDF
title_en: Multiple-bounce Smith Microfacet BRDFs using the Invariance Principle.
abstract: Smith微面元模型广泛应用于计算机图形学中以表示材料特性。传统微面元模型未考虑微几何体上的多反射,导致可见能量缺失,尤其在粗糙表面上更为明显。随后,随着微面元与体积等价性的揭示,随机游走解法被提出以引入多反射,但代价是高方差。近期,无位置属性被引入多反射模型,显著降低了噪声,但也引入了偏差或复杂的推导过程。本文提出一种基于不变性原理的简单方法,推导多反射Smith微面元双向反射分布函数(BRDF)。我们的模型核心是一个路径方向集合的遮蔽-阴影函数,而非分离的反射事件。该模型确保无偏性,并在同等时间内相比前人工作产生更少噪声,得益于其简洁的公式形式。此外,我们还提出了一种新颖的BRDF多重重要性采样概率密度函数(PDF),其与多反射BRDF匹配度更高,产生的噪声少于先前的简单近似方法。
abstract_en: Smith microfacet models are widely used in computer graphics to represent materials. Traditional microfacet models do not consider the multiple bounces on microgeometries, leading to visible energy missing, especially on rough surfaces. Later, as the equivalence between the microfacets and volume has been revealed, random walk solutions have been proposed to introduce multiple bounces, but at the cost of high variance. Recently, the position-free property has been introduced into the multiple-bounce model, resulting in much less noise, but also bias or a complex derivation.In this paper, we propose a simple way to derive the multiple-bounce Smith microfacet bidirectional reflectance distribution functions (BRDFs) using the invariance principle. At the core of our model is a shadowing-masking function for a path consisting of direction collections, rather than separated bounces. Our model ensures unbiasedness and can produce less noise compared to the previous work with equal time, thanks to the simple formulation. Furthermore, we also propose a novel probability density function (PDF) for BRDF multiple importance sampling, which has a better match with the multiple-bounce BRDFs, producing less noise than previous naive approximations.
authors: Yuang Cui, Gaole Pan, Jian Yang 0003, Lei Zhang 0006, Lingqi Yan 0001, Beibei Wang 0002

title: MuscleVAE:基于模型的肌肉驱动角色控制器
title_en: MuscleVAE: Model-Based Controllers of Muscle-Actuated Characters.
abstract: 本文提出了一种模拟与控制框架,用于生成肌肉驱动角色的生物力学合理运动。我们将疲劳动力学模型3CC-r模型整合到广泛采用的Hill型肌肉模型中,以模拟肌肉疲劳的发展与恢复过程,从而通过长时间活动导致的疲劳积累,创造出由疲劳引起的自然运动风格演变。为了解决高自由度肌骨骼系统的控制难题,我们提出了一种基于PD控制的新型肌肉空间控制策略。我们的模拟与控制框架支持肌肉运动控制生成模型的训练,该模型称为MuscleVAE。通过利用变分自编码器(VAEs),MuscleVAE能够从大规模无结构运动数据集中学习丰富的、灵活的技能潜在表示,不仅编码运动特征,还编码肌肉控制和疲劳特性。我们证明MuscleVAE模型可以通过基于模型的方法高效训练,从而生成高保真运动,并支持多种下游任务。
abstract_en: In this paper, we present a simulation and control framework for generating biomechanically plausible motion for muscle-actuated characters. We incorporate a fatigue dynamics model, the 3CC-r model, into the widely-adopted Hill-type muscle model to simulate the development and recovery of fatigue in muscles, which creates a natural evolution of motion style caused by the accumulation of fatigue from prolonged activities. To address the challenging problem of controlling a musculoskeletal system with high degrees of freedom, we propose a novel muscle-space control strategy based on PD control. Our simulation and control framework facilitates the training of a generative model for muscle-based motion control, which we refer to as MuscleVAE. By leveraging the variational autoencoders (VAEs), MuscleVAE is capable of learning a rich and flexible latent representation of skills from a large unstructured motion dataset, encoding not only motion features but also muscle control and fatigue properties. We demonstrate that the MuscleVAE model can be efficiently trained using a model-based approach, resulting in the production of high-fidelity motions and enabling a variety of downstream tasks.
authors: Yusen Feng, Xiyan Xu, Libin Liu 0002

title: 面向定向点法线估计的神经梯度学习与优化
title_en: Neural Gradient Learning and Optimization for Oriented Point Normal Estimation.
abstract: 我们提出了一种名为神经梯度学习(NGL)的深度学习方法,用于从3D点云中学习具有一致方向的梯度向量以进行法线估计。该方法在数据的底层几何结构上具有出色的梯度近似特性。我们利用一个简单的神经网络对目标函数进行参数化,通过全局隐式表示在点上生成梯度。然而,由于缺乏局部细节描述,推导出的梯度通常会偏离真实定向法线。因此,我们引入梯度向量优化(GVO),基于局部平面几何学习角度距离场以细化粗糙的梯度向量。最后,我们将方法公式化为一个两阶段的流程:先进行粗略估计,再进行细化。此外,我们将两个加权函数(即各向异性核和内点分数)整合到优化过程中,以提高方法的鲁棒性和细节保持性能。我们的方法在高效进行全局梯度近似的同时,实现了更准确的局部特征描述和更好的泛化能力。这使得我们提出了一种对噪声、离群点和点密度变化具有鲁棒性的最先进的法线估计器。广泛评估表明,我们的方法在常用基准测试中,无论是无方向还是有方向的法线估计,均优于以往的工作。源代码和预训练模型可在https://github.com/LeoQLi/NGLO获取。
abstract_en: We propose Neural Gradient Learning (NGL), a deep learning approach to learn gradient vectors with consistent orientation from 3D point clouds for normal estimation. It has excellent gradient approximation properties for the underlying geometry of the data. We utilize a simple neural network to parameterize the objective function to produce gradients at points using a global implicit representation. However, the derived gradients usually drift away from the ground-truth oriented normals due to the lack of local detail descriptions. Therefore, we introduce Gradient Vector Optimization (GVO) to learn an angular distance field based on local plane geometry to refine the coarse gradient vectors. Finally, we formulate our method with a two-phase pipeline of coarse estimation followed by refinement. Moreover, we integrate two weighting functions, i.e., anisotropic kernel and inlier score, into the optimization to improve the robust and detail-preserving performance. Our method efficiently conducts global gradient approximation while achieving better accuracy and generalization ability of local feature description. This leads to a state-of-the-art normal estimator that is robust to noise, outliers and point density variations. Extensive evaluations show that our method outperforms previous works in both unoriented and oriented normal estimation on widely used benchmarks. The source code and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/LeoQLi/NGLO .
authors: Qing Li 0032, Huifang Feng 0002, Kanle Shi, Yi Fang 0006, Yu-Shen Liu, Zhizhong Han

title: 姿态与骨骼感知的神经逆运动学用于姿态和运动编辑
title_en: Pose and Skeleton-aware Neural IK for Pose and Motion Editing.
abstract: 为电影或游戏中的3D角色设定姿态是一个迭代且繁琐的过程,需要操控许多控制柄(如关节)以达到令人满意的结果。神经逆运动学(Neural Inverse Kinematics, IK)是一种新型的逆运动学方法,它能够对3D角色姿态进行稀疏控制,并利用全身相关性完成未被操控的关节部分。尽管神经IK具有前景,但当前方法并未设计用于在姿态工作流程中保留先前编辑。当前模型仅根据控制柄生成单一姿态——无论之前的状态如何——这使得难以保留任何变化,并阻碍了姿态和运动编辑等任务。在本文中,我们引入了SKEL-IK,这是一种新型的架构和训练方案,其条件基于基础姿态,并设计为直接将信息流映射到骨骼图结构,从而通过在特定关节处阻断信息流来强制执行硬约束。因此,我们能够同时满足硬约束和软约束,并在需要时保留未被操控的身体部分。最后,通过以不同方式控制基础姿态,我们展示了模型在生成变化、快速编辑姿态和运动方面的能力;与当前最先进的方法相比,基础姿态的退化程度更低。
abstract_en: Posing a 3D character for film or game is an iterative and laborious process where many control handles (e.g. joints) need to be manipulated to achieve a compelling result. Neural Inverse Kinematics (IK) is a new type of IK that enables sparse control over a 3D character pose, and leverages full body correlations to complete the un-manipulated joints of the body. While neural IK is promising, current methods are not designed to preserve previous edits in posing workflows. Current models generate a single pose from the handles only—regardless of what was there previously—making it difficult to preserve any variations and hindering tasks such as pose and motion editing. In this paper, we introduce SKEL-IK, a novel architecture and training scheme that is conditioned on a base pose, and designed to flow information directly onto the skeletal graph structure, such that hard constraints can be enforced by blocking information flows at certain joints. As a result, we are able to satisfy both hard and soft constraints, as well as preserve un-manipulated parts of the body when desired. Finally, by controlling the base pose in different ways, we demonstrate the ability of our model to perform tasks such as generating variations and quickly editing poses and motions; with less erosion of the base poses compared to the current state-of-the-art.
authors: Dhruv Agrawal, Martin Guay, Jakob Buhmann, Dominik Borer, Robert W. Sumner

title: 自校准、全可微分的非视线逆渲染
title_en: Self-Calibrating, Fully Differentiable NLOS Inverse Rendering.
abstract: 现有时间分辨非视线(NLOS)成像方法通过逆向计算可见中继表面上间接照明的光学路径来重建隐藏场景。这些方法由于逆向过程中的歧义性和捕获噪声容易产生重建伪影,通常通过手动选择滤波函数和参数进行缓解。我们提出了一种全可微分的端到端NLOS逆渲染流程,该流程在重建隐藏场景时通过仅输入测量的照明数据,同时在时域和频域中工作,自校准成像参数。我们的流程从NLOS体强度中提取隐藏场景的几何表示,并利用可微分瞬态渲染估计由该几何信息在中继壁上产生的时序分辨照明。随后,我们通过最小化模拟时序分辨照明与测量照明之间的误差,使用梯度下降优化成像参数。我们的端到端可微分流程将基于衍射的体NLOS重建与路径空间光传输及简单的光线行进技术相结合,以提取隐藏场景的详细密集表面点集和法线。我们展示了该方法在显著噪声水平下仍能稳健地重建几何形状和反照率的鲁棒性。
abstract_en: Existing time-resolved non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging methods reconstruct hidden scenes by inverting the optical paths of indirect illumination measured at visible relay surfaces. These methods are prone to reconstruction artifacts due to inversion ambiguities and capture noise, which are typically mitigated through the manual selection of filtering functions and parameters. We introduce a fully-differentiable end-to-end NLOS inverse rendering pipeline that self-calibrates the imaging parameters during the reconstruction of hidden scenes, using as input only the measured illumination while working both in the time and frequency domains. Our pipeline extracts a geometric representation of the hidden scene from NLOS volumetric intensities and estimates the time-resolved illumination at the relay wall produced by such geometric information using differentiable transient rendering. We then use gradient descent to optimize imaging parameters by minimizing the error between our simulated time-resolved illumination and the measured illumination. Our end-to-end differentiable pipeline couples diffraction-based volumetric NLOS reconstruction with path-space light transport and a simple ray marching technique to extract detailed, dense sets of surface points and normals of hidden scenes.We demonstrate the robustness of our method to consistently reconstruct geometry and albedo, even under significant noise levels.
authors: Kiseok Choi, Inchul Kim, Dongyoung Choi, Julio Marco, Diego Gutierrez, Min H. Kim 0001

title: ShaDDR: 基于示例的交互式几何与纹理生成:通过三维形状细化与可微渲染
title_en: ShaDDR: Interactive Example-Based Geometry and Texture Generation via 3D Shape Detailization and Differentiable Rendering.
abstract: 我们提出ShaDDR,一种基于示例的深度生成神经网络,通过几何细化和条件纹理生成,从输入的粗略体素形状生成高分辨率纹理化三维形状。该方法在少量详细且带有纹理的示例形状上进行训练,能够通过多分辨率体素上采样实现几何细化,并通过可微渲染对抗示例纹理图像(来自少量视角)生成体素表面纹理。生成过程具有交互性,可在不到1秒内生成体素分辨率达5123的三维模型。生成的形状保留输入粗略体素模型的整体结构,而生成的几何细节和纹理风格可通过学习到的潜在编码进行操控。实验表明,与先前方法相比,我们的方法能够生成具有合理且改进的几何细节和干净纹理的更高分辨率形状。此外,我们展示了该方法从真实世界照片重建的形状中学习几何细节和纹理的能力。另外,我们开发了一个交互式建模应用,以展示该方法对各种用户输入的通用性和可控性,允许用户交互式雕刻粗略体素形状以定义细化三维形状的整体结构。代码和数据可在https://github.com/qiminchen/ShaDDR获取。
abstract_en: We present ShaDDR, an example-based deep generative neural network which produces a high-resolution textured 3D shape through geometry detailization and conditional texture generation applied to an input coarse voxel shape. Trained on a small set of detailed and textured exemplar shapes, our method learns to detailize the geometry via multi-resolution voxel upsampling and generate textures on voxel surfaces via differentiable rendering against exemplar texture images from a few views. The generation is interactive, taking less than 1 second to produce a 3D model with voxel resolutions up to 5123. The generated shape preserves the overall structure of the input coarse voxel model, while the style of the generated geometric details and textures can be manipulated through learned latent codes. In the experiments, we show that our method can generate higher-resolution shapes with plausible and improved geometric details and clean textures compared to prior works. Furthermore, we showcase the ability of our method to learn geometric details and textures from shapes reconstructed from real-world photos. In addition, we have developed an interactive modeling application to demonstrate the generalizability of our method to various user inputs and the controllability it offers, allowing users to interactively sculpt a coarse voxel shape to define the overall structure of the detailized 3D shape. Code and data are available at https://github.com/qiminchen/ShaDDR.
authors: Qimin Chen, Zhiqin Chen, Hang Zhou 0007, Hao Zhang 0002

title: 单图像引导的形状扩散三维人体数字化
title_en: Single-Image 3D Human Digitization with Shape-guided Diffusion.
abstract: 我们提出了一种方法,从单张输入图像生成具有连贯高分辨率外观的360度视角的人体视图。NeRF及其变体通常需要视频或不同视角的图像。现有大多数采用单目输入的方法要么依赖于真实3D扫描数据进行监督,要么缺乏3D一致性。尽管近期的3D生成模型在3D一致人体数字化方面展现出潜力,但这些方法难以泛化到多样化的服装外观,生成结果缺乏照片级真实感。与现有工作不同,我们利用预训练用于通用图像合成任务的高容量2D扩散模型作为穿衣人体的外观先验。为了在保留输入身份的同时实现更好的3D一致性,我们通过形状引导的扩散模型,基于轮廓和表面法线条件,对输入图像中缺失区域进行修复,逐步合成多视角图像。随后通过逆渲染融合这些合成的多视角图像,获得目标人物的完整纹理高分辨率3D网格。实验表明,我们的方法优于现有方法,能够从单张图像实现复杂纹理穿衣人体的360度照片级真实感合成。
abstract_en: We present an approach to generate a 360-degree view of a person with a consistent, high-resolution appearance from a single input image. NeRF and its variants typically require videos or images from different viewpoints. Most existing approaches taking monocular input either rely on ground-truth 3D scans for supervision or lack 3D consistency. While recent 3D generative models show promise of 3D consistent human digitization, these approaches do not generalize well to diverse clothing appearances, and the results lack photorealism. Unlike existing work, we utilize high-capacity 2D diffusion models pretrained for general image synthesis tasks as an appearance prior of clothed humans. To achieve better 3D consistency while retaining the input identity, we progressively synthesize multiple views of the human in the input image by inpainting missing regions with shape-guided diffusion conditioned on silhouette and surface normal. We then fuse these synthesized multi-view images via inverse rendering to obtain a fully textured high-resolution 3D mesh of the given person. Experiments show that our approach outperforms prior methods and achieves photorealistic 360-degree synthesis of a wide range of clothed humans with complex textures from a single image.

title: 显示能力对真实与虚拟物体光泽一致性的影响
title_en: The effect of display capabilities on the gloss consistency between real and virtual objects.
abstract: 光泽的忠实再现固然是困难的,因为显示设备的动态范围、峰值亮度和3D能力有限。本研究探讨了显示能力如何影响光泽外观与现实参照物体之间的关系。为此,我们采用精确的成像流程,在增强现实高动态范围(HDR)立体显示上实现虚拟与真实物体并列呈现时的感知光泽匹配,这一成果此前尚未达到如此程度。基于这种精确的光泽再现,我们开展了一系列光泽匹配实验,研究光泽感知如何受到个体因素的影响:物体反照率、显示亮度、动态范围、立体视觉和色调映射。我们通过详细分析个体因素,随后深入讨论观察到的感知效应来支持本研究。实验结果表明,立体呈现对HDR显示上的光泽匹配任务影响有限。然而,显示亮度和动态范围的降低会减少感知到的光泽。这意味着视觉系统无法补偿光泽外观在亮度变化(缺乏光泽恒常性)上的变化,且在低动态范围(LDR)显示上再现光泽时应谨慎选择色调映射运算符。
abstract_en: A faithful reproduction of gloss is inherently difficult because of the limited dynamic range, peak luminance, and 3D capabilities of display devices. This work investigates how the display capabilities affect gloss appearance with respect to a real-world reference object. To this end, we employ an accurate imaging pipeline to achieve a perceptual gloss match between a virtual and real object presented side-by-side on an augmented-reality high-dynamic-range (HDR) stereoscopic display, which has not been previously attained to this extent. Based on this precise gloss reproduction, we conduct a series of gloss matching experiments to study how gloss perception degrades based on individual factors: object albedo, display luminance, dynamic range, stereopsis, and tone mapping. We support the study with a detailed analysis of individual factors, followed by an in-depth discussion on the observed perceptual effects. Our experiments demonstrate that stereoscopic presentation has a limited effect on the gloss matching task on our HDR display. However, both reduced luminance and dynamic range of the display reduce the perceived gloss. This means that the visual system cannot compensate for the changes in gloss appearance across luminance (lack of gloss constancy), and the tone mapping operator should be carefully selected when reproducing gloss on a low dynamic range (LDR) display.

title: 基于隐式可微折射渲染的透明物体重建
title_en: Transparent Object Reconstruction via Implicit Differentiable Refraction Rendering.
abstract: 透明物体几何重建一直是一个长期存在的挑战。现有方法依赖于复杂的设置,如手动标注或暗室条件,以获取物体轮廓,通常需要受控环境和设计图案来推断射线-背景对应关系。然而,这些复杂安排限制了普通用户的实际应用。在本文中,我们显著简化了设置,并提出了一种新颖方法,可在未知自然场景中无需人工辅助重建透明物体。我们的方法包含两项关键技术。首先,我们引入基于体渲染的方法,通过将3D神经场投影到2D图像上估计物体轮廓。这一自动化过程可从自然场景中捕获的图像中生成高精度的多视角物体轮廓。其次,我们提出通过神经SDF场的可微折射渲染实现透明物体优化,使我们能够基于颜色而非显式的射线-背景对应关系优化折射射线。此外,我们的优化包含一种射线采样方法,以低计算成本监督物体轮廓。大量实验和对比表明,我们的方法在提供更便捷设置的同时生成高质量结果。
abstract_en: Reconstructing the geometry of transparent objects has been a long-standing challenge. Existing methods rely on complex setups, such as manual annotation or darkroom conditions, to obtain object silhouettes and usually require controlled environments with designed patterns to infer ray-background correspondence. However, these intricate arrangements limit the practical application for common users. In this paper, we significantly simplify the setups and present a novel method that reconstructs transparent objects in unknown natural scenes without manual assistance. Our method incorporates two key technologies. Firstly, we introduce a volume rendering-based method that estimates object silhouettes by projecting the 3D neural field onto 2D images. This automated process yields highly accurate multi-view object silhouettes from images captured in natural scenes. Secondly, we propose transparent object optimization through differentiable refraction rendering with the neural SDF field, enabling us to optimize the refraction ray based on color rather than explicit ray-background correspondence. Additionally, our optimization includes a ray sampling method to supervise the object silhouette at a low computational cost. Extensive experiments and comparisons demonstrate that our method produces high-quality results while offering much more convenient setups.

title: 零样本三维形状对应
title_en: Zero-Shot 3D Shape Correspondence.
abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的零样本方法,用于计算三维形状之间的对应关系。现有方法主要关注等距和近等距形状对(例如人类与人类),但对强非等距和跨类形状匹配(例如人类与牛)的关注较少。为此,我们引入了一种全自动方法,利用近期语言和视觉基础模型的卓越推理能力来解决困难的形状对应问题。我们的方法包含多个阶段。首先,我们通过将渲染的形状视图输入语言-视觉模型(例如BLIP2)以零样本方式对三维形状进行分类,为每个形状生成类别提案列表。这些提案通过ChatGPT的推理能力统一为每个形状的单一类别。其次,我们尝试以零样本方式对两个形状进行分割,但与共分割问题不同,我们不需要互惠的语义区域集合。相反,我们提出利用ChatGPT的上下文学习能力,为每个形状生成两组不同的语义区域,并建立它们之间的语义映射。这使我们的方法能够匹配具有显著几何结构差异的强非等距形状。最后,我们利用生成的语义映射生成粗略对应关系,这些对应关系可通过功能图框架进一步细化以生成密集的点对点映射。尽管方法简单,我们的方法以零样本方式产生了高度可信的结果,尤其是在强非等距形状之间。
abstract_en: We propose a novel zero-shot approach to computing correspondences between 3D shapes. Existing approaches mainly focus on isometric and near-isometric shape pairs (e.g., human vs. human), but less attention has been given to strongly non-isometric and inter-class shape matching (e.g., human vs. cow). To this end, we introduce a fully automatic method that exploits the exceptional reasoning capabilities of recent foundation models in language and vision to tackle difficult shape correspondence problems. Our approach comprises multiple stages. First, we classify the 3D shapes in a zero-shot manner by feeding rendered shape views to a language-vision model (e.g., BLIP2) to generate a list of class proposals per shape. These proposals are unified into a single class per shape by employing the reasoning capabilities of ChatGPT. Second, we attempt to segment the two shapes in a zero-shot manner, but in contrast to the co-segmentation problem, we do not require a mutual set of semantic regions. Instead, we propose to exploit the in-context learning capabilities of ChatGPT to generate two different sets of semantic regions for each shape and a semantic mapping between them. This enables our approach to match strongly non-isometric shapes with significant differences in geometric structure. Finally, we employ the generated semantic mapping to produce coarse correspondences that can further be refined by the functional maps framework to produce dense point-to-point maps. Our approach, despite its simplicity, produces highly plausible results in a zero-shot manner, especially between strongly non-isometric shapes.
